informal_problem.statement:
theorem positive_mass [T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) :
    ∀ k : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ m : ℝ,
      Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => admFlux g (hAF.ends k) r) atTop (𝓝 m) ∧
      0 ≤ m ∧ (m = 0 ↔ IsometricToEuclidean g)

signature.statement:
theorem positive_mass [T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) :
    ∀ k : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ m : ℝ,
      Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => admFlux g (hAF.ends k) r) atTop (𝓝 m) ∧
      0 ≤ m ∧ (m = 0 ↔ IsometricToEuclidean g)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro k
  have hsrc : (hAF.ends k).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends k).source_eq
  have hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro i j
    rw [← hsrc]
    exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g (hAF.ends k).Φ i j
  have hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x i j = g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x j i := by
    intro x i j
    exact g.symm _ _ _
  have hint : IntegrableOn
      (fun x : E3 => scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) x *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x).det) {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} := by
    refine (hAF.integrable_scalarCurvature k).congr_fun ?_
      (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm)
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by
      have h2 : (2 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := hx
      rw [hsrc]
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖
      linarith
    simp only
    rw [scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff g (hAF.ends k).Φ x hx']
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := adm_flux_converges (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) hAF.q hAF.q_gt hsmooth hsymm
    (hAF.decay k) hint
  have hm' : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => admFlux g (hAF.ends k) r) atTop (𝓝 m) := hm
  refine ⟨m, hm', mass_nonneg g hComplete hAF hR k m hm', ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    rw [h0] at hm'
    exact ricci_flat_asymptoticallyFlat_isometric g hComplete hAF k
      (mass_zero_ricci_flat g hComplete hAF hR k hm')
  · intro hiso
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hm' (flux_tendsto_zero_of_isometric g hAF hiso k)

subgoal_signatures.name: adm_flux_converges
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 1 / 2 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i)
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ)))
    (hint : IntegrableOn (fun x : E3 => scalarCurvatureLocal G x * Real.sqrt (G x).det)
      {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖}) :
    ∃ m : ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => 1 / (16 * Real.pi) * r ^ 2 *
      ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1),
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r • (θ : E3))
            - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j
        ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere) atTop (𝓝 m)

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source

signature.name: coeff_contDiffOn_source
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hw : ∀ w : E3, w = ∑ a : Fin 3, w a • e a := by
    intro w
    ext k
    simp [e, Pi.single_apply]
  
  have hexp : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (w1 w2 : E3),
      B (D w1) (D w2) = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
    intro B D w1 w2
    calc B (D w1) (D w2)
        = B (D (∑ a : Fin 3, w1 a • e a)) (D (∑ b : Fin 3, w2 b • e b)) := by
          rw [← hw w1, ← hw w2]
      _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
          simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          ring
  have hΦ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ Φ.source := Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun
  apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
  intro x0 hx0
  
  have hu : IsOpen (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) :=
    hΦ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Φ.open_source (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).open_source
  
  have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y))
      (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) := by
    have h1 := (contMDiffOn_iff_target.mp hΦ).2 (Φ x0)
    rw [extChartAt_source] at h1
    have h2 := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    simpa [extChartAt_coe, Function.comp_def] using h2
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y))
      (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).target :=
    fun y hy => (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).map_source hy.2
  
  have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)))
      (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hu).mp hF).2
  have hcoord : ∀ k a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun x => (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e k)) a)
      (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) := by
    intro k a
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e k))
        (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) := hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
  have hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun x => g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) a b)
      (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) :=
    fun a b => (g.smooth (Φ x0) a b).comp hF hmaps
  have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e i)) a *
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e j)) b *
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) a b)
      (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) := by
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro a _
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro b _
    exact ((hcoord i a).mul (hcoord j b)).mul (hG a b)
  
  have key : ∀ x ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source,
      g.coeff Φ x i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e i)) a *
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e j)) b *
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) a b := by
    intro x hx
    have hcont : ContinuousAt Φ x :=
      hΦ.continuousOn.continuousAt (Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hx.1)
    have hFdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x :=
      (hF.contDiffAt (hu.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hFx : chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x) ∈ (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).target := hmaps hx
    have hev : (Φ : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm ∘ fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) := by
      have hmem : (Φ : E3 → M) ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source ∈ 𝓝 x :=
        hcont.preimage_mem_nhds ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).open_source.mem_nhds hx.2)
      filter_upwards [hmem] with y hy
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      exact ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).left_inv hy).symm
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) :=
      ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (n := ∞)).contMDiffAt
        ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).open_target.mem_nhds hFx)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hfac : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ x v =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x))
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x v) := by
      intro v
      rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp x hg hFdiff.mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      rfl
    have hpt : (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) = Φ x :=
      (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).left_inv hx.2
    have h1 : g.coeff Φ x i j = g.g (Φ x) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ x (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ x (e j)) := rfl
    have h2 : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) a b =
        g.g (Φ x)
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) (e a))
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) (e b)) := by
      intro a b
      show g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x))) _ _ = _
      rw [show g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x))) = g.g (Φ x) from
        congrArg g.g hpt]
    rw [h1, hfac, hfac]
    simp only [h2]
    exact hexp (g.g (Φ x))
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)))
      _ _
  refine ⟨Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source, hu,
    ⟨hx0, mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x0)⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.inter_eq_right.mpr Set.inter_subset_left]
  exact hR.congr key

    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) :

signature.name: scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) :
    g.scalarCurvature (Φ x) = scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff Φ) x

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hu : ∀ u : E3, u = ∑ d : Fin 3, u d • e d := by
    intro u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hcomp_e : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) a = v a := by
    intro v a
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  have hcompo : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z → ∀ l d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z = (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) d := by
    intro ψ z hψ l d
    have hfun : (fun v => ψ v d) = (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ ψ := by
      funext v; simp
    rw [partialDeriv, hfun, fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj d).differentiableAt hψ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp
  have dmul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z → DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => f w * g w) z := fun f g z hf hg => hf.mul hg
  have pd_add : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => f w + g w) z = partialDeriv l f z + partialDeriv l g z := by
    intro f g z l hf hg
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_add hf hg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
  have pd_mul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => f w * g w) z = partialDeriv l f z * g z + f z * partialDeriv l g z := by
    intro f g z l hf hg
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_mul hf hg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have pd_sum : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f a) z) →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, f a w) z = ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv l (f a) z := by
    intro f z l hf
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_sum (fun a _ => hf a), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have pd_comp : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ψ z) → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d F (ψ z) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z := by
    intro F ψ z hψ hF l
    have h1 : partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z = fderiv ℝ F (ψ z) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (F ∘ ψ) z (e l) = _
      rw [fderiv_comp z hF hψ]
      rfl
    rw [h1, hu (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)), map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcompo ψ z hψ]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d _
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  have hpdU : ∀ (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ i,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) U := by
    intro U hU f hf i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) U := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have christoffel_contDiffOn : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3), IsOpen V →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V) → (∀ y ∈ V, (G y).det ≠ 0) →
      ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) V := by
    intro G V hV hG hdet k i j
    have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) V := by
      simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      repeat (first | apply ContDiffOn.sub | apply ContDiffOn.add | apply ContDiffOn.mul | exact hG _ _)
    have hadj : ∀ a b, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).adjugate a b) V := by
      intro a b
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
        simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_zero,
          Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.empty_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,
          Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Fin.isValue] <;>
        repeat (first | apply ContDiffOn.sub | apply ContDiffOn.add | apply ContDiffOn.mul | apply ContDiffOn.neg | exact hG _ _)
    have hinv : ∀ a b, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) V := by
      intro a b
      have : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) = fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate a b := by
        funext y

    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y
        - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y)) V
    apply ContDiffOn.mul contDiffOn_const
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro l _
    exact (hinv k l).mul
      (((hpdU V hV _ (hG j l) i).add (hpdU V hV _ (hG i l) j)).sub (hpdU V hV _ (hG i j) l))
  
  have pullback_partialDeriv : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U V : Set E3),

            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z *

            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z * G (ψ z) a b *
              partialDeriv l (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b)) z) := by
    intro ψ G U V hU hV hψ hmaps hG z hz l i j
    have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z :=
      (hψ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hJd : ∀ a k : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v a)) z := by

      ((hG a b).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hmaps z hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hGψd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G (ψ w) a b) z :=
      fun a b => (hGd a b).comp z hψd
    have htd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w *
        G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z :=
      fun a b => dmul _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b)) (hJd b j)
    rw [pd_sum _ _ _ (fun a => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => htd a b))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [pd_sum _ _ _ (fun b => htd a b)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    rw [pd_mul _ _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b)) (hJd b j),
      pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b), pd_comp (fun y => G y a b) ψ z hψd (hGd a b) l]
    ring
  
  have christoffel_pullback_algebra : ∀ (A G Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (dG H dGt : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      A.det ≠ 0 → G.det ≠ 0 → (∀ a b, G a b = G b a) → (∀ c i j, H c i j = H c j i) →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * G a b * A b j) →
      (∀ l i j, dGt l i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (H a l i * G a b * A b j + A a i * (∑ d : Fin 3, dG d a b * A d l) * A b j
          + A a i * G a b * H b l j)) →
      ∀ c i j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ k l *
          (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c l *
          (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) * A a i * A b j + H c i j := by
    intro A G Gt dG H dGt hA hG hGs hH hGt hdGt c i j
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGu : IsUnit G.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hG
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * G * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGiG : G⁻¹ * G = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul G hGu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hα : A * Gt⁻¹ = G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAB, Matrix.one_mul]
    have hα' : ∀ l, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Gt⁻¹ k l = ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * A⁻¹ l b := by
      intro l
      have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hα c) l
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h1
      exact h1
    have hβ : ∀ l, dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j = ∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l *
        (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β)
          + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j) := by
      intro l
      rw [hdGt, hdGt, hdGt]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hH _ j i, hH _ l i, hH _ l j]
      simp only [hGs 1 0, hGs 2 0, hGs 2 1]
      ring
    have eAB : ∀ γ b : Fin 3, A γ 0 * A⁻¹ 0 b + A γ 1 * A⁻¹ 1 b + A γ 2 * A⁻¹ 2 b
        = if γ = b then 1 else 0 := by
      intro γ b
      rw [← Matrix.one_apply, ← hAB, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hcontr : ∀ (u W : Fin 3 → ℝ), ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, u b * A⁻¹ l b) *
        (∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l * W γ) = ∑ b : Fin 3, u b * W b := by
      intro u W
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination
        (u 0 * W 0) * (eAB 0 0).trans (if_pos rfl)
        + (u 1 * W 0) * (eAB 0 1).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 2 * W 0) * (eAB 0 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 0 * W 1) * (eAB 1 0).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 1 * W 1) * (eAB 1 1).trans (if_pos rfl)
        + (u 2 * W 1) * (eAB 1 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 0 * W 2) * (eAB 2 0).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 1 * W 2) * (eAB 2 1).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 2 * W 2) * (eAB 2 2).trans (if_pos rfl)
    have hGG : ∑ a : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * G a b) * H a i j = H c i j := by
      have h2 : ∀ a, ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * G a b = (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) c a := by
        intro a
        rw [← hGiG, Matrix.mul_apply]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => by rw [hGs a b])
      simp only [h2, Matrix.one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
        Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    calc ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ k l *
            (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j))
        = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Gt⁻¹ k l) *
            (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j) := by
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * A⁻¹ l b) * (∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l *
            (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β)
              + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j)) := by
          simp only [hα', hβ]
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b *
            (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β b + dG β α b - dG b α β)
              + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a b * H a i j) := by
          rw [hcontr (fun b => G⁻¹ c b) (fun γ => ∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3,
            A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β) + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j)]
      _ = _ := by
          rw [← hGG]
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
  
  have christoffel_law_differentiate : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (U : Set E3), IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → ∀ z₀ ∈ U, ∀ (Γt Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ k i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (Γt k i j) z₀) →
      (∀ c a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (Γ c a b) (ψ z₀)) →
      (∀ z ∈ U, ∀ c i j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) z * Γt k i j z =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b (ψ z) * partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z *
          partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z + partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) z) →
      ∀ c l i j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv l (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c)) z₀ * Γt k i j z₀ +
            partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) z₀ * partialDeriv l (Γt k i j) z₀) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d (Γ c a b) (ψ z₀) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z₀) *
              partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z₀ * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z₀ +
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b (ψ z₀) *
            (partialDeriv l (partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a)) z₀ * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z₀ +
              partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z₀ * partialDeriv l (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b)) z₀) +
          partialDeriv l (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c))) z₀ := by
    intro ψ U hU hψ z₀ hz₀ Γt Γ hΓt hΓ hlaw c l i j
    have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z₀ :=
      (hψ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz₀)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hJ : ∀ a k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v a)) U :=
      fun a k => hpdU U hU _ (contDiffOn_euclidean.mp hψ a) k
    have hJd : ∀ a k : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v a)) z₀ :=
      fun a k => ((hJ a k).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz₀)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hHd : ∀ a k m : Fin 3,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k (partialDeriv m (fun v => ψ v a))) z₀ :=
      fun a k m => ((hpdU U hU _ (hJ a m) k).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz₀)).differentiableAt

    have hΓψd : ∀ c a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Γ c a b (ψ w)) z₀ :=
      fun c a b => (hΓ c a b).comp z₀ hψd
    have hev : (fun w => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) w * Γt k i j w) =ᶠ[𝓝 z₀]
        (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b (ψ w) * partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w *
          partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w + partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) w) := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz₀] with w hw
      exact hlaw w hw c i j
    have hEq : partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) w * Γt k i j w) z₀
        = partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b (ψ w) *
          partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w +
            partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) w) z₀ := by
      exact congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e l)) hev.fderiv_eq
    have hterm : ∀ a b : Fin 3, partialDeriv l (fun w => Γ c a b (ψ w) *
        partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z₀ =
        (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d (Γ c a b) (ψ z₀) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z₀) *
          partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z₀ * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z₀ +
        Γ c a b (ψ z₀) *
          (partialDeriv l (partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a)) z₀ * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z₀ +
            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z₀ * partialDeriv l (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b)) z₀) := by
      intro a b
      rw [pd_mul _ _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hΓψd c a b) (hJd a i)) (hJd b j),
        pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hΓψd c a b) (hJd a i), pd_comp (Γ c a b) ψ z₀ hψd (hΓ c a b) l]
      ring
    have htd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Γ c a b (ψ w) *
        partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z₀ :=
      fun a b => dmul _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hΓψd c a b) (hJd a i)) (hJd b j)
    have hR : partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b (ψ w) *
          partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w +
            partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) w) z₀ =

            (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d (Γ c a b) (ψ z₀) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z₀) *
              partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z₀ * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z₀ +
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b (ψ z₀) *
            (partialDeriv l (partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a)) z₀ * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z₀ +
              partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z₀ * partialDeriv l (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b)) z₀) +
          partialDeriv l (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c))) z₀ := by
      rw [pd_add _ _ _ _ (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun a _ =>
          DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => htd a b))) (hHd c i j),
        pd_sum _ _ _ (fun a => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => htd a b))]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => pd_sum _ z₀ l (fun b => htd a b))]
      simp only [hterm, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have hL : partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) w * Γt k i j w) z₀
        = ∑ k : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv l (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c)) z₀ * Γt k i j z₀ +
            partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) z₀ * partialDeriv l (Γt k i j) z₀) := by
      rw [pd_sum _ _ _ (fun k => dmul _ _ _ (hJd c k) (hΓt k i j))]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k _
      rw [pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hJd c k) (hΓt k i j)]
    rw [← hL, hEq, hR]
  
  have scalar_contraction_algebra : ∀ (A G Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (T Tt : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      A.det ≠ 0 → G.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * G a b * A b j) →
      (∀ c j l i, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Tt k j l i =
        ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, T c b d a * A b j * A d l * A a i) →
      ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ j k * ∑ i : Fin 3, Tt i k i j =
        ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, G⁻¹ j k * ∑ i : Fin 3, T i k i j := by
    intro A G Gt T Tt hA hG hGt hT
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * G * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hBA : A⁻¹ * A = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A hAu
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hTt : ∀ k j l i, Tt k j l i = ∑ c : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k c *
        (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, T c b d a * A b j * A d l * A a i) := by
      intro k j l i
      have hv : A.mulVec (fun k => Tt k j l i) = fun c =>
          ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, T c b d a * A b j * A d l * A a i := by
        funext c
        rw [← hT c j l i]
        rfl
      have h1 := congrFun (congrArg (fun v => A⁻¹.mulVec v) hv) k
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hBA, Matrix.one_mulVec] at h1
      rw [h1]
      rfl
    have eAB : ∀ d c : Fin 3, A d 0 * A⁻¹ 0 c + A d 1 * A⁻¹ 1 c + A d 2 * A⁻¹ 2 c
        = if d = c then 1 else 0 := by
      intro d c
      rw [← Matrix.one_apply, ← hAB, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hcontr2 : ∀ W : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i c * ∑ d : Fin 3, A d i * W c d = ∑ c : Fin 3, W c c := by
      intro W
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination
        W 0 0 * (eAB 0 0).trans (if_pos rfl) + W 1 0 * (eAB 0 1).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + W 2 0 * (eAB 0 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + W 0 1 * (eAB 1 0).trans (if_neg (by decide)) + W 1 1 * (eAB 1 1).trans (if_pos rfl)
        + W 2 1 * (eAB 1 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + W 0 2 * (eAB 2 0).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + W 1 2 * (eAB 2 1).trans (if_neg (by decide)) + W 2 2 * (eAB 2 2).trans (if_pos rfl)
    have hRt : (Matrix.of fun j k => ∑ i : Fin 3, Tt i k i j)
        = Matrix.transpose A * (Matrix.of fun j k => ∑ i : Fin 3, T i k i j) * A := by
      ext j k
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
      calc ∑ i : Fin 3, Tt i k i j
          = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i c * ∑ d : Fin 3, A d i *
              (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, T c b d a * A b k * A a j) := by
            simp only [hTt]
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
            ring
        _ = ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, T c b c a * A b k * A a j :=
            hcontr2 (fun c d => ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, T c b d a * A b k * A a j)
        _ = _ := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
            ring
    have htr : ∀ X Y : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
        ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, X j k * Y j k = Matrix.trace (X * Matrix.transpose Y) := by
      intro X Y
      simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
    have h1 : Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A = 1 := by
      rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, hAB, Matrix.transpose_one]
    show ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ j k * (Matrix.of fun j k => ∑ i : Fin 3, Tt i k i j) j k
      = ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, G⁻¹ j k * (Matrix.of fun j k => ∑ i : Fin 3, T i k i j) j k
    rw [htr, htr, hRt, hGtinv]
    set R := Matrix.of fun j k => ∑ i : Fin 3, T i k i j
    calc Matrix.trace (A⁻¹ * G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ *
          Matrix.transpose (Matrix.transpose A * R * A))
        = Matrix.trace (A⁻¹ * G⁻¹ * (Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A) *
            Matrix.transpose R * A) := by
          simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.trace (A⁻¹ * G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose R * A) := by rw [h1, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = Matrix.trace (A * (A⁻¹ * G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose R)) := by rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
      _ = Matrix.trace (G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose R) := by
          rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAB, Matrix.one_mul]
  
  have partialDeriv_comm : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →

  have riemann_law_algebra : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)

      (∀ c i j, H c i j = H c j i) → (∀ l c i j, H3 l c i j = H3 i c l j) →

        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b * A a i * A b j + H c i j) →

    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hT1 hD ⊢
    linear_combination hD c l i j - hD c i l j
      + Γt 0 i j * hT1 c l 0 + Γt 1 i j * hT1 c l 1 + Γt 2 i j * hT1 c l 2
      - Γt 0 l j * hT1 c i 0 - Γt 1 l j * hT1 c i 1 - Γt 2 l j * hT1 c i 2
      + Γ c 0 0 * A 0 l * hT1 0 i j + Γ c 0 1 * A 0 l * hT1 1 i j + Γ c 0 2 * A 0 l * hT1 2 i j
      + Γ c 1 0 * A 1 l * hT1 0 i j + Γ c 1 1 * A 1 l * hT1 1 i j + Γ c 1 2 * A 1 l * hT1 2 i j
      + Γ c 2 0 * A 2 l * hT1 0 i j + Γ c 2 1 * A 2 l * hT1 1 i j + Γ c 2 2 * A 2 l * hT1 2 i j
      - Γ c 0 0 * A 0 i * hT1 0 l j - Γ c 0 1 * A 0 i * hT1 1 l j - Γ c 0 2 * A 0 i * hT1 2 l j
      - Γ c 1 0 * A 1 i * hT1 0 l j - Γ c 1 1 * A 1 i * hT1 1 l j - Γ c 1 2 * A 1 i * hT1 2 l j
      - Γ c 2 0 * A 2 i * hT1 0 l j - Γ c 2 1 * A 2 i * hT1 1 l j - Γ c 2 2 * A 2 i * hT1 2 l j
      + Γ c 0 0 * A 0 j * hH 0 l i + Γ c 0 1 * A 1 j * hH 0 l i + Γ c 0 2 * A 2 j * hH 0 l i
      + Γ c 1 0 * A 0 j * hH 1 l i + Γ c 1 1 * A 1 j * hH 1 l i + Γ c 1 2 * A 2 j * hH 1 l i
      + Γ c 2 0 * A 0 j * hH 2 l i + Γ c 2 1 * A 1 j * hH 2 l i + Γ c 2 2 * A 2 j * hH 2 l i
      + hH3 l c i j

    have hzero : g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i))
        (D (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i)) = 0 := by
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      calc _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a * ∑ b : Fin 3,
            g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) * v b := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
        _ = 0 := by simp [hG]
    rw [hzero] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
  
  have hkey := key (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm)
    (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target
    h2.1 (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).open_target h2.2
    (fun z hz => (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source hz.2)
    (fun a b => g.smooth (Φ x) a b)
    (fun y a b => g.symm _ _ _)
    (fun y hy => s4 y hy)
    (fun z hz => s3 z hz)
    hxU
  have heq : g.coeff Φ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun w => Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun v => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ v) a) w *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) a b *
          partialDeriv j (fun v => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ v) b) w) := by
    filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hxU] with z hz
    ext i j
    exact s1 z hz i j
  rw [scalarCurvatureLocal_congr _ _ x heq]
  exact hkey.symm

proof.tactics:
by
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  obtain ⟨R, C, hR, hC, hb⟩ := metric_coeff_bounds G q hq0 hsmooth hdecay
  obtain ⟨R₀, C₀, hdecomp⟩ :=
    scalar_curvature_div_decomp G q hq0 hsmooth hsymm R C hR hC hb
  obtain ⟨R₁, hD⟩ :=
    div_integrable_exterior G q hq hsmooth R C hR hC hb hint R₀ C₀ hdecomp
  obtain ⟨hInt, hΨ⟩ := smoothed_tail_tendsto_zero (fluxDivLocal G) R₁ hD
  obtain ⟨R₂, C₂, hosc⟩ := flux_increment_bound G q hq0 hsmooth R C hR hC hb
  
  let A : ℝ → ℝ := fun a =>
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (a + s)
  let Ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun a =>
    ∫ x : E3, fluxDivLocal G x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a)
  have hΨ' : Tendsto Ψ atTop (𝓝 0) := hΨ
  have hpi : (16 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have h01 : R₁ ≤ max R₁ 2 := le_max_left _ _
  have h02 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ max R₁ 2 := le_max_right _ _
  have hAeq : ∀ a : ℝ, max R₁ 2 ≤ a →
      A a = (A (max R₁ 2) + Ψ (max R₁ 2) / (16 * Real.pi)) - Ψ a / (16 * Real.pi) := by
    intro a ha
    have ha1 : R₁ ≤ a := le_trans h01 ha
    have ha2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ a := le_trans h02 ha
    have hL : ∫ x : E3, fluxDivLocal G x
        * (Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - max R₁ 2) - Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a))
        = Ψ (max R₁ 2) - Ψ a := by
      simp only [Ψ, mul_sub]
      exact integral_sub (hInt _ h01) (hInt a ha1)
    have hs5 : Ψ (max R₁ 2) - Ψ a = -(16 * Real.pi) * (A (max R₁ 2) - A a) := by
      rw [← hL]
      exact divergence_shell_identity G hsmooth (max R₁ 2) a h02 ha2
    have key : Ψ (max R₁ 2) / (16 * Real.pi) - Ψ a / (16 * Real.pi) = A a - A (max R₁ 2) := by
      rw [← sub_div, hs5]
      field_simp
      ring
    linarith
  have hAt : Tendsto A atTop (𝓝 (A (max R₁ 2) + Ψ (max R₁ 2) / (16 * Real.pi))) := by
    have h1 : Tendsto (fun a => (A (max R₁ 2) + Ψ (max R₁ 2) / (16 * Real.pi))
        - Ψ a / (16 * Real.pi)) atTop
        (𝓝 ((A (max R₁ 2) + Ψ (max R₁ 2) / (16 * Real.pi)) - 0 / (16 * Real.pi))) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.sub (hΨ'.div_const _)
    rw [zero_div, sub_zero] at h1
    refine h1.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (max R₁ 2)] with a ha
    exact (hAeq a ha).symm
  exact ⟨A (max R₁ 2) + Ψ (max R₁ 2) / (16 * Real.pi),
    tendsto_of_smoothed_tendsto (fluxLocal G) q hq0 R₂ C₂ hosc _ hAt⟩

def fluxLocal (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / (16 * Real.pi) * r ^ 2 *
    ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r • (θ : E3))
          - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j
      ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere


def fluxDivLocal (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    (partialDeriv j (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y) x
      - partialDeriv j (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y) x)

subgoal_signatures.statement:

    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R C : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (hiso : IsometricToEuclidean g)
    (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => admFlux g (hAF.ends k) r) atTop (𝓝 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hiso
  obtain ⟨hψ, hcoef⟩ := isometric_coeff_eq_inner_fderiv g (hAF.ends k) F hF
  generalize hψdef : (fun y => F ((hAF.ends k).Φ y)) = ψ at hψ hcoef
  set U₁ : Set E3 := {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} with hU₁def
  have hU₁ : IsOpen U₁ := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hq2 : 1 / 2 < hAF.q := hAF.q_gt
  
  have hψ3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 ψ U₁ := hψ.of_le (by norm_cast)
  have hψ2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ U₁ := hψ.of_le (by norm_cast)
  have hDψ : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fderiv ℝ ψ) U₁ := hψ3.fderiv_of_isOpen hU₁ (by norm_num)
  have hDψ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ ψ) U₁ := hDψ.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hDψdiff : ∀ z ∈ U₁, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z := fun z hz =>
    (hDψ.differentiableOn (by norm_num) z hz).differentiableAt (hU₁.mem_nhds hz)
  have hD2cont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ)) U₁ :=
    hDψ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU₁ (by norm_num)
  have hDcont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ ψ) U₁ := hDψ.continuousOn
  have hpdiff : ∀ z ∈ U₁, ∀ v : E3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ψ y v) z :=
    fun z hz v => (hDψdiff z hz).clm_apply (differentiableAt_const v)
  have hpQ : ∀ z ∈ U₁, ∀ v w : E3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ψ y v) z w = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z w v := by
    intro z hz v w
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hDψdiff z hz) (differentiableAt_const v)]
    simp
  have hQsym : ∀ z ∈ U₁, ∀ v w : E3,
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z v w = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z w v := fun z hz v w =>
    (hψ2.contDiffAt (hU₁.mem_nhds hz)).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp) v w
  
  have hstar : ∀ x ∈ U₁, ∀ i j l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y i j) x =
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (e l) (e i)) (fderiv ℝ ψ x (e j)) +
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ x (e i)) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (e l) (e j)) := by
    intro x hx i j l
    have heq : (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y i j) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ y (e i)) (fderiv ℝ ψ y (e j))) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU₁.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hcoef y hy i j)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [heq.fderiv_eq, fderiv_inner_apply ℝ (hpdiff x hx _) (hpdiff x hx _), hpQ x hx,
      hpQ x hx]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨C, R, hC, hR, hdec⟩ :=
    decay_bounds_of_isBigO (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) hAF.q (by linarith) (hAF.decay k)
  set R₁ := max R 2 with hR₁
  set K := (27 / 2 : ℝ) * C with hK
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by positivity
  
  have hQb : ∀ x : E3, R₁ ≤ ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (e i) (e j)‖ ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1) := by
    intro x hx i j
    have hxR : R ≤ ‖x‖ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx
    have hx2 : 2 ≤ ‖x‖ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hx
    have hxU : x ∈ U₁ := by show 1 < ‖x‖; linarith
    have hgram : ∀ a b : Fin 3, |@inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ x (e a)) (fderiv ℝ ψ x (e b))
        - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6 := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hcoef x hxU a b]
      exact (hdec x hxR a b).1
    have hG : ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (e i) (e j)‖ ≤ 3 * ∑ l : Fin 3,
        |@inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (e i) (e j)) (fderiv ℝ ψ x (e l))| :=
      gram_inverse_bound (fun l => fderiv ℝ ψ x (e l)) hgram _
    have hkos : ∀ l : Fin 3,
        |@inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (e i) (e j)) (fderiv ℝ ψ x (e l))|
          ≤ (3 / 2) * (C * ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1)) := by
      intro l
      have h1 := hstar x hxU j l i
      have h2 := hstar x hxU i l j
      have h3 := hstar x hxU i j l
      have s1 := hQsym x hxU (e j) (e i)
      have s2 := hQsym x hxU (e l) (e i)
      have s3 := hQsym x hxU (e l) (e j)
      rw [s1] at h2
      rw [s2, s3] at h3

    refine (hAF.integrable_scalarCurvature k).congr_fun ?_
      (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm)
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by
      have h2 : (2 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := hx
      rw [hsrc]
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖
      linarith
    simp only
    rw [scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff g (hAF.ends k).Φ x hx']
  have hm' : Tendsto (fluxLocal (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ)) atTop (𝓝 m) := hm
  
  have hq0 : 0 < hAF.q := lt_trans (by norm_num) hAF.q_gt
  have hq'half : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < min hAF.q (3 / 4) := lt_min hAF.q_gt (by norm_num)
  have hq'le : min hAF.q (3 / 4) ≤ hAF.q := min_le_left _ _
  have hq'lt1 : min hAF.q (3 / 4) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨R, C, hR1, hC0, hb⟩ :=
    metric_coeff_bounds (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) hAF.q hq0 hsmooth (hAF.decay k)
  have hb' : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x).det ∧
      ∀ i j l : Fin 3,
        |g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)|
          ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-(min hAF.q (3 / 4))) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y i j) x‖
          ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-(min hAF.q (3 / 4)) - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv l (fun z => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ z i j) y) x‖
          ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-(min hAF.q (3 / 4)) - 2) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hdet, hrest⟩ := hb x hx
    refine ⟨hdet, fun i j l => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := hrest i j l
    have e0 : ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-(min hAF.q (3 / 4))) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx1 (by linarith)
    have e1 : ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-(min hAF.q (3 / 4)) - 1) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx1 (by linarith)
    have e2 : ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 2) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-(min hAF.q (3 / 4)) - 2) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx1 (by linarith)
    exact ⟨h0.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e0 hC0),
      h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 hC0),
      h2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hC0)⟩
  have hDecG : Dec1 (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R C := by
    intro x hx i j
    obtain ⟨_, hrest⟩ := hb' x hx
    refine ⟨(hrest i j 0).1, fun l => ?_⟩
    have h1 := (hrest i j l).2.1
    calc |partialDeriv l (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y i j) x|
        = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y i j) x (e l)‖ := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; rfl
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y i j) x‖ * ‖e l‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y i j) x‖ := by
          simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
      _ ≤ _ := h1
  
  obtain ⟨R₀, R₁, C₁, X, Y, hXY, hgauge, L₁, hstern⟩ :=
    stern_harmonic_cylinder_bound g hComplete hAF hR k
  have hR02 : 2 ≤ R₀ := hXY.1
  have hR01 : R₀ ≤ R₁ := hXY.2.1
  
  obtain ⟨hsymm', hsmooth', R₂, C₂, hR12, hC2, hdec'⟩ :=
    pullback_metric_decay (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) (by linarith) hq'lt1
      hsmooth hsymm R C hDecG X Y R₀ R₁ C₁ hXY
  have hR2one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ R₂ := by linarith
  have hsmooth₂ : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun x => pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y x a b) {x : E3 | R₂ < ‖x‖} := by
    intro a b
    exact (hsmooth' a b).mono (fun x hx => lt_of_le_of_lt hR12 hx)
  have hgauge₂ : ∀ x : E3, R₂ < ‖x‖ →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y x)⁻¹ i j *
          christoffel (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) 0 i j x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    exact hgauge x (lt_of_le_of_lt hR12 hx)
  
  have hT4 := cyl_grad_term_asymptotics (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y)
    (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R₂ C₂ hq'half hR2one hC2 hsmooth₂ hsymm' hdec' hgauge₂
  have hT5 := cyl_curv_term_asymptotics (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y)
    (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R₂ C₂ hq'half hR2one hC2 hsmooth₂ hsymm' hdec'
  have hT : Tendsto (fun L : ℝ =>
      (cylFlux (gradVec (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y)) L
          - P1 (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L)
        - (curvTerm (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L
          - P2 (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := hT4.sub hT5
    rwa [sub_zero] at h
  have hD : Tendsto (fun L : ℝ =>
      sternBoundary (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L
        - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * cylFlux (admVec (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y)) L)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    refine hT.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop R₂] with L hL
    have hsplit := cyl_adm_flux_split (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) R₂ L hL
      hsmooth₂ hsymm'
    simp only [sternBoundary]
    linarith
  
  by_contra hneg
  have hneg' : m < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hneg
  have hpm : Real.pi * m < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg Real.pi_pos hneg'
  obtain ⟨L₀', hL₀'⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hD (-(2 * Real.pi * m)) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hLflux⟩ := exists_cylinder_flux_le (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (min hAF.q (3 / 4))
    hq'half hq'lt1 hsmooth hsymm R C hR1 hC0 hb' hint m hm' X Y R₀ R₁ C₁ hXY hsmooth'
    R₂ C₂ hR12 hdec' (-(4 * Real.pi * m)) (by linarith) (max L₀' L₁)
  have h1 := hL₀' L (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hL)
  have h2 := hstern L (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hL)
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at h1
  have h3 := (abs_lt.mp h1).2
  linarith

mass_nonneg.definitions:
def cylPt (t a b : ℝ) : E3 := t • e 0 + a • e 1 + b • e 2


def pullbackMetric (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3) (x : E3) :
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  fun a b => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * G (Y x) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j


def admVec (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  fun j => ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) x - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) x)


def gradVec (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  fun k => Real.sqrt (G x).det *
    ∑ l : Fin 3, (G x)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G z)⁻¹ 0 0)) x


def capFlux (V : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
    (V (cylPt L (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0
      - V (cylPt (-L) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0) * ρ


def sideFlux (V : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
    (V (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) 1 * Real.cos s
      + V (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) 2 * Real.sin s) * L


def cylFlux (V : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  capFlux V L + sideFlux V L


def curvIntegrand (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t L s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let P : E3 := cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)
  let γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := fun a b => G P a.succ b.succ
  let γi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := γ⁻¹
  let Γ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun a b c => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ d : Fin 2, γi a d *
    (partialDeriv b.succ (fun z => G z c.succ d.succ) P
      + partialDeriv c.succ (fun z => G z b.succ d.succ) P
      - partialDeriv d.succ (fun z => G z b.succ c.succ) P)
  let n : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![Real.cos s, Real.sin s]
  let v : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![-(L * Real.sin s), L * Real.cos s]
  (L - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, n a * Γ a b c * v b * v c) /
    (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, γi a b * n a * n b) *
      Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, γ a b * v a * v b))


def curvTerm (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s


def sternBoundary (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  4 * Real.pi * L - curvTerm G L + cylFlux (gradVec G) L


def P1 (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * capFlux (admVec G) L + (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
    ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      (Real.cos s * (partialDeriv 0 (fun z => G z 1 0) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
          - partialDeriv 1 (fun z => G z 0 0) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)))
        + Real.sin s * (partialDeriv 0 (fun z => G z 2 0) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
          - partialDeriv 2 (fun z => G z 0 0) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)))) * L


def P2 (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  4 * Real.pi * L + (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
    ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      (Real.cos s * (partialDeriv 1 (fun z => G z 2 2) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
          - partialDeriv 2 (fun z => G z 1 2) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)))
        + Real.sin s * (partialDeriv 2 (fun z => G z 1 1) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
          - partialDeriv 1 (fun z => G z 2 1) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)))) * L


def Dec1 (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q R C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
    |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
    ∀ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun y => G y i j) x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)


def CoordChange (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ R₀ ∧ R₀ ≤ R₁ ∧ 0 < C ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X {y : E3 | R₀ < ‖y‖} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} ∧
  (∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ → R₀ < ‖Y x‖ ∧ X (Y x) = x) ∧
  Set.InjOn X {y : E3 | R₀ < ‖y‖} ∧
  (∀ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ →
    ‖X y - y‖ ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q) ∧
    (∀ i a : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv i (fun z => X z a) y - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (-q)) ∧
    (∀ i j a : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (fun w => X w a) z) y| ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 1)))

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R C : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
        |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ (R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (X Y : E3 → E3),
      CoordChange X Y (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R₀ R₁ C ∧
      (∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M]
    [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (hRic : ∀ (p : M) (j l : Fin 3),
      ricci (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) j l (chartAt E3 p p) = 0) :
    IsometricToEuclidean g

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hchart := flat_chart_exists_of_ricci g hRic
  have hdist : ∀ (u : ℕ → M) (p : M),
      Tendsto (fun n => g.riemannianDist (u n) p) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 p) :=
    fun u p hu => riemannianDist_tendsto_zero_imp_tendsto g u p hu
  
  have hsrc : (hAF.ends k).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends k).source_eq
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hgram⟩ := end_developing_map g hRic (hAF.ends k)
  have hsmooth : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ z a b) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro a b
    rw [← hsrc]
    exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g (hAF.ends k).Φ a b
  have hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (a b : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ z a b = g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ z b a :=
    fun z a b => g.symm _ _ _
  have hq : 0 < hAF.q := by linarith [hAF.q_gt]
  obtain ⟨R, J₀, hR, hJ₀s, hJ₀m, hJ₀i, hJ₀g⟩ :=
    exterior_isometric_inverse (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) hAF.q hq hsmooth hsymm (hAF.decay k)
      ψ hψ hgram
  
  have hΩopen : IsOpen {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hmemsrc : ∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ → J₀ y ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hsrc]
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) < ‖J₀ y‖ := hJ₀m hy
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖J₀ y‖
    linarith
  have hΦsm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (hAF.ends k).Φ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source :=
    (hAF.ends k).Φ.contMDiffOn
  have hJsm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ ((hAF.ends k).Φ ∘ J₀) {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ J₀ {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} := hJ₀s.contMDiffOn
    exact hΦsm.comp h1 (fun y hy => hmemsrc y hy)
  have hJg : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖}, g.coeff ((hAF.ends k).Φ ∘ J₀) y = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    ext i j
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ J₀ y :=
      (hJ₀s.contDiffAt (hΩopen.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (hAF.ends k).Φ (J₀ y) :=
      (hΦsm.contMDiffAt ((hAF.ends k).Φ.open_source.mem_nhds (hmemsrc y hy))).mdifferentiableAt
        (by simp)
    rw [coeff_comp_apply g (hAF.ends k).Φ J₀ y hdiff hmd i j, hJ₀g y hy i j, Matrix.one_apply]
  have hJinj : Set.InjOn ((hAF.ends k).Φ ∘ J₀) {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} := by
    intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ h
    exact hJ₀i hy₁ hy₂ ((hAF.ends k).Φ.injOn (hmemsrc y₁ hy₁) (hmemsrc y₂ hy₂) h)
  generalize ((hAF.ends k).Φ ∘ J₀) = J at hJsm hJg hJinj
  
  have hy₀ : (R + 1) • e 0 ∈ {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} := by
    show R < ‖(R + 1) • e 0‖
    rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨F, hFsm, hFg, hFy₀, hFd⟩ := flat_complete_extend_local_isometry g hComplete hchart hdist
    {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} hΩopen ((R + 1) • e 0) hy₀ J hJsm hJg
  
  have hΩconn : IsPreconnected {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} := by
    have hrank : 1 < Module.rank ℝ E3 := by
      rw [← Module.finrank_eq_rank, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
      norm_num
    have hS : IsConnected (sphere (0 : E3) 1) := isConnected_sphere hrank 0 zero_le_one
    have hP : IsConnected (sphere (0 : E3) 1 ×ˢ Set.Ioi R) := hS.prod isConnected_Ioi
    have himg : (fun p : E3 × ℝ => p.2 • p.1) '' (sphere (0 : E3) 1 ×ˢ Set.Ioi R) =
        {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨u, t⟩, ⟨hu, ht⟩, rfl⟩
        have hu' : ‖u‖ = 1 := by simpa using hu
        have ht' : R < t := ht
        show R < ‖t • u‖
        rw [norm_smul, hu', mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
        exact ht'
      · intro hy
        have hy' : R < ‖y‖ := hy
        have hne : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := by linarith
        refine ⟨(‖y‖⁻¹ • y, ‖y‖), ⟨?_, hy'⟩, ?_⟩
        · show ‖y‖⁻¹ • y ∈ sphere (0 : E3) 1
          rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne]
        · show ‖y‖ • ‖y‖⁻¹ • y = y
          rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hne, one_smul]
    rw [← himg]
    exact (hP.image _ (by fun_prop : Continuous fun p : E3 × ℝ => p.2 • p.1).continuousOn).isPreconnected
  have hFJ : Set.EqOn F J {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} :=
    local_isometry_rigidity g {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} hΩopen hΩconn F J hFsm.contMDiffOn hJsm
      (fun y _ => hFg y) hJg ((R + 1) • e 0) hy₀ hFy₀ hFd
  
  have hinj : Function.Injective F := by
    intro y₁ y₂ h12
    obtain ⟨A, b, hAb, hFT⟩ := deck_rigid_motion g F hFsm hFg y₁ y₂ h12
    have key : ∀ y : E3, R + ‖b‖ < ‖y‖ → A y + b = y := by
      intro y hy
      have hyΩ : y ∈ {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} := by
        show R < ‖y‖
        linarith [norm_nonneg b]
      have hTyΩ : A y + b ∈ {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} := by
        show R < ‖A y + b‖
        have h := norm_sub_le (A y + b) b
        rw [add_sub_cancel_right, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] at h
        linarith
      apply hJinj hTyΩ hyΩ
      rw [← hFJ hTyΩ, ← hFJ hyΩ]
      exact hFT y
    have hlin : ∀ z : E3, A z = z := by
      intro z
      have hcpos : 0 < R + ‖b‖ + ‖z‖ + 1 := by linarith [norm_nonneg b, norm_nonneg z]
      have hc : ‖(R + ‖b‖ + ‖z‖ + 1) • e 0‖ = R + ‖b‖ + ‖z‖ + 1 := by
        rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hcpos]
      have h1 := key ((R + ‖b‖ + ‖z‖ + 1) • e 0) (by rw [hc]; linarith [norm_nonneg z])
      have h2 := key ((R + ‖b‖ + ‖z‖ + 1) • e 0 + z) (by
        have h := norm_sub_le ((R + ‖b‖ + ‖z‖ + 1) • e 0 + z) z
        rw [add_sub_cancel_right, hc] at h
        linarith)
      rw [map_add] at h2
      have hz : A z = (A ((R + ‖b‖ + ‖z‖ + 1) • e 0) + A z + b)
          - (A ((R + ‖b‖ + ‖z‖ + 1) • e 0) + b) := by abel
      rw [hz, h2, h1]
      abel
    have hb : b = 0 := by
      have hcpos : 0 < R + ‖b‖ + 1 := by linarith [norm_nonneg b]
      have hc : ‖(R + ‖b‖ + 1) • e 0‖ = R + ‖b‖ + 1 := by
        rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hcpos]
      have h1 := key ((R + ‖b‖ + 1) • e 0) (by rw [hc]; linarith)
      rw [hlin] at h1
      simpa using h1
    rw [← hAb, hlin, hb, add_zero]
  
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective F := local_isometry_surjective g hchart F hFsm hFg
  exact isometricToEuclidean_of_bijective_local_isometry g F hFsm ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩ hFg

by
  classical
  
  have H1 : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u v : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] v → lapLocal G u y = lapLocal G v y := by
    intro G u v y huv
    have h1 : ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l u y = partialDeriv l v y := by
      intro l
      show fderiv ℝ u y (e l) = fderiv ℝ v y (e l)
      rw [huv.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ i l : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) y =
        partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l v z) y := by
      intro i l
      have hev : (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => partialDeriv l v z) := by
        filter_upwards [huv.eventuallyEq_nhds] with z hz
        show fderiv ℝ u z (e l) = fderiv ℝ v z (e l)
        rw [hz.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) y (e i) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv l v z) y (e i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [lapLocal, h1, h2]
  have H2 : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ) (α γ : ℝ) (y : E3),
      lapLocal G (fun z => α * u z + γ) y = α * lapLocal G u y := by
    intro G u α γ y
    have hP0 : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (l : Fin 3) (z : E3),
        partialDeriv l (fun z => α * w z) z = α * partialDeriv l w z := by
      intro w l z
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z) z (e l) = α * fderiv ℝ w z (e l)
      have : (fun z => α * w z) = α • w := by funext z; simp
      rw [this, fderiv_const_smul_of_field]; rfl
    have hP : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (γ' : ℝ) (l : Fin 3) (z : E3),
        partialDeriv l (fun z => α * w z + γ') z = α * partialDeriv l w z := by
      intro w γ' l z
      rw [← hP0]
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z + γ') z (e l) = fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z) z (e l)
      rw [fderiv_add_const]
    have h2 : ∀ i l : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l (fun z => α * u z + γ) z) y
        = α * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) y := by
      intro i l
      have : (fun z => partialDeriv l (fun z => α * u z + γ) z) =
          fun z => α * partialDeriv l u z := by
        funext z; exact hP u γ l z
      rw [this, hP0]
    simp only [lapLocal, h2, hP, hP0, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have H2' : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ) (γ : ℝ) (y : E3),

    intro G u γ y

  have lapM_congr : ∀ (u v : M → ℝ) (p : M), u =ᶠ[𝓝 p] v → lapM g u p = lapM g v p := by

  have hsrc : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, (hAF.ends j).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=

      (hρ0 j).2 ρ₁ (by linarith [hrρ0 j])).isOpen_compl
  have hcover : ∀ q, q ∈ O ∨ ∃ j, q ∈ T j := by
    intro q
    by_cases hqO : q ∈ O
    · exact Or.inl hqO
    · right
      rw [hO, Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not] at hqO
      obtain ⟨j, x, hx, hxq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hqO
      exact ⟨j, (hTmem j q).2 ⟨x, by have : ρ₁ ≤ ‖x‖ := hx; linarith, hxq⟩⟩
  
  obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂⟩ : ∃ f₂ : Fin hAF.numEnds → M → ℝ,
      f₂ = fun j p => a * farPot δ ((hAF.ends j).Φ.symm p) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : M → ℝ, F = fun p => (f p - β) +
      ∑ j, (T j).indicator (fun p => ε * smax1 ((f₂ j p - (f p - β)) / ε)) p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hf₂at : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), 1 < ‖x‖ →
      f₂ j ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) = a * farPot δ x := by
    intro j x hx
    rw [hf₂]
    show a * farPot δ ((hAF.ends j).Φ.symm ((hAF.ends j).Φ x)) = a * farPot δ x
    rw [hleft j x hx]
  have hFT : ∀ j, ∀ q ∈ T j, F q = (f q - β) + ε * smax1 ((f₂ j q - (f q - β)) / ε) := by
    intro j q hq
    rw [hF]
    show (f q - β) + ∑ i, (T i).indicator (fun p => ε * smax1 ((f₂ i p - (f p - β)) / ε)) q = _
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hq]
    · intro i _ hij; exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (hTdisj j i (Ne.symm hij) q hq) _
    · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) h
  have hFoff : ∀ q, (∀ j, q ∉ T j) → F q = f q - β := by
    intro q hq
    rw [hF]
    show (f q - β) + ∑ i, (T i).indicator (fun p => ε * smax1 ((f₂ i p - (f p - β)) / ε)) q = _
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => Set.indicator_of_notMem (hq i) _), add_zero]
  have hFO : ∀ q ∈ O, F q = f q - β := by
    intro q hqO
    by_cases hq : ∃ j, q ∈ T j
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hq
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxq⟩ := (hTmem j q).1 hj
      have hxρ : ‖x‖ < ρ₁ := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        rw [hO] at hqO
        exact (Set.mem_compl_iff _ _).1 hqO (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, x, hcon, hxq⟩)
      rw [hFT j q hj]
      have hx1 : 1 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
      have hfx : c₀ ≤ f q := by rw [← hxq]; exact hfann j x hx.le hxρ.le
      have hf₂x : f₂ j q = a * farPot δ x := by rw [← hxq]; exact hf₂at j x hx1
      have hφx := hφ x hx1.le
      have h2a : a * farPot δ x ≤ a * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hφx.2 ha0.le
      have harg : (f₂ j q - (f q - β)) / ε ≤ -1 := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hε0, hf₂x]
        linarith
      rw [hsm0 _ harg]; ring
    · push_neg at hq
      exact hFoff q hq
  have hFfar : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), ρ₂ < ‖x‖ →
      F ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) = a * farPot δ x := by
    intro j x hx
    have hxr : r < ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have hj : (hAF.ends j).Φ x ∈ T j := (hTmem j _).2 ⟨x, hxr, rfl⟩
    rw [hFT j _ hj, hffar j x hx, hf₂at j x (by linarith)]
    have hφx := hφ x (by linarith)
    have hnn : 0 ≤ a * farPot δ x := mul_nonneg ha0.le hφx.1
    have harg : 1 ≤ (a * farPot δ x - (0 - β)) / ε := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hε0]
      linarith
    rw [hsmid _ harg]
    have hdiv : ε * ((a * farPot δ x - (0 - β)) / ε) = a * farPot δ x - (0 - β) := by
      field_simp
    rw [hdiv]; ring
  have hFb : ∀ q, -1 / 8 ≤ F q ∧ F q ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro q
    have hf0 := (hfb q).1
    have hf1 := (hfb q).2
    rcases hcover q with hqO | ⟨j, hj⟩
    · rw [hFO q hqO]; constructor <;> linarith
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxq⟩ := (hTmem j q).1 hj
      rw [hFT j q hj]
      have hf₂x : f₂ j q = a * farPot δ x := by rw [← hxq]; exact hf₂at j x (by linarith)
      have hφx := hφ x (by linarith)
      have h2a : a * farPot δ x ≤ a * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hφx.2 ha0.le
      obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : ℝ, H = (f₂ j q - (f q - β)) / ε := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hH]
      have hHε : ε * H = f₂ j q - (f q - β) := by rw [hH]; field_simp
      have hlo := hsmlo H
      have hhi := hsmhi H
      have hmax0 : 0 ≤ max H 0 := le_max_right _ _
      have hnn : 0 ≤ ε * smax1 H := mul_nonneg hε0.le (le_trans hmax0 hlo)
      have hup : ε * smax1 H ≤ ε * (max H 0 + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhi hε0.le
      rcases le_total H 0 with hH0 | hH0
      · rw [max_eq_right hH0, zero_add, mul_one] at hup
        constructor <;> linarith
      · rw [max_eq_left hH0, mul_add, mul_one] at hup
        constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hf₂T : ∀ j, ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f₂ j) (T j) := by
    intro j
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (farPot δ) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mpr hφcd
    have h2 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (hAF.ends j).Φ.symm (T j) :=
      (hAF.ends j).Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun.mono (hTtarget j)
    have h3 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (farPot δ ∘ (hAF.ends j).Φ.symm) (T j) := by
      refine h1.comp h2 ?_
      intro q hq
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxq⟩ := (hTmem j q).1 hq
      show 1 < ‖(hAF.ends j).Φ.symm q‖
      rw [← hxq, hleft j x (by linarith)]; linarith
    refine ((contMDiffOn_const (c := a)).mul h3).congr (fun q _ => ?_)
    rw [hf₂]; rfl
  have hFsm : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ F := by
    apply contMDiff_of_locally_contMDiffOn
    intro p
    rcases hcover p with hpO | ⟨j, hj⟩
    · refine ⟨O, hOopen, hpO, ?_⟩
      exact (hfsm.contMDiffOn.sub contMDiffOn_const).congr (fun q hq => hFO q hq)
    · refine ⟨T j, hTopen j, hj, ?_⟩
      have hf' : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun q => f q - β) (T j) :=
        hfsm.contMDiffOn.sub contMDiffOn_const
      have hh : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun q => (f₂ j q - (f q - β)) / ε) (T j) :=
        ((hf₂T j).sub hf').div_const ε
      exact (hf'.add (contMDiffOn_const.mul (hsm_cd.contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn hh))).congr
        (fun q hq => hFT j q hq)
  
  have hsup : ∀ p, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g F p + g.scalarCurvature p := by
    intro p
    rcases hcover p with hpO | ⟨j, hj⟩
    · have hev : F =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun q => f q - β) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hOopen.mem_nhds hpO) (fun q hq => hFO q hq)
      rw [lapM_congr _ _ p hev, lapM_sub_const]
      exact hfsup p
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxp⟩ := (hTmem j p).1 hj
      have hx1 : 1 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
      have hxs : x ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by rw [hsrc j]; exact hx1
      have hy : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := mem_chart_target E3 p
      obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Set E3,
          U = (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hUopen : IsOpen U := by
        rw [hU]; exact (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (hTopen j)
      have hUsub : U ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by rw [hU]; exact Set.inter_subset_left
      have hyU : chartAt E3 p p ∈ U := by
        rw [hU]
        refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
        show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) ∈ T j
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)]
        exact hj
      obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁⟩ : ∃ u₁ : E3 → ℝ, u₁ = fun z => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) - β :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨u₂, hu₂⟩ : ∃ u₂ : E3 → ℝ, u₂ = fun z => f₂ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hu₁cd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u₁ U := by
        have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) - β)
            (chartAt E3 p).target :=
          (hfsm.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm).sub contMDiffOn_const
        rw [hu₁]
        exact (contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this).mono hUsub
      have hu₂cd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u₂ U := by
        have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f₂ j ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) U :=
          (hf₂T j).comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono hUsub)
            (by rw [hU]; exact fun z hz => hz.2)
        rw [hu₂]
        exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
      have hGcd : ∀ i l : Fin 3,
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z i l) U :=
        fun i l => (g.smooth p i l).mono hUsub
      have hpsd := hpsd_of _ (hPD2 p _ hy).inv
      obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hineq⟩ := smax1_lap_ge (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) u₁ u₂ U hUopen
        (chartAt E3 p p) hyU hGcd hu₁cd hu₂cd hpsd ε hε0
      have hFeq : (F ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
          (fun z => u₁ z + ε * smax1 ((u₂ z - u₁ z) / ε)) := by
        filter_upwards [hUopen.mem_nhds hyU] with z hz
        have hzT : (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ T j := by rw [hU] at hz; exact hz.2
        rw [hu₁, hu₂]
        exact hFT j _ hzT
      have hLF : lapM g F p = lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
          (fun z => u₁ z + ε * smax1 ((u₂ z - u₁ z) / ε)) (chartAt E3 p p) :=
        H1 _ _ _ _ hFeq
      have hL1 : lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) u₁ (chartAt E3 p p) = lapM g f p := by
        rw [hu₁]
        exact H2' _ (f ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) β _
      have hL2 : lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) u₂ (chartAt E3 p p) =
          lapM g (f₂ j) p := by
        rw [hu₂]; rfl
      have h2 := lapLocal_chart_invariant g (hAF.ends j).Φ (f₂ j) (T j) (hTopen j) (hf₂T j) x
        hxs (by rw [hxp]; exact hj)
      rw [hxp] at h2
      have h3 : lapLocal (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) (f₂ j ∘ (hAF.ends j).Φ) x =
          lapLocal (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) (fun y => a * farPot δ y + 0) x := by
        apply H1
        filter_upwards [(hAF.ends j).Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hxs] with y hy
        have hy1 : 1 < ‖y‖ := by rw [hsrc j] at hy; exact hy
        show f₂ j ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = a * farPot δ y + 0
        rw [hf₂at j y hy1, add_zero]
      have h4 := H2 (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) (farPot δ) a 0 x
      have hpos : 0 ≤ lapLocal (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) (farPot δ) x := by
        refine le_trans ?_ ((hR0 j).2 x (by linarith [hrR0 j])).1
        exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hδ0.le (by linarith)) (by norm_num))
          (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
      have hL2pos : 0 ≤ lapM g (f₂ j) p := by
        rw [← h2, h3, h4]; exact mul_nonneg ha0.le hpos
      have hRp := hR p
      have hsupf := hfsup p
      rw [hLF]
      rw [hL1, hL2] at hineq
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hs1) hsupf, mul_nonneg hs0 hL2pos,
        mul_nonneg hs0 hRp]
  
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : M → ℝ, w = fun q => 1 - F q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hwq : ∀ q, w q = 1 - F q := fun q => by rw [hw]
  have hwsm : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w := by
    rw [hw]; exact contMDiff_const.sub hFsm
  have hwlo : ∀ q, 1 / 2 ≤ w q := fun q => by rw [hwq]; have := (hFb q).2; linarith
  have hwhi : ∀ q, w q ≤ 9 / 8 := fun q => by rw [hwq]; have := (hFb q).1; linarith
  have hwpos : ∀ q, 0 < w q := fun q => by have := hwlo q; linarith
  obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := conformal_metric_exists g w hwsm hwpos
  have hcoeff : ∀ (φ : E3 → M) (y : E3), g'.coeff φ y = (w (φ y) ^ 4) • g.coeff φ y := by
    intro φ y
    ext i l
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, hg', ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hC' : g'.IsCompleteRiemannian :=
    isCompleteRiemannian_of_conformal g g' w hwsm.continuous (1 / 2) (9 / 8) (by norm_num)
      hwlo hwhi hg' hComplete
  have hR' : ∀ q : M, 0 ≤ g'.scalarCurvature q := by
    intro q
    have hy : chartAt E3 q q ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := mem_chart_target E3 q
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (w ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hwsm.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    have key := conformal_scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
      (w ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target (chartAt E3 q).open_target (g.smooth q)
      (hsymmG _) (fun z hz => (hPD2 q z hz).det_pos.ne') hu (fun z _ => hwpos _)
      (chartAt E3 q q) hy
    have e1 : g'.scalarCurvature q = scalarCurvatureLocal
        (fun z => ((w ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) z ^ 4) • g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z)
        (chartAt E3 q q) := by
      show scalarCurvatureLocal (g'.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q q) = _
      congr 1
      funext z
      exact hcoeff _ z
    have e2 : (w ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q q) = w q := by
      show w ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q)) = w q
      rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 q)]
    have e3 : lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (w ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (chartAt E3 q q) = -lapM g F q := by
      have : (w ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) = fun z => -1 * (F ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) z + 1 := by
        funext z; simp only [Function.comp_apply, hwq]; ring
      rw [this, H2]
      show -1 * lapM g F q = -lapM g F q
      ring
    have e4 : scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q q) =
        g.scalarCurvature q := rfl
    rw [e1, key, e2, e3, e4]
    have h1 := hsup q
    have h2 := hR q
    have h3 := (hFb q).2
    have h4 := hwpos q
    have h5 : 0 ≤ -8 * -lapM g F q + g.scalarCurvature q * w q := by
      rw [hwq]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg h2 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 - F q)]
    exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (pow_nonneg h4.le 5)) h5
  
  have hρ₂1 : 1 ≤ ρ₂ := by linarith
  have hρ₂2 : 2 ≤ ρ₂ := by linarith
  have hfar_coeff : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), ρ₂ < ‖x‖ →
      g'.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ x = ((1 - a * farPot δ x) ^ 4) • g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ x := by
    intro j x hx
    rw [hcoeff, hwq, hFfar j x hx]
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} :=
    measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm
  have hint' : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, IntegrableOn
      (fun x : E3 => g'.scalarCurvature ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) *
        Real.sqrt (g'.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ x).det) {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro j
    have hintG : IntegrableOn (fun x : E3 => scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) x *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ x).det) {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} := by
      refine (hAF.integrable_scalarCurvature j).congr_fun ?_ hmeas
      intro x hx
      have hxs : x ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
        rw [hsrc j]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖; have : (2 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := hx; linarith
      simp only
      rw [scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff g _ x hxs]
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (w ∘ (hAF.ends j).Φ) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
      rw [← hsrc j]
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp
        (hwsm.comp_contMDiffOn (hAF.ends j).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun)
    have h9 := conformal_scalar_integrable (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) (w ∘ (hAF.ends j).Φ)
      hAF.q a δ ρ₂ hδ0 hδq ha0.le ha14 hρ₂2 (hsmooth j) (hsymmG _) (hdetpos j) (hAF.decay j)
      hintG hu (fun x _ => hwpos _)
      (fun x hx => by
        show w ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) = _
        rw [hwq, hFfar j x hx])
    refine h9.congr_fun ?_ hmeas
    intro x hx
    have hxs : x ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
      rw [hsrc j]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖; have : (2 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := hx; linarith
    have e : g'.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ =
        fun y => ((w ∘ (hAF.ends j).Φ) y ^ 4) • g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y :=
      funext fun y => hcoeff _ y
    simp only
    rw [scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff g' _ x hxs, e]
  let hAF' : AsymptoticallyFlat g' :=
    { numEnds := hAF.numEnds
      ends := hAF.ends
      q := min hAF.q 1
      q_gt := hq'gt
      disjoint := hAF.disjoint
      isCompact_core := hAF.isCompact_core
      decay := fun j => conformal_decay (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) (g'.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ)
        hAF.q a δ ρ₂ hq0 ha0.le ha14 hδ0 hρ₂1 (hsmooth j) (hAF.decay j) (hfar_coeff j)
      integrable_scalarCurvature := hint' }
  
  have hflux := conformal_flux_tendsto (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (g'.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ)
    hAF.q a δ m ρ₂ hq0 ha0.le ha14 hδ0 hρ₂1 (hsmooth k) (hAF.decay k) (hfar_coeff k) hm
  exact ⟨g', hC', hAF', k, m - 2 * a, hR', hflux, by linarith⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_contDiffOn_source
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source

subgoal_signatures.name: scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) :
    g.scalarCurvature (Φ x) = scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff Φ) x

subgoal_signatures.name: conformal_scalarCurvatureLocal
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ)
    (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i)
    (hdet : ∀ x ∈ U, (G x).det ≠ 0) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (hupos : ∀ x ∈ U, 0 < u x)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    scalarCurvatureLocal (fun x => (u x ^ 4) • G x) y =
