        _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            staticSymLoc (g.coeff φ) (fun z => ψ (φ z)) a b y₁ ^ 2 :=
          Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun a => ∑ b : Fin 3, staticSymLoc (g.coeff φ) (fun z => ψ (φ z)) a b y₁ ^ 2)
            (fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i₁)
    · exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hGpos y₁ hy₁)
  have hFint : IntegrableOn F K := (hFc.mono hKφ).integrableOn_compact hK
  have hApos : 0 < ∫ y in K, F y := by
    rw [integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hFnn) hFint,
      Measure.restrict_apply' hKmeas]
    have hev : {y | 0 < F y} ∩ K ∈ 𝓝 y₁ := by
      refine Filter.inter_mem ?_ hKnhds
      exact continuousAt_const.eventually_lt (hFc.continuousAt (φ.open_source.mem_nhds hy₁)) hFy₁
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (Measure.measure_pos_of_mem_nhds _ hev) (measure_mono ?_)
    intro y hy
    exact ⟨hy.1.ne', hy.2⟩
  have hA'eq : (-∫ y in K, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff φ y)⁻¹ a c * (g.coeff φ y)⁻¹ b d * H y a b *
          staticLoc (g.coeff φ) (fun z => ψ (φ z)) c d y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det)
      = ∫ y in K, F y := by
    rw [← integral_neg]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun hKmeas fun y hy => ?_
    simp only [hkey y (hKφ hy), hF]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, hdef⟩ := deform_metric_in_chart g φ K hK hKφ H hHsm hHs hHK
  obtain ⟨t₂, C₃, ht₂, hC₃, hcl1, hcl2⟩ :=
    flux_first_order_expansion (g.coeff φ) H (fun z => ψ (φ z)) φ.source K φ.open_source hK hKφ
      hGsm hGs hGpos hRG hHsm hHs hHK hfsm
  have hS₀ : IsCompact (φ '' K) :=
    hK.image_of_continuousOn (φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono hKφ)
  obtain ⟨ε₀, CE, q', hε₀, hCE, hq', hsolve⟩ :=
    conformal_linear_solve g hComplete hAF k (φ '' K) hS₀ φ K hK hKφ
  obtain ⟨C₄, hC₄, hbound⟩ := hcl2 (CE * C₃) (mul_nonneg hCE hC₃)
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∫ y in K, F y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hApos' : 0 < A := by rw [hAdef]; exact hApos
  obtain ⟨t, htdef⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ,
      t = min (min (t₀ / 2) t₂) (min (ε₀ / (C₃ + 1)) (A / (16 * C₄ + 1))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ht : 0 < t := by
    rw [htdef]
    exact lt_min (lt_min (half_pos ht₀) ht₂)
      (lt_min (div_pos hε₀ (by linarith)) (div_pos hApos' (by linarith)))
  have ht_t₀ : |t| < t₀ := by
    rw [abs_of_pos ht, htdef]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)) (half_lt_self ht₀)
  have ht_t₂ : t ≤ t₂ := by rw [htdef]; exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have ht_ε : t ≤ ε₀ / (C₃ + 1) := by
    rw [htdef]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have ht_A : t ≤ A / (16 * C₄ + 1) := by
    rw [htdef]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hC₃t : C₃ * t ≤ ε₀ := by
    have h1 := (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < C₃ + 1)).1 ht_ε
    nlinarith
  have hAt : t * (16 * C₄ + 1) ≤ A := (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)).1 ht_A
  
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hcoeff, hheq⟩ := hdef t ht_t₀
  obtain ⟨hVsm, hVoff, hVon⟩ :=
    scalarCurvature_of_local_deformation g h φ K hK hKφ H t hh hcoeff
  have hVb : ∀ p : M, |h.scalarCurvature p| ≤ C₃ * t := by
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p ∈ φ '' K
    · obtain ⟨y, hyK, rfl⟩ := hp
      rw [hVon y (hKφ hyK)]
      have h1 := hcl1 t (by rw [abs_of_pos ht]; exact ht_t₂) y hyK
      rwa [abs_of_pos ht] at h1
    · rw [hVoff p hp, hR0 p, abs_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hC₃ ht.le
  
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hveq0, hvdec, hvE, hvpos⟩ :=
    hsolve h hh hheq (fun p => h.scalarCurvature p) (fun p => -h.scalarCurvature p) hVsm hVsm.neg
      (fun p hp => ⟨by show h.scalarCurvature p = 0; rw [hVoff p hp, hR0 p],
        by show -h.scalarCurvature p = 0; rw [hVoff p hp, hR0 p, neg_zero]⟩)
      (fun p => (hVb p).trans hC₃t)
  have hvpos' : ∀ p : M, 0 < 1 + v p := hvpos (fun p => rfl)
  have hveq : ∀ p : M, -8 * h.lapM v p + h.scalarCurvature p * (1 + v p) = 0 := by
    intro p
    have h1 := hveq0 p
    linarith
  have hlap : ∀ y ∈ φ.source, h.lapM v (φ y) =
      scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => g.coeff φ z + t • H z) y * (1 + v (φ y)) / 8 := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 := hveq (φ y)
    rw [hVon y hy] at h1
    linarith
  have hE : ∫ y in K, (|v (φ y)| + ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => v (φ z)) y‖) ≤ CE * C₃ * t := by
    have h1 := hvE (C₃ * t) (fun p => by rw [abs_neg]; exact hVb p)
    linarith
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z => v (φ z)) φ.source :=
    (contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hv.comp_contMDiffOn φ.contMDiffOn_toFun)).of_le
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  
  have hI : (∫ y in K, (ψ (φ y) * h.lapM v (φ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          ((h.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det -
            (g.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det) *
            partialDeriv i (fun z => ψ (φ z)) y * partialDeriv j (fun z => v (φ z)) y))
      = ∫ y in K, (ψ (φ y) *
          (scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => g.coeff φ z + t • H z) y * (1 + v (φ y)) / 8) *
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y + t • H y).det +
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            ((g.coeff φ y + t • H y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y + t • H y).det -
              (g.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det) *
              partialDeriv i (fun z => ψ (φ z)) y * partialDeriv j (fun z => v (φ z)) y) := by
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun hKmeas fun y hy => ?_
    simp only
    rw [hcoeff y (hKφ hy), hlap y (hKφ hy)]
  have hb : |(∫ y in K, (ψ (φ y) * h.lapM v (φ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          ((h.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det -
            (g.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det) *
            partialDeriv i (fun z => ψ (φ z)) y * partialDeriv j (fun z => v (φ z)) y))
      - t / 8 * A| ≤ C₄ * t ^ 2 := by
    rw [hI, hAdef, ← hA'eq]
    exact hbound t ht ht_t₂ (fun z => v (φ z)) hu hE
  have hIpos : 0 < ∫ y in K, (ψ (φ y) * h.lapM v (φ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          ((h.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det -
            (g.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det) *
            partialDeriv i (fun z => ψ (φ z)) y * partialDeriv j (fun z => v (φ z)) y) := by
    have h1 := (abs_le.1 hb).1
    have h2 : t * (t * (16 * C₄ + 1)) ≤ t * A := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAt ht.le
    nlinarith [mul_pos ht hApos', sq_nonneg t]
  obtain ⟨g', hC', hAF', k', hR', hflux⟩ :=
    conformal_correction_mass g hComplete hAF hR0 k m hm φ K hK hKφ h hh hheq ψ hψ hψharm q₁ R₁
      C₁ hq₁ hψdec v hv hvpos' hveq q' hq' hvdec
  exact ⟨g', hC', hAF', k', _, hR', hflux, sub_lt_self m (mul_pos (by positivity) hIpos)⟩

    (hne : ricci (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₀).symm) j l (chartAt E3 p₀ p₀) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y₁ : E3) (ψ : M → ℝ)

      (∀ (j' : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), R₁ < ‖x‖ →
        |ψ ((hAF.ends j').Φ x) - (if j' = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q₁) ∧

subgoal_signatures.name: conformal_linear_solve
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (S : Set M) (hS : IsCompact S) (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKφ : K ⊆ φ.source) :
    ∃ ε₀ C q' : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ 1 / 2 < q' ∧
      ∀ h : RiemannianMetric3 M, (∀ p : M, p ∉ S → h.g p = g.g p) →
        (∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ h.g p ξ ξ ∧ h.g p ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ) →
        ∀ V f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ V → ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
          (∀ p : M, p ∉ S → V p = 0 ∧ f p = 0) → (∀ p : M, |V p| ≤ ε₀) →
          ∃ v : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v ∧
            (∀ p : M, -8 * h.lapM v p + V p * v p = f p) ∧
            (∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (l : ℕ), l ≤ 2 →
              (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) x‖)
                =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - (l : ℝ))) ∧
            (∀ B : ℝ, (∀ p : M, |f p| ≤ B) →
              ∫ y in K, (|v (φ y)| + ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => v (φ z)) y‖) ≤ C * B) ∧
            ((∀ p : M, f p = -V p) → ∀ p : M, 0 < 1 + v p)

subgoal_signatures.name: flux_first_order_expansion
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ)
    (U K : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hGs : ∀ y i j, G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hR : ∀ y ∈ U, scalarCurvatureLocal G y = 0)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j)) (hHs : ∀ y i j, H y i j = H y j i)
    (hHK : ∀ y, y ∉ K → H y = 0) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) :
    ∃ t₂ C₃ : ℝ, 0 < t₂ ∧ 0 ≤ C₃ ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₂ → ∀ y ∈ K,
        |scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => G z + t • H z) y| ≤ C₃ * |t|) ∧
      ∀ B₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ B₀ → ∃ C₄ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₄ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ t₂ →
        ∀ u : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u U →
          ∫ y in K, (|u y| + ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖) ≤ B₀ * t →
          |(∫ y in K, (f y * (scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => G z + t • H z) y * (1 + u y) / 8) *
                Real.sqrt (G y + t • H y).det +
              ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
                ((G y + t • H y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (G y + t • H y).det -
                  (G y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (G y).det) * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j u y))
            - t / 8 * (-∫ y in K, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
                (G y)⁻¹ a c * (G y)⁻¹ b d * H y a b * staticLoc G f c d y) *
                Real.sqrt (G y).det)| ≤ C₄ * t ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: conformal_correction_mass
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (m : ℝ)
    (hm : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => admFlux g (hAF.ends k) r) atTop (𝓝 m))
    (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKφ : K ⊆ φ.source) (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hh : ∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K → h.g p = g.g p)
    (hheq : ∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3),
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ h.g p ξ ξ ∧ h.g p ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ)
    (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψharm : ∀ p : M, g.lapM ψ p = 0)
    (q₁ R₁ C₁ : ℝ) (hq₁ : 1 / 2 < q₁)
    (hψdec : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), R₁ < ‖x‖ →
      |ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) - (if j = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q₁) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) x‖ ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q₁ - 1))
    (v : M → ℝ) (hv : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v) (hvpos : ∀ p : M, 0 < 1 + v p)
    (hveq : ∀ p : M, -8 * h.lapM v p + h.scalarCurvature p * (1 + v p) = 0)
    (q' : ℝ) (hq' : 1 / 2 < q')
    (hvdec : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (l : ℕ), l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ (g' : RiemannianMetric3 M) (_ : g'.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF' : AsymptoticallyFlat g')
      (k' : Fin hAF'.numEnds),
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g'.scalarCurvature p) ∧
      Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => admFlux g' (hAF'.ends k') r) atTop
        (𝓝 (m - 1 / (2 * Real.pi) * ∫ y in K,
          (ψ (φ y) * h.lapM v (φ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det +
            ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
              ((h.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det -
                (g.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det) *
                partialDeriv i (fun z => ψ (φ z)) y * partialDeriv j (fun z => v (φ z)) y)))

and_nodes.error_message: RETIRED BY REVIEW: EVIDENCE: The 8-child split is correct and should come back the same: blueprint s1-s8 realized 1-to-1, crux isolated in conformal_linear_solve, every child consumed by the glue, evidence sections thorough. Resubmit the same children and the same glue, but two child statements are false as written and each needs one added hypothesis (both already available in the glue). (1) conformal_linear_solve is false when hAF.numEnds = 0. AsymptoticallyFlat allows zero ends, and then isCompact_core makes M compact (e.g. a flat T^3, which is complete and AF with no ends). Taking S = univ, h = g, V = 0, f = 1 would require a smooth v with -8*Laplacian v = 1 on a closed manifold, which is impossible because the integral of the Laplacian is 0. Fix: add (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) or 0 < hAF.numEnds. (2) conformal_correction_mass has no scalar-flatness hypothesis on g, but the blueprint's Green step ('bulk differences supported in phi(K)') uses R_g = 0 off phi''K. Counterexample: on R^3 take g = u^4 delta with u = 1 + m/(2r), m < 0, near infinity, smoothed and kept positive inside; set h = g, psi = 1, v = 1/u - 1 (so (1+v)^4 g = delta and hveq holds), and put K where R_g = 0, so the integral is 0. The conclusion would then give a complete AF metric with R >= 0 and negative mass on R^3, which PMT forbids. Fix: add (hR0 : forall p, g.scalarCurvature p = 0). I would approve exactly this split with those two hypotheses added. Details are in findings.md.

    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (S : Set M) (hS : IsCompact S) (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKφ : K ⊆ φ.source) :
    ∃ ε₀ C q' : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ 1 / 2 < q' ∧
      ∀ h : RiemannianMetric3 M, (∀ p : M, p ∉ S → h.g p = g.g p) →
        (∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ h.g p ξ ξ ∧ h.g p ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ) →
        ∀ V f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ V → ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
          (∀ p : M, p ∉ S → V p = 0 ∧ f p = 0) → (∀ p : M, |V p| ≤ ε₀) →
          ∃ v : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v ∧
            (∀ p : M, -8 * h.lapM v p + V p * v p = f p) ∧
            (∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (l : ℕ), l ≤ 2 →
              (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) x‖)
                =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - (l : ℝ))) ∧
            (∀ B : ℝ, (∀ p : M, |f p| ≤ B) →
              ∫ y in K, (|v (φ y)| + ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => v (φ z)) y‖) ≤ C * B) ∧
            ((∀ p : M, f p = -V p) → ∀ p : M, 0 < 1 + v p)

    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j)) (hHs : ∀ y i j, H y i j = H y j i)
    (hHK : ∀ y, y ∉ K → H y = 0) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) :
    ∃ t₂ C₃ : ℝ, 0 < t₂ ∧ 0 ≤ C₃ ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₂ → ∀ y ∈ K,
        |scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => G z + t • H z) y| ≤ C₃ * |t|) ∧
      ∀ B₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ B₀ → ∃ C₄ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₄ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ t₂ →

                (G y)⁻¹ a c * (G y)⁻¹ b d * H y a b * staticLoc G f c d y) *
                Real.sqrt (G y).det)| ≤ C₄ * t ^ 2

  have hpow : IntegrableOn (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-(2 * q + 2))) S := by
    have hs : (Module.finrank ℝ E3 : ℝ) < 2 * q + 2 := by
      rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]; push_cast; linarith
    have hg : Integrable (fun x : E3 => (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 2) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-(2 * q + 2)))
        (volume.restrict S) :=
      ((integrable_one_add_norm hs).const_mul _).integrableOn
    refine hg.mono' ((measurable_norm.pow_const _).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hS ?_
    intro x hx
    have hx' : R₁ < ‖x‖ := hx
    have ht : 1 ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg ht0 _)]
    have h1 : (2 * ‖x‖) ^ (-(2 * q + 2)) ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-(2 * q + 2)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) ht0] at h1
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 2) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(2 * q + 2)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add two_pos, add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    have h3 : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 2) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _
    calc ‖x‖ ^ (-(2 * q + 2))
        = (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 2) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-(2 * q + 2)) * ‖x‖ ^ (-(2 * q + 2))) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, h2, one_mul]
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * q + 2) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-(2 * q + 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h3
  
  have hc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
    fun i j => (hsmooth i j).continuousOn
  have hdetcont : ContinuousOn (fun x => (G x).det) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    have hfun : (fun x => (G x).det) = fun x =>
        G x 0 0 * G x 1 1 * G x 2 2 - G x 0 0 * G x 1 2 * G x 2 1
          - G x 0 1 * G x 1 0 * G x 2 2 + G x 0 1 * G x 1 2 * G x 2 0
          + G x 0 2 * G x 1 0 * G x 2 1 - G x 0 2 * G x 1 1 * G x 2 0 := by
      funext x; rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    rw [hfun]
    have t1 := ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).mul (hc 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 2)).mul (hc 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0)).mul (hc 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 2)).mul (hc 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hc 0 2).mul (hc 1 0)).mul (hc 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hc 0 2).mul (hc 1 1)).mul (hc 2 0)
    exact ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
  
  have hSsub1 : S ⊆ {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : R₁ < ‖x‖ := hx
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖
    linarith
  have hSsub2 : S ⊆ {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : R₁ < ‖x‖ := hx
    show (2 : ℝ) < ‖x‖
    linarith
  have hlow : ∀ x ∈ S, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : R₁ < ‖x‖ := hx
    exact (hb x (by linarith)).1
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < Real.sqrt (G x).det := by
    intro x hx
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith [hlow x hx])
  have hhc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (Real.sqrt (G x).det)⁻¹) S :=
    ((hdetcont.mono hSsub1).sqrt).inv₀ (fun x hx => (hpos x hx).ne')
  have hhm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Real.sqrt (G x).det)⁻¹) (volume.restrict S) :=
    hhc.aestronglyMeasurable hS
  have hhb : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict S),
      ‖(Real.sqrt (G x).det)⁻¹‖ ≤ (Real.sqrt (1 / 2))⁻¹ := by
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hS ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (hpos x hx))]
    exact (inv_le_inv₀ (hpos x hx) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num))).mpr
      (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hlow x hx))
  have hscal : IntegrableOn (scalarCurvatureLocal G) S := by
    have h1 : Integrable (fun x => (Real.sqrt (G x).det)⁻¹ *
        (scalarCurvatureLocal G x * Real.sqrt (G x).det)) (volume.restrict S) :=
      Integrable.bdd_mul (hint.mono_set hSsub2) hhm hhb
    refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun h1 ?_ hS
    intro x hx
    show (Real.sqrt (G x).det)⁻¹ * (scalarCurvatureLocal G x * Real.sqrt (G x).det)
      = scalarCurvatureLocal G x
    rw [mul_comm, mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (hpos x hx).ne']
  
  have hmeas : Measurable (fluxDivLocal G) := by
    unfold fluxDivLocal partialDeriv
    refine Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_))
    exact (measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ _ _).sub (measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ _ _)
  
  refine Integrable.mono' (hscal.norm.add (hpow.const_mul C₀)) hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hS ?_
  intro x hx
  have hx' : R₁ < ‖x‖ := hx
  have h := hdecomp x (by linarith)
  rw [show (-2 * q - 2 : ℝ) = -(2 * q + 2) by ring] at h
  show ‖fluxDivLocal G x‖ ≤ ‖scalarCurvatureLocal G x‖ + C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-(2 * q + 2))
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hA := abs_le.mp h
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;>
    linarith [neg_abs_le (scalarCurvatureLocal G x), le_abs_self (scalarCurvatureLocal G x)]

informal_problem.statement:
(f : E3 → ℝ) (R₁ : ℝ)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) :
    (∀ a : ℝ, R₁ ≤ a → Integrable (fun x : E3 => f x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a))) ∧
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => ∫ x : E3, f x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a)) atTop (𝓝 0)

signature.name: smoothed_tail_tendsto_zero
signature.statement:
(f : E3 → ℝ) (R₁ : ℝ)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) :
    (∀ a : ℝ, R₁ ≤ a → Integrable (fun x : E3 => f x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a))) ∧
    Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => ∫ x : E3, f x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a)) atTop (𝓝 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  set S : Set E3 := {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} with hS
  have hSm : MeasurableSet S := measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm
  have hF : Integrable (S.indicator f) := hf.integrable_indicator hSm
  have hφc : ∀ a : ℝ, Continuous (fun x : E3 => Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a)) := fun a =>
    Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp (continuous_norm.sub continuous_const)
  have hφb : ∀ a : ℝ, ∀ x : E3, ‖Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro a x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
  have hEq : ∀ a : ℝ, R₁ ≤ a → ∀ x : E3,
      f x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a) = S.indicator f x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a) := by
    intro a ha x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ S
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
    · have hx' : ‖x‖ ≤ R₁ := not_lt.mp hx
      have h0 : Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a) = 0 :=
        Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
      rw [h0, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  have hInt : ∀ a : ℝ, R₁ ≤ a →
      Integrable (fun x : E3 => f x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a)) := by
    intro a ha
    have h1 : Integrable (fun x : E3 => S.indicator f x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a)) :=
      hF.mul_bdd (hφc a).aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ (hφb a))
    have h2 : (fun x : E3 => f x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a))
        = (fun x : E3 => S.indicator f x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a)) :=
      funext (hEq a ha)
    rw [h2]
    exact h1
  refine ⟨hInt, ?_⟩
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => ∫ x : E3, f x * Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ _x : E3, (0 : ℝ))) := by
    refine tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun x => ‖S.indicator f x‖) ?_ ?_
      hF.norm ?_
    · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop R₁] with a ha
      exact (hInt a ha).aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop R₁] with a ha
      refine ae_of_all _ (fun x => ?_)
      rw [hEq a ha x, norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) (hφb a x)
    · refine ae_of_all _ (fun x => ?_)
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop ‖x‖] with a ha
      have h0 : Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a) = 0 :=
        Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
      rw [h0, mul_zero]
  rw [integral_zero] at hlim
  exact hlim

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    ∫ x : E3, fluxDivLocal G x
        * (Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a) - Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - b))
      = -(16 * Real.pi) *
        ((∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (a + s))
          - (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (b + s)))

signature.name: divergence_shell_identity
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) :
    ∫ x : E3, fluxDivLocal G x
        * (Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a) - Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - b))
      = -(16 * Real.pi) *
        ((∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (a + s))
          - (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (b + s)))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, t < 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 1 < t → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).continuous_deriv le_rfl
    · intro t ht
      have h : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds ht] with s hs
        exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hs)
      rw [h.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    · intro t ht
      have h : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ht] with s hs
        exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (le_of_lt hs)
      rw [h.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  obtain ⟨hwc, hw0, hw1⟩ := s1
  have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hB : IsOpen {x : E3 | ‖x‖ < 2} := isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const
  
  have s2 : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro f hf i
    exact (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have s3 : ∀ c : ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)) {y : E3 | y ≠ 0} ∧
      ∀ x : E3, x ≠ 0 → ∀ j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv j (fun y : E3 => Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)) x
          = deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - c) * (x j / ‖x‖) := by
    intro c
    constructor
    · intro y hy
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ - c) y :=
        (contDiffAt_norm ℝ hy).sub contDiffAt_const
      exact (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp_contDiffAt y h1).contDiffWithinAt
    · intro x hx j
      have hn : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx
      have hsq : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ x) x :=
        (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq x).hasFDerivAt
      have hsqrt := hsq.sqrt (by positivity)
      have heq : (fun y : E3 => Real.sqrt (‖y‖ ^ 2)) = fun y => ‖y‖ := by
        funext y; exact Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)
      rw [heq] at hsqrt
      have hψ : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - c))
          (‖x‖ - c) :=
        (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1).differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasDerivAt
      have hcomp := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt x hψ (hsqrt.sub_const c)
      have hf : (fun y : E3 => Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c))
          = Real.smoothTransition ∘ (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ - c) := rfl
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hf, hcomp.fderiv]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
      field_simp
      try simp
  
  have s4 : ∀ (f χ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} →
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} → (∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < 2 → χ x = 0) → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      Differentiable ℝ (fun x => f x * χ x) ∧
      Continuous (partialDeriv j (fun x => f x * χ x)) ∧
      ∀ x : E3, partialDeriv j (fun x => f x * χ x) x
        = partialDeriv j f x * χ x + f x * partialDeriv j χ x := by
    intro f χ hf hχ hχ0 j
    have hloc : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < 2 →
        (χ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) ∧ ((fun y => f y * χ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      intro x hx
      have hm : {x : E3 | ‖x‖ < 2} ∈ 𝓝 x := hB.mem_nhds hx
      constructor
      · filter_upwards [hm] with y hy using hχ0 y hy
      · filter_upwards [hm] with y hy
        simp [hχ0 y hy]
    have hdU : ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ f x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ χ x := by
      intro x hx
      exact ⟨(hf.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx),
        (hχ.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)⟩
    have hformula : ∀ x : E3, partialDeriv j (fun x => f x * χ x) x
        = partialDeriv j f x * χ x + f x * partialDeriv j χ x := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : 1 < ‖x‖
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hdU x hx
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [fderiv_fun_mul h1 h2]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · have hx2 : ‖x‖ < 2 := by linarith [not_lt.mp hx]
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hloc x hx2
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [h1.fderiv_eq, h2.fderiv_eq, hχ0 x hx2]
        simp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hformula⟩
    · intro x
      by_cases hx : 1 < ‖x‖
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hdU x hx
        exact h1.mul h2
      · have hx2 : ‖x‖ < 2 := by linarith [not_lt.mp hx]
        exact (differentiableAt_const (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hloc x hx2).2
    · rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : 1 < ‖x‖
      · have hcf : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e j)) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
          (hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
        have hcχ : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ χ y (e j)) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
          (hχ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
        have hcon : ContinuousOn (fun y => partialDeriv j f y * χ y + f y * partialDeriv j χ y)
            {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
          (hcf.mul hχ.continuousOn).add (hf.continuousOn.mul hcχ)
        have := hcon.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
        exact this.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => (hformula y).symm))
      · have hx2 : ‖x‖ < 2 := by linarith [not_lt.mp hx]
        have hev : (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] partialDeriv j (fun x => f x * χ x) := by
          filter_upwards [hB.mem_nhds hx2] with y hy
          unfold partialDeriv
          rw [(hloc y hy).2.fderiv_eq]
          simp
        exact continuousAt_const.congr hev
  
  have s5 : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (j : Fin 3), Differentiable ℝ f → HasCompactSupport f →
      Continuous (partialDeriv j f) →
      Integrable (partialDeriv j f) ∧ ∫ x : E3, partialDeriv j f x = 0 := by
    intro f j hdiff hcs hcont
    have hcs' : HasCompactSupport (partialDeriv j f) := by
      unfold partialDeriv
      exact hcs.fderiv_apply ℝ (e j)
    have hint : Integrable (partialDeriv j f) := hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs'
    refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
    have key := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := (volume : Measure E3))
      (f := f) (g := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (v := e j) ?_ ?_ ?_ hdiff (differentiable_const _)
    · simp at key
      have : ∫ x, partialDeriv j f x = ∫ x, fderiv ℝ f x (e j) := rfl
      rw [this]
      linarith
    · simpa [mul_one] using hint
    · simp
    · simpa using hdiff.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs
  
  have s6 : ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ →
      ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y)) x
        = fluxDivLocal G x := by
    intro x hx
    have hd : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k f) x := by
      intro k f hf
      exact ((s2 f hf k).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    have hj : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y)) x
        = ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv j (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y) x
            - partialDeriv j (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y) x) := by
      intro j
      have hdiff : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)), DifferentiableAt ℝ
          (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y)
          x :=
        fun i _ => (hd i _ (hsmooth i j)).sub (hd j _ (hsmooth i i))
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y)) x (e j)
        = _
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum hdiff, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hd i _ (hsmooth i j)) (hd j _ (hsmooth i i))]
      rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hj j), Finset.sum_comm]
    rfl
  
  have s7 : ∀ c : ℝ, 2 ≤ c →
      Integrable (fun x : E3 => (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) x - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) x))
          * (x j / ‖x‖)) * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - c)) := by
    intro c hc
    set H := fun x : E3 => (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) x - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) x))
            * (x j / ‖x‖)) * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - c) with hH
    have hz : ∀ x : E3, (‖x‖ < 2 ∨ c + 1 < ‖x‖) → H x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · simp only [hH, hw0 (‖x‖ - c) (by linarith), mul_zero]
      · simp only [hH, hw1 (‖x‖ - c) (by linarith), mul_zero]
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport H := by
      apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0:E3) (c+1))
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] at hx
      exact hz x (Or.inr hx)
    have hcont : Continuous H := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : 1 < ‖x‖
      · have hP : ∀ i j k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j))
            {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
          intro i j k
          exact ((hsmooth i j).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply
            continuousOn_const
        have hcoord : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x : E3 => x j / ‖x‖)
            {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
          intro j
          apply ContinuousOn.div
          · exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.continuousOn
          · exact continuous_norm.continuousOn
          · intro y hy
            have : (1:ℝ) < ‖y‖ := hy
            positivity
        have hon : ContinuousOn H {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
          apply ContinuousOn.mul
          · apply continuousOn_finset_sum
            intro j _
            apply ContinuousOn.mul _ (hcoord j)
            apply continuousOn_finset_sum
            intro i _
            exact (hP i j i).sub (hP i i j)
          · exact (hwc.comp (continuous_norm.sub continuous_const)).continuousOn
        exact hon.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
      · have hx2 : ‖x‖ < 2 := by linarith [not_lt.mp hx]
        have hev : (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] H := by
          filter_upwards [hB.mem_nhds hx2] with y hy
          exact (hz y (Or.inl hy)).symm
        exact continuousAt_const.congr hev
    exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs
  
  have s8 : ∀ h : E3 → ℝ, Integrable h →
      ∫ x : E3, h x = ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        r ^ 2 * ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1), h (r • (θ : E3)) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere := by
    intro h hh
    have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ E3 - 1 = 2 := by simp
    have hmp := Measure.measurePreserving_homeomorphUnitSphereProd (volume : Measure E3)
    rw [hdim] at hmp
    have h2 : ∫ x : E3, h x
        = ∫ x : ({0}ᶜ : Set E3), h x ∂(Measure.comap Subtype.val volume) := by
      rw [integral_subtype_comap (measurableSet_singleton 0).compl h]
      rw [← integral_add_compl (measurableSet_singleton (0:E3)) hh,
        setIntegral_measure_zero _ (measure_singleton 0), zero_add]
    let g : (sphere (0:E3) 1) × (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) → ℝ :=
      fun p => h ((homeomorphUnitSphereProd E3).symm p : E3)
    have hgΦ : ∀ x : ({0}ᶜ : Set E3), g (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E3 x) = h x := by
      intro x
      simp only [g, Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply]
    have h3 : ∫ x : ({0}ᶜ : Set E3), h x ∂(Measure.comap Subtype.val volume)
        = ∫ p, g p ∂((volume : Measure E3).toSphere.prod (Measure.volumeIoiPow 2)) := by
      rw [← hmp.integral_comp (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E3).measurableEmbedding g]
      simp only [hgΦ]
    have hgi : Integrable g ((volume : Measure E3).toSphere.prod (Measure.volumeIoiPow 2)) := by
      rw [← hmp.integrable_comp_emb (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E3).measurableEmbedding]
      have : g ∘ (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E3) = h ∘ Subtype.val := by
        funext x
        exact hgΦ x
      rw [this]
      exact (integrableOn_iff_comap_subtypeVal (measurableSet_singleton 0).compl).mp
        hh.integrableOn
    rw [h2, h3, integral_prod_symm g hgi, Measure.volumeIoiPow.eq_1]
    have hmeas : Measurable (fun r : Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) => ENNReal.ofReal ((r:ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
      ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_subtype_coe.pow_const 2)
    rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul hmeas
      (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top))]
    rw [← integral_subtype_comap measurableSet_Ioi
      (fun r => r ^ 2 * ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1), h (r • (θ : E3))
        ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere)]
    congr 1
    funext y
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity), smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
  
  have s9 : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c →
      ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), r ^ 2 * ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1),
          (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
             (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) (r • (θ : E3))
               - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) (r • (θ : E3))))
             * ((r • (θ : E3)) j / ‖r • (θ : E3)‖))
            * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖r • (θ : E3)‖ - c) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere
        = 16 * Real.pi * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (c + s) := by
    intro c hc
    set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 16 * Real.pi * (deriv Real.smoothTransition (r - c) * fluxLocal G r)
      with hg
    have h1 : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ 2 * ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1),
          (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
             (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) (r • (θ : E3))
               - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) (r • (θ : E3))))
             * ((r • (θ : E3)) j / ‖r • (θ : E3)‖))
            * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖r • (θ : E3)‖ - c) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere
          = g r := by
      intro r hr
      have hr0 : 0 < r := hr
      have hin : ∀ θ : sphere (0:E3) 1,
          (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
             (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) (r • (θ : E3))
               - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) (r • (θ : E3))))
             * ((r • (θ : E3)) j / ‖r • (θ : E3)‖))
            * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖r • (θ : E3)‖ - c)
          = (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
              (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r • (θ : E3))
                - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j)
              * deriv Real.smoothTransition (r - c) := by
        intro θ
        have hθ : ‖(θ : E3)‖ = 1 := norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ
        have hn : ‖r • (θ : E3)‖ = r := by
          rw [norm_smul, hθ, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr0, mul_one]
        have hcj : ∀ j : Fin 3, (r • (θ:E3)) j / r = (θ:E3) j := by
          intro j
          rw [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
        simp only [hn, hcj, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ hin), integral_mul_const]
      simp only [hg, fluxLocal]
      field_simp
      try ring
    rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi h1]
    have hsub : Set.Icc c (c+1) ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := fun r hr => lt_of_lt_of_le hc hr.1
    have hzero : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) \ Set.Icc c (c+1), g r = 0 := by
      intro r hr
      have hr2 := hr.2
      simp only [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le] at hr2
      rcases hr2 with hr2 | hr2
      · simp [hg, hw0 (r - c) (by linarith)]
      · simp [hg, hw1 (r - c) (by linarith)]
    rw [setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi hsub hzero]
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith)]
    have hshift := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right g c (a := 0) (b := 1)
    rw [zero_add, show (1:ℝ) + c = c + 1 by ring] at hshift
    rw [← hshift, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext s
    simp only [hg]
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right, add_comm s c]
  
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, V = fun j y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨η, hηdef⟩ : ∃ η : E3 → ℝ, η = fun x =>
      Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a) - Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - b) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨H, hHdef⟩ : ∃ H : ℝ → E3 → ℝ, H = fun c x => (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) x - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) x))
          * (x j / ‖x‖)) * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVx : ∀ j y, V j y = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y) :=
    fun j y => by rw [hVdef]
  have hηx : ∀ x, η x = Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a) - Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - b) :=
    fun x => by rw [hηdef]
  have hHx : ∀ c x, H c x = (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) x - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) x))
          * (x j / ‖x‖)) * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - c) :=
    fun c x => by rw [hHdef]
  have hVs : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (V j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro j
    have hfun : V j = fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y) := by
      rw [hVdef]
    have h : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (V j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
      rw [hfun]
      apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro i _
      exact (s2 _ (hsmooth i j) i).sub (s2 _ (hsmooth i i) j)
    exact h.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hη : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 η {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    have h : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ η {y : E3 | y ≠ 0} := by
      rw [hηdef]
      exact (s3 a).1.sub (s3 b).1
    refine (h.mono ?_).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    intro y hy
    have : (1:ℝ) < ‖y‖ := hy
    exact norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith)
  have hη0 : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < 2 → η x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hηx, Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith),
      Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), sub_zero]
  have hηcs : HasCompactSupport η := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0:E3) (max a b + 1))
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] at hx
    have h1 : a ≤ max a b := le_max_left _ _
    have h2 : b ≤ max a b := le_max_right _ _
    rw [hηx, Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith),
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith), sub_self]
  have hW : ∀ j : Fin 3, Differentiable ℝ (fun x => V j x * η x) ∧
      Continuous (partialDeriv j (fun x => V j x * η x)) ∧
      ∀ x : E3, partialDeriv j (fun x => V j x * η x) x
        = partialDeriv j (V j) x * η x + V j x * partialDeriv j η x :=
    fun j => s4 (V j) η (hVs j) hη hη0 j
  have hWcs : ∀ j : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (fun x => V j x * η x) := by
    intro j
    have := hηcs.mul_left (f := V j)
    exact this
  have hWi : ∀ j : Fin 3, Integrable (partialDeriv j (fun x => V j x * η x)) ∧
      ∫ x : E3, partialDeriv j (fun x => V j x * η x) x = 0 :=
    fun j => s5 _ j (hW j).1 (hWcs j) (hW j).2.1
  have s6' : ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ → ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (V j) x = fluxDivLocal G x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hVdef]
    exact s6 x hx
  
  have hpt : ∀ x : E3, ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun x => V j x * η x) x
      = fluxDivLocal G x * η x + (H a x - H b x) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : 1 < ‖x‖
    · have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith)
      have hdη : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j η x
          = deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a) * (x j / ‖x‖)
            - deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - b) * (x j / ‖x‖) := by
        intro j
        have hda : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : E3 => Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - a)) x :=
          ((s3 a).1.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hx0)
        have hdb : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : E3 => Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - b)) x :=
          ((s3 b).1.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hx0)
        rw [← (s3 a).2 x hx0 j, ← (s3 b).2 x hx0 j, hηdef]
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [fderiv_fun_sub hda hdb, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => (hW j).2.2 x), Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        ← Finset.sum_mul, s6' x hx]
      simp only [hdη, hHx, hVx, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    · have hx2 : ‖x‖ < 2 := by linarith [not_lt.mp hx]
      have hηev : η =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hB.mem_nhds hx2] with y hy using hη0 y hy
      have hdη : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j η x = 0 := by
        intro j
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [hηev.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => (hW j).2.2 x)]
      simp only [hdη, hη0 x hx2, hHx, hw0 (‖x‖ - a) (by linarith),
        hw0 (‖x‖ - b) (by linarith)]
      simp
  
  have hHi : ∀ c : ℝ, 2 ≤ c → Integrable (H c) := by
    intro c hc
    rw [hHdef]
    exact s7 c hc
  have hHint : ∀ c : ℝ, 2 ≤ c → ∫ x : E3, H c x
      = 16 * Real.pi * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (c + s) := by
    intro c hc
    rw [s8 (H c) (hHi c hc), hHdef]
    exact s9 c (by linarith)
  have hfun : (fun x : E3 => fluxDivLocal G x
      * (Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - a) - Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - b)))
      = fun x => (∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun x => V j x * η x) x) - (H a x - H b x) := by
    funext x
    rw [hpt x, hηx x]
    ring
  have i1 : Integrable (fun x : E3 => ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun x => V j x * η x) x) :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => (hWi j).1)
  have i2 : Integrable (fun x : E3 => H a x - H b x) := (hHi a ha).sub (hHi b hb)
  have hsum0 : ∑ j : Fin 3, ∫ x : E3, partialDeriv j (fun x => V j x * η x) x = 0 :=
    Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => (hWi j).2)
  rw [hfun, integral_sub i1 i2, integral_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => (hWi j).1), hsum0,
    integral_sub (hHi a ha) (hHi b hb), hHint a ha, hHint b hb]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
        |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)) :
    ∃ R₀ C₀ : ℝ, ∀ r r' : ℝ, R₀ ≤ r → r ≤ r' → r' ≤ r + 1 →
      |fluxLocal G r' - fluxLocal G r| ≤ C₀ * r ^ (-q) * (r' - r)

signature.name: flux_increment_bound
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
        |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)) :
    ∃ R₀ C₀ : ℝ, ∀ r r' : ℝ, R₀ ≤ r → r ≤ r' → r' ≤ r + 1 →
      |fluxLocal G r' - fluxLocal G r| ≤ C₀ * r ^ (-q) * (r' - r)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hUo : IsOpen {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (u : E3), ‖u‖ = 1 → ∀ j : Fin 3, |u j| ≤ 1 := by
    intro u hu j
    have := PiLp.norm_apply_le u j
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hu] at this
    exact this
  
  have hsum : ∀ (a b : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (u : E3) (M : ℝ), ‖u‖ = 1 →
      (∀ i j, |a i j| ≤ M) → (∀ i j, |b i j| ≤ M) →
      |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (a i j - b i j) * u j| ≤ 18 * M := by
    intro a b u M hu ha hb
    have hS : ∀ i j, |(a i j - b i j) * u j| ≤ 2 * M := by
      intro i j
      rw [abs_mul]
      have h1 : |a i j - b i j| ≤ 2 * M := by
        have := abs_sub (a i j) (b i j)
        linarith [ha i j, hb i j]
      calc |a i j - b i j| * |u j| ≤ |a i j - b i j| * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcoord u hu j) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ 2 * M := by linarith
    calc |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (a i j - b i j) * u j|
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |∑ j : Fin 3, (a i j - b i j) * u j| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |(a i j - b i j) * u j| :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _)
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, 2 * M :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hS i j))
      _ = 18 * M := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  
  have hdiff : ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableOn ℝ (partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j)) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro i j k
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) y) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
      (hsmooth i j).fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    have h2 := h1.differentiableOn (by norm_num)
    exact h2.clm_apply (differentiableOn_const (e k))
  
  have hP : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → R < t → ∀ u : E3, ‖u‖ = 1 → ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv k (fun x => G x i j) (t • u)| ≤ C * t ^ (-q - 1) := by
    intro t ht0 hRt u hu i j k
    have hn : ‖t • u‖ = t := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht0, hu, mul_one]
    have h1 := (fderiv ℝ (fun x => G x i j) (t • u)).le_opNorm (e k)
    have h2 : ‖e k‖ = 1 := by simp [e]
    have h3 := ((hb (t • u) (by rw [hn]; exact hRt)).2 i j k).2.1
    rw [hn] at h3
    rw [h2, mul_one] at h1
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact h1.trans h3
  
  have hL : ∀ r r' : ℝ, R < r → r ≤ r' → ∀ u : E3, ‖u‖ = 1 → ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) (r' • u) - partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) (r • u)|
        ≤ C * r ^ (-q - 2) * (r' - r) := by
    intro r r' hr hrr' u hu i j k
    have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
    have hseg : ∀ y ∈ segment ℝ (r • u) (r' • u), r ≤ ‖y‖ := by
      intro y hy
      rw [segment_eq_image] at hy
      obtain ⟨l, ⟨hl0, hl1⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
      have hsm : (1 - l) • (r • u) + l • (r' • u) = ((1 - l) * r + l * r') • u := by
        rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, ← add_smul]
      have hle : r ≤ (1 - l) * r + l * r' := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hl0 (sub_nonneg.2 hrr')]
      show r ≤ ‖(1 - l) • (r • u) + l • (r' • u)‖
      rw [hsm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hu, mul_one, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      exact hle
    have hmvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ)
      (f := partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j)) (C := C * r ^ (-q - 2))
      (s := segment ℝ (r • u) (r' • u)) ?_ ?_ (convex_segment _ _)
      (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _) (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _)
    · rw [← sub_smul, norm_smul, hu, mul_one,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ r' - r)] at hmvt
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hmvt
    · intro y hy
      have hy1 : y ∈ {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
        show 1 < ‖y‖
        linarith [hseg y hy]
      exact (hdiff i j k).differentiableAt (hUo.mem_nhds hy1)
    · intro y hy
      have hry := hseg y hy
      have h1 := ((hb y (by linarith)).2 i j k).2.2
      refine h1.trans ?_
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hC
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hr0 hry (by linarith)
  
  have hint : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 < t → Integrable (fun θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1 =>
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (t • (θ : E3))
          - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (t • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j)
      (volume : Measure E3).toSphere := by
    intro t ht
    have hc : ∀ i j k : Fin 3, Continuous
        (fun θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1 => partialDeriv k (fun x => G x i j) (t • (θ : E3))) := by
      intro i j k
      refine ((hdiff i j k).continuousOn).comp_continuous
        (continuous_subtype_val.const_smul t) ?_
      intro θ
      show 1 < ‖t • (θ : E3)‖
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith), norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ,
        mul_one]
      exact ht
    have hcont : Continuous (fun θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1 =>
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (t • (θ : E3))
            - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (t • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j) := by
      refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuous_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_))
      refine ((hc i j i).sub (hc i i j)).mul ?_
      fun_prop
    exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  
  set K : ℝ := (volume : Measure E3).toSphere.real Set.univ with hK
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := measureReal_nonneg
  refine ⟨R + 1, 9 * C * K / (2 * Real.pi), ?_⟩
  intro r r' hr hrr' hr'
  have hRr : R < r := by linarith
  have hRr' : R < r' := by linarith
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
  have hr0' : 0 < r' := by linarith
  have hr1 : 1 < r := by linarith
  have hr1' : 1 < r' := by linarith
  have hF : ∀ t, fluxLocal G t = 1 / (16 * Real.pi) * t ^ 2 *
      ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1),
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (t • (θ : E3))
            - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (t • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j
        ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere := fun t => rfl
  rw [hF r', hF r]
  set I1 := ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1),
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r' • (θ : E3))
            - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r' • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j
        ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere with hI1def
  set I0 := ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1),
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r • (θ : E3))
            - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j
        ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere with hI0def
  have hI1 : |I1| ≤ 18 * (C * r' ^ (-q - 1)) * K := by
    have := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := (volume : Measure E3).toSphere)
      (C := 18 * (C * r' ^ (-q - 1))) (ae_of_all _ (fun θ => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hsum _ _ (θ : E3) _ (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ)
          (fun i j => hP r' hr0' hRr' _ (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ) i j i)
          (fun i j => hP r' hr0' hRr' _ (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ) i i j)))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact this
  have hI10 : |I1 - I0| ≤ 18 * (C * r ^ (-q - 2) * (r' - r)) * K := by
    rw [hI1def, hI0def, ← integral_sub (hint r' hr1') (hint r hr1)]
    have := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := (volume : Measure E3).toSphere)
      (f := fun θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1 =>
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r' • (θ : E3))
            - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r' • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j)
        - ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r • (θ : E3))
            - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j)
      (C := 18 * (C * r ^ (-q - 2) * (r' - r))) (ae_of_all _ (fun θ => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have heq : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r' • (θ : E3))
            - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r' • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j)
          - ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r • (θ : E3))
            - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j
          = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            ((partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r' • (θ : E3))
                - partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r • (θ : E3)))
              - (partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r' • (θ : E3))
                - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r • (θ : E3)))) * (θ : E3) j := by
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
        have hfin := hsum _ _ (θ : E3) _ (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ)
          (fun i j => hL r r' hRr hrr' _ (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ) i j i)
          (fun i j => hL r r' hRr hrr' _ (norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ) i i j)
        rw [← heq] at hfin
        exact hfin))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact this
  
  set a := r ^ (-q) with ha
  have ha0 : 0 < a := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 _
  have hpow1 : r ^ (-q - 1) = a / r := by
    rw [Real.rpow_sub hr0, Real.rpow_one]
  have hpow2 : r ^ (-q - 2) = a / r ^ 2 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_sub hr0, Real.rpow_two]
  have hmono : r' ^ (-q - 1) ≤ r ^ (-q - 1) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hr0 hrr' (by linarith)
  have hX : r * |I1| ≤ 18 * C * K * a := by
    have h1 : |I1| ≤ 18 * (C * r ^ (-q - 1)) * K := by
      refine hI1.trans ?_
      have : C * r' ^ (-q - 1) ≤ C * r ^ (-q - 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hC
      nlinarith
    rw [hpow1] at h1
    have h2 : r * |I1| ≤ r * (18 * (C * (a / r)) * K) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hr0.le
    have h3 : r * (18 * (C * (a / r)) * K) = 18 * C * K * a := by
      field_simp
    linarith
  have hY : r ^ 2 * |I1 - I0| ≤ 18 * C * K * a * (r' - r) := by
    rw [hpow2] at hI10
    have h2 : r ^ 2 * |I1 - I0| ≤ r ^ 2 * (18 * (C * (a / r ^ 2) * (r' - r)) * K) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI10 (by positivity)
    have h3 : r ^ 2 * (18 * (C * (a / r ^ 2) * (r' - r)) * K) = 18 * C * K * a * (r' - r) := by
      field_simp
    linarith
  have hsq : r' ^ 2 - r ^ 2 ≤ 3 * r * (r' - r) := by nlinarith
  have hsq0 : 0 ≤ r' ^ 2 - r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hZ : (r' ^ 2 - r ^ 2) * |I1| ≤ 3 * (r' - r) * (18 * C * K * a) := by
    have h1 : (r' ^ 2 - r ^ 2) * |I1| ≤ 3 * r * (r' - r) * |I1| :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq (abs_nonneg _)
    have h2 : 3 * (r' - r) * (r * |I1|) ≤ 3 * (r' - r) * (18 * C * K * a) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hpi : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hdecomp : 1 / (16 * Real.pi) * r' ^ 2 * I1 - 1 / (16 * Real.pi) * r ^ 2 * I0
      = 1 / (16 * Real.pi) * ((r' ^ 2 - r ^ 2) * I1 + r ^ 2 * (I1 - I0)) := by ring
  rw [hdecomp, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 1 / (16 * Real.pi))]
  have htri : |(r' ^ 2 - r ^ 2) * I1 + r ^ 2 * (I1 - I0)|
      ≤ (r' ^ 2 - r ^ 2) * |I1| + r ^ 2 * |I1 - I0| := by
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hsq0, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ r ^ 2)]
  have htot : |(r' ^ 2 - r ^ 2) * I1 + r ^ 2 * (I1 - I0)| ≤ 72 * C * K * a * (r' - r) := by
    linarith
  calc 1 / (16 * Real.pi) * |(r' ^ 2 - r ^ 2) * I1 + r ^ 2 * (I1 - I0)|
      ≤ 1 / (16 * Real.pi) * (72 * C * K * a * (r' - r)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htot (by positivity)
    _ = 9 * C * K / (2 * Real.pi) * a * (r' - r) := by
        field_simp
        ring

informal_problem.statement:
(F : ℝ → ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (R₀ C₀ : ℝ)
    (hosc : ∀ r r' : ℝ, R₀ ≤ r → r ≤ r' → r' ≤ r + 1 → |F r' - F r| ≤ C₀ * r ^ (-q) * (r' - r))
    (m : ℝ)
    (hA : Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * F (a + s))
      atTop (𝓝 m)) :
    Tendsto F atTop (𝓝 m)

signature.name: tendsto_of_smoothed_tendsto
signature.statement:
(F : ℝ → ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (R₀ C₀ : ℝ)
    (hosc : ∀ r r' : ℝ, R₀ ≤ r → r ≤ r' → r' ≤ r + 1 → |F r' - F r| ≤ C₀ * r ^ (-q) * (r' - r))
    (m : ℝ)
    (hA : Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * F (a + s))
      atTop (𝓝 m)) :
    Tendsto F atTop (𝓝 m)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hcd : ContDiff ℝ ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) Real.smoothTransition :=
    Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)
  have hw : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) := hcd.continuous_deriv (by norm_num)
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ Real.smoothTransition := hcd.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hw1 : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s = 1 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub (fun x _ => hdiff x) (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 1)]
    simp [Real.smoothTransition.one, Real.smoothTransition.zero]
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (hw.continuousOn (s := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))
  
  have key : ∀ a : ℝ, max R₀ 1 ≤ a →
      |(∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * F (a + s)) - F a|
        ≤ W * |C₀| * a ^ (-q) := by
    intro a ha
    have hRa : R₀ ≤ a := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) ha
    have h1a : 1 ≤ a := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) ha
    have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
    have hP : 0 < a ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ha0 _
    have main : ∀ u v : ℝ, u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → u ≤ v →
        |F (a + v) - F (a + u)| ≤ |C₀| * (v - u) := by
      intro u v hu hv huv
      have hr : (a + u) ^ (-q) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith [hu.1]) (by linarith)
      have hr0 : 0 < (a + u) ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by linarith [hu.1]) _
      have h0 := hosc (a + u) (a + v) (by linarith [hu.1]) (by linarith)
        (by linarith [hu.1, hv.2])
      have e : a + v - (a + u) = v - u := by ring
      rw [e] at h0
      have hd : 0 ≤ v - u := by linarith
      have h4 : C₀ * (a + u) ^ (-q) ≤ |C₀| := by
        calc C₀ * (a + u) ^ (-q) ≤ |C₀| * (a + u) ^ (-q) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hr0.le
          _ ≤ |C₀| * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = |C₀| := mul_one _
      have h3 : C₀ * (a + u) ^ (-q) * (v - u) ≤ |C₀| * (v - u) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4 hd
      linarith
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun s => F (a + s)) (Set.uIcc 0 1) := by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      have hlip : LipschitzOnWith (Real.toNNReal |C₀|) (fun s => F (a + s)) (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
        apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
        intro s hs s' hs'
        simp only [Real.dist_eq]
        rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (abs_nonneg _)]
        rcases le_total s s' with h | h
        · rw [abs_sub_comm (F (a + s)), abs_sub_comm s s', abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h)]
          exact main s s' hs hs' h
        · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h)]
          exact main s' s hs' hs h
      exact hlip.continuousOn
    have hI1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => deriv Real.smoothTransition s * F (a + s))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 1).mul_continuousOn hcont
    have hI2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => deriv Real.smoothTransition s * F a)
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (hw.mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    have hc : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * F a = F a := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, hw1, one_mul]
    have hsplit : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * F (a + s)) - F a
        = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * (F (a + s) - F a) := by
      have h5 := intervalIntegral.integral_sub hI1 hI2
      rw [hc] at h5
      rw [← h5]
      congr 1
      ext s
      ring
    rw [hsplit]
    have hb : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ‖deriv Real.smoothTransition s * (F (a + s) - F a)‖ ≤ W * (|C₀| * a ^ (-q)) := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
      have hs' : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2⟩
      have h1 := hW s hs'
      have h2 : |F (a + s) - F a| ≤ |C₀| * a ^ (-q) := by
        have h6 := hosc a (a + s) hRa (by linarith [hs.1]) (by linarith [hs.2])
        have e : a + s - a = s := by ring
        rw [e] at h6
        calc |F (a + s) - F a| ≤ C₀ * a ^ (-q) * s := h6
          _ ≤ |C₀| * a ^ (-q) * s :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hP.le) hs.1.le
          _ ≤ |C₀| * a ^ (-q) * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs.2 (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hP.le)
          _ = |C₀| * a ^ (-q) := mul_one _
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (F (a + s) - F a)]
      exact mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans h1)
    have h7 := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hb
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h7
    have e : W * (|C₀| * a ^ (-q)) * |(1 : ℝ) - 0| = W * |C₀| * a ^ (-q) := by
      rw [sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one, mul_assoc]
    rw [e] at h7
    exact h7
  
  have hdiffT : Tendsto (fun a : ℝ =>
      (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * F (a + s)) - F a) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h' : Tendsto (fun a : ℝ => W * |C₀| * a ^ (-q)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have h8 := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hq).const_mul (W * |C₀|)
      rwa [mul_zero] at h8
    apply squeeze_zero_norm' _ h'
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (max R₀ 1)] with a ha
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact key a ha
  have h9 := hA.sub hdiffT
  rw [sub_zero] at h9
  exact h9.congr (fun a => sub_sub_cancel _ _)

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : EndChart M)
    (F : Diffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M E3 ∞)
    (hF : ∀ (p : M) (v w : E3), g.g p v w = @inner ℝ E3 _
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F p v) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F p w)) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => F (Φ.Φ x)) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} ∧
    ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff Φ.Φ x i j = @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => F (Φ.Φ y)) x (e i))
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => F (Φ.Φ y)) x (e j))

signature.name: isometric_coeff_eq_inner_fderiv
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : EndChart M)
    (F : Diffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M E3 ∞)
    (hF : ∀ (p : M) (v w : E3), g.g p v w = @inner ℝ E3 _
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F p v) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F p w)) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => F (Φ.Φ x)) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} ∧
    ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff Φ.Φ x i j = @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => F (Φ.Φ y)) x (e i))
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => F (Φ.Φ y)) x (e j))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hφ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ.Φ Φ.Φ.source := Φ.Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun
  have hFs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ F := F.contMDiff
  have hcomp : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun x => F (Φ.Φ x)) Φ.Φ.source :=
    hFs.comp_contMDiffOn hφ
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Φ.source_eq]
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcomp
  · intro x hx i j
    have hmem : x ∈ Φ.Φ.source := by rw [Φ.source_eq]; exact hx
    have hφx : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ.Φ x :=
      (hφ.contMDiffAt (Φ.Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hmem)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hFx : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F (Φ.Φ x) :=
      hFs.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hchain : ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => F (Φ.Φ y)) x v =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F (Φ.Φ x) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ.Φ x v) := by
      intro v
      rw [← mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      exact mfderiv_comp_apply x hFx hφx v
    have h1 : g.coeff Φ.Φ x i j = g.g (Φ.Φ x) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ.Φ x (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ.Φ x (e j)) := rfl
    rw [h1, hF, hchain, hchain]
