signature.name: gram_inverse_bound
signature.statement:
(p : Fin 3 → E3)
    (hp : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |@inner ℝ E3 _ (p i) (p j) - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6)
    (v : E3) : ‖v‖ ≤ 3 * ∑ l : Fin 3, |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)|

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hq : ∀ c : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, c i ^ 2 ≤ ‖∑ i : Fin 3, c i • p i‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro c
    have key : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        c i * c j * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (c i ^ 2 + c j ^ 2) / 12
          ≤ c i * (c j * @inner ℝ E3 _ (p i) (p j)) := by
      intro i j
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hp i j)
      have e1 : 0 ≤ (1 / 6 + (@inner ℝ E3 _ (p i) (p j) - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)))
          * (c i + c j) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
      have e2 : 0 ≤ (1 / 6 - (@inner ℝ E3 _ (p i) (p j) - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)))
          * (c i - c j) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
      nlinarith
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_right]
    have k00 := key 0 0
    have k01 := key 0 1
    have k02 := key 0 2
    have k10 := key 1 0
    have k11 := key 1 1
    have k12 := key 1 2
    have k20 := key 2 0
    have k21 := key 2 1
    have k22 := key 2 2
    simp only [Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, mul_one, mul_zero] at k00 k01 k02 k10 k11 k12 k20 k21 k22
    linarith
  
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℝ p := by
    rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
    intro g hg i
    have h := hq g
    rw [hg, norm_zero] at h
    have hi : g i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, g j ^ 2 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => g j ^ 2) (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (g j))
        (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hz : g i ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm (by nlinarith) (sq_nonneg _)
    exact (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).mp hz
  
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range p) = ⊤ :=
    hli.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' (by rw [Fintype.card_fin, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin])
  have hvmem : v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range p) := by
    rw [hspan]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hvmem
  
  have hinner : @inner ℝ E3 _ v (∑ i : Fin 3, c i • p i)
      = ∑ l : Fin 3, c l * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l) := by
    rw [inner_sum]
    simp only [real_inner_smul_right]
  rw [hc] at hinner
  have hN : ‖v‖ ^ 2 = ∑ l : Fin 3, c l * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l) := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hinner]
  have hqc := hq c
  rw [hc] at hqc
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ ‖v‖ := norm_nonneg v
  have hcl : ∀ l : Fin 3, |c l| ≤ 3 * ‖v‖ := by
    intro l
    have hl : c l ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, c j ^ 2 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => c j ^ 2) (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (c j))
        (Finset.mem_univ l)
    have hsq : c l ^ 2 ≤ (3 * ‖v‖) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have := sq_le_sq.mp hsq
    rwa [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * ‖v‖)] at this
  have hterm : ∀ l : Fin 3, c l * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)
      ≤ 3 * ‖v‖ * |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)| := by
    intro l
    calc c l * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l) ≤ |c l * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |c l| * |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)| := abs_mul _ _
      _ ≤ 3 * ‖v‖ * |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcl l) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hsum : ‖v‖ * ‖v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ * (3 * ∑ l : Fin 3, |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)|) := by
    have h1 : ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ l : Fin 3, 3 * ‖v‖ * |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)| := by
      rw [hN]; exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l _ => hterm l)
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at h1
    nlinarith
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hn0 with h0 | hpos
  · rw [← h0]; positivity
  · exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hsum hpos

informal_problem.statement:
(f : E3 → E3) (r B : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hdiff : ∀ z : E3, r / 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ f z)
    (hB : ∀ z : E3, r / 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → ∀ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ f z (e j)‖ ≤ B)
    (x y : E3) (hx : ‖x‖ = r) (hy : ‖y‖ = r) : ‖f x - f y‖ ≤ 5 * r * B

signature.name: sphere_oscillation_bound
signature.statement:
(f : E3 → E3) (r B : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hdiff : ∀ z : E3, r / 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ f z)
    (hB : ∀ z : E3, r / 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → ∀ j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ f z (e j)‖ ≤ B)
    (x y : E3) (hx : ‖x‖ = r) (hy : ‖y‖ = r) : ‖f x - f y‖ ≤ 5 * r * B

proof.tactics:
by
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hB x (by rw [hx]; linarith) 0)
  
  have hop : ∀ z : E3, r / 2 ≤ ‖z‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ ≤ 7 / 4 * B := by
    intro z hz
    have hcol := hB z hz
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun v => ?_)
    have hv : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
    have hLv : fderiv ℝ f z v = v 0 • fderiv ℝ f z (e 0) + v 1 • fderiv ℝ f z (e 1)
        + v 2 • fderiv ℝ f z (e 2) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul]
    have hn : ‖v‖ ^ 2 = v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have c0 := hcol 0
    have c1 := hcol 1
    have c2 := hcol 2
    have h1 : ‖fderiv ℝ f z v‖ ≤ |v 0| * B + |v 1| * B + |v 2| * B := by
      rw [hLv]
      calc _ ≤ ‖v 0 • fderiv ℝ f z (e 0)‖ + ‖v 1 • fderiv ℝ f z (e 1)‖
            + ‖v 2 • fderiv ℝ f z (e 2)‖ := norm_add₃_le
        _ = |v 0| * ‖fderiv ℝ f z (e 0)‖ + |v 1| * ‖fderiv ℝ f z (e 1)‖
            + |v 2| * ‖fderiv ℝ f z (e 2)‖ := by simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ _ := by gcongr
    have hs2 : (|v 0| + |v 1| + |v 2|) ^ 2 ≤ (7 / 4 * ‖v‖) ^ 2 := by
      have := sq_abs (v 0)
      have := sq_abs (v 1)
      have := sq_abs (v 2)
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|v 0| - |v 1|), sq_nonneg (|v 1| - |v 2|), sq_nonneg (|v 0| - |v 2|),
        sq_nonneg ‖v‖]
    have hs : |v 0| + |v 1| + |v 2| ≤ 7 / 4 * ‖v‖ := by
      have hn0 := norm_nonneg v
      have a0 := abs_nonneg (v 0)
      have a1 := abs_nonneg (v 1)
      have a2 := abs_nonneg (v 2)
      nlinarith
    calc ‖fderiv ℝ f z v‖ ≤ B * (|v 0| + |v 1| + |v 2|) := by linarith
      _ ≤ B * (7 / 4 * ‖v‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hB0
      _ = 7 / 4 * B * ‖v‖ := by ring
  
  have hseg : ∀ a b : E3, ‖a‖ = r → ‖b‖ = r → 0 ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ a b →
      ‖f a - f b‖ ≤ 7 / 4 * B * (10 / 7 * r) := by
    intro a b ha hb hab
    have hba : 0 ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ b a := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hab
    have hmem : ∀ z ∈ segment ℝ b a, r / 2 ≤ ‖z‖ := by
      rintro z ⟨s, t, hs, ht, hst, rfl⟩
      have hsq : ‖s • b + t • a‖ ^ 2
          = s ^ 2 * r ^ 2 + 2 * (s * t) * @inner ℝ E3 _ b a + t ^ 2 * r ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
          ha, hb, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs, abs_of_nonneg ht]
        ring
      have h2 : 1 / 2 ≤ s ^ 2 + t ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (s - t)]
      have h3 : (r / 2) ^ 2 ≤ ‖s • b + t • a‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hsq]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (sq_nonneg r),
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hs ht) hba, sq_nonneg r]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (s • b + t • a)]
    have hC := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := f)
      (fun z hz => hdiff z (hmem z hz)) (fun z hz => hop z (hmem z hz)) (convex_segment b a)
      (left_mem_segment ℝ b a) (right_mem_segment ℝ b a)
    have hchord : ‖a - b‖ ≤ 10 / 7 * r := by
      have hsq : ‖a - b‖ ^ 2 = r ^ 2 - 2 * @inner ℝ E3 _ a b + r ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_sub_sq_real, ha, hb]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (a - b)]
    calc ‖f a - f b‖ ≤ 7 / 4 * B * ‖a - b‖ := hC
      _ ≤ 7 / 4 * B * (10 / 7 * r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hchord (by positivity)
  
  obtain ⟨u, hu0, hxu⟩ : ∃ u : E3, u ≠ 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ x u = 0 := by
    have hie : ∀ i : Fin 3, @inner ℝ E3 _ x (e i) = x i := by
      intro i
      simp [e, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    by_cases h : x 0 = 0 ∧ x 1 = 0
    · refine ⟨e 0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h0
        have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v 0) h0
        simp at this
      · rw [hie 0, h.1]
    · refine ⟨x 0 • e 1 - x 1 • e 0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h0
        apply h
        have h1 := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v 1) h0
        have h2 := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v 0) h0
        simp at h1 h2
        exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, hie 0, hie 1]
        ring
  have hun : 0 < ‖u‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hu0
  set w₀ : E3 := (r / ‖u‖) • u with hw₀
  have hw₀n : ‖w₀‖ = r := by
    rw [hw₀, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hr.le hun.le),
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ hun.ne']
  have hxw₀ : @inner ℝ E3 _ x w₀ = 0 := by
    rw [hw₀, real_inner_smul_right, hxu, mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hxw, hwy⟩ : ∃ w : E3, ‖w‖ = r ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ x w = 0 ∧
      0 ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ w y := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 (@inner ℝ E3 _ w₀ y) with hpos | hneg
    · exact ⟨w₀, hw₀n, hxw₀, hpos⟩
    · refine ⟨-w₀, by rw [norm_neg, hw₀n], by rw [inner_neg_right, hxw₀, neg_zero], ?_⟩
      rw [inner_neg_left]
      linarith
  have h1 := hseg x w hx hw (le_of_eq hxw.symm)
  have h2 := hseg w y hw hy hwy
  calc ‖f x - f y‖ ≤ ‖f x - f w‖ + ‖f w - f y‖ := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
    _ ≤ 5 * r * B := by nlinarith

informal_problem.statement:
(r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hsub : sphere (0 : E3) r ⊆ U) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ∫ θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1,
        fderiv ℝ f (r • (θ : E3)) ((r • (θ : E3)) j • e i - (r • (θ : E3)) i • e j)
      ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere = 0

signature.name: sphere_rotation_integral_zero
signature.statement:
(r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hsub : sphere (0 : E3) r ⊆ U) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ∫ θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1,
        fderiv ℝ f (r • (θ : E3)) ((r • (θ : E3)) j • e i - (r • (θ : E3)) i • e j)
      ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | hij
  · simp
  
  have s2 : ∀ (R : E3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E3) (h : E3 → ℝ),
      ∫ θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1, h (R (θ : E3)) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere =
        ∫ θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1, h (θ : E3) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere := by
    intro R h
    have hiff : ∀ x : E3, x ∈ sphere (0:E3) 1 ↔ R.toHomeomorph x ∈ sphere (0:E3) 1 := by
      intro x
      simp
    let RS : sphere (0:E3) 1 ≃ₜ sphere (0:E3) 1 := R.toHomeomorph.subtype hiff
    let RSm := RS.toMeasurableEquiv
    have hcoe : ∀ θ : sphere (0:E3) 1, ((RSm θ : sphere (0:E3) 1) : E3) = R θ := fun θ => rfl
    open scoped Pointwise in
    have hset : ∀ s : Set (sphere (0:E3) 1),
        Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 • (Subtype.val '' (RSm ⁻¹' s))
          = R ⁻¹' (Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 • (Subtype.val '' s)) := by
      intro s
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_smul, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_image]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨c, hc, _, ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨c, hc, R θ, ⟨RSm θ, hθ, hcoe θ⟩, by rw [map_smul]⟩
      · rintro ⟨c, hc, _, ⟨φ, hφ, rfl⟩, hy⟩
        have hmem : R.symm (φ : E3) ∈ sphere (0:E3) 1 := by
          rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
          exact mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp φ.2
        refine ⟨c, hc, R.symm φ, ⟨⟨R.symm φ, hmem⟩, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        · have : RSm ⟨R.symm φ, hmem⟩ = φ := Subtype.ext (by rw [hcoe]; simp)
          rw [this]; exact hφ
        · rw [← map_smul, hy]; simp
    have hvol : ∀ X : Set E3, volume (R ⁻¹' X) = volume X := fun X => by
      have hmp : MeasurePreserving (R.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv) volume volume :=
        R.measurePreserving
      exact hmp.measure_preimage_equiv X
    have hmp : MeasurePreserving RSm (volume : Measure E3).toSphere
        (volume : Measure E3).toSphere := by
      refine ⟨RSm.measurable, ?_⟩
      ext s hs
      rw [MeasurableEquiv.map_apply, Measure.toSphere_apply' _ (RSm.measurable hs),
        Measure.toSphere_apply' _ hs, hset, hvol]
    exact hmp.integral_comp' (fun φ : sphere (0:E3) 1 => h φ)
  
  have s3 : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ R : E3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E3, ∀ x : E3,
      R x = x + (Real.cos t - 1) • (x i • e i + x j • e j)
        + Real.sin t • (x j • e i - x i • e j) := by
    intro t
    let L : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3 :=
      { toFun := fun x => x + (Real.cos t - 1) • (x i • e i + x j • e j)
          + Real.sin t • (x j • e i - x i • e j)
        map_add' := by
          intro x y
          simp only [PiLp.add_apply, add_smul, smul_add]
          module
        map_smul' := by
          intro a x
          simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, smul_add, smul_sub, mul_smul]
          module }
    have hn : ∀ x, ‖L x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
      intro x
      rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _), EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq,
        EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [L, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] at hij ⊢ <;>
        first
        | linear_combination (x.ofLp 0 ^ 2 + x.ofLp 1 ^ 2) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t
        | linear_combination (x.ofLp 0 ^ 2 + x.ofLp 2 ^ 2) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t
        | linear_combination (x.ofLp 1 ^ 2 + x.ofLp 2 ^ 2) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq t
    exact ⟨(LinearIsometry.mk L hn).toLinearIsometryEquiv rfl, fun x => rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ → E3 → E3, ∀ t x, ρ t x = x + (Real.cos t - 1) • (x i • e i + x j • e j)
      + Real.sin t • (x j • e i - x i • e j) := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ρ', hρ'⟩ : ∃ ρ' : ℝ → E3 → E3, ∀ t x, ρ' t x = (-Real.sin t) • (x i • e i + x j • e j)
      + Real.cos t • (x j • e i - x i • e j) := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hnorm : ∀ t x, ‖ρ t x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
    intro t x
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := s3 t
    rw [hρ, ← hR]
    exact R.norm_map x
  have hderiv : ∀ t x, HasDerivAt (fun s => ρ s x) (ρ' t x) t := by
    intro t x
    have := ((hasDerivAt_const t x).add (((Real.hasDerivAt_cos t).sub_const 1).smul_const
      (x i • e i + x j • e j))).add ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin t).smul_const (x j • e i - x i • e j))
    rw [zero_add, ← hρ'] at this
    have heq : (fun s => ρ s x) = ((fun _ => x) + fun y => (Real.cos y - 1) • (x i • e i + x j • e j))
        + fun y => Real.sin y • (x j • e i - x i • e j) := by
      funext s
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, hρ]
    rw [heq]
    exact this
  have hbound : ∀ t x, ‖ρ' t x‖ ≤ 4 * ‖x‖ := by
    intro t x
    rw [hρ']
    have hi : ‖x i‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le x i
    have hj : ‖x j‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le x j
    have hs := Real.abs_sin_le_one t
    have hc := Real.abs_cos_le_one t
    have h1 : ‖x i • e i + x j • e j‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖x‖ := by
      refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
      simp only [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one]
      exact add_le_add hi hj
    have h2 : ‖x j • e i - x i • e j‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖x‖ := by
      refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
      simp only [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one]
      exact add_le_add hj hi
    calc _ ≤ ‖(-Real.sin t) • (x i • e i + x j • e j)‖ + ‖Real.cos t • (x j • e i - x i • e j)‖ :=
          norm_add_le _ _
      _ = |Real.sin t| * ‖x i • e i + x j • e j‖ + |Real.cos t| * ‖x j • e i - x i • e j‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg]
      _ ≤ 1 * (‖x‖ + ‖x‖) + 1 * (‖x‖ + ‖x‖) :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul hs h1 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
            (mul_le_mul hc h2 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
      _ = 4 * ‖x‖ := by ring
  have hcont : ∀ t, Continuous (ρ t) := by
    intro t
    rw [show ρ t = _ from funext (hρ t)]
    fun_prop
  have hcont' : ∀ t, Continuous (ρ' t) := by
    intro t
    rw [show ρ' t = _ from funext (hρ' t)]
    fun_prop
  have hsph : ∀ t (θ : sphere (0:E3) 1), r • ρ t θ ∈ sphere (0:E3) r := by
    intro t θ
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, hnorm, norm_eq_of_mem_sphere, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos hr, mul_one]
  have hmem : ∀ t (θ : sphere (0:E3) 1), r • ρ t θ ∈ U := fun t θ => hsub (hsph t θ)
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f U := hf.continuousOn
  have hf'c : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) U := hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl
  have hfd : ∀ y ∈ U, HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f y) y := fun y hy =>
    ((hf.differentiableOn one_ne_zero y hy).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).hasFDerivAt
  obtain ⟨Mf, hMf⟩ := (isCompact_sphere (0:E3) r).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hf'c.mono hsub)
  have hFc : ∀ t, Continuous (fun θ : sphere (0:E3) 1 => f (r • ρ t θ)) := fun t =>
    hfc.comp_continuous (continuous_const.smul ((hcont t).comp continuous_subtype_val))
      (fun θ => hmem t θ)
  have hF'c : Continuous (fun θ : sphere (0:E3) 1 => fderiv ℝ f (r • ρ 0 θ) (r • ρ' 0 θ)) :=
    (hf'c.comp_continuous (continuous_const.smul ((hcont 0).comp continuous_subtype_val))
      (fun θ => hmem 0 θ)).clm_apply
      (continuous_const.smul ((hcont' 0).comp continuous_subtype_val))
  have hb : ∀ (t : ℝ) (θ : sphere (0:E3) 1),
      ‖fderiv ℝ f (r • ρ t θ) (r • ρ' t θ)‖ ≤ Mf * (r * 4) := by
    intro t θ
    have h1 : ‖r • ρ' t θ‖ ≤ r * 4 := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr]
      have := hbound t θ
      rw [norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ, mul_one] at this
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hr.le
    have h2 : ‖fderiv ℝ f (r • ρ t θ)‖ ≤ Mf := hMf _ (hsph t θ)
    calc _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f (r • ρ t θ)‖ * ‖r • ρ' t θ‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ ≤ Mf * (r * 4) := mul_le_mul h2 h1 (norm_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans h2)
  have key := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (μ := (volume : Measure E3).toSphere)
    (F := fun t (θ : sphere (0:E3) 1) => f (r • ρ t θ))
    (F' := fun t (θ : sphere (0:E3) 1) => fderiv ℝ f (r • ρ t θ) (r • ρ' t θ))
    (x₀ := 0) (bound := fun _ => Mf * (r * 4)) (s := Set.univ) Filter.univ_mem
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => (hFc t).aestronglyMeasurable)
    ((hFc 0).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _))
    hF'c.aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun θ t _ => hb t θ)
    (integrable_const _)
    (ae_of_all _ fun θ t _ => (hfd _ (hmem t θ)).comp_hasDerivAt t ((hderiv t θ).const_smul r))
  
  have hconst : (fun t => ∫ θ : sphere (0:E3) 1, f (r • ρ t θ) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere)
      = fun _ => ∫ θ : sphere (0:E3) 1, f (r • (θ : E3)) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere := by
    funext t
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := s3 t
    have hR' : ∀ x, ρ t x = R x := fun x => by rw [hρ, hR]
    simp only [hR']
    exact s2 R (fun y => f (r • y))
  have h0 : HasDerivAt
      (fun t => ∫ θ : sphere (0:E3) 1, f (r • ρ t θ) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere) 0 0 := by
    rw [hconst]; exact hasDerivAt_const _ _
  have hI := key.2.unique h0
  have hpt : ∀ θ : sphere (0:E3) 1, fderiv ℝ f (r • ρ 0 θ) (r • ρ' 0 θ) =
      fderiv ℝ f (r • (θ : E3)) ((r • (θ : E3)) j • e i - (r • (θ : E3)) i • e j) := by
    intro θ
    rw [hρ, hρ']
    simp only [Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero, sub_self, zero_smul, add_zero, neg_zero, zero_add,
      one_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_sub, mul_smul]
  simp only [hpt] at hI
  exact hI

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ C R : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 < R ∧ ∀ x : E3, R ≤ ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6 ∧
      ∀ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun y => G y i j) x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)

signature.name: decay_bounds_of_isBigO
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ C R : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 < R ∧ ∀ x : E3, R ≤ ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6 ∧
      ∀ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun y => G y i j) x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hsmall1 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3,
      ‖G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)‖ ≤ 1 / 6 := by
    intro i j
    have h0 := hdecay i j 0 (Nat.zero_le 2)
    have hv : Tendsto (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ))) (Bornology.cobounded E3)
        (𝓝 0) := by
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero]
      exact (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hq).comp tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop
    have h1 := h0.trans_tendsto hv
    simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at h1
    exact h1.eventually (ge_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 6))
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ‖G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)‖ ≤ 1 / 6 :=
    Filter.eventually_all.2 fun i => Filter.eventually_all.2 fun j => hsmall1 i j
  
  have hbound : ∀ i j l : Fin 3, ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l.val (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖
        ≤ c * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l.val : ℝ)) := by
    intro i j l
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hdecay i j l.val (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 l.isLt)).bound
    refine ⟨c, hc.mono fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rwa [norm_norm, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) _)] at hx
  choose c hc using hbound
  set C : ℝ := ∑ a : Fin 3 × Fin 3 × Fin 3, |c a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2| with hCdef
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => abs_nonneg _
  have hcC : ∀ i j l : Fin 3, c i j l ≤ C := fun i j l =>
    (le_abs_self _).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a : Fin 3 × Fin 3 × Fin 3 => |c a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2|)
        (fun b _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ (i, j, l)))
  have hunif : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3, ∀ i j l : Fin 3,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l.val (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖
        ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l.val : ℝ)) := by
    refine Filter.eventually_all.2 fun i => Filter.eventually_all.2 fun j =>
      Filter.eventually_all.2 fun l => ?_
    exact (hc i j l).mono fun x hx =>
      hx.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcC i j l) (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) _))
  
  obtain ⟨r, -, hr⟩ :=
    (Metric.hasBasis_cobounded_compl_closedBall (0 : E3)).eventually_iff.1 (hsmall.and hunif)
  refine ⟨C, max (r + 1) 1, hC, lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_right _ _), fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hxr : x ∈ (Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) r)ᶜ := by
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le]
    have : r + 1 ≤ ‖x‖ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hsx, hux⟩ := hr hxr
  intro i j
  refine ⟨?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · have h := hsx i j
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  · have h := hux i j 1
    change ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖
        ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) at h
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, Nat.cast_one, fderiv_sub_const] at h
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x (e k)‖
        ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ * ‖e k‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
      _ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) := h

informal_problem.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (B ε : ℝ)
    (hdet : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ A.det)
    (hB : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j| ≤ B)
    (hε : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε) :
    ∀ k l : Fin 3, |A⁻¹ k l| ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 ∧
      |A⁻¹ k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 12 * B ^ 2 * ε

signature.name: inv3_entry_bounds
signature.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (B ε : ℝ)
    (hdet : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ A.det)
    (hB : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j| ≤ B)
    (hε : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε) :
    ∀ k l : Fin 3, |A⁻¹ k l| ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 ∧
      |A⁻¹ k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 12 * B ^ 2 * ε

proof.tactics:
by
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hB 0 0)
  have hdpos : 0 < A.det := by linarith
  have hdne : A.det ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hdpos
  have hinvpos : 0 < (A.det)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hdpos
  have hinv2 : (A.det)⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
    rw [inv_le_comm₀ hdpos (by norm_num)]
    linarith
  have aux : ∀ x y z w : ℝ, |x| ≤ B → |y| ≤ B → |z| ≤ B → |w| ≤ B →
      |x * y - z * w| ≤ 2 * B ^ 2 := by
    intro x y z w hx hy hz hw
    have h1 : |x * y| ≤ B * B := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) hB0
    have h2 : |z * w| ≤ B * B := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hz hw (abs_nonneg _) hB0
    have h1' := abs_le.mp h1
    have h2' := abs_le.mp h2
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith [h1'.1, h1'.2, h2'.1, h2'.2]
  have aux' : ∀ x y z w : ℝ, |x| ≤ B → |y| ≤ B → |z| ≤ B → |w| ≤ B →
      |-(x * y) + z * w| ≤ 2 * B ^ 2 := by
    intro x y z w hx hy hz hw
    rw [neg_add_eq_sub]
    exact aux z w x y hz hw hx hy
  have hadj : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |A.adjugate k l| ≤ 2 * B ^ 2 := by
    intro k l
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;> simp <;>
      first
        | exact aux _ _ _ _ (hB _ _) (hB _ _) (hB _ _) (hB _ _)
        | exact aux' _ _ _ _ (hB _ _) (hB _ _) (hB _ _) (hB _ _)
  have hentry : ∀ k l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l = (A.det)⁻¹ * A.adjugate k l := by
    intro k l
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have ha : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |A⁻¹ k l| ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 := by
    intro k l
    rw [hentry, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hinvpos]
    have := mul_le_mul hinv2 (hadj k l) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hPA : A⁻¹ * A = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdne)
  intro k l
  refine ⟨ha k l, ?_⟩
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hPA k) l
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply] at h
  have hd : A⁻¹ k 0 * (if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      + A⁻¹ k 1 * (if (1 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      + A⁻¹ k 2 * (if (2 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = A⁻¹ k l := by
    fin_cases l <;> simp
  have key : A⁻¹ k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      = A⁻¹ k 0 * ((if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - A 0 l)
        + A⁻¹ k 1 * ((if (1 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - A 1 l)
        + A⁻¹ k 2 * ((if (2 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - A 2 l) := by
    linear_combination h - hd
  have hterm : ∀ m : Fin 3,
      |A⁻¹ k m * ((if m = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - A m l)| ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 * ε := by
    intro m
    rw [abs_mul, abs_sub_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul (ha k m) (hε m l) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  rw [key]
  have h3 := abs_add_three (A⁻¹ k 0 * ((if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - A 0 l))
    (A⁻¹ k 1 * ((if (1 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - A 1 l))
    (A⁻¹ k 2 * ((if (2 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - A 2 l))
  have t0 := hterm 0
  have t1 := hterm 1
  have t2 := hterm 2
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)
    (hdet : (G x).det ≠ 0) (m : Fin 3) :
    ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x ∧
      partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x =
        -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l

signature.name: inv_entry_partialDeriv
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)
    (hdet : (G x).det ≠ 0) (m : Fin 3) :
    ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x ∧
      partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x =
        -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdetD : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => H y a b) x) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (H y).det) x := by
    intro H hH
    have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
        H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
        - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
        + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
      funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H y)
    rw [hfun]
    have h00 := hH 0 0
    have h01 := hH 0 1
    have h02 := hH 0 2
    have h10 := hH 1 0
    have h11 := hH 1 1
    have h12 := hH 1 2
    have h20 := hH 2 0
    have h21 := hH 2 1
    have h22 := hH 2 2
    fun_prop
  have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y).det) x := hdetD G hG
  have hP : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x := by
    intro k l
    have hfun : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) =
        fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
        smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hfun]
    refine (hD.inv hdet).mul (hdetD _ ?_)
    intro a b
    by_cases hal : a = l
    · subst hal
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
      exact differentiableAt_const _
    · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hal]
      exact hG a b
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (G y).det ≠ 0 := hD.continuousAt.eventually_ne hdet
  have hE : ∀ a l : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G x a b * partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
      + ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l = 0 := by
    intro a l
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
        (∑ b : Fin 3, (G x a b • fderiv ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
          + (G x)⁻¹ b l • fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)) x := by
      have hs := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
        (A := fun b y => G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
        (fun b _ => (hG a b).hasFDerivAt.mul (hP b l).hasFDerivAt)
      convert hs using 1
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
        (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
      apply (hasFDerivAt_const (if a = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
      have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G y) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy)) a) l
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
      exact this
    have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e m)) (h1.unique h2)
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h3
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [← h3, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring
  intro k l
  refine ⟨hP k l, ?_⟩
  let X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun b l => partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
  let D : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun a b => partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x
  have hM : G x * X = -(D * (G x)⁻¹) := by
    ext a l'
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
    simp only [X, D, Matrix.of_apply]
    exact hE a l'
  have hX : X = -((G x)⁻¹ * (D * (G x)⁻¹)) := by
    calc X = ((G x)⁻¹ * G x) * X := by
          rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet), Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = (G x)⁻¹ * (G x * X) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [hM, Matrix.mul_neg]
  have hkl := congrFun (congrFun hX k) l
  simp only [X, D, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply] at hkl
  rw [hkl]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hP : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x)
    (hdG : ∀ c a b : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y) x)
    (m k i j : Fin 3) :
    partialDeriv m (christoffel G k i j) x =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x *
            (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) x + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) x
              - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) x)
          + (G x)⁻¹ k l *
            (partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y) x
              + partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y) x
              - partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y) x))

signature.name: christoffel_partialDeriv_formula
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hP : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x)
    (hdG : ∀ c a b : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y) x)
    (m k i j : Fin 3) :
    partialDeriv m (christoffel G k i j) x =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x *
            (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) x + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) x
              - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) x)
          + (G x)⁻¹ k l *
            (partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y) x
              + partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y) x
              - partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y) x))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hT : ∀ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)), HasFDerivAt (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l *
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y
        - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y))
      ((G x)⁻¹ k l • (fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y) x
          + fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y) x
          - fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y) x)
        + (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) x + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) x
          - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) x) • fderiv ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x) x := by
    intro l _
    exact (hP k l).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul
      (((hdG i j l).hasFDerivAt.fun_add (hdG j i l).hasFDerivAt).fun_sub (hdG l i j).hasFDerivAt)
  have hS := (HasFDerivAt.fun_sum hT).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hD : HasFDerivAt (christoffel G k i j) _ x := hS
  show fderiv ℝ (christoffel G k i j) x (e m) = _
  rw [hD.fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  unfold partialDeriv
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (dP : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (d1 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (d2 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (b e p α β : ℝ)
    (hPb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l| ≤ b)
    (hPe : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ e)
    (hdP : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, |dP m k l| ≤ p)
    (hd1 : ∀ c a b' : Fin 3, |d1 c a b'| ≤ α)
    (hd2 : ∀ m c a b' : Fin 3, |d2 m c a b'| ≤ β) (m k i j : Fin 3) :
    |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, P k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)| ≤ 9 / 2 * b * α ∧
    |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (dP m k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)
        + P k l * (d2 m i j l + d2 m j i l - d2 m l i j))
      - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (d2 m i j k + d2 m j i k - d2 m k i j)| ≤ 9 / 2 * (p * α + e * β)

signature.name: christoffel_value_bounds
signature.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (dP : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (d1 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (d2 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (b e p α β : ℝ)
    (hPb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l| ≤ b)
    (hPe : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ e)
    (hdP : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, |dP m k l| ≤ p)
    (hd1 : ∀ c a b' : Fin 3, |d1 c a b'| ≤ α)
    (hd2 : ∀ m c a b' : Fin 3, |d2 m c a b'| ≤ β) (m k i j : Fin 3) :
    |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, P k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)| ≤ 9 / 2 * b * α ∧
    |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (dP m k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)
        + P k l * (d2 m i j l + d2 m j i l - d2 m l i j))
      - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (d2 m i j k + d2 m j i k - d2 m k i j)| ≤ 9 / 2 * (p * α + e * β)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hPb 0 0)
  have he0 : 0 ≤ e := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hPe 0 0)
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hdP 0 0 0)
  have hYb : ∀ l : Fin 3, |d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j| ≤ 3 * α := by
    intro l
    have h1 := abs_le.mp (hd1 i j l)
    have h2 := abs_le.mp (hd1 j i l)
    have h3 := abs_le.mp (hd1 l i j)
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hXb : ∀ l : Fin 3, |d2 m i j l + d2 m j i l - d2 m l i j| ≤ 3 * β := by
    intro l
    have h1 := abs_le.mp (hd2 m i j l)
    have h2 := abs_le.mp (hd2 m j i l)
    have h3 := abs_le.mp (hd2 m l i j)
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hA : ∀ l : Fin 3, |P k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)| ≤ b * (3 * α) := by
    intro l
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hPb k l) (hYb l) (abs_nonneg _) hb0
  have hC : ∀ l : Fin 3, |dP m k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)| ≤ p * (3 * α) := by
    intro l
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hdP m k l) (hYb l) (abs_nonneg _) hp0
  have hB : ∀ l : Fin 3, |(P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) *
      (d2 m i j l + d2 m j i l - d2 m l i j)| ≤ e * (3 * β) := by
    intro l
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hPe k l) (hXb l) (abs_nonneg _) he0
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have h0 := abs_le.mp (hA 0)
    have h1 := abs_le.mp (hA 1)
    have h2 := abs_le.mp (hA 2)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [h0.1, h0.2, h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]
  · have hδ : (∑ l : Fin 3, (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
        (d2 m i j l + d2 m j i l - d2 m l i j)) = d2 m i j k + d2 m j i k - d2 m k i j := by
      simp [ite_mul]
    rw [← hδ, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have h0 := abs_le.mp (hB 0)
    have h1 := abs_le.mp (hB 1)
    have h2 := abs_le.mp (hB 2)
    have c0 := abs_le.mp (hC 0)
    have c1 := abs_le.mp (hC 1)
    have c2 := abs_le.mp (hC 2)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [h0.1, h0.2, h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2, c0.1, c0.2, c1.1, c1.2, c2.1, c2.2]

informal_problem.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (dΓ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (dd : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (e g t β : ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ j k : Fin 3, |P j k - (if j = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ e)
    (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |Γ k i j| ≤ g)
    (hdΓ : ∀ m k i j : Fin 3,
      |dΓ m k i j - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd m i j k + dd m j i k - dd m k i j)| ≤ t)
    (hdd : ∀ m a b c : Fin 3, |dd m a b c| ≤ β)
    (hsym : ∀ m a b c : Fin 3, dd m a b c = dd m a c b) :
    |∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, (dΓ i i j k - dΓ j i i k)
          + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k))
      - ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (dd j i i j - dd j j i i)|
      ≤ 3 * (6 * t + 18 * g ^ 2) + 9 * e * (9 * β + 6 * t + 18 * g ^ 2)

signature.name: scalar_trace_algebra
signature.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (dΓ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (dd : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (e g t β : ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ j k : Fin 3, |P j k - (if j = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ e)
    (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |Γ k i j| ≤ g)
    (hdΓ : ∀ m k i j : Fin 3,
      |dΓ m k i j - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd m i j k + dd m j i k - dd m k i j)| ≤ t)
    (hdd : ∀ m a b c : Fin 3, |dd m a b c| ≤ β)
    (hsym : ∀ m a b c : Fin 3, dd m a b c = dd m a c b) :
    |∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, (dΓ i i j k - dΓ j i i k)
          + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k))
      - ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (dd j i i j - dd j j i i)|
      ≤ 3 * (6 * t + 18 * g ^ 2) + 9 * e * (9 * β + 6 * t + 18 * g ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  have he : 0 ≤ e := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hP 0 0)
  have hg : 0 ≤ g := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hΓ 0 0 0)
  
  have key : ∀ (X L : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (D a M : ℝ),
      (∀ j k : Fin 3, |X j k - L j k| ≤ a) → (∀ j k : Fin 3, |L j k| ≤ M) →
      ∑ j : Fin 3, L j j = D →
      |∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k * X j k - D| ≤ 3 * a + 9 * e * (M + a) := by
    intro X L D a M hXL hL htr
    subst htr
    have hX : ∀ j k : Fin 3, |X j k| ≤ M + a := by
      intro j k
      have h1 := abs_add_le (L j k) (X j k - L j k)
      have h2 : L j k + (X j k - L j k) = X j k := by ring
      rw [h2] at h1
      linarith [hL j k, hXL j k]
    have hoff : ∀ j k : Fin 3, j ≠ k → |P j k * X j k| ≤ e * (M + a) := by
      intro j k hjk
      have h := hP j k
      rw [if_neg hjk, sub_zero] at h
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul h (hX j k) (abs_nonneg _) he
    have hdiag : ∀ j : Fin 3, |P j j * X j j - X j j| ≤ e * (M + a) := by
      intro j
      have h := hP j j
      rw [if_pos rfl] at h
      have h2 : P j j * X j j - X j j = (P j j - 1) * X j j := by ring
      rw [h2, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul h (hX j j) (abs_nonneg _) he
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have o01 := abs_le.mp (hoff 0 1 (by decide))
    have o02 := abs_le.mp (hoff 0 2 (by decide))
    have o10 := abs_le.mp (hoff 1 0 (by decide))
    have o12 := abs_le.mp (hoff 1 2 (by decide))
    have o20 := abs_le.mp (hoff 2 0 (by decide))
    have o21 := abs_le.mp (hoff 2 1 (by decide))
    have d0 := abs_le.mp (hdiag 0)
    have d1 := abs_le.mp (hdiag 1)
    have d2 := abs_le.mp (hdiag 2)
    have x0 := abs_le.mp (hXL 0 0)
    have x1 := abs_le.mp (hXL 1 1)
    have x2 := abs_le.mp (hXL 2 2)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · linarith [o01.1, o02.1, o10.1, o12.1, o20.1, o21.1, d0.1, d1.1, d2.1, x0.1, x1.1, x2.1]
    · linarith [o01.2, o02.2, o10.2, o12.2, o20.2, o21.2, d0.2, d1.2, d2.2, x0.2, x1.2, x2.2]
  
  have hXL : ∀ j k : Fin 3,
      |(∑ i : Fin 3, (dΓ i i j k - dΓ j i i k)
          + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k))
        - ∑ i : Fin 3, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j k i + dd i k j i - dd i i j k)
          - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i k i + dd j k i i - dd j i i k))| ≤ 6 * t + 18 * g ^ 2 := by
    intro j k
    have hprod : ∀ a b c d f h : Fin 3, |Γ a b c * Γ d f h| ≤ g ^ 2 := by
      intro a b c d f h
      rw [abs_mul, sq]
      exact mul_le_mul (hΓ a b c) (hΓ d f h) (abs_nonneg _) hg
    have h1 : |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k)|
        ≤ 18 * g ^ 2 := by
      calc |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k)|
          ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k)| :=
            Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, |Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k| :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (2 * g ^ 2) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _; apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro p _
            have u := abs_le.mp (hprod i i p p j k)
            have v := abs_le.mp (hprod i j p p i k)
            rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [u.1, u.2, v.1, v.2]
        _ = 18 * g ^ 2 := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have h2 : |∑ i : Fin 3,
          ((dΓ i i j k - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j k i + dd i k j i - dd i i j k))
            - (dΓ j i i k - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i k i + dd j k i i - dd j i i k)))|
        ≤ 6 * t := by
      calc |∑ i : Fin 3,
            ((dΓ i i j k - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j k i + dd i k j i - dd i i j k))
              - (dΓ j i i k - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i k i + dd j k i i - dd j i i k)))|
          ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3,
            |(dΓ i i j k - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j k i + dd i k j i - dd i i j k))
              - (dΓ j i i k - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i k i + dd j k i i - dd j i i k))| :=
            Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, (2 * t) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
            have u := abs_le.mp (hdΓ i i j k)
            have v := abs_le.mp (hdΓ j i i k)
            rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [u.1, u.2, v.1, v.2]
        _ = 6 * t := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have heq : (∑ i : Fin 3, (dΓ i i j k - dΓ j i i k)
          + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k))
        - ∑ i : Fin 3, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j k i + dd i k j i - dd i i j k)
          - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i k i + dd j k i i - dd j i i k))
        = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k)
          + ∑ i : Fin 3,
          ((dΓ i i j k - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j k i + dd i k j i - dd i i j k))
            - (dΓ j i i k - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i k i + dd j k i i - dd j i i k))) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [heq]
    have h3 := abs_add_le (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k))
      (∑ i : Fin 3,
          ((dΓ i i j k - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j k i + dd i k j i - dd i i j k))
            - (dΓ j i i k - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i k i + dd j k i i - dd j i i k))))
    linarith
  
  have hLb : ∀ j k : Fin 3,
      |∑ i : Fin 3, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j k i + dd i k j i - dd i i j k)
          - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i k i + dd j k i i - dd j i i k))| ≤ 9 * β := by
    intro j k
    calc |∑ i : Fin 3, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j k i + dd i k j i - dd i i j k)
          - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i k i + dd j k i i - dd j i i k))|
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j k i + dd i k j i - dd i i j k)
          - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i k i + dd j k i i - dd j i i k)| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, (3 * β) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
          have u1 := abs_le.mp (hdd i j k i)
          have u2 := abs_le.mp (hdd i k j i)
          have u3 := abs_le.mp (hdd i i j k)
          have v1 := abs_le.mp (hdd j i k i)
          have v2 := abs_le.mp (hdd j k i i)
          have v3 := abs_le.mp (hdd j i i k)
          rw [abs_le]; constructor
          · linarith [u1.1, u1.2, u2.1, u2.2, u3.1, u3.2, v1.1, v1.2, v2.1, v2.2, v3.1, v3.2]
          · linarith [u1.1, u1.2, u2.1, u2.2, u3.1, u3.2, v1.1, v1.2, v2.1, v2.2, v3.1, v3.2]
      _ = 9 * β := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  
  have htr : ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3,
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j j i + dd i j j i - dd i i j j)
        - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i j i + dd j j i i - dd j i i j))
      = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (dd j i i j - dd j j i i) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    linarith [hsym 0 0 0 0, hsym 0 1 0 1, hsym 0 2 0 2, hsym 1 0 1 0, hsym 1 1 1 1,
      hsym 1 2 1 2, hsym 2 0 2 0, hsym 2 1 2 1, hsym 2 2 2 2]
  have h := key
    (fun j k => ∑ i : Fin 3, (dΓ i i j k - dΓ j i i k)
      + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k))
    (fun j k => ∑ i : Fin 3, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd i j k i + dd i k j i - dd i i j k)
      - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dd j i k i + dd j k i i - dd j i i k)))
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (dd j i i j - dd j j i i)) (6 * t + 18 * g ^ 2) (9 * β)
    hXL hLb htr
  have e2 : 3 * (6 * t + 18 * g ^ 2) + 9 * e * (9 * β + (6 * t + 18 * g ^ 2))
      = 3 * (6 * t + 18 * g ^ 2) + 9 * e * (9 * β + 6 * t + 18 * g ^ 2) := by ring
  exact h.trans (le_of_eq e2)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ (R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (X Y : E3 → E3),
      CoordChange X Y (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R₀ R₁ C ∧
      (∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y x)⁻¹ i j *
            christoffel (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) 0 i j x = 0) ∧
      ∃ L₁ : ℝ, ∀ L : ℝ, L₁ ≤ L →
        0 ≤ sternBoundary (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L

signature.name: stern_harmonic_cylinder_bound
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ (R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (X Y : E3 → E3),
      CoordChange X Y (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R₀ R₁ C ∧
      (∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y x)⁻¹ i j *
            christoffel (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) 0 i j x = 0) ∧
      ∃ L₁ : ℝ, ∀ L : ℝ, L₁ ≤ L →
        0 ≤ sternBoundary (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hnormsq : ∀ t a b : ℝ, ‖cylPt t a b‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    intro t a b
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hnormge : ∀ t a b L : ℝ, L ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 → L ≤ ‖cylPt t a b‖ := by
    intro t a b L hL
    have h1 := hnormsq t a b
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖cylPt t a b‖ := norm_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  have hcongr : ∀ (G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (R : ℝ),
      (∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → G₁ x = G₂ x) →
      (∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ k i j : Fin 3, christoffel G₁ k i j x = christoffel G₂ k i j x) ∧
      (∀ L : ℝ, R < L → sternBoundary G₁ L = sternBoundary G₂ L) := by
    intro G₁ G₂ R h
    have hpd : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ (F : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ → ℝ) (c : Fin 3),
        partialDeriv c (fun z => F (G₁ z)) x = partialDeriv c (fun z => F (G₂ z)) x := by
      intro x hx F c
      have hU : {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} ∈ 𝓝 x :=
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hx
      have hev : (fun z => F (G₁ z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => F (G₂ z)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem hU (fun y hy => by simp only [h y hy])
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev]
    have hpd3 : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ a b c : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv c (fun z => G₁ z a b) x = partialDeriv c (fun z => G₂ z a b) x :=
      fun x hx a b c => hpd x hx (fun A => A a b) c
    have hchr : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ k i j : Fin 3,
        christoffel G₁ k i j x = christoffel G₂ k i j x := by
      intro x hx k i j
      simp only [christoffel, h x hx, hpd3 x hx]
    have hgrad : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → gradVec G₁ x = gradVec G₂ x := by
      intro x hx
      have h1 : ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G₁ z)⁻¹ 0 0)) x =
          partialDeriv l (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G₂ z)⁻¹ 0 0)) x :=
        fun l => hpd x hx (fun A => Real.sqrt (A⁻¹ 0 0)) l
      funext l
      simp only [gradVec, h x hx, h1]

    have hside : ∀ t s : ℝ, R < ‖cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)‖ := by
      intro t s
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hL (hnormge _ _ _ _ ?_)
      have := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq s

    have hcap : ∀ t ρ s : ℝ, t ^ 2 = L ^ 2 →
        R < ‖cylPt t (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)‖ := by
      intro t ρ s ht
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le hL (hnormge _ _ _ _ ?_)
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ρ * Real.cos s), sq_nonneg (ρ * Real.sin s)]

      fun ρ s => hgrad _ (hcap L ρ s rfl)
    have hgc2 : ∀ ρ s : ℝ, gradVec G₁ (cylPt (-L) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) =
        gradVec G₂ (cylPt (-L) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) :=
      fun ρ s => hgrad _ (hcap (-L) ρ s (by ring))
    simp only [sternBoundary, curvTerm, cylFlux, capFlux, sideFlux, hcurv, hgs, hgc1, hgc2]
  
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := exterior_cover_exists g hComplete hAF hR k
  have hqeq : D.af.q = hAF.q := D.q_eq
  have hq0' : 0 < D.af.q := lt_trans (by norm_num) D.af.q_gt
  have hq'pos : 0 < min hAF.q (3 / 4) :=

  have hq'lt1 : min hAF.q (3 / 4) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by norm_num)
  have hsrc' : (D.af.ends D.endIdx).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
    (D.af.ends D.endIdx).source_eq
  have hsmooth' : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun y => D.metric.coeff (D.af.ends D.endIdx).Φ y i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro i j

    exact coeff_contDiffOn_source D.metric (D.af.ends D.endIdx).Φ i j
  have hsymm' : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), D.metric.coeff (D.af.ends D.endIdx).Φ y i j =

    metric_coeff_bounds (D.metric.coeff (D.af.ends D.endIdx).Φ) D.af.q hq0' hsmooth'

    neumann_harmonic_exists D.metric D.af D.endIdx D.β D.Re D.exterior
  rw [hqeq] at hend
  have hlev : NoCompactRegularLevel D.β u :=
    no_compact_regular_level D.metric (D.af.ends D.endIdx) D.β D.Re D.exterior D.separates
      u hu hharm hneu
  
  have hR2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ max (max Ru RG) 2 := le_max_right _ _
  have hRu : Ru ≤ max (max Ru RG) 2 := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hRG : RG ≤ max (max Ru RG) 2 := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u ((D.af.ends D.endIdx).Φ z))

    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u ∘ (D.af.ends D.endIdx).Φ)

    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R₀ := hXY.1

    unfold pullbackMetric
    rw [D.coeff_eq (Y x) h3]

  refine ⟨R₀, R₁, C', _, Y, hXY, ?_, max L₁ (R₁ + 1), ?_⟩

    simp only [hchr x hx]

structure ExteriorCover.{uX} {N : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 N) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) where
  carrier : Type uX
  [instTop : TopologicalSpace carrier]
  [instChart : ChartedSpace E3 carrier]
  [instT2 : T2Space carrier]
  [instMfd : IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ carrier]
  metric : RiemannianMetric3 carrier
  af : AsymptoticallyFlat metric
  endIdx : Fin af.numEnds
  q_eq : af.q = hAF.q
  coeff_eq : ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ →
    metric.coeff (af.ends endIdx).Φ y = g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y
  scal_nonneg : ∀ p : carrier, 0 ≤ metric.scalarCurvature p
  β : carrier → ℝ
  Re : ℝ
  exterior : IsExteriorDomain (af.ends endIdx) β Re
  minimal : ∀ p : carrier, β p = 0 → metric.levelMeanCurv β p = 0
  separates : SeparatesLevelComponents β

instance ExteriorCover.instTopCarrier {N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    {g : RiemannianMetric3 N} {hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g} {k : Fin hAF.numEnds}
    (D : ExteriorCover g hAF k) : TopologicalSpace D.carrier := D.instTop

instance ExteriorCover.instChartCarrier {N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    {g : RiemannianMetric3 N} {hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g} {k : Fin hAF.numEnds}
    (D : ExteriorCover g hAF k) : ChartedSpace E3 D.carrier := D.instChart

instance ExteriorCover.instT2Carrier {N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    {g : RiemannianMetric3 N} {hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g} {k : Fin hAF.numEnds}
    (D : ExteriorCover g hAF k) : T2Space D.carrier := D.instT2

instance ExteriorCover.instMfdCarrier {N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    {g : RiemannianMetric3 N} {hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g} {k : Fin hAF.numEnds}
    (D : ExteriorCover g hAF k) : IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ D.carrier := D.instMfd

def RiemannianMetric3.gradInner (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u w : M → ℝ) (p : M) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ i j *
      partialDeriv i (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) *
      partialDeriv j (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p)


def RiemannianMetric3.levelMeanCurv (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (w : M → ℝ) (p : M) : ℝ :=
  let G := g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm
  let f : E3 → ℝ := fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
  let y := chartAt E3 p p
  let N := Real.sqrt (g.gradInner w w p)
  lapLoc G f y / N -
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a f y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b f y) * hessLoc G f i j y)
      / N ^ 3


def IsExteriorDomain (Φ : EndChart M) (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β ∧
  (∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0) ∧
  2 ≤ Re ∧
  (∀ y : E3, Re < ‖y‖ → 0 < β (Φ.Φ y)) ∧
  IsCompact ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} \ Φ.Φ '' {y : E3 | Re < ‖y‖})


def SeparatesLevelComponents (β : M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : M → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (p₀ : M), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w →
    p₀ ∈ {p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t} →
    IsCompact (connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀) →
    (∀ p ∈ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀, ∃ ξ : E3,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w p ξ ≠ 0 ∧
        (β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ξ = 0)) →
    ∃ K : Set M, IsCompact K ∧
      connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀ ⊆ K ∧
      K ⊆ {p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∧
      frontier K ⊆ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀ ∪ {p : M | β p = 0} ∧
      IsConnected (K \ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀) ∧
      K ⊆ closure (interior K)


def NoCompactRegularLevel (β u : M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ) (p₀ : M), p₀ ∈ {p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} →
    IsCompact (connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}) p₀) →
    ∃ p ∈ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}) p₀,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p = 0

    (∀ d a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y x) * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i

    (∀ c d a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3,
        ((∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k *
            partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) z) (Y x)) *

subgoal_signatures.name: pullbackMetric_partialDeriv
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3) (x : E3)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x)
    (hB : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)) (a b c : Fin 3) :
    partialDeriv c (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b) x =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x * G (Y x) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j
          + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i *
              (∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k * partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)) *
              (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j
          + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * G (Y x) i j *
              partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j) x)

    fun p => lt_of_lt_of_le hRL (hnorm p.1 p.2)
  have hGc : ∀ a b : Fin 3, Continuous
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G (cylPt p.1 (L * Real.cos p.2) (L * Real.sin p.2)) a b) :=
    fun a b => (hsmooth a b).continuousOn.comp_continuous hφ hmem
  have hdGc : ∀ i a b : Fin 3, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      partialDeriv i (fun z => G z a b) (cylPt p.1 (L * Real.cos p.2) (L * Real.sin p.2))) := by
    intro i a b
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b) x) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} :=
      (hsmooth a b).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z a b) x) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} :=
      h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    exact h2.comp_continuous hφ hmem
  
  have hbd : ∀ t s : ℝ, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |G (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)|
        ≤ C * L ^ (-q) ∧
      ∀ k : Fin 3, L * |partialDeriv k (fun y => G y i j)
        (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))| ≤ C * L ^ (-q) := by
    intro t s i j
    have hP := hnorm t s
    have hPR : R < ‖cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hRL hP
    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hdec _ hPR i j
    constructor
    · refine h0.trans ?_
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hL0 hP (by linarith)) hC.le
    · intro k
      have hpow : ‖cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)‖ ^ (-q - 1) ≤ L ^ (-q - 1) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hL0 hP (by linarith)
      have hLL : L * L ^ (-q - 1) = L ^ (-q) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hL0.ne']
        field_simp
      calc L * |partialDeriv k (fun y => G y i j) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))|
          ≤ L * (C * L ^ (-q - 1)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((h1 k).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hC.le))
              hL0.le
        _ = C * (L * L ^ (-q - 1)) := by ring
        _ = C * L ^ (-q) := by rw [hLL]
  
  have hκ : ∀ t s : ℝ,
      |curvIntegrand G t L s - 1 - curvLinAlg (cylGam G t L s) (cylDG G t L s) L s|
        ≤ 400 * (C * L ^ (-q)) ^ 2 := by
    intro t s
    have hγ : ∀ a b : Fin 2,
        |cylGam G t L s a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * L ^ (-q) := by
      intro a b
      have h := (hbd t s a.succ b.succ).1
      simp only [Fin.succ_inj] at h
      exact h
    have hinv := inv2 (cylGam G t L s) (C * L ^ (-q)) hε0 hLε.le hγ
    have hd : ∀ c a b : Fin 2, L * |cylDG G t L s c a b| ≤ C * L ^ (-q) :=
      fun c a b => (hbd t s a.succ b.succ).2 c.succ
    have h := curv_pointwise_expansion (cylGam G t L s) (cylGam G t L s)⁻¹ (cylDG G t L s) L s
      (C * L ^ (-q)) (C * L ^ (-q)) hL0 hε0 hLε.le hε0 hγ (fun a b => (hinv a b).1)
      (fun a b => (hinv a b).2) hd
    have e : curvIntegrand G t L s
        = curvKappa (cylGam G t L s) (cylGam G t L s)⁻¹ (cylDG G t L s) L s := rfl
    rw [e]
    calc _ ≤ 200 * ((C * L ^ (-q)) ^ 2 + C * L ^ (-q) * (C * L ^ (-q))) := h
      _ = 400 * (C * L ^ (-q)) ^ 2 := by ring
  
  have hD : ∀ t s : ℝ, curvLinAlg (cylGam G t L s) (cylDG G t L s) L s
      = curvWAlg (cylGam G t L s) (cylDG G t L s) L s + L / 2 * cylQ G t L s := by
    intro t s
    have hs12 : (fun z => G z 1 2) = (fun z => G z 2 1) := funext fun z => hsymm z 1 2
    simp only [curvLinAlg, curvWAlg, cylQ, cylDG, cylGam, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_one_eq_two, hs12]
    generalize cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s) = P
    linear_combination (L / 2 * (Real.cos s * partialDeriv 1 (fun z => G z 2 2) P
      - Real.cos s * partialDeriv 2 (fun z => G z 2 1) P
      + Real.sin s * partialDeriv 2 (fun z => G z 1 1) P
      - Real.sin s * partialDeriv 1 (fun z => G z 2 1) P)) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq s
  
  have hsmall : ∀ t s : ℝ, ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      |G (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)|
        ≤ 1 / 20 := fun t s a b => ((hbd t s a b).1).trans hLε.le
  have hKc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => curvIntegrand G p.1 L p.2) := by
    have hΓc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => cylGam G p.1 L p.2) :=
      continuous_pi fun a => continuous_pi fun b => hGc a.succ b.succ
    have hDc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => cylDG G p.1 L p.2) :=
      continuous_pi fun c => continuous_pi fun a => continuous_pi fun b =>
        hdGc c.succ a.succ b.succ
    have hγ20 : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ a b : Fin 2,
        |cylGam G p.1 L p.2 a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 20 := by
      intro p a b
      have h := hsmall p.1 p.2 a.succ b.succ

      exact h
    have hinvb := fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      inv2 (cylGam G p.1 L p.2) (1 / 20) (by norm_num) le_rfl (hγ20 p)
    have hdet : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, (cylGam G p.1 L p.2).det ≠ 0 := by
      intro p h0
      have h1 := (hinvb p 0 0).1
      rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_apply_not_isUnit _ (by rw [h0]; exact not_isUnit_zero)] at h1
      norm_num at h1
    have hinvc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹) := by
      have e : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹)
          = fun p => ((cylGam G p.1 L p.2).det)⁻¹ • (cylGam G p.1 L p.2).adjugate := by
        funext p
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
      rw [e]
      exact (hΓc.matrix_det.inv₀ hdet).smul hΓc.matrix_adjugate
    have hX : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ a b
        * ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] a * ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] b := by
      intro p
      have b00 : |(cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ 0 0 - 1| ≤ 2 * (1 / 20) := by
        have h := (hinvb p 0 0).1
        rwa [if_pos rfl] at h
      have b11 : |(cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ 1 1 - 1| ≤ 2 * (1 / 20) := by
        have h := (hinvb p 1 1).1
        rwa [if_pos rfl] at h
      have b01 : |(cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ 0 1| ≤ 2 * (1 / 20) := by
        have h := (hinvb p 0 1).1
        rwa [if_neg (by decide), sub_zero] at h
      have b10 : |(cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ 1 0| ≤ 2 * (1 / 20) := by
        have h := (hinvb p 1 0).1
        rwa [if_neg (by decide), sub_zero] at h
      obtain ⟨l00, u00⟩ := abs_le.mp b00
      obtain ⟨l11, u11⟩ := abs_le.mp b11
      obtain ⟨l01, u01⟩ := abs_le.mp b01
      obtain ⟨l10, u10⟩ := abs_le.mp b10
      have hcs := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq p.2
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ 0 0 - 1 + 1 / 10)
          (sq_nonneg (Real.cos p.2)),
        mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ 1 1 - 1 + 1 / 10)
          (sq_nonneg (Real.sin p.2)),
        mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 5 + ((cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ 0 1
          + (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ 1 0)) (sq_nonneg (Real.cos p.2 + Real.sin p.2)),
        mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 5 - ((cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ 0 1
          + (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ 1 0)) (sq_nonneg (Real.cos p.2 - Real.sin p.2))]
    have hY : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, cylGam G p.1 L p.2 a b
        * ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] a
        * ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] b := by
      intro p
      have g00 : |cylGam G p.1 L p.2 0 0 - 1| ≤ 1 / 20 := by
        have h := hγ20 p 0 0
        rwa [if_pos rfl] at h
      have g11 : |cylGam G p.1 L p.2 1 1 - 1| ≤ 1 / 20 := by
        have h := hγ20 p 1 1
        rwa [if_pos rfl] at h
      have g01 : |cylGam G p.1 L p.2 0 1| ≤ 1 / 20 := by
        have h := hγ20 p 0 1
        rwa [if_neg (by decide), sub_zero] at h
      have g10 : |cylGam G p.1 L p.2 1 0| ≤ 1 / 20 := by
        have h := hγ20 p 1 0
        rwa [if_neg (by decide), sub_zero] at h
      obtain ⟨l00, u00⟩ := abs_le.mp g00
      obtain ⟨l11, u11⟩ := abs_le.mp g11
      obtain ⟨l01, u01⟩ := abs_le.mp g01
      obtain ⟨l10, u10⟩ := abs_le.mp g10
      have hcs := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq p.2
      have hY' : 0 < cylGam G p.1 L p.2 0 0 * Real.sin p.2 ^ 2
          - (cylGam G p.1 L p.2 0 1 + cylGam G p.1 L p.2 1 0) * Real.sin p.2 * Real.cos p.2
          + cylGam G p.1 L p.2 1 1 * Real.cos p.2 ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ cylGam G p.1 L p.2 0 0 - 1 + 1 / 20)
            (sq_nonneg (Real.sin p.2)),
          mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ cylGam G p.1 L p.2 1 1 - 1 + 1 / 20)
            (sq_nonneg (Real.cos p.2)),
          mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 10 - (cylGam G p.1 L p.2 0 1
            + cylGam G p.1 L p.2 1 0)) (sq_nonneg (Real.sin p.2 + Real.cos p.2)),
          mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 10 + (cylGam G p.1 L p.2 0 1
            + cylGam G p.1 L p.2 1 0)) (sq_nonneg (Real.sin p.2 - Real.cos p.2))]
      have heq : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, cylGam G p.1 L p.2 a b
          * ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] a
          * ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] b
          = L ^ 2 * (cylGam G p.1 L p.2 0 0 * Real.sin p.2 ^ 2
            - (cylGam G p.1 L p.2 0 1 + cylGam G p.1 L p.2 1 0) * Real.sin p.2 * Real.cos p.2
            + cylGam G p.1 L p.2 1 1 * Real.cos p.2 ^ 2) := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
          Matrix.head_cons]
        ring
      rw [heq]
      exact mul_pos (pow_pos hL0 2) hY'
    show Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      curvKappa (cylGam G p.1 L p.2) (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ (cylDG G p.1 L p.2) L p.2)
    simp only [curvKappa, div_eq_mul_inv]
    refine Continuous.mul ?_ (Continuous.inv₀ ?_ ?_)
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
      fun_prop
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
      fun_prop
    · intro p
      exact mul_ne_zero (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (hX p)) (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (hY p))
  have hQc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => cylQ G p.1 L p.2) :=
    ((Real.continuous_cos.comp continuous_snd).mul ((hdGc 1 2 2).sub (hdGc 2 1 2))).add
      ((Real.continuous_sin.comp continuous_snd).mul ((hdGc 2 1 1).sub (hdGc 1 2 1)))
  
  have hinner : ∀ t : ℝ,
      |(∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s) - 2 * Real.pi
        - 1 / 2 * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cylQ G t L s * L|
        ≤ 400 * (C * L ^ (-q)) ^ 2 * (2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro t
    have hc : Continuous fun s : ℝ => (t, s) := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
    have hKi : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => curvIntegrand G t L s) volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      (hKc.comp hc).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hQi : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => cylQ G t L s * L) volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      ((hQc.comp hc).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable _ _
    obtain ⟨hWi, hW0⟩ := curv_exact_part_integral_zero G R L t hL0 hRL hsmooth
    have h1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => curvIntegrand G t L s - 1) volume 0 (2 * Real.pi) :=
      hKi.sub intervalIntegrable_const
    have h2 : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun s => curvIntegrand G t L s - 1 - 1 / 2 * (cylQ G t L s * L)) volume
        0 (2 * Real.pi) := h1.sub (hQi.const_mul _)
    have key : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s) - 2 * Real.pi
          - 1 / 2 * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cylQ G t L s * L
        = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (curvIntegrand G t L s - 1 - 1 / 2 * (cylQ G t L s * L)
            - curvWAlg (cylGam G t L s) (cylDG G t L s) L s) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub h2 hWi, hW0, sub_zero,
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub h1 (hQi.const_mul _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub hKi intervalIntegrable_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      simp
    rw [key]
    have hb := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 2 * Real.pi)
      (C := 400 * (C * L ^ (-q)) ^ 2)
      (f := fun s => curvIntegrand G t L s - 1 - 1 / 2 * (cylQ G t L s * L)
            - curvWAlg (cylGam G t L s) (cylDG G t L s) L s) (by
        intro s _
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        dsimp only
        have e2 : curvIntegrand G t L s - 1 - 1 / 2 * (cylQ G t L s * L)
            - curvWAlg (cylGam G t L s) (cylDG G t L s) L s
            = curvIntegrand G t L s - 1 - curvLinAlg (cylGam G t L s) (cylDG G t L s) L s := by
          rw [hD t s]; ring
        rw [e2]
        exact hκ t s)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero, abs_of_pos Real.two_pi_pos] at hb
    exact hb
  
  have hFc : Continuous (fun t => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s) :=
    intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      (f := fun t s => curvIntegrand G t L s) hKc 0 (2 * Real.pi)
  have hHc : Continuous (fun t => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cylQ G t L s * L) :=
    intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      (f := fun t s => cylQ G t L s * L) (hQc.mul continuous_const) 0 (2 * Real.pi)
  have hout : curvTerm G L - P2 G L
      = ∫ t in (-L)..L, ((∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s) - 2 * Real.pi
          - 1 / 2 * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cylQ G t L s * L) := by
    have hP2 : P2 G L = 4 * Real.pi * L + 1 / 2 *
        ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cylQ G t L s * L := rfl
    have hCT : curvTerm G L
        = ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s := rfl
    have i1 : ∫ t in (-L)..L, ((∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s) - 2 * Real.pi
          - 1 / 2 * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cylQ G t L s * L)
        = (∫ t in (-L)..L, ((∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s) - 2 * Real.pi))
          - ∫ t in (-L)..L, (1 / 2 * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cylQ G t L s * L) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hFc.intervalIntegrable _ _).sub intervalIntegrable_const)
        ((hHc.intervalIntegrable _ _).const_mul _)
    have i2 : ∫ t in (-L)..L, ((∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s) - 2 * Real.pi)
        = (∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s)
          - ∫ t in (-L)..L, (2 * Real.pi) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hFc.intervalIntegrable _ _) intervalIntegrable_const
    have i3 : ∫ t in (-L)..L, (1 / 2 * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cylQ G t L s * L)
        = 1 / 2 * ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cylQ G t L s * L :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _
    have i4 : ∫ t in (-L)..L, (2 * Real.pi) = (L - -L) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hP2, hCT, i1, i2, i3, i4]
    ring
  rw [hout, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hb := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := -L) (b := L)
    (C := 400 * (C * L ^ (-q)) ^ 2 * (2 * Real.pi))
    (f := fun t => (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s) - 2 * Real.pi
          - 1 / 2 * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), cylQ G t L s * L)
    (fun t _ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hinner t)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hb
  refine hb.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  have habs : |L - -L| = 2 * L := by
    rw [sub_neg_eq_add, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    ring
  have hpow : L * (L ^ (-q)) ^ 2 = L ^ (-(2 * q - 1)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hL0.le,
      show -(2 * q - 1) = 1 + (-q * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) by push_cast; ring,
      Real.rpow_add hL0, Real.rpow_one]
  rw [habs]
  calc 400 * (C * L ^ (-q)) ^ 2 * (2 * Real.pi) * (2 * L)
      = 1600 * Real.pi * C ^ 2 * (L * (L ^ (-q)) ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hpow]

cyl_curv_term_asymptotics.definitions:
def cylGam (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t L s : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
  fun a b => G (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) a.succ b.succ


def cylDG (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t L s : ℝ) : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ :=
  fun c a b => partialDeriv c.succ (fun z => G z a.succ b.succ)
    (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))


def curvKappa (γ γi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (L s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let Γ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun a b c => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ f : Fin 2, γi a f *
    (d b c f + d c b f - d f b c)
  let n : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![Real.cos s, Real.sin s]
  let v : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![-(L * Real.sin s), L * Real.cos s]
  (L - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, n a * Γ a b c * v b * v c) /
    (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, γi a b * n a * n b) *
      Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, γ a b * v a * v b))


def curvLinAlg (γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (L s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let k : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun a b => γ a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
  let n : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![Real.cos s, Real.sin s]
  let τ : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![-Real.sin s, Real.cos s]
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, k a b * n a * n b
      - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, k a b * τ a * τ b)
    - L * ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, τ c * τ a * n b * d c a b
    + L / 2 * ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, n c * τ a * τ b * d c a b


def curvWAlg (γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (L s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let k : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun a b => γ a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
  let n : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![Real.cos s, Real.sin s]
  let τ : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![-Real.sin s, Real.cos s]
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, k a b * n a * n b

def curvKappa (γ γi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (L s : ℝ) : ℝ :=

    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, heq]
    calc _ ≤ 12 * Real.pi * ℓ ^ 2 * (K₄ * ℓ ^ (-2 * q - 1)) := hbound
      _ = 12 * Real.pi * K₄ * (ℓ ^ 2 * ℓ ^ (-2 * q - 1)) := by ring
      _ = 12 * Real.pi * K₄ * ℓ ^ (-(2 * q - 1)) := by rw [hpow]
  
  obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁⟩ := cutoffPiolaField_props G hsmooth X Y q R₀ R₁ C₁ hq0 hXY R₃ hR13
    (fun x hx => (hYb x hx).1)
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂⟩ := cutoffPiola_div_integral_bound G hsmooth X Y q R₀ R₁ C₁ hq0 hXY R₃ hR13
    (fun x hx => (hYb x hx).2.1) R' hD
  have hA := smoothed_flux_tendsto G hsmooth m hm
  have hT2 : Tendsto (fun ℓ : ℝ => cylFlux (piolaVec Y (admVec G)) ℓ) atTop
      (𝓝 (16 * Real.pi * m)) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro δ hδ
    have hpi : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hA (δ / (32 * Real.pi)) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hτ (δ / 2) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨c, hcN₁, hcN₂, hcc₁, hcc₂, hc2⟩ :
        ∃ c : ℝ, N₁ ≤ c ∧ N₂ ≤ c ∧ c₁ ≤ c ∧ c₂ ≤ c ∧ (2 : ℝ) ≤ c :=
      ⟨max (max N₁ N₂) (max c₁ (max c₂ 2)),
        le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _),
        le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _),
        le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _),
        le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_right _ _),
        le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_right _ _)⟩
    refine ⟨max (R₃ + 1) (2 * c + 2), fun ℓ hℓ => ?_⟩
    have hℓ1 : R₃ + 1 ≤ ℓ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hℓ
    have hℓ2 : 2 * c + 2 ≤ ℓ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hℓ
    have hℓpos : 0 < ℓ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hCD, hflux⟩ := hc₁ c hcc₁
    have e1 := hflux ℓ (by linarith) hℓ2
    have e2 := cyl_divergence_theorem (cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c) hCD ℓ hℓpos
    have e3 := hc₂ c hcc₂ ℓ hℓ2
    have e4 := radial_cutoff_flux_integral G hsmooth c hc2
    have e5 := hN₁ c hcN₁
    have e6 := hN₂ c hcN₂
    beta_reduce at e5 e6
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at e5 e6 ⊢
    rw [sub_zero] at e6
    rw [← e1, e2]
    rw [e4] at e3
    have h5 := abs_lt.mp e5
    have h3 := abs_le.mp e3
    have h6 := abs_lt.mp e6
    have h16 : (0 : ℝ) < 16 * Real.pi := by positivity
    have k : 16 * Real.pi * (δ / (32 * Real.pi)) = δ / 2 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have m1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h5.2 h16
    have m2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h5.1 h16
    rw [k] at m1
    rw [mul_neg, k] at m2
    rw [abs_lt]
    constructor
    · nlinarith
    · nlinarith
  
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun ℓ : ℝ => cylFlux (admVec (pullbackMetric G Y)) ℓ) atTop
      (𝓝 (16 * Real.pi * m)) := by
    have h := hT1.add hT2
    rw [zero_add] at h
    exact h.congr (fun ℓ => sub_add_cancel _ _)
  have hev := (hlim.eventually
    (gt_mem_nhds (by linarith : 16 * Real.pi * m < 16 * Real.pi * m + ε))).and
    (eventually_ge_atTop L₀)
  obtain ⟨L, hL1, hL2⟩ := hev.exists
  exact ⟨L, hL2, hL1.le⟩
