[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) (hpos : ∀ p, 0 < w p) :
    ∃ g' : RiemannianMetric3 M, ∀ x, g'.g x = (w x ^ 4) • g.g x

signature.name: conformal_metric_exists
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) (hpos : ∀ p, 0 < w p) :
    ∃ g' : RiemannianMetric3 M, ∀ x, g'.g x = (w x ^ 4) • g.g x

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨⟨fun x => (w x ^ 4) • g.g x, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, fun x => rfl⟩
  · intro x v u
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [g.symm]
  · intro x v hv
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_pos (pow_pos (hpos x) 4) (g.posDef x v hv)
  · intro x₀ i j
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x₀).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hw.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    have h := (hu.pow 4).mul (g.smooth x₀ i j)
    refine h.congr (fun y _ => ?_)
    simp only [coeffMatrix, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(g g' : RiemannianMetric3 M) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : Continuous w) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hlo : ∀ p, c₁ ≤ w p) (hhi : ∀ p, w p ≤ c₂)
    (hg' : ∀ x, g'.g x = (w x ^ 4) • g.g x) (hC : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) :
    g'.IsCompleteRiemannian

signature.name: isCompleteRiemannian_of_conformal
signature.statement:
(g g' : RiemannianMetric3 M) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : Continuous w) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ) (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hlo : ∀ p, c₁ ≤ w p) (hhi : ∀ p, w p ≤ c₂)
    (hg' : ∀ x, g'.g x = (w x ^ 4) • g.g x) (hC : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) :
    g'.IsCompleteRiemannian

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hs1 : ∀ γ : ℝ → M, Continuous γ →
      0 ≤ g.curveLength γ ∧ c₁ ^ 2 * g.curveLength γ ≤ g'.curveLength γ ∧
        g'.curveLength γ ≤ c₂ ^ 2 * g.curveLength γ := by
    intro γ hγ
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun t => Real.sqrt (g.g (γ t)
        (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ : ∃ h : ℝ → ℝ, h = fun t => w (γ t) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hpos : ∀ t, 0 < w (γ t) := fun t => lt_of_lt_of_le hc₁ (hlo _)
    have hhpos : ∀ t, 0 < h t := fun t => by rw [hh]; exact pow_pos (hpos t) 2
    have hcont : Continuous h := by rw [hh]; exact (hw.comp hγ).pow 2
    have hinvcont : Continuous fun t => (h t)⁻¹ := hcont.inv₀ (fun t => (hhpos t).ne')
    have hlo2 : ∀ t, c₁ ^ 2 ≤ h t := fun t => by
      rw [hh]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hc₁.le (hlo _) 2
    have hhi2 : ∀ t, h t ≤ c₂ ^ 2 := fun t => by
      rw [hh]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (hpos t).le (hhi _) 2
    have hfnn : ∀ t, 0 ≤ f t := fun t => by rw [hf]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have heq : (fun t => Real.sqrt (g'.g (γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t)
        (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t))) = fun t => h t * f t := by
      funext t
      rw [hf, hh]
      simp only
      rw [hg', ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
      congr 1
      rw [show w (γ t) ^ 4 = (w (γ t) ^ 2) ^ 2 by ring]
      exact Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)
    have hL : g.curveLength γ = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, f t := by rw [hf]; rfl
    have hL' : g'.curveLength γ = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, h t * f t := by
      show (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sqrt (g'.g (γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t)
        (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t))) = _
      rw [heq]
    have hnn : 0 ≤ g.curveLength γ := by
      rw [hL]; exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun t _ => hfnn t)
    refine ⟨hnn, ?_⟩
    rw [hL', hL]
    by_cases hint : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume 0 1
    · have hhf : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => h t * f t) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
        hint.continuousOn_mul hcont.continuousOn
      constructor
      · rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one (hint.const_mul _) hhf
          (fun t _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hlo2 t) (hfnn t))
      · rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one hhf (hint.const_mul _)
          (fun t _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hhi2 t) (hfnn t))
    · have hnot : ¬ IntervalIntegrable (fun t => h t * f t) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
        intro hhf
        apply hint
        have h2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => (h t)⁻¹ * (h t * f t)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
          hhf.continuousOn_mul hinvcont.continuousOn
        have h3 : (fun t => (h t)⁻¹ * (h t * f t)) = f := by
          funext t; exact inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (hhpos t).ne' (f t)
        rw [h3] at h2
        exact h2
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_undef hint, intervalIntegral.integral_undef hnot]
      simp
  
  have hd : ∀ p q : M, c₁ ^ 2 * g.riemannianDist p q ≤ g'.riemannianDist p q ∧
      g'.riemannianDist p q ≤ c₂ ^ 2 * g.riemannianDist p q ∧ 0 ≤ g'.riemannianDist p q := by
    intro p q
    unfold RiemannianMetric3.riemannianDist
    have hb := fun (γ : {γ : ℝ → M // ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 γ ∧ γ 0 = p ∧ γ 1 = q}) =>
      hs1 γ.1 γ.2.1.continuous
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Real.mul_iInf_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg c₁)]
      exact ciInf_mono ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hb i).1⟩
        (fun i => (hb i).2.1)
    · rw [Real.mul_iInf_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg c₂)]
      exact ciInf_mono ⟨0, by
          rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact le_trans (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hb i).1) (hb i).2.1⟩
        (fun i => (hb i).2.2)
    · exact Real.iInf_nonneg (fun i => le_trans (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hb i).1) (hb i).2.1)
  
  intro u hu
  have hu' : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, g.riemannianDist (u m) (u n) < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hu (c₁ ^ 2 * ε) (mul_pos (pow_pos hc₁ 2) hε)
    refine ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
    have h1 := (hd (u m) (u n)).1
    have h2 := hN m hm n hn
    have h3 : c₁ ^ 2 * g.riemannianDist (u m) (u n) < c₁ ^ 2 * ε := lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h3 (pow_pos hc₁ 2).le
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hC u hu'
  refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => c₂ ^ 2 * g.riemannianDist (u n) p) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using hp.const_mul (c₂ ^ 2)
  exact squeeze_zero (fun n => (hd (u n) p).2.2) (fun n => (hd (u n) p).2.1) ht

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ ρ₀ ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, ρ₀ ≤ ρ → IsClosed ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖x‖})

signature.name: endChart_far_isClosed
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ ρ₀ ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, ρ₀ ≤ ρ → IsClosed ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖x‖})

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hsrc : (hAF.ends k).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends k).source_eq
  have hq : 0 < hAF.q := by linarith [hAF.q_gt]
  
  
  have hnormsq : ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ^ 2 = v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have s1 : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6) →
      ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * A i j := by
    intro A hA v
    have key : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * (v i * v j)
        - 1 / 6 * (|v i| * |v j|) ≤ v i * v j * A i j := by
      intro i j
      have h1 : -|(A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * (v i * v j)| ≤
          (A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * (v i * v j) := neg_abs_le _
      have h2 : |(A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * (v i * v j)| ≤
          1 / 6 * (|v i| * |v j|) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hA i j) (by positivity)
      nlinarith
    have k00 := key 0 0
    have k01 := key 0 1
    have k02 := key 0 2
    have k10 := key 1 0
    have k11 := key 1 1
    have k12 := key 1 2
    have k20 := key 2 0
    have k21 := key 2 1
    have k22 := key 2 2
    simp only [Fin.isValue, if_true, if_false, Fin.reduceEq] at k00 k01 k02 k10 k11 k12 k20 k21 k22
    rw [hnormsq]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have a01 := two_mul_le_add_sq |v 0| |v 1|
    have a02 := two_mul_le_add_sq |v 0| |v 2|
    have a12 := two_mul_le_add_sq |v 1| |v 2|
    simp only [sq_abs] at a01 a02 a12
    have q0 : |v 0| * |v 0| = v 0 ^ 2 := by rw [← sq, sq_abs]
    have q1 : |v 1| * |v 1| = v 1 ^ 2 := by rw [← sq, sq_abs]
    have q2 : |v 2| * |v 2| = v 2 ^ 2 := by rw [← sq, sq_abs]
    nlinarith
  
  
  obtain ⟨R, hR2, hRb⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, 2 ≤ R ∧ ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6 := by
    have hev : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3,
        |g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6 := by
      intro i j
      have hO := hAF.decay k i j 0 (by norm_num)
      have ht : Tendsto (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q - ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
          (Bornology.cobounded E3) (𝓝 0) := by
        have := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hq).comp (tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop (E := E3))
        simpa using this
      have h2 := hO.trans_tendsto ht
      have h3 := h2.eventually (eventually_le_nhds (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 6 by norm_num))
      filter_upwards [h3] with x hx
      simpa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hx
    have hall : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        |g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6 :=
      Filter.eventually_all.2 fun i => Filter.eventually_all.2 fun j => hev i j
    rw [← comap_norm_atTop, Filter.eventually_comap, Filter.eventually_atTop] at hall
    obtain ⟨R₁, hR₁⟩ := hall
    refine ⟨max R₁ 2, le_max_right _ _, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    exact hR₁ ‖x‖ (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx.le) x rfl
  have LB : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ v : E3,
      ‖v‖ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x i j :=
    fun x hx v => s1 _ (hRb x hx) v
  
  
  have s6 : ∀ (U : Set ℝ) (h h' : ℝ → E3) (K : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 ≤ K → (0 : ℝ) ∈ U →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, t ∈ U → HasDerivAt h (h' t) t ∧ ‖h' t‖ ≤ K) →
      (∀ (s : ℕ → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (xb : E3), τ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        (∀ n, s n ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ s n ∈ U) →
        Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 τ) → Tendsto (fun n => h (s n)) atTop (𝓝 xb) →
        dist xb (h 0) ≤ K → τ ∈ U) →
      (1 : ℝ) ∈ U := by
    intro U h h' K hU hK h0 hD hcl
    have hlip : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ 1 → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, x ∈ U) →
        ‖h b - h a‖ ≤ K * (b - a) := by
      intro a b ha hab hb1 hU'
      exact norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment' (f := h) (f' := h') (C := K)
        (fun x hx => ((hD x ⟨le_trans ha hx.1, le_trans hx.2 hb1⟩ (hU' x hx)).1).hasDerivWithinAt)
        (fun x hx => (hD x ⟨le_trans ha hx.1, le_trans hx.2.le hb1⟩
          (hU' x ⟨hx.1, hx.2.le⟩)).2) b ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : Set ℝ, T = {t | t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t, s ∈ U} :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have h0T : (0 : ℝ) ∈ T := by
      rw [hT]
      refine ⟨⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩, fun s hs => ?_⟩
      have : s = 0 := le_antisymm hs.2 hs.1
      rw [this]; exact h0
    have hTsub : ∀ t ∈ T, t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t, s ∈ U := by
      intro t ht; rw [hT] at ht; exact ht
    have hbdd : BddAbove T := ⟨1, fun t ht => (hTsub t ht).1.2⟩
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ : ∃ τ : ℝ, τ = sSup T := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hτ0 : 0 ≤ τ := by rw [hτ]; exact le_csSup hbdd h0T
    have hτ1 : τ ≤ 1 := by rw [hτ]; exact csSup_le ⟨0, h0T⟩ (fun t ht => (hTsub t ht).1.2)
    have ha : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s < τ → s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) s, u ∈ U := by
      intro s hs0 hsτ
      rw [hτ] at hsτ
      obtain ⟨t, htT, hst⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup ⟨0, h0T⟩ hsτ
      have ht := hTsub t htT
      exact ⟨⟨hs0, le_trans hst.le ht.1.2⟩, fun u hu => ht.2 u ⟨hu.1, le_trans hu.2 hst.le⟩⟩
    have hτU : τ ∈ U := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hτ0 with h | hpos
      · rw [← h]; exact h0
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℕ → ℝ, s = fun n : ℕ => τ * (1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    have hGy₀ : Φ.symm (ψ.symm y₀) = x₀ := by rw [hy₀s]; exact hLI x₀ hx₀src
    have hLr : 0 ≤ L * r := mul_nonneg hL0 hr0.le
    
    have hσball : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, dist (y₀ + t • (ψ p - y₀)) (ψ p) < r / 2 := by
      intro t ht
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have e : y₀ + t • (ψ p - y₀) - ψ p = (1 - t) • (y₀ - ψ p) := by
        simp only [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
      rw [e, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [ht.2]), ← dist_eq_norm]
      have := dist_nonneg (x := y₀) (y := ψ p)
      nlinarith [ht.1]
    have hcont_σ : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => y₀ + t • (ψ p - y₀)) :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
    set W := ψ.target ∩ ψ.symm ⁻¹' (Φ.target ∩ Φ.symm ⁻¹' {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) with hW
    have hWo : IsOpen W :=
      ψ.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm))
    have hnorm_y₀ : ‖ψ p - y₀‖ < r / 2 := by rw [← dist_eq_norm, dist_comm]; exact hy₀b
    have h1U := s6 {t : ℝ | y₀ + t • (ψ p - y₀) ∈ W}
      (fun t => Φ.symm (ψ.symm (y₀ + t • (ψ p - y₀))))
      (fun t => fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ.symm (ψ.symm y)) (y₀ + t • (ψ p - y₀)) (ψ p - y₀))
      (L * ‖ψ p - y₀‖) (hWo.preimage hcont_σ) (by positivity) ?h0 ?hD ?hcl
    · have h1W : y₀ + (1 : ℝ) • (ψ p - y₀) ∈ W := h1U
      have hσ1 : y₀ + (1 : ℝ) • (ψ p - y₀) = ψ p := by rw [one_smul]; abel
      rw [hσ1] at h1W
      have := h1W.2.1
      rw [ψ.left_inv hpψ] at this
      exact hpt this
    case h0 =>
      show y₀ + (0 : ℝ) • (ψ p - y₀) ∈ W
      rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
      refine ⟨hy₀t, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hy₀s]; exact hMS x₀ hx₀src
      · show R < ‖Φ.symm (ψ.symm y₀)‖
        rw [hGy₀]; linarith
    case hD =>
      intro t ht htU
      have htW : y₀ + t • (ψ p - y₀) ∈ W := htU
      obtain ⟨hdiff, hnorm⟩ := DB (y₀ + t • (ψ p - y₀)) htW.1 htW.2.1 htW.2.2
        (mem_closedBall.2 (by linarith [hσball t ht]))
      have hσd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y₀ + t • (ψ p - y₀)) (ψ p - y₀) t := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (ψ p - y₀)).const_add y₀
      have hcd := hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hσd
      exact ⟨hcd,
        le_trans (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnorm (norm_nonneg _))⟩
    case hcl =>
      intro s τ xb hτ hs hsτ hxb hdist
      change dist xb (Φ.symm (ψ.symm (y₀ + (0 : ℝ) • (ψ p - y₀)))) ≤ _ at hdist
      rw [zero_smul, add_zero, hGy₀] at hdist
      have hKr : L * ‖ψ p - y₀‖ ≤ L * (r / 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm_y₀.le hL0
      have hxbR : R + 1 < ‖xb‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_norm_le x₀ xb
        rw [← dist_eq_norm, dist_comm] at this
        linarith
      have hxbsrc : xb ∈ Φ.source := by
        rw [hsrc]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖xb‖; linarith
      have hτt : y₀ + τ • (ψ p - y₀) ∈ ψ.target :=
        hcb (mem_closedBall.2 (by linarith [hσball τ hτ]))
      have hlim1 : Tendsto (fun n => Φ (Φ.symm (ψ.symm (y₀ + s n • (ψ p - y₀))))) atTop
          (𝓝 (Φ xb)) :=
        ((hΦsm.continuousOn.continuousAt (Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hxbsrc)).tendsto).comp hxb
      have heq : ∀ n, Φ (Φ.symm (ψ.symm (y₀ + s n • (ψ p - y₀)))) =
          ψ.symm (y₀ + s n • (ψ p - y₀)) := by
        intro n
        have hn : y₀ + s n • (ψ p - y₀) ∈ W := (hs n).2
        exact hRI _ hn.2.1
      have hlim2 : Tendsto (fun n => ψ.symm (y₀ + s n • (ψ p - y₀))) atTop
          (𝓝 (ψ.symm (y₀ + τ • (ψ p - y₀)))) :=
        ((ψ.continuousAt_symm hτt).tendsto).comp ((hcont_σ.tendsto τ).comp hsτ)
      have huniq : Φ xb = ψ.symm (y₀ + τ • (ψ p - y₀)) :=
        tendsto_nhds_unique (hlim1.congr heq) hlim2
      show y₀ + τ • (ψ p - y₀) ∈ W
      refine ⟨hτt, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show ψ.symm (y₀ + τ • (ψ p - y₀)) ∈ Φ.target
        rw [← huniq]; exact hMS xb hxbsrc
      · show R < ‖Φ.symm (ψ.symm (y₀ + τ • (ψ p - y₀)))‖
        rw [← huniq, hLI xb hxbsrc]; linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδq : δ < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i)
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R₀ C : ℝ, 2 ≤ R₀ ∧ ∀ x : E3, R₀ < ‖x‖ →
      δ * (1 + δ) / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ) ≤ lapLocal G (farPot δ) x ∧
      |lapLocal G (farPot δ) x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ)

signature.name: farPot_lap_bounds
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδq : δ < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i)
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R₀ C : ℝ, 2 ≤ R₀ ∧ ∀ x : E3, R₀ < ‖x‖ →
      δ * (1 + δ) / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ) ≤ lapLocal G (farPot δ) x ∧
      |lapLocal G (farPot δ) x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hq : 0 < q := by linarith
  
  
  have hconv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun x => G x i j) (Bornology.cobounded E3)
      (𝓝 (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
    intro i j
    have h0 := hdecay i j 0 (Nat.zero_le 2)
    have hv : Tendsto (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ))) (Bornology.cobounded E3)
        (𝓝 0) := by
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero]
      exact (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hq).comp tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop
    have h1 := h0.trans_tendsto hv
    simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at h1
    have h2 : Tendsto (fun x => G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
        (Bornology.cobounded E3) (𝓝 0) :=
      tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.2 h1
    have h3 := h2.add_const (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
    simp only [sub_add_cancel, zero_add] at h3
    exact h3
  have hGt : Tendsto G (Bornology.cobounded E3) (𝓝 (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) := by
    refine tendsto_pi_nhds.2 fun i => tendsto_pi_nhds.2 fun j => ?_
    rw [Matrix.one_apply]
    exact hconv i j
  have hdetT : Tendsto (fun x => (G x).det) (Bornology.cobounded E3) (𝓝 1) := by
    have := ((continuous_id.matrix_det).tendsto (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)).comp hGt
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Matrix.det_one] using this
  have hdetE : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det :=
    hdetT.eventually_const_le (by norm_num)
  have hbound : ∀ i j l : Fin 3, ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l.val (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖
        ≤ c * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l.val : ℝ)) := by
    intro i j l
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hdecay i j l.val (Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 l.isLt)).bound
    refine ⟨c, hc.mono fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rwa [norm_norm, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) _)] at hx
  choose c hc using hbound
  set C : ℝ := ∑ a : Fin 3 × Fin 3 × Fin 3, |c a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2| with hCdef
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => abs_nonneg _
  have hcC : ∀ i j l : Fin 3, c i j l ≤ C := fun i j l =>
    (le_abs_self _).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a : Fin 3 × Fin 3 × Fin 3 => |c a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2|)
        (fun b _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ (i, j, l)))
  have hunif : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3, ∀ i j l : Fin 3,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l.val (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖
        ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l.val : ℝ)) := by
    refine Filter.eventually_all.2 fun i => Filter.eventually_all.2 fun j =>
      Filter.eventually_all.2 fun l => ?_
    exact (hc i j l).mono fun x hx =>
      hx.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcC i j l) (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) _))
  obtain ⟨r0, -, hrad⟩ :=
    (Metric.hasBasis_cobounded_compl_closedBall (0 : E3)).eventually_iff.1 (hdetE.and hunif)
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = max r0 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR1 : 1 ≤ R := by rw [hRdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxr : x ∈ (Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) r0)ᶜ := by
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le]
      rw [hRdef] at hx
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hx
    obtain ⟨hdx, hux⟩ := hrad hxr
    refine ⟨hdx, fun i j => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have h := hux i j 0
      change ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖
          ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ)) at h
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero] at h
      exact h
    · have h := hux i j 1
      change ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖
          ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - ((1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) at h
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, Nat.cast_one, fderiv_sub_const] at h
      exact h
  
  
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = 1 + C := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hbdef⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = 4 * B ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB1 : 1 ≤ B := by rw [hBdef]; linarith
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by linarith
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by rw [hbdef]; positivity
  obtain ⟨K₂, hK₂def⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = 3 * b * C + 81 / 2 * b ^ 2 * C := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K₂ := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ 3 * b * C := by positivity
    have h2 : 0 ≤ 81 / 2 * b ^ 2 * C := by positivity
    rw [hK₂def]; linarith
  have hpert : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3), R < ‖x‖ →
      |lapLocal G w x - ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv i w z) x| ≤
        K₂ * (‖x‖ ^ (-q) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) x|
          + ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) * ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k w x|) := by
    intro w x hx
    rw [hK₂def]
    have hr1 : 1 < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt hR1 hx
    have hr0 : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hdet, hbx⟩ := hb x hx
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = ‖x‖ ^ (-q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ, u = ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ := by rw [hρ]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _
    have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := by rw [hu]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _
    have hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hρ]; exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hr1.le (by linarith)
    rw [← hρ, ← hu]
    have hPD : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (f : E3 → ℝ), |partialDeriv c f x| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ := by
      intro c f
      have hn : ‖e c‖ = 1 := by simp [e]
      calc |partialDeriv c f x| = ‖fderiv ℝ f x (e c)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ * ‖e c‖ := (fderiv ℝ f x).le_opNorm _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ := by rw [hn, mul_one]
    have hd1 : ∀ c a b' : Fin 3, |partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b') x| ≤ C * u := by
      intro c a b'
      rw [hu]; exact (hPD c _).trans (hbx a b').2
    have hGε : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ρ := by
      intro i j; rw [hρ]; exact (hbx i j).1
    have hGB : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G x i j| ≤ B := by
      intro i j
      have h1 := hGε i j
      have h2 : |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> simp
      have h3 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (G x i j) (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      have h4 : C * ρ ≤ C := by nlinarith
      rw [hBdef]; linarith
    have hdetpos : 0 < (G x).det := by linarith
    have hm : ∀ a1 a2 a3 a4 : ℝ, |a1| ≤ B → |a2| ≤ B → |a3| ≤ B → |a4| ≤ B →
        |a1 * a2 - a3 * a4| ≤ 2 * B ^ 2 ∧ |-(a1 * a2) + a3 * a4| ≤ 2 * B ^ 2 := by
      intro a1 a2 a3 a4 h1 h2 h3 h4
      have e1 : |a1 * a2| ≤ B ^ 2 := by
        rw [abs_mul, sq]; exact mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hB0
      have e2 : |a3 * a4| ≤ B ^ 2 := by
        rw [abs_mul, sq]; exact mul_le_mul h3 h4 (abs_nonneg _) hB0
      have f1 := abs_le.mp e1
      have f2 := abs_le.mp e2
      constructor
      · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
      · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    have hadj : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |(G x).adjugate k l| ≤ 2 * B ^ 2 := by
      intro k l
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
      fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;> simp <;>
        first
        | exact (hm _ _ _ _ (hGB _ _) (hGB _ _) (hGB _ _) (hGB _ _)).1
        | exact (hm _ _ _ _ (hGB _ _) (hGB _ _) (hGB _ _) (hGB _ _)).2
    have hinv2 : (G x).det⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
      calc (G x).det⁻¹ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) hdet
        _ = 2 := by norm_num
    have hPb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |(G x)⁻¹ k l| ≤ b := by
      intro k l
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', abs_mul,
        abs_inv, abs_of_pos hdetpos, hbdef]
      calc (G x).det⁻¹ * |(G x).adjugate k l| ≤ 2 * (2 * B ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul hinv2 (hadj k l) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 4 * B ^ 2 := by ring
    have hPA : (G x)⁻¹ * G x = 1 :=
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdetpos.ne')
    have hPe : ∀ k l : Fin 3,
        |(G x)⁻¹ k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 3 * (b * (C * ρ)) := by
      intro k l
      have heq : (G x)⁻¹ k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
          ∑ m : Fin 3, (G x)⁻¹ k m * ((if m = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - G x m l) := by
        have h1 : (G x)⁻¹ * (1 - G x) = (G x)⁻¹ - 1 := by
          rw [Matrix.mul_sub, hPA, Matrix.mul_one]
        have h2 := congrFun (congrFun h1 k) l
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply] at h2
        simp only [Matrix.sub_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h2
        exact h2.symm
      rw [heq]
      calc |∑ m : Fin 3, (G x)⁻¹ k m * ((if m = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - G x m l)|
          ≤ ∑ m : Fin 3, |(G x)⁻¹ k m * ((if m = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - G x m l)| :=
            Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ m : Fin 3, b * (C * ρ) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_sub_comm]
            exact mul_le_mul (hPb k m) (hGε m l) (abs_nonneg _) hb0
        _ = 3 * (b * (C * ρ)) := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j x| ≤ 9 / 2 * b * (C * u) := by
      intro k i j
      show |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G x)⁻¹ k l *
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) x + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) x
          - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) x)| ≤ _
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)]
      have hs : |∑ l : Fin 3, (G x)⁻¹ k l *
          (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) x + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) x
            - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) x)| ≤ ∑ l : Fin 3, b * (3 * (C * u)) :=
        (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun l _ => by
          rw [abs_mul]
          refine mul_le_mul (hPb k l) ?_ (abs_nonneg _) hb0
          have h1 := abs_le.mp (hd1 i j l)
          have h2 := abs_le.mp (hd1 j i l)
          have h3 := abs_le.mp (hd1 l i j)
          rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2, h3.1, h3.2])
      have hc' : ∑ l : Fin 3, b * (3 * (C * u)) = 9 * b * (C * u) := by
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
      rw [hc'] at hs
      linarith
    have hdiag : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv i w z) x =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) x := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      simp [ite_mul]
    have hid : lapLocal G w x - ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv i w z) x =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            ((G x)⁻¹ i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) *
              partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) x
          - ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            (G x)⁻¹ i j * ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j x * partialDeriv k w x := by
      rw [hdiag]
      simp only [lapLocal, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [hid]
    obtain ⟨S2, hS2⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ,
        S = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) x| :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨S1, hS1⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k w x| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hS20 : 0 ≤ S2 := by
      rw [hS2]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => abs_nonneg _
    have hS10 : 0 ≤ S1 := by
      rw [hS1]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => abs_nonneg _
    rw [← hS2, ← hS1]
    have hT1 : |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        ((G x)⁻¹ i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) x|
          ≤ 3 * (b * (C * ρ)) * S2 := by
      rw [hS2, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hPe i j) (abs_nonneg _)
    have hinner : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        |∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j x * partialDeriv k w x| ≤
          9 / 2 * b * (C * u) * S1 := by
      intro i j
      rw [hS1, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_)
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hΓ k i j) (abs_nonneg _)
    have hT2 : |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G x)⁻¹ i j * ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j x * partialDeriv k w x|
          ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u) * S1) := by
      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hPb i j) (hinner i j) (abs_nonneg _) hb0
    have hT2' : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u) * S1)
        = 9 * (b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u) * S1)) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [hT2'] at hT2
    have a1 := abs_le.mp hT1
    have a2 := abs_le.mp hT2
    have k1 : 0 ≤ 3 * b * C * (u * S1) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hb0) hC) (mul_nonneg hu0 hS10)
    have k2 : 0 ≤ 81 / 2 * b ^ 2 * C * (ρ * S2) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg b)) hC) (mul_nonneg hρ0 hS20)
    have hexp : (3 * b * C + 81 / 2 * b ^ 2 * C) * (ρ * S2 + u * S1) =
        3 * (b * (C * ρ)) * S2 + 9 * (b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u) * S1))
          + 3 * b * C * (u * S1) + 81 / 2 * b ^ 2 * C * (ρ * S2) := by ring
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  
  have hN : ∀ z : E3, z ≠ 0 → ∃ L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun w : E3 => ‖w‖) L z ∧
      ∀ k : Fin 3, L (e k) = z k / ‖z‖ := by
    intro z hz
    have hz0 : ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz)
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E3 => ‖w‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ z) z :=
      (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq z).hasFDerivAt
    have h2 := h1.sqrt hz0
    have hfun : (fun w : E3 => Real.sqrt (‖w‖ ^ 2)) = fun w => ‖w‖ := by
      funext w; exact Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg w)
    rw [hfun] at h2
    refine ⟨_, h2, fun k => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg z)]
    have hzn : ‖z‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz
    simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    field_simp
  have hpow1 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≠ 0 → t ^ (-1 - δ) = t ^ (-δ) / t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [show (-1 - δ : ℝ) = -δ - 1 by ring, Real.rpow_sub_one ht]
  have hpow2 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≠ 0 → t ^ (-1 - δ - 1) = t ^ (-δ) / t / t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Real.rpow_sub_one ht, hpow1 t ht]
  have hpow3 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≠ 0 → t ^ (-δ - 1) = t ^ (-δ) / t := fun t ht =>
    Real.rpow_sub_one ht _
  have hP1 : ∀ z : E3, z ≠ 0 → ∀ k : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv k (farPot δ) z = -(1 + (1 + δ) * ‖z‖ ^ (-δ)) / ‖z‖ ^ 3 * z k := by
    intro z hz k
    have hr : ‖z‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz
    obtain ⟨L, hL, hLe⟩ := hN z hz
    have hPd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ + t ^ (-1 - δ))
        (-(‖z‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ + (-1 - δ) * ‖z‖ ^ (-1 - δ - 1)) ‖z‖ :=
      (hasDerivAt_inv hr).add (Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl hr))
    have h : HasFDerivAt (farPot δ)
        ((-(‖z‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ + (-1 - δ) * ‖z‖ ^ (-1 - δ - 1)) • L) z :=
      hPd.comp_hasFDerivAt z hL
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hLe, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hpow2 _ hr]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hP2 : ∀ y : E3, y ≠ 0 → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (farPot δ) z) y =
        (3 + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ) * ‖y‖ ^ (-δ)) / ‖y‖ ^ 5 * (y i * y j) +
          -(1 + (1 + δ) * ‖y‖ ^ (-δ)) / ‖y‖ ^ 3 * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro y hy i j
    have hr : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hy
    have hev : (fun z => partialDeriv j (farPot δ) z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        fun z => -(1 + (1 + δ) * ‖z‖ ^ (-δ)) / ‖z‖ ^ 3 * z j := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact hP1 z hz j
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -(1 + (1 + δ) * t ^ (-δ)))
        (-((1 + δ) * ((-δ) * ‖y‖ ^ (-δ - 1)))) ‖y‖ :=
      (((Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (p := -δ) (Or.inl hr)).const_mul (1 + δ)).const_add 1).neg
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 3) (3 * ‖y‖ ^ 2) ‖y‖ := by
      simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 3 ‖y‖
    have hQd := h1.div h2 (pow_ne_zero 3 hr)
    obtain ⟨L, hL, hLe⟩ := hN y hy
    have hcomp := hQd.comp_hasFDerivAt y hL
    have hpj : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => z j) (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have hm := hcomp.mul hpj
    have hm' : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => -(1 + (1 + δ) * ‖z‖ ^ (-δ)) / ‖z‖ ^ 3 * z j) _ y :=
      hm
    have hpe : (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (e i) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
      show (e i) j = _
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, eq_comm]
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv j (farPot δ) z) y (e i) = _
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hm'.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hLe,
      hpe, Function.comp, Pi.div_apply]
    rw [hpow3 _ hr]
    split_ifs <;> field_simp <;> ring
  
  
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = 9 * (5 + δ + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ)) + 3 * (2 + δ) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hAdef]; positivity
  obtain ⟨c0, hc0def⟩ : ∃ c0 : ℝ, c0 = δ * (1 + δ) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : 0 < c0 := by rw [hc0def]; positivity
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => K₂ * A * t ^ (-(q - δ))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (by linarith : 0 < q - δ)).const_mul (K₂ * A)
    simpa using this
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 ((tendsto_order.1 hlim).2 c0 hc0)
  
  
  refine ⟨max 2 (max R T), 3 * c0, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hxR : R < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hx
  have hxT : T < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hx
  have hx2 : 2 < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hx
  have hr0 : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hr0
  have hr : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := hr0.ne'
  have hP := hpert (farPot δ) x hxR
  have hZ : K₂ * A * ‖x‖ ^ (-(q - δ)) < c0 := hT ‖x‖ hxT.le
  have hd1 := hP1 x hx0
  have hd2 := hP2 x hx0
  have hxk : ∀ k : Fin 3, |x k| ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    intro k
    have := PiLp.norm_apply_le x k
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  have hS : x 0 * x 0 + x 1 * x 1 + x 2 * x 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    have := EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq x
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at this
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at this
    rw [this]; ring
  have hE : ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ) = ‖x‖ ^ (-δ) / ‖x‖ ^ 3 := by
    rw [show (-3 - δ : ℝ) = -δ - ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) by push_cast; ring, Real.rpow_sub hr0,
      Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hV : ‖x‖ ^ (-q) = ‖x‖ ^ (-δ) * ‖x‖ ^ (-(q - δ)) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hr0]; congr 1; ring
  have hV1 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) = ‖x‖ ^ (-δ) * ‖x‖ ^ (-(q - δ)) / ‖x‖ := by
    rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hr, hV]
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-δ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _
  have hW1 : ‖x‖ ^ (-δ) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hZ0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-(q - δ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _
  rw [← hc0def]
  set r := ‖x‖ with hrdef
  set W := r ^ (-δ) with hWdef
  set Z := r ^ (-(q - δ)) with hZdef
  set aa := -(1 + (1 + δ) * W) / r ^ 3 with haa
  set bb := (3 + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ) * W) / r ^ 5 with hbb
  have hr3 : 0 < r ^ 3 := pow_pos hr0 3
  have hr5 : 0 < r ^ 5 := pow_pos hr0 5
  have h1δ : 0 ≤ 1 + δ := by linarith
  have h3δ : 0 ≤ 3 + δ := by linarith
  
  have hdiag' : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv i (farPot δ) z) x =
      bb * (x i * x i) + aa := by
    intro i; rw [hd2 i i, if_pos rfl, mul_one]
  have e1 : bb * r ^ 2 + 3 * aa = 2 * c0 * (W / r ^ 3) := by
    rw [haa, hbb, hc0def]; field_simp; ring
  have hflat : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv i (farPot δ) z) x =
      2 * c0 * (W / r ^ 3) := by
    simp only [hdiag', Fin.sum_univ_three]
    linear_combination bb * hS + e1
  
  have hMpos : 0 ≤ 1 + (1 + δ) * W := by
    have := mul_nonneg h1δ hW0; linarith
  have hM : 1 + (1 + δ) * W ≤ 2 + δ := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hW1 h1δ; linarith
  have habsaa : |aa| ≤ (2 + δ) / r ^ 3 := by
    rw [haa, neg_div, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hMpos hr3.le)]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hM hr3.le
  have hS1 : ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (farPot δ) x| ≤ 3 * ((2 + δ) / r ^ 3 * r) := by
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (farPot δ) x| ≤ (2 + δ) / r ^ 3 * r := by
      intro k
      rw [hd1 k, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul habsaa (hxk k) (abs_nonneg _) (div_nonneg (by linarith) hr3.le)
    calc ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (farPot δ) x|
        ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, (2 + δ) / r ^ 3 * r := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hk k
      _ = 3 * ((2 + δ) / r ^ 3 * r) := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ (1 + δ) * (3 + δ) := mul_nonneg h1δ h3δ
  have hbb0 : 0 ≤ bb := by
    rw [hbb]
    have := mul_nonneg hN0 hW0
    exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hr5.le
  have hbbN : bb ≤ (3 + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ)) / r ^ 5 := by
    rw [hbb]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hW1 hN0
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hr5.le
  have hentry : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (farPot δ) z) x| ≤
      (3 + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ)) / r ^ 5 * (r * r) + (2 + δ) / r ^ 3 := by
    intro i j
    rw [hd2 i j]
    have hxx : |x i * x j| ≤ r * r := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hxk i) (hxk j) (abs_nonneg _) hr0.le
    have hdd : |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> simp
    have hpos1 : 0 ≤ (3 + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ)) / r ^ 5 := div_nonneg (by linarith) hr5.le
    have hpos2 : 0 ≤ (2 + δ) / r ^ 3 := div_nonneg (by linarith) hr3.le
    calc |bb * (x i * x j) + aa * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)|
        ≤ |bb * (x i * x j)| + |aa * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (3 + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ)) / r ^ 5 * (r * r) + (2 + δ) / r ^ 3 * 1 := by
        rw [abs_mul (bb) (x i * x j), abs_mul aa, abs_of_nonneg hbb0]
        exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul hbbN hxx (abs_nonneg _) hpos1)
          (mul_le_mul habsaa hdd (abs_nonneg _) hpos2)
      _ = (3 + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ)) / r ^ 5 * (r * r) + (2 + δ) / r ^ 3 := by ring
  have hS2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (farPot δ) z) x|
      ≤ 9 * ((3 + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ)) / r ^ 5 * (r * r) + (2 + δ) / r ^ 3) := by
    calc ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (farPot δ) z) x|
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            ((3 + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ)) / r ^ 5 * (r * r) + (2 + δ) / r ^ 3) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hentry i j
      _ = 9 * ((3 + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ)) / r ^ 5 * (r * r) + (2 + δ) / r ^ 3) := by
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  
  have herr : K₂ * (r ^ (-q) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (farPot δ) z) x|
      + r ^ (-q - 1) * ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (farPot δ) x|) ≤ c0 * (W / r ^ 3) := by
    rw [hV, hV1]
    have hWZ : 0 ≤ W * Z := mul_nonneg hW0 hZ0
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS2 hWZ
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS1 (div_nonneg hWZ hr0.le)
    have h3 : W * Z * (9 * ((3 + (1 + δ) * (3 + δ)) / r ^ 5 * (r * r) + (2 + δ) / r ^ 3)) +
        W * Z / r * (3 * ((2 + δ) / r ^ 3 * r)) = A * Z * (W / r ^ 3) := by
      rw [hAdef]; field_simp; ring
    have h4 : K₂ * A * Z * (W / r ^ 3) ≤ c0 * (W / r ^ 3) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hZ.le (div_nonneg hW0 hr3.le)
    calc K₂ * (W * Z * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (farPot δ) z) x|
        + W * Z / r * ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (farPot δ) x|)
        ≤ K₂ * (A * Z * (W / r ^ 3)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hK0
      _ = K₂ * A * Z * (W / r ^ 3) := by ring
      _ ≤ c0 * (W / r ^ 3) := h4
  rw [hflat] at hP
  have hab := abs_le.mp hP
  have hEpos : 0 ≤ c0 * (W / r ^ 3) := mul_nonneg hc0.le (div_nonneg hW0 hr3.le)
  rw [hE]
  refine ⟨by linarith [hab.1, herr], ?_⟩
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [hab.1, herr]
  · linarith [hab.2, herr]

informal_problem.statement:
(G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q a δ m R₂ : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1 / 4) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR₂ : 1 ≤ R₂)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ)))
    (hG' : ∀ x : E3, R₂ < ‖x‖ → G' x = ((1 - a * farPot δ x) ^ 4) • G x)
    (hm : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => fluxLocal G r) atTop (𝓝 m)) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => fluxLocal G' r) atTop (𝓝 (m - 2 * a))
