signature.statement:
(G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q a δ m R₂ : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1 / 4) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR₂ : 1 ≤ R₂)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ)))
    (hG' : ∀ x : E3, R₂ < ‖x‖ → G' x = ((1 - a * farPot δ x) ^ 4) • G x)
    (hm : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => fluxLocal G r) atTop (𝓝 m)) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => fluxLocal G' r) atTop (𝓝 (m - 2 * a))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hnorm : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∀ θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1, ‖r • (θ : E3)‖ = r := by
    intro r hr θ
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr, norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ, mul_one]
  have hθsq : ∀ θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1,
      (θ : E3) 0 ^ 2 + (θ : E3) 1 ^ 2 + (θ : E3) 2 ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro θ
    have h := EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq (θ : E3)
    rw [norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at h
    linarith
  have hθle : ∀ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1) (i : Fin 3), |(θ : E3) i| ≤ 1 := by
    intro θ i
    have h := PiLp.norm_apply_le (θ : E3) i
    rw [norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact h
  have hSopen : IsOpen {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hUopen : IsOpen {x : E3 | R₂ < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  
  have hS4 : ((volume : Measure E3).toSphere).real Set.univ = 4 * Real.pi := by
    rw [measureReal_def, Measure.toSphere_apply_univ, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin,
      EuclideanSpace.volume_ball_fin_three, ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_pow, one_mul,
      ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)]
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_natCast]
    push_cast
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : (E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) → ℝ → sphere (0 : E3) 1 → ℝ,
      F = fun (H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (r : ℝ) (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1) =>
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (fun x => H x i j) (r • (θ : E3))
          - partialDeriv j (fun x => H x i i) (r • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hflux : ∀ H r, fluxLocal H r = 1 / (16 * Real.pi) * r ^ 2 *
      ∫ θ, F H r θ ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere := by
    intro H r; rw [hF]; rfl
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ → sphere (0 : E3) 1 → ℝ,
      T = fun (r : ℝ) (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1) =>
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (θ : E3) i * (θ : E3) j * G (r • (θ : E3)) i j
        - ∑ i : Fin 3, G (r • (θ : E3)) i i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : ℝ → ℝ, Ψ = fun t : ℝ => (1 - a * (t⁻¹ + t ^ (-1 - δ))) ^ 4 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, P = fun t : ℝ =>
      4 * (1 - a * (t⁻¹ + t ^ (-1 - δ))) ^ 3 * (a * ((t ^ 2)⁻¹ + (1 + δ) * t ^ (-2 - δ))) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : E3 → ℝ, W = fun y : E3 => (1 - a * farPot δ y) ^ 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hχ : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≠ 0 →
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (1 - a * (t⁻¹ + t ^ (-1 - δ))) ^ 4) (P t) t := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹) (-(t ^ 2)⁻¹) t := hasDerivAt_inv ht
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (-1 - δ)) ((-1 - δ) * t ^ (-1 - δ - 1)) t :=
      Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (Or.inl ht)
    have e : (-1 - δ - 1) = -2 - δ := by ring
    rw [e] at h2
    have h3 := (((h1.add h2).const_mul a).const_sub 1).pow 4
    rw [hP]
    refine h3.congr_deriv ?_
    norm_num <;> ring
  have hWd : ∀ x : E3, x ≠ 0 →
      HasFDerivAt W (P ‖x‖ • ((1 / (2 * √(‖x‖ ^ 2))) • (2 • innerSL ℝ x))) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hn : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => √(‖y‖ ^ 2))
        ((1 / (2 * √(‖x‖ ^ 2))) • (2 • innerSL ℝ x)) x :=
      (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq x).hasFDerivAt.sqrt (pow_ne_zero 2 hn)
    have h2 : (fun y : E3 => √(‖y‖ ^ 2)) = fun y => ‖y‖ :=
      funext fun y => Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg y)
    rw [h2] at h1
    have h3 := (hχ ‖x‖ hn).comp_hasFDerivAt x h1
    rw [hW]
    exact h3
  have hdW : ∀ x : E3, x ≠ 0 → ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l W x = P ‖x‖ * (x l / ‖x‖) := by
    intro x hx l
    have hn : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx
    rw [partialDeriv, (hWd x hx).fderiv]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg x)]
    field_simp
    try simp
  
  have hpt : ∀ r : ℝ, R₂ < r → ∀ θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1,
      F G' r θ = Ψ r * F G r θ + P r * T r θ := by
    intro r hr θ
    have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : E3, x = r • (θ : E3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hxn : ‖x‖ = r := by rw [hx]; exact hnorm r hr0 θ
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hxn; linarith
    have hxl : ∀ l : Fin 3, x l = r * (θ : E3) l := by intro l; rw [hx]; rfl
    have hWx : W x = Ψ r := by rw [hW, hΨ]; simp only [farPot, hxn]
    have hdWx : ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l W x = P r * (θ : E3) l := by
      intro l; rw [hdW x hx0 l, hxn, hxl]; field_simp
    have hGd : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x := by
      intro i j
      exact ((hsmooth i j).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        (hSopen.mem_nhds (show (1:ℝ) < ‖x‖ by rw [hxn]; linarith))
    have hprod : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun y => G' y i j) x =
        Ψ r * partialDeriv k (fun y => G y i j) x + G x i j * (P r * (θ : E3) k) := by
      intro k i j
      have hev : (fun y => G' y i j) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => W y * G y i j) := by
        filter_upwards [hUopen.mem_nhds (show R₂ < ‖x‖ by rw [hxn]; exact hr)] with y hy
        rw [hG' y hy, hW]
        rfl
      have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => W y * G y i j)
          (W x • fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x +
            G x i j • (P ‖x‖ • ((1 / (2 * √(‖x‖ ^ 2))) • (2 • innerSL ℝ x)))) x :=
        (hWd x hx0).mul (hGd i j).hasFDerivAt
      rw [partialDeriv, hev.fderiv_eq, hd.fderiv, ← hWx, ← hdWx k]
      simp only [partialDeriv, (hWd x hx0).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hF, hT]
    dsimp only
    rw [← hx]
    simp only [hprod, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    linear_combination (-(P r * (G x 0 0 + G x 1 1 + G x 2 2))) * hθsq θ
  
  have hcontG : ∀ r : ℝ, 1 < r → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      Continuous fun θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1 => G (r • (θ : E3)) i j := by
    intro r hr i j
    exact (hsmooth i j).continuousOn.comp_continuous (continuous_subtype_val.const_smul r)
      (fun θ => show (1:ℝ) < ‖r • (θ : E3)‖ by rw [hnorm r (by linarith) θ]; exact hr)
  have hcontD : ∀ r : ℝ, 1 < r → ∀ k i j : Fin 3,
      Continuous fun θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1 => partialDeriv k (fun x => G x i j) (r • (θ : E3)) := by
    intro r hr k i j
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun x => G x i j) y (e k)) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
      ((hsmooth i j).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hSopen (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    exact h1.comp_continuous (continuous_subtype_val.const_smul r)
      (fun θ => show (1:ℝ) < ‖r • (θ : E3)‖ by rw [hnorm r (by linarith) θ]; exact hr)
  have hcoord : ∀ j : Fin 3, Continuous fun θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1 => (θ : E3) j :=
    fun j => (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ j).comp continuous_subtype_val
  have hint1 : ∀ r : ℝ, 1 < r → Integrable (F G r) (volume : Measure E3).toSphere := by
    intro r hr
    have hc : Continuous (F G r) := by
      rw [hF]
      exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuous_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        ((hcontD r hr i i j).sub (hcontD r hr j i i)).mul (hcoord j)
    exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  have hint2 : ∀ r : ℝ, 1 < r → Integrable (T r) (volume : Measure E3).toSphere := by
    intro r hr
    have hc : Continuous (T r) := by
      rw [hT]
      exact (continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuous_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        ((hcoord i).mul (hcoord j)).mul (hcontG r hr i j)).sub
        (continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ => hcontG r hr i i)
    exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  
  have hstar : ∀ r : ℝ, R₂ < r → fluxLocal G' r = Ψ r * fluxLocal G r +
      1 / (16 * Real.pi) * (r ^ 2 * P r) * ∫ θ, T r θ ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere := by
    intro r hr
    have hr1 : 1 < r := by linarith
    rw [hflux, hflux, show (∫ θ, F G' r θ ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere) =
        ∫ θ, (Ψ r * F G r θ + P r * T r θ) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere from
        integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ (hpt r hr)),
      integral_add ((hint1 r hr1).const_mul _) ((hint2 r hr1).const_mul _),
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    ring
  
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => r⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_inv_atTop_zero
  have hrp : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => r ^ (-1 - δ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (show 0 < 1 + δ by linarith)
    rwa [neg_add'] at h
  have hrd : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => r ^ (-δ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hδ
  have hu : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => 1 - a * (r⁻¹ + r ^ (-1 - δ))) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    have h := ((hinv.add hrp).const_mul a).const_sub 1
    rwa [add_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
  have hΨlim : Tendsto Ψ atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    rw [hΨ]
    have h := hu.pow 4
    rwa [one_pow] at h
  have hPlim : Tendsto (fun r => r ^ 2 * P r) atTop (𝓝 (4 * a)) := by
    have h : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => 4 * (1 - a * (r⁻¹ + r ^ (-1 - δ))) ^ 3 *
        (a * (1 + (1 + δ) * r ^ (-δ)))) atTop
        (𝓝 (4 * 1 ^ 3 * (a * (1 + (1 + δ) * 0)))) :=
      ((hu.pow 3).const_mul 4).mul (((hrd.const_mul (1 + δ)).const_add 1).const_mul a)
    simp only [one_pow, mul_zero, add_zero, mul_one] at h
    refine h.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with r hr
    rw [hP]
    dsimp only
    have hA : r ^ 2 * r ^ (-2 - δ) = r ^ (-δ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_two, ← Real.rpow_add hr]; congr 1; ring
    have hB : r ^ 2 * (r ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity)
    linear_combination (-(4 * (1 - a * (r⁻¹ + r ^ (-1 - δ))) ^ 3 * a)) * hB +
      (-(4 * (1 - a * (r⁻¹ + r ^ (-1 - δ))) ^ 3 * a * (1 + δ))) * hA
  
  have hTlim : Tendsto (fun r => ∫ θ, T r θ ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere) atTop
      (𝓝 (-2 * ((volume : Measure E3).toSphere).real Set.univ)) := by
    have hb : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3,
        |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ c * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) := by
      intro i j
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hdecay i j 0 (by norm_num)).bound
      refine ⟨c, hc.mono fun x hx => ?_⟩
      simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs, Nat.cast_zero,
        sub_zero] at hx
      rwa [abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) _)] at hx
    choose c hc using hb
    have hev : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ c i j * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all]; intro i; rw [Filter.eventually_all]; exact hc i
    rw [← comap_norm_atTop, Filter.eventually_comap, Filter.eventually_atTop] at hev
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hev
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |c i j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hcC : ∀ i j, c i j ≤ C := by
      intro i j
      rw [hC]
      calc c i j ≤ |c i j| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ∑ j' : Fin 3, |c i j'| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j' => |c i j'|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
            (Finset.mem_univ j)
        _ ≤ ∑ i' : Fin 3, ∑ j' : Fin 3, |c i' j'| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i' => ∑ j' : Fin 3, |c i' j'|)
            (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have key2 : ∀ f : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, (∀ i j, |f i j| ≤ ε) →
        |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j| ≤ 9 * ε := by
      intro f ε hf
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 0 0)
      obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 0 1)
      obtain ⟨h5, h6⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 0 2)
      obtain ⟨h7, h8⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 1 0)
      obtain ⟨h9, h10⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 1 1)
      obtain ⟨h11, h12⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 1 2)
      obtain ⟨h13, h14⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 2 0)
      obtain ⟨h15, h16⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 2 1)
      obtain ⟨h17, h18⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 2 2)
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    have key1 : ∀ f : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, (∀ i, |f i| ≤ ε) →
        |∑ i : Fin 3, f i| ≤ 3 * ε := by
      intro f ε hf
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 0)
      obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 1)
      obtain ⟨h5, h6⟩ := abs_le.mp (hf 2)
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    have hpw : ∀ r : ℝ, max R 2 ≤ r → ∀ θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1,
        ‖T r θ - (-2)‖ ≤ 12 * (C * r ^ (-q)) := by
      intro r hr θ
      have hr2 : 2 ≤ r := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hr
      have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : E3, x = r • (θ : E3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hxn : ‖x‖ = r := by rw [hx]; exact hnorm r hr0 θ
      have hbx := hR ‖x‖ (by rw [hxn]; exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hr) x rfl
      rw [hxn] at hbx
      have hε : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * r ^ (-q) :=
        fun i j => le_trans (hbx i j)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcC i j) (Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _))
      have hterm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |(θ : E3) i * (θ : E3) j *
          (G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0))| ≤ C * r ^ (-q) := by
        intro i j
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        have := mul_le_mul (mul_le_one₀ (hθle θ i) (abs_nonneg _) (hθle θ j)) (hε i j)
          (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        linarith
      have hdiag : ∀ i : Fin 3, |G x i i - 1| ≤ C * r ^ (-q) := by
        intro i
        have h := hε i i
        rwa [if_pos rfl] at h
      have hid : T r θ - (-2) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (θ : E3) i * (θ : E3) j *
          (G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) - ∑ i : Fin 3, (G x i i - 1) := by
        rw [hT]
        dsimp only
        rw [← hx]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        simp
        linear_combination hθsq θ
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hid]
      have hA := key2 _ _ hterm
      have hB := key1 _ _ hdiag
      rw [abs_le] at hA hB ⊢
      constructor <;> linarith [hA.1, hA.2, hB.1, hB.2]
    rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    refine squeeze_zero' (g := fun r => 12 * (C * r ^ (-q)) *
        ((volume : Measure E3).toSphere).real Set.univ)
      (Eventually.of_forall fun r => norm_nonneg _) ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (max R 2)] with r hr
      have hr1 : 1 < r := by linarith [le_max_right R 2]
      have hrw : ∫ θ, (T r θ - (-2)) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere =
          ∫ θ, T r θ ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere -
            -2 * ((volume : Measure E3).toSphere).real Set.univ := by
        rw [integral_sub (hint2 r hr1) (integrable_const _), integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      rw [← hrw]
      exact norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (ae_of_all _ (hpw r hr))
    · have h := (((tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hq).const_mul C).const_mul 12).mul_const
        (((volume : Measure E3).toSphere).real Set.univ)
      rwa [mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul] at h
  
  have hlim := (hΨlim.mul hm).add ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := 1 / (16 * Real.pi))).mul
    hPlim |>.mul hTlim)
  have hval : 1 * m + 1 / (16 * Real.pi) * (4 * a) * (-2 * (4 * Real.pi)) = m - 2 * a := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hS4, hval] at hlim
  refine hlim.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop R₂] with r hr
  rw [hstar r hr]

informal_problem.statement:
(G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q a δ R₂ : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1 / 4) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR₂ : 1 ≤ R₂)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ)))
    (hG' : ∀ x : E3, R₂ < ‖x‖ → G' x = ((1 - a * farPot δ x) ^ 4) • G x) :
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G' y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-(min q 1) - (l : ℝ))

signature.name: conformal_decay
signature.statement:
(G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q a δ R₂ : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1 / 4) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR₂ : 1 ≤ R₂)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ)))
    (hG' : ∀ x : E3, R₂ < ‖x‖ → G' x = ((1 - a * farPot δ x) ^ 4) • G x) :
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G' y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-(min q 1) - (l : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro i j l hl
  have hev : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3, 1 < ‖x‖ :=
    tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 1
  have hopen : IsOpen {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  
  have t_mono : ∀ (s s' : ℝ), s ≤ s' →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ s) =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ s' := by
    intro s s' hss
    refine Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1 ?_
    filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _),
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _), one_mul]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx.le hss
  
  have t_lincomb : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (m₁ m₂ m α β : ℝ), m₁ ≤ m → m₂ ≤ m →
      cdecaySym f m₁ → cdecaySym g m₂ → cdecaySym (fun y => α * f y + β * g y) m := by
    intro f g m₁ m₂ m α β h₁ h₂ hf hg
    refine ⟨(contDiffOn_const.mul hf.1).add (contDiffOn_const.mul hg.1), fun l hl => ?_⟩
    have key : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3,
        ‖‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => α * f y + β * g y) x‖‖ ≤
          1 * ‖|α| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l f x‖ + |β| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l g x‖‖ := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
      have hfx : ContDiffAt ℝ l f x :=
        (hf.1.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hgx : ContDiffAt ℝ l g x :=
        (hg.1.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have e : (fun y => α * f y + β * g y) = α • f + β • g := by
        funext y; simp [smul_eq_mul]
      have hfs : ContDiffAt ℝ l (α • f) x := hfx.const_smul α
      have hgs : ContDiffAt ℝ l (β • g) x := hgx.const_smul β
      rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply hfs hgs,
        iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hfx, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hgx, norm_norm,
        one_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      calc _ ≤ ‖α • iteratedFDeriv ℝ l f x‖ + ‖β • iteratedFDeriv ℝ l g x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have b1 := ((hf.2 l hl).const_mul_left |α|).trans (t_mono (m₁ - l) (m - l) (by linarith))
    have b2 := ((hg.2 l hl).const_mul_left |β|).trans (t_mono (m₂ - l) (m - l) (by linarith))
    exact (Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1 key).trans (b1.add b2)
  
  have t_mul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (m₁ m₂ : ℝ),
      cdecaySym f m₁ → cdecaySym g m₂ → cdecaySym (fun y => f y * g y) (m₁ + m₂) := by
    intro f g m₁ m₂ hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.mul hg.1, fun l hl => ?_⟩
    have key : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3,
        ‖‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => f y * g y) x‖‖ ≤
          1 * ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), (l.choose k : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (l - k) g x‖‖ := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
      have h := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf.1 hg.1 hopen.uniqueDiffOn hx (n := l)
        (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hw : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : E3 → ℝ),
          iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n u {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} x = iteratedFDeriv ℝ n u x :=
        fun n u => iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hopen hx
      simp only [hw] at h
      rw [norm_norm, one_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => by positivity))]
      exact h
    have hsum : (fun x => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), (l.choose k : ℝ) *
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (l - k) g x‖) =O[Bornology.cobounded E3]
        (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (m₁ + m₂ - (l : ℝ))) := by
      apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.sum
      intro k hk
      have hkl : k ≤ l := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      have h1 :=
        ((hf.2 k (by omega)).const_mul_left (l.choose k : ℝ)).mul (hg.2 (l - k) (by omega))
      refine h1.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun x => rfl) ?_
      filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
      rw [← Real.rpow_add (by linarith)]
      congr 1
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hkl]
      ring
    exact (Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1 key).trans hsum
  
  have t_rpow : ∀ p : ℝ, cdecaySym (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p) p := by
    intro p
    have hU : IsOpen {y : E3 | y ≠ 0} := isOpen_ne
    have hcd : ∀ y : E3, y ≠ 0 → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p) y := fun y hy =>
      (contDiffAt_norm ℝ hy).rpow_const_of_ne (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hy)
    have hcdU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p) {y | y ≠ 0} := fun y hy =>
      (hcd y hy).contDiffWithinAt
    have hne : ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ → x ≠ 0 := by
      intro x hx h
      rw [h, norm_zero] at hx
      linarith
    refine ⟨hcdU.mono (fun x hx => hne x hx), fun l hl => ?_⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p)) {y | y ≠ 0} := by
      have := hcdU.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (m := l) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
        hU.uniqueDiffOn
      exact this.congr (fun y hy => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen l hU hy).symm)
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := (isCompact_sphere (0 : E3) 1).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hcont.mono (fun y hy => by
        have hy' : ‖y‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hy
        show y ≠ 0
        intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hy'; norm_num at hy'))
    have main : ∀ x : E3, x ≠ 0 →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p) x‖ ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ (p - (l : ℝ)) := by
      intro x hx
      have hr : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx
      have ht : 0 < ‖x‖⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hr
      let L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := ‖x‖⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3
      have hLy : ∀ y, L y = ‖x‖⁻¹ • y := fun y => rfl
      have hcomp : (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p) ∘ L = fun y => ‖x‖⁻¹ ^ p * ‖y‖ ^ p := by
        funext y
        show ‖L y‖ ^ p = ‖x‖⁻¹ ^ p * ‖y‖ ^ p
        rw [hLy, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht.le]
        exact Real.mul_rpow ht.le (norm_nonneg y)
      have hLx : L x ∈ {y : E3 | y ≠ 0} := by
        show L x ≠ 0
        rw [hLy]; exact smul_ne_zero ht.ne' hx
      have hpre : IsOpen (L ⁻¹' {y : E3 | y ≠ 0}) := hU.preimage L.continuous
      have hxpre : x ∈ L ⁻¹' {y : E3 | y ≠ 0} := hLx
      have hchain := L.iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_right hcdU hU.uniqueDiffOn hpre.uniqueDiffOn
        hLx (i := l) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen l hpre hxpre, iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen l hU hLx,
        hcomp] at hchain
      have hsm : (fun y : E3 => ‖x‖⁻¹ ^ p * ‖y‖ ^ p) =
          (‖x‖⁻¹ ^ p) • (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p) := by
        funext y; simp [smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hsm, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply ((hcd x hx).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))]
        at hchain
      have hn := congrArg norm hchain
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg ht.le p)] at hn
      have hle := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p) (L x)) (fun _ => L)
      rw [← hn] at hle
      have hLn : ‖L‖ ≤ ‖x‖⁻¹ := by
        calc ‖L‖ ≤ ‖‖x‖⁻¹‖ * ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3‖ :=
              norm_smul_le (‖x‖⁻¹ : ℝ) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)
          _ ≤ ‖x‖⁻¹ * 1 := by
            rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg ht.le]
            exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le ht.le
          _ = ‖x‖⁻¹ := mul_one _
      have hprod : ∏ _i : Fin l, ‖L‖ ≤ ‖x‖⁻¹ ^ l := by
        rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hLn l
      have hKx : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p) (L x)‖ ≤ K := by
        apply hK
        rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, hLy, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht.le]
        exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne'
      have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hKx
      have h2 : ‖x‖⁻¹ ^ p * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p) x‖ ≤ K * ‖x‖⁻¹ ^ l :=
        le_trans hle (mul_le_mul hKx hprod (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)) hK0)
      have hrp : 0 < ‖x‖ ^ p := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr p
      rw [Real.inv_rpow hr.le, inv_pow] at h2
      rw [Real.rpow_sub hr, Real.rpow_natCast]
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p) x‖
          = ‖x‖ ^ p * ((‖x‖ ^ p)⁻¹ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ p) x‖) := by
            field_simp
        _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ p * (K * (‖x‖ ^ l)⁻¹) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hrp.le
        _ = K * (‖x‖ ^ p / ‖x‖ ^ l) := by ring
    refine Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound K ?_
    filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
    rw [norm_norm, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)]
    exact main x (hne x hx)
  
  have hφ : cdecaySym (farPot δ) (-1) := by
    have e : farPot δ = fun y => 1 * ‖y‖ ^ (-1 : ℝ) + 1 * ‖y‖ ^ (-1 - δ) := by
      funext y; simp only [farPot, Real.rpow_neg_one, one_mul]
    rw [e]
    exact t_lincomb _ _ (-1) (-1 - δ) (-1) 1 1 le_rfl (by linarith) (t_rpow _) (t_rpow _)
  have hφ2 := t_mul _ _ _ _ hφ hφ
  have hφ3 := t_mul _ _ _ _ hφ2 hφ
  have hφ4 := t_mul _ _ _ _ hφ3 hφ
  have hA := t_lincomb _ _ _ _ (-1) (-4 * a) (6 * a ^ 2) le_rfl (by norm_num) hφ hφ2
  have hB := t_lincomb _ _ _ _ (-1) (-4 * a ^ 3) (a ^ 4) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hφ3 hφ4
  have hV' := t_lincomb _ _ _ _ (-1) 1 1 le_rfl le_rfl hA hB
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : E3 → ℝ, V = fun y => (1 - a * farPot δ y) ^ 4 - 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hV : cdecaySym V (-1) := by
    have e : V = fun y => 1 * ((-4 * a) * farPot δ y + (6 * a ^ 2) * (farPot δ y * farPot δ y)) +
        1 * ((-4 * a ^ 3) * (farPot δ y * farPot δ y * farPot δ y) +
          a ^ 4 * (farPot δ y * farPot δ y * farPot δ y * farPot δ y)) := by
      rw [hVdef]; funext y; ring
    rw [e]; exact hV'
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hhdef⟩ : ∃ h : E3 → ℝ, h = fun y => G y i j - c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hh : cdecaySym h (-q) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hhdef]; exact (hsmooth i j).sub contDiffOn_const
    · intro l hl
      rw [hhdef, hc]
      exact hdecay i j l hl
  have hVh := t_mul _ _ _ _ hV hh
  have hmin1 := min_le_left q 1
  have hmin2 := min_le_right q 1
  have hT := t_lincomb _ _ (-q) (-1 + -q) (-(min q 1)) 1 1 (by linarith) (by linarith) hh hVh
  have hH := t_lincomb _ _ (-(min q 1)) (-1) (-(min q 1)) 1 c le_rfl (by linarith) hT hV
  have hfarnhds : ∀ x : E3, R₂ < ‖x‖ →
      (fun y => G' y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => 1 * (1 * h y + 1 * (V y * h y)) + c * V y) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hx) ?_
    intro y hy
    have hy' : R₂ < ‖y‖ := hy
    have hGy : G' y i j = (1 - a * farPot δ y) ^ 4 * G y i j := by
      rw [hG' y hy', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    simp only
    rw [hGy, ← hc, hhdef, hVdef]
    ring
  refine (hH.2 l hl).congr' ?_ (EventuallyEq.rfl)
  filter_upwards [tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop R₂] with x hx
  rw [((hfarnhds x hx).iteratedFDeriv ℝ l).eq_of_nhds]

conformal_decay.definitions:
def cdecaySym (f : E3 → ℝ) (m : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} ∧ ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
    (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l f x‖) =O[Bornology.cobounded E3]
      fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (m - (l : ℝ))

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ)
    (q a δ R₂ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδq : δ < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1 / 4) (hR₂ : 2 ≤ R₂)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i)
    (hdet : ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ → 0 < (G x).det)
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ)))
    (hint : IntegrableOn (fun x : E3 => scalarCurvatureLocal G x * Real.sqrt (G x).det)
      {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖}) (hupos : ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ → 0 < u x)
    (hufar : ∀ x : E3, R₂ < ‖x‖ → u x = 1 - a * farPot δ x) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : E3 => scalarCurvatureLocal (fun y => (u y ^ 4) • G y) x *
      Real.sqrt ((u x ^ 4) • G x).det) {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖}

signature.name: conformal_scalar_integrable
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ)
    (q a δ R₂ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδq : δ < q) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha' : a ≤ 1 / 4) (hR₂ : 2 ≤ R₂)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i)
    (hdet : ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ → 0 < (G x).det)
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ)))
    (hint : IntegrableOn (fun x : E3 => scalarCurvatureLocal G x * Real.sqrt (G x).det)
      {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖}) (hupos : ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ → 0 < u x)
    (hufar : ∀ x : E3, R₂ < ‖x‖ → u x = 1 - a * farPot δ x) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : E3 => scalarCurvatureLocal (fun y => (u y ^ 4) • G y) x *
      Real.sqrt ((u x ^ 4) • G x).det) {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖}

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hUo : IsOpen {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hSm : MeasurableSet {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} := measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm
  have hSU : {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} ⊆ {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := fun x hx => by
    have h : (2 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := hx
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖
    linarith
  have hKc : ∀ T : ℝ, IsCompact (closedBall (0 : E3) T ∩ {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖}) := fun T =>
    (isCompact_closedBall 0 T).inter_right (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm)
  have hKU : ∀ T : ℝ, closedBall (0 : E3) T ∩ {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖} ⊆ {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
    fun T x hx => by
      have h : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := hx.2
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖
      linarith
  
  have hGc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
    fun i j => (hsmooth i j).continuousOn
  have hA : Continuous (fun y : {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} => G (y : E3)) :=
    continuous_matrix (fun i j => (hGc i j).restrict)
  have hinvf : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (i j : Fin 3), A⁻¹ i j = A.det⁻¹ * A.adjugate i j := by
    intro A i j
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hGinvC : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (G x)⁻¹ i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro i j
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
    have h1 : Continuous (fun y : {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} => ((G (y : E3)).det)⁻¹) :=
      hA.matrix_det.inv₀ (fun y => (hdet y y.2).ne')
    have h2 := hA.matrix_adjugate.matrix_elem i j
    have heq : Set.restrict {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} (fun x => (G x)⁻¹ i j) =
        fun y : {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} => ((G (y : E3)).det)⁻¹ * (G (y : E3)).adjugate i j := by
      funext y
      simp only [Set.restrict_apply]
      rw [hinvf]
    rw [heq]
    exact h1.mul h2
  have hsqC : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (G x).det) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
    (continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict.2 hA.matrix_det).sqrt
  have hpd : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => partialDeriv l f z) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro f hf l
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => christoffel G k i j y) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    refine continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun l _ => ?_))
    exact (hGinvC k l).mul ((((hpd _ (hsmooth j l) i).continuousOn).add
      ((hpd _ (hsmooth i l) j).continuousOn)).sub ((hpd _ (hsmooth i j) l).continuousOn))
  have hlapC : ContinuousOn (fun y => lapLocal G u y) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    unfold lapLocal
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_))
    refine (hGinvC i j).mul (((hpd _ (hpd u hu j) i).continuousOn).sub
      (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => ?_)))
    exact (hchr k i j).mul ((hpd u hu k).continuousOn)
  have huC : ContinuousOn u {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := hu.continuousOn
  
  have hpt : ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ →
      scalarCurvatureLocal (fun y => (u y ^ 4) • G y) x * Real.sqrt ((u x ^ 4) • G x).det =
        -8 * u x * lapLocal G u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det +
          u x ^ 2 * (scalarCurvatureLocal G x * Real.sqrt (G x).det) := by
    intro x hx
    have hc := conformal_scalarCurvatureLocal G u {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} hUo hsmooth hsymm
      (fun y hy => (hdet y hy).ne') hu (fun y hy => hupos y hy) x hx
    have hv : 0 < u x := hupos x hx
    have hdet' : ((u x ^ 4) • G x).det = (u x ^ 6) ^ 2 * (G x).det := by
      rw [Matrix.det_smul, Fintype.card_fin]; ring
    rw [hc, hdet', Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (pow_nonneg hv.le 6)]
    have e6 : u x ^ 6 = u x ^ 5 * u x := by ring
    rw [e6]
    have hinv5 : (u x ^ 5)⁻¹ * u x ^ 5 = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 5 hv.ne')
    linear_combination (-8 * lapLocal G u x * u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det +
      scalarCurvatureLocal G x * u x * u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det) * hinv5
  
  have hφ : ∀ x : E3, 1 ≤ ‖x‖ → 0 ≤ farPot δ x ∧ farPot δ x ≤ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : ‖x‖⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hx
    have h2 : ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - δ) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hx (by linarith)
    have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)
    have h4 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - δ) := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
    unfold farPot
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hub : ∀ x : E3, R₂ < ‖x‖ → 1 / 2 ≤ u x ∧ u x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have h := hφ x (by linarith)
    rw [hufar x hx]
    have h1 : a * farPot δ x ≤ a * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h.2 ha
    have h2 : 0 ≤ a * farPot δ x := mul_nonneg ha h.1
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hh₂ : IntegrableOn (fun x => u x ^ 2 * (scalarCurvatureLocal G x * Real.sqrt (G x).det))
      {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} := by
    obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := (hKc R₂).exists_bound_of_continuousOn ((huC.pow 2).mono (hKU R₂))
    refine Integrable.bdd_mul (c := max C₁ 1) hint ?_ ?_
    · exact ((huC.pow 2).mono hSU).aestronglyMeasurable hSm
    · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hSm (fun x hx => ?_)
      have hx2 : (2 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := hx
      by_cases hxR : ‖x‖ ≤ R₂
      · have := hC₁ x ⟨mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 hxR, show (2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ by linarith⟩
        exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
      · push_neg at hxR
        have hb := hub x hxR
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
        nlinarith [le_max_right C₁ 1]
  
  have H1 : ∀ (u v : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] v → lapLocal G u y = lapLocal G v y := by
    intro u v y huv
    have h1 : ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l u y = partialDeriv l v y := by
      intro l
      show fderiv ℝ u y (e l) = fderiv ℝ v y (e l)
      rw [huv.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ i l : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) y =
        partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l v z) y := by
      intro i l
      have hev : (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => partialDeriv l v z) := by
        filter_upwards [huv.eventuallyEq_nhds] with z hz
        show fderiv ℝ u z (e l) = fderiv ℝ v z (e l)
        rw [hz.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) y (e i) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv l v z) y (e i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [lapLocal, h1, h2]
  have H2 : ∀ (u : E3 → ℝ) (α γ : ℝ) (y : E3),
      lapLocal G (fun z => α * u z + γ) y = α * lapLocal G u y := by
    intro u α γ y
    have hP0 : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (l : Fin 3) (z : E3),
        partialDeriv l (fun z => α * w z) z = α * partialDeriv l w z := by
      intro w l z
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z) z (e l) = α * fderiv ℝ w z (e l)
      have : (fun z => α * w z) = α • w := by funext z; simp
      rw [this, fderiv_const_smul_of_field]; rfl
    have hP : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (γ' : ℝ) (l : Fin 3) (z : E3),
        partialDeriv l (fun z => α * w z + γ') z = α * partialDeriv l w z := by
      intro w γ' l z
      rw [← hP0]
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z + γ') z (e l) = fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z) z (e l)
      rw [fderiv_add_const]
    have h2 : ∀ i l : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l (fun z => α * u z + γ) z) y
        = α * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) y := by
      intro i l
      have : (fun z => partialDeriv l (fun z => α * u z + γ) z) =
          fun z => α * partialDeriv l u z := by
        funext z; exact hP u γ l z
      rw [this, hP0]
    simp only [lapLocal, h2, hP, hP0, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hlapfar : ∀ x : E3, R₂ < ‖x‖ → lapLocal G u x = -a * lapLocal G (farPot δ) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hev : u =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => -a * farPot δ z + 1) := by
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds
        (show x ∈ {z : E3 | R₂ < ‖z‖} from hx)] with z hz
      rw [hufar z hz]; ring
    rw [H1 u _ x hev, H2 (farPot δ) (-a) 1 x]
  
  have hdet48 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, (∀ i j, |A i j| ≤ 2) → A.det ≤ 48 := by
    intro A hA
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    have hp : ∀ i j k l m n : Fin 3, A i j * A k l * A m n ≤ 8 ∧ -(A i j * A k l * A m n) ≤ 8 := by
      intro i j k l m n
      have h : |A i j * A k l * A m n| ≤ 8 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        have h1 := hA i j
        have h2 := hA k l
        have h3 := hA m n
        calc |A i j| * |A k l| * |A m n| ≤ 2 * 2 * 2 := by gcongr
          _ = 8 := by norm_num
      exact ⟨(le_abs_self _).trans h, (neg_le_abs _).trans h⟩
    linarith [(hp 0 0 1 1 2 2).1, (hp 0 0 1 2 2 1).2, (hp 0 1 1 0 2 2).2, (hp 0 1 1 2 2 0).1,
      (hp 0 2 1 0 2 1).1, (hp 0 2 1 1 2 0).2]
  have hev : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G x i j| ≤ 2 := by
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]; intro i
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]; intro j
    have hO := hdecay i j 0 (by norm_num)
    have ht : Tendsto (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ))) (Bornology.cobounded E3) (𝓝 0) := by
      have := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hq0).comp (tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop (E := E3))
      refine this.congr (fun x => ?_)
      simp
    have h2 := (hO.trans_tendsto ht).eventually (gt_mem_nhds one_pos)
    filter_upwards [h2] with x hx
    simp only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hx
    have h3 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (G x i j) (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
    have h01 : |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> simp
    linarith
  obtain ⟨R₁, -, hR₁⟩ := (Metric.hasBasis_cobounded_compl_closedBall (0 : E3)).eventually_iff.1 hev
  
  obtain ⟨R₀, C, hR₀, hRC⟩ := farPot_lap_bounds G q δ hδ hδq hsmooth hsymm hdecay
  obtain ⟨R₃, hR₃⟩ : ∃ R₃ : ℝ, R₃ = max (max R₀ R₂) R₁ + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR₃0 : R₀ < R₃ := by rw [hR₃]; have := le_max_left R₀ R₂; have := le_max_left (max R₀ R₂) R₁; linarith
  have hR₃2 : R₂ < R₃ := by rw [hR₃]; have := le_max_right R₀ R₂; have := le_max_left (max R₀ R₂) R₁; linarith
  have hR₃1 : R₁ < R₃ := by rw [hR₃]; have := le_max_right (max R₀ R₂) R₁; linarith
  have hBm : MeasurableSet {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖} := measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm
  have hBU : {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖} ⊆ {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := fun x hx => by
    have h : R₃ < ‖x‖ := hx
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖
    linarith
  
  have hpow : IntegrableOn (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ)) {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖} := by
    have hI : Integrable (fun x : E3 => (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-(3 + δ))) :=
      integrable_one_add_norm (by rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]; push_cast; linarith)
    have hI2 : Integrable (fun x : E3 => 2 ^ (3 + δ) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-(3 + δ))) := hI.const_mul _
    refine Integrable.mono' hI2.integrableOn ?_ ?_
    · exact (measurable_norm.pow_const _).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hBm (fun x hx => ?_)
      have hx' : R₃ < ‖x‖ := hx
      have hx1 : 1 ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)]
      have h1 : ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ) ≤ ((1 + ‖x‖) / 2) ^ (-3 - δ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have h2 : ((1 + ‖x‖) / 2) ^ (-3 - δ) = 2 ^ (3 + δ) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-(3 + δ)) := by
        rw [Real.div_rpow (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
        rw [show (-3 - δ) = -(3 + δ) by ring, Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2),
          div_inv_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      linarith
  
  have hh₁C : ContinuousOn (fun x => -8 * u x * lapLocal G u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det)
      {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
    ((continuousOn_const.mul huC).mul hlapC).mul hsqC
  have hh₁A : IntegrableOn (fun x => -8 * u x * lapLocal G u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det)
      (closedBall (0 : E3) R₃ ∩ {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖}) :=
    ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact (hKc R₃) (hh₁C.mono (hKU R₃))
  have hh₁B : IntegrableOn (fun x => -8 * u x * lapLocal G u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det)
      {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖} := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (Integrable.const_mul hpow (56 * a * C)) ?_ ?_
    · exact (hh₁C.mono hBU).aestronglyMeasurable hBm
    · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hBm (fun x hx => ?_)
      have hx' : R₃ < ‖x‖ := hx
      have hxR₂ : R₂ < ‖x‖ := by linarith
      have hxR₀ : R₀ < ‖x‖ := by linarith
      have hxR₁ : R₁ < ‖x‖ := by linarith
      have hb := hub x hxR₂
      have hL := (hRC x hxR₀).2
      have hGb : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G x i j| ≤ 2 := by
        have hxc : x ∈ (closedBall (0 : E3) R₁)ᶜ := by
          rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, mem_closedBall_zero_iff]; linarith
        exact hR₁ hxc
      have hD48 := hdet48 (G x) hGb
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (G x).det := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      have hs7 : Real.sqrt (G x).det ≤ 7 := Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨by norm_num, by linarith⟩
      show ‖-8 * u x * lapLocal G u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det‖ ≤ 56 * a * C * ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ)
      rw [hlapfar x hxR₂]
      have hcoef : 0 ≤ 8 * a * u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ha) (by linarith)) hs0
      have e : ‖-8 * u x * (-a * lapLocal G (farPot δ) x) * Real.sqrt (G x).det‖ =
          8 * a * u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det * |lapLocal G (farPot δ) x| := by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, show -8 * u x * (-a * lapLocal G (farPot δ) x) * Real.sqrt (G x).det
          = (8 * a * u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det) * lapLocal G (farPot δ) x by ring, abs_mul,
          abs_of_nonneg hcoef]
      rw [e]
      have hus : u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det ≤ 7 := by nlinarith
      have h1 : 8 * a * u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det ≤ 56 * a := by
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hus ha]
      calc 8 * a * u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det * |lapLocal G (farPot δ) x|
          ≤ 56 * a * |lapLocal G (farPot δ) x| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ 56 * a * (C * ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ha)
        _ = 56 * a * C * ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ) := by ring
  have hh₁ : IntegrableOn (fun x => -8 * u x * lapLocal G u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det)
      {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} := by
    refine (hh₁A.union hh₁B).mono_set (fun x hx => ?_)
    have hx2 : (2 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := hx
    by_cases h : ‖x‖ ≤ R₃
    · exact Or.inl ⟨mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 h, show (2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ by linarith⟩
    · exact Or.inr (show R₃ < ‖x‖ from lt_of_not_ge h)
  have hsum : IntegrableOn (fun x => -8 * u x * lapLocal G u x * Real.sqrt (G x).det +
      u x ^ 2 * (scalarCurvatureLocal G x * Real.sqrt (G x).det)) {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} :=
    Integrable.add hh₁ hh₂
  refine hsum.congr_fun (fun x hx => ?_) hSm
  have hx2 : (2 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := hx
  exact (hpt x (by linarith)).symm

subgoal_signatures.name: conformal_scalarCurvatureLocal
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ)
    (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i)
    (hdet : ∀ x ∈ U, (G x).det ≠ 0) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (hupos : ∀ x ∈ U, 0 < u x)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    scalarCurvatureLocal (fun x => (u x ^ 4) • G x) y =
      (u y ^ 5)⁻¹ * (-8 * lapLocal G u y + scalarCurvatureLocal G y * u y)

subgoal_signatures.name: farPot_lap_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδq : δ < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i)
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R₀ C : ℝ, 2 ≤ R₀ ∧ ∀ x : E3, R₀ < ‖x‖ →
      δ * (1 + δ) / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ) ≤ lapLocal G (farPot δ) x ∧
      |lapLocal G (farPot δ) x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-3 - δ)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p)
    (p₀ : M) (hp₀ : 0 < g.scalarCurvature p₀) (r : ℝ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    ∃ (f : M → ℝ) (ρ₁ ρ₂ c₀ : ℝ), r < ρ₁ ∧ ρ₁ < ρ₂ ∧ 0 < c₀ ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ p, 0 ≤ f p ∧ f p ≤ 1 / 4) ∧
      (∀ p, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g f p + g.scalarCurvature p) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), ρ₂ < ‖x‖ → f ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), r ≤ ‖x‖ → ‖x‖ ≤ ρ₁ → c₀ ≤ f ((hAF.ends j).Φ x))

signature.name: core_supersolution
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p)
    (p₀ : M) (hp₀ : 0 < g.scalarCurvature p₀) (r : ℝ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) :
    ∃ (f : M → ℝ) (ρ₁ ρ₂ c₀ : ℝ), r < ρ₁ ∧ ρ₁ < ρ₂ ∧ 0 < c₀ ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ p, 0 ≤ f p ∧ f p ≤ 1 / 4) ∧
      (∀ p, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g f p + g.scalarCurvature p) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), ρ₂ < ‖x‖ → f ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), r ≤ ‖x‖ → ‖x‖ ≤ ρ₁ → c₀ ≤ f ((hAF.ends j).Φ x))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have H2 : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ) (α γ : ℝ) (y : E3),
      lapLocal G (fun z => α * u z + γ) y = α * lapLocal G u y := by
    intro G u α γ y
    have hP0 : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (l : Fin 3) (z : E3),
        partialDeriv l (fun z => α * w z) z = α * partialDeriv l w z := by
      intro w l z
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z) z (e l) = α * fderiv ℝ w z (e l)
      have : (fun z => α * w z) = α • w := by funext z; simp
      rw [this, fderiv_const_smul_of_field]; rfl
    have hP : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (γ' : ℝ) (l : Fin 3) (z : E3),
        partialDeriv l (fun z => α * w z + γ') z = α * partialDeriv l w z := by
      intro w γ' l z
      rw [← hP0]
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z + γ') z (e l) = fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z) z (e l)
      rw [fderiv_add_const]
    have h2 : ∀ i l : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l (fun z => α * u z + γ) z) y
        = α * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) y := by
      intro i l
      have : (fun z => partialDeriv l (fun z => α * u z + γ) z) =
          fun z => α * partialDeriv l u z := by
        funext z; exact hP u γ l z
      rw [this, hP0]
    simp only [lapLocal, h2, hP, hP0, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hsrc : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, (hAF.ends j).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
    fun j => (hAF.ends j).source_eq
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : Set M, P = {q | ∃ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g f x + g.scalarCurvature x) ∧
      (∃ K : Set M, IsCompact K ∧ ∀ x, x ∉ K → f x = 0) ∧ 0 < f q} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPopen : IsOpen P := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
    intro q hq
    rw [hP, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hq
    obtain ⟨f, hfs, hf0, hfl, hfK, hfq⟩ := hq
    refine ⟨{x | 0 < f x}, ?_, isOpen_lt continuous_const hfs.continuous, hfq⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [hP, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    exact ⟨f, hfs, hf0, hfl, hfK, hx⟩
  have hPclosed : IsClosed P := by
    apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
    intro p hp
    have key := cs_good_propagate g hR p (fun U hU hpU => by
      obtain ⟨q, hqU, hqP⟩ := mem_closure_iff.1 hp U hU hpU
      rw [hP, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hqP
      exact ⟨q, hqU, hqP⟩)
    rw [hP, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    exact key
  have hP0 : p₀ ∈ P := by
    rw [hP, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    exact cs_bump_at_positive_scalar g hR p₀ hp₀
  have hPuniv : P = Set.univ := IsClopen.eq_univ ⟨hPclosed, hPopen⟩ ⟨p₀, hP0⟩
  have hgood : ∀ q : M, ∃ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g f x + g.scalarCurvature x) ∧
      (∃ K : Set M, IsCompact K ∧ ∀ x, x ∉ K → f x = 0) ∧ 0 < f q := by
    intro q
    have hq : q ∈ P := by rw [hPuniv]; exact Set.mem_univ q
    rw [hP, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hq
    exact hq
  choose fp hfps hfp0 hfpl hfpK hfpq using hgood
  choose Kp hKpc hKp using hfpK
  
  obtain ⟨ρ₁, hρ₁⟩ : ∃ ρ₁ : ℝ, ρ₁ = r + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : Set M,
      A = ⋃ j, (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | r ≤ ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ ρ₁} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAc : IsCompact A := by
    rw [hA]
    apply isCompact_iUnion
    intro j
    have hK : IsCompact {x : E3 | r ≤ ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ ρ₁} := by
      apply (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) ρ₁).of_isClosed_subset
      · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
          (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)
      · intro x hx
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        exact hx.2
    apply hK.image_of_continuousOn
    apply (hAF.ends j).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono
    intro x hx
    rw [hsrc j]
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖
    have := hx.1
    linarith
  
  have hAcov : A ⊆ ⋃ q : M, {x | 0 < fp q x} := fun x _ => Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨x, hfpq x⟩
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀⟩ := hAc.elim_finite_subcover (fun q => {x | 0 < fp q x})
    (fun q => isOpen_lt continuous_const (hfps q).continuous) hAcov
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : Finset M, t = insert p₀ t₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have htne : t.Nonempty := by rw [ht]; exact Finset.insert_nonempty _ _
  have hcard : 0 < (t.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.2 htne
  obtain ⟨favg, hfavg⟩ : ∃ favg : M → ℝ,
      favg = fun y => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, fp i y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfavgs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ favg := by
    rw [hfavg]
    exact contMDiff_const.mul (contMDiff_finset_sum (fun i _ => hfps i))
  have hfavg0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ favg y := by
    intro y
    rw [hfavg]
    exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hcard.le) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => hfp0 i y)
  have hfavgl : ∀ x, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g favg x + g.scalarCurvature x := by
    intro x
    rw [hfavg]
    exact cs_average_supersolution g t htne fp (fun i _ => hfps i) (fun i _ => hfpl i) x
  obtain ⟨Kt, hKt⟩ : ∃ Kt : Set M, Kt = ⋃ i ∈ t, Kp i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKtc : IsCompact Kt := by
    rw [hKt]
    exact t.isCompact_biUnion (fun i _ => hKpc i)
  have hfavgK : ∀ y, y ∉ Kt → favg y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : ∀ i ∈ t, y ∉ Kp i := fun i hi hyi =>
      hy (by rw [hKt]; exact Set.mem_biUnion hi hyi)
    rw [hfavg]
    show ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, fp i y = 0
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i hi => hKp i y (hy' i hi)), mul_zero]
  have hfavgpos : ∀ y ∈ A, 0 < favg y := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hpos⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (ht₀ hy)
    rw [hfavg]
    show 0 < ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, fp i y
    refine mul_pos (inv_pos.2 hcard) (Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ => hfp0 i y) ⟨i, ?_, hpos⟩)
    rw [ht]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi
  
  have hfavgc : Continuous favg := hfavgs.continuous
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀, hm₀A⟩ : ∃ m₀ : ℝ, 0 < m₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ A, m₀ ≤ favg y := by
    rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hAe | hAne
    · refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun y hy => ?_⟩
      rw [hAe] at hy
      simp at hy
    · obtain ⟨x, hxA, hxmin⟩ := hAc.exists_isMinOn hAne hfavgc.continuousOn
      exact ⟨favg x, hfavgpos x hxA, fun y hy => isMinOn_iff.1 hxmin y hy⟩
  
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hfavgc.bounded_above_of_compact_support (HasCompactSupport.intro hKtc hfavgK)
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ : ∃ lam : ℝ, lam = 1 / (4 * (|C₁| + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlam0 : 0 < lam := by rw [hlam]; positivity
  have hlamC : lam * (|C₁| + 1) = 1 / 4 := by
    rw [hlam]
    have : (0 : ℝ) < |C₁| + 1 := by positivity
    field_simp
  have hlam1 : lam ≤ 1 := by
    have := abs_nonneg C₁
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : M → ℝ, f = fun y => lam * favg y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f := by
    rw [hf]
    exact contMDiff_const.mul hfavgs
  have hfb : ∀ p, 0 ≤ f p ∧ f p ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    intro p
    rw [hf]
    show 0 ≤ lam * favg p ∧ lam * favg p ≤ 1 / 4
    have h1 := hfavg0 p
    have h2 : favg p ≤ |C₁| := by
      have := hC₁ p
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) (le_trans this (le_abs_self _))
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg hlam0.le h1, ?_⟩
    nlinarith
  have hlapf : ∀ p, lapM g f p = lam * lapM g favg p := by
    intro p
    have e1 : f ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm = fun z => lam * (favg ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) z + 0 := by
      funext z
      rw [hf]
      simp
    show lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (f ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p p) =
      lam * lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (favg ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p p)
    rw [e1, H2]
  have hfsup : ∀ p, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g f p + g.scalarCurvature p := by
    intro p
    rw [hlapf p]
    have h1 := hfavgl p
    have h2 := hR p
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hlam0.le h1, mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hlam1) h2]
  
  have hfar : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 2 ≤ ρ ∧
      ∀ x : E3, ρ < ‖x‖ → (hAF.ends j).Φ x ∉ Kt := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀2, hρ₀c⟩ := endChart_far_isClosed g hAF j
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : ℕ → Set M,
        C = fun n : ℕ => (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ₀ + (n : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCmem : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M), p ∈ C n ↔
        ∃ x : E3, ρ₀ + (n : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ ∧ (hAF.ends j).Φ x = p := by
      intro n p; rw [hC]; exact Iff.rfl
    have hCc : ∀ n : ℕ, IsClosed (C n) := by
      intro n
      rw [hC]
      exact hρ₀c _ (by have := n.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ); linarith)
    have hmono : Monotone (fun n : ℕ => (C n)ᶜ) := by
      intro n m hnm
      apply Set.compl_subset_compl.2
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxp⟩ := (hCmem m p).1 hp
      refine (hCmem n p).2 ⟨x, ?_, hxp⟩
      have : (n : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_le.2 hnm
      linarith
    have hcov : Kt ⊆ ⋃ n : ℕ, (C n)ᶜ := by
      intro p _
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
      by_cases hpt : p ∈ C 0
      · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hx₀p⟩ := (hCmem 0 p).1 hpt
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt ‖x₀‖
        refine ⟨n, fun hpn => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨x, hx, hxp⟩ := (hCmem n p).1 hpn
        have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := n.cast_nonneg
        have hx₀' : ρ₀ ≤ ‖x₀‖ := by simpa using hx₀
        have hx1 : x ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
          rw [hsrc j]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖; linarith
        have hx01 : x₀ ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
          rw [hsrc j]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x₀‖; linarith
        have e1 : (hAF.ends j).Φ.symm ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) = x :=
          (hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hx1
        have e2 : (hAF.ends j).Φ.symm ((hAF.ends j).Φ x₀) = x₀ :=
          (hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hx01
        have hxx : x = x₀ := by
          calc x = (hAF.ends j).Φ.symm ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) := e1.symm
            _ = (hAF.ends j).Φ.symm ((hAF.ends j).Φ x₀) := by rw [hxp, hx₀p]
            _ = x₀ := e2
        rw [hxx] at hx
        linarith
      · exact ⟨0, hpt⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hKtc.elim_directed_cover (fun n => (C n)ᶜ)
      (fun n => (hCc n).isOpen_compl) hcov hmono.directed_le
    refine ⟨ρ₀ + n, by have := n.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ); linarith, fun x hx hxK => ?_⟩
    exact hn hxK ((hCmem n _).2 ⟨x, hx.le, rfl⟩)
  choose ρj hρj2 hρj using hfar
  obtain ⟨ρ₂, hρ₂⟩ : ∃ ρ₂ : ℝ, ρ₂ = ρ₁ + 1 + ∑ j, |ρj j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, |ρj j| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hρjle : ∀ j, ρj j ≤ ρ₂ := by
    intro j
    have h1 : |ρj j| ≤ ∑ i, |ρj i| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |ρj i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have h2 := le_abs_self (ρj j)
    have h3 : 0 ≤ ρ₁ := by rw [hρ₁]; linarith
    rw [hρ₂]
    linarith
  refine ⟨f, ρ₁, ρ₂, lam * m₀, by rw [hρ₁]; linarith, by rw [hρ₂]; linarith,
    mul_pos hlam0 hm₀, hfs, hfb, hfsup, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j x hx
    have hxK : (hAF.ends j).Φ x ∉ Kt := hρj j x (by linarith [hρjle j])
    rw [hf]
    show lam * favg ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) = 0
    rw [hfavgK _ hxK, mul_zero]
  · intro j x hx1 hx2
    have hxA : (hAF.ends j).Φ x ∈ A := by
      rw [hA]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, x, ⟨hx1, hx2⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [hf]
    show lam * m₀ ≤ lam * favg ((hAF.ends j).Φ x)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hm₀A _ hxA) hlam0.le

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ → ℝ, σ = fun t => Real.smoothTransition ((t + 1) / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ σ := by
    rw [hσ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (by fun_prop)
  have hσc : Continuous σ := hσd.continuous
  have hσmono : Monotone σ := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [hσ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.monotone (by linarith)
  have hσ'nn : ∀ u, 0 ≤ deriv σ u := fun u => hσmono.deriv_nonneg
  have hσ01 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ σ u ∧ σ u ≤ 1 := by
    intro u; rw [hσ]
    exact ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
  have hsm : ∀ u, HasDerivAt smax1 (σ u) u := by
    intro u
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hσc.intervalIntegrable (-1) u)
      (hσc.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) hσc.continuousAt
    have e1 : smax1 = fun u => ∫ t in (-1 : ℝ)..u, σ t := by
      funext v; rw [hσ]; rfl
    rw [e1]; exact h
  
  have hD : ∀ z ∈ U, HasFDerivAt f₁ (fderiv ℝ f₁ z) z ∧ HasFDerivAt f₂ (fderiv ℝ f₂ z) z := by
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨((hf₁.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt,
      ((hf₂.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt⟩
  have hw : ∀ z ∈ U, HasFDerivAt (fun x => (f₂ x - f₁ x) / ε)
      (ε⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ f₂ z - fderiv ℝ f₁ z)) z := by
    intro z hz
    have := ((hD z hz).2.sub (hD z hz).1).const_mul ε⁻¹
    convert this using 1
    funext x; rw [div_eq_inv_mul]; rfl
  
  have hfirst : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv j (fun x => f₁ x + ε * smax1 ((f₂ x - f₁ x) / ε)) z =
        partialDeriv j f₁ z + σ ((f₂ z - f₁ z) / ε) * (partialDeriv j f₂ z - partialDeriv j f₁ z) := by
    intro z hz j
    have dc := (hsm ((f₂ z - f₁ z) / ε)).comp_hasFDerivAt z (hw z hz)
    have dh : HasFDerivAt (fun x => f₁ x + ε * smax1 ((f₂ x - f₁ x) / ε))
        (fderiv ℝ f₁ z + ε • (σ ((f₂ z - f₁ z) / ε) •
          (ε⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ f₂ z - fderiv ℝ f₁ z)))) z :=
      (hD z hz).1.add (dc.const_mul ε)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [dh.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  
  have hP : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      HasFDerivAt (fun z => partialDeriv j f z) (fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv j f z) y) y := by
    intro f hf j
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) y :=
      (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).fderiv_right (m := 1) (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y := h1.differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    exact (h2.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e j))).hasFDerivAt
  have hsecond : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j
        (fun x => f₁ x + ε * smax1 ((f₂ x - f₁ x) / ε)) z) y =
        (1 - σ ((f₂ y - f₁ y) / ε)) * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j f₁ z) y +
          σ ((f₂ y - f₁ y) / ε) * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j f₂ z) y +
          deriv σ ((f₂ y - f₁ y) / ε) / ε *
            (partialDeriv i f₂ y - partialDeriv i f₁ y) * (partialDeriv j f₂ y - partialDeriv j f₁ y) := by
    intro i j
    have hev : (fun z => partialDeriv j (fun x => f₁ x + ε * smax1 ((f₂ x - f₁ x) / ε)) z)
        =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => partialDeriv j f₁ z + σ ((f₂ z - f₁ z) / ε) *
          (partialDeriv j f₂ z - partialDeriv j f₁ z)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hfirst z hz j)
    have dσ : HasDerivAt σ (deriv σ ((f₂ y - f₁ y) / ε)) ((f₂ y - f₁ y) / ε) :=
      ((hσd.differentiable (by simp)) _).hasDerivAt
    have dσw := dσ.comp_hasFDerivAt y (hw y hy)
    have dB : HasFDerivAt (fun z => partialDeriv j f₁ z + σ ((f₂ z - f₁ z) / ε) *
          (partialDeriv j f₂ z - partialDeriv j f₁ z))
        (fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv j f₁ z) y +
          (σ ((f₂ y - f₁ y) / ε) • (fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv j f₂ z) y -
              fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv j f₁ z) y) +
            (partialDeriv j f₂ y - partialDeriv j f₁ y) •
              (deriv σ ((f₂ y - f₁ y) / ε) • (ε⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ f₂ y - fderiv ℝ f₁ y))))) y :=
      (hP f₁ hf₁ j).add (dσw.mul ((hP f₂ hf₂ j).sub (hP f₁ hf₁ j)))
    have : partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j
        (fun x => f₁ x + ε * smax1 ((f₂ x - f₁ x) / ε)) z) y =
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv j f₁ z + σ ((f₂ z - f₁ z) / ε) *
          (partialDeriv j f₂ z - partialDeriv j f₁ z)) y (e i) := by
      show fderiv ℝ _ y (e i) = _
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    rw [this, dB.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have alg : ∀ (u : E3 → ℝ) (s c : ℝ),
      (∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k u y = (1 - s) * partialDeriv k f₁ y + s * partialDeriv k f₂ y) →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j u z) y =
        (1 - s) * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j f₁ z) y +
          s * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j f₂ z) y +
          c * (partialDeriv i f₂ y - partialDeriv i f₁ y) * (partialDeriv j f₂ y - partialDeriv j f₁ y)) →
      lapLocal G u y = (1 - s) * lapLocal G f₁ y + s * lapLocal G f₂ y +
        c * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j *
          (partialDeriv i f₂ y - partialDeriv i f₁ y) * (partialDeriv j f₂ y - partialDeriv j f₁ y) := by
    intro u s c h1 h2
    have e1 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j *
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j u z) y -
          ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k u y) =
        (1 - s) * ((G y)⁻¹ i j * (partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j f₁ z) y -
          ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k f₁ y)) +
        s * ((G y)⁻¹ i j * (partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j f₂ z) y -
          ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k f₂ y)) +
        c * ((G y)⁻¹ i j * (partialDeriv i f₂ y - partialDeriv i f₁ y) *
          (partialDeriv j f₂ y - partialDeriv j f₁ y)) := by
      intro i j
      rw [h2 i j]
      simp only [h1, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    unfold lapLocal
    simp only [e1, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  set s := σ ((f₂ y - f₁ y) / ε) with hs
  refine ⟨s, (hσ01 _).1, (hσ01 _).2, ?_⟩
  have key := alg (fun x => f₁ x + ε * smax1 ((f₂ x - f₁ x) / ε)) s
    (deriv σ ((f₂ y - f₁ y) / ε) / ε)
    (fun k => by rw [hfirst y hy k]; ring) hsecond
  rw [key]
  have hQ := hpsd (fun i => partialDeriv i f₂ y - partialDeriv i f₁ y)
  have hc : 0 ≤ deriv σ ((f₂ y - f₁ y) / ε) / ε := div_nonneg (hσ'nn _) hε.le
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hc hQ]
