    (∀ u, deriv smax1 u = Real.smoothTransition ((u + 1) / 2)) ∧
    (∀ u, 0 ≤ deriv (deriv smax1) u) ∧ (∀ u, u ≤ -1 → smax1 u = 0) ∧
    (∀ u, 1 ≤ u → smax1 u = u) ∧ (∀ u, max u 0 ≤ smax1 u) ∧ (∀ u, smax1 u ≤ max u 0 + 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ → ℝ, σ = fun t => Real.smoothTransition ((t + 1) / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ σ := by
    rw [hσ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (by fun_prop)
  have hσc : Continuous σ := hσd.continuous
  have hσmono : Monotone σ := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [hσ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.monotone (by linarith)
  have hσ01 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ σ u ∧ σ u ≤ 1 := by
    intro u; rw [hσ]
    exact ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
  have hσ0 : ∀ t, t ≤ -1 → σ t = 0 := by
    intro t ht; rw [hσ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  have hσ1 : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → σ t = 1 := by
    intro t ht; rw [hσ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
  
  have hS : ∀ x : ℝ, Real.smoothTransition x + Real.smoothTransition (1 - x) = 1 := by
    intro x
    have h1 := Real.smoothTransition.pos_denom x
    unfold Real.smoothTransition
    rw [sub_sub_cancel, add_comm (expNegInvGlue (1 - x)) (expNegInvGlue x), div_add_div_same,
      div_self h1.ne']
  have hσs : ∀ t, σ t + σ (-t) = 1 := by
    intro t
    have h := hS ((t + 1) / 2)
    have e : 1 - (t + 1) / 2 = (-t + 1) / 2 := by ring
    rw [e] at h
    rw [hσ]
    exact h
  
  have e1 : smax1 = fun u => ∫ t in (-1 : ℝ)..u, σ t := by
    funext v; rw [hσ]; rfl
  have hD : ∀ u, HasDerivAt smax1 (σ u) u := by
    intro u
    rw [e1]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hσc.intervalIntegrable (-1) u)
      (hσc.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) hσc.continuousAt
  have hderiv : deriv smax1 = σ := funext fun u => (hD u).deriv
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ smax1 := fun u => (hD u).differentiableAt
  have P1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ smax1 := contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mpr ⟨hdiff, hderiv ▸ hσd⟩
  have P4 : ∀ u, u ≤ -1 → smax1 u = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    rw [e1]
    show ∫ t in (-1 : ℝ)..u, σ t = 0
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) ?_]
    · exact intervalIntegral.integral_zero
    · intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge hu] at ht
      exact hσ0 t ht.2
  have hI : ∫ t in (-1 : ℝ)..1, σ t = 1 := by
    have h1 : ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, σ (-x) = ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, σ x := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg]
      norm_num
    have h2 : ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (σ x + σ (-x)) =
        (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, σ x) + ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, σ (-x) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_add (hσc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((hσc.comp continuous_neg : Continuous fun x => σ (-x)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    have h3 : ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (σ x + σ (-x)) = 2 := by
      simp only [hσs]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
      norm_num
    linarith
  have P5 : ∀ u, 1 ≤ u → smax1 u = u := by
    intro u hu
    rw [e1]
    show ∫ t in (-1 : ℝ)..u, σ t = u
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (b := 1)
      (hσc.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hσc.intervalIntegrable _ _), hI]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ?_]
    · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    · intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hu] at ht
      exact hσ1 t ht.1
  have hmono : Monotone smax1 :=
    monotone_of_deriv_nonneg hdiff (fun u => by rw [hderiv]; exact (hσ01 u).1)
  have hDh : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun v => smax1 v - v) (σ u - 1) u :=
    fun u => (hD u).sub (hasDerivAt_id' u)
  have hanti : Antitone (fun v => smax1 v - v) :=
    antitone_of_deriv_nonpos (fun u => (hDh u).differentiableAt)
      (fun u => by rw [(hDh u).deriv]; linarith [(hσ01 u).2])
  have P6 : ∀ u, max u 0 ≤ smax1 u := by
    intro u
    apply max_le
    · have h := hanti (le_max_left u 1)
      simp only at h
      rw [P5 _ (le_max_right u 1)] at h
      linarith
    · have h := hmono (min_le_left u (-1))
      rw [P4 _ (min_le_right u (-1))] at h
      exact h
  have P7 : ∀ u, smax1 u ≤ max u 0 + 1 := by
    intro u
    have h := hmono (le_max_left u 1)
    rw [P5 _ (le_max_right u 1)] at h
    have h0 := le_max_left u 0
    have h1 := le_max_right u 0
    have h2 : max u 1 ≤ max u 0 + 1 := max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
    linarith
  refine ⟨P1, fun u => by rw [hderiv, hσ], fun u => ?_, P4, P5, P6, P7⟩
  rw [hderiv]
  exact hσmono.deriv_nonneg

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ φ.source) :
    (g.coeff φ y).PosDef

signature.name: coeff_posDef
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ φ.source) :
    (g.coeff φ y).PosDef

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hn : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hloc := PartialDiffeomorph.isLocalDiffeomorphAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ φ hy
  have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    have hL : ∀ u : E3, (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv hn) u =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y u := by
      intro u
      rw [← hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv_coe hn]
      rfl
    apply (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv hn).injective
    rw [hL, hw, map_zero]
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
  · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
    intro i j
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
    exact g.symm _ _ _
  · intro x hx
    have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hx
      funext j
      have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
      fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
    have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
    have hpos := g.posDef (φ y) _ hDv
    have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff φ y).mulVec x =
        g.g (φ y)
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
        RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
      ring
    rw [key]
    exact hpos

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

signature.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
  have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy
  have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
  have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).comp
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
  have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
    apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
    filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
    exact hz
  rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
  have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w) = w := by
    intro w
    have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
    simpa using h1
  have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
  · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
    intro i j
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
    exact g.symm _ _ _
  · intro x hx
    have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hx
      funext j
      have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
      fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
    have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
    have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ hDv
    have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).mulVec x =
        g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
        RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
      ring
    rw [key]
    exact hpos

informal_problem.statement:
(E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (m n : Fin 3 → ℝ) (ε ν : ℝ) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 6)
    (hE : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |E i j| ≤ ε) (hn : ∀ i : Fin 3, |n i| ≤ ν)
    (heq : ∀ i : Fin 3, m i + ∑ j : Fin 3, E i j * m j = n i) :
    ∀ i : Fin 3, |m i| ≤ 2 * ν ∧ |m i - n i| ≤ 6 * ε * ν

signature.name: lin3_solve_bound
signature.statement:
(E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (m n : Fin 3 → ℝ) (ε ν : ℝ) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 6)
    (hE : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |E i j| ≤ ε) (hn : ∀ i : Fin 3, |n i| ≤ ν)
    (heq : ∀ i : Fin 3, m i + ∑ j : Fin 3, E i j * m j = n i) :
    ∀ i : Fin 3, |m i| ≤ 2 * ν ∧ |m i - n i| ≤ 6 * ε * ν

proof.tactics:
by
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hE 0 0)
  have hν0 : 0 ≤ ν := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hn 0)
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ |m 0| + |m 1| + |m 2| := by
    have := abs_nonneg (m 0); have := abs_nonneg (m 1); have := abs_nonneg (m 2); linarith
  have hterm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |E i j * m j| ≤ ε * |m j| := by
    intro i j
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hE i j) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hdiff : ∀ i : Fin 3, |m i - n i| ≤ ε * (|m 0| + |m 1| + |m 2|) := by
    intro i
    have h := heq i
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h
    have e0 := abs_le.mp (hterm i 0)
    have e1 := abs_le.mp (hterm i 1)
    have e2 := abs_le.mp (hterm i 2)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [e0.1, e0.2, e1.1, e1.2, e2.1, e2.2]
  have hmi : ∀ i : Fin 3, |m i| ≤ ν + ε * (|m 0| + |m 1| + |m 2|) := by
    intro i
    have h1 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (m i) (n i)
    have h2 := hn i
    have h3 := hdiff i
    linarith
  have hS : |m 0| + |m 1| + |m 2| ≤ 6 * ν := by
    have a0 := hmi 0
    have a1 := hmi 1
    have a2 := hmi 2
    have hp : ε * (|m 0| + |m 1| + |m 2|) ≤ 1 / 6 * (|m 0| + |m 1| + |m 2|) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hε hS0
    linarith
  have hp1 : ε * (|m 0| + |m 1| + |m 2|) ≤ ε * (6 * ν) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS hε0
  have hp2 : (6 * ε) * ν ≤ 1 * ν :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hν0
  intro i
  have h1 := hdiff i
  have h2 := hmi i
  constructor
  · linarith
  · linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(B M g dg : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (φ η μ ν : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i a : Fin 3, |B i a| ≤ 2)
    (hBφ : ∀ i a : Fin 3, |B i a - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ φ)
    (hg : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |g i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η) (hη : η ≤ 1)
    (hM : ∀ i a : Fin 3, |M i a| ≤ μ) (hdg : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |dg i j| ≤ ν) (a b : Fin 3) :
    |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B i a * g i j * B j b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)|
        ≤ 7 * φ + 36 * η ∧
    |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (M i a * g i j * B j b + B i a * dg i j * B j b + B i a * g i j * M j b)|
        ≤ 72 * μ + 36 * ν

signature.name: pullback_entry_algebra
signature.statement:
(B M g dg : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (φ η μ ν : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ i a : Fin 3, |B i a| ≤ 2)
    (hBφ : ∀ i a : Fin 3, |B i a - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ φ)
    (hg : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |g i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η) (hη : η ≤ 1)
    (hM : ∀ i a : Fin 3, |M i a| ≤ μ) (hdg : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |dg i j| ≤ ν) (a b : Fin 3) :
    |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B i a * g i j * B j b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)|
        ≤ 7 * φ + 36 * η ∧
    |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (M i a * g i j * B j b + B i a * dg i j * B j b + B i a * g i j * M j b)|
        ≤ 72 * μ + 36 * ν

proof.tactics:
by
  have sum3 : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ i, |f i| ≤ c) → |∑ i, f i| ≤ 3 * c := by
    intro f c hf
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have h0 := abs_le.mp (hf 0)
    have h1 := abs_le.mp (hf 1)
    have h2 := abs_le.mp (hf 2)
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have sum9 : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ i j, |f i j| ≤ c) →
      |∑ i, ∑ j, f i j| ≤ 9 * c := by
    intro f c hf
    have h := sum3 (fun i => ∑ j, f i j) (3 * c) (fun i => sum3 (f i) c (hf i))
    linarith
  have mul2 : ∀ (x y X Y : ℝ), |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |x * y| ≤ X * Y := by
    intro x y X Y hx hy
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hx)
  have mul3 : ∀ (x y z X Y Z : ℝ), |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |z| ≤ Z → |x * y * z| ≤ X * Y * Z :=
    fun x y z X Y Z hx hy hz => mul2 _ _ _ _ (mul2 _ _ _ _ hx hy) hz
  have hg2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |g i j| ≤ 2 := by
    intro i j
    have h := abs_le.mp (hg i j)
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      rw [if_pos rfl] at h
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · rw [if_neg hij] at h
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have s4 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B i a * g i j * B j b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B i a * (g i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * B j b
        + ∑ i : Fin 3, B i a * (B i b - (if i = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
        + (B b a - (if b = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
  constructor
  · rw [s4]
    have T1 := sum9 (fun i j => B i a * (g i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * B j b)
      (2 * η * 2) (fun i j => mul3 _ _ _ _ _ _ (hB i a) (hg i j) (hB j b))
    have T2 := sum3 (fun i => B i a * (B i b - (if i = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)))
      (2 * φ) (fun i => mul2 _ _ _ _ (hB i a) (hBφ i b))
    have T3 := hBφ b a
    have e1 := abs_le.mp T1
    have e2 := abs_le.mp T2
    have e3 := abs_le.mp T3
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · have h := sum9 (fun i j =>
        M i a * g i j * B j b + B i a * dg i j * B j b + B i a * g i j * M j b)
      (μ * 2 * 2 + 2 * ν * 2 + 2 * 2 * μ) (by
        intro i j
        have u1 := abs_le.mp (mul3 _ _ _ _ _ _ (hM i a) (hg2 i j) (hB j b))
        have u2 := abs_le.mp (mul3 _ _ _ _ _ _ (hB i a) (hdg i j) (hB j b))
        have u3 := abs_le.mp (mul3 _ _ _ _ _ _ (hB i a) (hg2 i j) (hM j b))
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C) (x : E3) (hx : R₁ < ‖x‖) :
    R₀ < ‖Y x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ (1 + C) * ‖Y x‖ ∧ ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ (1 + C) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ≤ (1 + C) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)

signature.name: coordChange_norm_compare
signature.statement:
(X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C) (x : E3) (hx : R₁ < ‖x‖) :
    R₀ < ‖Y x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ (1 + C) * ‖Y x‖ ∧ ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ (1 + C) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ≤ (1 + C) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hR0, hR01, hC, -, -, hinv, -, hbd⟩ := hXY
  obtain ⟨hs0, hXYx⟩ := hinv x hx
  obtain ⟨hdisp, -, -⟩ := hbd (Y x) hs0
  rw [hXYx] at hdisp
  have hs1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖Y x‖ := by linarith
  have hrpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
  have hκ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + C := by linarith
  have hκpos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + C := by linarith
  have hpow : ‖Y x‖ ^ (1 - q) ≤ ‖Y x‖ := by
    have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hs1 (by linarith : 1 - q ≤ 1)
    rwa [Real.rpow_one] at h
  have htri : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖Y x‖ + ‖x - Y x‖ := norm_le_insert' x (Y x)
  have hB : ‖x‖ ≤ (1 + C) * ‖Y x‖ := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hC.le
    linarith
  have hbase : ‖x‖ / (1 + C) ≤ ‖Y x‖ := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hκpos]; linarith
  have hbpos : 0 < ‖x‖ / (1 + C) := div_pos hrpos hκpos
  have key : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → ‖Y x‖ ^ (-a) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-a) * (1 + C) ^ a := by
    intro a ha
    have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hbpos hbase (by linarith : -a ≤ 0)
    rw [Real.div_rpow hrpos.le hκpos.le, Real.rpow_neg hκpos.le a, div_inv_eq_mul] at h1
    exact h1
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_nonneg hrpos.le _
  have hr1 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg hrpos.le _
  refine ⟨hs0, hB, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := key q hq0.le
    have h2 : (1 + C) ^ q ≤ 1 + C := by
      have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hκ1 hq1.le
      rwa [Real.rpow_one] at h
    calc ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q) * (1 + C) ^ q := h1
      _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q) * (1 + C) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hr0
      _ = (1 + C) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) := mul_comm _ _
  · have h1 := key (q + 1) (by linarith)
    have he : -(q + 1) = -q - 1 := by ring
    rw [he] at h1
    have h2 : (1 + C) ^ (q + 1) ≤ (1 + C) ^ (2 : ℕ) := by
      have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hκ1 (by linarith : q + 1 ≤ 2)
      rwa [Real.rpow_two] at h
    calc ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) * (1 + C) ^ (q + 1) := h1
      _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) * (1 + C) ^ (2 : ℕ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hr1
      _ = (1 + C) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) := mul_comm _ _

informal_problem.statement:
(X Y : E3 → E3) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hinv : ∀ z ∈ U, X (Y z) = z) (hY : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ Y z)
    (hX : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ X (Y z)) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hA : ∀ d i : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x))
    (hB : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) :
    (∀ d a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y x) * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i
        = if d = a then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ c d a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3,
        ((∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k *
            partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) z) (Y x)) *
            (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i
          + partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y x) *
            partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) = 0)

signature.name: inverse_jacobian_identities
signature.statement:
(X Y : E3 → E3) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hinv : ∀ z ∈ U, X (Y z) = z) (hY : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ Y z)
    (hX : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ X (Y z)) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hA : ∀ d i : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x))
    (hB : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) :
    (∀ d a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y x) * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i
        = if d = a then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ c d a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3,
        ((∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k *
            partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) z) (Y x)) *
            (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i
          + partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y x) *
            partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (y v : E3),
      fderiv ℝ f y v = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k * partialDeriv k f y := by
    intro f y v
    have hv : v = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k • e k := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  
  have s2 : ∀ (y v : E3) (d : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ X y →
      (fderiv ℝ X y v) d = fderiv ℝ (fun w => X w d) y v := by
    intro y v d hXy
    have h : HasFDerivAt (fun w => X w d)
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ X y)) y :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp y hXy.hasFDerivAt
    rw [h.fderiv]
    rfl
  
  have s3 : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ X (Y z) (fderiv ℝ Y z v) = v := by
    intro z hz v
    have heq : X ∘ Y =ᶠ[𝓝 z] id :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hz) (fun w hw => hinv w hw)
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ (X ∘ Y) z = (fderiv ℝ X (Y z)).comp (fderiv ℝ Y z) :=
      fderiv_comp z (hX z hz) (hY z hz)
    have h2 : fderiv ℝ (X ∘ Y) z = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 := by
      rw [heq.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id]
    have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => L v) (h1.symm.trans h2)
    simpa using h3
  
  have s5 : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ d a : Fin 3,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y z) * (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i
        = if d = a then 1 else 0 := by
    intro z hz d a
    have h : (fderiv ℝ X (Y z) (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a))) d = (e a) d := by
      rw [s3 z hz (e a)]
    rw [s2 _ _ _ (hX z hz), s1 (fun w => X w d) (Y z)] at h
    have hr : (e a) d = if d = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [← hr, ← h]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => mul_comm _ _)
  refine ⟨fun d a => s5 x hx d a, ?_⟩
  intro c d a
  have hconst : (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y z) * (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i)
      =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (if d = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) (fun z hz => s5 z hz d a)
  have hderiv : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y z) * (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i)
      (∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y x) •
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x
        + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i •
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ Y x))) x := by
    apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
    intro i _
    have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun z => partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y z))
        ((fderiv ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x)).comp
          (fderiv ℝ Y x)) x :=
      (hA d i).hasFDerivAt.comp x (hY x hx).hasFDerivAt
    exact hc.mul (hB a i).hasFDerivAt
  have key : (∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y x) •
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x
        + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i •
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ Y x))) (e c) = 0 := by
    rw [← hderiv.fderiv, hconst.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  rw [← key, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
    s1 (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x) (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c))]
  have hp : partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x
      = fderiv ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x (e c) := rfl
  rw [hp]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3) (x : E3)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x)
    (hB : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)) (a b c : Fin 3) :
    partialDeriv c (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b) x =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x * G (Y x) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j
          + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i *
              (∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k * partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)) *
              (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j
          + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * G (Y x) i j *
              partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j) x)

signature.name: pullbackMetric_partialDeriv
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3) (x : E3)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x)
    (hB : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)) (a b c : Fin 3) :
    partialDeriv c (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b) x =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x * G (Y x) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j
          + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i *
              (∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k * partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)) *
              (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j
          + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * G (Y x) i j *
              partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j) x)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hchain : ∀ i j : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun z => G (Y z) i j) x (e c) =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k * partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x) := by
    intro i j
    have hcomp : fderiv ℝ (fun z => G (Y z) i j) x =
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)).comp (fderiv ℝ Y x) :=
      fderiv_comp x (hG i j) hY
    rw [hcomp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    have hw : fderiv ℝ Y x (e c) = ∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k • e k := by
      ext l
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hw]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  
  have hterm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt
      (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i * G (Y z) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j)
      (((fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * G (Y x) i j) • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j) x
        + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j • ((fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i • fderiv ℝ (fun z => G (Y z) i j) x
          + G (Y x) i j • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x)) x := by
    intro i j
    have hγ : HasFDerivAt (fun z => G (Y z) i j) (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G (Y z) i j) x) x :=
      ((hG i j).comp x hY).hasFDerivAt
    exact ((hB a i).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul hγ).fun_mul (hB b j).hasFDerivAt
  have hS := HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
    (A := fun i z => ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i * G (Y z) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j)
    (fun i _ => HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
      (A := fun j z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i * G (Y z) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j)
      (fun j _ => hterm i j))
  have hD : HasFDerivAt (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b) _ x := hS
  show fderiv ℝ (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b) x (e c) = _
  rw [hD.fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hchain]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
  unfold partialDeriv
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C) :
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullbackMetric G Y x a b) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) ∧
    ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ X (Y x) ∧
      (∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) ∧
      (∀ d i : Fin 3,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x)) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x))

signature.name: coordChange_regularity
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C) :
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullbackMetric G Y x a b) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) ∧
    ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ X (Y x) ∧
      (∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) ∧
      (∀ d i : Fin 3,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x)) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x))

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hR0, hR01, hC, hXs, hYs, hinv, hinj, hbd⟩ := hXY
  have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hV : IsOpen {y : E3 | R₀ < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hW : IsOpen {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hmapsW : Set.MapsTo Y {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := (hinv x hx).1
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖Y x‖
    linarith
  have hne : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hcoord : ∀ (F : E3 → E3) (S : Set E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S →
      ∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => F w d) S := by
    intro F S hF d
    have h := (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hF
    exact h
  have hfd : ∀ (F : E3 → E3) (S : Set E3), IsOpen S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S →
      ∀ a i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ F z (e a)) i) S := by
    intro F S hS hF a i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) S := hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hS le_rfl
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ F z (e a)) S :=
      h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact hcoord _ S h2 i
  have hpd : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (S : Set E3), IsOpen S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f S →
      ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => partialDeriv i f w) S := by
    intro f S hS hf i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) S := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hS le_rfl
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e i)) S :=
      h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact h2
  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · have hB := hfd Y _ hU hYs
    have hGY : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G (Y x) i j) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
      fun i j => (hsmooth i j).comp hYs hmapsW
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * G (Y x) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j) _
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ =>
      ((hB a i).mul (hGY i j)).mul (hB b j)))
  · have hxU : x ∈ {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := hx
    have hyV : Y x ∈ {y : E3 | R₀ < ‖y‖} := (hinv x hx).1
    have hyW : Y x ∈ {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := hmapsW hxU
    refine ⟨(hYs.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hxU)).differentiableAt hne,
      (hXs.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hyV)).differentiableAt hne,
      fun a i => ((hfd Y _ hU hYs a i).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hxU)).differentiableAt hne,
      fun d i => ((hpd _ _ hV (hcoord X _ hXs d) i).contDiffAt
        (hV.mem_nhds hyV)).differentiableAt hne,
      fun i j => ((hsmooth i j).contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hyW)).differentiableAt hne⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε) :
    |A.det - 1| ≤ 4 * ε

signature.name: det3_near_id_bound
signature.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε) :
    |A.det - 1| ≤ 4 * ε

proof.tactics:
by
  have e00 := hA 0 0
  have e11 := hA 1 1
  have e22 := hA 2 2
  have e01 := hA 0 1
  have e02 := hA 0 2
  have e10 := hA 1 0
  have e12 := hA 1 2
  have e20 := hA 2 0
  have e21 := hA 2 1
  rw [if_pos rfl] at e00 e11 e22
  rw [if_neg (by decide), sub_zero] at e01 e02 e10 e12 e20 e21
  have hid : A.det - 1 = ((A 0 0 - 1) + (A 1 1 - 1) + (A 2 2 - 1))
      + ((A 0 0 - 1) * (A 1 1 - 1) + (A 1 1 - 1) * (A 2 2 - 1) + (A 2 2 - 1) * (A 0 0 - 1))
      + (A 0 0 - 1) * (A 1 1 - 1) * (A 2 2 - 1)
      - A 0 0 * (A 1 2 * A 2 1) - A 2 2 * (A 0 1 * A 1 0) - A 1 1 * (A 0 2 * A 2 0)
      + A 0 1 * A 1 2 * A 2 0 + A 0 2 * A 1 0 * A 2 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]; ring
  have m2 : ∀ u v : ℝ, |u| ≤ ε → |v| ≤ ε → |u * v| ≤ ε * ε := fun u v hu hv => by
    rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hu hv (abs_nonneg _) hε0
  have m3 : ∀ u v w : ℝ, |u| ≤ ε → |v| ≤ ε → |w| ≤ ε → |u * v * w| ≤ ε * ε * ε :=
    fun u v w hu hv hw => by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hu hv (abs_nonneg _) hε0) hw (abs_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg hε0 hε0)
  have hd : ∀ t : ℝ, |t - 1| ≤ ε → |t| ≤ 1 + ε := fun t ht => by
    have := abs_le.mp ht
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have mx : ∀ t u v : ℝ, |t - 1| ≤ ε → |u| ≤ ε → |v| ≤ ε → |t * (u * v)| ≤ ε * ε + ε * ε * ε :=
    fun t u v ht hu hv => by
      rw [abs_mul]
      have h1 := mul_le_mul (hd t ht) (m2 u v hu hv) (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
      linarith
  have q1 := abs_le.mp (m2 _ _ e00 e11)
  have q2 := abs_le.mp (m2 _ _ e11 e22)
  have q3 := abs_le.mp (m2 _ _ e22 e00)
  have c1 := abs_le.mp (m3 _ _ _ e00 e11 e22)
  have c2 := abs_le.mp (m3 _ _ _ e01 e12 e20)
  have c3 := abs_le.mp (m3 _ _ _ e02 e10 e21)
  have x1 := abs_le.mp (mx _ _ _ e00 e12 e21)
  have x2 := abs_le.mp (mx _ _ _ e22 e01 e10)
  have x3 := abs_le.mp (mx _ _ _ e11 e02 e20)
  have l1 := abs_le.mp e00
  have l2 := abs_le.mp e11
  have l3 := abs_le.mp e22
  have s2 : ε * ε ≤ ε / 100 := by nlinarith
  have s3 : ε * ε * ε ≤ ε / 10000 := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ε * ε := mul_nonneg hε0 hε0
    have : ε * ε * ε ≤ ε * ε * (1 / 100) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε h0
    linarith
  rw [hid, abs_le]
  constructor
  · linarith [q1.1, q2.1, q3.1, c1.1, c2.1, c3.1, x1.2, x2.2, x3.2, l1.1, l2.1, l3.1]
  · linarith [q1.2, q2.2, q3.2, c1.2, c2.2, c3.2, x1.1, x2.1, x3.1, l1.2, l2.2, l3.2]

informal_problem.statement:

signature.name: gradVec_eq_formula
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)
    (hdet : (G x).det ≠ 0) (hP : 0 < (G x)⁻¹ 0 0) (k : Fin 3) :
    gradVec G x k = Real.sqrt (G x).det * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G x)⁻¹ k l *
      ((-∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G x)⁻¹ 0 a * partialDeriv l (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b 0)
        / (2 * Real.sqrt ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0)))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hinv : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x ∧
      partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x =
        -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l := by
    intro m
    have hdetD : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
        (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => H y a b) x) →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (H y).det) x := by
      intro H hH
      have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
          H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
          - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
          + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
        funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H y)
      rw [hfun]
      have h00 := hH 0 0
      have h01 := hH 0 1
      have h02 := hH 0 2
      have h10 := hH 1 0
      have h11 := hH 1 1
      have h12 := hH 1 2
      have h20 := hH 2 0
      have h21 := hH 2 1
      have h22 := hH 2 2
      fun_prop
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y).det) x := hdetD G hG
    have hPd : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x := by
      intro k l
      have hfun : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) =
          fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det := by
        funext y
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
          smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hfun]
      refine (hD.inv hdet).mul (hdetD _ ?_)
      intro a b
      by_cases hal : a = l
      · subst hal
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact differentiableAt_const _
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hal]
        exact hG a b
    have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (G y).det ≠ 0 := hD.continuousAt.eventually_ne hdet
    have hE : ∀ a l : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G x a b * partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
        + ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l = 0 := by
      intro a l
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (∑ b : Fin 3, (G x a b • fderiv ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
            + (G x)⁻¹ b l • fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)) x := by
        have hs := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
          (A := fun b y => G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (fun b _ => (hG a b).hasFDerivAt.mul (hPd b l).hasFDerivAt)
        convert hs using 1
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
        apply (hasFDerivAt_const (if a = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
        have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G y) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy)) a) l
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
        exact this
      have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e m)) (h1.unique h2)
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h3
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [← h3, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      ring
    intro k l
    refine ⟨hPd k l, ?_⟩
    let X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun b l => partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
    let D : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun a b => partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x
    have hM : G x * X = -(D * (G x)⁻¹) := by
      ext a l'
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
      simp only [X, D, Matrix.of_apply]
      exact hE a l'
    have hX : X = -((G x)⁻¹ * (D * (G x)⁻¹)) := by
      calc X = ((G x)⁻¹ * G x) * X := by
            rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet), Matrix.one_mul]
        _ = (G x)⁻¹ * (G x * X) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [hM, Matrix.mul_neg]
    have hkl := congrFun (congrFun hX k) l
    simp only [X, D, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply] at hkl
    rw [hkl]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring
  
  have key : ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G z)⁻¹ 0 0)) x =
      (-∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G x)⁻¹ 0 a * partialDeriv l (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b 0)
        / (2 * Real.sqrt ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0)) := by
    intro l
    obtain ⟨hf, hfl⟩ := hinv l 0 0
    have h2 := fderiv_sqrt (f := fun y => (G y)⁻¹ 0 0) hf hP.ne'
    rw [← hfl]
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h2, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  unfold gradVec
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by rw [key l])

informal_problem.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (D ε δ : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 100) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hPb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l| ≤ 5)
    (hPe : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 13 * ε)
    (hD : |D - 1| ≤ 4 * ε) (hd : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, |d m a b| ≤ δ) (k : Fin 3) :
    |Real.sqrt D * ∑ l : Fin 3, P k l *
        ((-∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P 0 a * d l a b * P b 0) / (2 * Real.sqrt (P 0 0)))
      + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * d k 0 0| ≤ 20000 * ε * δ

signature.name: gradVec_formula_bound
signature.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (D ε δ : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 100) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hPb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l| ≤ 5)
    (hPe : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 13 * ε)
    (hD : |D - 1| ≤ 4 * ε) (hd : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, |d m a b| ≤ δ) (k : Fin 3) :
    |Real.sqrt D * ∑ l : Fin 3, P k l *
        ((-∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P 0 a * d l a b * P b 0) / (2 * Real.sqrt (P 0 0)))
      + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * d k 0 0| ≤ 20000 * ε * δ

proof.tactics:
by
  have hεδ : 0 ≤ ε * δ := mul_nonneg hε0 hδ
  
  have tri : ∀ x y z X Y Z : ℝ, |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |z| ≤ Z → |x * y * z| ≤ X * Y * Z := by
    intro x y z X Y Z hx hy hz
    have hX : 0 ≤ X := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hx
    have hY : 0 ≤ Y := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hy
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) hX) hz (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hX hY)
  
  have e00 : |P 0 0 - 1| ≤ 13 * ε := by
    have h := hPe 0 0; rwa [if_pos rfl] at h
  have o01 : |P 0 1| ≤ 13 * ε := by
    have h := hPe 0 1; rwa [if_neg (by decide), sub_zero] at h
  have o02 : |P 0 2| ≤ 13 * ε := by
    have h := hPe 0 2; rwa [if_neg (by decide), sub_zero] at h
  have o10 : |P 1 0| ≤ 13 * ε := by
    have h := hPe 1 0; rwa [if_neg (by decide), sub_zero] at h
  have o20 : |P 2 0| ≤ 13 * ε := by
    have h := hPe 2 0; rwa [if_neg (by decide), sub_zero] at h
  
  have quad : ∀ M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, (∀ a b : Fin 3, |M a b| ≤ δ) →
      |(∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P 0 a * M a b * P b 0) - M 0 0| ≤ 702 * ε * δ ∧
      |∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P 0 a * M a b * P b 0| ≤ 225 * δ := by
    intro M hM
    have t00 : |P 0 0 * M 0 0 * P 0 0 - M 0 0| ≤ 78 * ε * δ := by
      have h1 := tri _ _ _ _ _ _ e00 (hM 0 0) (hPb 0 0)
      have h2 : |M 0 0 * (P 0 0 - 1)| ≤ δ * (13 * ε) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hM 0 0) e00 (abs_nonneg _) hδ
      have eq : P 0 0 * M 0 0 * P 0 0 - M 0 0
          = (P 0 0 - 1) * M 0 0 * P 0 0 + M 0 0 * (P 0 0 - 1) := by ring
      rw [eq]
      calc |(P 0 0 - 1) * M 0 0 * P 0 0 + M 0 0 * (P 0 0 - 1)|
          ≤ |(P 0 0 - 1) * M 0 0 * P 0 0| + |M 0 0 * (P 0 0 - 1)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 13 * ε * δ * 5 + δ * (13 * ε) := add_le_add h1 h2
        _ = 78 * ε * δ := by ring
    obtain ⟨a00, b00⟩ := abs_le.mp t00
    obtain ⟨a01, b01⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hPb 0 0) (hM 0 1) o10)
    obtain ⟨a02, b02⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hPb 0 0) (hM 0 2) o20)
    obtain ⟨a10, b10⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ o01 (hM 1 0) (hPb 0 0))
    obtain ⟨a11, b11⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ o01 (hM 1 1) (hPb 1 0))
    obtain ⟨a12, b12⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ o01 (hM 1 2) (hPb 2 0))
    obtain ⟨a20, b20⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ o02 (hM 2 0) (hPb 0 0))
    obtain ⟨a21, b21⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ o02 (hM 2 1) (hPb 1 0))
    obtain ⟨a22, b22⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ o02 (hM 2 2) (hPb 2 0))
    obtain ⟨c00, d00⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hPb 0 0) (hM 0 0) (hPb 0 0))
    obtain ⟨c01, d01⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hPb 0 0) (hM 0 1) (hPb 1 0))
    obtain ⟨c02, d02⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hPb 0 0) (hM 0 2) (hPb 2 0))
    obtain ⟨c10, d10⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hPb 0 1) (hM 1 0) (hPb 0 0))
    obtain ⟨c11, d11⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hPb 0 1) (hM 1 1) (hPb 1 0))
    obtain ⟨c12, d12⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hPb 0 1) (hM 1 2) (hPb 2 0))
    obtain ⟨c20, d20⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hPb 0 2) (hM 2 0) (hPb 0 0))
    obtain ⟨c21, d21⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hPb 0 2) (hM 2 1) (hPb 1 0))
    obtain ⟨c22, d22⟩ := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (hPb 0 2) (hM 2 2) (hPb 2 0))
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    refine ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · linarith
    · linarith
    · linarith
    · linarith
  
  have row : ∀ S : Fin 3 → ℝ, (∀ l, |S l - d l 0 0| ≤ 702 * ε * δ) → (∀ l, |S l| ≤ 225 * δ) →
      |∑ l : Fin 3, P k l * S l - d k 0 0| ≤ 9477 * ε * δ := by
    intro S h1 h2
    have hI : ∑ l : Fin 3, (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * S l = S k := by
      simp
    have eq : ∑ l : Fin 3, P k l * S l - d k 0 0
        = ∑ l : Fin 3, (P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * S l + (S k - d k 0 0) := by
      simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hI]; ring
    rw [eq]
    have hr : ∀ l : Fin 3, |(P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * S l| ≤ 13 * ε * (225 * δ) := by
      intro l
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hPe k l) (h2 l) (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    refine le_trans (abs_add_le _ _) ?_
    have hs1 := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs
      (fun l : Fin 3 => (P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * S l) Finset.univ
    have hs2 : ∑ l : Fin 3, |(P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * S l|
        ≤ ∑ _l : Fin 3, 13 * ε * (225 * δ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l _ => hr l)
    have hs3 : ∑ _l : Fin 3, 13 * ε * (225 * δ) = 3 * (13 * ε * (225 * δ)) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have hk := h1 k
    linarith
  
  have fin : ∀ T : ℝ, |T - d k 0 0| ≤ 9477 * ε * δ →
      |Real.sqrt D * (-T / (2 * Real.sqrt (P 0 0))) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * d k 0 0| ≤ 20000 * ε * δ := by
    intro T hT
    have hu := hd k 0 0
    obtain ⟨hD1, hD2⟩ := abs_le.mp hD
    obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := abs_le.mp e00
    have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := by linarith
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ P 0 0 := by linarith
    have hs0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg D
    have hp0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (P 0 0)
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt D ^ 2 = D := Real.sq_sqrt hD0
    have hp2 : Real.sqrt (P 0 0) ^ 2 = P 0 0 := Real.sq_sqrt hq0
    have hs1 : |Real.sqrt D - 1| ≤ 4 * ε := by
      have e : (Real.sqrt D - 1) * (Real.sqrt D + 1) = D - 1 := by linear_combination hs2
      have e2 : |Real.sqrt D - 1| * (Real.sqrt D + 1) = |D - 1| := by
        rw [← e, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt D + 1)]
      have e3 : |Real.sqrt D - 1| ≤ |Real.sqrt D - 1| * (Real.sqrt D + 1) :=
        le_mul_of_one_le_right (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have hp1 : |Real.sqrt (P 0 0) - 1| ≤ 13 * ε := by
      have e : (Real.sqrt (P 0 0) - 1) * (Real.sqrt (P 0 0) + 1) = P 0 0 - 1 := by
        linear_combination hp2
      have e2 : |Real.sqrt (P 0 0) - 1| * (Real.sqrt (P 0 0) + 1) = |P 0 0 - 1| := by
        rw [← e, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (P 0 0) + 1)]
      have e3 : |Real.sqrt (P 0 0) - 1| ≤ |Real.sqrt (P 0 0) - 1| * (Real.sqrt (P 0 0) + 1) :=
        le_mul_of_one_le_right (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
      linarith
    obtain ⟨hs1a, hs1b⟩ := abs_le.mp hs1
    obtain ⟨hp1a, hp1b⟩ := abs_le.mp hp1
    have hp_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt (P 0 0) := by linarith
    have hpne : Real.sqrt (P 0 0) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hp_pos
    have hps : |Real.sqrt (P 0 0) - Real.sqrt D| ≤ 17 * ε :=
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have key : Real.sqrt D * (-T / (2 * Real.sqrt (P 0 0))) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * d k 0 0
        = ((Real.sqrt (P 0 0) - Real.sqrt D) * d k 0 0 - Real.sqrt D * (T - d k 0 0))
          / (2 * Real.sqrt (P 0 0)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have h2p : 0 < 2 * Real.sqrt (P 0 0) := by linarith
    rw [key, abs_div, abs_of_pos h2p, div_le_iff₀ h2p]
    have a1 : |(Real.sqrt (P 0 0) - Real.sqrt D) * d k 0 0| ≤ 17 * ε * δ := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hps hu (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have a2 : |Real.sqrt D * (T - d k 0 0)| ≤ 2 * (9477 * ε * δ) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hs0]
      exact mul_le_mul (by linarith) hT (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    have hN := abs_sub ((Real.sqrt (P 0 0) - Real.sqrt D) * d k 0 0) (Real.sqrt D * (T - d k 0 0))
    have hN2 : 0 ≤ 20000 * ε * δ * (2 * Real.sqrt (P 0 0) - 1) := by
      have : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (P 0 0) - 1 := by linarith
      have h3 : 0 ≤ 20000 * ε * δ := by linarith
      exact mul_nonneg h3 this
    linarith
  
  have hq : ∀ l : Fin 3,
      |(∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P 0 a * d l a b * P b 0) - d l 0 0| ≤ 702 * ε * δ ∧
      |∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P 0 a * d l a b * P b 0| ≤ 225 * δ :=
    fun l => quad (d l) (hd l)
  have hT : |∑ l : Fin 3, P k l * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P 0 a * d l a b * P b 0)
      - d k 0 0| ≤ 9477 * ε * δ :=
    row (fun l => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P 0 a * d l a b * P b 0)
      (fun l => (hq l).1) (fun l => (hq l).2)
  have hsum : ∑ l : Fin 3, P k l *
        ((-∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P 0 a * d l a b * P b 0) / (2 * Real.sqrt (P 0 0)))
      = -(∑ l : Fin 3, P k l * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P 0 a * d l a b * P b 0))
          / (2 * Real.sqrt (P 0 0)) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  rw [hsum]
  exact fin _ hT

signature.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ε δ : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hPb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l| ≤ 5)
    (hPe : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 13 * ε)
    (hd : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, |d m a b| ≤ δ) :
    |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j *
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, P 0 l * (d i j l + d j i l - d l i j))
      - (∑ i : Fin 3, d i i 0 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, d 0 i i)| ≤ 4000 * ε * δ

proof.tactics:
by
  have hT : ∀ i j l : Fin 3, |d i j l + d j i l - d l i j| ≤ 3 * δ := by
    intro i j l
    have h1 := abs_le.mp (hd i j l)
    have h2 := abs_le.mp (hd j i l)
    have h3 := abs_le.mp (hd l i j)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2, h3.1, h3.2]
  have hI1 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by
    intro i j
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hc : ∀ i j l : Fin 3, |P i j * P 0 l - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
      (if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 78 * ε := by
    intro i j l
    have e : P i j * P 0 l - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
        (if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
        (P i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * P 0 l +
          (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * (P 0 l - (if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
      ring
    rw [e]
    calc _ ≤ |(P i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * P 0 l| +
          |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * (P 0 l - (if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0))| :=
          abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |P i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| * |P 0 l| +
          |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| * |P 0 l - (if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      _ ≤ (13 * ε) * 5 + 1 * (13 * ε) :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul (hPe i j) (hPb 0 l) (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith))
            (mul_le_mul (hI1 i j) (hPe 0 l) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
      _ = 78 * ε := by ring
  have hF : ∀ i j l : Fin 3, |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * (P i j * P 0 l - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
      (if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * (d i j l + d j i l - d l i j)| ≤
      117 * ε * δ := by
    intro i j l
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)]
    calc _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (78 * ε) * (3 * δ) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hc i j l) (by norm_num)) (hT i j l)
            (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = 117 * ε * δ := by ring
  have key : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j *
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, P 0 l * (d i j l + d j i l - d l i j))
      - (∑ i : Fin 3, d i i 0 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, d 0 i i) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (P i j * P 0 l - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
          (if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * (d i j l + d j i l - d l i j) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceEq, if_true, if_false]
    ring
  rw [key]
  calc _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (P i j * P 0 l - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
          (if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * (d i j l + d j i l - d l i j)| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * (P i j * P 0 l - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
          (if (0 : Fin 3) = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * (d i j l + d j i l - d l i j)| := by
        gcongr with i _
        refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
        gcongr with j _
        exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, 117 * ε * δ := by
        gcongr with i _ j _ l _
        exact hF i j l
    _ = 3159 * ε * δ := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
    _ ≤ 4000 * ε * δ := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hε0 hδ]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (R R' : ℝ) (hRR' : R ≤ R')
    (hsmooth : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x a b) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖})
    (hpos : ∀ x : E3, R' < ‖x‖ → (G x).det ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < (G x)⁻¹ 0 0) :
    (∀ a b k : Fin 3,
      ContinuousOn (fun x => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z a b) x) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) ∧

signature.name: gradVec_continuousOn
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (R R' : ℝ) (hRR' : R ≤ R')
    (hsmooth : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x a b) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖})

proof.tactics:
by
  have h1inf : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by
    exact_mod_cast le_top
  
  have hpd : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (s : Set E3), IsOpen s → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s →
      ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => partialDeriv k f x) s := by
    intro f s hs hf k
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) s := hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hs h1inf
    exact hc.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hV : IsOpen {x : E3 | R' < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hVU : {x : E3 | R' < ‖x‖} ⊆ {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := fun x hx =>
    lt_of_le_of_lt hRR' hx
  refine ⟨fun a b k => hpd _ _ hU (hsmooth a b) k, ?_⟩
  have hGV : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x a b) {x : E3 | R' < ‖x‖} :=
    fun a b => (hsmooth a b).mono hVU
  have h00 := hGV 0 0
  have h01 := hGV 0 1
  have h02 := hGV 0 2
  have h10 := hGV 1 0
  have h11 := hGV 1 1
  have h12 := hGV 1 2
  have h20 := hGV 2 0
  have h21 := hGV 2 1
  have h22 := hGV 2 2
  have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (G x).det) {x : E3 | R' < ‖x‖} := by
    simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    fun_prop
  have hdetinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ((G x).det)⁻¹) {x : E3 | R' < ‖x‖} :=
    hdetS.inv (fun x hx => (hpos x hx).1)
  have hadj : ∀ k l : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (G x).adjugate k l) {x : E3 | R' < ‖x‖} := by
    intro k l
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three] <;> fun_prop
  have hPS : ∀ k l : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (G x)⁻¹ k l) {x : E3 | R' < ‖x‖} := by
    intro k l
    refine ((hdetinv).mul (hadj k l)).congr ?_
    intro x _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
  have hhS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G z)⁻¹ 0 0)) {x : E3 | R' < ‖x‖} :=
    (hPS 0 0).sqrt (fun x hx => (hpos x hx).2.ne')
  have c1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (G x).det) {x : E3 | R' < ‖x‖} :=
    hdetS.continuousOn.sqrt
  have c3 : ∀ l : Fin 3, ContinuousOn
      (fun x => partialDeriv l (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G z)⁻¹ 0 0)) x) {x : E3 | R' < ‖x‖} :=
    fun l => hpd _ _ hV hhS l
  intro k
  show ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (G x).det *
    ∑ l : Fin 3, (G x)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G z)⁻¹ 0 0)) x) _
  exact c1.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum Finset.univ
    (fun l _ => ((hPS k l).continuousOn).mul (c3 l)))

informal_problem.statement:
(V W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (R L : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hRL : R < L)
    (hV : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => V x k) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖})
    (hW : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => W x k) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) :
    cylFlux (fun x => V x - W x) L = cylFlux V L - cylFlux W L

signature.name: cylFlux_sub_of_continuousOn
signature.statement:
(V W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (R L : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hRL : R < L)
    (hV : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => V x k) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖})
    (hW : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => W x k) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) :
    cylFlux (fun x => V x - W x) L = cylFlux V L - cylFlux W L

proof.tactics:
by
  have hnorm : ∀ t a b : ℝ, ‖cylPt t a b‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    intro t a b
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hmem : ∀ t a b : ℝ, L ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 →
      cylPt t a b ∈ {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by
    intro t a b h
    show R < ‖cylPt t a b‖
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have h1 := hnorm t a b
    have h2 : ‖cylPt t a b‖ ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hc 2
    nlinarith
  have hcont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) := by
    unfold cylPt
    fun_prop
  have hc : ∀ (U : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ), (∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => U x k) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) →
      ∀ (k : Fin 3) (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), Continuous φ →
      (∀ p, L ^ 2 ≤ (φ p).1 ^ 2 + (φ p).2.1 ^ 2 + (φ p).2.2 ^ 2) →
      Continuous (fun p => U (cylPt (φ p).1 (φ p).2.1 (φ p).2.2) k) := by
    intro U hU k φ hφ hφL
    exact (hU k).comp_continuous (hcont.comp hφ) (fun p => hmem _ _ _ (hφL p))
  have iter : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a b c d : ℝ), Continuous (Function.uncurry f) →
      Continuous (Function.uncurry g) →
      (∫ x in a..b, ∫ y in c..d, (f x y - g x y)) =
        (∫ x in a..b, ∫ y in c..d, f x y) - ∫ x in a..b, ∫ y in c..d, g x y := by
    intro f g a b c d hf hg
    have h1 : (fun x => ∫ y in c..d, (f x y - g x y)) =
        fun x => (∫ y in c..d, f x y) - ∫ y in c..d, g x y := by
      funext x
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hf.uncurry_left x).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((hg.uncurry_left x).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    rw [h1]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_sub
      ((intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hf c d).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hg c d).intervalIntegrable _ _)
  have capC : ∀ U : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ,
      (∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => U x k) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) →
      Continuous (Function.uncurry (fun ρ s : ℝ =>
        (U (cylPt L (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0
          - U (cylPt (-L) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0) * ρ)) := by
    intro U hU
    have h1 := hc U hU 0 (fun p => (L, p.1 * Real.cos p.2, p.1 * Real.sin p.2)) (by fun_prop)
      (fun p => by
        show L ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + (p.1 * Real.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (p.1 * Real.sin p.2) ^ 2
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 * Real.cos p.2), sq_nonneg (p.1 * Real.sin p.2)])
    have h2 := hc U hU 0 (fun p => (-L, p.1 * Real.cos p.2, p.1 * Real.sin p.2)) (by fun_prop)
      (fun p => by
        show L ^ 2 ≤ (-L) ^ 2 + (p.1 * Real.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (p.1 * Real.sin p.2) ^ 2
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 * Real.cos p.2), sq_nonneg (p.1 * Real.sin p.2)])
    exact Continuous.congr ((h1.sub h2).mul continuous_fst) (fun p => rfl)
  have sideC : ∀ U : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ,
      (∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => U x k) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) →
      Continuous (Function.uncurry (fun t s : ℝ =>
        (U (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) 1 * Real.cos s
          + U (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) 2 * Real.sin s) * L)) := by
    intro U hU
    have hφL : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ,
        L ^ 2 ≤ ((p.1, L * Real.cos p.2, L * Real.sin p.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ).1 ^ 2
          + ((p.1, L * Real.cos p.2, L * Real.sin p.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ).2.1 ^ 2
          + ((p.1, L * Real.cos p.2, L * Real.sin p.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ).2.2 ^ 2 := by
      intro p
      show L ^ 2 ≤ p.1 ^ 2 + (L * Real.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (L * Real.sin p.2) ^ 2
      have e : (L * Real.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (L * Real.sin p.2) ^ 2 = L ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← mul_add, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg p.1]
    have h1 := hc U hU 1 (fun p => (p.1, L * Real.cos p.2, L * Real.sin p.2)) (by fun_prop) hφL
    have h2 := hc U hU 2 (fun p => (p.1, L * Real.cos p.2, L * Real.sin p.2)) (by fun_prop) hφL
    exact Continuous.congr
      (((h1.mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp continuous_snd)).add
        (h2.mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp continuous_snd))).mul continuous_const) (fun p => rfl)
  have hcap : capFlux (fun x => V x - W x) L = capFlux V L - capFlux W L := by
    have h := iter _ _ 0 L 0 (2 * Real.pi) (capC V hV) (capC W hW)
    beta_reduce at h
    unfold capFlux
    refine Eq.trans ?_ h
    congr 1; funext ρ; congr 1; funext s
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  have hside : sideFlux (fun x => V x - W x) L = sideFlux V L - sideFlux W L := by
    have h := iter _ _ (-L) L 0 (2 * Real.pi) (sideC V hV) (sideC W hW)
    beta_reduce at h
    unfold sideFlux
    refine Eq.trans ?_ h
    congr 1; funext t; congr 1; funext s
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  unfold cylFlux
  rw [hcap, hside]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(a b : E3 → ℝ) (R L : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hRL : R < L)
    (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) :
    capFlux (fun x => ![partialDeriv 1 a x + partialDeriv 2 b x, 0, 0]) L =
      sideFlux (fun x => ![0, partialDeriv 0 a x, partialDeriv 0 b x]) L

signature.name: cyl_cap_side_identity
signature.statement:
(a b : E3 → ℝ) (R L : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hRL : R < L)
    (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) :
    capFlux (fun x => ![partialDeriv 1 a x + partialDeriv 2 b x, 0, 0]) L =
