proof.tactics:
by
  
  have t_norm : ∀ t y z : ℝ, ‖cylPt t y z‖ = Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + z ^ 2) := by
    intro t y z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  
  have t_swap : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), Continuous (Function.uncurry f) → ∀ a₀ b₀ c₀ d₀ : ℝ,
      ∫ x in a₀..b₀, ∫ y in c₀..d₀, f x y = ∫ y in c₀..d₀, ∫ x in a₀..b₀, f x y := by
    intro f hf a₀ b₀ c₀ d₀
    have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry f)
        ((volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a₀ b₀)).prod (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc c₀ d₀))) := by
      rw [Measure.prod_restrict, ← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
      exact (hf.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_uIcc.prod isCompact_uIcc)).mono_set
        (Set.prod_mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc)
    have h1 : ∀ x, ∫ y in c₀..d₀, f x y =
        (if c₀ ≤ d₀ then (1:ℝ) else -1) • ∫ y in Set.uIoc c₀ d₀, f x y :=
      fun x => intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_eq_integral_uIoc _ _ _ _
    simp only [h1]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_smul, MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_integral_swap hint]
    conv_rhs => rw [intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_eq_integral_uIoc]
  
  have t_shell : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} →
      ContinuousOn f {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} ∧
      (∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f x) x) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => partialDeriv i f x) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) := by
    intro f hf
    have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
    refine ⟨hf.continuousOn, fun x hx => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
    · exact ((hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
    · exact (hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  
  have t_cont : ∀ {α : Type} [TopologicalSpace α] (f : E3 → ℝ),
      ContinuousOn f {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} → ∀ (T Y Z : α → ℝ),
      Continuous T → Continuous Y → Continuous Z →
      (∀ p : α, R < ‖cylPt (T p) (Y p) (Z p)‖) →
      Continuous (fun p => f (cylPt (T p) (Y p) (Z p))) := by
    intro α _ f hf T Y Z hT hY hZ hmem
    have hc : Continuous (fun p => cylPt (T p) (Y p) (Z p)) := by
      unfold cylPt
      fun_prop
    exact hf.comp_continuous hc hmem
  
  have t_chain : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (T Y Z : ℝ → ℝ) (T' Y' Z' u : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt T T' u → HasDerivAt Y Y' u → HasDerivAt Z Z' u →
      HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f (cylPt (T u) (Y u) (Z u))) (cylPt (T u) (Y u) (Z u)) →
      HasDerivAt (fun v => f (cylPt (T v) (Y v) (Z v)))
        (T' * partialDeriv 0 f (cylPt (T u) (Y u) (Z u))
          + Y' * partialDeriv 1 f (cylPt (T u) (Y u) (Z u))
          + Z' * partialDeriv 2 f (cylPt (T u) (Y u) (Z u))) u := by
    intro f T Y Z T' Y' Z' u hT hY hZ hf
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun v => cylPt (T v) (Y v) (Z v))
        (T' • e 0 + Y' • e 1 + Z' • e 2) u := by
      unfold cylPt
      exact ((hT.smul_const (e 0)).add (hY.smul_const (e 1))).add (hZ.smul_const (e 2))
    have h := hf.comp_hasDerivAt u hγ
    convert h using 1
    simp only [partialDeriv, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have t_cap : ∀ c M : ℝ, R < |c| →
      ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..M, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (partialDeriv 1 a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + partialDeriv 2 b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * ρ =
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (a (cylPt c (M * Real.cos s) (M * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
            + b (cylPt c (M * Real.cos s) (M * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) * M := by
    intro c M hc
    obtain ⟨haC, haD, haP⟩ := t_shell a ha
    obtain ⟨hbC, hbD, hbP⟩ := t_shell b hb
    have hc2 : R ^ 2 < c ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs c]; exact pow_lt_pow_left₀ hc hR (by norm_num)
    have hmem : ∀ y z : ℝ, R < ‖cylPt c y z‖ := by
      intro y z
      rw [t_norm]
      exact (Real.lt_sqrt hR).mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y, sq_nonneg z])
    have cq : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} →
        Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => f (cylPt c (q.1 * Real.cos q.2) (q.1 * Real.sin q.2))) :=
      fun f hf => t_cont f hf (fun _ => c) (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 * Real.cos q.2)
        (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 * Real.sin q.2) continuous_const (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
        (fun q => hmem _ _)
    have cA := cq a haC
    have cB := cq b hbC
    have cA1 := cq _ (haP 1)
    have cA2 := cq _ (haP 2)
    have cB1 := cq _ (hbP 1)
    have cB2 := cq _ (hbP 2)
    have cC : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.cos q.2) := by fun_prop
    have cS : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sin q.2) := by fun_prop
    have cR : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1) := continuous_fst
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, F = fun ρ s =>
        ρ * (a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
          + b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, F = fun ρ s =>
        b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
          - a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨DΦ, hDΦ⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, F = fun ρ s =>
        (a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
          + b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s)
        + ρ * (Real.cos s * (Real.cos s * partialDeriv 1 a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + Real.sin s * partialDeriv 2 a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))
          + Real.sin s * (Real.cos s * partialDeriv 1 b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + Real.sin s * partialDeriv 2 b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨DΨ, hDΨ⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, F = fun ρ s =>
        (-(ρ * Real.sin s) * partialDeriv 1 b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + ρ * Real.cos s * partialDeriv 2 b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))
            * Real.cos s
          - b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s
          - ((-(ρ * Real.sin s) * partialDeriv 1 a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + ρ * Real.cos s * partialDeriv 2 a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))
            * Real.sin s
          + a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have cDΦ : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => DΦ q.1 q.2) := by
      subst hDΦ
      exact ((cA.mul cC).add (cB.mul cS)).add (cR.mul ((cC.mul ((cC.mul cA1).add
        (cS.mul cA2))).add (cS.mul ((cC.mul cB1).add (cS.mul cB2)))))
    have cDΨ : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => DΨ q.1 q.2) := by
      subst hDΨ
      exact (((((cR.mul cS).neg.mul cB1).add ((cR.mul cC).mul cB2)).mul cC).sub
        (cB.mul cS)).sub
        (((((cR.mul cS).neg.mul cA1).add ((cR.mul cC).mul cA2)).mul cS).add (cA.mul cC))
    have hΦd : ∀ ρ s, HasDerivAt (fun r => Φ r s) (DΦ ρ s) ρ := by
      intro ρ s
      have hTa := t_chain a (fun _ => c) (fun r => r * Real.cos s) (fun r => r * Real.sin s)
        0 (Real.cos s) (Real.sin s) ρ (hasDerivAt_const _ _) (hasDerivAt_mul_const _)
        (hasDerivAt_mul_const _) (haD _ (hmem _ _))
      have hTb := t_chain b (fun _ => c) (fun r => r * Real.cos s) (fun r => r * Real.sin s)
        0 (Real.cos s) (Real.sin s) ρ (hasDerivAt_const _ _) (hasDerivAt_mul_const _)
        (hasDerivAt_mul_const _) (hbD _ (hmem _ _))
      beta_reduce at hTa hTb
      have h := (hasDerivAt_id ρ).mul
        ((hTa.mul_const (Real.cos s)).add (hTb.mul_const (Real.sin s)))
      subst hΦ hDΦ
      refine h.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [id, Pi.add_apply]
      ring
    have hΨd : ∀ ρ s, HasDerivAt (fun u => Ψ ρ u) (DΨ ρ s) s := by
      intro ρ s
      have hY : HasDerivAt (fun u => ρ * Real.cos u) (ρ * -Real.sin s) s :=
        (Real.hasDerivAt_cos s).const_mul ρ
      have hZ : HasDerivAt (fun u => ρ * Real.sin u) (ρ * Real.cos s) s :=
        (Real.hasDerivAt_sin s).const_mul ρ
      have hTa := t_chain a (fun _ => c) (fun u => ρ * Real.cos u) (fun u => ρ * Real.sin u)
        0 _ _ s (hasDerivAt_const _ _) hY hZ (haD _ (hmem _ _))
      have hTb := t_chain b (fun _ => c) (fun u => ρ * Real.cos u) (fun u => ρ * Real.sin u)
        0 _ _ s (hasDerivAt_const _ _) hY hZ (hbD _ (hmem _ _))
      beta_reduce at hTa hTb
      have h := (hTb.mul (Real.hasDerivAt_cos s)).sub (hTa.mul (Real.hasDerivAt_sin s))
      subst hΨ hDΨ
      refine h.congr_deriv ?_
      ring
    
    have key : ∀ ρ s,
        (partialDeriv 1 a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + partialDeriv 2 b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * ρ
          = DΦ ρ s + DΨ ρ s := by
      intro ρ s
      subst hDΦ hDΨ
      linear_combination (-(ρ * (partialDeriv 1 a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + partialDeriv 2 b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))))) *
        Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq s
    have hΨper : ∀ ρ, Ψ ρ (2 * Real.pi) - Ψ ρ 0 = 0 := by
      intro ρ
      subst hΨ
      simp [Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi]
    have sl1 : ∀ ρ, Continuous (fun s => DΦ ρ s) := fun ρ =>
      cDΦ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have sl2 : ∀ ρ, Continuous (fun s => DΨ ρ s) := fun ρ =>
      cDΨ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have sl3 : ∀ s, Continuous (fun ρ => DΦ ρ s) := fun s =>
      cDΦ.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    calc ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..M, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (partialDeriv 1 a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + partialDeriv 2 b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * ρ
        = ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..M, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (DΦ ρ s + DΨ ρ s) := by
          congr 1; funext ρ; congr 1; funext s; exact key ρ s
      _ = ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..M, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), DΦ ρ s := by
          congr 1; funext ρ
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((sl1 ρ).intervalIntegrable _ _)
            ((sl2 ρ).intervalIntegrable _ _),
            intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun s _ => hΨd ρ s)
              ((sl2 ρ).intervalIntegrable _ _), hΨper ρ, add_zero]
      _ = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..M, DΦ ρ s := t_swap DΦ cDΦ _ _ _ _
      _ = _ := by
          congr 1; funext s
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun ρ _ => hΦd ρ s)
              ((sl3 s).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
          subst hΦ
          ring
  
  have t_side : ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (partialDeriv 0 a (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
            + partialDeriv 0 b (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) * L =
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          ((a (cylPt L (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
              + b (cylPt L (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) * L
            - (a (cylPt (-L) (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
              + b (cylPt (-L) (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) * L) := by
    obtain ⟨haC, haD, haP⟩ := t_shell a ha
    obtain ⟨hbC, hbD, hbP⟩ := t_shell b hb
    have hL2 : R ^ 2 < L ^ 2 := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hRL hR (by norm_num)
    have hmem : ∀ t s : ℝ, R < ‖cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)‖ := by
      intro t s
      rw [t_norm]
      refine (Real.lt_sqrt hR).mpr ?_
      have h1 : (L * Real.cos s) ^ 2 + (L * Real.sin s) ^ 2 = L ^ 2 := by
        have := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq s
        linear_combination L ^ 2 * this
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
    have cq : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} →
        Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => f (cylPt q.1 (L * Real.cos q.2) (L * Real.sin q.2))) :=
      fun f hf => t_cont f hf (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1) (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => L * Real.cos q.2)
        (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => L * Real.sin q.2) continuous_fst (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
        (fun q => hmem _ _)
    have cA0 := cq _ (haP 0)
    have cB0 := cq _ (hbP 0)
    have cC : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.cos q.2) := by fun_prop
    have cS : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sin q.2) := by fun_prop
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, F = fun t s =>
        (partialDeriv 0 a (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
            + partialDeriv 0 b (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) * L :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have cD : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => D q.1 q.2) := by
      subst hD
      exact ((cA0.mul cC).add (cB0.mul cS)).mul continuous_const
    have hΘ : ∀ t s, HasDerivAt
        (fun u => (a (cylPt u (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
            + b (cylPt u (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) * L) (D t s) t := by
      intro t s
      have hTa := t_chain a (fun u => u) (fun _ => L * Real.cos s) (fun _ => L * Real.sin s)
        1 0 0 t (hasDerivAt_id' t) (hasDerivAt_const _ _) (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
        (haD _ (hmem _ _))
      have hTb := t_chain b (fun u => u) (fun _ => L * Real.cos s) (fun _ => L * Real.sin s)
        1 0 0 t (hasDerivAt_id' t) (hasDerivAt_const _ _) (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
        (hbD _ (hmem _ _))
      beta_reduce at hTa hTb
      have h := ((hTa.mul_const (Real.cos s)).add (hTb.mul_const (Real.sin s))).mul_const L
      subst hD
      refine h.congr_deriv ?_
      ring
    have sl : ∀ s, Continuous (fun t => D t s) := fun s =>
      cD.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    calc _ = ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), D t s := by
          subst hD; rfl
      _ = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ t in (-L)..L, D t s := t_swap D cD _ _ _ _
      _ = _ := by
          congr 1; funext s
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun t _ => hΘ t s)
              ((sl s).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
  
  obtain ⟨haC, haD, haP⟩ := t_shell a ha
  obtain ⟨hbC, hbD, hbP⟩ := t_shell b hb
  have hL0 : 0 < L := lt_of_le_of_lt hR hRL
  have hcL : R < |L| := by rw [abs_of_pos hL0]; exact hRL
  have hcmL : R < |-L| := by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hL0]; exact hRL
  have hmemc : ∀ c : ℝ, R < |c| → ∀ y z : ℝ, R < ‖cylPt c y z‖ := by
    intro c hc y z
    have hc2 : R ^ 2 < c ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs c]; exact pow_lt_pow_left₀ hc hR (by norm_num)
    rw [t_norm]
    exact (Real.lt_sqrt hR).mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y, sq_nonneg z])
  have cX : ∀ c : ℝ, R < |c| → Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      (partialDeriv 1 a (cylPt c (q.1 * Real.cos q.2) (q.1 * Real.sin q.2))
        + partialDeriv 2 b (cylPt c (q.1 * Real.cos q.2) (q.1 * Real.sin q.2))) * q.1) := by
    intro c hc
    have h1 := t_cont _ (haP 1) (fun _ => c) (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 * Real.cos q.2)
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 * Real.sin q.2) continuous_const (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      (fun q => hmemc c hc _ _)
    have h2 := t_cont _ (hbP 2) (fun _ => c) (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 * Real.cos q.2)
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 * Real.sin q.2) continuous_const (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      (fun q => hmemc c hc _ _)
    exact (h1.add h2).mul continuous_fst
  have cG : ∀ c : ℝ, R < |c| → Continuous (fun s : ℝ =>
      (a (cylPt c (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
        + b (cylPt c (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) * L) := by
    intro c hc
    have h1 := t_cont a haC (fun _ => c) (fun s : ℝ => L * Real.cos s)
      (fun s : ℝ => L * Real.sin s) continuous_const (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      (fun q => hmemc c hc _ _)
    have h2 := t_cont b hbC (fun _ => c) (fun s : ℝ => L * Real.cos s)
      (fun s : ℝ => L * Real.sin s) continuous_const (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      (fun q => hmemc c hc _ _)
    exact ((h1.mul Real.continuous_cos).add (h2.mul Real.continuous_sin)).mul continuous_const
  have cF : ∀ c : ℝ, R < |c| → Continuous (fun ρ : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      (partialDeriv 1 a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
        + partialDeriv 2 b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * ρ) := fun c hc =>
    intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' (cX c hc) _ _
  have sX : ∀ c : ℝ, R < |c| → ∀ ρ : ℝ, Continuous (fun s : ℝ =>
      (partialDeriv 1 a (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
        + partialDeriv 2 b (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * ρ) := by
    intro c hc ρ
    have h := (cX c hc).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id :
      Continuous fun s : ℝ => ((ρ, s) : ℝ × ℝ))
    exact h
  unfold capFlux sideFlux
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
    Matrix.tail_cons]
  rw [t_side]
  calc _ = (∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (partialDeriv 1 a (cylPt L (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + partialDeriv 2 b (cylPt L (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * ρ)
        - ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (partialDeriv 1 a (cylPt (-L) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + partialDeriv 2 b (cylPt (-L) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * ρ := by
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((cF L hcL).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          ((cF (-L) hcmL).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun ρ _ => ?_)
        try simp only
        rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((sX L hcL ρ).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          ((sX (-L) hcmL ρ).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
        try simp only
        ring
    _ = (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (a (cylPt L (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
            + b (cylPt L (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) * L)
        - ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (a (cylPt (-L) (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
            + b (cylPt (-L) (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) * L := by
        rw [t_cap L L hcL, t_cap (-L) L hcmL]
    _ = _ := (intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((cG L hcL).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          ((cG (-L) hcmL).intervalIntegrable _ _)).symm

informal_problem.statement:
(V : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (L M : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hV : ∀ x : E3, L ≤ ‖x‖ → ∀ k : Fin 3, |V x k| ≤ M) :
    |cylFlux V L| ≤ 12 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * M

signature.name: cylFlux_abs_le
signature.statement:
(V : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (L M : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hV : ∀ x : E3, L ≤ ‖x‖ → ∀ k : Fin 3, |V x k| ≤ M) :
    |cylFlux V L| ≤ 12 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * M

proof.tactics:
by
  have hnorm : ∀ t a b : ℝ, ‖cylPt t a b‖ = Real.sqrt (t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
    intro t a b
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, sq_abs]
  have hge : ∀ t a b : ℝ, L ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 → L ≤ ‖cylPt t a b‖ := by
    intro t a b h
    rw [hnorm]
    exact (Real.le_sqrt hL (by positivity)).mpr h
  have hpi : |2 * Real.pi - 0| = 2 * Real.pi := by
    rw [sub_zero]; exact abs_of_pos (by positivity)
  
  have hcap : |capFlux V L| ≤ 4 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * M := by
    have hpt : ∀ ρ s : ℝ, |V (cylPt L (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0| ≤ M ∧
        |V (cylPt (-L) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0| ≤ M := by
      intro ρ s
      constructor
      · apply hV; apply hge
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ρ * Real.cos s), sq_nonneg (ρ * Real.sin s)]
      · apply hV; apply hge
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ρ * Real.cos s), sq_nonneg (ρ * Real.sin s)]
    unfold capFlux
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    refine (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (C := 2 * M * L * (2 * Real.pi))
      ?_).trans ?_
    · intro ρ hρ
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hL] at hρ
      obtain ⟨hρ0, hρL⟩ := hρ
      refine (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (C := 2 * M * L) ?_).trans
        (le_of_eq (by rw [hpi]))
      intro s _
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hpt ρ s
      have a1 := abs_le.mp h1
      have a2 := abs_le.mp h2
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hρ0]
      have h3 : |V (cylPt L (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0
          - V (cylPt (-L) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0| ≤ 2 * M :=
        abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [a1.1, a1.2, a2.1, a2.2], by linarith [a1.1, a1.2, a2.1, a2.2]⟩
      calc _ ≤ 2 * M * ρ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h3 hρ0.le
        _ ≤ 2 * M * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρL (by linarith)
    · rw [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hL]
      ring_nf
      exact le_refl _
  
  have hside : |sideFlux V L| ≤ 8 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * M := by
    have hpt : ∀ t s : ℝ, ∀ k : Fin 3,
        |V (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) k| ≤ M := by
      intro t s k
      apply hV; apply hge
      have hcs : (L * Real.cos s) ^ 2 + (L * Real.sin s) ^ 2 = L ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← mul_add, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
    unfold sideFlux
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    refine (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (C := 2 * M * L * (2 * Real.pi))
      ?_).trans ?_
    · intro t _
      refine (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (C := 2 * M * L) ?_).trans
        (le_of_eq (by rw [hpi]))
      intro s _
      have h1 := hpt t s 1
      have h2 := hpt t s 2
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hL]
      have hc : |V (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) 1 * Real.cos s| ≤ M := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        calc _ ≤ M * 1 := mul_le_mul h1 (Real.abs_cos_le_one s) (abs_nonneg _) hM
          _ = M := mul_one M
      have hs : |V (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) 2 * Real.sin s| ≤ M := by
        rw [abs_mul]

proof.tactics:
by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge hAF.numEnds 2 with h1 | h2
  · 
    have hpc : ∀ (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3), partialDeriv i (fun _ : E3 => c) = fun _ => 0 := by
      intro c i
      funext y
      simp [partialDeriv]
    let φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 p₀).symm.toPartialEquiv
        open_source := (chartAt E3 p₀).open_target
        open_target := (chartAt E3 p₀).open_source
        contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
        contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
    have hsym := ricci_symm_local (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₀).symm) (chartAt E3 p₀).target
      (chartAt E3 p₀ p₀) (chartAt E3 p₀).open_target (mem_chart_target E3 p₀) (g.smooth p₀)
      (fun z a b => g.symm _ _ _) (fun z hz => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p₀ z hz).det_pos.ne') j l
    have hst : ∀ a b : Fin 3, staticLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₀).symm) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) a b
        (chartAt E3 p₀ p₀) = ricci (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₀).symm) a b (chartAt E3 p₀ p₀) := by
      intro a b
      simp [staticLoc, lapLoc, hessLoc, hpc]
    refine ⟨φ, chartAt E3 p₀ p₀, fun _ => (1 : ℝ), 1, 1, 0, j, l, mem_chart_target E3 p₀,
      contMDiff_const, ?_, by norm_num, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p
      simp [RiemannianMetric3.lapM, lapLoc, hessLoc, hpc]
    · intro j' x _
      have hj : j' = k := Fin.ext (by have := j'.isLt; have := k.isLt; omega)
      subst hj
      simp
    · show staticSymLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₀).symm) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) j l
        (chartAt E3 p₀ p₀) ≠ 0
      rw [staticSymLoc, hst, hst, ← hsym]
      intro h
      apply hne
      linarith
  · 
    obtain ⟨k'', hk''⟩ : ∃ k'' : Fin hAF.numEnds, k'' ≠ k := by
      by_cases hk0 : k.val = 0
      · refine ⟨⟨1, by omega⟩, fun h => ?_⟩
        have h' : (1 : ℕ) = k.val := congrArg Fin.val h
        omega
      · refine ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, fun h => ?_⟩
        have h' : (0 : ℕ) = k.val := congrArg Fin.val h
        omega
    obtain ⟨ψ, q₁, R₁, C₁, hψ, hharm, hq₁, hdec⟩ := harmonic_end_weight g hComplete hAF k
    have hpos := harmonic_end_weight_pos g hAF k ψ hψ hharm q₁ R₁ C₁ (by linarith)
      (fun j' x hx => (hdec j' x hx).1)
    have hsrc : (hAF.ends k'').Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends k'').source_eq
    have hGsm : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (hAF.ends k'').Φ x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
      intro i j
      rw [← hsrc]
      exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g (hAF.ends k'').Φ i j
    obtain ⟨R', C', hR'1, hC', hdecG⟩ := christoffel_ricci_decay (g.coeff (hAF.ends k'').Φ)
      hAF.q (by linarith [hAF.q_gt]) hGsm (hAF.decay k'')
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ ((hAF.ends k'').Φ z)) (hAF.ends k'').Φ.source :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hψ.comp_contMDiffOn (hAF.ends k'').Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun)
    obtain ⟨Rm, hRm⟩ : ∃ Rm : ℝ, Rm = max (max R' R₁) 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hRm1 : 1 ≤ Rm := by rw [hRm]; exact le_max_right _ _
    have hRmR' : R' ≤ Rm := by rw [hRm]; exact (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have hRmR₁ : R₁ ≤ Rm := by rw [hRm]; exact (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have hUx : ∀ x : E3, Rm < ‖x‖ → x ∈ (hAF.ends k'').Φ.source := by
      intro x hx
      rw [hsrc]
      show 1 < ‖x‖
      linarith
    
    have hex : ∃ x₁ : E3, Rm < ‖x₁‖ ∧ ∃ i₁ j₁ : Fin 3,
        staticSymLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k'').Φ) (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends k'').Φ y)) i₁ j₁ x₁ ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hall
      push_neg at hall
      have heq : ∀ x : E3, Rm < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends k'').Φ y))) x =
            ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel (g.coeff (hAF.ends k'').Φ) k i j x *
                partialDeriv k (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends k'').Φ y)) x +
              ((ricci (g.coeff (hAF.ends k'').Φ) i j x +
                  ricci (g.coeff (hAF.ends k'').Φ) j i x) / 2) * ψ ((hAF.ends k'').Φ x) := by
        intro x hx i j
        have hRx : scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff (hAF.ends k'').Φ) x = 0 := by
          rw [← scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff g (hAF.ends k'').Φ x (hUx x hx)]
          exact hR0 _
        rw [static_hessian_identity (g.coeff (hAF.ends k'').Φ) (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends k'').Φ y))
          (hAF.ends k'').Φ.source x (hAF.ends k'').Φ.open_source (hUx x hx) hf
          (fun z a b => g.symm _ _ _) (coeff_posDef g (hAF.ends k'').Φ x (hUx x hx)).det_pos.ne'
          hRx (hall x hx) i j]
        ring
      have hR'x : ∀ x : E3, Rm < ‖x‖ → R' < ‖x‖ := fun x hx => lt_of_le_of_lt hRmR' hx
      have hR₁x : ∀ x : E3, Rm < ‖x‖ → R₁ < ‖x‖ := fun x hx => lt_of_le_of_lt hRmR₁ hx
      have hmono : ∀ (c : ℝ) (x : E3) (s : ℝ), c ≤ max C' C₁ → c * ‖x‖ ^ s ≤ max C' C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ s :=
        fun c x s hc => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := decaying_hessian_rigidity (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends k'').Φ y))
        (christoffel (g.coeff (hAF.ends k'').Φ))
        (fun i j x => (ricci (g.coeff (hAF.ends k'').Φ) i j x +
          ricci (g.coeff (hAF.ends k'').Φ) j i x) / 2)
        hAF.q (q₁ + 1) Rm (max C' C₁) (by linarith [hAF.q_gt]) (by linarith) hRm1
        (hf.mono fun x hx => hUx x hx)
        (by
          intro x hx k' i j
          exact ((hdecG x (hR'x x hx)).2.1 k' i j).trans (hmono C' x _ (le_max_left _ _)))
        (by
          intro x hx i j
          have ha := ((hdecG x (hR'x x hx)).2.2 i j).trans (hmono C' x _ (le_max_left _ _))
          have hb := ((hdecG x (hR'x x hx)).2.2 j i).trans (hmono C' x _ (le_max_left _ _))
          rw [abs_le] at ha hb ⊢
          constructor <;> linarith [ha.1, ha.2, hb.1, hb.2])
        (by
          intro x hx
          have h0 := (hdec k'' x (hR₁x x hx)).1
          rw [if_neg hk'', sub_zero] at h0
          have he : (1 - (q₁ + 1)) = -q₁ := by ring
          rw [he]
          exact h0.trans (hmono C₁ x _ (le_max_right _ _)))
        (by
          intro x hx
          have h0 := (hdec k'' x (hR₁x x hx)).2
          have he : (-(q₁ + 1)) = -q₁ - 1 := by ring
          rw [he]
          exact h0.trans (hmono C₁ x _ (le_max_right _ _)))
        heq
      have hn : ‖(max ρ Rm + 1) • e 0‖ = max ρ Rm + 1 := by
        rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos (by linarith [le_max_right ρ Rm])]
      have hz := hρ ((max ρ Rm + 1) • e 0) (by rw [hn]; linarith [le_max_left ρ Rm])
      have hp := hpos ((hAF.ends k'').Φ ((max ρ Rm + 1) • e 0))
      simp only at hz
      linarith
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, i₁, j₁, hS⟩ := hex
    exact ⟨(hAF.ends k'').Φ, x₁, ψ, q₁, R₁, C₁, i₁, j₁, hUx x₁ hx₁, hψ, hharm, hq₁, hdec, hS⟩

The glue closes both cases: one end uses psi = 1 and ricci_symm_local, and two or more ends argue by contradiction on an end k'' different from k, using static_hessian_identity, christoffel_ricci_decay, decaying_hessian_rigidity and harmonic_end_weight(_pos). Every child is actually used, and the four cited children are already-proved section-10 lemmas. The crux is named and isolated in decaying_hessian_rigidity, and its bootstrap proof checks out: s0 does not depend on N, K*s0^-q < 1/2, so P(N) implies P(N/2), and by induction f = 0. ricci_symm_local and static_hessian_identity are pointwise algebra (trace gives f*R + 2*Lap, so R = 0 forces the Hessian to equal f*Ric^sym), and christoffel_ricci_decay is bookkeeping on proved bounds. The PDE content of harmonic_end_weight and harmonic_end_weight_pos rests on the existing nodes conformal_linear_solve and harmonic_local_const_interior, which are the children's dependencies and are not cited by this glue. Blueprint sections 4 and 5 are substantive: numerical checks E1-E6 and falsification attempts F1-F12. There is no parameter explosion, no ancestor restatement and no recycling.

              calc |H y a b| * |u a| * |u b| ≤ |H y a b| * ‖u‖ * ‖u‖ := by gcongr
                _ = |H y a b| * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, |H y a b|) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
              rw [Finset.sum_mul]
              refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
              rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          _ ≤ η * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hHη y hyK) (by positivity)
      rw [hPu, abs_mul]
      have h1 : |t| * |∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, H y a b * u a * u b| ≤ |t| * (η * ‖u‖ ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left habs (abs_nonneg t)
      have h2 : |t| * (η * ‖u‖ ^ 2) ≤ c / 2 * ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hT) (sq_nonneg ‖u‖)]
      linarith
    · have h0 : P p = 0 := hP0 p (by tauto)
      rw [h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, abs_zero]
      linarith [hgnn p ξ]
  
  have hφKt : φ '' K ⊆ φ.target := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source (hKφ hy)
  have hφKc : IsClosed (φ '' K) :=
    (hK.image_of_continuousOn (φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono hKφ)).isClosed
  have hsm : ∀ x₀ : M, ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun y => coeffMatrix (fun p => g.g p + P p) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y i j)
      (chartAt E3 x₀).target := by
    intro x₀ i j
    have hsplit : (fun y => coeffMatrix (fun p => g.g p + P p) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y i j) =
        fun y => coeffMatrix g.g (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y i j +
          P ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y (e i))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y (e j)) := by
      funext y
      simp only [coeffMatrix, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    rw [hsplit]
    refine (g.smooth x₀ i j).add ?_
    have hW₁ : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' φ.target) :=
      (chartAt E3 x₀).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 x₀).open_target
        φ.open_target
    have hW₂ : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' (φ '' K)ᶜ) :=
      (chartAt E3 x₀).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 x₀).open_target
        hφKc.isOpen_compl
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro y hy
    by_cases hyt : (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y ∈ φ.target
    · refine ⟨_, hW₁, ⟨hy, hyt⟩, ?_⟩
      have hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z))
          ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' φ.target) := by
        have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun z => φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z))
            ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' φ.target) :=
          φ.symm.contMDiffOn_toFun.comp
            ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞) (x := x₀)).mono
              Set.inter_subset_left) (fun z hz => hz.2)
        exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.1 h1
      have hder : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' φ.target, ∀ v : E3,
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm z v) =
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) z v := by
        intro z hz v
        have h1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z) :=
          φ.symm.mdifferentiableAt hn hz.2
        have h2 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm z :=
          (((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞) (x := x₀)) z hz.1).contMDiffAt
            ((chartAt E3 x₀).open_target.mem_nhds hz.1)).mdifferentiableAt hn
        have h3 := mfderiv_comp z h1 h2
        rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at h3
        rw [show (fun z => φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) = φ.symm ∘ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm
          from rfl, h3]
        rfl
      have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)))
          ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' φ.target) :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW₁).1 hτ).2
      have hcomp : ∀ (k a : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => EuclideanSpace.proj a
          (fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) z (e k)))
          ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' φ.target) := by
        intro k a
        have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
            (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) z (e k))
            ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' φ.target) :=
          hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
      have hHτ : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => H (φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) a b)
          ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' φ.target) := fun a b =>
        (hH a b).comp_contDiffOn hτ
      have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => t * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          EuclideanSpace.proj a (fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) z (e i)) *
            H (φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) a b *
            EuclideanSpace.proj b (fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ.symm ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) z (e j)))
          ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' φ.target) :=
        contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ =>
          ((hcomp i a).mul (hHτ a b)).mul (hcomp j b))
      refine (hF.mono Set.inter_subset_right).congr fun z hz => ?_
      rw [hPev _ hz.2.2, hder z hz.2 (e i), hder z hz.2 (e j), Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      ring
    · refine ⟨_, hW₂, ⟨hy, fun hmem => hyt (hφKt hmem)⟩, ?_⟩
      refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr fun z hz => ?_
      rw [hPoff _ hz.2.2]
      rfl
  
  have hsym : ∀ x (v w : E3), (fun p => g.g p + P p) x v w = (fun p => g.g p + P p) x w v := by
    intro x v w
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    rw [g.symm x v w, hPsymm x v w]
  have hpd : ∀ x (v : E3), v ≠ 0 → 0 < (fun p => g.g p + P p) x v v := by
    intro x v hv
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    have h1 := (abs_le.1 (hPb x v)).1
    have h2 := g.posDef x v hv
    linarith
  refine ⟨⟨fun p => g.g p + P p, hsym, hpd, hsm⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    show g.g p + P p = g.g p
    rw [hPoff p hp, add_zero]
  · intro y hy
    ext i j
    have hpt : φ y ∈ φ.target := φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hy
    have hsy : φ.symm (φ y) = y := φ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hy
    have hc : P (φ y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y (e j)) = t * H y i j := by
      rw [hPev _ hpt, inv1 y hy, inv1 y hy, hsy]
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, hproj, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← hc]
    show (g.g (φ y) + P (φ y)) _ _ = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    rfl
  · intro p ξ
    show (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ (g.g p + P p) ξ ξ ∧ (g.g p + P p) ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    have h1 := abs_le.1 (hPb p ξ)
    have h2 := hgnn p ξ
    constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) :
    (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ricci G i j) U) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (scalarCurvatureLocal G) U ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (staticSymLoc G f i j) U)

signature.name: local_geometry_contDiffOn
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) :
    (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ricci G i j) U) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (scalarCurvatureLocal G) U ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (staticSymLoc G f i j) U)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hpd : ∀ h : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U → ∀ c : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv c h) U := by
    intro h hh c
    have hD := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).mp hh).2
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ h y (e c)) U
    exact hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hdetgen : ∀ F : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F z i j) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (F z).det) U := by
    intro F hF
    simp only [Matrix.det_apply]
    refine ContDiffOn.sum (fun σ _ => ?_)
    simp only [Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
    refine contDiffOn_const.mul ?_
    have hp := contDiffOn_prod' (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)))
      (f := fun i z => F z (σ i) i) (s := U) (n := ∞) (fun i _ => hF _ _)
    refine hp.congr (fun z _ => ?_)
    simp [Finset.prod_apply]
  have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).adjugate i j) U := by
    intro i j
    simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
    refine hdetgen (fun z => (G z).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1)) ?_
    intro a b
    by_cases hab : a = j
    · subst hab
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
      exact contDiffOn_const
    · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
      exact hG a b
  have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) U := by
    intro i j
    have heq : (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) =
        fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹ * (G z).adjugate i j := by
      funext z
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact ((hdetgen _ hG).inv hdet).mul (hadj i j)
  have hpar : ∀ a b c : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y) U :=
    fun a b c => hpd _ (hG a b) c
  
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U := by
    intro k i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => christoffel G k i j y) U
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum (fun l _ =>
      (hinv k l).mul (((hpar j l i).add (hpar i l j)).sub (hpar i j l))))
  
  have hRic : ∀ j k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ricci G j k) U := by
    intro j k
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ricci G j k y) U
    unfold ricci
    refine (ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ?_)).add
      (ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun p _ =>
        ((hΓ i i p).mul (hΓ p j k)).sub ((hΓ i j p).mul (hΓ p i k)))))
    exact (hpd _ (hΓ i j k) i).sub (hpd _ (hΓ i i k) j)
  
  have hScal : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (scalarCurvatureLocal G) U := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => scalarCurvatureLocal G y) U
    unfold scalarCurvatureLocal
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hinv j k).mul (hRic j k)))
  
  have hdf : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv j f) U := fun j => hpd f hf j
  have hHess : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G f i j) U := by
    intro i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => hessLoc G f i j y) U
    unfold hessLoc
    exact (hpd _ (hdf j) i).sub (ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hΓ k i j).mul (hdf k)))
  have hLap : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lapLoc G f) U := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => lapLoc G f y) U
    unfold lapLoc
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => (hinv i j).mul (hHess i j)))
  have hSt : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (staticLoc G f i j) U := by
    intro i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => staticLoc G f i j y) U
    unfold staticLoc
    exact ((hf.mul (hRic i j)).sub (hHess i j)).add (hLap.mul (hG i j))
  have hSym : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (staticSymLoc G f i j) U := by
    intro i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => staticSymLoc G f i j y) U
    unfold staticSymLoc
    exact ((hSt i j).add (hSt j i)).div_const 2
  exact ⟨hΓ, hRic, hScal, hSym⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKφ : K ⊆ φ.source) (H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (hh : ∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K → h.g p = g.g p)
    (hcoeff : ∀ y ∈ φ.source, h.coeff φ y = g.coeff φ y + t • H y) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ h.scalarCurvature ∧
    (∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K → h.scalarCurvature p = g.scalarCurvature p) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ φ.source, h.scalarCurvature (φ y) =
      scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => g.coeff φ z + t • H z) y)

signature.name: scalarCurvature_of_local_deformation
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKφ : K ⊆ φ.source) (H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (hh : ∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K → h.g p = g.g p)
    (hcoeff : ∀ y ∈ φ.source, h.coeff φ y = g.coeff φ y + t • H y) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ h.scalarCurvature ∧
    (∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K → h.scalarCurvature p = g.scalarCurvature p) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ φ.source, h.scalarCurvature (φ y) =
      scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => g.coeff φ z + t • H z) y)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hloc : ∀ (G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y : E3), G =ᶠ[𝓝 y] G' →
      scalarCurvatureLocal G y = scalarCurvatureLocal G' y := by
    intro G G' y hGG
    have hpd : ∀ (z : E3) (f f' : E3 → ℝ), f =ᶠ[𝓝 z] f' →
        ∀ m, partialDeriv m f z = partialDeriv m f' z := by
      intro z f f' hf m
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hf.fderiv_eq]
    have hchr : ∀ z, G =ᶠ[𝓝 z] G' → ∀ k i j, christoffel G k i j z = christoffel G' k i j z := by
      intro z hz k i j
      have h0 : G z = G' z := hz.eq_of_nhds
      have hent : ∀ a b m, partialDeriv m (fun w => G w a b) z =
          partialDeriv m (fun w => G' w a b) z :=
        fun a b m => hpd z _ _ (hz.mono fun w hw => by simp only [hw]) m
      unfold christoffel
      simp only [h0, hent]
    have hchrev : ∀ k i j, christoffel G k i j =ᶠ[𝓝 y] christoffel G' k i j := fun k i j =>
      hGG.eventuallyEq_nhds.mono fun z hz => hchr z hz k i j
    have hP : ∀ a b c m, partialDeriv m (christoffel G a b c) y =
        partialDeriv m (christoffel G' a b c) y :=
      fun a b c m => hpd y _ _ (hchrev a b c) m
    have hV : ∀ a b c, christoffel G a b c y = christoffel G' a b c y :=
      fun a b c => (hchrev a b c).eq_of_nhds
    have hric : ∀ j k, ricci G j k y = ricci G' j k y := by
      intro j k
      unfold ricci
      simp only [hP, hV]
    have hGy : G y = G' y := hGG.eq_of_nhds
    unfold scalarCurvatureLocal
    simp only [hGy, hric]
  
  have hsmooth : ∀ g' : RiemannianMetric3 M,
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ g'.scalarCurvature := by
    intro g' x₀
    let c := chartAt E3 x₀
    let Φc : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      PartialDiffeomorph.mk c.symm.toPartialEquiv c.open_target c.open_source
        contMDiffOn_chart_symm contMDiffOn_chart
    have hform : ∀ y ∈ c.target,
        g'.scalarCurvature (c.symm y) = scalarCurvatureLocal (g'.coeff c.symm) y :=
      fun y hy => scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff g' Φc y hy
    have hloc_sm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (scalarCurvatureLocal (g'.coeff c.symm)) c.target :=
      (local_geometry_contDiffOn (g'.coeff c.symm) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) c.target c.open_target
        (fun i j => g'.smooth x₀ i j)
        (fun y hy => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g' x₀ y hy).det_pos.ne') contDiffOn_const).2.2.1
    have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g'.scalarCurvature (c.symm y)) c.target :=
      hloc_sm.congr fun y hy => hform y hy
    have hFM : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun y => g'.scalarCurvature (c.symm y)) c.target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mpr hF
    have hcomp : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
        ((fun y => g'.scalarCurvature (c.symm y)) ∘ c) c.source :=
      hFM.comp contMDiffOn_chart (fun x hx => c.map_source hx)
    have hR : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ g'.scalarCurvature c.source :=
      hcomp.congr fun x hx => by simp only [Function.comp, c.left_inv hx]
    exact hR.contMDiffAt (chart_source_mem_nhds E3 x₀)
  refine ⟨hsmooth h, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    have hcl : IsClosed (φ '' K) :=
      (hK.image_of_continuousOn (φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono hKφ)).isClosed
    let c := chartAt E3 p
    have hO : (φ '' K)ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 (c.symm (c p)) := by
      rw [c.left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)]
      exact hcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hp
    have hN : c.symm ⁻¹' (φ '' K)ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 (c p) :=
      (c.continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 p)).preimage_mem_nhds hO
    have hev : h.coeff c.symm =ᶠ[𝓝 (c p)] g.coeff c.symm := by
      filter_upwards [hN] with z hz
      have hz' := hh (c.symm z) hz
      unfold RiemannianMetric3.coeff coeffMatrix
      rw [hz']
    show scalarCurvatureLocal (h.coeff c.symm) (c p) = scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff c.symm) (c p)
    exact hloc _ _ _ hev
  · intro y hy
    rw [scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff h φ y hy]
    apply hloc

by
  obtain ⟨ε₀, C, hε₀, hC, hsol⟩ := cls_energy_solve g hComplete hAF k S hS φ K hK hKφ
  refine ⟨ε₀, C, min hAF.q (3 / 4), hε₀, hC, lt_min hAF.q_gt (by norm_num), ?_⟩
  intro h hh hequiv V f hV hf hVf hVb
  obtain ⟨v, hv, heq, hlim, hB, hP⟩ := hsol h hh hequiv V f hV hf hVf hVb
  refine ⟨v, hv, heq, ?_, hB, hP⟩
  intro j l hl
  obtain ⟨R, hR1, hlap⟩ := cls_far_harmonic g h hAF S hS hh V f v hv hVf heq j
  have hsrc : (hAF.ends j).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends j).source_eq
  have hsmooth : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ x a b) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro a b
    rw [← hsrc]
    exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g (hAF.ends j).Φ a b
  have hu0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) (hAF.ends j).Φ.source :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hv.comp_contMDiffOn (hAF.ends j).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun)
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by
    refine hu0.mono ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [hsrc]
    show 1 < ‖x‖
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hR1 hx
  exact cls_far_decay (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) hAF.q hAF.q_gt hsmooth
    (fun x a b => g.symm _ _ _) (hAF.decay j) (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) R hR1 hu hlap
    (hlim j) l hl

def fvChristoffelVar (G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (k i j : Fin 3) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
    (partialDeriv i (fun z => H z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => H z i l) y
      - partialDeriv l (fun z => H z i j) y)
  - ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k a * H y a b * christoffel G b i j y


def fvRicciVar (G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (j k : Fin 3) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fvChristoffelVar G H i j k) y
      - partialDeriv j (fvChristoffelVar G H i i k) y)
  + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3,
      (fvChristoffelVar G H i i p y * christoffel G p j k y
        + christoffel G i i p y * fvChristoffelVar G H p j k y
        - fvChristoffelVar G H i j p y * christoffel G p i k y
        - christoffel G i j p y * fvChristoffelVar G H p i k y)


def fvScalarVar (G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
      (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j a * H y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b k) * ricci G j k y
  + ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j k * fvRicciVar G H j k y


def fvField (G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (G y).det *
    (f y * (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j k * fvChristoffelVar G H i j k y
            - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * fvChristoffelVar G H k k j y)
     - ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i a * H y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b j
            - (G y)⁻¹ i j * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * H y a b)
          * partialDeriv j f y)

    (hKφ : K ⊆ φ.source) (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hh : ∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K → h.g p = g.g p)

      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ h.g p ξ ξ ∧ h.g p ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ)
    (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψharm : ∀ p : M, g.lapM ψ p = 0)
    (q₁ R₁ C₁ : ℝ) (hq₁ : 1 / 2 < q₁)
    (hψdec : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), R₁ < ‖x‖ →
      |ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) - (if j = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q₁) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) x‖ ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q₁ - 1))
    (v : M → ℝ) (hv : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v) (hvpos : ∀ p : M, 0 < 1 + v p)
    (hveq : ∀ p : M, -8 * h.lapM v p + h.scalarCurvature p * (1 + v p) = 0)
    (q' : ℝ) (hq' : 1 / 2 < q')
    (hvdec : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (l : ℕ), l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ (g' : RiemannianMetric3 M) (_ : g'.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF' : AsymptoticallyFlat g')
      (k' : Fin hAF'.numEnds),
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g'.scalarCurvature p) ∧
      Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => admFlux g' (hAF'.ends k') r) atTop
        (𝓝 (m - 1 / (2 * Real.pi) * ∫ y in K,
          (ψ (φ y) * h.lapM v (φ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det +
            ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
              ((h.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det -
                (g.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det) *
                partialDeriv i (fun z => ψ (φ z)) y * partialDeriv j (fun z => v (φ z)) y)))

signature.name: conformal_correction_mass
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR0 : ∀ p : M, g.scalarCurvature p = 0)
    (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (m : ℝ)
    (hm : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => admFlux g (hAF.ends k) r) atTop (𝓝 m))
    (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKφ : K ⊆ φ.source) (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hh : ∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K → h.g p = g.g p)
    (hheq : ∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3),
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ h.g p ξ ξ ∧ h.g p ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ)
    (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψharm : ∀ p : M, g.lapM ψ p = 0)
    (q₁ R₁ C₁ : ℝ) (hq₁ : 1 / 2 < q₁)
    (hψdec : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), R₁ < ‖x‖ →
      |ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) - (if j = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q₁) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) x‖ ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q₁ - 1))
    (v : M → ℝ) (hv : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v) (hvpos : ∀ p : M, 0 < 1 + v p)
    (hveq : ∀ p : M, -8 * h.lapM v p + h.scalarCurvature p * (1 + v p) = 0)
    (q' : ℝ) (hq' : 1 / 2 < q')
    (hvdec : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (l : ℕ), l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ (g' : RiemannianMetric3 M) (_ : g'.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF' : AsymptoticallyFlat g')
      (k' : Fin hAF'.numEnds),
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g'.scalarCurvature p) ∧
      Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => admFlux g' (hAF'.ends k') r) atTop
        (𝓝 (m - 1 / (2 * Real.pi) * ∫ y in K,
          (ψ (φ y) * h.lapM v (φ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det +
            ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
              ((h.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det -
                (g.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det) *
                partialDeriv i (fun z => ψ (φ z)) y * partialDeriv j (fun z => v (φ z)) y)))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun p => 1 + v p) := contMDiff_const.add hv
  have hwc : Continuous (fun p => 1 + v p) := hw.continuous
  obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := conformal_metric_exists h (fun p => 1 + v p) hw hvpos
  have hg'' : ∀ x, g'.g x = ((1 + v x) ^ 4) • h.g x := hg'
  have hcoeffg' : ∀ (P : E3 → M) (y : E3), g'.coeff P y = ((1 + v (P y)) ^ 4) • h.coeff P y := by
    intro P y
    ext i j
    show g'.g (P y) _ _ = (1 + v (P y)) ^ 4 * h.g (P y) _ _
    rw [hg'' (P y), ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hSK : IsCompact (φ '' K) :=
    hK.image_of_continuousOn (φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono hKφ)
  have hfar : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 2 ≤ ρ ∧
      ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∉ φ '' K := by
    intro j
    have key : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∉ φ '' K := by
      refine hSK.induction_on
        (p := fun s => ∃ ρ : ℝ, ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∉ s) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact ⟨0, fun y _ hy' => by simp at hy'⟩
      · rintro s t hst ⟨ρ, hρ⟩
        exact ⟨ρ, fun y hy hs => hρ y hy (hst hs)⟩
      · rintro s t ⟨ρ₁, h₁⟩ ⟨ρ₂, h₂⟩
        refine ⟨max ρ₁ ρ₂, fun y hy hst => ?_⟩
        rcases hst with hs | ht
        · exact h₁ y (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hy) hs
        · exact h₂ y (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hy) ht
      · intro x _
        obtain ⟨ρ, N, hN, hρ⟩ := end_chart_escape g hAF j x
        exact ⟨N, mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds hN, ρ, hρ⟩
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := key
    exact ⟨max ρ 2, le_max_right _ _, fun y hy => hρ y (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hy)⟩
  choose ρe hρe2 hρe using hfar
  have hhfar : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), ρe j < ‖y‖ →
      h.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y = g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y := by
    intro j y hy
    have e1 : h.g ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = g.g ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) := hh _ (hρe j y hy)
    ext a c
    show h.g ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) _ _ = g.g ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) _ _
    rw [e1]
  have hG'far : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), ρe j < ‖x‖ →
      g'.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ x = ((1 + v ((hAF.ends j).Φ x)) ^ 4) • g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ x := by
    intro j x hx
    rw [hcoeffg', hhfar j x hx]
  
  have hloc := scalarCurvature_of_local_deformation g h φ K hK hKφ
    (fun y => h.coeff φ y - g.coeff φ y) 1 hh (fun y _ => by simp)
  have hRh : ∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K → h.scalarCurvature p = 0 :=
    fun p hp => (hloc.2.1 p hp).trans (hR0 p)
  have hvloc : ∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K → h.lapM v p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    have e1 := hveq p
    rw [hRh p hp, zero_mul, add_zero] at e1
    linarith
  have hRg' : ∀ p : M, g'.scalarCurvature p = 0 := conformal_scalar_flat h g' v hv hvpos hg'' hveq
  
  have hsmall : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ →
      |v ((hAF.ends j).Φ x)| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro j
    have h0 := hvdec j 0 (by norm_num)
    have ht : Tendsto (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ))) (Bornology.cobounded E3) (𝓝 0) := by
      have e : (-q' - ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = -q' := by simp
      rw [e]
      exact (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < q')).comp tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop
    have hev := (h0.trans_tendsto ht).eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2))
    rw [← comap_norm_atTop, Filter.eventually_comap, Filter.eventually_atTop] at hev
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hev
    refine ⟨R, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hR _ hx.le x rfl
    simp only [Set.mem_Iio, norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1.le
  choose Rs hRs using hsmall
  obtain ⟨Kc, hKcdef⟩ : ∃ Kc : Set M, Kc = (⋃ j, (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ ∪
      ⋃ j, (hAF.ends j).Φ '' ({x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖} ∩ {x : E3 | ‖x‖ ≤ max 2 (Rs j)}) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKc : IsCompact Kc := by
    rw [hKcdef]
    refine hAF.isCompact_core.union (isCompact_iUnion fun j => ?_)
    have hcl : IsClosed ({x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖} ∩ {x : E3 | ‖x‖ ≤ max 2 (Rs j)}) :=
      (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
        (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)
    have hA : IsCompact ({x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖} ∩ {x : E3 | ‖x‖ ≤ max 2 (Rs j)}) := by
      refine (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) (max 2 (Rs j))).of_isClosed_subset hcl ?_
      intro x hx
      exact mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 hx.2
    refine hA.image_of_continuousOn ((hAF.ends j).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono ?_)
    intro x hx
    rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq]
    have hx1 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := hx.1
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖
    linarith
  have hout : ∀ p : M, p ∉ Kc → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + v p ∧ 1 + v p ≤ 3 / 2 := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hKcdef] at hp
    have h1 : p ∈ ⋃ j, (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} := by
      by_contra hc
      exact hp (Or.inl hc)
    obtain ⟨j, x, hx, rfl⟩ : ∃ j x, x ∈ {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} ∧ (hAF.ends j).Φ x = p := by
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 h1
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxp⟩ := hj
      exact ⟨j, x, hx, hxp⟩
    have hx2 : (2 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := hx
    have hxR : max 2 (Rs j) < ‖x‖ := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact hp (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, x, ⟨hx2.le, hc⟩, rfl⟩))
    have h3 := hRs j x (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hxR)
    obtain ⟨h4, h5⟩ := abs_le.1 h3
    constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hab⟩ : ∃ a b : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ ∀ p : M, a ≤ 1 + v p ∧ 1 + v p ≤ b := by
    rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty Kc with hE | hNE
    · exact ⟨1 / 2, 3 / 2, by norm_num, fun p => hout p (by simp [hE])⟩
    · obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hmin⟩ := hKc.exists_isMinOn hNE hwc.continuousOn
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hmax⟩ := hKc.exists_isMaxOn hNE hwc.continuousOn
      refine ⟨min (1 / 2) (1 + v p₁), max (3 / 2) (1 + v p₂),
        lt_min (by norm_num) (hvpos p₁), fun p => ?_⟩
      by_cases hp : p ∈ Kc
      · have hm1 : 1 + v p₁ ≤ 1 + v p := isMinOn_iff.1 hmin p hp
        have hm2 : 1 + v p ≤ 1 + v p₂ := isMaxOn_iff.1 hmax p hp
        exact ⟨(min_le_right _ _).trans hm1, hm2.trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hout p hp
        exact ⟨(min_le_left _ _).trans h1, h2.trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩
  
  have hgnn : ∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), 0 ≤ g.g p ξ ξ := by
    intro p ξ
    by_cases hξ : ξ = 0
    · subst hξ; simp
    · exact (g.posDef p ξ hξ).le
  have hC' : g'.IsCompleteRiemannian := by
    refine isCompleteRiemannian_of_equiv g g' (a ^ 4 / 2) (2 * b ^ 4)
      (div_pos (pow_pos ha 4) two_pos) ?_ ?_ hComplete
    · intro p ξ
      rw [hg'' p, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have h1 := (hheq p ξ).1
      have h2 : a ^ 4 ≤ (1 + v p) ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ ha.le (hab p).1 4
      have h3 := hgnn p ξ
      have hw4 : 0 ≤ (1 + v p) ^ 4 := by positivity
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 h3, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hw4]
    · intro p ξ
      rw [hg'' p, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have h1 := (hheq p ξ).2
      have h2 : (1 + v p) ^ 4 ≤ b ^ 4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (hvpos p).le (hab p).2 4
      have h4 : 0 ≤ h.g p ξ ξ := by linarith [(hheq p ξ).1, hgnn p ξ]
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ b ^ 4 := by positivity
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 h4, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hb0]
  
  have hsrc : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, (hAF.ends j).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
    fun j => (hAF.ends j).source_eq
  have hGsm : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (i l : Fin 3),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ x i l) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro j i l
    rw [← hsrc j]
    exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g _ i l
  have hvsm : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro j
    rw [← hsrc j]
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hv.comp_contMDiffOn (hAF.ends j).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun)
  have hψsm : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro j
    rw [← hsrc j]
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hψ.comp_contMDiffOn (hAF.ends j).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun)
  have hdec' : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (i l : Fin 3) (n : ℕ), n ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
        (fun y => g'.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y i l - if i = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-(min hAF.q q') - (n : ℝ)) := by
    intro j
    exact conformal_factor_decay (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) (g'.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ)
      (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) hAF.q q' (ρe j) (by linarith [hAF.q_gt]) (by linarith)
      (by linarith [hρe2 j]) (hGsm j) (hvsm j) (hAF.decay j) (hvdec j) (hG'far j)
  have hint' : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun x : E3 => g'.scalarCurvature ((hAF.ends j).Φ x) *
        Real.sqrt (g'.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ x).det) {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro j
    simp only [hRg', zero_mul]
    exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_zero
  
  have hm' : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => fluxLocal (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) r) atTop (𝓝 m) := hm
  have hD : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => fluxLocal (g'.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) r -
      fluxLocal (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) r -
      4 * fluxLocal (fun x => (1 + v ((hAF.ends k).Φ x)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) r)
      atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    conformal_flux_difference (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (g'.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ)
      (fun y => v ((hAF.ends k).Φ y)) hAF.q q' (ρe k) hAF.q_gt hq' (by linarith [hρe2 k])
      (hGsm k) (hvsm k) (hAF.decay k) (hvdec k) (hG'far k)
  
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ : ∃ I : ℝ, I = ∫ y in K, (ψ (φ y) * h.lapM v (φ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det +
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        ((h.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det -
          (g.coeff φ y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det) *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => ψ (φ z)) y * partialDeriv j (fun z => v (φ z)) y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : Fin hAF.numEnds → ℝ → ℝ, T = fun j c =>
      ∫ y : E3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det *
        ∑ e : Fin 3, (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y)⁻¹ a e *
          (ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) * partialDeriv e (fun z => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ z)) y -
            v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) * partialDeriv e (fun z => ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ z)) y)) *
          (y a / ‖y‖)) * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : Fin hAF.numEnds → ℝ → ℝ, S = fun j c =>
      ∫ y : E3, (∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ z)) y * (y a / ‖y‖)) *
        deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ρ₀, _hρ₀2, hsumT⟩ := green_flux_identity g h hAF φ K hK hKφ hh ψ v hψ hv hψharm hvloc
  have hsumT' : ∀ c : ℝ, ρ₀ ≤ c → ∑ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, T j c = I := by
    intro c hc
    rw [hT, hI]
    exact hsumT c hc
  have hshell : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds,
      Tendsto (fun c => T j c - (if j = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * S j c) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro j
    rw [hT, hS]
    exact end_shell_asymptotics (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y))
      (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) (if j = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) hAF.q q₁ q' R₁ C₁
      hAF.q_gt hq₁ hq' (hGsm j) (hψsm j) (hvsm j) (hAF.decay j) (hψdec j) (hvdec j)
  have hsum0 := tendsto_finset_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin hAF.numEnds)) (fun j _ => hshell j)
  rw [Finset.sum_const_zero] at hsum0
  have hSk : Tendsto (fun c => S k c) atTop (𝓝 I) := by
    have h1 := (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => I) atTop (𝓝 I)).sub hsum0
    rw [sub_zero] at h1
    refine h1.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop ρ₀] with c hc
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsumT' c hc]
    have e2 : ∑ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, (if j = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * S j c = S k c := by
      simp [ite_mul]
    rw [e2]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨Gu, hGu⟩ : ∃ Gu : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      Gu = fun x => (1 + v ((hAF.ends k).Φ x)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpdGu : ∀ (i a c : Fin 3) (y : E3), partialDeriv i (fun z => Gu z a c) y =
      if a = c then partialDeriv i (fun z => v ((hAF.ends k).Φ z)) y else 0 := by
    intro i a c y
    by_cases hac : a = c

    intro i j

        ∑ e : Fin 3, (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y)⁻¹ a e *

  have hsrc : (hAF.ends k).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends k).source_eq
  have hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro i j
    rw [← hsrc]
    exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g (hAF.ends k).Φ i j
  have hRe2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Re := hβ.2.2.1
  have hβpos : ∀ y : E3, Re < ‖y‖ → 0 < β ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) := hβ.2.2.2.1
  have hq0 : 0 < hAF.q := lt_trans (by norm_num) hAF.q_gt
  set q' := min hAF.q (3 / 4) with hq'def
  have hq'half : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < q' := lt_min hAF.q_gt (by norm_num)
  have hq'le : q' ≤ hAF.q := min_le_left _ _
  have hq'34 : q' ≤ 3 / 4 := min_le_right _ _
  have hq'lt1 : q' < 1 := by linarith
  have hopen : ∀ ρ : ℝ, IsOpen {z : E3 | ρ < ‖z‖} :=
    fun ρ => isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  obtain ⟨RG, CG, hRG1, hCG0, hb⟩ :=
    metric_coeff_bounds (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) hAF.q hq0 hsmooth (hAF.decay k)
  
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, -, hF₀⟩ :=
    coord_lap_bounds (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) hAF.q hq0 hsmooth RG CG hRG1 hCG0 hb
  
  obtain ⟨R₁, C₁, h, hRGR₁, hC₁, hh, hhb⟩ :=
    far_approx_harmonic (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) hAF.q q' hq'half hq'lt1 hq'le hsmooth
      RG CG hRG1 hCG0 hb
  
  obtain ⟨ρc, -, hcl⟩ := endChart_far_isClosed g hAF k
  obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = max (max (R₁ + 1) (Re + 1)) ρc := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have haR₁ : R₁ + 1 ≤ a := by rw [ha_def]; exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have haRe : Re + 1 ≤ a := by rw [ha_def]; exact le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have haρ : ρc ≤ a := by rw [ha_def]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hR₁1 : 1 ≤ R₁ := le_trans hRG1 hRGR₁
  
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, hu₀supp, hu₀h⟩ :=
    end_cutoff_extension (hAF.ends k) h R₁ a hR₁1 (by linarith) hh (hcl a haρ)
  
  have hloc : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f₁ f₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] f₂ → lapLoc G f₁ y = lapLoc G f₂ y := by
    intro G f₁ f₂ y hfe
    have h1 : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j f₁ y = partialDeriv j f₂ y := by
      intro j
      show fderiv ℝ f₁ y (e j) = fderiv ℝ f₂ y (e j)
      rw [hfe.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₁) y = partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₂) y := by
      intro i j
      have hev : partialDeriv j f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] partialDeriv j f₂ := by
        filter_upwards [hfe.eventuallyEq_nhds] with z hz
        show fderiv ℝ f₁ z (e j) = fderiv ℝ f₂ z (e j)
        rw [hz.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f₁) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f₂) y (e i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [lapLoc, hessLoc, h1, h2]
  
  have hdec : ∀ y : E3, a + 1 < ‖y‖ →
      |lapLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (fun z => u₀ ((hAF.ends k).Φ z)) y|
        ≤ C₁ * ‖y‖ ^ (-2 - (2 * q' - 1)) := by
    intro y hy
    have hev : (fun z => u₀ ((hAF.ends k).Φ z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] h := by
      filter_upwards [(hopen (a + 1)).mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact hu₀h z (le_of_lt (show a + 1 < ‖z‖ from hz))
    rw [hloc _ _ _ y hev]
    have hexp : (-2 - (2 * q' - 1) : ℝ) = -1 - 2 * q' := by ring
    rw [hexp]
    exact (hhb y (by linarith)).2
  
  obtain ⟨u, B, hu, hharm, hneu, hbd⟩ :=
    neumann_harmonic_correction g hAF k β Re hβ u₀ hu₀ a (by linarith) hu₀supp
      (2 * q' - 1) C₁ (a + 1) (by linarith) (by linarith) hdec
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by
    have hn : ‖(Re + 1) • e 0‖ = |Re + 1| := by
      simp [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    have hy0 : Re < ‖(Re + 1) • e 0‖ := by
      rw [hn, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      linarith
    exact le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hbd _ (le_of_lt (hβpos _ hy0)))
  
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ z)) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u ∘ (hAF.ends k).Φ) (hAF.ends k).Φ.source :=
      hu.comp_contMDiffOn (hAF.ends k).Φ.contMDiffOn
    have h2 := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    rw [hsrc] at h2
    exact h2
  
  have hharmEnd : ∀ y : E3, Re < ‖y‖ →
      lapLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (fun z => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ z)) y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hys : y ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by
      rw [hsrc]
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
      linarith
    have hinv := lapLocal_chart_invariant g (hAF.ends k).Φ u Set.univ isOpen_univ
      hu.contMDiffOn y hys trivial
    have h0 : g.lapM u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) = 0 := hharm _ (le_of_lt (hβpos y hy))
    have e1 : lapLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (fun z => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ z)) y =
        lapLocal (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (u ∘ (hAF.ends k).Φ) y := rfl
    have e2 : lapM g u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) = g.lapM u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) := rfl
    rw [e1, hinv, e2, h0]
  
  have hC0b : ∀ y : E3, a + 1 < ‖y‖ →
      |u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) - y 0| ≤ (B + C₁) * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q') := by
    intro y hy
    have hy1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖y‖ := by linarith
    have hpow : 1 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q') := Real.one_le_rpow hy1 (by linarith)
    have h1 : |u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) - u₀ ((hAF.ends k).Φ y)| ≤ B :=
      hbd _ (le_of_lt (hβpos y (by linarith)))
    have h2 : |h y - y 0| ≤ C₁ * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q') := (hhb y (by linarith)).1
    rw [hu₀h y (le_of_lt hy)] at h1
    have h3 : B ≤ B * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q') := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hB
      linarith
    calc |u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) - y 0|
        = |(u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) - h y) + (h y - y 0)| := by rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
      _ ≤ |u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) - h y| + |h y - y 0| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ B + C₁ * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q') := add_le_add h1 h2
      _ ≤ B * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q') + C₁ * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q') := by linarith
      _ = (B + C₁) * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q') := by ring
  
  have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hπ1 : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => z 0) z = if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro j z
    show fderiv ℝ (⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) z (e j) = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    show (e j) 0 = _
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, eq_comm]
  have hπ2 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => z 0)) z = 0 := by
    intro i j z
    have hc : partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => z 0) = fun _ => if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 :=
      funext (hπ1 j)
    rw [hc]
    show fderiv ℝ (fun _ : E3 => if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) z (e i) = 0
    rw [fderiv_const_apply]
    rfl
  have hfd : ∀ z : E3, 1 < ‖z‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ z)) z := by
    intro z hz
    exact (hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt ((hopen 1).mem_nhds hz)
  have hv1 : ∀ z : E3, 1 < ‖z‖ → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv j (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w) - w 0) z =
        partialDeriv j (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w)) z - (if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro z hz j
    rw [← hπ1 j z]
    show fderiv ℝ ((fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w)) - (fun w : E3 => w 0)) z (e j) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w)) z (e j) - fderiv ℝ (fun w : E3 => w 0) z (e j)
    have hπdz : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : E3 => w 0) z :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt
    rw [fderiv_sub (hfd z hz) hπdz]
    rfl
  have hv2 : ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w) - w 0)) x =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w))) x := by
    intro x hx i j
    have hev : partialDeriv j (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w) - w 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun z => partialDeriv j (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w)) z
          - (if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      filter_upwards [(hopen 1).mem_nhds hx] with z hz
      exact hv1 z hz j
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w) - w 0)) x (e i) =
      fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w))) x (e i)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_sub_const]
  have hlapv : ∀ z : E3, a + 1 < ‖z‖ →
      lapLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w) - w 0) z =
        -lapLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (fun w : E3 => w 0) z := by
    intro z hz
    have hz1 : 1 < ‖z‖ := by linarith
    have h0 := hharmEnd z (by linarith)
    unfold lapLoc hessLoc at h0 ⊢
    simp only [hv1 z hz1, hv2 z hz1, hπ1, hπ2] at h0 ⊢
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0 ⊢
    linear_combination h0
  
  have hA₀ : 0 ≤ B + C₁ + C₀ := by linarith
  have hvs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w) - w 0) {x : E3 | a + 1 < ‖x‖} :=
    (hf.mono (fun x (hx : a + 1 < ‖x‖) => (show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ by linarith))).sub hπ.contDiffOn
  have hv0 : ∀ x : E3, a + 1 < ‖x‖ →
      |u ((hAF.ends k).Φ x) - x 0| ≤ (B + C₁ + C₀) * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hC0b x hx
    have hp : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
    calc _ ≤ (B + C₁) * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') := h1
      _ ≤ (B + C₁ + C₀) * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hp
  have hL0 : ∀ x : E3, a + 1 < ‖x‖ →
      |lapLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w) - w 0) x|
        ≤ (B + C₁ + C₀) * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q' - 2) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hlapv x hx, abs_neg]
    have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have h1 := (hF₀ x (by linarith)).1
    have h2 : ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q' - 2) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx1 (by linarith)
    have hp : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q' - 2) := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
    calc _ ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1) := h1
      _ ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q' - 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hC₀
      _ ≤ (B + C₁ + C₀) * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q' - 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hp
  have hL1 : ∀ x : E3, a + 1 < ‖x‖ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ (lapLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w) - w 0)) x‖
        ≤ (B + C₁ + C₀) * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q' - 3) := by
    intro x hx
    have hev : lapLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w) - w 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        -lapLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (fun w : E3 => w 0) := by
      filter_upwards [(hopen (a + 1)).mem_nhds hx] with z hz
      exact hlapv z hz
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_neg, norm_neg]
    have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have h1 := (hF₀ x (by linarith)).2
    have h2 : ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 2) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q' - 3) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx1 (by linarith)
    have hp : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q' - 3) := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
    calc _ ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 2) := h1
      _ ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q' - 3) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hC₀
      _ ≤ (B + C₁ + C₀) * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q' - 3) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hp
  obtain ⟨R', C', hR', hC', hd⟩ :=
    exterior_scaled_estimate (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) hAF.q hq0 hsmooth RG CG hRG1 hCG0 hb
      (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w) - w 0) (1 - q') (B + C₁ + C₀) (a + 1) (by linarith) hA₀
      hvs hv0 hL0 hL1
  
  refine ⟨u, R', B + C₁ + C' + 1, by linarith, by linarith, hu, hharm, hneu, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hy2 : a + 1 < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt hR' hy
  have hy1 : (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := by linarith
  have hyR : Re < ‖y‖ := by linarith
  have hp1 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q') := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
  have hp2 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ (-q') := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
  have hp3 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ (-q' - 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
  refine ⟨hharmEnd y hyR, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc _ ≤ (B + C₁) * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q') := hC0b y hy2
      _ ≤ (B + C₁ + C' + 1) * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q') := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hp1
  · intro i
    have h1 := (hd y hy).1 i
    rw [hv1 y hy1 i] at h1
    have he : (1 - q' - 1 : ℝ) = -q' := by ring
    rw [he] at h1
    calc _ ≤ C' * ‖y‖ ^ (-q') := h1
      _ ≤ (B + C₁ + C' + 1) * ‖y‖ ^ (-q') := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hp2
  · intro i j
    have h2 : |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun w => u ((hAF.ends k).Φ w))) y|
        ≤ C' * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q' - 2) := by
      rw [← hv2 y hy1 i j]
      exact (hd y hy).2 i j
    have he : (1 - q' - 2 : ℝ) = -q' - 1 := by ring
    rw [he] at h2
    calc _ ≤ C' * ‖y‖ ^ (-q' - 1) := h2
      _ ≤ (B + C₁ + C' + 1) * ‖y‖ ^ (-q' - 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hp3

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_contDiffOn_source
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source

subgoal_signatures.name: metric_coeff_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R C : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
        |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: coord_lap_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)) :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0)) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ →
        |lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0) x| ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0)) x‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: far_approx_harmonic
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q q' : ℝ)
    (hq' : 1 / 2 < q') (hq'1 : q' < 1) (hqq : q' ≤ q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)) :
    ∃ (R₁ C₁ : ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ), R ≤ R₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
        |h x - x 0| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') ∧ |lapLoc G h x| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q')

subgoal_signatures.name: exterior_scaled_estimate
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2))
    (v : E3 → ℝ) (s A ρ : ℝ) (hρ : R ≤ ρ) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v {x : E3 | ρ < ‖x‖})

  obtain ⟨K, hKc, hSK, hKE, hfr, hconn, hKcl⟩ := hsep u t p₀ hu hp₀ hcpt htrans

      rw [hNe] at hmem

    have hqO : q ∈ N ∩ interior K := ⟨hqN, hqint⟩
    have hq0 := mfderiv_eq_zero_of_const_on_closure_interior u hu (N ∩ interior K) t

      (subset_closure (by rw [hOo.interior_eq]; exact hqO))
    exact hno q (hOS hqO) hq0

      rw [nhdsWithin_restrict' _ (hWo.mem_nhds hpW)]
