    have hextE : IsLocalMaxOn u {q : M | 0 ≤ β q} p ∨ IsLocalMinOn u {q : M | 0 ≤ β q} p := by
      rcases hext with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (IsMaxFilter.filter_mono h hle)
      · exact Or.inr (IsMinFilter.filter_mono h hle)
    have hβp : 0 ≤ β p := hKE hp.1
    rcases hβp.lt_or_eq with hpos | hzero

    have h2 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 (X y₀), hS.localInverse X L' y₀ x ∈ U := by
      have hc := hS.localInverse_continuousAt
      have hv : hS.localInverse X L' y₀ (X y₀) = y₀ := hS.localInverse_apply_image
      apply hc.preimage_mem_nhds
      rw [hv]; exact hU.mem_nhds hy₀U
    rw [hXy₀] at h1 h2
    filter_upwards [h1, h2, hW.mem_nhds hx₀] with x hx1 hx2 hx3
    obtain ⟨hYU, hXY⟩ := hYW x hx3
    exact hinj hYU hx2 (hXY.trans hx1.symm)
  
  have s4 : ∀ S : Set E3, IsOpen S → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v S → (∀ y ∈ S, partialDeriv 0 v y ≠ 0) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => cylPt (v z) (z 1) (z 2)) S ∧
        ∀ y ∈ S, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun z : E3 => cylPt (v z) (z 1) (z 2)) y) := by
    intro S hS hvS hd
    have hp1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z 1) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    have hp2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z 2) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold cylPt
      exact ((hvS.smul contDiffOn_const).add (hp1.contDiffOn.smul contDiffOn_const)).add
        (hp2.contDiffOn.smul contDiffOn_const)
    · intro y hy
      have hvd : DifferentiableAt ℝ v y :=
        (hvS.contDiffAt (hS.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hD : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => cylPt (v z) (z 1) (z 2))
          ((fderiv ℝ v y).smulRight (e 0) +
            (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 1) +
            (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 2)) y := by
        unfold cylPt
        exact ((hvd.hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e 0)).add
          ((EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e 1))).add
          ((EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e 2))
      rw [hD.fderiv]
      rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
      intro h hh
      have c1 := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w 1) hh
      have c2 := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w 2) hh
      have c0 := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w 0) hh
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply] at c0 c1 c2
      have hh0 : h = (h 0) • e 0 := by
        ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, c1, c2]
      have : fderiv ℝ v y h = h 0 * partialDeriv 0 v y := by
        rw [hh0, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]; simp [partialDeriv]
      rw [this] at c0
      have h00 : h 0 = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp c0 with h' | h'
        · exact h'
        · exact absurd h' (hd y hy)
      rw [hh0, h00, zero_smul]
  
  have coord_eq :
      (fun z : E3 => cylPt (v z) (z 1) (z 2) 0) = v ∧
      (fun z : E3 => cylPt (v z) (z 1) (z 2) 1) =
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∧
      (fun z : E3 => cylPt (v z) (z 1) (z 2) 2) =
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> funext z <;> simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have s5 : ∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ →
      ‖(fun y => cylPt (v y) (y 1) (y 2)) y - y‖ ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q) ∧
      (∀ i a : Fin 3,
        |partialDeriv i (fun z => (fun y => cylPt (v y) (y 1) (y 2)) z a) y
          - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (-q)) ∧
      (∀ i j a : Fin 3,
        |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j
          (fun w => (fun y => cylPt (v y) (y 1) (y 2)) w a) z) y| ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 1)) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := hb y hy
    obtain ⟨e0, e1, e2⟩ := coord_eq
    have hn1 : 0 ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (-q) := mul_nonneg hC.le (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
    have hn2 : 0 ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 1) := mul_nonneg hC.le (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
    have hlin : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (z : E3) (i : Fin 3),
        partialDeriv i (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) z = if i = a then 1 else 0 := by
      intro a z i
      simp only [partialDeriv, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, eq_comm]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : cylPt (v y) (y 1) (y 2) - y = (v y - y 0) • e 0 := by
        ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      simp only
      rw [this, norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact h0
    · intro i a
      fin_cases a
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta]
        rw [e0]; exact h1 i
      · simp only [Fin.mk_one]
        rw [e1, hlin]; simpa using hn1
      · show |partialDeriv i (fun z => cylPt (v z) (z 1) (z 2) 2) y - _| ≤ _
        rw [e2, hlin]; simpa using hn1
    · intro i j a
      fin_cases a
      · simp only [Fin.zero_eta]
        rw [e0]; exact h2 i j
      · simp only [Fin.mk_one]
        rw [e1]
        simp only [hlin]
        simp [partialDeriv]; exact hn2
      · show |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (fun w => cylPt (v w) (w 1) (w 2) 2) z) y|
          ≤ _
        rw [e2]
        simp only [hlin]
        simp [partialDeriv]; exact hn2
  
  have s2 : ∀ K R₀ : ℝ, K ≤ R₀ → ContinuousOn v {y : E3 | K < ‖y‖} →
      (∀ y : E3, K < ‖y‖ → |v y - y 0| ≤ ‖y‖ / 4) →
      ∀ x : E3, 2 * R₀ < ‖x‖ → ∃ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ ∧ cylPt (v y) (y 1) (y 2) = x := by
    intro K R₀ hKR hvc hcl x hx
    set h := ‖x‖ / 2 with hh
    have hzx : ∀ τ : ℝ, cylPt τ (x 1) (x 2) = x + (τ - x 0) • e 0 := by
      intro τ; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hnorm : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (x 0 - h) (x 0 + h),
        ‖x‖ / 2 ≤ ‖cylPt τ (x 1) (x 2)‖ ∧ ‖cylPt τ (x 1) (x 2)‖ ≤ 3 * ‖x‖ / 2 := by
      intro τ hτ
      have hab : |τ - x 0| ≤ h := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [hτ.1, hτ.2]
      have hn : ‖(τ - x 0) • e 0‖ = |τ - x 0| := by
        rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      rw [hzx]
      constructor
      · have := norm_sub_norm_le x (-((τ - x 0) • e 0))
        rw [sub_neg_eq_add, norm_neg, hn] at this
        linarith
      · have := norm_add_le x ((τ - x 0) • e 0)
        rw [hn] at this
        linarith
    have hcont : Continuous fun τ : ℝ => cylPt τ (x 1) (x 2) := by
      unfold cylPt; fun_prop
    have hφ : ContinuousOn (fun τ => v (cylPt τ (x 1) (x 2))) (Set.Icc (x 0 - h) (x 0 + h)) := by
      refine hvc.comp hcont.continuousOn ?_
      intro τ hτ
      show K < ‖cylPt τ (x 1) (x 2)‖
      have := (hnorm τ hτ).1
      linarith
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
    have hle : x 0 - h ≤ x 0 + h := by linarith
    have hlo : v (cylPt (x 0 - h) (x 1) (x 2)) ≤ x 0 := by
      have hm : x 0 - h ∈ Set.Icc (x 0 - h) (x 0 + h) := ⟨le_refl _, hle⟩
      obtain ⟨n1, n2⟩ := hnorm _ hm
      have := hcl _ (by linarith)
      rw [(K0 _ _ _).1] at this
      have := (abs_le.mp this).2
      linarith
    have hhi : x 0 ≤ v (cylPt (x 0 + h) (x 1) (x 2)) := by
      have hm : x 0 + h ∈ Set.Icc (x 0 - h) (x 0 + h) := ⟨hle, le_refl _⟩
      obtain ⟨n1, n2⟩ := hnorm _ hm
      have := hcl _ (by linarith)
      rw [(K0 _ _ _).1] at this
      have := (abs_le.mp this).1
      linarith
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hτv⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hle hφ ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    refine ⟨cylPt τ (x 1) (x 2), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := (hnorm τ hτ).1; linarith
    · obtain ⟨k0, k1, k2⟩ := K0 τ (x 1) (x 2)
      simp only at hτv
      rw [k1, k2, hτv, K1]
  
  have s1 : ∀ K : ℝ, 0 < K → (∀ y : E3, K < ‖y‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ v y) →
      (∀ y : E3, K < ‖y‖ → 1 / 2 ≤ partialDeriv 0 v y) →
      (∀ y : E3, K < ‖y‖ → |v y - y 0| ≤ ‖y‖ / 4) →
      Set.InjOn (fun y : E3 => cylPt (v y) (y 1) (y 2)) {y : E3 | 2 * K < ‖y‖} := by
    intro K hK hdiff hd0 hcl
    have key : ∀ y y' : E3, 2 * K < ‖y‖ → 2 * K < ‖y'‖ → y' 0 < y 0 → y 1 = y' 1 →
        y 2 = y' 2 → v y = v y' → False := by
      intro y y' hy hy' hlt h1 h2 hvv
      set t := y 0 with ht
      set t' := y' 0 with ht'
      set a := y 1 with ha
      set b := y 2 with hbb
      have hzn : ∀ s : ℝ, ‖cylPt s a b‖ ^ 2 = s ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
        intro s; rw [K2]; obtain ⟨k0, k1, k2⟩ := K0 s a b; rw [k0, k1, k2]
      have hyz : cylPt t a b = y := K1 y
      have hyz' : cylPt t' a b = y' := by rw [h1, h2]; exact K1 y'
      have hny : ‖y‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by rw [← hyz]; exact hzn t
      have hny' : ‖y'‖ ^ 2 = t' ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by rw [← hyz']; exact hzn t'
      have hyp : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hyp' : 0 ≤ ‖y'‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hsq : (2 * K) ^ 2 < ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hsq' : (2 * K) ^ 2 < ‖y'‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      by_cases hseg : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc t' t, K < ‖cylPt s a b‖
      · 
        have hzd : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => cylPt s a b) (e 0) s := by
          intro s
          unfold cylPt
          have := ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const (e 0)).add_const (a • e 1) |>.add_const (b • e 2)
          simpa using this
        have hψ : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc t' t,
            HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => v (cylPt s a b)) (partialDeriv 0 v (cylPt s a b)) s := by
          intro s hs
          have := (hdiff _ (hseg s hs)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hzd s)
          exact this
        obtain ⟨c, hc, hceq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun s : ℝ => v (cylPt s a b))
          (fun s => partialDeriv 0 v (cylPt s a b)) hlt
          (fun s hs => (hψ s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
          (fun s hs => hψ s (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hs))
        simp only [hyz, hyz', hvv, sub_self, zero_div] at hceq
        have := hd0 _ (hseg c (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hc))
        linarith
      · 
        push_neg at hseg
        obtain ⟨s, hs, hsK⟩ := hseg
        have hsK2 : ‖cylPt s a b‖ ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2 := by
          have := norm_nonneg (cylPt s a b); nlinarith
        rw [hzn] at hsK2
        have hρ : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≤ K ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg s]
        have ht'neg : t' < 0 := by
          by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
          have : t' ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hs.1]
          nlinarith
        have htpos : 0 < t := by
          by_contra hc; push_neg at hc
          have : t ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by nlinarith [hs.2]
          nlinarith
        have htK : K < t := by nlinarith
        have hyle : ‖y‖ ≤ t + K := by
          have : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (t + K) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
          nlinarith
        have hvy := hcl y (by linarith)
        have hvy' := (abs_le.mp hvy).1
        have hpos : 0 < v y := by linarith
        have ht'K : K < -t' := by nlinarith
        have hyle' : ‖y'‖ ≤ -t' + K := by
          have : ‖y'‖ ^ 2 ≤ (-t' + K) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
          nlinarith
        have hvy2 := hcl y' (by linarith)
        have hvy2' := (abs_le.mp hvy2).2
        have hneg : v y' < 0 := by linarith
        linarith
    intro y hy y' hy' hXX
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hy hy'
    have hv' := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w 0) hXX
    have h1 := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w 1) hXX
    have h2 := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w 2) hXX
    simp only [K0] at hv' h1 h2
    rcases lt_trichotomy (y 0) (y' 0) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exact (key y' y hy' hy hlt h1.symm h2.symm hv'.symm).elim
    · calc y = cylPt (y 0) (y 1) (y 2) := (K1 y).symm
        _ = cylPt (y' 0) (y' 1) (y' 2) := by rw [heq, h1, h2]
        _ = y' := K1 y'
    · exact (key y y' hy hy' hgt h1 h2 hv').elim
  
  set K := max R ((4 * C) ^ (1 / q)) with hKdef
  have hRK : R ≤ K := le_max_left _ _
  have hKa : (4 * C) ^ (1 / q) ≤ K := le_max_right _ _
  have hK0 : 0 < K := by linarith
  have htail := s6 K hKa
  have hopen : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} :=
    fun r => isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hd0 : ∀ z : E3, K < ‖z‖ → 1 / 2 ≤ partialDeriv 0 v z := by
    intro z hz
    have h := (hb z (by linarith)).2.1 0
    rw [if_pos rfl] at h
    have h' := (htail ‖z‖ hz).1
    have h'' := (abs_le.mp h).1
    linarith
  have hcl : ∀ z : E3, K < ‖z‖ → |v z - z 0| ≤ ‖z‖ / 4 := by
    intro z hz
    exact (hb z (by linarith)).1.trans (htail ‖z‖ hz).2
  have hvK : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v {y : E3 | K < ‖y‖} :=
    hv.mono (fun y hy => lt_of_le_of_lt hRK hy)
  have hdiff : ∀ y : E3, K < ‖y‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ v y := fun y hy =>
    (hvK.contDiffAt ((hopen K).mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hv2K : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v {y : E3 | 2 * K < ‖y‖} :=
    hv.mono (fun y hy => by
      have hy' : 2 * K < ‖y‖ := hy
      show R < ‖y‖
      linarith)
  obtain ⟨hXs, hXd⟩ := s4 {y : E3 | 2 * K < ‖y‖} (hopen _) hv2K (fun y hy => by
    have hy' : 2 * K < ‖y‖ := hy
    have := hd0 y (by linarith)
    exact ne_of_gt (by linarith))
  have hinj := s1 K hK0 hdiff hd0 hcl
  have hsurj := s2 K (2 * K) (by linarith) hvK.continuousOn hcl
  have hYW : ∀ x ∈ {x : E3 | 2 * (2 * K) < ‖x‖},
      Function.invFunOn (fun y : E3 => cylPt (v y) (y 1) (y 2)) {y : E3 | 2 * K < ‖y‖} x
          ∈ {y : E3 | 2 * K < ‖y‖} ∧
        (fun y : E3 => cylPt (v y) (y 1) (y 2))
          (Function.invFunOn (fun y : E3 => cylPt (v y) (y 1) (y 2))
            {y : E3 | 2 * K < ‖y‖} x) = x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hsurj x hx
    exact Function.invFunOn_pos ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩
  have hYs := s3 _ _ _ _ (hopen _) (hopen _) hXs hinj hXd hYW
  refine ⟨2 * K, 2 * (2 * K), C,
    Function.invFunOn (fun y : E3 => cylPt (v y) (y 1) (y 2)) {y : E3 | 2 * K < ‖y‖},
    by linarith, ?_⟩
  unfold CoordChange
  refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, hC, hXs, hYs, fun x hx => hYW x hx, hinj, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  exact s5 y (by linarith)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (hmin : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv β p = 0)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hharm : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → g.lapM u p = 0)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0)
    (hlev : NoCompactRegularLevel β u)
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hXY : CoordChange X Y (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R₀ R₁ C)
    (hRe : Re ≤ R₀)
    (hX : ∀ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ → X y = cylPt (u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y)) (y 1) (y 2)) :
    ∃ L₁ : ℝ, ∀ L : ℝ, L₁ ≤ L →
      0 ≤ sternBoundary (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (hmin : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv β p = 0)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hharm : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → g.lapM u p = 0)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0)
    (hlev : NoCompactRegularLevel β u)
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hXY : CoordChange X Y (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R₀ R₁ C)
    (hRe : Re ≤ R₀)
    (hX : ∀ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ → X y = cylPt (u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y)) (y 1) (y 2)) :
    ∃ L₁ : ℝ, ∀ L : ℝ, L₁ ≤ L →
      0 ≤ sternBoundary (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L

proof.tactics:
by
  have hq0 : 0 < min hAF.q (3 / 4) :=
    lt_min (lt_trans (by norm_num) hAF.q_gt) (by norm_num)
  have hq1 : min hAF.q (3 / 4) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by norm_num)
  have hesc := end_chart_escape g hAF k
  have hdom := stern_domain_facts (hAF.ends k) β u Re hβ X Y (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R₀ R₁ C
    hq0 hq1 hXY hRe hX hesc
  have hβc : Continuous β := hβ.1.continuous
  have huc : Continuous u := hu.continuous
  have hcomp : ∀ L : ℝ, R₁ < L → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < L →
      (∀ p ∈ sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t},
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0) →
      ∀ p₀ ∈ sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t},
        (connectedComponentIn (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}) p₀ ∩
          sternSide (hAF.ends k) Y L).Nonempty := by
    intro L hL t ht hreg p₀ hp₀
    exact level_components_reach_side (hAF.ends k) β u Y R₁ L t hβc huc hL ht
      (fun x hx => (hdom.1 x hx).1) (hdom.2 L hL).1 (hdom.2 L hL).2.2.1
      ((hdom.2 L hL).2.2.2 t ht) hlev hreg p₀ hp₀
  exact stern_inequality_of_components g hAF hR k β Re hβ hmin u hu hharm hneu
    X Y R₀ R₁ C hXY hRe hX hdom hcomp

    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_domain_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (Φ : EndChart M) (β u : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain Φ β Re)
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C) (hRe : Re ≤ R₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have fderiv_entry_partialDeriv_symm : ∀ (Y : E3 → E3) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
      (hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y U) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U) (a c i : Fin 3),
      partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x =
        partialDeriv a (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e c)) i) x := by
    intro Y U hU hY x hx a c i
    have hYx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y x := hY.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    have hS : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ Y x := hYx.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    have hD1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ Y) x := hYx.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by
      change ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞)
      exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Y) x := hD1.differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have key : ∀ (u : E3) (k : Fin 3), partialDeriv k (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z u) i) x =
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Y) x (e k) u) i := by
      intro u k
      let L : (E3 →L[ℝ] E3) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj i).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 u)
      have h := L.hasFDerivAt.comp x hD.hasFDerivAt
      have hfun : (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z u) i) = L ∘ fderiv ℝ Y := rfl
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hfun, h.fderiv]
      rfl
    rw [key (e a) c, key (e c) a, hS (e c) (e a)]
  
  have pullback_christoffel_algebra : ∀ (J A P g : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (dG M dH : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (hJA : J * A = 1) (hPg : P * g = 1)
      (hg : ∀ i j : Fin 3, g i j = g j i)
      (hM : ∀ c i a : Fin 3, M c i a = M a i c)
      (hdH : ∀ c a b : Fin 3, dH c a b = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (M c i a * g i j * J j b + J i a * (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dG k i j) * J j b
          + J i a * g i j * M c j b)) (c a b : Fin 3),
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (A * P * A.transpose) c l * (dH a b l + dH b a l - dH l a b) =
        ∑ p : Fin 3, A c p * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * J j b *
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, P p l * (dG i j l + dG j i l - dG l i j)) + M a p b) := by
    intro J A P g dG M dH hJA hPg hg hM hdH c a b
    set Hi := A * P * A.transpose with hHi
    have hdH' : ∀ c a b, dH c a b = (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M c i a * g i j * J j b)
        + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, J i a * J k c * dG k i j * J j b)
        + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M c i b * g i j * J j a) := by
      intro c a b
      rw [hdH]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [hg 1 0, hg 2 0, hg 2 1]
      ring
    have hN : ∀ c a b, (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M c i a * g i j * J j b)
        = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M a i c * g i j * J j b := by
      intro c a b
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
      rw [hM]
    have hK : ∀ l, dH a b l + dH b a l - dH l a b
        = 2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M a i b * g i j * J j l)
          + ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, J i b * J k a * dG k i j * J j l)
            + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, J i a * J k b * dG k i j * J j l)
            - (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, J i a * J k l * dG k i j * J j b)) := by
      intro l
      rw [hdH' a b l, hdH' b a l, hdH' l a b, hN a l b, hN b l a, hN b a l]
      ring
    have hgT : g.transpose = g := by
      ext i j
      rw [Matrix.transpose_apply, hg j i]
    have HJ : Hi * J.transpose = A * P := by
      rw [hHi, Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, hJA, Matrix.transpose_one,
        Matrix.mul_one]
    have HJg : Hi * J.transpose * g.transpose = A := by
      rw [HJ, hgT, Matrix.mul_assoc, hPg, Matrix.mul_one]
    have hf : ∀ m, ∑ l : Fin 3, Hi c l * J m l = ∑ p : Fin 3, A c p * P p m := by
      intro m
      have h := congrFun (congrFun HJ c) m
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h
      exact h
    have he : ∀ i, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ l : Fin 3, Hi c l * J j l) * g i j = A c i := by
      intro i
      have h := congrFun (congrFun HJg c) i
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h
      exact h
    simp only [hK]
    linear_combination (norm := skip) (M a 0 b) * he 0 + (M a 1 b) * he 1 + (M a 2 b) * he 2
      + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * J j b * (dG i j 0 + dG j i 0 - dG 0 i j))
        * hf 0
      + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * J j b * (dG i j 1 + dG j i 1 - dG 1 i j))
        * hf 1
      + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * J j b * (dG i j 2 + dG j i 2 - dG 2 i j))
        * hf 2
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have gauge_contraction_algebra : ∀ (J A P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (Γ M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (w : Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (hJA : J * A = 1)
      (hid : ∀ c a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3,
        ((∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * D k i) * J i a + w i * M c i a) = 0),
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (A * P * A.transpose) a b *
        ∑ p : Fin 3, w p * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * J j b * Γ p i j + M a p b) =
      -(∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (D i j - ∑ k : Fin 3, Γ k i j * w k)) := by
    intro J A P Γ M D w hJA hid
    set Hi := A * P * A.transpose with hHi
    have hmat : J * Hi * J.transpose = P := by
      rw [hHi, show J * (A * P * A.transpose) * J.transpose = (J * A) * P * (J * A).transpose by
        simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]]
      rw [hJA, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.mul_one]
    have hsand : ∀ i j, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, J i a * Hi a b * J j b = P i j := by
      intro i j
      have h := congrFun (congrFun hmat i) j
      rw [← h]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hF : ∀ a b, ∑ p : Fin 3, w p *
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * J j b * Γ p i j + M a p b)
        = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * J j b * (∑ p : Fin 3, w p * Γ p i j - D i j) := by
      intro a b
      have h := hid a b
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h ⊢
      linear_combination h
    calc _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Hi a b *
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * J j b * (∑ p : Fin 3, w p * Γ p i j - D i j) := by
            simp only [hF]
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, J i a * Hi a b * J j b) *
            (∑ p : Fin 3, w p * Γ p i j - D i j) := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
      _ = _ := by
            simp only [hsand]
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
            ring
  intro x hx
  set X : E3 → E3 := fun y => cylPt (v y) (y 1) (y 2) with hXdef
  have hXY' := hXY
  obtain ⟨_hR0, _hR01, _hC, _hXs, hYs, hinv, _hinj, _hbd⟩ := hXY'
  have hU : IsOpen {z : E3 | R₁ < ‖z‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hW : IsOpen {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hyV : R₀ < ‖Y x‖ := (hinv x hx).1
  have hyW : R < ‖Y x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt hRR₀ hyV
  
  have hX0 : (fun w' => X w' 0) = v := by
    funext w'
    simp [hXdef, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  have hdetG : (G (Y x)).det ≠ 0 := hdet (Y x) hyW
  have hu : IsUnit (G (Y x)).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdetG
  have hPg : (G (Y x))⁻¹ * G (Y x) = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (G (Y x)) hu
  have hgP : G (Y x) * (G (Y x))⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G (Y x)) hu
  have hg : ∀ i j : Fin 3, G (Y x) i j = G (Y x) j i := hsymm (Y x)
  
  obtain ⟨-, hreg⟩ := coordChange_regularity (fun _ => (0 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
    (fun _ _ => contDiffOn_const) X Y q R₀ R₁ C hXY
  obtain ⟨hYx, _hXYx, hB, hA, -⟩ := hreg x hx
  have hGd : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x) := fun i j =>
    ((hG i j).contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hyW)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  obtain ⟨hid1, hid2⟩ := inverse_jacobian_identities X Y {z : E3 | R₁ < ‖z‖} hU
    (fun z hz => (hinv z hz).2) (fun z hz => (hreg z hz).1) (fun z hz => (hreg z hz).2.1)
    x hx hA hB
  
  set J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := Matrix.of fun i a => (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i with hJ
  set A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun d i => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) (Y x) with hAdef
  have hAJ : A * J = 1 := by
    ext d a
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    simpa [hJ, hAdef, Matrix.one_apply] using hid1 d a
  have hJA : J * A = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hAJ
  have hHx : pullbackMetric G Y x = J.transpose * G (Y x) * J := by
    ext a b
    simp only [pullbackMetric, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply,
      Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have hHinv : (pullbackMetric G Y x)⁻¹ = A * (G (Y x))⁻¹ * A.transpose := by
    rw [hHx]
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
    calc J.transpose * G (Y x) * J * (A * (G (Y x))⁻¹ * A.transpose)
        = J.transpose * (G (Y x) * ((J * A) * ((G (Y x))⁻¹ * A.transpose))) := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by
          rw [hJA, Matrix.one_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (G (Y x)), hgP, Matrix.one_mul,
            ← Matrix.transpose_mul, hAJ, Matrix.transpose_one]
  
  have hM : ∀ c i a : Fin 3, partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x
      = partialDeriv a (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e c)) i) x := fun c i a =>
    fderiv_entry_partialDeriv_symm Y {z : E3 | R₁ < ‖z‖} hU hYs x hx a c i
  have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 3, christoffel (pullbackMetric G Y) 0 a b x =
      ∑ p : Fin 3, A 0 p * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * J j b * christoffel G p i j (Y x)
        + partialDeriv a (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) p) x) := by
    intro a b
    have h5 := pullback_christoffel_algebra J A (G (Y x))⁻¹ (G (Y x))
      (fun k i j => partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x))
      (fun c i a => partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x)
      (fun c a b => partialDeriv c (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b) x)
      hJA hPg hg hM (fun c a b => pullbackMetric_partialDeriv G Y x hYx hB hGd a b c) 0 a b
    unfold christoffel
    rw [hHinv]
    exact h5
  
  have h6 := gauge_contraction_algebra J A (G (Y x))⁻¹
    (fun p i j => christoffel G p i j (Y x))
    (fun c i a => partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x)
    (fun k i => partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' 0) z) (Y x))
    (fun p => A 0 p) hJA (fun c a => hid2 c 0 a)
  have hlap := hharm (Y x) hyW
  calc ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (pullbackMetric G Y x)⁻¹ a b * christoffel (pullbackMetric G Y) 0 a b x
      = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (A * (G (Y x))⁻¹ * A.transpose) a b *
          ∑ p : Fin 3, A 0 p * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            J i a * J j b * christoffel G p i j (Y x)
              + partialDeriv a (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) p) x) := by
        rw [hHinv]
        simp only [hc]
    _ = -(∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (Y x))⁻¹ i j *
          (partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (fun w' => X w' 0) z) (Y x)
            - ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j (Y x) * A 0 k)) := h6
    _ = -(lapLoc G v (Y x)) := by
        simp only [lapLoc, hessLoc, hAdef, Matrix.of_apply, hX0]
    _ = 0 := by rw [hlap, neg_zero]

subgoal_signatures.name: inverse_jacobian_identities
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(X Y : E3 → E3) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hinv : ∀ z ∈ U, X (Y z) = z) (hY : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ Y z)
    (hX : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ X (Y z)) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hA : ∀ d i : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x))
    (hB : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) :
    (∀ d a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y x) * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i
        = if d = a then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ c d a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3,
        ((∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k *
            partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) z) (Y x)) *
            (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i
          + partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y x) *
            partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: pullbackMetric_partialDeriv
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3) (x : E3)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x)
    (hB : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)) (a b c : Fin 3) :
    partialDeriv c (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b) x =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x * G (Y x) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j
          + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i *
              (∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k * partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)) *
              (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j
          + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * G (Y x) i j *
              partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j) x)

informal_problem.statement:
(γ γi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (L s ε η : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 20)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hγ : ∀ a b : Fin 2, |γ a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε)
    (hγi : ∀ a b : Fin 2, |γi a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 2 * ε)
    (hγi2 : ∀ a b : Fin 2,
      |γi a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + (γ a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0))|
        ≤ 7 * ε ^ 2)
    (hd : ∀ c a b : Fin 2, L * |d c a b| ≤ η) :
    |curvKappa γ γi d L s - 1 - curvLinAlg γ d L s| ≤ 200 * (ε ^ 2 + ε * η)

signature.name: curv_pointwise_expansion
signature.statement:
(γ γi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (L s ε η : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 20)
    (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hγ : ∀ a b : Fin 2, |γ a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε)
    (hγi : ∀ a b : Fin 2, |γi a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 2 * ε)
    (hγi2 : ∀ a b : Fin 2,
      |γi a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + (γ a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0))|
        ≤ 7 * ε ^ 2)
    (hd : ∀ c a b : Fin 2, L * |d c a b| ≤ η) :
    |curvKappa γ γi d L s - 1 - curvLinAlg γ d L s| ≤ 200 * (ε ^ 2 + ε * η)

proof.tactics:
by
  have sqrt_aux : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → 16 / 25 ≤ x ^ 2 → 4 / 5 ≤ x := by
    intro x hx h; nlinarith
  have prod_aux : ∀ a b : ℝ, 4 / 5 ≤ a → 4 / 5 ≤ b → 16 / 25 ≤ a * b := by
    intro a b ha hb; nlinarith
  have hε2 : ε ^ 2 ≤ ε / 20 := by nlinarith
  have hcs : Real.cos s ^ 2 + Real.sin s ^ 2 = 1 := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq s
  have hC1 : |Real.cos s| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_cos_le_one s
  have hS1 : |Real.sin s| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_sin_le_one s
  have hnS1 : |-Real.sin s| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_neg]; exact hS1
  have c00 : (if (0 : Fin 2) = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 1 := if_pos rfl
  have c11 : (if (1 : Fin 2) = 1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 1 := if_pos rfl
  have c01 : (if (0 : Fin 2) = 1 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  have c10 : (if (1 : Fin 2) = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
  
  have k00 : |γ 0 0 - 1| ≤ ε := by have h := hγ 0 0; rwa [c00] at h
  have k11 : |γ 1 1 - 1| ≤ ε := by have h := hγ 1 1; rwa [c11] at h
  have k01 : |γ 0 1| ≤ ε := by have h := hγ 0 1; rwa [c01, sub_zero] at h
  have k10 : |γ 1 0| ≤ ε := by have h := hγ 1 0; rwa [c10, sub_zero] at h
  have i00 : |γi 0 0 - 1| ≤ 2 * ε := by have h := hγi 0 0; rwa [c00] at h
  have i11 : |γi 1 1 - 1| ≤ 2 * ε := by have h := hγi 1 1; rwa [c11] at h
  have i01 : |γi 0 1| ≤ 2 * ε := by have h := hγi 0 1; rwa [c01, sub_zero] at h
  have i10 : |γi 1 0| ≤ 2 * ε := by have h := hγi 1 0; rwa [c10, sub_zero] at h
  have p00 : |γi 0 0 - 1 + (γ 0 0 - 1)| ≤ 7 * ε ^ 2 := by have h := hγi2 0 0; rwa [c00] at h
  have p11 : |γi 1 1 - 1 + (γ 1 1 - 1)| ≤ 7 * ε ^ 2 := by have h := hγi2 1 1; rwa [c11] at h
  have p01 : |γi 0 1 + γ 0 1| ≤ 7 * ε ^ 2 := by
    have h := hγi2 0 1; rwa [c01, sub_zero, sub_zero] at h
  have p10 : |γi 1 0 + γ 1 0| ≤ 7 * ε ^ 2 := by
    have h := hγi2 1 0; rwa [c10, sub_zero, sub_zero] at h
  have hd' : ∀ c a b : Fin 2, |L * d c a b| ≤ η := by
    intro c a b; rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hL]; exact hd c a b
  
  have abs4 : ∀ a b c f : ℝ, |a + b + c + f| ≤ |a| + |b| + |c| + |f| := by
    intro a b c f
    have h1 := abs_add_le (a + b + c) f
    have h2 := abs_add_le (a + b) c
    have h3 := abs_add_le a b
    linarith
  have abs8 : ∀ a b c f g h i j : ℝ, |a + b + c + f + g + h + i + j|
      ≤ |a| + |b| + |c| + |f| + |g| + |h| + |i| + |j| := by
    intro a b c f g h i j
    have h1 := abs_add_le (a + b + c + f + g + h + i) j
    have h2 := abs_add_le (a + b + c + f + g + h) i
    have h3 := abs_add_le (a + b + c + f + g) h
    have h4 := abs_add_le (a + b + c + f) g
    have h5 := abs4 a b c f
    linarith
  have t1 : ∀ x m μ : ℝ, |x| ≤ 1 → |m| ≤ μ → |x * m| ≤ μ := by
    intro x m μ hx hm
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc |x| * |m| ≤ 1 * μ := mul_le_mul hx hm (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = μ := one_mul μ
  have t2 : ∀ x y m μ : ℝ, |x| ≤ 1 → |y| ≤ 1 → |m| ≤ μ → |x * y * m| ≤ μ := by
    intro x y m μ hx hy hm
    rw [abs_mul (x * y), abs_mul]
    have hxy : |x| * |y| ≤ 1 := mul_le_one₀ hx (abs_nonneg _) hy
    calc |x| * |y| * |m| ≤ 1 * μ := mul_le_mul hxy hm (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = μ := one_mul μ
  have t3 : ∀ x y z m μ : ℝ, |x| ≤ 1 → |y| ≤ 1 → |z| ≤ 1 → |m| ≤ μ → |x * y * z * m| ≤ μ := by
    intro x y z m μ hx hy hz hm
    rw [abs_mul (x * y * z), abs_mul (x * y), abs_mul]
    have hxy : |x| * |y| ≤ 1 := mul_le_one₀ hx (abs_nonneg _) hy
    have hxyz : |x| * |y| * |z| ≤ 1 := mul_le_one₀ hxy (abs_nonneg _) hz
    calc |x| * |y| * |z| * |m| ≤ 1 * μ := mul_le_mul hxyz hm (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = μ := one_mul μ
  have quad : ∀ m00 m01 m10 m11 x0 x1 μ : ℝ, |m00| ≤ μ → |m01| ≤ μ → |m10| ≤ μ → |m11| ≤ μ →
      |m00 * x0 * x0 + m01 * x0 * x1 + m10 * x1 * x0 + m11 * x1 * x1|
        ≤ μ * (|x0| + |x1|) ^ 2 := by
    intro m00 m01 m10 m11 x0 x1 μ h00 h01 h10 h11
    have tt : ∀ m x y : ℝ, |m| ≤ μ → |m * x * y| ≤ μ * (|x| * |y|) := by
      intro m x y hm
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))
    have a1 := tt m00 x0 x0 h00
    have a2 := tt m01 x0 x1 h01
    have a3 := tt m10 x1 x0 h10
    have a4 := tt m11 x1 x1 h11
    have e : μ * (|x0| + |x1|) ^ 2 = μ * (|x0| * |x0|) + μ * (|x0| * |x1|)
        + μ * (|x1| * |x0|) + μ * (|x1| * |x1|) := by ring
    rw [e]
    exact (abs4 _ _ _ _).trans (by linarith)
  have hSS : (|Real.cos s| + |Real.sin s|) ^ 2 ≤ 2 := by
    have h1 := sq_nonneg (|Real.cos s| - |Real.sin s|)
    have h2 := sq_abs (Real.cos s)
    have h3 := sq_abs (Real.sin s)
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨kn, hkn⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = (γ 0 0 - 1) * Real.cos s * Real.cos s
      + γ 0 1 * Real.cos s * Real.sin s + γ 1 0 * Real.sin s * Real.cos s
      + (γ 1 1 - 1) * Real.sin s * Real.sin s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨be, hbe⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = (γ 0 0 - 1) * (-Real.sin s) * (-Real.sin s)
      + γ 0 1 * (-Real.sin s) * Real.cos s + γ 1 0 * Real.cos s * (-Real.sin s)
      + (γ 1 1 - 1) * Real.cos s * Real.cos s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨al, hal⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = (γi 0 0 - 1) * Real.cos s * Real.cos s
      + γi 0 1 * Real.cos s * Real.sin s + γi 1 0 * Real.sin s * Real.cos s
      + (γi 1 1 - 1) * Real.sin s * Real.sin s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨rho, hrho⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = (γi 0 0 - 1 + (γ 0 0 - 1)) * Real.cos s * Real.cos s
      + (γi 0 1 + γ 0 1) * Real.cos s * Real.sin s + (γi 1 0 + γ 1 0) * Real.sin s * Real.cos s
      + (γi 1 1 - 1 + (γ 1 1 - 1)) * Real.sin s * Real.sin s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hknb : |kn| ≤ 2 * ε := by
    rw [hkn]
    refine (quad _ _ _ _ _ _ _ k00 k01 k10 k11).trans ?_
    calc ε * (|Real.cos s| + |Real.sin s|) ^ 2 ≤ ε * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSS hε0
      _ = 2 * ε := by ring
  have hbeb : |be| ≤ 2 * ε := by
    rw [hbe]
    refine (quad _ _ _ _ _ _ _ k00 k01 k10 k11).trans ?_
    rw [abs_neg, add_comm (|Real.sin s|)]
    calc ε * (|Real.cos s| + |Real.sin s|) ^ 2 ≤ ε * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSS hε0
      _ = 2 * ε := by ring
  have hrhob : |rho| ≤ 14 * ε ^ 2 := by
    rw [hrho]
    refine (quad _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p00 p01 p10 p11).trans ?_
    calc 7 * ε ^ 2 * (|Real.cos s| + |Real.sin s|) ^ 2 ≤ 7 * ε ^ 2 * 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSS (by positivity)
      _ = 14 * ε ^ 2 := by ring
  have halr : al = rho - kn := by rw [hal, hrho, hkn]; ring
  
  obtain ⟨T1, hT1⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x =
      (-Real.sin s) * (-Real.sin s) * Real.cos s * (L * d 0 0 0)
      + (-Real.sin s) * (-Real.sin s) * Real.sin s * (L * d 0 0 1)
      + (-Real.sin s) * Real.cos s * Real.cos s * (L * d 0 1 0)
      + (-Real.sin s) * Real.cos s * Real.sin s * (L * d 0 1 1)
      + Real.cos s * (-Real.sin s) * Real.cos s * (L * d 1 0 0)
      + Real.cos s * (-Real.sin s) * Real.sin s * (L * d 1 0 1)
      + Real.cos s * Real.cos s * Real.cos s * (L * d 1 1 0)
      + Real.cos s * Real.cos s * Real.sin s * (L * d 1 1 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T2, hT2⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x =
      Real.cos s * (-Real.sin s) * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 0 0 0)
      + Real.cos s * (-Real.sin s) * Real.cos s * (L * d 0 0 1)
      + Real.cos s * Real.cos s * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 0 1 0)
      + Real.cos s * Real.cos s * Real.cos s * (L * d 0 1 1)
      + Real.sin s * (-Real.sin s) * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 1 0 0)
      + Real.sin s * (-Real.sin s) * Real.cos s * (L * d 1 0 1)
      + Real.sin s * Real.cos s * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 1 1 0)
      + Real.sin s * Real.cos s * Real.cos s * (L * d 1 1 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A0, hA0⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x =
      (-Real.sin s) * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 0 0 0) + (-Real.sin s) * Real.cos s * (L * d 0 1 0)
      + Real.cos s * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 1 0 0) + Real.cos s * Real.cos s * (L * d 1 1 0) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B0, hB0⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x =
      (-Real.sin s) * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 0 0 0) + (-Real.sin s) * Real.cos s * (L * d 0 0 1)
      + Real.cos s * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 0 1 0) + Real.cos s * Real.cos s * (L * d 0 1 1) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A1, hA1⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x =
      (-Real.sin s) * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 0 0 1) + (-Real.sin s) * Real.cos s * (L * d 0 1 1)
      + Real.cos s * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 1 0 1) + Real.cos s * Real.cos s * (L * d 1 1 1) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B1, hB1⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x =
      (-Real.sin s) * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 1 0 0) + (-Real.sin s) * Real.cos s * (L * d 1 0 1)
      + Real.cos s * (-Real.sin s) * (L * d 1 1 0) + Real.cos s * Real.cos s * (L * d 1 1 1) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m0, hm0⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = Real.cos s * (γi 0 0 - 1) + Real.sin s * γi 1 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m1, hm1⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = Real.cos s * γi 0 1 + Real.sin s * (γi 1 1 - 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Dd, hDd⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = -T1 + T2 / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Ee, hEe⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = -(m0 * (A0 - 1 / 2 * B0) + m1 * (A1 - 1 / 2 * B1)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT1b : |T1| ≤ 8 * η := by
    rw [hT1]
    refine (abs8 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    linarith [t3 _ _ _ _ _ hnS1 hnS1 hC1 (hd' 0 0 0), t3 _ _ _ _ _ hnS1 hnS1 hS1 (hd' 0 0 1),
      t3 _ _ _ _ _ hnS1 hC1 hC1 (hd' 0 1 0), t3 _ _ _ _ _ hnS1 hC1 hS1 (hd' 0 1 1),
      t3 _ _ _ _ _ hC1 hnS1 hC1 (hd' 1 0 0), t3 _ _ _ _ _ hC1 hnS1 hS1 (hd' 1 0 1),
      t3 _ _ _ _ _ hC1 hC1 hC1 (hd' 1 1 0), t3 _ _ _ _ _ hC1 hC1 hS1 (hd' 1 1 1)]
  have hT2b : |T2| ≤ 8 * η := by
    rw [hT2]
    refine (abs8 _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    linarith [t3 _ _ _ _ _ hC1 hnS1 hnS1 (hd' 0 0 0), t3 _ _ _ _ _ hC1 hnS1 hC1 (hd' 0 0 1),
      t3 _ _ _ _ _ hC1 hC1 hnS1 (hd' 0 1 0), t3 _ _ _ _ _ hC1 hC1 hC1 (hd' 0 1 1),
      t3 _ _ _ _ _ hS1 hnS1 hnS1 (hd' 1 0 0), t3 _ _ _ _ _ hS1 hnS1 hC1 (hd' 1 0 1),
      t3 _ _ _ _ _ hS1 hC1 hnS1 (hd' 1 1 0), t3 _ _ _ _ _ hS1 hC1 hC1 (hd' 1 1 1)]
  have hDb : |Dd| ≤ 12 * η := by
    obtain ⟨l1, u1⟩ := abs_le.mp hT1b
    obtain ⟨l2, u2⟩ := abs_le.mp hT2b
    rw [hDd, abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hA0b : |A0| ≤ 4 * η := by
    rw [hA0]
    refine (abs4 _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    linarith [t2 _ _ _ _ hnS1 hnS1 (hd' 0 0 0), t2 _ _ _ _ hnS1 hC1 (hd' 0 1 0),
      t2 _ _ _ _ hC1 hnS1 (hd' 1 0 0), t2 _ _ _ _ hC1 hC1 (hd' 1 1 0)]
  have hB0b : |B0| ≤ 4 * η := by
    rw [hB0]
    refine (abs4 _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    linarith [t2 _ _ _ _ hnS1 hnS1 (hd' 0 0 0), t2 _ _ _ _ hnS1 hC1 (hd' 0 0 1),
      t2 _ _ _ _ hC1 hnS1 (hd' 0 1 0), t2 _ _ _ _ hC1 hC1 (hd' 0 1 1)]
  have hA1b : |A1| ≤ 4 * η := by
    rw [hA1]
    refine (abs4 _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    linarith [t2 _ _ _ _ hnS1 hnS1 (hd' 0 0 1), t2 _ _ _ _ hnS1 hC1 (hd' 0 1 1),
      t2 _ _ _ _ hC1 hnS1 (hd' 1 0 1), t2 _ _ _ _ hC1 hC1 (hd' 1 1 1)]
  have hB1b : |B1| ≤ 4 * η := by
    rw [hB1]
    refine (abs4 _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    linarith [t2 _ _ _ _ hnS1 hnS1 (hd' 1 0 0), t2 _ _ _ _ hnS1 hC1 (hd' 1 0 1),
      t2 _ _ _ _ hC1 hnS1 (hd' 1 1 0), t2 _ _ _ _ hC1 hC1 (hd' 1 1 1)]
  have hm0b : |m0| ≤ 4 * ε := by
    rw [hm0]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    linarith [t1 _ _ _ hC1 i00, t1 _ _ _ hS1 i10]
  have hm1b : |m1| ≤ 4 * ε := by
    rw [hm1]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    linarith [t1 _ _ _ hC1 i01, t1 _ _ _ hS1 i11]
  have hY0b : |A0 - 1 / 2 * B0| ≤ 6 * η := by
    obtain ⟨l1, u1⟩ := abs_le.mp hA0b
    obtain ⟨l2, u2⟩ := abs_le.mp hB0b
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hY1b : |A1 - 1 / 2 * B1| ≤ 6 * η := by
    obtain ⟨l1, u1⟩ := abs_le.mp hA1b
    obtain ⟨l2, u2⟩ := abs_le.mp hB1b
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hEb : |Ee| ≤ 48 * ε * η := by
    have q0 : |m0 * (A0 - 1 / 2 * B0)| ≤ 4 * ε * (6 * η) := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hm0b hY0b (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    have q1 : |m1 * (A1 - 1 / 2 * B1)| ≤ 4 * ε * (6 * η) := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hm1b hY1b (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    rw [hEe, abs_neg]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    linarith
  
  have red : ∀ N A B : ℝ, N = L * (1 + Dd + Ee) → A = 1 + al → B = L ^ 2 * (1 + be) →
      N / (Real.sqrt A * Real.sqrt B)
        = (1 + Dd + Ee) / (Real.sqrt (1 + al) * Real.sqrt (1 + be)) := by
    intro N A B hN hA hB
    rw [hN, hA, hB, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg L), Real.sqrt_sq hL.le,
      show Real.sqrt (1 + al) * (L * Real.sqrt (1 + be))
        = L * (Real.sqrt (1 + al) * Real.sqrt (1 + be)) by ring]
    exact mul_div_mul_left _ _ hL.ne'
  have hK : curvKappa γ γi d L s
      = (1 + Dd + Ee) / (Real.sqrt (1 + al) * Real.sqrt (1 + be)) := by
    simp only [curvKappa]
    apply red
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
      rw [hDd, hEe, hT1, hT2, hm0, hm1, hA0, hB0, hA1, hB1]
      ring
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
      rw [hal]
      linear_combination hcs
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]
      rw [hbe]
      linear_combination L ^ 2 * hcs
  have hLin : curvLinAlg γ d L s = 1 / 2 * (kn - be) + Dd := by
    simp only [curvLinAlg, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons, c00, c01, c10, c11]
    rw [hkn, hbe, hDd, hT1, hT2]
    ring
  
  have hε2η : ε ^ 2 * η ≤ ε / 20 * η := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hε2 hη
  have hεη : 0 ≤ ε * η := mul_nonneg hε0 hη
  obtain ⟨lkn, ukn⟩ := abs_le.mp hknb
  obtain ⟨lbe, ube⟩ := abs_le.mp hbeb
  obtain ⟨lrho, urho⟩ := abs_le.mp hrhob
  obtain ⟨lD, uD⟩ := abs_le.mp hDb
  obtain ⟨lE, uE⟩ := abs_le.mp hEb
  have h1a : 0 ≤ 1 + al := by linarith
  have h1b : 0 ≤ 1 + be := by linarith
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = Real.sqrt (1 + al) * Real.sqrt (1 + be) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσ0 : 0 ≤ σ := by rw [hσ]; positivity
  have hσsq : σ ^ 2 = (1 + al) * (1 + be) := by
    rw [hσ, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt h1a, Real.sq_sqrt h1b]
  have hσsq' : 16 / 25 ≤ σ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hσsq]
    exact prod_aux _ _ (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hσl : 4 / 5 ≤ σ := sqrt_aux σ hσ0 hσsq'
  have hσpos : 0 < σ := by linarith
  have hσne : σ ≠ 0 := hσpos.ne'
  have hprod : (1 + (al + be) / 2 - σ) * (1 + (al + be) / 2 + σ) = (al - be) ^ 2 / 4 := by
    have e : (1 + (al + be) / 2 - σ) * (1 + (al + be) / 2 + σ)
        = (1 + (al + be) / 2) ^ 2 - σ ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [e, hσsq]; ring
  have hws0 : 0 ≤ 1 + (al + be) / 2 - σ := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have h2 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h (show 0 < 1 + (al + be) / 2 + σ by linarith)
    rw [hprod] at h2
    have h3 := sq_nonneg (al - be)
    linarith
  have hws1 : 1 + (al + be) / 2 - σ ≤ 5 / 32 * (al - be) ^ 2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show 8 / 5 ≤ 1 + (al + be) / 2 + σ by linarith) hws0
    linarith
  have hab2 : (al - be) ^ 2 ≤ 25 * ε ^ 2 := by
    have h := sq_le_sq' (show -(5 * ε) ≤ al - be by linarith) (show al - be ≤ 5 * ε by linarith)
    calc (al - be) ^ 2 ≤ (5 * ε) ^ 2 := h
      _ = 25 * ε ^ 2 := by ring
  rw [hK, ← hσ, hLin]
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = (1 + Dd + Ee) / σ - 1 - (1 / 2 * (kn - be) + Dd) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hZ]
  have hZσ : Z * σ = Ee - rho / 2 - (al + be) / 2 * (1 / 2 * (kn - be) + Dd)
      + (1 + (al + be) / 2 - σ) * (1 + 1 / 2 * (kn - be) + Dd) := by
    rw [hZ, sub_mul, sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hσne]
    linear_combination (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * halr
  have hq1 : |(al + be) / 2 * (1 / 2 * (kn - be) + Dd)| ≤ (5 / 2 * ε) * (2 * ε + 12 * η) := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    refine mul_le_mul ?_ ?_ (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hq2 : |(1 + (al + be) / 2 - σ) * (1 + 1 / 2 * (kn - be) + Dd)|
      ≤ (4 * ε ^ 2) * (11 / 10 + 12 * η) := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    refine mul_le_mul ?_ ?_ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hws0]; linarith
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨lq1, uq1⟩ := abs_le.mp hq1
  obtain ⟨lq2, uq2⟩ := abs_le.mp hq2
  have hZs : |Z| * σ ≤ 160 * (ε ^ 2 + ε * η) := by
    have e : |Z| * σ = |Z * σ| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hσpos]
    rw [e, hZσ, abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hZ45 : |Z| * (4 / 5) ≤ |Z| * σ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hσl (abs_nonneg Z)
  linarith

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (R L t : ℝ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hRL : R < L)
    (hsmooth : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x a b) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun s => curvWAlg (cylGam G t L s) (cylDG G t L s) L s) volume
      0 (2 * Real.pi) ∧
    ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvWAlg (cylGam G t L s) (cylDG G t L s) L s = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  
  have hmem : ∀ s : ℝ, R < ‖cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)‖ := by
    intro s
    have hsq : ‖cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + L ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      simp [cylPt, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      linear_combination L ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq s
    have h0 := norm_nonneg (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hlt : ‖cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)‖ < L := lt_of_le_of_lt h hRL
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
  
  have hφd : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
      ((L * -Real.sin s) • e 1 + (L * Real.cos s) • e 2) s := by
    intro s
    have h1 := ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos s).const_mul L).smul_const (e 1)
    have h2 := ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin s).const_mul L).smul_const (e 2)
    have h0 := hasDerivAt_const s (t • e 0)
    have h := (h0.add h1).add h2
    rw [zero_add] at h
    exact h
  
  have hgam : ∀ (s : ℝ) (a b : Fin 2), HasDerivAt (fun s => cylGam G t L s a b)
      (L * (-(Real.sin s) * cylDG G t L s 0 a b + Real.cos s * cylDG G t L s 1 a b)) s := by
    intro s a b
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z a.succ b.succ)
        (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) :=
      ((hsmooth a.succ b.succ).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        (hU.mem_nhds (hmem s))
    have hc0 := hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hφd s)
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun s => cylGam G t L s a b)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a.succ b.succ) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
          ((L * -Real.sin s) • e 1 + (L * Real.cos s) • e 2)) s := hc0
    refine hc.congr_deriv ?_
    have e0 : cylDG G t L s 0 a b = fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a.succ b.succ)
        (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) (e 1) := rfl
    have e1 : cylDG G t L s 1 a b = fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a.succ b.succ)
        (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) (e 2) := rfl
    rw [e0, e1, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hφc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) := by
    unfold cylPt
    fun_prop
  have hGc : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      Continuous (fun s => G (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) a b) :=
    fun a b => (hsmooth a b).continuousOn.comp_continuous hφc hmem
  have hdGc : ∀ i a b : Fin 3, Continuous (fun s =>
      partialDeriv i (fun z => G z a b) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))) := by
    intro i a b
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b) x) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} :=
      (hsmooth a b).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z a b) x) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} :=
      h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    exact h2.comp_continuous hφc hmem
  have hΓc : Continuous (fun s => cylGam G t L s) :=
    continuous_pi fun a => continuous_pi fun b => hGc a.succ b.succ
  have hDc : Continuous (fun s => cylDG G t L s) :=
    continuous_pi fun c => continuous_pi fun a => continuous_pi fun b => hdGc c.succ a.succ b.succ
  have hWc : Continuous (fun s => curvWAlg (cylGam G t L s) (cylDG G t L s) L s) := by
    simp only [curvWAlg, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons]
    fun_prop
  
  have hder : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => -(1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      ((-Real.sin s) * (cylGam G t L s 0 0 - 1) * Real.cos s
        + (-Real.sin s) * cylGam G t L s 0 1 * Real.sin s
        + Real.cos s * cylGam G t L s 1 0 * Real.cos s
        + Real.cos s * (cylGam G t L s 1 1 - 1) * Real.sin s))
      (curvWAlg (cylGam G t L s) (cylDG G t L s) L s) s := by
    intro s
    have hs := Real.hasDerivAt_sin s
    have hc := Real.hasDerivAt_cos s
    have h00 := (hgam s 0 0).sub_const 1
    have h01 := hgam s 0 1
    have h10 := hgam s 1 0
    have h11 := (hgam s 1 1).sub_const 1
    have h := (((((hs.neg.mul h00).mul hc).add ((hs.neg.mul h01).mul hs)).add
      ((hc.mul h10).mul hc)).add ((hc.mul h11).mul hs)).const_mul (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [curvWAlg, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.head_cons]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, if_pos rfl, Fin.zero_eq_one_iff, Fin.one_eq_zero_iff,
      OfNat.ofNat_ne_one, one_ne_zero, zero_ne_one, if_false, if_true, sub_zero,
      Pi.mul_apply, Pi.neg_apply]
    ring
  
  have hWi := hWc.intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) 0 (2 * Real.pi)
  refine ⟨hWi, ?_⟩
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun s _ => hder s) hWi]
  simp only [cylGam, Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero, sub_self]

        |(fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) ∧
      (∀ c i a : Fin 3,

signature.name: coordChange_inverse_bounds
signature.statement:
(X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1)
    (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C) :
    ∃ R₃ K : ℝ, R₁ ≤ R₃ ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ x : E3, R₃ < ‖x‖ →
      ‖x‖ / 2 ≤ ‖Y x‖ ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (jacMat Y x).det ∧
      (∀ i a : Fin 3,
        |(fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) ∧
      (∀ c i a : Fin 3,
        |partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x| ≤ K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hXY' := hXY
  unfold CoordChange at hXY'
  obtain ⟨hR0, hR01, hC, hXs, hYs, hinv, hinj, hbd⟩ := hXY'
  have hreg := coordChange_regularity (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
    (fun i j => contDiffOn_const) X Y q R₀ R₁ C hXY
  
  have sum3 : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → ℝ) (b : ℝ), (∀ i, |f i| ≤ b) → |∑ i, f i| ≤ 3 * b := by
    intro f b hf
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have h0 := abs_le.mp (hf 0)
    have h1 := abs_le.mp (hf 1)
    have h2 := abs_le.mp (hf 2)
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have mulb : ∀ (u v A B : ℝ), |u| ≤ A → |v| ≤ B → |u * v| ≤ A * B := by
    intro u v A B hu hv
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul hu hv (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hu)
  
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ κ : ℝ, κ = 1 + C := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκ1 : 1 ≤ κ := by rw [hκ]; linarith
  have hκ0 : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hCκ : 0 ≤ C * κ := mul_nonneg hC.le hκ0.le
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = 600 * C * κ + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT0 : 0 < T := by rw [hT]; nlinarith
  have h600 : 600 * C * κ ≤ T := by rw [hT]; linarith
  refine ⟨max R₁ (T ^ (1 / q)), 72 * C * κ ^ 2, le_max_left _ _, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hxR1 : R₁ < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hx
  have hxT : T ^ (1 / q) < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hx
  have hTq0 : 0 < T ^ (1 / q) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hT0 _
  have hx0 : 0 < ‖x‖ := lt_trans hTq0 hxT
  have hu_le : ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ T⁻¹ := by
    have h1 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ (T ^ (1 / q)) ^ (-q) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hTq0 hxT.le (by linarith)
    have h2 : (T ^ (1 / q)) ^ (-q) = T⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_mul hT0.le]
      have : 1 / q * -q = -1 := by field_simp
      rw [this, Real.rpow_neg_one]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _
  have huT : ‖x‖ ^ (-q) * T ≤ 1 := by
    calc ‖x‖ ^ (-q) * T ≤ T⁻¹ * T := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu_le hT0.le
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hT0.ne'
  obtain ⟨hs0, hxs, hsq, hsq1⟩ := coordChange_norm_compare X Y q R₀ R₁ C hq0 hq1 hXY x hxR1
  rw [← hκ] at hxs hsq hsq1
  have hs0' : 0 < ‖Y x‖ := by linarith
  have hw0 : 0 ≤ ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_nonneg hs0'.le _
  have hw10 : 0 ≤ ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q - 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg hs0'.le _
  
  have hε600 : C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ 1 / 600 := by
    have h1 : C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ C * (κ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hC.le
    have h3 : 600 * C * κ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ T * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h600 hu0
    linarith
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q) := mul_nonneg hC.le hw0
  have hε : C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ 1 / 6 := by linarith
  
  have hpart1 : ‖x‖ / 2 ≤ ‖Y x‖ := by
    have hXYx := (hinv x hxR1).2
    have hXb := (hbd (Y x) hs0).1
    have hpow : ‖Y x‖ ^ (1 - q) = ‖Y x‖ * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q) := by
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Real.rpow_add hs0', Real.rpow_one]
    rw [hpow] at hXb
    have htri : ‖X (Y x)‖ ≤ ‖Y x‖ + ‖X (Y x) - Y x‖ := by
      simpa using norm_add_le (Y x) (X (Y x) - Y x)
    rw [hXYx] at htri hXb
    have hm : ‖Y x‖ * (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q)) ≤ ‖Y x‖ * (1 / 600) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε600 hs0'.le
    nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨hYd, hXd, hBd, hAd, -⟩ := hreg.2 x hxR1
  obtain ⟨hI, hII⟩ := inverse_jacobian_identities X Y {z : E3 | R₁ < ‖z‖}
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm) (fun z hz => (hinv z hz).2)
    (fun z hz => (hreg.2 z hz).1) (fun z hz => (hreg.2 z hz).2.1) x hxR1 hAd hBd
  obtain ⟨-, hA1, hA2⟩ := hbd (Y x) hs0
  
  have hBb : ∀ i a : Fin 3, |(fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i| ≤ 2 * 1 ∧
      |(fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)|
        ≤ 6 * (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q)) * 1 := by
    intro i a
    refine lin3_solve_bound
      (fun d k => partialDeriv k (fun w => X w d) (Y x) - (if k = d then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
      (fun k => (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) k) (fun d => if d = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q)) 1 hε ?_ ?_ ?_ i
    · intro d k
      exact hA1 k d
    · intro d
      show |(if d = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1
      split_ifs <;> simp
    · intro d
      have h := hI d a
      have hδ : ∑ k : Fin 3, (if k = d then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) k
          = (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) d := by simp
      simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hδ, h]
      ring
  have hB2 : ∀ i a : Fin 3, |(fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i| ≤ 2 :=
    fun i a => (hBb i a).1.trans (le_of_eq (mul_one _))
  have hBφ : ∀ i a : Fin 3,
      |(fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 6 * (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q)) :=
    fun i a => (hBb i a).2.trans (le_of_eq (mul_one _))
  
  have hMb : ∀ c i a : Fin 3, |partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x| ≤
      2 * (36 * (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q - 1))) := by
    intro c i a
    refine (lin3_solve_bound
      (fun d k => partialDeriv k (fun w => X w d) (Y x) - (if k = d then (1 : ℝ) else 0))
      (fun k => partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) k) x)
      (fun d => -∑ k : Fin 3, (∑ l : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) l *
          partialDeriv l (fun z => partialDeriv k (fun w => X w d) z) (Y x)) *
          (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) k)
      (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q)) (36 * (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q - 1))) hε ?_ ?_ ?_ i).1
    · intro d k
      exact hA1 k d
    · intro d
      show |-∑ k : Fin 3, (∑ l : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) l *
          partialDeriv l (fun z => partialDeriv k (fun w => X w d) z) (Y x)) *
          (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) k| ≤ 36 * (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q - 1))
      rw [abs_neg]
      have h36 : (36 : ℝ) * (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q - 1))
          = 3 * (3 * (2 * (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q - 1))) * 2) := by ring
      rw [h36]
      apply sum3
      intro k
      apply mulb _ _ _ _ _ (hB2 k a)
      apply sum3
      intro l
      exact mulb _ _ _ _ (hB2 l c) (hA2 l k d)
    · intro d
      have h := hII c d a
      have hδ : ∑ k : Fin 3, (if k = d then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
            partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) k) x
          = partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) d) x := by simp
      simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hδ]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at h
      linarith
  
  have hdet : |(jacMat Y x).det - 1| ≤ 4 * (6 * (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q))) :=
    det3_near_id_bound (jacMat Y x) (6 * (C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q))) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      (fun i j => by simp only [jacMat, Matrix.of_apply]; exact hBφ i j)
  refine ⟨hpart1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := (abs_le.mp hdet).1
    linarith
  · intro i a
    refine le_trans (hBφ i a) ?_
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 6 * C)
    have h2 : 6 * C * κ ≤ 72 * C * κ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hu0
    nlinarith
  · intro c i a
    refine le_trans (hMb c i a) ?_
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq1 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 72 * C)
    nlinarith

    (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C) (x : E3) (hx : R₁ < ‖x‖) :

subgoal_signatures.name: inverse_jacobian_identities
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(X Y : E3 → E3) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hinv : ∀ z ∈ U, X (Y z) = z) (hY : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ Y z)
    (hX : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ X (Y z)) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hA : ∀ d i : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x))
    (hB : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) :
    (∀ d a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y x) * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i
        = if d = a then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ c d a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3,
        ((∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k *
            partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) z) (Y x)) *
            (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i
          + partialDeriv i (fun w => X w d) (Y x) *
            partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) = 0)

      DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ X (Y x) ∧
      (∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) ∧

        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x)) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x))
