proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have t_sum3 : ∀ (f g : Fin 3 → ℝ) (A B : ℝ), (∀ i, |f i| ≤ A) → (∀ i, |g i| ≤ B) →
      |∑ i, f i * g i| ≤ 3 * (A * B) := by
    intro f g A B hf hg
    have hA : 0 ≤ A := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hf 0)
    have hfg : ∀ i, |f i * g i| ≤ A * B := fun i => by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hf i) (hg i) (abs_nonneg _) hA
    calc |∑ i, f i * g i| ≤ ∑ i, |f i * g i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, A * B := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hfg i)
      _ = 3 * (A * B) := by simp
  have t_sum3' : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → ℝ) (B : ℝ), (∀ i, |f i| ≤ B) → |∑ i, f i| ≤ 3 * B := by
    intro f B hf
    calc |∑ i, f i| ≤ ∑ i, |f i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, B := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hf i)
      _ = 3 * B := by simp
  have t_lin1 : ∀ (d : Fin 3 → ℝ) (H J : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (b : Fin 3),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, d i * H i j * J j b - d b =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, d i * (∑ j : Fin 3, (H i j - if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0) * J j b
          + (J i b - if i = b then (1:ℝ) else 0)) := by
    intro d H J b
    fin_cases b <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
  have t_lin2 : ∀ (d : Fin 3 → ℝ) (H J : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * H i j * d j - d a =
        ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, J i a * (H i j - if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)
          + (J j a - if j = a then (1:ℝ) else 0)) * d j := by
    intro d H J a
    fin_cases a <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
  have t_quad : ∀ (J M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (a b : Fin 3),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * M i j * J j b - M a b =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, (J i a - if i = a then (1:ℝ) else 0) * (∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * J j b)
          + ∑ j : Fin 3, M a j * (J j b - if j = b then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro J M a b
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
  have t_contr : ∀ (J : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (dH : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (c a b : Fin 3),
      ∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k a b - dH c a b =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, (J k c - if k = c then (1:ℝ) else 0) * dH k a b := by
    intro J dH c a b
    fin_cases c <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
  
  have t_canc : ∀ (D dH P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Adj : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (b : Fin 3),
      (∀ c i a, D c i a = D a i c) →
      ∑ a : Fin 3, (P a a b - P b a a) - ∑ i : Fin 3, Adj b i * ∑ a : Fin 3, (dH a a i - dH i a a)
          - ∑ a : Fin 3, (D a b a - D a a b)
        = ∑ a : Fin 3, ((P a a b - (D a b a + D a a b + dH a a b))
            - (P b a a - (D b a a + D b a a + dH b a a)))
          - ∑ i : Fin 3, (Adj b i - if b = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
              ∑ a : Fin 3, (dH a a i - dH i a a) := by
    intro D dH P Adj b hsym
    have h0 := hsym 0 0 b
    have h1 := hsym 1 1 b
    have h2 := hsym 2 2 b
    fin_cases b <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0 h1 h2 ⊢ <;>
      linear_combination (2:ℝ) * (h0 + h1 + h2)
  
  have t_adj : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (ε : ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε) →
      ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A.adjugate i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 2 * ε * (1 + ε) := by
    intro A ε hA
    have hε : 0 ≤ ε := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hA 0 0)
    have o : ∀ k l : Fin 3, k ≠ l → |A k l| ≤ ε := fun k l hkl => by
      have := hA k l; simpa [hkl] using this
    have hdg : ∀ k : Fin 3, |A k k - 1| ≤ ε := fun k => by
      have := hA k k; simpa using this
    have hall : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |A k l| ≤ 1 + ε := fun k l => by
      have h := hA k l
      have h2 : |A k l| ≤ |A k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)|
          + |(if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| := by
        have := abs_add_le (A k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
        simpa using this
      have h3 : |(if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> simp
      linarith
    have hp : ∀ x y : ℝ, |x| ≤ ε → |y| ≤ 1 + ε → |x * y| ≤ ε * (1 + ε) := fun x y hx hy => by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) hε
    have hp' : ∀ x y : ℝ, |x| ≤ 1 + ε → |y| ≤ ε → |x * y| ≤ ε * (1 + ε) := fun x y hx hy => by
      rw [mul_comm]; exact hp y x hy hx
    have hsq : ∀ x y : ℝ, |x| ≤ ε → |y| ≤ ε → |x * y| ≤ ε * ε := fun x y hx hy => by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) hε
    have hdiag : ∀ x y z w : ℝ, |x - 1| ≤ ε → |y| ≤ 1 + ε → |y - 1| ≤ ε → |z * w| ≤ ε * ε →
        |x * y - z * w - 1| ≤ 2 * ε * (1 + ε) := fun x y z w hx hy hy1 hzw => by
      have h1 := abs_le.mp (hp (x - 1) y hx hy)
      have h2 := abs_le.mp hy1
      have h3 := abs_le.mp hzw
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2, h3.1, h3.2]
    have hoffc : ∀ x y z w : ℝ, |x * y| ≤ ε * (1 + ε) → |z * w| ≤ ε * (1 + ε) →
        |x * y - z * w| ≤ 2 * ε * (1 + ε) ∧ |-(x * y) + z * w| ≤ 2 * ε * (1 + ε) :=
      fun x y z w h1 h2 => by
      have g1 := abs_le.mp h1
      have g2 := abs_le.mp h2
      constructor <;> (rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [g1.1, g1.2, g2.1, g2.2])
    intro i j
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · simp
      exact hdiag _ _ _ _ (hdg 1) (hall 2 2) (hdg 2)
        (hsq _ _ (o 1 2 (by decide)) (o 2 1 (by decide)))
    · simp
      exact (hoffc _ _ _ _ (hp _ _ (o 0 1 (by decide)) (hall 2 2))
        (hp _ _ (o 0 2 (by decide)) (hall 2 1))).2
    · simp
      exact (hoffc _ _ _ _ (hp _ _ (o 0 1 (by decide)) (hall 1 2))
        (hp _ _ (o 0 2 (by decide)) (hall 1 1))).1
    · simp
      exact (hoffc _ _ _ _ (hp _ _ (o 1 0 (by decide)) (hall 2 2))
        (hp _ _ (o 1 2 (by decide)) (hall 2 0))).2
    · simp
      exact hdiag _ _ _ _ (hdg 0) (hall 2 2) (hdg 2)
        (hsq _ _ (o 0 2 (by decide)) (o 2 0 (by decide)))
    · simp
      exact (hoffc _ _ _ _ (hp' _ _ (hall 0 0) (o 1 2 (by decide)))
        (hp _ _ (o 0 2 (by decide)) (hall 1 0))).2
    · simp
      exact (hoffc _ _ _ _ (hp _ _ (o 1 0 (by decide)) (hall 2 1))
        (hp' _ _ (hall 1 1) (o 2 0 (by decide)))).1
    · simp
      exact (hoffc _ _ _ _ (hp' _ _ (hall 0 0) (o 2 1 (by decide)))
        (hp _ _ (o 0 1 (by decide)) (hall 2 0))).2
    · simp
      exact hdiag _ _ _ _ (hdg 0) (hall 1 1) (hdg 1)
        (hsq _ _ (o 0 1 (by decide)) (o 1 0 (by decide)))
  
  have t_rpow : ∀ (r ρ q : ℝ), 0 < r → r / 2 ≤ ρ → 0 < q →
      ρ ^ (-q) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ q * r ^ (-q) ∧ ρ ^ (-q - 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 1) * r ^ (-q - 1) := by
    intro r ρ q hr hρ hq
    have hr2 : 0 < r / 2 := by positivity
    constructor
    · calc ρ ^ (-q) ≤ (r / 2) ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hr2 hρ (by linarith)
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ q * r ^ (-q) := by
          rw [Real.div_rpow hr.le (by norm_num), Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) q,
            div_inv_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    · calc ρ ^ (-q - 1) ≤ (r / 2) ^ (-q - 1) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hr2 hρ (by linarith)
        _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 1) * r ^ (-q - 1) := by
          rw [Real.div_rpow hr.le (by norm_num), show -q - 1 = -(q + 1) by ring,
            Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2) (q + 1), div_inv_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  
  have t_book : ∀ (r q K C : ℝ), 1 ≤ r → 0 < q → 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ C →
      36 * (K * r ^ (-q - 1)) * (3 * (C * (2 : ℝ) ^ q * r ^ (-q)) * (1 + K * r ^ (-q))
          + K * r ^ (-q))
        + 486 * (K * r ^ (-q)) * (1 + K * r ^ (-q)) ^ 2 * (C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 1) * r ^ (-q - 1))
        + 36 * (K * r ^ (-q)) * (1 + K * r ^ (-q)) * (C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 1) * r ^ (-q - 1))
      ≤ (36 * K ^ 2 + 1152 * (1 + K) ^ 2 * K * C * (2 : ℝ) ^ q) * r ^ (-2 * q - 1) := by
    intro r q K C hr hq hK hC
    have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
    have hs0 : 0 < r ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 _
    have hs1 : r ^ (-q) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hr (by linarith)
    have ht0 : 0 < r ^ (-q - 1) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 _
    have hst : r ^ (-2 * q - 1) = r ^ (-q) * r ^ (-q - 1) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hr0]; congr 1; ring
    have hP2 : (2:ℝ) ^ (q + 1) = 2 * (2:ℝ) ^ q := by
      rw [Real.rpow_add_one (by norm_num : (2:ℝ) ≠ 0)]; ring
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ (2:ℝ) ^ q := by positivity
    rw [hst, hP2]
    have hE1 : 1 ≤ 1 + K * r ^ (-q) := by
      have : 0 ≤ K * r ^ (-q) := by positivity
      linarith
    have hEK : 1 + K * r ^ (-q) ≤ 1 + K := by
      have : K * r ^ (-q) ≤ K * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs1 hK
      linarith
    have hK1 : 1 + K ≤ (1 + K) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hE2 : (1 + K * r ^ (-q)) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + K) ^ 2 := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ 1 + K * r ^ (-q) := by linarith
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 hEK 2
    have key : 108 * (1 + K * r ^ (-q)) + 972 * (1 + K * r ^ (-q)) ^ 2 + 72 * (1 + K * r ^ (-q))
        ≤ 1152 * (1 + K) ^ 2 := by linarith
    have hKCP : 0 ≤ K * C * (2:ℝ) ^ q := by positivity
    have hst0 : 0 ≤ r ^ (-q) * r ^ (-q - 1) := by positivity
    calc _ = r ^ (-q) * r ^ (-q - 1) * (36 * K ^ 2 + K * C * (2:ℝ) ^ q *
          (108 * (1 + K * r ^ (-q)) + 972 * (1 + K * r ^ (-q)) ^ 2
            + 72 * (1 + K * r ^ (-q)))) := by
          ring
      _ ≤ r ^ (-q) * r ^ (-q - 1) * (36 * K ^ 2 + K * C * (2:ℝ) ^ q * (1152 * (1 + K) ^ 2)) := by
          gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have t_bil : ∀ (d : Fin 3 → ℝ) (H J : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (ε η δ : ℝ),
      (∀ i a : Fin 3, |J i a - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε) →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |H i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, |d i| ≤ δ) → ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, d i * H i j * J j b - d b| ≤ 3 * δ * (3 * η * (1 + ε) + ε) ∧
      |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * H i j * d j - d a| ≤ 3 * δ * (3 * η * (1 + ε) + ε) := by
    intro d H J ε η δ hJ hH hd a b
    have hJb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |J k l| ≤ 1 + ε := fun k l => by
      have h := hJ k l
      have h2 := abs_add_le (J k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      have h3 : |(if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> simp
      simp only [sub_add_cancel] at h2
      linarith
    constructor
    · rw [t_lin1]
      have hw : ∀ i, |∑ j : Fin 3, (H i j - if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0) * J j b
          + (J i b - if i = b then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 3 * η * (1 + ε) + ε := fun i => by
        have h1 : |∑ j : Fin 3, (H i j - if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0) * J j b|
            ≤ 3 * (η * (1 + ε)) :=
          t_sum3 _ _ _ _ (fun j => hH i j) (fun j => hJb j b)
        have h2 := abs_add_le (∑ j : Fin 3, (H i j - if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0) * J j b)
          (J i b - if i = b then (1:ℝ) else 0)
        have h3 := hJ i b
        linarith
      have := t_sum3 d _ δ _ hd hw
      linarith
    · rw [t_lin2]
      have hw : ∀ j, |∑ i : Fin 3, J i a * (H i j - if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)
          + (J j a - if j = a then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 3 * η * (1 + ε) + ε := fun j => by
        have h1 : |∑ i : Fin 3, J i a * (H i j - if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)|
            ≤ 3 * ((1 + ε) * η) :=
          t_sum3 _ _ _ _ (fun i => hJb i a) (fun i => hH i j)
        have h2 := abs_add_le (∑ i : Fin 3, J i a * (H i j - if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0))
          (J j a - if j = a then (1:ℝ) else 0)
        have h3 := hJ j a
        linarith
      have := t_sum3 _ d _ δ hw hd
      linarith
  
  have t_tri : ∀ (J : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (dH : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (ε θ : ℝ),
      (∀ i a : Fin 3, |J i a - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε) →
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, |dH k i j| ≤ θ) → ∀ a b c : Fin 3,
      |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k i j) * J j b - dH c a b|
        ≤ 81 * ε * (1 + ε) ^ 2 * θ := by
    intro J dH ε θ hJ hdH a b c
    have hε : 0 ≤ ε := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hJ 0 0)
    have hθ : 0 ≤ θ := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hdH 0 0 0)
    have hJb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |J k l| ≤ 1 + ε := fun k l => by
      have h := hJ k l
      have h2 := abs_add_le (J k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      have h3 : |(if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> simp
      simp only [sub_add_cancel] at h2
      linarith
    have hM : ∀ i j, |∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k i j| ≤ 3 * ((1 + ε) * θ) := fun i j =>
      t_sum3 _ _ _ _ (fun k => hJb k c) (fun k => hdH k i j)
    have hMJ : ∀ i, |∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k i j) * J j b|
        ≤ 3 * ((3 * ((1 + ε) * θ)) * (1 + ε)) := fun i =>
      t_sum3 _ _ _ _ (fun j => hM i j) (fun j => hJb j b)
    have e1 := t_quad J (fun i j => ∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k i j) a b
    have e2 := t_contr J dH c a b
    beta_reduce at e1
    have b1 : |∑ i : Fin 3, (J i a - if i = a then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
        (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k i j) * J j b)|
        ≤ 3 * (ε * (3 * ((3 * ((1 + ε) * θ)) * (1 + ε)))) :=
      t_sum3 _ _ _ _ (fun i => hJ i a) hMJ
    have b2 : |∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k a j) *
        (J j b - if j = b then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 3 * ((3 * ((1 + ε) * θ)) * ε) :=
      t_sum3 _ _ _ _ (fun j => hM a j) (fun j => hJ j b)
    have b3 : |∑ k : Fin 3, (J k c - if k = c then (1:ℝ) else 0) * dH k a b| ≤ 3 * (ε * θ) :=
      t_sum3 _ _ _ _ (fun k => hJ k c) (fun k => hdH k a b)
    have split : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, J i a * (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k i j) * J j b
          - dH c a b
        = (∑ i : Fin 3, (J i a - if i = a then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
            (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k i j) * J j b)
          + ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k a j) * (J j b - if j = b then (1:ℝ) else 0))
          + ∑ k : Fin 3, (J k c - if k = c then (1:ℝ) else 0) * dH k a b := by
      linarith [e1, e2]
    rw [split]
    have t1 := abs_add_le (∑ i : Fin 3, (J i a - if i = a then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
            (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k i j) * J j b)
          + ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k a j) * (J j b - if j = b then (1:ℝ) else 0))
          (∑ k : Fin 3, (J k c - if k = c then (1:ℝ) else 0) * dH k a b)
    have t2 := abs_add_le (∑ i : Fin 3, (J i a - if i = a then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
            (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k i j) * J j b))
          (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, J k c * dH k a j) * (J j b - if j = b then (1:ℝ) else 0))
    have u0 : 0 ≤ ε * θ := mul_nonneg hε hθ
    have u1 : ε * θ ≤ ε * θ * (1 + ε) := by nlinarith
    have u2 : ε * θ * (1 + ε) ≤ ε * θ * (1 + ε) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  
  have t_cancB : ∀ (D dH P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Adj : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (α β θ : ℝ),
      (∀ c i a : Fin 3, D c i a = D a i c) →
      (∀ c a b : Fin 3, |P c a b - (D c b a + D c a b + dH c a b)| ≤ β) →
      (∀ b i : Fin 3, |Adj b i - (if b = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ α) →
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, |dH k i j| ≤ θ) → ∀ b : Fin 3,
      |∑ a : Fin 3, (P a a b - P b a a)
          - ∑ i : Fin 3, Adj b i * ∑ a : Fin 3, (dH a a i - dH i a a)
          - ∑ a : Fin 3, (D a b a - D a a b)| ≤ 6 * β + 18 * α * θ := by
    intro D dH P Adj α β θ hsym hE hAdj hdH b
    rw [t_canc D dH P Adj b hsym]
    have hU : ∀ i, |∑ a : Fin 3, (dH a a i - dH i a a)| ≤ 3 * (2 * θ) := fun i =>
      t_sum3' _ _ (fun a => by
        have := abs_sub (dH a a i) (dH i a a)
        linarith [hdH a a i, hdH i a a])
    have b1 : |∑ a : Fin 3, ((P a a b - (D a b a + D a a b + dH a a b))
            - (P b a a - (D b a a + D b a a + dH b a a)))| ≤ 3 * (2 * β) :=
      t_sum3' _ _ (fun a => by
        have := abs_sub (P a a b - (D a b a + D a a b + dH a a b))
          (P b a a - (D b a a + D b a a + dH b a a))
        linarith [hE a a b, hE b a a])
    have b2 : |∑ i : Fin 3, (Adj b i - if b = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
              ∑ a : Fin 3, (dH a a i - dH i a a)| ≤ 3 * (α * (3 * (2 * θ))) :=
      t_sum3 _ _ _ _ (fun i => hAdj b i) hU
    have := abs_sub (∑ a : Fin 3, ((P a a b - (D a b a + D a a b + dH a a b))
            - (P b a a - (D b a a + D b a a + dH b a a))))
        (∑ i : Fin 3, (Adj b i - if b = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) *
              ∑ a : Fin 3, (dH a a i - dH i a a))
    linarith
  
  
  
  refine ⟨max R₃ (2 * R), 36 * K ^ 2 + 1152 * (1 + K) ^ 2 * K * C * (2 : ℝ) ^ q,
    le_max_left _ _, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro x hx b
  have hx3 : R₃ < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hx
  have hx2 : 2 * R < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hx
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
  have hr0 : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hYn, hJ, hD⟩ := hYb x hx3
  have hYR : R < ‖Y x‖ := by linarith
  have hY1 : 1 < ‖Y x‖ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hcmp1, hcmp2⟩ := t_rpow ‖x‖ ‖Y x‖ q hr0 hYn hq
  
  have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hYx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y x := hY.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx3)
  have hYd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x := hYx.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hF : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Y) x := hYx.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Y) x := hF.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hJd : ∀ a i : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i)
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 (e a))).comp (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Y) x)) x := by
    intro a i
    exact (((EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 (e a))).hasFDerivAt).comp x hFd.hasFDerivAt
  have hDval : ∀ c i a : Fin 3, partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x
      = (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Y) x (e c) (e a)) i := by
    intro c i a
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [(hJd a i).fderiv]
    rfl
  have hsymm2 : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ Y x :=
    hYx.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
  have hBd : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x :=
    fun a i => (hJd a i).differentiableAt
  have hsym : ∀ c i a : Fin 3, partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x
      = partialDeriv a (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e c)) i) x := by
    intro c i a
    rw [hDval, hDval, hsymm2.eq]
  have hcurl : ∀ b : Fin 3, jacCurlVec Y x b = ∑ a : Fin 3,
      (partialDeriv a (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) b) x
        - partialDeriv a (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) a) x) := by
    intro b
    unfold jacCurlVec
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [((hJd a b).fun_sub (hJd b a)).fderiv, (hJd a b).fderiv, (hJd b a).fderiv]
    rfl
  have hGd : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x) := fun i j =>
    ((hsmooth i j).contDiffAt
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hY1)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have s1 : ∀ a b c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b) x =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x * G (Y x) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j
          + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i *
              (∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k * partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)) *
              (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j
          + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * G (Y x) i j *
              partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j) x) := by
    intro a b c
    have hchain : ∀ i j : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun z => G (Y z) i j) x (e c) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k * partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x) := by
      intro i j
      have hcomp : fderiv ℝ (fun z => G (Y z) i j) x =
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)).comp (fderiv ℝ Y x) :=
        fderiv_comp x (hGd i j) hYd
      rw [hcomp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      have hw : fderiv ℝ Y x (e c) = ∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) k • e k := by
        ext l
        simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
      conv_lhs => rw [hw]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rfl
    have hterm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt
        (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i * G (Y z) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j)
        (((fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * G (Y x) i j) • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j) x
          + (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j • ((fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i • fderiv ℝ (fun z => G (Y z) i j) x
            + G (Y x) i j • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x)) x := by
      intro i j
      have hγ : HasFDerivAt (fun z => G (Y z) i j) (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G (Y z) i j) x) x :=
        ((hGd i j).comp x hYd).hasFDerivAt
      exact ((hBd a i).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul hγ).fun_mul (hBd b j).hasFDerivAt
    have hS := HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
      (A := fun i z => ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i * G (Y z) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j)
      (fun i _ => HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
        (A := fun j z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i * G (Y z) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b)) j)
        (fun j _ => hterm i j))
    have hDf : HasFDerivAt (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b) _ x := hS
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b) x (e c) = _
    rw [hDf.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hchain]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
    unfold partialDeriv
    ring
  
  have hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G (Y x) i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)|
      ≤ C * (2 : ℝ) ^ q * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) := fun i j => by
    have h := (hb (Y x) hYR i j).1
    calc _ ≤ C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q) := h
      _ ≤ C * ((2 : ℝ) ^ q * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcmp1 hC
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hdH : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)|
      ≤ C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 1) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) := fun k i j => by
    have h := (hb (Y x) hYR i j).2
    calc |partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)|
        = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x) (e k)‖ := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; rfl
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)‖ * ‖e k‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x)‖ := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
      _ ≤ C * ‖Y x‖ ^ (-q - 1) := h
      _ ≤ C * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 1) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcmp2 hC
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have hE : ∀ c a b' : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv c (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b') x
        - (partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) b') x
          + partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b')) a) x
          + partialDeriv c (fun w => G w a b') (Y x))|
      ≤ 6 * (K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)) * (3 * (C * (2 : ℝ) ^ q * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) * (1 + K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q))
          + K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q))
        + 81 * (K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) * (1 + K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) ^ 2
          * (C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 1) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)) := by
    intro c a b'
    rw [s1 a b' c]
    have h1 := (t_bil (fun i => partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x)
      (fun i j => G (Y x) i j) (fun i a => (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i)
      (K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) (C * (2 : ℝ) ^ q * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) (K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1))
      hJ hH (fun i => hD c i a) a b').1
    have h3 := (t_bil (fun j => partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e b')) j) x)
      (fun i j => G (Y x) i j) (fun i a => (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i)
      (K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) (C * (2 : ℝ) ^ q * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) (K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1))
      hJ hH (fun j => hD c j b') a b').2
    have h2 := t_tri (fun i a => (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i)
      (fun k i j => partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x))
      (K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) (C * (2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 1) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)) hJ hdH a b' c
    beta_reduce at h1 h2 h3
    have htrip : ∀ (f g h : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (u v w B1 B2 B3 : ℝ),
        |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j - u| ≤ B1 →
        |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g i j - v| ≤ B2 →
        |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, h i j - w| ≤ B3 →
        |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (f i j + g i j + h i j) - (u + w + v)| ≤ B1 + B2 + B3 := by
      intro f g h u v w B1 B2 B3 hf hg hh
      have hs : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (f i j + g i j + h i j)
          = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g i j
            + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, h i j := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [hs]
      have a1 := abs_add_le
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j - u + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g i j - v))
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, h i j - w)
      have a2 := abs_add_le (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j - u)
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g i j - v)
      have heq : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g i j
            + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, h i j - (u + w + v)
          = (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j - u + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g i j - v))
            + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, h i j - w) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      linarith
    have key := htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2 h3
    refine le_trans key (le_of_eq ?_)
    ring
  
  have hAdj := t_adj (jacMat Y x) (K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q))
    (fun i a => by simp only [jacMat, Matrix.of_apply]; exact hJ i a)
  have hfin := t_cancB (fun c i a => partialDeriv c (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x)
    (fun k i j => partialDeriv k (fun w => G w i j) (Y x))
    (fun c a b' => partialDeriv c (fun z => pullbackMetric G Y z a b') x)
    (jacMat Y x).adjugate _ _ _ (fun c i a => hsym c i a) hE hAdj hdH b
  beta_reduce at hfin
  have hbk := t_book ‖x‖ q K C hr1 hq hK hC
  rw [hcurl b]
  refine le_trans hfin (le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) hbk)
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(Y : E3 → E3) (R ℓ : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hRℓ : R < ℓ)
    (hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) :
    cylFlux (jacCurlVec Y) ℓ = 0

signature.statement:
(Y : E3 → E3) (R ℓ : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hRℓ : R < ℓ)
    (hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) :
    cylFlux (jacCurlVec Y) ℓ = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hℓ0 : 0 ≤ ℓ := by linarith
  
  have hR1 : ∀ (H K Hx Ky : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a b c d : ℝ), a ≤ b → c ≤ d →
      (∀ x y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x' => H x' y) (Hx x y) x) →
      (∀ x y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y' => K x y') (Ky x y) y) →
      Continuous (Function.uncurry Hx) → Continuous (Function.uncurry Ky) →
      (∀ x : ℝ, K x d = K x c) →
      ∫ x in a..b, ∫ y in c..d, (Hx x y + Ky x y) = ∫ y in c..d, (H b y - H a y) := by
    intro H K Hx Ky a b c d _ hcd hH hK hHx hKy hper
    have step1 : ∀ x, ∫ y in c..d, (Hx x y + Ky x y) = ∫ y in c..d, Hx x y := by
      intro x
      have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun y => Hx x y) volume c d :=
        (hHx.uncurry_left x).intervalIntegrable c d
      have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun y => Ky x y) volume c d :=
        (hKy.uncurry_left x).intervalIntegrable c d
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hi1 hi2,
        intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun y _ => hK x y) hi2, hper x, sub_self,
        add_zero]
    have step3 : ∀ y, ∫ x in a..b, Hx x y = H b y - H a y := fun y =>
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun x _ => hH x y)
        ((hHx.uncurry_right y).intervalIntegrable a b)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => step1 x)]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun y _ => (step3 y).symm)]
    have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry Hx)
        ((volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a b)).prod (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc c d))) := by
      rw [Measure.prod_restrict, ← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
      exact (hHx.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_uIcc.prod isCompact_Icc)).mono_set
        (Set.prod_mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self)
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hcd]
    exact intervalIntegral_integral_swap hint
  
  have hR2 : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (t a b : ℝ → ℝ) (t' a' b' r : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt t t' r → HasDerivAt a a' r → HasDerivAt b b' r →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (cylPt (t r) (a r) (b r)) →
      HasDerivAt (fun u => F (cylPt (t u) (a u) (b u)))
        (t' * partialDeriv 0 F (cylPt (t r) (a r) (b r))
          + a' * partialDeriv 1 F (cylPt (t r) (a r) (b r))
          + b' * partialDeriv 2 F (cylPt (t r) (a r) (b r))) r := by
    intro F t a b t' a' b' r ht ha hb hF
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun u => cylPt (t u) (a u) (b u)) (t' • e 0 + a' • e 1 + b' • e 2) r :=
      ((ht.smul_const (e 0)).add (ha.smul_const (e 1))).add (hb.smul_const (e 2))
    have h0 := hF.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt r hγ
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun u => F (cylPt (t u) (a u) (b u)))
        (fderiv ℝ F (cylPt (t r) (a r) (b r)) (t' • e 0 + a' • e 1 + b' • e 2)) r := h0
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  
  have hmem : ∀ t a b : ℝ, ℓ ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 → R < ‖cylPt t a b‖ := by
    intro t a b h
    have hsq : ‖cylPt t a b‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      simp [cylPt, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have h0 := norm_nonneg (cylPt t a b)
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg h0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hc), mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hRℓ) (by linarith : 0 < ℓ + R)]
  have hmc : ∀ τ : ℝ, τ ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 → ∀ a b : ℝ, R < ‖cylPt τ a b‖ := fun τ hτ a b =>
    hmem τ a b (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b])
  have hms : ∀ t s : ℝ, R < ‖cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)‖ := by
    intro t s
    have htr : (ℓ * Real.cos s) ^ 2 + (ℓ * Real.sin s) ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 := by
      linear_combination ℓ ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq s
    exact hmem t _ _ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg t])
  
  have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ Y) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} :=
    hY.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
  have hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) b) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by
    intro a b
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z => fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} :=
      hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj b : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : E3 → ℝ,
      S = fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 0)) 1 - (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 1)) 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQdef⟩ : ∃ Q : E3 → ℝ,
      Q = fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 2)) 0 - (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 0)) 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : E3 → ℝ,
      P = fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 1)) 2 - (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 2)) 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 S {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by rw [hSdef]; exact (hA 0 1).sub (hA 1 0)
  have hQ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Q {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by rw [hQdef]; exact (hA 2 0).sub (hA 0 2)
  have hP : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 P {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by rw [hPdef]; exact (hA 1 2).sub (hA 2 1)
  
  have hpneg : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (F : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3),
      partialDeriv i (fun z => -F z) x = -partialDeriv i F x := by
    intro i F x
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_neg]
    rfl
  have hpzero : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (x : E3), partialDeriv i (fun _ : E3 => (0 : ℝ)) x = 0 := by
    intro i x
    unfold partialDeriv
    simp
  have hdiag : ∀ a : Fin 3,
      (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) a - (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) a) = fun _ : E3 => (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro a; funext z; ring
  have e01 : (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 0)) 1 - (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 1)) 0) = S := hSdef.symm
  have e10 : (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 1)) 0 - (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 0)) 1) = fun z => -S z := by
    rw [hSdef]; funext z; ring
  have e20 : (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 2)) 0 - (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 0)) 2) = Q := hQdef.symm
  have e02 : (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 0)) 2 - (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 2)) 0) = fun z => -Q z := by
    rw [hQdef]; funext z; ring
  have e12 : (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 1)) 2 - (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 2)) 1) = P := hPdef.symm
  have e21 : (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 2)) 1 - (fderiv ℝ Y z (e 1)) 2) = fun z => -P z := by
    rw [hPdef]; funext z; ring
  have hV : ∀ x : E3,
      jacCurlVec Y x 0 = partialDeriv 2 Q x - partialDeriv 1 S x ∧
      jacCurlVec Y x 1 = partialDeriv 0 S x - partialDeriv 2 P x ∧
      jacCurlVec Y x 2 = partialDeriv 1 P x - partialDeriv 0 Q x := by
    intro x
    simp only [jacCurlVec, Fin.sum_univ_three, hdiag, e01, e10, e20, e02, e12, e21, hpneg, hpzero]
    refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩
  
  have hreg : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} →
      (∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) ∧ ContinuousOn F {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv i F) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by
    intro F hF
    refine ⟨fun x hx => (hF.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx),
      hF.continuousOn, fun i => ?_⟩
    exact (hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  obtain ⟨hSd, hSc, hSpc⟩ := hreg S hS
  obtain ⟨hQd, hQc, hQpc⟩ := hreg Q hQ
  obtain ⟨hPd, -, hPpc⟩ := hreg P hP
  
  have hcapc : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn F {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} → ∀ τ : ℝ, τ ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 →
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F (cylPt τ (p.1 * Real.cos p.2) (p.1 * Real.sin p.2))) := by
    intro F hF τ hτ
    exact hF.comp_continuous (by unfold cylPt; fun_prop) (fun p => hmc τ hτ _ _)
  have hsidec : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn F {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} →
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F (cylPt p.1 (ℓ * Real.cos p.2) (ℓ * Real.sin p.2))) := by
    intro F hF
    exact hF.comp_continuous (by unfold cylPt; fun_prop) (fun p => hms _ _)
  
  have hρ : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, (∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) →
      ∀ τ : ℝ, τ ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 → ∀ ρ s : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun ρ' => F (cylPt τ (ρ' * Real.cos s) (ρ' * Real.sin s)))
        (Real.cos s * partialDeriv 1 F (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
          + Real.sin s * partialDeriv 2 F (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) ρ := by
    intro F hF τ hτ ρ s
    have h := hR2 F (fun _ => τ) (fun ρ' => ρ' * Real.cos s) (fun ρ' => ρ' * Real.sin s)
      0 (Real.cos s) (Real.sin s) ρ (hasDerivAt_const ρ τ) (hasDerivAt_mul_const _)
      (hasDerivAt_mul_const _) (hF _ (hmc τ hτ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))
    beta_reduce at h
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    ring
  have hsρ : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, (∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) →
      ∀ τ : ℝ, τ ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 → ∀ ρ s : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun s' => F (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s') (ρ * Real.sin s')))
        (-(ρ * Real.sin s) * partialDeriv 1 F (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
          + ρ * Real.cos s * partialDeriv 2 F (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) s := by
    intro F hF τ hτ ρ s
    have h := hR2 F (fun _ => τ) (fun s' => ρ * Real.cos s') (fun s' => ρ * Real.sin s')
      0 (ρ * -Real.sin s) (ρ * Real.cos s) s (hasDerivAt_const s τ)
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos s).const_mul ρ) ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin s).const_mul ρ)
      (hF _ (hmc τ hτ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))
    beta_reduce at h
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    ring
  have hT : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, (∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) → ∀ t s : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun t' => F (cylPt t' (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)))
        (partialDeriv 0 F (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s))) t := by
    intro F hF t s
    have h := hR2 F (fun u => u) (fun _ => ℓ * Real.cos s) (fun _ => ℓ * Real.sin s)
      1 0 0 t (hasDerivAt_id' t) (hasDerivAt_const _ _) (hasDerivAt_const _ _) (hF _ (hms t s))
    beta_reduce at h
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    ring
  have hTs : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, (∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) → ∀ t s : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun s' => F (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s') (ℓ * Real.sin s')))
        (-(ℓ * Real.sin s) * partialDeriv 1 F (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s))
          + ℓ * Real.cos s * partialDeriv 2 F (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s))) s := by
    intro F hF t s
    have h := hR2 F (fun _ => t) (fun s' => ℓ * Real.cos s') (fun s' => ℓ * Real.sin s')
      0 (ℓ * -Real.sin s) (ℓ * Real.cos s) s (hasDerivAt_const s t)
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos s).const_mul ℓ) ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin s).const_mul ℓ) (hF _ (hms t s))
    beta_reduce at h
    refine h.congr_deriv ?_
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨Hc, hHc⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ τ ρ s, f τ ρ s =
      ρ * (Real.sin s * Q (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
        - Real.cos s * S (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Kc, hKc⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ τ ρ s, f τ ρ s =
      Real.sin s * S (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
        + Real.cos s * Q (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Hxc, hHxc⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ τ ρ s, f τ ρ s =
      (Real.sin s * Q (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
        - Real.cos s * S (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))
      + ρ * (Real.sin s * (Real.cos s * partialDeriv 1 Q (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + Real.sin s * partialDeriv 2 Q (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))
          - Real.cos s * (Real.cos s * partialDeriv 1 S (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + Real.sin s * partialDeriv 2 S (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Kyc, hKyc⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ τ ρ s, f τ ρ s =
      (Real.cos s * S (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
        + Real.sin s * (-(ρ * Real.sin s) * partialDeriv 1 S (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
          + ρ * Real.cos s * partialDeriv 2 S (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))))
      + (-Real.sin s * Q (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
        + Real.cos s * (-(ρ * Real.sin s) * partialDeriv 1 Q (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
          + ρ * Real.cos s * partialDeriv 2 Q (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hHcd : ∀ τ : ℝ, τ ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 → ∀ ρ s : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun ρ' => Hc τ ρ' s) (Hxc τ ρ s) ρ := by
    intro τ hτ ρ s
    simp only [hHc, hHxc]
    refine ((hasDerivAt_id' ρ).mul (((hρ Q hQd τ hτ ρ s).const_mul (Real.sin s)).sub
      ((hρ S hSd τ hτ ρ s).const_mul (Real.cos s)))).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  have hKcd : ∀ τ : ℝ, τ ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 → ∀ ρ s : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun s' => Kc τ ρ s') (Kyc τ ρ s) s := by
    intro τ hτ ρ s
    simp only [hKc, hKyc]
    refine (((Real.hasDerivAt_sin s).mul (hsρ S hSd τ hτ ρ s)).add
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos s).mul (hsρ Q hQd τ hτ ρ s))).congr_deriv ?_
    ring
  have hsn : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sin p.2) := by fun_prop
  have hcs : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.cos p.2) := by fun_prop
  have hfst : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1) := continuous_fst
  have hHxcc : ∀ τ : ℝ, τ ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 → Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Hxc τ p.1 p.2) := by
    intro τ hτ
    have h1 := hcapc S hSc τ hτ
    have h2 := hcapc Q hQc τ hτ
    have h3 := hcapc _ (hSpc 1) τ hτ
    have h4 := hcapc _ (hSpc 2) τ hτ
    have h5 := hcapc _ (hQpc 1) τ hτ
    have h6 := hcapc _ (hQpc 2) τ hτ
    simp only [hHxc]
    exact ((hsn.mul h2).sub (hcs.mul h1)).add (hfst.mul ((hsn.mul ((hcs.mul h5).add
      (hsn.mul h6))).sub (hcs.mul ((hcs.mul h3).add (hsn.mul h4)))))
  have hKycc : ∀ τ : ℝ, τ ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 → Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Kyc τ p.1 p.2) := by
    intro τ hτ
    have h1 := hcapc S hSc τ hτ
    have h2 := hcapc Q hQc τ hτ
    have h3 := hcapc _ (hSpc 1) τ hτ
    have h4 := hcapc _ (hSpc 2) τ hτ
    have h5 := hcapc _ (hQpc 1) τ hτ
    have h6 := hcapc _ (hQpc 2) τ hτ
    simp only [hKyc]
    exact ((hcs.mul h1).add (hsn.mul (((hfst.mul hsn).neg.mul h3).add
      ((hfst.mul hcs).mul h4)))).add ((hsn.neg.mul h2).add
      (hcs.mul (((hfst.mul hsn).neg.mul h5).add ((hfst.mul hcs).mul h6))))
  have hKcper : ∀ τ ρ : ℝ, Kc τ ρ (2 * Real.pi) = Kc τ ρ 0 := by
    intro τ ρ
    simp only [hKc, Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero]
  have hptc : ∀ τ ρ s : ℝ, Hxc τ ρ s + Kyc τ ρ s =
      ρ * (partialDeriv 2 Q (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
        - partialDeriv 1 S (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) := by
    intro τ ρ s
    simp only [hHxc, hKyc]
    linear_combination ρ * (partialDeriv 2 Q (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
        - partialDeriv 1 S (cylPt τ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq s
  have hτ1 : ℓ ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 := rfl
  have hτ2 : (-ℓ) ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 := by ring
  have hcapR1 := hR1 (fun ρ s => Hc ℓ ρ s - Hc (-ℓ) ρ s) (fun ρ s => Kc ℓ ρ s - Kc (-ℓ) ρ s)
    (fun ρ s => Hxc ℓ ρ s - Hxc (-ℓ) ρ s) (fun ρ s => Kyc ℓ ρ s - Kyc (-ℓ) ρ s)
    0 ℓ 0 (2 * Real.pi) hℓ0 (by positivity)
    (fun x y => (hHcd ℓ hτ1 x y).sub (hHcd (-ℓ) hτ2 x y))
    (fun x y => (hKcd ℓ hτ1 x y).sub (hKcd (-ℓ) hτ2 x y))
    ((hHxcc ℓ hτ1).sub (hHxcc (-ℓ) hτ2)) ((hKycc ℓ hτ1).sub (hKycc (-ℓ) hτ2))
    (fun x => by simp only [hKcper])
  beta_reduce at hcapR1
  have hcap : capFlux (jacCurlVec Y) ℓ = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      (Hxc ℓ x y - Hxc (-ℓ) x y + (Kyc ℓ x y - Kyc (-ℓ) x y)) := by
    unfold capFlux
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun ρ _ => ?_)
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
    dsimp only
    rw [(hV _).1, (hV _).1]
    linear_combination hptc (-ℓ) ρ s - hptc ℓ ρ s
  
  obtain ⟨Hs, hHs⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t s, f t s =
      ℓ * (S (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
        - Q (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Hxs, hHxs⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t s, f t s =
      ℓ * (partialDeriv 0 S (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)) * Real.cos s
        - partialDeriv 0 Q (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)) * Real.sin s) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Ks, hKs⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t s, f t s =
      -P (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Kys, hKys⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ∀ t s, f t s =
      -(-(ℓ * Real.sin s) * partialDeriv 1 P (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s))
        + ℓ * Real.cos s * partialDeriv 2 P (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s))) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hHsd : ∀ t s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t' => Hs t' s) (Hxs t s) t := by
    intro t s
    simp only [hHs, hHxs]
    exact (((hT S hSd t s).mul_const (Real.cos s)).sub
      ((hT Q hQd t s).mul_const (Real.sin s))).const_mul ℓ
  have hKsd : ∀ t s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s' => Ks t s') (Kys t s) s := by
    intro t s
    simp only [hKs, hKys]
    exact (hTs P hPd t s).neg
  have hHxsc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Hxs p.1 p.2) := by
    have h1 := hsidec _ (hSpc 0)
    have h2 := hsidec _ (hQpc 0)
    simp only [hHxs]
    fun_prop
  have hKysc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Kys p.1 p.2) := by
    have h1 := hsidec _ (hPpc 1)
    have h2 := hsidec _ (hPpc 2)
    simp only [hKys]
    fun_prop
  have hKsper : ∀ t : ℝ, Ks t (2 * Real.pi) = Ks t 0 := by
    intro t
    simp only [hKs, Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero]
  have hsideR1 := hR1 Hs Ks Hxs Kys (-ℓ) ℓ 0 (2 * Real.pi) (by linarith) (by positivity)
    hHsd hKsd hHxsc hKysc hKsper
  have hside : sideFlux (jacCurlVec Y) ℓ = ∫ x in (-ℓ)..ℓ, ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      (Hxs x y + Kys x y) := by
    unfold sideFlux
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun t _ => ?_)
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
    dsimp only
    rw [(hV _).2.1, (hV _).2.2, hHxs, hKys]
    ring
  
  have hneg : ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (Hc ℓ ℓ y - Hc (-ℓ) ℓ y - (Hc ℓ 0 y - Hc (-ℓ) 0 y))
      = -∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (Hs ℓ y - Hs (-ℓ) y) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun y _ => ?_)
    dsimp only
    simp only [hHc, hHs]
    ring
  rw [cylFlux, hcap, hcapR1, hneg, hside, hsideR1]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3) (R₁ ℓ : ℝ)
    (hR₁ : 0 ≤ R₁) (hℓ : R₁ < ℓ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})
    (hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖})
    (hYn : ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ → 1 < ‖Y x‖)
    (hsmooth' : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullbackMetric G Y x a b) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) :
    cylFlux (admVec (pullbackMetric G Y)) ℓ =
      cylFlux (piolaVec Y (admVec G)) ℓ + cylFlux (jacCurlVec Y) ℓ +
      cylFlux (fun x b => admVec (pullbackMetric G Y) x b - piolaVec Y (admVec G) x b
        - jacCurlVec Y x b) ℓ

signature.name: cyl_flux_three_split
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3) (R₁ ℓ : ℝ)
    (hR₁ : 0 ≤ R₁) (hℓ : R₁ < ℓ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})
    (hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖})
    (hYn : ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ → 1 < ‖Y x‖)
    (hsmooth' : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullbackMetric G Y x a b) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) :
    cylFlux (admVec (pullbackMetric G Y)) ℓ =
      cylFlux (piolaVec Y (admVec G)) ℓ + cylFlux (jacCurlVec Y) ℓ +
      cylFlux (fun x b => admVec (pullbackMetric G Y) x b - piolaVec Y (admVec G) x b
        - jacCurlVec Y x b) ℓ

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsub : ∀ (V W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => V x k) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) →
      (∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => W x k) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) →
      cylFlux (fun x => V x - W x) ℓ = cylFlux V ℓ - cylFlux W ℓ := by
    intro V W hV hW
    have hnorm : ∀ t a b : ℝ, ‖cylPt t a b‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
      intro t a b
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have hmem : ∀ t a b : ℝ, ℓ ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 →
        cylPt t a b ∈ {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
      intro t a b h
      show R₁ < ‖cylPt t a b‖
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have h1 := hnorm t a b
      have h2 : ‖cylPt t a b‖ ^ 2 ≤ R₁ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hc 2
      nlinarith
    have hcont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) := by
      unfold cylPt
      fun_prop
    have hc : ∀ (U : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
        (∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => U x k) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) →
        ∀ (k : Fin 3) (φ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), Continuous φ →
        (∀ p, ℓ ^ 2 ≤ (φ p).1 ^ 2 + (φ p).2.1 ^ 2 + (φ p).2.2 ^ 2) →
        Continuous (fun p => U (cylPt (φ p).1 (φ p).2.1 (φ p).2.2) k) := by
      intro U hU k φ hφ hφL
      exact (hU k).comp_continuous (hcont.comp hφ) (fun p => hmem _ _ _ (hφL p))
    have iter : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (a b c d : ℝ), Continuous (Function.uncurry f) →
        Continuous (Function.uncurry g) →
        (∫ x in a..b, ∫ y in c..d, (f x y - g x y)) =
          (∫ x in a..b, ∫ y in c..d, f x y) - ∫ x in a..b, ∫ y in c..d, g x y := by
      intro f g a b c d hf hg
      have h1 : (fun x => ∫ y in c..d, (f x y - g x y)) =
          fun x => (∫ y in c..d, f x y) - ∫ y in c..d, g x y := by
        funext x
        exact intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hf.uncurry_left x).intervalIntegrable _ _)
          ((hg.uncurry_left x).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      rw [h1]
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_sub
        ((intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hf c d).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hg c d).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    have capC : ∀ U : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ,
        (∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => U x k) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) →
        Continuous (Function.uncurry (fun ρ s : ℝ =>
          (U (cylPt ℓ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0
            - U (cylPt (-ℓ) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0) * ρ)) := by
      intro U hU
      have h1 := hc U hU 0 (fun p => (ℓ, p.1 * Real.cos p.2, p.1 * Real.sin p.2)) (by fun_prop)
        (fun p => by
          show ℓ ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2 + (p.1 * Real.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (p.1 * Real.sin p.2) ^ 2
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 * Real.cos p.2), sq_nonneg (p.1 * Real.sin p.2)])
      have h2 := hc U hU 0 (fun p => (-ℓ, p.1 * Real.cos p.2, p.1 * Real.sin p.2)) (by fun_prop)
        (fun p => by
          show ℓ ^ 2 ≤ (-ℓ) ^ 2 + (p.1 * Real.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (p.1 * Real.sin p.2) ^ 2
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 * Real.cos p.2), sq_nonneg (p.1 * Real.sin p.2)])
      exact Continuous.congr ((h1.sub h2).mul continuous_fst) (fun p => rfl)
    have sideC : ∀ U : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ,
        (∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => U x k) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) →
        Continuous (Function.uncurry (fun t s : ℝ =>
          (U (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)) 1 * Real.cos s
            + U (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)) 2 * Real.sin s) * ℓ)) := by
      intro U hU
      have hφL : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ,
          ℓ ^ 2 ≤ ((p.1, ℓ * Real.cos p.2, ℓ * Real.sin p.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ).1 ^ 2
            + ((p.1, ℓ * Real.cos p.2, ℓ * Real.sin p.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ).2.1 ^ 2
            + ((p.1, ℓ * Real.cos p.2, ℓ * Real.sin p.2) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ).2.2 ^ 2 := by
        intro p
        show ℓ ^ 2 ≤ p.1 ^ 2 + (ℓ * Real.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (ℓ * Real.sin p.2) ^ 2
        have e : (ℓ * Real.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (ℓ * Real.sin p.2) ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 := by
          rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← mul_add, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg p.1]
      have h1 := hc U hU 1 (fun p => (p.1, ℓ * Real.cos p.2, ℓ * Real.sin p.2)) (by fun_prop) hφL
      have h2 := hc U hU 2 (fun p => (p.1, ℓ * Real.cos p.2, ℓ * Real.sin p.2)) (by fun_prop) hφL
      exact Continuous.congr
        (((h1.mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp continuous_snd)).add
          (h2.mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp continuous_snd))).mul continuous_const) (fun p => rfl)
    have hcap : capFlux (fun x => V x - W x) ℓ = capFlux V ℓ - capFlux W ℓ := by
      have h := iter _ _ 0 ℓ 0 (2 * Real.pi) (capC V hV) (capC W hW)
      beta_reduce at h
      unfold capFlux
      refine Eq.trans ?_ h
      congr 1; funext ρ; congr 1; funext s
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
      ring
    have hside : sideFlux (fun x => V x - W x) ℓ = sideFlux V ℓ - sideFlux W ℓ := by
      have h := iter _ _ (-ℓ) ℓ 0 (2 * Real.pi) (sideC V hV) (sideC W hW)
      beta_reduce at h
      unfold sideFlux
      refine Eq.trans ?_ h
      congr 1; funext t; congr 1; funext s
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
      ring
    unfold cylFlux
    rw [hcap, hside]
    ring
  
  have hBF : ∀ (R : ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContinuousOn (fun x => partialDeriv i f x) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by
    intro R f hf i
    have hSR : IsOpen {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
    have h := hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hSR (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    exact h.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  
  have hadm : ∀ (H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (R : ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => H x a b) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) →
      ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => admVec H x k) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by
    intro H R hH k
    simp only [admVec]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hBF R _ (hH i k) i).sub (hBF R _ (hH i i) k))
  have hS : IsOpen {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hDY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Y) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
    hY.fderiv_of_isOpen hS le_rfl
  have hent : ∀ a c : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) c) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
    intro a c
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
      hDY.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (contDiff_piLp_apply (p := 2) (i := c)).comp_contDiffOn h1
  
  have hJ : ∀ b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => jacCurlVec Y x b) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
    intro b
    simp only [jacCurlVec]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hBF R₁ _ ((hent a b).sub (hent b a)) a)
  
  have hjac : ContinuousOn (fun x => jacMat Y x) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
    refine continuousOn_pi.2 (fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 (fun a => ?_))
    exact (hent a i).continuousOn
  have hadj : ∀ a i : Fin 3,
      ContinuousOn (fun x => (jacMat Y x).adjugate a i) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
    intro a i
    have h := (continuous_id.matrix_adjugate).comp_continuousOn hjac
    exact continuousOn_pi.1 (continuousOn_pi.1 h a) i
  have hG1 := hadm G 1 hsmooth
  have hP : ∀ a : Fin 3,
      ContinuousOn (fun x => piolaVec Y (admVec G) x a) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
    intro a
    simp only [piolaVec]
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hadj a i).mul ?_)
    exact (hG1 i).comp hY.continuousOn (fun x hx => hYn x hx)
  have hA := hadm (pullbackMetric G Y) R₁ hsmooth'
  
  have e1 := hsub (fun x b => admVec (pullbackMetric G Y) x b - piolaVec Y (admVec G) x b)
    (jacCurlVec Y) (fun k => (hA k).sub (hP k)) hJ
  have e2 := hsub (admVec (pullbackMetric G Y)) (piolaVec Y (admVec G)) hA hP
  have h1 : (fun x => (fun b => admVec (pullbackMetric G Y) x b - piolaVec Y (admVec G) x b)
      - jacCurlVec Y x) = (fun x b => admVec (pullbackMetric G Y) x b - piolaVec Y (admVec G) x b
        - jacCurlVec Y x b) := rfl
  have h2 : (fun x => admVec (pullbackMetric G Y) x - piolaVec Y (admVec G) x) =
      (fun x b => admVec (pullbackMetric G Y) x b - piolaVec Y (admVec G) x b) := rfl
  rw [h1] at e1
  rw [h2] at e2
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(V : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hV : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => V x a))
    (ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) :
    cylFlux V ℓ = ∫ x in {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2},
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => V z a) x

signature.name: cyl_divergence_theorem
signature.statement:
(V : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hV : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => V x a))
    (ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : 0 < ℓ) :
    cylFlux V ℓ = ∫ x in {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2},
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => V z a) x

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hVd : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ x : E3,
      HasFDerivAt (fun z => V z a) (fderiv ℝ (fun z => V z a) x) x :=
    fun a x => (((hV a).differentiable (by simp)) x).hasFDerivAt
  have hVc : ∀ a : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z => V z a) := fun a => (hV a).continuous
  have hVP : ∀ a i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun x => partialDeriv i (fun z => V z a) x) :=
    fun a i => ((hV a).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  
  have t_swap : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), Continuous (Function.uncurry f) → ∀ a₀ b₀ c₀ d₀ : ℝ,
      ∫ x in a₀..b₀, ∫ y in c₀..d₀, f x y = ∫ y in c₀..d₀, ∫ x in a₀..b₀, f x y := by
    intro f hf a₀ b₀ c₀ d₀
    have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry f)
        ((volume.restrict (Set.uIoc a₀ b₀)).prod (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc c₀ d₀))) := by
      rw [Measure.prod_restrict, ← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
      exact (hf.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_uIcc.prod isCompact_uIcc)).mono_set
        (Set.prod_mono Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc)
    have h1 : ∀ x, ∫ y in c₀..d₀, f x y =
        (if c₀ ≤ d₀ then (1:ℝ) else -1) • ∫ y in Set.uIoc c₀ d₀, f x y :=
      fun x => intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_eq_integral_uIoc _ _ _ _
    simp only [h1]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_smul, MeasureTheory.intervalIntegral_integral_swap hint]
    conv_rhs => rw [intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_eq_integral_uIoc]
  
  have t_chain : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (T Y Z : ℝ → ℝ) (T' Y' Z' u : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt T T' u → HasDerivAt Y Y' u → HasDerivAt Z Z' u →
      HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f (cylPt (T u) (Y u) (Z u))) (cylPt (T u) (Y u) (Z u)) →
      HasDerivAt (fun v => f (cylPt (T v) (Y v) (Z v)))
        (T' * partialDeriv 0 f (cylPt (T u) (Y u) (Z u))
          + Y' * partialDeriv 1 f (cylPt (T u) (Y u) (Z u))
          + Z' * partialDeriv 2 f (cylPt (T u) (Y u) (Z u))) u := by
    intro f T Y Z T' Y' Z' u hT hY hZ hf
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun v => cylPt (T v) (Y v) (Z v))
        (T' • e 0 + Y' • e 1 + Z' • e 2) u := by
      unfold cylPt
      exact ((hT.smul_const (e 0)).add (hY.smul_const (e 1))).add (hZ.smul_const (e 2))
    have h := hf.comp_hasDerivAt u hγ
    convert h using 1
    simp only [partialDeriv, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have s1 : ∀ k : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Continuous k →
      ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2}, k p =
        ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          k (ρ * Real.cos s, ρ * Real.sin s) * ρ := by
    intro k hk
    have hDkm : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2} :=
      (isClosed_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)).measurableSet
    have hS'm : MeasurableSet (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ℓ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi) :=
      measurableSet_Ioc.prod measurableSet_Ioo
    have hTm : MeasurableSet polarCoord.target := by
      rw [polarCoord_target]; exact measurableSet_Ioi.prod measurableSet_Ioo
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ,
        H = fun p => p.1 * k (p.1 * Real.cos p.2, p.1 * Real.sin p.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hHc : Continuous H := by subst hH; fun_prop
    have step1 : ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2}, k p =
        ∫ p in polarCoord.target,
          (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ℓ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi).indicator H p := by
      rw [← integral_indicator hDkm, ← integral_comp_polarCoord_symm]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hTm ?_
      intro p hp
      beta_reduce
      rw [polarCoord_target] at hp
      obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hp
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioi] at hp1
      have hr : (p.1 * Real.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (p.1 * Real.sin p.2) ^ 2 = p.1 ^ 2 := by
        linear_combination p.1 ^ 2 * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq p.2
      by_cases hle : p.1 ≤ ℓ
      · have hm1 : polarCoord.symm p ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2} := by
          rw [polarCoord_symm_apply]
          show (p.1 * Real.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (p.1 * Real.sin p.2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2
          rw [hr]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hp1.le hle 2
        have hm2 : p ∈ Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ℓ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi := ⟨⟨hp1, hle⟩, hp2⟩
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hm1, Set.indicator_of_mem hm2, polarCoord_symm_apply,
          smul_eq_mul]
        subst hH
        rfl
      · have hm1 : polarCoord.symm p ∉ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2} := by
          rw [polarCoord_symm_apply]
          show ¬ ((p.1 * Real.cos p.2) ^ 2 + (p.1 * Real.sin p.2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2)
          rw [hr, not_le]
          exact pow_lt_pow_left₀ (lt_of_not_ge hle) hℓ.le (by norm_num)
        have hm2 : p ∉ Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ℓ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi := fun h => hle h.1.2
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hm1, Set.indicator_of_notMem hm2, smul_zero]
    have step2 : ∫ p in polarCoord.target,
          (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ℓ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi).indicator H p
        = ∫ p in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ℓ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi, H p := by
      rw [setIntegral_indicator hS'm, Set.inter_eq_right.mpr]
      rw [polarCoord_target]
      exact Set.prod_mono Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self subset_rfl
    have hint : IntegrableOn H (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ℓ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi)
        ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) := by
      rw [← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
      exact (hHc.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)).mono_set
        (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
    have step3 : ∫ p in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ℓ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi, H p
        = ∫ r in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) ℓ, ∫ θ in Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi, H (r, θ) := by
      rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ ℝ]
      exact setIntegral_prod H hint
    have step4 : ∀ r : ℝ, ∫ θ in Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi, H (r, θ) =
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), k (r * Real.cos s, r * Real.sin s) * r := by
      intro r
      have hper : Function.Periodic (fun θ => H (r, θ)) (2 * Real.pi) := by
        intro θ
        subst hH
        simp only [Real.cos_add_two_pi, Real.sin_add_two_pi]
      rw [← integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo,
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith [Real.pi_pos] : -Real.pi ≤ Real.pi)]
      have h := hper.intervalIntegral_add_eq (-Real.pi) 0
      rw [show -Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi = Real.pi by ring, zero_add] at h
      rw [h]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
      subst hH
      simp only
      ring
    rw [step1, step2, step3, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hℓ.le]
    exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc (fun r _ => step4 r)
  
  have hc0 : ∀ a b c : ℝ, (cylPt a b c) 0 = a := by
    intro a b c; simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hc1 : ∀ a b c : ℝ, (cylPt a b c) 1 = b := by
    intro a b c; simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hc2 : ∀ a b c : ℝ, (cylPt a b c) 2 = c := by
    intro a b c; simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have s2 : ∀ h : E3 → ℝ, Continuous h →
      ∫ x in {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2}, h x =
        ∫ t in (-ℓ)..ℓ, ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2},
          h (cylPt t p.1 p.2) := by
    intro h hh
    let E : E3 ≃ᵐ ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) := (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ)).symm.trans
      ((MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0).trans
        (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ) MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow))
    have hE : MeasurePreserving E volume volume :=
      (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 3)).trans
        ((volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0).trans
          ((MeasurePreserving.id volume).prod (volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ)))
    have hEc : ∀ a b c : ℝ, E (cylPt a b c) = (a, (b, c)) := by
      intro a b c
      have h' : E (cylPt a b c) = ((cylPt a b c) 0, ((cylPt a b c) 1, (cylPt a b c) 2)) := rfl
      rw [h', hc0, hc1, hc2]
    have hEs : ∀ q, E.symm q = cylPt q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 := by
      intro q
      have h' := E.symm_apply_apply (cylPt q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
      rw [hEc] at h'
      exact h'
    have hpre : E.symm ⁻¹' {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2} =
        Set.Icc (-ℓ) ℓ ×ˢ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2} := by
      ext q
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, hEs, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Icc, hc0, hc1,
        hc2, abs_le]
    rw [← (MeasurePreserving.symm E hE).setIntegral_preimage_emb E.symm.measurableEmbedding h _,
      hpre]
    simp only [hEs]
    have hcyl : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => h (cylPt q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)) :=
      hh.comp (show Continuous (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => cylPt q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) by
        unfold cylPt; fun_prop)
    have hsub : Set.Icc (-ℓ) ℓ ×ˢ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2} ⊆
        Set.Icc (-ℓ) ℓ ×ˢ (Set.Icc (-ℓ) ℓ ×ˢ Set.Icc (-ℓ) ℓ) := by
      rintro ⟨t, y, z⟩ ⟨ht, hyz⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hyz
      have hy : y ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg z]
      have hz : z ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y]
      exact ⟨ht, Set.mem_Icc.mpr (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hy hℓ.le),
        Set.mem_Icc.mpr (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hz hℓ.le)⟩
    have hint : IntegrableOn (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => h (cylPt q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2))
        (Set.Icc (-ℓ) ℓ ×ˢ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2})
        ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ))) := by
      rw [← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
      exact (hcyl.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact
        (isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc))).mono_set hsub
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ (ℝ × ℝ), setIntegral_prod _ hint, integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
      intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith : -ℓ ≤ ℓ)]
  
  have s5 : ∀ h : E3 → ℝ, Continuous h →
      ∫ x in {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2}, h x =
        ∫ t in (-ℓ)..ℓ, ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          h (cylPt t (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) * ρ := by
    intro h hh
    rw [s2 h hh]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun t _ => ?_)
    exact s1 (fun p => h (cylPt t p.1 p.2))
      (hh.comp (show Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => cylPt t p.1 p.2) by unfold cylPt; fun_prop))
  
  have cP : Continuous (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
      cylPt q.1.1 (q.1.2 * Real.cos q.2) (q.1.2 * Real.sin q.2)) := by
    unfold cylPt; fun_prop
  have cF : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, Continuous f → Continuous (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
      f (cylPt q.1.1 (q.1.2 * Real.cos q.2) (q.1.2 * Real.sin q.2)) * q.1.2) :=
    fun f hf => (hf.comp cP).mul (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst)
  
  have lin3 : ∀ F G : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      Continuous (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => F q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2) →
      Continuous (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => G q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2) →
      ∫ t in (-ℓ)..ℓ, ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (F t ρ s + G t ρ s) =
        (∫ t in (-ℓ)..ℓ, ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), F t ρ s) +
        ∫ t in (-ℓ)..ℓ, ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), G t ρ s := by
    intro F G hF hG
    have c2 : ∀ H : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Continuous (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => H q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2) →
        Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H p.1 p.2 s) :=
      fun H hH => intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        (f := fun (p : ℝ × ℝ) (s : ℝ) => H p.1 p.2 s) hH _ _
    have c1 : ∀ H : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Continuous (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => H q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2) →
        Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H t ρ s) :=
      fun H hH => intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        (f := fun t ρ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H t ρ s) (c2 H hH) _ _
    have sl2 : ∀ H : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Continuous (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => H q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2) →
        ∀ t, Continuous (fun ρ : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), H t ρ s) :=
      fun H hH t => (c2 H hH).comp
        (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id : Continuous fun ρ : ℝ => ((t, ρ) : ℝ × ℝ))
    have sl3 : ∀ H : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, Continuous (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => H q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2) →
        ∀ t ρ, Continuous (fun s : ℝ => H t ρ s) :=
      fun H hH t ρ => hH.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id :
        Continuous fun s : ℝ => (((t, ρ), s) : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ))
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add ((c1 F hF).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((c1 G hG).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun t _ => ?_)
    try simp only
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add ((sl2 F hF t).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((sl2 G hG t).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun ρ _ => ?_)
    try simp only
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_add ((sl3 F hF t ρ).intervalIntegrable _ _)
      ((sl3 G hG t ρ).intervalIntegrable _ _)
  
  have t_cap : ∀ c : ℝ,
      ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (partialDeriv 1 (fun z => V z 1) (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + partialDeriv 2 (fun z => V z 2) (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * ρ =
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (V (cylPt c (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)) 1 * Real.cos s
            + V (cylPt c (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)) 2 * Real.sin s) * ℓ := by
    intro c
    have cPc : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => cylPt c (q.1 * Real.cos q.2) (q.1 * Real.sin q.2)) := by
      unfold cylPt; fun_prop
    have cq : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, Continuous f →
        Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => f (cylPt c (q.1 * Real.cos q.2) (q.1 * Real.sin q.2))) :=
      fun f hf => hf.comp cPc
    have cA := cq _ (hVc 1)
    have cB := cq _ (hVc 2)
    have cA1 := cq _ (hVP 1 1)
    have cA2 := cq _ (hVP 1 2)
    have cB1 := cq _ (hVP 2 1)
    have cB2 := cq _ (hVP 2 2)
    have cC : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.cos q.2) := by fun_prop
    have cS : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sin q.2) := by fun_prop
    have cR : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1) := continuous_fst
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, F = fun ρ s =>
        ρ * (V (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 1 * Real.cos s
          + V (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 2 * Real.sin s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, F = fun ρ s =>
        V (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 2 * Real.cos s
          - V (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 1 * Real.sin s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨DΦ, hDΦ⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, F = fun ρ s =>
        (V (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 1 * Real.cos s
          + V (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 2 * Real.sin s)
        + ρ * (Real.cos s * (Real.cos s * partialDeriv 1 (fun z => V z 1)
              (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + Real.sin s * partialDeriv 2 (fun z => V z 1)
              (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))
          + Real.sin s * (Real.cos s * partialDeriv 1 (fun z => V z 2)
              (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + Real.sin s * partialDeriv 2 (fun z => V z 2)
              (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨DΨ, hDΨ⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, F = fun ρ s =>
        (-(ρ * Real.sin s) * partialDeriv 1 (fun z => V z 2)
              (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + ρ * Real.cos s * partialDeriv 2 (fun z => V z 2)
              (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))
            * Real.cos s
          - V (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 2 * Real.sin s
          - ((-(ρ * Real.sin s) * partialDeriv 1 (fun z => V z 1)
              (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + ρ * Real.cos s * partialDeriv 2 (fun z => V z 1)
              (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))
            * Real.sin s
          + V (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 1 * Real.cos s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have cDΦ : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => DΦ q.1 q.2) := by
      subst hDΦ
      exact ((cA.mul cC).add (cB.mul cS)).add (cR.mul ((cC.mul ((cC.mul cA1).add
        (cS.mul cA2))).add (cS.mul ((cC.mul cB1).add (cS.mul cB2)))))
    have cDΨ : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => DΨ q.1 q.2) := by
      subst hDΨ
      exact (((((cR.mul cS).neg.mul cB1).add ((cR.mul cC).mul cB2)).mul cC).sub
        (cB.mul cS)).sub
        (((((cR.mul cS).neg.mul cA1).add ((cR.mul cC).mul cA2)).mul cS).add (cA.mul cC))
    have hΦd : ∀ ρ s, HasDerivAt (fun r => Φ r s) (DΦ ρ s) ρ := by
      intro ρ s
      have hTa := t_chain (fun z => V z 1) (fun _ => c) (fun r => r * Real.cos s)
        (fun r => r * Real.sin s) 0 (Real.cos s) (Real.sin s) ρ (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
        (hasDerivAt_mul_const _) (hasDerivAt_mul_const _) (hVd 1 _)
      have hTb := t_chain (fun z => V z 2) (fun _ => c) (fun r => r * Real.cos s)
        (fun r => r * Real.sin s) 0 (Real.cos s) (Real.sin s) ρ (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
        (hasDerivAt_mul_const _) (hasDerivAt_mul_const _) (hVd 2 _)
      beta_reduce at hTa hTb
      have h := (hasDerivAt_id ρ).mul
        ((hTa.mul_const (Real.cos s)).add (hTb.mul_const (Real.sin s)))
      subst hΦ hDΦ
      refine h.congr_deriv ?_
      simp only [id, Pi.add_apply]
      ring
    have hΨd : ∀ ρ s, HasDerivAt (fun u => Ψ ρ u) (DΨ ρ s) s := by
      intro ρ s
      have hY : HasDerivAt (fun u => ρ * Real.cos u) (ρ * -Real.sin s) s :=
        (Real.hasDerivAt_cos s).const_mul ρ
      have hZ : HasDerivAt (fun u => ρ * Real.sin u) (ρ * Real.cos s) s :=
        (Real.hasDerivAt_sin s).const_mul ρ
      have hTa := t_chain (fun z => V z 1) (fun _ => c) (fun u => ρ * Real.cos u)
        (fun u => ρ * Real.sin u) 0 _ _ s (hasDerivAt_const _ _) hY hZ (hVd 1 _)
      have hTb := t_chain (fun z => V z 2) (fun _ => c) (fun u => ρ * Real.cos u)
        (fun u => ρ * Real.sin u) 0 _ _ s (hasDerivAt_const _ _) hY hZ (hVd 2 _)
      beta_reduce at hTa hTb
      have h := (hTb.mul (Real.hasDerivAt_cos s)).sub (hTa.mul (Real.hasDerivAt_sin s))
      subst hΨ hDΨ
      refine h.congr_deriv ?_
      ring
    have key : ∀ ρ s,
        (partialDeriv 1 (fun z => V z 1) (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + partialDeriv 2 (fun z => V z 2) (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * ρ
          = DΦ ρ s + DΨ ρ s := by
      intro ρ s
      subst hDΦ hDΨ
      linear_combination (-(ρ * (partialDeriv 1 (fun z => V z 1)
            (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + partialDeriv 2 (fun z => V z 2) (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))))) *
        Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq s
    have hΨper : ∀ ρ, Ψ ρ (2 * Real.pi) - Ψ ρ 0 = 0 := by
      intro ρ
      subst hΨ
      simp [Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi]
    have sl1 : ∀ ρ, Continuous (fun s => DΦ ρ s) := fun ρ =>
      cDΦ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have sl2 : ∀ ρ, Continuous (fun s => DΨ ρ s) := fun ρ =>
      cDΨ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have sl3 : ∀ s, Continuous (fun ρ => DΦ ρ s) := fun s =>
      cDΦ.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    calc ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
          (partialDeriv 1 (fun z => V z 1) (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
            + partialDeriv 2 (fun z => V z 2) (cylPt c (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * ρ
        = ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), (DΦ ρ s + DΨ ρ s) := by
          congr 1; funext ρ; congr 1; funext s; exact key ρ s
      _ = ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), DΦ ρ s := by
          congr 1; funext ρ
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((sl1 ρ).intervalIntegrable _ _)
            ((sl2 ρ).intervalIntegrable _ _),
            intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun s _ => hΨd ρ s)
              ((sl2 ρ).intervalIntegrable _ _), hΨper ρ, add_zero]
      _ = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, DΦ ρ s := t_swap DΦ cDΦ _ _ _ _
      _ = _ := by
          congr 1; funext s
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun ρ _ => hΦd ρ s)
              ((sl3 s).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
          subst hΦ
          ring
  
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, A = fun t ρ s =>
      partialDeriv 0 (fun z => V z 0) (cylPt t (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) * ρ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, B = fun t ρ s =>
      (partialDeriv 1 (fun z => V z 1) (cylPt t (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))
        + partialDeriv 2 (fun z => V z 2) (cylPt t (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s))) * ρ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have cA : Continuous (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => A q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2) := by
    subst hA; exact cF _ (hVP 0 0)
  have cB : Continuous (fun q : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => B q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2) := by
    subst hB; exact cF _ ((hVP 1 1).add (hVP 2 2))
  have hsplit : ∀ t ρ s : ℝ,
      (∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => V z a) (cylPt t (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)))
        * ρ = A t ρ s + B t ρ s := by
    intro t ρ s
    subst hA hB
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hcap : ∫ t in (-ℓ)..ℓ, ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), A t ρ s
      = capFlux V ℓ := by
    have cG : Continuous (Function.uncurry fun t ρ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), A t ρ s) :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        (f := fun (p : ℝ × ℝ) (s : ℝ) => A p.1 p.2 s) cA _ _
    rw [t_swap _ cG]
    unfold capFlux
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun ρ _ => ?_)
    have cAρ : Continuous (Function.uncurry fun t s => A t ρ s) :=
      cA.comp (((continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const).prodMk continuous_snd) :
        Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (((p.1, ρ), p.2) : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ))
    show ∫ t in (-ℓ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), A t ρ s = _
    rw [t_swap _ cAρ]
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s _ => ?_)
    have hcont : Continuous (fun t => A t ρ s) :=
      cA.comp (((continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).prodMk continuous_const) :
        Continuous fun t : ℝ => (((t, ρ), s) : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ))
    have hd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun u => V (cylPt u (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0 * ρ)
        (A t ρ s) t := by
      intro t
      have h1 := t_chain (fun z => V z 0) (fun u => u) (fun _ => ρ * Real.cos s)
        (fun _ => ρ * Real.sin s) 1 0 0 t (hasDerivAt_id' t) (hasDerivAt_const _ _)
        (hasDerivAt_const _ _) (hVd 0 _)
      beta_reduce at h1
      subst hA
      exact (h1.mul_const ρ).congr_deriv (by ring)
    show ∫ t in (-ℓ)..ℓ, A t ρ s = _
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun t _ => hd t)
      (hcont.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    ring
  
  have hside : ∫ t in (-ℓ)..ℓ, ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..ℓ, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), B t ρ s
      = sideFlux V ℓ := by
    unfold sideFlux
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun c _ => ?_)
    subst hB
    exact t_cap c
  
  have hDc : Continuous (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => V z a) x) :=
    continuous_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hVP a a)
  unfold cylFlux
  rw [s5 _ hDc]
  simp only [hsplit]
  rw [lin3 A B cA cB, hcap, hside]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) :
    ∫ y : E3, (∑ j : Fin 3, admVec G y j * (y j / ‖y‖)) * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)
      = 16 * Real.pi * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (c + s)
