signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (c : ℝ) (hc : 2 ≤ c) :
    ∫ y : E3, (∑ j : Fin 3, admVec G y j * (y j / ‖y‖)) * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)
      = 16 * Real.pi * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (c + s)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, t < 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 1 < t → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).continuous_deriv le_rfl
    · intro t ht
      have h : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds ht] with s hs
        exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hs)
      rw [h.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    · intro t ht
      have h : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ht] with s hs
        exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (le_of_lt hs)
      rw [h.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  obtain ⟨hwc, hw0, hw1⟩ := s1
  have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hB : IsOpen {x : E3 | ‖x‖ < 2} := isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const
  
  set H := fun x : E3 => (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) x - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) x))
          * (x j / ‖x‖)) * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖x‖ - c) with hH
  have hgoal : (fun y : E3 => (∑ j : Fin 3, admVec G y j * (y j / ‖y‖))
      * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)) = H := rfl
  rw [hgoal]
  
  have hHi : Integrable H := by
    have hz : ∀ x : E3, (‖x‖ < 2 ∨ c + 1 < ‖x‖) → H x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · simp only [hH, hw0 (‖x‖ - c) (by linarith), mul_zero]
      · simp only [hH, hw1 (‖x‖ - c) (by linarith), mul_zero]
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport H := by
      apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0:E3) (c+1))
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] at hx
      exact hz x (Or.inr hx)
    have hcont : Continuous H := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : 1 < ‖x‖
      · have hP : ∀ i j k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j))
            {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
          intro i j k
          exact ((hsmooth i j).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply
            continuousOn_const
        have hcoord : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x : E3 => x j / ‖x‖)
            {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
          intro j
          apply ContinuousOn.div
          · exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.continuousOn
          · exact continuous_norm.continuousOn
          · intro y hy
            have : (1:ℝ) < ‖y‖ := hy
            positivity
        have hon : ContinuousOn H {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
          apply ContinuousOn.mul
          · apply continuousOn_finset_sum
            intro j _
            apply ContinuousOn.mul _ (hcoord j)
            apply continuousOn_finset_sum
            intro i _
            exact (hP i j i).sub (hP i i j)
          · exact (hwc.comp (continuous_norm.sub continuous_const)).continuousOn
        exact hon.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
      · have hx2 : ‖x‖ < 2 := by linarith [not_lt.mp hx]
        have hev : (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] H := by
          filter_upwards [hB.mem_nhds hx2] with y hy
          exact (hz y (Or.inl hy)).symm
        exact continuousAt_const.congr hev
    exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs
  
  have s8 : ∀ h : E3 → ℝ, Integrable h →
      ∫ x : E3, h x = ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        r ^ 2 * ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1), h (r • (θ : E3)) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere := by
    intro h hh
    have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ E3 - 1 = 2 := by simp
    have hmp := Measure.measurePreserving_homeomorphUnitSphereProd (volume : Measure E3)
    rw [hdim] at hmp
    have h2 : ∫ x : E3, h x
        = ∫ x : ({0}ᶜ : Set E3), h x ∂(Measure.comap Subtype.val volume) := by
      rw [integral_subtype_comap (measurableSet_singleton 0).compl h]
      rw [← integral_add_compl (measurableSet_singleton (0:E3)) hh,
        setIntegral_measure_zero _ (measure_singleton 0), zero_add]
    let g : (sphere (0:E3) 1) × (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) → ℝ :=
      fun p => h ((homeomorphUnitSphereProd E3).symm p : E3)
    have hgΦ : ∀ x : ({0}ᶜ : Set E3), g (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E3 x) = h x := by
      intro x
      simp only [g, Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply]
    have h3 : ∫ x : ({0}ᶜ : Set E3), h x ∂(Measure.comap Subtype.val volume)
        = ∫ p, g p ∂((volume : Measure E3).toSphere.prod (Measure.volumeIoiPow 2)) := by
      rw [← hmp.integral_comp (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E3).measurableEmbedding g]
      simp only [hgΦ]
    have hgi : Integrable g ((volume : Measure E3).toSphere.prod (Measure.volumeIoiPow 2)) := by
      rw [← hmp.integrable_comp_emb (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E3).measurableEmbedding]
      have : g ∘ (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E3) = h ∘ Subtype.val := by
        funext x
        exact hgΦ x
      rw [this]
      exact (integrableOn_iff_comap_subtypeVal (measurableSet_singleton 0).compl).mp
        hh.integrableOn
    rw [h2, h3, integral_prod_symm g hgi, Measure.volumeIoiPow.eq_1]
    have hmeas : Measurable (fun r : Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) => ENNReal.ofReal ((r:ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
      ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (measurable_subtype_coe.pow_const 2)
    rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul hmeas
      (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top))]
    rw [← integral_subtype_comap measurableSet_Ioi
      (fun r => r ^ 2 * ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1), h (r • (θ : E3))
        ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere)]
    congr 1
    funext y
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity), smul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
  
  have s9 : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c →
      ∫ r in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), r ^ 2 * ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1),
          (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
             (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) (r • (θ : E3))
               - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) (r • (θ : E3))))
             * ((r • (θ : E3)) j / ‖r • (θ : E3)‖))
            * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖r • (θ : E3)‖ - c) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere
        = 16 * Real.pi * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1,
            deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (c + s) := by
    intro c hc
    set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 16 * Real.pi * (deriv Real.smoothTransition (r - c) * fluxLocal G r)
      with hg
    have h1 : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), r ^ 2 * ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1),
          (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
             (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) (r • (θ : E3))
               - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) (r • (θ : E3))))
             * ((r • (θ : E3)) j / ‖r • (θ : E3)‖))
            * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖r • (θ : E3)‖ - c) ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere
          = g r := by
      intro r hr
      have hr0 : 0 < r := hr
      have hin : ∀ θ : sphere (0:E3) 1,
          (∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
             (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) (r • (θ : E3))
               - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) (r • (θ : E3))))
             * ((r • (θ : E3)) j / ‖r • (θ : E3)‖))
            * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖r • (θ : E3)‖ - c)
          = (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
              (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r • (θ : E3))
                - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j)
              * deriv Real.smoothTransition (r - c) := by
        intro θ
        have hθ : ‖(θ : E3)‖ = 1 := norm_eq_of_mem_sphere θ
        have hn : ‖r • (θ : E3)‖ = r := by
          rw [norm_smul, hθ, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr0, mul_one]
        have hcj : ∀ j : Fin 3, (r • (θ:E3)) j / r = (θ:E3) j := by
          intro j
          rw [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
        simp only [hn, hcj, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ hin), integral_mul_const]
      simp only [hg, fluxLocal]
      field_simp
      try ring
    rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi h1]
    have hsub : Set.Icc c (c+1) ⊆ Set.Ioi 0 := fun r hr => lt_of_lt_of_le hc hr.1
    have hzero : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) \ Set.Icc c (c+1), g r = 0 := by
      intro r hr
      have hr2 := hr.2
      simp only [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le] at hr2
      rcases hr2 with hr2 | hr2
      · simp [hg, hw0 (r - c) (by linarith)]
      · simp [hg, hw1 (r - c) (by linarith)]
    rw [setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi hsub hzero]
    rw [integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith)]
    have hshift := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_add_right g c (a := 0) (b := 1)
    rw [zero_add, show (1:ℝ) + c = c + 1 by ring] at hshift
    rw [← hshift, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext s
    simp only [hg]
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right, add_comm s c]
  
  rw [s8 H hHi, hH]
  exact s9 c (by linarith)

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (m : ℝ) (hm : Tendsto (fluxLocal G) atTop (𝓝 m)) :
    Tendsto (fun c : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (c + s))
      atTop (𝓝 m)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hpd : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (h : E3 → ℝ), Measurable (partialDeriv k h) := by
    intro k h
    exact measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ h (e k)
  have hP : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × sphere (0 : E3) 1 => p.1 • (p.2 : E3)) :=
    (continuous_fst.smul (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).measurable
  have hcj : ∀ j : Fin 3, Measurable (fun p : ℝ × sphere (0 : E3) 1 => (p.2 : E3) j) := by
    intro j
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)).measurable
  have hF : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × sphere (0 : E3) 1 =>
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (p.1 • (p.2 : E3))
          - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (p.1 • (p.2 : E3))) * (p.2 : E3) j) := by
    refine Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_))
    exact (((hpd i _).comp hP).sub ((hpd j _).comp hP)).mul (hcj j)
  have hI := (hF.stronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
    (ν := (volume : Measure E3).toSphere)).measurable
  have hf : Measurable (fluxLocal G) :=
    (measurable_const.mul (measurable_id.pow_const 2)).mul hI
  
  have hcd : ContDiff ℝ ((1 : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) Real.smoothTransition :=
    Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)
  have hw : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) := hcd.continuous_deriv (by norm_num)
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ Real.smoothTransition := hcd.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hw1 : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s = 1 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub (fun x _ => hdiff x) (hw.intervalIntegrable 0 1)]
    simp [Real.smoothTransition.one, Real.smoothTransition.zero]
  
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, |deriv Real.smoothTransition s| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by
    rw [hB]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun u _ => abs_nonneg _)
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro ε hε
  have hδ : 0 < ε / (B + 1) := div_pos hε (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hm (ε / (B + 1)) hδ
  refine ⟨N, fun c hc => ?_⟩
  have hpt : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, |fluxLocal G (c + s) - m| < ε / (B + 1) := by
    intro s hs
    have := hN (c + s) (by linarith [hs.1])
    rwa [Real.dist_eq] at this
  have hI1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (c + s))
      volume 0 1 := by
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff, Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one]
    refine Integrable.mul_bdd (c := |m| + ε / (B + 1)) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact (hw.integrableOn_Icc (a := 0) (b := 1)).mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
    · exact (hf.comp (measurable_const_add c)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc (fun s hs => ?_)
      have h1 := hpt s hs
      have h2 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (fluxLocal G (c + s)) m
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      linarith
  have hI2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun s => deriv Real.smoothTransition s * m) volume 0 1 :=
    (hw.mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hm' : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * m = m := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, hw1, one_mul]
  have hsplit : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * (fluxLocal G (c + s) - m)
      = (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * fluxLocal G (c + s)) - m := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_sub hI1 hI2
    rw [hm'] at h
    rw [← h]
    congr 1
    ext s
    ring
  have hest : ‖∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition s * (fluxLocal G (c + s) - m)‖
      ≤ ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..1, ε / (B + 1) * |deriv Real.smoothTransition s| := by
    refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le zero_le_one
      (ae_of_all _ (fun t ht => ?_)) ((continuous_const.mul hw.abs).intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hpt t ht).le (abs_nonneg _)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, ← hB, hsplit, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hest
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  calc _ ≤ ε / (B + 1) * B := hest
    _ < ε / (B + 1) * (B + 1) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by linarith) hδ
    _ = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε (by linarith)

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C₁ : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C₁)
    (R₃ : ℝ) (hR₃ : R₁ ≤ R₃) (hYb : ∀ x : E3, R₃ < ‖x‖ → ‖x‖ / 2 ≤ ‖Y x‖) :
    ∃ c₀ : ℝ, ∀ c : ℝ, c₀ ≤ c →
      (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c x a)) ∧
      ∀ ℓ : ℝ, R₃ < ℓ → 2 * c + 2 ≤ ℓ →
        cylFlux (cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c) ℓ = cylFlux (piolaVec Y (admVec G)) ℓ

signature.name: cutoffPiolaField_props
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C₁ : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C₁)
    (R₃ : ℝ) (hR₃ : R₁ ≤ R₃) (hYb : ∀ x : E3, R₃ < ‖x‖ → ‖x‖ / 2 ≤ ‖Y x‖) :
    ∃ c₀ : ℝ, ∀ c : ℝ, c₀ ≤ c →
      (∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c x a)) ∧
      ∀ ℓ : ℝ, R₃ < ℓ → 2 * c + 2 ≤ ℓ →
        cylFlux (cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c) ℓ = cylFlux (piolaVec Y (admVec G)) ℓ

proof.tactics:
by
  unfold CoordChange at hXY
  obtain ⟨hR02, hR01, hC1, -, hYs, hYX, -, hXb⟩ := hXY
  have h11 : ((1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ∞) := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  have h1i : ((1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞) := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  
  have hgrowth : ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ → ‖Y x‖ ≤ max (2 * ‖x‖) ((2 * C₁) ^ (1 / q)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hY0, hXYx⟩ := hYX x hx
    have ht : 0 < ‖Y x‖ := by linarith
    have hstar : ‖Y x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + C₁ * ‖Y x‖ ^ (1 - q) := by
      have h1 := (hXb (Y x) hY0).1
      rw [hXYx] at h1
      have h2 : ‖Y x‖ - ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x - Y x‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_norm_le (Y x) x
        rw [norm_sub_rev] at this
        exact this
      linarith
    by_cases hcase : ‖Y x‖ ≤ (2 * C₁) ^ (1 / q)
    · exact le_max_of_le_right hcase
    · push_neg at hcase
      have h2C : 2 * C₁ < ‖Y x‖ ^ q := by
        have := Real.rpow_lt_rpow (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ (2 * C₁) ^ (1 / q)) hcase hq
        rwa [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq.ne',
          Real.rpow_one] at this
      have hpow : ‖Y x‖ ^ (1 - q) * ‖Y x‖ ^ q = ‖Y x‖ := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add ht, sub_add_cancel, Real.rpow_one]
      have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖Y x‖ ^ (1 - q) := Real.rpow_nonneg ht.le _
      have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2C.le h3
      have : C₁ * ‖Y x‖ ^ (1 - q) ≤ ‖Y x‖ / 2 := by nlinarith
      exact le_max_of_le_left (by linarith)
  refine ⟨max (2 * R₁ + 2) ((2 * C₁) ^ (1 / q)), fun c hc => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro a
    have hO : IsOpen {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
    have hB : IsOpen {x : E3 | ‖x‖ < R₁ + 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const
    have hW : IsOpen {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
    have hvan : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < R₁ + 1 → cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c x a = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [cutoffPiolaField]
      split_ifs with h
      · have hg := hgrowth x h
        have hle : ‖Y x‖ - c ≤ 0 := by
          have : max (2 * ‖x‖) ((2 * C₁) ^ (1 / q)) ≤ max (2 * R₁ + 2) ((2 * C₁) ^ (1 / q)) :=
            max_le_max (by linarith) le_rfl
          linarith
        simp [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos hle]
      · rfl
    have hYO : ∀ x ∈ {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}, 1 < ‖Y x‖ := fun x hx => by
      have := (hYX x hx).1
      linarith
    have hDY : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ Y) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
      hYs.fderiv_of_isOpen hO h11
    have hJ : ∀ k b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => jacMat Y x k b) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
      intro k b
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
        hDY.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      have h2 := (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) k).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      simpa [jacMat] using h2
    have hAdj : ∀ a' i : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (jacMat Y x).adjugate a' i) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
      intro a' i
      simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
      fin_cases a' <;> fin_cases i <;> simp <;>
        apply_rules [ContDiffOn.mul, ContDiffOn.sub, ContDiffOn.add, ContDiffOn.neg, hJ]
    have hPsi : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => Real.smoothTransition (‖Y x‖ - c))
        {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => ‖Y x‖) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
        (hYs.of_le h1i).norm ℝ (fun x hx => by
          have := hYO x hx
          exact norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith))
      exact (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).comp_contDiffOn (h1.sub contDiffOn_const)
    have hPD : ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
      intro i j k
      exact ((hsmooth i j).fderiv_of_isOpen hW h11).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hAdm : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => admVec G (Y x) i) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
      intro i
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => admVec G y i) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
        simp only [admVec]
        exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun l _ => (hPD l i l).sub (hPD l l i))
      exact h1.comp (hYs.of_le h1i) (fun x hx => hYO x hx)
    have hH : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Y x).adjugate a i *
        (Real.smoothTransition (‖Y x‖ - c) * admVec G (Y x) i)) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
      ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => (hAdj a i).mul (hPsi.mul (hAdm i)))
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hx : ‖x‖ < R₁ + 1
    · have hev : (fun x => cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c x a) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hB.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hvan y hy)
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    · push_neg at hx
      have hxO : x ∈ {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
        show R₁ < ‖x‖
        linarith
      have hev : (fun x => cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c x a) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Y x).adjugate a i *
            (Real.smoothTransition (‖Y x‖ - c) * admVec G (Y x) i) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hxO) (fun y hy => by
          have hy' : R₁ < ‖y‖ := hy
          simp only [cutoffPiolaField, if_pos hy'])
      exact (hH.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hxO)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  · intro ℓ hℓ hℓc
    have hℓpos : 0 < ℓ := by linarith
    have hpt : ∀ x : E3, ℓ ≤ ‖x‖ → ∀ a : Fin 3,
        cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c x a = piolaVec Y (admVec G) x a := by
      intro x hx a
      have h1 : R₁ < ‖x‖ := by linarith
      have h2 := hYb x (by linarith)
      have h3 : 1 ≤ ‖Y x‖ - c := by linarith
      simp only [cutoffPiolaField, piolaVec, if_pos h1, Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le h3,
        one_mul]
    have hnorm : ∀ t a b : ℝ, ‖cylPt t a b‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
      intro t a b
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
      simp [cylPt, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hge : ∀ t a b : ℝ, ℓ ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 → ℓ ≤ ‖cylPt t a b‖ := by
      intro t a b h
      rw [← hnorm] at h
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (cylPt t a b)]
    have hcap1 : ∀ ρ s : ℝ, ∀ a : Fin 3,
        cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c (cylPt ℓ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) a
          = piolaVec Y (admVec G) (cylPt ℓ (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) a :=
      fun ρ s => hpt _ (hge _ _ _ (by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ρ * Real.cos s), sq_nonneg (ρ * Real.sin s)]))
    have hcap2 : ∀ ρ s : ℝ, ∀ a : Fin 3,
        cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c (cylPt (-ℓ) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) a
          = piolaVec Y (admVec G) (cylPt (-ℓ) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) a :=
      fun ρ s => hpt _ (hge _ _ _ (by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ρ * Real.cos s), sq_nonneg (ρ * Real.sin s)]))
    have hside : ∀ t s : ℝ, ∀ a : Fin 3,
        cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)) a
          = piolaVec Y (admVec G) (cylPt t (ℓ * Real.cos s) (ℓ * Real.sin s)) a := by
      intro t s
      refine hpt _ (hge _ _ _ ?_)
      have h : (ℓ * Real.cos s) ^ 2 + (ℓ * Real.sin s) ^ 2 = ℓ ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← mul_add, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
    unfold cylFlux capFlux sideFlux
    simp only [hcap1, hcap2, hside]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C₁ : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C₁)
    (R₃ : ℝ) (hR₃ : R₁ ≤ R₃) (hdet : ∀ x : E3, R₃ < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (jacMat Y x).det)
    (R' : ℝ) (hD : IntegrableOn (fluxDivLocal G) {y : E3 | R' < ‖y‖}) :
    ∃ c₀ : ℝ, ∀ c : ℝ, c₀ ≤ c → ∀ ℓ : ℝ, 2 * c + 2 ≤ ℓ →
      |(∫ x in {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2},
          ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c z a) x)
        - ∫ y : E3, (∑ j : Fin 3, admVec G y j * (y j / ‖y‖)) *
            deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)|
        ≤ ∫ y : E3, |fluxDivLocal G y| * Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C₁ : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C₁)
    (R₃ : ℝ) (hR₃ : R₁ ≤ R₃) (hdet : ∀ x : E3, R₃ < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (jacMat Y x).det)
    (R' : ℝ) (hD : IntegrableOn (fluxDivLocal G) {y : E3 | R' < ‖y‖}) :
    ∃ c₀ : ℝ, ∀ c : ℝ, c₀ ≤ c → ∀ ℓ : ℝ, 2 * c + 2 ≤ ℓ →
      |(∫ x in {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2},
          ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c z a) x)
        - ∫ y : E3, (∑ j : Fin 3, admVec G y j * (y j / ‖y‖)) *

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have lin_expand : ∀ (f : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E3), f v = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k * f (e k) := by
    intro f v
    have hv : v = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k • e k := by
      ext j
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      fin_cases j <;> simp
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    simp [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have t_alg : ∀ (J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (dA dW : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (w : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ i, ∑ a : Fin 3, dA a i = 0) →
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, (dA a i * w i + J.adjugate a i * ∑ k : Fin 3, J k a * dW k i)
        = J.det * ∑ i : Fin 3, dW i i := by
    intro J dA dW w hP
    have h0 := hP 0
    have h1 := hP 1
    have h2 := hP 2
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0 h1 h2 ⊢
    simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three, Matrix.det_fin_three, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val',
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.empty_val',
      Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_fin_const]
    linear_combination (w 0) * h0 + (w 1) * h1 + (w 2) * h2
  have pd_fderiv_coord : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (x : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Z) x →
      ∀ (a b k : Fin 3),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Z z (e a)) k) x ∧
      partialDeriv b (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Z z (e a)) k) x
        = (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Z) x (e b) (e a)) k := by
    intro Z x hd a b k
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => fderiv ℝ Z z (e a))
        ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Z) x).flip (e a)) x := by
      have := hd.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e a) x)
      simpa using this
    have h2 := (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp x h1
    refine ⟨h2.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    show fderiv ℝ ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ fun z => fderiv ℝ Z z (e a)) x (e b) = _
    rw [h2.fderiv]
    simp
  have cross_div : ∀ (P Q : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (x : E3),
      (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (P a) x) → (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (Q a) x) →
      (∀ a b, partialDeriv b (P a) x = partialDeriv a (P b) x) →
      (∀ a b, partialDeriv b (Q a) x = partialDeriv a (Q b) x) →
      partialDeriv 0 (fun z => P 1 z * Q 2 z - P 2 z * Q 1 z) x
        + partialDeriv 1 (fun z => P 2 z * Q 0 z - P 0 z * Q 2 z) x
        + partialDeriv 2 (fun z => P 0 z * Q 1 z - P 1 z * Q 0 z) x = 0 := by
    intro P Q x hP hQ sP sQ
    have prod : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (f g h k : E3 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ g x → DifferentiableAt ℝ h x → DifferentiableAt ℝ k x →
        partialDeriv b (fun z => f z * g z - h z * k z) x
          = partialDeriv b f x * g x + f x * partialDeriv b g x
            - (partialDeriv b h x * k x + h x * partialDeriv b k x) := by
      intro b f g h k hf hg hh hk
      have h' : HasFDerivAt (fun z => f z * g z - h z * k z) _ x :=
        (hf.hasFDerivAt.mul hg.hasFDerivAt).sub (hh.hasFDerivAt.mul hk.hasFDerivAt)
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [h'.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [prod 0 _ _ _ _ (hP 1) (hQ 2) (hP 2) (hQ 1), prod 1 _ _ _ _ (hP 2) (hQ 0) (hP 0) (hQ 2),
      prod 2 _ _ _ _ (hP 0) (hQ 1) (hP 1) (hQ 0)]
    linear_combination (Q 2 x) * sP 1 0 - (Q 1 x) * sP 2 0 + (Q 0 x) * sP 2 1
      + (P 1 x) * sQ 2 0 - (P 2 x) * sQ 1 0 - (P 0 x) * sQ 2 1
  
  have s2 : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Z U → ∀ x : E3, x ∈ U →
      (∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (jacMat Z z).adjugate a i) x) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Z z).adjugate a i) x = 0 := by
    intro Z U hU hY x hx
    have hYc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Z x := hY.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    have hdc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Z) x := hYc.fderiv_right (by simp)
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Z) x := hdc.differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ Z x := hYc.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    set B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ := fun k a z => (fderiv ℝ Z z (e a)) k with hBdef
    have hBd : ∀ k a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (B k a) x :=
      fun k a => (pd_fderiv_coord Z x hd a 0 k).1
    have hBs : ∀ k a b, partialDeriv b (B k a) x = partialDeriv a (B k b) x := by
      intro k a b
      rw [(pd_fderiv_coord Z x hd a b k).2, (pd_fderiv_coord Z x hd b a k).2, hsymm.eq]
    have hadj : ∀ z, (jacMat Z z).adjugate = !![B 1 1 z * B 2 2 z - B 1 2 z * B 2 1 z,
        B 2 1 z * B 0 2 z - B 2 2 z * B 0 1 z, B 0 1 z * B 1 2 z - B 0 2 z * B 1 1 z;
        B 1 2 z * B 2 0 z - B 1 0 z * B 2 2 z, B 2 2 z * B 0 0 z - B 2 0 z * B 0 2 z,
        B 0 2 z * B 1 0 z - B 0 0 z * B 1 2 z;
        B 1 0 z * B 2 1 z - B 1 1 z * B 2 0 z, B 2 0 z * B 0 1 z - B 2 1 z * B 0 0 z,
        B 0 0 z * B 1 1 z - B 0 1 z * B 1 0 z] := by
      intro z
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [jacMat, hBdef] <;> ring
    have hfun : ∀ a i, (fun z => (jacMat Z z).adjugate a i) = fun z =>
        (!![B 1 1 z * B 2 2 z - B 1 2 z * B 2 1 z,
        B 2 1 z * B 0 2 z - B 2 2 z * B 0 1 z, B 0 1 z * B 1 2 z - B 0 2 z * B 1 1 z;
        B 1 2 z * B 2 0 z - B 1 0 z * B 2 2 z, B 2 2 z * B 0 0 z - B 2 0 z * B 0 2 z,
        B 0 2 z * B 1 0 z - B 0 0 z * B 1 2 z;
        B 1 0 z * B 2 1 z - B 1 1 z * B 2 0 z, B 2 0 z * B 0 1 z - B 2 1 z * B 0 0 z,
        B 0 0 z * B 1 1 z - B 0 1 z * B 1 0 z] : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) a i := by
      intro a i
      funext z
      rw [hadj z]
    constructor
    · intro a i
      rw [hfun a i]
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases i <;> simp <;>
        exact ((hBd _ _).mul (hBd _ _)).sub ((hBd _ _).mul (hBd _ _))
    · intro i
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hfun]
      fin_cases i <;> simp
      · exact cross_div (B 1) (B 2) x (hBd 1) (hBd 2) (hBs 1) (hBs 2)
      · exact cross_div (B 2) (B 0) x (hBd 2) (hBd 0) (hBs 2) (hBs 0)
      · exact cross_div (B 0) (B 1) x (hBd 0) (hBd 1) (hBs 0) (hBs 1)
  
  have s3 : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ Z x →
      (∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (jacMat Z z).adjugate a i) x) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y i) (Z x)) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3,
        ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Z z).adjugate a i) x = 0) →
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a
          (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Z z).adjugate a i * W (Z z) i) x
        = (jacMat Z x).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => W y i) (Z x) := by
    intro Z W x hY hA hW hP
    have hWY : ∀ i, HasFDerivAt (fun z => W (Z z) i)
        ((fderiv ℝ (fun y => W y i) (Z x)).comp (fderiv ℝ Z x)) x :=
      fun i => (hW i).hasFDerivAt.comp x hY.hasFDerivAt
    have hterm : ∀ a, partialDeriv a
        (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Z z).adjugate a i * W (Z z) i) x
        = ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Z z).adjugate a i) x * W (Z x) i
            + (jacMat Z x).adjugate a i *
              ∑ k : Fin 3, jacMat Z x k a * partialDeriv k (fun y => W y i) (Z x)) := by
      intro a
      have hs : HasFDerivAt
          (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Z z).adjugate a i * W (Z z) i) _ x :=
        HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
          (fun i _ => ((hA a i).hasFDerivAt.mul (hWY i)))
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hs.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sum', Finset.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp',
        Function.comp_apply]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [lin_expand (fderiv ℝ (fun y => W y i) (Z x)) (fderiv ℝ Z x (e a))]
      simp only [jacMat, Matrix.of_apply]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hterm a)]
    exact t_alg (jacMat Z x) (fun a i => partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Z z).adjugate a i) x)
      (fun k i => partialDeriv k (fun y => W y i) (Z x)) (fun i => W (Z x) i) hP
  
  have hwc : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) :=
    (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).continuous_deriv le_rfl
  have hw0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t < 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have h : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds ht] with s hs
      exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hs)
    rw [h.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  have hw1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 < t → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have h : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ht] with s hs
      exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (le_of_lt hs)
    rw [h.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  
  have s4 : ∀ (c : ℝ) (y : E3), 1 < ‖y‖ →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c) * admVec G z i) y) ∧
      ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c) * admVec G z i) y
        = (∑ j : Fin 3, admVec G y j * (y j / ‖y‖)) * deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)
          + fluxDivLocal G y * Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) := by
    intro c y hy
    have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (by linarith)
    have s2' : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} → ∀ i : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
      intro f hf i
      exact (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hd : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k f) y := by
      intro k f hf
      exact ((s2' f hf k).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
    have hUd : ∀ j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => admVec G z j) y := by
      intro j
      simp only [admVec]
      apply DifferentiableAt.fun_sum
      intro i _
      exact (hd i _ (hsmooth i j)).sub (hd j _ (hsmooth i i))
    have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : E3 => Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) y := by
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ - c) y :=
        (contDiffAt_norm ℝ hy0).sub contDiffAt_const
      exact (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp_contDiffAt y h1).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hψ' : ∀ j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) y
          = deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) * (y j / ‖y‖) := by
      intro j
      have hn : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hy0
      have hsq : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ y) y :=
        (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq y).hasFDerivAt
      have hsqrt := hsq.sqrt (by positivity)
      have heq : (fun y : E3 => Real.sqrt (‖y‖ ^ 2)) = fun y => ‖y‖ := by
        funext y; exact Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)
      rw [heq] at hsqrt
      have hψ : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c))
          (‖y‖ - c) :=
        (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1).differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasDerivAt
      have hcomp := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt y hψ (hsqrt.sub_const c)
      have hf : (fun y : E3 => Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c))
          = Real.smoothTransition ∘ (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖ - c) := rfl
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hf, hcomp.fderiv]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
      field_simp
      try simp
    have s6 : ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => admVec G z j) y = fluxDivLocal G y := by
      have hj : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => admVec G z j) y
          = ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv j (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y) y
              - partialDeriv j (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y) y) := by
        intro j
        have hdiff : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)), DifferentiableAt ℝ
            (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y)
            y :=
          fun i _ => (hd i _ (hsmooth i j)).sub (hd j _ (hsmooth i i))
        show fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
            (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y)) y (e j)
          = _
        rw [fderiv_fun_sum hdiff, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hd i _ (hsmooth i j)) (hd j _ (hsmooth i i))]
        rfl
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hj j), Finset.sum_comm]
      rfl
    refine ⟨fun i => hψd.mul (hUd i), ?_⟩
    have hprod : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c) * admVec G z i) y
          = partialDeriv i (fun z : E3 => Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) y * admVec G y i
            + Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) * partialDeriv i (fun z => admVec G z i) y := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [fderiv_fun_mul hψd (hUd i)]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hprod i), ← s6]
    simp only [hψ', Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have s5 : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (x : E3), (jacMat Z x).det = (fderiv ℝ Z x).det := by
    intro Z x
    let b := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis
    have : jacMat Z x = LinearMap.toMatrix b b (fderiv ℝ Z x : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) := by
      ext i a
      simp [jacMat, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, b]
    rw [this, LinearMap.det_toMatrix]
  
  have s7 : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (B : Set E3), MeasurableSet B →
      (∀ x ∈ B, HasFDerivAt Z (fderiv ℝ Z x) x) → Set.InjOn Z B →
      (∀ x ∈ B, 0 < (fderiv ℝ Z x).det) →
      ∀ (F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ), Integrable F₁ → Integrable F₂ →
      (∀ y : E3, F₁ y ≠ 0 → y ∈ Z '' B) →
      |(∫ x in B, (fderiv ℝ Z x).det * (F₁ (Z x) + F₂ (Z x))) - ∫ y, F₁ y| ≤ ∫ y, |F₂ y| := by
    intro Z B hB hYd hinj hdet F₁ F₂ h₁ h₂ hsupp
    have hcov := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hB
      (fun x hx => (hYd x hx).hasFDerivWithinAt) hinj (fun y => F₁ y + F₂ y)
    have e1 : (∫ x in B, (fderiv ℝ Z x).det * (F₁ (Z x) + F₂ (Z x)))
        = ∫ y in Z '' B, (F₁ y + F₂ y) := by
      rw [hcov]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hB (fun x hx => ?_)
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, abs_of_pos (hdet x hx)]
    rw [e1, integral_add h₁.integrableOn h₂.integrableOn]
    have e3 : ∫ y in Z '' B, F₁ y = ∫ y, F₁ y := by
      apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
      intro y hy
      by_contra h
      exact hy (hsupp y h)
    rw [e3, add_sub_cancel_left]
    calc |∫ y in Z '' B, F₂ y| ≤ ∫ y in Z '' B, |F₂ y| := by
          have := norm_integral_le_integral_norm (μ := volume.restrict (Z '' B)) F₂
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
      _ ≤ ∫ y, |F₂ y| := setIntegral_le_integral h₂.abs (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => abs_nonneg _))
  
  obtain ⟨hR0, hR01, hC, hXs, hYs, hYX, hinj, hXb⟩ := hXY
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρR0, hYn, hXn⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, R₀ < ρ ∧
      (∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ → ‖Y x‖ ≤ max ρ (2 * ‖x‖)) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, ρ ≤ ‖y‖ → ‖y‖ / 2 ≤ ‖X y‖ ∧ ‖X y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖y‖ ∧
        (R₁ < ‖X y‖ → Y (X y) = y)) := by
    have hρ1 : R₀ + 1 ≤ max (R₀ + 1) ((2 * C₁) ^ (1 / q)) := le_max_left _ _
    have hρ2 : (2 * C₁) ^ (1 / q) ≤ max (R₀ + 1) ((2 * C₁) ^ (1 / q)) := le_max_right _ _
    set ρ := max (R₀ + 1) ((2 * C₁) ^ (1 / q)) with hρ
    have key : ∀ r : ℝ, ρ ≤ r → C₁ * r ^ (1 - q) ≤ r / 2 := by
      intro r hr
      have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
      have h2C : 0 < 2 * C₁ := by linarith
      have hr1 : (2 * C₁) ^ (1 / q) ≤ r := le_trans hρ2 hr
      have hrq : 2 * C₁ ≤ r ^ q := by
        have := Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hr1 hq.le
        rwa [← Real.rpow_mul h2C.le, one_div, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq.ne', Real.rpow_one] at this
      have hsplit : r ^ (1 - q) = r / r ^ q := by
        rw [Real.rpow_sub hr0, Real.rpow_one]
      rw [hsplit]
      have hrqpos : 0 < r ^ q := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 q
      rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_div_iff₀ hrqpos (by norm_num)]
      nlinarith
    refine ⟨ρ, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨hY0, hXY'⟩ := hYX x hx
      by_cases hs : ‖Y x‖ ≤ ρ
      · exact le_trans hs (le_max_left _ _)
      · push_neg at hs
        have h1 := (hXb (Y x) hY0).1
        rw [hXY'] at h1
        have h2 := key (‖Y x‖) hs.le
        have h3 : ‖Y x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖x - Y x‖ := by
          have := norm_sub_norm_le (Y x) x
          rw [norm_sub_rev] at this
          linarith
        exact le_trans (by linarith) (le_max_right _ _)
    · intro y hy
      have hy0 : R₀ < ‖y‖ := by linarith
      have h1 := (hXb y hy0).1
      have h2 := key ‖y‖ hy
      have h3 : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖X y‖ + ‖X y - y‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_norm_le y (X y)
        rw [norm_sub_rev] at this
        linarith
      have h4 : ‖X y‖ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖X y - y‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_norm_le (X y) y
        linarith
      refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith [norm_nonneg y], ?_⟩
      intro hXy
      obtain ⟨hY0', hXYX⟩ := hYX (X y) hXy
      exact hinj hY0' hy0 hXYX
  
  refine ⟨max (max ρ (2 * R₃ + 2)) (max R' 2), fun c hc ℓ hℓ => ?_⟩
  have hρc : ρ ≤ c := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hc
  have hR3c : 2 * R₃ + 2 ≤ c := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) hc
  have hR'c : R' ≤ c := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hc
  have h2c : 2 ≤ c := le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hc
  obtain ⟨F₁, hF₁⟩ : ∃ F : E3 → ℝ, F = fun y => (∑ j : Fin 3, admVec G y j * (y j / ‖y‖)) *
      deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F₂, hF₂⟩ : ∃ F : E3 → ℝ, F = fun y => fluxDivLocal G y *
      Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ,
      W = fun y i => Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) * admVec G y i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hWi : ∀ i, (fun y => W y i) = fun z => Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c) * admVec G z i := by
    intro i; rw [hW]
  have hO₁ : IsOpen {z : E3 | R₁ < ‖z‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  
  have hV0 : ∀ z a, ‖z‖ < R₃ + 1 → cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c z a = 0 := by
    intro z a hz
    simp only [cutoffPiolaField]
    split_ifs with h
    · have hle : ‖Y z‖ ≤ c := le_trans (hYn z h) (max_le hρc (by linarith))
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith : ‖Y z‖ - c ≤ 0)]
      simp
    · rfl
  
  have hpt : ∀ x : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c z a) x
      = {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖}.indicator
          (fun x => (fderiv ℝ Y x).det * (F₁ (Y x) + F₂ (Y x))) x := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : R₃ < ‖x‖
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show x ∈ {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖} from hx)]
      have hx1 : x ∈ {z : E3 | R₁ < ‖z‖} := lt_of_le_of_lt hR₃ hx
      have hloc : ∀ a, partialDeriv a (fun z => cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c z a) x
          = partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i * W (Y z) i) x := by
        intro a
        unfold partialDeriv
        congr 1
        apply Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq
        filter_upwards [hO₁.mem_nhds hx1] with z hz
        have hz' : R₁ < ‖z‖ := hz
        simp only [cutoffPiolaField, if_pos hz', hW]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hloc a)]
      obtain ⟨hA, hP⟩ := s2 Y _ hO₁ hYs x hx1
      have hYd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x :=
        (hYs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hO₁.mem_nhds hx1)
      have hYx1 : 1 < ‖Y x‖ := by linarith [(hYX x hx1).1]
      obtain ⟨hWd, hWdiv⟩ := s4 c (Y x) hYx1
      have hWd' : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y i) (Y x) := by
        intro i; rw [hWi i]; exact hWd i
      rw [s3 Y W x hYd hA hWd' hP]
      simp only [hWi]
      rw [hWdiv, s5, hF₁, hF₂]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show x ∉ {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖} from hx)]
      have hB : IsOpen {z : E3 | ‖z‖ < R₃ + 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const
      have hxB : ‖x‖ < R₃ + 1 := by linarith [not_lt.mp hx]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro a _
      have hev : (fun z => cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c z a) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hB.mem_nhds hxB] with z hz using hV0 z a hz
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
  
  have hcoord : ∀ k : Fin 3, Continuous fun x : E3 => x k :=
    fun k => (EuclideanSpace.proj k).continuous
  have hCm : MeasurableSet {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2} := by
    have : {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2}
        = {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ} ∩ {x : E3 | (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2} := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact (measurableSet_le (hcoord 0).abs.measurable measurable_const).inter
      (measurableSet_le (((hcoord 1).pow 2).add ((hcoord 2).pow 2)).measurable measurable_const)
  have hΩm : MeasurableSet {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖} := measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm
  
  have hF₁supp : ∀ y : E3, F₁ y ≠ 0 → c ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ c + 1 := by
    intro y hy
    by_contra hcon
    apply hy
    rw [hF₁]
    rcases not_and_or.mp hcon with h | h
    · simp only [hw0 (‖y‖ - c) (by linarith [not_le.mp h]), mul_zero]
    · simp only [hw1 (‖y‖ - c) (by linarith [not_le.mp h]), mul_zero]
  have hF₁int : Integrable F₁ := by
    have hB2 : IsOpen {x : E3 | ‖x‖ < 2} := isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const
    have hz : ∀ x : E3, (‖x‖ < 2 ∨ c + 1 < ‖x‖) → F₁ x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · simp only [hF₁, hw0 (‖x‖ - c) (by linarith), mul_zero]
      · simp only [hF₁, hw1 (‖x‖ - c) (by linarith), mul_zero]
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport F₁ := by
      apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0:E3) (c+1))
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] at hx
      exact hz x (Or.inr hx)
    have hcont : Continuous F₁ := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : 1 < ‖x‖
      · have hP : ∀ i j k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j))
            {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
          intro i j k
          exact ((hsmooth i j).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply
            continuousOn_const
        have hadm : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => admVec G x j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
          intro j
          simp only [admVec]
          exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hP i j i).sub (hP i i j))
        have hc' : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x : E3 => x j / ‖x‖)
            {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
          intro j
          apply ContinuousOn.div
          · exact (hcoord j).continuousOn
          · exact continuous_norm.continuousOn
          · intro y hy
            have : (1:ℝ) < ‖y‖ := hy
            positivity
        have hon : ContinuousOn F₁ {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
          rw [hF₁]
          apply ContinuousOn.mul
          · apply continuousOn_finset_sum
            intro j _
            exact (hadm j).mul (hc' j)
          · exact (hwc.comp (continuous_norm.sub continuous_const)).continuousOn
        exact hon.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
      · have hx2 : ‖x‖ < 2 := by linarith [not_lt.mp hx]
        have hev : (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] F₁ := by
          filter_upwards [hB2.mem_nhds hx2] with y hy
          exact (hz y (Or.inl hy)).symm
        exact continuousAt_const.congr hev
    exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs
  
  have hF₂int : Integrable F₂ := by
    have hm : MeasurableSet {y : E3 | R' < ‖y‖} := measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm
    have hψc : Continuous (fun y : E3 => Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)) :=
      Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp (continuous_norm.sub continuous_const)
    have hi : Integrable (fun y : E3 => {y : E3 | R' < ‖y‖}.indicator (fluxDivLocal G) y *
        Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)) :=
      (hD.integrable_indicator hm).mul_bdd (c := 1) hψc.aestronglyMeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ (fun y => by
          show ‖Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)‖ ≤ 1
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)]
          exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one _))
    refine hi.congr (ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_))
    simp only [hF₂]
    by_cases hy : R' < ‖y‖
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show y ∈ {y : E3 | R' < ‖y‖} from hy)]
    · have hyc : ‖y‖ - c ≤ 0 := by linarith [not_lt.mp hy]
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show y ∉ {y : E3 | R' < ‖y‖} from hy),
        Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos hyc]
      simp
  
  have hsupp : ∀ y : E3, F₁ y ≠ 0 →
      y ∈ Y '' ({x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2} ∩ {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖}) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hF₁supp y hy
    have hy' : ρ ≤ ‖y‖ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hl, hu, hYX'⟩ := hXn y hy'
    have hxn : R₃ + 1 ≤ ‖X y‖ := by linarith
    have hxl : ‖X y‖ ≤ ℓ := by linarith
    have hℓ0 : 0 ≤ ℓ := by linarith [norm_nonneg (X y)]
    have hsq : ‖X y‖ ^ 2 = (X y 0) ^ 2 + (X y 1) ^ 2 + (X y 2) ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have hsqℓ : ‖X y‖ ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hxl 2
    refine ⟨X y, ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, hYX' (by linarith)⟩
    · have h0 : (X y 0) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X y 1), sq_nonneg (X y 2)]
      have := sq_le_sq.mp h0
      rwa [abs_of_nonneg hℓ0] at this
    · nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X y 0)]
    · show R₃ < ‖X y‖
      linarith
  
  have key := s7 Y ({x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2} ∩ {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖})
    (hCm.inter hΩm)
    (fun x hx => by
      have hx1 : x ∈ {z : E3 | R₁ < ‖z‖} := lt_of_le_of_lt hR₃ hx.2
      exact ((hYs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hO₁.mem_nhds hx1)).hasFDerivAt)
    (fun x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂ heq => by
      have e₁ := (hYX x₁ (lt_of_le_of_lt hR₃ hx₁.2)).2
      have e₂ := (hYX x₂ (lt_of_le_of_lt hR₃ hx₂.2)).2
      rw [← e₁, ← e₂, heq])
    (fun x hx => by
      rw [← s5]
      have := hdet x hx.2
      linarith)
    F₁ F₂ hF₁int hF₂int hsupp
  have e1 : (∫ x in {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2},
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c z a) x)
      = ∫ x in {x : E3 | |x 0| ≤ ℓ ∧ (x 1) ^ 2 + (x 2) ^ 2 ≤ ℓ ^ 2} ∩ {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖},
          (fderiv ℝ Y x).det * (F₁ (Y x) + F₂ (Y x)) := by
    rw [show (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => cutoffPiolaField G Y R₁ c z a) x)
        = {x : E3 | R₃ < ‖x‖}.indicator
          (fun x => (fderiv ℝ Y x).det * (F₁ (Y x) + F₂ (Y x))) from funext hpt]
    exact setIntegral_indicator hΩm
  have e2 : (∫ y : E3, (∑ j : Fin 3, admVec G y j * (y j / ‖y‖)) *
      deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)) = ∫ y, F₁ y := by
    rw [hF₁]
  have e3 : (∫ y : E3, |fluxDivLocal G y| * Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c))
      = ∫ y, |F₂ y| := by
    congr 1
    funext y
    rw [hF₂, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)]
  rw [e1, e2, e3]
  exact key

signature.name: exterior_cover_exists
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    Nonempty (ExteriorCover g hAF k)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨U, ρ, hUo, hUc, hρ, hfar, hcpt, hfront, hlift⟩ :=
    hi_exterior_region g hComplete hAF hR k
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := region_double_cover g hAF hR k U ρ hUo hUc hρ hfar hcpt hfront
  have hfc : IsCompact (frontier R.W) := by
    refine R.compact.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_frontier ?_
    rw [R.W_open.frontier_eq]
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hx.2 (R.far_sub y hy)
  obtain ⟨β, hβs, hpos, hzero, hreg, hmin⟩ :=
    minimal_defining_function R.metric R.W R.W_open hfc R.frontier_min
  have hset : {p | 0 < β p} = R.W := Set.ext hpos
  have hE : {p | 0 ≤ β p} = closure R.W := by
    rw [closure_eq_self_union_frontier]
    ext p
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union]
    rw [← hpos p, ← hzero p]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases h.lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr h.symm
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact h.le
      · exact h.ge
  have hext : IsExteriorDomain (R.af.ends R.endIdx) β R.ρ :=
    ⟨hβs, hreg, R.ρ_ge, fun y hy => (hpos _).2 (R.far_sub y hy), by rw [hE]; exact R.compact⟩
  have hlift' : CircleLiftable {p | 0 < β p} := by
    rw [hset]
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := R.homeo
    intro θ
    obtain ⟨φU, hφU⟩ := hlift (θ.comp ⟨e.symm, e.symm.continuous⟩)
    refine ⟨φU.comp ⟨e, e.continuous⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
    have h := hφU (e x)
    simpa using h
  have hconn : IsConnected {p | 0 < β p} := by
    rw [hset]; exact R.W_conn
  have hesc := end_chart_escape R.metric R.af R.endIdx
  have hsep := separates_of_circle_liftable (R.af.ends R.endIdx) β R.ρ hext hconn hlift' hesc
  exact ⟨ExteriorCover.mk R.carrier R.metric R.af R.endIdx R.q_eq R.coeff_eq R.scal_nonneg
    β R.ρ hext hmin hsep⟩

exterior_cover_exists.definitions:
def IsMinimalFrontierChart (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ) (p : M) : Prop :=
  IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧
  (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
  V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
  (∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv f x = 0) ∧
  IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∧ IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) ∧
  (V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | 0 < f x} ∨ V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0})


def HasMinimalFrontier (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 p, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), V ⊆ O ∧ IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p


def HasOneSidedMinimalFrontier (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ),
    IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p ∧ V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}


def CircleLiftable (U : Set M) : Prop :=
  ∀ θ : C(U, Circle), ∃ φ : C(U, ℝ), ∀ x : U, θ x = Circle.exp (φ x)


structure RegionCover.{uX} {N : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]

def IsMinimalFrontierChart (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ) (p : M) : Prop :=
  IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧
  (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
  V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
  (∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv f x = 0) ∧
  IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∧ IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) ∧
  (V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | 0 < f x} ∨ V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0})


def HasMinimalFrontier (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 p, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), V ⊆ O ∧ IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p


def HasOneSidedMinimalFrontier (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ),
    IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p ∧ V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}


def CircleLiftable (U : Set M) : Prop :=
  ∀ θ : C(U, Circle), ∃ φ : C(U, ℝ), ∀ x : U, θ x = Circle.exp (φ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, partialDeriv] at hneu
  
  have hchart : ∀ h : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ h →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) h p =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => h ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    intro h hh
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) h p := hh.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    rw [hmd.mfderiv]
    simp only [writtenInExtChartAt, extChartAt_coe, extChartAt_coe_symm, chartAt_self_eq,
      modelWithCornersSelf_coe, modelWithCornersSelf_coe_symm, Set.range_id, fderivWithin_univ,
      OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_apply, Function.comp_def, id]
  
  have hp : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p :=
    (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
  have hD : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 := by
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) (mem_chart_target E3 p)
    rw [hmd.mfderiv]
    simp only [writtenInExtChartAt, extChartAt_coe, extChartAt_coe_symm, chartAt_self_eq,
      modelWithCornersSelf_coe, modelWithCornersSelf_coe_symm, Set.range_id, fderivWithin_univ,
      OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_apply, OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_symm, Function.comp_def, id, hp]
    have hev : (fun x => (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm x)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
        (fun x => x) := by
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds (mem_chart_target E3 p)] with y hy
      exact (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hy
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact fderiv_id'
  
  have hGij : ∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) i j =
      g.g p (e i) (e j) := by
    intro i j
    show g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) (e j)) = _
    rw [hD, hp]
    rfl
  have hGpd : (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)).PosDef := by
    rw [Matrix.posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
    refine ⟨Matrix.IsHermitian.ext fun i j => ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    · rw [star_trivial, hGij, hGij, g.symm]
    · have hv : (∑ i : Fin 3, x i • e i) ≠ 0 := by
        intro hv
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w j) hv
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hpos := g.posDef p _ hv
      convert hpos using 1
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul', Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec,
        star_trivial, hGij]
      ring
  
  have hL : ∀ L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ i, L (e i) = 0) → L = 0 := by
    intro L hL
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.coe_injective
    refine (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext fun i => ?_
    simp [hL i]
  
  have hduf : ∀ ξ : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ξ =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) ξ := by
    intro ξ; rw [hchart u hu]; rfl
  have hdβf : ∀ ξ : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ξ =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) ξ := by
    intro ξ; rw [hchart β hβ]; rfl
  have ha : (fun i => fderiv ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) (e i)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hdu
    rw [hchart u hu]
    exact hL _ fun i => congrFun h0 i
  have hpos := hGpd.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos ha
  refine ⟨∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ i j *
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) (e i)) • e j, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hduf, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    refine ne_of_gt (α := ℝ) ?_
    convert hpos using 1
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  · rw [hdβf, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← hneu]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring_nf

proof.tactics:
by
  have hpS : p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := mem_chart_source E3 p
  have hx₀ : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := mem_chart_target E3 p
  
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    have h2 := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    exact h2.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  
  have hD : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) = 0 := by
    have hVo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' interior K) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 p).open_target
        isOpen_interior
    have hzero : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' interior K,
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hev : (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => c :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hVo.mem_nhds hy)
          (fun z hz => hK _ (interior_subset hz.2))
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_const_apply c
    have hx₀V : chartAt E3 p p ∈
        closure ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' interior K) := by
      rw [_root_.mem_closure_iff]
      intro W hW hxW
      have hU'o : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' W) :=
        (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 p).open_source hW
      obtain ⟨q, hqU, hqK⟩ := _root_.mem_closure_iff.mp hp _ hU'o ⟨hpS, hxW⟩
      refine ⟨chartAt E3 p q, hqU.2, (chartAt E3 p).map_source hqU.1, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p q) ∈ interior K
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hqU.1]
      exact hqK
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)))
        (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 p).open_target le_rfl
    have hcw := (hcont.continuousAt ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds hx₀)).continuousWithinAt
      (s := (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' interior K)
    have hmem := hcw.mem_closure_image hx₀V
    have hsub : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ''
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' interior K) ⊆ {0} := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact hzero y hy
    have h3 := closure_mono hsub hmem
    rw [closure_singleton] at h3
    exact h3
  
  have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p := hu.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  rw [hmd.mfderiv]
  have hw : writtenInExtChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) p u = fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) := by
    funext y
    simp [writtenInExtChartAt, extChartAt_model_space_eq_id, extChartAt_coe_symm]
  have hpt : extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) p p = chartAt E3 p p := by simp [extChartAt_coe]
  rw [hw, hpt, modelWithCornersSelf_coe, Set.range_id, fderivWithin_univ]
  exact hD
