informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)) :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0)) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ →
        |lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0) x| ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0)) x‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)

signature.name: coord_lap_bounds
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)) :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0)) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ →
        |lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0) x| ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0)) x‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  
  have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hU1 : ∀ y ∈ {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}, y ∈ {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro y hy
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hR hy
  have hGU : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} :=
    fun a b => (hsmooth a b).mono hU1
  have hdetU : ∀ y ∈ {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}, (G y).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have := (hb y hy).1
    exact ne_of_gt (by linarith)
  
  
  have hdGU : ∀ c a b : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by
    intro c a b
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} :=
      (hGU a b).fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  
  have hdetC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by
    have h : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y =>
        G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2 - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1
          - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2 + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0
          + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
    rw [h]
    have h00 := hGU 0 0
    have h01 := hGU 0 1
    have h02 := hGU 0 2
    have h10 := hGU 1 0
    have h11 := hGU 1 1
    have h12 := hGU 1 2
    have h20 := hGU 2 0
    have h21 := hGU 2 1
    have h22 := hGU 2 2
    fun_prop
  have hadj : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).adjugate k l) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by
    have h00 := hGU 0 0
    have h01 := hGU 0 1
    have h02 := hGU 0 2
    have h10 := hGU 1 0
    have h11 := hGU 1 1
    have h12 := hGU 1 2
    have h20 := hGU 2 0
    have h21 := hGU 2 1
    have h22 := hGU 2 2
    intro k l
    simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;> simp <;> fun_prop
  have hPU : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by
    intro k l
    have h : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) = fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate k l := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rw [h]
    exact (hdetC.inv hdetU).mul (hadj k l)
  
  
  have hΓU : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := by
    intro k i j
    have h : christoffel G k i j = fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y
          - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y) := by
      funext y; rfl
    rw [h]
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
      (hPU k l).mul (((hdGU i j l).add (hdGU j i l)).sub (hdGU l i j)))
  
  
  have hπ1 : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => z 0) z = if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro j z
    show fderiv ℝ (⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) z (e j) = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    show (e j) 0 = _
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, eq_comm]
  have hπ2 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => z 0)) z = 0 := by
    intro i j z
    have hc : partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => z 0) = fun _ => if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 :=
      funext (hπ1 j)
    rw [hc]
    show fderiv ℝ (fun _ : E3 => if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) z (e i) = 0
    rw [fderiv_const_apply]
    rfl
  have hF : lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0) =
      fun y => -∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G 0 i j y := by
    funext y
    simp only [lapLoc, hessLoc, hπ1, hπ2, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
      Finset.mem_univ, if_true, zero_sub, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  rw [hF]
  
  
  have hnorm : ∀ L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ‖L‖ ≤ ∑ m : Fin 3, |L (e m)| := by
    intro L
    refine L.opNorm_le_bound (Finset.sum_nonneg fun m _ => abs_nonneg _) ?_
    intro w
    have hw : w = ∑ m : Fin 3, w m • e m := by
      have := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr w
      simpa [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr] using this.symm
    have hLw : L w = ∑ m : Fin 3, w m * L (e m) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hw]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hLw, Real.norm_eq_abs, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [abs_mul, mul_comm]
    have hwm : |w m| ≤ ‖w‖ := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le w m
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwm (abs_nonneg _)
  
  have hsum9 : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (M : ℝ), (∀ i j, |f i j| ≤ M) →
      |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j| ≤ 9 * M := by
    intro f M hf
    calc |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j| ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |∑ j : Fin 3, f i j| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |f i j| :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hf i j
      _ = 9 * M := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  
  
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = 1 + C := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hbdef⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = 4 * B ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Kg, hKgdef⟩ : ∃ Kg : ℝ,
      Kg = 9 / 2 * (9 * b ^ 2 * C ^ 2 + 12 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2) + 3 / 2 * C := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Kv, hKvdef⟩ : ∃ Kv : ℝ, Kv = 81 / 2 * b ^ 2 * C := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Kd, hKddef⟩ : ∃ Kd : ℝ, Kd = 27 * (b * Kg + 81 / 2 * b ^ 3 * C ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB1 : 1 ≤ B := by rw [hBdef]; linarith
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := by rw [hbdef]; positivity
  have hKg0 : 0 ≤ Kg := by rw [hKgdef]; positivity
  have hKv0 : 0 ≤ Kv := by rw [hKvdef]; positivity
  have hKd0 : 0 ≤ Kd := by rw [hKddef]; positivity
  refine ⟨Kv + Kd, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => (hPU i j).mul (hΓU 0 i j)).neg
  
  
  intro x hx
  have hr1 : 1 < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt hR hx
  have hr0 : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hdet, hbx⟩ := hb x hx
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = ‖x‖ ^ (-q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℝ, u = ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ := by rw [hρ]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := by rw [hu]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := by rw [hv]; exact Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _
  have hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hρ]; exact Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hr1.le (by linarith)
  have huu : u * u ≤ v := by
    rw [hu, hv, ← Real.rpow_add hr0]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hr1.le (by linarith)
  have hρv : ρ * v ≤ v := by nlinarith
  rw [← hu, ← hv]
  
  have hPD : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (f : E3 → ℝ), |partialDeriv c f x| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ := by
    intro c f
    have hn : ‖e c‖ = 1 := by simp [e]
    calc |partialDeriv c f x| = ‖fderiv ℝ f x (e c)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ * ‖e c‖ := (fderiv ℝ f x).le_opNorm _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ := by rw [hn, mul_one]
  have hd1 : ∀ c a b' : Fin 3, |partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b') x| ≤ C * u := by
    intro c a b'
    rw [hu]; exact (hPD c _).trans (hbx a b' 0).2.1
  have hd2 : ∀ m c a b' : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b') y) x| ≤ C * v := by
    intro m c a b'
    rw [hv]; exact (hPD m _).trans (hbx a b' c).2.2
  have hGε : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ρ := by
    intro i j; rw [hρ]; exact (hbx i j 0).1
  have hGB : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G x i j| ≤ B := by
    intro i j
    have h1 := hGε i j
    have h2 : |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> simp
    have h3 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (G x i j) (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
    have h4 : C * ρ ≤ C := by nlinarith
    rw [hBdef]; linarith
  
  obtain ⟨ee, heedef⟩ : ∃ ee : ℝ, ee = 12 * B ^ 2 * (C * ρ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have h1 := inv3_entry_bounds (G x) B (C * ρ) hdet hGB hGε
  have hPb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |(G x)⁻¹ k l| ≤ b := by
    intro k l; rw [hbdef]; exact (h1 k l).1
  have hPe : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |(G x)⁻¹ k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ee := by
    intro k l; rw [heedef]; exact (h1 k l).2
  
  have hxU : {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} ∈ 𝓝 x := hU.mem_nhds hx
  have hGd : ∀ a b' : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b') x := fun a b' =>
    ((hGU a b').differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hxU
  have hdGd : ∀ c a b' : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b') y) x := fun c a b' =>
    ((hdGU c a b').differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hxU
  have hPd : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x := fun k l =>
    ((hPU k l).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hxU
  have hΓd : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (christoffel G 0 i j) x := fun i j =>
    ((hΓU 0 i j).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hxU
  
  have hdet' : (G x).det ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith)
  have h2 := fun m => inv_entry_partialDeriv G x hGd hdet' m
  obtain ⟨p, hpdef⟩ : ∃ p : ℝ, p = 9 * b ^ 2 * (C * u) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hα0 : 0 ≤ C * u := mul_nonneg hC hu0
  have hdP : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, |partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x| ≤ p := by
    intro m k l
    rw [((h2 m) k l).2, abs_neg, hpdef]
    calc |∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b' : Fin 3,
            (G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b') x * (G x)⁻¹ b' l|
        ≤ 9 * (b * (C * u) * b) := by
          apply hsum9
          intro a b'
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (hPb k a) (hd1 m a b') (abs_nonneg _) hb0) (hPb b' l)
            (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hb0 hα0)
      _ = 9 * b ^ 2 * (C * u) := by ring
  
  have h5 := fun m k i j => christoffel_value_bounds (G x)⁻¹
    (fun m k l => partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x)
    (fun c a b' => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b') x)
    (fun m c a b' => partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b') y) x)
    b ee p (C * u) (C * v) hPb hPe hdP hd1 hd2 m k i j
  have hΓ : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G 0 i j x| ≤ 9 / 2 * b * (C * u) :=
    fun i j => (h5 0 0 i j).1
  have hdΓ0 : ∀ m i j : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv m (christoffel G 0 i j) x - (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        (partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j 0) y) x
          + partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i 0) y) x
          - partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv 0 (fun z => G z i j) y) x)|
        ≤ 9 / 2 * (p * (C * u) + ee * (C * v)) := by
    intro m i j
    rw [christoffel_partialDeriv_formula G x hPd hdGd m 0 i j]
    exact (h5 m 0 i j).2
  have hpu : p * (C * u) ≤ 9 * b ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * v := by
    calc p * (C * u) = 9 * b ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * (u * u) := by rw [hpdef]; ring
      _ ≤ 9 * b ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huu (by positivity)
  have hev : ee * (C * v) ≤ 12 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * v := by
    calc ee * (C * v) = 12 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * (ρ * v) := by rw [heedef]; ring
      _ ≤ 12 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρv (by positivity)
  have hdΓ : ∀ m i j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv m (christoffel G 0 i j) x| ≤ Kg * v := by
    intro m i j
    have t0 := abs_le.mp (hdΓ0 m i j)
    have a1 := abs_le.mp (hd2 m i j 0)
    have a2 := abs_le.mp (hd2 m j i 0)
    have a3 := abs_le.mp (hd2 m 0 i j)
    have hKv : Kg * v = 9 / 2 * (9 * b ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * v + 12 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * v)
        + 3 / 2 * (C * v) := by rw [hKgdef]; ring
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  
  constructor
  · 
    rw [abs_neg]
    have hval := hsum9 (fun i j => (G x)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G 0 i j x)
      (b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u))) (fun i j => by
        show |(G x)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G 0 i j x| ≤ _
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hPb i j) (hΓ i j) (abs_nonneg _) hb0)
    have he : 9 * (b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u))) = Kv * u := by rw [hKvdef]; ring
    rw [he] at hval
    rw [add_mul]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hKd0 hu0]
  · 
    have hHas : HasFDerivAt
        (fun y => -∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G 0 i j y)
        (-∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ((G x)⁻¹ i j • fderiv ℝ (christoffel G 0 i j) x
          + christoffel G 0 i j x • fderiv ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) x)) x := by
      have hin : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt
          (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G 0 i j y)
          (∑ j : Fin 3, ((G x)⁻¹ i j • fderiv ℝ (christoffel G 0 i j) x
            + christoffel G 0 i j x • fderiv ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) x)) x := fun i =>
        HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
          (A := fun j y => (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G 0 i j y)
          (fun j _ => (hPd i j).hasFDerivAt.mul (hΓd i j).hasFDerivAt)
      exact (HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
        (A := fun i y => ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G 0 i j y)
        (fun i _ => hin i)).neg
    have hpart : ∀ m : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => -∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G 0 i j y) x
          (e m) =
        -∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ((G x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv m (christoffel G 0 i j) x
          + christoffel G 0 i j x * partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) x) := by
      intro m
      rw [hHas.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, partialDeriv]
    have hpb : ∀ m : Fin 3,
        |fderiv ℝ (fun y => -∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G 0 i j y) x
          (e m)| ≤ 9 * (b * (Kg * v) + 81 / 2 * b ^ 3 * C ^ 2 * v) := by
      intro m
      rw [hpart m, abs_neg]
      apply hsum9
      intro i j
      have t1 : |(G x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv m (christoffel G 0 i j) x| ≤ b * (Kg * v) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hPb i j) (hdΓ m i j) (abs_nonneg _) hb0
      have t2 : |christoffel G 0 i j x * partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) x|
          ≤ 81 / 2 * b ^ 3 * C ^ 2 * v := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        calc _ ≤ (9 / 2 * b * (C * u)) * p :=
              mul_le_mul (hΓ i j) (hdP m i j) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = 81 / 2 * b ^ 3 * C ^ 2 * (u * u) := by rw [hpdef]; ring
          _ ≤ 81 / 2 * b ^ 3 * C ^ 2 * v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huu (by positivity)
      exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add t1 t2)
    calc ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => -∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G 0 i j y) x‖
        ≤ ∑ m : Fin 3, |fderiv ℝ
            (fun y => -∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G 0 i j y) x (e m)| :=
          hnorm _
      _ ≤ ∑ m : Fin 3, 9 * (b * (Kg * v) + 81 / 2 * b ^ 3 * C ^ 2 * v) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => hpb m
      _ = Kd * v := by rw [hKddef]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
      _ ≤ (Kv + Kd) * v := by rw [add_mul]; nlinarith [mul_nonneg hKv0 hv0]

subgoal_signatures.name: inv3_entry_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (B ε : ℝ)
    (hdet : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ A.det)
    (hB : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j| ≤ B)
    (hε : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε) :
    ∀ k l : Fin 3, |A⁻¹ k l| ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 ∧
      |A⁻¹ k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 12 * B ^ 2 * ε

subgoal_signatures.name: inv_entry_partialDeriv
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)
    (hdet : (G x).det ≠ 0) (m : Fin 3) :
    ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x ∧
      partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x =
        -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l

subgoal_signatures.name: christoffel_partialDeriv_formula
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hP : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x)
    (hdG : ∀ c a b : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y) x)
    (m k i j : Fin 3) :
    partialDeriv m (christoffel G k i j) x =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x *
            (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) x + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) x
              - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) x)
          + (G x)⁻¹ k l *
            (partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y) x
              + partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y) x
              - partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y) x))

subgoal_signatures.name: christoffel_value_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (dP : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (d1 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (d2 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (b e p α β : ℝ)
    (hPb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l| ≤ b)
    (hPe : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ e)
    (hdP : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, |dP m k l| ≤ p)
    (hd1 : ∀ c a b' : Fin 3, |d1 c a b'| ≤ α)
    (hd2 : ∀ m c a b' : Fin 3, |d2 m c a b'| ≤ β) (m k i j : Fin 3) :
    |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, P k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)| ≤ 9 / 2 * b * α ∧
    |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (dP m k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)
        + P k l * (d2 m i j l + d2 m j i l - d2 m l i j))
      - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (d2 m i j k + d2 m j i k - d2 m k i j)| ≤ 9 / 2 * (p * α + e * β)

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q q' : ℝ)
    (hq' : 1 / 2 < q') (hq'1 : q' < 1) (hqq : q' ≤ q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)) :
    ∃ (R₁ C₁ : ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ), R ≤ R₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
        |h x - x 0| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') ∧ |lapLoc G h x| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q')

signature.name: far_approx_harmonic
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q q' : ℝ)
    (hq' : 1 / 2 < q') (hq'1 : q' < 1) (hqq : q' ≤ q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)) :
    ∃ (R₁ C₁ : ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ), R ≤ R₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
        |h x - x 0| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') ∧ |lapLoc G h x| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q')

proof.tactics:
by
  have hq0 : 0 < q := by linarith
  
  have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hπd : ∀ z : E3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : E3 => z 0) z := fun z =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt
  have hπ1 : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => z 0) z = if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro j z
    show fderiv ℝ (⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) z (e j) = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    show (e j) 0 = _
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, eq_comm]
  have hπ2 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => z 0)) z = 0 := by
    intro i j z
    have hc : partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => z 0) = fun _ => if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 :=
      funext (hπ1 j)
    rw [hc]
    show fderiv ℝ (fun _ : E3 => if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) z (e i) = 0
    rw [fderiv_const_apply]
    rfl
  
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, hF₀s, hF₀⟩ := coord_lap_bounds G q hq0 hsmooth R C hR hC hb
  
  have hF0 : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ →
      |lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0) x| ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-(1 + q')) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have h2 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-(1 + q')) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx1 (by linarith)
    exact (hF₀ x hx).1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hC₀)
  have hF1 : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ (lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0)) x‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-(1 + q') - 1) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have h2 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-(1 + q') - 1) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx1 (by linarith)
    exact (hF₀ x hx).2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hC₀)
  obtain ⟨f, A', hA', hfd, hfeq, hfb⟩ :=
    cutoff_source_bounds (lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0)) R (1 + q') C₀ hR (by linarith) hC₀
      hF₀s hF0 hF1
  
  obtain ⟨v, B₀, hB₀, hvd, hv1d, hvb⟩ :=
    smoothed_potential_C2 f (1 + q') A' (by linarith) (by linarith) hA' hfd
      (fun x => (hfb x).1) (fun x => (hfb x).2)
  
  have hBm0 : B₀ ≤ max B₀ A' := le_max_left _ _
  have hBm1 : A' ≤ max B₀ A' := le_max_right _ _
  have hBm : 0 ≤ max B₀ A' := le_trans hB₀ hBm0
  have hmono : ∀ (X B : ℝ) (y : E3) (p : ℝ), B ≤ max B₀ A' → X ≤ B * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ p →
      X ≤ max B₀ A' * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ p := by
    intro X B y p hB hX
    have h1y : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ‖y‖ := by have := norm_nonneg y; linarith
    exact hX.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB (Real.rpow_nonneg h1y _))
  have e1 : (2 - (1 + q') - 1 : ℝ) = 1 - (1 + q') := by ring
  have e2 : (2 - (1 + q') - 2 : ℝ) = -(1 + q') := by ring
  have e3 : (-(1 + q' + 1) : ℝ) = -(1 + q') - 1 := by ring
  obtain ⟨w, B', hB', hw, hwb⟩ :=
    mollify_C2_smooth v f (2 - (1 + q')) (1 + q' + 1) (max B₀ A') hBm hvd hv1d hfd (by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hvb x
      refine ⟨hmono _ _ x _ hBm0 h0, fun i => ?_, fun i j => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [e1]; exact hmono _ _ x _ hBm0 (h1 i)
      · rw [e2]; exact hmono _ _ x _ hBm0 (h2 i j)
      · rw [e3]; exact hmono _ _ x _ hBm0 h3
      · rw [e3]; exact hmono _ _ x _ hBm1 (hfb x).2)
  
  obtain ⟨K₂, hK₂, hpert⟩ := lapLoc_flat_perturbation G q hq0 R C hR hC hb
  
  have hwd : ∀ z : E3, DifferentiableAt ℝ w z := fun z => hw.differentiable (by simp) z
  set h : E3 → ℝ := fun x => x 0 + w x with hdef
  have hh1 : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv j h z = (if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + partialDeriv j w z := by
    intro j z
    rw [← hπ1 j z]
    show fderiv ℝ ((fun y : E3 => y 0) + w) z (e j) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y : E3 => y 0) z (e j) + fderiv ℝ w z (e j)
    rw [fderiv_add (hπd z) (hwd z)]
    rfl
  have hh2 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h) z = partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) z := by
    intro i j z
    have hc : partialDeriv j h = fun y => (if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + partialDeriv j w y :=
      funext (hh1 j)
    rw [hc]
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => (if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + partialDeriv j w y) z (e i) =
      fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j w) z (e i)
    rw [fderiv_const_add]
  have hlin : ∀ z : E3, lapLoc G h z = lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0) z + lapLoc G w z := by
    intro z
    unfold lapLoc hessLoc
    simp only [hh1, hh2, hπ1, hπ2]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have h112 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + 12 * K₂ := by linarith
  refine ⟨R + 2, 2 * B' + B' * (1 + 12 * K₂), h, by linarith, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := mul_nonneg hB' h112
    linarith
  · exact (hπ.add hw).contDiffOn
  · intro x hx
    have hxR : R < ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have hρ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have hρ0 : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have hneg : ∀ p : ℝ, p ≤ 0 → (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p ≤ ‖x‖ ^ p := fun p hp =>
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hρ0 (by linarith) hp
    obtain ⟨hw0, hw1, hw2, hw3⟩ := hwb x
    constructor
    · have hhx : h x - x 0 = w x := by
        show x 0 + w x - x 0 = w x
        ring
      rw [hhx]
      have hp : 0 ≤ 1 - q' := by linarith
      have hP : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have hA : (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (2 - (1 + q')) ≤ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') := by
        have e : (2 - (1 + q') : ℝ) = 1 - q' := by ring
        rw [e]
        have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - q') ≤ 2 ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
        rw [Real.rpow_one] at h2
        calc (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (1 - q') ≤ (2 * ‖x‖) ^ (1 - q') :=
              Real.rpow_le_rpow (by linarith) (by linarith) hp
          _ = 2 ^ (1 - q') * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') := Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by linarith)
          _ ≤ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hP
      have hK : 0 ≤ B' * (1 + 12 * K₂) * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hB' h112) hP
      calc |w x| ≤ B' * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (2 - (1 + q')) := hw0
        _ ≤ B' * (2 * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q')) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA hB'
        _ ≤ (2 * B' + B' * (1 + 12 * K₂)) * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - q') := by nlinarith
    · have hfx : f x = lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0) x := hfeq x (by linarith)
      have hP0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q') := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
      have hsplit : lapLoc G h x = (∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i w) x + f x)
          + (lapLoc G w x - ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i w) x) := by
        rw [hlin x, ← hfx]
        ring
      have b1 : |∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i w) x + f x|
          ≤ B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q') := by
        have h1 : (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-(1 + q' + 1)) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-(1 + q' + 1)) := hneg _ (by linarith)
        have h2 : ‖x‖ ^ (-(1 + q' + 1)) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q') :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hρ1 (by linarith)
        exact hw3.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h1.trans h2) hB')
      have hij : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
          |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) x| ≤ B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-(1 + q')) := by
        intro i j
        have h1 := hw2 i j
        rw [e2] at h1
        exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hneg _ (by linarith)) hB')
      have e4 : (2 - (1 + q') - 1 : ℝ) = -q' := by ring
      have hk : ∀ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k w x| ≤ B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-q') := by
        intro k
        have h1 := hw1 k
        rw [e4] at h1
        exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hneg _ (by linarith)) hB')
      have hS2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) x| ≤
          9 * (B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-(1 + q'))) := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        linarith [hij 0 0, hij 0 1, hij 0 2, hij 1 0, hij 1 1, hij 1 2, hij 2 0, hij 2 1,
          hij 2 2]
      have hS1 : ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k w x| ≤ 3 * (B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-q')) := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        linarith [hk 0, hk 1, hk 2]
      have hS2n : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) x| :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _))
      have hS1n : 0 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k w x| :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
      have hq1 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q') :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hρ1 (by linarith)
      have hq2 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - 1) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hρ1 (by linarith)
      have ee1 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q') * ‖x‖ ^ (-(1 + q')) = ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q') := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ0]; congr 1; ring
      have ee2 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - 1) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q') = ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q') := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hρ0]; congr 1; ring
      have hT : ‖x‖ ^ (-q) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) x|)
          + ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) * (∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k w x|)
            ≤ 12 * B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q') := by
        have t1 := mul_le_mul hq1 hS2 hS2n (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
        have t2 := mul_le_mul hq2 hS1 hS1n (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
        have t3 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q') * (9 * (B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-(1 + q'))))
            + ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - 1) * (3 * (B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-q')))
              = 12 * B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q') := by
          linear_combination (9 * B') * ee1 + (3 * B') * ee2
        linarith
      have b2 : |lapLoc G w x - ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i w) x|
          ≤ K₂ * (12 * B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q')) :=
        (hpert w x hxR).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT hK₂)
      rw [hsplit]
      have hBP := mul_nonneg hB' hP0
      calc _ ≤ |∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i w) x + f x|
            + |lapLoc G w x - ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i w) x| :=
            abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q') + K₂ * (12 * B' * ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q')) :=
            add_le_add b1 b2
        _ ≤ (2 * B' + B' * (1 + 12 * K₂)) * ‖x‖ ^ (-1 - 2 * q') := by nlinarith

subgoal_signatures.name: coord_lap_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)) :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0)) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ →
        |lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0) x| ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => z 0)) x‖ ≤ C₀ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: lapLoc_flat_perturbation
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)) :
    ∃ K₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ K₂ ∧ ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3), R < ‖x‖ →
      |lapLoc G w x - ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i w) x| ≤
        K₂ * (‖x‖ ^ (-q) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) x|
          + ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) * ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k w x|)

subgoal_signatures.name: cutoff_source_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(F : E3 → ℝ) (R a A : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖})
    (hF0 : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → |F x| ≤ A * ‖x‖ ^ (-a))
    (hF1 : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ F x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖ ^ (-a - 1)) :
    ∃ (f : E3 → ℝ) (A' : ℝ), 0 ≤ A' ∧ Differentiable ℝ f ∧
      (∀ x : E3, R + 2 ≤ ‖x‖ → f x = F x) ∧
      ∀ x : E3, |f x| ≤ A' * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a) ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ A' * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: smoothed_potential_C2
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(f : E3 → ℝ) (a A : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) (ha2 : a < 2) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hf0 : ∀ x : E3, |f x| ≤ A * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a))
    (hf1 : ∀ x : E3, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ A * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1)) :
    ∃ (v : E3 → ℝ) (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B ∧ Differentiable ℝ v ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, Differentiable ℝ (partialDeriv i v)) ∧
      ∀ x : E3, |v x| ≤ B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (2 - a) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i v x| ≤ B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (1 - a)) ∧
        (∀ i j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j v) x| ≤ B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a)) ∧
        |∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i v) x + f x| ≤ B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: mollify_C2_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(v f : E3 → ℝ) (s t B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hv : Differentiable ℝ v) (hv1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, Differentiable ℝ (partialDeriv i v))
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, |v x| ≤ B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ s ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i v x| ≤ B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (s - 1)) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j v) x| ≤ B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (s - 2)) ∧
      |∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i v) x + f x| ≤ B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-t) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-t)) :
    ∃ (w : E3 → ℝ) (B' : ℝ), 0 ≤ B' ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ w ∧
      ∀ x : E3, |w x| ≤ B' * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ s ∧
        (∀ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i w x| ≤ B' * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (s - 1)) ∧
        (∀ i j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) x| ≤ B' * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (s - 2)) ∧
        |∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i w) x + f x| ≤ B' * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-t)

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2))
    (v : E3 → ℝ) (s A ρ : ℝ) (hρ : R ≤ ρ) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v {x : E3 | ρ < ‖x‖})
    (hv0 : ∀ x : E3, ρ < ‖x‖ → |v x| ≤ A * ‖x‖ ^ s)
    (hL0 : ∀ x : E3, ρ < ‖x‖ → |lapLoc G v x| ≤ A * ‖x‖ ^ (s - 2))
    (hL1 : ∀ x : E3, ρ < ‖x‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ (lapLoc G v) x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖ ^ (s - 3)) :
    ∃ R' C' : ℝ, ρ ≤ R' ∧ 0 ≤ C' ∧ ∀ x : E3, R' < ‖x‖ →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i v x| ≤ C' * ‖x‖ ^ (s - 1)) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j v z) x| ≤ C' * ‖x‖ ^ (s - 2))

signature.name: exterior_scaled_estimate

    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2))
    (v : E3 → ℝ) (s A ρ : ℝ) (hρ : R ≤ ρ) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v {x : E3 | ρ < ‖x‖})
    (hv0 : ∀ x : E3, ρ < ‖x‖ → |v x| ≤ A * ‖x‖ ^ s)
    (hL0 : ∀ x : E3, ρ < ‖x‖ → |lapLoc G v x| ≤ A * ‖x‖ ^ (s - 2))
    (hL1 : ∀ x : E3, ρ < ‖x‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ (lapLoc G v) x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖ ^ (s - 3)) :
    ∃ R' C' : ℝ, ρ ≤ R' ∧ 0 ≤ C' ∧ ∀ x : E3, R' < ‖x‖ →

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C_G, hCG, hG⟩ := holder_schauder_global
  obtain ⟨ε₀, C₀, hε₀, hC₀, hest⟩ := perturbed_ball_estimate C_G hCG hG
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hKb⟩ := lapLoc_coeff_bounds G q hq hsmooth R C hR hC hb
  
  have s1 : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), lapLoc G f y =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j f z) y
        - ∑ k : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j y)
            * partialDeriv k f y := by
    intro f y
    simp only [lapLoc, hessLoc, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨X, hXdef⟩ : ∃ X : ℝ, X = 4 * 2 ^ q * K := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ q := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) q
  have hX : 0 ≤ X := by rw [hXdef]; positivity
  have hTend : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => X * r ^ (-q)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hq).const_mul X
  obtain ⟨Rε, hRε⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hTend.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hε₀))
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = |s| + |s - 2| + |s - 3| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS2 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ S := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) S
  have hρ1 : 1 ≤ ρ := le_trans hR hρ
  refine ⟨max (2 * ρ + 1) Rε, 16 * C₀ * A * 2 ^ S, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact le_trans (by linarith) (le_max_left _ _)
  · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC₀) hA) hS2.le
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨r, hrdef⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = ‖x‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hrdef] at hx ⊢
  have hr1 : 2 * ρ + 1 < r := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hx
  have hrε : Rε ≤ r := le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hx)
  have hr : 0 < r := by linarith
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
  obtain ⟨τ, hτdef⟩ : ∃ τ : ℝ, τ = r / 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hτ : 0 < τ := by rw [hτdef]; positivity
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : Set E3, U = {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hU : IsOpen U := by rw [hUdef]; exact isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hvU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v U := by rw [hUdef]; exact hv
  
  have geo2 : ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ < 2 → x + τ • z ∈ U := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hUdef]
    show ρ < ‖x + τ • z‖
    have h1 : ‖τ • z‖ = τ * ‖z‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hτ]
    have h2 : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x + τ • z‖ + ‖τ • z‖ := by
      calc ‖x‖ = ‖(x + τ • z) - τ • z‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ ‖x + τ • z‖ + ‖τ • z‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    have h3 : τ * ‖z‖ < τ * 2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz hτ
    rw [h1, ← hrdef] at h2
    linarith
  have geoB : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x τ, r / 2 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ 2 * r ∧ ρ < ‖y‖ := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy
    have h1 : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖y - x‖ := by
      calc ‖x‖ = ‖y - (y - x)‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖y - x‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    have h2 : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y - x‖ := by
      calc ‖y‖ = ‖x + (y - x)‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y - x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    rw [← hrdef] at h1 h2
    refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have memB : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, x + τ • z ∈ Metric.ball x τ := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, show x + τ • z - x = τ • z by abel, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hτ]
    calc τ * ‖z‖ < τ * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz hτ
      _ = τ := mul_one τ
  have hyb : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
      r / 2 ≤ ‖x + τ • z‖ ∧ ‖x + τ • z‖ ≤ 2 * r ∧ ρ < ‖x + τ • z‖ :=
    fun z hz => geoB _ (memB z hz)
  
  have cmp : ∀ yn p : ℝ, r / 2 ≤ yn → yn ≤ 2 * r → yn ^ p ≤ 2 ^ |p| * r ^ p := by
    intro yn p h1 h2
    have hyn : 0 < yn := by linarith
    rcases le_total 0 p with hp | hp
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hp, ← Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hr.le]
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow hyn.le h2 hp
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos hp]
      calc yn ^ p ≤ (r / 2) ^ p := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) h1 hp
        _ = 2 ^ (-p) * r ^ p := by
          rw [Real.div_rpow hr.le (by norm_num), Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num), div_eq_inv_mul]
  
  have a0 : |-q| = q := by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hq]
  have a1 : |-q - 1| = q + 1 := by rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; ring
  have a2 : |-q - 2| = q + 2 := by rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; ring
  have e1 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 1) = 2 ^ q * 2 := Real.rpow_add_one (by norm_num) q
  have e2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 2) = 2 ^ q * 4 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), Real.rpow_two]; norm_num
  have rq1 : r ^ (-q - 1) = r ^ (-q) / r := Real.rpow_sub_one hr0 (-q)
  have rq2 : r ^ (-q - 2) = r ^ (-q) / r ^ 2 := by rw [Real.rpow_sub hr, Real.rpow_two]
  have rs1 : r ^ (s - 1) = r ^ s / r := Real.rpow_sub_one hr0 s
  have rs2 : r ^ (s - 2) = r ^ s / r ^ 2 := by rw [Real.rpow_sub hr, Real.rpow_two]
  have rs3 : r ^ (s - 3) = r ^ s / r ^ 3 := by
    rw [Real.rpow_sub hr, show (3 : ℝ) = ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]
  have hu : 0 < r ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr _
  have hrs : 0 < r ^ s := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr _
  have p0 : (2 : ℝ) ^ |s| ≤ 2 ^ S := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
    (by rw [hSdef]; linarith [abs_nonneg (s - 2), abs_nonneg (s - 3)])
  have p2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ |s - 2| ≤ 2 ^ S := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
    (by rw [hSdef]; linarith [abs_nonneg s, abs_nonneg (s - 3)])
  have p3 : (2 : ℝ) ^ |s - 3| ≤ 2 ^ S := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num)
    (by rw [hSdef]; linarith [abs_nonneg s, abs_nonneg (s - 2)])
  
  obtain ⟨ε, hεdef⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, ε = X * r ^ (-q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = A * 2 ^ S * r ^ s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := by rw [hεdef]; positivity
  have hεε₀ : ε ≤ ε₀ := by rw [hεdef]; exact le_of_lt (hRε r hrε)
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by rw [hMdef]; positivity
  
  have hpdU : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => partialDeriv j f z) U :=
    fun f hf j => (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdiffU : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ y ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y :=
    fun f hf y hy => (hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
  have hLdiff : ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (lapLoc G v) y := by
    intro y hy
    have hyU : y ∈ U := by rw [hUdef]; exact hy
    obtain ⟨hP, hβ⟩ := hKb y (lt_of_le_of_lt hρ hy)
    have heq : lapLoc G v = fun y =>
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j v z) y
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j y)
              * partialDeriv k v y := funext (s1 v)
    rw [heq]
    apply DifferentiableAt.sub
    · apply DifferentiableAt.fun_sum
      intro i _
      apply DifferentiableAt.fun_sum
      intro j _
      exact (hP i j).2.1.mul (hdiffU _ (hpdU _ (hpdU v hvU j) i) y hyU)
    · apply DifferentiableAt.fun_sum
      intro k _
      exact (hβ k).2.1.mul (hdiffU _ (hpdU v hvU k) y hyU)
  
  have mvt : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (L : ℝ), (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x τ, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y) →
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x τ, ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ L) →
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ z' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
        |f (x + τ • z) - f (x + τ • z')| ≤ L * (τ * ‖z - z'‖) := by
    intro f L hd hL z hz z' hz'
    have h := (convex_ball x τ).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hd hL (memB z' hz') (memB z hz)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    have e : x + τ • z - (x + τ • z') = τ • (z - z') := by rw [smul_sub]; abel
    rw [e, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hτ] at h
    exact h
  
  have bP : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x τ,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y‖ ≤ K * (2 ^ q * 2 * (r ^ (-q) / r)) := by
    intro i j y hy
    obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩ := geoB y hy
    have hc := cmp ‖y‖ (-q - 1) g1 g2
    rw [a1, e1, rq1] at hc
    exact le_trans ((hKb y (lt_of_le_of_lt hρ g3)).1 i j).2.2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hK)
  have bβ : ∀ k : Fin 3, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x τ,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z) y‖
        ≤ K * (2 ^ q * 4 * (r ^ (-q) / r ^ 2)) := by
    intro k y hy
    obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩ := geoB y hy
    have hc := cmp ‖y‖ (-q - 2) g1 g2
    rw [a2, e2, rq2] at hc
    exact le_trans ((hKb y (lt_of_le_of_lt hρ g3)).2 k).2.2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hK)
  have bL : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x τ,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (lapLoc G v) y‖ ≤ A * (2 ^ |s - 3| * (r ^ s / r ^ 3)) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩ := geoB y hy
    have hc := cmp ‖y‖ (s - 3) g1 g2
    rw [rs3] at hc
    exact le_trans (hL1 y g3) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hA)
  
  have hwb : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, |v (x + τ • z)| ≤ M := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hyb z hz
    have hc := cmp _ s h1 h2
    calc |v (x + τ • z)| ≤ A * ‖x + τ • z‖ ^ s := hv0 _ h3
      _ ≤ A * (2 ^ |s| * r ^ s) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hA
      _ ≤ A * (2 ^ S * r ^ s) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right p0 hrs.le) hA
      _ = M := by rw [hMdef]; ring
  have hcoef : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ z' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |(G (x + τ • z))⁻¹ i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε ∧
          |(G (x + τ • z))⁻¹ i j - (G (x + τ • z'))⁻¹ i j| ≤ ε * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin 3,
          |τ * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (x + τ • z))⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j (x + τ • z)|
            ≤ ε ∧
          |τ * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (x + τ • z))⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j (x + τ • z)
            - τ * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
                (G (x + τ • z'))⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j (x + τ • z')| ≤ ε * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
      |τ ^ 2 * lapLoc G v (x + τ • z)| ≤ M ∧
      |τ ^ 2 * lapLoc G v (x + τ • z) - τ ^ 2 * lapLoc G v (x + τ • z')| ≤ M * ‖z - z'‖ := by
    intro z hz z' hz'
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hyb z hz
    obtain ⟨hP, hβ⟩ := hKb _ (lt_of_le_of_lt hρ h3)
    have hd : 0 ≤ ‖z - z'‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hτ2 : 0 < τ ^ 2 := pow_pos hτ 2
    have hεd : ε * ‖z - z'‖ = 4 * (K * 2 ^ q * r ^ (-q) * ‖z - z'‖) := by
      rw [hεdef, hXdef]; ring
    have hεe : ε = 4 * (K * 2 ^ q * r ^ (-q)) := by rw [hεdef, hXdef]; ring
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ K * 2 ^ q * r ^ (-q) := by positivity
    have hPd : 0 ≤ K * 2 ^ q * r ^ (-q) * ‖z - z'‖ := by positivity
    refine ⟨fun i j => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun k => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hc := cmp _ (-q) h1 h2
      rw [a0] at hc
      calc _ ≤ K * ‖x + τ • z‖ ^ (-q) := (hP i j).1
        _ ≤ K * (2 ^ q * r ^ (-q)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hK
        _ = K * 2 ^ q * r ^ (-q) := by ring

          have := mul_nonneg hlam (neg_nonneg.mpr (hψlap q))
          nlinarith
      · intro q hq
        have hl := ((lapM_gradInner_linear_local g (W n) ψ β q).1 (hW n) hψ σ (-lam)).2
        rw [hl, hWneu n q hq, hψneu q hq]
        simp
      · intro y hy
        show σ * W n ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) + (-lam) * ψ ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) ≤ 0
        rw [hWS n y hy, mul_zero, zero_add]
        have := mul_nonneg hlam (hψb ((hAF.ends k).Φ y)).1
        nlinarith
      · intro q hq hqF hqC
        show σ * W n q + (-lam) * ψ q ≤ 0
        rw [hWoff n q hq hqF hqC, mul_zero, zero_add]
        have := mul_nonneg hlam (hψb q).1
        nlinarith
    have h1 := hcmp 1 (Or.inl rfl)
    have h2 := hcmp (-1) (Or.inr rfl)
    have hψP : lam * ψ p ≤ lam * P₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hψb p).2 hlam
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  have hρs : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ≤ Rb + 4 + (n : ℝ) := fun n => by linarith

    neumann_limit g hAF k β Re hβ ft hft (lam * P₀) (fun n => Rb + 4 + (n : ℝ)) hρs W hW

  have hsum : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun q => zh q + Wl q) := by
    have h := hzh.add hWl
    exact h

    have h := hu₀.add hsum

          congr 1

[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u v w : M → ℝ) (p : M) :
    ((ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) → (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v) → ∀ a b : ℝ,
      g.lapM (fun q => a * u q + b * v q) p = a * g.lapM u p + b * g.lapM v p ∧
      g.gradInner (fun q => a * u q + b * v q) w p = a * g.gradInner u w p + b * g.gradInner v w p) ∧
    (∀ U : Set M, IsOpen U → p ∈ U → (∀ q ∈ U, u q = v q) →
      g.lapM u p = g.lapM v p ∧ g.gradInner u w p = g.gradInner v w p)

subgoal_signatures.name: neumann_dirichlet_solve
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : Re + 1 < ρ) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hf0 : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | Re < ‖y‖} → f p = 0) :
    ∃ w : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} → g.lapM w p = f p) ∧
      (∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner w β p = 0) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ = ρ → w ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) = 0) ∧
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} →
        p ∉ connectedComponentIn ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
          ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0)) → w p = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: neumann_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (h : M → ℝ) (hh : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ h) (B : ℝ)
    (ρs : ℕ → ℝ) (hρs : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ≤ ρs n) (W : ℕ → M → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ n : ℕ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (W n))
    (hlap : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M), 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n ≤ ‖y‖} →
      g.lapM (W n) p = h p)
    (hneu : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M), β p = 0 → g.gradInner (W n) β p = 0)
    (hbd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M), 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n < ‖y‖} →
      |W n p| ≤ B) :
    ∃ w : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → g.lapM w p = h p) ∧
      (∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner w β p = 0) ∧
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → |w p| ≤ B)

subgoal_signatures.name: neumann_barrier
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) (Rmin : ℝ) :
    ∃ (ψ : M → ℝ) (Rb c P₀ : ℝ), Rmin ≤ Rb ∧ Re < Rb ∧ 0 < c ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ ∧
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ ψ p ∧ ψ p ≤ P₀) ∧
      (∀ p : M, g.lapM ψ p ≤ 0) ∧
      (∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner ψ β p = 0) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, Rb < ‖y‖ → g.lapM ψ ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) ≤ -c * ‖y‖ ^ (-2 - ε))

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)

    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : Re + 1 < ρ) (z : M → ℝ) (hz : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ z)
    (hlap : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} → 0 ≤ g.lapM z p)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → 0 ≤ g.gradInner z β p)
    (hS : ∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ = ρ → z ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) ≤ 0)

        p ∉ connectedComponentIn ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
          ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0)) → z p ≤ 0) :
    ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} → z p ≤ 0

        (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) x := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp [ite_mul]
  have hid : lapLoc G w x - ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i w) x =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          ((G x)⁻¹ i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) x
        - ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (G x)⁻¹ i j * ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j x * partialDeriv k w x := by
    rw [hdiag]
    simp only [lapLoc, hessLoc, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  rw [hid]
  
  
  obtain ⟨S2, hS2⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ,
      S = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) x| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S1, hS1⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k w x| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS20 : 0 ≤ S2 := by
    rw [hS2]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => abs_nonneg _
  have hS10 : 0 ≤ S1 := by
    rw [hS1]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => abs_nonneg _
  rw [← hS2, ← hS1]
  have hT1 : |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      ((G x)⁻¹ i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) x|
        ≤ 3 * (b * (C * ρ)) * S2 := by
    rw [hS2, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hPe i j) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hinner : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j x * partialDeriv k w x| ≤ 9 / 2 * b * (C * u) * S1 := by
    intro i j
    rw [hS1, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hΓ k i j) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hT2 : |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G x)⁻¹ i j * ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j x * partialDeriv k w x|
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u) * S1) := by
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hPb i j) (hinner i j) (abs_nonneg _) hb0
  have hT2' : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u) * S1)
      = 9 * (b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u) * S1)) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  rw [hT2'] at hT2
  have a1 := abs_le.mp hT1
  have a2 := abs_le.mp hT2
  have k1 : 0 ≤ 3 * b * C * (u * S1) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hb0) hC) (mul_nonneg hu0 hS10)
  have k2 : 0 ≤ 81 / 2 * b ^ 2 * C * (ρ * S2) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg b)) hC) (mul_nonneg hρ0 hS20)
  have hexp : (3 * b * C + 81 / 2 * b ^ 2 * C) * (ρ * S2 + u * S1) =
      3 * (b * (C * ρ)) * S2 + 9 * (b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u) * S1))
        + 3 * b * C * (u * S1) + 81 / 2 * b ^ 2 * C * (ρ * S2) := by ring
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor <;> linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ ρ s : ℝ, 1 ≤ ρ → 0 ≤ s → ρ ^ (-s) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s * (1 + ρ) ^ (-s) := by
    intro ρ s hρ hs
    have h1 : (2 * ρ) ^ (-s) ≤ (1 + ρ) ^ (-s) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h2 : (2 * ρ) ^ (-s) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-s) * ρ ^ (-s) :=
      Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have h3 : (2 : ℝ) ^ s * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-s) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num)]
      simp
    have h4 : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _
    calc ρ ^ (-s) = (2 : ℝ) ^ s * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-s) * ρ ^ (-s)) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, h3, one_mul]
      _ = (2 : ℝ) ^ s * (2 * ρ) ^ (-s) := by rw [h2]
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ s * (1 + ρ) ^ (-s) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h4
  
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ, hχ01, hχ0, hχ1⟩ : ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ ∧
      (∀ x : E3, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ≤ R + 1 → χ x = 0) ∧ (∀ x : E3, R + 2 ≤ ‖x‖ → χ x = 1) := by
    let b : ContDiffBump (0 : E3) := ⟨R + 1, R + 2, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    refine ⟨fun x => 1 - b x, contDiff_const.sub b.contDiff, fun x => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := b.le_one (x := x); linarith
    · have := b.nonneg (x := x); linarith
    · intro x hx
      have : b x = 1 := b.one_of_mem_closedBall (by rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]; exact hx)
      show 1 - b x = 0
      rw [this]; norm_num
    · intro x hx
      have : b x = 0 := b.zero_of_le_dist (by rw [dist_zero_right]; exact hx)
      show 1 - b x = 1
      rw [this]; norm_num
  set f : E3 → ℝ := fun x => χ x * F x with hfdef
  have fa : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ≤ R + 1 → f x = 0 := fun x hx => by
    show χ x * F x = 0
    rw [hχ0 x hx, zero_mul]
  have fb : ∀ x : E3, R + 2 ≤ ‖x‖ → f x = F x := fun x hx => by
    show χ x * F x = F x
    rw [hχ1 x hx, one_mul]
  have hU₀ : IsOpen {x : E3 | ‖x‖ < R + 1} := isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const
  have hU₁ : IsOpen {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hU₂ : IsOpen {x : E3 | R + 2 < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hfU₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := hχ.contDiffOn.mul hF
  have fd : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < R + 1 → f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    filter_upwards [hU₀.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact fa y (le_of_lt hy)
  have fe : ∀ x : E3, R + 2 < ‖x‖ → f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] F := by
    intro x hx
    filter_upwards [hU₂.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact fb y (le_of_lt hy)
  have ff : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ f x := fun x hx =>
    ((hfU₁.differentiableOn (by simp)) x hx).differentiableAt (hU₁.mem_nhds hx)
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ f := by
    intro x
    rcases lt_or_ge ‖x‖ (R + 1) with h | h
    · exact (differentiableAt_const (0 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (fd x h)
    · exact ff x (by linarith)
  
  obtain ⟨M, hM0, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R + 1 ≤ ‖x‖ → ‖x‖ ≤ R + 2 → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ M := by
    have hcl : IsClosed ({x : E3 | R + 1 ≤ ‖x‖} ∩ closedBall 0 (R + 2)) :=
      (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter isClosed_closedBall
    have hcpt : IsCompact ({x : E3 | R + 1 ≤ ‖x‖} ∩ closedBall 0 (R + 2)) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall 0 (R + 2)).of_isClosed_subset hcl Set.inter_subset_right
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} :=
      hfU₁.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU₁ (by simp)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcpt.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono (by
      intro x hx
      have h1 : R + 1 ≤ ‖x‖ := hx.1
      show R < ‖x‖
      linarith))
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    have := hC x ⟨h1, by rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]; exact h2⟩
    exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have h2a : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _
  have hR3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (R + 3) ^ (a + 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
  have hA'0 : 0 ≤ A * (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) + M * (R + 3) ^ (a + 1) :=
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA h2a) (mul_nonneg hM0 hR3)
  have h2le : (2 : ℝ) ^ a ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hP1 : A * (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) ≤ A * (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) + M * (R + 3) ^ (a + 1) :=
    le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hM0 hR3)
  have hP2 : M * (R + 3) ^ (a + 1) ≤ A * (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) + M * (R + 3) ^ (a + 1) :=
    le_add_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg hA h2a)
  refine ⟨f, A * (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) + M * (R + 3) ^ (a + 1), hA'0, hdiff, fb,
    fun x => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hpx : 0 ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
    rcases le_or_gt ‖x‖ (R + 1) with h | h
    · rw [fa x h, abs_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hA'0 hpx
    · have hxR : R < ‖x‖ := by linarith
      have hx1 : 1 ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
      have e1 : |f x| ≤ |F x| := by
        show |χ x * F x| ≤ |F x|
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hχ01 x).1]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) (hχ01 x).2
      have e2 := s1 ‖x‖ a hx1 ha
      calc |f x| ≤ A * ‖x‖ ^ (-a) := e1.trans (hF0 x hxR)
        _ ≤ A * ((2 : ℝ) ^ a * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hA
        _ = (A * (2 : ℝ) ^ a) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a) := by ring
        _ ≤ (A * (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) + M * (R + 3) ^ (a + 1)) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ hpx
          exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2le hA).trans hP1
  · have hpx : 0 ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _
    rcases lt_or_ge ‖x‖ (R + 1) with h | h
    · rw [(fd x h).fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_apply, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hA'0 hpx
    rcases le_or_gt ‖x‖ (R + 2) with h' | h'
    · have hb := hM x h h'
      have hm1 : (R + 3) ^ (-a - 1) ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hm2 : (R + 3) ^ (a + 1) * (R + 3) ^ (-a - 1) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add (by linarith)]
        have : a + 1 + (-a - 1) = 0 := by ring
        rw [this, Real.rpow_zero]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ M := hb
        _ = M * (R + 3) ^ (a + 1) * (R + 3) ^ (-a - 1) := by rw [mul_assoc, hm2, mul_one]
        _ ≤ M * (R + 3) ^ (a + 1) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm1 (mul_nonneg hM0 hR3)
        _ ≤ (A * (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) + M * (R + 3) ^ (a + 1)) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP2 hpx
    · have hxR : R < ‖x‖ := by linarith
      have hx1 : 1 ≤ ‖x‖ := by linarith
      have e2 := s1 ‖x‖ (a + 1) hx1 (by linarith)
      have ee : -(a + 1) = -a - 1 := by ring
      rw [ee] at e2
      rw [(fe x h').fderiv_eq]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ F x‖ ≤ A * ‖x‖ ^ (-a - 1) := hF1 x hxR
        _ ≤ A * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hA
        _ = (A * (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1)) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) := by ring
        _ ≤ (A * (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) + M * (R + 3) ^ (a + 1)) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP1 hpx

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : E3 → ℝ, ∀ z : E3,
      K z = (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) + 1 / 2 * (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
    ⟨_, fun z => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η : E3 → ℝ, ∀ z : E3, η z = 15 / 2 * (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) ^ (-(7 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
    ⟨_, fun z => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hKd, hKid, hK1, hK2, htr⟩ := spc2_kernel_facts K hK
  obtain ⟨hηc, hη0, hηb, hηi, hcpos⟩ := spc2_density_facts η hη
  have htr' : ∀ z : E3, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i K) z = -η z := by
    intro z; rw [htr z, hη z]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = ∫ z, η z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hc] at hcpos
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hcpos
  have hcinv : 0 ≤ c⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hcpos.le
  have hfc : Continuous f := hf.continuous
  have hKic : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (partialDeriv i K) := fun i => (hKid i).continuous
  
  have hpd_le : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (z : E3), |partialDeriv i g z| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ g z‖ := by
    intro g i z
    calc |partialDeriv i g z| = ‖fderiv ℝ g z (e i)‖ := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; rfl
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ g z‖ * ‖e i‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ g z‖ := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  have hpd_add_const : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ) (b : ℝ) (j : Fin 3) (x : E3),
      partialDeriv j (fun x => g x + b) x = partialDeriv j g x := by
    intro g b j x
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_add_const]
  have hpd_const_mul : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ) (b : ℝ) (j : Fin 3) (x : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      partialDeriv j (fun x => b * g x) x = b * partialDeriv j g x := by
    intro g b j x hg
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_const_mul hg]
    rfl
  
  have hKi0 : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (z : E3), |partialDeriv i K z| ≤ 10 * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ) :=
    fun i z => (hpd_le K i z).trans (hK1 z)
  have hKij0 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      |partialDeriv j (partialDeriv i K) z| ≤ 60 * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-3 : ℝ) :=
    fun i j z => (hpd_le _ j z).trans (hK2 i z)
  
  have hpt : ∀ (k : E3 → ℝ) (p M : ℝ), (∀ z : E3, |k z| ≤ M * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-p)) →
      ∀ w y : E3, ‖k (w - y) * f y‖ ≤ M * A * ((1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a)) := by
    intro k p M hkb w y
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    have h1 := hkb (w - y)
    calc |k (w - y)| * |f y| ≤ (M * (1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-p)) * (A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a)) :=
          mul_le_mul h1 (hf0 y) (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans h1)
      _ = M * A * ((1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a)) := by ring
  have hint : ∀ (k : E3 → ℝ) (p M : ℝ), 0 ≤ p → 3 < p + a → Measurable k →
      (∀ z : E3, |k z| ≤ M * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-p)) → ∀ w : E3,
      Integrable (fun y => k (w - y) * f y) := by
    intro k p M hp hpa hk hkb w
    refine Integrable.mono' ((weight_peetre_integrable p a hp hpa w).const_mul (M * A)) ?_ ?_
    · exact ((hk.comp (measurable_const.sub measurable_id)).mul
        hfc.measurable).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => hpt k p M hkb w y)
  
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂, hconv2⟩ :=
    weight_conv_bound 2 a (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨C₃, hC₃, hconv3⟩ :=
    weight_conv_bound (a + 1) 2 (by linarith) (by linarith) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
