      ∀ (i : Fin 3) (x : E3),
      partialDeriv i (fun x : E3 => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * φ (x - y)) x =
        ∫ y : E3, ρ y * partialDeriv i φ (x - y) := by
    intro ρ φ hρc hρcs hρs hφ hloc hdiff i x
    have hu1 : ‖e i‖ = 1 := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hloc i (‖x‖ + 2)
    have hline : ∀ s0 : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x + s • e i) (e i) s0 := by
      intro s0
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s0).smul_const (e i)).const_add x
    have ha : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (fun x : E3 => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * φ (x - y)) (x + s • e i))
        (partialDeriv i (fun x : E3 => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * φ (x - y)) x) 0 :=
      (hdiff x).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0:ℝ) (hline 0) (by simp)
    have hIρ : Integrable ρ := hρc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hρcs
    have hb := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := volume)
      (F := fun (s : ℝ) (y : E3) => ρ y * φ (x + s • e i - y))
      (F' := fun (s : ℝ) (y : E3) => ρ y * partialDeriv i φ (x + s • e i - y))
      (x₀ := 0) (bound := fun y => |ρ y| * M) (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0:ℝ) one_pos)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s =>
        (hρc.mul (hφ.continuous.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).aestronglyMeasurable)
      ((hρc.mul (hφ.continuous.comp
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hρcs.mul_right))
      ((hρc.measurable.mul ((measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ φ (e i)).comp
        (measurable_const.sub measurable_id))).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (ae_of_all _ (by
        intro y s hs
        show ‖ρ y * partialDeriv i φ (x + s • e i - y)‖ ≤ |ρ y| * M
        rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        rcases le_or_gt ‖y‖ 1 with h | h
        · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM _ ?_) (abs_nonneg _)
          have hs' : |s| < 1 := by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hs
          calc ‖x + s • e i - y‖ ≤ ‖x + s • e i‖ + ‖y‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
            _ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖s • e i‖ + ‖y‖ := by gcongr; exact norm_add_le _ _
            _ = ‖x‖ + |s| + ‖y‖ := by rw [norm_smul, hu1, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one]
            _ ≤ ‖x‖ + 2 := by linarith
        · rw [hρs y h]; simp))
      (hIρ.abs.mul_const M)
      (ae_of_all _ (by
        intro y s _
        have hg : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x + s • e i - y) (e i) s := (hline s).sub_const y
        exact ((hφ (x + s • e i - y)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hg).const_mul (ρ y)))
    have h := ha.unique hb.2
    rw [h]
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
  
  have conv_contDiff : ∀ (ρ φ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → Continuous φ →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E3 => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * φ (x - y)) := by
    intro ρ φ hρ hρcs hφ
    have h := hρcs.contDiff_convolution_left (L := ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (μ := volume)
      (n := ⊤) hρ hφ.locallyIntegrable
    have heq : convolution ρ φ (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume =
        fun x : E3 => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * φ (x - y) := by
      funext x; exact convolution_mul
    rw [heq] at h; exact h
  
  have conv_sub_self_le : ∀ (ρ f : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3) (M : ℝ),
      Continuous ρ → HasCompactSupport ρ → (∀ y : E3, 0 ≤ ρ y) →
      (∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → ρ y = 0) → ∫ y : E3, ρ y = 1 → Differentiable ℝ f →
      (∀ z : E3, ‖z - x‖ ≤ 1 → ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ ≤ M) →
      |(∫ y : E3, ρ y * f (x - y)) - f x| ≤ M := by
    intro ρ f x M hρc hρcs hρ0 hρs hρ1 hf hM
    have hMV : ∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ ≤ 1 → |f (x - y) - f x| ≤ M := by
      intro y hy
      have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hM x (by simp))
      have hxS : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x 1 := Metric.mem_closedBall_self zero_le_one
      have hyS : x - y ∈ Metric.closedBall x 1 := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]; simpa using hy
      have h := (convex_closedBall x 1).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
        (fun z _ => hf z) (fun z hz => hM z (by rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hz))
        hxS hyS
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc ‖f (x - y) - f x‖ ≤ M * ‖x - y - x‖ := h
        _ = M * ‖y‖ := by simp
        _ ≤ M * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hM0
        _ = M := mul_one M
    have I₁ : Integrable (fun y : E3 => ρ y * f (x - y)) :=
      (hρc.mul (hf.continuous.comp
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hρcs.mul_right
    have I₂ : Integrable (fun y : E3 => ρ y * f x) :=
      (hρc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hρcs).mul_const _
    have heq : (∫ y : E3, ρ y * f (x - y)) - f x = ∫ y : E3, ρ y * (f (x - y) - f x) := by
      have h2 : ∫ y : E3, ρ y * f x = f x := by rw [integral_mul_const, hρ1, one_mul]
      have h3 : ∫ y : E3, ρ y * (f (x - y) - f x) =
          (∫ y : E3, ρ y * f (x - y)) - ∫ y : E3, ρ y * f x := by
        rw [← integral_sub I₁ I₂]; congr 1; funext y; ring
      rw [h3, h2]
    rw [heq]
    exact conv_abs_le_of_ball ρ (fun z => f z - f x) x M hρc hρcs hρ0 hρs hρ1 hMV
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρsm, hρcs, hρ0, hρ1, hρs⟩ : ∃ ρ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ ∧ HasCompactSupport ρ ∧
      (∀ y, 0 ≤ ρ y) ∧ ∫ y, ρ y = 1 ∧ ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → ρ y = 0 := by
    let φb : ContDiffBump (0 : E3) := ⟨1/2, 1, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
    refine ⟨φb.normed volume, φb.contDiff_normed, φb.hasCompactSupport_normed,
      fun y => φb.nonneg_normed y, φb.integral_normed, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    by_contra hne
    have hmem : y ∈ Function.support (φb.normed volume) := hne
    rw [φb.support_normed_eq] at hmem
    have : ‖y‖ < 1 := by simpa using hmem
    linarith
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρsm.continuous
  have h11 : (1 + 1 : ℝ) = 2 := by norm_num
  
  have hA : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ) (a : ℝ), (∀ z, |g z| ≤ B * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ a) →
      ∀ x y : E3, ‖y‖ ≤ 1 → |g (x - y)| ≤ 2 ^ |a| * B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ a := by
    intro g a hg x y hy
    have h := weight_shift_le x y a 1 hy
    rw [h11] at h
    calc |g (x - y)| ≤ B * (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ a := hg _
      _ ≤ B * (2 ^ |a| * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ a) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hB
      _ = 2 ^ |a| * B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ a := by ring
  
  have hBl : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ) (a : ℝ), (∀ z, |g z| ≤ B * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ a) →
      ∀ R : ℝ, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ ≤ R → |g z| ≤ M := by
    intro g a hg R
    refine ⟨B * (1 + R) ^ |a|, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have h := weight_shift_le 0 (-z) a R (by rwa [norm_neg])
    simp only [zero_sub, neg_neg, norm_zero, add_zero, Real.one_rpow, mul_one] at h
    exact (hg z).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hB)
  
  have hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E3 => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * v (x - y)) :=
    conv_contDiff ρ v hρsm hρcs hv.continuous
  have hd1 : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun x : E3 => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * v (x - y)) =
      fun x => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * partialDeriv j v (x - y) := by
    intro j; funext x
    exact conv_partialDeriv ρ v hρc hρcs hρs hv
      (fun i R => hBl _ _ (fun z => (hb z).2.1 i) R) (hw.differentiable (by simp)) j x
  have hd2 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x : E3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun x : E3 => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * v (x - y))) x =
        ∫ y : E3, ρ y * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j v) (x - y) := by
    intro i j x
    rw [hd1 j]
    exact conv_partialDeriv ρ (partialDeriv j v) hρc hρcs hρs (hv1 j)
      (fun i' R => hBl _ _ (fun z => (hb z).2.2.1 i' j) R)
      ((conv_contDiff ρ _ hρsm hρcs (hv1 j).continuous).differentiable (by simp)) i x
  
  have hc0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ |s| := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _
  have hc1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ |s - 1| := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _
  have hc2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ |s - 2| := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _
  have hct : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ |t| := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _
  refine ⟨fun x : E3 => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * v (x - y),
    B * (2 ^ |s| + 2 ^ |s - 1| + 2 ^ |s - 2| + 2 * 2 ^ |t|),
    mul_nonneg hB (by linarith), hw, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hW : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) ^ a := fun a =>
    Real.rpow_nonneg (by have := norm_nonneg x; linarith) a
  have key : ∀ (c a Y : ℝ), c ≤ 2 ^ |s| + 2 ^ |s - 1| + 2 ^ |s - 2| + 2 * 2 ^ |t| →
      Y ≤ c * B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ a →
      Y ≤ B * (2 ^ |s| + 2 ^ |s - 1| + 2 ^ |s - 2| + 2 * 2 ^ |t|) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ a := by
    intro c a Y hc hY
    refine hY.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (hW a))
    rw [mul_comm c B]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc hB
  refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_, fun i j => ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact key _ _ _ (by linarith)
      (conv_abs_le_of_ball ρ v x _ hρc hρcs hρ0 hρs hρ1 (hA v s (fun z => (hb z).1) x))
  · rw [hd1 i]
    exact key _ _ _ (by linarith)
      (conv_abs_le_of_ball ρ _ x _ hρc hρcs hρ0 hρs hρ1
        (hA _ (s - 1) (fun z => (hb z).2.1 i) x))
  · rw [hd2 i j x]
    exact key _ _ _ (by linarith)
      (conv_abs_le_of_ball ρ _ x _ hρc hρcs hρ0 hρs hρ1
        (hA _ (s - 2) (fun z => (hb z).2.2.1 i j) x))
  · 
    have hI : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        Integrable (fun y : E3 => ρ y * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i v) (x - y)) := fun i =>
      conv_integrable_of_ball ρ _ x _ hρc hρcs hρs
        (measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ (partialDeriv i v) (e i))
        (hA _ _ (fun z => (hb z).2.2.1 i i) x)
    have hJ : Integrable (fun y : E3 => ρ y * f (x - y)) :=
      (hρc.mul (hf.continuous.comp
        (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hρcs.mul_right
    have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i
          (fun x : E3 => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * v (x - y))) x =
        ∫ y : E3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ρ y * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i v) (x - y) := by
      rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hI i)]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hd2 i i x)
    have hL : ∫ y : E3, ρ y * (∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i v) (x - y) + f (x - y)) =
        (∫ y : E3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ρ y * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i v) (x - y)) +
          ∫ y : E3, ρ y * f (x - y) := by
      rw [← integral_add (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hI i)) hJ]
      congr 1; funext y; rw [mul_add, Finset.mul_sum]
    have hid : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i
          (fun x : E3 => ∫ y : E3, ρ y * v (x - y))) x + f x =
        (∫ y : E3, ρ y * (∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i v) (x - y) + f (x - y))) -
          ((∫ y : E3, ρ y * f (x - y)) - f x) := by
      rw [hsum, hL]; ring
    have b1 : |∫ y : E3, ρ y * (∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i v) (x - y)
        + f (x - y))| ≤ 2 ^ |t| * B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-t) := by
      have h := hA (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i v) z + f z) (-t)
        (fun z => (hb z).2.2.2.1) x
      rw [abs_neg] at h
      exact conv_abs_le_of_ball ρ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv i v) z + f z)
        x _ hρc hρcs hρ0 hρs hρ1 h
    have b2 : |(∫ y : E3, ρ y * f (x - y)) - f x| ≤ 2 ^ |t| * B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-t) := by
      refine conv_sub_self_le ρ f x _ hρc hρcs hρ0 hρs hρ1 hf (fun z hz => ?_)
      have h := weight_shift_le x (x - z) (-t) 1 (by rwa [norm_sub_rev])
      rw [sub_sub_cancel, abs_neg, h11] at h
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-t) := (hb z).2.2.2.2
        _ ≤ B * (2 ^ |t| * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-t)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hB
        _ = 2 ^ |t| * B * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-t) := by ring
    rw [hid]
    refine key (2 * 2 ^ |t|) _ _ (by linarith) ?_
    obtain ⟨b1l, b1r⟩ := abs_le.mp b1
    obtain ⟨b2l, b2r⟩ := abs_le.mp b2
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith

informal_problem.statement:
∃ C_G : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_G ∧
    ∀ (ψ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ K : ℝ,
      (∀ x y : E3, |∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) x
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) y| ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) →
      ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x y : E3), |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) x
          - partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) y| ≤ C_G * K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)

signature.name: holder_schauder_global
signature.statement:
∃ C_G : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_G ∧
    ∀ (ψ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ K : ℝ,
      (∀ x y : E3, |∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) x
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) y| ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) →
      ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x y : E3), |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) x
          - partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) y| ≤ C_G * K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, hmom⟩ := hess_kernel_moments
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, hlip⟩ := hess_kernel_lip
  obtain ⟨hp₁smooth, -, hp₁d2⟩ := gaussian_partials
  refine ⟨8 * c₁ + 4 * c₂, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro ψ hψ hψc K hK i j x y
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst hxy
    simp
  
  have hpd : ∀ g : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ a : Fin 3,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => partialDeriv a g z) :=
    fun g hg a => (hg.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hcs : ∀ g : E3 → ℝ, HasCompactSupport g → ∀ a : Fin 3,
      HasCompactSupport (fun z => partialDeriv a g z) :=
    fun g hg a => (hg.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp_left (g := fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e a)) rfl
  have hC1 : ∀ g : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ContDiff ℝ 1 g :=
    fun g hg => hg.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  
  have hd : 0 < ‖x - y‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxy)
  have hdh : 0 < ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hd _
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by
    have h := hK x y
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    have h2 : K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 0 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg hdh
    have h3 := abs_nonneg (∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) x
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) y)
    linarith
  
  set p : E3 → ℝ := fun ζ => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) with hpdef
  set H : E3 → ℝ := fun ζ => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
      (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2) with hHdef
  set f : E3 → ℝ := fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun y => partialDeriv k ψ y) z with hfdef
  set u : E3 → ℝ := fun z => partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) z with hudef
  set T : E3 → ℝ → ℝ := fun w t => t⁻¹ * ∫ ζ : E3, H ζ * f (w - Real.sqrt t • ζ) with hTdef
  have hψj : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) := hpd ψ hψ j
  have hψjc : HasCompactSupport (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) := hcs ψ hψc j
  have hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u := hpd _ hψj i
  have huc : HasCompactSupport u := hcs _ hψjc i
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f := ContDiff.sum (fun k _ => hpd _ (hpd ψ hψ k) k)
  have hfc : HasCompactSupport f := by
    have e3 : f = fun z => partialDeriv 0 (fun y => partialDeriv 0 ψ y) z
        + partialDeriv 1 (fun y => partialDeriv 1 ψ y) z
        + partialDeriv 2 (fun y => partialDeriv 2 ψ y) z := by
      funext z; exact Fin.sum_univ_three _
    rw [e3]
    exact ((hcs _ (hcs ψ hψc 0) 0).add (hcs _ (hcs ψ hψc 1) 1)).add (hcs _ (hcs ψ hψc 2) 2)
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hfc.exists_bound_of_continuous hf.continuous
  have hfb : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, |f z| ≤ B :=
    ⟨B, fun z => by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hB z⟩
  have hfH : ∀ y z : E3, |f y - f z| ≤ K * ‖y - z‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := hK
  obtain ⟨hHi, hH0, hHm, hHM⟩ := hmom i j H (fun ζ => rfl)
  have hite : (if j = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · simp [hij]
    · simp [hij, Ne.symm hij]
  
  have hrep : ∀ w : E3, IntegrableOn (T w) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
      u w = -∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), T w t := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨hint, heq⟩ := heat_rep_scalar u hu huc w
    have hA : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        (∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
          ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k u z) (w - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
          = T w t := by
      intro t ht
      have ht' : (0 : ℝ) < t := ht
      have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt t := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht'
      have e1 : (∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
          ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k u z) (w - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
          = ∫ ζ : E3, p ζ * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j f z) (w - Real.sqrt t • ζ) := by
        congr 1
        funext ζ
        congr 1
        exact laplacian_hessian_comm ψ hψ i j _
      have e2 : (∫ ζ : E3, p ζ * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j f z) (w - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
          = (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ * ∫ ζ : E3, partialDeriv i p ζ * partialDeriv j f (w - Real.sqrt t • ζ) :=
        conv_ibp_scaled p (fun z => partialDeriv j f z) (hC1 _ hp₁smooth) (hC1 _ (hpd _ hf j))
          (hcs _ hfc j) i w (Real.sqrt t) hs
      have e3 : (∫ ζ : E3, partialDeriv i p ζ * partialDeriv j f (w - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
          = (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ * ∫ ζ : E3, partialDeriv j (fun ζ' => partialDeriv i p ζ') ζ
              * f (w - Real.sqrt t • ζ) :=

        congr 1
        funext ζ
        congr 1
        refine (hp₁d2 j i ζ).trans ?_
        show (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *

            (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)
        rw [mul_comm (ζ j) (ζ i), hite]
      calc _ = _ := e1
        _ = _ := e2
        _ = (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ * ((Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ * ∫ ζ : E3, H ζ * f (w - Real.sqrt t • ζ)) := by
          rw [e3, e4]
        _ = t⁻¹ * ∫ ζ : E3, H ζ * f (w - Real.sqrt t • ζ) := by

    intro t ht

      hf.continuous hfb hfH

    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ht)]
    calc t⁻¹ * |∫ ζ : E3, H ζ * f (w - Real.sqrt t • ζ)|
        ≤ t⁻¹ * (K * Real.sqrt t ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * c₁) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h8 (inv_pos.mpr ht).le
      _ = c₁ * K * (t⁻¹ * Real.sqrt t ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ = c₁ * K * t ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)) := by rw [ex1 t ht]
  
  have hlarge : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 ≤ t →
      |T x t - T y t| ≤ c₂ * K * ‖x - y‖ * t ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ)) := by

          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h9 (inv_pos.mpr ht0).le

          + 4 * (c₂ * K * ‖x - y‖) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := hsplit
    _ = (8 * c₁ + 4 * c₂) * K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [e5, hdd]; ring

    rw [chrD y hPd hdGd m k i j, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hKgv : Kg * v = 9 / 2 * (9 * b ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * v) + 9 / 2 * (b * (C * v)) := by
      rw [hKgdef]; ring
    nlinarith [t1, t2, hpu, hKgv]
  
  
  refine ⟨fun i j => ⟨?_, hPd i j, ?_⟩, fun k => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    calc _ ≤ Ke * ρ := hPe i j
      _ ≤ (Ke + Kp + Kv + Kd) * ρ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hρ0
  · 
    calc ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y‖
        ≤ ∑ m : Fin 3, |fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y (e m)| := hnorm _
      _ ≤ ∑ m : Fin 3, p := Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => hdP m i j
      _ = Kp * u := by rw [hpdef, hKpdef]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
      _ ≤ (Ke + Kp + Kv + Kd) * u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hu0
  · 
    have hval := hsum9 (fun i j => (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j y)
      (b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u))) (fun i j => by
        show |(G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j y| ≤ _
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hPb i j) (hΓ k i j) (abs_nonneg _) hb0)
    have he : 9 * (b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u))) = Kv * u := by rw [hKvdef]; ring
    calc _ ≤ 9 * (b * (9 / 2 * b * (C * u))) := hval
      _ = Kv * u := he
      _ ≤ (Ke + Kp + Kv + Kd) * u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hu0
  · 
    have hin : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z) y := fun i =>
      DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun j _ => (hPd i j).mul (hΓd k i j)
    exact DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun i _ => hin i
  · 
    have hHas : HasFDerivAt
        (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z)
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ((G y)⁻¹ i j • fderiv ℝ (christoffel G k i j) y
          + christoffel G k i j y • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y)) y := by
      have hin : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt
          (fun z => ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z)
          (∑ j : Fin 3, ((G y)⁻¹ i j • fderiv ℝ (christoffel G k i j) y
            + christoffel G k i j y • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y)) y := fun i =>
        HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
          (A := fun j z => (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z)
          (fun j _ => (hPd i j).hasFDerivAt.mul (hΓd k i j).hasFDerivAt)
      exact HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
        (A := fun i z => ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z)
        (fun i _ => hin i)
    have hpart : ∀ m : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z) y
          (e m) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ((G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv m (christoffel G k i j) y
          + christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y) := by
      intro m
      rw [hHas.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, partialDeriv]
    have hpb : ∀ m : Fin 3,
        |fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z) y
          (e m)| ≤ 9 * (b * (Kg * v) + 81 / 2 * b ^ 3 * C ^ 2 * v) := by
      intro m
      rw [hpart m]
      apply hsum9
      intro i j
      have t1 : |(G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv m (christoffel G k i j) y| ≤ b * (Kg * v) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hPb i j) (hdΓ m k i j) (abs_nonneg _) hb0
      have t2 : |christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y|
          ≤ 81 / 2 * b ^ 3 * C ^ 2 * v := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        calc _ ≤ (9 / 2 * b * (C * u)) * p :=
              mul_le_mul (hΓ k i j) (hdP m i j) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = 81 / 2 * b ^ 3 * C ^ 2 * (u * u) := by rw [hpdef]; ring
          _ ≤ 81 / 2 * b ^ 3 * C ^ 2 * v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huu (by positivity)
      exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add t1 t2)
    calc ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z) y‖
        ≤ ∑ m : Fin 3, |fderiv ℝ
            (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z) y (e m)| :=
          hnorm _
      _ ≤ ∑ m : Fin 3, 9 * (b * (Kg * v) + 81 / 2 * b ^ 3 * C ^ 2 * v) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => hpb m
      _ = Kd * v := by rw [hKddef]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
      _ ≤ (Ke + Kp + Kv + Kd) * v := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hv0

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ (U : Set M) (ρ : ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ IsConnected U ∧ 2 ≤ ρ ∧
      (∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ U) ∧
      IsCompact (closure U \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ∧
      HasMinimalFrontier g U ∧ CircleLiftable U

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ (U : Set M) (ρ : ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ IsConnected U ∧ 2 ≤ ρ ∧
      (∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ U) ∧
      IsCompact (closure U \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ∧
      HasMinimalFrontier g U ∧ CircleLiftable U

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  have hpd : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (h : E3 → ℝ),
      partialDeriv i (fun z => -h z) = fun z => -partialDeriv i h z := by
    intro i h
    funext z
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [show (fun z => -h z) = -h from rfl, fderiv_neg]
    rfl
  have hhess : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) (y : E3),
      hessLoc G (fun z => -h z) i j y = -hessLoc G h i j y := by
    intro G h i j y
    simp only [hessLoc, hpd]
    simp only [mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    ring
  have hlap : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      lapLoc G (fun z => -h z) y = -lapLoc G h y := by
    intro G h y
    simp only [lapLoc, hhess, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  have hneg_lmc : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (p : M),
      g.levelMeanCurv (fun x => -f x) p = -g.levelMeanCurv f p := by
    intro f p
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.levelMeanCurv, RiemannianMetric3.gradInner]
    rw [hlap (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))]
    simp only [hpd, hhess, neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    ring
  
  
  have s1 : ∀ U : Set M, IsOpen U → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U) →
      HasMinimalFrontier g U := by
    intro U hU hS p hp O hO
    obtain ⟨V, f, hVO, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hVS, hH, hP, hN⟩ := hS.2 p hp O hO
    have hfr : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ frontier U ↔ f x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      constructor
      · intro h
        have h' : x ∈ V ∩ frontier U := ⟨hx, h⟩
        rw [hVS] at h'
        exact h'.2
      · intro h
        have h' : x ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hx, h⟩
        rw [← hVS] at h'
        exact h'.2
    have hfrU : ∀ x, x ∈ frontier U → x ∉ U := by
      intro x h
      rw [hU.frontier_eq] at h
      exact h.2
    have hsplit : ∀ A : Set M, A ⊆ V → (∀ x ∈ A, f x ≠ 0) → IsPreconnected A →
        A ⊆ U ∨ A ⊆ (closure U)ᶜ := by
      intro A hAV hA0 hAc
      refine hAc.subset_or_subset hU isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl ?_ ?_
      · exact Disjoint.mono_left subset_closure disjoint_compl_right
      · intro x hx
        by_cases hxU : x ∈ U
        · exact Or.inl hxU
        · right
          intro hxc
          have hxf : x ∈ frontier U := by
            rw [hU.frontier_eq]
            exact ⟨hxc, hxU⟩
          exact hA0 x hx ((hfr x (hAV hx)).1 hxf)
    have hpos := hsplit (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) Set.inter_subset_left
      (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx.2) hP
    have hneg := hsplit (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) Set.inter_subset_left
      (fun x hx => ne_of_lt hx.2) hN
    have hVU : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ U → f x ≠ 0 :=
      fun x hx hxU h0 => hfrU x ((hfr x hx).2 h0) hxU
    have hpcl : p ∈ closure U := frontier_subset_closure hp
    obtain ⟨x0, hx0V, hx0U⟩ : (V ∩ U).Nonempty := mem_closure_iff.1 hpcl V hVo hpV
    rcases hpos with hpos | hpos
    · refine ⟨V, f, hVO, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hVS, hH, hP, hN, ?_⟩
      rcases hneg with hneg | hneg
      · right
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hxV, hxU⟩
          exact ⟨hxV, hVU x hxV hxU⟩
        · rintro ⟨hxV, hx0⟩
          refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx0 with h | h
          · exact hneg ⟨hxV, h⟩
          · exact hpos ⟨hxV, h⟩
      · left
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hxV, hxU⟩
          refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hVU x hxV hxU) with h | h
          · exact absurd (subset_closure hxU) (hneg ⟨hxV, h⟩)
          · exact h
        · rintro ⟨hxV, h⟩
          exact ⟨hxV, hpos ⟨hxV, h⟩⟩
    · rcases hneg with hneg | hneg
      · refine ⟨V, fun x => -f x, hVO, hVo, hpV, hf.neg, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro x hx
          rw [show (fun x => -f x) = -f from rfl, mfderiv_neg]
          exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (hdf x hx)
        · rw [hVS]
          ext x
          simp
        · intro x hx h0
          rw [hneg_lmc]
          have h0' : f x = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp h0
          rw [hH x hx h0', neg_zero]
        · have e1 : V ∩ {x | 0 < -f x} = V ∩ {x | f x < 0} := by
            ext x
            simp
          rw [e1]
          exact hN
        · have e1 : V ∩ {x | -f x < 0} = V ∩ {x | 0 < f x} := by
            ext x
            simp
          rw [e1]
          exact hP
        · left
          ext x
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hxV, hxU⟩
            refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
            show 0 < -f x
            rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hVU x hxV hxU) with h | h
            · linarith
            · exact absurd (subset_closure hxU) (hpos ⟨hxV, h⟩)
          · rintro ⟨hxV, h⟩
            have h' : f x < 0 := by
              have : 0 < -f x := h
              linarith
            exact ⟨hxV, hneg ⟨hxV, h'⟩⟩
      · exfalso
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hVU x0 hx0V hx0U) with h | h
        · exact hneg ⟨hx0V, h⟩ (subset_closure hx0U)
        · exact hpos ⟨hx0V, h⟩ (subset_closure hx0U)
  
  
  have s3 : ∀ (Φ : EndChart M) (r : ℝ), 1 ≤ r →
      IsConnected (Φ.Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖}) ∧ IsOpen (Φ.Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖}) := by
    intro Φ r hr
    have hsub : {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} ⊆ Φ.Φ.source := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Φ.source_eq]
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
      have : r < ‖y‖ := hy
      linarith
    have hopen : IsOpen {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (Φ.Φ : E3 → M) Φ.Φ.source := Φ.Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
    have himgo : IsOpen (Φ.Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖}) :=
      Φ.Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source hopen hsub
    refine ⟨?_, himgo⟩
    have hA : IsConnected {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} := by
      have hrank : 1 < Module.rank ℝ E3 := by
        rw [← Module.finrank_eq_rank, finrank_euclideanSpace]
        simp
      have hS := isConnected_sphere hrank (0 : E3) (zero_le_one' ℝ)
      have hP := (isConnected_Ioi (a := r)).prod hS
      have himg : (fun q : ℝ × E3 => q.1 • q.2) '' (Set.Ioi r ×ˢ sphere (0 : E3) 1) =
          {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨t, θ⟩, ⟨ht, hθ⟩, rfl⟩
          have ht' : r < t := ht
          have hθ' : ‖θ‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.1 hθ
          show r < ‖t • θ‖
          rw [norm_smul, hθ', Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith), mul_one]
          exact ht'
        · intro hy
          have hy' : r < ‖y‖ := hy
          have hpos : 0 < ‖y‖ := by linarith
          refine ⟨(‖y‖, ‖y‖⁻¹ • y), ⟨hy', ?_⟩, ?_⟩
          · rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm,
              inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne']
          · show ‖y‖ • (‖y‖⁻¹ • y) = y
            rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hpos.ne', one_smul]
      rw [← himg]
      exact hP.image _ (continuous_fst.smul continuous_snd).continuousOn
    exact hA.image _ (hcont.mono hsub)
  
  
  have s4 : ∀ r : ℝ, 2 ≤ r → IsCompact (⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖})ᶜ := by
    intro r hr
    have hclosed : IsClosed (⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖})ᶜ := by
      rw [isClosed_compl_iff]
      exact isOpen_iUnion (fun l => (s3 (hAF.ends l) r (by linarith)).2)
    have hK : IsCompact ((⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | 2 < ‖y‖})ᶜ ∪
        ⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ r}) := by
      refine hAF.isCompact_core.union (isCompact_iUnion fun l => ?_)
      have hc : IsCompact {y : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ r} := by
        refine (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) r).of_isClosed_subset ?_ ?_
        · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
            (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)
        · intro y hy
          rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
          exact hy.2
      have hsub : {y : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ r} ⊆ (hAF.ends l).Φ.source := by
        intro y hy
        rw [(hAF.ends l).source_eq]
        show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
        linarith [hy.1]
      have hcont : ContinuousOn ((hAF.ends l).Φ : E3 → M) (hAF.ends l).Φ.source :=
        (hAF.ends l).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
      exact hc.image_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hsub)
    refine hK.of_isClosed_subset hclosed ?_
    intro x hx
    by_cases h2 : x ∈ ⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | 2 < ‖y‖}
    · right
      obtain ⟨l, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 h2
      have hy' : (2 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := hy
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨l, y, ⟨le_of_lt hy', ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact hx (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨l, y, hc, rfl⟩)
    · left
      exact h2
  
  
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, havoid⟩ := minimal_sets_avoid_far g hAF
  haveI : LocallyConnectedSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyConnectedSpace E3 M
  have hZc : IsClosed (⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖})ᶜ := by
    rw [isClosed_compl_iff]
    exact isOpen_iUnion (fun l => (s3 (hAF.ends l) r₀ (by linarith)).2)
  have hST : ∀ S : Set M, IsCompact S → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S → S ⊆ trappedSet g :=
    fun S hSc hSm x hx => subset_closure (Set.mem_sUnion.2 ⟨S, ⟨hSc, hSm⟩, hx⟩)
  have hTZ : trappedSet g ⊆ (⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖})ᶜ := by
    refine closure_minimal ?_ hZc
    rintro x ⟨S, ⟨hSc, hSm⟩, hxS⟩ hx
    obtain ⟨l, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
    exact havoid S hSc hSm l y hy hxS
  have hfarT : ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), r₀ < ‖y‖ →
      (hAF.ends l).Φ y ∉ trappedSet g := by
    intro l y hy hT
    exact hTZ hT (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨l, y, hy, rfl⟩)
  have hnorm_e : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ‖t • e 0‖ = t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht]
  have hy₀n : ‖(r₀ + 1) • e 0‖ = r₀ + 1 := hnorm_e _ (by linarith)
  have hx₀ : (hAF.ends k).Φ ((r₀ + 1) • e 0) ∈ (trappedSet g)ᶜ :=
    hfarT k _ (by rw [hy₀n]; linarith)
  have hUo : IsOpen (connectedComponentIn (trappedSet g)ᶜ ((hAF.ends k).Φ ((r₀ + 1) • e 0))) :=
    isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl.connectedComponentIn
  have hUc : IsConnected
      (connectedComponentIn (trappedSet g)ᶜ ((hAF.ends k).Φ ((r₀ + 1) • e 0))) :=
    isConnected_connectedComponentIn_iff.2 hx₀
  have hfront := trapped_outer_boundary_minimal g hComplete hAF k r₀ hr₀ havoid
  set U := connectedComponentIn (trappedSet g)ᶜ ((hAF.ends k).Φ ((r₀ + 1) • e 0)) with hUdef
  have hUT : U ⊆ (trappedSet g)ᶜ := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _
  have hfarU : (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖} ⊆ U := by
    refine (s3 (hAF.ends k) r₀ (by linarith)).1.isPreconnected.subset_connectedComponentIn
      ⟨(r₀ + 1) • e 0, ?_, rfl⟩ ?_
    · show r₀ < ‖(r₀ + 1) • e 0‖
      rw [hy₀n]
      linarith
    · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact hfarT k y hy
  have hfar : ∀ y : E3, r₀ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ U := fun y hy => hfarU ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  have hdisj : ∀ l : Fin hAF.numEnds, l ≠ k →
      Disjoint U ((hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖}) := by
    intro l hlk
    rw [Set.disjoint_iff]
    rintro z ⟨hzU, hzl⟩
    obtain ⟨S, R, hSc, hSm, hsep⟩ :=
      minimal_set_separates_ends g hComplete hAF k l (Ne.symm hlk)
    have hC : IsPreconnected (U ∪ (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖}) :=
      IsPreconnected.union z hzU hzl hUc.isPreconnected
        (s3 (hAF.ends l) r₀ (by linarith)).1.isPreconnected
    have hCd : Disjoint (U ∪ (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖}) S := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_iff]
      rintro x ⟨hxC, hxS⟩
      rcases hxC with hxU | ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      · exact hUT hxU (hST S hSc hSm hxS)
      · exact hfarT l y hy (hST S hSc hSm hxS)
    have htpos : 0 < max R r₀ + 1 := by linarith [le_max_right R r₀]
    have hte := hnorm_e (max R r₀ + 1) htpos
    have h1 : R < ‖(max R r₀ + 1) • e 0‖ := by rw [hte]; linarith [le_max_left R r₀]
    have h2 : r₀ < ‖(max R r₀ + 1) • e 0‖ := by rw [hte]; linarith [le_max_right R r₀]
    exact hsep _ hC hCd
      ⟨⟨(hAF.ends k).Φ ((max R r₀ + 1) • e 0), Or.inl (hfar _ h2), _, h1, rfl⟩,
        ⟨(hAF.ends l).Φ ((max R r₀ + 1) • e 0), Or.inr ⟨_, h2, rfl⟩, _, h1, rfl⟩⟩
  have hcpt : IsCompact (closure U \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖}) := by
    refine (s4 r₀ hr₀).of_isClosed_subset
      (isClosed_closure.sdiff (s3 (hAF.ends k) r₀ (by linarith)).2) ?_
    rintro x ⟨hxc, hxk⟩ hx
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
    by_cases hlk : l = k
    · rw [hlk] at hl
      exact hxk hl
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.1
        ((hdisj l hlk).symm.closure_right (s3 (hAF.ends l) r₀ (by linarith)).2) hl hxc
  have hHMF : HasMinimalFrontier g U := s1 U hUo hfront
  have hnone : ∀ S : Set M, IsCompact S → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S → S ⊆ U → S = ∅ := by
    intro S hSc hSm hSU
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    intro hx
    exact hUT (hSU hx) (hST S hSc hSm hx)
  
  obtain ⟨N, hNo, hNf, hNl⟩ := frontier_collar_liftable g hComplete hAF hR k U r₀ hUo hUc hr₀
    hfar hcpt hfront hnone
  have hlift : CircleLiftable U := circleLiftable_of_collar_liftable g hComplete hAF k U r₀
    hUo hUc hr₀ hfar hcpt hfront hnone N hNo hNf hNl
  exact ⟨U, r₀, hUo, hUc, hr₀, hfar, hcpt, hHMF, hlift⟩

def IsMinimalSurfaceSet (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (S : Set M) : Prop :=
  IsClosed S ∧ ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 p, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), V ⊆ O ∧ IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
    V ∩ S = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv f x = 0) ∧
    IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∧ IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | f x < 0})


def trappedSet (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) : Set M :=
  closure (⋃₀ {S : Set M | IsCompact S ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S})

by
  obtain ⟨T⟩ := flip_cover_top_exists g U hUo hfront
  
  have hM : ∀ x x' : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((chartAt E3 x).symm ≫ₕ chartAt E3 x')
      ((chartAt E3 x).symm ≫ₕ chartAt E3 x').source := by
    intro x x'
    have h := contDiffOn_ext_coord_change (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞) x' x
    have hs : ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm ≫ extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x').source =
        ((chartAt E3 x).symm ≫ₕ chartAt E3 x').source := by
      ext u
      simp [PartialEquiv.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, extChartAt_target,
        extChartAt_source, extChartAt_coe_symm]
    rw [hs] at h
    refine h.congr ?_
    intro u _
    simp [extChartAt_coe, extChartAt_coe_symm]
  obtain ⟨F⟩ : Nonempty (FlipCover g U) := by
    choose e he hpe using T.covering.isLocalHomeomorph
    letI cs : ChartedSpace E3 T.carrier :=
      { atlas := Set.range (fun z => (e z).trans (chartAt E3 (T.proj z)))
        chartAt := fun z => (e z).trans (chartAt E3 (T.proj z))
        mem_chart_source := fun z => by
          rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source]
          refine ⟨he z, ?_⟩
          show e z z ∈ (chartAt E3 (T.proj z)).source
          rw [← hpe z]
          exact mem_chart_source E3 (T.proj z)
        chart_mem_atlas := fun z => ⟨z, rfl⟩ }
    have hsrc : ∀ z w : T.carrier, w ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source →
        T.proj w ∈ (chartAt E3 (T.proj z)).source := by
      intro z w hw
      have hw' : w ∈ ((e z).trans (chartAt E3 (T.proj z))).source := hw
      rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source] at hw'
      have h2 := hw'.2
      rw [Set.mem_preimage, ← hpe z] at h2
      exact h2
    have heq : ∀ z w : T.carrier, w ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source →
        chartAt E3 z w = chartAt E3 (T.proj z) (T.proj w) := by
      intro z w _
      show ((e z).trans (chartAt E3 (T.proj z))) w = _
      rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_apply, ← hpe z]
    haveI : IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ T.carrier := by
      apply isManifold_of_contDiffOn
      intro A B hA hB
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hA
      obtain ⟨z', rfl⟩ := hB
      simp only [modelWithCornersSelf_coe, modelWithCornersSelf_coe_symm, Function.id_comp,
        Function.comp_id, Set.preimage_id, Set.range_id, Set.inter_univ]
      have key : ∀ v ∈ (e z).target, e z' ((e z).symm v) = v := by
        intro v hv

      refine ContDiffOn.congr ((hM (T.proj z) (T.proj z')).mono ?_) ?_

        simp only [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source,

          OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_trans, OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_trans_symm,
          Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Function.comp_apply] at hu ⊢
        obtain ⟨⟨hu1, hu2⟩, _, hu4⟩ := hu
        rw [key _ hu2] at hu4
        exact ⟨hu1, hu4⟩
      · intro u hu
        simp only [OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source, OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source,
          OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_target, OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_symm_eq_symm_trans_symm,
          Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, OpenPartialHomeomorph.coe_trans_symm,

             covering := T.covering
             label_locConst := T.label_locConst

      F.proj ((chartAt E3 z).symm u) = (chartAt E3 (F.proj z)).symm u := by
    intro z u hu

  have htgt : ∀ z : F.carrier, ∀ u ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target,

    rw [h1]

  have hwr : ∀ z : F.carrier, writtenInExtChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) z F.proj

    fun z => hπs.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  have hmid : ∀ z : F.carrier,

    intro z
    rw [(hmd z).mfderiv, ModelWithCorners.range_eq_univ, fderivWithin_univ, (hwr z).fderiv_eq,
      fderiv_id]
  have hmf : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (z : F.carrier), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →

    intro f z hf

    intro x₀ i j

    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨hP, hD⟩ := hpull (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 (F.proj x₀)).symm u
      (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hu)
      (by
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 x₀).open_target.mem_nhds hu] with u' hu'
        exact hloc x₀ u' hu')
    simp only [coeffMatrix]
    rw [hP, hD]
    rfl
  have hcoeff : ∀ (ψ : E3 → F.carrier) (φ : E3 → M) (y : E3),
      MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y → (F.proj ∘ ψ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] φ) →
        g'.coeff ψ y = g.coeff φ y := by
    intro ψ φ y hψ hev
    obtain ⟨hP, hD⟩ := hpull ψ φ y hψ hev
    funext i j
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, hg']
    rw [hP, hD]
    rfl
  
  have hgerm : ∀ (G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (O : Set E3), IsOpen O →
      (∀ u ∈ O, G₁ u = G₂ u) → ∀ y ∈ O,
        scalarCurvatureLocal G₁ y = scalarCurvatureLocal G₂ y ∧
        ∀ φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ, (∀ u ∈ O, φ₁ u = φ₂ u) →
          lapLoc G₁ φ₁ y = lapLoc G₂ φ₂ y ∧
          (∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G₁ φ₁ i j y = hessLoc G₂ φ₂ i j y) ∧
          (∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a φ₁ y = partialDeriv a φ₂ y) := by
    intro G₁ G₂ O hO hG y hy
    have hpd : ∀ (φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ), (∀ u ∈ O, φ₁ u = φ₂ u) →
        ∀ u ∈ O, ∀ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c φ₁ u = partialDeriv c φ₂ u := by
      intro φ₁ φ₂ h u hu c
      have hev : φ₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 u] φ₂ := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hu) h
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hpdG : ∀ u ∈ O, ∀ a b c : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv c (fun z => G₁ z a b) u = partialDeriv c (fun z => G₂ z a b) u :=
      fun u hu a b c => hpd _ _ (fun v hv => by rw [hG v hv]) u hu c
    have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ∀ u ∈ O, christoffel G₁ k i j u = christoffel G₂ k i j u := by
      intro k i j u hu
      simp only [christoffel, hG u hu, hpdG u hu]
    have hchry : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, christoffel G₁ k i j y = christoffel G₂ k i j y :=
      fun k i j => hchr k i j y hy
    have hchrd : ∀ k i j c : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv c (christoffel G₁ k i j) y = partialDeriv c (christoffel G₂ k i j) y :=
      fun k i j c => hpd _ _ (hchr k i j) y hy c
    have hGy : G₁ y = G₂ y := hG y hy
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [scalarCurvatureLocal, ricci, hGy, hchrd, hchry]
    · intro φ₁ φ₂ hφ
      have h1 : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a φ₁ y = partialDeriv a φ₂ y :=
        fun a => hpd _ _ hφ y hy a
      have h2 : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b φ₁) y = partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b φ₂) y :=
        fun a b => hpd _ _ (fun u hu => hpd _ _ hφ u hu b) y hy a
      have h3 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G₁ φ₁ i j y = hessLoc G₂ φ₂ i j y := by
        intro i j
        simp only [hessLoc, h1, h2, hchry]
      refine ⟨?_, h3, h1⟩
      simp only [lapLoc, h3, hGy]
  have hG : ∀ z : F.carrier, ∀ u ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target,
      g'.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm u = g.coeff (chartAt E3 (F.proj z)).symm u := by
    intro z u hu
    apply hcoeff
    · exact mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 z) hu
    · filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 z).open_target.mem_nhds hu] with u' hu'
      exact hloc z u' hu'
  have hy : ∀ z : F.carrier, chartAt E3 z z = chartAt E3 (F.proj z) (F.proj z) :=
    fun z => F.chart_eq z z (mem_chart_source E3 z)
  have hscal : ∀ z : F.carrier, g'.scalarCurvature z = g.scalarCurvature (F.proj z) := by
    intro z
    have h := (hgerm _ _ _ (chartAt E3 z).open_target (hG z) _ (mem_chart_target E3 z)).1
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.scalarCurvature]
    rw [h, hy z]
  have hlmc : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (z : F.carrier),
      g'.levelMeanCurv (f ∘ F.proj) z = g.levelMeanCurv f (F.proj z) := by
    intro f z
    have hφ : ∀ u ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target,
        (fun y => (f ∘ F.proj) ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) u =
          (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (F.proj z)).symm y)) u := by
      intro u hu
      simp only [Function.comp, hloc z u hu]
    obtain ⟨_, hrest⟩ :=
      hgerm _ _ _ (chartAt E3 z).open_target (hG z) _ (mem_chart_target E3 z)
    obtain ⟨hlap, hhess, hpa⟩ := hrest _ _ hφ
    have hGy := hG z _ (mem_chart_target E3 z)
    rw [hy z] at hlap hhess hpa hGy
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.levelMeanCurv, RiemannianMetric3.gradInner]
    rw [hy z]
    simp only [hlap, hhess, hpa, hGy]
  have hfin : ∀ x : M, (F.proj ⁻¹' {x}).Finite := by
    intro x
    refine Set.Finite.of_injOn (f := F.label) (t := Set.univ)
      (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) ?_ Set.finite_univ
    intro a ha b hb hab
    apply F.bij.1
    have ha' : F.proj a = x := ha
    have hb' : F.proj b = x := hb
    show (F.proj a, F.label a) = (F.proj b, F.label b)
    rw [ha', hb', hab]
  haveI : LocallyCompactSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyCompactSpace E3 M
  
  have hlocC : ∀ y : M, ∃ C : Set M, IsCompact C ∧ y ∈ interior C ∧
      IsCompact (F.proj ⁻¹' C) := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨_, V, hyV, hVo, _, H, hH⟩ := F.covering y
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hyC, hCV⟩ := exists_compact_subset hVo hyV
    haveI : Finite (F.proj ⁻¹' {y}) := (hfin y).to_subtype
    refine ⟨C, hC, hyC, ?_⟩
    have hC' : IsCompact ((Subtype.val : V → M) ⁻¹' C) := by
      rw [Subtype.isCompact_iff, Subtype.image_preimage_coe, Set.inter_eq_right.mpr hCV]
      exact hC
    have hK2 : IsCompact ((Subtype.val ∘ H.symm) ''
        (((Subtype.val : V → M) ⁻¹' C) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (F.proj ⁻¹' {y})))) :=
      (hC'.prod isCompact_univ).image (continuous_subtype_val.comp H.symm.continuous)
    refine hK2.of_isClosed_subset (hC.isClosed.preimage hcont) ?_
    intro x hx
    have hxV : F.proj x ∈ V := hCV hx
    refine ⟨H ⟨x, hxV⟩, ⟨?_, Set.mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
    · show ((H ⟨x, hxV⟩).1 : M) ∈ C
      rw [hH]
      exact hx
    · simp
  have hprop : ∀ K : Set M, IsCompact K → IsCompact (F.proj ⁻¹' K) := by
    intro K hK
    choose C _ hyC hCp using hlocC
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover (fun y => interior (C y))
      (fun _ => isOpen_interior) (fun y _ => Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨y, hyC y⟩)
    refine (t.isCompact_biUnion (fun y _ => hCp y)).of_isClosed_subset
      (hK.isClosed.preimage hcont) ?_
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy', hxy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (ht hx)
    exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨y, hy', (interior_subset hxy : F.proj x ∈ C y)⟩
  obtain ⟨af, k', hq, hlift, hcoeffk⟩ :=
    flip_cover_asymptotically_flat g hAF k U F g' hπs hcoeff hscal hprop
  obtain ⟨W, hWo, hWc, hWfar, hWcpt, hWmin, hWh⟩ :=
    flip_region_props g hAF k U ρ hUo hUc hfar hcpt hfront F g' hπs hmf hlmc hprop
      (af.ends k') hlift hρ
  have hscal' : ∀ z : F.carrier, 0 ≤ g'.scalarCurvature z := by
    intro z
    rw [hscal z]
    exact hR (F.proj z)
  exact ⟨RegionCover.mk F.carrier g' af k' hq hcoeffk hscal' W ρ hWo hWc hρ hWfar hWcpt hWmin
    hWh⟩

structure FlipCoverTop.{uX} {N : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 N) (U : Set N) where
  carrier : Type uX
  [instTop : TopologicalSpace carrier]
  [instT2 : T2Space carrier]
  proj : carrier → N
  label : carrier → Bool
  bij : Function.Bijective (fun z : carrier => (proj z, label z))
  covering : IsCoveringMap proj
  label_locConst : ∀ z : carrier, proj z ∈ U → ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, label w = label z
  label_flip : ∀ (V' : Set carrier) (f : N → ℝ) (p : N) (a b : carrier),
    IsOpen V' → Set.InjOn proj V' → p ∈ frontier U →
    IsMinimalFrontierChart g U (proj '' V') f p →
    (proj '' V') ∩ U = (proj '' V') ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0} →
    a ∈ V' → b ∈ V' → 0 < f (proj a) → f (proj b) < 0 → label a ≠ label b

    have hb : ∀ p ∈ frontier W, ∃ ψ : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ ∧

              + partialDeriv i (fun y => φ m ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) *
                (cc m * ν j)
              + cc m * ν i *
                partialDeriv j (fun y => φ m ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p)) := by

        simp only [hessLoc]
        rw [hBc2 i j, hL3b i j]
        simp only [hgradB, hS i j Λ]
        rw [hΛdef, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
        simp only [hgradF m hm, hS i j (cc m), hpy]
        ring

          g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) j i := fun i j => g.symm _ _ _
      have hP : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ i j =
          (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ j i := by
        intro i j
        have hT : Matrix.transpose (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)) =
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) := by
          ext a b; exact hGs b a
        have h := congrArg (fun A => A j i)
          (Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)))
        simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, hT] at h
        exact h
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.levelMeanCurv, RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, lapLoc, hgradB]
      exact levelMeanCurv_alg_combination J (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ hP ν
        cc (fun m => φ m p)
        (fun m i => partialDeriv i (fun y => φ m ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p))
        (fun m i j => hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
          (fun y => f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) i j (chartAt E3 p p)) Λ
        (fun i j => hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
          i j (chartAt E3 p p))

        (fun m hm => by
          have h := hH m hm

            hgradF m hm] at h

  intro w t p₀ hw hp₀ hScpt hT

  have hwc : Continuous w := hw.continuous

  have hEc : IsClosed {p : M | 0 ≤ β p} := isClosed_le continuous_const hβc
  have hSL : connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀ ⊆

  have hp₀S : p₀ ∈ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀ :=
    mem_connectedComponentIn hp₀
  have hSpc : IsPreconnected (connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀) :=

  have hSE : ∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀, 0 ≤ β x :=

  have GOOD : ∀ p ∈ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀, ∀ U ∈ 𝓝 p,

      IsPreconnected (V ∩ {p : M | 0 < β p}) ∧

      IsConnected (V ∩ {p : M | 0 < β p} ∩ {x | w x < t}) ∧
      p ∈ closure (V ∩ {p : M | 0 < β p} ∩ {x | t < w x}) ∧
      p ∈ closure (V ∩ {p : M | 0 < β p} ∩ {x | w x < t}) := by

        level_chart w β hw hβs p (hT p hp) (hreg p) U hU
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := chart_level_sides w β p κ ε hε hpκ hκp htgt hwκ
        (Or.inr (hβκ hβp.symm))

  have hloc5 : ∀ p ∈ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀,

    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨V, hVo, hpV, -, hVL, -⟩ := GOOD p hp Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
    refine ⟨V, hVo.mem_nhds hpV, ?_⟩
    have h1 : V ∩ ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) ⊆
        connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p :=

  obtain ⟨O, hOo, hSO, hOc, hOL, δ, hδ, hδfr⟩ :=
    collar_nbhd (connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀) {p : M | 0 ≤ β p}

  have K1 : ∀ x ∈ O ∩ {p : M | 0 < β p}, w x = t →
      x ∈ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀ := fun x hx hwx =>
    hOL ⟨subset_closure hx.1, hΩE hx.2, hwx⟩
  
  obtain ⟨f, g, hf, hg, hfg₁, hfg₂⟩ :=
    circle_jump_functions {p : M | 0 < β p}
      (connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀) O w t δ hwc hOo hδ K1

    two_sides_of_jump {p : M | 0 < β p}
      (connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀) O w t f g hΩo hconn hScl hSpc

    obtain ⟨p, hpT, hpV⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcover hyK)
    have hle : ρ p ≤ ∑ p ∈ T, |ρ p| :=

  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀⟩ := hfarK
  
  have hΦcont : ContinuousOn Φ.Φ Φ.Φ.source := Φ.Φ.contMDiffOn.continuousOn
  have hsubR : ∀ r : ℝ, 1 ≤ r → {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} ⊆ Φ.Φ.source := by
    intro r hr y hy
    rw [Φ.source_eq]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hr (show r < ‖y‖ from hy)
  obtain ⟨R, hR0R, hReR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R₀ ≤ R ∧ Re ≤ R :=

  have hFo : IsOpen (Φ.Φ '' {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖}) := by

    have himg := hprod.image (fun q : E3 × ℝ => q.2 • q.1)

    convert himg using 1
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_prod, mem_sphere_iff_norm, sub_zero,

    · intro hy

      · rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hy0]

    · intro y hy

    have hFcl : Disjoint (Φ.Φ '' {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖}) (closure A') :=

  rcases hFAB with hFA | hFB

    (bv : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Ω : Set E3) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hconn : IsPreconnected Ω)

        A x i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j f z) x +
      ∑ k : Fin 3, bv x k * partialDeriv k f x)
    (x₁ : E3) (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ Ω) (hmax : ∀ x ∈ Ω, f x ≤ f x₁) :

proof.tactics:
by
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f Ω := hf.continuousOn
  
  have hloc : ∀ xb ∈ Ω, f xb = f x₁ → ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 xb, f z = f x₁ := by
    intro xb hxb hfxb
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hballε⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩ xb hxb
    have hr : 0 < ε / 2 := by linarith
    refine Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mpr ⟨ε / 2, hr, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    by_contra hne
    have hyb : dist y xb < ε / 2 := hy
    have hyΩ : y ∈ Ω := hballε (by
      show dist y xb < ε
      linarith)
    have hfy : f y < f x₁ := lt_of_le_of_ne (hmax y hyΩ) hne
    
    have hsub : Metric.closedBall y (ε / 2) ⊆ Ω := by
      intro x hx
      apply hballε
      have h1 : dist x y ≤ ε / 2 := hx
      show dist x xb < ε
      have := dist_triangle x y xb
      linarith
    set C := Metric.closedBall y (ε / 2) ∩ f ⁻¹' {f x₁} with hCdef
    have hCcl : IsClosed C :=
      (hfc.mono hsub).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed Metric.isClosed_closedBall isClosed_singleton
    have hCc : IsCompact C :=
      (isCompact_closedBall y (ε / 2)).of_isClosed_subset hCcl Set.inter_subset_left
    have hxbC : xb ∈ C := by
      refine ⟨?_, hfxb⟩
      show dist xb y ≤ ε / 2
      rw [dist_comm]; linarith
    obtain ⟨xs, hxsC, hxsmin⟩ := hCc.exists_isMinOn ⟨xb, hxbC⟩
      ((continuous_id.dist continuous_const).continuousOn (s := C) (f := fun x => dist x y))
    have hmin : ∀ x ∈ C, dist xs y ≤ dist x y := fun x hx => hxsmin hx
    set R := dist xs y with hRdef
    have hfxs : f xs = f x₁ := hxsC.2
    have hRle : R ≤ ε / 2 := hxsC.1
    have hRpos : 0 < R := by
      rcases (dist_nonneg : 0 ≤ dist xs y).lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        have hxy : xs = y := dist_eq_zero.mp h.symm
        rw [hxy] at hfxs
        exact hne hfxs
    have hcb : Metric.closedBall y R ⊆ Ω :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hRle).trans hsub
    have hlt : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y R, f x < f xs := by
      intro x hx
      have hxR : dist x y < R := hx
      have hxΩ : x ∈ Ω := hcb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx)
      rw [hfxs]
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne (hmax x hxΩ) ?_
      intro hfx
      have hxC : x ∈ C := ⟨show dist x y ≤ ε / 2 by linarith, hfx⟩
      have := hmin x hxC
      linarith
    have hhopf := euclid_hopf_lemma A bv Ω hΩ hA hb hpos f hf y xs R hRpos hcb rfl
      (fun x hx => hL x (hcb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx))) hlt
    have hxsΩ : xs ∈ Ω := hcb (Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr le_rfl)
    have hlm : IsLocalMax f xs :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hxsΩ) (fun x hx => by rw [hfxs]; exact hmax x hx)
    rw [hlm.fderiv_eq_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at hhopf
    exact lt_irrefl _ hhopf
  
  set u : Set E3 := {x | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f z = f x₁} with hudef
  have hu : IsOpen u := isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds
  have hv : IsOpen (Ω ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Iio (f x₁)) := hfc.isOpen_inter_preimage hΩ isOpen_Iio
  have hcover : Ω ⊆ u ∪ (Ω ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Iio (f x₁)) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases (hmax x hx).lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hx, h⟩
    · exact Or.inl (hloc x hx h)
  have hne : (Ω ∩ u).Nonempty := ⟨x₁, hx₁, hloc x₁ hx₁ rfl⟩
  have hsubu : Ω ⊆ u := hconn.subset_left_of_subset_union hu hv
    (Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun x hxu hxv => by
      have hxu' : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f z = f x₁ := hxu
      have h1 : f x = f x₁ := hxu'.self_of_nhds
      have h2 : f x < f x₁ := hxv.2
      linarith)) hcover hne
  intro x hx
  have hxu' : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f z = f x₁ := hsubu hx
  exact hxu'.self_of_nhds

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hpdU : ∀ (T : Set E3), IsOpen T → ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T → ∀ i,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) T := by
    intro T hT f hf i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) T := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hT (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hdetS : ∀ (T : Set E3) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => A y i j) T) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (A y).det) T := by
    intro T A hA
    simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    exact (((((((hA 0 0).mul (hA 1 1)).mul (hA 2 2)).sub (((hA 0 0).mul (hA 1 2)).mul (hA 2 1))).sub
      (((hA 0 1).mul (hA 1 0)).mul (hA 2 2))).add (((hA 0 1).mul (hA 1 2)).mul (hA 2 0))).add
      (((hA 0 2).mul (hA 1 0)).mul (hA 2 1))).sub (((hA 0 2).mul (hA 1 1)).mul (hA 2 0))
  
  have hinvS : ∀ (T : Set E3) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => A y i j) T) → (∀ y ∈ T, (A y).det ≠ 0) →
      ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (A y)⁻¹ i j) T := by
    intro T A hA hdet i j
    have hadj : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (A y).adjugate i j) T := by
      simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
      apply hdetS T (fun y => (A y).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1))
      intro a b
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_apply]
      by_cases h : a = j
      · simp only [h, if_true]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [h, if_false]
        exact hA a b
    have heq : (fun y => (A y)⁻¹ i j) = fun y => ((A y).det)⁻¹ * (A y).adjugate i j := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rw [heq]
    exact ((hdetS T A hA).inv hdet).mul hadj
  
  have hlapS : ∀ (T : Set E3), IsOpen T → ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) T) →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) T) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lapLocal G f) T := by
    intro T hT G f hG hGinv hf
    have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => christoffel G k i j y) T := by
      intro k i j
      unfold christoffel
      exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hGinv k l).mul

    have hf1 : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => partialDeriv j f z) T :=
      fun j => hpdU T hT f hf j
    have hf2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j f z) y) T :=
      fun i j => hpdU T hT _ (hf1 j) i
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => lapLocal G f y) T
    unfold lapLocal
    exact ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => (hGinv i j).mul
      ((hf2 i j).sub (ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hchr k i j).mul (hf1 k)))
  
  apply contMDiff_of_locally_contMDiffOn
  intro x₀
  refine ⟨(chartAt E3 x₀).source, (chartAt E3 x₀).open_source, mem_chart_source E3 x₀, ?_⟩
  have hT : IsOpen (chartAt E3 x₀).target := (chartAt E3 x₀).open_target
  have hG₀ : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y i j) (chartAt E3 x₀).target :=
    fun i j => g.smooth x₀ i j
  have hdet : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y).det ≠ 0 :=
    fun y hy => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g x₀ y hy).det_pos.ne'

  have hf₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x₀).target :=

  have hF := hlapS _ hT _ _ hG₀ hGinv hf₀
  have hcomp : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
      (lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm) (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm y)) ∘
        chartAt E3 x₀) (chartAt E3 x₀).source :=
    hF.contMDiffOn.comp contMDiffOn_chart (fun p hp => (chartAt E3 x₀).map_source hp)
  let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
    ⟨(chartAt E3 x₀).toPartialEquiv.symm, (chartAt E3 x₀).open_target,
      (chartAt E3 x₀).open_source, contMDiffOn_chart_symm, contMDiffOn_chart⟩
  refine hcomp.congr (fun p hp => ?_)

  have h2 : Φ (chartAt E3 x₀ p) = p := (chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv hp

    ((ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) → (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v) → ∀ a b : ℝ,
      g.lapM (fun q => a * u q + b * v q) p = a * g.lapM u p + b * g.lapM v p ∧
      g.gradInner (fun q => a * u q + b * v q) w p = a * g.gradInner u w p + b * g.gradInner v w p) ∧
    (∀ U : Set M, IsOpen U → p ∈ U → (∀ q ∈ U, u q = v q) →
      g.lapM u p = g.lapM v p ∧ g.gradInner u w p = g.gradInner v w p)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have P0 : ∀ (g₁ g₂ : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (a b : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ g₁ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g₂ z → ∀ k : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv k (fun x => a * g₁ x + b * g₂ x) z =
        a * partialDeriv k g₁ z + b * partialDeriv k g₂ z := by
    intro g₁ g₂ z a b h₁ h₂ k
    have h : fderiv ℝ (fun x => a * g₁ x + b * g₂ x) z = a • fderiv ℝ g₁ z + b • fderiv ℝ g₂ z :=
      ((h₁.hasFDerivAt.const_mul a).add (h₂.hasFDerivAt.const_mul b)).fderiv
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have Loc : ∀ (f₁ f₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] f₂ →
      (∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k f₁ y = partialDeriv k f₂ y) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₁) y = partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₂) y) := by
    intro f₁ f₂ y hfe
    refine ⟨fun j => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩
    · show fderiv ℝ f₁ y (e j) = fderiv ℝ f₂ y (e j)
      rw [hfe.fderiv_eq]
    · have hev : partialDeriv j f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] partialDeriv j f₂ := by
        filter_upwards [hfe.eventuallyEq_nhds] with z hz
        show fderiv ℝ f₁ z (e j) = fderiv ℝ f₂ z (e j)
        rw [hz.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f₁) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f₂) y (e i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hS : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
  have hy₀S : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := mem_chart_target E3 p
  have hdiff : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (chartAt E3 p).target →
      ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, DifferentiableAt ℝ F z :=
    fun F hF z hz => (hF.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hS.mem_nhds hz)
  have hpd : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (chartAt E3 p).target → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv j F) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    intro F hF j
    have hd := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hS).mp hF).2
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ F z (e j)) (chartAt E3 p).target
    exact hd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hsm : ∀ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    intro f hf
    have h1 := hf.comp_contMDiffOn (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := p))
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  
  have Lin : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f₁ f₂ : E3 → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f₁ (chartAt E3 p).target → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f₂ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      ∀ a b : ℝ,
      (∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => a * f₁ z + b * f₂ z) (chartAt E3 p p) =
        a * partialDeriv k f₁ (chartAt E3 p p) + b * partialDeriv k f₂ (chartAt E3 p p)) ∧
      lapLoc G (fun z => a * f₁ z + b * f₂ z) (chartAt E3 p p) =
        a * lapLoc G f₁ (chartAt E3 p p) + b * lapLoc G f₂ (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    intro G f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ a b
    have hfirst : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, ∀ k : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv k (fun x => a * f₁ x + b * f₂ x) z =
          a * partialDeriv k f₁ z + b * partialDeriv k f₂ z :=
      fun z hz k => P0 f₁ f₂ z a b (hdiff _ h₁ z hz) (hdiff _ h₂ z hz) k
    have hsecond : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun x => a * f₁ x + b * f₂ x)) (chartAt E3 p p) =
          a * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₁) (chartAt E3 p p) +
            b * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₂) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      intro i j
      have hev : partialDeriv j (fun x => a * f₁ x + b * f₂ x) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
          fun z => a * partialDeriv j f₁ z + b * partialDeriv j f₂ z := by
        filter_upwards [hS.mem_nhds hy₀S] with z hz
        exact hfirst z hz j
      have hre : partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun x => a * f₁ x + b * f₂ x)) (chartAt E3 p p) =
          partialDeriv i (fun z => a * partialDeriv j f₁ z + b * partialDeriv j f₂ z)
            (chartAt E3 p p) := by
        show fderiv ℝ _ (chartAt E3 p p) (e i) = fderiv ℝ _ (chartAt E3 p p) (e i)
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      rw [hre]
      exact P0 _ _ _ a b (hdiff _ (hpd _ h₁ j) _ hy₀S) (hdiff _ (hpd _ h₂ j) _ hy₀S) i
    have hfirst0 := hfirst _ hy₀S
    refine ⟨hfirst0, ?_⟩
    unfold lapLoc hessLoc
    simp only [hsecond, hfirst0]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  refine ⟨fun hu hv a b => ?_, fun U hU hp huv => ?_⟩
  · have h₁ := hsm u hu
    have h₂ := hsm v hv
    obtain ⟨hk, hl⟩ := Lin (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) _ _ h₁ h₂ a b
    constructor
    · exact hl
    · simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner]
      simp only [hk, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
  · have hφp : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p :=
      (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
    have hcont : ContinuousAt (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 p)
    have hUn : U ∈ 𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)) := by
      rw [hφp]; exact hU.mem_nhds hp
    have hev : (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
        (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hcont.preimage_mem_nhds hUn) (fun y hy => huv _ hy)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Loc _ _ _ hev
    constructor
    · simp only [RiemannianMetric3.lapM, lapLoc, hessLoc, h1, h2]
    · simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, h1]

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : Re + 1 < ρ) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hf0 : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | Re < ‖y‖} → f p = 0) :
    ∃ w : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} → g.lapM w p = f p) ∧
      (∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner w β p = 0) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ = ρ → w ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) = 0) ∧
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} →
        p ∉ connectedComponentIn ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
          ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0)) → w p = 0)

signature.name: neumann_dirichlet_solve
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : Re + 1 < ρ) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hf0 : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | Re < ‖y‖} → f p = 0) :
    ∃ w : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} → g.lapM w p = f p) ∧
      (∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner w β p = 0) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ = ρ → w ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) = 0) ∧
      (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} →
        p ∉ connectedComponentIn ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
          ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0)) → w p = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hβs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β := hβ.1
  have hβpos : ∀ y : E3, Re < ‖y‖ → 0 < β ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) := hβ.2.2.2.1
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := by have := hβ.2.2.1; linarith
  have hρ0 : ‖ρ • e 0‖ = ρ := by
    rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos hρpos]
  have hbdry : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | Re < ‖y‖} := by
    intro p hp hpF
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyp⟩ := hpF
    have h1 := hβpos y hy
    rw [hyp, hp] at h1
    exact lt_irrefl _ h1
  have hmono : ∀ p : M, p ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} →
      p ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | Re < ‖y‖} := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyp⟩ := hp
    have hy' : ρ < ‖y‖ := hy
    exact ⟨y, show Re < ‖y‖ by linarith, hyp⟩
  have hsubcl : ∀ p : M, p ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} →
      p ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyp⟩ := hp
    have hy' : ρ < ‖y‖ := hy
    exact ⟨y, le_of_lt hy', hyp⟩
  
  have hzero : ∀ (p : M) (w : M → ℝ),
      g.lapM (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) p = 0 ∧ g.gradInner (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) w p = 0 := by
    intro p w
    have h := (lapM_gradInner_linear_local g (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) w p).1
      contMDiff_const contMDiff_const 0 0
    simp only [zero_mul, add_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hvan : ∀ (u : M → ℝ) (U : Set M), IsOpen U → (∀ q ∈ U, u q = 0) → ∀ p ∈ U,
      ∀ w : M → ℝ, g.lapM u p = 0 ∧ g.gradInner u w p = 0 := by
    intro u U hU hu p hp w
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (lapM_gradInner_linear_local g u (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) w p).2 U hU hp hu
    exact ⟨h1.trans (hzero p w).1, h2.trans (hzero p w).2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨hCc, hOCc, hSC, hoff⟩ := nds_component_topology g hAF k β Re hβ ρ hρ
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := nds_atlas_exists g hAF k β Re hβ ρ hρ
  have hconn : IsPreconnected (connectedComponentIn
      ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0))) :=
    isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
  have hS : ∃ q ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ‖y‖ = ρ}, q ∈ connectedComponentIn
      ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0)) :=
    ⟨(hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0), ⟨ρ • e 0, hρ0, rfl⟩, hSC _ hρ0⟩
  
  have hcover : ∀ p ∈ connectedComponentIn
      ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0)),
      ∃ j, ∃ x ∈ Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j / 8), A.κ j x = p := by
    intro p hp
    have hsum := A.ψ_sum p hp
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hz : ∀ j, A.ψ j p = 0 := by
      intro j
      by_contra hne
      have hpt : p ∈ tsupport (A.ψ j) := subset_tsupport _ hne
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxp⟩ := (A.ψ_supp j).2 hpt
      exact hcon j x hx hxp
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => hz j)] at hsum
    exact zero_ne_one hsum
  have hball8 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j / 8), x ∈ Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j) := by
    intro j x hx
    have hr := A.r_pos j
    exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hx
  
  obtain ⟨u, v, Gr, hsol⟩ := nds_weak_solution g A hconn hS f hf
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hWlap, hWneu, hWdir⟩ := nds_weak_regularity g A f hf u v Gr hsol
  
  haveI : SigmaCompactSpace M := af_sigmaCompactSpace g hAF
  haveI : LocallyCompactSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyCompactSpace E3 M
  have hdisj : Disjoint (({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) \
      connectedComponentIn ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
        ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0)))
      (connectedComponentIn ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
        ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0))) := Set.disjoint_sdiff_left
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ0, hχ1, -⟩ := exists_smooth_zero_one_nhds_of_isClosed 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (n := ⊤)
    hOCc.isClosed hCc.isClosed hdisj
  obtain ⟨U0, hU0o, hU0s, hU0⟩ := eventually_nhdsSet_iff_exists.mp hχ0
  obtain ⟨U1, hU1o, hU1s, hU1⟩ := eventually_nhdsSet_iff_exists.mp hχ1
  have hχs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ χ := χ.contMDiff
  have hwW : ∀ q ∈ U1, χ q * W q = W q := by
    intro q hq
    rw [hU1 q hq, one_mul]
  have hw0 : ∀ q ∈ U0, χ q * W q = 0 := by
    intro q hq
    rw [hU0 q hq, zero_mul]
  
  have hπ1 : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv b (fun z : E3 => z 0) z = if b = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro b z
    show fderiv ℝ (⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) z (e b) = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    show (e b) 0 = _
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, eq_comm]
  refine ⟨fun p => χ p * W p, hχs.mul hW, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro p hp0 hpF
    have hpFρ : p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} := fun h => hpF (hsubcl p h)
    by_cases hpC : p ∈ connectedComponentIn
        ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0))
    · have heq : g.lapM (fun q => χ q * W q) p = g.lapM W p :=
        ((lapM_gradInner_linear_local g (fun q => χ q * W q) W β p).2 U1 hU1o (hU1s hpC)
          hwW).1
      rw [heq]
      obtain ⟨j, x, hx8, rfl⟩ := hcover p hpC
      have hx := hball8 j x hx8
      have hx0 : 0 ≤ x 0 := (A.dom j x hx).1 hpC
      have hxs : x ∈ (A.κ j).source := by rw [A.source_eq j]; exact hx
      have hinv := lapLocal_chart_invariant g (A.κ j) W Set.univ isOpen_univ
        hW.contMDiffOn x hxs trivial
      have e1 : lapLoc (g.coeff (A.κ j)) (fun z => W (A.κ j z)) x =
          lapLocal (g.coeff (A.κ j)) (W ∘ A.κ j) x := rfl
      have e2 : lapM g W (A.κ j x) = g.lapM W (A.κ j x) := rfl
      rw [← e2, ← hinv, ← e1, hWlap j x hx8 hx0]
    · have hpU : p ∈ U0 := hU0s ⟨⟨hp0, hpFρ⟩, hpC⟩
      rw [(hvan (fun q => χ q * W q) U0 hU0o hw0 p hpU β).1, hf0 p hp0 (hoff p hp0 hpFρ hpC)]
  · 
    intro p hp
    have hp0 : 0 ≤ β p := le_of_eq hp.symm
    have hpFρ : p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} := fun h => hbdry p hp (hmono p h)
    by_cases hpC : p ∈ connectedComponentIn
        ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0))
    · have heq : g.gradInner (fun q => χ q * W q) β p = g.gradInner W β p :=
        ((lapM_gradInner_linear_local g (fun q => χ q * W q) W β p).2 U1 hU1o (hU1s hpC)
          hwW).2
      rw [heq]
      obtain ⟨j, x, hx8, rfl⟩ := hcover p hpC
      have hx := hball8 j x hx8
      have hxs : x ∈ (A.κ j).source := by rw [A.source_eq j]; exact hx
      obtain ⟨hD, hx00⟩ := (A.bdry j x hx).1 hp
      have hc0 : A.c j 0 = 0 := by
        rcases A.center j with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          have hr := A.r_pos j
          have hd : dist x (A.c j) < A.r j / 8 := hx8
          have hcoord : |x 0 - A.c j 0| ≤ dist x (A.c j) := by
            rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq,
              Real.dist_eq]
            apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
            have h1 : 0 ≤ |x 1 - A.c j 1| ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
            have h2 : 0 ≤ |x 2 - A.c j 2| ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
            linarith
          rw [hx00, zero_sub, abs_neg] at hcoord
          have : A.c j 0 ≤ |A.c j 0| := le_abs_self _
          linarith
      have hev : (fun z => β (A.κ j z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z : E3 => z 0) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx] with z hz
        exact A.neu j hD hc0 z hz
      have hdβ : ∀ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv b (fun z => β (A.κ j z)) x =
          if b = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
        intro b
        rw [← hπ1 b x]
        show fderiv ℝ (fun z => β (A.κ j z)) x (e b) = fderiv ℝ (fun z : E3 => z 0) x (e b)
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      have hN := hWneu j hD x hx8 hx00
      rw [gradInner_pdiffeo_formula g (A.κ j) W β hW hβs x hxs]
      have hrw : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (A.κ j) x)⁻¹ i b *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => W (A.κ j z)) x * partialDeriv b (fun z => β (A.κ j z)) x =
          (g.coeff (A.κ j) x)⁻¹ i 0 * partialDeriv i (fun z => W (A.κ j z)) x := by
        intro i
        have h10 : ¬ ((1 : Fin 3) = 0) := by decide
        have h20 : ¬ ((2 : Fin 3) = 0) := by decide
        simp only [hdβ, Fin.sum_univ_three, if_true, h10, h20, if_false, mul_one, mul_zero,
          add_zero]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hrw i)]
      exact hN
    · have hpU : p ∈ U0 := hU0s ⟨⟨hp0, hpFρ⟩, hpC⟩
      exact (hvan (fun q => χ q * W q) U0 hU0o hw0 p hpU β).2
  · 
    intro y hy
    have hC := hSC y hy
    obtain ⟨j, x, hx8, hxp⟩ := hcover _ hC
    have hx := hball8 j x hx8
    obtain ⟨hD, hx00⟩ := (A.dir j x hx).1 ⟨y, hy, hxp.symm⟩
    show χ ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) * W ((hAF.ends k).Φ y) = 0
    rw [hwW _ (hU1s hC), ← hxp]
    exact hWdir j hD x hx8 hx00
  · 
    intro p hp0 hpF hpC

structure NdsAtlas (M : Type*) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace E3 M]
    (β : M → ℝ) (Ω₀ S₀ : Set M) where
  n : ℕ
  κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞
  c : Fin n → E3
  r : Fin n → ℝ
  D : Fin n → Prop
  ψ : Fin n → M → ℝ
  r_pos : ∀ j, 0 < r j
  source_eq : ∀ j, (κ j).source = Metric.ball (c j) (r j)
  center : ∀ j, c j 0 = 0 ∨ r j ≤ c j 0
  D_center : ∀ j, D j → c j 0 = 0
  dom : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (c j) (r j), κ j x ∈ Ω₀ ↔ 0 ≤ x 0
  dir : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (c j) (r j), κ j x ∈ S₀ ↔ (D j ∧ x 0 = 0)
  bdry : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (c j) (r j), β (κ j x) = 0 ↔ (¬ D j ∧ x 0 = 0)
  neu : ∀ j, ¬ D j → c j 0 = 0 → ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (c j) (r j), β (κ j x) = x 0
  ψ_smooth : ∀ j, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ j)
  ψ_nonneg : ∀ j x, 0 ≤ ψ j x
  ψ_supp : ∀ j, IsCompact (tsupport (ψ j)) ∧ tsupport (ψ j) ⊆ κ j '' Metric.ball (c j) (r j / 8)
  ψ_sum : ∀ q ∈ Ω₀, ∑ j, ψ j q = 1

def ndsHalf (c : E3) (r : ℝ) : Set E3 := Metric.ball c (r / 2) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}

def ndsWeakSol (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) {β : M → ℝ} {Ω₀ S₀ : Set M} (A : NdsAtlas M β Ω₀ S₀)
    (f : M → ℝ) (u : ℕ → M → ℝ) (v : Fin A.n → E3 → ℝ) (Gr : Fin A.n → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ m, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u m) ∧
    ∃ N : Set M, IsOpen N ∧ S₀ ⊆ N ∧ ∀ q ∈ N, u m q = 0) ∧
  ∀ j, MemLp (v j) 2 (volume.restrict (ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j))) ∧
    (∀ a, MemLp (Gr j a) 2 (volume.restrict (ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j)))) ∧
    Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j), (u m (A.κ j x) - v j x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
    (∀ a, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j),
      (partialDeriv a (fun z => u m (A.κ j z)) x - Gr j a x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧
    ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j / 2) →
      (A.D j → ∃ O : Set E3, IsOpen O ∧ {x ∈ Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j) | x 0 = 0} ⊆ O ∧
        ∀ x ∈ O, ζ x = 0) →
      ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j),
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det * (g.coeff (A.κ j) x)⁻¹ a b *
            Gr j b x * partialDeriv a ζ x +
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det * f (A.κ j x) * ζ x) = 0
