signature.name: weight_peetre_integrable
signature.statement:
(p q : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : 3 < p + q) (x : E3) :
    Integrable (fun y : E3 => (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hfin : ((Module.finrank ℝ E3 : ℕ) : ℝ) < p + q := by
    rw [finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin]
    exact_mod_cast hpq
  have hmaj : Integrable (fun y : E3 => (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-(p + q))) :=
    (integrable_one_add_norm (μ := (volume : Measure E3)) hfin).const_mul _
  have hcont : Continuous (fun y : E3 => (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q)) := by
    refine Continuous.mul ?_ ?_
    · exact (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).norm).rpow_const
        (fun y => Or.inl (by positivity))
    · exact (continuous_const.add continuous_norm).rpow_const
        (fun y => Or.inl (by positivity))
  refine hmaj.mono' hcont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + ‖x‖ := by positivity
  have hb : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + ‖y‖ := by positivity
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + ‖x - y‖ := by positivity
  have hpeetre : 1 + ‖y‖ ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) * (1 + ‖x - y‖) := by
    have h1 : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖y - x‖ := norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub' y x
    rw [norm_sub_rev y x] at h1
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖x - y‖ := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    nlinarith
  have hs2 : (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p) ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-p) := by
    have h1 : ((1 + ‖x‖) * (1 + ‖x - y‖)) ^ (-p) ≤ (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-p) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hb hpeetre (by linarith)
    rw [Real.mul_rpow ha.le hc.le] at h1
    have hap : 0 < (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos ha p
    have h2 : (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-p) = 1 := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg ha.le, mul_inv_cancel₀ hap.ne']
    calc (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p)
        = (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * ((1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p)) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, h2, one_mul]
      _ ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-p) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hap.le
  have hF0 : 0 ≤ (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q) :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hc.le _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hb.le _)
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hF0]
  calc (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q)
      ≤ ((1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-p)) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs2 (Real.rpow_nonneg hb.le _)
    _ = (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-(p + q)) := by
        rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add hb, neg_add]

informal_problem.statement:
(k f : E3 → ℝ) (p q M A : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : 3 < p + q)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hk : Differentiable ℝ k)
    (hk1 : ∀ z : E3, ‖fderiv ℝ k z‖ ≤ M * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-p))
    (hf : Continuous f) (hf0 : ∀ y : E3, |f y| ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q)) (x : E3) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun x' : E3 => ∫ y, (k (x' - y) - k (-y)) * f y)
        (∫ y, f y • fderiv ℝ k (x - y)) x ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun x' : E3 => ∫ y, (k (x' - y) - k (-y)) * f y) x =
        ∫ y, partialDeriv i k (x - y) * f y

signature.name: renorm_conv_hasFDerivAt
signature.statement:
(k f : E3 → ℝ) (p q M A : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : 3 < p + q)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hk : Differentiable ℝ k)
    (hk1 : ∀ z : E3, ‖fderiv ℝ k z‖ ≤ M * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-p))
    (hf : Continuous f) (hf0 : ∀ y : E3, |f y| ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q)) (x : E3) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun x' : E3 => ∫ y, (k (x' - y) - k (-y)) * f y)
        (∫ y, f y • fderiv ℝ k (x - y)) x ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun x' : E3 => ∫ y, (k (x' - y) - k (-y)) * f y) x =
        ∫ y, partialDeriv i k (x - y) * f y

proof.tactics:
by
  have hkc : Continuous k := hk.continuous
  
  have hshift : ∀ x' y : E3, ‖x' - x‖ ≤ 1 →
      (1 + ‖x' - y‖) ^ (-p) ≤ 2 ^ p * (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p) := by
    intro x' y hx'
    have h1 : ‖x - y‖ ≤ ‖x - x'‖ + ‖x' - y‖ := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub x x' y
    have h2 : ‖x - x'‖ ≤ 1 := by rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact hx'
    have ha : 0 < (1 + ‖x - y‖) / 2 := by positivity
    have hab : (1 + ‖x - y‖) / 2 ≤ 1 + ‖x' - y‖ := by
      have := norm_nonneg (x' - y); linarith
    calc (1 + ‖x' - y‖) ^ (-p) ≤ ((1 + ‖x - y‖) / 2) ^ (-p) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos ha hab (by linarith)
      _ = 2 ^ p * (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p) := by
          rw [Real.div_rpow (by positivity) (by norm_num),
            Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), div_inv_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  
  have hdiff : ∀ y : E3,
      |k (x - y) - k (-y)| ≤ M * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-p) * ‖x‖ := by
    intro y
    have hbd : ∀ w ∈ segment ℝ (-y) (x - y),
        ‖fderiv ℝ k w‖ ≤ M * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-p) := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩ := hw
      have hw' : a • (-y) + b • (x - y) = b • x - y := by
        calc a • (-y) + b • (x - y) = b • x - (a + b) • y := by
              simp only [smul_neg, smul_sub, add_smul]; abel
          _ = b • x - y := by rw [hab, one_smul]
      rw [hw']
      have hb1 : b ≤ 1 := by linarith
      have hny : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖b • x - y‖ := by
        have e : y = b • x - (b • x - y) := by abel
        calc ‖y‖ = ‖b • x - (b • x - y)‖ := by rw [← e]
          _ ≤ ‖b • x‖ + ‖b • x - y‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖b • x - y‖ := by
            rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hb]
            have := norm_nonneg x
            nlinarith
      have hX : 0 < 1 + ‖x‖ := by positivity
      have hY : 0 < 1 + ‖y‖ := by positivity
      have hYW : (1 + ‖y‖) / (1 + ‖x‖) ≤ 1 + ‖b • x - y‖ := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hX]
        have := norm_nonneg x
        have := norm_nonneg (b • x - y)
        nlinarith
      have h1 : (1 + ‖b • x - y‖) ^ (-p) ≤ ((1 + ‖y‖) / (1 + ‖x‖)) ^ (-p) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (div_pos hY hX) hYW (by linarith)
      have h2 : ((1 + ‖y‖) / (1 + ‖x‖)) ^ (-p) = (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-p) := by
        rw [Real.div_rpow hY.le hX.le, Real.rpow_neg hX.le, div_inv_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ k (b • x - y)‖ ≤ M * (1 + ‖b • x - y‖) ^ (-p) := hk1 _
        _ ≤ M * ((1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-p)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h1.trans h2.le) hM
        _ = M * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-p) := by ring
    have hmvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (fun z _ => hk z) hbd
      (convex_segment _ _) (left_mem_segment ℝ (-y) (x - y)) (right_mem_segment ℝ (-y) (x - y))
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have e : x - y - -y = x := by abel
    rw [e] at hmvt
    exact hmvt
  have I0 := weight_peetre_integrable p q hp hpq 0
  have Ix := weight_peetre_integrable p q hp hpq x
  have hFcont : ∀ x' : E3, Continuous (fun y : E3 => (k (x' - y) - k (-y)) * f y) := fun x' =>
    ((hkc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).sub (hkc.comp continuous_neg)).mul hf
  have hF'meas : ∀ x' : E3,
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y : E3 => f y • fderiv ℝ k (x' - y)) volume := by
    intro x'
    have hm : Measurable (fun y : E3 => fderiv ℝ k (x' - y)) :=
      (measurable_fderiv ℝ k).comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).measurable
    exact hf.aestronglyMeasurable.smul hm.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound : ∀ x' ∈ Metric.ball x 1, ∀ y : E3,
      ‖f y • fderiv ℝ k (x' - y)‖ ≤
        M * A * 2 ^ p * ((1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q)) := by
    intro x' hx' y
    have hx'1 : ‖x' - x‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hx'; exact hx'.le
    have H : ‖fderiv ℝ k (x' - y)‖ ≤ M * (2 ^ p * (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p)) :=
      (hk1 _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hshift x' y hx'1) hM)
    have hfy : 0 ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q) := mul_nonneg hA (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc |f y| * ‖fderiv ℝ k (x' - y)‖
        ≤ (A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q)) * (M * (2 ^ p * (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p))) :=
          mul_le_mul (hf0 y) H (norm_nonneg _) hfy
      _ = M * A * 2 ^ p * ((1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q)) := by ring
  have hderiv : ∀ x' y : E3, HasFDerivAt (fun x' : E3 => (k (x' - y) - k (-y)) * f y)
      (f y • fderiv ℝ k (x' - y)) x' := by
    intro x' y
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => k (z - y)) (fderiv ℝ k (x' - y)) x' := by
      have := (hk (x' - y)).hasFDerivAt.comp x' ((hasFDerivAt_id x').sub_const y)
      simpa using this
    exact (h1.sub_const (k (-y))).mul_const (f y)
  have hFint : Integrable (fun y : E3 => (k (x - y) - k (-y)) * f y) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (I0.const_mul (M * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * ‖x‖ * A))
      (hFcont x).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    have h1 := hdiff y
    calc |k (x - y) - k (-y)| * |f y|
        ≤ (M * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-p) * ‖x‖) * (A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q)) :=
          mul_le_mul h1 (hf0 y) (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans h1)
      _ = M * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ p * ‖x‖ * A * ((1 + ‖0 - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q)) := by
          rw [zero_sub, norm_neg]; ring
  have hmain := hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (μ := volume)
    (F := fun x' y => (k (x' - y) - k (-y)) * f y)
    (F' := fun x' y => f y • fderiv ℝ k (x' - y))
    (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x one_pos)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x' => (hFcont x').aestronglyMeasurable))
    hFint (hF'meas x)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y x' hx' => hbound x' hx' y))
    (Ix.const_mul (M * A * 2 ^ p))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y x' _ => hderiv x' y))
  refine ⟨hmain, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hF'int : Integrable (fun y : E3 => f y • fderiv ℝ k (x - y)) :=
    Integrable.mono' (Ix.const_mul (M * A * 2 ^ p)) (hF'meas x)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => hbound x (Metric.mem_ball_self one_pos) y))
  unfold partialDeriv
  rw [hmain.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hF'int]
  congr 1
  funext y
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

subgoal_signatures.name: weight_peetre_integrable
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(p q : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : 3 < p + q) (x : E3) :
    Integrable (fun y : E3 => (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-q))

informal_problem.statement:
(k f : E3 → ℝ) (a A M : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) (ha2 : a < 2)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hk : Continuous k)
    (hk0 : ∀ z : E3, |k z| ≤ M * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ))
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hf0 : ∀ y : E3, |f y| ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a))
    (hf1 : ∀ y : E3, ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a - 1))
    (hW : Differentiable ℝ (fun x : E3 => ∫ y, k (x - y) * f y)) (x : E3) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x : E3 => ∫ y, k (x - y) * f y) x‖ ≤
      8 * A * M * ∫ y, (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)

signature.name: conv_fderiv_lip_bound
signature.statement:
(k f : E3 → ℝ) (a A M : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) (ha2 : a < 2)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hk : Continuous k)
    (hk0 : ∀ z : E3, |k z| ≤ M * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ))
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hf0 : ∀ y : E3, |f y| ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a))
    (hf1 : ∀ y : E3, ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a - 1))
    (hW : Differentiable ℝ (fun x : E3 => ∫ y, k (x - y) * f y)) (x : E3) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x : E3 => ∫ y, k (x - y) * f y) x‖ ≤
      8 * A * M * ∫ y, (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hwt_nn : ∀ y : E3, 0 ≤ (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ) := fun y =>
    mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
  have hI : 0 ≤ ∫ y, (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ) := integral_nonneg hwt_nn
  have hC : 0 ≤ 8 * A * M * ∫ y, (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ) := by
    positivity
  
  have hweight : ∀ c w : E3, ‖w - c‖ ≤ 1 / 2 →
      (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (-a - 1) ≤ 8 * (1 + ‖c‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) := by
    intro c w hw
    have hu : 1 ≤ 1 + ‖w‖ := by linarith [norm_nonneg w]
    have hv : 0 < 1 + ‖c‖ := by linarith [norm_nonneg c]
    have hcw : ‖c‖ - ‖w‖ ≤ ‖c - w‖ := norm_sub_norm_le c w
    rw [norm_sub_rev] at hcw
    have hvu : 1 + ‖c‖ ≤ 2 * (1 + ‖w‖) := by linarith
    have e1 : (-a - 1 : ℝ) = -(a + 1) := by ring
    rw [e1]
    have h2 : (2 * (1 + ‖w‖)) ^ (-(a + 1)) ≤ (1 + ‖c‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hv hvu (by linarith)
    have h3 : (2 * (1 + ‖w‖)) ^ (-(a + 1)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(a + 1)) * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) :=
      Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have h4 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(a + 1)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num), add_neg_cancel, Real.rpow_zero]
    have h5 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) ≤ 8 := by
      have h6 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
      have h8 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℝ) = 8 := by
        rw [show (3 : ℝ) = ((3 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]
        norm_num
      linarith
    have hq : 0 ≤ (1 + ‖c‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hv.le _
    have h2p : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _
    calc (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) * (2 * (1 + ‖w‖)) ^ (-(a + 1)) := by
          rw [h3, ← mul_assoc, h4, one_mul]
      _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (a + 1) * (1 + ‖c‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 h2p
      _ ≤ 8 * (1 + ‖c‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h5 hq
  
  have hinc : ∀ c h : E3, ‖h‖ ≤ 1 / 2 →
      |f (c + h) - f c| ≤ 8 * A * (1 + ‖c‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) * ‖h‖ := by
    intro c h hh
    have hbd : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall c (1 / 2),
        ‖fderiv ℝ f w‖ ≤ 8 * A * (1 + ‖c‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ f w‖ ≤ A * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (-a - 1) := hf1 w
        _ ≤ A * (8 * (1 + ‖c‖) ^ (-(a + 1))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hweight c w hw) hA
        _ = 8 * A * (1 + ‖c‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) := by ring
    have hmem1 : c ∈ Metric.closedBall c (1 / 2) := Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by norm_num)
    have hmem2 : c + h ∈ Metric.closedBall c (1 / 2) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
      exact hh
    have hmvt := (convex_closedBall c (1 / 2)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
      (fun w _ => hf w) hbd hmem1 hmem2
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt
    exact hmvt
  
  have hrep : ∀ w : E3, ∫ y, k (w - y) * f y = ∫ z, k z * f (w - z) := by
    intro w
    have h := integral_sub_left_eq_self (fun z => k z * f (w - z)) (volume : Measure E3) w
    simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at h
    exact h
  
  have hpeetre : ∀ (p : ℝ) (w : E3), 0 ≤ p → 3 < p + 2 →
      Integrable (fun y : E3 => (1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-(2 : ℝ))) := by
    intro p w hp hp3
    have hr : ((Module.finrank ℝ E3 : ℕ) : ℝ) < p + 2 := by
      rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]; push_cast; linarith
    have hbase : Integrable (fun y : E3 => (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-(p + 2))) := integrable_one_add_norm hr
    have hsh : Integrable (fun y : E3 => (1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-(p + 2))) :=
      hbase.comp_sub_left w
    refine Integrable.mono' (hsh.const_mul ((1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 : ℝ))) ?_ ?_
    · refine Continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (Continuous.mul ?_ ?_)
      · exact (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).norm).rpow_const
          (fun y => Or.inl (ne_of_gt (by positivity)))
      · exact (continuous_const.add continuous_norm).rpow_const
          (fun y => Or.inl (ne_of_gt (by positivity)))
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
      have hu : 0 < 1 + ‖w - y‖ := by positivity
      have ht : 0 < 1 + ‖y‖ := by positivity
      have hs : 0 < 1 + ‖w‖ := by positivity
      have hus : 1 + ‖w - y‖ ≤ (1 + ‖w‖) * (1 + ‖y‖) := by
        have := norm_sub_le w y
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg w, norm_nonneg y, mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg w) (norm_nonneg y)]
      have key : (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)) ≤ (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 : ℝ) * (1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-(2 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_neg ht.le, Real.rpow_neg hu.le]
        simp only [Real.rpow_two]
        have hsq : (1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2 * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ 2 := by
          have := mul_le_mul hus hus hu.le (by positivity)
          nlinarith
        calc ((1 + ‖y‖) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ ((1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ 2 / (1 + ‖w‖) ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
              inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]; exact hsq)
          _ = (1 + ‖w‖) ^ 2 * ((1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by rw [inv_div, div_eq_mul_inv]
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      calc (1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-(2 : ℝ))
          ≤ (1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-p) * ((1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 : ℝ) * (1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-(2 : ℝ))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key (by positivity)
        _ = (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 : ℝ) * ((1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-p) * (1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-(2 : ℝ))) := by ring
        _ = (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (2 : ℝ) * (1 + ‖w - y‖) ^ (-(p + 2)) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_add hu, show -p + -(2 : ℝ) = -(p + 2) by ring]
  
  have hFint : ∀ w : E3, Integrable (fun z : E3 => k z * f (w - z)) := by
    intro w
    refine Integrable.mono'
      ((hpeetre a w (by linarith) (by linarith)).const_mul (M * A)) ?_ ?_
    · exact (hk.mul (hf.continuous.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      have h1 := hk0 z
      have h2 := hf0 (w - z)
      calc |k z| * |f (w - z)| ≤ (M * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) * (A * (1 + ‖w - z‖) ^ (-a)) :=
            mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans h1)
        _ = M * A * ((1 + ‖w - z‖) ^ (-a) * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-(2 : ℝ))) := by ring
  
  have hlip : ∀ x' : E3, ‖x' - x‖ ≤ 1 / 2 →
      |(∫ z, k z * f (x' - z)) - ∫ z, k z * f (x - z)| ≤
        (8 * A * M * ∫ y, (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) * ‖x' - x‖ := by
    intro x' hxx
    rw [← integral_sub (hFint x') (hFint x)]
    have hdom : Integrable (fun z : E3 => (8 * A * M * ‖x' - x‖) *
        ((1 + ‖x - z‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ))) :=
      (hpeetre (a + 1) x (by linarith) (by linarith)).const_mul _
    have hpt : ∀ z : E3, ‖k z * f (x' - z) - k z * f (x - z)‖ ≤
        (8 * A * M * ‖x' - x‖) * ((1 + ‖x - z‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) := by
      intro z
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← mul_sub, abs_mul]
      have e : (x - z) + (x' - x) = x' - z := by abel
      have h1 := hk0 z
      have h2 := hinc (x - z) (x' - x) hxx
      rw [e] at h2
      calc |k z| * |f (x' - z) - f (x - z)| ≤ (M * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) *
            (8 * A * (1 + ‖x - z‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) * ‖x' - x‖) :=
            mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans h1)
        _ = _ := by ring
    have hn := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hdom (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
    rw [integral_const_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hn
    calc _ ≤ _ := hn
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have hev : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x,
      ‖(fun x : E3 => ∫ y, k (x - y) * f y) x' - (fun x : E3 => ∫ y, k (x - y) * f y) x‖ ≤
        (8 * A * M * ∫ y, (1 + ‖x - y‖) ^ (-(a + 1)) * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-2 : ℝ)) * ‖x' - x‖ := by
    filter_upwards [Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)] with x' hx'
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hx'
    show ‖(∫ y, k (x' - y) * f y) - ∫ y, k (x - y) * f y‖ ≤ _
    rw [hrep x', hrep x, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hlip x' hx'
  exact norm_fderiv_le_of_lip' ℝ hC hev

informal_problem.statement:
(η f : E3 → ℝ) (a A M : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) (ha2 : a < 2)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hηc : Continuous η) (hη0 : ∀ z : E3, 0 ≤ η z)
    (hηb : ∀ z : E3, η z ≤ M * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-7 : ℝ))
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hf0 : ∀ y : E3, |f y| ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a))
    (hf1 : ∀ y : E3, ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a - 1)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x : E3,
      |(∫ z, η z) * f x - ∫ y, η (x - y) * f y| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1)

signature.name: approx_identity_residual
signature.statement:
(η f : E3 → ℝ) (a A M : ℝ) (ha : 1 < a) (ha2 : a < 2)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hηc : Continuous η) (hη0 : ∀ z : E3, 0 ≤ η z)
    (hηb : ∀ z : E3, η z ≤ M * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-7 : ℝ))
    (hf : Differentiable ℝ f) (hf0 : ∀ y : E3, |f y| ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a))
    (hf1 : ∀ y : E3, ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a - 1)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x : E3,
      |(∫ z, η z) * f x - ∫ y, η (x - y) * f y| ≤ C * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hinc : ∀ x z : E3,
      |f x - f (x - z)| ≤ A * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 2) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) := by
    intro x z
    have hQ : 0 < 1 + ‖z‖ := by positivity
    have hX : 0 < 1 + ‖x‖ := by positivity
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = A * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 1) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := by
      rw [hK]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA (Real.rpow_nonneg hQ.le _)) (Real.rpow_nonneg hX.le _)
    have hbd : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall x ‖z‖, ‖fderiv ℝ f w‖ ≤ K := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw
      have hP : 0 < 1 + ‖w‖ := by positivity
      have h1 : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖w‖ + ‖z‖ := by
        have := norm_le_insert' x w
        rw [norm_sub_rev] at this
        linarith
      have hpeet : 1 + ‖x‖ ≤ (1 + ‖w‖) * (1 + ‖z‖) := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg w, norm_nonneg z, mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg w) (norm_nonneg z)]
      have h2 : (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (-a - 1) ≤ (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 1) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) := by
        have h3 : ((1 + ‖w‖) * (1 + ‖z‖)) ^ (-a - 1) ≤ (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hX hpeet (by linarith)
        rw [Real.mul_rpow hP.le hQ.le] at h3
        have h4 : (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 1) * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-a - 1) = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_add hQ, show a + 1 + (-a - 1) = 0 by ring, Real.rpow_zero]
        have h5 : 0 ≤ (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg hQ.le _
        calc (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (-a - 1)
            = (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 1) * ((1 + ‖w‖) ^ (-a - 1) * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-a - 1)) := by
              rw [mul_comm ((1 + ‖w‖) ^ (-a - 1)), ← mul_assoc, h4, one_mul]
          _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 h5
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ f w‖ ≤ A * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (-a - 1) := hf1 w
        _ ≤ A * ((1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 1) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hA
        _ = K := by rw [hK]; ring
    have hmem1 : x - z ∈ Metric.closedBall x ‖z‖ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      simp
    have hmem2 : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x ‖z‖ := Metric.mem_closedBall_self (norm_nonneg z)
    have hmvt := (convex_closedBall x ‖z‖).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
      (fun w _ => (hf w)) hbd hmem1 hmem2
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_sub_cancel] at hmvt
    have h6 : K * ‖z‖ ≤ K * (1 + ‖z‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hK0
    have h7 : (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 2) = (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 1) * (1 + ‖z‖) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add_one hQ.ne', show a + 1 + 1 = a + 2 by ring]
    calc |f x - f (x - z)| ≤ K * ‖z‖ := hmvt
      _ ≤ K * (1 + ‖z‖) := h6
      _ = _ := by rw [hK, h7]; ring
  
  have hfr : (Module.finrank ℝ E3 : ℝ) = 3 := by simp [E3, finrank_euclideanSpace]
  have hW7 : Integrable (fun z : E3 => (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-(7 : ℝ))) :=
    integrable_one_add_norm (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
  have hηi : Integrable η := by
    refine (hW7.const_mul M).mono' hηc.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hη0 z)]
    exact hηb z
  have hWa : Integrable (fun z : E3 => (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a - 5)) := by
    have h := integrable_one_add_norm (E := E3) (μ := volume) (r := 5 - a)
      (by rw [hfr]; linarith)
    rw [show a - 5 = -(5 - a) by ring]
    exact h
  have hfB : ∀ y : E3, |f y| ≤ A := by
    intro y
    have h1 : (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith [norm_nonneg y]) (by linarith)
    calc |f y| ≤ A * (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (-a) := hf0 y
      _ ≤ A * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hA
      _ = A := mul_one A
  
  have hident : ∀ x : E3, (∫ z, η z) * f x - ∫ y, η (x - y) * f y =
      ∫ z, η z * (f x - f (x - z)) := by
    intro x
    have htr : ∫ y, η (x - y) * f y = ∫ z, η z * f (x - z) := by
      have h := integral_sub_left_eq_self (fun y => η (x - y) * f y) (volume : Measure E3) x
      simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at h
      exact h.symm
    have I₁ : Integrable (fun z => η z * f x) := hηi.mul_const (f x)
    have I₂ : Integrable (fun z => η z * f (x - z)) := by
      refine (hηi.norm.mul_const A).mono'
        ((hηc.mul (hf.continuous.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (f (x - z))]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfB _) (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [htr, ← integral_mul_const, ← integral_sub I₁ I₂]
    congr 1
    funext z
    ring
  
  have hJ0 : 0 ≤ ∫ z : E3, (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a - 5) :=
    integral_nonneg (fun z => Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _)
  refine ⟨M * A * ∫ z : E3, (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a - 5), mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hM hA) hJ0,
    fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [hident x, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hmaj : ∀ z : E3, ‖η z * (f x - f (x - z))‖ ≤
      M * A * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a - 5) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) := by
    intro z
    have hQ : 0 < 1 + ‖z‖ := by positivity
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hη0 z)]
    have h1 := mul_le_mul (hηb z) (hinc x z) (abs_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg hM (Real.rpow_nonneg hQ.le _))
    have h2 : (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-7 : ℝ) * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 2) = (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a - 5) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hQ]
      congr 1
      ring
    calc η z * |f x - f (x - z)|
        ≤ M * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-7 : ℝ) * (A * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 2) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1)) := h1
      _ = M * A * ((1 + ‖z‖) ^ (-7 : ℝ) * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a + 2)) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1) := by
          ring
      _ = _ := by rw [h2]
  have hg : Integrable (fun z : E3 => M * A * (1 + ‖z‖) ^ (a - 5) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-a - 1)) :=
    (hWa.const_mul (M * A)).mul_const _
  refine (norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hmaj)).trans ?_
  rw [integral_mul_const, integral_const_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(v : E3 → ℝ) (a B : ℝ) (ha2 : a < 2) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hv : Differentiable ℝ v) (hv0 : v 0 = 0)
    (hdv : ∀ (w : E3) (i : Fin 3), |partialDeriv i v w| ≤ B * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (1 - a)) (x : E3) :

signature.name: ray_growth_bound
signature.statement:
(v : E3 → ℝ) (a B : ℝ) (ha2 : a < 2) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hv : Differentiable ℝ v) (hv0 : v 0 = 0)
    (hdv : ∀ (w : E3) (i : Fin 3), |partialDeriv i v w| ≤ B * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (1 - a)) (x : E3) :
    |v x| ≤ 3 * B / (2 - a) * (1 + ‖x‖) ^ (2 - a)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h2a : 0 < 2 - a := by linarith
  set r := ‖x‖ with hr
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := norm_nonneg x
  set c := 3 * B / (2 - a) with hc
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := div_nonneg (by linarith) h2a.le
  
  have hcoord : ∀ w : E3, |fderiv ℝ v w x| ≤ 3 * (r * (B * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (1 - a))) := by
    intro w
    have hx : x = ∑ i : Fin 3, x i • e i := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr x]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    have hL : fderiv ℝ v w x = ∑ i : Fin 3, x i * partialDeriv i v w := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hx]
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rfl
    rw [hL, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hb : ∀ i : Fin 3, |x i * partialDeriv i v w| ≤ r * (B * (1 + ‖w‖) ^ (1 - a)) := by
      intro i
      rw [abs_mul]
      have h1 : |x i| ≤ r := by
        have := PiLp.norm_apply_le x i
        rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact mul_le_mul h1 (hdv w i) (abs_nonneg _) hr0
    have t := abs_add_three (x 0 * partialDeriv 0 v w) (x 1 * partialDeriv 1 v w)
      (x 2 * partialDeriv 2 v w)
    linarith [hb 0, hb 1, hb 2]
  
  have hφ : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => v (s • x)) (fderiv ℝ v (t • x) x) t := by
    intro t
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s • x) ((1 : ℝ) • x) t := (hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const x
    have h2 := (hv (t • x)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h1
    rw [one_smul] at h2
    exact h2
  
  have hψ : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => c * (1 + s * r) ^ (2 - a))
      (c * (r * (2 - a) * (1 + t * r) ^ (2 - a - 1))) t := by
    intro t ht
    have hg : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => 1 + s * r) r t := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const r).const_add 1
    have hpos : (1 + t * r) ≠ 0 := by
      have := mul_nonneg ht hr0
      exact ne_of_gt (by linarith)
    exact (hg.rpow_const (p := 2 - a) (Or.inl hpos)).const_mul c
  
  have hbound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ‖fderiv ℝ v (t • x) x‖ ≤ c * (r * (2 - a) * (1 + t * r) ^ (2 - a - 1)) := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 := hcoord (t • x)
    have hn : ‖t • x‖ = t * r := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
    rw [hn] at h1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have he : (2 - a - 1 : ℝ) = 1 - a := by ring
    rw [he]
    have hc2 : c * (2 - a) = 3 * B := by rw [hc]; field_simp
    calc |fderiv ℝ v (t • x) x| ≤ 3 * (r * (B * (1 + t * r) ^ (1 - a))) := h1
      _ = c * (r * (2 - a) * (1 + t * r) ^ (1 - a)) := by
        linear_combination (-(r * (1 + t * r) ^ (1 - a))) * hc2
  
  have key : ‖(fun s : ℝ => v (s • x)) 1‖ ≤ (fun s : ℝ => c * (1 + s * r) ^ (2 - a)) 1 :=
    image_norm_le_of_norm_deriv_right_le_deriv_boundary'
      (fun t _ => (hφ t).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t _ => (hφ t).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (by simp [hv0, hc0])
      (fun t ht => (hψ t ht.1).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t ht => (hψ t ht.1).hasDerivWithinAt)
      hbound
      (show (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 from ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩)
  
  simp only [one_smul, one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at key
  exact key

    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
        ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k φ z) (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
    φ x = -∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *

signature.statement:
(φ : E3 → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ) (x : E3) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
        ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k φ z) (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)) (Set.Ioi 0) ∧
    φ x = -∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
        ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k φ z) (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have t_mass :
      Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ∧
      ∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) = 1 ∧
      Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * ‖ζ‖) ∧
      ∀ ζ : E3, 0 ≤ (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) ∧
        (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) ≤ 1 := by
    have hpi : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
    have hgi : ∀ b : ℝ, 0 < b → Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => Real.exp (-b * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2)) ∧
        ∫ ζ : E3, Real.exp (-b * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) = (Real.pi / b) ^ ((3:ℝ) / 2) := by
      intro b hb
      have h := GaussianFourier.integral_rexp_neg_mul_sq_norm (V := E3) hb
      rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin] at h
      have h' : ∫ ζ : E3, Real.exp (-b * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) = (Real.pi / b) ^ ((3:ℝ) / 2) := by
        rw [h]; norm_num
      refine ⟨Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero ?_, h'⟩
      rw [h']
      exact (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (div_pos hpi hb) _).ne'
    have hfun : (fun ζ : E3 => Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) =
        fun ζ => Real.exp (-(1/4) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) := by
      funext ζ; congr 1; ring
    obtain ⟨hi4, hv4⟩ := hgi (1/4) (by norm_num)
    obtain ⟨hi8, -⟩ := hgi (1/8) (by norm_num)
    have hint : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) := by rw [hfun]; exact hi4
    have hval : ∫ ζ : E3, Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) = (4 * Real.pi) ^ ((3:ℝ)/2) := by
      rw [hfun, hv4]; congr 1; field_simp
    have hc : (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * (4 * Real.pi) ^ ((3:ℝ)/2) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add (by positivity)]; norm_num
    have hnn : ∀ ζ : E3, 0 ≤ (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) :=
      fun ζ => by positivity
    refine ⟨hint.const_mul _, ?_, ?_, fun ζ => ⟨hnn ζ, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [integral_const_mul, hval, hc]
    · have hb : ∀ ζ : E3, ‖(4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * ‖ζ‖‖ ≤
          (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * 2 * Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) := by
        intro ζ
        have hr0 : 0 ≤ ‖ζ‖ := norm_nonneg _
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hnn ζ) hr0)]
        have hsplit : Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) =
            Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
        have key : ‖ζ‖ * Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) ≤ 2 := by
          have h1 := Real.add_one_le_exp ((1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2)
          have h2 : Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) * Real.exp ((1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) = 1 := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
          have h3 : 0 < Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) := Real.exp_pos _
          have h4 : ‖ζ‖ ≤ 2 * Real.exp ((1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) := by
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖ζ‖/2 - 1)]
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 h3.le]
        have h5 : 0 ≤ (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) := by
          positivity
        rw [hsplit]
        calc (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
              (Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) * Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2)) * ‖ζ‖
            = ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2)) *
                (‖ζ‖ * Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2)) := by ring
          _ ≤ ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(1/8) * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2)) * 2 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key h5
          _ = _ := by ring
      refine Integrable.mono' (hi8.const_mul ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * 2)) ?_
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb)
      exact (Continuous.mul (continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_exp.comp
        ((continuous_norm.pow 2).neg.div_const 4))) continuous_norm).aestronglyMeasurable
    · have hc1 : (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]) (by norm_num)
      have he1 : Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
        have := sq_nonneg ‖ζ‖
        linarith
      exact mul_le_one₀ hc1 (Real.exp_pos _).le he1
  
  have t_cont : ∀ (κ h : E3 → ℝ), Integrable κ → Continuous h → ∀ B : ℝ,
      (∀ z : E3, ‖h z‖ ≤ B) → ∀ x : E3,
      Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * h (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)) := by
    intro κ h hκ hh B hhb x
    refine continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun ζ => ‖κ ζ‖ * B) ?_ ?_ (hκ.norm.mul_const B) ?_
    · intro t
      exact hκ.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
        (hh.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.smul continuous_id))).aestronglyMeasurable
    · intro t
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ζ => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hhb _) (norm_nonneg _)
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ζ => ?_)
      exact continuous_const.mul
        (hh.comp (continuous_const.sub (Real.continuous_sqrt.smul continuous_const)))
  
  have t_lim : ∀ (κ h : E3 → ℝ), Integrable κ → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → ∀ x : E3,
      Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * h (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro κ h hκ hh hhc x
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hhc.exists_bound_of_continuous hh
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ :=
      (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : E3)).mp hhc.isCompact.isBounded
    have h0 : (∫ ζ : E3, (fun _ : E3 => (0 : ℝ)) ζ) = 0 := by simp
    rw [← h0]
    refine tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun ζ => ‖κ ζ‖ * B) ?_ ?_
      (hκ.norm.mul_const B) ?_
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => hκ.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
        (hh.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.smul continuous_id))).aestronglyMeasurable)
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ζ => by
        rw [norm_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB _) (norm_nonneg _)))
    · filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ne volume (0 : E3)] with ζ hζ
      have hn : 0 < ‖ζ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hζ
      have hev : ∀ᶠ t in atTop, (ρ + ‖x‖ + 1) / ‖ζ‖ < Real.sqrt t :=
        Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop _
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [hev] with t ht
      have h1 : ρ + ‖x‖ + 1 < Real.sqrt t * ‖ζ‖ := by
        rwa [div_lt_iff₀ hn] at ht
      have h2 : ‖Real.sqrt t • ζ‖ = Real.sqrt t * ‖ζ‖ := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg t)]
      have h3 : ‖Real.sqrt t • ζ‖ - ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x - Real.sqrt t • ζ‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_norm_le (Real.sqrt t • ζ) x
        rw [norm_sub_rev (Real.sqrt t • ζ) x] at this
        exact this
      have h4 : x - Real.sqrt t • ζ ∉ tsupport h := by
        intro hm
        have := hρ hm
        rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at this
        linarith
      simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport h4]
  
  have t_intOn : ∀ (κ h : E3 → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ ζ : E3, |κ ζ| ≤ c) → Continuous h →
      HasCompactSupport h → ∀ x : E3,
      Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * h (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)) →
      IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * h (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    intro κ h c hκb hh hhc x hcont
    have hhi : Integrable h := hh.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hhc
    have hbd : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ‖∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * h (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)‖ ≤
        (c * ∫ z : E3, |h z|) * t ^ (-(3/2 : ℝ)) := by
      intro t ht
      obtain ⟨s, hsdef⟩ : ∃ s, s = Real.sqrt t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hs : 0 < s := by rw [hsdef]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht
      rw [← hsdef]
      have hcv : (∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * h (x - s • ζ)) =
          (s ^ 3)⁻¹ * ∫ z : E3, κ (s⁻¹ • z) * h (x - z) := by
        have := Measure.integral_comp_smul (volume : Measure E3)
          (fun z : E3 => κ (s⁻¹ • z) * h (x - z)) s
        rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin] at this
        simp only [inv_smul_smul₀ hs.ne'] at this
        rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (pow_pos hs 3)), smul_eq_mul] at this
        exact this
      have hmaj : Integrable (fun z => c * ‖h (x - z)‖) :=
        (hhi.norm.comp_sub_left x).const_mul c
      have hI : ∫ z, c * ‖h (x - z)‖ = c * ∫ z : E3, |h z| := by
        rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sub_left_eq_self (fun z => ‖h z‖) volume x]
        simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hle : ‖∫ z : E3, κ (s⁻¹ • z) * h (x - z)‖ ≤ c * ∫ z : E3, |h z| := by
        rw [← hI]
        refine norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hmaj (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
        rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (κ _)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hκb _) (norm_nonneg _)
      have hpow : (s ^ 3)⁻¹ = t ^ (-(3/2 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [hsdef, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul ht.le,
          Real.rpow_neg ht.le]
        norm_num
      rw [hcv, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr (pow_pos hs 3)).le, hpow,
        mul_comm (c * ∫ z : E3, |h z|)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle (Real.rpow_nonneg ht.le _)
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * h (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
        (Set.Ioc 0 1) :=
      (hcont.integrableOn_Icc).mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
    have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * h (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
        (Set.Ioi 1) := by
      refine Integrable.mono' ((integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by norm_num : (-(3/2:ℝ)) < -1)
        one_pos).const_mul (c * ∫ z : E3, |h z|)) hcont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht
      exact hbd t (lt_trans one_pos ht)
    rw [← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi zero_le_one]
    exact h1.union h2
  
  have t_deriv : ∀ (κ ψ : E3 → ℝ), Integrable κ → Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => κ ζ * ‖ζ‖) →
      ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ (x : E3) (t₀ : ℝ), 0 < t₀ →
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * ψ (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
        (∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * (-(2 * Real.sqrt t₀)⁻¹ * fderiv ℝ ψ (x - Real.sqrt t₀ • ζ) ζ)) t₀ := by
    intro κ ψ hκ hκ1 hψ hψc x t₀ ht₀
    obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ := hψc.exists_bound_of_continuous hψ.continuous
    obtain ⟨B₁, hB₁⟩ := (hψc.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).exists_bound_of_continuous
      (hψ.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero)
    have hγ : ∀ t : ℝ, Continuous (fun ζ : E3 => x - Real.sqrt t • ζ) :=
      fun t => continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.smul continuous_id)
    have hball : ∀ t ∈ Metric.ball t₀ (t₀ / 2), t₀ / 2 < t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at ht
      linarith [ht.1]
    have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt (t₀ / 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have hc₀0 : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt (t₀ / 2))⁻¹ := by positivity
    refine (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := volume)
      (F := fun t ζ => κ ζ * ψ (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
      (F' := fun t ζ => κ ζ * (-(2 * Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ * fderiv ℝ ψ (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ) ζ))
      (bound := fun ζ => (2 * Real.sqrt (t₀ / 2))⁻¹ * B₁ * (|κ ζ| * ‖ζ‖))
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds t₀ (by linarith : 0 < t₀ / 2)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_).2
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => hκ.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
        (hψ.continuous.comp (hγ t)).aestronglyMeasurable)
    · exact hκ.mul_bdd (hψ.continuous.comp (hγ t₀)).aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ζ => hB₀ _))
    · exact hκ.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (continuous_const.mul
        (((hψ.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).comp (hγ t₀)).clm_apply
          continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ζ t ht => ?_)
      have ht' := hball t ht
      have hst : Real.sqrt (t₀ / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt t := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ht'.le
      have hinv : (2 * Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ ≤ (2 * Real.sqrt (t₀ / 2))⁻¹ :=
        inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by linarith)
      have hD : |fderiv ℝ ψ (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ) ζ| ≤ B₁ * ‖ζ‖ := by
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB₁ _) (norm_nonneg _))
      have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.sqrt t := by
        have := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (lt_trans (by linarith) ht' : (0:ℝ) < t); linarith
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_inv, Real.norm_of_nonneg hpos.le, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h1 : (2 * Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ * |fderiv ℝ ψ (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ) ζ| ≤
          (2 * Real.sqrt (t₀ / 2))⁻¹ * (B₁ * ‖ζ‖) :=
        mul_le_mul hinv hD (abs_nonneg _) hc₀0
      calc |κ ζ| * ((2 * Real.sqrt t)⁻¹ * |fderiv ℝ ψ (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ) ζ|)
          ≤ |κ ζ| * ((2 * Real.sqrt (t₀ / 2))⁻¹ * (B₁ * ‖ζ‖)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = (2 * Real.sqrt (t₀ / 2))⁻¹ * B₁ * (|κ ζ| * ‖ζ‖) := by ring
    · have : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => |κ ζ| * ‖ζ‖) := by
        refine hκ1.norm.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ζ => ?_)
        simp [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact this.const_mul _
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ζ t ht => ?_)
      have ht0 : 0 < t := lt_trans (by linarith) (hball t ht)
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.sqrt t • ζ) ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt t)) • ζ) t :=
        (Real.hasDerivAt_sqrt ht0.ne').smul_const ζ
      have h2 := h1.const_sub x
      have h3 :=
        ((hψ.differentiable one_ne_zero) (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h2
      have h4 := h3.const_mul (κ ζ)
      convert h4 using 1
      simp only [map_neg, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, one_div]
      ring
  
  have t_cs : ∀ (q : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3) (s : ℝ), s ≠ 0 → HasCompactSupport q →
      HasCompactSupport (fun ζ : E3 => q (x - s • ζ)) := fun q x s hs hq =>
    (hq.comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.subLeft x)).comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero s hs)
  have t_expand : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ζ : E3), L ζ = ∑ k : Fin 3, ζ k * L (e k) := by
    intro L ζ
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr ζ]
    simp [map_sum, map_smul]
  
  have t_ibp : ∀ (κ h : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 κ → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h →
      ∀ (l : Fin 3) (x : E3) (s : ℝ), 0 < s →
      ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * partialDeriv l h (x - s • ζ) =
        s⁻¹ * ∫ ζ : E3, partialDeriv l κ ζ * h (x - s • ζ) := by
    intro κ h hκ hh hhc l x s hs
    set G : E3 → ℝ := fun ζ => h (x - s • ζ) with hGdef
    have hGd : ∀ ζ, HasFDerivAt G
        ((fderiv ℝ h (x - s • ζ)).comp (-(s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3))) ζ := by
      intro ζ
      have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun ζ : E3 => x - s • ζ) (-(s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)) ζ :=
        ((hasFDerivAt_id ζ).const_smul s).const_sub x
      exact ((hh.differentiable one_ne_zero) (x - s • ζ)).hasFDerivAt.comp ζ hA
    have hGv : ∀ ζ, fderiv ℝ G ζ (e l) = -(s * partialDeriv l h (x - s • ζ)) := by
      intro ζ
      rw [(hGd ζ).fderiv]
      simp [partialDeriv]
    have hGdiff : Differentiable ℝ G := fun ζ => (hGd ζ).differentiableAt
    have hGc : HasCompactSupport G := t_cs h x s hs.ne' hhc
    have hpl : Continuous (fun z => partialDeriv l h z) :=
      (hh.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hplc : HasCompactSupport (fun z => partialDeriv l h z) :=
      (hhc.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp_left (g := fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e l)) rfl
    have hγ : Continuous (fun ζ : E3 => x - s • ζ) :=
      continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.smul continuous_id)
    have hκl : Continuous (fun ζ => fderiv ℝ κ ζ (e l)) :=
      (hκ.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
    have i1 : Integrable (fun ζ => fderiv ℝ κ ζ (e l) * G ζ) := by
      refine Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hκl.mul (hh.continuous.comp hγ)) ?_
      exact hGc.mul_left
    have hfun : (fun ζ => κ ζ * fderiv ℝ G ζ (e l)) =
        fun ζ => -s * (κ ζ * partialDeriv l h (x - s • ζ)) := by
      funext ζ; rw [hGv]; ring
    have i2 : Integrable (fun ζ => κ ζ * fderiv ℝ G ζ (e l)) := by
      rw [hfun]
      refine (Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hκ.continuous.mul (hpl.comp hγ))
        ?_).const_mul _
      exact (t_cs _ x s hs.ne' hplc).mul_left
    have i3 : Integrable (fun ζ => κ ζ * G ζ) :=
      Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hκ.continuous.mul (hh.continuous.comp hγ))
        hGc.mul_left
    have key := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume) i1 i2 i3
      (hκ.differentiable one_ne_zero) hGdiff
    rw [hfun, integral_const_mul] at key
    have : ∫ ζ : E3, partialDeriv l κ ζ * h (x - s • ζ) = ∫ ζ, fderiv ℝ κ ζ (e l) * G ζ := rfl
    rw [this]
    field_simp
    linarith
  
  have hpd : ∀ q : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ q → ∀ a : Fin 3,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => partialDeriv a q z) :=
    fun q hq a => (hq.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hcs : ∀ q : E3 → ℝ, HasCompactSupport q → ∀ a : Fin 3,
      HasCompactSupport (fun z => partialDeriv a q z) :=
    fun q hq a => (hq.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp_left (g := fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e a)) rfl
  have hC1 : ∀ q : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ q → ContDiff ℝ 1 q :=
    fun q hq => hq.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  
  have t_recomb : ∀ (κ ψ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 κ →
      (∀ (k : Fin 3) (ζ : E3), partialDeriv k κ ζ = -(ζ k / 2) * κ ζ) →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ (x : E3) (s : ℝ), 0 < s →
      ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * (-(2 * s)⁻¹ * fderiv ℝ ψ (x - s • ζ) ζ)
        = ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) (x - s • ζ) := by
    intro κ ψ hκ hκd hψ hψc x s hs
    have hγ : Continuous (fun ζ : E3 => x - s • ζ) :=
      continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.smul continuous_id)
    have hκk : ∀ k : Fin 3, Continuous (fun ζ => partialDeriv k κ ζ) :=
      fun k => (hκ.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
    have iA : ∀ k : Fin 3, Integrable
        (fun ζ => s⁻¹ * (partialDeriv k κ ζ * partialDeriv k ψ (x - s • ζ))) := by
      intro k
      refine (Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        ((hκk k).mul ((hpd ψ hψ k).continuous.comp hγ)) ?_).const_mul _
      exact (t_cs _ x s hs.ne' (hcs ψ hψc k)).mul_left
    have iB : ∀ k : Fin 3, Integrable
        (fun ζ => κ ζ * partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) (x - s • ζ)) := by
      intro k
      refine Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hκ.continuous.mul
        ((hpd _ (hpd ψ hψ k) k).continuous.comp hγ)) ?_
      exact (t_cs _ x s hs.ne' (hcs _ (hcs ψ hψc k) k)).mul_left
    have hpt : ∀ ζ : E3, κ ζ * (-(2 * s)⁻¹ * fderiv ℝ ψ (x - s • ζ) ζ) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, s⁻¹ * (partialDeriv k κ ζ * partialDeriv k ψ (x - s • ζ)) := by
      intro ζ
      rw [t_expand (fderiv ℝ ψ (x - s • ζ)) ζ]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [hκd 0, hκd 1, hκd 2]
      simp only [partialDeriv]
      field_simp
      ring
    calc ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * (-(2 * s)⁻¹ * fderiv ℝ ψ (x - s • ζ) ζ)
        = ∫ ζ : E3, ∑ k : Fin 3, s⁻¹ * (partialDeriv k κ ζ * partialDeriv k ψ (x - s • ζ)) := by
          congr 1; funext ζ; exact hpt ζ
      _ = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∫ ζ : E3, s⁻¹ * (partialDeriv k κ ζ * partialDeriv k ψ (x - s • ζ)) :=
          integral_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => iA k)
      _ = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) (x - s • ζ) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
          rw [integral_const_mul]
          exact (t_ibp κ (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) hκ (hC1 _ (hpd ψ hψ k)) (hcs ψ hψc k)
            k x s hs).symm
      _ = ∫ ζ : E3, ∑ k : Fin 3, κ ζ * partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) (x - s • ζ) :=
          (integral_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => iB k)).symm
      _ = _ := by
          congr 1; funext ζ; rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  
  have t_gauss : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun ζ : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ∧
      (∀ (k : Fin 3) (ζ : E3),
        partialDeriv k (fun ζ' : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ'‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ζ
          = -(ζ k / 2) * ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4))) := by
    refine ⟨contDiff_const.mul (Real.contDiff_exp.comp ((contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).neg.div_const 4)), ?_⟩
    intro k ζ
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun ζ : E3 => ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ ζ) ζ :=
      (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq ζ).hasFDerivAt
    have h2 := ((h1.neg.mul_const (4:ℝ)⁻¹).exp).const_mul ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)))
    have hf : (fun ζ' : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ'‖ ^ 2) / 4)) =
        fun y => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
          Real.exp ((-fun ζ : E3 => ‖ζ‖ ^ 2) y * (4:ℝ)⁻¹) := by
      funext y; simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hf, h2.fderiv]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨hPint, hP1, hPmom, hPb⟩ := t_mass
  have hPabs : ∀ ζ : E3,
      |(4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)| ≤ 1 := fun ζ => by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (hPb ζ).1]; exact (hPb ζ).2
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k φ z) z) :=
    ContDiff.sum (fun k _ => hpd _ (hpd φ hφ k) k)
  have hgc : HasCompactSupport
      (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k φ z) z) := by
    have e3 : (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k φ z) z) =
        fun z => partialDeriv 0 (fun y => partialDeriv 0 φ y) z
          + partialDeriv 1 (fun y => partialDeriv 1 φ y) z
          + partialDeriv 2 (fun y => partialDeriv 2 φ y) z := by
      funext z; exact Fin.sum_univ_three _
    rw [e3]
    exact ((hcs _ (hcs φ hφc 0) 0).add (hcs _ (hcs φ hφc 1) 1)).add (hcs _ (hcs φ hφc 2) 2)
  obtain ⟨Bg, hBg⟩ := hgc.exists_bound_of_continuous hg.continuous
  obtain ⟨Bφ, hBφ⟩ := hφc.exists_bound_of_continuous hφ.continuous
  have hAc := t_cont (fun ζ => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4))
    (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k φ z) z) hPint hg.continuous
    Bg hBg x
  have hAint : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
      Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
        ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k φ z) (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
      (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    t_intOn (fun ζ => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4))
      (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k φ z) z) 1 hPabs
      hg.continuous hgc x hAc
  have hFc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
      Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * φ (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)) :=
    t_cont (fun ζ => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) φ hPint
      hφ.continuous Bφ hBφ x
  have hFlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
      Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * φ (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    t_lim (fun ζ => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) φ hPint
      hφ.continuous hφc x
  have hder : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3,
      (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * φ (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
      (∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
        ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k φ z) (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ)) t := by
    intro t ht
    have ht' : (0 : ℝ) < t := ht
    have h1 := t_deriv (fun ζ => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) φ
      hPint hPmom (hC1 φ hφ) hφc x t ht'
    exact h1.congr_deriv (t_recomb
      (fun ζ => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) φ
      (hC1 _ t_gauss.1) t_gauss.2 hφ hφc x (Real.sqrt t)
      (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht'))
  have hftc := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
    (f := fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
      Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * φ (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
    (f' := fun t : ℝ => ∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
        ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k φ z) (x - Real.sqrt t • ζ))
    (a := 0) (m := 0) hFc.continuousWithinAt hder hAint hFlim
  have hF0 : (∫ ζ : E3, (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
      Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * φ (x - Real.sqrt 0 • ζ)) = φ x := by
    simp only [Real.sqrt_zero, zero_smul, sub_zero]
    rw [integral_mul_const, hP1, one_mul]
  refine ⟨hAint, ?_⟩
  rw [hftc]
  beta_reduce
  rw [hF0]
  ring

    (∀ (k : Fin 3) (ζ : E3),
      partialDeriv k (fun ζ' : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ'‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ζ
        = -(ζ k / 2) * ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4))) ∧
    (∀ (i j : Fin 3) (ζ : E3),
      partialDeriv i (fun ζ' => partialDeriv j
          (fun ζ'' : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ''‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ζ') ζ
        = (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
            (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hq : ∀ ζ : E3, HasFDerivAt (fun x : E3 => -(‖x‖ ^ 2) / 4)
      ((4⁻¹ : ℝ) • (-((2 : ℕ) • (innerSL ℝ ζ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)))) ζ := by
    intro ζ
    have h := ((hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq ζ).hasFDerivAt.neg).mul_const (4⁻¹ : ℝ)
    have hfe : (fun x : E3 => -(‖x‖ ^ 2) / 4) = fun x : E3 => -(‖x‖ ^ 2) * 4⁻¹ := by
      funext x; ring
    rw [hfe]
    exact h
  have hp : ∀ ζ : E3, HasFDerivAt
      (fun x : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖x‖ ^ 2) / 4))
      ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) • (Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) •
        ((4⁻¹ : ℝ) • (-((2 : ℕ) • (innerSL ℝ ζ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)))))) ζ :=
    fun ζ => ((hq ζ).exp).const_mul _
  have h2 : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (ζ : E3),
      partialDeriv k (fun ζ' : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ'‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ζ
        = -(ζ k / 2) * ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) := by
    intro k ζ
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [(hp ζ).fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, two_smul,
      ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, e,
      EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, conj_trivial, one_mul]
    ring
  refine ⟨ContDiff.mul contDiff_const (((contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).neg.div_const 4).exp), h2, ?_⟩
  intro i j ζ
  have hfun : (fun ζ' => partialDeriv j
      (fun ζ'' : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ''‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ζ')
      = fun ζ' : E3 => (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ' j) *
          ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ'‖ ^ 2) / 4)) := by
    funext ζ'
    rw [h2]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  have ha : HasFDerivAt (fun ζ' : E3 => -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ' j)
      ((-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) • (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) ζ :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _
  have hm : HasFDerivAt (fun ζ' : E3 => -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ' j *
      ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ'‖ ^ 2) / 4))) _ ζ := ha.mul (hp ζ)
  unfold partialDeriv
  rw [hm.fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, two_smul,
    ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, e,
    EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, conj_trivial, one_mul, PiLp.proj_apply,
    EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    simp only [if_true]
    ring
  · simp only [h, Ne.symm h, if_false]
    ring

by
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := hs.ne'
  have hκd : Differentiable ℝ κ := hκ.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hhd : Differentiable ℝ h := hh.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hdκc : Continuous (fun ζ => fderiv ℝ κ ζ (e l)) :=
    (hκ.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hdhc : Continuous (fun y => fderiv ℝ h y (e l)) :=
    (hh.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hAc : Continuous (fun ζ : E3 => x - s • ζ) := by fun_prop
  have hHfd : ∀ ζ : E3, HasFDerivAt (fun ζ : E3 => h (x - s • ζ))
      ((fderiv ℝ h (x - s • ζ)).comp (-(s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3))) ζ := by
    intro ζ
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => x - s • y) (-(s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)) ζ :=
      ((hasFDerivAt_id ζ).const_smul s).const_sub x
    exact (hhd (x - s • ζ)).hasFDerivAt.comp ζ h1
  have hHd : Differentiable ℝ (fun ζ : E3 => h (x - s • ζ)) :=
    fun ζ => (hHfd ζ).differentiableAt
  have hHder : ∀ ζ : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : E3 => h (x - s • ζ)) ζ (e l)
      = -(s * partialDeriv l h (x - s • ζ)) := by
    intro ζ
    rw [(hHfd ζ).fderiv]
    simp [partialDeriv]
  have hKc : IsCompact ((fun y : E3 => s⁻¹ • (x - y)) '' tsupport h) :=
    hhc.isCompact.image (by fun_prop)
  have hHc : HasCompactSupport (fun ζ : E3 => h (x - s • ζ)) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro hKc ?_
    intro ζ hζ
    apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
    intro hmem
    apply hζ
    refine ⟨x - s • ζ, hmem, ?_⟩
    simp [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs0]
  have hI1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => fderiv ℝ κ ζ (e l) * h (x - s • ζ)) :=
    (hdκc.mul (hh.continuous.comp hAc)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hHc.mul_left
  have hI2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun ζ : E3 => κ ζ * fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : E3 => h (x - s • ζ)) ζ (e l)) := by
    have hc : Continuous
        (fun ζ : E3 => κ ζ * fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : E3 => h (x - s • ζ)) ζ (e l)) := by
      have heq : (fun ζ : E3 => κ ζ * fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : E3 => h (x - s • ζ)) ζ (e l))
          = fun ζ => κ ζ * (-(s * partialDeriv l h (x - s • ζ))) :=
        funext fun ζ => by rw [hHder]
      rw [heq]
      exact hκ.continuous.mul ((continuous_const.mul (hdhc.comp hAc)).neg)
    exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hHc.fderiv_apply ℝ (e l)).mul_left
  have hI3 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => κ ζ * h (x - s • ζ)) :=
    (hκ.continuous.mul (hh.continuous.comp hAc)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hHc.mul_left
  have hIBP := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable hI1 hI2 hI3 hκd hHd
  have hL : ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * fderiv ℝ (fun ζ : E3 => h (x - s • ζ)) ζ (e l)
      = -(s * ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * partialDeriv l h (x - s • ζ)) := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, ← MeasureTheory.integral_neg]
    congr 1
    funext ζ
    rw [hHder]
    ring
  rw [hL] at hIBP
  have hJ : s * ∫ ζ : E3, κ ζ * partialDeriv l h (x - s • ζ)
      = ∫ ζ : E3, partialDeriv l κ ζ * h (x - s • ζ) := neg_inj.mp hIBP
  rw [← hJ, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hs0]

informal_problem.statement:
(ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (i j : Fin 3) (w : E3) :
    ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k
        (fun z' => partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j ψ y) z') z) w
      = partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j
          (fun z' => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun y => partialDeriv k ψ y) z') z) w

signature.name: laplacian_hessian_comm
signature.statement:
(ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (i j : Fin 3) (w : E3) :
    ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k
        (fun z' => partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j ψ y) z') z) w
      = partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j
          (fun z' => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun y => partialDeriv k ψ y) z') z) w

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hA : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a f) := by
    intro f hf a
    exact (hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const
  
  have hB : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b f) = partialDeriv b (partialDeriv a f) := by
    intro f hf a b
    have hd : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) :=
      (hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiable (by simp)
    have key : ∀ (c d : Fin 3) (y : E3),
        partialDeriv c (partialDeriv d f) y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y (e c) (e d) := by
      intro c d y
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e d)) y (e c) = _
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hd y) (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    funext y
    rw [key, key]
    exact (hf.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt
      (by
        simp only [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
        first
          | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
          | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
          | norm_cast
          | decide)) (e a) (e b)
  
  have hC : ∀ (F : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ), (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F k)) → ∀ (a : Fin 3) (y : E3),
      partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, F k z) y = ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (F k) y := by
    intro F hF a y
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun k _ => ((hF k).differentiable (by simp)) y)]
    simp [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have hψ1 : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a ψ) := hA ψ hψ
  show ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (partialDeriv k (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ))) w
    = partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z' => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (partialDeriv k ψ) z')) w
  have h1 : partialDeriv j (fun z' => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (partialDeriv k ψ) z')
      = fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (partialDeriv k (partialDeriv k ψ)) z := by
    funext z
    exact hC _ (fun k => hA _ (hψ1 k) k) j z
  rw [h1, hC _ (fun k => hA _ (hA _ (hψ1 k) k) j) i w]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  rw [hB _ (hψ1 k) j k, hB ψ hψ j k, hB _ (hA _ (hψ1 j) k) i k, hB _ (hψ1 j) i k]

informal_problem.statement:
∃ c₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ c₁ ∧ ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (k : E3 → ℝ),
    (∀ ζ : E3, k ζ = (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
      (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)) →
    Integrable k ∧ ∫ ζ : E3, k ζ = 0 ∧
    Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => |k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∧
    ∫ ζ : E3, |k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ c₁

signature.statement:

    (∀ ζ : E3, k ζ = (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
      (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)) →
    Integrable k ∧ ∫ ζ : E3, k ζ = 0 ∧
    Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => |k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∧
    ∫ ζ : E3, |k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ c₁

proof.tactics:
by
  have gaussian_partials' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun ζ : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ∧
      (∀ (k : Fin 3) (ζ : E3),
        partialDeriv k (fun ζ' : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ'‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ζ
          = -(ζ k / 2) * ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4))) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Fin 3) (ζ : E3),
        partialDeriv i (fun ζ' => partialDeriv j
            (fun ζ'' : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ''‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ζ') ζ
          = (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
              (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)) := by
    have hq : ∀ ζ : E3, HasFDerivAt (fun x : E3 => -(‖x‖ ^ 2) / 4)
        ((4⁻¹ : ℝ) • (-((2 : ℕ) • (innerSL ℝ ζ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)))) ζ := by
      intro ζ
      have h := ((hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq ζ).hasFDerivAt.neg).mul_const (4⁻¹ : ℝ)
      have hfe : (fun x : E3 => -(‖x‖ ^ 2) / 4) = fun x : E3 => -(‖x‖ ^ 2) * 4⁻¹ := by
        funext x; ring
      rw [hfe]
      exact h
    have hp : ∀ ζ : E3, HasFDerivAt
        (fun x : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖x‖ ^ 2) / 4))
        ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) • (Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) •
          ((4⁻¹ : ℝ) • (-((2 : ℕ) • (innerSL ℝ ζ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)))))) ζ :=
      fun ζ => ((hq ζ).exp).const_mul _
    have h2 : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (ζ : E3),
        partialDeriv k (fun ζ' : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ'‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ζ
          = -(ζ k / 2) * ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) := by
      intro k ζ
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [(hp ζ).fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, two_smul,
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, e,
        EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, conj_trivial, one_mul]
      ring
    refine ⟨ContDiff.mul contDiff_const (((contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).neg.div_const 4).exp), h2, ?_⟩
    intro i j ζ
    have hfun : (fun ζ' => partialDeriv j
        (fun ζ'' : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ''‖ ^ 2) / 4)) ζ')
        = fun ζ' : E3 => (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ' j) *
            ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ'‖ ^ 2) / 4)) := by
      funext ζ'
      rw [h2]
      ring
    rw [hfun]
    have ha : HasFDerivAt (fun ζ' : E3 => -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ' j)
        ((-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) • (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) ζ :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _
    have hm : HasFDerivAt (fun ζ' : E3 => -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ζ' j *
        ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ'‖ ^ 2) / 4))) _ ζ := ha.mul (hp ζ)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hm.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, two_smul,
      ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, e,
      EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, conj_trivial, one_mul, PiLp.proj_apply,
      EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h
      simp only [if_true]
      ring
    · simp only [h, Ne.symm h, if_false]
      ring
  obtain ⟨hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := gaussian_partials'
  
  have s1 : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r →
      Real.exp (-(r ^ 2) / 4) * (1 + r) ^ 3 ≤ Real.exp 100 * (1 + r) ^ (-(7 : ℝ)) := by
    intro r hr
    have ha : 0 < 1 + r := by linarith
    have h7 : (1 + r) ^ (-(7 : ℝ)) = ((1 + r) ^ 7)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg ha.le, show (7 : ℝ) = ((7 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num, Real.rpow_natCast]
    rw [h7, ← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos ha 7)]
    have h10 : (1 + r) ^ 10 ≤ Real.exp (10 * r) := by
      have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ ha.le
        (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp r] : 1 + r ≤ Real.exp r) 10
      rw [show (10 : ℝ) * r = ((10 : ℕ) : ℝ) * r by norm_num, Real.exp_nat_mul]
      exact h
    have hE : Real.exp (-(r ^ 2) / 4) * Real.exp (10 * r) ≤ Real.exp 100 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - 20)])
    calc Real.exp (-(r ^ 2) / 4) * (1 + r) ^ 3 * (1 + r) ^ 7
        = Real.exp (-(r ^ 2) / 4) * (1 + r) ^ 10 := by ring
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-(r ^ 2) / 4) * Real.exp (10 * r) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h10 (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ ≤ Real.exp 100 := hE
  
  have hc0 : 0 < (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _
  have hc1 : (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]) (by norm_num)
  have s2 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (ζ : E3),
      |(4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
          (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)|
        ≤ Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 ∧
      |(4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
          (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
        ≤ Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 ∧
      |-(ζ j / 2) * ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4))|
        ≤ Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 := by
    intro i j ζ
    have hr : 0 ≤ ‖ζ‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hE : 0 < Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) := Real.exp_pos _
    have hi : |ζ i| ≤ ‖ζ‖ := by
      have h := PiLp.norm_apply_le ζ i
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    have hj : |ζ j| ≤ ‖ζ‖ := by
      have h := PiLp.norm_apply_le ζ j
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    have hd : |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> norm_num
    have hij : |ζ i * ζ j| ≤ ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [abs_mul]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (ζ i), abs_nonneg (ζ j)]
    have hbr : |ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2| ≤ ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 / 4 + 1 / 2 := by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp hij
      obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := abs_le.mp hd
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hs : ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ‖ζ‖ := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
      calc √‖ζ‖ ≤ √((1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith)
        _ = 1 + ‖ζ‖ := Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hr _
    have hK1 : |(4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
          (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)|
        ≤ Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * (‖ζ‖ ^ 2 / 4 + 1 / 2) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc0, abs_of_pos hE]
      calc (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
            |ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2|
          ≤ 1 * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
            |ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2| := by
            gcongr
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * (‖ζ‖ ^ 2 / 4 + 1 / 2) := by
            rw [one_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbr hE.le
    have hp3 : ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 / 4 + 1 / 2 ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖ζ‖, mul_nonneg hr (sq_nonneg ‖ζ‖)]
    have hp2' : (‖ζ‖ ^ 2 / 4 + 1 / 2) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖ζ‖, mul_nonneg hr (sq_nonneg ‖ζ‖)]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hK1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp3 hE.le)
    · calc _ ≤ Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * (‖ζ‖ ^ 2 / 4 + 1 / 2) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) :=
            mul_le_mul hK1 hs hs0 (by positivity)
        _ = Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * ((‖ζ‖ ^ 2 / 4 + 1 / 2) * (1 + ‖ζ‖)) := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp2' hE.le
    · rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hc0 hE)]
      have hj2 : |ζ j / 2| ≤ ‖ζ‖ / 2 := by rw [abs_div, abs_two]; linarith
      have hr3 : ‖ζ‖ / 2 ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖ζ‖, mul_nonneg hr (sq_nonneg ‖ζ‖)]
      calc |ζ j / 2| * ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4))
          ≤ (‖ζ‖ / 2) * (1 * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4)) :=
            mul_le_mul hj2 (by gcongr) (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * (‖ζ‖ / 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr3 hE.le
  
  have hI : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ (-(7 : ℝ))) :=
    integrable_one_add_norm (by rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]; norm_num)
  have hD : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => Real.exp 100 * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ (-(7 : ℝ))) :=
    hI.const_mul (Real.exp 100)
  have dom : ∀ ζ : E3, Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3
      ≤ Real.exp 100 * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ (-(7 : ℝ)) := fun ζ => s1 ‖ζ‖ (norm_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨Real.exp 100 * ∫ ζ : E3, (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ (-(7 : ℝ)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos 100).le
      (integral_nonneg (fun ζ => Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _))
  intro i j k hk
  have hkf := funext hk
  subst hkf
  beta_reduce
  
  have hKc : Continuous (fun ζ : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
      Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)) := by
    fun_prop
  have hGc : Continuous (fun ζ : E3 =>
      -(ζ j / 2) * ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4))) := by
    fun_prop
  have hKi : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
      Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)) :=
    hD.mono' hKc.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun ζ => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (s2 i j ζ).1.trans (dom ζ))
  have hGi : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 =>
      -(ζ j / 2) * ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4))) :=
    hD.mono' hGc.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun ζ => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (s2 i j ζ).2.2.trans (dom ζ))
  have hMc : Continuous (fun ζ : E3 => |(4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *
      Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) * (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)| *
        ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
    (continuous_abs.comp hKc).mul (continuous_norm.rpow_const (fun _ => Or.inr (by norm_num)))
  have hMi : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => |(4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) *

    intro i j k hk ζ η t
    have hfun : (fun s : ℝ => k (ζ + s • η)) = fun s : ℝ =>
        (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ + s • η‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
          ((ζ i + s * η i) * (ζ j + s * η j) / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2) := by

    have hP := ((hi.mul hj).div_const 4).sub_const ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)
    have h := (hE.const_mul ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)))).mul hP
    convert h using 1
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.neg_apply, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have s3 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (w ζ η : E3), ‖w - ζ‖ ≤ 1 →

            Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 8) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 := by
    intro i j w ζ η hw
    have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ‖w‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ ‖ζ‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hn0 : 0 ≤ ‖η‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hwi : |w i| ≤ ‖w‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact PiLp.norm_apply_le w i
    have hwj : |w j| ≤ ‖w‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact PiLp.norm_apply_le w j
    have hηi : |η i| ≤ ‖η‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact PiLp.norm_apply_le η i
    have hηj : |η j| ≤ ‖η‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact PiLp.norm_apply_le η j
    have hin : |inner ℝ w η| ≤ ‖w‖ * ‖η‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm w η
    have hδ0 : 0 ≤ (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by split_ifs <;> norm_num
    have hδ1 : (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> norm_num
    have hρr : ‖w‖ ≤ ‖ζ‖ + 1 := by have := norm_le_insert' w ζ; linarith
    have hrρ : ‖ζ‖ ≤ ‖w‖ + 1 := by
      have := norm_le_insert' ζ w
      rw [norm_sub_rev] at this
      linarith
    have hij : |w i * w j| ≤ ‖w‖ * ‖w‖ := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hwi hwj (abs_nonneg _) hρ0
    have hP : |w i * w j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2| ≤ ‖w‖ * ‖w‖ / 4 + 1 / 2 := by
      rw [abs_le] at hij ⊢
      constructor <;> linarith [hij.1, hij.2]
    have hQ1 : |η i * w j| ≤ ‖η‖ * ‖w‖ := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hηi hwj (abs_nonneg _) hn0
    have hQ2 : |w i * η j| ≤ ‖w‖ * ‖η‖ := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hwi hηj (abs_nonneg _) hρ0
    have hQ : |η i * w j + w i * η j| ≤ 2 * (‖w‖ * ‖η‖) := by
      calc |η i * w j + w i * η j| ≤ |η i * w j| + |w i * η j| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖η‖ * ‖w‖ + ‖w‖ * ‖η‖ := add_le_add hQ1 hQ2
        _ = 2 * (‖w‖ * ‖η‖) := by ring
    have hB : |-(inner ℝ w η) / 2 * (w i * w j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)
            + (η i * w j + w i * η j) / 4| ≤ ‖η‖ * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 := by
      have hcube : ‖w‖ ^ 3 ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hρ0 (by linarith) 3
      have hlin : ‖w‖ ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 := by

        have h2 : (1 + ‖ζ‖) ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 := le_self_pow₀ h1 (by norm_num)
        linarith
      calc _ ≤ |-(inner ℝ w η) / 2 * (w i * w j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)|

        _ = |inner ℝ w η| / 2 * |w i * w j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2|

            rw [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_div, abs_neg]; norm_num
        _ ≤ (‖w‖ * ‖η‖) / 2 * (‖w‖ * ‖w‖ / 4 + 1 / 2) + 2 * (‖w‖ * ‖η‖) / 4 := by
            gcongr
        _ = ‖η‖ * (‖w‖ ^ 3 / 8 + 3 * ‖w‖ / 4) := by ring
        _ ≤ ‖η‖ * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 := by

            linarith
    have hE : Real.exp (-(‖w‖ ^ 2) / 4) ≤ Real.exp (1 / 4) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 8) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hrρ) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖w‖ + 1 + ‖ζ‖),
        sq_nonneg (‖w‖ - 1)]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]

  have s5 : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → Real.exp (-(r ^ 2) / 8) * (1 + r) ^ 8 ≤ 2 ^ 8 * (1 + 24 * 8 ^ 4) := by

    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by rw [hx]; positivity
    have h1 : (1 + r) ^ 8 ≤ 2 ^ 8 * (1 + r ^ 8) := by
      rcases le_total r 1 with h | h
      · have h' : (1 + r) ^ 8 ≤ 2 ^ 8 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) 8
        have : 0 ≤ r ^ 8 := by positivity
        nlinarith
      · have h' : (1 + r) ^ 8 ≤ (2 * r) ^ 8 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) 8
        rw [mul_pow] at h'
        nlinarith
    have h2 : x ^ 4 / 24 ≤ Real.exp x := by
      have := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp x hx0 4
      simpa [Nat.factorial] using this
    have h3 : Real.exp (-x) * Real.exp x = 1 := by rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have h4 : Real.exp (-x) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)

      calc Real.exp (-x) * (8 ^ 4 * x ^ 4) = 24 * 8 ^ 4 * (Real.exp (-x) * (x ^ 4 / 24)) := by ring
        _ ≤ 24 * 8 ^ 4 * (Real.exp (-x) * Real.exp x) := by gcongr

    have hneg : -(r ^ 2) / 8 = -x := by rw [hx]; ring

    calc Real.exp (-x) * (1 + r) ^ 8 ≤ Real.exp (-x) * (2 ^ 8 * (1 + r ^ 8)) := by gcongr
      _ = 2 ^ 8 * (Real.exp (-x) + Real.exp (-x) * r ^ 8) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 ^ 8 * (1 + 24 * 8 ^ 4) := by linarith
  
  have s4 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (k : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ ζ : E3, k ζ = (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 4) *
        (ζ i * ζ j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)) →
      ∀ ζ η : E3, ‖η‖ ≤ 1 →
      |k (ζ + η) - k ζ| ≤ (4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (1 / 4) * ‖η‖ *
            Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 8) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3 := by
    intro i j k hk ζ η hη
    have h := norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment_01' (f := fun s : ℝ => k (ζ + s • η))

              ((ζ + t • η) i * (ζ + t • η) j / 4 - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / 2)

      (fun x _ => (s2 i j k hk ζ η x).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun x hx => by

    norm_num

  have hFc : Continuous (fun ζ : E3 => |k (ζ + η) - k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=

  have hF0 : ∀ ζ : E3, 0 ≤ |k (ζ + η) - k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    fun ζ => mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
  have hmaj : ∀ ζ : E3, |k (ζ + η) - k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤

        (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ (-(4 : ℝ)) := by
    intro ζ

    have h4 := s4 i j k hk ζ η hη
    have hsq : ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ‖ζ‖ := by
      rcases le_total ‖ζ‖ 1 with h | h
      · have := Real.rpow_le_one hr0 h (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
        linarith
      · have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1)

        linarith

    have key : Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 8) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 4 ≤

      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hpos]
      calc Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 8) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 4 * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 4
          = Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 8) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 8 := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := s5 ‖ζ‖ hr0
    have hrpow : (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ (-(4 : ℝ)) = ((1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 4)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg (by positivity), show (4 : ℝ) = ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) by norm_num,
        Real.rpow_natCast]
    calc |k (ζ + η) - k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
        ≤ ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (1 / 4) * ‖η‖ *
            Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 8) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 3) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) :=
          mul_le_mul h4 hsq (Real.rpow_nonneg hr0 _) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) h4)
      _ = ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (1 / 4) * ‖η‖) *
            (Real.exp (-(‖ζ‖ ^ 2) / 8) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 4) := by ring
      _ ≤ ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (1 / 4) * ‖η‖) *
            ((2 ^ 8 * (1 + 24 * 8 ^ 4)) * ((1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 4)⁻¹) :=
