  have hFi : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => |k (ζ + η) - k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=

  refine ⟨hFi, ?_⟩
  calc ∫ ζ : E3, |k (ζ + η) - k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
      ≤ ∫ ζ : E3, ((4 * Real.pi) ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) * Real.exp (1 / 4) *
          (2 ^ 8 * (1 + 24 * 8 ^ 4)) * ‖η‖) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ (-(4 : ℝ)) :=
        integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ hF0) hg (ae_of_all _ hmaj)
    _ = _ := by rw [integral_const_mul]; ring

(k f : E3 → ℝ) (K M s : ℝ) (x : E3) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (hk : Integrable k) (hk0 : ∫ ζ : E3, k ζ = 0)
    (hkm : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => |k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)))
    (hM : ∫ ζ : E3, |k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ M)
    (hfc : Continuous f) (hfb : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, |f z| ≤ B)
    (hf : ∀ y z : E3, |f y - f z| ≤ K * ‖y - z‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    |∫ ζ : E3, k ζ * f (x - s • ζ)| ≤ K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * M

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hfb
  have hFc : Continuous (fun ζ : E3 => f (x - s • ζ)) := by fun_prop
  have I₁ : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => k ζ * f (x - s • ζ)) := by
    refine Integrable.mono' (hk.norm.const_mul B)
      (hk.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hFc.aestronglyMeasurable) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
    intro ζ
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (f _), mul_comm B]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB _) (norm_nonneg _)
  have I₂ : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => k ζ * f x) := hk.mul_const (f x)
  have hsplit : ∫ ζ : E3, k ζ * f (x - s • ζ)
      = ∫ ζ : E3, (k ζ * f (x - s • ζ) - k ζ * f x) := by
    rw [integral_sub I₁ I₂, integral_mul_const, hk0, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  have hpt : ∀ ζ : E3, ‖k ζ * f (x - s • ζ) - k ζ * f x‖
      ≤ K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (|k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro ζ
    have h1 : ‖x - s • ζ - x‖ = s * ‖ζ‖ := by
      rw [sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs]
    have h2 := hf (x - s • ζ) x
    rw [h1, Real.mul_rpow hs (norm_nonneg ζ)] at h2
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← mul_sub, abs_mul]
    calc |k ζ| * |f (x - s • ζ) - f x|
        ≤ |k ζ| * (K * (s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (|k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by ring
  have hG : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (|k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))) :=
    hkm.const_mul _
  have hle := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hG (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hle
  rw [hsplit, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
  calc _ ≤ _ := hle
    _ ≤ K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * M :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM (mul_nonneg hK (Real.rpow_nonneg hs _))

informal_problem.statement:
(k f : E3 → ℝ) (K M s : ℝ) (x y : E3) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hk : Integrable k) (hk0 : ∫ ζ : E3, k ζ = 0)
    (hkm : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => |k (ζ + s⁻¹ • (y - x)) - k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)))
    (hM : ∫ ζ : E3, |k (ζ + s⁻¹ • (y - x)) - k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ M)
    (hfc : Continuous f) (hfb : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, |f z| ≤ B)
    (hf : ∀ y z : E3, |f y - f z| ≤ K * ‖y - z‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    |(∫ ζ : E3, k ζ * f (x - s • ζ)) - ∫ ζ : E3, k ζ * f (y - s • ζ)| ≤ K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * M

signature.name: kernel_holder_diff
signature.statement:
(k f : E3 → ℝ) (K M s : ℝ) (x y : E3) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hk : Integrable k) (hk0 : ∫ ζ : E3, k ζ = 0)
    (hkm : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => |k (ζ + s⁻¹ • (y - x)) - k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)))
    (hM : ∫ ζ : E3, |k (ζ + s⁻¹ • (y - x)) - k ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ M)
    (hfc : Continuous f) (hfb : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, |f z| ≤ B)
    (hf : ∀ y z : E3, |f y - f z| ≤ K * ‖y - z‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    |(∫ ζ : E3, k ζ * f (x - s • ζ)) - ∫ ζ : E3, k ζ * f (y - s • ζ)| ≤ K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * M

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hfb
  have hφc : Continuous (fun ζ : E3 => f (x - s • ζ)) :=
    hfc.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.smul continuous_id))
  have hφb : ∀ ζ : E3, ‖f (x - s • ζ)‖ ≤ B := fun ζ => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hB _
  have hkh : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => k (ζ + s⁻¹ • (y - x))) := hk.comp_add_right _
  have i1 : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => k ζ * f (x - s • ζ)) :=
    hk.mul_bdd hφc.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hφb)
  have i2 : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => k (ζ + s⁻¹ • (y - x)) * f (x - s • ζ)) :=
    hkh.mul_bdd hφc.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hφb)
  have hsub : ∀ ξ : E3, y - s • (ξ + s⁻¹ • (y - x)) = x - s • ξ := by
    intro ξ
    rw [smul_add, smul_inv_smul₀ hs.ne']
    abel
  have star : ∫ ζ : E3, k ζ * f (y - s • ζ)
      = ∫ ξ : E3, k (ξ + s⁻¹ • (y - x)) * f (x - s • ξ) := by
    have h1 := integral_add_right_eq_self (μ := (volume : Measure E3))
      (fun ζ => k ζ * f (y - s • ζ)) (s⁻¹ • (y - x))
    simp only [hsub] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hint : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => k (ζ + s⁻¹ • (y - x)) - k ζ) := hkh.sub hk
  have hmean : ∫ ζ : E3, (k (ζ + s⁻¹ • (y - x)) - k ζ) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_sub hkh hk]
    have h2 := integral_add_right_eq_self (μ := (volume : Measure E3)) k (s⁻¹ • (y - x))
    rw [h2]; ring
  have small : ∀ k' : E3 → ℝ, Integrable k' → ∫ ζ : E3, k' ζ = 0 →
      Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => |k' ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) →
      ∫ ζ : E3, |k' ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ M →
      |∫ ζ : E3, k' ζ * f (x - s • ζ)| ≤ K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * M := by
    intro k' hk' hk'0 hk'm hk'M
    have I₂ : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => k' ζ * f x) := hk'.mul_const (f x)
    have I₁ : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => k' ζ * f (x - s • ζ)) :=
      hk'.mul_bdd hφc.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hφb)
    have hsplit : ∫ ζ : E3, k' ζ * f (x - s • ζ)
        = ∫ ζ : E3, (k' ζ * f (x - s • ζ) - k' ζ * f x) := by
      rw [integral_sub I₁ I₂, integral_mul_const, hk'0, zero_mul, sub_zero]
    have hpt : ∀ ζ : E3, ‖k' ζ * f (x - s • ζ) - k' ζ * f x‖
        ≤ K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (|k' ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
      intro ζ
      have h1 : ‖x - s • ζ - x‖ = s * ‖ζ‖ := by
        rw [sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs.le]
      have h2 := hf (x - s • ζ) x
      rw [h1, Real.mul_rpow hs.le (norm_nonneg ζ)] at h2
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← mul_sub, abs_mul]
      calc |k' ζ| * |f (x - s • ζ) - f x|
          ≤ |k' ζ| * (K * (s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (|k' ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := by ring
    have hG : Integrable (fun ζ : E3 => K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (|k' ζ| * ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))) :=
      hk'm.const_mul _
    have hle := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hG (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
    rw [integral_const_mul] at hle
    rw [hsplit, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc _ ≤ _ := hle
      _ ≤ K * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * M :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk'M (mul_nonneg hK (Real.rpow_nonneg hs.le _))
  have key := small (fun ζ => k (ζ + s⁻¹ • (y - x)) - k ζ) hint hmean hkm hM
  have hdiff : (∫ ζ : E3, k ζ * f (x - s • ζ)) - ∫ ζ : E3, k ζ * f (y - s • ζ)
      = -∫ ζ : E3, (k (ζ + s⁻¹ • (y - x)) - k ζ) * f (x - s • ζ) := by
    rw [star, ← integral_sub i1 i2, ← integral_neg]
    congr 1; funext ζ; ring
  rw [hdiff, abs_neg]
  exact key

informal_problem.statement:
(T₁ T₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b d : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (h1 : IntegrableOn T₁ (Set.Ioi 0)) (h2 : IntegrableOn T₂ (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hs1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → |T₁ t| ≤ a * t ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)))
    (hs2 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → |T₂ t| ≤ a * t ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)))
    (hl : ∀ t : ℝ, d ^ 2 ≤ t → |T₁ t - T₂ t| ≤ b * t ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ))) :
    |(∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), T₁ t) - ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), T₂ t|
      ≤ 8 * a * d ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 4 * b * d ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))

signature.name: time_split_bound
signature.statement:
(T₁ T₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b d : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (h1 : IntegrableOn T₁ (Set.Ioi 0)) (h2 : IntegrableOn T₂ (Set.Ioi 0))
    (hs1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → |T₁ t| ≤ a * t ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)))
    (hs2 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → |T₂ t| ≤ a * t ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)))
    (hl : ∀ t : ℝ, d ^ 2 ≤ t → |T₁ t - T₂ t| ≤ b * t ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ))) :
    |(∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), T₁ t) - ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), T₂ t|
      ≤ 8 * a * d ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 4 * b * d ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  set D : ℝ := d ^ 2 with hDdef
  have hD : 0 < D := by positivity
  have hU : Set.Ioc 0 D ∪ Set.Ioi D = Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hD.le
  have hsubS : Set.Ioc 0 D ⊆ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self
  have hsubL : Set.Ioi D ⊆ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := Set.Ioi_subset_Ioi hD.le
  have h1S := h1.mono_set hsubS
  have h1L := h1.mono_set hsubL
  have h2S := h2.mono_set hsubS
  have h2L := h2.mono_set hsubL
  have hsplit : ∀ T : ℝ → ℝ, IntegrableOn T (Set.Ioc 0 D) → IntegrableOn T (Set.Ioi D) →
      ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), T t = (∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 D, T t) + ∫ t in Set.Ioi D, T t := by
    intro T hS hL
    rw [← hU]
    exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi_same measurableSet_Ioi hS hL
  have hpS : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ))) (Set.Ioc 0 D) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hD.le).mp
      (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_rpow' (by norm_num))
  have hvS : ∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 D, t ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)) = 4 * D ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hD.le, integral_rpow (Or.inl (by norm_num))]
    rw [show (-(3 / 4 : ℝ)) + 1 = 1 / 4 by norm_num, Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num)]
    ring
  have hsmall : ∀ T : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → |T t| ≤ a * t ^ (-(3 / 4 : ℝ))) →
      |∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 D, T t| ≤ 4 * a * D ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    intro T hT
    have h := MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hpS.const_mul a)
      (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioc (fun t ht => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hT t ht.1))
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, hvS, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    linarith
  have hpL : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ))) (Set.Ioi D) :=
    integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by norm_num) hD
  have hvL : ∫ t in Set.Ioi D, t ^ (-(5 / 4 : ℝ)) = 4 * D ^ (-(1 / 4) : ℝ) := by
    rw [integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by norm_num) hD]
    rw [show (-(5 / 4 : ℝ)) + 1 = -(1 / 4) by norm_num]
    ring
  have hlarge : |(∫ t in Set.Ioi D, T₁ t) - ∫ t in Set.Ioi D, T₂ t|
      ≤ 4 * b * D ^ (-(1 / 4) : ℝ) := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_sub h1L h2L]
    have h := MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hpL.const_mul b)
      (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioi (fun t (ht : D < t) => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hl t ht.le))
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, hvL, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    linarith
  have e1 : D ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) = d ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hDdef, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hd.le]; norm_num
  have e2 : D ^ (-(1 / 4) : ℝ) = d ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hDdef, ← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hd.le]; norm_num
  rw [hsplit T₁ h1S h1L, hsplit T₂ h2S h2L]
  have hA1 := hsmall T₁ hs1
  have hA2 := hsmall T₂ hs2
  rw [e1] at hA1 hA2
  rw [e2] at hlarge
  have key : ∀ x y z w : ℝ, |(x + y) - (z + w)| ≤ |x| + |z| + |y - w| := by
    intro x y z w
    calc |(x + y) - (z + w)| = |(x + -z) + (y - w)| := by congr 1; ring
      _ ≤ |x + -z| + |y - w| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ |x| + |-z| + |y - w| := by gcongr; exact abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |x| + |z| + |y - w| := by rw [abs_neg]
  have hk := key (∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 D, T₁ t) (∫ t in Set.Ioi D, T₁ t)
    (∫ t in Set.Ioc 0 D, T₂ t) (∫ t in Set.Ioi D, T₂ t)
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(F F' : E3 → ℝ) (y₀ : E3) (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F y₀)
    (hF' : DifferentiableAt ℝ F' y₀) (h0 : F y₀ = 0) (h0' : F' y₀ = 0)
    (hne : fderiv ℝ F y₀ ≠ 0) (hne' : fderiv ℝ F' y₀ ≠ 0)
    (hsgn : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, 0 ≤ F y * F' y) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ fderiv ℝ F' y₀ = c • fderiv ℝ F y₀

signature.name: fderiv_pos_proportional
signature.statement:
(F F' : E3 → ℝ) (y₀ : E3) (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F y₀)
    (hF' : DifferentiableAt ℝ F' y₀) (h0 : F y₀ = 0) (h0' : F' y₀ = 0)
    (hne : fderiv ℝ F y₀ ≠ 0) (hne' : fderiv ℝ F' y₀ ≠ 0)
    (hsgn : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, 0 ≤ F y * F' y) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ fderiv ℝ F' y₀ = c • fderiv ℝ F y₀

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hdir : ∀ v : E3, 0 ≤ fderiv ℝ F y₀ v * fderiv ℝ F' y₀ v := by
    intro v
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y₀ + t • v) v 0 := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t • v) ((1 : ℝ) • v) 0 :=
        (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const v
      rw [one_smul] at h1
      exact h1.const_add y₀
    have hγ0 : (fun t : ℝ => y₀ + t • v) 0 = y₀ := by simp
    have hslope : ∀ (G : E3 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ G y₀ → G y₀ = 0 →
        Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ * G (y₀ + t • v)) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ G y₀ v)) := by
      intro G hG hG0
      have hGa : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G y₀) ((fun t : ℝ => y₀ + t • v) 0) := by
        rw [hγ0]; exact hG.hasFDerivAt
      have hd : HasDerivAt (G ∘ fun t : ℝ => y₀ + t • v) (fderiv ℝ G y₀ v) 0 :=
        hGa.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hγ
      have ht := (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope_zero).mp hd
      refine ht.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards with t
      simp [Function.comp, hG0, smul_eq_mul]
    have hprod := (hslope F hF h0).mul (hslope F' hF' h0')
    have hev1 := hprod.eventually_lt_const hneg
    have hcont : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => y₀ + t • v) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 y₀) := by
      have h := (hγ.continuousAt).tendsto
      simpa using h
    have hev2 : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ F (y₀ + t • v) * F' (y₀ + t • v) :=
      (hcont.eventually hsgn).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    obtain ⟨t, ht1, ht2⟩ := (hev1.and hev2).exists
    have : (t⁻¹ * F (y₀ + t • v)) * (t⁻¹ * F' (y₀ + t • v)) =
        (t⁻¹ * t⁻¹) * (F (y₀ + t • v) * F' (y₀ + t • v)) := by ring
    have h3 : 0 ≤ (t⁻¹ * t⁻¹) * (F (y₀ + t • v) * F' (y₀ + t • v)) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_self_nonneg _) ht2
    linarith
  
  set L := fderiv ℝ F y₀ with hLdef
  set L' := fderiv ℝ F' y₀ with hL'def
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ : ∃ v₀ : E3, L v₀ ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hall
    push_neg at hall
    exact hne (ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => by simp [hall x])
  set a := L v₀ with ha
  set b := L' v₀ with hb
  set c := b / a with hc
  have hbc : b = c * a := by rw [hc]; field_simp
  have hprop : ∀ w : E3, L' w = c * L w := by
    intro w
    set x := L w with hx
    set y := L' w with hy
    set δ := y - c * x with hδ
    set κ := 1 / (1 + |a * b|) with hκ
    have hpos1 : 0 < 1 + |a * b| := by positivity
    have hκpos : 0 < κ := by positivity
    have hκmul : κ * (1 + |a * b|) = 1 := by rw [hκ]; field_simp
    set t := -(δ * a * κ) with ht
    have hLv : L (w + (t - x / a) • v₀) = t * a := by
      rw [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← hx, ← ha]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hL'v : L' (w + (t - x / a) • v₀) = δ + t * b := by
      rw [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← hy, ← hb, hbc, hδ]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hP := hdir (w + (t - x / a) • v₀)
    rw [hLv, hL'v] at hP
    have hkey : t * a * (δ + t * b) = (δ * a) ^ 2 * (κ * (κ * (a * b) - 1)) := by
      rw [ht]; ring
    rw [hkey] at hP
    have hab : κ * (a * b) < 1 := by
      have h1 : a * b ≤ |a * b| := le_abs_self _
      have h2 : κ * (a * b) ≤ κ * |a * b| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hκpos.le
      nlinarith
    have hneg : κ * (κ * (a * b) - 1) < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hκpos (by linarith)
    have hsq : (δ * a) ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hcon hneg
      linarith
    have hsq0 : (δ * a) ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm hsq (sq_nonneg _)
    have hδa : δ * a = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp hsq0
    have hδ0 : δ = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hδa with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h hv₀
    rw [hδ] at hδ0
    linarith
  have hL'eq : L' = c • L := ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun w => by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact hprop w
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hL'eq⟩
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hne'
    rw [hL'eq, h, zero_smul]
  have hcnn : 0 ≤ c := by
    have h : 0 ≤ a * b := hdir v₀
    rw [hbc] at h
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have ha2 : 0 < a * a := mul_self_pos.mpr hv₀
    have : c * (a * a) < 0 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hcon ha2
    nlinarith
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hcnn (Ne.symm hc0)

informal_problem.statement:
{ι : Type*} (J : Finset ι) (Ψ F : ι → E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (hΨ : ∀ m ∈ J, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Ψ m) U)
    (hF : ∀ m ∈ J, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F m) U) (hF0 : ∀ m ∈ J, F m y₀ = 0) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * F m z) y₀ = ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m y₀ • fderiv ℝ (F m) y₀ ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * F m z)) y₀ =
        ∑ m ∈ J, (Ψ m y₀ * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (F m)) y₀
          + partialDeriv i (Ψ m) y₀ * partialDeriv j (F m) y₀
          + partialDeriv i (F m) y₀ * partialDeriv j (Ψ m) y₀)

signature.name: second_order_product_sum
signature.statement:
{ι : Type*} (J : Finset ι) (Ψ F : ι → E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (hΨ : ∀ m ∈ J, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Ψ m) U)
    (hF : ∀ m ∈ J, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F m) U) (hF0 : ∀ m ∈ J, F m y₀ = 0) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * F m z) y₀ = ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m y₀ • fderiv ℝ (F m) y₀ ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * F m z)) y₀ =
        ∑ m ∈ J, (Ψ m y₀ * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (F m)) y₀
          + partialDeriv i (Ψ m) y₀ * partialDeriv j (F m) y₀
          + partialDeriv i (F m) y₀ * partialDeriv j (Ψ m) y₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s2 : ∀ (A B : ι → E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), (∀ m ∈ J, DifferentiableAt ℝ (A m) y) →
      (∀ m ∈ J, DifferentiableAt ℝ (B m) y) →
      HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∑ m ∈ J, A m z * B m z)
        (∑ m ∈ J, (A m y • fderiv ℝ (B m) y + B m y • fderiv ℝ (A m) y)) y := by
    intro A B y hA hB
    exact HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (fun m hm => (hA m hm).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul (hB m hm).hasFDerivAt)
  
  have s1 : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv j f) U := by
    intro f hf j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e j)) U
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hdiff : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ f z := by
    intro f hf z hz
    exact (hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [(s2 Ψ F y₀ (fun m hm => hdiff _ (hΨ m hm) y₀ hy₀)
      (fun m hm => hdiff _ (hF m hm) y₀ hy₀)).fderiv]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
    rw [hF0 m hm, zero_smul, add_zero]
  · intro i j
    have hEq : partialDeriv j (fun z => ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * F m z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y₀]
        fun z => (∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * partialDeriv j (F m) z)
          + ∑ m ∈ J, F m z * partialDeriv j (Ψ m) z := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hy₀] with z hz
      have h := (s2 Ψ F z (fun m hm => hdiff _ (hΨ m hm) z hz)
        (fun m hm => hdiff _ (hF m hm) z hz)).fderiv
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * F m z) z (e j) =
        (∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * fderiv ℝ (F m) z (e j)) + ∑ m ∈ J, F m z * fderiv ℝ (Ψ m) z (e j)
      rw [h]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sum', Finset.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul', Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have hQ : HasFDerivAt (fun z => (∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * partialDeriv j (F m) z)
          + ∑ m ∈ J, F m z * partialDeriv j (Ψ m) z) _ y₀ :=
      (s2 Ψ (fun m => partialDeriv j (F m)) y₀ (fun m hm => hdiff _ (hΨ m hm) y₀ hy₀)
        (fun m hm => hdiff _ (s1 _ (hF m hm) j) y₀ hy₀)).add
      (s2 F (fun m => partialDeriv j (Ψ m)) y₀ (fun m hm => hdiff _ (hF m hm) y₀ hy₀)
        (fun m hm => hdiff _ (s1 _ (hΨ m hm) j) y₀ hy₀))
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (fun z => ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * F m z)) y₀ (e i) = _
    rw [hEq.fderiv_eq, hQ.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sum', Finset.sum_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul', Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
    rw [hF0 m hm]
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    ring

    (hP : ∀ i j, P i j = P j i) (ν : Fin 3 → ℝ) (lam c : ι → ℝ) (w : ι → Fin 3 → ℝ)

        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (Λ * ν i) * (Λ * ν j)) ^ 3 = 0

signature.name: levelMeanCurv_alg_combination
signature.statement:
{ι : Type*} (J : Finset ι) (P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ i j, P i j = P j i) (ν : Fin 3 → ℝ) (lam c : ι → ℝ) (w : ι → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (H : ι → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ) (Hβ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hlam : ∀ m ∈ J, 0 < lam m) (hΛdef : Λ = ∑ m ∈ J, c m * lam m) (hΛ : 0 < Λ)
    (hHβ : ∀ i j, Hβ i j = ∑ m ∈ J, (c m * H m i j + w m i * (lam m * ν j)
      + lam m * ν i * w m j))
    (hH : ∀ m ∈ J, (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * H m i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (lam m * ν i) * (lam m * ν j)) -
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        P i a * (lam m * ν a) * (P j b * (lam m * ν b)) * H m i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (lam m * ν i) * (lam m * ν j)) ^ 3 = 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * Hβ i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (Λ * ν i) * (Λ * ν j)) -
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        P i a * (Λ * ν a) * (P j b * (Λ * ν b)) * Hβ i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (Λ * ν i) * (Λ * ν j)) ^ 3 = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQdef⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ, Q = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * ν i * ν j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQt : ∀ t : ℝ,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (t * ν i) * (t * ν j) = t ^ 2 * Q := by
    intro t
    rw [hQdef]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hNt : ∀ (t : ℝ) (K : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        P i a * (t * ν a) * (P j b * (t * ν b)) * K i j =
      t ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        P i a * ν a * (P j b * ν b) * K i j := by
    intro t K
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  rcases le_or_gt Q 0 with hQ | hQ
  · 
    have h0 : Real.sqrt (Λ ^ 2 * Q) = 0 :=
      Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.mpr (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sq_nonneg Λ) hQ)
    rw [hQt Λ, h0]
    simp
  · 
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt Q := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt Q ^ 2 = Q := Real.sq_sqrt hQ.le
    have key : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ K : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * K i j) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (t * ν i) * (t * ν j)) -
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          P i a * (t * ν a) * (P j b * (t * ν b)) * K i j) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (t * ν i) * (t * ν j)) ^ 3 = 0) ↔
        Q * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * K i j) -
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            P i a * ν a * (P j b * ν b) * K i j) = 0 := by
      intro t ht K
      rw [hQt t, hNt t K, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg t), Real.sqrt_sq ht.le]
      have hts : 0 < t * Real.sqrt Q := mul_pos ht hs
      rw [sub_eq_zero, div_eq_div_iff hts.ne' (pow_pos hts 3).ne', sub_eq_zero]
      constructor
      · intro h
        have h3 : (t ^ 3 * Real.sqrt Q) *
            (Q * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * K i j) -
              (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
                P i a * ν a * (P j b * ν b) * K i j)) = 0 := by
          linear_combination h - (t ^ 3 * Real.sqrt Q *
            (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * K i j)) * hs2
        have hne : t ^ 3 * Real.sqrt Q ≠ 0 := (mul_pos (pow_pos ht 3) hs).ne'
        have h4 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left hne
        linarith
      · intro h
        linear_combination (t ^ 3 * Real.sqrt Q *
            (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * K i j)) * hs2 + (t ^ 3 * Real.sqrt Q) * h
    have hD : ∀ m ∈ J, Q * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * H m i j) -
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          P i a * ν a * (P j b * ν b) * H m i j) = 0 :=
      fun m hm => (key (lam m) (hlam m hm) (H m)).mp (hH m hm)
    rw [key Λ hΛ Hβ]
    simp only [hHβ, Fin.sum_univ_three, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m hm => ?_)
    have h := hD m hm
    subst hQdef
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h ⊢
    simp only [hP 1 0, hP 2 0, hP 2 1] at h ⊢
    linear_combination c m * h

    (hmonoK : ∀ t K K', P t K → K ≤ K' → P t K')
    (hmonot : ∀ t s K, t ≤ s → P s K → P t K)
    (hclosed : ∀ t K, (∀ K', K < K' → P t K') → P t K)
    (hinit : P τ₁ K₁)
    (hstep : ∀ t s K, τ₀ ≤ t → t < s → s ≤ τ₁ → P s K → P t (K / 2 + A * ((s - t) ^ 3)⁻¹)) :
    P τ₀ (4000 * A * ((τ₁ - τ₀) ^ 3)⁻¹)

signature.name: giaquinta_iteration
signature.statement:
(P : ℝ → ℝ → Prop) (τ₀ τ₁ A K₁ : ℝ) (hτ : τ₀ < τ₁) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hmonoK : ∀ t K K', P t K → K ≤ K' → P t K')
    (hmonot : ∀ t s K, t ≤ s → P s K → P t K)
    (hclosed : ∀ t K, (∀ K', K < K' → P t K') → P t K)
    (hinit : P τ₁ K₁)
    (hstep : ∀ t s K, τ₀ ≤ t → t < s → s ≤ τ₁ → P s K → P t (K / 2 + A * ((s - t) ^ 3)⁻¹)) :
    P τ₀ (4000 * A * ((τ₁ - τ₀) ^ 3)⁻¹)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = τ₁ - τ₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD : 0 < D := by rw [hDdef]; linarith
  obtain ⟨E, hEdef⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = A * (D ^ 3)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := by rw [hEdef]; positivity
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, c = fun m => (5 / 6 : ℝ) ^ m := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨t, htdef⟩ : ∃ t : ℕ → ℝ, t = fun m => τ₁ - D * c m := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hbdef⟩ : ∃ b : ℕ → ℝ, b = fun m => 2000 * E * ((6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 3 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : ∀ m, 0 < c m := fun m => by rw [hcdef]; positivity
  have hc1 : ∀ m, c m ≤ 1 := fun m => by
    rw [hcdef]; exact pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hcs : ∀ m, c (m + 1) = c m * (5 / 6) := fun m => by rw [hcdef]; exact pow_succ _ _
  have ht_lo : ∀ m, τ₀ ≤ t m := by
    intro m
    have := mul_le_of_le_one_right hD.le (hc1 m)
    rw [htdef]
    show τ₀ ≤ τ₁ - D * c m
    linarith
  have ht_hi : ∀ m, t m ≤ τ₁ := by
    intro m
    have := mul_pos hD (hc0 m)
    rw [htdef]
    show τ₁ - D * c m ≤ τ₁
    linarith
  have hgap : ∀ m, t (m + 1) - t m = D * c m / 6 := by
    intro m
    rw [htdef]
    show (τ₁ - D * c (m + 1)) - (τ₁ - D * c m) = _
    rw [hcs]; ring
  have ht_lt : ∀ m, t m < t (m + 1) := by
    intro m
    have h1 := hgap m
    have h2 : 0 < D * c m / 6 := by have := hc0 m; positivity
    linarith
  have hinvc : ∀ m, (6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m = (c m)⁻¹ := by
    intro m
    rw [hcdef]
    show (6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m = ((5 / 6 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹
    rw [← inv_pow]; norm_num
  have hs2 : ∀ m, A * ((t (m + 1) - t m) ^ 3)⁻¹ = 216 * E * ((6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 3 := by
    intro m
    rw [hgap, hinvc, hEdef]
    have hcne : c m ≠ 0 := (hc0 m).ne'
    have hDne : D ≠ 0 := hD.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  have hb0 : ∀ m, 0 ≤ b m := fun m => by rw [hbdef]; positivity
  have hs3 : ∀ m, b (m + 1) / 2 + 216 * E * ((6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 3 ≤ b m := by
    intro m
    rw [hbdef]
    show 2000 * E * ((6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1)) ^ 3 / 2 + 216 * E * ((6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 3
      ≤ 2000 * E * ((6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 3
    have hu : 0 ≤ ((6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ m) ^ 3 := by positivity
    have := mul_nonneg hE hu
    rw [pow_succ (6 / 5 : ℝ) m, mul_pow]
    nlinarith
  have hQ : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, P (t m) (K₁ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n + b m) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro m
      have h1 := hmonot (t m) τ₁ K₁ (ht_hi m) hinit
      refine hmonoK _ _ _ h1 ?_
      have := hb0 m
      simp only [pow_zero, mul_one]
      linarith
    | succ n ih =>
      intro m
      have h1 := hstep (t m) (t (m + 1)) _ (ht_lo m) (ht_lt m) (ht_hi (m + 1)) (ih (m + 1))
      rw [hs2] at h1
      refine hmonoK _ _ _ h1 ?_
      have := hs3 m
      rw [pow_succ (1 / 2 : ℝ) n]
      linarith
  have ht0 : t 0 = τ₀ := by
    rw [htdef, hcdef]
    show τ₁ - D * (5 / 6 : ℝ) ^ 0 = τ₀
    rw [pow_zero, mul_one, hDdef]; ring
  have hb00 : b 0 = 2000 * E := by
    rw [hbdef]
    show 2000 * E * ((6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ 0) ^ 3 = 2000 * E
    simp
  have h0 : ∀ n : ℕ, P τ₀ (K₁ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n + 2000 * E) := by
    intro n
    have := hQ n 0
    rwa [ht0, hb00] at this
  have hgoal : 4000 * A * ((τ₁ - τ₀) ^ 3)⁻¹ = 4000 * E := by rw [hEdef, hDdef]; ring
  rw [hgoal]
  apply hclosed
  intro K' hK'
  have hδ : 0 < K' - 2000 * E := by linarith
  have hpos : 0 < (K' - 2000 * E) / (|K₁| + 1) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hpos (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
  have hpn : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by positivity
  have h1 : K₁ * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ |K₁| * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hpn
  have h2 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n * (|K₁| + 1) < K' - 2000 * E := by
    rwa [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hn
  refine hmonoK _ _ _ (h0 n) ?_
  nlinarith

    (hmh : m + h ≤ s) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 w (Metric.ball 0 s))

      |partialDeriv i w x - partialDeriv i w y|

signature.name: interior_interpolation
signature.statement:
(w : E3 → ℝ) (s m h M₀ H : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hmh : m + h ≤ s) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 w (Metric.ball 0 s))
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) s, |w x| ≤ M₀)

  have f2 : (M₀ / ρ + H * q * ρ) / ρ + H * q = 4 * P + 2 * (H * q) := by
    rw [f1, hρr]; field_simp <;> ring
  have f3 : 2 * (M₀ / ρ + H * q * ρ) / r + 3 * ((M₀ / ρ + H * q * ρ) / ρ + H * q) * r
      = 16 * P * r + 7 * (H * q * r) := by
    rw [f2, f1]; field_simp <;> ring
  have f4 : 2 * M₀ / r + 3 * (M₀ / ρ + H * q * ρ) * r = 8 * P * r ^ 3 + 3 / 2 * (H * q * r ^ 3) := by
    rw [f1, hM₀P]; field_simp <;> ring
  have g1 : M₀ / (r ^ 2) ^ 2 = P := by rw [hPdef]; ring
  have g2 : M₀ / r ^ 2 = P * r ^ 2 := by rw [hM₀P, div_eq_iff (pow_ne_zero 2 hr0)]; ring
  have g3 : M₀ / r ^ 3 = P * r := by rw [hM₀P, div_eq_iff (pow_ne_zero 3 hr0)]; ring
  have g4 : M₀ / r = P * r ^ 3 := by rw [hM₀P, div_eq_iff hr0]; ring
  have hHq : H * q ≤ H * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqr hH0
  have hW1 : 0 ≤ M₀ / ρ + H * q * ρ :=
    le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (grad 0 0 (by rw [norm_zero]; linarith))
  have hW2 : 0 ≤ (M₀ / ρ + H * q * ρ) / ρ + H * q :=
    le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hess 0 0 0 (by rw [norm_zero]; linarith))
  have hms : Metric.ball (0 : E3) m ⊆ Metric.ball 0 s := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  
  intro x hx y hy i j
  have hxn : ‖x‖ < m := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hx
  have hxn' : ‖x‖ < m + ρ := by linarith
  rw [← hrdef, h32, hrr, g1, g2, g3, g4]
  have hrH : 0 ≤ r * H := mul_nonneg hr.le hH0
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hb := hess i j x hxn
    rw [f2] at hb
    linarith
  · have hb := grad i x hxn'
    rw [f1] at hb
    have a1 : H * q * r ^ 2 ≤ H * r * r ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hHq (by positivity)
    have a2 : 0 ≤ P * r ^ 2 := by positivity
    have a3 : 0 ≤ r ^ 3 * H := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hH0
    nlinarith
  · have kk := holder (fun z => partialDeriv i w z) _ _ hW1 hW2
      (fun p hp => hd1 i p (hms hp))
      (fun p hp => grad i p (by have := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hp; linarith))
      (fun p hp l => hess l i p (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hp)) x hx y hy
    rw [f3] at kk
    refine le_trans kk ?_
    have a1 : H * q * r ≤ H * r * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hHq hr.le
    have a2 : 0 ≤ P * r := by positivity
    have a3 : 0 ≤ r ^ 2 * H := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hH0
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
  · have kk := holder w _ _ hM0 hW1
      (fun p hp => hdw p (hms hp))
      (fun p hp => hM p (hms hp))
      (fun p hp l => grad l p (by have := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hp; linarith)) x hx y hy
    rw [f4] at kk
    refine le_trans kk ?_
    have a1 : H * q * r ^ 3 ≤ H * r * r ^ 3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hHq (by positivity)
    have a2 : 0 ≤ P * r ^ 3 := by positivity
    have a3 : 0 ≤ (r ^ 2) ^ 2 * H := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hH0
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)

informal_problem.statement:
(f : E3 → ℝ) (S : Set E3) (hconv : Convex ℝ S) (L : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hb : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k f x| ≤ L) :
    ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, |f x - f y| ≤ 3 * L * ‖x - y‖

signature.name: lip_of_partials
signature.statement:
(f : E3 → ℝ) (S : Set E3) (hconv : Convex ℝ S) (L : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hb : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k f x| ≤ L) :
    ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, |f x - f y| ≤ 3 * L * ‖x - y‖

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx y hy
  have hL : 0 ≤ L := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hb x hx 0)
  have hnorm : ∀ z ∈ S, ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ ≤ 3 * L := by
    intro z hz
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by linarith) ?_
    intro v
    have hv : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hD : fderiv ℝ f z v = v 0 * partialDeriv 0 f z + v 1 * partialDeriv 1 f z
        + v 2 * partialDeriv 2 f z := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rfl
    have h0 : |v 0| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le v 0
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have h1 : |v 1| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le v 1
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have h2 : |v 2| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le v 2
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have b0 := hb z hz 0
    have b1 := hb z hz 1
    have b2 := hb z hz 2
    have m0 : |v 0 * partialDeriv 0 f z| ≤ ‖v‖ * L := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul h0 b0 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    have m1 : |v 1 * partialDeriv 1 f z| ≤ ‖v‖ * L := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul h1 b1 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    have m2 : |v 2 * partialDeriv 2 f z| ≤ ‖v‖ * L := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul h2 b2 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hD]
    calc |v 0 * partialDeriv 0 f z + v 1 * partialDeriv 1 f z + v 2 * partialDeriv 2 f z|
        ≤ |v 0 * partialDeriv 0 f z + v 1 * partialDeriv 1 f z| + |v 2 * partialDeriv 2 f z| :=
          abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ |v 0 * partialDeriv 0 f z| + |v 1 * partialDeriv 1 f z| + |v 2 * partialDeriv 2 f z| := by
          linarith [abs_add_le (v 0 * partialDeriv 0 f z) (v 1 * partialDeriv 1 f z)]
      _ ≤ 3 * L * ‖v‖ := by linarith
  have h := hconv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hf hnorm hy hx
  rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h

informal_problem.statement:
(C_G : ℝ) (hCG : 0 ≤ C_G)
    (hG : ∀ (ψ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ K : ℝ,
      (∀ x y : E3, |∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) x
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) y| ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) →
      ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x y : E3), |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) x
          - partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) y| ≤ C_G * K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    ∃ ε₀ A₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 ≤ A₀ ∧
      ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ) (ε M : ℝ),
        0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ ε₀ → 0 ≤ M →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w (Metric.ball 0 2) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, |w z| ≤ M) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ z' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
          (∀ i j : Fin 3, |a z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε ∧
             |a z i j - a z' i j| ≤ ε * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
          (∀ k : Fin 3, |b z k| ≤ ε ∧ |b z k - b z' k| ≤ ε * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
          |F z| ≤ M ∧ |F z - F z'| ≤ M * ‖z - z'‖) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a z i j * partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j w y) z
            - ∑ k : Fin 3, b z k * partialDeriv k w z = F z) →
        ∀ t s K : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ t → t < s → s ≤ 1 →
          (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) s, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) s, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
            |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) x
              - partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) y| ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) →
          (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) t, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) t, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
            |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) x
              - partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) y|
              ≤ (K / 2 + A₀ * M * ((s - t) ^ 3)⁻¹) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))

signature.name: cutoff_step
signature.statement:
(C_G : ℝ) (hCG : 0 ≤ C_G)
    (hG : ∀ (ψ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ K : ℝ,
      (∀ x y : E3, |∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) x
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) y| ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) →
      ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x y : E3), |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) x
          - partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) y| ≤ C_G * K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    ∃ ε₀ A₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 ≤ A₀ ∧
      ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ) (ε M : ℝ),
        0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ ε₀ → 0 ≤ M →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w (Metric.ball 0 2) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, |w z| ≤ M) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ z' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
          (∀ i j : Fin 3, |a z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε ∧
             |a z i j - a z' i j| ≤ ε * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
          (∀ k : Fin 3, |b z k| ≤ ε ∧ |b z k - b z' k| ≤ ε * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
          |F z| ≤ M ∧ |F z - F z'| ≤ M * ‖z - z'‖) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a z i j * partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j w y) z
            - ∑ k : Fin 3, b z k * partialDeriv k w z = F z) →
        ∀ t s K : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ t → t < s → s ≤ 1 →
          (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) s, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) s, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
            |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) x
              - partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) y| ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) →
          (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) t, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) t, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
            |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) x
              - partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) y|
              ≤ (K / 2 + A₀ * M * ((s - t) ^ 3)⁻¹) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, hcut⟩ := radial_cutoff_holder
  
  obtain ⟨ν, hνdef⟩ : ∃ ν : ℝ, ν = 1 / (10000 * Λ * C_G + 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hden : 0 < 10000 * Λ * C_G + 2 := by positivity
  have hν : 0 < ν := by rw [hνdef]; positivity
  have hνmul : ν * (10000 * Λ * C_G + 2) = 1 := by rw [hνdef]; field_simp
  have hΛC : 0 ≤ ν * Λ * C_G := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hν.le hΛ) hCG
  have hν2 : ν ≤ 1 / 2 := by nlinarith
  have hν1 : ν ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hνabs : C_G * (2500 * Λ * ν) ≤ 1 / 4 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀def⟩ : ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, ε₀ = 1 / (10836 * C_G + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hε₀ : 0 < ε₀ := by rw [hε₀def]; positivity
  have hε₀mul : ε₀ * (10836 * C_G + 1) = 1 := by rw [hε₀def]; field_simp
  have hεC : 0 ≤ ε₀ * C_G := mul_nonneg hε₀.le hCG
  have hε₀1 : ε₀ ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hε₀abs : C_G * (2709 * ε₀) ≤ 1 / 4 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀def⟩ : ∃ A₀ : ℝ, A₀ = C_G * (2702 + 2502 * Λ) / ν ^ 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA₀ : 0 ≤ A₀ := by rw [hA₀def]; positivity
  refine ⟨ε₀, A₀, hε₀, hA₀, ?_⟩
  intro w a b F ε M hε hεε₀ hM hw hwb hcoef heq t s K ht hts hs hP
  have hε1 : ε ≤ 1 := le_trans hεε₀ hε₀1
  
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := by
    have hy₀ : ‖(1 / 4 : ℝ) • e 0‖ = 1 / 4 := by
      simp [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    have h0s : (0 : E3) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) s := Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith)
    have hys : (1 / 4 : ℝ) • e 0 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) s := by
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, hy₀]; linarith
    have h1 := hP 0 h0s _ hys 0 0
    have hn : ‖(0 : E3) - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • e 0‖ = 1 / 4 := by rw [zero_sub, norm_neg, hy₀]
    rw [hn] at h1
    have hpos : 0 < (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    by_contra hKn
    push_neg at hKn
    have h2 : K * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 0 := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hKn hpos
    have h3 := abs_nonneg (partialDeriv 0 (fun z => partialDeriv 0 w z) 0
      - partialDeriv 0 (fun z => partialDeriv 0 w z) ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • e 0))
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℝ, d = s - t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hd0 : 0 < d := by rw [hd]; linarith
  have hd1 : d ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [hd]; linarith
  obtain ⟨δ, hδdef⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = Real.sqrt d := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by rw [hδdef]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hd0
  have hδ2 : δ ^ 2 = d := by rw [hδdef]; exact Real.sq_sqrt hd0.le
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hδ6 : δ ^ 6 = (s - t) ^ 3 := by
    rw [show δ ^ 6 = (δ ^ 2) ^ 3 by ring, hδ2, hd]
  obtain ⟨m, hmdef⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, m = t + d / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hhdef⟩ : ∃ h : ℝ, h = (ν * δ) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hm₁m : t + δ ^ 2 / 4 < m := by rw [hmdef, hδ2]; linarith
  have hm₁1 : t + δ ^ 2 / 4 < 1 := by rw [hδ2]; linarith
  have hm₁2 : t + δ ^ 2 / 4 < 2 := by linarith
  have hm1 : m ≤ 1 := by rw [hmdef]; linarith
  have hms : m ≤ s := by rw [hmdef]; linarith
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by rw [hmdef]; linarith
  have hνδ : 0 < ν * δ := mul_pos hν hδ
  have hh0 : 0 < h := by rw [hhdef]; positivity
  have hmh : m + h ≤ s := by
    have hν2' : ν ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by nlinarith
    have hhd : h = ν ^ 2 * d := by rw [hhdef, ← hδ2]; ring
    rw [hhd, hmdef]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hν2' hd0.le]
  have hh12 : h ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) = ν * δ := by
    rw [hhdef, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_sq hνδ.le]
  have hh32 : h ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = (ν * δ) ^ 3 := by
    rw [show (3 / 2 : ℝ) = 1 / 2 + 1 by norm_num, Real.rpow_add hh0, Real.rpow_one, hh12, hhdef]
    ring
  have hh2 : h ^ 2 = (ν * δ) ^ 4 := by rw [hhdef]; ring
  
  have hw2s : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 w (Metric.ball 0 s) :=
    (hw.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))).of_le (by norm_cast)
  have hMs : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) s, |w x| ≤ M :=
    fun x hx => hwb x (Metric.ball_subset_ball hs hx)
  have hint := interior_interpolation w s m h M K hm0 hh0 hmh hw2s hMs hP
  obtain ⟨W2, hW2⟩ : ∃ W2 : ℝ, W2 = 100 * (ν * δ * K + M / (ν * δ) ^ 4) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W1, hW1⟩ : ∃ W1 : ℝ, W1 = 100 * ((ν * δ) ^ 3 * K + M / (ν * δ) ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨H1, hH1⟩ : ∃ H1 : ℝ, H1 = 100 * ((ν * δ) ^ 2 * K + M / (ν * δ) ^ 3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨H0, hH0⟩ : ∃ H0 : ℝ, H0 = 100 * ((ν * δ) ^ 4 * K + M / (ν * δ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW2n : 0 ≤ W2 := by rw [hW2]; positivity
  have hW1n : 0 ≤ W1 := by rw [hW1]; positivity
  have hH1n : 0 ≤ H1 := by rw [hH1]; positivity
  have hH0n : 0 ≤ H0 := by rw [hH0]; positivity
  have hw2b : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) m, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j w z) x| ≤ W2 := by
    intro x hx i j
    have h1 := (hint x hx x hx i j).1
    rw [hh12, hh2] at h1
    rw [hW2]; exact h1
  have hw1b : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) m, ∀ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k w x| ≤ W1 := by
    intro x hx k
    have h1 := (hint x hx x hx k k).2.1
    rw [hh32, hhdef] at h1
    rw [hW1]; exact h1
  have hw1α : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) m, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) m, ∀ k : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv k w x - partialDeriv k w y| ≤ H1 * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx y hy k
    have h1 := (hint x hx y hy k k).2.2.1
    rw [hh32, hhdef] at h1
    rw [hH1]; exact h1
  have hwα : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) m, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) m,
      |w x - w y| ≤ H0 * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have h1 := (hint x hx y hy 0 0).2.2.2
    rw [hh2, hh12] at h1
    rw [hH0]; exact h1
  
  obtain ⟨η, hηs, hη1, hηv, hη0, hηα, hη1b, hη1α, hη2b, hη2α⟩ := hcut t δ (by linarith) hδ hδ1
  have hvan1 : ∀ x : E3, t + δ ^ 2 / 4 < ‖x‖ → η x = 0 := fun x hx => (hηv x hx).1
  have hvanm : ∀ x : E3, m ≤ ‖x‖ → η x = 0 ∧ (∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k η x = 0) ∧
      ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k η z) x = 0 :=
    fun x hx => hηv x (lt_of_lt_of_le hm₁m hx)
  obtain ⟨hψs, hψc, hψw⟩ := cutoff_mul_smooth η w (t + δ ^ 2 / 4) t hm₁2 hηs hw hvan1 hη1
  have hlap := cutoff_lap_identity η w F a b (t + δ ^ 2 / 4) hm₁1 hηs hw hvan1 heq
  have hsub : Metric.ball (0 : E3) m ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 := Metric.ball_subset_ball hm1
  have hsubs : Metric.ball (0 : E3) m ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) s := Metric.ball_subset_ball hms
  have hR := cutoff_rhs_holder η w F a b m ε M K W1 W2 H0 H1 (Λ / δ) (Λ / δ ^ 2) (Λ / δ ^ 3)
    (Λ / δ ^ 4) (Λ / δ ^ 5) hm1 hε hM hK hW1n hW2n hH0n hH1n (by positivity) (by positivity)
    (by positivity) (by positivity) (by positivity) hvanm hη0 hηα hη1b hη1α hη2b hη2α
    (fun x hx => hwb x (hsub hx)) hwα hw1b hw1α hw2b
    (fun x hx y hy i j => hP x (hsubs hx) y (hsubs hy) i j)
    (fun z hz z' hz' => hcoef z (hsub hz) z' (hsub hz'))
  have hΔ : ∀ x y : E3,
      |∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k (fun x => η x * w x) z) x
        - ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k (fun x => η x * w x) z) y|
      ≤ ((1 * (2 * M) + Λ / δ * M) + 9 * (1 * (ε * (K + 2 * W2)) + Λ / δ * (ε * W2))
            + 3 * (1 * (ε * (H1 + 2 * W1)) + Λ / δ * (ε * W1))
            + 6 * (Λ / δ ^ 2 * H1 + Λ / δ ^ 3 * W1) + (Λ / δ ^ 4 * H0 + Λ / δ ^ 5 * M))
          * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    intro x y
    rw [hlap x, hlap y]
    exact hR x y

        - ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, η x * ((a x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0))

      (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := p)).contMDiffAt

    have h2 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)) := by
      rw [hcp]; exact hf.contMDiffAt

      ∃ c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ v : E3, a v = 0 → b v = 0 → c v = 0 → v = 0 := by

      intro v; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]

    set α2 := a (e 2) with hα2

        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h

          linear_combination -(ξ 0) * hz1 + (ξ 1) * hz0 - α2 * hbb
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h | h

        · exact absurd h haξ
      ext v

    by_cases hβp : β p = 0
    · obtain ⟨hfβ, hfβ'⟩ := CH β hβ
      refine ⟨fderiv ℝ (β ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p p), β ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm,

        by_cases h0 : ξ 0 = 0

          · intro h
            have := congrArg (fun f : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => f (e 0)) h
            simp [hproj] at this
          · rw [hproj]; exact h0
        · refine ⟨ξ 0 • EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) - ξ 1 • EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3),
            ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro h

            simp [hproj] at this

          · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hproj,
              smul_eq_mul]
            ring
      refine ⟨b, fun x => b (x - chartAt E3 p p), hb, hbξ, ?_, ?_, ?_, fun h => absurd h hβp⟩

  have hT₀ : ∀ v, T₀ v = a v • e 0 + b v • e 1 + cf v • e 2 := fun v => rfl
  have hinj : Function.Injective (T₀ : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) := by
    refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero (T₀ : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)).mpr fun v hv => ?_
    change T₀ v = 0 at hv
    have h0 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u 0) hv
    have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u 1) hv
    have h2 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u 2) hv
    simp [hT₀, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] at h0 h1 h2
    exact hcf v h0 h1 h2
  let T : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3 :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo (T₀ : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) hinj).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have hTT : (T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) = T₀ := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    show (LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo (T₀ : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) hinj) v = T₀ v
    rw [LinearEquiv.coe_ofInjectiveEndo]
    rfl
  
  let F : E3 → E3 := fun x => (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm x) - w p) • e 0 + g₂ x • e 1 +
    cf (x - chartAt E3 p p) • e 2
  have hF' : HasFDerivAt F (T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    rw [hTT]
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun x => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm x) - w p) a (chartAt E3 p p) :=
      hA.sub_const (w p)
    have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun x => cf (x - chartAt E3 p p)) cf (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using cf.hasFDerivAt.comp (chartAt E3 p p)
        ((hasFDerivAt_id (chartAt E3 p p)).sub_const (chartAt E3 p p))
    exact ((h1.smul_const (e 0)).add (hg₂d.smul_const (e 1))).add (h3.smul_const (e 2))
  have hF : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm x) - w p) (chartAt E3 p p) :=
      hfw.sub contDiffAt_const
    have h3 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => cf (x - chartAt E3 p p)) (chartAt E3 p p) :=
      (cf.contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)).contDiffAt
    exact ((h1.smul contDiffAt_const).add (hg₂c.smul contDiffAt_const)).add
      (h3.smul contDiffAt_const)
  have hF0 : ∀ x, F x 0 = w ((chartAt E3 p).symm x) - w p := by
    intro x; simp [F, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hF1 : ∀ x, F x 1 = g₂ x := by
    intro x; simp [F, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hFx₀ : F (chartAt E3 p p) = 0 := by
    simp [F, hcp, hg₂0]
  
  have hn : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  let ψ := ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph F hF hF' hn
  have hψ : (ψ : E3 → E3) = F := ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe hF hF' hn
  have hx₀ψ : chartAt E3 p p ∈ ψ.source := ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hF hF' hn
  
  let κ₀ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E3 := (chartAt E3 p).trans ψ
  have hκ₀ : ∀ x, κ₀ x = F (chartAt E3 p x) := by
    intro x
    show ψ (chartAt E3 p x) = F (chartAt E3 p x)
    rw [hψ]
  have hκ₀src : κ₀.source = (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' ψ.source :=
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.trans_source _ _
  have hpκ₀ : p ∈ κ₀.source := by rw [hκ₀src]; exact ⟨hpc, hx₀ψ⟩
  have hκ₀p : κ₀ p = 0 := by rw [hκ₀]; exact hFx₀
  
  have hW : κ₀.source ∩ interior U ∈ 𝓝 p :=
    Filter.inter_mem (κ₀.open_source.mem_nhds hpκ₀) (interior_mem_nhds.mpr hU)
  have hsymm0 : κ₀.symm 0 = p := by rw [← hκ₀p]; exact κ₀.left_inv hpκ₀
  have h0t : (0 : E3) ∈ κ₀.target := by
    have := κ₀.map_source hpκ₀
    rwa [hκ₀p] at this
  have hN : κ₀.target ∩ κ₀.symm ⁻¹' (κ₀.source ∩ interior U) ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3) := by
    refine Filter.inter_mem (κ₀.open_target.mem_nhds h0t) ?_
    have hca := κ₀.continuousAt_symm h0t
    rw [← hsymm0] at hW
    exact hca.preimage_mem_nhds hW
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hN
  have hSo : IsOpen (κ₀.source ∩ κ₀ ⁻¹' Metric.ball 0 ε) :=
    κ₀.isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball
  let κ := κ₀.restrOpen _ hSo
  have hκsrc : κ.source = κ₀.source ∩ (κ₀.source ∩ κ₀ ⁻¹' Metric.ball 0 ε) :=
    OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_source _ _ _
  have hκcoe : ∀ x, κ x = κ₀ x := fun x => rfl
  have hκtgt : κ.target = κ₀.target ∩ κ₀.symm ⁻¹' (κ₀.source ∩ κ₀ ⁻¹' Metric.ball 0 ε) := by
    show (κ₀.restrOpen _ hSo).toPartialEquiv.target = _
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restrOpen_toPartialEquiv, PartialEquiv.restr_target]
    rfl
  have hxc : ∀ x ∈ κ.source, x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hκsrc] at hx
    have := hx.1
    rw [hκ₀src] at this
    exact this.1
  refine ⟨κ, ε, hε, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hκsrc]
    refine ⟨hpκ₀, hpκ₀, ?_⟩
    show κ₀ p ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) ε
    rw [hκ₀p]; exact Metric.mem_ball_self hε
  · intro x hx
    rw [hκsrc] at hx
    obtain ⟨hx1, -, hx2⟩ := hx
    have := (hball hx2).2
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, κ₀.left_inv hx1] at this
    exact interior_subset this.2
  · rw [hκcoe]; exact hκ₀p
  · rw [hκtgt]
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hy1, -, hy2⟩
      have : κ₀ (κ₀.symm y) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) ε := hy2
      rwa [κ₀.right_inv hy1] at this
    · intro hy
      have hyN := hball hy
      refine ⟨hyN.1, κ₀.map_target hyN.1, ?_⟩
      show κ₀ (κ₀.symm y) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) ε
      rw [κ₀.right_inv hyN.1]; exact hy
  · intro x hx
    rw [hκcoe, hκ₀, hF0, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hxc x hx)]
  · intro hβp x hx
    rw [hκcoe, hκ₀, hF1]
    exact hg₂β hβp x (hxc x hx)

informal_problem.statement:
(w β : M → ℝ) (p : M) (κ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E3) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hp : p ∈ κ.source) (hκp : κ p = 0) (htgt : κ.target = Metric.ball 0 ε)
    (hwκ : ∀ x ∈ κ.source, w x - w p = κ x 0)
    (hcase : κ.source ⊆ {x | 0 < β x} ∨ ∀ x ∈ κ.source, β x = κ x 1) :
    IsPreconnected (κ.source ∩ ({x | 0 ≤ β x} ∩ w ⁻¹' {w p})) ∧
    IsPreconnected (κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x}) ∧
    IsConnected (κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w p < w x}) ∧
    IsConnected (κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w x < w p}) ∧
    p ∈ closure (κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w p < w x}) ∧
    p ∈ closure (κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w x < w p})

signature.name: chart_level_sides
signature.statement:
(w β : M → ℝ) (p : M) (κ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E3) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hp : p ∈ κ.source) (hκp : κ p = 0) (htgt : κ.target = Metric.ball 0 ε)
    (hwκ : ∀ x ∈ κ.source, w x - w p = κ x 0)
    (hcase : κ.source ⊆ {x | 0 < β x} ∨ ∀ x ∈ κ.source, β x = κ x 1) :
    IsPreconnected (κ.source ∩ ({x | 0 ≤ β x} ∩ w ⁻¹' {w p})) ∧
    IsPreconnected (κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x}) ∧
    IsConnected (κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w p < w x}) ∧
    IsConnected (κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w x < w p}) ∧
    p ∈ closure (κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w p < w x}) ∧
    p ∈ closure (κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w x < w p})

proof.tactics:
by
  have h0T : (0 : E3) ∈ κ.target := by rw [htgt]; exact Metric.mem_ball_self hε
  have hsp : κ.symm 0 = p := by rw [← hκp]; exact κ.left_inv hp
  
  have hP : ∀ C : Set E3, Convex ℝ (κ.target ∩ C) →
      IsPreconnected (κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' C) ∧
      ((κ.target ∩ C).Nonempty → (κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' C).Nonempty) ∧
      ((0 : E3) ∈ closure (κ.target ∩ C) → p ∈ closure (κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' C)) := by
    intro C hC
    have hI : κ.symm '' (κ.target ∩ C) = κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' C :=
      κ.toPartialEquiv.symm_image_target_inter_eq' C
    have hcont : ContinuousOn κ.symm (κ.target ∩ C) :=
      κ.continuousOn_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left
    refine ⟨hI ▸ hC.isPreconnected.image _ hcont, fun hne => hI ▸ hne.image _, fun hcl => ?_⟩
    have h := ((κ.continuousOn_symm.continuousWithinAt h0T).mono
      Set.inter_subset_left).mem_closure_image hcl
    rw [hI, hsp] at h
    exact h
  have key : ∀ (S : Set M) (C : Set E3), (∀ x ∈ κ.source, (x ∈ S ↔ κ x ∈ C)) →
      κ.source ∩ S = κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' C := by
    intro S C h
    ext x
    exact ⟨fun hx => ⟨hx.1, (h x hx.1).1 hx.2⟩, fun hx => ⟨hx.1, (h x hx.1).2 hx.2⟩⟩
  have hiff : ∀ x ∈ κ.source, (w p < w x ↔ 0 < κ x 0) ∧ (w x < w p ↔ κ x 0 < 0) ∧
      (w x = w p ↔ κ x 0 = 0) := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hwκ x hx
    refine ⟨⟨fun h => by linarith, fun h => by linarith⟩, ⟨fun h => by linarith,
      fun h => by linarith⟩, ⟨fun h => by linarith, fun h => by linarith⟩⟩
  have hlin : ∀ i : Fin 3, IsLinearMap ℝ (fun y : E3 => y i) := fun i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).toLinearMap.isLinear
  have hT : Convex ℝ κ.target := by rw [htgt]; exact convex_ball 0 ε
  
  have hnorm : ∀ a b : ℝ, ‖(!₂[a, b, 0] : E3)‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    intro a b
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hQ : (0 : E3) ∈ closure (κ.target ∩ ({y : E3 | 0 < y 1} ∩ {y : E3 | 0 < y 0})) ∧
      (0 : E3) ∈ closure (κ.target ∩ ({y : E3 | 0 < y 1} ∩ {y : E3 | y 0 < 0})) := by
    rw [htgt]
    constructor
    · rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
      intro r hr
      have hm : 0 < min ε r := lt_min hε hr
      set c := min ε r / 4 with hc
      have hc0 : 0 < c := by positivity
      have hn := hnorm c c
      have hlt : ‖(!₂[c, c, 0] : E3)‖ < min ε r := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (!₂[c, c, 0] : E3)]
      refine ⟨!₂[c, c, 0], ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (min_le_left _ _)
      · simp [hc0]
      · simp [hc0]
      · rw [dist_zero_left]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (min_le_right _ _)
    · rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
      intro r hr
      have hm : 0 < min ε r := lt_min hε hr
      set c := min ε r / 4 with hc
      have hc0 : 0 < c := by positivity
      have hn := hnorm (-c) c
      have hlt : ‖(!₂[-c, c, 0] : E3)‖ < min ε r := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg (!₂[-c, c, 0] : E3)]
      refine ⟨!₂[-c, c, 0], ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (min_le_left _ _)
      · simp [hc0]
      · simp [hc0]
      · rw [dist_zero_left]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (min_le_right _ _)
  rcases hcase with hA | hB
  · have e1 : κ.source ∩ ({x | 0 ≤ β x} ∩ w ⁻¹' {w p}) =
        κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' {y : E3 | y 0 = 0} := by
      apply key
      intro x hx
      have hb : 0 < β x := hA hx
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
        (hiff x hx).2.2, hb.le, true_and]
    have e2 : κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} = κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Set.univ := by
      apply key
      intro x hx
      have hb : 0 < β x := hA hx
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ, hb]
    have e3 : κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w p < w x} =
        κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' {y : E3 | 0 < y 0} := by
      rw [Set.inter_assoc]
      apply key
      intro x hx
      have hb : 0 < β x := hA hx
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage,
        (hiff x hx).1, hb, true_and]
    have e4 : κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w x < w p} =
        κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' {y : E3 | y 0 < 0} := by
      rw [Set.inter_assoc]
      apply key
      intro x hx
      have hb : 0 < β x := hA hx
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage,
        (hiff x hx).2.1, hb, true_and]
    have P1 := hP _ (hT.inter (convex_hyperplane (hlin 0) 0))
    have P2 := hP Set.univ (by rw [Set.inter_univ]; exact hT)
    have P3 := hP _ (hT.inter (convex_halfSpace_gt (hlin 0) 0))
    have P4 := hP _ (hT.inter (convex_halfSpace_lt (hlin 0) 0))
    have cl3 : (0 : E3) ∈ closure (κ.target ∩ {y : E3 | 0 < y 0}) :=
      closure_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ (fun y hy => hy.2)) hQ.1
    have cl4 : (0 : E3) ∈ closure (κ.target ∩ {y : E3 | y 0 < 0}) :=
      closure_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ (fun y hy => hy.2)) hQ.2
    rw [e1, e3, e4, e2]
    exact ⟨P1.1, P2.1, ⟨P3.2.1 (closure_nonempty_iff.mp ⟨0, cl3⟩), P3.1⟩,
      ⟨P4.2.1 (closure_nonempty_iff.mp ⟨0, cl4⟩), P4.1⟩, P3.2.2 cl3, P4.2.2 cl4⟩
  · have e1 : κ.source ∩ ({x | 0 ≤ β x} ∩ w ⁻¹' {w p}) =
        κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' ({y : E3 | 0 ≤ y 1} ∩ {y : E3 | y 0 = 0}) := by
      apply key
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
        (hiff x hx).2.2, hB x hx]
    have e2 : κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} = κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' {y : E3 | 0 < y 1} := by
      apply key
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, hB x hx]
    have e3 : κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w p < w x} =
        κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' ({y : E3 | 0 < y 1} ∩ {y : E3 | 0 < y 0}) := by
      rw [Set.inter_assoc]
      apply key
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage,
        (hiff x hx).1, hB x hx]
    have e4 : κ.source ∩ {x | 0 < β x} ∩ {x | w x < w p} =
        κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' ({y : E3 | 0 < y 1} ∩ {y : E3 | y 0 < 0}) := by
      rw [Set.inter_assoc]
      apply key
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage,
        (hiff x hx).2.1, hB x hx]
    have P1 := hP _ (hT.inter ((convex_halfSpace_ge (hlin 1) 0).inter
      (convex_hyperplane (hlin 0) 0)))
    have P2 := hP _ (hT.inter (convex_halfSpace_gt (hlin 1) 0))
    have P3 := hP _ (hT.inter ((convex_halfSpace_gt (hlin 1) 0).inter
      (convex_halfSpace_gt (hlin 0) 0)))
    have P4 := hP _ (hT.inter ((convex_halfSpace_gt (hlin 1) 0).inter
      (convex_halfSpace_lt (hlin 0) 0)))
    rw [e1, e3, e4, e2]
    exact ⟨P1.1, P2.1, ⟨P3.2.1 (closure_nonempty_iff.mp ⟨0, hQ.1⟩), P3.1⟩,
      ⟨P4.2.1 (closure_nonempty_iff.mp ⟨0, hQ.2⟩), P4.1⟩, P3.2.2 hQ.1, P4.2.2 hQ.2⟩

{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
    (S E : Set X) (w : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hw : Continuous w) (hE : IsClosed E)
    (hS : IsCompact S) (hSL : S ⊆ E ∩ w ⁻¹' {t})
    (hloc : ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 p, V ∩ (E ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) ⊆ S) :
    ∃ O : Set X, IsOpen O ∧ S ⊆ O ∧ IsCompact (closure O) ∧
      closure O ∩ (E ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) ⊆ S ∧
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ frontier O, x ∈ E → δ < |w x - t|

signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
    (S E : Set X) (w : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (hw : Continuous w) (hE : IsClosed E)
    (hS : IsCompact S) (hSL : S ⊆ E ∩ w ⁻¹' {t})
    (hloc : ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 p, V ∩ (E ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) ⊆ S) :
    ∃ O : Set X, IsOpen O ∧ S ⊆ O ∧ IsCompact (closure O) ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  set L : Set X := E ∩ w ⁻¹' {t} with hLdef
  have hSU : S ⊆ interior (S ∪ Lᶜ) := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hVL⟩ := hloc p hp
    refine mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr (Filter.mem_of_superset hV ?_)
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxL : x ∈ L
    · exact Or.inl (hVL ⟨hx, hxL⟩)
    · exact Or.inr hxL
  have hUL : ∀ x ∈ interior (S ∪ Lᶜ), x ∈ L → x ∈ S := by
    intro x hx hxL
    rcases interior_subset hx with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd hxL h
  obtain ⟨O, hOo, hSO, hOU, hOc⟩ :=
    exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hS isOpen_interior hSU
  have hcl : closure O ∩ L ⊆ S := fun x hx => hUL x (hOU hx.1) hx.2
  have hK : IsCompact (frontier O ∩ E) :=
    (hOc.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_frontier frontier_subset_closure).inter_right hE
  have hpos : ∀ b ∈ frontier O ∩ E, (0 : ℝ) < |w b - t| := by
    intro b hb
    refine abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr ?_)
    intro hwb
    have hbS : b ∈ S := hcl ⟨frontier_subset_closure hb.1, hb.2, hwb⟩
    have hfr := hb.1
    rw [hOo.frontier_eq] at hfr
    exact hfr.2 (hSO hbS)
  obtain ⟨a', ha', hbound⟩ :=
    hK.exists_forall_le' ((hw.sub continuous_const).abs.continuousOn) hpos
  refine ⟨O, hOo, hSO, hOc, hcl, a' / 2, half_pos ha', ?_⟩
  intro x hx hxE
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (half_lt_self ha') (hbound x ⟨hx, hxE⟩)

{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (Ω S O : Set X) (w : X → ℝ) (t δ : ℝ)
    (hw : Continuous w) (hO : IsOpen O) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ O ∩ Ω, w x = t → x ∈ S)
    (hfr : ∀ x ∈ frontier O, x ∈ Ω → δ < |w x - t|)
    (hlift : ∀ θ : C(Ω, Circle), ∃ φ : C(Ω, ℝ), ∀ x : Ω, θ x = Circle.exp (φ x)) :
    ∃ f g : X → ℤ, ContinuousOn f (Ω \ S) ∧ ContinuousOn g (O ∩ Ω) ∧

signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (Ω S O : Set X) (w : X → ℝ) (t δ : ℝ)
    (hw : Continuous w) (hO : IsOpen O) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ O ∩ Ω, w x = t → x ∈ S)
    (hfr : ∀ x ∈ frontier O, x ∈ Ω → δ < |w x - t|)
    (hlift : ∀ θ : C(Ω, Circle), ∃ φ : C(Ω, ℝ), ∀ x : Ω, θ x = Circle.exp (φ x)) :
    ∃ f g : X → ℤ, ContinuousOn f (Ω \ S) ∧ ContinuousOn g (O ∩ Ω) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O ∩ Ω, w x < t → f x = g x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ O ∩ Ω, t < w x → f x = g x + 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have glue : ∀ {Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace Y] (s : Set X) (F : X → Y) (c : Y),
      (∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ O → ContinuousAt F x) →
      (∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ frontier O → ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, y ∈ O → F y = c) →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => if x ∈ O then F x else c) s := by
    intro Y _ s F c hin hfr' x hx
    apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
    · refine (hin x hx hxO).congr ?_
      filter_upwards [hO.mem_nhds hxO] with y hy
      simp [hy]
    · by_cases hxc : x ∈ closure O
      · have hxf : x ∈ frontier O := by rw [hO.frontier_eq]; exact ⟨hxc, hxO⟩
        refine (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : X => c) x).congr ?_
        filter_upwards [hfr' x hx hxf] with y hy
        by_cases hyO : y ∈ O
        · simp [hyO, hy hyO]
        · simp [hyO]
      · refine (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : X => c) x).congr ?_
        filter_upwards [isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxc] with y hy
        have hyO : y ∉ O := fun h => hy (subset_closure h)
        simp [hyO]
  
  have rnd : ∀ (h : X → ℝ) (s : Set X), ContinuousOn h s → (∀ x ∈ s, ∃ n : ℤ, h x = n) →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => round (h x)) s := by
    intro h s hh hint x hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hint x hx
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[s] x, |h y - h x| < 1 / 2 := by
      have := Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (hh x hx) (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
      filter_upwards [this] with y hy
      rwa [Real.dist_eq] at hy
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[s] x, round (h y) = round (h x) := by
      filter_upwards [h1, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hy hys
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hint y hys
      rw [hm, hn] at hy ⊢
      have hmn : m = n := by
        have h3 : |((m - n : ℤ) : ℝ)| < 1 := by push_cast; linarith
        have h4 : |m - n| < 1 := by exact_mod_cast h3
        have := Int.abs_lt_one_iff.mp h4
        omega
      rw [hmn]
    exact (continuousWithinAt_const).congr_of_eventuallyEq h2 rfl
  have hτpos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have hτne : 2 * Real.pi ≠ 0 := hτpos.ne'
  
  let lam : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => max 0 (min 1 ((s + δ) / (2 * δ)))
  let ℓ : X → ℝ := fun x => lam (w x - t)
  have hℓc : Continuous ℓ := by
    show Continuous fun x => max 0 (min 1 ((w x - t + δ) / (2 * δ)))
    exact continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min
      (((hw.sub continuous_const).add continuous_const).div_const _))
  have hΛ1 : ∀ s, s < -δ → lam s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    have h : (s + δ) / (2 * δ) < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
    show max 0 (min 1 ((s + δ) / (2 * δ))) = 0
    rw [min_eq_right (by linarith), max_eq_left h.le]
  have hΛ2 : ∀ s, δ < s → lam s = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    have h : 1 < (s + δ) / (2 * δ) := by rw [one_lt_div (by linarith)]; linarith
    show max 0 (min 1 ((s + δ) / (2 * δ))) = 1
    rw [min_eq_left h.le, max_eq_right zero_le_one]
  have FR : ∀ x ∈ frontier O, x ∈ Ω → ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x,
      (ℓ y = 1 ∧ t < w y) ∨ (ℓ y = 0 ∧ w y < t) := by
    intro x hx hxΩ
    have hN : IsOpen {y | δ < |w y - t|} :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_const ((hw.sub continuous_const).abs)
    filter_upwards [hN.mem_nhds (hfr x hx hxΩ)] with y hy
    rcases lt_abs.mp hy with h | h
    · left; exact ⟨hΛ2 _ h, by linarith⟩
    · right; exact ⟨hΛ1 _ (by linarith), by linarith⟩
  
  let F : X → Circle := fun x => Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * ℓ x)
  let θ : X → Circle := fun x => if x ∈ O then F x else 1
  have hθc : ContinuousOn θ Ω := by
    apply glue Ω F 1
    · intro x _ _
      exact (Circle.exp.continuous.comp (continuous_const.mul hℓc)).continuousAt
    · intro x hxΩ hxf
      filter_upwards [FR x hxf hxΩ] with y hy _
      rcases hy with ⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩
      · show Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * ℓ y) = 1
        rw [h1, mul_one, Circle.exp_two_pi]
      · show Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * ℓ y) = 1
        rw [h1, mul_zero, Circle.exp_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hlift ⟨Ω.restrict θ, hθc.restrict⟩
  let φh : X → ℝ := fun x => if h : x ∈ Ω then φ ⟨x, h⟩ else 0
  have hφc : ContinuousOn φh Ω := by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
    have hr : Ω.restrict φh = ⇑φ := by
      funext ⟨x, hx⟩
      show (if h : x ∈ Ω then φ ⟨x, h⟩ else 0) = φ ⟨x, hx⟩
      rw [dif_pos hx]
    rw [hr]; exact φ.continuous
  have hφeq : ∀ x ∈ Ω, Circle.exp (φh x) = θ x := by
    intro x hx
    have h := hφ ⟨x, hx⟩
    show Circle.exp (if h : x ∈ Ω then φ ⟨x, h⟩ else 0) = θ x
    rw [dif_pos hx]
    exact h.symm
  
  let Fψ : X → ℝ := fun x => if w x < t then ℓ x else ℓ x - 1
  let ψ : X → ℝ := fun x => if x ∈ O then Fψ x else 0
  have hψc : ContinuousOn ψ (Ω \ S) := by
    apply glue (Ω \ S) Fψ 0
    · intro x hx hxO
      have hne : w x ≠ t := fun h => hx.2 (hS x ⟨hxO, hx.1⟩ h)
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
      · refine hℓc.continuousAt.congr ?_
        filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt hw continuous_const).mem_nhds h] with y hy
        show ℓ y = (if w y < t then ℓ y else ℓ y - 1)
        rw [if_pos (show w y < t from hy)]
      · refine (hℓc.sub (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : X => (1 : ℝ))).continuousAt.congr ?_
        filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const hw).mem_nhds h] with y hy
        show ℓ y - 1 = (if w y < t then ℓ y else ℓ y - 1)
        rw [if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt (show t < w y from hy)))]
    · intro x hx hxf
      filter_upwards [FR x hxf hx.1] with y hy _
      rcases hy with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · show (if w y < t then ℓ y else ℓ y - 1) = 0
        rw [if_neg (not_lt.mpr h2.le), h1]; norm_num
      · show (if w y < t then ℓ y else ℓ y - 1) = 0
        rw [if_pos h2, h1]
  
  have hθψ : ∀ x, θ x = Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * ψ x) := by
    intro x
    show (if x ∈ O then F x else 1) = Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * (if x ∈ O then Fψ x else 0))
    by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
    · rw [if_pos hxO, if_pos hxO]
      show Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * ℓ x) =
        Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * (if w x < t then ℓ x else ℓ x - 1))
      by_cases hwt : w x < t
      · rw [if_pos hwt]
      · rw [if_neg hwt, mul_sub, mul_one, Circle.exp_sub, Circle.exp_two_pi, div_one]
    · rw [if_neg hxO, if_neg hxO, mul_zero, Circle.exp_zero]
  
  have key : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∀ b : ℝ, θ x = Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * b) →
      ∃ m : ℤ, (φh x - 2 * Real.pi * b) / (2 * Real.pi) = m := by
    intro x hx b hb
    have h1 : Circle.exp (φh x) = Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * b) := (hφeq x hx).trans hb
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Circle.exp_eq_exp.mp h1
    refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
    rw [hm, add_sub_cancel_left, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hτne]
  refine ⟨fun x => round ((φh x - 2 * Real.pi * ψ x) / (2 * Real.pi)),
    fun x => round ((φh x - 2 * Real.pi * ℓ x) / (2 * Real.pi)), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine rnd (fun x => (φh x - 2 * Real.pi * ψ x) / (2 * Real.pi)) (Ω \ S) ?_ ?_
    · exact ((hφc.mono Set.diff_subset).sub (continuousOn_const.mul hψc)).div_const _
    · intro x hx
      exact key x hx.1 _ (hθψ x)
  · refine rnd (fun x => (φh x - 2 * Real.pi * ℓ x) / (2 * Real.pi)) (O ∩ Ω) ?_ ?_
    · exact ((hφc.mono Set.inter_subset_right).sub
        ((continuous_const.mul hℓc).continuousOn)).div_const _
    · intro x hx
      refine key x hx.2 _ ?_
      show (if x ∈ O then F x else 1) = Circle.exp (2 * Real.pi * ℓ x)
      rw [if_pos hx.1]
  · intro x hx hwt
    have hψx : ψ x = ℓ x := by
      show (if x ∈ O then Fψ x else 0) = ℓ x
      rw [if_pos hx.1]
      show (if w x < t then ℓ x else ℓ x - 1) = ℓ x
      rw [if_pos hwt]
    show round ((φh x - 2 * Real.pi * ψ x) / (2 * Real.pi)) =
      round ((φh x - 2 * Real.pi * ℓ x) / (2 * Real.pi))
    rw [hψx]
  · intro x hx hwt
    have hψx : ψ x = ℓ x - 1 := by
      show (if x ∈ O then Fψ x else 0) = ℓ x - 1
      rw [if_pos hx.1]
      show (if w x < t then ℓ x else ℓ x - 1) = ℓ x - 1
      rw [if_neg (not_lt.mpr hwt.le)]
    show round ((φh x - 2 * Real.pi * ψ x) / (2 * Real.pi)) =
      round ((φh x - 2 * Real.pi * ℓ x) / (2 * Real.pi)) + 1
    rw [hψx, ← round_add_one]
    congr 1
    rw [div_add_one hτne]
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [LocallyConnectedSpace X]
    (Ω S O : Set X) (w : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (f g : X → ℤ)
    (hΩo : IsOpen Ω) (hΩc : IsConnected Ω) (hSc : IsClosed S) (hSconn : IsPreconnected S)
    (p₀ : X) (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ S) (hSt : ∀ x ∈ S, w x = t)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Ω \ S)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (O ∩ Ω))
    (hfg₁ : ∀ x ∈ O ∩ Ω, w x < t → f x = g x)
    (hfg₂ : ∀ x ∈ O ∩ Ω, t < w x → f x = g x + 1)
    (hloc : ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ V : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ O ∧
      IsPreconnected (V ∩ Ω) ∧
      IsConnected (V ∩ Ω ∩ {x | t < w x}) ∧ IsConnected (V ∩ Ω ∩ {x | w x < t}) ∧
      p ∈ closure (V ∩ Ω ∩ {x | t < w x}) ∧ p ∈ closure (V ∩ Ω ∩ {x | w x < t}) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V ∩ Ω, w x = t → x ∈ S)) :
    ∃ A B : Set X, IsOpen A ∧ IsOpen B ∧ Disjoint A B ∧ A ∪ B = Ω \ S ∧
      IsConnected A ∧ IsConnected B ∧ S ⊆ closure A ∧ S ⊆ closure B

signature.name: two_sides_of_jump
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [LocallyConnectedSpace X]
    (Ω S O : Set X) (w : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (f g : X → ℤ)
    (hΩo : IsOpen Ω) (hΩc : IsConnected Ω) (hSc : IsClosed S) (hSconn : IsPreconnected S)
    (p₀ : X) (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ S) (hSt : ∀ x ∈ S, w x = t)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Ω \ S)) (hg : ContinuousOn g (O ∩ Ω))
    (hfg₁ : ∀ x ∈ O ∩ Ω, w x < t → f x = g x)
    (hfg₂ : ∀ x ∈ O ∩ Ω, t < w x → f x = g x + 1)
    (hloc : ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ V : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ O ∧
      IsPreconnected (V ∩ Ω) ∧
      IsConnected (V ∩ Ω ∩ {x | t < w x}) ∧ IsConnected (V ∩ Ω ∩ {x | w x < t}) ∧
      p ∈ closure (V ∩ Ω ∩ {x | t < w x}) ∧ p ∈ closure (V ∩ Ω ∩ {x | w x < t}) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V ∩ Ω, w x = t → x ∈ S)) :
    ∃ A B : Set X, IsOpen A ∧ IsOpen B ∧ Disjoint A B ∧ A ∪ B = Ω \ S ∧
      IsConnected A ∧ IsConnected B ∧ S ⊆ closure A ∧ S ⊆ closure B

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  choose! V hVo hpV hVO hVΩ hVp hVm hclp hclm hVS using hloc
  have hD : IsOpen (Ω \ S) := hΩo.sdiff hSc
  have hCo : ∀ z, IsOpen (connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) z) := fun z => hD.connectedComponentIn
  
  have chain : ∀ (P : Set X) (a : X),
      (∀ p ∈ S, IsPreconnected (V p ∩ P) ∧ V p ∩ P ⊆ Ω \ S ∧ p ∈ closure (V p ∩ P)) →
      (V p₀ ∩ P ∩ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a).Nonempty →
      ∀ p ∈ S, V p ∩ P ⊆ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a := by
    intro P a hP hstart
    have absorb : ∀ q ∈ S, (V q ∩ P ∩ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a).Nonempty →
        V q ∩ P ⊆ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a := by
      rintro q hq ⟨z, hzW, hzC⟩
      have h1 := (hP q hq).1.subset_connectedComponentIn hzW (hP q hq).2.1
      rwa [← connectedComponentIn_eq hzC] at h1
    have overlap : ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ q ∈ S, q ∈ V p → (V p ∩ P ∩ (V q ∩ P)).Nonempty := by
      intro p hp q hq hqV
      obtain ⟨z, hzV, hzW⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp (hP q hq).2.2 (V p) (hVo p hp) hqV
      exact ⟨z, ⟨hzV, hzW.2⟩, hzW⟩
    have prop : ∀ q ∈ S, ∀ p₁ ∈ {p | p ∈ S ∧ V p ∩ P ⊆ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a},
        ∀ p₂ ∈ S, q ∈ V p₁ → q ∈ V p₂ →
        p₂ ∈ {p | p ∈ S ∧ V p ∩ P ⊆ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a} := by
      intro q hq p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂ h1 h2
      obtain ⟨z, hz1, hzq⟩ := overlap p₁ hp₁.1 q hq h1
      have hWq := absorb q hq ⟨z, hzq, hp₁.2 hz1⟩
      obtain ⟨z', hz2, hzq'⟩ := overlap p₂ hp₂ q hq h2
      exact ⟨hp₂, absorb p₂ hp₂ ⟨z', hz2, hWq hzq'⟩⟩
    have hp₀T : p₀ ∈ {p | p ∈ S ∧ V p ∩ P ⊆ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a} :=
      ⟨hp₀, absorb p₀ hp₀ hstart⟩
    have key := isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint.mp hSconn
      (⋃ p ∈ {p | p ∈ S ∧ V p ∩ P ⊆ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a}, V p)
      (⋃ p ∈ S \ {p | p ∈ S ∧ V p ∩ P ⊆ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a}, V p)
      (isOpen_biUnion fun p hp => hVo p hp.1) (isOpen_biUnion fun p hp => hVo p hp.1)
      (fun p hp => by
        by_cases hpT : p ∈ {p | p ∈ S ∧ V p ∩ P ⊆ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a}
        · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_biUnion hpT (hpV p hp))
        · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_biUnion ⟨hp, hpT⟩ (hpV p hp)))
      (by
        ext q
        refine ⟨fun ⟨hq, h1, h2⟩ => ?_, fun h => h.elim⟩
        obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hq1⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp h1
        obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hq2⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp h2
        exact absurd (prop q hq p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂.1 hq1 hq2) hp₂.2)
    intro p hp
    rcases key with hS1 | hS2
    · obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁, hq1⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hS1 hp)
      exact (prop p hp p₁ hp₁ p hp hq1 (hpV p hp)).2
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂, hq2⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hS2 hp₀)
      exact hp₂.2 (prop p₀ hp₀ p₀ hp₀T p₂ hp₂.1 (hpV p₀ hp₀) hq2)
  
  have fills : ∀ x ∈ Ω \ S, Disjoint (closure (connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) x)) S →
      Ω ⊆ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) x := by
    intro x hx hdisj
    have hcl : ∀ y ∈ Ω, y ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) x) →
        y ∈ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) x := by
      intro y hyΩ hycl
      have hyS : y ∉ S := fun hyS => Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hycl hyS
      have hyD : y ∈ Ω \ S := ⟨hyΩ, hyS⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hzy, hzx⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hycl _ (hCo y) (mem_connectedComponentIn hyD)
      rw [connectedComponentIn_eq hzx, ← connectedComponentIn_eq hzy]
      exact mem_connectedComponentIn hyD
    refine hΩc.isPreconnected.subset_left_of_subset_union (hCo x) isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
      (Set.disjoint_compl_right_iff_subset.mpr subset_closure) ?_
      ⟨x, hx.1, mem_connectedComponentIn hx⟩
    intro y hy
    by_cases h : y ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) x)
    · exact Or.inl (hcl y hy h)
    · exact Or.inr h
  
  have hsubp : ∀ p, V p ∩ (Ω ∩ {x | t < w x}) ⊆ Ω \ S := by
    rintro p x ⟨-, hxΩ, hxw⟩
    exact ⟨hxΩ, fun hxS => (show t < w x from hxw).ne' (hSt x hxS)⟩
  have hsubm : ∀ p, V p ∩ (Ω ∩ {x | w x < t}) ⊆ Ω \ S := by
    rintro p x ⟨-, hxΩ, hxw⟩
    exact ⟨hxΩ, fun hxS => (show w x < t from hxw).ne (hSt x hxS)⟩
  
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := (hVp p₀ hp₀).nonempty
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := (hVm p₀ hp₀).nonempty
  have ha₀D : a₀ ∈ Ω \ S := hsubp p₀ ⟨ha₀.1.1, ha₀.1.2, ha₀.2⟩
  have hb₀D : b₀ ∈ Ω \ S := hsubm p₀ ⟨hb₀.1.1, hb₀.1.2, hb₀.2⟩
  have ha₀A : a₀ ∈ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a₀ := mem_connectedComponentIn ha₀D
  have hb₀B : b₀ ∈ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) b₀ := mem_connectedComponentIn hb₀D
  
  have hAB : Disjoint (connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a₀) (connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) b₀) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzA hzB
    have hAeq : connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a₀ = connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) b₀ :=
      (connectedComponentIn_eq hzA).trans (connectedComponentIn_eq hzB).symm
    have hb₀A : b₀ ∈ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a₀ := hAeq ▸ hb₀B
    have hf1 : f a₀ = f b₀ := isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.constant
      (hf.mono (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _)) ha₀A hb₀A
    have hg1 : g a₀ = g b₀ := (hVΩ p₀ hp₀).constant
      (hg.mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ (hVO p₀ hp₀))) ⟨ha₀.1.1, ha₀.1.2⟩
      ⟨hb₀.1.1, hb₀.1.2⟩
    have h1 := hfg₂ a₀ ⟨hVO p₀ hp₀ ha₀.1.1, ha₀.1.2⟩ ha₀.2
    have h2 := hfg₁ b₀ ⟨hVO p₀ hp₀ hb₀.1.1, hb₀.1.2⟩ hb₀.2
    omega
  
  have hAp : ∀ p ∈ S, V p ∩ (Ω ∩ {x | t < w x}) ⊆ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a₀ :=
    chain (Ω ∩ {x | t < w x}) a₀
      (fun p hp => ⟨by rw [← Set.inter_assoc]; exact (hVp p hp).isPreconnected, hsubp p,
        by rw [← Set.inter_assoc]; exact hclp p hp⟩)
      ⟨a₀, ⟨ha₀.1.1, ha₀.1.2, ha₀.2⟩, ha₀A⟩
  have hBm : ∀ p ∈ S, V p ∩ (Ω ∩ {x | w x < t}) ⊆ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) b₀ :=
    chain (Ω ∩ {x | w x < t}) b₀
      (fun p hp => ⟨by rw [← Set.inter_assoc]; exact (hVm p hp).isPreconnected, hsubm p,
        by rw [← Set.inter_assoc]; exact hclm p hp⟩)
      ⟨b₀, ⟨hb₀.1.1, hb₀.1.2, hb₀.2⟩, hb₀B⟩
  
  have hcov : connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a₀ ∪ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) b₀ = Ω \ S := by
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · exact Set.union_subset (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _) (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _)
    · intro x hx
      have hxC := mem_connectedComponentIn hx
      by_cases h : Disjoint (closure (connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) x)) S
      · exfalso
        have hΩC := fills x hx h
        have e1 := connectedComponentIn_eq (hΩC ha₀D.1)
        have e2 := connectedComponentIn_eq (hΩC hb₀D.1)
        have : a₀ ∈ connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) b₀ := by
          rw [← e2, e1]; exact ha₀A
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hAB ha₀A this
      · obtain ⟨p, hpcl, hpS⟩ := Set.not_disjoint_iff.mp h
        obtain ⟨z, hzV, hzC⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hpcl (V p) (hVo p hpS) (hpV p hpS)
        have hzD : z ∈ Ω \ S := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ hzC
        have hwz : w z ≠ t := fun hw => hzD.2 (hVS p hpS z ⟨hzV, hzD.1⟩ hw)
        have e0 := connectedComponentIn_eq hzC
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hwz with hlt | hgt
        · right
          have hzB := hBm p hpS ⟨hzV, hzD.1, hlt⟩
          have e1 := connectedComponentIn_eq hzB
          rw [e1, ← e0]; exact hxC
        · left
          have hzA := hAp p hpS ⟨hzV, hzD.1, hgt⟩
          have e1 := connectedComponentIn_eq hzA
          rw [e1, ← e0]; exact hxC
  refine ⟨connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) a₀, connectedComponentIn (Ω \ S) b₀, hCo a₀, hCo b₀, hAB,
    hcov, isConnected_connectedComponentIn_iff.mpr ha₀D,
    isConnected_connectedComponentIn_iff.mpr hb₀D, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    exact closure_mono (hAp p hp) (by rw [← Set.inter_assoc]; exact hclp p hp)
  · intro p hp
    exact closure_mono (hBm p hp) (by rw [← Set.inter_assoc]; exact hclm p hp)

signature.statement:

    ∃ r₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ r₀ ∧ ∀ S : Set M, IsCompact S → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S →
