proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hu : ∀ u : E3, u = ∑ d : Fin 3, u d • e d := by
    intro u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have quad_alg : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (u : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, u i * u j * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * A b j * B a b) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (∑ i : Fin 3, A a i * u i) * (∑ j : Fin 3, A b j * u j) * B a b := by
    intro A B u
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hessLoc_congr : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u v : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] v → ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G u i j y = hessLoc G v i j y := by
    intro G u v y huv i j
    have h1 : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k u y = partialDeriv k v y := by
      intro k
      show fderiv ℝ u y (e k) = fderiv ℝ v y (e k)
      rw [huv.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j u) y = partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j v) y := by
      have hev : partialDeriv j u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] partialDeriv j v := by
        filter_upwards [huv.eventuallyEq_nhds] with z hz
        show fderiv ℝ u z (e j) = fderiv ℝ v z (e j)
        rw [hz.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j u) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j v) y (e i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [hessLoc, h1, h2]
  
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀2, hpos⟩ := far_hess_pos_end g hAF
  refine ⟨r₀, hr₀2, ?_⟩
  intro S hSc hSm l y₀ hy₀ hy₀S
  have hsrc : (hAF.ends l).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends l).source_eq
  have hposl := hpos l
  
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁₀, hy₁S, hy₁max⟩ :=
    far_max_point_exists g hAF l S hSc y₀ (by linarith) hy₀S
  have hy₁r : r₀ < ‖y₁‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hy₀ hy₁₀
  set Φ := (hAF.ends l).Φ with hΦ
  have hlinv : ∀ y ∈ Φ.source, Φ.invFun (Φ y) = y := fun y hy => Φ.left_inv' hy
  have hrinv : ∀ q ∈ Φ.target, Φ (Φ.invFun q) = q := fun q hq => Φ.right_inv' hq
  have hmapt : ∀ q ∈ Φ.target, Φ.invFun q ∈ Φ.source := fun q hq => Φ.map_target' hq
  have hmaps : ∀ y ∈ Φ.source, Φ y ∈ Φ.target := fun y hy => Φ.map_source' hy
  have hy₁src : y₁ ∈ Φ.source := by
    rw [hsrc]
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y₁‖
    linarith
  have hpT : Φ y₁ ∈ Φ.target := hmaps y₁ hy₁src
  obtain ⟨V, f, hVO, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hVS, hHf, -, -⟩ :=
    hSm.2 (Φ y₁) hy₁S Φ.target (Φ.open_target.mem_nhds hpT)
  have hfp : f (Φ y₁) = 0 := by
    have h : Φ y₁ ∈ V ∩ S := ⟨hpV, hy₁S⟩
    rw [hVS] at h
    exact h.2
  
  set κ := chartAt E3 (Φ y₁) with hκ
  have hpκ : Φ y₁ ∈ κ.source := mem_chart_source E3 (Φ y₁)
  set z₀ := κ (Φ y₁) with hz₀def
  set U : Set E3 := κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' V with hUdef
  have hUo : IsOpen U := κ.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hVo
  have hz₀U : z₀ ∈ U := by
    refine ⟨κ.map_source hpκ, ?_⟩
    show κ.symm (κ (Φ y₁)) ∈ V
    rw [κ.left_inv hpκ]
    exact hpV
  set F : E3 → ℝ := fun z => f (κ.symm z) with hFdef
  set hM : M → ℝ := fun q => ‖Φ.invFun q‖ ^ 2 with hMdef
  set H : E3 → ℝ := fun z => hM (κ.symm z) with hHdef
  have hκsymm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ κ.symm U :=
    contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hf.comp_contMDiffOn hκsymm)
  have hhM : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ hM Φ.target :=
    (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun
  have hHs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H U :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hhM.comp hκsymm (fun z hz => hVO hz.2))
  have hF0 : F z₀ = 0 := by
    show f (κ.symm (κ (Φ y₁))) = 0
    rw [κ.left_inv hpκ]
    exact hfp
  have hdF : fderiv ℝ F z₀ ≠ 0 := by
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f (Φ y₁) := hf.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have heq : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f (Φ y₁) = fderiv ℝ F z₀ := by
      rw [hmd.mfderiv]
      simp [writtenInExtChartAt]
      rfl
    rw [← heq]
    exact hdf _ hpV
  have hmax : ∀ z ∈ U, F z = 0 → H z ≤ H z₀ := by
    intro z hz hFz
    have hqV : κ.symm z ∈ V := hz.2
    have hqS : κ.symm z ∈ S := by
      have h : κ.symm z ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hqV, hFz⟩
      rw [← hVS] at h
      exact h.2
    have hqT : κ.symm z ∈ Φ.target := hVO hqV
    have hys := hmapt _ hqT
    have hy1 : 1 < ‖Φ.invFun (κ.symm z)‖ := by
      rw [hsrc] at hys
      exact hys
    have hle := hy₁max (Φ.invFun (κ.symm z)) hy1 (by rw [hrinv _ hqT]; exact hqS)
    have hHz₀ : H z₀ = ‖y₁‖ ^ 2 := by
      show ‖Φ.invFun (κ.symm (κ (Φ y₁)))‖ ^ 2 = ‖y₁‖ ^ 2
      rw [κ.left_inv hpκ, hlinv y₁ hy₁src]
    rw [hHz₀]
    show ‖Φ.invFun (κ.symm z)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖y₁‖ ^ 2
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hle 2
  
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := lagrange_point_multiplier F H U hUo z₀ hz₀U hFs hHs hF0 hdF hmax
  have hD := constrained_second_order F H U hUo z₀ hz₀U hFs hHs hF0 hdF hmax μ hμ
  
  have hinv := hessLoc_chart_invariant g Φ hM Φ.target Φ.open_target hhM y₁ hy₁src hpT
  set A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => κ (Φ w) a) y₁ with hAdef
  have hdetA : A.det ≠ 0 := hinv.1
  have hT : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc (g.coeff Φ) (hM ∘ Φ) i j y₁ =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * A b j * hessLoc (g.coeff κ.symm) H a b z₀ := hinv.2
  have hcongr_end : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc (g.coeff Φ) (hM ∘ Φ) i j y₁ =
      hessLoc (g.coeff Φ) (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ ^ 2) i j y₁ := by
    apply hessLoc_congr
    filter_upwards [Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hy₁src] with z hz
    show ‖Φ.invFun (Φ z)‖ ^ 2 = ‖z‖ ^ 2
    rw [hlinv z hz]
  have hBpos : ∀ w : Fin 3 → ℝ, w ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w a * w b * hessLoc (g.coeff κ.symm) H a b z₀ := by
    intro w hw
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdetA
    set u : Fin 3 → ℝ := Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ w with hudef
    have hAw : Matrix.mulVec A u = w := by
      rw [hudef, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hw
      rw [← hAw, h, Matrix.mulVec_zero]
    have hwa : ∀ a, w a = ∑ i : Fin 3, A a i * u i := by
      intro a
      rw [← hAw]
      rfl
    have h0 := hposl y₁ hy₁r u hu0
    calc (0 : ℝ) < _ := h0
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, u i * u j *
            (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * A b j * hessLoc (g.coeff κ.symm) H a b z₀) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          rw [← hT i j, hcongr_end i j]
      _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, A a i * u i) *
            (∑ j : Fin 3, A b j * u j) * hessLoc (g.coeff κ.symm) H a b z₀ :=
          quad_alg A (fun a b => hessLoc (g.coeff κ.symm) H a b z₀) u
      _ = _ := by simp only [← hwa]
  
  have hH : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff κ.symm z₀)⁻¹ i j * hessLoc (g.coeff κ.symm) F i j z₀) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (g.coeff κ.symm z₀)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i F z₀ * partialDeriv j F z₀) -
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff κ.symm z₀)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a F z₀ *
          ((g.coeff κ.symm z₀)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b F z₀) *
          hessLoc (g.coeff κ.symm) F i j z₀) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (g.coeff κ.symm z₀)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i F z₀ * partialDeriv j F z₀) ^ 3 = 0 :=
    hHf (Φ y₁) hpV hfp
  
  have hG : (g.coeff κ.symm z₀).PosDef :=
    coeff_chart_symm_posDef g (Φ y₁) z₀ (mem_chart_target E3 (Φ y₁))
  have hξ : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k F z₀) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hdF
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, hu v, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun d _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hd : partialDeriv d F z₀ = 0 := congrFun h d
    rw [show fderiv ℝ F z₀ (e d) = partialDeriv d F z₀ from rfl, hd, mul_zero]
  have hBAD : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      hessLoc (g.coeff κ.symm) H i j z₀ - μ * hessLoc (g.coeff κ.symm) F i j z₀ =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j H) z₀ - μ * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) z₀ := by
    intro i j
    simp only [hessLoc, hμ, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  exact levelset_trace_contradiction (g.coeff κ.symm z₀) hG (fun k => partialDeriv k F z₀) hξ
    (fun i j => hessLoc (g.coeff κ.symm) F i j z₀) (fun i j => hessLoc (g.coeff κ.symm) H i j z₀)
    (fun i j => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j H) z₀ - μ * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) z₀)
    μ hBAD hD hBpos hH

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, a, c, ha2, hρs, hρeq, hc, hcpt⟩ := radial_exhaustion_exists g hAF
  have hq0 : 0 < hAF.q := lt_trans (by norm_num) hAF.q_gt
  
  have hbar : ∀ m : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ Rb : ℝ, ∀ y : E3, Rb < ‖y‖ →
      0 < levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ) (fun z => ‖z‖) y := by
    intro m
    have hsrc : (hAF.ends m).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends m).source_eq
    have hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
      intro i j
      rw [← hsrc]
      exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g (hAF.ends m).Φ i j
    obtain ⟨Rm, Cm, hR1, hC0, hb⟩ :=
      metric_coeff_bounds (g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ) hAF.q hq0 hsmooth (hAF.decay m)
    have hdec : Dec1 (g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ) hAF.q Rm Cm := by
      intro x hx i j
      obtain ⟨_, hrest⟩ := hb x hx
      refine ⟨(hrest i j 0).1, fun l' => ?_⟩
      have h1 := (hrest i j l').2.1
      calc |partialDeriv l' (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ y i j) x|
          = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ y i j) x (e l')‖ := by
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; rfl
        _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ y i j) x‖ * ‖e l'‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ y i j) x‖ := by
            simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
        _ ≤ _ := h1
    obtain ⟨Rb, -, hRb⟩ := coordSphere_levelMeanCurvCoord_pos (g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ) hAF.q
      Rm Cm hq0 hR1 hC0 (fun x hx => (hb x hx).1) hdec
    exact ⟨Rb, hRb⟩
  choose Rb hRb using hbar
  obtain ⟨Rs, hRs⟩ := Finite.exists_le Rb
  set r₁ : ℝ := max (max a c) Rs + 1 with hr₁
  have har : a < r₁ := by
    have := le_max_left a c
    have := le_max_left (max a c) Rs
    linarith
  have hcr : c < r₁ := by
    have := le_max_right a c
    have := le_max_left (max a c) Rs
    linarith
  have hRbr : ∀ m, Rb m < r₁ := by
    intro m
    have := hRs m
    have := le_max_right (max a c) Rs
    linarith
  
  have hsub : ∀ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (r : ℝ), 1 ≤ r →
      {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} ⊆ (hAF.ends m).Φ.source := by
    intro m r hr y hy
    rw [(hAF.ends m).source_eq]
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
    have : r < ‖y‖ := hy
    linarith
  have hopen : ∀ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (r : ℝ), 1 ≤ r →
      IsOpen ((hAF.ends m).Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖}) := by
    intro m r hr
    exact (hAF.ends m).Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm) (hsub m r hr)
  have htgt : ∀ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), 1 < ‖y‖ →
      (hAF.ends m).Φ y ∈ (hAF.ends m).Φ.target := by
    intro m y hy
    have hy' : y ∈ (hAF.ends m).Φ.source := by
      rw [(hAF.ends m).source_eq]; exact hy
    exact (hAF.ends m).Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.map_source hy'
  have hne : ∀ m m' : Fin hAF.numEnds, m ≠ m' → ∀ y z : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → 1 < ‖z‖ →
      (hAF.ends m).Φ y ≠ (hAF.ends m').Φ z := by
    intro m m' hmm' y z hy hz heq
    have h1 := htgt m y hy
    have h2 := htgt m' z hz
    rw [heq] at h1
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hAF.disjoint hmm') h1 h2
  
  have hD1 : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p →
      ∃ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), a < ‖y‖ ∧ (hAF.ends m).Φ y = p := by
    intro p hp
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have := hc p hcon
    linarith
  
  have hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨m, y, hay, rfl⟩ := hD1 p hp
    have hy : ρ ((hAF.ends m).Φ y) = ‖y‖ := hρeq m y hay
    have hy1 : (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := by linarith
    have hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ρ ((hAF.ends m).Φ z) = ‖z‖ :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hay)
        (fun z hz => hρeq m z hz)
    have hysrc : y ∈ (hAF.ends m).Φ.source := by
      rw [(hAF.ends m).source_eq]; exact hy1
    rw [levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g (hAF.ends m).Φ ρ (fun z => ‖z‖) hρs y hysrc hfh]
    apply hRb m y
    have := hRbr m
    linarith
  
  have hAsub : (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₁ < ‖y‖} ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hy' : r₁ < ‖y‖ := hy
    show r₁ < ρ _
    rw [hρeq l y (by linarith)]
    exact hy'
  have hAo : IsOpen ((hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₁ < ‖y‖}) := hopen l r₁ (by linarith)
  have hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₁ < ‖y‖}) := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
    rintro p ⟨hp, hpA⟩
    have hp' : r₁ < ρ p := hp
    obtain ⟨m, y, hay, rfl⟩ := hD1 p (le_of_lt hp')
    have hyr : r₁ < ‖y‖ := by
      rw [hρeq m y hay] at hp'
      exact hp'
    by_cases hml : m = l
    · subst hml
      exact absurd ⟨y, hyr, rfl⟩ hpA
    · refine ⟨(hAF.ends m).Φ '' {z : E3 | r₁ < ‖z‖}, ?_, hopen m r₁ (by linarith),
        ⟨y, hyr, rfl⟩⟩
      rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      have hz' : r₁ < ‖z‖ := hz
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · show r₁ < ρ _
        rw [hρeq m z (by linarith)]
        exact hz'
      · rintro ⟨z', hz'', heq⟩
        have hz''' : r₁ < ‖z'‖ := hz''
        exact hne m l hml z z' (by linarith) (by linarith) heq.symm
  
  obtain ⟨E, E', hEo, hE'o, hdisj, hAE, hBE', hScpt, hSmin⟩ :=
    separating_minimal_surface_of_mean_convex_exhaustion g ρ r₁
      ((hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₁ < ‖y‖}) hρs hcpt hmc hAsub hAo hBo
  refine ⟨(E ∪ E')ᶜ, r₁, hScpt, hSmin, ?_⟩
  
  rintro C hC hCS ⟨⟨x, hxC, hxk⟩, ⟨z, hzC, hzl⟩⟩
  have hCsub : C ⊆ E ∪ E' := by
    intro w hw
    by_contra hw'
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hCS hw hw'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hxk
  have hy' : r₁ < ‖y‖ := hy
  have hxE' : (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ E' := by
    apply hBE'
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show r₁ < ρ _
      rw [hρeq k y (by linarith)]
      exact hy'
    · rintro ⟨z', hz', heq⟩
      have hz'' : r₁ < ‖z'‖ := hz'
      exact hne k l hkl y z' (by linarith) (by linarith) heq.symm
  have hzE : z ∈ E := hAE hzl
  rcases hC.subset_or_subset hEo hE'o hdisj hCsub with h | h
  · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (h hxC) hxE'
  · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hzE (h hzC)

def levelMeanCurvCoord (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  lapLoc G f y /
      Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y) -
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a f y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b f y) * hessLoc G f i j y) /
      Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y) ^ 3

    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
    have : (U ∩ N₁).restrict φO = fun x => φN (Set.inclusion hUN₁ x) := by
      funext x
      show φO x.1 = _
      rw [hφO]
      simp only
      rw [dif_pos x.2]
    rw [this]
    exact φN.continuous.comp (continuous_inclusion hUN₁)
  have hc2 : ContinuousOn φO Fr := by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
    have : Fr.restrict φO = fun x => φF x := by
      funext x
      show φO x.1 = _
      rw [hφO]
      simp only
      rw [dif_neg (fun h => hdisj x.1 h.2 x.2), dif_pos x.2]
    rw [this]
    exact φF.continuous
  have hUO : U ∩ (N₁ ∪ Fr) = (U ∩ N₁) ∪ Fr := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxU, hxN | hxF⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hxU, hxN⟩
      · exact Or.inr hxF
    · rintro (⟨hxU, hxN⟩ | hxF)
      · exact ⟨hxU, Or.inl hxN⟩
      · exact ⟨hFrU hxF, Or.inr hxF⟩
  have hcO : ContinuousOn φO (U ∩ (N₁ ∪ Fr)) := by
    rw [hUO]
    exact hc1.union_of_isOpen hc2 (hUo.inter hN₁o) hFro
  have hφe : ∀ x : U, (x : M) ∈ N₁ ∪ Fr → θ x = Circle.exp (φO x) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hxN | hxF
    · have h := hφN ⟨x.1, hUN₁ ⟨x.2, hxN⟩⟩
      rw [hφO]
      simp only
      rw [dif_pos ⟨x.2, hxN⟩]
      exact h
    · have h := hφF ⟨x.1, hxF⟩
      rw [hφO]
      simp only
      rw [dif_neg (fun h => hdisj x.1 h.2 hxF), dif_pos hxF]
      exact h
  
  obtain ⟨K, Θ, ψ₁, hKc, hKU, hΘK, hθΘ⟩ :=
    circle_normalize_off_compact U (N₁ ∪ Fr) hUo hOo hfrO hCO θ φO hcO hφe
  
  obtain ⟨K', Ψ, ψ₂, hK'c, hK'U, hΨK', hΨs, hΘΨ⟩ := circle_smooth_approx U K hUo hKc hKU Θ hΘK
  
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀, hbar⟩ := radial_levelMeanCurv_pos g hAF k
  by_cases hl : ∃ φ : C(U, ℝ), ∀ x : U, Ψ (x : M) = Circle.exp (φ x)
  · obtain ⟨φΨ, hφΨ⟩ := hl
    refine ⟨φΨ + ψ₂.comp ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ + ψ₁, fun x => ?_⟩
    rw [hθΘ x, hΘΨ x, hφΨ x, ContinuousMap.add_apply, ContinuousMap.add_apply, Circle.exp_add,
      Circle.exp_add]
    rfl
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨S, hSc, hSm, hSU, hSne⟩ := minimal_dual_surface_exists g hAF k U ρ hUo hρ hfar hcpt
      hfront R₀ hR₀ hbar Ψ hΨs K' hK'c hK'U hΨK' hl
    have h0 := hnone S hSc hSm hSU
    rw [h0] at hSne
    exact Set.not_nonempty_empty hSne

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hfront : HasMinimalFrontier g U) :
    Nonempty (FlipCoverTop g U)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hcmp1, hcmp2⟩ := frontier_chart_compare g U hfront
  
  have hchart : ∀ {V : Set M} {f : M → ℝ} {p : M}, IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p →
      IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∧
      IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) := by
    intro V f p h
    unfold IsMinimalFrontierChart at h
    exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩
  
  have hF1 : ∀ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ) (p x : M), IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p → x ∈ V →
      IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f x := by
    intro V f p x hC hx
    unfold IsMinimalFrontierChart at hC ⊢
    exact ⟨hC.1, hx, hC.2.2⟩
  
  have hzero : ∀ {V : Set M} {f : M → ℝ} {p x : M}, IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p → x ∈ V →
      (x ∈ frontier U ↔ f x = 0) := by
    intro V f p x hC hx
    have hz := (hchart hC).2.2.2.2.1
    constructor
    · intro hxf
      have h1 : x ∈ V ∩ frontier U := ⟨hx, hxf⟩
      rw [hz] at h1
      exact h1.2
    · intro h0
      have h1 : x ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hx, h0⟩
      rw [← hz] at h1
      exact h1.2
  
  have hsgn : ∀ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ) (p : M), IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p →
      p ∈ frontier U → (∃ᶠ y in 𝓝 p, 0 < f y) ∧ (∃ᶠ y in 𝓝 p, f y < 0) := by
    intro V f p hC hp
    obtain ⟨_, hpV, hfs, hdf, _⟩ := hchart hC
    have hp0 : f p = 0 := (hzero hC hpV).1 hp
    have h1 := frontier_sign_change f p hfs hp0 (hdf p hpV)
    exact ⟨Filter.frequently_iff.mpr (fun hO => (h1 _ hO).1),
      Filter.frequently_iff.mpr (fun hO => (h1 _ hO).2)⟩
  
  have hdichGen : ∀ (V₁ V₂ : Set M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ) (p₁ p₂ x : M),
      IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V₁ f₁ p₁ → IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V₂ f₂ p₂ →
      x ∈ V₁ → x ∈ V₂ → x ∈ frontier U →
      (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (0 < f₁ y → 0 < f₂ y) ∧ (f₁ y < 0 → f₂ y < 0)) ∨
      (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (0 < f₁ y → f₂ y < 0) ∧ (f₁ y < 0 → 0 < f₂ y)) := by
    intro V₁ V₂ f₁ f₂ p₁ p₂ x h1 h2 hx1 hx2 hxf
    obtain ⟨N, hNo, hxN, -, hcase⟩ := hcmp2 V₁ V₂ f₁ f₂ p₁ p₂ x h1 h2 hx1 hx2 hxf
    rcases hcase with hA | hB
    · left
      filter_upwards [hNo.mem_nhds hxN] with y hy
      exact ⟨(hA y hy).1.mp, (hA y hy).2.mp⟩
    · right
      filter_upwards [hNo.mem_nhds hxN] with y hy
      exact ⟨(hB y hy).1.mp, (hB y hy).2.mp⟩
  
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : Set M, S = {q : M | q ∈ frontier U ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ),
      IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f q ∧ V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0}} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemS : ∀ q : M, q ∈ S ↔ (q ∈ frontier U ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ),
      IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f q ∧ V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0}) := by
    intro q
    rw [hSdef]
    rfl
  have hch : ∀ q : M, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), q ∈ S →
      IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f q ∧ V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0} := by
    intro q
    by_cases hq : q ∈ S
    · obtain ⟨_, V, f, h1, h2⟩ := (hmemS q).1 hq
      exact ⟨V, f, fun _ => ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨∅, 0, fun h => absurd h hq⟩
  choose V₀ σ hσ using hch
  
  have hUS : ∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ S := by
    intro x hxU hxS
    have h := hUo.inter_frontier_eq
    have hx : x ∈ U ∩ frontier U := ⟨hxU, ((hmemS x).1 hxS).1⟩
    rw [h] at hx
    exact hx
  have hV0open : ∀ q ∈ S, IsOpen (V₀ q) := fun q hq => (hchart (hσ q hq).1).1
  have hV0mem : ∀ q ∈ S, q ∈ V₀ q := fun q hq => (hchart (hσ q hq).1).2.1
  have hσcont : ∀ q ∈ S, ContinuousOn (σ q) (V₀ q) :=
    fun q hq => (hchart (hσ q hq).1).2.2.1.continuous.continuousOn
  
  have hF2 : ∀ q ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ V₀ q, (x ∈ S ↔ σ q x = 0) := by
    intro q hq x hx
    obtain ⟨hC, htwo⟩ := hσ q hq
    constructor
    · intro hxS
      exact (hzero hC hx).1 ((hmemS x).1 hxS).1
    · intro h0
      exact (hmemS x).2 ⟨(hzero hC hx).2 h0, V₀ q, σ q, hF1 _ _ _ _ hC hx, htwo⟩
  
  have hF3 : IsClosed S := by
    rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro q hq
    by_cases hqf : q ∈ frontier U
    · obtain ⟨V, f, -, hC⟩ := hfront q hqf Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
      have hside : V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | 0 < f x} ∨ V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0} := by
        unfold IsMinimalFrontierChart at hC
        exact hC.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
      obtain ⟨hVo, hqV, _⟩ := hchart hC
      rcases hside with hone | htwo
      · refine Filter.mem_of_superset (hVo.mem_nhds hqV) ?_
        intro x hxV hxS
        obtain ⟨hxf, V₂, f₂, hC₂, htwo₂⟩ := (hmemS x).1 hxS
        exact hcmp1 V V₂ f f₂ q x x hC hC₂ hone htwo₂ hxV (hchart hC₂).2.1 hxf
      · exact absurd ((hmemS q).2 ⟨hqf, V, f, hC, htwo⟩) hq
    · refine Filter.mem_of_superset (isClosed_frontier.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hqf) ?_
      intro x hx hxS
      exact hx ((hmemS x).1 hxS).1
  
  have hposS : ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ᶠ y in 𝓝 q, 0 < σ q y := fun q hq =>
    (hsgn _ _ _ (hσ q hq).1 ((hmemS q).1 hq).1).1
  
  have hdichS : ∀ q ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ V₀ q →
      (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (0 < σ x y → 0 < σ q y) ∧ (σ x y < 0 → σ q y < 0)) ∨
      (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (0 < σ x y → σ q y < 0) ∧ (σ x y < 0 → 0 < σ q y)) := by
    intro q hq x hx hxq
    exact hdichGen (V₀ x) (V₀ q) (σ x) (σ q) x q x (hσ x hx).1 (hσ q hq).1 (hV0mem x hx) hxq
      ((hmemS x).1 hx).1
  
  have hagree : ∀ (W : Set M) (φ₁ φ₂ : M → Bool), IsOpen W → IsFlipSection S σ W φ₁ →
      IsFlipSection S σ W φ₂ → IsOpen {x | x ∈ W ∧ φ₁ x = φ₂ x} := by
    intro W φ₁ φ₂ hW h₁ h₂
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    rintro q ⟨hqW, hq12⟩
    by_cases hqS : q ∈ S
    · have e₁ := (h₁ q hqW).2 hqS
      have e₂ := (h₂ q hqW).2 hqS
      obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀, hN₀p⟩ := (e₁.and e₂).exists_mem
      have hNmem : interior (N₀ ∩ W ∩ V₀ q) ∈ 𝓝 q :=
        interior_mem_nhds.mpr (Filter.inter_mem (Filter.inter_mem hN₀ (hW.mem_nhds hqW))
          ((hV0open q hqS).mem_nhds (hV0mem q hqS)))
      have key : ∀ w ∈ N₀ ∩ W ∩ V₀ q, σ q w ≠ 0 → φ₁ w = φ₂ w := by
        rintro w ⟨⟨hwN₀, _⟩, _⟩ hw0
        obtain ⟨⟨a1, b1⟩, ⟨a2, b2⟩⟩ := hN₀p w hwN₀
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hw0 with hneg | hpos'
        · rw [b1 hneg, b2 hneg, hq12]
        · rw [a1 hpos', a2 hpos', hq12]
      refine Filter.mem_of_superset hNmem ?_
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨⟨hyN₀, hyW⟩, hyV⟩ := interior_subset hy
      refine ⟨hyW, ?_⟩
      by_cases hy0 : σ q y = 0
      · have hyS : y ∈ S := (hF2 q hqS y hyV).2 hy0
        have hev : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 y, ((0 < σ y w → φ₁ w = φ₁ y) ∧ (σ y w < 0 → φ₁ w = !φ₁ y)) ∧
            ((0 < σ y w → φ₂ w = φ₂ y) ∧ (σ y w < 0 → φ₂ w = !φ₂ y)) ∧
            w ∈ interior (N₀ ∩ W ∩ V₀ q) ∧ w ∈ V₀ y :=
          ((h₁ y hyW).2 hyS).and (((h₂ y hyW).2 hyS).and
            ((show ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 y, w ∈ interior (N₀ ∩ W ∩ V₀ q) from isOpen_interior.mem_nhds hy).and
              (show ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 y, w ∈ V₀ y from (hV0open y hyS).mem_nhds (hV0mem y hyS))))
        obtain ⟨w, hwpos, ⟨hw1, _⟩, ⟨hw2, _⟩, hwI, hwVy⟩ := ((hposS y hyS).and_eventually hev).exists
        have hwS : w ∉ S := fun h => (ne_of_gt hwpos) ((hF2 y hyS w hwVy).1 h)
        have hwI' := interior_subset hwI

        have := key w hwI' hwq

        exact this

    · have e₁ := (h₁ q hqW).1 hqS
      have e₂ := (h₂ q hqW).1 hqS
      filter_upwards [e₁, e₂, hW.mem_nhds hqW] with x hx1 hx2 hxW
      exact ⟨hxW, by rw [hx1, hx2, hq12]⟩
  
  have hex : ∀ (q : M) (b : Bool) (O : Set M), O ∈ 𝓝 q → ∃ (W : Set M) (φ : M → Bool),
      IsOpen W ∧ q ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ O ∧ IsFlipSection S σ W φ ∧ φ q = b := by
    intro q b O hO
    by_cases hqS : q ∈ S
    · have hq0 : σ q q = 0 := (hF2 q hqS q (hV0mem q hqS)).1 hqS
      refine ⟨interior O ∩ V₀ q, fun y => if 0 < σ q y then b else if σ q y < 0 then !b
          else if (∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 y, 0 < σ y w → 0 < σ q w) then b else !b,
        isOpen_interior.inter (hV0open q hqS),
        ⟨mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hO, hV0mem q hqS⟩,
        fun y hy => interior_subset hy.1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        obtain ⟨_, hxV⟩ := hx
        constructor
        · intro hxS
          have hx0 : σ q x ≠ 0 := fun h => hxS ((hF2 q hqS x hxV).2 h)
          have hcont : ContinuousAt (σ q) x :=
            (hσcont q hqS).continuousAt ((hV0open q hqS).mem_nhds hxV)
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx0 with hneg | hpos'
          · filter_upwards [hcont.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hneg)] with y hy
            simp only [not_lt.mpr hy.le, not_lt.mpr hneg.le, hy, hneg, if_false, if_true]
          · filter_upwards [hcont.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hpos')] with y hy
            simp only [hy, hpos', if_true]
        · intro hxS
          have hx0 : σ q x = 0 := (hF2 q hqS x hxV).1 hxS
          rcases hdichS q hqS x hxS hxV with hA | hB
          · have hP : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 x, 0 < σ x w → 0 < σ q w := hA.mono (fun w hw => hw.1)
            filter_upwards [hA] with y hy

            · intro hpy
              have h1 := hy.1 hpy
              simp only [h1, hx0, lt_self_iff_false, hP, if_true, if_false]

def IsFlipSection {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (σ : X → X → ℝ) (W : Set X)
    (φ : X → Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ W, (q ∉ S → ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 q, φ x = φ q) ∧
    (q ∈ S → ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 q, (0 < σ q x → φ x = φ q) ∧ (σ q x < 0 → φ x = !φ q))


def FlipPt (X : Type*) : Type _ := X × Bool

    (q ∈ S → ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 q, (0 < σ q x → φ x = φ q) ∧ (σ q x < 0 → φ x = !φ q))

    have hopen : IsOpen (L0 '' {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖}) := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
      rintro w ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨e, hwe, hpe⟩ := F.covering.isLocalHomeomorph (L0 y)
      have hN : IsOpen ({y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} ∩ L0 ⁻¹' e.source) :=
        hL0c.isOpen_inter_preimage hAo e.open_source
      have hNsub : {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} ∩ L0 ⁻¹' e.source ⊆ Φ0.Φ.source := by
        rw [Φ0.source_eq]
        exact Set.inter_subset_left
      have hkey : ∀ y' ∈ {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} ∩ L0 ⁻¹' e.source, e.symm (Φ0.Φ y') = L0 y' := by
        intro y' hy'
        rw [← hL0p y' hy'.1, hpe]
        exact e.left_inv hy'.2
      have hΦN : IsOpen (Φ0.Φ '' ({y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} ∩ L0 ⁻¹' e.source)) :=
        Φ0.Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source hN hNsub
      have hΦNt : Φ0.Φ '' ({y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} ∩ L0 ⁻¹' e.source) ⊆ e.symm.source := by
        rintro _ ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩
        rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source, ← hL0p y' hy'.1, hpe]
        exact e.map_source hy'.2
      refine ⟨e.symm '' (Φ0.Φ '' ({y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} ∩ L0 ⁻¹' e.source)), ?_,
        e.symm.isOpen_image_of_subset_source hΦN hΦNt, ?_⟩
      · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨y', hy'.1, (hkey y' hy').symm⟩
      · exact ⟨Φ0.Φ y, ⟨y, ⟨hy, hwe⟩, rfl⟩, hkey y ⟨hy, hwe⟩⟩
    
    have hLsm : ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ L0 y := by
      intro y hy
      have hev : ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 y, 1 < ‖y'‖ ∧ L0 y' ∈ (chartAt E3 (L0 y)).source := by
        have h1 : ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 y, 1 < ‖y'‖ := hAo.mem_nhds hy
        have h2 : ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 y, L0 y' ∈ (chartAt E3 (L0 y)).source :=
          (hL0c.continuousAt (hAo.mem_nhds hy)).preimage_mem_nhds
            ((chartAt E3 (L0 y)).open_source.mem_nhds (mem_chart_source E3 (L0 y)))
        exact h1.and h2
      have heq' : L0 =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun y' => (chartAt E3 (L0 y)).symm
          (chartAt E3 (F.proj (L0 y)) (Φ0.Φ y'))) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with y' hy'
        rw [← hL0p y' hy'.1, ← F.chart_eq (L0 y) _ hy'.2,
          (chartAt E3 (L0 y)).left_inv hy'.2]
      have hΦs : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ0.Φ y :=
        Φ0.Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.contMDiffAt (Φ0.Φ.open_source.mem_nhds (hsrc0 y hy))
      have hC : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 (F.proj (L0 y))) (Φ0.Φ y) := by
        rw [← hL0p y hy]
        exact contMDiffOn_chart.contMDiffAt
          ((chartAt E3 (F.proj (L0 y))).open_source.mem_nhds
            (mem_chart_source E3 (F.proj (L0 y))))
      have hcs : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 (L0 y)).symm
          (chartAt E3 (F.proj (L0 y)) (Φ0.Φ y)) := by
        have h1 : chartAt E3 (F.proj (L0 y)) (Φ0.Φ y) = chartAt E3 (L0 y) (L0 y) := by
          rw [← hL0p y hy]
          exact (F.chart_eq (L0 y) (L0 y) (mem_chart_source E3 (L0 y))).symm
        rw [h1]
        exact contMDiffOn_chart_symm.contMDiffAt
          ((chartAt E3 (L0 y)).open_target.mem_nhds (mem_chart_target E3 (L0 y)))
      exact (hcs.comp y (hC.comp y hΦs)).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq'
    let PE : PartialEquiv E3 F.carrier :=
      { toFun := L0
        invFun := fun w => Φ0.Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm (F.proj w)
        source := {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖}
        target := L0 '' {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖}
        map_source' := fun y hy => ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        map_target' := by
          rintro w ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          show Φ0.Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm (F.proj (L0 y)) ∈ {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖}
          rw [hinv y hy]
          exact hy
        left_inv' := fun y hy => hinv y hy
        right_inv' := by
          rintro w ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          show L0 (Φ0.Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm (F.proj (L0 y))) = L0 y
          rw [hinv y hy] }
    have hinvsm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞
        (fun w => Φ0.Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm (F.proj w)) (L0 '' {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖}) := by
      refine Φ0.Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun.comp (hπs.contMDiffOn (s := L0 '' {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})) ?_
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      show F.proj (L0 y) ∈ Φ0.Φ.target
      rw [hL0p y hy]
      exact Φ0.Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source (hsrc0 y hy)
    let PD : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 F.carrier ∞ :=
      { toPartialEquiv := PE
        open_source := hAo
        open_target := hopen
        contMDiffOn_toFun := fun y hy => (hLsm y hy).contMDiffWithinAt
        contMDiffOn_invFun := hinvsm }
    exact ⟨⟨PD, rfl⟩, fun y => rfl, rfl⟩
  have hchart : ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (b : Bool), ∃ Φ' : EndChart F.carrier,
      (∀ y : E3, Φ'.Φ y = L l b y) ∧ Φ'.Φ.target = L l b '' {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} :=
    fun l b => hchartGen (hAF.ends l) (L l b) (hLc l b) (hLp l b)
  choose Φ' hΦ'eq hΦ'tgt using hchart
  
  have hstar : ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (b : Bool), ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ →
      g'.coeff (Φ' l b).Φ y = g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ y := by
    intro l b y hy
    have hAy : {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} ∈ 𝓝 y := hAo.mem_nhds hy
    apply hcoeff
    · have h1 := (Φ' l b).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun
      rw [(Φ' l b).source_eq] at h1
      exact (h1.contMDiffAt hAy).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    · filter_upwards [hAy] with y' hy'
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hΦ'eq]
      exact hLp l b y' hy'
  
  have hdecay : ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (b : Bool), ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
          (fun y => g'.coeff (Φ' l b).Φ y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q - (m : ℝ)) := by
    intro l b i j m hm
    refine (hAF.decay l i j m hm).congr' ?_ EventuallyEq.rfl
    have hev : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3, 1 < ‖x‖ :=
      tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 1
    filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
    have hloc : (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
        =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => g'.coeff (Φ' l b).Φ y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      filter_upwards [hAo.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
      rw [hstar l b y hy]
    show ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m _ x‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m _ x‖
    rw [(Filter.EventuallyEq.iteratedFDeriv ℝ hloc m).eq_of_nhds]
  
  have hdisjLB : ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (b : Bool) (l' : Fin hAF.numEnds) (b' : Bool),
      (l, b) ≠ (l', b') → ∀ y y' : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → 1 < ‖y'‖ → L l b y ≠ L l' b' y' := by
    intro l b l' b' hne y y' hy hy' heq
    have hp : (hAF.ends l).Φ y = (hAF.ends l').Φ y' := by
      rw [← hLp l b y hy, ← hLp l' b' y' hy', heq]
    have hys' : y ∈ (hAF.ends l).Φ.source := by rw [(hAF.ends l).source_eq]; exact hy
    have hys'' : y' ∈ (hAF.ends l').Φ.source := by rw [(hAF.ends l').source_eq]; exact hy'
    by_cases hll : l = l'
    · subst hll
      have hyy : y = y' := (hAF.ends l).Φ.toPartialEquiv.injOn hys' hys'' hp
      subst hyy
      have hbb : b ≠ b' := fun h => hne (by rw [h])
      have hD1 := (hD l y hy).1
      cases b <;> cases b'
      · exact hbb rfl
      · exact hD1 heq.symm
      · exact hD1 heq
      · exact hbb rfl
    · have h1 : (hAF.ends l).Φ y ∈ (hAF.ends l).Φ.target :=
        (hAF.ends l).Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hys'
      have h2 : (hAF.ends l').Φ y' ∈ (hAF.ends l').Φ.target :=
        (hAF.ends l').Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hys''
      rw [← hp] at h2
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hAF.disjoint hll) h1 h2
  
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : Fin (hAF.numEnds * 2) → EndChart F.carrier, ∀ j,
      E j = Φ' (finProdFinEquiv.symm j).1 (decide ((finProdFinEquiv.symm j).2 = 1)) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hdisj : Pairwise fun j j' : Fin (hAF.numEnds * 2) =>
      Disjoint (E j).Φ.target (E j').Φ.target := by
    intro j j' hjj'
    rw [hE j, hE j', hΦ'tgt, hΦ'tgt, Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro w ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ ⟨y', hy', hw⟩
    refine hdisjLB _ _ _ _ ?_ y' y hy' hy hw
    intro hpair
    apply hjj'
    have h1 : (finProdFinEquiv.symm j').1 = (finProdFinEquiv.symm j).1 :=
      (Prod.ext_iff.mp hpair).1
    have h2 : decide ((finProdFinEquiv.symm j').2 = 1) =
        decide ((finProdFinEquiv.symm j).2 = 1) :=
      (Prod.ext_iff.mp hpair).2
    have h2' : (finProdFinEquiv.symm j').2 = (finProdFinEquiv.symm j).2 := by
      have hfin : ∀ a b : Fin 2, decide (a = 1) = decide (b = 1) → a = b := by decide
      exact hfin _ _ h2
    have h3 : finProdFinEquiv.symm j' = finProdFinEquiv.symm j := Prod.ext h1 h2'
    exact (finProdFinEquiv.symm.injective h3).symm
  have hcore : (⋃ j, (E j).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ =
      F.proj ⁻¹' (⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ := by
    rw [Set.preimage_compl]
    congr 1
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, y, hy, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(finProdFinEquiv.symm j).1, y, hy, ?_⟩
      rw [hE j, hΦ'eq, hLp _ _ y (by linarith)]
    · rintro ⟨l, y, hy, hz⟩
      rcases (hD l y (by linarith)).2 z hz.symm with h | h
      · refine ⟨finProdFinEquiv (l, 1), y, hy, ?_⟩
        rw [hE, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hΦ'eq, h]
        rfl
      · refine ⟨finProdFinEquiv (l, 0), y, hy, ?_⟩
        rw [hE, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hΦ'eq, h]
        rfl
  have hcpt : IsCompact (⋃ j, (E j).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ := by
    rw [hcore]
    exact hprop _ hAF.isCompact_core
  have hdec : ∀ j, ∀ i i' : Fin 3, ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
          (fun y => g'.coeff (E j).Φ y i i' - if i = i' then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-hAF.q - (m : ℝ)) := by
    intro j
    rw [hE j]
    exact hdecay _ _
  have hint : ∀ j, IntegrableOn
      (fun x : E3 => g'.scalarCurvature ((E j).Φ x) * Real.sqrt (g'.coeff (E j).Φ x).det)
      {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro j
    rw [hE j]
    refine (hAF.integrable_scalarCurvature (finProdFinEquiv.symm j).1).congr_fun ?_
      (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm)
    intro y hy
    have hy1 : 1 < ‖y‖ := by
      have h2 : (2 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := hy
      linarith
    simp only
    rw [hscal, hΦ'eq, hLp _ _ y hy1, hstar _ _ y hy1]
  let af : AsymptoticallyFlat g' :=
    { numEnds := hAF.numEnds * 2
      ends := E
      q := hAF.q
      q_gt := hAF.q_gt
      disjoint := hdisj
      isCompact_core := hcpt
      decay := hdec
      integrable_scalarCurvature := hint }
  have hEk : E (finProdFinEquiv (k, 1)) = Φ' k true := by
    rw [hE, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rfl
  refine ⟨af, finProdFinEquiv (k, 1), rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    show F.proj ((E (finProdFinEquiv (k, 1))).Φ y) = _
    rw [hEk, hΦ'eq]
    exact hLp k true y hy
  · intro y hy
    show g'.coeff (E (finProdFinEquiv (k, 1))).Φ y = _
    rw [hEk]
    exact hstar k true y hy

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (U : Set M)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hUc : IsConnected U)
    (hfar : ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ U)
    (hcpt : IsCompact (closure U \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}))
    (hfront : HasMinimalFrontier g U) (F : FlipCover g U) (g' : RiemannianMetric3 F.carrier)
    (hπs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ F.proj)
    (hmf : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (z : F.carrier), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f ∘ F.proj) z = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f (F.proj z))
    (hlmc : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (z : F.carrier),
      g'.levelMeanCurv (f ∘ F.proj) z = g.levelMeanCurv f (F.proj z))
    (hprop : ∀ K : Set M, IsCompact K → IsCompact (F.proj ⁻¹' K))
    (Φ' : EndChart F.carrier) (hΦ' : ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → F.proj (Φ'.Φ y) = (hAF.ends k).Φ y)
    (hρ : 2 ≤ ρ) :
    ∃ W : Set F.carrier, IsOpen W ∧ IsConnected W ∧ (∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → Φ'.Φ y ∈ W) ∧
      IsCompact (closure W \ Φ'.Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ∧
      HasOneSidedMinimalFrontier g' W ∧ Nonempty (W ≃ₜ U)

by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ : ∃ b : Bool, F.label (Φ'.Φ ((ρ + 1) • e 0)) = b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : Set F.carrier, W = F.proj ⁻¹' U ∩ F.label ⁻¹' {b₀} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemW : ∀ x, x ∈ W ↔ F.proj x ∈ U ∧ F.label x = b₀ := by
    intro x
    simp only [hW, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  have hπc : Continuous F.proj := F.covering.continuous
  have hinj : ∀ a b : F.carrier, F.proj a = F.proj b → F.label a = F.label b → a = b := by
    intro a b h1 h2
    apply F.bij.1
    show (F.proj a, F.label a) = (F.proj b, F.label b)
    rw [h1, h2]
  have hLc : ∀ w : F.carrier, F.proj w ∈ U → ContinuousAt F.label w := by
    intro w hw
    exact continuousAt_const.congr ((F.label_locConst w hw).mono fun x hx => hx.symm)
  have hLp : ∀ S : Set F.carrier, IsPreconnected S → S ⊆ F.proj ⁻¹' U →
      ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ w ∈ S, F.label w = F.label a := by
    intro S hS hSU a ha w hw
    exact hS.constant (fun x hx => (hLc x (hSU hx)).continuousWithinAt) hw ha
  have hC : ∀ z ∈ closure W, F.proj z ∈ U → F.label z = b₀ := by
    intro z hz hzU
    have hN : F.proj ⁻¹' U ∩ {w | F.label w = F.label z} ∈ 𝓝 z :=
      Filter.inter_mem ((hUo.preimage hπc).mem_nhds hzU) (F.label_locConst z hzU)
    obtain ⟨w, ⟨_, hw1⟩, hw2⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.mp hz _ hN
    have hw3 := ((hmemW w).1 hw2).2
    have hw1' : F.label w = F.label z := hw1
    rw [← hw1']
    exact hw3
  have hpcl : ∀ z ∈ closure W, F.proj z ∈ closure U := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 := image_closure_subset_closure_image hπc ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact closure_mono (Set.image_subset_iff.mpr fun w hw => ((hmemW w).1 hw).1) h1
  have hWo : IsOpen W := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro z hz
    have hz' := (hmemW z).1 hz
    filter_upwards [(hUo.preimage hπc).mem_nhds hz'.1, F.label_locConst z hz'.1] with w hw1 hw2
    exact (hmemW w).2 ⟨hw1, hw2.trans hz'.2⟩
  have hWfr : ∀ x ∈ frontier W, F.proj x ∈ frontier U := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hWo.frontier_eq] at hx

        refine ⟨_, _, hlift _ hnegchart ?_ hs1, hs1⟩
        intro x hx h0 O hO
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := (hsc x hx (neg_eq_zero.mp h0) O hO).2
        exact ⟨y, hy, by linarith⟩
      · 
        have hb : F.label (ψ.symm xp) = b₀ := (hlp w₀ ⟨hw₀V, hgt⟩).symm.trans hw₀.2
        have hs1 : (ψ.source ∩ F.proj ⁻¹' V) ∩ W =
            (ψ.source ∩ F.proj ⁻¹' V) ∩ {x | 0 < (f ∘ F.proj) x} := by
          ext w
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hwV, hwW⟩
            have hwW' := (hmemW w).1 hwW
            have hne : f (F.proj w) ≠ 0 := ((Set.ext_iff.mp h2 _).1 ⟨hwV.2, hwW'.1⟩).2
            refine ⟨hwV, ?_⟩
            rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
            · exfalso
              apply hab
              rw [hb, ← hwW'.2, hln w ⟨hwV, h⟩]
            · exact h
          · intro hw
            exact ⟨hw.1, (hmemW w).2 ⟨hSpU hw, (hlp w hw).trans hb⟩⟩
        exact ⟨_, _, hlift f ⟨hVo, hpV, hfs, hdf, hzero, hmc, hpos, hneg, Or.inr h2⟩
          (fun x hx h0 O hO => (hsc x hx h0 O hO).1) hs1, hs1⟩
  exact ⟨W, hWo, hWc, hfarW, hcW, hfront', hhomeo⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hu : ∀ u : E3, u = ∑ d : Fin 3, u d • e d := by
    intro u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hcomp_e : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) a = v a := by
    intro v a
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  have hcompo : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z → ∀ l d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z = (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) d := by
    intro ψ z hψ l d
    have hfun : (fun v => ψ v d) = (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ ψ := by
      funext v; simp
    rw [partialDeriv, hfun, fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj d).differentiableAt hψ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp
  have dmul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z → DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => f w * g w) z := fun f g z hf hg => hf.mul hg
  have pd_mul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => f w * g w) z = partialDeriv l f z * g z + f z * partialDeriv l g z := by
    intro f g z l hf hg
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_mul hf hg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have pd_sum : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f a) z) →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, f a w) z = ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv l (f a) z := by
    intro f z l hf
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_sum (fun a _ => hf a), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have pd_comp : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ψ z) → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d F (ψ z) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z := by
    intro F ψ z hψ hF l
    have h1 : partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z = fderiv ℝ F (ψ z) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (F ∘ ψ) z (e l) = _
      rw [fderiv_comp z hF hψ]
      rfl
    rw [h1, hu (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)), map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcompo ψ z hψ]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d _
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  have hpdU : ∀ (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ i,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) U := by
    intro U hU f hf i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) U := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have pullback_partialDeriv : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U V : Set E3),
      IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → (∀ z ∈ U, ψ z ∈ V) →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) V) → ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ l i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv l (partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a)) z * G (ψ z) a b *
              partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z +
            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z *
              (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d (fun y => G y a b) (ψ z) *
                partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z) * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z +
            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z * G (ψ z) a b *
              partialDeriv l (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b)) z) := by
    intro ψ G U V hU hV hψ hmaps hG z hz l i j
    have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z :=
      (hψ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hJd : ∀ a k : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v a)) z := by
      intro a k
      exact ((hpdU U hU _ (contDiffOn_euclidean.mp hψ a) k).contDiffAt
        (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hGd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) (ψ z) := fun a b =>
      ((hG a b).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hmaps z hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hGψd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G (ψ w) a b) z :=
      fun a b => (hGd a b).comp z hψd
    have htd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w *
        G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z :=
      fun a b => dmul _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b)) (hJd b j)
    rw [pd_sum _ _ _ (fun a => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => htd a b))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [pd_sum _ _ _ (fun b => htd a b)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    rw [pd_mul _ _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b)) (hJd b j),
      pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b), pd_comp (fun y => G y a b) ψ z hψd (hGd a b) l]
    ring
  
  have christoffel_pullback_algebra : ∀ (A G Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (dG H dGt : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      A.det ≠ 0 → G.det ≠ 0 → (∀ a b, G a b = G b a) → (∀ c i j, H c i j = H c j i) →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * G a b * A b j) →
      (∀ l i j, dGt l i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (H a l i * G a b * A b j + A a i * (∑ d : Fin 3, dG d a b * A d l) * A b j
          + A a i * G a b * H b l j)) →
      ∀ c i j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ k l *
          (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c l *
          (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) * A a i * A b j + H c i j := by
    intro A G Gt dG H dGt hA hG hGs hH hGt hdGt c i j
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGu : IsUnit G.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hG
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * G * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGiG : G⁻¹ * G = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul G hGu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hα : A * Gt⁻¹ = G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAB, Matrix.one_mul]
    have hα' : ∀ l, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Gt⁻¹ k l = ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * A⁻¹ l b := by
      intro l
      have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hα c) l
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h1
      exact h1
    have hβ : ∀ l, dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j = ∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l *
        (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β)
          + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j) := by
      intro l
      rw [hdGt, hdGt, hdGt]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hH _ j i, hH _ l i, hH _ l j]
      simp only [hGs 1 0, hGs 2 0, hGs 2 1]
      ring
    have eAB : ∀ γ b : Fin 3, A γ 0 * A⁻¹ 0 b + A γ 1 * A⁻¹ 1 b + A γ 2 * A⁻¹ 2 b
        = if γ = b then 1 else 0 := by
      intro γ b
      rw [← Matrix.one_apply, ← hAB, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hcontr : ∀ (u W : Fin 3 → ℝ), ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, u b * A⁻¹ l b) *
        (∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l * W γ) = ∑ b : Fin 3, u b * W b := by
      intro u W
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination
        (u 0 * W 0) * (eAB 0 0).trans (if_pos rfl)
        + (u 1 * W 0) * (eAB 0 1).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 2 * W 0) * (eAB 0 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 0 * W 1) * (eAB 1 0).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 1 * W 1) * (eAB 1 1).trans (if_pos rfl)
        + (u 2 * W 1) * (eAB 1 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 0 * W 2) * (eAB 2 0).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 1 * W 2) * (eAB 2 1).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 2 * W 2) * (eAB 2 2).trans (if_pos rfl)
    have hGG : ∑ a : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * G a b) * H a i j = H c i j := by
      have h2 : ∀ a, ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * G a b = (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) c a := by
        intro a
        rw [← hGiG, Matrix.mul_apply]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => by rw [hGs a b])
      simp only [h2, Matrix.one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
        Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    calc ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ k l *
            (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j))
        = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Gt⁻¹ k l) *
            (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j) := by
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * A⁻¹ l b) * (∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l *
            (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β)
              + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j)) := by
          simp only [hα', hβ]
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b *
            (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β b + dG β α b - dG b α β)
              + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a b * H a i j) := by
          rw [hcontr (fun b => G⁻¹ c b) (fun γ => ∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3,
            A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β) + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j)]
      _ = _ := by
          rw [← hGG]
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
  
  have hbr_alg : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (Γt Γ H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P : Fin 3 → ℝ) (Q : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ c i j, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Γt k i j =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b * A a i * A b j + H c i j) →
      ∀ i j, ((∑ d : Fin 3, (∑ e : Fin 3, Q e d * A e i) * A d j
          + ∑ d : Fin 3, P d * H d i j)
            - ∑ k : Fin 3, Γt k i j * (∑ d : Fin 3, P d * A d k)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * A b j * (Q a b - ∑ k : Fin 3, Γ k a b * P k) := by
    intro A Γt Γ H P Q hT1 i j
    have h0 := hT1 0 i j
    have h1 := hT1 1 i j
    have h2 := hT1 2 i j
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0 h1 h2 ⊢
    linear_combination (-(P 0)) * h0 + (-(P 1)) * h1 + (-(P 2)) * h2
  
  have lmc_alg : ∀ (A Gm Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P Pt : Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (H Ht : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ), A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * Gm a b * A b j) →
      (∀ i, Pt i = ∑ a : Fin 3, P a * A a i) →
      (∀ i j, Ht i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * A b j * H a b) →
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ i j * Pt i * Pt j =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * P i * P j) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ i j * Ht i j =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * H i j) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          Gt⁻¹ i a * Pt a * (Gt⁻¹ j b * Pt b) * Ht i j =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          Gm⁻¹ i a * P a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * P b) * H i j) := by
    intro A Gm Gt P Pt H Ht hA hGt hPt hHt
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * Gm * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hM : A * Gt⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A = Gm⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv]
      calc A * (A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹) * Matrix.transpose A
          = (A * A⁻¹) * Gm⁻¹ * (Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A) := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = Gm⁻¹ := by
            rw [hAB, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, hAB, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul,
              Matrix.mul_one]
    have hM' : ∀ a b, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A a i * Gt⁻¹ i j * A b j = Gm⁻¹ a b := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hM]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [hPt, ← hM']
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    · simp only [hHt, ← hM']
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    · obtain ⟨νt, hνt⟩ : ∃ νt : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i, νt i = ∑ a : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ i a * Pt a :=
        ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ : ∃ ν : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ d, ν d = ∑ a : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ d a * P a :=
        ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      have K : ∀ d, ∑ i : Fin 3, A d i * νt i = ν d := by
        intro d
        simp only [hν, hνt, hPt, ← hM']
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      calc ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            Gt⁻¹ i a * Pt a * (Gt⁻¹ j b * Pt b) * Ht i j
          = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, νt i * νt j * Ht i j := by
            simp only [hνt, Fin.sum_univ_three]
            ring
        _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, νt i * νt j *
              (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * A b j * H a b) := by
            simp only [hHt]
        _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
              (∑ i : Fin 3, A a i * νt i) * (∑ j : Fin 3, A b j * νt j) * H a b := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
            ring
        _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ν a * ν b * H a b := by
            simp only [K]
        _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
              Gm⁻¹ i a * P a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * P b) * H i j := by
            simp only [hν, Fin.sum_univ_three]
            ring
  
  have partialDeriv_comm : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) z = partialDeriv j (partialDeriv i f) z := by
    intro f U hU hf z hz i j
    have hfz : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f z := hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
    have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f z :=
      hfz.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simpa using (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞))
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z :=
      (hfz.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by
        rw [one_add_one_eq_two]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have key2 : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b f) z = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z (e a) (e b) := by
      intro a b
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e b)) z (e a) = _
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    rw [key2, key2, hsymm]
  
  have lmc_congr : ∀ (G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u v : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      G =ᶠ[𝓝 y] G' → u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] v → levelMeanCurvCoord G u y = levelMeanCurvCoord G' v y := by
    intro G G' u v y hG huv
    have hy0 : G y = G' y := hG.eq_of_nhds
    have hent : ∀ a b i, partialDeriv i (fun z => G z a b) y
        = partialDeriv i (fun z => G' z a b) y := by
      intro a b i
      have : (fun z => G z a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => G' z a b) :=
        hG.mono (fun z hz => by simp [hz])
      simp only [partialDeriv, this.fderiv_eq]
    have hchr : ∀ k i j, christoffel G k i j y = christoffel G' k i j y := by
      intro k i j
      simp only [christoffel, hy0, hent]
    have h1 : ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l u y = partialDeriv l v y := by
      intro l
      show fderiv ℝ u y (e l) = fderiv ℝ v y (e l)
      rw [huv.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ i l : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv l u) y =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv l v) y := by
      intro i l
      have hev : (partialDeriv l u) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (partialDeriv l v) := by
        filter_upwards [huv.eventuallyEq_nhds] with z hz
        show fderiv ℝ u z (e l) = fderiv ℝ v z (e l)
        rw [hz.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv l u) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv l v) y (e i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hH : ∀ i j, hessLoc G u i j y = hessLoc G' v i j y := by
      intro i j
      simp only [hessLoc, hchr, h1, h2]
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, lapLoc, hy0, hH, h1]
  
  have key : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ) (U V : Set E3),
      IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → (∀ z ∈ U, ψ z ∈ V) →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) V) →
      (∀ y a b, G y a b = G y b a) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u V → x ∈ U →
      (G (ψ x)).det ≠ 0 →
      (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => ψ w a) x).det ≠ 0 →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (fun w => Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w)
          (fun w => u (ψ w)) x
        = levelMeanCurvCoord G u (ψ x) := by
    intro ψ G u U V hUo hVo hψ hmaps hG hGsym huV hxU hdetG hdetJ
    have hψc : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v => ψ v a) U := fun a =>
      contDiffOn_euclidean.mp hψ a
    set Gt : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := fun w => Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 3 =>
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w
      with hGt
    have hH : ∀ c i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) x
        = partialDeriv j (partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v c)) x :=
      fun c i j => partialDeriv_comm _ U hUo (hψc c) x hxU i j
    have hT1 : ∀ c i j : Fin 3,
        ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) x * christoffel Gt k i j x
          = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G c a b (ψ x) * partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) x *
            partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) x + partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) x := by
      intro c i j
      have h8 := pullback_partialDeriv ψ G U V hUo hVo hψ hmaps hG x hxU
      have h9 := christoffel_pullback_algebra
        (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => ψ w a) x) (G (ψ x)) (Gt x)
        (fun d a b => partialDeriv d (fun y => G y a b) (ψ x))
        (fun c i j => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) x)
        (fun l i j => partialDeriv l (fun w => Gt w i j) x)
        hdetJ hdetG (fun a b => hGsym _ a b)
        (fun c i j => hH c i j) (fun i j => rfl) (fun l i j => h8 l i j) c i j
      exact h9
    have hψd : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z := fun z hz =>
      (hψ.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hud : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ u (ψ z) := fun z hz =>
      (huV.contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds (hmaps z hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have h7a : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w => u (ψ w)) x
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d u (ψ x) * partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v d) x :=
      fun k => pd_comp u ψ x (hψd x hxU) (hud x hxU) k
    have hJd : ∀ a k : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v a)) x := by
      intro a k
      exact ((hpdU U hUo _ (hψc a) k).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hxU)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hPd : ∀ d : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv d u) (ψ x) := fun d =>
      ((hpdU V hVo u huV d).contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds (hmaps x hxU))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hPψd : ∀ d : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv d u (ψ y)) x := fun d =>
      (hPd d).comp x (hψd x hxU)
    have h7b : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun w => u (ψ w))) x
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, (∑ e : Fin 3, partialDeriv e (partialDeriv d u) (ψ x) *
            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v e) x) * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v d) x
          + ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d u (ψ x) * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v d)) x := by
      intro i j
      have hev : (partialDeriv j (fun w => u (ψ w))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          (fun y => ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d u (ψ y) * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v d) y) := by
        filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds hxU] with y hy
        exact pd_comp u ψ y (hψd y hy) (hud y hy) j
      have e1 : partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun w => u (ψ w))) x
          = partialDeriv i (fun y => ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d u (ψ y) *
              partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v d) y) x :=
        congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e i)) hev.fderiv_eq
      rw [e1, pd_sum _ _ _ (fun d => dmul _ _ _ (hPψd d) (hJd d j)), ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d _
      rw [pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hPψd d) (hJd d j),
        pd_comp (partialDeriv d u) ψ x (hψd x hxU) (hPd d) i]
    have hHt : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc Gt (fun w => u (ψ w)) i j x =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => ψ w a) x *
          partialDeriv j (fun w => ψ w b) x * hessLoc G u a b (ψ x) := by
      intro i j
      have hb := hbr_alg (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => ψ w a) x)
        (fun k i j => christoffel Gt k i j x) (fun c a b => christoffel G c a b (ψ x))
        (fun c i j => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) x)
        (fun d => partialDeriv d u (ψ x))
        (fun e d => partialDeriv e (partialDeriv d u) (ψ x)) hT1 i j
      show partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun w => u (ψ w))) x
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel Gt k i j x * partialDeriv k (fun w => u (ψ w)) x = _
      rw [h7b i j]
      simp only [h7a]
      exact hb
    have hall := lmc_alg (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => ψ w a) x)
      (G (ψ x)) (Gt x) (fun a => partialDeriv a u (ψ x))
      (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun w => u (ψ w)) x)
      (fun a b => hessLoc G u a b (ψ x)) (fun i j => hessLoc Gt (fun w => u (ψ w)) i j x)
      hdetJ (fun i j => rfl) h7a hHt
    have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (Gt x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun w => u (ψ w)) x *
          partialDeriv j (fun w => u (ψ w)) x =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (ψ x))⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i u (ψ x) *
          partialDeriv j u (ψ x) := hall.1
    have e2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (Gt x)⁻¹ i j * hessLoc Gt (fun w => u (ψ w)) i j x =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (ψ x))⁻¹ i j * hessLoc G u i j (ψ x) := hall.2.1
    have e3 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (Gt x)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a (fun w => u (ψ w)) x *
            ((Gt x)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b (fun w => u (ψ w)) x) *
            hessLoc Gt (fun w => u (ψ w)) i j x =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G (ψ x))⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a u (ψ x) * ((G (ψ x))⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b u (ψ x)) *
            hessLoc G u i j (ψ x) := hall.2.2
    unfold levelMeanCurvCoord lapLoc
    rw [e1, e2, e3]
  
  have h2 : IsOpen (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w))
        (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source) := by
    have hΦ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ Φ.source := Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun
    refine ⟨hΦ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Φ.open_source
      (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).open_source, ?_⟩
    have hc : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 (Φ x))
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source := contMDiffOn_chart
    have hcomp := hc.comp (hΦ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun w hw => hw.2)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcomp
  have hxU : x ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source := ⟨hx, mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x)⟩
  have hψd : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z := fun z hz =>
    (h2.2.contDiffAt (h2.1.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hM1 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z) := by
    intro z hz
    have hev : (Φ : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ∘ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w))) := by
      filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
      exact ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hw.2).symm
    rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp z
      (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 (Φ x))
        ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source hz.2)) (hψd z hz).mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
  have hM1' : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source, ∀ u : E3,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z u) := by
    intro z hz u
    rw [hM1 z hz]
    rfl
  
  have s1 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff Φ z i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) z *
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) a b *
            partialDeriv j (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) b) z := by
    intro z hz i j
    have hq : (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) = Φ z :=
      (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hz.2
    have hgq : g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))) = g.g (Φ z) :=
      congrArg g.g hq
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        D = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΦD : ∀ u : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u =
        D (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z u) := by
      intro u
      rw [hM1' z hz u, hD]
      rfl
    have hcD : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) a b
        = g.g (Φ z) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hgq, hD]
      rfl
    have hJ : ∀ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (e k)
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) d) z • e d := by
      intro k
      rw [hu (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (e k))]
      simp only [hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)]
    simp only [hcD]
    show g.g (Φ z) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z (e i))
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z (e j)) = _
    rw [hΦD, hΦD, hJ i, hJ j]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have s3 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
      (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) z).det
        ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz hdet
    obtain ⟨v, hv0, hJv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
    have hloc := PartialDiffeomorph.isLocalDiffeomorphAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ hz.1
    have hinj : ∀ u : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u = 0 → u = 0 := by
      intro u hu0
      rw [← hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv_coe (by simp)] at hu0
      exact (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv (by simp)).map_eq_zero_iff.mp hu0
    have hw : fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
      ext a
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul]
      have := congrFun hJv a
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
        hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)] at this
      simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        WithLp.ofLp_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [← this]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    have h0 : (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
      apply hinj
      rw [hM1' z hz, hw]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero _
    apply hv0
    funext a
    rw [← hcomp_e v a, h0]
    rfl
  
  have s4 : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy hdet
    obtain ⟨v, hv0, hGv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        D = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hid := (mdifferentiable_chart (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (Φ x)).comp_symm_deriv hy
    have hinj : ∀ u : E3, D u = 0 → u = 0 := by
      intro u hu0
      have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun hid u
      have h' : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)) ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D u)
          = u := by
        rw [hD]
        exact h1
      rw [hu0] at h'
      rw [← h']
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero _
    have hcD : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y a b
        = g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
      intro a b
      rw [hD]
      rfl
    have hw0 : (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hv0
      funext a
      rw [← hcomp_e v a, h]
      rfl
    have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i))
      (fun h => hw0 (hinj _ h))
    have hG : ∀ a, ∑ b : Fin 3, g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) * v b = 0 := by
      intro a
      have := congrFun hGv a
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.zero_apply, hcD] at this
      exact this
    have hzero : g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i))
        (D (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i)) = 0 := by
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      calc _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a * ∑ b : Fin 3,
            g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) * v b := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
        _ = 0 := by simp [hG]
    rw [hzero] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
  
  have huW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target := by
    have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm)
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target :=
      hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
  have hmapsW : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
      chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z) ∈ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target :=
    fun z hz => (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source hz.2
  have hkey := key (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm)
    (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y))
    (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target
    h2.1 (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).open_target h2.2 hmapsW
    (fun a b => g.smooth (Φ x) a b)
    (fun y a b => g.symm _ _ _) huW hxU
    (s4 _ ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source (mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x)))) (s3 x hxU)
  have heqG : g.coeff Φ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun w => Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun v => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ v) a) w *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) a b *
          partialDeriv j (fun v => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ v) b) w) := by
    filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hxU] with z hz
    ext i j
    exact s1 z hz i j
  have hequ : h =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun w => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)))) := by
    filter_upwards [hfh, h2.1.mem_nhds hxU] with z hz1 hz2
    show h z = f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)))
    rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hz2.2]
    exact hz1.symm
  have hL : g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ x) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm)
      (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) := rfl
  rw [hL, lmc_congr _ _ _ _ x heqG hequ]
  exact hkey.symm

(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q R C : ℝ)
