proof.tactics:
by
  
  have coordSphere_norm_partials : ∀ (y : E3), y ≠ 0 →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) y = y i / ‖y‖) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖)) y =
        ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - y i * y j / ‖y‖ ^ 2) / ‖y‖) := by
    intro y hy
    have hfd : ∀ z : E3, z ≠ 0 →
        HasFDerivAt (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖) ((‖z‖⁻¹) • innerSL ℝ z) z := by
      intro z hz
      have hzn : ‖z‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz
      have hz2 : ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hzn
      have h := (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq z).hasFDerivAt.sqrt hz2
      have heq : (fun x : E3 => Real.sqrt (‖x‖ ^ 2)) = fun x => ‖x‖ :=
        funext fun x => Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg x)
      rw [heq] at h
      convert h using 1
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
      simp [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg z)]
      field_simp
    have hp1 : ∀ z : E3, z ≠ 0 → ∀ i : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖) z = z i / ‖z‖ := by
      intro z hz i
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [(hfd z hz).fderiv]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
      ring
    refine ⟨hp1 y hy, fun i j => ?_⟩
    have hyn : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hy
    have hev : partialDeriv j (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun z => z j * ‖z‖⁻¹ := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      rw [hp1 z hz j, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have hproj : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => z j) (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have hinvn : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖⁻¹)
        ((-(‖y‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((‖y‖⁻¹) • innerSL ℝ y)) y :=
      (hasDerivAt_inv hyn).comp_hasFDerivAt y (hfd y hy)
    have hprod := hproj.fun_mul hinvn
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j fun x => ‖x‖) y (e i) = _
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hprod.fderiv]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
    · field_simp; ring
    · exact absurd h1.symm h2
    · exact absurd h2.symm h1
    · field_simp; ring
  
  have coordSphere_alg_pos : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Hm : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (ν : Fin 3 → ℝ) (r β ε : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 ≤ β → β ≤ 1 / 200 → 0 ≤ ε →
      ε * r ≤ 1 / 200 → ∑ i : Fin 3, ν i ^ 2 = 1 →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ β) →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |Hm i j - ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j) / r| ≤ ε) →
      0 < (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * Hm i j) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ν i * ν j) -
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          A i a * ν a * (A j b * ν b) * Hm i j) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ν i * ν j) ^ 3 := by
    intro A Hm ν r β ε hr hβ0 hβ hε0 hεr hν hA hH
    
    have h3 : ∀ (X : Fin 3 → ℝ) (M : ℝ), (∀ i, |X i| ≤ M) → |∑ i, X i| ≤ 3 * M := by
      intro X M hX
      calc |∑ i, X i| ≤ ∑ i, |X i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, M := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hX i)
        _ = 3 * M := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
            Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have h9 : ∀ (X : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (M : ℝ), (∀ i j, |X i j| ≤ M) →
        |∑ i, ∑ j, X i j| ≤ 9 * M := by
      intro X M hX
      calc |∑ i, ∑ j, X i j| ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, 3 * M :=
            (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
              (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h3 _ _ (hX i)))
        _ = 9 * M := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
            Nat.cast_ofNat]
          ring
    
    have hd1 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by
      intro i j; split_ifs <;> simp
    have hνsq : ∀ i, ν i ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      intro i; rw [← hν]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => ν k ^ 2) (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hνb : ∀ i, |ν i| ≤ 1 := fun i => (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one (ν i)).mp (hνsq i)
    have hAb : ∀ i j, |A i j| ≤ 1 + β := by
      intro i j
      calc |A i j| = |(A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) + (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| := by
            ring_nf
        _ ≤ |A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| + |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| :=
            abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ β + 1 := add_le_add (hA i j) (hd1 i j)
        _ = 1 + β := by ring
    have hcb : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j| ≤ 1 := by
      intro i j
      by_cases h : i = j
      · subst h
        rw [if_pos rfl, abs_le]
        have := hνsq i
        constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ν i)]
      · rw [if_neg h, zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_mul]
        calc |ν i| * |ν j| ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul (hνb i) (hνb j) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = 1 := one_mul 1
    have hE : ∀ i j, |r * Hm i j - ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j)| ≤ ε * r := by
      intro i j
      have e : r * Hm i j - ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j) =
          r * (Hm i j - ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j) / r) := by
        rw [mul_sub, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hr.ne']
      rw [e, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr]
      calc r * _ ≤ r * ε := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hH i j) hr.le
        _ = ε * r := mul_comm _ _
    
    have hn2eq : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ν i * ν j =
        1 + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * ν i * ν j := by
      have hν' := hν
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceEq, if_true, if_false] at hν' ⊢
      linear_combination hν'
    have hs : |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * ν i * ν j|
        ≤ 9 * β := by
      refine h9 _ _ (fun i j => ?_)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      calc _ ≤ β * 1 * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (hA i j) (hνb i) (abs_nonneg _) hβ0) (hνb j) (abs_nonneg _)
              (by positivity)
        _ = β := by ring
    
    have hrS : r * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * Hm i j =
        2 + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) *
              ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j)
          + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j *
              (r * Hm i j - ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j)) := by
      have hν' := hν
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceEq, if_true, if_false] at hν' ⊢
      linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) * hν'
    have ht1 : |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) *
        ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j)| ≤ 9 * β := by
      refine h9 _ _ (fun i j => ?_)
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc _ ≤ β * 1 := mul_le_mul (hA i j) (hcb i j) (abs_nonneg _) hβ0
        _ = β := by ring
    have ht2 : |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j *
        (r * Hm i j - ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j))| ≤
        9 * ((1 + β) * (ε * r)) := by
      refine h9 _ _ (fun i j => ?_)
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hAb i j) (hE i j) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    
    have hrQ : r * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          A i a * ν a * (A j b * ν b) * Hm i j =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ν a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, A j b * ν b) *
            ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j)
          + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ν a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, A j b * ν b) *
            (r * Hm i j - ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j)) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hQc : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ν a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, A j b * ν b) *
            ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (A i a - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * ν a) ^ 2
          - (∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (A i a - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * ν a) * ν i) ^ 2
          + (1 - ∑ i : Fin 3, ν i ^ 2) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ν i ^ 2 + 2 *
              ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (A i a - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * ν a) * ν i) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceEq, if_true, if_false]
      ring
    rw [hν] at hQc
    have hwb : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        |∑ a : Fin 3, (A i a - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * ν a| ≤ 3 * β := by
      intro i
      refine h3 _ _ (fun a => ?_)
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc _ ≤ β * 1 := mul_le_mul (hA i a) (hνb a) (abs_nonneg _) hβ0
        _ = β := by ring
    have hw2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (A i a - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * ν a) ^ 2
        ≤ 27 * β ^ 2 := by
      have hsq : ∀ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (A i a - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * ν a) ^ 2
          ≤ 9 * β ^ 2 := by
        intro i
        have h := hwb i
        have h' : (3 * β) ^ 2 = 9 * β ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [← h']
        exact sq_le_sq' (abs_le.mp h).1 (abs_le.mp h).2
      calc _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, 9 * β ^ 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hsq i)
        _ = 27 * β ^ 2 := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
            Nat.cast_ofNat]
          ring
    have hQc' : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ν a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, A j b * ν b) *
            ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j) ≤ 27 * β ^ 2 := by
      rw [hQc]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3,
        (A i a - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * ν a) * ν i)]
    have hvb : ∀ i : Fin 3, |∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ν a| ≤ 3 * (1 + β) := by
      intro i
      refine h3 _ _ (fun a => ?_)
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc _ ≤ (1 + β) * 1 := mul_le_mul (hAb i a) (hνb a) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = 1 + β := by ring
    have hQE : |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ν a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, A j b * ν b) *
            (r * Hm i j - ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ν i * ν j))|
        ≤ 9 * (3 * (1 + β) * (3 * (1 + β)) * (ε * r)) := by
      refine h9 _ _ (fun i j => ?_)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (hvb i) (hvb j) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)) (hE i j)
        (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    
    set n2 := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ν i * ν j with hn2def
    set S := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * Hm i j with hSdef
    set Q := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          A i a * ν a * (A j b * ν b) * Hm i j with hQdef
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ ε * r := by positivity
    have hn2lo : 191 / 200 ≤ n2 := by
      rw [hn2eq]; have := (abs_le.mp hs).1; linarith
    have hn2pos : 0 < n2 := by linarith
    have hbx : β * (ε * r) ≤ 1 / 40000 := by
      have := mul_le_mul hβ hεr hx0 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 200); linarith
    have hbb : β * β ≤ 1 / 40000 := by
      have := mul_le_mul hβ hβ hβ0 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 200); linarith
    have hbbx : β * β * (ε * r) ≤ 1 / 8000000 := by
      have := mul_le_mul hbb hεr hx0 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 40000); linarith
    have hrSlo : 19 / 10 ≤ r * S := by
      rw [hrS]
      have a1 := (abs_le.mp ht1).1
      have a2 := (abs_le.mp ht2).1
      have e2 : 9 * ((1 + β) * (ε * r)) = 9 * (ε * r) + 9 * (β * (ε * r)) := by ring
      linarith
    have hrQhi : r * Q ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [hrQ]
      have a2 := (abs_le.mp hQE).2
      have e2 : 9 * (3 * (1 + β) * (3 * (1 + β)) * (ε * r)) =
          81 * (ε * r) + 162 * (β * (ε * r)) + 81 * (β * β * (ε * r)) := by ring
      have e3 : 27 * β ^ 2 = 27 * (β * β) := by ring
      linarith
    have hprod : (191 / 200) * (19 / 10) ≤ n2 * (r * S) :=
      mul_le_mul hn2lo hrSlo (by norm_num) hn2pos.le
    have hnum : 0 < n2 * S - Q := by
      have e : r * (n2 * S - Q) = n2 * (r * S) - r * Q := by ring
      have h1 : 0 < r * (n2 * S - Q) := by rw [e]; linarith
      exact pos_of_mul_pos_right h1 hr.le
    
    have hN : 0 < Real.sqrt n2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hn2pos
    have hN2 : Real.sqrt n2 ^ 2 = n2 := Real.sq_sqrt hn2pos.le
    have key : S / Real.sqrt n2 - Q / Real.sqrt n2 ^ 3 =
        (Real.sqrt n2 ^ 2 * S - Q) / Real.sqrt n2 ^ 3 := by
      field_simp
    rw [key, hN2]
    exact div_pos hnum (pow_pos hN 3)
  
  have hrad : ∃ Rb : ℝ, R ≤ Rb ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, Rb < r → C * r ^ (-q) ≤ 1 / 100000 := by
    refine ⟨max R ((C * 100000) ^ (1 / q)), le_max_left _ _, fun r hr => ?_⟩
    have hr1 : R < r := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hr
    have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
    have hC' : 0 ≤ C * 100000 := by positivity
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ (C * 100000) ^ (1 / q) := Real.rpow_nonneg hC' _
    have htr : (C * 100000) ^ (1 / q) < r := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hr
    have htq : ((C * 100000) ^ (1 / q)) ^ q = C * 100000 := by
      rw [one_div, Real.rpow_inv_rpow hC' hq.ne']
    have h1 : C * 100000 < r ^ q := by
      rw [← htq]; exact Real.rpow_lt_rpow ht0 htr hq
    have hrq : 0 < r ^ q := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 q
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hr0.le, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_iff₀ hrq]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨Rb, hRRb, hRb⟩ := hrad
  refine ⟨Rb, hRRb, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  
  have hRr : R < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt hRRb hy
  have hr0 : 0 < ‖y‖ := by linarith
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp hr0
  obtain ⟨δ, hδdef⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, C * ‖y‖ ^ (-q) = δ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ := by rw [← hδdef]; exact mul_nonneg hC (Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _)
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 / 100000 := by rw [← hδdef]; exact hRb _ hy
  have hG1 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ δ := by
    intro i j; rw [← hδdef]; exact (hdec y hRr i j).1
  have hG2 : ∀ i j k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y| ≤ δ / ‖y‖ := by
    intro i j k
    have h := (hdec y hRr i j).2 k
    rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hr0.ne' (-q), ← mul_div_assoc, hδdef] at h
    exact h
  have hGB : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j| ≤ 1 + δ := by
    intro i j
    have h1 := hG1 i j
    have h2 : |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> simp
    calc |G y i j| = |(G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) + (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| := by
          ring_nf
      _ ≤ |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| + |(if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| :=
          abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ δ + 1 := add_le_add h1 h2
      _ = 1 + δ := by ring
  have hinv := inv3_entry_bounds (G y) (1 + δ) δ (hdet y hRr) hGB hG1
  have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j y| ≤ 18 * (1 + δ) ^ 2 * δ / ‖y‖ := by
    intro k i j
    have h := (christoffel_value_bounds (G y)⁻¹ (fun _ _ _ => 0)
      (fun c a b' => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b') y) (fun _ _ _ _ => 0)
      (4 * (1 + δ) ^ 2) (12 * (1 + δ) ^ 2 * δ) 0 (δ / ‖y‖) 0
      (fun k l => (hinv k l).1) (fun k l => (hinv k l).2) (by intros; simp)
      (fun c a b' => hG2 a b' c) (by intros; simp) 0 k i j).1
    unfold christoffel
    calc _ ≤ 9 / 2 * (4 * (1 + δ) ^ 2) * (δ / ‖y‖) := h
      _ = 18 * (1 + δ) ^ 2 * δ / ‖y‖ := by ring
  obtain ⟨hn1, hn2⟩ := coordSphere_norm_partials y hy0
  have hsq : ∑ i : Fin 3, (y i) ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hν : ∑ i : Fin 3, (y i / ‖y‖) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    simp only [div_pow]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, hsq]
    exact div_self (by positivity)
  have hνb : ∀ k : Fin 3, |y k / ‖y‖| ≤ 1 := by
    intro k
    have h : (y k / ‖y‖) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← hν]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => (y i / ‖y‖) ^ 2) (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_univ k)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y k / ‖y‖ + 1), sq_nonneg (y k / ‖y‖ - 1)]
  have hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |hessLoc G (fun z => ‖z‖) i j y -
      ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - y i / ‖y‖ * (y j / ‖y‖)) / ‖y‖| ≤
      54 * (1 + δ) ^ 2 * δ / ‖y‖ := by
    intro i j
    have e1 : hessLoc G (fun z => ‖z‖) i j y -
        ((if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - y i / ‖y‖ * (y j / ‖y‖)) / ‖y‖ =
        -(∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * (y k / ‖y‖)) := by
      unfold hessLoc
      rw [hn2 i j]
      simp only [hn1]
      ring
    rw [e1, abs_neg, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j y * (y k / ‖y‖)| ≤
        18 * (1 + δ) ^ 2 * δ / ‖y‖ := by
      intro k
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc _ ≤ 18 * (1 + δ) ^ 2 * δ / ‖y‖ * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul (hchr k i j) (hνb k) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = _ := mul_one _
    calc _ ≤ _ := abs_add_three _ _ _
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add_three (hk 0) (hk 1) (hk 2)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hbA : 12 * (1 + δ) ^ 2 * δ ≤ 1 / 200 := by nlinarith
  have hεr : 54 * (1 + δ) ^ 2 * δ / ‖y‖ * ‖y‖ ≤ 1 / 200 := by
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hr0.ne']; nlinarith
  unfold levelMeanCurvCoord lapLoc
  simp only [hn1]
  exact coordSphere_alg_pos (G y)⁻¹ (fun i j => hessLoc G (fun z => ‖z‖) i j y)
    (fun a => y a / ‖y‖) ‖y‖ (12 * (1 + δ) ^ 2 * δ) (54 * (1 + δ) ^ 2 * δ / ‖y‖) hr0
    (by positivity) hbA (by positivity) hεr hν (fun i j => (hinv i j).2) hH

subgoal_signatures.name: inv3_entry_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (B ε : ℝ)
    (hdet : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ A.det)
    (hB : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j| ≤ B)
    (hε : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε) :
    ∀ k l : Fin 3, |A⁻¹ k l| ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 ∧
      |A⁻¹ k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 12 * B ^ 2 * ε

subgoal_signatures.name: christoffel_value_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (dP : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (d1 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (d2 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (b e p α β : ℝ)
    (hPb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l| ≤ b)
    (hPe : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ e)
    (hdP : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, |dP m k l| ≤ p)
    (hd1 : ∀ c a b' : Fin 3, |d1 c a b'| ≤ α)
    (hd2 : ∀ m c a b' : Fin 3, |d2 m c a b'| ≤ β) (m k i j : Fin 3) :
    |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, P k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)| ≤ 9 / 2 * b * α ∧
    |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (dP m k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)
        + P k l * (d2 m i j l + d2 m j i l - d2 m l i j))
      - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (d2 m i j k + d2 m j i k - d2 m k i j)| ≤ 9 / 2 * (p * α + e * β)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) :
    ∃ (ρ : M → ℝ) (a c : ℝ), 2 ≤ a ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ ∧
      (∀ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), a < ‖y‖ → ρ ((hAF.ends m).Φ y) = ‖y‖) ∧
      (∀ p : M, (∀ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), a < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends m).Φ y ≠ p) → ρ p ≤ c) ∧
      (∀ s : ℝ, IsCompact {p : M | ρ p ≤ s})

signature.name: radial_exhaustion_exists
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) :
    ∃ (ρ : M → ℝ) (a c : ℝ), 2 ≤ a ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ ∧
      (∀ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), a < ‖y‖ → ρ ((hAF.ends m).Φ y) = ‖y‖) ∧
      (∀ p : M, (∀ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), a < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends m).Φ y ≠ p) → ρ p ≤ c) ∧
      (∀ s : ℝ, IsCompact {p : M | ρ p ≤ s})

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsub : ∀ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (r : ℝ), 1 ≤ r →
      {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} ⊆ (hAF.ends m).Φ.source := by
    intro m r hr y hy
    rw [(hAF.ends m).source_eq]
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
    have : r < ‖y‖ := hy
    linarith
  have hopen : ∀ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (r : ℝ), 1 ≤ r →
      IsOpen ((hAF.ends m).Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖}) := by
    intro m r hr
    exact (hAF.ends m).Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm) (hsub m r hr)
  have hZ : ∀ r : ℝ, 2 ≤ r → IsCompact (⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖})ᶜ := by
    intro r hr
    have hclosed : IsClosed (⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖})ᶜ := by
      rw [isClosed_compl_iff]
      exact isOpen_iUnion (fun l => hopen l r (by linarith))
    have hK : IsCompact ((⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | 2 < ‖y‖})ᶜ ∪
        ⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ r}) := by
      refine hAF.isCompact_core.union (isCompact_iUnion fun l => ?_)
      have hc : IsCompact {y : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ r} := by
        refine (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) r).of_isClosed_subset ?_ ?_
        · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
            (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)
        · intro y hy
          rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
          exact hy.2
      have hsub' : {y : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ r} ⊆ (hAF.ends l).Φ.source := by
        intro y hy
        rw [(hAF.ends l).source_eq]
        show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
        linarith [hy.1]
      have hcont : ContinuousOn ((hAF.ends l).Φ : E3 → M) (hAF.ends l).Φ.source :=
        (hAF.ends l).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
      exact hc.image_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hsub')
    refine hK.of_isClosed_subset hclosed ?_
    intro x hx
    by_cases h2 : x ∈ ⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | 2 < ‖y‖}
    · right
      obtain ⟨l, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 h2
      have hy' : (2 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := hy
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨l, y, ⟨le_of_lt hy', ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact hx (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨l, y, hc, rfl⟩)
    · left
      exact h2
  
  have hcl := fun m => endChart_far_isClosed g hAF m
  choose ρ₀ hρ₀2 hρ₀cl using hcl
  obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁⟩ := Finite.exists_le ρ₀
  set a₀ : ℝ := max a₁ 2 with ha₀def
  have ha₀2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ a₀ := le_max_right _ _
  have hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := hy
    have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.1 (lt_trans one_pos hy')
    exact (contDiffAt_norm ℝ hy0).contDiffWithinAt
  have hcut := fun m : Fin hAF.numEnds =>
    end_cutoff_extension (hAF.ends m) (fun y : E3 => ‖y‖) 1 a₀ le_rfl (by linarith) hh
      (hρ₀cl m a₀ (le_trans (ha₁ m) (le_max_left _ _)))
  choose u hus hu0 hueq using hcut
  
  set ρ : M → ℝ := fun p => ∑ m : Fin hAF.numEnds, u m p with hρdef
  have hρs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ :=
    contMDiff_finset_sum (fun m _ => hus m)
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρs.continuous
  set a : ℝ := a₀ + 1 with hadef
  have ha2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ a := by linarith
  have htgt : ∀ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), 1 < ‖y‖ →
      (hAF.ends m).Φ y ∈ (hAF.ends m).Φ.target := by
    intro m y hy
    have hy' : y ∈ (hAF.ends m).Φ.source := by
      rw [(hAF.ends m).source_eq]; exact hy
    exact (hAF.ends m).Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.map_source hy'
  have hform : ∀ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), a < ‖y‖ → ρ ((hAF.ends m).Φ y) = ‖y‖ := by
    intro m y hy
    have hy1 : (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := by linarith
    show ∑ b : Fin hAF.numEnds, u b ((hAF.ends m).Φ y) = ‖y‖
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m]
    · exact hueq m y (by linarith)
    · intro b _ hbm
      apply hu0 b
      rintro ⟨z, hz, heq⟩
      have hz' : a₀ < ‖z‖ := hz
      have h1 := htgt b z (by linarith)
      have h2 := htgt m y hy1
      rw [heq] at h1
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hAF.disjoint hbm) h1 h2
    · intro hm
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ m) hm
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hZ a ha2).bddAbove_image hρc.continuousOn
  refine ⟨ρ, a, c, ha2, hρs, hform, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp
    have hpZ : p ∈ (⋃ l, (hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | a < ‖y‖})ᶜ := by
      intro hx
      obtain ⟨m, y, hy, hyp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
      exact hp m y hy hyp
    exact hc ⟨p, hpZ, rfl⟩
  · intro s
    have hr2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ max s a := le_trans ha2 (le_max_right _ _)
    refine (hZ (max s a) hr2).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_le hρc continuous_const) ?_
    intro p hp hx
    have hp' : ρ p ≤ s := hp
    obtain ⟨m, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
    have hy' : max s a < ‖y‖ := hy
    have hya : a < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hy'
    have hys : s < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hy'
    rw [hform m y hya] at hp'
    linarith

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ ρ₀ ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, ρ₀ ≤ ρ → IsClosed ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖x‖})

subgoal_signatures.name: end_cutoff_extension
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (Φ : EndChart M) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (R₁ a : ℝ) (hR₁ : 1 ≤ R₁) (ha : R₁ < a)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h {y : E3 | R₁ < ‖y‖})
    (hclosed : IsClosed (Φ.Φ '' {y : E3 | a ≤ ‖y‖})) :
    ∃ u₀ : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u₀ ∧
      (∀ p : M, p ∉ Φ.Φ '' {y : E3 | a < ‖y‖} → u₀ p = 0) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, a + 1 ≤ ‖y‖ → u₀ (Φ.Φ y) = h y)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M]
    [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (r₁ : ℝ) (A : Set M)
    (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (hcpt : ∀ s : ℝ, IsCompact {p : M | ρ p ≤ s})
    (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p)
    (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A)
    (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) :
    ∃ E E' : Set M, IsOpen E ∧ IsOpen E' ∧ Disjoint E E' ∧ A ⊆ E ∧
      {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A ⊆ E' ∧ IsCompact (E ∪ E')ᶜ ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (E ∪ E')ᶜ

signature.name: separating_minimal_surface_of_mean_convex_exhaustion
signature.statement:
[T2Space M]
    [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (r₁ : ℝ) (A : Set M)
    (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (hcpt : ∀ s : ℝ, IsCompact {p : M | ρ p ≤ s})
    (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p)
    (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A)
    (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) :
    ∃ E E' : Set M, IsOpen E ∧ IsOpen E' ∧ Disjoint E E' ∧ A ⊆ E ∧
      {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A ⊆ E' ∧ IsCompact (E ∪ E')ᶜ ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (E ∪ E')ᶜ

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρ.continuous
  
  have hAm : sepChartMeas A := fun p =>
    ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hAo.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right).measurableSet
  have hfinA := sepRiemPer_far_lt_top g ρ r₁ (r₁ + 2) A hρ hcpt hmc hAsub hAo hBo
  
  have hK : IsCompact {x : M | ρ x ≤ r₁ + 1} := hcpt _
  have hΩ : IsOpen {x : M | ρ x < r₁ + 2} := isOpen_lt hρc continuous_const
  have hKΩ : {x : M | ρ x ≤ r₁ + 1} ⊆ {x : M | ρ x < r₁ + 2} := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : ρ x ≤ r₁ + 1 := hx
    show ρ x < r₁ + 2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨F, hFm, hFA, hFmin⟩ :=
    sepRiemPer_minimizer_exists g _ _ A hK hΩ hKΩ hAm hfinA
  have hAA : symmDiff A A ⊆ {x : M | ρ x ≤ r₁ + 1} := by
    rw [symmDiff_self]; exact Set.empty_subset _
  have hfinF : sepRiemPer g F {x : M | ρ x < r₁ + 2} < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (hFmin A hAm hAA) hfinA
  have hnull : sepChartNull (symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) :=
    sepMinimizer_eq_far_ae g ρ r₁ (r₁ + 1) (r₁ + 2) A F hρ hcpt hmc hAsub hAo hBo
      (by linarith) (by linarith) hFm hFA hfinF hFmin
  have hO : IsOpen {x : M | ρ x < r₁ + 1} := isOpen_lt hρc continuous_const
  have hOK : {x : M | ρ x < r₁ + 1} ⊆ {x : M | ρ x ≤ r₁ + 1} := fun x hx =>
    le_of_lt (show ρ x < r₁ + 1 from hx)
  have hloc : ∀ q : M, sepIsPerMin (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
      (chartAt E3 q '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
      (chartAt E3 q '' ({x : M | ρ x < r₁ + 1} ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) := fun q =>
    sepMinimizer_chart_local g _ _ _ A F hK hΩ hKΩ hO hOK hFm hFA hfinF hFmin q
  
  have N1 : ∀ T T' : Set M, T ⊆ T' → sepChartNull T' → sepChartNull T := by
    intro T T' h h' q
    exact measure_mono_null (Set.image_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ h)) (h' q)
  have N2 : ∀ T T' : Set M, sepChartNull T → sepChartNull T' → sepChartNull (T ∪ T') := by
    intro T T' h h' q
    show volume (chartAt E3 q '' ((T ∪ T') ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) = 0
    rw [Set.union_inter_distrib_right, Set.image_union]
    exact measure_union_null (h q) (h' q)
  have hvolpos : ∀ (s : Set E3) (z : E3), s ∈ 𝓝 z → volume s ≠ 0 := by
    intro s z hs h0
    have h1 : 0 < volume (interior s) :=
      isOpen_interior.measure_pos volume ⟨z, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hs⟩
    have h2 : volume (interior s) = 0 := measure_mono_null interior_subset h0
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact lt_irrefl _ h1
  obtain ⟨E, hEdef⟩ : ∃ E : Set M, E = {x | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, sepChartNull (N \ F)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E', hE'def⟩ : ∃ E' : Set M, E' = {x | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, sepChartNull (N ∩ F)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemE : ∀ x, x ∈ E ↔ ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, sepChartNull (N \ F) := fun x => by
    simp only [hEdef, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  have hmemE' : ∀ x, x ∈ E' ↔ ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, sepChartNull (N ∩ F) := fun x => by
    simp only [hE'def, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  have hEo : IsOpen E := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hNn⟩ := (hmemE x).1 hx
    filter_upwards [interior_mem_nhds.2 hN] with y hy
    exact (hmemE y).2 ⟨N, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.1 hy, hNn⟩
  have hE'o : IsOpen E' := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hNn⟩ := (hmemE' x).1 hx
    filter_upwards [interior_mem_nhds.2 hN] with y hy
    exact (hmemE' y).2 ⟨N, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.1 hy, hNn⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint E E' := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hx'
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁, h₁⟩ := (hmemE x).1 hx
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂, h₂⟩ := (hmemE' x).1 hx'
    have h3 : sepChartNull (N₁ ∩ N₂) := by
      have h4 := N2 _ _
        (N1 ((N₁ ∩ N₂) \ F) (N₁ \ F) (Set.diff_subset_diff_left Set.inter_subset_left) h₁)
        (N1 ((N₁ ∩ N₂) ∩ F) (N₂ ∩ F) (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ Set.inter_subset_right) h₂)
      rwa [Set.diff_union_inter] at h4
    have h5 : chartAt E3 x '' ((N₁ ∩ N₂) ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 x x) :=
      (chartAt E3 x).image_mem_nhds (mem_chart_source E3 x)
        (Filter.inter_mem (Filter.inter_mem hN₁ hN₂)
          ((chartAt E3 x).open_source.mem_nhds (mem_chart_source E3 x)))
    exact hvolpos _ _ h5 (h3 x)
  have hAE : A ⊆ E := by
    intro x hx
    refine (hmemE x).2 ⟨A, hAo.mem_nhds hx, N1 _ _ ?_ hnull⟩
    rintro y ⟨hyA, hyF⟩
    exact ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hyA, hyF⟩), hAsub hyA⟩
  have hBE' : {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A ⊆ E' := by
    intro x hx
    refine (hmemE' x).2 ⟨_, hBo.mem_nhds hx, N1 _ _ ?_ hnull⟩
    rintro y ⟨⟨hyW, hyA⟩, hyF⟩
    exact ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hyF, hyA⟩), hyW⟩
  have hSsub : (E ∪ E')ᶜ ⊆ {x : M | ρ x ≤ r₁} := by
    intro x hx
    show ρ x ≤ r₁
    by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    apply hx
    by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
    · exact Set.mem_union_left _ (hAE hxA)
    · exact Set.mem_union_right _ (hBE' ⟨hlt, hxA⟩)
  have hSclosed : IsClosed (E ∪ E')ᶜ := (hEo.union hE'o).isClosed_compl
  have hScpt : IsCompact (E ∪ E')ᶜ := (hcpt r₁).of_isClosed_subset hSclosed hSsub
  
  have hSmin : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (E ∪ E')ᶜ := by
    refine sepIsMinimalSurfaceSet_of_chart_graphs g _ hSclosed ?_
    intro p hpS
    have hpE : p ∉ E := fun h => hpS (Set.mem_union_left _ h)
    have hpE' : p ∉ E' := fun h => hpS (Set.mem_union_right _ h)
    have hpO : p ∈ {x : M | ρ x < r₁ + 1} := by
      have h' : ρ p ≤ r₁ := hSsub hpS
      show ρ p < r₁ + 1
      linarith
    have hps : p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := mem_chart_source E3 p
    obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ κ, κ = chartAt E3 p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hκ] at hps ⊢
    have hlocp := hloc p
    rw [← hκ] at hlocp
    obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : Set E3, U = κ '' ({x : M | ρ x < r₁ + 1} ∩ κ.source) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Fκ, hFκdef⟩ : ∃ Fκ : Set E3, Fκ = κ '' (F ∩ κ.source) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hUdef, ← hFκdef] at hlocp
    have hUo : IsOpen U := by
      rw [hUdef]
      exact κ.isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hO.inter κ.open_source) Set.inter_subset_right
    have hUt : U ⊆ κ.target := by
      rw [hUdef]
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact κ.map_source hx.2
    have hy₀U : κ p ∈ U := by rw [hUdef]; exact ⟨p, ⟨hpO, hps⟩, rfl⟩
    have hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff κ.symm y i j) U := by
      intro i j
      have h := g.smooth p i j
      rw [← hκ] at h
      exact h.mono hUt
    have hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), g.coeff κ.symm y i j = g.coeff κ.symm y j i :=
      fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
    have hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (g.coeff κ.symm y).PosDef := by
      intro y hy
      have h := coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y (by rw [← hκ]; exact hUt hy)
      rw [← hκ] at h
      exact h
    
    have T1 : ∀ Q : Set E3, IsOpen Q → Q ⊆ κ.target → volume (Q \ Fκ) = 0 →
        ∀ z ∈ Q, κ.symm z ∈ E := by
      intro Q hQ hQt hQ0 z hz
      have hNo : IsOpen (κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q) := κ.isOpen_inter_preimage hQ
      have hzN : κ.symm z ∈ κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q := by

        show κ (κ.symm z) ∈ Q
        rw [κ.right_inv (hQt hz)]

      refine (hmemE _).2 ⟨_, hNo.mem_nhds hzN, ?_⟩
      refine sepChartNull_of_image_null p _ (by rw [← hκ]; exact fun x hx => hx.1.1) ?_
      rw [← hκ]
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ hQ0
      rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨⟨hxs, hxQ⟩, hxF⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨hxQ, ?_⟩
      rw [hFκdef]
      rintro ⟨x', ⟨hx'F, hx's⟩, heq⟩
      exact hxF ((κ.injOn hx's hxs heq) ▸ hx'F)
    have T0 : ∀ Q : Set E3, IsOpen Q → Q ⊆ κ.target → volume (Q ∩ Fκ) = 0 →

      intro Q hQ hQt hQ0 z hz
      have hNo : IsOpen (κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q) := κ.isOpen_inter_preimage hQ
      have hzN : κ.symm z ∈ κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q := by
        refine ⟨κ.map_target (hQt hz), ?_⟩
        show κ (κ.symm z) ∈ Q
        rw [κ.right_inv (hQt hz)]
        exact hz
      refine (hmemE' _).2 ⟨_, hNo.mem_nhds hzN, ?_⟩
      refine sepChartNull_of_image_null p _ (by rw [← hκ]; exact fun x hx => hx.1.1) ?_
      rw [← hκ]
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ hQ0
      rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨⟨hxs, hxQ⟩, hxF⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨hxQ, ?_⟩
      rw [hFκdef]
      exact ⟨x, ⟨hxF, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    have T2 : ∀ z ∈ κ.target, κ.symm z ∈ E → ∃ Nz ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (Nz \ Fκ) = 0 := by
      intro z hz hE
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hNn⟩ := (hmemE _).1 hE
      have hxs : κ.symm z ∈ κ.source := κ.map_target hz
      refine ⟨κ '' (N ∩ κ.source), ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h := κ.image_mem_nhds hxs (Filter.inter_mem hN (κ.open_source.mem_nhds hxs))
        rwa [κ.right_inv hz] at h
      · have h := hNn p
        rw [← hκ] at h
        refine measure_mono_null ?_ h
        rw [hFκdef]
        rintro _ ⟨⟨x', ⟨hx'N, hx's⟩, rfl⟩, hnot⟩
        exact ⟨x', ⟨⟨hx'N, fun hF => hnot ⟨x', ⟨hF, hx's⟩, rfl⟩⟩, hx's⟩, rfl⟩
    have T2' : ∀ z ∈ κ.target, κ.symm z ∈ E' → ∃ Nz ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (Nz ∩ Fκ) = 0 := by
      intro z hz hE
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hNn⟩ := (hmemE' _).1 hE
      have hxs : κ.symm z ∈ κ.source := κ.map_target hz
      refine ⟨κ '' (N ∩ κ.source), ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h := κ.image_mem_nhds hxs (Filter.inter_mem hN (κ.open_source.mem_nhds hxs))
        rwa [κ.right_inv hz] at h
      · have h := hNn p
        rw [← hκ] at h
        refine measure_mono_null ?_ h
        rw [hFκdef]
        rintro _ ⟨⟨x', ⟨hx'N, hx's⟩, rfl⟩, ⟨x'', ⟨hx''F, hx''s⟩, heq⟩⟩
        have hxx : x'' = x' := κ.injOn hx''s hx's heq
        subst hxx
        exact ⟨x'', ⟨⟨hx'N, hx''F⟩, hx's⟩, rfl⟩
    
    have h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (κ p), volume (N \ Fκ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro N hN h0'
      have hmem : κ p ∈ interior N ∩ κ.target :=
        ⟨mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hN, κ.map_source hps⟩
      have h := T1 (interior N ∩ κ.target) (isOpen_interior.inter κ.open_target)
        Set.inter_subset_right
        (measure_mono_null (Set.diff_subset_diff_left (fun w hw => interior_subset hw.1)) h0')
        (κ p) hmem
      rw [κ.left_inv hps] at h
      exact hpE h
    have h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (κ p), volume (N ∩ Fκ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro N hN h0'
      have hmem : κ p ∈ interior N ∩ κ.target :=
        ⟨mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hN, κ.map_source hps⟩
      have h := T0 (interior N ∩ κ.target) (isOpen_interior.inter κ.open_target)
        Set.inter_subset_right
        (measure_mono_null (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ (fun w hw => interior_subset hw.1)) h0')
        (κ p) hmem
      rw [κ.left_inv hps] at h
      exact hpE' h
    
    obtain ⟨a, u, r, δ, hr, hδ, hu, hu0, hcyl, hsides⟩ :=
      sepPerMin_C1_graph (g.coeff κ.symm) U Fκ hUo hG hsymm hpd hlocp (κ p) hy₀U h1 h0
    obtain ⟨u', r', hr', hr'r, hu', hagree, hmse⟩ :=
      sepPerMin_C1_graph_smooth (g.coeff κ.symm) U Fκ hUo hG hsymm hpd hlocp a (κ p) u r δ
        hr hδ hu hu0 hcyl hsides
    
    have hcoord : Continuous (fun w : E3 => w a) := by fun_prop
    have hproj_cont : Continuous (sepPlaneProj a) := by
      unfold sepPlaneProj
      exact continuous_id.sub (hcoord.smul continuous_const)
    have hu'c : Continuous (fun w => u' (sepPlaneProj a w)) := hu'.continuous.comp hproj_cont
    have hcylo : ∀ r₀ δ₀ : ℝ, IsOpen (sepCyl a (κ p) r₀ δ₀) := by
      intro r₀ δ₀
      exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (hproj_cont.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
        continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (hcoord.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const)
    have hcoordadd : ∀ (w : E3) (t : ℝ), (w + t • e a) a = w a + t := by
      intro w t
      simp [e]
    have hprojadd : ∀ (w : E3) (t : ℝ), sepPlaneProj a (w + t • e a) = sepPlaneProj a w := by
      intro w t
      unfold sepPlaneProj
      rw [hcoordadd, add_smul]
      abel
    have hC'U : sepCyl a (κ p) r' δ ⊆ sepCyl a (κ p) r δ :=
      fun z hz => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hz.1 hr'r, hz.2⟩
    have hC't : sepCyl a (κ p) r' δ ⊆ κ.target := fun z hz => hUt (hcyl (hC'U hz))
    have hag : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (κ p) r' δ, u' (sepPlaneProj a z) = u (sepPlaneProj a z) :=
      fun z hz => hagree z hz.1
    have hu'0 : u' (sepPlaneProj a (κ p)) = κ p a := by
      rw [hagree (κ p) (by simp [sepPlaneProj, hr'])]
      exact hu0
    
    obtain ⟨Qp, hQp⟩ : ∃ Q : Set E3,
        Q = sepCyl a (κ p) r' δ ∩ {w | u' (sepPlaneProj a w) < w a} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Qm, hQm⟩ : ∃ Q : Set E3,
        Q = sepCyl a (κ p) r' δ ∩ {w | w a < u' (sepPlaneProj a w)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hQpo : IsOpen Qp := by rw [hQp]; exact (hcylo r' δ).inter (isOpen_lt hu'c hcoord)
    have hQmo : IsOpen Qm := by rw [hQm]; exact (hcylo r' δ).inter (isOpen_lt hcoord hu'c)
    have hQpt : Qp ⊆ κ.target := by rw [hQp]; exact Set.inter_subset_left.trans hC't
    have hQmt : Qm ⊆ κ.target := by rw [hQm]; exact Set.inter_subset_left.trans hC't
    have hQpsub : Qp ⊆ sepCyl a (κ p) r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} := by
      rw [hQp]
      rintro z ⟨hz, hz'⟩
      refine ⟨hC'U hz, ?_⟩
      show u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a
      rw [← hag z hz]
      exact hz'
    have hQmsub : Qm ⊆ sepCyl a (κ p) r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} := by
      rw [hQm]
      rintro z ⟨hz, hz'⟩
      refine ⟨hC'U hz, ?_⟩
      show z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)
      rw [← hag z hz]
      exact hz'
    have hnearp : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (κ p) r' δ, z a = u' (sepPlaneProj a z) →
        ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, (N ∩ Qp).Nonempty := by
      intro z hz hzg N hN
      have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => z + t • e a) := by fun_prop
      have hT : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => z + t • e a) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 z) := by
        have h := hc.tendsto 0
        simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at h
        exact h.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      have hev : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),
          z + t • e a ∈ N ∩ sepCyl a (κ p) r' δ ∧ t ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) :=
        (hT.eventually_mem (Filter.inter_mem hN ((hcylo r' δ).mem_nhds hz))).and
          eventually_mem_nhdsWithin
      obtain ⟨t, ⟨htN, htC⟩, ht0⟩ := hev.exists
      have ht0' : 0 < t := ht0
      refine ⟨z + t • e a, htN, ?_⟩
      rw [hQp]
      refine ⟨htC, ?_⟩
      show u' (sepPlaneProj a (z + t • e a)) < (z + t • e a) a
      rw [hprojadd, hcoordadd, ← hzg]
      linarith
    have hnearm : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (κ p) r' δ, z a = u' (sepPlaneProj a z) →
        ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, (N ∩ Qm).Nonempty := by
      intro z hz hzg N hN
      have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => z + t • e a) := by fun_prop
      have hT : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => z + t • e a) (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝 z) := by
        have h := hc.tendsto 0
        simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at h
        exact h.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      have hev : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[<] (0 : ℝ),
          z + t • e a ∈ N ∩ sepCyl a (κ p) r' δ ∧ t ∈ Set.Iio (0 : ℝ) :=
        (hT.eventually_mem (Filter.inter_mem hN ((hcylo r' δ).mem_nhds hz))).and
          eventually_mem_nhdsWithin
      obtain ⟨t, ⟨htN, htC⟩, ht0⟩ := hev.exists
      have ht0' : t < 0 := ht0
      refine ⟨z + t • e a, htN, ?_⟩
      rw [hQm]
      refine ⟨htC, ?_⟩
      show (z + t • e a) a < u' (sepPlaneProj a (z + t • e a))
      rw [hprojadd, hcoordadd, ← hzg]
      linarith
    
    obtain ⟨Q₁, Q₂, hQQ, hQ₁, hQ₂⟩ : ∃ Q₁ Q₂ : Set E3,
        ((Q₁ = Qm ∧ Q₂ = Qp) ∨ (Q₁ = Qp ∧ Q₂ = Qm)) ∧
        volume (Q₁ \ Fκ) = 0 ∧ volume (Q₂ ∩ Fκ) = 0 := by
      rcases hsides with ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ | ⟨hs1, hs2⟩
      · exact ⟨Qm, Qp, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩,
          measure_mono_null (Set.diff_subset_diff_left hQmsub) hs1,
          measure_mono_null (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hQpsub) hs2⟩
      · exact ⟨Qp, Qm, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩,
          measure_mono_null (Set.diff_subset_diff_left hQpsub) hs1,
          measure_mono_null (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hQmsub) hs2⟩
    have hQ₁o : IsOpen Q₁ := by
      rcases hQQ with ⟨h1', _⟩ | ⟨h1', _⟩ <;> rw [h1'] <;> assumption
    have hQ₂o : IsOpen Q₂ := by
      rcases hQQ with ⟨_, h2'⟩ | ⟨_, h2'⟩ <;> rw [h2'] <;> assumption
    have hQ₁t : Q₁ ⊆ κ.target := by
      rcases hQQ with ⟨h1', _⟩ | ⟨h1', _⟩ <;> rw [h1'] <;> assumption
    have hQ₂t : Q₂ ⊆ κ.target := by
      rcases hQQ with ⟨_, h2'⟩ | ⟨_, h2'⟩ <;> rw [h2'] <;> assumption
    have hnear₁ : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (κ p) r' δ, z a = u' (sepPlaneProj a z) →
        ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, (N ∩ Q₁).Nonempty := by
      rcases hQQ with ⟨h1', _⟩ | ⟨h1', _⟩ <;> rw [h1'] <;> assumption
    have hnear₂ : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (κ p) r' δ, z a = u' (sepPlaneProj a z) →
        ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, (N ∩ Q₂).Nonempty := by
      rcases hQQ with ⟨_, h2'⟩ | ⟨_, h2'⟩ <;> rw [h2'] <;> assumption
    have hmeasQ : ∀ (N Q : Set E3) (z : E3), N ∈ 𝓝 z → IsOpen Q →
        (∀ N' ∈ 𝓝 z, (N' ∩ Q).Nonempty) → volume (N \ Fκ) = 0 →
        volume (Q ∩ Fκ) = 0 → False := by
      intro N Q z hN hQ hnear hN0 hQ0
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hnear _ (interior_mem_nhds.2 hN)
      have hpos := (isOpen_interior.inter hQ).measure_pos volume ⟨w, hw⟩
      have hsub : interior N ∩ Q ⊆ (N \ Fκ) ∪ (Q ∩ Fκ) := by
        rintro v ⟨hvN, hvQ⟩
        by_cases hvF : v ∈ Fκ
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hvQ, hvF⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨interior_subset hvN, hvF⟩
      have hz0 : volume (interior N ∩ Q) = 0 :=
        measure_mono_null hsub (measure_union_null hN0 hQ0)
      rw [hz0] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
    have hmeasQ' : ∀ (N Q : Set E3) (z : E3), N ∈ 𝓝 z → IsOpen Q →
        (∀ N' ∈ 𝓝 z, (N' ∩ Q).Nonempty) → volume (N ∩ Fκ) = 0 →
        volume (Q \ Fκ) = 0 → False := by
      intro N Q z hN hQ hnear hN0 hQ0
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hnear _ (interior_mem_nhds.2 hN)
      have hpos := (isOpen_interior.inter hQ).measure_pos volume ⟨w, hw⟩
      have hsub : interior N ∩ Q ⊆ (N ∩ Fκ) ∪ (Q \ Fκ) := by
        rintro v ⟨hvN, hvQ⟩
        by_cases hvF : v ∈ Fκ
        · exact Or.inl ⟨interior_subset hvN, hvF⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hvQ, hvF⟩
      have hz0 : volume (interior N ∩ Q) = 0 :=
        measure_mono_null hsub (measure_union_null hN0 hQ0)
      rw [hz0] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
    refine ⟨a, u', r', δ, hr', hδ, hu', hu'0, hC't, ?_, hmse⟩
    intro z hz
    have hzt := hC't hz
    constructor
    · intro hzS
      by_contra hne
      have hmem : z ∈ Q₁ ∨ z ∈ Q₂ := by
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
        · have hzm : z ∈ Qm := by rw [hQm]; exact ⟨hz, h⟩
          rcases hQQ with ⟨h1', h2'⟩ | ⟨h1', h2'⟩
          · left; rw [h1']; exact hzm
          · right; rw [h2']; exact hzm
        · have hzp : z ∈ Qp := by rw [hQp]; exact ⟨hz, h⟩

          · right; rw [h2']; exact hzp
          · left; rw [h1']; exact hzp
      rcases hmem with h | h
      · exact hzS (Set.mem_union_left _ (T1 Q₁ hQ₁o hQ₁t hQ₁ z h))
      · exact hzS (Set.mem_union_right _ (T0 Q₂ hQ₂o hQ₂t hQ₂ z h))
    · intro hzg
      rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_union]
      rintro (hE | hE')
      · obtain ⟨Nz, hNz, hNz0⟩ := T2 z hzt hE
        exact hmeasQ Nz Q₂ z hNz hQ₂o (hnear₂ z hz hzg) hNz0 hQ₂
      · obtain ⟨Nz, hNz, hNz0⟩ := T2' z hzt hE'
        exact hmeasQ' Nz Q₁ z hNz hQ₁o (hnear₁ z hz hzg) hNz0 hQ₁
  
  exact ⟨E, E', hEo, hE'o, hdisj, hAE, hBE', hScpt, hSmin⟩

  have hunif : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → ∃ (O : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (Ψ : M → ℝ → M),
      IsOpen O ∧ X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Ψ p.1 p.2) (O ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, Ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (Ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧

    intro c d hc hd
    obtain ⟨O, ε, Ψ, _, h1, h2, h3, _, h5⟩ := hunif c d hc hd
    exact ⟨O, ε, Ψ, h1, h2, h3, h5⟩
  have hlong : ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ T₁ T₂ : ℝ, T₁ ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ T₂ → a < τ x + T₁ → τ x + T₂ < b →
      ∃ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β : ℝ), α < T₁ ∧ T₂ < β ∧ γ 0 = x ∧

    global_flow_assembly X hX τ a b hτs.continuousOn hτb V huniq hτlin hunif hlong
