      (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ))) ∧
      (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
        U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)

signature.name: frontier_collar_function
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hFc : IsCompact (frontier U))
    (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U)) :
    ∃ (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen N ∧ frontier U ⊆ N ∧ IsCompact (closure N) ∧
      0 < ε ∧ ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ (U ∩ N) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < τ x ∧ τ x < ε) ∧
      (∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d)) ∧
      (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ))) ∧
      (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
        U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  haveI : LocallyCompactSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyCompactSpace E3 M
  
  have hs1 : ∀ β : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β → ∀ p : M,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0 → ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 p, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β x ≠ 0 := by
    intro β hβ p hp
    have hcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hβ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)))
        (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      hcd.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 p).open_target (by simp)
    have hbr : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p := hβ.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
      rw [hmd.mfderiv]
      simp only [writtenInExtChartAt, extChartAt_coe, extChartAt_coe_symm, chartAt_self_eq,
        modelWithCornersSelf_coe, modelWithCornersSelf_coe_symm, Set.range_id, fderivWithin_univ,
        OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_apply, Function.comp_def, id]
    have hne0 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← hbr]; exact hp
    have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p),
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) y ≠ 0 :=
      (hcont.continuousAt ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds (mem_chart_target E3 p))).eventually_ne
        hne0
    have hev' := ((chartAt E3 p).continuousAt (mem_chart_source E3 p)).eventually hev
    filter_upwards [hev', chart_source_mem_nhds E3 p] with x hx hxs
    intro h0
    apply hx
    have hy : chartAt E3 p x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).map_source hxs
    have hsx : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) = x := (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs
    have hmdβ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x)) :=
      hβ.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hcs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    have hmds : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) :=
      (hcs.contMDiffAt ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds hy)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hcomp := mfderiv_comp (chartAt E3 p x) hmdβ hmds
    have h0' : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x)) = 0 := by
      rw [hsx]; exact h0
    rw [h0', ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp, mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at hcomp
    exact hcomp
  
  have hs2 : ∀ p : M, p ∈ frontier U → ∀ (V₁ V₂ : Set M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ),
      IsOpen V₁ → IsOpen V₂ → p ∈ V₁ → p ∈ V₂ →
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₁ → ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₂ →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ p ≠ 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ p ≠ 0 →
      V₁ ∩ frontier U = V₁ ∩ f₁ ⁻¹' {0} → V₂ ∩ frontier U = V₂ ∩ f₂ ⁻¹' {0} →
      ∃ κ : ℝ, (κ = 1 ∨ κ = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 p, 0 ≤ κ * (f₁ x * f₂ x) := by
    intro p hp V₁ V₂ f₁ f₂ hV₁ hV₂ hp₁ hp₂ hf₁ hf₂ hd₁ hd₂ hz₁ hz₂
    obtain ⟨V', f', hV'sub, hV'o, hpV', hf', hdf', hz', -, hPpos, hPneg⟩ :=
      hfront.2 p hp (V₁ ∩ V₂) ((hV₁.inter hV₂).mem_nhds ⟨hp₁, hp₂⟩)
    have hZ : ∀ (W : Set M) (h : M → ℝ), W ∩ frontier U = W ∩ h ⁻¹' {0} →
        ∀ x ∈ W, (x ∈ frontier U ↔ h x = 0) := by
      intro W h hz x hx
      have e := Set.ext_iff.1 hz x
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at e
      exact ⟨fun hxF => (e.1 ⟨hx, hxF⟩).2, fun h0 => (e.2 ⟨hx, h0⟩).2⟩
    
    have hE : ∀ h : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ h → h p = 0 →
        ((∀ x ∈ V', 0 ≤ h x) ∨ (∀ x ∈ V', h x ≤ 0)) → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) h p = 0 := by
      intro h hh h0 hsgn
      have hpy : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p :=
        (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
      have htend : Tendsto (chartAt E3 p).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)) (𝓝 p) := by
        have h1 := ((chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 p)).tendsto
        rwa [hpy] at h1
      have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p), (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ V' :=
        htend.eventually (hV'o.mem_nhds hpV')
      have hbr : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) h p =
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => h ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
        have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) h p := hh.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
        rw [hmd.mfderiv]
        simp only [writtenInExtChartAt, extChartAt_coe, extChartAt_coe_symm, chartAt_self_eq,
          modelWithCornersSelf_coe, modelWithCornersSelf_coe_symm, Set.range_id,
          fderivWithin_univ, OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_apply, Function.comp_def, id]
      rw [hbr]
      rcases hsgn with hs | hs
      · have hmin : IsLocalMin (fun y => h ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
          refine hev.mono (fun y hy => ?_)
          show h ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)) ≤ h ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          rw [hpy, h0]; exact hs _ hy
        exact hmin.fderiv_eq_zero
      · have hmax : IsLocalMax (fun y => h ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
          refine hev.mono (fun y hy => ?_)
          show h ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) ≤ h ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))
          rw [hpy, h0]; exact hs _ hy
        exact hmax.fderiv_eq_zero
    have hV'1 : ∀ x ∈ V', x ∈ V₁ := fun x hx => (hV'sub hx).1
    have hV'2 : ∀ x ∈ V', x ∈ V₂ := fun x hx => (hV'sub hx).2
    have hfp' : f' p = 0 := (hZ V' f' hz' p hpV').1 hp
    have hApos : ∃ a ∈ V', 0 < f' a := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hdf' p hpV' (hE f' hf' hfp' (Or.inr hcon))
    
    have hconst : ∀ (A : Set M) (h : M → ℝ), IsPreconnected A → Continuous h →
        (∀ x ∈ A, h x ≠ 0) → ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ A, 0 < h a → 0 < h b := by
      intro A h hA hc hne a ha b hb hpa
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have hb' : h b < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hcon (hne b hb)
      have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (h b) (h a) := ⟨hb'.le, hpa.le⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩ := hA.intermediate_value hb ha hc.continuousOn hmem
      exact hne z hz hz0
    
    have hclaim : ∀ (Vi : Set M) (fi : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ fi →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) fi p ≠ 0 → (∀ x ∈ V', x ∈ Vi) →
        Vi ∩ frontier U = Vi ∩ fi ⁻¹' {0} →
        ∃ κ : ℝ, (κ = 1 ∨ κ = -1) ∧ ∀ x ∈ V', 0 ≤ κ * (fi x * f' x) := by
      intro Vi fi hfi hdi hsub hzi
      have hzero : ∀ x ∈ V', (fi x = 0 ↔ f' x = 0) := fun x hx =>
        (hZ Vi fi hzi x (hsub x hx)).symm.trans (hZ V' f' hz' x hx)
      obtain ⟨a, haV, ha⟩ := hApos
      have hfa : fi a ≠ 0 := fun h => ha.ne' ((hzero a haV).1 h)
      have key : ∀ gi : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ gi →
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) gi p ≠ 0 → (∀ x ∈ V', (gi x = 0 ↔ f' x = 0)) →
          0 < gi a → ∀ x ∈ V', 0 ≤ gi x * f' x := by
        intro gi hgi hdg hzg hga x hx
        have hneP' : ∀ y ∈ V' ∩ {y | 0 < f' y}, gi y ≠ 0 := fun y hy h =>
          hy.2.ne' ((hzg y hy.1).1 h)
        have hneN' : ∀ y ∈ V' ∩ {y | f' y < 0}, gi y ≠ 0 := fun y hy h =>
          hy.2.ne ((hzg y hy.1).1 h)
        have hposP : ∀ y ∈ V' ∩ {y | 0 < f' y}, 0 < gi y := fun y hy =>
          hconst _ gi hPpos hgi.continuous hneP' a ⟨haV, ha⟩ y hy hga
        have hnegN : ∀ y ∈ V' ∩ {y | f' y < 0}, gi y < 0 := by
          intro y hy
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hneN' y hy) with h | h
          · exact h
          · exfalso
            have hposN : ∀ z ∈ V' ∩ {z | f' z < 0}, 0 < gi z := fun z hz =>
              hconst _ gi hPneg hgi.continuous hneN' y hy z hz h
            apply hdg
            refine hE gi hgi ((hzg p hpV').2 hfp') (Or.inl (fun z hz => ?_))
            rcases lt_trichotomy (f' z) 0 with h1 | h1 | h1
            · exact (hposN z ⟨hz, h1⟩).le
            · exact ((hzg z hz).2 h1).ge
            · exact (hposP z ⟨hz, h1⟩).le
        rcases lt_trichotomy (f' x) 0 with h1 | h1 | h1
        · exact (mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (hnegN x ⟨hx, h1⟩) h1).le
        · rw [h1, mul_zero]
        · exact (mul_pos (hposP x ⟨hx, h1⟩) h1).le
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hfa with h | h
      · refine ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, fun x hx => ?_⟩
        have hdn : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun y => -fi y) p ≠ 0 := by
          rw [show (fun y => -fi y) = -fi from rfl, mfderiv_neg]
          exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hdi
        have hk := key (fun y => -fi y) hfi.neg hdn
          (fun y hy => by simp only [neg_eq_zero]; exact hzero y hy) (neg_pos.mpr h) x hx
        have hr : -1 * (fi x * f' x) = -fi x * f' x := by ring
        rw [hr]; exact hk
      · exact ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, fun x hx => by rw [one_mul]; exact key fi hfi hdi hzero h x hx⟩
    
    obtain ⟨κ₁, hκ₁, h1⟩ := hclaim V₁ f₁ hf₁ hd₁ hV'1 hz₁
    obtain ⟨κ₂, hκ₂, h2⟩ := hclaim V₂ f₂ hf₂ hd₂ hV'2 hz₂
    refine ⟨κ₁ * κ₂, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases hκ₁ with h | h <;> rcases hκ₂ with h' | h' <;> rw [h, h'] <;> norm_num
    · filter_upwards [hV'o.mem_nhds hpV'] with x hx
      have a1 := h1 x hx
      have a2 := h2 x hx
      rcases eq_or_ne (f' x) 0 with h0 | h0
      · have hf10 : f₁ x = 0 := (hZ V₁ f₁ hz₁ x (hV'1 x hx)).1 ((hZ V' f' hz' x hx).2 h0)
        rw [hf10, zero_mul, mul_zero]
      · have hsq : 0 < f' x ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg _) (Ne.symm (pow_ne_zero 2 h0))
        have hprod : 0 ≤ (κ₁ * (f₁ x * f' x)) * (κ₂ * (f₂ x * f' x)) := mul_nonneg a1 a2
        have hr : (κ₁ * (f₁ x * f' x)) * (κ₂ * (f₂ x * f' x)) =
            (κ₁ * κ₂ * (f₁ x * f₂ x)) * f' x ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [hr] at hprod
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hc hsq
        linarith
  
  have h' : ∀ p : M, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), p ∈ frontier U →
      (IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧
        (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧ V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}) := by
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p ∈ frontier U
    · obtain ⟨V, f, -, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hz, -⟩ := hfront.2 p hp Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
      exact ⟨V, f, fun _ => ⟨hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hz⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨Set.univ, 0, fun h => absurd h hp⟩
  choose V f hVf using h'
  
  have hbcov : ∃ (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (N₁ : Set M),
      (∀ i, c i ∈ frontier U) ∧
      (∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (φ i)) ∧ (∀ i x, 0 ≤ φ i x) ∧
      (∀ i, tsupport (φ i) ⊆ V (c i)) ∧ IsOpen N₁ ∧ frontier U ⊆ N₁ ∧
      (∀ x ∈ N₁, ∃ i, φ i x = 1) := by
    have hb : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ ψ : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ ∧
        (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ V p ∧ ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 p, ψ x = 1 := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨b, -, hbs⟩ := (SmoothBumpFunction.nhds_basis_tsupport (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) p).mem_iff.1
        ((hVf p hp).1.mem_nhds (hVf p hp).2.1)
      exact ⟨b, b.contMDiff, fun x => b.nonneg, hbs, b.eventuallyEq_one⟩
    choose! ψ hψs hψnn hψsupp hψ1 using hb
    obtain ⟨t, htK, hcover⟩ := hFc.elim_nhds_subcover (fun p => interior {x | ψ p x = 1})
      (fun p hp => interior_mem_nhds.2 (hψ1 p hp))
    refine ⟨t.card, fun i => (t.equivFin.symm i : M), fun i => ψ (t.equivFin.symm i : M),
      ⋃ x ∈ t, interior {y | ψ x y = 1}, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hcover, ?_⟩
    · intro i; exact htK _ (t.equivFin.symm i).2
    · intro i; exact hψs _ (htK _ (t.equivFin.symm i).2)
    · intro i x; exact hψnn _ (htK _ (t.equivFin.symm i).2) x
    · intro i; exact hψsupp _ (htK _ (t.equivFin.symm i).2)
    · exact isOpen_biUnion (fun x _ => isOpen_interior)
    · intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hxp⟩ := hx
      refine ⟨t.equivFin ⟨p, hp⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      exact interior_subset (s := {y | ψ p y = 1}) hxp
  obtain ⟨n, c, φ, N₁, hcK, hφs, hφnn, hφsupp, hN₁o, hKN₁, hN₁⟩ := hbcov
  have hVo : ∀ i, IsOpen (V (c i)) := fun i => (hVf (c i) (hcK i)).1
  have hFs : ∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f (c i)) := fun i => (hVf (c i) (hcK i)).2.2.1
  have hFdf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ V (c i), mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f (c i)) x ≠ 0 :=
    fun i => (hVf (c i) (hcK i)).2.2.2.1
  have hFzero : ∀ i, V (c i) ∩ frontier U = V (c i) ∩ f (c i) ⁻¹' {0} :=
    fun i => (hVf (c i) (hcK i)).2.2.2.2
  have hZiff : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ V (c i), (x ∈ frontier U ↔ f (c i) x = 0) := by
    intro i x hx
    have h := Set.ext_iff.1 (hFzero i) x
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro hxW; exact (h.1 ⟨hx, hxW⟩).2
    · intro hf; exact (h.2 ⟨hx, hf⟩).2
  have hsuppV : ∀ i x, φ i x ≠ 0 → x ∈ V (c i) := fun i x hx =>
    hφsupp i (subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hx))
  
  set τ : M → ℝ := fun x => ∑ i, φ i x * |f (c i) x| with hτdef
  have hτc : Continuous τ :=
    continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hφs i).continuous.mul (hFs i).continuous.abs)
  have hτF : ∀ x ∈ frontier U, τ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
    by_cases h0 : φ i x = 0
    · rw [h0, zero_mul]
    · rw [(hZiff i x (hsuppV i x h0)).1 hx, abs_zero, mul_zero]
  have hτpos : ∀ x ∈ N₁, x ∉ frontier U → 0 < τ x := by
    intro x hx hxF
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hN₁ x hx
    have hxV := hsuppV i x (by rw [hi]; norm_num)
    have hne : f (c i) x ≠ 0 := fun h => hxF ((hZiff i x hxV).2 h)
    have hterm : ∀ j, 0 ≤ φ j x * |f (c j) x| := fun j => mul_nonneg (hφnn j x) (abs_nonneg _)
    have h1 : φ i x * |f (c i) x| ≤ τ x :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hterm j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [hi, one_mul] at h1
    have h2 := abs_pos.2 hne
    linarith
  
  have hτsm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ (frontier U)ᶜ := by
    intro x hx
    apply ContMDiffAt.contMDiffWithinAt
    have hterm : ∀ i, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun y => φ i y * |f (c i) y|) x := by
      intro i
      by_cases hxV : x ∈ V (c i)
      · have hne : f (c i) x ≠ 0 := fun h => hx ((hZiff i x hxV).2 h)
        have habs : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun y => |f (c i) y|) x :=
          (contDiffAt_abs (n := ⊤) hne).comp_contMDiffAt ((hFs i).contMDiffAt)
        exact (hφs i).contMDiffAt.mul habs
      · have hxs : x ∉ tsupport (φ i) := fun h => hxV (hφsupp i h)
        have hev : (fun y => φ i y * |f (c i) y|) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [(isClosed_tsupport (φ i)).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxs] with y hy
          rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy, zero_mul]
        exact contMDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    exact contMDiffAt_finset_sum (fun i _ => hterm i)
  
  have hgood : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ β : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β ∧
      ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 p, τ y = |β y| ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β y ≠ 0 := by
    intro p hpF
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hN₁ p (hKN₁ hpF)
    set J : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p ∈ V (c i)) with hJdef
    have hmemJ : ∀ i, i ∈ J ↔ p ∈ V (c i) := by
      intro i; simp [hJdef]
    have hj₀J : j₀ ∈ J := (hmemJ j₀).2 (hsuppV j₀ p (by rw [hj₀]; norm_num))
    have hev1 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 p, ∀ i, i ∉ J → φ i x = 0 := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all]
      intro i
      by_cases hi : i ∈ J
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x h => absurd hi h)
      · have hpi : p ∉ tsupport (φ i) := fun h => hi ((hmemJ i).2 (hφsupp i h))
        filter_upwards [(isClosed_tsupport (φ i)).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hpi] with x hx _
        exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
    have hκex : ∀ m, ∃ κ : ℝ, m ∈ J →
        ((κ = 1 ∨ κ = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 p, 0 ≤ κ * (f (c m) x * f (c j₀) x)) := by
      intro m
      by_cases hm : m ∈ J
      · obtain ⟨κ, h1, h2⟩ := hs2 p hpF
          (V (c m)) (V (c j₀)) (f (c m)) (f (c j₀)) (hVo m) (hVo j₀) ((hmemJ m).1 hm)
          ((hmemJ j₀).1 hj₀J) (hFs m) (hFs j₀) (hFdf m p ((hmemJ m).1 hm))
          (hFdf j₀ p ((hmemJ j₀).1 hj₀J)) (hFzero m) (hFzero j₀)
        exact ⟨κ, fun _ => ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨1, fun h => absurd h hm⟩
    choose κ hκ using hκex
    
    have hid' : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 p, ∑ m ∈ J, φ m x * |f (c m) x| =
        |∑ m ∈ J, κ m * φ m x * f (c m) x| := by
      have hVev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 p, ∀ m ∈ J, x ∈ V (c m) :=
        (Filter.eventually_all_finset J).2 (fun m hm => (hVo m).mem_nhds ((hmemJ m).1 hm))
      have hSev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 p, ∀ m ∈ J, 0 ≤ κ m * (f (c m) x * f (c j₀) x) :=
        (Filter.eventually_all_finset J).2 (fun m hm => (hκ m hm).2)
      filter_upwards [hVev, hSev] with x hxV hxS
      have habsκ : ∀ m ∈ J, |f (c m) x| = |κ m * f (c m) x| := by
        intro m hm
        rcases (hκ m hm).1 with h | h <;> simp [h, abs_neg]
      have hrew : ∀ m, κ m * φ m x * f (c m) x = φ m x * (κ m * f (c m) x) := fun m => by ring
      rcases lt_trichotomy (f (c j₀) x) 0 with h | h | h
      · have hm' : ∀ m ∈ J, κ m * f (c m) x ≤ 0 := by
          intro m hm
          have h3 : 0 ≤ (κ m * f (c m) x) * f (c j₀) x := by rw [mul_assoc]; exact hxS m hm
          by_contra hc
          push_neg at hc
          have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hc h
          linarith
        have hterm : ∀ m ∈ J, φ m x * |f (c m) x| = -(κ m * φ m x * f (c m) x) := by
          intro m hm
          rw [habsκ m hm, abs_of_nonpos (hm' m hm), hrew]; ring
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, abs_of_nonpos]
        exact Finset.sum_nonpos (fun m hm => by
          rw [hrew]; exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (hφnn m x) (hm' m hm))
      · have hxF := (hZiff j₀ x (hxV j₀ hj₀J)).2 h
        have h0 : ∀ m ∈ J, f (c m) x = 0 := fun m hm => (hZiff m x (hxV m hm)).1 hxF
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m hm => by rw [h0 m hm, abs_zero, mul_zero]),
          Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun m hm => by rw [h0 m hm, mul_zero]), abs_zero]
      · have hm' : ∀ m ∈ J, 0 ≤ κ m * f (c m) x := by
          intro m hm
          have h3 : 0 ≤ (κ m * f (c m) x) * f (c j₀) x := by rw [mul_assoc]; exact hxS m hm
          by_contra hc
          push_neg at hc
          have := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hc h
          linarith
        have hterm : ∀ m ∈ J, φ m x * |f (c m) x| = κ m * φ m x * f (c m) x := by
          intro m hm
          rw [habsκ m hm, abs_of_nonneg (hm' m hm), hrew]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, abs_of_nonneg]
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m hm => by
          rw [hrew]; exact mul_nonneg (hφnn m x) (hm' m hm))
    have hβs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun y => ∑ m ∈ J, κ m * φ m y * f (c m) y) :=
      contMDiff_finset_sum (fun m _ => (contMDiff_const.mul (hφs m)).mul (hFs m))
    
    have hdβ' : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun y => ∑ m ∈ J, κ m * φ m y * f (c m) y) p ≠ 0 := by
      have hpy : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p :=
        (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
      have hy₀U : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := mem_chart_target E3 p
      have hUo' : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
      have hcd : ∀ w : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w →
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
        fun w hw => contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hw.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
      have hdiffw : ∀ w : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w →
          DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := fun w hw =>
        ((hcd w hw).contDiffAt (hUo'.mem_nhds hy₀U)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hbr : ∀ w : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w →
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w p =
            fderiv ℝ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
        intro w hw
        have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w p := hw.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
        rw [hmd.mfderiv]
        simp only [writtenInExtChartAt, extChartAt_coe, extChartAt_coe_symm, chartAt_self_eq,
          modelWithCornersSelf_coe, modelWithCornersSelf_coe_symm, Set.range_id,
          fderivWithin_univ, OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl_apply, Function.comp_def, id]
      have htend : Tendsto (chartAt E3 p).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)) (𝓝 p) := by
        have h := ((chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm hy₀U).tendsto
        rwa [hpy] at h
      have hf0 : ∀ m ∈ J, f (c m) p = 0 := fun m hm => (hZiff m p ((hmemJ m).1 hm)).1 hpF
      have hκf : ∀ m, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => κ m * f (c m) x) :=
        fun m => contMDiff_const.mul (hFs m)
      have hκne : ∀ m ∈ J, κ m ≠ 0 := by
        intro m hm
        rcases (hκ m hm).1 with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
      have hF0 : ∀ m ∈ J,
          (fun y => κ m * f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) = 0 := by
        intro m hm
        show κ m * f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)) = 0
        rw [hpy, hf0 m hm, mul_zero]
      have hF0j : (fun y => f (c j₀) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) = 0 := by
        show f (c j₀) ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)) = 0
        rw [hpy, hf0 j₀ hj₀J]
      have hnej : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (c j₀) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← hbr _ (hFs j₀)]; exact hFdf j₀ p ((hmemJ j₀).1 hj₀J)
      have hne : ∀ m ∈ J,
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => κ m * f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) ≠ 0 := by
        intro m hm
        rw [fderiv_const_mul (hdiffw _ (hFs m)), ← hbr _ (hFs m)]
        exact smul_ne_zero (hκne m hm) (hFdf m p ((hmemJ m).1 hm))
      have hprop : ∀ m ∈ J, ∃ cm : ℝ, 0 < cm ∧
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => κ m * f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) =
            cm • fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (c j₀) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
        intro m hm
        refine fderiv_pos_proportional (fun y => f (c j₀) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
          (fun y => κ m * f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p)
          (hdiffw _ (hFs j₀)) (hdiffw _ (hκf m)) hF0j (hF0 m hm) hnej (hne m hm) ?_
        filter_upwards [htend.eventually (hκ m hm).2] with y hy
        have hr : f (c j₀) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * (κ m * f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =
            κ m * (f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * f (c j₀) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := by ring
        rw [hr]; exact hy
      choose! cc hccpos hcc using hprop
      have hL3 := second_order_product_sum J (fun m y => φ m ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (fun m y => κ m * f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target hUo'
        (chartAt E3 p p) hy₀U (fun m _ => hcd _ (hφs m)) (fun m _ => hcd _ (hκf m)) hF0
      beta_reduce at hL3
      have hL3a := hL3.1
      have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ m ∈ J, κ m * φ m ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
            f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) =
          (∑ m ∈ J, φ m p * cc m) •
            fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (c j₀) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
        have hfun : (fun y => ∑ m ∈ J, κ m * φ m ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
              f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =
            fun z => ∑ m ∈ J, φ m ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) *
              (κ m * f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) := by
          funext z; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => by ring)
        rw [hfun, hL3a, Finset.sum_smul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => ?_)
        rw [hcc m hm, hpy, smul_smul]
      rw [hbr _ hβs]
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ m ∈ J, κ m * φ m ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
            f (c m) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) ≠ 0
      rw [hfd]
      refine smul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt ?_) hnej
      refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun m hm => mul_nonneg (hφnn m p) (hccpos m hm).le)
        ⟨j₀, hj₀J, ?_⟩
      rw [hj₀, one_mul]; exact hccpos j₀ hj₀J
    have hev2 := hs1 _ hβs p hdβ'
    refine ⟨_, hβs, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [hid', hev1, hev2] with x hx1 hx2 hx3
    refine ⟨?_, hx3⟩
    rw [← hx1]
    show ∑ i, φ i x * |f (c i) x| = ∑ m ∈ J, φ m x * |f (c m) x|
    exact (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ J)
      (fun i _ hi => by rw [hx2 i hi, zero_mul])).symm
  
  set W₂ : Set M := {x | ∃ β : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β ∧
      ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, τ y = |β y| ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β y ≠ 0} with hW₂def
  have hW₂o : IsOpen W₂ := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    rintro x ⟨β, hβ, hev⟩
    filter_upwards [hev.eventually_nhds] with z hz
    exact ⟨β, hβ, hz⟩
  have hreg : ∀ x ∈ W₂, 0 < τ x → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0 := by
    rintro x ⟨β, hβ, hev⟩ hpos
    have hx := hev.self_of_nhds
    have hβne : β x ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; rw [hx.1, h, abs_zero] at hpos; exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hβne with h | h
    · have hev' : τ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => -β y := by
        filter_upwards [hev, hβ.continuous.continuousAt.eventually_lt continuousAt_const h]
          with y hy1 hy2
        rw [hy1.1, abs_of_neg hy2]
      rw [hev'.mfderiv_eq, show (fun y => -β y) = -β from rfl, mfderiv_neg]
      exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hx.2
    · have hev' : τ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] β := by
        filter_upwards [hev, continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hβ.continuous.continuousAt h]
          with y hy1 hy2
        rw [hy1.1, abs_of_pos hy2]
      rw [hev'.mfderiv_eq]
      exact hx.2
  
  have hUF : ∀ x ∈ U, x ∉ frontier U := fun x hx h => by
    rw [hUo.frontier_eq] at h; exact h.2 hx
  have hWo : IsOpen (N₁ ∩ W₂) := hN₁o.inter hW₂o
  have hFW : frontier U ⊆ N₁ ∩ W₂ := fun x hx => ⟨hKN₁ hx, hgood x hx⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hKc, hFK, hKW⟩ := exists_compact_between hFc hWo hFW
  have hKcl : IsClosed K := hKc.isClosed
  have hbdc : IsCompact (frontier K) :=
    hKc.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_frontier (frontier_subset_closure.trans hKcl.closure_subset)
  have hbdpos : ∀ x ∈ frontier K, 0 < τ x := by
    intro x hx
    have hxK : x ∈ K := hKcl.frontier_subset hx
    have hxF : x ∉ frontier U := fun h => hx.2 (hFK h)
    exact hτpos x (hKW hxK).1 hxF
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεK⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ frontier K, ε < τ x := by
    rcases (frontier K).eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun x hx => by simp [h] at hx⟩
    · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hmin⟩ := hbdc.exists_isMinOn h hτc.continuousOn
      refine ⟨τ x₀ / 2, half_pos (hbdpos x₀ hx₀), fun x hx => ?_⟩
      have h1 := isMinOn_iff.1 hmin x hx
      have h2 := hbdpos x₀ hx₀
      linarith
  have hdia : ∀ x ∈ K, τ x < ε → x ∈ interior K := by
    intro x hxK hτx
    by_contra h
    have hxb : x ∈ frontier K := ⟨subset_closure hxK, h⟩
    linarith [hεK x hxb]
  set N : Set M := interior K ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iio ε with hNdef
  have hNo : IsOpen N := isOpen_interior.inter (hτc.isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_Iio)
  have hNK : N ⊆ K := fun x hx => interior_subset hx.1
  have hFN : frontier U ⊆ N := fun x hx => ⟨hFK hx, by
    show τ x < ε
    rw [hτF x hx]; exact hε⟩
  have hNc : IsCompact (closure N) :=
    hKc.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure (closure_minimal hNK hKcl)
  have hτb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < τ x ∧ τ x < ε := fun x hx =>
    ⟨hτpos x (hKW (hNK hx.2)).1 (hUF x hx.1), hx.2.2⟩
  have hcl : closure U = U ∪ frontier U := closure_eq_self_union_frontier U
  have hτp : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d) := by
    intro c' d hc hd
    have heq : U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c' d = K ∩ closure U ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c' d := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hxU, hxN⟩, hxI⟩
        exact ⟨⟨hNK hxN, subset_closure hxU⟩, hxI⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨hxK, hxc⟩, hxI⟩
        have hτx : τ x < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt hxI.2 hd
        have hxU : x ∈ U := by
          rw [hcl] at hxc
          rcases hxc with h | h
          · exact h
          · exfalso
            have h3 : c' ≤ τ x := hxI.1
            rw [hτF x h] at h3
            linarith
        exact ⟨⟨hxU, hdia x hxK hτx, hτx⟩, hxI⟩
    rw [heq]
    exact hKc.of_isClosed_subset
      ((hKcl.inter isClosed_closure).inter (IsClosed.preimage hτc isClosed_Icc))
      (fun x hx => hx.1.1)
  have hτi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε →
      IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ)) := by
    intro δ hδ hδε
    have heq : frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ) = K ∩ closure U ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro (hxF | ⟨⟨hxU, hxN⟩, hxI⟩)
        · refine ⟨⟨interior_subset (hFK hxF), frontier_subset_closure hxF⟩, ?_⟩
          show τ x ≤ δ
          rw [hτF x hxF]; exact hδ.le
        · exact ⟨⟨hNK hxN, subset_closure hxU⟩, hxI⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨hxK, hxc⟩, hxI⟩
        rw [hcl] at hxc
        rcases hxc with h | h
        · have hτx : τ x < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt hxI hδε
          exact Or.inr ⟨⟨h, hdia x hxK hτx, hτx⟩, hxI⟩
        · exact Or.inl h
    rw [heq]
    exact (hKcl.inter isClosed_closure).inter (IsClosed.preimage hτc isClosed_Iic)
  have hτ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ := by
    intro δ hδ
    refine ⟨interior K ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iio (min δ ε),
      isOpen_interior.inter (hτc.isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_Iio), fun x hx => ⟨hFK hx, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show τ x < min δ ε
      rw [hτF x hx]; exact lt_min hδ hε
    · rintro x ⟨hxU, hxK, hxτ⟩
      have h1 : τ x < min δ ε := hxτ
      exact ⟨⟨hxK, lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (min_le_right _ _)⟩, lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  
  exact ⟨N, ε, τ, hNo, hFN, hNc, hε, hτsm.mono (fun x hx => hUF x hx.1),
    fun x hx => hreg x (hKW (hNK hx.2)).2 (hτb x hx).1, hτb, hτp, hτi, hτ0⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: fderiv_pos_proportional
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(F F' : E3 → ℝ) (y₀ : E3) (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ F y₀)
    (hF' : DifferentiableAt ℝ F' y₀) (h0 : F y₀ = 0) (h0' : F' y₀ = 0)
    (hne : fderiv ℝ F y₀ ≠ 0) (hne' : fderiv ℝ F' y₀ ≠ 0)
    (hsgn : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, 0 ≤ F y * F' y) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ fderiv ℝ F' y₀ = c • fderiv ℝ F y₀

subgoal_signatures.name: second_order_product_sum
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{ι : Type*} (J : Finset ι) (Ψ F : ι → E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (hΨ : ∀ m ∈ J, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Ψ m) U)
    (hF : ∀ m ∈ J, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F m) U) (hF0 : ∀ m ∈ J, F m y₀ = 0) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * F m z) y₀ = ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m y₀ • fderiv ℝ (F m) y₀ ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => ∑ m ∈ J, Ψ m z * F m z)) y₀ =
        ∑ m ∈ J, (Ψ m y₀ * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (F m)) y₀
          + partialDeriv i (Ψ m) y₀ * partialDeriv j (F m) y₀
          + partialDeriv i (F m) y₀ * partialDeriv j (Ψ m) y₀)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (U : Set M) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hUo : IsOpen U) (hUc : IsConnected U) (hρ : 2 ≤ ρ)
    (hfar : ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ U)
    (hcpt : IsCompact (closure U \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}))
    (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (hnone : ∀ S : Set M, IsCompact S → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S → S ⊆ U → S = ∅)
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (τ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hNc : IsCompact (closure N)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hτs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ (U ∩ N))
    (hτr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0)
    (hτb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < τ x ∧ τ x < ε)
    (hτp : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d))
    (hτi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ)))
    (hτ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ) :
    ∀ (x₀ : M) (a b : ℝ) (w : M → ℝ), x₀ ∈ U ∩ N → 0 < a → a < b → b < ε →
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, τ x ≤ a → w x < 0) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, b ≤ τ x → 0 < w x) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) →
      ∃ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ g.levelMeanCurv w x

signature.name: collar_no_outer_trapped
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (U : Set M) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hUo : IsOpen U) (hUc : IsConnected U) (hρ : 2 ≤ ρ)
    (hfar : ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ U)
    (hcpt : IsCompact (closure U \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}))
    (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (hnone : ∀ S : Set M, IsCompact S → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S → S ⊆ U → S = ∅)
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (τ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hNc : IsCompact (closure N)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hτs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ (U ∩ N))
    (hτr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0)
    (hτb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < τ x ∧ τ x < ε)
    (hτp : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d))
    (hτi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ)))
    (hτ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ) :
    ∀ (x₀ : M) (a b : ℝ) (w : M → ℝ), x₀ ∈ U ∩ N → 0 < a → a < b → b < ε →
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, τ x ≤ a → w x < 0) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, b ≤ τ x → 0 < w x) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) →
      ∃ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ g.levelMeanCurv w x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x₀ a b w hx₀ ha hab hb hws hwa hwb hwr
  by_contra hneg
  push_neg at hneg
  haveI : LocallyConnectedSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyConnectedSpace E3 M
  set C := connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ with hCdef
  have hCo : IsOpen C := (hUo.inter hNo).connectedComponentIn
  have hCsub : C ⊆ U ∩ N := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _
  have hx₀C : x₀ ∈ C := mem_connectedComponentIn hx₀
  have hwc : ContinuousOn w C := hws.continuousOn
  
  have hCcl : ∀ z ∈ U ∩ N, z ∈ closure C → z ∈ C := by
    intro z hz hzc
    have h1 : IsPreconnected (insert z C) :=
      (isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn).subset_closure (Set.subset_insert z C)
        (Set.insert_subset hzc subset_closure)
    have h2 : insert z C ⊆ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ :=
      h1.subset_connectedComponentIn (Set.mem_insert_of_mem z hx₀C) (Set.insert_subset hz hCsub)
    exact h2 (Set.mem_insert z C)
  
  have hK : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (C ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d) := by
    intro c d hc hd
    have hK' := hτp c d hc hd
    have hsubK : C ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d ⊆ U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d :=
      fun x hx => ⟨hCsub hx.1, hx.2⟩
    refine hK'.of_isClosed_subset ?_ hsubK
    rw [← closure_subset_iff_isClosed]
    intro z hz
    have hz1 : z ∈ U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d :=
      hK'.isClosed.closure_subset (closure_mono hsubK hz)
    exact ⟨hCcl z hz1.1 (closure_mono Set.inter_subset_left hz), hz1.2⟩
  
  have hs2 : ∃ x ∈ C, τ x < a := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hd : τ x₀ < ε := (hτb x₀ hx₀).2
    have hKc := hK a (τ x₀) ha hd
    have hKne : (C ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc a (τ x₀)).Nonempty := ⟨x₀, hx₀C, hcon x₀ hx₀C, le_rfl⟩
    have hτc : ContinuousOn τ (C ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc a (τ x₀)) :=
      hτs.continuousOn.mono (fun x hx => hCsub hx.1)
    obtain ⟨y, hyK, hymin⟩ := hKc.exists_isMinOn hKne hτc
    have hyC : y ∈ C := hyK.1
    have hloc : IsLocalMin τ y := by
      filter_upwards [hCo.mem_nhds hyC] with x hx
      by_cases hxd : τ x ≤ τ x₀
      · exact hymin ⟨hx, hcon x hx, hxd⟩
      · push_neg at hxd
        exact le_trans hyK.2.2 hxd.le
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y :=
      (hτs.mdifferentiableOn (by simp)).mdifferentiableAt
        ((hUo.inter hNo).mem_nhds (hCsub hyC))
    have hmf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y = 0 := by
      rw [hmd.mfderiv]
      have hw' : writtenInExtChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) y τ =
          τ ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) y).symm := by
        funext z
        simp [writtenInExtChartAt, extChartAt_model_space_eq_id]
      have h0 : (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) y).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) y y) = y :=
        extChartAt_to_inv y
      have ht : Tendsto (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) y).symm (𝓝 (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) y y)) (𝓝 y) := by
        have hca : ContinuousAt (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) y).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) y y) :=
          continuousAt_extChartAt_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) y
        have := hca.tendsto
        rwa [h0] at this
      have hlm : IsLocalMin (τ ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) y).symm) (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) y y) := by
        have hev := ht.eventually hloc
        filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
        simp only [Function.comp, h0]
        exact hz
      rw [hw', ModelWithCorners.range_eq_univ, fderivWithin_univ]
      exact hlm.fderiv_eq_zero
    exact hτr y (hCsub hyC) hmf
  
  set D : Set M := {x | x ∈ C ∧ w x ≤ 0} with hDdef
  have hDsub : D ⊆ U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iic b := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨hCsub hx.1, ?_⟩
    show τ x ≤ b
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have := hwb x hx.1 h.le
    linarith [hx.2]
  have hA : IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iic b)) := hτi b (by linarith) hb
  have hUD : ∀ z ∈ U, z ∈ closure D → z ∈ D := by
    intro z hzU hzD
    have hzA := hA.closure_subset (closure_mono (hDsub.trans Set.subset_union_right) hzD)
    have hzUN : z ∈ U ∩ N := by
      rcases hzA with h | h
      · rw [hUo.frontier_eq] at h
        exact absurd hzU h.2
      · exact h.1
    have hzC : z ∈ C := hCcl z hzUN (closure_mono (fun x hx => hx.1) hzD)
    refine ⟨hzC, ?_⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousAt w z := hwc.continuousAt (hCo.mem_nhds hzC)
    by_contra hpos
    push_neg at hpos
    have hev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 z, 0 < w x := hcont.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hpos)
    obtain ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 hzD _ hev
    exact absurd hx2.2 (not_le.2 hx1)
  have hUDeq : U \ D = U \ closure D := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hzU, hzD⟩
      exact ⟨hzU, fun h => hzD (hUD z hzU h)⟩
    · rintro ⟨hzU, hzD⟩
      exact ⟨hzU, fun h => hzD (subset_closure h)⟩
  have hDo : IsOpen (U \ D) := by
    rw [hUDeq]
    exact hUo.sdiff isClosed_closure
  set S : Set M := C ∩ w ⁻¹' {0} with hSdef
  have hDfr : frontier (U \ D) ⊆ S ∪ frontier U := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hDo.frontier_eq] at hz
    obtain ⟨hzc, hzn⟩ := hz
    by_cases hzU : z ∈ U
    · have hzD : z ∈ D := by
        by_contra h
        exact hzn ⟨hzU, h⟩
      refine Or.inl ⟨hzD.1, ?_⟩
      show w z = 0
      refine le_antisymm hzD.2 ?_
      by_contra hneg'
      push_neg at hneg'
      have hcont : ContinuousAt w z := hwc.continuousAt (hCo.mem_nhds hzD.1)
      have hev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 z, w x < 0 ∧ x ∈ C :=
        (hcont.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hneg')).and (hCo.mem_nhds hzD.1)
      obtain ⟨x, ⟨hx1, hx3⟩, hx2⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 hzc _ hev
      exact hx2.2 ⟨hx3, hx1.le⟩
    · right
      rw [hUo.frontier_eq]
      exact ⟨closure_mono Set.diff_subset hzc, hzU⟩
  have hSc : IsCompact S := by
    have hKab := hK a b ha hb
    have hSK : S ⊆ C ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc a b := by
      intro x hx
      have h0 : w x = 0 := hx.2
      refine ⟨hx.1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        have := hwa x hx.1 h.le
        linarith
      · by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        have := hwb x hx.1 h.le
        linarith
    have hSeq : S = (C ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc a b) ∩ w ⁻¹' {0} := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        exact ⟨hSK hx, hx.2⟩
      · intro hx
        exact ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2⟩
    have hcl : IsClosed ((C ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc a b) ∩ w ⁻¹' {0}) :=
      (hwc.mono (fun x hx => hx.1)).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hKab.isClosed
        isClosed_singleton
    rw [hSeq]
    exact hKab.of_isClosed_subset hcl Set.inter_subset_left
  
  obtain ⟨σ, aσ, cσ, haσ, hσs, hσeq, hσle, hσc⟩ := radial_exhaustion_exists g hAF
  have hEnd : ∀ m : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ Rb : ℝ, 2 ≤ Rb ∧ ∀ y : E3, Rb < ‖y‖ →
      0 < levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ) (fun z => ‖z‖) y := by
    intro m
    have hsrc : (hAF.ends m).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends m).source_eq
    have hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
      intro i j
      rw [← hsrc]
      exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g (hAF.ends m).Φ i j
    have hq0 : 0 < hAF.q := lt_trans (by norm_num) hAF.q_gt
    obtain ⟨R, Cc, hR1, hC0, hbd⟩ :=
      metric_coeff_bounds (g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ) hAF.q hq0 hsmooth (hAF.decay m)
    have hdec : Dec1 (g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ) hAF.q R Cc := by
      intro x hx i j
      obtain ⟨_, hrest⟩ := hbd x hx
      refine ⟨(hrest i j 0).1, fun l => ?_⟩
      have h1 := (hrest i j l).2.1
      calc |partialDeriv l (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ y i j) x|
          = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ y i j) x (e l)‖ := by
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; rfl
        _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ y i j) x‖ * ‖e l‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ y i j) x‖ := by
            simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
        _ ≤ _ := h1
    obtain ⟨Rb, _, hpos⟩ := coordSphere_levelMeanCurvCoord_pos (g.coeff (hAF.ends m).Φ)
      hAF.q R Cc hq0 hR1 hC0 (fun x hx => (hbd x hx).1) hdec
    exact ⟨max Rb 2, le_max_right _ _,
      fun y hy => hpos y (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hy)⟩
  choose Rb _ hRbpos using hEnd
  have hRbB : ∀ m, Rb m ≤ ∑ m', |Rb m'| := fun m =>
    (le_abs_self _).trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun m' => |Rb m'|)
      (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ m))
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁⟩ : ∃ r₁ : ℝ, r₁ = max (max aσ cσ) (∑ m', |Rb m'|) + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσH : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ σ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv σ p := by
    intro p hp
    have hm1 : max aσ cσ ≤ max (max aσ cσ) (∑ m', |Rb m'|) := le_max_left _ _
    have hm2 : (∑ m', |Rb m'|) ≤ max (max aσ cσ) (∑ m', |Rb m'|) := le_max_right _ _
    have hm3 : cσ ≤ max aσ cσ := le_max_right _ _
    have hpc : cσ < σ p := by linarith
    obtain ⟨m, y, hy, rfl⟩ : ∃ (m : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), aσ < ‖y‖ ∧
        (hAF.ends m).Φ y = p := by
      by_contra hno
      push_neg at hno
      exact absurd (hσle p hno) (not_le.2 hpc)
    have hσy : σ ((hAF.ends m).Φ y) = ‖y‖ := hσeq m y hy
    have hyR : Rb m < ‖y‖ := by
      have := hRbB m
      linarith
    have hsrc : y ∈ (hAF.ends m).Φ.source := by
      rw [(hAF.ends m).source_eq]
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
      linarith
    have hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, σ ((hAF.ends m).Φ z) = ‖z‖ := by
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact hσeq m z hz
    rw [levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g (hAF.ends m).Φ σ (fun z => ‖z‖) hσs y hsrc hfh]
    exact hRbpos m y hyR
  
  obtain ⟨cN, hcN⟩ := hNc.bddAbove_image hσs.continuous.continuousOn
  have hσN : ∀ p ∈ closure N, σ p ≤ cN := fun p hp => hcN ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r₁', hr₁'⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = max r₁ (cN + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hr₁'a : r₁ ≤ r₁' := by rw [hr₁']; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hr₁'b : cN + 1 ≤ r₁' := by rw [hr₁']; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hσH' : ∀ p : M, r₁' ≤ σ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv σ p :=
    fun p hp => hσH p (le_trans hr₁'a hp)
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = max (max aσ ρ) r₁' + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ht1 : aσ < t := by
    have h1 := le_max_left aσ ρ
    have h2 := le_max_left (max aσ ρ) r₁'
    linarith
  have ht2 : ρ < t := by
    have h1 := le_max_right aσ ρ
    have h2 := le_max_left (max aσ ρ) r₁'
    linarith
  have ht3 : r₁' < t := by
    have h2 := le_max_right (max aσ ρ) r₁'
    linarith
  have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith
  have hnt : ‖t • e 0‖ = t := by
    rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos htpos]
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩ : ∃ p : M, p = (hAF.ends k).Φ (t • e 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hp₁U : p₁ ∈ U := by
    rw [hp₁]
    exact hfar _ (by rw [hnt]; exact ht2)
  have hσp₁ : σ p₁ = t := by
    rw [hp₁, hσeq k _ (by rw [hnt]; exact ht1), hnt]
  have hp₁D : p₁ ∉ D := by
    intro h
    have := hσN p₁ (subset_closure (hCsub h.1).2)
    linarith
  have hp₁UD : p₁ ∈ U \ D := ⟨hp₁U, hp₁D⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set M, Ω = connectedComponentIn (U \ D) p₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by rw [hΩ]; exact hDo.connectedComponentIn
  have hΩc : IsConnected Ω := by rw [hΩ]; exact isConnected_connectedComponentIn_iff.2 hp₁UD
  have hΩsub : Ω ⊆ U \ D := by rw [hΩ]; exact connectedComponentIn_subset _ _
  have hp₁Ω : p₁ ∈ Ω := by rw [hΩ]; exact mem_connectedComponentIn hp₁UD
  have hΩfr : frontier Ω ⊆ frontier (U \ D) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hΩo.frontier_eq] at hz
    obtain ⟨hzc, hzn⟩ := hz
    rw [hDo.frontier_eq]
    refine ⟨closure_mono hΩsub hzc, fun hzUD => hzn ?_⟩
    have hzo : IsOpen (connectedComponentIn (U \ D) z) := hDo.connectedComponentIn
    obtain ⟨q, hq1, hq2⟩ := mem_closure_iff.1 hzc _ hzo (mem_connectedComponentIn hzUD)
    rw [hΩ] at hq2 ⊢
    rw [connectedComponentIn_eq hq2, ← connectedComponentIn_eq hq1]
    exact mem_connectedComponentIn hzUD
  have hfr : frontier Ω ⊆ S ∪ frontier U := hΩfr.trans hDfr
  have hfrσ : frontier Ω ⊆ {p : M | σ p < r₁'} := by
    intro z hz
    have hzN : z ∈ closure N := by
      rcases hfr hz with h | h
      · exact subset_closure (hCsub h.1).2
      · exact subset_closure (hFN h)
    have := hσN z hzN
    show σ z < r₁'
    linarith
  have hΩV : ∀ x ∈ Ω ∩ C, 0 < w x :=
    fun x hx => not_le.1 (fun h => (hΩsub hx.1).2 ⟨hx.2, h⟩)
  have hΩF : Disjoint Ω (frontier U) := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x hx hxF => ?_
    rw [hUo.frontier_eq] at hxF
    exact hxF.2 (hΩsub hx).1
  have hSF : Disjoint S (frontier U) := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x hx hxF => ?_
    rw [hUo.frontier_eq] at hxF
    exact hxF.2 (hCsub hx.1).1
  have hfar' : (Ω ∩ {p : M | r₁' < σ p}).Nonempty := ⟨p₁, hp₁Ω, by
    show r₁' < σ p₁
    rw [hσp₁]
    exact ht3⟩
  
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁C, hx₁τ⟩ := hs2
  have hx₁D : x₁ ∈ D := ⟨hx₁C, (hwa x₁ hx₁C hx₁τ.le).le⟩
  have hmeet : (closure Ω ∩ S).Nonempty := by
    by_contra hem
    rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hem
    have hcl : closure Ω ∩ U ⊆ Ω := by
      rintro z ⟨hzc, hzU⟩
      by_contra hzn
      have hzf : z ∈ frontier Ω := by

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨isClosed_frontier, fun p hp O hO => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨V, f, hVO, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hVS, hH, hP, hN⟩ := hS.2 p (hfr hp) O hO
  have hSm : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ Smin ↔ f x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : x ∈ V ∩ Smin := ⟨hx, h⟩
      rw [hVS] at h'
      exact h'.2
    · intro h
      have h' : x ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hx, h⟩
      rw [← hVS] at h'
      exact h'.2
  have hnotU : ∀ x ∈ Smin, x ∉ U := fun x hx hxU => Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hx hxU
  have hsplit : ∀ A : Set M, A ⊆ V → (∀ x ∈ A, f x ≠ 0) → IsPreconnected A →
      A ⊆ U ∨ A ⊆ (closure U)ᶜ := by
    intro A hAV hA0 hAc
    refine hAc.subset_or_subset hU isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl ?_ ?_
    · exact Disjoint.mono_left subset_closure disjoint_compl_right
    · intro x hx
      by_cases hxU : x ∈ U
      · exact Or.inl hxU
      · right
        intro hxc
        have hxf : x ∈ frontier U := by
          rw [hU.frontier_eq]
          exact ⟨hxc, hxU⟩
        exact hA0 x hx ((hSm x (hAV hx)).1 (hfr hxf))
  have hpos := hsplit (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) Set.inter_subset_left
    (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx.2) hP
  have hneg := hsplit (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) Set.inter_subset_left
    (fun x hx => ne_of_lt hx.2) hN
  have hone : V ∩ {x | 0 < f x} ⊆ U ∨ V ∩ {x | f x < 0} ⊆ U := by
    have hpcl : p ∈ closure U := frontier_subset_closure hp
    obtain ⟨x0, hx0V, hx0U⟩ : (V ∩ U).Nonempty := mem_closure_iff.1 hpcl V hVo hpV
    have hx0 : f x0 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hnotU x0 ((hSm x0 hx0V).2 h0) hx0U
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hx0 with h | h
    · right
      rcases hneg with hneg | hneg
      · exact hneg
      · exact absurd (subset_closure hx0U) (hneg ⟨hx0V, h⟩)
    · left
      rcases hpos with hpos | hpos
      · exact hpos
      · exact absurd (subset_closure hx0U) (hpos ⟨hx0V, h⟩)
  have hcrit : ∀ x ∈ V, IsLocalMax f x ∨ IsLocalMin f x → False := by
    intro x hx hext
    apply hdf x hx
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x := hf.mdifferentiable (by simp) x
    have hcont : ContinuousAt (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) :=
      continuousAt_extChartAt_symm x
    have hinv : (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) = x :=
      extChartAt_to_inv x
    have hT : Tendsto (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (𝓝 (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x)) (𝓝 x) := by
      have := hcont.tendsto
      rwa [hinv] at this
    have hF : fderiv ℝ (f ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm) (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) = 0 := by
      rcases hext with h | h
      · apply IsLocalMax.fderiv_eq_zero
        show ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x), f ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm y) ≤
          f ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x))
        rw [hinv]
        exact hT.eventually h
      · apply IsLocalMin.fderiv_eq_zero
        show ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x),
          f ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x)) ≤
            f ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm y)
        rw [hinv]
        exact hT.eventually h
    rw [hmd.mfderiv]
    simp only [writtenInExtChartAt, extChartAt_model_space_eq_id, PartialEquiv.refl_coe,
      Function.id_comp, modelWithCornersSelf_coe, Set.range_id, fderivWithin_univ]
    exact hF
  have hsides : ∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 →
      x ∈ closure (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∧ x ∈ closure (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) := by
    intro x hx hx0
    constructor
    · by_contra hc
      rw [mem_closure_iff_nhds] at hc
      push_neg at hc
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hts⟩ := hc
      refine hcrit x hx (Or.inl ?_)
      filter_upwards [ht, hVo.mem_nhds hx] with y hy hyV
      rw [hx0]
      by_contra hlt
      push_neg at hlt
      have hmem : y ∈ t ∩ (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) := ⟨hy, hyV, hlt⟩
      rw [hts] at hmem
      exact hmem
    · by_contra hc
      rw [mem_closure_iff_nhds] at hc
      push_neg at hc
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hts⟩ := hc
      refine hcrit x hx (Or.inr ?_)
      filter_upwards [ht, hVo.mem_nhds hx] with y hy hyV
      rw [hx0]
      by_contra hlt
      push_neg at hlt
      have hmem : y ∈ t ∩ (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) := ⟨hy, hyV, hlt⟩
      rw [hts] at hmem
      exact hmem

    · rintro x ⟨hxV, hx0⟩

      refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
      rw [hU.frontier_eq]
      refine ⟨?_, hnotU x ((hSm x hxV).2 hx0')⟩
      obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := hsides x hxV hx0'
      rcases hone with h | h
      · exact closure_mono h c1
      · exact closure_mono h c2
  exact ⟨V, f, hVO, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, heq, hH, hP, hN⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hSC : SigmaCompactSpace M := by
    have hB : IsSigmaCompact {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖} :=
      IsSigmaCompact.of_isClosed_subset isSigmaCompact_univ
        (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm) (Set.subset_univ _)
    have hI : IsSigmaCompact (⋃ k, (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖}) := by
      refine isSigmaCompact_iUnion _ (fun k => ?_)
      have hcont : ContinuousOn ((hAF.ends k).Φ : E3 → M) (hAF.ends k).Φ.source :=
        (hAF.ends k).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
      have hsub : {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖} ⊆ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by
        intro y hy
        rw [(hAF.ends k).source_eq]
        show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
        have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖y‖ := hy
        linarith
      exact hB.image_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hsub)
    have hK : IsSigmaCompact (⋃ k, (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ :=
      hAF.isCompact_core.isSigmaCompact
    have hU : IsSigmaCompact ((⋃ k, (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ ∪
        ⋃ k, (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖}) := by
      rw [Set.union_eq_iUnion]
      refine isSigmaCompact_iUnion _ (fun b => ?_)
      cases b
      · simpa using hI
      · simpa using hK
    have huniv : ((⋃ k, (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ ∪
        ⋃ k, (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖}) = Set.univ := by
      refine Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun x => ?_)
      by_cases h : x ∈ ⋃ k, (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖}
      · right
        obtain ⟨k, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 h
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k, y, (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖y‖ from le_of_lt hy), rfl⟩
      · left
        exact h
    rw [huniv] at hU
    exact isSigmaCompact_univ_iff.mp hU
  haveI := hSC
  haveI : SecondCountableTopology M := ChartedSpace.secondCountable_of_sigmaCompact E3 M
  have h0 : (∅ : Set M) ∈ {S : Set M | IsCompact S ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S} :=
    ⟨isCompact_empty, isClosed_empty, fun p hp => absurd hp (Set.notMem_empty p)⟩
  have hT : trappedSet g = closure (⋃₀ {S : Set M | IsCompact S ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S}) :=
    rfl
  rw [hT]
  rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (⋃₀ {S : Set M | IsCompact S ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S})
    with hA | hA
  · refine ⟨fun _ => ∅, fun _ => h0, ?_⟩
    rw [hA, Set.iUnion_empty]
  · haveI : Nonempty (⋃₀ {S : Set M | IsCompact S ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S}) :=
      Set.nonempty_coe_sort.mpr hA
    let d := TopologicalSpace.denseSeq (⋃₀ {S : Set M | IsCompact S ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S})
    choose S hSF hdS using fun n => Set.mem_sUnion.1 (d n).2
    refine ⟨S, hSF, ?_⟩
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · refine closure_minimal ?_ isClosed_closure
      have h1 : ⋃₀ {S : Set M | IsCompact S ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S} ⊆
          closure (Subtype.val '' Set.range d) :=
        Subtype.dense_iff.mp (TopologicalSpace.denseRange_denseSeq _)
      refine h1.trans (closure_mono ?_)
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨n, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, hdS n⟩
    · exact closure_mono (Set.iUnion_subset fun n => Set.subset_sUnion_of_mem (hSF n))

by
  haveI : LocallyConnectedSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyConnectedSpace E3 M
  intro q hq
  by_contra hqS
  have hqcl : q ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (trappedSet g)ᶜ x₀) := hq.1
  have hqint : q ∉ interior (connectedComponentIn (trappedSet g)ᶜ x₀) := hq.2
  
  have hAcl : ∀ N, IsClosed ((⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (ψ N), S n) ∪ Sig N) := fun N =>
    (isClosed_biUnion_finset (fun n _ => (hS n).2.1)).union (hSig N).2.1
  have hWo : ∀ N, IsOpen (connectedComponentIn
      ((⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (ψ N), S n) ∪ Sig N)ᶜ x₀) := fun N =>
    (hAcl N).isOpen_compl.connectedComponentIn
  
  have hSnT : ∀ n, S n ⊆ trappedSet g := by
    intro n x hx
    rw [hT]
    exact subset_closure (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, hx⟩)
  have hSigT : ∀ N, Sig N ⊆ trappedSet g := fun N x hx =>
    subset_closure (Set.mem_sUnion.2 ⟨Sig N, hSig N, hx⟩)
  have hAT : ∀ N, (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (ψ N), S n) ∪ Sig N ⊆ trappedSet g := by
    intro N x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · obtain ⟨n, _, hxn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hx
      exact hSnT n hxn
    · exact hSigT N hx
  have hCW : ∀ N, connectedComponentIn (trappedSet g)ᶜ x₀ ⊆
      connectedComponentIn ((⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (ψ N), S n) ∪ Sig N)ᶜ x₀ := fun N =>
    connectedComponentIn_mono x₀ (Set.compl_subset_compl.mpr (hAT N))
  
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hev⟩ := hlim q hqS
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hev
  have hqO : q ∈ interior O := mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hO
  set B := connectedComponentIn (interior O) q with hBdef
  have hqB : q ∈ B := mem_connectedComponentIn hqO
  have hBo : IsOpen B := isOpen_interior.connectedComponentIn
  have hBpre : IsPreconnected B := isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
  have hBO : B ⊆ O := (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _).trans interior_subset
  
  obtain ⟨y, hyB, hyC⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp hqcl B hBo hqB
  
  have hBW : ∀ N, N₀ ≤ N → B ⊆ connectedComponentIn
      ((⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (ψ N), S n) ∪ Sig N)ᶜ x₀ := by
    intro N hN
    refine hBpre.subset_of_closure_inter_subset (hWo N) ⟨y, hyB, hCW N hyC⟩ ?_
    rintro x ⟨hxcl, hxB⟩
    by_contra hxW
    have hxfr : x ∈ frontier (connectedComponentIn
        ((⋃ n ∈ Finset.range (ψ N), S n) ∪ Sig N)ᶜ x₀) := by
      rw [(hWo N).frontier_eq]
      exact ⟨hxcl, hxW⟩
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hN₀ N hN) (hBO hxB) (hfrN N hxfr)
  
  have hBS : Disjoint B (⋃ n, S n) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxB hxU
    obtain ⟨n, hxn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxU
    have hN : N₀ ≤ max N₀ (n + 1) := le_max_left _ _
    have hnN : n + 1 ≤ max N₀ (n + 1) := le_max_right _ _
    have hNψ : max N₀ (n + 1) ≤ ψ (max N₀ (n + 1)) := hψ.id_le _
    have hnr : n ∈ Finset.range (ψ (max N₀ (n + 1))) := Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)
    have hxA : x ∈ (⋃ m ∈ Finset.range (ψ (max N₀ (n + 1))), S m) ∪ Sig (max N₀ (n + 1)) :=
      Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨n, hnr, hxn⟩)
    exact (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ (hBW _ hN hxB)) hxA
  
  have hBT : B ⊆ (trappedSet g)ᶜ := by
    have h := hBS.closure_right hBo
    rw [← hT] at h
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp h
  
  have hBC : B ⊆ connectedComponentIn (trappedSet g)ᶜ x₀ := by
    rw [connectedComponentIn_eq hyC]
    exact hBpre.subset_connectedComponentIn hyB hBT
  exact hqint (interior_maximal hBC hBo hqB)

def RiemannianMetric3.jacobiDeriv (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (w : M → ℝ) (x : M) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x x))⁻¹ i j *
      partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm)
        (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y))) (chartAt E3 x x) *
      partialDeriv j (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x)


def IsStableMinimalSet (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (S : Set M) : Prop :=
  ∃ φ : M → ℝ, ∀ p ∈ S, 0 < φ p ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
    V ∩ S = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
    ∀ x ∈ V ∩ S, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧ 0 ≤ g.jacobiDeriv f x


def secondFundSq (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      ((G y)⁻¹ i j - (∑ a : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a f y) *
          (∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b f y) /
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y)) *
        hessLoc G f j k y *
        ((G y)⁻¹ k l - (∑ a : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv a f y) *
          (∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ l b * partialDeriv b f y) /
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y)) *
        hessLoc G f l i y) /
    (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y)


def HasCurvatureBound (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (S : Set M) (Λ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧

    secondFundSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))

def coordPlaneProj (a : Fin 3) (y : E3) : E3 := y - (y a) • e a


def MinimalSheetsNear (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M) (ρ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (Λ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (Sig : Set M) : Prop :=
  ∃ (a : Fin 3) (l : ℕ) (u : Fin l → E3 → ℝ), l ≤ L ∧
    (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u i)) ∧
    (∀ i (n : ℕ) (y : E3), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (u i) y‖ ≤ Λ n) ∧
    (∀ i i' : Fin l, i < i' → ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      u i (coordPlaneProj a y) < u i' (coordPlaneProj a y)) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin l) (y : E3), ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      |u i (coordPlaneProj a y) - (chartAt E3 p p) a| < 8 * ρ ∧
      (chartAt E3 p).symm (coordPlaneProj a y + u i (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) ∈ Sig ∧
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => z a - u i (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (coordPlaneProj a y + u i (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ Sig, x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source →
      chartAt E3 p x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ρ →
      ∃ i : Fin l, (chartAt E3 p x) a = u i (coordPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p x)))

        have e0 : Circle.exp (φA ⟨x₀, hx₀A⟩) = Circle.exp (φB ⟨x₀, hx₀B⟩) := by
          rw [← hφA, ← hφB]; rfl
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Circle.exp_eq_exp.mp e0
        refine ⟨m * (2 * Real.pi), Circle.exp_int_mul_two_pi m, ?_⟩
        haveI : PreconnectedSpace (A ∩ B : Set E3) := Subtype.preconnectedSpace hAB
        have heq := Circle.isCoveringMap_exp.eq_of_comp_eq
          (g₁ := fun x : (A ∩ B : Set E3) => φA ⟨x.1, x.2.1⟩)
          (g₂ := fun x : (A ∩ B : Set E3) => φB ⟨x.1, x.2.2⟩ + m * (2 * Real.pi))
          (φA.continuous.comp (continuous_inclusion Set.inter_subset_left))
          ((φB.continuous.comp (continuous_inclusion Set.inter_subset_right)).add
            continuous_const)
          (by
            funext x
            show Circle.exp (φA ⟨x.1, x.2.1⟩) =
              Circle.exp (φB ⟨x.1, x.2.2⟩ + m * (2 * Real.pi))
            rw [Circle.exp_add, Circle.exp_int_mul_two_pi, mul_one, ← hφA ⟨x.1, x.2.1⟩,
              ← hφB ⟨x.1, x.2.2⟩]
            rfl)
          ⟨x₀, hx₀A, hx₀B⟩ hm
        intro x hxA hxB
        exact congrFun heq ⟨x, hxA, hxB⟩
      · refine ⟨0, Circle.exp_zero, fun x hxA hxB => ?_⟩
        exact absurd ⟨x, hxA, hxB⟩ hne
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ψ = fun x =>
        if hx : x ∈ A then φA ⟨x, hx⟩ else if hx' : x ∈ B then φB ⟨x, hx'⟩ + c else 0 :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hψA : ContinuousOn ψ A := by
      rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
      have : A.restrict ψ = φA := by
        funext x
        rw [Set.restrict_apply, hψdef]
        simp only
        rw [dif_pos x.2]
      rw [this]
      exact φA.continuous
    have hψB : ContinuousOn ψ B := by
      rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
      have : B.restrict ψ = fun x => φB x + c := by
        funext x
        rw [Set.restrict_apply, hψdef]
        simp only
        by_cases hxA : (x : E3) ∈ A
        · rw [dif_pos hxA]
          exact hcAB x.1 hxA x.2
        · rw [dif_neg hxA, dif_pos x.2]
      rw [this]
      exact φB.continuous.add continuous_const
    have hψ : ContinuousOn ψ (A ∪ B) := hψA.union_of_isOpen hψB hA hB
    refine ⟨⟨(A ∪ B).restrict ψ, continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict.mp hψ⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
    show θ x = Circle.exp (ψ x.1)
    by_cases hxA : (x : E3) ∈ A
    · rw [hψdef]
      simp only
      rw [dif_pos hxA, ← hφA ⟨x.1, hxA⟩]
      rfl
    · have hxB : (x : E3) ∈ B := x.2.resolve_left hxA
      rw [hψdef]
      simp only
      rw [dif_neg hxA, dif_pos hxB, Circle.exp_add, hc1, mul_one, ← hφB ⟨x.1, hxB⟩]
      rfl
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (σ t : ℝ) (z : E3) (i : Fin 3),
      ((1 - t) • (σ • e 0) + t • z) i = (1 - t) * (σ * (if i = 0 then 1 else 0)) + t * z i := by
    intro σ t z i
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  have hpiece : ∀ σ : ℝ, σ ≠ 0 →
      ∀ θ : C({z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)}, Circle),
        ∃ φ : C({z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)}, ℝ),
          ∀ x, θ x = Circle.exp (φ x) := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hσσ : 0 < σ * σ := mul_self_pos.mpr hσ
    have hmem : ∀ (t : unitInterval) (z : {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)}),
        (1 - (t : ℝ)) • (σ • e 0) + (t : ℝ) • (z : E3) ∈
          {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)} := by
      rintro ⟨t, ht0, ht1⟩ ⟨z, hz⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz ⊢
      rintro ⟨h1, h2, h0⟩
      have e1 : (if (1 : Fin 3) = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
      have e2 : (if (2 : Fin 3) = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
      rw [hcoord, e1, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_add] at h1
      rw [hcoord, e2, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_add] at h2
      rw [hcoord, if_pos rfl, mul_one] at h0
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht0 with ht | ht
      · subst ht
        nlinarith
      · apply hz
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h | h
          · exact absurd h ht.ne'
          · exact h
        · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h | h
          · exact absurd h ht.ne'
          · exact h
        · by_contra hpos
          push_neg at hpos
          nlinarith [mul_pos ht hpos, mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) hσσ.le]
    have hc : σ • e 0 ∈ {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)} := by
      have := hcoord σ 0 0
      simp only [sub_zero, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero, one_mul, zero_mul] at this
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      rintro ⟨-, -, h0⟩
      rw [this] at h0
      simp only [if_true, mul_one] at h0
      linarith
    refine hcontr _ ⟨σ • e 0, hc⟩
      ⟨fun p => ⟨(1 - (p.1 : ℝ)) • (σ • e 0) + (p.1 : ℝ) • (p.2 : E3), hmem p.1 p.2⟩,
        Continuous.subtype_mk (by fun_prop) _⟩ ?_ ?_
    · intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp
    · intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp
  
  have hD : IsPreconnected {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0)} := by
    have hC : IsConnected ({0}ᶜ : Set ℂ) :=
      isConnected_compl_singleton_of_one_lt_rank (by rw [Complex.rank_real_complex]; norm_num) 0
    have hT : IsPreconnected ((Set.univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℂ)) :=
      isPreconnected_univ.prod hC.isPreconnected
    have himg : (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => p.1 • e 0 + p.2.re • e 1 + p.2.im • e 2) ''
        ((Set.univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℂ)) = {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0)} := by
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_univ, true_and,
        Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.exists]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, ζ, hζ, rfl⟩ ⟨h1, h2⟩
        apply hζ
        simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] at h1 h2
        exact Complex.ext h1 h2
      · intro hz
        refine ⟨z 0, ⟨z 1, z 2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro h
          apply hz
          exact ⟨congrArg Complex.re h, congrArg Complex.im h⟩
        · ext i
          fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [← himg]
    exact hT.image _ (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop))
  
  have hopen : ∀ σ : ℝ, IsOpen {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)} := by
    intro σ
    have hcl : IsClosed {z : E3 | z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0} := by
      refine (isClosed_eq (f := fun z : E3 => z 1) (by fun_prop) continuous_const).inter
        ((isClosed_eq (f := fun z : E3 => z 2) (by fun_prop) continuous_const).inter
          (isClosed_le (f := fun z : E3 => σ * z 0) (by fun_prop) continuous_const))
    exact hcl.isOpen_compl
  have hinter : {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} ∩
      {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (-1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} = {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0)} := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ ⟨a, b⟩
      rcases le_total (z 0) 0 with h | h
      · exact h1 ⟨a, b, by linarith⟩
      · exact h2 ⟨a, b, by linarith⟩
    · intro h
      exact ⟨fun ⟨a, b, _⟩ => h ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b, _⟩ => h ⟨a, b⟩⟩
  have hliftX := hglue _ _ (hopen 1) (hopen (-1)) (by rw [hinter]; exact hD)
    (hpiece 1 one_ne_zero) (hpiece (-1) (by norm_num))
  
  have hXne : ∀ z : E3, z ∈ {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} ∪
      {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (-1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} → z ≠ 0 := by
    rintro z hz rfl
    rcases hz with h | h <;> exact h ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  have hneX : ∀ z : E3, z ≠ 0 → z ∈ {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} ∪
      {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (-1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} := by
    intro z hz
    by_contra hc
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_or, not_not] at hc
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, ⟨-, -, h4⟩⟩ := hc
    apply hz
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, PiLp.zero_apply]
      linarith
    · simpa using h1
    · simpa using h2
  
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
  have hnh : ∀ y : E3, r < ‖y‖ → ‖(1 - r / ‖y‖) • y‖ = ‖y‖ - r := by
    intro y hy
    have hy0 : 0 < ‖y‖ := by linarith
    have hpos : 0 < 1 - r / ‖y‖ := by rw [sub_pos, div_lt_one hy0]; exact hy
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos, sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hy0.ne', one_mul]
  have hng : ∀ z : E3, z ≠ 0 → ‖(1 + r / ‖z‖) • z‖ = ‖z‖ + r := by
    intro z hz
    have hz0 : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz
    have hpos : 0 < 1 + r / ‖z‖ := by positivity
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos, add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hz0.ne', one_mul]
  have hgh : ∀ y : E3, r < ‖y‖ →
      (1 + r / ‖(1 - r / ‖y‖) • y‖) • ((1 - r / ‖y‖) • y) = y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hnh y hy, smul_smul]
    have hy0 : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h1 : ‖y‖ - r ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have : (1 + r / (‖y‖ - r)) * (1 - r / ‖y‖) = 1 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [this, one_smul]
  
  have hsrc : ∀ y : E3, r < ‖y‖ → y ∈ Φ.Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.source := by
    intro y hy
    show y ∈ Φ.Φ.source
    rw [Φ.source_eq]
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
    linarith
  set X : Set E3 := {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} ∪
      {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (-1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} with hXdef
  set Y : Set M := Φ.Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} with hYdef
  set Ψ := Φ.Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph with hΨ
  have hgsrc : ∀ z : X, r < ‖(1 + r / ‖(z : E3)‖) • (z : E3)‖ := by
    intro z
    rw [hng _ (hXne _ z.2)]
    have := norm_nonneg (z : E3)
    have := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hXne _ z.2)
    linarith
  have hgcont : Continuous fun z : X => (1 + r / ‖(z : E3)‖) • (z : E3) := by
    refine Continuous.smul (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.div
      (continuous_norm.comp continuous_subtype_val) ?_)) continuous_subtype_val
    intro z
    exact norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hXne _ z.2)
  have hΦcont : ContinuousOn (Ψ : E3 → M) Ψ.source := Ψ.continuousOn
  let a : C(X, Y) := ⟨fun z => ⟨Ψ ((1 + r / ‖(z : E3)‖) • (z : E3)),
      ⟨_, hgsrc z, rfl⟩⟩,
    Continuous.subtype_mk (hΦcont.comp_continuous hgcont (fun z => hsrc _ (hgsrc z))) _⟩
  have hYt : ∀ x : Y, (x : M) ∈ Ψ.target := by
    rintro ⟨_, y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact Ψ.map_source (hsrc y hy)
  have hYs : ∀ x : Y, r < ‖Ψ.symm (x : M)‖ := by
    rintro ⟨_, y, hy, rfl⟩
    show r < ‖Ψ.symm (Ψ y)‖
    rw [Ψ.left_inv (hsrc y hy)]
    exact hy
  have hscont : Continuous fun x : Y => Ψ.symm (x : M) :=
    Ψ.continuousOn_symm.comp_continuous continuous_subtype_val hYt
  have hbmem : ∀ x : Y, (1 - r / ‖Ψ.symm (x : M)‖) • Ψ.symm (x : M) ∈ X := by
    intro x
    apply hneX
    intro h0
    have := hnh _ (hYs x)
    rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
    linarith [hYs x]
  let b : C(Y, X) := ⟨fun x => ⟨(1 - r / ‖Ψ.symm (x : M)‖) • Ψ.symm (x : M), hbmem x⟩,
    Continuous.subtype_mk (Continuous.smul (continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.div
      (continuous_norm.comp hscont) (fun x => ne_of_gt (hr0.trans (hYs x))))) hscont) _⟩
  have hab : ∀ x : Y, a (b x) = x := by
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    show Ψ ((1 + r / ‖(1 - r / ‖Ψ.symm (x : M)‖) • Ψ.symm (x : M)‖) •
      ((1 - r / ‖Ψ.symm (x : M)‖) • Ψ.symm (x : M))) = x
    rw [hgh _ (hYs x), Ψ.right_inv (hYt x)]
  intro θ
  obtain ⟨φX, hφX⟩ := hliftX (θ.comp a)
  refine ⟨φX.comp b, fun x => ?_⟩
  have h := hφX (b x)
  rw [ContinuousMap.comp_apply, hab x] at h
  exact h

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    [LocallyCompactSpace X] (U O : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hfr : frontier U ⊆ O) (hC : IsCompact (closure U \ O)) (θ : C(U, Circle)) (φO : X → ℝ)
    (hφc : ContinuousOn φO (U ∩ O))
    (hφe : ∀ x : U, (x : X) ∈ O → θ x = Circle.exp (φO x)) :
    ∃ (K : Set X) (Θ : C(X, Circle)) (ψ : C(U, ℝ)), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ U ∧
      (∀ x : X, x ∉ K → Θ x = 1) ∧ ∀ x : U, θ x = Θ (x : X) * Circle.exp (ψ x)

signature.name: circle_normalize_off_compact
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    [LocallyCompactSpace X] (U O : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hfr : frontier U ⊆ O) (hC : IsCompact (closure U \ O)) (θ : C(U, Circle)) (φO : X → ℝ)
    (hφc : ContinuousOn φO (U ∩ O))
    (hφe : ∀ x : U, (x : X) ∈ O → θ x = Circle.exp (φO x)) :
    ∃ (K : Set X) (Θ : C(X, Circle)) (ψ : C(U, ℝ)), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ U ∧
      (∀ x : X, x ∉ K → Θ x = 1) ∧ ∀ x : U, θ x = Θ (x : X) * Circle.exp (ψ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  haveI : RegularSpace X := inferInstance
  
  have hCU : closure U \ O ⊆ U := by
    rintro x ⟨hxc, hxO⟩
    rw [closure_eq_self_union_frontier] at hxc
    rcases hxc with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (hfr h) hxO
  
  obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀o, hCW₀, hW₀U, hW₀c⟩ := exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hC hU hCU
  obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁o, hW₀W₁, hW₁U, hW₁c⟩ :=
    exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hW₀c hU hW₀U
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ0, hχ1, -⟩ := exists_continuous_zero_one_of_isCompact hW₀c hW₁o.isClosed_compl
    (Set.disjoint_compl_right_iff_subset.mpr hW₀W₁)
  have hχ0' : ∀ x ∈ W₀, χ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have := hχ0 (subset_closure hx)
    simpa using this
  have hχ1' : ∀ x, x ∉ closure W₁ → χ x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have := hχ1 (show x ∈ W₁ᶜ from fun h => hx (subset_closure h))
    simpa using this
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : X → ℝ, g = fun x => if x ∈ O then χ x * φO x else 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgU : ContinuousOn g U := by
    have h1 : ContinuousOn g (U ∩ O) :=
      (χ.continuous.continuousOn.mul hφc).congr (fun x hx => by simp [hg, hx.2])
    have h2 : ContinuousOn g (U ∩ W₀) :=
      (continuousOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr (fun x hx => by
        by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
        · simp [hg, hxO, hχ0' x hx.2]
        · simp [hg, hxO])
    refine (h1.union_of_isOpen h2 (hU.inter hO) (hU.inter hW₀o)).mono ?_
    intro x hxU
    by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hxU, hxO⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hxU, hCW₀ ⟨subset_closure hxU, hxO⟩⟩
  let ψ : C(U, ℝ) := ⟨U.restrict g, continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict.mp hgU⟩
  have hψ : ∀ x : U, ψ x = g x := fun x => rfl
  
  let F : C(U, Circle) := ⟨fun x => θ x * Circle.exp (-ψ x),
    (map_continuous θ).mul ((map_continuous Circle.exp).comp (map_continuous ψ).neg)⟩
  have hFx : ∀ x : U, F x = θ x * Circle.exp (-ψ x) := fun x => rfl
  have hF : ∀ x : U, (x : X) ∉ closure W₁ → F x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hχ1' (x : X) hx
    have hxO : (x : X) ∈ O := by
      by_contra hxO
      have h0 := hχ0' x (hCW₀ ⟨subset_closure x.2, hxO⟩)
      rw [h1] at h0
      norm_num at h0
    have hψx : ψ x = φO x := by
      rw [hψ, hg]
      simp [hxO, h1]
    rw [hFx, hψx, hφe x hxO, ← Circle.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Circle.exp_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : X → Circle, G = fun x => if h : x ∈ U then F ⟨x, h⟩ else 1 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hG1 : ∀ x, x ∉ closure W₁ → G x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hG]
    simp only
    split_ifs with h
    · exact hF ⟨x, h⟩ hx
    · rfl
  have hGU : ∀ x : U, G x = F x := by
    intro x
    rw [hG]
    simp only
    rw [dif_pos x.2]
  have hGc : Continuous G := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hxU : x ∈ U
    · have hcU : ContinuousOn G U := by
        rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
        have hres : U.restrict G = F := by
          funext y
          exact hGU y
        rw [hres]
        exact F.continuous
      exact hcU.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hxU)
    · have hxL : x ∉ closure W₁ := fun h => hxU (hW₁U h)
      have hopen : IsOpen (closure W₁)ᶜ := isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
      have hev : G =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => 1 :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hxL) (fun y hy => hG1 y hy)
      exact (continuousAt_const).congr hev.symm
  refine ⟨closure W₁, ⟨G, hGc⟩, ψ, hW₁c, hW₁U, fun x hx => hG1 x hx, fun x => ?_⟩
  show θ x = G x * Circle.exp (ψ x)
  rw [hGU x, hFx, mul_assoc, ← Circle.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Circle.exp_zero, mul_one]

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] [SigmaCompactSpace M]
    (U K : Set M) (hU : IsOpen U) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (Θ : C(M, Circle))
    (hΘ : ∀ x : M, x ∉ K → Θ x = 1) :
    ∃ (K' : Set M) (Ψ : C(M, Circle)) (ψ : C(M, ℝ)), IsCompact K' ∧ K' ⊆ U ∧
      (∀ x : M, x ∉ K' → Ψ x = 1) ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) ∞ (fun x : M => (Ψ x : ℂ)) ∧
      ∀ x : M, Θ x = Ψ x * Circle.exp (ψ x)
