signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] [SigmaCompactSpace M]
    (U K : Set M) (hU : IsOpen U) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (Θ : C(M, Circle))
    (hΘ : ∀ x : M, x ∉ K → Θ x = 1) :
    ∃ (K' : Set M) (Ψ : C(M, Circle)) (ψ : C(M, ℝ)), IsCompact K' ∧ K' ⊆ U ∧
      (∀ x : M, x ∉ K' → Ψ x = 1) ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) ∞ (fun x : M => (Ψ x : ℂ)) ∧
      ∀ x : M, Θ x = Ψ x * Circle.exp (ψ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set θ : M → ℂ := fun x => (Θ x : ℂ) with hθdef
  have hθc : Continuous θ := continuous_subtype_val.comp Θ.continuous
  have hθ1 : ∀ x, x ∉ K → θ x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    simp [θ, hΘ x hx]
  
  obtain ⟨Fm, hFm⟩ := exists_contMDiffMap_forall_mem_convex_of_local (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ⊤)
    (t := fun x => if x ∈ K then Metric.ball (θ x) (1 / 2) else ({1} : Set ℂ))
    (fun x => by
      by_cases hx : x ∈ K
      · simp only [hx, if_true]; exact convex_ball _ _
      · simp only [hx, if_false]; exact convex_singleton _)
    (fun x => by
      by_cases hx : ‖θ x - 1‖ < 1 / 2
      · have hx' : θ x ∈ Metric.ball (1 : ℂ) (1 / 2) := by
          rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; exact hx
        refine ⟨θ ⁻¹' Metric.ball 1 (1 / 2),
          hθc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx'), fun _ => (1 : ℂ),
          contMDiffOn_const, ?_⟩
        · intro y hy
          by_cases hyK : y ∈ K
          · simp only [hyK, if_true, Metric.mem_ball]
            rw [dist_comm]; exact hy
          · simp only [hyK, if_false, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      · push_neg at hx
        refine ⟨θ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (θ x) (1 / 4),
          hθc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by norm_num)),
          fun _ => θ x, contMDiffOn_const, ?_⟩
        intro y hy
        have hy' : dist (θ y) (θ x) < 1 / 4 := hy
        have hyK : y ∈ K := by
          by_contra hyK
          have h1 := hθ1 y hyK
          rw [h1, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm] at hy'
          linarith
        simp only [hyK, if_true, Metric.mem_ball]
        rw [dist_comm]; linarith)
  set F : M → ℂ := fun x => Fm x with hFdef
  have hFs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) ∞ F := Fm.contMDiff
  have hFclose : ∀ x, ‖F x - θ x‖ < 1 / 2 := by
    intro x
    have h := hFm x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ K
    · simp only [hx, if_true, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at h
      exact h
    · simp only [hx, if_false, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
      show ‖Fm x - θ x‖ < 1 / 2
      rw [h, hθ1 x hx, sub_self, norm_zero]; norm_num
  have hF1 : ∀ x, x ∉ K → F x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have h := hFm x
    simp only [hx, if_false, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
    exact h
  have hθn : ∀ x, ‖θ x‖ = 1 := fun x => Circle.norm_coe (Θ x)
  
  have ha : ∀ x, |‖F x‖ - 1| < 1 / 2 := by
    intro x
    have h := abs_norm_sub_norm_le (F x) (θ x)
    rw [hθn x] at h
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h (hFclose x)
  have hapos : ∀ x, 0 < ‖F x‖ := by
    intro x
    have h := ha x
    rw [abs_lt] at h
    linarith [h.1]
  have hF0 : ∀ x, F x ≠ 0 := fun x => norm_pos_iff.mp (hapos x)
  set N : M → ℂ := fun x => ((‖F x‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * F x with hNdef
  have hNn : ∀ x, ‖N x‖ = 1 := by
    intro x
    simp only [N, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (hapos x))]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (hapos x).ne'
  have hNs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) ∞ N := by
    intro x
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℂ => ‖z‖⁻¹) (F x) :=
      (contDiffAt_norm ℝ (hF0 x)).inv (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hF0 x))
    have h2 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun p => ‖F p‖⁻¹) x :=
      h1.comp_contMDiffAt (hFs x)
    have h3 := h2.smul (hFs x)
    have heq : (fun p => ‖F p‖⁻¹ • F p) = N := by
      funext p
      simp only [N, Complex.real_smul]
    rw [heq] at h3
    exact h3
  have hNclose : ∀ x, ‖θ x - N x‖ < 1 := by
    intro x
    have hpos := hapos x
    have e1 : F x - N x = ((1 - ‖F x‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * F x := by
      simp only [N]; push_cast; ring
    have e2 : ‖F x - N x‖ = |‖F x‖ - 1| := by
      rw [e1, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← abs_of_pos hpos, ← abs_mul,
        abs_of_pos hpos]
      congr 1
      field_simp
    have e3 : |‖F x‖ - 1| ≤ ‖F x - θ x‖ := by
      have h := abs_norm_sub_norm_le (F x) (θ x)
      rwa [hθn x] at h
    calc ‖θ x - N x‖ = ‖(θ x - F x) + (F x - N x)‖ := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ ‖θ x - F x‖ + ‖F x - N x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖F x - θ x‖ + ‖F x - N x‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]
      _ < 1 := by rw [e2]; linarith [hFclose x]
  
  have hNmem : ∀ x, N x ∈ Submonoid.unitSphere ℂ := by
    intro x
    show N x ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
    exact hNn x
  let Ψ : C(M, Circle) := ⟨fun x => ⟨N x, hNmem x⟩, hNs.continuous.subtype_mk hNmem⟩
  have hΨcoe : ∀ x, ((Ψ x : Circle) : ℂ) = N x := fun x => rfl
  have hΨ1 : ∀ x, x ∉ K → Ψ x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    apply Circle.ext
    rw [hΨcoe, Circle.coe_one]
    simp only [N, hF1 x hx, norm_one, inv_one, Complex.ofReal_one, one_mul]
  
  let w : C(M, Circle) := ⟨fun x => Θ x * (Ψ x)⁻¹, Θ.continuous.mul Ψ.continuous.inv⟩
  have hwcoe : ∀ x, ((w x : Circle) : ℂ) = θ x * (N x)⁻¹ := by
    intro x
    show ((Θ x * (Ψ x)⁻¹ : Circle) : ℂ) = _
    rw [Circle.coe_mul, Circle.coe_inv, hΨcoe]
  have hwn : ∀ x, ‖((w x : Circle) : ℂ) - 1‖ < 1 := by
    intro x
    have hN0 : N x ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; have := hNn x; rw [h, norm_zero] at this; exact zero_ne_one this
    have e : θ x * (N x)⁻¹ - 1 = (θ x - N x) * (N x)⁻¹ := by
      field_simp
    rw [hwcoe, e, norm_mul, norm_inv, hNn x, inv_one, mul_one]
    exact hNclose x
  have hslit : ∀ x, ((w x : Circle) : ℂ) ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
    intro x
    apply Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr
    left
    have h1 := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (((w x : Circle) : ℂ) - 1)
    have h2 := hwn x
    rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re] at h1
    have h4 : |(((w x : Circle) : ℂ)).re - 1| < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2
    rw [abs_lt] at h4
    linarith [h4.1]
  let ψ : C(M, ℝ) := ⟨fun x => Complex.arg ((w x : Circle) : ℂ),
    Complex.continuousOn_arg.comp_continuous (continuous_subtype_val.comp w.continuous) hslit⟩
  have hψ : ∀ x, Circle.exp (ψ x) = w x := fun x => Circle.exp_arg (w x)
  refine ⟨K, Ψ, ψ, hK, hKU, hΨ1, hNs, fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [hψ x]
  show Θ x = Ψ x * (Θ x * (Ψ x)⁻¹)
  rw [mul_comm (Θ x), ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ R₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ R₀ ∧ ∀ w : M → ℝ, (∀ z : E3, 1 < ‖z‖ → w ((hAF.ends k).Φ z) = ‖z‖) →
      ∀ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv w ((hAF.ends k).Φ y)

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ R₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ R₀ ∧ ∀ w : M → ℝ, (∀ z : E3, 1 < ‖z‖ → w ((hAF.ends k).Φ z) = ‖z‖) →
      ∀ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv w ((hAF.ends k).Φ y)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hu : ∀ u : E3, u = ∑ d : Fin 3, u d • e d := by
    intro u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hcompo : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z → ∀ l d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z = (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) d := by
    intro ψ z hψ l d
    have hfun : (fun v => ψ v d) = (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ ψ := by
      funext v; simp
    rw [partialDeriv, hfun, fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj d).differentiableAt hψ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp
  have pd_comp : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ψ z) → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d F (ψ z) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z := by
    intro F ψ z hψ hF l
    have h1 : partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z = fderiv ℝ F (ψ z) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (F ∘ ψ) z (e l) = _
      rw [fderiv_comp z hF hψ]
      rfl
    rw [h1, hu (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)), map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcompo ψ z hψ]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d _
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  
  have hessLoc_congr : ∀ (G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u v : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      G =ᶠ[𝓝 y] G' → u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] v → ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G u i j y = hessLoc G' v i j y := by
    intro G G' u v y hG huv i j
    have hy0 : G y = G' y := hG.eq_of_nhds
    have hent : ∀ a b l, partialDeriv l (fun z => G z a b) y
        = partialDeriv l (fun z => G' z a b) y := by
      intro a b l
      have : (fun z => G z a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => G' z a b) :=
        hG.mono (fun z hz => by simp [hz])
      simp only [partialDeriv, this.fderiv_eq]
    have hchr : ∀ k i j, christoffel G k i j y = christoffel G' k i j y := by
      intro k i j
      simp only [christoffel, hy0, hent]
    have h1 : ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l u y = partialDeriv l v y := by
      intro l
      show fderiv ℝ u y (e l) = fderiv ℝ v y (e l)
      rw [huv.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j u) y = partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j v) y := by
      have hev : partialDeriv j u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] partialDeriv j v := by
        filter_upwards [huv.eventuallyEq_nhds] with z hz
        show fderiv ℝ u z (e j) = fderiv ℝ v z (e j)
        rw [hz.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j u) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j v) y (e i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [hessLoc, hchr, h1, h2]
  
  have alg : ∀ (A G' G : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (v' v : Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (H' H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, G i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * G' a b * A b j) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, v i = ∑ a : Fin 3, A a i * v' a) →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, H i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * A b j * H' a b) →
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * v i * v j =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G'⁻¹ i j * v' i * v' j) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * H i j =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G'⁻¹ i j * H' i j) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          G⁻¹ i a * v a * (G⁻¹ j b * v b) * H i j =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          G'⁻¹ i a * v' a * (G'⁻¹ j b * v' b) * H' i j) := by
    intro A G' G v' v H' H hA hG hv hH
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGt : G = Matrix.transpose A * G' * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hG]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hBA : Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A = 1 := by
      rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, hAB, Matrix.transpose_one]
    have hGinv : G⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * G'⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hKm : A * G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A = G'⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGinv]
      calc A * (A⁻¹ * G'⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹) * Matrix.transpose A
          = (A * A⁻¹) * G'⁻¹ * (Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A) := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = G'⁻¹ := by rw [hAB, hBA, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
    have hK : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A a i * G⁻¹ i j * A b j = G'⁻¹ a b := by
      intro a b
      have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hKm a) b
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h1
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination h1
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hK
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [hv, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination (v' 0 * v' 0) * hK 0 0 + (v' 0 * v' 1) * hK 0 1
        + (v' 0 * v' 2) * hK 0 2 + (v' 1 * v' 0) * hK 1 0 + (v' 1 * v' 1) * hK 1 1
        + (v' 1 * v' 2) * hK 1 2 + (v' 2 * v' 0) * hK 2 0 + (v' 2 * v' 1) * hK 2 1
        + (v' 2 * v' 2) * hK 2 2
    · simp only [hH, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination H' 0 0 * hK 0 0 + H' 0 1 * hK 0 1 + H' 0 2 * hK 0 2
        + H' 1 0 * hK 1 0 + H' 1 1 * hK 1 1 + H' 1 2 * hK 1 2
        + H' 2 0 * hK 2 0 + H' 2 1 * hK 2 1 + H' 2 2 * hK 2 2
    · have regroup : ∀ (X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y : Fin 3 → ℝ) (Z : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
              X i a * y a * (X j b * y b) * Z i j =
            ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
              (∑ a : Fin 3, X i a * y a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, X j b * y b) * Z i j := by
        intro X y Z
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      have regroup2 : ∀ (u : Fin 3 → ℝ) (B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
          (Z : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, u i * u j * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, B a i * B b j * Z a b) =
            ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
              (∑ i : Fin 3, B a i * u i) * (∑ j : Fin 3, B b j * u j) * Z a b := by
        intro u B Z
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      have hu3 : ∀ d : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, A d i * (∑ a : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i a * v a) =
          ∑ c : Fin 3, G'⁻¹ d c * v' c := by
        intro d
        simp only [hv, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        linear_combination v' 0 * hK d 0 + v' 1 * hK d 1 + v' 2 * hK d 2
      rw [regroup G⁻¹ v H, regroup G'⁻¹ v' H']
      simp only [hH]
      have h5 := regroup2 (fun i => ∑ a : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i a * v a) A H'
      beta_reduce at h5
      rw [h5]
      simp only [hu3]
  
  have transfer : ∀ (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M),
      IsOpen V → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V → ∀ x : E3, x ∈ Φ.source → Φ x ∈ V →
      g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ x) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) x := by
    intro Φ f V hV hf x hx hxV
    obtain ⟨hdetJ, hHess⟩ := hessLoc_chart_invariant g Φ f V hV hf x hx hxV
    have h2 : IsOpen (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w))
          (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source) := by
      have hΦ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ Φ.source := Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun
      refine ⟨hΦ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Φ.open_source
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).open_source, ?_⟩
      have hc : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 (Φ x))
          (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source := contMDiffOn_chart
      have hcomp := hc.comp (hΦ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun w hw => hw.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcomp
    have hxU : x ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source :=
      ⟨hx, mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x)⟩
    have hψd : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z := fun z hz =>
      (h2.2.contDiffAt (h2.1.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hM1 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z) := by
      intro z hz
      have hev : (Φ : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
          ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ∘ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w))) := by
        filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
        exact ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hw.2).symm
      rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp z
        (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 (Φ x))
          ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source hz.2)) (hψd z hz).mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
    have hM1' : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source, ∀ u : E3,
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))
            (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z u) := by
      intro z hz u
      rw [hM1 z hz]
      rfl
    
    have s1 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        g.coeff Φ z i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) z *
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) a b *
              partialDeriv j (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) b) z := by
      intro z hz i j
      have hq : (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) = Φ z :=
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hz.2
      have hgq : g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))) = g.g (Φ z) :=
        congrArg g.g hq
      obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
          D = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hΦD : ∀ u : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u =
          D (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z u) := by
        intro u
        rw [hM1' z hz u, hD]
        rfl
      have hcD : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) a b
          = g.g (Φ z) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
        intro a b
        rw [← hgq, hD]
        rfl
      have hJ : ∀ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (e k)
          = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) d) z • e d := by
        intro k
        rw [hu (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (e k))]
        simp only [hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)]
      simp only [hcD]
      show g.g (Φ z) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z (e j)) = _
      rw [hΦD, hΦD, hJ i, hJ j]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    
    have hUo : IsOpen (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source ∩ V)) :=
      Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Φ.open_source
        ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).open_source.inter hV)
    have hxU' : x ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source ∩ V) :=
      ⟨hx, mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x), hxV⟩
    have hWo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' V) :=
      (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hV
    have hmapsW : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source ∩ V),
        chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z) ∈ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' V := by
      intro z hz
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source hz.2.1, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) ∈ V
      rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hz.2.1]
      exact hz.2.2
    have huW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y))
        ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' V) := by
      have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm)
          ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' V) :=
        hf.comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hy.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) :=
      (huW.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds (hmapsW x hxU'))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hequ : (f ∘ Φ) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun w => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)))) := by
      filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hxU] with z hz
      show f (Φ z) = f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)))
      rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hz.2]
    have s7 : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (f ∘ Φ) x = ∑ a : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x *
          partialDeriv a (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) := by
      intro i
      have e0 : partialDeriv i (f ∘ Φ) x = partialDeriv i
          (fun w => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)))) x := by
        show fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) x (e i) = fderiv ℝ _ x (e i)
        rw [hequ.fderiv_eq]
      rw [e0]
      exact (pd_comp (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w))
        x (hψd x hxU) hfd i).trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => mul_comm _ _))
    obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩ := alg
      (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x)
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))) (g.coeff Φ x)
      (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))
      (fun i => partialDeriv i (f ∘ Φ) x)
      (fun a b => hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm)
        (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) a b (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))
      (fun i j => hessLoc (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) i j x)
      hdetJ (fun i j => s1 x hxU i j) s7 hHess
    beta_reduce at e1 e2 e3
    show levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm)
      (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) = _
    unfold levelMeanCurvCoord lapLoc
    rw [e1, e2, e3]
  
  have hq0 : 0 < hAF.q := lt_trans (by norm_num) hAF.q_gt
  have hsrc : (hAF.ends k).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends k).source_eq
  have hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro i j
    rw [← hsrc]
    exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g (hAF.ends k).Φ i j
  obtain ⟨R, C, hR1, hC0, hb⟩ :=
    metric_coeff_bounds (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) hAF.q hq0 hsmooth (hAF.decay k)
  have hdet : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ x).det :=
    fun x hx => (hb x hx).1
  have hDec : Dec1 (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) hAF.q R C := by
    intro x hx i j
    obtain ⟨_, hrest⟩ := hb x hx
    refine ⟨(hrest i j 0).1, fun l => ?_⟩
    have h1 := (hrest i j l).2.1
    calc |partialDeriv l (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y i j) x|
        = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y i j) x (e l)‖ := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; rfl
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y i j) x‖ * ‖e l‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y i j) x‖ := by
          simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
      _ ≤ _ := h1
  obtain ⟨Rb, _, hpos⟩ := coordSphere_levelMeanCurvCoord_pos (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) hAF.q R C
    hq0 hR1 hC0 hdet hDec
  refine ⟨max Rb 2, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro w hw y hy
  have hyRb : Rb < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hy
  have hy2 : (2 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hy
  have hysrc : y ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by
    rw [hsrc]
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
    linarith
  
  have hwsm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (hAF.ends k).Φ.target := by
    have hn : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) {z : E3 | z ≠ 0} := by
      intro z hz
      exact (contDiffAt_norm ℝ hz).contMDiffAt.contMDiffWithinAt
    have hinv : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (hAF.ends k).Φ.invFun
        (hAF.ends k).Φ.target :=
      (hAF.ends k).Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun
    have hsrcp : ∀ p ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.target, 1 < ‖(hAF.ends k).Φ.invFun p‖ := by
      intro p hp
      have h1 : (hAF.ends k).Φ.invFun p ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source :=
        (hAF.ends k).Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_target hp
      rw [hsrc] at h1
      exact h1
    have hcomp := hn.comp hinv (fun p hp => show (hAF.ends k).Φ.invFun p ≠ 0 from by
      intro h0
      have := hsrcp p hp
      rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
      linarith)
    refine hcomp.congr ?_
    intro p hp
    have hpq : (hAF.ends k).Φ ((hAF.ends k).Φ.invFun p) = p :=
      (hAF.ends k).Φ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hp
    show w p = ‖(hAF.ends k).Φ.invFun p‖
    calc w p = w ((hAF.ends k).Φ ((hAF.ends k).Φ.invFun p)) := by rw [hpq]
      _ = ‖(hAF.ends k).Φ.invFun p‖ := hw _ (hsrcp p hp)
  have hyt : (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.target :=
    (hAF.ends k).Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hysrc
  rw [transfer (hAF.ends k).Φ w (hAF.ends k).Φ.target (hAF.ends k).Φ.open_target hwsm y
    hysrc hyt]
  
  have hO : {z : E3 | 1 < ‖z‖} ∈ 𝓝 y :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds (show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ by linarith)
  have hloc : (w ∘ (hAF.ends k).Φ) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem hO (fun z hz => hw z hz)
  have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (w ∘ (hAF.ends k).Φ) y =
      partialDeriv i (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) y := by
    intro i
    show fderiv ℝ _ y (e i) = fderiv ℝ _ y (e i)
    rw [hloc.fderiv_eq]
  have hhs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (w ∘ (hAF.ends k).Φ) i j y =
      hessLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) i j y :=
    hessLoc_congr _ _ _ _ y (Filter.EventuallyEq.refl _ _) hloc
  have heq : levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (w ∘ (hAF.ends k).Φ) y =
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) y := by
    unfold levelMeanCurvCoord lapLoc
    simp only [hpd, hhs]
  rw [heq]
  exact hpos y hyRb

subgoal_signatures.name: metric_coeff_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R C : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
        |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_contDiffOn_source
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source

subgoal_signatures.name: coordSphere_levelMeanCurvCoord_pos
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q R C : ℝ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hdet : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det) (hdec : Dec1 G q R C) :
    ∃ Rb : ℝ, R ≤ Rb ∧ ∀ y : E3, Rb < ‖y‖ → 0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun z => ‖z‖) y

subgoal_signatures.name: hessLoc_chart_invariant
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) (hxV : Φ x ∈ V) :
    (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x).det ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) i j x =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x *
          partialDeriv j (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) b) x *
          hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) a b
            (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (U : Set M)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hρ : 2 ≤ ρ)
    (hfar : ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ U)
    (hcpt : IsCompact (closure U \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}))
    (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U)) (R₀ : ℝ) (hR₀ : 2 ≤ R₀)
    (hbar : ∀ w : M → ℝ, (∀ z : E3, 1 < ‖z‖ → w ((hAF.ends k).Φ z) = ‖z‖) →
      ∀ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv w ((hAF.ends k).Φ y))
    (Ψ : C(M, Circle)) (hΨs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) ∞ (fun x : M => (Ψ x : ℂ)))
    (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (hΨK : ∀ x : M, x ∉ K → Ψ x = 1)
    (hnl : ¬ ∃ φ : C(U, ℝ), ∀ x : U, Ψ (x : M) = Circle.exp (φ x)) :
    ∃ S : Set M, IsCompact S ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S ∧ S ⊆ U ∧ S.Nonempty

signature.name: minimal_dual_surface_exists
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (U : Set M)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hρ : 2 ≤ ρ)
    (hfar : ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ U)
    (hcpt : IsCompact (closure U \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}))
    (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U)) (R₀ : ℝ) (hR₀ : 2 ≤ R₀)
    (hbar : ∀ w : M → ℝ, (∀ z : E3, 1 < ‖z‖ → w ((hAF.ends k).Φ z) = ‖z‖) →
      ∀ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv w ((hAF.ends k).Φ y))
    (Ψ : C(M, Circle)) (hΨs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) ∞ (fun x : M => (Ψ x : ℂ)))
    (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (hΨK : ∀ x : M, x ∉ K → Ψ x = 1)
    (hnl : ¬ ∃ φ : C(U, ℝ), ∀ x : U, Ψ (x : M) = Circle.exp (φ x)) :
    ∃ S : Set M, IsCompact S ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S ∧ S ⊆ U ∧ S.Nonempty

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  
  
  have hsrc : (hAF.ends k).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends k).source_eq
  have hfaro : ∀ r : ℝ, 1 ≤ r → IsOpen ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖}) := by
    intro r hr
    have hsub : {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} ⊆ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hsrc]
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
      have : r < ‖y‖ := hy
      linarith
    exact (hAF.ends k).Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm) hsub
  have hinj : ∀ y y' : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → 1 < ‖y'‖ →
      (hAF.ends k).Φ y = (hAF.ends k).Φ y' → y = y' := by
    intro y y' hy hy' h
    have h1 : y ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by rw [hsrc]; exact hy
    have h2 : y' ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by rw [hsrc]; exact hy'
    exact (hAF.ends k).Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.injOn h1 h2 h
  have hann : ∀ a b : ℝ, 1 < a →
      IsCompact ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | a ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ b}) := by
    intro a b ha
    have hc : IsCompact {y : E3 | a ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ b} := by
      refine (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) b).of_isClosed_subset ?_ ?_
      · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
          (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)
      · intro y hy
        rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
        exact hy.2
    have hsub : {y : E3 | a ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ b} ⊆ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hsrc]
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
      linarith [hy.1]
    have hcont : ContinuousOn ((hAF.ends k).Φ : E3 → M) (hAF.ends k).Φ.source :=
      (hAF.ends k).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
    exact hc.image_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hsub)
  have hcfar_far : ∀ r r' : ℝ, r < r' →
      (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | r' ≤ ‖y‖} ⊆ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} := by
    rintro r r' h _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, lt_of_lt_of_le h hy, rfl⟩
  have hfar_cfar : ∀ r : ℝ,
      (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | r < ‖y‖} ⊆ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | r ≤ ‖y‖} := by
    rintro r _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, le_of_lt (show r < ‖y‖ from hy), rfl⟩
  have hcfar_mono : ∀ r r' : ℝ, r ≤ r' →
      (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | r' ≤ ‖y‖} ⊆ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | r ≤ ‖y‖} := by
    rintro r r' h _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, le_trans h hy, rfl⟩
  have hfrU : ∀ x : M, x ∈ frontier U → x ∉ U := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hUo.frontier_eq] at hx
    exact hx.2
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨K', φ₀, hK'c, hKK', hK'U, hlift, hφ₀0, hφ₀m, hfin₀⟩ :=
    dual_anchor_exists g U hUo Ψ hΨs K hK hKU hΨK
  have hΨK' : ∀ x : M, x ∉ K' → Ψ x = 1 := fun x hx => hΨK x (fun h => hx (hKK' h))
  obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀, hcl⟩ := endChart_far_isClosed g hAF k
  have hesc : ∃ ρK : ℝ, ∀ y : E3, ρK < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∉ K' := by
    choose ρf Nf hNf hescf using end_chart_escape g hAF k
    obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ := hK'c.elim_nhds_subcover Nf (fun x _ => hNf x)

def dualOmega (Ψ : M → ℂ) (p : M) (y : E3) (i : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  (Ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).re * partialDeriv i (fun z => (Ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)).im) y -
    (Ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).im * partialDeriv i (fun z => (Ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)).re) y


def dualVarG (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (om : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (v : E3 → ℝ)
    (U Kc : Set E3) : ENNReal :=
  (⨆ (_ : ¬ MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrableOn v U), (⊤ : ENNReal)) ⊔
  ⨆ (X : E3 → E3) (_ : (∀ y, y ∉ Kc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
      tsupport X ⊆ U ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C),
    ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, (v y * sepDensDiv G X y +
      Real.sqrt (G y).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, om y i * X y i))


def dualRiemVar (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Ψ : M → ℂ) (φ : M → ℝ) (U Kc : Set M) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin n → M) (W : Fin n → Set M)
    (_ : (∀ k, IsOpen (W k) ∧ W k ⊆ U ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) ∧
      Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (W k) (W l))),
    ∑ k, dualVarG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (dualOmega Ψ (p k))
      (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k)
      (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source))


def dualChartMeas (φ : M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ p : M, Measurable ((chartAt E3 p).target.indicator (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)))

by

    simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]

    rw [hd.fderiv]

        2 * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * (2 * y k) := by
    intro G y i j
    simp only [hessLoc, hpd1, hpd2]
  
  have hinvB : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (B : ℝ), (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ A.det →

    intro A B hdet hB
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hB 0 0)
    have hdpos : 0 < A.det := by linarith
    have hinvpos : 0 < (A.det)⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hdpos
    have hinv2 : (A.det)⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
      rw [inv_le_comm₀ hdpos (by norm_num)]
      linarith
    have aux : ∀ x y z w : ℝ, |x| ≤ B → |y| ≤ B → |z| ≤ B → |w| ≤ B →
        |x * y - z * w| ≤ 2 * B ^ 2 := by
      intro x y z w hx hy hz hw
      have h1 : |x * y| ≤ B * B := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) hB0
      have h2 : |z * w| ≤ B * B := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hz hw (abs_nonneg _) hB0
      have h1' := abs_le.mp h1
      have h2' := abs_le.mp h2
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> nlinarith [h1'.1, h1'.2, h2'.1, h2'.2]

      intro x y z w hx hy hz hw

    intro k l
    rw [hentry, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hinvpos]

    linarith

      fin_cases i <;> simp [h0, h1, h2]
    have hexp : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          v i * v j * (2 * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - K i j)
        = 2 * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2) - ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * K i j := by
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * K i j
        ≤ η * (|v 0| + |v 1| + |v 2|) ^ 2 := by
      have := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) =>
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => hb i j
      refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have ha : (|v 0| + |v 1| + |v 2|) ^ 2 ≤ 3 * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith [sq_abs (v 0), sq_abs (v 1), sq_abs (v 2), sq_nonneg (|v 0| - |v 1|),
        sq_nonneg (|v 1| - |v 2|), sq_nonneg (|v 0| - |v 2|)]
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha hη0
    have h4 := mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 - 3 * η) hS
    rw [hexp]
    nlinarith
  
  have hq0 : 0 < hAF.q := lt_trans (by norm_num) hAF.q_gt
  have hend : ∀ l : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ r : ℝ, 2 ≤ r ∧ ∀ y : E3, r < ‖y‖ →
      ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 →
        0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          v i * v j * hessLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ ^ 2) i j y := by
    intro l
    have hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
      intro i j
      rw [← (hAF.ends l).source_eq]
      exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g (hAF.ends l).Φ i j
    obtain ⟨R, C, hR1, hC0, hb⟩ :=
      metric_coeff_bounds (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) hAF.q hq0 hsmooth (hAF.decay l)
    have hT0 : 0 ≤ 162 * C * (1 + C) ^ 2 := by positivity
    refine ⟨max 2 (max R ((162 * C * (1 + C) ^ 2 + 1) ^ hAF.q⁻¹)), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
    intro y hy v hv
    have hr2 : 2 < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hy
    have hrR : R < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hy
    have hrT : (162 * C * (1 + C) ^ 2 + 1) ^ hAF.q⁻¹ < ‖y‖ :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) hy
    obtain ⟨hdet, hrest⟩ := hb y hrR
    have hr0 : 0 < ‖y‖ := by linarith
    have hrq : 162 * C * (1 + C) ^ 2 + 1 < ‖y‖ ^ hAF.q := by
      have h1 := Real.rpow_lt_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _) hrT hq0
      rwa [Real.rpow_inv_rpow (by linarith) hq0.ne'] at h1
    have hs0 : 0 < ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 _
    have hsr : ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q) * ‖y‖ ^ hAF.q = 1 := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg hr0.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 _).ne']
    have hs1 : ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hrs : ‖y‖ * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1) = ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hr0.ne']
      field_simp
    have hΓ := hchr (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) y (C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q)) (C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1))
      hdet (fun i j => (hrest i j 0).1) (fun i j => (hrest i j 0).2.1)
    have hα0 : 0 ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1) := mul_nonneg hC0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _)
    have hγ0 : 0 ≤ 18 * (1 + C) ^ 2 * (C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1)) := by positivity
    have hΓ' : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) k i j y|
        ≤ 18 * (1 + C) ^ 2 * (C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1)) := by
      intro k i j
      refine (hΓ k i j).trans ?_
      have hCs : C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q) ≤ C := mul_le_of_le_one_right hC0 hs1
      have hCs0 : 0 ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q) := mul_nonneg hC0 hs0.le
      have h1 : (1 + C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q)) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + C) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) (by linarith) 2
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 18)) hα0
    have hyk : ∀ k : Fin 3, |y k| ≤ ‖y‖ := fun k => by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le y k
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have hKb : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        |∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) k i j y * (2 * y k)|
          ≤ 6 * ‖y‖ * (18 * (1 + C) ^ 2 * (C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1))) := by
      intro i j
      have hterm : ∀ k : Fin 3,
          |christoffel (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) k i j y * (2 * y k)|
            ≤ 18 * (1 + C) ^ 2 * (C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1)) * (2 * ‖y‖) := by
        intro k
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
        exact mul_le_mul (hΓ' k i j) (by linarith [hyk k]) (by positivity) hγ0
      have hs : |∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) k i j y * (2 * y k)|
          ≤ 3 * (18 * (1 + C) ^ 2 * (C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1)) * (2 * ‖y‖)) := by
        refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
        refine (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hterm k).trans ?_
        simp
      linarith
    have hη : 3 * (6 * ‖y‖ * (18 * (1 + C) ^ 2 * (C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1)))) < 2 := by
      have e1 : 3 * (6 * ‖y‖ * (18 * (1 + C) ^ 2 * (C * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q - 1))))
          = 2 * (162 * C * (1 + C) ^ 2) * ‖y‖ ^ (-hAF.q) := by
        linear_combination (324 * (1 + C) ^ 2 * C) * hrs
      have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hrq hs0
      rw [e1]
      nlinarith
    have hpos := hquad
      (fun i j => ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) k i j y * (2 * y k))
      _ hKb hη v hv
    simp only [hhess]
    exact hpos
  
  choose rf hrf2 hrf using hend
  refine ⟨2 + ∑ l, rf l, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : 0 ≤ ∑ l, rf l := Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ => by linarith [hrf2 l]
    linarith
  · intro l y hy v hv
    have hle : rf l ≤ ∑ l', rf l' :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun l' _ => by linarith [hrf2 l']) (Finset.mem_univ l)
    have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ l', rf l' := Finset.sum_nonneg fun l' _ => by linarith [hrf2 l']
    exact hrf l y (by linarith) v hv

    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :

subgoal_signatures.name: metric_coeff_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R C : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
        |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (S : Set M) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : 1 < ‖y₀‖) (hy₀S : (hAF.ends l).Φ y₀ ∈ S) :
    ∃ y₁ : E3, ‖y₀‖ ≤ ‖y₁‖ ∧ (hAF.ends l).Φ y₁ ∈ S ∧
      ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends l).Φ y ∈ S → ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y₁‖

signature.name: far_max_point_exists
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (S : Set M) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : 1 < ‖y₀‖) (hy₀S : (hAF.ends l).Φ y₀ ∈ S) :
    ∃ y₁ : E3, ‖y₀‖ ≤ ‖y₁‖ ∧ (hAF.ends l).Φ y₁ ∈ S ∧
      ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends l).Φ y ∈ S → ‖y‖ ≤ ‖y₁‖

proof.tactics:
by
  have hsrc : (hAF.ends l).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends l).source_eq
  have hcont : ContinuousOn ((hAF.ends l).Φ : E3 → M) (hAF.ends l).Φ.source :=
    (hAF.ends l).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
  choose ρ N hN hesc using end_chart_escape g hAF l
  obtain ⟨t, -, htS⟩ := hS.elim_nhds_subcover N (fun p _ => hN p)
  set ρS : ℝ := ‖y₀‖ + ∑ p ∈ t, |ρ p| with hρS
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ p ∈ t, |ρ p| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun p _ => abs_nonneg _)
  have hy₀ρ : ‖y₀‖ ≤ ρS := by linarith
  have hbound : ∀ y : E3, (hAF.ends l).Φ y ∈ S → ‖y‖ ≤ ρS := by
    intro y hyS
    by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    have hmem := htS hyS
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hmem
    obtain ⟨p, hpt, hpN⟩ := hmem
    have h1 : ρ p ≤ |ρ p| := le_abs_self _
    have h2 : |ρ p| ≤ ∑ q ∈ t, |ρ q| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun q => |ρ q|) (fun q _ => abs_nonneg _) hpt
    have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖y₀‖ := norm_nonneg _
    exact hesc p y (by linarith) hpN
  set K : Set E3 := {y : E3 | ‖y₀‖ ≤ ‖y‖} ∩ {y : E3 | ‖y‖ ≤ ρS} with hKdef
  have hKc : IsClosed K :=
    (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
      (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)
  have hKsrc : K ⊆ (hAF.ends l).Φ.source := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hsrc]
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy₀ hy.1
  have hBc : IsClosed (K ∩ (hAF.ends l).Φ ⁻¹' S) :=
    ContinuousOn.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed (hcont.mono hKsrc) hKc hS.isClosed
  have hBsub : K ∩ (hAF.ends l).Φ ⁻¹' S ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) ρS := by
    intro y hy
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
    exact hy.1.2
  have hBcpt : IsCompact (K ∩ (hAF.ends l).Φ ⁻¹' S) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) ρS).of_isClosed_subset hBc hBsub
  have hy₀B : y₀ ∈ K ∩ (hAF.ends l).Φ ⁻¹' S :=
    ⟨⟨show ‖y₀‖ ≤ ‖y₀‖ from le_refl _, show ‖y₀‖ ≤ ρS from hy₀ρ⟩, hy₀S⟩
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁B, hmax⟩ := hBcpt.exists_isMaxOn ⟨y₀, hy₀B⟩ continuous_norm.continuousOn
  refine ⟨y₁, hy₁B.1.1, hy₁B.2, ?_⟩
  intro y _ hyS
  rcases le_or_gt ‖y₀‖ ‖y‖ with h | h
  · have hyB : y ∈ K ∩ (hAF.ends l).Φ ⁻¹' S := ⟨⟨h, hbound y hyS⟩, hyS⟩
    exact isMaxOn_iff.mp hmax y hyB
  · exact le_trans h.le hy₁B.1.1

subgoal_signatures.name: end_chart_escape
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∀ p : M, ∃ ρ : ℝ, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∉ N

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) (hxV : Φ x ∈ V) :
    (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x).det ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) i j x =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x *
          partialDeriv j (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) b) x *
          hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) a b
            (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))

signature.name: hessLoc_chart_invariant
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) (hxV : Φ x ∈ V) :
    (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x).det ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) i j x =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x *
          partialDeriv j (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) b) x *
          hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) a b
            (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hu : ∀ u : E3, u = ∑ d : Fin 3, u d • e d := by
    intro u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hcomp_e : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) a = v a := by
    intro v a
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  have hcompo : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z → ∀ l d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z = (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) d := by
    intro ψ z hψ l d
    have hfun : (fun v => ψ v d) = (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ ψ := by
      funext v; simp
    rw [partialDeriv, hfun, fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj d).differentiableAt hψ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp
  have dmul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z → DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => f w * g w) z := fun f g z hf hg => hf.mul hg
  have pd_mul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => f w * g w) z = partialDeriv l f z * g z + f z * partialDeriv l g z := by
    intro f g z l hf hg
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_mul hf hg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have pd_sum : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f a) z) →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, f a w) z = ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv l (f a) z := by
    intro f z l hf
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_sum (fun a _ => hf a), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have pd_comp : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ψ z) → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d F (ψ z) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z := by
    intro F ψ z hψ hF l
    have h1 : partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z = fderiv ℝ F (ψ z) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (F ∘ ψ) z (e l) = _
      rw [fderiv_comp z hF hψ]
      rfl
    rw [h1, hu (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)), map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcompo ψ z hψ]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d _
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  have hpdU : ∀ (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ i,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) U := by
    intro U hU f hf i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) U := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have pullback_partialDeriv : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U V : Set E3),
      IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → (∀ z ∈ U, ψ z ∈ V) →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) V) → ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ l i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv l (partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a)) z * G (ψ z) a b *
              partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z +
            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z *
              (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d (fun y => G y a b) (ψ z) *
                partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z) * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z +
            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z * G (ψ z) a b *
              partialDeriv l (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b)) z) := by
    intro ψ G U V hU hV hψ hmaps hG z hz l i j
    have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z :=
      (hψ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hJd : ∀ a k : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v a)) z := by
      intro a k
      exact ((hpdU U hU _ (contDiffOn_euclidean.mp hψ a) k).contDiffAt
        (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hGd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) (ψ z) := fun a b =>
      ((hG a b).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hmaps z hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hGψd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G (ψ w) a b) z :=
      fun a b => (hGd a b).comp z hψd
    have htd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w *
        G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z :=
      fun a b => dmul _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b)) (hJd b j)
    rw [pd_sum _ _ _ (fun a => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => htd a b))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [pd_sum _ _ _ (fun b => htd a b)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    rw [pd_mul _ _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b)) (hJd b j),
      pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b), pd_comp (fun y => G y a b) ψ z hψd (hGd a b) l]
    ring
  
  have christoffel_pullback_algebra : ∀ (A G Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (dG H dGt : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      A.det ≠ 0 → G.det ≠ 0 → (∀ a b, G a b = G b a) → (∀ c i j, H c i j = H c j i) →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * G a b * A b j) →
      (∀ l i j, dGt l i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (H a l i * G a b * A b j + A a i * (∑ d : Fin 3, dG d a b * A d l) * A b j
          + A a i * G a b * H b l j)) →
      ∀ c i j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ k l *
          (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c l *
          (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) * A a i * A b j + H c i j := by
    intro A G Gt dG H dGt hA hG hGs hH hGt hdGt c i j
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGu : IsUnit G.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hG
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * G * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGiG : G⁻¹ * G = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul G hGu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hα : A * Gt⁻¹ = G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAB, Matrix.one_mul]
    have hα' : ∀ l, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Gt⁻¹ k l = ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * A⁻¹ l b := by
      intro l
      have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hα c) l
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h1
      exact h1
    have hβ : ∀ l, dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j = ∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l *
        (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β)
          + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j) := by
      intro l
      rw [hdGt, hdGt, hdGt]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hH _ j i, hH _ l i, hH _ l j]
      simp only [hGs 1 0, hGs 2 0, hGs 2 1]
      ring
    have eAB : ∀ γ b : Fin 3, A γ 0 * A⁻¹ 0 b + A γ 1 * A⁻¹ 1 b + A γ 2 * A⁻¹ 2 b
        = if γ = b then 1 else 0 := by
      intro γ b
      rw [← Matrix.one_apply, ← hAB, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hcontr : ∀ (u W : Fin 3 → ℝ), ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, u b * A⁻¹ l b) *
        (∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l * W γ) = ∑ b : Fin 3, u b * W b := by
      intro u W
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination
        (u 0 * W 0) * (eAB 0 0).trans (if_pos rfl)
        + (u 1 * W 0) * (eAB 0 1).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 2 * W 0) * (eAB 0 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 0 * W 1) * (eAB 1 0).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 1 * W 1) * (eAB 1 1).trans (if_pos rfl)
        + (u 2 * W 1) * (eAB 1 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 0 * W 2) * (eAB 2 0).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 1 * W 2) * (eAB 2 1).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 2 * W 2) * (eAB 2 2).trans (if_pos rfl)
    have hGG : ∑ a : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * G a b) * H a i j = H c i j := by
      have h2 : ∀ a, ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * G a b = (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) c a := by
        intro a
        rw [← hGiG, Matrix.mul_apply]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => by rw [hGs a b])
      simp only [h2, Matrix.one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
        Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    calc ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ k l *
            (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j))
        = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Gt⁻¹ k l) *
            (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j) := by
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * A⁻¹ l b) * (∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l *
            (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β)
              + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j)) := by
          simp only [hα', hβ]
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b *
            (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β b + dG β α b - dG b α β)
              + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a b * H a i j) := by
          rw [hcontr (fun b => G⁻¹ c b) (fun γ => ∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3,
            A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β) + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j)]
      _ = _ := by
          rw [← hGG]
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
  
  have hess_algebra : ∀ (A : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Γt Γ H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (P : Fin 3 → ℝ) (Q : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ c i j, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Γt k i j =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b * A a i * A b j + H c i j) →
      ∀ i j : Fin 3, ((∑ d : Fin 3, (∑ e : Fin 3, Q e d * A e i) * A d j
          + ∑ d : Fin 3, P d * H d i j)
            - ∑ k : Fin 3, Γt k i j * (∑ d : Fin 3, P d * A d k)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * A b j * (Q a b - ∑ k : Fin 3, Γ k a b * P k) := by
    intro A Γt Γ H P Q hT1 i j
    have h0 := hT1 0 i j
    have h1 := hT1 1 i j
    have h2 := hT1 2 i j
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0 h1 h2 ⊢
    linear_combination (-(P 0)) * h0 + (-(P 1)) * h1 + (-(P 2)) * h2

    have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f z :=

        rw [one_add_one_eq_two]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero

        partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b f) z = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z (e a) (e b) := by
      intro a b
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e b)) z (e a) = _
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    rw [key2, key2, hsymm]
  
  have hessLoc_congr : ∀ (G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u v : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),

    intro G G' u v y hG huv i j
    have hy0 : G y = G' y := hG.eq_of_nhds
    have hent : ∀ a b l, partialDeriv l (fun z => G z a b) y

      intro l

        show fderiv ℝ u z (e j) = fderiv ℝ v z (e j)
        rw [hz.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j u) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j v) y (e i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [hessLoc, hchr, h1, h2]

        (fun d a b => partialDeriv d (fun y => G y a b) (ψ x))
        (fun c i j => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) x)
        (fun l i j => partialDeriv l (fun w => Gt w i j) x)
        hdetJ hdetG (fun a b => hGsym _ a b)

      intro a k
      exact ((hpdU U hUo _ (hψc a) k).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hxU)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hPd : ∀ d : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv d u) (ψ x) := fun d =>

    have hPψd : ∀ d : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv d u (ψ y)) x := fun d =>

      intro i j

      rw [e1, pd_sum _ _ _ (fun d => dmul _ _ _ (hPψd d) (hJd d j)), ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d _
      rw [pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hPψd d) (hJd d j),
        pd_comp (partialDeriv d u) ψ x (hψd x hxU) (hPd d) i]

      (fun e d => partialDeriv e (partialDeriv d u) (ψ x))

    rw [h7b i j]
    simp only [h7a]
    exact h8
