      rw [← hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv_coe (by simp)] at hu0
      exact (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv (by simp)).map_eq_zero_iff.mp hu0
    have hw : fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
      ext a
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul]
      have := congrFun hJv a
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
        hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)] at this
      simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        WithLp.ofLp_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [← this]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    have h0 : (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
      apply hinj
      rw [hM1' z hz, hw]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero _
    apply hv0
    funext a
    rw [← hcomp_e v a, h0]
    rfl
  
  have s4 : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy hdet
    obtain ⟨v, hv0, hGv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        D = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hid := (mdifferentiable_chart (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (Φ x)).comp_symm_deriv hy
    have hinj : ∀ u : E3, D u = 0 → u = 0 := by
      intro u hu0
      have h1 := DFunLike.congr_fun hid u
      have h' : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)) ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D u)
          = u := by
        rw [hD]
        exact h1
      rw [hu0] at h'
      rw [← h']
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero _
    have hcD : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y a b
        = g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
      intro a b
      rw [hD]
      rfl
    have hw0 : (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hv0
      funext a
      rw [← hcomp_e v a, h]
      rfl
    have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i))
      (fun h => hw0 (hinj _ h))
    have hG : ∀ a, ∑ b : Fin 3, g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) * v b = 0 := by
      intro a
      have := congrFun hGv a
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Pi.zero_apply, hcD] at this
      exact this
    have hzero : g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i))
        (D (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i)) = 0 := by
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      calc _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a * ∑ b : Fin 3,
            g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) * v b := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
        _ = 0 := by simp [hG]
    rw [hzero] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
  
  have hUo : IsOpen (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source ∩ V)) :=
    Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Φ.open_source
      ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).open_source.inter hV)
  have hxU' : x ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source ∩ V) :=
    ⟨hx, mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x), hxV⟩
  have hUsub : Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source ∩ V) ⊆
      Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source := fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, hz.2.1⟩
  have hWo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' V) :=
    (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hV
  have hmapsW : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source ∩ V),
      chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z) ∈ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' V := by
    intro z hz
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source hz.2.1, ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) ∈ V
    rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hz.2.1]
    exact hz.2.2
  have huW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' V) := by
    have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm)
        ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' V) :=
      hf.comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hy.2)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
  have hkey := key (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm)
    (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y))
    (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source ∩ V))
    ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' V)
    hUo hWo (h2.2.mono hUsub) hmapsW
    (fun a b => (g.smooth (Φ x) a b).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
    (fun y a b => g.symm _ _ _) huW hxU'
    (s4 _ ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source (mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x)))) (s3 x hxU)
  have heqG : g.coeff Φ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun w => Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun v => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ v) a) w *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) a b *
          partialDeriv j (fun v => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ v) b) w) := by
    filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hxU] with z hz
    ext i j
    exact s1 z hz i j
  have hequ : (f ∘ Φ) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun w => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)))) := by
    filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hxU] with z hz
    show f (Φ z) = f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)))
    rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hz.2]
  refine ⟨s3 x hxU, fun i j => ?_⟩
  exact (hessLoc_congr _ _ _ _ x heqG hequ i j).trans (hkey i j)

informal_problem.statement:
(F H : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (z₀ : E3)
    (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ U) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U) (hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H U) (hF0 : F z₀ = 0)
    (hdF : fderiv ℝ F z₀ ≠ 0) (hmax : ∀ z ∈ U, F z = 0 → H z ≤ H z₀) :
    ∃ μ : ℝ, ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k H z₀ = μ * partialDeriv k F z₀

signature.name: lagrange_point_multiplier
signature.statement:
(F H : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (z₀ : E3)
    (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ U) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U) (hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H U) (hF0 : F z₀ = 0)
    (hdF : fderiv ℝ F z₀ ≠ 0) (hmax : ∀ z ∈ U, F z = 0 → H z ≤ H z₀) :
    ∃ μ : ℝ, ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k H z₀ = μ * partialDeriv k F z₀

proof.tactics:
by
  have hUn : U ∈ 𝓝 z₀ := hU.mem_nhds hz₀
  have hinf : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hFs : HasStrictFDerivAt F (fderiv ℝ F z₀) z₀ := (hF.contDiffAt hUn).hasStrictFDerivAt hinf
  have hHs : HasStrictFDerivAt H (fderiv ℝ H z₀) z₀ := (hH.contDiffAt hUn).hasStrictFDerivAt hinf
  have hext : IsLocalExtrOn H {x | F x = F z₀} z₀ := by
    have hmaxf : IsMaxFilter H (𝓝[{x | F x = F z₀}] z₀) z₀ := by
      show ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝[{x | F x = F z₀}] z₀, H x ≤ H z₀
      filter_upwards [mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds hUn, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hxU hxs
      exact hmax x hxU (hxs.trans hF0)
    exact hmaxf.isExtr
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hlin⟩ := hext.exists_multipliers_of_hasStrictFDerivAt_1d hFs hHs
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hb0
    subst hb0
    have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro ha0
      subst ha0
      exact hab rfl
    rw [zero_smul, add_zero] at hlin
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hlin with h | h
    · exact ha h
    · exact hdF h
  refine ⟨-a / b, fun k => ?_⟩
  have hk := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e k)) hlin
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at hk
  show fderiv ℝ H z₀ (e k) = -a / b * fderiv ℝ F z₀ (e k)
  field_simp
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(F H : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (z₀ : E3)
    (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ U) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U) (hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H U) (hF0 : F z₀ = 0)
    (hdF : fderiv ℝ F z₀ ≠ 0) (hmax : ∀ z ∈ U, F z = 0 → H z ≤ H z₀) (μ : ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k H z₀ = μ * partialDeriv k F z₀) :
    ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k F z₀ * v k = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j *
        (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j H) z₀ - μ * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) z₀) ≤ 0

signature.name: constrained_second_order
signature.statement:
(F H : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (z₀ : E3)
    (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ U) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U) (hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H U) (hF0 : F z₀ = 0)
    (hdF : fderiv ℝ F z₀ ≠ 0) (hmax : ∀ z ∈ U, F z = 0 → H z ≤ H z₀) (μ : ℝ)
    (hμ : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k H z₀ = μ * partialDeriv k F z₀) :
    ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k F z₀ * v k = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j *
        (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j H) z₀ - μ * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) z₀) ≤ 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro v hv
  have hUz : U ∈ 𝓝 z₀ := hU.mem_nhds hz₀
  have hFd : ∀ y ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ F y := fun y hy =>
    (hF.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
  have hHd : ∀ y ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ H y := fun y hy =>
    (hH.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
  have hd2 : ∀ G : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G U → ∀ y ∈ U,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ G) y := by
    intro G hG y hy
    exact ((hG.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by decide)).differentiableAt
      (by simp)
  have hcontB : ∀ G : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G U →
      ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ G) y) U := by
    intro G hG
    exact (hG.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (m := 1) (by decide)).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl
  
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : E3, V = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k • e k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : E3 → ℝ, L = fun y => H y - μ * F y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hLs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L U := by
    rw [hLdef]; exact hH.sub (contDiffOn_const.mul hF)
  have hLd1 : ∀ y ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ L y := fun y hy =>
    (hLs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
  have hLd2 := hd2 L hLs
  
  have key2 : ∀ G : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G U → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j G) z₀ = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ G) z₀ (e i) (e j) := by
    intro G hG i j
    have hc := hd2 G hG z₀ hz₀
    have h1 : partialDeriv j G = fun y => fderiv ℝ G y (e j) := rfl
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j G) z₀ (e i) = _
    rw [h1, fderiv_clm_apply hc (differentiableAt_const (e j))]
    simp
  have quad : ∀ Bm : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      Bm V V = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * Bm (e i) (e j) := by
    intro Bm
    rw [hVdef]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hVker : fderiv ℝ F z₀ V = 0 := by
    rw [hVdef, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← hv]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  have hLder : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ L y = fderiv ℝ H y - μ • fderiv ℝ F y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hLdef]
    exact ((hHd y hy).hasFDerivAt.sub ((hFd y hy).hasFDerivAt.const_mul μ)).fderiv
  have hdL : fderiv ℝ L z₀ = 0 := by
    rw [hLder z₀ hz₀]
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun u => ?_
    have hu : u = ∑ d : Fin 3, u d • e d := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    rw [hu]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
    have := hμ d
    simp only [partialDeriv] at this
    rw [this]
    ring
  have hL2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ L) z₀ =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ H) z₀ - μ • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z₀ := by
    have hev : fderiv ℝ L =ᶠ[𝓝 z₀] fun y => fderiv ℝ H y - μ • fderiv ℝ F y :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hUz (fun y hy => hLder y hy)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact ((hd2 H hH z₀ hz₀).hasFDerivAt.sub
      ((hd2 F hF z₀ hz₀).hasFDerivAt.const_smul μ)).fderiv
  have hQ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j *
        (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j H) z₀ - μ * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) z₀) =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ L) z₀ V V := by
    rw [hL2, quad]
    simp only [key2 H hH, key2 F hF, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have htan : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t < δ ∧
      ∃ z ∈ U, F z = 0 ∧ ‖z - (z₀ + t • V)‖ ≤ ε * t := by
    intro ε hε δ hδ
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u, fderiv ℝ F z₀ u ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hdF (ContinuousLinearMap.ext hcon)
    obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : E3, fderiv ℝ F z₀ W = 1 :=
      ⟨(fderiv ℝ F z₀ u)⁻¹ • u, by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hu]⟩
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ β : ℝ, β = ‖W‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hβ0 : 0 ≤ β := hβ ▸ norm_nonneg _
    have hcW : ContinuousAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y W) z₀ :=
      ((hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).continuousAt hUz).clm_apply
        continuousAt_const
    have hevW : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z₀, y ∈ U ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) < fderiv ℝ F y W :=
      Filter.Eventually.and hUz
        (hcW.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (by show (1 / 2 : ℝ) < fderiv ℝ F z₀ W; rw [hW]; norm_num)))
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρp⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hevW
    have hgd : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (z₀ + s • V)) 0 0 := by
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt F (fderiv ℝ F z₀) (z₀ + (0 : ℝ) • V) := by
        simpa using (hFd z₀ hz₀).hasFDerivAt
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z₀ + s • V) V 0 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id' (0 : ℝ)).smul_const V).const_add z₀
      have h3 := h1.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) h2
      rw [hVker] at h3
      exact h3
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = ε / (2 * (β + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hc0 : 0 < c := by rw [hc]; exact div_pos hε (by linarith)
    have hcε : c * (2 * (β + 1)) = ε := by
      rw [hc]; field_simp
    have hlo := (hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero.mp hgd).def hc0
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ, σ = ρ / (2 * (β + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hσ0 : 0 < σ := by rw [hσ]; exact div_pos hρ (by linarith)
    have hσβ : σ * (2 * (β + 1)) = ρ := by
      rw [hσ]; field_simp
    have hev2 : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), s * ‖V‖ < ρ / 2 :=
      ContinuousAt.eventually_lt (f := fun s : ℝ => s * ‖V‖) (g := fun _ => ρ / 2)
        (by fun_prop) continuousAt_const (by show (0 : ℝ) * ‖V‖ < ρ / 2; rw [zero_mul]; linarith)
    have hev3 : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), 2 * c * s < σ :=
      ContinuousAt.eventually_lt (f := fun s : ℝ => 2 * c * s) (g := fun _ => σ)
        (by fun_prop) continuousAt_const (by show 2 * c * 0 < σ; rw [mul_zero]; exact hσ0)
    have hev4 : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), s < δ :=
      ContinuousAt.eventually_lt (f := fun s : ℝ => s) (g := fun _ => δ)
        continuousAt_id continuousAt_const hδ
    have hall : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ),
        (‖F (z₀ + (0 + s) • V) - F (z₀ + (0 : ℝ) • V) - s • (0 : ℝ)‖ ≤ c * ‖s‖ ∧
          s * ‖V‖ < ρ / 2 ∧ 2 * c * s < σ ∧ s < δ) ∧ 0 < s :=
      ((hlo.and (hev2.and (hev3.and hev4))).filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds).and
        self_mem_nhdsWithin
    obtain ⟨t, ⟨hlt, h2, h3, h4⟩, ht⟩ := hall.exists
    simp only [zero_add, zero_smul, add_zero, hF0, sub_zero, smul_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht] at hlt
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : E3, P = z₀ + t • V := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have ha : |F P| ≤ c * t := by rw [hP]; exact hlt
    have h2a : 2 * |F P| ≤ σ := by linarith
    have hball : ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ σ → P + s • W ∈ U ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) < fderiv ℝ F (P + s • W) W := by
      intro s hs
      apply hρp
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have hsβ : |s| * β ≤ σ * β := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs hβ0
      rw [mul_add, mul_one] at hσβ
      calc ‖P + s • W - z₀‖ = ‖t • V + s • W‖ := by rw [hP]; congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ ‖t • V‖ + ‖s • W‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = t * ‖V‖ + |s| * β := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht, hβ]
        _ < ρ := by nlinarith
    have hq : ∀ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ σ →
        HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (P + s • W)) (fderiv ℝ F (P + s • W) W) s := by
      intro s hs
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => P + s • W) W s := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id' s).smul_const W).const_add P
      exact (hFd _ (hball s hs).1).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hl
    have hmvt : ∀ s₁ s₂ : ℝ, -σ ≤ s₁ → s₁ < s₂ → s₂ ≤ σ →
        (s₂ - s₁) / 2 ≤ F (P + s₂ • W) - F (P + s₁ • W) := by
      intro s₁ s₂ h1 h12 h2
      have hin : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc s₁ s₂, |s| ≤ σ := fun s hs =>
        abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hs.1], by linarith [hs.2]⟩
      obtain ⟨c', hc', hc'eq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun s : ℝ => F (P + s • W))
        (fun s => fderiv ℝ F (P + s • W) W) h12
        (fun s hs => (hq s (hin s hs)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
        (fun s hs => hq s (hin s (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hs)))
      have hpos := (hball c' (hin c' (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hc'))).2
      dsimp only at hc'eq
      rw [hc'eq, lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith)] at hpos
      linarith
    have hroot : ∃ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ 2 * |F P| ∧ F (P + s • W) = 0 := by
      by_cases hz : F P = 0
      · exact ⟨0, by simp, by simpa using hz⟩
      · have ha0 : 0 < |F P| := abs_pos.mpr hz
        have hup := hmvt 0 (2 * |F P|) (by linarith) (by linarith) h2a
        have hdn := hmvt (-(2 * |F P|)) 0 (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at hup hdn
        have hle := le_abs_self (F P)
        have hge := neg_abs_le (F P)
        have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc ((fun s : ℝ => F (P + s • W)) (-(2 * |F P|)))
            ((fun s : ℝ => F (P + s • W)) (2 * |F P|)) := by
          show F (P + (-(2 * |F P|)) • W) ≤ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ F (P + (2 * |F P|) • W)
          constructor <;> linarith
        obtain ⟨s, hs, hs0⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (f := fun s : ℝ => F (P + s • W))
          (show -(2 * |F P|) ≤ 2 * |F P| by linarith)
          (fun s hs => (hq s (abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hs.1], by linarith [hs.2]⟩)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
          hmem
        exact ⟨s, abs_le.mpr ⟨hs.1, hs.2⟩, hs0⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hs0⟩ := hroot
    have hsσ : |s| ≤ σ := by linarith
    refine ⟨t, ht, h4, P + s • W, (hball s hsσ).1, hs0, ?_⟩
    rw [← hP, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← hβ]
    have hε' : ε * t = 2 * c * t * β + 2 * c * t := by rw [← hcε]; ring
    have hct : 0 < c * t := mul_pos hc0 ht
    calc |s| * β ≤ (2 * |F P|) * β := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs hβ0
      _ ≤ 2 * (c * t) * β := by nlinarith
      _ ≤ ε * t := by nlinarith
  
  rw [hQ]
  by_contra hneg
  have hpos : 0 < fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ L) z₀ V V := lt_of_not_ge hneg
  
  have hBc : ContinuousAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ L) y) z₀ := (hcontB L hLs).continuousAt hUz
  have hΨ : ContinuousAt (fun p : E3 × E3 => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ L) p.1 p.2 p.2) (z₀, V) := by
    have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun p : E3 × E3 => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ L) p.1) (z₀, V) :=
      ContinuousAt.comp (x := (z₀, V)) (f := Prod.fst) hBc continuousAt_fst
    exact (h1.clm_apply continuousAt_snd).clm_apply continuousAt_snd
  have hev : ∀ᶠ p : E3 × E3 in 𝓝 (z₀, V), p.1 ∈ U ∧ 0 < fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ L) p.1 p.2 p.2 :=
    (continuousAt_fst.eventually_mem hUz).and (hΨ.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hpos))
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηp⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hev
  have hηp' : ∀ y h : E3, ‖y - z₀‖ < η → ‖h - V‖ < η →
      y ∈ U ∧ 0 < fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ L) y h h := by
    intro y h hy hh
    have hd : dist (y, h) (z₀, V) < η := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]; exact max_lt hy hh
    exact hηp hd
  have hgrow : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < η / (2 * (‖V‖ + η)) → ∀ z : E3,
      ‖z - (z₀ + t • V)‖ ≤ η / 2 * t → L z₀ < L z := by
    intro t ht htδ z hz
    obtain ⟨h, hhdef⟩ : ∃ h : E3, h = t⁻¹ • (z - z₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hzh : z = z₀ + t • h := by
      rw [hhdef, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ ht.ne', one_smul]; abel
    have hhV : ‖h - V‖ ≤ η / 2 := by
      have e1 : h - V = t⁻¹ • (z - (z₀ + t • V)) := by
        simp only [hhdef, smul_sub, smul_add, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht.ne', one_smul]
        abel
      rw [e1, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_pos ht]
      calc t⁻¹ * ‖z - (z₀ + t • V)‖ ≤ t⁻¹ * (η / 2 * t) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz (inv_nonneg.mpr ht.le)
        _ = η / 2 := by field_simp
    have hhn : ‖h‖ ≤ ‖V‖ + η / 2 := by
      have := norm_sub_norm_le h V
      linarith
    have hpt : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t,
        z₀ + r • h ∈ U ∧ 0 < fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ L) (z₀ + r • h) h h := by
      intro r hr
      apply hηp'
      · rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr.1]
        have h1 : t * (2 * (‖V‖ + η)) < η :=
          (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp htδ
        have h2 : r * ‖h‖ ≤ t * (‖V‖ + η) :=
          mul_le_mul hr.2 (by linarith) (norm_nonneg _) ht.le
        nlinarith
      · linarith
    have hline : ∀ r : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => z₀ + r • h) h r := by
      intro r
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id' r).smul_const h).const_add z₀
    have hφ : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t,
        HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => L (z₀ + r • h)) (fderiv ℝ L (z₀ + r • h) h) r := by
      intro r hr
      exact (hLd1 _ (hpt r hr).1).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt r (hline r)
    have hφ₁ : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t,
        HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => fderiv ℝ L (z₀ + r • h) h)
          (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ L) (z₀ + r • h) h h) r := by
      intro r hr
      have h1 := (hLd2 _ (hpt r hr).1).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt r (hline r)
      have h2 := h1.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const r h)
      simpa using h2
    have hmv : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t, HasDerivAt f (f' r) r) →
        ∀ b : ℝ, 0 < b → b ≤ t → ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo 0 b, f' c = (f b - f 0) / (b - 0) := by
      intro f f' hf b hb hbt
      exact exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope f f' hb
        (fun r hr => (hf r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hbt⟩).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
        (fun r hr => hf r ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2.le.trans hbt⟩)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := hmv _ _ hφ t ht le_rfl
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hd'⟩ := hmv _ _ hφ₁ c hc.1 hc.2.le
    have hφ₂ := (hpt d ⟨hd.1.le, hd.2.le.trans hc.2.le⟩).2
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, sub_zero, hdL, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at hc' hd'
    rw [hd'] at hφ₂
    have h1' : 0 < fderiv ℝ L (z₀ + c • h) h := (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hc.1).mp hφ₂
    rw [hc'] at h1'
    have h3 := (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right ht).mp h1'
    have hLz : L z = L (z₀ + t • h) := congrArg L hzh
    linarith
  obtain ⟨t, ht0, htδ, z, hzU, hFz, hzc⟩ :=
    htan (η / 2) (by positivity) (η / (2 * (‖V‖ + η))) (by positivity)
  have hlt := hgrow t ht0 htδ z hzc
  have hle := hmax z hzU hFz
  rw [hLdef] at hlt
  simp only [hF0, hFz, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hlt
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(Gm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hG : Gm.PosDef)
    (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hξ : ξ ≠ 0) (A B D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (μ : ℝ)
    (hBAD : ∀ i j : Fin 3, B i j - μ * A i j = D i j)
    (hD : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * v k = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * D i j ≤ 0)
    (hB : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * B i j)
    (hH : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * A i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) -
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * ξ b) * A i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) ^ 3 = 0) :
    False

signature.name: levelset_trace_contradiction
signature.statement:
(Gm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hG : Gm.PosDef)
    (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hξ : ξ ≠ 0) (A B D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (μ : ℝ)
    (hBAD : ∀ i j : Fin 3, B i j - μ * A i j = D i j)
    (hD : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * v k = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * D i j ≤ 0)
    (hB : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * B i j)
    (hH : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * A i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) -
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * ξ b) * A i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) ^ 3 = 0) :
    False

proof.tactics:
by
  have hsym : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Gm j i = Gm i j := by
    intro i j
    have h := hG.isHermitian.apply i j
    simpa using h
  have hdet : IsUnit Gm.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hG.det_pos.ne'
  have hquad : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * Gm i j * v j := by
    intro v hv
    have h := hG.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
    convert h using 1
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hbsym : ∀ u v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, u i * Gm i j * v j =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * Gm i j * u j := by
    intro u v
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hsym 0 1, hsym 0 2, hsym 1 2]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i, n i = ∑ a : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a :=
    ⟨fun i => ∑ a : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a, fun i => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) = s :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hspos : 0 < s := by
    rw [← hs]
    have h := hG.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ
    convert h using 1
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hGn : ∀ i : Fin 3, Gm i 0 * n 0 + Gm i 1 * n 1 + Gm i 2 * n 2 = ξ i := by
    intro i
    have h : Gm.mulVec (Gm⁻¹.mulVec ξ) = ξ := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have h2 := congrFun h i
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h2
    simp only [hn, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    linarith
  have hbn : ∀ u : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, u i * Gm i j * n j =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * u k := by
    intro u
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    linear_combination u 0 * hGn 0 + u 1 * hGn 1 + u 2 * hGn 2
  have hnb : ∀ u : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, n i * Gm i j * u j =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * u k := by
    intro u
    rw [hbsym, hbn]
  have hnn : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, n i * Gm i j * n j = s := by
    rw [hbn, ← hs]
    simp only [hn, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨v1, hv1ne, hv1ξ⟩ : ∃ v1 : Fin 3 → ℝ, v1 ≠ 0 ∧ ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * v1 k = 0 := by
    by_cases h0 : ξ 0 = 0
    · refine ⟨![1, 0, 0], ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h
        have := congrFun h 0
        simp at this
      · simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, h0]
    · refine ⟨![-ξ 1, ξ 0, 0], ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h
        have := congrFun h 1
        simp at this
        exact h0 this
      · simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ j, w j = ∑ i : Fin 3, v1 i * Gm i j :=
    ⟨fun j => ∑ i : Fin 3, v1 i * Gm i j, fun j => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v2, hv20, hv21, hv22⟩ : ∃ v2 : Fin 3 → ℝ, v2 0 = ξ 1 * w 2 - ξ 2 * w 1 ∧
      v2 1 = ξ 2 * w 0 - ξ 0 * w 2 ∧ v2 2 = ξ 0 * w 1 - ξ 1 * w 0 :=
    ⟨![ξ 1 * w 2 - ξ 2 * w 1, ξ 2 * w 0 - ξ 0 * w 2, ξ 0 * w 1 - ξ 1 * w 0], rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hv2ξ : ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * v2 k = 0 := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hv20, hv21, hv22]
    ring
  have hw' : ∀ j, w j = v1 0 * Gm 0 j + v1 1 * Gm 1 j + v1 2 * Gm 2 j := by
    intro j
    rw [hw, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hb12 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v1 i * Gm i j * v2 j = 0 := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hv20, hv21, hv22, hw']
    ring
  have hb21 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v2 i * Gm i j * v1 j = 0 := by
    rw [hbsym, hb12]
  obtain ⟨a1, ha1⟩ : ∃ a1 : ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v1 i * Gm i j * v1 j = a1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha1pos : 0 < a1 := by rw [← ha1]; exact hquad v1 hv1ne
  have hv2ne : v2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have c0 : v2 0 = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
    have c1 : v2 1 = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
    have c2 : v2 2 = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
    have hvw : v1 0 * w 0 + v1 1 * w 1 + v1 2 * w 2 = a1 := by
      rw [← ha1, hw', hw', hw']
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hξ' : ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * v1 k = 0 := hv1ξ
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hξ'
    have e0 : ξ 0 * a1 = 0 := by
      rw [← hvw]
      linear_combination v1 1 * c2 - v1 2 * c1 + w 0 * hξ' - v1 1 * hv22 + v1 2 * hv21
    have e1 : ξ 1 * a1 = 0 := by
      rw [← hvw]
      linear_combination v1 2 * c0 - v1 0 * c2 + w 1 * hξ' - v1 2 * hv20 + v1 0 * hv22
    have e2 : ξ 2 * a1 = 0 := by
      rw [← hvw]
      linear_combination v1 0 * c1 - v1 1 * c0 + w 2 * hξ' - v1 0 * hv21 + v1 1 * hv20
    apply hξ
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp e0).resolve_right ha1pos.ne'
    · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp e1).resolve_right ha1pos.ne'
    · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp e2).resolve_right ha1pos.ne'
  obtain ⟨a2, ha2⟩ : ∃ a2 : ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v2 i * Gm i j * v2 j = a2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha2pos : 0 < a2 := by rw [← ha2]; exact hquad v2 hv2ne
  
  set vecs : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := ![v1, v2, n] with hvecs
  set d : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![a1, a2, s] with hd
  set E : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := Matrix.of fun i k => vecs k i with hE
  set F : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun k j => (∑ i : Fin 3, vecs k i * Gm i j) / d k with hF
  set W : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun i j => ∑ k : Fin 3, vecs k i * vecs k j / d k with hW
  have hFE_entry : ∀ k l : Fin 3, (F * E) k l =
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, vecs k i * Gm i j * vecs l j) / d k := by
    intro k l
    simp only [hF, hE, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hFE : F * E = 1 := by
    ext k l
    rw [hFE_entry]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;>
      simp [hvecs, hd, ha1, ha2, hb12, hb21, hnn, hbn, hnb, hv1ξ, hv2ξ,
        ha1pos.ne', ha2pos.ne', hspos.ne']
  have hEF : E * F = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hFE
  have hWG : W * Gm = 1 := by
    rw [← hEF]
    ext i j
    simp only [hF, hE, hW, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hinv : Gm⁻¹ = W := Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hWG
  have hframe : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j =
      v1 i * v1 j / a1 + v2 i * v2 j / a2 + n i * n j / s := by
    intro i j
    rw [hinv]
    simp [hW, hvecs, hd, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  
  have hY : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * ξ b) * A i j) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, n i * n j * A i j := by
    simp only [hn, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hX : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * A i j) =
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v1 i * v1 j * A i j) / a1 +
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v2 i * v2 j * A i j) / a2 +
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, n i * n j * A i j) / s := by
    simp only [hframe, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  rw [hY, hs, hX] at hH
  set Q1 := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v1 i * v1 j * A i j with hQ1
  set Q2 := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v2 i * v2 j * A i j with hQ2
  set Qn := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, n i * n j * A i j with hQn
  have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hspos
  have hr2 : Real.sqrt s ^ 2 = s := Real.sq_sqrt hspos.le
  have hsum : Q1 / a1 + Q2 / a2 = 0 := by
    have h1 : Q1 / a1 + Q2 / a2 = Real.sqrt s *
        ((Q1 / a1 + Q2 / a2 + Qn / s) / Real.sqrt s - Qn / Real.sqrt s ^ 3) := by
      set r := Real.sqrt s with hrdef
      clear_value r
      subst hr2
      have hrne : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [h1, hH, mul_zero]
  
  have hmuQ : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 → ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * v k = 0 →
      0 < μ * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * A i j := by
    intro v hv hvξ
    have h1 := hD v hvξ
    have h2 := hB v hv
    have h3 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * D i j =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * B i j -
          μ * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * A i j := by
      simp only [← hBAD, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    linarith
  have hm1 := hmuQ v1 hv1ne hv1ξ
  have hm2 := hmuQ v2 hv2ne hv2ξ
  have hp1 : 0 < μ * Q1 / a1 := div_pos hm1 ha1pos
  have hp2 : 0 < μ * Q2 / a2 := div_pos hm2 ha2pos
  have hfin : μ * (Q1 / a1 + Q2 / a2) = μ * Q1 / a1 + μ * Q2 / a2 := by ring
  rw [hsum, mul_zero] at hfin
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 2 ≤ R ∧ ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), R ≤ ‖y‖ →
      0 < levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) (fun z => ‖z‖) y

signature.name: far_spheres_mean_convex
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 2 ≤ R ∧ ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), R ≤ ‖y‖ →
      0 < levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) (fun z => ‖z‖) y

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hN : ∀ z : E3, z ≠ 0 → ∃ N' : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      HasFDerivAt (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖) N' z ∧ ∀ k : Fin 3, N' (e k) = z k / ‖z‖ := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖z‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz
    have h1 := (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq z).hasFDerivAt
    have h2 := h1.sqrt (pow_ne_zero 2 hz')
    have heq : (fun x : E3 => Real.sqrt (‖x‖ ^ 2)) = fun x => ‖x‖ :=
      funext fun x => Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg x)
    rw [heq] at h2
    refine ⟨_, h2, fun k => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg z)]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    field_simp
  have hpd1 : ∀ z : E3, z ≠ 0 → ∀ k : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv k (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖) z = z k / ‖z‖ := by
    intro z hz k
    obtain ⟨N', hN', hN'e⟩ := hN z hz
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [hN'.fderiv]
    exact hN'e k
  
  have hpd2 : ∀ y : E3, y ≠ 0 → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖)) y =
        (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) / ‖y‖ - y i * y j / ‖y‖ ^ 3 := by
    intro y hy i j
    have hy' : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hy
    obtain ⟨N', hN', hN'e⟩ := hN y hy
    have hev : partialDeriv j (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun z => z j * ‖z‖⁻¹ := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_ne_nhds hy] with z hz
      rw [hpd1 z hz j, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => z j) (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖⁻¹) ((-(‖y‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) • N') y :=
      (hasDerivAt_inv hy').comp_hasFDerivAt y hN'
    have hm : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => z j * ‖z‖⁻¹)
        (y j • ((-(‖y‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) • N') + ‖y‖⁻¹ • (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) y :=
      hc.mul hd
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hm.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hN'e i]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h
      simp
      field_simp
      try ring
    · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
      field_simp
      try ring
  
  have hsq1 : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ ^ 2) = fun z => 2 * z k := by
    intro k
    funext z
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [fderiv_norm_sq_apply]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
  have hsq2 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (y : E3),
      partialDeriv i (fun z : E3 => 2 * z j) y = 2 * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro i j y
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => 2 * z j)
        ((2 : ℝ) • (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) y :=
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := y)).const_mul 2
    rw [hd.fderiv]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h
      simp
    · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
  
  have hid : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y : E3), y ≠ 0 → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      hessLoc G (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ ^ 2) i j y - 2 * ‖y‖ * hessLoc G (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) i j y
        = 2 * partialDeriv i (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) y * partialDeriv j (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) y := by
    intro G y hy i j
    have hy' : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hy
    simp only [hessLoc, hsq1, hsq2, hpd2 y hy, hpd1 y hy, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hposdef : ∀ (Gm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (β : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (u : Fin 3 → E3),
      (∀ v w, β v w = β w v) → (∀ v, v ≠ 0 → 0 < β v v) →
      (∀ i j, Gm i j = β (u i) (u j)) → Gm.det ≠ 0 → Gm.PosDef := by
    intro Gm β u hsym hpos hGm hdet
    rw [Matrix.posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · ext i j
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, hGm]
      exact hsym _ _
    · intro v hv
      have hq : star v ⬝ᵥ Gm.mulVec v = β (v 0 • u 0 + v 1 • u 1 + v 2 • u 2)
          (v 0 • u 0 + v 1 • u 1 + v 2 • u 2) := by
        simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, hGm, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      rw [hq]
      by_cases hw0 : v 0 • u 0 + v 1 • u 1 + v 2 • u 2 = 0
      · exfalso
        apply hdet
        rw [← Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff]
        refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
        funext i
        have h0 : β (u i) (v 0 • u 0 + v 1 • u 1 + v 2 • u 2) = 0 := by
          rw [hw0]; exact map_zero _
        simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h0
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hGm, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.zero_apply]
        linear_combination h0
      · exact hpos _ hw0
  
  have hq0 : 0 < hAF.q := lt_trans (by norm_num) hAF.q_gt
  have hendpd : ∀ l : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ r : ℝ, 2 ≤ r ∧ ∀ y : E3, r ≤ ‖y‖ →
      (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ y).PosDef := by
    intro l
    have hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
      intro i j
      rw [← (hAF.ends l).source_eq]
      exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g (hAF.ends l).Φ i j
    obtain ⟨R, C, hR1, hC0, hb⟩ :=
      metric_coeff_bounds (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) hAF.q hq0 hsmooth (hAF.decay l)
    refine ⟨max 2 R + 1, by linarith [le_max_left 2 R], fun y hy => ?_⟩
    have hRy : R < ‖y‖ := by linarith [le_max_right 2 R]
    have hdet := (hb y hRy).1
    exact hposdef _ (g.g ((hAF.ends l).Φ y))
      (fun i => mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (hAF.ends l).Φ y (e i))
      (g.symm _) (g.posDef _) (fun i j => rfl) (ne_of_gt (by linarith))
  
  have hform : ∀ (Gm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), Gm.PosDef → ∀ (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ), ξ ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (A B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (μ : ℝ), 0 < μ →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, B i j - μ * A i j = 2 * ξ i * ξ j) →
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * B i j) →
      0 < (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * A i j) /
            Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) -
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * ξ b) * A i j) /
            Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) ^ 3 := by
    intro Gm hG ξ hξ A B μ hμ hBA hB
    have hsym : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Gm j i = Gm i j := by
      intro i j
      have h := hG.isHermitian.apply i j
      simpa using h
    have hdet : IsUnit Gm.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hG.det_pos.ne'
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) = s :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hspos : 0 < s := by
      rw [← hs]
      have h := hG.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ
      convert h using 1
      simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    
    have hS1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * Gm i j = 3 := by
      have h := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul Gm hdet
      have h00 := congrFun (congrFun h 0) 0
      have h11 := congrFun (congrFun h 1) 1
      have h22 := congrFun (congrFun h 2) 2
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at h00 h11 h22
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination h00 + h11 + h22 - Gm⁻¹ 0 1 * hsym 0 1 - Gm⁻¹ 0 2 * hsym 0 2
        - Gm⁻¹ 1 0 * hsym 1 0 - Gm⁻¹ 1 2 * hsym 1 2 - Gm⁻¹ 2 0 * hsym 2 0
        - Gm⁻¹ 2 1 * hsym 2 1
    
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i, n i = ∑ a : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a :=
      ⟨fun i => ∑ a : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a, fun i => rfl⟩
    have hGn : ∀ i : Fin 3, Gm i 0 * n 0 + Gm i 1 * n 1 + Gm i 2 * n 2 = ξ i := by
      intro i
      have h : Gm.mulVec (Gm⁻¹.mulVec ξ) = ξ := by
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec]
      have h2 := congrFun h i
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h2
      simp only [hn, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith
    have hS2 : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * ξ b) * Gm i j) = s := by
      rw [← hs]
      have e1 : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * ξ b) * Gm i j) =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, n i * (Gm i 0 * n 0 + Gm i 1 * n 1 + Gm i 2 * n 2) := by
        simp only [hn, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [e1]
      simp only [hGn]
      simp only [hn, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    obtain ⟨P1, hP1⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ, (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * A i j) = P := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨P2, hP2⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ, (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * ξ b) * A i j) = P := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [hP1, hP2, hs]
    obtain ⟨N, hNdef⟩ : ∃ N : ℝ, Real.sqrt s = N := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hN : 0 < N := hNdef ▸ Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hspos
    have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := hN.ne'
    have hN2 : N ^ 2 = s := hNdef ▸ Real.sq_sqrt hspos.le
    rw [hNdef]
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = -(P1 / N - P2 / N ^ 3) * N / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by
      rw [hc]
      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hcon) hN.le) (by norm_num)
    have hS1' : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * (A i j + c * Gm i j) = P1 + c * 3 := by
      rw [← hP1]
      have h := hS1
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h ⊢
      linear_combination c * h
    have hS2' : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * ξ b) * (A i j + c * Gm i j)) = P2 + c * s := by
      rw [← hP2]
      have h := hS2
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h ⊢
      linear_combination c * h
    have hH : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * (A i j + c * Gm i j)) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) -
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * ξ b) * (A i j + c * Gm i j)) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) ^ 3 = 0 := by
      rw [hS1', hS2', hs, hNdef, ← hN2, hc]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hD : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * v k = 0 →
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * (B i j - μ * (A i j + c * Gm i j)) ≤ 0 := by
      intro v hv
      have hQ : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * Gm i j := by
        by_cases hv0 : v = 0
        · subst hv0
          simp
        · have h := hG.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0
          have e2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * Gm i j = star v ⬝ᵥ Gm.mulVec v := by
            simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
            ring
          rw [e2]
          exact h.le
      have hB' : ∀ i j : Fin 3, B i j = 2 * ξ i * ξ j + μ * A i j := by
        intro i j
        linarith [hBA i j]
      have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * (B i j - μ * (A i j + c * Gm i j)) =
          2 * (∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * v k) ^ 2 - μ * c * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * Gm i j := by
        simp only [hB', Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [e1, hv]
      have := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hμ.le hc0) hQ
      nlinarith
    exact levelset_trace_contradiction Gm hG ξ hξ (fun i j => A i j + c * Gm i j) B
      (fun i j => B i j - μ * (A i j + c * Gm i j)) μ (fun i j => rfl) hD hB hH
  
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hBpos⟩ := far_hess_pos_end g hAF
  choose rf hrf2 hrf using hendpd
  refine ⟨max (r₀ + 1) (2 + ∑ l, rf l), by linarith [le_max_left (r₀ + 1) (2 + ∑ l, rf l)], ?_⟩
  intro l y hy
  have hy1 : r₀ + 1 ≤ ‖y‖ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hy
  have hy2 : 2 + ∑ l, rf l ≤ ‖y‖ := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hy
  have hle : rf l ≤ ∑ l', rf l' :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun l' _ => by linarith [hrf2 l']) (Finset.mem_univ l)
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ l', rf l' := Finset.sum_nonneg fun l' _ => by linarith [hrf2 l']
  have hpd := hrf l y (by linarith)
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, norm_zero] at hy1
    linarith
  have hy' : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hy0
  have hξ : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) y) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hy0
    ext k
    have h1 := congrFun h k
    simp only [hpd1 y hy0, Pi.zero_apply] at h1
    rcases div_eq_zero_iff.mp h1 with h2 | h2
    · simpa using h2
    · exact absurd h2 hy'
  have key := hform (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ y) hpd
    (fun k => partialDeriv k (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) y) hξ
    (fun i j => hessLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖) i j y)
    (fun i j => hessLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ ^ 2) i j y)
    (2 * ‖y‖) (by linarith) (fun i j => hid _ y hy0 i j) (hBpos l y (by linarith))
  exact key

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_contDiffOn_source
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source

subgoal_signatures.name: metric_coeff_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R C : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
        |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: far_hess_pos_end
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) :
    ∃ r₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ r₀ ∧ ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), r₀ < ‖y‖ →
      ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 →
        0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          v i * v j * hessLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ ^ 2) i j y

subgoal_signatures.name: levelset_trace_contradiction
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(Gm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hG : Gm.PosDef)
    (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hξ : ξ ≠ 0) (A B D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (μ : ℝ)
    (hBAD : ∀ i j : Fin 3, B i j - μ * A i j = D i j)
    (hD : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * v k = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * D i j ≤ 0)
    (hB : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * B i j)
    (hH : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * A i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) -
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Gm⁻¹ i a * ξ a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * ξ b) * A i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) ^ 3 = 0) :
    False

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (r₀ : ℝ)
    (hr₀ : 2 ≤ r₀)
    (havoid : ∀ S : Set M, IsCompact S → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S →
      ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), r₀ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends l).Φ y ∉ S)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : r₀ + 1 < R)
    (hbar : ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), R ≤ ‖y‖ →
      0 < levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) (fun z => ‖z‖) y)
    (S : ℕ → Set M) (hS : ∀ n, IsCompact (S n) ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (S n)) :
    ∃ (Z : Set M) (J : ℕ) (pts : Fin J → M) (ρ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (Λ : ℕ → ℝ),
      IsCompact Z ∧ 0 < ρ ∧
      (∀ j, Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (10 * ρ) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (pts j)).target) ∧
      Z ⊆ (⋃ j, (chartAt E3 (pts j)).source ∩
        chartAt E3 (pts j) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) ρ) ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hpadd : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x y : E3),
      coordPlaneProj a (x + y) = coordPlaneProj a x + coordPlaneProj a y := by
    intro a x y
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, add_smul]
    abel
  have hpsmul : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (r : ℝ) (x : E3),
      coordPlaneProj a (r • x) = r • coordPlaneProj a x := by
    intro a r x
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_sub, mul_smul]
  have hplin : ∀ a : Fin 3, IsLinearMap ℝ (coordPlaneProj a) :=
    fun a => ⟨hpadd a, hpsmul a⟩
  have hpsub : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x y : E3),
      coordPlaneProj a (x - y) = coordPlaneProj a x - coordPlaneProj a y :=
    fun a x y => (IsLinearMap.mk' _ (hplin a)).map_sub x y
  have hpcd : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (coordPlaneProj a) := by
    intro a
    exact (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (IsLinearMap.mk' _ (hplin a))).contDiff
  have hpcont : ∀ a : Fin 3, Continuous (coordPlaneProj a) := fun a => (hpcd a).continuous
  have hpre : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (z : E3), coordPlaneProj a z + (z a) • e a = z := by
    intro a z
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, sub_add_cancel]
  have hple : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (v : E3), ‖coordPlaneProj a v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by
    intro a v
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, e,
      EuclideanSpace.single_apply, smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    fin_cases a <;> simp <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0), sq_nonneg (v 1), sq_nonneg (v 2)]
  have hcoord : ∀ a : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z : E3 => z a) := fun a => by fun_prop
  
  have hF3 : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (c z : E3), z ∈ Metric.ball c ρ →
      ‖coordPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ < 2 * ρ := by
    intro a c z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
    linarith [hple a (z - c)]
  have hdisc_open : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (c : E3),
      IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ < 2 * ρ} := by
    intro a c
    exact isOpen_lt ((hpcont a).comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm continuous_const
  have hdisc_conv : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (c : E3),
      Convex ℝ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ < 2 * ρ} := by
    intro a c
    have hset : {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ < 2 * ρ} =
        coordPlaneProj a ⁻¹' Metric.ball (coordPlaneProj a c) (2 * ρ) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hpsub]
    rw [hset]
    exact (convex_ball _ _).is_linear_preimage (hplin a)
  
  have hS2 : ∀ m j, MinimalSheetsNear g (pts j) ρ L Λ (Sig m) := fun m j => (hSig m).2 j
  unfold MinimalSheetsNear at hS2
  choose a l u hlL hsm hbd hord hsh hcv using hS2
  
  obtain ⟨ut, hut⟩ : ∃ ut : ℕ → Fin J → ℕ → E3 → ℝ, ∀ m j i,
      ut m j i = if h : i < l m j then u m j ⟨i, h⟩ else fun _ => 0 :=
    ⟨fun m j i => if h : i < l m j then u m j ⟨i, h⟩ else fun _ => 0, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hut_sm : ∀ m j i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ut m j i) := by
    intro m j i
    rw [hut]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact hsm m j _
    · exact contDiff_const
  have hut_bd : ∀ m j i (n : ℕ) (y : E3),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (ut m j i) y‖ ≤ max (Λ n) 0 := by
    intro m j i n y
    rw [hut]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact le_trans (hbd m j _ n y) (le_max_left _ _)
    · rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_fun]
      simp
  
  obtain ⟨ψ₁, hψ₁, ah, lh, hlhL, ha, hl⟩ : ∃ ψ₁ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ₁ ∧
      ∃ (ah : Fin J → Fin 3) (lh : Fin J → ℕ), (∀ j, lh j ≤ L) ∧
        (∀ N j, a (ψ₁ N) j = ah j) ∧ (∀ N j, l (ψ₁ N) j = lh j) := by
    let Fm : ℕ → (Fin J → Fin 3 × Fin (L + 1)) :=
      fun m j => (a m j, ⟨l m j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hlL m j)⟩)
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Finite.exists_infinite_fiber Fm
    have hfreq : ∃ᶠ m in atTop, Fm m = y := by
      rw [Nat.frequently_atTop_iff_infinite]
      exact Set.infinite_coe_iff.mp hy
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφy⟩ := Filter.extraction_of_frequently_atTop hfreq
    refine ⟨φ, hφ, fun j => (y j).1, fun j => (y j).2.val,
      fun j => Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (y j).2.isLt, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro N j
      have h := congrFun (hφy N) j
      show a (φ N) j = (y j).1
      rw [← h]
    · intro N j
      have h := congrFun (hφy N) j
      show l (φ N) j = (y j).2.val
      rw [← h]
  
  obtain ⟨ψ₂, F, hψ₂, hFsm, hconv0, hconvD⟩ :=
    smooth_arzela_ascoli_family (ι := Fin J × Fin L)
      (fun N ji => ut (ψ₁ N) ji.1 ji.2.val) (fun n => max (Λ n) 0)
      (fun N ji => hut_sm _ _ _) (fun N ji n y => hut_bd _ _ _ n y)
  have hidx : ∀ j (i : Fin (lh j)), i.val < L := fun j i => lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt (hlhL j)
  obtain ⟨Uf, hUf⟩ : ∃ Uf : (j : Fin J) → Fin (lh j) → E3 → ℝ,
      ∀ j (i : Fin (lh j)), Uf j i = F (j, ⟨i.val, hidx j i⟩) :=
    ⟨fun j i => F (j, ⟨i.val, hidx j i⟩), fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hUsm : ∀ j i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Uf j i) := fun j i => by rw [hUf]; exact hFsm _
  have hUc0 : ∀ j (i : Fin (lh j)) (y : E3),
      Tendsto (fun N => ut (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N)) j i.val y) atTop (𝓝 (Uf j i y)) := by
    intro j i y
    rw [hUf]
    exact hconv0 (j, ⟨i.val, hidx j i⟩) y
  have hUcD : ∀ j (i : Fin (lh j)) (n : ℕ) (y : E3),
      Tendsto (fun N => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (ut (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N)) j i.val) y) atTop
        (𝓝 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (Uf j i) y)) := by
    intro j i n y
    rw [hUf]
    exact hconvD (j, ⟨i.val, hidx j i⟩) n y
  
  have hlt : ∀ N j (i : Fin (lh j)), i.val < l (ψ₁ N) j := fun N j i => by
    rw [hl]; exact i.isLt
  have hut_eq : ∀ N j (i : Fin (lh j)),
      ut (ψ₁ N) j i.val = u (ψ₁ N) j ⟨i.val, hlt N j i⟩ := by
    intro N j i
    rw [hut, dif_pos (hlt N j i)]
  have hwo : ∀ N j (i i' : Fin (lh j)), i < i' → ∀ y : E3,
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ →
      ut (ψ₁ N) j i.val (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) <
        ut (ψ₁ N) j i'.val (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) := by
    intro N j i i' hii y hy
    rw [hut_eq, hut_eq]
    have h := hord (ψ₁ N) j ⟨i.val, hlt N j i⟩ ⟨i'.val, hlt N j i'⟩ (Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr hii) y
    rw [ha] at h
    exact h hy
  have hws : ∀ N j (i : Fin (lh j)) (y : E3),
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ →
      |ut (ψ₁ N) j i.val (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) - (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ah j)|
          < 8 * ρ ∧
      (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y +
        ut (ψ₁ N) j i.val (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) • e (ah j)) ∈ Sig (ψ₁ N) ∧
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm)
        (fun z => z (ah j) - ut (ψ₁ N) j i.val (coordPlaneProj (ah j) z))
        (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y + ut (ψ₁ N) j i.val (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) • e (ah j))
          = 0 := by
    intro N j i y hy
    rw [hut_eq]
    have h := hsh (ψ₁ N) j ⟨i.val, hlt N j i⟩ y
    rw [ha] at h
    exact h hy
  have hwc : ∀ N j, ∀ x ∈ Sig (ψ₁ N), x ∈ (chartAt E3 (pts j)).source →
      chartAt E3 (pts j) x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) ρ →
      ∃ i : Fin (lh j), (chartAt E3 (pts j) x) (ah j) =
        ut (ψ₁ N) j i.val (coordPlaneProj (ah j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) x)) := by
    intro N j x hx hs hb
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcv (ψ₁ N) j x hx hs hb
    rw [ha] at hi
    have hi' : i.val < lh j := by rw [← hl N j]; exact i.isLt
    refine ⟨⟨i.val, hi'⟩, ?_⟩
    show _ = ut (ψ₁ N) j i.val _
    rw [hut, dif_pos i.isLt]
    exact hi
  
  have hUslab : ∀ j (i : Fin (lh j)) (y : E3),
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ →
      |Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) - (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ah j)| ≤ 8 * ρ := by
    intro j i y hy
    have ht := ((hUc0 j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y)).sub_const
      ((chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ah j))).abs
    exact le_of_tendsto' ht (fun N => (hws (ψ₂ N) j i y hy).1.le)
  have hUord : ∀ j (i i' : Fin (lh j)), i < i' → ∀ y : E3,
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ →
      Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) ≤ Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) := by
    intro j i i' hii y hy
    exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' (hUc0 j i _) (hUc0 j i' _)
      (fun N => (hwo (ψ₂ N) j i i' hii y hy).le)
  
  have hUmse : ∀ j (i : Fin (lh j)) (y : E3),
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm)
        (fun z => z (ah j) - Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) z))
        (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y + Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) • e (ah j)) = 0 := by
    intro j i
    exact mse_graph_limit g (pts j) (ah j) ρ hρ (hball j)
      (fun k => ut (ψ₁ (ψ₂ k)) j i.val) (Uf j i) (fun k => hut_sm _ _ _) (hUsm j i)
      (fun n _ y => hUcD j i n y)
      (fun k y hy => ⟨(hws (ψ₂ k) j i y hy).1, (hws (ψ₂ k) j i y hy).2.2⟩)
  
  have hcoinc : ∀ j (i i' : Fin (lh j)), i < i' → ∀ y₀ : E3,
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y₀ - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ →
      Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y₀) = Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y₀) →
      ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ →
      Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) = Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) := by
    intro j i i' hii y₀ hy₀ heq y hy
    have hloc := minimal_graph_difference_elliptic g (pts j) (ah j) ρ hρ (hball j)
      (Uf j i) (Uf j i') (hUsm j i) (hUsm j i') (hUslab j i) (hUslab j i')
      (hUmse j i) (hUmse j i') (hUord j i i' hii)
    have hw2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y' => Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y') -
        Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y')) :=
      (((hUsm j i').comp (hpcd (ah j))).sub ((hUsm j i).comp (hpcd (ah j)))).of_le
        (by norm_cast)
    have h := hopf_strong_min_principle
      {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ}
      (hdisc_open _ _) (hdisc_conv _ _).isPreconnected _ hw2
      (fun y hy => sub_nonneg.mpr (hUord j i i' hii y hy)) hloc y₀ hy₀
      (by simp only [heq, sub_self]) y hy
    have h' : Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) - Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) = 0 := h
    linarith
  have hsame : ∀ j (i i' : Fin (lh j)) (y₀ : E3),
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y₀ - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ →
      Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y₀) = Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y₀) →
      ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ →
      Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) = Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) := by
    intro j i i' y₀ hy₀ heq y hy
    rcases lt_trichotomy i i' with hii | hii | hii
    · exact hcoinc j i i' hii y₀ hy₀ heq y hy
    · rw [hii]
    · exact (hcoinc j i' i hii y₀ hy₀ heq.symm y hy).symm
  
  obtain ⟨Sinf, hSinf⟩ : ∃ Sinf : Set M, Sinf =
      {q : M | ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 q, ∃ᶠ N in atTop, ¬ Disjoint O (Sig (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N)))} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemS : ∀ q, q ∈ Sinf ↔ ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 q, ∃ᶠ N in atTop, ¬ Disjoint O (Sig (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N))) := by
    intro q
    rw [hSinf]
    rfl
  have hKur : ∀ q : M, q ∉ Sinf →
      ∃ O ∈ 𝓝 q, ∀ᶠ N in atTop, Disjoint O (Sig (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N))) := by
    intro q hq
    have h : ¬ ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 q, ∃ᶠ N in atTop, ¬ Disjoint O (Sig (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N))) :=
      fun h => hq ((hmemS q).mpr h)
    simp only [not_forall, Filter.not_frequently, not_not] at h
    obtain ⟨O, hO, h⟩ := h
    exact ⟨O, hO, h⟩
  have hclosed : IsClosed Sinf := by
    rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨O, hO, h⟩ := hKur q hq
    obtain ⟨O', hO'O, hO'o, hqO'⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hO
    refine Filter.mem_of_superset (hO'o.mem_nhds hqO') ?_
    intro q' hq'
    rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, hmemS]
    intro hq'S
    have hf := hq'S O' (hO'o.mem_nhds hq')
    exact (Filter.not_frequently.mpr
      (h.mono fun N hN => not_not.mpr (hN.mono_left hO'O))) hf
  have hSZ : Sinf ⊆ Z := by
    intro q hq
    by_contra hqZ
    rw [hmemS] at hq
    have hf := hq Zᶜ (hZ.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hqZ)
    exact (Filter.not_frequently.mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N =>
      not_not.mpr (Disjoint.mono_right (hSig _).1 disjoint_compl_left))) hf
  have hcpt : IsCompact Sinf := hZ.of_isClosed_subset hclosed hSZ
  
  have hmin : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sinf := by
    refine ⟨hclosed, ?_⟩
    intro p hp O hO
    obtain ⟨j, hpj, hzj⟩ : ∃ j, p ∈ (chartAt E3 (pts j)).source ∧
        chartAt E3 (pts j) p ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) ρ := by
      have h := hcov (hSZ hp)
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at h
      obtain ⟨j, h1, h2⟩ := h
      exact ⟨j, h1, h2⟩
    have hballj : Metric.ball (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) ρ ⊆ (chartAt E3 (pts j)).target :=
      Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans
        ((Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)).trans (hball j))
    have hlim := limsup_sheets_local (chartAt E3 (pts j)) (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ah j)
      ρ hρ hballj (lh j) (fun N => Sig (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N))) (fun N i => ut (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N)) j i.val) (Uf j)
      (max (Λ 1) 0) (fun N i => hut_sm _ _ _) (fun N i y => hut_bd _ _ _ 1 y)
      (fun i y => hUc0 j i y) (fun N i y hy => (hws (ψ₂ N) j i y hy).2.1)
      (fun N x hx hs hb => hwc (ψ₂ N) j x hx hs hb)
    have hlim' : ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 (pts j)).source,
        chartAt E3 (pts j) x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) ρ →
        (x ∈ Sinf ↔ ∃ i : Fin (lh j), (chartAt E3 (pts j) x) (ah j) =
          Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) x))) := by
      intro x hx hb
      rw [hmemS]
      exact hlim x hx hb
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := (hlim' p hpj hzj).mp hp
    let W : Set E3 := Metric.ball (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) ρ ∩
      ⋂ i : Fin (lh j), {z : E3 | Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) p)) =
        (chartAt E3 (pts j) p) (ah j) ∨ z (ah j) ≠ Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) z)}
    have hWo : IsOpen W := by
      refine Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i => ?_)
      by_cases h : Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) p)) =
          (chartAt E3 (pts j) p) (ah j)
      · simp only [h, true_or, Set.setOf_true, isOpen_univ]
      · simp only [h, false_or]
        exact isOpen_ne_fun (hcoord (ah j)) ((hUsm j i).continuous.comp (hpcont (ah j)))
    have hz₀W : chartAt E3 (pts j) p ∈ W := by
      refine ⟨hzj, Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun i => ?_⟩
      by_cases h : Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) p)) =
          (chartAt E3 (pts j) p) (ah j)
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (fun h' => h h'.symm)
    have hWt : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 (pts j)).target := fun z hz => hballj hz.1
    have hMSE : ∀ z ∈ W, z (ah j) = Uf j i₀ (coordPlaneProj (ah j) z) →
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm)

      (∀ v, B v w₁ = B v w₂) → w₁ = w₂ := by
    intro B hB w₁ w₂ h
    by_contra hne
    have := hB (w₁ - w₂) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
    rw [(B (w₁ - w₂)).map_sub w₁ w₂, h (w₁ - w₂), sub_self] at this
    exact lt_irrefl _ this
  
  have det_contDiffAt : ∀ (H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y₀ : E3),
      (∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => H y i j) y₀) →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => (H y).det) y₀ := by
    intro H y₀ hH
    have : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3),
        ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℝ) * ∏ i, H y (σ i) i := by
      funext y; exact Matrix.det_apply' _
    rw [this]
    refine ContDiffAt.sum fun σ _ => contDiffAt_const.mul ?_
    exact contDiffAt_prod fun i _ => hH _ _
  have inv_contDiffAt : ∀ (H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y₀ : E3),
      (∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => H y i j) y₀) → (H y₀).det ≠ 0 → ∀ i k : Fin 3,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => (H y)⁻¹ i k) y₀ := by
    intro H y₀ hH hd i k
    have hinv : ∀ y, (H y)⁻¹ i k = ((H y).det)⁻¹ * (H y).adjugate i k := by
      intro y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
      simp [Matrix.smul_apply]
    simp only [hinv]
    refine ((det_contDiffAt H y₀ hH).inv hd).mul ?_
    simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
    refine det_contDiffAt _ y₀ fun a b => ?_
    by_cases h : a = k
    · subst h; simp [Matrix.updateRow_apply, contDiffAt_const]
    · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_apply, h, if_false]; exact hH a b
  
  have chart_inv : ∀ (x₀ x : M), x ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).source →
      (∀ u, tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) u) = u) ∧
      (∀ v, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x)
        (tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x v) = v) := by
    intro x₀ x hx
    have hy : chartAt E3 x₀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target := (chartAt E3 x₀).map_source hx
    have hxy : (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) = x := (chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv hx
    have hd1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hy
    have hd2 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀) x :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hx
    have hT : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀) x =
        tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x :=
      mfderiv_chartAt_eq_tangentCoordChange hx
    constructor
    · intro u
      have hd2' : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀)
          ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x)) := by rw [hxy]; exact hd2
      have hc := mfderiv_comp (chartAt E3 x₀ x) hd2' hd1
      have hid : ((chartAt E3 x₀) ∘ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 x₀ x)] id := by
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 x₀).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz using hz
      rw [hid.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_id, hxy, hT] at hc
      have := congrArg (fun L => L u) hc
      simpa using this.symm
    · intro v
      have hc := mfderiv_comp x hd1 hd2
      have hid : ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm ∘ (chartAt E3 x₀)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] id := by
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 x₀).eventually_left_inverse hx] with z hz using hz
      rw [hid.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_id, hT] at hc
      have := congrArg (fun L => L v) hc
      simpa using this.symm
  have chain_tau : ∀ (x₀ : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target →
      (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y ∈ X → ∀ v : E3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) y v =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm y)
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y v) := by
    intro x₀ y hy hyX v
    have hd1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hy
    have hτd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm y) :=
      (hτs.contMDiffAt (hX.mem_nhds hyX)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hc := mfderiv_comp y hτd hd1
    rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at hc
    exact congrArg (fun L => L v) hc
  have xi_smooth : ∀ (x₀ : M), x₀ ∈ X → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) y (e j))
        (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := by
    intro x₀ hx₀ j
    have hO : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) :=
      (chartAt E3 x₀).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hX
    have hy₀ : chartAt E3 x₀ x₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X :=
      ⟨mem_chart_target E3 x₀, by
        show (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) ∈ X
        rw [(chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x₀)]; exact hx₀⟩
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z))
        ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) := by
      have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (τ ∘ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm)
          ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) :=
        hτs.comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hy.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)))
        ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) :=
      hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hO (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    exact (hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hy₀)
  
  have section_cmd : ∀ (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x) (x₀ : M) (W : E3 → E3),
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 W (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) →
      (∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x (V x) = W (chartAt E3 x₀ x)) →
      ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
        (fun y => (⟨y, V y⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x₀ := by
    intro V x₀ W hW hV
    rw [Bundle.contMDiffAt_section]
    have hc : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 (chartAt E3 x₀) x₀ := by
      have := contMDiffAt_extChartAt (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := 1) (x := x₀)
      simpa [extChartAt_coe] using this
    have h1 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 (fun x => W (chartAt E3 x₀ x)) x₀ :=
      hW.contMDiffAt.comp x₀ hc
    refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hV] with x hx
    rw [← hx, tangentCoordChange_def, TangentBundle.trivializationAt_apply]
    rfl
  
  let ℓ : M → E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun x => mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x
  let w : M → E3 := fun x =>
    ∑ i, (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun a b => g.g x (e a) (e b))⁻¹ (fun j => ℓ x (e j))) i • e i
  let V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x := fun x => (ℓ x (w x))⁻¹ • w x
  have hwR : ∀ x v, g.g x v (w x) = ℓ x v := by
    intro x v
    have h1 := bil_riesz (g.g x) (fun j => ℓ x (e j)) (bil_detpos _ (g.posDef x)) v
    calc g.g x v (w x) = ∑ j, v j * ℓ x (e j) := h1
      _ = ℓ x (∑ i, v i • e i) := (lin_expand (ℓ x) (fun i => v i)).symm
      _ = ℓ x v := by rw [← vec_expand v]
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ X, 0 < ℓ x (w x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hw0 : w x ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hτr x hx
      ext v
      have := hwR x v
      rw [h0, map_zero] at this
      simpa using this.symm
    have := g.posDef x (w x) hw0
    rwa [hwR] at this
  refine ⟨V, ?_, ?_⟩
  swap
  · intro x hx
    show ℓ x ((ℓ x (w x))⁻¹ • w x) = 1
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (hpos x hx).ne']
  intro x₀ hx₀
  let G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm
  let ξ : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun y j => fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) y (e j)
  let c : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun y => Matrix.mulVec (G y)⁻¹ (ξ y)
  let W : E3 → E3 := fun y => (∑ i, c y i * ξ y i)⁻¹ • ∑ i, c y i • e i
  
  have hK : ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).source ∩ X,
      tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x (V x) = W (chartAt E3 x₀ x) ∧
      ℓ x (w x) = ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i * ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i := by
    rintro x ⟨hxs, hxX⟩
    obtain ⟨hTA0, hAT0⟩ := chart_inv x₀ x hxs
    let A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x)
    let T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x
    have hTA : ∀ u, T (A u) = u := hTA0
    have hAT : ∀ v, A (T v) = v := hAT0
    have hy : chartAt E3 x₀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target := (chartAt E3 x₀).map_source hxs
    have hxy : (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) = x := (chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv hxs
    have hG : G (chartAt E3 x₀ x) =
        Matrix.of fun a b => (g.g x).bilinearComp A A (e a) (e b) := by
      ext a b
      simp only [G, RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, Matrix.of_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply]
      rw [hxy]
      rfl
    have hξ : ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x) = fun j => ℓ x (A (e j)) := by
      funext j
      simp only [ξ]
      rw [chain_tau x₀ _ hy (by rw [hxy]; exact hxX), hxy]
      rfl
    have hdetB : (Matrix.of fun a b => (g.g x).bilinearComp A A (e a) (e b)).det ≠ 0 := by
      refine bil_detpos _ (fun v hv => ?_)
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply]
      apply g.posDef
      intro h0
      apply hv
      rw [← hTA v]
      exact (congrArg T h0).trans (map_zero T)
    let u : E3 := ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i • e i
    have hRu : ∀ v, (g.g x).bilinearComp A A v u = ∑ j, v j * ℓ x (A (e j)) := by
      intro v
      have := bil_riesz ((g.g x).bilinearComp A A) (fun j => ℓ x (A (e j))) hdetB v
      simp only [u, c, hG, hξ]
      exact this
    have hAu : ∀ v, g.g x v (A u) = ℓ x v := by
      intro v
      have h1 := hRu (T v)
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply, hAT v] at h1
      rw [h1]
      calc ∑ j, (T v) j * ℓ x (A (e j)) = ((ℓ x).comp A) (∑ i, (T v) i • e i) :=
            (lin_expand ((ℓ x).comp A) (fun i => (T v) i)).symm
        _ = ℓ x v := by
            rw [← vec_expand (T v), ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hAT v]
    have hwAu : w x = A u :=
      bil_unique (g.g x) (g.posDef x) _ _ (fun v => (hwR x v).trans (hAu v).symm)
    have hlw : ℓ x (w x) = ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i * ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i := by
      rw [hwAu, hξ]
      exact lin_expand ((ℓ x).comp A) (c (chartAt E3 x₀ x))
    refine ⟨?_, hlw⟩
    show T ((ℓ x (w x))⁻¹ • w x) = W (chartAt E3 x₀ x)
    rw [hlw, hwAu, map_smul, hTA]
  
  have hy₀ : chartAt E3 x₀ x₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target := mem_chart_target E3 x₀
  have hGs : ∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => G y i j) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := fun i j =>
    ((g.smooth x₀ i j).contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 x₀).open_target.mem_nhds hy₀)).of_le
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hK₀ := hK x₀ ⟨mem_chart_source E3 x₀, hx₀⟩
  have hdetG : (G (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀)).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hc0 : c (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) = 0 := by
      simp only [c, Matrix.inv_def, h0, Ring.inverse_zero, zero_smul, Matrix.zero_mulVec]
    have := hpos x₀ hx₀
    rw [hK₀.2, hc0] at this
    simp at this
  have hξs : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => ξ y j) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := fun j =>
    xi_smooth x₀ hx₀ j
  have hcs : ∀ i, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => c y i) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := by
    intro i
    simp only [c, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    exact ContDiffAt.sum fun k _ => (inv_contDiffAt G _ hGs hdetG i k).mul (hξs k)
  have hden : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => ∑ i, c y i * ξ y i) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) :=
    ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => (hcs i).mul (hξs i)
  have hden0 : ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) i * ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hK₀.2]; exact (hpos x₀ hx₀).ne'
  have hWs : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 W (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) :=
    (hden.inv hden0).smul (ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => (hcs i).smul contDiffAt_const)
  refine section_cmd V x₀ W hWs ?_
  filter_upwards [((chartAt E3 x₀).open_source.inter hX).mem_nhds
    ⟨mem_chart_source E3 x₀, hx₀⟩] with x hx using (hK x hx).1

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (X : Set M) (hX : IsOpen X)
    (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x) (x₀ : M) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ X)
    (hV : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
      (fun y => (⟨y, V y⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x₀) :
    ∃ (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (ψ : M → ℝ → M), IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => ψ p.1 p.2) (N ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ N, ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, ψ x s ∈ X

signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (X : Set M) (hX : IsOpen X)
    (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x) (x₀ : M) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ X)
    (hV : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
      (fun y => (⟨y, V y⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x₀) :
    ∃ (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (ψ : M → ℝ → M), IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => ψ p.1 p.2) (N ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ N, ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, ψ x s ∈ X

proof.tactics:
by
  set φ := extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x₀ with hφ
  set F : E3 → E3 := fun y => tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (φ.symm y) x₀ (φ.symm y)
    (V (φ.symm y)) with hFdef
  
  have hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 F (φ x₀) := by
    have h1 := (Bundle.contMDiffAt_section x₀).mp hV
    have h2 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 φ.symm (φ x₀) :=
      (contMDiffOn_extChartAt_symm x₀).contMDiffAt
        ((isOpen_extChartAt_target x₀).mem_nhds (mem_extChartAt_target x₀))
    rw [← extChartAt_to_inv (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) x₀] at h1
    have h3 := h1.comp _ h2
    rw [contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt] at h3
    refine h3.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    simp only [hFdef, hφ, Function.comp_apply, TangentBundle.trivializationAt_apply,
      tangentCoordChange_def, extChartAt_to_inv]
    rfl
  
  have hode : ∀ (f : E3 → E3) (y₀ : E3), ContDiffAt ℝ 1 f y₀ → ∀ (O : Set E3), IsOpen O →
      y₀ ∈ O → ∃ (δ : ℝ) (α : E3 × ℝ → E3), 0 < δ ∧
        ContinuousOn α (Metric.ball y₀ δ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ) ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ δ, α (y, 0) = y ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ,
          HasDerivAt (fun s => α (y, s)) (f (α (y, t))) t ∧ α (y, t) ∈ O := by
    intro f y₀ hf O hO hy₀
    obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, a, r, L, K, hr, hPL⟩ := IsPicardLindelof.of_contDiffAt_one hf (0:ℝ)
    obtain ⟨α, hα1, hαc⟩ := hPL.exists_forall_mem_closedBall_eq_hasDerivWithinAt_continuousOn
    have hD : closedBall y₀ (r:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 - ε₁) (0 + ε₁) ∈ 𝓝 (y₀, (0:ℝ)) :=
      prod_mem_nhds (closedBall_mem_nhds y₀ hr) (Icc_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith))
    have hy₀b : y₀ ∈ closedBall y₀ (r:ℝ) := mem_closedBall_self hr.le
    have hα0 : α (y₀, 0) = y₀ := (hα1 y₀ hy₀b).1
    have hcont : ContinuousAt α (y₀, 0) := hαc.continuousAt hD
    have hpre : α ⁻¹' O ∈ 𝓝 (y₀, (0:ℝ)) :=
      hcont.preimage_mem_nhds (by rw [hα0]; exact hO.mem_nhds hy₀)
    obtain ⟨δ', hδ', hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem hD hpre)
    have hbox : ball y₀ (min δ' ε₁) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(min δ' ε₁)) (min δ' ε₁) ⊆
        closedBall y₀ (r:ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 - ε₁) (0 + ε₁) ∩ α ⁻¹' O := by
      have h1 : Set.Ioo (-(min δ' ε₁)) (min δ' ε₁) = ball (0:ℝ) (min δ' ε₁) := by
        rw [Real.ball_eq_Ioo]; simp
      rw [h1, ball_prod_same]
      exact (ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hball
    refine ⟨min δ' ε₁, α, lt_min hδ' hε₁, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hαc.mono (fun p hp => (hbox hp).1)
    · intro y hy
      have hyr : y ∈ closedBall y₀ (r:ℝ) :=
        (hbox (Set.mk_mem_prod hy (show (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo _ _ from
          ⟨by linarith [lt_min hδ' hε₁], lt_min hδ' hε₁⟩))).1.1
      refine ⟨(hα1 y hyr).1, fun t ht => ?_⟩
      have hp := hbox (Set.mk_mem_prod hy ht)
      refine ⟨?_, hp.2⟩
      have htI : Set.Icc (0 - ε₁) (0 + ε₁) ∈ 𝓝 t := by
        have := ht.1; have := ht.2; have := min_le_right δ' ε₁
        exact Icc_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)
      exact ((hα1 y hyr).2 t hp.1.2).hasDerivAt htI
  
  have hcurve : ∀ (c : ℝ → E3) (J : Set ℝ), (∀ t ∈ J, c t ∈ φ.target) →
      (∀ t ∈ J, HasDerivAt c (F (c t)) t) →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn (fun t => φ.symm (c t)) V J := by
    intro c J hcJ hc t ht
    apply HasMFDerivAt.hasMFDerivWithinAt
    set z := φ.symm (c t) with hz
    have hzs : z ∈ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x₀).source := φ.map_target (hcJ t ht)
    have hzz : z ∈ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) z).source := mem_extChartAt_source z
    have hφz : extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x₀ z = c t := φ.right_inv (hcJ t ht)
    refine ⟨(continuousAt_extChartAt_symm'' (hcJ t ht)).comp (hc t ht).continuousAt, ?_⟩
    have h1 := hasFDerivWithinAt_tangentCoordChange (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) ⟨hzs, hzz⟩
    rw [hφz, ModelWithCorners.range_eq_univ, hasFDerivWithinAt_univ] at h1
    have h2 := h1.comp_hasDerivAt t (hc t ht)
    simp only [hFdef] at h2
    rw [← hz, tangentCoordChange_comp ⟨⟨hzz, hzs⟩, hzz⟩, tangentCoordChange_self hzz] at h2
    simp only [mfld_simps, hasFDerivWithinAt_univ]
    exact h2.hasFDerivAt
  
  set O' : Set E3 := φ.target ∩ φ.symm ⁻¹' X with hO'def
  have hO' : IsOpen O' :=
    (continuousOn_extChartAt_symm x₀).isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_extChartAt_target x₀) hX
  have hy₀O' : φ x₀ ∈ O' := ⟨mem_extChartAt_target x₀, by
    show φ.symm (φ x₀) ∈ X
    rw [hφ, extChartAt_to_inv]; exact hx₀⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, α, hδ, hαc, hα⟩ := hode F (φ x₀) hF O' hO' hy₀O'
  refine ⟨(φ.source ∩ φ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (φ x₀) δ) ∩ X, δ, fun x s => φ.symm (α (φ x, s)),
    ?_, ?_, Set.inter_subset_right, hδ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ((continuousOn_extChartAt x₀).isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_extChartAt_source x₀)
      Metric.isOpen_ball).inter hX
  · exact ⟨⟨mem_extChartAt_source x₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ⟩, hx₀⟩
  · have hg : ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => (φ p.1, p.2))
        (((φ.source ∩ φ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (φ x₀) δ) ∩ X) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ) :=
      ((continuousOn_extChartAt x₀).comp continuousOn_fst
        (fun p hp => hp.1.1.1)).prodMk continuousOn_snd
    have hgm : Set.MapsTo (fun p : M × ℝ => (φ p.1, p.2))
        (((φ.source ∩ φ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (φ x₀) δ) ∩ X) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ)
        (Metric.ball (φ x₀) δ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ) :=
      fun p hp => ⟨hp.1.1.2, hp.2⟩
    have hαm : Set.MapsTo α (Metric.ball (φ x₀) δ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ) φ.target := by
      intro p hp
      have := ((hα p.1 hp.1).2 p.2 hp.2).2
      exact this.1
    exact (continuousOn_extChartAt_symm x₀).comp (hαc.comp hg hgm) (hαm.comp hgm)
  · intro x hx
    have hxs : x ∈ φ.source := hx.1.1
    have hxb : φ x ∈ Metric.ball (φ x₀) δ := hx.1.2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show φ.symm (α (φ x, 0)) = x
      rw [(hα (φ x) hxb).1]
      exact φ.left_inv hxs
    · exact hcurve (fun s => α (φ x, s)) (Set.Ioo (-δ) δ)
        (fun t ht => ((hα (φ x) hxb).2 t ht).2.1) (fun t ht => ((hα (φ x) hxb).2 t ht).1)
    · intro s hs
      exact ((hα (φ x) hxb).2 s hs).2.2
