signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (X : Set M)
    (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hV : ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
      (fun y => (⟨y, V y⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x)
    (γ γ' : ℝ → M) (α β t₀ : ℝ) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β)
    (hγ : IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β)) (hγ' : IsMIntegralCurveOn γ' V (Set.Ioo α β))
    (hγX : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) (hγ'X : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ' t ∈ X)

proof.tactics:
by
  set S : Set ℝ := {t | γ t = γ' t} ∩ Set.Ioo α β with hS
  have hopen : IsOpen S := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    rintro t₁ ⟨h1, ht₁⟩
    have hmem : Set.Ioo α β ∈ 𝓝 t₁ := Ioo_mem_nhds ht₁.1 ht₁.2
    have hVt := hV (γ t₁) (hγX t₁ ht₁)
    have heq : γ =ᶠ[𝓝 t₁] γ' :=
      isMIntegralCurveAt_eventuallyEq_of_contMDiffAt_boundaryless hVt
        (hγ.isMIntegralCurveAt hmem) (hγ'.isMIntegralCurveAt hmem) h1
    filter_upwards [heq, hmem] with t h2 h3 using ⟨h2, h3⟩
  have hne : (Set.Ioo α β ∩ S).Nonempty := ⟨t₀, ht₀, h₀, ht₀⟩
  have hcl : closure S ∩ Set.Ioo α β ⊆ S := by
    rintro t ⟨htc, ht⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ht⟩
    haveI : (𝓝[S] t).NeBot := mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot.mp htc
    have hm : Set.Ioo α β ∈ 𝓝 t := Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2
    have t1 : Filter.Tendsto γ (𝓝[S] t) (𝓝 (γ t)) :=
      ((hγ.continuousOn.continuousAt hm).continuousWithinAt).tendsto
    have t2 : Filter.Tendsto γ' (𝓝[S] t) (𝓝 (γ' t)) :=
      ((hγ'.continuousOn.continuousAt hm).continuousWithinAt).tendsto
    have he : γ =ᶠ[𝓝[S] t] γ' := eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall (fun s hs => hs.1)
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique_of_eventuallyEq t1 t2 he
  have hsub : Set.Ioo α β ⊆ S :=
    isPreconnected_Ioo.subset_of_closure_inter_subset hopen hne hcl
  intro t ht
  exact (hsub ht).1

signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (X : Set M) (hX : IsOpen X)
    (τ : M → ℝ) (hτs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X)
    (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hVτ : ∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x (V x) = 1)
    (γ : ℝ → M) (α β s₀ : ℝ) (hs₀ : s₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β)
    (hγ : IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β)) (hγX : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) :
    ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo α β, τ (γ s) = τ (γ s₀) + (s - s₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro s hs
  have key : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, HasDerivAt (fun u => τ (γ u) - u) 0 t := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : HasMFDerivAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) γ t
        ((1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (V (γ t))) :=
      (hγ t ht).hasMFDerivAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ht)
    have hxX : γ t ∈ X := hγX t ht
    have h2 : HasMFDerivAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ (γ t) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ (γ t)) :=
      ((hτs.contMDiffAt (hX.mem_nhds hxX)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)).hasMFDerivAt
    have h3 := HasMFDerivAt.comp t h2 h1
    rw [hasMFDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt] at h3
    have h4 := h3.hasDerivAt
    have hval : ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ (γ t)).comp
        ((1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (V (γ t)))) 1 = 1 := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply, one_smul]
      exact hVτ (γ t) hxX
    have h4' : HasDerivAt (fun u => τ (γ u)) 1 t := by
      convert h4 using 1
      exact hval.symm
    have h5 := h4'.sub (hasDerivAt_id' t)
    rw [sub_self] at h5
    exact h5
  have hc := isOpen_Ioo.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero isPreconnected_Ioo
    (fun t ht => (key t ht).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (fun t ht => (key t ht).deriv) hs hs₀
  simp only at hc
  linarith

      0 < ε ∧ ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => ψ p.1 p.2) (N ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ N, ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, ψ x s ∈ X)

signature.statement:
(X K : Set M) (hKX : K ⊆ X) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hloc : ∀ x₀ ∈ X, ∃ (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (ψ : M → ℝ → M), IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ X ∧
      0 < ε ∧ ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => ψ p.1 p.2) (N ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ N, ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, ψ x s ∈ X)
    (huniq : ∀ (γ γ' : ℝ → M) (α β t₀ : ℝ), t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → IsMIntegralCurveOn γ' V (Set.Ioo α β) →

      Set.EqOn γ γ' (Set.Ioo α β)) :
    ∃ (O : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (Ψ : M → ℝ → M), IsOpen O ∧ K ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Ψ p.1 p.2) (O ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, Ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (Ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, Ψ x s ∈ X

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hP0 : ∀ x₀ : M, ∃ (N : Set M) (e : ℝ) (ψ : M → ℝ → M), x₀ ∈ X → (IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧
      N ⊆ X ∧ 0 < e ∧ ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => ψ p.1 p.2) (N ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-e) e) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ N, ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-e) e) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-e) e, ψ x s ∈ X) := by
    intro x₀
    by_cases h : x₀ ∈ X
    · obtain ⟨N, e, ψ, hh⟩ := hloc x₀ h
      exact ⟨N, e, ψ, fun _ => hh⟩
    · exact ⟨∅, 1, fun x _ => x, fun h' => absurd h' h⟩
  choose Nf εf ψf hP using hP0
  obtain ⟨t, htK, hcov⟩ := hK.elim_nhds_subcover Nf (fun x hx =>
    (hP x (hKX hx)).1.mem_nhds (hP x (hKX hx)).2.1)
  have hS : (insert (1 : ℝ) (t.image εf)).Nonempty := Finset.insert_nonempty _ _
  obtain ⟨ε, hεdef⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, ε = (insert (1 : ℝ) (t.image εf)).min' hS := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hε0 : 0 < ε := by
    have hm := Finset.min'_mem _ hS
    rw [← hεdef] at hm
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hm with h | h
    · rw [h]; norm_num
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, hie⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 h
      rw [← hie]; exact (hP i (hKX (htK i hi))).2.2.2.1
  have hεle : ∀ i ∈ t, ε ≤ εf i := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hεdef]
    exact Finset.min'_le _ _ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hi))
  have hJsub : ∀ i ∈ t, Set.Ioo (-ε) ε ⊆ Set.Ioo (-εf i) (εf i) := by
    intro i hi s hs
    have := hεle i hi
    exact ⟨by linarith [hs.1], by linarith [hs.2]⟩
  have h0J : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε := ⟨by linarith, hε0⟩
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨdef⟩ : ∃ Ψ : M → ℝ → M, Ψ = fun x s =>
      if h : ∃ i ∈ t, x ∈ Nf i then ψf (Classical.choose h) x s else x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ x ∈ Nf i, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, Ψ x s = ψf i x s := by
    intro i hi x hx s hs
    have h : ∃ i ∈ t, x ∈ Nf i := ⟨i, hi, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨hjt, hjx⟩ := Classical.choose_spec h
    have hΨ : Ψ x s = ψf (Classical.choose h) x s := by
      rw [hΨdef]
      exact dif_pos h
    rw [hΨ]
    have Pj := (hP _ (hKX (htK _ hjt))).2.2.2.2.2 x hjx
    have Pi := (hP i (hKX (htK i hi))).2.2.2.2.2 x hx
    exact huniq _ (ψf i x) (-ε) ε 0 h0J (Pj.2.1.mono (hJsub _ hjt))
      (Pi.2.1.mono (hJsub i hi)) (fun r hr => Pj.2.2 r (hJsub _ hjt hr))
      (fun r hr => Pi.2.2 r (hJsub i hi hr)) (by rw [Pj.1, Pi.1]) hs
  have hmemO : ∀ x ∈ ⋃ i ∈ t, Nf i, ∃ i ∈ t, x ∈ Nf i := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hx
    exact ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩
  refine ⟨⋃ i ∈ t, Nf i, ε, Ψ, isOpen_biUnion (fun i hi => (hP i (hKX (htK i hi))).1), hcov,
    ?_, hε0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hmemO x hx
    exact (hP i (hKX (htK i hi))).2.2.1 hxi
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hmemO p.1 hp.1
    have Pi := hP i (hKX (htK i hi))
    have hW : Nf i ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε ∈ 𝓝 p := (Pi.1.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds ⟨hxi, hp.2⟩
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun q : M × ℝ => ψf i q.1 q.2) p :=
      Pi.2.2.2.2.1.continuousAt
        (Filter.mem_of_superset hW (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl (hJsub i hi)))
    refine (hc.congr (Filter.eventually_of_mem hW ?_)).continuousWithinAt
    intro q hq
    exact (hA i hi q.1 hq.1 q.2 hq.2).symm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hmemO x hx
    have Pi := (hP i (hKX (htK i hi))).2.2.2.2.2 x hxi
    refine ⟨by rw [hA i hi x hxi 0 h0J]; exact Pi.1, ?_,
      fun s hs => by rw [hA i hi x hxi s hs]; exact Pi.2.2 s (hJsub i hi hs)⟩
    have hcurve := Pi.2.1.mono (hJsub i hi)
    intro r hr
    have h1 := hcurve r hr
    have heq : Ψ x r = ψf i x r := hA i hi x hxi r hr
    have h2 := h1.congr_mono (f₁ := Ψ x) (fun y hy => hA i hi x hxi y hy) heq subset_rfl
    have hV : V (Ψ x r) = V (ψf i x r) := by rw [heq]
    show HasMFDerivWithinAt _ _ _ _ _ _
    rw [hV]
    exact h2

    (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x) (hτb : ∀ x ∈ X, a < τ x ∧ τ x < b)
    (huniq : ∀ (γ γ' : ℝ → M) (α β t₀ : ℝ), t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → IsMIntegralCurveOn γ' V (Set.Ioo α β) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ' t ∈ X) → γ t₀ = γ' t₀ →

      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) →

    (x : M) (hx : x ∈ X) (T₁ T₂ : ℝ) (hT₁ : T₁ ≤ 0) (hT₂ : 0 ≤ T₂)

signature.statement:
(X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x) (hτb : ∀ x ∈ X, a < τ x ∧ τ x < b)
    (huniq : ∀ (γ γ' : ℝ → M) (α β t₀ : ℝ), t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → IsMIntegralCurveOn γ' V (Set.Ioo α β) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ' t ∈ X) → γ t₀ = γ' t₀ →
      Set.EqOn γ γ' (Set.Ioo α β))
    (hτlin : ∀ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β s₀ : ℝ), s₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) →
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo α β, τ (γ s) = τ (γ s₀) + (s - s₀))
    (hunif : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → ∃ (O : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (Ψ : M → ℝ → M),
      X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, Ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (Ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, Ψ x s ∈ X)
    (x : M) (hx : x ∈ X) (T₁ T₂ : ℝ) (hT₁ : T₁ ≤ 0) (hT₂ : 0 ≤ T₂)
    (ha : a < τ x + T₁) (hb : τ x + T₂ < b) :
    ∃ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β : ℝ), α < T₁ ∧ T₂ < β ∧ γ 0 = x ∧
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have glue : ∀ (γ γ' : ℝ → M) (α β α' β' t₁ : ℝ), t₁ ∈ Set.Ioo α β → t₁ ∈ Set.Ioo α' β' →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → IsMIntegralCurveOn γ' V (Set.Ioo α' β') →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α' β', γ' t ∈ X) → γ t₁ = γ' t₁ →
      ∃ γ'' : ℝ → M, IsMIntegralCurveOn γ'' V (Set.Ioo (min α α') (max β β')) ∧
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (min α α') (max β β'), γ'' t ∈ X) ∧ Set.EqOn γ'' γ (Set.Ioo α β) := by
    intro γ γ' α β α' β' t₁ ht₁ ht₁' hγ hγ' hγX hγ'X h₁
    have hJ₁ : Set.Ioo (max α α') (min β β') ⊆ Set.Ioo α β :=
      Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo (le_max_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hJ₂ : Set.Ioo (max α α') (min β β') ⊆ Set.Ioo α' β' :=
      Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo (le_max_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    have ht₁J : t₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (max α α') (min β β') :=
      ⟨max_lt ht₁.1 ht₁'.1, lt_min ht₁.2 ht₁'.2⟩
    have hEq : Set.EqOn γ γ' (Set.Ioo (max α α') (min β β')) :=
      huniq γ γ' _ _ t₁ ht₁J (hγ.mono hJ₁) (hγ'.mono hJ₂)
        (fun t ht => hγX t (hJ₁ ht)) (fun t ht => hγ'X t (hJ₂ ht)) h₁
    have hE1 : Set.EqOn ((Set.Ioo α β).piecewise γ γ') γ (Set.Ioo α β) :=
      fun t ht => Set.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ ht
    have hE2 : Set.EqOn ((Set.Ioo α β).piecewise γ γ') γ' (Set.Ioo α' β') := by
      intro t ht
      by_cases h : t ∈ Set.Ioo α β
      · rw [Set.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ h]
        exact hEq ⟨max_lt h.1 ht.1, lt_min h.2 ht.2⟩
      · exact Set.piecewise_eq_of_notMem _ _ _ h
    have hU : Set.Ioo α β ∪ Set.Ioo α' β' = Set.Ioo (min α α') (max β β') :=
      Set.Ioo_union_Ioo' (ht₁'.1.trans ht₁.2) (ht₁.1.trans ht₁'.2)
    have hG : ∀ (W : Set ℝ) (η : ℝ → M), IsOpen W →
        IsMIntegralCurveOn η V W → Set.EqOn ((Set.Ioo α β).piecewise γ γ') η W → ∀ t ∈ W,
        HasMFDerivWithinAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((Set.Ioo α β).piecewise γ γ')
          (Set.Ioo (min α α') (max β β')) t
          ((1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (V ((Set.Ioo α β).piecewise γ γ' t))) := by
      intro W η hWo hη hEqW t ht
      have hW : W ∈ nhds t := hWo.mem_nhds ht
      have h1 := (hη t ht).hasMFDerivAt hW
      have h2 : (Set.Ioo α β).piecewise γ γ' =ᶠ[nhds t] η := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hW hEqW
      have h3 := h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq h2
      rw [hEqW ht]
      exact h3.hasMFDerivWithinAt
    refine ⟨(Set.Ioo α β).piecewise γ γ', ?_, ?_, hE1⟩
    · intro t ht
      rw [← hU] at ht
      rcases ht with ht | ht
      · exact hG _ γ isOpen_Ioo hγ hE1 t ht
      · exact hG _ γ' isOpen_Ioo hγ' hE2 t ht
    · intro t ht
      rw [← hU] at ht
      rcases ht with ht | ht
      · rw [hE1 ht]; exact hγX t ht
      · rw [hE2 ht]; exact hγ'X t ht
  
  obtain ⟨O, ε, Ψ, hKO, hOX, hε, hΨ⟩ := hunif (τ x + T₁) (τ x + T₂) ha hb
  have hSM : ∀ z ∈ X, ∀ t : ℝ, τ z = τ x + t → T₁ ≤ t → t ≤ T₂ → z ∈ O := by
    intro z hz t hτz h1 h2
    refine hKO ⟨hz, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Icc, hτz]
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hext : ∀ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β t₁ : ℝ), t₁ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) → γ t₁ ∈ O →
      ∃ γ'' : ℝ → M, IsMIntegralCurveOn γ'' V (Set.Ioo (min α (t₁ - ε)) (max β (t₁ + ε))) ∧
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (min α (t₁ - ε)) (max β (t₁ + ε)), γ'' t ∈ X) ∧
        Set.EqOn γ'' γ (Set.Ioo α β) := by
    intro γ α β t₁ ht₁ hγ hγX hyO
    obtain ⟨hy0, hyI, hyX⟩ := hΨ (γ t₁) hyO
    have hsub : Set.Ioo (t₁ - ε) (t₁ + ε) ⊆ {t | t + -t₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε} := by
      intro t ht
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Ioo] at ht ⊢
      constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
    have hγ' : IsMIntegralCurveOn (Ψ (γ t₁) ∘ fun s => s + -t₁) V
        (Set.Ioo (t₁ - ε) (t₁ + ε)) :=
      (hyI.comp_add (-t₁)).mono hsub
    have hγ'X : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (t₁ - ε) (t₁ + ε), (Ψ (γ t₁) ∘ fun s => s + -t₁) s ∈ X := by
      intro s hs
      exact hyX (s + -t₁) (hsub hs)
    have ht₁' : t₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (t₁ - ε) (t₁ + ε) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h₁ : γ t₁ = (Ψ (γ t₁) ∘ fun s => s + -t₁) t₁ := by
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, add_neg_cancel, hy0]
    exact glue γ _ α β _ _ t₁ ht₁ ht₁' hγ hγ' hγX hγ'X h₁
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = ε / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; linarith
  have hτ0 : ∀ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β : ℝ), α < 0 → 0 < β → γ 0 = x →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, τ (γ t) = τ x + t := by
    intro γ α β hα hβ h0 hγ hγX t ht
    have := hτlin γ α β 0 ⟨hα, hβ⟩ hγ hγX t ht
    rw [this, h0, sub_zero]
  have h0 : ∃ α β : ℝ, α < 0 ∧ 0 < β ∧ ∃ γ : ℝ → M, γ 0 = x ∧
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X := by
    have hxO : x ∈ O := hSM x hx 0 (by ring) hT₁ hT₂
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hΨ x hxO
    exact ⟨-ε, ε, by linarith, hε, Ψ x, h1, h2, h3⟩
  have hfwd : ∀ α β : ℝ, α < 0 → 0 < β → β ≤ T₂ → (∃ γ : ℝ → M, γ 0 = x ∧
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) →
      ∃ α' β' : ℝ, α' ≤ α ∧ β + δ ≤ β' ∧ ∃ γ : ℝ → M, γ 0 = x ∧
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α' β') ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α' β', γ t ∈ X := by
    rintro α β hα hβ hβT ⟨γ, hγ0, hγ, hγX⟩
    have ht₁ : max 0 (β - δ) ∈ Set.Ioo α β :=
      ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hα (le_max_left _ _), max_lt hβ (by linarith)⟩
    have hyO : γ (max 0 (β - δ)) ∈ O :=
      hSM _ (hγX _ ht₁) _ (hτ0 γ α β hα hβ hγ0 hγ hγX _ ht₁)
        (le_trans hT₁ (le_max_left _ _)) (max_le hT₂ (by linarith))
    obtain ⟨γ'', h1, h2, h3⟩ := hext γ α β _ ht₁ hγ hγX hyO
    refine ⟨_, _, min_le_left _ _, ?_, γ'', ?_, h1, h2⟩
    · have := le_max_right 0 (β - δ)
      have := le_max_right β (max 0 (β - δ) + ε)
      linarith
    · rw [h3 ⟨hα, hβ⟩, hγ0]
  have hbwd : ∀ α β : ℝ, α < 0 → 0 < β → T₁ ≤ α → (∃ γ : ℝ → M, γ 0 = x ∧
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) →
      ∃ α' β' : ℝ, α' ≤ α - δ ∧ β ≤ β' ∧ ∃ γ : ℝ → M, γ 0 = x ∧
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α' β') ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α' β', γ t ∈ X := by
    rintro α β hα hβ hTα ⟨γ, hγ0, hγ, hγX⟩
    have ht₂ : min 0 (α + δ) ∈ Set.Ioo α β :=
      ⟨lt_min hα (by linarith), lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) hβ⟩
    have hyO : γ (min 0 (α + δ)) ∈ O :=
      hSM _ (hγX _ ht₂) _ (hτ0 γ α β hα hβ hγ0 hγ hγX _ ht₂)
        (le_min hT₁ (by linarith)) (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hT₂)
    obtain ⟨γ'', h1, h2, h3⟩ := hext γ α β _ ht₂ hγ hγX hyO
    refine ⟨_, _, ?_, le_max_left _ _, γ'', ?_, h1, h2⟩
    · have := min_le_right α (min 0 (α + δ) - ε)
      have := min_le_right 0 (α + δ)
      linarith
    · rw [h3 ⟨hα, hβ⟩, hγ0]
  
  have hQ : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ α β : ℝ, α < 0 ∧ 0 < β ∧ (∃ γ : ℝ → M, γ 0 = x ∧
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) ∧
      (T₂ < β ∨ (n : ℝ) * δ ≤ β) ∧ (α < T₁ ∨ α ≤ -((n : ℝ) * δ)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hP⟩ := h0
      exact ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hP, Or.inr (by simp; linarith), Or.inr (by simp; linarith)⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hP, hF, hB⟩ := ih
      have hring : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * δ = (n : ℝ) * δ + δ := by ring
      push_cast
      obtain ⟨α₁, β₁, hα₁, hβ₁, hP₁, hF₁, hαα₁, hββ₁⟩ : ∃ α₁ β₁ : ℝ, α₁ < 0 ∧ 0 < β₁ ∧
          (∃ γ : ℝ → M, γ 0 = x ∧
            IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α₁ β₁) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α₁ β₁, γ t ∈ X) ∧
          (T₂ < β₁ ∨ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * δ ≤ β₁) ∧ α₁ ≤ α ∧ β ≤ β₁ := by
        by_cases hT : T₂ < β
        · exact ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hP, Or.inl hT, le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
        · have hT' : β ≤ T₂ := le_of_not_gt hT
          obtain ⟨α', β', h1, h2, h3⟩ := hfwd α β hα hβ hT' hP
          have hnδ : (n : ℝ) * δ ≤ β := hF.resolve_left hT
          exact ⟨α', β', by linarith, by linarith, h3, Or.inr (by linarith), h1, by linarith⟩
      have hB₁ : α₁ < T₁ ∨ α₁ ≤ -((n : ℝ) * δ) := by
        rcases hB with h | h
        · left; linarith
        · right; linarith
      by_cases hT : α₁ < T₁
      · exact ⟨α₁, β₁, hα₁, hβ₁, hP₁, hF₁, Or.inl hT⟩
      · have hT' : T₁ ≤ α₁ := le_of_not_gt hT
        obtain ⟨α', β', h1, h2, h3⟩ := hbwd α₁ β₁ hα₁ hβ₁ hT' hP₁
        have hnδ : α₁ ≤ -((n : ℝ) * δ) := hB₁.resolve_left hT
        refine ⟨α', β', by linarith, by linarith, h3, ?_, Or.inr (by linarith)⟩
        rcases hF₁ with h | h
        · left; linarith
        · right; linarith
  
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max T₂ (-T₁) / δ)
  have hNδ : max T₂ (-T₁) < (N : ℝ) * δ := by rwa [div_lt_iff₀ hδpos] at hN
  obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, ⟨γ, hγ0, hγ, hγX⟩, hF, hB⟩ := hQ N
  have e1 := le_max_left T₂ (-T₁)
  have e2 := le_max_right T₂ (-T₁)
  refine ⟨γ, α, β, ?_, ?_, hγ0, hγ, hγX⟩
  · rcases hB with h | h
    · exact h
    · linarith
  · rcases hF with h | h
    · exact h
    · linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hsel : ∃ Θ : M → ℝ → M, ∀ (x : M) (γ : ℝ → M) (α β t : ℝ), (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      t ∈ Set.Ioo α β → IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) →
      (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ u ∈ X) → γ 0 = x → Θ x t = γ t := by
    refine ⟨fun x t => if h : ∃ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β : ℝ), (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo α β ∧
        t ∈ Set.Ioo α β ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) ∧
        (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ u ∈ X) ∧ γ 0 = x
      then Classical.choose h t else x, ?_⟩
    intro x γ α β t h0 ht hγ hγX hγ0
    have hP : ∃ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β : ℝ), (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo α β ∧
        t ∈ Set.Ioo α β ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) ∧
        (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ u ∈ X) ∧ γ 0 = x :=
      ⟨γ, α, β, h0, ht, hγ, hγX, hγ0⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [dif_pos hP]
    obtain ⟨α₀, β₀, h0', ht', hγ', hγX', hγ0'⟩ := Classical.choose_spec hP
    have hsub1 : Set.Ioo (max α α₀) (min β β₀) ⊆ Set.Ioo α β := fun u hu =>
      ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hu.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hu.2 (min_le_left _ _)⟩
    have hsub2 : Set.Ioo (max α α₀) (min β β₀) ⊆ Set.Ioo α₀ β₀ := fun u hu =>
      ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hu.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hu.2 (min_le_right _ _)⟩
    have hmem : ∀ u, u ∈ Set.Ioo α β → u ∈ Set.Ioo α₀ β₀ →
        u ∈ Set.Ioo (max α α₀) (min β β₀) :=
      fun u h1 h2 => ⟨max_lt h1.1 h2.1, lt_min h1.2 h2.2⟩
    have hEq := huniq (Classical.choose hP) γ (max α α₀) (min β β₀) 0 (hmem 0 h0 h0')
      (hγ'.mono hsub2) (hγ.mono hsub1)
      (fun u hu => hγX' u (hsub2 hu)) (fun u hu => hγX u (hsub1 hu)) (hγ0'.trans hγ0.symm)
    exact hEq (hmem t ht ht')
  obtain ⟨Θ, hK⟩ := hsel
  
  have F1 : ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ s : ℝ, a < τ x + s → τ x + s < b →
      Θ x s ∈ X ∧ τ (Θ x s) = τ x + s := by
    intro x hx s h1 h2
    have hb := hτb x hx
    have hA : a < τ x + min s 0 := by
      rcases min_choice s 0 with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
    have hB : τ x + max s 0 < b := by
      rcases max_choice s 0 with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨γ, α, β, hα, hβ, hγ0, hγ, hγX⟩ :=
      hlong x hx (min s 0) (max s 0) (min_le_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _) hA hB
    have e1 := min_le_right s 0
    have e2 := min_le_left s 0
    have e3 := le_max_right s 0
    have e4 := le_max_left s 0
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo α β := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hs : s ∈ Set.Ioo α β := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    rw [hK x γ α β s h0 hs hγ hγX hγ0]
    refine ⟨hγX s hs, ?_⟩
    rw [hτlin γ α β 0 h0 hγ hγX s hs, hγ0, sub_zero]
  
  have F2 : ∀ x ∈ X, Θ x 0 = x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨γ, α, β, hα, hβ, hγ0, hγ, hγX⟩ := hlong x hx 0 0 le_rfl le_rfl
      (by rw [add_zero]; exact (hτb x hx).1) (by rw [add_zero]; exact (hτb x hx).2)
    rw [hK x γ α β 0 ⟨hα, hβ⟩ ⟨hα, hβ⟩ hγ hγX hγ0, hγ0]
  
  have F3 : ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ s s' : ℝ, a < τ x + s → τ x + s < b → a < τ x + s + s' →
      τ x + s + s' < b → Θ (Θ x s) s' = Θ x (s + s') := by
    intro x hx s s' h1 h2 h3 h4
    have hb := hτb x hx
    obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = min 0 (min s (s + s')) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T₂, hT₂⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = max 0 (max s (s + s')) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have e1 : T₁ ≤ 0 := hT₁ ▸ min_le_left _ _
    have e2 : T₁ ≤ s := hT₁ ▸ (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have e3 : T₁ ≤ s + s' := hT₁ ▸ (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have f1 : 0 ≤ T₂ := hT₂ ▸ le_max_left _ _
    have f2 : s ≤ T₂ := hT₂ ▸ (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    have f3 : s + s' ≤ T₂ := hT₂ ▸ (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    have hA : a < τ x + T₁ := by
      rcases min_choice 0 (min s (s + s')) with h | h
      · linarith
      · rcases min_choice s (s + s') with h' | h' <;> linarith
    have hB : τ x + T₂ < b := by
      rcases max_choice 0 (max s (s + s')) with h | h
      · linarith
      · rcases max_choice s (s + s') with h' | h' <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨γ, α, β, hα, hβ, hγ0, hγ, hγX⟩ := hlong x hx T₁ T₂ e1 f1 hA hB
    have m0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo α β := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have ms : s ∈ Set.Ioo α β := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have mss : s + s' ∈ Set.Ioo α β := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    rw [hK x γ α β s m0 ms hγ hγX hγ0, hK x γ α β (s + s') m0 mss hγ hγX hγ0]
    have hδ : IsMIntegralCurveOn (γ ∘ fun u => u + s) V (Set.Ioo (α - s) (β - s)) :=
      (hγ.comp_add s).mono (fun u hu => by
        show u + s ∈ Set.Ioo α β
        exact ⟨by linarith [hu.1], by linarith [hu.2]⟩)
    have hδX : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (α - s) (β - s), (γ ∘ fun u => u + s) u ∈ X := fun u hu =>
      hγX (u + s) ⟨by linarith [hu.1], by linarith [hu.2]⟩
    have hδ0 : (γ ∘ fun u => u + s) 0 = γ s := by simp
    have hfin := hK (γ s) (γ ∘ fun u => u + s) (α - s) (β - s) s'
      ⟨by linarith [ms.1], by linarith [ms.2]⟩
      ⟨by linarith [mss.1], by linarith [mss.2]⟩ hδ hδX hδ0
    rw [hfin]
    show γ (s' + s) = γ (s + s')
    rw [add_comm]
  
  have hshort : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → ∃ (O : Set M) (ε : ℝ),
      X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d ⊆ O ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 p.2) (O ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) := by
    intro c d hc hd
    obtain ⟨O, ε, Ψ, -, hKO, -, hε, hΨc, hΨ⟩ := hunif c d hc hd
    refine ⟨O, ε, hKO, hε, hΨc.congr ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨h0, hint, hXΨ⟩ := hΨ p.1 hp.1
    exact hK p.1 (Ψ p.1) (-ε) ε p.2 ⟨by linarith, hε⟩ hp.2 hint hXΨ h0
  
  refine ⟨Θ, F1, F2, F3, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨x₀, s₀⟩ ⟨hx₀, hl₀, hu₀⟩
  have hl₀' : a < τ x₀ + s₀ := hl₀
  have hu₀' : τ x₀ + s₀ < b := hu₀
  have hb₀ := hτb x₀ hx₀
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ, μ = min (τ x₀) (τ x₀ + s₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ : ∃ ν : ℝ, ν = max (τ x₀) (τ x₀ + s₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hμ1 : μ ≤ τ x₀ := hμ ▸ min_le_left _ _
  have hμ2 : μ ≤ τ x₀ + s₀ := hμ ▸ min_le_right _ _
  have hν1 : τ x₀ ≤ ν := hν ▸ le_max_left _ _
  have hν2 : τ x₀ + s₀ ≤ ν := hν ▸ le_max_right _ _
  have hμa : a < μ := by rw [hμ]; exact lt_min hb₀.1 hl₀'
  have hνb : ν < b := by rw [hν]; exact max_lt hb₀.2 hu₀'
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, η = min (μ - a) (b - ν) / 3 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hηpos : 0 < η := by
    rw [hη]; exact div_pos (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by norm_num)
  have hη1 : 3 * η ≤ μ - a := by rw [hη]; linarith [min_le_left (μ - a) (b - ν)]
  have hη2 : 3 * η ≤ b - ν := by rw [hη]; linarith [min_le_right (μ - a) (b - ν)]
  obtain ⟨O, ε, hKO, hε, hΘc⟩ := hshort (μ - 2 * η) (ν + 2 * η) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, n = ⌈(|s₀| + η) / ε⌉₊ + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by rw [hn]; positivity
  have hNne : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hNpos.ne'
  have hNε : |s₀| + η < n * ε := by
    have h1 : (|s₀| + η) / ε ≤ ⌈(|s₀| + η) / ε⌉₊ := Nat.le_ceil _
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hε] at h1
    have h2 : (n : ℝ) = (⌈(|s₀| + η) / ε⌉₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [hn]; push_cast; ring
    have h3 : (n : ℝ) * ε = (⌈(|s₀| + η) / ε⌉₊ : ℝ) * ε + ε := by rw [h2]; ring
    linarith
  have hUo : IsOpen (X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (τ x₀ - η) (τ x₀ + η)) :=
    hτc.isOpen_inter_preimage hX isOpen_Ioo
  obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : Set (M × ℝ),
      W = (X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (τ x₀ - η) (τ x₀ + η)) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (s₀ - η) (s₀ + η) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hWo : IsOpen W := by rw [hWdef]; exact hUo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hpW : ((x₀, s₀) : M × ℝ) ∈ W := by
    rw [hWdef]
    exact Set.mk_mem_prod ⟨hx₀, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩ ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hWmem : ∀ p ∈ W, p.1 ∈ X ∧ τ x₀ - η < τ p.1 ∧ τ p.1 < τ x₀ + η ∧
      s₀ - η < p.2 ∧ p.2 < s₀ + η := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hWdef] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨hx, h1, h2⟩, h3, h4⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨hx, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  have hslab : ∀ p ∈ W, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n →
      μ - 2 * η ≤ τ p.1 + (k : ℝ) * p.2 / n ∧ τ p.1 + (k : ℝ) * p.2 / n ≤ ν + 2 * η := by
    intro p hp k hk
    obtain ⟨hx, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hWmem p hp
    have hθ0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) / n := by positivity
    have hθ1 : (k : ℝ) / n ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hNpos).mpr (by exact_mod_cast hk)
    have heq : τ p.1 + (k : ℝ) * p.2 / n =
        (1 - (k : ℝ) / n) * τ p.1 + ((k : ℝ) / n) * (τ p.1 + p.2) := by ring
    rw [heq]
    constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hθ1)
          (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ τ p.1 - (μ - 2 * η) by linarith),
        mul_nonneg hθ0 (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ τ p.1 + p.2 - (μ - 2 * η) by linarith)]
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hθ1)
          (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (ν + 2 * η) - τ p.1 by linarith),
        mul_nonneg hθ0 (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (ν + 2 * η) - (τ p.1 + p.2) by linarith)]
  have hstep : ∀ p ∈ W, p.2 / n ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, h3, h4⟩ := hWmem p hp
    have habs : |p.2| < n * ε := by
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor
      · have := neg_abs_le s₀; linarith
      · have := le_abs_self s₀; linarith
    have hlt : |p.2 / n| < ε := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hNpos, div_lt_iff₀ hNpos]; linarith
    exact abs_lt.mp hlt
  have hM : ∀ p ∈ W, ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n → Θ p.1 ((k : ℝ) * p.2 / n) ∈ O := by
    intro p hp k hk
    obtain ⟨hx, -⟩ := hWmem p hp
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hslab p hp k hk
    obtain ⟨hX', hτ'⟩ := F1 p.1 hx _ (by linarith) (by linarith)
    exact hKO ⟨hX', by rw [Set.mem_preimage, hτ']; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
  have hR : ∀ p ∈ W, ∀ k : ℕ, k + 1 ≤ n →
      Θ (Θ p.1 ((k : ℝ) * p.2 / n)) (p.2 / n) = Θ p.1 (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * p.2 / n) := by
    intro p hp k hk
    obtain ⟨hx, -⟩ := hWmem p hp
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hslab p hp k (by omega)
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hslab p hp (k + 1) hk
    have heq : (k : ℝ) * p.2 / n + p.2 / n = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * p.2 / n := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [F3 p.1 hx _ _ (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith), heq]
  have hC : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ n →
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 ((k : ℝ) * p.2 / n)) W := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      refine continuousOn_fst.congr ?_
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨hx, -⟩ := hWmem p hp
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_div]
      exact F2 p.1 hx
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => (Θ p.1 ((k : ℝ) * p.2 / n), p.2 / n)) W :=
        (ih (by omega)).prodMk (continuous_snd.div_const _).continuousOn
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : M × ℝ => (Θ p.1 ((k : ℝ) * p.2 / n), p.2 / n)) W
          (O ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) :=
        fun p hp => Set.mk_mem_prod (hM p hp k (by omega)) (hstep p hp)
      refine (hΘc.comp hcont hmaps).congr ?_
      intro p hp
      exact (hR p hp k hk).symm
  have hF : ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 p.2) W := by
    refine (hC n le_rfl).congr ?_
    intro p _
    have h : (n : ℝ) * p.2 / n = p.2 := mul_div_cancel_left₀ p.2 hNne
    simp only [h]
  exact (hF.continuousAt (hWo.mem_nhds hpW)).continuousWithinAt

signature.name: sepChartNull_of_image_null
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (p : M) (N : Set M)
    (hN : N ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source) (h0 : volume (chartAt E3 p '' N) = 0) :
    sepChartNull N

proof.tactics:
by
  intro q
  have hs0 : volume (chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) = 0 :=
    measure_mono_null (Set.image_mono Set.inter_subset_left) h0
  have himg : (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) '' (chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
      = chartAt E3 q '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
    rw [Set.image_image]
    refine Set.EqOn.image_eq ?_
    intro x hx
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hN hx.1)]
  have hsm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) :=
    (contMDiffOn_chart (x := q)).comp ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := p)).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
      Set.inter_subset_right
  have hcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hsm
  have hsub : chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ⊆
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source (hN hx.1), ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hN hx.1)]
    exact hx.2
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      (chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) :=
    (hcd.differentiableOn (by simp)).mono hsub
  rw [← himg]
  exact MeasureTheory.addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn_of_addHaar_eq_zero volume hdiff hs0

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (ρ : M → ℝ) (r₁ s : ℝ) (A : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ)
    (hcpt : ∀ t : ℝ, IsCompact {p : M | ρ p ≤ t})
    (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p)
    (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A)
    (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) :
    sepRiemPer g A {p : M | ρ p < s} < ⊤

signature.name: sepRiemPer_far_lt_top
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (ρ : M → ℝ) (r₁ s : ℝ) (A : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ)
    (hcpt : ∀ t : ℝ, IsCompact {p : M | ρ p ≤ t})
    (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p)
    (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A)
    (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) :
    sepRiemPer g A {p : M | ρ p < s} < ⊤

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hh1, hhd0, hhdz⟩ := sep_h_props
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρ.continuous
  have hρchart : ∀ q : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
      (chartAt E3 q).target := fun q =>
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hρ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  
  have s15 : ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → r₁ ≤ ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) →
      ∃ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y ≠ 0 := by
    intro q y hy hr
    by_contra hall
    push_neg at hall
    have h1 := levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g
      (PartialDiffeomorph.mk (chartAt E3 q).symm.toPartialEquiv (chartAt E3 q).open_target
        (chartAt E3 q).open_source contMDiffOn_chart_symm contMDiffOn_chart)
      ρ (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) hρ y hy (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => rfl))
    have h3 : g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) =
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y :=
      h1
    have h2 := hmc _ hr
    rw [h3] at h2
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, hall, mul_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero,
      Real.sqrt_zero, div_zero] at h2
    norm_num at h2
  
  have s16 : ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ (q : M) (y : E3),
      y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
        g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) := by
    intro u hu q y hy
    obtain ⟨-, hlaw, hgr⟩ := sep_chart_transition g q ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) y hy
      (mem_chart_source E3 _)
    set x := (chartAt E3 q).symm y with hx
    set J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := Matrix.of fun a i =>
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y (e i) a with hJ
    have hG : g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y =
        J.transpose * g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x x) * J := by
      ext i j
      rw [hlaw i j]
      simp only [hJ, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hdetJ : J.det ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hpos := (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q y hy).det_pos
      rw [hG, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, h0] at hpos
      simp at hpos
    have hq := sep_quadform_congr J (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x x)) hdetJ
      (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) (chartAt E3 x x))
    rw [hG]
    simp only [hgr u hu]
    simp only [hJ, Matrix.of_apply] at hq ⊢
    rw [hq]
    rfl
  
  have s17 : ∀ (φ : M → ENNReal) (p₁ p₂ : M) (S : Set M),
      S ⊆ (chartAt E3 p₁).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p₂).source →
      MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p₁ '' S) → MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p₂ '' S) →

    have hO : IsOpen (chartAt E3 x '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source)) :=

        Set.inter_subset_right
    have hmem : chartAt E3 x x ∈ chartAt E3 x '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) :=
      ⟨x, ⟨hKΩ hx, mem_chart_source E3 x⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hO _ hmem
  choose! ε hεpos hεsub using hballex
  have hcb : ∀ x ∈ K, closedBall (chartAt E3 x x) (3 * (ε x / 4)) ⊆
      chartAt E3 x '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) := fun x hx =>
    (closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith [hεpos x hx])).trans (hεsub x hx)
  have himt : ∀ x : M, chartAt E3 x '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) ⊆ (chartAt E3 x).target := by
    intro x
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 x).map_source hy.2
  have hnhds : ∀ x ∈ K,
      (chartAt E3 x).symm '' ball (chartAt E3 x x) (ε x / 4 / 2 / 2) ∈ 𝓝 x := by
    intro x hx
    have hpos := hεpos x hx
    have hsub : ball (chartAt E3 x x) (ε x / 4 / 2 / 2) ⊆ (chartAt E3 x).target := by
      intro z hz
      apply himt x
      apply hcb x hx
      exact (ball_subset_closedBall.trans (closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith))) hz
    have hopen : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 x).symm '' ball (chartAt E3 x x) (ε x / 4 / 2 / 2)) :=
      (chartAt E3 x).symm.isOpen_image_of_subset_source isOpen_ball
        (by rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source]; exact hsub)
    refine hopen.mem_nhds ⟨chartAt E3 x x, mem_ball_self (by linarith), ?_⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 x).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x)
  obtain ⟨t, htK, hcov⟩ := hK.elim_nhds_subcover _ hnhds
  obtain ⟨xs, hxs_mem, hxs_surj⟩ : ∃ xs : Fin t.card → M, (∀ j, xs j ∈ t) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ t, ∃ j, xs j = x :=
    ⟨fun j => (t.equivFin.symm j : M), fun j => (t.equivFin.symm j).2,
      fun x hx => ⟨t.equivFin ⟨x, hx⟩, by simp⟩⟩
  have hxsK : ∀ j, xs j ∈ K := fun j => htK _ (hxs_mem j)
  obtain ⟨cs, rs, hrs, hcbs, hcovs⟩ : ∃ (cs : Fin t.card → E3) (rs : Fin t.card → ℝ),
      (∀ j, 0 < rs j) ∧
      (∀ j, closedBall (cs j) (3 * rs j) ⊆ chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source)) ∧
      K ⊆ ⋃ j, (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (rs j / 2 / 2) := by
    refine ⟨fun j => chartAt E3 (xs j) (xs j), fun j => ε (xs j) / 4, fun j => ?_,
      fun j => hcb _ (hxsK j), ?_⟩
    · have := hεpos _ (hxsK j)
      show 0 < ε (xs j) / 4
      linarith
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨x, hxt, hzx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcov hz)
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hxs_surj x hxt
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hzx⟩
  
  have hW : ∀ (j : Fin t.card) (n : ℕ), sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm)
      (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source)) (ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) ≤
        sepRiemPer g (Fs n) Ω := by
    intro j n
    have hbt : ball (cs j) (3 * rs j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).target :=
      ball_subset_closedBall.trans ((hcbs j).trans (himt _))
    have hWo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) :=
      (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm.isOpen_image_of_subset_source isOpen_ball
        (by rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source]; exact hbt)
    have hWsub : (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (3 * rs j) ⊆
        Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source := by
      rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩ := hcbs j (ball_subset_closedBall hw)
      rw [(chartAt E3 (xs j)).left_inv hx'.2]
      exact hx'
    have himg : chartAt E3 (xs j) '' ((chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) =
        ball (cs j) (3 * rs j) :=
      (chartAt E3 (xs j)).toPartialEquiv.image_symm_image_of_subset_target hbt
    have key : (∑ k : Fin 1, sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 ((fun _ : Fin 1 => xs j) k)).symm)
        (chartAt E3 ((fun _ : Fin 1 => xs j) k) '' (Fs n ∩
          (chartAt E3 ((fun _ : Fin 1 => xs j) k)).source))
        (chartAt E3 ((fun _ : Fin 1 => xs j) k) ''
          ((fun _ : Fin 1 => (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) k))) ≤
        sepRiemPer g (Fs n) Ω := by
      unfold sepRiemPer
      exact le_iSup_of_le 1 (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ : Fin 1 => xs j)
        (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ : Fin 1 => (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (3 * rs j))
          (le_iSup_of_le ⟨fun _ => ⟨hWo, hWsub⟩,
            fun k l hkl => (hkl (Subsingleton.elim k l)).elim⟩ le_rfl)))
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one] at key
    dsimp only at key
    rw [himg] at key
    exact key
  have hL4 : ∀ j : Fin t.card, ∃ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a ∧ ∀ S : Set E3,
      sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal a * sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm) S (ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) := by
    intro j
    have h3 : 0 < 3 * rs j := by linarith [hrs j]
    exact sepPerG_one_le_mul (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm) (chartAt E3 (xs j)).target
      (cs j) (3 * rs j) (chartAt E3 (xs j)).open_target (fun i k => g.smooth (xs j) i k)
      (fun z hz => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g (xs j) z hz) h3 ((hcbs j).trans (himt _))
  choose a ha0 ha using hL4
  
  have hmod : ∀ (j : Fin t.card) (n : ℕ) (h : E3), ‖h‖ ≤ rs j →
      volume (symmDiff (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source))
        ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source))) ∩
          ball (cs j) (rs j)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * a j * Lr) * ‖h‖) := by
    intro j n h hh
    have h5 := sepPerG_one_translate_le (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source))
      (cs j) h (rs j) (hFsm n (xs j)) (hrs j) hh
    have h4 : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
        (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source)) (ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (a j) * ENNReal.ofReal Lr := by
      refine (ha j _).trans ?_
      gcongr
      exact (hW j n).trans (hFsΛ n)
    calc _ ≤ _ := h5
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ‖h‖) * (ENNReal.ofReal (a j) * ENNReal.ofReal Lr) := by
          gcongr
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * a j * Lr) * ‖h‖) := by
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (ha0 j),
            ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ‖h‖)]
          congr 1
          ring
  
  have hdiag : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ j : Fin t.card, j.val < k →
      ∃ L : Set E3, MeasurableSet L ∧ Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff
        (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs (φ n) ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source)) L ∩
          ball (cs j) (rs j / 2))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨id, strictMono_id, fun j hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφL⟩ := ih
      by_cases hk : k < t.card
      · obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hcau⟩ := sepSets_cauchy_subseq (cs ⟨k, hk⟩) (rs ⟨k, hk⟩)
          (2 * a ⟨k, hk⟩ * Lr) (hrs _)
          (fun n => chartAt E3 (xs ⟨k, hk⟩) '' (Fs (φ n) ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs ⟨k, hk⟩)).source))
          (fun n => hFsm (φ n) (xs ⟨k, hk⟩)) (fun n h hh => hmod ⟨k, hk⟩ (φ n) h hh)
        obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀m, hL₀⟩ := sepSets_limit_of_cauchy (ball (cs ⟨k, hk⟩) (rs ⟨k, hk⟩ / 2))
          (fun n => chartAt E3 (xs ⟨k, hk⟩) '' (Fs (φ (ψ n)) ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs ⟨k, hk⟩)).source))
          (fun n => hFsm (φ (ψ n)) (xs ⟨k, hk⟩)) hcau
        refine ⟨φ ∘ ψ, hφ.comp hψ, fun j hj => ?_⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hj with hj' | hj'
        · obtain ⟨L, hLm, hL⟩ := hφL j hj'
          exact ⟨L, hLm, hL.comp hψ.tendsto_atTop⟩
        · have hjk : j = ⟨k, hk⟩ := Fin.ext hj'
          subst hjk
          exact ⟨L₀, hL₀m, hL₀⟩
      · refine ⟨φ, hφ, fun j hj => hφL j ?_⟩
        have := j.isLt
        omega
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφL⟩ := hdiag t.card
  choose L hLm hL using fun j : Fin t.card => hφL j j.isLt
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFm, hFK, hconv⟩ := sepGlue_chart_limits K A₀ hK hA₀ t.card xs cs
    (fun j => rs j / 2) L (fun n => Fs (φ n))
    (fun j => by show 0 < rs j / 2; linarith [hrs j])
    (fun j => by
      show closedBall (cs j) (rs j / 2) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).target
      exact (closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith [hrs j])).trans ((hcbs j).trans (himt _)))
    hcovs hLm (fun n => hFsm (φ n)) (fun n => hFsK (φ n)) hL
  
  have hle : sepRiemPer g F Ω ≤ m :=
    sepRiemPer_le_of_tendsto g Ω F (fun n => Fs (φ n)) m hFm (fun n => hFsm (φ n)) hconv
      (hlim.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
  
  exact ⟨F, hFm, hFK, fun F' hF'm hF'K => hle.trans (iInf₂_le F' ⟨hF'm, hF'K⟩)⟩

[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :

subgoal_signatures.name: sepRiemPer_le_of_tendsto
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (U F : Set M) (Fs : ℕ → Set M) (m : ENNReal) (hF : sepChartMeas F)
    (hFs : ∀ n, sepChartMeas (Fs n))
    (hconv : ∀ (p : M) (C : Set E3), IsCompact C → C ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      Tendsto (fun n => volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ C))
        atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun n => sepRiemPer g (Fs n) U) atTop (𝓝 m)) :
    sepRiemPer g F U ≤ m

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerG_one_le_mul
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (y : E3) (R : ℝ)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) U)
    (hpd : ∀ z ∈ U, (G z).PosDef) (hR : 0 < R) (hB : closedBall y R ⊆ U) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ S : Set E3,
      sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (ball y R) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal c * sepPerG G S (ball y R)

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerG_one_translate_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : Set E3) (y h : E3) (r : ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hh : ‖h‖ ≤ r) :
    volume (symmDiff S ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S) ∩ ball y r) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ‖h‖) *
        sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (ball y (3 * r))

subgoal_signatures.name: sepSets_cauchy_subseq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(y : E3) (r C : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (S : ℕ → Set E3)
    (hS : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (S n))
    (hmod : ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : E3), ‖h‖ ≤ r →
      volume (symmDiff (S n) ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S n) ∩ ball y r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ‖h‖)) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      volume (symmDiff (S (φ n)) (S (φ m)) ∩ ball y (r / 2)) < ENNReal.ofReal ε

subgoal_signatures.name: sepSets_limit_of_cauchy
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(B : Set E3) (T : ℕ → Set E3) (hT : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (T n))
    (hcau : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      volume (symmDiff (T n) (T m) ∩ B) < ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
    ∃ L : Set E3, MeasurableSet L ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (T n) L ∩ B)) atTop (𝓝 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: sepGlue_chart_limits
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (K A₀ : Set M)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hA₀ : sepChartMeas A₀) (N : ℕ) (x : Fin N → M) (c : Fin N → E3)
    (r : Fin N → ℝ) (L : Fin N → Set E3) (Fs : ℕ → Set M) (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j)
    (hball : ∀ j, closedBall (c j) (r j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (x j)).target)
    (hcover : K ⊆ ⋃ j, (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm '' ball (c j) (r j / 2))
    (hL : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (L j)) (hFs : ∀ n, sepChartMeas (Fs n))
    (hFsK : ∀ n, symmDiff (Fs n) A₀ ⊆ K)
    (hconv : ∀ j, Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (chartAt E3 (x j) '' (Fs n ∩
      (chartAt E3 (x j)).source)) (L j) ∩ ball (c j) (r j))) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃ F : Set M, sepChartMeas F ∧ symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ K ∧
      ∀ (p : M) (C : Set E3), IsCompact C → C ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target →
        Tendsto (fun n => volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ C))
          atTop (𝓝 0)

    fun x hx => ⟨le_of_lt hx.2, hFA hx.1⟩
  have hK0c : IsCompact {p : M | r₁ ≤ ρ p ∧ ρ p ≤ r₂} := by
    refine (hcpt r₂).of_isClosed_subset ?_ (fun x hx => hx.2)

def calPiece (q : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (V : M → E3) : E3 → E3 :=
  Set.indicator (chartAt E3 q).target (fun y =>
    (φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) • mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
      ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3))


def calSmoothField (V : M → E3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
    ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 q).target


def calPartition {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (Ω : Set M) : Prop :=
  (∀ j, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (φ j)) ∧ (∀ j x, 0 ≤ φ j x) ∧ (∀ x, ∑ j, φ j x ≤ 1) ∧
  ∀ j, IsCompact (tsupport (φ j)) ∧ tsupport (φ j) ⊆ Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source


def calDivSum (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (E : Set M) (V : M → E3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
    sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) V) y


def calVolSum (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (E : Set M) (h : M → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
    φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * h ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (K Ω O A₀ F : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω) (hO : IsOpen O) (hOK : O ⊆ K) (hF : sepChartMeas F)
    (hFA : symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ K) (hfin : sepRiemPer g F Ω < ⊤)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : Set M, sepChartMeas F' → symmDiff F' A₀ ⊆ K →
      sepRiemPer g F Ω ≤ sepRiemPer g F' Ω) (p : M) :
    sepIsPerMin (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
      (chartAt E3 p '' (O ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set κ := chartAt E3 p with hκ
  set G := g.coeff κ.symm with hGdef
  set Φ := κ '' (F ∩ κ.source) with hΦdef
  set U := κ '' (O ∩ κ.source) with hUdef
  have hOΩ : O ⊆ Ω := hOK.trans hKΩ
  
  have hUt : U ⊆ κ.target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact κ.map_source hx.2
  
  have hB2 : ∀ Z : Set E3, Z ⊆ U → κ.symm '' Z ⊆ O ∩ κ.source := by
    rintro Z hZ _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hZ hz
    rw [κ.left_inv hx.2]
    exact hx
  
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) κ.target :=
    fun i j => g.smooth p i j
  have hdet : ∀ y ∈ κ.target, 0 < (G y).det :=
    fun y hy => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y hy).det_pos
  
  have hloc_le : ∀ V : Set E3, IsOpen V → V ⊆ U → sepPerG G Φ V ≤ sepRiemPer g F Ω := by
    intro V hV hVU
    have hVt : V ⊆ κ.target := hVU.trans hUt
    have hWo : IsOpen (κ.symm '' V) := κ.isOpen_image_symm_of_subset_target hV hVt
    have hWsub : κ.symm '' V ⊆ Ω ∩ κ.source := fun x hx =>
      ⟨hOΩ (hB2 V hVU hx).1, (hB2 V hVU hx).2⟩
    have himg : κ '' (κ.symm '' V) = V := κ.toPartialEquiv.image_symm_image_of_subset_target hVt
    rw [← himg]
    unfold sepRiemPer
    refine le_iSup_of_le 1 (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ => p) (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ => κ.symm '' V)
      (le_iSup_of_le ⟨fun _ => ⟨hWo, hWsub⟩, fun k l hkl => (hkl (Subsingleton.elim k l)).elim⟩
        ?_)))
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one]
  unfold sepIsPerMin
  refine ⟨hF p, fun V hV _ hVU => lt_of_le_of_lt (hloc_le V hV (subset_closure.trans hVU)) hfin,
    ?_⟩
  
  intro F' V K' hF' hV _ hVU hK'c hK'V hsd
  have hVU' : V ⊆ U := subset_closure.trans hVU
  have hVt : V ⊆ κ.target := hVU'.trans hUt
  have hK't : K' ⊆ κ.target := hK'V.trans hVt
  set L := κ.symm '' K' with hLdef
  set F'' := (F \ L) ∪ κ.symm '' (F' ∩ K') with hF''def
  have hLO : L ⊆ O := fun x hx => (hB2 K' (hK'V.trans hVU') hx).1
  
  have hP1 : symmDiff F F'' ⊆ L := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨hxF, hxF''⟩ | ⟨hxF'', hxF⟩
    · by_contra hxL
      exact hxF'' (Or.inl ⟨hxF, hxL⟩)
    · rcases hxF'' with ⟨hxF', _⟩ | ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      · exact absurd hxF' hxF
      · exact ⟨z, hz.2, rfl⟩
  
  have hP2 : symmDiff F'' A₀ ⊆ K := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxF : x ∈ F
    · by_cases hxF'' : x ∈ F''
      · apply hFA
        rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨_, hA⟩ | ⟨_, hn⟩
        · exact Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hxF, hA⟩)
        · exact absurd hxF'' hn
      · exact hOK (hLO (hP1 (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hxF, hxF''⟩))))
    · by_cases hxF'' : x ∈ F''
      · exact hOK (hLO (hP1 (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hxF'', hxF⟩))))
      · apply hFA
        rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨hA, _⟩
        · exact absurd h hxF''
        · exact Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hA, hxF⟩)
  
  have hF'sub : F' \ Φ ⊆ K' := fun z hz => hsd (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr hz))
  have hΦsub : Φ \ F' ⊆ K' := fun z hz => hsd (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl hz))
  have hP3 : κ '' (F'' ∩ κ.source) = F' := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxF'', hxs⟩, rfl⟩
      rcases hxF'' with ⟨hxF, hxL⟩ | ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      · by_contra hz
        have hK : κ x ∈ K' := hΦsub ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxF, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hz⟩
        exact hxL ⟨κ x, hK, κ.left_inv hxs⟩
      · rw [κ.right_inv (hK't hw.2)]
        exact hw.1
    · intro hz
      by_cases hzK : z ∈ K'
      · exact ⟨κ.symm z, ⟨Or.inr ⟨z, ⟨hz, hzK⟩, rfl⟩, κ.map_target (hK't hzK)⟩,
          κ.right_inv (hK't hzK)⟩
      · have hzΦ : z ∈ Φ := by
          by_contra h
          exact hzK (hF'sub ⟨hz, h⟩)
        obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxF, hxs⟩, rfl⟩ := hzΦ
        refine ⟨x, ⟨Or.inl ⟨hxF, ?_⟩, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
        rintro ⟨w, hw, hwx⟩
        apply hzK
        rw [← hwx, κ.right_inv (hK't hw)]
        exact hw
  
  have hP4 : sepChartMeas F'' := by
    intro q
    set κq := chartAt E3 q with hκq
    have hI : ∀ S : Set M, κq '' (S ∩ κq.source) = κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' S := by
      intro S
      rw [Set.inter_comm S]
      exact κq.image_source_inter_eq' S
    have hLc : IsCompact L := hK'c.image_of_continuousOn (κ.continuousOn_symm.mono hK't)
    have hIL : MeasurableSet (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' L) := by
      have ho : IsOpen (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' Lᶜ) :=
        κq.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage κq.open_target hLc.isClosed.isOpen_compl
      have heq : κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' L = κq.target \ (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' Lᶜ) := by
        ext z
        simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_compl_iff]
        tauto
      rw [heq]
      exact κq.open_target.measurableSet.diff ho.measurableSet
    have hIF : MeasurableSet (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' F) := by
      rw [← hI]
      exact hF q
    have hBt : F' ∩ K' ⊆ κ.target := fun z hz => hK't hz.2
    have hBm : MeasurableSet (F' ∩ K') := hF'.inter hK'c.isClosed.measurableSet
    have hsymmB : κ.symm '' (F' ∩ K') = κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' (F' ∩ K') :=
      κ.symm_image_eq_source_inter_preimage hBt
    have hDo : IsOpen (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) :=
      κq.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage κq.open_target κ.open_source
    have hτc : ContinuousOn (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) :=
      κ.continuousOn.comp (κq.continuousOn_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun z hz => hz.2)
    have hIB : MeasurableSet ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) ∩
        (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) ⁻¹' (F' ∩ K')) := by
      have hpw : Measurable ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source).piecewise
          (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) (fun _ => (0 : E3))) :=
        hτc.measurable_piecewise continuousOn_const hDo.measurableSet
      have heq : (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) ∩ (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) ⁻¹' (F' ∩ K') =
          (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) ∩ ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source).piecewise
            (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) (fun _ => (0 : E3))) ⁻¹' (F' ∩ K') := by
        ext z
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hzD, hzB⟩
          refine ⟨hzD, ?_⟩
          simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hzD]
          exact hzB
        · rintro ⟨hzD, hzB⟩
          refine ⟨hzD, ?_⟩
          simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hzD] at hzB
          exact hzB
      rw [heq]
      exact hDo.measurableSet.inter (hpw hBm)
    have hmain : κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' F'' =
        ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' F) \ (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' L)) ∪
          ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) ∩ (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) ⁻¹' (F' ∩ K')) := by
      rw [hF''def, hsymmB]
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff]
      tauto
    show MeasurableSet (κq '' (F'' ∩ κq.source))
    rw [hI, hmain]
    exact (hIF.diff hIL).union hIB
  have hP5 : sepRiemPer g F Ω ≤ sepRiemPer g F'' Ω := hmin F'' hP4 hP2
  have hfinV : sepPerG G Φ V < ⊤ := lt_of_le_of_lt (hloc_le V hV hVU') hfin
  have hne : sepRiemPer g F Ω ≠ ⊤ := hfin.ne
  
  refine sepPerG_le_of_local_compare G κ.target Φ F' V K' κ.open_target hGs hdet (hF p) hF' hV
    hVt hK'c hK'V hsd hfinV ?_
  intro V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hK'V₂ hV₂c hV₂V₁ hV₁V
  have hV₁Ω : V₁ ⊆ κ '' (Ω ∩ κ.source) :=
    hV₁V.trans (hVU'.trans (Set.image_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hOΩ)))
  have h3 : sepRiemPer g F'' Ω + sepPerG G Φ V₂ ≤
      sepRiemPer g F Ω + sepPerG G (κ '' (F'' ∩ κ.source)) V₁ + sepPerG G Φ (V₁ \ K') :=
    sepRiemPer_add_chart_le g F F'' Ω p K' V₁ V₂ hF hP4 hK'c hV₁ hV₂ hK'V₂ hV₂c hV₂V₁ hV₁Ω hP1
  rw [hP3] at h3
  have h4 : sepRiemPer g F Ω + sepPerG G Φ V₂ ≤
      sepRiemPer g F Ω + (sepPerG G F' V₁ + sepPerG G Φ (V₁ \ K')) := by
    calc sepRiemPer g F Ω + sepPerG G Φ V₂ ≤ sepRiemPer g F'' Ω + sepPerG G Φ V₂ :=
          add_le_add hP5 le_rfl
      _ ≤ _ := h3
      _ = _ := add_assoc _ _ _
  exact (ENNReal.add_le_add_iff_left hne).1 h4

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerG_le_of_local_compare
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U Φ₁ Φ₂ V K' : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det) (hΦ₁ : MeasurableSet Φ₁) (hΦ₂ : MeasurableSet Φ₂) (hV : IsOpen V) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (hK' : IsCompact K') (hK'V : K' ⊆ V) (hsd : symmDiff Φ₁ Φ₂ ⊆ K') (hfin : sepPerG G Φ₁ V < ⊤) (hcmp : ∀ V₁ V₂ : Set E3, IsOpen V₁ → IsOpen V₂ → K' ⊆ V₂ → IsCompact (closure V₂) → closure V₂ ⊆ V₁ → V₁ ⊆ V → sepPerG G Φ₁ V₂ ≤ sepPerG G Φ₂ V₁ + sepPerG G Φ₁ (V₁ \ K')) : sepPerG G Φ₁ V ≤ sepPerG G Φ₂ V

subgoal_signatures.name: sepRiemPer_add_chart_le
subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F₁ F₂ Ω : Set M) (p : M) (K' V₁ V₂ : Set E3) (hF₁ : sepChartMeas F₁) (hF₂ : sepChartMeas F₂) (hK' : IsCompact K') (hV₁ : IsOpen V₁) (hV₂ : IsOpen V₂) (hK'V₂ : K' ⊆ V₂) (hV₂c : IsCompact (closure V₂)) (hV₂V₁ : closure V₂ ⊆ V₁) (hV₁Ω : V₁ ⊆ chartAt E3 p '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) (hsd : symmDiff F₁ F₂ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' K') : sepRiemPer g F₂ Ω + sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (F₁ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) V₂ ≤ sepRiemPer g F₁ Ω + sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (F₂ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) V₁ + sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (F₁ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) (V₁ \ K')

search_metadata.last_error: Approved: the glue compiled and consumes every child (coeff_chart_symm_posDef is the already-proved node giving hdet; sepRiemPer_add_chart_le plus hmin and ENNReal cancellation with hfin yields hcmp; sepPerG_le_of_local_compare closes clause iii), and the blueprint's s4 measurability step was inlined as hP4 with a documented Divergence. Both new children are true (checked against the perimeter-measure picture: s2 is Euclidean epsilon-localisation via super/subadditivity and vanishing annulus, s3 is Riemannian locality whose crux is chart invariance L6), each drops minimality, patching and the epsilon-limit, and the blueprint gives full proof routes plus numeric Piola evidence (E1) and adversarial checks (F1-F11); the crux is deliberately isolated in the named child s3, not hidden.

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U F : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U)
    (h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y₀, volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) (h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y₀, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 u ∧
      u (sepPlaneProj a y₀) = y₀ a ∧ sepCyl a y₀ r δ ⊆ U ∧
      ((volume ((sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)}) \ F) = 0 ∧
          volume (sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ∩ F) = 0) ∨
        (volume ((sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a}) \ F) = 0 ∧
          volume (sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} ∩ F) = 0))

signature.name: sepPerMin_C1_graph
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U F : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U)
    (h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y₀, volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) (h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y₀, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 u ∧
      u (sepPlaneProj a y₀) = y₀ a ∧ sepCyl a y₀ r δ ⊆ U ∧
      ((volume ((sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)}) \ F) = 0 ∧
          volume (sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ∩ F) = 0) ∨
        (volume ((sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a}) \ F) = 0 ∧
          volume (sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} ∩ F) = 0))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := sepPosDef_normalizer (G y₀) (hpd y₀ hy₀)
  obtain ⟨-, hG₁, hsymm₁, hpd₁, hmin₁'⟩ :=
    sepAffinePullback G F U hU hmin.1 hG hsymm hpd y₀ L 1 one_pos
  have hmin₁ := hmin₁' hmin
  have hφc : Continuous (fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) := continuous_const.add L.continuous
  have hU₁ : IsOpen ((fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U) := hU.preimage hφc
  have h0U₁ : (0 : E3) ∈ (fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U := by
    show y₀ + L 0 ∈ U
    rw [map_zero, add_zero]
    exact hy₀
  have hfd : ∀ z : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) z = (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) := by
    intro z
    rw [fderiv_const_add]
    exact L.fderiv
  have hI : (fun z => (1 : ℝ) • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) 0 = 1 := by
    ext i j
    simp only [one_smul]
    unfold pullbackMetric
    rw [hfd 0]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, map_zero, add_zero]
    rw [hL i j, Matrix.one_apply]
  
  have hφψ : ∀ y : E3, y₀ + L (L.symm (y - y₀)) = y := by
    intro y
    rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, add_sub_cancel]
  have hψφ : ∀ z : E3, L.symm (y₀ + L z - y₀) = z := by
    intro z
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hψc : Continuous (fun y : E3 => L.symm (y - y₀)) :=
    L.symm.continuous.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  have hψ0 : L.symm (y₀ - y₀) = 0 := by rw [sub_self, map_zero]
  have hψnhds : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3), (fun y : E3 => L.symm (y - y₀)) ⁻¹' N ∈ 𝓝 y₀ := by
    intro N hN
    apply hψc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
    show N ∈ 𝓝 (L.symm (y₀ - y₀))
    rw [hψ0]
    exact hN
  have hvol : ∀ S : Set E3, volume S = 0 →
      volume ((fun y : E3 => L.symm (y - y₀)) ⁻¹' S) = 0 := by
    intro S hS
    have e1 : (fun y : E3 => L.symm (y - y₀)) ⁻¹' S =
        (fun y : E3 => y + (-y₀)) ⁻¹' ((L.symm : E3 → E3) ⁻¹' S) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [e1, measure_preimage_add_right, Measure.addHaar_preimage_continuousLinearEquiv, hS,
      mul_zero]
  
  have h1₁ : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3), volume (N \ (fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ≠ 0 := by
    intro N hN hzero
    apply h1 _ (hψnhds N hN)
    have h := hvol _ hzero
    refine le_antisymm (le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h.le) (zero_le _)
    rintro y ⟨hyN, hyF⟩
    refine ⟨hyN, ?_⟩
    show ¬ (y₀ + L (L.symm (y - y₀)) ∈ F)
    rw [hφψ]
    exact hyF
  have h0₁ : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3), volume (N ∩ (fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ≠ 0 := by
    intro N hN hzero
    apply h0 _ (hψnhds N hN)
    have h := hvol _ hzero
    refine le_antisymm (le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h.le) (zero_le _)
    rintro y ⟨hyN, hyF⟩
    refine ⟨hyN, ?_⟩
    show y₀ + L (L.symm (y - y₀)) ∈ F
    rw [hφψ]
    exact hyF
  
  obtain ⟨ε, r₀, hε, hr₀, hreg⟩ := sepPerMin_flat_regular
    (fun z => (1 : ℝ) • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
    ((fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U)
    hU₁ h0U₁ hG₁ hsymm₁ hpd₁ hI hmin₁
  obtain ⟨r, ν, hr, hrr₀, hν, hflat⟩ := sepTangentHalfSpace
    (fun z => (1 : ℝ) • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
    ((fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U)
    hU₁ h0U₁ hG₁ hsymm₁ hpd₁ hI hmin₁ h1₁ h0₁ ε hε r₀ hr₀
  obtain ⟨f, N, hf, hN, hfN, hneg, hpos⟩ := hreg r ν hr hrr₀ hν hflat
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : E3 → ℝ, g = fun y => f (L.symm (y - y₀)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgapp : ∀ y, g y = f (L.symm (y - y₀)) := fun y => by rw [hg]
  have hgC : ContDiff ℝ 1 g := by
    rw [hg]
    exact hf.comp (L.symm.contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))
  have hgc : Continuous g := hgC.continuous
  have hgy₀ : g y₀ = f 0 := by rw [hgapp, hψ0]
  have hN' := hψnhds N hN
  have hneg' : volume (((fun y : E3 => L.symm (y - y₀)) ⁻¹' N ∩ {z | g z < 0}) \ F) = 0 := by
    have h := hvol _ hneg
    refine le_antisymm (le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h.le) (zero_le _)
    rintro y ⟨⟨hyN, hyg⟩, hyF⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hyN, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show f (L.symm (y - y₀)) < 0
      rw [← hgapp]
      exact hyg
    · show ¬ (y₀ + L (L.symm (y - y₀)) ∈ F)
      rw [hφψ]
      exact hyF
  have hpos' : volume ((fun y : E3 => L.symm (y - y₀)) ⁻¹' N ∩ {z | 0 < g z} ∩ F) = 0 := by
    have h := hvol _ hpos
    refine le_antisymm (le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h.le) (zero_le _)
    rintro y ⟨⟨hyN, hyg⟩, hyF⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hyN, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show 0 < f (L.symm (y - y₀))
      rw [← hgapp]
      exact hyg
    · show y₀ + L (L.symm (y - y₀)) ∈ F
      rw [hφψ]
      exact hyF
  have hdg : fderiv ℝ g y₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hfN 0 (mem_of_mem_nhds hN)
    have hfg : f = g ∘ (fun z : E3 => y₀ + L z) := by
      funext z
      simp only [Function.comp, hgapp, hψφ]
    have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g ((fun z : E3 => y₀ + L z) 0) :=
      hgC.differentiable one_ne_zero _
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : E3 => y₀ + L z) 0 :=
      (differentiableAt_const _).add L.differentiableAt
    rw [hfg, fderiv_comp 0 hgd hφd]
    have e0 : y₀ + L 0 = y₀ := by
      rw [map_zero, add_zero]
    rw [e0, hzero, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp]
  have hg0 : g y₀ = 0 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy (g y₀) 0 with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exfalso
      have hmem : (fun y : E3 => L.symm (y - y₀)) ⁻¹' N ∩ {z | g z < 0} ∈ 𝓝 y₀ :=
        Filter.inter_mem hN' ((isOpen_lt hgc continuous_const).mem_nhds hlt)
      exact h1 _ hmem hneg'
    · exact heq
    · exfalso
      have hmem : (fun y : E3 => L.symm (y - y₀)) ⁻¹' N ∩ {z | 0 < g z} ∈ 𝓝 y₀ :=
        Filter.inter_mem hN' ((isOpen_lt continuous_const hgc).mem_nhds hgt)
      exact h0 _ hmem hpos'
  
  exact sepLevelset_to_coordGraph U F hU y₀ hy₀ g _ hgC hg0 hdg hN' hneg' hpos'

          ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' V) =

      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U)) ∧

      (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) j i) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ (fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U, (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z).PosDef) ∧
    (sepIsPerMin G F U → sepIsPerMin (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)

by

  have hLa : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift a x t) a = t := by

    calc ‖w‖ = ‖sepPlaneProj a w + w a • e a‖ := congrArg _ hw
      _ ≤ ‖sepPlaneProj a w‖ + ‖w a • e a‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖sepPlaneProj a w‖ + |w a| := by

    intro x hx
    show smthLift a x (v x) ∈ U
    refine hmemU x (v x) hx ?_
    have h := abs_lt.1 (hP1 x hx)
    exact abs_lt.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  
  set V : Set E3 := sepCyl a y₀ r₁ (δ / 2) with hVdef
  have hVo : IsOpen V :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (hPc.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (hcoord.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const)
  have hVcC : IsClosed {z : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - y₀)‖ ≤ r₁ ∧ |z a - y₀ a| ≤ δ / 2} :=
    (isClosed_le (continuous_norm.comp (hPc.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp (hcoord.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const)
  have hVcK : IsCompact {z : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - y₀)‖ ≤ r₁ ∧ |z a - y₀ a| ≤ δ / 2} := by
    refine Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hVcC ?_
    exact (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := y₀) (r := r₁ + δ / 2)).subset
      (fun z hz => Metric.mem_closedBall.2 (hbdd z _ _ hz.1 hz.2))
  have hVcl : closure V ⊆ {z : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - y₀)‖ ≤ r₁ ∧ |z a - y₀ a| ≤ δ / 2} :=
    closure_minimal (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2.le⟩) hVcC
  have hVcpt : IsCompact (closure V) := hVcK.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure hVcl
  have hVU : closure V ⊆ U := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' := hVcl hz
    exact hCU z (lt_of_le_of_lt hz'.1 hr₁r) (by linarith [hz'.2])
  have hVC : V ⊆ sepCyl a y₀ r δ := fun z hz =>
    ⟨lt_trans hz.1 hr₁r, by linarith [hz.2]⟩
  have hcl : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - y₀)‖ ≤ r₁ → |z a - y₀ a| ≤ δ / 2 → z ∈ U :=
    fun z h1 h2 => hCU z (lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hr₁r) (by linarith)
  
  
  
  have hEL : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D →
      ∫ x in D, fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x) = 0 := by
    intro φ hφ hφc hφD
    obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := hφ.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hφc
    have hφM : ∀ x, |φ x| ≤ |M₀| + 1 := fun x => by
      have := hM₀ x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      linarith [le_abs_self M₀]
    have hMpos : 0 < |M₀| + 1 := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (abs_nonneg _) one_pos
    have ht₀ : 0 < δ / (8 * (|M₀| + 1)) := div_pos hδ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hMpos)
    have htφ : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < δ / (8 * (|M₀| + 1)) → ∀ x, |t * φ x| < δ / 8 := by
      intro t ht x
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |t| * |φ x| ≤ |t| * (|M₀| + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hφM x) (abs_nonneg t)
        _ < δ / (8 * (|M₀| + 1)) * (|M₀| + 1) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ht hMpos
        _ = δ / 8 := by
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_mul_right _ _ hMpos.ne']
    
    set K : Set E3 := {z | smthHoriz a z ∈ tsupport φ ∧ |z a - y₀ a| ≤ δ / 4} with hKdef
    have hKcl : IsClosed K :=
      ((isClosed_tsupport φ).preimage hHc.continuous).inter
        (isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp (hcoord.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const)
    have hKV : K ⊆ V := by
      intro z hz
      refine ⟨hprojlt z (hφD hz.1), ?_⟩
      linarith [hz.2]
    have hKc : IsCompact K := hVcK.of_isClosed_subset hKcl
      (fun z hz => ⟨(hKV hz).1.le, (hKV hz).2.le⟩)
    have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hKcl.measurableSet
    have hF₁m : MeasurableSet F₁ := hmin₁.1
    
    have hper : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < δ / (8 * (|M₀| + 1)) →
        sepPerG G {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z) + t * φ (smthHoriz a z)} V =
          ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in D, smthLag G a (x, v x + t * φ x,
            smthGrad (fun y => v y + t * φ y) x)) := by
      intro t ht
      have hvt : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => v y + t * φ y) :=
        hv.add (contDiff_const.mul (hφ.of_le h1inf))
      refine smth_subgraph_perimeter G U hU hG hsymm hpd a y₀ r₁ (δ / 2) hr₁ (by linarith) hcl
        (fun y => v y + t * φ y) hvt ?_
      intro x hx
      have h1 := abs_lt.1 (hP1 x hx)
      have h2 := abs_lt.1 (htφ t ht x)
      exact abs_lt.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hSm : ∀ t : ℝ,
        MeasurableSet {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z) + t * φ (smthHoriz a z)} := by
      intro t
      refine (isOpen_lt hcoord ?_).measurableSet
      exact (hv.continuous.comp hHc.continuous).add
        (continuous_const.mul (hφ.continuous.comp hHc.continuous))
    
    have hae1 : volume (symmDiff F₁ {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z) + 0 * φ (smthHoriz a z)}
        ∩ V) = 0 := by
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null (measure_union_null hc1 hc2)
        (smth_graph_null a u hu.continuous))
      rintro z ⟨hzd, hzV⟩
      have hzC := hVC hzV
      have e1 : u (sepPlaneProj a z) = v (smthHoriz a z) := huv z
      have hS : z ∈ {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z) + 0 * φ (smthHoriz a z)} ↔
          z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z) := by
        rw [e1]; simp
      rw [Set.mem_symmDiff, hS] at hzd
      rcases lt_trichotomy (z a) (u (sepPlaneProj a z)) with h | h | h
      · left; left
        refine ⟨⟨hzC, h⟩, ?_⟩
        intro hzF
        rcases hzd with ⟨_, hS'⟩ | ⟨_, hF⟩
        · exact hS' h
        · exact hF hzF
      · right; exact h
      · left; right
        refine ⟨⟨hzC, h⟩, ?_⟩
        rcases hzd with ⟨hF, _⟩ | ⟨hS', _⟩
        · exact hF
        · exact absurd hS' (by linarith)
    
    have key : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < δ / (8 * (|M₀| + 1)) →
        (∫ x in D, smthLag G a (x, v x + 0 * φ x, smthGrad (fun y => v y + 0 * φ y) x)) ≤
          ∫ x in D, smthLag G a (x, v x + t * φ x, smthGrad (fun y => v y + t * φ y) x) := by
      intro t ht
      set St : Set E3 := {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z) + t * φ (smthHoriz a z)} with hStdef
      set S₀ : Set E3 := {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z) + 0 * φ (smthHoriz a z)}
        with hS₀def
      set F' : Set E3 := (F₁ \ K) ∪ (St ∩ K) with hF'def
      have hF'm : MeasurableSet F' := (hF₁m.diff hKm).union ((hSm t).inter hKm)
      have hsd : symmDiff F₁ F' ⊆ K := by
        intro z hz
        by_contra hzK
        rw [Set.mem_symmDiff] at hz
        rcases hz with ⟨hF, hF'⟩ | ⟨hF', hF⟩
        · exact hF' (Or.inl ⟨hF, hzK⟩)
        · rcases hF' with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩
          · exact hF h
          · exact hzK h
      have hle := hmin₁.2.2 F' V K hF'm hVo hVcpt hVU hKc hKV hsd
      have hae2 : volume (symmDiff F' St ∩ V) = 0 := by
        refine measure_mono_null ?_ hae1
        rintro z ⟨hzd, hzV⟩
        refine ⟨?_, hzV⟩
        by_cases hzK : z ∈ K
        · exfalso
          rw [Set.mem_symmDiff] at hzd
          rcases hzd with ⟨hF', hS⟩ | ⟨hS, hF'⟩
          · rcases hF' with ⟨_, hK'⟩ | ⟨hS', _⟩
            · exact hK' hzK
            · exact hS hS'
          · exact hF' (Or.inr ⟨hS, hzK⟩)
        · have hF : z ∈ F' ↔ z ∈ F₁ :=
            ⟨fun h => h.elim (fun h => h.1) (fun h => absurd h.2 hzK),
              fun h => Or.inl ⟨h, hzK⟩⟩
          have hS : z ∈ St ↔ z ∈ S₀ := by
            show z a < v (smthHoriz a z) + t * φ (smthHoriz a z) ↔
              z a < v (smthHoriz a z) + 0 * φ (smthHoriz a z)
            by_cases hφz : φ (smthHoriz a z) = 0
            · rw [hφz]; simp
            · have hsupp : smthHoriz a z ∈ tsupport φ := subset_tsupport _ hφz
              have hzD : s (smthHoriz a z) < r₁ ^ 2 := hφD hsupp
              have hfar : δ / 4 < |z a - y₀ a| := by
                by_contra hc
                push_neg at hc
                exact hzK ⟨hsupp, hc⟩
              have h1 := abs_lt.1 (hP1 _ (le_of_lt hzD))
              have h2 := abs_lt.1 (htφ t ht (smthHoriz a z))
              rw [zero_mul, add_zero]
              rcases lt_abs.1 hfar with h | h
              · constructor
                · intro hc; exfalso; linarith
                · intro hc; exfalso; linarith
              · exact ⟨fun _ => by linarith, fun _ => by linarith⟩
          rw [Set.mem_symmDiff] at hzd ⊢
          rw [hF, hS] at hzd
          exact hzd
      have e0 : sepPerG G F₁ V = sepPerG G S₀ V :=
        smth_sepPerG_ae_congr G F₁ S₀ V hF₁m (hSm 0) hae1
      have et : sepPerG G F' V = sepPerG G St V :=
        smth_sepPerG_ae_congr G F' St V hF'm (hSm t) hae2
      rw [e0, et, hper 0 (by rw [abs_zero]; exact ht₀), hper t ht] at hle
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff
        (integral_nonneg fun x => mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))).1 hle
    have hderiv := smth_firstVariation (smthLag G a)
      {w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | smthLift a w.1 w.2.1 ∈ U} hOo (hΛs.of_le h1inf)
      D {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | s x ≤ r₁ ^ 2} hDo.measurableSet hKd
      (fun x hx => show s x ≤ r₁ ^ 2 from le_of_lt (show s x < r₁ ^ 2 from hx)) v φ hv
      (hφ.of_le h1inf) hvOK
    refine IsLocalMin.hasDerivAt_eq_zero ?_ hderiv
    exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds (neg_lt_zero.2 ht₀) ht₀)
      (fun t ht => key t (abs_lt.2 ht))
  
  
  
  have hvOD : ∀ x ∈ D,
      (x, v x, smthGrad v x) ∈ {w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | smthLift a w.1 w.2.1 ∈ U} :=
    fun x hx => hvOK x (show s x ≤ r₁ ^ 2 from le_of_lt (show s x < r₁ ^ 2 from hx))
  have hhol := smth_weak_C1_holder (smthLag G a) _ hOo hΛs hell D hDo v hv hvOD hEL
  have hvs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v D :=
    smth_weak_holder_smooth (smthLag G a) _ hOo hΛs hell D hDo v hv hvOD hEL hhol
  have hELs : ∀ x ∈ D, smthELop (smthLag G a) v x = 0 :=
    smth_strongEL_of_weak (smthLag G a) _ hOo hΛs D hDo v hvs hvOD hEL
  
  
  
  have hgap : 0 < 9 * r₁ ^ 2 / 16 - r₁ ^ 2 / 4 := by
    have := pow_pos hr₁ 2; linarith
  set χ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x =>
    Real.smoothTransition ((9 * r₁ ^ 2 / 16 - s x) / (9 * r₁ ^ 2 / 16 - r₁ ^ 2 / 4)) with hχdef
  have hχc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ :=
    Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_const.sub hscd).div_const _)
  have hχ1 : ∀ x, s x ≤ r₁ ^ 2 / 4 → χ x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    refine Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le ?_
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hgap]
    linarith
  have hχ0 : ∀ x, 9 * r₁ ^ 2 / 16 ≤ s x → χ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
      (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hgap.le)
  set vt : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => χ x * v x with hvtdef
  have hvtc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ vt := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hx : s x < r₁ ^ 2
    · exact hχc.contDiffAt.mul (hvs.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hx))
    · push_neg at hx
      have hr2 := pow_pos hr₁ 2
      have hev : vt =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => 0 := by
        have hopen : IsOpen {y | 9 * r₁ ^ 2 / 16 < s y} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hscont
        filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds (show 9 * r₁ ^ 2 / 16 < s x by linarith)] with y hy
        show χ y * v y = 0
        rw [hχ0 y (le_of_lt hy), zero_mul]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hsmall : ∀ z, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - y₀)‖ < r₁ / 2 → s (smthHoriz a z) < r₁ ^ 2 / 4 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [← hsGc]
    have h := sq_lt_sq' (by linarith [norm_nonneg (sepPlaneProj a (z - y₀))]) hz
    linarith
  refine ⟨fun y => vt (smthHoriz a y), r₁ / 2, half_pos hr₁, by linarith, hvtc.comp hHc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro z hz
    show vt (smthHoriz a (sepPlaneProj a z)) = u (sepPlaneProj a z)
    rw [hHP, huv]
    show χ (smthHoriz a z) * v (smthHoriz a z) = v (smthHoriz a z)
    rw [hχ1 _ (hsmall z hz).le, one_mul]
  
  
  
  · intro z hz hzg
    beta_reduce at hzg ⊢
    have hzU : z ∈ U := hCU z (lt_trans hz.1 (by linarith)) hz.2
    have hsx : s (smthHoriz a z) < r₁ ^ 2 / 4 := hsmall z hz.1
    have hxD : smthHoriz a z ∈ D := show s (smthHoriz a z) < r₁ ^ 2 by
      have := pow_pos hr₁ 2; linarith
    have hev : vt =ᶠ[𝓝 (smthHoriz a z)] v := by
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt hscont continuous_const).mem_nhds hsx] with y hy
      show χ y * v y = v y
      rw [hχ1 y (le_of_lt hy), one_mul]
    have hvtx : vt (smthHoriz a z) = v (smthHoriz a z) := hev.self_of_nhds
    have hza : z a = vt (smthHoriz a z) := by rw [hzg, hHP]
    have hzlift : smthLift a (smthHoriz a z) (vt (smthHoriz a z)) = z := by
      rw [← hza]; exact hGz z
    have hfun : (fun w : E3 => w a - vt (smthHoriz a (sepPlaneProj a w))) =
        (fun w => w a - vt (smthHoriz a w)) := by
      funext w; rw [hHP]
    have h9 := smth_ELop_eq_meanCurv G U hU hG hsymm hpd a vt hvtc (smthHoriz a z)
      (by rw [hzlift]; exact hzU)
    rw [hzlift] at h9
    have hg : smthGrad vt =ᶠ[𝓝 (smthHoriz a z)] smthGrad v := by
      filter_upwards [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ) hev] with y hy
      unfold smthGrad
      rw [hy]
    have hgx : smthGrad vt (smthHoriz a z) = smthGrad v (smthHoriz a z) := hg.self_of_nhds
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin 2,
        (fun y => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) (y, vt y, smthGrad vt y) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1))
          =ᶠ[𝓝 (smthHoriz a z)]
          (fun y => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) (y, v y, smthGrad v y) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1)) := by
      intro k
      filter_upwards [hev, hg] with y hy1 hy2
      rw [hy1, hy2]
    have hloc : smthELop (smthLag G a) vt (smthHoriz a z) =
        smthELop (smthLag G a) v (smthHoriz a z) := by
      unfold smthELop
      rw [hvtx, hgx]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      rw [(hk k).fderiv_eq]
    rw [hloc, hELs _ hxD] at h9
    have hdet : 0 < Real.sqrt (G z).det := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpd z hzU).det_pos
    rw [hfun]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h9.symm with h | h
    · exact absurd h hdet.ne'
    · exact h

(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U F : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
