subgoal_signatures.name: smth_subgraph_perimeter
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (a : Fin 3) (c : E3) (ρ h : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hcl : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ ≤ ρ → |z a - c a| ≤ h → z ∈ U)
    (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v)
    (hin : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 →
      |v x - c a| < h) :
    sepPerG G {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)} (sepCyl a c ρ h) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in smthDisc a c ρ, smthLag G a (x, v x, smthGrad v x))

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_firstVariation
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΛ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Λ O)
    (D K : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hK : IsCompact K) (hDK : D ⊆ K)
    (v φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ)
    (hvO : ∀ x ∈ K, (x, v x, smthGrad v x) ∈ O) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ x in D, Λ (x, v x + t * φ x, smthGrad (fun y => v y + t * φ y) x))
      (∫ x in D, fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x)) 0

subgoal_signatures.statement:

    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (a : Fin 3) :
    IsOpen {w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | smthLift a w.1 w.2.1 ∈ U} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (smthLag G a) {w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | smthLift a w.1 w.2.1 ∈ U} ∧
    ∀ w ∈ {w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | smthLift a w.1 w.2.1 ∈ U},

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_weak_C1_holder
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΛ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ O)
    (hell : ∀ w ∈ O, ∀ q : Fin 2 → ℝ, q ≠ 0 →
      0 < fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, q)) w (0, 0, q))
    (D : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hD : IsOpen D) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v)
    (hvO : ∀ x ∈ D, (x, v x, smthGrad v x) ∈ O)
    (hEL : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D →

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ),
      (∀ y : E3, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) g y‖ ≤ C) →
      ∀ y z : E3, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g z - iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g y‖ ≤ C * ‖z - y‖ := by
    intro g hg n C hC y z
    have hd : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g) :=
      hg.differentiable_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast ENat.coe_lt_top n)
    refine Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (fun x _ => hd x) (fun x _ => ?_)
      convex_univ (Set.mem_univ y) (Set.mem_univ z)
    rw [norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv]
    exact hC x
  
  have s2 : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : ℝ),
      (∀ y : E3, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 2) g y‖ ≤ C) → ∀ (y h : E3),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g (y + h) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g y -
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) g y)) h‖ ≤ C * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro g hg n C hC y h
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hC 0)
    have hL1 := s1 g hg (n + 1) C hC
    have hd : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g) :=
      hg.differentiable_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast ENat.coe_lt_top n)
    have hfd : ∀ z, fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g) z =
        continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) g z) := fun z => by
      rw [fderiv_iteratedFDeriv]; rfl
    set A := continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) g y) with hA
    have hψ : ∀ z, HasFDerivAt (fun z => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g z - A z)
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) g z) - A) z := by
      intro z
      have h1 := (hd z).hasFDerivAt
      rw [hfd z] at h1
      exact h1.sub A.hasFDerivAt
    have hbound : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y ‖h‖,
        ‖continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) g z) - A‖ ≤ C * ‖h‖ := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hA, ← LinearIsometryEquiv.map_sub, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
      calc _ ≤ C * ‖z - y‖ := hL1 y z
        _ ≤ C * ‖h‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by rwa [← dist_eq_norm]) hC0
    have hyh : y + h ∈ Metric.closedBall y ‖h‖ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
    have key := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le
      (fun z _ => (hψ z).hasFDerivWithinAt) hbound (convex_closedBall y ‖h‖)
      (Metric.mem_closedBall_self (norm_nonneg h)) hyh
    have e : (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g (y + h) - A (y + h)) - (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g y - A y) =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g (y + h) - iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g y - A h := by
      rw [map_add]; abel
    simp only at key
    rw [e, add_sub_cancel_left] at key
    calc _ ≤ C * ‖h‖ * ‖h‖ := key
      _ = C * ‖h‖ ^ 2 := by ring
  
  have s4 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : ℕ → E3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => E3) ℝ) (C : ℝ),
      (∀ k (y z : E3), ‖g k z - g k y‖ ≤ C * ‖z - y‖) → ∀ (Q : Set E3), Dense Q →
      (∀ q ∈ Q, ∃ L, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => g k q) Filter.atTop (𝓝 L)) →
      ∀ y : E3, ∃ L, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => g k y) Filter.atTop (𝓝 L) := by
    intro n g C hL Q hQ hconv y
    apply cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete
    rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
    intro ε hε
    have hDpos : 0 < max C 0 + 1 := by have := le_max_right C 0; linarith
    have hL' : ∀ k (y z : E3), dist (g k z) (g k y) ≤ (max C 0 + 1) * dist z y := by
      intro k y z
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      calc _ ≤ C * ‖z - y‖ := hL k y z
        _ ≤ (max C 0 + 1) * ‖z - y‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [le_max_left C 0]) (norm_nonneg _)
    obtain ⟨q, hqQ, hq⟩ := hQ.exists_dist_lt y (show 0 < ε / (3 * (max C 0 + 1)) by positivity)
    obtain ⟨L, hLq⟩ := hconv q hqQ
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.1 hLq.cauchySeq (ε / 3) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hL' m q y
    have h2 := hL' n q y
    have h3 := hN m hm n hn
    have hDq : (max C 0 + 1) * dist y q < ε / 3 := by
      calc (max C 0 + 1) * dist y q < (max C 0 + 1) * (ε / (3 * (max C 0 + 1))) :=
            mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hq hDpos
        _ = ε / 3 := by field_simp
    calc dist (g m y) (g n y) ≤ dist (g m y) (g m q) + dist (g m q) (g n q) +
          dist (g n q) (g n y) := dist_triangle4 _ _ _ _
      _ < ε := by rw [dist_comm (g n q)]; linarith
  
  have s5 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : E3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => E3) ℝ)
      (A : E3 →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => E3) ℝ) (y : E3) (C : ℝ),
      (∀ h : E3, ‖G (y + h) - G y - A h‖ ≤ C * ‖h‖ ^ 2) → HasFDerivAt G A y := by
    intro n G A y C hC
    rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero]
    have h1 : (fun h => G (y + h) - G y - A h) =O[𝓝 0] (fun h : E3 => ‖h‖ ^ 2) :=
      Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound C (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun h => by
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; exact hC h)
    exact h1.trans_isLittleO (Asymptotics.isLittleO_norm_pow_id (by norm_num))
  
  have s6 : ∀ (G : (n : ℕ) → E3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => E3) ℝ),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (y : E3), HasFDerivAt (G n)
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ (G (n + 1) y)) y) →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => G 0 y 0) ∧
        ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => G 0 y 0) = G n := by
    intro G hG
    have claim : ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => G 0 y 0) = G n := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        funext y; ext m
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply]
        congr 1; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left, ih]
        funext y
        simp only [Function.comp_apply]
        rw [(hG n y).fderiv]
        exact LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _
    refine ⟨?_, claim⟩
    apply contDiff_of_differentiable_iteratedFDeriv
    intro m _
    rw [claim m]
    exact fun y => (hG m y).differentiableAt
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQc, hQd⟩ := TopologicalSpace.exists_countable_dense E3
  haveI : Countable Q := hQc.to_subtype
  
  have hcpt : ∀ a : ℕ × ι × Q, IsCompact (Metric.closedBall
      (0 : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin a.1 => E3) ℝ) (B a.1)) := by
    intro a
    haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ (ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin a.1 => E3) ℝ) :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_injective (ContinuousMultilinearMap.toMultilinearMapLinear (R' := ℝ)
        (A := ℝ) (M₁ := fun _ : Fin a.1 => E3) (M₂ := ℝ))
        ContinuousMultilinearMap.toMultilinearMap_injective
    haveI : ProperSpace (ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin a.1 => E3) ℝ) :=
      FiniteDimensional.proper_real _
    exact isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have hK := isCompact_univ_pi hcpt
  obtain ⟨p, -, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ := hK.tendsto_subseq
    (x := fun m (a : ℕ × ι × Q) => iteratedFDeriv ℝ a.1 (f m a.2.1) (a.2.2 : E3))
    (fun m => Set.mem_univ_pi.2 fun a => mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 (hb m a.2.1 a.1 a.2.2))
  have hQconv : ∀ a : ℕ × ι × Q, Tendsto
      (fun k => iteratedFDeriv ℝ a.1 (f (φ k) a.2.1) (a.2.2 : E3)) atTop (𝓝 (p a)) :=
    fun a => tendsto_pi_nhds.1 hlim a
  have hconv : ∀ (i : ι) (n : ℕ) (y : E3),
      ∃ L : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => E3) ℝ,
      Tendsto (fun k => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f (φ k) i) y) atTop (𝓝 L) := by
    intro i n
    exact s4 n (fun k => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f (φ k) i)) (B (n + 1))
      (fun k y z => s1 (f (φ k) i) (hf _ _) n (B (n + 1)) (fun y => hb (φ k) i (n + 1) y) y z)
      Q hQd (fun q hq => ⟨_, hQconv (n, i, ⟨q, hq⟩)⟩)
  choose G hG using hconv
  have hder : ∀ i n y, HasFDerivAt (G i n)
      (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ (G i (n + 1) y)) y := by
    intro i n y
    apply s5 n (G i n) _ y (B (n + 2))
    intro h
    have hc : Continuous (fun v : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ =>
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ v) h) :=
      (continuous_eval_const h).comp
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ).continuous
    have hu : Tendsto (fun k => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f (φ k) i) (y + h) -
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f (φ k) i) y -
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) (f (φ k) i) y)) h) atTop
        (𝓝 (G i n (y + h) - G i n y - (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ
          (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => E3) ℝ (G i (n + 1) y)) h)) :=
      ((hG i n (y + h)).sub (hG i n y)).sub ((hc.tendsto _).comp (hG i (n + 1) y))
    exact le_of_tendsto' hu.norm
      (fun k => s2 (f (φ k) i) (hf _ _) n (B (n + 2)) (hb (φ k) i (n + 2)) y h)
  have hsm := fun i => s6 (G i) (hder i)
  refine ⟨φ, fun i y => G i 0 y 0, hφ, fun i => (hsm i).1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i y
    have hc : Continuous (fun v : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin 0 => E3) ℝ => v 0) :=
      continuous_eval_const _
    have h1 := (hc.tendsto _).comp (hG i 0 y)
    refine h1.congr (fun k => ?_)
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply]
  · intro i n y
    rw [(hsm i).2 n]
    exact hG i n y

[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M) (a : Fin 3)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y hy
  
  
  have hPDlem : ∀ y' : E3, y' ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y').PosDef := by
    classical
    intro y' hy'
    have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y' ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy'
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y' :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy'
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y') :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y' =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y')).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y') := mfderiv_comp y' hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y' =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y' := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy'] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y')
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y' w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y' w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro ξ hξ
      have hvx : (∑ i, ξ i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hξ
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm y') _ hDv
      have key : star ξ ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y').mulVec ξ =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y')
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y' (∑ i, ξ i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y' (∑ i, ξ i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  
  let Pl : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3 :=
    { toFun := coordPlaneProj a
      map_add' := fun x y => by
        simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, add_smul]; abel
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, smul_sub,
          mul_smul] }
  let Pc : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap Pl
  have hPc : ∀ w, Pc w = coordPlaneProj a w := fun w => rfl
  let πl : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun z => z a
      map_add' := fun x y => by simp
      map_smul' := fun r x => by simp }
  let πc : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap πl
  have hπc : ∀ w, πc w = w a := fun w => rfl
  
  have hea : (e a) a = 1 := by simp [e]
  have hPP : ∀ (w : E3) (t : ℝ),
      coordPlaneProj a (coordPlaneProj a w + t • e a) = coordPlaneProj a w := by
    intro w t
    have h1 : (coordPlaneProj a w + t • e a) a = t := by simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
    show (coordPlaneProj a w + t • e a) - ((coordPlaneProj a w + t • e a) a) • e a = _
    rw [h1, add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hPe : coordPlaneProj a (e a) = 0 := by
    show e a - ((e a) a) • e a = 0
    rw [hea, one_smul, sub_self]
  
  have hdiff : ∀ u : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ u →
      Differentiable ℝ u ∧ Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) := by
    intro u hu
    have hu2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 u := hu.of_le (by norm_cast)
    exact ⟨hu2.differentiable (by norm_num),
      (hu2.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable (by norm_num)⟩
  
  have hpd1 : ∀ u : E3 → ℝ, Differentiable ℝ u → ∀ (w : E3) (i : Fin 3),
      partialDeriv i (fun z => z a - u (coordPlaneProj a z)) w =
        (e i) a - fderiv ℝ u (coordPlaneProj a w) (coordPlaneProj a (e i)) := by
    intro u hu w i
    have h : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => z a - u (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (πc - (fderiv ℝ u (coordPlaneProj a w)).comp Pc) w :=
      πc.hasFDerivAt.sub ((hu (Pc w)).hasFDerivAt.comp w Pc.hasFDerivAt)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hPc, hπc]
  have hpd2 : ∀ u : E3 → ℝ, Differentiable ℝ u → Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) →
      ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun w => w a - u (coordPlaneProj a w))) z =
        -(fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) (coordPlaneProj a z) (coordPlaneProj a (e i))
          (coordPlaneProj a (e j))) := by
    intro u hu hdu z i j
    have hfun : partialDeriv j (fun w => w a - u (coordPlaneProj a w)) =
        fun w => (e j) a - fderiv ℝ u (Pc w) (coordPlaneProj a (e j)) :=
      funext fun w => hpd1 u hu w j
    rw [hfun]
    have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun w => fderiv ℝ u (Pc w))
        ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) (Pc z)).comp Pc) z :=
      (hdu (Pc z)).hasFDerivAt.comp z Pc.hasFDerivAt
    have hd := hc.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (coordPlaneProj a (e j)) z)
    have h := hd.const_sub ((e j) a)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h.fderiv]
    simp [hPc]
  
  set x := coordPlaneProj a y with hx
  have hPP' : ∀ t : ℝ, coordPlaneProj a (x + t • e a) = x := fun t => hPP y t
  
  have hD0 : Tendsto (fun k => v k x) atTop (𝓝 (V x)) := by
    have h := ((continuous_eval_const (fun _ : Fin 0 => (0 : E3))).tendsto _).comp
      (hconv 0 (by norm_num) x)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply] using h
  have hD1 : ∀ h : E3, Tendsto (fun k => fderiv ℝ (v k) x h) atTop (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ V x h)) := by
    intro h
    have h' := ((continuous_eval_const (fun _ : Fin 1 => h)).tendsto _).comp
      (hconv 1 (by norm_num) x)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, iteratedFDeriv_one_apply] using h'
  have hD2 : ∀ h₁ h₂ : E3, Tendsto (fun k => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (v k)) x h₁ h₂) atTop
      (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x h₁ h₂)) := by
    intro h₁ h₂
    have h' := ((continuous_eval_const ![h₁, h₂]).tendsto _).comp (hconv 2 (by norm_num) x)
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons] using h'
  
  have hslab : |V x - (chartAt E3 p p) a| ≤ 8 * ρ :=
    le_of_tendsto' ((hD0.sub_const _).abs) (fun k => (hsheet k y hy).1.le)
  have hz : Tendsto (fun k => x + v k x • e a) atTop (𝓝 (x + V x • e a)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.add (hD0.smul_const (e a))
  have hz0T : x + V x • e a ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    apply hball
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
    have heq : x + V x • e a - chartAt E3 p p =
        coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p) + (V x - (chartAt E3 p p) a) • e a := by
      rw [hx]
      simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
      abel
    rw [heq]
    have hne : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by simp [e]
    calc ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p) + (V x - (chartAt E3 p p) a) • e a‖
        ≤ ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ + ‖(V x - (chartAt E3 p p) a) • e a‖ :=
          norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ + |V x - (chartAt E3 p p) a| := by
          rw [norm_smul, hne, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ 10 * ρ := by linarith
  
  set G := g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm with hGdef
  have hTo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
  have hsm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    fun i j => g.smooth p i j
  have hnhds : (chartAt E3 p).target ∈ 𝓝 (x + V x • e a) := hTo.mem_nhds hz0T
  have hGt : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun k => G (x + v k x • e a) i j) atTop
      (𝓝 (G (x + V x • e a) i j)) :=
    fun i j => ((hsm i j).continuousOn.continuousAt hnhds).tendsto.comp hz
  have hdGt : ∀ i j l : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun k => partialDeriv l (fun w => G w i j) (x + v k x • e a))
      atTop (𝓝 (partialDeriv l (fun w => G w i j) (x + V x • e a))) := by
    intro i j l
    have hc := (((hsm i j).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hTo
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).continuousAt hnhds).tendsto.comp hz
    exact ((continuous_eval_const (e l)).tendsto _).comp hc
  have hPD : (G (x + V x • e a)).PosDef := hPDlem _ hz0T
  have hdet : (G (x + V x • e a)).det ≠ 0 := hPD.det_pos.ne'
  have hGm : Tendsto (fun k => G (x + v k x • e a)) atTop (𝓝 (G (x + V x • e a))) :=
    tendsto_pi_nhds.2 fun i => tendsto_pi_nhds.2 fun j => hGt i j
  have hinvc : ContinuousAt Inv.inv (G (x + V x • e a)) := by
    apply continuousAt_matrix_inv
    rw [Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    exact continuousAt_inv₀ hdet
  have hGinvm := hinvc.tendsto.comp hGm
  have hGinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun k => (G (x + v k x • e a))⁻¹ i j) atTop
      (𝓝 ((G (x + V x • e a))⁻¹ i j)) :=
    fun i j => tendsto_pi_nhds.1 (tendsto_pi_nhds.1 hGinvm i) j
  
  have hvd : ∀ k, Differentiable ℝ (v k) ∧ Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ (v k)) :=
    fun k => hdiff (v k) (hv k)
  have hVd := hdiff V hV
  have h1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, Tendsto
      (fun k => partialDeriv i (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + v k x • e a))
      atTop (𝓝 (partialDeriv i (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a))) := by
    intro i
    rw [hpd1 V hVd.1, hPP']
    refine (tendsto_const_nhds.sub (hD1 (coordPlaneProj a (e i)))).congr (fun k => ?_)
    rw [hpd1 (v k) (hvd k).1, hPP']
  have h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Tendsto
      (fun k => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z)))
        (x + v k x • e a))
      atTop (𝓝 (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)))
        (x + V x • e a))) := by
    intro i j
    rw [hpd2 V hVd.1 hVd.2, hPP']
    refine (hD2 _ _).neg.congr (fun k => ?_)
    rw [hpd2 (v k) (hvd k).1 (hvd k).2, hPP']
  
  have hchr : ∀ m i j : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun k => christoffel G m i j (x + v k x • e a)) atTop
      (𝓝 (christoffel G m i j (x + V x • e a))) := by
    intro m i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact tendsto_const_nhds.mul (tendsto_finset_sum _ fun l _ =>
      (hGinv m l).mul (((hdGt j l i).add (hdGt i l j)).sub (hdGt i j l)))
  have hhess : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Tendsto
      (fun k => hessLoc G (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z)) i j (x + v k x • e a))
      atTop (𝓝 (hessLoc G (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) i j (x + V x • e a))) := by
    intro i j
    unfold hessLoc
    exact (h2 i j).sub (tendsto_finset_sum _ fun m _ => (hchr m i j).mul (h1 m))
  have hlap : Tendsto
      (fun k => lapLoc G (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + v k x • e a))
      atTop (𝓝 (lapLoc G (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a))) := by
    unfold lapLoc
    exact tendsto_finset_sum _ fun i _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      (hGinv i j).mul (hhess i j)
  have hN : Tendsto (fun k => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (x + v k x • e a))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + v k x • e a) *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + v k x • e a))
      atTop (𝓝 (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (x + V x • e a))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a) *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a))) :=
    tendsto_finset_sum _ fun i _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      ((hGinv i j).mul (h1 i)).mul (h1 j)
  have hnum : Tendsto (fun k => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a' : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G (x + v k x • e a))⁻¹ i a' *
          partialDeriv a' (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + v k x • e a) *
        ((G (x + v k x • e a))⁻¹ j b *
          partialDeriv b (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + v k x • e a)) *
        hessLoc G (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z)) i j (x + v k x • e a))
      atTop (𝓝 (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a' : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G (x + V x • e a))⁻¹ i a' *
          partialDeriv a' (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a) *
        ((G (x + V x • e a))⁻¹ j b *
          partialDeriv b (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a)) *
        hessLoc G (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) i j (x + V x • e a))) :=
    tendsto_finset_sum _ fun i _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      tendsto_finset_sum _ fun a' _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
        (((hGinv i a').mul (h1 a')).mul ((hGinv j b).mul (h1 b))).mul (hhess i j)
  
  have hξ : (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a))
      ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h' := congrFun h a
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, hpd1 V hVd.1, hPP', hPe, map_zero, hea, sub_zero,
      one_ne_zero] at h'
  have hN0 : 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (x + V x • e a))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a) *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a) := by
    have h := hPD.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum] at h
    refine lt_of_lt_of_eq h (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_)
    ring
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (x + V x • e a))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a) *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a)) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hN0).ne'
  
  have key : Tendsto
      (fun k => levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + v k x • e a))
      atTop (𝓝 (levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + V x • e a))) :=
    (hlap.div hN.sqrt hsq).sub (hnum.div (hN.sqrt.pow 3) (pow_ne_zero 3 hsq))
  have hzero : ∀ k, levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z))
      (x + v k x • e a) = 0 := fun k => (hsheet k y hy).2
  have hconst : Tendsto
      (fun k => levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z)) (x + v k x • e a))
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simp only [hzero]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique key hconst

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (p : M) (a : Fin 3) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target)
    (U V : E3 → ℝ) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (hslabU : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      |U (coordPlaneProj a y) - (chartAt E3 p p) a| ≤ 8 * ρ)
    (hslabV : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      |V (coordPlaneProj a y) - (chartAt E3 p p) a| ≤ 8 * ρ)
    (hMU : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => z a - U (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (coordPlaneProj a y + U (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) = 0)
    (hMV : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (coordPlaneProj a y + V (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) = 0)
    (hle : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      U (coordPlaneProj a y) ≤ V (coordPlaneProj a y)) :
    ∀ y₁ : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y₁ - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      V (coordPlaneProj a y₁) - U (coordPlaneProj a y₁) = 0 →
      ∃ (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (r lam Lam K : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < lam ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ r, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ ∧
          (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * v i * v j) ∧
          (∀ i j, |A y i j| ≤ Lam) ∧
          ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
              (fun y' => V (coordPlaneProj a y') - U (coordPlaneProj a y'))) y ≤
            K * ((V (coordPlaneProj a y) - U (coordPlaneProj a y)) +
              ∑ i, |partialDeriv i
                (fun y' => V (coordPlaneProj a y') - U (coordPlaneProj a y')) y|)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y₁ hy₁ h0
  
  
  
  have coeff_chart_symm_posDef : ∀ y : E3, y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro y hy
    classical
    have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : dotProduct (star x) ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).mulVec x) =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  
  
  have coordPlaneProj_graph_partials : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (φ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z)) ∧
      (∀ (y : E3) (t : ℝ) (k : Fin 3),
        partialDeriv k (fun z => z a - φ (coordPlaneProj a z)) (coordPlaneProj a y + t • e a) =
          (if k = a then 1 else 0) - partialDeriv k (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z)) y) ∧
      (∀ (y : E3) (t : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3),
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => z a - φ (coordPlaneProj a z)))
            (coordPlaneProj a y + t • e a) =
          -partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z))) y) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, partialDeriv a (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z)) y = 0) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (partialDeriv k (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z)))) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3,
        Continuous (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z))))) := by
    intro a φ hφ
    have hpadd : ∀ (x y : E3),
        coordPlaneProj a (x + y) = coordPlaneProj a x + coordPlaneProj a y := by
      intro x y
      simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, add_smul]
      abel
    have hpsmul : ∀ (r : ℝ) (x : E3), coordPlaneProj a (r • x) = r • coordPlaneProj a x := by
      intro r x
      simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_sub, mul_smul]
    have hplin : IsLinearMap ℝ (coordPlaneProj a) := ⟨hpadd, hpsmul⟩
    let πL : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (IsLinearMap.mk' _ hplin)
    have hπcd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (coordPlaneProj a) := πL.contDiff
    have hπc : Continuous (coordPlaneProj a) := hπcd.continuous
    have hea : coordPlaneProj a (e a) = 0 := by
      simp [coordPlaneProj]
    have hya : ∀ y : E3, (coordPlaneProj a y) a = 0 := by
      intro y
      simp [coordPlaneProj]
    have hidem : ∀ y : E3, coordPlaneProj a (coordPlaneProj a y) = coordPlaneProj a y := by
      intro y
      show coordPlaneProj a y - (coordPlaneProj a y) a • e a = coordPlaneProj a y
      rw [hya, zero_smul, sub_zero]
    have hshift : ∀ (y : E3) (t : ℝ),
        coordPlaneProj a (coordPlaneProj a y + t • e a) = coordPlaneProj a y := by
      intro y t
      rw [hpadd, hpsmul, hea, smul_zero, add_zero, hidem]
    have hφ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ := hφ.of_le (by norm_cast)
    have hφ2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ := hφ.of_le (by norm_cast)
    have hφd : Differentiable ℝ φ := hφ1.differentiable one_ne_zero
    have hφπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z)) := hφ.comp πL.contDiff
    have hφπd : Differentiable ℝ (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z)) :=
      hφd.comp πL.differentiable
    have core : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ), Differentiable ℝ F → ∀ (k : Fin 3) (z : E3),
        partialDeriv k (fun z => F (coordPlaneProj a z)) z =
          fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a z) (coordPlaneProj a (e k)) := by
      intro F hF k z
      have h : HasFDerivAt (fun z => F (coordPlaneProj a z))
          ((fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a z)).comp πL) z :=
        (hF (πL z)).hasFDerivAt.comp z πL.hasFDerivAt
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [h.fderiv]
      rfl
    have hlin1 : ∀ (z : E3) (k : Fin 3),
        partialDeriv k (fun z => z a - φ (coordPlaneProj a z)) z =
          (if k = a then 1 else 0) - partialDeriv k (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z)) z := by
      intro z k
      have hs : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => z a - φ (coordPlaneProj a z))
          (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) a - fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z)) z) z :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) a).hasFDerivAt.sub (hφπd z).hasFDerivAt
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hs.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
      congr 1
      by_cases h : k = a
      · subst h; simp
      · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
    have hψ : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x => fderiv ℝ φ x (coordPlaneProj a (e j))) :=
      fun j => (hφ2.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).clm_apply contDiff_const
    have hpj : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z)) =
        fun z => fderiv ℝ φ (coordPlaneProj a z) (coordPlaneProj a (e j)) :=
      fun j => funext fun z => core φ hφd j z
    have hpjh : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => z a - φ (coordPlaneProj a z)) =
        fun z => (if j = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) -
          fderiv ℝ φ (coordPlaneProj a z) (coordPlaneProj a (e j)) := by
      intro j; funext z; rw [hlin1, hpj]
    have hpij : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => φ (coordPlaneProj a z))) =
        fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun x => fderiv ℝ φ x (coordPlaneProj a (e j))) (coordPlaneProj a z)
          (coordPlaneProj a (e i)) := by
      intro i j
      rw [hpj j]
      funext z
      exact core _ ((hψ j).differentiable one_ne_zero) i z
    refine ⟨hφπ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y t k
      rw [hlin1, core φ hφd, core φ hφd, hshift]
    · intro y t i j
      rw [hpjh, hpij]
      have h1 : partialDeriv i (fun z => (if j = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) -
            fderiv ℝ φ (coordPlaneProj a z) (coordPlaneProj a (e j)))
            (coordPlaneProj a y + t • e a) =
          -partialDeriv i (fun z => fderiv ℝ φ (coordPlaneProj a z) (coordPlaneProj a (e j)))
            (coordPlaneProj a y + t • e a) := by
        simp only [partialDeriv]
        rw [fderiv_const_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply]
      rw [h1, core _ ((hψ j).differentiable one_ne_zero) i, hshift]
    · intro y
      rw [core φ hφd, hea, map_zero]
    · intro k
      rw [hpj k]
      exact (hψ k).comp πL.contDiff
    · intro i j
      rw [hpij i j]
      exact (((hψ j).continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).comp hπc).clm_apply continuous_const
  
  
  have mcP_mcR_contDiffAt : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Set E3), IsOpen T →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) → ∀ (z₁ : E3), z₁ ∈ T →
      (G z₁).det ≠ 0 → ∀ (ξ₁ : Fin 3 → ℝ), 0 < mcS G z₁ ξ₁ →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => mcP G q.1 q.2 i j) (z₁, ξ₁)) ∧
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => mcR G q.1 q.2) (z₁, ξ₁) := by
    intro G T hT hG z₁ hz₁ hdet ξ₁ hS
    have hdetgen : ∀ M : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
        (∀ k l, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun z => M z k l) z₁) →
          ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun z => (M z).det) z₁ := by
      intro M hM
      simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      exact (((((((hM 0 0).mul (hM 1 1)).mul (hM 2 2)).sub
        (((hM 0 0).mul (hM 1 2)).mul (hM 2 1))).sub
        (((hM 0 1).mul (hM 1 0)).mul (hM 2 2))).add (((hM 0 1).mul (hM 1 2)).mul (hM 2 0))).add
        (((hM 0 2).mul (hM 1 0)).mul (hM 2 1))).sub (((hM 0 2).mul (hM 1 1)).mul (hM 2 0))
    have hG2 : ∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun z => G z i j) z₁ :=
      fun i j => ((hG i j).contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hz₁)).of_le (by norm_cast)
    have hG1 : ∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun z => G z i j) z₁ :=
      fun i j => (hG2 i j).of_le (by norm_num)
    have hdG : ∀ l i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun z => partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) z) z₁ :=
      fun l i j => ((hG2 i j).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).clm_apply contDiffAt_const
    have hdet1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun z => (G z).det) z₁ := hdetgen G hG1
    have hadj : ∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun z => (G z).adjugate i j) z₁ := by
      intro i j
      simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
      apply hdetgen (fun z => (G z).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1))
      intro k l
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_apply]
      by_cases hk : k = j
      · simp only [if_pos hk]; exact contDiffAt_const
      · simp only [if_neg hk]; exact hG1 k l
    have hinv : ∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) z₁ := by
      intro i j
      have heq : (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) = fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹ * (G z).adjugate i j := by
        funext z
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [heq]
      exact (hdet1.inv hdet).mul (hadj i j)
    have hchr : ∀ k i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun z => christoffel G k i j z) z₁ := by
      intro k i j
      unfold christoffel
      exact contDiffAt_const.mul (ContDiffAt.sum fun l _ =>
        (hinv k l).mul (((hdG i j l).add (hdG j i l)).sub (hdG l i j)))
    have lift : ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 φ z₁ →
        ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => φ q.1) (z₁, ξ₁) :=
      fun φ hφ => hφ.comp (z₁, ξ₁) contDiffAt_fst
    have hcoord : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => q.2 k) (z₁, ξ₁) :=
      fun k => ((contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ k).comp contDiff_snd).contDiffAt
    have hinvq : ∀ i j,
        ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => (G q.1)⁻¹ i j) (z₁, ξ₁) :=
      fun i j => lift _ (hinv i j)
    have hchrq : ∀ k i j,
        ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => christoffel G k i j q.1) (z₁, ξ₁) :=
      fun k i j => lift _ (hchr k i j)
    have hSq : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => mcS G q.1 q.2) (z₁, ξ₁) := by
      unfold mcS
      exact ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => ContDiffAt.sum fun j _ =>
        ((hinvq i j).mul (hcoord i)).mul (hcoord j)
    have hNq : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
        (fun q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => Real.sqrt (mcS G q.1 q.2)) (z₁, ξ₁) :=
      hSq.sqrt hS.ne'
    have hN0 : Real.sqrt (mcS G z₁ ξ₁) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hS).ne'
    have hP : ∀ i j,
        ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => mcP G q.1 q.2 i j) (z₁, ξ₁) := by
      intro i j
      unfold mcP
      exact ((hinvq i j).div hNq hN0).sub
        (((ContDiffAt.sum fun a _ => (hinvq i a).mul (hcoord a)).mul
          (ContDiffAt.sum fun b _ => (hinvq j b).mul (hcoord b))).div (hNq.pow 3)
            (pow_ne_zero 3 hN0))
    refine ⟨hP, ?_⟩
    unfold mcR
    exact ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => ContDiffAt.sum fun j _ =>
      (hP i j).mul (ContDiffAt.sum fun k _ => (hchrq k i j).mul (hcoord k))
  
  
  have mcP_padded_posDef : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (z : E3), (G z).PosDef →
      ∀ (a : Fin 3) (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ), ξ a = 1 →
      0 < mcS G z ξ ∧ ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 →
        0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (mcP G z ξ i j + if i = a ∧ j = a then 1 else 0) * v i * v j := by
    intro G z hpd a ξ hξ
    have hpad : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ),
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (P i j + if i = b ∧ j = b then 1 else 0) * v i * v j =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * v i * v j + v b ^ 2 := by
      intro b P v
      fin_cases b <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
    have hB : ((G z)⁻¹).PosDef := hpd.inv
    have hBs : ∀ i j, (G z)⁻¹ j i = (G z)⁻¹ i j := by
      intro i j
      have := hB.isHermitian.apply i j
      simpa using this
    have hBpos : ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, x ≠ 0 → 0 < dotProduct x (Matrix.mulVec (G z)⁻¹ x) := by
      intro x hx
      have h := hB.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
      simpa using h
    have hξ0 : ξ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; rw [h] at hξ; simp at hξ
    have hSeq : mcS G z ξ = dotProduct ξ (Matrix.mulVec (G z)⁻¹ ξ) := by
      simp only [mcS, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring

      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, mcP G (zV y) (ξV y) i j *
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => V (coordPlaneProj a z))) y =
        -mcR G (zV y) (ξV y) := by
    intro y hy
    have h := hMV y hy
    rw [s1] at h
    have hcov : (fun k => partialDeriv k (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (coordPlaneProj a y + V (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a)) = ξV y := by
      rw [hξV]; funext k; exact hvD1 y _ k
    rw [hcov] at h
    simp only [hvD2] at h
    rw [← hzV y] at h
    simp only [mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h
    linarith
  have hVU1 : V (coordPlaneProj a y₁) = U (coordPlaneProj a y₁) := sub_eq_zero.mp h0
  have hz1 : zV y₁ = zU y₁ := by rw [hzV, hzU, hVU1]
  have hξ1 : ξV y₁ = ξU y₁ := by
    rw [hξV, hξU]; funext k; rw [hgrad0 k]
  have hξa : ξU y₁ a = 1 := by rw [hξU]; simp [hua]
  have hzUc : Continuous zU := by
    have : zU = fun y => coordPlaneProj a y + U (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a := funext hzU
    rw [this]; exact hπc.add ((hU.continuous.comp hπc).smul continuous_const)
  have hzVc : Continuous zV := by
    have : zV = fun y => coordPlaneProj a y + V (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a := funext hzV
    rw [this]; exact hπc.add ((hV.continuous.comp hπc).smul continuous_const)
  have hξUc : Continuous ξU := by
    have : ξU = fun y k => (if k = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) -
        partialDeriv k (fun z => U (coordPlaneProj a z)) y := funext hξU
    rw [this]; exact continuous_pi fun k => continuous_const.sub (hu1 k).continuous
  have hξVc : Continuous ξV := by
    have : ξV = fun y k => (if k = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) -
        partialDeriv k (fun z => V (coordPlaneProj a z)) y := funext hξV
    rw [this]; exact continuous_pi fun k => continuous_const.sub (hv1 k).continuous
  
  have hz1T : zU y₁ ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    rw [hzU]; exact hball (hgraph _ _ hy₁ (hslabU y₁ hy₁))
  have hpd : (G (zU y₁)).PosDef := coeff_chart_symm_posDef _ hz1T
  have hdet : (G (zU y₁)).det ≠ 0 := hpd.det_pos.ne'
  obtain ⟨hS, hA₀pd⟩ := mcP_padded_posDef G (zU y₁) hpd a (ξU y₁) hξa
  
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    fun i j => g.smooth p i j
  obtain ⟨hPcd, hRcd⟩ := mcP_mcR_contDiffAt G _ (chartAt E3 p).open_target hGs (zU y₁) hz1T
    hdet (ξU y₁) hS
  have hαUc : Continuous (fun y => (zU y, ξU y)) := hzUc.prodMk hξUc
  have hαVc : Continuous (fun y => (zV y, ξV y)) := hzVc.prodMk hξVc
  have hαV1 : (fun y => (zV y, ξV y)) y₁ = (zU y₁, ξU y₁) := by
    show (zV y₁, ξV y₁) = (zU y₁, ξU y₁)
    rw [hz1, hξ1]
  obtain ⟨KP, hKP, hPlip⟩ := s7
    (fun (ij : Fin 3 × Fin 3) (q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ)) => mcP G q.1 q.2 ij.1 ij.2) (zU y₁, ξU y₁)
    (fun ij => hPcd ij.1 ij.2) (fun y => (zV y, ξV y)) (fun y => (zU y, ξU y)) y₁
    hαVc.continuousAt hαUc.continuousAt hαV1 rfl
  obtain ⟨KR, hKR, hRlip⟩ := s7
    (fun (_ : Unit) (q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ)) => mcR G q.1 q.2) (zU y₁, ξU y₁)
    (fun _ => hRcd) (fun y => (zV y, ξV y)) (fun y => (zU y, ξU y)) y₁
    hαVc.continuousAt hαUc.continuousAt hαV1 rfl
  
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ : ∃ A₀ : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, ∀ i j,
      A₀ i j = mcP G (zU y₁) (ξU y₁) i j + if i = a ∧ j = a then 1 else 0 :=
    ⟨Matrix.of fun i j => mcP G (zU y₁) (ξU y₁) i j + if i = a ∧ j = a then 1 else 0,
      fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hA₀pos : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A₀ i j * v i * v j := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [hA₀]
    exact hA₀pd v hv
  obtain ⟨lam, δ, hlam, hδ, hell⟩ := quadForm_pos_perturb A₀ hA₀pos
  have hAev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₁, ∀ i j,
      |mcP G (zV y) (ξV y) i j - mcP G (zU y₁) (ξU y₁) i j| < δ := by
    refine Filter.eventually_all.2 fun i => Filter.eventually_all.2 fun j => ?_
    have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => mcP G q.1 q.2 i j)
        ((fun y => (zV y, ξV y)) y₁) := by
      rw [hαV1]; exact (hPcd i j).continuousAt
    have hc2 : ContinuousAt ((fun q : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => mcP G q.1 q.2 i j) ∘
        (fun y => (zV y, ξV y))) y₁ := ContinuousAt.comp hc1 hαVc.continuousAt
    filter_upwards [Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hc2.tendsto δ hδ] with y hy
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply] at hy
    rw [Real.dist_eq, hz1, hξ1] at hy
    exact hy
  obtain ⟨CH, hCHdef⟩ : ∃ CH : ℝ, CH = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => U (coordPlaneProj a z))) y₁| + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCH : 0 ≤ CH := by
    rw [hCHdef]
    have := Finset.sum_nonneg (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)))
      (f := fun i => ∑ j : Fin 3,
        |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => U (coordPlaneProj a z))) y₁|)
      (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
    linarith
  
  have hHev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₁, ∀ i j,
      |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => U (coordPlaneProj a z))) y -
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => U (coordPlaneProj a z))) y₁| < 1 := by
    refine Filter.eventually_all.2 fun i => Filter.eventually_all.2 fun j => ?_
    filter_upwards [Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp ((hu2 i j).tendsto y₁) 1 one_pos] with y hy
    exact hy
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrball⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hΩ.and (hPlip.and (hRlip.and (hAev.and hHev))))
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ KR + 9 * KP * CH := by
    have := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 9) hKP) hCH
    linarith
  refine ⟨fun y i j => mcP G (zV y) (ξV y) i j + if i = a ∧ j = a then 1 else 0, r, lam,
    ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |A₀ i j| + δ, KR + 9 * KP * CH, hr, hlam, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hyΩ, hyP, hyR, hyA, hyH⟩ := hrball (Metric.mem_ball.mp hy)
  have hAclose : ∀ i j,
      |(mcP G (zV y) (ξV y) i j + if i = a ∧ j = a then 1 else 0) - A₀ i j| ≤ δ := by
    intro i j
    rw [hA₀, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
    exact (hyA i j).le
  refine ⟨hyΩ, fun v => hell _ hAclose v, fun i j => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := hAclose i j
    have h2 := hsum_le A₀ i j
    have h3 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub
      (mcP G (zV y) (ξV y) i j + if i = a ∧ j = a then 1 else 0) (A₀ i j)
    show |mcP G (zV y) (ξV y) i j + if i = a ∧ j = a then 1 else 0| ≤ _
    linarith
  · 
    have hw0 : 0 ≤ V (coordPlaneProj a y) - U (coordPlaneProj a y) := sub_nonneg.mpr (hle y hyΩ)
    have hPy : ∀ i j, |mcP G (zV y) (ξV y) i j - mcP G (zU y) (ξU y) i j| ≤
        KP * ‖(zV y, ξV y) - (zU y, ξU y)‖ := fun i j => hyP (i, j)
    have hRy : |mcR G (zV y) (ξV y) - mcR G (zU y) (ξU y)| ≤
        KR * ‖(zV y, ξV y) - (zU y, ξU y)‖ := hyR ()
    have hHy : ∀ i j,
        |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => U (coordPlaneProj a z))) y| ≤ CH := by
      intro i j
      have h1 := hyH i j
      have h2 := hsum_le (fun i j =>
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => U (coordPlaneProj a z))) y₁) i j
      have h3 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub
        (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => U (coordPlaneProj a z))) y)
        (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => U (coordPlaneProj a z))) y₁)
      rw [hCHdef]
      linarith
    have hgap := s9 (mcP G (zV y) (ξV y)) (mcP G (zU y) (ξU y))
      (fun i j => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => V (coordPlaneProj a z))) y)
      (fun i j => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => U (coordPlaneProj a z))) y)
      (mcR G (zV y) (ξV y)) (mcR G (zU y) (ξU y)) KP KR CH
      ‖(zV y, ξV y) - (zU y, ξU y)‖ hKP hCH (hMSEV y hyΩ) (hMSEU y hyΩ) hRy hPy hHy
    have hwa' : partialDeriv a
        (fun y' => V (coordPlaneProj a y') - U (coordPlaneProj a y')) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      funext fun y' => hwa y'
    have haa : partialDeriv a (partialDeriv a
        (fun y' => V (coordPlaneProj a y') - U (coordPlaneProj a y'))) y = 0 := by
      rw [hwa']
      simp [partialDeriv]
    have hdiff : (zV y, ξV y) - (zU y, ξU y) =
        ((V (coordPlaneProj a y) - U (coordPlaneProj a y)) • e a,
          fun k => -partialDeriv k
            (fun y' => V (coordPlaneProj a y') - U (coordPlaneProj a y')) y) := by
      rw [Prod.mk_sub_mk, hzV, hzU, hξV, hξU]
      congr 1
      · rw [sub_smul]; abel
      · funext k
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        rw [hD1 k y]
        ring
    have hd := hprod (V (coordPlaneProj a y) - U (coordPlaneProj a y))
      (fun k => -partialDeriv k
        (fun y' => V (coordPlaneProj a y') - U (coordPlaneProj a y')) y)
    rw [← hdiff] at hd
    simp only [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hw0] at hd
    show ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (mcP G (zV y) (ξV y) i j + if i = a ∧ j = a then 1 else 0) *
          partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
            (fun y' => V (coordPlaneProj a y') - U (coordPlaneProj a y'))) y ≤ _
    rw [hpad a (mcP G (zV y) (ξV y)) (fun i j => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
      (fun y' => V (coordPlaneProj a y') - U (coordPlaneProj a y'))) y), haa, add_zero]
    simp only [hD2]
    calc _ ≤ (KR + 9 * KP * CH) * ‖(zV y, ξV y) - (zU y, ξU y)‖ := hgap
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hK0

informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set E3) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hΩc : IsPreconnected Ω)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ 2 w) (hnn : ∀ y ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ w y)
    (hloc : ∀ y₁ ∈ Ω, w y₁ = 0 → ∃ (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (r lam Lam K : ℝ),
      0 < r ∧ 0 < lam ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ r, y ∈ Ω ∧
        (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * v i * v j) ∧
        (∀ i j, |A y i j| ≤ Lam) ∧
        ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) y ≤
          K * (w y + ∑ i, |partialDeriv i w y|))
    (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ Ω) (h0 : w y₀ = 0) : ∀ y ∈ Ω, w y = 0

signature.statement:
(Ω : Set E3) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hΩc : IsPreconnected Ω)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ 2 w) (hnn : ∀ y ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ w y)
    (hloc : ∀ y₁ ∈ Ω, w y₁ = 0 → ∃ (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (r lam Lam K : ℝ),
      0 < r ∧ 0 < lam ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ r, y ∈ Ω ∧
        (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * v i * v j) ∧
        (∀ i j, |A y i j| ≤ Lam) ∧
        ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) y ≤
          K * (w y + ∑ i, |partialDeriv i w y|))
    (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ Ω) (h0 : w y₀ = 0) : ∀ y ∈ Ω, w y = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hwC : Continuous w := hw.continuous
  
  have H2 : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 f → ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y (e i) (e j) := by
    intro f hf y i j
    have hd : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) :=
      (hf.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable (by norm_num)
    have h1 := (hd y).hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e j) y)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e j)) y (e i) = _
    rw [h1.fderiv]
    simp
  
  have s1 : ∀ (A H : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * v i * v j) →
      (∀ i j, H i j = H j i) →
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, v i * v j * H i j) →
      0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * H i j := by
    intro A H hA hHs hH
    have hherm : H.IsHermitian := by
      ext i j
      simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hHs]
    have hpsd : H.PosSemidef := by
      rw [Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
      refine ⟨hherm, fun x => ?_⟩
      have := hH x
      simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
      convert this using 2
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := Matrix.posSemidef_iff_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self.mp hpsd
    have hHB : ∀ i j, H i j = ∑ k, B k i * B k j := by
      intro i j
      rw [hB, Matrix.mul_apply]
      simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
    have : ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * H i j = ∑ k, ∑ i, ∑ j, A i j * B k i * B k j := by
      simp only [hHB, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [this]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => hA (fun i => B k i))
  
  have s2 : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 f → ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y = partialDeriv j (partialDeriv i f) y := by
    intro f hf y i j
    rw [H2 f hf, H2 f hf]
    have hs : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f y :=
      hf.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField])
    exact hs (e i) (e j)
  
  have s3 : ∀ (h : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 h → ∀ (z : E3), IsLocalMin h z →
      ∀ (v : Fin 3 → ℝ), 0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, v i * v j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h) z := by
    intro h hh z hmin v
    have hQ : ∑ i, ∑ j, v i * v j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h) z =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ h) z (∑ k, v k • e k) (∑ k, v k • e k) := by
      simp only [H2 h hh, map_smul, map_add,
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [hQ]
    set u : E3 := ∑ k, v k • e k with hu
    have hd1 : Differentiable ℝ h := hh.differentiable (by norm_num)
    have hd2 : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ h) :=
      (hh.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable (by norm_num)
    have hline : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => z + t • u) u t := by
      intro t
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const u).const_add z
    have hφ : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => h (z + t • u)) (fderiv ℝ h (z + t • u) u) t :=
      fun t => (hd1 _).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hline t)
    have hψ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ h (z + t • u) u)
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ h) z u u) 0 := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ h (z + t • u))
          (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ h) z u) 0 :=
        (hd2 z).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 (hline 0) (by simp)
      have h2 := h1.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const 0 u)
      simpa using h2
    have hψ0 : fderiv ℝ h z u = 0 := by simp [hmin.fderiv_eq_zero]
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope] at hψ
    have hsl : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ), slope (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ h (z + t • u) u) 0 t < 0 :=
      (hψ.mono_left (nhdsWithin_mono _ (fun t ht => ne_of_gt ht))).eventually
        (gt_mem_nhds hneg)
    have hc : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => z + t • u) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 z) := by
      have := (hline 0).continuousAt.tendsto
      simpa using this
    have hloc : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0:ℝ), h z ≤ h (z + t • u) := hc.eventually hmin
    have hboth : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ),
        slope (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ h (z + t • u) u) 0 t < 0 ∧ h z ≤ h (z + t • u) :=
      hsl.and (nhdsWithin_le_nhds hloc)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδsub⟩ := mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp hboth
    have hδ0 : (0:ℝ) < δ := hδ
    have ht0 : (0:ℝ) < δ / 2 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hseq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun t : ℝ => h (z + t • u))
      (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ h (z + t • u) u) ht0
      (fun t _ => (hφ t).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t _ => hφ t)
    have hsδ : s ∈ Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) δ := ⟨hs.1, by linarith [hs.2]⟩
    have hsneg := (hδsub hsδ).1
    have htδ : δ / 2 ∈ Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) δ := ⟨ht0, by linarith⟩
    have htmin := (hδsub htδ).2
    rw [slope_def_field] at hsneg
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, hψ0, sub_zero] at hsneg hseq
    have hψs : fderiv ℝ h (z + s • u) u < 0 := by
      by_contra hc'
      push_neg at hc'
      have := div_nonneg hc' hs.1.le
      linarith
    rw [hseq] at hψs
    have := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr htmin) ht0.le
    linarith
  
  have s4 : ∀ (c : E3) (α R : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : E3 => Real.exp (-α * ‖x - c‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ x u : E3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun x : E3 => Real.exp (-α * ‖x - c‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) x u
          = -2 * α * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - c‖ ^ 2) * inner ℝ (x - c) u) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin 3) (x : E3),
        partialDeriv i (fun x : E3 => Real.exp (-α * ‖x - c‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) x
          = -2 * α * (x i - c i) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - c‖ ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x : E3),
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
          (fun x : E3 => Real.exp (-α * ‖x - c‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2))) x
          = (4 * α ^ 2 * (x i - c i) * (x j - c j) - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0))
              * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - c‖ ^ 2)) := by
    intro c α R
    have hsm : ContDiff ℝ 2
        (fun x : E3 => Real.exp (-α * ‖x - c‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) := by
      apply ContDiff.sub _ contDiff_const
      apply Real.contDiff_exp.comp
      apply contDiff_const.mul
      exact (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
    have hE : ∀ x : E3, HasFDerivAt (fun x : E3 => Real.exp (-α * ‖x - c‖ ^ 2))
        (Real.exp (-α * ‖x - c‖ ^ 2) •
          (-α • (2 • (innerSL ℝ (x - c)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)))) x := by
      intro x
      exact ((((hasFDerivAt_id x).sub_const c).norm_sq).const_mul (-α)).exp
    have h1 : ∀ x u : E3,

      have hL : K' * (v z + ∑ i, |partialDeriv i v z|) =
          K' * ((Real.exp (-α * ‖z - c‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) +
            ∑ i, |-2 * α * (z i - c i) * Real.exp (-α * ‖z - c‖ ^ 2)|) := by
        simp only [hvx, hvP]
      have hRr : ∑ i, ∑ j, A z i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j v) z =
          ∑ i, ∑ j, A z i j * ((4 * α ^ 2 * (z i - c i) * (z j - c j) -
            2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖z - c‖ ^ 2)) := by
        simp only [hvH]
      rw [hL, hRr] at hstar'
      linarith
    
    have hin : ∀ x : E3, ‖x - c‖ = R / 2 → 0 ≤ h x := by
      intro x hx
      have h1 := hεmin x hx
      have h2 : Real.exp (-α * ‖x - c‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
        have := sq_nonneg ‖x - c‖
        nlinarith
      have h3 : v x < 1 := by rw [hvx]; linarith
      have h4 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h3 hε0
      rw [hhx]
      linarith
    have hout : ∀ x : E3, ‖x - c‖ = R → 0 ≤ h x := by
      intro x hx
      rw [hhx, hvx, hx, sub_self, mul_zero, sub_zero]
      exact hnn x (hballΩ (hcbr x hx.le))
    have hDnn := s6 c R h hhC.continuous hin hout hint
    
    have hhx₀ : h x₀ = 0 := by rw [hhx, hvx, hx₀R, sub_self, mul_zero, sub_zero, hwx₀]
    have hray : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 / 2 → h x₀ ≤ h (x₀ + t • (c - x₀)) := by
      intro t ht1 ht2
      have hnorm : ‖x₀ + t • (c - x₀) - c‖ = (1 - t) * R := by
        rw [show x₀ + t • (c - x₀) - c = (1 - t) • (x₀ - c) by module, norm_smul,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith), hx₀R]
      rw [hhx₀]
      apply hDnn
      · rw [hnorm]; nlinarith
      · rw [hnorm]; nlinarith
    have hderiv := s8 h x₀ (c - x₀) (hhC.differentiable (by norm_num) x₀) (1 / 2)
      (by norm_num) hray
    have hwmin : IsLocalMin w x₀ := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hcbr x₀ hx₀R.le)] with y hy
      rw [hwx₀]
      exact hnn y (hballΩ hy)
    have hw0 : fderiv ℝ w x₀ = 0 := hwmin.fderiv_eq_zero
    have hval : fderiv ℝ h x₀ (c - x₀) =
        -(2 * ε * α * Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2) * R ^ 2) := by
      rw [hlinD, hw0, hvD, hx₀R, show c - x₀ = -(x₀ - c) by abel, inner_neg_right,
        real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hx₀R]
      simp
      ring
    have hpos' : 0 < 2 * ε * α * Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2) * R ^ 2 := by positivity
    linarith
  
  have hU : IsOpen {y | y ∈ Ω ∧ w y = 0} := by
    rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
    intro y hy
    exact hopen y hy.1 hy.2
  have hV : IsOpen (Ω ∩ {y | w y ≠ 0}) := hΩ.inter (isOpen_ne_fun hwC continuous_const)
  have hdisj : Disjoint {y | y ∈ Ω ∧ w y = 0} (Ω ∩ {y | w y ≠ 0}) :=
    Set.disjoint_left.mpr (fun y hy hy' => hy'.2 hy.2)
  have hcover : Ω ⊆ {y | y ∈ Ω ∧ w y = 0} ∪ (Ω ∩ {y | w y ≠ 0}) := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hwy : w y = 0
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hy, hwy⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hy, hwy⟩
  have hne : (Ω ∩ {y | y ∈ Ω ∧ w y = 0}).Nonempty := ⟨y₀, hy₀, hy₀, h0⟩
  have hsub := hΩc.subset_left_of_subset_union hU hV hdisj hcover hne
  intro y hy
  exact (hsub hy).2

    ∀ x ∈ κ.source, κ x ∈ Metric.ball c ρ →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx hz
  have hPcont : Continuous (coordPlaneProj a) := by
    unfold coordPlaneProj
    fun_prop
  have hP_eq : ∀ y : E3, coordPlaneProj a y + (y a) • e a = y := by
    intro y
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, sub_add_cancel]
  constructor
  · intro hfreq
    by_contra hne
    push_neg at hne
    have hq : ContinuousAt (fun x' => coordPlaneProj a (κ x')) x :=
      hPcont.continuousAt.comp (κ.continuousAt hx)
    have hκa : ContinuousAt (fun x' => (κ x') a) x :=
      ((PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) a).continuousAt).comp (κ.continuousAt hx)
    have hLipi : ∀ N i (p q : E3), |u N i p - u N i q| ≤ C * ‖p - q‖ := by
      intro N i p q
      have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (u N i) := (hd N i).differentiable (by simp)
      have hb : ∀ y ∈ (Set.univ : Set E3), ‖fderiv ℝ (u N i) y‖ ≤ C := by
        intro y _
        rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one]
        exact hLip N i y
      have h := convex_univ.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (fun y _ => hdiff y) hb
        (Set.mem_univ q) (Set.mem_univ p)
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    have hev : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ r in Filter.atTop ×ˢ 𝓝 x,
        (κ r.2) a ≠ u r.1 i (coordPlaneProj a (κ r.2)) := by
      intro i
      have hT : Filter.Tendsto (fun r : ℕ × X => u r.1 i (coordPlaneProj a (κ r.2)))
          (Filter.atTop ×ˢ 𝓝 x) (𝓝 (U i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)))) := by
        have hg : Filter.Tendsto (fun r : ℕ × X =>
            C * ‖coordPlaneProj a (κ r.2) - coordPlaneProj a (κ x)‖ +
              |u r.1 i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)) - U i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x))|)
            (Filter.atTop ×ˢ 𝓝 x) (𝓝 0) := by
          have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun r : ℕ × X => coordPlaneProj a (κ r.2))
              (Filter.atTop ×ˢ 𝓝 x) (𝓝 (coordPlaneProj a (κ x))) :=
            hq.tendsto.comp Filter.tendsto_snd
          have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun r : ℕ × X => u r.1 i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)))
              (Filter.atTop ×ˢ 𝓝 x) (𝓝 (U i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)))) :=
            (hconv i _).comp Filter.tendsto_fst
          have h1' := ((h1.sub_const (coordPlaneProj a (κ x))).norm).const_mul C
          have h2' := (h2.sub_const (U i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)))).abs
          have h3 := h1'.add h2'
          simpa using h3
        rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
        refine squeeze_zero (fun r => norm_nonneg _) (fun r => ?_) hg
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        calc |u r.1 i (coordPlaneProj a (κ r.2)) - U i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x))|
            ≤ |u r.1 i (coordPlaneProj a (κ r.2)) - u r.1 i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x))| +
              |u r.1 i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)) - U i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x))| :=
              abs_sub_le _ _ _
          _ ≤ C * ‖coordPlaneProj a (κ r.2) - coordPlaneProj a (κ x)‖ +
              |u r.1 i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)) - U i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x))| := by
              have := hLipi r.1 i (coordPlaneProj a (κ r.2)) (coordPlaneProj a (κ x))
              linarith
      have hK : Filter.Tendsto (fun r : ℕ × X => (κ r.2) a) (Filter.atTop ×ˢ 𝓝 x)
          (𝓝 ((κ x) a)) := hκa.tendsto.comp Filter.tendsto_snd
      have hD := hK.sub hT
      have hne' : (κ x) a - U i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (hne i)
      filter_upwards [hD.eventually_ne hne'] with r hr
      exact sub_ne_zero.mp hr
    have H1 := Filter.eventually_all.mpr hev
    have hs : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, x' ∈ κ.source ∧ κ x' ∈ Metric.ball c ρ :=
      Filter.Eventually.and (κ.open_source.mem_nhds hx)
        (κ.continuousAt hx (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz))
    have H2 : ∀ᶠ r in (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ) ×ˢ 𝓝 x,
        r.2 ∈ κ.source ∧ κ r.2 ∈ Metric.ball c ρ :=
      hs.prod_inr (Filter.atTop : Filter ℕ)
    obtain ⟨pa, hpa, pb, hpb, hgood⟩ := Filter.eventually_prod_iff.mp (H1.and H2)
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hpaN⟩ := ((hfreq {x' | pb x'} hpb).and_eventually hpa).exists
    obtain ⟨x', hx'O, hx'S⟩ := Set.not_disjoint_iff.mp hN
    obtain ⟨hall, hsrc, hb⟩ := hgood hpaN hx'O
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover N x' hx'S hsrc hb
    exact hall i hi
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    intro O hO
    have hv : ‖κ x - c‖ < ρ := by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
    have hP : ‖coordPlaneProj a (κ x - c)‖ < 2 * ρ := by
      have h1 : ‖(κ x - c) a‖ ≤ ‖κ x - c‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le _ _
      have h2 : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
      calc ‖coordPlaneProj a (κ x - c)‖ = ‖(κ x - c) - ((κ x - c) a) • e a‖ := rfl
        _ ≤ ‖κ x - c‖ + ‖((κ x - c) a) • e a‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = ‖κ x - c‖ + ‖(κ x - c) a‖ := by rw [norm_smul, h2, mul_one]
        _ < 2 * ρ := by linarith
    have hγ : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun N => coordPlaneProj a (κ x) + u N i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)) • e a)
        Filter.atTop (𝓝 (κ x)) := by
      have h := ((hconv i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x))).smul_const (e a)).const_add
        (coordPlaneProj a (κ x))
      rwa [← hi, hP_eq] at h
    have hsymm : Filter.Tendsto κ.symm (𝓝 (κ x)) (𝓝 x) := by
      have h := κ.continuousAt_symm (κ.map_source hx)
      rwa [ContinuousAt, κ.left_inv hx] at h
    have hev : ∀ᶠ N in Filter.atTop,
        κ.symm (coordPlaneProj a (κ x) + u N i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)) • e a) ∈ O :=
      (hsymm.comp hγ) hO
    refine Filter.Eventually.frequently ?_
    filter_upwards [hev] with N hN
    exact Set.not_disjoint_iff.mpr ⟨_, hN, hon N i (κ x) hP⟩

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (q p : M) (a : Fin 3) (U : E3 → ℝ) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (W : Set E3) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hWt : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) (hp : p ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source)
    (hpW : chartAt E3 q p ∈ W)
    (hpg : (chartAt E3 q p) a = U (coordPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 q p)))
    (hMSE : ∀ z ∈ W, z a = U (coordPlaneProj a z) →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun w => w a - U (coordPlaneProj a w)) z
        = 0)
    (O : Set M) (hO : O ∈ 𝓝 p) :
    ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), V ⊆ O ∧ IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧ chartAt E3 q x ∈ W) ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 ↔ (chartAt E3 q x) a = U (coordPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 q x))) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv f x = 0) ∧
      IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∧ IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | f x < 0})
