proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set κ := chartAt E3 q with hκ
  
  have hpadd : ∀ x y : E3, coordPlaneProj a (x + y) = coordPlaneProj a x + coordPlaneProj a y := by
    intro x y
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, add_smul]
    abel
  have hpsmul : ∀ (r : ℝ) (x : E3), coordPlaneProj a (r • x) = r • coordPlaneProj a x := by
    intro r x
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_sub, mul_smul]
  have hplin : IsLinearMap ℝ (coordPlaneProj a) := ⟨hpadd, hpsmul⟩
  let Lp : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (IsLinearMap.mk' _ hplin)
  have hLp : ∀ z, Lp z = coordPlaneProj a z := fun z => rfl
  have hpcd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (coordPlaneProj a) := Lp.contDiff
  have hPc : Continuous (coordPlaneProj a) := hpcd.continuous
  have hUc : Continuous U := hU.continuous
  have hea : (e a) a = 1 := by simp [e]
  have hPa : ∀ w : E3, (coordPlaneProj a w) a = 0 := by
    intro w
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hea, mul_one,
      sub_self]
  have hPe : coordPlaneProj a (e a) = 0 := by
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, hea, one_smul, sub_self]
  have hrec : ∀ z : E3, coordPlaneProj a z + (z a) • e a = z := by
    intro z
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, sub_add_cancel]
  have hPP : ∀ (w : E3) (c : ℝ),
      coordPlaneProj a (coordPlaneProj a w + c • e a) = coordPlaneProj a w := by
    intro w c
    rw [hpadd, hpsmul, hPe, smul_zero, add_zero]
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hea, mul_one,
      sub_self, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hPcoord : ∀ (w : E3) (c : ℝ), (coordPlaneProj a w + c • e a) a = c := by
    intro w c
    simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hPa, hea, mul_one, zero_add]
  have hPsub : ∀ z z₀ : E3, coordPlaneProj a z - coordPlaneProj a z₀ + (z a - z₀ a) • e a
      = z - z₀ := by
    intro z z₀
    conv_rhs => rw [← hrec z, ← hrec z₀]
    rw [sub_smul]
    abel
  have hea1 : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  have hcoord : Continuous (fun w : E3 => w a) := by fun_prop
  
  set h : E3 → ℝ := fun w => w a - U (coordPlaneProj a w) with hhdef
  have hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h := by
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : E3 => w a) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    exact h1.sub (hU.comp hpcd)
  have hda : ∀ z, fderiv ℝ h z (e a) = 1 := by
    intro z
    have hd1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E3 => w a) (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) z :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have hUd : DifferentiableAt ℝ U (Lp z) := (hU.contDiffAt).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hd2 : HasFDerivAt (fun w => U (Lp w)) ((fderiv ℝ U (Lp z)).comp Lp) z :=
      hUd.hasFDerivAt.comp z Lp.hasFDerivAt
    have h3 : fderiv ℝ h z = (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) - (fderiv ℝ U (Lp z)).comp Lp :=
      (hd1.sub hd2).fderiv
    rw [h3]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp', Function.comp_apply,
      hLp, hPe, map_zero, sub_zero]
    simp [e]
  have hdne : ∀ z, fderiv ℝ h z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z H
    have := hda z
    rw [H] at this
    simp at this
  
  obtain ⟨χ, -, hχ⟩ := (SmoothBumpFunction.nhds_basis_tsupport (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) p).mem_iff.1
    (κ.open_source.mem_nhds hp)
  set f : M → ℝ := fun x => χ x * h (κ x) with hfdef
  have hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f := by
    apply contMDiff_of_tsupport
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ κ.source := hχ (tsupport_mul_subset_left hx)
    have h1 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ κ x :=
      contMDiffOn_chart.contMDiffAt (κ.open_source.mem_nhds hx')
    have h2 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun y => h (κ y)) x :=
      (hh.contMDiff.contMDiffAt).comp x h1
    exact (χ.contMDiff.contMDiffAt).mul h2
  set V₁ : Set M := interior {x | χ x = 1} with hV₁def
  have hV₁o : IsOpen V₁ := isOpen_interior
  have hpV₁ : p ∈ V₁ := mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 χ.eventuallyEq_one
  have hfV₁ : ∀ x ∈ V₁, f x = h (κ x) := by
    intro x hx
    have h1' : x ∈ {x : M | χ x = 1} := interior_subset hx
    have h1 : χ x = 1 := h1'
    simp only [hfdef, h1, one_mul]
  
  set E : Set E3 := W ∩ (κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' (V₁ ∩ interior O)) with hEdef
  have hEo : IsOpen E :=
    hW.inter (κ.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage κ.open_target
      (hV₁o.inter isOpen_interior))
  set z₀ : E3 := κ p with hz₀def
  have hz₀E : z₀ ∈ E := by
    refine ⟨hpW, κ.map_source hp, ?_⟩
    show κ.symm (κ p) ∈ V₁ ∩ interior O
    rw [κ.left_inv hp]
    exact ⟨hpV₁, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hO⟩
  have hstar : ∀ z ∈ E, z ∈ W ∧ z ∈ κ.target ∧ κ.symm z ∈ interior O ∧
      f (κ.symm z) = h z := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hzW, hzt, hzV, hzO⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨hzW, hzt, hzO, ?_⟩
    rw [hfV₁ _ hzV, κ.right_inv hzt]
  
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hballE⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hEo z₀ hz₀E
  obtain ⟨r', hr', hcont⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.1
    (hUc.continuousAt (x := coordPlaneProj a z₀)) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  set δ : ℝ := ε / 2 with hδdef
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by positivity
  set r : ℝ := min r' δ with hrdef
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hr' hδ
  have hUb : ∀ y : E3, ‖y - coordPlaneProj a z₀‖ < r → |U y - z₀ a| < δ := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : dist y (coordPlaneProj a z₀) < r' := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy (min_le_left _ _)
    have h2 := hcont h1
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at h2
    rw [hpg]
    exact h2
  set C : Set E3 := {z : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a z - coordPlaneProj a z₀‖ < r ∧
    |z a - z₀ a| < δ} with hCdef
  have hCo : IsOpen C :=
    (isOpen_lt (hPc.sub continuous_const).norm continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (hcoord.sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const)
  have hCE : C ⊆ E := by
    intro z hz
    apply hballE
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, ← hPsub z z₀]
    calc ‖coordPlaneProj a z - coordPlaneProj a z₀ + (z a - z₀ a) • e a‖
        ≤ ‖coordPlaneProj a z - coordPlaneProj a z₀‖ + ‖(z a - z₀ a) • e a‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖coordPlaneProj a z - coordPlaneProj a z₀‖ + |z a - z₀ a| := by
          rw [norm_smul, hea1, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ < r + δ := add_lt_add hz.1 hz.2
      _ ≤ δ + δ := by linarith [min_le_right r' δ]
      _ = ε := by rw [hδdef]; ring
  
  set V : Set M := κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' C with hVdef
  have hVo : IsOpen V := κ.isOpen_inter_preimage hCo
  have hz₀C : z₀ ∈ C := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [sub_self, norm_zero]; exact hr
    · rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; exact hδ
  have hpV : p ∈ V := ⟨hp, hz₀C⟩
  have hVprop : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ κ.source ∧ κ x ∈ C ∧ κ x ∈ W ∧ x ∈ interior O ∧
      f x = h (κ x) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxs, hxC⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨h1, -, h3, h4⟩ := hstar _ (hCE hxC)
    rw [κ.left_inv hxs] at h3 h4
    exact ⟨hxs, hxC, h1, h3, h4⟩
  have hVO : V ⊆ O := fun x hx => interior_subset (hVprop x hx).2.2.2.1
  have hgerm : ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (κ x), f (κ.symm z) = h z := by
    intro x hx
    exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hEo.mem_nhds (hCE (hVprop x hx).2.1))
      (fun z hz => (hstar z hz).2.2.2)
  have hzero : ∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 ↔ (κ x) a = U (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [(hVprop x hx).2.2.2.2, hhdef, sub_eq_zero]
  
  have hmf : ∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx H
    have hxs : x ∈ κ.source := (hVprop x hx).1
    have hy : κ x ∈ κ.target := κ.map_source hxs
    have hfd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f (κ.symm (κ x)) :=
      hf.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hsd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ.symm (κ x) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
    have hc := mfderiv_comp (κ x) hfd hsd
    have H' : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f (κ.symm (κ x)) = 0 := by
      rw [κ.left_inv hxs]; exact H
    rw [H', ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp] at hc
    have hev : (f ∘ κ.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (κ x)] h := hgerm x hx
    rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at hc
    exact hdne _ hc
  
  have hmc : ∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv f x = 0 := by
    intro x hx hfx
    have hxs : x ∈ κ.source := (hVprop x hx).1
    let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      PartialDiffeomorph.mk κ.symm.toPartialEquiv κ.open_target κ.open_source
        contMDiffOn_chart_symm contMDiffOn_chart
    have hl := levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φ f h hf (κ x) (κ.map_source hxs) (hgerm x hx)
    have e1 : Φ (κ x) = x := κ.left_inv hxs
    have e2 : g.coeff Φ = g.coeff κ.symm := rfl
    rw [e1, e2] at hl
    rw [hl]
    exact hMSE _ (hVprop x hx).2.2.1 ((hzero x hx).1 hfx)
  
  set D : Set E3 := {x : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a x - coordPlaneProj a z₀‖ < r} with hDdef
  have hDc : IsPreconnected (D ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    have hD : D = coordPlaneProj a ⁻¹' Metric.ball (coordPlaneProj a z₀) r := by
      ext x
      simp only [hDdef, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    have hDconv : Convex ℝ D := by
      rw [hD]; exact (convex_ball _ _).is_linear_preimage hplin
    exact hDconv.isPreconnected.prod isPreconnected_Ioo
  set Cp : Set E3 := {z : E3 | (‖coordPlaneProj a z - coordPlaneProj a z₀‖ < r ∧
    |z a - z₀ a| < δ) ∧ U (coordPlaneProj a z) < z a} with hCpdef
  set Cm : Set E3 := {z : E3 | (‖coordPlaneProj a z - coordPlaneProj a z₀‖ < r ∧
    |z a - z₀ a| < δ) ∧ z a < U (coordPlaneProj a z)} with hCmdef
  have hCpc : IsPreconnected Cp := by
    let Ψ : E3 × ℝ → E3 := fun xs => coordPlaneProj a xs.1 +
      (U (coordPlaneProj a xs.1) + xs.2 * (z₀ a + δ - U (coordPlaneProj a xs.1))) • e a
    have hΨc : Continuous Ψ := by
      have h1 : Continuous (fun xs : E3 × ℝ => coordPlaneProj a xs.1) := hPc.comp continuous_fst
      have h2 : Continuous (fun xs : E3 × ℝ => U (coordPlaneProj a xs.1)) := hUc.comp h1
      exact h1.add ((h2.add (continuous_snd.mul (continuous_const.sub h2))).smul
        continuous_const)
    have himg : Ψ '' (D ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) = Cp := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨x, s⟩, ⟨hx, hs0, hs1⟩, rfl⟩
        have hx' : ‖coordPlaneProj a x - coordPlaneProj a z₀‖ < r := hx
        have hb := abs_lt.1 (hUb (coordPlaneProj a x) hx')
        have hd : 0 < z₀ a + δ - U (coordPlaneProj a x) := by linarith
        have hsd : 0 < s * (z₀ a + δ - U (coordPlaneProj a x)) := mul_pos hs0 hd
        have hsd' : s * (z₀ a + δ - U (coordPlaneProj a x)) <
            z₀ a + δ - U (coordPlaneProj a x) := by nlinarith
        show (‖coordPlaneProj a (Ψ (x, s)) - coordPlaneProj a z₀‖ < r ∧
          |(Ψ (x, s)) a - z₀ a| < δ) ∧ U (coordPlaneProj a (Ψ (x, s))) < (Ψ (x, s)) a
        simp only [Ψ, hPP, hPcoord]
        refine ⟨⟨hx', ?_⟩, by linarith⟩
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith
      · rintro ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz3⟩
        have hb := abs_lt.1 (hUb (coordPlaneProj a z) hz1)
        have hz2' := abs_lt.1 hz2
        have hd : 0 < z₀ a + δ - U (coordPlaneProj a z) := by linarith
        refine ⟨(z, (z a - U (coordPlaneProj a z)) / (z₀ a + δ - U (coordPlaneProj a z))),
          ⟨hz1, div_pos (by linarith) hd, (div_lt_one hd).2 (by linarith)⟩, ?_⟩
        show coordPlaneProj a z + (U (coordPlaneProj a z) +
          (z a - U (coordPlaneProj a z)) / (z₀ a + δ - U (coordPlaneProj a z)) *
            (z₀ a + δ - U (coordPlaneProj a z))) • e a = z
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hd.ne', add_sub_cancel, hrec]
    rw [← himg]
    exact hDc.image _ hΨc.continuousOn
  have hCmc : IsPreconnected Cm := by
    let Ψ : E3 × ℝ → E3 := fun xs => coordPlaneProj a xs.1 +
      (U (coordPlaneProj a xs.1) - xs.2 * (U (coordPlaneProj a xs.1) - (z₀ a - δ))) • e a
    have hΨc : Continuous Ψ := by
      have h1 : Continuous (fun xs : E3 × ℝ => coordPlaneProj a xs.1) := hPc.comp continuous_fst
      have h2 : Continuous (fun xs : E3 × ℝ => U (coordPlaneProj a xs.1)) := hUc.comp h1
      exact h1.add ((h2.sub (continuous_snd.mul (h2.sub continuous_const))).smul
        continuous_const)
    have himg : Ψ '' (D ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) = Cm := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨x, s⟩, ⟨hx, hs0, hs1⟩, rfl⟩
        have hx' : ‖coordPlaneProj a x - coordPlaneProj a z₀‖ < r := hx
        have hb := abs_lt.1 (hUb (coordPlaneProj a x) hx')
        have hd : 0 < U (coordPlaneProj a x) - (z₀ a - δ) := by linarith
        have hsd : 0 < s * (U (coordPlaneProj a x) - (z₀ a - δ)) := mul_pos hs0 hd
        have hsd' : s * (U (coordPlaneProj a x) - (z₀ a - δ)) <
            U (coordPlaneProj a x) - (z₀ a - δ) := by nlinarith
        show (‖coordPlaneProj a (Ψ (x, s)) - coordPlaneProj a z₀‖ < r ∧
          |(Ψ (x, s)) a - z₀ a| < δ) ∧ (Ψ (x, s)) a < U (coordPlaneProj a (Ψ (x, s)))
        simp only [Ψ, hPP, hPcoord]
        refine ⟨⟨hx', ?_⟩, by linarith⟩
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith
      · rintro ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz3⟩
        have hb := abs_lt.1 (hUb (coordPlaneProj a z) hz1)
        have hz2' := abs_lt.1 hz2
        have hd : 0 < U (coordPlaneProj a z) - (z₀ a - δ) := by linarith
        refine ⟨(z, (U (coordPlaneProj a z) - z a) / (U (coordPlaneProj a z) - (z₀ a - δ))),
          ⟨hz1, div_pos (by linarith) hd, (div_lt_one hd).2 (by linarith)⟩, ?_⟩
        show coordPlaneProj a z + (U (coordPlaneProj a z) -
          (U (coordPlaneProj a z) - z a) / (U (coordPlaneProj a z) - (z₀ a - δ)) *
            (U (coordPlaneProj a z) - (z₀ a - δ))) • e a = z
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hd.ne', sub_sub_cancel, hrec]
    rw [← himg]
    exact hDc.image _ hΨc.continuousOn
  have hCpC : Cp ⊆ C := fun z hz => hz.1
  have hCmC : Cm ⊆ C := fun z hz => hz.1
  have hCt : C ⊆ κ.target := fun z hz => (hstar z (hCE hz)).2.1
  have hsideP : V ∩ {x | 0 < f x} = κ.symm '' Cp := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxV, hfx⟩
      obtain ⟨hxs, hxC, -, -, hfe⟩ := hVprop x hxV
      have hfx' : 0 < h (κ x) := hfe ▸ hfx
      have hfx'' : 0 < (κ x) a - U (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)) := hfx'
      exact ⟨κ x, ⟨hxC, by linarith⟩, κ.left_inv hxs⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      have hzt : z ∈ κ.target := hCt (hCpC hz)
      have hxV : κ.symm z ∈ V := by
        refine ⟨κ.map_target hzt, ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_preimage, κ.right_inv hzt]
        exact hCpC hz
      refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
      show 0 < f (κ.symm z)
      rw [(hstar z (hCE (hCpC hz))).2.2.2]
      show 0 < z a - U (coordPlaneProj a z)
      linarith [hz.2]
  have hsideM : V ∩ {x | f x < 0} = κ.symm '' Cm := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxV, hfx⟩
      obtain ⟨hxs, hxC, -, -, hfe⟩ := hVprop x hxV
      have hfx' : h (κ x) < 0 := hfe ▸ hfx
      have hfx'' : (κ x) a - U (coordPlaneProj a (κ x)) < 0 := hfx'
      exact ⟨κ x, ⟨hxC, by linarith⟩, κ.left_inv hxs⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      have hzt : z ∈ κ.target := hCt (hCmC hz)
      have hxV : κ.symm z ∈ V := by
        refine ⟨κ.map_target hzt, ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_preimage, κ.right_inv hzt]
        exact hCmC hz
      refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
      show f (κ.symm z) < 0
      rw [(hstar z (hCE (hCmC hz))).2.2.2]
      show z a - U (coordPlaneProj a z) < 0
      linarith [hz.2]
  refine ⟨V, f, hVO, hVo, hpV, fun x hx => ⟨(hVprop x hx).1, (hVprop x hx).2.2.1⟩, hf, hmf,
    hzero, hmc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hsideP]
    exact hCpc.image _ (κ.continuousOn_symm.mono (hCpC.trans hCt))
  · rw [hsideM]
    exact hCmc.image _ (κ.continuousOn_symm.mono (hCmC.trans hCt))

subgoal_signatures.name: levelMeanCurv_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ x) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) h x

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (U F : Set M) (Fs : ℕ → Set M) (m : ENNReal) (hF : sepChartMeas F)
    (hFs : ∀ n, sepChartMeas (Fs n))
    (hconv : ∀ (p : M) (C : Set E3), IsCompact C → C ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      Tendsto (fun n => volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ C))
        atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun n => sepRiemPer g (Fs n) U) atTop (𝓝 m)) :
    sepRiemPer g F U ≤ m

signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (U F : Set M) (Fs : ℕ → Set M) (m : ENNReal) (hF : sepChartMeas F)
    (hFs : ∀ n, sepChartMeas (Fs n))
    (hconv : ∀ (p : M) (C : Set E3), IsCompact C → C ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      Tendsto (fun n => volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ C))
        atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun n => sepRiemPer g (Fs n) U) atTop (𝓝 m)) :
    sepRiemPer g F U ≤ m

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ (p : M) (X : E3 → E3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → tsupport X ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      Continuous (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X) ∧
        ∀ y : E3, y ∉ tsupport X → sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y = 0 := by
    intro p X hX hXt
    have hTo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
    have hent : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z i j) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      fun i j => g.smooth p i j
    have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det)
        (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      have hfun : (fun z => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det) = fun z =>
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 0 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 1 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 2
            - g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 0 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 2 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 1
            - g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 1 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 0 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 2
            + g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 1 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 2 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 0
            + g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 2 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 0 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 1
            - g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 2 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 1 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 0 := by
        funext z
        exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
      rw [hfun]
      exact (((((((hent 0 0).mul (hent 1 1)).mul (hent 2 2)).sub
        (((hent 0 0).mul (hent 1 2)).mul (hent 2 1))).sub
        (((hent 0 1).mul (hent 1 0)).mul (hent 2 2))).add
        (((hent 0 1).mul (hent 1 2)).mul (hent 2 0))).add
        (((hent 0 2).mul (hent 1 0)).mul (hent 2 1))).sub
        (((hent 0 2).mul (hent 1 1)).mul (hent 2 0))
    have hsqrt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det)
        (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      hdet.sqrt (fun z hz => ne_of_gt (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p z hz).det_pos)
    have hXi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) := fun i =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hX
    have hφ : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) := by
      intro i
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro z
      by_cases hz : z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
      · exact (hsqrt.mul (hXi i).contDiffOn).contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hz)
      · have hz' : z ∉ tsupport X := fun h => hz (hXt h)
        have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hz'
        refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
        simp [hw]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show Continuous (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) y (e i))
      refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
      exact ((hφ i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    · intro y hy
      have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy
      show ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) y (e i) = 0
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
      have h2 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
        simp [hw]
      rw [h2.fderiv_eq]
      simp
  
  have s2 : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (C S : Set E3) (Ss : ℕ → Set E3) (B : ℝ), IsCompact C →
      Continuous f → (∀ y : E3, y ∉ C → f y = 0) → (∀ y : E3, |f y| ≤ B) → MeasurableSet S →
      (∀ n, MeasurableSet (Ss n)) →
      Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y in Ss n, f y) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y in S, f y)) := by
    intro f C S Ss B hC hf hfC hB hS hSs hc
    have hCm : MeasurableSet C := hC.isClosed.measurableSet
    have hCfin : volume C < ⊤ := hC.measure_lt_top
    have hfi : Integrable f := hf.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.intro hC hfC)
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hB 0)
    have key : ∀ A : Set E3, ‖∫ y in A, f y‖ ≤ B * (volume (A ∩ C)).toReal := by
      intro A
      have h1 : ∫ y in A, f y = ∫ y in A ∩ C, f y := by
        have e := integral_inter_add_diff (s := A) (f := f) (μ := volume) hCm hfi.integrableOn
        have z : ∫ y in A \ C, f y = 0 :=
          setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun y hy => hfC y hy.2)
        rw [z, add_zero] at e
        exact e.symm
      rw [h1]
      have h2 := norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right) hCfin)
        (fun y _ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hB y) (f := f) (s := A ∩ C) (μ := volume)
      simpa [Measure.real] using h2
    have hbound : ∀ n, ‖(∫ y in Ss n, f y) - ∫ y in S, f y‖ ≤
        2 * B * (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal := by
      intro n
      have e1 := integral_inter_add_diff hS (hfi.integrableOn (s := Ss n))
      have e2 := integral_inter_add_diff (hSs n) (hfi.integrableOn (s := S))
      have e3 : Ss n ∩ S = S ∩ Ss n := Set.inter_comm _ _
      have hd : (∫ y in Ss n, f y) - ∫ y in S, f y =
          (∫ y in Ss n \ S, f y) - ∫ y in S \ Ss n, f y := by
        rw [← e1, ← e2, e3]; ring
      rw [hd]
      have hfin : volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C) ≠ ⊤ :=
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top hCfin.ne (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
      have m1 : (volume ((Ss n \ S) ∩ C)).toReal ≤ (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono hfin (measure_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _
          (by rw [Set.symmDiff_def]; exact Set.subset_union_left)))
      have m2 : (volume ((S \ Ss n) ∩ C)).toReal ≤ (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono hfin (measure_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _
          (by rw [Set.symmDiff_def]; exact Set.subset_union_right)))
      calc ‖(∫ y in Ss n \ S, f y) - ∫ y in S \ Ss n, f y‖
          ≤ ‖∫ y in Ss n \ S, f y‖ + ‖∫ y in S \ Ss n, f y‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ B * (volume ((Ss n \ S) ∩ C)).toReal + B * (volume ((S \ Ss n) ∩ C)).toReal :=
            add_le_add (key _) (key _)
        _ ≤ B * (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal +
              B * (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal := by gcongr
        _ = 2 * B * (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal := by ring
    rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    refine squeeze_zero (fun n => norm_nonneg _) hbound ?_
    have h0 : Tendsto (fun n => (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal ENNReal.zero_ne_top).comp hc
      simpa using this
    simpa using h0.const_mul (2 * B)
  
  have s3 : ∀ (α : Type) (N : ℕ) (P : Fin N → α → Prop) (a : Fin N → α → ENNReal) (m : ENNReal),
      (∀ k, ∃ x, P k x) → (∀ X : Fin N → α, (∀ k, P k (X k)) → ∑ k, a k (X k) ≤ m) →
      ∑ k, ⨆ (x : α) (_ : P k x), a k x ≤ m := by
    intro α N P a m hne h
    choose X₀ hX₀ using hne
    have heq : ∀ k, (⨆ (x : α) (_ : P k x), a k x) =
        ⨆ X : {X : Fin N → α // ∀ k, P k (X k)}, a k (X.1 k) := by
      intro k
      apply le_antisymm
      · refine iSup₂_le fun x hx => ?_
        refine le_iSup_of_le ⟨Function.update X₀ k x, fun j => ?_⟩ ?_
        · by_cases hj : j = k
          · subst hj; simp [hx]
          · simp [Function.update_of_ne hj, hX₀ j]
        · simp
      · exact iSup_le fun X => le_iSup₂_of_le (X.1 k) (X.2 k) le_rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => heq k)]
    rw [ENNReal.finsetSum_iSup]
    · exact iSup_le fun X => h X.1 X.2
    · intro X Y
      refine ⟨⟨fun k => if a k (X.1 k) ≤ a k (Y.1 k) then Y.1 k else X.1 k,
        fun k => by dsimp only; split_ifs; exacts [Y.2 k, X.2 k]⟩, fun k => ?_⟩
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with hk
      · exact ⟨hk, le_rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨le_rfl, (not_le.1 hk).le⟩
  
  unfold sepRiemPer
  refine iSup_le fun N => iSup_le fun p => iSup_le fun W => iSup_le fun hW => ?_
  have hVt : ∀ k, chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := by
    intro k
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 (p k)).map_source ((hW.1 k).2 hw).2
  
  unfold sepPerG
  refine s3 (E3 → E3) N (fun k X => ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
      tsupport X ⊆ chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ∧
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1)
    (fun k X => ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in chartAt E3 (p k) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y)) m ?_ ?_
  · intro k
    refine ⟨0, contDiff_const, HasCompactSupport.zero, ?_, fun y => by simp⟩
    rw [tsupport_zero]
    exact Set.empty_subset _
  intro Xs hXs
  
  have hterm : ∀ k, Tendsto (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal
      (∫ y in chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (Xs k) y)) atTop
      (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in chartAt E3 (p k) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (Xs k) y))) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨hXd, hXc, hXV, -⟩ := hXs k
    have hCt : tsupport (Xs k) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := hXV.trans (hVt k)
    obtain ⟨hc, hz⟩ := s1 (p k) (Xs k) hXd hCt
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := IsCompact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hXc hc.continuousOn
    have hB' : ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (Xs k) y| ≤ max B 0 := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport (Xs k)
      · have := hB y hy
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
      · rw [hz y hy, abs_zero]
        exact le_max_right _ _
    refine ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal (s2 _ (tsupport (Xs k)) _ _ (max B 0) hXc hc hz hB'
      (hF (p k)) (fun n => hFs n (p k)) ?_)
    have hsub : ∀ n, symmDiff (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source))
        (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)) ∩ tsupport (Xs k) ⊆
        chartAt E3 (p k) '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) ∩ tsupport (Xs k) := by
      intro n
      refine Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ ?_
      exact Set.subset_image_symmDiff.trans
        (Set.image_mono (Set.inter_symmDiff_distrib_right _ _ _).symm.subset)
    exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds
      (hconv (p k) _ hXc hCt) (fun n => zero_le _) (fun n => measure_mono (hsub n))
  
  have hsum := tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun k _ => hterm k)
  
  refine le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' hsum hlim (fun n => ?_)
  refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_)
    (?_ : ∑ k, sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm)
      (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)) (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k) ≤
        sepRiemPer g (Fs n) U)
  · unfold sepPerG
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le (Xs k) (hXs k) le_rfl
  · unfold sepRiemPer
    exact le_iSup_of_le N (le_iSup_of_le p (le_iSup_of_le W (le_iSup_of_le hW le_rfl)))

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (y : E3) (R : ℝ)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) U)
    (hpd : ∀ z ∈ U, (G z).PosDef) (hR : 0 < R) (hB : closedBall y R ⊆ U) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ S : Set E3,
      sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (ball y R) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal c * sepPerG G S (ball y R)

signature.name: sepPerG_one_le_mul
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (y : E3) (R : ℝ)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) U)
    (hpd : ∀ z ∈ U, (G z).PosDef) (hR : 0 < R) (hB : closedBall y R ⊆ U) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ S : Set E3,
      sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (ball y R) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal c * sepPerG G S (ball y R)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hdet : ∀ z ∈ U, 0 < (G z).det := fun z hz => (hpd z hz).det_pos
  have hdetfun : (fun w => (G w).det) = fun w =>
      G w 0 0 * G w 1 1 * G w 2 2 - G w 0 0 * G w 1 2 * G w 2 1
        - G w 0 1 * G w 1 0 * G w 2 2 + G w 0 1 * G w 1 2 * G w 2 0
        + G w 0 2 * G w 1 0 * G w 2 1 - G w 0 2 * G w 1 1 * G w 2 0 := by
    funext w; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK0, hKb⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ z ∈ closedBall y R,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |G z i j| ≤ K * (G z).det := by
    have hc : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun z => G z i j) (closedBall y R) :=
      fun i j => ((hG i j).continuousOn).mono hB
    have hdc : ContinuousOn (fun z => (G z).det) (closedBall y R) := by
      rw [hdetfun]
      have t1 := ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).mul (hc 2 2)
      have t2 := ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 2)).mul (hc 2 1)
      have t3 := ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0)).mul (hc 2 2)
      have t4 := ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 2)).mul (hc 2 0)
      have t5 := ((hc 0 2).mul (hc 1 0)).mul (hc 2 1)
      have t6 := ((hc 0 2).mul (hc 1 1)).mul (hc 2 0)
      exact ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
    have hnum : ContinuousOn (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |G z i j|) (closedBall y R) :=
      continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => (hc i j).abs))
    have hf := hnum.div hdc (fun z hz => (hdet z (hB hz)).ne')
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall y R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hd := hdet z (hB hz)
    have h1 := hC z hz
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    have h2 : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |G z i j|) / (G z).det ≤ max C 0 :=
      (le_abs_self _).trans (h1.trans (le_max_left _ _))
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hd).mp h2
  refine ⟨K + 1, by linarith, fun S => ?_⟩
  have hK1 : 0 < K + 1 := by linarith
  unfold sepPerG
  apply iSup₂_le
  rintro X ⟨hXs, hXc, hXt, hXn⟩
  set lam : ℝ := 1 / (K + 1) with hlam
  set X' : E3 → E3 := fun z => (lam / Real.sqrt (G z).det) • X z with hX'
  have hXU : tsupport X ⊆ U := hXt.trans (ball_subset_closedBall.trans hB)
  
  have hsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X' := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ U
    · have hn := hU.mem_nhds hz
      have hc : ∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => G w i j) z := fun i j => (hG i j).contDiffAt hn
      have hd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => (G w).det) z := by
        rw [hdetfun]
        have t1 := ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).mul (hc 2 2)
        have t2 := ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 2)).mul (hc 2 1)
        have t3 := ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0)).mul (hc 2 2)
        have t4 := ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 2)).mul (hc 2 0)
        have t5 := ((hc 0 2).mul (hc 1 0)).mul (hc 2 1)
        have t6 := ((hc 0 2).mul (hc 1 1)).mul (hc 2 0)
        exact ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
      have hs : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det) z := hd.sqrt (hdet z hz).ne'
      have hq : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => lam / Real.sqrt (G w).det) z :=
        contDiffAt_const.div hs (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hdet z hz)).ne'
      exact hq.smul hXs.contDiffAt
    · have hzt : z ∉ tsupport X := fun h => hz (hXU h)
      rw [notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq] at hzt
      have hev : X' =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => 0 := by
        filter_upwards [hzt] with w hw
        simp [hX', hw]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  
  have hcs : HasCompactSupport X' := by
    show HasCompactSupport ((fun z => lam / Real.sqrt (G z).det) • X)
    exact hXc.smul_left
  have hts : tsupport X' ⊆ ball y R :=
    (tsupport_smul_subset_right (fun z => lam / Real.sqrt (G z).det) X).trans hXt
  
  have hquad : ∀ z, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G z i j * X' z i * X' z j ≤ 1 := by
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ closedBall y R
    · have hd := hdet z (hB hz)
      have hA := hKb z hz
      have hv := hXn z
      set v := X z with hv_def
      set d := (G z).det with hd_def
      have hv' : v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply] at hv
        nlinarith [hv]
      have hvi : ∀ i, |v i| ≤ 1 := by
        have h0 : v 0 ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 1), sq_nonneg (v 2)]
        have h1 : v 1 ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0), sq_nonneg (v 2)]
        have h2 : v 2 ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0), sq_nonneg (v 1)]
        intro i
        fin_cases i
        · exact (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one _).1 h0
        · exact (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one _).1 h1
        · exact (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one _).1 h2
      set a : ℝ := lam / Real.sqrt d with ha
      have hX'z : ∀ i, X' z i = a * v i := by
        intro i
        simp [hX', ha, hv_def, hd_def]
      have hQ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G z i j * v i * v j ≤ K * d := by
        refine le_trans ?_ hA
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_))
        calc G z i j * v i * v j ≤ |G z i j * v i * v j| := le_abs_self _
          _ = |G z i j| * |v i| * |v j| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          _ ≤ |G z i j| * 1 * 1 := by gcongr <;> exact hvi _
          _ = |G z i j| := by ring
      have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G z i j * X' z i * X' z j =
          a ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G z i j * v i * v j := by
        simp only [hX'z, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
        ring
      have ha2 : a ^ 2 * d = lam ^ 2 := by
        rw [ha, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hd.le]
        field_simp
      rw [hsum]
      calc a ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G z i j * v i * v j ≤ a ^ 2 * (K * d) := by
            gcongr
        _ = K * lam ^ 2 := by rw [← ha2]; ring
        _ ≤ 1 := by
            rw [hlam, div_pow, one_pow, mul_one_div, div_le_one (by positivity)]
            nlinarith
    · have hXz : X z = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hz (ball_subset_closedBall (hXt (subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 h))))
      simp [hX', hXz]
  
  have hXd : Differentiable ℝ X := hXs.differentiable (by simp)
  have hdiv : ∀ w, sepDensDiv G X' w =
      lam * sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X w := by
    intro w
    have hfun : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X' z i) = fun z => lam * X z i := by
      intro i
      funext z
      by_cases hXz : X z = 0
      · simp [hX', hXz]
      · have hzU : z ∈ U := hXU (subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hXz))
        have hs := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hdet z hzU)
        simp only [hX', PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
    have hone : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun z => Real.sqrt ((fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) z).det
        * X z i) = fun z => X z i := by
      intro i
      funext z
      simp
    have hdi : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => X z i) w := by
      intro i
      exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt).comp w (hXd w)
    unfold sepDensDiv
    simp only [hfun, hone, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_const_mul (hdi i)]
    rfl
  have hint : ∫ z in S, sepDensDiv G X' z =
      lam * ∫ z in S, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X z := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext z
    exact hdiv z
  calc ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z in S, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X z)
      = ENNReal.ofReal ((K + 1) *
          (lam * ∫ z in S, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X z)) := by
        congr 1
        rw [hlam]
        field_simp
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (K + 1) * ENNReal.ofReal
          (lam * ∫ z in S, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X z) :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_mul hK1.le
    _ ≤ _ := by
        gcongr
        rw [← hint]
        exact le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun (X : E3 → E3) (_ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
          tsupport X ⊆ ball y R ∧ ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) =>
          ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in S, sepDensDiv G X y)) X' ⟨hsm, hcs, hts, hquad⟩ le_rfl

    (hr : 0 < r) (hh : ‖h‖ ≤ r) :
    volume (symmDiff S ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S) ∩ ball y r) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ‖h‖) *
