signature.name: sepPerG_one_translate_le
signature.statement:
(S : Set E3) (y h : E3) (r : ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hh : ‖h‖ ≤ r) :
    volume (symmDiff S ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S) ∩ ball y r) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ‖h‖) *
        sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (ball y (3 * r))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have sepTransAvg_contDiff : ∀ (φ : E3 → ℝ) (h : E3) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ)
      (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, φ (z - t • h)) := by
    intro φ h hφ hφc
    set ν : Measure ℝ := (volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Icc 0 1) with hν
    set μ : Measure E3 := Measure.map (fun t : ℝ => t • h) ν with hμ
    have hc := hφc.contDiff_convolution_right (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) (μ := μ)
      (f := fun _ : E3 => (1:ℝ)) (n := ⊤) (locallyIntegrable_const 1) hφ
    have heq : convolution (fun _ : E3 => (1:ℝ)) φ (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) μ =
        fun z => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, φ (z - t • h) := by
      funext z
      rw [convolution_def]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, one_smul]
      have hcz : Continuous (fun t : E3 => φ (z - t)) :=
        hφ.continuous.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
      rw [hμ, integral_map (f := fun t : E3 => φ (z - t))
        (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => t • h) ν) hcz.aestronglyMeasurable]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one, hν, integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
    rw [← heq]
    exact hc
  
  have sepTransAvg_fderiv_apply : ∀ (φ : E3 → ℝ) (h z : E3) (hφ : Continuous φ)
      (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : E3 => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, φ (w - t • h)) z),
      fderiv ℝ (fun w : E3 => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, φ (w - t • h)) z h = φ z - φ (z - h) := by
    intro φ h z hφ hd
    set Ψ := fun w : E3 => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, φ (w - t • h) with hΨ
    set F : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => φ (z - u • h) with hF
    have hFc : Continuous F := hφ.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..v, F u with hG
    have hGd : ∀ v, HasDerivAt G (F v) v := fun v =>
      (hFc.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 v).hasDerivAt
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z + s • h) ((1:ℝ) • h) 0 :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const h).const_add z
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (Ψ ∘ fun s : ℝ => z + s • h) (fderiv ℝ Ψ z ((1:ℝ) • h)) 0 :=
      hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hγ (by simp)
    have hid : (Ψ ∘ fun s : ℝ => z + s • h) = fun s => G (1 - s) - G (0 - s) := by
      funext s
      have e1 : (fun t : ℝ => φ (z + s • h - t • h)) = fun t => F (t - s) := by
        funext t
        show φ (z + s • h - t • h) = φ (z - (t - s) • h)
        congr 1
        rw [sub_smul]
        abel
      show (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, φ (z + s • h - t • h)) =
        (∫ u in (0:ℝ)..(1 - s), F u) - ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..(0 - s), F u
      rw [e1, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_right (fun t => F t) s,
        intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hFc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
          (hFc.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s => G (1 - s) - G (0 - s)) (-F (1 - 0) - -F (0 - 0)) 0 :=
      ((hGd (1 - 0)).comp_const_sub 1 0).sub ((hGd (0 - 0)).comp_const_sub 0 0)
    rw [hid] at h1
    have h3 := h1.unique h2
    rw [one_smul] at h3
    rw [h3]
    simp only [F, sub_zero, one_smul, zero_smul]
    ring
  
  have sepTransAvg_support : ∀ (φ : E3 → ℝ) (h y : E3) (r : ℝ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
      (hsupp : tsupport φ ⊆ ball y r) (hb : ∀ x, |φ x| ≤ 1) (hh : ‖h‖ ≤ r),
      HasCompactSupport (fun z : E3 => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, φ (z - t • h)) ∧
        tsupport (fun z : E3 => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, φ (z - t • h)) ⊆ ball y (2 * r) ∧
        ∀ z : E3, |∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, φ (z - t • h)| ≤ 1 := by
    intro φ h y r hφc hsupp hb hh
    set C : Set E3 := (fun p : E3 × ℝ => p.1 + p.2 • h) '' (tsupport φ ×ˢ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
      with hC
    have hCc : IsCompact C := (hφc.prod isCompact_Icc).image (by fun_prop)
    have hvan : ∀ z, z ∉ C → (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, φ (z - t • h)) = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0:ℝ)) ?_, intervalIntegral.integral_zero]
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      by_contra hne
      exact hz ⟨(z - t • h, t), ⟨subset_tsupport _ hne, ht⟩, by simp⟩
    have hsuppC : Function.support (fun z => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, φ (z - t • h)) ⊆ C := by
      intro z hz
      by_contra h'
      exact hz (hvan z h')
    refine ⟨HasCompactSupport.intro hCc hvan, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine (closure_minimal hsuppC hCc.isClosed).trans ?_
      rintro _ ⟨⟨k, t⟩, ⟨hk, ht⟩, rfl⟩
      have hk' := hsupp hk
      rw [mem_ball] at hk' ⊢
      have htn : ‖t • h‖ ≤ r := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
        nlinarith [ht.2, ht.1, norm_nonneg h]
      calc dist (k + t • h) y = ‖(k - y) + t • h‖ := by
            rw [dist_eq_norm]; congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ ‖k - y‖ + ‖t • h‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ < r + r := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; linarith
        _ = 2 * r := by ring
    · intro z
      have := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 1) (C := 1)
        (f := fun t => φ (z - t • h)) (fun t _ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hb _)
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  
  have sepPerG_one_pairing_of_potential : ∀ (S U : Set E3) (h : E3) (φ Ψ : E3 → ℝ)
      (hΨ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψ) (hΨc : HasCompactSupport Ψ) (hΨs : tsupport Ψ ⊆ U)
      (hΨb : ∀ z, |Ψ z| ≤ 1) (hΨd : ∀ z, fderiv ℝ Ψ z h = φ z - φ (z - h)),
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in S, (φ (x - h) - φ x)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S U := by
    intro S U h φ Ψ hΨ hΨc hΨs hΨb hΨd
    by_cases h0 : h = 0
    · subst h0
      simp
    have hn : ‖h‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h0
    set c : ℝ := -‖h‖⁻¹ with hc
    set X : E3 → E3 := fun z => (c * Ψ z) • h with hX
    have hXs : Function.support X ⊆ Function.support Ψ := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hz ⊢
      intro h0'
      apply hz
      simp [X, h0']
    have hXadm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ U ∧
        ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y i j *
          X y i * X y j ≤ 1 := by
      refine ⟨(contDiff_const.mul hΨ).smul contDiff_const,
        hΨc.mono' (hXs.trans (subset_tsupport _)), (closure_mono hXs).trans hΨs, ?_⟩
      intro z
      have hnsq : ‖h‖ ^ 2 = h 0 ^ 2 + h 1 ^ 2 + h 2 ^ 2 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        simp [sq_abs]
      have hcc : c ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [hc]
        field_simp
      have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) z i j *
          X z i * X z j = (Ψ z) ^ 2 := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply, X, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        simp
        linear_combination (Ψ z) ^ 2 * hcc - c ^ 2 * (Ψ z) ^ 2 * hnsq
      rw [hsum]
      exact (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one _).2 (hΨb z)
    have hle : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in S, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X x)
        ≤ sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S U := by
      unfold sepPerG
      exact le_iSup_of_le X (le_iSup_of_le hXadm le_rfl)
    have hdiv : ∀ z, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X z =
        ‖h‖⁻¹ * (φ (z - h) - φ z) := by
      intro z
      have hfun : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun w => Real.sqrt ((fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) w).det
          * X w i) = fun w => (c * h i) * Ψ w := by
        intro i
        funext w
        simp [X]
        ring
      have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ z := hΨ.differentiable (by simp) z
      have hhe : h = h 0 • e 0 + h 1 • e 1 + h 2 • e 2 := by
        ext j
        fin_cases j <;> simp [e]
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      simp only [hfun, fderiv_const_mul hdiff, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Fin.sum_univ_three]
      have hfd : fderiv ℝ Ψ z h = h 0 * fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e 0) + h 1 * fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e 1) +
          h 2 * fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e 2) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hhe]
        simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hΨd z] at hfd
      rw [hc]
      linear_combination ‖h‖⁻¹ * hfd
    have hI : ∫ x in S, (φ (x - h) - φ x) =
        ‖h‖ * ∫ x in S, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X x := by
      simp_rw [hdiv]
      rw [integral_const_mul]
      field_simp
    rw [hI, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (norm_nonneg _)]
    exact mul_le_mul_left' hle _
  
  have sepSmooth_indicator_approx : ∀ (A : Set E3) (y : E3) (r ε : ℝ) (hA : MeasurableSet A)
      (hAB : A ⊆ ball y r) (hε : 0 < ε),
      ∃ φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧ tsupport φ ⊆ ball y r ∧
        (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) ∧
        ∀ w : E3 → ℝ, Measurable w → (∀ x, |w x| ≤ 1) → (∀ x ∈ A, w x = 1) →
          (volume A).toReal - ε ≤ ∫ x, φ x * w x := by
    intro A y r ε hA hAB hε
    have hAfin : volume A ≠ ⊤ := ((measure_mono hAB).trans_lt measure_ball_lt_top).ne
    have hδ : ENNReal.ofReal (ε / 4) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le]
      linarith
    obtain ⟨K, hKA, hKc, hKd⟩ := hA.exists_isCompact_diff_lt hAfin hδ
    obtain ⟨O', hAO', hO'o, -, hO'd⟩ := hA.exists_isOpen_diff_lt hAfin hδ
    set O : Set E3 := O' ∩ ball y r with hOdef
    have hOo : IsOpen O := hO'o.inter isOpen_ball
    have hAO : A ⊆ O := Set.subset_inter hAO' hAB
    have hKO : K ⊆ O := hKA.trans hAO
    obtain ⟨V, hVo, hKV, hVO, hVc⟩ := exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hKc hOo hKO
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfr, hfs, hf1⟩ :=
      exists_contMDiff_support_eq_eq_one_iff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (n := ⊤) hVo hKc.isClosed hKV
    have hfc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f := contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp hf
    have hts : tsupport f = closure V := by
      show closure (Function.support f) = closure V
      rw [hfs]
    have hfcs : HasCompactSupport f := by
      show IsCompact (tsupport f)
      rw [hts]
      exact hVc
    have hf01 : ∀ x, f x ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := fun x => hfr ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨f, hfc, hfcs, ?_, fun x => hf01 x, ?_⟩
    · rw [hts]
      exact hVO.trans Set.inter_subset_right
    intro w hw hwb hwA
    have hOfin : volume O ≠ ⊤ :=
      ((measure_mono (Set.inter_subset_right : O ⊆ ball y r)).trans_lt measure_ball_lt_top).ne
    have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hKc.isClosed.measurableSet
    have hOKm : MeasurableSet (O \ K) := hOo.measurableSet.diff hKm
    have hOK : volume (O \ K) < ENNReal.ofReal (ε / 2) := by
      calc volume (O \ K) ≤ volume ((O' \ A) ∪ (A \ K)) := by
            apply measure_mono
            rintro x ⟨⟨hxO', -⟩, hxK⟩
            by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
            · exact Or.inr ⟨hxA, hxK⟩
            · exact Or.inl ⟨hxO', hxA⟩
        _ ≤ volume (O' \ A) + volume (A \ K) := measure_union_le _ _
        _ < ENNReal.ofReal (ε / 4) + ENNReal.ofReal (ε / 4) := ENNReal.add_lt_add hO'd hKd
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (ε / 2) := by
            rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by linarith) (by linarith)]
            congr 1
            ring
    have hOKr : volume.real (O \ K) < ε / 2 := ENNReal.toReal_lt_of_lt_ofReal hOK
    have hAOr : volume.real A ≤ volume.real O := measureReal_mono hAO hOfin
    have hOsplit : volume.real (O \ K) = volume.real O - volume.real K :=
      measureReal_diff hKO hKm hOfin
    have hfw_int : Integrable (fun x => f x * w x) := by
      have hfi : Integrable f := hfc.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hfcs
      have h2 := hfi.bdd_mul (c := 1) hw.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hwb x))
      simpa only [mul_comm] using h2
    have hKfin : volume K ≠ ⊤ := hKc.measure_lt_top.ne
    have hOKfin : volume (O \ K) ≠ ⊤ :=
      ((measure_mono (Set.diff_subset : O \ K ⊆ O)).trans_lt hOfin.lt_top).ne
    have hKi : Integrable (K.indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ)) :=
      (integrableOn_const hKfin).integrable_indicator hKm
    have hOKi : Integrable ((O \ K).indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ)) :=
      (integrableOn_const hOKfin).integrable_indicator hOKm
    have hpt : ∀ x, K.indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x - (O \ K).indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x ≤
        f x * w x := by
      intro x
      by_cases hxK : x ∈ K
      · have h1 : f x = 1 := (hf1 x).1 hxK
        have h2 : w x = 1 := hwA x (hKA hxK)
        simp [hxK, h1, h2]
      · by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
        · have hb1 := hf01 x
          have hb2 := abs_le.mp (hwb x)
          have hm : -1 ≤ f x * w x := by nlinarith [hb1.1, hb1.2, hb2.1, hb2.2]
          simp [hxK, hxO] <;> linarith
        · have h0 : f x = 0 := by
            by_contra hne
            have hx : x ∈ Function.support f := hne
            rw [hfs] at hx
            exact hxO (hVO (subset_closure hx))
          simp [hxK, hxO, h0]
    have hint : ∫ x, (K.indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x - (O \ K).indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x) ≤
        ∫ x, f x * w x := integral_mono (hKi.sub hOKi) hfw_int hpt
    rw [integral_sub hKi hOKi, integral_indicator_one hKm, integral_indicator_one hOKm] at hint
    have hAr : (volume A).toReal = volume.real A := rfl
    rw [hAr]
    rw [hOsplit] at hOKr hint
    linarith
  
  have sepTranslate_pairing_eq : ∀ (S : Set E3) (h : E3) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S)
      (hφ : Continuous φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ),
      ∫ x, φ x * (Set.indicator ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S) (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x -
        Set.indicator S (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x) = ∫ x in S, (φ (x - h) - φ x) := by
    intro S h φ hS hφ hφc
    have hTm : MeasurableSet ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S) := hS.preimage (measurable_add_const h)
    have hφi : Integrable φ := hφ.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hφc
    have e1 : (fun x => φ x * (Set.indicator ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S) (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x -
        Set.indicator S (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x)) =
        fun x => ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S).indicator φ x - S.indicator φ x := by
      funext x
      by_cases h1 : x + h ∈ S <;> by_cases h2 : x ∈ S <;> simp [h1, h2]
    rw [e1, integral_sub (hφi.indicator hTm) (hφi.indicator hS), integral_indicator hS]
    have hφh : Integrable (fun x => φ (x - h)) := hφi.comp_sub_right h
    have e2 : ∫ x, ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S).indicator φ x = ∫ x in S, φ (x - h) := by
      rw [← integral_indicator hS]
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (integral_add_right_eq_self
        (fun x => S.indicator (fun x => φ (x - h)) x) h)
      congr 1
      funext x
      by_cases h1 : x + h ∈ S <;> simp [h1]
    rw [e2, integral_sub hφh.integrableOn hφi.integrableOn]
  
  set P := sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (ball y (3 * r)) with hP
  set T := (fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S with hT
  have hTm : MeasurableSet T := hS.preimage (measurable_add_const h)
  have key : ∀ E : Set E3, MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ ball y r → ∀ σ : ℝ, |σ| = 1 →
      (∀ x ∈ E, σ * (T.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x - S.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x) = 1) →
      volume E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ * P := by
    intro E hE hEB σ hσ hEσ
    have hEfin : volume E ≠ ⊤ := ((measure_mono hEB).trans_lt measure_ball_lt_top).ne
    refine ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε _ => ?_
    have hε' : (0 : ℝ) < ε := hε
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφc, hφs, hφb, hφw⟩ := sepSmooth_indicator_approx E y r ε hE hEB hε'
    set w : E3 → ℝ := fun x =>
      σ * (T.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x - S.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x) with hw
    have hwm : Measurable w :=
      ((measurable_const.indicator hTm).sub (measurable_const.indicator hS)).const_mul σ
    have hwb : ∀ x, |w x| ≤ 1 := by
      intro x
      simp only [w, abs_mul, hσ, one_mul]
      by_cases h1 : x ∈ T <;> by_cases h2 : x ∈ S <;> simp [h1, h2]
    have h1 := hφw w hwm hwb hEσ
    set ψ : E3 → ℝ := fun x => σ * φ x with hψdef
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := contDiff_const.mul hφ
    have hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ := hφc.mul_left
    have hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ ball y r :=
      (closure_mono (Function.support_mul_subset_right _ _)).trans hφs
    have hψb : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ 1 := by
      intro x
      simp only [ψ, abs_mul, hσ, one_mul]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (hφb x).1]
      exact (hφb x).2
    have hint : ∫ x, φ x * w x = ∫ x in S, (ψ (x - h) - ψ x) := by
      have e1 : (fun x => φ x * w x) = fun x => σ * (φ x *
          (T.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x - S.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x)) := by
        funext x; simp only [w]; ring
      rw [e1, integral_const_mul, sepTranslate_pairing_eq S h φ hS hφ.continuous hφc,
        ← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      funext x
      simp only [ψ]
      ring
    set Ψ : E3 → ℝ := fun z => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, ψ (z - t • h) with hΨdef
    have hΨ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψ := sepTransAvg_contDiff ψ h hψ hψc
    obtain ⟨hΨc, hΨs, hΨb⟩ := sepTransAvg_support ψ h y r hψc hψs hψb hh
    have hΨd : ∀ z, fderiv ℝ Ψ z h = ψ z - ψ (z - h) := fun z =>
      sepTransAvg_fderiv_apply ψ h z hψ.continuous (hΨ.differentiable (by simp) z)
    have hB := sepPerG_one_pairing_of_potential S (ball y (3 * r)) h ψ Ψ hΨ hΨc
      (hΨs.trans (ball_subset_ball (by linarith))) hΨb hΨd
    have h2 : ENNReal.ofReal ((volume E).toReal - ε) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ * P := by
      refine le_trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h1) ?_
      rw [hint]
      exact hB
    calc volume E = ENNReal.ofReal ((volume E).toReal - ε + ε) := by
          rw [sub_add_cancel, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hEfin]
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((volume E).toReal - ε) + ENNReal.ofReal ε := ENNReal.ofReal_add_le
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ * P + ε := by
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
          gcongr
  have hsub : symmDiff S T ∩ ball y r ⊆ ((S \ T) ∩ ball y r) ∪ ((T \ S) ∩ ball y r) := by
    rw [Set.symmDiff_def, Set.union_inter_distrib_right]
  have hA := key ((S \ T) ∩ ball y r) ((hS.diff hTm).inter measurableSet_ball)
    Set.inter_subset_right (-1) (by simp) (by
      rintro x ⟨⟨hxS, hxT⟩, -⟩
      simp [hxS, hxT])
  have hB := key ((T \ S) ∩ ball y r) ((hTm.diff hS).inter measurableSet_ball)
    Set.inter_subset_right 1 (by simp) (by
      rintro x ⟨⟨hxT, hxS⟩, -⟩
      simp [hxS, hxT])
  calc volume (symmDiff S T ∩ ball y r)
      ≤ volume (((S \ T) ∩ ball y r) ∪ ((T \ S) ∩ ball y r)) := measure_mono hsub
    _ ≤ volume ((S \ T) ∩ ball y r) + volume ((T \ S) ∩ ball y r) := measure_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ * P + ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ * P := add_le_add hA hB
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ‖h‖) * P := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2), ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat, mul_assoc,
          two_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(y : E3) (r C : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (S : ℕ → Set E3)
    (hS : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (S n))
    (hmod : ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : E3), ‖h‖ ≤ r →
      volume (symmDiff (S n) ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S n) ∩ ball y r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ‖h‖)) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      volume (symmDiff (S (φ n)) (S (φ m)) ∩ ball y (r / 2)) < ENNReal.ofReal ε

signature.name: sepSets_cauchy_subseq
signature.statement:
(y : E3) (r C : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (S : ℕ → Set E3)
    (hS : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (S n))
    (hmod : ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : E3), ‖h‖ ≤ r →
      volume (symmDiff (S n) ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S n) ∩ ball y r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ‖h‖)) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      volume (symmDiff (S (φ n)) (S (φ m)) ∩ ball y (r / 2)) < ENNReal.ofReal ε

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  
  
  have sepSets_extract_cauchy : ∀ (D : ℕ → ℕ → ENNReal), (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ (K : ℕ)
      (v : ℕ → Fin K → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ n j, 0 ≤ v n j ∧ v n j ≤ 1) ∧
        ∀ n m, D n m ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε + c * ∑ j, |v n j - v m j|)) →
      ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
        D (φ n) (φ m) < ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    intro D happrox
    choose K v c hv hD using fun k : ℕ => happrox (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) (by positivity)
    let a : ℕ → (ℕ × ℕ → ℝ) := fun n p => if h : p.2 < K p.1 then v p.1 n ⟨p.2, h⟩ else 0
    have ha : ∀ n, a n ∈ Set.univ.pi (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) := by
      intro n p _
      simp only [a]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact ⟨(hv p.1 n ⟨p.2, h⟩).1, (hv p.1 n ⟨p.2, h⟩).2⟩
      · exact ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
    obtain ⟨alim, -, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ :=
      (isCompact_univ_pi (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => isCompact_Icc (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1))).tendsto_subseq ha
    refine ⟨φ, hφ, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt (half_pos hε)
    set δ := ε / (2 * (|c k| + 1) * ((K k : ℝ) + 1)) with hδ
    have hδpos : 0 < δ := by positivity
    have hcoord : ∀ j : Fin (K k), ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
        |v k (φ n) j - v k (φ m) j| < δ := by
      intro j
      have h1 : Tendsto (fun n => a (φ n) (k, j.val)) atTop (𝓝 (alim (k, j.val))) :=
        (tendsto_pi_nhds.1 hlim) (k, j.val)
      have h2 := h1.cauchySeq
      rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff] at h2
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h2 δ hδpos
      refine ⟨N, fun n m hn hm => ?_⟩
      have := hN n hn m hm
      simpa [a, j.isLt, Real.dist_eq] using this
    choose Nj hNj using hcoord
    refine ⟨Finset.univ.sup Nj, fun n m hn hm => ?_⟩
    have hb : ∀ j, |v k (φ n) j - v k (φ m) j| < δ := fun j =>
      hNj j n m ((Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans hn)
        ((Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans hm)
    have hsum : ∑ j, |v k (φ n) j - v k (φ m) j| ≤ (K k : ℝ) * δ := by
      calc _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin (K k), δ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => (hb j).le
        _ = K k * δ := by simp
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, |v k (φ n) j - v k (φ m) j| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => abs_nonneg _
    have hK : (0:ℝ) ≤ K k := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hc : 0 ≤ |c k| := abs_nonneg _
    have hfrac : |c k| * K k / ((|c k| + 1) * (K k + 1)) < 1 := by
      rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]; nlinarith
    have heq : |c k| * (↑(K k) * δ) = ε / 2 * (|c k| * K k / ((|c k| + 1) * (K k + 1))) := by
      rw [hδ]; field_simp
    have hcs : c k * ∑ j, |v k (φ n) j - v k (φ m) j| < ε / 2 := by
      calc c k * ∑ j, |v k (φ n) j - v k (φ m) j|
          ≤ |c k| * ∑ j, |v k (φ n) j - v k (φ m) j| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) hS0
        _ ≤ |c k| * (K k * δ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hc
        _ < ε / 2 := by rw [heq]; nlinarith
    calc D (φ n) (φ m)
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / ((k:ℝ) + 1) + c k * ∑ j, |v k (φ n) j - v k (φ m) j|) :=
          hD k (φ n) (φ m)
      _ < ENNReal.ofReal ε := (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hε).2 (by linarith)
  
  
  
  have sepSets_cube_deficiency : ∀ (T Q H : Set E3), MeasurableSet T → MeasurableSet Q →
      MeasurableSet H → (∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ x' ∈ Q, x' - x ∈ H) →
      volume (T ∩ Q) * volume (Q \ T) ≤
        ∫⁻ h in H, volume (symmDiff T ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' T) ∩ Q) := by
    intro T Q H hT hQ hH hQH
    have hA : MeasurableSet (T ∩ Q) := hT.inter hQ
    have hP : MeasurableSet (Q \ T) := hQ.diff hT
    set E : Set (E3 × E3) := {p | p.2 ∈ H ∧ p.1 ∈ Q ∧ p.1 ∈ T ∧ p.1 + p.2 ∉ T} with hE
    have hEm : MeasurableSet E := by
      have h1 : Measurable (fun p : E3 × E3 => p.1 + p.2) := measurable_fst.add measurable_snd
      exact (measurable_snd hH).inter ((measurable_fst hQ).inter
        ((measurable_fst hT).inter (h1 hT).compl))
    have hpres := measurePreserving_prod_add (volume : Measure E3) (volume : Measure E3)
    calc volume (T ∩ Q) * volume (Q \ T)
        = ((volume : Measure E3).prod (volume : Measure E3)) ((T ∩ Q) ×ˢ (Q \ T)) :=
          (Measure.prod_prod _ _).symm
      _ = ((volume : Measure E3).prod (volume : Measure E3))
            ((fun z : E3 × E3 => (z.1, z.1 + z.2)) ⁻¹' ((T ∩ Q) ×ˢ (Q \ T))) :=
          (hpres.measure_preimage (hA.prod hP).nullMeasurableSet).symm
      _ ≤ ((volume : Measure E3).prod (volume : Measure E3)) E := by
          apply measure_mono
          rintro ⟨x, h⟩ ⟨⟨hxT, hxQ⟩, hxhQ, hxhT⟩
          refine ⟨?_, hxQ, hxT, hxhT⟩
          have := hQH x hxQ (x + h) hxhQ
          simpa using this
      _ = ∫⁻ h, volume ((fun x => (x, h)) ⁻¹' E) := Measure.prod_apply_symm hEm
      _ = ∫⁻ h in H, volume (Q ∩ T ∩ ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' T)ᶜ) := by
          rw [← lintegral_indicator hH]
          congr 1
          funext h
          by_cases hh : h ∈ H
          · rw [Set.indicator_apply, if_pos hh]
            congr 1
            ext x
            simp only [hE, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff,
              Set.mem_compl_iff]
            tauto
          · rw [Set.indicator_apply, if_neg hh]
            have : (fun x => (x, h)) ⁻¹' E = ∅ := by
              ext x
              simp [hE, hh]
            rw [this, measure_empty]
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ h in H, volume (symmDiff T ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' T) ∩ Q) := by
          refine lintegral_mono fun h => measure_mono ?_
          rintro x ⟨⟨hxQ, hxT⟩, hxn⟩
          exact ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hxT, hxn⟩), hxQ⟩
  
  
  
  have sepSets_symmDiff_le_cubes : ∀ (A B V : Set E3) (K : ℕ) (Q : Fin K → Set E3) (q : ℝ),
      MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Q j)) → 0 < q →
      (∀ j, volume (Q j) = ENNReal.ofReal q) → V ⊆ ⋃ j, Q j →
      (volume (symmDiff A B ∩ V)).toReal ≤
        2 / q * ∑ j, (volume (A ∩ Q j)).toReal * (volume (Q j \ A)).toReal +
        2 / q * ∑ j, (volume (B ∩ Q j)).toReal * (volume (Q j \ B)).toReal +
        ∑ j, |(volume (A ∩ Q j)).toReal - (volume (B ∩ Q j)).toReal| := by
    intro A B V K Q q hA hB hQ hq hvol hV
    have split : ∀ X Y : Set E3, MeasurableSet Y → volume X ≠ ⊤ →
        (volume X).toReal = (volume (X ∩ Y)).toReal + (volume (X \ Y)).toReal := by
      intro X Y hY hX
      rw [← measure_inter_add_diff X hY, ENNReal.toReal_add
        (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hX (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_left))
        (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hX (measure_mono Set.diff_subset))]
    have hcube : ∀ j, (volume (symmDiff A B ∩ Q j)).toReal ≤
        2 / q * ((volume (A ∩ Q j)).toReal * (volume (Q j \ A)).toReal) +
        2 / q * ((volume (B ∩ Q j)).toReal * (volume (Q j \ B)).toReal) +
        |(volume (A ∩ Q j)).toReal - (volume (B ∩ Q j)).toReal| := by
      intro j
      have hQf : volume (Q j) ≠ ⊤ := by rw [hvol j]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
      have fin : ∀ X, X ⊆ Q j → volume X ≠ ⊤ := fun X hX =>
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top hQf (measure_mono hX)
      have e1 : B ∩ Q j ∩ A = A ∩ Q j ∩ B := by
        ext x; simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff]; tauto
      have e2 : (Q j \ A) ∩ B = (B ∩ Q j) \ A := by
        ext x; simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_diff]; tauto
      have e3 : (Q j \ B) ∩ A = (A ∩ Q j) \ B := by
        ext x; simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_diff]; tauto
      have e4 : (Q j \ B) \ A = (Q j \ A) \ B := by
        ext x; simp only [Set.mem_diff]; tauto
      have e5 : Q j ∩ A = A ∩ Q j := Set.inter_comm _ _
      have hα := split (A ∩ Q j) B hB (fin _ Set.inter_subset_right)
      have hβ := split (B ∩ Q j) A hA (fin _ Set.inter_subset_right)
      have hα' := split (Q j \ A) B hB (fin _ Set.diff_subset)
      have hβ' := split (Q j \ B) A hA (fin _ Set.diff_subset)
      have hqq := split (Q j) A hA hQf
      rw [e1] at hβ
      rw [e2] at hα'
      rw [e3, e4] at hβ'
      rw [e5] at hqq
      have hqr : (volume (Q j)).toReal = q := by rw [hvol j]; exact ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hq.le
      have hsd : (volume (symmDiff A B ∩ Q j)).toReal =
          (volume ((A ∩ Q j) \ B)).toReal + (volume ((B ∩ Q j) \ A)).toReal := by
        have hset : symmDiff A B ∩ Q j = ((A ∩ Q j) \ B) ∪ ((B ∩ Q j) \ A) := by
          ext x
          simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_symmDiff]
          tauto
        have hdis : Disjoint ((A ∩ Q j) \ B) ((B ∩ Q j) \ A) := by
          rw [Set.disjoint_left]
          intro x hx1 hx2
          exact hx1.2 hx2.1.1
        rw [hset, measure_union hdis (((hB.inter (hQ j))).diff hA), ENNReal.toReal_add
          (fin _ (fun x hx => hx.1.2)) (fin _ (fun x hx => hx.1.2))]
      set a := (volume (A ∩ Q j ∩ B)).toReal with ha
      set b := (volume ((A ∩ Q j) \ B)).toReal with hb
      set c := (volume ((B ∩ Q j) \ A)).toReal with hc
      set d := (volume ((Q j \ A) \ B)).toReal with hd
      have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      rw [hsd, hα, hβ, hα', hβ']
      have hqs : q = a + b + c + d := by rw [← hqr, hqq, hα, hα']; ring
      have habs : |a + b - (a + c)| = |b - c| := by congr 1; ring
      rw [habs]
      have hpoly : q * (b + c) ≤
          2 * ((a + b) * (c + d)) + 2 * ((a + c) * (b + d)) + q * |b - c| := by
        rw [hqs]
        rcases le_total c b with hcb | hbc
        · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hcb)]
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha0 hb0, mul_nonneg ha0 hd0, mul_nonneg hb0 hd0,
            mul_nonneg hc0 (sub_nonneg.2 hcb)]
        · rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.2 hbc)]
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha0 hc0, mul_nonneg ha0 hd0, mul_nonneg hc0 hd0,
            mul_nonneg hb0 (sub_nonneg.2 hbc)]
      rw [← sub_nonneg]
      have hrw : 2 / q * ((a + b) * (c + d)) + 2 / q * ((a + c) * (b + d)) + |b - c| - (b + c) =
          (2 * ((a + b) * (c + d)) + 2 * ((a + c) * (b + d)) + q * |b - c| - q * (b + c)) / q := by
        field_simp
      rw [hrw]
      exact div_nonneg (by linarith) hq.le
    have hU : volume (symmDiff A B ∩ V) ≤ ∑ j, volume (symmDiff A B ∩ Q j) := by
      calc volume (symmDiff A B ∩ V) ≤ volume (⋃ j, symmDiff A B ∩ Q j) := by
            apply measure_mono
            intro x hx
            obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (hV hx.2)
            exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hx.1, hj⟩
        _ ≤ ∑ j, volume (symmDiff A B ∩ Q j) := measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
    have hfin : ∀ j, volume (symmDiff A B ∩ Q j) ≠ ⊤ := fun j =>
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by rw [hvol j]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
        (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
    have hR : (volume (symmDiff A B ∩ V)).toReal ≤
        ∑ j, (volume (symmDiff A B ∩ Q j)).toReal := by
      rw [← ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun j _ => hfin j)]
      exact ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.sum_ne_top.2 (fun j _ => hfin j)) hU
    refine hR.trans ((Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hcube j).trans (le_of_eq ?_))
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  
  
  
  have sepSets_cube_cover : ∀ (y : E3) (r s : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 < s → s ≤ r / 4 →
      ∃ (K : ℕ) (Q : Fin K → Set E3) (H : Set E3), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Q j)) ∧
        (∀ j, volume (Q j) = ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ 3)) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (Q i) (Q j)) ∧ (∀ j, Q j ⊆ ball y r) ∧
        ball y (r / 2) ⊆ ⋃ j, Q j ∧ MeasurableSet H ∧ volume H ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (8 * s ^ 3) ∧
        (∀ h ∈ H, ‖h‖ ≤ 2 * s) ∧ (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ Q j, ∀ x' ∈ Q j, x' - x ∈ H) := by
    intro y r s _hr hs hsr
    have hLp := EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 3)
    let cube : (Fin 3 → ℤ) → Set E3 := fun z =>
      (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ)).symm ⁻¹'
        (Set.univ.pi fun i => Set.Ico ((z i : ℝ) * s) (((z i : ℝ) + 1) * s))
    have mem_cube : ∀ z x, x ∈ cube z ↔
        ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) * s ≤ x i ∧ x i < ((z i : ℝ) + 1) * s := by
      intro z x
      simp only [cube, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ_pi, Set.mem_Ico]
      exact Iff.rfl
    have cube_meas : ∀ z, MeasurableSet (cube z) := fun z =>
      MeasurableEquiv.measurable _ (MeasurableSet.univ_pi fun i => measurableSet_Ico)
    have cube_vol : ∀ z, volume (cube z) = ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ 3) := by
      intro z
      show volume ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ)).symm ⁻¹'
        (Set.univ.pi fun i => Set.Ico ((z i : ℝ) * s) (((z i : ℝ) + 1) * s))) = _
      rw [hLp.measure_preimage
          (MeasurableSet.univ_pi fun i => measurableSet_Ico).nullMeasurableSet,
        Real.volume_pi_Ico]
      simp only [show ∀ i, ((z i : ℝ) + 1) * s - (z i : ℝ) * s = s from fun i => by ring]
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, ENNReal.ofReal_pow hs.le]
    let H : Set E3 := (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ)).symm ⁻¹'
      (Set.univ.pi fun _ : Fin 3 => Set.Ioo (-s) s)
    have mem_H : ∀ h, h ∈ H ↔ ∀ i, -s < h i ∧ h i < s := by
      intro h
      simp only [H, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ_pi, Set.mem_Ioo]
      exact Iff.rfl
    have H_meas : MeasurableSet H :=
      MeasurableEquiv.measurable _ (MeasurableSet.univ_pi fun i => measurableSet_Ioo)
    have H_vol : volume H ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (8 * s ^ 3) := by
      apply le_of_eq
      show volume ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ)).symm ⁻¹'
        (Set.univ.pi fun _ : Fin 3 => Set.Ioo (-s) s)) = _
      rw [hLp.measure_preimage
          (MeasurableSet.univ_pi fun i => measurableSet_Ioo).nullMeasurableSet,
        Real.volume_pi_Ioo]
      rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by linarith)]
      congr 1
      ring
    have H_norm : ∀ h ∈ H, ‖h‖ ≤ 2 * s := by
      intro h hh
      rw [mem_H] at hh
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      have hsq : ∀ i, ‖h i‖ ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
        intro i
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
        nlinarith [(hh i).1, (hh i).2]
      rw [show 2 * s = √((2 * s) ^ 2) from (Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)).symm]
      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      nlinarith [hsq 0, hsq 1, hsq 2]
    have diff_H : ∀ z, ∀ x ∈ cube z, ∀ x' ∈ cube z, x' - x ∈ H := by
      intro z x hx x' hx'
      rw [mem_cube] at hx hx'
      rw [mem_H]
      intro i
      have h1 := hx i
      have h2 := hx' i
      have e : (x' - x) i = x' i - x i := by simp
      have e2 : ((z i : ℝ) + 1) * s = (z i : ℝ) * s + s := by ring
      rw [e]
      constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]
    have floor_eq : ∀ z x i, x ∈ cube z → ⌊x i / s⌋ = z i := by
      intro z x i hx
      rw [mem_cube] at hx
      rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
      constructor
      · rw [le_div_iff₀ hs]; exact (hx i).1
      · rw [div_lt_iff₀ hs]; exact (hx i).2
    have cube_disj : ∀ z w, z ≠ w → Disjoint (cube z) (cube w) := by
      intro z w hzw
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxz hxw
      apply hzw
      funext i
      exact (floor_eq z x i hxz).symm.trans (floor_eq w x i hxw)
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℤ, M = ⌈(‖y‖ + r) / s⌉ + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    let Zall : Finset (Fin 3 → ℤ) := Fintype.piFinset fun _ => Finset.Icc (-M) M
    let Z : Finset (Fin 3 → ℤ) := Zall.filter (fun z => cube z ⊆ ball y r)
    let e := Z.equivFin
    refine ⟨Z.card, fun j => cube (e.symm j : Fin 3 → ℤ), H, fun j => cube_meas _,
      fun j => cube_vol _, ?_, ?_, ?_, H_meas, H_vol, H_norm, fun j => diff_H _⟩
    · intro i j hij
      apply cube_disj
      intro h
      exact hij (e.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h))
    · intro j
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 (e.symm j).2).2
    · intro x hx
      rw [mem_ball] at hx
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : Fin 3 → ℤ, ∀ i, z i = ⌊x i / s⌋ := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      have hxz : x ∈ cube z := by
        rw [mem_cube]
        intro i
        rw [hz i]
        constructor
        · rw [← le_div_iff₀ hs]; exact Int.floor_le _
        · rw [← div_lt_iff₀ hs]; exact Int.lt_floor_add_one _
      have hsub : cube z ⊆ ball y r := by
        intro x' hx'
        rw [mem_ball]
        have h1 : ‖x' - x‖ ≤ 2 * s := H_norm _ (diff_H z x hxz x' hx')
        calc dist x' y ≤ dist x' x + dist x y := dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ < 2 * s + r / 2 := by rw [dist_eq_norm x' x]; linarith
          _ ≤ r := by linarith
      have hzall : z ∈ Zall := by
        rw [Fintype.mem_piFinset]
        intro i
        rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
        have hxi : |x i| < ‖y‖ + r := by
          have h1 : ‖x i‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le x i
          have h2 : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖y‖ + dist x y := by
            rw [dist_eq_norm]
            calc ‖x‖ = ‖y + (x - y)‖ := by rw [add_sub_cancel]
              _ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖x - y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
          linarith
        have hq : |x i / s| < (‖y‖ + r) / s := by
          rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hs]
          exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right hxi hs
        obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_lt.1 hq
        have hc := Int.le_ceil ((‖y‖ + r) / s)
        have hfl := Int.floor_le (x i / s)
        have hfl2 := Int.sub_one_lt_floor (x i / s)
        rw [← hz i] at hfl hfl2
        have h1 : (z i : ℝ) < ((⌈(‖y‖ + r) / s⌉ : ℤ) : ℝ) := by linarith
        have h1' : z i < ⌈(‖y‖ + r) / s⌉ := by exact_mod_cast h1
        have h2 : ((-⌈(‖y‖ + r) / s⌉ - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) < (z i : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith
        have h2' : -⌈(‖y‖ + r) / s⌉ - 1 < z i := by exact_mod_cast h2
        constructor <;> omega
      have hzZ : z ∈ Z := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hzall, hsub⟩
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨e ⟨z, hzZ⟩, ?_⟩
      show x ∈ cube ((e.symm (e ⟨z, hzZ⟩)) : Fin 3 → ℤ)
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      exact hxz
  
  
  
  have sepSets_deficiency_sum_le : ∀ (T U H : Set E3) (K : ℕ) (Q : Fin K → Set E3)
      (b : ENNReal), MeasurableSet T → MeasurableSet H → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Q j)) →
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (Q i) (Q j)) → (∀ j, Q j ⊆ U) →
      (∀ j, volume (T ∩ Q j) * volume (Q j \ T) ≤
        ∫⁻ h in H, volume (symmDiff T ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' T) ∩ Q j)) →
      (∀ h ∈ H, volume (symmDiff T ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' T) ∩ U) ≤ b) →
      ∑ j, volume (T ∩ Q j) * volume (Q j \ T) ≤ volume H * b := by
    intro T U H K Q b hT hH hQ hdisj hQU hcube hb
    set f : Fin K → E3 → ENNReal :=
      fun j h => volume (symmDiff T ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' T) ∩ Q j) with hf
    have hsw : ∀ s : Finset (Fin K), ∑ j ∈ s, ∫⁻ h in H, f j h ≤ ∫⁻ h in H, ∑ j ∈ s, f j h := by
      intro s
      induction s using Finset.induction_on with
      | empty => simp
      | insert a s ha ih =>
        simp only [Finset.sum_insert ha]
        calc (∫⁻ h in H, f a h) + ∑ j ∈ s, ∫⁻ h in H, f j h
            ≤ (∫⁻ h in H, f a h) + ∫⁻ h in H, ∑ j ∈ s, f j h := add_le_add le_rfl ih
          _ ≤ ∫⁻ h in H, (f a h + ∑ j ∈ s, f j h) := le_lintegral_add _ _
    have hpt : ∀ h ∈ H, ∑ j, f j h ≤ b := by
      intro h hh
      have hX : MeasurableSet (symmDiff T ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' T)) :=
        hT.symmDiff (measurable_add_const h hT)
      calc ∑ j, f j h = volume (⋃ j, symmDiff T ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' T) ∩ Q j) := by
            rw [measure_iUnion (fun i j hij => (hdisj hij).mono Set.inter_subset_right
              Set.inter_subset_right) (fun j => hX.inter (hQ j)), tsum_fintype]
        _ ≤ volume (symmDiff T ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' T) ∩ U) :=
            measure_mono (Set.iUnion_subset fun j => Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ (hQU j))
        _ ≤ b := hb h hh
    calc ∑ j, volume (T ∩ Q j) * volume (Q j \ T) ≤ ∑ j, ∫⁻ h in H, f j h :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hcube j
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ h in H, ∑ j, f j h := hsw _
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ h in H, b := setLIntegral_mono' hH hpt
      _ = volume H * b := by rw [setLIntegral_const, mul_comm]
  
  
  
  refine sepSets_extract_cauchy (fun n m => volume (symmDiff (S n) (S m) ∩ ball y (r / 2))) ?_
  intro ε hε
  set C' : ℝ := |C| with hC'
  have hC'0 : 0 ≤ C' := abs_nonneg C
  set s : ℝ := min (r / 4) (ε / (64 * (C' + 1))) with hs_def
  have hs : 0 < s := lt_min (by linarith) (div_pos hε (by positivity))
  have hsr : s ≤ r / 4 := min_le_left _ _
  have hsε : 64 * C' * s ≤ ε := by
    have h1 : s ≤ ε / (64 * (C' + 1)) := min_le_right _ _
    have h2 : 64 * C' * s ≤ 64 * C' * (ε / (64 * (C' + 1))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)
    have h3 : 64 * C' * (ε / (64 * (C' + 1))) = ε * (C' / (C' + 1)) := by
      field_simp
    have h4 : C' / (C' + 1) ≤ 1 := (div_le_one (by linarith)).2 (by linarith)
    have h5 : ε * (C' / (C' + 1)) ≤ ε * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hε.le
    linarith
  obtain ⟨K, Q, H, hQm, hQvol, hQdisj, hQU, hcover, hHm, hHvol, hHnorm, hQH⟩ :=
    sepSets_cube_cover y r s hr hs hsr
  have hs3 : 0 < s ^ 3 := pow_pos hs 3
  have hQfin : ∀ j, volume (Q j) ≠ ⊤ := fun j => by rw [hQvol j]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hQreal : ∀ j, (volume (Q j)).toReal = s ^ 3 := fun j => by
    rw [hQvol j]; exact ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hs3.le
  have hle_Q : ∀ n j, (volume (S n ∩ Q j)).toReal ≤ s ^ 3 := fun n j => by
    rw [← hQreal j]; exact ENNReal.toReal_mono (hQfin j) (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
  
  have hdef : ∀ n, ∑ j, (volume (S n ∩ Q j)).toReal * (volume (Q j \ S n)).toReal
      ≤ 16 * C' * s ^ 4 := by
    intro n
    have hcube : ∀ j, volume (S n ∩ Q j) * volume (Q j \ S n) ≤
        ∫⁻ h in H, volume (symmDiff (S n) ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S n) ∩ Q j) :=
      fun j => sepSets_cube_deficiency (S n) (Q j) H (hS n) (hQm j) hHm (hQH j)
    have hb : ∀ h ∈ H, volume (symmDiff (S n) ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S n) ∩ ball y r) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C' * s) := by
      intro h hh
      have hn : ‖h‖ ≤ 2 * s := hHnorm h hh
      refine (hmod n h (by linarith)).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
      calc C * ‖h‖ ≤ C' * ‖h‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ C' * (2 * s) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn hC'0
        _ = 2 * C' * s := by ring
    have hsum := sepSets_deficiency_sum_le (S n) (ball y r) H K Q (ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C' * s))
      (hS n) hHm hQm hQdisj hQU hcube hb
    have hsum' : ∑ j, volume (S n ∩ Q j) * volume (Q j \ S n) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (16 * C' * s ^ 4) := by
      refine hsum.trans ?_
      calc volume H * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C' * s)
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (8 * s ^ 3) * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * C' * s) := by gcongr
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (16 * C' * s ^ 4) := by
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
          congr 1
          ring
    have hfin : ∀ j, volume (S n ∩ Q j) * volume (Q j \ S n) ≠ ⊤ := fun j =>
      ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (hQfin j) (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right))
        (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (hQfin j) (measure_mono Set.diff_subset))
    have key := ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by positivity) hsum'
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun j _ => hfin j)] at key
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_mul] using key
  refine ⟨K, fun n j => (volume (S n ∩ Q j)).toReal / s ^ 3, s ^ 3, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n j
    exact ⟨div_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hs3.le, (div_le_one hs3).2 (hle_Q n j)⟩
  intro n m
  show volume (symmDiff (S n) (S m) ∩ ball y (r / 2)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε + s ^ 3 *
    ∑ j, |(volume (S n ∩ Q j)).toReal / s ^ 3 - (volume (S m ∩ Q j)).toReal / s ^ 3|)
  have hc3 := sepSets_symmDiff_le_cubes (S n) (S m) (ball y (r / 2)) K Q (s ^ 3) (hS n) (hS m)
    hQm hs3 hQvol hcover
  have hD_fin : volume (symmDiff (S n) (S m) ∩ ball y (r / 2)) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top measure_ball_lt_top.ne (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hD_fin]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have e1 : ∀ k, 2 / s ^ 3 * ∑ j, (volume (S k ∩ Q j)).toReal * (volume (Q j \ S k)).toReal
      ≤ 32 * C' * s := by
    intro k
    calc _ ≤ 2 / s ^ 3 * (16 * C' * s ^ 4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdef k) (by positivity)
      _ = 32 * C' * s := by field_simp; ring
  have e3 : ∑ j, |(volume (S n ∩ Q j)).toReal - (volume (S m ∩ Q j)).toReal| =
      s ^ 3 * ∑ j, |(volume (S n ∩ Q j)).toReal / s ^ 3 - (volume (S m ∩ Q j)).toReal / s ^ 3| := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hs3, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hs3.ne']
  have e1n := e1 n
  have e1m := e1 m
  rw [← e3]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(B : Set E3) (T : ℕ → Set E3) (hT : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (T n))
    (hcau : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      volume (symmDiff (T n) (T m) ∩ B) < ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
    ∃ L : Set E3, MeasurableSet L ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (T n) L ∩ B)) atTop (𝓝 0)

signature.name: sepSets_limit_of_cauchy
signature.statement:
(B : Set E3) (T : ℕ → Set E3) (hT : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (T n))
    (hcau : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      volume (symmDiff (T n) (T m) ∩ B) < ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
    ∃ L : Set E3, MeasurableSet L ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (T n) L ∩ B)) atTop (𝓝 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hpos : ∀ k : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) < (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := fun k => by positivity
  choose N hN using fun k : ℕ => hcau _ (hpos k)
  let φ : ℕ → ℕ := fun k => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), N i
  have hφm : Monotone φ := by
    apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
    intro k
    show ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), N i ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1 + 1), N i
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ (n := k + 1)]
    exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  have hNφ : ∀ k, N k ≤ φ k := fun k =>
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := N) (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.self_mem_range_succ k)
  have hconv : ∀ k : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal ((2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) = (2⁻¹ : ENNReal) ^ (k + 1) := by
    intro k
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num), ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (by norm_num)]
    simp
  have hφ : ∀ k n, φ k ≤ n →
      volume (symmDiff (T (φ k)) (T n) ∩ B) < (2⁻¹ : ENNReal) ^ (k + 1) := by
    intro k n hn
    rw [← hconv k]
    exact hN k (φ k) n (hNφ k) ((hNφ k).trans hn)
  
  let S : ℕ → Set E3 := fun k => T (φ k)
  let L : Set E3 := ⋂ m : ℕ, ⋃ k : ℕ, S (k + m)
  have hLm : MeasurableSet L :=
    MeasurableSet.iInter fun m => MeasurableSet.iUnion fun k => hT _
  have hS : ∀ i, volume (symmDiff (S i) (S (i + 1)) ∩ B) ≤ (2⁻¹ : ENNReal) ^ (i + 1) :=
    fun i => (hφ i (φ (i + 1)) (hφm (Nat.le_succ i))).le
  
  have htele : ∀ j d, symmDiff (S j) (S (d + j)) ⊆
      ⋃ i : ℕ, symmDiff (S (i + j)) (S (i + j + 1)) := by
    intro j d
    induction d with
    | zero => simp
    | succ d ih =>
      intro x hx
      rcases symmDiff_triangle (S j) (S (d + j)) (S (d + 1 + j)) hx with h | h
      · exact ih h
      · have e : d + 1 + j = d + j + 1 := by omega
        rw [e] at h
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨d, h⟩
  have hsub : ∀ j, symmDiff (S j) L ⊆ ⋃ i : ℕ, symmDiff (S (i + j)) (S (i + j + 1)) := by
    intro j x hx
    rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨hxS, hxL⟩ | ⟨hxL, hxS⟩
    · have hxL' : ¬ ∀ m : ℕ, x ∈ ⋃ k : ℕ, S (k + m) := fun h => hxL (Set.mem_iInter.2 h)
      push_neg at hxL'
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hxL'
      apply htele j m
      rw [Set.mem_symmDiff]
      left
      refine ⟨hxS, fun hx' => hm (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, ?_⟩)⟩
      rwa [Nat.add_comm] at hx'
    · have hx1 : x ∈ ⋃ k : ℕ, S (k + j) := Set.mem_iInter.1 hxL j
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx1
      apply htele j k
      rw [Set.mem_symmDiff]
      right
      exact ⟨hk, hxS⟩
  
  have htail_sum : ∀ j, volume ((⋃ i : ℕ, symmDiff (S (i + j)) (S (i + j + 1))) ∩ B) ≤
      (2⁻¹ : ENNReal) ^ j := by
    intro j
    rw [Set.iUnion_inter]
    refine (measure_iUnion_le _).trans ?_
    calc ∑' i, volume (symmDiff (S (i + j)) (S (i + j + 1)) ∩ B)
        ≤ ∑' i : ℕ, (2⁻¹ : ENNReal) ^ (j + 1) * 2⁻¹ ^ i := by
          refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun i => ?_
          refine (hS (i + j)).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
          rw [← pow_add]
          congr 1
          omega
      _ = (2⁻¹ : ENNReal) ^ (j + 1) * 2 := by
          rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, ENNReal.tsum_geometric_two]
      _ = (2⁻¹ : ENNReal) ^ j := by
          rw [pow_succ, mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (by norm_num) (by norm_num), mul_one]
  have htail : ∀ j, volume (symmDiff (S j) L ∩ B) ≤ (2⁻¹ : ENNReal) ^ j := fun j =>
    (measure_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left B (hsub j))).trans (htail_sum j)
  
  have hfar : ∀ j n, φ j ≤ n →
      volume (symmDiff (T n) L ∩ B) ≤ (2⁻¹ : ENNReal) ^ (j + 1) + 2⁻¹ ^ j := by
    intro j n hn
    have hincl : symmDiff (T n) L ∩ B ⊆
        (symmDiff (S j) (T n) ∩ B) ∪ (symmDiff (S j) L ∩ B) := by
      rintro x ⟨hx, hxB⟩
      rcases symmDiff_triangle (T n) (S j) L hx with h | h
      · left
        rw [symmDiff_comm] at h
        exact ⟨h, hxB⟩
      · right
        exact ⟨h, hxB⟩
    refine (measure_mono hincl).trans ((measure_union_le _ _).trans ?_)
    exact add_le_add (hφ j n hn).le (htail j)
  
  have hr : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => (2⁻¹ : ENNReal) ^ j) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    ENNReal.tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (ENNReal.inv_lt_one.2 ENNReal.one_lt_two)
  have hb : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => (2⁻¹ : ENNReal) ^ (j + 1) + 2⁻¹ ^ j) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := ((Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat 1).2 hr).add hr
    rw [add_zero] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨L, hLm, ?_⟩
  rw [ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_zero]
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_zero.1 hb ε hε).exists
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (φ j)] with n hn
  exact (hfar j n hn).trans hj

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (K A₀ : Set M)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hA₀ : sepChartMeas A₀) (N : ℕ) (x : Fin N → M) (c : Fin N → E3)
    (r : Fin N → ℝ) (L : Fin N → Set E3) (Fs : ℕ → Set M) (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j)
    (hball : ∀ j, closedBall (c j) (r j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (x j)).target)
    (hcover : K ⊆ ⋃ j, (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm '' ball (c j) (r j / 2))
    (hL : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (L j)) (hFs : ∀ n, sepChartMeas (Fs n))
    (hFsK : ∀ n, symmDiff (Fs n) A₀ ⊆ K)
    (hconv : ∀ j, Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (chartAt E3 (x j) '' (Fs n ∩
      (chartAt E3 (x j)).source)) (L j) ∩ ball (c j) (r j))) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃ F : Set M, sepChartMeas F ∧ symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ K ∧
      ∀ (p : M) (C : Set E3), IsCompact C → C ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target →
        Tendsto (fun n => volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ C))
          atTop (𝓝 0)

signature.name: sepGlue_chart_limits
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (K A₀ : Set M)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hA₀ : sepChartMeas A₀) (N : ℕ) (x : Fin N → M) (c : Fin N → E3)
    (r : Fin N → ℝ) (L : Fin N → Set E3) (Fs : ℕ → Set M) (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j)
    (hball : ∀ j, closedBall (c j) (r j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (x j)).target)
    (hcover : K ⊆ ⋃ j, (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm '' ball (c j) (r j / 2))
    (hL : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (L j)) (hFs : ∀ n, sepChartMeas (Fs n))
    (hFsK : ∀ n, symmDiff (Fs n) A₀ ⊆ K)
    (hconv : ∀ j, Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (chartAt E3 (x j) '' (Fs n ∩
      (chartAt E3 (x j)).source)) (L j) ∩ ball (c j) (r j))) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃ F : Set M, sepChartMeas F ∧ symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ K ∧
      ∀ (p : M) (C : Set E3), IsCompact C → C ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target →
        Tendsto (fun n => volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ C))
          atTop (𝓝 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hOpen : ∀ U : Set M, IsOpen U → sepChartMeas U := fun U hU p =>
    ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hU.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right).measurableSet
  have hCompl : ∀ S : Set M, sepChartMeas S → sepChartMeas Sᶜ := by
    intro S hS p
    have h : chartAt E3 p '' (Sᶜ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =
        (chartAt E3 p).target \ chartAt E3 p '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, ⟨hzS, hzs⟩, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source hzs, ?_⟩
        rintro ⟨z', ⟨hz'S, hz's⟩, heq⟩
        exact hzS ((chartAt E3 p).injOn hz's hzs heq ▸ hz'S)
      · rintro ⟨hyt, hyn⟩
        refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).symm y, ⟨fun hS' => hyn ⟨_, ⟨hS', (chartAt E3 p).map_target hyt⟩,
          (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hyt⟩, (chartAt E3 p).map_target hyt⟩,
          (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hyt⟩
    rw [h]
    exact (chartAt E3 p).open_target.measurableSet.diff (hS p)
  have hUnion : ∀ S T : Set M, sepChartMeas S → sepChartMeas T → sepChartMeas (S ∪ T) := by
    intro S T hS hT p
    rw [Set.union_inter_distrib_right, Set.image_union]
    exact (hS p).union (hT p)
  have hIUnion : ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Fin n → Set M), (∀ i, sepChartMeas (S i)) →
      sepChartMeas (⋃ i, S i) := by
    intro n S hS p
    rw [Set.iUnion_inter, Set.image_iUnion]
    exact MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun i => hS i p)
  have hInter : ∀ S T : Set M, sepChartMeas S → sepChartMeas T → sepChartMeas (S ∩ T) := by
    intro S T hS hT
    have h := hCompl _ (hUnion _ _ (hCompl S hS) (hCompl T hT))
    rwa [Set.compl_union, compl_compl, compl_compl] at h
  have hDiff : ∀ S T : Set M, sepChartMeas S → sepChartMeas T → sepChartMeas (S \ T) :=
    fun S T hS hT => hInter S Tᶜ hS (hCompl T hT)
  
  have hOne : ∀ (p : M) (N : Set M), N ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source →
      MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p '' N) → sepChartMeas N := by
    intro p N hN hm q
    set O := (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source with hOdef
    have hO : IsOpen O := (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 q).open_source
    have hs : chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) = chartAt E3 p '' N ∩ O := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, ⟨hzN, hzq⟩, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨⟨z, hzN, rfl⟩, (chartAt E3 p).map_source (hN hzN), ?_⟩
        show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p z) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hN hzN)]
        exact hzq
      · rintro ⟨⟨z, hzN, rfl⟩, -, hzq⟩
        have hzq' : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p z) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := hzq
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hN hzN)] at hzq'
        exact ⟨z, ⟨hzN, hzq'⟩, rfl⟩
    have hsm : MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) := by
      rw [hs]; exact hm.inter hO.measurableSet
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun y => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) O :=
      (chartAt E3 q).continuousOn.comp ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (fun y hy => hy.2)
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun y => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) O := by
      intro y₁ h₁ y₂ h₂ heq
      have h' : (chartAt E3 p).symm y₁ = (chartAt E3 p).symm y₂ :=
        (chartAt E3 q).injOn h₁.2 h₂.2 heq
      rw [← (chartAt E3 p).right_inv h₁.1, ← (chartAt E3 p).right_inv h₂.1, h']
    have hsO : chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ⊆ O := by
      rw [hs]; exact Set.inter_subset_right
    have himg := hsm.image_of_continuousOn_injOn (hcont.mono hsO) (hinj.mono hsO)
    have heq : (fun y => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ''
        (chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) =
          chartAt E3 q '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
      rw [Set.image_image]
      refine Set.EqOn.image_eq ?_
      intro z hz
      simp only
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hN hz.1)]
    rwa [heq] at himg
  
  have hL2 : ∀ (p q : M) (D : Set M), IsCompact D → D ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source →
      D ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source → ∃ k : ENNReal, k ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ N : Set M, N ⊆ D →
        MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p '' N) →
          volume (chartAt E3 q '' N) ≤ k * volume (chartAt E3 p '' N) := by
    intro p q D hD hDp hDq
    set O := (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source with hOdef
    have hO : IsOpen O := (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 q).open_source
    have hsm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) O :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart (x := q)).comp ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := p)).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        Set.inter_subset_right
    have hcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) O :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hsm
    have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ O, DifferentiableAt ℝ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y :=
      fun y hy => (hcd.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hy)
    have hfd : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)) O :=
      hcd.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)
    have hdet : ContinuousOn (fun y => (fderiv ℝ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y).det) O :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.continuous_det.comp_continuousOn hfd
    have hDpc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 p '' D) :=
      hD.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono hDp)
    have hDpO : chartAt E3 p '' D ⊆ O := by
      rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source (hDp hz), ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p z) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hDp hz)]
      exact hDq hz
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hDpc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hdet.mono hDpO)
    refine ⟨ENNReal.ofReal b, ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, fun N hND hNm => ?_⟩
    have hsD : chartAt E3 p '' N ⊆ chartAt E3 p '' D := Set.image_mono hND
    have hle := addHaar_image_le_lintegral_abs_det_fderiv volume hNm
      (f := chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      (fun y hy => (hdiff y (hDpO (hsD hy))).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt)
    have himg : (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) '' (chartAt E3 p '' N) =
        chartAt E3 q '' N := by
      rw [Set.image_image]
      refine Set.EqOn.image_eq ?_
      intro z hz
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hDp (hND hz))]
    rw [himg] at hle
    refine hle.trans ?_
    calc ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p '' N,
          ENNReal.ofReal |(fderiv ℝ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y).det|
        ≤ ∫⁻ _ in chartAt E3 p '' N, ENNReal.ofReal b := by
          refine setLIntegral_mono' hNm (fun y hy => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
          have := hb y (hsD hy)
          rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal b * volume (chartAt E3 p '' N) := setLIntegral_const _ _
  
  set B : Fin N → Set M := fun j => (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm '' ball (c j) (r j / 2) with hBdef
  have hBt : ∀ j, ball (c j) (r j / 2) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (x j)).target := fun j =>
    ball_subset_closedBall.trans
      ((closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith [hr j])).trans (hball j))
  have hBo : ∀ j, IsOpen (B j) := fun j =>
    (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm.isOpen_image_of_subset_source isOpen_ball
      (by rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source]; exact hBt j)
  have hBs : ∀ j, B j ⊆ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source := by
    rintro j _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 (x j)).map_target (hBt j hw)
  have hBball : ∀ j, ∀ z ∈ B j, chartAt E3 (x j) z ∈ ball (c j) (r j / 2) := by
    rintro j _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    rw [(chartAt E3 (x j)).right_inv (hBt j hw)]
    exact hw
  have hBcb : ∀ j, B j ⊆ (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm '' closedBall (c j) (r j) := fun j =>
    Set.image_mono (ball_subset_closedBall.trans
      (closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith [hr j])))
  
  have hKc : IsClosed K := hK.isClosed
  have hKm : sepChartMeas K := by
    have h := hCompl _ (hOpen _ hKc.isOpen_compl)
    rwa [compl_compl] at h
  
  set W : Fin N → Set M := fun j => ⋃ (i : Fin N) (_ : i < j), B i with hWdef
  have hWo : ∀ j, IsOpen (W j) := fun j => isOpen_iUnion fun i => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => hBo i
  set P : Fin N → Set M := fun j => (K ∩ B j) \ W j with hPdef
  have hPm : ∀ j, sepChartMeas (P j) := fun j =>
    hDiff _ _ (hInter _ _ hKm (hOpen _ (hBo j))) (hOpen _ (hWo j))
  have hPK : ∀ j, P j ⊆ K := fun j z hz => hz.1.1
  have hPB : ∀ j, P j ⊆ B j := fun j z hz => hz.1.2
  have hPdisj : ∀ i j, ∀ z, z ∈ P i → z ∈ P j → i = j := by
    intro i j z hi hj
    by_contra hne
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
    · exact hj.2 (Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨i, h, hi.1.2⟩)
    · exact hi.2 (Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨j, h, hj.1.2⟩)
  have hPcov : K ⊆ ⋃ j, P j := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (hcover hz)
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀, hmin⟩ := (wellFounded_lt (α := Fin N)).has_min {i | z ∈ B i} ⟨j, hj⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j₀, ⟨hz, hj₀⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hW
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hiB⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hW
    exact hmin i hiB hi
  
  set G : Fin N → Set M := fun j => P j ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) ⁻¹' L j with hGdef
  have hGm : ∀ j, sepChartMeas (G j) := by
    intro j
    refine hOne (x j) _ (fun z hz => hBs j (hPB j hz.1)) ?_
    have h1 : chartAt E3 (x j) '' G j = chartAt E3 (x j) '' P j ∩ L j :=
      Set.image_inter_preimage _ _ _
    have h2 : chartAt E3 (x j) '' P j = chartAt E3 (x j) '' (P j ∩ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source) := by
      rw [Set.inter_eq_left.2 (fun z hz => hBs j (hPB j hz))]
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact (hPm j (x j)).inter (hL j)
  set F : Set M := (A₀ ∩ Kᶜ) ∪ ⋃ j, G j with hFdef
  have hFm : sepChartMeas F :=
    hUnion _ _ (hInter _ _ hA₀ (hOpen _ hKc.isOpen_compl)) (hIUnion N G hGm)
  have hFout : ∀ z, z ∉ K → (z ∈ F ↔ z ∈ A₀) := by
    intro z hz
    constructor
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact h.1
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 h
        exact absurd (hPK j hj.1) hz
    · intro h
      exact Or.inl ⟨h, hz⟩
  have hFA : symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ K := by
    intro z hz
    by_contra hzK
    have h := hFout z hzK
    rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hz with h' | h'
    · exact h'.2 (h.1 h'.1)
    · exact h'.2 (h.2 h'.1)
  have hFin : ∀ j, ∀ z ∈ P j, (z ∈ F ↔ chartAt E3 (x j) z ∈ L j) := by
    intro j z hz
    constructor
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact absurd (hPK j hz) h.2
      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 h
        have hij := hPdisj i j z hi.1 hz
        subst hij
        exact hi.2
    · intro h
      exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hz, h⟩)
  have hFsin : ∀ j n, ∀ z ∈ P j, (z ∈ Fs n ↔
      chartAt E3 (x j) z ∈ chartAt E3 (x j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source)) := by
    intro j n z hz
    have hzs := hBs j (hPB j hz)
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨z, ⟨h, hzs⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨z', ⟨hz'F, hz's⟩, heq⟩
      exact (chartAt E3 (x j)).injOn hz's hzs heq ▸ hz'F
  
  set T : Fin N → ℕ → Set E3 := fun j n =>
    symmDiff (chartAt E3 (x j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source)) (L j) ∩ ball (c j) (r j)
    with hTdef
  have hTm : ∀ j n, MeasurableSet (T j n) := fun j n =>
    ((hFs n (x j)).symmDiff (hL j)).inter measurableSet_ball
  have hET : ∀ j n, ∀ z ∈ P j, z ∈ symmDiff (Fs n) F → chartAt E3 (x j) z ∈ T j n := by
    intro j n z hz hE
    refine ⟨?_, ball_subset_ball (by linarith [hr j]) (hBball j z (hPB j hz))⟩
    have h1 := hFin j z hz
    have h2 := hFsin j n z hz
    rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hE with h | h
    · exact Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨h2.1 h.1, fun h' => h.2 (h1.2 h')⟩)
    · exact Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨h1.1 h.1, fun h' => h.2 (h2.2 h')⟩)
  have hEK : ∀ n, symmDiff (Fs n) F ⊆ K := by
    intro n z hz
    have h : z ∈ symmDiff (Fs n) A₀ ∪ symmDiff A₀ F := symmDiff_triangle (Fs n) A₀ F hz
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact hFsK n h
    · exact hFA (by rwa [symmDiff_comm] at h)
  
  refine ⟨F, hFm, hFA, fun p C hC hCt => ?_⟩
  set Q := (chartAt E3 p).symm '' C with hQdef
  have hQc : IsCompact Q := hC.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.mono hCt)
  have hQs : Q ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_target (hCt hy)
  set D : Fin N → Set M := fun j => (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm '' closedBall (c j) (r j) ∩ Q
    with hDdef
  have hDc : ∀ j, IsCompact (D j) := fun j =>
    ((isCompact_closedBall _ _).image_of_continuousOn
      ((chartAt E3 (x j)).continuousOn_symm.mono (hball j))).inter hQc
  have hDs : ∀ j, D j ⊆ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source := by
    rintro j _ ⟨⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, -⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 (x j)).map_target (hball j hw)
  have hDp : ∀ j, D j ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := fun j z hz => hQs hz.2
  have hk : ∀ j, ∃ k : ENNReal, k ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ N' : Set M, N' ⊆ D j →
      MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 (x j) '' N') →
        volume (chartAt E3 p '' N') ≤ k * volume (chartAt E3 (x j) '' N') :=
    fun j => hL2 (x j) p (D j) (hDc j) (hDs j) (hDp j)
  choose k hktop hkle using hk
  have hpiece : ∀ j n, volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ P j ∩ Q)) ≤
      k j * volume (T j n) := by
    intro j n
    have hsubt : T j n ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) '' D j ⊆ (chartAt E3 (x j)).target := by
      rintro _ ⟨-, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩⟩
      exact (chartAt E3 (x j)).map_source (hDs j hz)
    have hN'D : (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm '' (T j n ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) '' D j) ⊆ D j := by
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨-, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [(chartAt E3 (x j)).left_inv (hDs j hz)]
      exact hz
    have hN'img : chartAt E3 (x j) '' ((chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
        (T j n ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) '' D j)) = T j n ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) '' D j :=
      (chartAt E3 (x j)).toPartialEquiv.image_symm_image_of_subset_target hsubt
    have hDjc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 (x j) '' D j) :=
      (hDc j).image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 (x j)).continuousOn.mono (hDs j))
    have hN'm : MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 (x j) '' ((chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
        (T j n ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) '' D j))) := by
      rw [hN'img]
      exact (hTm j n).inter hDjc.isClosed.measurableSet
    have hsub : symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ P j ∩ Q ⊆
        (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm '' (T j n ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) '' D j) := by
      rintro z ⟨⟨hzE, hzP⟩, hzQ⟩
      have hzD : z ∈ D j := ⟨hBcb j (hPB j hzP), hzQ⟩
      refine ⟨chartAt E3 (x j) z, ⟨hET j n z hzP hzE, ⟨z, hzD, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (chartAt E3 (x j)).left_inv (hDs j hzD)
    calc volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ P j ∩ Q))
        ≤ volume (chartAt E3 p '' ((chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
            (T j n ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) '' D j))) := measure_mono (Set.image_mono hsub)
      _ ≤ k j * volume (chartAt E3 (x j) '' ((chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
            (T j n ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) '' D j))) := hkle j _ hN'D hN'm
      _ ≤ k j * volume (T j n) := by
          gcongr
          rw [hN'img]
          exact Set.inter_subset_left
  have hbound : ∀ n, volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ C) ≤
      ∑ j, k j * volume (T j n) := by
    intro n
    have hsub : chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ C ⊆
        ⋃ j, chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ P j ∩ Q) := by
      rintro _ ⟨⟨z, ⟨hzE, hzs⟩, rfl⟩, hzC⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (hPcov (hEK n hzE))
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, z, ⟨⟨hzE, hj⟩, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨chartAt E3 p z, hzC, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hzs⟩
    calc _ ≤ volume (⋃ j, chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ P j ∩ Q)) := measure_mono hsub
      _ ≤ ∑ j, volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ P j ∩ Q)) :=
          measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j, k j * volume (T j n) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hpiece j n)
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∑ j, k j * volume (T j n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := tendsto_finset_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N))
      (fun j _ => ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul (hconv j) (Or.inr (hktop j)))
    simpa using h
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hlim (fun _ => zero_le _)
    hbound

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U Φ₁ Φ₂ V K' : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det) (hΦ₁ : MeasurableSet Φ₁) (hΦ₂ : MeasurableSet Φ₂) (hV : IsOpen V) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (hK' : IsCompact K') (hK'V : K' ⊆ V) (hsd : symmDiff Φ₁ Φ₂ ⊆ K') (hfin : sepPerG G Φ₁ V < ⊤) (hcmp : ∀ V₁ V₂ : Set E3, IsOpen V₁ → IsOpen V₂ → K' ⊆ V₂ → IsCompact (closure V₂) → closure V₂ ⊆ V₁ → V₁ ⊆ V → sepPerG G Φ₁ V₂ ≤ sepPerG G Φ₂ V₁ + sepPerG G Φ₁ (V₁ \ K')) : sepPerG G Φ₁ V ≤ sepPerG G Φ₂ V

signature.name: sepPerG_le_of_local_compare
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U Φ₁ Φ₂ V K' : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det) (hΦ₁ : MeasurableSet Φ₁) (hΦ₂ : MeasurableSet Φ₂) (hV : IsOpen V) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (hK' : IsCompact K') (hK'V : K' ⊆ V) (hsd : symmDiff Φ₁ Φ₂ ⊆ K') (hfin : sepPerG G Φ₁ V < ⊤) (hcmp : ∀ V₁ V₂ : Set E3, IsOpen V₁ → IsOpen V₂ → K' ⊆ V₂ → IsCompact (closure V₂) → closure V₂ ⊆ V₁ → V₁ ⊆ V → sepPerG G Φ₁ V₂ ≤ sepPerG G Φ₂ V₁ + sepPerG G Φ₁ (V₁ \ K')) : sepPerG G Φ₁ V ≤ sepPerG G Φ₂ V

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hK'c : IsClosed K' := hK'.isClosed
  
  have mono : ∀ (E A B : Set E3), A ⊆ B → sepPerG G E A ≤ sepPerG G E B := by
    intro E A B hAB
    unfold sepPerG
    exact iSup₂_mono' fun X hX => ⟨X, ⟨hX.1, hX.2.1, hX.2.2.1.trans hAB, hX.2.2.2⟩, le_rfl⟩
  
  have densZero : ∀ (X : E3 → E3) (y : E3), y ∉ tsupport X → sepDensDiv G X y = 0 := by
    intro X y hy
    have hX : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    unfold partialDeriv
    have h : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hX] with z hz
      simp [hz]
    rw [h.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have congrP : ∀ (E₁ E₂ A : Set E3), MeasurableSet E₁ → MeasurableSet E₂ → E₁ ∩ A = E₂ ∩ A →
      sepPerG G E₁ A = sepPerG G E₂ A := by
    intro E₁ E₂ A h1 h2 h
    unfold sepPerG
    refine iSup_congr fun X => iSup_congr fun hX => ?_
    congr 1
    rw [← integral_indicator h1, ← integral_indicator h2]
    congr 1
    funext y
    by_cases hyA : y ∈ A
    · have hiff := Set.ext_iff.mp h y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, hyA, and_true] at hiff
      by_cases hy1 : y ∈ E₁
      · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy1, hiff.mp hy1]
      · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy1, (not_congr hiff).mp hy1]
    · have hz := densZero X y (fun hy => hyA (hX.2.2.1 hy))
      simp [Set.indicator_apply, hz]
  
  have two : ∀ (E : Set E3), MeasurableSet E → ∀ A B : Set E3, Disjoint A B →
      sepPerG G E A + sepPerG G E B ≤ sepPerG G E (A ∪ B) := by
    intro E hE A B hAB
    have h := sepPerG_sum_le G E hE 2 ![A, B] (by

    simpa using h
  
  have collar : ∀ ε : ENNReal, 0 < ε → ∃ C : Set E3, IsOpen C ∧ K' ⊆ C ∧ C ⊆ V ∧
      sepPerG G Φ₁ (C \ K') < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    by_contra hH

        obtain ⟨X, h1⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.mp h1
        obtain ⟨hX, h1⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.mp h1

        obtain ⟨O, hOo, hTO, hOC, -⟩ :=

        refine ⟨C \ closure O, hCo.sdiff isClosed_closure, ?_, Set.diff_subset.trans hCV, ?_⟩

          exact ⟨hK'C hx, fun hxO => (hOC hxO).2 hx⟩

            refine le_trans h1.le ?_

            rw [Set.disjoint_left]
            intro x hxO hx

          have hsub : O ∪ ((C \ closure O) \ K') ⊆ C \ K' := by
            intro x hx

                gcongr

  have hε' : (0 : ENNReal) < (ε : ENNReal) / 2 :=

  obtain ⟨B, hBo, hK'B, hBC, -⟩ := exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hK' hCo hK'C

  have hAV : A ⊆ V := (subset_closure.trans hAB).trans hBV
  have hd : sepPerG G Φ₁ V ≤ sepPerG G Φ₁ A + sepPerG G Φ₁ (V \ K') := by
    refine (mono Φ₁ V (A ∪ (V \ K')) ?_).trans
      (sepPerG_union_le G U Φ₁ A (V \ K') hU hG hdet hΦ₁ hAo (hV.sdiff hK'c)
        (hAV.trans hVU) (Set.diff_subset.trans hVU))

    · exact Or.inr ⟨hy, h⟩

      (sepPerG_union_le G U Φ₁ _ _ hU hG hdet hΦ₁ (hCo.sdiff hK'c) (hV.sdiff isClosed_closure)
        (Set.diff_subset.trans (hCV.trans hVU)) (Set.diff_subset.trans hVU))

    by_cases h : y ∈ closure B
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hBC h, hyK⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hyV, h⟩

    (hcmp B A hBo hAo hK'A hAc hAB hBV).trans
      (add_le_add le_rfl (mono Φ₁ _ _ (Set.diff_subset_diff_left (subset_closure.trans hBC))))
  have hg : sepPerG G Φ₁ (V \ closure B) = sepPerG G Φ₂ (V \ closure B) := by
    refine congrP Φ₁ Φ₂ _ hΦ₁ hΦ₂ ?_
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
      by_contra h
      exact h2.2 (subset_closure (hK'B (hsd (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨h1, h⟩)))))
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
      by_contra h
      exact h2.2 (subset_closure (hK'B (hsd (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨h1, h⟩)))))
  have hh : sepPerG G Φ₂ B + sepPerG G Φ₂ (V \ closure B) ≤ sepPerG G Φ₂ V := by
    refine (two Φ₂ hΦ₂ _ _ ?_).trans (mono Φ₂ _ _ (Set.union_subset hBV Set.diff_subset))
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro y hyB hy
    exact hy.2 (subset_closure hyB)
  have he' : sepPerG G Φ₁ (V \ K') ≤
      sepPerG G Φ₁ (C \ K') + sepPerG G Φ₂ (V \ closure B) := by
    rw [← hg]; exact he
  have hxle : sepPerG G Φ₁ (C \ K') ≤ (ε : ENNReal) / 2 := hx.le
  calc sepPerG G Φ₁ V ≤ sepPerG G Φ₁ A + sepPerG G Φ₁ (V \ K') := hd
    _ ≤ (sepPerG G Φ₂ B + sepPerG G Φ₁ (C \ K')) +
        (sepPerG G Φ₁ (C \ K') + sepPerG G Φ₂ (V \ closure B)) := add_le_add hf he'

        (sepPerG G Φ₁ (C \ K') + sepPerG G Φ₁ (C \ K')) := by ring
    _ ≤ sepPerG G Φ₂ V + ((ε : ENNReal) / 2 + (ε : ENNReal) / 2) :=
        add_le_add hh (add_le_add hxle hxle)
    _ = sepPerG G Φ₂ V + ε := by rw [ENNReal.add_halves]
