      intro u
      have h := hGm.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg u
      have e1 : star u ⬝ᵥ (Matrix.mulVec Gm u) =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm i j * u i * u j := by
        simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        ring
      rw [← e1]; exact h
    set w : Fin 3 → ℝ := Matrix.mulVec Gm⁻¹ a with hw
    have hunit : IsUnit Gm.det := hGm.det_pos.ne'.isUnit
    have hGw : Matrix.mulVec Gm w = a := by
      rw [hw, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hunit, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have ha : ∀ i, a i = ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm i j * w j := by
      intro i
      rw [← hGw]
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    have hwi : ∀ i, w i = ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * a j := by
      intro i
      simp [hw, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    set B := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm i j * Z i * w j with hB
    have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, a i * Z i = B := by
      simp only [hB, ha, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      ring
    have e2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * a i * a j =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm i j * w i * w j := by
      have s1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * a i * a j = ∑ i : Fin 3, a i * w i := by
        simp only [hwi, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        ring
      rw [s1]
      simp only [ha, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      ring
    set Qw := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm i j * w i * w j with hQw
    set QZ := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm i j * Z i * Z j with hQZ
    have hquad : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ Qw * (t * t) + (2 * B) * t + QZ := by
      intro t
      have h := hQ (fun i => Z i + t * w i)
      have hexp : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm i j * (Z i + t * w i) * (Z j + t * w j) =
          Qw * (t * t) + (2 * B) * t + QZ := by
        simp only [hQw, hQZ, hB, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        rw [hsym 1 0, hsym 2 0, hsym 2 1]
        ring
      rw [← hexp]; exact h
    have hdisc := discrim_le_zero hquad
    unfold discrim at hdisc
    have hB2 : B ^ 2 ≤ Qw * QZ := by nlinarith
    rw [e1, e2, ← Real.sqrt_mul (hQ w)]
    exact Real.abs_le_sqrt hB2
  
  have tC : ∀ (T : Set E3), IsOpen T → ∀ (v w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v T →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w T → ∀ (K : Set E3), IsCompact K → K ⊆ T →
      (∀ y, y ∉ K → w y = 0) → ∀ (i : Fin 3),
      Integrable (fun y => v y * partialDeriv i w y) ∧
      Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv i v y * w y) ∧
      ∫ y, v y * partialDeriv i w y = -∫ y, partialDeriv i v y * w y := by
    intro T hT v w hv hw K hK hKT hwK i
    have hKc : IsClosed K := hK.isClosed
    obtain ⟨hwd, hw0⟩ := tB T K hT hKc hKT w hw hwK
    have hPT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => v y * w y) T := hv.mul hw
    have hP0 : ∀ y, y ∉ K → v y * w y = 0 := fun y hy => by rw [hwK y hy, mul_zero]
    obtain ⟨hPd, hP0'⟩ := tB T K hT hKc hKT _ hPT hP0
    have hprod : ∀ y, partialDeriv i (fun y => v y * w y) y =
        partialDeriv i v y * w y + v y * partialDeriv i w y := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ T
      · have hvd : DifferentiableAt ℝ v y :=
          (hv.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hwd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ w y := (hwd.differentiable (by simp)) y
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [show (fun y => v y * w y) = v * w from rfl, fderiv_mul hvd hwd']
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · have hyK : y ∉ K := fun h => hy (hKT h)
        rw [hP0' y hyK i, hwK y hyK, hw0 y hyK i]
        ring
    have hloc : ∀ y, y ∉ K → ∀ g : E3 → ℝ, (∀ z, z ∉ K → g z = 0) →
        g =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
      fun y hy g hg => Filter.eventually_of_mem (hKc.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy)
        (fun z hz => hg z hz)
    have hdw : Continuous (fun y => partialDeriv i w y) :=
      (hwd.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hdvT : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ v) T := hv.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hT (by simp)
    have hc1 : Continuous (fun y => v y * partialDeriv i w y) := by
      refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun y => ?_
      by_cases hy : y ∈ T
      · exact (hv.continuousOn.continuousAt (hT.mem_nhds hy)).mul hdw.continuousAt
      · have hyK : y ∉ K := fun h => hy (hKT h)
        exact continuousAt_const.congr
          (hloc y hyK _ (fun z hz => by rw [hw0 z hz i, mul_zero])).symm
    have hc2 : Continuous (fun y => partialDeriv i v y * w y) := by
      refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun y => ?_
      by_cases hy : y ∈ T
      · exact ((hdvT.continuousAt (hT.mem_nhds hy)).clm_apply continuousAt_const).mul
          hwd.continuous.continuousAt
      · have hyK : y ∉ K := fun h => hy (hKT h)
        exact continuousAt_const.congr
          (hloc y hyK _ (fun z hz => by rw [hwK z hz, mul_zero])).symm
    have hi1 : Integrable (fun y => v y * partialDeriv i w y) :=
      hc1.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (HasCompactSupport.intro hK fun z hz => by rw [hw0 z hz i, mul_zero])
    have hi2 : Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv i v y * w y) :=
      hc2.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (HasCompactSupport.intro hK fun z hz => by rw [hwK z hz, mul_zero])
    have hzero : ∫ y, partialDeriv i (fun y => v y * w y) y = 0 := by
      have hcP : Continuous (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun y => v y * w y) y) :=
        (hPd.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
      have h := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
        (f := fun _ : E3 => (1:ℝ)) (g := fun y => v y * w y) (v := e i) ?_ ?_ ?_
        (differentiable_const _) (hPd.differentiable (by simp))
      · simpa [partialDeriv] using h
      · simp
      · simp only [one_mul]
        exact hcP.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
          (HasCompactSupport.intro hK fun z hz => hP0' z hz i)
      · simp only [one_mul]
        exact hPd.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.intro hK hP0)
    refine ⟨hi1, hi2, ?_⟩
    have hsum : ∫ y, partialDeriv i (fun y => v y * w y) y =
        (∫ y, partialDeriv i v y * w y) + ∫ y, v y * partialDeriv i w y :=
      (integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hprod)).trans (integral_add hi2 hi1)
    linarith
  
  have hKc : IsClosed (tsupport X) := isClosed_tsupport X
  have hKcpt : IsCompact (tsupport X) := hXc.isCompact
  have hKT : tsupport X ⊆ T := hXU.trans hUT
  have hX0 : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → ∀ i : Fin 3, X y i = 0 := by
    intro y hy i
    rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy]
    simp
  have hXi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) := contDiff_euclidean.mp hX
  
  have hsd := tA G T hG hpd
  have hFT : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) T :=
    fun i => hsd.mul (hXi i).contDiffOn
  have hF0 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i = 0 :=
    fun i y hy => by rw [hX0 y hy i, mul_zero]
  have hFg := fun i => tB T (tsupport X) hT hKc hKT _ (hFT i) (hF0 i)
  
  have hcont : Continuous (sepDensDiv G X) := by
    show Continuous (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y)
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
      ((hFg i).1.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hsupp : tsupport (sepDensDiv G X) ⊆ tsupport X := by
    refine closure_minimal (fun y hy => ?_) hKc
    by_contra hyK
    apply hy
    show ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y = 0
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => (hFg i).2 y hyK i
  refine ⟨hcont, hsupp, ?_⟩
  
  have hI := fun i => tC T hT v _ hv (hFT i) (tsupport X) hKcpt hKT (hF0 i) i
  have hint : ∫ y, v y * sepDensDiv G X y =
      ∫ y, -(∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i v y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i)) := by
    calc ∫ y, v y * sepDensDiv G X y
        = ∫ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, v y * partialDeriv i
            (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y := by
          congr 1; funext y; simp only [sepDensDiv, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∫ y, v y * partialDeriv i
            (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y :=
          integral_finset_sum _ fun i _ => (hI i).1
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, -∫ y, partialDeriv i v y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (hI i).2.2
      _ = -∑ i : Fin 3, ∫ y, partialDeriv i v y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i) :=
          Finset.sum_neg_distrib _
      _ = -∫ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i v y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i) := by
          rw [integral_finset_sum _ fun i _ => (hI i).2.1]
      _ = ∫ y, -(∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i v y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i)) :=
          (integral_neg _).symm
  have hhint : Integrable
      (fun y => -(∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i v y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i))) :=
    (integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => (hI i).2.1).neg
  
  have hle : ∀ y ∈ tsupport X,
      -(∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i v y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i)) ≤
      Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i v y * partialDeriv j v y) * Real.sqrt (G y).det := by
    intro y hy
    have hyT := hKT hy
    have hcs := tD (G y) (hpd y hyT) (fun i => partialDeriv i v y) (fun i => X y i)
    beta_reduce at hcs
    have hq : Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_one]; exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hXn y)
    have hd : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (G y).det := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hhy : -(∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i v y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i)) =
        Real.sqrt (G y).det * -(∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i v y * X y i) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [hhy]
    calc Real.sqrt (G y).det * -(∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i v y * X y i)
        ≤ Real.sqrt (G y).det * (Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i v y * partialDeriv j v y) *
            Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((neg_le_abs _).trans hcs) hd
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (G y).det * (Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i v y * partialDeriv j v y) * 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) hd
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h0 : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X →
      -(∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i v y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i)) = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [hX0 y hy, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, neg_zero]
  
  rw [hint]
  exact tE _ _ (tsupport X) U hhint hKc hXU hle h0

informal_problem.statement:
(T F : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hF : MeasurableSet F) (d : E3 → ℝ)
    (hdc : Continuous d) (hdcs : HasCompactSupport d) (hdT : tsupport d ⊆ T)
    (v : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (hvc : ∀ m, ContinuousOn (v m) T) (hv1 : ∀ m y, |v m y| ≤ 1)
    (hlim : ∀ y ∈ T, Tendsto (fun m => v m y) atTop (𝓝 (F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y))) :
    Tendsto (fun m => ∫ y, v m y * d y) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y in F, d y))

signature.name: sep_dominated_limit
signature.statement:
(T F : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hF : MeasurableSet F) (d : E3 → ℝ)
    (hdc : Continuous d) (hdcs : HasCompactSupport d) (hdT : tsupport d ⊆ T)
    (v : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (hvc : ∀ m, ContinuousOn (v m) T) (hv1 : ∀ m y, |v m y| ≤ 1)
    (hlim : ∀ y ∈ T, Tendsto (fun m => v m y) atTop (𝓝 (F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y))) :
    Tendsto (fun m => ∫ y, v m y * d y) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y in F, d y))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hzero : ∀ y, y ∉ T → d y = 0 := fun y hy =>
    image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hy (hdT h))
  have hcont : ∀ m, Continuous (fun y => v m y * d y) := by
    intro m
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ T
    · exact ((hvc m).continuousAt (hT.mem_nhds hx)).mul hdc.continuousAt
    · have hxs : x ∉ tsupport d := fun h => hx (hdT h)
      have hev : d =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).1 hxs
      refine (continuousAt_const (y := (0 : ℝ))).congr ?_
      filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hy
      simp [hy]
  have hdint : Integrable d := hdc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hdcs
  have hDCT : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ y, v m y * d y) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, F.indicator d y)) := by
    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun y => |d y|)
      (fun m => (hcont m).aestronglyMeasurable) hdint.abs ?_ ?_
    · intro m
      refine ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg (d y)) (hv1 m y)
    · refine ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_)
      by_cases hy : y ∈ T
      · have h := (hlim y hy).mul_const (d y)
        have heq : F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y * d y = F.indicator d y := by
          by_cases hyF : y ∈ F
          · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hyF]
          · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyF]
        rwa [heq] at h
      · have hd0 : d y = 0 := hzero y hy
        have hi : F.indicator d y = 0 := by
          by_cases hyF : y ∈ F
          · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hyF, hd0]
          · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyF]
        rw [hi]
        simp only [hd0, mul_zero]
        exact tendsto_const_nhds
  rwa [integral_indicator hF] at hDCT

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p₁ p₂ : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₁).target)
    (hy₂ : (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₂).source) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) ∧
    (∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y = ∑ a : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z))
            (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)))

signature.name: sep_chart_transition
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p₁ p₂ : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₁).target)
    (hy₂ : (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₂).source) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) ∧
    (∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y = ∑ a : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z))
            (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hexp : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
    intro v
    ext k
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  
  have cca : ∀ (Φ : E3 → M) (τ : E3 → E3) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y →
      MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ (τ y) → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff (Φ ∘ τ) y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a * g.coeff Φ (τ y) a b * fderiv ℝ τ y (e j) b := by
    intro Φ τ y hτ hΦ i j
    set L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ (τ y) with hLdef
    set B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := g.g (Φ (τ y)) with hBdef
    have hL : ∀ v : E3, L v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • L (e a) := by
      intro v
      conv_lhs => rw [hexp v]
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul]
    have hchain : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y v = L (fderiv ℝ τ y v) := by
      intro v
      rw [mfderiv_comp_apply y hΦ hτ.mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      rfl
    have hlhs : g.coeff (Φ ∘ τ) y i j = B (L (fderiv ℝ τ y (e i))) (L (fderiv ℝ τ y (e j))) := by
      show g.g (Φ (τ y)) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y (e j)) = _
      rw [hchain, hchain]
    have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff Φ (τ y) a b = B (L (e a)) (L (e b)) := fun a b => rfl
    rw [hlhs, hL (fderiv ℝ τ y (e i)), hL (fderiv ℝ τ y (e j))]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, hc]
    conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
    ring
  
  have hA : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₁) hy
  have hB : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p₂) ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₂) hy₂
  have hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y :=
    mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hB.comp y hA)
  have hΦ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p₂).symm
      (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₂)
      ((chartAt E3 p₂).map_source hy₂)
  have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) =
      (chartAt E3 p₁).symm z := by
    have hO := (chartAt E3 p₁).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 p₂).open_source
    exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hy, hy₂⟩)
      (fun z hz => (chartAt E3 p₂).left_inv hz.2)
  refine ⟨hτ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    have hfun : (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 y] ⇑(chartAt E3 p₁).symm := hev
    have hmf := hfun.mfderiv_eq (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, E3))
    have hpt : (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y =
        (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y := (chartAt E3 p₂).left_inv hy₂
    have key : g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j =
        g.coeff (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y i j := by
      show _ = g.g ((⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y (e j))
      rw [hmf, hpt]
      rfl
    rw [key]
    exact cca _ _ y hτ hΦ i j
  · intro u hu i
    have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p₂).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    have hd₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z))
        (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) :=
      (hc.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        ((chartAt E3 p₂).open_target.mem_nhds ((chartAt E3 p₂).map_source hy₂))
    have hU : (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        ((fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z)) ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [hz]
    have hL : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E3), L v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a * L (e a) := by
      intro L v
      conv_lhs => rw [hexp v]
      simp [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hcomp := fderiv_comp y hd₂ hτ
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hU.fderiv_eq, hcomp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    exact hL _ _

informal_problem.statement:
(J G₂ : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hJ : J.det ≠ 0) (b : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (J.transpose * G₂ * J)⁻¹ i j * (∑ a : Fin 3, J a i * b a) *
        (∑ a : Fin 3, J a j * b a) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, G₂⁻¹ a c * b a * b c

signature.name: sep_quadform_congr
signature.statement:
(J G₂ : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hJ : J.det ≠ 0) (b : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (J.transpose * G₂ * J)⁻¹ i j * (∑ a : Fin 3, J a i * b a) *
        (∑ a : Fin 3, J a j * b a) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, G₂⁻¹ a c * b a * b c

proof.tactics:
by
  have key : ∀ (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * v i * v j = dotProduct v (M.mulVec v) := by
    intro M v
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
  have hv : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, J a i * b a = J.transpose.mulVec b i := by
    intro i
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  have hdet : IsUnit J.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hJ
  have hdetT : IsUnit J.transpose.det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_transpose]; exact hdet
  have hinv : (J.transpose * G₂ * J)⁻¹ = J⁻¹ * G₂⁻¹ * (J.transpose)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  simp only [hv]
  rw [key, key, hinv, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc (J⁻¹ * G₂⁻¹),
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdetT, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_transpose, Matrix.vecMul_vecMul,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet, Matrix.vecMul_one]

informal_problem.statement:
(s : Set E3) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (τ : E3 → E3)
    (hτ : ∀ y ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y) (hinj : Set.InjOn τ s)
    (G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hlaw : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 3, G₁ y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a * G₂ (τ y) a b * fderiv ℝ τ y (e j) b)
    (hpos : ∀ y ∈ s, 0 ≤ (G₂ (τ y)).det) (ψ : E3 → ENNReal) :
    ∫⁻ z in τ '' s, ψ z * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (G₂ z).det) =
      ∫⁻ y in s, ψ (τ y) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (G₁ y).det)

signature.name: sep_density_change
signature.statement:
(s : Set E3) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (τ : E3 → E3)
    (hτ : ∀ y ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y) (hinj : Set.InjOn τ s)
    (G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hlaw : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 3, G₁ y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a * G₂ (τ y) a b * fderiv ℝ τ y (e j) b)
    (hpos : ∀ y ∈ s, 0 ≤ (G₂ (τ y)).det) (ψ : E3 → ENNReal) :
    ∫⁻ z in τ '' s, ψ z * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (G₂ z).det) =
      ∫⁻ y in s, ψ (τ y) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (G₁ y).det)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdet : ∀ f : E3 →L[ℝ] E3, f.det = (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => f (e i) a).det := by
    intro f
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.det, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis]
    congr 1
  have hsq : ∀ (J A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, A i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, J a i * B a b * J b j) →
      Real.sqrt A.det = |J.det| * Real.sqrt B.det := by
    intro J A B h
    have hA : A = J.transpose * B * J := by
      ext i j
      rw [h i j]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    rw [hA, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose,
      show J.det * B.det * J.det = J.det ^ 2 * B.det by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  have hcov := MeasureTheory.lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_det_fderiv_mul volume hs
    (fun y hy => (hτ y hy).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hinj
    (fun z => ψ z * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (G₂ z).det))
  rw [hcov]
  refine MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_congr_fun hs ?_
  intro y hy
  have h1 := hsq (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a) (G₁ y) (G₂ (τ y))
    (fun i j => by simp only [Matrix.of_apply]; exact hlaw y hy i j)
  simp only
  rw [h1, ← hdet, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (abs_nonneg _)]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(w : M → E3 → ENNReal) (φ : M → ENNReal)
    (htrans : ∀ (p₁ p₂ : M) (S : Set M),
      S ⊆ (chartAt E3 p₁).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p₂).source →
      MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p₁ '' S) → MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p₂ '' S) →
      ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₁ '' S, φ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y) * w p₁ y =
        ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₂ '' S, φ ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm y) * w p₂ y)
    (m : ℕ) (q : Fin m → M) (V : Fin m → Set M)
    (hV : ∀ j, IsOpen (V j) ∧ V j ⊆ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source)
    (hφ : ∀ x, x ∉ ⋃ j, V j → φ x = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (p : Fin n → M) (W : Fin n → Set M)
    (hW : ∀ k, IsOpen (W k) ∧ W k ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun k l => Disjoint (W k) (W l)) :
    ∑ k, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k, φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y) * w (p k) y ≤
      ∑ j, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' V j, φ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * w (q j) y

signature.name: sep_cover_sum
signature.statement:
(w : M → E3 → ENNReal) (φ : M → ENNReal)
    (htrans : ∀ (p₁ p₂ : M) (S : Set M),
      S ⊆ (chartAt E3 p₁).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p₂).source →
      MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p₁ '' S) → MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p₂ '' S) →
      ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₁ '' S, φ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y) * w p₁ y =
        ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₂ '' S, φ ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm y) * w p₂ y)
    (m : ℕ) (q : Fin m → M) (V : Fin m → Set M)
    (hV : ∀ j, IsOpen (V j) ∧ V j ⊆ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source)
    (hφ : ∀ x, x ∉ ⋃ j, V j → φ x = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (p : Fin n → M) (W : Fin n → Set M)
    (hW : ∀ k, IsOpen (W k) ∧ W k ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun k l => Disjoint (W k) (W l)) :
    ∑ k, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k, φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y) * w (p k) y ≤
      ∑ j, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' V j, φ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * w (q j) y

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (p₀ : M) (F : E3 → ENNReal) (W₀ : Set M), IsOpen W₀ →
      W₀ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p₀).source →
      (∀ x ∈ W₀, x ∉ ⋃ j, V j → F (chartAt E3 p₀ x) = 0) →
      ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₀ '' W₀, F y ≤
        ∑ j, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ ∩ V j), F y := by
    intro p₀ F W₀ hWo hWs hF
    have hUo : IsOpen (⋃ j, V j) := isOpen_iUnion fun j => (hV j).1
    have hZ : MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ \ ⋃ j, V j)) := by
      rw [((chartAt E3 p₀).injOn.mono hWs).image_diff]
      exact ((chartAt E3 p₀).isOpen_image_of_subset_source hWo hWs).measurableSet.diff
        ((chartAt E3 p₀).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hWo.inter hUo)
          (Set.inter_subset_left.trans hWs)).measurableSet
    have hsub : chartAt E3 p₀ '' W₀ ⊆
        (⋃ j, chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ ∩ V j)) ∪ chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ \ ⋃ j, V j) := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      by_cases hxU : x ∈ ⋃ j, V j
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxU
        exact Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, x, ⟨hx, hj⟩, rfl⟩)
      · exact Or.inr ⟨x, ⟨hx, hxU⟩, rfl⟩
    have hZ0 : ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ \ ⋃ j, V j), F y = 0 := by
      have h : ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ \ ⋃ j, V j), F y =
          ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ \ ⋃ j, V j), (0 : ENNReal) := by
        apply setLIntegral_congr_fun hZ
        rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨hx, hxU⟩, rfl⟩
        exact hF x hx hxU
      rw [h, lintegral_zero]
    calc ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₀ '' W₀, F y
        ≤ ∫⁻ y in (⋃ j, chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ ∩ V j)) ∪ chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ \ ⋃ j, V j), F y :=
          lintegral_mono_set hsub
      _ ≤ (∫⁻ y in ⋃ j, chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ ∩ V j), F y) +
            (∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ \ ⋃ j, V j), F y) :=
          lintegral_union_le _ _ _
      _ ≤ (∑' j, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ ∩ V j), F y) + 0 := by
          rw [hZ0, add_zero, add_zero]
          exact lintegral_iUnion_le (fun j : Fin m => chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ ∩ V j)) F
      _ = ∑ j, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 p₀ '' (W₀ ∩ V j), F y := by
          rw [add_zero, tsum_fintype]
  
  have s2 : ∀ (q₀ : M) (F : E3 → ENNReal) (V₀ : Set M), V₀ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q₀).source →
      ∀ S : Fin n → Set M, (∀ k, IsOpen (S k)) → (∀ k, S k ⊆ V₀) →
      Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (S k) (S l)) →
      ∑ k, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 q₀ '' S k, F y ≤ ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 q₀ '' V₀, F y := by
    intro q₀ F V₀ hVs S hSo hSV hSd
    have hmeas : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 q₀ '' S k) := fun k =>
      ((chartAt E3 q₀).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hSo k) ((hSV k).trans hVs)).measurableSet
    have hd : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint fun k => chartAt E3 q₀ '' S k) := by
      intro k l hkl
      rw [Function.onFun, Set.disjoint_left]
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ ⟨x', hx', hxx'⟩
      have hx'x : x' = x :=
        (chartAt E3 q₀).injOn ((hSV l).trans hVs hx') ((hSV k).trans hVs hx) hxx'
      subst hx'x
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hSd hkl) hx hx'
    calc ∑ k, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 q₀ '' S k, F y
        = ∑' k, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 q₀ '' S k, F y := (tsum_fintype _).symm
      _ = ∫⁻ y in ⋃ k, chartAt E3 q₀ '' S k, F y := (lintegral_iUnion hmeas hd F).symm
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 q₀ '' V₀, F y :=
          lintegral_mono_set (Set.iUnion_subset fun k => Set.image_mono (hSV k))
  calc ∑ k, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k, φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y) * w (p k) y
      ≤ ∑ k, ∑ j, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 (p k) '' (W k ∩ V j),
          φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y) * w (p k) y := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
        refine s1 (p k) (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y) * w (p k) y) (W k) (hW k).1
          (hW k).2 ?_
        intro x hx hxU
        simp only [(chartAt E3 (p k)).left_inv ((hW k).2 hx), hφ x hxU, zero_mul]
    _ = ∑ k, ∑ j, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (W k ∩ V j),
          φ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * w (q j) y := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        exact htrans (p k) (q j) (W k ∩ V j)
          (Set.subset_inter (Set.inter_subset_left.trans (hW k).2)
            (Set.inter_subset_right.trans (hV j).2))
          ((chartAt E3 (p k)).isOpen_image_of_subset_source ((hW k).1.inter (hV j).1)
            (Set.inter_subset_left.trans (hW k).2)).measurableSet
          ((chartAt E3 (q j)).isOpen_image_of_subset_source ((hW k).1.inter (hV j).1)
            (Set.inter_subset_right.trans (hV j).2)).measurableSet
    _ = ∑ j, ∑ k, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (W k ∩ V j),
          φ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * w (q j) y := Finset.sum_comm
    _ ≤ ∑ j, ∫⁻ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' V j, φ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * w (q j) y :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
          s2 (q j) (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * w (q j) y) (V j) (hV j).2
            (fun k => W k ∩ V j) (fun k => (hW k).1.inter (hV j).1)
            (fun k => Set.inter_subset_right)
            (fun k l hkl => (hdisj hkl).mono Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_left)

informal_problem.statement:
(T Q : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hQ : IsCompact Q) (hQT : Q ⊆ T)
    (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (r₁ : ℝ)
    (hgrad : ∀ y ∈ T, r₁ ≤ f y → ∃ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i f y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 →
      ∫⁻ y in Q, ENNReal.ofReal (ε⁻¹ * deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1))
        ((f y - r₁) / ε)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C

signature.name: sep_shell_bound
signature.statement:
(T Q : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hQ : IsCompact Q) (hQT : Q ⊆ T)
    (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (r₁ : ℝ)
    (hgrad : ∀ y ∈ T, r₁ ≤ f y → ∃ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i f y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 →
      ∫⁻ y in Q, ENNReal.ofReal (ε⁻¹ * deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1))
        ((f y - r₁) / ε)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hh_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) :=
    Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).sub contDiff_const)
  have hh01 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1) ∧
      Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1) ≤ 1 :=
    fun t => ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
  have hhd0 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) t := by
    intro t
    apply Monotone.deriv_nonneg
    intro a b hab
    exact Real.smoothTransition.monotone (by linarith)
  have hhdz : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have hev : (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds (show t < 1 / 2 by linarith)] with s hs
      have hs' : s < 1 / 2 := hs
      exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hloc : ∀ u w : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u T → ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → tsupport w ⊆ T →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => u y * w y) := by
    intro u w hu hw hwT
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ T
    · exact (hu.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hy)).mul hw.contDiffAt
    · have hy' : y ∉ tsupport w := fun h => hy (hwT h)
      have hev : w =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy'
      have hev2 : (fun y => u y * w y) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
        simp [hz]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev2
  have hpd0 : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), y ∉ tsupport w → ∀ i, partialDeriv i w y = 0 := by
    intro w y hy i
    have hev : w =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy
    have hd : HasFDerivAt w (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
      (hasFDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) y).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    simp [partialDeriv, hd.fderiv]
  
  have hibp : ∀ v w : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v T → ContDiff ℝ ∞ w → HasCompactSupport w →
      tsupport w ⊆ T → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv i v y * w y) ∧
      Integrable (fun y => v y * partialDeriv i w y) ∧
      ∫ y, partialDeriv i v y * w y = -∫ y, v y * partialDeriv i w y := by
    intro v w hv hw hwc hwT i
    have hP : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => v y * w y) := hloc v w hv hw hwT
    have hPc : HasCompactSupport (fun y => v y * w y) := hwc.mul_left
    have hprod : ∀ y, partialDeriv i (fun y => v y * w y) y =
        partialDeriv i v y * w y + v y * partialDeriv i w y := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ T
      · have hvd : DifferentiableAt ℝ v y :=
          (hv.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hwd : DifferentiableAt ℝ w y := hw.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by simp)
        simp only [partialDeriv]
        change fderiv ℝ (v * w) y (e i) = _
        rw [(hvd.hasFDerivAt.mul hwd.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · have hy' : y ∉ tsupport w := fun h => hy (hwT h)
        have hy'' : y ∉ tsupport (fun y => v y * w y) :=
          fun h => hy' (tsupport_mul_subset_right h)
        rw [hpd0 _ y hy'' i, hpd0 w y hy' i, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy']
        ring
    have hcont1 : Continuous (fun y => partialDeriv i v y * w y) := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ T
      · have h1 : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ v) y :=
          (hv.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hT (by simp)).continuousAt (hT.mem_nhds hy)
        have h2 : ContinuousAt (fun y => partialDeriv i v y) y := by
          show ContinuousAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e i)) y
          exact h1.clm_apply continuousAt_const
        exact h2.mul hw.continuous.continuousAt
      · have hy' : y ∉ tsupport w := fun h => hy (hwT h)
        have hev : (fun y => partialDeriv i v y * w y) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy'] with z hz
          simp [hz]
        exact continuousAt_const.congr hev.symm
    have hint1 : Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv i v y * w y) :=
      hcont1.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hwc.mul_left
    have hdPc : Continuous (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun y => v y * w y) y) := by
      show Continuous (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y * w y) y (e i))
      exact (hP.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hdP_int : Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun y => v y * w y) y) :=
      hdPc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hPc.fderiv_apply ℝ (e i))
    have hint2 : Integrable (fun y => v y * partialDeriv i w y) := by
      refine (hdP_int.sub hint1).congr (Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, hprod y]
      ring
    have hzero : ∫ y, partialDeriv i (fun y => v y * w y) y = 0 := by
      have h1 : Integrable
          (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y * w y) x (e i) * (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) := by
        simpa [partialDeriv] using hdP_int
      have h2 : Integrable
          (fun x => (fun y => v y * w y) x * fderiv ℝ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x (e i)) := by
        simp
      have h3 : Integrable (fun x => (fun y => v y * w y) x * (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) := by
        simpa using hP.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hPc
      have key := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume) h1 h2 h3
        (hP.differentiable (by simp)) (differentiable_const _)
      have hl : ∫ x, (fun y => v y * w y) x * fderiv ℝ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x (e i) = 0 := by
        simp
      have hr : ∫ x, fderiv ℝ (fun y => v y * w y) x (e i) * (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x =
          ∫ y, partialDeriv i (fun y => v y * w y) y := by simp [partialDeriv]
      rw [hl, hr] at key
      linarith
    have hsum : ∫ y, partialDeriv i (fun y => v y * w y) y =
        (∫ y, partialDeriv i v y * w y) + ∫ y, v y * partialDeriv i w y :=
      (integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun y => hprod y)).trans
        (integral_add hint1 hint2)
    refine ⟨hint1, hint2, ?_⟩
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (hsum.symm.trans hzero)
  
  have hfd : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => partialDeriv i f y) T := by
    intro i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) T :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hT).1 hf).2
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀, hc₀le⟩ : ∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Q, r₁ ≤ f y → c₀ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i f y) ^ 2 := by
    have hcont : ContinuousOn
        (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i f y) ^ 2 + max 0 (r₁ - f y)) Q := by
      refine ContinuousOn.mono ?_ hQT
      refine ContinuousOn.add ?_ ?_
      · exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => ((hfd i).continuousOn).pow 2
      · exact (continuous_const.max continuous_id).comp_continuousOn
          (continuousOn_const.sub hf.continuousOn)
    obtain ⟨a', ha', hle⟩ := hQ.exists_forall_le' hcont (a := 0) (by
      intro y hy
      by_cases hr : r₁ ≤ f y
      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hgrad y (hQT hy) hr
        have h1 : 0 < (partialDeriv i f y) ^ 2 :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg _) (Ne.symm (pow_ne_zero 2 hi))
        have h2 : (partialDeriv i f y) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, (partialDeriv j f y) ^ 2 :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => (partialDeriv j f y) ^ 2)
            (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
        have h3 : 0 ≤ max 0 (r₁ - f y) := le_max_left _ _
        show 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i f y) ^ 2 + max 0 (r₁ - f y)
        linarith
      · have h1 : 0 ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, (partialDeriv j f y) ^ 2 :=
          Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
        have h2 : r₁ - f y ≤ max 0 (r₁ - f y) := le_max_right _ _
        push_neg at hr
        show 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i f y) ^ 2 + max 0 (r₁ - f y)
        linarith)
    refine ⟨a', ha', fun y hy hr => ?_⟩
    have h := hle y hy
    have h0 : max 0 (r₁ - f y) = 0 := max_eq_left (by linarith)
    simp only [h0, add_zero] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδT⟩ := hQ.exists_cthickening_subset_open hT hQT
  obtain ⟨F, hF1, hF0, hF01⟩ := exists_contMDiffMap_one_nhds_of_subset_interior 𝓘(ℝ, E3)
    (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) (s := Q) (t := Metric.thickening δ Q) hQ.isClosed
    (by rw [Metric.isOpen_thickening.interior_eq]; exact Metric.self_subset_thickening hδ Q)
  obtain ⟨χ, hχdef⟩ : ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, χ = ⇑F := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hχs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ := by
    rw [hχdef]
    exact contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp F.contMDiff
  have hχ01 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y ∧ χ y ≤ 1 := fun y => by rw [hχdef]; exact hF01 y
  have hχQ : ∀ y ∈ Q, χ y = 1 := fun y hy => by rw [hχdef]; exact hF1.self_of_nhdsSet y hy
  have hχsupp : tsupport χ ⊆ Metric.cthickening δ Q := by
    refine closure_minimal ?_ Metric.isClosed_cthickening
    intro y hy
    by_contra hy'
    apply hy
    rw [hχdef]
    exact hF0 y (fun h => hy' (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening δ Q h))
  have hχT : tsupport χ ⊆ T := hχsupp.trans hδT
  have hχc : HasCompactSupport χ :=
    (hQ.cthickening).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) hχsupp
  
  have hw : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) :=
    fun i => hloc _ _ (hfd i) hχs hχT
  have hwc : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) :=
    fun i => hχc.mul_left
  have hwT : ∀ i : Fin 3, tsupport (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) ⊆ T :=
    fun i => tsupport_mul_subset_right.trans hχT
  have hwi_int : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y) := by
    intro i
    have hc : Continuous (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y) := by
      show Continuous (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y (e i))
      exact ((hw i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ((hwc i).fderiv_apply ℝ (e i))
  
  have hchain : ∀ ε : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f z - r₁) / ε) - 1)) y =
        ε⁻¹ * deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) ((f y - r₁) / ε) *
          partialDeriv i f y := by
    intro ε y hy i
    have hfd' : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f y) y :=
      ((hf.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hg : HasFDerivAt (fun z => (f z - r₁) / ε) (ε⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ f y) y := by
      have h1 := (hfd'.sub_const r₁).const_mul ε⁻¹
      convert h1 using 1
      funext z
      rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
    have hh : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1))
        (deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) ((f y - r₁) / ε))
        ((f y - r₁) / ε) :=
      ((hh_smooth.differentiable (by simp)) _).hasDerivAt
    have hcomp := hh.comp_hasFDerivAt y hg
    show fderiv ℝ ((fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) ∘
      (fun z => (f z - r₁) / ε)) y (e i) = _
    rw [hcomp.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, partialDeriv]
    ring
  
  refine ⟨c₀⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∫ y, |partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y|, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε _hε1
  have hHs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f z - r₁) / ε) - 1)) T :=
    hh_smooth.comp_contDiffOn ((hf.sub contDiffOn_const).div_const ε)
  have hI : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv i
        (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f z - r₁) / ε) - 1)) y *
          (partialDeriv i f y * χ y)) ∧
      Integrable (fun y => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f y - r₁) / ε) - 1) *
          partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y) ∧
      ∫ y, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f z - r₁) / ε) - 1)) y *
          (partialDeriv i f y * χ y) =
        -∫ y, Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f y - r₁) / ε) - 1) *
          partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y :=
    fun i => hibp _ _ hHs (hw i) (hwc i) (hwT i) i
  obtain ⟨Fε, hFε⟩ : ∃ Fε : E3 → ℝ, Fε = fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f z - r₁) / ε) - 1)) y *
        (partialDeriv i f y * χ y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hform : ∀ y ∈ T, Fε y = ε⁻¹ * deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1))
      ((f y - r₁) / ε) * χ y * ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i f y) ^ 2 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hFε]
    simp only [hchain ε y hy]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hFnn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ Fε y := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ T
    · rw [hform y hy]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hε.le) (hhd0 _)) (hχ01 y).1)
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _)
    · have h0 : χ y = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hy (hχT h))
      rw [hFε]
      simp [h0]
  have hcmp : ∀ y ∈ Q, ε⁻¹ * deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1))
      ((f y - r₁) / ε) ≤ c₀⁻¹ * Fε y := by
    intro y hy
    have hyT := hQT hy
    by_cases hd : deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) ((f y - r₁) / ε) = 0
    · rw [hd, mul_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hc₀.le) (hFnn y)
    · have ht : 0 < (f y - r₁) / ε := by
        by_contra hneg
        exact hd (hhdz _ (not_lt.1 hneg))
      have hr : r₁ ≤ f y := by
        have h1 := mul_pos ht hε
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hε.ne'] at h1
        linarith
      have hS := hc₀le y hy hr
      rw [hform y hyT, hχQ y hy, mul_one]
      have ha : 0 ≤ ε⁻¹ * deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1))
          ((f y - r₁) / ε) := mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hε.le) (hhd0 _)
      rw [le_inv_mul_iff₀ hc₀]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS ha]
  have hFint : Integrable Fε := by
    rw [hFε]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hI i).1)
  have hdir : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ∫ y, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f z - r₁) / ε) - 1)) y *
          (partialDeriv i f y * χ y) ≤
        ∫ y, |partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y| := by
    intro i
    rw [(hI i).2.2, ← integral_neg]
    apply integral_mono (hI i).2.1.neg (hwi_int i).abs
    intro y
    have hH1 : |Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f y - r₁) / ε) - 1)| ≤ 1 :=
      abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [(hh01 ((f y - r₁) / ε)).1], (hh01 ((f y - r₁) / ε)).2⟩
    calc -(Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f y - r₁) / ε) - 1) *
          partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y)
        ≤ |Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f y - r₁) / ε) - 1) *
          partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y| := neg_le_abs _
      _ = |Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f y - r₁) / ε) - 1)| *
          |partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y| := abs_mul _ _
      _ ≤ |partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y| :=
          mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hH1
  calc ∫⁻ y in Q, ENNReal.ofReal (ε⁻¹ * deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1))
        ((f y - r₁) / ε))
      ≤ ∫⁻ y in Q, ENNReal.ofReal (c₀⁻¹ * Fε y) :=
        setLIntegral_mono' hQ.measurableSet fun y hy => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hcmp y hy)
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (c₀⁻¹ * Fε y) := setLIntegral_le_lintegral _ _
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, c₀⁻¹ * Fε y) :=
        (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (hFint.const_mul c₀⁻¹)
          (Eventually.of_forall fun y => mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hc₀.le) (hFnn y))).symm
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c₀⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3,
          ∫ y, |partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv i f y * χ y) y|) := by
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        rw [integral_const_mul]
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (inv_nonneg.2 hc₀.le)
        rw [hFε, integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hI i).1)]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hdir i

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (ρ : M → ℝ)
    (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (r₁ ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (A : Set M)
    (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A)
    (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x *
      Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((ρ x - r₁) / ε) - 1)) ∧
    ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) *
          Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) - r₁) / ε) - 1)) y =
        A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
          (ε⁻¹ * deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1))
            ((ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) - r₁) / ε)) *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y

          Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) - r₁) / ε) - 1)) y =

proof.tactics:
by
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρ.continuous
  
  have hloc : ∀ x : M,
      (x ∈ A → ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 x, A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) p *
          Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((ρ p - r₁) / ε) - 1) =
        Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((ρ p - r₁) / ε) - 1)) ∧
      (x ∉ A → ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 x, A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) p *
          Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((ρ p - r₁) / ε) - 1) = 0) := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx => ?_⟩
    · filter_upwards [hAo.mem_nhds hx] with p hp
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp, one_mul]
    · by_cases hlt : r₁ < ρ x
      · filter_upwards [hBo.mem_nhds ⟨hlt, hx⟩] with p hp
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hp.2, zero_mul]
      · have hN : IsOpen {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + ε / 2} := isOpen_lt hρc continuous_const
        have hxN : x ∈ {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + ε / 2} := by
          show ρ x < r₁ + ε / 2
          push_neg at hlt
          linarith
        filter_upwards [hN.mem_nhds hxN] with p hp
        have hp' : ρ p < r₁ + ε / 2 := hp
        have h1 : (ρ p - r₁) / ε < 1 / 2 := by
          rw [div_lt_iff₀ hε]
          linarith
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), mul_zero]
  
  have hkd : Differentiable ℝ (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) :=
    ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).comp
      ((contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id).sub contDiff_const)).differentiable (by simp)
  have hchain : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f y → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f z - r₁) / ε) - 1)) y =
        ε⁻¹ * deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) ((f y - r₁) / ε) *
          partialDeriv i f y := by
    intro f y hf i
    have hk : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1))
        (deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) ((f y - r₁) / ε))
        ((f y - r₁) / ε) := (hkd _).hasDerivAt
    have ha : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s - r₁) / ε) (1 / ε) (f y) :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id' (f y)).sub_const r₁).div_const ε
    have hc := hk.comp (f y) ha
    have hF := hc.comp_hasFDerivAt y hf.hasFDerivAt
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [show (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((f z - r₁) / ε) - 1)) =
      ((fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) ∘ (fun s : ℝ => (s - r₁) / ε)) ∘ f
      from rfl, hF.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have houter : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun s : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((s - r₁) / ε) - 1)) :=
    Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
      ((contDiff_const.mul ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const ε)).sub contDiff_const)
  have hφ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
      (fun x => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((ρ x - r₁) / ε) - 1)) :=
    houter.comp_contMDiff hρ
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun q y hy i => ?_⟩
  · by_cases hx : x ∈ A
    · exact (hφ x).congr_of_eventuallyEq ((hloc x).1 hx)
    · exact contMDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq ((hloc x).2 hx)
  · have hc : Tendsto (chartAt E3 q).symm (𝓝 y) (𝓝 ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) :=
      (chartAt E3 q).continuousAt_symm hy
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      have h1 := hρ.comp_contMDiffOn (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := q))
      have h2 := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
      exact (h2.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        ((chartAt E3 q).open_target.mem_nhds hy)
    by_cases hx : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ A
    · have hev' : (fun z => A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) *
            Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) - r₁) / ε) - 1)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) - r₁) / ε) - 1)) :=
        hc.eventually ((hloc _).1 hx)
      show fderiv ℝ _ y (e i) = _
      rw [hev'.fderiv_eq, Set.indicator_of_mem hx, one_mul]
      exact hchain _ y hfd i
    · have hev' : (fun z => A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) *
            Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) - r₁) / ε) - 1)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
        hc.eventually ((hloc _).2 hx)
      show fderiv ℝ _ y (e i) = _
      rw [hev'.fderiv_eq, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
      simp

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Ω : Set M) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {n₀ : ℕ} (q₀ : Fin n₀ → M) (φ₀ : Fin n₀ → M → ℝ) (hφ₀ : calPartition q₀ φ₀ Ω) (O : Set M) (hO : IsOpen O) (hO1 : ∀ x ∈ O, ∑ j, φ₀ j x = 1) (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (O' : Set M), calPartition q φ Ω ∧ IsOpen O' ∧ K ∪ O ⊆ O' ∧ (∀ x ∈ O', ∑ j, φ j x = 1) ∧ ∀ (E : Set M) (h : M → ℝ), E ⊆ O → calVolSum g q φ E h = calVolSum g q₀ φ₀ E h

signature.name: calPartition_extend
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Ω : Set M) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {n₀ : ℕ} (q₀ : Fin n₀ → M) (φ₀ : Fin n₀ → M → ℝ) (hφ₀ : calPartition q₀ φ₀ Ω) (O : Set M) (hO : IsOpen O) (hO1 : ∀ x ∈ O, ∑ j, φ₀ j x = 1) (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKΩ : K ⊆ Ω) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (O' : Set M), calPartition q φ Ω ∧ IsOpen O' ∧ K ∪ O ⊆ O' ∧ (∀ x ∈ O', ∑ j, φ j x = 1) ∧ ∀ (E : Set M) (h : M → ℝ), E ⊆ O → calVolSum g q φ E h = calVolSum g q₀ φ₀ E h

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hsm, hnn, hle, hsupp⟩ := hφ₀
  
  have hbump : ∀ x : K, ∃ b : SmoothBumpFunction 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (x : M), tsupport b ⊆ Ω := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨b, -, hb⟩ :=
      (SmoothBumpFunction.nhds_basis_tsupport (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (x : M)).mem_iff.1
        (hΩ.mem_nhds (hKΩ x.2))
    exact ⟨b, hb⟩
  choose b hb using hbump
  have hcovK : K ⊆ ⋃ x : K, interior {y | b x y = 1} := by
    intro z hz
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds]
    exact (b ⟨z, hz⟩).eventuallyEq_one
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover (fun x : K => interior {y | b x y = 1})
    (fun _ => isOpen_interior) hcovK
  obtain ⟨m, c, f, hf_sm, hf01, hf_supp, hKcov⟩ : ∃ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin m → M) (f : Fin m → M → ℝ),
      (∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i)) ∧ (∀ i x, 0 ≤ f i x ∧ f i x ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ i, IsCompact (tsupport (f i)) ∧ tsupport (f i) ⊆ Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (c i)).source) ∧
      K ⊆ ⋃ i, interior {x | f i x = 1} := by
    refine ⟨t.card, fun i => ((t.equivFin.symm i : K) : M), fun i => ⇑(b (t.equivFin.symm i)),
      fun i => (b _).contMDiff, fun i x => ⟨(b _).nonneg, (b _).le_one⟩,
      fun i => ⟨(b _).hasCompactSupport,
        Set.subset_inter (hb _) (b _).tsupport_subset_chartAt_source⟩, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    have hz' := ht hz
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz'
    obtain ⟨x, hxt, hzx⟩ := hz'
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨t.equivFin ⟨x, hxt⟩, ?_⟩
    have he : t.equivFin.symm (t.equivFin ⟨x, hxt⟩) = ⟨x, hxt⟩ := Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ _
    show z ∈ interior {y | b (t.equivFin.symm (t.equivFin ⟨x, hxt⟩) : K) y = 1}
    rw [he]
    exact hzx
  
  have hSsm : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => ∑ j, φ₀ j x) :=
    contMDiff_finset_sum fun j _ => hsm j
  
  have htel : ∀ x, ∑ k, f k x * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => j < k), (1 - f j x) =
      1 - ∏ i, (1 - f i x) := by
    intro x
    have := Finset.prod_one_sub_ordered Finset.univ (fun i => f i x)
    rw [this]
    ring
  have hP0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ∏ i, (1 - f i x) :=
    fun x => Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => sub_nonneg.2 (hf01 i x).2
  have hχ0 : ∀ k x, 0 ≤ f k x * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => j < k), (1 - f j x) :=
    fun k x => mul_nonneg (hf01 k x).1 (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => sub_nonneg.2 (hf01 j x).2)
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : Fin m → M → ℝ, ψ = fun k x => (1 - ∑ j, φ₀ j x) *
      (f k x * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun j => j < k), (1 - f j x)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have htot : ∀ x, ∑ j, Fin.append φ₀ ψ j x = 1 - (1 - ∑ j, φ₀ j x) * ∏ i, (1 - f i x) := by
    intro x
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
    simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, hψdef]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, htel x]
    ring
  refine ⟨n₀ + m, Fin.append q₀ c, Fin.append φ₀ ψ, O ∪ ⋃ i, interior {x | f i x = 1},
    ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    induction j using Fin.addCases with
    | left i =>
      simp only [Fin.append_left]
      exact hsm i
    | right k =>
      simp only [Fin.append_right, hψdef]
      exact (contMDiff_const.sub hSsm).mul ((hf_sm k).mul
        (contMDiff_finset_prod fun j _ => contMDiff_const.sub (hf_sm j)))
  · intro j x
    induction j using Fin.addCases with
    | left i =>
      simp only [Fin.append_left]
      exact hnn i x
    | right k =>
      simp only [Fin.append_right, hψdef]
      exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 (hle x)) (hχ0 k x)
  · intro x
    rw [htot x]
    have := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 (hle x)) (hP0 x)
    linarith
  · intro j
    induction j using Fin.addCases with
    | left i =>
      simp only [Fin.append_left]
      exact hsupp i
    | right k =>
      simp only [Fin.append_right]
      have hsub : tsupport (ψ k) ⊆ tsupport (f k) := by
        rw [hψdef]
        exact tsupport_mul_subset_right.trans tsupport_mul_subset_left
      exact ⟨(hf_supp k).1.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) hsub,
        hsub.trans (hf_supp k).2⟩
  · exact hO.union (isOpen_iUnion fun i => isOpen_interior)
  · rintro x (hx | hx)
    · exact Or.inr (hKcov hx)
    · exact Or.inl hx
  · rintro x (hx | hx)
    · rw [htot x, hO1 x hx]
      ring
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
      have hfi' : x ∈ {x | f i x = 1} := interior_subset hi
      have hfi : f i x = 1 := hfi'
      rw [htot x, Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) (by rw [hfi]; norm_num)]
      ring
  · intro E h hE
    unfold calVolSum
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
    simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
    refine (add_eq_left).2 ?_
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => ?_
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun y hy => ?_
    obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxE, hxs⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.left_inv _ hxs, hψdef]
    simp [hO1 x (hE hxE)]

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E Ω : Set M) (hE : sepChartMeas E) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (hφ : calPartition q φ Ω) (V : M → E3) (hV : calSmoothField V) (hV1 : ∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) : ENNReal.ofReal (calDivSum g q φ E V) ≤ sepRiemPer g E Ω

signature.name: sepRiemPer_ge_calDivSum
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E Ω : Set M) (hE : sepChartMeas E) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (hφ : calPartition q φ Ω) (V : M → E3) (hV : calSmoothField V) (hV1 : ∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) : ENNReal.ofReal (calDivSum g q φ E V) ≤ sepRiemPer g E Ω

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ : ∃ I : M → (M → ℝ) → ℝ, I = fun p ψ =>
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  suffices H : ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set M), IsOpen Ω → ∀ (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ),
      calPartition q φ Ω → ENNReal.ofReal (calDivSum g q φ E V) ≤ sepRiemPer g E Ω from
    H n Ω hΩ q φ hφ
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro Ω _ q φ _
    simp [calDivSum]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro Ω hΩ q φ hφ
    obtain ⟨hsm, hnn, hsum, hsupp⟩ := hφ
    by_cases hPtop : sepRiemPer g E Ω = ⊤
    · rw [hPtop]; exact le_top
    
    have hmono : ∀ U : Set M, U ⊆ Ω → sepRiemPer g E U ≤ sepRiemPer g E Ω := by
      intro U hU
      have h := sepRiemPer_disjoint_sum_le g E Ω (fun _ : Fin 1 => U) (fun _ => hU)
        (fun i j hij => absurd (Subsingleton.elim i j) hij)
      simpa using h
    have hfin : ∀ U : Set M, U ⊆ Ω → sepRiemPer g E U ≠ ⊤ := fun U hU =>
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top hPtop (hmono U hU)
    have hconv : ∀ (U : Set M), U ⊆ Ω → ∀ (x c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c →
        ENNReal.ofReal x ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * sepRiemPer g E U →
        x ≤ c * (sepRiemPer g E U).toReal := by
      intro U hU x c hc h
      have h2 := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal
        (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (hfin U hU))).1 h
      rwa [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hc] at h2
    have hpv0 : 0 ≤ (sepRiemPer g E Ω).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    
    have hφ1 : ∀ j x, φ j x ≤ 1 := fun j x =>
      le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => hnn k x) (Finset.mem_univ j)) (hsum x)
    have hφ0src : ∀ x, φ 0 x ≠ 0 → x ∈ Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (q 0)).source := fun x hx =>
      (hsupp 0).2 (subset_tsupport _ hx)
    have hprod : ∀ (w : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w →
        (∀ x, 0 ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ 1) → ∀ j,
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => w x * φ j x) ∧
        IsCompact (tsupport (fun x => w x * φ j x)) ∧
        tsupport (fun x => w x * φ j x) ⊆ tsupport w ∩ (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) ∧
        (∀ x, |w x * φ j x| ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ w x * φ j x) := by
      intro w hw hw01 j
      refine ⟨hw.mul (hsm j),
        (hsupp j).1.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) (tsupport_mul_subset_right),
        fun x hx => ⟨tsupport_mul_subset_left hx, (hsupp j).2 (tsupport_mul_subset_right hx)⟩,
        fun x => ?_, fun x => mul_nonneg (hw01 x).1 (hnn j x)⟩
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw01 x).1 (hnn j x))]
      exact mul_le_one₀ (hw01 x).2 (hnn j x) (hφ1 j x)
    have hΛeq : calDivSum g q φ E V = ∑ j, I (q j) (φ j) := by subst hI; rfl
    
    have hstar : ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u →
        calDivSum g q φ E V ≤ (sepRiemPer g E Ω).toReal + 8 * N * u * (sepRiemPer g E Ω).toReal
          + (n + 1) * (sepRiemPer g E Ω).toReal / N := by
      intro N hN u hu
      have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
      
      have hBsub : ∀ i : Fin N, Ω ∩ {x | u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) - 2 * u < φ 0 x ∧
          φ 0 x < u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) + 2 * u} ⊆ Ω := fun i => Set.inter_subset_left
      have hBdisj : Pairwise (fun i j : Fin N =>
          Disjoint (Ω ∩ {x | u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) - 2 * u < φ 0 x ∧
            φ 0 x < u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) + 2 * u})
          (Ω ∩ {x | u * (8 * ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) - 2 * u < φ 0 x ∧
            φ 0 x < u * (8 * ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) + 2 * u})) := by
        intro i j hij
        rw [Set.disjoint_left]
        rintro x ⟨-, h1, h2⟩ ⟨-, h3, h4⟩
        have hne : (i : ℕ) ≠ (j : ℕ) := fun h => hij (Fin.ext h)
        rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
        · have h' : ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h' hu.le]
        · have h' : ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h' hu.le]
      have hBsum := sepRiemPer_disjoint_sum_le g E Ω _ hBsub hBdisj
      have hBreal : ∑ i : Fin N, (sepRiemPer g E (Ω ∩ {x | u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) - 2 * u < φ 0 x ∧
          φ 0 x < u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) + 2 * u})).toReal ≤ (sepRiemPer g E Ω).toReal := by
        rw [← ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun i _ => hfin _ (hBsub i))]
        exact ENNReal.toReal_mono hPtop hBsum
      obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ : ∃ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)),
          (sepRiemPer g E (Ω ∩ {x | u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) - 2 * u < φ 0 x ∧
            φ 0 x < u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) + 2 * u})).toReal
            ≤ (sepRiemPer g E Ω).toReal / N := by
        refine Finset.exists_le_of_sum_le ⟨⟨0, hN⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ ?_
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
          mul_div_cancel₀ _ hNpos.ne']
        exact hBreal
      set t : ℝ := u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) with ht
      set B : Set M := Ω ∩ {x | t - 2 * u < φ 0 x ∧ φ 0 x < t + 2 * u} with hB
      have hi' : (sepRiemPer g E B).toReal ≤ (sepRiemPer g E Ω).toReal / N := hi
      have hBsub' : B ⊆ Ω := Set.inter_subset_left
      have hBopen : IsOpen B := hΩ.inter
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const (hsm 0).continuous).inter
          (isOpen_lt (hsm 0).continuous continuous_const))
      have ht0 : 0 < t := by positivity
      have htle : t ≤ 8 * N * u := by
        have hiN : ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast i.isLt
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hiN hu.le]
      
      obtain ⟨a, b, γ, ha, hb, hγ, h01, hsa, hsb, hsγ⟩ := calCut_functions (φ 0) (hsm 0) t u hu
      have h01a : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x ∧ a x ≤ 1 := fun x => ⟨(h01 x).1, (h01 x).2.1⟩
      have h01b : ∀ x, 0 ≤ b x ∧ b x ≤ 1 := fun x => ⟨(h01 x).2.2.1, (h01 x).2.2.2.1⟩
      have h01γ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ γ x ∧ γ x ≤ 1 := fun x => ⟨(h01 x).2.2.2.2.1, (h01 x).2.2.2.2.2.1⟩
      have hsum3 : ∀ x, a x + γ x + b x = 1 := fun x => (h01 x).2.2.2.2.2.2
      have hPa := hprod a ha h01a
      have hPb := hprod b hb h01b
      have hPγ := hprod γ hγ h01γ
      have hta' : tsupport a ⊆ tsupport (φ 0) := fun x hx =>
        subset_tsupport _ (ht0.trans (hsa hx)).ne'
      have hta : tsupport a ⊆ Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (q 0)).source := fun x hx =>
        hφ0src x (ht0.trans (hsa hx)).ne'
      set Ωa : Set M := Ω ∩ {x | t < φ 0 x} with hΩadef
      set Ωb : Set M := Ω ∩ {x | φ 0 x < t} with hΩbdef
      have hΩa : IsOpen Ωa := hΩ.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (hsm 0).continuous)
      have hΩb : IsOpen Ωb := hΩ.inter (isOpen_lt (hsm 0).continuous continuous_const)
      have hΩasub : Ωa ⊆ Ω := Set.inter_subset_left
      have hΩbsub : Ωb ⊆ Ω := Set.inter_subset_left
      have hdab : Disjoint Ωa Ωb := Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x h1 h2 =>
        lt_asymm (show t < φ 0 x from h1.2) (show φ 0 x < t from h2.2)
      
      have hsplit : ∀ j, I (q j) (φ j) = I (q j) (fun x => a x * φ j x) +
          I (q j) (fun x => γ x * φ j x) + I (q j) (fun x => b x * φ j x) := by
        intro j
        have hw : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (![a, γ, b] k) ∧
            ∀ x, 0 ≤ ![a, γ, b] k x ∧ ![a, γ, b] k x ≤ 1 := by
          intro k
          fin_cases k
          · exact ⟨ha, h01a⟩
          · exact ⟨hγ, h01γ⟩
          · exact ⟨hb, h01b⟩
        have h : I (q j) (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, ![a, γ, b] k x * φ j x) =
            ∑ k : Fin 3, I (q j) (fun x => ![a, γ, b] k x * φ j x) := by
          subst hI
          exact calPiece_div_integral_sum g (q j) (fun k x => ![a, γ, b] k x * φ j x)
            (fun k => (hprod _ (hw k).1 (hw k).2 j).1)
            (fun k => (hprod _ (hw k).1 (hw k).2 j).2.1)
            (fun k x hx => ((hprod _ (hw k).1 (hw k).2 j).2.2.1 hx).2.2) V hV _
        have hfun : (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, ![a, γ, b] k x * φ j x) = φ j := by
          funext x
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
            Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
          linear_combination (φ j x) * hsum3 x
        rw [hfun, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h
        simpa only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] using h
      
      have hAj : ∀ j, I (q j) (fun x => a x * φ j x) = I (q 0) (fun x => a x * φ j x) := by
        intro j
        subst hI
        exact calPiece_div_integral_chart_eq g (q j) (q 0) _ (hPa j).1 (hPa j).2.1
          (fun x hx => ⟨((hPa j).2.2.1 hx).2.2, (hta ((hPa j).2.2.1 hx).1).2⟩) V hV E hE
      have hAsum : I (q 0) (fun x => ∑ j, a x * φ j x) =
          ∑ j, I (q 0) (fun x => a x * φ j x) := by
        subst hI

        fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) y
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j)) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)
            (Z ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) : E3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hcancel : ∑ j, Mt j = 0 := by
    rw [hMdef, hSdef]
    exact cal_partition_div_cancel g {p : M | ρ p < s} q φ hφ O hO hφ1 Z hZ _ hDm hDO
  
  have hineq : ∀ j, ((∫ y in S j, calTheta r₁ η (f j y) * d j y) + Mt j +
      ((∫ y in S j, ee j y) - ∫ y in S j, calTheta r₁ η (f j y) * ee j y)) ≤
      (∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) V) y) -
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (((F \ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) ∪ A) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) y := by
    intro j
    have h := cal_chart_step g ρ r₁ η A F hρ hmc hAsub hAo hBo hF hη0 (q j) (φ j) (hφ.1 j)
      (hφ.2.1 j) (hφ.2.2.2 j).1 ((hφ.2.2.2 j).2.trans Set.inter_subset_right) Y V Z hY hY1
      (hVZ (q j))
    rw [hMdef, hSdef, hfdef, hddef, heedef]
    exact h.2.2
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => hineq j)
  have e1 : ∑ j, ((∫ y in S j, calTheta r₁ η (f j y) * d j y) + Mt j +
      ((∫ y in S j, ee j y) - ∫ y in S j, calTheta r₁ η (f j y) * ee j y)) =
      ∑ j, ((∫ y in S j, calTheta r₁ η (f j y) * d j y) +
      ((∫ y in S j, ee j y) - ∫ y in S j, calTheta r₁ η (f j y) * ee j y)) + ∑ j, Mt j := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
  rw [e1, hcancel, add_zero, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hsum
  unfold calDivSum
  linarith

    (r₁ η : ℝ) (A : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ)

    (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) (hη : 0 < η)
    (Y : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (hY1 : ∀ x, g.g x (Y x) (Y x) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ V Z : M → E3, calSmoothField V ∧ (∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) ∧ calSmoothField Z ∧
      ∀ q : M, ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, ∀ wV wY wZ : E3,
        wV = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (V ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
        wY = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)

        ∀ i : Fin 3,

subgoal_signatures.statement:

    (Y V Z : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (hY1 : ∀ x, g.g x (Y x) (Y x) ≤ 1)
    (hVZ : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, ∀ wV wY wZ : E3,

        wY = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)

        wZ = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) →
        ∀ i : Fin 3,
          wV i = (1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) * wY i +
            calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y i ∧
          wZ i = calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y i) :
    IntegrableOn (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *

      (chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun y => calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y)
      (chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ∧
    (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
          (φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)) +
      (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *

            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
              (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) +
      ((∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),

            (calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *

    (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
