by
  classical
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρ.continuous
  
  have hpd1 : ∀ (U : Set E3) (h : E3 → ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U → ∀ k : Fin 3,
      ContinuousOn (partialDeriv k h) U := by
    intro U h hU hh k
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ h) U := hh.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    show ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ h y (e k)) U
    exact h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hpds : ∀ (U : Set E3) (h : E3 → ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U → ∀ k : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv k h) U := by
    intro U h hU hh k
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ h y) U := hh.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ h y (e k)) U
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hmat : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => G y i j) U) → ContinuousOn G U := by
    intro G U hG
    exact continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j => hG i j
  have hdetc : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => G y i j) U) →
      ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y).det) U := by
    intro G U hG
    exact (continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn (hmat G U hG)
  have hinv : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => G y i j) U) → (∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0) →
      ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U := by
    intro G U hG hdet i j
    have hd := hdetc G U hG
    have ha : ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y).adjugate i j) U :=
      ((continuous_id.matrix_adjugate).matrix_elem i j).comp_continuousOn (hmat G U hG)
    have heq : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) = fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate i j := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact (hd.inv₀ hdet).mul ha
  
  have hLMCC : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3), IsOpen U →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) → (∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ContinuousOn (levelMeanCurvCoord G f) {y : E3 | y ∈ U ∧
        0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y} := by
    intro G f U hU hG hdet hf
    have hGc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => G y i j) U := fun i j => (hG i j).continuousOn
    have hGi := hinv G U hGc hdet
    have hdG : ∀ a b k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv k (fun z => G z a b)) U :=
      fun a b k => hpd1 U _ hU (hG a b) k
    have hdf : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv k f) U := fun k => hpd1 U f hU hf k
    have hddf : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f)) U :=
      fun i j => hpd1 U _ hU (hpds U f hU hf j) i
    have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (christoffel G k i j) U := by
      intro k i j
      show ContinuousOn (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y
          - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y)) U
      exact continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun l _ =>
        (hGi k l).mul (((hdG j l i).add (hdG i l j)).sub (hdG i j l)))
    have hhess : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (hessLoc G f i j) U := by
      intro i j
      show ContinuousOn (fun y => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y -
        ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k f y) U
      exact (hddf i j).sub (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun k _ => (hchr k i j).mul (hdf k))
    have hlap : ContinuousOn (lapLoc G f) U := by
      show ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * hessLoc G f i j y) U
      exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        (hGi i j).mul (hhess i j)
    have hQ : ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a f y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b f y) *
          hessLoc G f i j y) U :=
      continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
          (((hGi i a).mul (hdf a)).mul ((hGi j b).mul (hdf b))).mul (hhess i j)
    have hS : ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y) U :=
      continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        ((hGi i j).mul (hdf i)).mul (hdf j)
    have hsub : {y : E3 | y ∈ U ∧
        0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y} ⊆ U :=
      fun y hy => hy.1
    have hsq := hS.sqrt.mono hsub
    have hne : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | y ∈ U ∧
        0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y},
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y) ≠ 0 :=
      fun y hy => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hy.2).ne'
    exact ((hlap.mono hsub).div hsq hne).sub
      ((hQ.mono hsub).div (hsq.pow 3) fun y hy => pow_ne_zero 3 (hne y hy))
  
  have hHc : ∀ q0 : M, ContinuousOn (fun y => g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 q0).symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 q0).target ∩ {y : E3 | r₁ ≤ ρ ((chartAt E3 q0).symm y)}) := by
    intro q0
    let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 q0).symm.toPartialEquiv
        open_source := (chartAt E3 q0).open_target
        open_target := (chartAt E3 q0).open_source
        contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
        contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
    have hΦeq : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q0).target, g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 q0).symm y) =
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q0).symm)
          (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q0).symm z)) y := by
      intro y hy
      exact levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φ ρ (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q0).symm z)) hρ y hy
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => rfl)
    have hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q0).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q0).target := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ρ ∘ (chartAt E3 q0).symm)
          (chartAt E3 q0).target :=
        hρ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    have hcont := hLMCC (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q0).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q0).symm z)) _
      (chartAt E3 q0).open_target (fun i j => g.smooth q0 i j)
      (fun y hy => (Matrix.PosDef.det_pos (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q0 y hy)).ne') hfs
    refine (hcont.mono ?_).congr fun y hy => hΦeq y hy.1
    rintro y ⟨hy, hr⟩
    refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
    by_contra hS
    push_neg at hS
    have hpos := hmc _ hr
    rw [hΦeq y hy] at hpos
    unfold levelMeanCurvCoord at hpos
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.2 hS] at hpos
    simp at hpos
  
  have hnn : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 (q j) '' (D ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
      0 ≤ φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det := by
    rintro j _ ⟨x, ⟨hxD, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [(chartAt E3 (q j)).left_inv hxs]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hφ.2.1 j x) (hmc x (le_of_lt (hDρ hxD))).le)
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hint0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (D ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
      φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det :=
    fun j => setIntegral_nonneg (hD (q j)) (hnn j)
  have hzero : ∀ j, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (D ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
      φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det = 0 := by
    have h0' : ∑ j, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (D ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
        φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det ≤ 0 := h0
    have hsum := le_antisymm h0' (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hint0 j)
    intro j
    exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => hint0 j)).1 hsum j (Finset.mem_univ j)
  
  have hinteg : ∀ j, IntegrableOn (fun y =>
      φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 (q j) '' (D ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source)) := by
    intro j
    have hsrc : tsupport (φ j) ∩ {x | r₁ ≤ ρ x} ⊆ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source :=
      fun x hx => ((hφ.2.2.2 j).2 hx.1).2
    have hK : IsCompact (chartAt E3 (q j) '' (tsupport (φ j) ∩ {x | r₁ ≤ ρ x})) :=
      ((hφ.2.2.2 j).1.inter_right (isClosed_le continuous_const hρc)).image_of_continuousOn
        ((chartAt E3 (q j)).continuousOn.mono hsrc)
    have hKT : chartAt E3 (q j) '' (tsupport (φ j) ∩ {x | r₁ ≤ ρ x}) ⊆
        (chartAt E3 (q j)).target ∩ {y : E3 | r₁ ≤ ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)} := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      have hxs : x ∈ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source := hsrc hx
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 (q j)).map_source hxs, ?_⟩
      show r₁ ≤ ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm (chartAt E3 (q j) x))
      rw [(chartAt E3 (q j)).left_inv hxs]
      exact hx.2
    have hT : chartAt E3 (q j) '' (tsupport (φ j) ∩ {x | r₁ ≤ ρ x}) ⊆
        (chartAt E3 (q j)).target := fun y hy => (hKT hy).1
    have c1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (q j)).target :=
      (hφ.1 j).continuous.comp_continuousOn (chartAt E3 (q j)).continuousOn_symm
    have c3 : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det)
        (chartAt E3 (q j)).target :=
      (hdetc _ _ fun a b => (g.smooth (q j) a b).continuousOn).sqrt
    have hFc := ((c1.mono hT).mul ((hHc (q j)).mono hKT)).mul (c3.mono hT)
    refine IntegrableOn.of_forall_diff_eq_zero (hFc.integrableOn_compact hK) (hD (q j)) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxD, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hnK⟩
    have hφx : φ j x = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hnK ⟨x, ⟨subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hne),
        (show r₁ ≤ ρ x from le_of_lt (hDρ hxD))⟩, rfl⟩
    simp only [(chartAt E3 (q j)).left_inv hxs, hφx, zero_mul]
  
  have hnull : ∀ j, volume (chartAt E3 (q j) '' (D ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) ∩
      {y | φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det ≠ 0}) = 0 := by
    intro j
    have hae := (setIntegral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae
      ((ae_restrict_iff' (hD (q j))).2 (ae_of_all _ (hnn j))) (hinteg j)).1 (hzero j)
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, ae_restrict_iff' (hD (q j)), ae_iff] at hae
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ hae
    rintro y ⟨hyS, hy⟩
    exact fun h => hy (h hyS)
  
  have hNnull : ∀ j, sepChartNull
      {x | x ∈ D ∧ x ∈ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source ∧ φ j x ≠ 0} := by
    intro j
    refine sepChartNull_of_image_null (q j) _ (fun x hx => hx.2.1) ?_
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (hnull j)
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨hxD, hxs, hφx⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxD, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, (chartAt E3 (q j)).left_inv hxs]
    have h1 : 0 < φ j x := lt_of_le_of_ne (hφ.2.1 j x) (Ne.symm hφx)
    have h2 : 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ x := hmc x (le_of_lt (hDρ hxD))
    have h3 : 0 < Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm (chartAt E3 (q j) x)).det :=
      Real.sqrt_pos.2 (Matrix.PosDef.det_pos
        (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g (q j) _ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).map_source hxs)))
    exact (mul_pos (mul_pos h1 h2) h3).ne'
  
  have hcov : D ⊆ ⋃ j, {x | x ∈ D ∧ x ∈ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source ∧ φ j x ≠ 0} := by
    intro x hx
    have hs : ∑ j, φ j x ≠ 0 := by rw [hD1 x hx]; exact one_ne_zero
    obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hs
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hx,
      ((hφ.2.2.2 j).2 (subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hj))).2, hj⟩
  intro p
  have h1 : chartAt E3 p '' (D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ⊆ ⋃ j, chartAt E3 p ''
      ({x | x ∈ D ∧ x ∈ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source ∧ φ j x ≠ 0} ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨hxD, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (hcov hxD)
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, x, ⟨hj, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
  exact measure_mono_null h1 (measure_iUnion_null fun j => hNnull j p)

informal_problem.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hP : P.PosDef) :
    ∃ L : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3, ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (L (e i)) k * P k l * (L (e j)) l = if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0

signature.name: sepPosDef_normalizer
signature.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hP : P.PosDef) :
    ∃ L : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3, ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (L (e i)) k * P k l * (L (e j)) l = if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := Matrix.posSemidef_iff_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self.mp hP.posSemidef
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hB
  have hdetB : IsUnit B.det := by
    have h1 := hP.det_pos
    rw [hB, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose] at h1
    refine isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ?_
    intro h0
    rw [h0, mul_zero] at h1
    exact lt_irrefl _ h1
  have hBA : B * B⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv B hdetB
  have hAB : B⁻¹ * B = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul B hdetB
  have hAPA : (B⁻¹).transpose * P * B⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rw [hB]
    calc (B⁻¹).transpose * (B.transpose * B) * B⁻¹
        = (B * B⁻¹).transpose * (B * B⁻¹) := by
          rw [Matrix.transpose_mul]; simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hBA, Matrix.transpose_one, one_mul]
  have hleft : Function.LeftInverse (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin 3) B)
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin 3) B⁻¹) := by
    intro v
    show (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin 3) B *
      Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin 3) B⁻¹) v = v
    rw [← map_mul, hBA, map_one]
    rfl
  have hright : Function.RightInverse (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin 3) B)
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin 3) B⁻¹) := by
    intro v
    show (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin 3) B⁻¹ *
      Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := Fin 3) B) v = v
    rw [← map_mul, hAB, map_one]
    rfl
  refine ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse _ _ hleft hright, fun i j => ?_⟩
  have hcol : ∀ m k : Fin 3,
      (ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse _ _ hleft hright (e m)) k = B⁻¹ k m := by
    intro m k
    rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse_apply]
    have hem : e m = WithLp.toLp 2 ((e m).ofLp) := (WithLp.toLp_ofLp _ (e m)).symm
    rw [hem, Matrix.toEuclideanCLM_toLp]
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  simp only [hcol]
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hAPA i) j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul] at h
  rw [Finset.sum_comm] at h
  rw [h, Matrix.one_apply]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hF : MeasurableSet F) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (y₀ : E3) (L : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∀ V : Set E3, V ⊆ U →
      sepPerG (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
          ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' V) =
        ENNReal.ofReal c * sepPerG G F V) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z => (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j)
      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U)) ∧
    (∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j =
      (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) j i) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ (fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U, (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z).PosDef) ∧
    (sepIsPerMin G F U → sepIsPerMin (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U))

signature.name: sepAffinePullback
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hF : MeasurableSet F) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (y₀ : E3) (L : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∀ V : Set E3, V ⊆ U →
      sepPerG (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
          ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' V) =
        ENNReal.ofReal c * sepPerG G F V) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z => (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j)
      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U)) ∧
    (∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j =
      (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) j i) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ (fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U, (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z).PosDef) ∧
    (sepIsPerMin G F U → sepIsPerMin (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hfd : ∀ z : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) z = (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) := by
    intro z
    rw [fderiv_const_add]
    exact L.fderiv
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt c := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hc
  have hss : Real.sqrt c * Real.sqrt c = c := Real.mul_self_sqrt hc.le
  have hφc : Continuous (fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) := continuous_const.add L.continuous
  
  have s2 : ∀ z v : E3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j * v i * v j =
      c * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G (y₀ + L z) k l * (L v) k * (L v) l := by
    intro z v
    have hv : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
      ext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hLv : ∀ k, (L v) k = v 0 * (L (e 0)) k + v 1 * (L (e 1)) k + v 2 * (L (e 2)) k := by
      intro k
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      simp [map_add, map_smul]
    simp only [pullbackMetric, hfd, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, hLv,
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    ring
  
  have s1 : (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun z => (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j)
        ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U)) ∧
      (∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j =
        (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) j i) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ (fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U, (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z).PosDef) := by
    have hent : ∀ z a b, (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) a b =
        c * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (L (e a)) i * G (y₀ + L z) i j * (L (e b)) j := by
      intro z a b
      simp only [pullbackMetric, hfd, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a b
      simp_rw [hent]
      have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) := contDiff_const.add L.contDiff
      apply contDiffOn_const.mul
      apply ContDiffOn.sum; intro i _
      apply ContDiffOn.sum; intro j _
      refine ContDiffOn.mul (contDiffOn_const.mul ?_) contDiffOn_const
      exact (hG i j).comp hφ.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hz)
    · intro z a b
      rw [hent, hent]
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [hsymm]; ring
    · intro z hz
      set B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := Matrix.of fun k a => (L (e a)) k with hB
      have hmat : c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z =
          c • (B.conjTranspose * G (y₀ + L z) * B) := by
        ext a b
        rw [hent]
        simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
          star_trivial, hB, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      have hinj : Function.Injective B.mulVec := by
        intro v w hvw
        have key : ∀ u : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ k,
            B.mulVec u k = (L (u 0 • e 0 + u 1 • e 1 + u 2 • e 2)) k := by
          intro u k
          simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hB, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add, map_smul]
          ring
        have h2 : (v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 : E3) =
            (w 0 • e 0 + w 1 • e 1 + w 2 • e 2 : E3) := by
          apply L.injective
          ext k
          rw [← key v k, ← key w k, hvw]
        funext k
        have := congrArg (fun x : E3 => x k) h2
        fin_cases k <;> simpa [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using this
      rw [hmat]
      exact ((hpd _ hz).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hinj).smul hc
  
  have s3 : ∀ (X : E3 → E3) (z : E3),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y) (y₀ + L z) →
      sepDensDiv (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
        (fun z => (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ • L.symm (X (y₀ + L z))) z =
        c * |(L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).det| * sepDensDiv G X (y₀ + L z) := by
    intro X z hY
    set D := (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).det with hD
    set A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := Matrix.of fun k a => (L (e a)) k with hA
    have hAD : A.det = D := by
      have : LinearMap.toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis
          (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis ((L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) = A := by
        ext k a
        simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, hA]
      rw [← this, LinearMap.det_toMatrix]
    have hmat : ∀ z', c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z' =
        c • (A.transpose * G (y₀ + L z') * A) := by
      intro z'
      ext a b
      simp only [pullbackMetric, hfd, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hA,
        Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hsqrt : ∀ z', Real.sqrt (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z').det =
        c * |D| * Real.sqrt c * Real.sqrt (G (y₀ + L z')).det := by
      intro z'
      rw [hmat, Matrix.det_smul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, hAD]
      simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
      have h1 : |D| ^ 2 = D ^ 2 := sq_abs D
      have : c ^ 3 * (D * (G (y₀ + L z')).det * D) =
          (c * |D| * Real.sqrt c) ^ 2 * (G (y₀ + L z')).det := by
        calc c ^ 3 * (D * (G (y₀ + L z')).det * D)
            = c * c * c * D ^ 2 * (G (y₀ + L z')).det := by ring
          _ = c * c * (Real.sqrt c * Real.sqrt c) * |D| ^ 2 * (G (y₀ + L z')).det := by
            rw [hss, h1]
          _ = _ := by ring
      rw [this, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
    have hfun : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        (fun z' => Real.sqrt (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z').det *
          ((Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ • L.symm (X (y₀ + L z'))) i) =
        fun z' => (c * |D|) * (L.symm (Real.sqrt (G (y₀ + L z')).det • X (y₀ + L z'))) i := by
      intro i; funext z'
      rw [hsqrt]
      simp only [map_smul, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    have hφd : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) z :=
      (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).hasFDerivAt.const_add y₀
    set DY := fderiv ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y) (y₀ + L z) with hDY
    have hYd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y) DY (y₀ + L z) :=
      hY.hasFDerivAt
    have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun z' => Real.sqrt (G (y₀ + L z')).det • X (y₀ + L z'))
        (DY.comp (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)) z :=
      HasFDerivAt.comp (f := fun w : E3 => y₀ + L w) z hYd hφd
    have hcomp2 : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt
        (fun z' => (L.symm (Real.sqrt (G (y₀ + L z')).det • X (y₀ + L z'))) i)
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj i).comp
          ((L.symm : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).comp (DY.comp (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)))) z := by
      intro i
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp z
        ((L.symm : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).hasFDerivAt.comp z hcomp)
    have hterm : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z' => Real.sqrt (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z').det *
          ((Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ • L.symm (X (y₀ + L z'))) i) z (e i) =
        (c * |D|) * (L.symm (DY (L (e i)))) i := by
      intro i
      rw [hfun i, ((hcomp2 i).const_mul (c * |D|)).fderiv]
      simp
    have hterm2 : ∀ k : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y k) (y₀ + L z) (e k) = (DY (e k)) k := by
      intro k
      have h : HasFDerivAt (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y k)
          ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp DY) (y₀ + L z) := by
        have := (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp (y₀ + L z) hYd
        convert this using 1
      rw [h.fderiv]; simp
    have htr : ∀ f : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3, LinearMap.trace ℝ E3 f = ∑ i : Fin 3, (f (e i)) i := by
      intro f
      rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace ℝ (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis]
      simp [Matrix.trace, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    have htrace : ∑ i : Fin 3, (L.symm (DY (L (e i)))) i = ∑ k : Fin 3, (DY (e k)) k := by
      have h1 := htr (((L.symm : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) ∘ₗ ((DY : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) ∘ₗ
        ((L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)))
      have h2 := htr (DY : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)
      have h3 : LinearMap.trace ℝ E3 (((L.symm : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) ∘ₗ
          ((DY : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) ∘ₗ ((L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3))) =
          LinearMap.trace ℝ E3 (DY : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) := by
        rw [LinearMap.trace_comp_comm', LinearMap.comp_assoc]
        have hid : ((L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) ∘ₗ
            ((L.symm : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) = LinearMap.id := by
          ext x; simp
        rw [hid, LinearMap.comp_id]
      rw [h3] at h1
      rw [h1] at h2
      simpa using h2
    simp only [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hterm i), Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hterm2 k),
      ← htrace, Finset.mul_sum]
  
  have s4 : ∀ F' : Set E3, MeasurableSet F' → ∀ f : E3 → ℝ,
      ∫ z in (fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F', |(L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).det| * f (y₀ + L z) =
        ∫ y in F', f y := by
    intro F' hF' f
    have hm : MeasurableSet ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F') := hF'.preimage hφc.measurable
    have h := MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hm
      (f := fun w => y₀ + L w) (f' := fun _ => (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3))
      (fun x _ => ((L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).hasFDerivAt.const_add y₀).hasFDerivWithinAt)
      (fun a _ b _ hab => L.injective (add_left_cancel hab)) f
    have himg : (fun w => y₀ + L w) '' ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F') = F' := by
      apply Set.image_preimage_eq
      intro y
      exact ⟨L.symm (y - y₀), by simp⟩
    rw [himg] at h
    rw [h]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  
  have s5 : ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → tsupport X ⊆ U →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y) := by
    intro X hX hXU
    have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := by
      have : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y => G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2
          - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2
          + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0 + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1
          - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
        funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
      rw [this]
      have h := hG
      fun_prop (disch := assumption)
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport X
    · have hyU := hXU hy
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) y := hdet.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hyU)
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) y :=
        h1.sqrt (hpd y hyU).det_pos.ne'
      exact h2.smul hX.contDiffAt
    · have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy
      have hev' : (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
        simp [hw]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev'
  
  have fwd : ∀ (g : E3 → E3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → g 0 = 0 → ∀ (a : E3) (M : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3)
      (X : E3 → E3) (V : Set E3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ V →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => g (X (a + M z))) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun z => g (X (a + M z))) ∧
        tsupport (fun z => g (X (a + M z))) ⊆ (fun w => a + M w) ⁻¹' V := by
    intro g hg hg0 a M X V hX hXc hXV
    let Φ : E3 ≃ₜ E3 := M.toHomeomorph.trans (Homeomorph.addLeft a)
    have hΦ : (fun z => g (X (a + M z))) = (g ∘ X) ∘ Φ := by
      funext z; rfl
    refine ⟨hg.comp (hX.comp (contDiff_const.add M.contDiff)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hΦ]
      exact (hXc.comp_left hg0).comp_homeomorph Φ
    · rw [hΦ, tsupport_comp_eq_preimage]
      intro z hz
      exact hXV (tsupport_comp_subset hg0 X hz)
  
  have s7 : ∀ (G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F V F' V' : Set E3) (k : ℝ), 0 ≤ k →
      ∀ (T S : (E3 → E3) → (E3 → E3)),
      (∀ X : E3 → E3, (ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ V ∧
          ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →
        (ContDiff ℝ ∞ (T X) ∧ HasCompactSupport (T X) ∧ tsupport (T X) ⊆ V' ∧
          ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H y i j * T X y i * T X y j ≤ 1) ∧
        ∫ y in F', sepDensDiv H (T X) y = k * ∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G X y) →
      (∀ X' : E3 → E3, (ContDiff ℝ ∞ X' ∧ HasCompactSupport X' ∧ tsupport X' ⊆ V' ∧
          ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H y i j * X' y i * X' y j ≤ 1) →
        (ContDiff ℝ ∞ (S X') ∧ HasCompactSupport (S X') ∧ tsupport (S X') ⊆ V ∧
          ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * S X' y i * S X' y j ≤ 1) ∧ T (S X') = X') →
      sepPerG H F' V' = ENNReal.ofReal k * sepPerG G F V := by
    intro G H F V F' V' k hk T S hT hS
    unfold sepPerG
    rw [ENNReal.mul_iSup]
    simp_rw [ENNReal.mul_iSup]
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine iSup₂_le fun X' hX' => ?_
      obtain ⟨hSX, hTS⟩ := hS X' hX'
      have e1 := (hT (S X') hSX).2
      rw [hTS] at e1
      rw [e1, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hk]
      exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun X _ =>
        ENNReal.ofReal k * ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G X y)) (S X') hSX
    · refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hk, ← (hT X hX).2]
      exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun X' _ => ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in F', sepDensDiv H X' y))
        (T X) (hT X hX).1
  
  have P1 : ∀ F' : Set E3, MeasurableSet F' → ∀ V : Set E3, V ⊆ U →
      sepPerG (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
          ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F') ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' V) =
        ENNReal.ofReal c * sepPerG G F' V := by
    intro F' hF' V hVU
    apply s7 G (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) F' V _ _ c hc.le
      (fun X z => (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ • L.symm (X (y₀ + L z)))
      (fun X' y => Real.sqrt c • L (X' (L.symm (y - y₀))))
    · rintro X ⟨hX, hXc, hXV, hXn⟩
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := fwd (fun v => (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ • L.symm v)
        (L.symm.contDiff.const_smul _) (by simp) y₀ L X V hX hXc hXV
      refine ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · intro z
        rw [s2 z]
        have hLT : L ((Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ • L.symm (X (y₀ + L z))) =
            (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ • X (y₀ + L z) := by simp
        rw [hLT]
        have hcs : c * ((Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹) = 1 := by
          rw [← mul_inv, hss, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne']
        have key : c * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G (y₀ + L z) k l *
            ((Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ • X (y₀ + L z)) k * ((Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ • X (y₀ + L z)) l =
            (c * ((Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹)) * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
              G (y₀ + L z) k l * X (y₀ + L z) k * X (y₀ + L z) l := by
          simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
        rw [key, hcs, one_mul]
        exact hXn _
      · have hYd : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y) y :=
          fun y => (s5 X hX (hXV.trans hVU)).differentiable (by simp) y
        have hpt : ∀ z, sepDensDiv (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
            (fun z => (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ • L.symm (X (y₀ + L z))) z =
            c * (|(L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).det| * sepDensDiv G X (y₀ + L z)) := by
          intro z
          rw [s3 X z (hYd _)]
          ring
        simp_rw [hpt]
        rw [integral_const_mul, s4 F' hF' (sepDensDiv G X)]
    · rintro X' ⟨hX', hX'c, hX'V, hX'n⟩
      have hTS : (fun z => (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹ • L.symm
          ((fun y => Real.sqrt c • L (X' (L.symm (y - y₀)))) (y₀ + L z))) = X' := by
        funext z
        simp [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs.ne']
      have hSeq : (fun y => Real.sqrt c • L (X' (L.symm (y - y₀)))) =
          fun y => (fun v => Real.sqrt c • L v) (X' (-(L.symm y₀) + L.symm y)) := by
        funext y
        simp only [map_sub, neg_add_eq_sub]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := fwd (fun v => Real.sqrt c • L v)
        (L.contDiff.const_smul _) (by simp) (-(L.symm y₀)) L.symm X'
        ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' V) hX' hX'c hX'V
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, hTS⟩
      · rw [hSeq]; exact h1
      · rw [hSeq]; exact h2
      · rw [hSeq]
        intro y hy
        have := h3 hy
        simpa using this
      · intro y
        have hy : y₀ + L (L.symm (y - y₀)) = y := by simp
        have h := hX'n (L.symm (y - y₀))
        rw [s2, hy] at h
        have key : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j *
            (Real.sqrt c • L (X' (L.symm (y - y₀)))) i *
            (Real.sqrt c • L (X' (L.symm (y - y₀)))) j =
            (Real.sqrt c * Real.sqrt c) * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G y k l *
              (L (X' (L.symm (y - y₀)))) k * (L (X' (L.symm (y - y₀)))) l := by
          simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
        show ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j *
            (Real.sqrt c • L (X' (L.symm (y - y₀)))) i *
            (Real.sqrt c • L (X' (L.symm (y - y₀)))) j ≤ 1
        rw [key, hss]
        exact h
  
  have s8 : sepIsPerMin G F U → sepIsPerMin (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U) := by
    rintro ⟨hFm, hfin, hloc⟩
    let Φ : E3 ≃ₜ E3 := L.toHomeomorph.trans (Homeomorph.addLeft y₀)
    have hΦs : ∀ y, y₀ + L (Φ.symm y) = y := fun y => Φ.apply_symm_apply y
    have hΦs' : ∀ z, Φ.symm (y₀ + L z) = z := fun z => Φ.symm_apply_apply z
    have hpre : ∀ S : Set E3, (fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' (Φ.symm ⁻¹' S) = S := by
      intro S; ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, hΦs']
    have key : ∀ V' : Set E3, IsOpen V' → IsCompact (closure V') →
        closure V' ⊆ (fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U →
        IsOpen (Φ.symm ⁻¹' V') ∧ IsCompact (closure (Φ.symm ⁻¹' V')) ∧
          closure (Φ.symm ⁻¹' V') ⊆ U := by
      intro V' hV' hcpt hsub
      have hcl : closure (Φ.symm ⁻¹' V') = Φ.symm ⁻¹' closure V' :=
        (Φ.symm.preimage_closure V').symm
      refine ⟨hV'.preimage Φ.symm.continuous, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hcl]; exact Φ.symm.isCompact_preimage.mpr hcpt
      · rw [hcl]
        intro y hy
        have := hsub hy
        simp only [Set.mem_preimage, hΦs] at this
        exact this
    refine ⟨hFm.preimage hφc.measurable, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro V' hV' hcpt hsub
      obtain ⟨hVo, hVc, hVU⟩ := key V' hV' hcpt hsub
      rw [← hpre V', P1 F hFm _ (subset_closure.trans hVU)]
      exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top (hfin _ hVo hVc hVU)
    · intro F'' V' K' hF'' hV' hcpt hsub hK' hKV hsd
      obtain ⟨hVo, hVc, hVU⟩ := key V' hV' hcpt hsub
      have hF'm : MeasurableSet (Φ.symm ⁻¹' F'') :=
        hF''.preimage Φ.symm.continuous.measurable
      have hFF : Φ.symm ⁻¹' ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) = F := by
        ext y
        simp only [Set.mem_preimage, hΦs]
      have hsd' : symmDiff F (Φ.symm ⁻¹' F'') ⊆ Φ.symm ⁻¹' K' := by
        rw [← hFF, ← Set.preimage_symmDiff]
        exact Set.preimage_mono hsd
      have hle := hloc (Φ.symm ⁻¹' F'') _ (Φ.symm ⁻¹' K') hF'm hVo hVc hVU
        (Φ.symm.isCompact_preimage.mpr hK') (Set.preimage_mono hKV) hsd'
      have e1 := P1 F hFm _ (subset_closure.trans hVU)
      have e2 := P1 _ hF'm _ (subset_closure.trans hVU)
      rw [hpre V'] at e1 e2
      rw [hpre F''] at e2
      rw [e1, e2]
      exact mul_le_mul_left' hle _
  exact ⟨fun V hV => P1 F hF V hV, s1.1, s1.2.1, s1.2.2, s8⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (h0U : (0 : E3) ∈ U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (hI : G 0 = 1) (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) :
    ∃ ε r₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ (r : ℝ) (ν : E3), 0 < r → r < r₀ → ‖ν‖ = 1 →
      volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | r • z ∈ F} {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0} ∩
        Metric.ball 0 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε →
      ∃ (f : E3 → ℝ) (N : Set E3), ContDiff ℝ 1 f ∧ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ N, fderiv ℝ f z ≠ 0) ∧ volume ((N ∩ {z | f z < 0}) \ F) = 0 ∧
        volume (N ∩ {z | 0 < f z} ∩ F) = 0

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (h0U : (0 : E3) ∈ U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (hI : G 0 = 1) (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) :
    ∃ ε r₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ (r : ℝ) (ν : E3), 0 < r → r < r₀ → ‖ν‖ = 1 →
      volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | r • z ∈ F} {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0} ∩
        Metric.ball 0 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε →
      ∃ (f : E3 → ℝ) (N : Set E3), ContDiff ℝ 1 f ∧ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ N, fderiv ℝ f z ≠ 0) ∧ volume ((N ∩ {z | f z < 0}) \ F) = 0 ∧
        volume (N ∩ {z | 0 < f z} ∩ F) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨η₁, c₀, hη₁, hc₀, hc₀1, hdens⟩ := sepPerMin_density_lower
  obtain ⟨η₀, ε₀, θ, C₀, hη₀, hε₀, hθ, hθ2, hC₀, himp⟩ := sepPerMin_improve_flatness
  
  obtain ⟨τ, hτdef⟩ : ∃ τ : ℝ,
      τ = min (ε₀ / 8) (min (θ / 128) (min (1 / (128 * (C₀ + 1))) (1 / 16))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hC1 : 0 < 128 * (C₀ + 1) := by linarith
  have hτ : 0 < τ := by
    rw [hτdef]
    exact lt_min (by linarith) (lt_min (by linarith) (lt_min (div_pos one_pos hC1) (by norm_num)))
  have hτε : τ ≤ ε₀ / 8 := by rw [hτdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hτθ : τ ≤ θ / 128 := by rw [hτdef]; exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hτC : τ ≤ 1 / (128 * (C₀ + 1)) := by
    rw [hτdef]
    exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hτ16 : τ ≤ 1 / 16 := by
    rw [hτdef]
    exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  have hCτ : 16 * C₀ * τ ≤ 1 / 8 := by
    have h1 : τ * (128 * (C₀ + 1)) ≤ 1 := (le_div_iff₀ hC1).1 hτC
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨τ₀, hτ₀def⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = 8 * τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hτ₀ : 0 < τ₀ := by rw [hτ₀def]; linarith
  have hτ₀θ : τ₀ ≤ θ / 16 := by rw [hτ₀def]; linarith
  have hτ₀ε : τ₀ ≤ ε₀ := by rw [hτ₀def]; linarith
  
  obtain ⟨R0', hR0', hballU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hU 0 h0U
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀def⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = R0' / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR₀ : 0 < R₀ := by rw [hR₀def]; linarith
  have hcbU : Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) R₀ ⊆ U :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by rw [hR₀def]; linarith)).trans hballU
  
  have hbd : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) R₀,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) y‖ ≤ C := by
    intro i j
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) y) U :=
      (hG i j).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) R₀).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hc.mono hcbU)
  choose Cb hCb using hbd
  obtain ⟨M', hM'⟩ := Finite.exists_le (fun p : Fin 3 × Fin 3 => Cb p.1 p.2)
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = max M' 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by rw [hMdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hM : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) R₀, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) y‖ ≤ M := by
    intro y hy i j
    rw [hMdef]
    exact (hCb i j y hy).trans ((hM' (i, j)).trans (le_max_left _ _))
  
  have hη : 0 < min η₁ η₀ := lt_min hη₁ hη₀
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (0 : E3), ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ min η₁ η₀ := by

    obtain ⟨n, hn1, hnν, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hiter x hx hxb k
    refine ⟨n, hn1, ?_, h1, h2, h3⟩

    have h4 : 2 * C₀ * τ₀ * (1 - (1 / 2) ^ k) ≤ 2 * C₀ * τ₀ := by nlinarith
    have h5 : 2 * C₀ * τ₀ ≤ 1 / 8 := by rw [hτ₀def]; linarith
    linarith
  exact sepSlabDecay_C1_levelset F ν θ τ₀ (r / 4) hν hθ hθ2 hτ₀ hτ₀θ (by positivity) h0 hdec

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro ε hε r₁ hr₁
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρU⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.1 (hU.mem_nhds h0U)
  have hm0 : 0 < min r₁ ρ := lt_min hr₁ hρ
  have hmr₁ : min r₁ ρ ≤ r₁ := min_le_left _ _
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ k, r k = min r₁ ρ / ((k : ℝ) + 2) := ⟨_, fun k => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ k, R k = (ρ / min r₁ ρ) * ((k : ℝ) + 2) := ⟨_, fun k => rfl⟩
  have hk2 : ∀ k : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 2 := fun k => by positivity
  have hrpos : ∀ k, 0 < r k := fun k => by rw [hr]; exact div_pos hm0 (hk2 k)
  have hrlt : ∀ k, r k < r₁ := by
    intro k
    rw [hr]
    have h1k : (1 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 2 := by
      have := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k
      linarith
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (div_lt_self hm0 h1k) hmr₁
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ) + 2) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 2 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hrt : Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have e : r = fun k : ℕ => min r₁ ρ / ((k : ℝ) + 2) := funext hr
    rw [e]
    exact Tendsto.div_atTop tendsto_const_nhds h2
  have hRt : Tendsto R atTop atTop := by
    have e : R = fun k : ℕ => (ρ / min r₁ ρ) * ((k : ℝ) + 2) := funext hR
    rw [e]
    exact Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (div_pos hρ hm0) h2
  have hrR : ∀ k, r k * R k = ρ := by
    intro k
    rw [hr, hR]
    field_simp [hm0.ne', (hk2 k).ne']
  have hballR : ∀ k, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (R k), r k • z ∈ U := by
    intro k z hz
    apply hρU
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hz ⊢
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hrpos k)]
    have : r k * ‖z‖ < r k * R k := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz (hrpos k)
    rw [hrR k] at this
    exact this
  
  have hrestr : ∀ (G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (S W W' : Set E3),
      sepIsPerMin G' S W → W' ⊆ W → sepIsPerMin G' S W' := by
    intro G' S W W' h hW
    exact ⟨h.1, fun V hV hc hcl => h.2.1 V hV hc (hcl.trans hW),
      fun F' V K hF' hV hc hcl hK hKV hsd => h.2.2 F' V K hF' hV hc (hcl.trans hW) hK hKV hsd⟩
  have hmink : ∀ k, sepIsPerMin (fun z => G (r k • z)) {z : E3 | r k • z ∈ F}
      (Metric.ball 0 (R k)) := fun k =>
    hrestr _ _ _ _ (sepRescale G F U hU hG hsymm hpd hmin (r k) (hrpos k)).1
      (fun z hz => hballR k z hz)
  have hGk : ∀ k (i j : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G (r k • y) i j)
      (Metric.ball 0 (R k)) := by
    intro k i j
    exact (hG i j).comp (contDiff_const_smul (r k)).contDiffOn (fun z hz => hballR k z hz)
  have hcont : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (fun y => G y i j) 0 := fun i j =>
    (hG i j).continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds h0U)
  have hconv : ∀ ρ' : ℝ, 0 < ρ' → ∀ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' → ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0:E3) ρ', ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        |G (r k • y) i j - (if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε' := by
    intro ρ' hρ' ε' hε'
    have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (0:E3), ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        |G y i j - (if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)| < ε' := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all]
      intro i
      rw [Filter.eventually_all]
      intro j
      have h := Metric.tendsto_nhds.1 (hcont i j) ε' hε'
      filter_upwards [h] with y hy
      simp only [Real.dist_eq, hI, Matrix.one_apply] at hy
      exact hy
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδP⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.1 hev
    have hrt' : Tendsto (fun k => r k * ρ') atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have := hrt.mul_const ρ'
      rwa [zero_mul] at this
    filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.1 hrt').2 δ hδ] with k hk
    intro y hy i j
    have hyd : dist (r k • y) 0 < δ := by
      rw [dist_zero_right, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hrpos k)]
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hy
      calc r k * ‖y‖ ≤ r k * ρ' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.le (hrpos k).le
        _ < δ := hk
    exact (hδP hyd i j).le
  have hpre0 : ∀ c : ℝ, c ≠ 0 → ∀ S : Set E3, volume S = 0 →
      volume ((fun x : E3 => c • x) ⁻¹' S) = 0 := by
    intro c hc S hS
    rw [Measure.addHaar_preimage_smul volume hc, hS, mul_zero]
  have hnhds : ∀ k, ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), (fun x : E3 => (r k)⁻¹ • x) ⁻¹' N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3) := by
    intro k N hN
    apply (continuous_const_smul (r k)⁻¹).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
    show N ∈ 𝓝 ((r k)⁻¹ • (0:E3))
    rw [smul_zero]
    exact hN
  have h1k : ∀ k, ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ {z : E3 | r k • z ∈ F}) ≠ 0 := by
    intro k N hN hzero
    apply h1 _ (hnhds k N hN)
    have h := hpre0 (r k)⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero (hrpos k).ne') _ hzero
    refine le_antisymm (le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h.le) (zero_le _)
    rintro x ⟨hxN, hxF⟩
    refine ⟨hxN, ?_⟩
    show ¬ (r k • (r k)⁻¹ • x ∈ F)
    rw [smul_inv_smul₀ (hrpos k).ne']
    exact hxF
  have h0k : ∀ k, ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ {z : E3 | r k • z ∈ F}) ≠ 0 := by
    intro k N hN hzero
    apply h0 _ (hnhds k N hN)
    have h := hpre0 (r k)⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero (hrpos k).ne') _ hzero
    refine le_antisymm (le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h.le) (zero_le _)
    rintro x ⟨hxN, hxF⟩
    refine ⟨hxN, ?_⟩
    show r k • (r k)⁻¹ • x ∈ F
    rw [smul_inv_smul₀ (hrpos k).ne']
    exact hxF
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, K, hψ, hC1, hKmin, hK1, hK0, hC4⟩ := sepPerMin_blowup_compact
    (fun k z => G (r k • z)) (fun k => {z : E3 | r k • z ∈ F}) R hRt hGk
    (fun k y i j => hsymm _ i j) (fun k y hy => hpd _ (hballR k y hy)) hconv hmink h1k h0k
  obtain ⟨Λ, r₀, hr₀, hfin, hmono⟩ :=
    sepPerMin_monotonicity G F U hU h0U hG hsymm hpd hI hmin
  obtain ⟨Θ₀, hΘ₀, hlim⟩ := sepDensityRatio_limit
    (fun t => sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 t))
    Λ r₀ hr₀ hfin hmono
  have hrψ : Tendsto (fun k => r (ψ k)) atTop (𝓝 0) := hrt.comp hψ.tendsto_atTop
  have hseq : ∀ ρ' : ℝ, 0 < ρ' → Tendsto (fun k => sepPerG
      (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) {z : E3 | r (ψ k) • z ∈ F} (Metric.ball 0 ρ'))
      atTop (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal (Θ₀ * ρ' ^ 2))) := by
    intro ρ' hρ'
    have h := hlim (fun k => r (ψ k)) (fun k => hrpos _) hrψ ρ' hρ'
    refine Tendsto.congr (fun k => ?_) h
    exact ((sepRescale G F U hU hG hsymm hpd hmin (r (ψ k)) (hrpos _)).2 ρ' hρ').symm
  have hae : ∀ᵐ ρ' ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), 0 < ρ' →
      sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 ρ') =
        ENNReal.ofReal (Θ₀ * ρ' ^ 2) := by
    filter_upwards [hC4] with ρ' hρ' hpos
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hρ' hpos) (hseq ρ' hpos)
  have hall := sepPerG_ball_eq_of_ae K Θ₀ hΘ₀ hae
  
  have hcone := sepEuclMin_cone_of_const_density K hKmin Θ₀ hall
  obtain ⟨ν, hν, hKH⟩ := sepEuclMinCone_halfspace K hKmin hcone hK1 hK0
  have hev := (tendsto_order.1 (hC1 1 one_pos)).2 (ENNReal.ofReal ε) (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.2 hε)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hev.exists
  have hk' : volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | r (ψ k) • z ∈ F} K ∩ Metric.ball 0 1) <
      ENNReal.ofReal ε := hk
  refine ⟨r (ψ k), ν, hrpos _, hrlt _, hν, ?_⟩
  calc volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | r (ψ k) • z ∈ F} {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0} ∩
          Metric.ball 0 1)
      ≤ volume ((symmDiff {z : E3 | r (ψ k) • z ∈ F} K ∩ Metric.ball 0 1) ∪
          symmDiff K {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0}) := by
        apply measure_mono
        rintro x ⟨hx, hxB⟩
        rcases symmDiff_triangle _ K _ hx with h | h
        · exact Or.inl ⟨h, hxB⟩
        · exact Or.inr h
    _ ≤ volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | r (ψ k) • z ∈ F} K ∩ Metric.ball 0 1) +
          volume (symmDiff K {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0}) := measure_union_le _ _
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
        rw [hKH, add_zero]
        exact hk'.le

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hea : ∀ a : Fin 3, (e a) a = 1 := fun a => by simp [e]
  have hPa : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (z : E3), (sepPlaneProj a z) a = 0 := fun a z => by
    simp [sepPlaneProj, e]
  have hPsub : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x y : E3),
      sepPlaneProj a (x - y) = sepPlaneProj a x - sepPlaneProj a y := fun a x y => by
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]; abel
  have hPadd : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x : E3) (t : ℝ), sepPlaneProj a (x + t • e a) = sepPlaneProj a x :=
    fun a x t => by
      simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, add_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      simp [e]
  have hdec : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (z : E3), z = sepPlaneProj a z + (z a) • e a := fun a z => by
    simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hcadd : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x : E3) (t : ℝ), (x + t • e a) a = x a + t := fun a x t => by
    simp [e]
  have hen : ∀ a : Fin 3, ‖e a‖ = 1 := fun a => by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e a) ≠ 0 := by

    push_neg at hcon
    apply hdf
    ext v
    have hv : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
      ext j; fin_cases j <;> simp [e]
    rw [hv]
    simp [hcon]
  
  have key : ∀ f₁ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 f₁ → f₁ y₀ = 0 → 0 < fderiv ℝ f₁ y₀ (e a) →
      ∃ (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 u ∧
        u (sepPlaneProj a y₀) = y₀ a ∧ sepCyl a y₀ r δ ⊆ U ∩ N ∧
        ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r δ, (f₁ z < 0 ↔ z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)) ∧
          (0 < f₁ z ↔ u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a) := by
    intro f₁ hf₁ hf₁0 hc
    
    let Lp : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - (EuclideanSpace.proj a).smulRight (e a)
    have hLp : ∀ z, Lp z = sepPlaneProj a z := fun z => rfl
    let D : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := fderiv ℝ f₁ y₀
    let T₀ : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := Lp + D.smulRight (e a)
    have hT₀ : ∀ v, T₀ v = sepPlaneProj a v + D v • e a := fun v => rfl
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦdef⟩ : ∃ Φ : E3 → E3, Φ = fun z => sepPlaneProj a z + f₁ z • e a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΦeq : Φ = fun z => Lp z + f₁ z • e a := by
      rw [hΦdef]; funext z; rw [hLp]
    have hΦC : ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ := by
      rw [hΦeq]; exact Lp.contDiff.add (hf₁.smul contDiff_const)
    have hΦd : HasFDerivAt Φ T₀ y₀ := by
      rw [hΦeq]
      exact Lp.hasFDerivAt.add ((hf₁.differentiable one_ne_zero y₀).hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e a))

      rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
      intro v hv
      have hv' : sepPlaneProj a v + D v • e a = 0 := hv
      have h1 : D v = 0 := by
        have := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w a) hv'
        simpa [hPa, hea] using this
      rw [h1, zero_smul, add_zero] at hv'

        rw [hv', zero_add]

        rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← map_smul, ← h2]; exact h1
      have h4 : v a = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h3 with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h (ne_of_gt hc)
      rw [h2, h4, zero_smul]

      (LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo (T₀ : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) hinj).toContinuousLinearEquiv
    have hTT : (T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) = T₀ := by ext v; rfl
    have hΦd' : HasFDerivAt Φ (T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) y₀ := by rw [hTT]; exact hΦd
    have hn : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
    have hΨC := hΦC.contDiffAt.to_localInverse hΦd' hn
    have hstrict := hΦC.contDiffAt.hasStrictFDerivAt' hΦd' hn
    obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨdef⟩ : ∃ Ψ : E3 → E3, Ψ = hΦC.contDiffAt.localInverse hΦd' hn := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΨinv : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (Φ y₀), Φ (Ψ w) = w := by
      rw [hΨdef]; exact hstrict.eventually_right_inverse
    have hΨy₀ : Ψ (Φ y₀) = y₀ := by
      rw [hΨdef]; exact hstrict.localInverse_apply_image
    rw [← hΨdef] at hΨC
    have hΦy₀ : Φ y₀ = sepPlaneProj a y₀ := by simp [hΦdef, hf₁0]
    rw [hΦy₀] at hΨC hΨinv hΨy₀
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hηinv⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hΨinv

    have hvC : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 v (sepPlaneProj a y₀) := by
      rw [hvdef]
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj a).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp _ hΨC

      intro z hz
      have hx : Φ (Ψ (sepPlaneProj a z)) = sepPlaneProj a z := hηinv (by rwa [dist_eq_norm])
      obtain ⟨x, hxdef⟩ : ∃ x, x = Ψ (sepPlaneProj a z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hxdef] at hx
      have hfx : f₁ x = 0 := by
        have := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w a) hx
        simpa [hΦdef, hPa, hea] using this

        have h := hx

        simp only

    let χ : ContDiffBump (sepPlaneProj a y₀) := ⟨ε / 4, ε / 2, by positivity, by linarith⟩

      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro w

      rw [hudef]
      simp only
      rw [χ.one_of_mem_closedBall (by rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]; exact le_of_lt hw),

    have hhc : Continuous (fun z => fderiv ℝ f₁ z (e a)) :=

    have hW : U ∩ N ∩ {z | 0 < fderiv ℝ f₁ z (e a)} ∈ 𝓝 y₀ :=
      Filter.inter_mem (Filter.inter_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy₀) hN)
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const hhc).mem_nhds hc)
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hW
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hr₀c⟩ :=

    obtain ⟨r, hrdef⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = min r₀ (min η (min (ε / 4) (ρ / 2))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hr : 0 < r := by
      rw [hrdef]; exact lt_min hr₀ (lt_min hη (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)))
    have hrr₀ : r ≤ r₀ := by rw [hrdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hrη : r ≤ η := by
      rw [hrdef]; exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hrε : r ≤ ε / 4 := by
      rw [hrdef]
      exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hrρ : r ≤ ρ / 2 := by
      rw [hrdef]

    have hcyl : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r (ρ / 2),

      have hγC : ∀ τ, z a < τ → τ < z' a → γ τ ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r (ρ / 2) := by
        intro τ h1 h2
        obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
        obtain ⟨hz1', hz2'⟩ := hz'
        have hγa : (γ τ) a = τ := by rw [hγdef]; simp only; rw [hcadd]; ring
        have hγP : sepPlaneProj a (γ τ) = sepPlaneProj a z := by rw [hγdef]; simp only; rw [hPadd]

        · rw [hγa]
          rw [abs_lt] at hz2 hz2' ⊢
          constructor <;> linarith [hz2.1, hz2'.2]
      obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξeq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun τ => f₁ (γ τ))
        (fun τ => fderiv ℝ f₁ (γ τ) (e a)) hlt
        (fun τ _ => (hγd τ).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (fun τ _ => hγd τ)
      have hp : 0 < fderiv ℝ f₁ (γ ξ) (e a) := (hCball _ (hγC ξ hξ.1 hξ.2)).2
      simp only at hξeq
      rw [hξeq, hγz, hγz'] at hp
      have := (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (sub_pos.mpr hlt)).mp hp
      linarith
    
    have hsign : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r (ρ / 2), (f₁ z < 0 ↔ z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)) ∧
        (0 < f₁ z ↔ u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a) := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨hzρ, hzr⟩ := hcyl z hz
      obtain ⟨t, htdef⟩ : ∃ t, t = u (sepPlaneProj a z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g : E3, g = z + (t - z a) • e a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hga : g a = t := by rw [hgdef, hcadd]; ring
      have hgP : sepPlaneProj a g = sepPlaneProj a z := by rw [hgdef, hPadd]
      have hg' : g = sepPlaneProj a z + t • e a := by
        rw [hgdef]; simp only [sepPlaneProj, sub_smul]; abel
      have htv : t = v (sepPlaneProj a z) := by
        rw [htdef]; exact hueq _ (lt_of_lt_of_le hzr hrε)
      have hfg : f₁ g = 0 := by
        rw [hg', htv]; exact hvzero z (lt_of_lt_of_le hzr hrη)
      have htd : |t - y₀ a| < ρ / 2 := by
        have h := hr₀c (x := sepPlaneProj a z) (by rw [dist_eq_norm]; linarith)
        rw [Real.dist_eq, hu0] at h
        rw [htdef]; exact h
      have hgC : g ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r (ρ / 2) := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [hPsub, hgP, ← hPsub]; exact hz.1
        · rw [hga]; exact htd
      have hzg : z a = t → z = g := by
        intro h
        rw [hg', ← h]; exact hdec a z
      rw [← htdef]
      rcases lt_trichotomy (z a) t with h | h | h
      · have := hmono z hz g hgC hgP.symm (by rw [hga]; exact h)
        rw [hfg] at this
        exact ⟨⟨fun _ => h, fun _ => this⟩, ⟨fun h' => absurd this (not_lt.mpr h'.le),
          fun h' => absurd h (not_lt.mpr h'.le)⟩⟩
      · have h0 : f₁ z = 0 := by rw [hzg h]; exact hfg
        rw [h0]
        exact ⟨⟨fun h' => absurd h' (lt_irrefl _), fun h' => absurd h (ne_of_lt h')⟩,
          ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (lt_irrefl _), fun h' => absurd h.symm (ne_of_lt h')⟩⟩
      · have := hmono g hgC z hz hgP (by rw [hga]; exact h)
        rw [hfg] at this
        exact ⟨⟨fun h' => absurd this (not_lt.mpr h'.le), fun h' => absurd h (not_lt.mpr h'.le)⟩,
          ⟨fun _ => h, fun _ => this⟩⟩
    exact ⟨u, r, ρ / 2, hr, by positivity, huC, hu0,
      fun z hz => (hCball z hz).1, hsign⟩
  
  have sides : ∀ (C A B : Set E3), C ⊆ N → (∀ z ∈ C, z ∈ A → f z < 0) →
      (∀ z ∈ C, z ∈ B → 0 < f z) →
      volume ((C ∩ A) \ F) = 0 ∧ volume (C ∩ B ∩ F) = 0 := by
    intro C A B hCN hA hB
    constructor
    · refine measure_mono_null ?_ hneg
      rintro z ⟨⟨hzC, hzA⟩, hzF⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hCN hzC, hA z hzC hzA⟩, hzF⟩
    · refine measure_mono_null ?_ hpos
      rintro z ⟨⟨hzC, hzB⟩, hzF⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hCN hzC, hB z hzC hzB⟩, hzF⟩
  
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ha with hlt | hgt
  · have hd : fderiv ℝ (fun z => -f z) y₀ (e a) = -(fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e a)) := by
      have hfn : (fun z => -f z) = -f := rfl
      rw [hfn, fderiv_neg]; rfl
    obtain ⟨u, r, δ, hr, hδ, huC, hu0, hCsub, hs⟩ :=
      key (fun z => -f z) hf.neg (by simp [hf0]) (by rw [hd]; linarith)
    refine ⟨a, u, r, δ, hr, hδ, huC, hu0, fun z hz => (hCsub hz).1, Or.inr ?_⟩
    refine sides _ _ _ (fun z hz => (hCsub hz).2) ?_ ?_
    · intro z hz hzA
      have h := (hs z hz).2.2 hzA
      simp only at h
      linarith
    · intro z hz hzB
      have h := (hs z hz).1.2 hzB
      simp only at h
      linarith
  · obtain ⟨u, r, δ, hr, hδ, huC, hu0, hCsub, hs⟩ := key f hf hf0 hgt
    refine ⟨a, u, r, δ, hr, hδ, huC, hu0, fun z hz => (hCsub hz).1, Or.inl ?_⟩
    refine sides _ _ _ (fun z hz => (hCsub hz).2) ?_ ?_
    · intro z hz hzA
      exact (hs z hz).1.2 hzA
    · intro z hz hzB
      exact (hs z hz).2.2 hzB

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (E : Set E3) (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Set E3) (hdisj : Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (A k) (A l))) :
    ∑ k, sepPerG G E (A k) ≤ sepPerG G E (⋃ k, A k)

signature.name: sepPerG_sum_le
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (E : Set E3) (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Set E3) (hdisj : Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (A k) (A l))) :
    ∑ k, sepPerG G E (A k) ≤ sepPerG G E (⋃ k, A k)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s2 : ∀ (ι : Fin n → Type) (_hne : ∀ k, Nonempty (ι k)) (f : (k : Fin n) → ι k → ENNReal)
      (T : ENNReal), (∀ σ : (k : Fin n) → ι k, ∑ k, f k (σ k) ≤ T) → ∑ k, ⨆ i, f k i ≤ T := by
    intro ι hne f T h
    let σ₀ : (k : Fin n) → ι k := fun k => Classical.choice (hne k)
    have ha : ∀ k, ⨆ i, f k i ≤ ⨆ σ : ((k : Fin n) → ι k), f k (σ k) := by
      intro k
      refine iSup_le fun i => le_iSup_of_le (Function.update σ₀ k i) ?_
      simp
    have hb : ∑ k, ⨆ σ : ((k : Fin n) → ι k), f k (σ k) =
        ⨆ σ : ((k : Fin n) → ι k), ∑ k, f k (σ k) := by
      refine ENNReal.finsetSum_iSup (fun σ τ => ?_)
      refine ⟨fun a => if f a (σ a) ≤ f a (τ a) then τ a else σ a, fun a => ?_⟩
      by_cases hle : f a (σ a) ≤ f a (τ a)
      · simp only [if_pos hle]; exact ⟨hle, le_rfl⟩
      · simp only [if_neg hle]; exact ⟨le_rfl, le_of_not_ge hle⟩
    calc ∑ k, ⨆ i, f k i ≤ ∑ k, ⨆ σ : ((k : Fin n) → ι k), f k (σ k) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ha k
      _ = _ := hb
      _ ≤ T := iSup_le h
  
  have densCongr : ∀ (X X' : E3 → E3) (y : E3), X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] X' →
      sepDensDiv G X y = sepDensDiv G X' y := by
    intro X X' y h
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have h' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X' z i) := by
      filter_upwards [h] with z hz
      rw [hz]
    rw [h'.fderiv_eq]
  have densZero : ∀ (X : E3 → E3) (y : E3), y ∉ tsupport X → sepDensDiv G X y = 0 := by
    intro X y hy
    have hX : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    unfold partialDeriv
    have h : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hX] with z hz
      simp [hz]
    rw [h.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have densZero0 : ∀ y, sepDensDiv G (0 : E3 → E3) y = 0 := fun y => densZero 0 y (by simp)
  
  have s3 : ∀ (Y : Fin n → E3 → E3),
      Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (tsupport (Y k)) (tsupport (Y l))) →
      ∀ y, sepDensDiv G (fun z => ∑ k, Y k z) y = ∑ k, sepDensDiv G (Y k) y := by
    intro Y hd y
    by_cases h : ∃ k, y ∈ tsupport (Y k)
    · obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := h
      have hnot : ∀ l, l ≠ k₀ → y ∉ tsupport (Y l) := fun l hl hy =>
        Set.disjoint_left.mp (hd hl) hy hk₀
      have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ l, l ≠ k₀ → Y l z = 0 := by
        rw [Filter.eventually_all]
        intro l
        by_cases hl : l = k₀
        · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z h => absurd hl h
        · have := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (hnot l hl)
          filter_upwards [this] with z hz _
          simpa using hz
      have hZ : (fun z => ∑ k, Y k z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] Y k₀ := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
        exact Finset.sum_eq_single k₀ (fun l _ hl => hz l hl)
          (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h)
      rw [densCongr _ _ y hZ]
      exact (Finset.sum_eq_single k₀ (fun l _ hl => densZero _ y (hnot l hl))
        (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h)).symm
    · push_neg at h
      have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ l, Y l z = 0 := by
        rw [Filter.eventually_all]
        intro l
        filter_upwards [notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (h l)] with z hz
        simpa using hz
      have hZ : (fun z => ∑ k, Y k z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
        simp [hz]
      rw [densZero _ y (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr hZ)]
      exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l _ => densZero _ y (h l)).symm
  
  have s4 : ∀ (Y : Fin n → E3 → E3), (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (Y k) ∧
      tsupport (Y k) ⊆ A k ∧ ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Y k y i * Y k y j ≤ 1) →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ k, Y k z) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun z => ∑ k, Y k z) ∧
      tsupport (fun z => ∑ k, Y k z) ⊆ ⋃ k, A k ∧
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (∑ k, Y k y) i * (∑ k, Y k y) j ≤ 1 := by
    intro Y hY
    have hvan : ∀ x, x ∉ ⋃ k, tsupport (Y k) → (∑ k, Y k x) = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ =>
        image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport fun hk => hx (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k, hk⟩)
    have hKc : IsClosed (⋃ k, tsupport (Y k)) :=
      isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun k => isClosed_tsupport _
    have hKk : IsCompact (⋃ k, tsupport (Y k)) := isCompact_iUnion fun k => (hY k).2.1.isCompact
    refine ⟨ContDiff.sum fun k _ => (hY k).1, HasCompactSupport.intro' hKk hKc hvan, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine (closure_minimal ?_ hKc).trans (Set.iUnion_mono fun k => (hY k).2.2.1)
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxK
      exact hx (hvan x hxK)
    · intro y
      by_cases h : ∃ k, Y k y ≠ 0
      · obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := h
        have hyA : y ∈ A k₀ := (hY k₀).2.2.1 (subset_tsupport _ hk₀)
        have hsum : (∑ k, Y k y) = Y k₀ y := by
          refine Finset.sum_eq_single k₀ (fun l _ hl => ?_) (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h)
          by_contra hne
          have hyl : y ∈ A l := (hY l).2.2.1 (subset_tsupport _ hne)
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hdisj hl) hyl hyA
        rw [hsum]
        exact (hY k₀).2.2.2 y
      · push_neg at h
        have hsum : (∑ k, Y k y) = 0 := Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => h k
        rw [hsum]
        simp
  
  have adm0 : ∀ U : Set E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (0 : E3 → E3) ∧ HasCompactSupport (0 : E3 → E3) ∧
      tsupport (0 : E3 → E3) ⊆ U ∧
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (0 : E3 → E3) y i * (0 : E3 → E3) y j ≤ 1 := by
    intro U
    refine ⟨contDiff_const, HasCompactSupport.zero, by simp, fun y => by simp⟩
  
  have hrw : ∀ k, sepPerG G E (A k) = ⨆ (Y : {X : E3 → E3 // ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧
      HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ A k ∧
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1}),
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G Y.1 y) := by
    intro k
    unfold sepPerG
    exact iSup_subtype'
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => hrw k]
  refine s2 (fun k => {X : E3 → E3 // ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧
      HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ A k ∧
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1})
    (fun k => ⟨⟨0, adm0 _⟩⟩) (fun k Y => ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G Y.1 y)) _ ?_
  intro σ
  show ∑ k, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (σ k).1 y) ≤ _
  
  let a : Fin n → ℝ := fun k => ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (σ k).1 y
  let Y : Fin n → E3 → E3 := fun k => if 0 < a k then (σ k).1 else 0
  have hYpos : ∀ k, 0 < a k → Y k = (σ k).1 := fun k hk => if_pos hk
  have hYneg : ∀ k, ¬ 0 < a k → Y k = 0 := fun k hk => if_neg hk
  have F1 : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (Y k) ∧ tsupport (Y k) ⊆ A k ∧
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Y k y i * Y k y j ≤ 1 := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : 0 < a k
    · rw [hYpos k hk]; exact (σ k).2
    · rw [hYneg k hk]; exact adm0 _
  have F3 : ∀ k, ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (Y k) y = if 0 < a k then a k else 0 := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : 0 < a k
    · rw [if_pos hk, hYpos k hk]
    · rw [if_neg hk, hYneg k hk]
      simp [densZero0]
  have F3n : ∀ k, 0 ≤ ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (Y k) y := by
    intro k
    rw [F3 k]
    split_ifs with hk
    · exact hk.le
    · exact le_rfl
  have F4 : ∀ k, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (σ k).1 y) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (Y k) y) := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : 0 < a k
    · rw [F3 k, if_pos hk]
    · have : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (σ k).1 y) = 0 :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_of_nonpos (not_lt.mp hk)
      rw [this]
      exact zero_le _
  have F5 : ∀ k, Integrable (fun y => sepDensDiv G (Y k) y) (volume.restrict E) := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : 0 < a k
    · rw [hYpos k hk]
      exact Integrable.of_integral_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hk)
    · rw [hYneg k hk]
      have : (fun y => sepDensDiv G (0 : E3 → E3) y) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := funext densZero0
      rw [this]
      exact integrable_zero _ _ _
  have hd : Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (tsupport (Y k)) (tsupport (Y l))) :=
    fun k l hkl => (hdisj hkl).mono (F1 k).2.2.1 (F1 l).2.2.1
  have hZ := s4 Y F1
  have hint : ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (fun z => ∑ k, Y k z) y =
      ∑ k, ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (Y k) y := by
    calc ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (fun z => ∑ k, Y k z) y
        = ∫ y in E, ∑ k, sepDensDiv G (Y k) y := by
          congr 1
          funext y
          exact s3 Y hd y
      _ = _ := integral_finset_sum _ fun k _ => F5 k
  calc ∑ k, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (σ k).1 y)
      ≤ ∑ k, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (Y k) y) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => F4 k
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ k, ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (Y k) y) :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg fun k _ => F3n k).symm
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (fun z => ∑ k, Y k z) y) := by rw [hint]
    _ ≤ sepPerG G E (⋃ k, A k) := by
        unfold sepPerG
        exact le_iSup₂_of_le (fun z => ∑ k, Y k z) hZ le_rfl

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U E A B : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (hAU : A ⊆ U) (hBU : B ⊆ U) :
    sepPerG G E (A ∪ B) ≤ sepPerG G E A + sepPerG G E B

signature.name: sepPerG_union_le
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U E A B : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (hAU : A ⊆ U) (hBU : B ⊆ U) :
    sepPerG G E (A ∪ B) ≤ sepPerG G E A + sepPerG G E B

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i)) ∧
      Continuous (sepDensDiv G X) ∧ HasCompactSupport (sepDensDiv G X) := by
    intro X hX hXc hXU
    have hdetC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) U := by
      have heq : (fun z => (G z).det) = fun z =>
          G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
            - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
            + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0 := by
        funext z; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
      rw [heq]
      have h := hG
      exact (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
        (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
        (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
    have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) U :=
      hdetC.sqrt (fun x hx => (hdet x hx).ne')
    have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) := fun i =>
      (contDiff_piLp _).1 hX i
    have hzero : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → ∀ i : Fin 3,
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro y hy i
      have hX0 : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy
      filter_upwards [hX0] with z hz
      simp [hz]
    have hsm : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
      intro i
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ U
      · exact (hsq.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).mul (hcoord i).contDiffAt
      · have hy' : y ∉ tsupport X := fun h => hy (hXU h)
        exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hzero y hy' i)
    refine ⟨hsm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show Continuous fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y (e i)
      refine continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ => ?_
      exact ((hsm i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    · refine HasCompactSupport.mono' hXc ?_
      intro y hy
      by_contra hy'
      apply hy
      show ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y (e i) = 0
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
      rw [(hzero y hy' i).fderiv_eq]
      simp
  
  have s2 : ∀ T : Set E3, IsCompact T → T ⊆ A ∪ B →
      ∃ ψ₁ ψ₂ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ₁ ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ₂ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ₁ x) ∧
        (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ₂ x) ∧ (∀ x, ψ₁ x + ψ₂ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ T, ψ₁ x + ψ₂ x = 1) ∧
        tsupport ψ₁ ⊆ A ∧ tsupport ψ₂ ⊆ B := by
    intro T hT hTAB
    let V : Bool → Set E3 := fun b => cond b A B
    have hVo : ∀ b, IsOpen (V b) := by
      intro b; cases b
      · exact hB
      · exact hA
    have hcov : T ⊆ ⋃ b, V b := by
      intro x hx
      rcases hTAB hx with h | h
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨true, h⟩
      · exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨false, h⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ :=
      SmoothPartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate 𝓘(ℝ, E3) hT.isClosed V hVo hcov
    refine ⟨f true, f false, contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp (f true).contMDiff,
      contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp (f false).contMDiff, f.nonneg true, f.nonneg false, ?_, ?_,
      hf true, hf false⟩
    · intro x
      have h := f.sum_le_one x
      rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype, Fintype.sum_bool] at h
      exact h
    · intro x hx
      have h := f.sum_eq_one hx
      rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype, Fintype.sum_bool] at h
      exact h
  
  have s3 : ∀ (X : E3 → E3) (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (W : Set E3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X →
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) → (∀ x, ψ x ≤ 1) → tsupport ψ ⊆ W →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ψ y • X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun y => ψ y • X y) ∧
        tsupport (fun y => ψ y • X y) ⊆ W ∧
        ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (ψ y • X y) i * (ψ y • X y) j ≤ 1 := by
    intro X ψ W hX hXc hXq hψ hψ0 hψ1 hψW
    have hs1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ψ y • X y) := hψ.smul hX
    have hs2 : HasCompactSupport (fun y => ψ y • X y) := by
      have := hXc.smul_left (f := ψ)
      exact this
    have hs3 : tsupport (fun y => ψ y • X y) ⊆ W := (tsupport_smul_subset_left ψ X).trans hψW
    refine ⟨hs1, hs2, hs3, ?_⟩
    intro y
    have heq : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (ψ y • X y) i * (ψ y • X y) j =
        ψ y ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j := by
      simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      ring
    rw [heq]
    have h1 := hXq y
    have h2 := hψ0 y
    have h3 := hψ1 y
    have h4 : ψ y ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (ψ y)) (sub_nonneg.2 h1)]
  
  have s4 : ∀ Y₁ Y₂ : E3 → E3,
      (∀ i : Fin 3, Differentiable ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y₁ z i)) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, Differentiable ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y₂ z i)) → ∀ y,
      sepDensDiv G (fun z => Y₁ z + Y₂ z) y = sepDensDiv G Y₁ y + sepDensDiv G Y₂ y := by
    intro Y₁ Y₂ h₁ h₂ y
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have hfun : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (Y₁ z + Y₂ z) i) =
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y₁ z i) + (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y₂ z i) := by
      funext z; simp [PiLp.add_apply, mul_add]
    rw [hfun, fderiv_add ((h₁ i) y) ((h₂ i) y), ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
  
  unfold sepPerG
  refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
  obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXT, hXq⟩ := hX
  obtain ⟨ψ₁, ψ₂, hψ₁s, hψ₂s, hψ₁0, hψ₂0, hsum1, hsumT, hψ₁A, hψ₂B⟩ :=
    s2 (tsupport X) hXc hXT
  have hψ₁1 : ∀ x, ψ₁ x ≤ 1 := fun x => by linarith [hsum1 x, hψ₂0 x]
  have hψ₂1 : ∀ x, ψ₂ x ≤ 1 := fun x => by linarith [hsum1 x, hψ₁0 x]
  have adm₁ := s3 X ψ₁ A hXs hXc hXq hψ₁s hψ₁0 hψ₁1 hψ₁A
  have adm₂ := s3 X ψ₂ B hXs hXc hXq hψ₂s hψ₂0 hψ₂1 hψ₂B
  have hdecomp : X = fun z => ψ₁ z • X z + ψ₂ z • X z := by
    funext z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ tsupport X
    · rw [← add_smul, hsumT z hz, one_smul]
    · have h0 : X z = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz
      simp [h0]
  obtain ⟨c₁, cont₁, cs₁⟩ := s1 _ adm₁.1 adm₁.2.1 (adm₁.2.2.1.trans hAU)
  obtain ⟨c₂, cont₂, cs₂⟩ := s1 _ adm₂.1 adm₂.2.1 (adm₂.2.2.1.trans hBU)
  have hadd := s4 (fun y => ψ₁ y • X y) (fun y => ψ₂ y • X y)
    (fun i => (c₁ i).differentiable (by simp)) (fun i => (c₂ i).differentiable (by simp))
  have i₁ : Integrable (sepDensDiv G (fun y => ψ₁ y • X y)) (volume.restrict E) :=
    (cont₁.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport cs₁).integrableOn
  have i₂ : Integrable (sepDensDiv G (fun y => ψ₂ y • X y)) (volume.restrict E) :=
    (cont₂.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport cs₂).integrableOn
  have hint : ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G X y =
      (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (fun y => ψ₁ y • X y) y) +
        ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G (fun y => ψ₂ y • X y) y := by
    have h1 : ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G X y = ∫ y in E,
        (sepDensDiv G (fun y => ψ₁ y • X y) y + sepDensDiv G (fun y => ψ₂ y • X y) y) := by
      congr 1
      funext y
      rw [← hadd y, ← hdecomp]
    rw [h1, integral_add i₁ i₂]
  rw [hint]
  refine le_trans ENNReal.ofReal_add_le (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
  · exact le_iSup₂_of_le (fun y => ψ₁ y • X y) adm₁ le_rfl
  · exact le_iSup₂_of_le (fun y => ψ₂ y • X y) adm₂ le_rfl

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (r₀ : ℝ)
    (hr₀ : 2 ≤ r₀)
    (havoid : ∀ S : Set M, IsCompact S → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S →
      ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), r₀ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends l).Φ y ∉ S)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : r₀ + 1 < R)
    (hbar : ∀ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), R ≤ ‖y‖ →
      0 < levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (hAF.ends l).Φ) (fun z => ‖z‖) y)
    (S : ℕ → Set M) (hS : ∀ n, IsCompact (S n) ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (S n)) :
    ∃ A : M → Set E3 → ℝ, ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ Sig : Set M, IsCompact Sig ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig ∧
      IsStableMinimalSet g Sig ∧
      frontier (connectedComponentIn ((⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) ∪ Sig)ᶜ
        ((hAF.ends k).Φ ((r₀ + 1) • e 0))) ⊆ Sig ∧
      CoordAreaBound Sig A
