proof.tactics:
by
  haveI : LocallyConnectedSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyConnectedSpace E3 M
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, a, c, ha, hρ, hρend, hρcore, hcpt⟩ := radial_exhaustion_exists g hAF
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρ.continuous
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁a, hr₁c, hr₁R, hr₁r₀⟩ : ∃ r₁ : ℝ, a < r₁ ∧ c < r₁ ∧ R < r₁ ∧ r₀ < r₁ :=
    ⟨max (max a c) (max R r₀) + 1,
      by linarith [le_max_left a c, le_max_left (max a c) (max R r₀)],
      by linarith [le_max_right a c, le_max_left (max a c) (max R r₀)],
      by linarith [le_max_left R r₀, le_max_right (max a c) (max R r₀)],
      by linarith [le_max_right R r₀, le_max_right (max a c) (max R r₀)]⟩
  
  have hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p := by
    intro p hp
    have hex : ∃ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), a < ‖y‖ ∧ (hAF.ends l).Φ y = p := by
      by_contra hno
      push_neg at hno
      have := hρcore p hno
      linarith
    obtain ⟨l, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hex
    have hρy := hρend l y hy
    have hyR : R ≤ ‖y‖ := by rw [hρy] at hp; linarith
    have hsrc : y ∈ (hAF.ends l).Φ.source := by
      rw [(hAF.ends l).source_eq]
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
      linarith
    have hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ρ ((hAF.ends l).Φ z) = ‖z‖ := by
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact hρend l z hz
    rw [levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g (hAF.ends l).Φ ρ (fun z => ‖z‖) hρ y hsrc hfh]
    exact hbar l y hyR
  
  have hA₀o : IsOpen {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hρc
  have hΩo : IsOpen {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} := isOpen_lt hρc continuous_const
  have hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) := by
    rw [Set.diff_self]; exact isOpen_empty
  
  have hP₀ : sepRiemPer g {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} < ⊤ :=
    sepRiemPer_far_lt_top g ρ r₁ (r₁ + 2) {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} hρ hcpt hmc (fun p hp => hp)
      hA₀o hBo
  
  obtain ⟨cA, hcA0, hcA⟩ := coordArea_le_cutPerimeter g
  refine ⟨fun q C => cA q C *
    (sepRiemPer g {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2}).toReal, ?_⟩
  intro m
  
  have hKc : IsCompact (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) :=
    (Finset.range m).isCompact_biUnion (fun n _ => (hS n).1)
  have hKcl : IsClosed (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) := hKc.isClosed
  have hKρ : ∀ p ∈ (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n), ρ p < r₁ := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨n, -, hpn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hp
    by_cases hex : ∃ (l : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), a < ‖y‖ ∧ (hAF.ends l).Φ y = p
    · obtain ⟨l, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hex
      have hyr₀ : ‖y‖ ≤ r₀ := by
        by_contra hlt
        exact havoid (S n) (hS n).1 (hS n).2 l y (lt_of_not_ge hlt) hpn
      rw [hρend l y hy]
      linarith
    · push_neg at hex
      have := hρcore p hex
      linarith
  have hKKin : (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) ⊆ {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁} :=
    fun p hp => (hKρ p hp).le
  
  have hdisj : Disjoint (closure {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro p hp hpK
    have h1 : r₁ ≤ ρ p := closure_lt_subset_le continuous_const hρc hp
    have h2 := hKρ p hpK
    linarith
  have hfin₀ : hullRiemPer g {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2}
      (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) ≤ sepRiemPer g {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} :=
    hullRiemPer_le_sepRiemPer g _ _ _ hKcl hdisj
  
  have hA₀meas : sepChartMeas {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} := by
    intro q
    exact ((chartAt E3 q).isOpen_image_of_subset_source
      (hA₀o.inter (chartAt E3 q).open_source) Set.inter_subset_right).measurableSet
  have hKvΩ : {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁ + 1} ⊆ {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} := by
    intro p hp
    have h : ρ p ≤ r₁ + 1 := hp
    show ρ p < r₁ + 2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨F, hFm, hFA, hFmin⟩ := hullRiemPer_minimizer_exists g (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n)
    {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁ + 1} (hcpt (r₁ + 1)) hΩo hKvΩ
    hA₀meas (lt_of_le_of_lt hfin₀ hP₀)
  
  have hFfin : hullRiemPer g F {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) ≤
      sepRiemPer g {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} := by
    refine le_trans (hFmin _ hA₀meas ?_) hfin₀
    rw [symmDiff_self]
    exact bot_le
  have hFlt := lt_of_le_of_lt hFfin hP₀
  
  have hbarF := hullMinimizer_eq_far_ae g ρ r₁ (r₁ + 1) (r₁ + 2) {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} F
    (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) hρ hcpt hmc (fun p hp => hp) hA₀o hBo hKcl hKρ
    (by linarith) (by linarith) hFm hFA hFlt hFmin
  have hcoll : sepChartNull (symmDiff F {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁}) := by
    intro q
    refine MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null (Set.image_subset _ ?_) (hbarF q)
    rintro x ⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, hx3⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hx1, show r₁ < ρ x from lt_of_not_ge hx2⟩, hx3⟩
  
  have hKinc : IsClosed {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁} := isClosed_le hρc continuous_const
  have hKinKv : {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁} ⊆ interior {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁ + 1} := by
    intro p hp
    have h : ρ p ≤ r₁ := hp
    refine interior_maximal (t := {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 1}) (fun q hq => ?_)
      (isOpen_lt hρc continuous_const) (show ρ p < r₁ + 1 by linarith)
    have hq' : ρ q < r₁ + 1 := hq
    show ρ q ≤ r₁ + 1
    linarith
  have hA₀fr : frontier {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} ⊆ {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁} := by
    intro p hp
    have h := frontier_lt_subset_eq continuous_const hρc hp
    have h' : r₁ = ρ p := h
    show ρ p ≤ r₁
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨hEo, hEK, hA₀E, -, hfrKin⟩ := hull_normalization (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n)
    {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁} {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} F
    {x | x ∉ (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) ∧ ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, sepChartNull (N \ F)}
    hKcl hKinc hKKin hA₀o hA₀fr hcoll rfl
  set E : Set M := {x | x ∉ (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) ∧ ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, sepChartNull (N \ F)}
    with hEdef
  have hSigc : IsCompact (frontier E) := (hcpt r₁).of_isClosed_subset isClosed_frontier hfrKin
  
  have hfree := hull_free_regular g (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2}
    {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁ + 1} {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁} {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} F E hKcl hΩo (hcpt (r₁ + 1))
    hKvΩ hKinc hKinKv hKKin hA₀o hA₀fr hFm hFA hFlt hFmin hcoll rfl
  have hcont := hull_contact_regular g S hS m (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n)
    {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁ + 1} {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁} {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} F E rfl
    hΩo (hcpt (r₁ + 1)) hKvΩ hKinc hKinKv hKKin hA₀o hA₀fr hFm hFA hFlt hFmin hcoll rfl
  have hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier E) := by
    refine sepIsMinimalSurfaceSet_of_chart_graphs g _ isClosed_frontier (fun p hp => ?_)
    by_cases hpK : p ∈ ⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n
    · exact (hcont p hp hpK).2
    · exact hfree.2 p hp hpK
  
  obtain ⟨hEper, hEmin⟩ := hull_perimeter_transfer g S hS m (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n)
    {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁ + 1} {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁} {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} F E rfl
    hΩo (hcpt (r₁ + 1)) hKvΩ hKinc hKinKv hKKin hA₀o hA₀fr hFm hFA hFlt hFmin hcoll rfl hSm
    hfree.1 (fun p hp hpK => (hcont p hp hpK).1)
  have hEfin : hullRiemPer g E {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} (frontier E) ≤
      sepRiemPer g {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} := hEper.trans hFfin
  
  have hnorm_e : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ‖t • e 0‖ = t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht]
  have hTconn : IsPreconnected ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖}) := by
    have hsub : {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖} ⊆ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by
      intro y hy
      rw [(hAF.ends k).source_eq]
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
      have : r₀ < ‖y‖ := hy
      linarith
    have hcont' : ContinuousOn ((hAF.ends k).Φ : E3 → M) (hAF.ends k).Φ.source :=
      (hAF.ends k).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
    have hA : IsConnected {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖} := by
      have hrank : 1 < Module.rank ℝ E3 := by
        rw [← Module.finrank_eq_rank, finrank_euclideanSpace]
        simp
      have hS2 := isConnected_sphere hrank (0 : E3) (zero_le_one' ℝ)
      have hP := (isConnected_Ioi (a := r₀)).prod hS2
      have himg : (fun q : ℝ × E3 => q.1 • q.2) '' (Set.Ioi r₀ ×ˢ sphere (0 : E3) 1) =
          {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖} := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨t, θ⟩, ⟨ht, hθ⟩, rfl⟩
          have ht' : r₀ < t := ht
          have hθ' : ‖θ‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.1 hθ
          show r₀ < ‖t • θ‖
          rw [norm_smul, hθ', Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith), mul_one]
          exact ht'
        · intro hy
          have hy' : r₀ < ‖y‖ := hy
          have hpos : 0 < ‖y‖ := by linarith
          refine ⟨(‖y‖, ‖y‖⁻¹ • y), ⟨hy', ?_⟩, ?_⟩
          · rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm,
              inv_mul_cancel₀ hpos.ne']
          · show ‖y‖ • (‖y‖⁻¹ • y) = y
            rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hpos.ne', one_smul]
      rw [← himg]
      exact hP.image _ (continuous_fst.smul continuous_snd).continuousOn
    exact (hA.image _ (hcont'.mono hsub)).isPreconnected
  have hTE : (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | r₀ < ‖y‖} ⊆ E := by
    refine hTconn.subset_left_of_subset_union hEo isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
      (Disjoint.mono_left subset_closure disjoint_compl_right) ?_ ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      by_cases hxE : (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ E
      · exact Or.inl hxE
      · right
        intro hxc
        have hxf : (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ frontier E := by
          rw [hEo.frontier_eq]
          exact ⟨hxc, hxE⟩
        exact havoid (frontier E) hSigc hSm k y hy hxf
    · have hpos : 0 < r₁ + 1 := by linarith
      have hn := hnorm_e (r₁ + 1) hpos
      have hy₁ : r₀ < ‖(r₁ + 1) • e 0‖ := by rw [hn]; linarith
      have hy₁a : a < ‖(r₁ + 1) • e 0‖ := by rw [hn]; linarith
      refine ⟨(hAF.ends k).Φ ((r₁ + 1) • e 0), ⟨_, hy₁, rfl⟩, hA₀E ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · show r₁ < ρ ((hAF.ends k).Φ ((r₁ + 1) • e 0))
        rw [hρend k _ hy₁a, hn]
        linarith
      · intro hle
        have hle' : ρ ((hAF.ends k).Φ ((r₁ + 1) • e 0)) ≤ r₁ := hle
        rw [hρend k _ hy₁a, hn] at hle'
        linarith
  have hx₀E : (hAF.ends k).Φ ((r₀ + 1) • e 0) ∈ E := by
    refine hTE ⟨(r₀ + 1) • e 0, ?_, rfl⟩
    show r₀ < ‖(r₀ + 1) • e 0‖
    rw [hnorm_e (r₀ + 1) (by linarith)]
    linarith
  
  have hStab : IsStableMinimalSet g (frontier E) :=
    stable_of_cut_minimizing g (frontier E) E {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₁ + 1}
      hSigc hSm hEo rfl hΩo (hcpt (r₁ + 1)) (hfrKin.trans hKinKv) hKvΩ
      (lt_of_le_of_lt hEfin hP₀) hEmin
  refine ⟨frontier E, hSigc, hSm, hStab, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · set x₀ := (hAF.ends k).Φ ((r₀ + 1) • e 0) with hx₀def
    set U : Set M := ((⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) ∪ frontier E)ᶜ with hUdef
    have hUo : IsOpen U := (hKcl.union isClosed_frontier).isOpen_compl
    have hx₀U : x₀ ∈ U := by
      rintro (hK | hf)
      · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hEK hx₀E hK
      · rw [hEo.frontier_eq] at hf
        exact hf.2 hx₀E
    have hCE : connectedComponentIn U x₀ ⊆ E := by
      refine (isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn).subset_left_of_subset_union hEo
        isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl (Disjoint.mono_left subset_closure disjoint_compl_right)
        ?_ ⟨x₀, mem_connectedComponentIn hx₀U, hx₀E⟩
      intro z hz
      have hzU : z ∈ U := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ hz
      by_cases hzE : z ∈ E
      · exact Or.inl hzE
      · right
        intro hzc
        have hzf : z ∈ frontier E := by
          rw [hEo.frontier_eq]
          exact ⟨hzc, hzE⟩
        exact hzU (Or.inr hzf)
    have hCo : IsOpen (connectedComponentIn U x₀) := hUo.connectedComponentIn
    intro y hy
    rw [hCo.frontier_eq] at hy
    obtain ⟨hyc, hyC⟩ := hy
    by_cases hyU : y ∈ U
    · exfalso
      have hnb : connectedComponentIn U y ∈ 𝓝 y :=
        hUo.connectedComponentIn.mem_nhds (mem_connectedComponentIn hyU)
      obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 hyc _ hnb
      have e1 : connectedComponentIn U x₀ = connectedComponentIn U z :=
        connectedComponentIn_eq hz2
      have e2 : connectedComponentIn U y = connectedComponentIn U z :=
        connectedComponentIn_eq hz1
      apply hyC
      rw [e1, ← e2]
      exact mem_connectedComponentIn hyU
    · have hy' : y ∈ (⋃ n ∈ Finset.range m, S n) ∪ frontier E := not_not.1 hyU
      rcases hy' with hyK | hyf
      · have hyE : y ∉ E := fun h => Set.disjoint_left.1 hEK h hyK
        rw [hEo.frontier_eq]
        exact ⟨closure_mono hCE hyc, hyE⟩
      · exact hyf
  
  · intro q C hC hCt
    have hSΩ : frontier E ⊆ {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} := by
      intro p hp
      have h : ρ p ≤ r₁ := hfrKin hp
      show ρ p < r₁ + 2
      linarith
    calc MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure 2
          ((chartAt E3 q) '' (frontier E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩ C)
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (cA q C) * hullRiemPer g E {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} (frontier E) :=
          hcA (frontier E) E {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} hSigc hSm hEo rfl hΩo hSΩ q C hC hCt
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (cA q C) *
            sepRiemPer g {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2} := by
          gcongr
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (cA q C) * ENNReal.ofReal
            (sepRiemPer g {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2}).toReal := by
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hP₀.ne]
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (cA q C *
            (sepRiemPer g {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} {p : M | ρ p < r₁ + 2}).toReal) :=
          (ENNReal.ofReal_mul (hcA0 q C)).symm

def hullPerG (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U Kc : Set E3) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ (X : E3 → E3) (_ : (∀ y, y ∉ Kc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
      tsupport X ⊆ U ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C),
    ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G X y)


def hullRiemPer (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U K : Set M) : ENNReal :=
  ⨆ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin n → M) (W : Fin n → Set M)
    (_ : (∀ k, IsOpen (W k) ∧ W k ⊆ U ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) ∧
      Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (W k) (W l))),
    ∑ k, hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm)
      (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)) (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k)
      (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source))

stable_curvature_bound.definitions:
abbrev E2 : Type := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)


abbrev e2 (i : Fin 2) : E2 := EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)


def pd2 (i : Fin 2) (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2) : ℝ := fderiv ℝ w x (e2 i)


def pullMetric2 (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) :
    Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
  fun i j => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
    (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) k * G (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) l


def christoffel2 (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (k i j : Fin 2) (x : E2) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
    (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x)


def ricci2 (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (j k : Fin 2) (x : E2) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 2, (pd2 i (christoffel2 h i j k) x - pd2 j (christoffel2 h i i k) x)
    + ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2,
        (christoffel2 h i i p x * christoffel2 h p j k x
          - christoffel2 h i j p x * christoffel2 h p i k x)


def gaussCurv2 (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x : E2) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ j k * ricci2 h j k x


def lap2 (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j *
    (pd2 i (pd2 j w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k w x)


def IsSurfA2At (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (S : Set M) (κ : OpenPartialHomeomorph M E3) (p : M)
    (t : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V → p ∈ V → V ⊆ κ.source →
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f → (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) →
    V ∩ S = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} →
    secondFundSq (g.coeff κ.symm) (fun y => f (κ.symm y)) (κ p) = t

subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ ρ₁ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₁ ∧ ∀ Sig : Set M, IsCompact Sig → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig → ∀ q ∈ Sig, q ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source → chartAt E3 z q ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) r → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ ρ₁ → ∃ F : E2 → E3, F 0 = chartAt E3 z q ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x) ∧ (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x i j * x j = x i

subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ k₀ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ k₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₂ ∧ ∀ Sig : Set M, IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig → ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (F : E2 → E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) → ∃ a : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 a (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, IsSurfA2At g Sig (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) (a x) ∧ 0 ≤ a x ∧ -(a x) / 2 - k₀ ≤ gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) x ∧ gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) x ≤ k₀ ∧ -2 * (a x) ^ 2 - C₁ * a x - C₂ * Real.sqrt (a x) ≤ lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) a x

subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ k₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ k₀ ∧ ∀ Sig : Set M, IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig → IsStableMinimalSet g Sig → ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (F : E2 → E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) → ∃ a b φ : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn a (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 φ (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, IsSurfA2At g Sig (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) (a x) ∧ -k₀ ≤ b x ∧ 0 < φ x ∧ lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) φ x + (a x + b x) * φ x ≤ 0

subgoal_signatures.name: normal_disc_log_cutoff
subgoal_signatures.statement: (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∃ R₀ ε₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ R₀ ∧ 0 < ε₀ ∧ ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → ∀ (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (a b φ : E2 → ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 (R₀ / μ))) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (R₀ / μ), (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) → ContinuousOn a (Metric.ball 0 (R₀ / μ)) → ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball 0 (R₀ / μ)) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 φ (Metric.ball 0 (R₀ / μ)) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (R₀ / μ), 0 ≤ a x ∧ -(a x) / 2 - ε₀ * μ ^ 2 ≤ gaussCurv2 h x ∧ -(ε₀ * μ ^ 2) ≤ b x ∧ 0 < φ x ∧ lap2 h φ x + (a x + b x) * φ x ≤ 0) → ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / μ), a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det ≤ δ

subgoal_signatures.name: normal_disc_mean_value
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∃ ρ₀ c₀ ε₁ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ρ₀ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ 0 < c₀ ∧ 0 < ε₁ ∧ ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → ∀ (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (a : E2 → ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ))) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / μ), (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 a (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ)) → a 0 = μ ^ 2 → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / μ), 0 ≤ a x ∧ a x ≤ μ ^ 2 ∧ -(a x) / 2 - ε₁ * μ ^ 2 ≤ gaussCurv2 h x ∧ gaussCurv2 h x ≤ ε₁ * μ ^ 2 ∧ -2 * (a x) ^ 2 - ε₁ * μ ^ 2 * a x - ε₁ * μ ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (a x) ≤ lap2 h a x) → c₀ ≤ ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ₀ / μ), a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hP5 : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (y z : E3),
      coordPlaneProj a (y - z) = coordPlaneProj a y - coordPlaneProj a z := by
    intro a y z
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hea : ∀ a : Fin 3, (e a) a = 1 := by
    intro a; simp [e]
  have hpa : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (q : E3), (coordPlaneProj a q) a = 0 := by
    intro a q
    simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
  have hP3 : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (q : E3),
      coordPlaneProj a (coordPlaneProj a q) = coordPlaneProj a q := by
    intro a q
    conv_lhs => rw [coordPlaneProj, hpa, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hP2 : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (q : E3) (t : ℝ),
      coordPlaneProj a (q + t • e a) = coordPlaneProj a q := by
    intro a q t
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, hea, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
      add_smul]
    abel
  have hP4 : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (q : E3) (t : ℝ), (coordPlaneProj a q + t • e a) a = t := by
    intro a q t
    simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, hpa, hea, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add]
  have hP1 : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (q c : E3) (t : ℝ),
      coordPlaneProj a (coordPlaneProj a q + t • e a - c) = coordPlaneProj a (q - c) := by
    intro a q c t
    rw [hP5, hP2, hP3, hP5]
  have hP6 : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (w : E3), ‖w‖ ≤ ‖coordPlaneProj a w‖ + |w a| := by
    intro a w
    have hw : w = coordPlaneProj a w + (w a) • e a := by
      simp [coordPlaneProj]
    calc ‖w‖ = ‖coordPlaneProj a w + (w a) • e a‖ := by rw [← hw]
      _ ≤ ‖coordPlaneProj a w‖ + ‖(w a) • e a‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖coordPlaneProj a w‖ + |w a| := by
        rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hP7 : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (w : E3), ‖coordPlaneProj a w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    intro a w
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    by_cases h : i = a
    · subst h
      rw [hpa]; simpa using sq_nonneg (w i)
    · simp [coordPlaneProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, h]
  have hcontP : ∀ a : Fin 3, Continuous (coordPlaneProj a) := by
    intro a
    unfold coordPlaneProj
    fun_prop
  have hCylOpen : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (c : E3) (r : ℝ),
      IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ < r} := by
    intro a c r
    exact isOpen_lt ((hcontP a).comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm continuous_const
  
  have hcong : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f₁ f₂ : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3),
      f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] f₂ → levelMeanCurvCoord G f₁ z = levelMeanCurvCoord G f₂ z := by
    intro G f₁ f₂ z h
    have h1 : ∀ i, partialDeriv i f₁ z = partialDeriv i f₂ z := by
      intro i; unfold partialDeriv; rw [h.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ i j, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₁) z =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₂) z := by
      intro i j
      have h' : partialDeriv j f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] partialDeriv j f₂ :=
        (h.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).mono (fun y hy => by simp only [partialDeriv, hy])
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [show (fun y => fderiv ℝ f₁ y (e j)) = partialDeriv j f₁ from rfl,
        show (fun y => fderiv ℝ f₂ y (e j)) = partialDeriv j f₂ from rfl, h'.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, lapLoc, hessLoc, h1, h2]
  
  have hmono : ∀ (p : M) (ρ : ℝ) (L L' : ℕ) (Λ₁ Λ₂ : ℕ → ℝ) (Sig : Set M), L ≤ L' →
      (∀ n, Λ₁ n ≤ Λ₂ n) →
      MinimalSheetsNear g p ρ L Λ₁ Sig → MinimalSheetsNear g p ρ L' Λ₂ Sig := by
    intro p ρ L L' Λ₁ Λ₂ Sig hL hΛ h
    obtain ⟨a, l, u, hl, hs, hb, ho, hg, hc⟩ := h
    exact ⟨a, l, u, hl.trans hL, hs, fun i n y => (hb i n y).trans (hΛ n), ho, hg, hc⟩
  
  have hloc : ∀ p : M, ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (L : ℕ) (Λn : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧
      Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
      ∀ Sig : Set M, IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig → HasCurvatureBound g Sig Λ →
        CoordAreaBound Sig A → MinimalSheetsNear g p ρ L Λn Sig := by
    intro p
    
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεt⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (chartAt E3 p).open_target (chartAt E3 p p)
      (mem_chart_target E3 p)
    have hR0 : 0 < ε / 2 := by linarith
    have hR0t : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (ε / 2) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hεt
    
    obtain ⟨K, hK0, hK⟩ := graph_level_transfer g p (ε / 2) Λ hR0 hR0t
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρR, hS4⟩ := euclidean_sheet_structure (chartAt E3 p p) (ε / 2) K hR0 hK0
    have h10 : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)).trans hR0t
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := mse_graph_higher_bounds (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      (chartAt E3 p).target (chartAt E3 p p) ρ K (chartAt E3 p).open_target hρ h10
      (fun i j => g.smooth p i j) (fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _)
      (fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y hy)
    obtain ⟨B', hB'⟩ := planar_cutoff_extension (chartAt E3 p p) ρ hρ B
    refine ⟨ρ, ⌈max (A p (Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ))) 0 / (4 * ρ ^ 2)⌉₊,
      B', hρ, h10, ?_⟩
    
    intro Sig hmin hcurv harea
    obtain ⟨hreg1, hreg2⟩ := chart_image_regular g p Sig hmin
    have hballR0 : Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) (ε / 2) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hR0t
    obtain ⟨a, l, v, hV1, hV2, hV3, hV4, hV5, hV6⟩ :=
      hS4 ((chartAt E3 p) '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (fun z hz hzc => hreg1 z (hballR0 hz) hzc)
        (fun z hz => by
          obtain ⟨r, hr, F, -, hF1, hF2, hF3⟩ := hreg2 z hz.1
          exact ⟨r, hr, F, hF1, hF2, hF3⟩)
        (fun z hz b w r hr hw hpl hzb hgr hsl => by
          obtain ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxS, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hzB⟩ := hz
          exact (hK Sig hmin hcurv x hxS hxs b w r hr hw hpl hzb hgr).1
            (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzB) hsl)
    
    have hMSEv : ∀ i (y : E3), ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 3 * ρ →
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
          (fun z => z a - v i (coordPlaneProj a z)) (coordPlaneProj a y + v i y • e a) = 0 := by
      intro i y hy
      obtain ⟨x', ⟨hx'S, hx's⟩, hx'eq⟩ := (hV3 i y hy).2.2.2
      have hproj : coordPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p x') = coordPlaneProj a y := by
        rw [hx'eq, hP2, hP3]
      have hpy : ‖coordPlaneProj a (coordPlaneProj a y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 3 * ρ := by
        rw [hP5, hP3, ← hP5]; exact hy
      have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (v i) (coordPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p x')) := by
        rw [hproj]
        exact ((hV2 i).contDiffAt ((hCylOpen a _ _).mem_nhds hpy)).of_le
          (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
      have hgr : ∀ y', ‖coordPlaneProj a (y' - chartAt E3 p x')‖ <
          3 * ρ - ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ →
          coordPlaneProj a y' + v i (coordPlaneProj a y') • e a ∈
            (chartAt E3 p) '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) := by
        intro y' hy'
        have e1 : coordPlaneProj a (y' - chartAt E3 p p) =
            coordPlaneProj a (y' - chartAt E3 p x') +
              coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p) := by
          simp only [hP5, hproj]; abel
        have h3 : ‖coordPlaneProj a (y' - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 3 * ρ := by
          rw [e1]
          linarith [norm_add_le (coordPlaneProj a (y' - chartAt E3 p x'))
            (coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p))]
        rw [hV1]; exact (hV3 i y' h3).2.2.2
      have hzb : (chartAt E3 p x') a = v i (coordPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p x')) := by
        rw [hproj, hV1, hx'eq, hP4]
      have h := (hK Sig hmin hcurv x' hx'S hx's a (v i)
        (3 * ρ - ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖) (by linarith) hcd (hV1 i) hzb hgr).2
      rw [hx'eq] at h
      exact h
    
    have hhb : ∀ i (n : ℕ) (y : E3), ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ ≤ 5 / 2 * ρ →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (v i) y‖ ≤ B n := fun i =>
      hB a (v i) (hV1 i) (hV2 i) (fun y hy => by
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩ := hV3 i y hy
        refine ⟨by rw [hV1]; exact h3, h1, h2, ?_⟩
        rw [hV1]; exact hMSEv i y hy)
    have hu : ∀ i, ∃ u : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ u ∧ (∀ y, u (coordPlaneProj a y) = u y) ∧
        (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ → u y = v i y) ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : E3), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n u y‖ ≤ B' n :=
      fun i => hB' a (v i) (hV1 i) (hV2 i) (hhb i)
    choose u hu1 hu2 hu3 hu4 using hu
    
    have hcount := sheet_count_area (chartAt E3 p p) a ρ hρ l v
      ((chartAt E3 p) '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩
        Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ))
      (fun i => (hV2 i).continuousOn.mono (fun y hy => by
        have hy' : ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ := hy
        show ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 3 * ρ
        linarith))
      (fun i i' hii' y hy => by
        rw [hV1, hV1]; exact hV5 i i' hii' y (by linarith))
      (fun i y hy => by
        rw [hV1]
        refine ⟨(hV3 i y (by linarith)).2.2.2, ?_⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have h1 := hP6 a (coordPlaneProj a y + v i y • e a - chartAt E3 p p)
        rw [hP1] at h1
        have h2 : (coordPlaneProj a y + v i y • e a - chartAt E3 p p) a =
            v i y - (chartAt E3 p p) a := by
          rw [PiLp.sub_apply, hP4]
        rw [h2] at h1
        have h3 := hV4 i y hy
        linarith)
    have harea' := harea p (Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ))
      (isCompact_closedBall _ _) h10
    have hlL : l ≤ ⌈max (A p (Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ))) 0 /
        (4 * ρ ^ 2)⌉₊ := by
      have h4 : 0 < 4 * ρ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h3 : ENNReal.ofReal ((l : ℝ) * (4 * ρ ^ 2)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (max (A p (Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ))) 0) := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg l), ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
        exact (hcount.trans harea').trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_max_left _ _))
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (le_max_right _ _)] at h3
      have h5 : (l : ℝ) ≤ max (A p (Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ))) 0 /
          (4 * ρ ^ 2) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ h4]; exact h3
      exact_mod_cast h5.trans (Nat.le_ceil _)
    
    have huv : ∀ i (y : E3), ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
        u i (coordPlaneProj a y) = v i y := by
      intro i y hy; rw [hu2, hu3 i y hy]
    refine ⟨a, l, u, hlL, hu1, hu4, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i i' hii' y hy
      rw [huv i y hy, huv i' y hy]
      exact hV5 i i' hii' y (by linarith)
    · intro i y hy
      rw [huv i y hy]
      refine ⟨hV4 i y hy, ?_, ?_⟩
      · obtain ⟨x'', ⟨hx''S, hx''s⟩, hx''eq⟩ := (hV3 i y (by linarith)).2.2.2
        rw [← hx''eq, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx''s]
        exact hx''S
      · have hpt : ‖coordPlaneProj a (coordPlaneProj a y + v i y • e a - chartAt E3 p p)‖ <
            2 * ρ := by
          rw [hP1]; exact hy
        have hev : (fun z => z a - u i (coordPlaneProj a z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (coordPlaneProj a y + v i y • e a)]
            (fun z => z a - v i (coordPlaneProj a z)) := by
          filter_upwards [(hCylOpen a (chartAt E3 p p) (2 * ρ)).mem_nhds hpt] with z hz
          rw [hu2, hu3 i z hz, hV1]
        rw [hcong _ _ _ _ hev]
        exact hMSEv i y (by linarith)
    · intro x hx hxs hxb
      have hz : ‖coordPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p x - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ := by
        have h1 := hP7 a (chartAt E3 p x - chartAt E3 p p)
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hxb
        linarith

    exact h hy
  have hwc : ∀ N j, ∀ x ∈ Sig (ψ₁ N), x ∈ (chartAt E3 (pts j)).source →
      chartAt E3 (pts j) x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ρ j) →
      ∃ i : Fin (lh j), (chartAt E3 (pts j) x) (ah j) =
        ut (ψ₁ N) j i.val (coordPlaneProj (ah j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) x)) := by
    intro N j x hx hs hb
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcv (ψ₁ N) j x hx hs hb
    rw [ha] at hi
    have hi' : i.val < lh j := by rw [← hl N j]; exact i.isLt
    refine ⟨⟨i.val, hi'⟩, ?_⟩
    show _ = ut (ψ₁ N) j i.val _
    rw [hut, dif_pos i.isLt]
    exact hi
  
  have hUslab : ∀ j (i : Fin (lh j)) (y : E3),
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ j →
      |Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) - (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ah j)| ≤ 8 * ρ j := by
    intro j i y hy
    have ht := ((hUc0 j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y)).sub_const
      ((chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ah j))).abs
    exact le_of_tendsto' ht (fun N => (hws (ψ₂ N) j i y hy).1.le)
  have hUord : ∀ j (i i' : Fin (lh j)), i < i' → ∀ y : E3,
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ j →
      Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) ≤ Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) := by
    intro j i i' hii y hy
    exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' (hUc0 j i _) (hUc0 j i' _)
      (fun N => (hwo (ψ₂ N) j i i' hii y hy).le)
  
  have hUmse : ∀ j (i : Fin (lh j)) (y : E3),
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ j →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm)
        (fun z => z (ah j) - Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) z))
        (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y + Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) • e (ah j)) = 0 := by
    intro j i
    exact mse_graph_limit g (pts j) (ah j) (ρ j) (hρ j) (hball j)
      (fun k => ut (ψ₁ (ψ₂ k)) j i.val) (Uf j i) (fun k => hut_sm _ _ _) (hUsm j i)
      (fun n _ y => hUcD j i n y)
      (fun k y hy => ⟨(hws (ψ₂ k) j i y hy).1, (hws (ψ₂ k) j i y hy).2.2⟩)
  
  have hcoinc : ∀ j (i i' : Fin (lh j)), i < i' → ∀ y₀ : E3,
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y₀ - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ j →
      Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y₀) = Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y₀) →
      ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ j →
      Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) = Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) := by
    intro j i i' hii y₀ hy₀ heq y hy
    have hloc := minimal_graph_difference_elliptic g (pts j) (ah j) (ρ j) (hρ j) (hball j)
      (Uf j i) (Uf j i') (hUsm j i) (hUsm j i') (hUslab j i) (hUslab j i')
      (hUmse j i) (hUmse j i') (hUord j i i' hii)
    have hw2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y' => Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y') -
        Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y')) :=
      (((hUsm j i').comp (hpcd (ah j))).sub ((hUsm j i).comp (hpcd (ah j)))).of_le
        (by norm_cast)
    have h := hopf_strong_min_principle
      {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ j}
      (hdisc_open (ρ j) _ _) (hdisc_conv (ρ j) _ _).isPreconnected _ hw2
      (fun y hy => sub_nonneg.mpr (hUord j i i' hii y hy)) hloc y₀ hy₀
      (by simp only [heq, sub_self]) y hy
    have h' : Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) - Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) = 0 := h
    linarith
  have hsame : ∀ j (i i' : Fin (lh j)) (y₀ : E3),
      ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y₀ - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ j →
      Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y₀) = Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y₀) →
      ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj (ah j) (y - chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j))‖ < 2 * ρ j →
      Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) = Uf j i' (coordPlaneProj (ah j) y) := by
    intro j i i' y₀ hy₀ heq y hy
    rcases lt_trichotomy i i' with hii | hii | hii
    · exact hcoinc j i i' hii y₀ hy₀ heq y hy
    · rw [hii]
    · exact (hcoinc j i' i hii y₀ hy₀ heq.symm y hy).symm
  
  obtain ⟨Sinf, hSinf⟩ : ∃ Sinf : Set M, Sinf =
      {q : M | ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 q, ∃ᶠ N in atTop, ¬ Disjoint O (Sig (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N)))} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemS : ∀ q, q ∈ Sinf ↔ ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 q, ∃ᶠ N in atTop, ¬ Disjoint O (Sig (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N))) := by
    intro q
    rw [hSinf]
    rfl
  have hKur : ∀ q : M, q ∉ Sinf →
      ∃ O ∈ 𝓝 q, ∀ᶠ N in atTop, Disjoint O (Sig (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N))) := by
    intro q hq
    have h : ¬ ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 q, ∃ᶠ N in atTop, ¬ Disjoint O (Sig (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N))) :=
      fun h => hq ((hmemS q).mpr h)
    simp only [not_forall, Filter.not_frequently, not_not] at h
    obtain ⟨O, hO, h⟩ := h
    exact ⟨O, hO, h⟩
  have hclosed : IsClosed Sinf := by
    rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨O, hO, h⟩ := hKur q hq
    obtain ⟨O', hO'O, hO'o, hqO'⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hO
    refine Filter.mem_of_superset (hO'o.mem_nhds hqO') ?_
    intro q' hq'
    rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, hmemS]
    intro hq'S
    have hf := hq'S O' (hO'o.mem_nhds hq')
    exact (Filter.not_frequently.mpr
      (h.mono fun N hN => not_not.mpr (hN.mono_left hO'O))) hf
  have hSZ : Sinf ⊆ Z := by
    intro q hq
    by_contra hqZ
    rw [hmemS] at hq
    have hf := hq Zᶜ (hZ.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hqZ)
    exact (Filter.not_frequently.mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun N =>
      not_not.mpr (Disjoint.mono_right (hSig _).1 disjoint_compl_left))) hf
  have hcpt : IsCompact Sinf := hZ.of_isClosed_subset hclosed hSZ
  
  have hmin : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sinf := by
    refine ⟨hclosed, ?_⟩
    intro p hp O hO
    obtain ⟨j, hpj, hzj⟩ : ∃ j, p ∈ (chartAt E3 (pts j)).source ∧
        chartAt E3 (pts j) p ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ρ j) := by
      have h := hcov (hSZ hp)
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at h
      obtain ⟨j, h1, h2⟩ := h
      exact ⟨j, h1, h2⟩
    have hballj : Metric.ball (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ρ j) ⊆
        (chartAt E3 (pts j)).target :=
      Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans
        ((Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith [hρ j])).trans (hball j))
    have hlim := limsup_sheets_local (chartAt E3 (pts j)) (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ah j)
      (ρ j) (hρ j) hballj (lh j) (fun N => Sig (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N)))
      (fun N i => ut (ψ₁ (ψ₂ N)) j i.val) (Uf j)
      (max (Λ 1) 0) (fun N i => hut_sm _ _ _) (fun N i y => hut_bd _ _ _ 1 y)
      (fun i y => hUc0 j i y) (fun N i y hy => (hws (ψ₂ N) j i y hy).2.1)
      (fun N x hx hs hb => hwc (ψ₂ N) j x hx hs hb)
    have hlim' : ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 (pts j)).source,
        chartAt E3 (pts j) x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ρ j) →
        (x ∈ Sinf ↔ ∃ i : Fin (lh j), (chartAt E3 (pts j) x) (ah j) =
          Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) x))) := by
      intro x hx hb
      rw [hmemS]
      exact hlim x hx hb
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := (hlim' p hpj hzj).mp hp
    let W : Set E3 := Metric.ball (chartAt E3 (pts j) (pts j)) (ρ j) ∩
      ⋂ i : Fin (lh j), {z : E3 | Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) p)) =
        (chartAt E3 (pts j) p) (ah j) ∨ z (ah j) ≠ Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) z)}
    have hWo : IsOpen W := by
      refine Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i => ?_)
      by_cases h : Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) p)) =
          (chartAt E3 (pts j) p) (ah j)
      · simp only [h, true_or, Set.setOf_true, isOpen_univ]
      · simp only [h, false_or]
        exact isOpen_ne_fun (hcoord (ah j)) ((hUsm j i).continuous.comp (hpcont (ah j)))
    have hz₀W : chartAt E3 (pts j) p ∈ W := by
      refine ⟨hzj, Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun i => ?_⟩
      by_cases h : Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) p)) =
          (chartAt E3 (pts j) p) (ah j)
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr (fun h' => h h'.symm)
    have hWt : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 (pts j)).target := fun z hz => hballj hz.1
    have hMSE : ∀ z ∈ W, z (ah j) = Uf j i₀ (coordPlaneProj (ah j) z) →
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm)
          (fun w => w (ah j) - Uf j i₀ (coordPlaneProj (ah j) w)) z = 0 := by
      intro z hz hza
      have h := hUmse j i₀ z (hF3 (ρ j) _ _ _ hz.1)
      rw [← hza, hpre] at h
      exact h
    obtain ⟨V, f, hVO, hVo, hpV, hVW, hf, hdf, hzero, hH, hP, hN⟩ :=
      graph_minimal_chart g (pts j) p (ah j) (Uf j i₀) (hUsm j i₀) W hWo hWt hpj hz₀W hi₀
        hMSE O hO
    refine ⟨V, f, hVO, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, ?_, hH, hP, hN⟩
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxV, hxS⟩
      refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hxs, hxW⟩ := hVW x hxV
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (hlim' x hxs hxW.1).mp hxS
      show f x = 0
      rw [hzero x hxV]
      have hiI : Uf j i (coordPlaneProj (ah j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) p)) =
          (chartAt E3 (pts j) p) (ah j) := by
        rcases Set.mem_iInter.mp hxW.2 i with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd hi h
      have hc := hsame j i i₀ (chartAt E3 (pts j) p) (hF3 (ρ j) _ _ _ hzj) (hiI.trans hi₀)
        (chartAt E3 (pts j) x) (hF3 (ρ j) _ _ _ hxW.1)
      rw [hi, hc]
    · rintro ⟨hxV, hx0⟩
      refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hxs, hxW⟩ := hVW x hxV
      exact (hlim' x hxs hxW.1).mpr ⟨i₀, (hzero x hxV).mp hx0⟩
  
  exact ⟨fun N => ψ₁ (ψ₂ N), Sinf, hψ₁.comp hψ₂, hcpt, hmin, hKur⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: mse_graph_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M) (a : Fin 3)
    (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target)
    (v : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (V : E3 → ℝ) (hv : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (v k)) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (hconv : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ 2 → ∀ y : E3, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (v k) y)
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n V y)))
    (hsheet : ∀ k (y : E3), ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      |v k (coordPlaneProj a y) - (chartAt E3 p p) a| < 8 * ρ ∧
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => z a - v k (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (coordPlaneProj a y + v k (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) = 0) :
    ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (coordPlaneProj a y + V (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: minimal_graph_difference_elliptic
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (p : M) (a : Fin 3) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target)
    (U V : E3 → ℝ) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (hslabU : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      |U (coordPlaneProj a y) - (chartAt E3 p p) a| ≤ 8 * ρ)
    (hslabV : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      |V (coordPlaneProj a y) - (chartAt E3 p p) a| ≤ 8 * ρ)
    (hMU : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => z a - U (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (coordPlaneProj a y + U (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) = 0)
    (hMV : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (coordPlaneProj a y + V (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) = 0)
    (hle : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      U (coordPlaneProj a y) ≤ V (coordPlaneProj a y)) :
    ∀ y₁ : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y₁ - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      V (coordPlaneProj a y₁) - U (coordPlaneProj a y₁) = 0 →
      ∃ (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (r lam Lam K : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < lam ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ r, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ ∧
          (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * v i * v j) ∧
          (∀ i j, |A y i j| ≤ Lam) ∧
          ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
              (fun y' => V (coordPlaneProj a y') - U (coordPlaneProj a y'))) y ≤
            K * ((V (coordPlaneProj a y) - U (coordPlaneProj a y)) +
              ∑ i, |partialDeriv i
                (fun y' => V (coordPlaneProj a y') - U (coordPlaneProj a y')) y|)

subgoal_signatures.name: hopf_strong_min_principle
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(Ω : Set E3) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hΩc : IsPreconnected Ω)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ 2 w) (hnn : ∀ y ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ w y)
    (hloc : ∀ y₁ ∈ Ω, w y₁ = 0 → ∃ (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (r lam Lam K : ℝ),
      0 < r ∧ 0 < lam ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ r, y ∈ Ω ∧
        (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * v i * v j) ∧
        (∀ i j, |A y i j| ≤ Lam) ∧
        ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) y ≤
          K * (w y + ∑ i, |partialDeriv i w y|))
    (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ Ω) (h0 : w y₀ = 0) : ∀ y ∈ Ω, w y = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: limsup_sheets_local

    (c : E3) (a : Fin 3) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hball : Metric.ball c ρ ⊆ κ.target) (l : ℕ)
    (Sq : ℕ → Set X) (u : ℕ → Fin l → E3 → ℝ) (U : Fin l → E3 → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ N i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u N i))
    (hLip : ∀ N i (y : E3), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 (u N i) y‖ ≤ C)
    (hconv : ∀ i (y : E3), Filter.Tendsto (fun N => u N i y) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (U i y)))
    (hon : ∀ N i (y : E3), ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      κ.symm (coordPlaneProj a y + u N i (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) ∈ Sq N)
    (hcover : ∀ N, ∀ x ∈ Sq N, x ∈ κ.source → κ x ∈ Metric.ball c ρ →
      ∃ i, (κ x) a = u N i (coordPlaneProj a (κ x))) :
    ∀ x ∈ κ.source, κ x ∈ Metric.ball c ρ →
      ((∀ O ∈ 𝓝 x, ∃ᶠ N in Filter.atTop, ¬ Disjoint O (Sq N)) ↔

subgoal_signatures.name: graph_minimal_chart
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (q p : M) (a : Fin 3) (U : E3 → ℝ) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (W : Set E3) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hWt : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) (hp : p ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source)
    (hpW : chartAt E3 q p ∈ W)
    (hpg : (chartAt E3 q p) a = U (coordPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 q p)))
    (hMSE : ∀ z ∈ W, z a = U (coordPlaneProj a z) →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun w => w a - U (coordPlaneProj a w)) z
        = 0)
    (O : Set M) (hO : O ∈ 𝓝 p) :
    ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), V ⊆ O ∧ IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧ chartAt E3 q x ∈ W) ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 ↔ (chartAt E3 q x) a = U (coordPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 q x))) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv f x = 0) ∧
      IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∧ IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | f x < 0})

by
  
  have s1 : ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U →
      ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) ∧
        HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
    intro X hX hXc hXU i
    have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := by
      have hfun : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y =>
          G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2 - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1
            - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2 + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0
            + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
        funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
      rw [hfun]
      exact ((((((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 2)).sub
        (((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 1))).sub
        (((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 2))).add
        (((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 0))).add
        (((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 1)) |>.sub
        (((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 0))
    have hXi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hX
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
        rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
        intro z
        by_cases hz : z ∈ U
        · have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) z := hdet.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
          have h2 := h1.sqrt (hpd z hz).det_pos.ne'
          exact h2.mul hXi.contDiffAt
        · have hz' : z ∉ tsupport X := fun h => hz (hXU h)
          have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hz'
          have hev' : (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
            filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
            rw [hy]; simp
          exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev'
      exact hsm.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    · have hc : HasCompactSupport (fun z => X z i) := hXc.comp_left (g := fun v : E3 => v i) rfl
      exact hc.mul_left
  
  have s2 : ∀ h : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      Integrable (partialDeriv i h) ∧ ∫ y, partialDeriv i h y = 0 := by
    intro h hh hc i
    have hcont : Continuous (partialDeriv i h) := by
      unfold partialDeriv
      exact (hh.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hint : Integrable (partialDeriv i h) :=
      hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e i))
    refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
    have hhint : Integrable h := hh.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hc
    have key := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
      (f := fun _ : E3 => (1 : ℝ)) (g := h) (v := e i) (by simp) (by simpa using hint)
      (by simpa using hhint) (differentiable_const 1) (hh.differentiable one_ne_zero)
    simpa [partialDeriv] using key
  
  have hflux : ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U →
      Integrable (sepDensDiv G X) ∧ ∫ y, sepDensDiv G X y = 0 := by
    intro X hX hXc hXU
    have hs : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        Integrable (partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i)) ∧
          ∫ y, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y = 0 :=
      fun i => s2 _ (s1 X hX hXc hXU i).1 (s1 X hX hXc hXU i).2 i
    have he : sepDensDiv G X =
        fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y := rfl
    rw [he]
    refine ⟨integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hs i).1), ?_⟩
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hs i).1)]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => (hs i).2)
  
  have hneg : ∀ X : E3 → E3, sepDensDiv G (-X) = fun y => -sepDensDiv G X y := by
    intro X
    funext y
    unfold sepDensDiv
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    have hf : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (-X) z i) =
        -(fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
      funext z; simp
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hf, fderiv_neg, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply]
  
  have hle1 : ∀ B V : Set E3, MeasurableSet B → V ⊆ U → sepPerG G Bᶜ V ≤ sepPerG G B V := by
    intro B V hB hVU
    unfold sepPerG
    refine iSup₂_le (fun X hXadm => ?_)
    obtain ⟨hX, hXc, hXV, hX1⟩ := hXadm
    obtain ⟨hint, h0⟩ := hflux X hX hXc (hXV.trans hVU)
    have hadd := integral_add_compl hB hint
    have hadm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (-X) ∧ HasCompactSupport (-X) ∧ tsupport (-X) ⊆ V ∧
        ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (-X) y i * (-X) y j ≤ 1 := by
      refine ⟨hX.neg, hXc.neg, by rw [tsupport_neg]; exact hXV, fun y => ?_⟩
      have := hX1 y
      simpa using this
    have heq : ∫ y in Bᶜ, sepDensDiv G X y = ∫ y in B, sepDensDiv G (-X) y := by
      rw [hneg X, integral_neg]; linarith
    rw [heq]
    exact le_iSup₂ (f := fun (X : E3 → E3) (_ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
      tsupport X ⊆ V ∧ ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in B, sepDensDiv G X y)) (-X) hadm
  
  have hcompl : ∀ A V : Set E3, MeasurableSet A → V ⊆ U → sepPerG G Aᶜ V = sepPerG G A V := by
    intro A V hA hVU
    refine le_antisymm (hle1 A V hA hVU) ?_
    have h := hle1 Aᶜ V hA.compl hVU
    rwa [compl_compl] at h
  
  obtain ⟨hF, hfin, hle⟩ := hmin
  refine ⟨hF.compl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro V hVo hVc hVU
    rw [hcompl F V hF (subset_closure.trans hVU)]
    exact hfin V hVo hVc hVU
  · intro F' V K hF' hVo hVc hVU hK hKV hsd
    have hV' : V ⊆ U := subset_closure.trans hVU
    have hsd' : symmDiff F F'ᶜ ⊆ K := by
      rw [← compl_symmDiff_compl, compl_compl]; exact hsd
    rw [hcompl F V hF hV', ← hcompl F' V hF' hV']
    exact hle F'ᶜ V K hF'.compl hVo hVc hVU hK hKV hsd'

informal_problem.statement:
(a : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : Continuous w) :
    volume {z : E3 | z a = w (sepPlaneProj a z)} = 0

signature.name: smth_graph_null
signature.statement:
(a : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : Continuous w) :
    volume {z : E3 | z a = w (sepPlaneProj a z)} = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hea : ∀ (z : E3) (c : ℝ), (z + c • e a) a = z a + c := by
    intro z c
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hproj : ∀ (z : E3) (c : ℝ), sepPlaneProj a (z + c • e a) = sepPlaneProj a z := by
    intro z c
    unfold sepPlaneProj
    rw [hea, add_smul]
    abel
  have hcoord : Continuous (fun z : E3 => z a) := PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ a
  have hpc : Continuous (sepPlaneProj a) := by
    have : sepPlaneProj a = fun z : E3 => z - (z a) • e a := by
      funext z
      rfl
    rw [this]
    exact continuous_id.sub (hcoord.smul continuous_const)
  let A : ℝ → Set E3 := fun t => {z : E3 | z a = w (sepPlaneProj a z) + t}
  have hAm : ∀ t, MeasurableSet (A t) := fun t =>
    (isClosed_eq hcoord ((hw.comp hpc).add continuous_const)).measurableSet
  have hAd : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint A) := by
    intro s t hst
    rw [Function.onFun, Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hs ht
    apply hst
    have h1 : z a = w (sepPlaneProj a z) + s := hs
    have h2 : z a = w (sepPlaneProj a z) + t := ht
    linarith
  have hApre : ∀ t, A t = (fun h : E3 => h + (-t) • e a) ⁻¹'
      {z : E3 | z a = w (sepPlaneProj a z)} := by
    intro t
    ext h
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, A, hea, hproj]
    constructor <;> intro hh <;> linarith
  have hAv : ∀ t, volume (A t) = volume {z : E3 | z a = w (sepPlaneProj a z)} := by
    intro t
    rw [hApre t]
    exact measure_preimage_add_right volume _ _
  have hc := Measure.countable_meas_pos_of_disjoint_iUnion (μ := (volume : Measure E3)) hAm hAd
  by_contra hne
  have hpos : 0 < volume {z : E3 | z a = w (sepPlaneProj a z)} := pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne
  have huniv : {t : ℝ | 0 < volume (A t)} = Set.univ :=
    Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun t => by
      show 0 < volume (A t)
      rw [hAv t]
      exact hpos)
  rw [huniv] at hc
  exact Cardinal.not_countable_real hc

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F F' V : Set E3)
    (hF : MeasurableSet F) (hF' : MeasurableSet F') (h0 : volume (symmDiff F F' ∩ V) = 0) :
    sepPerG G F V = sepPerG G F' V

signature.name: smth_sepPerG_ae_congr
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F F' V : Set E3)
    (hF : MeasurableSet F) (hF' : MeasurableSet F') (h0 : volume (symmDiff F F' ∩ V) = 0) :
    sepPerG G F V = sepPerG G F' V

proof.tactics:
by
  have key : ∀ X : E3 → E3, tsupport X ⊆ V →
      ∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G X y = ∫ y in F', sepDensDiv G X y := by
    intro X hXV
    have hTm : MeasurableSet (tsupport X) := (isClosed_tsupport X).measurableSet
    have hzero : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → sepDensDiv G X y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy
      unfold sepDensDiv
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
      have hev' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
        rw [hz]
        simp
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev'.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hind : sepDensDiv G X = (tsupport X).indicator (sepDensDiv G X) := by
      funext y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport X
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, hzero y hy]
    have hae : (F ∩ tsupport X : Set E3) =ᵐ[volume] (F' ∩ tsupport X : Set E3) := by
      rw [ae_eq_set]
      constructor
      · refine measure_mono_null ?_ h0
        rintro z ⟨⟨hzF, hzT⟩, hz⟩
        exact ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hzF, fun hzF' => hz ⟨hzF', hzT⟩⟩), hXV hzT⟩
      · refine measure_mono_null ?_ h0
        rintro z ⟨⟨hzF', hzT⟩, hz⟩
        exact ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hzF', fun hzF => hz ⟨hzF, hzT⟩⟩), hXV hzT⟩
    rw [hind, setIntegral_indicator hTm, setIntegral_indicator hTm]
    exact setIntegral_congr_set hae
  unfold sepPerG
  refine iSup_congr fun X => iSup_congr fun hX => ?_
  rw [key X hX.2.2.1]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (a : Fin 3) (c : E3) (ρ h : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hcl : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ ≤ ρ → |z a - c a| ≤ h → z ∈ U)
    (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v)
    (hin : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 →
      |v x - c a| < h) :
    sepPerG G {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)} (sepCyl a c ρ h) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in smthDisc a c ρ, smthLag G a (x, v x, smthGrad v x))

signature.name: smth_subgraph_perimeter
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (a : Fin 3) (c : E3) (ρ h : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hcl : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ ≤ ρ → |z a - c a| ≤ h → z ∈ U)
    (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v)
    (hin : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 →
      |v x - c a| < h) :
    sepPerG G {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)} (sepCyl a c ρ h) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in smthDisc a c ρ, smthLag G a (x, v x, smthGrad v x))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hLa : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift a x t) a = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [smthLift]
  have hLs : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (k : Fin 2), (smthLift a x t) (a.succAbove k) = x k := by
    intro x t k
    simp [smthLift]
  have hHL : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthHoriz a (smthLift a x t) = x := by
    intro x t; funext k; exact hLs x t k
  have hPa : ∀ w : E3, (sepPlaneProj a w) a = 0 := by
    intro w; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hPs : ∀ (w : E3) (k : Fin 2), (sepPlaneProj a w) (a.succAbove k) = w (a.succAbove k) := by
    intro w k; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hnormsq : ∀ w : E3, ‖w‖ ^ 2 = w a ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, w (a.succAbove k) ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_succAbove (fun i => ‖w i‖ ^ 2) a]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hGc : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin 2, (smthHoriz a z k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [hnormsq, hPa]
    simp only [hPs, smthHoriz]
    simp
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ∀ x, s x = ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hsfun : s = fun x => ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 := funext hs
  have hscont : Continuous s := by
    rw [hsfun]; fun_prop
  have hsGc : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ ^ 2 = s (smthHoriz a z) := by
    intro z; rw [hs]; exact hGc z
  have hDmem : ∀ (r : ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ), x ∈ smthDisc a c r ↔ s x < r ^ 2 := by
    intro r x
    rw [hs]; exact Iff.rfl
  have hDo : IsOpen (smthDisc a c ρ) := by
    have : smthDisc a c ρ = {x | s x < ρ ^ 2} := by
      ext x; exact hDmem ρ x
    rw [this]; exact isOpen_lt hscont continuous_const
  have hDm : ∀ r : ℝ, MeasurableSet (smthDisc a c r) := by
    intro r
    have : smthDisc a c r = {x | s x < r ^ 2} := by
      ext x; exact hDmem r x
    rw [this]; exact (isOpen_lt hscont continuous_const).measurableSet
  
  have hGe : ∀ x, s x ≤ ρ ^ 2 → dist x (smthHoriz a c) ≤ ρ := by
    intro x hx
    refine (dist_pi_le_iff hρ.le).2 (fun k => ?_)
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    rw [hs] at hx
    have hk : (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 :=
      le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2)
        (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ k)) hx
    exact (sq_le_sq.1 hk).trans_eq (abs_of_pos hρ)
  have hKd : IsCompact {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | s x ≤ ρ ^ 2} := by
    refine Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded (isClosed_le hscont continuous_const) ?_
    exact (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := smthHoriz a c) (r := ρ)).subset
      (fun x hx => Metric.mem_closedBall.2 (hGe x hx))
  have hDsub : smthDisc a c ρ ⊆ {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | s x ≤ ρ ^ 2} :=
    fun x hx => le_of_lt ((hDmem ρ x).1 hx)
  
  have hzU : ∀ x ∈ {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | s x ≤ ρ ^ 2}, smthLift a x (v x) ∈ U := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : s x ≤ ρ ^ 2 := hx
    refine hcl _ ?_ ?_
    · have e1 := hsGc (smthLift a x (v x))
      rw [hHL] at e1
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (sepPlaneProj a (smthLift a x (v x) - c))]
    · rw [hLa]
      have hx'' := hx'
      rw [hs] at hx''
      exact (hin x hx'').le
  
  have hVD : ∀ x, smthLift a x (v x) ∈ sepCyl a c ρ h → x ∈ smthDisc a c ρ := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hDmem]
    have e1 := hsGc (smthLift a x (v x))
    rw [hHL] at e1
    have h1 : ‖sepPlaneProj a (smthLift a x (v x) - c)‖ < ρ := hx.1
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (sepPlaneProj a (smthLift a x (v x) - c))]
  
  have hVU : sepCyl a c ρ h ⊆ U := fun z hz => hcl z hz.1.le hz.2.le
  
  have hliftc : Continuous (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => smthLift a x (v x)) := by
    have hins : Continuous (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => (Fin.insertNth a (v x) x : Fin 3 → ℝ)) := by
      refine continuous_pi (fun i => ?_)
      rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
      · simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
        exact hv.continuous
      · simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
        exact continuous_apply k
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp hins
  have hgc : Continuous (smthGrad v) := by
    refine continuous_pi (fun k => ?_)
    exact (hv.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hcovc : Continuous (smthCovec a) := by
    refine continuous_pi (fun i => ?_)
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
    · simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
      exact continuous_const
    · simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
      exact (continuous_apply k).neg
  have hξc : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun x => smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i) :=
    fun i => (continuous_apply i).comp (hcovc.comp hgc)
  have h1inf : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  
  have hflux : ∀ X : E3 → E3, (ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
      tsupport X ⊆ sepCyl a c ρ h ∧
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →
      (∫ y in {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)}, sepDensDiv G X y) =
        (∫ x in smthDisc a c ρ, ∑ i : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det *
          X (smthLift a x (v x)) i * smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det *
          X (smthLift a x (v x)) i * smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i) (smthDisc a c ρ) := by
    intro X hX
    have hXU : tsupport X ⊆ U := hX.2.2.1.trans hVU
    have hZ := fun i => smth_density_contDiff G U hU hG hpd X hX.1 hX.2.1 hXU i
    have hGG := smth_gauss_green_subgraph a v hv (fun i z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i)
      (fun i => (hZ i).1.of_le h1inf) (fun i => (hZ i).2)
    have hcont : Continuous (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det *
        X (smthLift a x (v x)) i * smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i) := by
      refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
      exact ((hZ i).1.continuous.comp hliftc).mul (hξc i)
    have hzero : ∀ x, x ∉ smthDisc a c ρ → (∑ i : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det *
        X (smthLift a x (v x)) i * smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i) = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have hnot : smthLift a x (v x) ∉ tsupport X := fun hmem => hx (hVD x (hX.2.2.1 hmem))
      have hX0 : X (smthLift a x (v x)) = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hnot
      simp [hX0]

The [CRUX] (the G-free Gauss-Green identity for a C1 subgraph, with conormal insertNth a 1 (-grad v), checked numerically for all a and with the wrong sign ruled out) is isolated in the named child smth_gauss_green_subgraph. The glue uses every child: hGG, hZ, hCS, hLc and the smth_good_field obtain. Each child is true and much easier than the parent: a G-free integral identity, regularity of sqrt(det G)*X_i, 3x3 Cauchy-Schwarz, continuity of L where det G>0, and an explicit admissible field with pointwise-only bounds (YᵀGY=1, slack 2*C_g*sqrt(C_A)*delta<=eta, chi2=1 on the graph because hin holds on the closed disc). Sections 4 and 5 of the blueprint give concrete calculations and boundary-case derivations. Nothing restates an ancestor or a §10 lemma, and there is no split on parameter values. Note in findings.md: smth_lag_props in §10 may shorten smth_lag_graph_continuousOn, but it needs hsymm, which that child's signature lacks.

    ((hFcont 0 h0).integrableOn_compact hK).mono_set hDK
  have i4 : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (γ x + (0 : ℝ) • η x) (η x))
      (volume.restrict D) :=
    (hF'cont.mono hDK).aestronglyMeasurable hD
  have i5 : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict D), ∀ t ∈ ball (0 : ℝ) (ε / (|N| + 1)),
      ‖fderiv ℝ Λ (γ x + t • η x) (η x)‖ ≤ |B| * (|N| + 1) :=
    ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hD fun x hx t ht => hbd x (hDK hx) t (hball t ht)
  have i6 : Integrable (fun _ : Fin 2 → ℝ => |B| * (|N| + 1)) (volume.restrict D) :=

  have i7 : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict D), ∀ t ∈ ball (0 : ℝ) (ε / (|N| + 1)),
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Λ (γ x + s • η x)) (fderiv ℝ Λ (γ x + t • η x) (η x)) t := by
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hD fun x hx t ht => ?_

    exact ((hΛ.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt
      (hO.mem_nhds hw)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hpath
  exact (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (ball_mem_nhds 0 hδ) i2 i3 i4 i5 i6
    i7).2

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hinv3 : ∀ {X : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
      (H : X → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (s : Set X),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j) s) → (∀ y ∈ s, (H y).det ≠ 0) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) s ∧
        ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y)⁻¹ i j) s := by
    intro X _ _ H s hH hdet
    have h00 := hH 0 0; have h01 := hH 0 1; have h02 := hH 0 2
    have h10 := hH 1 0; have h11 := hH 1 1; have h12 := hH 1 2
    have h20 := hH 2 0; have h21 := hH 2 1; have h22 := hH 2 2
    have hd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) s := by
      simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      fun_prop
    refine ⟨hd, fun i j => ?_⟩
    have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((H y).det)⁻¹) s := hd.inv hdet
    have hadj : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).adjugate i j) s := by
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three] <;> fun_prop
    have heq : (fun y => (H y)⁻¹ i j) = fun y => ((H y).det)⁻¹ * (H y).adjugate i j := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact hinv.mul hadj
  
  have hquadpos : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), A.PosDef → ∀ ζ : Fin 3 → ℝ, ζ ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ζ i * ζ j := by
    intro A hA ζ hζ
    have h := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hζ
    have e : star ζ ⬝ᵥ A.mulVec ζ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ζ i * ζ j := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
    linarith
  
  have h1d : ∀ c α β γ : ℝ, 0 < c → 0 < γ → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2) →
      0 < deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => c * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2))) 0 := by
    intro c α β γ hc hγ hQ
    have hQd : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2)
        (2 * γ * s - 2 * β) s := by
      intro s
      have h := (((hasDerivAt_id' s).const_mul (2 * β)).const_sub α).add
        ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 s).const_mul γ)
      exact h.congr_deriv (by norm_num <;> ring)
    have hf' : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => c * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2))
        (c * ((2 * γ * s - 2 * β) / (2 * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2)))) s :=
      fun s => ((hQd s).sqrt (hQ s).ne').const_mul c
    have hdf : deriv (fun s : ℝ => c * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2)) =
        fun s => c * ((2 * γ * s - 2 * β) / (2 * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2))) :=
      funext (fun s => (hf' s).deriv)
    have hN : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => 2 * γ * s - 2 * β) (2 * γ * 1) 0 :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id' (0 : ℝ)).const_mul (2 * γ)).sub_const (2 * β)
    have hD : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => 2 * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2))
        (2 * ((2 * γ * 0 - 2 * β) / (2 * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * 0 + γ * 0 ^ 2)))) 0 :=
      ((hQd 0).sqrt (hQ 0).ne').const_mul 2
    have hα0 : 0 < α := by have := hQ 0; simpa using this
    have hsq0 : Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * 0 + γ * 0 ^ 2) = Real.sqrt α := by
      congr 1; ring
    have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt α := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hα0
    have hD0 : (2 * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * 0 + γ * 0 ^ 2)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hsq0]; positivity
    have hg : HasDerivAt
        (fun s : ℝ => c * ((2 * γ * s - 2 * β) / (2 * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2))))
        (c * ((2 * γ * 1 * (2 * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * 0 + γ * 0 ^ 2)) -
          (2 * γ * 0 - 2 * β) *
            (2 * ((2 * γ * 0 - 2 * β) / (2 * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * 0 + γ * 0 ^ 2))))) /
          (2 * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * 0 + γ * 0 ^ 2)) ^ 2)) 0 :=
      (hN.div hD hD0).const_mul c
    rw [hdf, hg.deriv, hsq0]
    have hr2 : Real.sqrt α ^ 2 = α := Real.sq_sqrt hα0.le
    have hdisc : 0 < α * γ - β ^ 2 := by
      have h := mul_pos hγ (hQ (β / γ))
      have e : γ * (α - 2 * β * (β / γ) + γ * (β / γ) ^ 2) = α * γ - β ^ 2 := by
        field_simp; ring
      linarith
    set r := Real.sqrt α with hrdef
    have e2 : (2 * γ * 1 * (2 * r) - (2 * γ * 0 - 2 * β) * (2 * ((2 * γ * 0 - 2 * β) / (2 * r)))) /
        (2 * r) ^ 2 = (γ * r ^ 2 - β ^ 2) / r ^ 3 := by
      field_simp; ring
    rw [e2, hr2]
    have : 0 < γ * α - β ^ 2 := by linarith
    exact mul_pos hc (div_pos this (pow_pos hr 3))
  
  set O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) :=
    {w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | smthLift a w.1 w.2.1 ∈ U} with hOdef
  have hLc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => smthLift a w.1 w.2.1) := by
    have hins : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) =>
        (Fin.insertNth a w.2.1 w.1 : Fin 3 → ℝ)) := by
      refine contDiff_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
      rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
      · simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
        exact contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_snd
      · simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
        exact (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ k).comp contDiff_fst
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp hins
  have hO : IsOpen O := hU.preimage hLc.continuous
  
  have hcovc : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => smthCovec a w.2.2 i) := by
    intro i
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
    · simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
      exact contDiff_const
    · simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, Pi.neg_apply]
      exact ((contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ k).comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)).neg
  have hcova : ∀ p : Fin 2 → ℝ, smthCovec a p a = 1 := by
    intro p; simp [smthCovec]
  have hcovne : ∀ p : Fin 2 → ℝ, smthCovec a p ≠ 0 := by
    intro p h
    have := congrFun h a
    rw [hcova] at this
    simp at this
  
  have hHij : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1) i j) O :=
    fun i j => (hG i j).comp hLc.contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
  obtain ⟨hdetS, hinvS⟩ := hinv3 (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) =>
    G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)) O hHij (fun w hw => (hpd _ hw).det_pos.ne')
  have hQs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) =>
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹ i j *
        smthCovec a w.2.2 i * smthCovec a w.2.2 j) O :=
    ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ =>
      ((hinvS i j).mul (hcovc i).contDiffOn).mul (hcovc j).contDiffOn))
  have hQpos : ∀ w ∈ O, 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹ i j *
        smthCovec a w.2.2 i * smthCovec a w.2.2 j :=
    fun w hw => hquadpos _ (hpd _ hw).inv _ (hcovne _)
  have hΛ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (smthLag G a) O :=
    (hdetS.sqrt (fun w hw => (hpd _ hw).det_pos.ne')).mul
      (hQs.sqrt (fun w hw => (hQpos w hw).ne'))
  refine ⟨hO, hΛ, ?_⟩
  
  intro w hw q hq
  set v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) := ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), q) with hvdef
  have hpt : ∀ s : ℝ, w + s • v = (w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2 + s • q) := by
    intro s
    refine Prod.ext (by simp [v]) (Prod.ext (by simp [v]) (by simp [v]))
  have hline : ∀ s : ℝ, w + s • v ∈ O := by
    intro s
    rw [hpt s]
    exact hw
  
  have h11 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ∞ := by
    have : ((2 : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) := WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
    exact le_of_eq_of_le (by norm_num) this
  have hd1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) y v) O :=
    (hΛ.fderiv_of_isOpen hO h11).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hΛdiff : ∀ y ∈ O, DifferentiableAt ℝ (smthLag G a) y := fun y hy =>
    (hΛ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hy)
  have hhdiff : ∀ y ∈ O, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) y v) y :=
    fun y hy => (hd1.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hy)
  have hℓ : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => w + s • v) v s := by
    intro s
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const v).const_add w
  have hinner : deriv (fun s : ℝ => smthLag G a (w + s • v)) =
      fun s => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) (w + s • v) v := by
    funext s
    exact ((hΛdiff _ (hline s)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s (hℓ s)).deriv
  have houter : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) (w + s • v) v)
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) y v) (w + (0 : ℝ) • v) v) 0 := by
    have h := (hhdiff _ (hline 0)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) (hℓ 0)
    exact h
  have hw0 : w + (0 : ℝ) • v = w := by simp
  rw [hw0] at houter
  have hdd : fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) w' v) w v =
      deriv (deriv (fun s : ℝ => smthLag G a (w + s • v))) 0 := by
    rw [hinner, houter.deriv]
  rw [hdd]
  
  set z : E3 := smthLift a w.1 w.2.1 with hzdef
  have hz : z ∈ U := hw
  set A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := (G z)⁻¹ with hAdef
  set ξ₀ : Fin 3 → ℝ := smthCovec a w.2.2 with hξ₀def
  set η : Fin 3 → ℝ := (Fin.insertNth a (0 : ℝ) q : Fin 3 → ℝ) with hηdef
  have hηa : η a = 0 := by simp [η]
  have hηs : ∀ k : Fin 2, η (a.succAbove k) = q k := by
    intro k; simp [η]
  have hcovline : ∀ s : ℝ, smthCovec a (w.2.2 + s • q) = fun i => ξ₀ i - s * η i := by
    intro s
    funext i
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
    · rw [hcova, hηa, hξ₀def, hcova]; ring
    · simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, Pi.neg_apply, Pi.add_apply,
        Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hξ₀def, hηs]
      ring
  set α : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ξ₀ i * ξ₀ j with hαdef
  set β : ℝ := ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ξ₀ i * η j) +
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * η i * ξ₀ j)) / 2 with hβdef
  set γ : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * η i * η j with hγdef
  have hquad : ∀ s : ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * (ξ₀ i - s * η i) * (ξ₀ j - s * η j) =
      α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2 := by
    intro s
    simp only [hαdef, hβdef, hγdef, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hApd : A.PosDef := (hpd z hz).inv
  have hQ : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2 := by
    intro s
    rw [← hquad s]
    refine hquadpos A hApd _ ?_
    intro h
    have := congrFun h a
    simp only [hξ₀def, hcova, hηa, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    norm_num at this
  have hηne : η ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hq
    have := congrFun h (a.succAbove k)
    rw [hηs] at this
    exact hk this
  have hγ : 0 < γ := hquadpos A hApd η hηne
  have hc : 0 < Real.sqrt (G z).det := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpd z hz).det_pos
  have hfun : (fun s : ℝ => smthLag G a (w + s • v)) =
      fun s => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Real.sqrt (α - 2 * β * s + γ * s ^ 2) := by
    funext s
    rw [hpt s, ← hquad s]
    simp only [smthLag, hcovline s]
    rfl
  rw [hfun]
  exact h1d _ α β γ hc hγ hQ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x₀ hx₀
  
  have hEL1 := smth_EL_C1_test Λ O hO hΛ D hD v hv hvO hEL
  obtain ⟨R, h₀, lam, Lam, K, M₀, hR, hh₀, hlam, hLam, hK, hM₀, hball, hstr⟩ :=
    smth_diffquot_structure Λ O hO hΛ hell D hD v hv hvO hEL1 x₀ hx₀
  obtain ⟨C, α, hC, hα, hhol⟩ := smth_linear_holder x₀ R lam Lam K M₀ hR hlam hLam hK hM₀
  
  have hdq : ∀ (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h ≤ h₀ →
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 8), ∀ y' ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 8),
        |(v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y) / h -
          (v (y' + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y') / h| ≤ C * dist y y' ^ α := by
    intro m h hh hhh y hy y' hy'
    obtain ⟨P, p, hPc, hpc, hwb, hcoer, hPb, hpb, hweak⟩ := hstr m h hh hhh
    have hw : ContDiff ℝ 1
        (fun y => (v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y) / h) :=
      ((hv.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).sub hv).div_const h
    exact hhol _ P p hw hPc hpc hwb hcoer hPb hpb hweak y hy y' hy'
  
  have hlim : ∀ (m : Fin 2) (y : Fin 2 → ℝ),
      Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => (v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y) / h)
        (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (smthGrad v y m)) := by

def smthDQ (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ :=
  fun x => (u (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - u x) / h


def smthHolC : ℕ → ((Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) → Set (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Prop
  | 0, u, S => ContinuousOn u S ∧ ∀ x₀ ∈ S, ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (C α : NNReal), 0 < ρ ∧ 0 < α ∧
      Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ S ∧ HolderOnWith C α u (Metric.ball x₀ ρ)
  | k + 1, u, S => (∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ u x) ∧
      ∀ m : Fin 2, smthHolC k (fun x => smthGrad u x m) S


def smthLinSol (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) : Prop :=
  ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ S →
    ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad φ x i =
      ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad φ x i


def smthSchauderData (lam : ℝ) (K α : NNReal) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) : Prop :=
  (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i j : Fin 2, |a x i j| ≤ (K : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith K α a S ∧
  (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i : Fin 2, |F x i| ≤ (K : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith K α F S ∧
  (∀ x ∈ S, |w x| ≤ (K : ℝ)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w S ∧
  (∃ C₀ : NNReal, HolderOnWith C₀ α (smthGrad w) S) ∧ smthLinSol a F w S
