    refine ⟨hc, hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ?_⟩
    exact HasCompactSupport.intro hK (fun x hx => by simp [hψK x hx])
  
  have hZ0 : ∀ (φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ), x ∉ tsupport φ → φ x = 0 :=
    fun φ x hx => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
  have hZ1 : ∀ (φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ), x ∉ tsupport φ → fderiv ℝ φ x = 0 := by
    intro φ x hx
    by_contra h
    exact hx (support_fderiv_subset ℝ (Function.mem_support.2 h))
  
  have hΛ' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Λ) O := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hΛ).2
  have hv' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ v) D := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hv).2
  have hgrad : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (smthGrad v) D := by
    rw [contDiffOn_pi]
    intro k
    exact hv'.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (y, v y, smthGrad v y)) D :=
    contDiffOn_id.prodMk (hv.prodMk hgrad)
  have hcoef : ∀ w, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ Λ (y, v y, smthGrad v y) w) D := by
    intro w
    exact (hΛ'.comp hΨ (fun y hy => hvO y hy)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ,
      B = fun y => fderiv ℝ Λ (y, v y, smthGrad v y) (0, 1, 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : Fin 2 → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ,
      P = fun k y => fderiv ℝ Λ (y, v y, smthGrad v y) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQdef⟩ : ∃ Q : Fin 2 → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ,
      Q = fun k y => fderiv ℝ (P k) y (Pi.single k 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hE : ∀ y, smthELop Λ v y = B y - ∑ k, Q k y := by
    intro y
    rw [hQdef, hPdef, hBdef]
    rfl
  have hBc : ContinuousOn B D := by rw [hBdef]; exact (hcoef _).continuousOn
  have hPs : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (P k) D := by intro k; rw [hPdef]; exact hcoef _
  have hQc : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (Q k) D := by
    intro k
    rw [hQdef]
    exact ((hPs k).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hD (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hEc : ContinuousOn (smthELop Λ v) D :=
    (hBc.sub (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun k _ => hQc k)).congr (fun y _ => hE y)
  
  have hint0 : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D →
      ∫ x, smthELop Λ v x * φ x = 0 := by
    intro φ hφ hφc hφD
    have hK : IsCompact (tsupport φ) := hφc
    have hφ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ := hφ.of_le (by simp)
    have hφd : Differentiable ℝ φ := hφ1.differentiable (by simp)
    have hdφ : ∀ w, Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ φ x w) := fun w =>
      (hφ1.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hlin : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x) =
        B x * φ x + ∑ k, P k x * fderiv ℝ φ x (Pi.single k 1) := by
      intro x
      rw [hBdef, hPdef]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have hvec : ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), φ x, smthGrad φ x) =
          φ x • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (1:ℝ), (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) +
          (fderiv ℝ φ x (Pi.single 0 1) • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0:ℝ), (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) +
           fderiv ℝ φ x (Pi.single 1 1) • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0:ℝ), (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ))) := by
        refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)
        · simp
        · simp
        · funext i
          fin_cases i <;> simp [smthGrad]
      rw [hvec, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
        smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hoff : ∀ x, x ∉ D → fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x) = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have hxK : x ∉ tsupport φ := fun h => hx (hφD h)
      rw [hlin, hZ0 φ x hxK, hZ1 φ x hxK]
      simp
    have h1 := hEL φ hφ hφc hφD
    rw [setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hoff] at h1
    have h2 : ∫ x, (B x * φ x + ∑ k, P k x * fderiv ℝ φ x (Pi.single k 1)) = 0 := by
      rw [← h1]
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact (hlin x).symm
    have hiB : Integrable (fun x => B x * φ x) :=
      (hmul B φ _ hK hφD hBc hφ.continuous (hZ0 φ)).2
    have hiP : ∀ k, Integrable (fun x => P k x * fderiv ℝ φ x (Pi.single k 1)) := fun k =>
      (hmul (P k) _ _ hK hφD (hPs k).continuousOn (hdφ _)
        (fun x hx => by simp [hZ1 φ x hx])).2
    have hiQ : ∀ k, Integrable (fun x => Q k x * φ x) := fun k =>
      (hmul (Q k) φ _ hK hφD (hQc k) hφ.continuous (hZ0 φ)).2
    have hibp : ∀ k, ∫ x, P k x * fderiv ℝ φ x (Pi.single k 1) = -∫ x, Q k x * φ x := by
      intro k
      have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (fun x => P k x * φ x) := by
        intro x
        by_cases hx : x ∈ D
        · exact (((hPs k).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
            (hD.mem_nhds hx)).mul (hφd x)
        · have hxK : x ∉ tsupport φ := fun h => hx (hφD h)
          have hev : (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun x => P k x * φ x) := by
            filter_upwards [(isClosed_tsupport φ).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxK] with y hy
            rw [hZ0 φ y hy, mul_zero]
          exact (differentiableAt_const _).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev.symm
      have hprod : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ (fun x => P k x * φ x) x (Pi.single k 1) =
          Q k x * φ x + P k x * fderiv ℝ φ x (Pi.single k 1) := by
        intro x
        by_cases hx : x ∈ D
        · have hPd := ((hPs k).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)
          have hh : HasFDerivAt (fun y => P k y * φ y)
              (P k x • fderiv ℝ φ x + φ x • fderiv ℝ (P k) x) x :=
            hPd.hasFDerivAt.mul (hφd x).hasFDerivAt
          rw [hh.fderiv, hQdef]
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
        · have hxK : x ∉ tsupport φ := fun h => hx (hφD h)
          have hev : (fun x => P k x * φ x) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := by
            filter_upwards [(isClosed_tsupport φ).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxK] with y hy
            rw [hZ0 φ y hy, mul_zero]
          rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hZ0 φ x hxK, hZ1 φ x hxK]
          simp
      have hfun : (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun x => P k x * φ x) x (Pi.single k 1)) =
          fun x => Q k x * φ x + P k x * fderiv ℝ φ x (Pi.single k 1) := funext hprod
      have hiH : Integrable (fun x => P k x * φ x) :=
        (hmul (P k) φ _ hK hφD (hPs k).continuousOn hφ.continuous (hZ0 φ)).2
      have hzero : ∫ x, fderiv ℝ (fun x => P k x * φ x) x (Pi.single k 1) = 0 := by
        have h := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable
          (f := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (g := fun x => P k x * φ x) (v := Pi.single k 1)
          (by simp) (by simp only [one_mul]; rw [hfun]; exact (hiQ k).add (hiP k))
          (by simp only [one_mul]; exact hiH) (differentiable_const _) hdiff
        simpa using h
      rw [hfun, integral_add (hiQ k) (hiP k)] at hzero
      linarith
    rw [integral_add hiB (integrable_finset_sum _ fun k _ => hiP k),
      integral_finset_sum _ fun k _ => hiP k] at h2
    calc ∫ x, smthELop Λ v x * φ x = ∫ x, (B x * φ x - ∑ k, Q k x * φ x) := by
          congr 1; funext x; rw [hE, sub_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = (∫ x, B x * φ x) - ∑ k, ∫ x, Q k x * φ x := by
          rw [integral_sub hiB (integrable_finset_sum _ fun k _ => hiQ k),
            integral_finset_sum _ fun k _ => hiQ k]
      _ = (∫ x, B x * φ x) + ∑ k, ∫ x, P k x * fderiv ℝ φ x (Pi.single k 1) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hibp k), Finset.sum_neg_distrib, sub_eq_add_neg]
      _ = 0 := h2
  
  intro x₁ hx₁
  by_contra hne
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun y => smthELop Λ v x₁ * smthELop Λ v y) x₁ :=
    continuousAt_const.mul (hEc.continuousAt (hD.mem_nhds hx₁))
  have hpos : 0 < smthELop Λ v x₁ * smthELop Λ v x₁ := mul_self_pos.2 hne
  have hS : {y | 0 < smthELop Λ v x₁ * smthELop Λ v y} ∈ 𝓝 x₁ :=
    hcont.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hpos)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφs, hφc, hφd, hφr, hφ1⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (n := ⊤) (Filter.inter_mem (hD.mem_nhds hx₁) hS)
  have hφD : tsupport φ ⊆ D := fun y hy => (hφs hy).1
  have h0 := hint0 φ hφd hφc hφD
  have hf_nonneg : ∀ y, 0 ≤ smthELop Λ v x₁ * smthELop Λ v y * φ y := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport φ
    · exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (hφs hy).2) (hφr ⟨y, rfl⟩).1
    · rw [hZ0 φ y hy, mul_zero]
  have hfc := hmul (fun y => smthELop Λ v x₁ * smthELop Λ v y) φ (tsupport φ) hφc hφD
    (continuousOn_const.mul hEc) hφd.continuous (hZ0 φ)
  have hint : ∫ y, smthELop Λ v x₁ * smthELop Λ v y * φ y = 0 := by
    simp_rw [mul_assoc]
    rw [integral_const_mul, h0, mul_zero]
  have hsupp : 0 < volume (Function.support fun y => smthELop Λ v x₁ * smthELop Λ v y * φ y) := by
    refine hfc.1.isOpen_support.measure_pos volume ⟨x₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [Function.mem_support, hφ1, mul_one]
    exact hpos.ne'
  have := (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg hf_nonneg hfc.2).2 hsupp
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (a : Fin 3) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hx : smthLift a x (v x) ∈ U) :
    smthELop (smthLag G a) v x = Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det *
      levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun w => w a - v (smthHoriz a w)) (smthLift a x (v x))

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (a : Fin 3) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hx : smthLift a x (v x) ∈ U) :
    smthELop (smthLag G a) v x = Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det *
      levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun w => w a - v (smthHoriz a w)) (smthLift a x (v x))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  
  have inv_entry : ∀ (x : E3) (m : Fin 3),
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x) → (G x).det ≠ 0 →
      ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x ∧
        partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x =
          -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            (G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l := by
    intro x m hG hdet
    have hdetD : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
        (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => H y a b) x) →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (H y).det) x := by
      intro H hH
      have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
          H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
          - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
          + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
        funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H y)
      rw [hfun]
      have h00 := hH 0 0
      have h01 := hH 0 1
      have h02 := hH 0 2
      have h10 := hH 1 0
      have h11 := hH 1 1
      have h12 := hH 1 2
      have h20 := hH 2 0
      have h21 := hH 2 1
      have h22 := hH 2 2
      fun_prop
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y).det) x := hdetD G hG
    have hP : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x := by
      intro k l
      have hfun : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) =
          fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det := by
        funext y
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
          smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hfun]
      refine (hD.inv hdet).mul (hdetD _ ?_)
      intro a b
      by_cases hal : a = l
      · subst hal
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact differentiableAt_const _
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hal]
        exact hG a b
    have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (G y).det ≠ 0 := hD.continuousAt.eventually_ne hdet
    have hE : ∀ a l : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G x a b * partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
        + ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l = 0 := by
      intro a l
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (∑ b : Fin 3, (G x a b • fderiv ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
            + (G x)⁻¹ b l • fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)) x := by
        have hs := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
          (A := fun b y => G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (fun b _ => (hG a b).hasFDerivAt.mul (hP b l).hasFDerivAt)
        convert hs using 1
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
        apply (hasFDerivAt_const (if a = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
        have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G y) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy)) a) l
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
        exact this
      have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e m)) (h1.unique h2)
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h3
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [← h3, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      ring
    intro k l
    refine ⟨hP k l, ?_⟩
    let Xm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun b l => partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
    let Dm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun a b => partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x
    have hM : G x * Xm = -(Dm * (G x)⁻¹) := by
      ext a l'
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
      simp only [Xm, Dm, Matrix.of_apply]
      exact hE a l'
    have hX : Xm = -((G x)⁻¹ * (Dm * (G x)⁻¹)) := by
      calc Xm = ((G x)⁻¹ * G x) * Xm := by
            rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet), Matrix.one_mul]
        _ = (G x)⁻¹ * (G x * Xm) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [hM, Matrix.mul_neg]
    have hkl := congrFun (congrFun hX k) l
    simp only [Xm, Dm, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply] at hkl
    rw [hkl]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring
  
  
  have hdivx : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3), IsOpen T →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) → (∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T → ∀ (X : E3 → E3), (∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) →
      ∀ (y : E3), y ∈ T →
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y →
      sepDensDiv G X y = Real.sqrt (G y).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y := by
    intro f T hT hG hpd hf X hX y hy hN
    
    have key : ∀ (Ginv : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (dS : Fin 3 → ℝ)
        (dGi : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Γp : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (p : Fin 3 → ℝ)
        (h : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (s N : ℝ), (∀ a b : Fin 3, Ginv a b = Ginv b a) →
        (∑ i : Fin 3, dS i * ∑ k : Fin 3, Ginv i k * p k +
            s * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, dGi i i k * p k =
          -(s * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Ginv i j * Γp i j)) →
        (∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, Ginv i k * p k) * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            dGi i a b * p a * p b =
          -2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            Ginv i a * p a * (Ginv j b * p b) * Γp i j) →
        ∑ i : Fin 3, (dS i * (N⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin 3, Ginv i k * p k) +
          s * (-((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (dGi i a b * p a * p b + Ginv a b * h i a * p b +
              Ginv a b * p a * h i b)) / (2 * N ^ 3)) * ∑ k : Fin 3, Ginv i k * p k +
            N⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin 3, (dGi i i k * p k + Ginv i k * h i k))) =
        s * ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Ginv i j * (h i j - Γp i j)) / N -
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            Ginv i a * p a * (Ginv j b * p b) * (h i j - Γp i j)) / N ^ 3) := by
      intro Ginv dS dGi Γp p h s N hsym hA1 hA2
      have e10 := hsym 1 0
      have e20 := hsym 2 0
      have e21 := hsym 2 1
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, e10, e20, e21] at hA1 hA2 ⊢
      linear_combination N⁻¹ * hA1 - (s * N⁻¹ ^ 3 / 2) * hA2
    
    have hTy : T ∈ 𝓝 y := hT.mem_nhds hy
    have hdet : 0 < (G y).det := (hpd y hy).det_pos
    have hGd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y := fun a b =>
      ((hG a b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hTy
    have hpd' : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv a f) y := by
      intro a
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f y := hf.contDiffAt hTy
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) y :=
        ((contDiffAt_infty.1 h1) 2).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)
      have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y := h2.differentiableAt one_ne_zero
      exact h3.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e a))
    have hsymI : ∀ a b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b = (G y)⁻¹ b a := by
      have hS : (G y).IsSymm := Matrix.IsSymm.ext (fun i j => hsymm y j i)
      have hSi := hS.inv
      intro a b
      exact hSi.apply b a
    
    have hs1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y ∧
        partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y = Real.sqrt (G y).det / 2 *
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv i (fun z => G z a b) y := by
      intro i
      have hfun : (fun z => (G z).det) = fun z =>

  have hΛd : ∀ w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ), smthLift a w.1 w.2.1 ∈ U →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (smthLag G a) w := by
    intro w hw
    have hdet : 0 < (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).det := (hpd _ hw).det_pos
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).det) w :=
      DifferentiableAt.comp (g := fun y => (G y).det)
        (f := fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => smthLift a w.1 w.2.1) w
        (hdetD G _ (hGd _ hw)) (hLd w)
    have h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹ i j) w :=
      fun i j => DifferentiableAt.comp (g := fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j)
        (f := fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => smthLift a w.1 w.2.1) w
        ((inv_entry _ 0 (hGd _ hw) hdet.ne' i j).1) (hLd w)
    have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) =>
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹ i j *
          smthCovec a w.2.2 i * smthCovec a w.2.2 j) w := by
      apply DifferentiableAt.fun_sum; intro i _
      apply DifferentiableAt.fun_sum; intro j _
      exact ((h2 i j).mul (hCd i w)).mul (hCd j w)
    have hQ := hQpos _ (hpd _ hw) w.2.2
    exact (h1.sqrt hdet.ne').mul (h3.sqrt hQ.ne')
  
  set W : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ := fun i w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * calUnitNormal G f w i with hWdef
  have hWd : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (W i) y := by
    intro y hy i
    have hdet := (hpd y hy).det_pos
    have hs : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det) y :=
      (hdetD G y (hGd y hy)).sqrt hdet.ne'
    have hGi : ∀ b c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ b c) y :=
      fun b c => (inv_entry y 0 (hGd y hy) hdet.ne' b c).1
    have hQd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3,
        (G w)⁻¹ b c * partialDeriv b f w * partialDeriv c f w) y := by
      apply DifferentiableAt.fun_sum; intro b _
      apply DifferentiableAt.fun_sum; intro c _
      exact ((hGi b c).mul (hpdf y b)).mul (hpdf y c)
    have hQp : 0 < ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ b c * partialDeriv b f y * partialDeriv c f y := by
      simp only [hdf]; exact hQpos _ (hpd y hy) _
    have hUd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => ∑ k : Fin 3, (G w)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f w) y := by
      apply DifferentiableAt.fun_sum; intro k _
      exact (hGi i k).mul (hpdf y k)
    have hR : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => (Real.sqrt (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3,
        (G w)⁻¹ b c * partialDeriv b f w * partialDeriv c f w))⁻¹) y :=
      (hQd.sqrt hQp.ne').inv (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hQp).ne'
    exact hs.mul (hR.mul hUd)
  
  have lineD : ∀ (w d : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (smthLag G a) w →
      (∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 (0:ℝ), smthLag G a (w + s • d) = φ s) → HasDerivAt φ c 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) w d = c := by
    intro w d φ c hΛ hev hφ
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => w + s • d) d 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const d).const_add w
    have h2 : HasDerivAt ((smthLag G a) ∘ fun s : ℝ => w + s • d)
        (fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) w d) 0 :=
      hΛ.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 h1 (by simp)
    exact h2.unique (hφ.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev)
  
  have hpD : ∀ w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ), smthLift a w.1 w.2.1 ∈ U → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) w (0, 0, Pi.single k 1) =
        -(Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).det *
          ((Real.sqrt (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹ b c *
              smthCovec a w.2.2 b * smthCovec a w.2.2 c))⁻¹ *
            ∑ m : Fin 3, (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹ (a.succAbove k) m * smthCovec a w.2.2 m)) := by
    rintro ⟨y, t, p⟩ hw k
    dsimp only at hw ⊢
    have hdet := (hpd _ hw).det_pos
    have hQ := hQpos _ (hpd _ hw) p
    have hsymA : ∀ b c : Fin 3, (G (smthLift a y t))⁻¹ b c = (G (smthLift a y t))⁻¹ c b := by
      have hS' : (G (smthLift a y t)).IsSymm := Matrix.IsSymm.ext (fun i j => hsymm _ j i)
      intro b c; exact hS'.inv.apply c b
    have hcov : ∀ (s : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
        smthCovec a (p + s • (Pi.single k (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) i =
        smthCovec a p i - s * (Pi.single (a.succAbove k) (1:ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ) i := by
      intro s i
      rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with h | ⟨l, h⟩
      · rw [h, hCa, hCa, Pi.single_apply, if_neg (Fin.succAbove_ne a k).symm]; ring
      · rw [h, hCs, hCs]
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.single_apply,
          Fin.succAbove_right_inj]
        ring
    set A := (G (smthLift a y t))⁻¹ with hA
    set ξ := smthCovec a p with hξ
    set η : Fin 3 → ℝ := Pi.single (a.succAbove k) (1:ℝ) with hη
    have hev : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 (0:ℝ), smthLag G a ((y, t, p) + s • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ),
        (Pi.single k (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) =
        Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a y t)).det * Real.sqrt ((∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * ξ b * ξ c)
          - s * (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * (η b * ξ c + ξ b * η c))
          + s ^ 2 * (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * η b * η c)) := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => ?_)
      simp only [Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, smul_zero, add_zero, smthLag]
      rw [← hpoly]
      simp only [hcov, hA]
    have hq : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * ξ b * ξ c)
          - s * (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * (η b * ξ c + ξ b * η c))
          + s ^ 2 * (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * η b * η c))
        (-(∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * (η b * ξ c + ξ b * η c))) 0 := by
      have h := (((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).mul_const
        (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * (η b * ξ c + ξ b * η c))).const_sub
        (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * ξ b * ξ c)).add
        (((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).pow 2).mul_const (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * η b * η c))
      convert h using 1
      simp
    have h0 : (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * ξ b * ξ c)
          - 0 * (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * (η b * ξ c + ξ b * η c))
          + 0 ^ 2 * (∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * η b * η c) =
        ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A b c * ξ b * ξ c := by ring
    have hsqd := (hq.sqrt (by rw [h0]; exact hQ.ne')).const_mul (Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a y t)).det)
    rw [lineD _ _ _ _ (hΛd (y, t, p) hw) hev hsqd, h0, hβ A ξ hsymA (a.succAbove k)]
    ring
  
  have hline : ∀ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthLift a y t ∈ U →
      smthLag G a (y, t, smthGrad v y) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, smthCovec a (smthGrad v y) i * W i (smthLift a y t) := by
    intro y t _
    simp only [hWdef, calUnitNormal, hdf, hHL, smthLag]
    exact (hkey _ _ _).symm
  
  set z := smthLift a x (v x) with hzdef
  
  have hT : fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, 1, 0) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i * partialDeriv a (W i) z := by
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z + s • e a) (e a) 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const (e a)).const_add z
    have hsum := HasDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
      (A := fun i s => smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i * W i (z + s • e a))
      (A' := fun i => smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i * partialDeriv a (W i) z)
      (fun i _ => ((hWd z hx i).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hl (by simp)).const_mul
        (smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i))
    refine lineD _ _ _ _ (hΛd (x, v x, smthGrad v x) hx) ?_ hsum
    have hcont : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => z + s • e a) := by fun_prop
    have hev : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 (0:ℝ), z + s • e a ∈ U := by
      apply hcont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
      exact hU.mem_nhds hx
    filter_upwards [hev] with s hs
    have hw : (x, v x, smthGrad v x) + s • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) =
        (x, v x + s, smthGrad v x) := by
      simp only [Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, smul_zero, add_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have hz' : smthLift a x (v x + s) = z + s • e a := by
      rw [hzdef, hLrep, hLrep, add_smul, add_assoc]
    rw [hw, hline x (v x + s) (by rw [hz']; exact hs), hz']
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
  
  have hP : ∀ k : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) (y, v y, smthGrad v y) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1)) x
        (Pi.single k 1) =
      -(partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) (W (a.succAbove k)) z +
        smthGrad v x k * partialDeriv a (W (a.succAbove k)) z) := by
    intro k
    have hvc : Continuous v := hv.continuous
    have hγrep : (fun y => smthLift a y (v y)) =
        fun y => ∑ l : Fin 2, y l • e (a.succAbove l) + v y • e a := by
      funext y; exact hLrep _ _
    have hγc : Continuous (fun y => smthLift a y (v y)) := by rw [hγrep]; fun_prop
    have hγD : HasFDerivAt (fun y => smthLift a y (v y))
        (∑ l : Fin 2, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj l : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
          (e (a.succAbove l)) + (fderiv ℝ v x).smulRight (e a)) x := by
      rw [hγrep]
      apply HasFDerivAt.add
      · apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
        intro l _
        exact (hasFDerivAt_apply l x).smul_const _
      · exact (hvd x).hasFDerivAt.smul_const _
    have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, smthLift a y (v y) ∈ U :=
      hγc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    have hPev : (fun y => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) (y, v y, smthGrad v y) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => -W (a.succAbove k) (smthLift a y (v y))) := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
      rw [hpD (y, v y, smthGrad v y) hy k]
      simp only [hWdef, calUnitNormal, hdf, hHL]
    rw [hPev.fderiv_eq]
    have hWz : HasFDerivAt (W (a.succAbove k)) (fderiv ℝ (W (a.succAbove k)) z)
        (smthLift a x (v x)) := (hWd z hx (a.succAbove k)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => W (a.succAbove k) (smthLift a y (v y)))
        ((fderiv ℝ (W (a.succAbove k)) z).comp
          (∑ l : Fin 2, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj l : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
            (e (a.succAbove l)) + (fderiv ℝ v x).smulRight (e a))) x :=
      HasFDerivAt.comp (g := W (a.succAbove k)) (f := fun y => smthLift a y (v y)) x hWz hγD
    have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun y => -W (a.succAbove k) (smthLift a y (v y)))
        (-((fderiv ℝ (W (a.succAbove k)) z).comp
          (∑ l : Fin 2, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj l : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
            (e (a.succAbove l)) + (fderiv ℝ v x).smulRight (e a)))) x :=
      hc1.neg
    rw [hcomp.fderiv]
    have hin : (∑ l : Fin 2, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj l : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
          (e (a.succAbove l)) + (fderiv ℝ v x).smulRight (e a)) (Pi.single k 1) =
        e (a.succAbove k) + smthGrad v x k • e a := by
      simp [Pi.single_apply, smthGrad]
      fin_cases k <;> simp
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hin, map_add, map_smul,
      smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  
  have hE : smthELop (smthLag G a) v x = ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (W i) z := by
    unfold smthELop
    rw [hT, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hP k),
      Fin.sum_univ_succAbove (fun i => smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i * partialDeriv a (W i) z) a,
      Fin.sum_univ_succAbove (fun i => partialDeriv i (W i) z) a]
    simp only [hCa, hCs, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  set X : E3 → E3 := fun w => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal G f w i)
    with hXdef
  have hXW : sepDensDiv G X z = ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (W i) z := rfl
  have hN : 0 < ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ b c * partialDeriv b f z * partialDeriv c f z := by
    simp only [hdf]; exact hQpos _ (hpd z hx) _
  rw [hE, ← hXW]
  exact hdivx f U hU hG hpd hfC.contDiffOn X (fun _ _ _ => rfl) z hx hN

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p q : M)
    (E W : Set M) (hE : sepChartMeas E) (hW : IsOpen W) (hWp : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source)
    (hWq : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) :
    sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
        (chartAt E3 q '' W) ≤
      sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (chartAt E3 p '' W)

signature.name: sepPerG_chart_le
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p q : M)
    (E W : Set M) (hE : sepChartMeas E) (hW : IsOpen W) (hWp : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source)
    (hWq : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) :
    sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
        (chartAt E3 q '' W) ≤
      sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (chartAt E3 p '' W)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have jacdet : ∀ (Y : E3 → E3) (x : E3), (jacMat Y x).det = (fderiv ℝ Y x).det := by
    intro Y x
    have h : jacMat Y x = LinearMap.toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis (fderiv ℝ Y x : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) := by
      ext i a
      rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
      simp [jacMat, e]
    rw [h, LinearMap.det_toMatrix]
  
  have densZero : ∀ (G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (y : E3),
      y ∉ tsupport X → sepDensDiv G' X y = 0 := by
    intro G' X y hy
    have hX : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    unfold partialDeriv
    have h : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G' z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hX] with z hz
      simp [hz]
    rw [h.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hOp : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p '' W) := (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source hW hWp
  have hOq : IsOpen (chartAt E3 q '' W) := (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_image_of_subset_source hW hWq
  have hSp : MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) := hE p
  have hSq : MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) := hE q
  set τ : E3 → E3 := fun z => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) with hτdef
  set σ : E3 → E3 := fun z => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) with hσdef
  
  have hOpt : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' W,
      y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ W := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source (hWp hx), by rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hWp hx)]; exact hx⟩
  have hOqt : ∀ z ∈ chartAt E3 q '' W,
      z ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm z ∈ W := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(chartAt E3 q).map_source (hWq hx), by rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv (hWq hx)]; exact hx⟩
  have hτx : ∀ x ∈ W, τ (chartAt E3 p x) = chartAt E3 q x := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [hτdef, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hWp hx)]
  have hτO : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' W, τ y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' W := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [hτx x hx]
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hσO : ∀ z ∈ chartAt E3 q '' W, σ z ∈ chartAt E3 p '' W := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
    simp only [hσdef, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv (hWq hx)]
  have hστ : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' W, σ (τ y) = y := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [hτx x hx]
    simp only [hσdef, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv (hWq hx)]
  
  have hτs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ (chartAt E3 p '' W) := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (chartAt E3 p '' W) :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart (x := q)).comp ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := p)).mono
        (fun y hy => (hOpt y hy).1)) (fun y hy => hWq (hOpt y hy).2)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  
  have hσc : ContinuousOn σ (chartAt E3 q '' W) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.comp ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn_symm.mono
      (fun z hz => (hOqt z hz).1)) (fun z hz => hWp (hOqt z hz).2)
  
  have hinj : Set.InjOn τ (chartAt E3 p '' W) := by
    intro y₁ h₁ y₂ h₂ h
    rw [← hστ y₁ h₁, ← hστ y₂ h₂, h]
  
  have himg : τ '' (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ chartAt E3 p '' W) =
      chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩ chartAt E3 q '' W := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨⟨x', hx', hx'e⟩, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
      have hxx : x' = x := (chartAt E3 p).injOn hx'.2 (hWp hx) hx'e
      subst hxx
      rw [hτx x' hx]
      exact ⟨⟨x', ⟨hx'.1, hWq hx⟩, rfl⟩, ⟨x', hx, rfl⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨x', hx', hx'e⟩, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
      have hxx : x' = x := (chartAt E3 q).injOn hx'.2 (hWq hx) hx'e
      subst hxx
      exact ⟨chartAt E3 p x', ⟨⟨x', ⟨hx'.1, hWp hx⟩, rfl⟩, ⟨x', hx, rfl⟩⟩, hτx x' hx⟩
  
  have hpt : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' W,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y ∧
      (jacMat τ y).det ≠ 0 ∧
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det =
        |(jacMat τ y).det| * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm (τ y)).det ∧
      ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j * v i * v j =

[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p₁ p₂ : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₁).target)

    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧

        g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) ∧
    (∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y = ∑ a : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *

subgoal_signatures.name: piola_div_of_null
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(Y : E3 → E3) (W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x)
    (hA : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x)
    (hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y i) (Y x))
    (hP : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x = 0) :
    ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i * W (Y z) i) x
      = (jacMat Y x).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => W y i) (Y x)

        (jacMat τ y).det * X' y a = ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat τ y).adjugate a i * X (τ y) i) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ O₁, ∀ i : Fin 3, X (τ y) i = ∑ a : Fin 3, jacMat τ y i a * X' y a) ∧
      (∀ y, y ∉ O₁ → X' y = 0)

      ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
    (hdτ.comp hσ hmaps).clm_apply (hY.comp_contDiffOn hσ)
  
  have hR₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
      ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Set.indicator (chartAt E3 p).source (fun x : M =>
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x)
          (Y (chartAt E3 p x)) : E3)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3))
      ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 p).source) := by
    refine hF.congr (fun y hy => ?_)
    have hm : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := hy.2
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hm]
    exact chain y hy.1 hm _
  
  have hCc : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 p).symm '' tsupport Y) :=
    hYc.isCompact.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.mono hYt)
  have hCcl : IsClosed ((chartAt E3 p).symm '' tsupport Y) := hCc.isClosed
  have hCs : (chartAt E3 p).symm '' tsupport Y ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_target (hYt hy)
  have hZ0 : ∀ x : M, x ∉ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' tsupport Y →
      Set.indicator (chartAt E3 p).source (fun x : M =>
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x)
          (Y (chartAt E3 p x)) : E3)) x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hs : x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hs]
      have hY0 : Y (chartAt E3 p x) = 0 := by
        refine image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx ?_)
        exact ⟨_, h, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hs⟩
      simp only [hY0, map_zero]
    · exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hs _
  have hO₂ : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩
      (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 p).symm '' tsupport Y)ᶜ) :=
    (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hCcl.isOpen_compl
  have hR₂ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
      ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Set.indicator (chartAt E3 p).source (fun x : M =>
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x)
          (Y (chartAt E3 p x)) : E3)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3))
      ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩
        (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 p).symm '' tsupport Y)ᶜ) := by
    refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : E3))).congr (fun y hy => ?_)
    rw [hZ0 _ hy.2, map_zero]
  
  refine contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn (fun y hy => ?_)
  by_cases h : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' tsupport Y
  · exact ⟨_, hO₁, ⟨hy, hCs h⟩, hR₁.mono Set.inter_subset_right⟩
  · exact ⟨_, hO₂, ⟨hy, h⟩, hR₂.mono Set.inter_subset_right⟩

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (p : M) (C : Set M) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCs : C ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source) : ∃ ζ : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ζ ∧ IsCompact (tsupport ζ) ∧ tsupport ζ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source ∧ ∀ x ∈ C, ζ x = 1

signature.name: chart_bump_eq_one
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (p : M) (C : Set M) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCs : C ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source) : ∃ ζ : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ζ ∧ IsCompact (tsupport ζ) ∧ tsupport ζ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source ∧ ∀ x ∈ C, ζ x = 1

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set κ := chartAt E3 p with hκ
  
  have hC'c : IsCompact (κ '' C) := hC.image_of_continuousOn (κ.continuousOn.mono hCs)
  have hC'cl : IsClosed (κ '' C) := hC'c.isClosed
  have hC't : κ '' C ⊆ κ.target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact κ.map_source (hCs hx)
  
  obtain ⟨N, hNo, hC'N, hNt, hNc⟩ :=
    exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hC'c κ.open_target hC't
  
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ0, hχ1, -⟩ := exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_of_isClosed 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (n := ⊤)
    hNo.isClosed_compl hC'cl (Set.disjoint_compl_left_iff_subset.mpr hC'N)
  have hχs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ χ := χ.contMDiff
  have hχN : ∀ y, χ y ≠ 0 → y ∈ N := by
    intro y hy
    by_contra h
    exact hy (hχ0 h)
  
  set ζ : M → ℝ := Set.indicator κ.source (fun x => χ (κ x)) with hζ
  have hSs : κ.symm '' closure N ⊆ κ.source := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact κ.map_target (hNt hy)
  have hSc : IsCompact (κ.symm '' closure N) :=
    hNc.image_of_continuousOn (κ.continuousOn_symm.mono hNt)
  have hScl : IsClosed (κ.symm '' closure N) := hSc.isClosed
  
  have hsupp : Function.support ζ ⊆ κ.symm '' closure N := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : ζ x ≠ 0 := hx
    by_cases hxs : x ∈ κ.source
    · have h1 : ζ x = χ (κ x) := Set.indicator_of_mem hxs _
      rw [h1] at hx'
      exact ⟨κ x, subset_closure (hχN _ hx'), κ.left_inv hxs⟩
    · exact absurd (Set.indicator_of_notMem hxs _) hx'
  have htsupp : tsupport ζ ⊆ κ.symm '' closure N := closure_minimal hsupp hScl
  have htsrc : tsupport ζ ⊆ κ.source := htsupp.trans hSs
  
  have hsmooth : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ζ := by
    apply contMDiff_of_tsupport
    intro x hx
    have hxs : x ∈ κ.source := htsrc hx
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun y => χ (κ y)) κ.source :=
      hχs.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart
    have h2 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun y => χ (κ y)) x :=
      h1.contMDiffAt (κ.open_source.mem_nhds hxs)
    refine h2.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (κ.open_source.mem_nhds hxs)
      (fun y hy => Set.indicator_of_mem hy _)
  refine ⟨ζ, hsmooth, hSc.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport ζ) htsupp, htsrc, ?_⟩
  
  intro x hx
  have h1 : ζ x = χ (κ x) := Set.indicator_of_mem (hCs hx) _
  rw [h1]
  exact hχ1 ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (q : M) (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) (W : M → E3) (hW : calSmoothField W) : (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det * calPiece q ψ W z i)) ∧ Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q ψ W))

signature.name: calPiece_regular
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (q : M) (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) (W : M → E3) (hW : calSmoothField W) : (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det * calPiece q ψ W z i)) ∧ Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q ψ W))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hposdef : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  set T : Set E3 := (chartAt E3 q).target with hTdef
  set w : E3 → E3 := fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
      ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (W ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3) with hwdef
  set G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm with hGdef
  have hTo : IsOpen T := (chartAt E3 q).open_target
  have hwT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w T := hW q
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) T := fun i j => g.smooth q i j
  have hdetpos : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 < (G y).det := fun y hy =>
    (hposdef y hy).det_pos
  have hdetT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) T := by
    have e : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y => G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2
        - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1
        - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2 + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0
        + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
      funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
    rw [e]
    have h := hGs
    exact (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
      (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
      (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
  have hsqT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) T :=
    hdetT.sqrt (fun y hy => (hdetpos y hy).ne')
  have hwi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w y i) T := by
    intro i
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hwT
  have hψT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) T := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      hψ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  have hcp : ∀ (z : E3) (i : Fin 3),
      calPiece q ψ W z i = T.indicator (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * w y i) z := by
    intro z i
    by_cases hz : z ∈ T
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
      simp only [calPiece]
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
      rw [WithLp.ofLp_smul]
      rfl
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
      simp only [calPiece]
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
      simp
  have hKc : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 q) '' tsupport ψ) :=
    hψc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn.mono hψs)
  have hKT : (chartAt E3 q) '' tsupport ψ ⊆ T := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hψs hx)
  have hvan : ∀ (y : E3) (i : Fin 3), y ∉ (chartAt E3 q) '' tsupport ψ →
      T.indicator (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * w y i) y = 0 := by
    intro y i hy
    by_cases hyT : y ∈ T
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyT]
      have h0 : ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = 0 := by
        apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
        intro hmem
        exact hy ⟨_, hmem, (chartAt E3 q).right_inv hyT⟩
      rw [h0, zero_mul]
    · exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hyT _
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, ∀ i z, F i z =
      Real.sqrt (G z).det * T.indicator (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * w y i) z :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hF : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F i) := by
    intro i
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ T
    · have hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
          (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * w y i)) T :=
        hsqT.mul (hψT.mul (hwi i))
      refine (hH.contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hz)).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hTo.mem_nhds hz] with y hy
      rw [hFdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
    · have hzK : z ∉ (chartAt E3 q) '' tsupport ψ := fun h => hz (hKT h)
      refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hKc.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hzK] with y hy
      rw [hFdef, hvan y i hy, mul_zero]
  have hFc : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (F i) := by
    intro i
    exact HasCompactSupport.intro hKc (fun y hy => by rw [hFdef, hvan y i hy, mul_zero])
  have hk_pt : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * calPiece q ψ W z i) = F i := by
    intro i; funext z; rw [hFdef, hcp]
  have hdiv : sepDensDiv G (calPiece q ψ W) =
      fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (F i) y := by
    funext y
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [hk_pt i]
  refine ⟨fun i => by rw [hk_pt i]; exact hF i, ?_⟩
  rw [hdiv]
  refine integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
  have hc : Continuous (partialDeriv i (F i)) :=
    ((hF i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hs : HasCompactSupport (partialDeriv i (F i)) :=
    (hFc i).fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e i)
  exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hs

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p q : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (hφ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ) (hφc : IsCompact (tsupport φ)) (hφs : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) (V : M → E3) (hV : calSmoothField V) (E : Set M) (hE : sepChartMeas E) : ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ V) y = ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q φ V) y

signature.name: calPiece_div_integral_chart_eq
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p q : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (hφ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ) (hφc : IsCompact (tsupport φ)) (hφs : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) (V : M → E3) (hV : calSmoothField V) (E : Set M) (hE : sepChartMeas E) : ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ V) y = ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q φ V) y

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hKp : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := fun x hx => (hφs hx).1
  have hKq : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source := fun x hx => (hφs hx).2
  
  have zeroOff : ∀ r : M, tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 r).source →
      ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y : E3), y ∉ chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ →
        sepDensDiv G (calPiece r φ V) y = 0 := by
    intro r hKr G y hy
    have hKrc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ) :=
      hφc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 r).continuousOn.mono hKr)
    have hz : ∀ z, z ∉ chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ → calPiece r φ V z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      unfold calPiece
      by_cases hzt : z ∈ (chartAt E3 r).target
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hzt]
        have h0 : φ ((chartAt E3 r).symm z) = 0 := by
          by_contra h0
          exact hz ⟨_, subset_tsupport _ h0, (chartAt E3 r).right_inv hzt⟩
        simp [h0]
      · exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hzt _
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * calPiece r φ V z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hKrc.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz'
      rw [hz z hz']
      simp
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have restrict : ∀ r : M, tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 r).source →
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 r '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 r).source),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 r).symm) (calPiece r φ V) y =
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 r '' (E ∩ tsupport φ),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 r).symm) (calPiece r φ V) y := by
    intro r hKr
    have hKrc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ) :=
      hφc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 r).continuousOn.mono hKr)
    have hfun : sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 r).symm) (calPiece r φ V) =
        (chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ).indicator
          (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 r).symm) (calPiece r φ V)) := by
      funext y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy]

      rw [hcpx, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
    rw [h1, h2]
    show (fderiv ℝ τ y) _ = (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) τ (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)))

  exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hAp_meas pw

[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p₁ p₂ : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₁).target)

    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) ∧
    (∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y = ∑ a : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z))
            (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)))

      (chartAt E3 (x.2.1 k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (x.2.1 k)).source))

      Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (x.2.2 k) (x.2.2 l))

    intro V
    unfold sepRiemPer
    refine iSup_le fun n => iSup_le fun p => iSup_le fun W => iSup_le fun h => ?_

    obtain ⟨m, p', W'⟩ := y

    obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hy

      intro k l hkl
      induction k using Fin.addCases with
      | left i =>
        induction l using Fin.addCases with
        | left j =>
          simp only [Fin.append_left]
          exact hx2 (fun h => hkl (by rw [h]))
        | right j =>

      (Set.disjoint_iUnion_right.2 fun i => hUd (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm)
    exact (add_le_add le_rfl h1).trans h2

      rw [hval y hyt, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx, zero_smul]
    · exact hval0 y hyt
  have hCon : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (calPiece p ψ V) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hψ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    exact (h1.smul (hV p)).congr hval
  have hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (calPiece p ψ V) := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ
    · exact hCon.contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds (hKt hy))
    · have hev : calPiece p ψ V =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
        filter_upwards [hKcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz using hZ z hz
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hHC : HasCompactSupport (calPiece p ψ V) := HasCompactSupport.intro hKc hZ
  have hT : tsupport (calPiece p ψ V) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ :=
    closure_minimal (fun y hy => by_contra fun h => hy (hZ y h)) hKcl
  
  set X : E3 → E3 := fun z => c⁻¹ • calPiece p ψ V z with hXdef
  have hXC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X := hC.const_smul c⁻¹
  have hXK : HasCompactSupport X := hHC.mono (fun y hy h => hy (by simp [hXdef, h]))
  have hXT : tsupport X ⊆ (chartAt E3 p) '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
    (tsupport_smul_subset_right (fun _ => c⁻¹) (calPiece p ψ V)).trans
      (hT.trans (Set.image_mono hψs))
  
  have hexp : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a : E3),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B (L (e i)) (L (e j)) * a i * a j = B (L a) (L a) := by
    intro L B a
    have ha : a = a 0 • e 0 + a 1 • e 1 + a 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_rhs => rw [ha]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hXN : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
    · have hxs : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
      have hchain : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) w) = w := by
        intro w
        have h := (mdifferentiable_chart (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) p).symm_comp_deriv hxs
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv hy] at h
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun h w
      have hXy : X y = (c⁻¹ * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) • mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3)
          (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := by
        simp only [hXdef, hval y hy, smul_smul]
      have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j * X y i * X y j =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (X y))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (X y)) :=
        hexp _ _ _
      rw [hsum, hXy]
      simp only [map_smul, hchain, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have h1 : |c⁻¹ * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hc), inv_mul_le_iff₀ hc, mul_one]
        exact hψb _
      have h2 : (c⁻¹ * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (c⁻¹ * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))]
      have h3 := hV1 ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
      have h4 : 0 ≤ (c⁻¹ * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 h4]
    · have hX0 : X y = 0 := by simp [hXdef, hval0 y hy]
      simp [hX0]
  
  have hS4 : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y) ≤
      sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (chartAt E3 p '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) := by
    unfold sepPerG
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le X ⟨hXC, hXK, hXT, hXN⟩ le_rfl
  
  have hS5 : sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (chartAt E3 p '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ≤ sepRiemPer g E U := by
    unfold sepRiemPer
    refine le_iSup_of_le 1 (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ => p) (le_iSup_of_le
      (fun _ => U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) (le_iSup_of_le
      ⟨fun _ => ⟨hU.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source, subset_rfl⟩,
        fun k l hkl => absurd (Subsingleton.elim k l) hkl⟩ ?_)))
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one]
  
  have hcal : calPiece p ψ V = fun z => c • X z := by
    funext z
    simp only [hXdef, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_smul]
  have hdiv : ∀ y, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y =
      c * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y := by
    intro y
    rw [hcal]
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have hf : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * (c • X z) i) =
        c • (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) := by
      funext z; simp only [Pi.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [hf, fderiv_const_smul_of_field]
    simp
  have hint : ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y =
      c * ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hdiv)
  
  rw [hint, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc.le]
  exact mul_le_mul_left' (hS4.trans hS5) _

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M) {m : ℕ} (ψ : Fin m → M → ℝ) (hψ : ∀ k, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ k)) (hψc : ∀ k, IsCompact (tsupport (ψ k))) (hψs : ∀ k, tsupport (ψ k) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source) (V : M → E3) (hV : calSmoothField V) (S : Set E3) : ∫ y in S, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p (fun x => ∑ k, ψ k x) V) y = ∑ k, ∫ y in S, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p (ψ k) V) y

signature.name: calPiece_div_integral_sum
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M) {m : ℕ} (ψ : Fin m → M → ℝ) (hψ : ∀ k, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ k)) (hψc : ∀ k, IsCompact (tsupport (ψ k))) (hψs : ∀ k, tsupport (ψ k) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source) (V : M → E3) (hV : calSmoothField V) (S : Set E3) : ∫ y in S, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p (fun x => ∑ k, ψ k x) V) y = ∑ k, ∫ y in S, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p (ψ k) V) y

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  
  have hposdef : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  set T : Set E3 := (chartAt E3 p).target with hTdef
  set w : E3 → E3 := fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p)
      ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3) with hwdef
  set G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm with hGdef
  have hTo : IsOpen T := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
  have hwT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w T := hV p
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) T := fun i j => g.smooth p i j
  have hdetpos : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 < (G y).det := fun y hy =>
    (hposdef y hy).det_pos
  have hdetT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) T := by
    have e : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y => G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2
        - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1
        - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2 + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0
        + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
      funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
    rw [e]
    have h := hGs
    exact (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
      (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
      (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
  have hsqT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) T :=
    hdetT.sqrt (fun y hy => (hdetpos y hy).ne')
  have hwi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w y i) T := by
    intro i
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hwT
  have hψT : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ψ k ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) T := by
    intro k
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ k ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      (hψ k).comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  
  have hcp : ∀ (φ : M → ℝ) (z : E3) (i : Fin 3),
      calPiece p φ V z i = T.indicator (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * w y i) z := by
    intro φ z i
    by_cases hz : z ∈ T
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
      simp only [calPiece]
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
      rw [WithLp.ofLp_smul]
      rfl
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
      simp only [calPiece]
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
      simp
  
  have hKc : ∀ k, IsCompact ((chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport (ψ k)) := fun k =>
    (hψc k).image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono (hψs k))
  have hKT : ∀ k, (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport (ψ k) ⊆ T := by
    rintro k _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source (hψs k hx)
  have hvan : ∀ k (y : E3) (i : Fin 3), y ∉ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport (ψ k) →
      T.indicator (fun y => ψ k ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * w y i) y = 0 := by
    intro k y i hy
    by_cases hyT : y ∈ T
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyT]
      have h0 : ψ k ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = 0 := by
        apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
        intro hmem
        exact hy ⟨_, hmem, (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hyT⟩
      rw [h0, zero_mul]
    · exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hyT _
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Fin m → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, ∀ k i z, F k i z =
      Real.sqrt (G z).det * T.indicator (fun y => ψ k ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * w y i) z :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hF : ∀ k (i : Fin 3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F k i) := by
    intro k i
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ T
    · have hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
          (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (ψ k ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * w y i)) T :=
        hsqT.mul ((hψT k).mul (hwi i))
      refine (hH.contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hz)).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hTo.mem_nhds hz] with y hy
      rw [hFdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
    · have hzK : z ∉ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport (ψ k) := fun h => hz (hKT k h)
      refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [(hKc k).isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hzK] with y hy
      rw [hFdef, hvan k y i hy, mul_zero]
  have hFc : ∀ k (i : Fin 3), HasCompactSupport (F k i) := by
    intro k i
    exact HasCompactSupport.intro (hKc k) (fun y hy => by rw [hFdef, hvan k y i hy, mul_zero])
  have hk_pt : ∀ k (i : Fin 3),
      (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * calPiece p (ψ k) V z i) = F k i := by
    intro k i; funext z; rw [hFdef, hcp]
  have hsum_pt : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * calPiece p (fun x => ∑ k, ψ k x) V z i)
        = fun z => ∑ k, F k i z := by
    intro i; funext z
    simp only [hFdef]
    rw [hcp, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    by_cases hz : z ∈ T
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hz, Finset.sum_mul]
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have hdiv_k : ∀ k, sepDensDiv G (calPiece p (ψ k) V) =
      fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (F k i) y := by
    intro k; funext y
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [hk_pt k i]
  have hdiv : ∀ y, sepDensDiv G (calPiece p (fun x => ∑ k, ψ k x) V) y =
      ∑ k, sepDensDiv G (calPiece p (ψ k) V) y := by
    intro y
    simp only [hdiv_k]
    unfold sepDensDiv
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [hsum_pt i]
    unfold partialDeriv
    have hfs : (fun z => ∑ k, F k i z) = ∑ k, F k i := by
      funext z; rw [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [hfs, fderiv_sum (fun k _ => ((hF k i).differentiable (by simp)) y)]
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have hint : ∀ k, Integrable (sepDensDiv G (calPiece p (ψ k) V)) (volume.restrict S) := by
    intro k
    rw [hdiv_k k]
    refine integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    have hc : Continuous (partialDeriv i (F k i)) :=
      ((hF k i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hs : HasCompactSupport (partialDeriv i (F k i)) :=
      (hFc k i).fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e i)
    exact (hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hs).integrableOn
  simp_rw [hdiv]
  exact integral_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => hint k)

informal_problem.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (t δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∃ a b γ : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ a ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ b ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ γ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ a x ∧ a x ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ b x ∧ b x ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ γ x ∧ γ x ≤ 1 ∧ a x + γ x + b x = 1) ∧ tsupport a ⊆ {x | t < f x} ∧ tsupport b ⊆ {x | f x < t} ∧ tsupport γ ⊆ {x | t - 2 * δ < f x ∧ f x < t + 2 * δ}

signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (t δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∃ a b γ : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ a ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ b ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ γ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ a x ∧ a x ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ b x ∧ b x ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ γ x ∧ γ x ≤ 1 ∧ a x + γ x + b x = 1) ∧ tsupport a ⊆ {x | t < f x} ∧ tsupport b ⊆ {x | f x < t} ∧ tsupport γ ⊆ {x | t - 2 * δ < f x ∧ f x < t + 2 * δ}

proof.tactics:
by
  have hTc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
  have hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun r : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * (r - t) / δ - 1)) :=
    hTc.comp (((contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)).div_const δ).sub
      contDiff_const)
  have hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun r : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * (t - r) / δ - 1)) :=
    hTc.comp (((contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)).div_const δ).sub
      contDiff_const)
  have ha : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
      (fun x => Real.smoothTransition (2 * (f x - t) / δ - 1)) := hA.comp_contMDiff hf
  have hb : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
      (fun x => Real.smoothTransition (2 * (t - f x) / δ - 1)) := hB.comp_contMDiff hf
  have A0 : ∀ x, f x ≤ t + δ / 2 → Real.smoothTransition (2 * (f x - t) / δ - 1) = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    have : 2 * (f x - t) / δ ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one hδ]; linarith
    linarith
  have A1 : ∀ x, t + δ ≤ f x → Real.smoothTransition (2 * (f x - t) / δ - 1) = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    have : 2 ≤ 2 * (f x - t) / δ := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]; linarith
    linarith
  have B0 : ∀ x, t - δ / 2 ≤ f x → Real.smoothTransition (2 * (t - f x) / δ - 1) = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    have : 2 * (t - f x) / δ ≤ 1 := by rw [div_le_one hδ]; linarith
    linarith
  have B1 : ∀ x, f x ≤ t - δ → Real.smoothTransition (2 * (t - f x) / δ - 1) = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    have : 2 ≤ 2 * (t - f x) / δ := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]; linarith
    linarith
  refine ⟨fun x => Real.smoothTransition (2 * (f x - t) / δ - 1),
    fun x => Real.smoothTransition (2 * (t - f x) / δ - 1),
    fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (f x - t) / δ - 1)
      - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (t - f x) / δ - 1),
    ha, hb, (contMDiff_const.sub ha).sub hb, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    have h1 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (2 * (f x - t) / δ - 1)
    have h2 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (2 * (f x - t) / δ - 1)
    have h3 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (2 * (t - f x) / δ - 1)
    have h4 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (2 * (t - f x) / δ - 1)
    have hab : Real.smoothTransition (2 * (f x - t) / δ - 1)
        + Real.smoothTransition (2 * (t - f x) / δ - 1) ≤ 1 := by
      rcases le_or_gt (f x) (t + δ / 2) with h | h
      · rw [A0 x h]; linarith
      · rw [B0 x (by linarith)]; linarith
    refine ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, by linarith, by linarith, by ring⟩
  · show closure _ ⊆ _
    refine subset_trans (closure_minimal (t := {x | t + δ / 2 ≤ f x}) ?_
      (isClosed_le continuous_const hf.continuous)) ?_
    · intro x hx
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hx
      show t + δ / 2 ≤ f x
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      exact hx (A0 x h.le)
    · intro x hx
      have hx' : t + δ / 2 ≤ f x := hx
      show t < f x
      linarith
  · show closure _ ⊆ _
    refine subset_trans (closure_minimal (t := {x | f x ≤ t - δ / 2}) ?_
      (isClosed_le hf.continuous continuous_const)) ?_
    · intro x hx
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hx
      show f x ≤ t - δ / 2
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      exact hx (B0 x h.le)
    · intro x hx
      have hx' : f x ≤ t - δ / 2 := hx
      show f x < t
      linarith
  · show closure _ ⊆ _
    refine subset_trans (closure_minimal (t := {x | t - δ ≤ f x} ∩ {x | f x ≤ t + δ}) ?_
      ((isClosed_le continuous_const hf.continuous).inter
        (isClosed_le hf.continuous continuous_const))) ?_
    · intro x hx
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hx
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · show t - δ ≤ f x
        by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        apply hx
        rw [A0 x (by linarith), B1 x h.le]
        ring
      · show f x ≤ t + δ
        by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        apply hx
        rw [A1 x h.le, B0 x (by linarith)]
        ring
    · intro x hx
      have h1 : t - δ ≤ f x := hx.1
      have h2 : f x ≤ t + δ := hx.2
      show t - 2 * δ < f x ∧ f x < t + 2 * δ
      constructor <;> linarith

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ)
    (r₁ η : ℝ) (A : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ)
    (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p)
    (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A)
    (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) (hη : 0 < η)
    (Y : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (hY1 : ∀ x, g.g x (Y x) (Y x) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ V Z : M → E3, calSmoothField V ∧ (∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) ∧ calSmoothField Z ∧
      ∀ q : M, ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, ∀ wV wY wZ : E3,
        wV = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (V ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
        wY = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
        wZ = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
        ∀ i : Fin 3,
          wV i = (1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) * wY i +
            calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i ∧
          wZ i = calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i
