proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have cal_bilin_riesz : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ),
      (∀ v : E3, v ≠ 0 → 0 < B v v) → ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ∃ v : E3, ∀ w : E3, B v w = ℓ w := by
    intro B hpos ℓ
    let D := InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E3
    let T : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3 :=
      { toFun := fun v => D.symm (B v)
        map_add' := fun v w => by simp
        map_smul' := fun c v => by simp }
    have hinj : Function.Injective T := by
      intro v w hvw
      have h1 : B v = B w := by
        have := congrArg D hvw
        simpa [T] using this
      by_contra hne
      have h2 := hpos (v - w) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
      have h3 : B (v - w) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, h1, sub_self]
      rw [h3] at h2
      simp at h2
    have hsurj := LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsurj (D.symm ℓ)
    refine ⟨v, fun w => ?_⟩
    have h1 : B v = ℓ := by
      have := congrArg D hv
      simpa [T] using this
    rw [h1]
  
  have cal_blend_quad_le : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ v w : E3, B v w = B w v) →
      (∀ v : E3, 0 ≤ B v v) → ∀ (Y X : E3), B Y Y ≤ 1 → B X X = 1 → ∀ (θ s : ℝ),
      0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) →
      B ((1 - θ) • Y + (s * θ) • X) ((1 - θ) • Y + (s * θ) • X) ≤ 1 := by
    intro B hsymm hpsd Y X hY hX θ s hθ0 hθ1 hs
    have hcs := hpsd (Y - (B Y X) • X)
    have hXY : B X Y = B Y X := hsymm X Y
    simp only [map_sub, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, hX, hXY] at hcs
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, hX, hXY]
    have hc2 : B Y X ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have hc := abs_le.mp (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one (B Y X) |>.mp hc2)
    have ha : 0 ≤ 1 - θ := sub_nonneg.2 hθ1
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha ha) (sub_nonneg.2 hY),
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hθ0) (sub_nonneg.2 hc.2)]
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha ha) (sub_nonneg.2 hY),
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hθ0) (neg_le_iff_add_nonneg.1 hc.1)]
  
  have hposdef : ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target →
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro q y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three,
          map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply,
          star_trivial, RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  
  have cal_grad_chart_rep : ∀ (N : M → E3),
      (∀ (x : M) (w : E3), g.g x (N x) w = (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ x w : ℝ)) →
      ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → ∀ (w : E3),
      w = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (N ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, w i = ∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i k *
        partialDeriv k (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) ∧
      g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (N ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (N ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ a b *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
    intro N hN q y hy w hw
    have hx : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hx
    have hinv : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y v) = v := by
      have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)).comp
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
      have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
        apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
        exact hz
      rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
      intro v
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L v) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        K = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        L = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hKL : ∀ v, K (L v) = v := by intro v; rw [hK, hL]; exact hinv v
    have hKinj : Function.Injective K := by
      have hsurj : Function.Surjective (K : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) := fun v => ⟨L v, hKL v⟩
      exact LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mpr hsurj
    have hLK : ∀ v, L (K v) = v := fun v => hKinj (hKL (K v))
    have hρd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      hρ.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hchain : ∀ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (L (e b)) := by
      intro b
      have h1 := mfderiv_comp y hρd hf
      rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at h1
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [show (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) = ρ ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm from rfl, h1, hL]
      rfl
    have hw' : L w = N ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) := by rw [hw, ← hK]; exact hLK _
    have hexp : w = ∑ a : Fin 3, w a • e a := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have h1 : ∀ b : Fin 3, g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (L w) (L (e b)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, w a * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y a b := by
      intro b
      conv_lhs => rw [hexp]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, hL]
      rfl
    have hsys : ∀ b : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, w a * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y a b =
        partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      intro b
      rw [← h1 b, hw', hN, hchain b]
    have hmv : (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).mulVec (fun a => w a) =
        fun b => partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      funext b
      rw [← hsys b]
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
      have hs : g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y b a = g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y a b := by
        simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        exact g.symm _ _ _
      rw [hs]
      ring
    have hdet : IsUnit (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det :=
      isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hposdef q y hy).det_pos.ne'
    have hsol : (fun a => w a) = ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹).mulVec
        (fun b => partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) := by
      have h2 := congrArg (fun v => ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹).mulVec v) hmv
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec] at h2
      exact h2
    have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, w i = ∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i k *
        partialDeriv k (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      intro i
      have h2 := congrFun hsol i
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using h2
    refine ⟨hcomp, ?_⟩
    have h3 : ∀ c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, c (L w) = ∑ b : Fin 3, w b * c (L (e b)) := by
      intro c
      conv_lhs => rw [hexp]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← hw', h3 (g.g _ (L w))]
    simp only [h1, hsys]
    simp only [hcomp, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
    ring
  
  have cal_unit_normal_contDiffOn : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ)
      (T : Set E3), IsOpen T → (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) →
      (∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T → ∀ (n : E3 → E3),
      (∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, n z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ n {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧
        0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} := by
    intro G f T hT hG hdet hf n hn
    have hdetT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) T := by
      have e : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y => G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2
          - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1
          - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2 + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0
          + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
        funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
      rw [e]
      have h := hG
      exact (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
        (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
        (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
    have hdinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹) T :=
      hdetT.inv (fun z hz => (hdet z hz).ne')
    have h00 := hG 0 0
    have h01 := hG 0 1
    have h02 := hG 0 2
    have h10 := hG 1 0
    have h11 := hG 1 1
    have h12 := hG 1 2
    have h20 := hG 2 0
    have h21 := hG 2 1
    have h22 := hG 2 2
    have hadj : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).adjugate a b) T := by
      intro a b
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three] <;> fun_prop
    have hinvE : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) T := by
      intro a b
      have e1 : (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) = fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹ * (G z).adjugate a b := by
        funext z
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [e1]
      exact hdinv.mul (hadj a b)
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) T := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hT (by simp)
    have hpd : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => partialDeriv k f z) T := fun k =>
      hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hNsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z) T :=
      ContDiffOn.sum (fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun b _ => ((hinvE a b).mul (hpd a)).mul (hpd b)))
    have hST : {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧
        0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ⊆ T :=
      fun z hz => hz.1
    rw [contDiffOn_piLp]
    intro i
    have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => calUnitNormal G f z i) {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧
        0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} :=
      (((hNsq.mono hST).sqrt (fun z hz => hz.2.ne')).inv
        (fun z hz => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hz.2).ne')).mul
        ((ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hinvE i k).mul (hpd k))).mono hST)
    exact hc.congr (fun z hz => hn z hz.1 i)
  
  have cal_blend_local_smooth : ∀ (T : Set E3), IsOpen T → ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T → ∀ (Yt n : E3 → E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt T →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ n {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} → ∀ (s : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → ∃ u : Set E3, IsOpen u ∧ z ∈ u ∧ ∀ z' ∈ T ∩ u, s z' = s z) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (1 - calTheta r₁ η (f z)) • Yt z +
        (s z * calTheta r₁ η (f z)) • n z) T ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => calTheta r₁ η (f z) • n z) T := by
    intro T hT f hf Yt n hYt hn s hs
    have hθf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => calTheta r₁ η (f z)) T := by
      unfold calTheta
      exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn
        ((contDiffOn_const.mul ((hf.sub contDiffOn_const).div_const η)).sub contDiffOn_const)
    have hθ0 : ∀ t, t < r₁ + η / 2 → calTheta r₁ η t = 0 := by
      intro t ht
      unfold calTheta
      apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
      have : (t - r₁) / η < 1 / 2 := by rw [div_lt_iff₀ hη]; linarith
      linarith
    have hfc := hf.continuousOn
    constructor
    · apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      intro z hz
      by_cases hz1 : f z < r₁ + η / 2
      · refine ⟨T ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Iio (r₁ + η / 2), hfc.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Iio,
          ⟨hz, hz1⟩, ?_⟩
        refine (hYt.mono Set.inter_subset_left).congr (fun z' hz' => ?_)
        have h := hθ0 _ hz'.2.2
        simp [h]
      · push_neg at hz1
        have hr : r₁ < f z := by linarith
        obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀o, hzu₀, hu₀⟩ := hs z hz hr
        refine ⟨u₀ ∩ (T ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ioi r₁),
          hu₀o.inter (hfc.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Ioi), ⟨hzu₀, hz, hr⟩, ?_⟩
        have hsub : T ∩ (u₀ ∩ (T ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ioi r₁)) ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} :=
          fun z' hz' => hz'.2.2
        have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z' => (1 - calTheta r₁ η (f z')) • Yt z' +
            (s z * calTheta r₁ η (f z')) • n z') (T ∩ (u₀ ∩ (T ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ioi r₁))) :=
          ((contDiffOn_const.sub (hθf.mono Set.inter_subset_left)).smul
            (hYt.mono Set.inter_subset_left)).add
            ((contDiffOn_const.mul (hθf.mono Set.inter_subset_left)).smul (hn.mono hsub))
        refine hsm.congr (fun z' hz' => ?_)
        simp only
        rw [hu₀ z' ⟨hz'.1, hz'.2.1⟩]
    · apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      intro z hz
      by_cases hz1 : f z < r₁ + η / 2
      · refine ⟨T ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Iio (r₁ + η / 2), hfc.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Iio,
          ⟨hz, hz1⟩, ?_⟩
        refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : E3))).congr (fun z' hz' => ?_)
        have h := hθ0 _ hz'.2.2
        simp [h]
      · push_neg at hz1
        have hr : r₁ < f z := by linarith
        refine ⟨T ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ioi r₁, hfc.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Ioi, ⟨hz, hr⟩, ?_⟩
        have hsub : T ∩ (T ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ioi r₁) ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} :=
          fun z' hz' => hz'.2
        exact (hθf.mono Set.inter_subset_left).smul (hn.mono hsub)
  
  choose N hN using fun x : M => cal_bilin_riesz (g.g x) (g.posDef x)
    (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ x : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)
  have hN' : ∀ (x : M) (w : E3), g.g x (N x) w = (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ x w : ℝ) :=
    fun x w => hN x w
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : M → E3, ∀ x, X x = (Real.sqrt (g.g x (N x) (N x)))⁻¹ • N x :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : M → E3, ∀ x, V x = (1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ x)) • Y x +
      (calSigma ρ r₁ A x * calTheta r₁ η (ρ x)) • X x := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ : ∃ Z : M → E3, ∀ x, Z x = calTheta r₁ η (ρ x) • X x := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hσA : ∀ x ∈ A, calSigma ρ r₁ A x = -1 := by
    intro x hx
    unfold calSigma
    rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h : x ∈ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A => h.2 hx),
      Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
    norm_num
  have hσB : ∀ x ∈ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A, calSigma ρ r₁ A x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    unfold calSigma
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx.2]
    norm_num
  have hpos : ∀ x : M, r₁ < ρ x → 0 < g.g x (N x) (N x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hH := hmc x hx.le
    have h2 := (cal_grad_chart_rep N hN' x (chartAt E3 x x) (mem_chart_target E3 x)
      _ rfl).2
    rw [(chartAt E3 x).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x)] at h2
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    have hgi : g.gradInner ρ ρ x ≤ 0 := by
      unfold RiemannianMetric3.gradInner
      rw [← h2]
      exact hle
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.levelMeanCurv] at hH
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.2 hgi] at hH
    simp at hH
  have hposq : ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target →
      r₁ < ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) →
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ a b *
        partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y *
        partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
    intro q y hy hr
    rw [← (cal_grad_chart_rep N hN' q y hy _ rfl).2]
    exact hpos _ hr
  have hrepX : ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → ∀ w : E3,
      w = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (X ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      w i = calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i := by
    intro q y hy w hw i
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : E3, u = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
        ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (N ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := cal_grad_chart_rep N hN' q y hy u hu
    have hwu : w = (Real.sqrt (g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (N ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
        (N ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))))⁻¹ • u := by
      rw [hw, hu, hX, map_smul]
    rw [hwu, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h1 i, h2]
    rfl
  have hrep : ∀ q : M, ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, ∀ wV wY wZ : E3,
        wV = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (V ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
        wY = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
        wZ = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
        ∀ i : Fin 3,
          wV i = (1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) * wY i +
            calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i ∧
          wZ i = calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i := by
    intro q y hy wV wY wZ hwV hwY hwZ i
    obtain ⟨wX, hwX⟩ : ∃ wX : E3, wX = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
        ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (X ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hX' := hrepX q y hy wX hwX i
    have eV : wV = (1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) • wY +
        (calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
          calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) • wX := by
      rw [hwV, hwY, hwX, hV, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
    have eZ : wZ = calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) • wX := by
      rw [hwZ, hwX, hZ, map_smul]
    constructor
    · rw [eV, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, hX']
    · rw [eZ, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hX']
  have hnorm : ∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [hV x]
    by_cases hx : r₁ < ρ x
    · have hn := hpos x hx
      have hX1 : g.g x (X x) (X x) = 1 := by
        simp only [hX x, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_inv, Real.mul_self_sqrt hn.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn.ne']
      have hσ : calSigma ρ r₁ A x = 1 ∨ calSigma ρ r₁ A x = -1 := by
        by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
        · exact Or.inr (hσA x hxA)
        · exact Or.inl (hσB x ⟨hx, hxA⟩)
      have hpsd : ∀ v : E3, 0 ≤ g.g x v v := by
        intro v
        by_cases hv : v = 0
        · subst hv; simp
        · exact (g.posDef x v hv).le
      exact cal_blend_quad_le (g.g x) (g.symm x) hpsd (Y x) (X x) (hY1 x) hX1
        (calTheta r₁ η (ρ x)) (calSigma ρ r₁ A x)
        (by unfold calTheta; exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)
        (by unfold calTheta; exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one _) hσ
    · have hθ : calTheta r₁ η (ρ x) = 0 := by
        unfold calTheta
        apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
        have : (ρ x - r₁) / η ≤ 0 := div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hη.le
        linarith
      rw [hθ]
      simpa using hY1 x
  have hsm : ∀ q : M,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
        ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
        ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    intro q
    have hT : IsOpen (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).open_target
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ρ ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm)
          (chartAt E3 q).target :=
        hρ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    have hn3 := cal_unit_normal_contDiffOn (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
      (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target hT (fun i j => g.smooth q i j)
      (fun z hz => (hposdef q z hz).det_pos) hf
      (fun z => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) z i)) (fun z _ i => rfl)
    have hn5 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => calUnitNormal
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) z i) : E3))
        {z : E3 | z ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ r₁ < ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)} :=
      hn3.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, hposq q z hz.1 hz.2⟩)
    have hs : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, r₁ < ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) →
        ∃ u : Set E3, IsOpen u ∧ z ∈ u ∧ ∀ z' ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ u,
          calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 q).symm z') = calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) := by
      intro z hz hr
      by_cases hzA : (chartAt E3 q).symm z ∈ A
      · refine ⟨(chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' A,
          (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hAo, ⟨hz, hzA⟩, fun z' hz' => ?_⟩
        rw [hσA _ hz'.2.2, hσA _ hzA]
      · have hzB : (chartAt E3 q).symm z ∈ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A := ⟨hr, hzA⟩
        refine ⟨(chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A),
          (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hBo, ⟨hz, hzB⟩, fun z' hz' => ?_⟩
        rw [hσB _ hz'.2.2, hσB _ hzB]
    have h5 := cal_blend_local_smooth (chartAt E3 q).target hT
      (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) hf
      (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (Y ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3)) _ (hY q) hn5
      (fun z => calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) hs
    constructor
    · refine h5.1.congr (fun y hy => ?_)
      refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
      beta_reduce
      rw [(hrep q y hy _ _ _ rfl rfl rfl i).1, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    · refine h5.2.congr (fun y hy => ?_)
      refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
      beta_reduce
      rw [(hrep q y hy _ _ _ rfl rfl rfl i).2, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact ⟨V, Z, fun q => (hsm q).1, hnorm, fun q => (hsm q).2, hrep⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (ρ : M → ℝ) (r₁ η : ℝ) (A F : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ)
    (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p)
    (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A)
    (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) (hF : sepChartMeas F) (hη : 0 < η)
    (p : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (hφ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ) (hφ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (hφc : IsCompact (tsupport φ)) (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source)
    (Y V Z : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (hY1 : ∀ x, g.g x (Y x) (Y x) ≤ 1)
    (hVZ : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, ∀ wV wY wZ : E3,
        wV = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) →
        wY = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) →
        wZ = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) →
        ∀ i : Fin 3,
          wV i = (1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) * wY i +
            calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y i ∧
          wZ i = calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y i) :
    IntegrableOn (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun y => calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y)
      (chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ∧

          (φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *

      (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),

      ((∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hT : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
  have hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z i j)
      (chartAt E3 p).target := fun i j => g.smooth p i j
  have hpd : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).PosDef :=
    fun z hz => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p z hz
  have hdet : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, 0 < (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det :=
    fun z hz => (hpd z hz).det_pos
  have hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z j i :=
    fun z i j => g.symm _ _ _
  have hcomp : ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    intro u hu
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    hcomp ρ hρ
  have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    hcomp φ hφ
  have hψ0 : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, 0 ≤ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z :=
    fun z _ => hφ0 _
  have hC : IsCompact (chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ) :=
    hφc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono hφp)
  have hCT : chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source (hφp hx)
  have hψC : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, z ∉ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ →
      (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z = 0 := by
    intro z hz hzC
    by_contra hne
    exact hzC ⟨(chartAt E3 p).symm z, subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.mpr hne),
      (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hz⟩
  
  have hlmc : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target,
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z =
        g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) := by
    intro z hz
    let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 p).symm.toPartialEquiv
        open_source := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
        open_target := (chartAt E3 p).open_source
        contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
        contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
    have h := levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φ ρ (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) hρ z hz
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
    exact h.symm
  have hN : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, r₁ ≤ ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) →
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z)⁻¹ a b *
        partialDeriv a (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z *
        partialDeriv b (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z := by
    intro z hz hfz
    have hH := hmc ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) hfz
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    have hs := Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.mpr hle
    have h0 : levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z = 0 := by
      rw [levelMeanCurvCoord, hs]
      simp
    rw [hlmc z hz] at h0
    linarith
  
  have hnp := ccs_normal_props (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
    (chartAt E3 p).target hT hG hpd hf
    (fun y => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y i)) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
  have hT'f : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, r₁ ≤ ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) →
      z ∈ {z : E3 | z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z)⁻¹ a b *
        partialDeriv a (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z *
        partialDeriv b (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z} :=
    fun z hz h => ⟨hz, hN z hz h⟩
  
  have hCS : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, r₁ < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) →
      |fderiv ℝ (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) : E3)| ≤
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
          (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z i)) := by
    intro z hz hfz
    refine hnp.2.2 z hz (hN z hz hfz.le) _ ?_
    rw [ccs_rep_norm g Y p z hz _ rfl]
    exact hY1 _
  
  have himg : ∀ S : Set M, chartAt E3 p '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =
      (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' S := by
    intro S
    rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact (chartAt E3 p).image_source_inter_eq' S
  have hAo' : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hAo.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right
  have hAsub' : chartAt E3 p '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ⊆
      {z : E3 | z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ r₁ < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)} := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨hxA, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source hxs, ?_⟩
    show r₁ < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs]
    exact hAsub hxA
  have hBe : {z : E3 | z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ r₁ < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)} \

      (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' ({x : M | r₁ < ρ x} \ A) := by
    rw [himg A]
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
    tauto
  have hBo' : IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ r₁ < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)} \
      chartAt E3 p '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) := by
    rw [hBe]
    exact (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hBo
  have hFT : chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨_, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source hxs
  have hsig : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) =

      (chartAt E3 p '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z := by
    intro z hz
    have hA : z ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ↔ (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ A := by
      rw [himg A]
      exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hz, h⟩⟩
    have hB : z ∈ {z : E3 | z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ r₁ < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)} \
        chartAt E3 p '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ↔

      rw [hBe]

    unfold calSigma
    by_cases h1 : (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ A
    · have h2 : (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∉ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x} \ A := fun h => h.2 h1
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem h2, Set.indicator_of_mem (hA.2 h1),

    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => h1 (hA.1 h))]
      by_cases h3 : (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x} \ A
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h3, Set.indicator_of_mem (hB.2 h3)]
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h3, Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => h3 (hB.1 h))]
  
  have hW₀o : ∀ z, z ∉ (chartAt E3 p).target → calPiece p φ Y z = 0 :=
    fun z hz => Set.indicator_of_notMem hz _
  have hW₁o : ∀ z, z ∉ (chartAt E3 p).target → calPiece p φ V z = 0 :=
    fun z hz => Set.indicator_of_notMem hz _
  have hW₀ : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, ∀ i : Fin 3, calPiece p φ Y z i =

    intro z hz i
    rw [calPiece, Set.indicator_of_mem hz, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> rfl
  have hW₁ : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, ∀ i : Fin 3, calPiece p φ V z i =

        ((1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) *

  have hZt : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, ∀ i : Fin 3,

  have hd : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, r₁ < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) →

    ring
  
  have hS : chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =

        {z : E3 | r₁ < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)} := by

    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff,

  have key := ccs_euclid_calib (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p).target

    (chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ) (chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
    (chartAt E3 p '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
    (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
    (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *

    (fun y => calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
    (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
      (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3))
    (fun y => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)

    (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
      (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3))
    (calPiece p φ Y) (calPiece p φ V) r₁ η hT hG hdet hf hη hψ hψ0 hC hCT hψC hnp.1
    (fun z hz => hz.1) hT'f (hY p) hnp.2.1 hCS hAo' hAsub' hBo' (hF p) hFT hsig hW₀o hW₀ hW₁o

subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T T' C Ft At : Set E3) (f ψ d sig : E3 → ℝ) (Yt Xt Zt W₀ W₁ : E3 → E3) (r₁ η : ℝ) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (hη : 0 < η) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ T) (hψ0 : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 ≤ ψ z) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCT : C ⊆ T) (hψC : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∉ C → ψ z = 0) (hT'o : IsOpen T') (hT'T : T' ⊆ T) (hT'f : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ ≤ f z → z ∈ T') (hYt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt T) (hXt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xt T') (hCS : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → |fderiv ℝ f z (Yt z)| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (Xt z)) (hAo : IsOpen At) (hAsub : At ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z}) (hBo : IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} \ At)) (hFm : MeasurableSet Ft) (hFT : Ft ⊆ T) (hsig : ∀ z ∈ T, sig z = ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} \ At).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - At.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) (hW₀o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → W₀ z = 0) (hW₀ : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₀ z i = ψ z * Yt z i) (hW₁o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → W₁ z = 0) (hW₁ : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₁ z i = ψ z * ((1 - calTheta r₁ η (f z)) * Yt z i + sig z * calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i)) (hZt : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, Zt z i = calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i) (hd : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → d z = ψ z * sepDensDiv G Xt z) : IntegrableOn d (symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun z => sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) (symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∧ (∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z) + (∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z)) + ((∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) - ∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z)) ≤ (∫ z in Ft, sepDensDiv G W₁ z) - ∫ z in (Ft \ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∪ At, sepDensDiv G W₀ z

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hφs : ∀ j, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (φ j) := hφ.1
  have hφc : ∀ j, IsCompact (tsupport (φ j)) := fun j => (hφ.2.2.2 j).1
  have hφt : ∀ j, tsupport (φ j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source :=
    fun j => (hφ.2.2.2 j).2.trans Set.inter_subset_right
  
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : Fin n → M → ℝ,
      D = fun j x => mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (φ j) x (Z x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hrep : ∀ (p : M) (u : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    fun p u hu => contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hrepd : ∀ (p : M) (u : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y :=
    fun p u hu y hy => ((hrep p u hu).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
      ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds hy)
  
  have hdir : ∀ (p : M) (u : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, ∀ v : E3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) v : E3) =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) v : ℝ) := by
    intro p u hu y hy v
    have hxp : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
    have hcpx : chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = y := (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hy
    have hcp : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hxp
    have hψm : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
        (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := by
      rw [hcpx]
      exact (hrepd p u hu y hy).mdifferentiableAt
    have hev : u =ᶠ[𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)]
        (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) ∘ chartAt E3 p := by
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).open_source.mem_nhds hxp] with w hw
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hw]
    have h1 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ((fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) ∘ chartAt E3 p)
          ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) := hev.mfderiv_eq
    have h2 := mfderiv_comp ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) hψm hcp
    have h3 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
        (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y := by
      rw [hcpx, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
    rw [h1, h2, h3]
    rfl
  have hF5 : ∀ (j : Fin n) (p : M), ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3) = D j ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) := by
    intro j p y hy
    rw [hD]
    exact hdir p (φ j) (hφs j) y hy _
  
  have hF4 : ∀ j x, x ∉ tsupport (φ j) → D j x = 0 := by
    intro j x hx
    have h := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hx
    have h0 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (φ j) x = 0 := by
      rw [h.mfderiv_eq]
      exact mfderiv_const
    rw [hD]
    show mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (φ j) x (Z x) = 0
    rw [h0]
    rfl
  
  have hsum0 : ∀ (p : M) (z : E3), z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target → (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ O →
      ∑ j, fderiv ℝ (fun w => φ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm w)) z = 0 := by
    intro p z hz hzO
    rw [← fderiv_sum (fun j _ => hrepd p (φ j) (hφs j) z hz)]
    have hfs : (∑ j, fun w => φ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm w)) =
        fun w => ∑ j, φ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm w) := by
      ext w
      simp [Finset.sum_apply]
    have hev : (fun w => ∑ j, φ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm w)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hO).mem_nhds ⟨hz, hzO⟩]
        with w hw
      exact hφ1 _ hw.2
    rw [hfs, hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hcont : ∀ (p : M) (a b : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ a →
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ b →
      ContinuousOn (fun y => b ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => a ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    intro p a b ha hb
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => b ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      hb.continuous.comp_continuousOn (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => a ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y)
        (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      (hrep p a ha).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 p).open_target (by simp)
    have h3 := (hZ p).continuousOn
    have h4 : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)
        (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      have hm : ContinuousOn (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
        continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j => (g.smooth p i j).continuousOn
      exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn ((continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hm)
    exact (h1.mul (h2.clm_apply h3)).mul h4
  
  have hint : ∀ (p : M) (F : E3 → ℝ) (K : Set M), IsCompact K → K ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source →
      ContinuousOn F (chartAt E3 p).target →
      (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∉ K → F y = 0) →
      IntegrableOn F (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) := by
    intro p F K hK hKs hF hF0
    have hKc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 p '' K) :=
      hK.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono hKs)
    have hKt : chartAt E3 p '' K ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source (hKs hx)
    refine ((hF.mono hKt).integrableOn_compact hKc).of_forall_diff_eq_zero (hE p) ?_
    rintro y ⟨⟨x, ⟨-, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hy⟩
    refine hF0 _ ((chartAt E3 p).map_source hxs) ?_
    intro hK'
    exact hy ⟨_, hK', (chartAt E3 p).right_inv ((chartAt E3 p).map_source hxs)⟩
  
  have hexp : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
    intro v
    ext k
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  have cca : ∀ (Φ : E3 → M) (τ : E3 → E3) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y →
      MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ (τ y) → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff (Φ ∘ τ) y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a * g.coeff Φ (τ y) a b * fderiv ℝ τ y (e j) b := by

    set B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := g.g (Φ (τ y)) with hBdef
    have hL : ∀ v : E3, L v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • L (e a) := by
      intro v
      conv_lhs => rw [hexp v]
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul]
    have hchain : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y v = L (fderiv ℝ τ y v) := by
      intro v
      rw [mfderiv_comp_apply y hΦ hτ.mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      rfl
    have hlhs : g.coeff (Φ ∘ τ) y i j = B (L (fderiv ℝ τ y (e i))) (L (fderiv ℝ τ y (e j))) := by
      show g.g (Φ (τ y)) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y (e j)) = _
      rw [hchain, hchain]
    have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff Φ (τ y) a b = B (L (e a)) (L (e b)) := fun a b => rfl
    rw [hlhs, hL (fderiv ℝ τ y (e i)), hL (fderiv ℝ τ y (e j))]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, hc]
    conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
    ring
  have hlaw : ∀ (p₁ p₂ : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₁).target →
      (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₂).source →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) := by

      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₁) hy
    have hB : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p₂) ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₂) hy₂
    have hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hB.comp y hA)
    have hΦ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p₂).symm
        (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₂)
        ((chartAt E3 p₂).map_source hy₂)
    have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) =
        (chartAt E3 p₁).symm z := by
      have hO' := (chartAt E3 p₁).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 p₂).open_source
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO'.mem_nhds ⟨hy, hy₂⟩)
        (fun z hz => (chartAt E3 p₂).left_inv hz.2)
    refine ⟨hτ, ?_⟩
    intro i j
    have hfun : (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 y] ⇑(chartAt E3 p₁).symm := hev
    have hmf := hfun.mfderiv_eq (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, E3))
    have hpt : (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y =
        (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y := (chartAt E3 p₂).left_inv hy₂
    have key : g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j =
        g.coeff (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y i j := by
      show _ = g.g ((⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y (e j))
      rw [hmf, hpt]
      rfl
    rw [key]
    exact cca _ _ y hτ hΦ i j
  
  have hsqrt : ∀ (A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (G₁ G₂ : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, G₁ i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A (e i) a * G₂ a b * A (e j) b) →
      Real.sqrt G₁.det = |A.det| * Real.sqrt G₂.det := by
    intro A G₁ G₂ hl
    have h1 : G₁ = (Matrix.of fun a i => A (e i) a).transpose * G₂ *
        (Matrix.of fun a i => A (e i) a) := by
      ext i j
      rw [hl i j]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have h3 : (Matrix.of fun a i => A (e i) a).det = A.det := by
      have hdt := LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis
        (A : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)
      show _ = LinearMap.det (A : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)
      rw [← hdt]
      congr 1
    rw [h1, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, h3,
      show A.det * G₂.det * A.det = A.det ^ 2 * G₂.det by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  
  have hvolEq : ∀ (p p' : M) (h : M → ℝ),
      (∀ x, h x ≠ 0 → x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source) →
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
          h ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det =
        ∫ z in chartAt E3 p' '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source),
          h ((chartAt E3 p').symm z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p').symm z).det := by
    intro p p' h hh
    have hsub : chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source)) ⊆
        chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
      Set.image_mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.1⟩)
    have hsub' : chartAt E3 p' '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source)) ⊆
        chartAt E3 p' '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source) :=
      Set.image_mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.2⟩)
    have hmeas : MeasurableSet
        (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source))) := by
      have he : chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source)) =
          chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩
            ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 p').source) := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxE, hxs, hxs'⟩, rfl⟩
          refine ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxE, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, (chartAt E3 p).map_source hxs, ?_⟩
          show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) ∈ (chartAt E3 p').source
          rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs]
          exact hxs'
        · rintro ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxE, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, -, hy⟩
          have hy' : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) ∈ (chartAt E3 p').source := hy
          rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs] at hy'
          exact ⟨x, ⟨hxE, hxs, hy'⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [he]
      exact (hE p).inter
        ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 p').open_source).measurableSet
    have hL : ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
          h ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det =
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source)),
          h ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det := by
      refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (hE p) hsub ?_
      rintro _ ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxE, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hy⟩
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs]
      have hx0 : h x = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hy ⟨x, ⟨hxE, hxs, (hh x hne).2⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [hx0, zero_mul]
    have hR : ∫ z in chartAt E3 p' '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source),
          h ((chartAt E3 p').symm z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p').symm z).det =
        ∫ z in chartAt E3 p' '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source)),
          h ((chartAt E3 p').symm z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p').symm z).det := by
      refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (hE p') hsub' ?_
      rintro _ ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxE, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hy⟩
      rw [(chartAt E3 p').left_inv hxs]
      have hx0 : h x = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hy ⟨x, ⟨hxE, (hh x hne).1, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [hx0, zero_mul]
    have himg : (fun z => chartAt E3 p' ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) ''
        (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source))) =
        chartAt E3 p' '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source)) := by
      rw [Set.image_image]
      refine Set.image_congr ?_
      intro x hx
      simp only [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx.2.1]
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun z => chartAt E3 p' ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
        (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source))) := by
      rintro _ ⟨x₁, hx₁, rfl⟩ _ ⟨x₂, hx₂, rfl⟩ hτe
      simp only [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx₁.2.1, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx₂.2.1] at hτe
      rw [(chartAt E3 p').injOn hx₁.2.2 hx₂.2.2 hτe]
    have hmem : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source)),
        y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p').source := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source hx.2.1, ?_⟩
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx.2.1]
      exact hx.2.2
    have hderiv : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source)),
        HasFDerivWithinAt (fun z => chartAt E3 p' ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
          (fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p' ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y)
          (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p').source))) y :=
      fun y hy => (hlaw p p' y (hmem y hy).1 (hmem y hy).2).1.hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
    have hcov := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hmeas hderiv hinj
      (fun z => h ((chartAt E3 p').symm z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p').symm z).det)
    rw [hL, hR, ← himg, hcov]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun hmeas (fun y hy => ?_)
    obtain ⟨hyt, hys⟩ := hmem y hy
    have hback : (chartAt E3 p').symm (chartAt E3 p' ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =
        (chartAt E3 p).symm y := (chartAt E3 p').left_inv hys
    have hv := hsqrt _ _ _ (hlaw p p' y hyt hys).2
    show h ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det =
      |(fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p' ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y).det| *
        (h ((chartAt E3 p').symm (chartAt E3 p' ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p').symm (chartAt E3 p' ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))).det)
    rw [hv, hback]
    ring
  
  have hA_t : ∀ (p : M) (y : E3), y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) →
      y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    rintro p _ ⟨x, ⟨-, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source hx
  have hA_E : ∀ (p : M) (y : E3), y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) →
      (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ E := by
    rintro p _ ⟨x, ⟨hxE, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx]
    exact hxE
  
  have hTint : ∀ (j k : Fin n) (p : M) (K : Set M), IsCompact K → K ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source →
      (∀ x, x ∉ K → φ k x * D j x = 0) →
      IntegrableOn (fun y => φ k ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * D j ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)
        (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) := by
    intro j k p K hK hKs h0
    refine hint p _ K hK hKs ?_ ?_
    · refine (hcont p (φ j) (φ k) (hφs j) (hφs k)).congr (fun y hy => ?_)
      simp only
      rw [hF5 j p y hy]
    · intro y _ hy
      rw [h0 _ hy, zero_mul]
  
  have stepA : ∀ j, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) y
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j)) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)
            (Z ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) : E3) =
      ∑ k, ∫ z in chartAt E3 (q k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q k)).source),
        φ k ((chartAt E3 (q k)).symm z) * D j ((chartAt E3 (q k)).symm z) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q k)).symm z).det := by
    intro j
    have e1 : ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) y
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j)) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)
              (Z ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) : E3) =
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
          ∑ k, φ k ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * D j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun (hE (q j)) (fun y hy => ?_)
      have hs := hφ1 _ (hEO (hA_E _ y hy))
      simp only
      rw [hF5 j (q j) y (hA_t _ y hy), ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, hs]
      ring
    rw [e1, integral_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => hTint j k (q j) (tsupport (φ j)) (hφc j) (hφt j)
      (fun x hx => by rw [hF4 j x hx, mul_zero]))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    refine hvolEq (q j) (q k) (fun x => φ k x * D j x) (fun x hx => ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
    · by_contra hxs
      exact hx (by
        show φ k x * D j x = 0
        rw [hF4 j x (fun ht => hxs (hφt j ht)), mul_zero])
    · by_contra hxs
      exact hx (by
        show φ k x * D j x = 0
        rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun ht => hxs (hφt k ht)), zero_mul])
  
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => stepA j), Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k _ => ?_)
  rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hTint j k (q k) (tsupport (φ k)) (hφc k) (hφt k)
    (fun x hx => by rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx, zero_mul]))]
  have hz0 : ∫ z in chartAt E3 (q k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q k)).source),
      ∑ j, φ k ((chartAt E3 (q k)).symm z) * D j ((chartAt E3 (q k)).symm z) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q k)).symm z).det =
      ∫ z in chartAt E3 (q k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q k)).source), (0 : ℝ) := by
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun (hE (q k)) (fun z hz => ?_)
    have hzt := hA_t _ z hz
    have hDs : ∑ j, D j ((chartAt E3 (q k)).symm z) =
        ∑ j, fderiv ℝ (fun w => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q k)).symm w)) z
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q k)) ((chartAt E3 (q k)).symm z)
            (Z ((chartAt E3 (q k)).symm z)) : E3) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => (hF5 j (q k) z hzt).symm)
    have h0 : ∑ j, D j ((chartAt E3 (q k)).symm z) = 0 := by
      rw [hDs, ← ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, hsum0 (q k) z hzt (hEO (hA_E _ z hz))]
      rfl
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, h0]
    ring
  rw [hz0]
  simp

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (S : Set M) (hS : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S) (z p : M) (hp : p ∈ S) (hpz : p ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source) : ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ IsSurfA2At g S (chartAt E3 z) p t ∧ IsSurfA2At g S (chartAt E3 p) p t

signature.name: surfA2_chart_invariant
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (S : Set M) (hS : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S) (z p : M) (hp : p ∈ S) (hpz : p ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source) : ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ IsSurfA2At g S (chartAt E3 z) p t ∧ IsSurfA2At g S (chartAt E3 p) p t

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hu : ∀ u : E3, u = ∑ d : Fin 3, u d • e d := by
    intro u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hξne : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0 →
      (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k F y) ≠ 0 := by
    intro F y hdF h
    apply hdF
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, hu v, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun d _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hd : partialDeriv d F y = 0 := congrFun h d
    rw [show fderiv ℝ F y (e d) = partialDeriv d F y from rfl, hd, mul_zero]
  have hpd : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (h : E3 → ℝ),
      partialDeriv i (fun z => -h z) = fun z => -partialDeriv i h z := by
    intro i h
    funext w
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [show (fun z => -h z) = -h from rfl, fderiv_neg]
    rfl
  
  have hschwarz : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U →
      ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) y = partialDeriv j (partialDeriv i F) y := by
    intro F U hU hF y hy i j
    have hFa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F y := hF.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
    have h2le : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by
      first
        | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
        | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
        | simp
    have hF2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F y := hFa.of_le h2le
    have hsy : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ F y :=
      hF2.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField])
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y :=
      (hF2.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have key : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b F) y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y (e a) (e b) := by
      intro a b
      show fderiv ℝ (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x (e b)) y (e a) = _
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    rw [key, key]
    exact hsy _ _
  
  have hpκ : p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := mem_chart_source E3 p
  have hy₂ : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := mem_chart_target E3 p
  have hsm : ∀ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    intro f hf
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hdF : ∀ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f p ≠ 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro f hf h
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f p := hf.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have heq : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f p =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      rw [hmd.mfderiv]
      simp [writtenInExtChartAt]
      rfl
    rw [← heq]
    exact h
  have hGsymm : ∀ (w : E3) (a b : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm w a b = g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm w b a :=
    fun w a b => g.symm _ _ _
  have hchr : ∀ (k i j : Fin 3) (w : E3),
      christoffel (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) k i j w =
        christoffel (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) k j i w := by
    intro k i j w
    have hf : (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z j i) =
        (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z i j) := funext fun z => hGsymm z j i
    simp only [christoffel, hf, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hHsym : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (chartAt E3 p).target → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) F i j (chartAt E3 p p) =
        hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) F j i (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    intro F hF i j
    simp only [hessLoc]
    rw [hschwarz F _ (chartAt E3 p).open_target hF _ hy₂ i j]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [hchr k i j]
  
  obtain ⟨V₀, f₀, -, hV₀o, hpV₀, hf₀, hdf₀, hV₀S, -, -, -⟩ :=
    hS.2 p hp (chartAt E3 p).source (chart_source_mem_nhds E3 p)
  have hPD : (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)).PosDef :=
    coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p (chartAt E3 p p) hy₂
  
  have hg5 : ∀ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V → p ∈ V → ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) → V ∩ S = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} →
      secondFundSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
          (chartAt E3 p p) =
        secondFundSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f₀ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
          (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    intro V f hV hpV hf hdf hVS
    have hfp : f p = 0 := by
      have h : p ∈ V ∩ S := ⟨hpV, hp⟩
      rw [hVS] at h
      exact h.2
    have hf₀p : f₀ p = 0 := by
      have h : p ∈ V₀ ∩ S := ⟨hpV₀, hp⟩
      rw [hV₀S] at h

subgoal_signatures.name: secondFundSq_congr_scale
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (μ : ℝ) (hPD : (G y).PosDef) (hξ : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k F₁ y) ≠ 0)

    (hDsymm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G F₂ i j y - μ * hessLoc G F₁ i j y =
      hessLoc G F₂ j i y - μ * hessLoc G F₁ j i y)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ)
    (y₁ y₂ : E3) (J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hJ : J.det ≠ 0) (hG₁ : (G₁ y₁).det ≠ 0)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, G₂ y₂ i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, J a i * G₁ y₁ a b * J b j)
    (hξ : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i F₂ y₂ = ∑ a : Fin 3, J a i * partialDeriv a F₁ y₁)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G₂ F₂ i j y₂ =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, J a i * J b j * hessLoc G₁ F₁ a b y₁) :
    secondFundSq G₂ F₂ y₂ = secondFundSq G₁ F₁ y₁

subgoal_signatures.name: hessLoc_chart_invariant
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) (hxV : Φ x ∈ V) :
    (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x).det ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) i j x =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x *
          partialDeriv j (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) b) x *
          hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) a b
            (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p₁ p₂ : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₁).target)
    (hy₂ : (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₂).source) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) ∧
    (∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y = ∑ a : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z))
            (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)))

by
  obtain ⟨ρ₂, hρ₂, hS2⟩ := surface_radial_geodesic_map g z r hr hball
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hS4⟩ := pullback_gauss_upper_bound g z r hr hball
  have hsk : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt k := Real.sqrt_nonneg k
  have hpos1 : 0 < 1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1) := by positivity
  refine ⟨min ρ₂ (1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1)), lt_min hρ₂ hpos1, ?_⟩
  intro Sig hSc hSm q hq hqs hqb ρ hρ hρle
  have hρ₁pos : 0 < min ρ₂ (1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1)) := lt_min hρ₂ hpos1
  have hρ₁₂ : min ρ₂ (1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1)) ≤ ρ₂ := min_le_left _ _
  have hkρ : Real.sqrt k * min ρ₂ (1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1)) ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 : min ρ₂ (1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1)) ≤ 1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1) := min_le_right _ _
    have h2 : Real.sqrt k * min ρ₂ (1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1)) ≤
        Real.sqrt k * (1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hsk
    have h3 : Real.sqrt k * (1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [mul_one_div, div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith
    linarith
  obtain ⟨F, hF0, hF, hFx⟩ := hS2 Sig hSc hSm q hq hqs hqb
  
  have hFt : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ₂, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target := by
    intro x hx
    apply hball
    have := (hFx x hx).1
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at this
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
    linarith
  have hGs : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y j i :=
    fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  have hGsm : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j) (chartAt E3 z).target :=
    fun i j => g.smooth z i j
  
  have hdF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) (Metric.ball 0 ρ₂) :=
    hF.fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball (by simp)
  have hcomp : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (a : Fin 3),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) a) (Metric.ball 0 ρ₂) := by
    intro i a
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) (Metric.ball 0 ρ₂) :=
      hdF.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
  have hGF : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) a b) (Metric.ball 0 ρ₂) :=
    fun a b => (hGsm a b).comp hF (fun x hx => hFt x hx)

      (fun x => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ₂) := by
    intro i j
    unfold pullMetric2
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun b _ =>
      ((hcomp i a).mul (hGF a b)).mul (hcomp j b)))
  
  have hhsymm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2),
      pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x i j =
        pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x j i := by
    intro x i j
    unfold pullMetric2
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
    rw [hGs (F x) b a]
    ring
  
  have hinj : ∀ x : E2, (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x).PosDef →
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x) := by
    intro x hpd
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro w hw
    by_contra hne
    have hv : (fun i => w i) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hne
      ext i
      exact congrFun h0 i
    have hpos := hpd.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
    have hw' : w = w 0 • e2 0 + w 1 • e2 1 := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [hw', map_add, map_smul, map_smul] at hw
    have hu : ∀ a : Fin 3, w 0 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 0)) a + w 1 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1)) a = 0 := by
      intro a
      have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v a) hw
      simpa using this
    have key : dotProduct (star (fun i => w i))
        (Matrix.mulVec (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x) fun i => w i) =

            g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) a b *
            (w 0 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 0)) b + w 1 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1)) b) := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, star_trivial, pullMetric2,
        Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.star_apply]
      ring
    rw [key] at hpos
    simp only [hu, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
  
  have hdet : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y).det ≠ 0 :=
    fun y hy => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g z y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hnf := radial_geodesic_normal_form (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (chartAt E3 z).target
    (chartAt E3 z).open_target hGsm hGs hdet ρ₂ F hF hFt (fun x hx => (hFx x hx).2.2.1)
    (fun x hx => (hFx x hx).2.2.2)
  have hsub : Metric.ball (0 : E2) (min ρ₂ (1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1))) ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ₂ :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ₁₂
  have hPD := normal_form_posDef_extends k (min ρ₂ (1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1))) hk hρ₁pos hkρ
    (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
    (fun i j => (hhs i j).mono hsub) hhsymm (fun x hx => hnf x (hsub hx))
    (by
      intro s hs0 hsle hpdS x hx
      have hsub' : Metric.ball (0 : E2) s ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ₂ :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (hsle.trans hρ₁₂)
      exact hS4 Sig hSm s F (hF.mono hsub')
        (fun y hy => ⟨(hFx y (hsub' hy)).1, (hFx y (hsub' hy)).2.1, hinj y (hpdS y hy)⟩) x hx)
  have hsubρ : Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (min ρ₂ (1 / (Real.sqrt k + 1))) :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball hρle
  refine ⟨F, hF0, hF.mono (hsubρ.trans hsub), fun i j => (hhs i j).mono (hsubρ.trans hsub), ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hx1 := hsubρ hx
  have hx2 := hsub hx1
  exact ⟨(hFx x hx2).1, (hFx x hx2).2.1, hinj x (hPD x hx1), hPD x hx1, hnf x hx2⟩
