signature.name: pullback_gauss_simons
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ k₀ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ k₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₂ ∧ ∀ Sig : Set M, IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig → ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (F : E2 → E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) → ∃ a : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 a (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, IsSurfA2At g Sig (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) (a x) ∧ 0 ≤ a x ∧ -(a x) / 2 - k₀ ≤ gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) x ∧ gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) x ≤ k₀ ∧ -2 * (a x) ^ 2 - C₁ * a x - C₂ * Real.sqrt (a x) ≤ lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) a x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hU : IsOpen (chartAt E3 z).target := (chartAt E3 z).open_target
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j)
      (chartAt E3 z).target := fun i j => g.smooth z i j
  have hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y j i :=
    fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  have hGpos : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y).PosDef :=
    fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g z y hy
  have hB : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r)) := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have hBU : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)).trans hball
  obtain ⟨K₀, hK₀, hamb⟩ := gs_amb_plane_bound _ _ hU hGs hGsymm hGpos _ hB hBU
  obtain ⟨c₁, c₂, hc₁, hc₂, hrem⟩ :=
    gs_simons_remainder_bound _ _ hU hGs hGsymm hGpos _ hB hBU
  refine ⟨K₀, 4 * K₀ + 2 * c₂, 2 * c₁, hK₀, by positivity, by positivity, ?_⟩
  
  intro Sig hSig ρ F hF hFx
  have hs : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hFB : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) :=
    fun x hx => Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hFx x hx).1
  have hFU : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target :=
    fun x hx => hBU (hFB x hx)
  have hinj : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x) :=
    fun x hx => (hFx x hx).2.2
  obtain ⟨hh, hhsymm, hhpos, hS, hSsymm, ha, ha0⟩ :=
    gs_regularity _ _ hU hGs hGsymm hGpos F _ hs hF hFU hinj
  
  have hkey : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V →
      (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ V → V ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).source →
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f → (∀ y ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f y ≠ 0) →
      V ∩ Sig = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} →
      secondFundSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F x) =
          gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x ∧
        (levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y))
            (F x) = 0 ↔ gsMeanCurv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x = 0) := by
    intro x hx V f hV hpV hVs hf hdf hVS
    have hpsrc : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source :=
      (chartAt E3 z).map_target (hFU x hx)
    have hκp : chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = F x :=
      (chartAt E3 z).right_inv (hFU x hx)
    have hcm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ (chartAt E3 z).symm) (chartAt E3 z).target :=
      hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    have hcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcm
    have hcda : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F x) :=
      hcd.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hFU x hx))
    have hf2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F x) :=
      hcda.of_le (by norm_cast)
    have hdf' : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F x) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hdf _ hpV
      have h0' : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y))
          (chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) = 0 := by
        rw [hκp]; exact h0
      have heq : f =ᶠ[𝓝 ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))]
          ((fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) ∘ (chartAt E3 z)) := by
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 z).open_source.mem_nhds hpsrc] with q hq
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, (chartAt E3 z).left_inv hq]
      have hmem : chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target :=
        (chartAt E3 z).map_source hpsrc
      have hd1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y))
          (chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) :=
        (hcm.contMDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hmem)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
      have hd2 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas _ _) hpsrc
      rw [heq.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp _ hd1 hd2, mfderiv_eq_fderiv, h0']
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp _
    have hzero : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F y) = 0 := by
      have hW : (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' V ∈ 𝓝 (F x) :=
        ((chartAt E3 z).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hV).mem_nhds ⟨hFU x hx, hpV⟩
      have hFc : ContinuousAt F x := hF.continuousOn.continuousAt (hs.mem_nhds hx)
      filter_upwards [hFc.preimage_mem_nhds hW, hs.mem_nhds hx] with y hy hys
      have h1 : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F y) ∈ V ∩ Sig := ⟨hy.2, (hFx y hys).2.1⟩
      rw [hVS] at h1
      exact h1.2
    exact gs_levelset_param _ F _ _ hs x hx hF (hinj x hx) hGsymm (hGpos _ (hFU x hx)) hf2 hdf'
      hzero
  
  have hH : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, gsMeanCurv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hpsrc : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source :=
      (chartAt E3 z).map_target (hFU x hx)
    obtain ⟨V, f, hVO, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hVS, hHf, -, -⟩ :=
      hSig.2 _ (hFx x hx).2.1 _ ((chartAt E3 z).open_source.mem_nhds hpsrc)
    have hf0 : f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = 0 := by
      have h1 : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ V ∩ Sig := ⟨hpV, (hFx x hx).2.1⟩
      rw [hVS] at h1
      exact h1.2
    have hlmc := hHf _ hpV hf0
    let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 z).symm.toPartialEquiv
        open_source := (chartAt E3 z).open_target
        open_target := (chartAt E3 z).open_source
        contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
        contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
    have hc := levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φ f (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) hf (F x)
      (hFU x hx) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
    have hΦ : (Φ : E3 → M) (F x) = (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) := rfl
    rw [hΦ, hlmc] at hc
    exact ((hkey x hx V f hVo hpV hVO hf hdf hVS).2).1 hc.symm
  
  have hloc : ∀ (C₁ C₂ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ),
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, C₁ k i j y = C₂ k i j y) →
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i j : Fin 2,
        gsSimonsE (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) C₁ i j x =
          gsSimonsE (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) C₂ i j x := by
    intro C₁ C₂ hC x hx i j
    have hev : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, C₁ k i j =ᶠ[𝓝 x] C₂ k i j := fun k i j =>
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hC y hy k i j)
    have hev2 : ∀ j' : Fin 2,
        (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2,
          (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F y)⁻¹ k l * C₁ k j' l y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2,
          (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F y)⁻¹ k l * C₂ k j' l y) := fun j' =>
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => by simp only [hC y hy])
    simp only [gsSimonsE, gsCovD1, gsCovD3, pd2, (hev2 _).fderiv_eq, (hev _ _ _).fderiv_eq,
      hC x hx]
  refine ⟨gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F, ha.of_le (by norm_cast), ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hκp : chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = F x :=
    (chartAt E3 z).right_inv (hFU x hx)
  
  have hgauss := gs_gauss_equation _ _ hU hGs hGsymm hGpos F _ hs hF hFU hinj x hx
  rw [hH x hx] at hgauss
  have hdetpos : 0 < (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x).det :=
    (hhpos x hx).det_pos
  have hdet : (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x).det =
      pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 0 0 *
        pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 1 1 -
      pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 0 1 ^ 2 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hhsymm x hx 1 0]
    ring
  have hb := hamb (F x) (hFB x hx) (gsTan F 0 x) (gsTan F 1 x)
  change |gsAmbPlane (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x| ≤
      K₀ * (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 0 0 *
        pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 1 1 -
      pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 0 1 ^ 2) at hb
  rw [← hdet] at hb
  have hA : |gsAmbPlane (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x /
      (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x).det| ≤ K₀ := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hdetpos, div_le_iff₀ hdetpos]
    exact hb
  obtain ⟨hA1, hA2⟩ := abs_le.mp hA
  have hax := ha0 x hx
  have hKlo : -(gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x) / 2 - K₀ ≤
      gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) x := by
    rw [hgauss]; linarith
  have hKhi : gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) x ≤ K₀ := by
    rw [hgauss]; linarith
  refine ⟨?_, hax, hKlo, hKhi, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro V f hV hpV hVs hf hdf hVS
    rw [hκp]
    exact (hkey x hx V f hV hpV hVs hf hdf hVS).1
  · 
    have hsim := gs_simons_intrinsic (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
      (gsSff (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) _ hs hh hhsymm hhpos hS hSsymm
      (fun y hy => hH y hy) x hx
    have hcod := gs_codazzi _ _ hU hGs hGsymm hGpos F _ hs hF hFU hinj
    have hE : ∀ i j : Fin 2,
        gsSimonsE (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
          (gsCodazzi (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
            (gsSff (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)) i j x =
        gsSimonsE (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
          (gsAmbCod (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) i j x :=
      hloc _ _ hcod x hx
    have hI : gsInner (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
          (gsSff (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
          (gsSimonsE (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
            (gsCodazzi (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
              (gsSff (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F))) x =
        gsInner (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
          (gsSff (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
          (gsSimonsE (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
            (gsAmbCod (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)) x := by
      simp only [gsInner, hE]
    rw [hI] at hsim
    have hR := hrem F _ hs hF hFU hinj x hx (hFB x hx)
    obtain ⟨hR1, -⟩ := abs_le.mp hR
    change 4 * gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) x *
        gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x +
      2 * gsInner (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
          (gsSff (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
          (gsSimonsE (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
            (gsAmbCod (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)) x ≤
      lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
        (gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) x at hsim
    have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKlo hax
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)]

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: levelMeanCurv_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ x) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) h x

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_levelset_param
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (f : E3 → ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f (F x)) (hdf : fderiv ℝ f (F x) ≠ 0) (hzero : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f (F y) = 0) : secondFundSq G f (F x) = gsSffSq G F x ∧ (levelMeanCurvCoord G f (F x) = 0 ↔ gsMeanCurv G F x = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullMetric2 G F x i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j = pullMetric2 G F x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, (pullMetric2 G F x).PosDef) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSff G F i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsSff G F i j x = gsSff G F j i x) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSffSq G F) s ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ gsSffSq G F x)

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_gauss_equation
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 G F) x = gsAmbPlane G F x / (pullMetric2 G F x).det + (gsMeanCurv G F x ^ 2 - gsSffSq G F x) / 2

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_amb_plane_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (B : Set E3) (hB : IsCompact B) (hBU : B ⊆ U) : ∃ K₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ K₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ B, ∀ X Y : E3, |∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, G y m l * riemannLocal G l i j k y * X i * Y j * Y k * X m| ≤ K₀ * ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * G y a b * X b) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y a * G y a b * Y b) - (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * G y a b * Y b) ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_simons_intrinsic
subgoal_signatures.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (S : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) (hhsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) (hS : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (S i j) s) (hSsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, S i j x = S j i x) (htr : ∀ x ∈ s, gsTrace h S x = 0) : ∀ x ∈ s, 4 * gaussCurv2 h x * gsInner h S S x + 2 * gsInner h S (gsSimonsE h (gsCodazzi h S)) x ≤ lap2 h (gsInner h S S) x

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_codazzi
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsCodazzi (pullMetric2 G F) (gsSff G F) k i j x = gsAmbCod G F k i j x

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_simons_remainder_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (B : Set E3) (hB : IsCompact B) (hBU : B ⊆ U) : ∃ c₁ c₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ c₁ ∧ 0 ≤ c₂ ∧ ∀ (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2), IsOpen s → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s → (∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) → (∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) → ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ B → |gsInner (pullMetric2 G F) (gsSff G F) (gsSimonsE (pullMetric2 G F) (gsAmbCod G F)) x| ≤ c₁ * Real.sqrt (gsSffSq G F x) + c₂ * gsSffSq G F x

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ k₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ k₀ ∧ ∀ Sig : Set M, IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig → IsStableMinimalSet g Sig → ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (F : E2 → E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) → ∃ a b φ : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn a (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 φ (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, IsSurfA2At g Sig (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) (a x) ∧ -k₀ ≤ b x ∧ 0 < φ x ∧ lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) φ x + (a x + b x) * φ x ≤ 0

signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ k₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ k₀ ∧ ∀ Sig : Set M, IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig → IsStableMinimalSet g Sig → ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (F : E2 → E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) → ∃ a b φ : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn a (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 2 φ (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, IsSurfA2At g Sig (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) (a x) ∧ -k₀ ≤ b x ∧ 0 < φ x ∧ lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) φ x + (a x + b x) * φ x ≤ 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hlapc : ∀ (h₁ h₂ : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : E2 → ℝ) (U : Set E2) (x : E2),
      IsOpen U → x ∈ U → Set.EqOn h₁ h₂ U → Set.EqOn w₁ w₂ U → lap2 h₁ w₁ x = lap2 h₂ w₂ x := by
    intro h₁ h₂ w₁ w₂ U x hU hx hh hw
    have hUx : U ∈ 𝓝 x := hU.mem_nhds hx
    have hhx : h₁ x = h₂ x := hh hx
    have hent : ∀ (a b k : Fin 2),
        pd2 k (fun z => h₁ z a b) x = pd2 k (fun z => h₂ z a b) x := by
      intro a b k
      have hev : (fun z => h₁ z a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => h₂ z a b) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem hUx (fun y hy => by simp only [hh hy])
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => h₁ z a b) x (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ (fun z => h₂ z a b) x (e2 k)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h₁ k i j x = christoffel2 h₂ k i j x := by
      intro k i j
      simp only [christoffel2, hhx, hent]
    have hw1 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k w₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] pd2 k w₂ := by
      intro k
      filter_upwards [hUx] with y hy
      have hev : w₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] w₂ := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun t ht => hw ht)
      show fderiv ℝ w₁ y (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ w₂ y (e2 k)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hw0 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k w₁ x = pd2 k w₂ x := fun k => (hw1 k).eq_of_nhds
    have hw2 : ∀ i k : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 k w₁) x = pd2 i (pd2 k w₂) x := by
      intro i k
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 k w₁) x (e2 i) = fderiv ℝ (pd2 k w₂) x (e2 i)
      rw [(hw1 k).fderiv_eq]
    simp only [lap2, hhx, hchr, hw0, hw2]
  
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀, hRicB⟩ := ejpRic_lower_bound (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
    (chartAt E3 z).target (Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r)) (chartAt E3 z).open_target
    (isCompact_closedBall _ _) hball (g.smooth z) (fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g z y hy)
  refine ⟨k₀, hk₀, ?_⟩
  intro Sig hSm hstab ρ F hF hFx
  obtain ⟨φM, hφM⟩ := hstab
  have hFK : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := (hFx x hx).1
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at h1
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
    linarith
  have hFt : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target :=
    fun x hx => hball (hFK x hx)
  have hsrc : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source :=
    fun x hx => (chartAt E3 z).map_target (hFt x hx)
  
  have hA : ∀ x : E2, ∃ t : ℝ, x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ →
      IsSurfA2At g Sig (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) t := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ
    · obtain ⟨t, -, ht, -⟩ := surfA2_chart_invariant g Sig hSm z _ (hFx x hx).2.1 (hsrc x hx)
      exact ⟨t, fun _ => ht⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hx⟩
  choose a ha using hA
  have hsym : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y j i :=
    fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  
  have hloc : ∀ x₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∃ (O : Set E2) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U' : Set E3),
      IsOpen O ∧ x₀ ∈ O ∧ O ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ ∧ IsOpen U' ∧ U' ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U' ∧ (∀ y ∈ U', fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, F x ∈ U' ∧ Φ (F x) = 0 ∧
        φM ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) ∧
        a x = secondFundSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) ∧
        0 ≤ ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) := by
    intro x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨-, V, f, hVo, hqV, hf, hdf, hVS, hst⟩ := hφM _ (hFx x₀ hx₀).2.1
    obtain ⟨hΦs, hΦd⟩ := ejp_chart_transfer g z f hf
    have hU'o : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' V) :=
      (chartAt E3 z).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 z).open_target hVo
    have hOo : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∩
        F ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' V)) :=
      hF.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball hU'o
    have hVS' : (V ∩ (chartAt E3 z).source) ∩ Sig =
        (V ∩ (chartAt E3 z).source) ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hyV, hys⟩, hyS⟩
        have h' : y ∈ V ∩ Sig := ⟨hyV, hyS⟩
        rw [hVS] at h'
        exact ⟨⟨hyV, hys⟩, h'.2⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨hyV, hys⟩, hy0⟩
        have h' : y ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hyV, hy0⟩
        rw [← hVS] at h'
        exact ⟨⟨hyV, hys⟩, h'.2⟩
    refine ⟨_, fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y), _, hOo, ⟨hx₀, hFt x₀ hx₀, hqV⟩,
      Set.inter_subset_left, hU'o, Set.inter_subset_left, hΦs.mono Set.inter_subset_left, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w hw
      have h1 := (hΦd ((chartAt E3 z).symm w) ((chartAt E3 z).map_target hw.1) (hdf _ hw.2)).1
      rwa [(chartAt E3 z).right_inv hw.1] at h1
    · intro x hx
      have hxW : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := hx.1
      have hp : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ V := hx.2.2
      have hpS : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig := (hFx x hxW).2.1
      have hκp : chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = F x :=
        (chartAt E3 z).right_inv (hFt x hxW)
      obtain ⟨-, hgr, hjac⟩ := hΦd _ (hsrc x hxW) (hdf _ hp)
      rw [hκp] at hgr hjac
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hst _ ⟨hp, hpS⟩
      have hf0 : f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = 0 := by
        have h' : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ V ∩ Sig := ⟨hp, hpS⟩
        rw [hVS] at h'
        exact h'.2
      have hsf := ha x hxW _ f (hVo.inter (chartAt E3 z).open_source) ⟨hp, hsrc x hxW⟩
        Set.inter_subset_right hf (fun y hy => hdf y hy.1) hVS'
      rw [hκp] at hsf
      refine ⟨hx.2, hf0, ?_, hsf.symm, ?_⟩
      · rw [hgr] at h1
        exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h1
      · rw [hjac] at h2
        exact h2
  
  have hkey : ∀ x₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∃ O : Set E2, IsOpen O ∧ x₀ ∈ O ∧
      O ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ ∧ ∃ ψ' Jf Rf af : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ' O ∧ ContinuousOn Jf O ∧
      ContinuousOn Rf O ∧ ContinuousOn af O ∧ ∀ x ∈ O,
        φM ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = ψ' x ∧ a x = af x ∧ 0 < ψ' x ∧ 0 ≤ Jf x ∧
        -k₀ ≤ Rf x ∧
        lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
          (fun x => φM ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) x =
          -(ψ' x) ^ 2 * Jf x - (af x + Rf x) * ψ' x := by
    intro x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨O, Φ, U', hOo, hx₀O, hOW, hU'o, hU'T, hΦ, hdΦ, hO⟩ := hloc x₀ hx₀
    have hGU : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j) U' :=
      fun i j => (g.smooth z i j).mono hU'T
    have hPU : ∀ y ∈ U', (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y).PosDef :=
      fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g z y (hU'T hy)
    obtain ⟨hSpos, hSs, hψs, hPots⟩ :=
      ejp_level_regularity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ U' hU'o hGU hPU hΦ hdΦ
    obtain ⟨hpd, hinv, hchr, -, hNs⟩ :=
      ejp_coord_smooth (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ U' hU'o hGU hPU hΦ
    have hH := lmcCoord_contDiffOn (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) U' hU'o hGU hPU Φ hΦ hdΦ
    have hric : ∀ j k : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ricci (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) j k y) U' := by
      intro j k
      simp only [ricci]
      apply ContDiffOn.add
      · apply ContDiffOn.sum
        intro i _
        exact (hpd _ (hchr i j k) i).sub (hpd _ (hchr i i k) j)
      · apply ContDiffOn.sum
        intro i _
        apply ContDiffOn.sum
        intro p _
        exact ((hchr i i p).mul (hchr p j k)).sub ((hchr i j p).mul (hchr p i k))
    have hRic : ContinuousOn (ejpRic (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ) U' := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
          ricci (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) j k y * ejpN (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ y j *
            ejpN (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ y k) U' := by
        apply ContDiffOn.sum
        intro j _
        apply ContDiffOn.sum
        intro k _
        exact ((hric j k).mul (hNs j)).mul (hNs k)
      exact h1.continuousOn.div hSs.continuousOn (fun y hy => (hSpos y hy).ne')
    have hJac : ContinuousOn (ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ) U' := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
            partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ) y *
            partialDeriv j Φ y) U' := by
        apply ContDiffOn.sum
        intro i _
        apply ContDiffOn.sum
        intro j _
        exact ((hinv i j).mul (hpd _ hH i)).mul (hpd _ hΦ j)
      exact h1.continuousOn
    have hsff : ContinuousOn (secondFundSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ) U' := by
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ y -
          ejpRic (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ y) U' := hPots.continuousOn.sub hRic
      refine h1.congr (fun y _ => ?_)
      simp only [ejpPot]
      ring
    have hFO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F O := hF.mono hOW
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo F O U' := fun x hx => (hO x hx).1
    refine ⟨O, hOo, hx₀O, hOW, fun x => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x),
      fun x => ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x),
      fun x => ejpRic (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x),
      fun x => secondFundSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x),
      hψs.comp hFO hmaps, hJac.comp hFO.continuousOn hmaps, hRic.comp hFO.continuousOn hmaps,
      hsff.comp hFO.continuousOn hmaps, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxU, hΦ0, hφx, hax, hJx⟩ := hO x hx
    have hψpos : 0 < ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) :=
      inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hSpos _ hxU))
    have hRx : -k₀ ≤ ejpRic (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) :=
      hRicB Φ (F x) (hFK x (hOW hx)) (hdΦ _ hxU)
    refine ⟨hφx, hax, hψpos, hJx, hRx, ?_⟩
    have hw : Set.EqOn (fun x => φM ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)))
        (fun x => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x)) O :=
      fun x hx => (hO x hx).2.2.1
    have hL := hlapc (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
      (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) _ _ O x hOo hx (fun _ _ => rfl) hw
    have hs2 := ejp_immersion_lap2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ
      (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ) U' hU'o hGU hsym hPU hΦ hdΦ hψs F O hOo hFO
      (fun x hx => ⟨(hO x hx).1, (hO x hx).2.1, (hFx x (hOW hx)).2.2⟩) x hx
    have hs1 := ejp_ambient_identity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ U' hU'o hGU hsym hPU hΦ hdΦ
      (F x) hxU
    rw [hL, hs2]
    simp only [ejpPot] at hs1
    linear_combination hs1
  
  refine ⟨a, fun x => -(lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
      (fun x => φM ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) x) / φM ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) - a x,
    fun x => φM ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨O, hOo, hx₀O, -, ψ', Jf, Rf, af, -, -, -, haf, hval⟩ := hkey x₀ hx₀
    have hev : af =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀] a :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hOo.mem_nhds hx₀O) (fun x hx => ((hval x hx).2.1).symm)
    exact ((haf.continuousAt (hOo.mem_nhds hx₀O)).congr hev).continuousWithinAt
  · 
    intro x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨O, hOo, hx₀O, -, ψ', Jf, Rf, af, hψ', hJf, hRf, haf, hval⟩ := hkey x₀ hx₀
    have hc : ContinuousOn
        (fun x => -(-(ψ' x) ^ 2 * Jf x - (af x + Rf x) * ψ' x) / ψ' x - af x) O :=
      ((((hψ'.continuousOn.pow 2).neg.mul hJf).sub ((haf.add hRf).mul hψ'.continuousOn)).neg.div
        hψ'.continuousOn (fun x hx => ((hval x hx).2.2.1).ne')).sub haf
    have hev : (fun x => -(-(ψ' x) ^ 2 * Jf x - (af x + Rf x) * ψ' x) / ψ' x - af x) =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀]
        (fun x => -(lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
          (fun x => φM ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) x) / φM ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) - a x) := by
      refine Filter.eventually_of_mem (hOo.mem_nhds hx₀O) (fun x hx => ?_)
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, -, -, h6⟩ := hval x hx
      simp only [h1, h2, h6]
    exact ((hc.continuousAt (hOo.mem_nhds hx₀O)).congr hev).continuousWithinAt
  · 
    refine contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn (fun x₀ hx₀ => ?_)
    obtain ⟨O, hOo, hx₀O, -, ψ', Jf, Rf, af, hψ', -, -, -, hval⟩ := hkey x₀ hx₀
    refine ⟨O, hOo, hx₀O, ?_⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∃ ρ₀ c₀ ε₁ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ρ₀ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ 0 < c₀ ∧ 0 < ε₁ ∧ ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → ∀ (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (a : E2 → ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ))) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / μ), (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 a (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ)) → a 0 = μ ^ 2 → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / μ), 0 ≤ a x ∧ a x ≤ μ ^ 2 ∧ -(a x) / 2 - ε₁ * μ ^ 2 ≤ gaussCurv2 h x ∧ gaussCurv2 h x ≤ ε₁ * μ ^ 2 ∧ -2 * (a x) ^ 2 - ε₁ * μ ^ 2 * a x - ε₁ * μ ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (a x) ≤ lap2 h a x) → c₀ ≤ ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ₀ / μ), a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det

signature.name: normal_disc_mean_value
signature.statement: ∃ ρ₀ c₀ ε₁ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ρ₀ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ 0 < c₀ ∧ 0 < ε₁ ∧ ∀ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ → ∀ (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (a : E2 → ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ))) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / μ), (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 a (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ)) → a 0 = μ ^ 2 → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / μ), 0 ≤ a x ∧ a x ≤ μ ^ 2 ∧ -(a x) / 2 - ε₁ * μ ^ 2 ≤ gaussCurv2 h x ∧ gaussCurv2 h x ≤ ε₁ * μ ^ 2 ∧ -2 * (a x) ^ 2 - ε₁ * μ ^ 2 * a x - ε₁ * μ ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (a x) ≤ lap2 h a x) → c₀ ≤ ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ₀ / μ), a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨1 / 2, Real.pi / 8, 1 / 2, by norm_num, le_refl _, by positivity, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro μ hμ h a hh hnf ha2 ha0 hb
  have hR : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / μ := by positivity
  have h2inf : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  
  have hnorm : ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1‖ = 1 := by
    intro φ
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hmem : ∀ (φ τ : ℝ), |τ| < 1 / μ →
      τ • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / μ) := by
    intro φ τ hτ
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_smul, hnorm, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hτ
  
  have hpt : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / μ), 0 ≤ a x ∧ a x ≤ μ ^ 2 ∧
      -(μ ^ 2) ≤ gaussCurv2 h x ∧ gaussCurv2 h x ≤ 1 / 2 * μ ^ 2 ∧
      -(3 * μ ^ 4) ≤ lap2 h a x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hb x hx
    have hs : Real.sqrt (a x) ≤ μ := by
      calc Real.sqrt (a x) ≤ Real.sqrt (μ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h2
        _ = μ := Real.sqrt_sq hμ.le
    have hs0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (a x)
    refine ⟨h1, h2, by linarith, h4, ?_⟩
    have e1 : a x ^ 2 ≤ μ ^ 4 := by nlinarith
    have e2 : μ ^ 2 * a x ≤ μ ^ 4 := by nlinarith
    have e3 : μ ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (a x) ≤ μ ^ 4 := by
      have : μ ^ 3 * Real.sqrt (a x) ≤ μ ^ 3 * μ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (by positivity)
      nlinarith
    nlinarith
  
  have hdetpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / μ), 0 < (h x).det :=
    fun x hx => (hnf x hx).1.det_pos
  have hdetC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x).det) (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ)) := by
    have e : (fun x => (h x).det) = fun x => h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 := by
      funext x; exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
    rw [e]
    exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have huC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ)) :=
    hdetC.sqrt (fun x hx => (hdetpos x hx).ne')
  have hu1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ)) :=
    huC.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have ha1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 a (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ)) := ha2.of_le (by norm_num)
  have hFC : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ)) :=
    ha1.mul hu1
  have hdiff : ∀ (g : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ)) →
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / μ), DifferentiableAt ℝ g x := by
    intro g hg x hx
    exact (hg.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)
  have hdirC : ∀ s : ℝ, Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) := by
    intro s; fun_prop
  have hcompφ : ∀ (g : E2 → ℝ) (s : ℝ), ContinuousOn g (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ)) → |s| < 1 / μ →
      Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => g (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) := by
    intro g s hg hs
    exact hg.comp_continuous (hdirC s) (fun φ => hmem φ s hs)
  have hcompD : ∀ (g : E2 → ℝ) (s : ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g (Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ)) → |s| < 1 / μ →
      Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ g (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
        (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) := by
    intro g s hg hs
    have h1 : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ g (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) :=
      (hg.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball le_rfl).comp_continuous (hdirC s)
        (fun φ => hmem φ s hs)
    have h2 : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) := by fun_prop
    exact h1.clm_apply h2
  
  have hray : ∀ φ : ℝ,
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s < 1 / μ →
        Real.sqrt (h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det ≤ 2) ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < 1 / μ → -(1 / 3) * μ ^ 2 * s ≤
        deriv (fun τ : ℝ => Real.sqrt (h (τ • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det) s := by
    intro φ
    obtain ⟨hqC, hq0, hode⟩ := normal_form_ray_jacobi (1 / μ) hR h hh hnf _ (hnorm φ)
    have hB := jacobi_q_radial_bounds μ (1 / 2) hμ (by norm_num)
      (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det)
      (fun t : ℝ => gaussCurv2 h (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)))
      (hqC.of_le h2inf)
      (by simp only [zero_smul]; exact hq0)
      (fun τ hτ => hdetpos _ (hmem φ τ (abs_lt.mpr hτ)))
      hode
      (fun t ht htR => by
        have hx := hmem φ t (by rw [abs_of_pos ht]; exact htR)
        exact ⟨(hpt _ hx).2.2.1, (hpt _ hx).2.2.2.1⟩)
    refine ⟨hB.1, fun s hs hsR => ?_⟩
    have := hB.2 s hs hsR
    linarith
  have hdet0 : (h 0).det = 1 := (normal_form_ray_jacobi (1 / μ) hR h hh hnf _ (hnorm 0)).2.1
  
  have hdu : ∀ (φ t : ℝ), |t| < 1 / μ →
      HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => Real.sqrt (h (τ • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
          (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) t := by
    intro φ t ht
    have hd := hdiff _ hu1 _ (hmem φ t ht)
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => τ • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
        (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) t := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)
    exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hl
  
  have harea : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 / μ →
      (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) t, Real.sqrt (h x).det) ≤ 2 * Real.pi * t ^ 2 := by
    intro t ht htR
    have hcl : Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) t ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ) :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball htR
    obtain ⟨hpol, hcont⟩ := integral_ball_polar_rad t ht (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det)
      (huC.continuousOn.mono hcl)
    rw [hpol]
    have hle : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t,
        (∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
          Real.sqrt (h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det * s) ≤
          4 * Real.pi * s := by
      intro s hs
      have hs' : |s| < 1 / μ := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]; linarith [hs.2]
      have hc : (∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, (2 * s)) = 4 * Real.pi * s := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]; ring
      rw [← hc]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
      · exact ((hcompφ _ s huC.continuousOn hs').mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable _ _
      · exact intervalIntegrable_const
      · intro φ _
        have := (hray φ).1 s hs.1 (by linarith [hs.2])
        nlinarith [hs.1]
    calc (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
          Real.sqrt (h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det * s)
        ≤ ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, 4 * Real.pi * s :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on ht.le (hcont.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc ht.le)
            ((continuous_const.mul continuous_id).intervalIntegrable _ _) hle
      _ = 2 * Real.pi * t ^ 2 := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_id]; ring
  
  have hflux : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 / μ → -(6 * Real.pi * μ ^ 4 * t) ≤
      ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
        Real.sqrt (h (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det *
          fderiv ℝ a (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
            (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) := by
    intro t ht htR
    obtain ⟨hcontL, hfl⟩ := normal_disc_flux_polar (1 / μ) hR h a hh hnf ha2
    have hfl' := hfl t ht htR
    have hcl : Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) t ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ) :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball htR
    have hint1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det * lap2 h a x) (Metric.ball 0 t) :=
      ((hcontL.mono hcl).integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall 0 t)).mono_set
        Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have hint2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det * (-(3 * μ ^ 4))) (Metric.ball 0 t) :=
      (((huC.continuousOn.mono hcl).mul continuousOn_const).integrableOn_compact
        (isCompact_closedBall 0 t)).mono_set Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have hmono : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) t, Real.sqrt (h x).det * (-(3 * μ ^ 4))) ≤
        ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) t, Real.sqrt (h x).det * lap2 h a x := by
      refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hint2 hint1 Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet ?_
      intro x hx
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (hpt x (Metric.ball_subset_ball htR.le hx)).2.2.2.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_mul_const] at hmono
    have hA := harea t ht htR
    have hrw : (∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
        t * Real.sqrt (h (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det *
          fderiv ℝ a (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
            (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) =
        t * ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
          Real.sqrt (h (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det *
            fderiv ℝ a (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
              (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      congr 1; funext φ; ring
    rw [hrw] at hfl'
    have hμ4 : 0 ≤ 3 * μ ^ 4 := by positivity
    have key : -(6 * Real.pi * μ ^ 4 * t ^ 2) ≤ t * ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
          Real.sqrt (h (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det *
            fderiv ℝ a (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
              (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) := by
      rw [← hfl']
      nlinarith
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcon ht
    nlinarith
  
  have hW : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 / 2 / μ → Real.pi * μ ^ 2 ≤
      ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
        a (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) *
          Real.sqrt (h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det := by
    intro s hs hsρ
    have hhalf : 1 / 2 / μ < 1 / μ := by
      rw [div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hμ]; norm_num
    have hsR : s < 1 / μ := lt_of_le_of_lt hsρ hhalf
    obtain ⟨hftc, hψc⟩ := spherical_mean_ftc (1 / μ) (fun x => a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) hFC
      s hs hsR
    simp only [] at hftc hψc
    rw [hftc, ha0, hdet0, Real.sqrt_one, mul_one]
    
    have hψ : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) s, -(7 * Real.pi * μ ^ 4) * t ≤
        ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
          fderiv ℝ (fun x => a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det)
            (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) := by
      intro t ht
      have htR : t < 1 / μ := lt_of_le_of_lt ht.2 hsR
      have ht' : |t| < 1 / μ := by rw [abs_of_pos ht.1]; exact htR
      have hpw : ∀ φ : ℝ,
          Real.sqrt (h (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det *
              fderiv ℝ a (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
                (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) + -(1 / 3 * μ ^ 4 * t) ≤
            fderiv ℝ (fun x => a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det)
              (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) := by
        intro φ
        have hx := hmem φ t ht'
        rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hdiff _ ha1 _ hx) (hdiff _ hu1 _ hx)]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        have hD := (hray φ).2 t ht.1 htR
        rw [(hdu φ t ht').deriv] at hD
        obtain ⟨ha0x, hamx, -, -, -⟩ := hpt _ hx
        have hm : 0 ≤ μ ^ 2 * t := mul_nonneg (by positivity) ht.1.le
        nlinarith
      have hint1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun φ : ℝ =>
          Real.sqrt (h (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det *
              fderiv ℝ a (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
                (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) MeasureTheory.volume (-Real.pi) Real.pi :=
        ((hcompφ _ t huC.continuousOn ht').mul (hcompD a t ha1 ht')).intervalIntegrable _ _
      have hint2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun φ : ℝ =>
          fderiv ℝ (fun x => a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det)
              (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
          MeasureTheory.volume (-Real.pi) Real.pi :=
        (hcompD _ t hFC ht').intervalIntegrable _ _
      have hmono := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by linarith [Real.pi_pos])
        (hint1.add intervalIntegrable_const) hint2 (fun φ _ => hpw φ)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hint1 intervalIntegrable_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul] at hmono
      have hf := hflux t ht.1 htR
      have hpos : 0 ≤ Real.pi * μ ^ 4 * t :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le (by positivity)) ht.1.le
      nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
    have hint3 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => -(7 * Real.pi * μ ^ 4) * t)
        (Set.Ioc 0 s) := by
      exact (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).integrableOn_Icc.mono_set Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self
    have hint4 := (hψc.integrableOn_Icc (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)).mono_set
      (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := s))
    have hI : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..s, -(7 * Real.pi * μ ^ 4) * t) ≤
        ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..s, ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
          fderiv ℝ (fun x => a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det)
            (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hs, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hs]
      exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hint3 hint4 measurableSet_Ioc hψ
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_id] at hI
    have hμs : μ * s ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsρ hμ.le
      rw [show μ * (1 / 2 / μ) = 1 / 2 by field_simp] at this
      exact this
    have hμs0 : 0 ≤ μ * s := by positivity
    have hsq : μ ^ 4 * s ^ 2 ≤ μ ^ 2 * (1 / 4) := by
      have : (μ * s) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 2) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hμs0 hμs 2
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  
  have hρ : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 / μ := by positivity
  have hclρ : Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (1 / 2 / μ) ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (1 / μ) := by
    apply Metric.closedBall_subset_ball
    rw [div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hμ]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨hpol, hcont⟩ := integral_ball_polar_rad (1 / 2 / μ) hρ
    (fun x => a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) (hFC.continuousOn.mono hclρ)
  simp only [] at hpol hcont
  rw [hpol]
  have hle : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2 / μ), Real.pi * μ ^ 2 * s ≤
      ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
        a (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) *
          Real.sqrt (h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det * s := by
    intro s hs
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
    have := hW s hs.1 hs.2
    nlinarith [hs.1]
  calc Real.pi / 8 = ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(1 / 2 / μ), Real.pi * μ ^ 2 * s := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_id]
        field_simp

        rw [sub_self, hP0, norm_zero]; exact hr
      have hW' : (fun y => coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b) ⁻¹'
          ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' V) ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p x) := by
        apply hγc.preimage_mem_nhds
        rw [hγz]; exact hWo.mem_nhds hzW
      filter_upwards [hW', hCo.mem_nhds hzC] with y hy1 hy2
      obtain ⟨x'', ⟨hx''S, hx''s⟩, hx''eq⟩ := hgr y hy2
      have hsx : (chartAt E3 p).symm (coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b) = x'' := by
        rw [← hx''eq, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx''s]
      have hx''V : x'' ∈ V := by rw [← hsx]; exact hy1.2
      have h' : x'' ∈ V ∩ Sig := ⟨hx''V, hx''S⟩
      rw [hVS] at h'
      show f ((chartAt E3 p).symm (coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b)) = 0
      rw [hsx]; exact h'.2
    
    obtain ⟨hgrad, r0, s0, hhess⟩ := graph_jet_relations b w (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 p x) hw hpl hzb hFC2 hvan
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ : ∃ lam : ℝ,
        lam = partialDeriv b (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hlam] at hgrad hhess
    have hlam0 : lam ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hk0
      rw [hgrad k0, h0, zero_mul]
    have hξw : ∃ k : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv k (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ≠ 0 := by
      refine ⟨k0, fun h0 => hk0 ?_⟩
      rw [hgrad k0, h0, mul_zero]
    
    have hFsym := hschwarz _ _ hFC2
    have hFwsym := hschwarz _ _ hFwC2
    have h2' : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) (chartAt E3 p x) =
          lam * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)))
              (chartAt E3 p x) +
            (fun k => (r0 k + s0 k) / 2) i *
              partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (chartAt E3 p x) +
            (fun k => (r0 k + s0 k) / 2) j *
              partialDeriv i (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (chartAt E3 p x) := by
      intro i j
      have e1 := hhess i j
      have e2 := hhess j i
      rw [hFsym j i, hFwsym j i] at e2
      simp only
      linear_combination (e1 + e2) / 2
    
    have hlmc := levelMeanCurvCoord_rescale (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 p x) hGi lam hlam0 (fun k => (r0 k + s0 k) / 2) hgrad h2'
    
    have hdiff : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) i j
            (chartAt E3 p x) -
          lam * hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y))
            i j (chartAt E3 p x) =
        (r0 i + s0 i) / 2 *
            partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (chartAt E3 p x) +
          (r0 j + s0 j) / 2 *
            partialDeriv i (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (chartAt E3 p x) := by
      intro i j
      simp only [hessLoc]
      rw [h2' i j]
      simp only [hgrad, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hsfs := secondFundSq_congr_scale (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 p x) lam hPD
      (fun h => by obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hξw; exact hk (congrFun h k))
      hlam0 hgrad
      (fun i j => by rw [hdiff i j, hdiff j i]; ring)
      (fun v hv => by
        simp only [hdiff]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hv ⊢
        linear_combination ((r0 0 + s0 0) * v 0 + (r0 1 + s0 1) * v 1 + (r0 2 + s0 2) * v 2) * hv)
    exact ⟨⟨lam, hlam0, hlmc⟩, hsfs, hξw⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  
  · intro hzB hslope
    obtain ⟨V', f', hV', hxV', hf', hdf', hVS', hsfs'⟩ := hcurv x hxS
    
    have hxx : chartAt E3 x x ∈ (chartAt E3 x).target := mem_chart_target E3 x
    have hlinv : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) = x := (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs
    let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 p).symm.toPartialEquiv
        open_source := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
        open_target := (chartAt E3 p).open_source
        contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
        contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
    have hΦx : Φ (chartAt E3 p x) = x := hlinv
    have hzΦ : chartAt E3 p x ∈ Φ.source := hzt
    have h7 := sep_chart_transition g p x (chartAt E3 p x) hzt
      (by rw [hlinv]; exact mem_chart_source E3 x)
    rw [hlinv] at h7
    obtain ⟨h7d, h7G, h7ξ⟩ := h7
    have hentry : ∀ a i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm w)) (chartAt E3 p x) (e i) a =
          partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm w) a) (chartAt E3 p x) := by
      intro a i
      have h := ((EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp (chartAt E3 p x)
        h7d.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
      show _ = fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm w) a) (chartAt E3 p x) (e i)
      rw [show (fun w => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm w) a) =
        (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ (fun w => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm w))
        from rfl, h]
      rfl
    have h6 := hessLoc_chart_invariant g Φ f' Set.univ isOpen_univ hf'.contMDiffOn
      (chartAt E3 p x) hzΦ (Set.mem_univ _)
    rw [hΦx] at h6
    have h6' : (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 =>
          partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm w) a) (chartAt E3 p x)).det
          ≠ 0 ∧
        ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f' ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
            i j (chartAt E3 p x) =
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3,
            partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm w) a) (chartAt E3 p x) *
              partialDeriv j (fun w => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm w) c) (chartAt E3 p x) *
              hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => f' ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) a c
                (chartAt E3 x x) := h6
    have hPDx := coeff_chart_symm_posDef g x (chartAt E3 x x) hxx
    have hchartT : secondFundSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
          (fun y => f' ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) =
        secondFundSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => f' ((chartAt E3 x).symm y))
          (chartAt E3 x x) := by
      refine secondFundSq_congr_tensor (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (fun y => f' ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (fun y => f' ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 x x) (chartAt E3 p x)
        (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 =>
          partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm w) a) (chartAt E3 p x))
        h6'.1 hPDx.det_pos.ne' ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro i j
        rw [h7G i j]
        simp only [hentry, Matrix.of_apply]
      · intro i
        rw [h7ξ f' hf' i]
        simp only [hentry, Matrix.of_apply]
      · intro i j
        rw [h6'.2 i j]
        simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
    
    obtain ⟨-, hsfsT, hξw⟩ := hT V' f' hV' hxV' hf' hdf' hVS'
    have hsfs : secondFundSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ≤ Λ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hsfsT, hchartT]; exact hsfs'
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))⁻¹ a c *
          partialDeriv a (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (chartAt E3 p x) *
          partialDeriv c (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (chartAt E3 p x) := by
      have h := hquad _ hPD.inv
        (fun k => partialDeriv k (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (chartAt E3 p x))
      refine le_of_le_of_eq h ?_
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
      ring
    obtain ⟨-, hup, hinv, hΓ⟩ := hbd _ hzB
    refine planar_hessian_bound (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p x) b w m Mx Γ Λ hm
      hPD hup hinv hΓ hw hpl hslope ?_
    intro t t' ht ht'
    have h5 := tangent_hess_sq_le (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) (chartAt E3 p x) hPD (hHsym _ _ hFwC2) hξw
      t t' ht ht'
    refine h5.trans ?_
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (mul_nonneg (hquad _ hPD t) (hquad _ hPD t'))
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsfs hS0
  
  · obtain ⟨V, f, -, hV, hxV, hf, hdf, hVS, hH, -, -⟩ := hmin.2 x hxS Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
    have hfx : f x = 0 := by
      have h : x ∈ V ∩ Sig := ⟨hxV, hxS⟩
      rw [hVS] at h; exact h.2
    let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 p).symm.toPartialEquiv
        open_source := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
        open_target := (chartAt E3 p).open_source
        contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
        contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
    have hlmcF : g.levelMeanCurv f ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x)) =
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
          (chartAt E3 p x) :=
      levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φ f (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) hf (chartAt E3 p x) hzt
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl))
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs, hH x hxV hfx] at hlmcF
    obtain ⟨⟨lam, hlam0, hrel⟩, -, -⟩ := hT V f hV hxV hf hdf hVS
    rw [← hlmcF, zero_mul] at hrel
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hrel.symm).resolve_left hlam0

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: levelMeanCurv_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ x) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) h x

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_chart_transfer
subgoal_signatures.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z).target ∧ ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ≠ 0 ∧ g.gradInner f f x = ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ∧ g.jacobiDeriv f x = ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x)

subgoal_signatures.name: hessLoc_chart_invariant
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) (hxV : Φ x ∈ V) :
    (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x).det ≠ 0 ∧
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) i j x =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x *
          partialDeriv j (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) b) x *
          hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) a b
            (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))

subgoal_signatures.name: sep_chart_transition
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p₁ p₂ : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₁).target)
    (hy₂ : (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₂).source) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) ∧
    (∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y = ∑ a : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z))
            (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)))

subgoal_signatures.name: secondFundSq_congr_tensor
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ)
    (y₁ y₂ : E3) (J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hJ : J.det ≠ 0) (hG₁ : (G₁ y₁).det ≠ 0)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, G₂ y₂ i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, J a i * G₁ y₁ a b * J b j)
    (hξ : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i F₂ y₂ = ∑ a : Fin 3, J a i * partialDeriv a F₁ y₁)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G₂ F₂ i j y₂ =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, J a i * J b j * hessLoc G₁ F₁ a b y₁) :
    secondFundSq G₂ F₂ y₂ = secondFundSq G₁ F₁ y₁

subgoal_signatures.name: secondFundSq_congr_scale
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (μ : ℝ) (hPD : (G y).PosDef) (hξ : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k F₁ y) ≠ 0)
    (hμ0 : μ ≠ 0) (hgrad : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k F₂ y = μ * partialDeriv k F₁ y)
    (hDsymm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G F₂ i j y - μ * hessLoc G F₁ i j y =
      hessLoc G F₂ j i y - μ * hessLoc G F₁ j i y)
    (hD : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k F₁ y * v k = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * (hessLoc G F₂ i j y - μ * hessLoc G F₁ i j y) = 0) :
    secondFundSq G F₂ y = secondFundSq G F₁ y

subgoal_signatures.name: levelMeanCurvCoord_rescale
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f ψ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (hsymm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (β : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (h1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i ψ y = c * partialDeriv i f y)
    (h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) y =
      c * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y + β i * partialDeriv j f y +
        β j * partialDeriv i f y) :
    levelMeanCurvCoord G ψ y * |c| = c * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y

subgoal_signatures.name: graph_jet_relations
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(b : Fin 3) (w F : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3)
    (hw : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z))
    (hpl : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hz : z b = w (coordPlaneProj b z))
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F z)
    (hvan : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, F (coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b) = 0) :
    (∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j F z =
       partialDeriv b F z * partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z) ∧
    ∃ r s : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) z =
        partialDeriv b F z *
            partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y))) z +
          partialDeriv i (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z * r j +
          s i * partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z

subgoal_signatures.name: tangent_hess_sq_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (hG : (G y).PosDef) (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G f i j y = hessLoc G f j i y)
    (hξ : ∃ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k f y ≠ 0) (t t' : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ht : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i f y * t i = 0)
    (ht' : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i f y * t' i = 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * hessLoc G f i j y * t' j) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * G y i j * t j) *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t' i * G y i j * t' j) *
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a c * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv c f y) *
          secondFundSq G f y)

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_compact_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Ω : Set E3) (c : E3)
    (R0 : ℝ) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hball : Metric.closedBall c R0 ⊆ Ω)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) Ω)
    (hpos : ∀ y ∈ Ω, (G y).PosDef) :
    ∃ m Mx Γ : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ 0 ≤ Mx ∧ 0 ≤ Γ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c R0,
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, m * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G y i j * v j) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G y i j * v j ≤ Mx * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * (G y)⁻¹ i j * v j ≤ m⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j y| ≤ Γ)

subgoal_signatures.name: planar_hessian_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (z : E3) (b : Fin 3)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (m Mx Γ Λ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hG : (G z).PosDef)
    (hup : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G z i j * v j ≤ Mx * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2)
    (hinv : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * (G z)⁻¹ i j * v j ≤ m⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2)
    (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j z| ≤ Γ)
