    sepDensDiv G₁ P₁ y = |(fderiv ℝ τ y).det| * sepDensDiv G₂ P₂ (τ y)

signature.name: sepDensDiv_transition_pointwise
signature.statement:
(O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (τ : E3 → E3)
    (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ O) (G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P₁ P₂ : E3 → E3)
    (hlaw : ∀ z ∈ O, ∀ i j : Fin 3, G₁ z i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ τ z (e i) a * G₂ (τ z) a b * fderiv ℝ τ z (e j) b)
    (hpos : ∀ z ∈ O, 0 ≤ (G₂ (τ z)).det)
    (hvec : ∀ z ∈ O, fderiv ℝ τ z (P₁ z) = P₂ (τ z))
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ O) (hdet : (fderiv ℝ τ y).det ≠ 0)
    (hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G₂ z).det * P₂ z i) (τ y)) :
    sepDensDiv G₁ P₁ y = |(fderiv ℝ τ y).det| * sepDensDiv G₂ P₂ (τ y)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hexpf : ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E3), ℓ v = ∑ b : Fin 3, ℓ (e b) * v b := by
    intro ℓ v
    have hv : v = ∑ b : Fin 3, v b • e b := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  have hexpv : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (v : E3) (k : Fin 3),
      L v k = ∑ b : Fin 3, L (e b) k * v b := by
    intro L v k
    have := hexpf ((EuclideanSpace.proj k).comp L) v
    simpa using this
  
  have hdetJ : ∀ z, (jacMat τ z).det = (fderiv ℝ τ z).det := by
    intro z
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.det, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis]
    congr 1
  
  have hcof : ∀ (J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (p : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (J (i+1) (a+1) * J (i+2) (a+2) - J (i+1) (a+2) * J (i+2) (a+1)) *
        ∑ b : Fin 3, J i b * p b = J.det * p a := by
    intro J p a
    fin_cases a <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.det_fin_three] <;> ring
  
  have hsqrt : ∀ z ∈ O, Real.sqrt (G₁ z).det =
      |(jacMat τ z).det| * Real.sqrt (G₂ (τ z)).det := by
    intro z hz
    have hG : G₁ z = (jacMat τ z).transpose * G₂ (τ z) * jacMat τ z := by
      ext i j
      rw [hlaw z hz i j]
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, jacMat]
      ring
    rw [hG, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
    rw [show (jacMat τ z).det * (G₂ (τ z)).det * (jacMat τ z).det =
      (jacMat τ z).det ^ 2 * (G₂ (τ z)).det by ring]
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  
  obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, ∀ i w, W i w = Real.sqrt (G₂ w).det * P₂ w i :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hWfun : ∀ i, W i = fun w => Real.sqrt (G₂ w).det * P₂ w i := fun i => funext (hWdef i)
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, ∀ a z, F a z = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (jacMat τ z (i+1) (a+1) * jacMat τ z (i+2) (a+2) -
        jacMat τ z (i+1) (a+2) * jacMat τ z (i+2) (a+1)) * W i (τ z) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hFz : ∀ z ∈ O, ∀ a : Fin 3,
      F a z = (jacMat τ z).det * Real.sqrt (G₂ (τ z)).det * P₁ z a := by
    intro z hz a
    have hP : ∀ i, P₂ (τ z) i = ∑ b : Fin 3, jacMat τ z i b * P₁ z b := by
      intro i
      rw [← hvec z hz, hexpv]
      rfl
    have h := hcof (jacMat τ z) (fun b => P₁ z b) a
    rw [hFdef]
    simp only [hWdef, hP]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h ⊢
    linear_combination (Real.sqrt (G₂ (τ z)).det) * h
  
  have hyN : O ∈ 𝓝 y := hO.mem_nhds hy
  have hτc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ τ y := hτ.contDiffAt hyN
  have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y := hτc.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hD1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ τ) y := hτc.fderiv_right (m := 1)
    (by simpa using (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞))
  have hDd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) y := hD1.differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ τ y :=
    hτc.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simpa using (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞))
  obtain ⟨L, hB, hLsym⟩ : ∃ L : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      (∀ k a, HasFDerivAt (fun z => jacMat τ z k a) (L k a) y) ∧
      ∀ k a b, L k a (e b) = L k b (e a) := by
    refine ⟨fun k a => ((EuclideanSpace.proj k).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 (e a))).comp (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) y), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k a
      have h := ((EuclideanSpace.proj k).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 (e a))).hasFDerivAt.comp y hDd.hasFDerivAt
      convert h using 1
    · intro k a b
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp', Function.comp_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
      rw [hsymm (e b) (e a)]
  have hV : ∀ i, HasFDerivAt (fun z => W i (τ z))
      ((fderiv ℝ (W i) (τ y)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ y)) y := by
    intro i
    have hWi : DifferentiableAt ℝ (W i) (τ y) := by
      rw [hWfun i]; exact hW i
    exact hWi.hasFDerivAt.comp y hτd.hasFDerivAt
  have hF : ∀ a, HasFDerivAt (F a) (∑ i : Fin 3,
      ((jacMat τ y (i+1) (a+1) * jacMat τ y (i+2) (a+2) -
        jacMat τ y (i+1) (a+2) * jacMat τ y (i+2) (a+1)) •
          (fderiv ℝ (W i) (τ y)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ y) +
        W i (τ y) • ((jacMat τ y (i+1) (a+1) • L (i+2) (a+2) +
            jacMat τ y (i+2) (a+2) • L (i+1) (a+1)) -
          (jacMat τ y (i+1) (a+2) • L (i+2) (a+1) +
            jacMat τ y (i+2) (a+1) • L (i+1) (a+2))))) y := by
    intro a
    have hFa : F a = fun z => ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ,
        (jacMat τ z (i+1) (a+1) * jacMat τ z (i+2) (a+2) -
          jacMat τ z (i+1) (a+2) * jacMat τ z (i+2) (a+1)) * W i (τ z) :=
      funext (hFdef a)
    rw [hFa]
    exact HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun i _ =>
      (((hB (i+1) (a+1)).fun_mul (hB (i+2) (a+2))).fun_sub
        ((hB (i+1) (a+2)).fun_mul (hB (i+2) (a+1)))).fun_mul (hV i)
  
  have hDV : ∀ i a, fderiv ℝ (W i) (τ y) (fderiv ℝ τ y (e a)) =
      ∑ b : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (W i) (τ y) (e b) * jacMat τ y b a := by
    intro i a
    rw [hexpf]
    rfl
  have h01 : ∀ k, L k 0 (e 1) = L k 1 (e 0) := fun k => hLsym k 0 1
  have h02 : ∀ k, L k 0 (e 2) = L k 2 (e 0) := fun k => hLsym k 0 2
  have h12 : ∀ k, L k 1 (e 2) = L k 2 (e 1) := fun k => hLsym k 1 2
  have hdiv : ∑ a : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (F a) y (e a) =
      (jacMat τ y).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (W i) (τ y) (e i) := by
    simp only [fun a => (hF a).fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp', Function.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul, hDV]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceAdd, Matrix.det_fin_three]
    simp only [h01, h02, h12]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨s, hsdef⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = if 0 < (fderiv ℝ τ y).det then 1 else -1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs : 0 < s * (fderiv ℝ τ y).det := by
    rw [hsdef]
    split_ifs with h
    · linarith
    · have h' : (fderiv ℝ τ y).det < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h) hdet
      linarith
  have habs : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < s * t → |t| = s * t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hsdef] at ht ⊢
    split_ifs at ht ⊢ with h
    · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; ring
    · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith)]; ring
  have hδc : ContinuousAt (fun z => (fderiv ℝ τ z).det) y :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.continuous_det.continuousAt.comp hDd.continuousAt
  have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, 0 < s * (fderiv ℝ τ z).det :=
    (continuousAt_const.mul hδc).eventually (lt_mem_nhds hs)
  have hgerm : ∀ a : Fin 3, (fun z => Real.sqrt (G₁ z).det * P₁ z a) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
      fun z => s * F a z := by
    intro a
    filter_upwards [hyN, hev] with z hz hz'
    rw [hFz z hz a, hsqrt z hz, hdetJ z, habs _ hz']
    ring
  have hpart : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => Real.sqrt (G₁ z).det * P₁ z a) y =
      s * fderiv ℝ (F a) y (e a) := by
    intro a
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [(((hF a).const_mul s).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hgerm a)).fderiv, (hF a).fderiv]
    rfl
  unfold sepDensDiv
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hpart a), ← Finset.mul_sum, hdiv, hdetJ,
    habs _ hs]
  simp only [partialDeriv, hWfun]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U K : Set M) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hFK : Disjoint (closure F) K) :
    hullRiemPer g F U K ≤ sepRiemPer g F U

signature.name: hullRiemPer_le_sepRiemPer
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U K : Set M) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hFK : Disjoint (closure F) K) :
    hullRiemPer g F U K ≤ sepRiemPer g F U

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (A B : Set E3), IsClosed A → IsClosed B → Disjoint A B →
      ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y ∧ χ y ≤ 1) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ A, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1) ∧ (∀ y ∈ B, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0) := by
    intro A B hA hB hAB
    obtain ⟨f, hf0, hf1, hf01⟩ :=
      exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_nhds_of_isClosed 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (n := ⊤) hB hA hAB.symm
    refine ⟨f, ?_, fun y => ⟨(hf01 y).1, (hf01 y).2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp f.contMDiff
    · exact eventually_nhdsSet_iff_forall.mp hf1
    · exact eventually_nhdsSet_iff_forall.mp hf0
  
  have s2a : ∀ (Kc : Set E3) (X : E3 → E3), (∀ y, y ∉ Kc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) →
      ∀ (χ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ → (∀ y ∈ Kc ∩ tsupport X, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0) →
      ∀ (X' : E3 → E3), (∀ y, X' y = χ y • X y) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ X' := by
    intro Kc X hXs χ hχ hχK X' hX'
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
    · by_cases hyK : y ∈ Kc
      · have h0 := hχK y ⟨hyK, hyT⟩
        have hev : X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
          filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
          rw [hX' z, hz, zero_smul]
        exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
      · have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => χ z • X z) y := hχ.contDiffAt.smul (hXs y hyK)
        have hfun : X' = fun z => χ z • X z := funext hX'
        rw [hfun]
        exact h1
    · have h0 : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hyT
      have hev : X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
        filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
        rw [hX' z, hz, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  
  have s2b : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (χ : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →
      (∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y ∧ χ y ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (X' : E3 → E3), (∀ y, X' y = χ y • X y) →
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X' y i * X' y j ≤ 1 := by
    intro G X χ hXn hχb X' hX' y
    have hs := hXn y
    have hc : ∀ i, X' y i = χ y * X y i := by
      intro i
      rw [hX' y]
      rfl
    have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X' y i * X' y j =
        (χ y) ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j := by
      simp only [hc, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      ring
    rw [e1]
    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hχb y
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (sq_nonneg (χ y))
    nlinarith
  
  have s2 : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F' U' Kc : Set E3) (X : E3 → E3),
      (∀ y, y ∉ Kc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U' →
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →
      ∀ χ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y ∧ χ y ≤ 1) →
      (∀ y ∈ F' ∩ tsupport X, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1) →
      (∀ y ∈ Kc ∩ tsupport X, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0) →
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in F', sepDensDiv G X y) ≤ sepPerG G F' U' := by
    intro G F' U' Kc X hXs hXc hXU hXn χ hχ hχb hχF hχK
    obtain ⟨X', hX'⟩ : ∃ X' : E3 → E3, ∀ y, X' y = χ y • X y := ⟨fun y => χ y • X y, fun _ => rfl⟩
    have ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X' := s2a Kc X hXs χ hχ hχK X' hX'
    have hsupp : Function.support X' ⊆ Function.support X := by
      intro y hy h0
      apply hy
      rw [hX' y, h0, smul_zero]
    have hb : HasCompactSupport X' := hXc.mono hsupp
    have hc : tsupport X' ⊆ U' := (closure_mono hsupp).trans hXU
    have hd := s2b G X χ hXn hχb X' hX'
    have hFO : F' ⊆ {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z} := by
      intro y hy
      show ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z
      by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
      · filter_upwards [hχF y ⟨hy, hyT⟩] with z hz
        rw [hX' z, hz, one_smul]
      · have h0 : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hyT
        filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
        rw [hX' z, hz, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero]
    have hOo : IsOpen {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z} := isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds
    have hf : ∀ y ∈ {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z}, sepDensDiv G X' y = sepDensDiv G X y := by
      intro y hy
      have hy' : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z := hy
      unfold sepDensDiv
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      unfold partialDeriv
      have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X' z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
        filter_upwards [hy'] with z hz
        rw [hz]
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hint : ∫ y in F', sepDensDiv G X' y = ∫ y in F', sepDensDiv G X y := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      have h1 : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z}),
          sepDensDiv G X' y = sepDensDiv G X y :=
        ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hOo.measurableSet hf
      exact ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hFO h1
    unfold sepPerG
    rw [← hint]
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun (Y : E3 → E3) (_ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧
        tsupport Y ⊆ U' ∧ ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in F', sepDensDiv G Y y)) X' ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd⟩ le_rfl
  
  have s3 : ∀ (p : M) (T : Set E3), IsCompact T → T ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      Disjoint (closure ((chartAt E3 p) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ T))
        (closure ((chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ T)) := by
    intro p T hT hTt
    have hS : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 p).symm '' T) :=
      hT.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.mono hTt)
    have hSs : (chartAt E3 p).symm '' T ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact (chartAt E3 p).map_target (hTt hy)
    have hA : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 p) '' (closure F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' T)) :=
      (hS.inter_left isClosed_closure).image_of_continuousOn
        ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono (Set.inter_subset_right.trans hSs))
    have hB : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' T)) :=
      (hS.inter_left hK).image_of_continuousOn
        ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono (Set.inter_subset_right.trans hSs))
    have hA' : closure ((chartAt E3 p) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ T) ⊆
        (chartAt E3 p) '' (closure F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' T) := by
      refine closure_minimal ?_ hA.isClosed
      rintro _ ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxF, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hyT⟩
      exact ⟨x, ⟨subset_closure hxF, (chartAt E3 p) x, hyT, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    have hB' : closure ((chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ T) ⊆
        (chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' T) := by
      refine closure_minimal ?_ hB.isClosed
      rintro _ ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxK, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hyT⟩
      exact ⟨x, ⟨hxK, (chartAt E3 p) x, hyT, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    refine Disjoint.mono hA' hB' ?_
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨x₁, ⟨hx₁F, hx₁S⟩, rfl⟩ ⟨x₂, ⟨hx₂K, hx₂S⟩, hx⟩
    have hx12 : x₂ = x₁ := (chartAt E3 p).injOn (hSs hx₂S) (hSs hx₁S) hx
    subst hx12
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hFK hx₁F hx₂K
  
  unfold hullRiemPer sepRiemPer
  refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun p => iSup_mono fun W => iSup_mono fun h =>
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
  unfold hullPerG
  refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
  obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXU, hXn, -⟩ := hX
  have hTt : tsupport X ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hXU hy
    exact (chartAt E3 (p k)).map_source ((h.1 k).2 hx).2
  have hsep := s3 (p k) (tsupport X) hXc hTt
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ, hχb, hχA, hχB⟩ := s1 _ _ isClosed_closure isClosed_closure hsep
  exact s2 _ _ _ _ X hXs hXc hXU hXn χ hχ hχb (fun y hy => hχA y (subset_closure hy))
    (fun y hy => hχB y (subset_closure hy))

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Kc Ω A₀ Kv : Set M) (hKv : IsCompact Kv) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    (hKvΩ : Kv ⊆ Ω) (hA₀ : sepChartMeas A₀) (hfin : hullRiemPer g A₀ Ω Kc < ⊤) :
    ∃ F : Set M, sepChartMeas F ∧ symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ Kv ∧
      ∀ F' : Set M, sepChartMeas F' → symmDiff F' A₀ ⊆ Kv →
        hullRiemPer g F Ω Kc ≤ hullRiemPer g F' Ω Kc

signature.name: hullRiemPer_minimizer_exists
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Kc Ω A₀ Kv : Set M) (hKv : IsCompact Kv) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)
    (hKvΩ : Kv ⊆ Ω) (hA₀ : sepChartMeas A₀) (hfin : hullRiemPer g A₀ Ω Kc < ⊤) :
    ∃ F : Set M, sepChartMeas F ∧ symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ Kv ∧
      ∀ F' : Set M, sepChartMeas F' → symmDiff F' A₀ ⊆ Kv →
        hullRiemPer g F Ω Kc ≤ hullRiemPer g F' Ω Kc

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hsqrt : ∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det)
      (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    intro p
    have hent : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z i j) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      fun i j => g.smooth p i j
    have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det)
        (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      have hfun : (fun z => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det) = fun z =>
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 0 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 1 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 2
            - g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 0 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 2 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 1
            - g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 1 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 0 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 2
            + g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 1 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 2 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 0
            + g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 2 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 0 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 1
            - g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 0 2 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 1 1 *
              g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z 2 0 := by
        funext z
        exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
      rw [hfun]
      exact (((((((hent 0 0).mul (hent 1 1)).mul (hent 2 2)).sub
        (((hent 0 0).mul (hent 1 2)).mul (hent 2 1))).sub
        (((hent 0 1).mul (hent 1 0)).mul (hent 2 2))).add
        (((hent 0 1).mul (hent 1 2)).mul (hent 2 0))).add
        (((hent 0 2).mul (hent 1 0)).mul (hent 2 1))).sub
        (((hent 0 2).mul (hent 1 1)).mul (hent 2 0))
    exact hdet.sqrt (fun z hz => ne_of_gt (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p z hz).det_pos)
  
  have hzero : ∀ (p : M) (X : E3 → E3) (y : E3), y ∉ tsupport X →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y = 0 := by
    intro p X y hy
    have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy
    show ∑ i : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) y (e i) = 0
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
    have h2 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
      simp [hw]
    rw [h2.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hmeas : ∀ (p : M) (X : E3 → E3),
      Measurable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X) := by
    intro p X
    show Measurable (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) y (e i))
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ _ _)
  
  have hbdd : ∀ (p : M) (X : E3 → E3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X →
      tsupport X ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y| ≤ C := by
    intro p X hX hXc hXt
    have hTo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
    have hXi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) := fun i =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hX
    have hφ : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) := by
      intro i
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro z
      by_cases hz : z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
      · exact ((hsqrt p).mul (hXi i).contDiffOn).contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hz)
      · have hz' : z ∉ tsupport X := fun h => hz (hXt h)
        have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hz'
        refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
        simp [hw]
    have hc : Continuous (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X) := by
      show Continuous (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) y (e i))
      refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
      exact ((hφ i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := IsCompact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hXc hc.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max B 0, fun y => ?_⟩
    by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport X
    · have := hB y hy
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · rw [hzero p X y hy, abs_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  
  have hcmp : ∀ F : Set M, sepRiemPer g F Ω ≤ hullRiemPer g F Ω Kc := by
    intro F
    unfold sepRiemPer hullRiemPer
    refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun p => iSup_mono fun W => iSup_mono fun hW =>
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
    have hVt : chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := by
      rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact (chartAt E3 (p k)).map_source ((hW.1 k).2 hw).2
    unfold sepPerG hullPerG
    exact iSup₂_le fun X hX => le_iSup₂_of_le X ⟨fun y _ => hX.1.contDiffAt, hX.2.1, hX.2.2.1,
      hX.2.2.2, hbdd (p k) X hX.1 hX.2.1 (hX.2.2.1.trans hVt)⟩ le_rfl
  
  have hint : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (C S : Set E3) (Ss : ℕ → Set E3) (B : ℝ), IsCompact C →
      Measurable f → (∀ y : E3, y ∉ C → f y = 0) → (∀ y : E3, |f y| ≤ B) → MeasurableSet S →
      (∀ n, MeasurableSet (Ss n)) →
      Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y in Ss n, f y) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y in S, f y)) := by
    intro f C S Ss B hC hf hfC hB hS hSs hc
    have hCm : MeasurableSet C := hC.isClosed.measurableSet
    have hCfin : volume C < ⊤ := hC.measure_lt_top
    have hfi : Integrable f := by
      have hg : Integrable (C.indicator (fun _ => B)) :=
        (integrable_indicator_iff hCm).2 (integrableOn_const hCfin.ne)
      refine hg.mono' hf.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
      by_cases hy : y ∈ C
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hB y
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, hfC y hy, norm_zero]
    have key : ∀ A : Set E3, ‖∫ y in A, f y‖ ≤ B * (volume (A ∩ C)).toReal := by
      intro A
      have h1 : ∫ y in A, f y = ∫ y in A ∩ C, f y := by
        have e := integral_inter_add_diff (s := A) (f := f) (μ := volume) hCm hfi.integrableOn
        have z : ∫ y in A \ C, f y = 0 :=
          setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun y hy => hfC y hy.2)
        rw [z, add_zero] at e
        exact e.symm
      rw [h1]
      have h2 := norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const
        (lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right) hCfin)
        (fun y _ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hB y) (f := f) (s := A ∩ C) (μ := volume)
      simpa [Measure.real] using h2
    have hbound : ∀ n, ‖(∫ y in Ss n, f y) - ∫ y in S, f y‖ ≤
        2 * B * (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal := by
      intro n
      have e1 := integral_inter_add_diff hS (hfi.integrableOn (s := Ss n))
      have e2 := integral_inter_add_diff (hSs n) (hfi.integrableOn (s := S))
      have e3 : Ss n ∩ S = S ∩ Ss n := Set.inter_comm _ _
      have hd : (∫ y in Ss n, f y) - ∫ y in S, f y =
          (∫ y in Ss n \ S, f y) - ∫ y in S \ Ss n, f y := by
        rw [← e1, ← e2, e3]; ring
      rw [hd]
      have hfin : volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C) ≠ ⊤ :=
        ne_top_of_le_ne_top hCfin.ne (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
      have m1 : (volume ((Ss n \ S) ∩ C)).toReal ≤ (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono hfin (measure_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _
          (by rw [Set.symmDiff_def]; exact Set.subset_union_left)))
      have m2 : (volume ((S \ Ss n) ∩ C)).toReal ≤ (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono hfin (measure_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _
          (by rw [Set.symmDiff_def]; exact Set.subset_union_right)))
      have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hB 0)
      calc ‖(∫ y in Ss n \ S, f y) - ∫ y in S \ Ss n, f y‖
          ≤ ‖∫ y in Ss n \ S, f y‖ + ‖∫ y in S \ Ss n, f y‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ B * (volume ((Ss n \ S) ∩ C)).toReal + B * (volume ((S \ Ss n) ∩ C)).toReal :=
            add_le_add (key _) (key _)
        _ ≤ B * (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal +
              B * (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal := by gcongr
        _ = 2 * B * (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal := by ring
    rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    refine squeeze_zero (fun n => norm_nonneg _) hbound ?_
    have h0 : Tendsto (fun n => (volume (symmDiff (Ss n) S ∩ C)).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal ENNReal.zero_ne_top).comp hc
      simpa using this
    simpa using h0.const_mul (2 * B)
  
  have hsups : ∀ (α : Type) (N : ℕ) (P : Fin N → α → Prop) (a : Fin N → α → ENNReal)
      (m : ENNReal), (∀ k, ∃ x, P k x) → (∀ X : Fin N → α, (∀ k, P k (X k)) → ∑ k, a k (X k) ≤ m) →
      ∑ k, ⨆ (x : α) (_ : P k x), a k x ≤ m := by
    intro α N P a m hne h
    choose X₀ hX₀ using hne
    have heq : ∀ k, (⨆ (x : α) (_ : P k x), a k x) =
        ⨆ X : {X : Fin N → α // ∀ k, P k (X k)}, a k (X.1 k) := by
      intro k
      apply le_antisymm
      · refine iSup₂_le fun x hx => ?_
        refine le_iSup_of_le ⟨Function.update X₀ k x, fun j => ?_⟩ ?_
        · by_cases hj : j = k
          · subst hj; simp [hx]
          · simp [Function.update_of_ne hj, hX₀ j]
        · simp
      · exact iSup_le fun X => le_iSup₂_of_le (X.1 k) (X.2 k) le_rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => heq k)]
    rw [ENNReal.finsetSum_iSup]
    · exact iSup_le fun X => h X.1 X.2
    · intro X Y
      refine ⟨⟨fun k => if a k (X.1 k) ≤ a k (Y.1 k) then Y.1 k else X.1 k,
        fun k => by dsimp only; split_ifs; exacts [Y.2 k, X.2 k]⟩, fun k => ?_⟩
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with hk
      · exact ⟨hk, le_rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨le_rfl, (not_le.1 hk).le⟩
  
  have hlsc : ∀ (F : Set M) (Gs : ℕ → Set M) (m' : ENNReal), sepChartMeas F →
      (∀ n, sepChartMeas (Gs n)) →
      (∀ (p : M) (C : Set E3), IsCompact C → C ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target →
        Tendsto (fun n => volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Gs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ C))
          atTop (𝓝 0)) →
      Tendsto (fun n => hullRiemPer g (Gs n) Ω Kc) atTop (𝓝 m') →
      hullRiemPer g F Ω Kc ≤ m' := by
    intro F Gs m' hF hGs hconv hlim'
    unfold hullRiemPer
    refine iSup_le fun N => iSup_le fun p => iSup_le fun W => iSup_le fun hW => ?_
    have hVt : ∀ k, chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := by
      intro k
      rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact (chartAt E3 (p k)).map_source ((hW.1 k).2 hw).2
    unfold hullPerG
    refine hsups (E3 → E3) N (fun k X =>
        (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧
        HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ∧
        (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y| ≤ C)
      (fun k X => ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in chartAt E3 (p k) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y)) m' ?_ ?_
    · intro k
      refine ⟨0, fun y _ => contDiffAt_const, HasCompactSupport.zero, ?_, fun y => by simp,
        0, fun y => by simp [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]⟩
      rw [tsupport_zero]
      exact Set.empty_subset _
    intro Xs hXs
    have hterm : ∀ k, Tendsto (fun n => ENNReal.ofReal
        (∫ y in chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Gs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (Xs k) y)) atTop
        (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in chartAt E3 (p k) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (Xs k) y))) := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨-, hXc, hXV, -, B, hB⟩ := hXs k
      have hCt : tsupport (Xs k) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := hXV.trans (hVt k)
      refine ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal (hint _ (tsupport (Xs k)) _ _ B hXc (hmeas (p k) (Xs k))
        (hzero (p k) (Xs k)) hB (hF (p k)) (fun n => hGs n (p k)) ?_)
      have hsub : ∀ n, symmDiff (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Gs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source))
          (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)) ∩ tsupport (Xs k) ⊆
          chartAt E3 (p k) '' (symmDiff (Gs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) ∩
            tsupport (Xs k) := by
        intro n
        refine Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ ?_
        exact Set.subset_image_symmDiff.trans
          (Set.image_mono (Set.inter_symmDiff_distrib_right _ _ _).symm.subset)
      exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds
        (hconv (p k) _ hXc hCt) (fun n => zero_le _) (fun n => measure_mono (hsub n))
    have hsum := tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun k _ => hterm k)
    refine le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' hsum hlim' (fun n => ?_)
    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_)
      (?_ : ∑ k, hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm)
        (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Gs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)) (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k)
        (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)) ≤ hullRiemPer g (Gs n) Ω Kc)
    · unfold hullPerG
      exact le_iSup₂_of_le (Xs k) (hXs k) le_rfl
    · unfold hullRiemPer
      exact le_iSup_of_le N (le_iSup_of_le p (le_iSup_of_le W (le_iSup_of_le hW le_rfl)))
  
  set m : ENNReal := ⨅ (F' : Set M) (_ : sepChartMeas F' ∧ symmDiff F' A₀ ⊆ Kv),
    hullRiemPer g F' Ω Kc with hm_def
  have hA₀C : sepChartMeas A₀ ∧ symmDiff A₀ A₀ ⊆ Kv :=
    ⟨hA₀, by rw [symmDiff_self]; exact Set.empty_subset _⟩
  have hmA : m ≤ hullRiemPer g A₀ Ω Kc := iInf₂_le A₀ hA₀C
  have hmtop : m ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top hfin.ne hmA
  have hseq : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ F : Set M, (sepChartMeas F ∧ symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ Kv) ∧
      hullRiemPer g F Ω Kc < m + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ENNReal)⁻¹ := by
    intro n
    have hpos : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ENNReal)⁻¹ ≠ 0 :=
      ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.2 (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)
    have hlt : m < m + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ENNReal)⁻¹ := ENNReal.lt_add_right hmtop hpos
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := iInf_lt_iff.1 hlt
    obtain ⟨hFC, hFlt⟩ := iInf_lt_iff.1 hF
    exact ⟨F, hFC, hFlt⟩
  choose Fs hFsC hFslt using hseq
  have hFsm : ∀ n, sepChartMeas (Fs n) := fun n => (hFsC n).1
  have hFsK : ∀ n, symmDiff (Fs n) A₀ ⊆ Kv := fun n => (hFsC n).2
  have hmle : ∀ n, m ≤ hullRiemPer g (Fs n) Ω Kc := fun n => iInf₂_le (Fs n) (hFsC n)
  have hinv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ENNReal)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    ENNReal.tendsto_inv_nat_nhds_zero.comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => hullRiemPer g (Fs n) Ω Kc) atTop (𝓝 m) := by
    have hup : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => m + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ENNReal)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 (m + 0)) :=
      tendsto_const_nhds.add hinv
    rw [add_zero] at hup
    exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hup hmle
      (fun n => (hFslt n).le)
  obtain ⟨Lr, hLr0, hFsΛ⟩ : ∃ Lr : ℝ, 0 ≤ Lr ∧
      ∀ n, hullRiemPer g (Fs n) Ω Kc ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Lr := by
    refine ⟨(m + 1).toReal, ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, fun n => ?_⟩
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (ENNReal.add_ne_top.2 ⟨hmtop, ENNReal.one_ne_top⟩)]
    refine (hFslt n).le.trans (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
    rw [ENNReal.inv_le_one]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_left 1 n
  
  have hballex : ∀ x ∈ Kv, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ball (chartAt E3 x x) ε ⊆ chartAt E3 x '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) := by
    intro x hx
    have hO : IsOpen (chartAt E3 x '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source)) :=
      (chartAt E3 x).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hΩ.inter (chartAt E3 x).open_source)
        Set.inter_subset_right
    have hmem : chartAt E3 x x ∈ chartAt E3 x '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) :=
      ⟨x, ⟨hKvΩ hx, mem_chart_source E3 x⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hO _ hmem
  choose! ε hεpos hεsub using hballex
  have hcb : ∀ x ∈ Kv, closedBall (chartAt E3 x x) (3 * (ε x / 4)) ⊆
      chartAt E3 x '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) := fun x hx =>
    (closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith [hεpos x hx])).trans (hεsub x hx)
  have himt : ∀ x : M, chartAt E3 x '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) ⊆ (chartAt E3 x).target := by
    intro x
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 x).map_source hy.2
  have hnhds : ∀ x ∈ Kv,
      (chartAt E3 x).symm '' ball (chartAt E3 x x) (ε x / 4 / 2 / 2) ∈ 𝓝 x := by
    intro x hx
    have hpos := hεpos x hx
    have hsub : ball (chartAt E3 x x) (ε x / 4 / 2 / 2) ⊆ (chartAt E3 x).target := by
      intro z hz
      apply himt x
      apply hcb x hx
      exact (ball_subset_closedBall.trans (closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith))) hz
    have hopen : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 x).symm '' ball (chartAt E3 x x) (ε x / 4 / 2 / 2)) :=
      (chartAt E3 x).symm.isOpen_image_of_subset_source isOpen_ball
        (by rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source]; exact hsub)
    refine hopen.mem_nhds ⟨chartAt E3 x x, mem_ball_self (by linarith), ?_⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 x).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x)
  obtain ⟨t, htK, hcov⟩ := hKv.elim_nhds_subcover _ hnhds
  obtain ⟨xs, hxs_mem, hxs_surj⟩ : ∃ xs : Fin t.card → M, (∀ j, xs j ∈ t) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ t, ∃ j, xs j = x :=
    ⟨fun j => (t.equivFin.symm j : M), fun j => (t.equivFin.symm j).2,
      fun x hx => ⟨t.equivFin ⟨x, hx⟩, by simp⟩⟩
  have hxsK : ∀ j, xs j ∈ Kv := fun j => htK _ (hxs_mem j)
  obtain ⟨cs, rs, hrs, hcbs, hcovs⟩ : ∃ (cs : Fin t.card → E3) (rs : Fin t.card → ℝ),
      (∀ j, 0 < rs j) ∧
      (∀ j, closedBall (cs j) (3 * rs j) ⊆ chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source)) ∧
      Kv ⊆ ⋃ j, (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (rs j / 2 / 2) := by
    refine ⟨fun j => chartAt E3 (xs j) (xs j), fun j => ε (xs j) / 4, fun j => ?_,
      fun j => hcb _ (hxsK j), ?_⟩
    · have := hεpos _ (hxsK j)
      show 0 < ε (xs j) / 4
      linarith
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨x, hxt, hzx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcov hz)
      obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hxs_surj x hxt
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hzx⟩
  
  have hW : ∀ (j : Fin t.card) (n : ℕ), sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm)
      (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source)) (ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) ≤
        sepRiemPer g (Fs n) Ω := by
    intro j n
    have hbt : ball (cs j) (3 * rs j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).target :=
      ball_subset_closedBall.trans ((hcbs j).trans (himt _))
    have hWo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) :=
      (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm.isOpen_image_of_subset_source isOpen_ball
        (by rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.symm_source]; exact hbt)
    have hWsub : (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (3 * rs j) ⊆
        Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source := by
      rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩ := hcbs j (ball_subset_closedBall hw)
      rw [(chartAt E3 (xs j)).left_inv hx'.2]
      exact hx'
    have himg : chartAt E3 (xs j) '' ((chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) =
        ball (cs j) (3 * rs j) :=
      (chartAt E3 (xs j)).toPartialEquiv.image_symm_image_of_subset_target hbt
    have key : (∑ k : Fin 1, sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 ((fun _ : Fin 1 => xs j) k)).symm)
        (chartAt E3 ((fun _ : Fin 1 => xs j) k) '' (Fs n ∩
          (chartAt E3 ((fun _ : Fin 1 => xs j) k)).source))
        (chartAt E3 ((fun _ : Fin 1 => xs j) k) ''
          ((fun _ : Fin 1 => (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) k))) ≤
        sepRiemPer g (Fs n) Ω := by
      unfold sepRiemPer
      exact le_iSup_of_le 1 (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ : Fin 1 => xs j)
        (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ : Fin 1 => (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm '' ball (cs j) (3 * rs j))
          (le_iSup_of_le ⟨fun _ => ⟨hWo, hWsub⟩,
            fun k l hkl => (hkl (Subsingleton.elim k l)).elim⟩ le_rfl)))
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one] at key
    dsimp only at key
    rw [himg] at key
    exact key
  have hL4 : ∀ j : Fin t.card, ∃ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a ∧ ∀ S : Set E3,
      sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal a * sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm) S (ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) := by
    intro j
    have h3 : 0 < 3 * rs j := by linarith [hrs j]
    exact sepPerG_one_le_mul (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (xs j)).symm) (chartAt E3 (xs j)).target
      (cs j) (3 * rs j) (chartAt E3 (xs j)).open_target (fun i k => g.smooth (xs j) i k)
      (fun z hz => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g (xs j) z hz) h3 ((hcbs j).trans (himt _))
  choose a ha0 ha using hL4
  
  have hmod : ∀ (j : Fin t.card) (n : ℕ) (h : E3), ‖h‖ ≤ rs j →
      volume (symmDiff (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source))
        ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source))) ∩
          ball (cs j) (rs j)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * a j * Lr) * ‖h‖) := by
    intro j n h hh
    have h5 := sepPerG_one_translate_le (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source))
      (cs j) h (rs j) (hFsm n (xs j)) (hrs j) hh
    have h4 : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
        (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs n ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source)) (ball (cs j) (3 * rs j)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (a j) * ENNReal.ofReal Lr := by
      refine (ha j _).trans ?_
      gcongr
      exact (hW j n).trans ((hcmp (Fs n)).trans (hFsΛ n))
    calc _ ≤ _ := h5
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ‖h‖) * (ENNReal.ofReal (a j) * ENNReal.ofReal Lr) := by
          gcongr
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * a j * Lr) * ‖h‖) := by
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (ha0 j),
            ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * ‖h‖)]
          congr 1
          ring
  
  have hdiag : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ j : Fin t.card, j.val < k →
      ∃ L : Set E3, MeasurableSet L ∧ Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff
        (chartAt E3 (xs j) '' (Fs (φ n) ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).source)) L ∩
          ball (cs j) (rs j / 2))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact ⟨id, strictMono_id, fun j hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφL⟩ := ih
      by_cases hk : k < t.card
      · obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hcau⟩ := sepSets_cauchy_subseq (cs ⟨k, hk⟩) (rs ⟨k, hk⟩)
          (2 * a ⟨k, hk⟩ * Lr) (hrs _)
          (fun n => chartAt E3 (xs ⟨k, hk⟩) '' (Fs (φ n) ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs ⟨k, hk⟩)).source))
          (fun n => hFsm (φ n) (xs ⟨k, hk⟩)) (fun n h hh => hmod ⟨k, hk⟩ (φ n) h hh)
        obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀m, hL₀⟩ := sepSets_limit_of_cauchy (ball (cs ⟨k, hk⟩) (rs ⟨k, hk⟩ / 2))
          (fun n => chartAt E3 (xs ⟨k, hk⟩) '' (Fs (φ (ψ n)) ∩ (chartAt E3 (xs ⟨k, hk⟩)).source))
          (fun n => hFsm (φ (ψ n)) (xs ⟨k, hk⟩)) hcau
        refine ⟨φ ∘ ψ, hφ.comp hψ, fun j hj => ?_⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hj with hj' | hj'
        · obtain ⟨L, hLm, hL⟩ := hφL j hj'
          exact ⟨L, hLm, hL.comp hψ.tendsto_atTop⟩
        · have hjk : j = ⟨k, hk⟩ := Fin.ext hj'
          subst hjk
          exact ⟨L₀, hL₀m, hL₀⟩
      · refine ⟨φ, hφ, fun j hj => hφL j ?_⟩
        have := j.isLt
        omega
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hφL⟩ := hdiag t.card
  choose L hLm hL using fun j : Fin t.card => hφL j j.isLt
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFm, hFK, hconv⟩ := sepGlue_chart_limits Kv A₀ hKv hA₀ t.card xs cs
    (fun j => rs j / 2) L (fun n => Fs (φ n))
    (fun j => by show 0 < rs j / 2; linarith [hrs j])
    (fun j => by
      show closedBall (cs j) (rs j / 2) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (xs j)).target
      exact (closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith [hrs j])).trans ((hcbs j).trans (himt _)))
    hcovs hLm (fun n => hFsm (φ n)) (fun n => hFsK (φ n)) hL
  
  have hle : hullRiemPer g F Ω Kc ≤ m :=
    hlsc F (fun n => Fs (φ n)) m hFm (fun n => hFsm (φ n)) hconv (hlim.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop)
  
  exact ⟨F, hFm, hFK, fun F' hF'm hF'K => hle.trans (iInf₂_le F' ⟨hF'm, hF'K⟩)⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerG_one_le_mul
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (y : E3) (R : ℝ)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) U)
    (hpd : ∀ z ∈ U, (G z).PosDef) (hR : 0 < R) (hB : closedBall y R ⊆ U) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ S : Set E3,
      sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (ball y R) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal c * sepPerG G S (ball y R)

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerG_one_translate_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : Set E3) (y h : E3) (r : ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hh : ‖h‖ ≤ r) :
    volume (symmDiff S ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S) ∩ ball y r) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ‖h‖) *
        sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (ball y (3 * r))

subgoal_signatures.name: sepSets_cauchy_subseq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(y : E3) (r C : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (S : ℕ → Set E3)
    (hS : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (S n))
    (hmod : ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : E3), ‖h‖ ≤ r →
      volume (symmDiff (S n) ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S n) ∩ ball y r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ‖h‖)) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      volume (symmDiff (S (φ n)) (S (φ m)) ∩ ball y (r / 2)) < ENNReal.ofReal ε

subgoal_signatures.name: sepSets_limit_of_cauchy
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(B : Set E3) (T : ℕ → Set E3) (hT : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (T n))
    (hcau : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      volume (symmDiff (T n) (T m) ∩ B) < ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
    ∃ L : Set E3, MeasurableSet L ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (T n) L ∩ B)) atTop (𝓝 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: sepGlue_chart_limits
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (K A₀ : Set M)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hA₀ : sepChartMeas A₀) (N : ℕ) (x : Fin N → M) (c : Fin N → E3)
    (r : Fin N → ℝ) (L : Fin N → Set E3) (Fs : ℕ → Set M) (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j)
    (hball : ∀ j, closedBall (c j) (r j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (x j)).target)
    (hcover : K ⊆ ⋃ j, (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm '' ball (c j) (r j / 2))
    (hL : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (L j)) (hFs : ∀ n, sepChartMeas (Fs n))
    (hFsK : ∀ n, symmDiff (Fs n) A₀ ⊆ K)
    (hconv : ∀ j, Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (chartAt E3 (x j) '' (Fs n ∩
      (chartAt E3 (x j)).source)) (L j) ∩ ball (c j) (r j))) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∃ F : Set M, sepChartMeas F ∧ symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ K ∧
      ∀ (p : M) (C : Set E3), IsCompact C → C ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target →
        Tendsto (fun n => volume (chartAt E3 p '' (symmDiff (Fs n) F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ C))
          atTop (𝓝 0)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (r₁ r₂ s : ℝ) (A F Kc : Set M)
    (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (hcpt : ∀ t : ℝ, IsCompact {p : M | ρ p ≤ t})
    (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p)
    (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A)
    (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) (hKc : IsClosed Kc)
    (hKcρ : ∀ p ∈ Kc, ρ p < r₁) (hr₁₂ : r₁ < r₂) (hr₂s : r₂ < s) (hF : sepChartMeas F)
    (hFA : symmDiff F A ⊆ {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₂})
    (hfin : hullRiemPer g F {p : M | ρ p < s} Kc < ⊤)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : Set M, sepChartMeas F' → symmDiff F' A ⊆ {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₂} →
      hullRiemPer g F {p : M | ρ p < s} Kc ≤ hullRiemPer g F' {p : M | ρ p < s} Kc) :
    sepChartNull (symmDiff F A ∩ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p})

signature.name: hullMinimizer_eq_far_ae
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (r₁ r₂ s : ℝ) (A F Kc : Set M)
    (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (hcpt : ∀ t : ℝ, IsCompact {p : M | ρ p ≤ t})
    (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p)
    (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A)
    (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) (hKc : IsClosed Kc)
    (hKcρ : ∀ p ∈ Kc, ρ p < r₁) (hr₁₂ : r₁ < r₂) (hr₂s : r₂ < s) (hF : sepChartMeas F)
    (hFA : symmDiff F A ⊆ {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₂})
    (hfin : hullRiemPer g F {p : M | ρ p < s} Kc < ⊤)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : Set M, sepChartMeas F' → symmDiff F' A ⊆ {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₂} →
      hullRiemPer g F {p : M | ρ p < s} Kc ≤ hullRiemPer g F' {p : M | ρ p < s} Kc) :
    sepChartNull (symmDiff F A ∩ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p})

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρ.continuous
  
  have himg : ∀ (x : M) (S : Set M), chartAt E3 x '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) =
      (chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' S := by
    intro x S
    rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact (chartAt E3 x).image_source_inter_eq' S
  have hopenimg : ∀ (x : M) (S : Set M), IsOpen S →
      MeasurableSet ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' S) := by
    intro x S hS
    exact ((chartAt E3 x).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hS).measurableSet
  have hUo : IsOpen {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hρc
  have hΩo : IsOpen {p : M | ρ p < s} := isOpen_lt hρc continuous_const
  have hTFm : sepChartMeas ((F \ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) ∪ A) := by
    intro x
    have hFp := hF x
    rw [himg] at hFp ⊢
    have e : (chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' ((F \ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) ∪ A) =
        (((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' F) \
          ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' {p : M | r₁ < ρ p})) ∪
        ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' A) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff]
      tauto
    rw [e]
    exact (hFp.diff (hopenimg x _ hUo)).union (hopenimg x _ hAo)
  have hTFA : symmDiff ((F \ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) ∪ A) A ⊆ {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₂} := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ | ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
    · rcases hx1 with ⟨hxF, -⟩ | hxA
      · exact hFA (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hxF, hx2⟩))
      · exact absurd hxA hx2
    · exact absurd (Or.inr hx1) hx2
  have hDm : sepChartMeas (symmDiff F A ∩ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) := by
    intro x
    have hFp := hF x
    rw [himg] at hFp ⊢
    have e : (chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' (symmDiff F A ∩ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) =
        symmDiff ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' F)
          ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' A) ∩
        ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_symmDiff]
      tauto
    rw [e]
    exact (hFp.symmDiff (hopenimg x _ hAo)).inter (hopenimg x _ hUo)
  have hDK : symmDiff F A ∩ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} ⊆ {p : M | r₁ ≤ ρ p ∧ ρ p ≤ r₂} :=
    fun x hx => ⟨le_of_lt hx.2, hFA hx.1⟩
  have hK0c : IsCompact {p : M | r₁ ≤ ρ p ∧ ρ p ≤ r₂} := by
    refine (hcpt r₂).of_isClosed_subset ?_ (fun x hx => hx.2)
    exact (isClosed_le continuous_const hρc).inter (isClosed_le hρc continuous_const)
  
  obtain ⟨rK, hrK1, hrKc⟩ : ∃ rK : ℝ, rK < r₁ ∧ ∀ p ∈ Kc, ρ p < rK := by
    by_cases hKe : Kc.Nonempty
    · have hKcc : IsCompact Kc :=
        (hcpt r₁).of_isClosed_subset hKc (fun p hp => (hKcρ p hp).le)
      obtain ⟨x0, hx0, hmax⟩ := hKcc.exists_isMaxOn hKe hρc.continuousOn
      have h0 := hKcρ x0 hx0
      refine ⟨(ρ x0 + r₁) / 2, by linarith, fun p hp => ?_⟩
      have h1 : ρ p ≤ ρ x0 := isMaxOn_iff.1 hmax p hp
      linarith
    · exact ⟨r₁ - 1, by linarith, fun p hp => absurd ⟨p, hp⟩ hKe⟩
  obtain ⟨rs, hrs⟩ : ∃ rs : ℝ, rs = (rK + r₁) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hrKs : rK < rs := by rw [hrs]; linarith
  have hrs1 : rs < r₁ := by rw [hrs]; linarith
  have hΩso : IsOpen {p : M | rs < ρ p ∧ ρ p < s} :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const hρc).inter (isOpen_lt hρc continuous_const)
  have hK0Ωs : {p : M | r₁ ≤ ρ p ∧ ρ p ≤ r₂} ⊆ {p : M | rs < ρ p ∧ ρ p < s} :=
    fun x hx => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hrs1 hx.1, lt_of_le_of_lt hx.2 hr₂s⟩
  
  have hagree : ∀ (z : M) (f : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ y, f y ≠ 0 → ∃ x, x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source ∧ ρ x < r₁ ∧ chartAt E3 z x = y) →
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 z '' (((F \ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) ∪ A) ∩ (chartAt E3 z).source), f y =
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 z '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 z).source), f y := by
    intro z f hf
    rw [← integral_indicator (hTFm z), ← integral_indicator (hF z)]
    congr 1
    funext y
    by_cases hy : f y = 0
    · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy]
    · obtain ⟨x, hxs, hρx, rfl⟩ := hf y hy
      have hiff : x ∈ (F \ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) ∪ A ↔ x ∈ F := by
        constructor
        · rintro (⟨hxF, -⟩ | hxA)
          · exact hxF
          · exact absurd (show r₁ < ρ x from hAsub hxA) (not_lt.2 hρx.le)
        · intro hxF

      ContDiff ℝ ∞ u ∧ u (sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)) = chartAt E3 p p a ∧
      sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
      (∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ,
        ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ frontier E ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z))) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ, z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z) →
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
          (fun w => w a - u (sepPlaneProj a w)) z = 0)

signature.name: hull_free_regular
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (K Ω Kv Kin A₀ F E : Set M) (hK : IsClosed K) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hKv : IsCompact Kv)
    (hKvΩ : Kv ⊆ Ω) (hKin : IsClosed Kin) (hKinKv : Kin ⊆ interior Kv) (hKKin : K ⊆ Kin)
    (hA₀ : IsOpen A₀) (hA₀fr : frontier A₀ ⊆ Kin) (hF : sepChartMeas F)
    (hFA : symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ Kv) (hfin : hullRiemPer g F Ω K < ⊤)
    (hmin : ∀ F' : Set M, sepChartMeas F' → symmDiff F' A₀ ⊆ Kv →
      hullRiemPer g F Ω K ≤ hullRiemPer g F' Ω K)
    (hcoll : sepChartNull (symmDiff F A₀ \ Kin))
    (hE : E = {x | x ∉ K ∧ ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, sepChartNull (N \ F)}) :
    (∀ p : M, p ∉ K → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 p, ¬ sepChartNull (N \ F)) →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 p, ¬ sepChartNull (N ∩ F)) → p ∈ frontier E) ∧
    ∀ p ∈ frontier E, p ∉ K → ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ u ∧ u (sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)) = chartAt E3 p p a ∧
      sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
      (∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ,
        ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ frontier E ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z))) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ, z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z) →
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
          (fun w => w a - u (sepPlaneProj a w)) z = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hEo, -, -, -, hfrKin⟩ :=
    hull_normalization K Kin A₀ F E hK hKin hKKin hA₀ hA₀fr hcoll hE
  
  have N1 : ∀ S S' : Set M, S ⊆ S' → sepChartNull S' → sepChartNull S := by
    intro S S' h h' q
    exact measure_mono_null (Set.image_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ h)) (h' q)
  have N2 : ∀ S S' : Set M, sepChartNull S → sepChartNull S' → sepChartNull (S ∪ S') := by
    intro S S' h h' q
    rw [Set.union_inter_distrib_right, Set.image_union]
    exact measure_union_null (h q) (h' q)
  have N0 : ∀ (x : M) (N : Set M), N ∈ 𝓝 x → ¬ sepChartNull N := by
    intro x N hN h
    have h1 : N ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source ∈ 𝓝 x :=
      Filter.inter_mem hN ((chartAt E3 x).open_source.mem_nhds (mem_chart_source E3 x))
    have h2 : chartAt E3 x '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 x x) :=
      (chartAt E3 x).image_mem_nhds (mem_chart_source E3 x) h1
    have h3 := MeasureTheory.Measure.measure_pos_of_mem_nhds (μ := (volume : Measure E3)) h2
    rw [h x] at h3
    exact lt_irrefl _ h3
  have N3 : ∀ (y : M) (N : Set M), N ∈ 𝓝 y → sepChartNull (N \ F) → sepChartNull (N ∩ F) →
      False := by
    intro y N hN h1 h2
    apply N0 y N hN
    rw [← Set.diff_union_inter N F]
    exact N2 _ _ h1 h2
  
  have key : ∀ p : M, p ∈ interior Kv → p ∉ K → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 p, ¬ sepChartNull (N \ F)) →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 p, ¬ sepChartNull (N ∩ F)) →
      ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ u ∧ u (sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)) = chartAt E3 p p a ∧
        sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
        (∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ,
          ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ frontier E ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z))) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ, z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z) →
          levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
            (fun w => w a - u (sepPlaneProj a w)) z = 0) := by
    intro p hpKv hpK hN1 hN0
    have hO : IsOpen (interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ) := isOpen_interior.inter hK.isOpen_compl
    have hOKv : interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ ⊆ Kv := fun x hx => interior_subset hx.1
    have hOK : Disjoint (interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ) K :=
      Set.disjoint_left.2 (fun x hx hxK => hx.2 hxK)
    have hpsrc : p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := mem_chart_source E3 p
    have hUo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p '' ((interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hO.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source)
        Set.inter_subset_right
    have hy₀ : chartAt E3 p p ∈ chartAt E3 p '' ((interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
      ⟨p, ⟨⟨hpKv, hpK⟩, hpsrc⟩, rfl⟩
    have hUt : chartAt E3 p '' ((interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ⊆
        (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source hx.2
    have hUK : chartAt E3 p '' ((interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ⊆
        chartAt E3 p '' (Kᶜ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
      Set.image_mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1.2, hx.2⟩)
    have hloc := hullMinimizer_chart_local g K Ω Kv (interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ) A₀ F hK hΩ hKvΩ hO hOKv
      hOK hF hFA hfin hmin p
    have hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j)
        (chartAt E3 p '' ((interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :=
      fun i j => (g.smooth p i j).mono hUt
    have hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y j i :=
      fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
    have hpd : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' ((interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef :=
      fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y (hUt hy)
    have hNp : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p),
        (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' interior N ∈ 𝓝 p := by
      intro N hN
      exact ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage isOpen_interior).mem_nhds
        ⟨hpsrc, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hN⟩
    have h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p),
        volume (N \ chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro N hN hzero
      apply hN1 _ (hNp N hN)
      apply sepChartNull_of_image_null p
      · intro x hx
        exact hx.1.1
      · refine measure_mono_null ?_ hzero
        rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨⟨hxs, hxN⟩, hxF⟩, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨interior_subset hxN, ?_⟩
        rintro ⟨w, ⟨hwF, hws⟩, hwx⟩
        have hwx' : w = x := (chartAt E3 p).injOn hws hxs hwx
        rw [hwx'] at hwF
        exact hxF hwF
    have h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p),
        volume (N ∩ chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro N hN hzero
      apply hN0 _ (hNp N hN)
      apply sepChartNull_of_image_null p
      · intro x hx
        exact hx.1.1
      · refine measure_mono_null ?_ hzero
        rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨⟨hxs, hxN⟩, hxF⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨interior_subset hxN, x, ⟨hxF, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, u, r, δ, hr, hδ, hu1, hu0, hcyl, hside⟩ :=
      sepPerMin_C1_graph (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (chartAt E3 p '' ((interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) hUo hG hsymm hpd hloc
        (chartAt E3 p p) hy₀ h1 h0
    obtain ⟨u', r', hr', hr'r, hu', hagree, hMSE⟩ :=
      sepPerMin_C1_graph_smooth (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (chartAt E3 p '' ((interior Kv ∩ Kᶜ) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) hUo hG hsymm hpd hloc a
        (chartAt E3 p p) u r δ hr hδ hu1 hu0 hcyl hside
    have hC' : sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r' δ ⊆ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ :=
      fun z hz => ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hz.1 hr'r, hz.2⟩
    have hagree' : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r' δ,
        u' (sepPlaneProj a z) = u (sepPlaneProj a z) :=
      fun z hz => hagree z hz.1
    have sub1 : sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r' δ ∩ {z | z a < u' (sepPlaneProj a z)} ⊆
        sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} := by
      rintro z ⟨hz, hz'⟩
      refine ⟨hC' hz, ?_⟩
      show z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)
      rw [← hagree' z hz]
      exact hz'
    have sub2 : sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r' δ ∩ {z | u' (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ⊆
        sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} := by
      rintro z ⟨hz, hz'⟩
      refine ⟨hC' hz, ?_⟩
      show u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a
      rw [← hagree' z hz]
      exact hz'
    have hside' :
        (volume ((sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r' δ ∩ {z | z a < u' (sepPlaneProj a z)}) \
            chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) = 0 ∧
          volume (sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r' δ ∩ {z | u' (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ∩
            chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) = 0) ∨
        (volume ((sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r' δ ∩ {z | u' (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a}) \
            chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) = 0 ∧
          volume (sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r' δ ∩ {z | z a < u' (sepPlaneProj a z)} ∩
            chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) = 0) := by
      rcases hside with ⟨hA, hB⟩ | ⟨hA, hB⟩
      · left
        exact ⟨measure_mono_null (Set.diff_subset_diff_left sub1) hA,
          measure_mono_null (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ sub2) hB⟩
      · right
        exact ⟨measure_mono_null (Set.diff_subset_diff_left sub2) hA,
          measure_mono_null (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ sub1) hB⟩
    have hcylK : sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r' δ ⊆ chartAt E3 p '' (Kᶜ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
      (hC'.trans hcyl).trans hUK
    have hiff := hull_chart_side_transfer K F E p hE hEo a (chartAt E3 p p) u' r' δ
      hu'.continuous hcylK hside'
    have hbase : u' (sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)) = chartAt E3 p p a := by
      rw [hagree (chartAt E3 p p) (by simp [sepPlaneProj, hr'])]
      exact hu0
    exact ⟨a, u', r', δ, hr', hδ, hu', hbase, (hC'.trans hcyl).trans hUt, hiff, hMSE⟩
  
  have conj2 : ∀ p ∈ frontier E, p ∉ K → ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ u ∧ u (sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)) = chartAt E3 p p a ∧
      sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
      (∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ,
        ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ frontier E ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z))) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ, z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z) →
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
          (fun w => w a - u (sepPlaneProj a w)) z = 0) := by
    intro p hp hpK
    have hpKin : p ∈ Kin := hfrKin hp
    have hpcl : p ∈ closure E := frontier_subset_closure hp
    have hfr := hp
    rw [hEo.frontier_eq] at hfr
    have hpE : p ∉ E := hfr.2
    refine key p (hKinKv hpKin) hpK ?_ ?_
    · intro N hN hnull
      apply hpE
      rw [hE]
      exact ⟨hpK, N, hN, hnull⟩
    · intro N hN hnull
      obtain ⟨y, hyN, hyE⟩ :=
        mem_closure_iff.1 hpcl (interior N) isOpen_interior (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hN)
      rw [hE] at hyE
      obtain ⟨-, Ny, hNy, hNynull⟩ := hyE
      apply N3 y (N ∩ Ny) (Filter.inter_mem (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.1 hyN) hNy)
      · exact N1 ((N ∩ Ny) \ F) (Ny \ F) (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1.2, hx.2⟩) hNynull
      · exact N1 ((N ∩ Ny) ∩ F) (N ∩ F) (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2⟩) hnull
  
  refine ⟨?_, conj2⟩
  intro p hpK hN1 hN0
  have hpKin : p ∈ Kin := by
    by_contra hpKin
    by_cases hpA : p ∈ A₀
    · apply hN1 (A₀ ∩ Kinᶜ) ((hA₀.inter hKin.isOpen_compl).mem_nhds ⟨hpA, hpKin⟩)
      refine N1 _ _ ?_ hcoll
      rintro x ⟨⟨hxA, hxKin⟩, hxF⟩
      exact ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hxA, hxF⟩), hxKin⟩
    · have hpcl : p ∉ closure A₀ := by
        rw [closure_eq_self_union_frontier]
        rintro (h | h)
        · exact hpA h
        · exact hpKin (hA₀fr h)
      apply hN0 ((closure A₀)ᶜ ∩ Kinᶜ)
        ((isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl.inter hKin.isOpen_compl).mem_nhds ⟨hpcl, hpKin⟩)
      refine N1 _ _ ?_ hcoll
      rintro x ⟨⟨hxA, hxKin⟩, hxF⟩
      exact ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hxF, fun h => hxA (subset_closure h)⟩), hxKin⟩
  obtain ⟨a, u, r, δ, hr, hδ, -, hu0, -, hiff, -⟩ := key p (hKinKv hpKin) hpK hN1 hN0
  have hz : chartAt E3 p p ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ := by
    simp [sepCyl, sepPlaneProj, hr, hδ]
  have hfin' := (hiff _ hz).2 hu0.symm
  rwa [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)] at hfin'

subgoal_signatures.name: hull_normalization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (K Kin A₀ F E : Set M)
    (hK : IsClosed K) (hKin : IsClosed Kin) (hKKin : K ⊆ Kin) (hA₀ : IsOpen A₀)
    (hA₀fr : frontier A₀ ⊆ Kin) (hcoll : sepChartNull (symmDiff F A₀ \ Kin))
    (hE : E = {x | x ∉ K ∧ ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, sepChartNull (N \ F)}) :
    IsOpen E ∧ Disjoint E K ∧ A₀ \ Kin ⊆ E ∧ E \ Kin ⊆ A₀ ∧ frontier E ⊆ Kin

subgoal_signatures.name: hullMinimizer_chart_local
subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (K Ω Kv O A₀ F : Set M) (hK : IsClosed K) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hKvΩ : Kv ⊆ Ω) (hO : IsOpen O) (hOKv : O ⊆ Kv) (hOK : Disjoint O K) (hF : sepChartMeas F) (hFA : symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ Kv) (hfin : hullRiemPer g F Ω K < ⊤) (hmin : ∀ F' : Set M, sepChartMeas F' → symmDiff F' A₀ ⊆ Kv → hullRiemPer g F Ω K ≤ hullRiemPer g F' Ω K) (p : M) : sepIsPerMin (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) (chartAt E3 p '' (O ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerMin_C1_graph
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U F : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U)
    (h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y₀, volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) (h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y₀, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 u ∧
      u (sepPlaneProj a y₀) = y₀ a ∧ sepCyl a y₀ r δ ⊆ U ∧
      ((volume ((sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)}) \ F) = 0 ∧
          volume (sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ∩ F) = 0) ∨
        (volume ((sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a}) \ F) = 0 ∧
          volume (sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} ∩ F) = 0))

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerMin_C1_graph_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U F : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) (a : Fin 3) (y₀ : E3)
    (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ 1 u)
    (hu0 : u (sepPlaneProj a y₀) = y₀ a) (hcyl : sepCyl a y₀ r δ ⊆ U)
    (hside : (volume ((sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)}) \ F) = 0 ∧
          volume (sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ∩ F) = 0) ∨
        (volume ((sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a}) \ F) = 0 ∧
          volume (sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} ∩ F) = 0)) :
    ∃ (u' : E3 → ℝ) (r' : ℝ), 0 < r' ∧ r' ≤ r ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ u' ∧
      (∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - y₀)‖ < r' →
        u' (sepPlaneProj a z) = u (sepPlaneProj a z)) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r' δ, z a = u' (sepPlaneProj a z) →

      refine sheet_coincides_of_side g p a u' r' δ hr' hδ hu' hbase hcylT hMSE ε (f i) hε hballT
        (hfs i) (hf0 i) (hdf i) (hfM i) σ _ hσ (hτ (s i)) ?_
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ hfull
      rintro z ⟨⟨⟨hzC, -⟩, hzs⟩, hzneg⟩
      refine ⟨⟨hzC, hzs⟩, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨-, hzB, hzD⟩
      have := ((hφ i (s i)).2.2.1 z (hρi i hzB)).1.1 (hzD i)
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hzneg
      linarith
    choose r₁ δ₁ hr₁ hr₁r hδ₁ hδ₁δ hcyl₁ hiff₁ using hs8
    obtain ⟨j₁, -, hj₁⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ r₁ Finset.univ_nonempty
    obtain ⟨j₂, -, hj₂⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image Finset.univ δ₁ Finset.univ_nonempty
    have hsubcyl : ∀ i, sepCyl a y₀ (r₁ j₁) (δ₁ j₂) ⊆ sepCyl a y₀ (r₁ i) (δ₁ i) :=
      fun i => hcylmono a _ _ _ _ (hj₁ i (Finset.mem_univ _)) (hj₂ i (Finset.mem_univ _))
    have hsub' : sepCyl a y₀ (r₁ j₁) (δ₁ j₂) ⊆ sepCyl a y₀ r' δ :=
      hcylmono a _ _ _ _ (hr₁r j₁) (hδ₁δ j₂)
    refine ⟨a, u', r₁ j₁, δ₁ j₂, σ, hr₁ j₁, hδ₁ j₂, hu', hbase, (hsub'.trans hC').trans hcyl,
      fun z hz h => hMSE z (hsub' hz) h, hσ, fun i z hz => hiff₁ i z (hsubcyl i hz), ?_⟩
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ hfull
    rintro z ⟨⟨hz, hzs⟩, hzF⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hsub' hz, hzs⟩, fun h => hzF h.1⟩
  
  have hsec : ∃ s : Fin k → Bool, ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y₀,
      volume (N ∩ (Fκ ∩ {z | z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (εs i₀) ∧ ∀ i, 0 < φ i (s i) z})) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    choose Ns hNs hNs0 using hcon
    have hN : (⋂ s, Ns s) ∈ 𝓝 y₀ := Filter.iInter_mem.2 hNs
    have hpcl : p ∈ closure E := frontier_subset_closure hpE
    have hQ : (chartAt E3 p).source ∩
        chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' (interior (⋂ s, Ns s) ∩ Metric.ball y₀ (εs i₀)) ∈ 𝓝 p :=
      ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage (isOpen_interior.inter Metric.isOpen_ball)).mem_nhds

    obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxsrc, hxN, hxB⟩, hxE⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 hpcl _ hQ

    obtain ⟨hxK, Nx, hNx, hNxnull⟩ := hxE'
    have hz₀K : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) = x := (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxsrc
    have hfne : ∀ i, f i (chartAt E3 p x) ≠ 0 := by
      intro i h0
      apply hxK
      have := (hfK (chartAt E3 p x) (hball'ε hxB)).2 ⟨i, h0⟩
      rwa [hz₀K] at this
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : Fin k → Bool, ∀ i, (s i = true ↔ 0 < f i (chartAt E3 p x)) :=
      ⟨fun i => decide (0 < f i (chartAt E3 p x)), fun i => by simp⟩
    have hz₀D : ∀ i, 0 < φ i (s i) (chartAt E3 p x) := by
      intro i
      rw [((hφ i (s i)).2.2.1 (chartAt E3 p x) (hball' i hxB)).1]
      cases hsi : s i
      · have h1 : ¬ 0 < f i (chartAt E3 p x) := by
          intro h; have := (hs i).2 h; rw [hsi] at this; exact Bool.false_ne_true this
        have h2 : f i (chartAt E3 p x) < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.1 h1) (hfne i)
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        linarith
      · have h1 : 0 < f i (chartAt E3 p x) := (hs i).1 hsi
        simp only [if_true]
        linarith
    have hOo : IsOpen (interior (⋂ s, Ns s) ∩
        {z | z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (εs i₀) ∧ ∀ i, 0 < φ i (s i) z} ∩
        chartAt E3 p '' (interior Nx ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :=
      (isOpen_interior.inter (hDopen s _ le_rfl)).inter
        ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source
          (isOpen_interior.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source) Set.inter_subset_right)
    have hpos := hOo.measure_pos volume
      ⟨chartAt E3 p x, ⟨hxN, hxB, hz₀D⟩, x, ⟨mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hNx, hxsrc⟩, rfl⟩
    apply hpos.ne'
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null (hNs0 s) (hNxnull p))
    rintro w ⟨⟨hwN, hwD⟩, y, ⟨hyN, hysrc⟩, rfl⟩
    by_cases hyF : y ∈ F
    · left
      exact ⟨Set.mem_iInter.1 (interior_subset hwN) s, ⟨y, ⟨hyF, hysrc⟩, rfl⟩, hwD⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨y, ⟨⟨interior_subset hyN, hyF⟩, hysrc⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ := hsec
  obtain ⟨a, u, r, δ, σ, hr, hδ, hu, hu0, hcylB, hMSE, hσ, hiff, hfullσ⟩ :=
    R s₀ (εs i₀) (hεs i₀) le_rfl hs₀
  have hCB : sepCyl a y₀ r δ ⊆ Metric.ball y₀ ε := hcylB.trans hball'ε
  have hCK : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r δ,
      ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ K ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z)) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hfK z (hCB hz)]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩; exact ((hiff i z hz).1).1 hi
    · intro h; exact ⟨⟨0, hk⟩, ((hiff ⟨0, hk⟩ z hz).1).2 h⟩
  
  have hside2 : ∃ r₂ δ₂ : ℝ, 0 < r₂ ∧ r₂ ≤ r ∧ 0 < δ₂ ∧ δ₂ ≤ δ ∧
      (volume (sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < -σ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))} ∩ Fκ) = 0 ∨
       volume ((sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < -σ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))}) \ Fκ) = 0) := by
    by_cases hcase : ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 y₀,
        volume (N ∩ (sepCyl a y₀ r δ ∩ {z | 0 < -σ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))} ∩ Fκ)) = 0
    · obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := hcase
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htN⟩ := hcylnhds a N hN
      refine ⟨min r t, min δ t, lt_min hr ht, min_le_left _ _, lt_min hδ ht, min_le_left _ _,
        Or.inl ?_⟩
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ hN0
      rintro z ⟨⟨hz, hzs⟩, hzF⟩
      exact ⟨htN (hcylmono a t t _ _ (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _) hz),
        ⟨hcylmono a r δ _ _ (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _) hz, hzs⟩, hzF⟩
    · push_neg at hcase
      obtain ⟨ρ₂, hρ₂, hρ₂C⟩ :=
        Metric.mem_nhds_iff.1 ((hcylopen a r δ).mem_nhds (hcylmem a r δ hr hδ))
      have hρ₃ : 0 < min ρ₂ (εs i₀) := lt_min hρ₂ (hεs i₀)
      have hρ₃C : Metric.ball y₀ (min ρ₂ (εs i₀)) ⊆ sepCyl a y₀ r δ :=
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hρ₂C
      have hneg : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r δ, 0 < -σ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z)) →
          ∀ i, 0 < (if !s₀ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * f i z := by
        intro z hz hzs i
        have h1 := hiff i z hz
        have hne : z a ≠ u (sepPlaneProj a z) := by
          intro h; rw [h, sub_self, mul_zero] at hzs; exact lt_irrefl _ hzs
        have hf0' : f i z ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (h1.1.1 h)
        have hnp : ¬ 0 < (if s₀ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * f i z := by
          rw [h1.2]; intro h; linarith
        have h2 : (if s₀ i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * f i z ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (hτne _) hf0'
        have h3 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.1 hnp) h2
        rw [hτneg, neg_mul]
        linarith
      have hDinc : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (min ρ₂ (εs i₀)),
          0 < -σ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z)) → ∀ i, 0 < φ i (!s₀ i) z := by
        intro z hz hzs i
        have hzi : z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (εs i) :=
          hball' i (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz)
        rw [((hφ i (!s₀ i)).2.2.1 z hzi).1]
        exact hneg z (hρ₃C hz) hzs i
      have h0' : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y₀, volume (N ∩ (Fκ ∩ {z | z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (min ρ₂ (εs i₀)) ∧
          ∀ i, 0 < φ i ((fun i => !s₀ i) i) z})) ≠ 0 := by
        intro N hN hzero
        apply hcase (N ∩ Metric.ball y₀ (min ρ₂ (εs i₀)))
          (Filter.inter_mem hN (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hρ₃))
        refine measure_mono_null ?_ hzero
        rintro z ⟨⟨hzN, hzB⟩, ⟨-, hzs⟩, hzF⟩
        exact ⟨hzN, hzF, hzB, hDinc z hzB hzs⟩
      obtain ⟨a', u'', r', δ', σ', hr', hδ', -, -, -, -, -, hiff', hfull'⟩ :=
        R (fun i => !s₀ i) (min ρ₂ (εs i₀)) hρ₃ (min_le_right _ _) h0'
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htC'⟩ :=
        hcylnhds a _ ((hcylopen a' r' δ').mem_nhds (hcylmem a' r' δ' hr' hδ'))
      refine ⟨min r t, min δ t, lt_min hr ht, min_le_left _ _, lt_min hδ ht, min_le_left _ _,
        Or.inr ?_⟩
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ hfull'
      rintro z ⟨⟨hz, hzs⟩, hzF⟩
      have hzC' : z ∈ sepCyl a' y₀ r' δ' :=
        htC' (hcylmono a t t _ _ (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _) hz)
      have hzC : z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r δ := hcylmono a r δ _ _ (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _) hz
      exact ⟨⟨hzC', ((hiff' ⟨0, hk⟩ z hzC').2).1 (hneg z hzC hzs ⟨0, hk⟩)⟩, hzF⟩
  obtain ⟨r₂, δ₂, hr₂, hr₂r, hδ₂, hδ₂δ, hother⟩ := hside2
  have hC₂ : sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ⊆ sepCyl a y₀ r δ := hcylmono a r δ r₂ δ₂ hr₂r hδ₂δ
  have hfull₂ : volume ((sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < σ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))}) \ Fκ)
      = 0 :=
    measure_mono_null (Set.diff_subset_diff_left (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hC₂)) hfullσ
  
  have hT : sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := hC₂.trans (hCB.trans hballT)
  have hCK₂ : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂,
      ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ K ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z)) := fun z hz => hCK z (hC₂ hz)
  have huc : Continuous u := hu.continuous
  have hπc : Continuous fun z : E3 => sepPlaneProj a z := by
    unfold sepPlaneProj; fun_prop
  have hgc : Continuous fun z : E3 => z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z) := by fun_prop
  have hsideo : ∀ τ : ℝ,
      IsOpen (sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < τ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))}) := by
    intro τ
    exact (hcylopen a r₂ δ₂).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.mul hgc))
  have hsymmo : ∀ τ : ℝ, IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).symm ''
      (sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < τ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))})) :=
    fun τ => (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_symm_of_subset_target (hsideo τ) (fun z hz => hT hz.1)
  have hEK : ∀ x ∈ E, x ∉ K := by
    intro x hx; rw [hE] at hx; exact hx.1
  
  have hnullside : ∀ τ : ℝ,
      volume (sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < τ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))} ∩ Fκ) = 0 →
      ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < τ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))},
        (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∉ closure E := by
    intro τ hτ0 z hz hzcl
    obtain ⟨x, ⟨z', hz', rfl⟩, hxE⟩ := mem_closure_iff.1 hzcl _ (hsymmo τ) ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    have hxE' := hxE
    rw [hE] at hxE'
    obtain ⟨-, N, hN, hNnull⟩ := hxE'
    have hz'T : z' ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := hT hz'.1
    have hxsrc : (chartAt E3 p).symm z' ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source :=
      (chartAt E3 p).map_target hz'T
    have hOo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p '' (interior N ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩
        (sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < τ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))})) :=
      ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source
        (isOpen_interior.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source) Set.inter_subset_right).inter
        (hsideo τ)
    have hpos := hOo.measure_pos volume
      ⟨z', ⟨(chartAt E3 p).symm z', ⟨mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hN, hxsrc⟩,
        (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hz'T⟩, hz'⟩
    apply hpos.ne'
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null hτ0 (hNnull p))
    rintro w ⟨⟨y, ⟨hyN, hysrc⟩, rfl⟩, hwC⟩
    by_cases hyF : y ∈ F
    · left
      exact ⟨hwC, y, ⟨hyF, hysrc⟩, rfl⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨y, ⟨⟨interior_subset hyN, hyF⟩, hysrc⟩, rfl⟩
  
  have hfullside : ∀ τ : ℝ,
      volume ((sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < τ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))}) \ Fκ) = 0 →
      ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < τ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))},

    intro τ hτ0 z hz
    rw [hE]
    refine ⟨fun hK => ?_, (chartAt E3 p).symm ''
      (sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < τ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))}),
      (hsymmo τ).mem_nhds ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · have h := (hCK₂ z hz.1).1 hK
      have h2 : 0 < τ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z)) := hz.2
      rw [h, sub_self, mul_zero] at h2
      exact lt_irrefl _ h2
    · refine sepChartNull_of_image_null p _ ?_ ?_
      · rintro _ ⟨⟨z', hz', rfl⟩, -⟩
        exact (chartAt E3 p).map_target (hT hz'.1)
      · refine measure_mono_null ?_ hτ0
        rintro w ⟨y, ⟨⟨z', hz', rfl⟩, hyF⟩, rfl⟩
        have hz'T : z' ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := hT hz'.1
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv hz'T]
        refine ⟨hz', ?_⟩
        rintro ⟨y', ⟨hy'F, hy'src⟩, hy'eq⟩
        apply hyF

          rw [hy'eq, (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hz'T]
        rw [← (chartAt E3 p).injOn hy'src ((chartAt E3 p).map_target hz'T) hy'eq']
        exact hy'F
  
  have hea : ∀ (x : E3) (c : ℝ), (x + c • e a) a = x a + c := by
    intro x c; simp [e]
  have hπe : ∀ (x : E3) (c : ℝ), sepPlaneProj a (x + c • e a) = sepPlaneProj a x := by
    intro x c
    simp only [sepPlaneProj]
    rw [hea, add_smul]
    abel
  have hσsq : σ * σ = 1 := by rcases hσ with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have hσne : σ ≠ 0 := by rcases hσ with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  
  have hiffE : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂,
      ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ frontier E ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z)) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hEo.frontier_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hcl, hnE⟩
      by_contra hne
      have hne' : z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hne
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (mul_ne_zero hσne hne') with hlt | hgt
      · have hz' : z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ ∩ {z | 0 < -σ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))} :=
          ⟨hz, show 0 < -σ * (z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z)) by rw [neg_mul]; linarith⟩
        rcases hother with h0 | h1
        · exact hnullside (-σ) h0 z hz' hcl
        · exact hnE (hfullside (-σ) h1 z hz')
      · exact hnE (hfullside σ hfull₂ z ⟨hz, hgt⟩)
    · intro h
      refine ⟨?_, fun hE' => hEK _ hE' ((hCK₂ z hz).2 h)⟩
      have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => z + (σ * t) • e a) := by fun_prop
      have ht : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => z + (σ * t) • e a) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 z) := by
        have h0 := hc.tendsto 0
        simp only [mul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero] at h0
        exact h0.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      have hlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => (chartAt E3 p).symm (z + (σ * t) • e a)) (𝓝[>] 0)
          (𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) :=
        ((chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm (hT hz)).tendsto.comp ht
      refine mem_closure_of_tendsto hlim ?_
      have hδpos : 0 < δ₂ - |z a - y₀ a| := by have := hz.2; linarith
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hδpos)]
        with t ht0 ht1
      have ht0' : 0 < t := ht0
      have ht1' : t < δ₂ - |z a - y₀ a| := ht1
      refine hfullside σ hfull₂ _ ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · show ‖sepPlaneProj a (z + (σ * t) • e a - y₀)‖ < r₂
        rw [show z + (σ * t) • e a - y₀ = (z - y₀) + (σ * t) • e a by abel, hπe]
        exact hz.1
      · show |(z + (σ * t) • e a) a - y₀ a| < δ₂
        rw [hea]
        have h2 : |z a - y₀ a| < δ₂ - t := by linarith
        rw [abs_lt] at h2 ⊢
        rcases hσ with hs | hs <;> rw [hs] <;> constructor <;> linarith [h2.1, h2.2]
      · show 0 < σ * ((z + (σ * t) • e a) a - u (sepPlaneProj a (z + (σ * t) • e a)))
        rw [hπe, hea, ← h]
        rw [show σ * (z a + σ * t - z a) = (σ * σ) * t by ring, hσsq, one_mul]
        exact ht0'
  
  have hVo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).symm '' sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_symm_of_subset_target (hcylopen a r₂ δ₂) hT
  have hpV : p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' sepCyl a y₀ r₂ δ₂ :=
    ⟨y₀, hcylmem a r₂ δ₂ hr₂ hδ₂, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hpsrc⟩
  refine ⟨⟨_, hVo.mem_nhds hpV, ?_⟩, a, u, r₂, δ₂, hr₂, hδ₂, hu, hu0, hT, hiffE,
    fun z hz h => hMSE z (hC₂ hz) h⟩
  rintro x ⟨⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, hxK⟩
  exact (hiffE z hz).2 ((hCK₂ z hz).1 hxK)

subgoal_signatures.name: hull_normalization
subgoal_signatures.statement:
