proof.tactics:
by
  
  have nullMono : ∀ A B : Set M, A ⊆ B → sepChartNull B → sepChartNull A :=
    fun A B h hB q => measure_mono_null (Set.image_subset _ (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ h)) (hB q)
  have nullUnion : ∀ A B : Set M, sepChartNull A → sepChartNull B → sepChartNull (A ∪ B) := by
    intro A B hA hB q
    rw [Set.union_inter_distrib_right, Set.image_union]
    exact measure_union_null (hA q) (hB q)
  have himg_inter : ∀ (q : M) (A B : Set M),
      chartAt E3 q '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩ chartAt E3 q '' (B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ⊆
        chartAt E3 q '' ((A ∩ B) ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
    rintro q A B y ⟨⟨a, ⟨haA, has⟩, rfl⟩, ⟨b, ⟨hbB, hbs⟩, hab⟩⟩
    have hba : b = a := (chartAt E3 q).injOn hbs has hab
    rw [hba] at hbB
    exact ⟨a, ⟨⟨haA, hbB⟩, has⟩, rfl⟩
  
  have hloc : ∀ A : Set M, (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, sepChartNull (N ∩ A)) → sepChartNull A := by
    intro A hA q
    apply measure_null_of_locally_null
    rintro y ⟨x, ⟨hxA, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hNnull⟩ := hA x hxA
    refine ⟨chartAt E3 q '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩
      chartAt E3 q '' (interior N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply inter_mem_nhdsWithin
      apply IsOpen.mem_nhds
      · exact (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_image_of_subset_source
          (isOpen_interior.inter (chartAt E3 q).open_source) Set.inter_subset_right
      · exact ⟨x, ⟨mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hN, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    · refine measure_mono_null ?_ (hNnull q)
      refine (himg_inter q A (interior N)).trans ?_
      exact Set.image_subset _ (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _
        (fun z hz => ⟨interior_subset hz.2, hz.1⟩))
  
  have hmemK : ∀ x, x ∈ K ↔ ∃ n, ∃ (_ : n ∈ Finset.range m), x ∈ S n := by
    intro x
    rw [hKdef, Set.mem_iUnion₂]
  have hKc : IsClosed K := by
    rw [hKdef]
    exact ((Finset.range m).isCompact_biUnion (fun n _ => (hS n).1)).isClosed
  have hKnull : sepChartNull K := by
    intro q
    refine measure_mono_null ?_
      (measure_iUnion_null (fun n => minimalSurfaceSet_sepChartNull g (S n) (hS n).2 q))
    rintro y ⟨x, ⟨hxK, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨n, -, hxn⟩ := (hmemK x).1 hxK
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, x, ⟨hxn, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
  have hfrnull : sepChartNull (frontier E) := minimalSurfaceSet_sepChartNull g _ hreg
  
  obtain ⟨hEo, hEK, hA₀E, hEA₀, -⟩ :=
    hull_normalization K Kin A₀ F E hKc hKin hKKin hA₀ hA₀fr hcoll hE
  have hfrE : ∀ x, x ∈ frontier E ↔ x ∈ closure E ∧ x ∉ E := by
    intro x
    rw [hEo.frontier_eq]
    rfl
  
  have hEF : sepChartNull (E \ F) := by
    apply hloc
    intro x hx
    have hxE := hx.1
    rw [hE] at hxE
    obtain ⟨-, N, hN, hNn⟩ := hxE
    exact ⟨N, hN, nullMono (N ∩ (E \ F)) (N \ F) (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, hz.2.2⟩) hNn⟩
  have hR : sepChartNull (F \ (E ∪ K ∪ frontier E)) := by
    apply hloc
    intro x hx
    have hxK : x ∉ K := fun h => hx.2 (Or.inl (Or.inr h))
    have hxE : x ∉ E := fun h => hx.2 (Or.inl (Or.inl h))
    have hxf : x ∉ frontier E := fun h => hx.2 (Or.inr h)
    by_cases h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, ¬ sepChartNull (N \ F)
    · by_cases h2 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, ¬ sepChartNull (N ∩ F)
      · exact absurd (hbd x hxK h1 h2) hxf
      · push_neg at h2
        obtain ⟨N, hN, hNn⟩ := h2
        exact ⟨N, hN, nullMono (N ∩ (F \ (E ∪ K ∪ frontier E))) (N ∩ F)
          (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, hz.2.1⟩) hNn⟩
    · push_neg at h1
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hNn⟩ := h1
      exact absurd (by rw [hE]; exact ⟨hxK, N, hN, hNn⟩) hxE
  have hFE : sepChartNull (F \ E) := by
    refine nullMono _ _ ?_ (nullUnion _ _ (nullUnion _ _ hKnull hfrnull) hR)
    rintro x ⟨hxF, hxE⟩
    by_cases hK : x ∈ K
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hK)
    by_cases hf : x ∈ frontier E
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hf)
    refine Or.inr ⟨hxF, fun h => ?_⟩
    rcases h with (h | h) | h
    · exact hxE h
    · exact hK h
    · exact hf h
  have hnull : sepChartNull (symmDiff F E) := by
    rw [Set.symmDiff_def]
    exact nullUnion _ _ hFE hEF
  
  have hside : ∀ p ∈ frontier E \ K, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ E = V ∩ {x | 0 < f x} := by
    rintro p ⟨hp, hpK⟩
    obtain ⟨V, f, -, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hVS, -, hP, hN⟩ :=
      hreg.2 p hp Kᶜ (hKc.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hpK)
    have hfr : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ frontier E ↔ f x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      constructor
      · intro h
        have h' : x ∈ V ∩ frontier E := ⟨hx, h⟩
        rw [hVS] at h'
        exact h'.2
      · intro h
        have h' : x ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hx, h⟩
        rw [← hVS] at h'
        exact h'.2
    have hsplit : ∀ A : Set M, A ⊆ V → (∀ x ∈ A, f x ≠ 0) → IsPreconnected A →
        A ⊆ E ∨ A ⊆ (closure E)ᶜ := by
      intro A hAV hA0 hAc
      refine hAc.subset_or_subset hEo isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl ?_ ?_
      · exact Disjoint.mono_left subset_closure disjoint_compl_right
      · intro x hx
        by_cases hxE : x ∈ E
        · exact Or.inl hxE
        · right
          intro hxc
          exact hA0 x hx ((hfr x (hAV hx)).1 ((hfrE x).2 ⟨hxc, hxE⟩))
    have hpos := hsplit (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) Set.inter_subset_left
      (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx.2) hP
    have hneg := hsplit (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) Set.inter_subset_left
      (fun x hx => ne_of_lt hx.2) hN
    have hVE : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ E → f x ≠ 0 :=
      fun x hx hxE h0 => ((hfrE x).1 ((hfr x hx).2 h0)).2 hxE
    have hpcl : p ∈ closure E := frontier_subset_closure hp
    obtain ⟨x0, hx0V, hx0E⟩ : (V ∩ E).Nonempty := mem_closure_iff.1 hpcl V hVo hpV
    rcases hpos with hpos | hpos <;> rcases hneg with hneg | hneg
    · exfalso
      have hVnull : sepChartNull (V \ F) := by
        refine nullMono _ _ ?_ (nullUnion _ _ hfrnull hEF)
        rintro x ⟨hxV, hxF⟩
        by_cases h0 : f x = 0
        · exact Or.inl ((hfr x hxV).2 h0)
        · right
          refine ⟨?_, hxF⟩
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h0 with h | h
          · exact hneg ⟨hxV, h⟩
          · exact hpos ⟨hxV, h⟩
      have hpE : p ∈ E := by
        rw [hE]
        exact ⟨hpK, V, hVo.mem_nhds hpV, hVnull⟩
      exact ((hfrE p).1 hp).2 hpE
    · refine ⟨V, f, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, ?_⟩
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hxV, hxE⟩
        refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hVE x hxV hxE) with h | h
        · exact absurd (subset_closure hxE) (hneg ⟨hxV, h⟩)
        · exact h
      · rintro ⟨hxV, h⟩
        exact ⟨hxV, hpos ⟨hxV, h⟩⟩
    · refine ⟨V, fun x => -f x, hVo, hpV, hf.neg, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        rw [show (fun x => -f x) = -f from rfl, mfderiv_neg]
        exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (hdf x hx)
      · ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hxV, hxE⟩
          refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
          show 0 < -f x
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hVE x hxV hxE) with h | h
          · linarith
          · exact absurd (subset_closure hxE) (hpos ⟨hxV, h⟩)
        · rintro ⟨hxV, h⟩
          have h' : f x < 0 := by
            have : 0 < -f x := h
            linarith
          exact ⟨hxV, hneg ⟨hxV, h'⟩⟩
    · exfalso
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hVE x0 hx0V hx0E) with h | h
      · exact hneg ⟨hx0V, h⟩ (subset_closure hx0E)
      · exact hpos ⟨hx0V, h⟩ (subset_closure hx0E)
  
  have hΓcl : IsClosed (frontier E \ K) := by
    rw [← closure_subset_iff_isClosed]
    intro x hx
    have hxS : x ∈ frontier E := closure_minimal Set.diff_subset isClosed_frontier hx
    refine ⟨hxS, fun hxK => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hVK⟩ := hKloc x hxS hxK
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hxn⟩ := (hmemK x).1 hxK
    have hVS : V ∩ S n ⊆ frontier E :=
      fun z hz => hVK ⟨hz.1, (hmemK z).2 ⟨n, hn, hz.2⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨V', hV', hV'S⟩ :=
      minimalSurfaceSet_local_eq_of_subset g (S n) (frontier E) (hS n).2 hreg x hxn V hV hVS
    obtain ⟨z, hzV', hzΓ⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 hx V' hV'
    exact hzΓ.2 ((hmemK z).2 ⟨n, hn, hV'S ⟨hzV', hzΓ.1⟩⟩)
  
  have hmonoK : ∀ (D U K₁ K₂ : Set M), K₁ ⊆ K₂ →
      hullRiemPer g D U K₁ ≤ hullRiemPer g D U K₂ := by
    intro D U K₁ K₂ h
    unfold hullRiemPer
    refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun p => iSup_mono fun W => iSup_mono fun hW => ?_
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
    unfold hullPerG
    refine iSup_mono fun X => iSup_mono' fun hX => ⟨⟨fun y hy => hX.1 y (fun hy' =>
      hy (Set.image_subset _ (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ h) hy')), hX.2⟩, le_rfl⟩
  
  have hcongr : ∀ (D D' U K' : Set M), sepChartNull (symmDiff D D') →
      hullRiemPer g D U K' = hullRiemPer g D' U K' := by
    intro D D' U K' h
    have key : ∀ (q : M) (W Kc : Set E3),
        hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q '' (D ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) W Kc =
          hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
            (chartAt E3 q '' (D' ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) W Kc := by
      intro q W Kc
      have hae : chartAt E3 q '' (D ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) =ᵐ[volume]
          chartAt E3 q '' (D' ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
        rw [← measure_symmDiff_eq_zero_iff]
        refine measure_mono_null ?_ (h q)
        intro y hy
        rw [Set.mem_symmDiff] at hy
        rcases hy with ⟨⟨a, ⟨haD, has⟩, rfl⟩, hy⟩ | ⟨⟨a, ⟨haD, has⟩, rfl⟩, hy⟩
        · refine ⟨a, ⟨?_, has⟩, rfl⟩
          rw [Set.mem_symmDiff]
          exact Or.inl ⟨haD, fun h' => hy ⟨a, ⟨h', has⟩, rfl⟩⟩
        · refine ⟨a, ⟨?_, has⟩, rfl⟩
          rw [Set.mem_symmDiff]
          exact Or.inr ⟨haD, fun h' => hy ⟨a, ⟨h', has⟩, rfl⟩⟩
      unfold hullPerG
      simp_rw [setIntegral_congr_set hae]
    unfold hullRiemPer
    simp_rw [key]
  
  have hEJ : Disjoint E (frontier E ∩ K) := hEK.mono_right Set.inter_subset_right
  have hEΓ : Disjoint E (frontier E \ K) :=
    Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x hxE hx => ((hfrE x).1 hx.1).2 hxE
  have hJΓ : Disjoint (frontier E ∩ K) (frontier E \ K) :=
    Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x h1 h2 => h2.2 h1.2
  have hA1 : hullRiemPer g E Ω (frontier E) ≤ hullRiemPer g E Ω (frontier E ∩ K) := by
    have h := hullRiemPer_remove_onesided g E Ω (frontier E ∩ K) (frontier E \ K) hEo
      (isClosed_frontier.inter hKc) hΓcl hEJ hEΓ hJΓ hside
    rwa [Set.inter_union_diff] at h
  have hA2 : hullRiemPer g E Ω (frontier E ∩ K) ≤ hullRiemPer g E Ω K :=
    hmonoK E Ω _ K Set.inter_subset_right
  have hA3 : hullRiemPer g E Ω K = hullRiemPer g F Ω K := by
    refine hcongr E F Ω K ?_
    rw [symmDiff_comm]
    exact hnull
  have hA : hullRiemPer g E Ω (frontier E) ≤ hullRiemPer g F Ω K :=
    hA1.trans (hA2.trans hA3.le)
  
  refine ⟨hA, fun E' hE'm hE'E hE'Kv => ?_⟩
  have hclass : symmDiff E' A₀ ⊆ Kv := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_symmDiff] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨hxE', hxA⟩ | ⟨hxA, hxE'⟩
    · by_contra hxKv
      have hxKin : x ∉ Kin := fun h => hxKv (interior_subset (hKinKv h))
      exact hxA (hEA₀ ⟨hE'E hxE', hxKin⟩)
    · by_cases hxE : x ∈ E
      · exact hE'Kv ⟨hxE, hxE'⟩
      · by_contra hxKv
        have hxKin : x ∉ Kin := fun h => hxKv (interior_subset (hKinKv h))
        exact hxE (hA₀E ⟨hxA, hxKin⟩)
  have h1 := hmin E' hE'm hclass
  have hB0cl : IsClosed (K \ frontier E) := by
    rw [← closure_subset_iff_isClosed]
    intro x hx
    have hxK : x ∈ K := closure_minimal Set.diff_subset hKc hx
    refine ⟨hxK, fun hxS => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hVK⟩ := hKloc x hxS hxK
    obtain ⟨z, hzV, hz⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 hx V hV
    exact hz.2 (hVK ⟨hzV, hz.1⟩)
  have hBC : Disjoint (K \ frontier E) (closure E) :=
    Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x hx hxc =>
      hx.2 ((hfrE x).2 ⟨hxc, fun hxE => Set.disjoint_left.1 hEK hxE hx.1⟩)
  have h2 := hullRiemPer_cut_transfer g E' Ω (K ∩ frontier E) (K \ frontier E) (closure E)
    (frontier E) (hKc.inter isClosed_frontier) hB0cl isClosed_closure
    (Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x h1 h2 => h2.2 h1.2) hBC (hE'E.trans subset_closure)
    Set.inter_subset_right
  rw [Set.inter_union_diff] at h2
  exact hA.trans (h1.trans h2)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]

signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (K Ω Kv O A₀ F : Set M) (hK : IsClosed K) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hKvΩ : Kv ⊆ Ω) (hO : IsOpen O) (hOKv : O ⊆ Kv) (hOK : Disjoint O K) (hF : sepChartMeas F) (hFA : symmDiff F A₀ ⊆ Kv) (hfin : hullRiemPer g F Ω K < ⊤) (hmin : ∀ F' : Set M, sepChartMeas F' → symmDiff F' A₀ ⊆ Kv → hullRiemPer g F Ω K ≤ hullRiemPer g F' Ω K) (p : M) : sepIsPerMin (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) (chartAt E3 p '' (O ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set κ := chartAt E3 p with hκ
  set G := g.coeff κ.symm with hGdef
  set Φ := κ '' (F ∩ κ.source) with hΦdef
  set U := κ '' (O ∩ κ.source) with hUdef
  have hOΩ : O ⊆ Ω := hOKv.trans hKvΩ
  
  have hUt : U ⊆ κ.target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact κ.map_source hx.2
  
  have hB2 : ∀ Z : Set E3, Z ⊆ U → κ.symm '' Z ⊆ O ∩ κ.source := by
    rintro Z hZ _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hZ hz
    rw [κ.left_inv hx.2]
    exact hx
  
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) κ.target :=
    fun i j => g.smooth p i j
  have hpd : ∀ y ∈ κ.target, (G y).PosDef := fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y hy
  have hdet : ∀ y ∈ κ.target, 0 < (G y).det := fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos
  
  have hloc_le : ∀ V : Set E3, IsOpen V → V ⊆ U → sepPerG G Φ V ≤ hullRiemPer g F Ω K := by
    intro V hV hVU
    have hVt : V ⊆ κ.target := hVU.trans hUt
    have hWo : IsOpen (κ.symm '' V) := κ.isOpen_image_symm_of_subset_target hV hVt
    have hWsub : κ.symm '' V ⊆ Ω ∩ κ.source := fun x hx =>
      ⟨hOΩ (hB2 V hVU hx).1, (hB2 V hVU hx).2⟩
    have himg : κ '' (κ.symm '' V) = V := κ.toPartialEquiv.image_symm_image_of_subset_target hVt
    have hdom : sepPerG G Φ V ≤ hullPerG G Φ V (κ '' (K ∩ κ.source)) :=
      sepPerG_le_hullPerG G κ.target Φ V (κ '' (K ∩ κ.source)) κ.open_target hGs hpd hVt
    refine hdom.trans ?_
    rw [← himg]
    unfold hullRiemPer
    refine le_iSup_of_le 1 (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ => p) (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ => κ.symm '' V)
      (le_iSup_of_le ⟨fun _ => ⟨hWo, hWsub⟩, fun k l hkl => (hkl (Subsingleton.elim k l)).elim⟩
        ?_)))
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one]
  unfold sepIsPerMin
  refine ⟨hF p, fun V hV _ hVU => lt_of_le_of_lt (hloc_le V hV (subset_closure.trans hVU)) hfin,
    ?_⟩
  
  intro F' V K' hF' hV _ hVU hK'c hK'V hsd
  have hVU' : V ⊆ U := subset_closure.trans hVU
  have hVt : V ⊆ κ.target := hVU'.trans hUt
  have hK't : K' ⊆ κ.target := hK'V.trans hVt
  set L := κ.symm '' K' with hLdef
  set F'' := (F \ L) ∪ κ.symm '' (F' ∩ K') with hF''def
  have hLO : L ⊆ O := fun x hx => (hB2 K' (hK'V.trans hVU') hx).1
  
  have hP1 : symmDiff F F'' ⊆ L := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨hxF, hxF''⟩ | ⟨hxF'', hxF⟩
    · by_contra hxL
      exact hxF'' (Or.inl ⟨hxF, hxL⟩)
    · rcases hxF'' with ⟨hxF', _⟩ | ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      · exact absurd hxF' hxF
      · exact ⟨z, hz.2, rfl⟩
  
  have hP2 : symmDiff F'' A₀ ⊆ Kv := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxF : x ∈ F
    · by_cases hxF'' : x ∈ F''
      · apply hFA
        rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨_, hA⟩ | ⟨_, hn⟩
        · exact Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hxF, hA⟩)
        · exact absurd hxF'' hn
      · exact hOKv (hLO (hP1 (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hxF, hxF''⟩))))
    · by_cases hxF'' : x ∈ F''
      · exact hOKv (hLO (hP1 (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hxF'', hxF⟩))))
      · apply hFA
        rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨hA, _⟩
        · exact absurd h hxF''
        · exact Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hA, hxF⟩)
  
  have hF'sub : F' \ Φ ⊆ K' := fun z hz => hsd (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr hz))
  have hΦsub : Φ \ F' ⊆ K' := fun z hz => hsd (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl hz))
  have hP3 : κ '' (F'' ∩ κ.source) = F' := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxF'', hxs⟩, rfl⟩
      rcases hxF'' with ⟨hxF, hxL⟩ | ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      · by_contra hz
        have hK : κ x ∈ K' := hΦsub ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxF, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hz⟩
        exact hxL ⟨κ x, hK, κ.left_inv hxs⟩
      · rw [κ.right_inv (hK't hw.2)]
        exact hw.1
    · intro hz
      by_cases hzK : z ∈ K'
      · exact ⟨κ.symm z, ⟨Or.inr ⟨z, ⟨hz, hzK⟩, rfl⟩, κ.map_target (hK't hzK)⟩,
          κ.right_inv (hK't hzK)⟩
      · have hzΦ : z ∈ Φ := by
          by_contra h
          exact hzK (hF'sub ⟨hz, h⟩)
        obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxF, hxs⟩, rfl⟩ := hzΦ
        refine ⟨x, ⟨Or.inl ⟨hxF, ?_⟩, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
        rintro ⟨w, hw, hwx⟩
        apply hzK
        rw [← hwx, κ.right_inv (hK't hw)]
        exact hw
  
  have hP4 : sepChartMeas F'' := by
    intro q
    set κq := chartAt E3 q with hκq
    have hI : ∀ S : Set M, κq '' (S ∩ κq.source) = κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' S := by
      intro S
      rw [Set.inter_comm S]
      exact κq.image_source_inter_eq' S
    have hLc : IsCompact L := hK'c.image_of_continuousOn (κ.continuousOn_symm.mono hK't)
    have hIL : MeasurableSet (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' L) := by
      have ho : IsOpen (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' Lᶜ) :=
        κq.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage κq.open_target hLc.isClosed.isOpen_compl
      have heq : κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' L = κq.target \ (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' Lᶜ) := by
        ext z
        simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_compl_iff]
        tauto
      rw [heq]
      exact κq.open_target.measurableSet.diff ho.measurableSet
    have hIF : MeasurableSet (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' F) := by
      rw [← hI]
      exact hF q
    have hBt : F' ∩ K' ⊆ κ.target := fun z hz => hK't hz.2
    have hBm : MeasurableSet (F' ∩ K') := hF'.inter hK'c.isClosed.measurableSet
    have hsymmB : κ.symm '' (F' ∩ K') = κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' (F' ∩ K') :=
      κ.symm_image_eq_source_inter_preimage hBt
    have hDo : IsOpen (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) :=
      κq.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage κq.open_target κ.open_source
    have hτc : ContinuousOn (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) :=
      κ.continuousOn.comp (κq.continuousOn_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun z hz => hz.2)
    have hIB : MeasurableSet ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) ∩
        (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) ⁻¹' (F' ∩ K')) := by
      have hpw : Measurable ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source).piecewise
          (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) (fun _ => (0 : E3))) :=
        hτc.measurable_piecewise continuousOn_const hDo.measurableSet
      have heq : (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) ∩ (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) ⁻¹' (F' ∩ K') =
          (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) ∩ ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source).piecewise
            (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) (fun _ => (0 : E3))) ⁻¹' (F' ∩ K') := by
        ext z
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hzD, hzB⟩
          refine ⟨hzD, ?_⟩
          simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hzD]
          exact hzB
        · rintro ⟨hzD, hzB⟩
          refine ⟨hzD, ?_⟩
          simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hzD] at hzB
          exact hzB
      rw [heq]
      exact hDo.measurableSet.inter (hpw hBm)
    have hmain : κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' F'' =
        ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' F) \ (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' L)) ∪
          ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) ∩ (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) ⁻¹' (F' ∩ K')) := by
      rw [hF''def, hsymmB]
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff]
      tauto
    show MeasurableSet (κq '' (F'' ∩ κq.source))
    rw [hI, hmain]
    exact (hIF.diff hIL).union hIB
  
  have hP5 : hullRiemPer g F Ω K ≤ hullRiemPer g F'' Ω K := hmin F'' hP4 hP2
  have hfinV : sepPerG G Φ V < ⊤ := lt_of_le_of_lt (hloc_le V hV hVU') hfin
  have hne : hullRiemPer g F Ω K ≠ ⊤ := hfin.ne
  
  have hUΩK : U ⊆ κ '' ((Ω \ K) ∩ κ.source) :=
    Set.image_mono (fun x hx => ⟨⟨hOΩ hx.1, Set.disjoint_left.1 hOK hx.1⟩, hx.2⟩)
  
  refine sepPerG_le_of_local_compare G κ.target Φ F' V K' κ.open_target hGs hdet (hF p) hF' hV
    hVt hK'c hK'V hsd hfinV ?_
  intro V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hK'V₂ hV₂c hV₂V₁ hV₁V
  have hV₁Ω : V₁ ⊆ κ '' ((Ω \ K) ∩ κ.source) := hV₁V.trans (hVU'.trans hUΩK)
  have h3 : hullRiemPer g F'' Ω K + sepPerG G Φ V₂ ≤
      hullRiemPer g F Ω K + sepPerG G (κ '' (F'' ∩ κ.source)) V₁ + sepPerG G Φ (V₁ \ K') :=
    hullRiemPer_add_chart_le g F F'' Ω K p K' V₁ V₂ hF hP4 hK'c hV₁ hV₂ hK'V₂ hV₂c hV₂V₁ hV₁Ω
      hP1
  rw [hP3] at h3
  have h4 : hullRiemPer g F Ω K + sepPerG G Φ V₂ ≤
      hullRiemPer g F Ω K + (sepPerG G F' V₁ + sepPerG G Φ (V₁ \ K')) := by
    calc hullRiemPer g F Ω K + sepPerG G Φ V₂ ≤ hullRiemPer g F'' Ω K + sepPerG G Φ V₂ :=
          add_le_add hP5 le_rfl
      _ ≤ _ := h3
      _ = _ := add_assoc _ _ _
  exact (ENNReal.add_le_add_iff_left hne).1 h4

subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U Φ₁ Φ₂ V K' : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det) (hΦ₁ : MeasurableSet Φ₁) (hΦ₂ : MeasurableSet Φ₂) (hV : IsOpen V) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (hK' : IsCompact K') (hK'V : K' ⊆ V) (hsd : symmDiff Φ₁ Φ₂ ⊆ K') (hfin : sepPerG G Φ₁ V < ⊤) (hcmp : ∀ V₁ V₂ : Set E3, IsOpen V₁ → IsOpen V₂ → K' ⊆ V₂ → IsCompact (closure V₂) → closure V₂ ⊆ V₁ → V₁ ⊆ V → sepPerG G Φ₁ V₂ ≤ sepPerG G Φ₂ V₁ + sepPerG G Φ₁ (V₁ \ K')) : sepPerG G Φ₁ V ≤ sepPerG G Φ₂ V

subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F₁ F₂ Ω K : Set M) (p : M) (K' V₁ V₂ : Set E3) (hF₁ : sepChartMeas F₁) (hF₂ : sepChartMeas F₂) (hK' : IsCompact K') (hV₁ : IsOpen V₁) (hV₂ : IsOpen V₂) (hK'V₂ : K' ⊆ V₂) (hV₂c : IsCompact (closure V₂)) (hV₂V₁ : closure V₂ ⊆ V₁) (hV₁Ω : V₁ ⊆ chartAt E3 p '' ((Ω \ K) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) (hsd : symmDiff F₁ F₂ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' K') : hullRiemPer g F₂ Ω K + sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (F₁ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) V₂ ≤ hullRiemPer g F₁ Ω K + sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (F₂ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) V₁ + sepPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (F₁ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) (V₁ \ K')

signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (K F E : Set M) (p : M) (hE : E = {x | x ∉ K ∧ ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, sepChartNull (N \ F)}) (hEo : IsOpen E) (a : Fin 3) (c : E3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (hcyl : sepCyl a c r δ ⊆ chartAt E3 p '' (Kᶜ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) (hside : (volume ((sepCyl a c r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)}) \ chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) = 0 ∧ volume (sepCyl a c r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ∩ chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) = 0) ∨ (volume ((sepCyl a c r δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a}) \ chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) = 0 ∧ volume (sepCyl a c r δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} ∩ chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) = 0)) : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a c r δ, ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ frontier E ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z))

proof.tactics:
by
  set κ := chartAt E3 p with hκ
  set Fκ := κ '' (F ∩ κ.source) with hFκdef
  set C := sepCyl a c r δ with hCdef
  have hmemE : ∀ x, x ∈ E ↔ (x ∉ K ∧ ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, sepChartNull (N \ F)) := fun x => by
    rw [hE]; rfl
  
  
  have sepChartNull_of_image_null : ∀ (p : M) (N : Set M),
      N ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source → volume (chartAt E3 p '' N) = 0 → sepChartNull N := by
    intro p N hN h0 q
    have hs0 : volume (chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) = 0 :=
      measure_mono_null (Set.image_mono Set.inter_subset_left) h0
    have himg : (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) ''
        (chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
        = chartAt E3 q '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
      rw [Set.image_image]
      refine Set.EqOn.image_eq ?_
      intro x hx
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hN hx.1)]
    have hsm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart (x := q)).comp
        ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := p)).mono Set.inter_subset_left) Set.inter_subset_right
    have hcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hsm
    have hsub : chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ⊆
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source (hN hx.1), ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hN hx.1)]
      exact hx.2
    have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (chartAt E3 p '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) :=
      (hcd.differentiableOn (by simp)).mono hsub
    rw [← himg]
    exact MeasureTheory.addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn_of_addHaar_eq_zero volume
      hdiff hs0
  
  have hCK : ∀ z ∈ C, z ∈ κ.target ∧ κ.symm z ∉ K := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x', ⟨hx'K, hx's⟩, rfl⟩ := hcyl hz
    exact ⟨κ.map_source hx's, by rw [κ.left_inv hx's]; exact hx'K⟩
  have hvolpos : ∀ (s : Set E3) (z : E3), s ∈ 𝓝 z → volume s ≠ 0 := by
    intro s z hs h0
    have h1 : 0 < volume (interior s) :=
      isOpen_interior.measure_pos volume ⟨z, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hs⟩
    have h2 : volume (interior s) = 0 := measure_mono_null interior_subset h0
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact lt_irrefl _ h1
  
  have T1 : ∀ Q : Set E3, IsOpen Q → Q ⊆ C → volume (Q \ Fκ) = 0 →
      ∀ z ∈ Q, κ.symm z ∈ E := by
    intro Q hQ hQC hQ0 z hz
    have hzt := (hCK z (hQC hz)).1
    have hNo : IsOpen (κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q) := κ.isOpen_inter_preimage hQ
    have hzN : κ.symm z ∈ κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q := by
      refine ⟨κ.map_target hzt, ?_⟩
      show κ (κ.symm z) ∈ Q
      rw [κ.right_inv hzt]
      exact hz
    refine (hmemE _).2 ⟨(hCK z (hQC hz)).2, _, hNo.mem_nhds hzN, ?_⟩
    refine sepChartNull_of_image_null p _ (fun x hx => hx.1.1) ?_
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ hQ0
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨⟨hxs, hxQ⟩, hxF⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hxQ, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨x', ⟨hx'F, hx's⟩, heq⟩
    exact hxF ((κ.injOn hx's hxs heq) ▸ hx'F)
  
  have T0 : ∀ Q : Set E3, IsOpen Q → Q ⊆ C → volume (Q ∩ Fκ) = 0 →
      ∀ z ∈ Q, κ.symm z ∉ closure E := by
    intro Q hQ hQC hQ0 z hz hcl
    have hzt := (hCK z (hQC hz)).1
    have hNo : IsOpen (κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q) := κ.isOpen_inter_preimage hQ
    have hzN : κ.symm z ∈ κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q := by
      refine ⟨κ.map_target hzt, ?_⟩
      show κ (κ.symm z) ∈ Q
      rw [κ.right_inv hzt]
      exact hz
    have hNF : sepChartNull ((κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q) ∩ F) := by
      refine sepChartNull_of_image_null p _ (fun x hx => hx.1.1) ?_
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ hQ0
      rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨⟨hxs, hxQ⟩, hxF⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨hxQ, x, ⟨hxF, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hyN, hyE⟩ := _root_.mem_closure_iff.1 hcl _ hNo hzN
    obtain ⟨-, Ny, hNy, hNyn⟩ := (hmemE y).1 hyE
    have hsub : (κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q) ∩ Ny ⊆ (Ny \ F) ∪ ((κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q) ∩ F) := by
      intro w hw
      by_cases hwF : w ∈ F
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hw.1, hwF⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hw.2, hwF⟩
    have hy' : (κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q) ∩ Ny ∈ 𝓝 y := Filter.inter_mem (hNo.mem_nhds hyN) hNy
    have h5 : chartAt E3 y '' (((κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' Q) ∩ Ny) ∩ (chartAt E3 y).source) ∈
        𝓝 (chartAt E3 y y) :=
      (chartAt E3 y).image_mem_nhds (mem_chart_source E3 y)
        (Filter.inter_mem hy' ((chartAt E3 y).open_source.mem_nhds (mem_chart_source E3 y)))
    apply hvolpos _ _ h5
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null (hNyn y) (hNF y))
    rw [← Set.image_union, ← Set.union_inter_distrib_right]
    exact Set.image_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hsub)
  
  have T2 : ∀ z ∈ C, κ.symm z ∈ E → ∃ Nz ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (Nz \ Fκ) = 0 := by
    intro z hzC hE'
    have hz := (hCK z hzC).1
    obtain ⟨-, N, hN, hNn⟩ := (hmemE _).1 hE'
    have hxs : κ.symm z ∈ κ.source := κ.map_target hz
    refine ⟨κ '' (N ∩ κ.source), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h := κ.image_mem_nhds hxs (Filter.inter_mem hN (κ.open_source.mem_nhds hxs))
      rwa [κ.right_inv hz] at h
    · have h := hNn p
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ h
      rintro _ ⟨⟨x', ⟨hx'N, hx's⟩, rfl⟩, hnot⟩
      exact ⟨x', ⟨⟨hx'N, fun hF => hnot ⟨x', ⟨hF, hx's⟩, rfl⟩⟩, hx's⟩, rfl⟩
  
  have hmeasQ : ∀ (N Q : Set E3) (z : E3), N ∈ 𝓝 z → IsOpen Q →
      (∀ N' ∈ 𝓝 z, (N' ∩ Q).Nonempty) → volume (N \ Fκ) = 0 →
      volume (Q ∩ Fκ) = 0 → False := by
    intro N Q z hN hQ hnear hN0 hQ0
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hnear _ (interior_mem_nhds.2 hN)
    have hpos := (isOpen_interior.inter hQ).measure_pos volume ⟨w, hw⟩
    have hsub : interior N ∩ Q ⊆ (N \ Fκ) ∪ (Q ∩ Fκ) := by
      rintro v ⟨hvN, hvQ⟩
      by_cases hvF : v ∈ Fκ
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hvQ, hvF⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨interior_subset hvN, hvF⟩
    have hz0 : volume (interior N ∩ Q) = 0 :=
      measure_mono_null hsub (measure_union_null hN0 hQ0)
    rw [hz0] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
  
  have hcoord : Continuous (fun w : E3 => w a) := by fun_prop
  have hproj_cont : Continuous (sepPlaneProj a) := by
    unfold sepPlaneProj
    exact continuous_id.sub (hcoord.smul continuous_const)
  have huc : Continuous (fun w => u (sepPlaneProj a w)) := hu.comp hproj_cont
  have hCo : IsOpen C :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (hproj_cont.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
      continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (hcoord.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const)
  have hcoordadd : ∀ (w : E3) (t : ℝ), (w + t • e a) a = w a + t := by
    intro w t
    simp [e]
  have hprojadd : ∀ (w : E3) (t : ℝ), sepPlaneProj a (w + t • e a) = sepPlaneProj a w := by
    intro w t
    unfold sepPlaneProj
    rw [hcoordadd, add_smul]
    abel
  obtain ⟨Qp, hQp⟩ : ∃ Q : Set E3, Q = C ∩ {w | u (sepPlaneProj a w) < w a} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Qm, hQm⟩ : ∃ Q : Set E3, Q = C ∩ {w | w a < u (sepPlaneProj a w)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQpo : IsOpen Qp := by rw [hQp]; exact hCo.inter (isOpen_lt huc hcoord)
  have hQmo : IsOpen Qm := by rw [hQm]; exact hCo.inter (isOpen_lt hcoord huc)
  have hQpC : Qp ⊆ C := by rw [hQp]; exact Set.inter_subset_left
  have hQmC : Qm ⊆ C := by rw [hQm]; exact Set.inter_subset_left
  
  have hnearp : ∀ z ∈ C, z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, (N ∩ Qp).Nonempty := by
    intro z hz hzg N hN
    have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => z + t • e a) := by fun_prop
    have hT : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => z + t • e a) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 z) := by
      have h := hc.tendsto 0
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at h
      exact h.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hev : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), z + t • e a ∈ N ∩ C ∧ t ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) :=
      (hT.eventually_mem (Filter.inter_mem hN (hCo.mem_nhds hz))).and eventually_mem_nhdsWithin
    obtain ⟨t, ⟨htN, htC⟩, ht0⟩ := hev.exists
    have ht0' : 0 < t := ht0
    refine ⟨z + t • e a, htN, ?_⟩
    rw [hQp]
    refine ⟨htC, ?_⟩
    show u (sepPlaneProj a (z + t • e a)) < (z + t • e a) a
    rw [hprojadd, hcoordadd, ← hzg]
    linarith
  have hnearm : ∀ z ∈ C, z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, (N ∩ Qm).Nonempty := by
    intro z hz hzg N hN
    have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => z + t • e a) := by fun_prop
    have hT : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => z + t • e a) (𝓝[<] 0) (𝓝 z) := by
      have h := hc.tendsto 0
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at h
      exact h.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have hev : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[<] (0 : ℝ), z + t • e a ∈ N ∩ C ∧ t ∈ Set.Iio (0 : ℝ) :=
      (hT.eventually_mem (Filter.inter_mem hN (hCo.mem_nhds hz))).and eventually_mem_nhdsWithin
    obtain ⟨t, ⟨htN, htC⟩, ht0⟩ := hev.exists
    have ht0' : t < 0 := ht0
    refine ⟨z + t • e a, htN, ?_⟩
    rw [hQm]
    refine ⟨htC, ?_⟩
    show (z + t • e a) a < u (sepPlaneProj a (z + t • e a))
    rw [hprojadd, hcoordadd, ← hzg]
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨Q₁, Q₂, hQQ, hQ₁, hQ₂⟩ : ∃ Q₁ Q₂ : Set E3,
      ((Q₁ = Qm ∧ Q₂ = Qp) ∨ (Q₁ = Qp ∧ Q₂ = Qm)) ∧
      volume (Q₁ \ Fκ) = 0 ∧ volume (Q₂ ∩ Fκ) = 0 := by
    rcases hside with ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ | ⟨hs1, hs2⟩
    · exact ⟨Qm, Qp, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, by rw [hQm]; exact hs1, by rw [hQp]; exact hs2⟩
    · exact ⟨Qp, Qm, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, by rw [hQp]; exact hs1, by rw [hQm]; exact hs2⟩
  have hQ₁o : IsOpen Q₁ := by
    rcases hQQ with ⟨h1', _⟩ | ⟨h1', _⟩ <;> rw [h1'] <;> assumption
  have hQ₂o : IsOpen Q₂ := by
    rcases hQQ with ⟨_, h2'⟩ | ⟨_, h2'⟩ <;> rw [h2'] <;> assumption
  have hQ₁C : Q₁ ⊆ C := by
    rcases hQQ with ⟨h1', _⟩ | ⟨h1', _⟩ <;> rw [h1'] <;> assumption
  have hQ₂C : Q₂ ⊆ C := by
    rcases hQQ with ⟨_, h2'⟩ | ⟨_, h2'⟩ <;> rw [h2'] <;> assumption
  have hnear₁ : ∀ z ∈ C, z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, (N ∩ Q₁).Nonempty := by
    rcases hQQ with ⟨h1', _⟩ | ⟨h1', _⟩ <;> rw [h1'] <;> assumption
  have hnear₂ : ∀ z ∈ C, z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, (N ∩ Q₂).Nonempty := by
    rcases hQQ with ⟨_, h2'⟩ | ⟨_, h2'⟩ <;> rw [h2'] <;> assumption
  
  intro z hz
  have hzt := (hCK z hz).1
  rw [hEo.frontier_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hzcl, hzE⟩
    by_contra hne
    have hmem : z ∈ Q₁ ∨ z ∈ Q₂ := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
      · have hzm : z ∈ Qm := by rw [hQm]; exact ⟨hz, h⟩
        rcases hQQ with ⟨h1', h2'⟩ | ⟨h1', h2'⟩
        · left; rw [h1']; exact hzm
        · right; rw [h2']; exact hzm
      · have hzp : z ∈ Qp := by rw [hQp]; exact ⟨hz, h⟩
        rcases hQQ with ⟨h1', h2'⟩ | ⟨h1', h2'⟩
        · right; rw [h2']; exact hzp
        · left; rw [h1']; exact hzp
    rcases hmem with h | h
    · exact hzE (T1 Q₁ hQ₁o hQ₁C hQ₁ z h)
    · exact T0 Q₂ hQ₂o hQ₂C hQ₂ z h hzcl
  · intro hzg
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [_root_.mem_closure_iff]
      intro W hW hxW
      have hxs : κ.symm z ∈ κ.source := κ.map_target hzt
      have h := κ.image_mem_nhds hxs
        (Filter.inter_mem (hW.mem_nhds hxW) (κ.open_source.mem_nhds hxs))
      rw [κ.right_inv hzt] at h
      obtain ⟨w, ⟨w', ⟨hw'W, hw's⟩, rfl⟩, hwQ⟩ := hnear₁ z hz hzg _ h
      refine ⟨w', hw'W, ?_⟩
      have h' := T1 Q₁ hQ₁o hQ₁C hQ₁ _ hwQ
      rwa [κ.left_inv hw's] at h'
    · intro hE'
      obtain ⟨Nz, hNz, hNz0⟩ := T2 z hz hE'
      exact hmeasQ Nz Q₂ z hNz hQ₂o (hnear₂ z hz hzg) hNz0 hQ₂

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (μ : ℝ) (hPD : (G y).PosDef) (hξ : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k F₁ y) ≠ 0)
    (hμ0 : μ ≠ 0) (hgrad : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k F₂ y = μ * partialDeriv k F₁ y)
    (hDsymm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G F₂ i j y - μ * hessLoc G F₁ i j y =
      hessLoc G F₂ j i y - μ * hessLoc G F₁ j i y)
    (hD : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k F₁ y * v k = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * (hessLoc G F₂ i j y - μ * hessLoc G F₁ i j y) = 0) :
    secondFundSq G F₂ y = secondFundSq G F₁ y

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (μ : ℝ) (hPD : (G y).PosDef) (hξ : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k F₁ y) ≠ 0)
    (hμ0 : μ ≠ 0) (hgrad : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k F₂ y = μ * partialDeriv k F₁ y)
    (hDsymm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G F₂ i j y - μ * hessLoc G F₁ i j y =
      hessLoc G F₂ j i y - μ * hessLoc G F₁ j i y)
    (hD : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k F₁ y * v k = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * (hessLoc G F₂ i j y - μ * hessLoc G F₁ i j y) = 0) :

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have trace_core : ∀ (P H H2 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (μ : ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P a j * (H2 j k - μ * H j k) * P k b = 0) →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, P i j * H2 j k * P k l * H2 l i =
        μ ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          P i j * H j k * P k l * H l i := by
    intro P H H2 μ hQ
    have h00 := hQ 0 0
    have h01 := hQ 0 1
    have h02 := hQ 0 2
    have h10 := hQ 1 0
    have h11 := hQ 1 1
    have h12 := hQ 1 2
    have h20 := hQ 2 0
    have h21 := hQ 2 1
    have h22 := hQ 2 2
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h00 h01 h02 h10 h11 h12 h20 h21 h22 ⊢
    linear_combination (μ * H 0 0 + H2 0 0) * h00 + (μ * H 1 0 + H2 1 0) * h01 +
      (μ * H 2 0 + H2 2 0) * h02 + (μ * H 0 1 + H2 0 1) * h10 + (μ * H 1 1 + H2 1 1) * h11 +
      (μ * H 2 1 + H2 2 1) * h12 + (μ * H 0 2 + H2 0 2) * h20 + (μ * H 1 2 + H2 1 2) * h21 +
      (μ * H 2 2 + H2 2 2) * h22
  
  have core : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (H H2 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (μ : ℝ), μ ≠ 0 → (∀ i j : Fin 3, A i j = A j i) →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, H2 i j - μ * H i j = H2 j i - μ * H j i) →
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * v k = 0 →
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * v j * (H2 i j - μ * H i j) = 0) →
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          (A i j - (∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * (μ * ξ a)) * (∑ b : Fin 3, A j b * (μ * ξ b)) /
              (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * (μ * ξ a) * (μ * ξ b))) * H2 j k *
            (A k l - (∑ a : Fin 3, A k a * (μ * ξ a)) * (∑ b : Fin 3, A l b * (μ * ξ b)) /
              (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * (μ * ξ a) * (μ * ξ b))) * H2 l i) /
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * (μ * ξ a) * (μ * ξ b)) =
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          (A i j - (∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ξ a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, A j b * ξ b) /
              (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b)) * H j k *
            (A k l - (∑ a : Fin 3, A k a * ξ a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, A l b * ξ b) /
              (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b)) * H l i) /
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b) := by
    intro A H H2 ξ μ hμ hA hDs hD
    have hcμ : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * (μ * ξ a) = μ * ∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ξ a := by
      intro i
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hSμ : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * (μ * ξ a) * (μ * ξ b) =
        μ ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    simp only [hcμ, hSμ]
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ξ a = c i :=
      ⟨fun i => ∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ξ a, fun i => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b = S := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    
    have polar : ∀ u w : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * u k = 0 → ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * w k = 0 →
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, u i * w j * (H2 i j - μ * H i j) = 0 := by
      intro u w hu hw
      have h1 := hD (fun k => u k + w k) (by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hu hw ⊢
        linarith)
      have h2 := hD (fun k => u k - w k) (by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hu hw ⊢
        linarith)
      have s01 := hDs 0 1
      have s02 := hDs 0 2
      have s12 := hDs 1 2
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h1 h2 ⊢
      linear_combination (h1 - h2) / 4 + (u 0 * w 1 - w 0 * u 1) / 2 * s01 +
        (u 0 * w 2 - w 0 * u 2) / 2 * s02 + (u 1 * w 2 - w 1 * u 2) / 2 * s12
    have e1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ξ j * A i j = c i := by
      intro i
      rw [← hc]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have e1' : ∀ l : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * A k l = c l := by
      intro l
      rw [← hc]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [hA 0 l, hA 1 l, hA 2 l]
      ring
    have e2 : ∑ j : Fin 3, ξ j * c j = S := by
      rw [← hS]
      simp only [← hc, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    simp only [hc, hS]
    by_cases hS0 : S = 0
    · simp [hS0]
    have hPμ : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        A i j - μ * c i * (μ * c j) / (μ ^ 2 * S) = A i j - c i * c j / S := by
      intro i j
      rw [show μ * c i * (μ * c j) = μ ^ 2 * (c i * c j) by ring,
        mul_div_mul_left _ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 hμ)]
    simp only [hPμ]
    have row : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ξ j * (A i j - c i * c j / S) = 0 := by
      intro i
      have h : ∑ j : Fin 3, ξ j * (A i j - c i * c j / S) =
          (∑ j : Fin 3, ξ j * A i j) - c i * (∑ j : Fin 3, ξ j * c j) / S := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [h, e1, e2, mul_div_assoc, div_self hS0, mul_one, sub_self]
    have col : ∀ l : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * (A k l - c k * c l / S) = 0 := by
      intro l
      have h : ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * (A k l - c k * c l / S) =
          (∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * A k l) - c l * (∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * c k) / S := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [h, e1', e2, mul_div_assoc, div_self hS0, mul_one, sub_self]
    have hQ : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
        (A a j - c a * c j / S) * (H2 j k - μ * H j k) * (A k b - c k * c b / S) = 0 := by
      intro a b
      have h := polar (fun j => A a j - c a * c j / S) (fun k => A k b - c k * c b / S)
        (row a) (col b)
      beta_reduce at h
      rw [← h]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      ring
    have key := trace_core (fun i j => A i j - c i * c j / S) H H2 μ hQ
    beta_reduce at key
    rw [key, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 hμ)]
  have hA : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i := by
    intro i j
    have h := hPD.isHermitian.inv.apply j i
    simp only [star_trivial] at h
    exact h
  unfold secondFundSq
  simp only [hgrad]
  exact core (G y)⁻¹ (fun j k => hessLoc G F₁ j k y) (fun j k => hessLoc G F₂ j k y)
    (fun k => partialDeriv k F₁ y) μ hμ0 hA hDsymm hD

informal_problem.statement:
(G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ)
    (y₁ y₂ : E3) (J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hJ : J.det ≠ 0) (hG₁ : (G₁ y₁).det ≠ 0)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, G₂ y₂ i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, J a i * G₁ y₁ a b * J b j)
    (hξ : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i F₂ y₂ = ∑ a : Fin 3, J a i * partialDeriv a F₁ y₁)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G₂ F₂ i j y₂ =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, J a i * J b j * hessLoc G₁ F₁ a b y₁) :
    secondFundSq G₂ F₂ y₂ = secondFundSq G₁ F₁ y₁

signature.name: secondFundSq_congr_tensor
signature.statement:
(G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ)
    (y₁ y₂ : E3) (J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hJ : J.det ≠ 0) (hG₁ : (G₁ y₁).det ≠ 0)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, G₂ y₂ i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, J a i * G₁ y₁ a b * J b j)
    (hξ : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i F₂ y₂ = ∑ a : Fin 3, J a i * partialDeriv a F₁ y₁)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G₂ F₂ i j y₂ =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, J a i * J b j * hessLoc G₁ F₁ a b y₁) :
    secondFundSq G₂ F₂ y₂ = secondFundSq G₁ F₁ y₁

proof.tactics:
by
  have hJK : J * J⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv J (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hJ)
  
  have tf : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
      (N H : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ), (G y)⁻¹ = N →
      (∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a f y = ξ a) → (∀ j k : Fin 3, hessLoc G f j k y = H j k) →
      secondFundSq G f y = Matrix.trace (Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin 3 => N i j -
          (∑ a : Fin 3, N i a * ξ a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, N j b * ξ b) /
            (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, N a b * ξ a * ξ b)) * H *
        Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin 3 => N i j -
          (∑ a : Fin 3, N i a * ξ a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, N j b * ξ b) /
            (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, N a b * ξ a * ξ b)) * H) /
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, N a b * ξ a * ξ b) := by
    intro G f y N H ξ hN hξ' hH'
    have gen : ∀ P Q : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, P i j * Q j k * P k l * Q l i =
          Matrix.trace (P * Q * P * Q) := by
      intro P Q
      simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    unfold secondFundSq
    simp only [hN, hξ', hH']
    rw [← gen]
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
  
  have cp : ∀ (N K L : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ), L * K = 1 →
      (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (K * N * K.transpose) a b * (L.transpose.mulVec ξ) a *
          (L.transpose.mulVec ξ) b = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, N a b * ξ a * ξ b) ∧
      Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin 3 => (K * N * K.transpose) i j -
          (∑ a : Fin 3, (K * N * K.transpose) i a * (L.transpose.mulVec ξ) a) *
          (∑ b : Fin 3, (K * N * K.transpose) j b * (L.transpose.mulVec ξ) b) /
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (K * N * K.transpose) a b * (L.transpose.mulVec ξ) a *
            (L.transpose.mulVec ξ) b)) =
        K * Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin 3 => N i j -
          (∑ a : Fin 3, N i a * ξ a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, N j b * ξ b) /
            (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, N a b * ξ a * ξ b)) * K.transpose := by
    intro N K L ξ hLK
    have hKL : K.transpose * L.transpose = 1 := by
      rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, hLK, Matrix.transpose_one]
    have hw : (K * N * K.transpose).mulVec (L.transpose.mulVec ξ) = K.mulVec (N.mulVec ξ) := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_assoc (K * N), hKL, Matrix.mul_one,
        ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
    have hquad : ∀ (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ),
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, M a b * v a * v b = dotProduct v (M.mulVec v) := by
      intro M v
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hS : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (K * N * K.transpose) a b * (L.transpose.mulVec ξ) a *
          (L.transpose.mulVec ξ) b = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, N a b * ξ a * ξ b := by
      rw [hquad, hquad, hw, Matrix.mulVec_transpose, ← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec,
        Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hLK, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hrow : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, (K * N * K.transpose) i a * (L.transpose.mulVec ξ) a =
        (K.mulVec (N.mulVec ξ)) i := by
      intro i
      rw [← hw]
      rfl
    refine ⟨hS, ?_⟩
    rw [hS]
    simp only [hrow]
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.mulVec,
      dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have tc : ∀ (P Q K L : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), L * K = 1 →
      Matrix.trace (K * P * K.transpose * (L.transpose * Q * L) * (K * P * K.transpose) *
        (L.transpose * Q * L)) = Matrix.trace (P * Q * P * Q) := by
    intro P Q K L hLK
    have hKL : K.transpose * L.transpose = 1 := by
      rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, hLK, Matrix.transpose_one]
    have h1 : ∀ X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, K.transpose * (L.transpose * X) = X :=
      fun X => by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hKL, Matrix.one_mul]
    have h2 : ∀ X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, L * (K * X) = X :=
      fun X => by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hLK, Matrix.one_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, h1, h2]
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm K]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, hLK, Matrix.mul_one]
  
  have hB : G₂ y₂ = J.transpose * G₁ y₁ * J := by
    ext i j
    rw [hG i j]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hBinv : (G₂ y₂)⁻¹ = J⁻¹ * (G₁ y₁)⁻¹ * (J⁻¹).transpose := by
    rw [hB, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, ← Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hξ' : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a F₂ y₂ =
      (J.transpose.mulVec (fun c => partialDeriv c F₁ y₁)) a := by
    intro a
    rw [hξ a]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  have hH' : ∀ j k : Fin 3, hessLoc G₂ F₂ j k y₂ =
      (J.transpose * (Matrix.of fun a b => hessLoc G₁ F₁ a b y₁) * J) j k := by
    intro j k
    rw [hH j k]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  rw [tf G₂ F₂ y₂ (J⁻¹ * (G₁ y₁)⁻¹ * (J⁻¹).transpose)
      (J.transpose * (Matrix.of fun a b => hessLoc G₁ F₁ a b y₁) * J)
      (J.transpose.mulVec (fun c => partialDeriv c F₁ y₁)) hBinv hξ' hH',
    tf G₁ F₁ y₁ (G₁ y₁)⁻¹ (Matrix.of fun a b => hessLoc G₁ F₁ a b y₁)
      (fun c => partialDeriv c F₁ y₁) rfl (fun a => rfl) (fun j k => rfl)]
  obtain ⟨hS, hP⟩ := cp (G₁ y₁)⁻¹ J⁻¹ J (fun c => partialDeriv c F₁ y₁) hJK
  rw [hP, hS, tc _ _ J⁻¹ J hJK]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (hPD : (G y).PosDef) (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G F i j y = hessLoc G F j i y) :
    0 ≤ secondFundSq G F y

signature.name: secondFundSq_nonneg_of_posDef
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (hPD : (G y).PosDef) (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G F i j y = hessLoc G F j i y) :
    0 ≤ secondFundSq G F y

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s2 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, A.PosSemidef → ∀ ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 3 => A i j - (∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ξ a) *
        (∑ b : Fin 3, A j b * ξ b) / (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b)).PosSemidef := by
    intro A hA ξ
    have hsym : ∀ i j : Fin 3, A i j = A j i := by
      intro i j
      have h := hA.isHermitian.apply i j
      simpa using h.symm
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i, ∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * ξ a = w i := ⟨_, fun i => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b = S := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    simp only [hw, hS]
    by_cases hS0 : S = 0
    · have : (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 3 => A i j - w i * w j / S) = A := by
        ext i j
        simp [hS0]
      rw [this]
      exact hA
    · have hC : ∀ j, ∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * A k j = w j := by
        intro j
        rw [← hw j, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three, hsym 0 j, hsym 1 j, hsym 2 j]
        ring
      have hQ : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, ξ k * A k l * ξ l = S := by
        rw [← hS]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      set Q : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
        Matrix.of fun k i : Fin 3 => (if k = i then S else 0) - ξ k * w i with hQdef
      have hexp : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (Q.conjTranspose * A * Q) i j =
          S ^ 2 * A i j - S * w i * (∑ k : Fin 3, ξ k * A k j)
            - S * w j * (∑ l : Fin 3, A i l * ξ l)
            + w i * w j * (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, ξ k * A k l * ξ l) := by
        intro i j
        simp only [hQdef, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial,
          Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp <;> ring
      have heq : (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 3 => A i j - w i * w j / S) =
          (S ^ 2)⁻¹ • (Q.conjTranspose * A * Q) := by
        ext i j
        rw [Matrix.smul_apply, hexp i j, hC j, hw i, hQ, Matrix.of_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [heq]
      exact (hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same Q).smul (by positivity)
  
  have s3 : ∀ P H : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, P.PosSemidef → (∀ i j : Fin 3, H i j = H j i) →
      0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, P i j * H j k * P k l * H l i := by
    intro P H hP hHs
    have htr : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, P i j * H j k * P k l * H l i
        = (P * H * P * H).trace := by
      simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [htr]
    have hHc : H.conjTranspose = H := by
      ext i j
      simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, hHs j i]
    obtain ⟨B, rfl⟩ := Matrix.posSemidef_iff_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self.mp hP
    have hL : (B * H * B.conjTranspose).conjTranspose = B * H * B.conjTranspose := by
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
        hHc]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hcyc : (B.conjTranspose * B * H * (B.conjTranspose * B) * H).trace =
        ((B * H * B.conjTranspose).conjTranspose * (B * H * B.conjTranspose)).trace := by
      rw [hL]
      rw [show B.conjTranspose * B * H * (B.conjTranspose * B) * H =
          B.conjTranspose * (B * H * B.conjTranspose * B * H) by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]]
      rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hcyc]
    exact (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _).trace_nonneg
  
  have hApsd : ((G y)⁻¹).PosSemidef := (Matrix.PosDef.inv hPD).posSemidef
  have hS : 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a F y * partialDeriv b F y := by
    have h := hApsd.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (fun a => partialDeriv a F y)
    calc (0 : ℝ) ≤ _ := h
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
  
  unfold secondFundSq
  exact div_nonneg (s3 _ (Matrix.of fun j k => hessLoc G F j k y)
    (s2 _ hApsd (fun a => partialDeriv a F y)) hH) hS

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E Ω K : Set M) {N : ℕ} (U : Fin N → Set M) (hU : ∀ i, U i ⊆ Ω) (hUd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (U i) (U j))) : ∑ i, hullRiemPer g E (U i) K ≤ hullRiemPer g E Ω K

signature.name: hullRiemPer_disjoint_sum_le
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E Ω K : Set M) {N : ℕ} (U : Fin N → Set M) (hU : ∀ i, U i ⊆ Ω) (hUd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (U i) (U j))) : ∑ i, hullRiemPer g E (U i) K ≤ hullRiemPer g E Ω K

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let val : (Σ n : ℕ, (Fin n → M) × (Fin n → Set M)) → ENNReal := fun x =>
    ∑ k, hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (x.2.1 k)).symm)
      (chartAt E3 (x.2.1 k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (x.2.1 k)).source))
      (chartAt E3 (x.2.1 k) '' x.2.2 k)
      (chartAt E3 (x.2.1 k) '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 (x.2.1 k)).source))
  let fam : Set M → (Σ n : ℕ, (Fin n → M) × (Fin n → Set M)) → Prop := fun V x =>
    (∀ k, IsOpen (x.2.2 k) ∧ x.2.2 k ⊆ V ∩ (chartAt E3 (x.2.1 k)).source) ∧
      Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (x.2.2 k) (x.2.2 l))
  have hle : ∀ V : Set M, hullRiemPer g E V K ≤ ⨆ x : {x // fam V x}, val x.1 := by
    intro V
    unfold hullRiemPer
    refine iSup_le fun n => iSup_le fun p => iSup_le fun W => iSup_le fun h => ?_
    exact le_iSup_of_le (⟨⟨n, (p, W)⟩, h⟩ : {x // fam V x}) le_rfl
  have hne : ∀ V : Set M, Nonempty {x // fam V x} := fun V =>
    ⟨⟨⟨0, (Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0)⟩, ⟨fun k => k.elim0, fun k => k.elim0⟩⟩⟩
  have hfam : ∀ A B Ω' : Set M, A ⊆ Ω' → B ⊆ Ω' → Disjoint A B →
      ∀ x y, fam A x → fam B y → val x + val y ≤ hullRiemPer g E Ω' K := by
    intro A B Ω' hA hB hAB x y hx hy
    obtain ⟨n, p, W⟩ := x
    obtain ⟨m, p', W'⟩ := y
    obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
    dsimp only at hx1 hx2 hy1 hy2
    have hc1 : ∀ k, IsOpen (Fin.append W W' k) ∧
        Fin.append W W' k ⊆ Ω' ∩ (chartAt E3 (Fin.append p p' k)).source := by
      intro k
      induction k using Fin.addCases with
      | left i =>
        simp only [Fin.append_left]
        exact ⟨(hx1 i).1, (hx1 i).2.trans (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hA)⟩
      | right j =>
        simp only [Fin.append_right]
        exact ⟨(hy1 j).1, (hy1 j).2.trans (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hB)⟩
    have hc2 : Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (Fin.append W W' k) (Fin.append W W' l)) := by
      intro k l hkl
      induction k using Fin.addCases with
      | left i =>
        induction l using Fin.addCases with
        | left j =>
          simp only [Fin.append_left]
          exact hx2 (fun h => hkl (by rw [h]))
        | right j =>
          simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
          exact Disjoint.mono ((hx1 i).2.trans Set.inter_subset_left)
            ((hy1 j).2.trans Set.inter_subset_left) hAB
      | right i =>
        induction l using Fin.addCases with
        | left j =>
          simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
          exact Disjoint.mono ((hy1 i).2.trans Set.inter_subset_left)
            ((hx1 j).2.trans Set.inter_subset_left) hAB.symm
        | right j =>
          simp only [Fin.append_right]
          exact hy2 (fun h => hkl (by rw [h]))
    have hval : val ⟨n + m, (Fin.append p p', Fin.append W W')⟩ =
        val ⟨n, (p, W)⟩ + val ⟨m, (p', W')⟩ := by
      simp only [val, Fin.sum_univ_add, Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
    rw [← hval]
    unfold hullRiemPer
    exact le_iSup_of_le (n + m) (le_iSup_of_le (Fin.append p p')
      (le_iSup_of_le (Fin.append W W') (le_iSup_of_le ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ le_rfl)))
  have hbin : ∀ A B Ω' : Set M, A ⊆ Ω' → B ⊆ Ω' → Disjoint A B →
      hullRiemPer g E A K + hullRiemPer g E B K ≤ hullRiemPer g E Ω' K := by
    intro A B Ω' hA hB hAB
    haveI := hne A
    haveI := hne B
    refine (add_le_add (hle A) (hle B)).trans ?_
    exact ENNReal.iSup_add_iSup_le fun x y => hfam A B Ω' hA hB hAB x.1 y.1 x.2 y.2
  clear hle hne hfam
  clear_value val fam
  induction N generalizing Ω with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    have h1 := ih (⋃ i : Fin N, U i.succ) (fun i => U i.succ)
      (fun i => Set.subset_iUnion (fun i => U i.succ) i)
      (fun i j hij => hUd ((Fin.succ_injective N).ne hij))
    have h2 := hbin (U 0) (⋃ i : Fin N, U i.succ) Ω (hU 0)
      (Set.iUnion_subset fun i => hU i.succ)
      (Set.disjoint_iUnion_right.2 fun i => hUd (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm)
    exact (add_le_add le_rfl h1).trans h2

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U K : Set M) : sepRiemPer g F U ≤ hullRiemPer g F U K

signature.name: sepRiemPer_le_hullRiemPer
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U K : Set M) : sepRiemPer g F U ≤ hullRiemPer g F U K

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hpd : ∀ (p : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro p y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  
  have tA : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Set E3),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) T) →
      (∀ y ∈ T, (G y).PosDef) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) T := by
    intro G T hG hpd'
    have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) T := by
      have : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y => G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2
          - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1
          - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2 + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0
          + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
        funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (G y)
      rw [this]
      have h := hG
      exact (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
        (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
        (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
    exact hdet.sqrt (fun y hy => (hpd' y hy).det_pos.ne')
  
  have tB : ∀ (T : Set E3), IsOpen T → ∀ (a : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a T →
      ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ T →
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => a z * X z i) y| ≤ C := by
    intro T hT a ha X hX hXc hXT
    have hKc : IsClosed (tsupport X) := isClosed_tsupport X
    have hX0 : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → ∀ i : Fin 3, X y i = 0 := by
      intro y hy i
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy]
      simp
    have hXi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) := contDiff_euclidean.mp hX
    have hloc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X →
        (fun z => a z * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      fun i y hy => Filter.eventually_of_mem (hKc.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy)
        (fun z hz => by simp only [hX0 z hz i, mul_zero])
    have hd : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => a z * X z i) := by
      intro i
      refine contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.2 fun y => ?_
      by_cases hy : y ∈ T
      · exact (ha.mul (hXi i).contDiffOn).contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hy)
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hloc i y (fun h => hy (hXT h)))
    have hcont : Continuous (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => a z * X z i) y) :=
      continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
        ((hd i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hsupp : HasCompactSupport
        (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => a z * X z i) y) := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro hXc.isCompact fun y hy => ?_
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [(hloc i y hy).fderiv_eq]
      simp
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcont.bounded_above_of_compact_support hsupp
    refine ⟨C, fun y => ?_⟩
    have h := hC y
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  
  unfold sepRiemPer hullRiemPer
  refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun p => iSup_mono fun W => iSup_mono fun hW => ?_
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
  have hWsrc : W k ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source := (hW.1 k).2.trans Set.inter_subset_right
  have hsd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 (p k)).target :=
    tA _ _ (fun i j => g.smooth (p k) i j) (hpd (p k))
  unfold sepPerG hullPerG
  refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
  have htT : tsupport X ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := by
    refine hX.2.2.1.trans ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 (p k)).map_source (hWsrc hx)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := tB _ (chartAt E3 (p k)).open_target _ hsd X hX.1 hX.2.1 htT
  refine le_iSup_of_le X (le_iSup_of_le ⟨fun y _ => hX.1.contDiffAt, hX.2.1, hX.2.2.1, hX.2.2.2,
    C, fun y => hC y⟩ le_rfl)

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (Kc W : Set M) (q : M) (t δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hKc : ∀ p ∈ Kc, ρ p < t - δ) (hW : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' W ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X y| ≤ C) : ∃ XL XB XR : E3 → E3, (∀ y, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X y = sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XL y + sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XB y + sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XR y) ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XL) ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XB) ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XR) ∧ ((∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ XL y) ∧ HasCompactSupport XL ∧ tsupport XL ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | ρ p < t - δ / 8}) ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * XL y i * XL y j ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XL y| ≤ C) ∧ (ContDiff ℝ ∞ XB ∧ HasCompactSupport XB ∧ tsupport XB ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | t - δ < ρ p ∧ ρ p < t + δ}) ∧ ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * XB y i * XB y j ≤ 1) ∧ (ContDiff ℝ ∞ XR ∧ HasCompactSupport XR ∧ tsupport XR ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | t + δ / 8 < ρ p}) ∧ ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * XR y i * XR y j ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XL y ≠ 0 → y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | ρ p < t - δ / 8})) ∧ (∀ y, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XB y ≠ 0 → y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | t - δ < ρ p ∧ ρ p < t + δ}))
