signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (Kc W : Set M) (q : M) (t δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hKc : ∀ p ∈ Kc, ρ p < t - δ) (hW : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' W ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X y| ≤ C) : ∃ XL XB XR : E3 → E3, (∀ y, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X y = sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XL y + sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XB y + sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XR y) ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XL) ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XB) ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XR) ∧ ((∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ XL y) ∧ HasCompactSupport XL ∧ tsupport XL ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | ρ p < t - δ / 8}) ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * XL y i * XL y j ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XL y| ≤ C) ∧ (ContDiff ℝ ∞ XB ∧ HasCompactSupport XB ∧ tsupport XB ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | t - δ < ρ p ∧ ρ p < t + δ}) ∧ ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * XB y i * XB y j ≤ 1) ∧ (ContDiff ℝ ∞ XR ∧ HasCompactSupport XR ∧ tsupport XR ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | t + δ / 8 < ρ p}) ∧ ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * XR y i * XR y j ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XL y ≠ 0 → y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | ρ p < t - δ / 8})) ∧ (∀ y, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) XB y ≠ 0 → y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | t - δ < ρ p ∧ ρ p < t + δ}))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXt, hXn, C0, hC0⟩ := hX
  
  have hpd : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  
  have hJ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    have hent : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j)
        (chartAt E3 q).target := fun i j => g.smooth q i j
    have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
        (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      have e3 := fun a b c d a' b' => ((hent a b).mul (hent c d)).mul (hent a' b')
      exact (((((e3 0 0 1 1 2 2).sub (e3 0 0 1 2 2 1)).sub (e3 0 1 1 0 2 2)).add
        (e3 0 1 1 2 2 0)).add (e3 0 2 1 0 2 1)).sub (e3 0 2 1 1 2 0)
    exact hdet.sqrt (fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne')
  have hTo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).open_target
  generalize hG : g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm = G at hJ hXn hC0 ⊢
  
  have hloc : ∀ (Z₁ Z₂ : E3 → E3) (y : E3), Z₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] Z₂ →
      sepDensDiv G Z₁ y = sepDensDiv G Z₂ y := by
    intro Z₁ Z₂ y h
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have h' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z₁ z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z₂ z i) :=
      h.mono fun z hz => by simp only [hz]
    rw [h'.fderiv_eq]
  have hzero : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (y : E3), y ∉ tsupport Z → sepDensDiv G Z y = 0 := by
    intro Z y hy
    rw [hloc Z 0 y (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy)]
    simp [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
  have hcoord : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (y : E3), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Z y → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => Z z i) y := by
    intro Z y hZ i
    exact (contDiffAt_piLp _).1 hZ i
  
  have hbdd : ∀ Z : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Z → HasCompactSupport Z →
      tsupport Z ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target → ∃ C, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G Z y| ≤ C := by
    intro Z hZ hZc hZT
    have hh : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) := by
      intro i
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target
      · exact (hJ.contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hy)).mul (hcoord Z y hZ.contDiffAt i)
      · have h0 : Z =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h => hy (hZT h))
        have h1 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
          simp [hz]
        exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq h1
    have hcont : Continuous (sepDensDiv G Z) := by
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
        ((hh i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hsupp : HasCompactSupport (sepDensDiv G Z) :=
      HasCompactSupport.intro hZc (fun y hy => hzero Z y hy)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcont.bounded_above_of_compact_support hsupp
    exact ⟨C, fun y => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC y⟩
  
  have hint : ∀ Z : E3 → E3, HasCompactSupport Z → (∃ C, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G Z y| ≤ C) →
      Integrable (sepDensDiv G Z) := by
    rintro Z hZc ⟨C, hC⟩
    have hmeas : Measurable (sepDensDiv G Z) := by
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ _ _
    have hon : IntegrableOn (sepDensDiv G Z) (tsupport Z) :=
      Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := C) hZc.measure_lt_top.ne hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
        (ae_of_all _ fun y => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC y)
    exact hon.integrable_of_forall_notMem_eq_zero fun y hy => hzero Z y hy
  
  obtain ⟨ψL, hψL⟩ : ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ψ = fun s => Real.smoothTransition ((t - δ / 4 - s) / (δ / 4)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ψR, hψR⟩ : ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ψ = fun s => Real.smoothTransition ((s - t - δ / 4) / (δ / 4)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ4 : (0 : ℝ) < δ / 4 := by linarith
  have hψLs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψL := by
    rw [hψL]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id).div_const _)
  have hψRs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψR := by
    rw [hψR]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
      (((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).sub contDiff_const).div_const _)
  have hψL01 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ ψL s ∧ ψL s ≤ 1 := fun s => by
    simp only [hψL]; exact ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
  have hψR01 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ ψR s ∧ ψR s ≤ 1 := fun s => by
    simp only [hψR]; exact ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
  have hψLsupp : ∀ s, ψL s ≠ 0 → s < t - δ / 4 := by
    intro s hs
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    apply hs
    simp only [hψL]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    exact div_nonpos_iff.2 (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, hδ4.le⟩)
  have hψRsupp : ∀ s, ψR s ≠ 0 → t + δ / 4 < s := by
    intro s hs
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    apply hs
    simp only [hψR]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    exact div_nonpos_iff.2 (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, hδ4.le⟩)
  have hψL1 : ∀ s, s ≤ t - δ / 2 → ψL s = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    simp only [hψL]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ4]
    linarith
  have hψR1 : ∀ s, t + δ / 2 ≤ s → ψR s = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    simp only [hψR]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ4]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨ψB, hψB⟩ : ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ψ = fun s => 1 - ψL s - ψR s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψBs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψB := by
    rw [hψB]; exact (contDiff_const.sub hψLs).sub hψRs
  have hψLR : ∀ s, ψL s = 0 ∨ ψR s = 0 := by
    intro s
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have h1 := hψLsupp s h.1
    have h2 := hψRsupp s h.2
    linarith
  have hψB01 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ ψB s ∧ ψB s ≤ 1 := by
    intro s
    simp only [hψB]
    have h1 := hψL01 s
    have h2 := hψR01 s
    rcases hψLR s with h | h <;> constructor <;> linarith
  have hψBsupp : ∀ s, ψB s ≠ 0 → t - δ / 2 < s ∧ s < t + δ / 2 := by
    intro s hs
    simp only [hψB] at hs
    constructor
    · by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have h1 := hψL1 s hc
      have h2 : ψR s = 0 := by
        by_contra h; have := hψRsupp s h; linarith
      apply hs; rw [h1, h2]; ring
    · by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have h1 := hψR1 s hc
      have h2 : ψL s = 0 := by
        by_contra h; have := hψLsupp s h; linarith
      apply hs; rw [h1, h2]; ring
  have hψsum : ∀ s, ψL s + ψB s + ψR s = 1 := by
    intro s; simp only [hψB]; ring
  
  obtain ⟨f, hfdef⟩ : ∃ f : E3 → ℝ, f = fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfat : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f y := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ρ ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      hρ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      rw [hfdef]; exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    intro y hy
    exact h2.contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hy)
  have hf2 : ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source, f (chartAt E3 q x) = ρ x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hfdef]
    simp only
    rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hx]
  have hTX : tsupport X ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hXt hy
    exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hW hx)
  have hvan : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ), IsClosed S → (∀ s, ψ s ≠ 0 → s ∈ S) →
      ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, f y ∉ S →
        (fun z => ψ (f z) • X z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
    intro ψ S hS hψS y hy hfy
    have hc : ContinuousAt f y := (hfat y hy).continuousAt
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, f z ∈ Sᶜ := hc.preimage_mem_nhds (hS.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hfy)
    filter_upwards [h1] with z hz
    have h2 : ψ (f z) = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hz (hψS _ h)
    simp [h2]
  
  have hcut : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → (∀ s, 0 ≤ ψ s ∧ ψ s ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (S : Set ℝ), IsClosed S → (∀ s, ψ s ≠ 0 → s ∈ S) →
      (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) →
          ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ (f z) • X z) y) ∧
        HasCompactSupport (fun z => ψ (f z) • X z) ∧
        tsupport (fun z => ψ (f z) • X z) ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | ρ p ∈ S}) ∧
        (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          G y i j * (ψ (f y) • X y) i * (ψ (f y) • X y) j ≤ 1) ∧
        ((∀ p ∈ Kc, ρ p ∉ S) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ (f z) • X z) ∧
          ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source),
            (fun z => ψ (f z) • X z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3)) := by
    intro ψ hψ hψ01 S hS hψS
    have ha : ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) →
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ (f z) • X z) y := by
      intro y hyK
      by_cases hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target
      · exact (hψ.contDiffAt.comp y (hfat y hy)).smul (hXs y hyK)
      · have h0 : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h => hy (hTX h))
        have h1 : (fun z => ψ (f z) • X z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
          filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
          simp [hz]
        exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq h1
    refine ⟨ha, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact HasCompactSupport.intro hXc (fun y hy => by
        simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy])
    · intro y hy
      have hyX : y ∈ tsupport X := tsupport_smul_subset_right (fun z => ψ (f z)) X hy
      obtain ⟨x, hxW, rfl⟩ := hXt hyX
      refine ⟨x, ⟨hxW, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      by_contra hxS
      have hT := (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hW hxW)
      have hfy : f (chartAt E3 q x) ∉ S := by
        rw [hf2 x (hW hxW)]
        exact hxS
      exact (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.2 (hvan ψ S hS hψS _ hT hfy)) hy
    · intro y
      have hQ := hXn y
      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hψ01 (f y)
      have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (ψ (f y) • X y) i * (ψ (f y) • X y) j
          = ψ (f y) ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j := by
        simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [e1]
      have h2 : ψ (f y) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ h0 h1
      have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ (sq_nonneg (ψ (f y)))
      linarith
    · intro hKS
      have hK0 : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source),
          (fun z => ψ (f z) • X z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
        rintro y ⟨p, ⟨hpK, hps⟩, rfl⟩
        exact hvan ψ S hS hψS _ ((chartAt E3 q).map_source hps)
          (by rw [hf2 p hps]; exact hKS p hpK)
      refine ⟨contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.2 fun y => ?_, hK0⟩
      by_cases hy : y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hK0 y hy)
      · exact ha y hy
  
  obtain ⟨aL, bL, cL, dL, -⟩ := hcut ψL hψLs hψL01 (Set.Iic (t - δ / 4)) isClosed_Iic
    (fun s hs => le_of_lt (hψLsupp s hs))
  obtain ⟨-, bB, cB, dB, eB⟩ := hcut ψB hψBs hψB01 (Set.Icc (t - δ / 2) (t + δ / 2)) isClosed_Icc
    (fun s hs => ⟨(hψBsupp s hs).1.le, (hψBsupp s hs).2.le⟩)
  obtain ⟨-, bR, cR, dR, eR⟩ := hcut ψR hψRs hψR01 (Set.Ici (t + δ / 4)) isClosed_Ici
    (fun s hs => le_of_lt (hψRsupp s hs))
  have eB' := eB (fun p hp hS => by
    have h1 := hKc p hp
    have h2 : t - δ / 2 ≤ ρ p := hS.1
    linarith)
  have eR' := eR (fun p hp hS => by
    have h1 := hKc p hp
    have h2 : t + δ / 4 ≤ ρ p := hS
    linarith)
  have cL' : tsupport (fun z => ψL (f z) • X z) ⊆
      chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | ρ p < t - δ / 8}) := by
    refine cL.trans (Set.image_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ fun p hp => ?_))
    have h1 : ρ p ≤ t - δ / 4 := hp
    show ρ p < t - δ / 8
    linarith
  have cB' : tsupport (fun z => ψB (f z) • X z) ⊆
      chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | t - δ < ρ p ∧ ρ p < t + δ}) := by
    refine cB.trans (Set.image_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ fun p hp => ?_))
    have h1 : t - δ / 2 ≤ ρ p := hp.1
    have h2 : ρ p ≤ t + δ / 2 := hp.2
    show t - δ < ρ p ∧ ρ p < t + δ
    constructor <;> linarith
  have cR' : tsupport (fun z => ψR (f z) • X z) ⊆
      chartAt E3 q '' (W ∩ {p : M | t + δ / 8 < ρ p}) := by
    refine cR.trans (Set.image_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ fun p hp => ?_))
    have h1 : t + δ / 4 ≤ ρ p := hp
    show t + δ / 8 < ρ p
    linarith
  have hWT : chartAt E3 q '' W ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hW hx)
  have hBT : tsupport (fun z => ψB (f z) • X z) ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    cB'.trans ((Set.image_mono Set.inter_subset_left).trans hWT)
  have hRT : tsupport (fun z => ψR (f z) • X z) ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    cR'.trans ((Set.image_mono Set.inter_subset_left).trans hWT)
  
  have hsum : ∀ y, X y = ψL (f y) • X y + ψB (f y) • X y + ψR (f y) • X y := by
    intro y
    rw [← add_smul, ← add_smul, hψsum, one_smul]
  have hid : ∀ y, sepDensDiv G X y = sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψL (f z) • X z) y +
      sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψB (f z) • X z) y + sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψR (f z) • X z) y := by
    intro y
    by_cases hyK : y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)
    · have hB0 := eB'.2 y hyK
      have hR0 := eR'.2 y hyK
      have hXL : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => ψL (f z) • X z) := by
        filter_upwards [hB0, hR0] with z hz1 hz2
        conv_lhs => rw [hsum z]
        rw [hz1, hz2, add_zero, add_zero]
      rw [hloc _ _ y hXL, hloc _ _ y hB0, hloc _ _ y hR0]
      simp [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
    · by_cases hyT : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target
      · have hJy := hJ.contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hyT)
        have hd : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Z y → ∀ i : Fin 3,
            DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) y :=
          fun Z hZ i => (hJy.mul (hcoord Z y hZ i)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hL := hd _ (aL y hyK)
        have hB := hd _ eB'.1.contDiffAt
        have hR := hd _ eR'.1.contDiffAt
        unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        have e1 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) = fun z =>
            (Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψL (f z) • X z) i + Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψB (f z) • X z) i)
              + Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψR (f z) • X z) i := by
          funext z
          conv_lhs => rw [hsum z]
          simp only [PiLp.add_apply, WithLp.ofLp_add, Pi.add_apply]
          ring
        have h3 : fderiv ℝ (fun z =>
            Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψL (f z) • X z) i + Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψB (f z) • X z) i
              + Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψR (f z) • X z) i) y =
            fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψL (f z) • X z) i) y +
              fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψB (f z) • X z) i) y +
              fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψR (f z) • X z) i) y :=
          (((hL i).hasFDerivAt.add (hB i).hasFDerivAt).add (hR i).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
        rw [e1, h3]
        beta_reduce
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
      · have h1 : y ∉ tsupport X := fun h => hyT (hTX h)
        rw [hzero _ y h1, hzero _ y (fun h => h1 (tsupport_smul_subset_right _ _ h)),
          hzero _ y (fun h => h1 (tsupport_smul_subset_right _ _ h)),
          hzero _ y (fun h => h1 (tsupport_smul_subset_right _ _ h))]
        ring
  
  obtain ⟨CB, hCB⟩ := hbdd _ eB'.1 bB hBT
  obtain ⟨CR, hCR⟩ := hbdd _ eR'.1 bR hRT
  have hCL : ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψL (f z) • X z) y| ≤ C0 + CB + CR := by
    intro y
    have e1 := hid y
    have h1 := abs_le.1 (hC0 y)
    have h2 := abs_le.1 (hCB y)
    have h3 := abs_le.1 (hCR y)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2, h3.1, h3.2]
  have hsuppDiv : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (A : Set E3), tsupport Z ⊆ A →
      ∀ y, sepDensDiv G Z y ≠ 0 → y ∈ A := by
    intro Z A hZA y hy
    by_contra hyA
    exact hy (hzero Z y (fun h => hyA (hZA h)))
  exact ⟨fun z => ψL (f z) • X z, fun z => ψB (f z) • X z, fun z => ψR (f z) • X z, hid,
    hint _ bL ⟨_, hCL⟩, hint _ bB ⟨CB, hCB⟩, hint _ bR ⟨CR, hCR⟩,
    ⟨aL, bL, cL', dL, ⟨_, hCL⟩⟩, ⟨eB'.1, bB, cB', dB⟩, ⟨eR'.1, bR, cR', dR⟩,
    hsuppDiv _ _ cL', hsuppDiv _ _ cB'⟩

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (r₁ r₂ s : ℝ) (A F : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (hcpt : ∀ t : ℝ, IsCompact {p : M | ρ p ≤ t}) (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p) (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A) (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) (hr₁₂ : r₁ < r₂) (hr₂s : r₂ < s) (hF : sepChartMeas F) (hFA : symmDiff F A ⊆ {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₂}) (Ω' : Set M) (hΩ' : IsOpen Ω') (hΩ's : Ω' ⊆ {p : M | ρ p < s}) {n₀ : ℕ} (q₀ : Fin n₀ → M) (φ₀ : Fin n₀ → M → ℝ) (hφ₀ : calPartition q₀ φ₀ Ω') (O₀ : Set M) (hO₀ : IsOpen O₀) (hKO₀ : {p : M | r₁ ≤ ρ p ∧ ρ p ≤ r₂} ⊆ O₀) (hφ₀1 : ∀ x ∈ O₀, ∑ j, φ₀ j x = 1) (m : ℕ) (pp : Fin m → M) (W : Fin m → Set M) (hW : ∀ k, IsOpen (W k) ∧ W k ⊆ Ω' ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) (hWd : Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (W k) (W l))) (Y : Fin m → E3 → E3) (hY : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (Y k) ∧ tsupport (Y k) ⊆ chartAt E3 (pp k) '' W k ∧ ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y i j * Y k y i * Y k y j ≤ 1) : ENNReal.ofReal ((∑ k, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (((F \ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) ∪ A) ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm) (Y k) y) + calVolSum g q₀ φ₀ (symmDiff F A ∩ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (fun x => g.levelMeanCurv ρ x)) ≤ sepRiemPer g F Ω'

signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (r₁ r₂ s : ℝ) (A F : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (hcpt : ∀ t : ℝ, IsCompact {p : M | ρ p ≤ t}) (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p) (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A) (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) (hr₁₂ : r₁ < r₂) (hr₂s : r₂ < s) (hF : sepChartMeas F) (hFA : symmDiff F A ⊆ {p : M | ρ p ≤ r₂}) (Ω' : Set M) (hΩ' : IsOpen Ω') (hΩ's : Ω' ⊆ {p : M | ρ p < s}) {n₀ : ℕ} (q₀ : Fin n₀ → M) (φ₀ : Fin n₀ → M → ℝ) (hφ₀ : calPartition q₀ φ₀ Ω') (O₀ : Set M) (hO₀ : IsOpen O₀) (hKO₀ : {p : M | r₁ ≤ ρ p ∧ ρ p ≤ r₂} ⊆ O₀) (hφ₀1 : ∀ x ∈ O₀, ∑ j, φ₀ j x = 1) (m : ℕ) (pp : Fin m → M) (W : Fin m → Set M) (hW : ∀ k, IsOpen (W k) ∧ W k ⊆ Ω' ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) (hWd : Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (W k) (W l))) (Y : Fin m → E3 → E3) (hY : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (Y k) ∧ tsupport (Y k) ⊆ chartAt E3 (pp k) '' W k ∧ ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y i j * Y k y i * Y k y j ≤ 1) : ENNReal.ofReal ((∑ k, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (((F \ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) ∪ A) ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm) (Y k) y) + calVolSum g q₀ φ₀ (symmDiff F A ∩ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (fun x => g.levelMeanCurv ρ x)) ≤ sepRiemPer g F Ω'

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρ.continuous
  have himg : ∀ (x : M) (S : Set M), chartAt E3 x '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) =
      (chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' S := by
    intro x S
    rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact (chartAt E3 x).image_source_inter_eq' S
  have hopenimg : ∀ (x : M) (S : Set M), IsOpen S →
      MeasurableSet ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' S) := by
    intro x S hS
    exact ((chartAt E3 x).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hS).measurableSet
  have hUo : IsOpen {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hρc
  
  have hTFm : sepChartMeas ((F \ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) ∪ A) := by
    intro x
    have hFp := hF x
    rw [himg] at hFp ⊢
    have e : (chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' ((F \ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) ∪ A) =
        (((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' F) \
          ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' {p : M | r₁ < ρ p})) ∪
        ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' A) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff]
      tauto
    rw [e]
    exact (hFp.diff (hopenimg x _ hUo)).union (hopenimg x _ hAo)
  
  have hDO₀ : symmDiff F A ∩ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} ⊆ O₀ :=
    fun x hx => hKO₀ ⟨le_of_lt hx.2, hFA hx.1⟩
  
  have hmono : ∀ {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ), calPartition q φ Ω' →
      calPartition q φ {p : M | ρ p < s} := by
    intro n q φ hφ
    exact ⟨hφ.1, hφ.2.1, hφ.2.2.1, fun j => ⟨(hφ.2.2.2 j).1,

by
  
  have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) T := by
    have : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y => G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2
        - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1
        - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2 + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0
        + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
      funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (G y)
    rw [this]
    have h := hG
    exact (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
      (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
      (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
  have hsd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) T :=
    hdet.sqrt (fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne')
  
  have hQ : ∀ X : E3 → E3, (ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ A ∧
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →

      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C) := by

    have hKc : IsClosed (tsupport X) := isClosed_tsupport X
    have hKT : tsupport X ⊆ T := hXA.trans hAT
    have hX0 : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → ∀ i : Fin 3, X y i = 0 := by
      intro y hy i
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy]

    have hXi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) := contDiff_euclidean.mp hX

    have hFg : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
      intro i
      refine contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.2 fun y => ?_
      by_cases hy : y ∈ T

      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hloc i y (fun h => hy (hKT h)))

      show Continuous (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y)
      exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
        ((hFg i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const

      refine closure_minimal (fun y hy => ?_) hKc

      apply hy

      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [(hloc i y hyK).fderiv_eq]

    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcs.exists_bound_of_continuous hcont
    exact ⟨C, fun y => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC y⟩
  unfold sepPerG hullPerG
  exact iSup₂_le fun X hP => le_iSup₂_of_le X (hQ X hP) le_rfl

  have hE : Real.exp (-(Λ * (r k * ρ))) * Real.exp (Λ * (r k * ρ)) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add, neg_add_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
  simp only [hf_def]
  calc ρ ^ 2 * (Real.exp (-(Λ * (r k * ρ))) *
        (Real.exp (Λ * (r k * ρ)) * (P (r k * ρ)).toReal / (r k * ρ) ^ 2))
      = ρ ^ 2 * ((Real.exp (-(Λ * (r k * ρ))) * Real.exp (Λ * (r k * ρ))) *
        (P (r k * ρ)).toReal / (r k * ρ) ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = (r k)⁻¹ ^ 2 * (P (r k * ρ)).toReal := by
        rw [hE]
        field_simp

signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h : ∀ᵐ ρ ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), 0 < ρ → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ 2)) : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ρ hρ
  set P : ℝ → ENNReal := fun r =>
    sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 r) with hPdef
  set g : ℝ → ENNReal := fun r => ENNReal.ofReal (c * r ^ 2) with hgdef
  show P ρ = g ρ
  have hmono : ∀ r₁ r₂ : ℝ, r₁ ≤ r₂ → P r₁ ≤ P r₂ := by
    intro r₁ r₂ hr
    simp only [hPdef, sepPerG]
    refine iSup_mono fun X => iSup_mono' fun hX => ⟨⟨hX.1, hX.2.1,
      hX.2.2.1.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball hr), hX.2.2.2⟩, le_rfl⟩
  have hgood : ∀ u v : ℝ, u < v → ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo u v, 0 < x → P x = g x := by
    intro u v huv
    have hne : (volume : Measure ℝ) (Set.Ioo u v) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Real.volume_Ioo]
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.2 (sub_pos.2 huv)).ne'
    exact Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hne (ae_restrict_of_ae h)
  have hδ : ∀ n : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := fun n => by positivity
  have hA : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo ρ (ρ + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)), 0 < x → P x = g x :=
    fun n => hgood _ _ (by linarith [hδ n])
  have hB : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ x ∈ Set.Ioo (max (ρ / 2) (ρ - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) ρ,
      0 < x → P x = g x :=
    fun n => hgood _ _ (max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith [hδ n]))
  choose a ha haP using hA
  choose b hb hbP using hB
  have hapos : ∀ n, 0 < a n := fun n => lt_trans hρ (ha n).1
  have hbpos : ∀ n, 0 < b n := fun n =>
    lt_trans (lt_of_lt_of_le (half_pos hρ) (le_max_left _ _)) (hb n).1
  have hup : ∀ n, P ρ ≤ g (a n) := fun n => by
    rw [← haP n (hapos n)]
    exact hmono _ _ (ha n).1.le
  have hlow : ∀ n, g (b n) ≤ P ρ := fun n => by
    rw [← hbP n (hbpos n)]
    exact hmono _ _ (hb n).2.le
  have hδt : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  have hplus : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ρ + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 ρ) := by
    have := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := ρ)).add hδt
    rwa [add_zero] at this
  have hminus : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ρ - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 ρ) := by
    have := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := ρ)).sub hδt
    rwa [sub_zero] at this
  have halim : Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (𝓝 ρ) :=
    tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hplus
      (fun n => (ha n).1.le) (fun n => (ha n).2.le)
  have hblim : Filter.Tendsto b Filter.atTop (𝓝 ρ) :=
    tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le hminus tendsto_const_nhds
      (fun n => le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hb n).1.le) (fun n => (hb n).2.le)
  have hgc : Continuous g :=
    ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow 2))
  have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => g (a n)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (g ρ)) :=
    (hgc.tendsto ρ).comp halim
  have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => g (b n)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (g ρ)) :=
    (hgc.tendsto ρ).comp hblim
  exact le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto' h1 hup) (le_of_tendsto' h2 hlow)

by
  have hK : MeasurableSet K := hmin.1
  have hfin : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
      sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤ := by

    exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  obtain ⟨μ, ν, hμ, hνm, hν1, hGG, hper⟩ := sepGaussGreen_measure K hK hfin
  have hFV := fun T hT hTc =>

    intro r hr

  have hae := sepRadial_normal_vanish μ ν c hνm hν1 hFV hball
  apply sepCone_of_radial_flux K hK
  intro ψ hψ hψc
  have hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => ψ z • z) := hψ.smul contDiff_id
  have hXc : HasCompactSupport (fun z : E3 => ψ z • z) := hψc.smul_right
  rw [hGG _ hX hXc]

    filter_upwards [hae] with x hx

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hsq : ∀ (A : ℕ → Set E3) (L H : Set E3),
      Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (A k) L ∩ Metric.ball (0:E3) 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      volume (symmDiff L H) = 0 →
      Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (A k) H ∩ Metric.ball (0:E3) 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro A L H hA hLH
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hA
      (fun k => zero_le _) (fun k => ?_)
    calc volume (symmDiff (A k) H ∩ Metric.ball (0:E3) 1)
        ≤ volume ((symmDiff (A k) L ∩ Metric.ball (0:E3) 1) ∪ symmDiff L H) := by
          apply measure_mono
          rintro x ⟨hx, hxB⟩
          rcases symmDiff_triangle _ L _ hx with h | h
          · exact Or.inl ⟨h, hxB⟩
          · exact Or.inr h
      _ ≤ volume (symmDiff (A k) L ∩ Metric.ball (0:E3) 1) + volume (symmDiff L H) :=
          measure_union_le _ _
      _ = volume (symmDiff (A k) L ∩ Metric.ball (0:E3) 1) := by rw [hLH, add_zero]
  
  have hcompl : ∀ L : Set E3, sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) L Set.univ →
      sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) Lᶜ Set.univ := by
    intro L hL
    refine ⟨hL.1.compl, fun V hV hc hcl => ?_, fun F' V Kc hF' hV hc hcl hKc hKcV hsd => ?_⟩
    · rw [sepPerG_one_compl L V hL.1]
      exact hL.2.1 V hV hc hcl
    · have hsd' : symmDiff L F'ᶜ ⊆ Kc := by
        have hEq : symmDiff L F'ᶜ = symmDiff Lᶜ F' := by
          ext y
          simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff, Set.mem_compl_iff]
          tauto
        rw [hEq]
        exact hsd
      rw [sepPerG_one_compl L V hL.1, ← sepPerG_one_compl F' V hF']
      exact hL.2.2 F'ᶜ V Kc hF'.compl hV hc hcl hKc hKcV hsd'
  
  have hcyl : ∀ (L : Set E3) (u : E3), ‖u‖ = 1 →
      sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) L Set.univ →
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | t • z ∈ L} L) = 0) →
      (∀ s : ℝ, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • u ∈ L} L) = 0) →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0) →
      ∃ ν : E3, ‖ν‖ = 1 ∧ volume (symmDiff L {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0}) = 0 := by
    intro L u hu hL hconeL htrL h1L h0L
    obtain ⟨hdil, htr⟩ := sepMeasBdry_invariant L u hconeL htrL
    have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, norm_zero] at hu
      exact zero_ne_one hu
    
    have hreg : ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) →
        z - @inner ℝ E3 _ u z • u ≠ 0 → ∃ (a : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (ρ δ : ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ 0 < δ ∧
          Continuous w ∧ ∀ y ∈ sepCyl a z ρ δ,
            ((∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) ↔
              y a = w (sepPlaneProj a y)) := by
      intro z hz hz'
      obtain ⟨r, Lz, hr, hr0, hconv, hminz, h1z, h0z, hconez, htrzz, htrzu⟩ :=
        sepEuclCone_tangentCone L u z hL hconeL htrL (fun N hN => (hz N hN).2)
          (fun N hN => (hz N hN).1)
      have hind : LinearIndependent ℝ ![z, u] := by
        rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
        intro c₁ c₂ hc
        by_cases hc1 : c₁ = 0
        · subst hc1
          rw [zero_smul, zero_add] at hc
          exact ⟨rfl, (smul_eq_zero.mp hc).resolve_right hu0⟩
        · exfalso
          apply hz'
          have hzu : z = (-(c₁⁻¹ * c₂)) • u := by
            have h' : c₁ • z = -(c₂ • u) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hc
            calc z = c₁⁻¹ • (c₁ • z) := by rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc1, one_smul]
              _ = (-(c₁⁻¹ * c₂)) • u := by rw [h', smul_neg, smul_smul, neg_smul]
          have huu : @inner ℝ E3 _ u u = 1 := by
            rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu]
            norm_num
          rw [hzu, real_inner_smul_right, huu, mul_one, sub_self]
      obtain ⟨hdilz, htrz⟩ := sepMeasBdry_invariant Lz z hconez htrzz
      obtain ⟨-, htru⟩ := sepMeasBdry_invariant Lz u hconez htrzu
      obtain ⟨ν, hν, hLν⟩ := sepTwoDir_cone_halfspace Lz z u hind hdilz htrz htru
        (sepMinBdry_null Lz hminz) h1z h0z
      have hflat := hsq (fun k => {w : E3 | z + r k • w ∈ L}) Lz
        {w : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w < 0} (hconv 1 one_pos) hLν
      obtain ⟨a, w, ρ, δ, hρ, hδ, hw, -, hside⟩ := sepFlat_to_graph L z ν r hL
        (fun N hN => (hz N hN).2) (fun N hN => (hz N hN).1) hν hr hr0 hflat
      exact ⟨a, w, ρ, δ, hρ, hδ, hw.continuous,
        sepGraph_measBdry L a z w ρ δ hw.continuous hside⟩
    
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ, hrays⟩ := sepCylCone_finite_rays L u hu hdil htr hreg
    rcases sepCylCone_wedge_config L u Φ hu hdil htr hΦ hrays h1L h0L with
      h | ⟨E, q₁, q₂, p₁, p₂, hE, hq₁, hq₂, hind, hW, hS, hN⟩
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      have hEmin : sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) E Set.univ := by
        rcases hE with rfl | rfl
        · exact hL
        · exact hcompl L hL
      exact sepWedge_not_min E q₁ q₂ p₁ p₂ hEmin hq₁ hq₂ hind hW hS hN
  
  have hv0 : ∀ s : ℝ, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • (0:E3) ∈ K} K) = 0 := by
    intro s
    have hset : {z : E3 | z + s • (0:E3) ∈ K} = K := by
      ext z
      simp
    rw [hset, symmDiff_self]
    exact measure_empty
  have hdilK := (sepMeasBdry_invariant K 0 hcone hv0).1
  have hloc : ∀ x : E3, x ≠ 0 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) →
      ∃ (m : E3) (N : Set E3), ‖m‖ = 1 ∧ N ∈ 𝓝 x ∧
        volume ((N ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧
        volume (N ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} ∩ K) = 0 := by
    intro x hx hxb
    obtain ⟨r, L, hr, hr0, hconv, hLmin, h1L, h0L, hconeL, htrx, -⟩ :=
      sepEuclCone_tangentCone K 0 x hmin hcone hv0 (fun N hN => (hxb N hN).2)
        (fun N hN => (hxb N hN).1)
    have hxn : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx
    have he : ‖‖x‖⁻¹ • x‖ = 1 := by
      rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hxn.ne']
    have htre : ∀ s : ℝ, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • (‖x‖⁻¹ • x) ∈ L} L) = 0 := by
      intro s
      simp only [smul_smul]
      exact htrx (s * ‖x‖⁻¹)
    obtain ⟨ν, hν, hLν⟩ := hcyl L (‖x‖⁻¹ • x) he hLmin hconeL htre h1L h0L
    have hflat := hsq (fun k => {w : E3 | x + r k • w ∈ K}) L
      {w : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w < 0} (hconv 1 one_pos) hLν
    obtain ⟨a, u, ρ, δ, hρ, hδ, hu, hu0, hside⟩ := sepFlat_to_graph K x ν r hmin
      (fun N hN => (hxb N hN).2) (fun N hN => (hxb N hN).1) hν hr hr0 hflat
    exact sepCone_local_plane K x hmin hdilK a u ρ δ hρ hδ hu hu0 hside
  
  exact sepGlobal_planes K h1 h0 hloc

    have hdisj : Disjoint U₁ U₀ := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      rintro x ⟨N₁, hN₁, h1⟩ ⟨N₀, hN₀, h0⟩
      have hM : N₀ ∩ N₁ ∈ 𝓝 x := Filter.inter_mem hN₀ hN₁
      have hpos : 0 < volume (N₀ ∩ N₁) := Measure.measure_pos_of_mem_nhds volume hM
      have hle : volume (N₀ ∩ N₁) ≤ volume ((N₀ ∩ N₁) ∩ F) + volume ((N₀ ∩ N₁) \ F) :=
        measure_le_inter_add_diff _ _ _
      have h0' : volume ((N₀ ∩ N₁) ∩ F) = 0 :=
        measure_mono_null (fun y (hy : y ∈ (N₀ ∩ N₁) ∩ F) => (⟨hy.1.1, hy.2⟩ : y ∈ N₀ ∩ F)) h0
      have h1' : volume ((N₀ ∩ N₁) \ F) = 0 :=
        measure_mono_null (fun y (hy : y ∈ (N₀ ∩ N₁) \ F) => (⟨hy.1.2, hy.2⟩ : y ∈ N₁ \ F)) h1
      rw [h0', h1', add_zero] at hle
      exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle) (lt_irrefl 0)
    have hcov : S ⊆ U₁ ∪ U₀ := by
      intro z hz
      have h := hnb z hz
      push_neg at h
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hN'⟩ := h
      by_cases h0 : volume (N ∩ F) = 0
      · exact Or.inr ⟨N, hN, h0⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨N, hN, hN' h0⟩
    have hloc : ∀ s : Set E3, (∀ x ∈ s, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (s ∩ N) = 0) → volume s = 0 := by
      intro s hs
      refine measure_null_of_locally_null s (fun x hx => ?_)
      obtain ⟨N, hN, h0⟩ := hs x hx
      exact ⟨s ∩ N, inter_mem_nhdsWithin s hN, h0⟩
    by_cases hne : (S ∩ U₁).Nonempty
    · right
      have hSU : S ⊆ U₁ := hS.subset_left_of_subset_union hU₁o hU₀o hdisj hcov hne
      apply hloc
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨N, hN, h0⟩ := hSU hx.1
      exact ⟨N, hN, measure_mono_null
        (fun y (hy : y ∈ (S \ F) ∩ N) => (⟨hy.2, hy.1.2⟩ : y ∈ N \ F)) h0⟩
    · left
      apply hloc
      intro x hx
      have hx0 : x ∈ U₀ := by
        rcases hcov hx.1 with h | h
        · exact absurd ⟨x, hx.1, h⟩ hne
        · exact h
      obtain ⟨N, hN, h0⟩ := hx0
      exact ⟨N, hN, measure_mono_null
        (fun y (hy : y ∈ (S ∩ F) ∩ N) => (⟨hy.2, hy.1.2⟩ : y ∈ N ∩ F)) h0⟩
  
  have hvolB : ∀ c : E3, ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 4096) < volume (Metric.ball c (1 / 8)) := by
    intro c
    rw [EuclideanSpace.volume_ball_fin_three, ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by norm_num),
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
  have hvn : ‖(1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν‖ = 1 / 4 := by
    rw [norm_smul, hν, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  have hvi : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν) = 1 / 4 := by
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hν]; norm_num
  have hcapm : Metric.ball (-((1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν)) (1 / 8) ⊆
      Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ} := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : ‖w + (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν‖ < 1 / 8 := by
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, sub_neg_eq_add] at hw
    have hi : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (w + (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν) ≤ ‖w + (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν‖ := by
      have := real_inner_le_norm ν (w + (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν)
      rwa [hν, one_mul] at this
    rw [inner_add_right, hvi] at hi
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
      have := norm_sub_le (w + (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν) ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν)
      rw [add_sub_cancel_right] at this
      linarith
    · show @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w < -τ
      linarith
  have hcapp : Metric.ball ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν) (1 / 8) ⊆
      Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : ‖w - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν‖ < 1 / 8 := by
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw
    have hi : |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (w - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν)| ≤ ‖w - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν‖ := by
      have := abs_real_inner_le_norm ν (w - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν)
      rwa [hν, one_mul] at this
    rw [inner_sub_right, hvi] at hi
    have hi2 := (abs_le.mp hi).1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
      have := norm_add_le (w - (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν) ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • ν)
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at this
      linarith
    · show τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w
      linarith
  have hP0 : ENNReal.ofReal (c₀ * τ ^ 3) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 4096) := by
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    have h1 : τ ^ 3 ≤ (1 / 16) ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hτ.le hτ16 3
    have h2 : 0 ≤ τ ^ 3 := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hlin : IsLinearMap ℝ (fun z : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z) :=
    IsLinearMap.mk (fun x y => inner_add_right ν x y) (fun c x => real_inner_smul_right ν x c)
  refine ⟨ha, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hconv : Convex ℝ (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ}) :=
      (convex_ball _ _).inter (convex_halfSpace_lt hlin _)
    have hnb : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ},
        ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) := by
      intro z hz hb
      have h1 := (abs_le.mp (ha z hz.1 hb)).1
      have h2 : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ := hz.2
      linarith
    rcases hdich _ hconv.isPreconnected hnb with h | h
    · exfalso
      have hsub : (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ}) \ F ⊆
          symmDiff F {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0} ∩ Metric.ball 0 1 := by
        rintro z ⟨hz, hzF⟩
        refine ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨?_, hzF⟩), ?_⟩
        · show @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0
          have : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ := hz.2
          linarith
        · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
          have := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz.1
          linarith
      have hle := measure_le_inter_add_diff volume
        (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ}) F
      rw [h, zero_add] at hle
      have hA := (hvolB _).trans_le (measure_mono hcapm)
      exact lt_irrefl _ (((hA.trans_le hle).trans_le (measure_mono hsub)).trans
        (hL1.trans_le hP0))
    · exact h
  · 
    have hconv : Convex ℝ (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z}) :=
      (convex_ball _ _).inter (convex_halfSpace_gt hlin _)
    have hnb : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z},
        ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) := by
      intro z hz hb
      have h1 := (abs_le.mp (ha z hz.1 hb)).2
      have h2 : τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z := hz.2
      linarith
    rcases hdich _ hconv.isPreconnected hnb with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      have hsub : (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z}) ∩ F ⊆
          symmDiff F {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0} ∩ Metric.ball 0 1 := by
        rintro z ⟨hz, hzF⟩
        refine ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hzF, ?_⟩), ?_⟩
        · show ¬ (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0)
          have : τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z := hz.2
          linarith
        · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
          have := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz.1
          linarith
      have hle := measure_le_inter_add_diff volume
        (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z}) F
      rw [h, add_zero] at hle
      have hA := (hvolB _).trans_le (measure_mono hcapp)
      exact lt_irrefl _ (((hA.trans_le hle).trans_le (measure_mono hsub)).trans
        (hL1.trans_le hP0))

informal_problem.statement: ∃ η₀ ε₀ θ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < η₀ ∧ 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (x ν : E3) (ρ τ : ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) → (∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) → (∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) → sepIsPerMin G F U → 0 < ρ → Metric.closedBall x ρ ⊆ U → (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x ρ, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η₀ ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) y‖ * ρ ≤ η₀ * τ) → 0 < τ → τ ≤ ε₀ → ‖ν‖ = 1 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x ρ, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z - x)| ≤ τ * ρ) → volume ((Metric.ball x ρ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z - x) < -(τ * ρ)}) \ F) = 0 → volume (Metric.ball x ρ ∩ {z | τ * ρ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0 → ∃ ν' : E3, ‖ν'‖ = 1 ∧ ‖ν' - ν‖ ≤ C₀ * τ ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x (θ * ρ), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν' (z - x)| ≤ (τ / 2) * (θ * ρ)) ∧ volume ((Metric.ball x (θ * ρ) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' (z - x) < -((τ / 2) * (θ * ρ))}) \ F) = 0 ∧ volume (Metric.ball x (θ * ρ) ∩ {z | (τ / 2) * (θ * ρ) < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0

signature.statement: ∃ η₀ ε₀ θ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < η₀ ∧ 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (x ν : E3) (ρ τ : ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) → (∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) → (∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) → sepIsPerMin G F U → 0 < ρ → Metric.closedBall x ρ ⊆ U → (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x ρ, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η₀ ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) y‖ * ρ ≤ η₀ * τ) → 0 < τ → τ ≤ ε₀ → ‖ν‖ = 1 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x ρ, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z - x)| ≤ τ * ρ) → volume ((Metric.ball x ρ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z - x) < -(τ * ρ)}) \ F) = 0 → volume (Metric.ball x ρ ∩ {z | τ * ρ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0 → ∃ ν' : E3, ‖ν'‖ = 1 ∧ ‖ν' - ν‖ ≤ C₀ * τ ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x (θ * ρ), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν' (z - x)| ≤ (τ / 2) * (θ * ρ)) ∧ volume ((Metric.ball x (θ * ρ) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' (z - x) < -((τ / 2) * (θ * ρ))}) \ F) = 0 ∧ volume (Metric.ball x (θ * ρ) ∩ {z | (τ / 2) * (θ * ρ) < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨δH, cH, hδH, hcH, hcH1, hHarn⟩ := sepPerMin_partial_harnack
  let T : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun A μ => if h : 0 < A ∧ 0 < μ then
    Classical.choose (quadSurface_meanCurv_approx A μ h.1 h.2) else 1
  have hTpos : ∀ A μ : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 < μ → 0 < T A μ := by
    intro A μ hA hμ
    have h : 0 < A ∧ 0 < μ := ⟨hA, hμ⟩
    show 0 < (if h : 0 < A ∧ 0 < μ then
      Classical.choose (quadSurface_meanCurv_approx A μ h.1 h.2) else 1)
    rw [dif_pos h]
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (quadSurface_meanCurv_approx A μ h.1 h.2)).1
  obtain ⟨ε₀, η₀', θ, C₀, hε₀, hη₀', hθ, hθ2, hC₀, hS5⟩ :=
    flatSlab_viscosity_improve δH cH T hδH hcH hcH1 hTpos
  refine ⟨min η₀' δH, ε₀, θ, C₀, lt_min hη₀' hδH, hε₀, hθ, hθ2, hC₀, ?_⟩
  intro G F U x ν ρ τ hU hG hsymm hpd hmin hρ hcb hmet hτ hτε hν hx hslab hside1 hside2
  have hη₀pos : 0 < min η₀' δH := lt_min hη₀' hδH
  have hη₀δ : min η₀' δH ≤ δH := min_le_right _ _
  have hη₀η : min η₀' δH ≤ η₀' := min_le_left _ _
  have hρ0 : ρ ≠ 0 := hρ.ne'
  
  have hnull : ∀ (a : E3) (c : ℝ), c ≠ 0 → ∀ S : Set E3, volume S = 0 →
      volume ((fun z : E3 => a + c • z) ⁻¹' S) = 0 := by
    intro a c hc S hS
    have e : (fun z : E3 => a + c • z) ⁻¹' S =
        (fun z : E3 => c • z) ⁻¹' ((fun v : E3 => a + v) ⁻¹' S) := rfl
    rw [e, MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_preimage_smul volume hc, measure_preimage_add, hS,
      mul_zero]
  have hψform : (fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) = fun w : E3 => (-(ρ⁻¹ • x)) + ρ⁻¹ • w := by
    funext w
    rw [smul_sub]
    abel
  have hnullφ : ∀ S : Set E3, volume S = 0 → volume ((fun z : E3 => x + ρ • z) ⁻¹' S) = 0 :=
    hnull x ρ hρ0
  have hnullψ : ∀ S : Set E3, volume S = 0 →
      volume ((fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' S) = 0 := by
    intro S hS
    rw [hψform]
    exact hnull _ _ (inv_ne_zero hρ0) S hS
  have hφψ : ∀ w : E3, x + ρ • (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) = w := by
    intro w
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hρ0, one_smul]
    abel
  have hψφ : ∀ z : E3, ρ⁻¹ • ((x + ρ • z) - x) = z := by
    intro z
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ0, one_smul]
  have hφcont : Continuous (fun z : E3 => x + ρ • z) := by fun_prop
  have hψcont : Continuous (fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) := by fun_prop
  have hinφ : ∀ v z : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ v ((x + ρ • z) - x) = ρ * @inner ℝ E3 _ v z := by
    intro v z
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, real_inner_smul_right]
  have hinψ : ∀ v w : E3,
      @inner ℝ E3 _ v (w - x) = ρ * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) := by
    intro v w
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hρ0, one_mul]
  have hinw : ∀ v w : E3,
      @inner ℝ E3 _ v w = @inner ℝ E3 _ v x + ρ * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) := by
    intro v w
    rw [← hinψ, inner_sub_right]
    ring
  have hnφ : ∀ z y : E3, ‖(x + ρ • z) - (x + ρ • y)‖ = ρ * ‖z - y‖ := by
    intro z y
    rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ.le]
  have hnφ0 : ∀ z : E3, ‖(x + ρ • z) - x‖ = ρ * ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ.le]
  have hwx : ∀ w : E3, ‖w - x‖ = ρ * ‖ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)‖ := by
    intro w
    have e := hnφ0 (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x))
    rwa [hφψ] at e
  have hwy : ∀ w y : E3, ‖w - (x + ρ • y)‖ = ρ * ‖ρ⁻¹ • (w - x) - y‖ := by
    intro w y
    have e := hnφ (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) y
    rwa [hφψ] at e
  set F' : Set E3 := {z : E3 | x + ρ • z ∈ F} with hF'
  have hB1 : ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (x + ρ • z), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F') ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F') ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz N hN
    have hN' : (fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' N ∈ 𝓝 (x + ρ • z) := by
      apply hψcont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
      rw [hψφ]
      exact hN
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hz _ hN'
    have e1 : (fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' N ∩ F =
        (fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' (N ∩ F') := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, hF', Set.mem_setOf_eq, hφψ]
    have e2 : (fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' N \ F =
        (fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' (N \ F') := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_preimage, hF', Set.mem_setOf_eq, hφψ]
    refine ⟨fun h => h1 ?_, fun h => h2 ?_⟩
    · rw [e1]
      exact hnullψ _ h
    · rw [e2]
      exact hnullψ _ h
  have hB2 : ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F') ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F') ≠ 0) →
      ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (x + ρ • z), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz N hN
    have hN' : (fun z : E3 => x + ρ • z) ⁻¹' N ∈ 𝓝 z := hφcont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hN
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hz _ hN'
    have e1 : (fun z : E3 => x + ρ • z) ⁻¹' N ∩ F' = (fun z : E3 => x + ρ • z) ⁻¹' (N ∩ F) := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, hF', Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have e2 : (fun z : E3 => x + ρ • z) ⁻¹' N \ F' = (fun z : E3 => x + ρ • z) ⁻¹' (N \ F) := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_preimage, hF', Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    refine ⟨fun h => h1 ?_, fun h => h2 ?_⟩
    · rw [e1]
      exact hnullφ _ h
    · rw [e2]
      exact hnullφ _ h
  have hB1' : ∀ w : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)), volume (N ∩ F') ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F') ≠ 0 := by
    intro w hw
    apply hB1
    rw [hφψ]
    exact hw
  have hnotF : ∀ w : E3, w ∉ F → ρ⁻¹ • (w - x) ∉ F' := by
    intro w hw h
    apply hw
    have h' : x + ρ • (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ∈ F := h
    rwa [hφψ] at h'
  have hinF : ∀ w : E3, w ∈ F → ρ⁻¹ • (w - x) ∈ F' := by
    intro w hw
    show x + ρ • (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ∈ F
    rw [hφψ]
    exact hw
  
  have h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3), volume (N ∩ F') ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F') ≠ 0 := by
    apply hB1
    rw [smul_zero, add_zero]
    exact hx
  have hball1 : ∀ z : E3, z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 → x + ρ • z ∈ Metric.ball x ρ := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hnφ0]
    nlinarith
  have hslab' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F') ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F') ≠ 0) →

    have h1 := hslab _ (hball1 z hz) (hB2 z hzb)

    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) hρ
  have hs1' : volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ}) \ F') = 0 := by

    rintro z ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz3⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hball1 z hz1, ?_⟩, hz3⟩

  have hs2' : volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F') = 0 := by
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (hnullφ _ hside2)
    rintro z ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz3⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hball1 z hz1, ?_⟩, hz3⟩
    show τ * ρ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν ((x + ρ • z) - x)
    have hz2' : τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z := hz2
    rw [hinφ]
    nlinarith
  have hHarn' : ∀ (y : E3) (r a b : ℝ),
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ F') ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F') ≠ 0) →
      0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 → a ≤ b → b - a ≤ δH * r →
      min η₀' δH * τ * r ^ 2 ≤ δH * (b - a) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y r, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F') ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F') ≠ 0) →
         a ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ b) →
      volume ((Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < a}) \ F') = 0 →
      volume (Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | b < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F') = 0 →
      ∃ a' b' : ℝ, a ≤ a' ∧ a' ≤ b' ∧ b' ≤ b ∧ b' - a' ≤ (1 - cH) * (b - a) ∧

      rw [hwy] at hw

    have hψmemC : ∀ w : E3, ‖w - (x + ρ • y)‖ ≤ ρ * r →
        ρ⁻¹ • (w - x) ∈ Metric.closedBall y r := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      rw [hwy] at hw
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hw hρ
    have hinB : ∀ w : E3, ‖w - (x + ρ • y)‖ ≤ ρ * r → w ∈ Metric.ball x ρ := by

      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at h1

      nlinarith
    have hcbY : Metric.closedBall (x + ρ • y) (ρ * r) ⊆ U := by
      intro w hw
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw
      exact hcb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hinB w hw))
    have hmetY : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (x + ρ • y) (ρ * r), ∀ i j : Fin 3,

        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w i j) z‖ * (ρ * r) ^ 2 ≤
          δH * ((ρ * b + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x) - (ρ * a + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x)) := by
      intro z hz i j
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
      obtain ⟨hm1, hm2⟩ := hmet z (hinB z hz.le) i j
      refine ⟨hm1.trans hη₀δ, ?_⟩
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w i j) z‖ * (ρ * r) ^ 2
          = (‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w i j) z‖ * ρ) * (ρ * r ^ 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ (min η₀' δH * τ) * (ρ * r ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm2 (by positivity)
        _ = ρ * (min η₀' δH * τ * r ^ 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ ρ * (δH * (b - a)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hguard hρ.le
        _ = δH * ((ρ * b + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x) - (ρ * a + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x)) := by ring
    have hslY : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (x + ρ • y) (ρ * r),
        (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
        ρ * a + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧
          @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ ρ * b + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x := by
      intro w hw hwb
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw
      obtain ⟨k1, k2⟩ := hsl _ (hψmemS w hw) (hB1' w hwb)
      rw [hinw ν w]
      have k1' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k1 hρ.le
      have k2' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 hρ.le
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hsdY1 : volume ((Metric.ball (x + ρ • y) (ρ * r) ∩
        {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < ρ * a + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x}) \ F) = 0 := by
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ (hnullψ _ hsd1)
      rintro w ⟨⟨hw1, hw2⟩, hw3⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw1
      refine ⟨⟨hψmemS w hw1, ?_⟩, hnotF w hw3⟩
      show @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) < a
      have hw2' : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w < ρ * a + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x := hw2
      rw [hinw ν w] at hw2'
      exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (by linarith) hρ.le
    have hsdY2 : volume (Metric.ball (x + ρ • y) (ρ * r) ∩
        {z | ρ * b + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 := by
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ (hnullψ _ hsd2)
      rintro w ⟨⟨hw1, hw2⟩, hw3⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw1
      refine ⟨⟨hψmemS w hw1, ?_⟩, hinF w hw3⟩
      show b < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x))
      have hw2' : ρ * b + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w := hw2
      rw [hinw ν w] at hw2'
      exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (by linarith) hρ.le
    obtain ⟨a'', b'', h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hHarn G F U (x + ρ • y) ν (ρ * r)
      (ρ * a + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x) (ρ * b + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x) hU hG hsymm hpd hmin
      (mul_pos hρ hr) hcbY hν (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith) hmetY hY hslY hsdY1 hsdY2
    refine ⟨(a'' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x) / ρ, (b'' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x) / ρ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [le_div_iff₀ hρ]
      linarith
    · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hρ.le
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hρ]
      linarith
    · rw [← sub_div, div_le_iff₀ hρ]
      linarith
    · intro z hz hzb
      have hw : x + ρ • z ∈ Metric.ball (x + ρ • y) (ρ * r / 8) := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hnφ]
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
        nlinarith
      obtain ⟨k1, k2⟩ := h5 _ hw (hB2 z hzb)
      have e : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x + ρ • z) = @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x + ρ * @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z := by
        rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right]
      rw [e] at k1 k2
      constructor
      · rw [div_le_iff₀ hρ]
        linarith
      · rw [le_div_iff₀ hρ]
        linarith
  have hTouch' : ∀ A μ : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 < μ → τ ≤ T A μ → min η₀' δH ≤ T A μ →
      ∀ (b z₀ : E3) (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : ℝ) (N : Set E3),
      @inner ℝ E3 _ b ν = 0 → (∀ i j, M i j = M j i) → (∀ i, ∑ j, M i j * ν j = 0) →
      ‖b‖ ≤ A → (∀ i j, |M i j| ≤ A) → z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) →
      (∀ N' ∈ 𝓝 z₀, volume (N' ∩ F') ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N' \ F') ≠ 0) →
      @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z₀ = τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z₀ + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z₀ i * z₀ j + c) →
      N ∈ 𝓝 z₀ →
      (μ ≤ ∑ i, M i i → volume ((N ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z <
          τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z i * z j + c)}) \ F') ≠ 0) ∧
      (∑ i, M i i ≤ -μ → volume (N ∩ {z | τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z i * z j + c) < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F') ≠ 0) := by
    intro A μ hA hμ hτT hηT b z₀ M c N hbν hMs hMν hbA hMA hz₀ hz₀b hz₀eq hN
    have hAμ : 0 < A ∧ 0 < μ := ⟨hA, hμ⟩
    have hTeq : T A μ = Classical.choose (quadSurface_meanCurv_approx A μ hA hμ) := dif_pos hAμ
    have hspec := (Classical.choose_spec (quadSurface_meanCurv_approx A μ hA hμ)).2
    rw [hTeq] at hτT hηT
    have hsm2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) := by fun_prop
    have hsm1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (y - x)) :=
      contDiff_const.inner ℝ (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
    have hsm1' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x))) :=
      contDiff_const.inner ℝ hsm2
    have hsm3 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) i) := fun i =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hsm2
    have hfsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (y - x) -
        τ * ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) j + c)) :=
      hsm1.sub (contDiff_const.mul ((hsm1'.add (ContDiff.sum fun i _ => ContDiff.sum fun j _ =>
        (contDiff_const.mul (hsm3 i)).mul (hsm3 j))).add contDiff_const))
    have hfψ : ∀ w : E3, (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (w - x) -
        τ * ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) j + c)) =
        ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) - τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) j + c)) := by
      intro w
      rw [hinψ ν w]
      ring
    have hWo : IsOpen ((fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' (interior N ∩ Metric.ball 0 1)) :=
      (isOpen_interior.inter Metric.isOpen_ball).preimage hψcont
    have hw₀W : x + ρ • z₀ ∈
        (fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' (interior N ∩ Metric.ball 0 1) := by
      show ρ⁻¹ • ((x + ρ • z₀) - x) ∈ interior N ∩ Metric.ball 0 1
      rw [hψφ]
      refine ⟨mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hN, ?_⟩
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hz₀ ⊢
      linarith
    have hWball : ∀ w ∈ (fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' (interior N ∩ Metric.ball 0 1),

      intro w hw
      have h1 : ρ⁻¹ • (w - x) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 := hw.2
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at h1
      rw [hwx]

    have hWU : (fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' (interior N ∩ Metric.ball 0 1) ⊆ U :=
      fun w hw => hcb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
        (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; exact hWball w hw))
    have hf0 : (fun y : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (y - x) -
        τ * ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) j + c)) (x + ρ • z₀) = 0 := by
      show (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν ((x + ρ • z₀) - x) -
        τ * ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • ((x + ρ • z₀) - x)) +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • ((x + ρ • z₀) - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • ((x + ρ • z₀) - x)) j + c))
        = 0
      rw [hfψ, hψφ, hz₀eq]
      ring
    have hest : ∀ w ∈ (fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' (interior N ∩ Metric.ball 0 1),
        |ρ * levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (y - x) -
          τ * ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) +
            ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) j + c)) w +
          2 * τ * ∑ i, M i i| ≤ μ * τ := by
      intro w hw
      have hwb : w ∈ Metric.ball x ρ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        exact hWball w hw
      exact hspec G ν b x w M ρ τ c hν hρ hτ hτT hMs hMν hbA hMA (hWball w hw).le
        (fun i j => ⟨((hmet w hwb i j).1).trans hηT,
          ((hmet w hwb i j).2).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hηT hτ.le)⟩)
    obtain ⟨hT1, hT2⟩ := sepPerMin_touch_principle G F U
      ((fun w : E3 => ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) ⁻¹' (interior N ∩ Metric.ball 0 1))
      (fun y : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (y - x) -
        τ * ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) j + c))
      (x + ρ • z₀) hU hG hsymm hpd hmin hWo hWU hfsm hw₀W hf0 (hB2 z₀ hz₀b)
    constructor
    · intro htr hvol
      apply hT1
      · intro w hw
        have h := (abs_le.1 (hest w hw)).2
        have hτtr : μ * τ ≤ τ * ∑ i, M i i := by nlinarith
        have h' : ρ * levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (y - x) -
            τ * ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) +
              ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) j + c)) w < 0 := by
          nlinarith
        exact neg_of_mul_neg_right h' hρ.le
      · refine measure_mono_null ?_ (hnullψ _ hvol)
        rintro w ⟨⟨hw1, hw2⟩, hw3⟩
        refine ⟨⟨interior_subset hw1.1, ?_⟩, hnotF w hw3⟩
        have hw2' : (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (w - x) -
            τ * ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) +
              ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) j + c)) < 0 := hw2
        rw [hfψ] at hw2'
        have hneg := neg_of_mul_neg_right hw2' hρ.le
        show @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) < τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) j + c)
        linarith
    · intro htr hvol
      apply hT2
      · intro w hw
        have h := (abs_le.1 (hest w hw)).1
        have hτtr : τ * ∑ i, M i i ≤ -(μ * τ) := by nlinarith
        have h' : 0 < ρ * levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (y - x) -
            τ * ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) +
              ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - x)) j + c)) w := by
          nlinarith
        exact pos_of_mul_pos_right h' hρ.le
      · refine measure_mono_null ?_ (hnullψ _ hvol)
        rintro w ⟨⟨hw1, hw2⟩, hw3⟩
        refine ⟨⟨interior_subset hw1.1, ?_⟩, hinF w hw3⟩
        have hw2' : 0 < (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (w - x) -
            τ * ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) +
              ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) j + c)) := hw2
        rw [hfψ] at hw2'
        have hpos := pos_of_mul_pos_right hw2' hρ.le
        show τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x)) j + c) <
          @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x))
        linarith
  obtain ⟨ν', hν'1, hν'ν, hsl', hsd1', hsd2'⟩ := hS5 F' ν τ (min η₀' δH) hτ hτε hη₀pos.le hη₀η
    hν h0 hslab' hs1' hs2' hHarn' hTouch'
  have hballθ : ∀ w : E3, w ∈ Metric.ball x (θ * ρ) →
      ρ⁻¹ • (w - x) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ := by
    intro w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hwx] at hw
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (by linarith) hρ.le
  refine ⟨ν', hν'1, hν'ν, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w hw hwb
    have h1 := hsl' _ (hballθ w hw) (hB1' w hwb)
    rw [hinψ ν' w, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hρ]
    calc ρ * |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν' (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x))| ≤ ρ * ((τ / 2) * θ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hρ.le

  · refine measure_mono_null ?_ (hnullψ _ hsd1')
    rintro w ⟨⟨hw1, hw2⟩, hw3⟩

    rw [hinψ ν' w] at hw2'
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (by linarith) hρ.le
  · refine measure_mono_null ?_ (hnullψ _ hsd2')
    rintro w ⟨⟨hw1, hw2⟩, hw3⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hballθ w hw1, ?_⟩, hinF w hw3⟩
    show (τ / 2) * θ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' (ρ⁻¹ • (w - x))
    have hw2' : (τ / 2) * (θ * ρ) < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' (w - x) := hw2
    rw [hinψ ν' w] at hw2'
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left (by linarith) hρ.le

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerMin_touch_principle
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U W : Set E3)
    (f : E3 → ℝ) (z₀ : E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) (hW : IsOpen W) (hWU : W ⊆ U) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ W) (hf0 : f z₀ = 0)
    (hbd : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z₀, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) :
    ((∀ z ∈ W, levelMeanCurvCoord G f z < 0) →
        volume ((W ∩ {z | f z < 0}) \ F) = 0 → False) ∧
    ((∀ z ∈ W, 0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G f z) →
        volume (W ∩ {z | 0 < f z} ∩ F) = 0 → False)

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerMin_partial_harnack
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ δH cH : ℝ, 0 < δH ∧ 0 < cH ∧ cH < 1 ∧
