      calc ‖x' - x‖ ≤ ‖x'‖ + ‖x‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ < ρ₀ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := hscale ‖x' - x‖ hDpos hDlt
    obtain ⟨m, -, hmν, hsl, -, -⟩ := hdec x hx hxb k
    have hx'ball : x' ∈ Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; exact hk2
    have h1 := hsl x' hx'ball hx'b
    have hhk : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have hθk : 0 < ρ₀ * θ ^ k := by positivity
    have h2 : (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ≤ ‖x' - x‖ / 16 := by
      have e : ρ₀ * θ ^ (k + 1) = θ * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) := by ring
      rw [e] at hk1
      have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτθ hθk.le
      have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_of_le_one_right hτ₀.le hhk) hθk.le
      linarith
    have h5 : |@inner ℝ E3 _ (ν - m) (x' - x)| ≤ ‖x' - x‖ / 8 := by
      calc |@inner ℝ E3 _ (ν - m) (x' - x)| ≤ ‖ν - m‖ * ‖x' - x‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ ≤ (1 / 8) * ‖x' - x‖ := by
            rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmν (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖x' - x‖ / 8 := by ring
    have h6 : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x) =
        @inner ℝ E3 _ m (x' - x) + @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν - m) (x' - x) := by
      rw [inner_sub_left]; ring
    have ha : |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x)| ≤ 3 * ‖x' - x‖ / 16 := by
      rw [h6]
      calc |@inner ℝ E3 _ m (x' - x) + @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν - m) (x' - x)|
          ≤ |@inner ℝ E3 _ m (x' - x)| + |@inner ℝ E3 _ (ν - m) (x' - x)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 3 * ‖x' - x‖ / 16 := by linarith
    have hP := norm_sub_sq_real (x' - x) (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x) • ν)
    have h7 : @inner ℝ E3 _ (x' - x) (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x) • ν) =
        (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm ν (x' - x)]; ring
    have h8 : ‖@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x) • ν‖ = |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x)| := by
      rw [norm_smul, hν, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [h7, h8, sq_abs] at hP
    have h9 : |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x)| ^ 2 ≤ (3 * ‖x' - x‖ / 16) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) ha 2
    rw [sq_abs] at h9
    have h10 : (4 * |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x)|) ^ 2 ≤
        ‖(x' - x) - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x) • ν‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, sq_abs]; nlinarith
    have h11 : 4 * |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x)| ≤ ‖(x' - x) - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x) • ν‖ := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg ((x' - x) - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x) • ν),
        abs_nonneg (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x))]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : Set E3, W = {z : E3 | ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8} :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hWmem : ∀ z : E3, z ∈ W ↔ ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 := by
    intro z; rw [hWdef]; rfl
  have hWo : IsOpen W := by
    rw [hWdef]
    exact isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hPle : ∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    have h1 := norm_sub_sq_real z (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν)
    have h3 : @inner ℝ E3 _ z ν = @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z := real_inner_comm ν z
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul, hν, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, h3] at h1
    have h2 : ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z)]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg z, norm_nonneg (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν)]
  have hballW : Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ₀ / 8) ⊆ W := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hWmem]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hPle z) (mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hz)
  
  obtain ⟨U, hUgr, hULip, hUside⟩ :=
    sepSlab_graph_function F ν ρ₀ hν hρ₀ hAB hconnB hconnA hlip hcaps
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := sepSlab_normal_limit F ν θ τ₀ ρ₀ hν hθ hθ2 hτ₀ hτθ hρ₀ hdec
  have hK : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 * τ₀ / θ := by positivity
  
  have hcont : ∀ x x' : E3, ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ‖x'‖ < ρ₀ / 2 →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x', volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ∀ k : ℕ,
      ‖x - x'‖ < ρ₀ * θ ^ k / 2 → ‖n x - n x'‖ ≤ 8 * (5 * τ₀ / θ) * (1 / 2) ^ k := by
    intro x x' hx hxb hx' hx'b k hxx'
    obtain ⟨hn1, -, hnk⟩ := hn x hx hxb
    obtain ⟨hn1', -, hnk'⟩ := hn x' hx' hx'b
    obtain ⟨hsl, hbel, -⟩ := hnk k
    obtain ⟨-, -, habo'⟩ := hnk' k
    have hr0 : 0 < ρ₀ * θ ^ k := by positivity
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ 5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) := by positivity
    have hx'x : |@inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (x' - x)| ≤ 5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) :=
      hsl x' (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]; linarith) hx'b
    have hA : volume ((Metric.ball x' (ρ₀ * θ ^ k / 2) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x') <
        -(2 * (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)))}) \ F) = 0 := by
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ hbel
      rintro z ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz3⟩
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hz3⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz1 ⊢
        calc ‖z - x‖ = ‖(z - x') + (x' - x)‖ := by rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
          _ ≤ ‖z - x'‖ + ‖x' - x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ < ρ₀ * θ ^ k := by rw [norm_sub_rev x' x]; linarith
      · have hz2' : @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x') <
            -(2 * (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))) := hz2
        show @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x) < -(5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))
        have e : @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x) =
            @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x') + @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (x' - x) := by
          rw [← inner_add_right, sub_add_sub_cancel]
        rw [e]
        have := (abs_le.1 hx'x).2
        linarith
    have hB : volume (Metric.ball x' (ρ₀ * θ ^ k / 2) ∩ {z | 2 * (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k *
        (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) < @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x') (z - x')} ∩ F) = 0 := by
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ habo'
      rintro z ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz3⟩
      refine ⟨⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hz1, ?_⟩, hz3⟩
      have hz2' : 2 * (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) <
          @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x') (z - x') := hz2
      show 5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) < @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x') (z - x')
      linarith
    have key := sepSlab_halfspace_normal_close F x' (n x) (n x') (ρ₀ * θ ^ k / 2)
      (2 * (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))) hn1 hn1' (by positivity) (by positivity)
      hA hB
    calc ‖n x - n x'‖ ≤ 2 * (2 * (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))) /
          (ρ₀ * θ ^ k / 2) := key
      _ = 8 * (5 * τ₀ / θ) * (1 / 2) ^ k := by
          rw [div_eq_iff (by positivity)]; ring
  
  obtain ⟨hC1, hfd⟩ := sepSlab_graph_C1
    {w : E3 | ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0} ν n U W ρ₀ θ (5 * τ₀ / θ)
    hν hWo hρ₀ hθ hθ2 hK
    (fun z hz => (hUgr z ((hWmem z).1 hz)).2)
    (fun z hz z' hz' => hULip z z' ((hWmem z).1 hz) ((hWmem z').1 hz'))
    (fun z hz => by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hUgr z ((hWmem z).1 hz)
      obtain ⟨hn1, hn2, hn3⟩ := hn _ h1 h2
      refine ⟨hn1, hn2, fun k w hw hwd => ?_⟩
      exact (hn3 k).1 w (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; exact hwd) hw)
    (fun z hz z' hz' k hd => hcont _ _ (hUgr z ((hWmem z).1 hz)).1 (hUgr z ((hWmem z).1 hz)).2
      (hUgr z' ((hWmem z').1 hz')).1 (hUgr z' ((hWmem z').1 hz')).2 k hd)
  have hUν : ∀ z ∈ W, fderiv ℝ U z ν = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hfd z hz ν, hνν, one_smul, sub_self, inner_zero_right, mul_zero]
  
  have hbump : ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ⊆ W → ∃ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 f ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (R / 2), f z = @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z - U z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (R / 2), fderiv ℝ f z ≠ 0) := by
    intro R hR hball
    let χ : ContDiffBump (0 : E3) := ⟨R / 2, 3 * R / 4, by positivity, by linarith⟩
    have hinner : ∀ z : E3, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun w : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w) z :=
      fun z => contDiffAt_const.inner ℝ contDiffAt_id
    have hone : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (R / 2), χ z = 1 := fun z hz =>
      χ.one_of_mem_closedBall (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz)
    refine ⟨fun w => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w - χ w * U w, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro z
      by_cases hz : z ∈ W
      · exact (hinner z).sub (χ.contDiff.contDiffAt.mul (hC1.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hz)))
      · have hzR : R ≤ ‖z‖ := by
          by_contra h
          exact hz (hball (mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (lt_of_not_ge h)))
        have hzt : z ∉ tsupport χ := by
          rw [χ.tsupport_eq, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
          show ¬ ‖z‖ ≤ 3 * R / 4
          exact not_le.2 (by linarith)
        have hev := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hzt
        refine (hinner z).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
        simp [hw]
    · intro z hz
      show @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z - χ z * U z = _
      rw [hone z hz, one_mul]
    · intro z hz
      have hzW : z ∈ W := hball (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hz)
      have hUd : DifferentiableAt ℝ U z :=
        (hC1.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hzW)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
      have hev : (fun w => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w - χ w * U w) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
          (fun w => innerSL ℝ ν w - U w) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
        rw [hone w hw, one_mul, innerSL_apply]
      have hD : HasFDerivAt (fun w => innerSL ℝ ν w - U w) (innerSL ℝ ν - fderiv ℝ U z) z :=
        (innerSL ℝ ν).hasFDerivAt.sub hUd.hasFDerivAt
      rw [(hD.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).fderiv]
      intro h0
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L ν) h0
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, innerSL_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h1
      rw [hνν, hUν z hzW] at h1
      norm_num at h1
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfeq, hfd'⟩ := hbump (ρ₀ / 8) (by positivity) hballW
  
  have hNfacts : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ₀ / 8 / 2),
      ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 ∧ |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z| < ρ₀ / 4 := by
    intro z hz
    have hzn : ‖z‖ < ρ₀ / 8 / 2 := mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hz
    refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (hPle z) (by linarith), ?_⟩
    have := abs_real_inner_le_norm ν z
    rw [hν, one_mul] at this
    linarith
  refine ⟨f, Metric.ball 0 (ρ₀ / 8 / 2), hf, Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ (by positivity), hfd', ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply hnullB
    rintro z ⟨hz, hfz⟩
    obtain ⟨hzW, hin⟩ := hNfacts z hz
    have hfz' : f z < 0 := hfz
    rw [hfeq z hz] at hfz'
    exact (hUside z hzW hin).1 (by linarith)
  · apply hnullA
    rintro z ⟨hz, hfz⟩
    obtain ⟨hzW, hin⟩ := hNfacts z hz
    have hfz' : 0 < f z := hfz
    rw [hfeq z hz] at hfz'
    exact (hUside z hzW hin).2 (by linarith)

subgoal_signatures.name: sepSlab_normal_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement: (F : Set E3) (ν : E3) (θ τ₀ ρ₀ : ℝ) (hν : ‖ν‖ = 1) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ2 : θ ≤ 1 / 2) (hτ₀ : 0 < τ₀) (hτθ : τ₀ ≤ θ / 16) (hρ₀ : 0 < ρ₀) (hdec : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ n : E3, ‖n‖ = 1 ∧ ‖n - ν‖ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ n (z - x)| ≤ (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) ∧ volume ((Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ n (z - x) < -((τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))}) \ F) = 0 ∧ volume (Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) < @inner ℝ E3 _ n (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0) : ∃ n : E3 → E3, ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ‖n x‖ = 1 ∧ ‖n x - ν‖ ≤ 3 / 8 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x)| ≤ (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) ∧ volume ((Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x) < -((5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))}) \ F) = 0 ∧ volume (Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) < @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: sepSlab_halfspace_normal_close
subgoal_signatures.statement: (F : Set E3) (x m m' : E3) (r c : ℝ) (hm : ‖m‖ = 1) (hm' : ‖m'‖ = 1) (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h1 : volume ((Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m (z - x) < -c}) \ F) = 0) (h2 : volume (Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | c < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0) : ‖m - m'‖ ≤ 2 * c / r

subgoal_signatures.name: sepSlab_graph_function
subgoal_signatures.statement: (F : Set E3) (ν : E3) (ρ₀ : ℝ) (hν : ‖ν‖ = 1) (hρ₀ : 0 < ρ₀) (hAB : ∀ z : E3, (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) = 0) → (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ F) = 0) → False) (hconnB : ∀ S : Set E3, IsPreconnected S → (∀ z ∈ S, ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) → ∀ p ∈ S, (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 p, volume (N \ F) = 0) → ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 q, volume (N \ F) = 0) (hconnA : ∀ S : Set E3, IsPreconnected S → (∀ z ∈ S, ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) → ∀ p ∈ S, (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 p, volume (N ∩ F) = 0) → ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 q, volume (N ∩ F) = 0) (hlip : ∀ x x' : E3, ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ‖x'‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x', volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x)| ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖(x' - x) - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x) • ν‖) (hcaps : ∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν - (ρ₀ / 4) • ν), volume (N \ F) = 0) ∧ (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + (ρ₀ / 4) • ν), volume (N ∩ F) = 0)) : ∃ U : E3 → ℝ, (∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 2 ∧ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) ∧ (∀ z z' : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → ‖z' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z' • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → |U z' - U z| ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖z' - z‖) ∧ (∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z| < ρ₀ / 4 → (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < U z → ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ F) = 0) ∧ (U z < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z → ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) = 0))

subgoal_signatures.name: sepSlab_graph_C1
subgoal_signatures.statement: (S : Set E3) (ν : E3) (n : E3 → E3) (U : E3 → ℝ) (W : Set E3) (ρ₀ θ K : ℝ) (hν : ‖ν‖ = 1) (hW : IsOpen W) (hρ₀ : 0 < ρ₀) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ2 : θ ≤ 1 / 2) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hS : ∀ z ∈ W, z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν ∈ S) (hU : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ z' ∈ W, |U z' - U z| ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖z' - z‖) (hn : ∀ z ∈ W, ‖n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν)‖ = 1 ∧ ‖n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν) - ν‖ ≤ 3 / 8 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖w - (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν)‖ < ρ₀ * θ ^ k → |@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν)) (w - (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν))| ≤ (K * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) (hcont : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ z' ∈ W, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν) - (z' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z' • ν + U z' • ν)‖ < ρ₀ * θ ^ k / 2 → ‖n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν) - n (z' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z' • ν + U z' • ν)‖ ≤ 8 * K * (1 / 2) ^ k) : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 U W ∧ ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ U z v = -(@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν)) ν)⁻¹ * @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν)) (v - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν v • ν)

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T T' C Ft At : Set E3) (f ψ d sig : E3 → ℝ) (Yt Xt Zt W₀ W₁ : E3 → E3) (r₁ η : ℝ) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (hη : 0 < η) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ T) (hψ0 : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 ≤ ψ z) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCT : C ⊆ T) (hψC : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∉ C → ψ z = 0) (hT'o : IsOpen T') (hT'T : T' ⊆ T) (hT'f : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ ≤ f z → z ∈ T') (hYt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt T) (hXt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xt T') (hCS : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → |fderiv ℝ f z (Yt z)| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (Xt z)) (hAo : IsOpen At) (hAsub : At ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z}) (hBo : IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} \ At)) (hFm : MeasurableSet Ft) (hFT : Ft ⊆ T) (hsig : ∀ z ∈ T, sig z = ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} \ At).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - At.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) (hW₀o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → W₀ z = 0) (hW₀ : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₀ z i = ψ z * Yt z i) (hW₁o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → W₁ z = 0) (hW₁ : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₁ z i = ψ z * ((1 - calTheta r₁ η (f z)) * Yt z i + sig z * calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i)) (hZt : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, Zt z i = calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i) (hd : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → d z = ψ z * sepDensDiv G Xt z) : IntegrableOn d (symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun z => sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) (symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∧ (∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z) + (∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z)) + ((∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) - ∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z)) ≤ (∫ z in Ft, sepDensDiv G W₁ z) - ∫ z in (Ft \ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∪ At, sepDensDiv G W₀ z

signature.name: ccs_euclid_calib
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T T' C Ft At : Set E3) (f ψ d sig : E3 → ℝ) (Yt Xt Zt W₀ W₁ : E3 → E3) (r₁ η : ℝ) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (hη : 0 < η) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ T) (hψ0 : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 ≤ ψ z) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCT : C ⊆ T) (hψC : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∉ C → ψ z = 0) (hT'o : IsOpen T') (hT'T : T' ⊆ T) (hT'f : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ ≤ f z → z ∈ T') (hYt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt T) (hXt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xt T') (hCS : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → |fderiv ℝ f z (Yt z)| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (Xt z)) (hAo : IsOpen At) (hAsub : At ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z}) (hBo : IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} \ At)) (hFm : MeasurableSet Ft) (hFT : Ft ⊆ T) (hsig : ∀ z ∈ T, sig z = ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} \ At).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - At.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) (hW₀o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → W₀ z = 0) (hW₀ : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₀ z i = ψ z * Yt z i) (hW₁o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → W₁ z = 0) (hW₁ : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₁ z i = ψ z * ((1 - calTheta r₁ η (f z)) * Yt z i + sig z * calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i)) (hZt : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, Zt z i = calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i) (hd : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → d z = ψ z * sepDensDiv G Xt z) : IntegrableOn d (symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun z => sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) (symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∧ (∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z) + (∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z)) + ((∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) - ∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z)) ≤ (∫ z in Ft, sepDensDiv G W₁ z) - ∫ z in (Ft \ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∪ At, sepDensDiv G W₀ z

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨hθs, hθ0, hθ1, hθz, -, -⟩ := ccs_theta_props r₁ η hη
  have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) T := ccs_sqrtdet_smooth G T hG hdet
  have hθT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => calTheta r₁ η (f z)) T := hθs.comp_contDiffOn hf
  have hθ' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => 1 - calTheta r₁ η (f z)) T := contDiffOn_const.sub hθT
  obtain ⟨U', hU'⟩ : ∃ U : Set E3, U = {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hU'] at hAsub hBo hsig
  have hU'o : IsOpen U' := by
    rw [hU']; exact hf.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Ioi
  have hU'T : ∀ z ∈ U', z ∈ T := fun z hz => by rw [hU'] at hz; exact hz.1
  have hU'f : ∀ z ∈ U', r₁ < f z := fun z hz => by rw [hU'] at hz; exact hz.2
  have hU'mk : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → z ∈ U' := fun z hz h => by rw [hU']; exact ⟨hz, h⟩
  obtain ⟨Z', hZ'⟩ : ∃ Z : Set E3, Z = {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ f z < r₁ + η / 2} ∪ Cᶜ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hZ'o : IsOpen Z' := by
    rw [hZ']
    exact (hf.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Iio).union hC.isClosed.isOpen_compl
  have hvan : ∀ z ∈ Z', z ∈ T → ψ z * calTheta r₁ η (f z) = 0 := by
    intro z hz hzT
    rw [hZ'] at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨_, hlt⟩ | hzC
    · rw [hθz (f z) hlt.le, mul_zero]
    · rw [hψC z hzT hzC, zero_mul]
  have hUZ : ∀ z, z ∉ U' → z ∈ Z' := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hZ']
    by_cases hzT : z ∈ T
    · left
      refine ⟨hzT, ?_⟩
      have h1 : ¬ r₁ < f z := fun h => hz (hU'mk z hzT h)
      push_neg at h1
      show f z < r₁ + η / 2
      linarith
    · right
      exact fun hzC => hzT (hCT hzC)
  have hfrZ : ∀ y ∈ frontier At, y ∈ Z' := by
    intro y hy
    apply hUZ
    intro hyU
    have hyA : y ∉ At := by
      rw [hAo.frontier_eq] at hy; exact hy.2
    have hyB : y ∈ U' \ At := ⟨hyU, hyA⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hxB, hxA⟩ := mem_closure_iff.1 (frontier_subset_closure hy) _ hBo hyB
    exact hxB.2 hxA
  have hsigA : ∀ z ∈ At, sig z = -1 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hsig z (hU'T z (hAsub hz)), Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => h.2 hz),
      Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
    norm_num
  have hsigB : ∀ z ∈ U' \ At, sig z = 1 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hsig z (hU'T z hz.1), Set.indicator_of_mem hz, Set.indicator_of_notMem hz.2]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : E3 → ℝ, σ = fun z =>
      (U' \ At).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - At.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσapp : ∀ z, σ z =
      (U' \ At).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - At.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z :=
    fun z => congrFun hσ z
  have hσsig : ∀ z ∈ T, σ z = sig z := fun z hz => by rw [hσapp z, hsig z hz]
  have hσA : ∀ z ∈ At, σ z = -1 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hσapp z, Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => h.2 hz), Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
    norm_num
  have hσB : ∀ z ∈ U' \ At, σ z = 1 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hσapp z, Set.indicator_of_mem hz, Set.indicator_of_notMem hz.2]
    norm_num
  have hσ0 : ∀ z, z ∉ U' → σ z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hσapp z, Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hz h.1),
      Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hz (hAsub h))]
    norm_num
  have hσind : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3),
      σ z * g z = (U' \ At).indicator g z - At.indicator g z := by
    intro g z
    rw [hσapp z]
    by_cases h1 : z ∈ U' \ At
    · have h2 : z ∉ At := h1.2
      simp [Set.indicator_of_mem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem h2]
    · by_cases h2 : z ∈ At
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem h1, Set.indicator_of_mem h2]
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem h2]
  
  obtain ⟨P₁, hP₁⟩ : ∃ P : E3 → E3,
      P = T.indicator (fun z => (ψ z * (1 - calTheta r₁ η (f z))) • Yt z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P₂, hP₂⟩ : ∃ P : E3 → E3,
      P = T.indicator (fun z => (ψ z * calTheta r₁ η (f z)) • Yt z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q', hQ'⟩ : ∃ P : E3 → E3,
      P = T.indicator (fun z => (ψ z * calTheta r₁ η (f z)) • Xt z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hP₁T : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, P₁ z i = ψ z * (1 - calTheta r₁ η (f z)) * Yt z i := by
    intro z hz i; rw [hP₁, Set.indicator_of_mem hz]; simp
  have hP₂T : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, P₂ z i = ψ z * calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Yt z i := by
    intro z hz i; rw [hP₂, Set.indicator_of_mem hz]; simp
  have hQ'T : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, Q' z i = ψ z * calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i := by
    intro z hz i; rw [hQ', Set.indicator_of_mem hz]; simp
  have hP₁o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → P₁ z = 0 := fun z hz => by rw [hP₁, Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
  have hP₂o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → P₂ z = 0 := fun z hz => by rw [hP₂, Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
  have hQ'o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → Q' z = 0 := fun z hz => by rw [hQ', Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
  have hP₁C : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∉ C → P₁ z = 0 := fun z hz hzC => by
    rw [hP₁, Set.indicator_of_mem hz, hψC z hz hzC, zero_mul, zero_smul]
  have hP₂C : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∉ C → P₂ z = 0 := fun z hz hzC => by
    rw [hP₂, Set.indicator_of_mem hz, hψC z hz hzC, zero_mul, zero_smul]
  have hQ'C : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∉ C → Q' z = 0 := fun z hz hzC => by
    rw [hQ', Set.indicator_of_mem hz, hψC z hz hzC, zero_mul, zero_smul]
  have hP₂Z : ∀ z ∈ Z', P₂ z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    by_cases hzT : z ∈ T
    · rw [hP₂, Set.indicator_of_mem hzT, hvan z hz hzT, zero_smul]
    · exact hP₂o z hzT
  have hQ'Z : ∀ z ∈ Z', Q' z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    by_cases hzT : z ∈ T
    · rw [hQ', Set.indicator_of_mem hzT, hvan z hz hzT, zero_smul]
    · exact hQ'o z hzT
  have hYi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Yt z i) T := fun i => (contDiffOn_piLp 2).1 hYt i
  have hθX := ccs_thetaX_smooth T T' f Xt r₁ η hT hf hη hT'o hT'f hXt
  have hP₁s : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => P₁ z i) T := fun i =>
    ((hψ.mul hθ').mul (hYi i)).congr (fun z hz => hP₁T z hz i)
  have hP₂s : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => P₂ z i) T := fun i =>
    ((hψ.mul hθT).mul (hYi i)).congr (fun z hz => hP₂T z hz i)
  have hQ's : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Q' z i) T := fun i =>
    (hψ.mul (hθX i)).congr (fun z hz => by rw [hQ'T z hz i]; ring)
  obtain ⟨hP₁r, hP₁i⟩ := ccs_field_regular G T C P₁ hT hG hdet hC hCT hP₁o hP₁C hP₁s
  obtain ⟨hP₂r, hP₂i⟩ := ccs_field_regular G T C P₂ hT hG hdet hC hCT hP₂o hP₂C hP₂s
  obtain ⟨hQ'r, hQ'i⟩ := ccs_field_regular G T C Q' hT hG hdet hC hCT hQ'o hQ'C hQ's
  have hdiff : ∀ V : E3 → E3, (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i)) →
      ∀ (y : E3) (i : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) y :=
    fun V hV y i => ((hV i).1.differentiable (by simp)) y
  
  have hdivlin : ∀ (V V₁ V₂ : E3 → E3) (α β : ℝ) (y : E3),
      (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, V z i = α * V₁ z i + β * V₂ z i) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V₁ z i) y) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V₂ z i) y) →
      sepDensDiv G V y = α * sepDensDiv G V₁ y + β * sepDensDiv G V₂ y := by
    intro V V₁ V₂ α β y hloc h1 h2
    have h := ccs_div_local G V V₁ V₂ (fun _ => α) (fun _ => β) y hloc
      (differentiableAt_const _) (differentiableAt_const _) h1 h2
    simpa using h
  have hD₀ : ∀ y, sepDensDiv G W₀ y = sepDensDiv G P₁ y + sepDensDiv G P₂ y := by
    intro y
    have hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₀ z i = 1 * P₁ z i + 1 * P₂ z i := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z i => ?_)
      by_cases hz : z ∈ T
      · rw [hW₀ z hz i, hP₁T z hz i, hP₂T z hz i]; ring
      · rw [hW₀o z hz, hP₁o z hz, hP₂o z hz]; simp
    rw [hdivlin W₀ P₁ P₂ 1 1 y hloc (hdiff P₁ hP₁r y) (hdiff P₂ hP₂r y)]; ring
  have hD₁ : ∀ y, sepDensDiv G W₁ y = sepDensDiv G P₁ y + σ y * sepDensDiv G Q' y := by
    intro y
    by_cases hyA : y ∈ At
    · have hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₁ z i = 1 * P₁ z i + (-1) * Q' z i := by
        filter_upwards [hAo.mem_nhds hyA] with z hz
        intro i
        have hzT := hU'T z (hAsub hz)
        rw [hW₁ z hzT i, hP₁T z hzT i, hQ'T z hzT i, hsigA z hz]; ring
      rw [hdivlin W₁ P₁ Q' 1 (-1) y hloc (hdiff P₁ hP₁r y) (hdiff Q' hQ'r y), hσA y hyA]
      ring
    by_cases hyB : y ∈ U' \ At
    · have hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₁ z i = 1 * P₁ z i + 1 * Q' z i := by
        filter_upwards [hBo.mem_nhds hyB] with z hz
        intro i
        have hzT := hU'T z hz.1
        rw [hW₁ z hzT i, hP₁T z hzT i, hQ'T z hzT i, hsigB z hz]; ring
      rw [hdivlin W₁ P₁ Q' 1 1 y hloc (hdiff P₁ hP₁r y) (hdiff Q' hQ'r y), hσB y hyB]
      ring
    · have hyU : y ∉ U' := fun h => hyB ⟨h, hyA⟩
      have hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₁ z i = 1 * P₁ z i + 0 * Q' z i := by
        filter_upwards [hZ'o.mem_nhds (hUZ y hyU)] with z hz
        intro i
        by_cases hzT : z ∈ T
        · rw [hW₁ z hzT i, hP₁T z hzT i]
          have h0 := hvan z hz hzT
          linear_combination (sig z * Xt z i) * h0
        · rw [hW₁o z hzT, hP₁o z hzT]; simp
      rw [hdivlin W₁ P₁ Q' 1 0 y hloc (hdiff P₁ hP₁r y) (hdiff Q' hQ'r y), hσ0 y hyU]
      ring
  have hb0 : ∀ y, y ∉ U' → sepDensDiv G P₂ y = 0 := by
    intro y hyU
    have hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, P₂ z i = 0 * P₁ z i + 0 * P₁ z i := by
      filter_upwards [hZ'o.mem_nhds (hUZ y hyU)] with z hz
      intro i; rw [hP₂Z z hz]; simp
    rw [hdivlin P₂ P₁ P₁ 0 0 y hloc (hdiff P₁ hP₁r y) (hdiff P₁ hP₁r y)]; ring
  
  have hbA : ∫ z in At, sepDensDiv G P₂ z = 0 :=
    ccs_flux_zero G P₂ At hAo (fun i => (hP₂r i).1.of_le (by simp)) (fun i => (hP₂r i).2)
      (fun y hy => Filter.mem_of_superset (hZ'o.mem_nhds (hfrZ y hy)) (fun z hz => hP₂Z z hz))
  have hcA : ∫ z in At, sepDensDiv G Q' z = 0 :=
    ccs_flux_zero G Q' At hAo (fun i => (hQ'r i).1.of_le (by simp)) (fun i => (hQ'r i).2)
      (fun y hy => Filter.mem_of_superset (hZ'o.mem_nhds (hfrZ y hy)) (fun z hz => hQ'Z z hz))
  
  have hid := ccs_int_identity Ft At U' (sepDensDiv G P₁) (sepDensDiv G P₂) (sepDensDiv G Q')
    (sepDensDiv G W₀) (sepDensDiv G W₁) σ hFm hAo.measurableSet hU'o.measurableSet hAsub
    hP₁i hP₂i hQ'i hσapp hD₀ hD₁ hb0 hbA hcA
  
  have hSeq : symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z} = symmDiff Ft At ∩ U' := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      refine ⟨h1, hU'mk z ?_ h2⟩
      rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 h1 with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩
      · exact hFT h
      · exact hU'T z (hAsub h)
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact ⟨h1, hU'f z h2⟩
  have hTFeq : (Ft \ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∪ At = (Ft \ U') ∪ At := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨h1, h2⟩ | h)
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h1, fun h => h2 (hU'f z h)⟩
      · exact Or.inr h
    · rintro (⟨h1, h2⟩ | h)
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h1, fun h => h2 (hU'mk z (hFT h1) h)⟩
      · exact Or.inr h
  rw [hSeq, hTFeq]
  obtain ⟨S', hS'⟩ : ∃ S : Set E3, S = symmDiff Ft At ∩ U' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hS'] at hid ⊢
  have hS'm : MeasurableSet S' := by
    rw [hS']; exact (hFm.symmDiff hAo.measurableSet).inter hU'o.measurableSet
  have hS'U : ∀ z ∈ S', z ∈ U' := fun z hz => by rw [hS'] at hz; exact hz.2
  
  have hKcl : IsClosed (C ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici r₁) :=
    (hf.continuousOn.mono hCT).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hC.isClosed isClosed_Ici
  have hKc : IsCompact (C ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici r₁) := hC.of_isClosed_subset hKcl Set.inter_subset_left
  have hKT' : C ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici r₁ ⊆ T' := fun z hz => hT'f z (hCT hz.1) hz.2
  have hKT : C ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici r₁ ⊆ T := fun z hz => hCT hz.1
  have htool : ∀ u : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn u (C ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici r₁) →
      (∀ z ∈ S', z ∉ C → u z = 0) → IntegrableOn u S' := by
    intro u hu h0
    refine (hu.integrableOn_compact hKc).of_forall_diff_eq_zero hS'm ?_
    intro z hz
    apply h0 z hz.1
    intro hzC
    exact hz.2 ⟨hzC, (hU'f z (hS'U z hz.1)).le⟩
  have hdivX : ContinuousOn (sepDensDiv G Xt) T' := by
    have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn
        (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Xt z i) y) T' := by
      intro i
      have hk : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Xt z i) T' :=
        (hs.mono hT'T).mul ((contDiffOn_piLp 2).1 hXt i)
      exact (hk.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hT'o (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    unfold sepDensDiv
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hcomp i)
  have hu₁ : ContinuousOn (fun z => ψ z * sepDensDiv G Xt z) (C ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici r₁) :=
    (hψ.continuousOn.mono hKT).mul (hdivX.mono hKT')
  have hdS : ∀ z ∈ S', d z = ψ z * sepDensDiv G Xt z :=
    fun z hz => hd z (hU'T z (hS'U z hz)) (hU'f z (hS'U z hz))
  have hψS : ∀ z ∈ S', z ∉ C → ψ z = 0 := fun z hz hzC => hψC z (hU'T z (hS'U z hz)) hzC
  have hI1 : IntegrableOn d S' :=
    (htool _ hu₁ (fun z hz hzC => by simp only [hψS z hz hzC, zero_mul])).congr_fun
      (fun z hz => (hdS z hz).symm) hS'm
  have hI2 : IntegrableOn (fun z => calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z) S' :=
    (htool (fun z => calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (ψ z * sepDensDiv G Xt z))
      ((hθT.continuousOn.mono hKT).mul hu₁)
      (fun z hz hzC => by simp only [hψS z hz hzC, zero_mul, mul_zero])).congr_fun
      (fun z hz => by simp only [hdS z hz]) hS'm
  have hdψ0 : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∉ C → fderiv ℝ ψ z = 0 := by
    intro z hz hzC
    have hev : ψ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [(hT.inter hC.isClosed.isOpen_compl).mem_nhds ⟨hz, hzC⟩] with w hw
      exact hψC w hw.1 hw.2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]; simp
  have hZtv : ∀ z ∈ T, Zt z = calTheta r₁ η (f z) • Xt z :=
    fun z hz => PiLp.ext (fun i => by rw [hZt z hz i]; simp)
  have hI3 : IntegrableOn (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z)) S' := by
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det *
        (calTheta r₁ η (f z) * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Xt z))) (C ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici r₁) :=
      (hs.continuousOn.mono hKT).mul ((hθT.continuousOn.mono hKT).mul
        (((hψ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hT (by simp)).mono hKT).clm_apply
          (hXt.continuousOn.mono hKT')))
    refine (htool _ hcont (fun z hz hzC => ?_)).congr_fun (fun z hz => ?_) hS'm
    · simp only [hdψ0 z (hU'T z (hS'U z hz)) hzC, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero]
    · simp only [hZtv z (hU'T z (hS'U z hz)), map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hW₀int : Integrable (sepDensDiv G W₀) :=
    (hP₁i.add hP₂i).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => (hD₀ y).symm))
  have hI4 : IntegrableOn (fun z => sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) S' := by
    have h : IntegrableOn (fun z => (U' \ At).indicator (sepDensDiv G W₀) z -
        At.indicator (sepDensDiv G W₀) z) S' :=
      ((hW₀int.indicator hBo.measurableSet).sub (hW₀int.indicator hAo.measurableSet)).integrableOn
    refine h.congr_fun (fun z hz => ?_) hS'm
    rw [← hσsig z (hU'T z (hS'U z hz)), hσind]
  have hθm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => calTheta r₁ η (f z)) (volume.restrict S') :=
    (hθT.continuousOn.aestronglyMeasurable hT.measurableSet).mono_set
      (fun z hz => hU'T z (hS'U z hz))
  have hθb : ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume.restrict S'), ‖calTheta r₁ η (f z)‖ ≤ 1 :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hθ0 _)]; exact hθ1 _)
  have hI5 : IntegrableOn (fun z => calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z)) S' :=
    hI4.bdd_mul hθm hθb
  have hI6 : IntegrableOn (fun z => σ z * sepDensDiv G P₁ z + sepDensDiv G Q' z) S' := by
    have h : IntegrableOn (fun z => ((U' \ At).indicator (sepDensDiv G P₁) z -
        At.indicator (sepDensDiv G P₁) z) + sepDensDiv G Q' z) S' :=
      (((hP₁i.indicator hBo.measurableSet).sub (hP₁i.indicator hAo.measurableSet)).add
        hQ'i).integrableOn
    refine h.congr_fun (fun z _ => ?_) hS'm
    rw [hσind]
  
  have hpt : ∀ z ∈ S', calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z + Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z) +
      (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z - calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z)) ≤
      σ z * sepDensDiv G P₁ z + sepDensDiv G Q' z := by
    intro z hz
    have hzU := hS'U z hz
    have hzT := hU'T z hzU
    have hfz := hU'f z hzU
    have hzT' := hT'f z hzT hfz.le
    have hsz : sig z = 1 ∨ sig z = -1 := by
      by_cases hA : z ∈ At
      · exact Or.inr (hsigA z hA)
      · exact Or.inl (hsigB z ⟨hzU, hA⟩)
    rw [hσsig z hzT]
    exact ccs_layer_pointwise G T T' f ψ sig d Yt Xt Zt W₀ P₁ Q' r₁ η z hT hG hdet hf hη hψ
      (hψ0 z hzT) hT'o hT'T hYt hXt hzT' hsz (hCS z hzT hfz) hW₀
      (fun w hw i => by rw [hP₁T w hw i]; ring)
      (fun w hw i => by rw [hQ'T w (hT'T hw) i]; ring) (hZt z hzT) (hd z hzT hfz)
  
  have hI23 : IntegrableOn (fun z => calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z +
      Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z)) S' := hI2.add hI3
  have hI45 : IntegrableOn (fun z => sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z -
      calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z)) S' := hI4.sub hI5
  have hsplit : ∫ z in S', (calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z + Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z) +
      (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z - calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z))) =
      (∫ z in S', calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z) +
        (∫ z in S', Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z)) +
        ((∫ z in S', sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) -
          ∫ z in S', calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z)) := by
    rw [integral_add hI23 hI45, integral_add hI2 hI3, integral_sub hI4 hI5]
  refine ⟨hI1, hI4, ?_⟩
  rw [← hsplit, hid]
  exact setIntegral_mono_on (hI23.add hI45) hI6 hS'm hpt

    intro a b
    exact hSi.apply b a
  
  
  have inv_entry : ∀ (x : E3) (m : Fin 3),
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x) → (G x).det ≠ 0 →
      ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x ∧
        partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x =
          -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            (G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l := by
    intro x m hG hdet
    have hdetD : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
        (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => H y a b) x) →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (H y).det) x := by
      intro H hH
      have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
          H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
          - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
          + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
        funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H y)
      rw [hfun]
      have h00 := hH 0 0
      have h01 := hH 0 1
      have h02 := hH 0 2
      have h10 := hH 1 0
      have h11 := hH 1 1
      have h12 := hH 1 2
      have h20 := hH 2 0
      have h21 := hH 2 1
      have h22 := hH 2 2
      fun_prop
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y).det) x := hdetD G hG
    have hP : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x := by
      intro k l
      have hfun : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) =
          fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det := by
        funext y
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
          smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hfun]
      refine (hD.inv hdet).mul (hdetD _ ?_)
      intro a b
      by_cases hal : a = l
      · subst hal
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact differentiableAt_const _
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hal]
        exact hG a b
    have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (G y).det ≠ 0 := hD.continuousAt.eventually_ne hdet
    have hE : ∀ a l : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G x a b * partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
        + ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l = 0 := by
      intro a l
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (∑ b : Fin 3, (G x a b • fderiv ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
            + (G x)⁻¹ b l • fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)) x := by
        have hs := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
          (A := fun b y => G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (fun b _ => (hG a b).hasFDerivAt.mul (hP b l).hasFDerivAt)
        convert hs using 1
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
        apply (hasFDerivAt_const (if a = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
        have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G y) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy)) a) l
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
        exact this
      have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e m)) (h1.unique h2)
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h3
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [← h3, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      ring
    intro k l
    refine ⟨hP k l, ?_⟩
    let Xm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun b l => partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
    let Dm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun a b => partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x
    have hM : G x * Xm = -(Dm * (G x)⁻¹) := by
      ext a l'
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
      simp only [Xm, Dm, Matrix.of_apply]
      exact hE a l'
    have hX : Xm = -((G x)⁻¹ * (Dm * (G x)⁻¹)) := by
      calc Xm = ((G x)⁻¹ * G x) * Xm := by
            rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet), Matrix.one_mul]
        _ = (G x)⁻¹ * (G x * Xm) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [hM, Matrix.mul_neg]
    have hkl := congrFun (congrFun hX k) l
    simp only [Xm, Dm, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply] at hkl
    rw [hkl]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring
  
  have hs1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y ∧
      partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y = Real.sqrt (G y).det / 2 *
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv i (fun z => G z a b) y := by
    intro i
    have hfun : (fun z => (G z).det) = fun z =>
        G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
          - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
          + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0 := by
      funext z; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (G z)
    have h00 := (hGd 0 0).hasFDerivAt
    have h01 := (hGd 0 1).hasFDerivAt
    have h02 := (hGd 0 2).hasFDerivAt
    have h10 := (hGd 1 0).hasFDerivAt
    have h11 := (hGd 1 1).hasFDerivAt
    have h12 := (hGd 1 2).hasFDerivAt
    have h20 := (hGd 2 0).hasFDerivAt
    have h21 := (hGd 2 1).hasFDerivAt
    have h22 := (hGd 2 2).hasFDerivAt
    have hD := (((((((h00.mul h11).mul h22).sub ((h00.mul h12).mul h21)).sub
      ((h01.mul h10).mul h22)).add ((h01.mul h12).mul h20)).add
      ((h02.mul h10).mul h21)).sub ((h02.mul h11).mul h20))
    have hD' : HasFDerivAt (fun z => (G z).det) _ y :=
      hD.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => congrFun hfun z)
    have hS := hD'.sqrt hdet.ne'
    refine ⟨hS.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hS.fderiv]
    have hinv : ∀ a b, (G y)⁻¹ a b = ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate a b := by
      intro a b
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [hinv]
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt (G y).det * Real.sqrt (G y).det = (G y).det :=
      Real.mul_self_sqrt hdet.le
    have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt (G y).det := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hdet
    have hfac : 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (G y).det) = Real.sqrt (G y).det / 2 * ((G y).det)⁻¹ := by
      have aux : ∀ s d : ℝ, 0 < s → s * s = d → 1 / (2 * s) = s / 2 * d⁻¹ := by
        intro s d hs h
        subst h
        field_simp
      exact aux _ _ hspos hs2
    rw [hfac]
    set d := (G y).det with hd
    have f10 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 1 0) y = fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 0 1) y := by
      congr 1; funext z; exact hsymm z 1 0
    have f20 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 2 0) y = fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 0 2) y := by
      congr 1; funext z; exact hsymm z 2 0
    have f21 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 2 1) y = fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 1 2) y := by
      congr 1; funext z; exact hsymm z 2 1
    have e10 := hsymm y 1 0
    have e20 := hsymm y 2 0
    have e21 := hsymm y 2 1
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three,
      Matrix.adjugate_fin_three, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.empty_val',
      Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_fin_const, f10, f20, f21, e10, e20, e21]
    ring
  have hs2 := fun m => inv_entry y m hGd hdet.ne'
  have hdS : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y =
      Real.sqrt (G y).det / 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv i (fun z => G z a b) y := fun i => (hs1 i).2
  have hdGi : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y =
      -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y * (G y)⁻¹ b l :=
    fun m k l => (hs2 m k l).2
  
  have hloc : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y =
      partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * calUnitNormal G f z i) y := by
    intro i
    have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * calUnitNormal G f z i) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hTy (fun z hz => by simp only [hX z hz i])
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev]
  
  have hs : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y := (hs1 0).1
  have hGi : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) y :=
    fun a b => (hs2 0 a b).1
  have hp := hpd'
  have hs3 : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * calUnitNormal G f z i) y = partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y * ((Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y))⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f y) + Real.sqrt (G y).det * (-((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) y * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y + (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv a f) y * partialDeriv b f y + (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv b f) y)) / (2 * Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y) ^ 3)) * ∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f y + (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y))⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i k) y * partialDeriv k f y + (G y)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv k f) y)) := by
    intro i
    have pd_mul : ∀ (u v : E3 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ u y → DifferentiableAt ℝ v y →
        partialDeriv i (fun z => u z * v z) y =
          partialDeriv i u y * v y + u y * partialDeriv i v y := by
      intro u v hu hv
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [fderiv_fun_mul hu hv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have pd_sum : ∀ (u : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ), (∀ k, DifferentiableAt ℝ (u k) y) →
        partialDeriv i (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, u k z) y = ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (u k) y := by
      intro u hu
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun k _ => hu k)]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    have pd_inv_sqrt : ∀ (Q : E3 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ Q y → 0 < Q y →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (Real.sqrt (Q z))⁻¹) y ∧
        partialDeriv i (fun z => (Real.sqrt (Q z))⁻¹) y =
          -(partialDeriv i Q y) / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q y) ^ 3) := by
      intro Q hQ hpos
      have hr : Real.sqrt (Q y) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hpos).ne'
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => Real.sqrt (Q z))
          ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q y))) • fderiv ℝ Q y) y := hQ.hasFDerivAt.sqrt hpos.ne'
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => (Real.sqrt (Q z))⁻¹)
          ((-(Real.sqrt (Q y) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q y))) • fderiv ℝ Q y)) y :=
        (hasDerivAt_inv hr).comp_hasFDerivAt y h1
      refine ⟨h2.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [h2.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    have h2d : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z) y :=
      fun a b => (hGi a b).mul (hp a)
    have h3d : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z) y :=
      fun a b => (h2d a b).mul (hp b)
    have hQb : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z) y :=
      fun a => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => h3d a b)
    have hQd : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z) y :=
      DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun a _ => hQb a)
    have hUk : ∀ k : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f z) y :=
      fun k => (hGi i k).mul (hp k)
    have hUd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f z) y :=
      DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun k _ => hUk k)
    obtain ⟨hRd, hRpd⟩ := pd_inv_sqrt _ hQd hN
    have hcald : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => calUnitNormal G f z i) y := hRd.mul hUd
    have hQpd : partialDeriv i
        (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z) y =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) y * partialDeriv a f y *
          partialDeriv b f y + (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv a f) y *
            partialDeriv b f y +
          (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv b f) y) := by
      rw [pd_sum _ hQb]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
      rw [pd_sum _ (h3d a)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
      rw [pd_mul _ (partialDeriv b f) (h2d a b) (hp b),
        pd_mul _ (partialDeriv a f) (hGi a b) (hp a)]
      ring
    have hUpd : partialDeriv i (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f z) y =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i k) y * partialDeriv k f y +
          (G y)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv k f) y) := by
      rw [pd_sum _ hUk]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      rw [pd_mul _ (partialDeriv k f) (hGi i k) (hp k)]
    have hcalpd : partialDeriv i (fun z => calUnitNormal G f z i) y =
        partialDeriv i (fun z => (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z))⁻¹) y *
          ∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f y +
        (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y))⁻¹ *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f z) y :=
      pd_mul _ _ hRd hUd
    rw [pd_mul _ _ hs hcald, hcalpd, hRpd, hQpd, hUpd]
    simp only [calUnitNormal]
    all_goals ring
  
  have e10 := hsymI 1 0
  have e20 := hsymI 2 0
  have e21 := hsymI 2 1
  have hA1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y *
        ∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f y +
      Real.sqrt (G y).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i k) y * partialDeriv k f y =
      -(Real.sqrt (G y).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j *
        ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k f y) := by
    simp only [hdS, hdGi, christoffel, Fin.sum_univ_three, e10, e20, e21]
    ring
  have hA2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f y) *
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) y * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y =
      -2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a f y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b f y) *
          ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k f y := by
    simp only [hdGi, christoffel, Fin.sum_univ_three, e10, e20, e21]
    ring
  
  unfold sepDensDiv
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (hloc i).trans (hs3 i))]
  exact key (G y)⁻¹ (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y)
    (fun i a b => partialDeriv i (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) y)
    (fun i j => ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k f y)
    (fun a => partialDeriv a f y) (fun i a => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv a f) y)
    (Real.sqrt (G y).det)
    (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y))
    hsymI hA1 hA2

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) : IsOpen {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z → ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 → |fderiv ℝ f z w| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (X z)

signature.name: ccs_normal_props
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) : IsOpen {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z → ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 → |fderiv ℝ f z w| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (X z)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).det ≠ 0 := fun z hz => (hpd z hz).det_pos.ne'
  have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) T := by
    intro i j
    have hd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) T := by
      simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      have := hG
      fun_prop
    have hadj : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).adjugate i j) T := by
      simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp <;> fun_prop
    have heq : (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) = fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹ * (G z).adjugate i j := by
      funext z
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact (hd.inv hdet).mul hadj
  
  have hpf : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => partialDeriv k f z) T := by
    intro k
    have h1 := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hT).mp hf).2
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z) T := by
    refine ContDiffOn.sum (fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun b _ => ?_))
    exact ((hinv a b).mul (hpf a)).mul (hpf b)
  
  have key : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), A.PosDef → ∀ (ξ w : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b →
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 →
      |∑ a : Fin 3, ξ a * w a| ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b) := by
    intro A hA ξ w hNA hw
    set N := ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b with hNdef
    set s := Real.sqrt N with hs
    have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hNA
    have hss : s * s = N := Real.mul_self_sqrt hNA.le
    set u := Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ ξ with hu
    have hAu : Matrix.mulVec A u = ξ := by
      rw [hu, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA.det_pos.ne'), Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hsym : Matrix.transpose A = A := by
      have h := hA.isHermitian
      rw [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h
      exact h
    have huA : Matrix.vecMul u A = ξ := by
      rw [← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hsym, hAu]
    have e2 : dotProduct u (Matrix.mulVec A w) = dotProduct ξ w := by
      rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, huA]
    have huξ : dotProduct u ξ = N := by
      simp only [hu, hNdef, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hQ : dotProduct w (Matrix.mulVec A w) = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * w a * w b := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hD : dotProduct ξ w = ∑ a : Fin 3, ξ a * w a := rfl
    have hquad : ∀ t : ℝ,
        0 ≤ N - 2 * t * (dotProduct ξ w) + t ^ 2 * (dotProduct w (Matrix.mulVec A w)) := by
      intro t
      have h0 := hA.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (u - t • w)
      rw [star_trivial] at h0
      have e1 : dotProduct (u - t • w) (Matrix.mulVec A (u - t • w)) =
          N - 2 * t * (dotProduct ξ w) + t ^ 2 * (dotProduct w (Matrix.mulVec A w)) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_smul, hAu, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub,
          smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, e2, dotProduct_comm w ξ, huξ]
        ring
      rw [← e1]
      exact h0
    rw [← hD]
    have h1 := hquad s
    have h2 := hquad (-s)
    rw [hQ] at h1 h2
    have h3 := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg s) (sub_nonneg.mpr hw)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  have hexp : ∀ (z v : E3), fderiv ℝ f z v = ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a f z * v a := by
    intro z v
    have hv : v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, partialDeriv]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => mul_comm _ _)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hN.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Ioi
  · have hS : {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ⊆ T := fun z hz => hz.1
    rw [contDiffOn_piLp]
    intro i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => calUnitNormal G f z i) {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 <
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} := by
      unfold calUnitNormal
      refine ContDiffOn.mul ?_ ?_
      · refine ContDiffOn.inv ?_ ?_
        · exact (hN.mono hS).sqrt (fun z hz => hz.2.ne')
        · intro z hz
          exact (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hz.2).ne'
      · exact (ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hinv i k).mul (hpf k))).mono hS
    exact h1.congr (fun z hz => hX z hz.1 i)
  · intro z hz hNz w hw
    have hRHS : fderiv ℝ f z (X z) = Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z) := by
      rw [hexp]
      have hXz : ∀ i, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i := hX z hz
      simp only [hXz, calUnitNormal]
      set N := ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z
        with hNdef
      have hss : Real.sqrt N * Real.sqrt N = N := Real.mul_self_sqrt hNz.le
      have hs0 : Real.sqrt N ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hNz).ne'
      have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i f z * ((Real.sqrt N)⁻¹ *
          ∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f z) = (Real.sqrt N)⁻¹ * N := by
        rw [hNdef]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [hsum]
      calc (Real.sqrt N)⁻¹ * N = (Real.sqrt N)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt N * Real.sqrt N) := by rw [hss]
        _ = Real.sqrt N := inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hs0 _
    rw [hRHS, hexp z w]
    exact key (G z) (hpd z hz) (fun a => partialDeriv a f z) (fun a => w a) hNz hw

informal_problem.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (V : M → E3) (p : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) (w : E3) (hw : w = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y a b * w a * w b = g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))

signature.name: ccs_rep_norm
signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (V : M → E3) (p : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) (w : E3) (hw : w = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y a b * w a * w b = g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hx : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
  have hxy : (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = y := (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hy
  have h0 := (mdifferentiable_chart (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) p).symm_comp_deriv hx
  rw [hxy] at h0
  have hDL : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) v) = v := by
    intro v
    have := congrArg (fun T => T v) h0
    simpa using this
  have hR : g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      = g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w)
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w) := by
    rw [hw, hDL]
  have hwexp : w = w 0 • e 0 + w 1 • e 1 + w 2 • e 2 := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  rw [hR]
  conv_rhs => rw [hwexp]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(Y : E3 → E3) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y U) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    (∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x) ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x = 0

signature.name: piola_adjugate_div_zero
signature.statement:
(Y : E3 → E3) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y U) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    (∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x) ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hadj : ∀ (J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (a i : Fin 3),
      J.adjugate a i = J (i+1) (a+1) * J (i+2) (a+2) - J (i+1) (a+2) * J (i+2) (a+1) := by
    intro J a i
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three] <;> ring
  
  have hxN : U ∈ 𝓝 x := hU.mem_nhds hx
  have hYc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y x := hY.contDiffAt hxN
  have hD1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ Y) x := hYc.fderiv_right (m := 1)
    (by simpa using (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞))
  have hDd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Y) x := hD1.differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ Y x :=
    hYc.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simpa using (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞))
  obtain ⟨L, hB, hLsym⟩ : ∃ L : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      (∀ k a, HasFDerivAt (fun z => jacMat Y z k a) (L k a) x) ∧
      ∀ k a b, L k a (e b) = L k b (e a) := by
    refine ⟨fun k a => ((EuclideanSpace.proj k).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 (e a))).comp (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Y) x), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k a
      have h := ((EuclideanSpace.proj k).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 (e a))).hasFDerivAt.comp x hDd.hasFDerivAt
      convert h using 1
    · intro k a b
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp', Function.comp_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
      rw [hsymm (e b) (e a)]
  
  have hA : ∀ a i : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i)
      ((jacMat Y x (i+1) (a+1) • L (i+2) (a+2) + jacMat Y x (i+2) (a+2) • L (i+1) (a+1)) -
        (jacMat Y x (i+1) (a+2) • L (i+2) (a+1) + jacMat Y x (i+2) (a+1) • L (i+1) (a+2))) x := by
    intro a i
    have hfun : (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) = fun z =>
        jacMat Y z (i+1) (a+1) * jacMat Y z (i+2) (a+2) -
          jacMat Y z (i+1) (a+2) * jacMat Y z (i+2) (a+1) :=
      funext fun z => hadj (jacMat Y z) a i
    rw [hfun]
    exact ((hB (i+1) (a+1)).fun_mul (hB (i+2) (a+2))).fun_sub
      ((hB (i+1) (a+2)).fun_mul (hB (i+2) (a+1)))
  refine ⟨fun a i => (hA a i).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
  have h01 : ∀ k, L k 1 (e 0) = L k 0 (e 1) := fun k => hLsym k 1 0
  have h02 : ∀ k, L k 2 (e 0) = L k 0 (e 2) := fun k => hLsym k 2 0
  have h12 : ∀ k, L k 2 (e 1) = L k 1 (e 2) := fun k => hLsym k 2 1
  intro i
  simp only [partialDeriv, fun a => (hA a i).fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  fin_cases i <;>
  · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceAdd, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one]
    simp only [h01, h02, h12]
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
(Y : E3 → E3) (W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x)
    (hA : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x)
    (hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y i) (Y x))
    (hP : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x = 0) :
    ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i * W (Y z) i) x
      = (jacMat Y x).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => W y i) (Y x)

signature.name: piola_div_of_null
signature.statement:
(Y : E3 → E3) (W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x)
    (hA : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x)
    (hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y i) (Y x))
    (hP : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x = 0) :
    ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i * W (Y z) i) x
      = (jacMat Y x).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => W y i) (Y x)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hchain : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ f (Y x) → ∀ a : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (fun z => f (Y z)) x =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, jacMat Y x k a * partialDeriv k f (Y x) := by
    intro f hf a
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_comp' x hf hY, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    have hv : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k • e k := by
      intro v
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a))]
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  have hWi : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => W (Y z) i) x :=
    fun i => (hW i).comp x hY
  
  have hprod : ∀ a : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i * W (Y z) i) x
        = ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x * W (Y x) i
          + (jacMat Y x).adjugate a i * partialDeriv a (fun z => W (Y z) i) x) := by
    intro a
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => (hA a i).fun_mul (hWi i)), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hA a i) (hWi i)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hc : ∀ a i : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => W (Y z) i) x =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, jacMat Y x k a * partialDeriv k (fun y => W y i) (Y x) :=
    fun a i => hchain (fun y => W y i) (hW i) a
  
  have hK : ∀ k i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, jacMat Y x k a * (jacMat Y x).adjugate a i
      = (jacMat Y x).det * (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) k i := by
    intro k i
    rw [← Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mul_adjugate, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have h00 := hK 0 0
  have h01 := hK 0 1
  have h02 := hK 0 2
  have h10 := hK 1 0
  have h11 := hK 1 1
  have h12 := hK 1 2
  have h20 := hK 2 0
  have h21 := hK 2 1
  have h22 := hK 2 2
  have hP0 := hP 0
  have hP1 := hP 1
  have hP2 := hP 2
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hprod a)]
  simp only [hc]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at h00 h11 h22 hP0 hP1 hP2 ⊢
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1),
    Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2), Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0),
    Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2), Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0),
    Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1)] at h01 h02 h10 h12 h20 h21
  linear_combination W (Y x) 0 * hP0 + W (Y x) 1 * hP1 + W (Y x) 2 * hP2
    + partialDeriv 0 (fun y => W y 0) (Y x) * h00
    + partialDeriv 0 (fun y => W y 1) (Y x) * h01
    + partialDeriv 0 (fun y => W y 2) (Y x) * h02
    + partialDeriv 1 (fun y => W y 0) (Y x) * h10
    + partialDeriv 1 (fun y => W y 1) (Y x) * h11
    + partialDeriv 1 (fun y => W y 2) (Y x) * h12
    + partialDeriv 2 (fun y => W y 0) (Y x) * h20
    + partialDeriv 2 (fun y => W y 1) (Y x) * h21
    + partialDeriv 2 (fun y => W y 2) (Y x) * h22

informal_problem.statement:
(τ σ : E3 → E3) (O₁ O₂ : Set E3) (hO₁ : IsOpen O₁)
    (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ O₁) (hσ : ContinuousOn σ O₂)
    (hσO : ∀ z ∈ O₂, σ z ∈ O₁) (hστ : ∀ y ∈ O₁, σ (τ y) = y)
    (hJ0 : ∀ y ∈ O₁, (jacMat τ y).det ≠ 0)
    (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) (hXO : tsupport X ⊆ O₂) :
    ∃ X' : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X' ∧ HasCompactSupport X' ∧ tsupport X' ⊆ O₁ ∧
      (∀ y ∈ O₁, ∀ a : Fin 3,
        (jacMat τ y).det * X' y a = ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat τ y).adjugate a i * X (τ y) i) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ O₁, ∀ i : Fin 3, X (τ y) i = ∑ a : Fin 3, jacMat τ y i a * X' y a) ∧
      (∀ y, y ∉ O₁ → X' y = 0)

signature.name: transport_field_exists
signature.statement:
(τ σ : E3 → E3) (O₁ O₂ : Set E3) (hO₁ : IsOpen O₁)
    (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ O₁) (hσ : ContinuousOn σ O₂)
    (hσO : ∀ z ∈ O₂, σ z ∈ O₁) (hστ : ∀ y ∈ O₁, σ (τ y) = y)
    (hJ0 : ∀ y ∈ O₁, (jacMat τ y).det ≠ 0)
    (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) (hXO : tsupport X ⊆ O₂) :
    ∃ X' : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X' ∧ HasCompactSupport X' ∧ tsupport X' ⊆ O₁ ∧
      (∀ y ∈ O₁, ∀ a : Fin 3,
        (jacMat τ y).det * X' y a = ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat τ y).adjugate a i * X (τ y) i) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ O₁, ∀ i : Fin 3, X (τ y) i = ∑ a : Fin 3, jacMat τ y i a * X' y a) ∧
      (∀ y, y ∉ O₁ → X' y = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ τ) O₁ :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO₁).1 hτ).2
  have hent : ∀ i a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => jacMat τ y i a) O₁ := by
    intro i a
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e a)) O₁ :=
      hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact contDiffOn_euclidean.1 h1 i
  have h00 := hent 0 0
  have h01 := hent 0 1
  have h02 := hent 0 2
  have h10 := hent 1 0
  have h11 := hent 1 1
  have h12 := hent 1 2
  have h20 := hent 2 0
  have h21 := hent 2 1
  have h22 := hent 2 2
  have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (jacMat τ y).det) O₁ := by
    simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    fun_prop
  have hadj : ∀ a i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (jacMat τ y).adjugate a i) O₁ := by
    intro a i
    simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases i <;> simp <;> fun_prop
  have hXτ : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => X (τ y) i) O₁ := fun i =>
    (contDiff_euclidean.1 hX i).comp_contDiffOn hτ
  have hcomp : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((jacMat τ y).det)⁻¹ *
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat τ y).adjugate a i * X (τ y) i) O₁ := by
    intro a
    exact (hdet.inv fun y hy => hJ0 y hy).mul
      (ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => (hadj a i).mul (hXτ i))
  
  let F : E3 → E3 := fun y => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun a : Fin 3 => ((jacMat τ y).det)⁻¹ *
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat τ y).adjugate a i * X (τ y) i)
  have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F O₁ := contDiffOn_euclidean.2 fun a => hcomp a
  let X' : E3 → E3 := fun y => if y ∈ O₁ then F y else 0

  have hK : IsCompact K := hXc.image_of_continuousOn (hσ.mono hXO)

    exact hσO z (hXO hz)

    intro y hy
    by_cases hyO : y ∈ O₁

        intro h
        exact hy ⟨τ y, h, hστ y hyO⟩
      have hXz : X (τ y) = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hτX
      rw [hX'F y hyO]
      ext a
      simp [F, hXz]
    · exact if_neg hyO

  have hcs : HasCompactSupport X' := hK.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport X') htK

      v i = ∑ a : Fin 3, J i a * (J.det⁻¹ * ∑ j : Fin 3, J.adjugate a j * v j) := by
    intro J hJ v i
    have h1 : ∀ j, ∑ a : Fin 3, J i a * J.adjugate a j = J.det * (if i = j then 1 else 0) := by

      have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_adjugate J) i) j
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply] at this
      rw [this, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    calc v i = J.det⁻¹ * ∑ j : Fin 3, (J.det * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * v j := by

          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring
  refine ⟨X', hX'cd, hcs, htK.trans hKO, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy a
    rw [hX'F y hy]
    show (jacMat τ y).det * (((jacMat τ y).det)⁻¹ *
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat τ y).adjugate a i * X (τ y) i) = _
    exact mul_inv_cancel_left₀ (hJ0 y hy) _
  · intro y hy i
    rw [hX'F y hy]
    show X (τ y) i = ∑ a : Fin 3, jacMat τ y i a * (((jacMat τ y).det)⁻¹ *
      ∑ j : Fin 3, (jacMat τ y).adjugate a j * X (τ y) j)
    exact key (jacMat τ y) (hJ0 y hy) (fun j => X (τ y) j) i
  · intro y hy
    exact if_neg hy
