signature.statement: (S : ℕ → Set E3) (T V : Set E3) (hS : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (S k)) (hT : MeasurableSet T) (hconv : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (S k) T ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) : ∀ a : ENNReal, a < sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) T V → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, a < sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (S k) V

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a ha
  unfold sepPerG at ha
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.1 ha
  obtain ⟨hAdm, ha'⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.1 hX
  obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXV, hXn⟩ := hAdm
  set f : E3 → ℝ := sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X with hfdef
  have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun z => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) * X z i) := by
    intro i
    exact contDiff_const.mul ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hXs)
  have hfeq : f = fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) * X z i) y (e i) :=
    rfl
  have hfc : Continuous f := by
    rw [hfeq]
    refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    exact ((hcomp i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hf0 : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → f y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hO : (tsupport X)ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 y := (isClosed_tsupport X).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy
    rw [hfeq]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
    have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) * X z i)
        =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hO] with z hz
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz]
      simp
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have hfcs : HasCompactSupport f := HasCompactSupport.intro hXc hf0
  have hfi : Integrable f := hfc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hfcs
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hfc.bounded_above_of_compact_support hfcs
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hXc.isBounded.subset_ball (0 : E3)
  have hρpos : (0:ℝ) < max r 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_right _ _)
  have hρ : ∀ y, y ∉ Metric.ball (0:E3) (max r 1) → f y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    apply hf0
    intro hyt
    exact hy (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_max_left _ _) (hr hyt))
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hM 0)
  have hbound : ∀ k, |(∫ y in S k, f y) - ∫ y in T, f y| ≤
      M * (volume (symmDiff (S k) T ∩ Metric.ball (0:E3) (max r 1))).toReal := by
    intro k
    set D := symmDiff (S k) T ∩ Metric.ball (0:E3) (max r 1) with hD
    have hDm : MeasurableSet D := ((hS k).symmDiff hT).inter measurableSet_ball
    have hDfin : volume D ≠ ⊤ :=
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right) measure_ball_lt_top).ne
    rw [← integral_indicator (hS k), ← integral_indicator hT,
      ← integral_sub (hfi.indicator (hS k)) (hfi.indicator hT)]
    have hDnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ D.indicator (fun _ => M) x := fun x => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => hM0) x
    have hpt : ∀ x, ‖(S k).indicator f x - T.indicator f x‖ ≤ D.indicator (fun _ => M) x := by
      intro x
      have hfx := hM x
      have hxD : ((x ∈ S k ∧ x ∉ T) ∨ (x ∈ T ∧ x ∉ S k)) ∧ x ∈ Metric.ball (0:E3) (max r 1) →
          x ∈ D := by
        intro h
        rw [hD, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_symmDiff]
        exact h
      by_cases h3 : x ∈ Metric.ball (0:E3) (max r 1)
      · by_cases h1 : x ∈ S k <;> by_cases h2 : x ∈ T
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h1, Set.indicator_of_mem h2, sub_self, norm_zero]
          exact hDnn x
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem h2, sub_zero,
            Set.indicator_of_mem (hxD ⟨Or.inl ⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩)]
          exact hfx
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h1, Set.indicator_of_mem h2, zero_sub, norm_neg,
            Set.indicator_of_mem (hxD ⟨Or.inr ⟨h2, h1⟩, h3⟩)]
          exact hfx
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem h2, sub_self, norm_zero]
          exact hDnn x
      · have hfx0 := hρ x h3
        have e1 : (S k).indicator f x = 0 := by
          by_cases h1 : x ∈ S k
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h1, hfx0]
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h1]
        have e2 : T.indicator f x = 0 := by
          by_cases h2 : x ∈ T
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h2, hfx0]
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h2]
        rw [e1, e2, sub_self, norm_zero]
        exact hDnn x
    have hint : Integrable (D.indicator (fun _ => M)) :=
      (integrable_indicator_iff hDm).2 (integrableOn_const hDfin)
    have h := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hint (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
    rw [integral_indicator_const M hDm, Measure.real_def, smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact h
  have hu : Tendsto (fun k => (volume (symmDiff (S k) T ∩ Metric.ball (0:E3) (max r 1))).toReal)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal ENNReal.zero_ne_top).comp (hconv (max r 1) hρpos)
    rwa [ENNReal.toReal_zero] at this
  have hMu : Tendsto (fun k =>
      M * (volume (symmDiff (S k) T ∩ Metric.ball (0:E3) (max r 1))).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have := hu.const_mul M
    rwa [mul_zero] at this
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y in S k, f y) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y in T, f y)) := by
    rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    refine squeeze_zero (fun k => norm_nonneg _) (fun k => ?_) hMu
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hbound k
  have hlim' := ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal hlim
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_order.1 hlim').1 a ha'] with k hk
  unfold sepPerG
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hk (le_iSup₂_of_le X ⟨hXs, hXc, hXV, hXn⟩ le_rfl)

informal_problem.statement: (S : ℕ → Set E3) (hS : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (S k)) (hbd : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (S k) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C) : ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (K : Set E3), StrictMono ψ ∧ MeasurableSet K ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (S (ψ k)) K ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ)) atTop (𝓝 0)

signature.name: sepSets_locally_compact_subseq
signature.statement: (S : ℕ → Set E3) (hS : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (S k)) (hbd : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ k in atTop, sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (S k) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C) : ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (K : Set E3), StrictMono ψ ∧ MeasurableSet K ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (S (ψ k)) K ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ)) atTop (𝓝 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have H : ∀ (m : ℕ) (Φ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono Φ → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ k →
        volume (symmDiff (S (Φ (φ n))) (S (Φ (φ k))) ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((m : ℝ) + 1)) <
          ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    intro m Φ hΦ
    obtain ⟨r, hr_def⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = 2 * ((m : ℝ) + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hr : 0 < r := by rw [hr_def]; positivity
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd (3 * r) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 hC
    have hmod : ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : E3), ‖h‖ ≤ r →
        volume (symmDiff (S (Φ (n + k₀))) ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S (Φ (n + k₀))) ∩ ball 0 r) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * max C 0) * ‖h‖) := by
      intro n h hh
      have h1 := sepPerG_one_translate_le (S (Φ (n + k₀))) 0 h r (hS _) hr hh
      have h2 : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (S (Φ (n + k₀)))
          (Metric.ball 0 (3 * r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (max C 0) :=
        (hk₀ _ (le_trans (Nat.le_add_left k₀ n) (hΦ.id_le _))).trans
          (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_max_left _ _))
      calc _ ≤ _ := h1
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ‖h‖) * ENNReal.ofReal (max C 0) := mul_le_mul_left' h2 _
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * max C 0) * ‖h‖) := by
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
          congr 1
          ring
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hcau⟩ := sepSets_cauchy_subseq 0 r (2 * max C 0) hr
      (fun n => S (Φ (n + k₀))) (fun n => hS _) hmod
    have hr2 : r / 2 = (m : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [hr_def]; ring
    refine ⟨fun n => φ n + k₀, fun a b hab => Nat.add_lt_add_right (hφ hab) k₀, ?_⟩
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hcau ε hε
    refine ⟨N, fun n k hn hk => ?_⟩
    have h := hN n k hn hk
    rw [hr2] at h
    exact h
  
  choose φ hφmono hφcau using H
  obtain ⟨seq, hseqS⟩ : ∃ seq : ℕ → {Φ : ℕ → ℕ // StrictMono Φ}, ∀ m,
      seq (m + 1) = ⟨(seq m).1 ∘ φ m (seq m).1 (seq m).2,
        (seq m).2.comp (hφmono m (seq m).1 (seq m).2)⟩ :=
    ⟨fun m => Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => {Φ : ℕ → ℕ // StrictMono Φ}) ⟨id, strictMono_id⟩
      (fun m P => ⟨P.1 ∘ φ m P.1 P.2, P.2.comp (hφmono m P.1 P.2)⟩) m, fun m => rfl⟩
  have hstep : ∀ m i, (seq (m + 1)).1 i = (seq m).1 (φ m (seq m).1 (seq m).2 i) := by
    intro m i
    rw [hseqS m]
    rfl
  have hcauM : ∀ (m : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ k →
      volume (symmDiff (S ((seq (m + 1)).1 n)) (S ((seq (m + 1)).1 k)) ∩
        Metric.ball 0 ((m : ℝ) + 1)) < ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    intro m ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hφcau m (seq m).1 (seq m).2 ε hε
    refine ⟨N, fun n k hn hk => ?_⟩
    rw [hstep m n, hstep m k]
    exact hN n k hn hk
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, ∀ n, ψ n = (seq (n + 1)).1 n :=
    ⟨fun n => (seq (n + 1)).1 n, fun n => rfl⟩
  have hψ : StrictMono ψ := by
    refine strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun n => ?_
    rw [hψdef n, hψdef (n + 1), hstep (n + 1)]
    exact (seq (n + 1)).2 (lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self n) ((hφmono _ _ _).id_le _))
  have htail : ∀ m n, m ≤ n → ∀ i, ∃ j, i ≤ j ∧ (seq (n + 1)).1 i = (seq (m + 1)).1 j := by
    intro m n hmn
    induction n, hmn using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => intro i; exact ⟨i, le_rfl, rfl⟩
    | succ n hmn ih =>
      intro i
      obtain ⟨j, hij, hj⟩ := ih (φ (n + 1) (seq (n + 1)).1 (seq (n + 1)).2 i)
      refine ⟨j, le_trans ((hφmono _ _ _).id_le i) hij, ?_⟩
      rw [hstep (n + 1) i, hj]
  have hcau : ∀ (m : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n k : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ k →
      volume (symmDiff (S (ψ n)) (S (ψ k)) ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((m : ℝ) + 1)) <
        ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    intro m ε hε
    obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := hcauM m ε hε
    refine ⟨max N₀ m, fun n k hn hk => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hnj, hj⟩ := htail m n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn) n
    obtain ⟨j', hkj, hj'⟩ := htail m k (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk) k
    rw [hψdef n, hψdef k, hj, hj']
    exact hN₀ j j' (le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn) hnj)
      (le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk) hkj)
  
  have hlim : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ L : Set E3, MeasurableSet L ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (S (ψ n)) L ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((m : ℝ) + 1)))
        atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    fun m => sepSets_limit_of_cauchy (Metric.ball 0 ((m : ℝ) + 1)) (fun n => S (ψ n))
      (fun n => hS _) (hcau m)
  choose L hLm hLconv using hlim
  
  have hover : ∀ m M : ℕ, m ≤ M →
      volume (symmDiff (L m) (L M) ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((m : ℝ) + 1)) = 0 := by
    intro m M hmM
    have hmM' : (m : ℝ) ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast hmM
    have hball : Metric.ball (0 : E3) ((m : ℝ) + 1) ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ((M : ℝ) + 1) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
    have hT := (hLconv m).add (hLconv M)
    rw [add_zero] at hT
    refine le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto' hT fun n => ?_) (zero_le _)
    refine (measure_mono ?_).trans (measure_union_le _ _)
    rintro x ⟨hx, hxB⟩
    have hxB' := hball hxB
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_symmDiff] at hx ⊢
    by_cases hxT : x ∈ S (ψ n) <;> tauto
  obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : Set E3,
      K = ⋃ m : ℕ, (L m ∩ (Metric.ball 0 ((m : ℝ) + 1) \ Metric.ball 0 (m : ℝ))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKm : MeasurableSet K := by
    rw [hKdef]
    exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun m => (hLm m).inter (measurableSet_ball.diff measurableSet_ball)
  have hKiff : ∀ x : E3, x ∈ K ↔ x ∈ L ⌊‖x‖⌋₊ := by
    intro x
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
    rw [hKdef, Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨m, hxL, hx1, hx2⟩
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hx1 hx2
      have hfl : ⌊‖x‖⌋₊ = m := (Nat.floor_eq_iff h0).2 ⟨le_of_not_gt hx2, hx1⟩
      rw [hfl]
      exact hxL
    · intro hx
      refine ⟨⌊‖x‖⌋₊, hx, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]; exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]; exact not_lt.2 (Nat.floor_le h0)
  have hKL : ∀ M : ℕ, volume (symmDiff K (L M) ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((M : ℝ) + 1)) = 0 := by
    intro M
    refine measure_mono_null (t := ⋃ m : ℕ,
      (symmDiff (L m) (L M) ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((m : ℝ) + 1)) ∩ {_x : E3 | m ≤ M}) ?_ ?_
    · rintro x ⟨hx, hxB⟩
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hxB
      have hle : ⌊‖x‖⌋₊ ≤ M := by
        have : ⌊‖x‖⌋₊ < M + 1 := (Nat.floor_lt h0).2 (by push_cast; exact hxB)
        omega
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⌊‖x‖⌋₊, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hle⟩
      · rw [Set.mem_symmDiff, ← hKiff x]
        rw [Set.mem_symmDiff] at hx
        exact hx
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]; exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    · refine measure_iUnion_null fun m => ?_
      by_cases hm : m ≤ M
      · exact measure_mono_null Set.inter_subset_left (hover m M hm)
      · have hempty : {_x : E3 | m ≤ M} = ∅ := by
          ext x; simp [hm]
        rw [hempty, Set.inter_empty, measure_empty]
  
  refine ⟨ψ, K, hψ, hKm, fun ρ hρ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℕ, M = ⌈ρ⌉₊ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρM : ρ < (M : ℝ) + 1 := by
    have := Nat.le_ceil ρ
    rw [← hMdef] at this
    linarith
  have hball : Metric.ball (0 : E3) ρ ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ((M : ℝ) + 1) :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball hρM.le
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds (hLconv M)
    (fun n => zero_le _) (fun n => ?_)
  show volume (symmDiff (S (ψ n)) K ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ) ≤
    volume (symmDiff (S (ψ n)) (L M) ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((M : ℝ) + 1))
  calc volume (symmDiff (S (ψ n)) K ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ)
      ≤ volume ((symmDiff (S (ψ n)) (L M) ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((M : ℝ) + 1)) ∪
          (symmDiff K (L M) ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((M : ℝ) + 1))) := by
        apply measure_mono
        rintro x ⟨hx, hxB⟩
        have hxB' := hball hxB
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_symmDiff] at hx ⊢
        by_cases hxL : x ∈ L M <;> tauto
    _ ≤ volume (symmDiff (S (ψ n)) (L M) ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((M : ℝ) + 1)) +
          volume (symmDiff K (L M) ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((M : ℝ) + 1)) := measure_union_le _ _
    _ = volume (symmDiff (S (ψ n)) (L M) ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((M : ℝ) + 1)) := by
        rw [hKL M, add_zero]

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerG_one_translate_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(S : Set E3) (y h : E3) (r : ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hh : ‖h‖ ≤ r) :
    volume (symmDiff S ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S) ∩ ball y r) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ‖h‖) *
        sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (ball y (3 * r))

subgoal_signatures.name: sepSets_cauchy_subseq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(y : E3) (r C : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (S : ℕ → Set E3)
    (hS : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (S n))
    (hmod : ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : E3), ‖h‖ ≤ r →
      volume (symmDiff (S n) ((fun x => x + h) ⁻¹' S n) ∩ ball y r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ‖h‖)) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      volume (symmDiff (S (φ n)) (S (φ m)) ∩ ball y (r / 2)) < ENNReal.ofReal ε

subgoal_signatures.name: sepSets_limit_of_cauchy
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(B : Set E3) (T : ℕ → Set E3) (hT : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (T n))
    (hcau : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m : ℕ, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      volume (symmDiff (T n) (T m) ∩ B) < ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
    ∃ L : Set E3, MeasurableSet L ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => volume (symmDiff (T n) L ∩ B)) atTop (𝓝 0)

informal_problem.statement: (f : ℝ → ENNReal) (hf : Monotone f) (hfin : ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊤) : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ b : ENNReal, f x < b → ∃ y : ℝ, x < y ∧ f y < b

signature.name: sepMonotone_ae_rightCont
signature.statement: (f : ℝ → ENNReal) (hf : Monotone f) (hfin : ∀ x, f x ≠ ⊤) : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ b : ENNReal, f x < b → ∃ y : ℝ, x < y ∧ f y < b

proof.tactics:
by
  have hS : {x | ¬ContinuousAt f x}.Countable := hf.countable_not_continuousAt
  filter_upwards [hS.ae_notMem volume] with x hx
  intro b hb
  have hc : ContinuousAt f x := by
    simpa using hx
  have h1 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y < b := hc.tendsto.eventually (eventually_lt_nhds hb)
  have h2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[>] x, f y < b := h1.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have h3 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝[>] x, x < y := self_mem_nhdsWithin
  obtain ⟨y, hxy, hyb⟩ := (h3.and h2).exists
  exact ⟨y, hxy, hyb⟩

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hclose : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 100) (S V : Set E3) (hV : V ⊆ U) : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V ≤ 2 * sepPerG G S V ∧ sepPerG G S V ≤ 2 * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V

signature.name: sepPerG_one_compare
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hclose : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 100) (S V : Set E3) (hV : V ⊆ U) : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V ≤ 2 * sepPerG G S V ∧ sepPerG G S V ≤ 2 * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have htrip : ∀ a b c A B C : ℝ, |a| ≤ A → |b| ≤ B → |c| ≤ C → |a * b * c| ≤ A * B * C := by
    intro a b c A B C ha hb hc
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul ha hb (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha)) hc
      (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha) ((abs_nonneg _).trans hb))
  
  have hdetB : ∀ M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |M i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 100) →
      9 / 10 ≤ M.det ∧ M.det ≤ 11 / 10 := by
    intro M hM
    have d0 : |M 0 0 - 1| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 0 0
    have d1 : |M 1 1 - 1| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 1 1
    have d2 : |M 2 2 - 1| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 2 2
    have o01 : |M 0 1| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 0 1
    have o02 : |M 0 2| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 0 2
    have o10 : |M 1 0| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 1 0
    have o12 : |M 1 2| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 1 2
    have o20 : |M 2 0| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 2 0
    have o21 : |M 2 1| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 2 1
    obtain ⟨d0l, d0u⟩ := abs_le.mp d0
    obtain ⟨d1l, d1u⟩ := abs_le.mp d1
    obtain ⟨d2l, d2u⟩ := abs_le.mp d2
    have a0 : |M 0 0| ≤ 101 / 100 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have a1 : |M 1 1| ≤ 101 / 100 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have a2 : |M 2 2| ≤ 101 / 100 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have p1 : (99 / 100 : ℝ) * (99 / 100) ≤ M 0 0 * M 1 1 :=
      mul_le_mul (by linarith) (by linarith) (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have p2 : (99 / 100 : ℝ) * (99 / 100) * (99 / 100) ≤ M 0 0 * M 1 1 * M 2 2 :=
      mul_le_mul p1 (by linarith) (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have pu := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ a0 a1 a2)
    have t1 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ a0 o12 o21)
    have t2 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o01 o10 a2)
    have t3 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o01 o12 o20)
    have t4 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o02 o10 o21)
    have t5 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o02 a1 o20)
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    constructor
    · linarith [pu.1, pu.2, t1.1, t1.2, t2.1, t2.2, t3.1, t3.2, t4.1, t4.2, t5.1, t5.2]
    · linarith [pu.1, pu.2, t1.1, t1.2, t2.1, t2.2, t3.1, t3.2, t4.1, t4.2, t5.1, t5.2]
  
  have hpair : ∀ a x y : ℝ, |a| ≤ 1 / 100 → |a * x * y| ≤ 1 / 100 * ((x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) / 2) := by
    intro a x y ha
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, mul_assoc]
    have h1 : |x| * |y| ≤ (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) / 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|x| - |y|), sq_abs x, sq_abs y]
    exact mul_le_mul ha h1 (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (by norm_num)
  have hquad : ∀ M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |M i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 100) → ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      97 / 100 * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * v i * v j ∧
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * v i * v j ≤ 103 / 100 * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 := by
    intro M hM v
    have d0 : |M 0 0 - 1| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 0 0
    have d1 : |M 1 1 - 1| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 1 1
    have d2 : |M 2 2 - 1| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 2 2
    have o01 : |M 0 1| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 0 1
    have o02 : |M 0 2| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 0 2
    have o10 : |M 1 0| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 1 0
    have o12 : |M 1 2| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 1 2
    have o20 : |M 2 0| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 2 0
    have o21 : |M 2 1| ≤ 1 / 100 := by simpa using hM 2 1
    have q00 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 0) (v 0) d0)
    have q11 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 1) (v 1) d1)
    have q22 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 2) (v 2) d2)
    have q01 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 0) (v 1) o01)
    have q02 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 0) (v 2) o02)
    have q10 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 1) (v 0) o10)
    have q12 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 1) (v 2) o12)
    have q20 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 2) (v 0) o20)
    have q21 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 2) (v 1) o21)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    constructor
    · linarith [q00.1, q11.1, q22.1, q01.1, q02.1, q10.1, q12.1, q20.1, q21.1]
    · linarith [q00.2, q11.2, q22.2, q01.2, q02.2, q10.2, q12.2, q20.2, q21.2]
  
  have hsmul : ∀ (h : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U → ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X →
      tsupport X ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => h z • X z) := by
    intro h hh X hX hXU
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ U
    · exact (hh.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).smul hX.contDiffAt
    · have hz' : z ∉ tsupport X := fun h' => hz (hXU h')
      have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).mp hz'
      have hev' : (fun w => h w • X w) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (fun _ => (0 : E3)) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
        rw [hw, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev'
  
  have hdetC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := by
    have hfun : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y => G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2
        - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2
        + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0 + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1
        - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
    rw [hfun]
    have e1 := ((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 2)
    have e2 := ((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 1)
    have e3 := ((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 2)
    have e4 := ((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 0)
    have e5 := ((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 1)
    have e6 := ((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 0)
    exact ((((e1.sub e2).sub e3).add e4).add e5).sub e6
  have hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det := fun y hy => by
    linarith [(hdetB _ (hclose y hy)).1]
  have hsqrtC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) U :=
    hdetC.sqrt (fun y hy => (hpos y hy).ne')
  have hinvC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (Real.sqrt (G y).det)⁻¹) U :=
    hsqrtC.inv (fun y hy => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos y hy)).ne')
  
  have hsq1 : ∀ y v : E3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y i j * v i * v j = ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 := by
    intro y v
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply]
    ring
  
  have hK : ∀ G1 G2 : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ X : E3 → E3, (ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ V ∧
        ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G1 y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →
        ∃ Y : E3 → E3, (ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ V ∧
          ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G2 y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) ∧
          ∀ y, sepDensDiv G2 Y y = 1 / 2 * sepDensDiv G1 X y) →
      sepPerG G1 S V ≤ 2 * sepPerG G2 S V := by
    intro G1 G2 hT
    unfold sepPerG
    refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
    obtain ⟨Y, hY, hd⟩ := hT X hX
    have hint : ∫ y in S, sepDensDiv G1 X y = 2 * ∫ y in S, sepDensDiv G2 Y y := by
      simp_rw [hd]
      rw [integral_const_mul]
      ring
    rw [hint, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num), ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]
    refine mul_le_mul_left' ?_ 2
    exact le_iSup_of_le Y (le_iSup_of_le hY le_rfl)
  
  have hD : ∀ (G1 G2 : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X1 X2 : E3 → E3),
      (∀ z (i : Fin 3), Real.sqrt (G2 z).det * X2 z i = 1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (G1 z).det * X1 z i)) →
      ∀ y, sepDensDiv G2 X2 y = 1 / 2 * sepDensDiv G1 X1 y := by
    intro G1 G2 X1 X2 h y
    unfold sepDensDiv
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have hf : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G2 z).det * X2 z i) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (fun z => Real.sqrt (G1 z).det * X1 z i) := by
      funext z
      rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h z i]
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hf, fderiv_const_smul_of_field]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have dir1 : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V ≤ 2 * sepPerG G S V := by
    refine hK (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) G fun X hX => ?_
    obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXV, hXb⟩ := hX
    have hX0 : ∀ z, z ∉ U → X z = 0 := fun z hz =>
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h' => hz (hV (hXV h')))
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : E3 → ℝ, a = fun z => 1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (G z).det)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have haz : ∀ z, a z = 1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (G z).det)⁻¹ := fun z => by rw [ha]
    have haC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U := by
      rw [ha]
      exact contDiffOn_const.mul hinvC
    refine ⟨fun z => a z • X z, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, hD _ _ _ _ ?_⟩
    · exact hsmul a haC X hXs (hXV.trans hV)
    · refine hXc.mono ?_
      intro z hz h0
      apply hz
      show a z • X z = 0
      rw [h0, smul_zero]
    · exact (tsupport_smul_subset_right _ _).trans hXV
    · intro y
      show ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (a y • X y) i * (a y • X y) j ≤ 1
      have hYi : ∀ i : Fin 3, (a y • X y) i = a y * X y i := fun i => by simp
      simp only [hYi]
      have hexp : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (a y * X y i) * (a y * X y j) =
          a y ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [hexp]
      by_cases hy : y ∈ U
      · have hX1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, X y i ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
          have h := hXb y
          rwa [hsq1 y (X y)] at h
        have hQ := hquad (G y) (hclose y hy) (fun i => X y i)
        have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, X y i ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
        have hQ0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j := by
          nlinarith [hQ.1]
        have hdy := hdetB (G y) (hclose y hy)
        have hdpos : 0 < (G y).det := hpos y hy
        have hinv : (G y).det⁻¹ ≤ 10 / 9 := by
          rw [inv_le_comm₀ hdpos (by norm_num)]
          calc (10 / 9 : ℝ)⁻¹ = 9 / 10 := by norm_num
            _ ≤ _ := hdy.1
        have ha2 : a y ^ 2 ≤ 5 / 18 := by
          rw [haz y, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hdpos.le]
          nlinarith [hinv]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 ha2) hQ0, hQ.2, hX1]
      · simp [hX0 y hy]
    · intro z i
      show Real.sqrt (G z).det * (a z • X z) i =
        1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt ((1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)).det * X z i)
      by_cases hz : z ∈ U
      · have hr : Real.sqrt (G z).det ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos z hz)).ne'
        simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.det_one, Real.sqrt_one, haz z]
        rw [show Real.sqrt (G z).det * (1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (G z).det)⁻¹ * X z i) =
          1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * (Real.sqrt (G z).det)⁻¹) * X z i by ring,
          mul_inv_cancel₀ hr]
        ring
      · simp [hX0 z hz]
  
  have dir2 : sepPerG G S V ≤ 2 * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V := by
    refine hK G (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) fun Y hY => ?_
    obtain ⟨hYs, hYc, hYV, hYb⟩ := hY
    have hY0 : ∀ z, z ∉ U → Y z = 0 := fun z hz =>
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h' => hz (hV (hYV h')))
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : E3 → ℝ, b = fun z => 1 / 2 * Real.sqrt (G z).det := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hbz : ∀ z, b z = 1 / 2 * Real.sqrt (G z).det := fun z => by rw [hb]
    have hbC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b U := by
      rw [hb]
      exact contDiffOn_const.mul hsqrtC
    refine ⟨fun z => b z • Y z, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, hD _ _ _ _ ?_⟩
    · exact hsmul b hbC Y hYs (hYV.trans hV)
    · refine hYc.mono ?_
      intro z hz h0
      apply hz
      show b z • Y z = 0
      rw [h0, smul_zero]
    · exact (tsupport_smul_subset_right _ _).trans hYV
    · intro y
      show ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y i j *
        (b y • Y y) i * (b y • Y y) j ≤ 1
      rw [hsq1 y (b y • Y y)]
      have hYi : ∀ i : Fin 3, (b y • Y y) i = b y * Y y i := fun i => by simp
      simp only [hYi]
      have hexp : ∑ i : Fin 3, (b y * Y y i) ^ 2 = b y ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, Y y i ^ 2 := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [hexp]
      by_cases hy : y ∈ U
      · have hQ := hquad (G y) (hclose y hy) (fun i => Y y i)
        have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, Y y i ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
        have hdy := hdetB (G y) (hclose y hy)
        have hdpos : 0 < (G y).det := hpos y hy
        have hb2 : b y ^ 2 ≤ 11 / 40 := by
          rw [hbz y, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hdpos.le]
          nlinarith [hdy.2]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hb2) hs0, hQ.1, hYb y]
      · simp [hY0 y hy]
    · intro z i
      show Real.sqrt ((1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)).det * (b z • Y z) i =
        1 / 2 * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i)
      simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.det_one, Real.sqrt_one, hbz z]
      ring
  exact ⟨dir1, dir2⟩

informal_problem.statement: (S V : Set E3) (hS : MeasurableSet S) : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) Sᶜ V = sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V

signature.name: sepPerG_one_compl
signature.statement: (S V : Set E3) (hS : MeasurableSet S) : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) Sᶜ V = sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hD : ∀ (X : E3 → E3) (y : E3),
      sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X y
        = ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun z => X z i) y (e i) := by
    intro X y
    simp [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
  
  have hneg : ∀ (X : E3 → E3) (y : E3),
      sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (-X) y
        = -sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X y := by
    intro X y
    rw [hD, hD, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    have h1 : (fun z => (-X) z i) = -(fun z => X z i) := by
      funext z
      simp
    rw [h1, fderiv_neg, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply]
  
  have hint : ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X →
      Integrable (sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X) ∧
      ∫ y, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X y = 0 := by
    intro X hX hc
    have hpi : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => X z i) y (e i)) ∧
        ∫ y, fderiv ℝ (fun z => X z i) y (e i) = 0 := by
      intro i
      have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hX
      have h2 : HasCompactSupport (fun z => X z i) :=
        hc.comp_left (g := fun v : E3 => v i) (by simp)
      have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (fun z => X z i) := h1.differentiable (by simp)
      have hcont : Continuous (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => X z i) y (e i)) :=
        (h1.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
      have hcs : HasCompactSupport (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => X z i) y (e i)) :=
        h2.fderiv_apply ℝ (e i)
      have hI : Integrable (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => X z i) y (e i)) :=
        hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs
      have hIg : Integrable (fun z => X z i) :=
        h1.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport h2
      refine ⟨hI, ?_⟩
      have key := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
