            (fun z => ψ n z • X z) y) + ENNReal.ofReal (2 * M * L) := ENNReal.ofReal_add_le
        _ ≤ _ := add_le_add hadm le_rfl
    have hpt : ∀ y, Tendsto (fun n => ψ n y) atTop
        (𝓝 ((Metric.closedBall x t)ᶜ.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y)) := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : dist y x ≤ t
      · have hyc : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x t := hy
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun hc => absurd hyc hc)]
        have : (fun n => ψ n y) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          funext n; exact hψ0 n y (by linarith [hh n])
        rw [this]
        exact tendsto_const_nhds
      · have hyc : y ∈ (Metric.closedBall x t)ᶜ := hy
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyc]
        push_neg at hy
        refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
        filter_upwards [hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (sub_pos.2 hy))] with n hn
        exact (hψ1 n y (by linarith)).symm
    have hlimD := dom_lim F (Metric.closedBall x t)ᶜ D ψ measurableSet_closedBall.compl hD
      (fun n => (hψs n).continuous) (fun n => habs _ (hψ01 n)) hpt
    rw [(sphere_congr F x t D).1] at hlimD
    exact le_of_tendsto' (ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal hlimD) hbd
  · 
    intro t' htt'
    refine iSup₂_le fun X hXadm => ?_
    obtain ⟨hX, hXc, -, hXn⟩ := hXadm
    set D := sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X with hDdef
    have hD : Integrable D := divOne_integrable X hX hXc
    have hex : ∀ n, ∃ R : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ R ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ R y ∧ R y ≤ 1) ∧
        (∀ y, dist y x ≤ t → R y = 0) ∧ (∀ y, t + h n ≤ dist y x → R y = 1) ∧
        (∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ R y‖ ≤ (Metric.closedBall x (t + h n) \ Metric.ball x t).indicator
          (fun _ => M / ((t + h n) - t)) y) :=
      fun n => hcut x t (t + h n) ht.le (by linarith [hh n])
    choose R hRs hR01 hR0 hR1 hRd using hex
    set χ : ℕ → E3 → ℝ := fun n y => 1 - R n y with hχ
    have hχs : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ n) := fun n => contDiff_const.sub (hRs n)
    have hχ01 : ∀ n y, 0 ≤ χ n y ∧ χ n y ≤ 1 := fun n y =>
      ⟨by simp only [hχ]; linarith [(hR01 n y).2], by simp only [hχ]; linarith [(hR01 n y).1]⟩
    have hχd : ∀ n y, ‖fderiv ℝ (χ n) y‖ ≤
        (Metric.closedBall x (t + h n) \ Metric.ball x t).indicator
          (fun _ => M / ((t + h n) - t)) y := by
      intro n y
      have : fderiv ℝ (χ n) y = -fderiv ℝ (R n) y := fderiv_const_sub 1
      rw [this, norm_neg]
      exact hRd n y
    have hχsupp : ∀ n, tsupport (χ n) ⊆ Metric.closedBall x (t + h n) := by
      intro n
      apply closure_minimal _ Metric.isClosed_closedBall
      intro y hy
      by_contra hc
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, not_le] at hc
      apply hy
      show 1 - R n y = 0
      rw [hR1 n y hc.le]
      ring
    have hbd : ∀ n, ∫ y in F, χ n y * D y ≤
        (∫ y in F, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
            (fun z => χ n z • X z) y) + 2 * M * L := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨hFA, hFAle⟩ := hann n _ subset_rfl
      have hest := prod_est F _ X (χ n) (M / ((t + h n) - t))
        (measurableSet_closedBall.diff measurableSet_ball) hFA hX hXc hXn (hχs n)
        (habs _ (hχ01 n)) (hχd n)
      have hK0 : 0 ≤ M / ((t + h n) - t) := div_nonneg hM0 (by linarith [hh n])
      have hKL : M / ((t + h n) - t) * (L * h n) = M * L := by
        have e1 : (t + h n) - t = h n := by ring
        rw [e1]
        field_simp [(hh n).ne']
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hFAle hK0
      have h2 : M * L ≤ 2 * M * L := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hM0 hL]
      rw [hDdef]
      linarith
    have hev : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in F, χ n y * D y) ≤
        sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball x t') +
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 * M * L) := by
      filter_upwards [hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (sub_pos.2 htt'))] with n hn
      have hsub : Metric.closedBall x (t + h n) ⊆ Metric.ball x t' :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
      have hadm := hle (fun z => χ n z • X z) (Metric.ball x t') ((hχs n).smul hX)
        (hcs _ X hXc)
        (fun y hy => hsub (hχsupp n (tsupport_smul_subset_left _ _ hy)))
        (hsmul_n X (χ n) (hχ01 n) hXn)
      calc ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in F, χ n y * D y)
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ y in F, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
            (fun z => χ n z • X z) y) + 2 * M * L) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hbd n)
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in F, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
            (fun z => χ n z • X z) y) + ENNReal.ofReal (2 * M * L) := ENNReal.ofReal_add_le
        _ ≤ _ := add_le_add hadm le_rfl
    have hpt : ∀ y, Tendsto (fun n => χ n y) atTop
        (𝓝 ((Metric.closedBall x t).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y)) := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : dist y x ≤ t
      · have hyc : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x t := hy
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyc]
        have : (fun n => χ n y) = fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
          funext n; simp only [hχ]; rw [hR0 n y hy]; ring
        rw [this]
        exact tendsto_const_nhds
      · have hyc : y ∉ Metric.closedBall x t := hy
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyc]
        push_neg at hy
        refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
        filter_upwards [hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (sub_pos.2 hy))] with n hn
        simp only [hχ]
        rw [hR1 n y (by linarith)]
        ring
    have hlimD := dom_lim F (Metric.closedBall x t) D χ measurableSet_closedBall hD
      (fun n => (hχs n).continuous) (fun n => habs _ (hχ01 n)) hpt
    rw [(sphere_congr F x t D).2] at hlimD
    exact le_of_tendsto (ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal hlimD) hev

informal_problem.statement: (m : ℝ → ℝ) (s c₁ : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hmono : Monotone m) (hpos : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < s → 0 < m t) (hder : ∀ᵐ t ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ), 0 < t → t < s → ∀ d : ℝ, HasDerivAt m d t → c₁ * m t ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) ≤ d) : (c₁ / 3) ^ 3 * s ^ 3 ≤ m s

signature.name: sepMono_cube_growth
signature.statement: (m : ℝ → ℝ) (s c₁ : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hc₁ : 0 < c₁) (hmono : Monotone m) (hpos : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < s → 0 < m t) (hder : ∀ᵐ t ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ), 0 < t → t < s → ∀ d : ℝ, HasDerivAt m d t → c₁ * m t ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) ≤ d) : (c₁ / 3) ^ 3 * s ^ 3 ≤ m s

proof.tactics:
by
  have hlim : ∀ (K M : ℝ), (∀ x : ℝ, 0 < x → x < s → K * x ^ 3 ≤ M) → K * s ^ 3 ≤ M := by
    intro K M h
    have ht : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => K * x ^ 3) (nhdsWithin s (Set.Iio s))
        (nhds (K * s ^ 3)) :=
      ((continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow 3)).tendsto s).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    refine le_of_tendsto ht ?_
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsLT hs] with x hx
    exact h x hx.1 hx.2
  apply hlim
  intro x hx0 hxs
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = (s - x) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = (s + x) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by rw [ha]; linarith
  have hab : a ≤ b := by rw [ha, hb]; linarith
  have hbs : b < s := by rw [hb]; linarith
  have hba : b - a = x := by rw [ha, hb]; ring
  have hposI : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 < m u :=
    fun u hu => hpos u (by linarith [hu.1]) (by linarith [hu.2])
  have hfmono : MonotoneOn (fun u => m u ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) (Set.Icc a b) := by
    intro u hu v _ huv
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (hposI u hu).le (hmono huv) (by norm_num)
  have hderiv : ∀ t d : ℝ, 0 < m t → HasDerivAt m d t → c₁ * m t ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) ≤ d →
      c₁ / 3 ≤ deriv (fun u => m u ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) t := by
    intro t d hm hd hle
    have h1 := hd.rpow_const (p := (1 : ℝ) / 3) (Or.inl hm.ne')
    rw [h1.deriv]
    have hA : 0 < m t ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3 - 1) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hm _
    have hid : m t ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) * m t ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3 - 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hm]; norm_num
    have h2 : c₁ * m t ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) * m t ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3 - 1) ≤
        d * m t ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3 - 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle hA.le
    have h3 : c₁ * m t ^ ((2 : ℝ) / 3) * m t ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3 - 1) = c₁ := by
      rw [mul_assoc, hid, mul_one]
    linarith
  have hae : ∀ᵐ t ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ), t ∈ Set.Icc a b →
      c₁ / 3 ≤ deriv (fun u => m u ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) t := by
    filter_upwards [hder, hmono.ae_differentiableAt] with t h1 h2
    intro htI
    have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith [htI.1]
    have hts : t < s := by linarith [htI.2]
    exact hderiv t (deriv m t) (hposI t htI) h2.hasDerivAt
      (h1 ht0 hts (deriv m t) h2.hasDerivAt)
  have hf' : MonotoneOn (fun u => m u ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) (Set.uIcc a b) := by
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab]; exact hfmono
  have hfab : m a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) ≤ m b ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) :=
    hfmono ⟨le_rfl, hab⟩ ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩ hab
  have hD : 0 ≤ m b ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) - m a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by linarith
  have hI2 : (∫ u in a..b, deriv (fun u => m u ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) u) ≤
      m b ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) - m a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := by
    have hI := hf'.intervalIntegral_deriv_mem_uIcc
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.1 hI with h | h
    · exact h.2
    · have h2 : (∫ u in a..b, deriv (fun u => m u ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) u) ≤ 0 := h.2
      linarith
  have hlow : (∫ _ in a..b, (c₁ / 3)) ≤
      ∫ u in a..b, deriv (fun u => m u ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) u :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mono_ae_restrict hab intervalIntegrable_const
      hf'.intervalIntegrable_deriv ((MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).2 hae)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, hba] at hlow
  have hfa : 0 < m a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hposI a ⟨le_rfl, hab⟩) _
  have hmb := hposI b ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩
  have h3 : (c₁ / 3 * x) ^ 3 ≤ (m b ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) ^ 3 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) 3
  have hcube : (m b ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3)) ^ 3 = m b := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hmb.le]; norm_num
  calc (c₁ / 3) ^ 3 * x ^ 3 = (c₁ / 3 * x) ^ 3 := by ring
    _ ≤ m b := h3.trans hcube.le
    _ ≤ m s := hmono hbs.le

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P : E3 → E3) (Q₀ : Set E3) (hQ₀ : IsOpen Q₀) (hP : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * P z i)) (hPc : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * P z i)) (hfr : ∀ y ∈ frontier Q₀, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, P z = 0) : ∫ z in Q₀, sepDensDiv G P z = 0

signature.name: ccs_flux_zero
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P : E3 → E3) (Q₀ : Set E3) (hQ₀ : IsOpen Q₀) (hP : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * P z i)) (hPc : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * P z i)) (hfr : ∀ y ∈ frontier Q₀, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, P z = 0) : ∫ z in Q₀, sepDensDiv G P z = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hibp : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 w → HasCompactSupport w → ∀ v : E3,
      Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ w x v) ∧ ∫ x, fderiv ℝ w x v = 0 := by
    intro w hw hwc v
    have hI : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ w x v) :=
      ((hw.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hwc.fderiv_apply ℝ v)
    have hJ : Integrable w := hw.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hwc
    refine ⟨hI, ?_⟩
    have h := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
      (f := fun _ : E3 => (1 : ℝ)) (g := w) (v := v)
      (by simp) (by simpa using hI) (by simpa using hJ) (differentiable_const _)
      (hw.differentiable one_ne_zero)
    simpa using h
  
  have hind : ∀ k : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 k → HasCompactSupport k →
      (∀ y ∈ frontier Q₀, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, k z = 0) →
      ContDiff ℝ 1 (Q₀.indicator k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (Q₀.indicator k) ∧
      ∀ y v : E3, fderiv ℝ (Q₀.indicator k) y v = Q₀.indicator (fun z => fderiv ℝ k z v) y := by
    intro k hk hkc hkfr
    have hloc : ∀ y, (y ∈ Q₀ ∧ Q₀.indicator k =ᶠ[𝓝 y] k) ∨
        (y ∉ Q₀ ∧ Q₀.indicator k =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ Q₀
      · left
        exact ⟨hy, Filter.eventually_of_mem (hQ₀.mem_nhds hy)
          (fun z hz => Set.indicator_of_mem hz k)⟩
      · right
        refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
        by_cases hc : y ∈ closure Q₀
        · have hyf : y ∈ frontier Q₀ := by rw [hQ₀.frontier_eq]; exact ⟨hc, hy⟩
          filter_upwards [hkfr y hyf] with z hz
          exact Set.indicator_apply_eq_zero.mpr (fun _ => hz)
        · filter_upwards [isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hc] with z hz
          exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hz (subset_closure h)) k
    refine ⟨contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr (fun y => ?_),
      hkc.mono' (fun x hx => subset_tsupport k (fun h0 => hx (by simp [Set.indicator_apply, h0]))),
      fun y v => ?_⟩
    · rcases hloc y with ⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩
      · exact hk.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq h
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq h
    · rcases hloc y with ⟨hy, h⟩ | ⟨hy, h⟩
      · rw [h.fderiv_eq, Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
      · rw [h.fderiv_eq, Set.indicator_of_notMem hy]
        simp
  
  have hk0 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ y ∈ frontier Q₀, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, Real.sqrt (G z).det * P z i = 0 := by
    intro i y hy
    filter_upwards [hfr y hy] with z hz
    rw [hz]
    simp
  have hzero : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ∫ z in Q₀, fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * P z i) z (e i) = 0 := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hind _ (hP i) (hPc i) (hk0 i)
    rw [← integral_indicator hQ₀.measurableSet]
    have hfun : (Q₀.indicator fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * P z i) z (e i)) =
        fun z => fderiv ℝ (Q₀.indicator fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * P z i) z (e i) := by
      funext z
      rw [h3]
    rw [hfun]
    exact (hibp _ h1 h2 (e i)).2
  have hint : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)),
      Integrable (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * P z i) z (e i))
        (volume.restrict Q₀) :=
    fun i _ => (hibp _ (hP i) (hPc i) (e i)).1.integrableOn
  unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
  rw [integral_finset_sum _ hint]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => hzero i)

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V W₁ W₂ : E3 → E3) (h₁ h₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, V z i = h₁ z * W₁ z i + h₂ z * W₂ z i) (hh₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ h₁ y) (hh₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ h₂ y) (hW₁ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₁ z i) y) (hW₂ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₂ z i) y) : sepDensDiv G V y = h₁ y * sepDensDiv G W₁ y + Real.sqrt (G y).det * fderiv ℝ h₁ y (W₁ y) + (h₂ y * sepDensDiv G W₂ y + Real.sqrt (G y).det * fderiv ℝ h₂ y (W₂ y))

signature.name: ccs_div_local
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V W₁ W₂ : E3 → E3) (h₁ h₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, V z i = h₁ z * W₁ z i + h₂ z * W₂ z i) (hh₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ h₁ y) (hh₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ h₂ y) (hW₁ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₁ z i) y) (hW₂ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₂ z i) y) : sepDensDiv G V y = h₁ y * sepDensDiv G W₁ y + Real.sqrt (G y).det * fderiv ℝ h₁ y (W₁ y) + (h₂ y * sepDensDiv G W₂ y + Real.sqrt (G y).det * fderiv ℝ h₂ y (W₂ y))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hev : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
      (fun z => h₁ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₁ z i) +
        h₂ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₂ z i)) := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [hloc] with z hz
    rw [hz i]; ring
  have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) y =
      h₁ y * partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₁ z i) y
        + (Real.sqrt (G y).det * W₁ y i) * fderiv ℝ h₁ y (e i)
        + (h₂ y * partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₂ z i) y
        + (Real.sqrt (G y).det * W₂ y i) * fderiv ℝ h₂ y (e i)) := by
    intro i
    have d₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h₁ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₁ z i)) y :=
      hh₁.mul (hW₁ i)
    have d₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h₂ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₂ z i)) y :=
      hh₂.mul (hW₂ i)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [(hev i).fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_add d₁ d₂,
      fderiv_fun_mul hh₁ (hW₁ i), fderiv_fun_mul hh₂ (hW₂ i)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    try ring
  have hbasis : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : E3),
      L w = w 0 * L (e 0) + w 1 * L (e 1) + w 2 * L (e 2) := by
    intro L w
    have hw : w = w 0 • e 0 + w 1 • e 1 + w 2 • e 2 := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hw]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  unfold sepDensDiv
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hpd]
  rw [hbasis (fderiv ℝ h₁ y) (W₁ y), hbasis (fderiv ℝ h₂ y) (W₂ y)]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (Ft At U' : Set E3) (a b c D₀ D₁ σ : E3 → ℝ) (hFm : MeasurableSet Ft) (hAm : MeasurableSet At) (hUm : MeasurableSet U') (hAU : At ⊆ U') (ha : Integrable a) (hb : Integrable b) (hc : Integrable c) (hσ : ∀ z, σ z = (U' \ At).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - At.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) (hD₀ : ∀ z, D₀ z = a z + b z) (hD₁ : ∀ z, D₁ z = a z + σ z * c z) (hb0 : ∀ z, z ∉ U' → b z = 0) (hbA : ∫ z in At, b z = 0) (hcA : ∫ z in At, c z = 0) : (∫ z in Ft, D₁ z) - ∫ z in (Ft \ U') ∪ At, D₀ z = ∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ U', (σ z * a z + c z)

signature.name: ccs_int_identity
signature.statement: (Ft At U' : Set E3) (a b c D₀ D₁ σ : E3 → ℝ) (hFm : MeasurableSet Ft) (hAm : MeasurableSet At) (hUm : MeasurableSet U') (hAU : At ⊆ U') (ha : Integrable a) (hb : Integrable b) (hc : Integrable c) (hσ : ∀ z, σ z = (U' \ At).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - At.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) (hD₀ : ∀ z, D₀ z = a z + b z) (hD₁ : ∀ z, D₁ z = a z + σ z * c z) (hb0 : ∀ z, z ∉ U' → b z = 0) (hbA : ∫ z in At, b z = 0) (hcA : ∫ z in At, c z = 0) : (∫ z in Ft, D₁ z) - ∫ z in (Ft \ U') ∪ At, D₀ z = ∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ U', (σ z * a z + c z)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hBm : MeasurableSet (U' \ At) := hUm.diff hAm
  have hS0m : MeasurableSet ((Ft \ U') ∪ At) := (hFm.diff hUm).union hAm
  have hSm : MeasurableSet (symmDiff Ft At ∩ U') := (hFm.symmDiff hAm).inter hUm
  have hσu : ∀ (u : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3),
      σ z * u z = (U' \ At).indicator u z - At.indicator u z := by
    intro u z
    rw [hσ z]
    simp only [Set.indicator_apply]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  have hσc : Integrable (fun z => σ z * c z) :=
    ((hc.indicator hBm).sub (hc.indicator hAm)).congr
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        exact (hσu c z).symm)
  have hσa : Integrable (fun z => σ z * a z) :=
    ((ha.indicator hBm).sub (ha.indicator hAm)).congr
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        exact (hσu a z).symm)
  have hD1i : Integrable D₁ :=
    (ha.add hσc).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      exact (hD₁ z).symm)
  have hD0i : Integrable D₀ :=
    (ha.add hb).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      exact (hD₀ z).symm)
  have hEi : Integrable (fun z => σ z * a z + c z) := hσa.add hc
  have hpt : ∀ z, Ft.indicator D₁ z - ((Ft \ U') ∪ At).indicator D₀ z
      - (symmDiff Ft At ∩ U').indicator (fun z => σ z * a z + c z) z
      = -(At.indicator b z + At.indicator c z) := by
    intro z
    simp only [Set.indicator_apply, hD₁ z, hD₀ z, hσ z, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff,
      Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_symmDiff]
    by_cases hF : z ∈ Ft <;> by_cases hA : z ∈ At <;> by_cases hU : z ∈ U'
    all_goals first
      | exact absurd (hAU hA) hU
      | (simp only [hF, hA, hU, if_true, if_false, true_and, and_true, not_true, not_false_eq_true,
          and_false, false_and, or_false, false_or, true_or, or_true]
         (try rw [hb0 z hU])
         ring)
  have key : ∫ z, (Ft.indicator D₁ z - ((Ft \ U') ∪ At).indicator D₀ z
      - (symmDiff Ft At ∩ U').indicator (fun z => σ z * a z + c z) z) = 0 := by
    simp only [hpt]
    rw [integral_neg, integral_add (hb.indicator hAm) (hc.indicator hAm),
      integral_indicator hAm, integral_indicator hAm, hbA, hcA]
    simp
  rw [integral_sub (f := fun z => Ft.indicator D₁ z - ((Ft \ U') ∪ At).indicator D₀ z)
      ((hD1i.indicator hFm).sub (hD0i.indicator hS0m)) (hEi.indicator hSm),
    integral_sub (hD1i.indicator hFm) (hD0i.indicator hS0m), integral_indicator hFm,
    integral_indicator hS0m, integral_indicator hSm] at key
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (r₁ η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (calTheta r₁ η) ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ calTheta r₁ η t) ∧ (∀ t, calTheta r₁ η t ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ t, t ≤ r₁ + η / 2 → calTheta r₁ η t = 0) ∧ Monotone (calTheta r₁ η) ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ deriv (calTheta r₁ η) t)

signature.name: ccs_theta_props
signature.statement: (r₁ η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (calTheta r₁ η) ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ calTheta r₁ η t) ∧ (∀ t, calTheta r₁ η t ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ t, t ≤ r₁ + η / 2 → calTheta r₁ η t = 0) ∧ Monotone (calTheta r₁ η) ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ deriv (calTheta r₁ η) t)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdef : calTheta r₁ η = fun t => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((t - r₁) / η) - 1) := by
    funext t; rfl
  have ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => 2 * ((t - r₁) / η) - 1) := by fun_prop
  have hmono : Monotone (calTheta r₁ η) := by
    intro s t hst
    rw [hdef]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.monotone
    have : (s - r₁) / η ≤ (t - r₁) / η :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hη.le
    linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hmono, fun t => hmono.deriv_nonneg⟩
  · rw [hdef]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ha
  · intro t; rw [hdef]; exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
  · intro t; rw [hdef]; exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
  · intro t ht
    rw [hdef]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    have h1 : (t - r₁) / η ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hη]; linarith
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: (T T' : Set E3) (f : E3 → ℝ) (Xt : E3 → E3) (r₁ η : ℝ) (hT : IsOpen T) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (hη : 0 < η) (hT'o : IsOpen T') (hT'f : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ ≤ f z → z ∈ T') (hXt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xt T') : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i) T

signature.name: ccs_thetaX_smooth
signature.statement: (T T' : Set E3) (f : E3 → ℝ) (Xt : E3 → E3) (r₁ η : ℝ) (hT : IsOpen T) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (hη : 0 < η) (hT'o : IsOpen T') (hT'f : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ ≤ f z → z ∈ T') (hXt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xt T') : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i) T

proof.tactics:
by
  intro i
  have hAff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => 2 * ((t - r₁) / η) - 1) :=
    (contDiff_const.mul ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const η)).sub contDiff_const
  have hθ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (calTheta r₁ η) := by
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((t - r₁) / η) - 1))
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp hAff
  have hθf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => calTheta r₁ η (f z)) T := hθ.comp_contDiffOn hf
  have hzero : ∀ t : ℝ, t < r₁ + η / 2 → calTheta r₁ η t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    show Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((t - r₁) / η) - 1) = 0
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    have h1 : (t - r₁) / η ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hη]
      linarith
    linarith
  have hXi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Xt z i) T' := (contDiffOn_piLp 2).1 hXt i
  apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
  intro z hz
  rcases lt_or_ge r₁ (f z) with h | h
  · refine ⟨T', hT'o, hT'f z hz h.le, ?_⟩
    exact (hθf.mono Set.inter_subset_left).mul (hXi.mono Set.inter_subset_right)
  · refine ⟨T ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Iio (r₁ + η / 2), hf.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Iio,
      ⟨hz, show f z < r₁ + η / 2 by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
    refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr ?_
    intro w hw
    have hw' : f w < r₁ + η / 2 := hw.2.2
    simp only [hzero (f w) hw', zero_mul]

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T C : Set E3) (V : E3 → E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCT : C ⊆ T) (hV0 : ∀ z, z ∉ T → V z = 0) (hVC : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∉ C → V z = 0) (hV : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => V z i) T) : (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i)) ∧ Integrable (sepDensDiv G V)

signature.name: ccs_field_regular
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T C : Set E3) (V : E3 → E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCT : C ⊆ T) (hV0 : ∀ z, z ∉ T → V z = 0) (hVC : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∉ C → V z = 0) (hV : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => V z i) T) : (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i)) ∧ Integrable (sepDensDiv G V)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) T := by
    have h := ((((((hG 0 0).mul ((hG 1 1).mul (hG 2 2))).sub ((hG 0 0).mul ((hG 1 2).mul (hG 2 1)))).sub
      ((hG 0 1).mul ((hG 1 0).mul (hG 2 2)))).add ((hG 0 1).mul ((hG 1 2).mul (hG 2 0)))).add
      ((hG 0 2).mul ((hG 1 0).mul (hG 2 1)))).sub ((hG 0 2).mul ((hG 1 1).mul (hG 2 0)))
    refine h.congr (fun z _ => ?_)
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]; ring
  have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) T :=
    hdetS.sqrt (fun z hz => (hdet z hz).ne')
  
  have hvan : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ z, z ∉ C → Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i = 0 := by
    intro i z hz
    by_cases hzT : z ∈ T
    · rw [hVC z hzT hz]; simp
    · rw [hV0 z hzT]; simp
  
  have hk : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) := by
    intro i
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hzT : z ∈ T
    · exact (hs.mul (hV i)).contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hzT)
    · have hzC : z ∉ C := fun h => hzT (hCT h)
      have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hC.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hzC) (fun w hw => hvan i w hw)
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hks : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) :=
    fun i => HasCompactSupport.intro hC (fun z hz => hvan i z hz)
  refine ⟨fun i => ⟨hk i, hks i⟩, ?_⟩
  have hterm : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable
      (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) y) := by
    intro i
    have hc : Continuous (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) y (e i)) :=
      ((hk i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport
        (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * V z i) y (e i)) :=
      (hks i).fderiv_apply ℝ (e i)
    exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs
  unfold sepDensDiv
  exact integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hterm i)

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T T' : Set E3) (f ψ sig d : E3 → ℝ) (Yt Xt Zt W₀ P₁ Q' : E3 → E3) (r₁ η : ℝ) (z : E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => G w i j) T) (hdet : ∀ w ∈ T, 0 < (G w).det) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (hη : 0 < η) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ T) (hψ0 : 0 ≤ ψ z) (hT'o : IsOpen T') (hT'T : T' ⊆ T) (hYt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt T) (hXt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xt T') (hz : z ∈ T') (hsig : sig z = 1 ∨ sig z = -1) (hCS : |fderiv ℝ f z (Yt z)| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (Xt z)) (hW₀ : ∀ w ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₀ w i = ψ w * Yt w i) (hP₁ : ∀ w ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, P₁ w i = ψ w * ((1 - calTheta r₁ η (f w)) * Yt w i)) (hQ' : ∀ w ∈ T', ∀ i : Fin 3, Q' w i = ψ w * (calTheta r₁ η (f w) * Xt w i)) (hZt : ∀ i : Fin 3, Zt z i = calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i) (hd : d z = ψ z * sepDensDiv G Xt z) : calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z + Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z) + (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z - calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z)) ≤ sig z * sepDensDiv G P₁ z + sepDensDiv G Q' z

signature.name: ccs_layer_pointwise
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T T' : Set E3) (f ψ sig d : E3 → ℝ) (Yt Xt Zt W₀ P₁ Q' : E3 → E3) (r₁ η : ℝ) (z : E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => G w i j) T) (hdet : ∀ w ∈ T, 0 < (G w).det) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (hη : 0 < η) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ T) (hψ0 : 0 ≤ ψ z) (hT'o : IsOpen T') (hT'T : T' ⊆ T) (hYt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt T) (hXt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xt T') (hz : z ∈ T') (hsig : sig z = 1 ∨ sig z = -1) (hCS : |fderiv ℝ f z (Yt z)| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (Xt z)) (hW₀ : ∀ w ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₀ w i = ψ w * Yt w i) (hP₁ : ∀ w ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, P₁ w i = ψ w * ((1 - calTheta r₁ η (f w)) * Yt w i)) (hQ' : ∀ w ∈ T', ∀ i : Fin 3, Q' w i = ψ w * (calTheta r₁ η (f w) * Xt w i)) (hZt : ∀ i : Fin 3, Zt z i = calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i) (hd : d z = ψ z * sepDensDiv G Xt z) : calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z + Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z) + (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z - calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z)) ≤ sig z * sepDensDiv G P₁ z + sepDensDiv G Q' z

proof.tactics:
by
  have hzT : z ∈ T := hT'T hz
  have hTz : T ∈ 𝓝 z := hT.mem_nhds hzT
  have hT'z : T' ∈ 𝓝 z := hT'o.mem_nhds hz
  
  have hdefθ : calTheta r₁ η = fun t => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((t - r₁) / η) - 1) := by
    funext t; rfl
  have hθs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (calTheta r₁ η) := by
    rw [hdefθ]
    have ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => 2 * ((t - r₁) / η) - 1) := by fun_prop
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ha
  have hθmono : Monotone (calTheta r₁ η) := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [hdefθ]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.monotone
    have : (a - r₁) / η ≤ (b - r₁) / η := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hη.le
    linarith
  
  have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det) T := by
    have h := hG
    have hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
        - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
        + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0) T :=
      (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
        (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
        (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
    have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) T :=
      hP.congr (fun z _ => Matrix.det_fin_three (G z))
    exact hdetS.sqrt (fun z hz => (hdet z hz).ne')
  
  have ccs_div_local : ∀ (V W₁ W₂ : E3 → E3) (h₁ h₂ : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, ∀ i : Fin 3, V w i = h₁ w * W₁ w i + h₂ w * W₂ w i) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ h₁ z → DifferentiableAt ℝ h₂ z →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * W₁ w i) z) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * W₂ w i) z) →
      sepDensDiv G V z = h₁ z * sepDensDiv G W₁ z + Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ h₁ z (W₁ z) +
        (h₂ z * sepDensDiv G W₂ z + Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ h₂ z (W₂ z)) := by
    intro V W₁ W₂ h₁ h₂ hloc hh₁ hh₂ hW₁ hW₂
    have hev : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * V w i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (fun w => h₁ w * (Real.sqrt (G w).det * W₁ w i) +
          h₂ w * (Real.sqrt (G w).det * W₂ w i)) := by
      intro i
      filter_upwards [hloc] with w hw
      rw [hw i]; ring
    have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * V w i) z =
        h₁ z * partialDeriv i (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * W₁ w i) z
          + (Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₁ z i) * fderiv ℝ h₁ z (e i)
          + (h₂ z * partialDeriv i (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * W₂ w i) z
          + (Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₂ z i) * fderiv ℝ h₂ z (e i)) := by
      intro i
      have d₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => h₁ w * (Real.sqrt (G w).det * W₁ w i)) z :=
        hh₁.mul (hW₁ i)
      have d₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => h₂ w * (Real.sqrt (G w).det * W₂ w i)) z :=
        hh₂.mul (hW₂ i)
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [(hev i).fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_add d₁ d₂,
        fderiv_fun_mul hh₁ (hW₁ i), fderiv_fun_mul hh₂ (hW₂ i)]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      try ring
    have hbasis : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : E3),
        L w = w 0 * L (e 0) + w 1 * L (e 1) + w 2 * L (e 2) := by
      intro L w
      have hw : w = w 0 • e 0 + w 1 • e 1 + w 2 • e 2 := by
        ext j
        fin_cases j <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      conv_lhs => rw [hw]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    unfold sepDensDiv
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hpd]
    rw [hbasis (fderiv ℝ h₁ z) (W₁ z), hbasis (fderiv ℝ h₂ z) (W₂ z)]
    ring
  have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z := (hf.contDiffAt hTz).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z := (hψ.contDiffAt hTz).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hθd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (calTheta r₁ η) (f z) := hθs.differentiable (by simp) (f z)
  have hθf : HasFDerivAt (fun w => calTheta r₁ η (f w))
      (deriv (calTheta r₁ η) (f z) • fderiv ℝ f z) z :=
    hθd.hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt z hfd.hasFDerivAt
  have hYi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => Yt w i) T := fun i => (contDiffOn_piLp 2).1 hYt i
  have hXi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => Xt w i) T' :=
    fun i => (contDiffOn_piLp 2).1 hXt i
  have hWd : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * W₀ w i) z := by
    intro i
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * (ψ w * Yt w i)) z :=
      ((hs.mul (hψ.mul (hYi i))).contDiffAt hTz).differentiableAt (by simp)
    refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hTz] with w hw
    rw [hW₀ w hw i]
  have hXd : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * Xt w i) z := fun i =>
    (((hs.mono hT'T).mul (hXi i)).contDiffAt hT'z).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hlocP : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, ∀ i : Fin 3, P₁ w i =
      (fun w => 1 - calTheta r₁ η (f w)) w * W₀ w i + (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) w * W₀ w i := by
    filter_upwards [hTz] with w hw
    intro i
    rw [hP₁ w hw i, hW₀ w hw i]; ring
  have hdP := ccs_div_local P₁ W₀ W₀ (fun w => 1 - calTheta r₁ η (f w)) (fun _ => 0) hlocP
    ((differentiableAt_const 1).sub hθf.differentiableAt) (differentiableAt_const 0) hWd hWd
  have hlocQ : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, ∀ i : Fin 3, Q' w i =
      (fun w => ψ w * calTheta r₁ η (f w)) w * Xt w i + (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) w * Xt w i := by
    filter_upwards [hT'z] with w hw
    intro i
    rw [hQ' w hw i]; ring
  have hdQ := ccs_div_local Q' Xt Xt (fun w => ψ w * calTheta r₁ η (f w)) (fun _ => 0) hlocQ
    (hψd.mul hθf.differentiableAt) (differentiableAt_const 0) hXd hXd
  have hF1 : fderiv ℝ (fun w => 1 - calTheta r₁ η (f w)) z =
      -(deriv (calTheta r₁ η) (f z) • fderiv ℝ f z) := by
    rw [fderiv_const_sub, hθf.fderiv]
  have hF2 : fderiv ℝ (fun w => ψ w * calTheta r₁ η (f w)) z =
      ψ z • (deriv (calTheta r₁ η) (f z) • fderiv ℝ f z) + calTheta r₁ η (f z) • fderiv ℝ ψ z := by
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hψd hθf.differentiableAt, hθf.fderiv]
  have hF0 : fderiv ℝ (fun _ : E3 => (0:ℝ)) z = 0 := by simp
  have hW₀z : W₀ z = ψ z • Yt z := PiLp.ext (fun i => by rw [hW₀ z hzT i]; simp)
  have hZz : Zt z = calTheta r₁ η (f z) • Xt z := PiLp.ext (fun i => by rw [hZt i]; simp)
  rw [hdP, hdQ, hF1, hF2, hF0, hW₀z, hZz, hd]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul', Pi.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, map_smul,
    smul_eq_mul]
  have ha : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (G z).det := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have ht' : 0 ≤ deriv (calTheta r₁ η) (f z) := hθmono.deriv_nonneg
  have hp3 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (G z).det * ψ z * deriv (calTheta r₁ η) (f z) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hψ0) ht'
  rcases hsig with h | h
  · rw [h]
    have hg : 0 ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (Xt z) - fderiv ℝ f z (Yt z) := by
      have := le_abs_self (fderiv ℝ f z (Yt z)); linarith
    have key := mul_nonneg hp3 hg
    nlinarith [key]
  · rw [h]
    have hg : 0 ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (Xt z) + fderiv ℝ f z (Yt z) := by
      have := neg_abs_le (fderiv ℝ f z (Yt z)); linarith
    have key := mul_nonneg hp3 hg
    nlinarith [key]

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) T

signature.name: ccs_sqrtdet_smooth
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) T

proof.tactics:
by
  have h := hG
  have hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
      - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
      + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0) T :=
    (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
      (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
      (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
  have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) T :=
    hP.congr (fun z _ => Matrix.det_fin_three (G z))
  exact hdetS.sqrt (fun z hz => (hdet z hz).ne')

informal_problem.statement: (F : Set E3) (ν : E3) (θ τ₀ ρ₀ : ℝ) (hν : ‖ν‖ = 1) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ2 : θ ≤ 1 / 2) (hτ₀ : 0 < τ₀) (hτθ : τ₀ ≤ θ / 16) (hρ₀ : 0 < ρ₀) (hdec : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ n : E3, ‖n‖ = 1 ∧ ‖n - ν‖ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ n (z - x)| ≤ (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) ∧ volume ((Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ n (z - x) < -((τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))}) \ F) = 0 ∧ volume (Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) < @inner ℝ E3 _ n (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0) : ∃ n : E3 → E3, ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ‖n x‖ = 1 ∧ ‖n x - ν‖ ≤ 3 / 8 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x)| ≤ (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) ∧ volume ((Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x) < -((5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))}) \ F) = 0 ∧ volume (Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) < @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0

signature.name: sepSlab_normal_limit
signature.statement: (F : Set E3) (ν : E3) (θ τ₀ ρ₀ : ℝ) (hν : ‖ν‖ = 1) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ2 : θ ≤ 1 / 2) (hτ₀ : 0 < τ₀) (hτθ : τ₀ ≤ θ / 16) (hρ₀ : 0 < ρ₀) (hdec : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ n : E3, ‖n‖ = 1 ∧ ‖n - ν‖ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ n (z - x)| ≤ (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) ∧ volume ((Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ n (z - x) < -((τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))}) \ F) = 0 ∧ volume (Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) < @inner ℝ E3 _ n (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0) : ∃ n : E3 → E3, ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ‖n x‖ = 1 ∧ ‖n x - ν‖ ≤ 3 / 8 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x)| ≤ (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) ∧ volume ((Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x) < -((5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))}) \ F) = 0 ∧ volume (Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) < @inner ℝ E3 _ (n x) (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsc : ∀ (x m m' : E3) (r c : ℝ), ‖m‖ = 1 → ‖m'‖ = 1 → 0 < r → 0 ≤ c →
      volume ((Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m (z - x) < -c}) \ F) = 0 →
      volume (Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | c < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0 →
      ‖m - m'‖ * r ≤ 2 * c := by
    intro x m m' r c hm hm' hr hc h1 h2
    by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℝ, ‖m' - m‖ = d := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hdd : ‖m - m'‖ = d := by rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact hd
    rw [hdd] at hlt
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := by rw [← hd]; exact norm_nonneg _
    have hdpos : 0 < d := by
      rcases hd0.lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact h
      · rw [← h] at hlt; linarith
    have hmm : @inner ℝ E3 _ m m' = 1 - d ^ 2 / 2 := by
      have h := norm_sub_sq_real m' m
      rw [hm, hm', hd, real_inner_comm] at h
      linarith
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = (r * d + 2 * c) / (2 * d ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have htpos : 0 < t := by rw [ht]; positivity
    have htd : t * d = (r * d + 2 * c) / (2 * d) := by
      rw [ht]; field_simp; try ring
    have htd2 : t * (d ^ 2 / 2) = (r * d + 2 * c) / 4 := by
      rw [ht]; field_simp; try ring
    have hwx : (x + t • (m' - m)) - x = t • (m' - m) := by abel
    have e1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ m' ((x + t • (m' - m)) - x) = t * (d ^ 2 / 2) := by
      rw [hwx, real_inner_smul_right, inner_sub_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hm',
        real_inner_comm, hmm]
      ring
    have e2 : @inner ℝ E3 _ m ((x + t • (m' - m)) - x) = -(t * (d ^ 2 / 2)) := by
      rw [hwx, real_inner_smul_right, inner_sub_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hm, hmm]
      ring
    have hnorm : ‖(x + t • (m' - m)) - x‖ = t * d := by
      rw [hwx, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos htpos, hd]
    have key1 : t * d < r := by
      rw [htd, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith
    have key2 : c < t * (d ^ 2 / 2) := by
      rw [htd2]; linarith
    have hO : IsOpen (Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m (z - x) < -c} ∩
        {z | c < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (z - x)}) := by
      refine (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter ?_).inter ?_
      · exact isOpen_lt (continuous_const.inner (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))
          continuous_const
      · exact isOpen_lt continuous_const
          (continuous_const.inner (continuous_id.sub continuous_const))
    have hwO : x + t • (m' - m) ∈ Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m (z - x) < -c} ∩
        {z | c < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (z - x)} := by
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hnorm]; exact key1
      · show @inner ℝ E3 _ m ((x + t • (m' - m)) - x) < -c
        rw [e2]; linarith
      · show c < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' ((x + t • (m' - m)) - x)
        rw [e1]; exact key2
    have hpos := hO.measure_pos volume ⟨_, hwO⟩
    have hsub : Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m (z - x) < -c} ∩
        {z | c < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (z - x)} ⊆
        ((Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m (z - x) < -c}) \ F) ∪
        (Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | c < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (z - x)} ∩ F) := by
      rintro z ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz3⟩
      by_cases hzF : z ∈ F
      · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hz1, hz3⟩, hzF⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hzF⟩
    have h0 := MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null hsub (MeasureTheory.measure_union_null h1 h2)
    exact absurd h0 hpos.ne'
  have hθ1 : θ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  
  have H : ∀ x : E3, ∃ L : E3, ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      ‖L‖ = 1 ∧ ‖L - ν‖ ≤ 3 / 8 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ,
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
          |@inner ℝ E3 _ L (z - x)| ≤ (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) ∧
        volume ((Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ L (z - x) <
          -((5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))}) \ F) = 0 ∧
        volume (Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ∩ {z | (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) <
          @inner ℝ E3 _ L (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 ∧ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)
    swap
    · exact ⟨ν, fun h1 h2 => absurd ⟨h1, h2⟩ hx⟩
    obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := hx
    choose u hu1 hu2 hu3 hu4 hu5 using hdec x hx1 hx2
    have hstep : ∀ k : ℕ, dist (u k) (u (k + 1)) ≤ (2 * τ₀ / θ) * (1 / 2) ^ k := by
      intro k
      have hθk : 0 < θ ^ k := pow_pos hθ k
      have hrk : 0 < ρ₀ * θ ^ (k + 1) := by positivity
      have hc : 0 ≤ (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) := by positivity
      have hball : Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ (k + 1)) ⊆ Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) := by
        apply Metric.ball_subset_ball
        rw [pow_succ]
        have : 0 < ρ₀ * θ ^ k := by positivity
        nlinarith
      have htk : (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ (k + 1)) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ (k + 1)) ≤
          (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) := by
        have e : (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ (k + 1)) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ (k + 1)) =
            ((τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) * (θ / 2) := by
          rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; ring
        rw [e]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hc (by linarith)
      have h1 : volume ((Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ (k + 1)) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ (u k) (z - x) <
          -((τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))}) \ F) = 0 :=
        MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null
          (Set.diff_subset_diff_left (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hball)) (hu4 k)
      have h2 : volume (Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ (k + 1)) ∩ {z | (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) <
          @inner ℝ E3 _ (u (k + 1)) (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0 := by
        refine MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null ?_ (hu5 (k + 1))
        rintro z ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨hz1, lt_of_le_of_lt htk hz2⟩, hz3⟩
      have hm := hsc x (u k) (u (k + 1)) _ _ (hu1 k) (hu1 (k + 1)) hrk hc h1 h2
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have e : (2 * τ₀ / θ) * (1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ (k + 1)) =
          2 * ((τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) := by
        rw [pow_succ]; field_simp; try ring
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right (by rw [e]; exact hm) hrk
    have hcs : CauchySeq u := cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1 / 2) (2 * τ₀ / θ) (by norm_num) hstep
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hcs
    have hbound : ∀ k : ℕ, ‖u k - L‖ ≤ 4 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k := by
      intro k
      have h := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto (1 / 2) (2 * τ₀ / θ) (by norm_num) hstep hL k
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at h
      calc ‖u k - L‖ ≤ 2 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k / (1 - 1 / 2) := h
        _ = 4 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k := by ring
    have hLn : ‖L‖ = 1 := by
      have h := hL.norm
      have h' : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => ‖u k‖) Filter.atTop (𝓝 1) := by
        simp only [hu1]; exact tendsto_const_nhds
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique h h'
    have h4 : 4 * τ₀ / θ ≤ 1 / 4 := by rw [div_le_iff₀ hθ]; linarith
    refine ⟨L, fun _ _ => ⟨hLn, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩⟩
    · have hb0 := hbound 0
      rw [norm_sub_rev, pow_zero, mul_one] at hb0
      have hu20 := hu2 0
      calc ‖L - ν‖ = ‖(L - u 0) + (u 0 - ν)‖ := by rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
        _ ≤ ‖L - u 0‖ + ‖u 0 - ν‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 3 / 8 := by linarith
    · have hr : 0 < ρ₀ * θ ^ k := by positivity
      have hq : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) := by positivity
      have hτle : τ₀ ≤ τ₀ / θ := le_div_self hτ₀.le hθ hθ1
      have hs : (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) + (4 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) ≤
          (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) := by
        have e1 : (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) + (4 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) =
            (τ₀ + 4 * τ₀ / θ) * ((1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) := by ring
        have e2 : (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) =
            (τ₀ / θ + 4 * τ₀ / θ) * ((1 / 2) ^ k * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) := by ring
        rw [e1, e2]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hq
      have hest : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x (ρ₀ * θ ^ k),
          |@inner ℝ E3 _ (L - u k) (z - x)| ≤ (4 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) := by
        intro z hz
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
        calc |@inner ℝ E3 _ (L - u k) (z - x)| ≤ ‖L - u k‖ * ‖z - x‖ :=
              abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
          _ ≤ (4 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) :=
              mul_le_mul (by rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact hbound k) hz.le (norm_nonneg _)
                (by positivity)
      have hsplit : ∀ z : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ L (z - x) =
          @inner ℝ E3 _ (u k) (z - x) + @inner ℝ E3 _ (L - u k) (z - x) := by
        intro z; rw [inner_sub_left]; ring
      refine ⟨fun z hz hzS => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have a := hu3 k z hz hzS
        have b := hest z hz
        rw [hsplit]
        calc |@inner ℝ E3 _ (u k) (z - x) + @inner ℝ E3 _ (L - u k) (z - x)|
            ≤ |@inner ℝ E3 _ (u k) (z - x)| + |@inner ℝ E3 _ (L - u k) (z - x)| :=
              abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ _ := by linarith
      · refine MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null ?_ (hu4 k)
        rintro z ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz3⟩
        refine ⟨⟨hz1, ?_⟩, hz3⟩
        have hz2' : @inner ℝ E3 _ L (z - x) < -((5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) := hz2
        have b := abs_le.1 (hest z hz1)
        show @inner ℝ E3 _ (u k) (z - x) < -((τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k))
        rw [hsplit] at hz2'
        linarith [b.1]
      · refine MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null ?_ (hu5 k)
        rintro z ⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz3⟩
        refine ⟨⟨hz1, ?_⟩, hz3⟩
        have hz2' : (5 * τ₀ / θ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) < @inner ℝ E3 _ L (z - x) := hz2
        have b := abs_le.1 (hest z hz1)
        show (τ₀ * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) < @inner ℝ E3 _ (u k) (z - x)
        rw [hsplit] at hz2'
        linarith [b.2]
  choose n hn using H
  exact ⟨n, hn⟩

informal_problem.statement: (F : Set E3) (x m m' : E3) (r c : ℝ) (hm : ‖m‖ = 1) (hm' : ‖m'‖ = 1) (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h1 : volume ((Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m (z - x) < -c}) \ F) = 0) (h2 : volume (Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | c < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0) : ‖m - m'‖ ≤ 2 * c / r

signature.name: sepSlab_halfspace_normal_close
signature.statement: (F : Set E3) (x m m' : E3) (r c : ℝ) (hm : ‖m‖ = 1) (hm' : ‖m'‖ = 1) (hr : 0 < r) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h1 : volume ((Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m (z - x) < -c}) \ F) = 0) (h2 : volume (Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | c < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (z - x)} ∩ F) = 0) : ‖m - m'‖ ≤ 2 * c / r

proof.tactics:
by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  set δ := ‖m - m'‖ with hδ
  have h2cr : 0 ≤ 2 * c / r := by positivity
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := lt_of_le_of_lt h2cr hcon
  have hδr : 2 * c < r * δ := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hr] at hcon; linarith
  have hmm : @inner ℝ E3 _ m m' = 1 - δ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    have := norm_sub_sq_real m m'
    rw [hm, hm'] at this
    rw [hδ]; linarith
  have hmm1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ m m = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hm]; norm_num
  have hm'm'1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ m' m' = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hm']; norm_num
  have hcomm : @inner ℝ E3 _ m' m = @inner ℝ E3 _ m m' := real_inner_comm _ _
  have hA : @inner ℝ E3 _ m (m' - m) = -(δ ^ 2 / 2) := by
    rw [inner_sub_right, hmm, hmm1]; ring
  have hB : @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (m' - m) = δ ^ 2 / 2 := by
    rw [inner_sub_right, hcomm, hmm, hm'm'1]; ring
  have hcd : 2 * c / δ < r := (div_lt_iff₀ hδpos).2 hδr
  have hcd0 : 0 ≤ 2 * c / δ := by positivity
  set s := (r + 2 * c / δ) / 2 with hs
  have hs1 : 2 * c / δ < s := by rw [hs]; linarith
  have hs2 : s < r := by rw [hs]; linarith
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
  have hsδ : 2 * c < s * δ := (div_lt_iff₀ hδpos).1 hs1
  set t := s / δ with ht
  have ht0 : 0 < t := div_pos hs0 hδpos
  have htδ : t * δ = s := by rw [ht]; field_simp
  have hnorm' : ‖m' - m‖ = δ := by rw [hδ, norm_sub_rev]
  set z₀ := x + t • (m' - m) with hz₀
  have hzx : z₀ - x = t • (m' - m) := by rw [hz₀]; abel
  have hzball : z₀ ∈ Metric.ball x r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hzx, norm_smul, hnorm', Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos ht0, htδ]
    exact hs2
  have hz1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ m (z₀ - x) < -c := by
    rw [hzx, real_inner_smul_right, hA]
    have : t * -(δ ^ 2 / 2) = -(t * δ * δ / 2) := by ring
    rw [this, htδ]; linarith
  have hz2 : c < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (z₀ - x) := by
    rw [hzx, real_inner_smul_right, hB]
    have : t * (δ ^ 2 / 2) = t * δ * δ / 2 := by ring
    rw [this, htδ]; linarith
  let S : Set E3 := Metric.ball x r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m (z - x) < -c} ∩
    {z | c < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (z - x)}
  have hcont1 : Continuous (fun z : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ m (z - x)) := by fun_prop
  have hcont2 : Continuous (fun z : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (z - x)) := by fun_prop
  have hSopen : IsOpen S :=
    (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt hcont1 continuous_const)).inter
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const hcont2)
  have hSne : S.Nonempty := ⟨z₀, ⟨hzball, hz1⟩, hz2⟩
  have hSnull : volume S = 0 := by
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null h1 h2)
    rintro z ⟨⟨hzb, hza⟩, hzc⟩
    by_cases hzF : z ∈ F
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hzb, hzc⟩, hzF⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hzb, hza⟩, hzF⟩
  exact hSopen.measure_ne_zero volume hSne hSnull

informal_problem.statement: (F : Set E3) (ν : E3) (ρ₀ : ℝ) (hν : ‖ν‖ = 1) (hρ₀ : 0 < ρ₀) (hAB : ∀ z : E3, (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) = 0) → (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ F) = 0) → False) (hconnB : ∀ S : Set E3, IsPreconnected S → (∀ z ∈ S, ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) → ∀ p ∈ S, (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 p, volume (N \ F) = 0) → ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 q, volume (N \ F) = 0) (hconnA : ∀ S : Set E3, IsPreconnected S → (∀ z ∈ S, ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) → ∀ p ∈ S, (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 p, volume (N ∩ F) = 0) → ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 q, volume (N ∩ F) = 0) (hlip : ∀ x x' : E3, ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ‖x'‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x', volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x)| ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖(x' - x) - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x) • ν‖) (hcaps : ∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν - (ρ₀ / 4) • ν), volume (N \ F) = 0) ∧ (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + (ρ₀ / 4) • ν), volume (N ∩ F) = 0)) : ∃ U : E3 → ℝ, (∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 2 ∧ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) ∧ (∀ z z' : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → ‖z' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z' • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → |U z' - U z| ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖z' - z‖) ∧ (∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z| < ρ₀ / 4 → (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < U z → ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ F) = 0) ∧ (U z < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z → ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) = 0))

signature.name: sepSlab_graph_function
signature.statement: (F : Set E3) (ν : E3) (ρ₀ : ℝ) (hν : ‖ν‖ = 1) (hρ₀ : 0 < ρ₀) (hAB : ∀ z : E3, (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) = 0) → (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ F) = 0) → False) (hconnB : ∀ S : Set E3, IsPreconnected S → (∀ z ∈ S, ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) → ∀ p ∈ S, (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 p, volume (N \ F) = 0) → ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 q, volume (N \ F) = 0) (hconnA : ∀ S : Set E3, IsPreconnected S → (∀ z ∈ S, ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) → ∀ p ∈ S, (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 p, volume (N ∩ F) = 0) → ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 q, volume (N ∩ F) = 0) (hlip : ∀ x x' : E3, ‖x‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ‖x'‖ < ρ₀ / 2 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x', volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x)| ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖(x' - x) - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (x' - x) • ν‖) (hcaps : ∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν - (ρ₀ / 4) • ν), volume (N \ F) = 0) ∧ (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + (ρ₀ / 4) • ν), volume (N ∩ F) = 0)) : ∃ U : E3 → ℝ, (∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 2 ∧ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) ∧ (∀ z z' : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → ‖z' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z' • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → |U z' - U z| ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖z' - z‖) ∧ (∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z| < ρ₀ / 4 → (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < U z → ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ F) = 0) ∧ (U z < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z → ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) = 0))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hνν : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν ν = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hν]; norm_num
  
  have hPν : ∀ z : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν) = 0 := by
    intro z
    rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, hνν]; ring
  have hsq : ∀ (z : E3) (t : ℝ), ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ ^ 2 + t ^ 2 := by
    intro z t
    have h := norm_add_sq_real (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν) (t • ν)
    have h2 : @inner ℝ E3 _ (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν) (t • ν) = 0 := by
      rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_comm ν (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν), hPν z, mul_zero]
    have h3 : ‖t • ν‖ = |t| := by rw [norm_smul, hν, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [h2, h3, sq_abs] at h
    rw [h]; ring
  have hPle : ∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    have h1 := norm_sub_sq_real z (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν)
    have h3 : @inner ℝ E3 _ z ν = @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z := real_inner_comm ν z
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, norm_smul, hν, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, h3] at h1
    have h2 : ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z)]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg z, norm_nonneg (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν)]
  have hnorm : ∀ (z : E3) (t : ℝ), ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → |t| < ρ₀ / 4 →
      ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 2 := by
    intro z t hz ht
    have h := hsq z t
    have h4 : t ^ 2 < (ρ₀ / 4) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs t]; exact pow_lt_pow_left₀ ht (abs_nonneg t) two_ne_zero
    have h5 : ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ ^ 2 < (ρ₀ / 8) ^ 2 :=
      pow_lt_pow_left₀ hz (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero
    have h6 : ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν‖ ^ 2 < (ρ₀ / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν)]
  have hdiff : ∀ (z z' : E3) (t t' : ℝ),
      @inner ℝ E3 _ ν ((z' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z' • ν + t' • ν) - (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν))
        = t' - t ∧
      ((z' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z' • ν + t' • ν) - (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν)) -
        @inner ℝ E3 _ ν ((z' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z' • ν + t' • ν) -
          (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν)) • ν = (z' - z) - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z' - z) • ν := by
    intro z z' t t'
    have h1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν ((z' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z' • ν + t' • ν) -
        (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν)) = t' - t := by
      simp only [inner_sub_right, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, hνν]
      ring
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    rw [h1, inner_sub_right]
    simp only [sub_smul]
    abel
  
  have hseg : ∀ (y : E3) (a b : ℝ),
      IsPreconnected ((fun t : ℝ => y + t • ν) '' Set.Icc a b) := fun y a b =>
    isPreconnected_Icc.image _ (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t : ℝ => y + t • ν).continuousOn
  have hT : 0 < ρ₀ / 4 := by positivity
  have hcapB : ∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 →
      ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + (-(ρ₀ / 4)) • ν), volume (N \ F) = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have e : z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + (-(ρ₀ / 4)) • ν =
        z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν - (ρ₀ / 4) • ν := by
      rw [neg_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [e]; exact (hcaps z hz).1
  
  have hcross : ∀ z : E3, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → ∃ t : ℝ, |t| < ρ₀ / 4 ∧
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) := by
    intro z hz
    have hB := hcapB z hz
    have hA := (hcaps z hz).2
    by_contra hcon
    have hcon' : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < ρ₀ / 4 →
        ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧
          volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) := fun t ht hSg => hcon ⟨t, ht, hSg⟩
    have hfree : ∀ w ∈ (fun t : ℝ => z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν) ''
        Set.Icc (-(ρ₀ / 4)) (ρ₀ / 4),
        ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) := by
      rintro w ⟨t, ⟨ht1, ht2⟩, rfl⟩ hSg
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht1 with h1 | h1
      · subst h1
        obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := hB
        exact (hSg N hN).2 hN0
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht2 with h2 | h2
      · subst h2
        obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := hA
        exact (hSg N hN).1 hN0
      exact hcon' t (abs_lt.2 ⟨h1, h2⟩) hSg
    have hmem1 : z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + (-(ρ₀ / 4)) • ν ∈
        (fun t : ℝ => z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν) '' Set.Icc (-(ρ₀ / 4)) (ρ₀ / 4) :=
      ⟨-(ρ₀ / 4), ⟨le_refl _, by linarith⟩, rfl⟩
    have hmem2 : z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + (ρ₀ / 4) • ν ∈
        (fun t : ℝ => z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν) '' Set.Icc (-(ρ₀ / 4)) (ρ₀ / 4) :=
      ⟨ρ₀ / 4, ⟨by linarith, le_refl _⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hAB _ hA (hconnB _ (hseg _ _ _) hfree _ hmem1 hB _ hmem2)
  
  have hex : ∀ z : E3, ∃ t : ℝ, ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → (|t| < ρ₀ / 4 ∧
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧
        volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) := by
    intro z
    by_cases h : ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hcross z h
      exact ⟨t, fun _ => ht⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h' => absurd h' h⟩
  choose U hU using hex
  
  have huniq : ∀ (z : E3) (t t' : ℝ), ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν‖ < ρ₀ / 8 → |t| < ρ₀ / 4 →
      |t'| < ρ₀ / 4 →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t' • ν), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      t' = t := by
    intro z t t' hz ht ht' hSg hSg'
    have h := hlip _ _ (hnorm z t hz ht) hSg (hnorm z t' hz ht') hSg'
    rw [(hdiff z z t t').2, (hdiff z z t t').1, sub_self, inner_zero_right, zero_smul, sub_zero,
      norm_zero, mul_zero] at h
    have := abs_nonpos_iff.1 h
    linarith
  refine ⟨U, fun z hz => ⟨hnorm z (U z) hz (hU z hz).1, (hU z hz).2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z z' hz hz'
    have h := hlip _ _ (hnorm z (U z) hz (hU z hz).1) (hU z hz).2
      (hnorm z' (U z') hz' (hU z' hz').1) (hU z' hz').2
    rw [(hdiff z z' (U z) (U z')).2, (hdiff z z' (U z) (U z')).1] at h
    calc |U z' - U z| ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖(z' - z) - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z' - z) • ν‖ := h
      _ ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖z' - z‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hPle (z' - z)) (by norm_num)
  · intro z hz hs
    have huniq' : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < ρ₀ / 4 →
        (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧
          volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → t = U z :=
      fun t ht hSgt => huniq z (U z) t hz (hU z hz).1 ht (hU z hz).2 hSgt
    have hz' : z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν = z := sub_add_cancel _ _
    obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := abs_lt.1 hs
    have hB := hcapB z hz
    have hA := (hcaps z hz).2
    constructor
    · intro hlt
      have hfree : ∀ w ∈ (fun t : ℝ => z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν) ''
          Set.Icc (-(ρ₀ / 4)) (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z),
          ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) := by
        rintro w ⟨t, ⟨ht1, ht2⟩, rfl⟩ hSg
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht1 with h1 | h1
        · subst h1
          obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := hB
          exact (hSg N hN).2 hN0
        have := huniq' t (abs_lt.2 ⟨h1, by linarith⟩) hSg
        linarith
      have hmem1 : z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + (-(ρ₀ / 4)) • ν ∈
          (fun t : ℝ => z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν) ''
            Set.Icc (-(ρ₀ / 4)) (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z) :=
        ⟨-(ρ₀ / 4), ⟨le_refl _, by linarith⟩, rfl⟩
      have hmem2 : z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν ∈
          (fun t : ℝ => z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν) ''
            Set.Icc (-(ρ₀ / 4)) (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z) :=
        ⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z, ⟨by linarith, le_refl _⟩, rfl⟩
      have h := hconnB _ (hseg _ _ _) hfree _ hmem1 hB _ hmem2
      rwa [hz'] at h
    · intro hlt
      have hfree : ∀ w ∈ (fun t : ℝ => z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν) ''
          Set.Icc (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z) (ρ₀ / 4),
          ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) := by
        rintro w ⟨t, ⟨ht1, ht2⟩, rfl⟩ hSg
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht2 with h2 | h2
        · subst h2
          obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := hA
          exact (hSg N hN).1 hN0
        have := huniq' t (abs_lt.2 ⟨by linarith, h2⟩) hSg
        linarith
      have hmem1 : z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + (ρ₀ / 4) • ν ∈
          (fun t : ℝ => z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν) ''
            Set.Icc (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z) (ρ₀ / 4) :=
        ⟨ρ₀ / 4, ⟨by linarith, le_refl _⟩, rfl⟩
      have hmem2 : z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν ∈
          (fun t : ℝ => z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + t • ν) ''
            Set.Icc (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z) (ρ₀ / 4) :=
        ⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z, ⟨le_refl _, by linarith⟩, rfl⟩
      have h := hconnA _ (hseg _ _ _) hfree _ hmem1 hA _ hmem2
      rwa [hz'] at h

informal_problem.statement: (S : Set E3) (ν : E3) (n : E3 → E3) (U : E3 → ℝ) (W : Set E3) (ρ₀ θ K : ℝ) (hν : ‖ν‖ = 1) (hW : IsOpen W) (hρ₀ : 0 < ρ₀) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ2 : θ ≤ 1 / 2) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hS : ∀ z ∈ W, z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν ∈ S) (hU : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ z' ∈ W, |U z' - U z| ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖z' - z‖) (hn : ∀ z ∈ W, ‖n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν)‖ = 1 ∧ ‖n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν) - ν‖ ≤ 3 / 8 ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ w ∈ S, ‖w - (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν)‖ < ρ₀ * θ ^ k → |@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν)) (w - (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν))| ≤ (K * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k)) (hcont : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ z' ∈ W, ∀ k : ℕ, ‖(z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν) - (z' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z' • ν + U z' • ν)‖ < ρ₀ * θ ^ k / 2 → ‖n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν) - n (z' - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z' • ν + U z' • ν)‖ ≤ 8 * K * (1 / 2) ^ k) : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 U W ∧ ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ U z v = -(@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν)) ν)⁻¹ * @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν)) (v - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν v • ν)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : E3 → E3, ∀ z, X z = z - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν + U z • ν :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  simp only [← hX] at hS hn hcont ⊢
  have hθ1 : θ < 1 := by linarith
  
  have hXdiff : ∀ z z' : E3, X z' - X z =
      ((z' - z) - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z' - z) • ν) + (U z' - U z) • ν := by
    intro z z'
    rw [hX, hX, inner_sub_right, sub_smul, sub_smul]
    abel
  
  have hXlip : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ z' ∈ W, ‖X z' - X z‖ ≤ 3 * ‖z' - z‖ := by
    intro z hz z' hz'
    rw [hXdiff]
    have h1 : ‖@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z' - z) • ν‖ ≤ ‖z' - z‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, hν, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have := abs_real_inner_le_norm ν (z' - z)
      rw [hν, one_mul] at this
      exact this
    have h2 : ‖(U z' - U z) • ν‖ ≤ (1 / 4) * ‖z' - z‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, hν, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hU z hz z' hz'
    have h3 := norm_add_le ((z' - z) - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z' - z) • ν) ((U z' - U z) • ν)
    have h4 := norm_sub_le (z' - z) (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν (z' - z) • ν)
    linarith [norm_nonneg (z' - z)]
  
  have hβ : ∀ z ∈ W, 119 / 128 ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := hn z hz
    have h := norm_sub_sq_real (n (X z)) ν
    rw [h1, hν] at h
    have h3 : ‖n (X z) - ν‖ ^ 2 ≤ (3 / 8) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h2 2
    nlinarith
  
  have hscale : ∀ d : ℝ, 0 < d → d < ρ₀ → ∃ k : ℕ, ρ₀ * θ ^ (k + 1) ≤ d ∧ d < ρ₀ * θ ^ k := by
    intro d hd hdρ
    have hex : ∃ m : ℕ, ρ₀ * θ ^ (m + 1) ≤ d := by
      have ht : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ρ₀ * θ ^ (m + 1)) atTop (𝓝 (ρ₀ * 0)) :=
        ((tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hθ.le hθ1).comp
          (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)).const_mul ρ₀
      rw [mul_zero] at ht
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (ht.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hd)).exists
      exact ⟨m, hm.le⟩
    classical
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, k = Nat.find hex := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨k, by rw [hk]; exact Nat.find_spec hex, ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hk0
    · rw [hk0, pow_zero, mul_one]; exact hdρ
    · have hmin := Nat.find_min hex (show k - 1 < Nat.find hex by omega)
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hk0] at hmin
      exact lt_of_not_ge hmin
  
  have hrate : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ z' ∈ W, ∀ k₀ : ℕ, ‖X z' - X z‖ < ρ₀ * θ ^ k₀ →
      |@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) (X z' - X z)| ≤ K * (1 / 2) ^ k₀ * ‖X z' - X z‖ / θ := by
    intro z hz z' hz' k₀ hk₀
    by_cases hD : X z' - X z = 0
    · rw [hD, inner_zero_right, abs_zero, norm_zero, mul_zero, zero_div]
    have hDpos : 0 < ‖X z' - X z‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hD
    have hρθ : ρ₀ * θ ^ k₀ ≤ ρ₀ :=
      mul_le_of_le_one_right hρ₀.le (pow_le_one₀ hθ.le hθ1.le)
    obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := hscale _ hDpos (lt_of_lt_of_le hk₀ hρθ)
    have hkk : k₀ ≤ k := by
      by_contra hlt
      push_neg at hlt
      have h5 : θ ^ k₀ ≤ θ ^ (k + 1) := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hθ.le hθ1.le (by omega)
      have h6 : ρ₀ * θ ^ k₀ ≤ ρ₀ * θ ^ (k + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h5 hρ₀.le
      linarith
    have hfl := (hn z hz).2.2 k (X z') (hS z' hz') hk2
    have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (1 / 2) ^ k₀ :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hkk
    have hρk : ρ₀ * θ ^ k ≤ ‖X z' - X z‖ / θ := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hθ]
      calc ρ₀ * θ ^ k * θ = ρ₀ * θ ^ (k + 1) := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := hk1
    calc |@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) (X z' - X z)| ≤ (K * (1 / 2) ^ k) * (ρ₀ * θ ^ k) := hfl
      _ ≤ (K * (1 / 2) ^ k₀) * (‖X z' - X z‖ / θ) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf hK) hρk (by positivity) (by positivity)
      _ = K * (1 / 2) ^ k₀ * ‖X z' - X z‖ / θ := by ring
  
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : E3 → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ∀ z, Φ z =
      (-(@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν)⁻¹) •
        (innerSL ℝ (n (X z)) - (@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν) • innerSL ℝ ν) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hΦapp : ∀ z v, Φ z v = -(@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν)⁻¹ *
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) (v - @inner ℝ E3 _ ν v • ν) := by
    intro z v
    rw [hΦ]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right]
    ring
  
  have hderiv : ∀ z ∈ W, HasFDerivAt U (Φ z) z := by
    intro z hz
    have hβpos : 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hβ z hz)
    have hinv : (@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν)⁻¹ * @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν = 1 :=
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hβpos.ne'
    rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨rW, hrW, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hW z hz
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one
      (show 0 < ε * θ * @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν / (3 * K + 1) by positivity)
      (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
    have ht : 3 * K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ ≤ ε * θ * @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν := by
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hk₀
      have : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ := by positivity
      nlinarith
    have hr : 0 < min rW (ρ₀ * θ ^ k₀ / 3) := lt_min hrW (by positivity)
    rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
    refine ⟨_, hr, fun h hh => ?_⟩
    rw [dist_zero_right] at hh
    have hh1 : ‖h‖ < rW := lt_of_lt_of_le hh (min_le_left _ _)
    have hh2 : ‖h‖ < ρ₀ * θ ^ k₀ / 3 := lt_of_lt_of_le hh (min_le_right _ _)
    have hz' : z + h ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hh1)
    have hD := hXlip z hz (z + h) hz'
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at hD
    have hDlt : ‖X (z + h) - X z‖ < ρ₀ * θ ^ k₀ := by linarith
    have hR := hrate z hz (z + h) hz' k₀ hDlt
    have hid : U (z + h) - U z - Φ z h = (@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν)⁻¹ *
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) (X (z + h) - X z) := by
      rw [hΦapp, hXdiff, add_sub_cancel_left]
      simp only [inner_add_right, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right]
      linear_combination (U z - U (z + h)) * hinv
    rw [hid, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hβpos, inv_mul_le_iff₀ hβpos]
    have h3 : K * (1 / 2) ^ k₀ * ‖X (z + h) - X z‖ / θ ≤
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν * (ε * ‖h‖) := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hθ]
      have hK' : 0 ≤ K * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k₀ := by positivity
      calc K * (1 / 2) ^ k₀ * ‖X (z + h) - X z‖ ≤ K * (1 / 2) ^ k₀ * (3 * ‖h‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD hK'
        _ = (3 * K * (1 / 2) ^ k₀) * ‖h‖ := by ring
        _ ≤ (ε * θ * @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν) * ‖h‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν * (ε * ‖h‖) * θ := by ring
    linarith
  
  have hgc : ContinuousOn (fun z => n (X z)) W := by
    rw [Metric.continuousOn_iff]
    intro b hb ε hε
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (show 0 < ε / (8 * K + 1) by positivity)
      (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
    refine ⟨ρ₀ * θ ^ k / 6, by positivity, fun a ha hab => ?_⟩
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hab ⊢
    have h1 := hXlip b hb a ha
    have h2 : ‖X a - X b‖ < ρ₀ * θ ^ k / 2 := by linarith
    have h3 := hcont a ha b hb k h2
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hk
    have : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hβc : ContinuousOn (fun z => @inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν) W :=
    hgc.inner continuousOn_const
  have hΦc : ContinuousOn Φ W := by
    have e : Φ = fun z => (-(@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν)⁻¹) •
        (innerSL ℝ (n (X z)) - (@inner ℝ E3 _ (n (X z)) ν) • innerSL ℝ ν) := funext hΦ
    rw [e]
    refine ((hβc.inv₀ ?_).neg).smul
      (((innerSL ℝ).continuous.comp_continuousOn hgc).sub (hβc.smul continuousOn_const))
    intro z hz
    exact (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hβ z hz)).ne'
  have hfd : Set.EqOn (fderiv ℝ U) Φ W := fun z hz => (hderiv z hz).fderiv
  refine ⟨?_, fun z hz v => by rw [(hderiv z hz).fderiv, hΦapp]⟩
  rw [show (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) = 0 + 1 by norm_num, contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW]
  refine ⟨fun z hz => (hderiv z hz).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    exact absurd h (by decide)
  · rw [contDiffOn_zero]
    exact hΦc.congr hfd

(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U W : Set E3)
    (f : E3 → ℝ) (z₀ : E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) (hW : IsOpen W) (hWU : W ⊆ U) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ W) (hf0 : f z₀ = 0)
    (hbd : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z₀, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) :
    ((∀ z ∈ W, levelMeanCurvCoord G f z < 0) →
        volume ((W ∩ {z | f z < 0}) \ F) = 0 → False) ∧
    ((∀ z ∈ W, 0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G f z) →
        volume (W ∩ {z | 0 < f z} ∩ F) = 0 → False)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hpdn : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (k : E3 → ℝ),
      partialDeriv i (fun z => -k z) = fun z => -partialDeriv i k z := by
    intro i k
    funext z
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [show (fun z => -k z) = -k from rfl, fderiv_neg]
    rfl
  have hhess : ∀ (k : E3 → ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) (y : E3),
      hessLoc G (fun z => -k z) i j y = -hessLoc G k i j y := by
    intro k i j y
    simp only [hessLoc, hpdn]
    simp only [mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    ring
  have hlap : ∀ (k : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), lapLoc G (fun z => -k z) y = -lapLoc G k y := by
    intro k y
    simp only [lapLoc, hhess, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  have hlmc_neg : ∀ y : E3,
      levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun z => -f z) y = -levelMeanCurvCoord G f y := by
    intro y
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, hlap, hpdn, hhess, neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_neg,
      Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    ring
  
  have core : ∀ (A : Set E3) (h : E3 → ℝ) (R c : ℝ), 0 < R →
      Metric.closedBall z₀ R ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ ∞ h →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ R,
        0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a h z * partialDeriv b h z ∧
        0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G h z) →
      IsOpen A → A ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} →
      IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} \ A) →
      volume ((symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}) \
        Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2)) = 0 →
      volume (symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}) = 0 := by
    intro A h R c hR hRU hh hNH hAo hAsub hBo hloc
    have hF : MeasurableSet F := hmin.1
    have hcl : closure (Metric.ball z₀ R) = Metric.closedBall z₀ R :=
      closure_ball z₀ (ne_of_gt hR)
    have hcV : IsCompact (closure (Metric.ball z₀ R)) := by
      rw [hcl]; exact isCompact_closedBall z₀ R
    have hVU : closure (Metric.ball z₀ R) ⊆ U := by rw [hcl]; exact hRU
    have hSlt : sepPerG G F (Metric.ball z₀ R) < ⊤ :=
      hmin.2.1 _ Metric.isOpen_ball hcV hVU
    obtain ⟨hint, hbdY⟩ := sepTouch_perY_bound G F U A h z₀ R c hU hG hsymm hpd hF hR hRU hh
      hNH hAo hAsub hBo hloc hSlt.ne
    have hΩo : IsOpen {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hh.continuous)
    set Ω : Set E3 := {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} with hΩdef
    set K : Set E3 := Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2) with hKdef
    set D : Set E3 := symmDiff F A ∩ Ω with hDdef
    set F' : Set E3 := (F \ (Ω ∩ K)) ∪ (A ∩ K) with hF'def
    set I : ℝ := ∫ z in D, Real.sqrt (G z).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G h z with hIdef
    set P : ℝ := (sepPerG G F (Metric.ball z₀ R)).toReal with hPdef

(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U W : Set E3) (g : E3 → ℝ)
    (z₀ : E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)

    ∃ R ε : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ 0 < ε ∧ Metric.closedBall z₀ R ⊆ W ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ R,
        0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b *
            partialDeriv a (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z *
            partialDeriv b (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z ∧

(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U A : Set E3) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (z₀ : E3) (R c : ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U)

    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (hF : MeasurableSet F) (hR : 0 < R) (hRU : Metric.closedBall z₀ R ⊆ U)
    (hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h)
    (hNH : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ R,
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a h z * partialDeriv b h z ∧
      0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G h z)
    (hAo : IsOpen A) (hAsub : A ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z})
    (hBo : IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} \ A))

        (symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}) ∧
    ∀ Y : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y → HasCompactSupport Y → tsupport Y ⊆ Metric.ball z₀ R →

        (∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z},

      (sepPerG G F (Metric.ball z₀ R)).toReal

search_metadata.last_error: Approved at the commit gate. The glue compiles and uses both children: sepTouch_strictify gives R, eps and positive N_h, H_h in both parts, and sepTouch_perY_bound feeds core (integrability, the Y=0 instance giving I<=P, and the iSup bound on Per(F')). Blueprint steps s1 (H(-f)=-H(f)) and s4 (ENNReal minimality gap) are proved inline, and findings.md records this divergence. The [CRUX] stays in the named child sepTouch_perY_bound. Each child checks out mathematically. strictify follows from H_g(z0)>0 forcing N_g(z0)>0 plus joint continuity at (0,z0), which makes it much easier than the parent. perY_bound is the classical trace-free calibration inequality: X is the unit G-normal of h, div X = sqrt(detG) H_h, the layer term has a sign by |dh(Y)|<=dh(X), and the A=Omega case uses zero flux. Its core inequality is the formal_proved ccs_euclid_calib, whose hypotheses I checked against blueprint P4. What remains is bump selection, admissibility of W1 and two dominated-convergence limits, with no minimality or touching argument. Blueprint sections 4 and 5 contain real numerics (exact equality on calibrated balls, a strict cube case, s2 tables) and edge-case derivations F1-F12. Nothing collides with section 10, no child restates an ancestor, and the constants c=-eps R^2/4 and R/2 are derived. Note for the perY_bound prover: take the ccs_* toolkit (ccs_euclid_calib, ccs_normal_props, ccs_divx, ccs_thetaX_smooth, ccs_theta_props) as DAG edges rather than re-proving it, and split off W1 admissibility if P3 gets heavy.
