sepPerMin_partial_harnack.definitions:
def hpProj (z : E3) : E2 := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![z 1, z 2]


def hpLift (t : ℝ) (x : E2) : E3 := cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)


def hpCyl (ρ h : ℝ) : Set E3 := {z : E3 | z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2 ∧ |z 0| < h}


def hpSliceJumps (F : Set E3) (ℓ υ : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2) : Prop :=
  volume {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Ioo (-(1 / 4)) (ℓ x) ∧ hpLift t x ∉ F} = 0 ∧
  volume {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Ioo (υ x) (1 / 4) ∧ hpLift t x ∈ F} = 0 ∧
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → volume {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Ioo (ℓ x) (ℓ x + s) ∧ hpLift t x ∉ F} ≠ 0) ∧
  (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → volume {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Ioo (υ x - s) (υ x) ∧ hpLift t x ∈ F} ≠ 0)


def hpSuperSol (v : E2 → ℝ) (Λ₀ β₀ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ φ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → ∀ x₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2),
    (∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, φ x ≤ v x) → φ x₀ = v x₀ → ‖fderiv ℝ φ x₀‖ ≤ Λ₀ →
    ∑ i : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ φ y (e2 i)) x₀ (e2 i) ≤
      β₀ * (1 + ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x₀‖)


def hpHarnNorm (δ c : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (a b : ℝ),
    IsOpen U → (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) U) →
    (∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) → (∀ z ∈ U, (G z).PosDef) →
    sepIsPerMin G F U → Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) 1 ⊆ U → a ≤ b → b - a ≤ δ →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
       |G z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ δ ∧
       ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w i j) z‖ ≤ δ * (b - a)) →
    (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
       a ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ b) →
    volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | z 0 < a}) \ F) = 0 →
    volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | b < z 0} ∩ F) = 0 →
    ∃ a' b' : ℝ, a ≤ a' ∧ a' ≤ b' ∧ b' ≤ b ∧ b' - a' ≤ (1 - c) * (b - a) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 8),
        (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → a' ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ b'

  have s2 : ∀ (P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 / 6 →

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (δH cH : ℝ) (T : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < δH → 0 < cH → cH < 1 →
    (∀ A μ : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 < μ → 0 < T A μ) →
    ∃ ε₀ η₀ θ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 < η₀ ∧ 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ 0 ≤ C₀ ∧
    ∀ (F : Set E3) (ν : E3) (τ η : ℝ), 0 < τ → τ ≤ ε₀ → 0 ≤ η → η ≤ η₀ → ‖ν‖ = 1 →
    (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
       |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z| ≤ τ) →
    volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ}) \ F) = 0 →
    volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 →
    (∀ (y : E3) (r a b : ℝ), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
       0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 → a ≤ b → b - a ≤ δH * r →
       η * τ * r ^ 2 ≤ δH * (b - a) →
       (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y r, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
          a ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ b) →
       volume ((Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < a}) \ F) = 0 →
       volume (Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | b < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 →
       ∃ a' b' : ℝ, a ≤ a' ∧ a' ≤ b' ∧ b' ≤ b ∧ b' - a' ≤ (1 - cH) * (b - a) ∧
         ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y (r / 8),
           (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
           a' ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ b') →
    (∀ A μ : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 < μ → τ ≤ T A μ → η ≤ T A μ →
       ∀ (b z₀ : E3) (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : ℝ) (N : Set E3),
       @inner ℝ E3 _ b ν = 0 → (∀ i j, M i j = M j i) → (∀ i, ∑ j, M i j * ν j = 0) →
       ‖b‖ ≤ A → (∀ i j, |M i j| ≤ A) → z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) →
       (∀ N' ∈ 𝓝 z₀, volume (N' ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N' \ F) ≠ 0) →
       @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z₀ = τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z₀ + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z₀ i * z₀ j + c) →
       N ∈ 𝓝 z₀ →
       (μ ≤ ∑ i, M i i → volume ((N ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z <
           τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z i * z j + c)}) \ F) ≠ 0) ∧
       (∑ i, M i i ≤ -μ → volume (N ∩ {z | τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z +
           ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z i * z j + c) < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) ≠ 0)) →
    ∃ ν' : E3, ‖ν'‖ = 1 ∧ ‖ν' - ν‖ ≤ C₀ * τ ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
         |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z| ≤ (τ / 2) * θ) ∧
      volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z < -((τ / 2) * θ)}) \ F) = 0 ∧
      volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ ∩ {z | (τ / 2) * θ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z} ∩ F) = 0

signature.name: flatSlab_viscosity_improve
signature.statement:
∀ (δH cH : ℝ) (T : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), 0 < δH → 0 < cH → cH < 1 →
    (∀ A μ : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 < μ → 0 < T A μ) →
    ∃ ε₀ η₀ θ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 < η₀ ∧ 0 < θ ∧ θ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ 0 ≤ C₀ ∧
    ∀ (F : Set E3) (ν : E3) (τ η : ℝ), 0 < τ → τ ≤ ε₀ → 0 ≤ η → η ≤ η₀ → ‖ν‖ = 1 →
    (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
       |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z| ≤ τ) →
    volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ}) \ F) = 0 →
    volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 →
    (∀ (y : E3) (r a b : ℝ), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
       0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 → a ≤ b → b - a ≤ δH * r →
       η * τ * r ^ 2 ≤ δH * (b - a) →
       (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y r, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
          a ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ b) →
       volume ((Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < a}) \ F) = 0 →
       volume (Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | b < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 →
       ∃ a' b' : ℝ, a ≤ a' ∧ a' ≤ b' ∧ b' ≤ b ∧ b' - a' ≤ (1 - cH) * (b - a) ∧
         ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y (r / 8),
           (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
           a' ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ b') →
    (∀ A μ : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 < μ → τ ≤ T A μ → η ≤ T A μ →
       ∀ (b z₀ : E3) (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : ℝ) (N : Set E3),
       @inner ℝ E3 _ b ν = 0 → (∀ i j, M i j = M j i) → (∀ i, ∑ j, M i j * ν j = 0) →
       ‖b‖ ≤ A → (∀ i j, |M i j| ≤ A) → z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) →
       (∀ N' ∈ 𝓝 z₀, volume (N' ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N' \ F) ≠ 0) →
       @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z₀ = τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z₀ + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z₀ i * z₀ j + c) →
       N ∈ 𝓝 z₀ →
       (μ ≤ ∑ i, M i i → volume ((N ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z <
           τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z i * z j + c)}) \ F) ≠ 0) ∧
       (∑ i, M i i ≤ -μ → volume (N ∩ {z | τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z +
           ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z i * z j + c) < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) ≠ 0)) →
    ∃ ν' : E3, ‖ν'‖ = 1 ∧ ‖ν' - ν‖ ≤ C₀ * τ ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
         |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z| ≤ (τ / 2) * θ) ∧
      volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z < -((τ / 2) * θ)}) \ F) = 0 ∧
      volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ ∩ {z | (τ / 2) * θ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z} ∩ F) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro δH cH T hδH hcH hcH1 hTpos
  obtain ⟨Ch, hCh0, hCh⟩ := flatSlab_visc_harmonic_taylor
  have hδ'pos : 0 < min δH (1 / 64) := lt_min hδH (by norm_num)
  have hδ'le : min δH (1 / 64) ≤ 1 / 64 := min_le_right _ _
  have hδ'δ : min δH (1 / 64) ≤ δH := min_le_left _ _
  have hc'pos : 0 < min cH (1 / 2) := lt_min hcH (by norm_num)
  have hc'le : min cH (1 / 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
  have hc'c : min cH (1 / 2) ≤ cH := min_le_left _ _
  have hCh1 : 0 < Ch + 1 := by linarith
  
  by_contra hcon
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ (F : Set E3) (ν : E3) (τ η : ℝ), 0 < τ ∧
      τ ≤ min (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) (1 / 100) ∧ 0 ≤ η ∧
      η ≤ min (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) (8 * min δH (1 / 64)) ∧ ‖ν‖ = 1 ∧
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
         |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z| ≤ τ) ∧
      volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ}) \ F) = 0 ∧
      volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 ∧
      (∀ (y : E3) (r a b : ℝ), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
         0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 → a ≤ b → b - a ≤ δH * r →
         η * τ * r ^ 2 ≤ δH * (b - a) →
         (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y r, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
            a ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ b) →
         volume ((Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < a}) \ F) = 0 →
         volume (Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | b < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 →
         ∃ a' b' : ℝ, a ≤ a' ∧ a' ≤ b' ∧ b' ≤ b ∧ b' - a' ≤ (1 - cH) * (b - a) ∧
           ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y (r / 8),
             (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
             a' ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ b') ∧
      (∀ A μ : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 < μ → τ ≤ T A μ → η ≤ T A μ →
         ∀ (b z₀ : E3) (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : ℝ) (N : Set E3),
         @inner ℝ E3 _ b ν = 0 → (∀ i j, M i j = M j i) → (∀ i, ∑ j, M i j * ν j = 0) →
         ‖b‖ ≤ A → (∀ i j, |M i j| ≤ A) → z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) →
         (∀ N' ∈ 𝓝 z₀, volume (N' ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N' \ F) ≠ 0) →
         @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z₀ = τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z₀ + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z₀ i * z₀ j + c) →
         N ∈ 𝓝 z₀ →
         (μ ≤ ∑ i, M i i → volume ((N ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z <
             τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z i * z j + c)}) \ F) ≠ 0) ∧
         (∑ i, M i i ≤ -μ → volume (N ∩ {z | τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z +
             ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z i * z j + c) < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) ≠ 0)) ∧
      ¬ (∃ ν' : E3, ‖ν'‖ = 1 ∧ ‖ν' - ν‖ ≤ 4 * (Ch + 1) * τ ∧
          (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / (40 * (Ch + 1))),
             (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
             |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z| ≤ (τ / 2) * (1 / (40 * (Ch + 1)))) ∧
          volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / (40 * (Ch + 1))) ∩
             {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z < -((τ / 2) * (1 / (40 * (Ch + 1))))}) \ F) = 0 ∧
          volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / (40 * (Ch + 1))) ∩
             {z | (τ / 2) * (1 / (40 * (Ch + 1))) < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z} ∩ F) = 0) := by
    intro k
    by_contra hk
    apply hcon
    refine ⟨min (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) (1 / 100), min (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) (8 * min δH (1 / 64)),
      1 / (40 * (Ch + 1)), 4 * (Ch + 1), lt_min (by positivity) (by norm_num),
      lt_min (by positivity) (by linarith), div_pos one_pos (by linarith),
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) (by linarith), by linarith, ?_⟩
    intro F ν τ η hτ hτε hη hηε hν h0 hslab hs1 hs2 hHarn hTouch
    by_contra hne
    exact hk ⟨F, ν, τ, η, hτ, hτε, hη, hηε, hν, h0, hslab, hs1, hs2, hHarn, hTouch, hne⟩
  choose F ν τ η hτ hτε hη hηε hν h0 hslab hs1 hs2 hHarn hTouch hnot using key
  choose e1 e2 he1 he2 he12 he1ν he2ν hcomp using fun k => flatSlab_frame (ν k) (hν k)
  have hτ100 : ∀ k, τ k ≤ 1 / 100 := fun k => (hτε k).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hτk : ∀ k : ℕ, τ k ≤ 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := fun k => (hτε k).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hηk : ∀ k : ℕ, η k ≤ 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := fun k => (hηε k).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hη8 : ∀ k, η k ≤ 8 * min δH (1 / 64) := fun k => (hηε k).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hcnorm : ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 = ζ.re ^ 2 + ζ.im ^ 2 := by
    intro ζ
    rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
    ring
  
  have hZ : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x y w : ℝ),
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν k) (x • e1 k + y • e2 k + w • ν k) = w ∧
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (e1 k) (x • e1 k + y • e2 k + w • ν k) = x ∧
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (e2 k) (x • e1 k + y • e2 k + w • ν k) = y ∧
      ‖x • e1 k + y • e2 k + w • ν k‖ ^ 2 = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + w ^ 2 := by
    intro k x y w
    have h11 : @inner ℝ E3 _ (e1 k) (e1 k) = 1 := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, he1 k]; norm_num
    have h22 : @inner ℝ E3 _ (e2 k) (e2 k) = 1 := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, he2 k]; norm_num
    have hνν : @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν k) (ν k) = 1 := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hν k]; norm_num
    have h21 : @inner ℝ E3 _ (e2 k) (e1 k) = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact he12 k
    have hν1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν k) (e1 k) = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact he1ν k
    have hν2 : @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν k) (e2 k) = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact he2ν k
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, hν1, hν2, hνν]; ring
    · simp only [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, h11, he12 k, he1ν k]; ring
    · simp only [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, h21, h22, he2ν k]; ring
    · rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      simp only [inner_add_right, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_left,
        h11, h22, hνν, h21, hν1, hν2, he12 k, he1ν k, he2ν k]
      ring
  
  have hHarn' : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ (y : E3) (r a b : ℝ),
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ F k) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F k) ≠ 0) →
      0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 → a ≤ b →
      b - a ≤ min δH (1 / 64) * r →
      η k * τ k * r ^ 2 ≤ min δH (1 / 64) * (b - a) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y r, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F k) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F k) ≠ 0) →
         a ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν k) z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν k) z ≤ b) →
      volume ((Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν k) z < a}) \ F k) = 0 →
      volume (Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | b < @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν k) z} ∩ F k) = 0 →
      ∃ a' b' : ℝ, a ≤ a' ∧ a' ≤ b' ∧ b' ≤ b ∧ b' - a' ≤ (1 - min cH (1 / 2)) * (b - a) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y (r / 8),
          (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F k) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F k) ≠ 0) →
          a' ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν k) z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ (ν k) z ≤ b' := by
    intro k y r a b hy hr hyr hab hw hg hsl hsd1 hsd2
    obtain ⟨a', b', h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hHarn k y r a b hy hr hyr hab
      (hw.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ'δ hr.le))
      (hg.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ'δ (by linarith))) hsl hsd1 hsd2
    exact ⟨a', b', h1, h2, h3,
      h4.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by linarith)), h5⟩
  
  have hfib : ∀ (k : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ), ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → ∃ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (ζ.re • e1 k + ζ.im • e2 k + (τ k * t) • ν k),
        volume (N ∩ F k) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F k) ≠ 0 := by
    intro k ζ hζ
    obtain ⟨hXν, -, -, hXn⟩ := hZ k ζ.re ζ.im 0
    rw [zero_smul, add_zero] at hXν hXn
    have hXn' : ‖ζ.re • e1 k + ζ.im • e2 k‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      have h1 := hcnorm ζ
      have h2 : ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 3) ^ 2 := by gcongr
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      nlinarith [mul_self_le_mul_self (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) hc.le]
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsF⟩ := flatSlab_crossing (F k) (ν k) (ζ.re • e1 k + ζ.im • e2 k) (τ k)
      (hν k) (hτ k) (by linarith [hτ100 k]) hXν hXn' (hslab k) (hs1 k) (hs2 k)
    refine ⟨s / τ k, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (hτ k), div_le_one (hτ k)]
      exact hs
    · have hst : τ k * (s / τ k) = s := by
        have hne := (hτ k).ne'
        field_simp
      rw [hst]
      exact hsF
  
  have hmod : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k, K ≤ k → ∀ (ζ ζ' : ℂ) (t t' : ℝ), ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 →
      ‖ζ'‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → ‖ζ - ζ'‖ < (1 / 8) ^ j / 4 →
      (|t| ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (ζ.re • e1 k + ζ.im • e2 k + (τ k * t) • ν k),
        volume (N ∩ F k) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F k) ≠ 0) →
      (|t'| ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (ζ'.re • e1 k + ζ'.im • e2 k + (τ k * t') • ν k),
        volume (N ∩ F k) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F k) ≠ 0) →
      |t - t'| ≤ 2 * (1 - min cH (1 / 2)) ^ j := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_nat_gt (4 * 8 ^ j / min δH (1 / 64))
    refine ⟨K, fun k hk ζ ζ' t t' hζ hζ' hζζ' hR hR' => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ht, hzF⟩ := hR
    obtain ⟨ht', hyF⟩ := hR'
    have h8 : (8 : ℝ) ^ j * (1 / 8) ^ j = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    have hapos : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 8) ^ j := by positivity
    have hkK : (K : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have hτK : 4 * τ k * 8 ^ j ≤ min δH (1 / 64) := by
      have h1 : τ k * ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := by
        have := hτk k
        rwa [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at this
      have h2 : 4 * 8 ^ j < (K : ℝ) * min δH (1 / 64) := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ'pos).mp hK
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2.le (hτ k).le,
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hδ'pos.le,
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkK (mul_nonneg hδ'pos.le (hτ k).le)]
    have hτa : τ k ≤ (1 / 8) ^ j / 256 := by
      have h1 : τ k * 8 ^ j ≤ 1 / 256 := by linarith
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hapos.le
      calc τ k = τ k * 8 ^ j * (1 / 8) ^ j := by rw [mul_assoc, h8, mul_one]
        _ ≤ 1 / 256 * (1 / 8) ^ j := h2
        _ = (1 / 8) ^ j / 256 := by ring
    obtain ⟨hyν, -, -, hyn⟩ := hZ k ζ'.re ζ'.im (τ k * t')
    obtain ⟨hzν, -, -, -⟩ := hZ k ζ.re ζ.im (τ k * t)
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, hdn⟩ := hZ k (ζ.re - ζ'.re) (ζ.im - ζ'.im) (τ k * t - τ k * t')
    have hdiff : (ζ.re • e1 k + ζ.im • e2 k + (τ k * t) • ν k) -
        (ζ'.re • e1 k + ζ'.im • e2 k + (τ k * t') • ν k) =
        (ζ.re - ζ'.re) • e1 k + (ζ.im - ζ'.im) • e2 k + (τ k * t - τ k * t') • ν k := by
      simp only [sub_smul]; abel
    have hζ'n := hcnorm ζ'
    have hdζ := hcnorm (ζ - ζ')
    rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im] at hdζ
    have ht'2 : t' ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have := abs_le.mp ht'; nlinarith
    have htt : (t - t') ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by
      have := abs_le.mp ht; have := abs_le.mp ht'; nlinarith
    have hyl : ‖ζ'.re • e1 k + ζ'.im • e2 k + (τ k * t') • ν k‖ < 1 / 2 := by
      have hζ'2 : ‖ζ'‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 3) ^ 2 := by gcongr
      have hτ2 : τ k ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 100) ^ 2 := by
        have := hτ k
        have := hτ100 k
        gcongr
      have hτt : (τ k * t') ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 100) ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht'2 (sq_nonneg (τ k))]
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      nlinarith [mul_self_le_mul_self (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) hc]
    have hzy : ‖(ζ.re • e1 k + ζ.im • e2 k + (τ k * t) • ν k) -
        (ζ'.re • e1 k + ζ'.im • e2 k + (τ k * t') • ν k)‖ < (1 / 8) ^ j / 2 := by
      rw [hdiff]
      have hd2 : ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ 2 < ((1 / 8) ^ j / 4) ^ 2 := by gcongr
      have hτt : (τ k * t - τ k * t') ^ 2 ≤ 4 * τ k ^ 2 := by
        rw [← mul_sub, mul_pow]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htt (sq_nonneg (τ k))]
      have hτ3 : τ k ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / 8) ^ j / 256) ^ 2 := by
        have := hτ k
        gcongr
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      nlinarith [mul_self_le_mul_self (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1 / 8) ^ j / 2) hc]
    have hs4 := flatSlab_harnack_iterate (min δH (1 / 64)) (min cH (1 / 2)) (F k) (ν k) (τ k)
      (η k) hδ'pos hδ'le hc'pos hc'le (hτ k) (hη k) (hη8 k) (hν k) (hslab k) (hs1 k) (hs2 k)
      (hHarn' k) j _ _ hτK hyl hyF hzF hzy
    rw [hzν, hyν, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (hτ k)] at hs4
    have h' : τ k * |t - t'| ≤ τ k * (2 * (1 - min cH (1 / 2)) ^ j) := by linarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h' (hτ k)
  
  obtain ⟨φ, u, hφ, hu, hu1, hconv⟩ := flatSlab_height_compactness (1 - min cH (1 / 2))
    (fun k ζ t => |t| ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (ζ.re • e1 k + ζ.im • e2 k + (τ k * t) • ν k),
      volume (N ∩ F k) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F k) ≠ 0)
    (by linarith) (by linarith) hfib (fun k ζ t _ h => h.1) hmod

    have hx₀n : ‖x₀‖ < 1 / 4 := by simpa using hx₀

    refine (flatSlab_sliding_touch T (F (φ (max K N))) (ν (φ (max K N))) (e1 (φ (max K N)))
      (e2 (φ (max K N))) (τ (φ (max K N))) (η (φ (max K N))) γ u x₀ p1' p2' a' b d' c' σ s
      (hν _) (he1 _) (he2 _) (he12 _) (he1ν _) (he2ν _) (hcomp _) (hτ _) (hτ100 _) (hslab _)

    have hid : ∀ ζ : ℂ, p1' * ζ.re + p2' * ζ.im + a' * ζ.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * ζ.re * ζ.im +
        d' * ζ.im ^ 2 + c' =
        p1 * ζ.re + p2 * ζ.im + a * ζ.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * ζ.re * ζ.im + d * ζ.im ^ 2 + c +

    have hq'x : p1' * x₀.re + p2' * x₀.im + a' * x₀.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * x₀.re * x₀.im +

    have hcont : Continuous (fun ζ : ℂ => p1' * ζ.re + p2' * ζ.im + a' * ζ.re ^ 2 +
        2 * b * ζ.re * ζ.im + d' * ζ.im ^ 2 + c') := by fun_prop
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδq⟩ := Metric.continuous_iff.mp hcont x₀ 1 one_pos
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = min (σ₀ / 2) (min (δ / 2) (1 / 100)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hσpos : 0 < σ := by

    have hσ2 : σ ≤ δ / 2 := by rw [hσ]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have hσ3 : σ ≤ 1 / 100 := by rw [hσ]; exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have hsσ : 0 < s * σ ^ 2 := mul_pos hspos (pow_pos hσpos 2)
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, v = min (s * σ ^ 2 / 4) (1 / 4) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hγpos : 0 < γ := by rw [hγ]; exact lt_min (by linarith) (by norm_num)
    have hγ1 : γ < s * σ ^ 2 / 2 := by
      rw [hγ]; exact (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)

    have hbd : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ σ, |p1' * ζ.re + p2' * ζ.im + a' * ζ.re ^ 2 +

    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hGC γ hγpos

      (e2 (φ (max K N))) (τ (φ (max K N))) (η (φ (max K N))) γ u x₀ p1' p2' a' b d' c' σ s
      (hν _) (he1 _) (he2 _) (he12 _) (he1ν _) (he2ν _) (hcomp _) (hτ _) (hτ100 _) (hslab _)
      (hs1 _) (hs2 _) (hTouch _) (hfib _) hk1 hγpos.le hγ2 hx₀n hσpos hσ3 hspos hγ1 hbd

    intro ζ hζ

  obtain ⟨p1, p2, hp1, hp2, hpoly⟩ := hCh u hu.continuousOn (fun ζ _ => hu1 ζ) hu0 hVPb hVPa

subgoal_signatures.name: flatSlab_frame
flatSlab_crossing
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (F : Set E3) (ν X : E3) (τ : ℝ), ‖ν‖ = 1 → 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 / 4 →
    @inner ℝ E3 _ ν X = 0 → ‖X‖ ≤ 1 / 2 →

      |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z| ≤ τ) →
    volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ}) \ F) = 0 →
    volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 →
    ∃ s : ℝ, |s| ≤ τ ∧ ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (X + s • ν), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0

subgoal_signatures.name: flatSlab_harnack_iterate
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (δH cH : ℝ) (F : Set E3) (ν : E3) (τ η : ℝ), 0 < δH →
    δH ≤ 1 / 64 → 0 < cH → cH ≤ 1 / 2 → 0 < τ → 0 ≤ η → η ≤ 8 * δH → ‖ν‖ = 1 →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z| ≤ τ) →
    volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ}) \ F) = 0 →
    volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 →
    (∀ (y : E3) (r a b : ℝ), (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 → a ≤ b → b - a ≤ δH * r →
      η * τ * r ^ 2 ≤ δH * (b - a) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y r, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
        a ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ b) →
      volume ((Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < a}) \ F) = 0 →
      volume (Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | b < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 →

          a' ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ b') →
    ∀ (j : ℕ) (y z : E3), 4 * τ * 8 ^ j ≤ δH → ‖y‖ < 1 / 2 →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      ‖z - y‖ < (1 / 8) ^ j / 2 →

subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (T : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (F : Set E3) (ν e1 e2 : E3) (τ η γ : ℝ)
    (u : ℂ → ℝ) (x₀ : ℂ) (p1 p2 a b d c σ s : ℝ),
    ‖ν‖ = 1 → ‖e1‖ = 1 → ‖e2‖ = 1 → @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 e2 = 0 → @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 ν = 0 →

      ∀ (b z₀ : E3) (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : ℝ) (N : Set E3),
      @inner ℝ E3 _ b ν = 0 → (∀ i j, M i j = M j i) → (∀ i, ∑ j, M i j * ν j = 0) →
      ‖b‖ ≤ A → (∀ i j, |M i j| ≤ A) → z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) →

by

  have hDc : Continuous D := hDs.continuous
  have hDcs : HasCompactSupport D := hvc.fderiv ℝ
  have hD0 : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport v → D y = 0 := fun y hy =>
    Function.notMem_support.mp (fun h => hy (support_fderiv_subset ℝ h))

  have hGs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E3).symm.contDiff.comp hDs
  have hGn : ∀ y, ‖G y‖ = ‖D y‖ := fun y => (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E3).symm.norm_map _
  have hGi : ∀ y (i : Fin 3), partialDeriv i v y = G y i := by
    intro y i
    show D y (e i) = G y i
    have h := InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := E3) (x := e i) (y := D y)
    rw [← h, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    simp [hG]
  have hDsq : (fun y => ‖D y‖ ^ 2) = fun y => ‖G y‖ ^ 2 := by
    funext y; rw [hGn]
  
  have hkey : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∫ y, ‖D y‖ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (ε ^ 2 + ‖D y‖ ^ 2) ≤ p := by
    intro ε hε
    set s : E3 → ℝ := fun y => Real.sqrt (ε ^ 2 + ‖D y‖ ^ 2) with hs
    have hspos : ∀ y, 0 < s y := fun y => Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
    have hss : ContDiff ℝ ∞ s := by
      have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ‖D y‖ ^ 2) := by rw [hDsq]; exact hGs.norm_sq ℝ
      exact (contDiff_const.add h1).sqrt
        (fun y => (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < ε ^ 2 + ‖D y‖ ^ 2).ne')
    set X : E3 → E3 := fun y => -((s y)⁻¹ • G y) with hX
    have hXs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X := ((hss.inv fun y => (hspos y).ne').smul hGs).neg
    have hXcs : HasCompactSupport X := by
      refine hDcs.mono' ?_
      intro y hy
      apply subset_tsupport
      intro h0
      apply hy
      have h0' : D y = 0 := h0
      have : G y = 0 := by simp [hG, h0']
      simp [hX, this]
    have hX1 : ∀ y, ‖X y‖ ≤ 1 := by
      intro y
      rw [hX]
      simp only
      rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, norm_inv, Real.norm_of_nonneg (hspos y).le,
        inv_mul_le_iff₀ (hspos y), mul_one, hGn]
      calc ‖D y‖ = Real.sqrt (‖D y‖ ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)).symm

    have hXi : ∀ y (i : Fin 3), X y i = -((s y)⁻¹ * G y i) := by
      intro y i; simp [hX]
    have hdualX := hdual X hXs hXcs hX1
    have hXis : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w => X w i) := fun i =>

    have hint1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv i v y * X y i) := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv
      exact ((hDc.clm_apply continuous_const).mul (hXis i).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport

    have hint2 : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun y => v y * partialDeriv i (fun w => X w i) y) := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv

        continuous_const)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hvc.mul_right
    have hint3 : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun y => v y * X y i) := fun i =>
      (hv.continuous.mul (hXis i).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hvc.mul_right
    have hibp : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∫ y, v y * partialDeriv i (fun w => X w i) y =
        -∫ y, partialDeriv i v y * X y i := by
      intro i

        (hint1 i) (hint2 i) (hint3 i) (hv.differentiable (by simp)) ((hXis i).differentiable (by simp))
      exact h
    have hsum : ∫ y, v y * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => X w i) y =
        -∫ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i v y * X y i := by
      simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hint2 i), integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hint1 i),
        ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hibp i)
    have hpt : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i v y * X y i = -(‖D y‖ ^ 2 / s y) := by
      intro y
      simp only [hGi, hXi]
      rw [← hGn, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      rw [div_eq_inv_mul, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring
    have heq : ∫ y, ‖D y‖ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (ε ^ 2 + ‖D y‖ ^ 2) =
        ∫ y, v y * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => X w i) y := by
      rw [hsum, ← integral_neg]
      congr 1
      funext y
      rw [hpt y, neg_neg]
    linarith
  
  have hDint : Integrable D := hDc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hDcs
  rw [← ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm hDint]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  set K := tsupport v with hK
  have hKc : IsCompact K := hvc
  have hKm : MeasurableSet K := (isClosed_tsupport v).measurableSet
  set μK := (volume K).toReal with hμKdef
  have hμK : 0 ≤ μK := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hbound : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∫ y, ‖D y‖ ≤ p + ε * μK := by

      · refine hDcs.mono' ?_

        apply subset_tsupport

      rw [integral_indicator hKm, setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      rfl

          rw [integral_add hint1 hint2, hint2i]
      _ ≤ p + ε * μK := by linarith [hkey ε hε]
  apply le_of_forall_pos_lt_add
  intro δ hδ
  have hε : 0 < δ / (μK + 1) := by positivity
  have h1 := hbound _ hε
  have h2 : δ / (μK + 1) * μK < δ := by
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  linarith
