          z).fderiv]
        exact convolution_precompR_apply _ hψl ((hcoord i).2.fderiv ℝ)
          ((hcoord i).1.continuous_fderiv (by simp)) z (e i)
      have hsum : convolution (φ.normed volume)
          (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => X w i) y)
          (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume z =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, convolution (φ.normed volume) (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun w => X w i) y)
            (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume z := by
        simp only [convolution_def, ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
        rw [integral_finset_sum]
        intro i _
        simpa using (hψc.convolutionExists_left (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) hψ
          (hD i).1.locallyIntegrable z).integrable
      rw [hsum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [hcc i, hcp i]

informal_problem.statement: (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : E3)) (S : Set E3) (D : E3 → ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hD : Continuous D) (hDc : HasCompactSupport D) : ∫ z in S, MeasureTheory.convolution (φ.normed volume) D (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume z = ∫ y, MeasureTheory.convolution (φ.normed volume) (S.indicator fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume y * D y

signature.name: sepIso_conv_adjoint
signature.statement: (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : E3)) (S : Set E3) (D : E3 → ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hD : Continuous D) (hDc : HasCompactSupport D) : ∫ z in S, MeasureTheory.convolution (φ.normed volume) D (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume z = ∫ y, MeasureTheory.convolution (φ.normed volume) (S.indicator fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume y * D y

proof.tactics:
by
  have hDi : Integrable D volume := hD.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hDc
  have hρi : Integrable (φ.normed volume) volume := φ.integrable_normed
  have hH := hDi.convolution_integrand (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) hρi
  have hF : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun z y =>
      S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z * (φ.normed volume (z - y) * D y))
      (volume.prod volume) := by
    refine (hH.indicator (hS.prod MeasurableSet.univ)).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
    rintro ⟨z, y⟩
    by_cases hz : z ∈ S
    · have hp : (z, y) ∈ S ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set E3) := ⟨hz, Set.mem_univ _⟩
      simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hp, Set.indicator_of_mem hz, Function.uncurry_apply_pair,
        ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    · have hp : (z, y) ∉ S ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set E3) := fun h => hz h.1
      simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hp, Set.indicator_of_notMem hz,
        Function.uncurry_apply_pair, zero_mul]
  have h3 : ∫ z in S, MeasureTheory.convolution (φ.normed volume) D
      (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume z =
      ∫ z, ∫ y, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z * (φ.normed volume (z - y) * D y) := by
    rw [← integral_indicator hS]
    congr 1
    funext z
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    by_cases hz : z ∈ S
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz, Set.indicator_of_mem hz, one_mul,
        MeasureTheory.convolution_eq_swap]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz, Set.indicator_of_notMem hz, zero_mul]
  have h4 : ∫ y, MeasureTheory.convolution (φ.normed volume) (S.indicator fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume y * D y =
      ∫ y, ∫ z, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z * (φ.normed volume (z - y) * D y) := by
    congr 1
    funext y
    rw [MeasureTheory.convolution_eq_swap, ← integral_mul_const]
    congr 1
    funext z
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [show y - z = -(z - y) by abel, φ.normed_neg]
    ring
  rw [h3, h4]
  exact integral_integral_swap hF

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (η : ℝ) (hV : IsOpen V) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V) (hη0 : 0 ≤ η) (hη : η ≤ 1 / 12) (hclose : ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η) (S : Set E3) : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η)) * sepPerG G S V ∧ sepPerG G S V ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η)) * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V

signature.name: sepPerG_near_id_compare
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (η : ℝ) (hV : IsOpen V) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V) (hη0 : 0 ≤ η) (hη : η ≤ 1 / 12) (hclose : ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η) (S : Set E3) : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η)) * sepPerG G S V ∧ sepPerG G S V ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η)) * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have h1m : 0 < 1 - 4 * η := by linarith
  have h1p : 0 < 1 + 4 * η := by linarith
  have hηη : η * η ≤ η / 12 := by nlinarith
  have hηηη : η * η * η ≤ η / 144 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hη0 hη0]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = (1 - 4 * η) / (1 + 4 * η) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by rw [hc]; exact div_nonneg h1m.le h1p.le
  have hcle1 : c ≤ 1 := by rw [hc, div_le_one h1p]; linarith
  have hcm : c * (1 + 4 * η) = 1 - 4 * η := by rw [hc]; exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt h1p)
  have hl0 : 0 ≤ (1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η) := div_nonneg h1p.le h1m.le
  have hlc : (1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η) * c = 1 := by
    rw [hc, div_mul_div_comm, mul_comm (1 + 4 * η)]
    exact div_self (mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt h1m) (ne_of_gt h1p))
  have hc2 : c ^ 2 * (1 + 4 * η) ≤ 1 - 4 * η := by
    have e : c ^ 2 * (1 + 4 * η) = c * (1 - 4 * η) := by rw [← hcm]; ring
    rw [e]
    nlinarith
  
  have htrip : ∀ a b c A B C : ℝ, |a| ≤ A → |b| ≤ B → |c| ≤ C → |a * b * c| ≤ A * B * C := by
    intro a b c A B C ha hb hc
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul ha hb (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha)) hc
      (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha) ((abs_nonneg _).trans hb))
  
  have hdetB : ∀ M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |M i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η) →
      1 - 4 * η ≤ M.det ∧ M.det ≤ 1 + 4 * η := by
    intro M hM
    have d0 : |M 0 0 - 1| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 0 0
    have d1 : |M 1 1 - 1| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 1 1
    have d2 : |M 2 2 - 1| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 2 2
    have o01 : |M 0 1| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 0 1
    have o02 : |M 0 2| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 0 2
    have o10 : |M 1 0| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 1 0
    have o12 : |M 1 2| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 1 2
    have o20 : |M 2 0| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 2 0
    have o21 : |M 2 1| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 2 1
    obtain ⟨d0l, d0u⟩ := abs_le.mp d0
    obtain ⟨d1l, d1u⟩ := abs_le.mp d1
    obtain ⟨d2l, d2u⟩ := abs_le.mp d2
    have a0 : |M 0 0| ≤ 1 + η := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have a1 : |M 1 1| ≤ 1 + η := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have a2 : |M 2 2| ≤ 1 + η := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have p1 : (1 - η) * (1 - η) ≤ M 0 0 * M 1 1 :=
      mul_le_mul (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have p2 : (1 - η) * (1 - η) * (1 - η) ≤ M 0 0 * M 1 1 * M 2 2 :=
      mul_le_mul p1 (by linarith) (by linarith) ((mul_self_nonneg (1 - η)).trans p1)
    have pu := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ a0 a1 a2)
    have t1 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ a0 o12 o21)
    have t2 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o01 o10 a2)
    have t3 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o01 o12 o20)
    have t4 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o02 o10 o21)
    have t5 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o02 a1 o20)
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    constructor
    · linarith [pu.1, pu.2, t1.1, t1.2, t2.1, t2.2, t3.1, t3.2, t4.1, t4.2, t5.1, t5.2]
    · linarith [pu.1, pu.2, t1.1, t1.2, t2.1, t2.2, t3.1, t3.2, t4.1, t4.2, t5.1, t5.2]
  
  have hpair : ∀ a x y : ℝ, |a| ≤ η → |a * x * y| ≤ η * ((x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) / 2) := by
    intro a x y ha
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, mul_assoc]
    have h1 : |x| * |y| ≤ (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) / 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|x| - |y|), sq_abs x, sq_abs y]
    exact mul_le_mul ha h1 (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) hη0
  have hquad : ∀ M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |M i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η) → ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      (1 - 3 * η) * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * v i * v j ∧
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * v i * v j ≤ (1 + 3 * η) * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 := by
    intro M hM v
    have d0 : |M 0 0 - 1| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 0 0
    have d1 : |M 1 1 - 1| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 1 1
    have d2 : |M 2 2 - 1| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 2 2
    have o01 : |M 0 1| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 0 1
    have o02 : |M 0 2| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 0 2
    have o10 : |M 1 0| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 1 0
    have o12 : |M 1 2| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 1 2
    have o20 : |M 2 0| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 2 0
    have o21 : |M 2 1| ≤ η := by simpa using hM 2 1
    have q00 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 0) (v 0) d0)
    have q11 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 1) (v 1) d1)
    have q22 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 2) (v 2) d2)
    have q01 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 0) (v 1) o01)
    have q02 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 0) (v 2) o02)
    have q10 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 1) (v 0) o10)
    have q12 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 1) (v 2) o12)
    have q20 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 2) (v 0) o20)
    have q21 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 2) (v 1) o21)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    constructor
    · linarith [q00.1, q11.1, q22.1, q01.1, q02.1, q10.1, q12.1, q20.1, q21.1]
    · linarith [q00.2, q11.2, q22.2, q01.2, q02.2, q10.2, q12.2, q20.2, q21.2]
  
  have hsmul : ∀ (h : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h V → ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X →
      tsupport X ⊆ V → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => h z • X z) := by
    intro h hh X hX hXU
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ V
    · exact (hh.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hz)).smul hX.contDiffAt
    · have hz' : z ∉ tsupport X := fun h' => hz (hXU h')
      have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).mp hz'
      have hev' : (fun w => h w • X w) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (fun _ => (0 : E3)) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
        rw [hw, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev'
  
  have hdetC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) V := by
    have hfun : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y => G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2
        - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2
        + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0 + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1
        - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
    rw [hfun]
    have e1 := ((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 2)
    have e2 := ((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 1)
    have e3 := ((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 2)
    have e4 := ((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 0)
    have e5 := ((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 1)
    have e6 := ((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 0)
    exact ((((e1.sub e2).sub e3).add e4).add e5).sub e6
  have hpos : ∀ y ∈ V, 0 < (G y).det := fun y hy => by
    linarith [(hdetB _ (hclose y hy)).1]
  have hsqrtC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) V :=
    hdetC.sqrt (fun y hy => (hpos y hy).ne')
  have hinvC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (Real.sqrt (G y).det)⁻¹) V :=
    hsqrtC.inv (fun y hy => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos y hy)).ne')
  
  have hsq1 : ∀ y v : E3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y i j * v i * v j = ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 := by
    intro y v
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply]
    ring
  
  have hK : ∀ G1 G2 : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ X : E3 → E3, (ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ V ∧
        ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G1 y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →
        ∃ Y : E3 → E3, (ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ V ∧
          ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G2 y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) ∧
          ∀ y, sepDensDiv G2 Y y = c * sepDensDiv G1 X y) →
      sepPerG G1 S V ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η)) * sepPerG G2 S V := by
    intro G1 G2 hT
    unfold sepPerG
    refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
    obtain ⟨Y, hY, hd⟩ := hT X hX
    have hint : ∫ y in S, sepDensDiv G1 X y =
        (1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η) * ∫ y in S, sepDensDiv G2 Y y := by
      simp_rw [hd]
      rw [integral_const_mul, ← mul_assoc, hlc, one_mul]
    rw [hint, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hl0]
    refine mul_le_mul_left' ?_ _
    exact le_iSup_of_le Y (le_iSup_of_le hY le_rfl)
  
  have hD : ∀ (G1 G2 : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X1 X2 : E3 → E3),
      (∀ z (i : Fin 3), Real.sqrt (G2 z).det * X2 z i = c * (Real.sqrt (G1 z).det * X1 z i)) →
      ∀ y, sepDensDiv G2 X2 y = c * sepDensDiv G1 X1 y := by
    intro G1 G2 X1 X2 h y
    unfold sepDensDiv
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have hf : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G2 z).det * X2 z i) =
        c • (fun z => Real.sqrt (G1 z).det * X1 z i) := by
      funext z
      rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h z i]
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hf, fderiv_const_smul_of_field]
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have dir1 : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η)) * sepPerG G S V := by
    refine hK (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) G fun X hX => ?_
    obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXV, hXb⟩ := hX
    have hX0 : ∀ z, z ∉ V → X z = 0 := fun z hz =>
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h' => hz (hXV h'))
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : E3 → ℝ, a = fun z => c * (Real.sqrt (G z).det)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have haz : ∀ z, a z = c * (Real.sqrt (G z).det)⁻¹ := fun z => by rw [ha]
    have haC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a V := by
      rw [ha]
      exact contDiffOn_const.mul hinvC
    refine ⟨fun z => a z • X z, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, hD _ _ _ _ ?_⟩
    · exact hsmul a haC X hXs hXV
    · refine hXc.mono ?_
      intro z hz h0
      apply hz
      show a z • X z = 0
      rw [h0, smul_zero]
    · exact (tsupport_smul_subset_right _ _).trans hXV
    · intro y
      show ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (a y • X y) i * (a y • X y) j ≤ 1
      have hYi : ∀ i : Fin 3, (a y • X y) i = a y * X y i := fun i => by simp
      simp only [hYi]
      have hexp : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (a y * X y i) * (a y * X y j) =
          a y ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [hexp]
      by_cases hy : y ∈ V
      · have hX1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, X y i ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
          have h := hXb y
          rwa [hsq1 y (X y)] at h
        have hQ := hquad (G y) (hclose y hy) (fun i => X y i)
        have hQ' : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1 + 4 * η := by
          have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX1 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + 3 * η)
          linarith [hQ.2]
        have hdy := hdetB (G y) (hclose y hy)
        have hdpos : 0 < (G y).det := hpos y hy
        have key : a y ^ 2 * (1 + 4 * η) ≤ 1 := by
          rw [haz y, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hdpos.le]
          have hcd : c ^ 2 * (1 + 4 * η) ≤ (G y).det := by linarith [hdy.1]
          calc c ^ 2 * ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (1 + 4 * η)
              = (c ^ 2 * (1 + 4 * η)) * ((G y).det)⁻¹ := by ring
            _ ≤ (G y).det * ((G y).det)⁻¹ :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcd (inv_nonneg.2 hdpos.le)
            _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hdpos.ne'
        have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ' (sq_nonneg (a y))
        linarith
      · simp [hX0 y hy]
    · intro z i
      show Real.sqrt (G z).det * (a z • X z) i =
        c * (Real.sqrt ((1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)).det * X z i)
      by_cases hz : z ∈ V
      · have hr : Real.sqrt (G z).det ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos z hz)).ne'
        simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.det_one, Real.sqrt_one, haz z]
        rw [show Real.sqrt (G z).det * (c * (Real.sqrt (G z).det)⁻¹ * X z i) =
          c * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * (Real.sqrt (G z).det)⁻¹) * X z i by ring,
          mul_inv_cancel₀ hr]
        ring
      · simp [hX0 z hz]
  
  have dir2 : sepPerG G S V ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η)) *
        sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V := by
    refine hK G (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) fun Y hY => ?_
    obtain ⟨hYs, hYc, hYV, hYb⟩ := hY
    have hY0 : ∀ z, z ∉ V → Y z = 0 := fun z hz =>
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h' => hz (hYV h'))
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : E3 → ℝ, b = fun z => c * Real.sqrt (G z).det := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hbz : ∀ z, b z = c * Real.sqrt (G z).det := fun z => by rw [hb]
    have hbC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b V := by
      rw [hb]
      exact contDiffOn_const.mul hsqrtC
    refine ⟨fun z => b z • Y z, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, hD _ _ _ _ ?_⟩
    · exact hsmul b hbC Y hYs hYV
    · refine hYc.mono ?_
      intro z hz h0
      apply hz
      show b z • Y z = 0
      rw [h0, smul_zero]
    · exact (tsupport_smul_subset_right _ _).trans hYV
    · intro y
      show ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y i j *
        (b y • Y y) i * (b y • Y y) j ≤ 1
      rw [hsq1 y (b y • Y y)]
      have hYi : ∀ i : Fin 3, (b y • Y y) i = b y * Y y i := fun i => by simp
      simp only [hYi]
      have hexp : ∑ i : Fin 3, (b y * Y y i) ^ 2 = b y ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, Y y i ^ 2 := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [hexp]
      by_cases hy : y ∈ V
      · have hQ := hquad (G y) (hclose y hy) (fun i => Y y i)
        have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, Y y i ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
        have hdy := hdetB (G y) (hclose y hy)
        have hdpos : 0 < (G y).det := hpos y hy
        have hb2 : b y ^ 2 ≤ 1 - 4 * η := by
          rw [hbz y, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hdpos.le]
          have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdy.2 (sq_nonneg c)
          linarith
        have hm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb2 hs0
        have hm2 := mul_nonneg hη0 hs0
        have hYb' := hYb y
        linarith [hQ.1]
      · simp [hY0 y hy]
    · intro z i
      show Real.sqrt ((1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)).det * (b z • Y z) i =
        c * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i)
      simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.det_one, Real.sqrt_one, hbz z]
      ring
  exact ⟨dir1, dir2⟩

informal_problem.statement: ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (E F V : Set E3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (s σ M : ℝ), IsOpen V → (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V) → (∀ y ∈ V, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 12) → MeasurableSet E → MeasurableSet F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → (∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖ ≤ M) → 0 ≤ σ → (∀ h₀ : ℝ, 0 < h₀ → ∃ h : ℝ, 0 < h ∧ h < h₀ ∧ volume (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (σ * h)) → sepPerG G ((E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y})) V ≤ sepPerG G E V + sepPerG G F (V ∩ {y | s < u y}) + ENNReal.ofReal (C₀ * M * σ)

signature.name: sepPerG_glue_levelset
signature.statement: ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (E F V : Set E3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (s σ M : ℝ), IsOpen V → (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V) → (∀ y ∈ V, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 12) → MeasurableSet E → MeasurableSet F → ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → (∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖ ≤ M) → 0 ≤ σ → (∀ h₀ : ℝ, 0 < h₀ → ∃ h : ℝ, 0 < h ∧ h < h₀ ∧ volume (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (σ * h)) → sepPerG G ((E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y})) V ≤ sepPerG G E V + sepPerG G F (V ∩ {y | s < u y}) + ENNReal.ofReal (C₀ * M * σ)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hρC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
  have hρD : Differentiable ℝ Real.smoothTransition := hρC.differentiable (by simp)
  have hρ0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → Real.smoothTransition t = 0 :=
    fun t ht => Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos ht
  have hρ1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → Real.smoothTransition t = 1 :=
    fun t ht => Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le ht
  have hρd0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t < 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have hev : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds ht] with x hx
      exact hρ0 x (le_of_lt hx)
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  have hρd1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 < t → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have hev : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun _ => (1:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ht] with x hx
      exact hρ1 x (le_of_lt hx)
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    ((hρC.continuous_deriv (by simp)).continuousOn (s := Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1))
  obtain ⟨K, hK0, hKb⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |deriv Real.smoothTransition t| ≤ K := by
    refine ⟨max K₁ 0, le_max_right _ _, fun t => ?_⟩
    by_cases h0 : t < 0
    · rw [hρd0 t h0, abs_zero]; exact le_max_right _ _
    by_cases h1 : 1 < t
    · rw [hρd1 t h1, abs_zero]; exact le_max_right _ _
    push_neg at h0 h1
    have := hK₁ t ⟨h0, h1⟩
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨8 / 3 * K, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro G E F V u s σ M hV hG hclose hE hF hu hM hσ hslab
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hM 0)
  have hucont : Continuous u := hu.continuous
  have hum : Measurable u := hucont.measurable
  have huD : Differentiable ℝ u := hu.differentiable (by simp)
  
  have htrip : ∀ a b c A B C : ℝ, |a| ≤ A → |b| ≤ B → |c| ≤ C → |a * b * c| ≤ A * B * C := by
    intro a b c A B C ha hb hc
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul ha hb (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha)) hc
      (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha) ((abs_nonneg _).trans hb))
  have hdetB : ∀ y ∈ V, 2 / 3 ≤ (G y).det ∧ (G y).det ≤ 4 / 3 := by
    intro y hy
    have hC := hclose y hy
    have d0 : |G y 0 0 - 1| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 0 0
    have d1 : |G y 1 1 - 1| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 1 1
    have d2 : |G y 2 2 - 1| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 2 2
    have o01 : |G y 0 1| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 0 1
    have o02 : |G y 0 2| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 0 2
    have o10 : |G y 1 0| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 1 0
    have o12 : |G y 1 2| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 1 2
    have o20 : |G y 2 0| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 2 0
    have o21 : |G y 2 1| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 2 1
    obtain ⟨d0l, d0u⟩ := abs_le.mp d0
    obtain ⟨d1l, d1u⟩ := abs_le.mp d1
    obtain ⟨d2l, d2u⟩ := abs_le.mp d2
    have a0 : |G y 0 0| ≤ 1 + 1 / 12 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have a1 : |G y 1 1| ≤ 1 + 1 / 12 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have a2 : |G y 2 2| ≤ 1 + 1 / 12 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have p1 : (1 - 1 / 12) * (1 - 1 / 12) ≤ G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 :=
      mul_le_mul (by linarith) (by linarith) (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have p2 : (1 - 1 / 12) * (1 - 1 / 12) * (1 - 1 / 12) ≤ G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2 :=
      mul_le_mul p1 (by linarith) (by norm_num)
        ((by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1 - 1 / 12) * (1 - 1 / 12)).trans p1)
    have pu := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ a0 a1 a2)
    have t1 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ a0 o12 o21)
    have t2 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o01 o10 a2)
    have t3 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o01 o12 o20)
    have t4 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o02 o10 o21)
    have t5 := abs_le.mp (htrip _ _ _ _ _ _ o02 a1 o20)
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    constructor
    · linarith [pu.1, pu.2, t1.1, t1.2, t2.1, t2.2, t3.1, t3.2, t4.1, t4.2, t5.1, t5.2]
    · linarith [pu.1, pu.2, t1.1, t1.2, t2.1, t2.2, t3.1, t3.2, t4.1, t4.2, t5.1, t5.2]
  have hpair : ∀ a x y : ℝ, |a| ≤ 1 / 12 → |a * x * y| ≤ 1 / 12 * ((x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) / 2) := by
    intro a x y ha
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, mul_assoc]
    have h1 : |x| * |y| ≤ (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) / 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|x| - |y|), sq_abs x, sq_abs y]
    exact mul_le_mul ha h1 (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (by norm_num)
  have hquad : ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ v : E3,
      3 / 4 * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * v i * v j := by
    intro y hy v
    have hC := hclose y hy
    have d0 : |G y 0 0 - 1| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 0 0
    have d1 : |G y 1 1 - 1| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 1 1
    have d2 : |G y 2 2 - 1| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 2 2
    have o01 : |G y 0 1| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 0 1
    have o02 : |G y 0 2| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 0 2
    have o10 : |G y 1 0| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 1 0
    have o12 : |G y 1 2| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 1 2
    have o20 : |G y 2 0| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 2 0
    have o21 : |G y 2 1| ≤ 1 / 12 := by simpa using hC 2 1
    have q00 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 0) (v 0) d0)
    have q11 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 1) (v 1) d1)
    have q22 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 2) (v 2) d2)
    have q01 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 0) (v 1) o01)
    have q02 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 0) (v 2) o02)
    have q10 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 1) (v 0) o10)
    have q12 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 1) (v 2) o12)
    have q20 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 2) (v 0) o20)
    have q21 := abs_le.mp (hpair _ (v 2) (v 1) o21)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    linarith [q00.1, q11.1, q22.1, q01.1, q02.1, q10.1, q12.1, q20.1, q21.1]
  
  have hdetC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) V := by
    have hfun : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y => G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2
        - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2
        + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0 + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1
        - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
    rw [hfun]
    have e1 := ((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 2)
    have e2 := ((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 1)
    have e3 := ((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 2)
    have e4 := ((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 0)
    have e5 := ((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 1)
    have e6 := ((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 0)
    exact ((((e1.sub e2).sub e3).add e4).add e5).sub e6
  have hpos : ∀ y ∈ V, 0 < (G y).det := fun y hy => by linarith [(hdetB y hy).1]
  have hsqrtC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) V :=
    hdetC.sqrt (fun y hy => (hpos y hy).ne')
  have hS3 : ∀ Y : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y → HasCompactSupport Y → tsupport Y ⊆ V →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i)) ∧
      Continuous (sepDensDiv G Y) ∧ HasCompactSupport (sepDensDiv G Y) := by
    intro Y hY hYc hYV
    have hw : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) := by
      intro i
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro z
      by_cases hz : z ∈ V
      · exact (hsqrtC.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hz)).mul
          ((contDiff_euclidean.1 hY i).contDiffAt)
      · have hz' : z ∉ tsupport Y := fun h' => hz (hYV h')
        have hev : Y =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).mp hz'
        have hev' : (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * Y w i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
          filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
          rw [hw]; simp
        exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev'
    refine ⟨hw, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      exact continuous_finset_sum _
        (fun i _ => ((hw i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const)
    · refine HasCompactSupport.intro hYc (fun y hy => ?_)
      have hev : Y =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).mp hy
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
      have hev' : (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * Y w i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
        rw [hw]; simp
      rw [hev'.fderiv_eq]; simp
  
  refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
  obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXV, hXQ⟩ := hX
  obtain ⟨hw, hdivC, hdivc⟩ := hS3 X hXs hXc hXV
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ := hdivC.bounded_above_of_compact_support hdivc
  obtain ⟨A, hA0, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ A :=
    ⟨max A₀ 0, le_max_right _ _, fun y => by
      have := hA₀ y
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩
  have hX0 : ∀ z, z ∉ V → X z = 0 := fun z hz =>
    image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h' => hz (hXV h'))
  
  have hwv : ∀ y, ‖Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y‖ ≤ 4 / 3 := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ V
    · have hn2 : ‖X y‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin 3, X y i ^ 2 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
        simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      have hq := hquad y hy (X y)
      have hQ := hXQ y
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, X y i ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
      have hs : ∑ i : Fin 3, X y i ^ 2 ≤ 4 / 3 := by linarith
      have hd := hdetB y hy
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h1 : (Real.sqrt (G y).det * ‖X y‖) ^ 2 ≤ (4 / 3) ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hpos y hy).le, hn2]
        have := mul_le_mul hd.2 hs hs0 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4 / 3)
        nlinarith
      have h2 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (G y).det * ‖X y‖ :=
        mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
      nlinarith
    · rw [hX0 y hy, smul_zero, norm_zero]; norm_num
  
  have hprod : ∀ (φ : E3 → ℝ) (D : E3 → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)), (∀ y, HasFDerivAt φ (D y) y) →
      ∀ y, sepDensDiv G (fun z => φ z • X z) y =
        φ y * sepDensDiv G X y + D y (Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y) := by
    intro φ D hφ y
    have hi : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (φ z • X z) i) y =
        φ y * partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y +
          Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i * D y (e i) := by
      intro i
      have hf : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (φ z • X z) i) =
          fun z => φ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
        funext z
        simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun z => φ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i))
          (φ y • fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y +
            (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i) • D y) y :=
        (hφ y).mul ((hw i).differentiable (by simp) y).hasFDerivAt
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hf, hd.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hdec : Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y = (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y 0) • e 0 +
        (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y 1) • e 1 + (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y 2) • e 2 := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp
    simp only [sepDensDiv, hi, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hdec]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  refine ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε _ => ?_
  have hε' : (0:ℝ) < ε := hε
  obtain ⟨h, hh0, hhh₀, hvol⟩ := hslab (ε / (A * σ + 1)) (div_pos hε' (by positivity))
  have hAσh : A * σ * h ≤ ε := by
    have := (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < A * σ + 1)).1 hhh₀
    nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ : ∃ ℓ : E3 → ℝ, ℓ = fun y => 2 / h * (u y - s) - 1 / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hℓD : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt ℓ ((2 / h) • fderiv ℝ u y) y := by
    intro y
    rw [hℓ]
    exact (((huD y).hasFDerivAt.sub_const s).const_mul (2 / h)).sub_const (1 / 2)
  have hℓC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ℓ := by
    rw [hℓ]
    exact (contDiff_const.mul (hu.sub contDiff_const)).sub contDiff_const
  have hℓkey : ∀ y, ℓ y * h = 2 * (u y - s) - h / 2 := by
    intro y
    rw [hℓ]
    field_simp
  have hℓlo : ∀ y, u y ≤ s → ℓ y < 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have := hℓkey y
    nlinarith
  have hℓhi : ∀ y, s + h ≤ u y → 1 < ℓ y := by
    intro y hy
    have := hℓkey y
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : ∃ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ψ = fun y => Real.smoothTransition (ℓ y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := by
    rw [hψ]
    exact hρC.comp hℓC
  have hψ01 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ ψ y ∧ ψ y ≤ 1 := fun y => by
    rw [hψ]
    exact ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : E3 → ℝ, c = fun y => deriv Real.smoothTransition (ℓ y) * (2 / h) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψD : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt ψ (c y • fderiv ℝ u y) y := by
    intro y
    have h1 := (hρD (ℓ y)).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt y (hℓD y)
    rw [smul_smul] at h1
    rw [hψ, hc]
    exact h1
  have hcb : ∀ y, |c y| ≤ K * (2 / h) := by
    intro y
    rw [hc]
    simp only
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 / h)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hKb _) (by positivity)
  have hdu : ∀ y, |fderiv ℝ u y (Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y)| ≤ M * (4 / 3) := by
    intro y
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact ((fderiv ℝ u y).le_opNorm _).trans
      (mul_le_mul (hM y) (hwv y) (norm_nonneg _) hM0)
  
  obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁def⟩ : ∃ f : E3 → ℝ, f = sepDensDiv G (fun z => (1 - ψ z) • X z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂def⟩ : ∃ f : E3 → ℝ, f = sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψ z • X z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hf2 : ∀ y, f₂ y = ψ y * sepDensDiv G X y +
      c y * fderiv ℝ u y (Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y) := by
    intro y
    rw [hf₂def, hprod ψ _ hψD y]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hf1 : ∀ y, f₁ y = (1 - ψ y) * sepDensDiv G X y -
      c y * fderiv ℝ u y (Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y) := by
    intro y
    have := hprod (fun z => 1 - ψ z) _ (fun y => (hψD y).const_sub 1) y
    rw [hf₁def, this]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hI : ∀ y, sepDensDiv G X y = f₁ y + f₂ y := by
    intro y
    rw [hf1, hf2]
    ring
  have hZ2 : ∀ y, u y ≤ s → f₂ y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hl := hℓlo y hy
    have e1 : ψ y = 0 := by rw [hψ]; exact hρ0 _ hl.le
    have e2 : c y = 0 := by rw [hc]; simp only; rw [hρd0 _ hl, zero_mul]
    rw [hf2, e1, e2]
    ring
  have hZ1 : ∀ y, s + h ≤ u y → f₁ y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hl := hℓhi y hy
    have e1 : ψ y = 1 := by rw [hψ]; exact hρ1 _ hl.le
    have e2 : c y = 0 := by rw [hc]; simp only; rw [hρd1 _ hl, zero_mul]
    rw [hf1, e1, e2]
    ring
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ : ∃ Λ : ℝ, Λ = A + K * (2 / h) * (M * (4 / 3)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΛ0 : 0 ≤ Λ := by rw [hΛ]; positivity
  have hB1 : ∀ y, |f₁ y| ≤ Λ := by
    intro y
    rw [hf1]
    have hp := hψ01 y
    have e1 : |(1 - ψ y) * sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ 1 * A := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩) (hA y) (abs_nonneg _)
        (by norm_num)
    have e2 : |c y * fderiv ℝ u y (Real.sqrt (G y).det • X y)| ≤
        K * (2 / h) * (M * (4 / 3)) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hcb y) (hdu y) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have e1' := abs_le.mp e1
    have e2' := abs_le.mp e2
    rw [hΛ]
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [e1'.1, e2'.2], by linarith [e1'.2, e2'.1]⟩
  
  have hquadsmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (y : E3), 0 ≤ a → a ≤ 1 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (a • X y) i * (a • X y) j ≤ 1 := by
    intro a y ha0 ha1
    have hYi : ∀ i : Fin 3, (a • X y) i = a * X y i := fun i => by simp
    simp only [hYi]
    have hexp : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (a * X y i) * (a * X y j) =
        a ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [hexp]
    have hQ := hXQ y
    have ha2 : a ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have hm := mul_nonpos_iff.2 (Or.inl ⟨sq_nonneg a, (by linarith :
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j - 1 ≤ 0)⟩)
    nlinarith
  have hY1s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => (1 - ψ z) • X z) := (contDiff_const.sub hψC).smul hXs
  have hY2s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ z • X z) := hψC.smul hXs
  have hY1c : HasCompactSupport (fun z => (1 - ψ z) • X z) := by
    refine hXc.mono ?_
    intro z hz h0
    apply hz
    show (1 - ψ z) • X z = 0
    rw [h0, smul_zero]
  have hY2c : HasCompactSupport (fun z => ψ z • X z) := by
    refine hXc.mono ?_
    intro z hz h0
    apply hz
    show ψ z • X z = 0
    rw [h0, smul_zero]
  have hY1V : tsupport (fun z => (1 - ψ z) • X z) ⊆ V :=
    (tsupport_smul_subset_right _ _).trans hXV
  have hψsupp : tsupport ψ ⊆ {y | s < u y} := by
    have hsub : Function.support ψ ⊆ {y | s + h / 4 ≤ u y} := by
      intro y hy
      have hl : 0 < ℓ y := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        apply hy
        rw [hψ]
        exact hρ0 _ hcon
      have := hℓkey y
      show s + h / 4 ≤ u y
      nlinarith
    refine (closure_minimal hsub (isClosed_le continuous_const hucont)).trans ?_
    intro y hy
    show s < u y
    have : s + h / 4 ≤ u y := hy
    linarith
  have hY2V : tsupport (fun z => ψ z • X z) ⊆ V ∩ {y | s < u y} :=
    Set.subset_inter ((tsupport_smul_subset_right _ _).trans hXV)
      ((tsupport_smul_subset_left _ _).trans hψsupp)
  have hA1 : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, f₁ y) ≤ sepPerG G E V := by
    rw [hf₁def]
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le (fun z => (1 - ψ z) • X z)
      ⟨hY1s, hY1c, hY1V, fun y => hquadsmul _ y (by linarith [(hψ01 y).2])
        (by linarith [(hψ01 y).1])⟩ le_rfl
  have hA2 : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in F, f₂ y) ≤ sepPerG G F (V ∩ {y | s < u y}) := by
    rw [hf₂def]
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le (fun z => ψ z • X z)
      ⟨hY2s, hY2c, hY2V, fun y => hquadsmul _ y (hψ01 y).1 (hψ01 y).2⟩ le_rfl
  have hf₁I : Integrable f₁ := by
    obtain ⟨_, h1, h2⟩ := hS3 _ hY1s hY1c hY1V
    rw [hf₁def]
    exact h1.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport h2
  have hf₂I : Integrable f₂ := by
    obtain ⟨_, h1, h2⟩ := hS3 _ hY2s hY2c (hY2V.trans Set.inter_subset_left)
    rw [hf₂def]
    exact h1.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport h2
  
  have hDg : MeasurableSet ((E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y})) :=
    (hE.inter (measurableSet_le hum measurable_const)).union
      (hF.inter (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hum))
  have hS : MeasurableSet (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h}) :=
    (hE.symmDiff hF).inter ((measurableSet_lt measurable_const hum).inter
      (measurableSet_lt hum measurable_const))
  have hSfin : volume (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h}) < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt hvol ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hSreal : (volume (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h})).toReal ≤ σ * h :=
    ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (mul_nonneg hσ hh0.le) hvol
  have hSint : Integrable ((symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h}).indicator
      (fun _ => Λ)) :=
    (integrable_indicator_iff hS).2 (integrableOn_const hSfin.ne)
  have hstep2 : ∫ y in (E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y}), f₂ y = ∫ y in F, f₂ y := by
    rw [← integral_indicator hDg, ← integral_indicator hF]
    congr 1
    funext y
    simp only [Set.indicator_apply]
    by_cases hy : u y ≤ s
    · rw [hZ2 y hy]
      simp
    · have hsy : s < u y := lt_of_not_ge hy
      have hmem : y ∈ (E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y}) ↔ y ∈ F := by
        constructor
        · rintro (⟨_, h'⟩ | ⟨h', _⟩)
          · exact absurd h' hy
          · exact h'
        · intro h'
          exact Or.inr ⟨h', hsy⟩
      by_cases hyF : y ∈ F
      · rw [if_pos (hmem.2 hyF), if_pos hyF]
      · rw [if_neg (fun h' => hyF (hmem.1 h')), if_neg hyF]
  have hstep3 : ∫ y in (E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y}), f₁ y ≤
      (∫ y in E, f₁ y) + Λ * (volume (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h})).toReal := by
    rw [← integral_indicator hDg, ← integral_indicator hE]
    have hpt : ∀ y, ((E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y})).indicator f₁ y ≤
        E.indicator f₁ y + (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h}).indicator
          (fun _ => Λ) y := by
      intro y
      have hS0 : 0 ≤ (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h}).indicator (fun _ => Λ) y :=
        Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => hΛ0) y
      have hb := abs_le.mp (hB1 y)
      by_cases hy1 : u y ≤ s
      · have hmem : y ∈ (E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y}) ↔ y ∈ E := by
          constructor
          · rintro (⟨h', _⟩ | ⟨_, h'⟩)
            · exact h'
            · exact absurd hy1 (not_le.2 h')
          · intro h'
            exact Or.inl ⟨h', hy1⟩
        have heq : ((E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y})).indicator f₁ y =
            E.indicator f₁ y := by
          simp only [Set.indicator_apply]
          by_cases hyE : y ∈ E
          · rw [if_pos (hmem.2 hyE), if_pos hyE]
          · rw [if_neg (fun h' => hyE (hmem.1 h')), if_neg hyE]
        linarith
      by_cases hy2 : s + h ≤ u y
      · have e1 : ((E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y})).indicator f₁ y = 0 := by
          simp only [Set.indicator_apply, hZ1 y hy2, ite_self]
        have e2 : E.indicator f₁ y = 0 := by
          simp only [Set.indicator_apply, hZ1 y hy2, ite_self]
        linarith
      have hsy : s < u y := lt_of_not_ge hy1
      have hyh : u y < s + h := lt_of_not_ge hy2
      have hmem : y ∈ (E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y}) ↔ y ∈ F := by
        constructor
        · rintro (⟨_, h'⟩ | ⟨h', _⟩)
          · exact absurd h' hy1
          · exact h'
        · intro h'
          exact Or.inr ⟨h', hsy⟩
      by_cases hyE : y ∈ E <;> by_cases hyF : y ∈ F
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (hmem.2 hyF), Set.indicator_of_mem hyE]
        linarith
      · have hyS : y ∈ symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h} :=
          ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hyE, hyF⟩), hsy, hyh⟩
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h' => hyF (hmem.1 h')), Set.indicator_of_mem hyE,
          Set.indicator_of_mem hyS]
        linarith
      · have hyS : y ∈ symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h} :=
          ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hyF, hyE⟩), hsy, hyh⟩
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (hmem.2 hyF), Set.indicator_of_notMem hyE,
          Set.indicator_of_mem hyS]
        linarith
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h' => hyF (hmem.1 h')), Set.indicator_of_notMem hyE]
        linarith
    calc ∫ y, ((E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y})).indicator f₁ y
        ≤ ∫ y, (E.indicator f₁ y + (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h}).indicator
            (fun _ => Λ) y) :=
          integral_mono (hf₁I.indicator hDg) ((hf₁I.indicator hE).add hSint) hpt
      _ = (∫ y, E.indicator f₁ y) + ∫ y, (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h}).indicator
            (fun _ => Λ) y := integral_add (hf₁I.indicator hE) hSint
      _ = (∫ y, E.indicator f₁ y) +
            Λ * (volume (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h})).toReal := by
          rw [integral_indicator_const Λ hS, smul_eq_mul, measureReal_def, mul_comm]
  have hsplit : ∫ y in (E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y}), sepDensDiv G X y ≤
      (∫ y in E, f₁ y) + (∫ y in F, f₂ y) + 8 / 3 * K * M * σ + A * σ * h := by
    have e1 : ∫ y in (E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y}), sepDensDiv G X y =
        (∫ y in (E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y}), f₁ y) +
          ∫ y in (E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y}), f₂ y := by
      simp_rw [hI]
      exact integral_add hf₁I.integrableOn hf₂I.integrableOn
    have e2 : Λ * (σ * h) = A * σ * h + 8 / 3 * K * M * σ := by
      rw [hΛ]
      field_simp
      ring
    have e3 : Λ * (volume (symmDiff E F ∩ {y | s < u y ∧ u y < s + h})).toReal ≤ Λ * (σ * h) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSreal hΛ0
    rw [e1, hstep2]
    linarith [hstep3]
  
  calc ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in (E ∩ {y | u y ≤ s}) ∪ (F ∩ {y | s < u y}), sepDensDiv G X y)
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ y in E, f₁ y) + (∫ y in F, f₂ y) + 8 / 3 * K * M * σ +
          A * σ * h) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hsplit
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, f₁ y) + ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in F, f₂ y) +
          ENNReal.ofReal (8 / 3 * K * M * σ) + ENNReal.ofReal (A * σ * h) :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_add_le.trans (add_le_add (ENNReal.ofReal_add_le.trans
          (add_le_add ENNReal.ofReal_add_le le_rfl)) le_rfl)
    _ ≤ sepPerG G E V + sepPerG G F (V ∩ {y | s < u y}) +
          ENNReal.ofReal (8 / 3 * K * M * σ) + ε := by
        refine add_le_add (add_le_add (add_le_add hA1 hA2) le_rfl) ?_
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hAσh

informal_problem.statement: (m : ℝ → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hm : MonotoneOn m (Set.Icc a b)) (hc : m b - m a < c * (b - a)) : ∃ s : ℝ, a ≤ s ∧ s < b ∧ ∀ h₀ : ℝ, 0 < h₀ → ∃ h : ℝ, 0 < h ∧ h < h₀ ∧ s + h ≤ b ∧ m (s + h) - m s ≤ c * h

signature.name: sepMonotone_good_slice
signature.statement: (m : ℝ → ℝ) (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hm : MonotoneOn m (Set.Icc a b)) (hc : m b - m a < c * (b - a)) : ∃ s : ℝ, a ≤ s ∧ s < b ∧ ∀ h₀ : ℝ, 0 < h₀ → ∃ h : ℝ, 0 < h ∧ h < h₀ ∧ s + h ≤ b ∧ m (s + h) - m s ≤ c * h

proof.tactics:
by
  by_contra hne
  have hneg : ∀ s, a ≤ s → s < b → ∃ h₀ : ℝ, 0 < h₀ ∧ ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h < h₀ → s + h ≤ b →
      c * h < m (s + h) - m s := by
    intro s h1 h2
    by_contra hx
    apply hne
    refine ⟨s, h1, h2, fun h₀ hh₀ => ?_⟩
    by_contra hy
    apply hx
    refine ⟨h₀, hh₀, fun h hh hhh hsb => ?_⟩
    by_contra hz
    exact hy ⟨h, hh, hhh, hsb, not_lt.mp hz⟩
  have hab' : m a ≤ m b := hm ⟨le_refl a, hab.le⟩ ⟨hab.le, le_refl b⟩ hab.le
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by
    by_contra hc'
    push_neg at hc'
    have : c * (b - a) ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hc' (by linarith)
    linarith
  set K : ℝ := m a - c * a with hK
  set A : Set ℝ := {t : ℝ | a ≤ t ∧ t ≤ b ∧ ∀ x, a ≤ x → x ≤ t → K + c * x ≤ m x} with hA
  have haA : a ∈ A := by
    refine ⟨le_refl a, hab.le, fun x hx1 hx2 => ?_⟩
    have : x = a := le_antisymm hx2 hx1
    rw [this, hK]
    linarith
  have hne' : A.Nonempty := ⟨a, haA⟩
  have hbdd : BddAbove A := ⟨b, fun t ht => ht.2.1⟩
  set T : ℝ := sSup A with hT
  have haT : a ≤ T := le_csSup hbdd haA
  have hTb : T ≤ b := csSup_le hne' (fun t ht => ht.2.1)
  have s3 : ∀ x, a ≤ x → x < T → K + c * x ≤ m x := by
    intro x hx1 hx2
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup hne' hx2
    exact ht.2.2 x hx1 hxt.le
  have s4 : K + c * T ≤ m T := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le haT with hlt | heq
    · by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      set d : ℝ := K + c * T - m T with hd
      have hd0 : 0 < d := by linarith
      have hq : 0 < d / (2 * c) := by positivity
      set x : ℝ := max a (T - d / (2 * c)) with hx
      have hx1 : a ≤ x := le_max_left _ _
      have hx2 : x < T := max_lt hlt (by linarith)
      have hx3 : T - d / (2 * c) ≤ x := le_max_right _ _
      have hcx : c * (T - d / (2 * c)) ≤ c * x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx3 hc0.le
      have heq2 : c * (T - d / (2 * c)) = c * T - d / 2 := by
        field_simp
      have hPx := s3 x hx1 hx2
      have hmx : m x ≤ m T := hm ⟨hx1, by linarith⟩ ⟨haT, hTb⟩ hx2.le
      linarith
    · rw [← heq, hK]
      linarith
  have s5 : T ∈ A := by
    refine ⟨haT, hTb, fun x hx1 hx2 => ?_⟩
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hx2 with hlt | heq
    · exact s3 x hx1 hlt
    · rw [heq]; exact s4
  have s6 : T = b := by
    by_contra hTne
    have hTlt : T < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hTb hTne
    obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀, hloc⟩ := hneg T haT hTlt
    have hmin0 : 0 < min h₀ (b - T) := lt_min hh₀ (by linarith)
    set h : ℝ := min h₀ (b - T) / 2 with hh
    have hh0 : 0 < h := by positivity
    have hm1 : min h₀ (b - T) ≤ h₀ := min_le_left _ _
    have hm2 : min h₀ (b - T) ≤ b - T := min_le_right _ _
    have hhh₀ : h < h₀ := by linarith
    have hhb : T + h ≤ b := by linarith
    have hTh : T + h ∈ A := by
      refine ⟨by linarith, hhb, fun x hx1 hx2 => ?_⟩
      rcases le_or_gt x T with hxT | hxT
      · exact s5.2.2 x hx1 hxT
      · have h1 := hloc (x - T) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        have h2 : T + (x - T) = x := by ring
        rw [h2] at h1
        nlinarith
    have := le_csSup hbdd hTh
    linarith
  have hbA : b ∈ A := by rw [← s6]; exact s5
  have hfin := hbA.2.2 b hab.le (le_refl b)
  rw [hK] at hfin
  nlinarith

informal_problem.statement: (W V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) (hWc : IsCompact (closure W)) (hWV : closure W ⊆ V) : ∃ (u : E3 → ℝ) (L : Set E3) (M : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ u ∧ IsCompact L ∧ L ⊆ V ∧ (∀ y ∈ closure W, u y = 0) ∧ (∀ y, y ∉ L → u y = 1) ∧ 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖ ≤ M

signature.name: sepSmooth_shell_cutoff
signature.statement: (W V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) (hWc : IsCompact (closure W)) (hWV : closure W ⊆ V) : ∃ (u : E3 → ℝ) (L : Set E3) (M : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ u ∧ IsCompact L ∧ L ⊆ V ∧ (∀ y ∈ closure W, u y = 0) ∧ (∀ y, y ∉ L → u y = 1) ∧ 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖ ≤ M

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδV⟩ := hWc.exists_cthickening_subset_open hV hWV
  have hTo : IsOpen (Metric.thickening δ (closure W)) := Metric.isOpen_thickening
  have hWT : closure W ⊆ Metric.thickening δ (closure W) :=
    Metric.self_subset_thickening hδ (closure W)
  have hTL : Metric.thickening δ (closure W) ⊆ Metric.cthickening δ (closure W) :=
    Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening δ (closure W)
  have hLc : IsCompact (Metric.cthickening δ (closure W)) := hWc.cthickening
  have hLcl : IsClosed (Metric.cthickening δ (closure W)) := Metric.isClosed_cthickening
  have hdisj : Disjoint (closure W) (Metric.thickening δ (closure W))ᶜ :=
    Set.disjoint_compl_right_iff_subset.mpr hWT
  obtain ⟨u, hu, -, h0, h1⟩ := exists_contMDiff_zero_iff_one_iff_of_isClosed
    (𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) isClosed_closure hTo.isClosed_compl hdisj
  have hu' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u := contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp hu
  have hu1 : ∀ y, y ∉ Metric.cthickening δ (closure W) → u y = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    exact (h1 y).mp (fun hyT => hy (hTL hyT))
  have hvs : HasCompactSupport (fun y => u y - 1) :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro' hLc hLcl (fun y hy => by rw [hu1 y hy]; ring)
  have hvs' : HasCompactSupport (fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y - 1)) := hvs.fderiv ℝ
  have hvc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y - 1)) :=
    (hu'.sub contDiff_const).continuous_fderiv (by simp)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hvc.bounded_above_of_compact_support hvs'
  refine ⟨u, Metric.cthickening δ (closure W), max C 0, hu', hLc, hδV,
    fun y hy => (h0 y).mp hy, hu1, le_max_right _ _, fun y => ?_⟩
  have := hC y
  rw [fderiv_sub_const] at this
  exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U W : Set E3) (g : E3 → ℝ)
    (z₀ : E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hW : IsOpen W) (hWU : W ⊆ U) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ W) (hH : 0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G g z₀) :
    ∃ R ε : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ 0 < ε ∧ Metric.closedBall z₀ R ⊆ W ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ R,
        0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b *
            partialDeriv a (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z *
            partialDeriv b (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z ∧
        0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z

signature.name: sepTouch_strictify
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U W : Set E3) (g : E3 → ℝ)
    (z₀ : E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hW : IsOpen W) (hWU : W ⊆ U) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ W) (hH : 0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G g z₀) :
    ∃ R ε : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ 0 < ε ∧ Metric.closedBall z₀ R ⊆ W ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ R,
        0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b *
            partialDeriv a (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z *
            partialDeriv b (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z ∧
        0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hz₀U : z₀ ∈ U := hWU hz₀
  have hdet : (G z₀).det ≠ 0 := ((hpd z₀ hz₀U).det_pos).ne'
  
  have hQg : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G z₀)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a g z₀ * partialDeriv b g z₀ := by
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    have hs : Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G z₀)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a g z₀ * partialDeriv b g z₀) = 0 :=
      Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.mpr hneg
    have h0 : levelMeanCurvCoord G g z₀ = 0 := by
      unfold levelMeanCurvCoord
      rw [hs]
      simp
    linarith
  
  have hφ : ∀ y : E3, HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2)
      (2 • (innerSL ℝ (y - z₀)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)) y :=
    fun y => ((hasFDerivAt_id y).sub_const z₀).norm_sq
  have hgd : ∀ y : E3, HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℝ g y) y :=
    fun y => (hg.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  have hp1 : ∀ (ε : ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      partialDeriv a (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) =
        fun y => partialDeriv a g y - 2 * ε * (y a - z₀ a) := by
    intro ε a
    funext y
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2)
        (fderiv ℝ g y - ε • (2 • (innerSL ℝ (y - z₀)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3))) y :=
      (hgd y).sub ((hφ y).const_mul ε)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hd.fderiv]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right] <;> ring
  have hgj : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv j g) := fun j =>
    (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hg).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hp2 : ∀ (ε : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) (y : E3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2)) y =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j g) y - 2 * ε * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro ε i j y
    rw [hp1 ε j]
    have hA : HasFDerivAt (partialDeriv j g) (fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j g) y) y :=
      ((hgj j).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
    have hB : HasFDerivAt (fun x : E3 => 2 * ε * ((EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x - z₀ j))
        ((2 * ε) • (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) y :=
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt).sub_const (z₀ j)).const_mul (2 * ε)
    have hC : fderiv ℝ (fun x : E3 => partialDeriv j g x - 2 * ε * (x j - z₀ j)) y =
        fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j g) y - (2 * ε) • (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
      (hA.sub hB).fderiv
    show fderiv ℝ (fun x : E3 => partialDeriv j g x - 2 * ε * (x j - z₀ j)) y (e i) =
      fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j g) y (e i) - 2 * ε * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
    rw [hC]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; simp
    · simp [hij, Ne.symm hij]
  
  have hcenter : ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ,
      (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z₀)⁻¹ a b *
          partialDeriv a (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀ *
          partialDeriv b (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀ =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z₀)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a g z₀ * partialDeriv b g z₀) ∧
      levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀ =
        levelMeanCurvCoord G g z₀ - ε * c := by
    refine ⟨2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z₀)⁻¹ i j * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (G z₀)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i g z₀ * partialDeriv j g z₀) -
      2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G z₀)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a g z₀ * ((G z₀)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b g z₀) *
            (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (G z₀)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i g z₀ * partialDeriv j g z₀) ^ 3, fun ε => ?_⟩
    have h1 : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀ =
        partialDeriv a g z₀ := by
      intro a
      rw [hp1 ε a]
      simp
    have hhs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) i j z₀ =
        hessLoc G g i j z₀ - 2 * ε * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      intro i j
      unfold hessLoc
      rw [hp2 ε i j z₀]
      simp only [h1]
      ring
    have hQ : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z₀)⁻¹ a b *
          partialDeriv a (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀ *
          partialDeriv b (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀ =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z₀)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a g z₀ * partialDeriv b g z₀ := by
      simp only [h1]
    refine ⟨hQ, ?_⟩
    have hlap : lapLoc G (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀ = lapLoc G g z₀ -
        2 * ε * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z₀)⁻¹ i j * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      unfold lapLoc
      simp only [hhs]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      ring
    have hnum : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G z₀)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀ *
            ((G z₀)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀) *
            hessLoc G (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) i j z₀) =
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G z₀)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a g z₀ * ((G z₀)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b g z₀) *
            hessLoc G g i j z₀) -
        2 * ε * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G z₀)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a g z₀ * ((G z₀)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b g z₀) *
            (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) := by
      simp only [h1, hhs]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      ring
    unfold levelMeanCurvCoord
    rw [hlap, hnum, hQ]
    ring
  
  have hGc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (fun y => G y i j) z₀ := fun i j =>
    (hG i j).continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hz₀U)
  have hGm : ContinuousAt G z₀ :=
    continuousAt_pi.2 fun i => continuousAt_pi.2 fun j => hGc i j
  have hinvm : ContinuousAt (fun y => (G y)⁻¹) z₀ := by
    have hRi : ContinuousAt Ring.inverse (G z₀).det := by
      rw [Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
      exact continuousAt_inv₀ hdet
    exact (continuousAt_matrix_inv (G z₀) hRi).comp hGm
  have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) z₀ := fun i j =>
    continuousAt_pi.1 (continuousAt_pi.1 hinvm i) j
  have hdG : ∀ a b k : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z a b) y) z₀ := by
    intro a b k
    have h1 := ((hG a b).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).continuousAt
      (hU.mem_nhds hz₀U)
    exact h1.clm_apply continuousAt_const
  have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (fun y => christoffel G k i j y) z₀ := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact continuousAt_const.mul (tendsto_finset_sum _ fun l _ =>
      (hinv k l).mul (((hdG j l i).add (hdG i l j)).sub (hdG i j l)))
  have hcont : ∀ h : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ h →
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z₀)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a h z₀ * partialDeriv b h z₀ →
      ContinuousAt (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a h y * partialDeriv b h y) z₀ ∧
        ContinuousAt (levelMeanCurvCoord G h) z₀ := by
    intro h hh hQ0
    have hj : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv j h) := fun j =>
      (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hh).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
    have hd1 : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (partialDeriv a h) z₀ := fun a =>
      ((hh.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const).continuousAt
    have hd2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h)) z₀ := fun i j =>
      (((hj j).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const).continuousAt
    have hQc : ContinuousAt (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a h y * partialDeriv b h y) z₀ :=
      tendsto_finset_sum _ fun a _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
        ((hinv a b).mul (hd1 a)).mul (hd1 b)
    have hhess : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (fun y => hessLoc G h i j y) z₀ := by
      intro i j
      unfold hessLoc
      exact (hd2 i j).sub (tendsto_finset_sum _ fun k _ => (hchr k i j).mul (hd1 k))
    have hlap : ContinuousAt (fun y => lapLoc G h y) z₀ := by
      unfold lapLoc
      exact tendsto_finset_sum _ fun i _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        (hinv i j).mul (hhess i j)
    have hnum : ContinuousAt (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a h y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b h y) *
          hessLoc G h i j y) z₀ :=
      tendsto_finset_sum _ fun i _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        tendsto_finset_sum _ fun a _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
          (((hinv i a).mul (hd1 a)).mul ((hinv j b).mul (hd1 b))).mul (hhess i j)
    have hN := hQc.sqrt
    have hN0 : Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G z₀)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a h z₀ * partialDeriv b h z₀) ≠ 0 :=
      (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hQ0).ne'
    refine ⟨hQc, ?_⟩
    exact (hlap.div hN hN0).sub (hnum.div (hN.pow 3) (pow_ne_zero 3 hN0))
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hcenter
  have hc1 : 0 < 4 * (|c| + 1) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεc⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε * c < levelMeanCurvCoord G g z₀ := by
    refine ⟨levelMeanCurvCoord G g z₀ / (4 * (|c| + 1)), div_pos hH hc1, ?_⟩
    have hεpos : 0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G g z₀ / (4 * (|c| + 1)) := div_pos hH hc1
    have h2 : levelMeanCurvCoord G g z₀ / (4 * (|c| + 1)) * (4 * (|c| + 1)) =
        levelMeanCurvCoord G g z₀ := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hc1.ne'
    have h1 : levelMeanCurvCoord G g z₀ / (4 * (|c| + 1)) * c ≤
        levelMeanCurvCoord G g z₀ / (4 * (|c| + 1)) * |c| :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self c) hεpos.le
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg c]
  obtain ⟨hQeq, hHeq⟩ := hc ε
  have hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) :=
    hg.sub (contDiff_const.mul ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).norm_sq ℝ))
  have hQh0 : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z₀)⁻¹ a b *
      partialDeriv a (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀ *
      partialDeriv b (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀ := by
    rw [hQeq]; exact hQg
  have hHh0 : 0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y => g y - ε * ‖y - z₀‖ ^ 2) z₀ := by
    rw [hHeq]; linarith
  obtain ⟨hQc, hHc⟩ := hcont _ hh hQh0
  have ev := (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hQc hQh0).and
    (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hHc hHh0)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδb⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp ev
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrW⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW z₀ hz₀
  have hmin : 0 < min δ r := lt_min hδ hr
  refine ⟨min δ r / 2, ε, by positivity, hε, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    apply hrW
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    have := min_le_right δ r
    linarith
  · intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
    have hzδ : dist z z₀ < δ := by
      have := min_le_left δ r
      linarith
    exact hδb hzδ

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U A : Set E3) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (z₀ : E3) (R c : ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (hF : MeasurableSet F) (hR : 0 < R) (hRU : Metric.closedBall z₀ R ⊆ U)
    (hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h)
    (hNH : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ R,
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a h z * partialDeriv b h z ∧
      0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G h z)
    (hAo : IsOpen A) (hAsub : A ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z})
    (hBo : IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} \ A))
    (hloc : volume ((symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}) \
      Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2)) = 0)
    (hfin : sepPerG G F (Metric.ball z₀ R) ≠ ⊤) :
    IntegrableOn (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G h z)
        (symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}) ∧
    ∀ Y : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y → HasCompactSupport Y → tsupport Y ⊆ Metric.ball z₀ R →
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) →
      (∫ z in (F \ ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} ∩ Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2))) ∪
          (A ∩ Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2)), sepDensDiv G Y z) +
        (∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z},
          Real.sqrt (G z).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G h z) ≤
      (sepPerG G F (Metric.ball z₀ R)).toReal

      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) →
