proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hTU : Metric.ball z₀ R ⊆ U := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hRU
  have hGT : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) (Metric.ball z₀ R) :=
    fun i j => (hG i j).mono hTU
  have hpdT : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R, (G z).PosDef := fun z hz => hpd z (hTU hz)
  have hdetT : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R, 0 < (G z).det := fun z hz => (hpdT z hz).det_pos
  have hNT : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R,
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a h z * partialDeriv b h z :=
    fun z hz => (hNH z (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz)).1
  have hΩo : IsOpen {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hh.continuous)
  have hDm : MeasurableSet (symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}) :=
    (hF.symmDiff hAo.measurableSet).inter hΩo.measurableSet
  have hF'm : MeasurableSet ((F \ ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} ∩
      Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2))) ∪ (A ∩ Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2))) :=
    (hF.diff (hΩo.measurableSet.inter Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet)).union
      (hAo.measurableSet.inter Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet)
  obtain ⟨Xt, hXtdef⟩ : ∃ X : E3 → E3,
      X = fun z => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => calUnitNormal G h z i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXt : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R, ∀ i : Fin 3, Xt z i = calUnitNormal G h z i := by
    intro z _ i; rw [hXtdef]
  obtain ⟨-, hXsm', hCSall⟩ := ccs_normal_props G h (Metric.ball z₀ R) Metric.isOpen_ball hGT
    hpdT hh.contDiffOn Xt hXt
  have hXsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xt (Metric.ball z₀ R) := hXsm'.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz, hNT z hz⟩)
  have hXn : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G z i j * Xt z i * Xt z j = 1 := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [hXt z hz]
    exact sepTouch_unitNormal_Gnorm G h z (hdetT z hz).ne' (hNT z hz)
  have hdivX : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R,
      sepDensDiv G Xt z = Real.sqrt (G z).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G h z :=
    fun z hz => ccs_divx G h _ Metric.isOpen_ball hGT hsymm hpdT hh.contDiffOn Xt hXt z hz (hNT z hz)
  obtain ⟨sig, hsigdef⟩ : ∃ s : E3 → ℝ, s = fun z =>
      ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} \ A).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z -
        A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsig : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R, sig z =
      ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} \ A).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z -
        A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z := by
    intro z _; rw [hsigdef]
  have hsig1 : ∀ z, |sig z| ≤ 1 := by
    intro z
    simp only [hsigdef]
    by_cases hA : z ∈ A
    · have hB : z ∉ ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} \ A) := fun h' => h'.2 hA
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hA, Set.indicator_of_notMem hB]; norm_num
    · by_cases hB : z ∈ ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} \ A)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hB, Set.indicator_of_notMem hA]; norm_num
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hB, Set.indicator_of_notMem hA]; norm_num
  have hSD : symmDiff (F ∩ Metric.ball z₀ R) A ∩ {z : E3 | c < h z} =
      symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} := by
    ext z
    have hz := @hAsub z
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_symmDiff, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz ⊢
    tauto
  
  have hdivres : ∀ (V : E3 → E3) (S T : Set E3), MeasurableSet S → tsupport V ⊆ T →
      ∫ z in S, sepDensDiv G V z = ∫ z in S ∩ T, sepDensDiv G V z := by
    intro V S T hS hVT
    apply setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hS Set.inter_subset_left
    intro z hz
    have hzV : z ∉ tsupport V := fun h' => hz.2 ⟨hz.1, hVT h'⟩
    have hev : V =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hzV
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
    have hev' : (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * V w i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
      rw [hw]; simp
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hev'.fderiv_eq]; simp
  
  have hcomp : (((F \ ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} ∩
      Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2))) ∪ (A ∩ Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2))) ∩
        Metric.ball z₀ R : Set E3) =ᵐ[volume]
      (((F ∩ Metric.ball z₀ R) \ {z : E3 | c < h z}) ∪ A : Set E3) := by
    rw [ae_eq_set]
    constructor
    · refine measure_mono_null ?_ hloc
      intro z hz
      have hz' := @hAsub z
      simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_symmDiff,
        Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz hz' ⊢
      tauto
    · refine measure_mono_null ?_ hloc
      intro z hz
      have hz' := @hAsub z
      simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_symmDiff,
        Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz hz' ⊢
      tauto
  
  have hθlim : ∀ u : E3 → ℝ,
      IntegrableOn u (symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}) →
      Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z},
          calTheta c (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) (h z) * u z) atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}, u z)) := by
    intro u hu
    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun z => ‖u z‖) (fun k => ?_) hu.norm
      (fun k => ?_) ?_
    · have hk : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      exact (((ccs_theta_props c _ hk).1.continuous.comp hh.continuous).aestronglyMeasurable).mul
        hu.aestronglyMeasurable
    · have hk : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      obtain ⟨-, h0, h1, -⟩ := ccs_theta_props c _ hk
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (calTheta _ _ _), abs_of_nonneg (h0 _)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (h1 _)
    · filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hDm] with z hz
      have hδ : 0 < h z - c := sub_pos.2 hz.2.2
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hδ
      refine tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const (i₀ := N) (fun k hk => ?_)
      have hθ1 : calTheta c (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) (h z) = 1 := by
        unfold calTheta
        apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
        have hNk : (N : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk
        have hk' : 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1) :=
          one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
        have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
        have h1 : 1 ≤ (h z - c) / (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) := by
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos]; linarith
        linarith
      rw [hθ1, one_mul]
  
  have key : ∀ Y : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y → HasCompactSupport Y →
      tsupport Y ⊆ Metric.ball z₀ R →
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) →
      IntegrableOn (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G h z)
          (symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}) ∧
      (∫ z in (F \ ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} ∩ Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2))) ∪
          (A ∩ Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2)), sepDensDiv G Y z) +
        (∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z},
          Real.sqrt (G z).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G h z) ≤
      (sepPerG G F (Metric.ball z₀ R)).toReal := by
    intro Y hY hYc hYT hY1
    
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρR, hSρ⟩ := exists_lt_subset_ball (isClosed_tsupport Y) hYT
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁def⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = max ρ (3 * R / 4) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hr₁ : R / 2 < r₁ := by
      rw [hr₁def]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_max_right _ _)
    have hr₁R : r₁ < R := by rw [hr₁def]; exact max_lt hρR (by linarith)
    have hr₁pos : 0 < r₁ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂def⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = (r₁ + R) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hr₁₂ : r₁ < r₂ := by rw [hr₂def]; linarith
    have hr₂ : r₂ < R := by rw [hr₂def]; linarith
    let b : ContDiffBump z₀ := ⟨r₁, r₂, hr₁pos, hr₁₂⟩
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ f : E3 → ℝ, f = ⇑b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hψs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := by rw [hψdef]; exact b.contDiff
    have hψ0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ ψ z := fun z => by rw [hψdef]; exact b.nonneg
    have hψ1 : ∀ z, ψ z ≤ 1 := fun z => by rw [hψdef]; exact b.le_one
    have hψone : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r₁, ψ z = 1 :=
      fun z hz => by rw [hψdef]; exact b.one_of_mem_closedBall hz
    have hψzero : ∀ z, z ∉ Metric.closedBall z₀ r₂ → ψ z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hψdef]
      apply Function.notMem_support.1
      rw [b.support_eq]
      exact fun h' => hz (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall h')
    have hSr₁ : tsupport Y ⊆ Metric.ball z₀ r₁ :=
      hSρ.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by rw [hr₁def]; exact le_max_left _ _))
    have hdψ : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r₁, fderiv ℝ ψ z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hev : ψ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
        exact hψone w (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]; simp
    have hCc : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall z₀ r₂) := isCompact_closedBall z₀ r₂
    have hCT : Metric.closedBall z₀ r₂ ⊆ Metric.ball z₀ R := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hr₂
    have hKr₁ : Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball z₀ r₁ :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hr₁
    have hψT : ∀ z, z ∉ Metric.ball z₀ R → ψ z = 0 :=
      fun z hz => hψzero z (fun h' => hz (hCT h'))
    have hYT0 : ∀ z, z ∉ Metric.ball z₀ R → Y z = 0 :=
      fun z hz => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h' => hz (hYT h'))
    have hYψ : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R, ∀ i : Fin 3, Y z i = ψ z * Y z i := by
      intro z _ i
      by_cases hz : z ∈ tsupport Y
      · rw [hψone z (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hSr₁ hz)), one_mul]
      · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz]; simp
    
    have hae : ∀ᵐ z ∂(volume.restrict
        (symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z})), z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r₁ := by
      rw [ae_restrict_iff' hDm, ae_iff]
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ hloc
      intro z hz
      have hz' : ¬ (z ∈ symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} →
          z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ r₁) := hz
      have h1 : z ∈ symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} := by
        by_contra h'; exact hz' (fun h'' => absurd h'' h')
      have h2 : z ∉ Metric.ball z₀ r₁ := fun h' => hz' (fun _ => h')
      exact ⟨h1, fun hK => h2 (hKr₁ hK)⟩
    
    obtain ⟨d, hddef⟩ : ∃ d : E3 → ℝ, d = fun z => ψ z * sepDensDiv G Xt z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hstep : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
        IntegrableOn d (symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}) ∧
        IntegrableOn (fun z => sig z * sepDensDiv G Y z)
          (symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}) ∧
        (∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z},
            calTheta c η (h z) * d z) +
          ((∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z},
              sig z * sepDensDiv G Y z) -
            ∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z},
              calTheta c η (h z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G Y z)) ≤
          (sepPerG G F (Metric.ball z₀ R)).toReal -
            ∫ z in (F \ ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} ∩
              Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2))) ∪ (A ∩ Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2)),
              sepDensDiv G Y z := by
      intro η hη
      obtain ⟨-, hθ0, hθ1, -, -, -⟩ := ccs_theta_props c η hη
      obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁def⟩ : ∃ W : E3 → E3, W = fun z => ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
          (sig z * calTheta c η (h z)) • Xt z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨Zt, hZtdef⟩ : ∃ Z : E3 → E3, Z = fun z => calTheta c η (h z) • Xt z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨hW₁s, hW₁c, hW₁C⟩ := sepTouch_W1_smooth (Metric.ball z₀ R)
        (Metric.closedBall z₀ r₂) A h ψ sig Y Xt c η Metric.isOpen_ball hCc hCT hh hη hψs hψzero
        hY hXsm hAo hAsub hBo hsig
      rw [← hW₁def] at hW₁s hW₁c hW₁C
      have hW₁n : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * W₁ y i * W₁ y j ≤ 1 := by
        intro y
        by_cases hy : y ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R
        · rw [hW₁def]
          exact sepTouch_W1_norm (G y) (hpdT y hy) (Y y) (Xt y) (ψ y) (calTheta c η (h y))
            (sig y) (hY1 y) (hXn y hy).le (hψ0 y) (hψ1 y) (hθ0 _) (hθ1 _) (hsig1 y)
        · have : W₁ y = 0 := by rw [hW₁def]; simp [hψT y hy]
          rw [this]; simp
      have hW₁P : ∫ z in F, sepDensDiv G W₁ z ≤ (sepPerG G F (Metric.ball z₀ R)).toReal := by
        have hle : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z in F, sepDensDiv G W₁ z) ≤
            sepPerG G F (Metric.ball z₀ R) := by
          unfold sepPerG
          exact le_iSup₂_of_le W₁ ⟨hW₁s, hW₁c, hW₁C.trans hCT, hW₁n⟩ le_rfl
        exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal hfin).1 hle
      obtain ⟨hi1, hi2, hi3⟩ := ccs_euclid_calib G (Metric.ball z₀ R) (Metric.ball z₀ R)
        (Metric.closedBall z₀ r₂) (F ∩ Metric.ball z₀ R) A h ψ d sig Y Xt Zt Y W₁ c η
        Metric.isOpen_ball hGT hdetT hh.contDiffOn hη hψs.contDiffOn (fun z _ => hψ0 z) hCc hCT
        (fun z _ hz => hψzero z hz) Metric.isOpen_ball subset_rfl (fun z hz _ => hz)
        hY.contDiffOn hXsm (fun z hz _ => hCSall z hz (hNT z hz) (Y z) (hY1 z)) hAo hAsub hBo
        (hF.inter Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet) Set.inter_subset_right hsig hYT0 hYψ
        (fun z hz => by rw [hW₁def]; simp [hψT z hz])
        (fun z _ i => by rw [hW₁def]; simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.add_apply, smul_eq_mul])
        (fun z _ i => by rw [hZtdef]; simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul])
        (fun z _ _ => by rw [hddef])
      rw [hSD] at hi1 hi2 hi3
      have hZ0 : ∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z},
          Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z) = 0 := by
        apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
        filter_upwards [hae] with z hz
        rw [hdψ z hz]; simp
      have hW₁F : ∫ z in F ∩ Metric.ball z₀ R, sepDensDiv G W₁ z =
          ∫ z in F, sepDensDiv G W₁ z :=
        (hdivres W₁ F (Metric.ball z₀ R) hF (hW₁C.trans hCT)).symm
      have hYF' : ∫ z in ((F ∩ Metric.ball z₀ R) \ {z : E3 | c < h z}) ∪ A, sepDensDiv G Y z =
          ∫ z in (F \ ({z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z} ∩
            Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2))) ∪ (A ∩ Metric.closedBall z₀ (R / 2)),
            sepDensDiv G Y z := by
        rw [hdivres Y _ (Metric.ball z₀ R) hF'm hYT]
        exact (setIntegral_congr_set hcomp).symm
      refine ⟨hi1, hi2, ?_⟩
      rw [hZ0, hW₁F, hYF'] at hi3
      linarith
    
    obtain ⟨hdi, hsdi, -⟩ := hstep 1 one_pos
    have hdae : d =ᵐ[volume.restrict
        (symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z})]
        fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G h z := by
      filter_upwards [hae, ae_restrict_mem hDm] with z hz hzD
      have hzT : z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R := hzD.2.1
      rw [hddef]
      simp only
      rw [hψone z (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz), one_mul, hdivX z hzT]
    have hint : IntegrableOn (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G h z)
        (symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}) :=
      hdi.congr_fun_ae hdae
    have hdI : ∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}, d z =
        ∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z},
          Real.sqrt (G z).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G h z :=
      integral_congr_ae hdae
    
    have hDc : ∀ z ∈ symmDiff F A ∩ {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}, c < h z :=
      fun z hz => hz.2.2
    have t1 := hθlim d hdi
    have t2 := hθlim (fun z => sig z * sepDensDiv G Y z) hsdi
    have hlim := t1.add ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := ∫ z in symmDiff F A ∩
      {z : E3 | z ∈ Metric.ball z₀ R ∧ c < h z}, sig z * sepDensDiv G Y z)).sub t2)
    rw [sub_self, add_zero, hdI] at hlim
    have hle := le_of_tendsto' hlim (fun k => (hstep (1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1)) (by positivity)).2.2)
    exact ⟨hint, by linarith⟩
  
  refine ⟨(key 0 contDiff_const HasCompactSupport.zero
    (by rw [tsupport_zero]; exact Set.empty_subset _) (by intro y; simp)).1,
    fun Y hY hYc hYT hY1 => (key Y hY hYc hYT hY1).2⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_euclid_calib
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T T' C Ft At : Set E3) (f ψ d sig : E3 → ℝ) (Yt Xt Zt W₀ W₁ : E3 → E3) (r₁ η : ℝ) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (hη : 0 < η) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ T) (hψ0 : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 ≤ ψ z) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCT : C ⊆ T) (hψC : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∉ C → ψ z = 0) (hT'o : IsOpen T') (hT'T : T' ⊆ T) (hT'f : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ ≤ f z → z ∈ T') (hYt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt T) (hXt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xt T') (hCS : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → |fderiv ℝ f z (Yt z)| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (Xt z)) (hAo : IsOpen At) (hAsub : At ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z}) (hBo : IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} \ At)) (hFm : MeasurableSet Ft) (hFT : Ft ⊆ T) (hsig : ∀ z ∈ T, sig z = ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} \ At).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - At.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) (hW₀o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → W₀ z = 0) (hW₀ : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₀ z i = ψ z * Yt z i) (hW₁o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → W₁ z = 0) (hW₁ : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₁ z i = ψ z * ((1 - calTheta r₁ η (f z)) * Yt z i + sig z * calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i)) (hZt : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, Zt z i = calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i) (hd : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → d z = ψ z * sepDensDiv G Xt z) : IntegrableOn d (symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun z => sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) (symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∧ (∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z) + (∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z)) + ((∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) - ∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z)) ≤ (∫ z in Ft, sepDensDiv G W₁ z) - ∫ z in (Ft \ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∪ At, sepDensDiv G W₀ z

by
  intro F ν X τ hν hτ hτ4 hνX hX hslab hbelow habove
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ : ∃ γ : ℝ → E3, γ = fun t => X + t • ν := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hγc : Continuous γ := by
    rw [hγ]; exact continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
  have hXν : @inner ℝ E3 _ X ν = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hνX
  have hgeom : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 1 / 2 →
      γ t ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (γ t) = t := by
    intro t ht
    have hin : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (γ t) = t := by
      simp only [hγ, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, hνX, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hν]
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, hin⟩
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    have h1 : ‖γ t‖ ^ 2 = ‖X‖ ^ 2 + t ^ 2 := by
      simp only [hγ]
      rw [norm_add_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right, hXν, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hν,
        mul_one, sq_abs]
      ring
    have h2 : t ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      have := abs_le.mp ht
      nlinarith
    have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖X‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have h4 : 0 ≤ ‖γ t‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have h5 : ‖X‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have hopenA : IsOpen {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) = 0} := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    rintro z ⟨N, hN, h0⟩
    filter_upwards [Filter.Eventually.eventually_nhds hN] with y hy
    exact ⟨N, hy, h0⟩
  have hopenB : IsOpen {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ F) = 0} := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    rintro z ⟨N, hN, h0⟩
    filter_upwards [Filter.Eventually.eventually_nhds hN] with y hy
    exact ⟨N, hy, h0⟩
  have hdisj : ∀ z : E3, (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) = 0) →
      (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ F) = 0) → False := by
    rintro z ⟨N₁, hN₁, h₁⟩ ⟨N₂, hN₂, h₂⟩
    have hN : N₁ ∩ N₂ ∈ 𝓝 z := Filter.inter_mem hN₁ hN₂
    have hpos : 0 < volume (N₁ ∩ N₂) := MeasureTheory.Measure.measure_pos_of_mem_nhds volume hN
    have hsub : N₁ ∩ N₂ ⊆ (N₁ ∩ F) ∪ (N₂ \ F) := by
      rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      by_cases hxF : x ∈ F
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hx1, hxF⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hx2, hxF⟩

    exact lt_irrefl _ hpos

    continuous_const.inner continuous_id
  have hB : -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ γ ⁻¹' {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ F) = 0} := by
    obtain ⟨hb, hi⟩ := hgeom (-(1 / 2)) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by norm_num)])
    refine ⟨Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ}, ?_, hbelow⟩
    refine (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt hinnc continuous_const)).mem_nhds ⟨hb, ?_⟩
    show @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (γ (-(1 / 2))) < -τ
    rw [hi]; linarith
  have hA : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ γ ⁻¹' {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) = 0} := by
    obtain ⟨hb, hi⟩ := hgeom (1 / 2) (by rw [abs_of_pos (by norm_num)])
    refine ⟨Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z}, ?_, habove⟩
    refine (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hinnc)).mem_nhds ⟨hb, ?_⟩
    show τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (γ (1 / 2))
    rw [hi]; linarith
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htU, htV⟩ : ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2),

  subst hγ

      (volume (N \ F) = 0 → volume (Ω \ F) = 0) ∧
        (volume (N ∩ F) = 0 → volume (Ω ∩ F) = 0) := by
    intro Ω N w hΩo hΩc hwΩ hN hnb
    obtain ⟨U₁, hU₁⟩ : ∃ U : Set E3, U = {x | ∃ O ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (O \ F) = 0} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨U₂, hU₂⟩ : ∃ U : Set E3, U = {x | ∃ O ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (O ∩ F) = 0} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hU₁o : IsOpen U₁ := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      intro x hx
      rw [hU₁] at hx ⊢
      obtain ⟨O, hO, h0⟩ := hx
      refine Filter.mem_of_superset (interior_mem_nhds.2 hO) ?_
      intro p hp
      exact ⟨interior O, isOpen_interior.mem_nhds hp,
        measure_mono_null (Set.diff_subset_diff_left interior_subset) h0⟩
    have hU₂o : IsOpen U₂ := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      intro x hx
      rw [hU₂] at hx ⊢
      obtain ⟨O, hO, h0⟩ := hx
      refine Filter.mem_of_superset (interior_mem_nhds.2 hO) ?_
      intro p hp
      exact ⟨interior O, isOpen_interior.mem_nhds hp,
        measure_mono_null (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ interior_subset) h0⟩
    have hdisj : Disjoint U₁ U₂ := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro x hx1 hx2
      rw [hU₁] at hx1
      rw [hU₂] at hx2
      obtain ⟨O₁, hO₁, h₁⟩ := hx1
      obtain ⟨O₂, hO₂, h₂⟩ := hx2
      have hpos : 0 < volume (O₁ ∩ O₂) :=
        Measure.measure_pos_of_mem_nhds volume (Filter.inter_mem hO₁ hO₂)
      have hsub : O₁ ∩ O₂ ⊆ (O₂ ∩ F) ∪ (O₁ \ F) := by
        intro p hp
        by_cases hpF : p ∈ F
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hp.2, hpF⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hp.1, hpF⟩
      have hnull : volume (O₁ ∩ O₂) = 0 := measure_mono_null hsub (measure_union_null h₂ h₁)
      rw [hnull] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
    have hcov : Ω ⊆ U₁ ∪ U₂ := by
      intro x hx
      have h := hnb x hx
      push_neg at h
      obtain ⟨N', hN', h'⟩ := h
      by_cases h0 : volume (N' ∩ F) = 0
      · right; rw [hU₂]; exact ⟨N', hN', h0⟩
      · left; rw [hU₁]; exact ⟨N', hN', h' h0⟩
    constructor
    · intro h0
      have hwU : w ∈ U₁ := by rw [hU₁]; exact ⟨N, hN, h0⟩
      have hsub : Ω ⊆ U₁ :=
        hΩc.subset_left_of_subset_union hU₁o hU₂o hdisj hcov ⟨w, hwΩ, hwU⟩
      apply measure_null_of_locally_null
      intro x hx
      have hx1 := hsub hx.1
      rw [hU₁] at hx1
      obtain ⟨O, hO, hO0⟩ := hx1
      exact ⟨(Ω \ F) ∩ O, inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hO,
        measure_mono_null (show (Ω \ F) ∩ O ⊆ O \ F from fun p hp => ⟨hp.2, hp.1.2⟩) hO0⟩
    · intro h0
      have hwU : w ∈ U₂ := by rw [hU₂]; exact ⟨N, hN, h0⟩
      have hcov' : Ω ⊆ U₂ ∪ U₁ := by rw [Set.union_comm]; exact hcov
      have hsub : Ω ⊆ U₂ :=
        hΩc.subset_left_of_subset_union hU₂o hU₁o hdisj.symm hcov' ⟨w, hwΩ, hwU⟩
      apply measure_null_of_locally_null
      intro x hx
      have hx1 := hsub hx.1
      rw [hU₂] at hx1
      obtain ⟨O, hO, hO0⟩ := hx1
      exact ⟨(Ω ∩ F) ∩ O, inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hO,
        measure_mono_null (show (Ω ∩ F) ∩ O ⊆ O ∩ F from fun p hp => ⟨hp.2, hp.1.2⟩) hO0⟩
  
  have hq : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ j → 4 * τ ≤ δH * (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k := by
    intro k hk
    have h8 : (8 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ 8 ^ j := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hk
    have hinv : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k * 8 ^ k = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    have hqpos : 0 < (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
    have h1 : 4 * τ * 8 ^ k ≤ δH :=
      le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h8 (by linarith)) hj
    calc 4 * τ = 4 * τ * ((1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k * 8 ^ k) := by rw [hinv, mul_one]
      _ = 4 * τ * 8 ^ k * (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k := by ring
      _ ≤ δH * (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hqpos.le
  have hcont : Continuous (fun x : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x) := continuous_const.inner continuous_id
  have hlin : IsLinearMap ℝ (fun x : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x) :=
    IsLinearMap.mk (fun x w => inner_add_right ν x w) (fun c x => real_inner_smul_right ν x c)
  have hνν : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν ν = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hν]; norm_num
  have hyball : ∀ ρ : ℝ, ρ ≤ 1 / 2 → ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball y ρ, w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 := by
    intro ρ hρ w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    calc ‖w‖ = ‖(w - y) + y‖ := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
      _ ≤ ‖w - y‖ + ‖y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ < 1 := by linarith
  have hyslab : |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν y| ≤ τ :=
    hslab y (mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (by linarith)) hyb
  have hyτ := abs_le.1 hyslab
  
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ j → ∃ a b : ℝ, -τ ≤ a ∧ b = a + 2 * τ * (1 - cH) ^ k ∧ b ≤ τ ∧
      (∀ w ∈ Metric.ball y ((1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k / 2),
        (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
        a ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w ≤ b) ∧
      volume ((Metric.ball y ((1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k / 2) ∩ {w | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w < a}) \ F) = 0 ∧
      volume (Metric.ball y ((1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k / 2) ∩ {w | b < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w} ∩ F) = 0 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      simp only [pow_zero]
      have hsub : Metric.ball y (1 / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 :=
        fun w hw => hyball (1 / 2) le_rfl w hw
      refine ⟨-τ, τ, le_rfl, by ring, le_rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro w hw hwb
        exact abs_le.1 (hslab w (hsub hw) hwb)
      · exact measure_mono_null
          (Set.diff_subset_diff_left (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hsub)) hside1
      · exact measure_mono_null
          (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hsub)) hside2
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk1
      have hk : k ≤ j := Nat.le_of_succ_le hk1
      obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hbτ, hbd, hs1, hs2⟩ := ih hk
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = 2 * τ * (1 - cH) ^ k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hr] at hbd hs1 hs2
      rw [← hL] at hb
      have hqk := hq k hk
      have hqk1 := hq (k + 1) hk1
      have hqpos : 0 < (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
      have hr0 : 0 < r := by rw [hr]; positivity
      have hrle : r ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        have : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        rw [hr]; linarith
      have hcpow0 : 0 ≤ (1 - cH) ^ k := pow_nonneg (by linarith) k
      have hcpow1 : (1 - cH) ^ k ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := by rw [hL]; exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) hcpow0
      have hLr : L ≤ δH * r := by
        have : 2 * τ * (1 - cH) ^ k ≤ 2 * τ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcpow1 (by linarith)
        rw [hL, hr]; linarith
      have hguard : η * τ * r ^ 2 ≤ δH * L := by
        have h64 : ((1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ 2 = (1 / 64 : ℝ) ^ k := by rw [sq, ← mul_pow]; norm_num
        have hp : (1 / 64 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (1 - cH) ^ k := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by linarith) k
        have hp0 : 0 ≤ (1 / 64 : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
        have hr2 : r ^ 2 = (1 / 64 : ℝ) ^ k / 4 := by rw [hr, div_pow, h64]; norm_num
        rw [hr2, hL]
        have e1 : η * τ * ((1 / 64 : ℝ) ^ k / 4) ≤ 8 * δH * τ * ((1 / 64 : ℝ) ^ k / 4) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hη8 hτ.le
        have e2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * δH * τ)
        nlinarith
      have hsub : Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 := by
        intro w hw
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw
        rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
        calc ‖w‖ = ‖(w - y) + y‖ := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
          _ ≤ ‖w - y‖ + ‖y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ < 1 := by linarith
      have hba : b - a = L := by linarith
      obtain ⟨a', b', haa, hab', hbb, hwid, hbd'⟩ :=
        hHarn y r a b hyb hr0 hsub (by linarith) (by linarith) (by rw [hba]; exact hguard)
          hbd hs1 hs2
      rw [hba] at hwid
      have hL'0 : 0 ≤ (1 - cH) * L := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hL0
      have hL'L : (1 - cH) * L ≤ L := by nlinarith
      obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁⟩ : ∃ a₁ : ℝ, a₁ = min a' (b - (1 - cH) * L) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have ha₁τ : -τ ≤ a₁ := by rw [ha₁]; exact le_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have ha₁a' : a₁ ≤ a' := by rw [ha₁]; exact min_le_left _ _
      have ha₁b : a₁ ≤ b - (1 - cH) * L := by rw [ha₁]; exact min_le_right _ _
      have hb'a₁ : b' - (1 - cH) * L ≤ a₁ := by rw [ha₁]; exact le_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hr8 : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) / 2 = r / 8 := by rw [hr]; ring
      have hLL : 2 * τ * (1 - cH) ^ (k + 1) = (1 - cH) * L := by rw [hL]; ring
      rw [hr8, hLL]
      have hbd₁ : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball y (r / 8),
          (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
          a₁ ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w ≤ a₁ + (1 - cH) * L := by
        intro w hw hwb
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hbd' w hw hwb
        constructor <;> linarith
      have hq1' : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) = r / 4 := by rw [hr, pow_succ]; ring
      rw [hq1'] at hqk1
      have hρ : 4 * τ < r / 8 := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hδ64 hr0.le
        nlinarith
      have hρpos : 0 < r / 8 := by positivity
      have hΩo : ∀ c : ℝ, IsOpen (Metric.ball y (r / 8) ∩ {x : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x < c}) :=
        fun c => Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt hcont continuous_const)
      have hΩo' : ∀ c : ℝ, IsOpen (Metric.ball y (r / 8) ∩ {x : E3 | c < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x}) :=
        fun c => Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hcont)
      refine ⟨a₁, a₁ + (1 - cH) * L, ha₁τ, rfl, by linarith, hbd₁, ?_, ?_⟩
      · 
        obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : E3, w = y - (r / 8 / 2) • ν := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        have hwy : dist w y < r / 8 := by
          rw [dist_eq_norm, hw, sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg, norm_smul, hν, Real.norm_eq_abs,
            abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
          linarith
        have hwh : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w = @inner ℝ E3 _ ν y - r / 8 / 2 := by
          rw [hw, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, hνν, mul_one]
        have hw1 : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 :=
          hyball (r / 8) (by linarith) w (Metric.mem_ball.2 hwy)
        have hwlt : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w < -τ := by rw [hwh]; linarith
        have hN : Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {x | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x < -τ} ∈ 𝓝 w :=
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt hcont continuous_const)).mem_nhds ⟨hw1, hwlt⟩
        have hwa : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w < a₁ := by linarith
        refine (hprop _ _ w (hΩo a₁)
          ((convex_ball y (r / 8)).inter (convex_halfSpace_lt hlin a₁)).isPreconnected
          ⟨Metric.mem_ball.2 hwy, hwa⟩ hN ?_).1 hside1
        intro x hx hxb
        have := (hbd₁ x hx.1 hxb).1
        exact (not_lt.2 this) hx.2
      · 
        obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : E3, w = y + (r / 8 / 2) • ν := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        have hwy : dist w y < r / 8 := by
          rw [dist_eq_norm, hw, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hν, Real.norm_eq_abs,
            abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
          linarith
        have hwh : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w = @inner ℝ E3 _ ν y + r / 8 / 2 := by
          rw [hw, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, hνν, mul_one]
        have hw1 : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 :=
          hyball (r / 8) (by linarith) w (Metric.mem_ball.2 hwy)
        have hwlt : τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w := by rw [hwh]; linarith
        have hN : Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {x | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν x} ∈ 𝓝 w :=
          (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hcont)).mem_nhds ⟨hw1, hwlt⟩
        have hwa : a₁ + (1 - cH) * L < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν w := by linarith
        refine (hprop _ _ w (hΩo' _)
          ((convex_ball y (r / 8)).inter (convex_halfSpace_gt hlin _)).isPreconnected
          ⟨Metric.mem_ball.2 hwy, hwa⟩ hN ?_).2 hside2
        intro x hx hxb
        have := (hbd₁ x hx.1 hxb).2
        exact (not_lt.2 this) hx.2
  
  obtain ⟨a, b, -, hb, -, hbd, -, -⟩ := key j le_rfl
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ j / 2 := by positivity
  have hz := hbd z (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; exact hzy) hzb
  have hy' := hbd y (Metric.mem_ball_self hr0) hyb
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  constructor <;> linarith [hz.1, hz.2, hy'.1, hy'.2]

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (R : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ → Prop), 0 ≤ ℓ → ℓ < 1 →
    (∀ k ζ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → ∃ t, R k ζ t) →
    (∀ k ζ t, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → R k ζ t → |t| ≤ 1) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k, K ≤ k → ∀ ζ ζ' t t', ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → ‖ζ'‖ ≤ 1 / 3 →
      ‖ζ - ζ'‖ < (1 / 8) ^ j / 4 → R k ζ t → R k ζ' t' → |t - t'| ≤ 2 * ℓ ^ j) →
    ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (u : ℂ → ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧ Continuous u ∧ (∀ ζ, |u ζ| ≤ 1) ∧
      ∀ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ → ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k, K ≤ k → ∀ ζ t, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → R (φ k) ζ t →
        |t - u ζ| ≤ γ

signature.statement:
∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (R : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ → Prop), 0 ≤ ℓ → ℓ < 1 →
    (∀ k ζ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → ∃ t, R k ζ t) →
    (∀ k ζ t, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → R k ζ t → |t| ≤ 1) →
    (∀ j : ℕ, ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k, K ≤ k → ∀ ζ ζ' t t', ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → ‖ζ'‖ ≤ 1 / 3 →
      ‖ζ - ζ'‖ < (1 / 8) ^ j / 4 → R k ζ t → R k ζ' t' → |t - t'| ≤ 2 * ℓ ^ j) →
    ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (u : ℂ → ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧ Continuous u ∧ (∀ ζ, |u ζ| ≤ 1) ∧
      ∀ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ → ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k, K ≤ k → ∀ ζ t, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → R (φ k) ζ t →
        |t - u ζ| ≤ γ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ℓ R hℓ0 hℓ1 hex hbd hmod
  
  have hsel : ∀ (k : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ), ∃ t : ℝ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → R k ζ t := by
    intro k ζ
    by_cases h : ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hex k ζ h
      exact ⟨t, fun _ => ht⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h' => absurd h' h⟩
  choose f hfR using hsel
  have hf1 : ∀ k ζ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → |f k ζ| ≤ 1 := fun k ζ h => hbd k ζ _ h (hfR k ζ h)
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqd⟩ : ∃ q : ℕ → ℂ, (∀ n, ‖q n‖ ≤ 1 / 3) ∧
      ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ n, ‖ζ - q n‖ < ε := by
    haveI : Nonempty (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 3)) :=
      ⟨⟨0, mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 (by norm_num)⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := TopologicalSpace.exists_dense_seq (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 3))
    refine ⟨fun n => (w n : ℂ), fun n => mem_closedBall_zero_iff.1 (w n).2, ?_⟩
    intro ζ hζ ε hε
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hw.exists_dist_lt
      (⟨ζ, mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 hζ⟩ : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 3)) hε
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm] at hn
    exact hn
  
  obtain ⟨φ, a, hφ, hconv⟩ : ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧
      ∀ n, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f (φ k) (q n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (a n)) := by
    have hs : IsCompact (Set.univ.pi (fun _ : ℕ => Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)) :=
      isCompact_univ_pi (fun _ => isCompact_Icc)
    have hmem : ∀ k, (fun n => f k (q n)) ∈ Set.univ.pi (fun _ : ℕ => Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) := by
      intro k
      rw [Set.mem_univ_pi]
      intro n
      exact abs_le.1 (hf1 k (q n) (hq n))
    obtain ⟨a, -, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ := hs.tendsto_subseq hmem
    exact ⟨φ, a, hφ, fun n => (tendsto_pi_nhds.1 hlim) n⟩
  
  have hAEC : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k, K ≤ k → ∀ ζ ζ' : ℂ,
      ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → ‖ζ'‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → ‖ζ - ζ'‖ < δ → |f (φ k) ζ - f (φ k) ζ'| ≤ ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (half_pos hε) hℓ1
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hmod j
    refine ⟨(1 / 8) ^ j / 4, by positivity, K, fun k hk ζ ζ' hζ hζ' hd => ?_⟩
    have := hK (φ k) (le_trans hk (hφ.id_le k)) ζ ζ' _ _ hζ hζ' hd (hfR _ ζ hζ) (hfR _ ζ' hζ')
    linarith
  
  have hUC : ∀ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ → ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k m, K ≤ k → K ≤ m → ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 →
      |f (φ k) ζ - f (φ m) ζ| ≤ γ := by
    intro γ hγ
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, K₀, hK₀⟩ := hAEC (γ / 4) (by positivity)
    have hcov : Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 3) ⊆ ⋃ n, Metric.ball (q n) δ := by
      intro ζ hζ
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at hζ
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hqd ζ hζ δ hδ
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; exact hn⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 3)).elim_finite_subcover
      (fun n => Metric.ball (q n) δ) (fun n => Metric.isOpen_ball) hcov
    have hN : ∀ n, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ k, N ≤ k → |f (φ k) (q n) - a n| < γ / 8 := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 (hconv n) (γ / 8) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨N, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      have := hN k hk
      rwa [Real.dist_eq] at this
    choose N hN using hN
    refine ⟨max K₀ (t.sup N), fun k m hk hm ζ hζ => ?_⟩
    have hζ' : ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 3) := mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 hζ
    obtain ⟨n, hnt, hn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (ht hζ')
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hn
    have hNn : N n ≤ t.sup N := Finset.le_sup hnt
    have h1 := hK₀ k (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk) ζ (q n) hζ (hq n) hn
    have h2 := hK₀ m (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hm) ζ (q n) hζ (hq n) hn
    have h3 := hN n k (le_trans hNn (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk))
    have h4 := hN n m (le_trans hNn (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hm))
    rw [abs_le] at h1 h2 ⊢
    rw [abs_lt] at h3 h4
    constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2, h3.1, h3.2, h4.1, h4.2]
  
  have hcs : ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → CauchySeq (fun k => f (φ k) ζ) := by
    intro ζ hζ
    rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hUC (ε / 2) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨K, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have := hK m n hm hn ζ hζ
    linarith
  obtain ⟨v, hvdef⟩ : ∃ v : ℂ → ℝ, ∀ ζ, v ζ = limUnder Filter.atTop (fun k => f (φ k) ζ) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hv : ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f (φ k) ζ) Filter.atTop (nhds (v ζ)) := by
    intro ζ hζ
    rw [hvdef]
    exact (hcs ζ hζ).tendsto_limUnder
  have hv1 : ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → |v ζ| ≤ 1 := fun ζ hζ =>
    le_of_tendsto' (hv ζ hζ).abs (fun k => hf1 _ ζ hζ)
  have hunif : ∀ γ : ℝ, 0 < γ → ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k, K ≤ k → ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 →
      |f (φ k) ζ - v ζ| ≤ γ := by
    intro γ hγ
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hUC γ hγ
    refine ⟨K, fun k hk ζ hζ => ?_⟩
    refine le_of_tendsto ((tendsto_const_nhds.sub (hv ζ hζ)).abs) ?_
    rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
    exact ⟨K, fun m hm => hK k m hk hm ζ hζ⟩
  have hvc : ContinuousOn v (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 3)) := by
    rw [Metric.continuousOn_iff]
    intro b hb ε hε
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at hb
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, K₀, hK₀⟩ := hAEC (ε / 2) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun x hx hxb => ?_⟩
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at hx
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hxb
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have : |v x - v b| ≤ ε / 2 := by
      refine le_of_tendsto (((hv x hx).sub (hv b hb)).abs) ?_
      rw [Filter.eventually_atTop]
      exact ⟨K₀, fun k hk => hK₀ k hk x b hx hb hxb⟩
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℂ → ℂ, ∀ ζ, P ζ = ((max 1 (3 * ‖ζ‖))⁻¹ : ℝ) • ζ :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hPc : Continuous P := by
    have hPe : P = fun ζ => ((max 1 (3 * ‖ζ‖))⁻¹ : ℝ) • ζ := funext hP
    rw [hPe]
    have hm : Continuous (fun ζ : ℂ => max 1 (3 * ‖ζ‖)) :=
      continuous_const.max (continuous_const.mul continuous_norm)
    exact (hm.inv₀ (fun ζ => (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_left _ _)).ne')).smul continuous_id
  have hPn : ∀ ζ, ‖P ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 := by
    intro ζ
    have hpos : 0 < max 1 (3 * ‖ζ‖) := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_left _ _)
    have h3 : 3 * ‖ζ‖ ≤ max 1 (3 * ‖ζ‖) := le_max_right _ _
    rw [hP, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hpos.le), inv_mul_le_iff₀ hpos]
    linarith
  have hPid : ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → P ζ = ζ := by
    intro ζ hζ
    rw [hP, max_eq_left (by linarith), inv_one, one_smul]
  refine ⟨φ, fun ζ => v (P ζ), hφ,
    hvc.comp_continuous hPc (fun ζ => mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 (hPn ζ)),
    fun ζ => hv1 _ (hPn ζ), ?_⟩
  
  intro γ hγ
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (show (0 : ℝ) < γ / 4 by positivity) hℓ1
  obtain ⟨Kj, hKj⟩ := hmod j
  obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ := hunif (γ / 2) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨max K₁ Kj, fun k hk ζ t hζ ht => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hKj (φ k) (le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hk) (hφ.id_le k)) ζ ζ t
    (f (φ k) ζ) hζ hζ (by rw [sub_self, norm_zero]; positivity) ht (hfR _ ζ hζ)
  have h2 := hK₁ k (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hk) ζ hζ
  show |t - v (P ζ)| ≤ γ
  rw [hPid ζ hζ]
  rw [abs_le] at h1 h2 ⊢
  constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]

∀ (T : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (F : Set E3) (ν e1 e2 : E3) (τ η γ : ℝ)
    (u : ℂ → ℝ) (x₀ : ℂ) (p1 p2 a b d c σ s : ℝ),
    ‖ν‖ = 1 → ‖e1‖ = 1 → ‖e2‖ = 1 → @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 e2 = 0 → @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 ν = 0 →
    @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 ν = 0 →
    (∀ z : E3, z = @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z • e1 + @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z • e2 + @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z • ν) →
    0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 / 100 →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z| ≤ τ) →
    volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ}) \ F) = 0 →
    volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 →
    (∀ A μ : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 < μ → τ ≤ T A μ → η ≤ T A μ →
      ∀ (b z₀ : E3) (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : ℝ) (N : Set E3),
      @inner ℝ E3 _ b ν = 0 → (∀ i j, M i j = M j i) → (∀ i, ∑ j, M i j * ν j = 0) →
      ‖b‖ ≤ A → (∀ i j, |M i j| ≤ A) → z₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) →
      (∀ N' ∈ 𝓝 z₀, volume (N' ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N' \ F) ≠ 0) →
      @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z₀ = τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z₀ + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z₀ i * z₀ j + c) →
      N ∈ 𝓝 z₀ →
      (μ ≤ ∑ i, M i i → volume ((N ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z <
          τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z i * z j + c)}) \ F) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∑ i, M i i ≤ -μ → volume (N ∩ {z | τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ b z +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * z i * z j + c) < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) ≠ 0)) →
    (∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 3 → ∃ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (ζ.re • e1 + ζ.im • e2 + (τ * t) • ν), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      ‖(⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z, @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z⟩ : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 / 3 →
      |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z / τ - u ⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z, @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z⟩| ≤ γ) →
    0 ≤ γ → γ < 1 / 2 → ‖x₀‖ < 1 / 4 → 0 < σ → σ ≤ 1 / 100 → 0 < s → γ < s * σ ^ 2 / 2 →
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ σ,
      |p1 * ζ.re + p2 * ζ.im + a * ζ.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * ζ.re * ζ.im + d * ζ.im ^ 2 + c| ≤ 2) →
    p1 * x₀.re + p2 * x₀.im + a * x₀.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * x₀.re * x₀.im + d * x₀.im ^ 2 + c = u x₀ →
    ((0 < a + d → τ ≤ T (|p1| + |p2| + |a| + 2 * |b| + |d| + 1) (a + d) →
        η ≤ T (|p1| + |p2| + |a| + 2 * |b| + |d| + 1) (a + d) →
        (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ σ, p1 * ζ.re + p2 * ζ.im + a * ζ.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * ζ.re * ζ.im +
          d * ζ.im ^ 2 + c + s * ‖ζ - x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ u ζ) → False) ∧
     (a + d < 0 → τ ≤ T (|p1| + |p2| + |a| + 2 * |b| + |d| + 1) (-(a + d)) →
        η ≤ T (|p1| + |p2| + |a| + 2 * |b| + |d| + 1) (-(a + d)) →
        (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ σ, u ζ + s * ‖ζ - x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ p1 * ζ.re + p2 * ζ.im +
          a * ζ.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * ζ.re * ζ.im + d * ζ.im ^ 2 + c) → False))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro T F ν e1 e2 τ η γ u x₀ p1 p2 a b d c σ s hν he1 he2 h12 h1ν h2ν hcomp hτ hτ1 hslab
    hlo hhi hTouch hfib hGC hγ0 hγ1 hx₀ hσ hσ1 hs hγs hbd hq0
  have hτ0 : τ ≠ 0 := hτ.ne'
  
  have h21 : inner ℝ e2 e1 = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact h12
  have hν1 : inner ℝ ν e1 = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact h1ν
  have hν2 : inner ℝ ν e2 = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact h2ν
  have h11 : inner ℝ e1 e1 = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, he1]; norm_num
  have h22 : inner ℝ e2 e2 = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, he2]; norm_num
  have hνν : inner ℝ ν ν = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hν]; norm_num
  have hcoord : ∀ x y t : ℝ, inner ℝ e1 (x • e1 + y • e2 + t • ν) = x ∧
      inner ℝ e2 (x • e1 + y • e2 + t • ν) = y ∧ inner ℝ ν (x • e1 + y • e2 + t • ν) = t := by
    intro x y t
    simp only [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, h11, h22, hνν, h12, h1ν, h2ν, h21, hν1,
      hν2]
    refine ⟨by ring, by ring, by ring⟩
  have hpy : ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ e1 z ^ 2 + inner ℝ e2 z ^ 2 + inner ℝ ν z ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    have h : inner ℝ z z =
        inner ℝ (inner ℝ e1 z • e1 + inner ℝ e2 z • e2 + inner ℝ ν z • ν) z :=
      congrArg (fun y => inner ℝ y z) (hcomp z)
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, h, inner_add_left, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left]
    ring
  have hcn : ∀ x y : ℝ, ‖(⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 := by
    intro x y; rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_mk]; ring
  have hcn' : ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 = ζ.re ^ 2 + ζ.im ^ 2 := by
    intro ζ; rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]; ring
  have hHc : Continuous (fun z : E3 => inner ℝ ν z) := by fun_prop
  have hZc : Continuous (fun z : E3 => (⟨inner ℝ e1 z, inner ℝ e2 z⟩ : ℂ)) := by
    have e : (fun z : E3 => (⟨inner ℝ e1 z, inner ℝ e2 z⟩ : ℂ)) =
        fun z => ((inner ℝ e1 z : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((inner ℝ e2 z : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
      funext z; apply Complex.ext <;> simp
    rw [e]; fun_prop
  
  have hτsq : τ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 10000 := by nlinarith
  have hsqlt : ∀ t r : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → 0 < r → t ^ 2 < r ^ 2 → t < r := by
    intro t r ht hr h; nlinarith
  have hcyl : ∀ x y : ℝ, (⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ) ∈ closedBall x₀ σ →
      ‖(⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 / 3 ∧ x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ (13 / 50) ^ 2 := by
    intro x y hxy
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hxy
    have h1 := norm_sub_norm_le (⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ) x₀
    have h2 : ‖(⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ)‖ ≤ 13 / 50 := by linarith
    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
    rw [← hcn]
    have := norm_nonneg (⟨x, y⟩ : ℂ)
    nlinarith
  have hball1 : ∀ z : E3, (⟨inner ℝ e1 z, inner ℝ e2 z⟩ : ℂ) ∈ closedBall x₀ σ →
      |inner ℝ ν z| < 3 * τ → z ∈ ball (0 : E3) 1 := by
    intro z hz hh
    have h1 := (hcyl _ _ hz).2
    have h2 := hpy z
    have h3 := sq_lt_sq' (abs_lt.mp hh).1 (abs_lt.mp hh).2
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    exact hsqlt _ _ (norm_nonneg z) one_pos (by nlinarith)
  have hball2 : ∀ z : E3, (⟨inner ℝ e1 z, inner ℝ e2 z⟩ : ℂ) ∈ closedBall x₀ σ →
      |inner ℝ ν z| ≤ τ → z ∈ ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2) := by
    intro z hz hh
    have h1 := (hcyl _ _ hz).2
    have h2 := hpy z
    have h3 := sq_le_sq' (abs_le.mp hh).1 (abs_le.mp hh).2
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    exact hsqlt _ _ (norm_nonneg z) (by norm_num) (by nlinarith)
  
  have hBc : IsClosed {z : E3 | ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0} := by
    rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ¬ ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0 := hz
    push_neg at hz'
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hNz⟩ := hz'
    filter_upwards [eventually_mem_nhds_iff.2 hN] with w hw
    intro hw'
    exact (hw' N hw).2 (hNz (hw' N hw).1)
  
  have hside : ∀ (Ω N : Set E3) (w : E3), IsOpen Ω → IsPreconnected Ω → w ∈ Ω → N ∈ 𝓝 w →
      (∀ y ∈ Ω, ¬ ∀ N' ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N' ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N' \ F) ≠ 0) →
      (volume (N \ F) = 0 → volume (Ω \ F) = 0) ∧ (volume (N ∩ F) = 0 → volume (Ω ∩ F) = 0) := by
    intro Ω N w hΩo hΩc hwΩ hN hnb
    have hFo : IsOpen {y : E3 | ∃ N' ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N' \ F) = 0} := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      rintro y ⟨N', hN', h0⟩
      filter_upwards [eventually_mem_nhds_iff.2 hN'] with y' hy'
      exact ⟨N', hy', h0⟩
    have hEo : IsOpen {y : E3 | ∃ N' ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N' ∩ F) = 0} := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      rintro y ⟨N', hN', h0⟩
      filter_upwards [eventually_mem_nhds_iff.2 hN'] with y' hy'
      exact ⟨N', hy', h0⟩
    have hdisj : Disjoint {y : E3 | ∃ N' ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N' \ F) = 0}
        {y : E3 | ∃ N' ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N' ∩ F) = 0} := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      rintro y ⟨N1, hN1, h1⟩ ⟨N2, hN2, h2⟩
      have hpos := Measure.measure_pos_of_mem_nhds volume (Filter.inter_mem hN1 hN2)
      have hle : volume (N1 ∩ N2) ≤ volume ((N1 \ F) ∪ (N2 ∩ F)) := by
        apply measure_mono

informal_problem.statement:
∃ Ch : ℝ, 0 ≤ Ch ∧ ∀ u : ℂ → ℝ,
    ContinuousOn u (Metric.closedBall 0 (1 / 3)) →
    (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (1 / 3), |u ζ| ≤ 1) → u 0 = 0 →
    (∀ x₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4), ∀ p1 p2 a b d c σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → 0 < a + d →
      (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball x₀ σ, p1 * ζ.re + p2 * ζ.im + a * ζ.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * ζ.re * ζ.im +
        d * ζ.im ^ 2 + c ≤ u ζ) →
      p1 * x₀.re + p2 * x₀.im + a * x₀.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * x₀.re * x₀.im + d * x₀.im ^ 2 + c = u x₀ →
      False) →
    (∀ x₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4), ∀ p1 p2 a b d c σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → a + d < 0 →
      (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball x₀ σ, u ζ ≤ p1 * ζ.re + p2 * ζ.im + a * ζ.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * ζ.re * ζ.im +
        d * ζ.im ^ 2 + c) →
      p1 * x₀.re + p2 * x₀.im + a * x₀.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * x₀.re * x₀.im + d * x₀.im ^ 2 + c = u x₀ →
      False) →
    ∃ p1 p2 : ℝ, |p1| ≤ Ch ∧ |p2| ≤ Ch ∧
      ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ 1 / 10 → |u ζ - p1 * ζ.re - p2 * ζ.im| ≤ Ch * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2

by
  
  have hs5 : ∀ (F : Polynomial ℂ) (r B : ℝ), 0 < r →
      (∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖F.coeff n‖ * r ^ n ≤ B) →
      ∀ ζ : ℂ, ‖ζ‖ ≤ r / 2 →
        |(Polynomial.eval ζ F).re - (F.coeff 0).re - (F.coeff 1 * ζ).re| ≤
          2 * B * ‖ζ‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2 := by
    intro F r B hr hB ζ hζ
    have hev : Polynomial.eval ζ F = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (F.natDegree + 2), F.coeff i * ζ ^ i :=
      Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' (by omega) ζ
    have hsplit : Polynomial.eval ζ F - F.coeff 0 - F.coeff 1 * ζ =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range F.natDegree, F.coeff (j + 2) * ζ ^ (j + 2) := by
      rw [hev, Finset.sum_range_succ', Finset.sum_range_succ']
      simp only [pow_zero, mul_one, zero_add, pow_one]
      ring
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (by positivity) (hB 1 le_rfl)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : ℝ, x = ‖ζ‖ / r := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by rw [hx]; positivity
    have hx1 : x ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [hx, div_le_iff₀ hr]; linarith
    have hz : ‖ζ‖ = x * r := by rw [hx]; field_simp
    have hterm : ∀ j : ℕ, ‖F.coeff (j + 2) * ζ ^ (j + 2)‖ ≤ B * x ^ 2 * (1 / 2) ^ j := by
      intro j
      rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, hz, mul_pow]
      have h1 := hB (j + 2) (by omega)
      have h2 : x ^ (j + 2) ≤ x ^ 2 * (1 / 2) ^ j := by
        rw [pow_add, mul_comm]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hx0 hx1 j) (by positivity)
      calc ‖F.coeff (j + 2)‖ * (x ^ (j + 2) * r ^ (j + 2))
          = (‖F.coeff (j + 2)‖ * r ^ (j + 2)) * x ^ (j + 2) := by ring
        _ ≤ B * x ^ (j + 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (by positivity)
        _ ≤ B * (x ^ 2 * (1 / 2) ^ j) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hB0
        _ = B * x ^ 2 * (1 / 2) ^ j := by ring
    have hre : (Polynomial.eval ζ F).re - (F.coeff 0).re - (F.coeff 1 * ζ).re =
        (Polynomial.eval ζ F - F.coeff 0 - F.coeff 1 * ζ).re := by
      simp only [Complex.sub_re]
    rw [hre, hsplit]
    calc |(∑ j ∈ Finset.range F.natDegree, F.coeff (j + 2) * ζ ^ (j + 2)).re|
        ≤ ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range F.natDegree, F.coeff (j + 2) * ζ ^ (j + 2)‖ :=
          Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range F.natDegree, ‖F.coeff (j + 2) * ζ ^ (j + 2)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range F.natDegree, B * x ^ 2 * (1 / 2) ^ j :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hterm j)
      _ = B * x ^ 2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range F.natDegree, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]

        p1 * x₀.re + p2 * x₀.im + a * x₀.re ^ 2 + 2 * b * x₀.re * x₀.im + d * x₀.im ^ 2 + c =

∀ (u : ℂ → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →

subgoal_signatures.name: fsvht_carath_coeff

∀ (F : Polynomial ℂ) (r M : ℝ), 0 < r →
    (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = r → |(Polynomial.eval z F).re| ≤ M) →
    ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖F.coeff n‖ * r ^ n ≤ 2 * M

        calc volume (N₁ ∩ N₂) ≤ volume ((N₁ ∩ N₂) ∩ F) + volume ((N₁ ∩ N₂) \ F) := by
              conv_lhs => rw [← Set.inter_union_diff (N₁ ∩ N₂) F]
              exact measure_union_le _ _
          _ ≤ volume (N₂ ∩ F) + volume (N₁ \ F) :=

                (measure_mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2⟩))
          _ = 0 := by rw [h₁, h₂, add_zero]
      have hpos : 0 < volume (interior (N₁ ∩ N₂)) :=
        isOpen_interior.measure_pos volume ⟨w, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hN''⟩
      have hle := measure_mono (μ := volume) (interior_subset (s := N₁ ∩ N₂))
      rw [hv] at hle
      exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_le hpos hle) (lt_irrefl 0)
    have hcover : Ω ⊆ {w : E3 | ∃ N' ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N' \ F) = 0} ∪
        {w : E3 | ∃ N' ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N' ∩ F) = 0} := by
      intro w hw
      have h := hnb w hw
      push_neg at h
      obtain ⟨N', hN', h'⟩ := h
      by_cases hc : volume (N' ∩ F) = 0
      · exact Or.inr ⟨N', hN', hc⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨N', hN', h' hc⟩
    rcases hΩc.subset_or_subset hFo hEo hdisj hcover with hsub | hsub
    · refine ⟨fun _ => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
      · apply measure_null_of_locally_null
        intro w hw
        obtain ⟨N', hN', h0⟩ := hsub hw.1
        exact ⟨(Ω \ F) ∩ N', inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hN',
          measure_mono_null (show (Ω \ F) ∩ N' ⊆ N' \ F from fun x hx => ⟨hx.2, hx.1.2⟩) h0⟩
      · exact absurd (⟨N, hN, h⟩ : z ∈ {w : E3 | ∃ N' ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N' ∩ F) = 0})
          (Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (hsub hzΩ))
    · refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun _ => ?_⟩
      · exact absurd (hsub hzΩ)
          (Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (⟨N, hN, h⟩ : z ∈ {w : E3 | ∃ N' ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N' \ F) = 0}))
      · apply measure_null_of_locally_null
        intro w hw
        obtain ⟨N', hN', h0⟩ := hsub hw.1
        exact ⟨(Ω ∩ F) ∩ N', inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hN',
          measure_mono_null (show (Ω ∩ F) ∩ N' ⊆ N' ∩ F from fun x hx => ⟨hx.2, hx.1.2⟩) h0⟩
  
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ : ∃ θ : ℝ, θ = 1 / (40 * (Ch + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hθ]
  have hC1 : 0 < Ch + 1 := by linarith
  have hθpos : 0 < θ := by rw [hθ]; positivity
  have hθmul : θ * (40 * (Ch + 1)) = 1 := by
    rw [hθ]; field_simp
  have hτ' : τ * (160 * (Ch + 1)) ≤ 1 := by
    rwa [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hτle
  have hγ' : γ * (160 * (Ch + 1)) ≤ 1 := by
    rwa [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hγle
  have hτθ : 4 * τ ≤ θ := by nlinarith
  have hγθ : 4 * γ ≤ θ := by nlinarith
  have hθ40 : θ ≤ 1 / 40 := by nlinarith
  have hChθ : Ch * θ ≤ 1 / 40 := by nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : E3, P = p1 • e1 + p2 • e2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : E3, n = ν - τ • P := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = ‖n‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hνe1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν e1 = 0 := (real_inner_comm e1 ν).trans he1ν
  have hνe2 : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν e2 = 0 := (real_inner_comm e2 ν).trans he2ν
  have hνP : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν P = 0 := by
    rw [hP, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, hνe1, hνe2]; ring
  have hPn : ‖P‖ ≤ |p1| + |p2| := by
    calc ‖P‖ ≤ ‖p1 • e1‖ + ‖p2 • e2‖ := by rw [hP]; exact norm_add_le _ _
      _ = |p1| + |p2| := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, he1, he2, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_one, mul_one]
  have hL2 : L ^ 2 = 1 + τ ^ 2 * ‖P‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hL, hn, norm_sub_sq_real, hν, real_inner_smul_right, hνP, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos hτ]
    ring
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := by rw [hL]; exact norm_nonneg _
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ L := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (τ * ‖P‖)]
  have hLpos : 0 < L := by linarith
  have hLle' : L ≤ 1 + τ * ‖P‖ := by
    have h := norm_sub_le ν (τ • P)
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hτ, hν] at h
    rw [hL, hn]; exact h
  have hLle : L ≤ 1 + τ * (|p1| + |p2|) := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hPn hτ.le]
  obtain ⟨ν', hν'⟩ : ∃ ν' : E3, ν' = L⁻¹ • n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hν'n : ‖ν'‖ = 1 := by
    rw [hν', norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hLpos), ← hL,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hLpos.ne']
  have hId : ∀ z : E3, L * @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z = @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z -
      τ * (p1 * @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z + p2 * @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z) := by
    intro z
    rw [hν', real_inner_smul_left, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hLpos.ne', one_mul, hn,
      inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, hP, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_left]
  have hdist : ‖ν' - ν‖ ≤ 4 * (Ch + 1) * τ := by
    have hdiff : ν' - ν = (L⁻¹ - 1) • n - τ • P := by
      rw [hν', hn, sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
    have hinv : L⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hL1
    have h1 : ‖(L⁻¹ - 1) • n‖ = L - 1 := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith), ← hL]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h2 : ‖τ • P‖ = τ * ‖P‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hτ]
    have h3 : ‖ν' - ν‖ ≤ L - 1 + τ * ‖P‖ := by
      rw [hdiff, ← h1, ← h2]; exact norm_sub_le _ _
    have h4 : τ * ‖P‖ ≤ τ * (2 * Ch) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hτ.le
    nlinarith
  
  have bessel : ∀ z : E3,
      ‖(⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z, @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z⟩ : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    have e11 : @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 e1 = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, he1]; norm_num
    have e22 : @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 e2 = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, he2]; norm_num
    have e21 : @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 e1 = 0 := (real_inner_comm e1 e2).trans he12
    have ze1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ z e1 = @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z := real_inner_comm e1 z
    have ze2 : @inner ℝ E3 _ z e2 = @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z := real_inner_comm e2 z
    have zz : @inner ℝ E3 _ z z = ‖z‖ ^ 2 := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq z
    have h := real_inner_self_nonneg (x := z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z • e1 - @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z • e2)
    simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
      e11, e22, he12, e21, ze1, ze2, zz] at h
    have hc : ‖(⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z, @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z⟩ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 =
        @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z * @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z + @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z * @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z := by
      rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_mk]
    have hsq : ‖(⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z, @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z⟩ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖z‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [hc]; nlinarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z, @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z⟩ : ℂ), norm_nonneg z]
  
  have hslab' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ,
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z| ≤ (τ / 2) * θ := by
    intro z hz hbd
    have hzθ : ‖z‖ < θ := mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hz
    have hζ := bessel z
    have hz1 : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 := mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (by linarith)
    have hcl := hclose z hz1 hbd (by linarith)
    have hq : |u ⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z, @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z⟩ - p1 * @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z -
        p2 * @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z| ≤
        Ch * ‖(⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z, @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z⟩ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 := hquad _ (by linarith)
    have hsq : ‖(⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z, @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z⟩ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ θ ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith) 2
    have hq2 : Ch * ‖(⟨@inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z, @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z⟩ : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ Ch * θ ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hCh
    have hq3 : Ch * θ * θ ≤ 1 / 40 * θ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hChθ hθpos.le
    have hX : τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z / τ) = @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z := by field_simp
    obtain ⟨hq_l, hq_r⟩ := abs_le.1 hq
    obtain ⟨hc_l, hc_r⟩ := abs_le.1 hcl
    have hD1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z / τ - (p1 * @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z + p2 * @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z)
        ≤ 11 * θ / 40 := by nlinarith
    have hD2 : -(11 * θ / 40) ≤
        @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z / τ - (p1 * @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z + p2 * @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z) := by
      nlinarith
    have hLv : L * @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z = τ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ ν z / τ -
        (p1 * @inner ℝ E3 _ e1 z + p2 * @inner ℝ E3 _ e2 z)) := by
      rw [hId z, mul_sub, hX]
    have hb1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD1 hτ.le
    have hb2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD2 hτ.le
    have h1 : |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z| ≤ L * |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z| :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_left (abs_nonneg _) hL1
    have h2 : L * |@inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z| = |L * @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z| := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hLpos]
    have h3 : |L * @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z| ≤ τ * (11 * θ / 40) := by
      rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    have h4 : 0 < τ * θ := mul_pos hτ hθpos
    linarith
  
  have hc : L * @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' ν = 1 := by
    rw [hId ν, he1ν, he2ν, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hν]; ring
  have hcpos : 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' ν := by nlinarith
  have hc23 : 2 / 3 ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' ν := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hLle hcpos.le]
  have hκ : (τ / 2) * θ < (θ / 2) * @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' ν := by
    have : τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' ν := by linarith
    nlinarith
  have hνν : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν ν = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hν]; norm_num
  have hcontν' : Continuous (fun z : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z) := by fun_prop
  have hcontν : Continuous (fun z : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z) := by fun_prop
  refine ⟨ν', hν'n, hdist, hslab', ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have hΩo : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z < -((τ / 2) * θ)}) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt hcontν' continuous_const)
    have hΩc : IsPreconnected
        (Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z < -((τ / 2) * θ)}) := by
      refine ((convex_ball (0 : E3) θ).inter ?_).isPreconnected
      intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right] at hx hy ⊢
      rcases ha.lt_or_eq with ha' | ha'
      · have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
        subst hb'
        nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx ha', mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.le hb]
      · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
        rw [← ha', hb1]; linarith
    have hz₀ : (-(θ / 2)) • ν ∈
        Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z < -((τ / 2) * θ)} := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by linarith), hν]
        linarith
      · show @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' ((-(θ / 2)) • ν) < -((τ / 2) * θ)
        rw [real_inner_smul_right]; linarith
    have hN : Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < -τ} ∈ 𝓝 ((-(θ / 2)) • ν) := by
      refine (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt hcontν continuous_const)).mem_nhds ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by linarith), hν]
        linarith
      · show @inner ℝ E3 _ ν ((-(θ / 2)) • ν) < -τ
        rw [real_inner_smul_right, hνν]; linarith
    refine (sides _ _ _ hΩo hΩc hz₀ hN ?_).1 hs1
    intro w hw hbd
    have := hslab' w hw.1 hbd
    have hw2 : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' w < -((τ / 2) * θ) := hw.2
    have := (abs_le.1 this).1
    linarith
  · 
    have hΩo : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ ∩ {z | (τ / 2) * θ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z}) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hcontν')
    have hΩc : IsPreconnected
        (Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ ∩ {z | (τ / 2) * θ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z}) := by
      refine ((convex_ball (0 : E3) θ).inter ?_).isPreconnected
      intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right] at hx hy ⊢
      rcases ha.lt_or_eq with ha' | ha'
      · have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
        subst hb'
        nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx ha', mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.le hb]
      · have hb1 : b = 1 := by linarith
        rw [← ha', hb1]; linarith
    have hz₁ : (θ / 2) • ν ∈
        Metric.ball (0 : E3) θ ∩ {z | (τ / 2) * θ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' z} := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith), hν]
        linarith
      · show (τ / 2) * θ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' ((θ / 2) • ν)
        rw [real_inner_smul_right]; linarith
    have hN : Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∈ 𝓝 ((θ / 2) • ν) := by
      refine (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hcontν)).mem_nhds ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith), hν]
        linarith
      · show τ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν ((θ / 2) • ν)
        rw [real_inner_smul_right, hνν]; linarith
    refine (sides _ _ _ hΩo hΩc hz₁ hN ?_).2 hs2
    intro w hw hbd
    have := hslab' w hw.1 hbd
    have hw2 : (τ / 2) * θ < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν' w := hw.2
    have := (abs_le.1 this).2
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(δ c : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hc : 0 < c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hN : hpHarnNorm δ c) :
    ∃ δH cH : ℝ, 0 < δH ∧ 0 < cH ∧ cH < 1 ∧
    ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (y ν : E3) (r a b : ℝ),
    IsOpen U → (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) U) →
    (∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) → (∀ z ∈ U, (G z).PosDef) →
    sepIsPerMin G F U → 0 < r → Metric.closedBall y r ⊆ U → ‖ν‖ = 1 → a ≤ b →
    b - a ≤ δH * r →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y r, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
       |G z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ δH ∧
       ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w i j) z‖ * r ^ 2 ≤ δH * (b - a)) →
    (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y r, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
       a ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ b) →
    volume ((Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < a}) \ F) = 0 →
    volume (Metric.ball y r ∩ {z | b < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z} ∩ F) = 0 →
    ∃ a' b' : ℝ, a ≤ a' ∧ a' ≤ b' ∧ b' ≤ b ∧ b' - a' ≤ (1 - cH) * (b - a) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y (r / 8),
        (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
        a' ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z ≤ b'

       |G z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ δH ∧
