proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨δ / 9, c, by positivity, hc, hc1, ?_⟩
  intro G F U y ν r a b hU hG hsymm hpd hmin hr hcb hν hab hba hmet hy hslab hbot htop
  
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : E3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E3, ∀ w : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (R w) = w 0 := by
    have he : ‖e 0‖ = ‖ν‖ := by rw [hν]; simp [e]
    refine ⟨(ℝ ∙ (e 0 - ν))ᗮ.reflection, fun w => ?_⟩
    have h1 : (ℝ ∙ (e 0 - ν))ᗮ.reflection (e 0) = ν := Submodule.reflection_sub he
    have h2 : @inner ℝ E3 _ ((ℝ ∙ (e 0 - ν))ᗮ.reflection (e 0))
        ((ℝ ∙ (e 0 - ν))ᗮ.reflection w) = @inner ℝ E3 _ (e 0) w :=
      LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_map _ _ _
    rw [h1] at h2
    rw [h2]
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3, ∀ v, L v = r • R v :=
    ⟨R.toContinuousLinearEquiv.trans
      (LinearEquiv.smulOfNeZero ℝ E3 r hr.ne').toContinuousLinearEquiv, fun v => rfl⟩
  have hfd : ∀ z : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun w : E3 => y + L w) z = (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) := by
    intro z; rw [fderiv_const_add]; exact L.fderiv
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ : ∃ c₀ : ℝ, c₀ = (r ^ 2)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc₀pos : 0 < c₀ := by rw [hc₀]; positivity
  have hc₀r : c₀ * r ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [hc₀]; field_simp
  obtain ⟨-, hG', hsymm', hpd', hmin'⟩ :=
    sepAffinePullback G F U hU hmin.1 hG hsymm hpd y L c₀ hc₀pos
  have hφc : Continuous (fun w : E3 => y + L w) := continuous_const.add L.continuous
  have hdist : ∀ w : E3, dist (y + L w) y = r * ‖w‖ := by
    intro w
    rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, hL, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr.le,
      LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
  have hball : ∀ (w : E3) (ρ : ℝ), w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) ρ ↔
      y + L w ∈ Metric.ball y (r * ρ) := by
    intro w ρ
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Metric.mem_ball, hdist, dist_zero_right]
    exact ⟨fun h => mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hr, fun h => lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h hr.le⟩
  obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀⟩ : ∃ h₀ : ℝ, h₀ = @inner ℝ E3 _ ν y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hH : ∀ w : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (y + L w) = h₀ + r * w 0 := by
    intro w; rw [inner_add_right, hL, real_inner_smul_right, hR, hh₀]
  
  have hnull : ∀ S : Set E3, volume ((fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' S) = 0 ↔ volume S = 0 := by
    intro S
    have h1 : (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' S = L ⁻¹' ((fun h => y + h) ⁻¹' S) := rfl
    rw [h1, MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_preimage_continuousLinearEquiv,
      MeasureTheory.measure_preimage_add]
    have hd : LinearMap.det ((L.symm : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) ≠ 0 :=
      (LinearEquiv.isUnit_det' L.symm.toLinearEquiv).ne_zero
    rw [mul_eq_zero]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exfalso
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero] at h
        have := abs_pos.2 hd
        linarith
      · exact h
    · intro h; exact Or.inr h
  have hbd : ∀ w : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N ∩ (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' F) ≠ 0 ∧
      volume (N \ (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' F) ≠ 0) ↔
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (y + L w), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) := by
    intro w
    constructor
    · intro h N hN
      have hN' : (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' N ∈ 𝓝 w := hφc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hN
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h _ hN'
      exact ⟨fun h0 => h1 ((hnull (N ∩ F)).2 h0), fun h0 => h2 ((hnull (N \ F)).2 h0)⟩
    · intro h N hN
      have hψc : Continuous (fun z : E3 => L.symm (z - y)) :=
        L.symm.continuous.comp (continuous_sub_right y)
      have hψ : (fun z : E3 => L.symm (z - y)) (y + L w) = w := by simp
      have hN' : (fun z : E3 => L.symm (z - y)) ⁻¹' N ∈ 𝓝 (y + L w) := by
        apply hψc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
        simpa using hN
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h _ hN'
      have e1 : (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' ((fun z : E3 => L.symm (z - y)) ⁻¹' N ∩ F) =
          N ∩ (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' F := by
        ext v; simp
      have e2 : (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' ((fun z : E3 => L.symm (z - y)) ⁻¹' N \ F) =
          N \ (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' F := by
        ext v; simp
      refine ⟨fun h0 => h1 ?_, fun h0 => h2 ?_⟩
      · rw [← hnull, e1]; exact h0
      · rw [← hnull, e2]; exact h0
  
  obtain ⟨ta, hra⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, r * t = a - h₀ := ⟨(a - h₀) / r, by field_simp⟩
  obtain ⟨tb, hrb⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, r * t = b - h₀ := ⟨(b - h₀) / r, by field_simp⟩
  have hab' : ta ≤ tb := le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) hr
  have hwidth : r * (tb - ta) = b - a := by linarith
  
  have hent : ∀ (v : E3) (a b : Fin 3), (c₀ • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y + L w) v) a b =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j * G (y + L v) i j := by
    intro v a b
    simp only [pullbackMetric, hfd, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    rw [hL (e a), hL (e b)]
    simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    linear_combination ((R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j * G (y + L v) i j) * hc₀r
  have hrho : ∀ i a : Fin 3, |(R (e a)) i| ≤ 1 := by
    intro i a
    have h := PiLp.norm_apply_le (R (e a)) i
    rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] at h
    simpa [e] using h
  have horth : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) i = if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro a b
    have h : @inner ℝ E3 _ (R (e a)) (R (e b)) = @inner ℝ E3 _ (e a) (e b) :=
      R.inner_map_map _ _
    rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, PiLp.inner_apply] at h
    simp only [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, map_one, one_mul] at h
    rw [← h]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp [mul_comm]
  have hdelta : ∀ a b : Fin 3, (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro a b
    rw [← horth]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    simp [mul_ite]
  have hLn : ‖(L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)‖ ≤ r := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hr.le (fun v => ?_)
    rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe, hL, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr.le,
      LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
  have hmet' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |(c₀ • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y + L w) z) i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ δ ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => (c₀ • pullbackMetric G (fun u => y + L u) w) i j) z‖ ≤
        δ * (tb - ta) := by
    intro w hw a b
    have hzB : y + L w ∈ Metric.ball y r := by
      have := (hball w 1).1 hw; rwa [mul_one] at this
    have hzU : y + L w ∈ U := hcb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzB)
    have hm := hmet (y + L w) hzB
    constructor
    · rw [hent, hdelta, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      calc |∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ j : Fin 3, (R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j * G (y + L w) i j -
              ∑ j : Fin 3, (R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0))|
          ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |∑ j : Fin 3, (R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j * G (y + L w) i j -
              ∑ j : Fin 3, (R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| :=
            Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, δ / 9 := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
            rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
            rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_mul]
            have h1 := hrho i a
            have h2 := hrho j b
            have h3 := (hm i j).1
            have h4 : 0 ≤ |G (y + L w) i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0| := abs_nonneg _
            have h5 : |(R (e a)) i| * |(R (e b)) j| ≤ 1 := by
              have := mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
              linarith
            calc |(R (e a)) i| * |(R (e b)) j| * |G (y + L w) i j - if i = j then 1 else 0|
                ≤ 1 * |G (y + L w) i j - if i = j then 1 else 0| :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h5 h4
              _ ≤ δ / 9 := by linarith
        _ = δ := by simp; ring
    · have hfun : (fun v => (c₀ • pullbackMetric G (fun u => y + L u) v) a b) =
          fun v => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j * G (y + L v) i j :=
        funext fun v => hent v a b
      have hd : ∀ i j : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun v => G (y + L v) i j)
          ((fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) (y + L w)).comp (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)) w := by
        intro i j
        have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z i j) (y + L w) :=
          ((hG i j).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hzU)
        exact hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp w ((L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).hasFDerivAt.const_add y)
      have hsum : HasFDerivAt
          (fun v => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j * G (y + L v) i j)
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ((R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j) •
            (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) (y + L w)).comp (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)) w := by
        apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum; intro i _
        apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum; intro j _
        exact (hd i j).const_mul _
      rw [hfun, hsum.fderiv]
      have hDb : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) (y + L w)‖ * r ≤
          δ / 9 * (tb - ta) := by
        intro i j
        have h2 := (hm i j).2
        rw [← hwidth] at h2
        refine le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ hr
        nlinarith
      calc ‖∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ((R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j) •
            (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) (y + L w)).comp (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)‖
          ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖∑ j : Fin 3, ((R (e a)) i * (R (e b)) j) •
            (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) (y + L w)).comp (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, δ / 9 * (tb - ta) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
            refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
            rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
            have h1 := hrho i a
            have h2 := hrho j b
            have h5 : |(R (e a)) i| * |(R (e b)) j| ≤ 1 := by
              have := mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
              linarith
            have h6 : ‖(fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) (y + L w)).comp (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)‖ ≤
                δ / 9 * (tb - ta) := by
              refine (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _).trans ?_
              refine le_trans ?_ (hDb i j)
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLn (norm_nonneg _)
            have h7 : 0 ≤ ‖(fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) (y + L w)).comp (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)‖ :=
              norm_nonneg _
            calc |(R (e a)) i| * |(R (e b)) j| *
                  ‖(fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) (y + L w)).comp (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)‖
                ≤ 1 * ‖(fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z i j) (y + L w)).comp (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)‖ :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h5 h7
              _ ≤ δ / 9 * (tb - ta) := by linarith
        _ = δ * (tb - ta) := by simp; ring
  
  have hŨ : IsOpen ((fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' U) := hU.preimage hφc
  have hcb' : Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) 1 ⊆ (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' U := by
    intro w hw
    apply hcb
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hdist]
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hw
    nlinarith
  have hba' : tb - ta ≤ δ := by
    have h1 : r * (tb - ta) ≤ r * δ := by
      rw [hwidth]; nlinarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h1 hr
  have hy' : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3), volume (N ∩ (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' F) ≠ 0 ∧
      volume (N \ (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' F) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hbd]
    simpa using hy
  have hslab' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' F) ≠ 0 ∧
        volume (N \ (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' F) ≠ 0) → ta ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ tb := by
    intro w hw hwb
    have hzB : y + L w ∈ Metric.ball y r := by
      have := (hball w 1).1 hw; rwa [mul_one] at this
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hslab (y + L w) hzB ((hbd w).1 hwb)
    rw [hH] at h1 h2
    exact ⟨le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) hr, le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) hr⟩
  have hbot' : volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | z 0 < ta}) \
      (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' F) = 0 := by
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ ((hnull _).2 hbot)
    rintro w ⟨⟨hw1, hw2⟩, hw3⟩
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hw3⟩
    · have := (hball w 1).1 hw1; rwa [mul_one] at this
    · show @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (y + L w) < a
      rw [hH]
      have h : w 0 < ta := hw2
      have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hr
      linarith
  have htop' : volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | tb < z 0} ∩
      (fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' F) = 0 := by
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ ((hnull _).2 htop)
    rintro w ⟨⟨hw1, hw2⟩, hw3⟩
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hw3⟩
    · have := (hball w 1).1 hw1; rwa [mul_one] at this
    · show b < @inner ℝ E3 _ ν (y + L w)
      rw [hH]
      have h : tb < w 0 := hw2
      have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hr
      linarith
  
  obtain ⟨ta', tb', h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ :=
    hN (fun z => c₀ • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y + L w) z) ((fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' F)
      ((fun w => y + L w) ⁻¹' U) ta tb hŨ hG' hsymm' hpd' (hmin' hmin) hcb' hab' hba' hmet'
      hy' hslab' hbot' htop'
  refine ⟨h₀ + r * ta', h₀ + r * tb', ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hr.le; linarith
  · have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hr.le; linarith
  · have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hr.le; linarith
  · have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hr.le
    have e1 : r * ((1 - c) * (tb - ta)) = (1 - c) * (b - a) := by rw [← hwidth]; ring
    nlinarith
  · intro z hz hzb
    have hinv : y + L (L.symm (z - y)) = z := by simp
    have hw : L.symm (z - y) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 8) := by
      rw [hball, hinv]
      have : r * (1 / 8) = r / 8 := by ring
      rw [this]; exact hz
    have hwb := (hbd (L.symm (z - y))).2 (by rw [hinv]; exact hzb)
    obtain ⟨k1, k2⟩ := h5 _ hw hwb
    have hz' : @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z = h₀ + r * (L.symm (z - y)) 0 := by
      rw [← hH, hinv]
    rw [hz']
    exact ⟨by have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k1 hr.le; linarith,
      by have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left k2 hr.le; linarith⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: sepAffinePullback
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hF : MeasurableSet F) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (y₀ : E3) (L : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∀ V : Set E3, V ⊆ U →
      sepPerG (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
          ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' V) =
        ENNReal.ofReal c * sepPerG G F V) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z => (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j)
      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U)) ∧
    (∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j =
      (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) j i) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ (fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U, (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z).PosDef) ∧
    (sepIsPerMin G F U → sepIsPerMin (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U))

informal_problem.statement:
(F : Set E3) (a b : ℝ) (ha : -(1 / 8) ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hb : b ≤ 1 / 8)
    (hslab : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → a ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ b)
    (hbot : volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | z 0 < a}) \ F) = 0)
    (htop : volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | b < z 0} ∩ F) = 0) :
    ∃ ℓ υ : E2 → ℝ,
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), a ≤ ℓ x ∧ ℓ x ≤ υ x ∧ υ x ≤ b) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2),
        (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (hpLift (ℓ x) x), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (hpLift (υ x) x), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2),
        (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
        ℓ (hpProj z) ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ υ (hpProj z)) ∧
      volume ({z | z ∈ hpCyl (1 / 2) (1 / 2) ∧ z 0 < ℓ (hpProj z)} \ F) = 0 ∧
      volume ({z | z ∈ hpCyl (1 / 2) (1 / 2) ∧ υ (hpProj z) < z 0} ∩ F) = 0 ∧
      LowerSemicontinuousOn ℓ (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2)) ∧
      UpperSemicontinuousOn υ (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2))

signature.name: hpHarn_envelopes
signature.statement:
(F : Set E3) (a b : ℝ) (ha : -(1 / 8) ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hb : b ≤ 1 / 8)
    (hslab : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → a ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ b)
    (hbot : volume ((Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | z 0 < a}) \ F) = 0)
    (htop : volume (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | b < z 0} ∩ F) = 0) :
    ∃ ℓ υ : E2 → ℝ,
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), a ≤ ℓ x ∧ ℓ x ≤ υ x ∧ υ x ≤ b) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2),
        (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (hpLift (ℓ x) x), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) ∧
        (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (hpLift (υ x) x), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0)) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (1 / 2),
        (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
        ℓ (hpProj z) ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ υ (hpProj z)) ∧
      volume ({z | z ∈ hpCyl (1 / 2) (1 / 2) ∧ z 0 < ℓ (hpProj z)} \ F) = 0 ∧
      volume ({z | z ∈ hpCyl (1 / 2) (1 / 2) ∧ υ (hpProj z) < z 0} ∩ F) = 0 ∧
      LowerSemicontinuousOn ℓ (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2)) ∧
      UpperSemicontinuousOn υ (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Bd, hBd⟩ : ∃ Bd : E3 → Prop, ∀ z, Bd z ↔
      ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0 := ⟨_, fun z => Iff.rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : Set E3, ∀ z, z ∈ A ↔ ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ F) = 0 :=
    ⟨{z | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ F) = 0}, fun z => Iff.rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : Set E3, ∀ z, z ∈ E ↔ ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) = 0 :=
    ⟨{z | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ F) = 0}, fun z => Iff.rfl⟩
  have hAo : IsOpen A := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨N, hN, h0⟩ := (hA z).1 hz
    obtain ⟨O, hON, hO, hzO⟩ := _root_.mem_nhds_iff.1 hN
    exact Filter.mem_of_superset (hO.mem_nhds hzO) (fun w hw =>
      (hA w).2 ⟨O, hO.mem_nhds hw, measure_mono_null (Set.diff_subset_diff_left hON) h0⟩)
  have hEo : IsOpen E := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨N, hN, h0⟩ := (hE z).1 hz
    obtain ⟨O, hON, hO, hzO⟩ := _root_.mem_nhds_iff.1 hN
    exact Filter.mem_of_superset (hO.mem_nhds hzO) (fun w hw =>
      (hE w).2 ⟨O, hO.mem_nhds hw, measure_mono_null (Set.inter_subset_inter_left F hON) h0⟩)
  have hdisj : ∀ z, z ∈ A → z ∈ E → False := by
    intro z hzA hzE
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁, h₁⟩ := (hA z).1 hzA
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂, h₂⟩ := (hE z).1 hzE
    have hN : N₁ ∩ N₂ ∈ 𝓝 z := Filter.inter_mem hN₁ hN₂
    have hpos : 0 < volume (N₁ ∩ N₂) :=
      MeasureTheory.Measure.measure_pos_of_mem_nhds volume hN
    have hle : volume (N₁ ∩ N₂) ≤ volume ((N₁ ∩ N₂) ∩ F) + volume ((N₁ ∩ N₂) \ F) :=
      measure_le_inter_add_diff _ _ _
    have e1 : volume ((N₁ ∩ N₂) ∩ F) = 0 :=
      measure_mono_null (fun w (hw : w ∈ (N₁ ∩ N₂) ∩ F) => (⟨hw.1.2, hw.2⟩ : w ∈ N₂ ∩ F)) h₂
    have e2 : volume ((N₁ ∩ N₂) \ F) = 0 :=
      measure_mono_null (fun w (hw : w ∈ (N₁ ∩ N₂) \ F) => (⟨hw.1.1, hw.2⟩ : w ∈ N₁ \ F)) h₁
    rw [e1, e2, add_zero] at hle
    exact absurd (le_antisymm hle (zero_le _)) hpos.ne'
  have hcover : ∀ z, ¬ Bd z → z ∈ A ∨ z ∈ E := by
    intro z hz
    by_cases hzA : z ∈ A
    · exact Or.inl hzA
    by_cases hzE : z ∈ E
    · exact Or.inr hzE
    exfalso
    apply hz
    rw [hBd]
    intro N hN
    exact ⟨fun h => hzE ((hE z).2 ⟨N, hN, h⟩), fun h => hzA ((hA z).2 ⟨N, hN, h⟩)⟩
  have hBdA : ∀ z, Bd z → z ∉ A := by
    intro z hz hzA
    obtain ⟨N, hN, h0⟩ := (hA z).1 hzA
    exact ((hBd z).1 hz N hN).2 h0
  have hBdE : ∀ z, Bd z → z ∉ E := by
    intro z hz hzE
    obtain ⟨N, hN, h0⟩ := (hE z).1 hzE
    exact ((hBd z).1 hz N hN).1 h0
  have hBdc : IsClosed {z | Bd z} := by
    have h : {z | Bd z}ᶜ = A ∪ E := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        exact hcover z hz
      · rintro (h | h) hz
        · exact hBdA z hz h
        · exact hBdE z hz h
    rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, h]
    exact hAo.union hEo
  
  have hl0 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), (hpLift t x) 0 = t := by
    intro t x
    simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hl1 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), (hpLift t x) 1 = x 0 := by
    intro t x
    simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hl2 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), (hpLift t x) 2 = x 1 := by
    intro t x
    simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hp0 : ∀ z : E3, (hpProj z) 0 = z 1 := by
    intro z
    simp [hpProj]
  have hp1 : ∀ z : E3, (hpProj z) 1 = z 2 := by
    intro z
    simp [hpProj]
  have hlp : ∀ z : E3, hpLift (z 0) (hpProj z) = z := by
    intro z
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hl0 _ _
    · show (hpLift (z 0) (hpProj z)) 1 = z 1
      rw [hl1, hp0]
    · show (hpLift (z 0) (hpProj z)) 2 = z 2
      rw [hl2, hp1]
  have hn3 : ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hn2 : ∀ x : E2, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hcont2 : Continuous (fun p : E2 × ℝ => hpLift p.2 p.1) := by
    unfold hpLift cylPt
    fun_prop
  have hcontx : ∀ x : E2, Continuous (fun t : ℝ => hpLift t x) := fun x =>
    hcont2.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hc0 : Continuous (fun w : E3 => w 0) := by fun_prop
  have hinball : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < 1 / 2 →
      hpLift t x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 := by
    intro x hx t ht
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hx ⊢
    have h1 := hn3 (hpLift t x)
    rw [hl0, hl1, hl2] at h1
    have h2 := hn2 x
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have ht2 : t ^ 2 < 1 / 4 := by
      have : t ^ 2 = |t| ^ 2 := (sq_abs t).symm
      rw [this]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg t]
    have hx2 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 < 1 / 4 := by nlinarith
    have hz0 : 0 ≤ ‖hpLift t x‖ := norm_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  have hseedA : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, w 0 < a → w ∈ A := by
    intro w hw hwa
    have hO : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | z 0 < a}) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt hc0 continuous_const)
    exact (hA w).2 ⟨_, hO.mem_nhds ⟨hw, hwa⟩, hbot⟩
  have hseedE : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, b < w 0 → w ∈ E := by
    intro w hw hwb
    have hO : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z | b < z 0}) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc0)
    exact (hE w).2 ⟨_, hO.mem_nhds ⟨hw, hwb⟩, htop⟩
  have hseg : ∀ (U V : Set E3), IsOpen U → IsOpen V → (∀ z, z ∈ U → z ∈ V → False) →
      (∀ z, ¬ Bd z → z ∈ U ∨ z ∈ V) → ∀ (x : E2) (I : Set ℝ), IsPreconnected I →
      (∀ t ∈ I, ¬ Bd (hpLift t x)) → ∀ t₀ ∈ I, hpLift t₀ x ∈ U →
      ∀ t ∈ I, hpLift t x ∈ U := by
    intro U V hU hV hUV hcov x I hI hnb t₀ ht₀ hU0 t ht
    have hP : IsPreconnected ((fun s => hpLift s x) '' I) :=
      hI.image _ (hcontx x).continuousOn
    have hsub : (fun s => hpLift s x) '' I ⊆ U ∪ V := by
      rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      exact hcov _ (hnb s hs)
    have hdj : Disjoint U V := Set.disjoint_left.2 (fun z h1 h2 => hUV z h1 h2)
    exact hP.subset_left_of_subset_union hU hV hdj hsub ⟨_, ⟨t₀, ht₀, rfl⟩, hU0⟩ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  have habs14 : |(-(1 / 4) : ℝ)| < 1 / 2 := by
    rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> norm_num
  have habs14' : |(1 / 4 : ℝ)| < 1 / 2 := by
    rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> norm_num
  
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : E2 → Set ℝ, ∀ x t, t ∈ S x ↔ (a ≤ t ∧ t ≤ b) ∧ Bd (hpLift t x) :=
    ⟨fun x => Set.Icc a b ∩ {t | Bd (hpLift t x)}, fun x t => Iff.rfl⟩
  have hScpt : ∀ x, IsCompact (S x) := by
    intro x
    have h : S x = Set.Icc a b ∩ (fun t => hpLift t x) ⁻¹' {z | Bd z} := by
      ext t
      rw [hS]
      rfl
    rw [h]
    exact isCompact_Icc.inter_right (hBdc.preimage (hcontx x))
  have hSne : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), (S x).Nonempty := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hne
    have hnb : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 / 4) : ℝ) (1 / 4), ¬ Bd (hpLift t x) := by
      intro t ht hbd
      have htb : |t| < 1 / 2 := abs_lt.2 ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
      have h := hslab _ (hinball x hx t htb) ((hBd _).1 hbd)
      rw [hl0] at h
      exact hne ⟨t, (hS x t).2 ⟨h, hbd⟩⟩
    have hlo : hpLift (-(1 / 4)) x ∈ A :=
      hseedA _ (hinball x hx _ habs14) (by rw [hl0]; linarith)
    have hhi : hpLift (1 / 4) x ∈ A :=
      hseg A E hAo hEo hdisj hcover x _ isPreconnected_Icc hnb _
        ⟨le_rfl, by norm_num⟩ hlo _ ⟨by norm_num, le_rfl⟩
    have hhiE : hpLift (1 / 4) x ∈ E :=
      hseedE _ (hinball x hx _ habs14') (by rw [hl0]; linarith)
    exact hdisj _ hhi hhiE
  refine ⟨fun x => sInf (S x), fun x => sSup (S x), ?_⟩
  have hℓmem : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), sInf (S x) ∈ S x :=
    fun x hx => (hScpt x).sInf_mem (hSne x hx)
  have hυmem : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), sSup (S x) ∈ S x :=
    fun x hx => (hScpt x).sSup_mem (hSne x hx)
  have hi : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2),
      a ≤ sInf (S x) ∧ sInf (S x) ≤ sSup (S x) ∧ sSup (S x) ≤ b := by
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨((hS x _).1 (hℓmem x hx)).1.1,
      csInf_le_csSup (hScpt x).bddBelow (hScpt x).bddAbove (hSne x hx),
      ((hS x _).1 (hυmem x hx)).1.2⟩
  have hgapL : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), ∀ t : ℝ, a ≤ t → t < sInf (S x) →
      ¬ Bd (hpLift t x) := by
    intro x hx t hat htl hbd
    have htS : t ∈ S x :=
      (hS x t).2 ⟨⟨hat, by linarith [(hi x hx).2.1, (hi x hx).2.2]⟩, hbd⟩
    exact absurd (csInf_le (hScpt x).bddBelow htS) (not_le.2 htl)
  have hgapU : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), ∀ t : ℝ, sSup (S x) < t → t ≤ b →
      ¬ Bd (hpLift t x) := by
    intro x hx t hut htb hbd
    have htS : t ∈ S x :=
      (hS x t).2 ⟨⟨by linarith [(hi x hx).1, (hi x hx).2.1], htb⟩, hbd⟩
    exact absurd (le_csSup (hScpt x).bddAbove htS) (not_le.2 hut)
  have hprojD : ∀ z ∈ hpCyl (1 / 2) (1 / 2), hpProj z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    have h := hn2 (hpProj z)
    rw [hp0, hp1] at h
    have h1 := hz.1
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖hpProj z‖ := norm_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨hi, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨(hBd _).1 ((hS x _).1 (hℓmem x hx)).2, (hBd _).1 ((hS x _).1 (hυmem x hx)).2⟩
  · intro z hz hzb
    have hz1 : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by norm_num) hz
    have h := hslab z hz1 hzb
    have hbd : Bd (hpLift (z 0) (hpProj z)) := by
      rw [hlp]
      exact (hBd z).2 hzb
    have hzS : z 0 ∈ S (hpProj z) := (hS _ _).2 ⟨h, hbd⟩
    exact ⟨csInf_le (hScpt _).bddBelow hzS, le_csSup (hScpt _).bddAbove hzS⟩
  · have hRA : ∀ z, z ∈ hpCyl (1 / 2) (1 / 2) → z 0 < sInf (S (hpProj z)) → z ∈ A := by
      intro z hzc hzl
      have hx := hprojD z hzc
      have hzabs : |z 0| < 1 / 2 := hzc.2
      have hI : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) (sInf (S (hpProj z))),
          ¬ Bd (hpLift t (hpProj z)) := by
        intro t ht hbd
        have htb : |t| < 1 / 2 :=
          abs_lt.2 ⟨ht.1, by linarith [ht.2, (hi _ hx).2.1, (hi _ hx).2.2]⟩
        have h := hslab _ (hinball _ hx t htb) ((hBd _).1 hbd)
        rw [hl0] at h
        exact hgapL _ hx t h.1 ht.2 hbd
      have hseed : hpLift (-(1 / 4)) (hpProj z) ∈ A :=
        hseedA _ (hinball _ hx _ habs14) (by rw [hl0]; linarith)
      have h := hseg A E hAo hEo hdisj hcover _ _ isPreconnected_Ioo hI (-(1 / 4))
        ⟨by norm_num, by linarith [(hi _ hx).1]⟩ hseed (z 0)
        ⟨by linarith [(abs_lt.1 hzabs).1], hzl⟩
      rwa [hlp] at h
    apply measure_null_of_locally_null
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨N, hN, h0⟩ := (hA z).1 (hRA z hz.1.1 hz.1.2)
    refine ⟨_, inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hN, ?_⟩
    exact measure_mono_null (fun w hw => (⟨hw.2, hw.1.2⟩ : w ∈ N \ F)) h0
  · have hRE : ∀ z, z ∈ hpCyl (1 / 2) (1 / 2) → sSup (S (hpProj z)) < z 0 → z ∈ E := by
      intro z hzc hzu
      have hx := hprojD z hzc
      have hzabs : |z 0| < 1 / 2 := hzc.2
      have hI : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (sSup (S (hpProj z))) (1 / 2),
          ¬ Bd (hpLift t (hpProj z)) := by
        intro t ht hbd
        have htb : |t| < 1 / 2 :=
          abs_lt.2 ⟨by linarith [ht.1, (hi _ hx).1, (hi _ hx).2.1], ht.2⟩
        have h := hslab _ (hinball _ hx t htb) ((hBd _).1 hbd)
        rw [hl0] at h
        exact hgapU _ hx t ht.1 h.2 hbd
      have hseed : hpLift (1 / 4) (hpProj z) ∈ E :=
        hseedE _ (hinball _ hx _ habs14') (by rw [hl0]; linarith)
      have h := hseg E A hEo hAo (fun w h1 h2 => hdisj w h2 h1)
        (fun w hw => (hcover w hw).symm) _ _ isPreconnected_Ioo hI (1 / 4)
        ⟨by linarith [(hi _ hx).2.2], by norm_num⟩ hseed (z 0)
        ⟨hzu, (abs_lt.1 hzabs).2⟩
      rwa [hlp] at h
    apply measure_null_of_locally_null
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨N, hN, h0⟩ := (hE z).1 (hRE z hz.1.1 hz.1.2)
    refine ⟨_, inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hN, ?_⟩
    exact measure_mono_null (fun w hw => (⟨hw.2, hw.1.2⟩ : w ∈ N ∩ F)) h0
  · intro x hx y hy
    by_cases hya : y < a
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x' hx'
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hya (hi x' hx').1
    · push_neg at hya
      have hloc : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a y,
          ∀ᶠ p : E2 × ℝ in 𝓝 (x, t), ¬ Bd (hpLift p.2 p.1) := by
        intro t ht
        have hnb : ¬ Bd (hpLift t x) := hgapL x hx t ht.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt ht.2 hy)
        exact (hBdc.isOpen_compl.preimage hcont2).mem_nhds hnb
      have htube := (isCompact_Icc (a := a) (b := y)).eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
        (P := fun x' t => ¬ Bd (hpLift t x')) hloc
      filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds htube, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x' h1 h2
      by_contra hle
      push_neg at hle
      exact h1 (sInf (S x')) ⟨(hi x' h2).1, hle⟩ ((hS x' _).1 (hℓmem x' h2)).2
  · intro x hx y hy
    by_cases hyb : b < y
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x' hx'
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hi x' hx').2.2 hyb
    · push_neg at hyb
      have hloc : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc y b,
          ∀ᶠ p : E2 × ℝ in 𝓝 (x, t), ¬ Bd (hpLift p.2 p.1) := by
        intro t ht
        have hnb : ¬ Bd (hpLift t x) := hgapU x hx t (lt_of_lt_of_le hy ht.1) ht.2
        exact (hBdc.isOpen_compl.preimage hcont2).mem_nhds hnb
      have htube := (isCompact_Icc (a := y) (b := b)).eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
        (P := fun x' t => ¬ Bd (hpLift t x')) hloc
      filter_upwards [nhdsWithin_le_nhds htube, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x' h1 h2
      by_contra hle
      push_neg at hle
      exact h1 (sSup (S x')) ⟨hle, (hi x' h2).2.2⟩ ((hS x' _).1 (hυmem x' h2)).2

informal_problem.statement:
(F : Set E3) (a b : ℝ) (ℓ υ : E2 → ℝ) (hF : MeasurableSet F)
    (ha : -(1 / 8) ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1 / 8)
    (h1 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), a ≤ ℓ x ∧ ℓ x ≤ υ x ∧ υ x ≤ b)
    (h2 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2),
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (hpLift (ℓ x) x), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (hpLift (υ x) x), volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0))
    (h4 : volume ({z | z ∈ hpCyl (1 / 2) (1 / 2) ∧ z 0 < ℓ (hpProj z)} \ F) = 0)
    (h5 : volume ({z | z ∈ hpCyl (1 / 2) (1 / 2) ∧ υ (hpProj z) < z 0} ∩ F) = 0)
    (h6 : LowerSemicontinuousOn ℓ (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2)))
    (h7 : UpperSemicontinuousOn υ (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2)))
    (c₀ : ℝ) (hc₀ : 0 < c₀)
    (hdens : ∀ p : E3, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → Metric.closedBall p s ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 p, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) →
      ENNReal.ofReal (c₀ * s ^ 3) ≤ volume (F ∩ Metric.ball p s) ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (c₀ * s ^ 3) ≤ volume (Metric.ball p s \ F)) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), ‖x‖ < 1 / 2 → hpSliceJumps F ℓ υ x

    (h1 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), a ≤ ℓ x ∧ ℓ x ≤ υ x ∧ υ x ≤ b)

(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (O : Set E3) (Y : E3 → E3)
    (hO : IsOpen O) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) O)

    ∀ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ∀ z : E3,

  have hLc : ∀ (L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (h : E2), L h = h 0 * L (e2 0) + h 1 * L (e2 1) := by
    intro L h
    conv_lhs => rw [hdec h]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

        h 1 * h 0 * B (e2 1) (e2 0) + h 1 * h 1 * B (e2 1) (e2 1) := by
    intro B h
    have k : B h = h 0 • B (e2 0) + h 1 • B (e2 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hdec h]

  have hderiv : ∀ (φ : E2 → ℝ) (x₀ : E2), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → ∀ k l : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ φ y (e2 l)) x₀ (e2 k) =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x₀ (e2 k) (e2 l) := by
    intro φ x₀ hφ k l
    have hD : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ φ) := hφ.fderiv_right (by simp)
    have hDd : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) := hD.differentiable (by simp)
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hDd x₀) (differentiableAt_const _)]
    simp
  
  have htaylor : ∀ (φ : E2 → ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (η : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → 0 < η →
      ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, φ x₀ + fderiv ℝ φ x₀ (x - x₀) +
        (1 / 2) * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x₀ (x - x₀) (x - x₀) - (η / 2) * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ φ x := by
    intro φ x₀ η hφ hη
    have hφd : Differentiable ℝ φ := hφ.differentiable (by simp)
    have hD : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ φ) := hφ.fderiv_right (by simp)
    have hDd : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) := hD.differentiable (by simp)
    have hlo := (hDd x₀).hasFDerivAt.isLittleO
    have h1 := hlo.def (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < η / 2)
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.1 h1
    rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
    refine ⟨r, hr, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    set D2 := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x₀ with hD2
    set h := x - x₀ with hh
    have hγ : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => φ (x₀ + s • h) - s * fderiv ℝ φ x₀ h -
        s ^ 2 / 2 * D2 h h + η / 2 * s ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2)
        (fderiv ℝ φ (x₀ + s • h) h - fderiv ℝ φ x₀ h - s * D2 h h + η * s * ‖h‖ ^ 2) s := by
      intro s
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x₀ + s • h) h s := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const h).const_add x₀
      have k1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => φ (x₀ + s • h)) (fderiv ℝ φ (x₀ + s • h) h) s :=
        (hφd _).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hl
      have k2 := (hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const (fderiv ℝ φ x₀ h)
      have k3 := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 s).div_const 2).mul_const (D2 h h)
      have k4 := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 s).const_mul (η / 2)).mul_const (‖h‖ ^ 2)
      convert ((k1.sub k2).sub k3).add k4 using 1
      simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
      ring
    have hmono : MonotoneOn (fun s : ℝ => φ (x₀ + s • h) - s * fderiv ℝ φ x₀ h -
        s ^ 2 / 2 * D2 h h + η / 2 * s ^ 2 * ‖h‖ ^ 2) (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
      apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 1)
      · exact HasDerivAt.continuousOn (fun s _ => hγ s)
      · exact fun s _ => (hγ s).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      · intro s hs
        rw [interior_Icc] at hs
        rw [(hγ s).deriv]
        obtain ⟨hs0, hs1⟩ := hs
        have hnh : ‖s • h‖ = s * ‖h‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hs0]
        have hxr : ‖h‖ < r := by rw [hh, ← dist_eq_norm]; exact hx
        have hdist : dist (x₀ + s • h) x₀ < r := by
          rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, hnh]
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg h]
        have hb := hball hdist
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left, hnh] at hb
        have hop := (fderiv ℝ φ (x₀ + s • h) - fderiv ℝ φ x₀ - D2 (s • h)).le_opNorm h

          simp [map_smul]
        rw [hval, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hop
        have hlow := neg_abs_le (fderiv ℝ φ (x₀ + s • h) h - fderiv ℝ φ x₀ h - s * D2 h h)
        have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb (norm_nonneg h)
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg h, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hη.le hs0.le) (sq_nonneg ‖h‖)]
    have key := hmono ⟨le_refl (0 : ℝ), zero_le_one⟩ ⟨zero_le_one, le_refl (1 : ℝ)⟩ zero_le_one
    have hx' : x₀ + h = x := by rw [hh]; abel
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, one_smul, one_mul, hx'] at key
    norm_num at key
    linarith
  
  have hexp : ∀ (ρ ε s g0 g1 h00 h01 h10 h11 η : ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (p y : E3),
      ρ ≠ 0 →
      M = !![0, 0, 0; 0, s * (ρ / 2) * (h00 - η), s * (ρ / 4) * (h01 + h10);
        0, s * (ρ / 4) * (h01 + h10), s * (ρ / 2) * (h11 - η)] →
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (e 0) (y - p) - ε * ρ * (@inner ℝ E3 _ (cylPt 0 (s * g0) (s * g1))
        (ρ⁻¹ • (y - p)) + ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - p)) i * (ρ⁻¹ • (y - p)) j + 0) =
      (y 0 - p 0) - s * ε * ((g0 * (y 1 - p 1) + g1 * (y 2 - p 2)) +
        (1 / 2) * (h00 * (y 1 - p 1) ^ 2 + (h01 + h10) * (y 1 - p 1) * (y 2 - p 2) +
          h11 * (y 2 - p 2) ^ 2) - (η / 2) * ((y 1 - p 1) ^ 2 + (y 2 - p 2) ^ 2)) := by
    intro ρ ε s g0 g1 h00 h01 h10 h11 η M p y hρ hM
    subst hM
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, cylPt, inner_add_left, inner_smul_left,
      EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hprops : ∀ (ρ s h00 h01 h10 h11 η B : ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), 0 < ρ → 0 ≤ η →
      |h00| ≤ B → |h01| ≤ B → |h10| ≤ B → |h11| ≤ B →
      M = !![0, 0, 0; 0, s * (ρ / 2) * (h00 - η), s * (ρ / 4) * (h01 + h10);
        0, s * (ρ / 4) * (h01 + h10), s * (ρ / 2) * (h11 - η)] →
      (∀ i j, M i j = M j i) ∧ (∀ i, ∑ j, M i j * (e 0) j = 0) ∧
      ∑ i, M i i = s * (ρ / 2) * (h00 + h11 - 2 * η) ∧
      (∀ i j, |M i j| ≤ |s| * (ρ / 2) * (B + η)) := by
    intro ρ s h00 h01 h10 h11 η B M hρ hη h1 h2 h3 h4 hM
    have hB : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans h1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j; rw [hM]; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp
    · intro i; rw [hM]; fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    · rw [hM]; simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    · have k1 : |s * (ρ / 2) * (h00 - η)| ≤ |s| * (ρ / 2) * (B + η) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < ρ / 2)]
        gcongr
        exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hη]; linarith)
      have k2 : |s * (ρ / 2) * (h11 - η)| ≤ |s| * (ρ / 2) * (B + η) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < ρ / 2)]
        gcongr
        exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hη]; linarith)
      have k3 : |s * (ρ / 4) * (h01 + h10)| ≤ |s| * (ρ / 2) * (B + η) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < ρ / 4)]
        have : |h01 + h10| ≤ 2 * B := (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
        have hs := abs_nonneg s
        calc |s| * (ρ / 4) * |h01 + h10| ≤ |s| * (ρ / 4) * (2 * B) := by gcongr
          _ ≤ |s| * (ρ / 2) * (B + η) := by
            have : |s| * (ρ / 4) * (2 * B) = |s| * (ρ / 2) * B := by ring
            rw [this]; gcongr; linarith
      have k0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ |s| * (ρ / 2) * (B + η) := by positivity
      have hent : ∀ i j, M i j = 0 ∨ M i j = s * (ρ / 2) * (h00 - η) ∨
          M i j = s * (ρ / 4) * (h01 + h10) ∨ M i j = s * (ρ / 2) * (h11 - η) := by
        intro i j; rw [hM]; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp
      intro i j
      rcases hent i j with h | h | h | h <;> rw [h]
      · rw [abs_zero]; exact k0
      · exact k1
      · exact k3
      · exact k2

      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z := by
    calc _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f z) *
          ∑ j : Fin 3, G z i j * (∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ j k * partialDeriv k f z) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f z) * partialDeriv i f z := by
          simp_rw [hrow]
      _ = _ := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by ring)
  have hgen : ∀ (c : ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G z i j * (c * v i) * (c * v j) =
        c ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G z i j * v i * v j := by
    intro c v
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
  have hs : Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z *
      partialDeriv b f z) ^ 2 =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z :=
    Real.sq_sqrt hN.le
  have hmain := hgen (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z *
      partialDeriv b f z))⁻¹ (fun i => ∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f z)
  simp only [] at hmain
  rw [hQ, inv_pow, hs, inv_mul_cancel₀ hN.ne'] at hmain
  unfold calUnitNormal
  exact hmain

signature.name: sepTouch_W1_norm
signature.statement:
(M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hpd : M.PosDef) (u w : E3)
    (p t s : ℝ)
    (hu : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * u i * u j ≤ 1)
    (hw : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * w i * w j ≤ 1)
    (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (hs : |s| ≤ 1) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * (p • ((1 - t) • u + (s * t) • w)) i *
      (p • ((1 - t) • u + (s * t) • w)) j ≤ 1

proof.tactics:
by
  have psd : ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * x i * x j := by
    intro x
    have h := hpd.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg x
    have e : dotProduct (star x) (M.mulVec x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * x i * x j := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
    rw [← e]; exact h
  have hv : ∀ i : Fin 3, (p • ((1 - t) • u + (s * t) • w)) i =
      (p * (1 - t)) * u i + (p * (s * t)) * w i := by
    intro i
    simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.add_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  simp only [hv]
  have h1 := psd (fun i => u i + w i)
  have h2 := psd (fun i => u i - w i)
  have hu0 := psd (fun i => u i)
  have hw0 := psd (fun i => w i)
  have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * (u i + w i) * (u j + w j) =
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * u i * u j) + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * w i * w j)
        + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * (u i * w j + w i * u j) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  have e2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * (u i - w i) * (u j - w j) =
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * u i * u j) + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * w i * w j)
        - ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * (u i * w j + w i * u j) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  have e3 : ∀ a b : ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * (a * u i + b * w i) * (a * u j + b * w j) =
      a ^ 2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * u i * u j)
        + a * b * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * (u i * w j + w i * u j))
        + b ^ 2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * w i * w j) := by
    intro a b
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  simp only at h1 h2 hu0 hw0
  rw [e1] at h1
  rw [e2] at h2
  rw [e3]
  generalize (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * u i * u j) = qu at *
  generalize (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * w i * w j) = qw at *
  generalize (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * (u i * w j + w i * u j)) = C at *
  generalize ha : p * (1 - t) = a
  generalize hb : p * (s * t) = b
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by rw [← ha]; exact mul_nonneg hp0 (by linarith)
  have hb' : |b| ≤ p * t := by
    rw [← hb, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hp0, abs_of_nonneg ht0]
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs ht0
    nlinarith
  have hab : a + |b| ≤ 1 := by
    have : a + p * t = p := by rw [← ha]; ring
    linarith
  have hCabs : |C| ≤ qu + qw := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hbC : b * C ≤ |b| * (qu + qw) :=
    calc b * C ≤ |b * C| := le_abs_self _
      _ = |b| * |C| := abs_mul _ _
      _ ≤ |b| * (qu + qw) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hCabs (abs_nonneg _)
  have habC : a * b * C ≤ a * |b| * (qu + qw) := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbC ha0
    calc a * b * C = a * (b * C) := by ring
      _ ≤ a * (|b| * (qu + qw)) := this
      _ = a * |b| * (qu + qw) := by ring
  have hbn : 0 ≤ |b| := abs_nonneg _
  have hc1 : (a ^ 2 + a * |b|) * qu ≤ a ^ 2 + a * |b| := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ a ^ 2 + a * |b|)
    linarith
  have hc2 : (b ^ 2 + a * |b|) * qw ≤ b ^ 2 + a * |b| := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ b ^ 2 + a * |b|)
    linarith
  have hsq : (a + |b|) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    have h0 : 0 ≤ a + |b| := by linarith
    nlinarith
  have hb2 : b ^ 2 = |b| ^ 2 := (sq_abs b).symm
  nlinarith

informal_problem.statement:
(T C A : Set E3) (h ψ sig : E3 → ℝ) (Y X : E3 → E3) (c η : ℝ)
    (hT : IsOpen T) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCT : C ⊆ T) (hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (hψC : ∀ z, z ∉ C → ψ z = 0) (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y)
    (hX : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X T) (hAo : IsOpen A) (hAsub : A ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ c < h z})
    (hBo : IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ c < h z} \ A))
    (hsig : ∀ z ∈ T, sig z = ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ c < h z} \ A).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z -
      A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
        (sig z * calTheta c η (h z)) • X z)) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun z => ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
        (sig z * calTheta c η (h z)) • X z)) ∧
      tsupport (fun z => ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
        (sig z * calTheta c η (h z)) • X z)) ⊆ C

signature.statement:
(T C A : Set E3) (h ψ sig : E3 → ℝ) (Y X : E3 → E3) (c η : ℝ)
    (hT : IsOpen T) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCT : C ⊆ T) (hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (hψC : ∀ z, z ∉ C → ψ z = 0) (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y)
    (hX : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X T) (hAo : IsOpen A) (hAsub : A ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ c < h z})
    (hBo : IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ c < h z} \ A))
    (hsig : ∀ z ∈ T, sig z = ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ c < h z} \ A).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z -
      A.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
        (sig z * calTheta c η (h z)) • X z)) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun z => ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
        (sig z * calTheta c η (h z)) • X z)) ∧
      tsupport (fun z => ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
        (sig z * calTheta c η (h z)) • X z)) ⊆ C

proof.tactics:
by
  have hΘs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (calTheta c η) := by
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((t - c) / η) - 1))
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
      ((contDiff_const.mul ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const η)).sub contDiff_const)
  have hΘ0 : ∀ t, t ≤ c + η / 2 → calTheta c η t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold calTheta
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    have h1 : (t - c) / η ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hη]; linarith
    linarith
  have hθ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => calTheta c η (h z)) := hΘs.comp hh
  have hW0 : ∀ z, z ∉ C → ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
      (sig z * calTheta c η (h z)) • X z) = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hψC z hz, zero_smul]
  have hsupp : Function.support (fun z => ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
      (sig z * calTheta c η (h z)) • X z)) ⊆ C :=
    Function.support_subset_iff'.mpr hW0
  have hCcl : IsClosed C := hC.isClosed
  have hts : tsupport (fun z => ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
      (sig z * calTheta c η (h z)) • X z)) ⊆ C :=
    closure_minimal hsupp hCcl
  have hsigA : ∀ z ∈ A, sig z = -1 := by
    intro z hz
    have hzT : z ∈ T := (hAsub hz).1
    rw [hsig z hzT, Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h' => h'.2 hz), Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
    norm_num
  have hsigB : ∀ z ∈ {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ c < h z} \ A, sig z = 1 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hsig z hz.1.1, Set.indicator_of_mem hz, Set.indicator_of_notMem hz.2]
    norm_num
  refine ⟨?_, HasCompactSupport.intro hC hW0, hts⟩
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro z₀
  by_cases hz₀C : z₀ ∈ C
  · rcases lt_or_ge (h z₀) (c + η / 2) with hlt | hge
    · 
      have hU : {z : E3 | h z < c + η / 2} ∈ 𝓝 z₀ :=
        (isOpen_lt hh.continuous continuous_const).mem_nhds hlt
      refine ((hψ.smul hY).contDiffAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hU] with z hz
      have hz' : h z < c + η / 2 := hz
      rw [hΘ0 _ hz'.le]
      simp
    · have hz₀T : z₀ ∈ T := hCT hz₀C
      have hXa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X z₀ := hX.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hz₀T)
      by_cases hz₀A : z₀ ∈ A
      · 
        have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
            (-calTheta c η (h z)) • X z)) z₀ :=
          hψ.contDiffAt.smul (((contDiffAt_const.sub hθ.contDiffAt).smul hY.contDiffAt).add
            (hθ.contDiffAt.neg.smul hXa))
        refine hg.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [hAo.mem_nhds hz₀A] with z hz
        rw [hsigA z hz, neg_one_mul]
      · 
        have hz₀B : z₀ ∈ {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ c < h z} \ A :=
          ⟨⟨hz₀T, by linarith⟩, hz₀A⟩
        have hg : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ z • ((1 - calTheta c η (h z)) • Y z +
            (calTheta c η (h z)) • X z)) z₀ :=
          hψ.contDiffAt.smul (((contDiffAt_const.sub hθ.contDiffAt).smul hY.contDiffAt).add
            (hθ.contDiffAt.smul hXa))
        refine hg.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        filter_upwards [hBo.mem_nhds hz₀B] with z hz
        rw [hsigB z hz, one_mul]
  · 
    refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : E3))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hCcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hz₀C] with z hz
    exact hW0 z hz

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (t t' : ℝ) (x x' : E2), (hpLift t x) 0 = t ∧ (hpLift t x) 1 = x 0 ∧
    (hpLift t x) 2 = x 1 ∧ hpProj (hpLift t x) = x ∧ ‖hpLift t x‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∧
    hpLift t x - hpLift t' x' = hpLift (t - t') (x - x') ∧ ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2

signature.name: hpLift_basic
signature.statement:
∀ (t t' : ℝ) (x x' : E2), (hpLift t x) 0 = t ∧ (hpLift t x) 1 = x 0 ∧
    (hpLift t x) 2 = x 1 ∧ hpProj (hpLift t x) = x ∧ ‖hpLift t x‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∧
    hpLift t x - hpLift t' x' = hpLift (t - t') (x - x') ∧ ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have hc : ∀ (s : ℝ) (y : E2), (hpLift s y) 0 = s ∧ (hpLift s y) 1 = y 0 ∧
      (hpLift s y) 2 = y 1 := by
    intro s y
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hn2 : ∀ y : E2, ‖y‖ ^ 2 = y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro y
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      sq_abs, sq_abs]
  intro t t' x x'
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := hc t x
  refine ⟨h0, h1, h2, ?_, ?_, ?_, hn2 x⟩
  · ext i
    fin_cases i
    · show (hpLift t x) 1 = x 0
      exact h1
    · show (hpLift t x) 2 = x 1
      exact h2
  · rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs, h0, h1, h2, hn2 x]
    ring
  · obtain ⟨k0, k1, k2⟩ := hc t' x'
    obtain ⟨d0, d1, d2⟩ := hc (t - t') (x - x')
    ext j
    fin_cases j
    · show (hpLift t x - hpLift t' x') 0 = hpLift (t - t') (x - x') 0
      rw [PiLp.sub_apply, h0, k0, d0]
    · show (hpLift t x - hpLift t' x') 1 = hpLift (t - t') (x - x') 1
      rw [PiLp.sub_apply, h1, k1, d1, PiLp.sub_apply]
    · show (hpLift t x - hpLift t' x') 2 = hpLift (t - t') (x - x') 2
      rw [PiLp.sub_apply, h2, k2, d2, PiLp.sub_apply]

signature.statement:
(∀ S : Set E3, MeasurableSet S →
    Measurable (fun x : E2 => volume {t : ℝ | hpLift t x ∈ S}) ∧
    volume S = ∫⁻ x : E2, volume {t : ℝ | hpLift t x ∈ S}) ∧
    (∀ S : Set E3, volume S = 0 →
      ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), volume {t : ℝ | hpLift t x ∈ S} = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcoord : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2),
      hpLift t x = (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x) : Fin 3 → ℝ) : E3) := by
    intro t x
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> rfl
  have hΘ : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (fun p : E2 × ℝ => hpLift p.2 p.1)
      (volume.prod volume) volume := by
    have h1 := (PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp (Fin 2)).prod
      (MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure ℝ))
    have h2 := MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_swap
      (μ := (volume : Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))
    have h3 := MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.symm
      (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0)
      (volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0)
    have h4 := PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 3)
    have H := h4.comp (h3.comp (h2.comp h1))
    have hfun : (fun p : E2 × ℝ => hpLift p.2 p.1) =
        (WithLp.toLp 2 ∘ (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0).symm ∘
          Prod.swap ∘ Prod.map WithLp.ofLp id) := by
      funext p
      rw [hcoord]
      simp [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNthEquiv_apply,
        Fin.insertNth_zero'] <;> rfl
    rw [hfun]
    exact H
  refine ⟨fun S hS => ?_, fun S hS0 => ?_⟩
  · have hP : MeasurableSet ((fun p : E2 × ℝ => hpLift p.2 p.1) ⁻¹' S) := hΘ.measurable hS
    refine ⟨measurable_measure_prodMk_left hP, ?_⟩
    rw [← hΘ.measure_preimage hS.nullMeasurableSet, MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_apply hP]
    rfl
  · have hT := MeasureTheory.measurableSet_toMeasurable (volume : Measure E3) S
    have hT0 : (volume.prod volume) ((fun p : E2 × ℝ => hpLift p.2 p.1) ⁻¹'
        MeasureTheory.toMeasurable (volume : Measure E3) S) = 0 := by
      rw [hΘ.measure_preimage hT.nullMeasurableSet, MeasureTheory.measure_toMeasurable]
      exact hS0
    have hS0' : (volume.prod volume) ((fun p : E2 × ℝ => hpLift p.2 p.1) ⁻¹' S) = 0 :=
      MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null
        (Set.preimage_mono (MeasureTheory.subset_toMeasurable _ _)) hT0
    have hae := MeasureTheory.Measure.measure_ae_null_of_prod_null hS0'
    filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
    exact hx

signature.statement:
∀ (A : Set E3) (h : E2 → ℝ) (T : Set E2) (c₀ : ℝ),
    MeasurableSet A → 0 < c₀ →
    (∀ S : Set E3, MeasurableSet S →

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hcb : hpCyl (1 / 4) (1 / 4) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [hpCyl, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    rw [Real.sqrt_lt' one_pos]
    have h3 := abs_lt.mp h2
    nlinarith
  have hin : ∀ z, Ψ z ≠ 0 → z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 :=
    fun z hz => hcb (hΨs (subset_tsupport _ hz))
  
  have tri : ∀ x y w p q r : ℝ, |x| ≤ p → |y| ≤ q → |w| ≤ r → |x * y * w| ≤ p * q * r := by
    intro x y w p q r hx hy hw
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    have hp : 0 ≤ p := (abs_nonneg _).trans hx
    have hq : 0 ≤ q := (abs_nonneg _).trans hy
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) hp) hw (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hp hq)
  have hdet : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, 9 / 10 ≤ (G z).det ∧ G z 0 0 ≤ 101 / 100 := by
    intro z hz
    have h := hclose z hz
    have d : ∀ i : Fin 3, 99 / 100 ≤ G z i i ∧ G z i i ≤ 101 / 100 := by
      intro i
      have hi := h i i
      rw [if_pos rfl] at hi
      have := abs_le.mp hi
      constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]
    have dA : ∀ i : Fin 3, |G z i i| ≤ 101 / 100 := by
      intro i
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith [(d i).1, (d i).2]
    have o : ∀ i j : Fin 3, i ≠ j → |G z i j| ≤ 1 / 100 := by
      intro i j hij
      have hij' := h i j
      rwa [if_neg hij, sub_zero] at hij'
    refine ⟨?_, (d 0).2⟩
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    have p0 : (99 / 100) * (99 / 100) * (99 / 100) ≤ G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 :=
      mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (d 0).1 (d 1).1 (by norm_num) (by linarith [(d 0).1]))
        (d 2).1 (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg (by linarith [(d 0).1]) (by linarith [(d 1).1]))
    have p1 := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (dA 0) (o 1 2 (by decide)) (o 2 1 (by decide)))
    have p2 := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (o 0 1 (by decide)) (o 1 0 (by decide)) (dA 2))
    have p3 := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (o 0 1 (by decide)) (o 1 2 (by decide))
      (o 2 0 (by decide)))
    have p4 := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (o 0 2 (by decide)) (o 1 0 (by decide))
      (o 2 1 (by decide)))
    have p5 := abs_le.mp (tri _ _ _ _ _ _ (o 0 2 (by decide)) (dA 1) (o 2 0 (by decide)))
    linarith [p1.1, p1.2, p2.1, p2.2, p3.1, p3.2, p4.1, p4.2, p5.1, p5.2]
  
  obtain ⟨k, hkdef⟩ : ∃ k : E3 → ℝ, k = fun z => 9 / 10 * (Real.sqrt (G z).det)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1) := by
    have hfun : (fun z => (G z).det) = fun z =>
        G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
        - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
        + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0 :=
      funext fun z => Matrix.det_fin_three (G z)
    rw [hfun]
    exact ((((((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 2)).sub (((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 1))).sub

    refine (hD.sqrt fun z hz => ne_of_gt (by linarith [(hdet z hz).1])).inv ?_

  have hXc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X := by
    rw [hXdef]
    exact hΨk.smul contDiff_const
  have hXt : tsupport X ⊆ tsupport Ψ := by
    rw [hXdef]
    exact (tsupport_smul_subset_left _ _).trans (tsupport_mul_subset_left)
  have hXcs : HasCompactSupport X := hΨc.mono' ((subset_tsupport X).trans hXt)
  have hXs : tsupport X ⊆ hpCyl (1 / 4) (1 / 4) := hXt.trans hΨs
  have hXi : ∀ z (i : Fin 3), X z i = Ψ z * k z * (if i = 0 then 1 else 0) := by
    intro z i
    rw [hXdef]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  have hXb : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    simp only [hXi, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide, show (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide, if_true,
      if_false, mul_zero, mul_one, add_zero]
    by_cases hy : Ψ y = 0

        rw [show 9 / 10 * (Real.sqrt (G y).det)⁻¹ * (9 / 10 * (Real.sqrt (G y).det)⁻¹) =

        rw [e1]
        have h81 : (81 / 100) / (G y).det ≤ 9 / 10 := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ hdpos]; linarith
        have h0 : 0 ≤ (81 / 100) / (G y).det := by positivity
        calc Ψ y * Ψ y * ((81 / 100) / (G y).det) ≤ 1 * (9 / 10) :=
              mul_le_mul hΨ2 h81 h0 zero_le_one
          _ = 9 / 10 := by ring
      have hq0 : 0 ≤ Ψ y * k y * (Ψ y * k y) := mul_self_nonneg _
      have : G y 0 0 * (Ψ y * k y) * (Ψ y * k y) = G y 0 0 * (Ψ y * k y * (Ψ y * k y)) := by

      rw [this]
      nlinarith
  
  have hfun : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =
      fun z => (if i = 0 then (9 / 10 : ℝ) else 0) * Ψ z := by

    by_cases hz : Ψ z = 0
    · rw [hz]; simp
    · have hdpos : 0 < (G z).det := by linarith [(hdet z (hin z hz)).1]
      have hs0 : Real.sqrt (G z).det ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hdpos)
      rw [hkdef]
      split_ifs
      · field_simp
      · simp
  have hΨd : Differentiable ℝ Ψ := hΨ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hdiv : ∀ y, sepDensDiv G X y = 9 / 10 * partialDeriv 0 Ψ y := by
    intro y
    have hpi : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y =
        (if i = 0 then (9 / 10 : ℝ) else 0) * partialDeriv i Ψ y := by
      intro i
      rw [hfun i]
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [fderiv_const_mul (hΨd y)]
      rfl
    unfold sepDensDiv
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, hpi 0, hpi 1, hpi 2]
    simp
  have hint : (∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G X y) = 9 / 10 * ∫ y in F, partialDeriv 0 Ψ y := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext y
    exact hdiv y
  unfold sepPerG
  refine le_iSup₂_of_le X ⟨hXc, hXcs, hXs, hXb⟩ ?_
  rw [hint]

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hp0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hp1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z 1) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hp2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z 2) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hprojE : hpProj = fun z : E3 => (z 1) • e2 0 + (z 2) • e2 1 := by
    funext z
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hprojC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ hpProj := by
    rw [hprojE]
    exact (hp1.smul contDiff_const).add (hp2.smul contDiff_const)
  have hpn : ∀ z : E3, ‖hpProj z‖ ^ 2 = z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two, hprojE]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hzn : ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  
  have hψcs : ∀ k, HasCompactSupport (ψ k) := by
    intro k
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_Icc (a := -(6 / 25 : ℝ)) (b := 6 / 25)) ?_
    intro t ht
    apply hψ0 k t
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp h
    exact ht ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩
  have hdψ : ∀ k, MeasureTheory.Integrable (deriv (ψ k)) := by
    intro k
    exact ((hψ k).continuous_deriv (by simp)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hψcs k).deriv
  
  have hΨfun : Ψ = fun z => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, c k (hpProj z) * ψ k (z 0) := funext hΨ
  have hΨs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψ := by
    rw [hΨfun]
    apply ContDiff.sum
    intro k _
    exact ((hc k).comp hprojC).mul ((hψ k).comp hp0)
  
  have hΨ1 : ∀ z, |Ψ z| ≤ 1 := by
    intro z
    rw [hΨ z]
    calc |∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, c k (hpProj z) * ψ k (z 0)|
        ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, |c k (hpProj z) * ψ k (z 0)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, c k (hpProj z) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro k _
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hc0 k _)]
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (hc0 k _) (hψ1 k _)
      _ ≤ 1 := hc1 _
  
  set Q : Set E3 := {z | hpProj z ∈ ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range K, tsupport (c k)} ∩
    {z | |z 0| ≤ 6 / 25} with hQ
  have hsuppQ : Function.support Ψ ⊆ Q := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Function.mem_support, hΨ z] at hz
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hz
    have h1 : c k (hpProj z) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne
    have h2 : ψ k (z 0) ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hne
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]
      exact ⟨k, hk, subset_tsupport _ h1⟩
    · show |z 0| ≤ 6 / 25
      by_contra h
      exact h2 (hψ0 k _ (le_of_lt (not_le.mp h)))
  have hQc : IsClosed Q := by
    apply IsClosed.inter
    · exact (isClosed_biUnion_finset (fun k _ => isClosed_tsupport (c k))).preimage
        hprojC.continuous
    · exact isClosed_le (continuous_abs.comp hp0.continuous) continuous_const
  have htsQ : tsupport Ψ ⊆ Q := closure_minimal hsuppQ hQc
  have hQcyl : Q ⊆ hpCyl (1 / 4) (1 / 4) := by
    rintro z ⟨h1, h2⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion] at h1 h2
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hz⟩ := h1
    have hb := hcs k hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hb
    show z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 < (1 / 4) ^ 2 ∧ |z 0| < 1 / 4
    refine ⟨?_, by linarith⟩
    rw [← hpn z]
    have := norm_nonneg (hpProj z)
    nlinarith
  have hQb : Bornology.IsBounded Q := by
    refine (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := (0 : E3)) (r := 1)).subset ?_
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hQcyl hz
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
    have hn := hzn z
    have h3 : z 0 ^ 2 < 1 / 16 := by
      have := sq_abs (z 0)
      have := abs_nonneg (z 0)
      nlinarith
    have := norm_nonneg z
    nlinarith
  have hΨc : HasCompactSupport Ψ :=
    IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset (Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hQc hQb)
      (isClosed_tsupport _) htsQ
  
  have hderiv : ∀ z, partialDeriv 0 Ψ z =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, c k (hpProj z) * deriv (ψ k) (z 0) := by
    intro z
    have hD : HasFDerivAt Ψ (fderiv ℝ Ψ z) z := (hΨs.differentiable (by simp) z).hasFDerivAt
    have hD' : HasFDerivAt Ψ (fderiv ℝ Ψ z) (z + (0 : ℝ) • e 0) := by simpa using hD
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z + s • e 0) (e 0) 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const (e 0)).const_add z
    have h1 := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (f := fun s : ℝ => z + s • e 0) (0 : ℝ) hD' hγ
    have a1 : ∀ s : ℝ, (z + s • e 0) 1 = z 1 := by
      intro s; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have a2 : ∀ s : ℝ, (z + s • e 0) 2 = z 2 := by
      intro s; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hpe : ∀ s : ℝ, hpProj (z + s • e 0) = hpProj z := by
      intro s
      show (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![(z + s • e 0) 1, (z + s • e 0) 2] =
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![z 1, z 2]
      rw [a1, a2]
    have h0e : ∀ s : ℝ, (z + s • e 0) 0 = z 0 + s := by
      intro s; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hcomp : (Ψ ∘ fun s : ℝ => z + s • e 0) =
        fun s => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, c k (hpProj z) * ψ k (z 0 + s) := by
      funext s
      simp only [Function.comp, hΨ, hpe, h0e]
    rw [hcomp] at h1
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, c k (hpProj z) * ψ k (z 0 + s))
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, c k (hpProj z) * deriv (ψ k) (z 0)) 0 := by
      apply HasDerivAt.fun_sum
      intro k _
      apply HasDerivAt.const_mul
      have hd : HasDerivAt (ψ k) (deriv (ψ k) (z 0 + 0)) (z 0 + 0) :=
        ((hψ k).differentiable (by simp) _).hasDerivAt
      have := hd.comp_const_add (z 0) 0
      simpa using this
    exact h1.unique h3
  
  have hpdfun : partialDeriv 0 Ψ = fun z => fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e 0) := rfl
  have hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (partialDeriv 0 Ψ) := by
    rw [hpdfun]
    exact ((hΨs.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.fderiv_apply ℝ hΨc (e 0))
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2),
      hpLift t x = (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x) : Fin 3 → ℝ) : E3) := by
    intro t x
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> rfl
  have hΘ : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (fun p : E2 × ℝ => hpLift p.2 p.1)
      (volume.prod volume) volume := by
    have h1 := (PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp (Fin 2)).prod
      (MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure ℝ))
    have h2 := MeasureTheory.Measure.measurePreserving_swap
      (μ := (volume : Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))
    have h3 := MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.symm
      (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0)
      (volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0)
    have h4 := PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 3)
    have H := h4.comp (h3.comp (h2.comp h1))
    have hfun : (fun p : E2 × ℝ => hpLift p.2 p.1) =
        (WithLp.toLp 2 ∘ (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0).symm ∘
          Prod.swap ∘ Prod.map WithLp.ofLp id) := by
      funext p
      rw [hcoord]
      simp [MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNthEquiv_apply,
        Fin.insertNth_zero'] <;> rfl
    rw [hfun]
    exact H
  have hgint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (F.indicator (partialDeriv 0 Ψ)) := hint.indicator hF
  have hfub : ∫ z, F.indicator (partialDeriv 0 Ψ) z =
      ∫ x : E2, ∫ t : ℝ, F.indicator (partialDeriv 0 Ψ) (hpLift t x) := by
    have hmap := MeasureTheory.integral_map (μ := (volume : Measure E2).prod (volume : Measure ℝ))
      hΘ.measurable.aemeasurable (f := F.indicator (partialDeriv 0 Ψ))
      (by rw [hΘ.map_eq]; exact hgint.aestronglyMeasurable)
    rw [hΘ.map_eq] at hmap
    rw [hmap]
    have hint2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun p : E2 × ℝ => F.indicator (partialDeriv 0 Ψ) (hpLift p.2 p.1))
        ((volume : Measure E2).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) :=
      hΘ.integrable_comp_of_integrable hgint
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_prod _ hint2
  
  refine ⟨hΨs, hΨc, htsQ.trans hQcyl, hΨ1, ?_⟩
  rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hF, hfub]
  congr 1
  funext x
  have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => hpLift t x) := by
    unfold hpLift cylPt
    fun_prop
  have hS : MeasurableSet {t : ℝ | hpLift t x ∈ F} := hF.preimage hcont.measurable
  have hpt : ∀ t, F.indicator (partialDeriv 0 Ψ) (hpLift t x) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, c k x *
        ({t | hpLift t x ∈ F}.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * deriv (ψ k) t) := by
    intro t
    have b0 : (hpLift t x) 0 = t := by
      simp [hpLift, cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have bp : hpProj (hpLift t x) = x := by
      rw [hprojE]
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [hpLift, cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    by_cases ht : hpLift t x ∈ F
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht, hderiv, bp, b0]
      have : t ∈ {t | hpLift t x ∈ F} := ht
      simp [Set.indicator_of_mem this]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht]
      have : t ∉ {t | hpLift t x ∈ F} := ht
      simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem this]
  simp_rw [hpt]
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    rfl
  · intro k _
    apply MeasureTheory.Integrable.const_mul
    have : (fun t => {t | hpLift t x ∈ F}.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * deriv (ψ k) t) =
        {t | hpLift t x ∈ F}.indicator (deriv (ψ k)) := by
      funext t
      by_cases ht : t ∈ {t | hpLift t x ∈ F} <;> simp [ht]
    rw [this]
    exact (hdψ k).indicator hS

proof.tactics:
by
  have hUp : ∀ α β : ℝ, α < β →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => hpUp α β t) ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ hpUp α β t ∧ hpUp α β t ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ t, t ≤ α → hpUp α β t = 0) ∧ (∀ t, β ≤ t → hpUp α β t = 1) := by
    intro α β hαβ
    have hpos : 0 < β - α := sub_pos.mpr hαβ
    refine ⟨?_, fun t => ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩,
      fun t ht => ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    · have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => (t - α) / (β - α)) :=
        (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const _
      exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp h1
    · unfold hpUp
      apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
      exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hpos.le
    · unfold hpUp
      apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
      rw [one_le_div hpos]
      linarith
  obtain ⟨hAs, hAb, hA0, hA1⟩ := hUp (-(6 / 25)) (-(3 / 16)) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨hBs, hBb, hB0, hB1⟩ := hUp (3 / 16) (6 / 25) (by norm_num)
  have hP0s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ hpProf0 := by
    have : hpProf0 = fun t => hpUp (-(6 / 25)) (-(3 / 16)) t - hpUp (3 / 16) (6 / 25) t := by
      funext t; rfl
    rw [this]
    exact hAs.sub hBs
  have hP0b : ∀ t, 0 ≤ hpProf0 t ∧ hpProf0 t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t
    unfold hpProf0
    rcases le_total t (3 / 16) with ht | ht
    · rw [hB0 t ht]
      have := hAb t
      constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]
    · rw [hA1 t (by linarith)]
      have := hBb t
      constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]
  have hP0mid : ∀ t, -(3 / 16) ≤ t → t ≤ 3 / 16 → hpProf0 t = 1 := by
    intro t h1 h2
    unfold hpProf0
    rw [hA1 t h1, hB0 t h2]
    norm_num
  have hP0z : ∀ t, 6 / 25 ≤ |t| → hpProf0 t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    unfold hpProf0
    rcases le_abs'.mp ht with h | h
    · rw [hA0 t h, hB0 t (by linarith)]
      norm_num
    · rw [hA1 t (by linarith), hB1 t h]
      norm_num
  refine ⟨⟨hP0s, fun t => abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [(hP0b t).1], (hP0b t).2⟩, hP0z⟩, ?_⟩
  intro α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄ h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  obtain ⟨hUs, hUb, hU0, hU1⟩ := hUp α₁ α₂ h2
  obtain ⟨hVs, hVb, hV0, hV1⟩ := hUp α₃ α₄ h4
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : hpProf α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄ = fun t => hpProf0 t - 2 * hpUp α₁ α₂ t + 2 * hpUp α₃ α₄ t := by
      funext t; rfl
    rw [this]
    exact (hP0s.sub (contDiff_const.mul hUs)).add (contDiff_const.mul hVs)
  · intro t
    unfold hpProf
    rw [abs_le]
    rcases le_total t (-(3 / 16)) with ht | ht
    · rw [hU0 t (by linarith), hV0 t (by linarith)]
      have := hP0b t
      constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]
    · rcases le_total t (3 / 16) with ht' | ht'
      · rw [hP0mid t ht ht']
        rcases le_total t α₃ with h | h
        · rw [hV0 t h]
          have := hUb t
          constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]
        · rw [hU1 t (by linarith)]
          have := hVb t
          constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]
      · rw [hU1 t (by linarith), hV1 t (by linarith)]
        have := hP0b t
        constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]
  · intro t ht
    unfold hpProf
    rw [hP0z t ht]
    rcases le_abs'.mp ht with h | h
    · rw [hU0 t (by linarith), hV0 t (by linarith)]
      norm_num
    · rw [hU1 t (by linarith), hV1 t (by linarith)]
      norm_num

informal_problem.statement:
(S : Set ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S) (ℓ υ : ℝ)
    (hℓ : -(1 / 8) ≤ ℓ) (hℓυ : ℓ ≤ υ) (hυ : υ ≤ 1 / 8)
    (hJ1 : volume {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Ioo (-(1 / 4)) ℓ ∧ t ∉ S} = 0)
    (hJ2 : volume {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Ioo υ (1 / 4) ∧ t ∈ S} = 0) :
    hpSliceInt S hpProf0 = 1 ∧
    (∀ α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄ : ℝ, -(3 / 16) ≤ α₁ → α₁ < α₂ → α₂ < α₃ → α₃ < α₄ → α₄ ≤ 3 / 16 →
      -1 ≤ hpSliceInt S (hpProf α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄) ∧ hpSliceInt S (hpProf α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄) ≤ 3) ∧
    (ℓ < υ → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → volume {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Ioo ℓ (ℓ + s) ∧ t ∉ S} ≠ 0) →
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → volume {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Ioo (υ - s) υ ∧ t ∈ S} ≠ 0) →
      ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → ∃ q₁ q₂ q₃ q₄ : ℚ, -(3 / 16) ≤ (q₁ : ℝ) ∧ (q₁ : ℝ) < q₂ ∧

(S : Set ℝ) (hS : MeasurableSet S) (ℓ υ : ℝ)

    (hJ2 : volume {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Ioo υ (1 / 4) ∧ t ∈ S} = 0) :

      -1 ≤ hpSliceInt S (hpProf α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄) ∧ hpSliceInt S (hpProf α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄) ≤ 3) ∧

        (q₂ : ℝ) < q₃ ∧ (q₃ : ℝ) < q₄ ∧ (q₄ : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 16 ∧
