proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hpRamp : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ α β : ℝ, α < β →
      Differentiable ℝ (hpUp α β) ∧ Continuous (deriv (hpUp α β)) ∧
      (∀ t, 0 ≤ deriv (hpUp α β) t) ∧ (∀ t, deriv (hpUp α β) t ≤ C / (β - α)) ∧
      (∀ t, t ∉ Set.Icc α β → deriv (hpUp α β) t = 0) ∧ ∫ t, deriv (hpUp α β) t = 1 := by
    have hσd : Differentiable ℝ Real.smoothTransition :=
      (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable one_ne_zero
    have hσc : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) :=
      (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).continuous_deriv le_rfl
    have hσ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → deriv Real.smoothTransition x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      rcases lt_or_ge x 0 with h | h
      · have hev : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds h] with y hy
          exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hy)
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
      · have h1 : 1 < x := by
          by_contra h'
          exact hx ⟨h, not_lt.mp h'⟩
        have hev : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds h1] with y hy
          exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (le_of_lt hy)
        rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    have hσcs : HasCompactSupport (deriv Real.smoothTransition) :=
      HasCompactSupport.intro isCompact_Icc hσ0
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hσc.bounded_above_of_compact_support hσcs
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hM 0)
    have hσnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition x :=
      fun x => Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
    refine ⟨M + 1, by linarith, fun α β hαβ => ?_⟩
    have hd : 0 < β - α := by linarith
    have hu : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (hpUp α β)
        (deriv Real.smoothTransition ((t - α) / (β - α)) * (1 / (β - α))) t := by
      intro t
      have ha : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (x - α) / (β - α)) (1 / (β - α)) t :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const α).div_const (β - α)
      exact (hσd ((t - α) / (β - α))).hasDerivAt.comp t ha
    have hderiv : deriv (hpUp α β) =
        fun t => deriv Real.smoothTransition ((t - α) / (β - α)) * (1 / (β - α)) :=
      funext fun t => (hu t).deriv
    have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ (hpUp α β) := fun t => (hu t).differentiableAt
    have hcont : Continuous (deriv (hpUp α β)) := by
      rw [hderiv]
      exact (hσc.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const _)).mul continuous_const
    have hzero : ∀ t, t ∉ Set.Icc α β → deriv (hpUp α β) t = 0 := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hderiv]
      simp only
      rw [hσ0, zero_mul]
      rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      apply ht
      constructor
      · have := (div_nonneg_iff.mp h1)
        rcases this with ⟨h3, _⟩ | ⟨_, h4⟩
        · linarith
        · linarith
      · rw [div_le_one hd] at h2
        linarith
    refine ⟨hdiff, hcont, ?_, ?_, hzero, ?_⟩
    · intro t
      rw [hderiv]
      exact mul_nonneg (hσnn _) (by positivity)
    · intro t
      rw [hderiv]
      simp only
      have h1 : deriv Real.smoothTransition ((t - α) / (β - α)) ≤ M + 1 := by
        have := hM ((t - α) / (β - α))
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        linarith [le_abs_self (deriv Real.smoothTransition ((t - α) / (β - α)))]
      rw [mul_one_div]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hd.le
    · rw [← setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hzero,
        integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hαβ.le,
        intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub (fun x _ => hdiff x) (hcont.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
      simp only [hpUp, sub_self, zero_div, div_self hd.ne']
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one, Real.smoothTransition.zero, sub_zero]
  
  have hpWeight : ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) (α β K : ℝ), Continuous w → (∀ t, 0 ≤ w t) → (∀ t, w t ≤ K) →
      (∀ t, t ∉ Set.Icc α β → w t = 0) → ∫ t, w t = 1 →
      Integrable (fun t => S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * w t) ∧
      0 ≤ ∫ t, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * w t ∧
      ∫ t, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * w t ≤ 1 ∧
      ∫ t, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * w t ≤ K * (volume (Set.Icc α β ∩ S)).toReal ∧
      1 - ∫ t, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * w t ≤
        K * (volume (Set.Icc α β \ S)).toReal := by
    intro w α β K hw hw0 hwK hws hw1
    have hwi : Integrable w :=
      hw.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.intro isCompact_Icc hws)
    have hgeq : (fun t => S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * w t) = S.indicator w := by
      funext t
      by_cases h : t ∈ S
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem h]
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem h]
    have hgi : Integrable (fun t => S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * w t) := by
      rw [hgeq]; exact hwi.indicator hS
    have hm1 : MeasurableSet (Set.Icc α β ∩ S) := measurableSet_Icc.inter hS
    have hm2 : MeasurableSet (Set.Icc α β \ S) := measurableSet_Icc.diff hS
    have hi1 : Integrable ((Set.Icc α β ∩ S).indicator (fun _ => K)) :=
      ((continuous_const.integrableOn_Icc (a := α) (b := β)).mono_set
        Set.inter_subset_left).integrable_indicator hm1
    have hi2 : Integrable ((Set.Icc α β \ S).indicator (fun _ => K)) :=
      ((continuous_const.integrableOn_Icc (a := α) (b := β)).mono_set
        Set.diff_subset).integrable_indicator hm2
    have hK1 : ∫ t, (Set.Icc α β ∩ S).indicator (fun _ => K) t =
        K * (volume (Set.Icc α β ∩ S)).toReal := by
      rw [integral_indicator hm1, setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, measureReal_def, mul_comm]
    have hK2 : ∫ t, (Set.Icc α β \ S).indicator (fun _ => K) t =
        K * (volume (Set.Icc α β \ S)).toReal := by
      rw [integral_indicator hm2, setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, measureReal_def, mul_comm]
    refine ⟨hgi, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine integral_nonneg fun t => mul_nonneg ?_ (hw0 t)
      exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) t
    · refine le_trans (integral_mono hgi hwi fun t => ?_) hw1.le
      by_cases h : t ∈ S
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem h]
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem h, hw0 t]
    · rw [← hK1]
      refine integral_mono hgi hi1 fun t => ?_
      by_cases h : t ∈ S
      · by_cases h' : t ∈ Set.Icc α β
        · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem h,
            Set.indicator_of_mem (show t ∈ Set.Icc α β ∩ S from ⟨h', h⟩), hwK t]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t ∉ Set.Icc α β ∩ S from fun hh => h' hh.1),
            hws t h']
          simp
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h, Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t ∉ Set.Icc α β ∩ S from
          fun hh => h hh.2)]
        simp
    · have hsub1 : 1 - ∫ t, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * w t =
          ∫ t, (w t - S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * w t) := by
        rw [integral_sub hwi hgi, hw1]
      rw [hsub1, ← hK2]
      refine integral_mono (hwi.sub hgi) hi2 fun t => ?_
      by_cases h : t ∈ S
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h, Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t ∉ Set.Icc α β \ S from
          fun hh => hh.2 h)]
        simp
      · by_cases h' : t ∈ Set.Icc α β
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h,
            Set.indicator_of_mem (show t ∈ Set.Icc α β \ S from ⟨h', h⟩)]
          simp [hwK t]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t ∉ Set.Icc α β \ S from fun hh => h' hh.1),
            hws t h']
          simp
  
  have hpDens : ∀ (A : Set ℝ), MeasurableSet A → ∀ (p q θ : ℝ), p < q → 0 < θ →
      volume {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Ioo p q ∧ t ∈ A} ≠ 0 →
      ∃ α β : ℚ, p < (α : ℝ) ∧ (α : ℝ) < β ∧ (β : ℝ) < q ∧
        volume (Set.Icc (α : ℝ) β \ A) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (θ * ((β : ℝ) - α)) := by
    intro A hA p q θ _ hθ hpos
    set A' : Set ℝ := {t : ℝ | t ∈ Set.Ioo p q ∧ t ∈ A} with hA'
    have hA'm : MeasurableSet A' := measurableSet_Ioo.inter hA
    obtain ⟨x, hxA', hx⟩ := Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hpos
      (Besicovitch.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div (volume : Measure ℝ) A')
    have hpx : p < x := hxA'.1.1
    have hxq : x < q := hxA'.1.2
    set ε : ℝ := min θ 1 / 4 with hε
    have hε0 : 0 < ε := by
      have : 0 < min θ 1 := lt_min hθ one_pos
      rw [hε]; linarith
    have hεθ : ε ≤ θ / 4 := by
      have := min_le_left θ 1
      rw [hε]; linarith
    have hε1 : ε ≤ 1 / 4 := by
      have := min_le_right θ 1
      rw [hε]; linarith
    have hlt : ENNReal.ofReal (1 - ε) < 1 := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_lt_one]; linarith
    set δ : ℝ := min (x - p) (q - x) with hδ
    have hδ0 : 0 < δ := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hev1 : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (1 - ε) <
        volume (A' ∩ closedBall x r) / volume (closedBall x r) :=
      hx.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hlt)
    have hev2 : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), 0 < r := self_mem_nhdsWithin
    have hev3 : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), r < δ := nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hδ0)
    obtain ⟨r, hr1, hr0, hrδ⟩ := (hev1.and (hev2.and hev3)).exists
    have hrp : r < x - p := lt_of_lt_of_le hrδ (min_le_left _ _)
    have hrq : r < q - x := lt_of_lt_of_le hrδ (min_le_right _ _)
    have hvolB : volume (closedBall x r) = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * r) := by
      rw [Real.volume_closedBall]
    have hmul := ENNReal.mul_lt_of_lt_div hr1
    rw [hvolB, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by linarith)] at hmul
    have hfin : volume (A' ∩ closedBall x r) ≠ ⊤ :=
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by rw [hvolB]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
        (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
    have hdiff : volume (closedBall x r \ A') ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ε * r) := by
      have e1 : closedBall x r \ A' = closedBall x r \ (A' ∩ closedBall x r) := by
        ext t; simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_inter_iff]; tauto
      rw [e1, measure_diff Set.inter_subset_right
        (hA'm.inter measurableSet_closedBall).nullMeasurableSet hfin, hvolB]
      calc ENNReal.ofReal (2 * r) - volume (A' ∩ closedBall x r)
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * r) - ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε) * (2 * r)) :=
            tsub_le_tsub_left hmul.le _
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * r - (1 - ε) * (2 * r)) :=
            (ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ (by nlinarith)).symm
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ε * r) := by ring_nf
    obtain ⟨α, hα1, hα2⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (show x - r < x - r / 2 by linarith)
    obtain ⟨β, hβ1, hβ2⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (show x + r / 2 < x + r by linarith)
    refine ⟨α, β, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
    have hsub : Set.Icc (α : ℝ) β \ A ⊆ closedBall x r \ A' := by
      rintro t ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, ht3⟩
      refine ⟨?_, fun h => ht3 h.2⟩
      rw [Real.closedBall_eq_Icc]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    calc volume (Set.Icc (α : ℝ) β \ A) ≤ volume (closedBall x r \ A') := measure_mono hsub
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ε * r) := hdiff
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (θ * ((β : ℝ) - α)) := by
          apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
          have h1 : 2 * ε * r ≤ θ / 2 * r := by nlinarith
          have h2 : r < (β : ℝ) - α := by linarith
          nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hramp⟩ := hpRamp
  have R : ∀ α β : ℝ, α < β → Differentiable ℝ (hpUp α β) ∧
      Integrable (fun t => S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * deriv (hpUp α β) t) ∧
      0 ≤ hpSliceInt S (hpUp α β) ∧ hpSliceInt S (hpUp α β) ≤ 1 ∧
      hpSliceInt S (hpUp α β) ≤ C / (β - α) * (volume (Set.Icc α β ∩ S)).toReal ∧
      1 - hpSliceInt S (hpUp α β) ≤ C / (β - α) * (volume (Set.Icc α β \ S)).toReal := by
    intro α β hαβ
    obtain ⟨hd, hc, hnn, hK, hz, h1⟩ := hramp α β hαβ
    obtain ⟨hi, w0, w1, w2, w3⟩ :=
      hpWeight (deriv (hpUp α β)) α β (C / (β - α)) hc hnn hK hz h1
    exact ⟨hd, hi, w0, w1, w2, w3⟩
  
  have comb : ∀ (f₁ f₂ f₃ f₄ : ℝ → ℝ) (c₃ c₄ : ℝ), Differentiable ℝ f₁ → Differentiable ℝ f₂ →
      Differentiable ℝ f₃ → Differentiable ℝ f₄ →
      Integrable (fun t => S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * deriv f₁ t) →
      Integrable (fun t => S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * deriv f₂ t) →
      Integrable (fun t => S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * deriv f₃ t) →
      Integrable (fun t => S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * deriv f₄ t) →
      hpSliceInt S (fun t => f₁ t - f₂ t - c₃ * f₃ t + c₄ * f₄ t) =
        hpSliceInt S f₁ - hpSliceInt S f₂ - c₃ * hpSliceInt S f₃ + c₄ * hpSliceInt S f₄ := by
    intro f₁ f₂ f₃ f₄ c₃ c₄ hd₁ hd₂ hd₃ hd₄ hi₁ hi₂ hi₃ hi₄
    have hder : deriv (fun t => f₁ t - f₂ t - c₃ * f₃ t + c₄ * f₄ t) =
        fun t => deriv f₁ t - deriv f₂ t - c₃ * deriv f₃ t + c₄ * deriv f₄ t := by
      funext t
      exact ((((hd₁ t).hasDerivAt.sub (hd₂ t).hasDerivAt).sub
        ((hd₃ t).hasDerivAt.const_mul c₃)).add ((hd₄ t).hasDerivAt.const_mul c₄)).deriv
    unfold hpSliceInt
    rw [hder]
    have hfun : (fun t => S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t *
        (deriv f₁ t - deriv f₂ t - c₃ * deriv f₃ t + c₄ * deriv f₄ t)) =
        fun t => S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * deriv f₁ t -
          S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * deriv f₂ t -
          c₃ * (S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * deriv f₃ t) +
          c₄ * (S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) t * deriv f₄ t) := by
      funext t; ring
    rw [hfun, integral_add, integral_sub, integral_sub, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    all_goals first
      | exact hi₁ | exact hi₂ | exact hi₄.const_mul c₄ | exact hi₃.const_mul c₃
      | exact hi₁.sub hi₂ | exact (hi₁.sub hi₂).sub (hi₃.const_mul c₃)
  have h1 : (-(6 / 25) : ℝ) < -(3 / 16) := by norm_num
  have h2 : (3 / 16 : ℝ) < 6 / 25 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨d1, i1, a1, b1, c1, e1⟩ := R _ _ h1
  obtain ⟨d2, i2, a2, b2, c2, e2⟩ := R _ _ h2
  have hv1 : volume (Set.Icc (-(6 / 25) : ℝ) (-(3 / 16)) \ S) = 0 := by
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ hJ1
    rintro t ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, ht3⟩
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ht3⟩
  have hv2 : volume (Set.Icc (3 / 16 : ℝ) (6 / 25) ∩ S) = 0 := by
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ hJ2
    rintro t ⟨⟨ht1, ht2⟩, ht3⟩
    exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ht3⟩
  rw [hv1, ENNReal.toReal_zero, mul_zero] at e1
  rw [hv2, ENNReal.toReal_zero, mul_zero] at c2
  have L1 : hpSliceInt S (hpUp (-(6 / 25)) (-(3 / 16))) = 1 := by linarith
  have L2 : hpSliceInt S (hpUp (3 / 16) (6 / 25)) = 0 := by linarith
  have hP0 : hpProf0 = fun t => hpUp (-(6 / 25)) (-(3 / 16)) t - hpUp (3 / 16) (6 / 25) t -
      0 * hpUp (-(6 / 25)) (-(3 / 16)) t + 0 * hpUp (-(6 / 25)) (-(3 / 16)) t := by
    funext t; simp only [hpProf0]; ring
  have V0 : hpSliceInt S hpProf0 = 1 := by
    rw [hP0, comb _ _ _ _ 0 0 d1 d2 d1 d1 i1 i2 i1 i1, L1, L2]; ring
  have VP : ∀ α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄ : ℝ, α₁ < α₂ → α₃ < α₄ →
      hpSliceInt S (hpProf α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄) =
        1 - 2 * hpSliceInt S (hpUp α₁ α₂) + 2 * hpSliceInt S (hpUp α₃ α₄) := by
    intro α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄ h12 h34
    obtain ⟨d3, i3, -⟩ := R _ _ h12
    obtain ⟨d4, i4, -⟩ := R _ _ h34
    have hP : hpProf α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄ = fun t => hpUp (-(6 / 25)) (-(3 / 16)) t -
        hpUp (3 / 16) (6 / 25) t - 2 * hpUp α₁ α₂ t + 2 * hpUp α₃ α₄ t := by
      funext t; simp only [hpProf, hpProf0]
    rw [hP, comb _ _ _ _ 2 2 d1 d2 d3 d4 i1 i2 i3 i4, L1, L2]; ring
  refine ⟨V0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄ _ h12 _ h34 _
    rw [VP α₁ α₂ α₃ α₄ h12 h34]
    obtain ⟨-, -, a3, b3, -⟩ := R _ _ h12
    obtain ⟨-, -, a4, b4, -⟩ := R _ _ h34
    constructor <;> linarith
  · intro hlu hJ3 hJ4 θ hθ
    set s : ℝ := (υ - ℓ) / 2 with hs
    have hs0 : 0 < s := by rw [hs]; linarith
    have hθ' : 0 < θ / (4 * C) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨q₁, q₂, hq1, hq12, hq2, hvq⟩ := hpDens Sᶜ hS.compl ℓ (ℓ + s) (θ / (4 * C))
      (by linarith) hθ' (hJ3 s hs0)
    obtain ⟨q₃, q₄, hq3, hq34, hq4, hvq'⟩ := hpDens S hS (υ - s) υ (θ / (4 * C))
      (by linarith) hθ' (hJ4 s hs0)
    rw [Set.diff_compl] at hvq
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, c3, -⟩ := R _ _ hq12
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, e4⟩ := R _ _ hq34
    have hne12 : (q₂ : ℝ) - q₁ ≠ 0 := (sub_pos.2 hq12).ne'
    have hne34 : (q₄ : ℝ) - q₃ ≠ 0 := (sub_pos.2 hq34).ne'
    have t1 := ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (mul_nonneg hθ'.le (by linarith)) hvq
    have t2 := ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (mul_nonneg hθ'.le (by linarith)) hvq'
    have u1 : hpSliceInt S (hpUp q₁ q₂) ≤ θ / 4 := by
      calc hpSliceInt S (hpUp q₁ q₂)
          ≤ C / ((q₂ : ℝ) - q₁) * (volume (Set.Icc (q₁ : ℝ) q₂ ∩ S)).toReal := c3
        _ ≤ C / ((q₂ : ℝ) - q₁) * (θ / (4 * C) * ((q₂ : ℝ) - q₁)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left t1 (div_nonneg hC0.le (by linarith))
        _ = θ / 4 := by field_simp
    have u2 : 1 - hpSliceInt S (hpUp q₃ q₄) ≤ θ / 4 := by
      calc 1 - hpSliceInt S (hpUp q₃ q₄)
          ≤ C / ((q₄ : ℝ) - q₃) * (volume (Set.Icc (q₃ : ℝ) q₄ \ S)).toReal := e4
        _ ≤ C / ((q₄ : ℝ) - q₃) * (θ / (4 * C) * ((q₄ : ℝ) - q₃)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left t2 (div_nonneg hC0.le (by linarith))
        _ = θ / 4 := by field_simp
    refine ⟨q₁, q₂, q₃, q₄, by linarith, hq12, by linarith, hq34, by linarith, ?_⟩
    rw [VP _ _ _ _ hq12 hq34]
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(I : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (T : Set E2) (hI : ∀ k, Measurable (I k))
    (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), ‖x‖ < 1 / 4 →
      I 0 x = 1 ∧ ∀ k, -1 ≤ I k x ∧ I k x ≤ 3)
    (hT : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), x ∈ T → ‖x‖ < 1 / 4 →
      ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → ∃ k, 3 - θ ≤ I k x)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (volume (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4)) +
        2 * volume (T ∩ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4))).toReal - η ≤
      ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4),
        (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun k => I k x)

signature.name: hpSL_sup_limit
signature.statement:
(I : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (T : Set E2) (hI : ∀ k, Measurable (I k))
    (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), ‖x‖ < 1 / 4 →
      I 0 x = 1 ∧ ∀ k, -1 ≤ I k x ∧ I k x ≤ 3)
    (hT : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), x ∈ T → ‖x‖ < 1 / 4 →
      ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → ∃ k, 3 - θ ≤ I k x)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, (volume (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4)) +
        2 * volume (T ∩ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4))).toReal - η ≤
      ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4),
        (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun k => I k x)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set B := Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4) with hBdef
  set S : ℕ → E2 → ℝ := fun n x =>
    (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun k => I k x) with hSdef
  have hBm : MeasurableSet B := measurableSet_ball
  have hBfin : volume B ≠ ⊤ := measure_ball_lt_top.ne
  have hTBfin : volume (T ∩ B) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top hBfin (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
  set β := (volume B).toReal with hβ
  set m := (volume (T ∩ B)).toReal with hm
  have hβ0 : 0 ≤ β := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  set θ := η / (2 * (β + 1)) with hθ
  have hθpos : 0 < θ := div_pos hη (by positivity)
  have hSmono : ∀ n p, n ≤ p → ∀ x, S n x ≤ S p x := by
    intro n p hnp x
    exact Finset.sup'_mono (fun k => I k x)
      (fun y hy => by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hy ⊢; omega) _
  set A : ℕ → Set E2 := fun n => {x | 3 - θ ≤ S n x} ∩ B with hA
  have hAmono : Monotone A := by
    intro n p hnp x hx
    exact ⟨le_trans hx.1 (hSmono n p hnp x), hx.2⟩
  set U := ⋃ n, A n with hU
  have hcov : volume (T ∩ B) ≤ volume U := by
    refine measure_mono_ae (hT.mono fun x hx hxTB => ?_)
    have hxTB' : x ∈ T ∩ B := hxTB
    have hxB : ‖x‖ < 1 / 4 := mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hxTB'.2
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hx hxTB'.1 hxB θ hθpos
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k, ?_, hxTB'.2⟩
    show 3 - θ ≤ S k x
    exact le_trans hk (Finset.le_sup' (fun k => I k x) (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_self k)))
  have hUB : U ⊆ B := Set.iUnion_subset fun n => Set.inter_subset_right
  have hUfin : volume U ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top hBfin (measure_mono hUB)
  have htend : Tendsto (fun n => (volume (A n)).toReal) atTop (𝓝 (volume U).toReal) :=
    (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal hUfin).comp (tendsto_measure_iUnion_atTop hAmono)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (htend.eventually_const_lt
    (show (volume U).toReal - η / 4 < (volume U).toReal by linarith)).exists
  have hmU : m ≤ (volume U).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_mono hUfin hcov
  have hSmeas : Measurable (S n) := Finset.measurable_range_sup'' (fun k _ => hI k)
  set a := (volume (A n)).toReal with ha
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have haβ : a ≤ β := ENNReal.toReal_mono hBfin (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
  have hAnm : MeasurableSet {x | 3 - θ ≤ S n x} := measurableSet_le measurable_const hSmeas
  have hbB : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict B), 1 ≤ S n x ∧ S n x ≤ 3 := by
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' hBm]
    filter_upwards [hb] with x hx hxB
    obtain ⟨h0, hk⟩ := hx (mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hxB)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← h0]
      exact Finset.le_sup' (fun k => I k x) (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.succ_pos n))
    · exact Finset.sup'_le _ _ (fun k _ => (hk k).2)
  have hSint : IntegrableOn (S n) B := by
    refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := 3) hBfin hSmeas.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards [hbB] with x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]
  have hc1 : IntegrableOn (fun _ : E2 => (1 : ℝ)) B := integrableOn_const hBfin
  have hc2 : IntegrableOn ({x | 3 - θ ≤ S n x}.indicator (fun _ : E2 => (2 - θ : ℝ))) B :=
    (integrableOn_const hBfin).indicator hAnm
  have hgle : (fun x => (1 : ℝ) + {x | 3 - θ ≤ S n x}.indicator (fun _ : E2 => (2 - θ : ℝ)) x)
      ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict B] S n := by
    filter_upwards [hbB] with x hx
    by_cases hxA : x ∈ {x | 3 - θ ≤ S n x}
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxA]
      have : 3 - θ ≤ S n x := hxA
      linarith
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxA]
      linarith [hx.1]
  have hgval : (∫ x in B, ((1 : ℝ) + {x | 3 - θ ≤ S n x}.indicator (fun _ : E2 => (2 - θ : ℝ)) x))
      = β + (2 - θ) * a := by
    rw [integral_add hc1 hc2, setIntegral_const, setIntegral_indicator hAnm, setIntegral_const,
      measureReal_def, measureReal_def, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Set.inter_comm]
    ring
  have hint : β + (2 - θ) * a ≤ ∫ x in B, S n x := by
    rw [← hgval]
    exact setIntegral_mono_ae_restrict (hc1.add hc2) hSint hgle
  have hθβ : θ * β + θ = η / 2 := by
    rw [hθ]
    field_simp
    try ring
  have hθa : θ * a ≤ θ * β := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left haβ hθpos.le
  have hlhs : (volume B + 2 * volume (T ∩ B)).toReal = β + 2 * m := by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_add hBfin (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top hTBfin),
      ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofNat]
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  show (volume B + 2 * volume (T ∩ B)).toReal - η ≤ ∫ x in B, S n x
  rw [hlhs]
  nlinarith [hint, hθβ, hθa, hn, hmU]

informal_problem.statement:
(n : ℕ) (I : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hI : ∀ k, Measurable (I k))
    (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), ‖x‖ < 1 / 4 → ∀ k, -1 ≤ I k x ∧ I k x ≤ 3)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → E2 → ℝ, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (c k)) ∧ (∀ k x, 0 ≤ c k x) ∧
      (∀ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c k x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ k, HasCompactSupport (c k)) ∧
      (∀ k, tsupport (c k) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4)) ∧
      (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4),
          (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun k => I k x)) - η ≤
        ∫ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c k x * I k x

signature.name: hpSL_bump_select
signature.statement:
(n : ℕ) (I : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hI : ∀ k, Measurable (I k))
    (hb : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), ‖x‖ < 1 / 4 → ∀ k, -1 ≤ I k x ∧ I k x ≤ 3)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → E2 → ℝ, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (c k)) ∧ (∀ k x, 0 ≤ c k x) ∧
      (∀ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c k x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ k, HasCompactSupport (c k)) ∧
      (∀ k, tsupport (c k) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4)) ∧
      (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4),
          (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun k => I k x)) - η ≤
        ∫ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c k x * I k x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (I : ℕ → E2 → ℝ), (∀ k, Measurable (I k)) →
      ∃ A : ℕ → Set E2, (∀ k, MeasurableSet (A k)) ∧
        (∀ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (A k).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x = 1) ∧
        (∀ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (A k).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x * I k x =
          (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun k => I k x)) := by
    intro n I hI
    set M : E2 → ℝ := fun x => (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
      (fun k => I k x) with hMdef
    have hM : Measurable M := by
      have := Finset.measurable_sup' (Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (n := n)) (fun k _ => hI k)
      convert this using 1
      funext x
      simp [M, Finset.sup'_apply]
    let B : ℕ → Set E2 := fun k => {x | I k x = M x}
    have hB : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (B k) := fun k => measurableSet_eq_fun (hI k) hM
    let A : ℕ → Set E2 := fun k => B k \ ⋃ j ∈ Finset.range k, B j
    have hA : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (A k) := fun k =>
      (hB k).diff (Finset.measurableSet_biUnion _ (fun j _ => hB j))
    have key : ∀ x, ∃ k₀, k₀ ∈ Finset.range (n + 1) ∧ x ∈ A k₀ ∧
        ∀ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), k ≠ k₀ → x ∉ A k := by
      intro x
      have H : ∃ k, k ≤ n ∧ x ∈ B k := by
        obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
          (fun k => I k x)
        exact ⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk), hk'.symm⟩
      refine ⟨Nat.find H, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.find_spec H).1),
        ⟨(Nat.find_spec H).2, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists]
        intro j hj hjB
        have hj' : j < Nat.find H := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
        exact Nat.find_min H hj' ⟨by have := (Nat.find_spec H).1; omega, hjB⟩
      · intro k hk hne hkA
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
        · exact Nat.find_min H h ⟨Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk), hkA.1⟩
        · exact hkA.2 (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr
            ⟨Nat.find H, Finset.mem_range.mpr h, (Nat.find_spec H).2⟩)
    refine ⟨A, hA, fun x => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀, hx, hother⟩ := key x
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k₀ (fun k hk hne => Set.indicator_of_notMem (hother k hk hne) _)
        (fun h => absurd hk₀ h)]
      exact Set.indicator_of_mem hx _
    · obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀, hx, hother⟩ := key x
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k₀ (fun k hk hne => by
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (hother k hk hne), zero_mul]) (fun h => absurd hk₀ h)]
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, one_mul]
      exact hx.1
  
  have s4 : ∀ (M : E2 → ℝ), IntegrableOn M (Metric.ball 0 (1 / 4)) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < 1 / 4 ∧
        ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4), M x ≤ (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, M x) + ε := by
    intro M hM ε hε
    let s : ℕ → Set E2 := fun j => Metric.ball 0 (1 / 4 - 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 5))
    have hmono : Monotone s := by
      intro i j hij
      apply Metric.ball_subset_ball
      have hij' : (i : ℝ) + 5 ≤ (j : ℝ) + 5 := by
        have : (i : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hij
        linarith
      have : (1 : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 5) ≤ 1 / ((i : ℝ) + 5) :=
        one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) hij'
      linarith
    have hU : (⋃ j, s j) = Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4) := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · exact Set.iUnion_subset fun j => Metric.ball_subset_ball (by
          have : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 5) := by positivity
          linarith)
      · intro x hx
        rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hx
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 4 - ‖x‖ by linarith)
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, ?_⟩
        show x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4 - 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 5))
        rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
        have : (1 : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 5) ≤ 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) :=
          one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
        linarith
    have ht := MeasureTheory.tendsto_setIntegral_of_monotone (μ := volume) (f := M)
      (fun j => measurableSet_ball) hmono (by rw [hU]; exact hM)
    rw [hU] at ht
    have hev := (tendsto_order.1 ht).1 _
      (show (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4), M x) - ε < _ by linarith)
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hev.exists
    refine ⟨1 / 4 - 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 5), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : (1 : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 5) ≤ 1 / 5 :=
        one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) (by have := j.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ); linarith)
      linarith
    · have : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 5) := by positivity
      linarith
    · have hj' : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4), M x) - ε <
          ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4 - 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 5)), M x := hj
      linarith
  
  have s2 : ∀ (φ : ContDiffBump (0 : E2)) (K : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (g : ℕ → E2 → ℝ),
      (∀ k, Measurable (g k)) → (∀ k x, 0 ≤ g k x) → (∀ k x, g k x ≤ 1) →
      (∀ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, g k x ≤ 1) → (∀ k x, r ≤ ‖x‖ → g k x = 0) →
      (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞
        (convolution (φ.normed volume) (g k) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume)) ∧
      (∀ k x, 0 ≤ convolution (φ.normed volume) (g k) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x) ∧
      (∀ k x, convolution (φ.normed volume) (g k) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K,
        convolution (φ.normed volume) (g k) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ k x, r + φ.rOut ≤ ‖x‖ →
        convolution (φ.normed volume) (g k) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x = 0) ∧
      (∀ k, HasCompactSupport
        (convolution (φ.normed volume) (g k) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume)) ∧
      (∀ k, tsupport
        (convolution (φ.normed volume) (g k) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) ⊆
        Metric.closedBall 0 (r + φ.rOut)) := by
    intro φ K r g hg hg0 hg1 hsum hgr
    have hconv : ∀ k x,
        convolution (φ.normed volume) (g k) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x
          = ∫ t, φ.normed volume t * g k (x - t) := by
      intro k x
      rw [convolution_lsmul]
      rfl
    have hψ0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ φ.normed volume t := fun t => φ.nonneg_normed t
    have hψi : Integrable (φ.normed volume) volume := φ.integrable_normed
    have hψ1 : ∫ t, φ.normed volume t = 1 := φ.integral_normed
    have hgint : ∀ k, Integrable (g k) volume := by
      intro k
      have hbd : Integrable ((Metric.ball (0 : E2) r).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) volume :=
        (integrableOn_const measure_ball_lt_top.ne).integrable_indicator measurableSet_ball
      refine hbd.mono' (hg k).aestronglyMeasurable (Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
      by_cases hx : ‖x‖ < r
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hx), Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_nonneg (hg0 k x)]
        exact hg1 k x
      · rw [hgr k x (not_lt.mp hx), norm_zero]
        exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) x
    have hP1 : ∀ k x, Integrable (fun t => φ.normed volume t * g k (x - t)) volume := by
      intro k x
      refine hψi.mono' ?_ (Eventually.of_forall fun t => ?_)
      · exact (φ.continuous_normed.measurable.mul
          ((hg k).comp (measurable_const.sub measurable_id))).aestronglyMeasurable
      · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hψ0 t) (hg0 k _))]
        calc φ.normed volume t * g k (x - t) ≤ φ.normed volume t * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg1 k _) (hψ0 t)
          _ = φ.normed volume t := mul_one _
    have hvan : ∀ k x, r + φ.rOut ≤ ‖x‖ →
        convolution (φ.normed volume) (g k) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume x = 0 := by
      intro k x hx
      rw [hconv]
      have hz : (fun t => φ.normed volume t * g k (x - t)) = fun _ => 0 := by
        funext t
        by_cases ht : ‖t‖ < φ.rOut
        · have : r ≤ ‖x - t‖ := by
            have := norm_sub_norm_le x t
            linarith
          rw [hgr k _ this, mul_zero]
        · have : φ.normed volume t = 0 := by
            apply Function.notMem_support.mp
            rw [φ.support_normed_eq]
            simpa [mem_ball_zero_iff] using ht
          rw [this, zero_mul]
      rw [hz, integral_zero]
    refine ⟨fun k => ?_, fun k x => ?_, fun k x => ?_, fun x => ?_, hvan, fun k => ?_,
      fun k => ?_⟩
    · exact φ.hasCompactSupport_normed.contDiff_convolution_left _ φ.contDiff_normed
        (hgint k).locallyIntegrable
    · rw [hconv]
      exact integral_nonneg fun t => mul_nonneg (hψ0 t) (hg0 k _)
    · rw [hconv, ← hψ1]
      refine integral_mono (hP1 k x) hψi fun t => ?_
      calc φ.normed volume t * g k (x - t) ≤ φ.normed volume t * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg1 k _) (hψ0 t)
        _ = φ.normed volume t := mul_one _
    · simp only [hconv]
      rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => hP1 k x), ← hψ1]
      refine integral_mono (integrable_finset_sum _ fun k _ => hP1 k x) hψi fun t => ?_
      simp only
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      calc φ.normed volume t * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, g k (x - t) ≤ φ.normed volume t * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hsum _) (hψ0 t)
        _ = φ.normed volume t := mul_one _
    · refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E2) (r + φ.rOut)) fun x hx =>
        hvan k x ?_
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] at hx
      exact hx.le
    · refine closure_minimal (fun x hx => ?_) Metric.isClosed_closedBall
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
      by_contra h
      exact hx (hvan k x (not_le.mp h).le)
  
  have s3 : ∀ (K : ℕ) (I : ℕ → E2 → ℝ), (∀ k, Measurable (I k)) →
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), ‖x‖ < 1 / 4 → ∀ k, -1 ≤ I k x ∧ I k x ≤ 3) →
      ∀ (c : ℕ → ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (f : ℕ → E2 → ℝ), (∀ m k, Continuous (c m k)) →
      (∀ m k x, 0 ≤ c m k x) → (∀ m k x, c m k x ≤ 1) →
      (∀ m k x, 1 / 4 ≤ ‖x‖ → c m k x = 0) →
      (∀ k, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), Tendsto (fun m => c m k x) atTop (𝓝 (f k x))) →
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, c m k x * I k x) atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, f k x * I k x)) := by
    intro K I hI hb c f hc hc0 hc1 hcv hlim
    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
      ((Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4)).indicator (fun _ => 3 * (K : ℝ))) (fun m => ?_)
      ((integrableOn_const measure_ball_lt_top.ne).integrable_indicator measurableSet_ball)
      (fun m => ?_) ?_
    · exact (Finset.measurable_sum _ fun k _ =>
        (hc m k).measurable.mul (hI k)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [hb] with x hx
      by_cases hx4 : ‖x‖ < 1 / 4
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hx4)]
        have hIx := hx hx4
        calc ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, c m k x * I k x‖
            ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, ‖c m k x * I k x‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, (3 : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => by
              rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hc0 m k x)]
              have h1 := hc1 m k x
              have h0 := hc0 m k x
              have h3 : |I k x| ≤ 3 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [(hIx k).1], (hIx k).2⟩
              nlinarith [abs_nonneg (I k x)]
          _ = 3 * K := by rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (by rwa [mem_ball_zero_iff]),
          Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => by rw [hcv m k x (not_lt.mp hx4), zero_mul], norm_zero]
    · filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hlim] with x hx
      exact tendsto_finset_sum _ fun k _ => (hx k).mul_const (I k x)
  
  set M : E2 → ℝ := fun x => (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one
    (fun k => I k x) with hMdef
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hA1, hAM⟩ := s1 n I hI
  have hM : Measurable M := by
    have := Finset.measurable_sup' (Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (n := n)) (fun k _ => hI k)
    convert this using 1
    funext x
    simp [M, Finset.sup'_apply]
  have hMint : IntegrableOn M (Metric.ball 0 (1 / 4)) := by
    refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := 3) measure_ball_lt_top.ne
      hM.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_ball]
    filter_upwards [hb] with x hx hxD
    have h := hx (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hxD)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
    constructor
    · have := Finset.le_sup' (fun k => I k x) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.succ_pos n))
      linarith [(h 0).1]
    · exact Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun k _ => (h k).2
  obtain ⟨r, hr0, hr4, hrD⟩ := s4 M hMint (η / 2) (by linarith)
  set g : ℕ → E2 → ℝ := fun k => (A k ∩ Metric.ball 0 r).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
    with hgdef
  have hgm : ∀ k, Measurable (g k) := fun k =>
    measurable_const.indicator ((hA k).inter measurableSet_ball)
  have hg0 : ∀ k x, 0 ≤ g k x := fun k x => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) x
  have hg1 : ∀ k x, g k x ≤ 1 := fun k x => Set.indicator_le_self' (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) x
  have hgr : ∀ k x, r ≤ ‖x‖ → g k x = 0 := fun k x hx =>
    Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => by have := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp h.2; linarith) _
  have hgball : ∀ k x, x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) r →
      g k x = (A k).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x := by
    intro k x hx
    simp only [g, Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_inter_iff, hx, and_true]
  have hgsum : ∀ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), g k x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) r
    · rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => hgball k x hx, hA1 x]
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hx h.2) _]
      norm_num
  have hgkey : ∀ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), g k x * I k x =
      (Metric.ball (0 : E2) r).indicator M x := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) r
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by rw [hgball k x hx],
        hAM x]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => by
        rw [show g k x = 0 from Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hx h.2) _, zero_mul]]
  have hgint : ∀ k, LocallyIntegrable (g k) volume := fun k =>
    ((integrableOn_const (ne_top_of_le_ne_top measure_ball_lt_top.ne
      (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right))).integrable_indicator
      ((hA k).inter measurableSet_ball)).locallyIntegrable
  set δ : ℝ := 1 / 4 - r with hδ
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := by linarith
  set ρ : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => δ / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) with hρdef
  have hρ0 : ∀ m, 0 < ρ m := fun m => by positivity
  have hρle : ∀ m, ρ m ≤ δ / 2 := fun m => by
    have h1 : 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith [m.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ)]
    calc ρ m = δ / 2 * (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) := rfl
      _ ≤ δ / 2 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith)
      _ = δ / 2 := mul_one _
  let φ : ℕ → ContDiffBump (0 : E2) := fun m =>
    ⟨ρ m / 2, ρ m, by linarith [hρ0 m], by linarith [hρ0 m]⟩
  have hφr : ∀ m, (φ m).rOut = ρ m := fun m => rfl
  have hφt : Tendsto (fun m => (φ m).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have := (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).const_mul (δ / 2)
    rw [mul_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hφK : ∀ᶠ m in atTop, (φ m).rOut ≤ 2 * (φ m).rIn :=
    Eventually.of_forall fun m => by
      show ρ m ≤ 2 * (ρ m / 2)
      linarith
  set c : ℕ → ℕ → E2 → ℝ := fun m k =>
    convolution ((φ m).normed volume) (g k) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume with hcdef
  have hlim : ∀ k, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2),
      Tendsto (fun m => c m k x) atTop (𝓝 (g k x)) :=
    fun k => ContDiffBump.ae_convolution_tendsto_right_of_locallyIntegrable hφt hφK (hgint k)
  have hprops := fun m => s2 (φ m) (n + 1) r g hgm hg0 hg1 hgsum hgr
  have hcv : ∀ m k x, 1 / 4 ≤ ‖x‖ → c m k x = 0 := fun m k x hx =>
    (hprops m).2.2.2.2.1 k x (by rw [hφr]; linarith [hρle m])
  have hT := s3 (n + 1) I hI hb c g (fun m k => ((hprops m).1 k).continuous)
    (fun m k x => (hprops m).2.1 k x) (fun m k x => (hprops m).2.2.1 k x) hcv hlim
  have hlimval : ∫ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), g k x * I k x =
      ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, M x := by
    rw [show (fun x => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), g k x * I k x) =
      (Metric.ball (0 : E2) r).indicator M from funext hgkey,
      integral_indicator measurableSet_ball]
  rw [hlimval] at hT
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ((tendsto_order.1 hT).1 _
    (show (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, M x) - η / 2 < _ by linarith)).exists
  refine ⟨c m, (hprops m).1, (hprops m).2.1, (hprops m).2.2.2.1, (hprops m).2.2.2.2.2.1,
    fun k => ((hprops m).2.2.2.2.2.2 k).trans
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by rw [hφr]; linarith [hρle m])), ?_⟩
  have hm' : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, M x) - η / 2 <
      ∫ x, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c m k x * I k x := hm
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (O : Set E3) (Y : E3 → E3)
    (hO : IsOpen O) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) O)
    (hdet : ∀ z ∈ O, 0 < (G z).det) (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y) (hYc : HasCompactSupport Y)
    (hYO : tsupport Y ⊆ O) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i)) ∧
    Continuous (sepDensDiv G Y) ∧ HasCompactSupport (sepDensDiv G Y) ∧
    ∀ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ∀ z : E3,
      sepDensDiv G (fun w => ψ w • Y w) z =
        ψ z * sepDensDiv G Y z + Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Y z)

signature.name: hpDensDiv_calculus
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (O : Set E3) (Y : E3 → E3)
    (hO : IsOpen O) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) O)
    (hdet : ∀ z ∈ O, 0 < (G z).det) (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y) (hYc : HasCompactSupport Y)
    (hYO : tsupport Y ⊆ O) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i)) ∧
    Continuous (sepDensDiv G Y) ∧ HasCompactSupport (sepDensDiv G Y) ∧
    ∀ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ∀ z : E3,
      sepDensDiv G (fun w => ψ w • Y w) z =
        ψ z * sepDensDiv G Y z + Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Y z)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h0 : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  
  have hw : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) := by
    intro i
    have hYi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Y z i) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hY
    have hdetC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) O := by
      have hfe : (fun z => (G z).det) = fun z =>
          G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
            - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
            + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0 := by
        funext z
        exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
      rw [hfe]
      exact (((((((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 2)).sub
        (((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 1))).sub
        (((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 2))).add
        (((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 0))).add
        (((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 1))).sub
        (((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 0))
    have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) O :=
      hdetC.sqrt (fun z hz => (hdet z hz).ne')
    have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) O :=
      hs.mul hYi.contDiffOn
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ O
    · exact hc.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)
    · have hzt : z ∉ tsupport Y := fun h => hz (hYO h)
      have hev : Y =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hzt
      have hev' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
        simp [hw]
      exact (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev'
  
  have hcont : Continuous (sepDensDiv G Y) := by
    have hfe : sepDensDiv G Y = fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) z (e i) := by
      funext z
      simp only [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
    rw [hfe]
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
      ((hw i).continuous_fderiv h0).clm_apply continuous_const
  
  have hsupp : HasCompactSupport (sepDensDiv G Y) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.mono' hYc ?_
    intro z hz
    by_contra hzt
    apply hz
    have hev : Y =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hzt
    simp only [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    have hev' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
      simp [hw]
    rw [hev'.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  refine ⟨hw, hcont, hsupp, ?_⟩
  intro ψ hψ z
  have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z := hψ.differentiable h0 z
  have hwd : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * Y w i) z :=
    fun i => (hw i).differentiable h0 z
  have hfun : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * (ψ w • Y w) i) =
      fun w => ψ w * (Real.sqrt (G w).det * Y w i) := by
    intro i
    funext w
    simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hder : ∀ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * (ψ w • Y w) i) z (e i) =
      ψ z * fderiv ℝ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * Y w i) z (e i) +
        Real.sqrt (G z).det * (Y z i * fderiv ℝ ψ z (e i)) := by
    intro i
    rw [hfun i, fderiv_fun_mul hψd (hwd i)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hY3 : Y z = Y z 0 • e 0 + Y z 1 • e 1 + Y z 2 • e 2 := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hexp : fderiv ℝ ψ z (Y z) = ∑ i : Fin 3, Y z i * fderiv ℝ ψ z (e i) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hY3]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  simp only [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hder i), Finset.sum_add_distrib, hexp,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Z : E3 → E3) (a ρ : ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1))
    (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i)
    (hclose : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |G z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Z) (hZc : HasCompactSupport Z)
    (hZs : tsupport Z ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z : E3 | z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2})
    (hZG : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Z y i * Z y j ≤ 1) :
    ∫ z in {z : E3 | z 0 < a}, sepDensDiv G Z z ≤
      (101 / 100) * (volume (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ)).toReal

signature.name: hpHalf_flux_bound
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Z : E3 → E3) (a ρ : ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1))
    (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i)
    (hclose : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |G z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Z) (hZc : HasCompactSupport Z)
    (hZs : tsupport Z ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 ∩ {z : E3 | z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2})
    (hZG : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Z y i * Z y j ≤ 1) :
    ∫ z in {z : E3 | z 0 < a}, sepDensDiv G Z z ≤
      (101 / 100) * (volume (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ)).toReal

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hdet : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, 0 < (G z).det := fun z hz =>
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hpNearId_algebra (G z) (hsymm z) (hclose z hz)).1.1
  
  have hw : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) := by
    intro i
    have hZi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Z z i) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hZ
    have hdetC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1) := by
      have hfe : (fun z => (G z).det) = fun z =>
          G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
            - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
            + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0 := by
        funext z
        exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
      rw [hfe]
      exact (((((((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 2)).sub
        (((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 1))).sub
        (((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 2))).add
        (((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 0))).add
        (((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 1))).sub
        (((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 0))
    have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1) :=
      hdetC.sqrt (fun z hz => (hdet z hz).ne')
    have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1) :=
      hs.mul hZi.contDiffOn
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1
    · exact hc.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)
    · have hzt : z ∉ tsupport Z := fun h => hz (hZs h).1
      have hev : Z =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hzt
      have hev' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
        simp [hy]
      exact (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev'
  have hwc : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) := by
    intro i
    refine HasCompactSupport.mono' hZc ?_
    intro z hz
    apply subset_tsupport
    intro h
    apply hz
    simp [h]
  
  have hflux := hpHalf_flux_identity (fun i z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) a
    (fun i => (hw i).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) hwc
  have hLHS : (∫ z in {z : E3 | z 0 < a}, sepDensDiv G Z z) =
      ∫ x : E2, Real.sqrt (G (hpLift a x)).det * Z (hpLift a x) 0 := hflux
  
  have hpt : ∀ x : E2, Real.sqrt (G (hpLift a x)).det * Z (hpLift a x) 0 ≤
      (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ).indicator (fun _ => (101 / 100 : ℝ)) x := by
    intro x
    by_cases h0 : Z (hpLift a x) 0 = 0
    · rw [h0, mul_zero]
      exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => by norm_num) x
    · have hZne : Z (hpLift a x) ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 (by rw [h]; rfl)
      have hmem : hpLift a x ∈ tsupport Z := subset_tsupport _ hZne
      obtain ⟨hB, hcyl⟩ := hZs hmem
      have h1 : (hpLift a x) 1 = x 0 := by
        simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      have h2 : (hpLift a x) 2 = x 1 := by
        simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      have hn : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
          Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs]
      have hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := by
        rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]

        (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm.measurableEmbedding.comp
          (MeasurableEmbedding.prodMap (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.measurableEmbedding
            MeasurableEmbedding.id)))
  
  have hH : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | z 0 < a} :=
    (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const).measurableSet
  have hfub : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, Integrable F →
      (∫ z in {z : E3 | z 0 < a}, F z = ∫ x : E2, ∫ t in Set.Iio a, F (hpLift t x)) ∧
      (∫ z in {z : E3 | z 0 < a}, F z = ∫ t in Set.Iio a, ∫ x : E2, F (hpLift t x)) := by
    intro F hF
    have hpt : ∀ p : E2 × ℝ, {z : E3 | z 0 < a}.indicator F (hpLift p.2 p.1) =
        (Set.Iio a).indicator (fun s => F (hpLift s p.1)) p.2 := by
      intro p
      by_cases h : p.2 < a
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show hpLift p.2 p.1 ∈ {z : E3 | z 0 < a} by simp [hc0, h]),
          Set.indicator_of_mem (show p.2 ∈ Set.Iio a from h)]
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show hpLift p.2 p.1 ∉ {z : E3 | z 0 < a} by simp [hc0, h]),
          Set.indicator_of_notMem (show p.2 ∉ Set.Iio a from h)]
    have hG : Integrable (fun p : E2 × ℝ => (Set.Iio a).indicator (fun s => F (hpLift s p.1)) p.2)
        (volume.prod volume) := by
      have := (hΘ.integrable_comp_emb hemb).2 (hF.indicator hH)
      refine this.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => ?_)
      exact hpt p
    have hpull : ∫ z in {z : E3 | z 0 < a}, F z =
        ∫ p : E2 × ℝ, (Set.Iio a).indicator (fun s => F (hpLift s p.1)) p.2 ∂(volume.prod volume) := by
      rw [← integral_indicator hH, ← hΘ.integral_comp hemb]
      exact integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hpull, integral_prod _ hG]
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact integral_indicator measurableSet_Iio
    · rw [hpull, integral_prod_symm _ hG]
      have hin : ∀ t : ℝ, ∫ x : E2, (Set.Iio a).indicator (fun s => F (hpLift s x)) t =
          (Set.Iio a).indicator (fun s => ∫ x : E2, F (hpLift s x)) t := by
        intro t
        by_cases h : t < a
        · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem (show t ∈ Set.Iio a from h)]
        · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show t ∉ Set.Iio a from h)]
      simp_rw [hin]
      exact integral_indicator measurableSet_Iio
  
  have htan : ∀ v : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 v → HasCompactSupport v → ∀ (t : ℝ) (j : Fin 3), j ≠ 0 →
      ∫ x : E2, partialDeriv j v (hpLift t x) = 0 := by
    intro v hv hvc t j hj
    let L : E2 →L[ℝ] E3 := (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 1) +
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 2)
    have hL : ∀ x : E2, hpLift t x = t • e 0 + L x := by
      intro x; ext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [L, hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hdv : Differentiable ℝ v := hv.differentiable one_ne_zero
    have hfe : (fun x : E2 => v (hpLift t x)) = v ∘ (fun y : E2 => t • e 0 + L y) := by
      funext y; simp only [Function.comp, hL y]
    have hgfd : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (fun x : E2 => v (hpLift t x))
        ((fderiv ℝ v (hpLift t x)).comp L) x := by
      intro x
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => t • e 0 + L y) L x := L.hasFDerivAt.const_add _
      have h2 := (hdv (t • e 0 + L x)).hasFDerivAt
      have h3 := h2.comp x h1
      rw [hfe, hL x]
      exact h3
    have hgd : ∀ x u, fderiv ℝ (fun x : E2 => v (hpLift t x)) x u =
        fderiv ℝ v (hpLift t x) (L u) := fun x u => by
      rw [(hgfd x).fderiv]; rfl
    have hgC : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x : E2 => v (hpLift t x)) := by
      rw [hfe]; exact hv.comp (contDiff_const.add L.contDiff)
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hvc.isCompact.isBounded.subset_closedBall 0
    have hgc : HasCompactSupport (fun x : E2 => v (hpLift t x)) := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E2) R) ?_
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] at hx
      have hle : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖hpLift t x‖ := by
        nlinarith [hnorm t x, norm_nonneg x, norm_nonneg (hpLift t x), sq_nonneg t]
      apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      intro hm
      have := hR hm
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at this
      linarith
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : E2, L u = e j := by
      fin_cases j
      · exact (hj rfl).elim
      · exact ⟨e2 0, by ext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [L, e, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]⟩
      · exact ⟨e2 1, by ext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [L, e, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]⟩
    have hint_eq : (fun x => partialDeriv j v (hpLift t x)) =
        fun x => (fun _ : E2 => (1 : ℝ)) x * fderiv ℝ (fun x : E2 => v (hpLift t x)) x u := by
      funext x; rw [one_mul, hgd, hu]; rfl
    rw [hint_eq]
    have hcontg : Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun x : E2 => v (hpLift t x)) x u) :=
      (hgC.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hcsg : HasCompactSupport (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun x : E2 => v (hpLift t x)) x u) :=
      (hgc.fderiv ℝ).comp_left (g := fun T : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T u) (by simp)
    rw [integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
      (f := fun _ : E2 => (1 : ℝ)) (g := fun x : E2 => v (hpLift t x)) (v := u) ?_ ?_ ?_
      (differentiable_const _) (hgC.differentiable one_ne_zero)]
    · simp
    · simp
    · simpa using hcontg.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcsg
    · simpa using hgC.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hgc
  
  have hnor : ∀ v : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 v → HasCompactSupport v → ∀ x : E2,
      ∫ t in Set.Iio a, partialDeriv 0 v (hpLift t x) = v (hpLift a x) := by
    intro v hv hvc x
    have hA : ∀ t : ℝ, hpLift t x = t • e 0 + hpLift 0 x := by
      intro t; ext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hdv : Differentiable ℝ v := hv.differentiable one_ne_zero
    have hfe : (fun s => v (hpLift s x)) = v ∘ (fun s : ℝ => s • e 0 + hpLift 0 x) := by
      funext s; simp only [Function.comp, ← hA s]
    have hder : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => v (hpLift s x)) (partialDeriv 0 v (hpLift t x)) t := by
      intro t
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s • e 0 + hpLift 0 x) (e 0) t := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (e 0)).add_const (hpLift 0 x)
      have h2 := (hdv (t • e 0 + hpLift 0 x)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h1
      rw [hfe, hA t]
      exact h2
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hvc.isCompact.isBounded.subset_closedBall 0
    have hout : ∀ t : ℝ, R < |t| → hpLift t x ∉ tsupport v := by
      intro t ht hm
      have := hR hm
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at this
      have hle : |t| ≤ ‖hpLift t x‖ := by
        nlinarith [hnorm t x, norm_nonneg x, norm_nonneg (hpLift t x), sq_abs t, abs_nonneg t]
      linarith
    have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => partialDeriv 0 v (hpLift t x)) := by
      have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => hpLift t x) := by
        have : (fun t : ℝ => hpLift t x) = fun t => t • e 0 + hpLift 0 x := funext hA
        rw [this]; fun_prop
      exact ((hv.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).comp hc).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport (fun t : ℝ => partialDeriv 0 v (hpLift t x)) := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_Icc (a := -(|R| + 1)) (b := |R| + 1)) ?_
      intro t ht
      have ht' : R < |t| := by
        rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at ht
        rcases ht with h | h
        · rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith [abs_nonneg R])]; linarith [le_abs_self R]
        · rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith [abs_nonneg R])]; linarith [le_abs_self R]
      have : hpLift t x ∉ tsupport (fderiv ℝ v) := fun h => hout t ht' (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ h)
      simp [partialDeriv, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport this]
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun s => v (hpLift s x)) atBot (𝓝 0) := by
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_le_atBot (-(|R| + 1))] with s hs
      have : R < |s| := by
        rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith [abs_nonneg R])]; linarith [le_abs_self R]
      exact (image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (hout s this)).symm
    rw [← integral_Iic_eq_integral_Iio,
      integral_Iic_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto' (fun t _ => hder t)
        (hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs).integrableOn hlim]
    simp
  
  have hint : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Integrable (fun z => partialDeriv j (w i) z) := by
    intro i j
    have hc : Continuous (fun z => partialDeriv j (w i) z) :=
      ((hw i).continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hs : HasCompactSupport (fun z => partialDeriv j (w i) z) :=
      ((hwc i).fderiv ℝ).comp_left (g := fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T (e j)) (by simp)
    exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hs
  
  rw [integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => (hint i i).integrableOn), Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have h0 : ∫ z in {z : E3 | z 0 < a}, partialDeriv 0 (w 0) z = ∫ x : E2, w 0 (hpLift a x) := by
    rw [(hfub _ (hint 0 0)).1]
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact hnor (w 0) (hw 0) (hwc 0) x
  have h1 : ∫ z in {z : E3 | z 0 < a}, partialDeriv 1 (w 1) z = 0 := by
    rw [(hfub _ (hint 1 1)).2]
    simp [htan (w 1) (hw 1) (hwc 1) _ 1 (by decide)]
  have h2 : ∫ z in {z : E3 | z 0 < a}, partialDeriv 2 (w 2) z = 0 := by
    rw [(hfub _ (hint 2 2)).2]
    simp [htan (w 2) (hw 2) (hwc 2) _ 2 (by decide)]
  rw [h0, h1, h2]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (h0U : (0 : E3) ∈ U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hI : G 0 = 1) : ∃ ρ C : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) ρ ⊆ U ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) ρ, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖y‖

signature.name: sepMetric_lip_zero
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (h0U : (0 : E3) ∈ U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hI : G 0 = 1) : ∃ ρ C : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) ρ ⊆ U ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) ρ, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖y‖

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hU.mem_nhds h0U)
  have hρ : 0 < ε / 2 := half_pos hε
  have hB : Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (ε / 2) ⊆ U :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hε)).trans hball
  have hbound : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (ε / 2),
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ M := by
    intro i j
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j)) U :=
      (hG i j).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) (ε / 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hc.mono hB)
  choose M hM using hbound
  set C : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, max (M i j) 0 with hCdef
  have hC : 0 ≤ C :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => le_max_right _ _))
  have hMC : ∀ i j : Fin 3, M i j ≤ C := by
    intro i j
    calc M i j ≤ max (M i j) 0 := le_max_left _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j' : Fin 3, max (M i j') 0 :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j' => max (M i j') 0)
            (fun j' _ => le_max_right _ _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
      _ ≤ C :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i' => ∑ j' : Fin 3, max (M i' j') 0)
            (fun i' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j' _ => le_max_right _ _)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  refine ⟨ε / 2, C, hρ, hC, hB, ?_⟩
  intro y hy i j
  have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (ε / 2),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x := by
    intro x hx
    exact ((hG i j).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hB hx))
  have hmvt := (convex_closedBall (0 : E3) (ε / 2)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
    hdiff (hM i j) (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ.le) hy
  rw [sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt
  have h0 : G 0 i j = if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    rw [hI, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [← h0]
  exact hmvt.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMC i j) (norm_nonneg y))

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (ρ C : ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hCρ : C * ρ ≤ 1 / 12) (hball : Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) ρ ⊆ U) (hlip : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) ρ, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖y‖) : (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ ρ → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 t) < ⊤) ∧ ∀ (r r' : ℝ) (F' : Set E3), 0 < r → r < r' → r' ≤ ρ → MeasurableSet F' → symmDiff F F' ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 r') ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((1 + 4 * (C * r')) / (1 - 4 * (C * r'))) ^ 2) * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F' (Metric.ball 0 r')

signature.name: sepPerMin_euclid_quasiMin
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (ρ C : ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hCρ : C * ρ ≤ 1 / 12) (hball : Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) ρ ⊆ U) (hlip : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) ρ, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖y‖) : (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ ρ → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 t) < ⊤) ∧ ∀ (r r' : ℝ) (F' : Set E3), 0 < r → r < r' → r' ≤ ρ → MeasurableSet F' → symmDiff F F' ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 r') ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((1 + 4 * (C * r')) / (1 - 4 * (C * r'))) ^ 2) * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F' (Metric.ball 0 r')

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcmp : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ ρ → ∀ S : Set E3,
      sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (Metric.ball 0 t) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * (C * t)) / (1 - 4 * (C * t))) * sepPerG G S (Metric.ball 0 t) ∧
        sepPerG G S (Metric.ball 0 t) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * (C * t)) / (1 - 4 * (C * t))) *
            sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S (Metric.ball 0 t) := by
    intro t ht htρ S
    have hBρ : Metric.ball (0:E3) t ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 ρ :=
      Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall htρ)
    refine sepPerG_near_id_compare G (Metric.ball 0 t) (C * t) Metric.isOpen_ball
      (fun i j => (hG i j).mono (hBρ.trans hball)) (mul_nonneg hC ht.le) ?_ ?_ S
    · have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htρ hC
      linarith
    · intro y hy i j
      refine (hlip y (hBρ hy) i j).trans ?_
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hy
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy.le hC
  have hclo : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ ρ →
      IsCompact (closure (Metric.ball (0:E3) t)) ∧ closure (Metric.ball (0:E3) t) ⊆ U := by
    intro t ht htρ
    rw [closure_ball (0:E3) ht.ne']
    exact ⟨isCompact_closedBall 0 t, (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall htρ).trans hball⟩
  refine ⟨fun t ht htρ => ?_, fun r r' F' hr hrr' hr'ρ hF' hsd => ?_⟩
  · have h1 := hmin.2.1 (Metric.ball 0 t) Metric.isOpen_ball (hclo t ht htρ).1 (hclo t ht htρ).2
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hcmp t ht htρ F).1 (ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top h1)
  · have hr' : 0 < r' := hr.trans hrr'
    have h3 := hmin.2.2 F' (Metric.ball 0 r') (Metric.closedBall 0 r) hF' Metric.isOpen_ball
      (hclo r' hr' hr'ρ).1 (hclo r' hr' hr'ρ).2 (isCompact_closedBall 0 r)
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hrr') hsd
    have hCr : C * r' ≤ C * ρ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr'ρ hC
    have hCr0 : 0 ≤ C * r' := mul_nonneg hC hr'.le
    have hl0 : 0 ≤ (1 + 4 * (C * r')) / (1 - 4 * (C * r')) :=
      div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
    calc sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 r')
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * (C * r')) / (1 - 4 * (C * r'))) *
            sepPerG G F (Metric.ball 0 r') := (hcmp r' hr' hr'ρ F).1
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * (C * r')) / (1 - 4 * (C * r'))) *
            sepPerG G F' (Metric.ball 0 r') := by gcongr
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * (C * r')) / (1 - 4 * (C * r'))) *
            (ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * (C * r')) / (1 - 4 * (C * r'))) *
              sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F' (Metric.ball 0 r')) := by
          gcongr
          exact (hcmp r' hr' hr'ρ F').2
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (((1 + 4 * (C * r')) / (1 - 4 * (C * r'))) ^ 2) *
            sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F' (Metric.ball 0 r') := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hl0, sq]

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerG_near_id_compare
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (η : ℝ) (hV : IsOpen V) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V) (hη0 : 0 ≤ η) (hη : η ≤ 1 / 12) (hclose : ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η) (S : Set E3) : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η)) * sepPerG G S V ∧ sepPerG G S V ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + 4 * η) / (1 - 4 * η)) * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V

informal_problem.statement: (F : Set E3) (hF : MeasurableSet F) (a b r r' K κ : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hba : b < a) (har : a < r) (hrr' : r < r') (hκ0 : 0 < κ) (hκ1 : κ < 1) (hK : (r ^ 2 - b ^ 2) / (r ^ 2 - a ^ 2) < K) : ∃ F' : Set E3, MeasurableSet F' ∧ symmDiff F F' ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r ∧ sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F' (Metric.ball 0 r') ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((b / a) ^ 2) * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 a) + ENNReal.ofReal K * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F {y : E3 | (1 - κ) * a < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r'}

signature.name: sepCone_competitor_bound
signature.statement: (F : Set E3) (hF : MeasurableSet F) (a b r r' K κ : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hba : b < a) (har : a < r) (hrr' : r < r') (hκ0 : 0 < κ) (hκ1 : κ < 1) (hK : (r ^ 2 - b ^ 2) / (r ^ 2 - a ^ 2) < K) : ∃ F' : Set E3, MeasurableSet F' ∧ symmDiff F F' ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r ∧ sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F' (Metric.ball 0 r') ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((b / a) ^ 2) * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 a) + ENNReal.ofReal K * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F {y : E3 | (1 - κ) * a < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r'}

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have ha : 0 < a := hb.trans hba
  have hr0 : 0 < r := ha.trans har
  have hr'0 : 0 < r' := hr0.trans hrr'
  have hKpos : 0 < K := by
    have h1 : 0 < r ^ 2 - b ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h2 : 0 < r ^ 2 - a ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    exact lt_trans (div_pos h1 h2) hK
  obtain ⟨P, hPs, hPpos, hPin, hPd0, hP1, hPb⟩ :=
    sepRadialProfile_inv_exists a b r K hb hba har hK
  obtain ⟨hΦs, hinj, hfix, hprop, hk, hnorm⟩ :=
    sepRadial_map_props P r hr0.le hPs hPpos hP1 (fun u hu => (hPb u hu).2.1)
  have hdet : ∀ y : E3, 0 < (jacMat (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y).det := by
    intro y
    rw [(sepRadial_jac_adj_bound P hPs y).1]
    exact mul_pos (hPpos _) (hPb _ (sq_nonneg _)).2.1
  have hnorm' : ∀ y : E3, ‖(fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y‖ = ‖y‖ * P (‖y‖ ^ 2) := hnorm
  have hfix' : ∀ y : E3, r ≤ ‖y‖ → (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y = y := hfix
  
  have hκa0 : 0 ≤ (1 - κ) * a := mul_nonneg (by linarith) ha.le
  have hka : a * P (a ^ 2) = b := by
    rw [hPin _ le_rfl]
    field_simp
  have hkκ : (1 - κ) * a * P (((1 - κ) * a) ^ 2) = (1 - κ) * b := by
    have hle : (1 - κ) * a ≤ a := by nlinarith
    have hsq : ((1 - κ) * a) ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hκa0 hle 2
    rw [hPin _ hsq]
    field_simp
  have hkr : r * P (r ^ 2) = r := by rw [hP1 _ le_rfl, mul_one]
  have hkr' : r' * P (r' ^ 2) = r' := by
    have hsq : r ^ 2 ≤ r' ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr0.le hrr'.le 2
    rw [hP1 _ hsq, mul_one]
  
  have hF' : MeasurableSet ((fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) '' F) :=
    hF.image_of_continuousOn_injOn hΦs.continuous.continuousOn hinj.injOn
  have hsd : symmDiff F ((fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) '' F) ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
    by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    rw [Set.mem_symmDiff] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨hxF, hxF'⟩ | ⟨hxF', hxF⟩
    · exact hxF' ⟨x, hxF, hfix' x hlt.le⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hyF, hyx⟩ := hxF'
      by_cases hy : r ≤ ‖y‖
      · rw [hfix' y hy] at hyx
        rw [← hyx] at hxF
        exact hxF hyF
      · push_neg at hy
        have h1 := hnorm' y
        rw [hyx] at h1
        have h2 : ‖y‖ * P (‖y‖ ^ 2) < r * P (r ^ 2) :=
          hk (Set.mem_Ici.2 (norm_nonneg y)) (Set.mem_Ici.2 hr0.le) hy
        linarith
  
  have hmonoV : ∀ (S V V' : Set E3), V ⊆ V' →
      sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V ≤
        sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) S V' := by
    intro S V V' hVV'
    unfold sepPerG
    apply iSup₂_le
    intro X hX
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le X ⟨hX.1, hX.2.1, hX.2.2.1.trans hVV', hX.2.2.2⟩ le_rfl
  have hcov : Metric.ball (0 : E3) r' ⊆
      Metric.ball 0 b ∪ {y : E3 | (1 - κ) * b < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r'} := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hx
    by_cases h : ‖x‖ < b
    · left
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
      exact h
    · right
      push_neg at h
      refine ⟨?_, hx⟩
      nlinarith
  have hAnnOpen : IsOpen {y : E3 | (1 - κ) * b < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r'} :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const)
  have hunion := sepPerG_union_le (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) Set.univ
    ((fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) '' F) (Metric.ball 0 b)
    {y : E3 | (1 - κ) * b < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r'} isOpen_univ
    (fun i j => contDiffOn_const) (fun y _ => by simp) hF' Metric.isOpen_ball hAnnOpen
    (Set.subset_univ _) (Set.subset_univ _)
  
  have hVWin : (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) ⁻¹' Metric.ball 0 b ⊆ Metric.ball 0 a := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : ‖(fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y‖ < b := mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hy
    rw [hnorm' y] at hy'
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have h : a * P (a ^ 2) ≤ ‖y‖ * P (‖y‖ ^ 2) :=
      hk.monotoneOn (Set.mem_Ici.2 ha.le) (Set.mem_Ici.2 (norm_nonneg y)) hc
    linarith
  have hin : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) a, ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      ∑ c : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
        (jacMat (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y).adjugate c i * v i) ^ 2 ≤
        ((b / a) ^ 2) ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 := by
    intro y hy v
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hy
    have hu : ‖y‖ ^ 2 < a ^ 2 := by
      have := norm_nonneg y
      nlinarith
    have h1 : P (‖y‖ ^ 2) = b / a := hPin _ hu.le
    have h2 : deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2) = 0 := hPd0 _ hu
    have hab : 0 < b / a := div_pos hb ha
    refine (sepRadial_jac_adj_bound P hPs y).2 ((b / a) ^ 2) ?_ ?_ ?_ v
    · exact le_of_eq (by rw [h1])
    · rw [h1, h2]
      positivity
    · rw [h1, h2]
      exact le_of_eq (by ring)
  have hinner := sepPerG_piola_image (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) hΦs hinj hdet hprop F
    (Metric.ball 0 b) (Metric.ball 0 a) hF hVWin ((b / a) ^ 2) (by positivity) hin
  
  have hVWout : (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) ⁻¹' {y : E3 | (1 - κ) * b < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r'} ⊆
      {y : E3 | (1 - κ) * a < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r'} := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : (1 - κ) * b < ‖(fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y‖ ∧
        ‖(fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y‖ < r' := hy
    rw [hnorm' y] at hy'
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have h : ‖y‖ * P (‖y‖ ^ 2) ≤ (1 - κ) * a * P (((1 - κ) * a) ^ 2) :=
        hk.monotoneOn (Set.mem_Ici.2 (norm_nonneg y)) (Set.mem_Ici.2 hκa0) hc
      linarith [hy'.1]
    · by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have h : r' * P (r' ^ 2) ≤ ‖y‖ * P (‖y‖ ^ 2) :=
        hk.monotoneOn (Set.mem_Ici.2 hr'0.le) (Set.mem_Ici.2 (norm_nonneg y)) hc
      linarith [hy'.2]
  have hout : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | (1 - κ) * a < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r'}, ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      ∑ c : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3,
        (jacMat (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y).adjugate c i * v i) ^ 2 ≤
        K ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 := by
    intro y _ v
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hPb (‖y‖ ^ 2) (sq_nonneg _)
    exact (sepRadial_jac_adj_bound P hPs y).2 K h1 h2.le h3 v
  have houter := sepPerG_piola_image (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) hΦs hinj hdet hprop F
    {y : E3 | (1 - κ) * b < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r'} {y : E3 | (1 - κ) * a < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r'} hF
    hVWout K hKpos hout
  
  refine ⟨(fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) '' F, hF', hsd, ?_⟩
  calc sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
        ((fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) '' F) (Metric.ball 0 r')
      ≤ sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
        ((fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) '' F)
        (Metric.ball 0 b ∪ {y : E3 | (1 - κ) * b < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r'}) := hmonoV _ _ _ hcov
    _ ≤ _ := hunion
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add hinner houter

subgoal_signatures.statement: (P : ℝ → ℝ) (hP : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P) (y : E3) : (jacMat (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y).det = P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 * deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2))) ∧ ∀ M : ℝ, P (‖y‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ M → 0 ≤ P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 * deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2)) → P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 * deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2)) ≤ M → ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y).adjugate a i * v i) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: sepRadial_map_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: (P : ℝ → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hP : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P) (hPpos : ∀ u, 0 < P u) (hP1 : ∀ u, r ^ 2 ≤ u → P u = 1) (hmono : ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → 0 < P u * (P u + 2 * u * deriv P u)) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ∧ Function.Injective (fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ∧ (∀ y : E3, r ≤ ‖y‖ → P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y = y) ∧ (∀ S : Set E3, IsCompact S → IsCompact ((fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ⁻¹' S)) ∧ StrictMonoOn (fun s : ℝ => s * P (s ^ 2)) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ ∀ y : E3, ‖P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y‖ = ‖y‖ * P (‖y‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: sepRadialProfile_inv_exists
subgoal_signatures.statement: (a b r K : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hba : b < a) (har : a < r) (hK : (r ^ 2 - b ^ 2) / (r ^ 2 - a ^ 2) < K) : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ P ∧ (∀ u, 0 < P u) ∧ (∀ u, u ≤ a ^ 2 → P u = b / a) ∧ (∀ u, u < a ^ 2 → deriv P u = 0) ∧ (∀ u, r ^ 2 ≤ u → P u = 1) ∧ ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → P u ^ 2 ≤ K ∧ 0 < P u * (P u + 2 * u * deriv P u) ∧ P u * (P u + 2 * u * deriv P u) ≤ K

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerG_union_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U E A B : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (hAU : A ⊆ U) (hBU : B ⊆ U) :
    sepPerG G E (A ∪ B) ≤ sepPerG G E A + sepPerG G E B

      (𝓝[>] (0:ℝ)) (𝓝 (r / 2)) := by
    have := ((((tendsto_const_nhds (x := r ^ 2)).sub (hid.pow 2)).div
      ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := 2 * r)).sub hid) h2r0).add (hid.pow 2)).mul
      (((tendsto_const_nhds (x := (1:ℝ))).add (hid.mul (tendsto_const_nhds (x := r)))).sub
        (hid.pow 2))
    have e : ((r ^ 2 - 0 ^ 2) / (2 * r - 0) + 0 ^ 2) * (1 + 0 * r - 0 ^ 2) = r / 2 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rwa [e] at this
  have hq : Filter.Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε / (r - ε)) ^ 2 * p (r - ε)) (𝓝[>] (0:ℝ)) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hr0' : r - 0 ≠ 0 := by simp [hr0]
    have := ((hid.div ((tendsto_const_nhds (x := r)).sub hid) hr0').pow 2).mul
      (hd.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hrt)
    simpa using this
  have hlam' : Filter.Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => lam (r + ε ^ 2)) (𝓝[>] (0:ℝ)) (𝓝 (lam r)) :=
    hlam.tendsto.comp hxt
  have hlim := hlam'.mul (hq.add ((hα.mul hSx).add (hβ.mul hSy)))
  have hfin := ge_of_tendsto hlim hev
  have e : lam r * (0 + (0 * d + r / 2 * d)) = lam r * r * d / 2 := by ring
  rw [e] at hfin
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (m : ℝ → ℝ) (R C : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hmono : Monotone m) (hnn : ∀ t, 0 ≤ m t) (hder : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < R → ∀ d : ℝ, HasDerivAt m d t → 2 * m t ≤ (1 + C * t) * t * d) : ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ t → t < R → Real.exp (2 * C * s) * m s / s ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (2 * C * t) * m t / t ^ 2
