signature.statement: (m : ℝ → ℝ) (R C : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hmono : Monotone m) (hnn : ∀ t, 0 ≤ m t) (hder : ∀ t, 0 < t → t < R → ∀ d : ℝ, HasDerivAt m d t → 2 * m t ≤ (1 + C * t) * t * d) : ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ t → t < R → Real.exp (2 * C * s) * m s / s ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (2 * C * t) * m t / t ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro s t hs hst htR
  have ht : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le hs hst
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hnn s) with h0 | hms
  · rw [← h0, mul_zero, zero_div]
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (hnn t)) (sq_nonneg t)
  have hpos : ∀ x, s ≤ x → 0 < m x := fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hms (hmono hx)
  have hmt : 0 < m t := hpos t hst
  have hu : Set.uIcc s t = Set.Icc s t := Set.uIcc_of_le hst
  have hfmono : MonotoneOn (fun u => Real.log (m u)) (Set.uIcc s t) := by
    rw [hu]
    intro u hu' v _ huv
    exact Real.log_le_log (hpos u hu'.1) (hmono huv)
  have hg : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc s t,
      HasDerivAt (fun u => 2 * Real.log u - 2 * C * u) ((fun u => 2 * u⁻¹ - 2 * C) x) x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hu] at hx
    have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := (lt_of_lt_of_le hs hx.1).ne'
    have h := ((Real.hasDerivAt_log hx0).const_mul 2).sub ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul (2 * C))
    convert h using 1
    simp
  have hg'c : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => 2 * u⁻¹ - 2 * C) (Set.uIcc s t) := by
    rw [hu]
    apply ContinuousOn.sub _ continuousOn_const
    apply ContinuousOn.mul continuousOn_const
    apply ContinuousOn.inv₀ continuousOn_id
    intro x hx
    exact (lt_of_lt_of_le hs hx.1).ne'
  have hint_g' : IntervalIntegrable (fun u : ℝ => 2 * u⁻¹ - 2 * C) MeasureTheory.volume s t :=
    hg'c.intervalIntegrable
  have hint_f : IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun u => Real.log (m u))) MeasureTheory.volume s t :=
    hfmono.intervalIntegrable_deriv
  have hFTC : ∫ x in s..t, (fun u : ℝ => 2 * u⁻¹ - 2 * C) x =
      (fun u => 2 * Real.log u - 2 * C * u) t - (fun u => 2 * Real.log u - 2 * C * u) s :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hg hint_g'
  have hmem := hfmono.intervalIntegral_deriv_mem_uIcc
  have hfst : Real.log (m s) ≤ Real.log (m t) := Real.log_le_log hms (hmono hst)
  rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (sub_nonneg.mpr hfst)] at hmem
  have hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂MeasureTheory.volume, x ∈ Set.Icc s t →
      (fun u : ℝ => 2 * u⁻¹ - 2 * C) x ≤ deriv (fun u => Real.log (m u)) x := by
    filter_upwards [hmono.ae_differentiableAt] with x hx hxI
    have hx0 : 0 < x := lt_of_lt_of_le hs hxI.1
    have hxR : x < R := lt_of_le_of_lt hxI.2 htR
    have hmx : 0 < m x := hpos x hxI.1
    have hd := hx.hasDerivAt
    have hle := hder x hx0 hxR (deriv m x) hd
    have hlog : HasDerivAt (fun u => Real.log (m u)) (deriv m x / m x) x := hd.log hmx.ne'
    rw [hlog.deriv]
    show 2 * x⁻¹ - 2 * C ≤ deriv m x / m x
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hmx]
    have hxP : 0 < x * (1 + C * x) := by positivity
    have hxinv : x * x⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hx0.ne'
    have key : (2 * x⁻¹ - 2 * C) * m x * (x * (1 + C * x)) ≤ deriv m x * (x * (1 + C * x)) := by
      have e : (2 * x⁻¹ - 2 * C) * m x * (x * (1 + C * x)) = (2 - 2 * C ^ 2 * x ^ 2) * m x := by
        linear_combination (2 * m x * (1 + C * x)) * hxinv
      rw [e]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (C * x)) hmx.le]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right key hxP
  have hcmp : ∫ x in s..t, (fun u : ℝ => 2 * u⁻¹ - 2 * C) x ≤
      ∫ x in s..t, deriv (fun u => Real.log (m u)) x :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mono_ae_restrict hst hint_g' hint_f
      ((MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Icc).2 hae)
  have hlog : (2 * Real.log t - 2 * C * t) - (2 * Real.log s - 2 * C * s) ≤
      Real.log (m t) - Real.log (m s) := by
    have := hcmp.trans hmem.2
    rw [hFTC] at this
    simpa using this
  have hX : 0 < Real.exp (2 * C * s) * m s / s ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hY : 0 < Real.exp (2 * C * t) * m t / t ^ 2 := by positivity
  rw [← Real.log_le_log_iff hX hY]
  have hes : 0 < Real.exp (2 * C * s) * m s := by positivity
  have het : 0 < Real.exp (2 * C * t) * m t := by positivity
  rw [Real.log_div hes.ne' (pow_ne_zero 2 hs.ne'), Real.log_div het.ne' (pow_ne_zero 2 ht.ne'),
    Real.log_mul (Real.exp_pos _).ne' hms.ne', Real.log_mul (Real.exp_pos _).ne' hmt.ne',
    Real.log_exp, Real.log_exp, Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
  push_cast
  linarith

by
  
  have hST1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
  have hSTd : Differentiable ℝ Real.smoothTransition := hST1.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hvan : ∀ x ∉ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, deriv Real.smoothTransition x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · have hev : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds hx)
          (fun y hy => Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hy))
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    · have hev : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (1:ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hx)
          (fun y hy => Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (le_of_lt hy))
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
  obtain ⟨K, hK0, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, |deriv Real.smoothTransition x| ≤ K := by
    have hcont : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) := hST1.continuous_deriv le_rfl
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport (deriv Real.smoothTransition) :=
      HasCompactSupport.intro isCompact_Icc hvan
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hcs.exists_bound_of_continuous hcont
    exact ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x => by
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (hC x).trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩
  refine ⟨24 * K, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro h hh0 hh1
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = (1 / 4 + h / 3) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = (1 / 4 + 2 * h / 3) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD : h / 6 ≤ B - A := by rw [hA, hB]; nlinarith
  have hDpos : 0 < B - A := by linarith
  have hB1 : B < 1 := by rw [hB]; nlinarith
  have hBR : B < (1 / 4 + h) ^ 2 := by rw [hB]; nlinarith
  have hA64 : 1 / 64 < A := by rw [hA]; nlinarith
  
  set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.smoothTransition ((B - s) / (B - A)) with hgdef
  have hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g :=
    Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id).div_const _)
  have hg01 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ g s ∧ g s ≤ 1 := fun s =>
    ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
  have hg1 : ∀ s, s ≤ A → g s = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hDpos]; linarith
  have hg0 : ∀ s, B ≤ s → g s = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hDpos]; linarith
  have hgd : ∀ s, HasDerivAt g
      (deriv Real.smoothTransition ((B - s) / (B - A)) * (-1 / (B - A))) s := by
    intro s
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (B - s) / (B - A)) (-1 / (B - A)) s :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id' s).const_sub B).div_const (B - A)
    exact (hSTd _).hasDerivAt.comp s h1
  have hgdb : ∀ s, |deriv Real.smoothTransition ((B - s) / (B - A)) * (-1 / (B - A))|
      ≤ K / (B - A) := by
    intro s
    rw [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_neg, abs_one, abs_of_pos hDpos, mul_one_div]
    gcongr
    exact hK _
  have hgd0 : ∀ s, B < s →
      deriv Real.smoothTransition ((B - s) / (B - A)) * (-1 / (B - A)) = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    have : (B - s) / (B - A) < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith) hDpos
    rw [hvan _ (fun hm => absurd hm.1 (not_le.mpr this)), zero_mul]
  
  refine ⟨fun z => g (z 0 ^ 2) * g (z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z i) := fun i =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    exact (hgs.comp ((hc 0).pow 2)).mul (hgs.comp (((hc 1).pow 2).add ((hc 2).pow 2)))
  · intro z
    exact ⟨mul_nonneg (hg01 _).1 (hg01 _).1, mul_le_one₀ (hg01 _).2 (hg01 _).1 (hg01 _).2⟩
  · intro z hz1 hz0
    have h0 : z 0 ^ 2 < A := by
      rw [hA]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (z 0), sq_abs (z 0)]
    show g (z 0 ^ 2) * g (z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2) = 1
    rw [hg1 _ h0.le, hg1 _ (by rw [hA]; exact hz1.le), one_mul]
  · have hT : IsClosed {z : E3 | z 0 ^ 2 ≤ B ∧ z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 ≤ B} := by
      rw [Set.setOf_and]
      exact (isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const).inter
        (isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
    refine (closure_minimal ?_ hT).trans ?_
    · intro z hz
      have hz' : g (z 0 ^ 2) * g (z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2) ≠ 0 := hz
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · by_contra hc
        exact hz' (by rw [hg0 _ (le_of_lt (not_le.mp hc)), zero_mul])
      · by_contra hc
        exact hz' (by rw [hg0 _ (le_of_lt (not_le.mp hc)), mul_zero])
    · rintro z ⟨h0, h12⟩
      refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
      exact abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · intro z hz
    have hz0 : z 0 ^ 2 < A := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (z 0), sq_abs (z 0)]
    have hN : {w : E3 | w 0 ^ 2 < A} ∈ 𝓝 z :=
      (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const).mem_nhds hz0
    have hev : (fun w : E3 => g (w 0 ^ 2) * g (w 1 ^ 2 + w 2 ^ 2)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        fun w => g (w 1 ^ 2 + w 2 ^ 2) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hN (fun w hw => by
        show g (w 0 ^ 2) * g (w 1 ^ 2 + w 2 ^ 2) = g (w 1 ^ 2 + w 2 ^ 2)
        rw [hg1 _ (le_of_lt hw), one_mul])
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    set q' : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := (2 * z 1) • (EuclideanSpace.proj 1 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) +
      (2 * z 2) • (EuclideanSpace.proj 2 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) with hq'
    have hP : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun w : E3 => w i)
        (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) z := fun i =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have hq : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E3 => w 1 ^ 2 + w 2 ^ 2) q' z := by
      have h1 := ((hP 1).mul (hP 1)).add ((hP 2).mul (hP 2))
      convert h1 using 1
      · funext w
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply]
        ring
      · rw [hq']; ext v; simp; ring
    have hcomp := (hgd (z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2)).comp_hasFDerivAt z hq
    rw [show (fun w : E3 => g (w 1 ^ 2 + w 2 ^ 2)) = g ∘ (fun w : E3 => w 1 ^ 2 + w 2 ^ 2)
      from rfl, hcomp.fderiv, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    by_cases hqB : B < z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2
    · rw [hgd0 _ hqB, abs_zero, zero_mul]; positivity
    · push_neg at hqB
      have hz1 : |z 1| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z 2), sq_nonneg (z 1 - 1), sq_nonneg (z 1 + 1)]
      have hz2 : |z 2| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z 1), sq_nonneg (z 2 - 1), sq_nonneg (z 2 + 1)]
      have hq'4 : ‖q'‖ ≤ 4 := by
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by norm_num) (fun v => ?_)
        have hv1 : |v 1| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
          have := PiLp.norm_apply_le v 1; rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        have hv2 : |v 2| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
          have := PiLp.norm_apply_le v 2; rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        have hval : q' v = 2 * z 1 * v 1 + 2 * z 2 * v 2 := by rw [hq']; simp
        rw [hval, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        calc |2 * z 1 * v 1 + 2 * z 2 * v 2|
            ≤ |2 * z 1 * v 1| + |2 * z 2 * v 2| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = 2 * (|z 1| * |v 1|) + 2 * (|z 2| * |v 2|) := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two]; ring
          _ ≤ 2 * (1 * ‖v‖) + 2 * (1 * ‖v‖) := by
              gcongr
          _ = 4 * ‖v‖ := by ring
      calc |deriv Real.smoothTransition ((B - (z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2)) / (B - A)) * (-1 / (B - A))|
            * ‖q'‖ ≤ K / (B - A) * 4 :=
            mul_le_mul (hgdb _) hq'4 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ K / (h / 6) * 4 := by
            gcongr
        _ = 24 * K / h := by field_simp; ring

    {g | 1 / 16 < g 0 ^ 2 + g 1 ^ 2 ∧ g 0 ^ 2 + g 1 ^ 2 < (1 / 4 + h) ^ 2} with hA'

    have h2 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 4) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg x) hxD 2

    linarith
  have hsub : A ∪ Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (1 / 4) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (1 / 4 + h) := by

      have h1 := hnsq x
      have h3 := hx.2

    · intro x hx

      linarith
  have hunion : volume A + ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 16) * V ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (h / 2 + h ^ 2) * V + ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 16) * V := by
    rw [← hD, ← measure_union hdisj measurableSet_closedBall, hD, ← add_mul,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
    have : h / 2 + h ^ 2 + 1 / 16 = (1 / 4 + h) ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [this, ← hBR]
    exact measure_mono hsub
  have hAle : volume A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (h / 2 + h ^ 2) * V :=
    ENNReal.le_of_add_le_add_right (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hVfin) hunion
  
  have hba : 0 ≤ b - a := sub_nonneg.2 hab
  have hRHS : ENNReal.ofReal ((b - a) * (8 * h + 16 * h ^ 2)) *
      volume (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 4)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (b - a) * (ENNReal.ofReal (h / 2 + h ^ 2) * V) := by
    have hX : 0 ≤ (b - a) * (8 * h + 16 * h ^ 2) := mul_nonneg hba (by positivity)
    rw [hball, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hX, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hba]
    congr 2
    ring
  rw [hS, hRHS, ← hAA']

signature.name: fsvht_approx_circle
signature.statement:
∀ (u : ℂ → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
    ContinuousOn u (Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r) →
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ F : Polynomial ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = r →
      |u z - (Polynomial.eval z F).re| ≤ ε

proof.tactics:
by
  intro u r hr hu ε hε
  
  have hmono : ∀ (a b : ℂ) (m n : ℕ), ∃ R : Polynomial ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = r →
      (a * z ^ m).re * (b * z ^ n).re = (Polynomial.eval z R).re := by
    intro a b m n
    have hzz : ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = r → z * (starRingEnd ℂ) z = (r : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq, hz]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hpol1 : ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℂ,
        w₁.re * w₂.re = ((w₁ * w₂).re + (w₁ * (starRingEnd ℂ) w₂).re) / 2 := by
      intro w₁ w₂
      simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
      ring
    have hpol2 : ∀ w₁ w₂ : ℂ,
        w₁.re * w₂.re = ((w₁ * w₂).re + ((starRingEnd ℂ) w₁ * w₂).re) / 2 := by
      intro w₁ w₂
      simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.conj_re, Complex.conj_im]
      ring
    rcases le_or_gt n m with hnm | hmn
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnm
      refine ⟨Polynomial.C (a * b / 2) * Polynomial.X ^ (n + k + n) +
        Polynomial.C (a * (starRingEnd ℂ) b * ((r : ℂ) ^ 2) ^ n / 2) * Polynomial.X ^ k, ?_⟩
      intro z hz
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]
      rw [hpol1]
      have e1 : a * z ^ (n + k) * (b * z ^ n) =
          a * b / 2 * z ^ (n + k + n) + a * b / 2 * z ^ (n + k + n) := by ring
      have e2 : a * z ^ (n + k) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (b * z ^ n) =
          a * (starRingEnd ℂ) b * ((r : ℂ) ^ 2) ^ n / 2 * z ^ k +
          a * (starRingEnd ℂ) b * ((r : ℂ) ^ 2) ^ n / 2 * z ^ k := by
        rw [map_mul, map_pow, ← hzz z hz]
        ring
      rw [e1, e2]
      simp only [Complex.add_re]
      ring
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hmn.le
      refine ⟨Polynomial.C (a * b / 2) * Polynomial.X ^ (m + (m + k)) +
        Polynomial.C ((starRingEnd ℂ) a * b * ((r : ℂ) ^ 2) ^ m / 2) * Polynomial.X ^ k, ?_⟩
      intro z hz
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]
      rw [hpol2]
      have e1 : a * z ^ m * (b * z ^ (m + k)) =
          a * b / 2 * z ^ (m + (m + k)) + a * b / 2 * z ^ (m + (m + k)) := by ring
      have e2 : (starRingEnd ℂ) (a * z ^ m) * (b * z ^ (m + k)) =
          (starRingEnd ℂ) a * b * ((r : ℂ) ^ 2) ^ m / 2 * z ^ k +
          (starRingEnd ℂ) a * b * ((r : ℂ) ^ 2) ^ m / 2 * z ^ k := by
        rw [map_mul, map_pow, ← hzz z hz]
        ring
      rw [e1, e2]
      simp only [Complex.add_re]
      ring
  
  have hmul : ∀ P Q : Polynomial ℂ, ∃ R : Polynomial ℂ, ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = r →
      (Polynomial.eval z P).re * (Polynomial.eval z Q).re = (Polynomial.eval z R).re := by
    intro P
    induction P using Polynomial.induction_on' with
    | add p q hp hq =>
      intro Q
      obtain ⟨R₁, h₁⟩ := hp Q
      obtain ⟨R₂, h₂⟩ := hq Q
      refine ⟨R₁ + R₂, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [Polynomial.eval_add, Complex.add_re, add_mul, h₁ z hz, h₂ z hz,
        Polynomial.eval_add, Complex.add_re]
    | monomial m a =>
      intro Q
      induction Q using Polynomial.induction_on' with
      | add p q hp hq =>
        obtain ⟨R₁, h₁⟩ := hp
        obtain ⟨R₂, h₂⟩ := hq
        refine ⟨R₁ + R₂, fun z hz => ?_⟩
        rw [Polynomial.eval_add (p := p) (q := q), Complex.add_re, mul_add, h₁ z hz, h₂ z hz,
          Polynomial.eval_add, Complex.add_re]
      | monomial n b =>
        obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hmono a b m n
        refine ⟨R, fun z hz => ?_⟩
        rw [Polynomial.eval_monomial, Polynomial.eval_monomial]
        exact hR z hz
  
  let A : Subalgebra ℝ C(Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r, ℝ) :=
    { carrier := {g | ∃ F : Polynomial ℂ, ∀ x : Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r,
          g x = (Polynomial.eval (x : ℂ) F).re}
      mul_mem' := by
        rintro g₁ g₂ ⟨F₁, h₁⟩ ⟨F₂, h₂⟩
        obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hmul F₁ F₂
        refine ⟨R, fun x => ?_⟩
        rw [ContinuousMap.mul_apply, h₁, h₂]
        exact hR x (mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp x.2)
      one_mem' := ⟨Polynomial.C 1, fun x => by simp⟩
      add_mem' := by
        rintro g₁ g₂ ⟨F₁, h₁⟩ ⟨F₂, h₂⟩
        refine ⟨F₁ + F₂, fun x => ?_⟩
        rw [ContinuousMap.add_apply, h₁, h₂, Polynomial.eval_add, Complex.add_re]
      zero_mem' := ⟨0, fun x => by simp⟩
      algebraMap_mem' := fun c => ⟨Polynomial.C (c : ℂ), fun x => by
        simp [algebraMap_apply]⟩ }
  have hmemA : ∀ g : C(Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r, ℝ), g ∈ A ↔
      ∃ F : Polynomial ℂ, ∀ x : Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r,
        g x = (Polynomial.eval (x : ℂ) F).re := fun g => Iff.rfl
  
  have hsep : A.SeparatesPoints := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hxy' : (x : ℂ) ≠ (y : ℂ) := fun h => hxy (Subtype.ext h)
    by_cases hre : (x : ℂ).re = (y : ℂ).re
    · have him : (x : ℂ).im ≠ (y : ℂ).im := fun h => hxy' (Complex.ext hre h)
      let gIm : C(Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r, ℝ) :=
        ⟨fun p => (p : ℂ).im, Complex.continuous_im.comp continuous_subtype_val⟩
      have hgIm : gIm ∈ A := by
        rw [hmemA]
        refine ⟨Polynomial.C (-Complex.I) * Polynomial.X, fun p => ?_⟩
        simp [gIm]
      exact ⟨gIm, ⟨gIm, hgIm, rfl⟩, him⟩
    · let gRe : C(Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r, ℝ) :=
        ⟨fun p => (p : ℂ).re, Complex.continuous_re.comp continuous_subtype_val⟩
      have hgRe : gRe ∈ A := by
        rw [hmemA]
        refine ⟨Polynomial.X, fun p => ?_⟩
        simp [gRe]
      exact ⟨gRe, ⟨gRe, hgRe, rfl⟩, hre⟩
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := ContinuousMap.exists_mem_subalgebra_near_continuous_of_separatesPoints A hsep
    ((Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r).restrict u) hu.restrict ε hε
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := (hmemA g).mp g.2
  refine ⟨F, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have hzS : z ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) r := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr hz
  have h1 := hg ⟨z, hzS⟩
  rw [hF, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_sub_comm] at h1
  exact h1.le

signature.name: fsvht_carath_coeff
signature.statement:
∀ (F : Polynomial ℂ) (r M : ℝ), 0 < r →
    (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ = r → |(Polynomial.eval z F).re| ≤ M) →
    ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ‖F.coeff n‖ * r ^ n ≤ 2 * M

proof.tactics:
by
  intro F r M hr hF n hn
  
  have rootsum : ∀ (om : ℂ) (N m : ℕ), IsPrimitiveRoot om N →
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (om ^ m) ^ j = if N ∣ m then (N : ℂ) else 0 := by
    intro om N m hom
    split_ifs with h
    · have h1 : om ^ m = 1 := (hom.pow_eq_one_iff_dvd m).mpr h
      simp [h1]
    · have h1 : om ^ m ≠ 1 := fun h' => h ((hom.pow_eq_one_iff_dvd m).mp h')
      have h2 : (om ^ m) ^ N = 1 := by
        rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, hom.pow_eq_one, one_pow]
      have h3 := geom_sum_mul (om ^ m) N
      rw [h2, sub_self] at h3
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr h1)
  set N := F.natDegree + n + 1 with hN
  have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by omega
  set om := Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / N) with hom
  have hprim : IsPrimitiveRoot om N := Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp N hN0
  have hnorm : ‖om‖ = 1 := hprim.norm'_eq_one hN0
  have hne : om ≠ 0 := hprim.ne_zero hN0
  have hconj : (starRingEnd ℂ) om = om ^ (N - 1) := by
    have h1 : om * (starRingEnd ℂ) om = 1 := by
      rw [Complex.mul_conj', hnorm]; simp
    have h2 : om * om ^ (N - 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ N), hprim.pow_eq_one]
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hne (h1.trans h2.symm)
  have hgeom : ∀ m : ℕ, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (om ^ m) ^ j = if N ∣ m then (N : ℂ) else 0 :=
    fun m => rootsum om N m hprim
  
  have hH : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, Polynomial.eval ((r : ℂ) * om ^ j) F * (om ^ (N - n)) ^ j
      = (N : ℂ) * (F.coeff n * (r : ℂ) ^ n) := by
    have hdeg : F.natDegree < N := by omega
    have hnN : n < N := by omega
    have step : ∀ j, Polynomial.eval ((r : ℂ) * om ^ j) F * (om ^ (N - n)) ^ j
        = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, F.coeff k * (r : ℂ) ^ k * (om ^ (k + (N - n))) ^ j := by
      intro j
      rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' hdeg, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      ring
    simp_rw [step]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hgeom]
    have key : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range N,
        (F.coeff k * (r : ℂ) ^ k * if N ∣ k + (N - n) then (N : ℂ) else 0)
          = if k = n then (N : ℂ) * (F.coeff n * (r : ℂ) ^ n) else 0 := by
      intro k hk
      have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      by_cases hkn : k = n
      · subst hkn
        have hd : N ∣ k + (N - k) := by rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hnN.le]
        rw [if_pos hd, if_pos rfl]; ring
      · rw [if_neg hkn]
        have hnd : ¬ N ∣ k + (N - n) := by
          rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
          rcases Nat.lt_or_ge c 2 with hc2 | hc2
          · interval_cases c
            · simp at hc; omega
            · simp at hc; omega
          · have : N * c ≥ N * 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hc2
            omega
        rw [if_neg hnd, mul_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl key, Finset.sum_ite_eq' (Finset.range N) n,
      if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mpr hnN)]
  
  have hA : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
      (starRingEnd ℂ) (Polynomial.eval ((r : ℂ) * om ^ j) F) * (om ^ (N - n)) ^ j = 0 := by
    have step : ∀ j, (starRingEnd ℂ) (Polynomial.eval ((r : ℂ) * om ^ j) F) * (om ^ (N - n)) ^ j
        = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (F.natDegree + 1),
            (starRingEnd ℂ) (F.coeff k) * (r : ℂ) ^ k * (om ^ ((N - 1) * k + (N - n))) ^ j := by
      intro j
      rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range, map_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      rw [map_mul, map_pow, map_mul, map_pow, Complex.conj_ofReal, hconj]
      ring
    simp_rw [step]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hgeom]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_
    have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
    have hnd : ¬ N ∣ (N - 1) * k + (N - n) := by
      have hid : (N - 1) * k + (N - n) = (N - (k + n)) + N * k := by
        have e1 : (N - 1) * k + k = N * k := by
          rw [Nat.sub_one_mul, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left k (by omega))]
        omega
      rw [hid, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left,
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
      omega
    rw [if_neg hnd, mul_zero]
  
  have hRe : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
      (((Polynomial.eval ((r : ℂ) * om ^ j) F).re : ℝ) : ℂ) * (om ^ (N - n)) ^ j
        = (N : ℂ) / 2 * (F.coeff n * (r : ℂ) ^ n) := by
    have hsplit : ∀ j, (((Polynomial.eval ((r : ℂ) * om ^ j) F).re : ℝ) : ℂ) * (om ^ (N - n)) ^ j
        = (Polynomial.eval ((r : ℂ) * om ^ j) F * (om ^ (N - n)) ^ j
          + (starRingEnd ℂ) (Polynomial.eval ((r : ℂ) * om ^ j) F) * (om ^ (N - n)) ^ j) / 2 := by
      intro j
      rw [Complex.re_eq_add_conj]; ring
    simp_rw [hsplit]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib, hH, hA]; ring
  
  have hbound : ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
      (((Polynomial.eval ((r : ℂ) * om ^ j) F).re : ℝ) : ℂ) * (om ^ (N - n)) ^ j‖ ≤ N * M := by
    calc _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N,
          ‖(((Polynomial.eval ((r : ℂ) * om ^ j) F).re : ℝ) : ℂ) * (om ^ (N - n)) ^ j‖ :=
          norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, M := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
        rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_pow, hnorm, one_pow, one_pow, mul_one, Complex.norm_real,
          Real.norm_eq_abs]
        apply hF
        rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, hnorm, one_pow, mul_one, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hr.le]
      _ = N * M := by simp
  rw [hRe] at hbound
  have hcalc : ‖(N : ℂ) / 2 * (F.coeff n * (r : ℂ) ^ n)‖ = (N : ℝ) / 2 * (‖F.coeff n‖ * r ^ n) := by
    rw [norm_mul, norm_div, norm_mul, norm_pow, Complex.norm_natCast, Complex.norm_of_nonneg hr.le]
    norm_num
  rw [hcalc] at hbound
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hN0
  have h2 : (N : ℝ) * (‖F.coeff n‖ * r ^ n) ≤ N * (2 * M) := by linarith
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h2 hNpos

by
  intro x a _ha0 ha2
  set φ : ℝ → ℝ := (Set.Iio (1 : ℝ)).indicator (fun r : ℝ => r ^ (-a)) with hφ

      ((Set.Iio (1 : ℝ)).indicator (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (1 - a))) (Set.Ioi 0) := by

    by_cases h1 : y < 1
    · have hm : y ∈ Set.Iio (1 : ℝ) := h1
      simp only [hφ, Set.indicator_of_mem hm]
      rw [show (1 - a) = 1 + (-a) by ring, Real.rpow_add hy0, Real.rpow_one]
    · have hm : y ∉ Set.Iio (1 : ℝ) := h1
      simp only [hφ, Set.indicator_of_notMem hm, mul_zero]
  have hgi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (1 - a)) (Set.Ioo 0 1) :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioo_of_le zero_le_one).1
      (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_rpow' (by linarith))
  have hHint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      ((Set.Iio (1 : ℝ)).indicator (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (1 - a))) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn, MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_Iio,
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_restrict measurableSet_Iio,
      Set.Iio_inter_Ioi]
    exact hgi
  have hFint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => y * φ y) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
    hHint.congr_fun hEq.symm measurableSet_Ioi
  have hFval : (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), y * φ y) = 1 / (2 - a) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi hEq,
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Iio, Set.Ioi_inter_Iio,
      ← MeasureTheory.integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo,

      integral_rpow (Or.inl (by linarith))]
    have h2a : (2 - a) ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [show 1 - a + 1 = 2 - a by ring, Real.one_rpow, Real.zero_rpow h2a]

  have hfin : Module.finrank ℝ E2 = 2 := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
  have hrad : (fun y : ℝ => y ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E2 - 1) • φ y) = fun y : ℝ => y * φ y := by
    funext y
    rw [hfin]
    simp

    rw [MeasureTheory.integrable_fun_norm_addHaar MeasureTheory.volume, hrad]
    exact hFint
  have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume] fun z : E2 => φ ‖z‖ := by

      exact Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg z) _
    · have hm : ‖z‖ ∉ Set.Iio (1 : ℝ) := h

  have hval : (∫ z : E2, φ ‖z‖) = 2 * Real.pi / (2 - a) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_fun_norm_addHaar MeasureTheory.volume φ, hrad, hFval, hfin,
      MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, EuclideanSpace.volume_ball_fin_two, ENNReal.ofReal_one,
      one_pow, one_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal Real.pi_pos.le]
    have h2a : (2 - a) ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
    push_cast
    ring
  
  have htrans : (∫⁻ y in Metric.ball x 1, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - y‖ ^ (-a))) =
      ∫⁻ z : E2, ENNReal.ofReal (φ ‖z‖) := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator measurableSet_ball]

by
  intro K g ψ c hK hg hgc hc hψ

      ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h → ∀ x : E2,
      HasFDerivAt (fun u => ∫ y in K, h (u - y)) (∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ h (x - y)) x := by

    refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (μ := volume.restrict K)
      (F := fun u y => h (u - y)) (F' := fun u y => fderiv ℝ h (u - y)) (x₀ := x)

        (hcont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)

      rw [convolution_def, ← integral_indicator hK.measurableSet]
      congr 1

  have hψd : ∀ u, HasFDerivAt ψ (c • ∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ g (u - y)) u := by
    intro u
    rw [hψeq]

    (hDgcont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  
  have hpart : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (x : E2),
      fderiv ℝ (fun u => fderiv ℝ ψ u (e2 i)) x (e2 i) =

    intro i x
    have hi1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun w => fderiv ℝ g w (e2 i)) := hDg.clm_apply contDiff_const
    have hic : HasCompactSupport (fun w => fderiv ℝ g w (e2 i)) := hgc.fderiv_apply ℝ (e2 i)

      hi1.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)

        fun u => c * ∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ g (u - y) (e2 i) := by
      funext u
      rw [hfd]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply (hint1 u)]
    rw [hstep1]
    have hd := (hA (fun w => fderiv ℝ g w (e2 i)) hi1 hic x).const_mul c
    rw [hd.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hint2 : Integrable (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ g w (e2 i)) (x - y))
        (volume.restrict K) :=
      (hicont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hint2]
  refine ⟨?_, fun x => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [hψeq]
    exact contDiff_const.mul hsmooth
  · rw [hfd]
    refine (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le c (∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ g (x - y))).trans ?_
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) hc
  · simp only [hpart]
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, integral_finset_sum]
    intro i _
    have hi1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun w => fderiv ℝ g w (e2 i)) := hDg.clm_apply contDiff_const
    have hicont : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ g w (e2 i))) :=
      hi1.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)
    exact ((hicont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).clm_apply
      continuous_const).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  · rw [hHess x]
    refine (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le c
      (∫ y in K, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (x - y))).trans ?_
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) hc

proof.tactics:
by
  intro K g x s hKc hg hs0 hK1 hup hball
  have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hKc.measurableSet
  have hGc : Continuous (fun y : E2 => g (x - y)) := hg.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)
  have hPc : Continuous (fun y : E2 => max (g (x - y)) 0) := hGc.max continuous_const
  have hGi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y : E2 => g (x - y)) K :=
    hGc.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hKc
  have hPi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y : E2 => max (g (x - y)) 0) K :=
    hPc.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hKc
  have hKsub : K ⊆ Metric.ball x 1 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]
    exact hK1 y hy
  have hs : 0 < s ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hs0 _
  have h2 : (∫ y in K, g (x - y)) ≤ ∫ y in K, max (g (x - y)) 0 :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hGi hPi hKm (fun y _ => le_max_left _ _)
  have h3 : (∫ y in K, max (g (x - y)) 0) =
      (∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal (max (g (x - y)) 0)).toReal :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => le_max_right _ _)) hPi.aestronglyMeasurable
  have h4 : ∀ᵐ y ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K),
      ENNReal.ofReal (max (g (x - y)) 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - y‖ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) := by
    have hne : ∀ᵐ y ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K), y ≠ x :=
      MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_ae (MeasureTheory.Measure.ae_ne _ x)
    have hmem : ∀ᵐ y ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K), y ∈ K :=
      MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem hKm
    filter_upwards [hne, hmem] with y hyx hyK
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    have hw0 : x - y ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hyx)
    have hb := hup (x - y) hw0 (hK1 y hyK)
    have hH0 : 0 ≤ ‖x - y‖ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
    exact max_le (by linarith) hH0
  have h5 : (∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal (max (g (x - y)) 0)) ≤
      ∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - y‖ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) :=
    MeasureTheory.lintegral_mono_ae h4
  have h6 : (∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - y‖ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)))) ≤
      ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball x 1, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - y‖ ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))) :=
    MeasureTheory.lintegral_mono_set hKsub
  have h7 : (∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal (max (g (x - y)) 0)).toReal ≤ 4 * Real.pi / 3 :=
    ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by positivity) (h5.trans (h6.trans hball))
  rw [h3] at h2
  exact h2.trans h7

        (1 / 4) * ‖w‖ ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ)) ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  intro K g x ρ hKc hg hρ hKx hB hball
  have hK : MeasurableSet K := hKc.measurableSet
  have hpos : ∀ y ∈ K, 0 < ‖x - y‖ := fun y hy => lt_trans hρ (hKx y hy).1
  have hint : ∀ p : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun y => ‖x - y‖ ^ p) K := by
    intro p
    apply ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact hKc
    exact ContinuousOn.rpow_const ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).norm.continuousOn)
      (fun y hy => Or.inl (ne_of_gt (hpos y hy)))
  have I3 := hint (-(3 / 2 : ℝ))
  have I5 := hint (-(5 / 2 : ℝ))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hA : (∫ y in K, ‖fderiv ℝ g (x - y)‖) ≤
        ∫ y in K, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
      apply integral_mono_of_nonneg
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall
          (fun y => (norm_nonneg (fderiv ℝ g (x - y)) : _))
      · exact I3.const_mul (1 / 2)
      · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hK
          (fun y hy => (hB (x - y) (hKx y hy).1 (hKx y hy).2).1)
    rw [integral_const_mul] at hA
    have hC : (∫ y in K, ‖x - y‖ ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ))) =
        (∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - y‖ ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)))).toReal :=
      integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))
        I3.aestronglyMeasurable
    have hsub : K ⊆ Metric.ball x 1 := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]
      exact (hKx y hy).2
    have hD : (∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - y‖ ^ (-(3 / 2 : ℝ)))) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (4 * Real.pi) :=
      (lintegral_mono_set hsub).trans hball
    have hE := ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by positivity) hD
    rw [← hC] at hE
    linarith
  · refine ⟨∫ y in K, ‖x - y‖ ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ)), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : (∫ y in K, (1 : ℝ)) ≤ ∫ y in K, ‖x - y‖ ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ)) := by
        apply setIntegral_mono_on (continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hKc) I5 hK
        intro y hy
        exact Real.one_le_rpow_of_pos_of_le_one_of_nonpos (hpos y hy) (hKx y hy).2.le
          (by norm_num)
      rw [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, measureReal_def] at h1
      exact h1
    · rw [setIntegral_congr_fun hK
        (fun y hy => (hB (x - y) (hKx y hy).1 (hKx y hy).2).2.1), integral_const_mul]

            · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall

            · exact I5.const_mul (7 / 4)
            · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hK
                (fun y hy => (hB (x - y) (hKx y hy).1 (hKx y hy).2).2.2)
        _ = (7 / 4) * ∫ y in K, ‖x - y‖ ^ (-(5 / 2 : ℝ)) := integral_const_mul _ _

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (v ψ : E2 → ℝ) (Λ₀ β₀ : ℝ) (z : E2) (R : ℝ) (O : Set E2),
    LowerSemicontinuousOn v (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2)) →
    (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), 0 ≤ v x) → hpSuperSol v Λ₀ β₀ →
    Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2) → 0 ≤ R → ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ →
    (∀ x, dist x z = R → ψ x ≤ 0) →
    (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall z R, x ∈ O → ψ x ≤ v x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z R, x ∉ O → ‖fderiv ℝ ψ x‖ ≤ Λ₀ ∧
      β₀ * (1 + ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x‖) <
        ∑ i : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ψ y (e2 i)) x (e2 i)) →
    ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall z R, ψ x ≤ v x

signature.statement:
∀ (v ψ : E2 → ℝ) (Λ₀ β₀ : ℝ) (z : E2) (R : ℝ) (O : Set E2),
    LowerSemicontinuousOn v (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2)) →
    (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2), 0 ≤ v x) → hpSuperSol v Λ₀ β₀ →
    Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2) → 0 ≤ R → ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ →
    (∀ x, dist x z = R → ψ x ≤ 0) →
    (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall z R, x ∈ O → ψ x ≤ v x) →
    (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z R, x ∉ O → ‖fderiv ℝ ψ x‖ ≤ Λ₀ ∧
      β₀ * (1 + ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x‖) <
        ∑ i : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ψ y (e2 i)) x (e2 i)) →
    ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall z R, ψ x ≤ v x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro v ψ Λ₀ β₀ z R O hlsc hv0 hss hBD hR hψ hsph hO hout
  have hcpt : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall z R) := isCompact_closedBall z R
  have hne : (Metric.closedBall z R).Nonempty := ⟨z, Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR⟩
  have hF : LowerSemicontinuousOn (fun x => v x + -ψ x) (Metric.closedBall z R) := by
    have h1 : LowerSemicontinuousOn v (Metric.closedBall z R) := hlsc.mono hBD
    have h2 : LowerSemicontinuousOn (fun x => -ψ x) (Metric.closedBall z R) :=
      (hψ.continuous.neg.lowerSemicontinuous).lowerSemicontinuousOn _
    exact h1.add h2
  obtain ⟨xs, hxs, hmin⟩ := hF.exists_isMinOn hne hcpt
  rw [isMinOn_iff] at hmin
  set m : ℝ := v xs - ψ xs with hm
  have hspade : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall z R, ψ x + m ≤ v x := by
    intro x hx
    have := hmin x hx
    simp only at this
    rw [hm]
    linarith
  have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := by
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    have hlt : v xs < ψ xs := by rw [hm] at hneg; linarith
    have hxD : xs ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (1 / 2) := hBD hxs
    have hd : dist xs z ≤ R := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hxs
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hd with hlt' | heq
    · have hxb : xs ∈ Metric.ball z R := Metric.mem_ball.mpr hlt'
      by_cases hxO : xs ∈ O
      · have := hO xs hxs hxO
        linarith
      · obtain ⟨hgrad, hstrict⟩ := hout xs hxb hxO
        have hsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ψ x + m) := hψ.add contDiff_const
        have hev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 xs, (fun x => ψ x + m) x ≤ v x := by
          apply Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hxb)
          intro x hx
          exact hspade x (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx)
        have heqv : (fun x => ψ x + m) xs = v xs := by
          simp only [hm]; ring
        have hDf : fderiv ℝ (fun x => ψ x + m) = fderiv ℝ ψ := by
          funext y
          exact fderiv_add_const _
        have hg' : ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => ψ x + m) xs‖ ≤ Λ₀ := by
          rw [hDf]; exact hgrad
        have key := hss (fun x => ψ x + m) hsm xs hxD hev heqv hg'
        rw [hDf] at key
        linarith
    · have h1 := hsph xs heq
      have h2 := hv0 xs hxD
      linarith
  intro x hx
  have := hspade x hx
  linarith

signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hfin : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) : ∃ (μ : Measure E3) (ν : E3 → E3), (∀ r : ℝ, μ (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) ∧ Measurable ν ∧ (∀ x, ‖ν x‖ = 1) ∧ (∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X → ∫ y in K, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X y = ∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) ∂μ) ∧ (∀ V : Set E3, IsOpen V → μ V = sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K V)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hF1 : ∀ (X : E3 → E3) (y : E3),
      sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X y =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => X z i) y := by
    intro X y
    simp only [sepDensDiv, Matrix.det_one, Real.sqrt_one, one_mul]
  
  have hF2 : ∀ v : E3,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j * v i * v j = ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
    simp [Matrix.one_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, sq]
  have hadm : ∀ v : E3,
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j * v i * v j ≤ 1) ↔
        ‖v‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro v
    rw [hF2]
    have h0 := norm_nonneg v
    constructor
    · intro h; nlinarith
    · intro h; nlinarith
  
  have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∃ μp μm : Measure E3, (∀ r : ℝ, μp (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, μm (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) ∧
      ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
        ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y = (∫ x, φ x ∂μp) - ∫ x, φ x ∂μm := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨hadd, hsmul, hbd⟩ := sepGG_component_functional K hK hfin i
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ, hΛbd⟩ :=
      sepGG_order0_extend (fun φ => ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y) hadd hsmul hbd
    obtain ⟨μp, μm, hp, hm, hrep⟩ := sepGG_riesz_signed Λ hΛbd
    refine ⟨μp, μm, hp, hm, fun φ hφ hφc => ?_⟩
    let f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ := ⟨⟨φ, hφ.continuous⟩, hφc⟩
    have h1 : Λ f = ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y := hΛ f hφ
    have h2 : Λ f = (∫ x, φ x ∂μp) - ∫ x, φ x ∂μm := hrep f
    rw [← h1, h2]
  choose μp μm hp hm hrep using hcomp
  obtain ⟨μ, ν, hμ, hνm, hν1, hpol⟩ := sepGG_polar μp μm hp hm
  
  have hGG : ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X →
      ∫ y in K, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X y =
        ∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) ∂μ := by
    intro X hX hXc
    have hXi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) := fun i => contDiff_euclidean.mp hX i
    have hXic : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (fun z => X z i) := fun i =>
      hXc.comp_left (g := fun v : E3 => v i) rfl
    have hint : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => X z i) y) := by
      intro i
      apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      · exact ((hXi i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
      · exact (hXic i).fderiv_apply ℝ (e i)
    rw [← hpol X hX.continuous hXc]
    rw [integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => hF1 X y))]
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hint i).integrableOn)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hrep i _ (hXi i) (hXic i))
  refine ⟨μ, ν, hμ, hνm, hν1, hGG, ?_⟩
  
  intro V hV
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (sepGG_dual_norm μ hμ ν hνm hν1 V hV).trans ?_
    refine iSup₂_le (fun X hX => ?_)

by
  
  have t1 : μ.map (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ 2) =

    have hqm : Measurable (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ 2) := (continuous_norm.pow 2).measurable
    set v : ℝ → ENNReal := fun s => if s ≤ 0 then 0 else ENNReal.ofReal (c * s) with hv
    have h1 : ∀ s, μ.map (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ 2) (Set.Iio s) = v s := by
      intro s
      rw [Measure.map_apply hqm measurableSet_Iio]
      by_cases hs : s ≤ 0
      · have : (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ 2) ⁻¹' Set.Iio s = ∅ := by

        have : (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ 2) ⁻¹' Set.Iio s = Metric.ball 0 (Real.sqrt s) := by
          ext x

        rw [this, hball _ (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hs), Real.sq_sqrt hs.le]

    have h2 : ∀ s, (ENNReal.ofReal c • (volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Ioi 0)) (Set.Iio s)
        = v s := by
      intro s
      rw [Measure.smul_apply, Measure.restrict_apply measurableSet_Iio, smul_eq_mul]
      by_cases hs : s ≤ 0
      · have : Set.Iio s ∩ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) = ∅ := by
          ext x
          simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_Iio, Set.mem_Ioi, Set.mem_empty_iff_false,
            iff_false, not_and, not_lt]
          intro h
          linarith
        rw [this, measure_empty, mul_zero]
        simp [hv, hs]
      · push_neg at hs
        have : Set.Iio s ∩ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) = Set.Ioo 0 s := by
          ext x
          simp [and_comm]

    · intro a b hab

    have hq : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ x) x :=

    have hs : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => ψ (‖z‖ ^ 2)) (deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) • (2 • innerSL ℝ x)) x :=

    have hTd : HasFDerivAt T (ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 +

      exact hs.smul (hasFDerivAt_id x)
    have hTw : ∀ w, fderiv ℝ T x w

      intro w
      rw [hTd.fderiv]
      simp
      ring_nf
    have hpi : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => T z i) x = (fderiv ℝ T x (e i)) i := by
      intro i
      have h := ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt).comp x hTd
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [show (fun z => T z i) = (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ T from rfl, h.fderiv,
        hTd.fderiv]
      rfl
    have hdiv : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => T z i) x
        = 3 * ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) + 2 * deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp only [hpi, hTw]
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
      ring
    have hnor : @inner ℝ E3 _ v (fderiv ℝ T x v)
        = ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) + 2 * deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) * (@inner ℝ E3 _ x v) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hTw, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right,

      ring

    ring
  
  have t3 : ∀ b : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => expNegInvGlue (b - s)) ∧

      (∀ s : ℝ, b < s → deriv (fun s : ℝ => expNegInvGlue (b - s)) s = 0) ∧
      (∀ s : ℝ, s < b → deriv (fun s : ℝ => expNegInvGlue (b - s)) s < 0) ∧

    · exact (expNegInvGlue.contDiff (n := ⊤)).comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)
    · intro s hs
      exact expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
    · intro s hs
      have : (fun s : ℝ => expNegInvGlue (b - s)) =ᶠ[𝓝 s] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by

        exact expNegInvGlue.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)

      linarith
    · intro s
      apply Antitone.deriv_nonpos
      exact expNegInvGlue.monotone.comp_antitone (fun x y h => sub_le_sub_left h b)
  
  have t4 : ∀ (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (b : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → (∀ s : ℝ, b ≤ s → ψ s = 0) →

      rw [hzero s hs.le, hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
      ring

  have hP : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖x‖ ^ 2 < (n : ℝ) + 1 → @inner ℝ E3 _ x (ν x) = 0 := by
    intro n
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = (n : ℝ) + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ψ = fun s => expNegInvGlue (b - s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    have hdc : Continuous (deriv ψ) := hψ1.continuous_deriv le_rfl
    have hψc : Continuous ψ := hψ1.continuous
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = b + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hR0 : 0 < R := by linarith
    have hstar : ∀ x : E3, R ≤ ‖x‖ → b < ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by

    have hTc : HasCompactSupport (fun z : E3 => ψ (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) := by
      apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0:E3) R)
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] at hx
      show ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) • x = 0
      rw [hψ0 _ (hstar x hx.le).le, zero_smul]
    have hint0 := hFV _ hTs hTc
    have hI : ∀ x, (∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => (fun z : E3 => ψ (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) z i) x

        = 2 * (ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) + ‖x‖ ^ 2 * deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2))

    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := R ^ 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn

        (fun x : E3 => -(2 * deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) * (@inner ℝ E3 _ x (ν x)) ^ 2)) μ := by
      have hm : Measurable
          (fun x : E3 => -(2 * deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) * (@inner ℝ E3 _ x (ν x)) ^ 2)) :=

            mul_le_mul hd (hi2.trans hx2) (sq_nonneg _) hD0
