    have hf1zero : ∫ x, 2 * (ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) + ‖x‖ ^ 2 * deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2)) ∂μ = 0 := by
      have hm : ∫ x, 2 * (ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) + ‖x‖ ^ 2 * deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2)) ∂μ
          = ∫ s, 2 * (ψ s + s * deriv ψ s) ∂(μ.map (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ 2)) :=
        (integral_map (continuous_norm.pow 2).measurable.aemeasurable
          hGc.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
      rw [hm, t1, integral_smul_measure, integral_const_mul, t4 ψ b hψ1 hψ0, mul_zero, smul_zero]
    have hsum : ∫ x, (2 * (ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) + ‖x‖ ^ 2 * deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2))
        + -(2 * deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) * (@inner ℝ E3 _ x (ν x)) ^ 2)) ∂μ = 0 := by
      rw [← hint0]
      congr 1
      funext x
      exact (hI x).symm
    rw [integral_add hint1 hint2, hf1zero, zero_add] at hsum
    have hnn : (0 : E3 → ℝ) ≤
        fun x : E3 => -(2 * deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) * (@inner ℝ E3 _ x (ν x)) ^ 2) := by
      intro x
      have := hψle (‖x‖ ^ 2)
      have := sq_nonneg (@inner ℝ E3 _ x (ν x))
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply]
      nlinarith
    have hae := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg hnn hint2).1 hsum
    filter_upwards [hae] with x hx hxb
    have hd : deriv ψ (‖x‖ ^ 2) < 0 := hψneg _ (by rw [hb]; exact hxb)
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hx
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 (neg_eq_zero.1 hx) with h | h
    · exfalso
      linarith
    · exact (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).1 h
  
  have hall := ae_all_iff.2 hP
  filter_upwards [hall] with x hx
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (‖x‖ ^ 2)
  exact hx n (by linarith)

informal_problem.statement: (K : Set E3) (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hflux : ∀ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∫ y in K, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (fun z => ψ z • z) y = 0) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} K) = 0

signature.name: sepCone_of_radial_flux
signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hflux : ∀ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∫ y in K, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (fun z => ψ z • z) y = 0) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} K) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (φ : E3 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
      ∫ z in {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K}, φ z = t⁻¹ ^ 3 * ∫ y in K, φ (t⁻¹ • y) := by
    intro φ t ht
    have hKt : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} := hK.preimage (measurable_const_smul t)
    rw [← integral_indicator hKt, ← integral_indicator hK]
    have hpt : ∀ z : E3, Set.indicator {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} φ z =
        K.indicator (fun y => φ (t⁻¹ • y)) (t • z) := by
      intro z
      by_cases hz : t • z ∈ K
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show z ∈ {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} from hz),
          Set.indicator_of_mem hz, inv_smul_smul₀ ht.ne']
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show z ∉ {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} from hz),
          Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
    simp_rw [hpt]
    rw [Measure.integral_comp_smul volume (fun y => K.indicator (fun y => φ (t⁻¹ • y)) y) t]
    rw [finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity),
      inv_pow]
  
  have s2 : ∀ (φ : E3 → ℝ), Differentiable ℝ φ → ∀ (s : ℝ) (y : E3),
      sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (fun z => φ (s • z) • z) y
        = 3 * φ (s • y) + s * fderiv ℝ φ (s • y) y := by
    intro φ hφ s y
    have hψ : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => φ (s • z))
        ((fderiv ℝ φ (s • y)).comp (s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)) y := by
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => s • z) (s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3) y :=
        (hasFDerivAt_id y).const_smul s
      exact (hφ (s • y)).hasFDerivAt.comp y h1
    have hi : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => φ (s • z) * z i) y
        = φ (s • y) + s * fderiv ℝ φ (s • y) (e i) * y i := by
      intro i
      have hproj : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => z i) (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
      have hprod : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => φ (s • z) * z i)
          (φ (s • y) • (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) +
            y i • (fderiv ℝ φ (s • y)).comp (s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)) y :=
        hψ.mul hproj
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hprod.fderiv]
      simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      ring
    have hy : ∑ i : Fin 3, y i • e i = y := by
      have := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr y
      simpa [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr] using this
    have hL : fderiv ℝ φ (s • y) y = ∑ i : Fin 3, y i * fderiv ℝ φ (s • y) (e i) := by
      calc fderiv ℝ φ (s • y) y = fderiv ℝ φ (s • y) (∑ i : Fin 3, y i • e i) := by rw [hy]
        _ = _ := by simp [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [sepDensDiv]
    simp only [Matrix.det_one, Real.sqrt_one, one_mul, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [hi, hL, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have s3 : ∀ (φ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 3 * ∫ y in K, φ (r • y))
        (s ^ 2 * ∫ y in K, (3 * φ (s • y) + s * fderiv ℝ φ (s • y) y)) s := by
    intro φ hφ hφc s hs
    have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ φ := hφ.differentiable (by simp)
    have hcfd : Continuous (fderiv ℝ φ) := hφ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
    obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀⟩ : ∃ R₀ : ℝ, tsupport φ ⊆ closedBall 0 R₀ :=
      (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0).1 hφc.isCompact.isBounded
    set R : ℝ := max R₀ 0 with hRdef
    have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := le_max_right _ _
    have hRsupp : tsupport φ ⊆ closedBall 0 R :=
      hR₀.trans (closedBall_subset_closedBall (le_max_left _ _))
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ φ x‖ ≤ M :=
      hcfd.bounded_above_of_compact_support (hφc.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ))
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hM 0)
    set ρ : ℝ := 2 * R / s with hρdef
    have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ := by positivity
    have hρs : s / 2 * ρ = R := by rw [hρdef]; field_simp
    set μ : Measure E3 := volume.restrict K with hμ
    set bound : E3 → ℝ := (closedBall (0 : E3) ρ).indicator (fun _ => M * ρ) with hbound
    have hF_meas : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝 s, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y : E3 => φ (r • y)) μ :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall
        (fun r => (hφ.continuous.comp (continuous_const_smul r)).aestronglyMeasurable)
    have hF_int : Integrable (fun y : E3 => φ (s • y)) μ :=
      ((hφ.continuous.comp (continuous_const_smul s)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hφc.comp_smul hs.ne')).integrableOn
    have hF'_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y : E3 => fderiv ℝ φ (s • y) y) μ :=
      ((hcfd.comp (continuous_const_smul s)).clm_apply continuous_id).aestronglyMeasurable
    have h_bound : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ∀ r ∈ ball s (s / 2), ‖fderiv ℝ φ (r • y) y‖ ≤ bound y := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y r hr => ?_)
      rw [mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hr
      have hr' : s / 2 < r := by
        have := (abs_lt.1 hr).1
        linarith
      have hrpos : 0 < r := by linarith
      by_cases hy : ‖y‖ ≤ ρ
      · rw [hbound, Set.indicator_of_mem (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 hy)]
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans
          (mul_le_mul (hM _) hy (norm_nonneg _) hM0)
      · push_neg at hy
        have hnot : r • y ∉ tsupport φ := by
          intro hmem
          have h1 := mem_closedBall_zero_iff.1 (hRsupp hmem)
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hrpos] at h1
          nlinarith [mul_pos hrpos (sub_pos.2 hy), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hr'.le) hρ0]
        have h0 : fderiv ℝ φ (r • y) = 0 := by
          by_contra h
          exact hnot (support_fderiv_subset ℝ (Function.mem_support.2 h))
        rw [h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, norm_zero, hbound,
          Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => by
            have := mem_closedBall_zero_iff.1 h
            linarith)]
    have bound_int : Integrable bound μ :=
      ((integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_closedBall).2
        (integrableOn_const measure_closedBall_lt_top.ne)).restrict
    have h_diff : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ∀ r ∈ ball s (s / 2),
        HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => φ (r • y)) (fderiv ℝ φ (r • y) y) r := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y r _ => ?_)
      have h := (hdiff (r • y)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt r ((hasDerivAt_id r).smul_const y)
      simpa using h
    obtain ⟨hint', hderiv⟩ := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
      (μ := μ) (F := fun r y => φ (r • y)) (F' := fun r y => fderiv ℝ φ (r • y) y)
      (ball_mem_nhds s (half_pos hs)) hF_meas hF_int hF'_meas h_bound bound_int h_diff
    have hprod := (hasDerivAt_pow 3 s).mul hderiv
    convert hprod using 1
    rw [integral_add (hF_int.const_mul 3) (hint'.const_mul s), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul]
    norm_num
    ring
  
  intro t ht
  have hKt : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} := hK.preimage (measurable_const_smul t)
  have key : ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      ∫ z in {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K}, φ z = ∫ z in K, φ z := by
    intro φ hφ hφc
    have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ φ := hφ.differentiable (by simp)
    have hH0 : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => r ^ 3 * ∫ y in K, φ (r • y)) 0 r := by
      intro r hr
      have hr' : 0 < r := hr
      have h3 := s3 φ hφ hφc r hr'
      have hint : ∫ y in K, (3 * φ (r • y) + r * fderiv ℝ φ (r • y) y) = 0 := by
        have h := hflux (fun z => φ (r • z)) (hφ.comp (contDiff_const_smul r))
          (hφc.comp_smul hr'.ne')
        refine Eq.trans ?_ h
        refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
        exact (s2 φ hdiff r y).symm
      rw [hint, mul_zero] at h3
      exact h3
    have hconst := IsOpen.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero isOpen_Ioi isPreconnected_Ioi
      (fun r hr => (hH0 r hr).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
      (fun r hr => (hH0 r hr).deriv) (inv_pos.2 ht) (one_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
    rw [s1 φ t ht]
    simpa only [one_pow, one_mul, one_smul] using hconst
  
  set f : E3 → ℝ := fun x => Set.indicator {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x -
    K.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x with hfdef
  have hf : LocallyIntegrable f volume :=
    ((locallyIntegrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator hKt).sub
      ((locallyIntegrable_const (1 : ℝ)).indicator hK)
  have hzero : ∀ g : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → HasCompactSupport g → ∫ x, g x • f x = 0 := by
    intro g hg hgc
    have hgi : Integrable g := hg.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hgc
    have e1 : (fun x => g x • f x) =
        fun x => Set.indicator {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} g x - K.indicator g x := by
      funext x
      simp only [hfdef, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub]
      have a1 : ∀ S : Set E3, g x * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x = S.indicator g x := by
        intro S
        by_cases h : x ∈ S
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h, Set.indicator_of_mem h, mul_one]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h, Set.indicator_of_notMem h, mul_zero]
      rw [a1, a1]
    rw [e1, integral_sub (hgi.indicator hKt) (hgi.indicator hK), integral_indicator hKt,
      integral_indicator hK, key g hg hgc, sub_self]
  have hae := ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero hf hzero
  rw [ae_iff] at hae
  refine measure_mono_null ?_ hae
  intro x hx
  rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · show f x ≠ 0
    rw [hfdef]
    simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem h2]
    norm_num
  · show f x ≠ 0
    rw [hfdef]
    simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem h2]
    norm_num

informal_problem.statement: (K : Set E3) (v : E3) (hcone : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} K) = 0) (hv : ∀ s : ℝ, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • v ∈ K} K) = 0) : (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z + s • v), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0)

signature.name: sepMeasBdry_invariant
signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (v : E3) (hcone : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} K) = 0) (hv : ∀ s : ℝ, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • v ∈ K} K) = 0) : (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z + s • v), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have T : ∀ (f : E3 → E3) (z : E3), Continuous f →
      (∀ S : Set E3, volume S = 0 → volume (f ⁻¹' S) = 0) →
      volume (symmDiff (f ⁻¹' K) K) = 0 →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) →
      ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (f z), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro f z hf hnull hD hz N hN
    have hN' : f ⁻¹' N ∈ 𝓝 z := hf.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hN
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := hz (f ⁻¹' N) hN'
    refine ⟨fun h0 => hA ?_, fun h0 => hB ?_⟩
    · have h1 : volume (f ⁻¹' (N ∩ K)) = 0 := hnull _ h0
      have hsub : f ⁻¹' N ∩ K ⊆ f ⁻¹' (N ∩ K) ∪ symmDiff (f ⁻¹' K) K := by
        intro x hx
        by_cases hfx : f x ∈ K
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hx.1, hfx⟩
        · refine Or.inr ?_
          rw [Set.mem_symmDiff]
          exact Or.inr ⟨hx.2, hfx⟩
      exact MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null hsub (MeasureTheory.measure_union_null h1 hD)
    · have h1 : volume (f ⁻¹' (N \ K)) = 0 := hnull _ h0
      have hsub : f ⁻¹' N \ K ⊆ f ⁻¹' (N \ K) ∪ symmDiff (f ⁻¹' K) K := by
        intro x hx
        by_cases hfx : f x ∈ K
        · refine Or.inr ?_
          rw [Set.mem_symmDiff]
          exact Or.inl ⟨hfx, hx.2⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hx.1, hfx⟩
      exact MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null hsub (MeasureTheory.measure_union_null h1 hD)
  refine ⟨fun t ht z hz => ?_, fun s z hz => ?_⟩
  · have hnull : ∀ S : Set E3, volume S = 0 → volume ((fun x : E3 => t • x) ⁻¹' S) = 0 := by
      intro S hS
      rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_preimage_smul volume (ne_of_gt ht) S, hS, mul_zero]
    exact T (fun x : E3 => t • x) z (continuous_const_smul t) hnull (hcone t ht) hz
  · have hnull : ∀ S : Set E3, volume S = 0 → volume ((fun x : E3 => x + s • v) ⁻¹' S) = 0 := by
      intro S hS
      rw [MeasureTheory.measure_preimage_add_right volume (s • v) S]
      exact hS
    exact T (fun x : E3 => x + s • v) z (continuous_add_right (s • v)) hnull (hv s) hz

informal_problem.statement: (K : Set E3) (hmin : sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K Set.univ) : volume {z : E3 | ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0} = 0

signature.name: sepMinBdry_null
signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (hmin : sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K Set.univ) : volume {z : E3 | ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0} = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  
  have hlow : ∀ (S : Set E3) (c : ℝ), MeasurableSet S → 0 < c →
      volume {x : E3 | x ∉ S ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
        ENNReal.ofReal (c * r ^ 3) ≤ volume (S ∩ Metric.ball x r)} = 0 := by
    intro S c hS hc
    have hω0 : volume (Metric.closedBall (0:E3) 1) ≠ 0 :=
      (Metric.measure_closedBall_pos volume (0:E3) one_pos).ne'
    have hωtop : volume (Metric.closedBall (0:E3) 1) ≠ ⊤ := measure_closedBall_lt_top.ne
    have hball : ∀ (x : E3) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → volume (Metric.closedBall x r) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ 3) * volume (Metric.closedBall (0:E3) 1) := by
      intro x r hr
      rw [Measure.addHaar_closedBall' volume x hr.le, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    have hae := Besicovitch.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div_of_measurableSet volume hS
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (ae_iff.1 hae)
    rintro x ⟨hxS, hx⟩ hlim
    rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxS] at hlim
    have hpos : 0 < ENNReal.ofReal c / volume (Metric.closedBall (0:E3) 1) :=
      ENNReal.div_pos (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.2 hc).ne' hωtop
    have hle : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal c / volume (Metric.closedBall (0:E3) 1) ≤
        volume (S ∩ Metric.closedBall x r) / volume (Metric.closedBall x r) := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
      have hr' : (0:ℝ) < r := hr
      have ht0 : ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ 3) ≠ 0 := (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.2 (pow_pos hr' 3)).ne'
      have httop : ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ 3) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
      rw [hball x r hr']
      calc ENNReal.ofReal c / volume (Metric.closedBall (0:E3) 1)
          = ENNReal.ofReal c * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ 3) /
              (volume (Metric.closedBall (0:E3) 1) * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ 3)) :=
            (ENNReal.mul_div_mul_right _ _ ht0 httop).symm
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (c * r ^ 3) /
              (ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ 3) * volume (Metric.closedBall (0:E3) 1)) := by
            rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc.le, mul_comm (volume (Metric.closedBall (0:E3) 1))]
        _ ≤ volume (S ∩ Metric.closedBall x r) /
              (ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ 3) * volume (Metric.closedBall (0:E3) 1)) := by
            apply ENNReal.div_le_div_right
            exact (hx r hr').trans
              (measure_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ Metric.ball_subset_closedBall))
    have h0 := ge_of_tendsto hlim hle
    have h0' : ENNReal.ofReal c / volume (Metric.closedBall (0:E3) 1) ≤ 0 := by
      simpa using h0
    exact absurd h0' (not_le.2 hpos)
  
  obtain ⟨η₁, c₀, hη₁, hc₀, -, hD⟩ := sepPerMin_density_lower
  have hDK : ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) →
      ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ENNReal.ofReal (c₀ * s ^ 3) ≤ volume (K ∩ Metric.ball z s) ∧
        ENNReal.ofReal (c₀ * s ^ 3) ≤ volume (Metric.ball z s \ K) := by
    intro z hz s hs
    refine hD (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K Set.univ z s isOpen_univ
      (fun i j => contDiffOn_const) (fun y i j => ?_) (fun y _ => Matrix.PosDef.one)
      (fun y _ i j => ?_) hmin hs (Set.subset_univ _) hz
    · show (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j = (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) j i
      rcases eq_or_ne i j with h | h
      · subst h; rfl
      · rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne h, Matrix.one_apply_ne h.symm]
    · show |(1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η₁
      rw [Matrix.one_apply, sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact hη₁.le
  
  have hA := hlow K c₀ hmin.1 hc₀
  have hB := hlow Kᶜ c₀ hmin.1.compl hc₀
  refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null hA hB)
  intro z hz
  by_cases hzK : z ∈ K
  · right
    refine ⟨fun h => h hzK, fun r hr => ?_⟩
    have h2 := (hDK z hz r hr).2
    rwa [Set.diff_eq, Set.inter_comm] at h2
  · left
    exact ⟨hzK, fun r hr => (hDK z hz r hr).1⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerMin_density_lower
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∃ η₁ c₀ : ℝ, 0 < η₁ ∧ 0 < c₀ ∧ c₀ ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (x : E3) (s : ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) → (∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) → (∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) → (∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ η₁) → sepIsPerMin G F U → 0 < s → Metric.closedBall x s ⊆ U → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ F) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ F) ≠ 0) → ENNReal.ofReal (c₀ * s ^ 3) ≤ volume (F ∩ Metric.ball x s) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (c₀ * s ^ 3) ≤ volume (Metric.ball x s \ F)

informal_problem.statement: (K : Set E3) (a : Fin 3) (x : E3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (ρ δ : ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (hside : (volume ((sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ∩ K) = 0) ∨ (volume ((sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} ∩ K) = 0)) : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a x ρ δ, ((∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z))

signature.name: sepGraph_measBdry
signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (a : Fin 3) (x : E3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (ρ δ : ℝ) (hu : Continuous u) (hside : (volume ((sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ∩ K) = 0) ∨ (volume ((sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} ∩ K) = 0)) : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a x ρ δ, ((∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hcoord : Continuous (fun w : E3 => w a) := PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ a
  have hP : Continuous (sepPlaneProj a) := by
    unfold sepPlaneProj
    exact continuous_id.sub (hcoord.smul continuous_const)
  have hC : IsOpen (sepCyl a x ρ δ) := by
    unfold sepCyl
    rw [Set.setOf_and]
    exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (hP.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
      continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt ((hcoord.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)
  have hB : IsOpen {z : E3 | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} := isOpen_lt hcoord (hu.comp hP)
  have hA : IsOpen {z : E3 | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} := isOpen_lt (hu.comp hP) hcoord
  have hshift : ∀ (w : E3) (s : ℝ), sepPlaneProj a (w + s • e a) = sepPlaneProj a w ∧
      (w + s • e a) a = w a + s := by
    intro w s
    have h1 : (w + s • e a) a = w a + s := by
      simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    refine ⟨?_, h1⟩
    unfold sepPlaneProj
    rw [h1, add_smul]
    abel
  have hnorm : ∀ s : ℝ, ‖s • e a‖ = |s| := by
    intro s
    rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hmass : ∀ (S N O : Set E3), IsOpen O → O.Nonempty → O ⊆ N → O ⊆ S →
      (volume (S \ K) = 0 → volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0) ∧ (volume (S ∩ K) = 0 → volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) := by
    intro S N O hO hne hON hOS
    have hpos : volume O ≠ 0 := hO.measure_ne_zero volume hne
    constructor
    · intro hS hNK
      apply hpos
      refine measure_mono_null (t := (N ∩ K) ∪ (S \ K)) ?_ (measure_union_null hNK hS)
      intro w hw
      by_cases hwK : w ∈ K
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hON hw, hwK⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hOS hw, hwK⟩
    · intro hS hNK
      apply hpos
      refine measure_mono_null (t := (N \ K) ∪ (S ∩ K)) ?_ (measure_union_null hNK hS)
      intro w hw
      by_cases hwK : w ∈ K
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hOS hw, hwK⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hON hw, hwK⟩
  intro z hzC
  constructor
  · intro hbd
    rcases lt_trichotomy (z a) (u (sepPlaneProj a z)) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · exfalso
      have hN : sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} ∈ 𝓝 z :=
        (hC.inter hB).mem_nhds ⟨hzC, hlt⟩
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hbd _ hN
      rcases hside with ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ | ⟨hs1, hs2⟩
      · exact h2 hs1
      · exact h1 hs2
    · exact heq
    · exfalso
      have hN : sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ∈ 𝓝 z :=
        (hC.inter hA).mem_nhds ⟨hzC, hgt⟩
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hbd _ hN
      rcases hside with ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ | ⟨hs1, hs2⟩
      · exact h1 hs2
      · exact h2 hs1
  · intro hz N hN
    have hNC : N ∩ sepCyl a x ρ δ ∈ 𝓝 z := Filter.inter_mem hN (hC.mem_nhds hzC)
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.1 hNC
    have ht0 : 0 < ε / 2 := by positivity
    have htε : ε / 2 < ε := by linarith
    obtain ⟨hPm, hcm⟩ := hshift z (-(ε / 2))
    obtain ⟨hPp, hcp⟩ := hshift z (ε / 2)
    have hmball : z + (-(ε / 2)) • e a ∈ Metric.ball z ε := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, hnorm, abs_neg, abs_of_pos ht0]
      exact htε
    have hpball : z + (ε / 2) • e a ∈ Metric.ball z ε := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, hnorm, abs_of_pos ht0]
      exact htε
    have hOmo : IsOpen (Metric.ball z ε ∩ (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)})) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (hC.inter hB)
    have hOpo : IsOpen (Metric.ball z ε ∩ (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a})) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (hC.inter hA)
    have hOmne : (Metric.ball z ε ∩
        (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)})).Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨z + (-(ε / 2)) • e a, hmball, (hball hmball).2, ?_⟩
      show (z + (-(ε / 2)) • e a) a < u (sepPlaneProj a (z + (-(ε / 2)) • e a))
      rw [hcm, hPm, ← hz]
      linarith
    have hOpne : (Metric.ball z ε ∩
        (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a})).Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨z + (ε / 2) • e a, hpball, (hball hpball).2, ?_⟩
      show u (sepPlaneProj a (z + (ε / 2) • e a)) < (z + (ε / 2) • e a) a
      rw [hcp, hPp, ← hz]
      linarith
    have hOmN : Metric.ball z ε ∩ (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)}) ⊆ N :=
      fun w hw => (hball hw.1).1
    have hOpN : Metric.ball z ε ∩ (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a}) ⊆ N :=
      fun w hw => (hball hw.1).1
    have hm := hmass _ N _ hOmo hOmne hOmN Set.inter_subset_right
    have hp := hmass _ N _ hOpo hOpne hOpN Set.inter_subset_right
    rcases hside with ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ | ⟨hs1, hs2⟩
    · exact ⟨hm.1 hs1, hp.2 hs2⟩
    · exact ⟨hp.1 hs1, hm.2 hs2⟩

informal_problem.statement: (K : Set E3) (h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) (h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0) (hloc : ∀ x : E3, x ≠ 0 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) → ∃ (m : E3) (N : Set E3), ‖m‖ = 1 ∧ N ∈ 𝓝 x ∧ volume ((N ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (N ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} ∩ K) = 0) : ∃ ν : E3, ‖ν‖ = 1 ∧ volume (symmDiff K {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0}) = 0

signature.name: sepGlobal_planes
signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) (h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0) (hloc : ∀ x : E3, x ≠ 0 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) → ∃ (m : E3) (N : Set E3), ‖m‖ = 1 ∧ N ∈ 𝓝 x ∧ volume ((N ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (N ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} ∩ K) = 0) : ∃ ν : E3, ‖ν‖ = 1 ∧ volume (symmDiff K {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0}) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have t_ray : ∀ (y v : E3) (M : Set E3), M ∈ 𝓝 y →
      ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ y + t • v ∈ interior M := by
    intro y v M hM
    have hcont : Continuous fun t : ℝ => y + t • v :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
    have hev : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ), y + t • v ∈ interior M := by
      apply nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      apply hcont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
      simpa using interior_mem_nhds.mpr hM
    obtain ⟨t, htM, ht⟩ := (hev.and self_mem_nhdsWithin).exists
    exact ⟨t, ht, htM⟩
  
  have t_s1 : ∀ m : E3, m ≠ 0 → volume {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z = 0} = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    have hset : {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z = 0} =
        (((ℝ ∙ m)ᗮ : Submodule ℝ E3) : Set E3) := by
      ext z
      simp [Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right]
    rw [hset]
    apply Measure.addHaar_submodule
    intro h
    have : m ∈ (ℝ ∙ m)ᗮ := h ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right] at this
    exact hm (inner_self_eq_zero.mp this)
  
  have t_s2 : ∀ (K : Set E3) (m m' y : E3), ‖m‖ = 1 → ‖m'‖ = 1 →
      @inner ℝ E3 _ m y = 0 → @inner ℝ E3 _ m' y = 0 →
      ∀ (M : Set E3), M ∈ 𝓝 y →
      volume ((M ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) \ K) = 0 →
      volume (M ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' z} ∩ K) = 0 → m = m' := by
    intro K m m' y hm hm' hy hy' M hM hneg hpos'
    by_contra hne
    have hmm : @inner ℝ E3 _ m m = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hm]; norm_num
    have hmm' : @inner ℝ E3 _ m' m' = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hm']; norm_num
    have hlt : @inner ℝ E3 _ m m' < 1 := by
      by_contra hge
      push_neg at hge
      apply hne
      have h := norm_sub_sq_real m m'
      rw [hm, hm'] at h
      have h2 : ‖m - m'‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖m - m'‖]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp h2))
    have hv1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ m (m' - m) < 0 := by
      rw [inner_sub_right, hmm]; linarith
    have hv2 : 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (m' - m) := by
      rw [inner_sub_right, hmm', real_inner_comm m m']; linarith
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htM⟩ := t_ray y (m' - m) M hM
    have hO : IsOpen (interior M ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0} ∩
        {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' z}) :=
      (isOpen_interior.inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.inner continuous_id) continuous_const)).inter
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.inner continuous_id))
    have hpO : y + t • (m' - m) ∈ interior M ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0} ∩
        {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' z} := by
      refine ⟨⟨htM, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · show @inner ℝ E3 _ m (y + t • (m' - m)) < 0
        rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, hy]
        nlinarith
      · show 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' (y + t • (m' - m))
        rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, hy']
        nlinarith
    apply hO.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨_, hpO⟩
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null hneg hpos')
    rintro z ⟨⟨hzM, hz1⟩, hz2⟩
    by_cases hzK : z ∈ K
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨interior_subset hzM, hz2⟩, hzK⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨interior_subset hzM, hz1⟩, hzK⟩
  
  have t_s3 : ∀ (K : Set E3) (m y : E3), ‖m‖ = 1 → @inner ℝ E3 _ m y = 0 →
      ∀ (N₀ : Set E3), N₀ ∈ 𝓝 y →
      volume ((N₀ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) \ K) = 0 →
      volume (N₀ ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} ∩ K) = 0 →
      ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro K m y hm hy N₀ hN₀ hneg hpos N hN
    have hmm : @inner ℝ E3 _ m m = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hm]; norm_num
    have hNN : N ∩ N₀ ∈ 𝓝 y := Filter.inter_mem hN hN₀
    constructor
    · intro h0
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htM⟩ := t_ray y (-m) (N ∩ N₀) hNN
      have hO : IsOpen (interior (N ∩ N₀) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) :=
        isOpen_interior.inter (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.inner continuous_id) continuous_const)
      have hpO : y + t • (-m) ∈ interior (N ∩ N₀) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0} := by
        refine ⟨htM, ?_⟩
        show @inner ℝ E3 _ m (y + t • (-m)) < 0
        rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, inner_neg_right, hy, hmm]
        linarith
      apply hO.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨_, hpO⟩
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null h0 hneg)
      rintro z ⟨hzM, hz1⟩
      have hzM' := interior_subset hzM
      by_cases hzK : z ∈ K
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hzM'.1, hzK⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hzM'.2, hz1⟩, hzK⟩
    · intro h0
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htM⟩ := t_ray y m (N ∩ N₀) hNN
      have hO : IsOpen (interior (N ∩ N₀) ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z}) :=
        isOpen_interior.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.inner continuous_id))
      have hpO : y + t • m ∈ interior (N ∩ N₀) ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} := by
        refine ⟨htM, ?_⟩
        show 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m (y + t • m)
        rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, hy, hmm]
        linarith
      apply hO.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨_, hpO⟩
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null h0 hpos)
      rintro z ⟨hzM, hz1⟩
      have hzM' := interior_subset hzM
      by_cases hzK : z ∈ K
      · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hzM'.2, hz1⟩, hzK⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hzM'.1, hzK⟩
  
  have t_s4 : ∀ (K : Set E3) (m y : E3),
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) →
      ∀ (N₀ : Set E3), N₀ ∈ 𝓝 y →
      volume ((N₀ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) \ K) = 0 →
      volume (N₀ ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} ∩ K) = 0 →
      @inner ℝ E3 _ m y = 0 := by
    intro K m y hy N₀ hN₀ hneg hpos
    rcases lt_trichotomy (@inner ℝ E3 _ m y) 0 with hc | hc | hc
    · exfalso
      have hN : N₀ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0} ∈ 𝓝 y :=
        Filter.inter_mem hN₀ ((isOpen_lt (continuous_const.inner continuous_id)
          continuous_const).mem_nhds hc)
      exact (hy _ hN).2 hneg
    · exact hc
    · exfalso
      have hN : N₀ ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} ∈ 𝓝 y :=
        Filter.inter_mem hN₀ ((isOpen_lt continuous_const
          (continuous_const.inner continuous_id)).mem_nhds hc)
      exact (hy _ hN).1 hpos
  
  have t_s5 : ∀ (K U : Set E3), IsPreconnected U →
      (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) = 0 ∨ volume (N \ K) = 0) →
      volume (U ∩ K) = 0 ∨ volume (U \ K) = 0 := by
    intro K U hU hloc
    have hR : IsOpen {x : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) = 0} := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      rintro x ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩
      filter_upwards [eventually_eventually_nhds.mpr hN] with x' hx'
      exact ⟨N, hx', hN0⟩
    have hQ : IsOpen {x : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N \ K) = 0} := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      rintro x ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩
      filter_upwards [eventually_eventually_nhds.mpr hN] with x' hx'
      exact ⟨N, hx', hN0⟩
    have hdisj : Disjoint {x : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) = 0}
        {x : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N \ K) = 0} := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      rintro x ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ ⟨N', hN', hN'0⟩
      have hpos := Measure.measure_pos_of_mem_nhds volume (Filter.inter_mem hN hN')
      refine hpos.ne' (measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null hN0 hN'0))
      rintro z ⟨hzN, hzN'⟩
      by_cases hzK : z ∈ K
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hzN, hzK⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hzN', hzK⟩
    have hcover : U ⊆ {x : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) = 0} ∪
        {x : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N \ K) = 0} := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨N, hN, h | h⟩ := hloc x hx
      · exact Or.inl ⟨N, hN, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨N, hN, h⟩
    rcases hU.subset_or_subset hR hQ hdisj hcover with hUR | hUQ
    · left
      apply measure_null_of_locally_null
      rintro x ⟨hxU, hxK⟩
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := hUR hxU
      exact ⟨(U ∩ K) ∩ N, inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hN,
        measure_mono_null (fun z (hz : z ∈ (U ∩ K) ∩ N) => (⟨hz.2, hz.1.2⟩ : z ∈ N ∩ K)) hN0⟩
    · right
      apply measure_null_of_locally_null
      rintro x ⟨hxU, hxK⟩
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := hUQ hxU
      exact ⟨(U \ K) ∩ N, inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hN,
        measure_mono_null (fun z (hz : z ∈ (U \ K) ∩ N) => (⟨hz.2, hz.1.2⟩ : z ∈ N \ K)) hN0⟩
  
  have t_s6pre : ∀ m : E3, m ≠ 0 →
      IsPreconnected ({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z = 0} \ {0}) := by
    intro m hm
    haveI : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ E3 = 2 + 1) := ⟨by simp⟩
    have hfr : Module.finrank ℝ (ℝ ∙ m)ᗮ = 2 := Submodule.finrank_orthogonal_span_singleton hm
    have hrank : 1 < Module.rank ℝ (ℝ ∙ m)ᗮ := by
      rw [← Module.finrank_eq_rank, hfr]
      norm_num
    have hc := isConnected_compl_singleton_of_one_lt_rank hrank (0 : (ℝ ∙ m)ᗮ)
    have himg : (Subtype.val '' ({0}ᶜ : Set (ℝ ∙ m)ᗮ)) =
        {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z = 0} \ {0} := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · exact (Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right).mp w.2
        · intro h
          apply hw
          exact Subtype.ext h
      · rintro ⟨hz, hz0⟩
        refine ⟨⟨z, (Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right).mpr hz⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
        intro h
        apply hz0
        have := congrArg Subtype.val h
        simpa using this
    rw [← himg]
    exact (hc.image _ continuous_subtype_val.continuousOn).isPreconnected
  
  have t_s7 : ∀ m m' : E3,
      ∃ w : E3, w ≠ 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ m w = 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ m' w = 0 := by
    intro m m'
    let f : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := (innerₛₗ ℝ m).prod (innerₛₗ ℝ m')
    have hlt : Module.finrank ℝ (ℝ × ℝ) < Module.finrank ℝ E3 := by simp
    have hker := LinearMap.ker_ne_bot_of_finrank_lt (f := f) hlt
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hw0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).mp hker
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hw
    have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst hw
    have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd hw
    simp [f] at h1 h2
    exact ⟨w, hw0, h1, h2⟩
  
  have t_s8 : ∀ (m : E3), ‖m‖ = 1 → ∀ (y : E3), y ≠ 0 →
      y ∈ closure (({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z = 0} \ {0}) ∩
        {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume ((N ∩ {w | @inner ℝ E3 _ m w < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧
          volume (N ∩ {w | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m w} ∩ K) = 0}) →
      ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume ((N ∩ {w | @inner ℝ E3 _ m w < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧
        volume (N ∩ {w | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m w} ∩ K) = 0 := by
    intro m hm y hy0 hcl
    have hb : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0 := by
      intro N hN
      obtain ⟨y', hy'N, ⟨hy'P, -⟩, N', hN', hA1, hA2⟩ :=
        mem_closure_iff.mp hcl (interior N) isOpen_interior (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hN)
      have h := t_s3 K m y' hm hy'P N' hN' hA1 hA2 (interior N) (isOpen_interior.mem_nhds hy'N)
      exact ⟨fun h0 => h.1 (measure_mono_null (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ interior_subset) h0),
        fun h0 => h.2 (measure_mono_null (Set.diff_subset_diff_left interior_subset) h0)⟩
    obtain ⟨m', N₁, hm', hN₁, hB1, hB2⟩ := hloc y hy0 hb
    obtain ⟨y', hy'N, ⟨hy'P, -⟩, N', hN', hA1, hA2⟩ :=
      mem_closure_iff.mp hcl (interior N₁) isOpen_interior (mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.mpr hN₁)
    have hN₁y' : N₁ ∈ 𝓝 y' :=
      Filter.mem_of_superset (isOpen_interior.mem_nhds hy'N) interior_subset
    have hby' := t_s3 K m y' hm hy'P N' hN' hA1 hA2
    have hy'P' := t_s4 K m' y' hby' N₁ hN₁y' hB1 hB2
    have hM1 : volume (((N' ∩ N₁) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) \ K) = 0 :=
      measure_mono_null (by intro z hz; exact ⟨⟨hz.1.1.1, hz.1.2⟩, hz.2⟩) hA1
    have hM2 : volume ((N' ∩ N₁) ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m' z} ∩ K) = 0 :=
      measure_mono_null (by intro z hz; exact ⟨⟨hz.1.1.2, hz.1.2⟩, hz.2⟩) hB2
    have heq : m = m' := t_s2 K m m' y' hm hm' hy'P hy'P' (N' ∩ N₁)
      (Filter.inter_mem hN' hN₁y') hM1 hM2
    subst heq
    exact ⟨N₁, hN₁, hB1, hB2⟩
  
  have t_s9 : ∀ (m : E3), ‖m‖ = 1 → ∀ (x₀ : E3), @inner ℝ E3 _ m x₀ = 0 →
      ∀ (N₀ : Set E3), N₀ ∈ 𝓝 x₀ →
      volume ((N₀ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) \ K) = 0 →
      volume (N₀ ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} ∩ K) = 0 →
      (∀ y : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ m y ≠ 0 →
        ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ K) = 0 ∨ volume (N \ K) = 0) →
      volume (symmDiff K {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) = 0 := by
    intro m hm x₀ hx₀ N₀ hN₀ hneg hpos hbdry
    have hmm : @inner ℝ E3 _ m m = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hm]; norm_num
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, norm_zero] at hm
      exact zero_ne_one hm
    have hlin : IsLinearMap ℝ (fun z : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ m z) :=
      ⟨fun x y => inner_add_right _ _ _, fun c x => real_inner_smul_right _ _ _⟩
    have hpc1 : IsPreconnected {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0} :=
      (convex_halfSpace_lt hlin 0).isPreconnected
    have hpc2 : IsPreconnected {z : E3 | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} :=
      (convex_halfSpace_gt hlin 0).isPreconnected
    have hA := t_s5 K _ hpc1 (fun x hx => hbdry x (ne_of_lt hx))
    have hB := t_s5 K _ hpc2 (fun x hx => hbdry x (ne_of_gt hx))
    have hneg' : volume ({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0} \ K) = 0 := by
      rcases hA with h | h
      · exfalso
        obtain ⟨t, ht, htM⟩ := t_ray x₀ (-m) N₀ hN₀
        have hO : IsOpen (interior N₀ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) :=
          isOpen_interior.inter (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.inner continuous_id) continuous_const)
        have hpO : x₀ + t • (-m) ∈ interior N₀ ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0} := by
          refine ⟨htM, ?_⟩
          show @inner ℝ E3 _ m (x₀ + t • (-m)) < 0
          rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, inner_neg_right, hx₀, hmm]
          linarith
        apply hO.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨_, hpO⟩
        refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null h hneg)
        rintro z ⟨hzM, hz1⟩
        by_cases hzK : z ∈ K
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hz1, hzK⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨interior_subset hzM, hz1⟩, hzK⟩
      · exact h
    have hpos' : volume ({z : E3 | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} ∩ K) = 0 := by
      rcases hB with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        obtain ⟨t, ht, htM⟩ := t_ray x₀ m N₀ hN₀
        have hO : IsOpen (interior N₀ ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z}) :=
          isOpen_interior.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.inner continuous_id))
        have hpO : x₀ + t • m ∈ interior N₀ ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} := by
          refine ⟨htM, ?_⟩
          show 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m (x₀ + t • m)
          rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, hx₀, hmm]
          linarith
        apply hO.measure_ne_zero volume ⟨_, hpO⟩
        refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null h hpos)
        rintro z ⟨hzM, hz1⟩
        by_cases hzK : z ∈ K
        · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨interior_subset hzM, hz1⟩, hzK⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hz1, hzK⟩
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null (measure_union_null hneg' hpos') (t_s1 m hm0))
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_symmDiff] at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨hzK, hzH⟩ | ⟨hzH, hzK⟩
    · have hzH' : ¬ (@inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0) := hzH
      rcases (not_lt.mp hzH').lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨h, hzK⟩)
      · exact Or.inr h.symm
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨hzH, hzK⟩)
  
  have hnb : ∀ x : E3, ¬ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) →
      ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) = 0 ∨ volume (N \ K) = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    push_neg at hx
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hN'⟩ := hx
    by_cases h : volume (N ∩ K) = 0
    · exact ⟨N, hN, Or.inl h⟩
    · exact ⟨N, hN, Or.inr (hN' h)⟩
  
  have hex : ∃ x₀ : E3, x₀ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x₀, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    have hall : ∀ x ∈ ({0}ᶜ : Set E3), ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) = 0 ∨ volume (N \ K) = 0 :=
      fun x hx => hnb x (fun hb => hcon ⟨x, hx, hb⟩)
    have hrank : 1 < Module.rank ℝ E3 := by
      rw [← Module.finrank_eq_rank, finrank_euclideanSpace]
      simp
    have hconn := (isConnected_compl_singleton_of_one_lt_rank hrank (0:E3)).isPreconnected
    rcases t_s5 K _ hconn hall with h | h
    · apply h0 Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null (measure_singleton (0:E3)) h)
      intro z hz
      by_cases hz0 : z = 0
      · exact Or.inl hz0
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hz0, hz.2⟩
    · apply h1 Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null (measure_singleton (0:E3)) h)
      intro z hz
      by_cases hz0 : z = 0
      · exact Or.inl hz0
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hz0, hz.2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀0, hx₀b⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨m₀, N₀, hm₀, hN₀, hneg₀, hpos₀⟩ := hloc x₀ hx₀0 hx₀b
  have hx₀P := t_s4 K m₀ x₀ hx₀b N₀ hN₀ hneg₀ hpos₀
  
  have hprop : ∀ m : E3, ‖m‖ = 1 → ∀ x : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ m x = 0 → x ≠ 0 →
      (∃ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume ((N ∩ {w | @inner ℝ E3 _ m w < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧
        volume (N ∩ {w | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m w} ∩ K) = 0) →
      ∀ y : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ m y = 0 → y ≠ 0 →
      ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume ((N ∩ {w | @inner ℝ E3 _ m w < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧
        volume (N ∩ {w | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m w} ∩ K) = 0 := by
    intro m hm x hx hx0 hxu y hy hy0
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, norm_zero] at hm
      exact zero_ne_one hm
    have huo : IsOpen {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z,
        volume ((N ∩ {w | @inner ℝ E3 _ m w < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧
        volume (N ∩ {w | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m w} ∩ K) = 0} := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      rintro z ⟨N, hN, hA⟩
      filter_upwards [eventually_eventually_nhds.mpr hN] with z' hz'
      exact ⟨N, hz', hA⟩
    have hs := t_s6pre m hm0
    by_contra hyu
    have hcov : ({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z = 0} \ {0}) ⊆
        {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume ((N ∩ {w | @inner ℝ E3 _ m w < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧
          volume (N ∩ {w | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m w} ∩ K) = 0} ∪
        (closure (({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z = 0} \ {0}) ∩
          {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume ((N ∩ {w | @inner ℝ E3 _ m w < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧
            volume (N ∩ {w | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m w} ∩ K) = 0}))ᶜ := by
      intro z hz
      by_cases hzc : z ∈ closure (({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z = 0} \ {0}) ∩
          {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume ((N ∩ {w | @inner ℝ E3 _ m w < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧
            volume (N ∩ {w | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m w} ∩ K) = 0})
      · exact Or.inl (t_s8 m hm z hz.2 hzc)
      · exact Or.inr hzc
    obtain ⟨z, hzs, hzu, hzc⟩ := hs _ _ huo isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl hcov
      ⟨x, ⟨hx, hx0⟩, hxu⟩ ⟨y, ⟨hy, hy0⟩, fun hyc => hyu (t_s8 m hm y hy0 hyc)⟩
    exact hzc (subset_closure ⟨hzs, hzu⟩)
  
  have hallP : ∀ y : E3, y ≠ 0 → (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 y, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) →
      @inner ℝ E3 _ m₀ y = 0 := by
    intro y hy0 hyb
    obtain ⟨m, N₁, hm, hN₁, hB1, hB2⟩ := hloc y hy0 hyb
    have hyP := t_s4 K m y hyb N₁ hN₁ hB1 hB2
    obtain ⟨w, hw0, hwm, hwm₀⟩ := t_s7 m m₀
    obtain ⟨Na, hNa, hNa1, hNa2⟩ := hprop m hm y hyP hy0 ⟨N₁, hN₁, hB1, hB2⟩ w hwm hw0
    obtain ⟨Nb, hNb, hNb1, hNb2⟩ :=
      hprop m₀ hm₀ x₀ hx₀P hx₀0 ⟨N₀, hN₀, hneg₀, hpos₀⟩ w hwm₀ hw0
    have hM1 : volume (((Na ∩ Nb) ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) \ K) = 0 :=
      measure_mono_null (by intro z hz; exact ⟨⟨hz.1.1.1, hz.1.2⟩, hz.2⟩) hNa1
    have hM2 : volume ((Na ∩ Nb) ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m₀ z} ∩ K) = 0 :=
      measure_mono_null (by intro z hz; exact ⟨⟨hz.1.1.2, hz.1.2⟩, hz.2⟩) hNb2
    have heq : m = m₀ := t_s2 K m m₀ w hm hm₀ hwm hwm₀ (Na ∩ Nb) (Filter.inter_mem hNa hNb)
      hM1 hM2
    rw [← heq]
    exact hyP
  
  refine ⟨m₀, hm₀, t_s9 m₀ hm₀ x₀ hx₀P N₀ hN₀ hneg₀ hpos₀ ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  apply hnb
  intro hyb
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hy (inner_zero_right _)
  exact hy (hallP y hy0 hyb)

informal_problem.statement: (K : Set E3) (x : E3) (hmin : sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K Set.univ) (hdil : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (ρ δ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ 1 u) (hu0 : u (sepPlaneProj a x) = x a) (hside : (volume ((sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ∩ K) = 0) ∨ (volume ((sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} ∩ K) = 0)) : ∃ (m : E3) (N : Set E3), ‖m‖ = 1 ∧ N ∈ 𝓝 x ∧ volume ((N ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (N ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} ∩ K) = 0

signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (x : E3) (hmin : sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K Set.univ) (hdil : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (ρ δ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ 1 u) (hu0 : u (sepPlaneProj a x) = x a) (hside : (volume ((sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a} ∩ K) = 0) ∨ (volume ((sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | u (sepPlaneProj a z) < z a}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (sepCyl a x ρ δ ∩ {z | z a < u (sepPlaneProj a z)} ∩ K) = 0)) : ∃ (m : E3) (N : Set E3), ‖m‖ = 1 ∧ N ∈ 𝓝 x ∧ volume ((N ∩ {z | @inner ℝ E3 _ m z < 0}) \ K) = 0 ∧ volume (N ∩ {z | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ m z} ∩ K) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hP_sub : ∀ y y' : E3, sepPlaneProj a (y - y') = sepPlaneProj a y - sepPlaneProj a y' := by
    intro y y'
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hP_a : ∀ y : E3, (sepPlaneProj a y) a = 0 := by
    intro y
    simp [sepPlaneProj, e]
  have hP_lift : ∀ p : E3, p a = 0 → ∀ s : ℝ,
      (p + s • e a) a = s ∧ sepPlaneProj a (p + s • e a) = p := by
    intro p hp s
    have h1 : (p + s • e a) a = s := by simp [e, hp]
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, h1]
    exact add_sub_cancel_right p (s • e a)
  have hinner_e : ∀ z : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ (e a) z = z a := by
    intro z
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  have hinner_P : ∀ g z : E3, g a = 0 →
      @inner ℝ E3 _ g (sepPlaneProj a z) = @inner ℝ E3 _ g z := by
    intro g z hg
    simp [sepPlaneProj, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right,
      EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, hg]
  have hP0 : sepPlaneProj a (x - x) = 0 := by
    simp [sepPlaneProj]
  
  have hsymmI : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y i j =
        (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y j i := by
    intro y i j
    simp only [Matrix.one_apply]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h, Ne.symm h]
  obtain ⟨u', r', hr', hr'ρ, hu', hagree, hmse⟩ :=
    sepPerMin_C1_graph_smooth (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) Set.univ K isOpen_univ
      (fun i j => contDiffOn_const) hsymmI (fun _ _ => Matrix.PosDef.one) hmin a x u ρ δ hρ hδ
      hu hu0 (Set.subset_univ _) hside
  
  have hB := sepGraph_measBdry K a x u ρ δ hu.continuous hside
  have hgraph' : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a x r' δ,
      ((∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) ↔
        z a = u' (sepPlaneProj a z)) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzC : z ∈ sepCyl a x ρ δ := ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hz.1 hr'ρ, hz.2⟩
    rw [hB z hzC, hagree z hz.1]
  have hw0 : u' (sepPlaneProj a x) = x a := by
    rw [hagree x (by rw [hP0, norm_zero]; exact hr'), hu0]
  
  obtain ⟨ρ₂, η, hρ₂, hρ₂r', hη, hH⟩ :=
    sepConeGraph_homog K hdil a x u' r' δ hr' hδ (hu'.continuous) hw0 hgraph'
  
  have hmse' : ∀ p : E3, p a = 0 → ‖p - sepPlaneProj a x‖ < ρ₂ →
