(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (h0U : (0 : E3) ∈ U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (hI : G 0 = 1) (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) :
    ∃ ε r₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ 0 < r₀ ∧ ∀ (r : ℝ) (ν : E3), 0 < r → r < r₀ → ‖ν‖ = 1 →
      volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | r • z ∈ F} {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0} ∩
        Metric.ball 0 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε →
      ∃ (f : E3 → ℝ) (N : Set E3), ContDiff ℝ 1 f ∧ N ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E3) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ N, fderiv ℝ f z ≠ 0) ∧ volume ((N ∩ {z | f z < 0}) \ F) = 0 ∧
        volume (N ∩ {z | 0 < f z} ∩ F) = 0

informal_problem.statement: (K : Set E3) (v x : E3) (hmin : sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K Set.univ) (hcone : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} K) = 0) (hv : ∀ s : ℝ, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • v ∈ K} K) = 0) (hx1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) (hx0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0) : ∃ (r : ℕ → ℝ) (L : Set E3), (∀ k, 0 < r k) ∧ Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff {w : E3 | x + r k • w ∈ K} L ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧ sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) L Set.univ ∧ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | t • z ∈ L} L) = 0) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • x ∈ L} L) = 0) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • v ∈ L} L) = 0)

signature.name: sepEuclCone_tangentCone
signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (v x : E3) (hmin : sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K Set.univ) (hcone : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} K) = 0) (hv : ∀ s : ℝ, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • v ∈ K} K) = 0) (hx1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) (hx0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0) : ∃ (r : ℕ → ℝ) (L : Set E3), (∀ k, 0 < r k) ∧ Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff {w : E3 | x + r k • w ∈ K} L ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧ sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) L Set.univ ∧ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | t • z ∈ L} L) = 0) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • x ∈ L} L) = 0) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • v ∈ L} L) = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hG1 : ∀ (S : Set E3) (i j : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun y : E3 => (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y i j) S :=
    fun S i j => contDiffOn_const
  have hsymm1 : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y i j =
      (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y j i := by
    intro y i j
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h; rfl
    · exact (Matrix.one_apply_ne h).trans (Matrix.one_apply_ne (Ne.symm h)).symm
  have hpd1 : ∀ y ∈ (Set.univ : Set E3),
      ((fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y).PosDef :=
    fun y _ => Matrix.PosDef.one
  
  have hmetric : (fun z : E3 => (1 : ℝ) • pullbackMetric (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
      (fun w => x + (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ E3) w) z) =
      fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) := by
    funext z
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun w : E3 => x + (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ E3) w) z =
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 :=
      ((hasFDerivAt_id z).const_add x).fderiv
    ext a b
    simp only [one_smul, pullbackMetric, hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hminF : sepIsPerMin (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}
      Set.univ := by
    have h := (sepAffinePullback (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K Set.univ
      isOpen_univ hmin.1 (hG1 Set.univ) hsymm1 hpd1 x (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ E3) 1
      one_pos).2.2.2.2 hmin
    rw [hmetric, Set.preimage_univ] at h
    exact h
  have hN0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), {y : E3 | y - x ∈ N} ∈ 𝓝 x := by
    intro N hN
    apply (continuous_sub_right x).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
    show N ∈ 𝓝 (x - x)
    rw [sub_self]
    exact hN
  have h1F : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}) ≠ 0 := by
    intro N hN
    have e : N \ {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K} =
        (fun h : E3 => x + h) ⁻¹' ({y : E3 | y - x ∈ N} \ K) := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, add_sub_cancel_left]
    rw [e, measure_preimage_add]
    exact hx1 _ (hN0 N hN)
  have h0F : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}) ≠ 0 := by
    intro N hN
    have e : N ∩ {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K} =
        (fun h : E3 => x + h) ⁻¹' ({y : E3 | y - x ∈ N} ∩ K) := by
      ext w
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, add_sub_cancel_left]
    rw [e, measure_preimage_add]
    exact hx0 _ (hN0 N hN)
  
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀⟩ : ∃ r₀ : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ k, r₀ k = 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 2) := ⟨_, fun k => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ k, R k = (k : ℝ) + 2 := ⟨_, fun k => rfl⟩
  have hk2 : ∀ k : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 2 := fun k => by positivity
  have hr₀pos : ∀ k, 0 < r₀ k := fun k => by rw [hr₀]; exact div_pos one_pos (hk2 k)
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ) + 2) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 2 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hr₀t : Tendsto r₀ atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have e : r₀ = fun k : ℕ => 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 2) := funext hr₀
    rw [e]
    exact Tendsto.div_atTop tendsto_const_nhds h2
  have hRt : Tendsto R atTop atTop := by
    have e : R = fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ) + 2 := funext hR
    rw [e]
    exact h2
  have hmink : ∀ k, sepIsPerMin (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
      {z : E3 | r₀ k • z ∈ {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}} (Metric.ball 0 (R k)) := by
    intro k
    have h := (sepRescale (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}
      Set.univ isOpen_univ (hG1 Set.univ) hsymm1 hpd1 hminF (r₀ k) (hr₀pos k)).1
    exact ⟨h.1, fun V hV hc _ => h.2.1 V hV hc (fun z _ => Set.mem_univ _),
      fun F' V K' hF' hV hc _ hK hKV hsd =>
        h.2.2 F' V K' hF' hV hc (fun z _ => Set.mem_univ _) hK hKV hsd⟩
  have hnhds : ∀ k, ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), (fun z : E3 => (r₀ k)⁻¹ • z) ⁻¹' N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3) := by
    intro k N hN
    apply (continuous_const_smul (r₀ k)⁻¹).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
    show N ∈ 𝓝 ((r₀ k)⁻¹ • (0:E3))
    rw [smul_zero]
    exact hN
  have hpre0 : ∀ c : ℝ, c ≠ 0 → ∀ S : Set E3, volume S = 0 →
      volume ((fun z : E3 => c • z) ⁻¹' S) = 0 := by
    intro c hc S hS
    rw [Measure.addHaar_preimage_smul volume hc, hS, mul_zero]
  have h1k : ∀ k, ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3),
      volume (N \ {z : E3 | r₀ k • z ∈ {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}}) ≠ 0 := by
    intro k N hN hzero
    apply h1F _ (hnhds k N hN)
    have h := hpre0 (r₀ k)⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero (hr₀pos k).ne') _ hzero
    refine le_antisymm (le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h.le) (zero_le _)
    rintro z ⟨hzN, hzF⟩
    refine ⟨hzN, ?_⟩
    show ¬ (r₀ k • (r₀ k)⁻¹ • z ∈ {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K})
    rw [smul_inv_smul₀ (hr₀pos k).ne']
    exact hzF
  have h0k : ∀ k, ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3),
      volume (N ∩ {z : E3 | r₀ k • z ∈ {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}}) ≠ 0 := by
    intro k N hN hzero
    apply h0F _ (hnhds k N hN)
    have h := hpre0 (r₀ k)⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero (hr₀pos k).ne') _ hzero
    refine le_antisymm (le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h.le) (zero_le _)
    rintro z ⟨hzN, hzF⟩
    refine ⟨hzN, ?_⟩
    show r₀ k • (r₀ k)⁻¹ • z ∈ {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}
    rw [smul_inv_smul₀ (hr₀pos k).ne']
    exact hzF
  have hconv0 : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0:E3) ρ, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        |(fun (_ : ℕ) (_ : E3) => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) k y i j -
          (if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε := by
    intro ρ _ ε hε
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun k y _ i j => by
      simp only [Matrix.one_apply, sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact hε.le
  obtain ⟨ψ, L, hψ, hC1, hLmin, hL1, hL0, hC4⟩ := sepPerMin_blowup_compact
    (fun (_ : ℕ) (_ : E3) => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
    (fun k => {z : E3 | r₀ k • z ∈ {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}}) R hRt
    (fun k i j => contDiffOn_const) (fun k y i j => hsymm1 y i j)
    (fun k y _ => Matrix.PosDef.one) hconv0 hmink h1k h0k
  obtain ⟨Λ, r₁, hr₁, hfin, hmono⟩ := sepPerMin_monotonicity
    (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K} Set.univ isOpen_univ
    (Set.mem_univ 0) (hG1 Set.univ) hsymm1 hpd1 rfl hminF
  obtain ⟨Θ₀, hΘ₀, hlim⟩ := sepDensityRatio_limit
    (fun t => sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}
      (Metric.ball 0 t)) Λ r₁ hr₁ hfin hmono
  have hrψ : Tendsto (fun k => r₀ (ψ k)) atTop (𝓝 0) := hr₀t.comp hψ.tendsto_atTop
  have hseq : ∀ ρ' : ℝ, 0 < ρ' → Tendsto (fun k => sepPerG
      (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) {z : E3 | r₀ (ψ k) • z ∈ {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}}
      (Metric.ball 0 ρ')) atTop (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal (Θ₀ * ρ' ^ 2))) := by
    intro ρ' hρ'
    have h := hlim (fun k => r₀ (ψ k)) (fun k => hr₀pos _) hrψ ρ' hρ'
    refine Tendsto.congr (fun k => ?_) h
    exact ((sepRescale (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) {w : E3 | x + w ∈ K}
      Set.univ isOpen_univ (hG1 Set.univ) hsymm1 hpd1 hminF (r₀ (ψ k)) (hr₀pos _)).2
      ρ' hρ').symm
  have hae : ∀ᵐ ρ' ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), 0 < ρ' →
      sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) L (Metric.ball 0 ρ') =
        ENNReal.ofReal (Θ₀ * ρ' ^ 2) := by
    filter_upwards [hC4] with ρ' hρ' hpos
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hρ' hpos) (hseq ρ' hpos)
  have hall := sepPerG_ball_eq_of_ae L Θ₀ hΘ₀ hae
  have hconeL := sepEuclMin_cone_of_const_density L hLmin Θ₀ hall
  
  have hnull : ∀ (c : ℝ) (y₀ : E3) (S : Set E3), c ≠ 0 → volume S = 0 →
      volume ((fun z : E3 => y₀ + c • z) ⁻¹' S) = 0 := by
    intro c y₀ S hc hS
    have e1 : (fun z : E3 => y₀ + c • z) ⁻¹' S =
        (fun z : E3 => c • z) ⁻¹' ((fun h : E3 => y₀ + h) ⁻¹' S) := rfl
    rw [e1, Measure.addHaar_preimage_smul volume hc, measure_preimage_add, hS, mul_zero]
  have hvshift : ∀ (ρr s : ℝ), 0 < ρr →
      volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • v ∈ {w : E3 | x + ρr • w ∈ K}}
        {w : E3 | x + ρr • w ∈ K}) = 0 := by
    intro ρr s hρr
    have e : symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • v ∈ {w : E3 | x + ρr • w ∈ K}}
        {w : E3 | x + ρr • w ∈ K} =
        (fun z : E3 => x + ρr • z) ⁻¹' symmDiff {y : E3 | y + (ρr * s) • v ∈ K} K := by
      ext z
      have hid : x + ρr • (z + s • v) = x + ρr • z + (ρr * s) • v := by
        rw [smul_add, smul_smul, add_assoc]
      simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, hid]
    rw [e]
    exact hnull ρr x _ hρr.ne' (hv _)
  have hxshift : ∀ (ρr s : ℝ), 0 < ρr → 0 < 1 + ρr * s →
      volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • x ∈ {w : E3 | x + ρr • w ∈ K}}
        {z : E3 | (1 + ρr * s)⁻¹ • z ∈ {w : E3 | x + ρr • w ∈ K}}) = 0 := by
    intro ρr s hρr hlam
    have hμ : ρr * (1 + ρr * s)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hρr.ne' (inv_ne_zero hlam.ne')
    have hlm : (1 + ρr * s) * (ρr * (1 + ρr * s)⁻¹) = ρr := by
      field_simp
    have e : symmDiff {z : E3 | z + s • x ∈ {w : E3 | x + ρr • w ∈ K}}
        {z : E3 | (1 + ρr * s)⁻¹ • z ∈ {w : E3 | x + ρr • w ∈ K}} =
        (fun z : E3 => x + (ρr * (1 + ρr * s)⁻¹) • z) ⁻¹'
          symmDiff {y : E3 | (1 + ρr * s) • y ∈ K} K := by
      ext z
      have hid1 : x + ρr • (z + s • x) =
          (1 + ρr * s) • (x + (ρr * (1 + ρr * s)⁻¹) • z) := by
        rw [smul_add (1 + ρr * s), smul_smul, hlm, add_smul, one_smul, smul_add, smul_smul]
        abel
      have hid2 : x + ρr • ((1 + ρr * s)⁻¹ • z) = x + (ρr * (1 + ρr * s)⁻¹) • z := by
        rw [smul_smul]
      simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, hid1, hid2]
    rw [e]
    exact hnull _ x _ hμ (hcone _ hlam)
  have hshift : ∀ (A B : ℕ → Set E3) (L' M' : Set E3) (w : E3),
      (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ))
        atTop (𝓝 0)) →
      (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (B k) M' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ))
        atTop (𝓝 0)) →
      (∀ᶠ k in atTop, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + w ∈ A k} (B k)) = 0) →
      volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + w ∈ L'} M') = 0 := by
    intro A B L' M' w hA hB hAB
    have hball : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ →
        volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + w ∈ L'} M' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ) = 0 := by
      intro ρ hρ
      have hρ' : 0 < ρ + ‖w‖ := by positivity
      have hle : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + w ∈ L'} M' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ) ≤
          volume (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 (ρ + ‖w‖)) +
            volume (symmDiff (B k) M' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
        filter_upwards [hAB] with k hk
        calc volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + w ∈ L'} M' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ)
            ≤ volume ((fun z : E3 => z + w) ⁻¹' (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 (ρ + ‖w‖)) ∪
                symmDiff {z : E3 | z + w ∈ A k} (B k) ∪
                (symmDiff (B k) M' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ)) := by
              apply measure_mono
              rintro z ⟨hz, hzb⟩
              rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hzb
              have hzb' : ‖z + w‖ < ρ + ‖w‖ := by
                have := norm_add_le z w
                linarith
              simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_symmDiff,
                Set.mem_setOf_eq, mem_ball_zero_iff] at hz ⊢
              tauto
          _ ≤ volume ((fun z : E3 => z + w) ⁻¹' (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 (ρ + ‖w‖))) +
                volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + w ∈ A k} (B k)) +
                volume (symmDiff (B k) M' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ) :=
              (measure_union_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (measure_union_le _ _) le_rfl)
          _ = volume (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 (ρ + ‖w‖)) +
                volume (symmDiff (B k) M' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
              rw [measure_preimage_add_right, hk, add_zero]
      have htend : Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 (ρ + ‖w‖)) +
          volume (symmDiff (B k) M' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
        have h := (hA _ hρ').add (hB _ hρ)
        rwa [add_zero] at h
      exact le_antisymm (ge_of_tendsto htend hle) (zero_le _)
    have hcover : symmDiff {z : E3 | z + w ∈ L'} M' ⊆
        ⋃ n : ℕ, (symmDiff {z : E3 | z + w ∈ L'} M' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt ‖z‖
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, hz, ?_⟩
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
      linarith
    exact measure_mono_null hcover (measure_iUnion_null fun n => hball _ (by positivity))
  have hdil : ∀ (A : ℕ → Set E3) (L' : Set E3) (c : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ))
        atTop (𝓝 0)) →
      Tendsto c atTop (𝓝 1) →
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | t • z ∈ L'} L') = 0) →
      ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | c k • z ∈ A k} L' ∩
        Metric.ball 0 ρ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro A L' c hA hc hcL ρ hρ
    have hev : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, c k ∈ Set.Ioo (1/2 : ℝ) 2 :=
      hc (Ioo_mem_nhds (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
    have hbound : ∀ᶠ k in atTop,
        volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | c k • z ∈ A k} L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal 8 * volume (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 (2 * ρ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with k hk
      obtain ⟨hk1, hk2⟩ := hk
      have ht : 0 < c k := by linarith
      have h3 : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ c k ^ 3 := by
        calc (1 / 8 : ℝ) = (1 / 2) ^ 3 := by norm_num
          _ ≤ c k ^ 3 := by gcongr
      have hfac : ENNReal.ofReal |(c k ^ Module.finrank ℝ E3)⁻¹| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 8 := by
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
        have h4 : 1 / c k ^ 3 ≤ 1 / (1 / 8 : ℝ) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) h3
        rw [one_div] at h4
        have h5 : (1 / (1 / 8 : ℝ)) = 8 := by norm_num
        linarith
      calc volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | c k • z ∈ A k} L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ)
          ≤ volume ((fun z : E3 => c k • z) ⁻¹' (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 (2 * ρ)) ∪
              symmDiff {z : E3 | c k • z ∈ L'} L') := by
            apply measure_mono
            rintro z ⟨hz, hzb⟩
            rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hzb
            have hzb' : ‖c k • z‖ < 2 * ρ := by
              rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht]
              nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
            simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_symmDiff,
              Set.mem_setOf_eq, mem_ball_zero_iff] at hz ⊢
            tauto
        _ ≤ volume ((fun z : E3 => c k • z) ⁻¹' (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 (2 * ρ))) +
              volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | c k • z ∈ L'} L') := measure_union_le _ _
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal |(c k ^ Module.finrank ℝ E3)⁻¹| *
              volume (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 (2 * ρ)) := by
            rw [hcL _ ht, add_zero, Measure.addHaar_preimage_smul volume ht.ne']
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 8 * volume (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 (2 * ρ)) :=
            mul_le_mul_right' hfac _
    have hup : Tendsto (fun k => ENNReal.ofReal 8 *
        volume (symmDiff (A k) L' ∩ Metric.ball 0 (2 * ρ))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have h := ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul (hA (2 * ρ) (by linarith))
        (Or.inr (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (r := 8)))
      rwa [mul_zero] at h
    exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hup
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun k => zero_le _) hbound
  
  refine ⟨fun k => r₀ (ψ k), L, fun k => hr₀pos _, hrψ, hC1, hLmin, hL1, hL0, hconeL, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s
    have hlam : Tendsto (fun k => 1 + r₀ (ψ k) * s) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
      have h := (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (1:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1)).add
        (hrψ.mul_const s)
      rw [zero_mul, add_zero] at h
      exact h
    have hc : Tendsto (fun k => (1 + r₀ (ψ k) * s)⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
      have h := hlam.inv₀ one_ne_zero
      rw [inv_one] at h
      exact h
    have hpos : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, 0 < 1 + r₀ (ψ k) * s := hlam.eventually (lt_mem_nhds one_pos)
    have hB := hdil (fun k => {w : E3 | x + r₀ (ψ k) • w ∈ K}) L
      (fun k => (1 + r₀ (ψ k) * s)⁻¹) hC1 hc hconeL
    exact hshift (fun k => {w : E3 | x + r₀ (ψ k) • w ∈ K})
      (fun k => {z : E3 | (1 + r₀ (ψ k) * s)⁻¹ • z ∈ {w : E3 | x + r₀ (ψ k) • w ∈ K}})
      L L (s • x) hC1 hB (hpos.mono fun k hk => hxshift (r₀ (ψ k)) s (hr₀pos _) hk)
  · intro s
    exact hshift (fun k => {w : E3 | x + r₀ (ψ k) • w ∈ K})
      (fun k => {w : E3 | x + r₀ (ψ k) • w ∈ K}) L L (s • v) hC1 hC1
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun k => hvshift (r₀ (ψ k)) s (hr₀pos _))

subgoal_signatures.name: sepAffinePullback
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hF : MeasurableSet F) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (y₀ : E3) (L : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∀ V : Set E3, V ⊆ U →
      sepPerG (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
          ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' V) =
        ENNReal.ofReal c * sepPerG G F V) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z => (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j)
      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U)) ∧
    (∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j =
      (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) j i) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ (fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U, (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z).PosDef) ∧
    (sepIsPerMin G F U → sepIsPerMin (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U))

subgoal_signatures.name: sepRescale
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : sepIsPerMin (fun z => G (r • z)) {z : E3 | r • z ∈ F} {z : E3 | r • z ∈ U} ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) {z : E3 | r • z ∈ F} (Metric.ball 0 ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (r⁻¹ ^ 2) * sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 (r * ρ))

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerMin_blowup_compact
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : ℕ → E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : ℕ → Set E3) (R : ℕ → ℝ) (hR : Tendsto R atTop atTop) (hG : ∀ k (i j : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G k y i j) (Metric.ball 0 (R k))) (hsymm : ∀ k (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G k y i j = G k y j i) (hpd : ∀ k, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0:E3) (R k), (G k y).PosDef) (hconv : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0:E3) ρ, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G k y i j - (if i = j then (1:ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε) (hmin : ∀ k, sepIsPerMin (G k) (F k) (Metric.ball 0 (R k))) (h1 : ∀ k, ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ F k) ≠ 0) (h0 : ∀ k, ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ F k) ≠ 0) : ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (K : Set E3), StrictMono ψ ∧ (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => volume (symmDiff (F (ψ k)) K ∩ Metric.ball 0 ρ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧ sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K Set.univ ∧ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ᵐ ρ ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (F (ψ k)) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) atTop (𝓝 (sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 ρ)))

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerMin_monotonicity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (h0U : (0 : E3) ∈ U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hI : G 0 = 1) (hmin : sepIsPerMin G F U) : ∃ Λ r₀ : ℝ, 0 < r₀ ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r₀ → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 t) < ⊤) ∧ ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ t → t < r₀ → Real.exp (Λ * s) * (sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 s)).toReal / s ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (Λ * t) * (sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) F (Metric.ball 0 t)).toReal / t ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: sepDensityRatio_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement: (P : ℝ → ENNReal) (Λ r₀ : ℝ) (hr₀ : 0 < r₀) (hfin : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < r₀ → P t < ⊤) (hmono : ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ t → t < r₀ → Real.exp (Λ * s) * (P s).toReal / s ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (Λ * t) * (P t).toReal / t ^ 2) : ∃ Θ₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Θ₀ ∧ ∀ (r : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, 0 < r k) → Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → Tendsto (fun k => ENNReal.ofReal ((r k)⁻¹ ^ 2) * P (r k * ρ)) atTop (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal (Θ₀ * ρ ^ 2)))

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerG_ball_eq_of_ae
subgoal_signatures.statement: (K : Set E3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h : ∀ᵐ ρ ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), 0 < ρ → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ 2)) : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (c * ρ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: sepEuclMin_cone_of_const_density
subgoal_signatures.statement: (K : Set E3) (hmin : sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K Set.univ) (c : ℝ) (hc : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 r) = ENNReal.ofReal (c * r ^ 2)) : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → volume (symmDiff {z : E3 | t • z ∈ K} K) = 0

informal_problem.statement: (L : Set E3) (a b : E3) (hab : LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b]) (hdil : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (hta : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z + s • a), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (htb : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z + s • b), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (hnull : volume {z : E3 | ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0} = 0) (h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0) : ∃ ν : E3, ‖ν‖ = 1 ∧ volume (symmDiff L {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0}) = 0

signature.name: sepTwoDir_cone_halfspace
signature.statement: (L : Set E3) (a b : E3) (hab : LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b]) (hdil : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (hta : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z + s • a), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (htb : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z + s • b), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (hnull : volume {z : E3 | ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0} = 0) (h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0) : ∃ ν : E3, ‖ν‖ = 1 ∧ volume (symmDiff L {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0}) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hdec⟩ : ∃ n : E3, ‖n‖ = 1 ∧
      ∀ z : E3, ∃ α β : ℝ, z = α • a + β • b + (@inner ℝ E3 _ n z) • n := by
    have hKr : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ {a, b} : Submodule ℝ E3) = 2 := by
      have h := finrank_span_eq_card hab
      rw [Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty] at h
      simpa using h
    have hE : Module.finrank ℝ E3 = 3 := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
    have hKo : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ {a, b} : Submodule ℝ E3)ᗮ = 1 := by
      have h := Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal (Submodule.span ℝ {a, b} : Submodule ℝ E3)
      omega
    have hne : (Submodule.span ℝ {a, b} : Submodule ℝ E3)ᗮ ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro h
      rw [h, finrank_bot] at hKo
      exact zero_ne_one hKo
    obtain ⟨m, hmK, hm0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
    have hn1 : ‖(‖m‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • m‖ = 1 := by
      rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hm0)]
    have hnK : (‖m‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • m ∈ (Submodule.span ℝ {a, b} : Submodule ℝ E3)ᗮ :=
      Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hmK
    have hn0 : (‖m‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • m ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, norm_zero] at hn1
      exact zero_ne_one hn1
    have hspan : (Submodule.span ℝ {a, b} : Submodule ℝ E3)ᗮ = ℝ ∙ ((‖m‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • m) := by
      symm
      apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq
      · rw [Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
        exact hnK
      · rw [finrank_span_singleton hn0, hKo]
    refine ⟨(‖m‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • m, hn1, fun z => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, w, hw, hz⟩ :=
      Submodule.exists_add_mem_mem_orthogonal (K := (Submodule.span ℝ {a, b} : Submodule ℝ E3)) z
    rw [hspan] at hw
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hw
    have hny : @inner ℝ E3 _ ((‖m‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • m) y = 0 :=
      Submodule.inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal hy hnK
    have hc : @inner ℝ E3 _ ((‖m‖⁻¹ : ℝ) • m) z = c := by
      rw [hz, inner_add_right, hny, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hn1]
      ring
    obtain ⟨α, β, hαβ⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_pair.1 hy
    refine ⟨α, β, ?_⟩
    rw [hc, hαβ]
    exact hz
  
  have hB0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0 :=
    fun N hN => ⟨h0 N hN, h1 N hN⟩
  have hBn : ∀ c : ℝ, c ≠ 0 →
      (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (c • n), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → False := by
    intro c hc hcn
    have hsub : {w : E3 | 0 < c * @inner ℝ E3 _ n w} ⊆
        {z : E3 | ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0} := by
      intro w hw
      have hw' : 0 < c * @inner ℝ E3 _ n w := hw
      obtain ⟨α, β, hαβ⟩ := hdec w
      generalize hc' : @inner ℝ E3 _ n w = c' at hw' hαβ
      subst hαβ
      have ht : 0 < c' / c := by
        have e : c' / c = (c * c') / (c * c) := by field_simp
        rw [e]
        exact div_pos hw' (mul_self_pos.2 hc)
      have h1' := hdil (c' / c) ht (c • n) hcn
      rw [smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ c' hc] at h1'
      have h3' := htb β _ (hta α _ h1')
      have heq : c' • n + α • a + β • b = α • a + β • b + c' • n := by abel
      rw [heq] at h3'
      exact h3'
    have hSo : IsOpen {w : E3 | 0 < c * @inner ℝ E3 _ n w} :=
      isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.inner continuous_id))
    have hmem : c • n ∈ {w : E3 | 0 < c * @inner ℝ E3 _ n w} := by
      show 0 < c * @inner ℝ E3 _ n (c • n)
      rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hn]
      have := mul_self_pos.2 hc
      nlinarith
    have hpos := hSo.measure_pos volume ⟨c • n, hmem⟩
    exact hpos.ne' (measure_mono_null hsub hnull)
  have hB : ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) ↔
      @inner ℝ E3 _ n z = 0 := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨α, β, hαβ⟩ := hdec z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      by_contra hc
      generalize hc' : @inner ℝ E3 _ n z = c at hαβ hc
      subst hαβ
      have h2 := htb (-β) _ (hta (-α) _ hz)
      have heq : α • a + β • b + c • n + (-α) • a + (-β) • b = c • n := by
        simp only [neg_smul]
        abel
      rw [heq] at h2
      exact hBn c hc h2
    · intro hz
      rw [hz, zero_smul, add_zero] at hαβ
      have h2 := htb β _ (hta α _ hB0)
      rw [zero_add, ← hαβ] at h2
      exact h2
  
  have hU1o : IsOpen {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) = 0} := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    rintro z ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩
    obtain ⟨V, hVN, hVo, hzV⟩ := _root_.mem_nhds_iff.1 hN
    exact Filter.mem_of_superset (hVo.mem_nhds hzV)
      (fun w hw => ⟨N, Filter.mem_of_superset (hVo.mem_nhds hw) hVN, hN0⟩)
  have hU2o : IsOpen {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ L) = 0} := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    rintro z ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩
    obtain ⟨V, hVN, hVo, hzV⟩ := _root_.mem_nhds_iff.1 hN
    exact Filter.mem_of_superset (hVo.mem_nhds hzV)
      (fun w hw => ⟨N, Filter.mem_of_superset (hVo.mem_nhds hw) hVN, hN0⟩)
  have hdisj : Disjoint {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) = 0}
      {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ L) = 0} := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro z ⟨N₁, hN₁, h₁⟩ ⟨N₂, hN₂, h₂⟩
    have hN : N₁ ∩ N₂ ∈ 𝓝 z := Filter.inter_mem hN₁ hN₂
    have hpos : 0 < volume (N₁ ∩ N₂) :=
      Measure.measure_pos_of_nonempty_interior volume ⟨z, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hN⟩
    have hzero : volume (N₁ ∩ N₂) = 0 := by
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null h₁ h₂)
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxL : x ∈ L
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hx.1, hxL⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hx.2, hxL⟩
    exact hpos.ne' hzero
  have hconst : ∀ H : Set E3, IsPreconnected H →
      (∀ z ∈ H, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) = 0 ∨ volume (N \ L) = 0) →
      volume (H ∩ L) = 0 ∨ volume (H \ L) = 0 := by
    intro H hH hloc
    have hcov : H ⊆ {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) = 0} ∪
        {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ L) = 0} := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨N, hN, h | h⟩ := hloc z hz
      · exact Or.inl ⟨N, hN, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨N, hN, h⟩
    rcases IsPreconnected.subset_or_subset hU1o hU2o hdisj hcov hH with hsub | hsub
    · left
      apply measure_null_of_locally_null
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := hsub hx.1
      have hsN : (H ∩ L) ∩ N ⊆ N ∩ L := fun y hy => ⟨hy.2, hy.1.2⟩
      exact ⟨(H ∩ L) ∩ N, inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hN, measure_mono_null hsN hN0⟩
    · right
      apply measure_null_of_locally_null
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := hsub hx.1
      have hsN : (H \ L) ∩ N ⊆ N \ L := fun y hy => ⟨hy.2, hy.1.2⟩
      exact ⟨(H \ L) ∩ N, inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hN, measure_mono_null hsN hN0⟩
  
  have hP : volume {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ n z = 0} = 0 :=
    measure_mono_null (fun z hz => (hB z).2 hz) hnull
  have hlin : IsLinearMap ℝ (fun z : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ n z) :=
    ⟨fun x y => inner_add_right n x y, fun c x => real_inner_smul_right n x c⟩
  have hHp : IsPreconnected {z : E3 | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ n z} :=
    (convex_halfSpace_gt hlin 0).isPreconnected
  have hHm : IsPreconnected {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ n z < 0} :=
    (convex_halfSpace_lt hlin 0).isPreconnected
  have hlocH : ∀ z : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ n z ≠ 0 →
      ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) = 0 ∨ volume (N \ L) = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    by_contra hne
    push_neg at hne
    exact hz ((hB z).1 hne)
  have hp := hconst _ hHp (fun z hz => hlocH z (ne_of_gt hz))
  have hm := hconst _ hHm (fun z hz => hlocH z (ne_of_lt hz))
  have hU1 := h1 Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
  have hU0 := h0 Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
  
  rcases hp with hp | hp <;> rcases hm with hm | hm
  · exfalso
    apply hU0
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null (measure_union_null hp hm) hP)
    intro z hz
    rcases lt_trichotomy 0 (@inner ℝ E3 _ n z) with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨h, hz.2⟩)
    · exact Or.inr h.symm
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨h, hz.2⟩)
  · refine ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null (measure_union_null hp hm) hP)
    intro z hz
    rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hz with ⟨hzL, hzH⟩ | ⟨hzH, hzL⟩
    · rcases lt_trichotomy 0 (@inner ℝ E3 _ n z) with h | h | h
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨h, hzL⟩)
      · exact Or.inr h.symm
      · exact absurd h hzH
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨hzH, hzL⟩)
  · refine ⟨-n, by rw [norm_neg, hn], ?_⟩
    have hset : {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ (-n) z < 0} = {z : E3 | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ n z} := by
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, inner_neg_left, neg_lt_zero]
    rw [hset]
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null (measure_union_null hp hm) hP)
    intro z hz
    rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hz with ⟨hzL, hzH⟩ | ⟨hzH, hzL⟩
    · rcases lt_trichotomy 0 (@inner ℝ E3 _ n z) with h | h | h
      · exact absurd h hzH
      · exact Or.inr h.symm
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨h, hzL⟩)
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨hzH, hzL⟩)
  · exfalso
    apply hU1
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null (measure_union_null hp hm) hP)
    intro z hz
    rcases lt_trichotomy 0 (@inner ℝ E3 _ n z) with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨h, hz.2⟩)
    · exact Or.inr h.symm
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨h, hz.2⟩)

informal_problem.statement: (L : Set E3) (e : E3) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hdil : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (htr : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z + s • e), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (hreg : ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e ≠ 0 → ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (ρ δ : ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ 0 < δ ∧ Continuous u ∧ ∀ w ∈ sepCyl a z ρ δ, ((∀ N ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) ↔ w a = u (sepPlaneProj a w))) : ∃ Φ : Finset E3, (∀ φ ∈ Φ, ‖φ‖ = 1 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ e φ = 0) ∧ ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e ≠ 0 → ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e‖⁻¹ • (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e) ∈ Φ

signature.name: sepCylCone_finite_rays
signature.statement: (L : Set E3) (e : E3) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hdil : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (htr : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z + s • e), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (hreg : ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e ≠ 0 → ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (ρ δ : ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ 0 < δ ∧ Continuous u ∧ ∀ w ∈ sepCyl a z ρ δ, ((∀ N ∈ 𝓝 w, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) ↔ w a = u (sepPlaneProj a w))) : ∃ Φ : Finset E3, (∀ φ ∈ Φ, ‖φ‖ = 1 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ e φ = 0) ∧ ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e ≠ 0 → ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e‖⁻¹ • (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e) ∈ Φ

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : Set E3, ∀ z, z ∈ B ↔
      ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0 := ⟨_, fun z => Iff.rfl⟩
  have hdil' : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z ∈ B, t • z ∈ B := fun t ht z hz =>
    (hBdef _).2 (hdil t ht z ((hBdef z).1 hz))
  have htr' : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ B, z + s • e ∈ B := fun s z hz =>
    (hBdef _).2 (htr s z ((hBdef z).1 hz))
  have hee : @inner ℝ E3 _ e e = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, he]; norm_num
  
  have hBc : IsClosed B := by
    rw [← isOpen_compl_iff, isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, hBdef] at hz
    simp only [not_forall] at hz
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hN'⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨O, hON, hO, hzO⟩ := _root_.mem_nhds_iff.1 hN
    filter_upwards [hO.mem_nhds hzO] with y hy
    rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, hBdef]
    intro h
    exact hN' (h N (Filter.mem_of_superset (hO.mem_nhds hy) hON))
  
  set Γ : Set E3 := Metric.sphere (0 : E3) 1 ∩ ({φ | @inner ℝ E3 _ e φ = 0} ∩ B) with hΓ
  have hΓc : IsCompact Γ := by
    refine (isCompact_sphere (0 : E3) 1).inter_right ?_
    refine IsClosed.inter ?_ hBc
    exact isClosed_eq (continuous_const.inner continuous_id) continuous_const
  have hmemΓ : ∀ φ, φ ∈ Γ ↔ ‖φ‖ = 1 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ e φ = 0 ∧ φ ∈ B := by
    intro φ
    simp only [hΓ, Set.mem_inter_iff, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  
  have hiso : ∀ φ₀ ∈ Γ, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 φ₀, ∀ φ ∈ U, φ ∈ B → ‖φ‖ = 1 →
      @inner ℝ E3 _ e φ = 0 → φ = φ₀ := by
    intro φ₀ hφ₀
    obtain ⟨hφ₀1, hφ₀e, hφ₀B⟩ := (hmemΓ φ₀).1 hφ₀
    have hne : φ₀ - @inner ℝ E3 _ e φ₀ • e ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hφ₀e, zero_smul, sub_zero]
      intro h
      rw [h, norm_zero] at hφ₀1
      exact zero_ne_one hφ₀1
    obtain ⟨a, u, ρ, δ, hρ, hδ, -, hgraph⟩ := hreg φ₀ ((hBdef φ₀).1 hφ₀B) hne
    have hgr : ∀ w ∈ sepCyl a φ₀ ρ δ, (w ∈ B ↔ w a = u (sepPlaneProj a w)) :=
      fun w hw => (hBdef w).trans (hgraph w hw)
    have hH : ∀ s t : ℝ, 0 < s → s • φ₀ + t • e ∈ B := fun s t hs =>
      htr' t _ (hdil' s hs φ₀ hφ₀B)
    obtain ⟨ε, hε⟩ : ∃ ε : E3, ε = EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hcoord : ∀ (w : E3) (r : ℝ), (w + r • ε) a = w a + r := by
      intro w r; simp [hε]
    have hPdef : ∀ w : E3, sepPlaneProj a w = w - (w a) • ε := by
      intro w; rw [hε]; rfl
    have hP : ∀ (w : E3) (r : ℝ), sepPlaneProj a (w + r • ε) = sepPlaneProj a w := by
      intro w r
      rw [hPdef, hPdef, hcoord, add_smul]
      abel
    have hdecomp : ∀ w : E3, w = sepPlaneProj a w + (w a) • ε := by
      intro w; rw [hPdef, sub_add_cancel]
    have hVU : ∀ (w : E3) (r : ℝ), w ∈ sepCyl a φ₀ ρ δ → w ∈ B →
        w + r • ε ∈ sepCyl a φ₀ ρ δ → w + r • ε ∈ B → r = 0 := by
      intro w r hwC hwB hwC' hwB'
      have h1 := (hgr w hwC).1 hwB
      have h2 := (hgr _ hwC').1 hwB'
      rw [hP, hcoord, ← h1] at h2
      linarith
    have hCopen : IsOpen (sepCyl a φ₀ ρ δ) := by
      have hca : Continuous (fun z : E3 => z a) := by fun_prop
      have hcP : Continuous (fun z : E3 => sepPlaneProj a (z - φ₀)) := by
        simp only [hPdef]
        fun_prop
      exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp hcP) continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (hca.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const)
    have hvertC : ∀ r : ℝ, |r| < δ → φ₀ + r • ε ∈ sepCyl a φ₀ ρ δ := by
      intro r hr
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
        have : sepPlaneProj a (r • ε) = 0 := by
          have h := hP 0 r
          rw [zero_add] at h
          rw [h, hPdef]; simp
        rw [this, norm_zero]; exact hρ
      · rw [hcoord, add_sub_cancel_left]; exact hr
    have hφ₀C : φ₀ ∈ sepCyl a φ₀ ρ δ := by
      have h := hvertC 0 (by rw [abs_zero]; exact hδ)
      rwa [zero_smul, add_zero] at h
    
    have hinj : ∀ α β : ℝ, sepPlaneProj a (α • φ₀ + β • e) = 0 → α = 0 ∧ β = 0 := by
      intro α β hv
      obtain ⟨v, hvdef⟩ : ∃ v : E3, v = α • φ₀ + β • e := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hvdef] at hv
      have hv' : v = (v a) • ε := by
        have := hdecomp v; rw [hv, zero_add] at this; exact this
      obtain ⟨s, hs0, hs1, hs2⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ 0 < 1 + s * α ∧ |s * v a| < δ := by
        refine ⟨min (1 / (2 * (|α| + 1))) (δ / (2 * (|v a| + 1))), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
        · have hm := min_le_left (1 / (2 * (|α| + 1))) (δ / (2 * (|v a| + 1)))
          have hpos : 0 < min (1 / (2 * (|α| + 1))) (δ / (2 * (|v a| + 1))) :=
            lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
          rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hm
          have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_abs_le α) hpos.le
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg α]
        · have hm := min_le_right (1 / (2 * (|α| + 1))) (δ / (2 * (|v a| + 1)))
          have hpos : 0 < min (1 / (2 * (|α| + 1))) (δ / (2 * (|v a| + 1))) :=
            lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity)
          rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hm
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hpos]
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg (v a)]
      have hw : φ₀ + (s * v a) • ε = (1 + s * α) • φ₀ + (s * β) • e := by
        calc φ₀ + (s * v a) • ε = φ₀ + s • ((v a) • ε) := by rw [smul_smul]
          _ = φ₀ + s • v := by rw [← hv']
          _ = (1 + s * α) • φ₀ + (s * β) • e := by rw [hvdef]; module
      have hsv : s * v a = 0 := by
        refine hVU φ₀ (s * v a) hφ₀C hφ₀B (hvertC _ hs2) ?_
        rw [hw]; exact hH _ _ hs1
      have hva : v a = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hsv with h | h
        · exact absurd h hs0.ne'
        · exact h
      have hv0 : v = 0 := by rw [hv', hva, zero_smul]
      have h1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ φ₀ v = α := by
        rw [hvdef, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right,
          real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hφ₀1, real_inner_comm e φ₀, hφ₀e]
        ring
      have h2 : @inner ℝ E3 _ e v = β := by
        rw [hvdef, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, hφ₀e, hee]
        ring
      rw [hv0, inner_zero_right] at h1 h2
      exact ⟨h1.symm, h2.symm⟩
    
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] E3,
        ∀ c, T c = c 0 • φ₀ + c 1 • e + c 2 • ε :=
      ⟨{ toFun := fun c => c 0 • φ₀ + c 1 • e + c 2 • ε
         map_add' := by
           intro x y
           simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_smul]
           abel
         map_smul' := by
           intro r x
           simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply, smul_add, mul_smul] },
        fun c => rfl⟩
    have hTinj : Function.Injective T := by
      rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
      intro c hc
      rw [hT] at hc
      have hPc : sepPlaneProj a (c 0 • φ₀ + c 1 • e) = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg (sepPlaneProj a) hc
        rw [hP] at h
        rw [h, hPdef]; simp
      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hinj _ _ hPc
      rw [h0, h1, zero_smul, zero_smul, zero_add, zero_add] at hc
      have h2 : c 2 = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w a) hc
        simpa [hε] using h
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h0
      · exact h1
      · exact h2
    have hTsurj : Function.Surjective T := by
      rw [← LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank]
      · exact hTinj
      · simp
    obtain ⟨cc, hcc, hcT⟩ : ∃ cc : E3 → (Fin 3 → ℝ), Continuous cc ∧ ∀ v, T (cc v) = v := by
      let Te := LinearEquiv.ofBijective T ⟨hTinj, hTsurj⟩
      refine ⟨Te.symm, LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional (Te.symm : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ)),
        fun v => ?_⟩
      exact Te.apply_symm_apply v
    have hcφ₀ : cc φ₀ = ![1, 0, 0] := by
      apply hTinj
      rw [hcT, hT]
      simp
    
    have hg : Continuous (fun φ : E3 => φ - (cc φ 2) • ε) :=
      continuous_id.sub (((continuous_apply 2).comp hcc).smul continuous_const)
    refine ⟨{φ | 0 < cc φ 0} ∩ sepCyl a φ₀ ρ δ ∩ (fun φ : E3 => φ - (cc φ 2) • ε) ⁻¹'
      sepCyl a φ₀ ρ δ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine Filter.inter_mem (Filter.inter_mem ?_ (hCopen.mem_nhds hφ₀C)) ?_
      · refine (isOpen_lt continuous_const ((continuous_apply 0).comp hcc)).mem_nhds ?_
        show 0 < cc φ₀ 0
        rw [hcφ₀]; simp
      · refine hg.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds ?_
        have : φ₀ - (cc φ₀ 2) • ε = φ₀ := by rw [hcφ₀]; simp
        rw [this]
        exact hCopen.mem_nhds hφ₀C
    · rintro φ ⟨⟨hpos, hφC⟩, hyC⟩ hφB hφ1 hφe
      have hpos' : 0 < cc φ 0 := hpos
      have hyC' : φ - (cc φ 2) • ε ∈ sepCyl a φ₀ ρ δ := hyC
      have hφT : φ = cc φ 0 • φ₀ + cc φ 1 • e + cc φ 2 • ε := by
        have h := hcT φ
        rw [hT] at h
        exact h.symm
      have hy : φ - (cc φ 2) • ε = cc φ 0 • φ₀ + cc φ 1 • e := by
        calc φ - (cc φ 2) • ε = (cc φ 0 • φ₀ + cc φ 1 • e + cc φ 2 • ε) - cc φ 2 • ε := by
              rw [← hφT]
          _ = cc φ 0 • φ₀ + cc φ 1 • e := add_sub_cancel_right _ _
      have hyB : φ - (cc φ 2) • ε ∈ B := by rw [hy]; exact hH _ _ hpos'
      have hk2 : cc φ 2 = 0 := by
        refine hVU _ (cc φ 2) hyC' hyB ?_ ?_
        · rw [sub_add_cancel]; exact hφC
        · rw [sub_add_cancel]; exact hφB
      have hφ' : φ = cc φ 0 • φ₀ + cc φ 1 • e := by
        rw [← hy, hk2, zero_smul, sub_zero]
      have hk1 : cc φ 1 = 0 := by
        have h := hφe
        rw [hφ', inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, hφ₀e, hee] at h
        linarith
      rw [hk1, zero_smul, add_zero] at hφ'
      have hk0 : cc φ 0 = 1 := by
        have h := hφ1
        rw [hφ', norm_smul, hφ₀1, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos'] at h
        exact h
      rw [hφ', hk0, one_smul]
  choose! U hUn hUiso using hiso
  obtain ⟨t, htΓ, hcov⟩ := hΓc.elim_nhds_subcover U hUn
  refine ⟨t, fun φ hφ => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := (hmemΓ φ).1 (htΓ φ hφ)
    exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · intro z hz hz'
    have hzB : z ∈ B := (hBdef z).2 hz
    have hz'B : z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e ∈ B := by
      have h := htr' (-(@inner ℝ E3 _ e z)) z hzB
      rwa [neg_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at h
    have hnpos : 0 < ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hz'
    have hφB := hdil' _ (inv_pos.2 hnpos) _ hz'B
    have hφ1 : ‖‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e‖⁻¹ • (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e)‖ = 1 := by
      rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hnpos.ne']
    have hφe : @inner ℝ E3 _ e (‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e‖⁻¹ • (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e)) = 0 := by
      rw [real_inner_smul_right, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, hee]
      ring
    have hφΓ := (hmemΓ _).2 ⟨hφ1, hφe, hφB⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxU⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcov hφΓ)
    rw [hUiso x (htΓ x hx) _ hxU hφB hφ1 hφe]
    exact hx

informal_problem.statement: (L : Set E3) (e : E3) (Φ : Finset E3) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hdil : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (htr : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z + s • e), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (hΦ : ∀ φ ∈ Φ, ‖φ‖ = 1 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ e φ = 0) (hrays : ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e ≠ 0 → ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e‖⁻¹ • (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e) ∈ Φ) (h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0) : (∃ ν : E3, ‖ν‖ = 1 ∧ volume (symmDiff L {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0}) = 0) ∨ ∃ (E : Set E3) (q₁ q₂ p₁ p₂ : E3), (E = L ∨ E = Lᶜ) ∧ ‖q₁‖ = 1 ∧ ‖q₂‖ = 1 ∧ LinearIndependent ℝ ![q₁, q₂] ∧ (∀ z : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z ≤ 0 → @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z ≤ 0 → (@inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z = 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z = 0) ∨ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0)) ∧ volume ({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0} ∩ {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z < 0} ∩ E) = 0 ∧ volume (({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0} ∩ {z : E3 | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z ∨ 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z}) \ E) = 0

signature.statement: (L : Set E3) (e : E3) (Φ : Finset E3) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (hdil : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (htr : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z + s • e), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (hΦ : ∀ φ ∈ Φ, ‖φ‖ = 1 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ e φ = 0) (hrays : ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) → z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e ≠ 0 → ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e‖⁻¹ • (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e) ∈ Φ) (h1 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) (h0 : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (0:E3), volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0) : (∃ ν : E3, ‖ν‖ = 1 ∧ volume (symmDiff L {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ ν z < 0}) = 0) ∨ ∃ (E : Set E3) (q₁ q₂ p₁ p₂ : E3), (E = L ∨ E = Lᶜ) ∧ ‖q₁‖ = 1 ∧ ‖q₂‖ = 1 ∧ LinearIndependent ℝ ![q₁, q₂] ∧ (∀ z : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z ≤ 0 → @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z ≤ 0 → (@inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z = 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z = 0) ∨ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0)) ∧ volume ({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0} ∩ {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z < 0} ∩ E) = 0 ∧ volume (({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0} ∩ {z : E3 | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z ∨ 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z}) \ E) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ (K O : Set E3), IsPreconnected O →
      (∀ z ∈ O, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) = 0 ∨ volume (N \ K) = 0) →
      volume (O ∩ K) = 0 ∨ volume (O \ K) = 0 := by
    intro K O hconn hloc
    have hopen0 : IsOpen {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) = 0} := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      rintro z ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩
      obtain ⟨V, hVN, hVo, hzV⟩ := _root_.mem_nhds_iff.1 hN
      refine Filter.mem_of_superset (hVo.mem_nhds hzV) ?_
      intro w hw
      exact ⟨V, hVo.mem_nhds hw, measure_mono_null (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hVN) hN0⟩
    have hopen1 : IsOpen {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ K) = 0} := by
      rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
      rintro z ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩
      obtain ⟨V, hVN, hVo, hzV⟩ := _root_.mem_nhds_iff.1 hN
      refine Filter.mem_of_superset (hVo.mem_nhds hzV) ?_
      intro w hw
      exact ⟨V, hVo.mem_nhds hw, measure_mono_null (Set.diff_subset_diff_left hVN) hN0⟩
    have hcover : O ⊆ {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) = 0} ∪
        {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ K) = 0} := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨N, hN, h | h⟩ := hloc z hz
      · exact Or.inl ⟨N, hN, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨N, hN, h⟩
    have hdisj : Disjoint {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) = 0}
        {z : E3 | ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N \ K) = 0} := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      rintro z ⟨N₀, hN₀, h0⟩ ⟨N₁, hN₁, h1⟩
      have hpos : 0 < volume (N₀ ∩ N₁) :=
        Measure.measure_pos_of_mem_nhds _ (Filter.inter_mem hN₀ hN₁)
      have hnull : volume (N₀ ∩ N₁) = 0 := by
        refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null h0 h1)
        rintro x ⟨hx0, hx1⟩
        by_cases hxK : x ∈ K
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hx0, hxK⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hx1, hxK⟩
      exact hpos.ne' hnull
    rcases hconn.subset_or_subset hopen0 hopen1 hdisj hcover with h | h
    · left
      apply measure_null_of_locally_null
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := h hx.1
      exact ⟨(O ∩ K) ∩ N, inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hN,
        measure_mono_null (fun y (hy : y ∈ (O ∩ K) ∩ N) => (⟨hy.2, hy.1.2⟩ : y ∈ N ∩ K)) hN0⟩
    · right
      apply measure_null_of_locally_null
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := h hx.1
      exact ⟨(O \ K) ∩ N, inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hN,
        measure_mono_null (fun y (hy : y ∈ (O \ K) ∩ N) => (⟨hy.2, hy.1.2⟩ : y ∈ N \ K)) hN0⟩
  
  have s2 : ∀ x y : E3,
      IsPreconnected {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ x z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ y z < 0} := by
    intro x y
    apply Convex.isPreconnected
    intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ s t hs ht hst
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right] at hz₁ hz₂ ⊢
    rcases hs.eq_or_lt with hs0 | hs0
    · subst hs0
      have ht1 : t = 1 := by linarith
      subst ht1
      constructor <;> linarith [hz₂.1, hz₂.2]
    · have a1 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hs0 hz₁.1
      have a2 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hs0 hz₁.2
      have b1 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht hz₂.1.le
      have b2 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ht hz₂.2.le
      constructor <;> linarith
  
  have s3 : ∀ x y : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ e x = 0 → @inner ℝ E3 _ e y = 0 →
      (∀ φ ∈ Φ, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 φ, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) →
        ¬ (@inner ℝ E3 _ x φ < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ y φ < 0)) →
      ∀ z ∈ {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ x z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ y z < 0},
        ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ L) = 0 ∨ volume (N \ L) = 0 := by
    intro x y hex hey havoid z hz
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hxe : @inner ℝ E3 _ x e = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hex
    have hye : @inner ℝ E3 _ y e = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hey
    have hxw : @inner ℝ E3 _ x (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e) = @inner ℝ E3 _ x z := by
      rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, hxe, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    have hyw : @inner ℝ E3 _ y (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e) = @inner ℝ E3 _ y z := by
      rw [inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, hye, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    have hw0 : z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have := hz.1
      rw [← hxw, h, inner_zero_right] at this
      exact lt_irrefl _ this
    have hBw : ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e),
        volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0 := by
      have h := htr (-(@inner ℝ E3 _ e z)) z hcon
      rwa [neg_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at h
    have hφ := hrays z hcon hw0
    have hpos : 0 < ‖z - @inner ℝ E3 _ e z • e‖⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 (norm_pos_iff.2 hw0)
    have hBφ := hdil _ hpos _ hBw
    apply havoid _ hφ hBφ
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, hxw, hyw]
    exact ⟨mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hpos hz.1, mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hpos hz.2⟩
  
  have hee : @inner ℝ E3 _ e e = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, he]; norm_num
  have s4 : ∀ a b v : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ e a = 0 → @inner ℝ E3 _ e b = 0 →
      LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b] → @inner ℝ E3 _ e v = 0 → ∃ s t : ℝ, v = s • a + t • b := by
    intro a b v hea heb hab hev
    have hnot : e ∉ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![a, b]) := by
      intro h
      rw [Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at h
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at hc
      have h2 := congrArg (fun w => @inner ℝ E3 _ e w) hc
      simp only [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, hea, heb, hee] at h2
      norm_num at h2
    have hind3 : LinearIndependent ℝ ![e, a, b] := by
      have : LinearIndependent ℝ (Fin.cons e ![a, b] : Fin 3 → E3) :=
        linearIndependent_fin_cons.2 ⟨hab, hnot⟩
      exact this
    have htop := hind3.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank (by simp)
    have hv : v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![e, a, b]) := by rw [htop]; trivial
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hv
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hv
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_cons] at hc
    have h2 := congrArg (fun w => @inner ℝ E3 _ e w) hc
    simp only [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, hea, heb, hee, hev] at h2
    have hc0 : c 0 = 0 := by linarith
    refine ⟨c 1, c 2, ?_⟩
    rw [← hc, hc0, zero_smul, zero_add]
  
  have sβ : ∀ a b : E3, ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖b‖ = 1 → ∀ s t : ℝ,
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ a b • a - b) (s • a + t • b) =
        -t * (1 - @inner ℝ E3 _ a b ^ 2) ∧
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ a b • b - a) (s • a + t • b) =
        -s * (1 - @inner ℝ E3 _ a b ^ 2) := by
    intro a b ha hb s t
    have haa : @inner ℝ E3 _ a a = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, ha]; norm_num
    have hbb : @inner ℝ E3 _ b b = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hb]; norm_num
    have hba : @inner ℝ E3 _ b a = @inner ℝ E3 _ a b := real_inner_comm _ _
    constructor
    · simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
        haa, hbb, hba]
      ring
    · simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
        haa, hbb, hba]
      ring
  have sα : ∀ a b : E3, ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖b‖ = 1 → LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b] →
      0 < 1 - @inner ℝ E3 _ a b ^ 2 := by
    intro a b ha hb hab
    have haa : @inner ℝ E3 _ a a = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, ha]; norm_num
    have hbb : @inner ℝ E3 _ b b = 1 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hb]; norm_num
    have hba : @inner ℝ E3 _ b a = @inner ℝ E3 _ a b := real_inner_comm _ _
    have hne : b - @inner ℝ E3 _ a b • a ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have := (LinearIndependent.pair_iff.1 hab (-(@inner ℝ E3 _ a b)) 1
        (by rw [neg_smul, one_smul, ← h]; abel)).2
      exact one_ne_zero this
    have hpos : 0 < ‖b - @inner ℝ E3 _ a b • a‖ ^ 2 := pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.2 hne) 2
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hpos
    simp only [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
      haa, hbb, hba] at hpos
    nlinarith
  
  have s5 : ∀ Ψ : Finset E3, (∀ ψ ∈ Ψ, ‖ψ‖ = 1) →
      (∀ a ∈ Ψ, ∀ b ∈ Ψ, LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b] → ∀ v ∈ Ψ,
        ∃ s t : ℝ, v = s • a + t • b) →
      (∃ a ∈ Ψ, ∃ b ∈ Ψ, LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b] ∧ ∀ φ ∈ Ψ,
        ¬ (@inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ a b • a - b) φ < 0 ∧
          @inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ a b • b - a) φ < 0)) ∨
      ∀ a ∈ Ψ, ∀ b ∈ Ψ, ¬ LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b] := by
    intro Ψ hunit hspan
    have posL : ∀ x k : ℝ, 0 < k → -x * k < 0 → 0 < x := by
      intro x k hk h
      by_contra hx
      push_neg at hx
      have := mul_nonneg (neg_nonneg.2 hx) hk.le
      linarith
    have negL : ∀ x k : ℝ, 0 < x → 0 < k → -x * k < 0 := by
      intro x k hx hk
      rw [neg_mul, neg_lt_zero]
      exact mul_pos hx hk
    by_cases hS : ((Ψ ×ˢ Ψ).filter
        (fun p : E3 × E3 => LinearIndependent ℝ ![p.1, p.2])).Nonempty
    swap
    · right
      intro a ha b hb hab
      exact hS ⟨(a, b), Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨ha, hb⟩, hab⟩⟩
    left
    obtain ⟨p, hpS, hpmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image _
      (fun p : E3 × E3 => (Ψ.filter (fun v =>
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p.1 p.2 • p.1 - p.2) v < 0 ∧
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p.1 p.2 • p.2 - p.1) v < 0)).card) hS
    obtain ⟨hpΨ, hab⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hpS
    obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := Finset.mem_product.1 hpΨ
    refine ⟨p.1, ha, p.2, hb, hab, ?_⟩
    intro φ hφ hcone
    obtain ⟨σ, τ, hφeq⟩ := hspan p.1 ha p.2 hb hab φ hφ
    have hau := hunit _ ha
    have hbu := hunit _ hb
    have hφu := hunit _ hφ
    have hκ := sα p.1 p.2 hau hbu hab
    have hβ := sβ p.1 p.2 hau hbu σ τ
    have hcone' := hcone
    rw [hφeq, hβ.1, hβ.2] at hcone'
    have hτ : 0 < τ := posL τ _ hκ hcone'.1
    have hσ : 0 < σ := posL σ _ hκ hcone'.2
    have hind' : LinearIndependent ℝ ![p.1, φ] := by
      rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
      intro x y hxy
      have h' : (x + y * σ) • p.1 + (y * τ) • p.2 = 0 := by
        rw [← hxy, hφeq]; simp only [smul_add, smul_smul, add_smul]; abel
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := LinearIndependent.pair_iff.1 hab _ _ h'
      have hy : y = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h2 with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h hτ.ne'
      refine ⟨?_, hy⟩
      rw [hy] at h1
      linarith
    have hφS : (p.1, φ) ∈ (Ψ ×ˢ Ψ).filter
        (fun p : E3 × E3 => LinearIndependent ℝ ![p.1, p.2]) :=
      Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨ha, hφ⟩, hind'⟩
    have hle := hpmin _ hφS
    have hsub : Ψ.filter (fun v =>
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p.1 φ • p.1 - φ) v < 0 ∧
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p.1 φ • φ - p.1) v < 0) ⊆ Ψ.filter (fun v =>
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p.1 p.2 • p.1 - p.2) v < 0 ∧
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p.1 p.2 • p.2 - p.1) v < 0) := by
      intro v hv
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hv ⊢
      obtain ⟨hvΨ, hvc⟩ := hv
      obtain ⟨s', t', hveq⟩ := hspan p.1 ha φ hφ hind' v hvΨ
      have hκ' := sα p.1 φ hau hφu hind'
      have hβ' := sβ p.1 φ hau hφu s' t'
      rw [hveq, hβ'.1, hβ'.2] at hvc
      have ht' : 0 < t' := posL t' _ hκ' hvc.1
      have hs' : 0 < s' := posL s' _ hκ' hvc.2
      refine ⟨hvΨ, ?_⟩
      have hv2 : v = (s' + t' * σ) • p.1 + (t' * τ) • p.2 := by
        rw [hveq, hφeq]; simp only [smul_add, smul_smul, add_smul]; abel
      have hβ2 := sβ p.1 p.2 hau hbu (s' + t' * σ) (t' * τ)
      rw [hv2, hβ2.1, hβ2.2]
      have h1 : 0 < t' * τ := mul_pos ht' hτ
      have h2 : 0 < s' + t' * σ := by have := mul_pos ht' hσ; linarith
      exact ⟨negL _ _ h1 hκ, negL _ _ h2 hκ⟩
    have hnotin : φ ∉ Ψ.filter (fun v =>
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p.1 φ • p.1 - φ) v < 0 ∧
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p.1 φ • φ - p.1) v < 0) := by
      intro hmem
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hmem
      have h2 := hmem.2.2
      have hφ01 : (0:ℝ) • p.1 + (1:ℝ) • φ = φ := by simp
      have hz := (sβ p.1 φ hau hφu 0 1).2
      rw [hφ01] at hz
      rw [hz, neg_zero, zero_mul] at h2
      exact lt_irrefl _ h2
    have hlt := Finset.card_lt_card ((Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset hsub).2
      ⟨φ, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hφ, hcone⟩, hnotin⟩)
    exact absurd hle (not_le.2 hlt)
  
  have s6 : ∀ a : E3, ∃ n : E3, ‖n‖ = 1 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ e n = 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ a n = 0 := by
    intro a
    have hK : Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![e, a])) ≤ 2 :=
      (finrank_range_le_card (R := ℝ) ![e, a]).trans (by simp)
    have hsum := Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![e, a]))
    rw [finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin] at hsum
    have hne : (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![e, a]))ᗮ ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro h
      rw [h, finrank_bot] at hsum
      omega
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hm0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
    have hmpos : 0 < ‖m‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hm0
    have he' : e ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![e, a]) :=
      Submodule.subset_span (⟨0, rfl⟩ : e ∈ Set.range ![e, a])
    have ha' : a ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![e, a]) :=

      exact ⟨hz.1.2, hz.2⟩
    · refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null hT1E hT2E)
      rintro z ⟨⟨hP, h | h⟩, hzE⟩
      · refine Or.inl ⟨⟨?_, hP.1⟩, hzE⟩
        rw [inner_neg_left]; linarith
      · refine Or.inr ⟨⟨?_, hP.2⟩, hzE⟩
        rw [inner_neg_left]; linarith
  
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨdef⟩ : ∃ Ψ : Finset E3, Ψ = Φ.filter
      (fun φ => ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 φ, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΨmem : ∀ ψ : E3, ψ ∈ Ψ ↔
      ψ ∈ Φ ∧ ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 ψ, volume (N ∩ L) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ L) ≠ 0 := by
    intro ψ; rw [hΨdef, Finset.mem_filter]
  have hΨunit : ∀ ψ ∈ Ψ, ‖ψ‖ = 1 := fun ψ h => (hΦ ψ ((hΨmem ψ).1 h).1).1
  have hΨe : ∀ ψ ∈ Ψ, @inner ℝ E3 _ e ψ = 0 := fun ψ h => (hΦ ψ ((hΨmem ψ).1 h).1).2
  have hspan : ∀ a ∈ Ψ, ∀ b ∈ Ψ, LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b] → ∀ v ∈ Ψ,
      ∃ s t : ℝ, v = s • a + t • b :=
    fun a ha b hb hab v hv => s4 a b v (hΨe a ha) (hΨe b hb) hab (hΨe v hv)
  have hcolor : ∀ x y : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ e x = 0 → @inner ℝ E3 _ e y = 0 →
      (∀ φ ∈ Ψ, ¬ (@inner ℝ E3 _ x φ < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ y φ < 0)) →
      volume ({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ x z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ y z < 0} ∩ L) = 0 ∨
        volume ({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ x z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ y z < 0} \ L) = 0 := by
    intro x y hex hey hav
    exact s1 L _ (s2 x y) (s3 x y hex hey (fun φ hφ hB => hav φ ((hΨmem φ).2 ⟨hφ, hB⟩)))
  have hne0 : ∀ q : E3, ‖q‖ = 1 → q ≠ 0 := by
    intro q hq h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hq; exact zero_ne_one hq
  rcases s5 Ψ hΨunit hspan with ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab, hcorner⟩ | hdep
  · right
    obtain ⟨q₁, q₂, δ, hq₁, hq₂, hind, hδ, heq₁, heq₂, ha1, ha2, hb2, hb1, hiff, hav₁, hav₂⟩ :=
      s9 a b Ψ (hΨunit a ha) (hΨunit b hb) (hΨe a ha) (hΨe b hb) hab
    have hQ := hcolor q₁ q₂ heq₁ heq₂ (fun φ hφ h => hcorner φ hφ ((hiff φ).1 h))
    have he1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ e (-q₁) = 0 := by rw [inner_neg_right, heq₁, neg_zero]
    have he2 : @inner ℝ E3 _ e (-q₂) = 0 := by rw [inner_neg_right, heq₂, neg_zero]
    have he3 : @inner ℝ E3 _ e (q₁ + δ • q₂) = 0 := by
      rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, heq₁, heq₂, mul_zero, add_zero]
    have he4 : @inner ℝ E3 _ e (q₂ + δ • q₁) = 0 := by
      rw [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, heq₁, heq₂, mul_zero, add_zero]
    have hT₁ := hcolor (-q₁) (q₁ + δ • q₂) he1 he3 hav₁
    have hT₂ := hcolor (-q₂) (q₂ + δ • q₁) he2 he4 hav₂
    exact s10 q₁ q₂ a b δ hq₁ hq₂ hind hδ ha1 ha2 hb2 hb1 ((hΨmem a).1 ha).2
      ((hΨmem b).1 hb).2 (s7 q₁ (hne0 q₁ hq₁)) (s7 q₂ (hne0 q₂ hq₂)) hQ hT₁ hT₂
  · left
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hen, hall⟩ : ∃ n : E3, ‖n‖ = 1 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ e n = 0 ∧
        ∀ φ ∈ Ψ, @inner ℝ E3 _ n φ = 0 := by
      by_cases hne : Ψ.Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hne
        obtain ⟨n, hn, hen, han⟩ := s6 a
        refine ⟨n, hn, hen, fun φ hφ => ?_⟩
        have hnd := hdep a ha φ hφ
        rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at hnd
        push_neg at hnd
        obtain ⟨s, t, hst, hst0⟩ := hnd
        have h := congrArg (fun w => @inner ℝ E3 _ n w) hst
        simp only [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, inner_zero_right] at h
        have hna : @inner ℝ E3 _ n a = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact han
        rw [hna, mul_zero, zero_add] at h
        rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h with ht | ht
        · exfalso
          have hs : s ≠ 0 := fun hs0 => hst0 hs0 ht
          rw [ht, zero_smul, add_zero] at hst
          rcases smul_eq_zero.1 hst with h' | h'
          · exact hs h'
          · exact hne0 a (hΨunit a ha) h'
        · exact ht
      · rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
        obtain ⟨n, hn, hen, -⟩ := s6 e
        refine ⟨n, hn, hen, fun φ hφ => ?_⟩
        rw [hne] at hφ
        simp at hφ
    have hA := hcolor n n hen hen (fun φ hφ h => by
      rw [hall φ hφ] at h; exact lt_irrefl _ h.1)
    have hen' : @inner ℝ E3 _ e (-n) = 0 := by rw [inner_neg_right, hen, neg_zero]
    have hB := hcolor (-n) (-n) hen' hen' (fun φ hφ h => by
      rw [inner_neg_left, hall φ hφ, neg_zero] at h; exact lt_irrefl _ h.1)
    exact s8 n hn (s7 n (hne0 n hn)) hA hB

informal_problem.statement: (E : Set E3) (q₁ q₂ p₁ p₂ : E3) (hmin : sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) E Set.univ) (hq₁ : ‖q₁‖ = 1) (hq₂ : ‖q₂‖ = 1) (hind : LinearIndependent ℝ ![q₁, q₂]) (hW : ∀ z : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z ≤ 0 → @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z ≤ 0 → (@inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z = 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z = 0) ∨ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0)) (hS : volume ({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0} ∩ {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z < 0} ∩ E) = 0) (hN : volume (({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0} ∩ {z : E3 | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z ∨ 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z}) \ E) = 0) : False

signature.statement: (E : Set E3) (q₁ q₂ p₁ p₂ : E3) (hmin : sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) E Set.univ) (hq₁ : ‖q₁‖ = 1) (hq₂ : ‖q₂‖ = 1) (hind : LinearIndependent ℝ ![q₁, q₂]) (hW : ∀ z : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z ≤ 0 → @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z ≤ 0 → (@inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z = 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z = 0) ∨ (@inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0)) (hS : volume ({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0} ∩ {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z < 0} ∩ E) = 0) (hN : volume (({z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0} ∩ {z : E3 | 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ z ∨ 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ z}) \ E) = 0) : False

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hcyl : ∀ a b c : ℝ, (cylPt a b c) 0 = a ∧ (cylPt a b c) 1 = b ∧ (cylPt a b c) 2 = c := by
    intro a b c
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hcont : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z : E3 => z i) := fun i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i).continuous
  
  obtain ⟨β, σ, τ, hσ, hτ, hq₁β, hq₂β⟩ := wedge_orthoframe q₁ q₂ hq₁ hq₂ hind
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : E3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E3, Ψ = β.repr.symm := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hβc : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (w : E3), @inner ℝ E3 _ (β i) (Ψ w) = w i := by
    intro i w
    rw [hΨ, ← OrthonormalBasis.repr_apply_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hc₁ : ∀ w : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ (Ψ w) = -σ * w 0 + τ * w 1 := by
    intro w
    rw [hq₁β, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, hβc, hβc]
  have hc₂ : ∀ w : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ (Ψ w) = -σ * w 0 - τ * w 1 := by
    intro w
    rw [hq₂β, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, hβc, hβc]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨k, hkdef⟩ : ∃ k : ℝ, k = σ / τ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hk : 0 < k := by rw [hkdef]; exact div_pos hσ hτ
  have hkτ : ∀ x : ℝ, τ * (k * x) = σ * x := by
    intro x
    rw [hkdef]
    field_simp
  have hmin₁ : sepIsPerMin (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (Ψ ⁻¹' E) Set.univ := by
    have hsymm1 : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y i j =
        (fun _ : E3 => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y j i := by
      intro y i j
      show (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j = (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) j i
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · rw [hij]
      · rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne hij, Matrix.one_apply_ne (Ne.symm hij)]
    have hA := (sepAffinePullback (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) E Set.univ isOpen_univ
      hmin.1 (fun i j => contDiffOn_const) hsymm1
      (fun _ _ => Matrix.PosDef.one) 0 Ψ.toContinuousLinearEquiv 1 one_pos).2.2.2.2 hmin
    have hfd : ∀ z : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun w => (0 : E3) + Ψ.toContinuousLinearEquiv w) z =
        (Ψ.toContinuousLinearEquiv : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) := by
      intro z
      rw [fderiv_const_add]
      exact ContinuousLinearEquiv.fderiv _
    have hsum : ∀ v w : E3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        v i * (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j * w j = @inner ℝ E3 _ v w := by
      intro v w
      simp [Matrix.one_apply, PiLp.inner_apply, mul_comm, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hmet : (fun z => (1:ℝ) • pullbackMetric (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
        (fun w => (0 : E3) + Ψ.toContinuousLinearEquiv w) z) =
        fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) := by
      funext z
      ext a b
      rw [one_smul]
      simp only [pullbackMetric, hfd]
      rw [hsum]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Matrix.one_apply, eq_comm]
    have hpre : (fun w => (0 : E3) + Ψ.toContinuousLinearEquiv w) ⁻¹' E = Ψ ⁻¹' E := by
      ext w; simp
    rw [hmet, hpre, Set.preimage_univ] at hA
    exact hA
  obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : Set E3,
      W = {z : E3 | @inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z < 0} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hWopen : IsOpen W := by
    rw [hWdef]
    exact IsOpen.inter (isOpen_lt (f := fun z : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ p₁ z) (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
      (isOpen_lt (f := fun z : E3 => @inner ℝ E3 _ p₂ z) (by fun_prop) continuous_const)
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set E3, O = Ψ ⁻¹' W := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hO : IsOpen O := by rw [hOdef]; exact hWopen.preimage Ψ.continuous
  
  have hsub : ∀ z : E3, 0 < z 0 → |z 1| ≤ k * z 0 → z ∈ O := by
    intro w hw0 hw1
    have h1 : τ * |w 1| ≤ σ * w 0 := by
      rw [← hkτ]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw1 hτ.le
    have h2 : τ * w 1 ≤ τ * |w 1| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self _) hτ.le
    have h3 : τ * (-w 1) ≤ τ * |w 1| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_le_abs _) hτ.le
    have hσw : 0 < σ * w 0 := mul_pos hσ hw0
    rw [hOdef, Set.mem_preimage]
    rcases hW (Ψ w) (by rw [hc₁]; linarith) (by rw [hc₂]; linarith) with h | h
    · rw [hc₁, hc₂] at h
      linarith [h.1, h.2]
    · rw [hWdef]; exact h
  
  have hmp : MeasurePreserving Ψ := Ψ.measurePreserving
  have hS₁ : volume (O ∩ {z : E3 | |z 1| < k * z 0} ∩ Ψ ⁻¹' E) = 0 := by
    apply measure_mono_null _ (hmp.quasiMeasurePreserving.preimage_null hS)
    rintro w ⟨⟨hwO, hw⟩, hwE⟩
    rw [hOdef, Set.mem_preimage, hWdef] at hwO
    refine ⟨⟨hwO, ?_⟩, hwE⟩
    have hw' : |w 1| < k * w 0 := hw
    have h1 : τ * |w 1| < σ * w 0 := by
      rw [← hkτ]; exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hw' hτ
    have h2 : τ * w 1 ≤ τ * |w 1| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self _) hτ.le
    have h3 : τ * (-w 1) ≤ τ * |w 1| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_le_abs _) hτ.le
    show @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ (Ψ w) < 0 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ (Ψ w) < 0
    rw [hc₁, hc₂]
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hN₁ : volume ((O ∩ {z : E3 | k * z 0 < |z 1|}) \ Ψ ⁻¹' E) = 0 := by
    apply measure_mono_null _ (hmp.quasiMeasurePreserving.preimage_null hN)
    rintro w ⟨⟨hwO, hw⟩, hwE⟩
    rw [hOdef, Set.mem_preimage, hWdef] at hwO
    refine ⟨⟨hwO, ?_⟩, hwE⟩
    have hw' : k * w 0 < |w 1| := hw
    have h1 : σ * w 0 < τ * |w 1| := by
      rw [← hkτ]; exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hw' hτ
    show 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ q₁ (Ψ w) ∨ 0 < @inner ℝ E3 _ q₂ (Ψ w)
    rw [hc₁, hc₂]
    rcases le_or_gt 0 (w 1) with h | h
    · left; rw [abs_of_nonneg h] at h1; linarith
    · right; rw [abs_of_neg h] at h1; linarith
  
  have hgainE : ∃ s₁ s₂ h θ : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ θ < s₁ ∧ s₁ < s₂ ∧ 0 < h ∧
      2 * Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) * ((s₂ + θ - (s₁ - θ)) * (2 * (h + θ)) - (s₂ - s₁) * (2 * h)) +
        4 * k * h * (s₁ + s₂) + 4 * k * s₂ * (s₂ - s₁) <
        4 * Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) * h * (s₂ - s₁) := by
    obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hcdef]
    have hc2 : c ^ 2 = 1 + k ^ 2 := by rw [hcdef]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
    have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := by rw [hcdef]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hck : k < c := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul hcon hcon hc0 hk.le]
    have hckp : 0 < c + k := by linarith
    have hckm : 0 < c - k := by linarith
    have hckp' : c + k ≠ 0 := hckp.ne'
    have hckm' : c - k ≠ 0 := hckm.ne'
    obtain ⟨s, hsdef⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = (c - k) / (2 * (c + k)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨H0, hHdef⟩ : ∃ H0 : ℝ, H0 = 4 * k / (c - k) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs' : s * (2 * (c + k)) = c - k := by
      rw [hsdef]; field_simp
    have hH' : H0 * (c - k) = 4 * k := by
      rw [hHdef]; field_simp
    have hs0 : 0 < s := by rw [hsdef]; exact div_pos hckm (by linarith)
    have hs1 : s < 1 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcon hckp.le
      linarith
    have hH0 : 0 < H0 := by rw [hHdef]; exact div_pos (by linarith) hckm
    have hden : 0 < 2 * c * (3 + 2 * H0) := by
      have : 0 < c := by linarith
      positivity
    obtain ⟨θ, hθdef⟩ : ∃ θ : ℝ, θ = min (s / 2) (k / (2 * c * (3 + 2 * H0))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hθ0 : 0 < θ := by rw [hθdef]; exact lt_min (by linarith) (div_pos hk hden)
    have hθ1 : θ ≤ s / 2 := by rw [hθdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hθ2 : θ * (2 * c * (3 + 2 * H0)) ≤ k := by
      have : θ ≤ k / (2 * c * (3 + 2 * H0)) := by rw [hθdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
      rwa [le_div_iff₀ hden] at this
    refine ⟨s, 1, H0, θ, hθ0, by linarith, hs1, hH0, ?_⟩
    have hcθ : 0 ≤ c * θ := mul_nonneg hc0 hθ0.le
    have hp := mul_nonneg hcθ (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 - (1 - s + 2 * θ))
    have hks := mul_pos hk hs0
    have e1 : H0 * (s * (2 * (c + k))) = H0 * (c - k) := by rw [hs']
    linarith [hp, hθ2, e1, hH', hks]
  obtain ⟨s₁, s₂, h, θ, hθ, hθs, hs, hh, hgain⟩ := hgainE
  have hs₁ : 0 < s₁ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨k', hk', hbox⟩ :=
    wedge_box_in_open k (s₁ - θ) (s₂ + θ) (h + θ) O hk (by linarith) hO hsub
  have hk'0 : 0 < k' := by linarith
  
  have hnorm : ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ ≤ |z 0| + |z 1| + |z 2| := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h0 := abs_nonneg (z 0)
    have h1 := abs_nonneg (z 1)
    have h2 := abs_nonneg (z 2)
    calc Real.sqrt (|z 0| ^ 2 + |z 1| ^ 2 + |z 2| ^ 2)
        ≤ Real.sqrt ((|z 0| + |z 1| + |z 2|) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith)
      _ = |z 0| + |z 1| + |z 2| := Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)
  have hcpt : ∀ (A B C : ℝ) (S : Set E3), IsClosed S →
      (∀ z ∈ S, |z 0| ≤ A ∧ |z 1| ≤ B ∧ |z 2| ≤ C) → IsCompact S := by
    intro A B C S hS hb
    refine Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hS ?_
    rw [isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le]
    exact ⟨A + B + C, fun z hz => by
      obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := hb z hz
      linarith [hnorm z]⟩
  
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : Set E3, V = {z : E3 | s₁ - θ < z 0 ∧ z 0 < s₂ + θ ∧
      |z 1| < k' * z 0 ∧ |z 2| < h + θ} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVopen : IsOpen V := by
    rw [hVdef]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const (hcont 0)).inter ((isOpen_lt (hcont 0) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt (hcont 1).abs (continuous_const.mul (hcont 0))).inter
        (isOpen_lt (hcont 2).abs continuous_const)))
  obtain ⟨Bc, hBcdef⟩ : ∃ Bc : Set E3, Bc = {z : E3 | s₁ - θ ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ s₂ + θ ∧
      |z 1| ≤ k' * z 0 ∧ |z 2| ≤ h + θ} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hBcclosed : IsClosed Bc := by
    rw [hBcdef]
    exact (isClosed_le continuous_const (hcont 0)).inter ((isClosed_le (hcont 0) continuous_const).inter
      ((isClosed_le (hcont 1).abs (continuous_const.mul (hcont 0))).inter
        (isClosed_le (hcont 2).abs continuous_const)))
  have hVBc : V ⊆ Bc := by
    rw [hVdef, hBcdef]
    rintro z ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    exact ⟨h1.le, h2.le, h3.le, h4.le⟩
  have hclV : closure V ⊆ Bc := closure_minimal hVBc hBcclosed
  have hBcbd : ∀ z ∈ Bc, |z 0| ≤ s₂ + θ ∧ |z 1| ≤ k' * (s₂ + θ) ∧ |z 2| ≤ h + θ := by
    rw [hBcdef]
    rintro z ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    have hz0 : 0 < z 0 := by linarith
    exact ⟨by rw [abs_of_pos hz0]; exact h2, h3.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hk'0.le), h4⟩
  have hVcpt : IsCompact (closure V) :=
    hcpt _ _ _ _ isClosed_closure (fun z hz => hBcbd z (hclV hz))
  have hVO : V ⊆ O := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' := hVBc hz
    rw [hBcdef] at hz'
    exact hbox z hz'.1 hz'.2.1 hz'.2.2.1 hz'.2.2.2

subgoal_signatures.name: sepAffinePullback
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hF : MeasurableSet F) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (y₀ : E3) (L : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∀ V : Set E3, V ⊆ U →
      sepPerG (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
          ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' V) =
        ENNReal.ofReal c * sepPerG G F V) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z => (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j)
      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U)) ∧
    (∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) i j =
      (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z) j i) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ (fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U, (c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z).PosDef) ∧
    (sepIsPerMin G F U → sepIsPerMin (fun z => c • pullbackMetric G (fun w => y₀ + L w) z)
      ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' F) ((fun w => y₀ + L w) ⁻¹' U))

    intro i a
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Φ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hΦ).2
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ Φ z (e a)) := h1.clm_apply contDiff_const
    have h3 := (contDiff_piLp 2).1 h2 i
    simp only [jacMat, Matrix.of_apply]
    exact h3
  
  have hAdj : ∀ a i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => (jacMat Φ z).adjugate a i) := by
    have h00 := hJ 0 0
    have h01 := hJ 0 1
    have h02 := hJ 0 2
    have h10 := hJ 1 0
    have h11 := hJ 1 1
    have h12 := hJ 1 2
    have h20 := hJ 2 0
    have h21 := hJ 2 1
    have h22 := hJ 2 2
    intro a i
    simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases i <;> simp <;> fun_prop
  
  have hdetEq : ∀ y, (fderiv ℝ Φ y).det = (jacMat Φ y).det := by
    intro y
    show LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ Φ y : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) = _
    rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis]
    congr 1
  
  have hcov : ∀ g : E3 → ℝ, ∫ x in Φ '' F, g x = ∫ y in F, (jacMat Φ y).det * g (Φ y) := by
    intro g
    rw [integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hF
      (fun y _ => (hΦ.differentiable (by simp) y).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hinj.injOn g]
    refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_))
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, hdetEq, abs_of_pos (hdet y)]
  
  unfold sepPerG
  apply iSup₂_le
  intro X hX
  obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXV, hX1⟩ := hX
  have hXi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w => X w i) := fun i => (contDiff_piLp 2).1 hXs i
  
  obtain ⟨Y, hYa⟩ : ∃ Y : E3 → E3, ∀ (z : E3) (a : Fin 3),
      Y z a = ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ z).adjugate a i * (M⁻¹ * X (Φ z) i) :=
    ⟨fun z => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun a => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ z).adjugate a i * (M⁻¹ * X (Φ z) i)),
      fun z a => rfl⟩
  have hYfun : ∀ a : Fin 3, (fun z => Y z a)
      = fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ z).adjugate a i * (M⁻¹ * X (Φ z) i) :=
    fun a => funext fun z => hYa z a
  have hYs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y := by
