    refine (contDiff_piLp 2).2 fun a => ?_
    have e1 := hYfun a
    simp only at e1
    rw [e1]
    exact ContDiff.sum fun i _ => (hAdj a i).mul (contDiff_const.mul ((hXi i).comp hΦ))
  have hY0 : ∀ z, X (Φ z) = 0 → Y z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    ext a
    rw [hYa]
    simp [hz]
  have hsuppY : tsupport Y ⊆ Φ ⁻¹' tsupport X := by
    refine closure_minimal (fun z hz => ?_) ((isClosed_tsupport X).preimage hΦ.continuous)
    by_contra h
    exact hz (hY0 z (image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport h))
  have hYc : HasCompactSupport Y :=
    (hprop _ hXc).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport Y) hsuppY
  have hYW : tsupport Y ⊆ W := hsuppY.trans ((Set.preimage_mono hXV).trans hVW)
  have hY1 : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    rw [hq]
    by_cases hy : y ∈ W
    · have hX : ∑ i : Fin 3, X (Φ y) i ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        rw [← hq]
        exact hX1 (Φ y)
      have h := hbd y hy (fun i => M⁻¹ * X (Φ y) i)
      have hM2 : M ^ 2 * (M⁻¹) ^ 2 = 1 := by
        rw [← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hM.ne', one_pow]
      have e2 : ∑ a : Fin 3, Y y a ^ 2 = ∑ a : Fin 3,
          (∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * (fun i => M⁻¹ * X (Φ y) i) i) ^ 2 := by
        simp only [hYa]
      rw [e2]
      refine h.trans (Eq.trans_le ?_ hX)
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, mul_pow]
      linear_combination (X (Φ y) 0 ^ 2 + X (Φ y) 1 ^ 2 + X (Φ y) 2 ^ 2) * hM2
    · have hX0 : X (Φ y) = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hy (hVW (hXV h)))
      rw [hY0 y hX0]
      simp
  
  have hdiv : ∀ y, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) Y y
      = (jacMat Φ y).det * (M⁻¹ * sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X (Φ y)) := by
    intro y
    rw [hdd, hdd]
    obtain ⟨hA, hP⟩ := piola_adjugate_div_zero Φ Set.univ isOpen_univ hΦ.contDiffOn y
      (Set.mem_univ y)
    have hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => M⁻¹ * X w i) (Φ y) :=
      fun i => ((contDiff_const.mul (hXi i)).differentiable (by simp)) _
    have h : ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a
        (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ z).adjugate a i * (M⁻¹ * X (Φ z) i)) y
        = (jacMat Φ y).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => M⁻¹ * X w i) (Φ y) :=
      piola_div_of_null Φ (fun w i => M⁻¹ * X w i) y (hΦ.differentiable (by simp) y) hA hW hP
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => by rw [hYfun a]), h]
    congr 1
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_const_mul ((hXi i).differentiable (by simp) _), ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hMinv : M * M⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hM.ne'
  have hint : ∫ x in Φ '' F, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X x
      = M * ∫ y in F, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) Y y := by
    rw [hcov, ← integral_const_mul]
    refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_))
    simp only [hdiv y]
    linear_combination
      (-((jacMat Φ y).det * sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X (Φ y))) * hMinv
  rw [hint, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hM.le]
  refine mul_le_mul_left' ?_ _
  exact le_iSup₂_of_le Y ⟨hYs, hYc, hYW, hY1⟩ le_rfl

subgoal_signatures.name: piola_div_of_null
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(Y : E3 → E3) (W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x)
    (hA : ∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x)
    (hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y i) (Y x))
    (hP : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x = 0) :
    ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i * W (Y z) i) x
      = (jacMat Y x).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => W y i) (Y x)

subgoal_signatures.name: piola_adjugate_div_zero
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(Y : E3 → E3) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y U) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    (∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x) ∧
    ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x = 0

informal_problem.statement: (P : ℝ → ℝ) (hP : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P) (y : E3) : (jacMat (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y).det = P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 * deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2))) ∧ ∀ M : ℝ, P (‖y‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ M → 0 ≤ P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 * deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2)) → P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 * deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2)) ≤ M → ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y).adjugate a i * v i) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2

signature.name: sepRadial_jac_adj_bound
signature.statement: (P : ℝ → ℝ) (hP : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P) (y : E3) : (jacMat (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y).det = P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 * deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2))) ∧ ∀ M : ℝ, P (‖y‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ M → 0 ≤ P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 * deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2)) → P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (P (‖y‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ‖y‖ ^ 2 * deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2)) ≤ M → ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y).adjugate a i * v i) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hA : ∀ i a : Fin 3, jacMat (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y i a =
      P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * (if i = a then 1 else 0) + 2 * deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2) * y a * y i := by
    intro i a
    have hN : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ y) y :=
      (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq y).hasFDerivAt
    have hPd : HasDerivAt P (deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2)) (‖y‖ ^ 2) :=
      ((hP.differentiable (by simp)) _).hasDerivAt
    have hC : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2))
        (deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • 2 • innerSL ℝ y) y :=
      hPd.comp_hasFDerivAt y hN
    have hF := hC.smul (hasFDerivAt_id y)
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y = _ := hF.fderiv
    simp only [jacMat, Matrix.of_apply]
    rw [hfd]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, innerSL_apply, id,
      PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, EuclideanSpace.single_apply,
      EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, conj_trivial, nsmul_eq_mul]
    split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> ring
  
  have s2 : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (p d u : ℝ),
      y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 = u →
      (∀ i a : Fin 3, A i a = p * (if i = a then 1 else 0) + 2 * d * y a * y i) →
      A.det = p * (p * (p + 2 * u * d)) ∧ ∀ a i : Fin 3,
        A.adjugate a i = p * (p + 2 * u * d) * (if a = i then 1 else 0)
          - 2 * p * d * y a * y i := by
    intro A p d u hu hA
    subst hu
    constructor
    · rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      simp only [hA]
      simp
      ring
    · intro a i
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [hA] <;> ring
  
  have s3 : ∀ (B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (p d u : ℝ),
      y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 = u →
      (∀ a i : Fin 3, B a i = p * (p + 2 * u * d) * (if a = i then 1 else 0)
        - 2 * p * d * y a * y i) →
      ∀ M : ℝ, p ^ 2 ≤ M → 0 ≤ p * (p + 2 * u * d) → p * (p + 2 * u * d) ≤ M →
      ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, B a i * v i) ^ 2 ≤
        M ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 := by
    intro B p d u hu hB M h1 h2 h3 v
    have hrow : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, B a i * v i =
        p * (p + 2 * u * d) * v a - 2 * p * d * y a * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1 + y 2 * v 2) := by
      intro a
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hB]
      fin_cases a <;> simp <;> ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => by rw [hrow a])]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hid : (p * (p + 2 * u * d) * v 0
          - 2 * p * d * y 0 * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1 + y 2 * v 2)) ^ 2 +
        (p * (p + 2 * u * d) * v 1 - 2 * p * d * y 1 * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1 + y 2 * v 2)) ^ 2 +
        (p * (p + 2 * u * d) * v 2 - 2 * p * d * y 2 * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1 + y 2 * v 2)) ^ 2
        = (p * (p + 2 * u * d)) ^ 2 * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2) +
          (-4 * p ^ 2 * d * (p + u * d)) * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1 + y 2 * v 2) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hu]; ring
    rw [hid]
    have hkey : (p * (p + 2 * u * d)) ^ 2 + (-4 * p ^ 2 * d * (p + u * d)) * u
        = (p ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
    have hV : 0 ≤ v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hs2 : (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1 + y 2 * v 2) ^ 2 ≤ u * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2) := by
      rw [← hu]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y 0 * v 1 - y 1 * v 0), sq_nonneg (y 0 * v 2 - y 2 * v 0),
        sq_nonneg (y 1 * v 2 - y 2 * v 1)]
    have hp2 : 0 ≤ p ^ 2 := sq_nonneg p
    have hM2a : (p * (p + 2 * u * d)) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ h2 h3 2
    have hM2p : (p ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hp2 h1 2
    rcases le_or_gt (-4 * p ^ 2 * d * (p + u * d)) 0 with hc | hc
    · have h4 : (-4 * p ^ 2 * d * (p + u * d)) * (y 0 * v 0 + y 1 * v 1 + y 2 * v 2) ^ 2 ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hc (sq_nonneg _)
      have h5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM2a hV
      linarith
    · have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs2 hc.le
      have h5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM2p hV
      have h6 : (p * (p + 2 * u * d)) ^ 2 * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2) +
          (-4 * p ^ 2 * d * (p + u * d)) * (u * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2)) =
          (p ^ 2) ^ 2 * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2) := by
        rw [← hkey]; ring
      linarith
  
  have hu : y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  obtain ⟨hdet, hadj⟩ := s2 (jacMat (fun z : E3 => P (‖z‖ ^ 2) • z) y) (P (‖y‖ ^ 2))
    (deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2)) (‖y‖ ^ 2) hu hA
  exact ⟨hdet, fun M h1 h2 h3 v => s3 _ (P (‖y‖ ^ 2)) (deriv P (‖y‖ ^ 2)) (‖y‖ ^ 2) hu hadj
    M h1 h2 h3 v⟩

informal_problem.statement: (P : ℝ → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hP : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P) (hPpos : ∀ u, 0 < P u) (hP1 : ∀ u, r ^ 2 ≤ u → P u = 1) (hmono : ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → 0 < P u * (P u + 2 * u * deriv P u)) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ∧ Function.Injective (fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ∧ (∀ y : E3, r ≤ ‖y‖ → P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y = y) ∧ (∀ S : Set E3, IsCompact S → IsCompact ((fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ⁻¹' S)) ∧ StrictMonoOn (fun s : ℝ => s * P (s ^ 2)) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ ∀ y : E3, ‖P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y‖ = ‖y‖ * P (‖y‖ ^ 2)

signature.name: sepRadial_map_props
signature.statement: (P : ℝ → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hP : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P) (hPpos : ∀ u, 0 < P u) (hP1 : ∀ u, r ^ 2 ≤ u → P u = 1) (hmono : ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → 0 < P u * (P u + 2 * u * deriv P u)) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ∧ Function.Injective (fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ∧ (∀ y : E3, r ≤ ‖y‖ → P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y = y) ∧ (∀ S : Set E3, IsCompact S → IsCompact ((fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ⁻¹' S)) ∧ StrictMonoOn (fun s : ℝ => s * P (s ^ 2)) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ ∀ y : E3, ‖P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y‖ = ‖y‖ * P (‖y‖ ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) :=
    (hP.comp (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ)).smul contDiff_id
  
  have hnorm : ∀ y : E3, ‖P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y‖ = ‖y‖ * P (‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro y
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (hPpos _), mul_comm]
  
  have hfix : ∀ y : E3, r ≤ ‖y‖ → P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y = y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hP1 _ (pow_le_pow_left₀ hr hy 2), one_smul]
  
  have hk : StrictMonoOn (fun s : ℝ => s * P (s ^ 2)) (Set.Ici 0) := by
    apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Ici 0)
    · exact (continuous_id.mul (hP.continuous.comp (continuous_pow 2))).continuousOn
    · intro s hs
      rw [interior_Ici] at hs
      have hPd : DifferentiableAt ℝ P (s ^ 2) := hP.differentiable (by simp) (s ^ 2)
      have hsq : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (2 * s) s := by
        simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 2 s
      have hc : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => P (x ^ 2)) (deriv P (s ^ 2) * (2 * s)) s :=
        HasDerivAt.comp (h := fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) s hPd.hasDerivAt hsq
      have hm : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x * P (x ^ 2))
          (1 * P (s ^ 2) + s * (deriv P (s ^ 2) * (2 * s))) s :=
        (hasDerivAt_id' s).mul hc
      rw [hm.deriv]
      have hpos := hmono (s ^ 2) (sq_nonneg s)
      have hb : 0 < P (s ^ 2) + 2 * s ^ 2 * deriv P (s ^ 2) :=
        pos_of_mul_pos_right hpos (hPpos _).le
      have heq : 1 * P (s ^ 2) + s * (deriv P (s ^ 2) * (2 * s)) =
          P (s ^ 2) + 2 * s ^ 2 * deriv P (s ^ 2) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      exact hb
  
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) := by
    intro y₁ y₂ h
    have h' : P (‖y₁‖ ^ 2) • y₁ = P (‖y₂‖ ^ 2) • y₂ := h
    have hn : ‖y₁‖ * P (‖y₁‖ ^ 2) = ‖y₂‖ * P (‖y₂‖ ^ 2) := by
      rw [← hnorm y₁, ← hnorm y₂, h']
    have hn' : ‖y₁‖ = ‖y₂‖ :=
      hk.injOn (Set.mem_Ici.2 (norm_nonneg y₁)) (Set.mem_Ici.2 (norm_nonneg y₂)) hn
    rw [hn'] at h'
    exact smul_right_injective E3 (hPpos (‖y₂‖ ^ 2)).ne' h'
  
  have hprop : ∀ S : Set E3, IsCompact S →
      IsCompact ((fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ⁻¹' S) := by
    intro S hS
    have hcl : IsClosed ((fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ⁻¹' S) :=
      hS.isClosed.preimage hΦ.continuous
    have hsub : (fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ⁻¹' S ⊆ S ∪ Metric.closedBall 0 r := by
      intro y hy
      rcases le_or_gt r ‖y‖ with h | h
      · left
        have hy' : P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y ∈ S := hy
        rw [hfix y h] at hy'
        exact hy'
      · right
        exact mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 h.le
    have hbd : Bornology.IsBounded ((fun y : E3 => P (‖y‖ ^ 2) • y) ⁻¹' S) :=
      (hS.isBounded.union Metric.isBounded_closedBall).subset hsub
    exact Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hcl hbd
  exact ⟨hΦ, hinj, hfix, hprop, hk, hnorm⟩

informal_problem.statement: (a b r K : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hba : b < a) (har : a < r) (hK : (r ^ 2 - b ^ 2) / (r ^ 2 - a ^ 2) < K) : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ P ∧ (∀ u, 0 < P u) ∧ (∀ u, u ≤ a ^ 2 → P u = b / a) ∧ (∀ u, u < a ^ 2 → deriv P u = 0) ∧ (∀ u, r ^ 2 ≤ u → P u = 1) ∧ ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → P u ^ 2 ≤ K ∧ 0 < P u * (P u + 2 * u * deriv P u) ∧ P u * (P u + 2 * u * deriv P u) ≤ K

signature.name: sepRadialProfile_inv_exists
signature.statement: (a b r K : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) (hba : b < a) (har : a < r) (hK : (r ^ 2 - b ^ 2) / (r ^ 2 - a ^ 2) < K) : ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ P ∧ (∀ u, 0 < P u) ∧ (∀ u, u ≤ a ^ 2 → P u = b / a) ∧ (∀ u, u < a ^ 2 → deriv P u = 0) ∧ (∀ u, r ^ 2 ≤ u → P u = 1) ∧ ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → P u ^ 2 ≤ K ∧ 0 < P u * (P u + 2 * u * deriv P u) ∧ P u * (P u + 2 * u * deriv P u) ≤ K

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hS2 : ∀ (α β c T K : ℝ), α < β → 0 < c → c < 1 → β - α < T → T < K * (β - α) →
      ∃ g : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧ (∀ u, u ≤ α → g u = c) ∧
      (∀ u, β ≤ u → g u = 1) ∧ (∀ u, 0 < g u ∧ g u ≤ K) ∧ ∫ u in α..β, g u = T := by
    intro α β c T K hαβ hc0 hc1 hLT hTK
    have hL0 : 0 < β - α := by linarith
    have hT0 : 0 < T := by linarith
    have hK0 : 0 < K := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      nlinarith
    have hK1 : 1 < K := by nlinarith
    have hTKL : T / K < β - α := by rw [div_lt_iff₀ hK0]; linarith
    have hTK0 : 0 < T / K := div_pos hT0 hK0
    have hKTK : K * (T / K) = T := mul_div_cancel₀ T hK0.ne'
    obtain ⟨σ, hσdef⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ, σ = (β - α - T / K) / 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hσ0 : 0 < σ := by rw [hσdef]; linarith
    have hσL : 4 * σ < β - α := by rw [hσdef]; linarith
    
    have hstep : ∀ p q : ℝ, p < q → ∃ τ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ τ ∧ (∀ u, u ≤ p → τ u = 0) ∧
        (∀ u, q ≤ u → τ u = 1) ∧ (∀ u, 0 ≤ τ u) ∧ (∀ u, τ u ≤ 1) := by
      intro p q hpq
      have hqp : 0 < q - p := by linarith
      refine ⟨fun u => Real.smoothTransition ((u - p) / (q - p)), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const _)
      · intro u hu
        apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
        exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hqp.le
      · intro u hu
        apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hqp]
        linarith
      · intro u
        exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      · intro u
        exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
    obtain ⟨τ₁, hτ₁s, hτ₁0, hτ₁1, hτ₁nn, hτ₁le⟩ := hstep α (α + σ) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨τ₂, hτ₂s, hτ₂0, hτ₂1, hτ₂nn, hτ₂le⟩ := hstep (β - σ) β (by linarith)
    have hτ₁c : Continuous τ₁ := hτ₁s.continuous
    have hτ₂c : Continuous τ₂ := hτ₂s.continuous
    have h21 : ∀ u, τ₂ u ≤ τ₁ u := by
      intro u
      rcases le_or_gt (α + σ) u with h | h
      · rw [hτ₁1 u h]; exact hτ₂le u
      · rw [hτ₂0 u (by linarith)]; exact hτ₁nn u
    
    have hec : Continuous (fun u => c * (1 - τ₁ u) + τ₂ u) := by fun_prop
    have hdc : Continuous (fun u => τ₁ u - τ₂ u) := by fun_prop
    have he01 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ c * (1 - τ₁ u) + τ₂ u ∧ c * (1 - τ₁ u) + τ₂ u ≤ 1 := by
      intro u
      rcases le_or_gt (α + σ) u with h | h
      · rw [hτ₁1 u h]
        constructor
        · nlinarith [hτ₂nn u]
        · nlinarith [hτ₂le u]
      · rw [hτ₂0 u (by linarith)]
        have h1 := hτ₁nn u
        have h2 := hτ₁le u
        constructor
        · nlinarith
        · nlinarith
    obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∫ u in α..β, (c * (1 - τ₁ u) + τ₂ u) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = ∫ u in α..β, (τ₁ u - τ₂ u) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by
      rw [hAdef]
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hαβ.le (fun u _ => (he01 u).1)
    have hAL : A ≤ β - α := by
      rw [hAdef]
      have h := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hαβ.le
        (hec.intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) α β)
        (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1 : ℝ))) (fun u _ => (he01 u).2)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
      exact h
    have hBL : β - α - 2 * σ ≤ B := by
      rw [hBdef]
      have hI := fun x y => hdc.intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) x y
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hI α (α + σ)) (hI (α + σ) β),
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hI (α + σ) (β - σ)) (hI (β - σ) β)]
      have h1 : 0 ≤ ∫ u in α..(α + σ), (τ₁ u - τ₂ u) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by linarith) (fun u _ => sub_nonneg.2 (h21 u))
      have h3 : 0 ≤ ∫ u in (β - σ)..β, (τ₁ u - τ₂ u) :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (by linarith) (fun u _ => sub_nonneg.2 (h21 u))
      have h2 : ∫ u in (α + σ)..(β - σ), (τ₁ u - τ₂ u) = (β - σ) - (α + σ) := by
        have heq : Set.EqOn (fun u => τ₁ u - τ₂ u) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
            (Set.uIcc (α + σ) (β - σ)) := by
          intro u hu
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at hu
          simp only
          rw [hτ₁1 u hu.1, hτ₂0 u hu.2, sub_zero]
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr heq, intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul,
          mul_one]
      rw [h2]
      linarith
    have hB0 : 0 < B := by linarith
    obtain ⟨m, hmdef⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, m = (T - A) / B := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hm0 : 0 < m := by rw [hmdef]; exact div_pos (by linarith) hB0
    have hmB : m * B = T - A := by rw [hmdef]; exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hB0.ne'
    have hmK : m < K := by
      rw [hmdef, div_lt_iff₀ hB0]
      have h1 : K * (β - α - 2 * σ) ≤ K * B := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBL hK0.le
      have h2 : K * (β - α - 2 * σ) = (K * (β - α) + T) / 2 := by
        rw [hσdef]
        linear_combination (1 / 2 : ℝ) * hKTK
      linarith
    refine ⟨fun u => c * (1 - τ₁ u) + τ₂ u + m * (τ₁ u - τ₂ u), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ => c) := contDiff_const
      have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ => m) := contDiff_const
      have h3 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) := contDiff_const
      exact ((h1.mul (h3.sub hτ₁s)).add hτ₂s).add (h2.mul (hτ₁s.sub hτ₂s))
    · intro u hu
      simp only
      rw [hτ₁0 u hu, hτ₂0 u (by linarith)]
      ring
    · intro u hu
      simp only
      rw [hτ₁1 u (by linarith), hτ₂1 u hu]
      ring
    · intro u
      simp only
      have hw0 : 0 ≤ 1 - τ₁ u := sub_nonneg.2 (hτ₁le u)
      have hw1 : 0 ≤ τ₁ u - τ₂ u := sub_nonneg.2 (h21 u)
      have hw2 : 0 ≤ τ₂ u := hτ₂nn u
      have hμc : min c m ≤ c := min_le_left _ _
      have hμm : min c m ≤ m := min_le_right _ _
      have hμ0 : 0 < min c m := lt_min hc0 hm0
      constructor
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hw0 (sub_nonneg.2 hμc), mul_nonneg hw1 (sub_nonneg.2 hμm),
          mul_nonneg hw2 (sub_nonneg.2 (show min c m ≤ 1 by linarith))]
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hw0 (sub_nonneg.2 (show c ≤ K by linarith)),
          mul_nonneg hw1 (sub_nonneg.2 hmK.le),
          mul_nonneg hw2 (sub_nonneg.2 hK1.le)]
    · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hec.intervalIntegrable α β)
        ((continuous_const.mul hdc).intervalIntegrable α β), intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        ← hAdef, ← hBdef, hmB]
      ring
  
  have hS3 : ∀ (α β c K : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < α → ContDiff ℝ ∞ g →
      (∀ u, u ≤ α → g u = c) → (∀ u, β ≤ u → g u = 1) → (∀ u, 0 < g u ∧ g u ≤ K) →
      ∫ u in α..β, g u = β - c * α → ∃ H : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ H ∧
      (∀ u, HasDerivAt H (g u) u) ∧ (∀ u, u ≤ α → H u = c * u) ∧ (∀ u, β ≤ u → H u = u) ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < u → 0 < H u) ∧ (∀ u, 0 ≤ u → H u ≤ K * u) := by
    intro α β c K g hα hg hgc hg1 hgb hint
    have hgC : Continuous g := hg.continuous
    have hI : ∀ x y : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable g volume x y :=
      fun x y => hgC.intervalIntegrable x y
    have hd : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..u, g t) (g u) u :=
      fun u => (hgC.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 u).hasDerivAt
    have hleft : ∀ u, u ≤ α → ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..u, g t = c * u := by
      intro u hu
      have heq : Set.EqOn g (fun _ => c) (Set.uIcc 0 u) := by
        intro t ht
        apply hgc
        rcases Set.mem_uIcc.1 ht with h | h
        · linarith [h.2]
        · linarith [h.2]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr heq, intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    refine ⟨fun u => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..u, g t, ?_, hd, hleft, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hder : deriv (fun u => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..u, g t) = g := funext fun u => (hd u).deriv
      exact contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.2 ⟨fun u => (hd u).differentiableAt, by rw [hder]; exact hg⟩
    · intro u hu
      simp only
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hI 0 α) (hI α u),
        ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hI α β) (hI β u), hleft α le_rfl,
        hint]
      have heq : Set.EqOn g (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (Set.uIcc β u) := by
        intro t ht
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hu] at ht
        exact hg1 t ht.1
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr heq, intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    · intro u hu
      exact intervalIntegral.intervalIntegral_pos_of_pos_on (hI 0 u) (fun x _ => (hgb x).1) hu
    · intro u hu
      have h := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hu (hI 0 u) (intervalIntegrable_const (c := K))
        (fun x _ => (hgb x).2)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul] at h
      simp only
      linarith
  
  have hS4 : ∀ (α β c K : ℝ) (H g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < α → α < β → 0 < c → c ≤ K →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ H → (∀ u, HasDerivAt H (g u) u) → (∀ u, u ≤ α → H u = c * u) →
      (∀ u, β ≤ u → H u = u) → (∀ u, 0 < u → 0 < H u) → (∀ u, 0 ≤ u → H u ≤ K * u) →
      (∀ u, 0 ≤ u → 0 < g u ∧ g u ≤ K) → ∃ P : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ P ∧ (∀ u, 0 < P u) ∧
      (∀ u, u ≤ α → P u = Real.sqrt c) ∧ (∀ u, u < α → deriv P u = 0) ∧
      (∀ u, β ≤ u → P u = 1) ∧
      ∀ u, 0 ≤ u → P u ^ 2 ≤ K ∧ 0 < P u * (P u + 2 * u * deriv P u) ∧
        P u * (P u + 2 * u * deriv P u) ≤ K := by
    intro α β c K H g hα hαβ hc hcK hH hHd hHc hH1 hHpos hHK hg
    obtain ⟨R, hR0, hRpos, hRs, hRc⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ t, 0 < t → R t = H t / t) ∧
        (∀ u, 0 < R u) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ R ∧ (∀ u, u ≤ α → R u = c) := by
      have hR0' : ∀ t, 0 < t → (if t ≤ α then c else H t / t) = H t / t := by
        intro t ht
        split_ifs with h
        · rw [hHc t h, mul_div_cancel_right₀ c ht.ne']
        · rfl
      refine ⟨fun u => if u ≤ α then c else H u / u, hR0', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro u
        simp only
        split_ifs with h
        · exact hc
        · push_neg at h
          exact div_pos (hHpos u (hα.trans h)) (hα.trans h)
      · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
        intro x
        rcases lt_or_ge x α with hx | hx
        · apply (contDiffAt_const (c := c)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
          filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hx] with t ht
          exact if_pos (le_of_lt ht)
        · have hx0 : 0 < x := hα.trans_le hx
          have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun t => H t / t) x :=
            hH.contDiffAt.div contDiffAt_id hx0.ne'
          apply h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq
          filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hx0] with t ht
          exact hR0' t ht
      · intro u hu
        exact if_pos hu
    have hPs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u => Real.sqrt (R u)) := hRs.sqrt (fun u => (hRpos u).ne')
    have hPsq : ∀ u, Real.sqrt (R u) ^ 2 = R u := fun u => Real.sq_sqrt (hRpos u).le
    have hPd0 : ∀ u, u < α → deriv (fun u => Real.sqrt (R u)) u = 0 := by
      intro u hu
      have hev : (fun u => Real.sqrt (R u)) =ᶠ[𝓝 u] (fun _ => Real.sqrt c) := by
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hu] with t ht
        rw [hRc t (le_of_lt ht)]
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    have hkey : ∀ u, 0 < u → Real.sqrt (R u) * (Real.sqrt (R u) + 2 * u *
        deriv (fun u => Real.sqrt (R u)) u) = g u := by
      intro u hu
      have hPd : HasDerivAt (fun u => Real.sqrt (R u)) (deriv (fun u => Real.sqrt (R u)) u) u :=
        ((hPs.differentiable (by simp)) u).hasDerivAt
      have h1 := (hasDerivAt_id' u).mul (hPd.pow 2)
      have hev : (fun t => t * Real.sqrt (R t) ^ 2) =ᶠ[𝓝 u] H := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hu] with t ht
        rw [hPsq t, hR0 t ht, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt ht)]
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t => t * Real.sqrt (R t) ^ 2) (g u) u :=
        (hHd u).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
      have h3 := h1.unique h2
      norm_num at h3
      linear_combination h3
    refine ⟨fun u => Real.sqrt (R u), hPs, fun u => Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hRpos u), ?_, hPd0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro u hu
      simp only
      rw [hRc u hu]
    · intro u hu
      simp only
      have hu0 : 0 < u := by linarith
      rw [hR0 u hu0, hH1 u hu, div_self hu0.ne', Real.sqrt_one]
    · intro u hu
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hPsq u]
        rcases le_or_gt u α with h | h
        · rw [hRc u h]; exact hcK
        · have hu0 : 0 < u := hα.trans h
          rw [hR0 u hu0, div_le_iff₀ hu0]
          exact hHK u hu
      · rcases lt_or_ge u α with h | h
        · rw [hPd0 u h, mul_zero, add_zero, ← sq, hPsq u, hRc u h.le]
          exact ⟨hc, hcK⟩
        · rw [hkey u (hα.trans_le h)]
          exact hg u hu
  
  have ha : 0 < a := hb.trans hba
  have hα : 0 < a ^ 2 := pow_pos ha 2
  have hαβ : a ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hab : 0 < b / a := div_pos hb ha
  have hab1 : b / a < 1 := (div_lt_one ha).2 hba
  have hc0 : 0 < (b / a) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hc1 : (b / a) ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hcα : (b / a) ^ 2 * a ^ 2 = b ^ 2 := by
    rw [div_pow, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 ha.ne')]
  have hLT : r ^ 2 - a ^ 2 < r ^ 2 - b ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hTK : r ^ 2 - b ^ 2 < K * (r ^ 2 - a ^ 2) := by
    rwa [div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith)] at hK
  have hK1 : 1 < K := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgc, hg1, hgb, hgint⟩ :=
    hS2 (a ^ 2) (r ^ 2) ((b / a) ^ 2) (r ^ 2 - b ^ 2) K hαβ hc0 hc1 hLT hTK
  have hgint' : ∫ u in a ^ 2..r ^ 2, g u = r ^ 2 - (b / a) ^ 2 * a ^ 2 := by
    rw [hgint, hcα]
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hHd, hHc, hH1, hHpos, hHK⟩ :=
    hS3 (a ^ 2) (r ^ 2) ((b / a) ^ 2) K g hα hg hgc hg1 hgb hgint'
  obtain ⟨P, hPs, hPpos, hPc, hPd0, hP1, hPb⟩ :=
    hS4 (a ^ 2) (r ^ 2) ((b / a) ^ 2) K H g hα hαβ hc0 (by linarith) hH hHd hHc hH1 hHpos hHK
      (fun u _ => hgb u)
  refine ⟨P, hPs, hPpos, ?_, hPd0, hP1, hPb⟩
  intro u hu
  rw [hPc u hu, Real.sqrt_sq hab.le]

informal_problem.statement: (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t : ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ), (∀ i a : Fin 3, |B i a| ≤ β) → |t| ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, v a ^ 2 = 1 → Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (1 + t • B).adjugate a i * v a) ^ 2) ≤ 1 + t * (Matrix.trace B - ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, v a * B a i * v i) + C * t ^ 2

signature.name: sepFV_adj_expansion_bound
signature.statement: (β : ℝ) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t : ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ), (∀ i a : Fin 3, |B i a| ≤ β) → |t| ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, v a ^ 2 = 1 → Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (1 + t • B).adjugate a i * v a) ^ 2) ≤ 1 + t * (Matrix.trace B - ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, v a * B a i * v i) + C * t ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨(3 / 2) * ((6 * β + 6 * β ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * (6 * β ^ 2)), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro B t v hB ht hv
  
  have hv1 : ∀ a : Fin 3, |v a| ≤ 1 := by
    intro a
    have h1 : v a ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b : Fin 3, v b ^ 2 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun b => v b ^ 2) (fun b _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ a)
    rw [hv] at h1
    exact (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one _).1 h1
  have hv' : v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hv; exact hv
  
  have hadj : ∀ a i : Fin 3, (1 + t • B).adjugate a i = (if a = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
      + t * ((if a = i then Matrix.trace B else 0) - B a i) + t ^ 2 * B.adjugate a i := by
    intro a i
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three, Matrix.adjugate_fin_three, Matrix.trace_fin_three]
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases i <;>
      simp [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring
  
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : Fin 3 → ℝ, u = fun i => Matrix.trace B * v i - ∑ a : Fin 3, B a i * v a :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : Fin 3 → ℝ, z = fun i => ∑ a : Fin 3, B.adjugate a i * v a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hw : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, (1 + t • B).adjugate a i * v a
      = v i + t * u i + t ^ 2 * z i := by
    intro i
    simp only [hadj, hu, hz]
    fin_cases i <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
  
  have hBv : ∀ j k a : Fin 3, |B j k * v a| ≤ β := by
    intro j k a
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc |B j k| * |v a| ≤ β * 1 := mul_le_mul (hB j k) (hv1 a) (abs_nonneg _) hβ
      _ = β := mul_one β
  have hBB : ∀ j k l m : Fin 3, |B j k * B l m| ≤ β ^ 2 := by
    intro j k l m
    rw [abs_mul, sq]
    exact mul_le_mul (hB j k) (hB l m) (abs_nonneg _) hβ
  have key : ∀ p q : ℝ, |p| ≤ β ^ 2 → |q| ≤ β ^ 2 →
      |p - q| ≤ 2 * β ^ 2 ∧ |-p + q| ≤ 2 * β ^ 2 := by
    intro p q hp hq
    have hp' := abs_le.1 hp
    have hq' := abs_le.1 hq
    constructor <;> rw [abs_le] <;> constructor <;> linarith
  have hadjB : ∀ a i : Fin 3, |B.adjugate a i| ≤ 2 * β ^ 2 := by
    intro a i
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases i <;> simp <;>
      first
      | exact (key _ _ (hBB _ _ _ _) (hBB _ _ _ _)).1
      | exact (key _ _ (hBB _ _ _ _) (hBB _ _ _ _)).2
  have hAv : ∀ a i : Fin 3, |B.adjugate a i * v a| ≤ 2 * β ^ 2 := by
    intro a i
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc |B.adjugate a i| * |v a| ≤ (2 * β ^ 2) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul (hadjB a i) (hv1 a) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = 2 * β ^ 2 := mul_one _
  have hub : ∀ i : Fin 3, |u i| ≤ 6 * β := by
    intro i
    have e : u i = B 0 0 * v i + B 1 1 * v i + B 2 2 * v i
        - (B 0 i * v 0 + B 1 i * v 1 + B 2 i * v 2) := by
      rw [hu]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.trace_fin_three]; ring
    rw [e, abs_le]
    have h1 := abs_le.1 (hBv 0 0 i)
    have h2 := abs_le.1 (hBv 1 1 i)
    have h3 := abs_le.1 (hBv 2 2 i)
    have h4 := abs_le.1 (hBv 0 i 0)
    have h5 := abs_le.1 (hBv 1 i 1)
    have h6 := abs_le.1 (hBv 2 i 2)
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hzb : ∀ i : Fin 3, |z i| ≤ 6 * β ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    have e : z i = B.adjugate 0 i * v 0 + B.adjugate 1 i * v 1 + B.adjugate 2 i * v 2 := by
      rw [hz]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [e, abs_le]
    have h1 := abs_le.1 (hAv 0 i)
    have h2 := abs_le.1 (hAv 1 i)
    have h3 := abs_le.1 (hAv 2 i)
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hlin : ∑ i : Fin 3, v i * u i
      = Matrix.trace B - ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, v a * B a i * v i := by
    rw [hu]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.trace_fin_three]
    linear_combination (B 0 0 + B 1 1 + B 2 2) * hv'
  
  have star : ∀ p q r : ℝ, |p| ≤ 1 → |q| ≤ 6 * β → |r| ≤ 6 * β ^ 2 →
      (p + t * q + t ^ 2 * r) ^ 2 ≤ p ^ 2 + 2 * t * (p * q)
        + ((6 * β + 6 * β ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * (6 * β ^ 2)) * t ^ 2 := by
    intro p q r hp hq hr
    have e : (p + t * q + t ^ 2 * r) ^ 2
        = p ^ 2 + 2 * t * (p * q) + t ^ 2 * ((q + t * r) ^ 2 + 2 * (p * r)) := by ring
    have htr : |t * r| ≤ 6 * β ^ 2 := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |t| * |r| ≤ 1 * (6 * β ^ 2) := mul_le_mul ht hr (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 6 * β ^ 2 := one_mul _
    have hqr : |q + t * r| ≤ 6 * β + 6 * β ^ 2 :=
      (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hq htr)
    have hsq : (q + t * r) ^ 2 ≤ (6 * β + 6 * β ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hqr 2
    have hpr : p * r ≤ 6 * β ^ 2 := by
      calc p * r ≤ |p * r| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |p| * |r| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ 1 * (6 * β ^ 2) := mul_le_mul hp hr (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 6 * β ^ 2 := one_mul _
    have hb : t ^ 2 * ((q + t * r) ^ 2 + 2 * (p * r))
        ≤ t ^ 2 * ((6 * β + 6 * β ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * (6 * β ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (sq_nonneg t)
    rw [e]
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (1 + t • B).adjugate a i * v a) ^ 2 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ, g = Matrix.trace B - ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, v a * B a i * v i :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = (6 * β + 6 * β ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * (6 * β ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := by
    rw [hS]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hSle : S ≤ 1 + 2 * t * g + 3 * K * t ^ 2 := by
    have hsum : S = ∑ i : Fin 3, (v i + t * u i + t ^ 2 * z i) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hS]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [hw i])
    have hlin' : v 0 * u 0 + v 1 * u 1 + v 2 * u 2 = g := by
      rw [hg, ← hlin, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hsum, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have s0 := star (v 0) (u 0) (z 0) (hv1 0) (hub 0) (hzb 0)
    have s1 := star (v 1) (u 1) (z 1) (hv1 1) (hub 1) (hzb 1)
    have s2 := star (v 2) (u 2) (z 2) (hv1 2) (hub 2) (hzb 2)
    rw [← hK] at s0 s1 s2
    have e : 2 * t * g = 2 * t * (v 0 * u 0) + 2 * t * (v 1 * u 1) + 2 * t * (v 2 * u 2) := by
      rw [← hlin']; ring
    rw [e]
    linarith
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt S ≤ (1 + S) / 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt hS0, sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt S - 1)]
  rw [← hS, ← hg]
  have e2 : (3 / 2) * ((6 * β + 6 * β ^ 2) ^ 2 + 2 * (6 * β ^ 2)) = (3 / 2) * K := by rw [hK]
  rw [e2]
  nlinarith [hsqrt, hSle]

informal_problem.statement: (T : E3 → E3) (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (hTc : HasCompactSupport T) : ∃ β t₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ β ∧ 0 < t₀ ∧ t₀ ≤ 1 ∧ (∀ (x : E3) (i a : Fin 3), |jacMat T x i a| ≤ β) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₀ → Function.Injective (fun y : E3 => y + t • T y) ∧ ∀ x : E3, jacMat (fun y : E3 => y + t • T y) x = 1 + t • jacMat T x ∧ 1 / 2 ≤ (jacMat (fun y : E3 => y + t • T y) x).det

signature.name: sepFV_deformation_props
signature.statement: (T : E3 → E3) (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (hTc : HasCompactSupport T) : ∃ β t₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ β ∧ 0 < t₀ ∧ t₀ ≤ 1 ∧ (∀ (x : E3) (i a : Fin 3), |jacMat T x i a| ≤ β) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₀ → Function.Injective (fun y : E3 => y + t • T y) ∧ ∀ x : E3, jacMat (fun y : E3 => y + t • T y) x = 1 + t • jacMat T x ∧ 1 / 2 ≤ (jacMat (fun y : E3 => y + t • T y) x).det

proof.tactics:
by
  have hT' : Differentiable ℝ T := hT.differentiable (by simp)
  have hc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ T) := hT.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
  have hs : HasCompactSupport (fderiv ℝ T) := hTc.fderiv ℝ
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hc.bounded_above_of_compact_support hs
  obtain ⟨β, hβdef⟩ : ∃ β : ℝ, β = max C₀ 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hβ0 : 0 ≤ β := by rw [hβdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hβ : ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ T x‖ ≤ β := fun x => by
    rw [hβdef]; exact (hC₀ x).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have hJ : ∀ (x : E3) (i a : Fin 3), |jacMat T x i a| ≤ β := by
    intro x i a
    have h1 : |jacMat T x i a| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ T x (e a)‖ := by
      simp only [jacMat, Matrix.of_apply]
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact PiLp.norm_apply_le _ _
    have h2 : ‖fderiv ℝ T x (e a)‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ T x‖ * ‖e a‖ :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
    have h3 : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    rw [h3, mul_one] at h2
    linarith [hβ x]
  
  have hjac : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E3),
      jacMat (fun y : E3 => y + t • T y) x = 1 + t • jacMat T x := by
    intro t x
    have hD : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y + t • T y)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 + t • fderiv ℝ T x) x :=
      (hasFDerivAt_id x).add ((hT' x).hasFDerivAt.const_smul t)
    ext i a
    simp only [jacMat, Matrix.of_apply, hD.fderiv]
    simp [Matrix.one_apply, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  have hinj : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| * β < 1 → Function.Injective (fun y : E3 => y + t • T y) := by
    intro t ht y y' hyy
    simp only at hyy
    have hL : LipschitzWith ⟨β, hβ0⟩ T := lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_fderiv_le hT' (fun x => by
      rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, coe_nnnorm]; exact hβ x)
    have h1 : y - y' = t • (T y' - T y) := by
      rw [smul_sub]
      calc y - y' = (y + t • T y) - t • T y - y' := by abel
        _ = (y' + t • T y') - t • T y - y' := by rw [hyy]
        _ = t • T y' - t • T y := by abel
    have h2 : ‖T y' - T y‖ ≤ β * ‖y' - y‖ := hL.norm_sub_le y' y
    have h3 : ‖y - y'‖ ≤ |t| * β * ‖y - y'‖ := by
      calc ‖y - y'‖ = |t| * ‖T y' - T y‖ := by rw [h1, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ |t| * (β * ‖y' - y‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (abs_nonneg t)
        _ = |t| * β * ‖y - y'‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev y' y]; ring
    have h5 := norm_nonneg (y - y')
    have h4 : ‖y - y'‖ = 0 := by
      refine le_antisymm ?_ h5
      nlinarith
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp h4)
  
  have hdet : ∀ m : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, (∀ i a, |m i a| ≤ 1 / 100) →
      1 / 2 ≤ (1 + m).det := by
    intro m hm
    have hexp : (1 + m).det = 1 + (m 0 0 + m 1 1 + m 2 2)
        + (m 0 0 * m 1 1 + m 0 0 * m 2 2 + m 1 1 * m 2 2 - m 1 2 * m 2 1 - m 0 1 * m 1 0
            - m 0 2 * m 2 0)
        + (m 0 0 * m 1 1 * m 2 2 - m 0 0 * m 1 2 * m 2 1 - m 0 1 * m 1 0 * m 2 2
            + m 0 1 * m 1 2 * m 2 0 + m 0 2 * m 1 0 * m 2 1 - m 0 2 * m 1 1 * m 2 0) := by
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      simp [Matrix.one_apply]
      ring
    have P2 : ∀ x y : ℝ, |x| ≤ 1 / 100 → |y| ≤ 1 / 100 → |x * y| ≤ 1 / 10000 := by
      intro x y hx hy
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |x| * |y| ≤ (1 / 100) * (1 / 100) := mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 1 / 10000 := by norm_num
    have P3 : ∀ x y z : ℝ, |x| ≤ 1 / 100 → |y| ≤ 1 / 100 → |z| ≤ 1 / 100 →
        |x * y * z| ≤ 1 / 1000000 := by
      intro x y z hx hy hz
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      calc |x| * |y| * |z| ≤ (1 / 100) * (1 / 100) * (1 / 100) :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)) hz (abs_nonneg _)
              (by norm_num)
        _ = 1 / 1000000 := by norm_num
    rw [hexp]
    have l1 := abs_le.mp (hm 0 0)
    have l2 := abs_le.mp (hm 1 1)
    have l3 := abs_le.mp (hm 2 2)
    have q1 := abs_le.mp (P2 _ _ (hm 0 0) (hm 1 1))
    have q2 := abs_le.mp (P2 _ _ (hm 0 0) (hm 2 2))
    have q3 := abs_le.mp (P2 _ _ (hm 1 1) (hm 2 2))
    have q4 := abs_le.mp (P2 _ _ (hm 1 2) (hm 2 1))
    have q5 := abs_le.mp (P2 _ _ (hm 0 1) (hm 1 0))
    have q6 := abs_le.mp (P2 _ _ (hm 0 2) (hm 2 0))
    have c1 := abs_le.mp (P3 _ _ _ (hm 0 0) (hm 1 1) (hm 2 2))
    have c2 := abs_le.mp (P3 _ _ _ (hm 0 0) (hm 1 2) (hm 2 1))
    have c3 := abs_le.mp (P3 _ _ _ (hm 0 1) (hm 1 0) (hm 2 2))
    have c4 := abs_le.mp (P3 _ _ _ (hm 0 1) (hm 1 2) (hm 2 0))
    have c5 := abs_le.mp (P3 _ _ _ (hm 0 2) (hm 1 0) (hm 2 1))
    have c6 := abs_le.mp (P3 _ _ _ (hm 0 2) (hm 1 1) (hm 2 0))
    linarith [l1.1, l2.1, l3.1, q1.1, q2.1, q3.1, q4.2, q5.2, q6.2,
      c1.1, c2.2, c3.2, c4.1, c5.1, c6.2]
  
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀def⟩ : ∃ t₀ : ℝ, t₀ = 1 / (100 * (β + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpos : 0 < 100 * (β + 1) := by positivity
  have ht₀ : 0 < t₀ := by rw [ht₀def]; positivity
  have hmul : t₀ * (100 * (β + 1)) = 1 := by
    rw [ht₀def]; field_simp
  have ht₀1 : t₀ ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have ht₀β : t₀ * β ≤ 1 / 100 := by nlinarith
  refine ⟨β, t₀, hβ0, ht₀, ht₀1, hJ, fun t ht => ⟨hinj t ?_, fun x => ⟨hjac t x, ?_⟩⟩⟩
  · have : |t| * β ≤ t₀ * β := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht hβ0
    linarith
  · rw [hjac t x]
    apply hdet
    intro i a
    rw [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul]
    calc |t| * |jacMat T x i a| ≤ |t| * β := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hJ x i a) (abs_nonneg t)
      _ ≤ t₀ * β := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht hβ0
      _ ≤ 1 / 100 := ht₀β

informal_problem.statement: (Φ : E3 → E3) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ) (C : Set E3) (hC : IsCompact C) (hΦC : ∀ x : E3, x ∉ C → Φ x = x) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i)) ∧ ∀ x : E3, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (fun y : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * X (Φ y) i)) x = (jacMat Φ x).det * sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X (Φ x)

signature.name: sepFV_piola_field
signature.statement: (Φ : E3 → E3) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ) (C : Set E3) (hC : IsCompact C) (hΦC : ∀ x : E3, x ∉ C → Φ x = x) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i)) ∧ ∀ x : E3, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (fun y : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * X (Φ y) i)) x = (jacMat Φ x).det * sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X (Φ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hadj : ∀ (J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (a i : Fin 3),
      J.adjugate a i = J (i+1) (a+1) * J (i+2) (a+2) - J (i+1) (a+2) * J (i+2) (a+1) := by
    intro J a i
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three] <;> ring
  
  have hnull : ∀ (Y : E3 → E3) (x : E3), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y x →
      (∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x = 0 := by
    intro Y x hYc
    have hD1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ Y) x := hYc.fderiv_right (m := 1)
      (by simpa using (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞))
    have hDd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Y) x := hD1.differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ Y x :=
      hYc.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simpa using (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞))
    obtain ⟨L, hB, hLsym⟩ : ∃ L : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
        (∀ k a, HasFDerivAt (fun z => jacMat Y z k a) (L k a) x) ∧
        ∀ k a b, L k a (e b) = L k b (e a) := by
      refine ⟨fun k a => ((EuclideanSpace.proj k).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 (e a))).comp (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Y) x), ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro k a
        have h := ((EuclideanSpace.proj k).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 (e a))).hasFDerivAt.comp x hDd.hasFDerivAt
        convert h using 1
      · intro k a b
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp', Function.comp_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.apply_apply]
        rw [hsymm (e b) (e a)]
    have hA : ∀ a i : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i)
        ((jacMat Y x (i+1) (a+1) • L (i+2) (a+2) + jacMat Y x (i+2) (a+2) • L (i+1) (a+1)) -
          (jacMat Y x (i+1) (a+2) • L (i+2) (a+1) + jacMat Y x (i+2) (a+1) • L (i+1) (a+2))) x := by
      intro a i
      have hfun : (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) = fun z =>
          jacMat Y z (i+1) (a+1) * jacMat Y z (i+2) (a+2) -
            jacMat Y z (i+1) (a+2) * jacMat Y z (i+2) (a+1) :=
        funext fun z => hadj (jacMat Y z) a i
      rw [hfun]
      exact ((hB (i+1) (a+1)).fun_mul (hB (i+2) (a+2))).fun_sub
        ((hB (i+1) (a+2)).fun_mul (hB (i+2) (a+1)))
    refine ⟨fun a i => (hA a i).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    have h01 : ∀ k, L k 1 (e 0) = L k 0 (e 1) := fun k => hLsym k 1 0
    have h02 : ∀ k, L k 2 (e 0) = L k 0 (e 2) := fun k => hLsym k 2 0
    have h12 : ∀ k, L k 2 (e 1) = L k 1 (e 2) := fun k => hLsym k 2 1
    intro i
    simp only [partialDeriv, fun a => (hA a i).fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    fin_cases i <;>
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceAdd, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one]
      simp only [h01, h02, h12]
      ring
  
  have hpiola : ∀ (Y : E3 → E3) (W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : E3),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x →
      (∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y i) (Y x)) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3,
        ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x = 0) →
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i * W (Y z) i) x
        = (jacMat Y x).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => W y i) (Y x) := by
    intro Y W x hY hA hW hP
    have hchain : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ f (Y x) → ∀ a : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a (fun z => f (Y z)) x =
          ∑ k : Fin 3, jacMat Y x k a * partialDeriv k f (Y x) := by
      intro f hf a
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [fderiv_comp' x hf hY, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      have hv : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k • e k := by
        intro v
        ext j
        fin_cases j <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      conv_lhs => rw [hv (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a))]
      rw [map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rfl
    have hWi : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => W (Y z) i) x :=
      fun i => (hW i).comp x hY
    have hprod : ∀ a : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i * W (Y z) i) x
          = ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => (jacMat Y z).adjugate a i) x * W (Y x) i
            + (jacMat Y x).adjugate a i * partialDeriv a (fun z => W (Y z) i) x) := by
      intro a
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => (hA a i).fun_mul (hWi i)), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hA a i) (hWi i)]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hc : ∀ a i : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => W (Y z) i) x =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, jacMat Y x k a * partialDeriv k (fun y => W y i) (Y x) :=
      fun a i => hchain (fun y => W y i) (hW i) a
    have hK : ∀ k i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, jacMat Y x k a * (jacMat Y x).adjugate a i
        = (jacMat Y x).det * (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) k i := by
      intro k i
      rw [← Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mul_adjugate, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have h00 := hK 0 0
    have h01 := hK 0 1
    have h02 := hK 0 2
    have h10 := hK 1 0
    have h11 := hK 1 1
    have h12 := hK 1 2
    have h20 := hK 2 0
    have h21 := hK 2 1
    have h22 := hK 2 2
    have hP0 := hP 0
    have hP1 := hP 1
    have hP2 := hP 2
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hprod a)]
    simp only [hc]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at h00 h11 h22 hP0 hP1 hP2 ⊢
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1),
      Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2), Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0),
      Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2), Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0),
      Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1)] at h01 h02 h10 h12 h20 h21
    linear_combination W (Y x) 0 * hP0 + W (Y x) 1 * hP1 + W (Y x) 2 * hP2
      + partialDeriv 0 (fun y => W y 0) (Y x) * h00
      + partialDeriv 0 (fun y => W y 1) (Y x) * h01
      + partialDeriv 0 (fun y => W y 2) (Y x) * h02
      + partialDeriv 1 (fun y => W y 0) (Y x) * h10
      + partialDeriv 1 (fun y => W y 1) (Y x) * h11
      + partialDeriv 1 (fun y => W y 2) (Y x) * h12
      + partialDeriv 2 (fun y => W y 0) (Y x) * h20
      + partialDeriv 2 (fun y => W y 1) (Y x) * h21
      + partialDeriv 2 (fun y => W y 2) (Y x) * h22
  
  have hD : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Φ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hΦ).2
  have hJ : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => jacMat Φ x k l) := by
    intro k l
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ Φ x (e l)) := hD.clm_apply contDiff_const
    exact (contDiff_piLp 2).1 h1 k
  have hAdjS : ∀ a i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i) := by
    intro a i
    have hfun : (fun z => (jacMat Φ z).adjugate a i) = fun z =>
        jacMat Φ z (i+1) (a+1) * jacMat Φ z (i+2) (a+2) -
          jacMat Φ z (i+1) (a+2) * jacMat Φ z (i+2) (a+1) :=
      funext fun z => hadj (jacMat Φ z) a i
    rw [hfun]
    exact ((hJ _ _).mul (hJ _ _)).sub ((hJ _ _).mul (hJ _ _))
  have hXi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => X y i) := fun i => (contDiff_piLp 2).1 hX i
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (contDiff_piLp 2).2 (fun a => ?_)
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i
    exact ContDiff.sum (fun i _ => (hAdjS a i).mul ((hXi i).comp hΦ))
  · refine HasCompactSupport.intro (hC.union hXc.isCompact) ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_union, not_or] at hx
    have hΦx : Φ x = x := hΦC x hx.1
    have hX0 : X x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx.2
    ext a
    show ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i = (0 : E3) a
    rw [hΦx, hX0]
    simp
  · intro x
    have h1 : Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) = 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_one, Real.sqrt_one]
    simp only [sepDensDiv, h1, one_mul]
    obtain ⟨hA, hP⟩ := hnull Φ x (hΦ.contDiffAt)
    have hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x := hΦ.differentiable (by simp) x
    have hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => X y i) (Φ x) :=
      fun i => (hXi i).differentiable (by simp) (Φ x)
    exact hpiola Φ (fun y i => X y i) x hY hA hW hP

informal_problem.statement: (K : Set E3) (hK : MeasurableSet K) (μ : Measure E3) (ν : E3 → E3) (hμ : ∀ r : ℝ, μ (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) (hνm : Measurable ν) (hν1 : ∀ x, ‖ν x‖ = 1) (hGG : ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X → ∫ y in K, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X y = ∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) ∂μ) (Φ : E3 → E3) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ) (hinj : Function.Injective Φ) (hdet : ∀ x : E3, 0 < (jacMat Φ x).det) (R : ℝ) (hΦR : ∀ x : E3, Φ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R → x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R) (hZ : ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i)) ∧ ∀ x : E3, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (fun y : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * X (Φ y) i)) x = (jacMat Φ x).det * sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X (Φ x)) : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (Φ '' K) (Metric.ball 0 R) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R).indicator (fun y : E3 => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * ν y a) ^ 2)) x ∂μ)

signature.name: sepFV_transport_bound
signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (hK : MeasurableSet K) (μ : Measure E3) (ν : E3 → E3) (hμ : ∀ r : ℝ, μ (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) (hνm : Measurable ν) (hν1 : ∀ x, ‖ν x‖ = 1) (hGG : ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X → ∫ y in K, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X y = ∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) ∂μ) (Φ : E3 → E3) (hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Φ) (hinj : Function.Injective Φ) (hdet : ∀ x : E3, 0 < (jacMat Φ x).det) (R : ℝ) (hΦR : ∀ x : E3, Φ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R → x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R) (hZ : ∀ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X → HasCompactSupport X → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i)) ∧ ∀ x : E3, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (fun y : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * X (Φ y) i)) x = (jacMat Φ x).det * sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X (Φ x)) : sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (Φ '' K) (Metric.ball 0 R) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R).indicator (fun y : E3 => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * ν y a) ^ 2)) x ∂μ)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨h, hhdef⟩ : ∃ h : E3 → ℝ, h = fun y : E3 => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3,
      (∑ a : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * ν y a) ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hdetEq : ∀ x : E3, (fderiv ℝ Φ x).det = (jacMat Φ x).det := by
    intro x
    show LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ Φ x : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) = _
    rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis]
    congr 1
    all_goals (ext i a; simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, jacMat])
  
  have hCV : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ∫ y in Φ '' K, f y = ∫ x in K, (jacMat Φ x).det * f (Φ x) := by
    intro f
    rw [integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hK
      (fun x _ => (hΦ.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hinj.injOn f]
    refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, hdetEq x, abs_of_pos (hdet x)]
  
  have hνsq : ∀ y : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, (ν y a) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro y
    have h1 := hν1 y
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq] at h1
    have h2 := (Real.sqrt_eq_one).1 h1
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] using h2
  have hνc : ∀ (y : E3) (a : Fin 3), |ν y a| ≤ 1 := by
    intro y a
    have h1 : (ν y a) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b : Fin 3, (ν y b) ^ 2 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun b => (ν y b) ^ 2) (fun b _ => sq_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_univ a)
    rw [hνsq y] at h1
    exact (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one _).1 h1
  
  have hJc : ∀ i a : Fin 3, Continuous (fun y => jacMat Φ y i a) := by
    intro i a
    have h1 : Continuous (fun y => fderiv ℝ Φ y (e a)) :=
      (hΦ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i).continuous.comp h1
  have hJcont : Continuous (fun y => jacMat Φ y) :=
    continuous_pi fun i => continuous_pi fun a => hJc i a
  have hAdjc : ∀ a i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun y => (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i) := by
    intro a i
    exact (continuous_apply i).comp ((continuous_apply a).comp hJcont.matrix_adjugate)
  have hνmc : ∀ a : Fin 3, Measurable (fun y => ν y a) :=
    fun a => (EuclideanSpace.proj a).continuous.measurable.comp hνm
  have hhm : Measurable h := by
    rw [hhdef]
    refine Measurable.sqrt ?_
    refine Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    refine Measurable.pow_const ?_ 2
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun a _ => (hAdjc a i).measurable.mul (hνmc a))
  
  have hHc : Continuous (fun y : E3 => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3,
      (∑ a : Fin 3, |(jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i|) ^ 2)) := by
    refine Real.continuous_sqrt.comp ?_
    refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    refine Continuous.pow ?_ 2
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => (hAdjc a i).abs)
  have hhle : ∀ y : E3, h y ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3,
      (∑ a : Fin 3, |(jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i|) ^ 2) := by
    intro y
    rw [hhdef]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have hw : |∑ a : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * ν y a| ≤
        ∑ a : Fin 3, |(jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i| := by
      calc _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, |(jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * ν y a| :=
            Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, |(jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i| := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro a _
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) (hνc y a)
    calc (∑ a : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * ν y a) ^ 2
        = |∑ a : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * ν y a| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ (∑ a : Fin 3, |(jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i|) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hw 2
  have hhnn : ∀ y : E3, 0 ≤ h y := by
    intro y
    rw [hhdef]
    exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hG : Integrable (fun x => (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R).indicator h x) μ := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hHc.continuousOn
    have hon : IntegrableOn h (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R) μ := by
      refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := C) (hμ R).ne hhm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_ball).2 (ae_of_all _ fun y hy => ?_)
      have h1 := hC y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hhnn y)]
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact (hhle y).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans h1)
    exact hon.integrable_indicator measurableSet_ball
  have hGnn : 0 ≤ ∫ x, (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R).indicator h x ∂μ :=
    integral_nonneg (fun x => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun y _ => hhnn y) x)
  
  unfold sepPerG
  refine iSup₂_le (fun X hX => ?_)
  obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXB, hX1⟩ := hX
  obtain ⟨hZs, hZc, hZd⟩ := hZ X hXs hXc
  
  have hpt : ∀ x : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
      (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i)) (ν x) ≤
      (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R).indicator h x := by
    intro x
    have hinner : @inner ℝ E3 _ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
        (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i)) (ν x) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, X (Φ x) i * ∑ a : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * ν x a := by
      simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.equiv]
      ring
    rw [hinner]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, hhdef]
      have hu : ∑ i : Fin 3, (X (Φ x) i) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        have h1 := hX1 (Φ x)
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply] at h1
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        nlinarith [h1]
      have hCS := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq Finset.univ (fun i => X (Φ x) i)
        (fun i => ∑ a : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * ν x a)
      have hw0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * ν x a) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
      have h2 : (∑ i : Fin 3, X (Φ x) i * ∑ a : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * ν x a) ^ 2 ≤
          ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * ν x a) ^ 2 :=
        hCS.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left hw0 hu)
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (Real.abs_le_sqrt h2)
    · have hΦx : Φ x ∉ tsupport X := fun h' => hx (hΦR x (hXB h'))
      have hX0 : X (Φ x) = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hΦx
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, hX0]
      simp
  subst hhdef
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  rw [hCV]
  have e1 : ∫ x in K, (jacMat Φ x).det *
      sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X (Φ x) =
      ∫ x in K, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))
        (fun y : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
          (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ y).adjugate a i * X (Φ y) i)) x :=
    integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => (hZd x).symm)
  rw [e1, hGG _ hZs hZc]
  by_cases hF : Integrable (fun x => @inner ℝ E3 _ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
      (fun a : Fin 3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, (jacMat Φ x).adjugate a i * X (Φ x) i)) (ν x)) μ
  · exact integral_mono hF hG hpt
  · exact (le_of_eq (integral_undef hF)).trans hGnn

informal_problem.statement: (μ : Measure E3) (V : Set E3) (hV : MeasurableSet V) (hμV : μ V < ⊤) (g : E3 → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (M : ℝ) (hgM : ∀ x, |g x| ≤ M) (hgV : ∀ x, x ∉ V → g x = 0) (h : ℝ → E3 → ℝ) (C t₀ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) (hpos : ∀ t x, 0 ≤ h t x) (hh : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₀ → ∀ x ∈ V, h t x ≤ 1 + t * g x + C * t ^ 2) (hle : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₀ → (μ V).toReal ≤ ∫ x, V.indicator (h t) x ∂μ) : ∫ x, g x ∂μ = 0

signature.name: sepFV_first_order_vanish
signature.statement: (μ : Measure E3) (V : Set E3) (hV : MeasurableSet V) (hμV : μ V < ⊤) (g : E3 → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (M : ℝ) (hgM : ∀ x, |g x| ≤ M) (hgV : ∀ x, x ∉ V → g x = 0) (h : ℝ → E3 → ℝ) (C t₀ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) (hpos : ∀ t x, 0 ≤ h t x) (hh : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₀ → ∀ x ∈ V, h t x ≤ 1 + t * g x + C * t ^ 2) (hle : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₀ → (μ V).toReal ≤ ∫ x, V.indicator (h t) x ∂μ) : ∫ x, g x ∂μ = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hsupp : Function.support g ⊆ V := Function.support_subset_iff'.2 hgV
  have hgOn : IntegrableOn g V μ :=
    Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := M) hμV.ne hg.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hgM x))
  have hgI : Integrable g μ := (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset hsupp).1 hgOn
  set I := ∫ x, g x ∂μ with hIdef
  set m := (μ V).toReal with hmdef
  have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  set K := C * m with hKdef
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := mul_nonneg hC hm0
  have key : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₀ → 0 ≤ t * I + K * t ^ 2 := by
    intro t ht
    have hcI : Integrable (fun x => V.indicator (fun _ => 1 + C * t ^ 2) x) μ :=
      (integrableOn_const hμV.ne).integrable_indicator hV
    have hGint : Integrable (fun x => V.indicator (fun _ => 1 + C * t ^ 2) x + t * g x) μ :=
      hcI.add (hgI.const_mul t)
    have hGval : ∫ x, (V.indicator (fun _ => 1 + C * t ^ 2) x + t * g x) ∂μ
        = m * (1 + C * t ^ 2) + t * I := by
      rw [integral_add hcI (hgI.const_mul t), integral_indicator_const _ hV, integral_const_mul,
        measureReal_def, smul_eq_mul]
    have hmono : ∫ x, V.indicator (h t) x ∂μ ≤
        ∫ x, (V.indicator (fun _ => 1 + C * t ^ 2) x + t * g x) ∂μ := by
      refine integral_mono_of_nonneg
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun x _ => hpos t x) x))
        hGint (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
      by_cases hx : x ∈ V
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
        have := hh t ht x hx
        linarith
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, hgV x hx]
        simp
    have h1 := hle t ht
    rw [hGval] at hmono
    have e1 : m * (1 + C * t ^ 2) = m + K * t ^ 2 := by rw [hKdef]; ring
    linarith
  by_contra hI0
  have ha : 0 < |I| := abs_pos.mpr hI0
  set ε := min t₀ (|I| / (2 * (K + 1))) with hεdef
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min ht₀ (by positivity)
  have hεt : ε ≤ t₀ := min_le_left _ _
  have hεa : ε * (2 * (K + 1)) ≤ |I| := by
    have := min_le_right t₀ (|I| / (2 * (K + 1)))
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at this
    exact this
  have hmain : 0 ≤ -(ε * |I|) + K * ε ^ 2 := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hI0 with hneg | hposI
    · have := key ε (by rw [abs_of_pos hε]; exact hεt)
      rw [abs_of_neg hneg]
      have e2 : -(ε * -I) = ε * I := by ring
      rw [e2]
      exact this
    · have := key (-ε) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hε]; exact hεt)
      rw [abs_of_pos hposI]
      have e2 : -ε * I + K * (-ε) ^ 2 = -(ε * I) + K * ε ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [e2] at this
      exact this
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hεa hε.le, mul_pos hε hε, mul_nonneg hK (sq_nonneg ε)]

informal_problem.statement: (T : E3 → E3) (x v : E3) (hT : DifferentiableAt ℝ T x) : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => T z i) x - @inner ℝ E3 _ v (fderiv ℝ T x v) = Matrix.trace (jacMat T x) - ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, v a * jacMat T x a i * v i

signature.name: sepFV_integrand_matrix_form
signature.statement: (T : E3 → E3) (x v : E3) (hT : DifferentiableAt ℝ T x) : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => T z i) x - @inner ℝ E3 _ v (fderiv ℝ T x v) = Matrix.trace (jacMat T x) - ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, v a * jacMat T x a i * v i

proof.tactics:
by
  have hD := hT.hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => T z i) x = jacMat T x i i := by
    intro i
    have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun z => T z i)
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ T x)) x :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp x hD
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hc.fderiv]
    rfl
  have h2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => T z i) x = Matrix.trace (jacMat T x) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => h1 i)]
    rfl
  have hv : v = ∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i := by
    ext j
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  have h4 : ∀ a : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ T x v) a = ∑ i : Fin 3, v i * jacMat T x a i := by
    intro a
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    simp [map_sum, map_smul, jacMat]
  have h5 : @inner ℝ E3 _ v (fderiv ℝ T x v)
      = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, v a * jacMat T x a i * v i := by
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial, h4 a, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    ring
  rw [h2, h5]

informal_problem.statement: (K : Set E3) (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hfin : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) (i : Fin 3) : (∀ φ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i (φ + ψ) y = (∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y) + ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i ψ y) ∧ (∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i (c • φ) y = c * ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y) ∧ (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r → ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ y, |φ y| ≤ s) → |∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y| ≤ C * s)

signature.name: sepGG_component_functional
signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hfin : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) (i : Fin 3) : (∀ φ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i (φ + ψ) y = (∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y) + ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i ψ y) ∧ (∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i (c • φ) y = c * ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y) ∧ (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r → ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ y, |φ y| ≤ s) → |∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y| ≤ C * s)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hint : ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv i φ y) := by
    intro φ hφ hφc
    apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    · exact (hφ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    · exact hφc.fderiv_apply ℝ (e i)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro φ ψ hφ hφc hψ hψc
    have hpt : ∀ y, partialDeriv i (φ + ψ) y = partialDeriv i φ y + partialDeriv i ψ y := by
      intro y
      have hdφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ y := (hφ.differentiable (by simp)) y
      have hdψ : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ y := (hψ.differentiable (by simp)) y
      show fderiv ℝ (φ + ψ) y (e i) = _
      rw [fderiv_add hdφ hdψ]
      rfl
    simp only [hpt]
    exact integral_add (hint φ hφ hφc).integrableOn (hint ψ hψ hψc).integrableOn
  · intro c φ hφ hφc
    have hpt : ∀ y, partialDeriv i (c • φ) y = c * partialDeriv i φ y := by
      intro y
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ y := (hφ.differentiable (by simp)) y
      show fderiv ℝ (c • φ) y (e i) = _
      rw [fderiv_const_smul hd c]
      rfl
    simp only [hpt]
    exact integral_const_mul c _
  · intro r hr
    have hR : (0 : ℝ) < r + 1 := by linarith
    have hfinR := hfin (r + 1) hR
    refine ⟨(sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 (r + 1))).toReal,
      ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, ?_⟩
    intro φ hφ hφc hsupp s hs
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hs 0)
    have key : ∀ c : ℝ, |c| * s ≤ 1 → c * (∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y) ≤
        (sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 (r + 1))).toReal := by
      intro c hc
      obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ : ∃ Y : E3 → E3, Y = fun z => (c * φ z) • e i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hYs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y := by
        rw [hY]
        exact (contDiff_const.mul hφ).smul contDiff_const
      have hsuppY : Function.support Y ⊆ Function.support φ := by
        intro z hz h0
        apply hz
        simp [hY, h0]
      have hYcs : HasCompactSupport Y := hφc.mono hsuppY
      have hYt : tsupport Y ⊆ Metric.ball 0 (r + 1) :=
        ((closure_mono hsuppY : tsupport Y ⊆ tsupport φ).trans hsupp).trans
          (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))
      have hYn : ∀ y, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
          (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y j k * Y y j * Y y k ≤ 1 := by
        intro y
        have hsq : ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
            (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) y j k * Y y j * Y y k = ‖Y y‖ ^ 2 := by
          rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
          simp [Matrix.one_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, sq]
        have hnorm : ‖Y y‖ = |c| * |φ y| := by
          rw [hY]
          simp only
          rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
        have h1 : |c| * |φ y| ≤ 1 :=
          le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hs y) (abs_nonneg c)) hc
        have h2 : 0 ≤ |c| * |φ y| := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)
        rw [hsq, hnorm]
        nlinarith
      have hdiv : ∀ y, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) Y y =
          c * partialDeriv i φ y := by
        intro y
        have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ y := (hφ.differentiable (by simp)) y
        have hj : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => Y z j) y =
            (if j = i then c else 0) * partialDeriv j φ y := by
          intro j
          have hfun : (fun z => Y z j) = fun z => (if j = i then c else 0) * φ z := by
            funext z
            rw [hY]
            by_cases hji : j = i
            · subst hji
              simp
            · simp [hji, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
          rw [hfun]
          unfold partialDeriv
          rw [fderiv_const_mul hd]
          rfl
        simp only [sepDensDiv, Matrix.det_one, Real.sqrt_one, one_mul]
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hj j)]
        simp
      have hint_eq : (∫ y in K, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) Y y) =
          c * ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y := by
        simp only [hdiv]
        exact integral_const_mul c _
      have hle : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in K, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) Y y)
          ≤ sepPerG (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) K (Metric.ball 0 (r + 1)) := by
        unfold sepPerG
        exact le_iSup₂_of_le Y ⟨hYs, hYcs, hYt, hYn⟩ le_rfl
      rw [hint_eq] at hle
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal hfinR.ne).1 hle
    rcases hs0.lt_or_eq with hspos | hs0'
    · have hinv : 0 < s⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 hspos
      have h1 := key s⁻¹ (by rw [abs_of_pos hinv, inv_mul_cancel₀ hspos.ne'])
      have h2 := key (-s⁻¹) (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hinv, inv_mul_cancel₀ hspos.ne'])
      rw [neg_mul] at h2
      have hL : s * (s⁻¹ * (∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y)) = ∫ y in K, partialDeriv i φ y := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hspos.ne', one_mul]
      have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hspos.le
      have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hspos.le
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor
      · nlinarith
      · nlinarith
    · have hφ0 : φ = 0 := by
        funext y
        have := hs y
        rw [← hs0'] at this
        exact abs_nonpos_iff.1 this
      subst hφ0
      rw [← hs0']
      simp [partialDeriv]

informal_problem.statement: (ℓ : (E3 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hadd : ∀ φ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ℓ (φ + ψ) = ℓ φ + ℓ ψ) (hsmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ℓ (c • φ) = c * ℓ φ) (hbd : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r → ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ y, |φ y| ≤ s) → |ℓ φ| ≤ C * s) : ∃ Λ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f : E3 → ℝ) → Λ f = ℓ (f : E3 → ℝ)) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, tsupport (f : E3 → ℝ) ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r → ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ y, |f y| ≤ s) → |Λ f| ≤ C * s

signature.name: sepGG_order0_extend
signature.statement: (ℓ : (E3 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hadd : ∀ φ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ℓ (φ + ψ) = ℓ φ + ℓ ψ) (hsmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ℓ (c • φ) = c * ℓ φ) (hbd : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r → ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ y, |φ y| ≤ s) → |ℓ φ| ≤ C * s) : ∃ Λ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f : E3 → ℝ) → Λ f = ℓ (f : E3 → ℝ)) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, tsupport (f : E3 → ℝ) ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r → ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ y, |f y| ≤ s) → |Λ f| ≤ C * s

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hs1 : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ U : Set E3, IsOpen U →
      tsupport f ⊆ U → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ g : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧
        tsupport g ⊆ U ∧ ∀ x, |g x - f x| ≤ δ := by
    intro f hf hfc U hU hfU δ hδ
    obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hthick⟩ := hfc.isCompact.exists_thickening_subset_open hU hfU
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hηf⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.1
      (hfc.uniformContinuous_of_continuous hf) δ hδ
    have hrO0 : 0 < min (ε₀ / 2) η := lt_min (by linarith) hη
    let ρ : ContDiffBump (0 : E3) :=
      ⟨min (ε₀ / 2) η / 2, min (ε₀ / 2) η, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    refine ⟨convolution (ρ.normed volume) f (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume,
      ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact HasCompactSupport.contDiff_convolution_left (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := ⊤) _
        ρ.hasCompactSupport_normed ρ.contDiff_normed hf.locallyIntegrable
    · exact HasCompactSupport.convolution _ ρ.hasCompactSupport_normed hfc
    · have hsupp : Function.support
          (convolution (ρ.normed volume) f (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) ⊆
            thickening (min (ε₀ / 2) η) (tsupport f) := by
        refine (support_convolution_subset _).trans ?_
        rw [ρ.support_normed_eq]
        intro y hy
        obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_add.1 hy
        rw [mem_thickening_iff]
        refine ⟨b, subset_tsupport _ hb, ?_⟩
        rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_right]
        have ha' : a ∈ ball (0 : E3) (min (ε₀ / 2) η) := ha
        simpa using ha'
      have hlt : min (ε₀ / 2) η < ε₀ := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
      calc tsupport (convolution (ρ.normed volume) f (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume)
          ⊆ closure (thickening (min (ε₀ / 2) η) (tsupport f)) := closure_mono hsupp
        _ ⊆ cthickening (min (ε₀ / 2) η) (tsupport f) :=
            closure_thickening_subset_cthickening _ _
        _ ⊆ thickening ε₀ (tsupport f) := cthickening_subset_thickening' hε₀ hlt _
        _ ⊆ U := hthick
    · intro x
      have h := ContDiffBump.dist_normed_convolution_le (φ := ρ) (μ := volume) (x₀ := x)
        (ε := δ) hf.aestronglyMeasurable (by
          intro y hy
          have hy' : dist y x < min (ε₀ / 2) η := hy
          have : dist y x < η := lt_of_lt_of_le hy' (min_le_right _ _)
          exact (hηf this).le)
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at h
      exact h
  
  have hsub : ∀ a b : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ a → HasCompactSupport a → ContDiff ℝ ∞ b →
      HasCompactSupport b → ℓ (a - b) = ℓ a - ℓ b := by
    intro a b ha hac hb hbc
    have hb' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ((-1 : ℝ) • b) := by rw [neg_one_smul]; exact hb.neg
    have hbc' : HasCompactSupport ((-1 : ℝ) • b) := by rw [neg_one_smul]; exact hbc.neg
    have e1 : a - b = a + (-1 : ℝ) • b := by rw [neg_one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [e1, hadd a _ ha hac hb' hbc', hsmul (-1) b hb hbc]
    ring
  
  have hlip : ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ a b : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ a →
      HasCompactSupport a → tsupport a ⊆ closedBall 0 R → ContDiff ℝ ∞ b →
      HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ closedBall 0 R → ∀ t : ℝ,
      (∀ y, |a y - b y| ≤ t) → |ℓ a - ℓ b| ≤ C * t := by
    intro R hR
    obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hbd R hR
    refine ⟨C, hC0, fun a b ha hac haR hb hbc hbR t ht => ?_⟩
    rw [← hsub a b ha hac hb hbc]
    exact hC (a - b) (ha.sub hb) (hac.sub hbc)
      ((tsupport_sub a b).trans (Set.union_subset haR hbR)) t (fun y => ht y)
  
  have hclose : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (φ ψ : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (R : ℝ), sepGGApx f φ R → sepGGApx f ψ R →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n m, N ≤ n → N ≤ m → |ℓ (φ n) - ℓ (ψ m)| ≤ ε := by
    intro f φ ψ R hφ hψ ε hε
    obtain ⟨hR, hφs, hφc, hφR, hφf⟩ := hφ
    obtain ⟨-, hψs, hψc, hψR, hψf⟩ := hψ
    obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hlip R hR
    have hC1 : C + 1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hηe⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 2 * η * (C + 1) = ε :=
      ⟨ε / (2 * (C + 1)), div_pos hε (by linarith), by field_simp⟩
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hφf η hη
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := hψf η hη
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n m hn hm => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hC (φ n) (ψ m) (hφs n) (hφc n) (hφR n) (hψs m) (hψc m) (hψR m)
      (2 * η) (fun y => by
        have a1 := hN₁ n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn) y
        have a2 := hN₂ m (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hm) y
        rw [abs_le] at a1 a2 ⊢
        constructor <;> linarith [a1.1, a1.2, a2.1, a2.2])
    have h2 : C * (2 * η) ≤ 2 * η * (C + 1) := by nlinarith
    linarith
  
  have hs2 : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (φ ψ : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (R : ℝ), sepGGApx f φ R → sepGGApx f ψ R →
      ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun n => ℓ (φ n)) atTop (𝓝 L) ∧
        Tendsto (fun n => ℓ (ψ n)) atTop (𝓝 L) := by
    intro f φ ψ R hφ hψ
    have hcs : CauchySeq (fun n => ℓ (φ n)) := by
      rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff']
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hclose f φ φ R hφ hφ (ε / 2) (by linarith)
      refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have := hN n N hn le_rfl
      linarith
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hcs
    refine ⟨L, hL, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop] at hL ⊢
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hL (ε / 2) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := hclose f φ ψ R hφ hψ (ε / 2) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have a1 := hN₁ n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn)
    have a2 := hN₂ n n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn) (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at a1 ⊢
    rw [abs_lt] at a1 ⊢
    rw [abs_le] at a2
    constructor <;> linarith [a1.1, a1.2, a2.1, a2.2]
  
  have hmono : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (φ : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (R R' : ℝ), sepGGApx f φ R → R ≤ R' →
      sepGGApx f φ R' := by
    intro f φ R R' h hRR'
    obtain ⟨hR, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
    exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hR hRR', h1, h2,
      fun n => (h3 n).trans (closedBall_subset_closedBall hRR'), h4⟩
  
  have hs3 : ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
      tsupport (f : E3 → ℝ) ⊆ closedBall 0 r := by
    intro f
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀⟩ := (isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : E3)).1
      f.hasCompactSupport.isCompact.isBounded
    exact ⟨max r₀ 1, lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_right _ _),
      hr₀.trans (closedBall_subset_closedBall (le_max_left _ _))⟩
