  have hs4 : ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
      tsupport (f : E3 → ℝ) ⊆ closedBall 0 r → ∃ A : ℕ → E3 → ℝ,
        sepGGApx (f : E3 → ℝ) A (r + 1) ∧ ∀ n y, |A n y| ≤ |f y| + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro f r hr hfr
    have hfU : tsupport (f : E3 → ℝ) ⊆ ball 0 (r + 1) :=
      hfr.trans (closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))
    have hex : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ g : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧
        tsupport g ⊆ ball 0 (r + 1) ∧ ∀ x, |g x - f x| ≤ 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) :=
      fun n => hs1 f f.continuous f.hasCompactSupport _ isOpen_ball hfU _ (by positivity)
    choose A hAs hAc hAU hAf using hex
    refine ⟨A, ⟨by linarith, hAs, hAc, fun n => (hAU n).trans ball_subset_closedBall, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hε
      refine ⟨N, fun n hn y => ?_⟩
      have h1 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1) := Nat.one_div_le_one_div hn
      linarith [hAf n y]
    · intro n y
      have h := hAf n y
      rw [abs_le] at h
      exact abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [neg_abs_le (f y), h.1], by linarith [le_abs_self (f y), h.2]⟩
  
  have hs5 : ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, ∃ L : ℝ, ∀ (φ : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (R : ℝ),
      sepGGApx (f : E3 → ℝ) φ R → Tendsto (fun n => ℓ (φ n)) atTop (𝓝 L) := by
    intro f
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hfr⟩ := hs3 f
    obtain ⟨A, hA, -⟩ := hs4 f r hr hfr
    obtain ⟨L, hL, -⟩ := hs2 f A A (r + 1) hA hA
    refine ⟨L, fun φ R hφ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨L', h1, h2⟩ := hs2 f A φ (max (r + 1) R)
      (hmono _ _ _ _ hA (le_max_left _ _)) (hmono _ _ _ _ hφ (le_max_right _ _))
    rw [tendsto_nhds_unique hL h1]
    exact h2
  
  choose Λ₀ hΛ₀ using hs5
  
  have hApx_add : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (φ ψ : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (R R' : ℝ), sepGGApx f φ R →
      sepGGApx g ψ R' → sepGGApx (f + g) (fun n => φ n + ψ n) (max R R') := by
    intro f g φ ψ R R' hφ hψ
    obtain ⟨hR, hφs, hφc, hφR, hφf⟩ := hφ
    obtain ⟨hR', hψs, hψc, hψR, hψf⟩ := hψ
    refine ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hR (le_max_left _ _), fun n => (hφs n).add (hψs n),
      fun n => (hφc n).add (hψc n), fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (tsupport_add (φ n) (ψ n)).trans (Set.union_subset
        ((hφR n).trans (closedBall_subset_closedBall (le_max_left _ _)))
        ((hψR n).trans (closedBall_subset_closedBall (le_max_right _ _))))
    · intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hφf (ε / 2) (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := hψf (ε / 2) (by linarith)
      refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun n hn y => ?_⟩
      have a1 := hN₁ n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn) y
      have a2 := hN₂ n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn) y
      simp only [Pi.add_apply]
      rw [abs_le] at a1 a2 ⊢
      constructor <;> linarith [a1.1, a1.2, a2.1, a2.2]
  have hApx_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (φ : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (R : ℝ), sepGGApx f φ R →
      sepGGApx (c • f) (fun n => c • φ n) R := by
    intro c f φ R hφ
    obtain ⟨hR, hφs, hφc, hφR, hφf⟩ := hφ
    refine ⟨hR, fun n => (hφs n).const_smul c, fun n => (hφc n).smul_left (f := fun _ => c),
      fun n => ((tsupport_smul_subset_right (fun _ => c) (φ n))).trans (hφR n), ?_⟩
    intro ε hε
    have hc1 : 0 < |c| + 1 := by positivity
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hφf (ε / (|c| + 1)) (div_pos hε hc1)
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn y => ?_⟩
    have a1 := hN n hn y
    have e1 : (fun n => c • φ n) n y - (c • f) y = c * (φ n y - f y) := by
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [e1, abs_mul]
    calc |c| * |φ n y - f y| ≤ |c| * (ε / (|c| + 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a1 (abs_nonneg c)
      _ ≤ ε := by
          rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_iff₀ hc1]
          nlinarith [abs_nonneg c]
  
  have hΛadd : ∀ f g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, Λ₀ (f + g) = Λ₀ f + Λ₀ g := by
    intro f g
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hf₁⟩ := hs3 f
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hg₂⟩ := hs3 g
    obtain ⟨A, hA, -⟩ := hs4 f r₁ hr₁ hf₁
    obtain ⟨B, hB, -⟩ := hs4 g r₂ hr₂ hg₂
    have hS := hApx_add _ _ _ _ _ _ hA hB
    rw [← CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.coe_add] at hS
    have h1 := hΛ₀ (f + g) _ _ hS
    have h2 : Tendsto (fun n => ℓ (A n + B n)) atTop (𝓝 (Λ₀ f + Λ₀ g)) := by
      have e : (fun n => ℓ (A n + B n)) = fun n => ℓ (A n) + ℓ (B n) := by
        funext n
        exact hadd _ _ (hA.2.1 n) (hA.2.2.1 n) (hB.2.1 n) (hB.2.2.1 n)
      rw [e]
      exact (hΛ₀ f _ _ hA).add (hΛ₀ g _ _ hB)
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2
  
  have hΛsmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ),
      Λ₀ (c • f) = c * Λ₀ f := by
    intro c f
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hfr⟩ := hs3 f
    obtain ⟨A, hA, -⟩ := hs4 f r hr hfr
    have hT := hApx_smul c _ _ _ hA
    rw [← CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.coe_smul] at hT
    have h1 := hΛ₀ (c • f) _ _ hT
    have h2 : Tendsto (fun n => ℓ (c • A n)) atTop (𝓝 (c * Λ₀ f)) := by
      have e : (fun n => ℓ (c • A n)) = fun n => c * ℓ (A n) := by
        funext n
        exact hsmul c _ (hA.2.1 n) (hA.2.2.1 n)
      rw [e]
      exact (hΛ₀ f _ _ hA).const_mul c
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2
  
  let Λ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := Λ₀
      map_add' := hΛadd
      map_smul' := fun c f => by
        simp only [RingHom.id_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        exact hΛsmul c f }
  refine ⟨Λ, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · intro f hf
    show Λ₀ f = ℓ (f : E3 → ℝ)
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hfr⟩ := hs3 f
    have hc : sepGGApx (f : E3 → ℝ) (fun _ => (f : E3 → ℝ)) r :=
      ⟨hr, fun _ => hf, fun _ => f.hasCompactSupport, fun _ => hfr,
        fun ε hε => ⟨0, fun n _ y => by simp [hε.le]⟩⟩
    have h1 := hΛ₀ f _ _ hc
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 tendsto_const_nhds
  
  · intro r hr
    obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hbd (r + 1) (by linarith)
    refine ⟨C, hC0, fun f hfr s hs => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨A, hA, hAb⟩ := hs4 f r hr hfr
    have hle : ∀ n : ℕ, |ℓ (A n)| ≤ C * (s + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
      intro n
      refine hC (A n) (hA.2.1 n) (hA.2.2.1 n) (hA.2.2.2.1 n) _ (fun y => ?_)
      linarith [hAb n y, hs y]
    have h1 : Tendsto (fun n => |ℓ (A n)|) atTop (𝓝 |Λ₀ f|) := (hΛ₀ f _ _ hA).abs
    have h2 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => C * (s + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) atTop (𝓝 (C * (s + 0))) :=
      (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_add s).const_mul C
    rw [add_zero] at h2
    show |Λ₀ f| ≤ C * s
    exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' h1 h2 hle

sepGG_order0_extend.definitions:
def sepGGApx (f : E3 → ℝ) (φ : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (R : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < R ∧ (∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φ n)) ∧ (∀ n, HasCompactSupport (φ n)) ∧
    (∀ n, tsupport (φ n) ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 R) ∧
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n, N ≤ n → ∀ y, |φ n y - f y| ≤ ε)

informal_problem.statement: (Λ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hbd : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, tsupport (f : E3 → ℝ) ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r → ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ y, |f y| ≤ s) → |Λ f| ≤ C * s) : ∃ μp μm : Measure E3, (∀ r : ℝ, μp (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) ∧ (∀ r : ℝ, μm (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) ∧ ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, Λ f = (∫ x, f x ∂μp) - ∫ x, f x ∂μm

signature.name: sepGG_riesz_signed
signature.statement: (Λ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (hbd : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, tsupport (f : E3 → ℝ) ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 r → ∀ s : ℝ, (∀ y, |f y| ≤ s) → |Λ f| ≤ C * s) : ∃ μp μm : Measure E3, (∀ r : ℝ, μp (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) ∧ (∀ r : ℝ, μm (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) ∧ ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, Λ f = (∫ x, f x ∂μp) - ∫ x, f x ∂μm

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ → Set ℝ, S = fun f =>
      {t : ℝ | ∃ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ f x) ∧ Λ g = t} :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmem : ∀ f t, t ∈ S f ↔
      ∃ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x ∧ g x ≤ f x) ∧ Λ g = t := by
    intro f t; rw [hS]; rfl
  
  have hbdd : ∀ f, BddAbove (S f) := by
    intro f
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : E3)).1
      f.hasCompactSupport.isCompact.isBounded
    obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := hbd (max r₀ 1) (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_right _ _))
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := HasCompactSupport.exists_bound_of_continuous f.hasCompactSupport
      (map_continuous f)
    refine ⟨C * B, ?_⟩
    rintro t ht
    rw [hmem] at ht
    obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := ht
    have hsupp : tsupport (g : E3 → ℝ) ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 (max r₀ 1) := by
      refine (closure_mono ?_).trans
        (hr₀.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (le_max_left _ _)))
      intro x hx
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
      intro hfx
      apply hx
      have h := hg x
      rw [hfx] at h
      exact le_antisymm h.2 h.1
    have hgB : ∀ y, |g y| ≤ B := by
      intro y
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (hg y).1]
      have hy := hB y
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hy
      exact (hg y).2.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans hy)
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hC g hsupp B hgB)
  have hzero : ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → (0 : ℝ) ∈ S f := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hmem]
    exact ⟨0, fun x => by simp [hf x], map_zero Λ⟩
  have hself : ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → Λ f ∈ S f := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hmem]
    exact ⟨f, fun x => ⟨hf x, le_rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  
  have hadd : ∀ f₁ f₂ : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f₁ x) →
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ f₂ x) → sSup (S (f₁ + f₂)) = sSup (S f₁) + sSup (S f₂) := by
    intro f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂
    have h12 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ (f₁ + f₂) x := fun x => by
      simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]; linarith [h₁ x, h₂ x]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply csSup_le ⟨0, hzero _ h12⟩
      intro t ht
      rw [hmem] at ht
      obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := ht
      have hg1 : Λ (g ⊓ f₁) ∈ S f₁ := by
        rw [hmem]
        refine ⟨g ⊓ f₁, fun x => ?_, rfl⟩
        simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.inf_apply]
        exact ⟨le_inf (hg x).1 (h₁ x), inf_le_right⟩
      have hg2 : Λ (g - g ⊓ f₁) ∈ S f₂ := by
        rw [hmem]
        refine ⟨g - g ⊓ f₁, fun x => ?_, rfl⟩
        simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.sub_apply,
          CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.inf_apply]
        obtain ⟨hgx1, hgx2⟩ := hg x
        simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply] at hgx2
        have hm : g x ⊓ f₁ x ≤ g x := inf_le_left
        constructor
        · linarith
        · rcases le_total (g x) (f₁ x) with h | h
          · rw [inf_eq_left.2 h]; linarith [h₂ x]
          · rw [inf_eq_right.2 h]; linarith
      have hsplit : Λ g = Λ (g ⊓ f₁) + Λ (g - g ⊓ f₁) := by
        rw [← map_add]; congr 1; abel
      rw [hsplit]
      exact add_le_add (le_csSup (hbdd _) hg1) (le_csSup (hbdd _) hg2)
    · have key : ∀ t₁ ∈ S f₁, ∀ t₂ ∈ S f₂, t₁ + t₂ ≤ sSup (S (f₁ + f₂)) := by
        intro t₁ ht₁ t₂ ht₂
        rw [hmem] at ht₁ ht₂
        obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, rfl⟩ := ht₁
        obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂, rfl⟩ := ht₂
        apply le_csSup (hbdd _)
        rw [hmem]
        refine ⟨g₁ + g₂, fun x => ?_, map_add Λ g₁ g₂⟩
        simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
        obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := hg₁ x
        obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := hg₂ x
        constructor <;> linarith
      have h2 : ∀ t₂ ∈ S f₂, sSup (S f₁) ≤ sSup (S (f₁ + f₂)) - t₂ := by
        intro t₂ ht₂
        apply csSup_le ⟨0, hzero _ h₁⟩
        intro t₁ ht₁
        linarith [key t₁ ht₁ t₂ ht₂]
      have h3 : sSup (S f₂) ≤ sSup (S (f₁ + f₂)) - sSup (S f₁) := by
        apply csSup_le ⟨0, hzero _ h₂⟩
        intro t₂ ht₂
        linarith [h2 t₂ ht₂]
      linarith
  
  have hsmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ), 0 ≤ c →
      sSup (S (c • f)) = c * sSup (S f) := by
    intro c f hc
    rcases hc.lt_or_eq with hc | rfl
    · open scoped Pointwise in
      have hset : S (c • f) = c • S f := by
        ext t
        rw [Set.mem_smul_set, hmem]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
          refine ⟨Λ (c⁻¹ • g), ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [hmem]
            refine ⟨c⁻¹ • g, fun x => ?_, rfl⟩
            obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hg x
            simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h1 h2 ⊢
            constructor
            · exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hc.le) h1
            · rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hc]; exact h2
          · rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hc.ne']
        · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          rw [hmem] at hy
          obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := hy
          refine ⟨c • g, fun x => ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
            obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hg x
            exact ⟨mul_nonneg hc.le h1, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hc.le⟩
          · rw [map_smul]
      rw [hset, Real.sSup_smul_of_nonneg hc.le, smul_eq_mul]
    · have hset : S ((0 : ℝ) • f) = {0} := by
        ext t
        rw [hmem, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
          have hg0 : g = 0 := by
            ext x
            have h := hg x
            simp only [zero_smul, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.zero_apply] at h ⊢
            exact le_antisymm h.2 h.1
          rw [hg0, map_zero]
        · rintro rfl
          exact ⟨0, fun x => by simp, map_zero Λ⟩
      rw [hset, csSup_singleton, zero_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ → ℝ, p = fun f => sSup (S f) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpadd : ∀ f g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) →
      p (f + g) = p f + p g := by
    intro f g hf hg; rw [hp]; exact hadd f g hf hg
  have hpsmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ), 0 ≤ c →
      p (c • f) = c * p f := by
    intro c f hc; rw [hp]; exact hsmul c f hc
  have hp0 : p 0 = 0 := by
    have h := hpsmul 0 0 le_rfl
    rw [zero_smul, zero_mul] at h
    exact h
  have npos : ∀ (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ) x, 0 ≤ (f ⊔ 0) x := by
    intro f x
    simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.sup_apply, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.zero_apply]
    exact le_sup_right
  have hdec : ∀ (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ) x, (f ⊔ 0) x - ((-f) ⊔ 0) x = f x := by
    intro f x
    simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.sup_apply, CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.zero_apply,
      CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.neg_apply]
    rcases le_total 0 (f x) with h | h
    · rw [sup_eq_left.2 h, sup_eq_right.2 (by linarith)]; ring
    · rw [sup_eq_right.2 h, sup_eq_left.2 (by linarith)]; ring
  have K : ∀ f a b : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ a x) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ b x) →
      (∀ x, f x = a x - b x) → p (f ⊔ 0) - p ((-f) ⊔ 0) = p a - p b := by
    intro f a b ha hb hfab
    have e : f ⊔ 0 + b = a + (-f) ⊔ 0 := by
      ext x
      simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
      linarith [hdec f x, hfab x]
    have h1 := hpadd (f ⊔ 0) b (npos f) hb
    have h2 := hpadd a ((-f) ⊔ 0) ha (npos (-f))
    rw [e] at h1
    linarith
  let P : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun f => p (f ⊔ 0) - p ((-f) ⊔ 0)
      map_add' := by
        intro f g
        show p ((f + g) ⊔ 0) - p ((-(f + g)) ⊔ 0) =
          (p (f ⊔ 0) - p ((-f) ⊔ 0)) + (p (g ⊔ 0) - p ((-g) ⊔ 0))
        rw [K (f + g) (f ⊔ 0 + g ⊔ 0) ((-f) ⊔ 0 + (-g) ⊔ 0)
          (fun x => by
            simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
            linarith [npos f x, npos g x])
          (fun x => by
            simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
            linarith [npos (-f) x, npos (-g) x])
          (fun x => by
            simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.add_apply]
            linarith [hdec f x, hdec g x])]
        rw [hpadd _ _ (npos f) (npos g), hpadd _ _ (npos (-f)) (npos (-g))]
        ring
      map_smul' := by
        intro c f
        show p ((c • f) ⊔ 0) - p ((-(c • f)) ⊔ 0) = c • (p (f ⊔ 0) - p ((-f) ⊔ 0))
        rw [smul_eq_mul]
        rcases le_total 0 c with hc | hc
        · rw [K (c • f) (c • (f ⊔ 0)) (c • ((-f) ⊔ 0))
            (fun x => by
              simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
              exact mul_nonneg hc (npos f x))
            (fun x => by
              simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
              exact mul_nonneg hc (npos (-f) x))
            (fun x => by
              have h := hdec f x
              simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
              linear_combination (-c) * h)]
          rw [hpsmul c _ hc, hpsmul c _ hc]
          ring
        · have hc' : 0 ≤ -c := by linarith
          rw [K (c • f) ((-c) • ((-f) ⊔ 0)) ((-c) • (f ⊔ 0))
            (fun x => by
              simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
              exact mul_nonneg hc' (npos (-f) x))
            (fun x => by
              simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
              exact mul_nonneg hc' (npos f x))
            (fun x => by
              have h := hdec f x
              simp only [CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
              linear_combination (-c) * h)]
          rw [hpsmul (-c) _ hc', hpsmul (-c) _ hc']
          ring }
  have hPapp : ∀ f, P f = p (f ⊔ 0) - p ((-f) ⊔ 0) := fun f => rfl
  have hPcone : ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → P f = p f := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hPapp, K f f 0 hf (fun x => by simp) (fun x => by simp), hp0, sub_zero]
  
  have hrmk : ∀ Q : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ,
      (∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → 0 ≤ Q f) →
      ∃ μ : Measure E3, (∀ r : ℝ, μ (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) ∧
        ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, Q f = ∫ x, f x ∂μ := by
    intro Q hQ
    let Q' : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ :=
      PositiveLinearMap.mk₀ Q (fun f hf => hQ f (fun x => by
        simpa using CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.le_def.mp hf x))
    refine ⟨RealRMK.rieszMeasure Q', fun r => ?_, fun f => ?_⟩
    · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
        (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) r).measure_lt_top
    · exact (RealRMK.integral_rieszMeasure Q' f).symm
  
  have hPpos : ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → 0 ≤ P f := by
    intro f hf
    rw [hPcone f hf, hp]
    exact le_csSup (hbdd f) (hzero f hf)
  have hQpos : ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap E3 ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → 0 ≤ (P - Λ) f := by
    intro f hf
    rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, hPcone f hf, hp, sub_nonneg]
    exact le_csSup (hbdd f) (hself f hf)
  obtain ⟨μp, hμp, hrepP⟩ := hrmk P hPpos
  obtain ⟨μm, hμm, hrepQ⟩ := hrmk (P - Λ) hQpos
  refine ⟨μp, μm, hμp, hμm, fun f => ?_⟩
  rw [← hrepP f, ← hrepQ f, LinearMap.sub_apply]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (μp μm : Fin 3 → Measure E3) (hp : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (r : ℝ), μp i (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) (hm : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (r : ℝ), μm i (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) : ∃ (μ : Measure E3) (ν : E3 → E3), (∀ r : ℝ, μ (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) ∧ Measurable ν ∧ (∀ x, ‖ν x‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ X : E3 → E3, Continuous X → HasCompactSupport X → ∑ i : Fin 3, ((∫ x, X x i ∂(μp i)) - ∫ x, X x i ∂(μm i)) = ∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) ∂μ

signature.name: sepGG_polar
signature.statement: (μp μm : Fin 3 → Measure E3) (hp : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (r : ℝ), μp i (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) (hm : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (r : ℝ), μm i (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) : ∃ (μ : Measure E3) (ν : E3 → E3), (∀ r : ℝ, μ (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) ∧ Measurable ν ∧ (∀ x, ‖ν x‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ X : E3 → E3, Continuous X → HasCompactSupport X → ∑ i : Fin 3, ((∫ x, X x i ∂(μp i)) - ∫ x, X x i ∂(μm i)) = ∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) ∂μ

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hLF : ∀ ρ : Measure E3, (∀ r : ℝ, ρ (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) →
      IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ρ := by
    intro ρ hρ
    refine ⟨fun K hK => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_ball (0 : E3)).1 hK.isBounded
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono hr) (hρ r)
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρdef⟩ : ∃ ρ : Measure E3, ρ = ∑ i : Fin 3, (μp i + μm i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρapp : ∀ s, ρ s = ∑ i : Fin 3, (μp i s + μm i s) := by
    intro s
    rw [hρdef, Measure.finset_sum_apply]
    simp only [Measure.add_apply]
  have hρ : ∀ r : ℝ, ρ (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤ := by
    intro r
    rw [hρapp]
    exact ENNReal.sum_lt_top.mpr (fun i _ => ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr ⟨hp i r, hm i r⟩)
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts ρ := hLF ρ hρ
  haveI : SigmaFinite ρ := sigmaFinite_of_locallyFinite
  have hlep : ∀ i, μp i ≤ ρ := by
    intro i
    refine Measure.le_iff.mpr (fun s _ => ?_)
    rw [hρapp]
    calc μp i s ≤ μp i s + μm i s := le_self_add
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, (μp j s + μm j s) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => μp j s + μm j s) (fun j _ => zero_le _)
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hlem : ∀ i, μm i ≤ ρ := by
    intro i
    refine Measure.le_iff.mpr (fun s _ => ?_)
    rw [hρapp]
    calc μm i s ≤ μp i s + μm i s := le_add_self
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, (μp j s + μm j s) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => μp j s + μm j s) (fun j _ => zero_le _)
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
  
  have hrn : ∀ μ' : Measure E3, μ' ≤ ρ → ∃ a : E3 → ℝ, Measurable a ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ a x ∧ a x ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, ∫ x, φ x ∂μ' = ∫ x, a x * φ x ∂ρ := by
    intro μ' hle
    haveI : SigmaFinite μ' := Measure.sigmaFinite_of_le ρ hle
    haveI : μ'.HaveLebesgueDecomposition ρ :=
      Measure.haveLebesgueDecomposition_of_sigmaFinite μ' ρ
    have hac : μ' ≪ ρ := Measure.absolutelyContinuous_of_le hle
    refine ⟨fun x => min 1 ((μ'.rnDeriv ρ x).toReal),
      measurable_const.min (Measure.measurable_rnDeriv μ' ρ).ennreal_toReal,
      fun x => ⟨le_min zero_le_one ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, min_le_left _ _⟩, fun φ => ?_⟩
    rw [← integral_rnDeriv_smul hac]
    refine integral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [Measure.rnDeriv_le_one_of_le hle] with x hx
    have hx' : μ'.rnDeriv ρ x ≤ 1 := hx
    have h1 : (μ'.rnDeriv ρ x).toReal ≤ 1 := by
      have := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.one_ne_top hx'
      simpa using this
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, min_eq_right h1]
  
  choose a ha_meas ha_bd ha_int using fun i => hrn (μp i) (hlep i)
  choose b hb_meas hb_bd hb_int using fun i => hrn (μm i) (hlem i)
  
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξdef⟩ : ∃ ξ : E3 → E3,
      ξ = fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, (a i x - b i x) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hξm : Measurable ξ := by
    rw [hξdef]
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => ((ha_meas i).sub (hb_meas i)).smul_const _)
  have hξ3 : ∀ x, ‖ξ x‖ ≤ 3 := by
    intro x
    have hterm : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        ‖(a i x - b i x) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by
      intro i
      rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith [(ha_bd i x).2, (hb_bd i x).1],
        by linarith [(ha_bd i x).1, (hb_bd i x).2]⟩
    calc ‖ξ x‖ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖(a i x - b i x) • EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)‖ := by
          rw [hξdef]; exact norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, (1 : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hterm i)
      _ = 3 := by simp
  have hinner : ∀ x (v : E3), @inner ℝ E3 _ v (ξ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, (a i x - b i x) * v i := by
    intro x v
    rw [hξdef]
    simp [inner_sum, real_inner_smul_right, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
  
  obtain ⟨μ, hμdef⟩ : ∃ μ : Measure E3,
      μ = ρ.withDensity (fun x => ((‖ξ x‖₊ : NNReal) : ENNReal)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ν, hνdef⟩ : ∃ ν : E3 → E3, ν = fun x =>
      if ξ x = 0 then EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ) else ‖ξ x‖⁻¹ • ξ x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hνm : Measurable ν := by
    rw [hνdef]
    exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_eq_fun hξm measurable_const) measurable_const
      (hξm.norm.inv.smul hξm)
  have hν1 : ∀ x, ‖ν x‖ = 1 := by
    intro x
    by_cases h : ξ x = 0
    · simp [hνdef, h, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    · simp only [hνdef, h, if_false]
      rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h)]
  have hK : ∀ x, ‖ξ x‖ • ν x = ξ x := by
    intro x
    by_cases h : ξ x = 0
    · simp [hνdef, h]
    · simp only [hνdef, h, if_false]
      rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h), one_smul]
  have hμ : ∀ r : ℝ, μ (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤ := by
    intro r
    rw [hμdef, withDensity_apply _ measurableSet_ball]
    calc ∫⁻ x in Metric.ball 0 r, ((‖ξ x‖₊ : NNReal) : ENNReal) ∂ρ
        ≤ ∫⁻ x in Metric.ball 0 r, (3 : ENNReal) ∂ρ := by
          refine lintegral_mono (fun x => ?_)
          have h3 : ‖ξ x‖₊ ≤ 3 := by
            rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe]
            simpa using hξ3 x
          have h3' := ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr h3
          simpa using h3'
      _ = 3 * ρ (Metric.ball 0 r) := by rw [setLIntegral_const]
      _ < ⊤ := ENNReal.mul_lt_top (by simp) (hρ r)
  have hpolar : ∀ X : E3 → E3, ∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) ∂μ =
      ∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ξ x) ∂ρ := by
    intro X
    rw [hμdef, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_smul hξm.nnnorm]
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [NNReal.smul_def, coe_nnnorm, smul_eq_mul, ← real_inner_smul_right, hK]
  
  refine ⟨μ, ν, hμ, hνm, hν1, fun X hX hXc => ?_⟩
  rw [hpolar X]
  have hXi : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun x => X x i) := fun i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i).continuous.comp hX
  have hXic : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (fun x => X x i) := fun i =>
    hXc.comp_left (g := fun v : E3 => v i) rfl
  have hint : ∀ (c : E3 → ℝ), Measurable c → (∀ x, |c x| ≤ 1) → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      Integrable (fun x => c x * X x i) ρ := by
    intro c hc hc1 i
    have hf : Integrable (fun x => X x i) ρ :=
      (hXi i).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hXic i)
    exact hf.bdd_mul (c := 1) hc.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Eventually.of_forall fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hc1 x)
  have Ia : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun x => a i x * X x i) ρ := fun i =>
    hint (a i) (ha_meas i)
      (fun x => abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [(ha_bd i x).1], (ha_bd i x).2⟩) i
  have Ib : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun x => b i x * X x i) ρ := fun i =>
    hint (b i) (hb_meas i)
      (fun x => abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [(hb_bd i x).1], (hb_bd i x).2⟩) i
  calc ∑ i : Fin 3, ((∫ x, X x i ∂(μp i)) - ∫ x, X x i ∂(μm i))
      = ∑ i : Fin 3, ((∫ x, a i x * X x i ∂ρ) - ∫ x, b i x * X x i ∂ρ) := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [ha_int i, hb_int i]
    _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∫ x, (a i x * X x i - b i x * X x i) ∂ρ := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [integral_sub (Ia i) (Ib i)]
    _ = ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 3, (a i x * X x i - b i x * X x i) ∂ρ := by
        rw [integral_finset_sum]
        exact fun i _ => (Ia i).sub (Ib i)
    _ = ∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ξ x) ∂ρ := by
        congr 1
        funext x
        rw [hinner]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by ring)

informal_problem.statement: (μ : Measure E3) (hμ : ∀ r : ℝ, μ (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) (ν : E3 → E3) (hνm : Measurable ν) (hν1 : ∀ x, ‖ν x‖ = 1) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) : μ V ≤ ⨆ (X : E3 → E3) (_ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ V ∧ ∀ y, ‖X y‖ ≤ 1), ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) ∂μ)

signature.name: sepGG_dual_norm
signature.statement: (μ : Measure E3) (hμ : ∀ r : ℝ, μ (Metric.ball 0 r) < ⊤) (ν : E3 → E3) (hνm : Measurable ν) (hν1 : ∀ x, ‖ν x‖ = 1) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) : μ V ≤ ⨆ (X : E3 → E3) (_ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ V ∧ ∀ y, ‖X y‖ ≤ 1), ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) ∂μ)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hfc : IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ := ⟨fun K hK => by
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hK.isBounded.subset_ball 0
    exact (measure_mono hr).trans_lt (hμ r)⟩
  haveI := hfc
  haveI : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ := isLocallyFiniteMeasure_of_isFiniteMeasureOnCompacts
  haveI hreg : μ.Regular := Measure.Regular.of_sigmaCompactSpace_of_isLocallyFiniteMeasure μ
  
  refine le_of_forall_lt (fun c hc => ?_)
  rw [hV.measure_eq_iSup_isCompact μ] at hc
  obtain ⟨C, hc⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.mp hc
  obtain ⟨hCV, hc⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.mp hc
  obtain ⟨hC, hcC⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.mp hc
  have hCfin : μ C < ⊤ := hC.measure_lt_top
  have hctop : c ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_lt hcC
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = c.toReal := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, m = (μ C).toReal := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := ha ▸ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have ham : a < m := by
    rw [ha, hm]; exact (ENNReal.toReal_lt_toReal hctop hCfin.ne).mpr hcC
  have hca : c = ENNReal.ofReal a := by rw [ha, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hctop]
  
  obtain ⟨W, hWo, hCW, hWV, hWc⟩ := exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hC hV hCV
  obtain ⟨χ, hχs, hχr, hχsupp, hχ1⟩ :=
    exists_contMDiff_support_eq_eq_one_iff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (n := ⊤) hWo hC.isClosed hCW
  have hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ := contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp hχs
  have hχ01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1 := fun x => hχr ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hχC : ∀ x ∈ C, χ x = 1 := fun x hx => (hχ1 x).mp hx
  have hχ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ closure W → χ x = 0 := fun x hx => by
    have h' : x ∉ Function.support χ := by
      rw [hχsupp]; exact fun h => hx (subset_closure h)
    simpa using h'
  have hCWc : C ⊆ closure W := hCW.trans subset_closure
  have hWcfin : μ (closure W) < ⊤ := hWc.measure_lt_top
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ, w = (μ (closure W)).toReal := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hw0 : 0 ≤ w := hw ▸ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  
  have hfint : Integrable (C.indicator ν) μ := by
    rw [integrable_indicator_iff hC.measurableSet]
    refine Integrable.mono' (show IntegrableOn (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) C μ from
      integrableOn_const hCfin.ne) hνm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => (hν1 x).le)
  have hε : 0 < (m - a) / 4 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨g, -, hgL1, hgc, hgi⟩ := hfint.exists_hasCompactSupport_integral_sub_le hε
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδdef⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = (m - a) / (8 * (w + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by rw [hδdef]; exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hδeq : 8 * (δ * w) + 8 * δ = m - a := by
    rw [hδdef]; field_simp
  have hρc : Continuous (fun x => (max 1 ‖g x‖)⁻¹ • g x) :=
    ((continuous_const.max hgc.norm).inv₀
      (fun x => (lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_left _ _)).ne')).smul hgc
  obtain ⟨Sm, hSm⟩ := exists_contMDiffMap_forall_mem_convex_of_local_const 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (n := ⊤)
    (t := fun x => Metric.ball ((max 1 ‖g x‖)⁻¹ • g x) δ) (fun x => convex_ball _ _)
    (fun x => ⟨(max 1 ‖g x‖)⁻¹ • g x, Filter.Eventually.mono
      (hρc.continuousAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hδ)) (fun y hy => Metric.mem_ball_comm.mp hy)⟩)
  have hS : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => Sm x) := contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp Sm.contMDiff
  have hSδ : ∀ x, ‖Sm x - (max 1 ‖g x‖)⁻¹ • g x‖ < δ := fun x => by
    have h' := hSm x
    rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at h'
  
  have key : ∀ (νv gv Sv : E3) (cc : ℝ), ‖νv‖ = 1 → 0 ≤ cc → cc ≤ 1 →
      ‖Sv - (max 1 ‖gv‖)⁻¹ • gv‖ < δ →
      ‖((1 + δ)⁻¹ * cc) • Sv‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      (cc = 1 → 1 - 2 * δ - 2 * ‖gv - νv‖ ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ (((1 + δ)⁻¹ * cc) • Sv) νv) ∧
      -(2 * δ) - 2 * ‖gv‖ ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ (((1 + δ)⁻¹ * cc) • Sv) νv := by
    intro νv gv Sv cc hνv hc0 hc1 hSv
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = (max 1 ‖gv‖)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← ht] at hSv
    have htprop : 0 < t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧ t * ‖gv‖ ≤ 1 ∧ (t = 1 ∨ t * ‖gv‖ = 1) := by
      rcases le_total ‖gv‖ 1 with h | h
      · rw [max_eq_left h, inv_one] at ht
        subst ht
        exact ⟨one_pos, le_rfl, by linarith, Or.inl rfl⟩
      · rw [max_eq_right h] at ht
        have hg0 : 0 < ‖gv‖ := by linarith
        have h1 : t * ‖gv‖ = 1 := by rw [ht]; exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hg0.ne'
        refine ⟨by rw [ht]; exact inv_pos.mpr hg0, ?_, h1.le, Or.inr h1⟩
        rw [ht]; exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ h
    obtain ⟨ht0, ht1, htg, hcase⟩ := htprop
    have hng : 0 ≤ ‖gv‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hρn : ‖t • gv‖ = t * ‖gv‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht0.le]
    have hρg : ‖t • gv - gv‖ = (1 - t) * ‖gv‖ := by
      have : t • gv - gv = (t - 1) • gv := by rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
      rw [this, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
      ring
    have hR2 : (1 - t) * ‖gv‖ ≤ ‖gv - νv‖ := by
      rcases hcase with h | h
      · rw [h]; simp
      · have := norm_sub_norm_le gv νv
        rw [hνv] at this
        have e1 : (1 - t) * ‖gv‖ = ‖gv‖ - t * ‖gv‖ := by ring
        rw [e1, h]
        exact this
    have hSn : ‖Sv‖ ≤ t * ‖gv‖ + δ := by
      have := norm_sub_norm_le Sv (t • gv)
      rw [hρn] at this
      linarith
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ, q = (1 + δ)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hq]
    have hq0 : 0 < q := by rw [hq]; exact inv_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have hqe : q * (1 + δ) = 1 := by rw [hq]; exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (by linarith)
    have hqe' : q + q * δ = 1 := by rw [← hqe]; ring
    have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := by
      have := mul_pos hq0 hδ
      linarith
    have hk0 : 0 ≤ q * cc := mul_nonneg hq0.le hc0
    have hk1 : q * cc ≤ 1 := mul_le_one₀ hq1 hc0 hc1
    have hXn : ‖(q * cc) • Sv‖ = q * cc * ‖Sv‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hk0]
    have hSn0 : 0 ≤ ‖Sv‖ := norm_nonneg _
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hXn]
      have h1 : ‖Sv‖ ≤ 1 + δ := by linarith
      calc q * cc * ‖Sv‖ ≤ q * cc * (1 + δ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hk0
        _ = cc * (q * (1 + δ)) := by ring
        _ ≤ 1 := by rw [hqe]; linarith
    · intro hcc
      rw [hcc, mul_one, real_inner_smul_left]
      have hI1 : -(‖Sv - t • gv‖ * ‖νv‖) ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ (Sv - t • gv) νv :=
        neg_le_of_abs_le (abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _)
      have hI2 : -(‖t • gv - νv‖ * ‖νv‖) ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ (t • gv - νv) νv :=
        neg_le_of_abs_le (abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _)
      have hνν : @inner ℝ E3 _ νv νv = 1 := by
        rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hνv]; norm_num
      have hsplit : @inner ℝ E3 _ Sv νv =
          @inner ℝ E3 _ (Sv - t • gv) νv + @inner ℝ E3 _ (t • gv - νv) νv + @inner ℝ E3 _ νv νv := by
        rw [inner_sub_left, inner_sub_left]; ring
      have htri : ‖t • gv - νv‖ ≤ ‖t • gv - gv‖ + ‖gv - νv‖ := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
      rw [hνv, mul_one] at hI1 hI2
      have hI : 1 - δ - 2 * ‖gv - νv‖ ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ Sv νv := by
        rw [hsplit, hνν]; linarith
      set b := 1 - δ - 2 * ‖gv - νv‖ with hb
      have hb1 : b ≤ 1 := by have := norm_nonneg (gv - νv); linarith
      have hqI : q * b ≤ q * @inner ℝ E3 _ Sv νv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hI hq0.le
      have hqb : b - δ ≤ q * b := by
        rcases le_total 0 b with hb0 | hb0
        · have hbq : b * q ≤ 1 := by
            calc b * q ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul hb1 hq1 hq0.le zero_le_one
              _ = 1 := one_mul 1
          have e2 : q * b - (b - δ) = δ * (1 - b * q) := by linear_combination b * hqe
          have := mul_nonneg hδ.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hbq)
          linarith
        · have e3 : (q - 1) * b = q * b - b := by ring
          have := mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (by linarith : q - 1 ≤ 0) hb0
          linarith
      linarith
    · rw [real_inner_smul_left]
      have hI : -(‖Sv‖ * ‖νv‖) ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ Sv νv :=
        neg_le_of_abs_le (abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _)
      rw [hνv, mul_one] at hI
      have hgt : ‖Sv‖ ≤ ‖gv‖ + δ := by
        have := mul_le_of_le_one_left hng ht1
        linarith
      have hIabs : |@inner ℝ E3 _ Sv νv| ≤ ‖Sv‖ := by
        have := abs_real_inner_le_norm Sv νv
        rwa [hνv, mul_one] at this
      have : -(q * cc * ‖Sv‖) ≤ q * cc * @inner ℝ E3 _ Sv νv := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (neg_le_of_abs_le hIabs) hk0
        linarith
      have h2 : q * cc * ‖Sv‖ ≤ ‖Sv‖ := mul_le_of_le_one_left hSn0 hk1
      linarith
  
  set X : E3 → E3 := fun x => ((1 + δ)⁻¹ * χ x) • Sm x with hXdef
  have hXs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X := (contDiff_const.mul hχ).smul hS
  have hX0 : ∀ x, x ∉ closure W → X x = 0 := fun x hx => by
    simp [hXdef, hχ0 x hx]
  have hXc : HasCompactSupport X := HasCompactSupport.intro' hWc isClosed_closure hX0
  have hsuppW : Function.support X ⊆ closure W := fun x hx =>
    by_contra (fun h => (Function.mem_support.mp hx) (hX0 x h))
  have hXV : tsupport X ⊆ V := (closure_minimal hsuppW isClosed_closure).trans hWV
  have hX1 : ∀ y, ‖X y‖ ≤ 1 := fun y =>
    (key (ν y) (g y) (Sm y) (χ y) (hν1 y) (hχ01 y).1 (hχ01 y).2 (hSδ y)).1
  
  have hC1 : Integrable (C.indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ)) μ := by
    rw [integrable_indicator_iff hC.measurableSet]; exact integrableOn_const hCfin.ne
  have hW1 : Integrable ((closure W).indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ)) μ := by
    rw [integrable_indicator_iff isClosed_closure.measurableSet]; exact integrableOn_const hWcfin.ne
  have hN : Integrable (fun x => ‖C.indicator ν x - g x‖) μ := (hfint.sub hgi).norm
  have hInn : Integrable (fun x => @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x)) μ := by
    refine Integrable.mono' hW1 (hXs.continuous.measurable.inner hνm).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
    by_cases hx : x ∈ closure W
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Pi.one_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc |@inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x)| ≤ ‖X x‖ * ‖ν x‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
        _ ≤ 1 := by rw [hν1 x, mul_one]; exact hX1 x
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, hX0 x hx, inner_zero_left, norm_zero]
  have hpt : ∀ x, C.indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x - 2 * δ * (closure W).indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x
      - 2 * ‖C.indicator ν x - g x‖ ≤ @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) := by
    intro x
    have hk := key (ν x) (g x) (Sm x) (χ x) (hν1 x) (hχ01 x).1 (hχ01 x).2 (hSδ x)
    by_cases hxC : x ∈ C
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxC, Set.indicator_of_mem (hCWc hxC), Set.indicator_of_mem hxC,
        Pi.one_apply, norm_sub_rev]
      have := hk.2.1 (hχC x hxC)
      simp only [hXdef]
      linarith
    · by_cases hxW : x ∈ closure W
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxC, Set.indicator_of_mem hxW, Set.indicator_of_notMem hxC,
          Pi.one_apply]
        simp only [zero_sub, norm_neg, mul_one]
        have := hk.2.2
        simp only [hXdef]
        linarith
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxC, Set.indicator_of_notMem hxW, Set.indicator_of_notMem hxC,
          hX0 x hxW, inner_zero_left]
        simp only [zero_sub, norm_neg, mul_zero, neg_zero]
        have := norm_nonneg (g x)
        linarith
  have hW2 : Integrable (fun x => 2 * δ * (closure W).indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x) μ :=
    hW1.const_mul (2 * δ)
  have hA : Integrable (fun x => C.indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x
      - 2 * δ * (closure W).indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x) μ := hC1.sub hW2
  have hB : Integrable (fun x => 2 * ‖C.indicator ν x - g x‖) μ := hN.const_mul 2
  have hH : Integrable (fun x => C.indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x
      - 2 * δ * (closure W).indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x - 2 * ‖C.indicator ν x - g x‖) μ := hA.sub hB
  have hmono := integral_mono hH hInn hpt
  have hcalc : ∫ x, (C.indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x - 2 * δ * (closure W).indicator (1 : E3 → ℝ) x
      - 2 * ‖C.indicator ν x - g x‖) ∂μ = m - 2 * δ * w - 2 * ∫ x, ‖C.indicator ν x - g x‖ ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_sub hA hB, integral_sub hC1 hW2, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
      integral_indicator_one hC.measurableSet, integral_indicator_one isClosed_closure.measurableSet,
      hm, hw]
    rfl
  rw [hcalc] at hmono
  
  have hlt : a < ∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) ∂μ := by
    linarith
  rw [hca]
  calc ENNReal.ofReal a < ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (X x) (ν x) ∂μ) :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by linarith)).mpr hlt
    _ ≤ _ := le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun (Y : E3 → E3) (_ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧
          tsupport Y ⊆ V ∧ ∀ y, ‖Y y‖ ≤ 1) => ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, @inner ℝ E3 _ (Y x) (ν x) ∂μ))
          X ⟨hXs, hXc, hXV, hX1⟩ le_rfl

informal_problem.statement: (K : Set E3) (hdil : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) (a : Fin 3) (x : E3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (R δ : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hw : Continuous w) (hw0 : w (sepPlaneProj a x) = x a) (hgraph : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a x R δ, ((∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) ↔ z a = w (sepPlaneProj a z))) : ∃ ρ₂ η : ℝ, 0 < ρ₂ ∧ ρ₂ < R ∧ 0 < η ∧ ∀ p : E3, p a = 0 → ‖p - sepPlaneProj a x‖ < ρ₂ → |w p - x a| < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t - 1| < η → w (t • p) = t * w p

signature.name: sepConeGraph_homog
signature.statement: (K : Set E3) (hdil : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ z : E3, (∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) → ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 (t • z), volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) (a : Fin 3) (x : E3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (R δ : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hw : Continuous w) (hw0 : w (sepPlaneProj a x) = x a) (hgraph : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a x R δ, ((∀ N ∈ 𝓝 z, volume (N ∩ K) ≠ 0 ∧ volume (N \ K) ≠ 0) ↔ z a = w (sepPlaneProj a z))) : ∃ ρ₂ η : ℝ, 0 < ρ₂ ∧ ρ₂ < R ∧ 0 < η ∧ ∀ p : E3, p a = 0 → ‖p - sepPlaneProj a x‖ < ρ₂ → |w p - x a| < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t - 1| < η → w (t • p) = t * w p

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hP_sub : ∀ y y' : E3, sepPlaneProj a (y - y') = sepPlaneProj a y - sepPlaneProj a y' := by
    intro y y'
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hsmul_a : ∀ (t : ℝ) (y : E3), (t • y) a = t * y a := by
    intro t y
    simp
  have hP_smul : ∀ (t : ℝ) (y : E3), sepPlaneProj a (t • y) = t • sepPlaneProj a y := by
    intro t y
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, hsmul_a, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  have hP_lift : ∀ p : E3, p a = 0 → ∀ s : ℝ,
      (p + s • e a) a = s ∧ sepPlaneProj a (p + s • e a) = p := by
    intro p hp s
    have h1 : (p + s • e a) a = s := by simp [e, hp]
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, h1]
    exact add_sub_cancel_right p (s • e a)
  obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, hcont⟩ :=
    (Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (hw.continuousAt (x := sepPlaneProj a x))) (δ / 4) (by linarith)
  have hcont' : ∀ q : E3, ‖q - sepPlaneProj a x‖ < ε₁ → |w q - x a| < δ / 4 := by
    intro q hq
    have h := hcont (x := q) (by rw [dist_eq_norm]; exact hq)
    rwa [Real.dist_eq, hw0] at h
  obtain ⟨ρ₂, hρ₂def⟩ : ∃ ρ₂ : ℝ, ρ₂ = min (R / 4) ε₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρ₂ : 0 < ρ₂ := by rw [hρ₂def]; exact lt_min (by linarith) hε₁
  have hρ₂R4 : ρ₂ ≤ R / 4 := by rw [hρ₂def]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hρ₂ε : ρ₂ ≤ ε₁ := by rw [hρ₂def]; exact min_le_right _ _
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = ‖sepPlaneProj a x‖ + ρ₂ + |x a| + δ + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hn0 := norm_nonneg (sepPlaneProj a x)
  have ha0 := abs_nonneg (x a)
  have hMpos : 0 < M := by rw [hMdef]; linarith
  have hmRδ : 0 < min R δ := lt_min hR hδ
  obtain ⟨η, hηdef⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, η = min (1 / 2) (min R δ / (8 * M)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hη : 0 < η := by
    rw [hηdef]; exact lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hmRδ (by linarith))
  have hη12 : η ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [hηdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hηM : η * M ≤ min R δ / 8 := by
    have h1 : η ≤ min R δ / (8 * M) := by rw [hηdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
    calc η * M ≤ min R δ / (8 * M) * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hMpos.le
      _ = min R δ / 8 := by field_simp
  have hηMR : η * M ≤ R / 8 := le_trans hηM (by have := min_le_left R δ; linarith)
  have hηMδ : η * M ≤ δ / 8 := le_trans hηM (by have := min_le_right R δ; linarith)
  refine ⟨ρ₂, η, hρ₂, by linarith, hη, ?_⟩
  intro p hp hpd
  have hwp : |w p - x a| < δ / 4 := hcont' p (lt_of_lt_of_le hpd hρ₂ε)
  refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hB1 : ‖p‖ ≤ M := by
    have := norm_sub_norm_le p (sepPlaneProj a x)
    rw [hMdef]; linarith
  have hB2 : |w p| ≤ M := by
    have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (w p) (x a)
    rw [hMdef]; linarith
  obtain ⟨hza, hzP⟩ := hP_lift p hp (w p)
  have hzC : p + w p • e a ∈ sepCyl a x R δ := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show ‖sepPlaneProj a (p + w p • e a - x)‖ < R
      rw [hP_sub, hzP]; linarith
    · show |(p + w p • e a) a - x a| < δ
      rw [hza]; linarith
  have hBz := (hgraph _ hzC).mpr (by rw [hza, hzP])
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by have := (abs_lt.mp ht).1; linarith
  have hBtz := hdil t ht0 _ hBz
  have htzC : t • (p + w p • e a) ∈ sepCyl a x R δ := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show ‖sepPlaneProj a (t • (p + w p • e a) - x)‖ < R
      rw [hP_sub, hP_smul, hzP]
      have heq : t • p - sepPlaneProj a x = (t - 1) • p + (p - sepPlaneProj a x) := by
        rw [sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
      rw [heq]
      have h1 : |t - 1| * ‖p‖ ≤ η * M := mul_le_mul ht.le hB1 (norm_nonneg _) hη.le
      calc ‖(t - 1) • p + (p - sepPlaneProj a x)‖
          ≤ ‖(t - 1) • p‖ + ‖p - sepPlaneProj a x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = |t - 1| * ‖p‖ + ‖p - sepPlaneProj a x‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ < R := by linarith
    · show |(t • (p + w p • e a)) a - x a| < δ
      rw [hsmul_a, hza]
      have heq : t * w p - x a = (t - 1) * w p + (w p - x a) := by ring
      rw [heq]
      have h1 : |t - 1| * |w p| ≤ η * M := mul_le_mul ht.le hB2 (abs_nonneg _) hη.le
      calc |(t - 1) * w p + (w p - x a)| ≤ |(t - 1) * w p| + |w p - x a| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |t - 1| * |w p| + |w p - x a| := by rw [abs_mul]
        _ < δ := by linarith
  have hfin := (hgraph _ htzC).mp hBtz
  rw [hsmul_a, hza, hP_smul, hzP] at hfin
  exact hfin.symm

informal_problem.statement: (u : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (p₀ : E3) (ρ η : ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hη : 0 < η) (hp₀a : p₀ a = 0) (hhom : ∀ p : E3, p a = 0 → ‖p - p₀‖ < ρ → ∀ t : ℝ, |t - 1| < η → u (t • p) = t * u p) (hmse : ∀ p : E3, p a = 0 → ‖p - p₀‖ < ρ → levelMeanCurvCoord (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (fun w => w a - u (sepPlaneProj a w)) (p + u p • e a) = 0) : ∃ g : E3, g a = 0 ∧ ∀ p : E3, p a = 0 → ‖p - p₀‖ < ρ → u p = @inner ℝ E3 _ g p

signature.name: sepConeGraph_linear
signature.statement: (u : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (p₀ : E3) (ρ η : ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hη : 0 < η) (hp₀a : p₀ a = 0) (hhom : ∀ p : E3, p a = 0 → ‖p - p₀‖ < ρ → ∀ t : ℝ, |t - 1| < η → u (t • p) = t * u p) (hmse : ∀ p : E3, p a = 0 → ‖p - p₀‖ < ρ → levelMeanCurvCoord (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) (fun w => w a - u (sepPlaneProj a w)) (p + u p • e a) = 0) : ∃ g : E3, g a = 0 ∧ ∀ p : E3, p a = 0 → ‖p - p₀‖ < ρ → u p = @inner ℝ E3 _ g p

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  
  
  have alg : ∀ A B C d1 d2 p1 p2 : ℝ, A * p1 + B * p2 = 0 → B * p1 + C * p2 = 0 →
      (p1 ≠ 0 ∨ p2 ≠ 0) →
      (1 + d1 ^ 2 + d2 ^ 2) * (A + C) = A * d1 ^ 2 + 2 * B * d1 * d2 + C * d2 ^ 2 →
      A = 0 ∧ B = 0 ∧ C = 0 := by
    intro A B C d1 d2 p1 p2 E1 E2 hp hM
    have hD1 : (A * C - B ^ 2) * p1 = 0 := by linear_combination C * E1 - B * E2
    have hD2 : (A * C - B ^ 2) * p2 = 0 := by linear_combination A * E2 - B * E1
    have hD : A * C - B ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rcases hp with hp | hp
      · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hD1).resolve_right hp
      · exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hD2).resolve_right hp
    have hT : (A + C) ^ 2 + (C * d1 - B * d2) ^ 2 + (B * d1 - A * d2) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      linear_combination (A + C) * hM - (d1 ^ 2 + d2 ^ 2) * hD
    have hT0 : A + C = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (A + C), sq_nonneg (C * d1 - B * d2), sq_nonneg (B * d1 - A * d2)]
    have hsq : A ^ 2 + 2 * B ^ 2 + C ^ 2 = 0 := by
      linear_combination (A + C) * hT0 - 2 * hD
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg A, sq_nonneg B, sq_nonneg C]
  have hchr : ∀ k i j y, christoffel (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) k i j y = 0 := by
    intro k i j y
    simp [christoffel, partialDeriv]
  have sqd : ∀ X Y S : ℝ, 0 < S → X / Real.sqrt S - Y / Real.sqrt S ^ 3 = 0 → X * S = Y := by
    intro X Y S hS h
    have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt S := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hS
    have hr2 : Real.sqrt S ^ 2 = S := Real.sq_sqrt hS.le
    rw [div_sub_div _ _ hr.ne' (pow_pos hr 3).ne', div_eq_zero_iff] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · have : Real.sqrt S * (X * Real.sqrt S ^ 2 - Y) = 0 := by linear_combination h
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h' | h'
      · exact absurd h' hr.ne'
      · rw [hr2] at h'; linarith
    · exact absurd h (mul_pos hr (pow_pos hr 3)).ne'
  have key : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (d q : Fin 3 → ℝ) (h : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ i j, h i j = h j i) → (∀ j, h b j = 0) → d b = 0 → q b = 0 → (∃ i, q i ≠ 0) →
      (∀ i, ∑ j, h i j * q j = 0) →
      (∀ j, partialDeriv j f y = (e j) b - d j) →
      (∀ i j, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y = -h i j) →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) f y = 0 →
      ∀ i j, h i j = 0 := by
    intro b f y d q h hsym hrow hdb hqb hq hker hd hh hmse
    have hcol : ∀ i, h i b = 0 := fun i => by rw [hsym]; exact hrow i
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, lapLoc, hessLoc, hchr, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero,
      sub_zero, inv_one, hh, hd] at hmse
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hq
    fin_cases b
    all_goals
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] at hmse hker hdb hqb hrow hcol
    · 
      have hS : 0 < (1 - d 0) * (1 - d 0) + d 1 * d 1 + d 2 * d 2 := by
        rw [hdb]; nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (d 1), mul_self_nonneg (d 2)]
      have hM := sqd _ _ _ hS hmse
      simp only [hdb, hrow, hcol, hsym 2 1] at hM
      have E1 := hker 1
      have E2 := hker 2
      simp only [hcol, hsym 2 1, zero_mul, zero_add] at E1 E2
      have hp : q 1 ≠ 0 ∨ q 2 ≠ 0 := by
        fin_cases i₀
        · exact absurd hqb hi₀
        · exact Or.inl hi₀
        · exact Or.inr hi₀
      obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC⟩ := alg (h 1 1) (h 1 2) (h 2 2) (d 1) (d 2) (q 1) (q 2) E1 E2 hp
        (by linear_combination -hM)
      intro i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [hrow, hcol, hA, hB, hC, hsym 2 1]
    · 
      have hS : 0 < d 0 * d 0 + (1 - d 1) * (1 - d 1) + d 2 * d 2 := by
        rw [hdb]; nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (d 0), mul_self_nonneg (d 2)]
      have hM := sqd _ _ _ hS hmse
      simp only [hdb, hrow, hcol, hsym 2 0] at hM
      have E1 := hker 0
      have E2 := hker 2
      simp only [hcol, hsym 2 0, zero_mul, add_zero] at E1 E2
      have hp : q 0 ≠ 0 ∨ q 2 ≠ 0 := by
        fin_cases i₀
        · exact Or.inl hi₀
        · exact absurd hqb hi₀
        · exact Or.inr hi₀
      obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC⟩ := alg (h 0 0) (h 0 2) (h 2 2) (d 0) (d 2) (q 0) (q 2) E1 E2 hp
        (by linear_combination -hM)
      intro i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [hrow, hcol, hA, hB, hC, hsym 2 0]
    · 
      have hS : 0 < d 0 * d 0 + d 1 * d 1 + (1 - d 2) * (1 - d 2) := by
        rw [hdb]; nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg (d 0), mul_self_nonneg (d 1)]
      have hM := sqd _ _ _ hS hmse
      simp only [hdb, hrow, hcol, hsym 1 0] at hM
      have E1 := hker 0
      have E2 := hker 1
      simp only [hcol, hsym 1 0, zero_mul, add_zero] at E1 E2
      have hp : q 0 ≠ 0 ∨ q 1 ≠ 0 := by
        fin_cases i₀
        · exact Or.inl hi₀
        · exact Or.inr hi₀
        · exact absurd hqb hi₀
      obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC⟩ := alg (h 0 0) (h 0 1) (h 1 1) (d 0) (d 1) (q 0) (q 1) E1 E2 hp
        (by linear_combination -hM)
      intro i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [hrow, hcol, hA, hB, hC, hsym 1 0]
  
  
  
  set Pc : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - (EuclideanSpace.proj a).smulRight (e a)
    with hPc
  have hPc_apply : ∀ y, Pc y = sepPlaneProj a y := by
    intro y
    simp [Pc, sepPlaneProj]
  have hea : (e a) a = 1 := by simp
  have hPa : ∀ y : E3, (sepPlaneProj a y) a = 0 := by
    intro y; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hPplane : ∀ y : E3, y a = 0 → sepPlaneProj a y = y := by
    intro y hy; simp [sepPlaneProj, hy]
  have hPtrans : ∀ (y : E3) (s : ℝ), sepPlaneProj a (y + s • e a) = sepPlaneProj a y := by
    intro y s
    have h1 : (y + s • e a) a = y a + s := by simp
    rw [sepPlaneProj, sepPlaneProj, h1, add_smul]
    abel
  have hPsmul : ∀ (y : E3) (t : ℝ), sepPlaneProj a (t • y) = t • sepPlaneProj a y := by
    intro y t
    rw [← hPc_apply, ← hPc_apply, map_smul]
  have hdecomp : ∀ y : E3, y = sepPlaneProj a y + (y a) • e a := by
    intro y; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hexp : ∀ z : E3, ∑ j : Fin 3, z j • e j = z := by
    intro z
    ext k
    fin_cases k <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  obtain ⟨v, hvdef⟩ : ∃ v : E3 → ℝ, v = fun w => u (sepPlaneProj a w) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v := by
    have : v = u ∘ Pc := by
      funext w; simp [hvdef, hPc_apply]
    rw [this]
    exact hu.comp Pc.contDiff
  have hvd : Differentiable ℝ v := hv.differentiable (by simp)
  have hv1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ v) := hv.fderiv_right (m := 1) (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
  have hDv : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) := hv1.differentiable (by simp)
  have hD2c : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v)) := hv1.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
  have hsymm : ∀ w x y, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w x y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w y x := by
    intro w x y
    have h := (hv.contDiffAt (x := w)).isSymmSndFDerivAt
      (by simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
    exact h x y
  
  have hvT : ∀ (w : E3) (s : ℝ), v (w + s • e a) = v w := by
    intro w s; simp only [hvdef, hPtrans]
  have hDvT : ∀ (w : E3) (s : ℝ), fderiv ℝ v (w + s • e a) = fderiv ℝ v w := by
    intro w s
    have h1 : (fun x => v (x + s • e a)) = v := funext fun x => hvT x s
    rw [← fderiv_comp_add_right, h1]
  have hD2vT : ∀ (w : E3) (s : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (w + s • e a) = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w := by
    intro w s
    have h1 : (fun x => fderiv ℝ v (x + s • e a)) = fderiv ℝ v := funext fun x => hDvT x s
    rw [← fderiv_comp_add_right, h1]
  have hdirv : ∀ w, fderiv ℝ v w (e a) = 0 := by
    intro w
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => v (w + s • e a)) (fderiv ℝ v (w + (0:ℝ) • e a) (e a)) 0 := by
      have hg : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => w + s • e a) (e a) 0 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const (e a)).const_add w
      exact (hvd _).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) hg
    have h2 : (fun s : ℝ => v (w + s • e a)) = fun _ => v w := funext fun s => hvT w s
    rw [h2, zero_smul, add_zero] at h1
    exact h1.unique (hasDerivAt_const 0 (v w))
  have hdirD : ∀ w, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w (e a) = 0 := by
    intro w
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ v (w + s • e a))
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (w + (0:ℝ) • e a) (e a)) 0 := by
      have hg : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => w + s • e a) (e a) 0 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const (e a)).const_add w
      exact (hDv _).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) hg
    have h2 : (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ v (w + s • e a)) = fun _ => fderiv ℝ v w :=
      funext fun s => hDvT w s
    rw [h2, zero_smul, add_zero] at h1
    exact h1.unique (hasDerivAt_const 0 _)
  have hdirD' : ∀ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w x (e a) = 0 := by
    intro w x
    rw [hsymm, hdirD]; rfl
  
  set Ω : Set E3 := {w | ‖sepPlaneProj a w - p₀‖ < ρ} with hΩdef
  have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by
    have : Continuous (fun w => sepPlaneProj a w) := by
      have : (fun w => sepPlaneProj a w) = fun w => Pc w := funext fun w => (hPc_apply w).symm
      rw [this]; exact Pc.continuous
    exact isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (this.sub continuous_const)) continuous_const
  have hΩc : Convex ℝ Ω := by
    have : Ω = (Pc : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) ⁻¹' Metric.ball p₀ ρ := by
      ext w; simp [Ω, hPc_apply, dist_eq_norm]
    rw [this]
    exact (convex_ball p₀ ρ).linear_preimage _
  have hp₀Ω : p₀ ∈ Ω := by
    show ‖sepPlaneProj a p₀ - p₀‖ < ρ
    rw [hPplane p₀ hp₀a, sub_self, norm_zero]; exact hρ
  
  have hvhom : ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ t : ℝ, |t - 1| < η → v (t • w) = t * v w := by
    intro w hw t ht
    simp only [hvdef, hPsmul]
    exact hhom _ (hPa w) hw t ht
  have heul : ∀ w ∈ Ω, fderiv ℝ v w w = v w := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => v (t • w)) (fderiv ℝ v ((1:ℝ) • w) w) 1 := by
      have hg : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t • w) w 1 := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (1:ℝ)).smul_const w
      exact (hvd _).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (1:ℝ) hg
    rw [one_smul] at h1
    have h2 : (fun t : ℝ => v (t • w)) =ᶠ[𝓝 1] fun t => t * v w := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (1:ℝ) hη] with t ht
      exact hvhom w hw t (by rw [← Real.dist_eq]; exact ht)
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t * v w) (1 * v w) 1 := (hasDerivAt_id 1).mul_const (v w)
    rw [one_mul] at h3
    exact (h2.hasDerivAt_iff.mp h1).unique h3
  have heul2 : ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w x w = 0 := by
    intro w hw x
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y y - v y)
        ((fderiv ℝ v w).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w).flip w
          - fderiv ℝ v w) w :=
      ((hDv w).hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_id w)).sub (hvd w).hasFDerivAt
    have h2 : (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y y - v y) =ᶠ[𝓝 w] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hw] with y hy
      rw [heul y hy, sub_self]
    have h3 := (h2.hasFDerivAt_iff.mp h1).unique (hasFDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) w)
    have h4 := congrArg (fun L => L x) h3
    simpa using h4
  
  
  
  have hfeq : (fun w : E3 => w a - u (sepPlaneProj a w)) = fun w => w a - v w := by
    rw [hvdef]
  have hpd1 : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv j (fun w : E3 => w a - v w) z = (e j) a - fderiv ℝ v z (e j) := by
    intro j z
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E3 => w a - v w)
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) - fderiv ℝ v z) z :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.sub (hvd z).hasFDerivAt
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [h1.fderiv]
    simp
  have hpd1f : ∀ j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv j (fun w : E3 => w a - v w) = fun z => (e j) a - fderiv ℝ v z (e j) :=
    fun j => funext fun z => hpd1 j z
  have hpd2 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun w : E3 => w a - v w)) z =
        -(fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) z (e i) (e j)) := by
    intro i j z
    rw [hpd1f j]
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e j))
        ((fderiv ℝ v z).comp (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) z).flip (e j)) z :=
      (hDv z).hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e j) z)
    have h2 := h1.const_sub ((e j) a)
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [h2.fderiv]
    simp
  
  
  
  have hzero : ∀ w ∈ Ω, sepPlaneProj a w ≠ 0 → fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w = 0 := by
    intro w hw hP0
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : E3, p = sepPlaneProj a w := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hpa : p a = 0 := by rw [hp]; exact hPa w
    have hpd : ‖p - p₀‖ < ρ := by rw [hp]; exact hw
    have hy : p + u p • e a = w + (u p - w a) • e a := by
      have hw' := hdecomp w
      rw [← hp] at hw'
      calc p + u p • e a = (p + w a • e a) + (u p - w a) • e a := by
            rw [add_assoc, ← add_smul]; congr 2; ring
        _ = w + (u p - w a) • e a := by rw [← hw']
    have hD1 : fderiv ℝ v (p + u p • e a) = fderiv ℝ v w := by rw [hy, hDvT]
    have hD2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (p + u p • e a) = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w := by
      rw [hy, hD2vT]
    have hm := hmse p hpa hpd
    rw [hfeq] at hm
    have hij := key a (fun w : E3 => w a - v w) (p + u p • e a)
      (fun j => fderiv ℝ v w (e j)) (fun j => p j)
      (fun i j => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w (e i) (e j))
      (fun i j => hsymm w (e i) (e j))
      (fun j => by simp only [hdirD w]; rfl)
      (hdirv w) hpa
      (by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        apply hP0
        rw [← hp]
        ext i
        simp [hcon i])
      (by
        intro i
        have h0 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w (e i) p = 0 := by
          rw [hp, sepPlaneProj, map_sub, map_smul, heul2 w hw, hdirD' w, smul_zero, sub_zero]
        rw [← hexp p, map_sum] at h0
        rw [← h0]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
        rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm])
      (fun j => by rw [hpd1, hD1])
      (fun i j => by rw [hpd2, hD2])
      hm
    ext x z
    rw [← hexp x, ← hexp z]
    simp [map_sum, hij]
  have hzero' : ∀ w ∈ Ω, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    by_cases hP0 : sepPlaneProj a w = 0
    · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : Fin 3, b ≠ a := ⟨a + 1, by fin_cases a <;> decide⟩
      have hba : (e b) a = 0 := by simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Ne.symm hb]
      have hbP : sepPlaneProj a (e b) = e b := hPplane _ hba
      have hw' : ‖sepPlaneProj a w - p₀‖ < ρ := hw
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = ρ - ‖sepPlaneProj a w - p₀‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hr0 : 0 < r := by rw [hr]; linarith
      have hPs : ∀ s : ℝ, sepPlaneProj a (w + s • e b) = sepPlaneProj a w + s • e b := by
        intro s
        rw [← hPc_apply, map_add, map_smul, hPc_apply, hPc_apply, hbP]
      have hsub : Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) r ⊆ {s : ℝ | fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (w + s • e b) = 0} := by
        intro s hs
        apply hzero
        · show ‖sepPlaneProj a (w + s • e b) - p₀‖ < ρ
          rw [hPs]
          calc ‖sepPlaneProj a w + s • e b - p₀‖ = ‖(sepPlaneProj a w - p₀) + s • e b‖ := by
                congr 1; abel
            _ ≤ ‖sepPlaneProj a w - p₀‖ + ‖s • e b‖ := norm_add_le _ _
            _ = ‖sepPlaneProj a w - p₀‖ + s := by
                rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                  abs_of_pos hs.1]
            _ < ρ := by linarith [hs.2]
        · rw [hPs, hP0, zero_add]
          intro h0
          have h1 := congrArg (fun z : E3 => z b) h0
          simp at h1
          exact hs.1.ne' h1
      have hcont : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (w + s • e b)) :=
        hD2c.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
      have hclosed : IsClosed {s : ℝ | fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (w + s • e b) = 0} :=
        isClosed_eq hcont continuous_const
      have hcl := hclosed.closure_subset_iff.mpr hsub
      rw [closure_Ioo hr0.ne] at hcl
      have h0 := hcl ⟨le_refl 0, hr0.le⟩
      simpa using h0
    · exact hzero w hw hP0
  
  
  
  have hconst : ∀ w ∈ Ω, fderiv ℝ v w = fderiv ℝ v p₀ := by
    intro w hw
    exact hΩo.is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero hΩc.isPreconnected hDv.differentiableOn
      (fun z hz => hzero' z hz) hw hp₀Ω
  refine ⟨(InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E3).symm (fderiv ℝ v p₀), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := @InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply ℝ E3 _ _ _ _ (e a) (fderiv ℝ v p₀)
    rw [real_inner_comm, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left] at h1
    simp at h1
    rw [h1, hdirv]
  · intro p hpa hpd
    have hpΩ : p ∈ Ω := by
      show ‖sepPlaneProj a p - p₀‖ < ρ
      rw [hPplane p hpa]; exact hpd
    rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply, ← hconst p hpΩ, heul p hpΩ, hvdef]
    show u p = u (sepPlaneProj a p)
    rw [hPplane p hpa]

informal_problem.statement:
(a : Fin 3) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v)
    (Z : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hZ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Z i)) (hZc : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (Z i)) :
    ∫ z in {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)}, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (Z i) z =
      ∫ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, Z i (smthLift a x (v x)) * smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i

signature.name: smth_gauss_green_subgraph
signature.statement:
(a : Fin 3) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v)
    (Z : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hZ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Z i)) (hZc : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (Z i)) :
    ∫ z in {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)}, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (Z i) z =
      ∫ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, Z i (smthLift a x (v x)) * smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hLa : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift a x t) a = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [smthLift]
  have hHL : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthHoriz a (smthLift a x t) = x := by
    intro x t; funext k; simp [smthLift, smthHoriz]
  have hlin : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      smthLift a x t = t • e a + ∑ j : Fin 2, x j • e (a.succAbove j) := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
    · simp [smthLift, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    · simp [smthLift, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      fin_cases k <;> simp
  have hHc : Continuous (smthHoriz a) := by
    unfold smthHoriz
    fun_prop
  have hcoord : Continuous (fun z : E3 => z a) := by fun_prop
  have hLc : ∀ {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : X → Fin 2 → ℝ) (g : X → ℝ),
      Continuous f → Continuous g → Continuous (fun p => smthLift a (f p) (g p)) := by
    intro X _ f g hf hg
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp (Continuous.finInsertNth a hg hf)
  have hloc : ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, HasCompactSupport φ → ∃ K : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ), IsCompact K ∧
      ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ x t, φ (smthLift a x t) ≠ 0 → x ∈ K ∧ |t| ≤ R := by
    intro φ hφ
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hφ.isCompact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcoord.continuousOn
    refine ⟨smthHoriz a '' tsupport φ, hφ.isCompact.image hHc, R, fun x t hne => ?_⟩
    have hmem : smthLift a x t ∈ tsupport φ := subset_tsupport _ hne
    refine ⟨⟨_, hmem, hHL x t⟩, ?_⟩
    have := hR _ hmem
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hLa] at this
    exact this
  have hvc : Continuous v := hv.continuous
  have hcs : ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, HasCompactSupport φ →
      HasCompactSupport (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ => φ (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1))) ∧
      (∀ s : ℝ, HasCompactSupport (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => φ (smthLift a x (s + v x)))) ∧
      (∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, HasCompactSupport (fun s : ℝ => φ (smthLift a x (s + v x)))) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => φ (smthLift a x (v x))) := by
    intro φ hφ
    obtain ⟨K, hK, R, hKR⟩ := hloc φ hφ
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hvc.continuousOn
    refine ⟨?_, fun s => ?_, fun x => ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine HasCompactSupport.intro (hK.prod (isCompact_Icc (a := -(R + M)) (b := R + M)))
        (fun p hp => ?_)
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hKR _ _ hne
      apply hp
      refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
      have h3 := hM _ h1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h3
      have h4 : |p.2| ≤ R + M := by
        calc |p.2| = |(p.2 + v p.1) - v p.1| := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ |p.2 + v p.1| + |v p.1| := abs_sub _ _
          _ ≤ R + M := add_le_add h2 h3
      exact abs_le.1 h4
    · refine HasCompactSupport.intro hK (fun x hx => ?_)
      by_contra hne
      exact hx (hKR _ _ hne).1
    · refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_Icc (a := -(R + |v x|)) (b := R + |v x|))
        (fun s hs => ?_)
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨_, h2⟩ := hKR _ _ hne
      apply hs
      have h4 : |s| ≤ R + |v x| := by
        calc |s| = |(s + v x) - v x| := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ |s + v x| + |v x| := abs_sub _ _
          _ ≤ R + |v x| := add_le_add h2 le_rfl
      exact abs_le.1 h4
    · refine HasCompactSupport.intro hK (fun x hx => ?_)
      by_contra hne
      exact hx (hKR _ _ hne).1
  
  have hpd : ∀ Y : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 Y → HasCompactSupport Y → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      Continuous (partialDeriv j Y) ∧ HasCompactSupport (partialDeriv j Y) := by
    intro Y hY hYc j
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show Continuous (fun z => fderiv ℝ Y z (e j))
      exact (hY.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
    · exact hYc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e j)
  have hgradc : ∀ k : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad v x k) := by
    intro k
    show Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ v x (Pi.single k 1))
    exact (hv.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hξc : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun x => smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i) := by
    intro i
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
    · simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
      exact continuous_const
    · simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, Pi.neg_apply]
      exact (hgradc k).neg
  have hΨc : Continuous (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ => smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1)) :=
    hLc _ _ continuous_fst (continuous_snd.add (hvc.comp continuous_fst))
  have hint : ∀ c : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Continuous c → ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, Continuous φ →
      HasCompactSupport φ →
      Integrable (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ => c p.1 * φ (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1))) := by
    intro c hc φ hφ hφc
    exact ((hc.comp continuous_fst).mul (hφ.comp hΨc)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (hcs φ hφc).1.mul_left
  have hint2 : ∀ c : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Continuous c → ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, Continuous φ →
      HasCompactSupport φ →
      Integrable (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => c x * φ (smthLift a x (v x))) := by
    intro c hc φ hφ hφc
    exact (hc.mul (hφ.comp (hLc _ _ continuous_id hvc))).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (hcs φ hφc).2.2.2.mul_left
  have hHmeas : (volume : Measure ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ)).restrict {p | p.2 < 0} =
      (volume : Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)).prod ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Iio 0)) := by
    have hset : {p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ | p.2 < 0} = Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Iio 0 := by
      ext p; simp
    rw [hset, Measure.volume_eq_prod, ← Measure.prod_restrict, Measure.restrict_univ]
  
  have hs1 : ∀ g : E3 → ℝ, ∫ z, g z = ∫ p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ, g (smthLift a p.1 p.2) := by
    intro g
    have hA : MeasurePreserving
        (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ ≃ᵐ ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) volume volume :=
      Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := (volume : Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)))
          (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))
    have hB : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) a).symm
        (volume : Measure (ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (volume : Measure (Fin 3 → ℝ)) :=
      (measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => (volume : Measure ℝ)) a).symm
    have hC : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ))
        (volume : Measure (Fin 3 → ℝ)) (volume : Measure E3) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 3)).symm
    have h1 := hA.trans (hB.trans hC)
    rw [← h1.integral_comp' g]
    congr 1
  have hs2 : ∀ h : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ,
      ∫ p, h p = ∫ p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ, h (p.1, p.2 + v p.1) := by
    intro h
    let σ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ ≃ᵐ (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ :=
      { toFun := fun p => (p.1, p.2 + v p.1)
        invFun := fun p => (p.1, p.2 - v p.1)
        left_inv := fun p => by simp
        right_inv := fun p => by simp
        measurable_toFun := by
          show Measurable (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ => (p.1, p.2 + v p.1))
          apply Continuous.measurable; fun_prop
        measurable_invFun := by
          show Measurable (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ => (p.1, p.2 - v p.1))
          apply Continuous.measurable; fun_prop }
    have hσ : MeasurePreserving σ volume volume := by
      have := MeasurePreserving.skew_product (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)))
        (g := fun x s => s + v x) (μc := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (μd := (volume : Measure ℝ))
        (by apply Continuous.measurable; fun_prop)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => map_add_right_eq_self volume (v x)))
      exact this
    rw [← hσ.integral_comp' h]
    congr 1
  
  have hΩ : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)} :=
    measurableSet_lt hcoord.measurable (hvc.comp hHc).measurable
  have hH : MeasurableSet {p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ | p.2 < 0} :=
    measurableSet_lt measurable_snd measurable_const
  have htr : ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, ∫ z in {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)}, F z =
      ∫ p in {p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ | p.2 < 0}, F (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1)) := by
    intro F
    rw [← integral_indicator hΩ]
    refine (hs1 _).trans ((hs2 (fun p => Set.indicator {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)} F
      (smthLift a p.1 p.2))).trans ?_)
    rw [← integral_indicator hH]
    congr 1
    funext p
    simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hLa, hHL, add_lt_iff_neg_right]
  
  have hvert : ∀ c : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Continuous c → ∀ Y : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 Y →
      HasCompactSupport Y →
      ∫ p in {p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ | p.2 < 0}, c p.1 * partialDeriv a Y (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1))
        = ∫ x, c x * Y (smthLift a x (v x)) := by
    intro c hc Y hY hYc
    obtain ⟨hpc, hpcs⟩ := hpd Y hY hYc a
    have hI := (hint c hc _ hpc hpcs).restrict (s := {p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ | p.2 < 0})
    rw [hHmeas] at hI
    rw [hHmeas, integral_prod _ hI]
    congr 1
    funext x
    have hfun : (fun s : ℝ => smthLift a x (s + v x)) =
        fun s => (s + v x) • e a + ∑ j : Fin 2, x j • e (a.succAbove j) :=
      funext fun s => hlin x _
    have hderiv : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => c x * Y (smthLift a x (s + v x)))
        (c x * partialDeriv a Y (smthLift a x (s + v x))) s := by
      intro s
      have hL : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => smthLift a x (s + v x)) (e a) s := by
        rw [hfun]
        simpa using (((hasDerivAt_id s).add_const (v x)).smul_const (e a)).add_const
          (∑ j : Fin 2, x j • e (a.succAbove j))
      exact ((hY.differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hL).const_mul (c x)
    have hcont' : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => c x * partialDeriv a Y (smthLift a x (s + v x))) :=
      continuous_const.mul (hpc.comp (hLc _ _ continuous_const (continuous_id.add continuous_const)))
    have hIon : IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => c x * partialDeriv a Y (smthLift a x (s + v x)))
        (Set.Iic 0) :=
      (hcont'.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ((hcs _ hpcs).2.2.1 x).mul_left).integrableOn
    have htend : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => c x * Y (smthLift a x (s + v x))) atBot (𝓝 0) :=
      (((hcs Y hYc).2.2.1 x).mul_left (f := fun _ => c x)).is_zero_at_infty.mono_left
        atBot_le_cocompact
    show ∫ s in Set.Iio 0, c x * partialDeriv a Y (smthLift a x (s + v x)) =
      c x * Y (smthLift a x (v x))
    rw [← integral_Iic_eq_integral_Iio,
      integral_Iic_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto' (fun s _ => hderiv s) hIon htend]
    simp
  
  have hhor : ∀ Y : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 Y → HasCompactSupport Y → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      ∫ p in {p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ | p.2 < 0},
        (partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) Y (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1)) +
          smthGrad v p.1 k * partialDeriv a Y (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1))) = 0 := by
    intro Y hY hYc k
    obtain ⟨hc1, hcs1⟩ := hpd Y hY hYc (a.succAbove k)
    obtain ⟨hc2, hcs2⟩ := hpd Y hY hYc a
    have hI : Integrable (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) Y (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1)) +
          smthGrad v p.1 k * partialDeriv a Y (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1))) := by
      have h1 := hint (fun _ => 1) continuous_const _ hc1 hcs1
      have h2 := hint (fun x => smthGrad v x k) (hgradc k) _ hc2 hcs2
      simpa using h1.add h2
    have hI' := hI.restrict (s := {p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ | p.2 < 0})
    rw [hHmeas] at hI'
    have hinner : ∀ s : ℝ, ∫ x : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        (partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) Y (smthLift a x (s + v x)) +
          smthGrad v x k * partialDeriv a Y (smthLift a x (s + v x))) = 0 := by
      intro s
      have hfun : (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => smthLift a x (s + v x)) =
          fun x => (s + v x) • e a + ∑ j : Fin 2, x j • e (a.succAbove j) :=
        funext fun x => hlin x _
      have hL : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => smthLift a x (s + v x))
          ((fderiv ℝ v x).smulRight (e a) + ∑ j : Fin 2,
            (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e (a.succAbove j))) x := by
        intro x
        rw [hfun]
        have hS : HasFDerivAt (∑ j : Fin 2, fun y : Fin 2 → ℝ => y j • e (a.succAbove j))
            (∑ j : Fin 2, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
              (e (a.succAbove j))) x :=
          HasFDerivAt.sum fun j _ => (hasFDerivAt_apply j x).smul_const (e (a.succAbove j))
        have hS' : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Fin 2 → ℝ => ∑ j : Fin 2, y j • e (a.succAbove j))
            (∑ j : Fin 2, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
              (e (a.succAbove j))) x := by
          convert hS using 1
        exact (((hv.differentiable one_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt.const_add s).smul_const (e a)).add hS'
      have hg : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun x => Y (smthLift a x (s + v x)))
          ((fderiv ℝ Y (smthLift a x (s + v x))).comp ((fderiv ℝ v x).smulRight (e a) +
            ∑ j : Fin 2, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
              (e (a.succAbove j)))) x := by
        intro x
        exact (hY.differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt.comp x (hL x)
      have hval : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ,
          fderiv ℝ (fun x => Y (smthLift a x (s + v x))) x (Pi.single k 1) =
            partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) Y (smthLift a x (s + v x)) +
              smthGrad v x k * partialDeriv a Y (smthLift a x (s + v x)) := by
        intro x
        rw [(hg x).fderiv]
        have hsum : ∑ j : Fin 2, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
            (Pi.single k 1) • e (a.succAbove j) = e (a.succAbove k) := by
          simp [Pi.single_apply]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, map_add,
          map_smul, smul_eq_mul, partialDeriv, smthGrad]
        rw [hsum]
        ring
      have hFc : Continuous (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ =>
          partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) Y (smthLift a x (s + v x)) +
            smthGrad v x k * partialDeriv a Y (smthLift a x (s + v x))) := by
        have hl : Continuous (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => smthLift a x (s + v x)) :=
          hLc _ _ continuous_id (continuous_const.add hvc)
        exact (hc1.comp hl).add ((hgradc k).mul (hc2.comp hl))
      have hFcs : HasCompactSupport (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ =>
          partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) Y (smthLift a x (s + v x)) +
            smthGrad v x k * partialDeriv a Y (smthLift a x (s + v x))) :=
        ((hcs _ hcs1).2.1 s).add (((hcs _ hcs2).2.1 s).mul_left)
      have hgc : Continuous (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => Y (smthLift a x (s + v x))) :=
        hY.continuous.comp (hLc _ _ continuous_id (continuous_const.add hvc))
      have hIBP := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
        (f := fun _ : Fin 2 → ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (g := fun x => Y (smthLift a x (s + v x)))
        (v := Pi.single k 1) (by simp)
        (by
          simp only [one_mul, hval]
          exact hFc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hFcs)
        (by
          simp only [one_mul]
          exact hgc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ((hcs Y hYc).2.1 s))
        (differentiable_const _) (fun x => (hg x).differentiableAt)
      have h0 : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, fderiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin 2 → ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) x = 0 :=
        fun x => fderiv_const_apply _
      simp only [h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, zero_mul, integral_zero, neg_zero,
        one_mul, hval] at hIBP
      exact hIBP
    rw [hHmeas, integral_prod_symm _ hI']
    exact (integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hinner)).trans (integral_zero _ _)
  
  have hpt : ∀ p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (Z i) (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1)) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, smthCovec a (smthGrad v p.1) i *
            partialDeriv a (Z i) (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1)) +
          ∑ k : Fin 2, (partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) (Z (a.succAbove k))
              (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1)) +
            smthGrad v p.1 k * partialDeriv a (Z (a.succAbove k))
              (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1))) := by
    intro p
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a, Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a]
    simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_same, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, Pi.neg_apply]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have hIA : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      smthCovec a (smthGrad v p.1) i * partialDeriv a (Z i) (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1)))
      ((volume : Measure ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ)).restrict {p | p.2 < 0}) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hpd (Z i) (hZ i) (hZc i) a
    exact (hint _ (hξc i) _ h1 h2).restrict
  have hIB : ∀ k : Fin 2, Integrable (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ =>
      partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) (Z (a.succAbove k)) (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1)) +
        smthGrad v p.1 k * partialDeriv a (Z (a.succAbove k)) (smthLift a p.1 (p.2 + v p.1)))
      ((volume : Measure ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ)).restrict {p | p.2 < 0}) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hpd (Z (a.succAbove k)) (hZ _) (hZc _) (a.succAbove k)
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hpd (Z (a.succAbove k)) (hZ _) (hZc _) a
    have := (hint (fun _ => 1) continuous_const _ h1 h2).add
      (hint (fun x => smthGrad v x k) (hgradc k) _ h3 h4)
    simp only [one_mul] at this
    exact this.restrict
  rw [htr, integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt),
    integral_add (integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => hIA i)
      (integrable_finset_sum _ fun k _ => hIB k),
    integral_finset_sum _ fun i _ => hIA i, integral_finset_sum _ fun k _ => hIB k]
  simp only [fun i => hvert _ (hξc i) (Z i) (hZ i) (hZc i),
    fun k => hhor (Z (a.succAbove k)) (hZ _) (hZc _) k, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  rw [← integral_finset_sum _ fun i _ => hint2 _ (hξc i) (Z i) (hZ i).continuous (hZc i)]
  congr 1
  funext x
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
