    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) (hXU : tsupport X ⊆ U)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i)

signature.name: smth_density_contDiff
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) (hXU : tsupport X ⊆ U)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := by
    have e : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y =>
        G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2 - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1
          - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2 + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0
          + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    rw [e]
    exact (((((((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 2)).sub (((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 1))).sub
      (((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 2))).add (((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 0))).add
      (((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 1))).sub (((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 0))
  have hxi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i).contDiff.comp hX
  have hzero : ∀ z, X z = 0 → Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hz]
    simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · refine contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr (fun y => ?_)
    by_cases hy : y ∈ U
    · have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) y := hd.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y :=
        h1.sqrt (ne_of_gt (hpd y hy).det_pos)
      exact h2.mul hxi.contDiffAt
    · have hy' : y ∉ tsupport X := fun h => hy (hXU h)
      have hO : (tsupport X)ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 y := (isClosed_tsupport X).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy'
      have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem hO (fun z hz => hzero z (image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz))
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  · refine hXc.mono ?_
    intro z hz
    by_contra h
    exact hz (hzero z (Function.notMem_support.mp h))

informal_problem.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef)
    (X ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, X i * ξ i) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * X i * X j) *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j)

signature.name: smth_quad_cauchySchwarz
signature.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef)
    (X ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, X i * ξ i) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * X i * X j) *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hdet : IsUnit A.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA.isUnit
  have hAinv : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hdet
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : Fin 3 → ℝ, y = Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ ξ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have h3a : Matrix.mulVec A y = ξ := by
    rw [hy, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hAinv, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hT : A.transpose = A :=
    (Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial A).symm.trans hA.isHermitian.eq
  have hsym : ∀ u v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      dotProduct u (Matrix.mulVec A v) = dotProduct v (Matrix.mulVec A u) := by
    intro u v
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hT, dotProduct_comm]
  have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, X i * ξ i = dotProduct X ξ := rfl
  have e2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * X i * X j = dotProduct X (Matrix.mulVec A X) := by
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
  have e3 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j =
      dotProduct ξ (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ ξ) := by
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
  have hQy : dotProduct ξ (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ ξ) = dotProduct y (Matrix.mulVec A y) := by
    rw [← hy, h3a, dotProduct_comm]
  have hB : dotProduct X ξ = dotProduct X (Matrix.mulVec A y) := by
    rw [h3a]
  have h5 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ dotProduct y (Matrix.mulVec A y) * (t * t) +
      (2 * dotProduct X (Matrix.mulVec A y)) * t + dotProduct X (Matrix.mulVec A X) := by
    intro t
    have h := hA.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (t • y + X)
    have hs : star (t • y + X) = t • y + X := by
      funext i
      simp
    simp only [hs, Matrix.mulVec_add, Matrix.mulVec_smul, dotProduct_add, add_dotProduct,
      dotProduct_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul] at h
    rw [hsym y X] at h
    nlinarith [h]
  have hd := discrim_le_zero h5
  unfold discrim at hd
  rw [e1, e2, e3, hQy, hB]
  nlinarith [hd]

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hvc : Continuous v := hv.continuous
  have hgrad : Continuous (fun x => smthGrad v x) := by
    unfold smthGrad
    exact continuous_pi (fun k => (hv.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const)
  have hζ : Continuous (fun x => smthLift a x (v x)) := by
    unfold smthLift
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
      (Continuous.finInsertNth a hvc continuous_id)
  have hGe : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => G (smthLift a x (v x)) i j) W := by
    intro i j
    exact (hG i j).continuousOn.comp hζ.continuousOn (fun x hx => hW x hx)
  have hGm : ContinuousOn (fun x => G (smthLift a x (v x))) W :=
    continuousOn_pi.2 (fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 (fun j => hGe i j))
  have hdet : ContinuousOn (fun x => (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det) W :=
    (continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hGm
  have hinv : ContinuousOn (fun x => (G (smthLift a x (v x)))⁻¹) W := by
    intro x hx
    have hne : (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det ≠ 0 := (hpd _ (hW x hx)).det_pos.ne'
    have hca : ContinuousAt Ring.inverse (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det := by
      rw [Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
      exact continuousAt_inv₀ hne
    exact (continuousAt_matrix_inv _ hca).comp_continuousWithinAt
      (f := fun x => G (smthLift a x (v x))) (hGm x hx)
  have hinve : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (G (smthLift a x (v x)))⁻¹ i j) W :=
    fun i j => (continuous_id.matrix_elem i j).comp_continuousOn hinv
  have hξ : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun x => smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i) := by
    intro i
    have hc : Continuous (fun x => (Fin.insertNth a (1 : ℝ) (-smthGrad v x) : Fin 3 → ℝ)) :=
      Continuous.finInsertNth a continuous_const hgrad.neg
    exact (continuous_apply i).comp hc
  show ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det *
    Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (smthLift a x (v x)))⁻¹ i j *
      smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i * smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) j)) W
  refine hdet.sqrt.mul (ContinuousOn.sqrt ?_)
  refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_))
  exact ((hinve i j).mul (hξ i).continuousOn).mul (hξ j).continuousOn

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (a : Fin 3) (c : E3) (ρ h : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hcl : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ ≤ ρ → |z a - c a| ≤ h → z ∈ U)
    (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v)
    (hin : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 →
      |v x - c a| < h)
    (r₁ η : ℝ) (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) (hr₁ρ : r₁ < ρ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ X : E3 → E3,
      (ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ sepCyl a c ρ h ∧
        ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ smthDisc a c r₁, smthLag G a (x, v x, smthGrad v x) - η ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det * X (smthLift a x (v x)) i *
          smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ smthDisc a c ρ, -η ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det * X (smthLift a x (v x)) i *
          smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i)

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (a : Fin 3) (c : E3) (ρ h : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hcl : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ ≤ ρ → |z a - c a| ≤ h → z ∈ U)
    (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v)
    (hin : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 →
      |v x - c a| < h)
    (r₁ η : ℝ) (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) (hr₁ρ : r₁ < ρ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ X : E3 → E3,
      (ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ sepCyl a c ρ h ∧
        ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ smthDisc a c r₁, smthLag G a (x, v x, smthGrad v x) - η ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det * X (smthLift a x (v x)) i *
          smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ smthDisc a c ρ, -η ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det * X (smthLift a x (v x)) i *
          smthCovec a (smthGrad v x) i)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hLa : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift a x t) a = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [smthLift]
  have hLs : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (k : Fin 2), (smthLift a x t) (a.succAbove k) = x k := by
    intro x t k
    simp [smthLift]
  have hHL : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthHoriz a (smthLift a x t) = x := by
    intro x t; funext k; exact hLs x t k
  have hPa : ∀ w : E3, (sepPlaneProj a w) a = 0 := by
    intro w; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hPs : ∀ (w : E3) (k : Fin 2), (sepPlaneProj a w) (a.succAbove k) = w (a.succAbove k) := by
    intro w k; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hnormsq : ∀ w : E3, ‖w‖ ^ 2 = w a ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, w (a.succAbove k) ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_succAbove (fun i => ‖w i‖ ^ 2) a]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hGc : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin 2, (smthHoriz a z k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [hnormsq, hPa]
    simp only [hPs, smthHoriz]
    simp
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ∀ x, s x = ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hsfun : s = fun x => ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 := funext hs
  have hscont : Continuous s := by
    rw [hsfun]; fun_prop
  have hsGc : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ ^ 2 = s (smthHoriz a z) := by
    intro z; rw [hs]; exact hGc z
  
  have hGe : ∀ x, s x ≤ ρ ^ 2 → dist x (smthHoriz a c) ≤ ρ := by
    intro x hx
    refine (dist_pi_le_iff hρ.le).2 (fun k => ?_)
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    rw [hs] at hx
    have hk : (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 :=
      le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2)
        (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ k)) hx
    exact (sq_le_sq.1 hk).trans_eq (abs_of_pos hρ)
  have hKd : IsCompact {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | s x ≤ ρ ^ 2} := by
    refine Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded (isClosed_le hscont continuous_const) ?_
    exact (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := smthHoriz a c) (r := ρ)).subset
      (fun x hx => Metric.mem_closedBall.2 (hGe x hx))
  have hc0 : s (smthHoriz a c) = 0 := by
    rw [hs]; simp [smthHoriz]
  have hKne : ({x : Fin 2 → ℝ | s x ≤ ρ ^ 2}).Nonempty :=
    ⟨smthHoriz a c, show s (smthHoriz a c) ≤ ρ ^ 2 by rw [hc0]; positivity⟩
  
  have hzU : ∀ x ∈ {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | s x ≤ ρ ^ 2}, smthLift a x (v x) ∈ U := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : s x ≤ ρ ^ 2 := hx
    refine hcl _ ?_ ?_
    · have e1 := hsGc (smthLift a x (v x))
      rw [hHL] at e1
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (sepPlaneProj a (smthLift a x (v x) - c))]
    · rw [hLa]
      have hx'' := hx'
      rw [hs] at hx''
      exact (hin x hx'').le
  
  have hVU : sepCyl a c ρ h ⊆ U := fun z hz => hcl z hz.1.le hz.2.le
  
  have hliftc : Continuous (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => smthLift a x (v x)) := by
    have hins : Continuous (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => (Fin.insertNth a (v x) x : Fin 3 → ℝ)) := by
      refine continuous_pi (fun i => ?_)
      rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
      · simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
        exact hv.continuous
      · simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
        exact continuous_apply k
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp hins
  have hgc : Continuous (smthGrad v) := by
    refine continuous_pi (fun k => ?_)
    exact (hv.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  
  have hHc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (smthHoriz a) := by
    refine contDiff_pi.2 (fun k => ?_)
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj (a.succAbove k) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hcovs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (smthCovec a) := by
    refine contDiff_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
    · simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
      exact contDiff_const
    · simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
      exact (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ k).neg
  
  have hvc : Continuous v := hv.continuous
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀K, hx₀max⟩ := hKd.exists_isMaxOn hKne
    (f := fun x => |v x - c a|) (by fun_prop : Continuous fun x => |v x - c a|).continuousOn
  have hbound : ∀ x, s x ≤ ρ ^ 2 → |v x - c a| ≤ |v x₀ - c a| :=
    fun x hx => isMaxOn_iff.1 hx₀max x hx
  have hh₁ : 0 ≤ |v x₀ - c a| := abs_nonneg _
  have hh₁h : |v x₀ - c a| < h := by
    have h0 : s x₀ ≤ ρ ^ 2 := hx₀K
    rw [hs] at h0
    exact hin x₀ h0
  
  obtain ⟨χ, hχs, hχc, hχV, hχ01, hχ1⟩ :=
    smth_cyl_cutoff a c r₁ ρ |v x₀ - c a| h hr₁ hr₁ρ hh₁ hh₁h
  have hχU : tsupport χ ⊆ U := hχV.trans hVU
  
  obtain ⟨hdetS, hinvS⟩ := smth_metric_inv_contDiffOn G U hG hpd
  
  have hF1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det)
      {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | s x ≤ ρ ^ 2} :=
    (hdetS.continuousOn.comp hliftc.continuousOn (fun x hx => hzU x hx)).sqrt
  have hF2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |(G (smthLift a x (v x)))⁻¹ i j|)
      {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | s x ≤ ρ ^ 2} := by
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_))
    exact ((hinvS i j).continuousOn.comp hliftc.continuousOn (fun x hx => hzU x hx)).abs
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hKd.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hF1
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := hKd.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hF2
  obtain ⟨Cg, hCg, hCgb⟩ : ∃ Cg : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cg ∧ ∀ x, s x ≤ ρ ^ 2 →
      Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a x (v x))).det ≤ Cg := by
    refine ⟨max C₁ 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hC₁ x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h1.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  obtain ⟨CA, hCA, hCAb⟩ : ∃ CA : ℝ, 0 ≤ CA ∧ ∀ x, s x ≤ ρ ^ 2 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |(G (smthLift a x (v x)))⁻¹ i j| ≤ CA := by
    refine ⟨max C₂ 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hC₂ x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h1.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  
  have hsq := Real.sqrt_nonneg CA
  have hden : 0 < 2 * (Cg + 1) * (Real.sqrt CA + 1) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨δ, hδdef⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = η / (2 * (Cg + 1) * (Real.sqrt CA + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by rw [hδdef]; positivity
  have hδeq : δ * (2 * (Cg + 1) * (Real.sqrt CA + 1)) = η := by
    rw [hδdef]; exact div_mul_cancel₀ η hden.ne'
  have hδη : 2 * Cg * Real.sqrt CA * δ ≤ η := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hδ.le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Cg + Real.sqrt CA + 1)]
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPs, hPd, -⟩ := hgc.exists_contDiff_approx ⊤ (continuous_const (y := δ))
    (fun _ => hδ)
  have hPk : ∀ x k, |P x k - smthGrad v x k| ≤ δ := fun x k => by
    have h1 := hPd x
    have h2 : dist (P x k) (smthGrad v x k) ≤ dist (P x) (smthGrad v x) := dist_le_pi_dist _ _ k
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at h2
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζdef⟩ : ∃ ζ : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, ζ = fun z => smthCovec a (P (smthHoriz a z)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hζs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ := by
    rw [hζdef]; exact hcovs.comp (hPs.comp hHc)
  have hζ0 : ∀ z, ζ z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z h0
    have h1 := congrFun h0 a
    rw [hζdef] at h1
    simp [smthCovec] at h1
  have hζz : ∀ x, ζ (smthLift a x (v x)) = smthCovec a (P x) := by
    intro x; rw [hζdef]; simp only [hHL]
  
  obtain ⟨X, hXdef⟩ : ∃ X : E3 → E3, X = fun z => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i =>
      χ z * ((∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * ζ z k) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ζ z k * ζ z l))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X := by
    rw [hXdef]; exact smth_unit_field_contDiff G U hU hinvS hpd χ hχs hχU ζ hζs hζ0
  have hXi : ∀ z i, X z i = χ z * ((∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * ζ z k) /
      Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ζ z k * ζ z l)) := by
    intro z i; rw [hXdef]; rfl
  
  have hXsupp : Function.support X ⊆ Function.support χ := by
    intro z hz
    by_contra h0
    apply hz
    have h0' : χ z = 0 := Function.notMem_support.1 h0
    ext i
    simp [hXi, h0']
  have hXc : HasCompactSupport X := hχc.mono hXsupp
  have hXV : tsupport X ⊆ sepCyl a c ρ h := (closure_mono hXsupp).trans hχV
  
  have hunit : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), A.PosDef → ∀ (ζ : Fin 3 → ℝ), ζ ≠ 0 →
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j *
        (t * ((∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l))) *
        (t * ((∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ j k * ζ k) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l))) ≤ 1 := by
    intro A hA ζ hζ t ht0 ht1
    set q := ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l with hqdef
    set r := Real.sqrt q with hrdef
    have hq : 0 < q := by
      have h0 := hA.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hζ
      have e : dotProduct (star ζ) (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ ζ) = q := by
        simp only [hqdef, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
      linarith
    have hr2 : r ^ 2 = q := Real.sq_sqrt hq.le
    have hw : ∀ i, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * (∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ j k * ζ k) = ζ i := by
      intro i
      have h := congrFun (show Matrix.mulVec A (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ ζ) = ζ by
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hA.det_pos.ne'),
          Matrix.one_mulVec]) i
      exact h
    have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * (t * ((∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) / r)) *
        (t * ((∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ j k * ζ k) / r)) =
        (t / r) ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) * ζ i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [← hw i, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      ring
    have hq' : ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) * ζ i = q := by
      rw [hqdef]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      ring
    rw [hsum, hq', div_pow, hr2, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hq.ne']
    nlinarith
  have hXB : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ U
    · simp only [hXi]

proof.tactics:
by
  intro φ hφ hφc hφD
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδD⟩ := hφc.exists_cthickening_subset_open hD hφD
  have hK'c : IsCompact (Metric.cthickening δ (tsupport φ)) := hφc.cthickening
  
  have hgradc : ∀ f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 f → Continuous (smthGrad f) := by
    intro f hf
    exact continuous_pi fun k => (hf.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hAc : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) D := by
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ Λ) O := hΛ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)

      (∫ x in D, fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, f x, smthGrad f x)) =
        ∫ x in Metric.cthickening δ (tsupport φ),

    intro f hf hfK

    intro x hx

  have hstab : ∀ (ψ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ →

informal_problem.statement: (Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΛ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ O) (hell : ∀ w ∈ O, ∀ q : Fin 2 → ℝ, q ≠ 0 → 0 < fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, q)) w (0, 0, q)) (D : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hD : IsOpen D) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v) (hvO : ∀ x ∈ D, (x, v x, smthGrad v x) ∈ O) (hEL1 : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ x in D, fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x) = 0) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ D) : ∃ R h₀ lam Lam K M₀ : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ 0 < h₀ ∧ 0 < lam ∧ 0 ≤ Lam ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧ 0 ≤ M₀ ∧ Metric.closedBall x₀ R ⊆ D ∧ ∀ (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h ≤ h₀ → ∃ (P : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContinuousOn P (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) ∧ ContinuousOn p (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, |(v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v x) / h| ≤ M₀) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, lam * ∑ k, (smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y) / h) x k) ^ 2 - K ≤ ∑ k, P x k * smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y) / h) x k) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, ∀ k, |P x k| ≤ Lam * (1 + ∑ j, |smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y) / h) x j|)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, |p x| ≤ Lam * (1 + ∑ j, |smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y) / h) x j|)) ∧ (∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R → ∫ x, (∑ k, P x k * smthGrad φ x k + p x * φ x) = 0)

signature.statement: (Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΛ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ O) (hell : ∀ w ∈ O, ∀ q : Fin 2 → ℝ, q ≠ 0 → 0 < fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, q)) w (0, 0, q)) (D : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hD : IsOpen D) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v) (hvO : ∀ x ∈ D, (x, v x, smthGrad v x) ∈ O) (hEL1 : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ x in D, fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x) = 0) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ D) : ∃ R h₀ lam Lam K M₀ : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ 0 < h₀ ∧ 0 < lam ∧ 0 ≤ Lam ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧ 0 ≤ M₀ ∧ Metric.closedBall x₀ R ⊆ D ∧ ∀ (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ), 0 < h → h ≤ h₀ → ∃ (P : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContinuousOn P (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) ∧ ContinuousOn p (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, |(v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v x) / h| ≤ M₀) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, lam * ∑ k, (smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y) / h) x k) ^ 2 - K ≤ ∑ k, P x k * smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y) / h) x k) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, ∀ k, |P x k| ≤ Lam * (1 + ∑ j, |smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y) / h) x j|)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, |p x| ≤ Lam * (1 + ∑ j, |smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v y) / h) x j|)) ∧ (∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R → ∫ x, (∑ k, P x k * smthGrad φ x k + p x * φ x) = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ),
      ∀ x, W x = (x, v x, smthGrad v x) := ⟨fun x => (x, v x, smthGrad v x), fun x => rfl⟩
  
  have hgradc : Continuous (smthGrad v) :=
    continuous_pi fun k => (hv.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hWc : Continuous W := by
    have e1 : W = fun x => (x, v x, smthGrad v x) := funext hW
    rw [e1]
    exact continuous_id.prodMk (hv.continuous.prodMk hgradc)
  have hLc' : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) D := by
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ Λ) O := hΛ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)
    have h2 : Continuous (fun x => (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) :=
      continuous_id.prodMk (hv.continuous.prodMk hgradc)
    exact h1.comp h2.continuousOn (fun x hx => hvO x hx)
  have hLc : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (W x)) D := by
    have e1 : (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (W x)) = fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) :=
      funext fun x => by rw [hW]
    rw [e1]; exact hLc'
  
  have hs6 : ∀ (L : ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c' : ℝ) (q : Fin 2 → ℝ),
      L (0, c', q) = c' * L (0, 1, 0) + ∑ k, q k * L (0, 0, Pi.single k 1) := by
    intro L c' q
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have key : ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), c', q) = c' • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) +
        (q 0 • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) +
          q 1 • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ))) := by
      refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)
      · simp
      · simp
      · funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
    rw [key, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
      smul_eq_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrD⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hD x₀ hx₀
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = r / 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR : 0 < R := by rw [hRdef]; positivity
  have hB₂D : Metric.closedBall x₀ (2 * R) ⊆ D := fun y hy =>
    hrD (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by rw [hRdef]; linarith) hy)
  have hBR : Metric.closedBall x₀ R ⊆ Metric.closedBall x₀ (2 * R) :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)
  have hB₂c : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x₀ (2 * R)) := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  obtain ⟨κ, Λ₂, lam₀, hκ, hΛ₂, hlam₀, hQO, hHb, hHe⟩ :=
    smth_dq_compact_constants Λ O hO hΛ hell (W '' Metric.closedBall x₀ (2 * R))
      (hB₂c.image hWc) ⟨W x₀, x₀, Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by linarith), rfl⟩
      (by rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; rw [hW]; exact hvO y (hB₂D hy))
  obtain ⟨Cv, hCv⟩ :=
    hB₂c.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hv.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀def⟩ : ∃ M₀ : ℝ, M₀ = max Cv 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM₀ : 0 ≤ M₀ := by rw [hM₀def]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hDv : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (2 * R), ‖fderiv ℝ v y‖ ≤ M₀ := fun y hy =>
    (hCv y hy).trans (by rw [hM₀def]; exact le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hWu⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.1
    (hB₂c.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hWc.continuousOn) κ hκ
  obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀def⟩ : ∃ h₀ : ℝ, h₀ = min R (η / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hh₀ : 0 < h₀ := by rw [hh₀def]; exact lt_min hR (by positivity)
  have hh₀R : h₀ ≤ R := by rw [hh₀def]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hh₀η : h₀ < η := by rw [hh₀def]; exact lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = Λ₂ * (1 + M₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by rw [hcdef]; exact mul_nonneg hΛ₂ (by linarith)
  
  have hσ : ∀ q : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖q‖ ≤ ∑ j, |q j| := by
    intro q
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)).2 fun i => ?_
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |q j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _)
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have young : ∀ t : ℝ, c * |t| ≤ lam₀ / 2 * t ^ 2 + c ^ 2 / (2 * lam₀) := by
    intro t
    have key : lam₀ / 2 * t ^ 2 + c ^ 2 / (2 * lam₀) - c * |t| =
        (lam₀ * |t| - c) ^ 2 / (2 * lam₀) := by
      rw [← sq_abs t]
      field_simp
      ring
    have : 0 ≤ (lam₀ * |t| - c) ^ 2 / (2 * lam₀) := by positivity
    linarith
  refine ⟨R, h₀, lam₀ / 2, c, c ^ 2 / lam₀, M₀, hR, hh₀, by positivity, hc, by positivity, hM₀,
    hBR.trans hB₂D, ?_⟩
  
  intro m h hh hhh
  have hh0 : h ≠ 0 := hh.ne'
  obtain ⟨ev, hevdef⟩ : ∃ ev : Fin 2 → ℝ, ev = (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hevdef]
  have hev : ‖ev‖ = 1 := by rw [hevdef, Pi.norm_single, norm_one]
  have hnorm_a : ‖h • ev‖ = h := by
    rw [norm_smul, hev, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hh]
  have hmem : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (2 * R) ∧
      x + h • ev ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (2 * R) := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨hBR hx, ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hx ⊢
    calc dist (x + h • ev) x₀ ≤ dist (x + h • ev) x + dist x x₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = h + dist x x₀ := by rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, hnorm_a]
      _ ≤ 2 * R := by linarith
  
  have hdv : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ v y := fun y => hv.differentiable one_ne_zero y
  have hs5 : ∀ x, smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x =
      fun k => (smthGrad v (x + h • ev) k - smthGrad v x k) / h := by
    intro x
    have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => v (y + h • ev)) x :=
      (hdv _).comp x (differentiableAt_id.add_const _)
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x =
        h⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ v (x + h • ev) - fderiv ℝ v x) := by
      have e1 : (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) = fun y => h⁻¹ * (v (y + h • ev) - v y) := by
        funext y; rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
      have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => v (y + h • ev) - v y) x := hd1.sub (hdv x)
      rw [e1, fderiv_const_mul hd2]
      congr 1
      rw [show (fun y => v (y + h • ev) - v y) = (fun y => v (y + h • ev)) - v from rfl,
        fderiv_sub hd1 (hdv x), fderiv_comp_add_right]
    funext k
    simp only [smthGrad, hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ), ∀ x k, P x k =
      (fderiv ℝ Λ (W (x + h • ev)) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1) -
        fderiv ℝ Λ (W x) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1)) / h := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ∀ x, p x =
      (fderiv ℝ Λ (W (x + h • ev)) (0, 1, 0) - fderiv ℝ Λ (W x) (0, 1, 0)) / h :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hL1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (W (x + h • ev))) (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) :=
    hLc.comp (continuous_add_right _).continuousOn (fun x hx => hB₂D (hmem x hx).2)
  have hL0 : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (W x)) (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) :=
    hLc.mono (hBR.trans hB₂D)
  
  have hwb : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, |(v (x + h • ev) - v x) / h| ≤ M₀ := by
    intro x hx
    have hmv := (convex_closedBall x₀ (2 * R)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
      (fun y _ => hdv y) hDv (hmem x hx).1 (hmem x hx).2
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, hnorm_a, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmv
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hh, div_le_iff₀ hh]
    exact hmv
  
  have hstruct : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R,
      (∀ ζ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ),
        |fderiv ℝ Λ (W (x + h • ev)) ζ - fderiv ℝ Λ (W x) ζ| ≤
          h * (Λ₂ * ‖((ev, (v (x + h • ev) - v x) / h,
            smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x) :
              (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ * ‖ζ‖)) ∧
      lam₀ * ∑ k, (smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x k) ^ 2 -
          Λ₂ * ‖((ev, (v (x + h • ev) - v x) / h, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ *
            ‖smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x‖ ≤
        (fderiv ℝ Λ (W (x + h • ev)) (0, 0, smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x) -
          fderiv ℝ Λ (W x) (0, 0, smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x)) / h := by
    intro x hx
    have hY : W (x + h • ev) - W x = h • ((ev, (v (x + h • ev) - v x) / h,
        smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) := by
      rw [hW, hW, hs5 x]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)
      · simp
      · simp only [Prod.snd_sub, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.fst_sub, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
      · funext k
        simp only [Prod.snd_sub, Prod.smul_snd, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.smul_fst, Pi.sub_apply,
          Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
    have hseg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, W x + t • (W (x + h • ev) - W x) ∈
        Metric.cthickening κ (W '' Metric.closedBall x₀ (2 * R)) := by
      intro t ht
      have hd : dist (W (x + h • ev)) (W x) < κ := by
        apply hWu _ (hmem x hx).2 _ (hmem x hx).1
        rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, hnorm_a]
        linarith
      refine Metric.mem_cthickening_of_dist_le _ (W x) κ _ ⟨x, (hmem x hx).1, rfl⟩ ?_
      rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1,
        ← dist_eq_norm]
      calc t * dist (W (x + h • ev)) (W x) ≤ 1 * dist (W (x + h • ev)) (W x) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht.2 dist_nonneg
        _ ≤ κ := by rw [one_mul]; exact hd.le
    exact smth_dq_segment_estimates Λ O hO hΛ _ hQO Λ₂ lam₀ hHb hHe (W x) (W (x + h • ev)) hseg
      h hh ev _ _ hY
  refine ⟨P, p, ?_, ?_, hwb, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have e1 : P = fun x k => (fderiv ℝ Λ (W (x + h • ev)) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1) -
        fderiv ℝ Λ (W x) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1)) / h := funext fun x => funext fun k => hP x k
    rw [e1]
    exact continuousOn_pi.2 fun k =>
      ((hL1.clm_apply continuousOn_const).sub (hL0.clm_apply continuousOn_const)).div_const _
  · 
    have e1 : p = fun x => (fderiv ℝ Λ (W (x + h • ev)) (0, 1, 0) -
        fderiv ℝ Λ (W x) (0, 1, 0)) / h := funext hp
    rw [e1]
    exact ((hL1.clm_apply continuousOn_const).sub (hL0.clm_apply continuousOn_const)).div_const _
  · 
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨-, hB⟩ := hstruct x hx
    have hsum : ∑ k, P x k * smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x k =
        (fderiv ℝ Λ (W (x + h • ev)) (0, 0, smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x) -
          fderiv ℝ Λ (W x) (0, 0, smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x)) / h := by
      rw [hs6 (fderiv ℝ Λ (W (x + h • ev))) 0 (smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x),
        hs6 (fderiv ℝ Λ (W x)) 0 (smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x)]
      simp only [hP, zero_mul, zero_add, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    rw [hsum]
    have hn : ‖((ev, (v (x + h • ev) - v x) / h, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ ≤
        1 + M₀ := by
      have hw := hwb x hx
      simp only [Prod.norm_def, hev, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_zero]
      exact max_le (by linarith) (max_le (by linarith) (by linarith))
    have hq := hσ (smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x)
    have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul hn hq (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith)) hΛ₂
    have y0 := young (smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x 0)
    have y1 := young (smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x 1)
    have hcc : c ^ 2 / lam₀ = c ^ 2 / (2 * lam₀) + c ^ 2 / (2 * lam₀) := by
      field_simp; ring
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hprod hB ⊢
    rw [hcc]
    rw [hcdef] at y0 y1 ⊢
    nlinarith
  · 
    intro x hx k
    obtain ⟨hA, -⟩ := hstruct x hx
    have h1 := hA (0, 0, Pi.single k 1)
    have hk : ‖(((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single k 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) :
        (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ = 1 := by
      simp [Prod.norm_def, Pi.norm_single]
    rw [hk, mul_one] at h1
    have hw := hwb x hx
    have hq := hσ (smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x)
    have h2 : ‖((ev, (v (x + h • ev) - v x) / h, smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x) :
        (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ ≤
        (1 + M₀) * (1 + ∑ j, |smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x j|) := by
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, |smthGrad (fun y => (v (y + h • ev) - v y) / h) x j| :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => abs_nonneg _
      simp only [Prod.norm_def, hev, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      refine max_le ?_ (max_le ?_ ?_) <;> nlinarith
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hΛ₂) hh.le
    rw [hP, abs_div, abs_of_pos hh, div_le_iff₀ hh, hcdef]
    nlinarith
  · 
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hA, -⟩ := hstruct x hx
    have h1 := hA (0, 1, 0)
    have hk : ‖(((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) :
        (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ = 1 := by
      simp [Prod.norm_def]

signature.name: smth_metric_inv_contDiffOn
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdetgen : ∀ M : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => M y k l) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (M y).det) U := by
    intro M hM
    have t1 := ((hM 0 0).mul (hM 1 1)).mul (hM 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hM 0 0).mul (hM 1 2)).mul (hM 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hM 0 1).mul (hM 1 0)).mul (hM 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hM 0 1).mul (hM 1 2)).mul (hM 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hM 0 2).mul (hM 1 0)).mul (hM 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hM 0 2).mul (hM 1 1)).mul (hM 2 0)
    have hpoly := ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
    exact hpoly.congr (fun y _ => Matrix.det_fin_three (M y))
  have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := hdetgen G hG
  have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).adjugate i j) U := by
    intro i j
    have h := hdetgen (fun y => (G y).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1)) (by
      intro k l
      by_cases hk : k = j
      · subst hk
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hk]
        exact hG k l)
    exact h.congr (fun y _ => Matrix.adjugate_apply (G y) i j)
  have hinvformula : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      (G y)⁻¹ i j = ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate i j := by
    intro y i j
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
  refine ⟨hdet, fun i j => ?_⟩
  have h := (hdet.inv (fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne')).mul (hadj i j)
  exact h.congr (fun y _ => hinvformula y i j)

informal_problem.statement:

signature.name: smth_cyl_cutoff
signature.statement:
(a : Fin 3) (c : E3) (r₁ ρ h₁ h : ℝ) (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) (hr₁ρ : r₁ < ρ)
    (hh₁ : 0 ≤ h₁) (hh₁h : h₁ < h) :
    ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ ∧ HasCompactSupport χ ∧ tsupport χ ⊆ sepCyl a c ρ h ∧
      (∀ z, 0 ≤ χ z ∧ χ z ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ z : E3, ∑ k : Fin 2, (z (a.succAbove k) - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ r₁ ^ 2 →
        |z a - c a| ≤ h₁ → χ z = 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂def⟩ : ∃ r₂ : ℝ, r₂ = (r₁ + ρ) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨h₂, hh₂def⟩ : ∃ h₂ : ℝ, h₂ = (h₁ + h) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hr12 : r₁ < r₂ := by rw [hr₂def]; linarith
  have hr2ρ : r₂ < ρ := by rw [hr₂def]; linarith
  have hr2 : 0 < r₂ := by linarith
  have hh12 : h₁ < h₂ := by rw [hh₂def]; linarith
  have hh2h : h₂ < h := by rw [hh₂def]; linarith
  have hh2 : 0 < h₂ := by linarith
  have hDr : 0 < r₂ ^ 2 - r₁ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hDh : 0 < h₂ ^ 2 - h₁ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hr2ρ2 : r₂ ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hh2h2 : h₂ ^ 2 < h ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨σ, hσdef⟩ : ∃ σ : E3 → ℝ,
      σ = fun z => ∑ k : Fin 2, (z (a.succAbove k) - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨τ, hτdef⟩ : ∃ τ : E3 → ℝ, τ = fun z => (z a - c a) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσ : ∀ z, σ z = ∑ k : Fin 2, (z (a.succAbove k) - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 :=
    fun z => by rw [hσdef]
  have hτ : ∀ z, τ z = (z a - c a) ^ 2 := fun z => by rw [hτdef]
  have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z i) := fun i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hσs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ σ := by
    rw [hσdef]
    exact ContDiff.sum (fun k _ => ((hcoord _).sub contDiff_const).pow 2)
  have hτs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ τ := by
    rw [hτdef]
    exact ((hcoord _).sub contDiff_const).pow 2
  
  obtain ⟨χ, hχdef⟩ : ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, χ = fun z =>
      Real.smoothTransition ((r₂ ^ 2 - σ z) / (r₂ ^ 2 - r₁ ^ 2)) *
        Real.smoothTransition ((h₂ ^ 2 - τ z) / (h₂ ^ 2 - h₁ ^ 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hχ : ∀ z, χ z = Real.smoothTransition ((r₂ ^ 2 - σ z) / (r₂ ^ 2 - r₁ ^ 2)) *
        Real.smoothTransition ((h₂ ^ 2 - τ z) / (h₂ ^ 2 - h₁ ^ 2)) := fun z => by rw [hχdef]
  
  have hχs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ := by
    rw [hχdef]
    have hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)
    exact (hT.comp ((contDiff_const.sub hσs).div_const _)).mul
      (hT.comp ((contDiff_const.sub hτs).div_const _))
  
  have h01 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ χ z ∧ χ z ≤ 1 := by
    intro z
    rw [hχ]
    exact ⟨mul_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _) (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _),
      mul_le_one₀ (Real.smoothTransition.le_one _) (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)
        (Real.smoothTransition.le_one _)⟩
  
  have hone : ∀ z : E3, ∑ k : Fin 2, (z (a.succAbove k) - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ r₁ ^ 2 →
      |z a - c a| ≤ h₁ → χ z = 1 := by
    intro z hz1 hz2
    have hτ1 : (z a - c a) ^ 2 ≤ h₁ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hz2 2
    have e1 : Real.smoothTransition ((r₂ ^ 2 - σ z) / (r₂ ^ 2 - r₁ ^ 2)) = 1 := by
      apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hDr, hσ z]
      linarith
    have e2 : Real.smoothTransition ((h₂ ^ 2 - τ z) / (h₂ ^ 2 - h₁ ^ 2)) = 1 := by
      apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hDh, hτ z]
      linarith
    rw [hχ, e1, e2, mul_one]
  
  have hsupp : Function.support χ ⊆ {z | σ z ≤ r₂ ^ 2} ∩ {z | τ z ≤ h₂ ^ 2} := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Function.mem_support, hχ] at hz
    have hA := left_ne_zero_of_mul hz
    have hB := right_ne_zero_of_mul hz
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show σ z ≤ r₂ ^ 2
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      apply hA
      apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hDr, zero_mul]
      linarith
    · show τ z ≤ h₂ ^ 2
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      apply hB
      apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hDh, zero_mul]
      linarith
  have hKc : IsClosed ({z | σ z ≤ r₂ ^ 2} ∩ {z | τ z ≤ h₂ ^ 2}) :=
    (isClosed_le hσs.continuous continuous_const).inter
      (isClosed_le hτs.continuous continuous_const)
  have hts : tsupport χ ⊆ {z | σ z ≤ r₂ ^ 2} ∩ {z | τ z ≤ h₂ ^ 2} :=
    closure_minimal hsupp hKc
  
  have hPa : ∀ w : E3, (sepPlaneProj a w) a = 0 := by
    intro w; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hPs : ∀ (w : E3) (k : Fin 2), (sepPlaneProj a w) (a.succAbove k) = w (a.succAbove k) := by
    intro w k; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hnormsq : ∀ w : E3, ‖w‖ ^ 2 = w a ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, w (a.succAbove k) ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_succAbove (fun i => ‖w i‖ ^ 2) a]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hN1 : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ ^ 2 = σ z := by
    intro z
    rw [hnormsq, hPa, hσ]
    simp only [hPs, PiLp.sub_apply]
    ring
  have hN2 : ∀ z : E3, ‖z - c‖ ^ 2 = τ z + σ z := by
    intro z
    rw [hnormsq, hσ, hτ]
    simp only [PiLp.sub_apply]
  
  have hKcyl : {z | σ z ≤ r₂ ^ 2} ∩ {z | τ z ≤ h₂ ^ 2} ⊆ sepCyl a c ρ h := by
    rintro z ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
    have hz1' : σ z ≤ r₂ ^ 2 := hz1
    have hz2' : τ z ≤ h₂ ^ 2 := hz2
    have hA : ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ < ρ := by
      have h1 : ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2 := by rw [hN1]; linarith
      have h2 := abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq h1 (by linarith)
      rwa [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] at h2
    have hB : |z a - c a| < h := by
      have h1 : (z a - c a) ^ 2 < h ^ 2 := by rw [← hτ z]; linarith
      exact abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq h1 (by linarith)
    exact ⟨hA, hB⟩
  
  have hKball : {z | σ z ≤ r₂ ^ 2} ∩ {z | τ z ≤ h₂ ^ 2} ⊆ Metric.closedBall c (h₂ + r₂) := by
    rintro z ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
    have hz1' : σ z ≤ r₂ ^ 2 := hz1
    have hz2' : τ z ≤ h₂ ^ 2 := hz2
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
    have h1 : ‖z - c‖ ^ 2 ≤ (h₂ + r₂) ^ 2 := by rw [hN2]; nlinarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (z - c)]
  refine ⟨χ, hχs, ?_, hts.trans hKcyl, h01, hone⟩
  exact ((isCompact_closedBall c (h₂ + r₂)).of_isClosed_subset hKc hKball).of_isClosed_subset
    (isClosed_tsupport χ) hts

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (χ : E3 → ℝ) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (hχU : tsupport χ ⊆ U)
    (ζ : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζ0 : ∀ z, ζ z ≠ 0) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i =>
      χ z * ((∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * ζ z k) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ζ z k * ζ z l))))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hζk : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => ζ z k) := fun k => contDiff_pi.1 hζ k
  have hN : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * ζ z k) U := by
    intro i
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hinv i k).mul (hζk k).contDiffOn)
  have hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ζ z k * ζ z l) U := by
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun l _ =>
      ((hinv k l).mul (hζk k).contDiffOn).mul (hζk l).contDiffOn))
  have hqpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l * ζ y k * ζ y l := by
    intro y hy
    have h0 := (hpd y hy).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos (hζ0 y)
    have e : dotProduct (star (ζ y)) (Matrix.mulVec (G y)⁻¹ (ζ y)) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l * ζ y k * ζ y l := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
    linarith
  have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z => Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ζ z k * ζ z l)) U :=
    hq.sqrt (fun y hy => (hqpos y hy).ne')
  have hsqne : ∀ y ∈ U,
      Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l * ζ y k * ζ y l) ≠ 0 :=
    fun y hy => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hqpos y hy)).ne'
  have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => χ z * ((∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * ζ z k) /
      Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ζ z k * ζ z l))) := by
    intro i
    have hon : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => χ z * ((∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * ζ z k) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ζ z k * ζ z l))) U :=
      hχ.contDiffOn.mul ((hN i).div hsq hsqne)
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ U
    · exact hon.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
    · have hzs : z ∉ tsupport χ := fun h => hz (hχU h)
      have hev := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).1 hzs
      refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hw
      simp [hw]
  have hΦ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => (fun i => χ z * ((∑ k : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i k * ζ z k) /
      Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ζ z k * ζ z l))) : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) :=
    contDiff_pi.2 hcomp
  exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp hΦ
