signature.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) (ζ ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) (δ C g Cg η t : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hC : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |A⁻¹ i j| ≤ C)
    (hd : ∀ i : Fin 3, |ζ i - ξ i| ≤ δ) (hg : Real.sqrt g ≤ Cg) (hη : 2 * Cg * Real.sqrt C * δ ≤ η)
    (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    t * (Real.sqrt g * Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j)) - η ≤
      ∑ i : Fin 3, Real.sqrt g *
        (t * ((∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l))) * ξ i

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hBpd : (A⁻¹).PosDef := hA.inv
  have hsym : ∀ i j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j = A⁻¹ j i := by
    intro i j
    have h := hBpd.isHermitian.apply i j
    simp only [star_trivial] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hqf : ∀ u : Fin 3 → ℝ, dotProduct (star u) (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ u) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * u i * u j := by
    intro u
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
  
  have hquad : ∀ x y : ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      A⁻¹ i j * (x * (ξ i - ζ i) + y * ζ i) * (x * (ξ j - ζ j) + y * ζ j) =
      x ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * (ξ i - ζ i) * (ξ j - ζ j) +
        2 * x * y * ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) * (ξ i - ζ i) +
        y ^ 2 * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l := by
    intro x y
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hsym 1 0, hsym 2 0, hsym 2 1]
    ring
  have hnn : ∀ x y : ℝ, 0 ≤
      x ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * (ξ i - ζ i) * (ξ j - ζ j) +
        2 * x * y * ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) * (ξ i - ζ i) +
        y ^ 2 * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l := by
    intro x y
    have h := hBpd.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (fun i => x * (ξ i - ζ i) + y * ζ i)
    rw [hqf] at h
    rw [← hquad x y]
    exact h
  have hQpos : 0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l := by
    have h := hBpd.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hζ
    rw [hqf] at h
    exact h
  have hqd0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * (ξ i - ζ i) * (ξ j - ζ j) := by
    have := hBpd.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (fun i => ξ i - ζ i)
    rw [hqf] at this
    exact this
  have hP : ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) * ξ i =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) * (ξ i - ζ i) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  have hexp : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l +
        2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) * (ξ i - ζ i) +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * (ξ i - ζ i) * (ξ j - ζ j) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hsym 1 0, hsym 2 0, hsym 2 1]
    ring
  have hqdC : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * (ξ i - ζ i) * (ξ j - ζ j) ≤ C * δ ^ 2 := by
    have hdi : ∀ i : Fin 3, |ξ i - ζ i| ≤ δ := fun i => by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact hd i
    have hterm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * (ξ i - ζ i) * (ξ j - ζ j) ≤ |A⁻¹ i j| * δ ^ 2 := by
      intro i j
      calc A⁻¹ i j * (ξ i - ζ i) * (ξ j - ζ j)
          ≤ |A⁻¹ i j * (ξ i - ζ i) * (ξ j - ζ j)| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |A⁻¹ i j| * (|ξ i - ζ i| * |ξ j - ζ j|) := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ |A⁻¹ i j| * (δ * δ) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
            exact mul_le_mul (hdi i) (hdi j) (abs_nonneg _) hδ
        _ = |A⁻¹ i j| * δ ^ 2 := by ring
    calc ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * (ξ i - ζ i) * (ξ j - ζ j)
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |A⁻¹ i j| * δ ^ 2 :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hterm i j))
      _ = (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |A⁻¹ i j|) * δ ^ 2 := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ ≤ C * δ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC (sq_nonneg δ)
  have hRHS : ∑ i : Fin 3, Real.sqrt g *
        (t * ((∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l))) * ξ i =
      t * Real.sqrt g * ((∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) * ξ i) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l)) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  rw [hRHS]
  
  generalize hQ : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * ζ k * ζ l = Q at *
  generalize hqξ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j = qξ at *
  generalize hqd : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * (ξ i - ζ i) * (ξ j - ζ j) = qd at *
  generalize hc : ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) * (ξ i - ζ i) = c at *
  generalize hPP : ∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ζ k) * ξ i = P at *
  
  have hCS : c ^ 2 ≤ Q * qd := by
    have h := hnn Q (-c)
    nlinarith
  have ha : 0 < Real.sqrt Q := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hQpos
  have ha2 : Real.sqrt Q ^ 2 = Q := Real.sq_sqrt hQpos.le
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt qd := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt qd ^ 2 = qd := Real.sq_sqrt hqd0
  have has : c ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt Q * Real.sqrt qd) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, ha2, hs2]; exact hCS
  obtain ⟨hcl, hcu⟩ := abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' has (mul_nonneg ha.le hs0)
  have hb : Real.sqrt qξ ≤ Real.sqrt Q + Real.sqrt qd := by
    have h1 : qξ ≤ (Real.sqrt Q + Real.sqrt qd) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    calc Real.sqrt qξ ≤ Real.sqrt ((Real.sqrt Q + Real.sqrt qd) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
      _ = Real.sqrt Q + Real.sqrt qd := Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)
  have hPa : Real.sqrt Q - Real.sqrt qd ≤ P / Real.sqrt Q := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ha]; nlinarith
  have hsC : Real.sqrt qd ≤ Real.sqrt C * δ := by
    calc Real.sqrt qd ≤ Real.sqrt (C * δ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hqdC
      _ = Real.sqrt C * Real.sqrt (δ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_mul' C (sq_nonneg δ)
      _ = Real.sqrt C * δ := by rw [Real.sqrt_sq hδ]
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt C * δ) := by positivity
  have hdiff : Real.sqrt qξ - P / Real.sqrt Q ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt C * δ) := by linarith
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt g := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ t * Real.sqrt g := mul_nonneg ht0 hS0
  have hKC : t * Real.sqrt g ≤ Cg := le_trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left hS0 ht1) hg
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiff hK0
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKC hD0
  nlinarith

informal_problem.statement: (k : ℕ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (hu : smthHolC (k + 1) u S) : smthHolC k u S

signature.name: smth_holC_mono
signature.statement: (k : ℕ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (hu : smthHolC (k + 1) u S) : smthHolC k u S

proof.tactics:
by
  induction k generalizing u with
  | succ k ih =>
    exact ⟨hu.1, fun m => ih _ (hu.2 m)⟩
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨hd, hpar⟩ := hu
    refine ⟨fun x hx => (hd x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt, ?_⟩
    intro x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrS⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hS x₀ hx₀
    have hcont : ∀ m : Fin 2, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ y, dist y x₀ < δ →
        |smthGrad u y m| ≤ |smthGrad u x₀ m| + 1 := by
      intro m
      have hc : ContinuousAt (fun x => smthGrad u x m) x₀ :=
        (hpar m).1.continuousAt (hS.mem_nhds hx₀)
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, h⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hc 1 one_pos
      refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun y hy => ?_⟩
      have h1 := h hy
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at h1
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (smthGrad u y m) (smthGrad u x₀ m)
      linarith
    obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, h₀⟩ := hcont 0
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h₁⟩ := hcont 1
    obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = (|smthGrad u x₀ 0| + 1) + (|smthGrad u x₀ 1| + 1) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by rw [hBdef]; positivity
    have hρ : 0 < min r (min δ₀ δ₁) := lt_min hr (lt_min hδ₀ hδ₁)
    have hball : Metric.ball x₀ (min r (min δ₀ δ₁)) ⊆ S :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hrS
    have hbound : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (min r (min δ₀ δ₁)), ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖ ≤ B := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hy
      have hy0 : dist y x₀ < δ₀ :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hy ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
      have hy1 : dist y x₀ < δ₁ :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hy ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
      have b0 := h₀ y hy0
      have b1 := h₁ y hy1
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hB0 (fun h => ?_)
      have hdec : h = h 0 • (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) + h 1 • (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) := by
        funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
      have hlin : fderiv ℝ u y h = h 0 * smthGrad u y 0 + h 1 * smthGrad u y 1 := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hdec]
        simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smthGrad]
      have hh0 : |h 0| ≤ ‖h‖ := by
        have := norm_le_pi_norm h 0
        rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      have hh1 : |h 1| ≤ ‖h‖ := by
        have := norm_le_pi_norm h 1
        rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hlin]
      calc |h 0 * smthGrad u y 0 + h 1 * smthGrad u y 1|
          ≤ |h 0 * smthGrad u y 0| + |h 1 * smthGrad u y 1| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |h 0| * |smthGrad u y 0| + |h 1| * |smthGrad u y 1| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ ‖h‖ * (|smthGrad u x₀ 0| + 1) + ‖h‖ * (|smthGrad u x₀ 1| + 1) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul hh0 b0 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
              (mul_le_mul hh1 b1 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
        _ = B * ‖h‖ := by rw [hBdef]; ring
    have hlip : LipschitzOnWith ⟨B, hB0⟩ u (Metric.ball x₀ (min r (min δ₀ δ₁))) := by
      refine Convex.lipschitzOnWith_of_nnnorm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ)
        (fun y hy => hd y (hball hy)) (fun y hy => ?_) (convex_ball _ _)
      rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, coe_nnnorm]
      exact hbound y hy
    exact ⟨min r (min δ₀ δ₁), ⟨B, hB0⟩, 1, hρ, one_pos, hball, hlip.holderOnWith⟩

informal_problem.statement: (k : ℕ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) : (∀ T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ), IsOpen T → T ⊆ S → smthHolC k u S → smthHolC k u T) ∧ ((∀ x ∈ S, ∃ T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ), IsOpen T ∧ x ∈ T ∧ T ⊆ S ∧ smthHolC k u T) → smthHolC k u S)

signature.name: smth_holC_local
signature.statement: (k : ℕ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) : (∀ T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ), IsOpen T → T ⊆ S → smthHolC k u S → smthHolC k u T) ∧ ((∀ x ∈ S, ∃ T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ), IsOpen T ∧ x ∈ T ∧ T ⊆ S ∧ smthHolC k u T) → smthHolC k u S)

proof.tactics:
by
  induction k generalizing u with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro T hT hTS hu
      simp only [smthHolC] at hu ⊢
      obtain ⟨hc, hh⟩ := hu
      refine ⟨hc.mono hTS, ?_⟩
      intro x₀ hx₀
      obtain ⟨ρ, C, α, hρ, hα, hball, hH⟩ := hh x₀ (hTS hx₀)
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεT⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hT x₀ hx₀
      exact ⟨min ρ ε, C, α, lt_min hρ hε, hα,
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right ρ ε)).trans hεT,
        hH.mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left ρ ε))⟩
    · intro hloc
      simp only [smthHolC] at hloc ⊢
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        obtain ⟨T, hT, hxT, hTS, hcT, _⟩ := hloc x hx
        exact (hcT.continuousAt (hT.mem_nhds hxT)).continuousWithinAt
      · intro x₀ hx₀
        obtain ⟨T, hT, hxT, hTS, _, hhT⟩ := hloc x₀ hx₀
        obtain ⟨ρ, C, α, hρ, hα, hball, hH⟩ := hhT x₀ hxT
        exact ⟨ρ, C, α, hρ, hα, hball.trans hTS, hH⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro T hT hTS hu
      simp only [smthHolC] at hu ⊢
      obtain ⟨hd, hg⟩ := hu
      exact ⟨fun x hx => hd x (hTS hx),
        fun m => (ih (fun x => smthGrad u x m)).1 T hT hTS (hg m)⟩
    · intro hloc
      simp only [smthHolC] at hloc ⊢
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        obtain ⟨T, _, hxT, _, hdT, _⟩ := hloc x hx
        exact hdT x hxT
      · intro m
        refine (ih (fun x => smthGrad u x m)).2 ?_
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨T, hT, hxT, hTS, _, hgT⟩ := hloc x hx
        exact ⟨T, hT, hxT, hTS, hgT m⟩

informal_problem.statement: (k : ℕ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (hu : smthHolC k u S) : ContDiffOn ℝ k u S

signature.name: smth_holC_contDiffOn
signature.statement: (k : ℕ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (hu : smthHolC k u S) : ContDiffOn ℝ k u S

proof.tactics:
by
  induction k generalizing u with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : ContinuousOn u S := hu.1
    simpa using (contDiffOn_zero (𝕜 := ℝ)).mpr h0
  | succ k ih =>
    have hd : ∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ u x := hu.1
    have hpar : ∀ m : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun x => smthGrad u x m) S :=
      fun m => ih _ (hu.2 m)
    have hlin : ∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        fderiv ℝ u x y = y 0 * smthGrad u x 0 + y 1 * smthGrad u x 1 := by
      intro x y
      have hy : y = y 0 • (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) + y 1 • (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) := by
        funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
      conv_lhs => rw [hy]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smthGrad]
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fderiv ℝ u) S := by
      refine contDiffOn_clm_apply.mpr ?_
      intro y
      refine ContDiffOn.congr (f := fun x => y 0 * smthGrad u x 0 + y 1 * smthGrad u x 1)
        ((contDiffOn_const.mul (hpar 0)).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hpar 1))) ?_
      intro x _
      exact hlin x y
    have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ u S := fun x hx => (hd x hx).differentiableWithinAt
    rw [Nat.cast_succ]
    exact (contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hS).mpr
      ⟨hdiff, fun h => absurd h (WithTop.natCast_ne_top k), hfd⟩

informal_problem.statement: (k : ℕ) (u w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (c : ℝ) (hu : smthHolC k u S) (hw : smthHolC k w S) : smthHolC k (fun _ => c) S ∧ smthHolC k (fun x => u x + w x) S ∧ smthHolC k (fun x => u x * w x) S

signature.name: smth_holC_algebra
signature.statement: (k : ℕ) (u w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (c : ℝ) (hu : smthHolC k u S) (hw : smthHolC k w S) : smthHolC k (fun _ => c) S ∧ smthHolC k (fun x => u x + w x) S ∧ smthHolC k (fun x => u x * w x) S

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hcongr : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ S, f x = g x) →
      smthHolC n f S → smthHolC n g S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro f g hfg hf
      refine ⟨hf.1.congr (fun x hx => (hfg x hx).symm), fun x₀ hx₀ => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨ρ, C, α, hρ, hα, hsub, hH⟩ := hf.2 x₀ hx₀
      refine ⟨ρ, C, α, hρ, hα, hsub, ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      rw [← hfg x (hsub hx), ← hfg y (hsub hy)]
      exact hH x hx y hy
    | succ n ih =>
      intro f g hfg hf
      have hev : ∀ x ∈ S, f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g := fun x hx =>
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hS.mem_nhds hx) hfg
      refine ⟨fun x hx => (hf.1 x hx).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hev x hx).symm, fun m => ?_⟩
      refine ih _ _ (fun x hx => ?_) (hf.2 m)
      simp only [smthGrad]
      rw [(hev x hx).fderiv_eq]
  
  have hconst : ∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ), smthHolC n (fun _ => c) S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro c
      refine ⟨continuousOn_const, fun x₀ hx₀ => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hS x₀ hx₀
      refine ⟨ε, 0, 1, hε, one_pos, hball, ?_⟩
      intro x _ y _
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro c
      refine ⟨fun x _ => differentiableAt_const c, fun m => ?_⟩
      have h0 : (fun x => smthGrad (fun _ => c) x m) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        funext x
        simp [smthGrad]
      rw [h0]
      exact ih 0
  
  have hgrad : ∀ (f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (m : Fin 2),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      smthGrad (fun y => f y + g y) x m = smthGrad f x m + smthGrad g x m ∧
      smthGrad (fun y => f y * g y) x m = smthGrad f x m * g x + f x * smthGrad g x m := by
    intro f g x m hf hg
    simp only [smthGrad]
    constructor
    · rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    · rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
  
  have mk : ∀ (h : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (A : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (K : ℝ) (β : NNReal), 0 ≤ K →
      (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ A, |h x - h y| ≤ K * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ)) →
      HolderOnWith (Real.toNNReal K) β h A := by
    intro h A K β hK hb
    intro x hx y hy
    calc edist (h x) (h y) = ENNReal.ofReal |h x - h y| := by rw [edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ)) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hb x hx y hy)
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal K * ENNReal.ofReal (dist x y ^ (β : ℝ)) := ENNReal.ofReal_mul hK
      _ = ((Real.toNNReal K : NNReal) : ENNReal) * edist x y ^ (β : ℝ) := by
        rw [edist_dist, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y))
          (NNReal.coe_nonneg β)]
        rfl
  
  have hbase : ∀ f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, smthHolC 0 f S → smthHolC 0 g S →
      smthHolC 0 (fun x => f x + g x) S ∧ smthHolC 0 (fun x => f x * g x) S := by
    intro f g hf hg
    have loc : ∀ x₀ ∈ S, ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (C₁ C₂ β : NNReal), 0 < ρ ∧ 0 < β ∧
        Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ S ∧
        ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ,
          |f x - f y| ≤ C₁ * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) ∧ |g x - g y| ≤ C₂ * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) ∧
          dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      intro x₀ hx₀
      obtain ⟨ρ₁, C₁, α₁, hρ₁, hα₁, hsub₁, hH₁⟩ := hf.2 x₀ hx₀
      obtain ⟨ρ₂, C₂, α₂, hρ₂, hα₂, hsub₂, hH₂⟩ := hg.2 x₀ hx₀
      have hρ : 0 < min (min ρ₁ ρ₂) (1 / 2) := lt_min (lt_min hρ₁ hρ₂) (by norm_num)
      have hB1 : Metric.ball x₀ (min (min ρ₁ ρ₂) (1 / 2)) ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρ₁ :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
      have hB2 : Metric.ball x₀ (min (min ρ₁ ρ₂) (1 / 2)) ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρ₂ :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
      have hdist : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (min (min ρ₁ ρ₂) (1 / 2)),
          ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (min (min ρ₁ ρ₂) (1 / 2)), dist x y ≤ 1 := by
        intro x hx y hy
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx hy
        have h1 := dist_triangle x x₀ y
        rw [dist_comm x₀ y] at h1
        have : min (min ρ₁ ρ₂) (1 / 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
        linarith
      have hD : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (min (min ρ₁ ρ₂) (1 / 2)),
          ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (min (min ρ₁ ρ₂) (1 / 2)), edist x y ≤ ((1 : NNReal) : ENNReal) := by
        intro x hx y hy
        rw [edist_dist, ENNReal.coe_one]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_one.mpr (hdist x hx y hy)
      have hH₁' := HolderOnWith.of_le hD (hH₁.mono hB1) (min_le_left α₁ α₂)
      have hH₂' := HolderOnWith.of_le hD (hH₂.mono hB2) (min_le_right α₁ α₂)
      obtain ⟨C₁', hH₁''⟩ : ∃ C : NNReal, HolderOnWith C (min α₁ α₂) f
          (Metric.ball x₀ (min (min ρ₁ ρ₂) (1 / 2))) := ⟨_, hH₁'⟩
      obtain ⟨C₂', hH₂''⟩ : ∃ C : NNReal, HolderOnWith C (min α₁ α₂) g
          (Metric.ball x₀ (min (min ρ₁ ρ₂) (1 / 2))) := ⟨_, hH₂'⟩
      refine ⟨min (min ρ₁ ρ₂) (1 / 2), C₁', C₂', min α₁ α₂, hρ, lt_min hα₁ hα₂, hB1.trans hsub₁,
        fun x hx y hy => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [← Real.dist_eq]; exact hH₁''.dist_le hx hy
      · rw [← Real.dist_eq]; exact hH₂''.dist_le hx hy
      · exact Real.rpow_le_one dist_nonneg (hdist x hx y hy) (NNReal.coe_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨⟨hf.1.add hg.1, fun x₀ hx₀ => ?_⟩, ⟨hf.1.mul hg.1, fun x₀ hx₀ => ?_⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨ρ, C₁, C₂, β, hρ, hβ, hsub, hb⟩ := loc x₀ hx₀
      refine ⟨ρ, _, β, hρ, hβ, hsub, mk _ _ ((C₁ : ℝ) + C₂) β (by positivity) ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      show |(f x + g x) - (f y + g y)| ≤ _
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := hb x hx y hy
      have e : (f x + g x) - (f y + g y) = (f x - f y) + (g x - g y) := by ring
      rw [e]
      calc |(f x - f y) + (g x - g y)| ≤ |f x - f y| + |g x - g y| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ C₁ * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) + C₂ * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) := add_le_add h1 h2
        _ = ((C₁ : ℝ) + C₂) * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) := by ring
    · obtain ⟨ρ, C₁, C₂, β, hρ, hβ, hsub, hb⟩ := loc x₀ hx₀
      have hx₀B : x₀ ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ := Metric.mem_ball_self hρ
      have bf : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, |f z| ≤ |f x₀| + C₁ := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨h1, -, h3⟩ := hb z hz x₀ hx₀B
        have h4 : |f z - f x₀| ≤ C₁ :=
          le_trans h1 (mul_le_of_le_one_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) h3)
        have h5 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (f z) (f x₀)
        linarith
      have bg : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, |g z| ≤ |g x₀| + C₂ := by
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨-, h2, h3⟩ := hb z hz x₀ hx₀B
        have h4 : |g z - g x₀| ≤ C₂ :=
          le_trans h2 (mul_le_of_le_one_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) h3)
        have h5 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (g z) (g x₀)
        linarith
      refine ⟨ρ, _, β, hρ, hβ, hsub,
        mk _ _ ((C₁ : ℝ) * (|g x₀| + C₂) + (|f x₀| + C₁) * C₂) β (by positivity) ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      show |f x * g x - f y * g y| ≤ _
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, -⟩ := hb x hx y hy
      have hδ : 0 ≤ dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg _
      have bgx := bg x hx
      have bfy := bf y hy
      have e : f x * g x - f y * g y = (f x - f y) * g x + f y * (g x - g y) := by ring
      rw [e]
      calc |(f x - f y) * g x + f y * (g x - g y)|
          ≤ |(f x - f y) * g x| + |f y * (g x - g y)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |f x - f y| * |g x| + |f y| * |g x - g y| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ ((C₁ : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ)) * (|g x₀| + C₂) +
              (|f x₀| + C₁) * ((C₂ : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ)) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul h1 bgx (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
              (mul_le_mul bfy h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
        _ = ((C₁ : ℝ) * (|g x₀| + C₂) + (|f x₀| + C₁) * C₂) * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) := by ring
  
  have hmono : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), smthHolC (n + 1) f S → smthHolC n f S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro f hf
      obtain ⟨hd, hg⟩ := hf
      refine ⟨fun x hx => (hd x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt, fun x₀ hx₀ => ?_⟩
      have hev : ∀ m : Fin 2, ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, |smthGrad f x m| ≤ |smthGrad f x₀ m| + 1 := by
        intro m
        have hc : ContinuousAt (fun x => smthGrad f x m) x₀ :=
          (hg m).1.continuousAt (hS.mem_nhds hx₀)
        filter_upwards [hc.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ one_pos)] with x hx
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at hx
        have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (smthGrad f x m) (smthGrad f x₀ m)
        linarith
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hball⟩ :=
        Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp ((hev 0).and ((hev 1).and (hS.mem_nhds hx₀)))
      have hB0 : 0 ≤ (|smthGrad f x₀ 0| + 1) + (|smthGrad f x₀ 1| + 1) := by positivity
      have hnorm : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ,
          ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ (|smthGrad f x₀ 0| + 1) + (|smthGrad f x₀ 1| + 1) := by
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨h0, h1, -⟩ := hball x hx
        refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hB0 (fun v => ?_)
        have hv : v = v 0 • (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) + v 1 • (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) := by
          funext i
          fin_cases i <;> simp
        have hval : fderiv ℝ f x v = v 0 * smthGrad f x 0 + v 1 * smthGrad f x 1 := by
          conv_lhs => rw [hv]
          rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
          rfl
        have hv0 : |v 0| ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm v 0
        have hv1 : |v 1| ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm v 1
        rw [hval, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        calc |v 0 * smthGrad f x 0 + v 1 * smthGrad f x 1|
            ≤ |v 0 * smthGrad f x 0| + |v 1 * smthGrad f x 1| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |v 0| * |smthGrad f x 0| + |v 1| * |smthGrad f x 1| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          _ ≤ ‖v‖ * (|smthGrad f x₀ 0| + 1) + ‖v‖ * (|smthGrad f x₀ 1| + 1) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul hv0 h0 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
              (mul_le_mul hv1 h1 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
          _ = ((|smthGrad f x₀ 0| + 1) + (|smthGrad f x₀ 1| + 1)) * ‖v‖ := by ring
      have hlip : LipschitzOnWith (Real.toNNReal ((|smthGrad f x₀ 0| + 1) + (|smthGrad f x₀ 1| + 1)))
          f (Metric.ball x₀ ρ) := by
        refine Convex.lipschitzOnWith_of_nnnorm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ)
          (fun x hx => hd x (hball x hx).2.2) (fun x hx => ?_) (convex_ball x₀ ρ)
        rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, coe_nnnorm, Real.coe_toNNReal _ hB0]
        exact hnorm x hx
      exact ⟨ρ, _, 1, hρ, one_pos, fun x hx => (hball x hx).2.2, hlip.holderOnWith⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro f hf
      exact ⟨hf.1, fun m => ih _ (hf.2 m)⟩
  
  have hP : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, smthHolC n f S → smthHolC n g S →
      smthHolC n (fun x => f x + g x) S ∧ smthHolC n (fun x => f x * g x) S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact hbase
    | succ n ih =>
      intro f g hf hg
      have hf' := hmono n f hf
      have hg' := hmono n g hg
      refine ⟨⟨fun x hx => (hf.1 x hx).fun_add (hg.1 x hx), fun m => ?_⟩,
        ⟨fun x hx => (hf.1 x hx).fun_mul (hg.1 x hx), fun m => ?_⟩⟩
      · refine hcongr n (fun x => smthGrad f x m + smthGrad g x m) _
          (fun x hx => ((hgrad f g x m (hf.1 x hx) (hg.1 x hx)).1).symm) ?_
        exact (ih _ _ (hf.2 m) (hg.2 m)).1
      · refine hcongr n (fun x => smthGrad f x m * g x + f x * smthGrad g x m) _
          (fun x hx => ((hgrad f g x m (hf.1 x hx) (hg.1 x hx)).2).symm) ?_
        exact (ih _ _ (ih _ _ (hf.2 m) hg').2 (ih _ _ hf' (hg.2 m)).2).1
  exact ⟨hconst k c, (hP k u w hu hw).1, (hP k u w hu hw).2⟩

informal_problem.statement: (Ψ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ O) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hv : smthHolC (k + 1) v S) (hvO : ∀ x ∈ S, (x, v x, smthGrad v x) ∈ O) : smthHolC k (fun x => Ψ (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) S

signature.name: smth_holC_comp
signature.statement: (Ψ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ O) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hv : smthHolC (k + 1) v S) (hvO : ∀ x ∈ S, (x, v x, smthGrad v x) ∈ O) : smthHolC k (fun x => Ψ (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) S

proof.tactics:
by
  have hinf0 : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  
  have congr : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ S, f x = g x) →
      smthHolC n f S → smthHolC n g S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro f g hfg hf
      refine ⟨hf.1.congr (fun x hx => (hfg x hx).symm), ?_⟩
      intro x₀ hx₀
      obtain ⟨ρ, C, α, hρ, hα, hsub, hH⟩ := hf.2 x₀ hx₀
      refine ⟨ρ, C, α, hρ, hα, hsub, ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      rw [← hfg x (hsub hx), ← hfg y (hsub hy)]
      exact hH x hx y hy
    | succ n ih =>
      intro f g hfg hf
      have hev : ∀ x ∈ S, g =ᶠ[nhds x] f := fun x hx =>
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hS.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => (hfg y hy).symm)
      refine ⟨fun x hx => (hf.1 x hx).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hev x hx), fun m => ?_⟩
      refine ih _ _ (fun x hx => ?_) (hf.2 m)
      simp only [smthGrad]
      rw [(hev x hx).fderiv_eq]
  
  have base : ∀ Ψ' : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ' O →
      smthHolC 1 v S → smthHolC 0 (fun x => Ψ' (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) S := by
    intro Ψ' hΨ' hv1
    have hXat : ∀ x ∈ S, ContinuousAt (fun y => (y, v y, smthGrad v y)) x := by
      intro x hx
      refine continuousAt_id.prodMk ((hv1.1 x hx).continuousAt.prodMk ?_)
      exact continuousAt_pi.2 fun j => (hv1.2 j).1.continuousAt (hS.mem_nhds hx)
    refine ⟨hΨ'.continuousOn.comp (fun x hx => (hXat x hx).continuousWithinAt)
      (fun x hx => hvO x hx), ?_⟩
    intro x₀ hx₀
    have h0 : smthHolC 0 v S := smth_holC_mono 0 v S hS hv1
    obtain ⟨ρv, Cv, αv, hρv, hαv, hsubv, hHv⟩ := h0.2 x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨ρ0, C0, α0, hρ0, hα0, hsub0, hH0⟩ := (hv1.2 0).2 x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨ρ1, C1, α1, hρ1, hα1, hsub1, hH1⟩ := (hv1.2 1).2 x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεO⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hO _ (hvO x₀ hx₀)
    have hKO : Metric.closedBall ((x₀, v x₀, smthGrad v x₀) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
        (ε / 2) ⊆ O :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hε)).trans hεO
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := (hΨ'.mono hKO).exists_lipschitzOnWith hinf0 (convex_closedBall _ _)
      (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδX⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.1 (hXat x₀ hx₀) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    set ρ : ℝ := min (min (min ρv ρ0) (min ρ1 δ)) (1 / 2) with hρdef
    have hρ : 0 < ρ := lt_min (lt_min (lt_min hρv hρ0) (lt_min hρ1 hδ)) (by norm_num)
    have hρv' : ρ ≤ ρv := (min_le_left _ _).trans ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
    have hρ0' : ρ ≤ ρ0 := (min_le_left _ _).trans ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
    have hρ1' : ρ ≤ ρ1 := (min_le_left _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
    have hρδ : ρ ≤ δ := (min_le_left _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
    have hρh : ρ ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
    have hBv : Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρv := Metric.ball_subset_ball hρv'
    have hB0 : Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρ0 := Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ0'
    have hB1 : Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρ1 := Metric.ball_subset_ball hρ1'
    set β : NNReal := min (min αv α0) (min α1 1) with hβdef
    have hβ : 0 < β := lt_min (lt_min hαv hα0) (lt_min hα1 one_pos)
    have hβv : β ≤ αv := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have hβ0 : β ≤ α0 := (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have hβ1 : β ≤ α1 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have hβone : β ≤ 1 := (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
    set Cm : NNReal := max (max 1 Cv) (max C0 C1) with hCmdef
    have hCm1 : (1 : NNReal) ≤ Cm := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have hCmv : Cv ≤ Cm := (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have hCm0 : C0 ≤ Cm := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    have hCm1' : C1 ≤ Cm := (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    have hd : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, edist x y ≤ 1 := by
      intro x hx y hy
      rw [edist_dist]
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_one.2
      have h1 := Metric.mem_ball.1 hx
      have h2 := Metric.mem_ball.1 hy
      have h3 := dist_triangle_right x y x₀
      linarith
    have hpow : ∀ (d : ENNReal) (a C : NNReal), d ≤ 1 → β ≤ a → C ≤ Cm →
        (C : ENNReal) * d ^ (a : ℝ) ≤ (Cm : ENNReal) * d ^ (β : ℝ) := by
      intro d a C hd1 hβa hC
      calc (C : ENNReal) * d ^ (a : ℝ) ≤ (C : ENNReal) * d ^ (β : ℝ) :=
            mul_le_mul_left' (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hd1 (by exact_mod_cast hβa)) _
        _ ≤ (Cm : ENNReal) * d ^ (β : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_right' (by exact_mod_cast hC) _
    have hXH : HolderOnWith Cm β (fun x => (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) (Metric.ball x₀ ρ) := by
      intro x hx y hy
      have hd1 := hd x hx y hy
      simp only [Prod.edist_eq]
      refine max_le ?_ (max_le ?_ ?_)
      · calc edist x y = ((1 : NNReal) : ENNReal) * edist x y ^ ((1 : NNReal) : ℝ) := by simp
          _ ≤ _ := hpow _ 1 1 hd1 hβone hCm1
      · exact (hHv x (hBv hx) y (hBv hy)).trans (hpow _ _ _ hd1 hβv hCmv)
      · refine edist_pi_le_iff.2 (fun j => ?_)
        fin_cases j
        · exact (hH0 x (hB0 hx) y (hB0 hy)).trans (hpow _ _ _ hd1 hβ0 hCm0)
        · exact (hH1 x (hB1 hx) y (hB1 hy)).trans (hpow _ _ _ hd1 hβ1 hCm1')
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun x => (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) (Metric.ball x₀ ρ)
        (Metric.closedBall (x₀, v x₀, smthGrad v x₀) (ε / 2)) := by
      intro x hx
      exact Metric.mem_closedBall.2
        (le_of_lt (hδX (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.1 hx) hρδ)))
    have hcomp := hL.holderOnWith.comp hXH hmaps
    refine ⟨ρ, _, _, hρ, ?_, hBv.trans hsubv, hcomp⟩
    rw [one_mul]
    exact hβ
  
  have H : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ Ψ' : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ' O →
      smthHolC (n + 1) v S → smthHolC n (fun x => Ψ' (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact base
    | succ n ih =>
      intro Ψ' hΨ' hv2
      have hv' : smthHolC (n + 1) v S := smth_holC_mono (n + 1) v S hS hv2
      have hΨ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Ψ') O := hΨ'.fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl
      have IH : ∀ c : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ),
          smthHolC n (fun x => fderiv ℝ Ψ' (x, v x, smthGrad v x) c) S :=
        fun c => ih _ (hΨ1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const) hv'
      have hgm : ∀ m : Fin 2, smthHolC n (fun x => smthGrad v x m) S :=
        fun m => smth_holC_mono n _ S hS (hv2.2 m)
      have hjm : ∀ j m : Fin 2,
          smthHolC n (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad v y j) x m) S :=
        fun j m => (hv2.2 j).2 m
      have hdec : ∀ (a : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (p : Fin 2 → ℝ),
          ((a, t, p) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) =
            (a, (0 : ℝ), (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) + t • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) +
              (p 0 • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) +
                p 1 • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ))) := by
        intro a t p
        refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)
        · funext i; simp
        · simp
        · funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
      
      have chain : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ m : Fin 2,
          DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Ψ' (y, v y, smthGrad v y)) x ∧
          smthGrad (fun y => Ψ' (y, v y, smthGrad v y)) x m =
            fderiv ℝ Ψ' (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (Pi.single m 1, 0, 0) +
            smthGrad v x m * fderiv ℝ Ψ' (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, 1, 0) +
            (smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad v y 0) x m *
                fderiv ℝ Ψ' (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, 0, Pi.single 0 1) +
              smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad v y 1) x m *
                fderiv ℝ Ψ' (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, 0, Pi.single 1 1)) := by
        intro x hx m
        have hdΨ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ' (x, v x, smthGrad v x) :=
          (hΨ'.differentiableOn hinf0).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds (hvO x hx))
        have hXd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (y, v y, smthGrad v y))
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ)).prod ((fderiv ℝ v x).prod
              (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun j => fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad v y j) x))) x := by
          refine (hasFDerivAt_id x).prodMk ((hv2.1 x hx).hasFDerivAt.prodMk ?_)
          exact (hasFDerivAt_pi (φ := fun j y => smthGrad v y j)).2
            fun j => ((hv2.2 j).1 x hx).hasFDerivAt
        have hg := hdΨ.hasFDerivAt.comp x hXd
        refine ⟨hg.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
        show fderiv ℝ (Ψ' ∘ (fun y => (y, v y, smthGrad v y))) x (Pi.single m 1) = _
        rw [hg.fderiv]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.pi_apply]
        rw [hdec (Pi.single m 1) _ _]
        simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
        simp only [smthGrad]
        rfl
      refine ⟨fun x hx => (chain x hx 0).1, fun m => ?_⟩
      have T2 := (smth_holC_algebra n _ _ S hS 0 (hgm m) (IH (0, 1, 0))).2.2
      have T30 := (smth_holC_algebra n _ _ S hS 0 (hjm 0 m) (IH (0, 0, Pi.single 0 1))).2.2
      have T31 := (smth_holC_algebra n _ _ S hS 0 (hjm 1 m) (IH (0, 0, Pi.single 1 1))).2.2
      have T12 := (smth_holC_algebra n _ _ S hS 0 (IH (Pi.single m 1, 0, 0)) T2).2.1
      have T3 := (smth_holC_algebra n _ _ S hS 0 T30 T31).2.1
      have T := (smth_holC_algebra n _ _ S hS 0 T12 T3).2.1
      refine congr n _ _ (fun x hx => ?_) T
      beta_reduce
      rw [(chain x hx m).2]
  exact H k Ψ hΨ hv

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hdec : ∀ (L : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℝ),
      L v = ∑ j : Fin 2, v j * L (Pi.single j 1) := by
    intro L v
    have hv : v = v 0 • (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) + v 1 • (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) := by
      funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  
  have taylor : ∀ (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (B : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)), Convex ℝ B →
      (∀ x ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) → HolderOnWith M α (smthGrad f) B →
      ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ z ∈ B, |f z - f x - ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad f x j * (z - x) j| ≤
        2 * (M : ℝ) * ‖z - x‖ ^ (α : ℝ) * ‖z - x‖ := by
    intro f B hB hf hH x hx z hz
    set ρ := ‖z - x‖ with hρ
    have hS : Convex ℝ (B ∩ closedBall x ρ) := hB.inter (convex_closedBall x ρ)
    have hxS : x ∈ B ∩ closedBall x ρ := ⟨hx, mem_closedBall_self (norm_nonneg _)⟩
    have hzS : z ∈ B ∩ closedBall x ρ := ⟨hz, by rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]⟩
    have hbound : ∀ p ∈ B ∩ closedBall x ρ,
        ‖fderiv ℝ f p - fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ 2 * (M : ℝ) * ρ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
      intro p hp
      have hc : dist (smthGrad f p) (smthGrad f x) ≤ M * dist p x ^ (α : ℝ) := hH.dist_le hp.1 hx
      have hpx : dist p x ≤ ρ := hp.2
      have hpow : dist p x ^ (α : ℝ) ≤ ρ ^ (α : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow dist_nonneg hpx α.2
      have hc' : ‖smthGrad f p - smthGrad f x‖ ≤ M * ρ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
        rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hc.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow M.2)
      have hρα : 0 ≤ ρ ^ (α : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) ?_
      intro v
      rw [hdec, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hj : ∀ j, (fderiv ℝ f p - fderiv ℝ f x) (Pi.single j 1) =
          (smthGrad f p - smthGrad f x) j := by
        intro j; simp [smthGrad]
      simp only [hj, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      set c := smthGrad f p - smthGrad f x
      have h0 : |v 0| ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm v 0
      have h1 : |v 1| ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm v 1
      have k0 : |c 0| ≤ ‖c‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm c 0
      have k1 : |c 1| ≤ ‖c‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm c 1
      calc |v 0 * c 0 + v 1 * c 1| ≤ |v 0 * c 0| + |v 1 * c 1| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |v 0| * |c 0| + |v 1| * |c 1| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ ‖v‖ * ‖c‖ + ‖v‖ * ‖c‖ :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul h0 k0 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
              (mul_le_mul h1 k1 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
        _ = 2 * ‖c‖ * ‖v‖ := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * (M * ρ ^ (α : ℝ)) * ‖v‖ := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (norm_nonneg _)
            linarith
        _ = 2 * (M : ℝ) * ρ ^ (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ := by ring
    have hmvt := hS.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le' (fun p hp => hf p hp.1) hbound hxS hzS
    have hsum : ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad f x j * (z - x) j = fderiv ℝ f x (z - x) := by
      rw [hdec (fderiv ℝ f x) (z - x)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      simp only [smthGrad]; ring
    rw [hsum, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hmvt
  
  have tlim : ∀ (B : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)), IsOpen B → ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ (f : ℕ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
      (a : ℕ → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : Fin 2 → ℝ) (C β : ℝ), 0 < β →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ B, |f n z - f n x - ∑ j : Fin 2, a n j * (z - x) j| ≤
        C * ‖z - x‖ ^ β * ‖z - x‖) →
      (∀ z ∈ B, Tendsto (fun n => f n z) atTop (𝓝 (w z))) →
      Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 L) → DifferentiableAt ℝ w x ∧ smthGrad w x = L := by
    intro B hB x hx f a w L C β hβ hT hf ha
    have hTinf : ∀ z ∈ B, |w z - w x - ∑ j : Fin 2, L j * (z - x) j| ≤
        C * ‖z - x‖ ^ β * ‖z - x‖ := by
      intro z hz
      have hcoord : ∀ j : Fin 2, Tendsto (fun n => a n j) atTop (𝓝 (L j)) :=
        fun j => tendsto_pi_nhds.1 ha j
      have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => |f n z - f n x - ∑ j : Fin 2, a n j * (z - x) j|) atTop
          (𝓝 |w z - w x - ∑ j : Fin 2, L j * (z - x) j|) := by
        refine (((hf z hz).sub (hf x hx)).sub ?_).abs
        exact tendsto_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => (hcoord j).mul_const _)
      exact le_of_tendsto' hlim (fun n => hT n z hz)
    set ℓ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
      L 0 • ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) 0 +
      L 1 • ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) 1 with hℓdef
    have hℓ : ∀ v : Fin 2 → ℝ, ℓ v = ∑ j : Fin 2, L j * v j := by
      intro v
      simp [hℓdef, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hD : HasFDerivAt w ℓ x := by
      rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
      intro c hc
      have h1 : ∀ᶠ k in 𝓝 (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), x + k ∈ B := by
        have hcont : Tendsto (fun k : Fin 2 → ℝ => x + k) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 x) := by
          have := (continuous_const.add continuous_id : Continuous fun k : Fin 2 → ℝ => x + k).tendsto 0
          simpa using this
        exact hcont (hB.mem_nhds hx)
      have h2 : ∀ᶠ k in 𝓝 (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), C * ‖k‖ ^ β < c := by
        have hcont : Tendsto (fun k : Fin 2 → ℝ => C * ‖k‖ ^ β) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (C * ‖(0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)‖ ^ β)) := by
          refine Tendsto.const_mul C ?_
          exact ((Real.continuousAt_rpow_const _ β (Or.inr hβ.le)).tendsto).comp
            (continuous_norm.tendsto 0)
        rw [norm_zero, Real.zero_rpow hβ.ne', mul_zero] at hcont
        exact hcont.eventually_lt_const hc
      filter_upwards [h1, h2] with k hk1 hk2
      have h := hTinf (x + k) hk1
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_left] at h
      rw [hℓ, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc |w (x + k) - w x - ∑ j : Fin 2, L j * k j| ≤ C * ‖k‖ ^ β * ‖k‖ := h
        _ ≤ c * ‖k‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk2.le (norm_nonneg _)
    refine ⟨hD.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    funext j
    simp only [smthGrad, hD.fderiv, hℓ]
    fin_cases j <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  
  have c1 : ∀ (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (B : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)), IsOpen B →
      (∀ x ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ w x) → HolderOnWith M α (smthGrad w) B →
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w B := by
    intro w B hB hd hH
    have hgc : ContinuousOn (smthGrad w) B := hH.continuousOn hα
    have hfc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ w) B := by
      rw [continuousOn_clm_apply]
      intro v
      have e1 : (fun x => fderiv ℝ w x v) = fun x => ∑ j : Fin 2, v j * smthGrad w x j := by
        funext x; rw [hdec]; rfl
      rw [e1]
      refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_)
      exact continuousOn_const.mul ((continuous_apply j).comp_continuousOn hgc)
    have : ContDiffOn ℝ (0 + 1) w B := by
      rw [contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hB]
      refine ⟨fun x hx => (hd x hx).differentiableWithinAt, by simp, ?_⟩
      exact contDiffOn_zero.2 hfc
    simpa using this
  
  have hbig : ∀ z ∈ ball y (r + h₀), DifferentiableAt ℝ u z := fun z hz =>
    ((hu.differentiableOn (by norm_num)) z hz).differentiableAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)
  set e₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ := Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) with he₀
  have hnorm_e : ‖e₀‖ = 1 := by rw [he₀, Pi.norm_single, norm_one]
  
  have dqd : ∀ h : ℝ, |h| < h₀ → ∀ x ∈ ball y r, DifferentiableAt ℝ (smthDQ u m h) x := by
    intro h hh x hx
    have hx1 : x ∈ ball y (r + h₀) := ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hx
    have hx2 : x + h • e₀ ∈ ball y (r + h₀) := by
      rw [mem_ball] at hx ⊢
      calc dist (x + h • e₀) y ≤ dist (x + h • e₀) x + dist x y := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ = ‖h • e₀‖ + dist x y := by rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
        _ < h₀ + r := by rw [norm_smul, hnorm_e, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]; linarith
        _ = r + h₀ := by ring
    have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => u (z + h • e₀)) x :=

      (hc.sub (hbig x hx1)).mul_const _
    have e2 : smthDQ u m h = fun z => (u (z + h • e₀) - u z) * h⁻¹ := by
      funext z; simp only [smthDQ, he₀, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [e2]; exact hc2
  
  have dqlim : ∀ x, DifferentiableAt ℝ u x → ∀ s : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n, s n ≠ 0) →
      Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 0) →
      Tendsto (fun n => smthDQ u m (s n) x) atTop (𝓝 (smthGrad u x m)) := by
    intro x hux s hs0 hs
    have hline : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • e₀) e₀ 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const e₀).const_add x
    have hu' : HasFDerivAt u (fderiv ℝ u x) (x + (0 : ℝ) • e₀) := by
      rw [zero_smul, add_zero]; exact hux.hasFDerivAt
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => u (x + t • e₀)) (fderiv ℝ u x e₀) 0 :=
      hu'.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hline
    have hsl := hγ.tendsto_slope_zero
    have hs' : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝[≠] 0) :=
      tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.2 ⟨hs, Eventually.of_forall hs0⟩
    have h3 := hsl.comp hs'
    have e3 : smthGrad u x m = fderiv ℝ u x e₀ := rfl
    rw [e3]
    refine h3.congr (fun n => ?_)
    simp only [Function.comp, zero_add, zero_smul, add_zero, smul_eq_mul, smthDQ, he₀]
    rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
  
  set B := ball y r with hBdef
  set w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => smthGrad u x m with hwdef
  set s : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => h₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 2) with hsdef
  have hspos : ∀ n, 0 < s n := fun n => div_pos hh₀ (by positivity)
  have hslt : ∀ n, s n < h₀ := fun n =>
    div_lt_self hh₀ (by have := n.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ); linarith)
  have habs : ∀ n, |s n| = s n := fun n => abs_of_pos (hspos n)
  have hs0 : Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 2 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  have Hn : ∀ n, HolderOnWith M α (smthGrad (smthDQ u m (s n))) B := fun n =>
    (hdq (s n) (by rw [habs]; exact hspos n) (by rw [habs]; exact hslt n)).1
  have Bn : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ B, ‖smthGrad (smthDQ u m (s n)) x‖ ≤ M := fun n =>
    (hdq (s n) (by rw [habs]; exact hspos n) (by rw [habs]; exact hslt n)).2
  have Dn : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ (smthDQ u m (s n)) x := fun n =>
    dqd (s n) (by rw [habs]; exact hslt n)
  have Tn : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ z ∈ B, |smthDQ u m (s n) z - smthDQ u m (s n) x -
      ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (smthDQ u m (s n)) x j * (z - x) j| ≤
        2 * (M : ℝ) * ‖z - x‖ ^ (α : ℝ) * ‖z - x‖ := fun n =>
    taylor _ B (convex_ball y r) (Dn n) (Hn n)
  have Cn : ∀ z ∈ B, Tendsto (fun n => smthDQ u m (s n) z) atTop (𝓝 (w z)) := by
    intro z hz
    exact dqlim z (hbig z (ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hz)) s (fun n => (hspos n).ne') hs0
  have hαpos : (0 : ℝ) < (α : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.2 hα
  have key : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ x' ∈ B, ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ L L' : Fin 2 → ℝ, StrictMono φ ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℝ w x ∧ smthGrad w x = L ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ w x' ∧ smthGrad w x' = L' ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => smthGrad (smthDQ u m (s (φ n))) x) atTop (𝓝 L) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => smthGrad (smthDQ u m (s (φ n))) x') atTop (𝓝 L') := by
    intro x hx x' hx'
    have hP : ∀ n, (smthGrad (smthDQ u m (s n)) x, smthGrad (smthDQ u m (s n)) x') ∈
        closedBall (0 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) M := by
      intro n
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, Prod.norm_def]
      exact max_le (Bn n x hx) (Bn n x' hx')
    obtain ⟨⟨L, L'⟩, -, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ := tendsto_subseq_of_bounded isBounded_closedBall hP
    have hl1 : Tendsto (fun n => smthGrad (smthDQ u m (s (φ n))) x) atTop (𝓝 L) := hlim.fst_nhds
    have hl2 : Tendsto (fun n => smthGrad (smthDQ u m (s (φ n))) x') atTop (𝓝 L') :=
      hlim.snd_nhds
    obtain ⟨d1, g1⟩ := tlim B isOpen_ball x hx (fun n => smthDQ u m (s (φ n)))
      (fun n => smthGrad (smthDQ u m (s (φ n))) x) w L (2 * M) α hαpos
      (fun n z hz => Tn (φ n) x hx z hz) (fun z hz => (Cn z hz).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) hl1
    obtain ⟨d2, g2⟩ := tlim B isOpen_ball x' hx' (fun n => smthDQ u m (s (φ n)))
      (fun n => smthGrad (smthDQ u m (s (φ n))) x') w L' (2 * M) α hαpos
      (fun n z hz => Tn (φ n) x' hx' z hz) (fun z hz => (Cn z hz).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop) hl2
    exact ⟨φ, L, L', hφ, d1, g1, d2, g2, hl1, hl2⟩
  have hH : HolderOnWith M α (smthGrad w) B := by
    intro x hx x' hx'
    obtain ⟨φ, L, L', hφ, -, g1, -, g2, hl1, hl2⟩ := key x hx x' hx'
    rw [g1, g2]
    exact le_of_tendsto' (hl1.edist hl2) (fun n => (Hn (φ n)).edist_le hx hx')
  have hd : ∀ x ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ w x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨φ, L, L', hφ, d1, -⟩ := key x hx x hx
    exact d1
  exact ⟨c1 w B isOpen_ball hd hH, hH⟩

informal_problem.statement: (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (P : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (Q : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hP : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => P x i) S) (hQ : ContinuousOn Q S) (heq : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ S → ∫ x, (∑ i : Fin 2, P x i * smthGrad φ x i + Q x * φ x) = 0) (m : Fin 2) : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ S → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, (smthGrad (fun y => P y i) x m - (if i = m then Q x else 0)) * smthGrad φ x i = 0

signature.name: smth_ibp_shift
signature.statement: (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (P : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (Q : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hP : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => P x i) S) (hQ : ContinuousOn Q S) (heq : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ S → ∫ x, (∑ i : Fin 2, P x i * smthGrad φ x i + Q x * φ x) = 0) (m : Fin 2) : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ S → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, (smthGrad (fun y => P y i) x m - (if i = m then Q x else 0)) * smthGrad φ x i = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (g h : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContinuousOn g S → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h →
      tsupport h ⊆ S → Integrable (fun x => g x * h x) := by
    intro g h hg hh hhc hhS
    have hcont : Continuous (fun x => g x * h x) := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ S
      · exact (hg.continuousAt (hS.mem_nhds hx)).mul hh.continuousAt
      · have hxt : x ∉ tsupport h := fun h' => hx (hhS h')
        have hev : h =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).1 hxt
        have hev2 : (fun y => g y * h y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
          simp [hy]
        exact continuousAt_const.congr hev2.symm
    exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hhc.mul_left
  
  have tsup_grad : ∀ h : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, tsupport h ⊆ S → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      tsupport (fun x => smthGrad h x k) ⊆ S := by
    intro h hhS k x hx
    by_contra hxS
    have hxt : x ∉ tsupport (fderiv ℝ h) := fun h' => hxS (hhS (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ h'))
    have hev : fderiv ℝ h =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).1 hxt
    have hev2 : (fun y => smthGrad h y k) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
      simp [smthGrad, hy]
    exact (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).2 hev2 hx
  
  have s3 : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ S →
      ∀ k : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => smthGrad φ x k) ∧
        HasCompactSupport (fun x => smthGrad φ x k) ∧ tsupport (fun x => smthGrad φ x k) ⊆ S := by
    intro φ hφ hφc hφS k
    have hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ φ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hφ).2
    exact ⟨hd.clm_apply contDiff_const, hφc.fderiv_apply ℝ _, tsup_grad φ hφS k⟩
  
  have s4 : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (i k : Fin 2),
      smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y k) x i = smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y i) x k := by
    intro φ hφ x i k
    have hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ φ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hφ).2
    have hdd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x := (hd.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    have key : ∀ a b : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad φ y a) x (Pi.single b 1) =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x (Pi.single b 1) (Pi.single a 1) := by
      intro a b
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ φ y (Pi.single a 1)) x (Pi.single b 1) = _
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hdd (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    have hS2 : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ φ x := hφ.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      simp only [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      exact (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)))
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad φ y k) x (Pi.single i 1) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad φ y i) x (Pi.single k 1)
    rw [key, key]
    exact hS2 _ _
  
  have s2 : ∀ (p h : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 p S → ContDiff ℝ 1 h →
      HasCompactSupport h → tsupport h ⊆ S → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      ∫ x, p x * smthGrad h x k = -∫ x, smthGrad p x k * h x := by
    intro p h hp hh hhc hhS k
    have hoff : ∀ x, x ∉ S → h =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ h =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have hxt : x ∉ tsupport h := fun h' => hx (hhS h')
      refine ⟨(notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).1 hxt, (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).1 ?_⟩
      exact fun h' => hxt (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ h')
    have hFoff : ∀ x, x ∉ S → (fun y => p y * h y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      filter_upwards [(hoff x hx).1] with y hy
      simp [hy]
    have hpd : ∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ p x := fun x hx =>
      (hp.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hS.mem_nhds hx)
    have hhd : Differentiable ℝ h := hh.differentiable (by simp)
    have hFd : Differentiable ℝ (fun y => p y * h y) := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ S
      · exact (hpd x hx).mul (hhd x)
      · exact (differentiableAt_const (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hFoff x hx)
    have hFder : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ (fun y => p y * h y) x (Pi.single k 1) * 1 =
        smthGrad p x k * h x + p x * smthGrad h x k := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ S
      · rw [show (fun y => p y * h y) = p * h from rfl, fderiv_mul (hpd x hx) (hhd x)]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          smthGrad]
        ring
      · have h1 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => p y * h y) x = 0 := by
          rw [(hFoff x hx).fderiv_eq]; simp
        have h2 : h x = 0 := (hoff x hx).1.self_of_nhds
        have h3 : fderiv ℝ h x = 0 := (hoff x hx).2.self_of_nhds
        simp [h1, h2, h3, smthGrad]
    have hcp : ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad p x k) S :=
      (hp.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hS le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hU := s1 (fun x => smthGrad p x k) h hcp hh.continuous hhc hhS
    have hV := s1 p (fun x => smthGrad h x k) hp.continuousOn
      ((hh.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const) (hhc.fderiv_apply ℝ _)
      (tsup_grad h hhS k)
    have hFi := s1 p h hp.continuousOn hh.continuous hhc hhS
    have hfun : (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => p y * h y) x (Pi.single k 1) * 1) =
        fun x => smthGrad p x k * h x + p x * smthGrad h x k := funext hFder
    have key := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable
      (f := fun y => p y * h y) (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (v := Pi.single k 1) (μ := volume)
      (by rw [hfun]; exact hU.add hV) (by simp) (by simpa using hFi) hFd (differentiable_const 1)
    rw [hfun, integral_add hU hV] at key
    simp at key
    linarith
  
  intro φ hφ hφc hφS
  have hψ : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => smthGrad φ x i) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun x => smthGrad φ x i) ∧ tsupport (fun x => smthGrad φ x i) ⊆ S :=
    s3 φ hφ hφc hφS
  have hψψ : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y i) x m) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y i) x m) ∧
      tsupport (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y i) x m) ⊆ S :=
    fun i => s3 _ (hψ i).1 (hψ i).2.1 (hψ i).2.2 m
  have h0 := heq _ (hψ m).1 (hψ m).2.1 (hψ m).2.2
  have hsw : (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, P x i * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y m) x i +
      Q x * smthGrad φ x m) = fun x => P x 0 * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y 0) x m +
      P x 1 * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y 1) x m + Q x * smthGrad φ x m := by
    funext x
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, s4 φ hφ x 0 m, s4 φ hφ x 1 m]
  rw [hsw] at h0
  have T1 : ∀ i : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => P x i * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y i) x m) :=
    fun i => s1 (fun x => P x i) _ (hP i).continuousOn (hψψ i).1.continuous (hψψ i).2.1
      (hψψ i).2.2
  have T2 : Integrable (fun x => Q x * smthGrad φ x m) :=
    s1 Q _ hQ (hψ m).1.continuous (hψ m).2.1 (hψ m).2.2
  have U : ∀ i : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => P y i) x m * smthGrad φ x i) :=
    fun i => s1 (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => P y i) x m) _
      (((hP i).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hS le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const)
      (hψ i).1.continuous (hψ i).2.1 (hψ i).2.2
  have IBP : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∫ x, P x i * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y i) x m =
      -∫ x, smthGrad (fun y => P y i) x m * smthGrad φ x i :=
    fun i => s2 (fun x => P x i) _ (hP i) ((hψ i).1.of_le (by simp)) (hψ i).2.1 (hψ i).2.2 m
  have T11 : Integrable (fun x => P x 0 * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y 0) x m +
      P x 1 * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad φ y 1) x m) := (T1 0).add (T1 1)
  have U01 : Integrable (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => P y 0) x m * smthGrad φ x 0 +
      smthGrad (fun y => P y 1) x m * smthGrad φ x 1) := (U 0).add (U 1)
  rw [integral_add T11 T2, integral_add (T1 0) (T1 1), IBP 0, IBP 1] at h0
  have htarget : (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, (smthGrad (fun y => P y i) x m -
      (if i = m then Q x else 0)) * smthGrad φ x i) = fun x =>
      (smthGrad (fun y => P y 0) x m * smthGrad φ x 0 +
        smthGrad (fun y => P y 1) x m * smthGrad φ x 1) - Q x * smthGrad φ x m := by
    funext x
    fin_cases m <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring
  rw [htarget, integral_sub U01 T2, integral_add (U 0) (U 1)]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (α : NNReal) (lam : ℝ) (K : NNReal) (R : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hR : 0 < R) : ∃ M : NNReal, ∀ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), smthSchauderData lam K α a F w (Metric.ball y R) → HolderOnWith M α (smthGrad w) (Metric.ball y (R / 2)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y (R / 2), ‖smthGrad w x‖ ≤ (M : ℝ)

signature.name: smth_lin_schauder_est
signature.statement: (α : NNReal) (lam : ℝ) (K : NNReal) (R : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hR : 0 < R) : ∃ M : NNReal, ∀ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), smthSchauderData lam K α a F w (Metric.ball y R) → HolderOnWith M α (smthGrad w) (Metric.ball y (R / 2)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y (R / 2), ‖smthGrad w x‖ ≤ (M : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hrig⟩ := smth_sch_rigidity α lam K hα0 hα1 hlam
  have he : 0 < min ε (1 / 2) := lt_min hε (by norm_num)
  have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (K : ℝ) := K.2
  obtain ⟨σ, τ, τ', L₀, hσ0, hσ4, hσe, hσK, hτ0, hτ1, hτσ, hτ'0, hτ'1, hτ'K, hL1, hL2, hL3⟩ :=
    smth_sch_params α K R (min ε (1 / 2)) hα0 hK0 hR he
  generalize hedef : min ε (1 / 2) = e at he hσe hσK hτ'K hL3
  have heε : e ≤ ε := hedef ▸ min_le_left _ _
  have hαr0 : (0 : ℝ) < (α : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hα0
  have hαr1 : (α : ℝ) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hα1
  obtain ⟨M', hM'⟩ : ∃ M' : ℝ,
      M' = max (L₀ * (2 / R) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ))) (16 * K / R + 4 * L₀ / R) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM'0 : 0 ≤ M' := by
    rw [hM']
    refine le_trans ?_ (le_max_right _ _)
    exact add_nonneg (div_nonneg (by positivity) hR.le) (div_nonneg (by linarith) hR.le)
  have hMcoe : ((Real.toNNReal M' : NNReal) : ℝ) = M' := Real.coe_toNNReal _ hM'0
  refine ⟨Real.toNNReal M', ?_⟩
  intro y a F w hdata
  obtain ⟨hE, hBa, hHa, hBF, hHF, hBw, hC1, ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩, hSol⟩ := hdata
  have haC : ContinuousOn a (Metric.ball y R) := hHa.continuousOn hα0
  have hFC : ContinuousOn F (Metric.ball y R) := hHF.continuousOn hα0
  have hdpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y R, 0 < R - dist x y := fun x hx => by
    have := Metric.mem_ball.1 hx; linarith
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : Set ℝ, Q = {v | ∃ x ∈ Metric.ball y R, ∃ z ∈ Metric.ball y R, x ≠ z ∧
      v = (min (R - dist x y) (R - dist z y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * ‖smthGrad w x - smthGrad w z‖ /
        dist x z ^ (α : ℝ)} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQnn : ∀ v ∈ Q, 0 ≤ v := by
    rw [hQ]
    rintro v ⟨x, hx, z, hz, hxz, rfl⟩
    have hm0 : 0 < min (R - dist x y) (R - dist z y) := lt_min (hdpos x hx) (hdpos z hz)
    positivity
  have hQb : BddAbove Q := by
    refine ⟨R ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * C₀, ?_⟩
    rw [hQ]
    rintro v ⟨x, hx, z, hz, hxz, rfl⟩
    have hdist : 0 < dist x z := dist_pos.2 hxz
    have hm0 : 0 < min (R - dist x y) (R - dist z y) := lt_min (hdpos x hx) (hdpos z hz)
    have hmR : min (R - dist x y) (R - dist z y) ≤ R :=
      le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith [dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y)])
    have h1 : (min (R - dist x y) (R - dist z y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) ≤ R ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow hm0.le hmR (by positivity)
    have h2 : ‖smthGrad w x - smthGrad w z‖ ≤ C₀ * dist x z ^ (α : ℝ) := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hC₀.dist_le hx hz
    have hdα : 0 < dist x z ^ (α : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hdist _
    rw [mul_div_assoc]
    refine mul_le_mul h1 ?_ (by positivity) (by positivity)
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hdα]; exact h2
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = sSup Q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := hL ▸ Real.sSup_nonneg hQnn
  have hwt : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y R, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y R,
      (min (R - dist x y) (R - dist z y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * ‖smthGrad w x - smthGrad w z‖ ≤
        L * dist x z ^ (α : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx z hz
    by_cases hxz : x = z
    · subst hxz; simp [Real.zero_rpow hαr0.ne']
    · have hdα : 0 < dist x z ^ (α : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (dist_pos.2 hxz) _
      have hmem : (min (R - dist x y) (R - dist z y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) *
          ‖smthGrad w x - smthGrad w z‖ / dist x z ^ (α : ℝ) ∈ Q := by
        rw [hQ]; exact ⟨x, hx, z, hz, hxz, rfl⟩
      have := le_csSup hQb hmem
      rw [← hL, div_le_iff₀ hdα] at this
      exact this
  obtain ⟨hI, hII⟩ := smth_sch_weighted_interp α y R K L w hR hL0 hC1 hBw hwt
  
  have hIIm : ∀ L' : ℝ, (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y R, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 →
      ‖smthGrad w p‖ ≤ 4 * (K : ℝ) / (t * (R - dist p y)) + 2 * L' * t ^ (α : ℝ) / (R - dist p y)) →
      ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y R, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 → ∀ d : ℝ, 0 ≤ d → d ≤ R - dist p y →
        d * ‖smthGrad w p‖ ≤ 4 * (K : ℝ) / t + 2 * L' * t ^ (α : ℝ) := by
    intro L' hL' p hp t ht0 ht1 d hd0 hdp
    have hpp := hdpos p hp
    calc d * ‖smthGrad w p‖ ≤ (R - dist p y) * ‖smthGrad w p‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdp (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (R - dist p y) * (4 * (K : ℝ) / (t * (R - dist p y)) +
            2 * L' * t ^ (α : ℝ) / (R - dist p y)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hL' p hp t ht0 ht1) hpp.le
      _ = 4 * (K : ℝ) / t + 2 * L' * t ^ (α : ℝ) := by
          field_simp
  
  have key : L ≤ L₀ := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hLpos : 0 < L := by linarith
    have hQne : Q.Nonempty := by
      by_contra hne
      rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
      rw [hne, Real.sSup_empty] at hL
      linarith
    obtain ⟨v, hvQ, hv⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup hQne (show L / 2 < sSup Q by rw [← hL]; linarith)
    rw [hQ] at hvQ
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, z₀, hz₀, hxz, rfl⟩ := hvQ
    generalize hd₀def : min (R - dist x₀ y) (R - dist z₀ y) = d₀ at hv
    generalize hρdef : dist x₀ z₀ = ρ at hv
    generalize hDdef : ‖smthGrad w x₀ - smthGrad w z₀‖ = D at hv
    have hx₀p := hdpos x₀ hx₀
    have hz₀p := hdpos z₀ hz₀
    have hd₀x : d₀ ≤ R - dist x₀ y := hd₀def ▸ min_le_left _ _
    have hd₀z : d₀ ≤ R - dist z₀ y := hd₀def ▸ min_le_right _ _
    have hd₀p : 0 < d₀ := hd₀def ▸ lt_min hx₀p hz₀p
    have hd₀R : d₀ ≤ R := by linarith [dist_nonneg (x := x₀) (y := y)]
    have hρp : 0 < ρ := hρdef ▸ dist_pos.2 hxz
    have hρα : 0 < ρ ^ (α : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hρp _
    have hdα : 0 < d₀ ^ (α : ℝ) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hd₀p _
    have hd1α : d₀ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) = d₀ * d₀ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_add hd₀p, Real.rpow_one]
    have hstar : L / 2 * ρ ^ (α : ℝ) < d₀ * d₀ ^ (α : ℝ) * D := by

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_avg_holder
subgoal_signatures.statement: (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f : ℝ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (KH β : NNReal) (hH : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HolderOnWith KH β (f s) S) (hc : ∀ x ∈ S, ContinuousOn (fun s => f s x) (Set.Icc 0 1)) : (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ c₀ ε : ℝ, (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |f s x - c₀| ≤ ε) → |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f s x) - c₀| ≤ ε) ∧ HolderOnWith KH β (fun x => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f s x) S

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_avg_lip_comp
subgoal_signatures.statement: (Φ : ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) → (((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (Bset : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (L : NNReal) (hL : LipschitzOnWith L Φ Bset) (hLb : ∀ z ∈ Bset, ‖Φ z‖ ≤ L) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (Z : ℝ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (CZ β : NNReal) (hZH : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HolderOnWith CZ β (Z s) S) (hZB : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ S, Z s x ∈ Bset) (hZc : ∀ x ∈ S, ContinuousOn (fun s => Z s x) (Set.Icc 0 1)) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hV : ‖V‖ ≤ 1) : (∀ x ∈ S, |∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s x) V| ≤ L) ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ c₀ ε : ℝ, (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |Φ (Z s x) V - c₀| ≤ ε) → |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s x) V) - c₀| ≤ ε) ∧ HolderOnWith (L * CZ) β (fun x => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s x) V) S

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_local_coeff_ball
subgoal_signatures.statement: (Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΛ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ O) (hell : ∀ w ∈ O, ∀ q : Fin 2 → ℝ, q ≠ 0 → 0 < fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, q)) w (0, 0, q)) (z₀ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ O) : ∃ (r lam0 : ℝ) (L : NNReal), 0 < r ∧ 0 < lam0 ∧ Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ O ∧ (∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam0 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z₀ (0, 0, Pi.single j 1) * ξ i * ξ j) ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ∀ i j : Fin 2, |fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z (0, 0, Pi.single j 1) - fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z₀ (0, 0, Pi.single j 1)| ≤ lam0 / 8) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 2, LipschitzOnWith L (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1))) (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z‖ ≤ L) ∧ LipschitzOnWith L (fderiv ℝ Λ) (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ‖fderiv ℝ Λ z‖ ≤ L

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_dq_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v) (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ) (hh : h ≠ 0) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (smthDQ v m h) ∧ (∀ x, smthGrad (smthDQ v m h) x = fun j => (smthGrad v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) j - smthGrad v x j) / h) ∧ (∀ x, smthDQ v m h x = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, smthGrad v (x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) m) ∧ ∀ (T S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (C β : NNReal), HolderOnWith C β (smthGrad v) T → (∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ T ∧ x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) ∈ T) → ∃ C₀ : NNReal, HolderOnWith C₀ β (smthGrad (smthDQ v m h)) S

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_ftc_split
