  have hsegO : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, Y₀ + t • (Y₁ - Y₀) ∈ O := fun t ht => hQO (hseg t ht)
  have hdiff : ∀ w ∈ O, HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ Λ) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w) w := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Λ w := hΛ.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hw)
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ Λ) w := h1.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_cast)
    exact (h2.differentiableAt one_ne_zero).hasFDerivAt
  have mvt : ∀ ζ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ), ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      fderiv ℝ Λ Y₁ ζ - fderiv ℝ Λ Y₀ ζ =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) (Y₀ + t • (Y₁ - Y₀)) (Y₁ - Y₀) ζ := by
    intro ζ
    have hder : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ Λ (Y₀ + t • (Y₁ - Y₀)) ζ)
          (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) (Y₀ + t • (Y₁ - Y₀)) (Y₁ - Y₀) ζ) t := by
      intro t ht
      have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Y₀ + t • (Y₁ - Y₀)) (Y₁ - Y₀) t :=
        (((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (Y₁ - Y₀)).const_add Y₀).congr_deriv (one_smul ℝ _)
      have hc := (hdiff _ (hsegO t ht)).comp_hasDerivAt t hγ
      have hc2 := hc.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const t ζ)
      exact hc2.congr_deriv (by simp)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hceq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope
      (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ Λ (Y₀ + t • (Y₁ - Y₀)) ζ)
      (fun t => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) (Y₀ + t • (Y₁ - Y₀)) (Y₁ - Y₀) ζ) zero_lt_one
      (fun t ht => (hder t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t ht => hder t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht))
    refine ⟨c, Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hc, ?_⟩
    rw [hceq]
    simp
  refine ⟨fun ζ => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, hid⟩ := mvt ζ
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwdef⟩ : ∃ w, w ∈ Q ∧ Y₀ + t • (Y₁ - Y₀) = w := ⟨_, hseg t ht, rfl⟩
    rw [hwdef, hY] at hid
    rw [hid, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hh]
    apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hh.le
    calc |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w ((e, s, q) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ζ|
        = ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w ((e, s, q) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ζ‖ :=
          (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w‖ * ‖((e, s, q) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ * ‖ζ‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm₂ _ _ _
      _ ≤ Λ₂ * ‖((e, s, q) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ * ‖ζ‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hΛ₂ w hw) (norm_nonneg _))
            (norm_nonneg _)
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, hid⟩ := mvt ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), q)
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwdef⟩ : ∃ w, w ∈ Q ∧ Y₀ + t • (Y₁ - Y₀) = w := ⟨_, hseg t ht, rfl⟩
    rw [hwdef, hY] at hid
    rw [hid, le_div_iff₀ hh, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hsplit : ((e, s, q) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) =
        ((e, s, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) + ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), q) := by
      simp
    rw [hsplit, map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    have hz : ‖(((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), q) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ = ‖q‖ := by
      simp [Prod.norm_def]
    have h1 : |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w ((e, s, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
        ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), q)| ≤
        Λ₂ * ‖((e, s, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ * ‖q‖ := by
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← hz]
      calc _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w‖ * ‖((e, s, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ *
            ‖(((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), q) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm₂ _ _ _
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hΛ₂ w hw) (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)
    have h2 := hlam w hw q
    have h3 := neg_abs_le (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w ((e, s, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
        ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), q))
    have h4 : lam₀ * ∑ k, q k ^ 2 - Λ₂ * ‖((e, s, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ * ‖q‖ ≤
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w ((e, s, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
          ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), q) +
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), q) ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), q) := by
      linarith
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hh.le

informal_problem.statement: (Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (D : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hD : IsOpen D) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hcont : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) D) (hEL1 : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ x in D, fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x) = 0) (a : Fin 2 → ℝ) (φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφD : tsupport φ ⊆ D) (hφa : ∀ x ∈ tsupport φ, x + a ∈ D) : ∫ x, (fderiv ℝ Λ (x + a, v (x + a), smthGrad v (x + a)) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x) - fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x)) = 0

signature.name: smth_dq_shift_weak_eq
signature.statement: (Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (D : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hD : IsOpen D) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hcont : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) D) (hEL1 : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ x in D, fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x) = 0) (a : Fin 2 → ℝ) (φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ) (hφD : tsupport φ ⊆ D) (hφa : ∀ x ∈ tsupport φ, x + a ∈ D) : ∫ x, (fderiv ℝ Λ (x + a, v (x + a), smthGrad v (x + a)) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x) - fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x)) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have pairing : ∀ (L : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ))
      (χ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 χ → HasCompactSupport χ →
      ContinuousOn L (tsupport χ) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => L x (0, χ x, smthGrad χ x)) ∧
      ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport χ → L x (0, χ x, smthGrad χ x) = 0 := by
    intro L χ hχ hχc hL
    have hvan : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport χ → L x (0, χ x, smthGrad χ x) = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have h1 : χ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
      have h2 : fderiv ℝ χ x = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hx (support_fderiv_subset ℝ hne)
      have h3 : smthGrad χ x = 0 := by
        funext k
        simp [smthGrad, h2]
      rw [h1, h3]
      have h4 : (((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) = 0 :=
        rfl
      rw [h4, map_zero]
    refine ⟨?_, hvan⟩
    have hgrad : Continuous (smthGrad χ) :=
      continuous_pi fun k => (hχ.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hg : Continuous (fun x => ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), χ x, smthGrad χ x)) :=
      continuous_const.prodMk (hχ.continuous.prodMk hgrad)
    have hcon : ContinuousOn (fun x => L x (0, χ x, smthGrad χ x)) (tsupport χ) :=
      hL.clm_apply hg.continuousOn
    exact (hcon.integrableOn_compact hχc.isCompact).integrable_of_forall_notMem_eq_zero hvan
  
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => φ (y - a)) := hφ.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hψc : HasCompactSupport (fun y => φ (y - a)) :=
    hφc.comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.subRight a)
  have hψt : ∀ y ∈ tsupport (fun y => φ (y - a)), y - a ∈ tsupport φ := by
    intro y hy
    have e : tsupport (fun y => φ (y - a)) = (Homeomorph.subRight a) ⁻¹' tsupport φ :=
      tsupport_comp_eq_preimage φ (Homeomorph.subRight a)
    rw [e] at hy
    exact hy
  have hψD : tsupport (fun y => φ (y - a)) ⊆ D := by
    intro y hy
    have h := hφa _ (hψt y hy)
    rwa [sub_add_cancel] at h
  have hψgrad : ∀ x, smthGrad (fun y => φ (y - a)) (x + a) = smthGrad φ x := by
    intro x
    funext k
    simp only [smthGrad]
    rw [fderiv_comp_sub, add_sub_cancel_right]
  
  have hFψ := pairing (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) (fun y => φ (y - a)) hψ hψc
    (hcont.mono hψD)
  have hIψ : ∫ y, fderiv ℝ Λ (y, v y, smthGrad v y)
      (0, φ (y - a), smthGrad (fun z => φ (z - a)) y) = 0 := by
    have h0 : ∀ y, y ∉ D → fderiv ℝ Λ (y, v y, smthGrad v y)
        (0, φ (y - a), smthGrad (fun z => φ (z - a)) y) = 0 :=
      fun y hy => hFψ.2 y (fun h => hy (hψD h))
    rw [← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero h0]
    exact hEL1 _ hψ hψc hψD
  have hI1 : ∫ x, fderiv ℝ Λ (x + a, v (x + a), smthGrad v (x + a)) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x) = 0 := by
    have h := MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
      (fun y => fderiv ℝ Λ (y, v y, smthGrad v y)
        (0, φ (y - a), smthGrad (fun z => φ (z - a)) y)) a
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right, hψgrad] at h
    rw [h]
    exact hIψ
  
  have hFφ := pairing (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x)) φ hφ hφc (hcont.mono hφD)
  have hI2 : ∫ x, fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x) = 0 := by
    have h0 : ∀ y, y ∉ D → fderiv ℝ Λ (y, v y, smthGrad v y) (0, φ y, smthGrad φ y) = 0 :=
      fun y hy => hFφ.2 y (fun h => hy (hφD h))
    rw [← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero h0]
    exact hEL1 _ hφ hφc hφD
  
  have hint1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (x + a, v (x + a), smthGrad v (x + a)) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x)) :=
    (pairing (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (x + a, v (x + a), smthGrad v (x + a))) φ hφ hφc
      (hcont.comp (continuous_add_right a).continuousOn (fun x hx => hφa x hx))).1
  have hint2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun x => fderiv ℝ Λ (x, v x, smthGrad v x) (0, φ x, smthGrad φ x)) := hFφ.1
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub hint1 hint2, hI1, hI2, sub_zero]

informal_problem.statement: (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (R lam Lam K M₀ : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hLam : 0 ≤ Lam) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M₀) : ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₂ ∧ ∀ (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (P : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 w → ContinuousOn P (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) → ContinuousOn p (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, |w x| ≤ M₀) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, lam * ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 - K ≤ ∑ k, P x k * smthGrad w x k) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, ∀ k, |P x k| ≤ Lam * (1 + ∑ j, |smthGrad w x j|)) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, |p x| ≤ Lam * (1 + ∑ j, |smthGrad w x j|)) → (∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R → ∫ x, (∑ k, P x k * smthGrad φ x k + p x * φ x) = 0) → ∀ (η : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (c : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 η → HasCompactSupport η → tsupport η ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R → |c| ≤ M₀ → ∫ x, η x ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤ C₁ * (∫ x, (w x - c) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2) + C₂ * ∫ x, η x ^ 2

signature.name: slh_caccioppoli
signature.statement: (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (R lam Lam K M₀ : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hLam : 0 ≤ Lam) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M₀) : ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₂ ∧ ∀ (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (P : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 w → ContinuousOn P (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) → ContinuousOn p (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, |w x| ≤ M₀) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, lam * ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 - K ≤ ∑ k, P x k * smthGrad w x k) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, ∀ k, |P x k| ≤ Lam * (1 + ∑ j, |smthGrad w x j|)) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, |p x| ≤ Lam * (1 + ∑ j, |smthGrad w x j|)) → (∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R → ∫ x, (∑ k, P x k * smthGrad φ x k + p x * φ x) = 0) → ∀ (η : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (c : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 η → HasCompactSupport η → tsupport η ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R → |c| ≤ M₀ → ∫ x, η x ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤ C₁ * (∫ x, (w x - c) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2) + C₂ * ∫ x, η x ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hscalar : ∀ (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ e d P₁ P₂ q : ℝ), |d| ≤ 2 * M₀ →
      lam * (a₁ ^ 2 + a₂ ^ 2) - K ≤ P₁ * a₁ + P₂ * a₂ →
      |P₁| ≤ Lam * (1 + (|a₁| + |a₂|)) → |P₂| ≤ Lam * (1 + (|a₁| + |a₂|)) →
      |q| ≤ Lam * (1 + (|a₁| + |a₂|)) →
      lam ^ 2 * (e ^ 2 * (a₁ ^ 2 + a₂ ^ 2)) ≤
        2 * lam * (P₁ * (e ^ 2 * a₁ + 2 * e * d * b₁) + P₂ * (e ^ 2 * a₂ + 2 * e * d * b₂)
          + q * (e ^ 2 * d))
        + (4 * lam + 32 * Lam ^ 2) * (d ^ 2 * (b₁ ^ 2 + b₂ ^ 2))
        + 2 * (lam * K + lam * Lam ^ 2 + 2 * lam * M₀ * Lam + 8 * M₀ ^ 2 * Lam ^ 2) * e ^ 2 := by
    intro a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ e d P₁ P₂ q hd hco hP₁ hP₂ hq
    have h1 : (|a₁| + |a₂|) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (a₁ ^ 2 + a₂ ^ 2) := by
      rw [← sq_abs a₁, ← sq_abs a₂]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|a₁| - |a₂|)]
    have h2 : (|b₁| + |b₂|) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (b₁ ^ 2 + b₂ ^ 2) := by
      rw [← sq_abs b₁, ← sq_abs b₂]; nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|b₁| - |b₂|)]
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ |a₁| + |a₂| := by positivity
    have hβ0 : 0 ≤ |b₁| + |b₂| := by positivity
    generalize |a₁| + |a₂| = s at h1 hs0 hP₁ hP₂ hq
    have hL : 0 ≤ Lam * (1 + s) := mul_nonneg hLam (by linarith)
    have h3 : |P₁ * b₁ + P₂ * b₂| ≤ Lam * (1 + s) * (|b₁| + |b₂|) := by
      calc |P₁ * b₁ + P₂ * b₂| ≤ |P₁ * b₁| + |P₂ * b₂| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |P₁| * |b₁| + |P₂| * |b₂| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ Lam * (1 + s) * |b₁| + Lam * (1 + s) * |b₂| :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP₁ (abs_nonneg _))
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP₂ (abs_nonneg _))
        _ = Lam * (1 + s) * (|b₁| + |b₂|) := by ring
    generalize |b₁| + |b₂| = β at h2 hβ0 h3
    have h6 : -(2 * |e| * |d| * (Lam * (1 + s) * β)) ≤ 2 * e * d * (P₁ * b₁ + P₂ * b₂) := by
      have habs : |2 * e * d * (P₁ * b₁ + P₂ * b₂)| ≤ 2 * |e| * |d| * (Lam * (1 + s) * β) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by positivity)
      linarith [neg_abs_le (2 * e * d * (P₁ * b₁ + P₂ * b₂))]
    have h9 : -(Lam * (1 + s) * (e ^ 2 * (2 * M₀))) ≤ q * (e ^ 2 * d) := by
      have habs : |q * (e ^ 2 * d)| ≤ Lam * (1 + s) * (e ^ 2 * (2 * M₀)) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg e)]
        exact mul_le_mul hq (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (sq_nonneg e)) (by positivity) hL
      linarith [neg_abs_le (q * (e ^ 2 * d))]
    have hlam2 : 0 ≤ 2 * lam := by linarith
    have h4 : 2 * lam * (e ^ 2 * (lam * (a₁ ^ 2 + a₂ ^ 2) - K)) ≤
        2 * lam * (e ^ 2 * (P₁ * a₁ + P₂ * a₂)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hco (sq_nonneg e)) hlam2
    have h6' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h6 hlam2
    have h9' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h9 hlam2
    have h7 : 16 * lam * Lam * |e| * s * |d| * β ≤
        lam ^ 2 * e ^ 2 * s ^ 2 + 64 * Lam ^ 2 * d ^ 2 * β ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs e, ← sq_abs d]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (lam * |e| * s - 8 * Lam * |d| * β)]
    have h8 : 2 * lam * (2 * Lam * |e| * |d| * β) ≤ 2 * lam * (Lam ^ 2 * e ^ 2 + d ^ 2 * β ^ 2) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hlam2
      rw [← sq_abs e, ← sq_abs d]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Lam * |e| - |d| * β)]
    have h10 : 16 * lam * M₀ * Lam * e ^ 2 * s ≤
        lam ^ 2 * e ^ 2 * s ^ 2 + 64 * M₀ ^ 2 * Lam ^ 2 * e ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg e) (sq_nonneg (lam * s - 8 * M₀ * Lam))]
    have h1' : lam ^ 2 * e ^ 2 * s ^ 2 ≤ lam ^ 2 * e ^ 2 * (2 * (a₁ ^ 2 + a₂ ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)
    have h2' : (2 * lam + 16 * Lam ^ 2) * d ^ 2 * β ^ 2 ≤
        (2 * lam + 16 * Lam ^ 2) * d ^ 2 * (2 * (b₁ ^ 2 + b₂ ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (by positivity)
    linarith [h4, h6', h9', h7, h8, h10, h1', h2']
  
  have hgradφ : ∀ (η w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (c : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 η → ContDiff ℝ 1 w →
      ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2),
      smthGrad (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) x k =
        η x ^ 2 * smthGrad w x k + 2 * η x * (w x - c) * smthGrad η x k := by
    intro η w c hη hw x k
    have hdη : DifferentiableAt ℝ η x := hη.differentiable (by norm_num) x
    have hdw : DifferentiableAt ℝ w x := hw.differentiable (by norm_num) x
    have hdwc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => w y - c) x := hdw.sub_const c
    have hdi : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => η y * (w y - c)) x := hdη.mul hdwc
    unfold smthGrad
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hdη hdi, fderiv_fun_mul hdη hdwc, fderiv_sub_const]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have e1 : ∀ X : ℝ, lam ^ 2 * (2 / lam * X) = 2 * lam * X := fun X => by
    field_simp
  have e2 : ∀ X : ℝ, lam ^ 2 * ((4 * lam + 32 * Lam ^ 2) / lam ^ 2 * X) =
      (4 * lam + 32 * Lam ^ 2) * X := fun X => by
    field_simp
  have e3 : ∀ X : ℝ, lam ^ 2 *
      (2 * (lam * K + lam * Lam ^ 2 + 2 * lam * M₀ * Lam + 8 * M₀ ^ 2 * Lam ^ 2) / lam ^ 2 * X) =
      2 * (lam * K + lam * Lam ^ 2 + 2 * lam * M₀ * Lam + 8 * M₀ ^ 2 * Lam ^ 2) * X := fun X => by
    field_simp
  refine ⟨(4 * lam + 32 * Lam ^ 2) / lam ^ 2,
    2 * (lam * K + lam * Lam ^ 2 + 2 * lam * M₀ * Lam + 8 * M₀ ^ 2 * Lam ^ 2) / lam ^ 2,
    by positivity, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro w P p hw hP hp hwb hcoer hPb hpb hweak η c hη hηc hηB hc
  have hgφ := hgradφ η w c hη hw
  
  have hη0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport η → η x = 0 := fun x hx => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
  have hgη0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport η → ∀ k, smthGrad η x k = 0 := by
    intro x hx k
    unfold smthGrad
    rw [fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport ℝ hx]
    rfl
  have hcl : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.closedBall x₀ R → x ∉ tsupport η := fun x hx hxη =>
    hx (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hηB hxη))
  
  have hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) :=
    hη.mul (hη.mul (hw.sub contDiff_const))
  have hφc : HasCompactSupport (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro hηc.isCompact (fun x hx => by simp [hη0 x hx])
  have hφB : tsupport (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R :=
    (tsupport_mul_subset_left).trans hηB
  have hF0 := hweak _ hφ hφc hφB
  
  have hgw : ∀ k, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad w x k) := fun k => by
    show Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ w x (Pi.single k 1))
    exact (hw.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hgη : ∀ k, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad η x k) := fun k => by
    show Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ η x (Pi.single k 1))
    exact (hη.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hgφc : ∀ k, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) x k) :=
    fun k => by
      show Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) x (Pi.single k 1))
      exact (hφ.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).clm_apply continuous_const
  
  have hFint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ∑ k, P x k *
      smthGrad (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) x k +
      p x * (η x * (η x * (w x - c)))) := by
    have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ k, P x k *
        smthGrad (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) x k +
        p x * (η x * (η x * (w x - c)))) (Metric.closedBall x₀ R) := by
      refine ContinuousOn.add (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => ?_)) ?_
      · exact (continuousOn_pi.mp hP k).mul (hgφc k).continuousOn
      · exact hp.mul hφ.continuous.continuousOn
    have hsupp : Function.support (fun x => ∑ k, P x k *
        smthGrad (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) x k +
        p x * (η x * (η x * (w x - c)))) ⊆ Metric.closedBall x₀ R := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxc
      apply hx
      have h1 := hcl x hxc
      simp [hgφ, hη0 x h1, hgη0 x h1]
    exact (MeasureTheory.integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset hsupp).mp
      (hFc.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall x₀ R))
  have hGint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => η x ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) := by
    refine Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ?_ ?_
    · exact (hη.continuous.pow 2).mul
        (continuous_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => (hgw k).pow 2))
    · exact HasCompactSupport.intro hηc.isCompact (fun x hx => by simp [hη0 x hx])
  have hHint : MeasureTheory.Integrable
      (fun x => (w x - c) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2) := by
    refine Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ?_ ?_
    · exact ((hw.continuous.sub continuous_const).pow 2).mul
        (continuous_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => (hgη k).pow 2))
    · exact HasCompactSupport.intro hηc.isCompact (fun x hx => by simp [hgη0 x hx])
  have hEint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => η x ^ 2) := by
    refine Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hη.continuous.pow 2) ?_
    exact HasCompactSupport.intro hηc.isCompact (fun x hx => by simp [hη0 x hx])
  
  have hpt : ∀ x, η x ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤
      2 / lam * (∑ k, P x k * smthGrad (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) x k +
        p x * (η x * (η x * (w x - c)))) +
      (4 * lam + 32 * Lam ^ 2) / lam ^ 2 * ((w x - c) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2) +
      2 * (lam * K + lam * Lam ^ 2 + 2 * lam * M₀ * Lam + 8 * M₀ ^ 2 * Lam ^ 2) / lam ^ 2 *
        η x ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    refine le_of_mul_le_mul_left ?_ (pow_pos hlam 2)
    rw [mul_add, mul_add, e1, e2, e3]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hgφ]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport η
    · have hxc : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hηB hx)
      have hco := hcoer x hxc
      have hP0 := hPb x hxc 0
      have hP1 := hPb x hxc 1
      have hq := hpb x hxc
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hco hP0 hP1 hq
      have hd : |w x - c| ≤ 2 * M₀ := by
        have h1 := abs_le.mp (hwb x hxc)
        have h2 := abs_le.mp hc
        exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have key := hscalar (smthGrad w x 0) (smthGrad w x 1) (smthGrad η x 0) (smthGrad η x 1)
        (η x) (w x - c) (P x 0) (P x 1) (p x) hd hco hP0 hP1 hq
      linarith [key]
    · simp [hη0 x hx, hgη0 x hx]
  
  have hRint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x =>
      2 / lam * (∑ k, P x k * smthGrad (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) x k +
        p x * (η x * (η x * (w x - c)))) +
      (4 * lam + 32 * Lam ^ 2) / lam ^ 2 * ((w x - c) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2) +
      2 * (lam * K + lam * Lam ^ 2 + 2 * lam * M₀ * Lam + 8 * M₀ ^ 2 * Lam ^ 2) / lam ^ 2 *
        η x ^ 2) :=
    ((hFint.const_mul _).add (hHint.const_mul _)).add (hEint.const_mul _)
  have hmono := MeasureTheory.integral_mono hGint hRint hpt
  have hA : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x =>
      2 / lam * (∑ k, P x k * smthGrad (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) x k +
        p x * (η x * (η x * (w x - c))))) := hFint.const_mul _
  have hB : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x =>
      (4 * lam + 32 * Lam ^ 2) / lam ^ 2 * ((w x - c) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2)) :=
    hHint.const_mul _
  have hAB : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x =>
      2 / lam * (∑ k, P x k * smthGrad (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) x k +
        p x * (η x * (η x * (w x - c)))) +
      (4 * lam + 32 * Lam ^ 2) / lam ^ 2 * ((w x - c) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2)) :=
    hA.add hB
  have hC : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x =>
      2 * (lam * K + lam * Lam ^ 2 + 2 * lam * M₀ * Lam + 8 * M₀ ^ 2 * Lam ^ 2) / lam ^ 2 *
        η x ^ 2) := hEint.const_mul _
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add hAB hC, MeasureTheory.integral_add hA hB,
    MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
    MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul] at hmono
  have hF0' : ∫ x, (∑ k, P x k * smthGrad (fun y => η y * (η y * (w y - c))) x k +
      p x * (η x * (η x * (w x - c)))) = 0 := hF0
  rw [hF0', mul_zero, zero_add] at hmono
  exact hmono

informal_problem.statement: ∃ Cη : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cη ∧ ∀ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ η : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 η ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ tsupport η ⊆ Metric.closedBall y (7 * r / 4) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ η x ∧ η x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall y r, η x = 1 ∧ smthGrad η x = 0) ∧ (∀ x, ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2 ≤ Cη / r ^ 2)

signature.statement: ∃ Cη : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cη ∧ ∀ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ η : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 η ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ tsupport η ⊆ Metric.closedBall y (7 * r / 4) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ η x ∧ η x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall y r, η x = 1 ∧ smthGrad η x = 0) ∧ (∀ x, ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2 ≤ Cη / r ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hS1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
  obtain ⟨φ, hφc, hφ01, hφ1, hφ0⟩ : ∃ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ (∀ t, 0 ≤ φ t ∧ φ t ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ t, |t| ≤ 5 / 4 → φ t = 1) ∧ (∀ t, 3 / 2 ≤ |t| → φ t = 0) := by
    refine ⟨fun t => Real.smoothTransition (6 - 4 * t) * Real.smoothTransition (6 + 4 * t),
      (hS1.comp (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id))).mul
        (hS1.comp (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id))), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t
      have a1 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (6 - 4 * t)
      have a2 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (6 - 4 * t)
      have b1 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (6 + 4 * t)
      have b2 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (6 + 4 * t)
      exact ⟨mul_nonneg a1 b1, mul_le_one₀ a2 b1 b2⟩
    · intro t ht
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp ht
      show Real.smoothTransition (6 - 4 * t) * Real.smoothTransition (6 + 4 * t) = 1
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith),
        Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith), mul_one]
    · intro t ht
      show Real.smoothTransition (6 - 4 * t) * Real.smoothTransition (6 + 4 * t) = 0
      rcases le_or_gt 0 t with h | h
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg h] at ht
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), zero_mul]
      · rw [abs_of_neg h] at ht
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith : 6 + 4 * t ≤ 0), mul_zero]
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦc, hΦ01, hΦ1, hΦsupp⟩ : ∃ Φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ ∧
      (∀ w, 0 ≤ Φ w ∧ Φ w ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ w : Fin 2 → ℝ, (∀ k, |w k| ≤ 5 / 4) → Φ w = 1) ∧
      (∀ w : Fin 2 → ℝ, Φ w ≠ 0 → ∀ k, |w k| < 3 / 2) := by
    refine ⟨fun w => φ (w 0) * φ (w 1),
      (hφc.comp (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ (0 : Fin 2))).mul (hφc.comp (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ (1 : Fin 2))),
      fun w => ⟨mul_nonneg (hφ01 _).1 (hφ01 _).1, mul_le_one₀ (hφ01 _).2 (hφ01 _).1 (hφ01 _).2⟩,
      ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w hw
      show φ (w 0) * φ (w 1) = 1
      rw [hφ1 _ (hw 0), hφ1 _ (hw 1), mul_one]
    · intro w hw
      have h0' : |w 0| < 3 / 2 := by
        by_contra hk
        push_neg at hk
        exact hw (by show φ (w 0) * φ (w 1) = 0; rw [hφ0 _ hk, zero_mul])
      have h1' : |w 1| < 3 / 2 := by
        by_contra hk
        push_neg at hk
        exact hw (by show φ (w 0) * φ (w 1) = 0; rw [hφ0 _ hk, mul_zero])
      exact Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨h0', h1'⟩
  have hΦd0 : ∀ w : Fin 2 → ℝ, (∀ k, |w k| < 5 / 4) → fderiv ℝ Φ w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    have hopen : IsOpen {v : Fin 2 → ℝ | ∀ k, |v k| < 5 / 4} := by
      have he : {v : Fin 2 → ℝ | ∀ k, |v k| < 5 / 4} = ⋂ k, {v : Fin 2 → ℝ | |v k| < 5 / 4} := by
        ext v; simp
      rw [he]
      exact isOpen_iInter_of_finite
        (fun k => isOpen_lt ((continuous_apply k).abs) continuous_const)
    have hev : Φ =ᶠ[nhds w] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hw) (fun v hv => hΦ1 v (fun k => (hv k).le))
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact fderiv_const_apply 1
  have hΦcpt : HasCompactSupport Φ := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (3 / 2))
    intro w hw
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by norm_num)]
    intro k
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (hΦsupp w hw k).le
  have hfc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ Φ) := hΦc.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hfc.bounded_above_of_compact_support (hΦcpt.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ))
  have hΦd : Differentiable ℝ Φ := hΦc.differentiable (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨2 * (max C 0) ^ 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro y r hr
  have hchain : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (fun x => Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y)))
      ((fderiv ℝ Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y))).comp (r⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ))) x := by
    intro x
    have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => r⁻¹ • (x - y))
        (r⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ)) x :=
      ((hasFDerivAt_id x).sub_const y).const_smul r⁻¹
    exact (hΦd _).hasFDerivAt.comp x hA
  have hgrad : ∀ x k, smthGrad (fun x => Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y))) x k =
      r⁻¹ * fderiv ℝ Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y)) (Pi.single k 1) := by
    intro x k
    unfold smthGrad
    rw [(hchain x).fderiv]
    simp
  have hsupp : Function.support (fun x => Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y))) ⊆ Metric.closedBall y (3 * r / 2) := by
    intro x hx
    have h := hΦsupp _ hx
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_pi_le_iff (by positivity)]
    intro k
    have hk := h k
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hr] at hk
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have := (inv_mul_lt_iff₀ hr).1 hk
    linarith
  refine ⟨fun x => Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y)), hΦc.comp ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).const_smul r⁻¹),
    HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact (isCompact_closedBall y (3 * r / 2)) hsupp,
    ?_, fun x => hΦ01 _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine (closure_minimal hsupp Metric.isClosed_closedBall).trans ?_
    exact Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)
  · intro x hx
    have hz : ∀ k, |(r⁻¹ • (x - y)) k| ≤ 1 := by
      intro k
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_pi_le_iff hr.le] at hx
      have hk := hx k
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at hk
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hr]
      rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hr]
      linarith
    refine ⟨hΦ1 _ (fun k => (hz k).trans (by norm_num)), ?_⟩
    funext k
    rw [hgrad, hΦd0 _ (fun k => (hz k).trans_lt (by norm_num))]
    simp
  · intro x
    have hb : ∀ k, (smthGrad (fun x => Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y))) x k) ^ 2 ≤ (max C 0) ^ 2 / r ^ 2 := by
      intro k
      rw [hgrad]
      have ha : |fderiv ℝ Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y)) (Pi.single k 1)| ≤ max C 0 := by
        calc |fderiv ℝ Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y)) (Pi.single k 1)|
            = ‖fderiv ℝ Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y)) (Pi.single k 1)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
          _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y))‖ * ‖(Pi.single k (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)‖ :=
              ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
          _ = ‖fderiv ℝ Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y))‖ := by rw [Pi.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one]
          _ ≤ C := hC _
          _ ≤ max C 0 := le_max_left _ _
      have ha2 : (fderiv ℝ Φ (r⁻¹ • (x - y)) (Pi.single k 1)) ^ 2 ≤ (max C 0) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) ha 2
      rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, inv_mul_eq_div]
      gcongr
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    calc _ ≤ (max C 0) ^ 2 / r ^ 2 + (max C 0) ^ 2 / r ^ 2 := add_le_add (hb 0) (hb 1)
      _ = 2 * (max C 0) ^ 2 / r ^ 2 := by ring

informal_problem.statement: (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ 1 w) (a b : Fin 2 → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hab : ∀ k, a k < b k) (hL : ∀ k, b k - a k ≤ L) : ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), (w x - ⨍ z in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), w z) ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2

signature.statement: (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ 1 w) (a b : Fin 2 → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (hab : ∀ k, a k < b k) (hL : ∀ k, b k - a k ≤ L) : ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), (w x - ⨍ z in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), w z) ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h1d : ∀ (φ φ' : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ t, HasDerivAt φ (φ' t) t) → Continuous φ' →
      ∀ (α β s t : ℝ), s ∈ Set.Icc α β → t ∈ Set.Icc α β →
        (φ s - φ t) ^ 2 ≤ (β - α) * ∫ u in α..β, φ' u ^ 2 := by
    intro φ φ' hφ hφ' α β s t hs ht
    have hJ : 0 ≤ ∫ u in α..β, φ' u ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (hs.1.trans hs.2) (fun u _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have key : ∀ s t : ℝ, α ≤ t → t ≤ s → s ≤ β →
        (φ s - φ t) ^ 2 ≤ (β - α) * ∫ u in α..β, φ' u ^ 2 := by
      intro s t hαt hts hsβ
      have hint1 : IntervalIntegrable φ' volume t s := hφ'.intervalIntegrable t s
      have hint2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun u => φ' u ^ 2) volume t s :=
        (hφ'.pow 2).intervalIntegrable t s
      have hI1 : ∫ u in t..s, φ' u = φ s - φ t :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun u _ => hφ u) hint1
      have hmono : ∫ u in t..s, φ' u ^ 2 ≤ ∫ u in α..β, φ' u ^ 2 :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_interval hαt hts hsβ
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u => sq_nonneg _))
          ((hφ'.pow 2).intervalIntegrable α β)
      have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ u in t..s, ((s - t) * φ' u - (φ s - φ t)) ^ 2 :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hts (fun u _ => sq_nonneg _)
      have hexp : ∫ u in t..s, ((s - t) * φ' u - (φ s - φ t)) ^ 2 =
          (s - t) ^ 2 * (∫ u in t..s, φ' u ^ 2) - 2 * (s - t) * (φ s - φ t) * (∫ u in t..s, φ' u)
            + (s - t) * (φ s - φ t) ^ 2 := by
        have hfun : (fun u => ((s - t) * φ' u - (φ s - φ t)) ^ 2) =
            fun u => ((s - t) ^ 2 * φ' u ^ 2 - (2 * (s - t) * (φ s - φ t)) * φ' u)
              + (φ s - φ t) ^ 2 := by
          funext u; ring
        rw [hfun, intervalIntegral.integral_add ((hint2.const_mul _).sub (hint1.const_mul _))
            intervalIntegrable_const,
          intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hint2.const_mul _) (hint1.const_mul _),
          intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
          intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hexp, hI1] at hnn
      have hCS : (φ s - φ t) ^ 2 ≤ (s - t) * ∫ u in t..s, φ' u ^ 2 := by
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hts with h | h
        · subst h
          simp
        · have hδ : 0 < s - t := sub_pos.2 h
          have h2 : 0 ≤ (s - t) * ((s - t) * (∫ u in t..s, φ' u ^ 2) - (φ s - φ t) ^ 2) := by
            nlinarith
          have h3 := (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hδ).1 h2
          linarith
      calc (φ s - φ t) ^ 2 ≤ (s - t) * ∫ u in t..s, φ' u ^ 2 := hCS
        _ ≤ (s - t) * ∫ u in α..β, φ' u ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono (by linarith)
        _ ≤ (β - α) * ∫ u in α..β, φ' u ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hJ
    rcases le_total t s with h | h
    · exact key s t ht.1 h hs.2
    · have := key t s hs.1 h ht.2
      calc (φ s - φ t) ^ 2 = (φ t - φ s) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ _ := this
  
  have two_leg : ∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, (∀ k, x k ∈ Set.Icc (a k) (b k)) →
      (∀ k, y k ∈ Set.Icc (a k) (b k)) →
      (w x - w y) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (b 0 - a 0) * (∫ t in a 0..b 0, (smthGrad w ![t, x 1] 0) ^ 2)
        + 2 * (b 1 - a 1) * ∫ s in a 1..b 1, (smthGrad w ![y 0, s] 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro x y hx hy
    have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ w := hw.differentiable (by norm_num)
    have hfd : Continuous (fun z => fderiv ℝ w z) := hw.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)
    have leg : ∀ (p v : Fin 2 → ℝ), (∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => w (p + t • v))
        (fderiv ℝ w (p + t • v) v) t) ∧
        Continuous (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ w (p + t • v) v) := by
      intro p v
      have hpath : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => p + t • v) v t := by
        intro t
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const v).const_add p
      refine ⟨fun t => ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact (hdiff (p + t • v)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hpath t)
      · exact (hfd.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))).clm_apply
          continuous_const
    have e0 : ∀ t : ℝ, (![0, x 1] : Fin 2 → ℝ) + t • (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) = ![t, x 1] := by
      intro t; funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
    have e1 : ∀ s : ℝ, (![y 0, 0] : Fin 2 → ℝ) + s • (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) = ![y 0, s] := by
      intro s; funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
    obtain ⟨hd0, hc0⟩ := leg ![0, x 1] (Pi.single 0 1)
    obtain ⟨hd1, hc1⟩ := leg ![y 0, 0] (Pi.single 1 1)
    simp only [e0] at hd0 hc0
    simp only [e1] at hd1 hc1
    have hU := h1d (fun t => w ![t, x 1]) (fun t => smthGrad w ![t, x 1] 0) hd0 hc0
      (a 0) (b 0) (x 0) (y 0) (hx 0) (hy 0)
    have hW := h1d (fun s => w ![y 0, s]) (fun s => smthGrad w ![y 0, s] 1) hd1 hc1
      (a 1) (b 1) (x 1) (y 1) (hx 1) (hy 1)
    have hxe : x = ![x 0, x 1] := by funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
    have hye : y = ![y 0, y 1] := by funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
    have hsplit : w x - w y =
        (w ![x 0, x 1] - w ![y 0, x 1]) + (w ![y 0, x 1] - w ![y 0, y 1]) := by
      rw [← hxe, ← hye]; ring
    rw [hsplit]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((w ![x 0, x 1] - w ![y 0, x 1]) - (w ![y 0, x 1] - w ![y 0, y 1]))]
  
  have hvarG : ∀ (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)), volume S ≠ 0 → volume S ≠ ⊤ →
      ∀ (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), IntegrableOn f S → IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) S →
      2 * (volume S).toReal * ∫ x in S, (f x - ⨍ z in S, f z) ^ 2 =
        ∫ x in S, (∫ y in S, (f x - f y) ^ 2) := by
    intro S hS0 hSt f hf hf2
    have hVpos : 0 < (volume S).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos hS0 hSt
    have hc : ∀ c : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun _ : Fin 2 → ℝ => c) S := fun c =>
      integrableOn_const (by simpa [lt_top_iff_ne_top] using hSt)
    have hcI : ∀ c : ℝ, ∫ _ in S, c = (volume S).toReal * c := by
      intro c; rw [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, measureReal_def]
    have hm : ⨍ z in S, f z = (volume S).toReal⁻¹ * ∫ z in S, f z := by
      rw [setAverage_eq, smul_eq_mul, measureReal_def]
    set V := (volume S).toReal
    set I1 := ∫ z in S, f z
    set I2 := ∫ z in S, f z ^ 2
    set m := ⨍ z in S, f z
    have hinner : ∀ x, ∫ y in S, (f x - f y) ^ 2 = V * f x ^ 2 - 2 * f x * I1 + I2 := by
      intro x
      have hfun : (fun y => (f x - f y) ^ 2) =
          fun y => (f x ^ 2 - (2 * f x) * f y) + f y ^ 2 := by
        funext y; ring
      have hi1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => f x ^ 2 - (2 * f x) * f y) S :=
        (hc _).sub (hf.const_mul _)
      have hi2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => (2 * f x) * f y) S := hf.const_mul _
      rw [hfun, integral_add hi1 hf2, integral_sub (hc _) hi2, hcI, integral_const_mul]
    have hrhs : ∫ x in S, (∫ y in S, (f x - f y) ^ 2) = 2 * V * I2 - 2 * I1 ^ 2 := by
      simp_rw [hinner]
      have hfun : (fun x => V * f x ^ 2 - 2 * f x * I1 + I2) =
          fun x => (V * f x ^ 2 - (2 * I1) * f x) + I2 := by
        funext x; ring
      have hi1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => V * f x ^ 2 - (2 * I1) * f x) S :=
        (hf2.const_mul _).sub (hf.const_mul _)
      have hi2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => V * f x ^ 2) S := hf2.const_mul _
      have hi3 : IntegrableOn (fun x => (2 * I1) * f x) S := hf.const_mul _
      rw [hfun, integral_add hi1 (hc _), integral_sub hi2 hi3, integral_const_mul,
        integral_const_mul, hcI]
      ring
    have hlhs : ∫ x in S, (f x - m) ^ 2 = I2 - 2 * m * I1 + V * m ^ 2 := by
      have hfun : (fun x => (f x - m) ^ 2) = fun x => (f x ^ 2 - (2 * m) * f x) + m ^ 2 := by
        funext x; ring
      have hi1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2 - (2 * m) * f x) S := hf2.sub (hf.const_mul _)
      have hi3 : IntegrableOn (fun x => (2 * m) * f x) S := hf.const_mul _
      rw [hfun, integral_add hi1 (hc _), integral_sub hf2 hi3, integral_const_mul, hcI]
    rw [hrhs, hlhs, hm]
    have hV0 : V ≠ 0 := hVpos.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hBF : ∀ H : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Continuous H →
      (∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), H x) =
          ∫ s in a 1..b 1, ∫ t in a 0..b 0, H ![t, s] ∧
      (∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), H x) =
          ∫ t in a 0..b 0, ∫ s in a 1..b 1, H ![t, s] := by
    intro H hH
    have hvc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (![p.1, p.2] : Fin 2 → ℝ)) :=
      continuous_fst.matrixVecCons (continuous_snd.matrixVecCons continuous_const)
    have hGc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => H ![p.1, p.2]) := hH.comp hvc
    have hmp : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow : (Fin 2 → ℝ) ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ)
        volume volume :=
      volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ
    have hpre : Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)) =
        (MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow : (Fin 2 → ℝ) ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ) ⁻¹'
          (Set.Ioo (a 0) (b 0) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (a 1) (b 1)) := by
      ext x
      simp [Fin.forall_fin_two, MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow_apply]
    have key := hmp.setIntegral_preimage_emb MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.measurableEmbedding
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => H ![p.1, p.2]) (Set.Ioo (a 0) (b 0) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (a 1) (b 1))
    have h1 : (∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), H x) =
        ∫ p in Set.Ioo (a 0) (b 0) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (a 1) (b 1), H ![p.1, p.2] := by
      rw [hpre]
      refine Eq.trans ?_ key
      congr 1
      funext x
      congr 1
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow_apply]
    have hint : IntegrableOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => H ![p.1, p.2])
        (Set.Ioo (a 0) (b 0) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (a 1) (b 1)) (volume.prod volume) := by
      rw [← Measure.volume_eq_prod]
      exact (hGc.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)).mono_set
        (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
    have hIoo : ∀ (α β : ℝ), α ≤ β → ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ,
        ∫ u in Set.Ioo α β, g u = ∫ u in α..β, g u := by
      intro α β h g
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le h, integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo]
    have h0le := (hab 0).le
    have h1le := (hab 1).le
    constructor
    · rw [h1, Measure.volume_eq_prod, ← Measure.prod_restrict, integral_prod_symm _ (by
        rw [Measure.prod_restrict]; exact hint)]
      rw [hIoo _ _ h1le]
      congr 1
      funext s
      rw [hIoo _ _ h0le]
    · rw [h1, Measure.volume_eq_prod, setIntegral_prod _ hint, hIoo _ _ h0le]
      congr 1
      funext t
      rw [hIoo _ _ h1le]
  
  have hslice : ∀ F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Continuous F →
      Continuous (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => ∫ t in a 0..b 0, F ![t, x 1]) ∧
      Continuous (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => ∫ s in a 1..b 1, F ![x 0, s]) ∧
      (∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), (∫ t in a 0..b 0, F ![t, x 1])) =
        (b 0 - a 0) * ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), F x ∧
      (∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), (∫ s in a 1..b 1, F ![x 0, s])) =
        (b 1 - a 1) * ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), F x := by
    intro F hF
    have hAc : Continuous (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => ∫ t in a 0..b 0, F ![t, x 1]) :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        (f := fun (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => F ![t, x 1])
        (hF.comp (continuous_snd.matrixVecCons
          (((continuous_apply 1).comp continuous_fst).matrixVecCons continuous_const))) _ _
    have hBc : Continuous (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => ∫ s in a 1..b 1, F ![x 0, s]) :=
      intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        (f := fun (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (s : ℝ) => F ![x 0, s])
        (hF.comp (((continuous_apply 0).comp continuous_fst).matrixVecCons
          (continuous_snd.matrixVecCons continuous_const))) _ _
    refine ⟨hAc, hBc, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [(hBF _ hAc).1, (hBF F hF).1, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      funext s
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
    · rw [(hBF _ hBc).2, (hBF F hF).2, ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      funext t
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hwc : Continuous w := hw.continuous
  have hdc : ∀ k : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad w x k) := fun k =>
    (hw.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hg0c : Continuous (fun x => (smthGrad w x 0) ^ 2) := (hdc 0).pow 2
  have hg1c : Continuous (fun x => (smthGrad w x 1) ^ 2) := (hdc 1).pow 2
  obtain ⟨hA0c, -, hA0int, -⟩ := hslice (fun x => (smthGrad w x 0) ^ 2) hg0c
  obtain ⟨-, hB1c, -, hB1int⟩ := hslice (fun x => (smthGrad w x 1) ^ 2) hg1c
  have hvar := hvarG (Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)))
  set Q : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ) := Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)) with hQdef
  have hQm : MeasurableSet Q := MeasurableSet.univ_pi (fun k => measurableSet_Ioo)
  have hK : IsCompact (Set.univ.pi (fun k : Fin 2 => Set.Icc (a k) (b k))) :=
    isCompact_univ_pi (fun k => isCompact_Icc)
  have hQK : Q ⊆ Set.univ.pi (fun k : Fin 2 => Set.Icc (a k) (b k)) :=
    Set.pi_mono (fun k _ => Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
  have IntQ : ∀ H : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Continuous H → IntegrableOn H Q := fun H hH =>
    (hH.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK).mono_set hQK
  have hl0 : 0 < b 0 - a 0 := sub_pos.2 (hab 0)
  have hl1 : 0 < b 1 - a 1 := sub_pos.2 (hab 1)
  have hV : (volume Q).toReal = (b 0 - a 0) * (b 1 - a 1) := by
    rw [hQdef, Real.volume_pi_Ioo_toReal (fun k => (hab k).le), Fin.prod_univ_two]
  have hVpos : 0 < (volume Q).toReal := by rw [hV]; positivity
  have hQ0 : volume Q ≠ 0 := (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.1 hVpos).1.ne'
  have hQt : volume Q ≠ ⊤ := (ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff.1 hVpos).2.ne
  have hconst : ∀ c : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun _ : Fin 2 → ℝ => c) Q := fun c =>
    IntQ _ continuous_const
  have hcI : ∀ c : ℝ, ∫ _ in Q, c = (volume Q).toReal * c := by
    intro c
    rw [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, measureReal_def]
  
  have s6 : ∀ x ∈ Q, ∫ y in Q, (w x - w y) ^ 2 ≤
      (volume Q).toReal * (2 * (b 0 - a 0) * (∫ t in a 0..b 0, (smthGrad w ![t, x 1] 0) ^ 2))
        + 2 * (b 1 - a 1) * ((b 1 - a 1) * ∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 1) ^ 2) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxI : ∀ k, x k ∈ Set.Icc (a k) (b k) := fun k =>
      Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hx k (Set.mem_univ k))
    calc ∫ y in Q, (w x - w y) ^ 2
        ≤ ∫ y in Q, (2 * (b 0 - a 0) * (∫ t in a 0..b 0, (smthGrad w ![t, x 1] 0) ^ 2)
            + 2 * (b 1 - a 1) * ∫ s in a 1..b 1, (smthGrad w ![y 0, s] 1) ^ 2) := by
          refine setIntegral_mono_on (IntQ _ ((continuous_const.sub hwc).pow 2))
            (IntQ _ (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul hB1c))) hQm ?_
          intro y hy
          have hyI : ∀ k, y k ∈ Set.Icc (a k) (b k) := fun k =>
            Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self (hy k (Set.mem_univ k))
          exact two_leg x y hxI hyI
      _ = (volume Q).toReal * (2 * (b 0 - a 0) * (∫ t in a 0..b 0, (smthGrad w ![t, x 1] 0) ^ 2))
            + 2 * (b 1 - a 1) * ((b 1 - a 1) * ∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 1) ^ 2) := by
          rw [integral_add (hconst _) ((IntQ _ hB1c).const_mul _), hcI, integral_const_mul,
            hB1int]
  
  have s7 : ∫ x in Q, (∫ y in Q, (w x - w y) ^ 2) ≤
      ∫ x in Q, ((volume Q).toReal * (2 * (b 0 - a 0) *
          (∫ t in a 0..b 0, (smthGrad w ![t, x 1] 0) ^ 2))
        + 2 * (b 1 - a 1) * ((b 1 - a 1) * ∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 1) ^ 2)) := by
    refine integral_mono_of_nonneg ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => integral_nonneg (fun y => sq_nonneg _))
    · exact IntQ _ ((continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.mul hA0c)).add continuous_const)
    · exact (ae_restrict_iff' hQm).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall s6)
  have s7eq : ∫ x in Q, ((volume Q).toReal * (2 * (b 0 - a 0) *
          (∫ t in a 0..b 0, (smthGrad w ![t, x 1] 0) ^ 2))
        + 2 * (b 1 - a 1) * ((b 1 - a 1) * ∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 1) ^ 2)) =
      (volume Q).toReal * (2 * (b 0 - a 0) * ((b 0 - a 0) * ∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 0) ^ 2))
        + (volume Q).toReal * (2 * (b 1 - a 1) * ((b 1 - a 1) * ∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 1) ^ 2)) := by
    rw [integral_add (((IntQ _ hA0c).const_mul _).const_mul _) (hconst _), hcI,
      integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, hA0int]
  
  have hvar' := hvar hQ0 hQt w (IntQ w hwc) (IntQ _ (hwc.pow 2))
  have hsum : ∫ x in Q, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 =
      (∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 0) ^ 2) + ∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 1) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    exact integral_add (IntQ _ hg0c) (IntQ _ hg1c)
  have hG0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 0) ^ 2 :=
    setIntegral_nonneg hQm (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hG1 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 1) ^ 2 :=
    setIntegral_nonneg hQm (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hL0 : (b 0 - a 0) ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hl0.le (hL 0) 2
  have hL1 : (b 1 - a 1) ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hl1.le (hL 1) 2
  rw [hsum]
  set I := ∫ x in Q, (w x - ⨍ z in Q, w z) ^ 2 with hI
  set G0 := ∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 0) ^ 2 with hG0def
  set G1 := ∫ x in Q, (smthGrad w x 1) ^ 2 with hG1def
  set V := (volume Q).toReal with hVdef
  have hmain : 2 * V * I ≤ 2 * V * ((b 0 - a 0) ^ 2 * G0 + (b 1 - a 1) ^ 2 * G1) := by
    rw [hvar']
    calc _ ≤ _ := s7
      _ = _ := s7eq
      _ = 2 * V * ((b 0 - a 0) ^ 2 * G0 + (b 1 - a 1) ^ 2 * G1) := by ring
  have hI' : I ≤ (b 0 - a 0) ^ 2 * G0 + (b 1 - a 1) ^ 2 * G1 :=
    le_of_mul_le_mul_left hmain (by positivity)
  have h0 : (b 0 - a 0) ^ 2 * G0 ≤ L ^ 2 * G0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL0 hG0
  have h1 : (b 1 - a 1) ^ 2 * G1 ≤ L ^ 2 * G1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL1 hG1
  calc I ≤ (b 0 - a 0) ^ 2 * G0 + (b 1 - a 1) ^ 2 * G1 := hI'
    _ ≤ L ^ 2 * G0 + L ^ 2 * G1 := add_le_add h0 h1
    _ = L ^ 2 * (G0 + G1) := by ring

informal_problem.statement: (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ 1 w) (hbox : ∀ (a b : Fin 2 → ℝ) (L : ℝ), (∀ k, a k < b k) → (∀ k, b k - a k ≤ L) → ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), (w x - ⨍ z in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), w z) ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : ∃ c : ℝ, (∀ M : ℝ, (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r, |w x| ≤ M) → |c| ≤ M) ∧ ∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r, (w x - c) ^ 2 ≤ 8320 * r ^ 2 * ∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2

signature.statement: (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ 1 w) (hbox : ∀ (a b : Fin 2 → ℝ) (L : ℝ), (∀ k, a k < b k) → (∀ k, b k - a k ≤ L) → ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), (w x - ⨍ z in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), w z) ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) : ∃ c : ℝ, (∀ M : ℝ, (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r, |w x| ≤ M) → |c| ≤ M) ∧ ∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r, (w x - c) ^ 2 ≤ 8320 * r ^ 2 * ∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hwc : Continuous w := hw.continuous
  have hGc : Continuous (fun x => ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) := by
    have hfd : Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ w x) := hw.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)
    refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => ?_)
    have : Continuous (fun x => smthGrad w x k) := by
      show Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ w x (Pi.single k 1))
      exact hfd.clm_apply continuous_const
    exact this.pow 2
  have hGnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 :=
    fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hint : ∀ h : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Continuous h → ∀ X ⊆ Metric.closedBall y (2 * r),
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn h X :=

  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons] at vT vB vL vR vS1 vS2 vS3
  
  have h1T := hsubB ![y 0 - 2 * r, y 1 + r] ![y 0 - r, y 1 + 2 * r]
    ![y 0 - 2 * r, y 1 + r] ![y 0 + 2 * r, y 1 + 2 * r]
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
  have h1L := hsubB ![y 0 - 2 * r, y 1 + r] ![y 0 - r, y 1 + 2 * r]
    ![y 0 - 2 * r, y 1 - 2 * r] ![y 0 - r, y 1 + 2 * r]
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
  have h2T := hsubB ![y 0 + r, y 1 + r] ![y 0 + 2 * r, y 1 + 2 * r]
    ![y 0 - 2 * r, y 1 + r] ![y 0 + 2 * r, y 1 + 2 * r]
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
  have h2R := hsubB ![y 0 + r, y 1 + r] ![y 0 + 2 * r, y 1 + 2 * r]
    ![y 0 + r, y 1 - 2 * r] ![y 0 + 2 * r, y 1 + 2 * r]
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
  have h3L := hsubB ![y 0 - 2 * r, y 1 - 2 * r] ![y 0 - r, y 1 - r]
    ![y 0 - 2 * r, y 1 - 2 * r] ![y 0 - r, y 1 + 2 * r]
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
  have h3B := hsubB ![y 0 - 2 * r, y 1 - 2 * r] ![y 0 - r, y 1 - r]
    ![y 0 - 2 * r, y 1 - 2 * r] ![y 0 + 2 * r, y 1 - r]
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
  
  have VT := hboxA _ _ hTlt (hle _ _
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)) hTA
  have VB := hboxA _ _ hBlt (hle _ _
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)) hBA
  have VL := hboxA _ _ hLlt (hle _ _
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)) hLA
  have VR := hboxA _ _ hRlt (hle _ _
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; linarith)) hRA
  refine ⟨⨍ z in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (![y 0 - 2 * r, y 1 + r] k)
    (![y 0 + 2 * r, y 1 + 2 * r] k)), w z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro M hM
    have hpos : 0 < (MeasureTheory.volume (Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo

  · exact core _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (hBm _ _) (hBm _ _) (hBm _ _) (hBm _ _) (hBm _ _) (hBm _ _)

informal_problem.statement: (θ C₄ R₁ : ℝ) (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hC₄ : 0 ≤ C₄) (hR₁ : 0 < R₁) : ∃ β A : ℝ, 0 < β ∧ β ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ s t : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ t → t ≤ R₁ → Φ s ≤ Φ t) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ R₁ → 0 ≤ Φ r) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ R₁ / 2 → Φ r ≤ θ * Φ (2 * r) + C₄ * r ^ 2) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ R₁ → Φ r ≤ A * (Φ R₁ + 1) * r ^ β

signature.name: slh_holefill_iter
signature.statement: (θ C₄ R₁ : ℝ) (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hC₄ : 0 ≤ C₄) (hR₁ : 0 < R₁) : ∃ β A : ℝ, 0 < β ∧ β ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ s t : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ t → t ≤ R₁ → Φ s ≤ Φ t) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ R₁ → 0 ≤ Φ r) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ R₁ / 2 → Φ r ≤ θ * Φ (2 * r) + C₄ * r ^ 2) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ R₁ → Φ r ≤ A * (Φ R₁ + 1) * r ^ β

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀def⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ, q = max θ (1 / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hq₀half : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ q₀ := hq₀def ▸ le_max_right _ _
  have hθq₀ : θ ≤ q₀ := hq₀def ▸ le_max_left _ _
  have hq₀pos : 0 < q₀ := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hq₀half
  have hq₀lt1 : q₀ < 1 := hq₀def ▸ max_lt hθ1 (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨β, hβdef⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = -Real.logb 2 q₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hqβ : (2 : ℝ) ^ (-β) = q₀ := by
    rw [hβdef, neg_neg]; exact Real.rpow_logb (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hq₀pos
  have hβ0 : 0 < β := by
    have := Real.logb_neg (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2) hq₀pos hq₀lt1
    linarith
  have hβ1 : β ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 : Real.logb 2 (1 / 2 : ℝ) = -1 := by
      rw [one_div, Real.logb_inv, Real.logb_self_eq_one (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)]
    have h2 := Real.logb_le_logb_of_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2) hq₀half
    linarith
  have hhalfβ : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ β = q₀ := by
    rw [← hqβ, one_div, Real.inv_rpow (by norm_num), Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num)]
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, m = max 1 (C₄ * R₁ ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := hMdef ▸ le_max_left _ _
  have hMC : C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 ≤ M := hMdef ▸ le_max_right _ _
  have hRβ : 0 < R₁ ^ β := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hR₁ β
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by linarith
  refine ⟨β, 2 * M / R₁ ^ β, hβ0, hβ1, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro Φ hmono hnn hrec r hr0 hrR
  have hD : 0 ≤ C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hΦR : 0 ≤ Φ R₁ := hnn R₁ hR₁ le_rfl
  
  have hiter : ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, 0 ≤ a 0 →
      (∀ k : ℕ, a (k + 1) ≤ θ * a k + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 / 4) ^ (k + 1)) →
      ∀ k : ℕ, a k ≤ q₀ ^ k * (a 0 + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2) := by
    intro a ha0 hr
    have hstar : ∀ k : ℕ, a k ≤ q₀ ^ k * (a 0 + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 - (1 / 2) ^ k)) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        have hqk : 0 ≤ q₀ ^ k := pow_nonneg hq₀pos.le k
        have hp : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        have hB : 0 ≤ q₀ ^ k * (a 0 + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 - (1 / 2) ^ k)) :=
          mul_nonneg hqk (by nlinarith)
        have h1 : θ * a k ≤ q₀ * (q₀ ^ k * (a 0 + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 - (1 / 2) ^ k))) :=
          calc θ * a k ≤ θ * (q₀ ^ k * (a 0 + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 - (1 / 2) ^ k))) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hθ0
            _ ≤ q₀ * (q₀ ^ k * (a 0 + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 - (1 / 2) ^ k))) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hθq₀ hB
        have hpq : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) ≤ q₀ ^ (k + 1) :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hq₀half (k + 1)
        have h4 : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) = (1 / 2) ^ (k + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ (k + 1) := by
          rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
        have h5 : C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) ≤
            C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 / 2) ^ (k + 1) * q₀ ^ (k + 1) := by
          rw [h4, ← mul_assoc]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpq (by positivity)
        calc a (k + 1) ≤ θ * a k + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 / 4) ^ (k + 1) := hr k
          _ ≤ q₀ * (q₀ ^ k * (a 0 + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 - (1 / 2) ^ k))) +
              C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 / 2) ^ (k + 1) * q₀ ^ (k + 1) := by linarith
          _ = q₀ ^ (k + 1) * (a 0 + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 - (1 / 2) ^ (k + 1))) := by ring
    intro k
    have hqk : 0 ≤ q₀ ^ k := pow_nonneg hq₀pos.le k
    have hpk : 0 ≤ C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
    calc a k ≤ q₀ ^ k * (a 0 + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 - (1 / 2) ^ k)) := hstar k
      _ ≤ q₀ ^ k * (a 0 + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hqk
          nlinarith
  
  have hrec' : ∀ k : ℕ, Φ (R₁ / 2 ^ (k + 1)) ≤
      θ * Φ (R₁ / 2 ^ k) + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 / 4) ^ (k + 1) := by
    intro k
    have h2pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (k + 1) := by positivity
    have hs0 : 0 < R₁ / 2 ^ (k + 1) := div_pos hR₁ h2pos
    have hs1 : R₁ / 2 ^ (k + 1) ≤ R₁ / 2 := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hR₁.le (by norm_num)
      calc (2 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 1 := by norm_num
        _ ≤ 2 ^ (k + 1) := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    have h := hrec _ hs0 hs1
    have e1 : 2 * (R₁ / 2 ^ (k + 1)) = R₁ / 2 ^ k := by
      rw [pow_succ]; field_simp
    have h4 : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) = (1 / 2) ^ (k + 1) * (1 / 2) ^ (k + 1) := by
      rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
    have e2 : C₄ * (R₁ / 2 ^ (k + 1)) ^ 2 = C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 * (1 / 4) ^ (k + 1) := by
      rw [h4, div_eq_mul_one_div R₁, ← one_div_pow]; ring
    rw [e1, e2] at h
    exact h
  have hseq := hiter (fun k => Φ (R₁ / 2 ^ k)) (by simpa using hΦR) hrec'
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := exists_nat_pow_near
    (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ R₁ / r from (one_le_div hr0).mpr hrR) (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
  have h2k : (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ k := by positivity
  have hrk : r ≤ R₁ / 2 ^ k := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h2k]; rw [le_div_iff₀ hr0] at hk1; linarith
  have hkr : R₁ / 2 ^ (k + 1) < r := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]; rw [div_lt_iff₀ hr0] at hk2; linarith
  have hmon : Φ r ≤ Φ (R₁ / 2 ^ k) :=
    hmono r (R₁ / 2 ^ k) hr0 hrk (div_le_self hR₁.le (one_le_pow₀ one_le_two))
  have hak : Φ (R₁ / 2 ^ k) ≤ q₀ ^ k * (Φ R₁ + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2) := by
    have := hseq k
    simpa using this
  
  have hgeom : q₀ ^ k ≤ 2 * (r ^ β / R₁ ^ β) := by
    have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2) ^ (k + 1) := by positivity
    have ht : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) ≤ r / R₁ := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hR₁, one_div_pow]
      have : 1 / 2 ^ (k + 1) * R₁ = R₁ / 2 ^ (k + 1) := by ring
      linarith
    have h1 := Real.rpow_le_rpow ht0 ht hβ0.le
    rw [Real.div_rpow hr0.le hR₁.le, ← Real.rpow_pow_comm (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2),
      hhalfβ] at h1
    have hqk : 0 ≤ q₀ ^ k := pow_nonneg hq₀pos.le k
    calc q₀ ^ k ≤ q₀ ^ k * (2 * q₀) := le_mul_of_one_le_right hqk (by linarith)
      _ = 2 * q₀ ^ (k + 1) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * (r ^ β / R₁ ^ β) := by linarith
  
  have hE : Φ R₁ + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 ≤ M * (Φ R₁ + 1) := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hM1) hΦR]
  have hEnn : 0 ≤ Φ R₁ + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hfac : 0 ≤ 2 * (r ^ β / R₁ ^ β) := by
    have := Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le β
    positivity
  calc Φ r ≤ Φ (R₁ / 2 ^ k) := hmon
    _ ≤ q₀ ^ k * (Φ R₁ + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2) := hak
    _ ≤ 2 * (r ^ β / R₁ ^ β) * (Φ R₁ + C₄ * R₁ ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgeom hEnn
    _ ≤ 2 * (r ^ β / R₁ ^ β) * (M * (Φ R₁ + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE hfac
    _ = 2 * M / R₁ ^ β * (Φ R₁ + 1) * r ^ β := by ring

informal_problem.statement: (ρ₁ M α : ℝ) (hρ₁ : 0 < ρ₁) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ 1 w) (hbox : ∀ (a b : Fin 2 → ℝ) (L : ℝ), (∀ k, a k < b k) → (∀ k, b k - a k ≤ L) → ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), (w x - ⨍ z in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), w z) ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) (y y' : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hy : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ ρ₁ → ∫ x in Metric.ball y r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤ M * r ^ (2 * α)) (hy' : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ ρ₁ → ∫ x in Metric.ball y' r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤ M * r ^ (2 * α)) (hd : dist y y' < ρ₁ / 2) : |w y - w y'| ≤ 16 * Real.sqrt M / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) * dist y y' ^ α

signature.name: slh_morrey
signature.statement: (ρ₁ M α : ℝ) (hρ₁ : 0 < ρ₁) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hα : 0 < α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ 1 w) (hbox : ∀ (a b : Fin 2 → ℝ) (L : ℝ), (∀ k, a k < b k) → (∀ k, b k - a k ≤ L) → ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), (w x - ⨍ z in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), w z) ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 * ∫ x in Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (a k) (b k)), ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) (y y' : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hy : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ ρ₁ → ∫ x in Metric.ball y r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤ M * r ^ (2 * α)) (hy' : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ ρ₁ → ∫ x in Metric.ball y' r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤ M * r ^ (2 * α)) (hd : dist y y' < ρ₁ / 2) : |w y - w y'| ≤ 16 * Real.sqrt M / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) * dist y y' ^ α

proof.tactics:
by
  have hwc : Continuous w := hw.continuous
  have hq0 : 0 < (2:ℝ) ^ (-α) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hq1 : (2:ℝ) ^ (-α) < 1 := Real.rpow_lt_one_of_one_lt_of_neg (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hD : 0 < 1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-α) := by linarith
  
  have hint : ∀ (g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), Continuous g → ∀ c r,
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn g (Metric.ball c r) :=
    fun g hg c r => (hg.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall c r)).mono_set
      Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  
  have hV : ∀ (c : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      MeasureTheory.volume.real (Metric.ball c r) = (2 * r) ^ 2 := by
    intro c r hr
    rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, Real.volume_pi_ball c hr]
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)
  
  have hav : ∀ (c : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (k : ℝ),
      Continuous f → ⨍ u in Metric.ball c r, (f u - k) = (⨍ u in Metric.ball c r, f u) - k := by
    intro c r hr f k hf
    rw [MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq, MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq,
      MeasureTheory.integral_sub (hint f hf c r) (hint _ continuous_const c r),
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, hV c r hr, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_sub]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  
  have tele : ∀ (a : ℝ → ℝ) (L B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B →
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ₁ → |a (s / 2) - a s| ≤ B * s ^ α) →
      Filter.Tendsto a (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds L) →
      ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ₁ → |L - a s| ≤ B * s ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) := by
    intro a L B hB hhalf hlim s hs hsρ
    have hsn_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < s / 2 ^ n := fun n => by positivity
    have hsn_le : ∀ n : ℕ, s / 2 ^ n ≤ s := fun n => div_le_self hs.le (one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num))
    have hsucc : ∀ n : ℕ, s / 2 ^ (n + 1) = s / 2 ^ n / 2 := fun n => by
      rw [pow_succ, div_div]
    have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, (s / 2 ^ n) ^ α = s ^ α * ((2:ℝ) ^ (-α)) ^ n := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [hsucc, Real.div_rpow (hsn_pos n).le (by norm_num), ih, Real.rpow_neg (by norm_num),
          pow_succ]
        field_simp
    have hP : ∀ n : ℕ, |a (s / 2 ^ n) - a s| * (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-α)) ≤
        B * s ^ α * (1 - ((2:ℝ) ^ (-α)) ^ n) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih =>
        have h1 := hhalf (s / 2 ^ n) (hsn_pos n) ((hsn_le n).trans hsρ)
        rw [hpow n] at h1
        rw [hsucc]
        have htri : |a (s / 2 ^ n / 2) - a s| ≤
            |a (s / 2 ^ n / 2) - a (s / 2 ^ n)| + |a (s / 2 ^ n) - a s| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
        calc |a (s / 2 ^ n / 2) - a s| * (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-α))
            ≤ (|a (s / 2 ^ n / 2) - a (s / 2 ^ n)| + |a (s / 2 ^ n) - a s|) *
                (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-α)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htri hD.le
          _ = |a (s / 2 ^ n / 2) - a (s / 2 ^ n)| * (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-α)) +
                |a (s / 2 ^ n) - a s| * (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-α)) := by ring
          _ ≤ B * (s ^ α * ((2:ℝ) ^ (-α)) ^ n) * (1 - (2:ℝ) ^ (-α)) +
                B * s ^ α * (1 - ((2:ℝ) ^ (-α)) ^ n) :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hD.le) ih
          _ = B * s ^ α * (1 - ((2:ℝ) ^ (-α)) ^ (n + 1)) := by ring
    have hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, |a (s / 2 ^ n) - a s| ≤ B * s ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) := by
      intro n
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hD]
      have hqn : 0 ≤ ((2:ℝ) ^ (-α)) ^ n := pow_nonneg hq0.le n
      have hBs : 0 ≤ B * s ^ α := mul_nonneg hB (Real.rpow_nonneg hs.le _)
      nlinarith [hP n]
    have hsn_t : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => s / 2 ^ n) Filter.atTop
        (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) := by
      rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
      refine ⟨(tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) < 2)).const_div_atTop s, ?_⟩
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => hsn_pos n)
    have hT : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => |a (s / 2 ^ n) - a s|) Filter.atTop
        (nhds (|L - a s|)) :=
      ((hlim.comp hsn_t).sub_const (a s)).abs
    exact le_of_tendsto' hT hbound
  
  have avgT : ∀ z : Fin 2 → ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ⨍ x in Metric.ball z s, w x)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (w z)) := by
    intro z
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδw⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.1 hwc.continuousAt (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hδ] with s hs
    have hs0 : 0 < s := hs.1
    rw [Real.dist_eq, ← hav z s hs0 w (w z) hwc, MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq, hV z s hs0,
      smul_eq_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    have hb := MeasureTheory.norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
      (s := Metric.ball z s) (f := fun u => w u - w z) (C := ε / 2)
      (by rw [Real.volume_pi_ball z hs0]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top)
      (fun u hu => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← Real.dist_eq]
        exact (hδw (lt_trans (Metric.mem_ball.1 hu) hs.2)).le)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hV z s hs0] at hb
    calc ((2 * s) ^ 2)⁻¹ * |∫ x in Metric.ball z s, (w x - w z)|
        ≤ ((2 * s) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (ε / 2 * (2 * s) ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by positivity)
      _ = ε / 2 := by field_simp
      _ < ε := half_lt_self hε
  
  have cmp : ∀ (z x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t s : ℝ), 0 < t → 0 < s →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball z s, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤ M * s ^ (2 * α) →
      Metric.ball x t ⊆ Metric.ball z s →
      |(⨍ u in Metric.ball x t, w u) - ⨍ u in Metric.ball z s, w u| ≤
        s / t * (Real.sqrt M * s ^ α) := by
    intro z x t s ht hs hz hsub
    have hQ : Metric.ball z s = Set.univ.pi (fun k => Set.Ioo (z k - s) (z k + s)) := by
      rw [ball_pi z hs]
      congr 1
      funext k
      exact Real.ball_eq_Ioo _ _
    have h1 := hbox (fun k => z k - s) (fun k => z k + s) (2 * s)
      (fun k => by show z k - s < z k + s; linarith)
      (fun k => by show z k + s - (z k - s) ≤ 2 * s; linarith)
    beta_reduce at h1
    rw [← hQ] at h1
    set m := ⨍ u in Metric.ball z s, w u with hm
    have hfc : Continuous (fun u => w u - m) := hwc.sub continuous_const
    have hS0 : MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball x t) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Real.volume_pi_ball x ht]; simp; positivity
    have hStop : MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball x t) ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [Real.volume_pi_ball x ht]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    have hJ := ConvexOn.map_set_average_le (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (t := Metric.ball x t)
      (f := fun u => w u - m)
      (Even.convexOn_pow (𝕜 := ℝ) even_two) (continuous_pow 2).continuousOn isClosed_univ hS0
      hStop (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)) (hint _ hfc x t)
      (hint _ ((continuous_pow 2).comp hfc) x t)
    simp only at hJ
    rw [hav x t ht w m hwc,
      MeasureTheory.setAverage_eq MeasureTheory.volume (fun u => (w u - m) ^ 2), hV x t ht,
      smul_eq_mul] at hJ
    have hmono : ∫ u in Metric.ball x t, (w u - m) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ u in Metric.ball z s, (w u - m) ^ 2 :=
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set (hint _ (hfc.pow 2) z s)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u => sq_nonneg _)) hsub.eventuallyLE
    have hsq : s ^ (2 * α) = (s ^ α) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul hs.le]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    have hG : (2 * s) ^ 2 * ∫ x in Metric.ball z s, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤
        (2 * s) ^ 2 * (M * s ^ (2 * α)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz (by positivity)
    have key : ((⨍ u in Metric.ball x t, w u) - m) ^ 2 ≤ (s / t * (Real.sqrt M * s ^ α)) ^ 2 := by
      calc ((⨍ u in Metric.ball x t, w u) - m) ^ 2
          ≤ ((2 * t) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ u in Metric.ball x t, (w u - m) ^ 2 := hJ
        _ ≤ ((2 * t) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((2 * s) ^ 2 * (M * s ^ (2 * α))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hmono.trans (h1.trans hG)) (by positivity)
        _ = (s / t * (Real.sqrt M * s ^ α)) ^ 2 := by
            rw [hsq, show (s / t * (Real.sqrt M * s ^ α)) ^ 2 =
                (s / t) ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt M) ^ 2 * (s ^ α) ^ 2 by ring, Real.sq_sqrt hM]
            field_simp
    exact abs_le_of_sq_le_sq key (by positivity)
  
  have osc : ∀ z : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ ρ₁ → ∫ x in Metric.ball z r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤
        M * r ^ (2 * α)) →
      ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ₁ →
        |w z - ⨍ x in Metric.ball z s, w x| ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt M * s ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) := by
    intro z hz
    refine tele (fun s => ⨍ x in Metric.ball z s, w x) (w z) (2 * Real.sqrt M) (by positivity)
      ?_ (avgT z)
    intro s hs hsρ
    have h := cmp z z (s / 2) s (by positivity) hs (hz s hs hsρ)
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))
    have h2 : s / (s / 2) = 2 := by field_simp
    rw [h2] at h
    calc |(⨍ x in Metric.ball z (s / 2), w x) - ⨍ x in Metric.ball z s, w x|
        ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt M * s ^ α) := h
      _ = 2 * Real.sqrt M * s ^ α := by ring
  
  have hsM : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt M := Real.sqrt_nonneg M
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (dist_nonneg : 0 ≤ dist y y') with h0 | hpos
  · have hyy : y = y' := dist_eq_zero.1 h0.symm
    subst hyy
    rw [sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (by positivity) hD.le) (Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg _)
  · have h2d : 0 < 2 * dist y y' := by linarith
    have h2dρ : 2 * dist y y' ≤ ρ₁ := by linarith
    have E1 := osc y hy (2 * dist y y') h2d h2dρ
    have E2 := osc y' hy' (2 * dist y y') h2d h2dρ
    have hsub1 : Metric.ball y (dist y y') ⊆ Metric.ball y (2 * dist y y') :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
    have hsub2 : Metric.ball y (dist y y') ⊆ Metric.ball y' (2 * dist y y') := by
      intro u hu
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hu ⊢
      calc dist u y' ≤ dist u y + dist y y' := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < 2 * dist y y' := by linarith
    have E3 := cmp y y (dist y y') (2 * dist y y') hpos h2d (hy _ h2d h2dρ) hsub1
    have E4 := cmp y' y (dist y y') (2 * dist y y') hpos h2d (hy' _ h2d h2dρ) hsub2
    have h2 : 2 * dist y y' / dist y y' = 2 := by field_simp
    rw [h2] at E3 E4
    have hX0 : 0 ≤ (2 * dist y y') ^ α := Real.rpow_nonneg h2d.le _
    have hmain : |w y - w y'| ≤
        4 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y') ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) +
          4 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y') ^ α := by
      have e1 := abs_le.1 E1
      have e2 := abs_le.1 E2
      have e3 := abs_le.1 E3
      have e4 := abs_le.1 E4
      have hsplit : 4 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y') ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) =
          2 * (2 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y') ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α))) := by ring
      rw [hsplit]
      refine abs_le.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · nlinarith
      · nlinarith
    have hle : 4 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y') ^ α ≤
        4 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y') ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) :=
      le_div_self (by positivity) hD (by linarith)
    have hX : (2 * dist y y') ^ α ≤ 2 * dist y y' ^ α := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) dist_nonneg]
      have h2a := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2) hα1
      rw [Real.rpow_one] at h2a
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2a (Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg _)
    have hfin : 8 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y') ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) ≤
        8 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y' ^ α) / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX (by positivity)) hD.le
    have hsum : 4 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y') ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) +
        4 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y') ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) =
        8 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y') ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) := by ring
    calc |w y - w y'|
        ≤ 8 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y') ^ α / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) := by linarith
      _ ≤ 8 * Real.sqrt M * (2 * dist y y' ^ α) / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) := hfin
      _ = 16 * Real.sqrt M / (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-α)) * dist y y' ^ α := by ring

informal_problem.statement: (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (R M₀ C₁ C₂ Cη CP : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hM₀ : 0 ≤ M₀) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁) (hC₂ : 0 ≤ C₂) (hCη : 0 ≤ Cη) (hCP : 0 ≤ CP) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ 1 w) (hwb : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R, |w x| ≤ M₀) (hcacc : ∀ (η : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (c : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 η → HasCompactSupport η → tsupport η ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R → |c| ≤ M₀ → ∫ x, η x ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤ C₁ * (∫ x, (w x - c) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2) + C₂ * ∫ x, η x ^ 2) (hcut : ∀ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ η : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 η ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ tsupport η ⊆ Metric.closedBall y (7 * r / 4) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ η x ∧ η x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall y r, η x = 1 ∧ smthGrad η x = 0) ∧ (∀ x, ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2 ≤ Cη / r ^ 2)) (hpoinc : ∀ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ c : ℝ, (∀ M : ℝ, (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r, |w x| ≤ M) → |c| ≤ M) ∧ ∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r, (w x - c) ^ 2 ≤ CP * r ^ 2 * ∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (R / 8), (∫ x in Metric.ball y (R / 4), ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤ 16 * C₁ * Cη * M₀ ^ 2 + C₂ * R ^ 2) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ R / 8 → ∫ x in Metric.ball y r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤ C₁ * Cη * CP / (1 + C₁ * Cη * CP) * (∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r), ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) + 16 * C₂ / (1 + C₁ * Cη * CP) * r ^ 2
