proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (η : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ), x ∉ tsupport η → smthGrad η x = 0 := by
    intro η x hx
    have h : fderiv ℝ η x = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hx (support_fderiv_subset ℝ (Function.mem_support.mpr hne))
    funext k
    show fderiv ℝ η x (Pi.single k 1) = 0
    rw [h]
    rfl
  
  have s2 : ∀ (f η : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)), MeasurableSet S → Continuous f →
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → Continuous η → HasCompactSupport η → (∀ x ∈ S, η x = 1) →
      ∫ x in S, f x ≤ ∫ x, η x ^ 2 * f x := by
    intro f η S hS hf hf0 hη hηc hη1
    have hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => η x ^ 2 * f x) := by
      have hc : Continuous (fun x => η x ^ 2 * f x) := (hη.pow 2).mul hf
      have hcs : HasCompactSupport (fun x => η x ^ 2 * f x) := by
        have e : (fun x => η x ^ 2 * f x) = η * (fun x => η x * f x) := by
          funext x; simp only [Pi.mul_apply]; ring
        rw [e]; exact hηc.mul_right
      exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs
    calc ∫ x in S, f x = ∫ x in S, η x ^ 2 * f x := by
          refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hS (fun x hx => ?_)
          simp [hη1 x hx]
      _ ≤ ∫ x, η x ^ 2 * f x :=
          MeasureTheory.setIntegral_le_integral hint
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hf0 x)))
  
  have s3 : ∀ (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (ρ B : ℝ), 0 ≤ ρ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) →
      (∀ x ∉ Metric.closedBall y ρ, F x = 0) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall y ρ, F x ≤ B) →
      ∫ x, F x ≤ B * (2 * ρ) ^ 2 := by
    intro F y ρ B hρ hF0 hout hle
    rw [← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hout]
    have hvol : MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.closedBall y ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * ρ) ^ 2) := by
      rw [Real.volume_pi_closedBall y hρ]; simp
    calc ∫ x in Metric.closedBall y ρ, F x ≤ ∫ x in Metric.closedBall y ρ, B := by
          refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hF0) ?_ ?_
          · exact continuous_const.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall y ρ)
          · exact (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_closedBall).2
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hle)
      _ = B * (2 * ρ) ^ 2 := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def, hvol,
            ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity), smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  
  have s4 : ∀ (g η : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r Cη' : ℝ), 0 < r → Continuous g →
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall y r, smthGrad η x = 0) →
      (∀ x ∉ Metric.closedBall y (7 * r / 4), smthGrad η x = 0) →
      (∀ x, ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2 ≤ Cη' / r ^ 2) →
      ∫ x, g x * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2 ≤
        Cη' / r ^ 2 * ∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r, g x := by
    intro g η y r Cη' hr hg hg0 hin hout hgrad
    have hzero : ∀ x ∉ Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r,
        g x * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have h0 : smthGrad η x = 0 := by
        by_cases h1 : x ∈ Metric.closedBall y r
        · exact hin x h1
        · apply hout
          intro h2
          exact hx ⟨Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) h2, h1⟩
      simp [h0]
    rw [← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hzero,
      ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono_of_nonneg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => mul_nonneg (hg0 x)
        (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)))) ?_
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
    · exact ((hg.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall y (2 * r))).mono_set
        (Set.diff_subset.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)).const_mul _
    · dsimp only
      rw [mul_comm (Cη' / r ^ 2)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hgrad x) (hg0 x)
  
  have s5 : ∀ (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), Continuous f → ∀ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r, f x =
        (∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r), f x) - ∫ x in Metric.closedBall y r, f x := by
    intro f hf y r hr
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_diff measurableSet_closedBall
      ((hf.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall y (2 * r))).mono_set
        Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith))
  
  have hg2n : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 :=
    fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hg2c : Continuous (fun x => ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) := by
    have hfd : Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ w x) := hw.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)
    refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => ?_)
    have : Continuous (fun x => smthGrad w x k) := by
      show Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ w x (Pi.single k 1))
      exact hfd.clm_apply continuous_const
    exact this.pow 2
  have hRne : R ≠ 0 := hR.ne'
  intro y hy
  have hy' : dist y x₀ < R / 8 := hy
  have hG : ∀ (η : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ), tsupport η ⊆ Metric.closedBall y ρ →
      ∀ x ∉ Metric.closedBall y ρ, smthGrad η x = 0 ∧ η x = 0 := by
    intro η ρ hs x hx
    have hx' : x ∉ tsupport η := fun h => hx (hs h)
    exact ⟨s1 η x hx', image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx'⟩
  have hR1 : ∀ s : ℝ, s ≤ 7 * R / 16 → Metric.closedBall y s ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := by
    intro s hs x hx
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hx
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    linarith [dist_triangle x y x₀]
  have hN : ∀ (η : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 ≤ ρ → tsupport η ⊆ Metric.closedBall y ρ →
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ η x ∧ η x ≤ 1) → ∫ x, η x ^ 2 ≤ 1 * (2 * ρ) ^ 2 := by
    intro η ρ hρ hs hb
    refine s3 (fun x => η x ^ 2) y ρ 1 hρ (fun x => sq_nonneg _) (fun x hx => ?_) (fun x _ => ?_)
    · simp [(hG η ρ hs x hx).2]
    · exact pow_le_one₀ (hb x).1 (hb x).2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨η, hηC, hηc, hsupp, hb, hone, hgb⟩ := hcut y (R / 4) (by positivity)
    have hts : tsupport η ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := hsupp.trans (hR1 _ (by linarith))
    have hc := hcacc η 0 hηC hηc hts (by simp [hM₀])
    have hlow := s2 (fun x => ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) η (Metric.ball y (R / 4))
      measurableSet_ball hg2c hg2n hηC.continuous hηc
      (fun x hx => (hone x (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx)).1)
    beta_reduce at hlow
    have hX : ∫ x, (w x - 0) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2 ≤
        M₀ ^ 2 * (Cη / (R / 4) ^ 2) * (2 * (7 * (R / 4) / 4)) ^ 2 := by
      refine s3 (fun x => (w x - 0) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2) y (7 * (R / 4) / 4) _
        (by positivity)
        (fun x => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)))
        (fun x hx => ?_) (fun x hx => ?_)
      · simp [(hG η _ hsupp x hx).1]
      · have hxR : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R :=
          Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hR1 _ (by linarith) hx)
        have h1 : (w x - 0) ^ 2 ≤ M₀ ^ 2 := by
          rw [sub_zero, ← sq_abs]
          exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hwb x hxR) 2
        exact mul_le_mul h1 (hgb x) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hNA := hN η (7 * (R / 4) / 4) (by positivity) hsupp hb
    have e1 : M₀ ^ 2 * (Cη / (R / 4) ^ 2) * (2 * (7 * (R / 4) / 4)) ^ 2 =
        49 / 4 * (Cη * M₀ ^ 2) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have e2 : (1 : ℝ) * (2 * (7 * (R / 4) / 4)) ^ 2 = 49 / 64 * R ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [e1] at hX
    rw [e2] at hNA
    have h3 : C₁ * (∫ x, (w x - 0) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2) ≤
        C₁ * (49 / 4 * (Cη * M₀ ^ 2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX hC₁
    have h4 : C₂ * ∫ x, η x ^ 2 ≤ C₂ * (49 / 64 * R ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNA hC₂
    have h5 : 0 ≤ C₁ * (Cη * M₀ ^ 2) := by positivity
    have h6 : 0 ≤ C₂ * R ^ 2 := by positivity
    linarith
  · 
    intro r hr hr8
    obtain ⟨η, hηC, hηc, hsupp, hb, hone, hgb⟩ := hcut y r hr
    obtain ⟨c, hcM, hP⟩ := hpoinc y r hr
    have hR2 : Metric.ball y (2 * r) ⊆ Metric.closedBall x₀ R := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
      linarith [dist_triangle x y x₀]
    have hcM0 : |c| ≤ M₀ := hcM M₀ (fun x hx => hwb x (hR2 hx.1))
    have hts : tsupport η ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ R := hsupp.trans (hR1 _ (by linarith))
    have hc := hcacc η c hηC hηc hts hcM0
    have hJ := s2 (fun x => ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) η (Metric.closedBall y r)
      measurableSet_closedBall hg2c hg2n hηC.continuous hηc (fun x hx => (hone x hx).1)
    beta_reduce at hJ
    have hwc : Continuous (fun x => (w x - c) ^ 2) := (hw.continuous.sub continuous_const).pow 2
    have hX := s4 (fun x => (w x - c) ^ 2) η y r Cη hr hwc (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
      (fun x hx => (hone x hx).2) (fun x hx => (hG η _ hsupp x hx).1) hgb
    beta_reduce at hX
    have hCr : 0 ≤ Cη / r ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hr2 : r ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have e' : ∀ G : ℝ, Cη / r ^ 2 * (CP * r ^ 2 * G) = Cη * CP * G := by
      intro G
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_iff hr2]
      ring
    have hX2 : C₁ * (∫ x, (w x - c) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2) ≤
        C₁ * Cη * CP * (∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r) \ Metric.closedBall y r,
          ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) := by
      have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP hCr
      calc C₁ * (∫ x, (w x - c) ^ 2 * ∑ k, (smthGrad η x k) ^ 2)
          ≤ C₁ * (Cη / r ^ 2 * (CP * r ^ 2 * (∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r) \
              Metric.closedBall y r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hX.trans h1) hC₁
        _ = _ := by rw [e']; ring
    have hNB := hN η (7 * r / 4) (by positivity) hsupp hb
    have e2 : (1 : ℝ) * (2 * (7 * r / 4)) ^ 2 = 49 / 4 * r ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [e2] at hNB
    have hsplit := s5 (fun x => ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) hg2c y r hr
    beta_reduce at hsplit
    have hmono : ∫ x in Metric.ball y r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 ≤
        ∫ x in Metric.closedBall y r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2 :=
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set
        (hg2c.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall y r))
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => hg2n x))
        Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.eventuallyLE
    have hK : 0 ≤ C₁ * Cη * CP := by positivity
    have h4 : C₂ * ∫ x, η x ^ 2 ≤ C₂ * (49 / 4 * r ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNB hC₂
    have h6 : 0 ≤ C₂ * r ^ 2 := by positivity
    rw [hsplit] at hX2
    have key : (1 + C₁ * Cη * CP) * (∫ x in Metric.closedBall y r, ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) ≤
        C₁ * Cη * CP * (∫ x in Metric.ball y (2 * r), ∑ k, (smthGrad w x k) ^ 2) +
          16 * C₂ * r ^ 2 := by
      linarith
    have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + C₁ * Cη * CP)
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← add_div, le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig : Set M) (hSc : IsCompact Sig) (hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) :
    ∃ φ lam : M → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ Sig, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ q ∈ U, q ∈ Sig → lam q = lam p) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ Sig, 0 < φ p ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
        V ∩ Sig = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ V ∩ Sig, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧ g.jacobiDeriv f x = lam x / φ x

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig : Set M) (hSc : IsCompact Sig) (hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) :
    ∃ φ lam : M → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ Sig, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ q ∈ U, q ∈ Sig → lam q = lam p) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ Sig, 0 < φ p ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
        V ∩ Sig = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ V ∩ Sig, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧ g.jacobiDeriv f x = lam x / φ x

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hgraph : ∀ p ∈ Sig, ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), eigGraphChart Sig p a u r δ :=
    fun p hp => eig_graph_chart_exists g Sig hSm p hp
  
  obtain ⟨P, hreal, hbridge⟩ := eig_patched_atlas g Sig hSc hgraph
  
  obtain ⟨Vp, hVs, hVid⟩ := eig_jacobi_potential g Sig hSm
  
  have hVpatch : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Vp (P.param j x)) (P.W j) := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨z, F, hSP, hpar, -⟩ := hreal j
    rw [hpar]
    exact hVs z (P.W j) F hSP
  
  obtain ⟨lam, φ, hlam, hnn, hnz, hφ⟩ := eig_patched_principal Sig hSc P Vp hVpatch
  
  have hP1 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ Sig := by
    intro j x hx
    have hmem : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at hmem
    exact hmem.2
  
  have hc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => Vp (P.param j x) + lam (P.param j x)) (P.W j) := by
    intro j
    refine (hVpatch j).continuousOn.add ?_
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hUl⟩ := hlam (P.param j x) (hP1 j x hx)
    have hca : ContinuousAt (P.param j) x :=
      (P.param_cont j).continuousAt ((P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx)
    have hev : (fun x' => lam (P.param j x')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => lam (P.param j x)) := by
      filter_upwards [hca.preimage_mem_nhds hU, (P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx] with x' h1 h2
      exact hUl _ h1 (hP1 j x' h2)
    exact (continuousAt_const.congr hev.symm).continuousWithinAt
  
  have hφpos : ∀ p ∈ Sig, 0 < φ p := by
    intro p hp
    by_contra hneg
    have h0 : φ p = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hneg) (hnn p hp)
    have hz := eig_patched_strong_min Sig P φ (fun q => Vp q + lam q) (fun j => (hφ j).1) hc hnn
      (fun j x hx => (hφ j).2 x hx) p hp h0
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hq0⟩ := hnz p hp
    exact hq0 (hz q hq)
  
  have hsm : eigSmoothAlong Sig φ := hbridge φ (fun j => (hφ j).1)
  
  refine ⟨φ, lam, hlam, fun p hp => ⟨hφpos p hp, ?_⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨a, u, r, δ, hG⟩ := hgraph p hp
  obtain ⟨V', f, hV'o, hpV', hf, hdf, hV'S, hnorm⟩ :=
    eig_prescribed_gradient g Sig φ hsm hφpos p hp a u r δ hG
  refine ⟨V', f, hV'o, hpV', hf, hdf, hV'S, fun x hx => ⟨hnorm x hx, ?_⟩⟩
  
  obtain ⟨j, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hx.2)
  have hxim : x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
    rw [P.image_eq j]
    exact ⟨hxj, hx.2⟩
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀W, hx₀⟩ := hxim
  obtain ⟨z, F, hSP, hpar, hh⟩ := hreal j
  have hparx : ∀ x', P.param j x' = (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x') := fun x' => congrFun hpar x'
  have hW'o : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' V') :=
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) hV'o
  have hx₀W' : x₀ ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' V' := by
    refine ⟨hx₀W, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, hx₀]
    exact hx.1
  have hSP' : eigSurfParam Sig z (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' V') F := by
    obtain ⟨-, hFs, hpt⟩ := hSP
    exact ⟨hW'o, hFs.mono Set.inter_subset_left, fun x' hx' => hpt x' hx'.1⟩
  have hinO : ∀ x' ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' V', (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x') ∈ V' := by
    intro x' hx'
    rw [← hparx]
    exact hx'.2
  have hid := hVid V' f hV'o hf hdf hV'S z (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' V') F x₀ hSP' hx₀W' hinO
  have hyx : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x₀) = x := by
    rw [← hparx]
    exact hx₀
  rw [hyx] at hid
  have hψφ : ∀ q ∈ V' ∩ Sig, (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f q))⁻¹ = φ q := fun q hq =>
    inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right (hnorm q hq)
  have heqOn : Set.EqOn
      (fun x' => (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))))⁻¹)
      (fun x' => φ (P.param j x')) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' V') := by
    intro x' hx'
    show (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))))⁻¹ = φ (P.param j x')
    rw [hparx]
    exact hψφ _ ⟨hinO x' hx', ((hSP'.2.2 x' hx').2.1)⟩
  have hpd : ∀ k : Fin 2,
      pd2 k (fun x' => (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))))⁻¹)
        =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀] pd2 k (fun x' => φ (P.param j x')) := by
    intro k
    filter_upwards [hW'o.mem_nhds hx₀W'] with y hy
    show fderiv ℝ _ y (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ _ y (e2 k)
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (heqOn.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hW'o.mem_nhds hy))]
  have h1 : ∀ k : Fin 2,
      pd2 k (fun x' => (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))))⁻¹) x₀
        = pd2 k (fun x' => φ (P.param j x')) x₀ := fun k => (hpd k).eq_of_nhds
  have h2 : ∀ i k : Fin 2,
      pd2 i (pd2 k (fun x' => (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))))⁻¹)) x₀
        = pd2 i (pd2 k (fun x' => φ (P.param j x'))) x₀ := by
    intro i k
    show fderiv ℝ _ x₀ (e2 i) = fderiv ℝ _ x₀ (e2 i)
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (hpd k)]
  have hlap : lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
      (fun x' => (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))))⁻¹) x₀ =
      lap2 (P.h j) (fun x' => φ (P.param j x')) x₀ := by
    rw [hh]
    simp only [lap2, h1, h2]
  rw [hlap, hψφ x hx] at hid
  have hs5 := (hφ j).2 x₀ hx₀W
  rw [hx₀] at hs5
  have hφx : 0 < φ x := hφpos x hx.2
  have hprod : (g.jacobiDeriv f x * φ x - lam x) * φ x = 0 := by
    linear_combination hid - hs5
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with h | h
  · rw [eq_div_iff hφx.ne']
    linarith
  · exact absurd h hφx.ne'

jacobi_eigen_data.definitions:
def eigSurfParam (Sig : Set M) (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3) : Prop :=
  IsOpen W ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∧
    (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)


def eigSmoothAlong (Sig : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3), eigSurfParam Sig z W F →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) W


def eigGraphChart (Sig : Set M) (p : M) (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ u ∧
  sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
  (∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r →
    |u (sepPlaneProj a z) - chartAt E3 p p a| < δ) ∧
  ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ,
    ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ Sig ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z))


structure EigPatchedSurface (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) where
  n : ℕ
  W : Fin n → Set E2
  param : Fin n → E2 → X
  proj : Fin n → X → E2
  O : Fin n → Set X
  h : Fin n → E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ
  W_open : ∀ j, IsOpen (W j)
  O_open : ∀ j, IsOpen (O j)
  param_cont : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (param j) (W j)
  proj_cont : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (proj j) (O j)
  image_eq : ∀ j, param j '' W j = O j ∩ S
  proj_param : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ W j, proj j (param j x) = x
  cover : S ⊆ ⋃ j, O j
  trans_smooth : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => proj k (param j x)) (W j ∩ param j ⁻¹' O k)
  h_smooth : ∀ j (a b : Fin 2), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h j x a b) (W j)
  h_posDef : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ W j, (h j x).PosDef
  h_compat : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ W j ∩ param j ⁻¹' O k, ∀ a b : Fin 2,
    h j x a b = ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ (fun x' => proj k (param j x')) x (e2 a) c * h k (proj k (param j x)) c d *
        fderiv ℝ (fun x' => proj k (param j x')) x (e2 b) d

by
  classical
  
  have hcd : ∀ (p : M) (u : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    fun p u hu => contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  
  
  
  set A : Set M := {x | ∃ p ∈ Sig, lam p ≠ lam p₀ ∧ ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p,
      (∀ q ∈ U, q ∈ Sig → lam q = lam p) ∧ x ∈ interior U} with hAdef
  set B : Set M := {x | ∃ p ∈ Sig, lam p = lam p₀ ∧ ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p,
      (∀ q ∈ U, q ∈ Sig → lam q = lam p) ∧ x ∈ interior U} with hBdef
  have hAo : IsOpen A := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
    rintro x ⟨p, hp, hlp, U, hU, hUl, hxU⟩
    exact ⟨interior U, fun y hy => ⟨p, hp, hlp, U, hU, hUl, hy⟩, isOpen_interior, hxU⟩
  have hBo : IsOpen B := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
    rintro x ⟨p, hp, hlp, U, hU, hUl, hxU⟩
    exact ⟨interior U, fun y hy => ⟨p, hp, hlp, U, hU, hUl, hy⟩, isOpen_interior, hxU⟩
  set S0 : Set M := Sig \ A with hS0def
  have hS0c : IsCompact S0 := hSc.diff hAo
  have hS0Sig : S0 ⊆ Sig := Set.diff_subset
  have hS0lam : ∀ x ∈ S0, lam x = lam p₀ := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hUl⟩ := hlam x hx.1
    exact hx.2 ⟨x, hx.1, hne, U, hU, hUl, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hU⟩
  have hS0B : S0 ⊆ B := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hUl⟩ := hlam x hx.1
    exact ⟨x, hx.1, hS0lam x hx, U, hU, hUl, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 hU⟩
  have hp₀S0 : p₀ ∈ S0 := by
    refine ⟨hp₀, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨p, hp, hlp, U, hU, hUl, hxU⟩
    exact hlp (hUl p₀ (interior_subset hxU) hp₀).symm
  set U₀ : Set M := O' ∩ B with hU₀def
  have hU₀o : IsOpen U₀ := hO'.inter hBo
  have hS0U₀ : S0 ⊆ U₀ := fun x hx => ⟨hSO' hx.1, hS0B hx⟩
  have hU₀Sig : ∀ x ∈ U₀, x ∈ Sig → x ∈ S0 := by
    rintro x ⟨-, p, hp, hlp, U, hU, hUl, hxU⟩ hxS
    have hlx : lam x = lam p₀ := (hUl x (interior_subset hxU) hxS).trans hlp
    refine ⟨hxS, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨p', hp', hlp', U', hU', hUl', hxU'⟩
    exact hlp' ((hUl' x (interior_subset hxU') hxS).symm.trans hlx)
  
  
  
  have hdat' : ∀ p : M, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), p ∈ Sig → (IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ Sig = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
      ∀ x ∈ V ∩ Sig, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧
        g.jacobiDeriv f x = lam x / φ x) := by
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p ∈ Sig
    · obtain ⟨-, V, f, h⟩ := hdata p hp
      exact ⟨V, f, fun _ => h⟩
    · exact ⟨Set.univ, 0, fun h => absurd h hp⟩
  choose Vf ff hVf using hdat'
  have hVo : ∀ p ∈ Sig, IsOpen (Vf p) := fun p hp => (hVf p hp).1
  have hpV : ∀ p ∈ Sig, p ∈ Vf p := fun p hp => (hVf p hp).2.1
  have hfs : ∀ p ∈ Sig, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ff p) := fun p hp => (hVf p hp).2.2.1
  have hdf : ∀ p ∈ Sig, ∀ x ∈ Vf p, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (ff p) x ≠ 0 :=

  have hVS : ∀ p ∈ Sig, Vf p ∩ Sig = Vf p ∩ ff p ⁻¹' {0} := fun p hp => (hVf p hp).2.2.2.2.1
  have hgr : ∀ p ∈ Sig, ∀ x ∈ Vf p ∩ Sig, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (ff p) (ff p) x) * φ x = 1 :=
    fun p hp x hx => ((hVf p hp).2.2.2.2.2 x hx).1
  have hjd : ∀ p ∈ Sig, ∀ x ∈ Vf p ∩ Sig, g.jacobiDeriv (ff p) x = lam x / φ x :=

    · intro hf; exact (h.2 ⟨hx, hf⟩).2
  
  have hb : ∀ p ∈ S0, ∃ ψ : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ ∧

    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨b, -, hbs⟩ := (SmoothBumpFunction.nhds_basis_tsupport (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) p).mem_iff.1
      (((hVo p (hS0Sig hp)).inter hU₀o).mem_nhds ⟨hpV p (hS0Sig hp), hS0U₀ hp⟩)
    exact ⟨b, b.contMDiff, fun x => b.nonneg, hbs, b.eventuallyEq_one⟩
  choose! ψ hψs hψnn hψsupp hψ1 using hb
  obtain ⟨t, htS0, hcov⟩ := hS0c.elim_nhds_subcover (fun p => {x | 0 < ψ p x})
    (fun p hp => Filter.mem_of_superset (hψ1 p hp) (fun x hx => by
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx ⊢
      rw [hx]; norm_num))
  have htSig : ∀ i ∈ t, i ∈ Sig := fun i hi => hS0Sig (htS0 i hi)
  
  set Ssum : M → ℝ := fun x => ∑ i ∈ t, ψ i x with hSdef
  have hSs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ Ssum :=
    contMDiff_finset_sum (fun i hi => hψs i (htS0 i hi))
  have hSpos : ∀ x ∈ S0, 0 < Ssum x := by
    intro x hx
    have h := hcov hx

    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := h
    exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun j hj => hψnn j (htS0 j hj) x) ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩
  obtain ⟨xm, hxm, hmin⟩ := hS0c.exists_isMinOn ⟨p₀, hp₀S0⟩ hSs.continuous.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀def⟩ : ∃ s₀ : ℝ, s₀ = Ssum xm / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs₀ : 0 < s₀ := by have := hSpos xm hxm; rw [hs₀def]; linarith
  have hSge : ∀ x ∈ S0, 2 * s₀ ≤ Ssum x := by
    intro x hx
    have := isMinOn_iff.1 hmin x hx
    rw [hs₀def]; linarith
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ → ℝ,
      R = fun s => s₀ / 2 + (s - s₀ / 2) * Real.smoothTransition (2 * s / s₀ - 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => 2 * s / s₀ - 1) := by fun_prop
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * s / s₀ - 1)) :=
      Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp h1
    have h3 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => s - s₀ / 2) := by fun_prop
    rw [hRdef]
    exact contDiff_const.add (h3.mul h2)

    by_cases hs : s ≤ s₀ / 2

          rw [sub_nonpos, div_le_one hs₀]; linarith)
      simp only [h0, mul_zero, add_zero, le_refl]

      have h2 : 0 ≤ (s - s₀ / 2) * Real.smoothTransition (2 * s / s₀ - 1) :=
        mul_nonneg (by linarith) this
      show s₀ / 2 ≤ s₀ / 2 + (s - s₀ / 2) * Real.smoothTransition (2 * s / s₀ - 1)
      linarith

    intro s hs
    rw [hRdef]
    have h1 : Real.smoothTransition (2 * s / s₀ - 1) = 1 :=

    rw [h1]; ring
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : M → ℝ, D = fun x => R (Ssum x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

  have hDpos : ∀ x, 0 < D x := by

  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀def⟩ : ∃ N₀ : Set M, N₀ = {x | s₀ < Ssum x} := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    intro x; rw [hwdef]
  have hws : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w := by
    have h1 : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => ∑ i ∈ t, ψ i x * ff i x ^ 2) :=

    intro i hi
    by_cases h0 : ψ i x = 0
    · rw [h0, zero_mul]
    · rw [(hZiff i (htSig i hi) x (hsuppV i hi x h0).1).1 hx]; ring

    intro x hxN hxS
    rw [hN₀def] at hxN
    have hxN' : s₀ < Ssum x := hxN
    have hS : 0 < Ssum x := lt_trans hs₀ hxN'

      push_neg at h

    have hfi : ff i x ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
      hxS ((hZiff i (htSig i hi) x (hsuppV i hi x hψi.ne').1).2 h0)
    have hsq : 0 < ff i x ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg _) (Ne.symm (pow_ne_zero 2 hfi))
    rw [hw]

    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ t₀ ∧
      hullRiemPer g (E \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t}) Ω Sig < hullRiemPer g E Ω Sig

signature.name: collar_removal_decreases_hull
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig E Ω O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ) (hE : IsOpen E)
    (hfr : frontier E = Sig) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hO : IsOpen O) (hOΩ : O ⊆ Ω)
    (hfin : hullRiemPer g E Ω Sig < ⊤) (ht₀ : 0 < t₀)
    (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀}) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O)
    (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ Sig → w x = 0) (hwpos : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∉ Sig → 0 < w x)
    (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ Sig))
    (hdw : ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, g.levelMeanCurv w x < 0)
    (hbd : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, w x ≤ t₀ → g.gradInner w w x ≤ C ∧ |g.levelMeanCurv w x| ≤ C)
    (hne : (O ∩ Sig).Nonempty) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ t₀ ∧
      hullRiemPer g (E \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t}) Ω Sig < hullRiemPer g E Ω Sig

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht_eq⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = t₀ / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ht : 0 < t := by rw [ht_eq]; linarith
  have htt₀ : t ≤ t₀ := by rw [ht_eq]; linarith
  have hSigc : IsClosed Sig := hfr ▸ isClosed_frontier
  have hESig : Disjoint E Sig := by
    rw [← hfr, hE.frontier_eq]; exact Set.disjoint_sdiff_right
  have hSigi : interior Sig = ∅ := by
    rw [← hfr, ← frontier_compl]; exact interior_frontier hE.isClosed_compl
  have hEm : sepChartMeas E := by
    intro q'
    exact ((chartAt E3 q').isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hE.inter (chartAt E3 q').open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right).measurableSet
  
  have hP0 : calPartition (fun j : Fin 0 => (j.elim0 : M))
      (fun j : Fin 0 => (j.elim0 : M → ℝ)) O :=
    ⟨fun j => j.elim0, fun j => j.elim0, fun x => by simp, fun j => j.elim0⟩
  obtain ⟨n, q, φ, O', hφ, hO'o, hKO'', hφ1, -⟩ :=
    calPartition_extend g O hO (fun j : Fin 0 => (j.elim0 : M))
      (fun j : Fin 0 => (j.elim0 : M → ℝ)) hP0 ∅ isOpen_empty (fun x hx => hx.elim)
      {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} hcpt (fun x hx => hx.1)
  have hKO' : {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} ⊆ O' := fun x hx => hKO'' (Or.inl hx)
  
  obtain ⟨β, hβdef⟩ : ∃ β : M → ℝ, β = O.indicator
      (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - t / 4) / (t / 2 - t / 4))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hβs, hβ01, hβ1, hβ0, -, hcl, -⟩ := collar_cutoff_props Sig O w t₀ (t / 4) (t / 2)
    hSigc hO hcpt hwc hw0 hws (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  rw [← hβdef] at hβs hβ01 hβ1 hβ0
  
  have hUo : IsOpen {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x < 3 * t / 4} :=
    hwc.isOpen_inter_preimage hO (isOpen_Iio (a := 3 * t / 4))
  have hC₁c : IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4} := (hcl (3 * t / 4) (by linarith)).1
  have hUC₁ : {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x < 3 * t / 4} ⊆ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4} :=
    fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.le⟩
  
  have hLR := hullRiemPer_disjoint_sum_le g E Ω Sig
    ![Ω \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4}, {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x < 3 * t / 4}]
    (fun j => by
      fin_cases j
      · exact Set.diff_subset
      · intro x hx
        exact hOΩ (show x ∈ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x < 3 * t / 4} from hx).1)
    (by
      have hd : Disjoint (Ω \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4}) {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x < 3 * t / 4} :=
        Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x hx hx' => hx.2 (hUC₁ hx')
      intro a b hab
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b
      · exact absurd rfl hab
      · exact hd
      · exact hd.symm
      · exact absurd rfl hab)
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hLR
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons] at hLR
  have hP₁fin : hullRiemPer g E (Ω \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4}) Sig ≠ ⊤ :=
    (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans le_self_add hLR) hfin).ne
  have hPUfin : hullRiemPer g E {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x < 3 * t / 4} Sig ≠ ⊤ :=
    (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_trans le_add_self hLR) hfin).ne
  obtain ⟨P, hPeq, hPnn⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ, hullRiemPer g E Ω Sig = ENNReal.ofReal P ∧ 0 ≤ P :=
    ⟨_, (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfin.ne).symm, ENNReal.toReal_nonneg⟩
  obtain ⟨P₁, hP₁eq, hP₁nn⟩ : ∃ P₁ : ℝ,
      hullRiemPer g E (Ω \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4}) Sig = ENNReal.ofReal P₁ ∧ 0 ≤ P₁ :=
    ⟨_, (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hP₁fin).symm, ENNReal.toReal_nonneg⟩
  obtain ⟨PU, hPUeq, hPUnn⟩ : ∃ PU : ℝ,
      hullRiemPer g E {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x < 3 * t / 4} Sig = ENNReal.ofReal PU ∧ 0 ≤ PU :=
    ⟨_, (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hPUfin).symm, ENNReal.toReal_nonneg⟩
  have hsumR : P₁ + PU ≤ P := by
    rw [hP₁eq, hPUeq, hPeq, ← ENNReal.ofReal_add hP₁nn hPUnn] at hLR
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hPnn).1 hLR
  
  obtain ⟨V, hVs, hVd, hV1, hVsupp, hVform⟩ := collar_jump_field g Sig E O w t₀ (t / 8) (t / 4)
    hE hfr hO hcpt hwc hw0 hwpos hws hdw hbd (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hβtsupp : tsupport β ⊆ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x < 3 * t / 4} := by
    refine (closure_minimal (fun x hx => ?_) (hcl (t / 2) (by linarith)).1).trans ?_
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hβ0 x hx
      exact ⟨h1, h2.le⟩
    · intro x hx
      exact ⟨hx.1, by linarith [hx.2]⟩
  have hφU : calPartition q (fun j x => β x * φ j x) {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x < 3 * t / 4} := by
    refine ⟨fun j => hβs.mul (hφ.1 j), fun j x => mul_nonneg (hβ01 x).1 (hφ.2.1 j x),
      fun x => ?_, fun j => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      exact mul_le_one₀ (hβ01 x).2 (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hφ.2.1 j x) (hφ.2.2.1 x)
    · exact (hφ.2.2.2 j).1.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) tsupport_mul_subset_right
    · intro x hx
      exact ⟨hβtsupp (tsupport_mul_subset_left hx),
        ((hφ.2.2.2 j).2 (tsupport_mul_subset_right hx)).2⟩
  have hlow := hull_jump_lower_bound g E {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x < 3 * t / 4} Sig hE hSigc hSigi hESig
    hUo q (fun j x => β x * φ j x) hφU V hVs hVd hV1
  have hcalU : calDivSum g q (fun j x => β x * φ j x) E V = calDivSum g q φ E V := by
    unfold calDivSum
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    have hpc : calPiece (q j) (fun x => β x * φ j x) V = calPiece (q j) (φ j) V := by
      unfold calPiece
      congr 1
      funext y
      by_cases hV : V ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) = 0
      · simp [hV]
      · have h := hVsupp _ hV
        beta_reduce
        rw [(hβ1 _ h.2.1 (by linarith [h.2.2])).1, one_mul]
    rw [hpc]
  rw [hcalU, hVform O O' q φ hφ hO'o (fun x hx => hKO' ⟨hx.1, by linarith [hx.2]⟩) hφ1,
    hPUeq] at hlow
  have hΦU := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hPUnn).1 hlow
  
  obtain ⟨VζH, hVζH⟩ : ∃ v : ℝ, calVolSum g q φ E (fun x =>
      O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - t / 8) / (t / 4 - t / 8))) x *
        g.levelMeanCurv w x) = v := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hneg := (collar_gain_neg g Sig E O O O' w t₀ (t / 8) (t / 4) t (t + t / 2) hE hfr hO hcpt
    hwc hw0 hwpos hws hdw hH hbd hne (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (by linarith) q φ hφ hO'o hKO' hφ1).2
  rw [hVζH] at hneg
  have hVnn : ∀ u : M → ℝ, 0 ≤ calVolSum g q φ E (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) := by
    intro u
    unfold calVolSum
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => integral_nonneg fun y =>
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hφ.2.1 j _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hPpos : 0 < P := by
    have := hVnn (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - t / 8) / (t / 4 - t / 8))))
    linarith
  
  have s10 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (pp : Fin m → M) (W : Fin m → Set M),
      (∀ k, IsOpen (W k) ∧ W k ⊆ Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) →
      Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (W k) (W l)) →
      ∀ Y : Fin m → E3 → E3, (∀ k,
        (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) →
          ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Y k) y) ∧ HasCompactSupport (Y k) ∧
        tsupport (Y k) ⊆ chartAt E3 (pp k) '' W k ∧
        (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y i j * Y k y i * Y k y j ≤ 1) ∧
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm) (Y k) y| ≤ C) →
      ∑ k, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (pp k) '' ((E \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm) (Y k) y ≤ P + VζH := by
    intro m pp W hW hWd Y hY
    choose C hC using fun k => (hY k).2.2.2.2
    
    have hε : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ t / 2 →
        ∑ k, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (pp k) '' ((E \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t}) ∩
            (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm) (Y k) y ≤
        P + VζH + ∑ k, C k * (volume (chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩
          {x | x ∈ O ∧ t < w x ∧ w x < t + ε} ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩
            tsupport (Y k))).toReal := by
      intro ε hε0 hεt
      obtain ⟨χ, hχdef⟩ : ∃ χ : M → ℝ, χ = O.indicator
          (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - t) / (t + ε - t))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨hχs, hχ01, hχ1, hχ0, hχd, hχcl, hKfc⟩ := collar_cutoff_props Sig O w t₀ t (t + ε)
        hSigc hO hcpt hwc hw0 hws ht (by linarith) (by linarith)
      rw [← hχdef] at hχs hχ01 hχ1 hχ0 hχd
      have hspl := fun k => collar_member_split g Sig E O (W k) w χ (pp k) t ε (3 * t / 4) (C k)
        hE hfr hO hwc (hW k).1 ((hW k).2.trans Set.inter_subset_right) (by linarith)
        (hχcl (3 * t / 4) (by linarith)).1 (hχcl (t + ε) (by linarith)).1 hχs hχ01 hχ1 hχ0
        (Y k) ⟨(hY k).1, (hY k).2.1, (hY k).2.2.1, (hY k).2.2.2.1⟩ (hC k)
      
      have hfam : (∀ k, IsOpen (W k \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4}) ∧
            W k \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4} ⊆
              (Ω \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∧
          Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (W k \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4})
            (W l \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4})) :=
        ⟨fun k => ⟨(hW k).1.sdiff hC₁c,
          fun x hx => ⟨⟨((hW k).2 hx.1).1, hx.2⟩, ((hW k).2 hx.1).2⟩⟩,
          fun k l hkl => (hWd hkl).mono Set.diff_subset Set.diff_subset⟩
      have hD : ∑ k, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source),
            sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm)
              (fun z => (1 - χ ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm z)) • Y k z) y) ≤
          hullRiemPer g E (Ω \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4}) Sig := by
        refine le_trans ?_ (le_iSup_of_le m (le_iSup_of_le pp
          (le_iSup_of_le (fun k => W k \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ 3 * t / 4})
            (le_iSup_of_le hfam le_rfl))))
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => le_iSup₂_of_le _ (hspl k).1 le_rfl
      have hsub : ∀ (x : Fin m → ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (∑ k, x k) ≤ ∑ k, ENNReal.ofReal (x k) :=
        fun x => Finset.le_sum_of_subadditive ENNReal.ofReal ENNReal.ofReal_zero.le
          (fun a b => ENNReal.ofReal_add_le) _ _
      have hDR := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hP₁nn).1 (((hsub _).trans hD).trans hP₁eq.le)
      
      have hJ := chart_volume_family_le g O O' E {y | y ∈ O ∧ t ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ t + ε} hEm q φ hφ
        hO'o hφ1 χ hχs hKfc (fun x hx => hKO' ⟨hx.1, by linarith [hx.2.2]⟩) hχd pp W
        (fun k => tsupport (Y k)) (fun k => ⟨(hW k).1, (hW k).2.trans Set.inter_subset_right⟩)
        hWd (fun k => ⟨(hY k).2.1, (hY k).2.2.1⟩)
      beta_reduce at hJ
      
      have hflux := collar_flux_conservation g Sig E O O O' w t₀ (t / 8) (t / 4) t (t + ε) hE hfr
        hO hcpt hwc hw0 hwpos hws hdw hbd (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) ht
        (by linarith) (by linarith) q φ hφ hO'o hKO' hφ1
      have hgain := (collar_gain_neg g Sig E O O O' w t₀ (t / 8) (t / 4) t (t + ε) hE hfr hO hcpt
        hwc hw0 hwpos hws hdw hH hbd hne (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        (by linarith) q φ hφ hO'o hKO' hφ1).1
      rw [← hχdef] at hflux hgain
      have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k (_ : k ∈ Finset.univ) => (hspl k).2
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hsum
      linarith
    
    have hlim : ∀ k, Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (volume (chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩
        {x | x ∈ O ∧ t < w x ∧ w x < t + t / 2 / ((N : ℝ) + 1)} ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩
          tsupport (Y k))).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : ℕ → Set E3, S = fun N : ℕ => chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩
          {x | x ∈ O ∧ t < w x ∧ w x < t + t / 2 / ((N : ℝ) + 1)} ∩
            (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ tsupport (Y k) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hmeas : ∀ N : ℕ, NullMeasurableSet (S N) volume := by
        intro N
        simp only [hSdef]
        refine MeasurableSet.nullMeasurableSet ?_
        refine (IsOpen.measurableSet ?_).inter (isClosed_tsupport _).measurableSet
        refine (chartAt E3 (pp k)).isOpen_image_of_subset_source ?_ Set.inter_subset_right
        exact (hE.inter (hwc.isOpen_inter_preimage hO
          (isOpen_Ioo (a := t) (b := t + t / 2 / ((N : ℝ) + 1))))).inter
          (chartAt E3 (pp k)).open_source
      have hanti : Antitone S := by
        intro N N' hNN'
        simp only [hSdef]
        refine Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ (Set.image_mono ?_)
        rintro x ⟨⟨hxE, hxO, h1, h2⟩, hxs⟩
        refine ⟨⟨hxE, hxO, h1, lt_of_lt_of_le h2 ?_⟩, hxs⟩
        have hc : (N : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (N' : ℝ) + 1 := by
          have := (Nat.cast_le (α := ℝ)).2 hNN'
          linarith
        have : t / 2 / ((N' : ℝ) + 1) ≤ t / 2 / ((N : ℝ) + 1) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity) hc
        linarith
      have hfin' : ∃ N, volume (S N) ≠ ⊤ := ⟨0, by
        simp only [hSdef]
        exact (lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
          (hY k).2.1.measure_lt_top).ne⟩
      have hempty : volume (⋂ N, S N) = 0 := by
        refine measure_mono_null (fun y hy => ?_) measure_empty
        exfalso
        have hyN : ∀ N : ℕ, y ∈ S N := Set.mem_iInter.1 hy
        simp only [hSdef] at hyN
        obtain ⟨⟨x, ⟨⟨-, -, hx1, -⟩, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, -⟩ := hyN 0
        obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (t / 2 / (w x - t))
        obtain ⟨⟨x', ⟨⟨-, -, -, hx'2⟩, hx's⟩, hxx'⟩, -⟩ := hyN N
        have hx'x : x' = x := (chartAt E3 (pp k)).injOn hx's hxs hxx'
        rw [hx'x] at hx'2
        have hwpos' : 0 < w x - t := by linarith
        have h3 : t / 2 / (w x - t) < (N : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ hwpos'] at h3
        have h4 : t / 2 / ((N : ℝ) + 1) < w x - t := by
          rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          linarith
        linarith
      have h := tendsto_measure_iInter_atTop hmeas hanti hfin'
      rw [hempty] at h
      have h2 := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal ENNReal.zero_ne_top).comp h
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_zero, hSdef] at h2
      exact h2
    have hsumlim : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ k, C k * (volume (chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩
        {x | x ∈ O ∧ t < w x ∧ w x < t + t / 2 / ((N : ℝ) + 1)} ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩
          tsupport (Y k))).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have := tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ fun k _ => (hlim k).const_mul (C k)
      rw [show (∑ k : Fin m, C k * 0) = 0 by simp] at this
      exact this
    have hT : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => P + VζH + ∑ k, C k * (volume (chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩
        {x | x ∈ O ∧ t < w x ∧ w x < t + t / 2 / ((N : ℝ) + 1)} ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩
          tsupport (Y k))).toReal) atTop (𝓝 (P + VζH)) := by
      have := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := P + VζH)).add hsumlim
      rwa [add_zero] at this
    refine ge_of_tendsto' hT fun N => ?_
    have hN1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have := (Nat.cast_nonneg N : (0 : ℝ) ≤ N)
      linarith
    exact hε _ (div_pos (by linarith) (by positivity)) (div_le_self (by linarith) hN1)
  
  have sumsup : ∀ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → (E3 → E3) → ENNReal) (a c : ENNReal),
      (∀ X : Fin m → E3 → E3, a + ∑ k, f k (X k) ≤ c) → a + ∑ k, ⨆ Z, f k Z ≤ c := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro f a c h
      simpa using h (fun k => k.elim0)
    | succ m ih =>
      intro f a c h
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, ← add_assoc, ENNReal.add_iSup, ENNReal.iSup_add]
      refine iSup_le fun Z => ?_
      refine ih (fun k => f k.succ) (a + f 0 Z) c fun X => ?_
      have := h (Fin.cons Z X)
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at this
      simpa [add_assoc] using this
  have trunc : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (S U' Kk : Set E3) (Z : E3 → E3),
      ∃ Z' : E3 → E3, ((∀ y, y ∉ Kk → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Z' y) ∧ HasCompactSupport Z' ∧
        tsupport Z' ⊆ U' ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Z' y i * Z' y j ≤ 1) ∧
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G Z' y| ≤ C) ∧
        0 ≤ ∫ y in S, sepDensDiv G Z' y ∧
        (⨆ (_ : (∀ y, y ∉ Kk → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Z y) ∧ HasCompactSupport Z ∧

    · refine ⟨0, h0adm, by rw [h0int], iSup_le fun hadm => ?_⟩

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (Sig O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ)
    (t₀ a b : ℝ) (hSig : IsClosed Sig) (hO : IsOpen O) (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀})
    (hwc : ContinuousOn w O) (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ Sig → w x = 0)
    (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ Sig)) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ t₀) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
        (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ∧
        O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O, w x ≤ a →
        O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x = 1 ∧
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x, O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ≠ 0 →
        x ∈ O ∧ w x < b) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b} →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) x = 0) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, c ≤ t₀ → IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c} ∧ IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c}) ∧
      IsCompact {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b}

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig E O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (t₀ a b : ℝ) (hE : IsOpen E) (hfr : frontier E = Sig)
    (hO : IsOpen O) (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀}) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O)
    (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ Sig → w x = 0) (hwpos : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∉ Sig → 0 < w x)
    (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ Sig))
    (hdw : ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0)
    (hbd : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, w x ≤ t₀ → g.gradInner w w x ≤ C ∧ |g.levelMeanCurv w x| ≤ C)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ t₀) :
    ∃ V : M → E3,
      (∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p)
        ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3))
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Sigᶜ)) ∧
      (∀ (p : M) (ψ : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ → IsCompact (tsupport ψ) →
        tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y,
          y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) →
          |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y| ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x, V x ≠ 0 → x ∈ E ∧ x ∈ O ∧ w x < b) ∧
      ∀ (Ω' O'' : Set M) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ), calPartition q φ Ω' →
        IsOpen O'' → {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ b} ⊆ O'' → (∀ x ∈ O'', ∑ j, φ j x = 1) →
        calDivSum g q φ E V =
          calVolSum g q φ E (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner
            (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))))
            (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) x)) -
          calVolSum g q φ E (fun x =>
            O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x *
              g.levelMeanCurv w x)

signature.name: smth_lin_C2_step
signature.statement: (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 2, smthHolC 1 (fun x => a x i j) S) (hF : ∀ i : Fin 2, smthHolC 1 (fun x => F x i) S) (hell : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j) (hw : smthHolC 1 w S) (heq : smthLinSol a F w S) : smthHolC 2 w S

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have of_dist : ∀ {X : Type} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → X)
      (K α : NNReal), (∀ x ∈ T, ∀ y ∈ T, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ (K : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (α : ℝ)) →
      HolderOnWith K α f T := by
    intro X _ T f K α hf x hx y hy
    rw [edist_dist, edist_dist, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg dist_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg α),
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (NNReal.coe_nonneg K)]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hf x hx y hy)
  
  have prod_le : ∀ p q p' q' b d : ℝ, |p| ≤ b → |q'| ≤ b → |p - p'| ≤ d → |q - q'| ≤ d →
      |p * q - p' * q'| ≤ 2 * b * d := by
    intro p q p' q' b d hp hq' h1 h2
    have hb : 0 ≤ b := (abs_nonneg _).trans hp
    have e : p * q - p' * q' = p * (q - q') + q' * (p - p') := by ring
    rw [e]
    calc |p * (q - q') + q' * (p - p')| ≤ |p| * |q - q'| + |q'| * |p - p'| := by
          rw [← abs_mul, ← abs_mul]; exact abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ b * d + b * d := add_le_add (mul_le_mul hp h2 (abs_nonneg _) hb)
          (mul_le_mul hq' h1 (abs_nonneg _) hb)
      _ = 2 * b * d := by ring
  have comb : ∀ A A' P0 P0' P1 P1' c d : ℝ, |A - A'| ≤ c → |P0 - P0'| ≤ d → |P1 - P1'| ≤ d →
      |A - (P0 + P1) - (A' - (P0' + P1'))| ≤ c + 2 * d := by
    intro A A' P0 P0' P1 P1' c d h1 h2 h3
    have e : A - (P0 + P1) - (A' - (P0' + P1')) = (A - A') - ((P0 - P0') + (P1 - P1')) := by ring
    rw [e]
    have h4 := abs_sub (A - A') ((P0 - P0') + (P1 - P1'))
    have h5 := abs_add_le (P0 - P0') (P1 - P1')
    linarith
  
  have hgdq : ∀ (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ u x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ u (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) → ∀ j : Fin 2,
      smthGrad (smthDQ u m h) x j =
        (smthGrad u (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) j - smthGrad u x j) / h := by
    intro u m h x hx hxh j
    have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Fin 2 → ℝ => y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ)) x := (hasFDerivAt_id x).add_const _
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => u (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)))
        (fderiv ℝ u (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) x := by
      have := hxh.hasFDerivAt.comp x h0
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt
        (fun y => (u (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - u y) * h⁻¹)
        (h⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ u (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - fderiv ℝ u x)) x :=
      (h1.sub hx.hasFDerivAt).mul_const h⁻¹
    have h3 : smthDQ u m h =
        fun y => (u (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - u y) * h⁻¹ := by
      funext y; simp only [smthDQ, div_eq_mul_inv]
    simp only [smthGrad]
    rw [h3, h2.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  refine (smth_holC_local 2 w S hS).2 ?_
  intro x₀ hx₀
  
  have ha0 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, smthHolC 0 (fun x => a x i j) S :=
    fun i j => smth_holC_mono 0 _ S hS (ha i j)
  have hF0 : ∀ i : Fin 2, smthHolC 0 (fun x => F x i) S :=
    fun i => smth_holC_mono 0 _ S hS (hF i)
  obtain ⟨ρ, B, C, α, hρ, hρ4, hα0, hα1, hρS, hfam⟩ := smth_holC0_common
    ((Fin 2 × Fin 2) ⊕ ((Fin 2 × Fin 2 × Fin 2) ⊕ ((Fin 2 × Fin 2) ⊕ Fin 2))) S hS
    (Sum.elim (fun p x => a x p.1 p.2)
      (Sum.elim (fun p x => smthGrad (fun y => a y p.1 p.2.1) x p.2.2)
        (Sum.elim (fun p x => smthGrad (fun y => F y p.1) x p.2) (fun j x => smthGrad w x j))))
    (by
      rintro (p | p | p | j)
      · exact ha0 p.1 p.2
      · exact (ha p.1 p.2.1).2 p.2.2
      · exact (hF p.1).2 p.2
      · exact hw.2 j)
    x₀ hx₀
  have hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, HolderOnWith C α (fun x => a x i j) (ball x₀ ρ) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, |a x i j| ≤ (B : ℝ) := fun i j => hfam (Sum.inl (i, j))
  have hDA : ∀ i j m : Fin 2,
      HolderOnWith C α (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m) (ball x₀ ρ) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, |smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m| ≤ (B : ℝ) :=
    fun i j m => hfam (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (i, j, m)))
  have hDF : ∀ i m : Fin 2,
      HolderOnWith C α (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => F y i) x m) (ball x₀ ρ) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, |smthGrad (fun y => F y i) x m| ≤ (B : ℝ) :=
    fun i m => hfam (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (i, m))))
  have hDW : ∀ j : Fin 2, HolderOnWith C α (fun x => smthGrad w x j) (ball x₀ ρ) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, |smthGrad w x j| ≤ (B : ℝ) :=
    fun j => hfam (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr j)))
  
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = ρ / 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR : 0 < R := by rw [hRdef]; positivity
  have hcl : closedBall x₀ (2 * R) ⊆ ball x₀ ρ := closedBall_subset_ball (by rw [hRdef]; linarith)
  have h2R : ball x₀ (2 * R) ⊆ ball x₀ ρ := ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcl
  have hRS : ball x₀ R ⊆ ball x₀ ρ := ball_subset_ball (by rw [hRdef]; linarith)
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam, hlamE⟩ := smth_unif_ellipticity (closedBall x₀ (2 * R))
    (isCompact_closedBall _ _) a (fun i j => (ha0 i j).1.mono (hcl.trans hρS))
    (fun x hx => hell x (hρS (hcl hx)))
  have hB0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ B := NNReal.coe_nonneg B
  have hC0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ C := NNReal.coe_nonneg C
  obtain ⟨K₀, hK₀⟩ : ∃ K₀ : NNReal, K₀ = B + C + 2 * B * B + 4 * B * C := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK₀r : (K₀ : ℝ) = B + C + 2 * B * B + 4 * B * C := by rw [hK₀]; push_cast; ring
  have hBB : 0 ≤ (B : ℝ) * B := mul_nonneg hB0 hB0
  have hBC : 0 ≤ (B : ℝ) * C := mul_nonneg hB0 hC0
  have hBK : (B : ℝ) ≤ K₀ := by rw [hK₀r]; linarith
  have hCK : (C : ℝ) ≤ K₀ := by rw [hK₀r]; linarith
  have hFK2 : (C : ℝ) + 4 * B * C ≤ K₀ := by rw [hK₀r]; linarith
  
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := smth_lin_schauder_est α lam K₀ R hα0 hα1 hlam hR
  have hw1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w S := by exact_mod_cast smth_holC_contDiffOn 1 w S hS hw
  
  have hdata : ∀ m : Fin 2, ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < |h| → |h| < R →
      smthSchauderData lam K₀ α (fun x => a (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)))
        (fun x i => smthDQ (fun y => F y i) m h x -
          ∑ j : Fin 2, smthDQ (fun y => a y i j) m h x * smthGrad w x j)
        (smthDQ w m h) (ball x₀ R) := by
    intro m h hh hhR
    have hv : ‖h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)‖ = |h| := by
      rw [norm_smul, Pi.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hshift : ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R,
        x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) ∈ ball x₀ (2 * R) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_ball] at hx ⊢
      have h1 : dist (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) x = |h| := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, hv]
      have h2 := dist_triangle (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) x x₀
      linarith
    have hshS : ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) ∈ ball x₀ ρ :=
      fun x hx => h2R (hshift x hx)
    have hdist : ∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, dist (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))
        (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) = dist x y := fun x y => dist_add_right _ _ _
    have mvt : ∀ f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) →
        HolderOnWith C α (fun x => smthGrad f x m) (ball x₀ ρ) →
        (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ ρ, |smthGrad f x m| ≤ (B : ℝ)) →
        (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, |smthDQ f m h x| ≤ (B : ℝ)) ∧
          HolderOnWith C α (smthDQ f m h) (ball x₀ R) :=
      fun f hd hH hB => smth_dq_mvt_bounds f x₀ R m B C α hR (fun x hx => hd x (hρS (h2R hx)))
        (fun x hx => hB x (h2R hx)) (hH.mono h2R) h hh hhR
    have dqF := fun i : Fin 2 => mvt (fun y => F y i) (hF i).1 (hDF i m).1 (hDF i m).2
    have dqA := fun i j : Fin 2 => mvt (fun y => a y i j) (ha i j).1 (hDA i j m).1 (hDA i j m).2
    have dqW := mvt w hw.1 (hDW m).1 (hDW m).2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      intro x hx ξ
      exact hlamE _ (ball_subset_closedBall (hshift x hx)) ξ
    · 
      intro x hx i j
      exact ((hA i j).2 _ (hshS x hx)).trans hBK
    · 
      refine of_dist _ _ _ _ (fun x hx y hy => ?_)
      have hD : 0 ≤ (K₀ : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (α : ℝ) := by positivity
      refine (dist_pi_le_iff hD).2 (fun i => (dist_pi_le_iff hD).2 (fun j => ?_))
      have h1 := (hA i j).1.dist_le (hshS x hx) (hshS y hy)
      rw [hdist] at h1
      exact h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCK (by positivity))
    · 
      intro x hx i
      have e1 := (dqF i).1 x hx
      have e2 := (dqA i 0).1 x hx
      have e3 := (dqA i 1).1 x hx
      have e4 := (hDW 0).2 x (hRS hx)
      have e5 := (hDW 1).2 x (hRS hx)
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      calc _ ≤ |smthDQ (fun y => F y i) m h x| +
            (|smthDQ (fun y => a y i 0) m h x| * |smthGrad w x 0| +
              |smthDQ (fun y => a y i 1) m h x| * |smthGrad w x 1|) := by
            refine (abs_sub _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl ?_)
            rw [← abs_mul, ← abs_mul]
            exact abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ B + (B * B + B * B) := add_le_add e1 (add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul e2 e4 (abs_nonneg _) hB0) (mul_le_mul e3 e5 (abs_nonneg _) hB0))
        _ ≤ K₀ := by rw [hK₀r]; linarith
    · 
      refine of_dist _ _ _ _ (fun x hx y hy => ?_)
      have hDn : 0 ≤ dist x y ^ (α : ℝ) := by positivity
      have hD : 0 ≤ (K₀ : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (α : ℝ) := by positivity
      refine (dist_pi_le_iff hD).2 (fun i => ?_)
      have hxρ := hRS hx
      have hyρ := hRS hy
      have f1 := (dqF i).2.dist_le hx hy
      have f2 := (dqA i 0).2.dist_le hx hy
      have f3 := (dqA i 1).2.dist_le hx hy
      have f4 := (hDW 0).1.dist_le hxρ hyρ
      have f5 := (hDW 1).1.dist_le hxρ hyρ
      simp only [Real.dist_eq] at f1 f2 f3 f4 f5 ⊢
      have p0 := prod_le _ _ _ _ _ _ ((dqA i 0).1 x hx) ((hDW 0).2 y hyρ) f2 f4
      have p1 := prod_le _ _ _ _ _ _ ((dqA i 1).1 x hx) ((hDW 1).2 y hyρ) f3 f5
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      calc _ ≤ (C : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (α : ℝ) + 2 * (2 * B * (C * dist x y ^ (α : ℝ))) :=
            comb _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f1 p0 p1
        _ = (C + 4 * B * C) * dist x y ^ (α : ℝ) := by ring
        _ ≤ K₀ * dist x y ^ (α : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hFK2 hDn
    · 
      intro x hx
      exact (dqW.1 x hx).trans hBK
    · 
      have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ 1
          (fun x => (w (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - w x) / h) (ball x₀ R) := by
        refine ContDiffOn.div_const (ContDiffOn.sub ?_ (hw1.mono (hRS.trans hρS))) h
        exact hw1.comp (contDiffOn_id.add contDiffOn_const) (fun x hx => hρS (hshS x hx))
      exact hc
    · 
      have hh0 : |h| ≠ 0 := hh.ne'
      refine ⟨Real.toNNReal (2 * C / |h|), of_dist _ _ _ _ (fun x hx y hy => ?_)⟩
      rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by positivity)]
      have hD : 0 ≤ 2 * (C : ℝ) / |h| * dist x y ^ (α : ℝ) := by positivity
      refine (dist_pi_le_iff hD).2 (fun j => ?_)
      have hxS := hρS (hRS hx)
      have hyS := hρS (hRS hy)
      rw [hgdq w m h x (hw.1 x hxS) (hw.1 _ (hρS (hshS x hx))) j,
        hgdq w m h y (hw.1 y hyS) (hw.1 _ (hρS (hshS y hy))) j, Real.dist_eq]
      have g1 := (hDW j).1.dist_le (hshS x hx) (hshS y hy)
      have g2 := (hDW j).1.dist_le (hRS hx) (hRS hy)
      rw [hdist] at g1
      simp only [Real.dist_eq] at g1 g2
      rw [div_sub_div_same, abs_div, div_le_iff₀ hh]
      have e2 : 2 * (C : ℝ) / |h| * dist x y ^ (α : ℝ) * |h| = 2 * C * dist x y ^ (α : ℝ) := by
        field_simp
      rw [e2]
      have e : ∀ p q r s : ℝ, p - q - (r - s) = (p - r) - (q - s) := by intros; ring
      rw [e]
      have h4 := abs_sub (smthGrad w (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) j -
        smthGrad w (y + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) j) (smthGrad w x j - smthGrad w y j)
      linarith
    · 
      exact smth_lin_dq_eq S hS a F w (fun i j => (ha0 i j).1) (fun i => (hF0 i).1) hw.1
        (fun j => (hw.2 j).1) heq x₀ R hR (h2R.trans hρS) m h hh hhR
  
  have hlim : ∀ m : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => smthGrad w x m) (ball x₀ (R / 2)) ∧
      HolderOnWith M α (smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad w x m)) (ball x₀ (R / 2)) := by
    intro m
    refine smth_dq_limit w x₀ (R / 2) (R / 2) (half_pos hR) (half_pos hR) ?_ m M α hα0 ?_
    · refine hw1.mono ?_
      rw [add_halves]
      exact hRS.trans hρS
    · intro h hpos hlt
      exact hM x₀ _ _ (smthDQ w m h) (hdata m h hpos (by linarith))
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (C' α' : NNReal) (s : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))
      (m : Fin 2), HolderOnWith C' α' f s → HolderOnWith C' α' (fun x => f x m) s := by
    intro f C' α' s m hf x hx y hy
    exact (edist_le_pi_edist (f x) (f y) m).trans (hf x hx y hy)
  have hR2 : 0 < R / 2 := half_pos hR
  have hRR : ball x₀ (R / 2) ⊆ ball x₀ R := ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  refine ⟨ball x₀ (R / 2), isOpen_ball, mem_ball_self hR2, hRR.trans (hRS.trans hρS), ?_⟩
  refine ⟨fun x hx => hw.1 x (hρS (hRS (hRR hx))), fun m => ⟨?_, fun j => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact ((hlim m).1.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)
  · exact (hcoord _ M α _ j (hlim m).2).continuousOn hα0
  · intro x hx
    have hxd := mem_ball.1 hx
    refine ⟨R / 2 - dist x x₀, M, α, by linarith, hα0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ball_subset_ball' (by linarith)
    · exact (hcoord _ M α _ j (hlim m).2).mono (ball_subset_ball' (by linarith))

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_holC_mono
subgoal_signatures.statement: (k : ℕ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (hu : smthHolC (k + 1) u S) : smthHolC k u S

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_holC_contDiffOn
subgoal_signatures.statement: (k : ℕ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (hu : smthHolC k u S) : ContDiffOn ℝ k u S

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_holC_local
subgoal_signatures.statement: (k : ℕ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) : (∀ T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ), IsOpen T → T ⊆ S → smthHolC k u S → smthHolC k u T) ∧ ((∀ x ∈ S, ∃ T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ), IsOpen T ∧ x ∈ T ∧ T ⊆ S ∧ smthHolC k u T) → smthHolC k u S)

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_dq_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement: (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r h₀ : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hh₀ : 0 < h₀) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (Metric.ball y (r + h₀))) (m : Fin 2) (M α : NNReal) (hα : 0 < α) (hdq : ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < |h| → |h| < h₀ → HolderOnWith M α (smthGrad (smthDQ u m h)) (Metric.ball y r) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y r, ‖smthGrad (smthDQ u m h) x‖ ≤ (M : ℝ)) : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => smthGrad u x m) (Metric.ball y r) ∧ HolderOnWith M α (smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad u x m)) (Metric.ball y r)

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_holC0_common
subgoal_signatures.statement: (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (f : ι → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, smthHolC 0 (f i) S) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ S) : ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (B C α : NNReal), 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ 0 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧ Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ S ∧ ∀ i, HolderOnWith C α (f i) (Metric.ball x₀ ρ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, |f i x| ≤ (B : ℝ)

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_unif_ellipticity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (K : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x i j) K) (hell : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j) : ∃ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_lin_dq_eq

by
  
  have hw1 : ∀ j : Fin 2, smthHolC 1 (fun x => smthGrad w x j) S := fun j => hw.2 j
  have haC : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x i j) S := by
    intro i j

    exact_mod_cast this

  have cF : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => F x i) S := fun i => (hFC i).continuousOn
  have cW : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad w x j) S :=
    fun j => (hWC j).continuousOn
  have cdA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m) S :=
    fun i j => ((ha i j).2 m).1
  have cdF : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => F y i) x m) S :=
    fun i => ((hF i).2 m).1
  have cWW : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad w y m) x j) S :=
    fun j => ((hw1 m).2 j).1
  
  have hφgrad : ∀ (φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (i : Fin 2), tsupport φ ⊆ S →
      tsupport (fun x => smthGrad φ x i) ⊆ S := by

    exact ((tsupport_comp_subset (g := fun L : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (Pi.single i 1))
      rfl (fderiv ℝ φ)).trans (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ)).trans hφD
  have hint : ∀ (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (i : Fin 2), ContinuousOn f S →

    exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hgk.mul_left
  
  have hsymm : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ j : Fin 2,
      smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad w y j) x m = smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad w y m) x j := by
    intro x hx j
    have hC2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 w S := by
      have := smth_holC_contDiffOn 2 w S hS hw
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x := hC2.contDiffAt (hS.mem_nhds hx)
    have hSy : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ w x := hcd.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp)
    have hdd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x :=

    have key : ∀ j' m' : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad w y j') x (Pi.single m' 1) =

      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hdd (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad w y j) x (Pi.single m 1) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad w y m) x (Pi.single j 1)
    rw [key, key]
    exact hSy _ _
  
  have hprod : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      smthGrad (fun y => a y i 0 * smthGrad w y 0 + a y i 1 * smthGrad w y 1 - F y i) x m =
        smthGrad (fun y => a y i 0) x m * smthGrad w x 0 +
          a x i 0 * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad w y 0) x m +

          smthGrad (fun y => F y i) x m := by

    have hd := (((((ha i 0).1 x hx).hasFDerivAt.mul ((hw1 0).1 x hx).hasFDerivAt).add

      (Pi.single m 1) = _
    rw [hfd]
    simp only [smthGrad, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hP : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ 1
      (fun x => a x i 0 * smthGrad w x 0 + a x i 1 * smthGrad w x 1 - F x i) S :=
    fun i => (((haC i 0).mul (hWC 0)).add ((haC i 1).mul (hWC 1))).sub (hFC i)
  have heq' : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ S →
      ∫ x, (∑ i : Fin 2, (a x i 0 * smthGrad w x 0 + a x i 1 * smthGrad w x 1 - F x i) *
        smthGrad φ x i + (0 : ℝ) * φ x) = 0 := by
    intro φ hφ hφc hφD
    have hL : Integrable
        (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad φ x i) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        hint (fun x => a x i j * smthGrad w x j) φ i ((cA i j).mul (cW j)) hφ hφc hφD
    have hR : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad φ x i) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => hint (fun x => F x i) φ i (cF i) hφ hφc hφD
    have hpt : (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, (a x i 0 * smthGrad w x 0 + a x i 1 * smthGrad w x 1 -

        fun x => (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad φ x i) -
          ∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad φ x i := by
      funext x
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    rw [hpt, integral_sub hL hR, heq φ hφ hφc hφD, sub_self]
  have hs : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ S →
      ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, (smthGrad
        (fun y => a y i 0 * smthGrad w y 0 + a y i 1 * smthGrad w y 1 - F y i) x m -
          (if i = m then (0 : ℝ) else 0)) * smthGrad φ x i = 0 :=
    smth_ibp_shift S hS
      (fun x i => a x i 0 * smthGrad w x 0 + a x i 1 * smthGrad w x 1 - F x i)
      (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) hP continuousOn_const heq' m

  have h0 := hs φ hφ hφc hφD
  have hL' : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      a x i j * smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad w x m) x j * smthGrad φ x i) :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      hint (fun x => a x i j * smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad w x m) x j) φ i
        ((cA i j).mul (cWW j)) hφ hφc hφD
  have cFm : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => F y i) x m -
      ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m * smthGrad w x j) S :=
    fun i => (cdF i).sub (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => (cdA i j).mul (cW j)))
  have hR' : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, (smthGrad (fun y => F y i) x m -
      ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m * smthGrad w x j) * smthGrad φ x i) :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => hint _ φ i (cFm i) hφ hφc hφD
  have hpt : (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, (smthGrad
        (fun y => a y i 0 * smthGrad w y 0 + a y i 1 * smthGrad w y 1 - F y i) x m -
          (if i = m then (0 : ℝ) else 0)) * smthGrad φ x i) =
      fun x => (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
          a x i j * smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad w x m) x j * smthGrad φ x i) -
        ∑ i : Fin 2, (smthGrad (fun y => F y i) x m -
          ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m * smthGrad w x j) * smthGrad φ x i := by
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ S
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, ite_self, sub_zero]
      rw [hprod x hx 0, hprod x hx 1, hsymm x hx 0, hsymm x hx 1]
      ring
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hzero x hx 0, hzero x hx 1, mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero]
  rw [hpt, integral_sub hL' hR'] at h0
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (Z : Set E3) (a : Fin 3), MeasurableSet Z →
      (∀ x : E3, Set.Subsingleton {t : ℝ | x + t • e a ∈ Z}) → volume Z = 0 := by
    intro Z a hZ hline
    let T₁ : E3 ≃ᵐ (Fin 3 → ℝ) := (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ)).symm
    have h₁ : MeasurePreserving T₁ volume volume :=
      EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 3)
    let T₂ : (Fin 3 → ℝ) ≃ᵐ ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) :=
      MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) a
    have h₂ : MeasurePreserving T₂ volume (volume.prod volume) := by
      have := MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove
        (fun _ : Fin 3 => (volume : Measure ℝ)) a
      simpa only [volume_pi] using this
    let Ψ := T₁.trans T₂
    have hΨ : MeasurePreserving Ψ volume (volume.prod volume) := h₂.comp h₁
    have hW : MeasurableSet (Ψ.symm ⁻¹' Z) := Ψ.symm.measurable hZ
    have hZW : Z = Ψ ⁻¹' (Ψ.symm ⁻¹' Z) := by
      ext z; simp
    rw [hZW, hΨ.measure_preimage_equiv, Measure.prod_apply_symm hW]
    have key : ∀ x' : Fin 2 → ℝ, (fun t => (t, x')) ⁻¹' (Ψ.symm ⁻¹' Z) =
        {t | (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth a 0 x') : E3) + t • e a ∈ Z} := by
      intro x'
      ext t
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      have hsymm : Ψ.symm (t, x') = (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth a t x') : E3) := by
        show T₁.symm (T₂.symm (t, x')) = _
        simp only [T₁, T₂, MeasurableEquiv.symm_symm, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply]
        rfl
      have hsplit : (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth a t x') : E3) =
          (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth a 0 x') : E3) + t • e a := by
        ext i
        rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
        · simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
        · simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne]
      rw [hsymm, hsplit]
    simp_rw [key]
    have h0 : ∀ x' : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        volume {t | (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth a 0 x') : E3) + t • e a ∈ Z} = 0 :=
      fun x' => (hline _).measure_zero _
    simp [h0]
  
  have s4 : ∀ (U : Set E3) (h : E3 → ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h U → ∀ y₀ ∈ U,
      fderiv ℝ h y₀ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ (a : Fin 3) (r : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball y₀ r ⊆ U ∧
        MeasurableSet (Metric.ball y₀ r ∩ h ⁻¹' {0}) ∧
        ∀ x : E3, Set.Subsingleton {t : ℝ | x + t • e a ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r ∩ h ⁻¹' {0}} := by
    intro U h hU hh y₀ hy₀ hd
    have ha : ∃ a, fderiv ℝ h y₀ (e a) ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      apply hd
      have hL : ((fderiv ℝ h y₀ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) = 0 :=
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext (fun i => by simpa using hcon i)
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.coe_injective (by simpa using hL)
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ha
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ h y (e a)) U :=
      (hh.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, fderiv ℝ h y (e a) ≠ 0 :=
      (hcont.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hy₀)).eventually_ne ha
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.1 (inter_mem hev (hU.mem_nhds hy₀))
    refine ⟨a, r, hr, fun y hy => (hrsub hy).2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hcB : ContinuousOn h (ball y₀ r) := hh.continuousOn.mono (fun y hy => (hrsub hy).2)
      have ho := hcB.isOpen_inter_preimage isOpen_ball
        (isOpen_compl_singleton : IsOpen ({(0:ℝ)}ᶜ))
      have hset : ball y₀ r ∩ h ⁻¹' {0} = ball y₀ r \ (ball y₀ r ∩ h ⁻¹' ({(0:ℝ)}ᶜ)) := by
        ext y
        simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff]
        tauto
      rw [hset]
      exact measurableSet_ball.diff ho.measurableSet
    · intro x t₁ ht₁ t₂ ht₂
      by_contra hne
      have main : ∀ s₁ s₂ : ℝ, s₁ < s₂ → x + s₁ • e a ∈ ball y₀ r ∩ h ⁻¹' {0} →
          x + s₂ • e a ∈ ball y₀ r ∩ h ⁻¹' {0} → False := by
        intro s₁ s₂ hs h1 h2
        have hne' : s₂ - s₁ ≠ 0 := (sub_pos.2 hs).ne'
        have hseg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc s₁ s₂, x + t • e a ∈ ball y₀ r := by
          intro t ht
          have hθ0 : 0 ≤ (t - s₁) / (s₂ - s₁) := div_nonneg (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith)
          have hθ1 : (t - s₁) / (s₂ - s₁) ≤ 1 := by
            rw [div_le_one (by linarith)]; linarith [ht.2]
          have hmem := (convex_ball y₀ r).add_smul_sub_mem h1.1 h2.1 ⟨hθ0, hθ1⟩
          convert hmem using 1
          rw [show x + s₂ • e a - (x + s₁ • e a) = (s₂ - s₁) • e a by rw [sub_smul]; abel]
          rw [smul_smul, add_assoc, ← add_smul]
          congr 2
          field_simp
          ring
        have hder : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc s₁ s₂,
            HasDerivAt (fun t => h (x + t • e a)) (fderiv ℝ h (x + t • e a) (e a)) t := by
          intro t ht
          have hyU : x + t • e a ∈ U := (hrsub (hseg t ht)).2
          have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ h (x + t • e a) :=
            (hh.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hyU)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
          have hl : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • e a) (e a) t := by
            simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (e a)).const_add x
          exact hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hl
        obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero hs
          (fun t ht => (hder t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
          (by
            show h (x + s₁ • e a) = h (x + s₂ • e a)
            rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 h1.2, Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 h2.2])
          (fun t ht => hder t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht))
        exact (hrsub (hseg c (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hc))).1 hc0
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
      · exact main _ _ hlt ht₁ ht₂
      · exact main _ _ hlt ht₂ ht₁
  
  have s3 : ∀ (p x : M) (f : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 →
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ≠ 0 := by
    intro p x f hf hx hdf
    have hC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      have h1 := hf.comp_contMDiffOn (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := p) (n := ∞) (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)))
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    refine ⟨hC.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top), ?_⟩
    intro h0
    apply hdf
    have hφx : chartAt E3 p x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).map_source hx
    have hdh : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) :=
      (hC.contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds hφx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have heq : (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ∘ (chartAt E3 p) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] f := by
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).open_source.mem_nhds hx] with z hz
      simp [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hz]
    rw [← heq.mfderiv_eq]
    have hφd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) x :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hx
    rw [mfderiv_comp x (mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.2 hdh) hφd, mfderiv_eq_fderiv, h0]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp _
  
  intro p
  apply measure_null_of_locally_null
  rintro y ⟨x, ⟨hxS, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, f, -, hVo, hxV, hf, hdf, hVS, -⟩ :=
    hS.2 x hxS (chartAt E3 p).source ((chartAt E3 p).open_source.mem_nhds hxs)
  obtain ⟨hC, hne⟩ := s3 p x f hf hxs (hdf x hxV)
  have hUo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' V) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hVo
  have hxU : chartAt E3 p x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' V :=
    ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source hxs, by
      show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) ∈ V
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs]; exact hxV⟩
  obtain ⟨a, r, hr, hBU, hBm, hline⟩ := s4 _ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) hUo
    (hC.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (chartAt E3 p x) hxU hne
  have hZ := s1 _ a hBm hline
  refine ⟨chartAt E3 p '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ ball (chartAt E3 p x) r,
    inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ (ball_mem_nhds _ hr), ?_⟩
  refine measure_mono_null ?_ hZ
  rintro z ⟨⟨w, ⟨hwS, hws⟩, rfl⟩, hzB⟩
  refine ⟨hzB, ?_⟩
  have hwV : w ∈ V := by
    have h1 : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p w) ∈ V := (hBU hzB).2
    rwa [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hws] at h1
  have hw0 : w ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := hVS ▸ ⟨hwV, hwS⟩
  show f ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p w)) ∈ ({0} : Set ℝ)
  rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hws]
  exact hw0.2

signature.statement:

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hext : ∀ (u : M → ℝ) (x : M),
      (IsLocalMin u x → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x = 0) ∧
      (IsLocalMax u x → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x = 0) := by
    intro u x
    by_cases hd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x
    · have hw : writtenInExtChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) x u =
          u ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm := by
        funext y
        simp [writtenInExtChartAt]
      have hc : ContinuousAt (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) :=
        continuousAt_extChartAt_symm x
      have hinv : (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) = x :=
        extChartAt_to_inv x
      rw [hd.mfderiv, hw, ModelWithCorners.range_eq_univ, fderivWithin_univ]
      constructor
      · intro hmin
        rw [← hinv] at hmin
        exact (hmin.comp_continuous hc).fderiv_eq_zero
      · intro hmax
        rw [← hinv] at hmax
        exact (hmax.comp_continuous hc).fderiv_eq_zero
    · exact ⟨fun _ => mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt hd,
        fun _ => mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt hd⟩
  have fermat : ∀ (u : M → ℝ) (x : M), mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0 →
      ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, (∃ y ∈ N, u y < u x) ∧ (∃ y ∈ N, u x < u y) := by
    intro u x hu N hN
    constructor
    · by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hu ((hext u x).1 (Filter.mem_of_superset hN fun y hy => hcon y hy))
    · by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hu ((hext u x).2 (Filter.mem_of_superset hN fun y hy => hcon y hy))
  
  have hpV : p ∈ V := mem_of_mem_nhds hV
  have hpSig : p ∈ Sig := hVS ⟨hpV, hp⟩
  obtain ⟨V₁, f, hV₁V, hV₁o, hpV₁, hf, hdf, hV₁S, -, -, -⟩ := hS.2 p hp V hV
  obtain ⟨V₂, h, hV₂V₁, hV₂o, hpV₂, hh, hdh, hV₂Sig, -, hP, hQ⟩ :=
    hSig.2 p hpSig V₁ (hV₁o.mem_nhds hpV₁)
  have memS : ∀ x ∈ V₁, x ∈ S ↔ f x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    constructor
    · intro h'
      have h'' : x ∈ V₁ ∩ S := ⟨hx, h'⟩
      rw [hV₁S] at h''
      exact h''.2
    · intro h'
      have h'' : x ∈ V₁ ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hx, h'⟩
      rw [← hV₁S] at h''
      exact h''.2
  have memSig : ∀ x ∈ V₂, x ∈ Sig ↔ h x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    constructor
    · intro h'
      have h'' : x ∈ V₂ ∩ Sig := ⟨hx, h'⟩
      rw [hV₂Sig] at h''
      exact h''.2
    · intro h'
      have h'' : x ∈ V₂ ∩ h ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hx, h'⟩
      rw [← hV₂Sig] at h''
      exact h''.2
  have fp0 : f p = 0 := (memS p hpV₁).1 hp
  have hside : ∀ x ∈ V₂, h x ≠ 0 → f x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx hx0 hfx
    have hxV₁ : x ∈ V₁ := hV₂V₁ hx
    have hxS : x ∈ S := (memS x hxV₁).2 hfx
    have hxSig : x ∈ Sig := hVS ⟨hV₁V hxV₁, hxS⟩
    exact hx0 ((memSig x hx).1 hxSig)
  have hhloc : ∀ x ∈ V₂, ∀ N ∈ 𝓝 x, (∃ y ∈ N, h y < h x) ∧ (∃ y ∈ N, h x < h y) :=
    fun x hx N hN => fermat h x (hdh x hx) N hN
  
  have main : ∀ f' : M → ℝ, Continuous f' → (∀ x ∈ V₂, h x ≠ 0 → f' x ≠ 0) →
      (∃ y ∈ V₂, f' y < 0) → ∀ x ∈ V₂, h x = 0 → ¬ (0 < f' x) := by
    intro f' hf' hside' ⟨y, hyV₂, hy⟩ x hxV₂ hx0 hfx
    have hAo : IsOpen {z : M | 0 < f' z} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hf'
    have hBo : IsOpen {z : M | f' z < 0} := isOpen_lt hf' continuous_const
    have hAB : Disjoint {z : M | 0 < f' z} {z : M | f' z < 0} := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro z hz1 hz2
      have h1 : 0 < f' z := hz1
      have h2 : f' z < 0 := hz2
      linarith
    have hcov : ∀ T : Set M, T ⊆ V₂ → (∀ z ∈ T, h z ≠ 0) →
        T ⊆ {z : M | 0 < f' z} ∪ {z : M | f' z < 0} := by
      intro T hT hT0 z hz
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hside' z (hT hz) (hT0 z hz)) with h1 | h1
      · exact Or.inr h1
      · exact Or.inl h1
    have hPs := hP.subset_or_subset hAo hBo hAB
      (hcov _ Set.inter_subset_left (fun z hz => ne_of_gt hz.2))
    have hQs := hQ.subset_or_subset hAo hBo hAB
      (hcov _ Set.inter_subset_left (fun z hz => ne_of_lt hz.2))
    have hUx : V₂ ∩ {z : M | 0 < f' z} ∈ 𝓝 x := (hV₂o.inter hAo).mem_nhds ⟨hxV₂, hfx⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨z, hzU, hz⟩, ⟨z', hz'U, hz'⟩⟩ := hhloc x hxV₂ _ hUx
    rw [hx0] at hz hz'
    have hPA : V₂ ∩ {z : M | 0 < h z} ⊆ {z : M | 0 < f' z} := by
      rcases hPs with h1 | h1
      · exact h1
      · exfalso
        have h2 : f' z' < 0 := h1 ⟨hz'U.1, hz'⟩
        have h3 : 0 < f' z' := hz'U.2
        linarith
    have hQA : V₂ ∩ {z : M | h z < 0} ⊆ {z : M | 0 < f' z} := by
      rcases hQs with h1 | h1
      · exact h1
      · exfalso
        have h2 : f' z < 0 := h1 ⟨hzU.1, hz⟩
        have h3 : 0 < f' z := hzU.2
        linarith
    have hUy : V₂ ∩ {z : M | f' z < 0} ∈ 𝓝 y := (hV₂o.inter hBo).mem_nhds ⟨hyV₂, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨w, hwU, hw⟩, ⟨w', hw'U, hw'⟩⟩ := hhloc y hyV₂ _ hUy
    by_cases hhy : h y ≤ 0
    · have h2 : 0 < f' w := hQA ⟨hwU.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hw hhy⟩
      have h3 : f' w < 0 := hwU.2
      linarith
    · push_neg at hhy
      have h2 : 0 < f' w' := hPA ⟨hw'U.1, lt_trans hhy hw'⟩
      have h3 : f' w' < 0 := hw'U.2
      linarith
  have hfc : Continuous f := hf.continuous
  obtain ⟨⟨y₁, hy₁V₂, hy₁⟩, ⟨y₂, hy₂V₂, hy₂⟩⟩ :=
    fermat f p (hdf p hpV₁) V₂ (hV₂o.mem_nhds hpV₂)
  rw [fp0] at hy₁ hy₂
  have hzero : ∀ x ∈ V₂, h x = 0 → f x = 0 := by
    intro x hxV₂ hx0
    have n1 := main f hfc hside ⟨y₁, hy₁V₂, hy₁⟩ x hxV₂ hx0
    have n2 := main (fun z => -f z) hfc.neg
      (fun z hz hz0 => neg_ne_zero.mpr (hside z hz hz0))
      ⟨y₂, hy₂V₂, by simp only; linarith⟩ x hxV₂ hx0
    simp only [neg_pos] at n2
    push_neg at n1 n2
    linarith
  refine ⟨V₂, hV₂o.mem_nhds hpV₂, ?_⟩
  rintro x ⟨hxV₂, hxSig⟩
  exact (memS x (hV₂V₁ hxV₂)).2 (hzero x hxV₂ ((memSig x hxV₂).1 hxSig))

    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U A B C K₂ : Set M) (hA : IsClosed A) (hB : IsClosed B)
