proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  have hposdef : ∀ (p : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro p y hy
    classical
    have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  
  have s1 : ∀ (P Q : Set E3), IsClosed P → IsClosed Q → Disjoint P Q →
      ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y ∧ χ y ≤ 1) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ P, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Q, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0) := by
    intro P Q hP hQ hPQ
    obtain ⟨f, hf0, hf1, hf01⟩ :=
      exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_nhds_of_isClosed 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (n := ⊤) hQ hP hPQ.symm
    refine ⟨f, ?_, fun y => ⟨(hf01 y).1, (hf01 y).2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp f.contMDiff
    · exact eventually_nhdsSet_iff_forall.mp hf1
    · exact eventually_nhdsSet_iff_forall.mp hf0
  
  have germ : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Y Z : E3 → E3) (y : E3),
      (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, Y z = Z z) → sepDensDiv G Y y = sepDensDiv G Z y := by
    intro G Y Z y hy
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    unfold partialDeriv
    have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) := by
      filter_upwards [hy] with z hz
      rw [hz]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have divZero : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y : E3),
      sepDensDiv G (fun _ => (0 : E3)) y = 0 := by
    intro G y
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    simp
  
  have prodRule : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (χ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      (∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ χ y →
      sepDensDiv G (fun z => χ z • X z) y = χ y * sepDensDiv G X y +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i χ y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i) := by
    intro G X χ y hh hχ
    unfold sepDensDiv
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have hfun : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (χ z • X z) i) =
        fun z => χ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
      funext z
      show Real.sqrt (G z).det * (χ z * X z i) = _
      ring
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hfun, fderiv_fun_mul hχ (hh i)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hsm : ∀ (q : M) (X : E3 → E3) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y → ∀ i : Fin 3,
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det * X z i) y := by
    intro q X y hy hX i
    have hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z a b) y :=
      fun a b => (g.smooth q a b).contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 q).open_target.mem_nhds hy)
    have hdet : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det) y := by
      simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      have h00 := hG 0 0
      have h01 := hG 0 1
      have h02 := hG 0 2
      have h10 := hG 1 0
      have h11 := hG 1 1
      have h12 := hG 1 2
      have h20 := hG 2 0
      have h21 := hG 2 1
      have h22 := hG 2 2
      fun_prop
    have hpos : 0 < (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det := (hposdef q y hy).det_pos
    have hsq : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det) y :=
      hdet.sqrt hpos.ne'
    have hXi : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) y :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp y hX
    exact hsq.mul hXi
  
  unfold hullRiemPer
  refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun p => iSup_mono fun W => iSup_mono fun h =>
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
  unfold hullPerG
  refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
  obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXU, hXn, Cb, hCb⟩ := hX
  have hTt : tsupport X ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hXU hy
    exact (chartAt E3 (p k)).map_source ((h.1 k).2 hx).2
  have hS : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm '' tsupport X) :=
    hXc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 (p k)).continuousOn_symm.mono hTt)
  have hSs : (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm '' tsupport X ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 (p k)).map_target (hTt hy)
  have hPc : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (B ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm '' tsupport X)) :=
    (hS.inter_left hB).image_of_continuousOn
      ((chartAt E3 (p k)).continuousOn.mono (Set.inter_subset_right.trans hSs))
  have hQc : IsCompact
      ((chartAt E3 (p k)) '' ((A ∪ C) ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm '' tsupport X)) :=
    (hS.inter_left (hA.union hC)).image_of_continuousOn
      ((chartAt E3 (p k)).continuousOn.mono (Set.inter_subset_right.trans hSs))
  have hQP : Disjoint
      ((chartAt E3 (p k)) '' ((A ∪ C) ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm '' tsupport X))
      ((chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (B ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm '' tsupport X)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨x₁, ⟨hx₁AC, hx₁S⟩, rfl⟩ ⟨x₂, ⟨hx₂B, hx₂S⟩, hx⟩
    have hx12 : x₂ = x₁ := (chartAt E3 (p k)).injOn (hSs hx₂S) (hSs hx₁S) hx
    rw [hx12] at hx₂B
    rcases hx₁AC with hxA | hxC
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hAB hxA hx₂B
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hBC hx₂B hxC
  have hmem : ∀ (S : Set M) (y : E3), y ∈ tsupport X →
      y ∈ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) →
      y ∈ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm '' tsupport X) := by
    rintro S _ hyT ⟨x, ⟨hxS, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, ⟨hxS, (chartAt E3 (p k)) x, hyT, (chartAt E3 (p k)).left_inv hxs⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ, hχb, hχQ, hχP⟩ := s1 _ _ hQc.isClosed hPc.isClosed hQP
  
  have hclass : ∀ y ∈ tsupport X, (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0) ∨ (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1) ∨
      y ∉ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' ((A ∪ B) ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) := by
    intro y hyT
    by_cases hyB : y ∈ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (B ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)
    · exact Or.inl (hχP y (hmem B y hyT hyB))
    by_cases hyAC : y ∈ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' ((A ∪ C) ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (hχQ y (hmem _ y hyT hyAC)))
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr ?_)
    rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxA | hxB, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact hyAC ⟨x, ⟨Or.inl hxA, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact hyB ⟨x, ⟨hxB, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨X', hX'⟩ : ∃ X' : E3 → E3, ∀ y, X' y = χ y • X y :=
    ⟨fun y => χ y • X y, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hX'f : X' = fun z => χ z • X z := funext hX'
  have hz0 : ∀ y, (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0) → X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
    intro y hy
    filter_upwards [hy] with z hz
    rw [hX' z, hz, zero_smul]
  have hz1 : ∀ y, (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1) → ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z := by
    intro y hy
    filter_upwards [hy] with z hz
    rw [hX' z, hz, one_smul]
  have hzT : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
    intro y hy
    have h0 : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy
    filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
    rw [hX' z, hz, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero]
  
  have hc : ∀ y, y ∉ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (K₂ ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X' y := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
    · by_cases hyB : y ∈ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (B ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hz0 y (hχP y (hmem B y hyT hyB)))
      · have hK1 : y ∉ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' ((A ∪ B) ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) := by
          rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxA | hxB, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
          · exact hy ⟨x, ⟨hAK hxA, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
          · exact hyB ⟨x, ⟨hxB, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
        rw [hX'f]
        exact hχ.contDiffAt.smul (hXs y hK1)
    · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hzT y hyT)
  
  have hsupp : Function.support X' ⊆ Function.support X := by
    intro y hy h0
    apply hy
    rw [hX' y, h0, smul_zero]
  have hb : HasCompactSupport X' := hXc.mono hsupp
  have hcU : tsupport X' ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' W k := (closure_mono hsupp).trans hXU
  
  have hd : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y i j * X' y i * X' y j ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    have hs := hXn y
    have hcomp : ∀ i, X' y i = χ y * X y i := by
      intro i
      rw [hX' y]
      rfl
    have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y i j * X' y i * X' y j =
        (χ y) ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y i j * X y i * X y j := by
      simp only [hcomp, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      ring
    rw [e1]
    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hχb y
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (sq_nonneg (χ y))
    nlinarith
  
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ Cb := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hCb 0)
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : ∃ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ∀ y, ψ y = ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i χ y *
      (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det * X y i) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hZo : IsOpen {y : E3 | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0} := isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds
  have hIo : IsOpen {y : E3 | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1} := isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds
  have hRc : IsCompact (tsupport X \
      ({y : E3 | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0} ∪ {y : E3 | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1})) :=
    hXc.diff (hZo.union hIo)
  have hRsm : ∀ y ∈ tsupport X \
      ({y : E3 | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0} ∪ {y : E3 | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1}),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y ∧ y ∈ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := by
    rintro y ⟨hyT, hyZI⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hTt hyT⟩
    rcases hclass y hyT with h0 | h1 | hK1
    · exact absurd (Or.inl h0) hyZI
    · exact absurd (Or.inr h1) hyZI
    · exact hXs y hK1
  have hψc : ContinuousOn ψ (tsupport X \
      ({y : E3 | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0} ∪ {y : E3 | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1})) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hXy, hyt⟩ := hRsm y hy
    apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    rw [show ψ = fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i χ y *
      (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det * X y i) from funext hψ]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (fun y => partialDeriv i χ y) y := fun i =>
      ((hχ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const).continuousAt
    have hhc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousAt
        (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det * X y i) y :=
      fun i => (hsm (p k) X y hyt hXy i).continuousAt
    exact (((hpd 0).mul (hhc 0)).add ((hpd 1).mul (hhc 1))).add ((hpd 2).mul (hhc 2))
  obtain ⟨Mb, hMb⟩ := hRc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hψc
  have hf : ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X' y| ≤ C' := by
    refine ⟨Cb + |Mb|, fun y => ?_⟩
    by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
    · by_cases hyZ : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0
      · rw [germ _ X' _ y (hz0 y hyZ), divZero, abs_zero]
        linarith [abs_nonneg Mb]
      by_cases hyI : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1
      · rw [germ _ X' X y (hz1 y hyI)]
        linarith [hCb y, abs_nonneg Mb]
      have hyR : y ∈ tsupport X \
          ({y : E3 | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0} ∪ {y : E3 | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1}) := by
        refine ⟨hyT, ?_⟩
        rintro (h0 | h1)
        · exact hyZ h0
        · exact hyI h1
      obtain ⟨hXy, hyt⟩ := hRsm y hyR
      have hdiff : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
          (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm z).det * X z i) y :=
        fun i => (hsm (p k) X y hyt hXy i).differentiableAt (by simp)
      rw [hX'f, prodRule _ X χ y hdiff (hχ.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by simp)), ← hψ y]
      have h1 := hMb y hyR
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      have h2 := hCb y
      obtain ⟨hχ0, hχ1⟩ := hχb y
      have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hχ1
        (abs_nonneg (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y))
      calc |χ y * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y + ψ y|
          ≤ |χ y * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y| + |ψ y| :=
            abs_add_le _ _
        _ = χ y * |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y| + |ψ y| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hχ0]
        _ ≤ Cb + |Mb| := by linarith [le_abs_self Mb]
    · rw [germ _ X' _ y (hzT y hyT), divZero, abs_zero]
      linarith [abs_nonneg Mb]
  
  have hFO : (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) ⊆
      {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z} := by
    intro y hy
    show ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z
    by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
    · have hyQ : y ∈ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' ((A ∪ C) ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm '' tsupport X) := by
        obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxF, hxs⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
        exact hmem _ _ hyT ⟨x, ⟨Or.inr (hFC hxF), hxs⟩, rfl⟩
      exact hz1 y (hχQ y hyQ)
    · have h0 : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hyT
      filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
      rw [hX' z, hz, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero]
  have hOo : IsOpen {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z} := isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds
  have hint : ∫ y in (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X' y =
      ∫ y in (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    have h1 : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z}),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X' y =
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y :=
      ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hOo.measurableSet (fun y hy => germ _ X' X y hy)
    exact ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hFO h1
  rw [← hint]
  exact le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun (Y : E3 → E3)
      (_ : (∀ y, y ∉ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (K₂ ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) →
          ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧
        tsupport Y ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' W k ∧
        (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) ∧
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) Y y| ≤ C) =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in (chartAt E3 (p k)) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) Y y)) X' ⟨hc, hb, hcU, hd, hf⟩ le_rfl

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E U J Γ : Set M) (hE : IsOpen E) (hJ : IsClosed J)
    (hΓ : IsClosed Γ) (hEJ : Disjoint E J) (hEΓ : Disjoint E Γ) (hJΓ : Disjoint J Γ)
    (hside : ∀ p ∈ Γ, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ E = V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) :
    hullRiemPer g E U (J ∪ Γ) ≤ hullRiemPer g E U J

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E U J Γ : Set M) (hE : IsOpen E) (hJ : IsClosed J)

    (hside : ∀ p ∈ Γ, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ E = V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) :

proof.tactics:
by
  unfold hullRiemPer
  refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun p => iSup_mono fun W => iSup_mono fun hW => ?_
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
  set κ := chartAt E3 (p k) with hκ
  have hWs : W k ⊆ κ.source := fun x hx => ((hW.1 k).2 hx).2
  have hWt : κ '' W k ⊆ κ.target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact κ.map_source (hWs hx)
  have hopen : ∀ O : Set M, IsOpen O → IsOpen (κ '' (O ∩ κ.source)) := fun O hO =>
    κ.isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hO.inter κ.open_source) Set.inter_subset_right
  have hdisj : ∀ A B : Set M, Disjoint A B →
      Disjoint (κ '' (A ∩ κ.source)) (κ '' (B ∩ κ.source)) := by
    intro A B hAB
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨a, ⟨haA, has⟩, rfl⟩ ⟨b, ⟨hbB, hbs⟩, hab⟩
    have hba : b = a := κ.injOn hbs has hab
    rw [hba] at hbB
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hAB haA hbB
  have hcl : ∀ A : Set M, IsClosed A →
      closure (κ '' (A ∩ κ.source)) ∩ κ '' W k ⊆ κ '' (A ∩ κ.source) := by
    rintro A hA y ⟨hyc, hyW⟩
    have hyt : y ∈ κ.target := hWt hyW
    have hx : κ.symm y ∈ closure (κ.symm '' (κ '' (A ∩ κ.source))) :=
      mem_closure_image (κ.continuousAt_symm hyt) hyc
    have hsub : κ.symm '' (κ '' (A ∩ κ.source)) ⊆ A := by
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨a, ⟨haA, has⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [κ.left_inv has]
      exact haA
    have hxA : κ.symm y ∈ A := closure_minimal hsub hA hx
    exact ⟨κ.symm y, ⟨hxA, κ.map_target hyt⟩, κ.right_inv hyt⟩
  have hφsmooth : ∀ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f (κ.symm z)) κ.target := by
    intro f hf
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ κ.symm) κ.target :=
      hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  rw [Set.union_inter_distrib_right, Set.image_union]
  refine hullPerG_remove_onesided _ _ _ _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact κ.isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hW.1 k).1 hWs
  · intro i j
    exact (g.smooth (p k) i j).mono hWt
  · intro y hy
    exact coeff_chart_symm_posDef g (p k) y (hWt hy)
  · exact hopen E hE
  · exact hdisj _ _ hEJ
  · exact hdisj _ _ hEΓ
  · exact hdisj _ _ hJΓ
  · exact hcl J hJ
  · exact hcl Γ hΓ
  · rintro y ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxΓ, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, -⟩
    obtain ⟨V, f, hVo, hxV, hf, hdf, hVE⟩ := hside x hxΓ
    have hVt : κ '' (V ∩ κ.source) ⊆ κ.target := by
      rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      exact κ.map_source hw.2
    refine ⟨κ '' (V ∩ κ.source), fun z => f (κ.symm z), hopen V hVo, ⟨x, ⟨hxV, hxs⟩, rfl⟩,
      (hφsmooth f hf).mono hVt, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨w, ⟨hwV, hws⟩, rfl⟩ h0
      have hyt : κ w ∈ κ.target := κ.map_source hws
      have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => f (κ.symm z)) (κ w) :=
        ((hφsmooth f hf).contDiffAt (κ.open_target.mem_nhds hyt)).differentiableAt
          (by simp)
      have hκd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ w :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 (p k)) hws
      have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 w] (fun z => f (κ.symm z)) ∘ κ := by
        filter_upwards [κ.open_source.mem_nhds hws] with v hv
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, κ.left_inv hv]
      have hm : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f w =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ((fun z => f (κ.symm z)) ∘ κ) w := hev.mfderiv_eq
      rw [mfderiv_comp w hφd.mdifferentiableAt hκd, mfderiv_eq_fderiv, h0] at hm
      apply hdf w hwV
      rw [hm]
      rfl
    · ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨a, ⟨haV, has⟩, rfl⟩, ⟨b, ⟨hbE, hbs⟩, hab⟩⟩
        have hba : b = a := κ.injOn hbs has hab

    have h4 := lmc_deriv_thirdJet G U hU hG hsymm hpd y₀ hy₀ ψ φ hψs hφs hψdne
      (fun j => (hj1 j).symm) (fun i j => (hj2 i j).symm) a

        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j *
          (partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ)) y₀ -
            partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ)) y₀)) =
        -(2 * lam) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j *

            (if a = j then partialDeriv i ψ y₀ else 0) +
            (if a = i then partialDeriv j ψ y₀ else 0)) := by
      intro f
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [hj3 a i j]

    obtain ⟨h, hhdef⟩ : ∃ h : E3 → ℝ, h = fun y => τ * (1 + lam * ‖y - y₀‖ ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩

      intro z hφz
      rw [hφeq] at hφz

      · exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h1).resolve_left hτ
      · exact absurd h1 (hm z).ne'

      · rw [hφeq]; exact mul_pos_iff_of_pos_right (hm z)

      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ε,

      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ε, φ z ≤ 0 → sepDensDiv G (hcrNormalField G φ) z ≤ 0) :=
    fun b => key _ (by cases b <;> norm_num)

    cases b
    · exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
    · exact Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨-, -, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hφ b
  exact ⟨h1.mono hsub, fun z hz => h2 z (hsub hz), fun z hz => h3 z (hsub hz),
    fun z hz => h4 z (hsub hz)⟩

    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ) (hφ₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₁ U)

    partialDeriv a (levelMeanCurvCoord G φ₁) y₀ - partialDeriv a (levelMeanCurvCoord G φ₂) y₀ =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        ((G y₀)⁻¹ i j / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
            (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀ * partialDeriv l φ₁ y₀) -
          (∑ k : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀) *
            (∑ l : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ j l * partialDeriv l φ₁ y₀) /
            Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
              (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀ * partialDeriv l φ₁ y₀) ^ 3) *

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (ψ : E3 → ℝ)
    (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U) (hψ0 : ψ y₀ = 0) (t : ℝ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)) U ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)) y₀ = fderiv ℝ ψ y₀ ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)) y₀ =
        partialDeriv j ψ y₀) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2))) y₀ =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) y₀) ∧
      (∀ a i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
          (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)))) y₀ =
        partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ)) y₀ +
          2 * t * ((if i = j then partialDeriv a ψ y₀ else 0) +
            (if a = j then partialDeriv i ψ y₀ else 0) +
            (if a = i then partialDeriv j ψ y₀ else 0)))

      (M⁻¹ i j / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, M⁻¹ k l * ξ k * ξ l) -
        (∑ k : Fin 3, M⁻¹ i k * ξ k) * (∑ l : Fin 3, M⁻¹ j l * ξ l) /

        c * ξ a

  have hDeq : hspSector B φ (fun _ : Fin k => true) = D := by

  have hSD : ∀ s : Fin k → Bool, s ≠ (fun _ : Fin k => true) → hspSector B φ s ∩ D = ∅ := by

    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h1

  have hKcw : ∀ z ∈ B, (∃ i, φ i z = 0) → z ∈ Kc := by
    intro z hz hw

  have hone : ∀ V : Set E3, IsOpen V → V ⊆ B → hullPerG G Fκ V Kc ≤ hullRiemPer g F Ω K := by

    have hWsub : κ.symm '' V ⊆ Ω ∩ κ.source := by

  have hΦle : ∀ V : Set E3, sepPerG G (Fκ ∩ D) V ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ Fκ V := by

    rw [← hDeq]

  unfold sepIsPerMin
  refine ⟨(hF p).inter hDo.measurableSet,

  intro F' V K' hF' hV _ hVB hK'c hK'V hsd

  have hVt : V ⊆ κ.target := hVB'.trans hBt
  have hK't : K' ⊆ κ.target := hK'V.trans hVt
  have hF'sub : F' \ (Fκ ∩ D) ⊆ K' := fun z hz => hsd (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr hz))
  have hΦsub : (Fκ ∩ D) \ F' ⊆ K' := fun z hz => hsd (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl hz))

    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hdc.exists_bound_of_continuous hdt.1
    exact sector_field_removal G B hBo hGsB hpdB k φ hφ hdφ V K' F' hV hVB' hK'c hK'V hF'
      (fun z hzF _ ⟨i, hi⟩ => hF'sub ⟨hzF, fun hzΦ => absurd (hzΦ.2.2 i) (not_lt.2 hi)⟩)
      (fun i z hz hle => hcal i z (hVB' (hK'V hz)) hle)
      Y (fun z _ _ => hYs.contDiffAt) hYc hYV hYn
      ⟨C, fun z _ _ => by have := hC z; rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this⟩
  
  set F'' : Set E3 := F' ∩ D with hF''def
  set Ψ : Set E3 := F'' ∪ (Fκ \ D) with hΨdef
  have hΨm : MeasurableSet Ψ :=
    (hF'.inter hDo.measurableSet).union ((hF p).diff hDo.measurableSet)
  have hsdΨ : symmDiff Fκ Ψ ⊆ K' := by
    intro z hz
    rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hz with ⟨hzF, hzΨ⟩ | ⟨hzΨ, hzF⟩
    · have hzD : z ∈ D := by
        by_contra h
        exact hzΨ (Or.inr ⟨hzF, h⟩)
      exact hΦsub ⟨⟨hzF, hzD⟩, fun hzF' => hzΨ (Or.inl ⟨hzF', hzD⟩)⟩
    · rcases hzΨ with ⟨hzF', _⟩ | ⟨hzF2, _⟩
      · exact hF'sub ⟨hzF', fun h => hzF h.1⟩
      · exact absurd hzF2 hzF
  have hΨtop : Ψ ∩ hspSector B φ (fun _ : Fin k => true) = F'' := by
    rw [hDeq]
    ext z
    simp only [hΨdef, hF''def, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff]
    tauto
  have hΨs : ∀ s : Fin k → Bool, s ≠ (fun _ : Fin k => true) →
      Ψ ∩ hspSector B φ s = Fκ ∩ hspSector B φ s := by
    intro s hs
    have h0 := hSD s hs
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hzΨ | hzΨ, hzs⟩
      · have : z ∈ hspSector B φ s ∩ D := ⟨hzs, hzΨ.2⟩

      have : z ∈ hspSector B φ s ∩ D := ⟨hzs, hzD⟩
      rw [h0] at this

  set L := κ.symm '' K' with hLdef
  set Ft := (F \ L) ∪ κ.symm '' (Ψ ∩ K') with hFtdef
  have hLKv : L ⊆ Kv := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact interior_subset (hBKv z (hVB' (hK'V hz)))
  have hP1 : symmDiff F Ft ⊆ L := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨hxF, hxFt⟩ | ⟨hxFt, hxF⟩
    · by_contra hxL
      exact hxFt (Or.inl ⟨hxF, hxL⟩)
    · rcases hxFt with ⟨hxF', _⟩ | ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      · exact absurd hxF' hxF
      · exact ⟨z, hz.2, rfl⟩
  have hP2 : symmDiff Ft A₀ ⊆ Kv := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxF : x ∈ F
    · by_cases hxFt : x ∈ Ft
      · apply hFA
        rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨_, hA⟩ | ⟨_, hn⟩
        · exact Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hxF, hA⟩)
        · exact absurd hxFt hn
      · exact hLKv (hP1 (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hxF, hxFt⟩)))
    · by_cases hxFt : x ∈ Ft
      · exact hLKv (hP1 (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hxFt, hxF⟩)))
      · apply hFA
        rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hx with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨hA, _⟩
        · exact absurd h hxFt
        · exact Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hA, hxF⟩)
  have hΨsub1 : Ψ \ Fκ ⊆ K' := fun z hz => hsdΨ (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr hz))
  have hΨsub2 : Fκ \ Ψ ⊆ K' := fun z hz => hsdΨ (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl hz))
  have hP3 : κ '' (Ft ∩ κ.source) = Ψ := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxFt, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
      rcases hxFt with ⟨hxF, hxL⟩ | ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩

        refine ⟨x, ⟨Or.inl ⟨hxF, ?_⟩, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
        rintro ⟨w, hw, hwx⟩

  have hP4 : sepChartMeas Ft := by
    intro q

      have heq : κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' L = κq.target \ (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' Lᶜ) := by
        ext z

    have hBm : MeasurableSet (Ψ ∩ K') := hΨm.inter hK'c.isClosed.measurableSet
    have hsymmB : κ.symm '' (Ψ ∩ K') = κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' (Ψ ∩ K') :=

    have hDo' : IsOpen (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) :=

    have hτc : ContinuousOn (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) :=

      have hpw : Measurable ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source).piecewise

        hτc.measurable_piecewise continuousOn_const hDo'.measurableSet
      have heq : (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) ∩ (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) ⁻¹' (Ψ ∩ K') =
          (κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source) ∩ ((κq.target ∩ κq.symm ⁻¹' κ.source).piecewise
            (fun z => κ (κq.symm z)) (fun _ => (0 : E3))) ⁻¹' (Ψ ∩ K') := by
        ext z
        constructor

      rw [hFtdef, hsymmB]
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_diff]

  have hcmp : ∀ V₁ V₂ : Set E3, IsOpen V₁ → IsOpen V₂ → K' ⊆ V₂ → IsCompact (closure V₂) →

    intro V₁ V₂ hV₁ hV₂ hK'V₂ hV₂c hV₂V₁ hV₁V

      (fun s => (hSo s).measurableSet) (hF p) hΨm hV hVt hK'c hK'V hsdΨ (hfinS V hV hVB') hcmp
  
  have hsplit : ∀ E : Set E3, hspSectorPer G B φ E V =

    intro E

    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs => ?_
    rw [hΨs s (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hs)]

    refine ne_top_of_le_ne_top (hfinS V hV hVB').ne ?_

    (ENNReal.add_le_add_iff_right hRfin).1 hSig

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U B : Set E3) (k : ℕ)
    (φ : Fin k → E3 → ℝ) (Φ₁ Φ₂ V K' : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set y₀ : E3 := chartAt E3 p p with hy₀def
  set G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm with hGdef
  have h2le : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by norm_cast
  
  
  
  have hSC : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (x : E3), sepPlaneProj c x = coordPlaneProj c x := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hPsub : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (v w : E3),
      sepPlaneProj c (v - w) = sepPlaneProj c v - sepPlaneProj c w := by
    intro c v w; simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]; abel
  have hPc : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (v : E3), (sepPlaneProj c v) c = 0 := by
    intro c v; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hPdec : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (v : E3), v = sepPlaneProj c v + (v c) • e c := by
    intro c v; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hPadd : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (v : E3) (t : ℝ), sepPlaneProj c (v + t • e c) = sepPlaneProj c v := by
    intro c v t
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, add_smul]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPP : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (v : E3), sepPlaneProj c (sepPlaneProj c v) = sepPlaneProj c v := by
    intro c v
    show sepPlaneProj c v - (sepPlaneProj c v) c • e c = sepPlaneProj c v
    rw [hPc, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hP0 : ∀ c : Fin 3, sepPlaneProj c 0 = 0 := by intro c; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hPlin : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (s t : ℝ) (v w : E3),
      sepPlaneProj c (s • v + t • w) = s • sepPlaneProj c v + t • sepPlaneProj c w := by
    intro c s t v w
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, add_smul, smul_sub,
      mul_smul]
    abel
  have hPnorm : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (v : E3), ‖sepPlaneProj c v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by
    intro c v
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    by_cases h : i = c
    · subst h; simp [sepPlaneProj]; positivity
    · simp [sepPlaneProj, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, h]
  have hcoord_le : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (v : E3), |v c| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
    intro c v
    have := PiLp.norm_apply_le v c
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  have hnorm_split : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (v : E3), ‖v‖ ≤ ‖sepPlaneProj c v‖ + |v c| := by
    intro c v
    calc ‖v‖ = ‖sepPlaneProj c v + (v c) • e c‖ := by rw [← hPdec]
      _ ≤ ‖sepPlaneProj c v‖ + ‖(v c) • e c‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖sepPlaneProj c v‖ + |v c| := by
          rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hPγg : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (z : E3) (t : ℝ),
      sepPlaneProj c (sepPlaneProj c z + t • e c) = sepPlaneProj c z := by
    intro c z t; rw [hPadd, hPP]
  have hγbg : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (z : E3) (t : ℝ), (sepPlaneProj c z + t • e c) c = t := by
    intro c z t; simp [hPc]
  have hPγsub : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (z : E3) (t : ℝ),
      sepPlaneProj c ((sepPlaneProj c z + t • e c) - y₀) = sepPlaneProj c (z - y₀) := by
    intro c z t; rw [hPsub, hPγg, hPsub]
  have hPcd : ∀ c : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (sepPlaneProj c) := by
    intro c; unfold sepPlaneProj; fun_prop
  have hcd : ∀ c : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : E3 => w c) := by intro c; fun_prop
  have hPcont : ∀ c : Fin 3, Continuous fun w : E3 => ‖sepPlaneProj c (w - y₀)‖ := by
    intro c; unfold sepPlaneProj; fun_prop
  
  have hVPpd_c : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (V : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ V → ∀ y : E3,
      partialDeriv c (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj c w)) y = 0 := by
    intro c V hV y
    have hP : HasFDerivAt (sepPlaneProj c)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - (EuclideanSpace.proj c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e c)) y :=
      (hasFDerivAt_id y).sub ((EuclideanSpace.proj c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e c))
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj c w))
        ((fderiv ℝ V (sepPlaneProj c y)).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - (EuclideanSpace.proj c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e c))) y :=
      ((hV.differentiable (by simp)) _).hasFDerivAt.comp y hP
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hd.fderiv]
    simp
  have hψpd : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (V : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ V → ∀ (y : E3) (i : Fin 3),
      partialDeriv i (fun w => w c - V (sepPlaneProj c w)) y =
        (e i) c - partialDeriv i (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj c w)) y := by
    intro c V hV y i
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : E3 => w c) y := by fun_prop
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj c w)) y :=
      ((hV.comp (hPcd c)).differentiable (by simp)) y
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub h1 h2, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
    have : (fun w : E3 => w c) = ⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := rfl
    rw [this, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    rfl
  
  have hGs : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i := fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  have hQs : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i := by
    intro y i j
    have hT : (G y).transpose = G y := by
      ext k l; exact hGs y l k
    have h := Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv (G y)
    rw [hT] at h
    have := congrFun (congrFun h j) i
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using this
  
  have hsg : ∀ A B k : ℝ, (A = 0 ↔ B = 0) → (0 < A ↔ 0 < B) → (0 < k * A ↔ 0 < k * B) := by
    intro A B k h0 hp
    have hn : A < 0 ↔ B < 0 := by
      constructor
      · intro hA
        have h1 : ¬ 0 < B := fun hB => absurd (hp.mpr hB) (not_lt.mpr hA.le)
        have h2 : B ≠ 0 := fun hB => absurd (h0.mpr hB) hA.ne
        exact lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h1) h2
      · intro hB
        have h1 : ¬ 0 < A := fun hA => absurd (hp.mp hA) (not_lt.mpr hB.le)
        have h2 : A ≠ 0 := fun hA => absurd (h0.mp hA) hB.ne
        exact lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp h1) h2
    rcases lt_trichotomy k 0 with hk | hk | hk
    · constructor
      · intro h
        have hA : A < 0 := by nlinarith
        have hB := hn.mp hA
        nlinarith
      · intro h
        have hB : B < 0 := by nlinarith
        have hA := hn.mpr hB
        nlinarith
    · subst hk; simp
    · rw [mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hk, mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hk]; exact hp
  
  
  
  set C : Set E3 := sepCyl a y₀ r δ with hCdef
  set B : Set E3 := Metric.ball y₀ ε with hBdef
  set F₁ : E3 → ℝ := fun w => w a - u (sepPlaneProj a w) with hF₁def
  have hCo : IsOpen C := by
    have h1 : Continuous fun z : E3 => ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - y₀)‖ := hPcont a
    have h2 : Continuous fun z : E3 => |z a - y₀ a| := by fun_prop
    exact (isOpen_lt h1 continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt h2 continuous_const)
  have hy₀C : y₀ ∈ C := by
    show ‖sepPlaneProj a (y₀ - y₀)‖ < r ∧ |y₀ a - y₀ a| < δ
    rw [sub_self, hP0, norm_zero, sub_self, abs_zero]; exact ⟨hr, hδ⟩
  have hy₀B : y₀ ∈ B := Metric.mem_ball_self hε
  have hBo : IsOpen B := Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hF₁s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F₁ := (hcd a).sub (hu.comp (hPcd a))
  have hF₁c : Continuous F₁ := hF₁s.continuous
  have hF₁0 : F₁ y₀ = 0 := by
    show y₀ a - u (sepPlaneProj a y₀) = 0
    rw [hu0, sub_self]
  have hF₁a : ∀ y : E3, partialDeriv a F₁ y = 1 := by
    intro y
    show partialDeriv a (fun w => w a - u (sepPlaneProj a w)) y = 1
    rw [hψpd a u hu y a, hVPpd_c a u hu y]
    simp
  have hfc : ContinuousOn f B := hf.continuousOn
  have hτ0 : τ ≠ 0 := by rcases hτ with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have hσ0 : σ ≠ 0 := by rcases hσ with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have hσ2 : σ * σ = 1 := by rcases hσ with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have hτ2 : τ * τ = 1 := by rcases hτ with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  have hOS1 : ∀ z ∈ C, z ∈ B → 0 < σ * F₁ z → 0 ≤ τ * f z := by
    intro z hzC hzB hzs
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    have hO : IsOpen ((C ∩ {w | 0 < σ * F₁ w}) ∩ (B ∩ (fun w => τ * f w) ⁻¹' Set.Iio 0)) :=
      (hCo.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.mul hF₁c))).inter
        ((continuousOn_const.mul hfc).isOpen_inter_preimage hBo isOpen_Iio)
    have hpos := hO.measure_pos volume ⟨z, ⟨hzC, hzs⟩, hzB, hneg⟩
    apply hpos.ne'
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ hnull
    rintro w ⟨⟨hwC, hws⟩, hwB, hwf⟩
    exact ⟨⟨⟨hwC, hwB⟩, hws⟩, hwf⟩
  have hOS2 : ∀ z ∈ C, z ∈ B → f z = 0 → σ * F₁ z ≤ 0 := by
    intro z hzC hzB hz0
    by_contra hpos
    push_neg at hpos
    have hW : (C ∩ B ∩ {w | 0 < σ * F₁ w}) ∈ 𝓝 z :=
      ((hCo.inter hBo).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.mul hF₁c))).mem_nhds
        ⟨⟨hzC, hzB⟩, hpos⟩
    have hlm : IsLocalMin (fun w => τ * f w) z := by
      filter_upwards [hW] with w hw
      show τ * f z ≤ τ * f w
      rw [hz0, mul_zero]
      exact hOS1 w hw.1.1 hw.1.2 hw.2
    have hd := hlm.fderiv_eq_zero
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z :=
      (hf.contDiffAt (hBo.mem_nhds hzB)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    rw [fderiv_const_mul hdiff] at hd
    exact hdf z hzB ((smul_eq_zero.1 hd).resolve_left hτ0)
  
  
  
  have hCBo : IsOpen (C ∩ B) := hCo.inter hBo
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := lagrange_point_multiplier f (fun z => σ * F₁ z) (C ∩ B) hCBo y₀
    ⟨hy₀C, hy₀B⟩ (hf.mono Set.inter_subset_right) ((contDiff_const.mul hF₁s).contDiffOn) hf0
    (hdf y₀ hy₀B)
    (fun z hz hz0 => by
      show σ * F₁ z ≤ σ * F₁ y₀
      rw [hF₁0, mul_zero]
      exact hOS2 z hz.1 hz.2 hz0)
  have hHpd : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => σ * F₁ z) y₀ = σ * partialDeriv k F₁ y₀ := by
    intro k
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_const_mul ((hF₁s.differentiable (by simp)) y₀)]
    simp
  set κ : ℝ := σ * μ with hκdef
  have hTAN : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k F₁ y₀ = κ * partialDeriv k f y₀ := by
    intro k
    have h : σ * partialDeriv k F₁ y₀ = μ * partialDeriv k f y₀ := (hHpd k).symm.trans (hμ k)
    linear_combination σ * h - partialDeriv k F₁ y₀ * hσ2
  have hκ : κ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have := hTAN a
    rw [hF₁a, h0, zero_mul] at this
    exact one_ne_zero this
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨b, -, hbmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ
    (fun k => |partialDeriv k f y₀|) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have hbmax' : ∀ k, |partialDeriv k f y₀| ≤ |partialDeriv b f y₀| :=
    fun k => hbmax k (Finset.mem_univ _)
  have hd₂ : partialDeriv b f y₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hdf y₀ hy₀B
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.coe_injective
    apply (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext
    intro i
    have h1 : |partialDeriv i f y₀| ≤ 0 := by
      have := hbmax' i; rwa [h0, abs_zero] at this
    have hi : fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e i) = 0 := abs_nonpos_iff.mp h1
    simp [hi]
  have hd₁ : partialDeriv b F₁ y₀ = κ * partialDeriv b f y₀ := hTAN b
  have hd₁ne : partialDeriv b F₁ y₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [hd₁]; exact mul_ne_zero hκ hd₂
  have hbndF : ∀ i, |partialDeriv i F₁ y₀| ≤ |partialDeriv b F₁ y₀| := by
    intro i
    calc |partialDeriv i F₁ y₀| = |κ| * |partialDeriv i f y₀| := by
          rw [hTAN i, abs_mul κ]
      _ ≤ |κ| * |partialDeriv b f y₀| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbmax' i) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = |partialDeriv b F₁ y₀| := by rw [hTAN b, abs_mul κ]
  obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, hε₁sub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hCBo y₀ ⟨hy₀C, hy₀B⟩
  have hBall_C : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ε₁, z ∈ C := fun z hz => (hε₁sub hz).1
  have hBall_B : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ε₁, z ∈ B := fun z hz => (hε₁sub hz).2

    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
    have hn : ‖z - y₀‖ < 2 * s := by
      have := hnorm_split a (z - y₀)
      rw [PiLp.sub_apply] at this
      linarith
    have hPb : ‖sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀)‖ < 2 * s := lt_of_le_of_lt (hPnorm b _) hn
    have hzb : |z b - y₀ b| < 2 * s := by
      have := hcoord_le b (z - y₀)
      rw [PiLp.sub_apply] at this
      linarith
    refine ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ?_, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩,
      ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith⟩
    show z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ε
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    linarith
  have hX : ∀ (x v c : ℝ), c ≠ 0 → (x = v ↔ c * (x - v) = 0) := by
    intro x v c hc
    rw [mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero]
    simp [hc]
  have hfinal : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a y₀ s s,
      (f z = 0 ↔ F₁ z = 0) ∧
      (0 < τ * f z ↔ 0 < τ * (partialDeriv b f y₀ * (z b - V₁ (sepPlaneProj b z)))) ∧
      (0 < σ * F₁ z ↔
        0 < σ * (κ * partialDeriv b f y₀ * (z b - V₁ (sepPlaneProj b z)))) := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨-, -, hz1, hz2, hz2ρ⟩ := hzfacts z hz
    have hv := hEQ z hz2ρ
    have i1 := hiff₁ z hz1
    have i2 := hiff₂ z hz2
    rw [← hv] at i2
    rw [hd₁] at i1
    refine ⟨i2.1.trans i1.1.symm, hsg _ _ τ (i2.1.trans (hX _ _ _ hd₂)) i2.2,
      hsg _ _ σ (i1.1.trans (hX _ _ _ (mul_ne_zero hκ hd₂))) i1.2⟩
  
  have hSG : 0 < τ * κ * σ := by
    obtain ⟨zs, hzs⟩ : ∃ zs : E3, zs = y₀ + (s / 2 * σ) • e a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPe : sepPlaneProj a ((s / 2 * σ) • e a) = 0 := by
      have := hPadd a 0 (s / 2 * σ)
      rwa [zero_add, hP0] at this
    have habsσ : |σ| = 1 := by rcases hσ with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
    have hzsa : zs a - y₀ a = s / 2 * σ := by rw [hzs]; simp
    have hzsmem : zs ∈ sepCyl a y₀ s s := by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hzs, add_sub_cancel_left, hPe, norm_zero]; exact hs
      · rw [hzsa, abs_mul, habsσ, mul_one, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]; linarith
    have hPzs : sepPlaneProj a zs = sepPlaneProj a y₀ := by rw [hzs, hPadd]
    have hF₁zs : F₁ zs = s / 2 * σ := by
      show zs a - u (sepPlaneProj a zs) = s / 2 * σ
      rw [hPzs, hu0]; exact hzsa
    obtain ⟨hzsC, hzsB, -, -, -⟩ := hzfacts zs hzsmem
    have hσF : 0 < σ * F₁ zs := by
      rw [hF₁zs]
      have : σ * (s / 2 * σ) = s / 2 * (σ * σ) := by ring
      rw [this, hσ2]; linarith
    have hτf0 := hOS1 zs hzsC hzsB hσF
    obtain ⟨h0, hτ', hσ'⟩ := hfinal zs hzsmem
    have hfne : f zs ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have := h0.mp h
      rw [hF₁zs] at this
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp this with h' | h'
      · linarith
      · exact hσ0 h'
    have hτf : 0 < τ * f zs := lt_of_le_of_ne hτf0 (Ne.symm (mul_ne_zero hτ0 hfne))
    have hA := hτ'.mp hτf
    have hB := hσ'.mp hσF
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    nlinarith [mul_pos hA hB, sq_nonneg (partialDeriv b f y₀ * (zs b - V₁ (sepPlaneProj b zs)))]
  
  
  
  refine ⟨s, s, hs, hsr, hs, hsδ, fun z hz => (hzfacts z hz).2.1, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨h0, hτf, hσF⟩ := hfinal z hz
  refine ⟨h0.trans (show F₁ z = 0 ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z) from sub_eq_zero), ?_⟩
  have hmul : σ * (κ * partialDeriv b f y₀ * (z b - V₁ (sepPlaneProj b z))) =
      (τ * κ * σ) * (τ * (partialDeriv b f y₀ * (z b - V₁ (sepPlaneProj b z)))) := by
    linear_combination (-(σ * κ * partialDeriv b f y₀ * (z b - V₁ (sepPlaneProj b z)))) * hτ2
  have key : 0 < τ * (partialDeriv b f y₀ * (z b - V₁ (sepPlaneProj b z))) ↔
      0 < σ * (κ * partialDeriv b f y₀ * (z b - V₁ (sepPlaneProj b z))) := by
    rw [hmul, mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hSG]
  exact hτf.trans (key.trans hσF.symm)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (p : M) (a : Fin 3) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (10 * ρ) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target)
    (U V : E3 → ℝ) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (hslabU : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      |U (coordPlaneProj a y) - (chartAt E3 p p) a| ≤ 8 * ρ)
    (hslabV : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      |V (coordPlaneProj a y) - (chartAt E3 p p) a| ≤ 8 * ρ)
    (hMU : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => z a - U (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (coordPlaneProj a y + U (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) = 0)
    (hMV : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => z a - V (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (coordPlaneProj a y + V (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) = 0)
    (hle : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      U (coordPlaneProj a y) ≤ V (coordPlaneProj a y)) :
    ∀ y₁ : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y₁ - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < 2 * ρ →
      V (coordPlaneProj a y₁) - U (coordPlaneProj a y₁) = 0 →
      ∃ (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (r lam Lam K : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < lam ∧

              (fun y' => V (coordPlaneProj a y') - U (coordPlaneProj a y'))) y ≤

signature.statement: (q₁ q₂ : E3) (hq₁ : ‖q₁‖ = 1) (hq₂ : ‖q₂‖ = 1) (hind : LinearIndependent ℝ ![q₁, q₂]) : ∃ (β : OrthonormalBasis (Fin 3) ℝ E3) (σ τ : ℝ), 0 < σ ∧ 0 < τ ∧ q₁ = (-σ) • β 0 + τ • β 1 ∧ q₂ = (-σ) • β 0 + (-τ) • β 1

proof.tactics:
by
  have hsum : q₁ + q₂ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := (LinearIndependent.pair_iff.mp hind) 1 1 (by rw [one_smul, one_smul]; exact h)
    exact one_ne_zero this.1
  have hdiff : q₁ - q₂ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := (LinearIndependent.pair_iff.mp hind) 1 (-1)
      (by rw [one_smul, neg_one_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]; exact h)
    exact one_ne_zero this.1
  have hA0 : ‖q₁ + q₂‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hsum
  have hB0 : ‖q₁ - q₂‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hdiff
  have hApos : 0 < ‖q₁ + q₂‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hsum
  have hBpos : 0 < ‖q₁ - q₂‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hdiff
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : E3, b = (-‖q₁ + q₂‖⁻¹) • (q₁ + q₂) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : E3, c = ‖q₁ - q₂‖⁻¹ • (q₁ - q₂) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hbn : ‖b‖ = 1 := by
    rw [hb, norm_smul, norm_neg, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hA0]
  have hcn : ‖c‖ = 1 := by
    rw [hc, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hB0]
  have horth : @inner ℝ E3 _ (q₁ + q₂) (q₁ - q₂) = 0 :=
    (real_inner_add_sub_eq_zero_iff q₁ q₂).mpr (hq₁.trans hq₂.symm)
  have hbc : @inner ℝ E3 _ b c = 0 := by
    rw [hb, hc, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, horth, mul_zero, mul_zero]

  have hcc : @inner ℝ E3 _ c c = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hcn, one_pow]
  have hON : Orthonormal ℝ (({0, 1} : Set (Fin 3)).restrict ![b, c, 0]) := by
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hi hj
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl <;>

  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := Orthonormal.exists_orthonormalBasis_extension_of_card_eq hdim hON
  have hβ0 : β 0 = b := by

    simpa using this

    simpa using this

      rw [neg_mul_neg, div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_inv_cancel₀ hA0]
    have h2 : ‖q₁ - q₂‖ / 2 * ‖q₁ - q₂‖⁻¹ = 1 / 2 := by

    rw [hβ0, hβ1, hb, hc, smul_smul, smul_smul, h1, h2]
    module
  · have h1 : -(‖q₁ + q₂‖ / 2) * -‖q₁ + q₂‖⁻¹ = 1 / 2 := by

    have h2 : -(‖q₁ - q₂‖ / 2) * ‖q₁ - q₂‖⁻¹ = -(1 / 2) := by

    rw [hβ0, hβ1, hb, hc, smul_smul, smul_smul, h1, h2]

by

  have hcont : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z : E3 => z i) := fun i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i).continuous

  obtain ⟨f, hfdef⟩ : ∃ f : E3 → ℝ, f = sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hfdef]
  have hf : ∀ z : E3, f z = partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) z + partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) z +
      partialDeriv 2 (fun w => X w 2) z := by
    intro z
    rw [hfdef]
    simp only [sepDensDiv, Matrix.det_one, Real.sqrt_one, one_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hfeq : f = fun z => partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) z + partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) z +
      partialDeriv 2 (fun w => X w 2) z := funext hf
  have hfc : Continuous f := by
    rw [hfeq]; exact ((hdp 0 0).1.add (hdp 1 1).1).add (hdp 2 2).1
  have hfs : HasCompactSupport f := by
    rw [hfeq]; exact ((hdp 0 0).2.add (hdp 1 1).2).add (hdp 2 2).2
  have hfi : Integrable f := hfc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hfs
  have hf0 : ∀ z : E3, z 0 ≤ 0 → f z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hf, (hvan z hz 0 0).2, (hvan z hz 1 1).2, (hvan z hz 2 2).2]; ring
  
  have hmeasW : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | k * z 0 < |z 1|} :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.mul (hcont 0)) (hcont 1).abs).measurableSet
  have hmeasP : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | k * z 0 < z 1} :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.mul (hcont 0)) (hcont 1)).measurableSet
  have hmeasM : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | z 1 < -k * z 0} :=
    (isOpen_lt (hcont 1) (continuous_const.mul (hcont 0))).measurableSet
  have hsplit : ∫ z in {z : E3 | k * z 0 < |z 1|}, f z =
      (∫ z in {z : E3 | k * z 0 < z 1}, f z) + ∫ z in {z : E3 | z 1 < -k * z 0}, f z := by
    rw [← integral_indicator hmeasW, ← integral_indicator hmeasP, ← integral_indicator hmeasM,
      ← integral_add (hfi.indicator hmeasP) (hfi.indicator hmeasM)]
    congr 1
    funext z
    simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have e : -k * z 0 = -(k * z 0) := by ring
    simp only [e]
    by_cases h0 : z 0 ≤ 0
    · rw [hf0 z h0]; simp
    · push_neg at h0
      have hkz : 0 < k * z 0 := mul_pos hk h0
      by_cases h1 : k * z 0 < z 1
      · have hW : k * z 0 < |z 1| := lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (le_abs_self _)
        have hM : ¬ z 1 < -(k * z 0) := by linarith
        rw [if_pos hW, if_pos h1, if_neg hM, add_zero]
      · by_cases h2 : z 1 < -(k * z 0)
        · have hW : k * z 0 < |z 1| := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (neg_le_abs (z 1))
          rw [if_pos hW, if_neg h1, if_pos h2, zero_add]
        · have hW : ¬ k * z 0 < |z 1| := by
            push_neg at h1 h2
            rw [not_lt, abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
          rw [if_neg hW, if_neg h1, if_neg h2, add_zero]
  
  have hHS : ∀ c : ℝ,
      (∫ z in {z : E3 | c * z 0 < z 1}, f z =
        -∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, (X (cylPt q.1 (c * q.1 + 0) q.2) 1 - c * X (cylPt q.1 (c * q.1 + 0) q.2) 0)) ∧
      (∫ z in {z : E3 | z 1 < c * z 0}, f z =
        ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, (X (cylPt q.1 (c * q.1 + 0) q.2) 1 - c * X (cylPt q.1 (c * q.1 + 0) q.2) 0)) := by
    intro c
    have hΦ : MeasurePreserving (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)
        volume volume :=
      cylPt_measurePreserving.comp (prod3_shear_measurePreserving c)
    have htr : ∀ H : Set E3, MeasurableSet H → ∫ z in H, f z =
        ∫ p in (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) ⁻¹' H,
          f (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) := by
      intro H hH
      have h := setIntegral_map (μ := (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ))) hH
        hfc.aestronglyMeasurable hΦ.measurable.aemeasurable
      rw [hΦ.map_eq] at h
      exact h
    have hpreP : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) ⁻¹'
        {z : E3 | c * z 0 < z 1} = {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.2.1} := by
      ext p
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hc0, hc1]
      constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
    have hpreM : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) ⁻¹'
        {z : E3 | z 1 < c * z 0} = {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 < 0} := by
      ext p
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hc0, hc1]
      constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
    have hmP : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | c * z 0 < z 1} :=
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_const.mul (hcont 0)) (hcont 1)).measurableSet
    have hmM : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | z 1 < c * z 0} :=
      (isOpen_lt (hcont 1) (continuous_const.mul (hcont 0))).measurableSet
    have hpt : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ, f (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) =
        (partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) +
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) +
        (partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) -
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) +
        partialDeriv 2 (fun w => X w 2) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) := by
      intro p; rw [hf]; ring
    obtain ⟨hA00c, hA00s, -, -⟩ := cylShear_comp_compactSupport _ (hdp 0 0).1 (hdp 0 0).2 c
    obtain ⟨hA01c, hA01s, -, -⟩ := cylShear_comp_compactSupport _ (hdp 0 1).1 (hdp 0 1).2 c
    obtain ⟨hA11c, hA11s, -, -⟩ := cylShear_comp_compactSupport _ (hdp 1 1).1 (hdp 1 1).2 c
    obtain ⟨hA22c, hA22s, -, -⟩ := cylShear_comp_compactSupport _ (hdp 2 2).1 (hdp 2 2).2 c
    obtain ⟨hX0c, hX0s, -, -⟩ := cylShear_comp_compactSupport _ (hXp 0).1 (hXp 0).2 c
    obtain ⟨hX1c, hX1s, -, -⟩ := cylShear_comp_compactSupport _ (hXp 1).1 (hXp 1).2 c
    obtain ⟨hX2c, hX2s, -, -⟩ := cylShear_comp_compactSupport _ (hXp 2).1 (hXp 2).2 c
    
    have hTc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) +
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) :=
      hA00c.add (continuous_const.mul hA01c)
    have hTs : HasCompactSupport (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) +
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) :=
      hA00s.add hA01s.mul_left
    
    have hUc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) -
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) :=
      hA11c.sub (continuous_const.mul hA01c)
    have hUs : HasCompactSupport (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) -
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) :=
      hA11s.sub hA01s.mul_left
    have hFUc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        X (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) 1 - c * X (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) 0) :=
      hX1c.sub (continuous_const.mul hX0c)
    have hFUs : HasCompactSupport (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        X (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) 1 - c * X (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) 0) :=
      hX1s.sub hX0s.mul_left
    have iT : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) +
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) :=
      hTc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hTs
    have iU : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) -
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) :=
      hUc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hUs
    have iS : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
        partialDeriv 2 (fun w => X w 2) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) :=
      hA22c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hA22s
    have hsum : ∀ S : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ), ∫ p in S, f (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) =
        (∫ p in S, (partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) +
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2))) +
        (∫ p in S, (partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) -
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2))) +
        ∫ p in S, partialDeriv 2 (fun w => X w 2) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) := by
      intro S
      have i12 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
          (partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) +
            c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) +
          (partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) -
            c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)))
          (volume.restrict S) := iT.integrableOn.add iU.integrableOn
      rw [← integral_add iT.integrableOn iU.integrableOn, ← integral_add i12 iS.integrableOn]
      congr 1
      funext p
      exact hpt p
    have hdT : ∀ t u s : ℝ, HasDerivAt
        (fun x : ℝ => (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => X (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) 0) (x, u, s))
        ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
          partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) +
            c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) (t, u, s)) t :=
      fun t u s => (cylShear_hasDerivAt X hX c t u s 0).1
    have hdU : ∀ t u s : ℝ, HasDerivAt
        (fun x : ℝ => (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
          X (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) 1 - c * X (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) 0)
          (t, x, s))
        ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
          partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) -
            c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) (t, u, s)) u :=
      fun t u s => (cylShear_hasDerivAt X hX c t u s 1).2.1.sub
        ((cylShear_hasDerivAt X hX c t u s 0).2.1.const_mul c)
    have hdS : ∀ t u s : ℝ, HasDerivAt
        (fun x : ℝ => (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => X (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) 2) (t, u, x))
        ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ =>
          partialDeriv 2 (fun w => X w 2) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) (t, u, s)) s :=
      fun t u s => (cylShear_hasDerivAt X hX c t u s 2).2.2
    have h7P : ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.2.1},
        (partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) +
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) = 0 :=
      prod3_deriv_fst_integral_zero _ _ hX0s hTc hTs hdT (Set.Ioi 0) measurableSet_Ioi
    have h7M : ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 < 0},
        (partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) +
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) = 0 :=
      prod3_deriv_fst_integral_zero _ _ hX0s hTc hTs hdT (Set.Iio 0) measurableSet_Iio
    have h8P : ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.2.1},
        partialDeriv 2 (fun w => X w 2) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) = 0 :=
      prod3_deriv_thd_integral_zero _ _ hX2s hA22c hA22s hdS (Set.Ioi 0) measurableSet_Ioi
    have h8M : ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 < 0},
        partialDeriv 2 (fun w => X w 2) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) = 0 :=
      prod3_deriv_thd_integral_zero _ _ hX2s hA22c hA22s hdS (Set.Iio 0) measurableSet_Iio
    have h9 : (∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.2.1},
        (partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) -
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) =
        -∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, (X (cylPt q.1 (c * q.1 + 0) q.2) 1 - c * X (cylPt q.1 (c * q.1 + 0) q.2) 0)) ∧
        (∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 < 0},
        (partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) -
          c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) =
        ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, (X (cylPt q.1 (c * q.1 + 0) q.2) 1 - c * X (cylPt q.1 (c * q.1 + 0) q.2) 0)) :=
      prod3_deriv_snd_halfline _ _ hFUc hFUs hUc hUs hdU
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [htr _ hmP, hpreP, hsum, h7P, h8P, h9.1]; ring
    · rw [htr _ hmM, hpreM, hsum, h7M, h8M, h9.2]; ring
  
  obtain ⟨hPk, -⟩ := hHS k
  obtain ⟨-, hMk⟩ := hHS (-k)
  obtain ⟨-, -, hA0c, hA0s⟩ := cylShear_comp_compactSupport _ (hXp 0).1 (hXp 0).2 k
  obtain ⟨-, -, hA1c, hA1s⟩ := cylShear_comp_compactSupport _ (hXp 1).1 (hXp 1).2 k
  obtain ⟨-, -, hB0c, hB0s⟩ := cylShear_comp_compactSupport _ (hXp 0).1 (hXp 0).2 (-k)
  obtain ⟨-, -, hB1c, hB1s⟩ := cylShear_comp_compactSupport _ (hXp 1).1 (hXp 1).2 (-k)
  have iA0 : Integrable (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 0) :=
    hA0c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hA0s
  have iA1 : Integrable (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 1) :=
    hA1c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hA1s
  have iB0 : Integrable (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 0) := by
    have h := hB0c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (μ := (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ))) hB0s
    simpa only [neg_mul] using h
  have iB1 : Integrable (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 1) := by
    have h := hB1c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (μ := (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ))) hB1s
    simpa only [neg_mul] using h
  have iGp : Integrable (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      k * X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 0 - X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 1) :=
    (iA0.const_mul k).sub iA1
  have iGm : Integrable (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      k * X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 0 + X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 1) :=
    (iB0.const_mul k).add iB1
  have hvanq : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, q ∉ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) →
      (k * X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 0 - X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 1 +
        (k * X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 0 + X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 1)) = 0 := by
    intro q hq
    have hq1 : q.1 ≤ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      exact hq ⟨h, Set.mem_univ _⟩
    have e1 : (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 0 ≤ 0 := by rw [hc0]; exact hq1
    have e2 : (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 0 ≤ 0 := by rw [hc0]; exact hq1
    rw [(hvan _ e1 0 0).1, (hvan _ e1 1 0).1, (hvan _ e2 0 0).1, (hvan _ e2 1 0).1]; ring
  have eP : -∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, (X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1 + 0) q.2) 1 - k * X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1 + 0) q.2) 0) =
      ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, (k * X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 0 - X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 1) := by
    rw [← integral_neg]
    congr 1
    funext q
    simp only [add_zero]
    ring
  have eM : ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, (X (cylPt q.1 (-k * q.1 + 0) q.2) 1 - -k * X (cylPt q.1 (-k * q.1 + 0) q.2) 0) =
      ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, (k * X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 0 + X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 1) := by
    congr 1
    funext q
    simp only [add_zero, neg_mul]
    ring
  rw [hsplit, hPk, hMk, eP, eM, setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hvanq,
    integral_add iGp iGm]

subgoal_signatures.name: cylPt_measurePreserving

subgoal_signatures.statement: (c : ℝ) : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (p.1, c * p.1 + p.2.1, p.2.2)) volume volume

subgoal_signatures.name: cylShear_hasDerivAt
subgoal_signatures.statement: (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (c t u s : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => X (cylPt x (c * x + u) s) i) (partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w i) (cylPt t (c * t + u) s) + c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w i) (cylPt t (c * t + u) s)) t ∧ HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => X (cylPt t (c * t + x) s) i) (partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w i) (cylPt t (c * t + u) s)) u ∧ HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => X (cylPt t (c * t + u) x) i) (partialDeriv 2 (fun w => X w i) (cylPt t (c * t + u) s)) s

subgoal_signatures.name: divField_props
