        u' p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2 =
      (∫ q in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h, u s₂ q.1 q.2) -
      (∫ q in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₁)) (k * s₁) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h, u s₁ q.1 q.2) -
      ∫ q in Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h,
        (k * u q.1 (k * q.1) q.2 + k * u q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) := by
    intro u u' huc hu'c hdu
    have starX : ∀ (g g' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => g q.1 q.2) →
        Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => g' q.1 q.2) →
        (∀ x y, HasDerivAt (fun t => g t y) (g' x y) x) →
        ∫ q in {q : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < q.1 ∧ q.1 < s₂ ∧ |q.2| < k * q.1}, g' q.1 q.2 =
          (∫ y in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂), g s₂ y) -
          (∫ y in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₁)) (k * s₁), g s₁ y) -
          ∫ x in Set.Ioo s₁ s₂, (k * g x (k * x) + k * g x (-(k * x))) := by
      intro g g' hg hg' hdg
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ → ℝ, a = fun y => max s₁ (|y| / k) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hay : ∀ y, a y = max s₁ (|y| / k) := fun y => by rw [ha]
      have hac : Continuous a := by
        rw [ha]; exact continuous_const.max (continuous_abs.div_const k)
      have hgy : ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun y => g x y) := fun x =>
        hg.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id : Continuous fun y : ℝ => (x, y))
      have hg'x : ∀ y : ℝ, Continuous (fun x => g' x y) := fun y =>
        hg'.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const : Continuous fun x : ℝ => (x, y))
      have hga : Continuous (fun y => g (a y) y) :=
        hg.comp (hac.prodMk continuous_id : Continuous fun y : ℝ => (a y, y))
      have hgp : Continuous (fun x => g x (k * x)) :=
        hg.comp (continuous_id.prodMk (continuous_const.mul continuous_id) :
          Continuous fun x : ℝ => (x, k * x))
      have hgm : Continuous (fun x => g x (-(k * x))) :=
        hg.comp (continuous_id.prodMk (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).neg :
          Continuous fun x : ℝ => (x, -(k * x)))
      
      have hI : Integrable ({q : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < q.1 ∧ q.1 < s₂ ∧ |q.2| < k * q.1}.indicator
          (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => g' q.1 q.2)) := (hintTr _ hg').integrable_indicator hTrm
      have hslice : ∫ q in {q : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < q.1 ∧ q.1 < s₂ ∧ |q.2| < k * q.1}, g' q.1 q.2 =
          ∫ y in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂), (g s₂ y - g (a y) y) := by
        rw [← integral_indicator hTrm, Measure.volume_eq_prod, integral_prod_symm _ hI,
          ← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioo]
        congr 1
        funext y
        have e1 : (fun x => {q : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < q.1 ∧ q.1 < s₂ ∧ |q.2| < k * q.1}.indicator
            (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => g' q.1 q.2) (x, y)) =
            (Set.Ioo (a y) s₂).indicator (fun x => g' x y) := by
          funext x
          have hmem : (x, y) ∈ {q : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < q.1 ∧ q.1 < s₂ ∧ |q.2| < k * q.1} ↔
              x ∈ Set.Ioo (a y) s₂ := by
            rw [hay]
            simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Ioo, max_lt_iff, div_lt_iff₀ hk]
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩; exact ⟨⟨h1, by linarith⟩, h2⟩
            · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h3⟩, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, h2, by linarith⟩
          by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.Ioo (a y) s₂
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Set.indicator_of_mem (hmem.mpr hx)]
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx,
              Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h' => hx (hmem.mp h'))]
        rw [e1, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioo]
        by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.Ioo (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂)
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
          have hya := abs_lt.mpr hy
          have hlt : a y < s₂ := by
            rw [hay]; exact max_lt hs (by rw [div_lt_iff₀ hk]; linarith)
          rw [hIoo _ _ _ hlt.le, intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
            (fun x _ => hdg x y) ((hg'x y).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy]
          have hya : k * s₂ ≤ |y| := by
            by_contra hc; push_neg at hc; exact hy (abs_lt.mp hc)
          have hge : s₂ ≤ a y := by
            rw [hay]; exact le_max_of_le_right (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hk]; linarith)
          rw [Set.Ioo_eq_empty (not_lt.mpr hge), Measure.restrict_empty, integral_zero_measure]
      
      have hII : ∀ c d : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable (fun y => g (a y) y) volume c d :=
        fun c d => hga.intervalIntegrable c d
      have hmid : ∫ y in (-(k * s₁))..(k * s₁), g (a y) y =
          ∫ y in (-(k * s₁))..(k * s₁), g s₁ y := by
        refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun y hy => ?_)
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at hy
        have hy' : |y| ≤ k * s₁ := abs_le.mpr hy
        rw [hay, max_eq_left (by rw [div_le_iff₀ hk]; linarith)]
      have hright : ∫ y in (k * s₁)..(k * s₂), g (a y) y = k * ∫ x in s₁..s₂, g x (k * x) := by
        have e1 : ∫ y in (k * s₁)..(k * s₂), g (a y) y =
            ∫ y in (k * s₁)..(k * s₂), g (y / k) y := by
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun y hy => ?_)
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hks.le] at hy
          have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by linarith [hy.1]
          rw [hay, abs_of_nonneg hy0, max_eq_right (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hk]; linarith [hy.1])]
        have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (a := s₁) (b := s₂)
          (fun y => g (y / k) y) hk.ne'
        beta_reduce at e2
        have e3 : ∫ x in s₁..s₂, g (k * x / k) (k * x) = ∫ x in s₁..s₂, g x (k * x) := by
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
          rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ x hk.ne']
        rw [e3, smul_eq_mul] at e2
        rw [e1, e2, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hk.ne', one_mul]
      have hleft : ∫ y in (-(k * s₂))..(-(k * s₁)), g (a y) y =
          k * ∫ x in s₁..s₂, g x (-(k * x)) := by
        have e1 : ∫ y in (-(k * s₂))..(-(k * s₁)), g (a y) y =
            ∫ y in (-(k * s₂))..(-(k * s₁)), g (-y / k) y := by
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun y hy => ?_)
          rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at hy
          have hy0 : y ≤ 0 := by linarith [hy.2]
          rw [hay, abs_of_nonpos hy0, max_eq_right (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hk]; linarith [hy.2])]
        have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (a := s₁) (b := s₂)
          (fun y => g (-y / k) y) (neg_ne_zero.mpr hk.ne')
        beta_reduce at e2
        have e3 : ∫ x in s₁..s₂, g (-(-k * x) / k) (-k * x) =
            ∫ x in s₁..s₂, g x (-(k * x)) := by
          refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
          rw [neg_mul, neg_neg, mul_div_cancel_left₀ x hk.ne']
        rw [e3, neg_mul, neg_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_symm (-(k * s₂)) (-(k * s₁)),
          smul_eq_mul] at e2
        rw [e1, e2, inv_neg, neg_mul_neg, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hk.ne', one_mul]
      have hLow : ∫ y in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂), g (a y) y =
          k * (∫ x in Set.Ioo s₁ s₂, g x (-(k * x))) +
            (∫ y in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₁)) (k * s₁), g s₁ y) +
            k * ∫ x in Set.Ioo s₁ s₂, g x (k * x) := by
        rw [hIoo _ _ _ (by linarith : -(k * s₂) ≤ k * s₂),
          hIoo _ _ _ (by linarith : -(k * s₁) ≤ k * s₁), hIoo _ _ _ hs.le, hIoo _ _ _ hs.le,
          ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hII (-(k * s₂)) (-(k * s₁)))
            (hII (-(k * s₁)) (k * s₂)),
          ← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hII (-(k * s₁)) (k * s₁))
            (hII (k * s₁) (k * s₂)), hmid, hright, hleft]
        ring
      rw [hslice, integral_sub (hint1 _ (hgy s₂) _ _) (hint1 _ hga _ _), hLow,
        integral_add ((hint1 _ hgp _ _).const_mul k) ((hint1 _ hgm _ _).const_mul k),
        integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
      ring
    
    rw [hswap3 _ _ _ (hintP _ hu'c)]
    have hc2 : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => u s₂ q.1 q.2) :=
      huc.comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ((s₂, q.1), q.2))
    have hc1 : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => u s₁ q.1 q.2) :=
      huc.comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ((s₁, q.1), q.2))
    have hcx : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
        k * u q.1 (k * q.1) q.2 + k * u q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) := by
      have h1 : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ((q.1, k * q.1), q.2)) := by fun_prop
      have h2 : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ((q.1, -(k * q.1)), q.2)) := by fun_prop
      exact (continuous_const.mul (huc.comp h1)).add (continuous_const.mul (huc.comp h2))
    obtain ⟨e2, i2⟩ := hswap2 _ _ _ (hintR _ (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂) (-h) h hc2)
    obtain ⟨e1, i1⟩ := hswap2 _ _ _ (hintR _ (-(k * s₁)) (k * s₁) (-h) h hc1)
    obtain ⟨ex, ix⟩ := hswap2 _ _ _ (hintR _ s₁ s₂ (-h) h hcx)
    have i21 : IntegrableOn (fun z =>
        (∫ x in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂), u s₂ (x, z).1 (x, z).2) -
        ∫ x in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₁)) (k * s₁), u s₁ (x, z).1 (x, z).2) (Set.Ioo (-h) h) :=
      i2.sub i1
    rw [e2, e1, ex, ← integral_sub i2 i1, ← integral_sub i21 ix]
    congr 1
    funext z
    exact starX (fun x y => u x y z) (fun x y => u' x y z)
      (huc.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const : Continuous fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (q, z)))
      (hu'c.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const : Continuous fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (q, z)))
      (fun x y => hdu x y z)
  have hL : ∫ z in {z : E3 | s₁ < z 0 ∧ z 0 < s₂ ∧ |z 1| < k * z 0 ∧ |z 2| < h},
      sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X z =
      ∫ p in {q : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < q.1 ∧ q.1 < s₂ ∧ |q.2| < k * q.1} ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h,
        (partialDeriv 0 (fun v => X v 0) (cylPt p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2) +
          partialDeriv 1 (fun v => X v 1) (cylPt p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2) +
          partialDeriv 2 (fun v => X v 2) (cylPt p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2)) := by
    simp_rw [hs1]
    rw [cylPt_setIntegral_eq _ (fun w => partialDeriv 0 (fun v => X v 0) w +
      partialDeriv 1 (fun v => X v 1) w + partialDeriv 2 (fun v => X v 2) w), hpre]
  rw [hL, integral_add (hintP _ ((hu' 0).add (hu' 1))) (hintP _ (hu' 2)),
    integral_add (hintP _ (hu' 0)) (hintP _ (hu' 1))]
  have h0 := prism_dx_flux (fun x y z => X (cylPt x y z) 0)
    (fun x y z => partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w 0) (cylPt x y z)) (hu 0) (hu' 0)
    (hs4 0).1
  have h1 := prism_dy_flux (fun x y z => X (cylPt x y z) 1)
    (fun x y z => partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w 1) (cylPt x y z)) (hu 1) (hu' 1)
    (hs4 1).2.1
  have h2 := prism_dz_flux (fun x y z => X (cylPt x y z) 2)
    (fun x y z => partialDeriv 2 (fun w => X w 2) (cylPt x y z)) (hu' 2)
    (hs4 2).2.2.1
  beta_reduce at h0 h1 h2
  have hcp : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g →
      Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => X (cylPt q.1 (g q.1) q.2) i) := fun i g hg =>
    (hXc i).comp (hcc _ _ _ continuous_fst (hg.comp continuous_fst) continuous_snd)
  have hFx : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      k * X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 0 + k * X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 0) :=
    (continuous_const.mul (hcp 0 _ (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))).add
      (continuous_const.mul (hcp 0 _ (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).neg))
  have hFy : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 1 - X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 1) :=
    (hcp 1 _ (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).sub
      (hcp 1 _ (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).neg)
  have hsplit : ∫ p in Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h, (k * X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 -
      X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 + (k * X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 +
        X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1)) =
      (∫ q in Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h,
        (k * X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 0 + k * X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 0)) -
      ∫ q in Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h,
        (X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 1 - X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 1) := by
    have e : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => k * X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 -
        X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 + (k * X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 +
          X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1)) =
        fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (k * X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 0 +
          k * X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 0) -
          (X (cylPt q.1 (k * q.1) q.2) 1 - X (cylPt q.1 (-(k * q.1)) q.2) 1) := by
      funext q; ring
    rw [e]
    exact integral_sub (hintR _ _ _ _ _ hFx) (hintR _ _ _ _ _ hFy)
  rw [h0, h1, h2, hsplit]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (k a b H : ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hk : 0 < k) (ha : 0 < a) (hO : IsOpen O) (hsub : ∀ z : E3, 0 < z 0 → |z 1| ≤ k * z 0 → z ∈ O) : ∃ k' : ℝ, k < k' ∧ ∀ z : E3, a ≤ z 0 → z 0 ≤ b → |z 1| ≤ k' * z 0 → |z 2| ≤ H → z ∈ O

signature.name: wedge_box_in_open
signature.statement: (k a b H : ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hk : 0 < k) (ha : 0 < a) (hO : IsOpen O) (hsub : ∀ z : E3, 0 < z 0 → |z 1| ≤ k * z 0 → z ∈ O) : ∃ k' : ℝ, k < k' ∧ ∀ z : E3, a ≤ z 0 → z 0 ≤ b → |z 1| ≤ k' * z 0 → |z 2| ≤ H → z ∈ O

proof.tactics:
by
  set K : Set E3 := {z : E3 | a ≤ z 0 ∧ z 0 ≤ b ∧ |z 1| ≤ k * z 0 ∧ |z 2| ≤ H} with hKdef
  have hcont : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z : E3 => z i) :=
    fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i).continuous
  have hKc : IsClosed K :=
    (isClosed_le continuous_const (hcont 0)).inter ((isClosed_le (hcont 0) continuous_const).inter
      ((isClosed_le (hcont 1).abs (continuous_const.mul (hcont 0))).inter
        (isClosed_le (hcont 2).abs continuous_const)))
  have hnormsq : ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hKb : Bornology.IsBounded K := by
    rw [Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : E3)]
    refine ⟨|b| + k * |b| + |H|, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hz
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
    have e0 : |z 0| ≤ |b| := by
      rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]; exact h2.trans (le_abs_self b)
    have e1 : |z 1| ≤ k * |b| :=
      h3.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h2.trans (le_abs_self b)) hk.le)
    have e2 : |z 2| ≤ |H| := h4.trans (le_abs_self H)
    have hn := hnormsq z
    have s0 : z 0 ^ 2 = |z 0| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
    have s1 : z 1 ^ 2 = |z 1| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
    have s2 : z 2 ^ 2 = |z 2| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
    have p0 := abs_nonneg (z 0)
    have p1 := abs_nonneg (z 1)
    have p2 := abs_nonneg (z 2)
    have hN := norm_nonneg z
    have hR0 : 0 ≤ |b| + k * |b| + |H| := by
      have := abs_nonneg b; have := abs_nonneg H; positivity
    have hsum : |z 0| + |z 1| + |z 2| ≤ |b| + k * |b| + |H| := by linarith
    have hsq : ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (|b| + k * |b| + |H|) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hn, s0, s1, s2]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg p0 p1, mul_nonneg p1 p2, mul_nonneg p0 p2,
        mul_self_le_mul_self (by positivity) hsum]
    nlinarith
  have hKcpt : IsCompact K := Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hKc hKb
  have hKO : K ⊆ O := by
    intro z hz
    exact hsub z (by linarith [hz.1]) hz.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδO⟩ := hKcpt.exists_thickening_subset_open hO hKO
  have hb1 : 0 < 2 * (|b| + 1) := by positivity
  set d : ℝ := δ / (2 * (|b| + 1)) with hd
  have hdpos : 0 < d := div_pos hδ hb1
  have hdδ : d * (2 * (|b| + 1)) = δ := by rw [hd]; field_simp
  refine ⟨k + d, by linarith, fun z h0 h0b h1 h2 => ?_⟩
  have hz0 : 0 < z 0 := by linarith
  set c : ℝ := max (-(k * z 0)) (min (z 1) (k * z 0)) with hc
  set t : ℝ := z 1 - c with ht
  have hkz : 0 ≤ k * z 0 := by positivity
  have hcabs : |c| ≤ k * z 0 := by
    rw [abs_le]; constructor
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact max_le (by linarith) (min_le_right _ _)
  have htabs : |t| ≤ d * z 0 := by
    rw [abs_le] at h1 ⊢
    obtain ⟨h1a, h1b⟩ := h1
    rw [ht, hc]
    rcases le_total (z 1) (k * z 0) with h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h]
      rcases le_total (-(k * z 0)) (z 1) with h' | h'
      · rw [max_eq_right h']; constructor <;> nlinarith
      · rw [max_eq_left h']; constructor <;> nlinarith
    · rw [min_eq_right h, max_eq_right (by linarith)]; constructor <;> nlinarith
  set w : E3 := z - EuclideanSpace.single 1 t with hwdef
  have w0 : w 0 = z 0 := by
    simp [hwdef, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have w1 : w 1 = c := by
    simp [hwdef, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, ht]
  have w2 : w 2 = z 2 := by
    simp [hwdef, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hw : w ∈ K := by
    show a ≤ _ ∧ _ ≤ b ∧ |_| ≤ k * _ ∧ |_| ≤ H
    rw [w0, w1, w2]
    exact ⟨h0, h0b, hcabs, h2⟩
  have hdist : dist z w < δ := by
    rw [hwdef, dist_eq_norm, sub_sub_cancel, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hzb : z 0 < 2 * (|b| + 1) := by
      have := le_abs_self b; linarith
    calc |t| ≤ d * z 0 := htabs
      _ < d * (2 * (|b| + 1)) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hzb hdpos
      _ = δ := hdδ
  exact hδO (Metric.mem_thickening_iff.2 ⟨_, hw, hdist⟩)

informal_problem.statement: (k s₁ s₂ h : ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hk : 0 < k) (hs₁ : 0 < s₁) (hs : s₁ < s₂) (hh : 0 < h) (hU : IsOpen U) (hface : ∀ x t : ℝ, s₁ ≤ x → x ≤ s₂ → |t| ≤ h → cylPt x (k * x) t ∈ U ∧ cylPt x (-(k * x)) t ∈ U) : ∃ Y : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ U ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ {z : E3 | 0 < z 0} ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) ∧ 4 * Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) * h * (s₂ - s₁) ≤ ∫ p in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), (k * Y (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - Y (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 + (k * Y (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + Y (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1))

signature.name: wedge_face_lower_field
signature.statement: (k s₁ s₂ h : ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hk : 0 < k) (hs₁ : 0 < s₁) (hs : s₁ < s₂) (hh : 0 < h) (hU : IsOpen U) (hface : ∀ x t : ℝ, s₁ ≤ x → x ≤ s₂ → |t| ≤ h → cylPt x (k * x) t ∈ U ∧ cylPt x (-(k * x)) t ∈ U) : ∃ Y : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ U ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ {z : E3 | 0 < z 0} ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) ∧ 4 * Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) * h * (s₂ - s₁) ≤ ∫ p in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), (k * Y (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - Y (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 + (k * Y (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + Y (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcont : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z : E3 => z i) :=
    fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i).continuous
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by rw [hcdef]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hcsq : c ^ 2 = 1 + k ^ 2 := by rw [hcdef]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hcoord : ∀ x a b : ℝ, (cylPt x a b) 0 = x ∧ (cylPt x a b) 1 = a ∧ (cylPt x a b) 2 = b := by
    intro x a b
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hzero : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3), z ∉ tsupport f → f z = 0 := by
    intro f z hz
    by_contra hne
    exact hz (subset_tsupport _ hne)
  have hzero2 : ∀ (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (z : ℝ × ℝ), z ∉ tsupport f → f z = 0 := by
    intro f z hz
    by_contra hne
    exact hz (subset_tsupport _ hne)
  
  have cutoff : ∀ (K V : Set E3), IsCompact K → IsOpen V → K ⊆ V → ∃ η : E3 → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ η ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ tsupport η ⊆ V ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ η z ∧ η z ≤ 1) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ K, η z = 1 := by
    intro K V hK hV hKV
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδV⟩ := hK.exists_thickening_subset_open hV hKV
    have hT : IsCompact (cthickening (δ / 2) K) := hK.cthickening
    have hTV : cthickening (δ / 2) K ⊆ V :=
      (Metric.cthickening_subset_thickening' hδ (by linarith) K).trans hδV
    have hKT : K ⊆ interior (cthickening (δ / 2) K) :=
      (Metric.self_subset_thickening (by linarith) K).trans
        (interior_maximal (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _) Metric.isOpen_thickening)
    obtain ⟨f, hf1, hf0, hf01⟩ :=
      exists_contMDiffMap_one_nhds_of_subset_interior 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (n := ⊤) hK.isClosed hKT
    refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp f.contMDiff
    · exact HasCompactSupport.intro hT hf0
    · have hsub : tsupport f ⊆ cthickening (δ / 2) K := by
        refine closure_minimal ?_ Metric.isClosed_cthickening
        intro x hx
        by_contra hn
        exact hx (hf0 x hn)
      exact hsub.trans hTV
    · intro z
      exact hf01 z
    · intro z hz
      exact hf1.self_of_nhdsSet z hz
  
  have hcP : ∀ a : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous a →
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 (a p.1) p.2) := by
    intro a ha
    simp only [cylPt]
    fun_prop
  have hcs : ∀ (a : ℝ → ℝ) (η : E3 → ℝ), HasCompactSupport η →
      HasCompactSupport (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => η (cylPt p.1 (a p.1) p.2)) := by
    intro a η hη
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mp hη.isCompact.isBounded
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro
      (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (-C) C ×ˢ Set.Icc (-C) C)) ?_
    intro p hp
    by_contra hne
    have hz := hC _ (subset_tsupport _ hne)
    obtain ⟨a1, _, a3⟩ := hcoord p.1 (a p.1) p.2
    have n0 := PiLp.norm_apply_le (cylPt p.1 (a p.1) p.2) 0
    have n2 := PiLp.norm_apply_le (cylPt p.1 (a p.1) p.2) 2
    rw [a1, Real.norm_eq_abs] at n0
    rw [a3, Real.norm_eq_abs] at n2
    exact hp ⟨abs_le.mp (by linarith), abs_le.mp (by linarith)⟩
  obtain ⟨Rc, hRcdef⟩ : ∃ Rc : Set (ℝ × ℝ), Rc = Set.Icc s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc (-h) h := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hRcc : IsCompact Rc := by rw [hRcdef]; exact isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hcPp := hcP (fun x => k * x) (by fun_prop)
  have hcPm := hcP (fun x => -(k * x)) (by fun_prop)
  obtain ⟨Up, hUpdef⟩ : ∃ Up : Set E3, Up = U ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} ∩ {z | 0 < z 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Um, hUmdef⟩ : ∃ Um : Set E3, Um = U ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} ∩ {z | z 1 < 0} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUpo : IsOpen Up := by
    rw [hUpdef]
    exact (hU.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (hcont 0))).inter
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (hcont 1))
  have hUmo : IsOpen Um := by
    rw [hUmdef]
    exact (hU.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (hcont 0))).inter
      (isOpen_lt (hcont 1) continuous_const)
  have hKp : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) '' Rc ⊆ Up := by
    rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    rw [hRcdef] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, ⟨ht1, ht2⟩⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, _⟩ := hcoord p.1 (k * p.1) p.2
    rw [hUpdef]
    refine ⟨⟨(hface p.1 p.2 hx1 hx2 (abs_le.mpr ⟨ht1, ht2⟩)).1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show 0 < (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0
      rw [a1]; linarith
    · show 0 < (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1
      rw [a2]; exact mul_pos hk (by linarith)
  have hKm : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) '' Rc ⊆ Um := by
    rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    rw [hRcdef] at hp
    obtain ⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, ⟨ht1, ht2⟩⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, _⟩ := hcoord p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2
    rw [hUmdef]
    refine ⟨⟨(hface p.1 p.2 hx1 hx2 (abs_le.mpr ⟨ht1, ht2⟩)).2, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show 0 < (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0
      rw [a1]; linarith
    · show (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1 < 0
      rw [a2]
      have := mul_pos hk (show 0 < p.1 by linarith)
      linarith
  obtain ⟨ηp, hηps, hηpc, hηpV, hηp01, hηp1⟩ :=
    cutoff _ Up (hRcc.image hcPp) hUpo hKp
  obtain ⟨ηm, hηms, hηmc, hηmV, hηm01, hηm1⟩ :=
    cutoff _ Um (hRcc.image hcPm) hUmo hKm
  have F1p : ∀ z, ηp z ≠ 0 → z ∈ U ∧ 0 < z 0 ∧ 0 < z 1 := by
    intro z hz
    have hzU := hηpV (subset_tsupport _ hz)
    rw [hUpdef] at hzU
    exact ⟨hzU.1.1, hzU.1.2, hzU.2⟩
  have F1m : ∀ z, ηm z ≠ 0 → z ∈ U ∧ 0 < z 0 ∧ z 1 < 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have hzU := hηmV (subset_tsupport _ hz)
    rw [hUmdef] at hzU
    exact ⟨hzU.1.1, hzU.1.2, hzU.2⟩
  have F2 : ∀ z, ηp z = 0 ∨ ηm z = 0 := by
    intro z
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have h1 := (F1p z hcon.1).2.2
    have h2 := (F1m z hcon.2).2.2
    linarith
  have F3a : ∀ x t : ℝ, ηm (cylPt x (k * x) t) = 0 := by
    intro x t
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨_, h0, h1⟩ := F1m _ hne
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, _⟩ := hcoord x (k * x) t
    rw [a1] at h0
    rw [a2] at h1
    have := mul_pos hk h0
    linarith
  have F3b : ∀ x t : ℝ, ηp (cylPt x (-(k * x)) t) = 0 := by
    intro x t
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨_, h0, h1⟩ := F1p _ hne
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, _⟩ := hcoord x (-(k * x)) t
    rw [a1] at h0
    rw [a2] at h1
    have := mul_pos hk h0
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ : ∃ Y : E3 → E3, Y = fun z =>
      ((ηp z + ηm z) * (k / c)) • e 0 + ((ηm z - ηp z) / c) • e 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hY0 : ∀ z, Y z 0 = (ηp z + ηm z) * (k / c) := by
    intro z; rw [hY]; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hY1 : ∀ z, Y z 1 = (ηm z - ηp z) / c := by
    intro z; rw [hY]; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hY2 : ∀ z, Y z 2 = 0 := by
    intro z; rw [hY]; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hYz : ∀ z, ηp z = 0 → ηm z = 0 → Y z = 0 := by
    intro z h1 h2
    rw [hY]
    simp [h1, h2]
  have hKc : IsCompact (tsupport ηp ∪ tsupport ηm) := hηpc.isCompact.union hηmc.isCompact
  have hsuppY : Function.support Y ⊆ tsupport ηp ∪ tsupport ηm := by
    intro z hz
    by_contra hn
    rw [Set.mem_union, not_or] at hn
    exact hz (hYz z (hzero _ _ hn.1) (hzero _ _ hn.2))
  have htsY : tsupport Y ⊆ tsupport ηp ∪ tsupport ηm :=
    closure_minimal hsuppY ((isClosed_tsupport _).union (isClosed_tsupport _))
  have htsU : tsupport ηp ∪ tsupport ηm ⊆ U ∩ {z : E3 | 0 < z 0} := by
    rintro z (hz | hz)
    · have := hηpV hz
      rw [hUpdef] at this
      exact this.1
    · have := hηmV hz
      rw [hUmdef] at this
      exact this.1
  refine ⟨Y, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hY]
    fun_prop
  · refine HasCompactSupport.intro hKc ?_
    intro z hz
    by_contra hne
    exact hz (hsuppY hne)
  · exact fun z hz => (htsU (htsY hz)).1
  · exact fun z hz => (htsU (htsY hz)).2
  · intro y
    have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j * Y y i * Y y j =
        Y y 0 ^ 2 + Y y 1 ^ 2 + Y y 2 ^ 2 := by
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply]
      ring
    rw [hsum, hY0, hY1, hY2]
    obtain ⟨a0, a1⟩ := hηp01 y
    obtain ⟨b0, b1⟩ := hηm01 y
    rcases F2 y with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0]
      have e1 : ((0 + ηm y) * (k / c)) ^ 2 + ((ηm y - 0) / c) ^ 2 + (0:ℝ) ^ 2 =
          ηm y ^ 2 * ((1 + k ^ 2) / c ^ 2) := by ring
      rw [e1, ← hcsq, div_self (by positivity), mul_one]
      nlinarith
    · rw [h0]
      have e1 : ((ηp y + 0) * (k / c)) ^ 2 + ((0 - ηp y) / c) ^ 2 + (0:ℝ) ^ 2 =
          ηp y ^ 2 * ((1 + k ^ 2) / c ^ 2) := by ring
      rw [e1, ← hcsq, div_self (by positivity), mul_one]
      nlinarith
  · 
    obtain ⟨G, hGdef⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, G = fun p =>
        c * ηp (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) + c * ηm (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have heq : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ,
        k * Y (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - Y (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 +
          (k * Y (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + Y (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1) = G p := by
      intro p
      rw [hGdef, hY0, hY1, hY0, hY1, F3a, F3b]
      have e1 : ∀ a b : ℝ, k * ((a + 0) * (k / c)) - (0 - a) / c +
          (k * ((0 + b) * (k / c)) + (b - 0) / c) = (a + b) * ((1 + k ^ 2) / c) := by
        intro a b; ring
      rw [e1, ← hcsq]
      field_simp
    have hGcont : Continuous G := by
      rw [hGdef]
      exact (continuous_const.mul (hηps.continuous.comp hcPp)).add
        (continuous_const.mul (hηms.continuous.comp hcPm))
    have hA := hcs (fun x => k * x) ηp hηpc
    have hB := hcs (fun x => -(k * x)) ηm hηmc
    have hGcs : HasCompactSupport G := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (hA.isCompact.union hB.isCompact) ?_
      intro p hp
      rw [Set.mem_union, not_or] at hp
      have h1 := hzero2 _ _ hp.1
      have h2 := hzero2 _ _ hp.2
      simp only at h1 h2
      rw [hGdef]
      simp only
      rw [h1, h2]
      ring
    have hG0 : ∀ p, 0 ≤ G p := by
      intro p
      rw [hGdef]
      have := (hηp01 (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2)).1
      have := (hηm01 (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2)).1
      positivity
    have hGR : ∀ p ∈ Rc, 2 * c ≤ G p := by
      intro p hp
      rw [hGdef]
      simp only
      rw [hηp1 (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩,
        hηm1 (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩]
      linarith
    have hGint : Integrable G := hGcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hGcs
    have hD : MeasurableSet (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) :=
      measurableSet_Ioi.prod MeasurableSet.univ
    have hR : MeasurableSet Rc := by rw [hRcdef]; exact measurableSet_Icc.prod measurableSet_Icc
    have hRD : Rc ⊆ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := by
      intro p hp
      rw [hRcdef] at hp
      exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hs₁ hp.1.1, trivial⟩
    have h1 : ∫ p in Rc, G p ≤ ∫ p in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), G p :=
      setIntegral_mono_set hGint.integrableOn (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hD (fun p _ => hG0 p))
        hRD.eventuallyLE
    have hRfin : volume Rc ≠ ⊤ := hRcc.measure_lt_top.ne
    have h2 : volume.real Rc • (2 * c) ≤ ∫ p in Rc, G p :=
      setIntegral_ge_of_const_le hR hRfin hGR hGint.integrableOn
    have h3 : volume.real Rc = (s₂ - s₁) * (h - -h) := by
      rw [hRcdef, Measure.volume_eq_prod ℝ ℝ, measureReal_prod_prod, Real.volume_real_Icc,
        Real.volume_real_Icc, max_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_left (by linarith)]
    have h4 : 4 * c * h * (s₂ - s₁) = volume.real Rc • (2 * c) := by
      rw [h3, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    have h5 : ∫ p in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), G p =
        ∫ p in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ),
          (k * Y (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - Y (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 +
          (k * Y (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + Y (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1)) := by
      congr 1
      funext p
      exact (heq p).symm
    rw [← hcdef, ← h5, h4]
    exact h2.trans h1

informal_problem.statement: (k s₁ s₂ h a₁ a₂ H : ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (hk : 0 < k) (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (h1 : a₁ ≤ s₁) (hs : s₁ < s₂) (h2 : s₂ ≤ a₂) (hh : 0 < h) (hH : h ≤ H) (hX : Continuous X) (hsupp : ∀ z : E3, X z ≠ 0 → a₁ < z 0 ∧ z 0 < a₂ ∧ |z 2| < H) (hbd : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) : (∫ p in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), (k * X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 + (k * X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1))) + (-(∫ p in Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h, (k * X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 + (k * X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1))) + (∫ p in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h, X (cylPt s₂ p.1 p.2) 0) - (∫ p in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₁)) (k * s₁) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h, X (cylPt s₁ p.1 p.2) 0) + (∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < p.1 ∧ p.1 < s₂ ∧ |p.2| < k * p.1}, (X (cylPt p.1 p.2 h) 2 - X (cylPt p.1 p.2 (-h)) 2))) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) * ((a₂ - a₁) * (2 * H) - (s₂ - s₁) * (2 * h)) + 4 * k * h * (s₁ + s₂) + 4 * k * s₂ * (s₂ - s₁)
