signature.statement: (k s₁ s₂ h a₁ a₂ H : ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (hk : 0 < k) (ha₁ : 0 < a₁) (h1 : a₁ ≤ s₁) (hs : s₁ < s₂) (h2 : s₂ ≤ a₂) (hh : 0 < h) (hH : h ≤ H) (hX : Continuous X) (hsupp : ∀ z : E3, X z ≠ 0 → a₁ < z 0 ∧ z 0 < a₂ ∧ |z 2| < H) (hbd : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) : (∫ p in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), (k * X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 + (k * X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1))) + (-(∫ p in Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h, (k * X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 + (k * X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1))) + (∫ p in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h, X (cylPt s₂ p.1 p.2) 0) - (∫ p in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₁)) (k * s₁) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h, X (cylPt s₁ p.1 p.2) 0) + (∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < p.1 ∧ p.1 < s₂ ∧ |p.2| < k * p.1}, (X (cylPt p.1 p.2 h) 2 - X (cylPt p.1 p.2 (-h)) 2))) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) * ((a₂ - a₁) * (2 * H) - (s₂ - s₁) * (2 * h)) + 4 * k * h * (s₁ + s₂) + 4 * k * s₂ * (s₂ - s₁)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hcyl : ∀ t a b : ℝ, (cylPt t a b) 0 = t ∧ (cylPt t a b) 1 = a ∧ (cylPt t a b) 2 = b := by
    intro t a b
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z : E3 => z i) :=
    fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i).continuous
  
  have hsq : ∀ y, X y 0 ^ 2 + X y 1 ^ 2 + X y 2 ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    have h := hbd y
    have e : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j * X y i * X y j =
        X y 0 ^ 2 + X y 1 ^ 2 + X y 2 ^ 2 := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply_eq,
        Matrix.one_apply_ne (show (0:Fin 3) ≠ 1 by decide),
        Matrix.one_apply_ne (show (0:Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide),
        Matrix.one_apply_ne (show (1:Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide),
        Matrix.one_apply_ne (show (1:Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide),
        Matrix.one_apply_ne (show (2:Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide),
        Matrix.one_apply_ne (show (2:Fin 3) ≠ 1 by decide)]
      ring
    rw [e] at h
    exact h
  have hab0 : ∀ y, |X y 0| ≤ 1 := fun y => by
    have h := hsq y
    exact (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one _).mp (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X y 1), sq_nonneg (X y 2)])
  have hab2 : ∀ y, |X y 2| ≤ 1 := fun y => by
    have h := hsq y
    exact (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one _).mp (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X y 1), sq_nonneg (X y 0)])
  have hk2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + k ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hm : ∀ y, |k * X y 0 - X y 1| ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) := fun y => by
    apply Real.abs_le_sqrt
    have h := hsq y
    have h' : 0 ≤ 1 - X y 0 ^ 2 - X y 1 ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X y 2)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X y 0 + k * X y 1), mul_nonneg hk2 h']
  have hp : ∀ y, |k * X y 0 + X y 1| ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) := fun y => by
    apply Real.abs_le_sqrt
    have h := hsq y
    have h' : 0 ≤ 1 - X y 0 ^ 2 - X y 1 ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X y 2)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X y 0 - k * X y 1), mul_nonneg hk2 h']
  
  have hrect : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, volume (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ Set.Ioo c d : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (b - a) * ENNReal.ofReal (d - c) := by
    intro a b c d
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_prod, Real.volume_Ioo, Real.volume_Ioo]
  have hrect_lt : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, volume (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ Set.Ioo c d : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) < ⊤ := by
    intro a b c d
    rw [hrect]
    exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hrectReal : ∀ a b c d : ℝ, a ≤ b → c ≤ d →
      volume.real (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ Set.Ioo c d : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) = (b - a) * (d - c) := by
    intro a b c d hab hcd
    rw [measureReal_def, hrect, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by linarith),
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by linarith)]
  
  have hrectInt : ∀ (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (A B : ℝ), 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ B → (∀ p, |G p| ≤ 1) →
      |∫ p in Set.Ioo (-A) A ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-B) B, G p| ≤ (2 * A) * (2 * B) := by
    intro G A B hA hB hG
    have h : ‖∫ p in Set.Ioo (-A) A ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-B) B, G p‖ ≤
        1 * volume.real (Set.Ioo (-A) A ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-B) B : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
      norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const (hrect_lt (-A) A (-B) B)
        (fun p _ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hG p)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hrectReal _ _ _ _ (by linarith) (by linarith)] at h
    calc _ ≤ _ := h
      _ = (2 * A) * (2 * B) := by ring
  
  have htrap : ∀ (G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), (∀ p, |G p| ≤ 2) →
      ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < p.1 ∧ p.1 < s₂ ∧ |p.2| < k * p.1}, G p ≤ 4 * k * s₂ * (s₂ - s₁) := by
    intro G hG
    have hs₁ : 0 < s₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le ha₁ h1
    have hsub : {p : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < p.1 ∧ p.1 < s₂ ∧ |p.2| < k * p.1} ⊆
        Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂) := by
      rintro p ⟨hp1, hp2, hp3⟩
      have hk' : k * p.1 < k * s₂ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hp2 hk
      have := abs_lt.mp (lt_trans hp3 hk')
      exact ⟨⟨hp1, hp2⟩, this.1, this.2⟩
    have hTlt := lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono hsub) (hrect_lt s₁ s₂ (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂))
    have h : ‖∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < p.1 ∧ p.1 < s₂ ∧ |p.2| < k * p.1}, G p‖ ≤
        2 * volume.real {p : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < p.1 ∧ p.1 < s₂ ∧ |p.2| < k * p.1} :=
      norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const hTlt
        (fun p _ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hG p)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    have hmono := measureReal_mono hsub (hrect_lt s₁ s₂ (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂)).ne
    have hks : 0 < k * s₂ := mul_pos hk (by linarith)
    rw [hrectReal _ _ _ _ hs.le (by linarith)] at hmono
    have := le_abs_self (∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ | s₁ < p.1 ∧ p.1 < s₂ ∧ |p.2| < k * p.1}, G p)
    have e : 2 * ((s₂ - s₁) * (k * s₂ - -(k * s₂))) = 4 * k * s₂ * (s₂ - s₁) := by ring
    linarith
  
  have hface : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), Continuous F → (∀ p, |F p| ≤ C) →
      (∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, F p ≠ 0 → a₁ < p.1 ∧ p.1 < a₂ ∧ |p.2| < H) →
      (∫ p in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), F p) -
        (∫ p in Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h, F p) ≤
        C * ((a₂ - a₁) * (2 * H) - (s₂ - s₁) * (2 * h)) := by
    intro F C hF hFb hFs
    have hoff : ∀ p, p ∉ Set.Ioo a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-H) H → F p = 0 := by
      intro p hp
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨q1, q2, q3⟩ := hFs p hne
      exact hp ⟨⟨q1, q2⟩, (abs_lt.mp q3).1, (abs_lt.mp q3).2⟩
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport F := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc :
        IsCompact (Set.Icc a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc (-H) H)) ?_
      intro p hp
      apply hoff
      rintro ⟨⟨q1, q2⟩, q3, q4⟩
      exact hp ⟨⟨q1.le, q2.le⟩, q3.le, q4.le⟩
    have hint : Integrable F := hF.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs
    have hQR : Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h ⊆ Set.Ioo a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-H) H := by
      rintro p ⟨⟨q1, q2⟩, q3, q4⟩
      exact ⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hRD : Set.Ioo a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-H) H ⊆ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := by
      rintro p ⟨⟨q1, q2⟩, q3, q4⟩
      exact ⟨show (0:ℝ) < p.1 by linarith, Set.mem_univ _⟩
    have hDmeas : MeasurableSet (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) :=
      measurableSet_Ioi.prod MeasurableSet.univ
    have hQmeas : MeasurableSet (Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h) :=
      measurableSet_Ioo.prod measurableSet_Ioo
    have e1 : (∫ p in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), F p) =
        ∫ p in Set.Ioo a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-H) H, F p :=
      setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hDmeas hRD (fun p hp => hoff p hp.2)
    have e2 := integral_diff hQmeas hint.integrableOn hQR
    have hdlt : volume ((Set.Ioo a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-H) H) \ (Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h)) < ⊤ :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono Set.diff_subset) (hrect_lt _ _ _ _)
    have hb : ‖∫ p in (Set.Ioo a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-H) H) \ (Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h), F p‖ ≤
        C * volume.real ((Set.Ioo a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-H) H) \ (Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h)) :=
      norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const hdlt
        (fun p _ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hFb p)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hb
    have hvol := measureReal_diff (μ := (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ))) hQR
      hQmeas (hrect_lt a₁ a₂ (-H) H).ne
    rw [hrectReal a₁ a₂ (-H) H (by linarith) (by linarith),
      hrectReal s₁ s₂ (-h) h (by linarith) (by linarith)] at hvol
    rw [hvol] at hb
    have := le_abs_self
      (∫ p in (Set.Ioo a₁ a₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-H) H) \ (Set.Ioo s₁ s₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h), F p)
    rw [e1, ← e2]
    calc _ ≤ _ := this
      _ ≤ _ := hb
      _ = C * ((a₂ - a₁) * (2 * H) - (s₂ - s₁) * (2 * h)) := by ring
  
  have hPcont : ∀ σ : ℝ, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 (σ * (k * p.1)) p.2) := by
    intro σ
    unfold cylPt
    fun_prop
  have hFcont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      k * X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 +
        (k * X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1)) := by
    have c1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2)) := by
      have := hX.comp (hPcont 1)
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
    have c2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2)) := by
      have := hX.comp (hPcont (-1))
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
    have d10 := (hcoord 0).comp c1
    have d11 := (hcoord 1).comp c1
    have d20 := (hcoord 0).comp c2
    have d21 := (hcoord 1).comp c2
    exact ((continuous_const.mul d10).sub d11).add ((continuous_const.mul d20).add d21)
  have hFbd : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, |k * X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 +
        (k * X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1)| ≤
        2 * Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2) := by
    intro p
    have := abs_add_le (k * X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1)
      (k * X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1)
    linarith [hm (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2), hp (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2)]
  have hFsupp : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, k * X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 0 - X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) 1 +
        (k * X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 0 + X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) 1) ≠ 0 →
        a₁ < p.1 ∧ p.1 < a₂ ∧ |p.2| < H := by
    intro p hne
    by_cases hA : X (cylPt p.1 (k * p.1) p.2) = 0
    · by_cases hB : X (cylPt p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2) = 0
      · exfalso; apply hne; rw [hA, hB]; simp
      · obtain ⟨q1, q2, q3⟩ := hsupp _ hB
        obtain ⟨r0, _, r2⟩ := hcyl p.1 (-(k * p.1)) p.2
        rw [r0] at q1 q2; rw [r2] at q3
        exact ⟨q1, q2, q3⟩
    · obtain ⟨q1, q2, q3⟩ := hsupp _ hA
      obtain ⟨r0, _, r2⟩ := hcyl p.1 (k * p.1) p.2
      rw [r0] at q1 q2; rw [r2] at q3
      exact ⟨q1, q2, q3⟩
  
  have S7 := hface _ (2 * Real.sqrt (1 + k ^ 2)) hFcont hFbd hFsupp
  
  have hs₁ : 0 < s₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le ha₁ h1
  have S8a := hrectInt (fun p => X (cylPt s₂ p.1 p.2) 0) (k * s₂) h
    (mul_pos hk (by linarith)).le hh.le (fun p => hab0 _)
  have S8b := hrectInt (fun p => X (cylPt s₁ p.1 p.2) 0) (k * s₁) h
    (mul_pos hk hs₁).le hh.le (fun p => hab0 _)
  have S8a' := le_abs_self (∫ p in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₂)) (k * s₂) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h,
    X (cylPt s₂ p.1 p.2) 0)
  have S8b' := neg_abs_le (∫ p in Set.Ioo (-(k * s₁)) (k * s₁) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-h) h,
    X (cylPt s₁ p.1 p.2) 0)
  
  have S9 := htrap (fun p => X (cylPt p.1 p.2 h) 2 - X (cylPt p.1 p.2 (-h)) 2) (fun p => by
    have := abs_sub (X (cylPt p.1 p.2 h) 2) (X (cylPt p.1 p.2 (-h)) 2)
    linarith [hab2 (cylPt p.1 p.2 h), hab2 (cylPt p.1 p.2 (-h))])
  
  have hid : (2 * (k * s₂)) * (2 * h) + (2 * (k * s₁)) * (2 * h) = 4 * k * h * (s₁ + s₂) := by ring
  simp only at S8a S8b S9
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (X : E3 → E3) (V : Set E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hc : HasCompactSupport X) (hV : tsupport X ⊆ V) : Integrable (sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X) ∧ ∀ A B : Set E3, MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → volume ((A ∩ V) \ B) = 0 → volume ((B ∩ V) \ A) = 0 → ∫ z in A, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X z = ∫ z in B, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X z

signature.name: sepDensDiv_one_local
signature.statement: (X : E3 → E3) (V : Set E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hc : HasCompactSupport X) (hV : tsupport X ⊆ V) : Integrable (sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X) ∧ ∀ A B : Set E3, MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → volume ((A ∩ V) \ B) = 0 → volume ((B ∩ V) \ A) = 0 → ∫ z in A, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X z = ∫ z in B, sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X z

proof.tactics:
by
  set f := sepDensDiv (fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) X with hf
  have hfeq : ∀ y, f y = ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => X z i) y := by
    intro y
    simp only [hf, sepDensDiv, Matrix.det_one, Real.sqrt_one, one_mul]
  have hgi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => X z i) := fun i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i).contDiff.comp hX
  have hcont : Continuous f := by
    have hfun : f = fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun z => X z i) y (e i) := funext hfeq
    rw [hfun]
    refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    exact ((hgi i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hvan : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → f y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hfeq]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
    have h1 : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy
    have h2 : (fun z => X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
      h1.mono (fun z hz => by simp [hz])
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h2.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have hint : Integrable f :=
    hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.intro' hc.isCompact (isClosed_tsupport X) hvan)
  refine ⟨hint, fun A B hA hB hAB hBA => ?_⟩
  have hloc : ∀ S : Set E3, MeasurableSet S →
      ∫ z in S, f z = ∫ z in S ∩ tsupport X, f z := by
    intro S hS
    refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hS Set.inter_subset_left ?_
    intro x hx
    exact hvan x (fun hxT => hx.2 ⟨hx.1, hxT⟩)
  have hae : (A ∩ tsupport X : Set E3) =ᵐ[volume] (B ∩ tsupport X : Set E3) := by
    rw [ae_eq_set]
    constructor
    · refine measure_mono_null ?_ hAB
      rintro x ⟨⟨hxA, hxT⟩, hxn⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hxA, hV hxT⟩, fun hxB => hxn ⟨hxB, hxT⟩⟩
    · refine measure_mono_null ?_ hBA
      rintro x ⟨⟨hxB, hxT⟩, hxn⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hxB, hV hxT⟩, fun hxA => hxn ⟨hxA, hxT⟩⟩
  rw [hloc A hA, hloc B hB]
  exact setIntegral_congr_set hae

informal_problem.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (q : M) (C : Set E3) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCt : C ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) : ∃ η Γ m : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 0 < Γ ∧ 0 < m ∧ Metric.cthickening η C ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.cthickening η C, ∀ b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y b b ≤ Γ) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.cthickening η C, m ≤ Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)

signature.name: chart_metric_constants
signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (q : M) (C : Set E3) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCt : C ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) : ∃ η Γ m : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 0 < Γ ∧ 0 < m ∧ Metric.cthickening η C ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.cthickening η C, ∀ b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y b b ≤ Γ) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.cthickening η C, m ≤ Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hKt⟩ :=
    hC.exists_cthickening_subset_open (chartAt E3 q).open_target hCt
  have hK : IsCompact (Metric.cthickening η C) := hC.cthickening
  have hent : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j)
      (Metric.cthickening η C) := fun i j => ((g.smooth q i j).continuousOn).mono hKt
  have hG : ContinuousOn (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Metric.cthickening η C) :=
    continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j => hent i j
  have hdet : ContinuousOn (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
      (Metric.cthickening η C) :=
    (continuous_id.matrix_det (n := Fin 3) (R := ℝ)).comp_continuousOn hG
  have hsq : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
      (Metric.cthickening η C) := hdet.sqrt
  have hB : ∀ b : Fin 3, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.cthickening η C,
      ‖g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y b b‖ ≤ B := fun b => hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hent b b)
  choose B hB using hB
  have hdiag : ∀ y ∈ Metric.cthickening η C, ∀ b : Fin 3,
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y b b ≤ 1 + ∑ c : Fin 3, |B c| := by
    intro y hy b
    have h1 : g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y b b ≤ ‖g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y b b‖ := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact le_abs_self _
    have h2 : B b ≤ |B b| := le_abs_self _
    have h3 : |B b| ≤ ∑ c : Fin 3, |B c| :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun c => |B c|) (fun c _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ b)
    linarith [hB b y hy]
  have hΓ : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + ∑ c : Fin 3, |B c| := by
    have : 0 ≤ ∑ c : Fin 3, |B c| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun c _ => abs_nonneg _)
    linarith
  rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (Metric.cthickening η C) with hE | hne
  · refine ⟨η, 1 + ∑ c : Fin 3, |B c|, 1, hη, hΓ, one_pos, hKt, hdiag, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    rw [hE] at hy
    exact absurd hy (Set.notMem_empty y)
  · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hmin⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn hne hsq
    have hpd : (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y₀).PosDef := by
      classical
      have hy : y₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := hKt hy₀
      have hq : (chartAt E3 q).symm y₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
      have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y₀ :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
      have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y₀) :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hq
      have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y₀ =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y₀)).comp
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y₀) := mfderiv_comp y₀ hg hf
      have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y₀ =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y₀ := by
        apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
        exact hz
      rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
      have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y₀)
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y₀ w) = w := by
        intro w
        have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
        simpa using h1
      have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y₀ w = 0 → w = 0 := by
        intro w hw
        rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
      apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
      · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
        intro i j
        simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
        exact g.symm _ _ _
      · intro x hx
        have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          apply hx
          funext j
          have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
          fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
        have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
        have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 q).symm y₀) _ hDv
        have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y₀).mulVec x =
            g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y₀)
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y₀ (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y₀ (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
          simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
            ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
            RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
          ring
        rw [key]
        exact hpos
    have hm : 0 < Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y₀).det :=
      Real.sqrt_pos.2 hpd.det_pos
    refine ⟨η, 1 + ∑ c : Fin 3, |B c|, _, hη, hΓ, hm, hKt, hdiag, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    exact hmin hy

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig : Set M) (hS : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) (q : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q) '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hyO : y ∈ O) (hOt : O ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) : ∃ (a : Fin 3) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧ Continuous v ∧ v (smthHoriz a y) = y a ∧ (∀ x ∈ smthDisc a y r, ∀ w ∈ smthDisc a y r, |v x - v w| ≤ 4 * ‖x - w‖) ∧ (∀ x ∈ smthDisc a y r, |v x - y a| < δ) ∧ {z : E3 | smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a y r ∧ |z a - y a| < δ} ⊆ O ∧ ∀ z : E3, smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a y r → |z a - y a| < δ → (z ∈ (chartAt E3 q) '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ↔ z a = v (smthHoriz a z))

signature.name: chart_graph_patch
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig : Set M) (hS : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) (q : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q) '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hyO : y ∈ O) (hOt : O ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) : ∃ (a : Fin 3) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧ Continuous v ∧ v (smthHoriz a y) = y a ∧ (∀ x ∈ smthDisc a y r, ∀ w ∈ smthDisc a y r, |v x - v w| ≤ 4 * ‖x - w‖) ∧ (∀ x ∈ smthDisc a y r, |v x - y a| < δ) ∧ {z : E3 | smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a y r ∧ |z a - y a| < δ} ⊆ O ∧ ∀ z : E3, smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a y r → |z a - y a| < δ → (z ∈ (chartAt E3 q) '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ↔ z a = v (smthHoriz a z))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨hpS, hps⟩, hpy⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨V, f, -, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hVS, -⟩ := hS.2 p hpS Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
  
  have hFt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hf.comp_contMDiffOn (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := q)))
  have hFd0 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hdf p hpV
    have hyt : chartAt E3 q p ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).map_source hps
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q p) :=
      ((hFt.contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 q).open_target.mem_nhds hyt)).differentiableAt (by simp))
    have hFm : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
        (chartAt E3 q p) := hFd.mdifferentiableAt
    have hκ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) p :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hps
    have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ∘ (chartAt E3 q) := by
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).open_source.mem_nhds hps] with x hx
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hx]
    rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp p hFm hκ, mfderiv_eq_fderiv, h0]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : Set E3,
      W = O ∩ ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' V) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : E3 → ℝ, F = fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW : IsOpen W := by
    rw [hWdef]; exact hO.inter ((chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hVo)
  have hyW : y ∈ W := by
    rw [hWdef]
    refine ⟨hyO, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hpy]; exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source hps
    · show (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ V
      rw [← hpy, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hps]; exact hpV
  have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W := by
    rw [hFdef]; exact hFt.mono (by rw [hWdef]; exact fun z hz => hz.2.1)
  have hF0 : F y = 0 := by
    rw [hFdef, ← hpy]
    show f ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q p)) = 0
    rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hps]
    have : p ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := by rw [← hVS]; exact ⟨hpV, hpS⟩
    exact this.2
  have hd : fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0 := by rw [hFdef, ← hpy]; exact hFd0
  have hWO : W ⊆ O := by rw [hWdef]; exact Set.inter_subset_left
  have hWiff : ∀ z ∈ W, (z ∈ (chartAt E3 q) '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ↔ F z = 0) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hWdef] at hz
    obtain ⟨-, hzt, hzV⟩ := hz
    rw [hFdef]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxS, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
      have hxV : x ∈ V := by
        have h1 : (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q x) ∈ V := hzV
        rwa [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxs] at h1
      have : x ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := by rw [← hVS]; exact ⟨hxV, hxS⟩
      show f ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q x)) = 0
      rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxs]; exact this.2
    · intro h0
      have : (chartAt E3 q).symm z ∈ V ∩ Sig := by rw [hVS]; exact ⟨hzV, h0⟩
      exact ⟨_, ⟨this.2, (chartAt E3 q).map_target hzt⟩, (chartAt E3 q).right_inv hzt⟩
  suffices key : ∃ (a : Fin 3) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ 0 < δ ∧ Continuous v ∧
      v (smthHoriz a y) = y a ∧
      (∀ x ∈ smthDisc a y r, ∀ w ∈ smthDisc a y r, |v x - v w| ≤ 4 * ‖x - w‖) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ smthDisc a y r, |v x - y a| < δ) ∧
      {z : E3 | smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a y r ∧ |z a - y a| < δ} ⊆ W ∧
      ∀ z : E3, smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a y r → |z a - y a| < δ →
        (F z = 0 ↔ z a = v (smthHoriz a z)) by
    obtain ⟨a, v, r, δ, hr, hδ, hv, hv0, hlip, hvb, hcyl, hiff⟩ := key
    refine ⟨a, v, r, δ, hr, hδ, hv, hv0, hlip, hvb, hcyl.trans hWO, ?_⟩
    intro z hz1 hz2
    rw [hWiff z (hcyl ⟨hz1, hz2⟩)]
    exact hiff z hz1 hz2
  clear hWiff hWO hFdef hWdef hFt hFd0
  
  have liftH : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthHoriz a (smthLift a x t) = x := by
    intro a x t
    funext k
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove (α := fun _ => ℝ) a t x k
  have liftS : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (k : Fin 2),
      (smthLift a x t) (a.succAbove k) = x k := fun a x t k => congrFun (liftH a x t) k
  have liftA : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift a x t) a = t := by
    intro a x t
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_same (α := fun _ => ℝ) a t x
  have liftSelf : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (z : E3), smthLift a (smthHoriz a z) (z a) = z := by
    intro a z
    ext i
    exact congrFun (Fin.insertNth_self_removeNth (α := fun _ => ℝ) a (fun j => z j)) i
  have liftC : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ), Continuous (fun t => smthLift a x t) := by
    intro a x
    unfold smthLift
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
      (Continuous.finInsertNth a continuous_id continuous_const)
  have liftC2 : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (t : ℝ), Continuous (fun x => smthLift a x t) := by
    intro a t
    unfold smthLift
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
      (Continuous.finInsertNth a continuous_const continuous_id)
  
  have hexp : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (u : E3), L u = ∑ b : Fin 3, u b * L (e b) := by
    intro L u
    have hu : u = ∑ b : Fin 3, u b • e b := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hu]
    simp [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hb0 : ∃ b, partialDeriv b F y ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    apply hd
    ext u
    rw [hexp]
    simp only [partialDeriv] at h
    simp [h]
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := hb0
  obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ
    (fun b => |partialDeriv b F y|) Finset.univ_nonempty
  have ha' : ∀ b, |partialDeriv b F y| ≤ |partialDeriv a F y| :=
    fun b => ha b (Finset.mem_univ _)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, m = |partialDeriv a F y| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmpos : 0 < m := by
    rw [hm]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le (abs_pos.mpr hb₀) (ha' b₀)
  obtain ⟨s, hs1, hsm⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) ∧ s * partialDeriv a F y = m := by
    by_cases h : 0 < partialDeriv a F y
    · exact ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, by rw [hm, abs_of_pos h, one_mul]⟩
    · push_neg at h
      exact ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, by rw [hm, abs_of_nonpos h]; ring⟩
  have hsabs : |s| = 1 := by rcases hs1 with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by rcases hs1 with h | h <;> simp [h]
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : E3 → ℝ, G = fun w => s * F w := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hdiffW : ∀ z ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ F z := fun z hz =>
    (hF.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hz)
  have hpG : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ b, partialDeriv b G z = s * partialDeriv b F z := by
    intro z hz b
    simp only [partialDeriv, hG]
    rw [fderiv_const_mul (hdiffW z hz)]
    simp
  
  have hcontd : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ F) W := hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
  have hpc : ∀ b, ContinuousAt (fun z => partialDeriv b F z) y := by
    intro b
    exact (hcontd.clm_apply continuousOn_const).continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hyW)
  have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, z ∈ W ∧ ∀ b, |partialDeriv b F z - partialDeriv b F y| < m / 4 := by
    refine Filter.Eventually.and (hW.mem_nhds hyW) ?_
    rw [Filter.eventually_all]
    intro b
    exact (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (hpc b) (m / 4) (by positivity)).mono
      fun z hz => by rwa [Real.dist_eq] at hz
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hev
  have hBW : ∀ z ∈ ball y ε, z ∈ W := fun z hz => (hball hz).1
  have hpos : ∀ z ∈ ball y ε, 3 * m / 4 < partialDeriv a G z := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 := (hball hz).2 a
    rw [hpG z (hBW z hz)]
    have h2 : |s * (partialDeriv a F z - partialDeriv a F y)| < m / 4 := by
      rw [abs_mul, hsabs, one_mul]; exact h1
    have e1 : s * partialDeriv a F z = m + s * (partialDeriv a F z - partialDeriv a F y) := by
      rw [← hsm]; ring
    rw [e1]
    linarith [(abs_lt.mp h2).1]
  have hApos : ∀ z ∈ ball y ε, 0 < partialDeriv a G z := fun z hz => by
    linarith [hpos z hz]
  have hside : ∀ z ∈ ball y ε, ∀ k : Fin 2,
      |partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) G z| ≤ 2 * partialDeriv a G z := by
    intro z hz k
    have h1 := (hball hz).2 (a.succAbove k)
    have h2 := ha' (a.succAbove k)
    have h3 := hpos z hz
    rw [hpG z (hBW z hz) (a.succAbove k), abs_mul, hsabs, one_mul]
    have h4 := abs_add_le (partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) F y)
      (partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) F z - partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) F y)
    rw [add_sub_cancel] at h4
    rw [← hm] at h2
    linarith
  
  have hdiffG : ∀ z ∈ ball y ε, DifferentiableAt ℝ G z := fun z hz => by
    rw [hG]; exact (hdiffW z (hBW z hz)).const_mul s
  have hGcB : ∀ z ∈ ball y ε, ContinuousAt G z := fun z hz => (hdiffG z hz).continuousAt
  have hmvt : ∀ P ∈ ball y ε, ∀ Q ∈ ball y ε, ∃ ξ ∈ ball y ε,
      G Q - G P = partialDeriv a G ξ * (Q a - P a) +
        ∑ k : Fin 2, partialDeriv (a.succAbove k) G ξ * (Q (a.succAbove k) - P (a.succAbove k)) := by
    intro P hP Q hQ
    have hseg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, P + t • (Q - P) ∈ ball y ε :=
      fun t ht => (convex_ball y ε).add_smul_sub_mem hP hQ ht
    have hγc : Continuous fun t : ℝ => P + t • (Q - P) := by fun_prop
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => G (P + t • (Q - P))) (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
      intro t ht
      exact (ContinuousAt.comp (f := fun t : ℝ => P + t • (Q - P)) (hGcB _ (hseg t ht))
        hγc.continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
    have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => G (P + t • (Q - P)))
        (fderiv ℝ G (P + t • (Q - P)) (Q - P)) t := by
      intro t ht
      have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => P + t • (Q - P)) (Q - P) t := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (Q - P)).const_add P
      exact (hdiffG _ (hseg t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hγ
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hceq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope _ _ zero_lt_one hcont hderiv
    refine ⟨P + c • (Q - P), hseg c (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hc), ?_⟩
    simp only [one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero, sub_zero, div_one, add_sub_cancel] at hceq
    rw [← hceq, hexp, Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a]
    simp only [partialDeriv, PiLp.sub_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have hdist : ∀ z : E3, dist z y ^ 2 = (z a - y a) ^ 2 +
      ∑ k : Fin 2, (z (a.succAbove k) - y (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _),
      Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a]
    simp [Real.dist_eq, sq_abs]
  have hgeo : ∀ z : E3, ∑ k : Fin 2, (z (a.succAbove k) - y (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 < (ε / 4) ^ 2 →
      |z a - y a| ≤ ε / 2 → z ∈ ball y ε := by
    intro z h1 h2
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    have h3 := hdist z
    have h4 : (z a - y a) ^ 2 ≤ (ε / 2) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h2 2
    have h5 : dist z y ^ 2 < ε ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := z) (y := y)]
  have hgeoL : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - y (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 < (ε / 4) ^ 2 → |t - y a| ≤ ε / 2 →
      smthLift a x t ∈ ball y ε := by
    intro x t hx ht
    refine hgeo _ ?_ ?_
    · simp only [liftS]; exact hx
    · rw [liftA]; exact ht
  
  have hmono : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - y (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 < (ε / 4) ^ 2 →
      ∀ t t', |t - y a| ≤ ε / 2 → |t' - y a| ≤ ε / 2 → t < t' →
      G (smthLift a x t) < G (smthLift a x t') := by
    intro x hx t t' ht ht' htt'
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, heq⟩ := hmvt _ (hgeoL x t hx ht) _ (hgeoL x t' hx ht')
    simp only [liftA, liftS, sub_self, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero] at heq
    have := mul_pos (hApos ξ hξ) (sub_pos.mpr htt')
    linarith
  have huniq : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - y (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 < (ε / 4) ^ 2 →
      ∀ t t', |t - y a| ≤ ε / 2 → |t' - y a| ≤ ε / 2 →
      G (smthLift a x t) = 0 → G (smthLift a x t') = 0 → t = t' := by
    intro x hx t t' ht ht' h0 h0'
    rcases lt_trichotomy t t' with h | h | h
    · have := hmono x hx t t' ht ht' h; linarith
    · exact h
    · have := hmono x hx t' t ht' ht h; linarith
  
  have hc0 : ∑ k : Fin 2, (smthHoriz a y k - y (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 < (ε / 4) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [smthHoriz, sub_self]
    simpa using pow_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < ε / 4) 2
  have hGy : G (smthLift a (smthHoriz a y) (y a)) = 0 := by
    rw [liftSelf, hG]; simp [hF0]
  have hhalf : |ε / 2| ≤ ε / 2 := by rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
  have hplus : 0 < G (smthLift a (smthHoriz a y) (y a + ε / 2)) := by
    have := hmono _ hc0 (y a) (y a + ε / 2) (by simp; positivity) (by simpa using hhalf)
      (by linarith)
    rwa [hGy] at this
  have hminus : G (smthLift a (smthHoriz a y) (y a - ε / 2)) < 0 := by
    have := hmono _ hc0 (y a - ε / 2) (y a) (by simpa [abs_sub_comm] using hhalf)
      (by simp; positivity) (by linarith)
    rwa [hGy] at this
  have hcp : ContinuousAt (fun x => G (smthLift a x (y a + ε / 2))) (smthHoriz a y) :=
    ContinuousAt.comp (f := fun x => smthLift a x (y a + ε / 2))
      (hGcB _ (hgeoL _ _ hc0 (by simpa using hhalf))) (liftC2 a _).continuousAt
  have hcm : ContinuousAt (fun x => G (smthLift a x (y a - ε / 2))) (smthHoriz a y) :=
    ContinuousAt.comp (f := fun x => smthLift a x (y a - ε / 2))
      (hGcB _ (hgeoL _ _ hc0 (by simpa [abs_sub_comm] using hhalf))) (liftC2 a _).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hr₀b⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp
    ((Filter.Tendsto.eventually hcp (lt_mem_nhds hplus)).and
      (Filter.Tendsto.eventually hcm (gt_mem_nhds hminus)))
  obtain ⟨r, hrdef⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = min r₀ (ε / 4) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hr : 0 < r := by rw [hrdef]; exact lt_min hr₀ (by positivity)
  have hrr₀ : r ≤ r₀ := by rw [hrdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hre : r ≤ ε / 4 := by rw [hrdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hdiscP : ∀ x ∈ smthDisc a y r, dist x (smthHoriz a y) < r₀ ∧
      ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - y (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 < (ε / 4) ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - y (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := hx
    constructor
    · rw [dist_pi_lt_iff hr₀]
      intro k
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have hk : (x k - y (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => (x k - y (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2)
          (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ k)) hx'
      have := abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq hk hr.le
      simp only [smthHoriz]
      linarith
    · have := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr.le hre 2
      linarith
  
  have hex : ∀ x ∈ smthDisc a y r, ∃ t, |t - y a| < ε / 2 ∧ G (smthLift a x t) = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxd, hxs⟩ := hdiscP x hx
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hr₀b hxd
    have hcontI : ContinuousOn (fun t => G (smthLift a x t))
        (Set.Icc (y a - ε / 2) (y a + ε / 2)) := by
      intro t ht
      have ht' : |t - y a| ≤ ε / 2 := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
      exact (ContinuousAt.comp (f := fun t => smthLift a x t) (hGcB _ (hgeoL x t hxs ht'))
        (liftC a x).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
    obtain ⟨t, ht, ht0⟩ := intermediate_value_Ioo (by linarith : y a - ε / 2 ≤ y a + ε / 2)
      hcontI ⟨h2, h1⟩
    exact ⟨t, abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩, ht0⟩
  choose v₀ hv₀ hv₀0 using hex
  obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁⟩ : ∃ v₁ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ∀ x (h : x ∈ smthDisc a y r), v₁ x = v₀ x h :=
    ⟨fun x => if h : x ∈ smthDisc a y r then v₀ x h else y a, fun x h => dif_pos h⟩
  
  have hlip : ∀ x ∈ smthDisc a y r, ∀ w ∈ smthDisc a y r, |v₁ x - v₁ w| ≤ 4 * ‖x - w‖ := by
    intro x hx w hw
    rw [hv₁ x hx, hv₁ w hw]
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, heq⟩ := hmvt _ (hgeoL x _ (hdiscP x hx).2 (hv₀ x hx).le)
      _ (hgeoL w _ (hdiscP w hw).2 (hv₀ w hw).le)
    simp only [liftA, liftS, hv₀0, sub_self, Fin.sum_univ_two] at heq
    have hA := hApos ξ hξ
    have hs0' := hside ξ hξ 0
    have hs1' := hside ξ hξ 1
    have hd0 : |w 0 - x 0| ≤ ‖x - w‖ := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (x - w) 0
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.sub_apply, abs_sub_comm] at this
    have hd1 : |w 1 - x 1| ≤ ‖x - w‖ := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (x - w) 1
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.sub_apply, abs_sub_comm] at this
    have e1 : partialDeriv a G ξ * |v₀ x hx - v₀ w hw| =
        |partialDeriv (a.succAbove 0) G ξ * (w 0 - x 0) +
          partialDeriv (a.succAbove 1) G ξ * (w 1 - x 1)| := by
      rw [← abs_of_pos hA, ← abs_mul]
      congr 1
      linear_combination heq
    have key : partialDeriv a G ξ * |v₀ x hx - v₀ w hw| ≤ partialDeriv a G ξ * (4 * ‖x - w‖) := by
      rw [e1]
      calc _ ≤ |partialDeriv (a.succAbove 0) G ξ * (w 0 - x 0)| +
            |partialDeriv (a.succAbove 1) G ξ * (w 1 - x 1)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |partialDeriv (a.succAbove 0) G ξ| * |w 0 - x 0| +
            |partialDeriv (a.succAbove 1) G ξ| * |w 1 - x 1| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ (2 * partialDeriv a G ξ) * ‖x - w‖ + (2 * partialDeriv a G ξ) * ‖x - w‖ :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul hs0' hd0 (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith))
              (mul_le_mul hs1' hd1 (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith))
        _ = partialDeriv a G ξ * (4 * ‖x - w‖) := by ring
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left key hA
  
  have hLon : LipschitzOnWith 4 v₁ (smthDisc a y r) := by
    refine LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul fun x hx w hw => ?_
    rw [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
    have := hlip x hx w hw
    push_cast
    exact this
  obtain ⟨v, hvL, hvEq⟩ := hLon.extend_real
  have hcD : smthHoriz a y ∈ smthDisc a y r := by
    show ∑ k : Fin 2, (smthHoriz a y k - y (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 < r ^ 2
    simp only [smthHoriz, sub_self]
    simpa using pow_pos hr 2
  refine ⟨a, v, r, ε / 2, hr, by positivity, hvL.continuous, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hvEq hcD, hv₁ _ hcD]
    exact huniq _ (hdiscP _ hcD).2 _ _ (hv₀ _ hcD).le (by simp; positivity) (hv₀0 _ hcD) hGy
  · intro x hx w hw
    rw [← hvEq hx, ← hvEq hw]
    exact hlip x hx w hw
  · intro x hx
    rw [← hvEq hx, hv₁ x hx]
    exact hv₀ x hx
  · rintro z ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
    exact hBW z (hgeo z (hdiscP _ hz1).2 hz2.le)
  · intro z hz1 hz2
    have hzs := (hdiscP _ hz1).2
    have hzeq : smthLift a (smthHoriz a z) (z a) = z := liftSelf a z
    constructor
    · intro h0
      rw [← hvEq hz1, hv₁ _ hz1]
      refine huniq _ hzs _ _ hz2.le (hv₀ _ hz1).le ?_ (hv₀0 _ hz1)
      rw [hzeq, hG]
      simp [h0]
    · intro hza
      rw [← hvEq hz1, hv₁ _ hz1] at hza
      have h1 := hv₀0 _ hz1
      rw [← hza, hzeq, hG] at h1
      simpa [hs0] using h1

informal_problem.statement: (a : Fin 3) (c : E3) (r δ : ℝ) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : Continuous v) (hvin : ∀ x ∈ smthDisc a c r, |v x - c a| < δ) : IsPreconnected {z : E3 | smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a c r ∧ |z a - c a| < δ ∧ v (smthHoriz a z) < z a} ∧ IsPreconnected {z : E3 | smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a c r ∧ |z a - c a| < δ ∧ z a < v (smthHoriz a z)}

signature.name: cyl_sides_preconnected
signature.statement: (a : Fin 3) (c : E3) (r δ : ℝ) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : Continuous v) (hvin : ∀ x ∈ smthDisc a c r, |v x - c a| < δ) : IsPreconnected {z : E3 | smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a c r ∧ |z a - c a| < δ ∧ v (smthHoriz a z) < z a} ∧ IsPreconnected {z : E3 | smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a c r ∧ |z a - c a| < δ ∧ z a < v (smthHoriz a z)}

proof.tactics:
by
  have L1 : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthHoriz a (smthLift a x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    funext k
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove (α := fun _ => ℝ) a t x k
  have L2 : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift a x t) a = t := by
    intro x t
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_same (α := fun _ => ℝ) a t x
  have L3 : ∀ z : E3, smthLift a (smthHoriz a z) (z a) = z := by
    intro z
    ext i
    exact congrFun (Fin.insertNth_self_removeNth (α := fun _ => ℝ) a (fun j => z j)) i
  have L4 : ∀ F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ → ℝ, Continuous F →
      Continuous (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ => smthLift a p.1 (F p)) := by
    intro F hF
    unfold smthLift
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
      (Continuous.finInsertNth a hF continuous_fst)
  have hconv : Convex ℝ (smthDisc a c r) := by
    rw [convex_iff_forall_pos]
    intro x hx y hy s t hs ht hst
    simp only [smthDisc, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul] at hx hy ⊢
    have ht' : t = 1 - s := by linarith
    have key : ∀ u w : ℝ, (s * u + t * w) ^ 2 ≤ s * u ^ 2 + t * w ^ 2 := by
      intro u w
      have hid : s * u ^ 2 + t * w ^ 2 - (s * u + t * w) ^ 2 = s * t * (u - w) ^ 2 := by
        rw [ht']; ring
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hs.le ht.le) (sq_nonneg (u - w))]
    have e0 : s * x 0 + t * y 0 - c (a.succAbove 0) =
        s * (x 0 - c (a.succAbove 0)) + t * (y 0 - c (a.succAbove 0)) := by
      rw [ht']; ring
    have e1 : s * x 1 + t * y 1 - c (a.succAbove 1) =
        s * (x 1 - c (a.succAbove 1)) + t * (y 1 - c (a.succAbove 1)) := by
      rw [ht']; ring
    rw [e0, e1]
    have k0 := key (x 0 - c (a.succAbove 0)) (y 0 - c (a.succAbove 0))
    have k1 := key (x 1 - c (a.succAbove 1)) (y 1 - c (a.succAbove 1))
    have m1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx hs
    have m2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy ht
    have hr : s * r ^ 2 + t * r ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by rw [← add_mul, hst, one_mul]
    nlinarith
  have hP : IsPreconnected (smthDisc a c r ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
    hconv.isPreconnected.prod isPreconnected_Ioo
  constructor
  · have hcont : Continuous (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        smthLift a p.1 (v p.1 + p.2 * (c a + δ - v p.1))) :=
      L4 _ ((hv.comp continuous_fst).add
        (continuous_snd.mul (continuous_const.sub (hv.comp continuous_fst))))
    have heq : (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        smthLift a p.1 (v p.1 + p.2 * (c a + δ - v p.1))) ''
          (smthDisc a c r ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) =
        {z : E3 | smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a c r ∧ |z a - c a| < δ ∧
          v (smthHoriz a z) < z a} := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨x, τ⟩, ⟨hx, hτ0, hτ1⟩, rfl⟩
        have hb := abs_lt.mp (hvin x hx)
        have hg : 0 < c a + δ - v x := by linarith
        have h1 : 0 < τ * (c a + δ - v x) := mul_pos hτ0 hg
        have h2 : τ * (c a + δ - v x) < c a + δ - v x := by nlinarith
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        rw [L1, L2]
        exact ⟨hx, abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith⟩
      · rintro ⟨hx, hz, hlt⟩
        have hb := abs_lt.mp hz
        have hg : 0 < c a + δ - v (smthHoriz a z) := by linarith
        refine ⟨(smthHoriz a z, (z a - v (smthHoriz a z)) / (c a + δ - v (smthHoriz a z))),
          ⟨hx, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · exact div_pos (by linarith) hg
        · rw [div_lt_one hg]; linarith
        · simp only
          rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hg.ne']
          rw [show v (smthHoriz a z) + (z a - v (smthHoriz a z)) = z a by ring]
          exact L3 z
    rw [← heq]
    exact hP.image _ hcont.continuousOn
  · have hcont : Continuous (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        smthLift a p.1 (v p.1 - p.2 * (v p.1 - (c a - δ)))) :=
      L4 _ ((hv.comp continuous_fst).sub
        (continuous_snd.mul ((hv.comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const)))
    have heq : (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ =>
        smthLift a p.1 (v p.1 - p.2 * (v p.1 - (c a - δ)))) ''
          (smthDisc a c r ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) =
        {z : E3 | smthHoriz a z ∈ smthDisc a c r ∧ |z a - c a| < δ ∧
          z a < v (smthHoriz a z)} := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨x, τ⟩, ⟨hx, hτ0, hτ1⟩, rfl⟩
        have hb := abs_lt.mp (hvin x hx)
        have hg : 0 < v x - (c a - δ) := by linarith
        have h1 : 0 < τ * (v x - (c a - δ)) := mul_pos hτ0 hg
        have h2 : τ * (v x - (c a - δ)) < v x - (c a - δ) := by nlinarith
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
        rw [L1, L2]
        exact ⟨hx, abs_lt.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, by linarith⟩
      · rintro ⟨hx, hz, hlt⟩
        have hb := abs_lt.mp hz
        have hg : 0 < v (smthHoriz a z) - (c a - δ) := by linarith
        refine ⟨(smthHoriz a z, (v (smthHoriz a z) - z a) / (v (smthHoriz a z) - (c a - δ))),
          ⟨hx, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · exact div_pos (by linarith) hg
        · rw [div_lt_one hg]; linarith
        · simp only
          rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hg.ne']
          rw [show v (smthHoriz a z) - (v (smthHoriz a z) - z a) = z a by ring]
          exact L3 z
    rw [← heq]
    exact hP.image _ hcont.continuousOn

informal_problem.statement: (a : Fin 3) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : Continuous v) (h : E3 → ℝ) (hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 h) (hhc : HasCompactSupport h) : (∫ z in {z : E3 | v (smthHoriz a z) < z a}, partialDeriv a h z) = -∫ x, h (smthLift a x (v x)) ∧ (∫ z in {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)}, partialDeriv a h z) = ∫ x, h (smthLift a x (v x))

signature.name: graph_side_integral
signature.statement: (a : Fin 3) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : Continuous v) (h : E3 → ℝ) (hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 h) (hhc : HasCompactSupport h) : (∫ z in {z : E3 | v (smthHoriz a z) < z a}, partialDeriv a h z) = -∫ x, h (smthLift a x (v x)) ∧ (∫ z in {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)}, partialDeriv a h z) = ∫ x, h (smthLift a x (v x))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hg_cont : Continuous (partialDeriv a h) := by
    have : partialDeriv a h = fun z => fderiv ℝ h z (e a) := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact (hh.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hg_supp : HasCompactSupport (partialDeriv a h) := by
    have : partialDeriv a h = (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e a)) ∘ fderiv ℝ h := rfl
    rw [this]
    exact (hhc.fderiv ℝ).comp_left (by simp)
  have hgi : Integrable (partialDeriv a h) := hg_cont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hg_supp
  
  have hline : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthLift a x t = smthLift a x 0 + t • e a := by
    intro x t
    ext i
    rcases eq_or_ne i a with rfl | hia
    · simp [smthLift]
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hia
      simp [smthLift, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne]
  have hiso : ∀ x, Isometry (fun t : ℝ => smthLift a x t) := by
    intro x
    refine Isometry.of_dist_eq fun t s => ?_
    rw [dist_eq_norm, hline x t, hline x s, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← sub_smul, norm_smul,
      EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.dist_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hderiv : ∀ x t, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => smthLift a x s) (e a) t := by
    intro x t
    have : (fun s : ℝ => smthLift a x s) = fun s => smthLift a x 0 + s • e a := funext (hline x)
    rw [this]
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (e a)).const_add (smthLift a x 0)
  
  have hftc : ∀ x c, (∫ t in Set.Ioi c, partialDeriv a h (smthLift a x t)) = -h (smthLift a x c) ∧
      (∫ t in Set.Iio c, partialDeriv a h (smthLift a x t)) = h (smthLift a x c) := by
    intro x c
    have hfd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun t => h (smthLift a x t)) (partialDeriv a h (smthLift a x t)) t := by
      intro t
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt h (fderiv ℝ h (smthLift a x t)) (smthLift a x t) :=
        (hh.differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
      exact h1.comp_hasDerivAt t (hderiv x t)
    have hcemb := (hiso x).isClosedEmbedding
    have hf'c : Continuous (fun t => partialDeriv a h (smthLift a x t)) :=
      hg_cont.comp (hiso x).continuous
    have hf'i : Integrable (fun t => partialDeriv a h (smthLift a x t)) :=
      hf'c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hg_supp.comp_isClosedEmbedding hcemb)
    have hfs : HasCompactSupport (fun t => h (smthLift a x t)) := hhc.comp_isClosedEmbedding hcemb
    have hfcont : Continuous (fun t => h (smthLift a x t)) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun t => (hfd t).continuousAt
    have hlim := hfs.is_zero_at_infty
    rw [cocompact_eq_atBot_atTop] at hlim
    have htop : Tendsto (fun t => h (smthLift a x t)) atTop (𝓝 0) := hlim.mono_left le_sup_right
    have hbot : Tendsto (fun t => h (smthLift a x t)) atBot (𝓝 0) := hlim.mono_left le_sup_left
    constructor
    · rw [integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hfcont.continuousWithinAt (fun t _ => hfd t)
        hf'i.integrableOn htop, zero_sub]
    · rw [← integral_Iic_eq_integral_Iio, integral_Iic_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
        hfcont.continuousWithinAt (fun t _ => hfd t) hf'i.integrableOn hbot, sub_zero]
  
  have liftH : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthHoriz a (smthLift a x t) = x := by
    intro x t
    funext k
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove (α := fun _ => ℝ) a t x k
  have liftA : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift a x t) a = t := by
    intro x t
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_same (α := fun _ => ℝ) a t x
  have hHc : Continuous (smthHoriz a) := by
    unfold smthHoriz
    fun_prop
  
  obtain ⟨T, hTapp, hTmp⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) ≃ᵐ E3, (∀ p, T p = smthLift a p.2 p.1) ∧
      MeasurePreserving T (volume : Measure (ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) volume := by
    refine ⟨(MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) a).symm.trans
      (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ)), fun p => rfl, ?_⟩
    have h1 := MeasurePreserving.symm _
      (measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => (volume : Measure ℝ)) a)
    have h2 : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ)) volume volume :=
      MeasurePreserving.symm _ (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 3))
    exact h2.comp h1
  
  have key : ∀ (P : Set (ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (S : Set E3), MeasurableSet P → MeasurableSet S →
      (∀ p, T p ∈ S ↔ p ∈ P) →
      ∫ z in S, partialDeriv a h z =
        ∫ x, ∫ t, P.indicator (fun p => partialDeriv a h (T p)) (t, x) := by
    intro P S hP hS hPS
    rw [← integral_indicator hS, ← hTmp.integral_comp' (S.indicator (partialDeriv a h))]
    have hfun : (fun p => S.indicator (partialDeriv a h) (T p)) =
        P.indicator (fun p => partialDeriv a h (T p)) := by
      classical
      funext p
      by_cases hp : p ∈ P
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp, Set.indicator_of_mem ((hPS p).2 hp)]
      · have hp' : T p ∉ S := fun h' => hp ((hPS p).1 h')
        rw [Set.indicator_apply, Set.indicator_apply, if_neg hp, if_neg hp']
    rw [hfun]
    have hint : Integrable (P.indicator (fun p => partialDeriv a h (T p)))
        ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ))) :=
      ((hTmp.integrable_comp_emb T.measurableEmbedding).mpr hgi).indicator hP
    exact integral_prod_symm _ hint
  have hSup : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | v (smthHoriz a z) < z a} :=
    (isOpen_lt (hv.comp hHc) (by fun_prop)).measurableSet
  have hSlo : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | z a < v (smthHoriz a z)} :=
    (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) (hv.comp hHc)).measurableSet
  have hPup : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | v p.2 < p.1} :=
    measurableSet_lt (hv.measurable.comp measurable_snd) measurable_fst
  have hPlo : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | p.1 < v p.2} :=
    measurableSet_lt measurable_fst (hv.measurable.comp measurable_snd)
  have hupper := key _ _ hPup hSup (fun p => by
    rw [hTapp]; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, liftH, liftA])
  have hlower := key _ _ hPlo hSlo (fun p => by
    rw [hTapp]; simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, liftH, liftA])
  have hinup : ∀ x, (∫ t, {p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | v p.2 < p.1}.indicator
      (fun p => partialDeriv a h (T p)) (t, x)) = -h (smthLift a x (v x)) := by
    intro x
    have : (fun t => {p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | v p.2 < p.1}.indicator
        (fun p => partialDeriv a h (T p)) (t, x)) =
        (Set.Ioi (v x)).indicator (fun t => partialDeriv a h (smthLift a x t)) := by
      funext t
      simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Ioi, hTapp]
    rw [this, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi]
    exact (hftc x (v x)).1
  have hinlo : ∀ x, (∫ t, {p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | p.1 < v p.2}.indicator
      (fun p => partialDeriv a h (T p)) (t, x)) = h (smthLift a x (v x)) := by
    intro x
    have : (fun t => {p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | p.1 < v p.2}.indicator
        (fun p => partialDeriv a h (T p)) (t, x)) =
        (Set.Iio (v x)).indicator (fun t => partialDeriv a h (smthLift a x t)) := by
      funext t
      simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Iio, hTapp]
    rw [this, integral_indicator measurableSet_Iio]
    exact (hftc x (v x)).2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hupper]
    simp only [hinup, integral_neg]
  · rw [hlower]
    simp only [hinlo]

informal_problem.statement: (a : Fin 3) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hlip : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ w ∈ S, |v x - v w| ≤ 4 * ‖x - w‖) : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure 2 ((fun x => smthLift a x (v x)) '' S) ≤ 18 * MeasureTheory.volume S

signature.name: graph_hausdorff_le
signature.statement: (a : Fin 3) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hlip : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ w ∈ S, |v x - v w| ≤ 4 * ‖x - w‖) : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure 2 ((fun x => smthLift a x (v x)) '' S) ≤ 18 * MeasureTheory.volume S

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcoord : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
      (smthLift a x t) i = Fin.insertNth (α := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) a t x i :=
    fun x t i => rfl
  have hsq : ∀ x w : Fin 2 → ℝ, dist (smthLift a x (v x)) (smthLift a w (v w)) ^ 2
      = (v x - v w) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - w k) ^ 2 := by
    intro x w
    rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)),
      Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a]
    simp only [Real.dist_eq, sq_abs, hcoord, Fin.insertNth_apply_same,
      Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
  have hL : LipschitzOnWith (NNReal.sqrt 18) (fun x => smthLift a x (v x)) S := by
    apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x hx w hw
    have hn : 0 ≤ dist x w := dist_nonneg
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin 2, |x k - w k| ≤ dist x w := by
      intro k
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (x - w) k
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
    have hv : |v x - v w| ≤ 4 * dist x w := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]; exact hlip x hx w hw
    have hs := hsq x w
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hs
    have e18 : ((NNReal.sqrt 18 : NNReal) : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 18 := by
      rw [Real.coe_sqrt]; norm_num
    rw [e18]
    have hq : (Real.sqrt 18) ^ 2 = 18 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    have hd : 0 ≤ dist (smthLift a x (v x)) (smthLift a w (v w)) := dist_nonneg
    have a0 : (x 0 - w 0) ^ 2 ≤ dist x w ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hk 0) 2
    have a1 : (x 1 - w 1) ^ 2 ≤ dist x w ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hk 1) 2
    have av : (v x - v w) ^ 2 ≤ (4 * dist x w) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hv 2
    have e16 : (4 * dist x w) ^ 2 = 16 * dist x w ^ 2 := by ring
    show dist (smthLift a x (v x)) (smthLift a w (v w)) ≤ Real.sqrt 18 * dist x w
    rw [← pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ hd (by positivity) two_ne_zero, mul_pow, hq, hs]
    linarith
  have h := hL.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (d := 2) (by norm_num)
  have h5 : ((NNReal.sqrt 18 : NNReal) : ENNReal) ^ (2 : ℝ) = 18 := by
    rw [ENNReal.rpow_two, ← ENNReal.coe_pow, NNReal.sq_sqrt]; rfl
  have h6 : (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) :
      MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)) = MeasureTheory.volume := by
    simpa using (MeasureTheory.hausdorffMeasure_pi_real (ι := Fin 2))
  rw [h5, h6] at h
  exact h

informal_problem.statement: {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (a : ι → Fin 3) (v : ι → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (D : ι → Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hD : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (D i)) (hDf : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.volume (D i) ≠ ⊤) (hv : ∀ i, Continuous (v i)) (hH : ∀ i, ∀ S ⊆ D i, MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure 2 ((fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' S) ≤ 18 * MeasureTheory.volume S) (hcov : K ⊆ ⋃ i, (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' D i) (ε : ENNReal) (hε : ε ≠ 0) : ∃ Q : ι → Set (Fin 2 → ℝ), (∀ i, IsCompact (Q i) ∧ Q i ⊆ D i ∧ (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' Q i ⊆ K) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint ((fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' Q i) ((fun x => smthLift (a j) x (v j x)) '' Q j)) ∧ MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure 2 K ≤ 18 * ∑ i, MeasureTheory.volume (Q i) + ε

signature.name: disjoint_graph_selection
signature.statement: {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (a : ι → Fin 3) (v : ι → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (D : ι → Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hD : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (D i)) (hDf : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.volume (D i) ≠ ⊤) (hv : ∀ i, Continuous (v i)) (hH : ∀ i, ∀ S ⊆ D i, MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure 2 ((fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' S) ≤ 18 * MeasureTheory.volume S) (hcov : K ⊆ ⋃ i, (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' D i) (ε : ENNReal) (hε : ε ≠ 0) : ∃ Q : ι → Set (Fin 2 → ℝ), (∀ i, IsCompact (Q i) ∧ Q i ⊆ D i ∧ (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' Q i ⊆ K) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint ((fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' Q i) ((fun x => smthLift (a j) x (v j x)) '' Q j)) ∧ MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure 2 K ≤ 18 * ∑ i, MeasureTheory.volume (Q i) + ε

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have liftH : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthHoriz b (smthLift b x t) = x := by
    intro b x t
    funext k
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove (α := fun _ => ℝ) b t x k
  have liftA : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift b x t) b = t := by
    intro b x t
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_same (α := fun _ => ℝ) b t x
  have liftSelf : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (z : E3), smthLift b (smthHoriz b z) (z b) = z := by
    intro b z
    ext i
    exact congrFun (Fin.insertNth_self_removeNth (α := fun _ => ℝ) b (fun j => z j)) i
  have horizC : ∀ b : Fin 3, Continuous (smthHoriz b) := by
    intro b
    unfold smthHoriz
    fun_prop
  have hΓc : ∀ i, Continuous (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) := by
    intro i
    unfold smthLift
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
      (Continuous.finInsertNth (a i) (hv i) continuous_id)
  
  have hTm : ∀ i, MeasurableSet ((fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' D i) := by
    intro i
    have heq : (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' D i =
        smthHoriz (a i) ⁻¹' D i ∩ {z : E3 | z (a i) = v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)} := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · show smthHoriz (a i) (smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) ∈ D i
          rw [liftH]
          exact hx
        · show (smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) (a i) =
            v i (smthHoriz (a i) (smthLift (a i) x (v i x)))
          rw [liftH, liftA]
      · rintro ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
        refine ⟨smthHoriz (a i) z, hz1, ?_⟩
        show smthLift (a i) (smthHoriz (a i) z) (v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)) = z
        have hz2' : z (a i) = v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) := hz2
        rw [← hz2']
        exact liftSelf _ _
    rw [heq]
    refine ((hD i).preimage (horizC (a i)).measurable).inter ?_
    have hcz : Continuous (fun z : E3 => z (a i)) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (a i) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
    exact (isClosed_eq hcz ((hv i).comp (horizC (a i)))).measurableSet
  
  have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.isClosed.measurableSet
  let σ := Fintype.equivFin ι
  let B : ι → Set E3 := fun i =>
    (K ∩ (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' D i) \
      ⋃ j, ⋃ (_ : σ j < σ i), (fun x => smthLift (a j) x (v j x)) '' D j
  have hBm : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (B i) := fun i =>
    (hKm.inter (hTm i)).diff (MeasurableSet.iUnion fun j => MeasurableSet.iUnion fun _ => hTm j)
  have hBsub : ∀ i, B i ⊆ K ∩ (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' D i :=
    fun i => Set.diff_subset
  have hBcov : K ⊆ ⋃ i, B i := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (hcov hz)
    have hs : (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun i => z ∈ (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' D i)).Nonempty :=
      ⟨i₀, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hi₀⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hmin⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image _ σ hs
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, ⟨hz, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hzu
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hzu
    obtain ⟨hlt, hzj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hj
    have hle := hmin j (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hzj⟩)
    exact absurd hlt (not_lt.2 hle)
  have hBdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (B i) (B j)) := by
    intro i j hij
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro z hzi hzj
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (σ.injective.ne hij) with h | h
    · exact hzj.2 (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨h, hzi.1.2⟩⟩)
    · exact hzi.2 (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨h, hzj.1.2⟩⟩)
  
  let P : ι → Set (Fin 2 → ℝ) := fun i => D i ∩ (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) ⁻¹' B i
  have hPm : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (P i) := fun i =>
    (hD i).inter ((hBm i).preimage (hΓc i).measurable)
  have hPf : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.volume (P i) ≠ ⊤ := fun i =>
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (hDf i) (MeasureTheory.measure_mono Set.inter_subset_left)
  have hPB : ∀ i, (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' P i ⊆ B i := by
    rintro i _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hx.2
  have hKP : K ⊆ ⋃ i, (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' P i := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (hBcov hz)
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩ := (hBsub i hi).2
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, x, ⟨hx, ?_⟩, hxz⟩
    show (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) x ∈ B i
    rw [hxz]
    exact hi
  have hHK : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure 2 K ≤
      18 * ∑ i, MeasureTheory.volume (P i) := by
    calc MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure 2 K
        ≤ MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure 2
            (⋃ i, (fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' P i) := MeasureTheory.measure_mono hKP
      _ ≤ ∑ i, MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure 2
            ((fun x => smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) '' P i) :=
          MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i, 18 * MeasureTheory.volume (P i) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hH i (P i) Set.inter_subset_left
      _ = 18 * ∑ i, MeasureTheory.volume (P i) := (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
  
  have hc : (18 * (Fintype.card ι : ENNReal)) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by norm_num) (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)
  have hδ : ε / (18 * (Fintype.card ι : ENNReal)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, ENNReal.div_eq_zero_iff]
    push_neg
    exact ⟨hε, hc⟩
  have hex : ∀ i, ∃ Q ⊆ P i, IsCompact Q ∧ MeasureTheory.volume (P i) <
      MeasureTheory.volume Q + ε / (18 * (Fintype.card ι : ENNReal)) :=
    fun i => (hPm i).exists_isCompact_lt_add (hPf i) hδ
  choose Q hQP hQc hQlt using hex
  have hsum : 18 * ∑ i, MeasureTheory.volume (P i) ≤
      18 * ∑ i, MeasureTheory.volume (Q i) + ε := by
    calc 18 * ∑ i, MeasureTheory.volume (P i)
        ≤ 18 * ∑ i, (MeasureTheory.volume (Q i) + ε / (18 * (Fintype.card ι : ENNReal))) := by
          gcongr with i
          exact (hQlt i).le
      _ = 18 * ∑ i, MeasureTheory.volume (Q i) +
            (18 * (Fintype.card ι : ENNReal)) * (ε / (18 * (Fintype.card ι : ENNReal))) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_add,
            mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ 18 * ∑ i, MeasureTheory.volume (Q i) + ε := by
          gcongr
          exact ENNReal.mul_div_le
  refine ⟨Q, fun i => ⟨hQc i, (hQP i).trans Set.inter_subset_left, ?_⟩, ?_, hHK.trans hsum⟩
  · exact (Set.image_mono (hQP i)).trans ((hPB i).trans ((hBsub i).trans Set.inter_subset_left))
  · intro i j hij
    exact Disjoint.mono ((Set.image_mono (hQP i)).trans (hPB i))
      ((Set.image_mono (hQP j)).trans (hPB j)) (hBdisj hij)

informal_problem.statement: {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (P O : ι → Set E3) (hP : ∀ i, IsCompact (P i)) (hO : ∀ i, IsOpen (O i)) (hPO : ∀ i, P i ⊆ O i) (hdisj : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)) : ∃ χ : ι → E3 → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ i) ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ χ i z ∧ χ i z ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ z ∈ P i, χ i z = 1) ∧ HasCompactSupport (χ i) ∧ tsupport (χ i) ⊆ O i) ∧ Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (tsupport (χ i)) (tsupport (χ j))

signature.name: disjoint_bumps
signature.statement: {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (P O : ι → Set E3) (hP : ∀ i, IsCompact (P i)) (hO : ∀ i, IsOpen (O i)) (hPO : ∀ i, P i ⊆ O i) (hdisj : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)) : ∃ χ : ι → E3 → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ i) ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ χ i z ∧ χ i z ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ z ∈ P i, χ i z = 1) ∧ HasCompactSupport (χ i) ∧ tsupport (χ i) ⊆ O i) ∧ Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (tsupport (χ i)) (tsupport (χ j))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hε : ∀ i, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ Metric.cthickening ε (P i) ⊆ O i :=
    fun i => (hP i).exists_cthickening_subset_open (hO i) (hPO i)
  choose ε hε0 hεO using hε
  have hδ' : ∀ i, ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ Disjoint (Metric.cthickening δ (P i))
      (Metric.cthickening δ (⋃ j, ⋃ (_ : j ≠ i), P j)) := by
    intro i
    have hQc : IsClosed (⋃ j, ⋃ (_ : j ≠ i), P j) :=
      isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun j => isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun _ => (hP j).isClosed
    have hPQ : Disjoint (P i) (⋃ j, ⋃ (_ : j ≠ i), P j) := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_iUnion_right]
      intro j
      rw [Set.disjoint_iUnion_right]
      intro hji
      exact hdisj (Ne.symm hji)
    exact hPQ.exists_cthickenings (hP i) hQc
  choose δ' hδ'0 hδ'd using hδ'
  set δ : ι → ℝ := fun i => min (ε i) (δ' i) with hδdef
  have hδ0 : ∀ i, 0 < δ i := fun i => lt_min (hε0 i) (hδ'0 i)
  have hKO : ∀ i, Metric.cthickening (δ i) (P i) ⊆ O i := fun i =>
    (Metric.cthickening_mono (min_le_left _ _) _).trans (hεO i)
  have hkey : ∀ a b, a ≠ b → δ a ≤ δ b →
      Disjoint (Metric.cthickening (δ a) (P a)) (Metric.cthickening (δ b) (P b)) := by
    intro a b hab hle
    have h1 : Metric.cthickening (δ a) (P a) ⊆
        Metric.cthickening (δ' b) (⋃ j, ⋃ (_ : j ≠ b), P j) := by
      refine (Metric.cthickening_mono hle _).trans ?_
      refine (Metric.cthickening_subset_of_subset _ ?_).trans
        (Metric.cthickening_mono (min_le_right _ _) _)
      exact Set.subset_iUnion₂_of_subset a hab le_rfl
    have h2 : Metric.cthickening (δ b) (P b) ⊆ Metric.cthickening (δ' b) (P b) :=
      Metric.cthickening_mono (min_le_right _ _) _
    exact Disjoint.mono h1 h2 (hδ'd b).symm
  have hKd : Pairwise fun i j =>
      Disjoint (Metric.cthickening (δ i) (P i)) (Metric.cthickening (δ j) (P j)) := by
    intro i j hij
    rcases le_total (δ i) (δ j) with h | h
    · exact hkey i j hij h
    · exact (hkey j i (Ne.symm hij) h).symm
  have hbump : ∀ i, ∃ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ f z ∧ f z ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ P i, f z = 1) ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧
      tsupport f ⊆ Metric.cthickening (δ i) (P i) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfr, hfs, hf1⟩ := exists_contMDiff_support_eq_eq_one_iff 𝓘(ℝ, E3)
      (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) (Metric.isOpen_thickening (δ := δ i) (E := P i)) (hP i).isClosed
      (Metric.self_subset_thickening (hδ0 i) _)
    have hts : tsupport f ⊆ Metric.cthickening (δ i) (P i) := by
      rw [tsupport, hfs]
      exact Metric.closure_thickening_subset_cthickening _ _
    refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hts⟩
    · exact contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp hf
    · intro z
      have := hfr (Set.mem_range_self z)
      exact ⟨this.1, this.2⟩
    · intro z hz
      exact (hf1 z).mp hz
    · exact ((hP i).cthickening).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport f) hts
  choose χ hχ using hbump
  refine ⟨χ, fun i => ⟨(hχ i).1, (hχ i).2.1, (hχ i).2.2.1, (hχ i).2.2.2.1,
    (hχ i).2.2.2.2.trans (hKO i)⟩, ?_⟩
  intro i j hij
  exact Disjoint.mono (hχ i).2.2.2.2 (hχ j).2.2.2.2 (hKd hij)

c i (a i)| < δ i}) (hχd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (tsupport (χ i)) (tsupport (χ j))) (hftc : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ), Continuous w → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h → (∫ z in {z : E3 | w (smthHoriz b z) < z b}, partialDeriv b h z) = -∫ x, h (smthLift b x (w x)) ∧ (∫ z in {z : E3 | z b < w (smthHoriz b z)}, partialDeriv b h z) = ∫ x, h (smthLift b x (w x))) : ENNReal.ofReal (m / Real.sqrt Γ) * ∑ i, MeasureTheory.volume (Q i) ≤ hullPerG G F U Kc
