proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s2 : ∀ (s χ' : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ s T → ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ' →
      tsupport χ' ⊆ T → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => χ' z * s z) := by
    intro s χ' hs hχ' hχT
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport χ'
    · exact hχ'.contDiffAt.mul (hs.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds (hχT hy)))
    · have h0 : χ' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy
      refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0:ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
      simp [hz]
  have s3 : ∀ (φ ψ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (b : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ y →
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ), φ (y + t • e b) = ψ (y + t • e b)) →
      |partialDeriv b φ y| ≤ |partialDeriv b ψ y| := by
    intro φ ψ y b hψ hray
    by_cases hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ y
    · apply le_of_eq
      congr 1
      have hℓ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y + t • e b) (e b) 0 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const (e b)).const_add y
      have hy0 : y = y + (0:ℝ) • e b := by simp
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => φ (y + t • e b)) (fderiv ℝ φ y (e b)) 0 :=
        hφ.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hℓ hy0
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ψ (y + t • e b)) (fderiv ℝ ψ y (e b)) 0 :=
        hψ.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hℓ hy0
      have hT1 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => φ (y + t • e b)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (φ y)) := by
        have := h1.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)))
        simpa using this
      have hT2 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => ψ (y + t • e b)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (ψ y)) := by
        have := h2.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)))
        simpa using this
      have hT1' : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => φ (y + t • e b)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (ψ y)) :=
        hT2.congr' (hray.mono fun t ht => ht.symm)
      have hval : φ y = ψ y := tendsto_nhds_unique hT1 hT1'
      have h2' : HasDerivWithinAt (fun t : ℝ => φ (y + t • e b)) (fderiv ℝ ψ y (e b))
          (Set.Ioi 0) 0 :=
        h2.hasDerivWithinAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq hray (by simpa using hval)
      exact (uniqueDiffWithinAt_Ioi 0).eq_deriv _ h1.hasDerivWithinAt h2'
    · simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hφ]
      simp
  have pd_loc : ∀ (S f : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (cst : ℝ) (b : Fin 3) (y : E3), IsOpen O → y ∈ O →
      (∀ z ∈ O, S z = cst) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f y →
      partialDeriv b (fun z => S z * f z) y = cst * partialDeriv b f y := by
    intro S f O cst b y hO hy hS hf
    have hev : (fun z => S z * f z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun z => cst * f z :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => by simp only [hS z hz])
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_mul hf, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have pd_const : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (cst : ℝ) (b : Fin 3) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f y →
      partialDeriv b (fun z => cst * f z) y = cst * partialDeriv b f y := by
    intro f cst b y hf
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_const_mul hf, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have pd_zero : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ) (b : Fin 3) (y : E3), g =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 → partialDeriv b g y = 0 := by
    intro g b y hg
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hg.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have cd_loc : ∀ (S f : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (cst : ℝ) (y : E3), IsOpen O → y ∈ O →
      (∀ z ∈ O, S z = cst) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => S z * f z) y := by
    intro S f O cst y hO hy hS hf
    refine ((contDiffAt_const (c := cst)).mul hf.contDiffAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => by simp only [hS z hz])
  have ev_zero : ∀ (S f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), y ∉ tsupport f →
      (fun z => S z * f z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := by
    intro S f y hy
    filter_upwards [notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy] with z hz
    simp [hz]
  have split : ∀ (φ : ι → E3 → ℝ), (Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (tsupport (φ i)) (tsupport (φ j))) →
      ∀ y, ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => ∑ i, if a i = j then φ i z else 0) y =
        ∑ i, partialDeriv (a i) (φ i) y := by
    intro φ hφ y
    by_cases hex : ∃ i₀, y ∈ tsupport (φ i₀)
    · obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hex
      have hoth : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → φ i =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := fun i hi =>
        notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (fun hy => Set.disjoint_left.mp (hφ hi) hy hi₀)
      have hall : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → φ i z = 0 := by
        rw [Filter.eventually_all]
        intro i
        by_cases hi : i = i₀
        · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z h => absurd hi h)
        · filter_upwards [hoth i hi] with z hz
          intro _
          exact hz
      have hj : ∀ j, partialDeriv j (fun z => ∑ i, if a i = j then φ i z else 0) y =
          if a i₀ = j then partialDeriv j (φ i₀) y else 0 := by
        intro j
        have hev : (fun z => ∑ i, if a i = j then φ i z else 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
            (fun z => if a i₀ = j then φ i₀ z else 0) := by
          filter_upwards [hall] with z hz
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i₀]
          · intro i _ hi
            simp [hz i hi]
          · intro h
            exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
        by_cases hij : a i₀ = j
        · subst hij
          simp
        · simp [hij]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hj j), Finset.sum_ite_eq]
      rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.sum_eq_single i₀]
      · intro i _ hi
        exact pd_zero _ _ _ (hoth i hi)
      · intro h
        exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
    · push_neg at hex
      have hall : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i, φ i z = 0 := by
        rw [Filter.eventually_all]
        intro i
        exact notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (hex i)
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
      · intro i _
        exact pd_zero _ _ _ (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (hex i))
      · intro j _
        refine pd_zero _ _ _ ?_
        filter_upwards [hall] with z hz
        simp [hz]
  
  have horizC : ∀ b : Fin 3, Continuous (smthHoriz b) := by
    intro b
    unfold smthHoriz
    fun_prop
  have liftH : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthHoriz b (smthLift b x t) = x := by
    intro b x t
    funext k
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove (α := fun _ => ℝ) b t x k
  have liftA : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift b x t) b = t := by
    intro b x t
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_same (α := fun _ => ℝ) b t x
  have gamC : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), Continuous w →
      Continuous (fun x => smthLift b x (w x)) := by
    intro b w hw
    unfold smthLift
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
      (Continuous.finInsertNth b hw continuous_id)
  have rayA : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (y : E3) (t : ℝ), (y + t • e b) b = y b + t := by
    intro b y t
    simp
  have rayH : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (y : E3) (t : ℝ), smthHoriz b (y + t • e b) = smthHoriz b y := by
    intro b y t
    funext k
    simp [smthHoriz, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne]
  
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ : ∃ lam : ℝ, lam = 1 / Real.sqrt Γ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt Γ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hΓ
  have hlam0 : 0 < lam := by rw [hlam]; positivity
  have hlamΓ : lam ^ 2 * Γ = 1 := by
    rw [hlam, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hΓ.le]
    field_simp
  have hlamm : lam * m = m / Real.sqrt Γ := by rw [hlam]; ring
  have hsupp : ∀ i z, z ∈ tsupport (χ i) → z ∈ U ∧ z ∈ N ∧
      (z ∈ Kc ↔ z (a i) = v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)) := by
    intro i z hz
    have hc := (hχ i).2.2.2.2 hz
    exact ⟨(hcyl i hc).1, (hcyl i hc).2, hgraph i z hc.1 hc.2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨α, β, hαb, hβb, hα0, hβ0, hβα⟩ : ∃ α β : ι → ℝ, (∀ i, |α i| ≤ lam) ∧
      (∀ i, |β i| ≤ lam) ∧
      (∀ i, α i ≠ 0 → ∀ z, smthHoriz (a i) z ∈ smthDisc (a i) (c i) (r i) →
        |z (a i) - c i (a i)| < δ i → v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i) → z ∈ F) ∧
      (∀ i, β i ≠ 0 → ∀ z, smthHoriz (a i) z ∈ smthDisc (a i) (c i) (r i) →
        |z (a i) - c i (a i)| < δ i → z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) → z ∈ F) ∧
      (∀ i, lam ≤ β i - α i) := by
    refine ⟨fun i => if {z : E3 | smthHoriz (a i) z ∈ smthDisc (a i) (c i) (r i) ∧
        |z (a i) - c i (a i)| < δ i ∧ v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)} ⊆ F then -lam else 0,
      fun i => if {z : E3 | smthHoriz (a i) z ∈ smthDisc (a i) (c i) (r i) ∧
        |z (a i) - c i (a i)| < δ i ∧ z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)} ⊆ F then lam else 0,
      ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      dsimp only
      split_ifs
      · rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos hlam0]
      · simp [hlam0.le]
    · intro i
      dsimp only
      split_ifs
      · rw [abs_of_pos hlam0]
      · simp [hlam0.le]
    · intro i hne z h1 h2 h3
      dsimp only at hne
      split_ifs at hne with hs
      · exact hs ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      · exact absurd rfl hne
    · intro i hne z h1 h2 h3
      dsimp only at hne
      split_ifs at hne with hs
      · exact hs ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      · exact absurd rfl hne
    · intro i
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
      · linarith
      · linarith
      · linarith
      · exfalso
        rcases hone i with h | h
        · exact h2 h
        · exact h1 h
  obtain ⟨S, hSup, hSlo, hSb⟩ : ∃ S : ι → E3 → ℝ,
      (∀ i z, v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i) → S i z = α i) ∧
      (∀ i z, z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) → S i z = β i) ∧ (∀ i z, |S i z| ≤ lam) := by
    refine ⟨fun i z => if v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i) then α i
      else if z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) then β i else 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i z h
      simp only [if_pos h]
    · intro i z h
      simp only [if_neg (not_lt.2 h.le), if_pos h]
    · intro i z
      dsimp only
      split_ifs
      · exact hαb i
      · exact hβb i
      · simp [hlam0.le]
  have hUpO : ∀ i, IsOpen {z : E3 | v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)} := fun i =>
    isOpen_lt ((hv i).comp (horizC (a i))) (by fun_prop)
  have hLoO : ∀ i, IsOpen {z : E3 | z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)} := fun i =>
    isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) ((hv i).comp (horizC (a i)))
  
  have hsd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) T := by
    have h := hG
    have hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
        - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
        + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0) T :=
      (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
        (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
        (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
    have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) T :=
      hP.congr (fun z _ => Matrix.det_fin_three (G z))
    exact hdetS.sqrt (fun z hz => (hdet z hz).ne')
  obtain ⟨h, hhdef⟩ : ∃ h : ι → E3 → ℝ, h = fun i z => χ i z * Real.sqrt (G z).det := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hh : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (h i) := by
    intro i
    rw [hhdef]
    exact s2 _ _ hsd (hχ i).1 (fun z hz => hNT ((hsupp i z hz).2.1))
  have hhc : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (h i) := by
    intro i
    rw [hhdef]
    exact (hχ i).2.2.2.1.mul_right
  have hhs : ∀ i, tsupport (h i) ⊆ tsupport (χ i) := by
    intro i
    rw [hhdef]
    exact tsupport_mul_subset_left
  have hh0 : ∀ i z, 0 ≤ h i z := by
    intro i z
    rw [hhdef]
    exact mul_nonneg ((hχ i).2.1 z).1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hhd : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (h i) := fun i => (hh i).differentiable (by simp)
  have hpc : ∀ i, Continuous (fun y => partialDeriv (a i) (h i) y) := fun i =>
    ((hh i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hpcs : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (fun y => partialDeriv (a i) (h i) y) := fun i =>
    (hhc i).fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e (a i))
  have hpi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv (a i) (h i) y) := fun i =>
    (hpc i).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hpcs i)
  have hp0 : ∀ i y, y ∉ tsupport (h i) → partialDeriv (a i) (h i) y = 0 := fun i y hy =>
    pd_zero _ _ _ (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy)
  
  have hD : ∀ i y, |partialDeriv (a i) (fun z => S i z * h i z) y| ≤
      lam * |partialDeriv (a i) (h i) y| := by
    intro i y
    rcases lt_trichotomy (v i (smthHoriz (a i) y)) (y (a i)) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · rw [pd_loc (S i) (h i) _ (α i) (a i) y (hUpO i) hlt (fun z hz => hSup i z hz)
        ((hhd i) y), abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hαb i) (abs_nonneg _)
    · have hray : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0:ℝ), (fun z => S i z * h i z) (y + t • e (a i)) =
          (fun z => α i * h i z) (y + t • e (a i)) := by
        refine eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall ?_
        intro t ht
        have ht' : (0:ℝ) < t := ht
        have hup' : v i (smthHoriz (a i) (y + t • e (a i))) < (y + t • e (a i)) (a i) := by
          rw [rayH, rayA]
          linarith
        simp only [hSup i _ hup']
      refine (s3 _ _ y (a i) (((hhd i) y).const_mul (α i)) hray).trans ?_
      rw [pd_const (h i) (α i) (a i) y ((hhd i) y), abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hαb i) (abs_nonneg _)
    · rw [pd_loc (S i) (h i) _ (β i) (a i) y (hLoO i) hgt (fun z hz => hSlo i z hz)
        ((hhd i) y), abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hβb i) (abs_nonneg _)
  
  obtain ⟨X, hXdef⟩ : ∃ X : E3 → E3, X = fun z => ∑ i, (S i z * χ i z) • e (a i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hA1 : ∀ y, y ∉ Kc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hXdef]
    refine ContDiffAt.sum (fun i _ => ?_)
    have hci : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => S i z * χ i z) y := by
      by_cases hyt : y ∈ tsupport (χ i)
      · have hne : y (a i) ≠ v i (smthHoriz (a i) y) := fun h' => hy ((hsupp i y hyt).2.2.mpr h')
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
        · exact cd_loc (S i) (χ i) _ (β i) y (hLoO i) hlt (fun z hz => hSlo i z hz) (hχ i).1
        · exact cd_loc (S i) (χ i) _ (α i) y (hUpO i) hgt (fun z hz => hSup i z hz) (hχ i).1
      · exact (contDiffAt_const (c := (0:ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq (ev_zero (S i) (χ i) y hyt)
    exact hci.smul (contDiffAt_const (c := e (a i)))
  
  have hsuppX : Function.support X ⊆ ⋃ i, tsupport (χ i) := by
    intro z hz
    by_contra hcon
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists] at hcon
    apply hz
    rw [hXdef]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (hcon i), mul_zero, zero_smul]
  have hWc : IsCompact (⋃ i, tsupport (χ i)) := isCompact_iUnion (fun i => (hχ i).2.2.2.1)
  have hXW : tsupport X ⊆ ⋃ i, tsupport (χ i) := closure_minimal hsuppX hWc.isClosed
  have hA2a : HasCompactSupport X := hWc.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport X) hXW
  have hA2b : tsupport X ⊆ U :=
    hXW.trans (Set.iUnion_subset fun i z hz => (hsupp i z hz).1)
  
  have hA3 : ∀ y, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, G y j k * X y j * X y k ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    by_cases hex : ∃ i₀, S i₀ y * χ i₀ y ≠ 0
    · obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hex
      have hχ0 : χ i₀ y ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul hi₀
      have hyt : y ∈ tsupport (χ i₀) := subset_tsupport _ hχ0
      have hoth : ∀ i, i ≠ i₀ → S i y * χ i y = 0 := by
        intro i hi
        have : χ i y = 0 :=
          image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h' => Set.disjoint_left.mp (hχd hi) h' hyt)
        rw [this, mul_zero]
      have hcb : |S i₀ y * χ i₀ y| ≤ lam := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ((hχ i₀).2.1 y).1]
        have h1 := hSb i₀ y
        have h2 := ((hχ i₀).2.1 y).2
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (S i₀ y)]
      have hGb := hGa y (hsupp i₀ y hyt).2.1 (a i₀)
      have hXy : X y = (S i₀ y * χ i₀ y) • e (a i₀) := by
        rw [hXdef]
        exact Finset.sum_eq_single i₀ (fun i _ hi => by rw [hoth i hi, zero_smul])
          (fun h' => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h')
      generalize S i₀ y * χ i₀ y = cc at hXy hcb
      have hXj : ∀ j, X y j = if j = a i₀ then cc else 0 := by
        intro j
        rw [hXy]
        simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      simp only [hXj, mul_ite, ite_mul, mul_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ,
        if_true]
      have hc2 : cc * cc ≤ lam * lam := by
        rw [← abs_mul_abs_self cc]
        exact mul_self_le_mul_self (abs_nonneg _) hcb
      rcases le_or_gt (G y (a i₀) (a i₀)) 0 with hG0 | hG0
      · nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg cc]
      · nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hc2 hG0.le]
    · push_neg at hex
      have hXy : X y = 0 := by
        rw [hXdef]
        exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => by rw [hex i, zero_smul])
      simp [hXy]
  
  have hφd : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (tsupport (fun z => S i z * h i z))
      (tsupport (fun z => S j z * h j z)) := fun i j hij =>
    (hχd hij).mono (tsupport_mul_subset_right.trans (hhs i))
      (tsupport_mul_subset_right.trans (hhs j))
  have hXcomp : ∀ j : Fin 3, (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z j) =
      fun z => ∑ i, if a i = j then S i z * h i z else 0 := by
    intro j
    funext z
    rw [hXdef, hhdef]
    simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      EuclideanSpace.single_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    by_cases hij : a i = j
    · subst hij
      simp only [if_true]
      ring
    · rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hij), if_neg hij]
      ring
  have hdiv : ∀ y, sepDensDiv G X y = ∑ i, partialDeriv (a i) (fun z => S i z * h i z) y := by
    intro y
    unfold sepDensDiv
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by rw [hXcomp j])]
    exact split (fun i z => S i z * h i z) hφd y
  
  have hB : ∀ i, ∃ B, ∀ y, |partialDeriv (a i) (h i) y| ≤ B := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := (hpc i).bounded_above_of_compact_support (hpcs i)
    exact ⟨B, fun y => by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hB y⟩
  choose B hBb using hB
  have hA4 : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C := by
    refine ⟨∑ i, lam * B i, fun y => ?_⟩
    rw [hdiv y]
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    exact (hD i y).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hBb i y) hlam0.le)
  
  have hDi : ∀ i, Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv (a i) (fun z => S i z * h i z) y) := by
    intro i
    refine ((hpi i).abs.const_mul lam).mono' ?_ (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
    · exact (measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ (fun z => S i z * h i z) (e (a i))).aestronglyMeasurable
    · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hD i y
  have hflux : ∀ i, lam * m * (volume (Q i)).toReal ≤
      ∫ y in F, partialDeriv (a i) (fun z => S i z * h i z) y := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨hf1, hf2⟩ := hftc (a i) (v i) (h i) (hv i) ((hh i).of_le (by simp)) (hhc i)
    have hPm : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)} := (hUpO i).measurableSet
    have hLm : MeasurableSet {z : E3 | z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)} := (hLoO i).measurableSet
    have hDF : ∀ z ∈ F, partialDeriv (a i) (fun z => S i z * h i z) z =
        {z : E3 | v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)}.indicator
          (fun z => α i * partialDeriv (a i) (h i) z) z +
        {z : E3 | z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)}.indicator
          (fun z => β i * partialDeriv (a i) (h i) z) z := by
      intro z hzF
      by_cases hzP : v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)
      · have hzL : ¬ z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) := fun h' => lt_asymm hzP h'
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show z ∈ {z : E3 | v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)} from hzP),
          Set.indicator_of_notMem (show z ∉ {z : E3 | z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)} from hzL),
          add_zero]
        exact pd_loc (S i) (h i) _ (α i) (a i) z (hUpO i) hzP (fun w hw => hSup i w hw) ((hhd i) z)
      · by_cases hzL : z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show z ∉ {z : E3 | v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)} from hzP),
            Set.indicator_of_mem (show z ∈ {z : E3 | z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)} from hzL),
            zero_add]
          exact pd_loc (S i) (h i) _ (β i) (a i) z (hLoO i) hzL (fun w hw => hSlo i w hw)
            ((hhd i) z)
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show z ∉ {z : E3 | v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)} from hzP),
            Set.indicator_of_notMem (show z ∉ {z : E3 | z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)} from hzL),
            add_zero]
          have heq : z (a i) = v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) := by
            push_neg at hzP hzL
            linarith
          have hzt : z ∉ tsupport (h i) := fun hzt =>
            Set.disjoint_left.mp hFK hzF ((hsupp i z (hhs i hzt)).2.2.mpr heq)
          exact pd_zero _ _ _ (ev_zero (S i) (h i) z hzt)
    have hoffF : ∀ z, z ∉ F →
        {z : E3 | v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)}.indicator
          (fun z => α i * partialDeriv (a i) (h i) z) z +
        {z : E3 | z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)}.indicator
          (fun z => β i * partialDeriv (a i) (h i) z) z = 0 := by
      intro z hzF
      have h1 : {z : E3 | v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)}.indicator
          (fun z => α i * partialDeriv (a i) (h i) z) z = 0 := by
        by_cases hα : α i = 0
        · simp [hα]
        · by_cases hzP : v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)
          · have hzt : z ∉ tsupport (h i) := by
              intro hzt
              have hc := (hχ i).2.2.2.2 (hhs i hzt)
              exact hzF (hα0 i hα z hc.1 hc.2 hzP)
            rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show z ∈ {z : E3 | v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)} from hzP),
              hp0 i z hzt, mul_zero]
          · exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (show z ∉ {z : E3 | v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)} from hzP) _
      have h2 : {z : E3 | z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)}.indicator
          (fun z => β i * partialDeriv (a i) (h i) z) z = 0 := by
        by_cases hβ : β i = 0
        · simp [hβ]
        · by_cases hzL : z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)
          · have hzt : z ∉ tsupport (h i) := by
              intro hzt
              have hc := (hχ i).2.2.2.2 (hhs i hzt)
              exact hzF (hβ0 i hβ z hc.1 hc.2 hzL)
            rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show z ∈ {z : E3 | z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)} from hzL),
              hp0 i z hzt, mul_zero]
          · exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (show z ∉ {z : E3 | z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)} from hzL) _
      rw [h1, h2, add_zero]
    have hint : ∫ y in F, partialDeriv (a i) (fun z => S i z * h i z) y =
        α i * (∫ z in {z : E3 | v i (smthHoriz (a i) z) < z (a i)}, partialDeriv (a i) (h i) z) +
        β i * (∫ z in {z : E3 | z (a i) < v i (smthHoriz (a i) z)}, partialDeriv (a i) (h i) z) := by
      rw [setIntegral_congr_fun hF.measurableSet hDF,
        setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hoffF,
        integral_add (((hpi i).const_mul (α i)).indicator hPm)
          (((hpi i).const_mul (β i)).indicator hLm),
        integral_indicator hPm, integral_indicator hLm, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    have hIm : m * (volume (Q i)).toReal ≤ ∫ x, h i (smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) := by
      have hgc : Continuous (fun x => h i (smthLift (a i) x (v i x))) :=
        (hh i).continuous.comp (gamC (a i) (v i) (hv i))
      have hgcs : HasCompactSupport (fun x => h i (smthLift (a i) x (v i x))) := by
        refine HasCompactSupport.intro (IsCompact.image (hhc i) (horizC (a i))) ?_
        intro x hx
        by_contra hne
        exact hx ⟨_, subset_tsupport _ hne, liftH (a i) x (v i x)⟩
      have hgi : Integrable (fun x => h i (smthLift (a i) x (v i x))) :=
        hgc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hgcs
      have hQm := (hQ i).1.measurableSet
      calc m * (volume (Q i)).toReal = ∫ x in Q i, m := by
            rw [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, Measure.real, mul_comm]
        _ ≤ ∫ x in Q i, h i (smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) := by
          refine setIntegral_mono_on ?_ hgi.integrableOn hQm ?_
          · exact continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact (hQ i).1
          · intro x hx
            have hγ : smthLift (a i) x (v i x) ∈ N := by
              have hmem : smthLift (a i) x (v i x) ∈ {z : E3 | smthHoriz (a i) z ∈
                  smthDisc (a i) (c i) (r i) ∧ |z (a i) - c i (a i)| < δ i} := by
                refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
                · rw [liftH]
                  exact (hQ i).2 hx
                · rw [liftA]
                  exact hvin i x ((hQ i).2 hx)
              exact (hcyl i hmem).2
            simp only [hhdef]
            rw [(hχ i).2.2.1 x hx, one_mul]
            exact hGm _ hγ
        _ ≤ ∫ x, h i (smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) :=
          setIntegral_le_integral hgi (ae_of_all _ fun x => hh0 i _)
    have hI0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, h i (smthLift (a i) x (v i x)) := integral_nonneg (fun x => hh0 i _)
    rw [hint, hf1, hf2]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 (hβα i)) hI0, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hIm hlam0.le]
  
  have htot : ∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G X y =
      ∑ i, ∫ y in F, partialDeriv (a i) (fun z => S i z * h i z) y := by
    simp_rw [hdiv]
    exact integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hDi i).integrableOn)
  have hmain : m / Real.sqrt Γ * ∑ i, (volume (Q i)).toReal ≤ ∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G X y := by
    rw [htot, ← hlamm, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hflux i
  have hENN : ENNReal.ofReal (m / Real.sqrt Γ) * ∑ i, volume (Q i) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (m / Real.sqrt Γ * ∑ i, (volume (Q i)).toReal) := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (div_nonneg hm.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)),
      ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i _ => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal ((hQ i).1.measure_lt_top.ne)).symm)
  rw [hENN]
  refine (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hmain).trans ?_
  unfold hullPerG
  exact le_iSup₂_of_le X ⟨hA1, hA2a, hA2b, hA3, hA4⟩ le_rfl

informal_problem.statement: (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (f : ι → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, smthHolC 0 (f i) S) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ S) : ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (B C α : NNReal), 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ 0 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧ Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ S ∧ ∀ i, HolderOnWith C α (f i) (Metric.ball x₀ ρ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, |f i x| ≤ (B : ℝ)

signature.statement: (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (f : ι → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, smthHolC 0 (f i) S) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ S) : ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (B C α : NNReal), 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ 0 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧ Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ S ∧ ∀ i, HolderOnWith C α (f i) (Metric.ball x₀ ρ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, |f i x| ≤ (B : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεS⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hS x₀ hx₀
  choose ρ' C' α' hρ' hα' hball' hHol' using fun i => (hf i).2 x₀ hx₀
  have lower : ∀ (r : ι → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → (∀ i, 0 < r i) →
      ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t < c ∧ ∀ i, t ≤ r i := by
    intro r c hc hr
    have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ j, 1 / r j := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => (one_div_pos.mpr (hr j)).le)
    have hc1 : 0 < 1 / c := one_div_pos.mpr hc
    refine ⟨1 / (1 / c + ∑ j, 1 / r j + 1), one_div_pos.mpr (by linarith), ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc 1 / (1 / c + ∑ j, 1 / r j + 1) < 1 / (1 / c) :=
            one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt hc1 (by linarith)
        _ = c := one_div_one_div c
    · intro i
      have hi : 1 / r i ≤ ∑ j, 1 / r j :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => 1 / r j)
          (fun j _ => (one_div_pos.mpr (hr j)).le) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      calc 1 / (1 / c + ∑ j, 1 / r j + 1) ≤ 1 / (1 / r i) :=
            one_div_le_one_div_of_le (one_div_pos.mpr (hr i)) (by linarith)
        _ = r i := one_div_one_div (r i)
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ0, hρlt, hρle⟩ := lower ρ' (min (1 / 4) ε) (lt_min (by norm_num) hε) hρ'
  obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha1, hale⟩ :=
    lower (fun i => (α' i : ℝ)) 1 one_pos (fun i => NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (hα' i))
  have hρ4 : ρ ≤ 1 / 4 := (lt_of_lt_of_le hρlt (min_le_left _ _)).le
  have hρε : ρ ≤ ε := (lt_of_lt_of_le hρlt (min_le_right _ _)).le
  obtain ⟨α, hαdef⟩ : ∃ α : NNReal, α = Real.toNNReal a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hαa : (α : ℝ) = a := by rw [hαdef]; exact Real.coe_toNNReal a ha0.le
  have hαle : ∀ i, α ≤ α' i := fun i => by
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, hαa]; exact hale i
  refine ⟨ρ, ∑ i, (‖f i x₀‖₊ + C' i), ∑ i, C' i, α, hρ0, hρ4, ?_, ?_,
    (Metric.ball_subset_ball hρε).trans hεS, ?_⟩
  · rw [← NNReal.coe_pos, hαa]; exact ha0
  · rw [← NNReal.coe_lt_coe, hαa, NNReal.coe_one]; exact ha1
  · intro i
    have hCi : C' i ≤ ∑ j, C' j :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := C') (fun j _ => zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hBeq : ((∑ j, (‖f j x₀‖₊ + C' j) : NNReal) : ℝ) = ∑ j, (|f j x₀| + (C' j : ℝ)) := by
      rw [NNReal.coe_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [NNReal.coe_add, coe_nnnorm, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hBi : |f i x₀| + (C' i : ℝ) ≤ ((∑ j, (‖f j x₀‖₊ + C' j) : NNReal) : ℝ) := by
      rw [hBeq]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |f j x₀| + (C' j : ℝ))
        (fun j _ => add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (NNReal.coe_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hf' : HolderOnWith (C' i) (α' i) (f i) (Metric.ball x₀ ρ) :=
      (hHol' i).mono (Metric.ball_subset_ball (hρle i))
    have hdiam : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ,
        edist x y ≤ ((1 : NNReal) : ENNReal) := by
      intro x hx y hy
      rw [edist_dist, ENNReal.coe_one, ENNReal.ofReal_le_one]
      have h1 := dist_triangle_right x y x₀
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx hy
      linarith
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h := HolderOnWith.of_le hdiam hf' (hαle i)
      rw [NNReal.one_rpow, mul_one] at h
      exact h.mono_const hCi
    · intro x hx
      have hx0 : x₀ ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ := Metric.mem_ball_self hρ0
      have hd : dist x x₀ ≤ 1 := by rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx; linarith
      have h := hf'.dist_le_of_le hx hx0 hd
      rw [Real.one_rpow, mul_one, Real.dist_eq] at h
      have h2 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (f i x) (f i x₀)
      linarith

informal_problem.statement: (K : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x i j) K) (hell : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j) : ∃ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j

signature.name: smth_unif_ellipticity
signature.statement: (K : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hK : IsCompact K) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x i j) K) (hell : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j) : ∃ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j

proof.tactics:
by
  rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty K with hKe | hKne
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [hKe] at hx
    exact absurd hx (Set.notMem_empty x)
  set S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ) := Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) 1 with hSdef
  have hS : IsCompact S := isCompact_sphere 0 1
  have hP : IsCompact (K ×ˢ S) := hK.prod hS
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ := hKne
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁⟩ : S.Nonempty := NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.mpr zero_le_one
  have hPne : (K ×ˢ S).Nonempty := ⟨(x₁, η₁), Set.mk_mem_prod hx₁ hη₁⟩
  have hcont : ContinuousOn
      (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → ℝ) =>
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a p.1 i j * p.2 i * p.2 j) (K ×ˢ S) := by
    have hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => a p.1 i j)
        (K ×ˢ S) := fun i j =>
      (ha i j).comp continuousOn_fst (fun p hp => (Set.mem_prod.mp hp).1)
    have hC : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => p.2 i)
        (K ×ˢ S) := fun i => ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_)
    exact ((hA i j).mul (hC i)).mul (hC j)
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hmin⟩ := hP.exists_isMinOn hPne hcont
  set m : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a p₀.1 i j * p₀.2 i * p₀.2 j with hmdef
  have hmin' : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ η ∈ S, m ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * η i * η j := by
    intro x hx η hη
    exact (isMinOn_iff.mp hmin) (x, η) (Set.mk_mem_prod hx hη)
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    obtain ⟨hx₀, hη₀⟩ := Set.mem_prod.mp hp₀
    have hn : ‖p₀.2‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hη₀
    have hne : p₀.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, norm_zero] at hn
      exact zero_ne_one hn
    exact hell p₀.1 hx₀ p₀.2 hne
  refine ⟨m / 2, half_pos hm, ?_⟩
  intro x hx ξ
  by_cases hξ : ξ = 0
  · subst hξ
    simp
  have hr : 0 < ‖ξ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hξ
  set r : ℝ := ‖ξ‖ with hrdef
  set η : Fin 2 → ℝ := r⁻¹ • ξ with hηdef
  have hηn : ‖η‖ = 1 := by
    rw [hηdef, norm_smul, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne']
  have hηS : η ∈ S := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr hηn
  have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 2, ξ i = r * η i := by
    intro i
    rw [hηdef, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_mul]
  have hhom : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j =
      r ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * η i * η j := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hcoord 0, hcoord 1]
    ring
  have hbd : ∀ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    have h1 : |ξ i| ≤ r := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm ξ i
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have h2 : 0 ≤ |ξ i| := abs_nonneg _
    rw [← sq_abs]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ h2 h1 2
  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ 2 * r ^ 2 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    linarith [hbd 0, hbd 1]
  have hmq := hmin' x hx η hηS
  rw [hhom]
  have hr2 : 0 ≤ r ^ 2 := sq_nonneg r
  calc m / 2 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ m / 2 * (2 * r ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by linarith)
    _ = r ^ 2 * m := by ring
    _ ≤ r ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * η i * η j :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmq hr2

informal_problem.statement: (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x i j) S) (hF : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => F x i) S) (hwd : ∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ w x) (hwg : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad w x j) S) (heq : smthLinSol a F w S) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R) ⊆ S) (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < |h|) (hhR : |h| < R) : smthLinSol (fun x => a (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) (fun x i => smthDQ (fun y => F y i) m h x - ∑ j : Fin 2, smthDQ (fun y => a y i j) m h x * smthGrad w x j) (smthDQ w m h) (Metric.ball x₀ R)

signature.name: smth_lin_dq_eq
signature.statement: (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x i j) S) (hF : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => F x i) S) (hwd : ∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ w x) (hwg : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad w x j) S) (heq : smthLinSol a F w S) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R) ⊆ S) (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < |h|) (hhR : |h| < R) : smthLinSol (fun x => a (x + h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) (fun x i => smthDQ (fun y => F y i) m h x - ∑ j : Fin 2, smthDQ (fun y => a y i j) m h x * smthGrad w x j) (smthDQ w m h) (Metric.ball x₀ R)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro φ hφ hφc hφB
  generalize hτ : h • (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) = τ
  have hdq : ∀ (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ), smthDQ u m h x = (u (x + τ) - u x) / h := by
    intro u x; rw [← hτ]; rfl
  have hv : ‖τ‖ = |h| := by
    rw [← hτ, norm_smul, Pi.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hBS : Metric.ball x₀ R ⊆ S := (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
  have hshift : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R, x + τ ∈ S := by
    intro x hx
    apply hball
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx ⊢
    have h1 : dist (x + τ) x = |h| := by rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, hv]
    have h2 := dist_triangle (x + τ) x x₀
    linarith
  have hφS : tsupport φ ⊆ S := hφB.trans hBS
  
  have hdcont : ∀ i : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad φ x i) := by
    intro i
    simp only [smthGrad]
    exact (hφ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hdsupp : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport φ → smthGrad φ x i = 0 := by
    intro i x hx
    have hx' : x ∉ tsupport (fderiv ℝ φ) := fun h' => hx (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ h')
    have h0 : fderiv ℝ φ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx'
    simp [smthGrad, h0]
  
  have hint : ∀ g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContinuousOn g (Metric.ball x₀ R) → ∀ i : Fin 2,
      Integrable (fun x => g x * smthGrad φ x i) := by
    intro g hg i
    have hsub : tsupport (fun x => g x * smthGrad φ x i) ⊆ tsupport φ := by
      refine closure_minimal ?_ (isClosed_tsupport φ)
      intro x hx
      by_contra hx'
      apply hx
      simp only [hdsupp i x hx', mul_zero]
    have hc : Continuous (fun x => g x * smthGrad φ x i) :=
      (hg.mul (hdcont i).continuousOn).continuous_of_tsupport_subset Metric.isOpen_ball
        (hsub.trans hφB)
    exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset hφc (isClosed_tsupport _) hsub)
  
  have hcomp : ∀ g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContinuousOn g S →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => g (x + τ)) (Metric.ball x₀ R) :=
    fun g hg => hg.comp (continuous_add_right τ).continuousOn hshift
  have hdqc : ∀ g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContinuousOn g S →
      ContinuousOn (smthDQ g m h) (Metric.ball x₀ R) := by
    intro g hg
    have e : smthDQ g m h = fun x => (g (x + τ) - g x) / h := funext (hdq g)
    rw [e]
    exact ((hcomp g hg).sub (hg.mono hBS)).div_const h
  
  have hgdq : ∀ x, DifferentiableAt ℝ w x → DifferentiableAt ℝ w (x + τ) → ∀ j : Fin 2,
      smthGrad (smthDQ w m h) x j = (smthGrad w (x + τ) j - smthGrad w x j) / h := by
    intro x hx hxh j
    have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Fin 2 → ℝ => y + τ)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ)) x := (hasFDerivAt_id x).add_const _
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => w (y + τ)) (fderiv ℝ w (x + τ)) x := by
      have := hxh.hasFDerivAt.comp x h0
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (w (y + τ) - w y) * h⁻¹)
        (h⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ w (x + τ) - fderiv ℝ w x)) x :=
      (h1.sub hx.hasFDerivAt).mul_const h⁻¹
    have h3 : smthDQ w m h = fun y => (w (y + τ) - w y) * h⁻¹ := by
      funext y; rw [hdq, div_eq_mul_inv]
    simp only [smthGrad]
    rw [h3, h2.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨P1, hP1⟩ : ∃ P1 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, P1 = fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      a (x + τ) i j * smthGrad w (x + τ) j * smthGrad φ x i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P0, hP0⟩ : ∃ P0 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, P0 = fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      a x i j * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad φ x i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨R1, hR1⟩ : ∃ R1 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, R1 = fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2,
      F (x + τ) i * smthGrad φ x i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨R0, hR0⟩ : ∃ R0 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, R0 = fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2,
      F x i * smthGrad φ x i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Q = fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      smthDQ (fun y => a y i j) m h x * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad φ x i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have iP1 : Integrable P1 := by
    rw [hP1]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ =>
      hint _ ((hcomp _ (ha i j)).mul (hcomp _ (hwg j))) i))
  have iP0 : Integrable P0 := by
    rw [hP0]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ =>
      hint _ (((ha i j).mono hBS).mul ((hwg j).mono hBS)) i))
  have iR1 : Integrable R1 := by
    rw [hR1]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hint _ (hcomp _ (hF i)) i)
  have iR0 : Integrable R0 := by
    rw [hR0]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hint _ ((hF i).mono hBS) i)
  have iQ : Integrable Q := by
    rw [hQ]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ =>
      hint _ ((hdqc _ (ha i j)).mul ((hwg j).mono hBS)) i))
  
  have hP0R0 : (∫ x, P0 x) = ∫ x, R0 x := by
    rw [hP0, hR0]; exact heq φ hφ hφc hφS
  
  have hP1R1 : (∫ x, P1 x) = ∫ x, R1 x := by
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => φ (y + -τ)) := hφ.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
    have hψc : HasCompactSupport (fun y => φ (y + -τ)) :=
      hφc.comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.addRight (-τ))
    have hψS : tsupport (fun y => φ (y + -τ)) ⊆ S := by
      intro y hy
      have hy' : y ∈ (Homeomorph.addRight (-τ)) ⁻¹' tsupport φ := by
        rw [← tsupport_comp_eq_preimage]; exact hy
      have hy'' : y + -τ ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R := hφB hy'
      have := hshift _ hy''
      rwa [neg_add_cancel_right] at this
    have hgψ : ∀ y i, smthGrad (fun y => φ (y + -τ)) y i = smthGrad φ (y + -τ) i := by
      intro y i
      simp only [smthGrad]
      rw [fderiv_comp_add_right]
    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, G = fun y => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
        a y i j * smthGrad w y j * smthGrad φ (y + -τ) i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, H = fun y => ∑ i : Fin 2,
        F y i * smthGrad φ (y + -τ) i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have key : (∫ y, G y) = ∫ y, H y := by
      have := heq _ hψ hψc hψS
      simp only [hgψ] at this
      rw [hG, hH]; exact this
    have e1 : (∫ x, P1 x) = ∫ x, G (x + τ) := by
      congr 1; funext x; rw [hP1, hG]; simp only [add_neg_cancel_right]
    have e2 : (∫ x, R1 x) = ∫ x, H (x + τ) := by
      congr 1; funext x; rw [hR1, hH]; simp only [add_neg_cancel_right]
    rw [e1, e2, integral_add_right_eq_self G τ, integral_add_right_eq_self H τ]
    exact key
  
  have hL : ∀ x, (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      a (x + τ) i j * smthGrad (smthDQ w m h) x j * smthGrad φ x i) =
      (P1 x - P0 x) / h - Q x := by
    intro x
    rw [hP1, hP0, hQ]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R
    · have hxS := hBS hx
      have g0 := hgdq x (hwd x hxS) (hwd _ (hshift x hx)) 0
      have g1 := hgdq x (hwd x hxS) (hwd _ (hshift x hx)) 1
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, g0, g1, hdq]
      ring
    · have hx' : x ∉ tsupport φ := fun h' => hx (hφB h')
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hdsupp 0 x hx', hdsupp 1 x hx', mul_zero]
      ring
  have hRt : ∀ x, (∑ i : Fin 2, (smthDQ (fun y => F y i) m h x -
      ∑ j : Fin 2, smthDQ (fun y => a y i j) m h x * smthGrad w x j) * smthGrad φ x i) =
      (R1 x - R0 x) / h - Q x := by
    intro x
    rw [hR1, hR0, hQ]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hdq]
    ring
  show (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      a (x + τ) i j * smthGrad (smthDQ w m h) x j * smthGrad φ x i) =
    ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, (smthDQ (fun y => F y i) m h x -
      ∑ j : Fin 2, smthDQ (fun y => a y i j) m h x * smthGrad w x j) * smthGrad φ x i
  have eL : (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      a (x + τ) i j * smthGrad (smthDQ w m h) x j * smthGrad φ x i) =
      ∫ x, ((P1 x - P0 x) / h - Q x) := by
    congr 1; funext x; exact hL x
  have eR : (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, (smthDQ (fun y => F y i) m h x -
      ∑ j : Fin 2, smthDQ (fun y => a y i j) m h x * smthGrad w x j) * smthGrad φ x i) =
      ∫ x, ((R1 x - R0 x) / h - Q x) := by
    congr 1; funext x; exact hRt x
  have i1 : Integrable (fun x => (P1 x - P0 x) / h) := (iP1.sub iP0).div_const h
  have i2 : Integrable (fun x => (R1 x - R0 x) / h) := (iR1.sub iR0).div_const h
  rw [eL, eR, integral_sub i1 iQ, integral_sub i2 iQ, integral_div, integral_div,
    integral_sub iP1 iP0, integral_sub iR1 iR0, hP1R1, hP0R0]

informal_problem.statement: (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (R : ℝ) (m : Fin 2) (B C α : NNReal) (hR : 0 < R) (hd : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hB : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |smthGrad f x m| ≤ (B : ℝ)) (hH : HolderOnWith C α (fun x => smthGrad f x m) (Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R))) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < |h|) (hhR : |h| < R) : (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R, |smthDQ f m h x| ≤ (B : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith C α (smthDQ f m h) (Metric.ball x₀ R)

signature.name: smth_dq_mvt_bounds
signature.statement: (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (R : ℝ) (m : Fin 2) (B C α : NNReal) (hR : 0 < R) (hd : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) (hB : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |smthGrad f x m| ≤ (B : ℝ)) (hH : HolderOnWith C α (fun x => smthGrad f x m) (Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R))) (h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < |h|) (hhR : |h| < R) : (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R, |smthDQ f m h x| ≤ (B : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith C α (smthDQ f m h) (Metric.ball x₀ R)

proof.tactics:
by
  set e : Fin 2 → ℝ := Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) with he
  have hh0 : h ≠ 0 := abs_pos.mp hh
  have hen : ‖e‖ = 1 := by rw [he, Pi.norm_single, norm_one]
  have hseg : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      x + (t * h) • e ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R) := by
    intro x hx t ht
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx ⊢
    have h1 : ‖(t * h) • e‖ ≤ |h| := by
      rw [norm_smul, hen, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
      calc t * |h| ≤ 1 * |h| := by gcongr; exact ht.2
        _ = |h| := one_mul _
    calc dist (x + (t * h) • e) x₀ ≤ dist (x + (t * h) • e) x + dist x x₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = ‖(t * h) • e‖ + dist x x₀ := by rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
      _ < 2 * R := by linarith
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (x + (s * h) • e)) (h * smthGrad f (x + (t * h) • e) m) t := by
    intro x hx t ht
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x + (s * h) • e) (h • e) t := by
      have h2 := ((hasDerivAt_id t).mul_const h).smul_const e
      simp only [id, one_mul] at h2
      exact h2.const_add x
    have hf := (hd _ (hseg x hx t ht)).hasFDerivAt
    refine (hf.comp_hasDerivAt t hγ).congr_deriv ?_
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hτeq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun s : ℝ => f (x + (s * h) • e))
      (fun t => h * smthGrad f (x + (t * h) • e) m) zero_lt_one
      (fun t ht => (hderiv x hx t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t ht => hderiv x hx t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht))
    have hτ' := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hτ
    simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, zero_smul, add_zero, sub_zero, div_one] at hτeq
    have hdq : smthDQ f m h x = smthGrad f (x + (τ * h) • e) m := by
      show (f (x + h • e) - f x) / h = _
      rw [← hτeq]
      field_simp
    rw [hdq]
    exact hB _ (hseg x hx τ hτ')
  · intro x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hτeq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope
      (fun s : ℝ => f (x + (s * h) • e) - f (y + (s * h) • e))
      (fun t => h * smthGrad f (x + (t * h) • e) m - h * smthGrad f (y + (t * h) • e) m)
      zero_lt_one
      (fun t ht => ((hderiv x hx t ht).sub (hderiv y hy t ht)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t ht => (hderiv x hx t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).sub
        (hderiv y hy t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)))
    have hτ' := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hτ
    simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, zero_smul, add_zero, sub_zero, div_one] at hτeq
    have hdq : smthDQ f m h x - smthDQ f m h y =
        smthGrad f (x + (τ * h) • e) m - smthGrad f (y + (τ * h) • e) m := by
      show (f (x + h • e) - f x) / h - (f (y + h • e) - f y) / h = _
      rw [div_sub_div_same, show f (x + h • e) - f x - (f (y + h • e) - f y) =
        f (x + h • e) - f (y + h • e) - (f x - f y) by ring, ← hτeq, ← mul_sub]
      field_simp
    have hp := hseg x hx τ hτ'
    have hq := hseg y hy τ hτ'
    calc edist (smthDQ f m h x) (smthDQ f m h y)
        = edist (smthGrad f (x + (τ * h) • e) m) (smthGrad f (y + (τ * h) • e) m) := by
          rw [edist_dist, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, hdq]
      _ ≤ C * edist (x + (τ * h) • e) (y + (τ * h) • e) ^ (α : ℝ) := hH _ hp _ hq
      _ = C * edist x y ^ (α : ℝ) := by rw [edist_add_right]

informal_problem.statement: (α : NNReal) (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (R K L : ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w (Metric.ball y R)) (hK : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y R, |w x| ≤ K) (hwt : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y R, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y R, (min (R - dist x y) (R - dist z y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * ‖smthGrad w x - smthGrad w z‖ ≤ L * dist x z ^ (α : ℝ)) : (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y R, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p ((R - dist p y) / 2), ∀ q' ∈ Metric.ball p ((R - dist p y) / 2), ‖smthGrad w q - smthGrad w q'‖ ≤ L * (2 / (R - dist p y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * dist q q' ^ (α : ℝ)) ∧ (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y R, ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 → ‖smthGrad w p‖ ≤ 4 * K / (τ * (R - dist p y)) + 2 * L * τ ^ (α : ℝ) / (R - dist p y))

signature.name: smth_sch_weighted_interp
signature.statement: (α : NNReal) (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (R K L : ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w (Metric.ball y R)) (hK : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y R, |w x| ≤ K) (hwt : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y R, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y R, (min (R - dist x y) (R - dist z y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * ‖smthGrad w x - smthGrad w z‖ ≤ L * dist x z ^ (α : ℝ)) : (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y R, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p ((R - dist p y) / 2), ∀ q' ∈ Metric.ball p ((R - dist p y) / 2), ‖smthGrad w q - smthGrad w q'‖ ≤ L * (2 / (R - dist p y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * dist q q' ^ (α : ℝ)) ∧ (∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y R, ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ < 1 → ‖smthGrad w p‖ ≤ 4 * K / (τ * (R - dist p y)) + 2 * L * τ ^ (α : ℝ) / (R - dist p y))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hα0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (α : ℝ) := α.2
  have hα1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + (α : ℝ) := by linarith
  have part1 : ∀ p ∈ Metric.ball y R, ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball p ((R - dist p y) / 2),
      ∀ q' ∈ Metric.ball p ((R - dist p y) / 2),
      ‖smthGrad w q - smthGrad w q'‖ ≤
        L * (2 / (R - dist p y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * dist q q' ^ (α : ℝ) := by
    intro p hp q hq q' hq'
    have hpd : 0 < R - dist p y := by have := Metric.mem_ball.1 hp; linarith
    have hqd : (R - dist p y) / 2 < R - dist q y := by
      have h1 := Metric.mem_ball.1 hq
      have h2 := dist_triangle q p y
      linarith
    have hq'd : (R - dist p y) / 2 < R - dist q' y := by
      have h1 := Metric.mem_ball.1 hq'
      have h2 := dist_triangle q' p y
      linarith
    have hqb : q ∈ Metric.ball y R := by rw [Metric.mem_ball]; linarith
    have hq'b : q' ∈ Metric.ball y R := by rw [Metric.mem_ball]; linarith
    have hm : (R - dist p y) / 2 ≤ min (R - dist q y) (R - dist q' y) := le_min hqd.le hq'd.le
    have hd2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (R - dist p y) / 2 := by linarith
    have hmα : ((R - dist p y) / 2) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) ≤
        (min (R - dist q y) (R - dist q' y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow hd2 hm hα1
    have h2 : ((R - dist p y) / 2) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * ‖smthGrad w q - smthGrad w q'‖ ≤
        L * dist q q' ^ (α : ℝ) :=
      le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmα (norm_nonneg _)) (hwt q hqb q' hq'b)
    have hdinv : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 / (R - dist p y) := div_nonneg (by norm_num) hpd.le
    have e1 : (2 / (R - dist p y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * ((R - dist p y) / 2) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.mul_rpow hdinv hd2]
      rw [show 2 / (R - dist p y) * ((R - dist p y) / 2) = 1 by field_simp, Real.one_rpow]
    have hpow0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (2 / (R - dist p y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hdinv _
    calc ‖smthGrad w q - smthGrad w q'‖
        = (2 / (R - dist p y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) *
            (((R - dist p y) / 2) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * ‖smthGrad w q - smthGrad w q'‖) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, e1, one_mul]
      _ ≤ (2 / (R - dist p y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * (L * dist q q' ^ (α : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hpow0
      _ = L * (2 / (R - dist p y)) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * dist q q' ^ (α : ℝ) := by ring
  refine ⟨part1, ?_⟩
  intro p hp τ hτ0 hτ1
  have hpd : 0 < R - dist p y := by have := Metric.mem_ball.1 hp; linarith
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : ℝ, d = R - dist p y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hd] at hpd ⊢
  have hdne : d ≠ 0 := hpd.ne'
  have hτne : τ ≠ 0 := hτ0.ne'
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hK p hp)
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ : ∃ h : ℝ, h = τ * d / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hh0 : 0 < h := by rw [hh]; positivity
  have hhd : h < d / 2 := by rw [hh]; nlinarith
  have hb : 0 ≤ 4 * K / (τ * d) + 2 * L * τ ^ (α : ℝ) / d := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ 4 * K / (τ * d) := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by positivity)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ 2 * L * τ ^ (α : ℝ) / d :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (Real.rpow_nonneg hτ0.le _)) hpd.le
    linarith
  refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hb).2 (fun k => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : Fin 2 → ℝ, v = Pi.single k (1 : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hvn : ‖v‖ = 1 := by rw [hv, Pi.norm_single, norm_one]
  have hdist : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → dist (p + t • v) p = t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hvn, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht,
      mul_one]
  have hseg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) h, p + t • v ∈ Metric.ball p ((R - dist p y) / 2) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, hdist t ht.1, ← hd]
    linarith [ht.2]
  have hpb : p ∈ Metric.ball p ((R - dist p y) / 2) := Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith)
  have hsegR : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) h, p + t • v ∈ Metric.ball y R := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    have h1 := dist_triangle (p + t • v) p y
    rw [hdist t ht.1] at h1
    linarith [ht.2]
  have hdiff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) h, DifferentiableAt ℝ w (p + t • v) := by
    intro t ht
    exact (hw.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hsegR t ht))
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = L * (2 / d) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) * h ^ (α : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hdinv : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 / d := div_nonneg (by norm_num) hpd.le
  have hosc : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) h,
      |smthGrad w (p + t • v) k - smthGrad w p k| ≤ B := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 := part1 p hp (p + t • v) (hseg t ht) p hpb
    rw [hdist t ht.1, ← hd] at h1
    have h2 : t ^ (α : ℝ) ≤ h ^ (α : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow ht.1 ht.2 hα0
    have h3 : |smthGrad w (p + t • v) k - smthGrad w p k| ≤
        ‖smthGrad w (p + t • v) - smthGrad w p‖ := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (smthGrad w (p + t • v) - smthGrad w p) k
      rwa [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    rw [hB]
    refine le_trans h3 (le_trans h1 ?_)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (mul_nonneg hL (Real.rpow_nonneg hdinv _))
  have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) h,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun t => w (p + t • v) - t * smthGrad w p k)
        (smthGrad w (p + t • v) k - smthGrad w p k) (Set.Icc 0 h) t := by
    intro t ht
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => p + t • v) v t := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const v).const_add p
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun t => w (p + t • v)) (fderiv ℝ w (p + t • v) v) t :=
      (hdiff t ht).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hl
    have hc' : fderiv ℝ w (p + t • v) v = smthGrad w (p + t • v) k := by
      rw [hv]; rfl
    rw [← hc']
    exact (hc.sub (hasDerivAt_mul_const (smthGrad w p k))).hasDerivWithinAt
  have hmvt : ‖(w (p + h • v) - h * smthGrad w p k) - (w (p + (0 : ℝ) • v) - 0 * smthGrad w p k)‖
      ≤ B * (h - 0) :=
    norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment' hderiv
      (fun t ht => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hosc t (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self ht))
      h ⟨hh0.le, le_rfl⟩
  simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt
  have hw2 : |w (p + h • v) - w p| ≤ 2 * K := by
    have a1 := abs_le.1 (hK _ (hsegR h ⟨hh0.le, le_rfl⟩))
    have a2 := abs_le.1 (hK p hp)
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hkey : h * |smthGrad w p k| ≤ 2 * K + B * h := by
    have e : h * |smthGrad w p k| = |h * smthGrad w p k| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hh0]
    rw [e]
    have a1 := abs_le.1 hmvt
    have a2 := abs_le.1 hw2
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hB' : B = 2 * L * τ ^ (α : ℝ) / d := by
    rw [hB, hh, Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 / d), Real.rpow_one]
    have e2 : (2 / d) ^ (α : ℝ) * (τ * d / 2) ^ (α : ℝ) = τ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.mul_rpow hdinv (by positivity)]
      congr 1
      field_simp
    calc L * (2 / d * (2 / d) ^ (α : ℝ)) * (τ * d / 2) ^ (α : ℝ)
        = L * (2 / d) * ((2 / d) ^ (α : ℝ) * (τ * d / 2) ^ (α : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ = 2 * L * τ ^ (α : ℝ) / d := by rw [e2]; field_simp
  have hfin : |smthGrad w p k| ≤ (2 * K + B * h) / h := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hh0]; linarith
  refine le_trans hfin (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [hB', hh]
  field_simp
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (ha : ContinuousOn a S) (hF : ContinuousOn F S) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w S) (hsol : smthLinSol a F w S) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (ρ κ T : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hT : 0 < T) (hsub : Metric.ball x₀ (ρ * T) ⊆ S) (W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hW : ∀ ζ, W ζ = (w (x₀ + ρ • ζ) - w x₀ - ρ * ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad w x₀ j * ζ j) / (ρ * κ)) (G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hG : ∀ ζ i, G ζ i = (F (x₀ + ρ • ζ) i - F x₀ i - ∑ j : Fin 2, (a (x₀ + ρ • ζ) i j - a x₀ i j) * smthGrad w x₀ j) / κ) : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 W (Metric.ball 0 T) ∧ (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ j : Fin 2, smthGrad W ζ j = (smthGrad w (x₀ + ρ • ζ) j - smthGrad w x₀ j) / κ) ∧ smthLinSol (fun ζ => a (x₀ + ρ • ζ)) G W (Metric.ball 0 T)

signature.name: smth_sch_blowup_eq
signature.statement: (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : IsOpen S) (ha : ContinuousOn a S) (hF : ContinuousOn F S) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w S) (hsol : smthLinSol a F w S) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (ρ κ T : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hT : 0 < T) (hsub : Metric.ball x₀ (ρ * T) ⊆ S) (W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hW : ∀ ζ, W ζ = (w (x₀ + ρ • ζ) - w x₀ - ρ * ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad w x₀ j * ζ j) / (ρ * κ)) (G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hG : ∀ ζ i, G ζ i = (F (x₀ + ρ • ζ) i - F x₀ i - ∑ j : Fin 2, (a (x₀ + ρ • ζ) i j - a x₀ i j) * smthGrad w x₀ j) / κ) : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 W (Metric.ball 0 T) ∧ (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ j : Fin 2, smthGrad W ζ j = (smthGrad w (x₀ + ρ • ζ) j - smthGrad w x₀ j) / κ) ∧ smthLinSol (fun ζ => a (x₀ + ρ • ζ)) G W (Metric.ball 0 T)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hρ0 : ρ ≠ 0 := hρ.ne'
  have hκ0 : κ ≠ 0 := hκ.ne'
  
  have hA : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, x₀ + ρ • ζ ∈ S := by
    intro ζ hζ
    apply hsub
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hζ
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hρ.le]
    exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hζ hρ
  
  have hWC : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 W (Metric.ball 0 T) := by
    have hWfun : W = fun ζ => (w (x₀ + ρ • ζ) - w x₀ - ρ * ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad w x₀ j * ζ j)
        / (ρ * κ) := funext hW
    rw [hWfun]
    have hAcd : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ => x₀ + ρ • ζ) := by fun_prop
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ => w (x₀ + ρ • ζ)) (Metric.ball 0 T) :=
      hw.comp hAcd.contDiffOn (fun ζ hζ => hA ζ hζ)
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ => ρ * ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad w x₀ j * ζ j) := by
      fun_prop
    exact ((h1.sub contDiffOn_const).sub h2.contDiffOn).div_const _
  
  have hWg : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ j : Fin 2,
      smthGrad W ζ j = (smthGrad w (x₀ + ρ • ζ) j - smthGrad w x₀ j) / κ := by
    intro ζ hζ j
    have hdw : DifferentiableAt ℝ w (x₀ + ρ • ζ) :=
      (hw.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt (hS.mem_nhds (hA ζ hζ))
    have hAd : HasFDerivAt (fun ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ => x₀ + ρ • ζ)
        (ρ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ζ :=
      ((hasFDerivAt_id ζ).const_smul ρ).const_add x₀
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ => w (x₀ + ρ • ζ))
        ((fderiv ℝ w (x₀ + ρ • ζ)).comp (ρ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ))) ζ :=
      hdw.hasFDerivAt.comp ζ hAd
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ => ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad w x₀ k * ζ k)
        (∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad w x₀ k •
          (ContinuousLinearMap.proj k : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) ζ := by
      have := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun k (ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ) => smthGrad w x₀ k * ζ k)
        (A' := fun k => smthGrad w x₀ k • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj k : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ))
        (x := ζ) (fun k _ => (hasFDerivAt_apply k ζ).const_mul (smthGrad w x₀ k))
      convert this using 1
    have h3 := ((h1.sub_const (w x₀)).sub (h2.const_mul ρ)).mul_const (ρ * κ)⁻¹
    have h4 : HasFDerivAt W ((ρ * κ)⁻¹ • ((fderiv ℝ w (x₀ + ρ • ζ)).comp
        (ρ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ)) -
        ρ • ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad w x₀ k •
          (ContinuousLinearMap.proj k : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ))) ζ := by
      refine h3.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
      rw [hW y, div_eq_mul_inv]
      rfl
    show fderiv ℝ W ζ (Pi.single j 1) = _
    rw [h4.fderiv]
    simp only [smthGrad, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id',
      Pi.smul_apply, id_eq, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sum', Finset.sum_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul', ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ,
      if_true]
    field_simp
    try ring
  refine ⟨hWC, hWg, ?_⟩
  
  intro φ hφ hφc hφs
  
  set ψ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => φ (ρ⁻¹ • (x - x₀)) with hψdef
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ := hφ.comp (by fun_prop)
  have hBA : ∀ ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ρ⁻¹ • (x₀ + ρ • ζ - x₀) = ζ := by
    intro ζ
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ0, one_smul]
  have hAB : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, x₀ + ρ • (ρ⁻¹ • (x - x₀)) = x := by
    intro x
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hρ0, one_smul]
    abel
  have hKc : IsCompact ((fun ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ => x₀ + ρ • ζ) '' tsupport φ) :=
    hφc.isCompact.image (by fun_prop)
  have hsuppK : Function.support ψ ⊆ (fun ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ => x₀ + ρ • ζ) '' tsupport φ := by
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨ρ⁻¹ • (x - x₀), subset_tsupport _ hx, hAB x⟩
  have hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro' hKc hKc.isClosed (fun x hx => ?_)
    by_contra h
    exact hx (hsuppK h)
  have hψS : tsupport ψ ⊆ S := by
    refine (closure_minimal hsuppK hKc.isClosed).trans ?_
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hA y (hφs hy)
  have hψg : ∀ (ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (i : Fin 2),
      smthGrad ψ (x₀ + ρ • ζ) i = ρ⁻¹ * smthGrad φ ζ i := by
    intro ζ i
    have hB : HasFDerivAt (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => ρ⁻¹ • (x - x₀))
        (ρ⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (x₀ + ρ • ζ) :=
      ((hasFDerivAt_id _).sub_const x₀).const_smul ρ⁻¹
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ (ρ⁻¹ • (x₀ + ρ • ζ - x₀)) :=
      (hφ.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    have h : HasFDerivAt ψ ((fderiv ℝ φ (ρ⁻¹ • (x₀ + ρ • ζ - x₀))).comp
        (ρ⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (x₀ + ρ • ζ) :=
      hφd.hasFDerivAt.comp (x₀ + ρ • ζ) hB
    show fderiv ℝ ψ (x₀ + ρ • ζ) (Pi.single i 1) = ρ⁻¹ * fderiv ℝ φ ζ (Pi.single i 1)
    rw [h.fderiv, hBA]
    simp
  
  have hDcont : ∀ i : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad ψ x i) := fun i =>
    (hψ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hDcs : ∀ i : Fin 2, HasCompactSupport (fun x => smthGrad ψ x i) := fun i =>
    hψc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) _
  have hDts : ∀ i : Fin 2, tsupport (fun x => smthGrad ψ x i) ⊆ S := by
    intro i
    refine (closure_minimal ?_ (isClosed_tsupport ψ)).trans hψS
    intro x hx
    apply support_fderiv_subset ℝ
    intro h0
    apply hx
    show fderiv ℝ ψ x (Pi.single i 1) = 0
    rw [h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  
  have h0 : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∫ x, smthGrad ψ x i = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hI : Integrable (fun x => smthGrad ψ x i) :=
      (hDcont i).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hDcs i)
    have := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
      (f := fun _ : Fin 2 → ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (g := ψ) (v := (Pi.single i 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ))
      (by simp) (by simpa using hI) (by simpa using hψ.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hψc)
      (differentiable_const _) (hψ.differentiable (by simp))
    simpa [smthGrad] using this
  
  have hint : ∀ g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContinuousOn g S → ∀ i : Fin 2,
      Integrable (fun x => g x * smthGrad ψ x i) := by
    intro g hg i
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => g x * smthGrad ψ x i) S := hg.mul (hDcont i).continuousOn
    have h2 : tsupport (fun x => g x * smthGrad ψ x i) ⊆ S :=
      tsupport_mul_subset_right.trans (hDts i)
    exact (h1.continuous_of_tsupport_subset hS h2).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (hDcs i).mul_left
  have hac : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x i j) S := fun i j =>
    continuousOn_pi.1 (continuousOn_pi.1 ha i) j
  have hFc : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => F x i) S := fun i => continuousOn_pi.1 hF i
  have hgc : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad w x j) S := fun j =>
    (hw.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hS le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  
  set P : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
    a x i j * (smthGrad w x j - smthGrad w x₀ j) * smthGrad ψ x i with hP
  set Q : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2,
    (F x i - F x₀ i - ∑ j : Fin 2, (a x i j - a x₀ i j) * smthGrad w x₀ j) * smthGrad ψ x i
    with hQ
  have hPQ : ∫ x, P x = ∫ x, Q x := by
    have i1 : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
        a x i j * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad ψ x i) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        hint (fun x => a x i j * smthGrad w x j) ((hac i j).mul (hgc j)) i
    have i3 : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
        a x i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        hint (fun x => a x i j * smthGrad w x₀ j) ((hac i j).mul continuousOn_const) i
    have i4 : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad ψ x i) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => hint (fun x => F x i) (hFc i) i
    have i5 : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, F x₀ i * smthGrad ψ x i) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => hint (fun _ => F x₀ i) continuousOn_const i
    have i6 : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
        a x₀ i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        hint (fun _ => a x₀ i j * smthGrad w x₀ j) continuousOn_const i
    have z5 : ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, F x₀ i * smthGrad ψ x i = 0 := by
      rw [integral_finset_sum _ fun i _ => hint (fun _ => F x₀ i) continuousOn_const i]
      simp [integral_const_mul, h0]
    have z6 : ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x₀ i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i = 0 := by
      rw [integral_finset_sum _ fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        hint (fun _ => a x₀ i j * smthGrad w x₀ j) continuousOn_const i]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
      rw [integral_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        hint (fun _ => a x₀ i j * smthGrad w x₀ j) continuousOn_const i]
      simp [integral_const_mul, h0]
    have eP : P = fun x => (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad ψ x i)
        - (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i) := by
      funext x
      simp only [hP, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    have eQ : Q = fun x => (∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad ψ x i)
        - (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i)
        - (∑ i : Fin 2, F x₀ i * smthGrad ψ x i)
        + (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x₀ i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i) := by
      funext x
      simp only [hQ, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    have e1 : ∫ x, P x = (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad ψ x i)
        - ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i := by
      rw [eP]
      exact integral_sub i1 i3
    have e2 : ∫ x, Q x = (∫ x, (∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad ψ x i)
        - (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i)
        - (∑ i : Fin 2, F x₀ i * smthGrad ψ x i))
        + ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x₀ i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i := by
      rw [eQ]
      exact integral_add ((i4.sub i3).sub i5) i6
    have e3 : (∫ x, (∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad ψ x i)
        - (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i)
        - (∑ i : Fin 2, F x₀ i * smthGrad ψ x i)) =
        (∫ x, (∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad ψ x i)
        - (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i))
        - ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, F x₀ i * smthGrad ψ x i :=
      integral_sub (i4.sub i3) i5
    have e4 : (∫ x, (∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad ψ x i)
        - (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i)) =
        (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad ψ x i)
        - ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x₀ j * smthGrad ψ x i :=
      integral_sub i4 i3
    have e5 := hsol ψ hψ hψc hψS
    rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, z5, z6, e5]
    ring
  
  have hcv : ∀ f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ∫ ζ, f (x₀ + ρ • ζ) = (ρ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ x, f x := by
    intro f
    have h1 := Measure.integral_comp_smul (volume : Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (fun y => f (x₀ + y)) ρ
    have h2 : ∫ y, f (x₀ + y) = ∫ x, f x := integral_add_left_eq_self f x₀
    simp only [Module.finrank_fin_fun] at h1
    rw [h1, h2, abs_of_pos (by positivity), smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hφ0 : ∀ ζ, ζ ∉ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T → ∀ i, smthGrad φ ζ i = 0 := by
    intro ζ hζ i
    have : fderiv ℝ φ ζ = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hζ (hφs (support_fderiv_subset ℝ h))
    show fderiv ℝ φ ζ (Pi.single i 1) = 0
    rw [this, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  have hL : (fun ζ => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a (x₀ + ρ • ζ) i j * smthGrad W ζ j *
      smthGrad φ ζ i) = fun ζ => (ρ / κ) * P (x₀ + ρ • ζ) := by
    funext ζ
    simp only [hP, hψg]
    by_cases hζ : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T
    · simp only [hWg ζ hζ, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      field_simp
      try ring
    · simp [hφ0 ζ hζ]
  have hR : (fun ζ => ∑ i : Fin 2, G ζ i * smthGrad φ ζ i) =
      fun ζ => (ρ / κ) * Q (x₀ + ρ • ζ) := by
    funext ζ
    simp only [hQ, hψg, hG, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    field_simp
    try ring
  show ∫ ζ, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a (x₀ + ρ • ζ) i j * smthGrad W ζ j * smthGrad φ ζ i =
    ∫ ζ, ∑ i : Fin 2, G ζ i * smthGrad φ ζ i
  rw [hL, hR, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, hcv P, hcv Q, hPQ]

informal_problem.statement: (α : NNReal) (lam : ℝ) (K : NNReal) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (hlam : 0 < lam) : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ (T : ℝ) (b : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ), 1 / ε ≤ T → ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 W (Metric.ball 0 T) → W 0 = 0 → smthGrad W 0 = 0 → (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖smthGrad W ζ - smthGrad W ζ'‖ ≤ 4 * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) → 1 / 2 ≤ ‖smthGrad W ξ‖ → (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ η : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, η i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b ζ i j * η i * η j) → (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ i j : Fin 2, |b ζ i j| ≤ (K : ℝ)) → ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball 0 T) → ContinuousOn G (Metric.ball 0 T) → (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖b ζ - b 0‖ ≤ ε * ‖ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) → (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖G ζ‖ ≤ ε * ‖ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) → smthLinSol b G W (Metric.ball 0 T) → False

signature.name: smth_sch_rigidity
signature.statement: (α : NNReal) (lam : ℝ) (K : NNReal) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (hlam : 0 < lam) : ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ (T : ℝ) (b : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ), 1 / ε ≤ T → ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1 → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 W (Metric.ball 0 T) → W 0 = 0 → smthGrad W 0 = 0 → (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖smthGrad W ζ - smthGrad W ζ'‖ ≤ 4 * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) → 1 / 2 ≤ ‖smthGrad W ξ‖ → (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ η : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, η i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b ζ i j * η i * η j) → (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ i j : Fin 2, |b ζ i j| ≤ (K : ℝ)) → ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball 0 T) → ContinuousOn G (Metric.ball 0 T) → (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖b ζ - b 0‖ ≤ ε * ‖ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) → (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖G ζ‖ ≤ ε * ‖ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) → smthLinSol b G W (Metric.ball 0 T) → False

proof.tactics:
by
  
  by_contra hne
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ (T : ℝ) (b : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ)
      (W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (k : ℝ) + 1 ≤ T ∧ ‖ξ‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 W (Metric.ball 0 T) ∧ W 0 = 0 ∧ smthGrad W 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T,
        ‖smthGrad W ζ - smthGrad W ζ'‖ ≤ 4 * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) ∧
      1 / 2 ≤ ‖smthGrad W ξ‖ ∧
      (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ η : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, η i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b ζ i j * η i * η j) ∧
      (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ i j : Fin 2, |b ζ i j| ≤ (K : ℝ)) ∧
      ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball 0 T) ∧ ContinuousOn G (Metric.ball 0 T) ∧
      (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖b ζ - b 0‖ ≤ 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖G ζ‖ ≤ 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) ∧
      smthLinSol b G W (Metric.ball 0 T) := by
    intro k
    by_contra hk
    apply hne
    refine ⟨1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1), by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro T b G W ξ e1 e2 e3 e4 e5 e6 e7 e8 e9 e10 e11 e12 e13 e14
    rw [one_div_one_div] at e1
    exact hk ⟨T, b, G, W, ξ, e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6, e7, e8, e9, e10, e11, e12, e13, e14⟩
  choose T b G W ξ h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8 h9 h10 h11 h12 h13 h14 using key
  have hα : (0 : ℝ) < (α : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.2 hα0
  have hα1' : (α : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hα1.le
  have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (K : ℝ) := K.2
  have F2 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ^ (α : ℝ) ≤ 1 + t := by
    intro t ht
    rcases le_or_gt t 1 with h | h
    · have := Real.rpow_le_one ht h hα.le
      linarith
    · have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h.le hα1'
      rw [Real.rpow_one] at this
      linarith
  have hTpos : ∀ k, 0 < T k := fun k => by
    have := h1 k
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
    linarith
  have h0B : ∀ k, (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k) :=
    fun k => Metric.mem_ball_self (hTpos k)
  have hTt : Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    Filter.tendsto_atTop_mono (fun k => by linarith [h1 k]) tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have h9' : ∀ k, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k), ‖b k ζ‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) := by
    intro k ζ hζ
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hK0).2 (fun i => ?_)
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hK0).2 (fun j => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact h9 k ζ hζ i j
  have h15 : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (smthGrad (W k)) (Metric.ball 0 (T k)) := by
    intro k
    have hfd := (h3 k).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball le_rfl
    exact continuousOn_pi.2 (fun j => hfd.clm_apply continuousOn_const)
  have S1 := fun k => smth_rig_single_bounds α hα0 hα1 (T k) (W k) (h3 k) (h4 k) (h5 k) (h6 k)
  
  have hbd : ∀ k, ∀ ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖ζ‖ < T k →
      ‖((W k ζ, smthGrad (W k) ζ, b k 0, ξ k) :
        ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ ≤ (16 + (K : ℝ)) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 := by
    intro k ζ hζ
    have hζB : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k) := mem_ball_zero_iff.2 hζ
    have hs : 0 ≤ ‖ζ‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hA : 1 ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hB : 1 + ‖ζ‖ ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hC : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hD : (K : ℝ) ≤ (K : ℝ) * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have e1 := (S1 k).2.2.1 ζ hζB
    have e2 := (S1 k).2.1 ζ hζB
    have e3 := h9' k 0 (h0B k)
    have e4 := h2 k
    refine norm_prod_le_iff.2 ⟨?_, norm_prod_le_iff.2 ⟨?_, norm_prod_le_iff.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩⟩
    · show ‖W k ζ‖ ≤ _
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      linarith
    · show ‖smthGrad (W k) ζ‖ ≤ _
      linarith
    · show ‖b k 0‖ ≤ _
      linarith
    · show ‖ξ k‖ ≤ _
      linarith
  have hhol : ∀ k, ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖ζ‖ < T k → ‖ζ'‖ < T k →
      ‖((W k ζ, smthGrad (W k) ζ, b k 0, ξ k) :
          ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) -
        (W k ζ', smthGrad (W k) ζ', b k 0, ξ k)‖ ≤
        (16 + (K : ℝ)) * (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖) ^ 2 * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
    intro k ζ ζ' hζ hζ'
    have hζB : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k) := mem_ball_zero_iff.2 hζ
    have hζB' : ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k) := mem_ball_zero_iff.2 hζ'
    have hs := norm_nonneg ζ
    have hs' := norm_nonneg ζ'

    (MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.id (volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ)).prod
      ((MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ).symm _)
  have hB : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving
      (⇑(MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0).symm :
        ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) volume volume :=
    (MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0).symm _
  have hC : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving
      (WithLp.toLp 2 : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → E3) volume volume :=
    PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 3)
  have h := hC.comp (hB.comp hA)
  have heq : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) =
      (WithLp.toLp 2 : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → E3) ∘
        ((⇑(MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0).symm :
          ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) ∘
          (Prod.map id ⇑MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.symm : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) := by
    funext p
    obtain ⟨t, a, b⟩ := p
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro j
    fin_cases j <;>
      simp [cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply,
        Fin.insertNthEquiv_apply, Fin.insertNth_zero', MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow_symm_apply] <;>
      rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact h

signature.statement: (c : ℝ) : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (p.1, c * p.1 + p.2.1, p.2.2)) volume volume

proof.tactics:
by
  have hg : ∀ x : ℝ, MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (c * x + q.1, q.2))
      (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) = MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro x
    have h := (MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_add_left
      (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) ((c * x, (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ)).map_eq
    have hfun : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => (c * x + q.1, q.2)) = (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ((c * x, (0:ℝ)) : ℝ × ℝ) + q) := by
      funext q

    rw [hfun]

  have hm : Measurable (Function.uncurry (fun (x : ℝ) (q : ℝ × ℝ) => (c * x + q.1, q.2))) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (c * z.1 + z.2.1, z.2.2)) := by fun_prop
    exact hc.measurable
  exact (MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving.id (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ)).skew_product
    (g := fun (x : ℝ) (q : ℝ × ℝ) => (c * x + q.1, q.2)) hm (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg)
