signature.name: cylShear_hasDerivAt
signature.statement: (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (c t u s : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => X (cylPt x (c * x + u) s) i) (partialDeriv 0 (fun w => X w i) (cylPt t (c * t + u) s) + c * partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w i) (cylPt t (c * t + u) s)) t ∧ HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => X (cylPt t (c * t + x) s) i) (partialDeriv 1 (fun w => X w i) (cylPt t (c * t + u) s)) u ∧ HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => X (cylPt t (c * t + u) x) i) (partialDeriv 2 (fun w => X w i) (cylPt t (c * t + u) s)) s

proof.tactics:
by
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : E3 => X w i) := by
    have h := (EuclideanSpace.proj i : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hX
    exact h
  have hfd : Differentiable ℝ (fun w : E3 => X w i) := hf.differentiable (by simp)
  have hF : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E3 => X w i)
      (fderiv ℝ (fun w : E3 => X w i) (cylPt t (c * t + u) s)) (cylPt t (c * t + u) s) :=
    (hfd _).hasFDerivAt
  have g1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => cylPt x (c * x + u) s) (e 0 + c • e 1) t := by
    have h := (((hasDerivAt_id' t).smul_const (e 0)).add
      ((((hasDerivAt_id' t).const_mul c).add_const u).smul_const (e 1))).add_const (s • e 2)
    unfold cylPt
    convert h using 1
    simp
  have g2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => cylPt t (c * t + x) s) (e 1) u := by
    have h := ((((hasDerivAt_id' u).const_add (c * t)).smul_const (e 1)).const_add
      (t • e 0)).add_const (s • e 2)
    unfold cylPt
    convert h using 1
    simp
  have g3 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => cylPt t (c * t + u) x) (e 2) s := by
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id' s).smul_const (e 2)).const_add (t • e 0 + (c * t + u) • e 1)
    unfold cylPt
    convert h using 1
    simp
  have h1 := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (x := t) (l := fun w : E3 => X w i) hF g1
  have h2 := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (x := u) (l := fun w : E3 => X w i) hF g2
  have h3 := HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (x := s) (l := fun w : E3 => X w i) hF g3
  refine ⟨?_, h2, h3⟩
  convert h1 using 1
  rw [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rfl

informal_problem.statement: (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hc : HasCompactSupport X) (hpos : tsupport X ⊆ {z : E3 | 0 < z 0}) : (∀ i j : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z : E3 => partialDeriv j (fun w => X w i) z) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun z : E3 => partialDeriv j (fun w => X w i) z)) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z : E3 => X z i) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun z : E3 => X z i)) ∧ (∀ z : E3, z 0 ≤ 0 → ∀ i j : Fin 3, X z i = 0 ∧ partialDeriv j (fun w => X w i) z = 0)

signature.name: divField_props
signature.statement: (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hc : HasCompactSupport X) (hpos : tsupport X ⊆ {z : E3 | 0 < z 0}) : (∀ i j : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z : E3 => partialDeriv j (fun w => X w i) z) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun z : E3 => partialDeriv j (fun w => X w i) z)) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z : E3 => X z i) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun z : E3 => X z i)) ∧ (∀ z : E3, z 0 ≤ 0 → ∀ i j : Fin 3, X z i = 0 ∧ partialDeriv j (fun w => X w i) z = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun w => X w i) = (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ X := by
    intro i
    funext w
    rfl
  have hsm : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w => X w i) := by
    intro i
    rw [hcomp i]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hX
  have hcs : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (fun w => X w i) := by
    intro i
    rw [hcomp i]
    exact hc.comp_left (by simp)
  have hts : ∀ i : Fin 3, tsupport (fun w => X w i) ⊆ tsupport X := by
    intro i
    rw [hcomp i]
    exact tsupport_comp_subset (by simp) X
  refine ⟨fun i j => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun i => ⟨(hsm i).continuous, hcs i⟩, fun z hz i j => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hfd : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fun w => X w i)) :=
      (hsm i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)
    exact hfd.clm_apply continuous_const
  · exact (hcs i).fderiv_apply ℝ (e j)
  · have hz' : z ∉ tsupport X := by
      intro h
      have := hpos h
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at this
      linarith
    rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz']
    rfl
  · have hz' : z ∉ tsupport (fun w => X w i) := by
      intro h
      have := hpos (hts i h)
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at this
      linarith
    show fderiv ℝ (fun w => X w i) z (e j) = 0
    rw [fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport ℝ hz']
    rfl

signature.name: cylShear_comp_compactSupport
signature.statement: (g : E3 → ℝ) (hg : Continuous g) (hgc : HasCompactSupport g) (c : ℝ) : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => g (cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2)) ∧ Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => g (cylPt q.1 (c * q.1) q.2)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => g (cylPt q.1 (c * q.1) q.2))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hc0 : ∀ a b d : ℝ, (cylPt a b d) 0 = a := by
    intro a b d; simp [cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hc1 : ∀ a b d : ℝ, (cylPt a b d) 1 = b := by
    intro a b d; simp [cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hc2 : ∀ a b d : ℝ, (cylPt a b d) 2 = d := by
    intro a b d; simp [cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hΦ : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2) := by
    unfold cylPt
    exact ((continuous_fst.smul continuous_const).add
      (((continuous_const.mul continuous_fst).add (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd)).smul
        continuous_const)).add ((continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd).smul continuous_const)
  have hφ : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => cylPt q.1 (c * q.1) q.2) := by
    unfold cylPt
    exact ((continuous_fst.smul continuous_const).add
      ((continuous_const.mul continuous_fst).smul continuous_const)).add
        (continuous_snd.smul continuous_const)
  have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun z : E3 => z i) := fun i => by fun_prop
  have hΨ : Continuous (fun z : E3 => (z 0, z 1 - c * z 0, z 2)) :=
    (hcoord 0).prodMk (((hcoord 1).sub (continuous_const.mul (hcoord 0))).prodMk (hcoord 2))
  have hψ : Continuous (fun z : E3 => (z 0, z 2)) := (hcoord 0).prodMk (hcoord 2)
  refine ⟨hg.comp hΦ, ?_, hg.comp hφ, ?_⟩
  · refine HasCompactSupport.intro (hgc.isCompact.image hΨ) ?_
    intro p hp
    by_contra h
    apply hp
    refine ⟨cylPt p.1 (c * p.1 + p.2.1) p.2.2, subset_tsupport g h, ?_⟩
    simp only [hc0, hc1, hc2, add_sub_cancel_left]
  · refine HasCompactSupport.intro (hgc.isCompact.image hψ) ?_
    intro q hq
    by_contra h
    apply hq
    refine ⟨cylPt q.1 (c * q.1) q.2, subset_tsupport g h, ?_⟩
    simp only [hc0, hc2]

informal_problem.statement: (F F' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hF : HasCompactSupport F) (hF'c : Continuous F') (hF's : HasCompactSupport F') (hd : ∀ t u s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => F (x, u, s)) (F' (t, u, s)) t) (A : Set ℝ) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}, F' p = 0

signature.name: prod3_deriv_fst_integral_zero
signature.statement: (F F' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hF : HasCompactSupport F) (hF'c : Continuous F') (hF's : HasCompactSupport F') (hd : ∀ t u s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => F (x, u, s)) (F' (t, u, s)) t) (A : Set ℝ) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}, F' p = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hslice : ∀ (G : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), HasCompactSupport G → ∀ u s : ℝ,
      HasCompactSupport (fun x : ℝ => G (x, u, s)) := by
    intro G hG u s
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (hG.isCompact.image continuous_fst) ?_
    intro x hx
    apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
    intro hmem
    exact hx ⟨(x, u, s), hmem, rfl⟩
  have hsl0 : ∀ u s : ℝ, ∫ x : ℝ, F' (x, u, s) = 0 := by
    intro u s
    have hd' : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => F (x, u, s)) (F' (x, u, s)) x :=
      fun x => hd x u s
    have hfc : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => F (x, u, s)) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 (fun x => (hd' x).continuousAt)
    have hf'c : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => F' (x, u, s)) :=
      hF'c.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    have hfi : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x : ℝ => F (x, u, s)) :=
      hfc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hslice F hF u s)
    have hf'i : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x : ℝ => F' (x, u, s)) :=
      hf'c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hslice F' hF's u s)
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_eq_zero_of_hasDerivAt_of_integrable hd' hf'i hfi
  have hS : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A} :=
    hA.preimage (measurable_fst.comp measurable_snd)
  have hI : MeasureTheory.Integrable F' := hF'c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hF's
  have hIS : MeasureTheory.Integrable ({p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}.indicator F')
      ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ).prod
        (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ))) := hI.indicator hS
  rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hS]
  show ∫ p, {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}.indicator F' p ∂((MeasureTheory.volume :
      MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ).prod (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ))) = 0
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_prod_symm _ hIS]
  have hinner : ∀ y : ℝ × ℝ,
      ∫ x : ℝ, {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}.indicator F' (x, y) = 0 := by
    rintro ⟨u, s⟩
    by_cases hu : u ∈ A
    · have : (fun x : ℝ => {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}.indicator F' (x, u, s)) =
          fun x => F' (x, u, s) := by
        funext x
        exact Set.indicator_of_mem (show (x, u, s) ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A} from hu) _
      rw [this]
      exact hsl0 u s
    · have : (fun x : ℝ => {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}.indicator F' (x, u, s)) =
          fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        funext x
        exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (show (x, u, s) ∉ {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A} from hu) _
      rw [this]
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_zero _ _
  simp only [hinner]
  exact MeasureTheory.integral_zero _ _

informal_problem.statement: (F F' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hF : HasCompactSupport F) (hF'c : Continuous F') (hF's : HasCompactSupport F') (hd : ∀ t u s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => F (t, u, x)) (F' (t, u, s)) s) (A : Set ℝ) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}, F' p = 0

signature.name: prod3_deriv_thd_integral_zero
signature.statement: (F F' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hF : HasCompactSupport F) (hF'c : Continuous F') (hF's : HasCompactSupport F') (hd : ∀ t u s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => F (t, u, x)) (F' (t, u, s)) s) (A : Set ℝ) (hA : MeasurableSet A) : ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}, F' p = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hS : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A} :=
    hA.preimage (measurable_fst.comp measurable_snd)
  have hI : MeasureTheory.Integrable F' := hF'c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hF's
  have hI2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable ({p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}.indicator F') :=
    hI.indicator hS
  rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hS]
  have hslice : ∀ t u : ℝ, ∫ s : ℝ, F' (t, u, s) = 0 := by
    intro t u
    have hc' : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => F' (t, u, s)) :=
      hF'c.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))
    have hcs' : HasCompactSupport (fun s : ℝ => F' (t, u, s)) := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro
        (hF's.isCompact.image (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)) ?_
      intro s hs
      apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      intro hmem
      exact hs ⟨(t, u, s), hmem, rfl⟩
    have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => F (t, u, s)) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 (fun s => (hd t u s).continuousAt)
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport (fun s : ℝ => F (t, u, s)) := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro
        (hF.isCompact.image (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)) ?_
      intro s hs
      apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      intro hmem
      exact hs ⟨(t, u, s), hmem, rfl⟩
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_eq_zero_of_hasDerivAt_of_integrable (hd t u)
      (hc'.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs') (hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs)
  have hinner : ∀ t : ℝ,
      ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}.indicator F' (t, q) = 0 := by
    intro t
    have hct : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => F' (t, q)) :=
      hF'c.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have hcst : HasCompactSupport (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => F' (t, q)) := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (hF's.isCompact.image continuous_snd) ?_
      intro q hq
      apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      intro hmem
      exact hq ⟨(t, q), hmem, rfl⟩
    have heq : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}.indicator F' (t, q)) =
        (Prod.fst ⁻¹' A).indicator (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => F' (t, q)) := by
      funext q
      by_cases hq : q.1 ∈ A
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show (t, q) ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A} from hq),
          Set.indicator_of_mem (show q ∈ Prod.fst ⁻¹' A from hq)]
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show (t, q) ∉ {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A} from hq),
          Set.indicator_of_notMem (show q ∉ Prod.fst ⁻¹' A from hq)]
    have hIt : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}.indicator F' (t, q)) := by
      rw [heq]
      exact (hct.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcst).indicator (measurable_fst hA)
    have hu : ∀ u : ℝ, ∫ s : ℝ, {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}.indicator F' (t, (u, s)) = 0 := by
      intro u
      by_cases hu : u ∈ A
      · rw [← hslice t u]
        congr 1
        funext s
        exact Set.indicator_of_mem (show (t, (u, s)) ∈ {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A} from hu) _
      · have h0 : (fun s : ℝ => {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}.indicator F' (t, (u, s))) =
            fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
          funext fun s =>
            Set.indicator_of_notMem (show (t, (u, s)) ∉ {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A} from hu) _
        rw [h0, MeasureTheory.integral_zero]
    refine (MeasureTheory.integral_prod _ hIt).trans ?_
    simp only [hu, MeasureTheory.integral_zero]
  refine (MeasureTheory.integral_prod _ hI2).trans ?_
  simp only [hinner, MeasureTheory.integral_zero]

informal_problem.statement: (F F' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hFc : Continuous F) (hF : HasCompactSupport F) (hF'c : Continuous F') (hF's : HasCompactSupport F') (hd : ∀ t u s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => F (t, x, s)) (F' (t, u, s)) u) : (∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.2.1}, F' p = -∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, F (q.1, 0, q.2)) ∧ (∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 < 0}, F' p = ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, F (q.1, 0, q.2))

signature.name: prod3_deriv_snd_halfline
signature.statement: (F F' : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hFc : Continuous F) (hF : HasCompactSupport F) (hF'c : Continuous F') (hF's : HasCompactSupport F') (hd : ∀ t u s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => F (t, x, s)) (F' (t, u, s)) u) : (∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.2.1}, F' p = -∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, F (q.1, 0, q.2)) ∧ (∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 < 0}, F' p = ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, F (q.1, 0, q.2))

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨R₁, -, hv₁⟩ := hF.exists_pos_le_norm
  obtain ⟨R₂, -, hv₂⟩ := hF's.exists_pos_le_norm
  have hvan : ∀ t s x : ℝ, max R₁ R₂ ≤ |x| → F (t, x, s) = 0 ∧ F' (t, x, s) = 0 := by
    intro t s x hx
    have h1 : |x| ≤ ‖((t, x, s) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)‖ := by
      have a : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖(x, s)‖ := norm_fst_le (x, s)
      have b : ‖(x, s)‖ ≤ ‖((t, (x, s)) : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ)‖ := norm_snd_le (t, (x, s))
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at a
      exact a.trans b
    exact ⟨hv₁ _ (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (hx.trans h1)),
      hv₂ _ (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (hx.trans h1))⟩
  have ftc : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f' → (∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) →
      (∀ x, max R₁ R₂ ≤ |x| → f x = 0 ∧ f' x = 0) →
      (∫ x in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), f' x = -f 0) ∧ (∫ x in Set.Iio (0:ℝ), f' x = f 0) := by
    intro f f' hf'c hdf hv
    have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 (fun x => (hdf x).continuousAt)
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport f' := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_Icc (a := -max R₁ R₂) (b := max R₁ R₂)) ?_
      intro x hx
      have : max R₁ R₂ ≤ |x| := by
        by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        exact hx (abs_le.1 h.le)
      exact (hv x this).2
    have hint : Integrable f' := hf'c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs
    have htop : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (max R₁ R₂)] with x hx
      exact ((hv x (hx.trans (le_abs_self x))).1).symm
    have hbot : Tendsto f atBot (𝓝 0) := by
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [eventually_le_atBot (-max R₁ R₂)] with x hx
      exact ((hv x (by linarith [neg_le_abs x])).1).symm
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hfc.continuousWithinAt (fun x _ => hdf x)
        hint.integrableOn htop, zero_sub]
    · rw [← integral_Iic_eq_integral_Iio, integral_Iic_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
        hfc.continuousWithinAt (fun x _ => hdf x) hint.integrableOn hbot, sub_zero]
  have hφ : MeasurePreserving (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => (w.1.1, w.2, w.1.2)) volume volume := by
    have h1 := measurePreserving_prodAssoc (volume : Measure ℝ) (volume : Measure ℝ)
      (volume : Measure ℝ)
    have h2 := (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure ℝ)).prod
      (Measure.measurePreserving_swap (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ)))
    exact h2.comp h1
  have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => (w.1.1, w.2, w.1.2)) :=
    (MeasurableEquiv.prodAssoc.trans
      ((MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ).prodCongr MeasurableEquiv.prodComm)).measurableEmbedding
  have hF'int : Integrable F' := hF'c.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hF's
  have htr : ∀ A : Set ℝ, ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A}, F' p =
      ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, ∫ u in A, F' (q.1, u, q.2) := by
    intro A
    have hpre : (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => (w.1.1, w.2, w.1.2)) ⁻¹' {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 ∈ A} =
        (Set.univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ×ˢ A := by
      ext ⟨⟨t, s⟩, u⟩
      simp [Set.mem_prod]
    have hi : IntegrableOn (fun w : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => F' (w.1.1, w.2, w.1.2))
        ((Set.univ : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) ×ˢ A) ((volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) := by
      rw [← hpre]
      exact (hφ.integrableOn_comp_preimage hemb).2 hF'int.integrableOn
    rw [← hφ.setIntegral_preimage_emb hemb, hpre, Measure.volume_eq_prod, setIntegral_prod _ hi,
      Measure.restrict_univ]
  have slice : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, (∫ u in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), F' (q.1, u, q.2) = -F (q.1, 0, q.2)) ∧
      (∫ u in Set.Iio (0:ℝ), F' (q.1, u, q.2) = F (q.1, 0, q.2)) := fun q =>
    ftc (fun x => F (q.1, x, q.2)) (fun x => F' (q.1, x, q.2))
      (hF'c.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)))
      (fun x => hd q.1 x q.2) (fun x hx => hvan q.1 q.2 x hx)
  have eP : ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | 0 < p.2.1}, F' p =
      ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, ∫ u in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), F' (q.1, u, q.2) := htr (Set.Ioi 0)
  have eM : ∫ p in {p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ | p.2.1 < 0}, F' p =
      ∫ q : ℝ × ℝ, ∫ u in Set.Iio (0:ℝ), F' (q.1, u, q.2) := htr (Set.Iio 0)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [eP, ← integral_neg]
    congr 1
    funext q
    exact (slice q).1
  · rw [eM]
    congr 1
    funext q
    exact (slice q).2

informal_problem.statement: (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f : ℝ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (KH β : NNReal) (hH : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HolderOnWith KH β (f s) S) (hc : ∀ x ∈ S, ContinuousOn (fun s => f s x) (Set.Icc 0 1)) : (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ c₀ ε : ℝ, (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |f s x - c₀| ≤ ε) → |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f s x) - c₀| ≤ ε) ∧ HolderOnWith KH β (fun x => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f s x) S

signature.name: smth_avg_holder
signature.statement: (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f : ℝ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (KH β : NNReal) (hH : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HolderOnWith KH β (f s) S) (hc : ∀ x ∈ S, ContinuousOn (fun s => f s x) (Set.Icc 0 1)) : (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ c₀ ε : ℝ, (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |f s x - c₀| ≤ ε) → |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f s x) - c₀| ≤ ε) ∧ HolderOnWith KH β (fun x => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f s x) S

proof.tactics:
by
  have hI : ∀ x ∈ S, IntervalIntegrable (fun s => f s x) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
    fun x hx => (hc x hx).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one
  have hsub : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIoc (0:ℝ) 1, s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
    exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hs
  have hbound : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |g s| ≤ C) →
      |∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, g s| ≤ C := by
    intro g C hg
    have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const
      (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1) (C := C) (f := g)
      (fun s hs => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hg s (hsub s hs))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    simpa using h
  have hA : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ c₀ ε : ℝ, (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |f s x - c₀| ≤ ε) →
      |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f s x) - c₀| ≤ ε := by
    intro x hx c₀ ε h
    have e : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f s x) - c₀ = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, (f s x - c₀) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hI x hx) intervalIntegrable_const]
      simp
    rw [e]
    exact hbound _ _ h
  have hd : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
      |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f s x) - ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, f s y| ≤ (KH:ℝ) * dist x y ^ (β:ℝ) := by
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hI x hx) (hI y hy)]
    refine hbound _ _ (fun s hs => ?_)
    have := (hH s hs).dist_le hx hy
    rwa [Real.dist_eq] at this
  refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [edist_dist, edist_dist, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg dist_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg β),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (NNReal.coe_nonneg KH)]
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  exact hd x hx y hy

informal_problem.statement: {Y : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] (X : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Y) (T S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (CX β : NNReal) (hX : HolderOnWith CX β X T) (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ T ∧ x + u ∈ T) : HolderOnWith CX β (fun x => X (x + u)) S ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → HolderOnWith CX β (fun x => X x + s • (X (x + u) - X x)) S

signature.name: smth_shift_holder
signature.statement: {Y : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup Y] [NormedSpace ℝ Y] (X : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Y) (T S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (CX β : NNReal) (hX : HolderOnWith CX β X T) (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ T ∧ x + u ∈ T) : HolderOnWith CX β (fun x => X (x + u)) S ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 → HolderOnWith CX β (fun x => X x + s • (X (x + u) - X x)) S

proof.tactics:
by
  have hA : HolderOnWith CX β (fun x => X (x + u)) S := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have h := hX (x + u) (hS x hx).2 (y + u) (hS y hy).2
    rw [edist_add_right] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
  intro s hs0 hs1 x hx y hy
  have h1 : dist (X x) (X y) ≤ (CX : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) :=
    hX.dist_le (hS x hx).1 (hS y hy).1
  have h2 : dist (X (x + u)) (X (y + u)) ≤ (CX : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) :=
    hA.dist_le hx hy
  rw [dist_eq_norm (X x) (X y)] at h1
  rw [dist_eq_norm (X (x + u)) (X (y + u))] at h2
  have key : dist (X x + s • (X (x + u) - X x)) (X y + s • (X (y + u) - X y))
      ≤ (CX : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm (X x + s • (X (x + u) - X x)) (X y + s • (X (y + u) - X y))]
    have e : (X x + s • (X (x + u) - X x)) - (X y + s • (X (y + u) - X y)) =
        (1 - s) • (X x - X y) + s • (X (x + u) - X (y + u)) := by module
    rw [e]
    have hs1' : 0 ≤ 1 - s := by linarith
    calc ‖(1 - s) • (X x - X y) + s • (X (x + u) - X (y + u))‖
        ≤ ‖(1 - s) • (X x - X y)‖ + ‖s • (X (x + u) - X (y + u))‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = (1 - s) * ‖X x - X y‖ + s * ‖X (x + u) - X (y + u)‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs1', Real.norm_of_nonneg hs0]
      _ ≤ (1 - s) * ((CX : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ)) + s * ((CX : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ)) := by
          gcongr
      _ = (CX : ℝ) * dist x y ^ (β : ℝ) := by ring
  show edist (X x + s • (X (x + u) - X x)) (X y + s • (X (y + u) - X y)) ≤ (CX : ENNReal) * edist x y ^ (β : ℝ)
  rw [edist_dist, edist_dist, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg dist_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg β),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (NNReal.coe_nonneg CX)]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal key

informal_problem.statement: (Φ : ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) → (((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (Bset : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (L : NNReal) (hL : LipschitzOnWith L Φ Bset) (hLb : ∀ z ∈ Bset, ‖Φ z‖ ≤ L) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (Z : ℝ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (CZ β : NNReal) (hZH : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HolderOnWith CZ β (Z s) S) (hZB : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ S, Z s x ∈ Bset) (hZc : ∀ x ∈ S, ContinuousOn (fun s => Z s x) (Set.Icc 0 1)) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hV : ‖V‖ ≤ 1) : (∀ x ∈ S, |∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s x) V| ≤ L) ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ c₀ ε : ℝ, (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |Φ (Z s x) V - c₀| ≤ ε) → |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s x) V) - c₀| ≤ ε) ∧ HolderOnWith (L * CZ) β (fun x => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s x) V) S

signature.name: smth_avg_lip_comp
signature.statement: (Φ : ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) → (((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (Bset : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (L : NNReal) (hL : LipschitzOnWith L Φ Bset) (hLb : ∀ z ∈ Bset, ‖Φ z‖ ≤ L) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (Z : ℝ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (CZ β : NNReal) (hZH : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, HolderOnWith CZ β (Z s) S) (hZB : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ S, Z s x ∈ Bset) (hZc : ∀ x ∈ S, ContinuousOn (fun s => Z s x) (Set.Icc 0 1)) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hV : ‖V‖ ≤ 1) : (∀ x ∈ S, |∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s x) V| ≤ L) ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ c₀ ε : ℝ, (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, |Φ (Z s x) V - c₀| ≤ ε) → |(∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s x) V) - c₀| ≤ ε) ∧ HolderOnWith (L * CZ) β (fun x => ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s x) V) S

proof.tactics:
by
  have hop : ∀ T : ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) →L[ℝ] ℝ, |T V| ≤ ‖T‖ := by
    intro T
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc ‖T V‖ ≤ ‖T‖ * ‖V‖ := T.le_opNorm V
      _ ≤ ‖T‖ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV (norm_nonneg T)
      _ = ‖T‖ := mul_one _
  have hint : ∀ x ∈ S, IntervalIntegrable (fun s => Φ (Z s x) V) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun s => Φ (Z s x)) (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
      hL.continuousOn.comp (hZc x hx) (fun s hs => hZB s hs x hx)
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun s => Φ (Z s x) V) (Set.Icc 0 1) :=
      h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    exact h2.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one
  have hIoc : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIoc (0:ℝ) 1, s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
    exact Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hs
  have hreal : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, dist (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s x) V)
      (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s y) V) ≤ (L:ℝ) * CZ * dist x y ^ (β:ℝ) := by
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [Real.dist_eq, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hint x hx) (hint y hy),
      ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hb := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1)
      (f := fun s => Φ (Z s x) V - Φ (Z s y) V) (C := (L:ℝ) * CZ * dist x y ^ (β:ℝ)) ?_
    · simpa only [sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one] using hb
    · intro s hs
      have hs' := hIoc s hs
      have hzx := hZB s hs' x hx
      have hzy := hZB s hs' y hy
      show ‖Φ (Z s x) V - Φ (Z s y) V‖ ≤ _
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
      calc |(Φ (Z s x) - Φ (Z s y)) V| ≤ ‖Φ (Z s x) - Φ (Z s y)‖ := hop _
        _ = dist (Φ (Z s x)) (Φ (Z s y)) := (dist_eq_norm _ _).symm
        _ ≤ L * dist (Z s x) (Z s y) := hL.dist_le_mul _ hzx _ hzy
        _ ≤ L * (CZ * dist x y ^ (β:ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hZH s hs').dist_le hx hy) L.coe_nonneg
        _ = L * CZ * dist x y ^ (β:ℝ) := by ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hb := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1)
      (f := fun s => Φ (Z s x) V) (C := (L:ℝ)) ?_
    · simpa only [sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one] using hb
    · intro s hs
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact (hop _).trans (hLb _ (hZB s (hIoc s hs) x hx))
  · intro x hx c₀ ε hc
    have heq : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Φ (Z s x) V) - c₀ =
        ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, (Φ (Z s x) V - c₀) := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hint x hx) intervalIntegrable_const]
      simp
    rw [heq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hb := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1)
      (f := fun s => Φ (Z s x) V - c₀) (C := ε) ?_
    · simpa only [sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one] using hb
    · intro s hs
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hc s (hIoc s hs)
  · intro x hx y hy
    rw [edist_dist, edist_dist, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg dist_nonneg β.coe_nonneg,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (NNReal.coe_nonneg _)]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    rw [NNReal.coe_mul]
    exact hreal x hx y hy

informal_problem.statement: (M₀ a : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (lam0 : ℝ) (hlam0 : 0 < lam0) (hM : ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam0 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, M₀ i j * ξ i * ξ j) (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 2, |a i j - M₀ i j| ≤ lam0 / 8) : ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam0 / 2 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a i j * ξ i * ξ j

signature.name: smth_ell_perturb
signature.statement: (M₀ a : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (lam0 : ℝ) (hlam0 : 0 < lam0) (hM : ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam0 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, M₀ i j * ξ i * ξ j) (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 2, |a i j - M₀ i j| ≤ lam0 / 8) : ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam0 / 2 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a i j * ξ i * ξ j

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ξ
  have key : ∀ A B u v c : ℝ, |A - B| ≤ c → B * u * v - c / 2 * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) ≤ A * u * v := by
    intro A B u v c h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp h
    have e1 : 0 ≤ c + (A - B) := by linarith
    have e2 : 0 ≤ c - (A - B) := by linarith
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg e1 (sq_nonneg (u + v)), mul_nonneg e2 (sq_nonneg (u - v))]
  have H := hM ξ
  have b00 := key (a 0 0) (M₀ 0 0) (ξ 0) (ξ 0) (lam0 / 8) (ha 0 0)
  have b01 := key (a 0 1) (M₀ 0 1) (ξ 0) (ξ 1) (lam0 / 8) (ha 0 1)
  have b10 := key (a 1 0) (M₀ 1 0) (ξ 1) (ξ 0) (lam0 / 8) (ha 1 0)
  have b11 := key (a 1 1) (M₀ 1 1) (ξ 1) (ξ 1) (lam0 / 8) (ha 1 1)
  have P : 0 ≤ lam0 * (ξ 0 ^ 2 + ξ 1 ^ 2) :=
    mul_nonneg hlam0.le (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at H ⊢
  nlinarith [H, b00, b01, b10, b11, P]

informal_problem.statement: (Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΛ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ O) (hell : ∀ w ∈ O, ∀ q : Fin 2 → ℝ, q ≠ 0 → 0 < fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, q)) w (0, 0, q)) (z₀ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ O) : ∃ (r lam0 : ℝ) (L : NNReal), 0 < r ∧ 0 < lam0 ∧ Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ O ∧ (∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam0 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z₀ (0, 0, Pi.single j 1) * ξ i * ξ j) ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ∀ i j : Fin 2, |fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z (0, 0, Pi.single j 1) - fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z₀ (0, 0, Pi.single j 1)| ≤ lam0 / 8) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 2, LipschitzOnWith L (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1))) (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z‖ ≤ L) ∧ LipschitzOnWith L (fderiv ℝ Λ) (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ‖fderiv ℝ Λ z‖ ≤ L

signature.name: smth_local_coeff_ball
signature.statement: (Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΛ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ O) (hell : ∀ w ∈ O, ∀ q : Fin 2 → ℝ, q ≠ 0 → 0 < fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, q)) w (0, 0, q)) (z₀ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hz₀ : z₀ ∈ O) : ∃ (r lam0 : ℝ) (L : NNReal), 0 < r ∧ 0 < lam0 ∧ Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ O ∧ (∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam0 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z₀ (0, 0, Pi.single j 1) * ξ i * ξ j) ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ∀ i j : Fin 2, |fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z (0, 0, Pi.single j 1) - fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z₀ (0, 0, Pi.single j 1)| ≤ lam0 / 8) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 2, LipschitzOnWith L (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1))) (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z‖ ≤ L) ∧ LipschitzOnWith L (fderiv ℝ Λ) (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ‖fderiv ℝ Λ z‖ ≤ L

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have h1inf : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hΛ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Λ) O := hΛ.fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl
  have hA : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) O :=
    fun i => hΛ1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hDA : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1))) O :=
    fun i => (hA i).fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl
  
  have hdec : ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      (((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) =
        ξ 0 • (((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) +
        ξ 1 • (((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) := by
    intro ξ
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)
    · simp
    · simp
    · funext k; fin_cases k <;> simp
  
  have hexp : ∀ z ∈ O, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, ξ)) z (0, 0, ξ) =
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z
          (0, 0, Pi.single j 1) * ξ i * ξ j := by
    intro z hz ξ
    have hfun : (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, ξ)) = fun w' =>
        ξ 0 * fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single 0 1) + ξ 1 * fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single 1 1) := by
      funext w'; rw [hdec ξ]; simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have d : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z :=
      fun i => ((hA i).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)
    have hd := (((d 0).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (ξ 0)).fun_add ((d 1).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (ξ 1))).fderiv
    rw [hfun, hd, hdec ξ]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hpos : ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z₀ (0, 0, Pi.single j 1) * ξ i * ξ j := by
    intro ξ hξ
    rw [← hexp z₀ hz₀ ξ]
    exact hell z₀ hz₀ ξ hξ
  
  have hcoer : ∀ M : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ,
      (∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, M i j * ξ i * ξ j) →
      ∃ lam0 : ℝ, 0 < lam0 ∧ ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        lam0 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, M i j * ξ i * ξ j := by
    intro M hM
    have hA0 : 0 < M 0 0 := by
      have h := hM ![1, 0] (by intro h; have := congrFun h 0; simp at this)
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using h
    have hD0 : 0 < M 1 1 := by
      have h := hM ![0, 1] (by intro h; have := congrFun h 1; simp at this)
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using h
    have hdisc : 0 < 4 * M 0 0 * M 1 1 - (M 0 1 + M 1 0) ^ 2 := by
      have h := hM ![-(M 0 1 + M 1 0), 2 * M 0 0]
        (by intro h; have := congrFun h 1; simp at this; linarith)
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at h
      nlinarith
    refine ⟨(4 * M 0 0 * M 1 1 - (M 0 1 + M 1 0) ^ 2) / (4 * (M 0 0 + M 1 1)),
      div_pos hdisc (by linarith), fun ξ => ?_⟩
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * M 0 0 * ξ 0 + (M 0 1 + M 1 0) * ξ 1),
      sq_nonneg ((M 0 1 + M 1 0) * ξ 0 + 2 * M 1 1 * ξ 1)]
  obtain ⟨lam0, hlam0, hcoer0⟩ := hcoer _ hpos
  
  have hcont : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1))) z₀ :=
    fun i => (hDA i).continuousOn.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds hz₀)
  have hδ : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ z, dist z z₀ < δ →
      dist (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z₀) < lam0 / 8 :=
    fun i => Metric.continuousAt_iff.1 (hcont i) (lam0 / 8) (by positivity)
  choose δ hδpos hδ using hδ
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hO z₀ hz₀
  have hδm : 0 < min (δ 0) (δ 1) := lt_min (hδpos 0) (hδpos 1)
  obtain ⟨r, hrdef⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = min (ε / 2) (min (δ 0) (δ 1) / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by rw [hrdef]; exact lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hrε : r ≤ ε / 2 := by rw [hrdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hrδ : r ≤ min (δ 0) (δ 1) / 2 := by rw [hrdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hrO : Metric.closedBall z₀ r ⊆ O :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
  have hVn : ∀ j : Fin 2,
      ‖(((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single j 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ ≤ 1 :=
    fun j => norm_prod_le_iff.2 ⟨by simp, norm_prod_le_iff.2 ⟨by simp, by rw [Pi.norm_single, norm_one]⟩⟩
  have hclose : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      |fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z (0, 0, Pi.single j 1) -
        fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z₀ (0, 0, Pi.single j 1)| ≤
        lam0 / 8 := by
    intro z hz i j
    have hzd : dist z z₀ < δ i := by
      have h1 : dist z z₀ ≤ r := hz
      have h3 : min (δ 0) (δ 1) ≤ δ i := by
        fin_cases i
        · exact min_le_left _ _
        · exact min_le_right _ _
      have h4 := hδpos i
      linarith
    have hd := hδ i z hzd
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hd
    rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z -
            fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z₀‖ *
          ‖(((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single j 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) :
            (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z -
            fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z₀‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hVn j) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ lam0 / 8 := by rw [mul_one]; exact hd.le
  
  have hweak : ∀ (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ))
      (K K' : NNReal), K ≤ K' →
      (LipschitzOnWith K f (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ‖f z‖ ≤ K) →
      (LipschitzOnWith K' f (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ‖f z‖ ≤ K') := by
    intro f K K' hKK' ⟨hL, hB⟩
    refine ⟨LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul fun x hx y hy => (hL.dist_le_mul x hx y hy).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_le_coe.2 hKK') dist_nonneg), fun z hz => ?_⟩
    exact (hB z hz).trans (NNReal.coe_le_coe.2 hKK')
  have hlip : ∀ f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzOnWith L f (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r, ‖f z‖ ≤ L := by
    intro f hf
    have hfB := hf.mono hrO
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hfB.exists_lipschitzOnWith one_ne_zero (convex_closedBall z₀ r)
      (isCompact_closedBall z₀ r)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall z₀ r).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hfB.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max K C.toNNReal, LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul fun x hx y hy =>
      (hK.dist_le_mul x hx y hy).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_le_coe.2 (le_max_left _ _)) dist_nonneg),
      fun z hz => ?_⟩
    exact (hC z hz).trans ((Real.le_coe_toNNReal C).trans (NNReal.coe_le_coe.2 (le_max_right _ _)))
  obtain ⟨L0, hL0⟩ := hlip _ ((hDA 0).of_le h1inf)
  obtain ⟨L1, hL1⟩ := hlip _ ((hDA 1).of_le h1inf)
  obtain ⟨L2, hL2⟩ := hlip _ (hΛ1.of_le h1inf)
  have hLA : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      LipschitzOnWith (max (max L0 L1) L2)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1))) (Metric.closedBall z₀ r) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall z₀ r,
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, Pi.single i 1)) z‖ ≤ (max (max L0 L1) L2 : NNReal) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hweak _ _ _ ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)) hL0
    · exact hweak _ _ _ ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)) hL1
  have hLΛ := hweak _ _ _ (le_max_right (max L0 L1) L2) hL2
  exact ⟨r, lam0, max (max L0 L1) L2, hr0, hlam0, hrO, hcoer0, hclose, hLA, hLΛ.1, hLΛ.2⟩

informal_problem.statement: (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (C α β : NNReal) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hhol : HolderOnWith C α (smthGrad v) (Metric.ball x₀ ρ)) (hβα : β ≤ α) (hβ1 : β ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hr1 : r ≤ 1 / 2) : ∃ L : NNReal, (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, ‖smthGrad v x‖ ≤ L) ∧ HolderOnWith L β (smthGrad v) (Metric.ball x₀ r) ∧ HolderOnWith L β (fun x => ((x, v x, smthGrad v x) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (Metric.ball x₀ r)

signature.name: smth_graph_holder
signature.statement: (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v) (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (ρ : ℝ) (C α β : NNReal) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hhol : HolderOnWith C α (smthGrad v) (Metric.ball x₀ ρ)) (hβα : β ≤ α) (hβ1 : β ≤ 1) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r ≤ ρ) (hr1 : r ≤ 1 / 2) : ∃ L : NNReal, (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, ‖smthGrad v x‖ ≤ L) ∧ HolderOnWith L β (smthGrad v) (Metric.ball x₀ r) ∧ HolderOnWith L β (fun x => ((x, v x, smthGrad v x) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (Metric.ball x₀ r)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hBρ : Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hrρ
  have hx₀ρ : x₀ ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ := Metric.mem_ball_self hρ
  
  have hdiam : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r,
      edist x y ≤ ((1 : NNReal) : ENNReal) := by
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [ENNReal.coe_one, edist_dist, ENNReal.ofReal_le_one]
    have h1 : dist x x₀ < r := hx
    have h2 : dist y x₀ < r := hy
    have := dist_triangle_right x y x₀
    linarith
  
  have hdown : ∀ {Y : Type} [PseudoEMetricSpace Y] (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Y) (K K' γ : NNReal),
      K ≤ K' → β ≤ γ → HolderOnWith K γ f (Metric.ball x₀ r) →
      HolderOnWith K' β f (Metric.ball x₀ r) := by
    intro Y _ f K K' γ hKK hβγ hf
    have h := HolderOnWith.of_le hdiam hf hβγ
    simp only [NNReal.one_rpow, mul_one] at h
    intro x hx y hy
    exact (h x hx y hy).trans (mul_le_mul_right' (ENNReal.coe_le_coe.2 hKK) _)
  
  set M : NNReal := ‖smthGrad v x₀‖₊ + C with hM
  have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, ‖smthGrad v x‖ ≤ (M : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    have hd := hhol.dist_le (hBρ hx) hx₀ρ
    have hxr : dist x x₀ < r := hx
    have hpow : dist x x₀ ^ (α : ℝ) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one dist_nonneg (by linarith) α.2
    have hC : (C : ℝ) * dist x x₀ ^ (α : ℝ) ≤ C := mul_le_of_le_one_right C.2 hpow
    have htri := norm_sub_norm_le (smthGrad v x) (smthGrad v x₀)
    rw [← dist_eq_norm] at htri
    have hMe : (M : ℝ) = ‖smthGrad v x₀‖ + (C : ℝ) := by
      rw [hM, NNReal.coe_add, coe_nnnorm]
    rw [hMe]
    linarith
  
  have hvd : Differentiable ℝ v := hv.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hlip : LipschitzOnWith (2 * M) v (Metric.ball x₀ r) := by
    refine Convex.lipschitzOnWith_of_nnnorm_fderiv_le (fun x _ => hvd x) ?_ (convex_ball x₀ r)
    intro z hz
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, coe_nnnorm, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat]
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun u => ?_)
    have hu : u = u 0 • (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) + u 1 • (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) := by
      funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
    have heq : fderiv ℝ v z u = u 0 * smthGrad v z 0 + u 1 * smthGrad v z 1 := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hu]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smthGrad]
    have h0 : |u 0| ≤ ‖u‖ := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm u 0
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have h1 : |u 1| ≤ ‖u‖ := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm u 1
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have g0 : |smthGrad v z 0| ≤ M := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (smthGrad v z) 0
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (hbound z hz)
    have g1 : |smthGrad v z 1| ≤ M := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (smthGrad v z) 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (hbound z hz)
    rw [heq, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc |u 0 * smthGrad v z 0 + u 1 * smthGrad v z 1|
        ≤ |u 0 * smthGrad v z 0| + |u 1 * smthGrad v z 1| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |u 0| * |smthGrad v z 0| + |u 1| * |smthGrad v z 1| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      _ ≤ ‖u‖ * M + ‖u‖ * M := by gcongr
      _ = 2 * M * ‖u‖ := by ring
  
  set L : NNReal := 1 + 2 * M + C with hL
  have hML : M ≤ L := by
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, hL]; push_cast
    linarith [NNReal.coe_nonneg M, NNReal.coe_nonneg C]
  have hCL : C ≤ L := by
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, hL]; push_cast
    linarith [NNReal.coe_nonneg M, NNReal.coe_nonneg C]
  have h1L : (1 : NNReal) ≤ L := by
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, hL]; push_cast
    linarith [NNReal.coe_nonneg M, NNReal.coe_nonneg C]
  have h2ML : 2 * M ≤ L := by
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, hL]; push_cast
    linarith [NNReal.coe_nonneg M, NNReal.coe_nonneg C]
  
  have hG : HolderOnWith L β (smthGrad v) (Metric.ball x₀ r) :=
    hdown _ C L α hCL hβα (hhol.mono hBρ)
  have hI : HolderOnWith L β (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => x) (Metric.ball x₀ r) :=
    hdown _ 1 L 1 h1L hβ1 (LipschitzWith.id.lipschitzOnWith.holderOnWith)
  have hV : HolderOnWith L β v (Metric.ball x₀ r) :=
    hdown _ (2 * M) L 1 h2ML hβ1 hlip.holderOnWith
  refine ⟨L, fun x hx => (hbound x hx).trans (NNReal.coe_le_coe.2 hML), hG, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  rw [Prod.edist_eq, Prod.edist_eq]
  exact max_le (hI x hx y hy) (max_le (hV x hx y hy) (hG x hx y hy))

informal_problem.statement: (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v) (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ) (hh : h ≠ 0) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (smthDQ v m h) ∧ (∀ x, smthGrad (smthDQ v m h) x = fun j => (smthGrad v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) j - smthGrad v x j) / h) ∧ (∀ x, smthDQ v m h x = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, smthGrad v (x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) m) ∧ ∀ (T S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (C β : NNReal), HolderOnWith C β (smthGrad v) T → (∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ T ∧ x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) ∈ T) → ∃ C₀ : NNReal, HolderOnWith C₀ β (smthGrad (smthDQ v m h)) S

signature.name: smth_dq_calculus
signature.statement: (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hv : ContDiff ℝ 1 v) (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ) (hh : h ≠ 0) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (smthDQ v m h) ∧ (∀ x, smthGrad (smthDQ v m h) x = fun j => (smthGrad v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) j - smthGrad v x j) / h) ∧ (∀ x, smthDQ v m h x = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, smthGrad v (x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) m) ∧ ∀ (T S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (C β : NNReal), HolderOnWith C β (smthGrad v) T → (∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ T ∧ x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) ∈ T) → ∃ C₀ : NNReal, HolderOnWith C₀ β (smthGrad (smthDQ v m h)) S

proof.tactics:
by
  have hd : Differentiable ℝ v := hv.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hdef : smthDQ v m h = fun x =>
      (v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v x) * h⁻¹ := by
    funext x; simp only [smthDQ, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hC1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (smthDQ v m h) := by
    rw [hdef]
    exact ((hv.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).sub hv).mul contDiff_const
  have hgrad : ∀ x, smthGrad (smthDQ v m h) x = fun j =>
      (smthGrad v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) j - smthGrad v x j) / h := by
    intro x
    have H1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)))
        (fderiv ℝ v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) x := by
      have := (hd (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))).hasFDerivAt.comp x
        ((hasFDerivAt_id x).add_const (h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)))
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
    have H3 := (H1.sub (hd x).hasFDerivAt).mul_const h⁻¹
    have hF : fderiv ℝ (smthDQ v m h) x =
        h⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - fderiv ℝ v x) := by
      rw [hdef]; exact H3.fderiv
    funext j
    simp only [smthGrad, hF, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
  have hint : ∀ x, smthDQ v m h x =
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, smthGrad v (x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) m := by
    intro x
    have hγ : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))
        (h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) s := by
      intro s
      exact ((hasDerivAt_mul_const h).smul_const (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)).const_add x
    have hf : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc (0:ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => v (x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)))
          (h * smthGrad v (x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) m) s := by
      intro s _
      have := (hd (x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s
        (hγ s)
      convert this using 1
      simp only [smthGrad, ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hcont : Continuous
        (fun s : ℝ => h * smthGrad v (x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) m) := by
      have h1 : Continuous (fun y => smthGrad v y m) :=
        (hv.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
      exact continuous_const.mul (h1.comp (continuous_const.add
        ((continuous_id.mul continuous_const).smul continuous_const)))
    have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hf (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hftc
    simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, zero_smul, add_zero] at hftc
    rw [show smthDQ v m h x = (v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - v x) / h from rfl,
      ← hftc]
    exact mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hh
  refine ⟨hC1, hgrad, hint, ?_⟩
  intro T S C β hhol hS
  refine ⟨‖h⁻¹‖₊ * (2 * C), ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  have hG : ∀ z, smthGrad (smthDQ v m h) z = h⁻¹ •
      (smthGrad v (z + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - smthGrad v z) := by
    intro z
    rw [hgrad z]
    funext j
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
  obtain ⟨hxT, hxuT⟩ := hS x hx
  obtain ⟨hyT, hyuT⟩ := hS y hy
  have h1 := hhol _ hxuT _ hyuT
  have h2 := hhol x hxT y hyT
  rw [edist_add_right] at h1
  rw [hG x, hG y, edist_smul₀, ENNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul]
  calc (‖h⁻¹‖₊ : ENNReal) *
        edist (smthGrad v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - smthGrad v x)
          (smthGrad v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) - smthGrad v y)
      ≤ (‖h⁻¹‖₊ : ENNReal) *
        (edist (smthGrad v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)))
            (smthGrad v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) +
          edist (smthGrad v x) (smthGrad v y)) := by
        gcongr
        simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, edist_neg_neg] using edist_add_add_le
          (smthGrad v (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) (-smthGrad v x)
          (smthGrad v (y + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) (-smthGrad v y)
    _ ≤ (‖h⁻¹‖₊ : ENNReal) * (C * edist x y ^ (β:ℝ) + C * edist x y ^ (β:ℝ)) := by
        gcongr
    _ = ((‖h⁻¹‖₊ * (2 * C) : NNReal) : ENNReal) * edist x y ^ (β:ℝ) := by
        push_cast; ring

informal_problem.statement: (Ψ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Ψ O) (z z' : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hseg : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, z + s • (z' - z) ∈ O) (h : ℝ) (hh : h ≠ 0) (e₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hd : z' - z = h • (e₀, t, p)) : (Ψ z' - Ψ z) / h = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (e₀, 0, 0)) + t * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (0, 1, 0)) + ∑ j : Fin 2, p j * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (0, 0, Pi.single j 1)

signature.name: smth_ftc_split
signature.statement: (Ψ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Ψ O) (z z' : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hseg : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, z + s • (z' - z) ∈ O) (h : ℝ) (hh : h ≠ 0) (e₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hd : z' - z = h • (e₀, t, p)) : (Ψ z' - Ψ z) / h = (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (e₀, 0, 0)) + t * (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (0, 1, 0)) + ∑ j : Fin 2, p j * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (0, 0, Pi.single j 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z))) (Set.uIcc 0 1) := by
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
    exact (hΨ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl).comp
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)).continuousOn
      (fun s hs => hseg s hs)
  have hint : ∀ V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ),
      IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) V) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
    fun V => (hcont.clm_apply continuousOn_const).intervalIntegrable
  have hftc : (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (z' - z)) = Ψ z' - Ψ z := by
    have key := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
      (f := fun s : ℝ => Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)))
      (f' := fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (z' - z)) ?_ (hint _)
    · simp only [one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero, add_sub_cancel] at key
      exact key
    · intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at hs
      have hγ := hseg s hs
      have hΨd : HasFDerivAt Ψ (fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z))) (z + s • (z' - z)) :=
        (((hΨ.differentiableOn one_ne_zero) _ hγ).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hγ)).hasFDerivAt
      have hg : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z + s • (z' - z)) (z' - z) s := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const (z' - z)).const_add z
      exact hΨd.comp_hasDerivAt s hg
  have hdec : ((e₀, t, p) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) =
      ((e₀, 0, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) + t • ((0, 1, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
        + (p 0 • ((0, 0, Pi.single 0 1) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
          + p 1 • ((0, 0, Pi.single 1 1) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)
    · simp
    · simp
    · funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp
  have hpt : ∀ s : ℝ, fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (z' - z) =
      h * (fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (e₀, 0, 0)
        + t * fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (0, 1, 0)
        + (p 0 * fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (0, 0, Pi.single 0 1)
          + p 1 * fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (0, 0, Pi.single 1 1))) := by
    intro s
    have e : z' - z = h • (((e₀, 0, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
        + t • ((0, 1, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
        + (p 0 • ((0, 0, Pi.single 0 1) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
          + p 1 • ((0, 0, Pi.single 1 1) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)))) := by
      rw [hd, hdec]
    have e2 : fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (z' - z) =
        fderiv ℝ Ψ (z + s • (z' - z)) (h • (((e₀, 0, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
        + t • ((0, 1, 0) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
        + (p 0 • ((0, 0, Pi.single 0 1) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))
          + p 1 • ((0, 0, Pi.single 1 1) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))))) := by
      rw [← e]
    rw [e2]
    simp only [map_smul, map_add, smul_eq_mul]
  have hI := intervalIntegral.integral_congr (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
    (fun s (_ : s ∈ Set.uIcc (0:ℝ) 1) => hpt s)
  have iA := hint (e₀, 0, 0)
  have iB := (hint (0, 1, 0)).const_mul t
  have iC0 := (hint (0, 0, Pi.single 0 1)).const_mul (p 0)
  have iC1 := (hint (0, 0, Pi.single 1 1)).const_mul (p 1)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_add (iA.add iB) (iC0.add iC1),
    intervalIntegral.integral_add iA iB, intervalIntegral.integral_add iC0 iC1,
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hftc] at hI
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hI, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hh]

informal_problem.statement: (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f₁ f₂ f₃ f₄ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ 1) (K₁ β : NNReal) (hb : ∀ x ∈ S, |f₁ x| ≤ K₁ ∧ |f₂ x| ≤ K₁ ∧ |f₃ x| ≤ K₁ ∧ |f₄ x| ≤ K₁) (h₁ : HolderOnWith K₁ β f₁ S) (h₂ : HolderOnWith K₁ β f₂ S) (h₃ : HolderOnWith K₁ β f₃ S) (h₄ : HolderOnWith K₁ β f₄ S) : (∀ x ∈ S, |-(f₁ x * f₂ x + f₃ x) + t * f₄ x| ≤ ((2 * K₁ * K₁ + 2 * K₁ : NNReal) : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith (2 * K₁ * K₁ + 2 * K₁) β (fun x => -(f₁ x * f₂ x + f₃ x) + t * f₄ x) S

signature.name: smth_holder_combo
signature.statement: (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f₁ f₂ f₃ f₄ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ 1) (K₁ β : NNReal) (hb : ∀ x ∈ S, |f₁ x| ≤ K₁ ∧ |f₂ x| ≤ K₁ ∧ |f₃ x| ≤ K₁ ∧ |f₄ x| ≤ K₁) (h₁ : HolderOnWith K₁ β f₁ S) (h₂ : HolderOnWith K₁ β f₂ S) (h₃ : HolderOnWith K₁ β f₃ S) (h₄ : HolderOnWith K₁ β f₄ S) : (∀ x ∈ S, |-(f₁ x * f₂ x + f₃ x) + t * f₄ x| ≤ ((2 * K₁ * K₁ + 2 * K₁ : NNReal) : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith (2 * K₁ * K₁ + 2 * K₁) β (fun x => -(f₁ x * f₂ x + f₃ x) + t * f₄ x) S

proof.tactics:
by
  have hk : (0:ℝ) ≤ (K₁:ℝ) := K₁.coe_nonneg
  have hC : ((2 * K₁ * K₁ + 2 * K₁ : NNReal) : ℝ) = 2 * (K₁:ℝ) * K₁ + 2 * K₁ := by
    push_cast; ring
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a₁, a₂, a₃, a₄⟩ := hb x hx
    rw [hC]
    have p1 : |f₁ x * f₂ x| ≤ (K₁:ℝ) * K₁ := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul a₁ a₂ (abs_nonneg _) hk
    have p2 : |t * f₄ x| ≤ 1 * (K₁:ℝ) := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ht a₄ (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
    have t1 := abs_add_le (-(f₁ x * f₂ x + f₃ x)) (t * f₄ x)
    have t2 := abs_add_le (f₁ x * f₂ x) (f₃ x)
    rw [abs_neg] at t1
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hk hk]
  · intro x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨a₁, a₂, a₃, a₄⟩ := hb x hx
    obtain ⟨b₁, b₂, b₃, b₄⟩ := hb y hy
    have e₁ := h₁.dist_le hx hy
    have e₂ := h₂.dist_le hx hy
    have e₃ := h₃.dist_le hx hy
    have e₄ := h₄.dist_le hx hy
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at e₁ e₂ e₃ e₄
    have hD0 : 0 ≤ dist x y ^ (β:ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg _
    have key : |(-(f₁ x * f₂ x + f₃ x) + t * f₄ x) - (-(f₁ y * f₂ y + f₃ y) + t * f₄ y)|
        ≤ (2 * (K₁:ℝ) * K₁ + 2 * K₁) * dist x y ^ (β:ℝ) := by
      have eq : (-(f₁ x * f₂ x + f₃ x) + t * f₄ x) - (-(f₁ y * f₂ y + f₃ y) + t * f₄ y)
          = (-(f₁ x * (f₂ x - f₂ y) + f₂ y * (f₁ x - f₁ y)) + -(f₃ x - f₃ y))
            + t * (f₄ x - f₄ y) := by ring
      rw [eq]
      have q1 : |f₁ x * (f₂ x - f₂ y)| ≤ (K₁:ℝ) * (K₁ * dist x y ^ (β:ℝ)) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul a₁ e₂ (abs_nonneg _) hk
      have q2 : |f₂ y * (f₁ x - f₁ y)| ≤ (K₁:ℝ) * (K₁ * dist x y ^ (β:ℝ)) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul b₂ e₁ (abs_nonneg _) hk
      have q4 : |t * (f₄ x - f₄ y)| ≤ 1 * ((K₁:ℝ) * dist x y ^ (β:ℝ)) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ht e₄ (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      have r1 := abs_add_le (-(f₁ x * (f₂ x - f₂ y) + f₂ y * (f₁ x - f₁ y)) + -(f₃ x - f₃ y))
        (t * (f₄ x - f₄ y))
      have r2 := abs_add_le (-(f₁ x * (f₂ x - f₂ y) + f₂ y * (f₁ x - f₁ y))) (-(f₃ x - f₃ y))
      have r3 := abs_add_le (f₁ x * (f₂ x - f₂ y)) (f₂ y * (f₁ x - f₁ y))
      rw [abs_neg, abs_neg] at r2
      nlinarith
    rw [edist_dist, edist_dist, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg dist_nonneg β.coe_nonneg,
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (NNReal.coe_nonneg _)]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    rw [Real.dist_eq, hC]
    exact key

informal_problem.statement: (U S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hU : IsOpen U) (hS : IsOpen S) (P : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (Q : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hP : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => P x i) U) (hQ : ContinuousOn Q U) (heq : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → ∫ x, (∑ i : Fin 2, P x i * smthGrad φ x i + Q x * φ x) = 0) (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ) (hh : h ≠ 0) (hshift : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) ∈ U) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x i j) S) (hw : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad w x j) S) (hF : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => F x i) S) (hid : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i : Fin 2, (P (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) i - P x i) / h = ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x j - F x i + (if i = m then (1:ℝ) else 0) * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Q (x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) : smthLinSol a F w S

signature.name: smth_dq_weak_eq
signature.statement: (U S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hU : IsOpen U) (hS : IsOpen S) (P : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (Q : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hP : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => P x i) U) (hQ : ContinuousOn Q U) (heq : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → ∫ x, (∑ i : Fin 2, P x i * smthGrad φ x i + Q x * φ x) = 0) (m : Fin 2) (h : ℝ) (hh : h ≠ 0) (hshift : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) ∈ U) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => a x i j) S) (hw : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad w x j) S) (hF : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => F x i) S) (hid : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i : Fin 2, (P (x + h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) i - P x i) / h = ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x j - F x i + (if i = m then (1:ℝ) else 0) * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Q (x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) : smthLinSol a F w S

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have t_s1 : ∀ (W K : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), IsOpen W → IsCompact K → K ⊆ W →
      ContinuousOn f W → (∀ x, x ∉ K → f x = 0) → Integrable f := by
    intro W K f hW hK hKW hf h0
    have hc : Continuous f := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ W
      · exact hf.continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
      · have hxK : x ∉ K := fun h => hx (hKW h)
        have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [hK.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxK] with y hy
          exact h0 y hy
        exact continuousAt_const.congr hev.symm
    exact hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.intro hK h0)
  
  have t_g0 : ∀ (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ), x ∉ tsupport u →
      ∀ i, smthGrad u x i = 0 := by
    intro u x hx i
    have : fderiv ℝ u x = 0 :=
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ h))
    simp [smthGrad, this]
  have t_gc : ∀ u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → ∀ i,
      Continuous (fun x => smthGrad u x i) := by
    intro u hu i
    exact (hu.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  
  have t_s6 : ∀ (f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (c : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) → Integrable (fun x => f x * g (x - c)) →
      ∫ x, f x * ((g x - g (x - c)) / t) = -∫ x, (f (x + c) - f x) / t * g x := by
    intro f g c t hf1 hf2
    have htr : ∫ x, f x * g (x - c) = ∫ x, f (x + c) * g x := by
      rw [← integral_add_right_eq_self (fun x => f x * g (x - c)) c]
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]
    have hf3 : Integrable (fun x => f (x + c) * g x) := by
      have := hf2.comp_add_right c
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using this
    have e1 : (fun x => f x * ((g x - g (x - c)) / t)) =
        fun x => (f x * g x - f x * g (x - c)) / t := by
      funext x; ring
    have e2 : (fun x => (f (x + c) - f x) / t * g x) =
        fun x => (f (x + c) * g x - f x * g x) / t := by
      funext x; ring
    rw [e1, e2, integral_div, integral_div, integral_sub hf1 hf2, integral_sub hf3 hf1, htr]
    ring
  
  have t_swap : ∀ (G : ℝ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (L : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)), IsCompact L →
      (∀ p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ), p.1 ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 → ContinuousAt (Function.uncurry G) p) →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ x, x ∉ L → G s x = 0) →
      ∫ x, (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, G s x) = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, ∫ x, G s x := by
    intro G L hL hc h0
    simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one]
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (Function.uncurry G) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ L) :=
      fun p hp => (hc p hp.1).continuousWithinAt
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry G) (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ L) :=
      hcont.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod hL)
    have h2 : IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry G)
        (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))) := by
      refine h1.of_forall_diff_eq_zero (measurableSet_Icc.prod MeasurableSet.univ) ?_
      rintro ⟨s, x⟩ ⟨⟨hs, -⟩, hn⟩
      have hx : x ∉ L := fun hx => hn ⟨hs, hx⟩
      exact h0 s hs x hx
    have h3 : IntegrableOn (Function.uncurry G)
        (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))) :=
      h2.mono_set (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self subset_rfl)
    have hmeas : (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)).prod (volume : Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)) =
        (volume : Measure (ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))).restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, ← Measure.prod_restrict, Measure.restrict_univ]
    have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry G)
        ((volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)).prod volume) := by
      rw [hmeas]; exact h3
    exact (integral_integral_swap hint).symm
  
  have t_s2 : ∀ (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → HasCompactSupport f →
      ∀ (c : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => (f y - f (y - c)) / t) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun y => (f y - f (y - c)) / t) ∧
      tsupport (fun y => (f y - f (y - c)) / t) ⊆ tsupport f ∪ (fun x => x + c) '' tsupport f ∧
      ∀ y i, smthGrad (fun y => (f y - f (y - c)) / t) y i =
        (smthGrad f y i - smthGrad f (y - c) i) / t := by
    intro f hf hfc c t
    have hA : IsCompact (tsupport f ∪ (fun x => x + c) '' tsupport f) :=
      hfc.isCompact.union (hfc.isCompact.image (continuous_add_right c))
    have hsupp : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport f ∪ (fun x => x + c) '' tsupport f →
        (f y - f (y - c)) / t = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 : f y = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun hh => hy (Or.inl hh))
      have h2 : f (y - c) = 0 :=
        image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun hh => hy (Or.inr ⟨y - c, hh, sub_add_cancel y c⟩))
      rw [h1, h2]; simp
    have hfd : Differentiable ℝ f := hf.differentiable (by simp)
    refine ⟨(hf.sub (hf.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))).div_const t,
      HasCompactSupport.intro hA hsupp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine closure_minimal ?_ hA.isClosed
      intro y hy
      by_contra hn
      exact hy (hsupp y hn)
    · intro y i
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => f (y - c)) (fderiv ℝ f (y - c)) y := by
        have := (hfd (y - c)).hasFDerivAt.comp y ((hasFDerivAt_id y).sub_const c)
        simpa using this
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (f y - f (y - c)) / t)
          (t⁻¹ • (fderiv ℝ f y - fderiv ℝ f (y - c))) y := by
        have := ((hfd y).hasFDerivAt.sub h1).const_smul t⁻¹
        convert this using 1
        funext z; simp [smul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul]
      simp only [smthGrad, h2.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
  intro φ hφ hφc hφS
  have hseg : ∀ x ∈ tsupport φ, ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
      x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) ∈ U :=
    fun x hx s hs => hshift x (hφS hx) s hs
  
  have hs5 : ∫ x, Q x * ((φ x - φ (x - h • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) / h) =
      ∫ x, (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Q (x + (s * h) • (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))) *
        smthGrad φ x m := by
    obtain ⟨em, hem⟩ : ∃ em : Fin 2 → ℝ, em = (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hem] at hseg ⊢
    have hD : Continuous (fun x => smthGrad φ x m) := t_gc φ hφ m
    have hD0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport φ → smthGrad φ x m = 0 := fun x hx => t_g0 φ x hx m
    have hφd : Differentiable ℝ φ := hφ.differentiable (by simp)
    
    have hftc : ∀ y, ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, smthGrad φ (y - (s * h) • em) m =
        (φ y - φ (y - h • em)) / h := by
      intro y
      have hder : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc (0:ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => φ (y - (s * h) • em))
          (-h * smthGrad φ (y - (s * h) • em) m) s := by
        intro s _
        have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => y - (s * h) • em) (-((1 * h) • em)) s :=
          (((hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const h).smul_const em).const_sub y
        have := (hφd (y - (s * h) • em)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hγ
        convert this using 1
        simp only [smthGrad, ← hem, map_neg, map_smul, one_mul, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun s : ℝ => -h * smthGrad φ (y - (s * h) • em) m)
          volume 0 1 := by
        apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
        exact continuous_const.mul (hD.comp (continuous_const.sub
          ((continuous_id.mul continuous_const).smul continuous_const)))
      have key := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hder hint
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at key
      simp only [one_mul, zero_mul, zero_smul, sub_zero] at key
      field_simp
      linarith
    
    have hc1 : ∀ p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ), p.1 ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 →
        ContinuousAt (Function.uncurry (fun s x => Q (x + (s * h) • em) * smthGrad φ x m)) p := by
      rintro ⟨s₀, x₀⟩ hs₀
      by_cases hx₀ : x₀ ∈ tsupport φ
      · have hQc : ContinuousAt Q (x₀ + (s₀ * h) • em) :=
          hQ.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds (hseg x₀ hx₀ s₀ hs₀))
        have hmap : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => p.2 + (p.1 * h) • em) := by fun_prop
        exact (hQc.comp_of_eq hmap.continuousAt rfl).mul (hD.comp continuous_snd).continuousAt
      · have hopen : IsOpen {p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | p.2 ∈ (tsupport φ)ᶜ} :=
          (isClosed_tsupport φ).isOpen_compl.preimage continuous_snd
        refine (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => (0:ℝ)) _).congr ?_
        filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds (show (s₀, x₀) ∈ {p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | p.2 ∈ (tsupport φ)ᶜ}
          from hx₀)] with p hp
        show (0:ℝ) = Q (p.2 + (p.1 * h) • em) * smthGrad φ p.2 m
        rw [hD0 _ hp, mul_zero]
    have hz1 : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport φ →
        Q (x + (s * h) • em) * smthGrad φ x m = 0 := by
      intro s _ x hx; rw [hD0 x hx, mul_zero]
    
    have hc2 : ∀ p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ), p.1 ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 →
        ContinuousAt (Function.uncurry (fun s y => Q y * smthGrad φ (y - (s * h) • em) m)) p := by
      rintro ⟨s₀, y₀⟩ hs₀
      have hmap : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => p.2 - (p.1 * h) • em) := by fun_prop
      by_cases hz : y₀ - (s₀ * h) • em ∈ tsupport φ
      · have hy : y₀ ∈ U := by
          have := hseg _ hz s₀ hs₀
          rwa [sub_add_cancel] at this
        have hQc : ContinuousAt Q y₀ := hQ.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
        exact (hQc.comp_of_eq continuous_snd.continuousAt rfl).mul (hD.comp hmap).continuousAt
      · have hopen : IsOpen {p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | p.2 - (p.1 * h) • em ∈ (tsupport φ)ᶜ} :=
          (isClosed_tsupport φ).isOpen_compl.preimage hmap
        refine (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => (0:ℝ)) _).congr ?_
        filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds (show (s₀, y₀) ∈
          {p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | p.2 - (p.1 * h) • em ∈ (tsupport φ)ᶜ} from hz)] with p hp
        show (0:ℝ) = Q p.2 * smthGrad φ (p.2 - (p.1 * h) • em) m
        rw [hD0 _ hp, mul_zero]
    have hL2 : IsCompact ((fun p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => p.2 + (p.1 * h) • em) ''
        (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ tsupport φ)) :=
      (isCompact_Icc.prod hφc.isCompact).image (by fun_prop)
    have hz2 : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ y,
        y ∉ (fun p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => p.2 + (p.1 * h) • em) '' (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ×ˢ tsupport φ) →
        Q y * smthGrad φ (y - (s * h) • em) m = 0 := by
      intro s hs y hy
      have : y - (s * h) • em ∉ tsupport φ :=
        fun hz => hy ⟨(s, y - (s * h) • em), ⟨hs, hz⟩, sub_add_cancel y _⟩
      rw [hD0 _ this, mul_zero]
    
    have hsw1 := t_swap (fun s x => Q (x + (s * h) • em) * smthGrad φ x m) (tsupport φ)
      hφc.isCompact hc1 hz1
    have hsw2 := t_swap (fun s y => Q y * smthGrad φ (y - (s * h) • em) m) _ hL2 hc2 hz2
    have htr : ∀ s : ℝ, ∫ y, Q y * smthGrad φ (y - (s * h) • em) m =
        ∫ x, Q (x + (s * h) • em) * smthGrad φ x m := by
      intro s
      rw [← integral_add_right_eq_self (fun y => Q y * smthGrad φ (y - (s * h) • em) m)
        ((s * h) • em)]
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]
    calc ∫ x, Q x * ((φ x - φ (x - h • em)) / h)
        = ∫ y, ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Q y * smthGrad φ (y - (s * h) • em) m := by
          congr 1; funext y
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, hftc y]
      _ = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, ∫ y, Q y * smthGrad φ (y - (s * h) • em) m := hsw2
      _ = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, ∫ x, Q (x + (s * h) • em) * smthGrad φ x m := by
          congr 1; funext s; exact htr s
      _ = ∫ x, ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Q (x + (s * h) • em) * smthGrad φ x m := hsw1.symm
      _ = _ := by
          congr 1; funext x
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  obtain ⟨em, hem⟩ : ∃ em : Fin 2 → ℝ, em = (Pi.single m (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hem] at hshift hid hs5
  
  have hSU0 : S ⊆ U := by
    intro x hx; have := hshift x hx 0 ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩; simpa using this
  have hSU1 : ∀ x ∈ S, x + h • em ∈ U := by
    intro x hx; have := hshift x hx 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩; simpa using this
  have hK : IsCompact (tsupport φ) := hφc.isCompact
  have hKU : tsupport φ ⊆ U := hφS.trans hSU0
  have hKcU : (fun x => x + h • em) '' tsupport φ ⊆ U := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact hSU1 x (hφS hx)
  have hKc : IsCompact ((fun x => x + h • em) '' tsupport φ) :=
    hK.image (continuous_add_right _)
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ψ = fun y => (φ y - φ (y - h • em)) / h :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hψ, hψc, hψsupp, hψgrad⟩ := t_s2 φ hφ hφc (h • em) h
  rw [← hψdef] at hψ hψc hψsupp hψgrad
  have hψU : tsupport ψ ⊆ U := hψsupp.trans (Set.union_subset hKU hKcU)
  have hDφ : ∀ i, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad φ x i) := t_gc φ hφ
  have hDψ : ∀ i, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad ψ x i) := t_gc ψ hψ
  have hφ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport φ → ∀ i, smthGrad φ x i = 0 := t_g0 φ
  have hψ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ψ → ∀ i, smthGrad ψ x i = 0 := t_g0 ψ
  
  have I1 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => P x i * smthGrad ψ x i) := fun i =>
    t_s1 U (tsupport ψ) _ hU hψc hψU ((hP i).mul (hDψ i).continuousOn)
      (fun x hx => by rw [hψ0 x hx i, mul_zero])
  have I2 : Integrable (fun x => Q x * ψ x) :=
    t_s1 U (tsupport ψ) _ hU hψc hψU (hQ.mul hψ.continuous.continuousOn)
      (fun x hx => by rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx, mul_zero])
  have I3 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => P x i * smthGrad φ x i) := fun i =>
    t_s1 U (tsupport φ) _ hU hK hKU ((hP i).mul (hDφ i).continuousOn)
      (fun x hx => by rw [hφ0 x hx i, mul_zero])
  have I4 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => P x i * smthGrad φ (x - h • em) i) := fun i =>
    t_s1 U _ _ hU hKc hKcU
      ((hP i).mul ((hDφ i).comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).continuousOn)
      (fun x hx => by
        have : x - h • em ∉ tsupport φ := fun hz => hx ⟨x - h • em, hz, sub_add_cancel x _⟩
        rw [hφ0 _ this i, mul_zero])
  have hPc : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun x => P (x + h • em) i) S := fun i =>
    (hP i).comp (continuousOn_id.add continuousOn_const) (fun x hx => hSU1 x hx)
  have I7 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun x => (P (x + h • em) i - P x i) / h * smthGrad φ x i) :=
    fun i => t_s1 S (tsupport φ) _ hS hK hφS
      ((((hPc i).sub ((hP i).mono hSU0)).div_const h).mul (hDφ i).continuousOn)
      (fun x hx => by rw [hφ0 x hx i, mul_zero])
  have IA : Integrable
      (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad φ x i) := by
    refine t_s1 S (tsupport φ) _ hS hK hφS ?_ ?_
    · exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _
        (fun j _ => ((ha i j).mul (hw j)).mul (hDφ i).continuousOn))
    · intro x hx; simp [hφ0 x hx]
  have IB : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad φ x i) := by
    refine t_s1 S (tsupport φ) _ hS hK hφS ?_ ?_
    · exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hF i).mul (hDφ i).continuousOn)
    · intro x hx; simp [hφ0 x hx]
  
  have hPi : ∀ i, ∫ x, P x i * smthGrad ψ x i =
      -∫ x, (P (x + h • em) i - P x i) / h * smthGrad φ x i := by
    intro i
    have h6 := t_s6 (fun x => P x i) (fun x => smthGrad φ x i) (h • em) h (I3 i) (I4 i)
    refine Eq.trans ?_ h6
    congr 1; funext x
    beta_reduce
    rw [hψgrad]
  have hQψ : ∫ x, Q x * ψ x =
      ∫ x, (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Q (x + (s * h) • em)) * smthGrad φ x m := by
    rw [hψdef]; exact hs5
  have E1 := heq ψ hψ hψc hψU
  have I1s : Integrable (fun x => P x 0 * smthGrad ψ x 0 + P x 1 * smthGrad ψ x 1) :=
    (I1 0).add (I1 1)
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at E1
  rw [integral_add I1s I2, integral_add (I1 0) (I1 1), hPi 0, hPi 1, hQψ] at E1
  
  have E3 : ∀ x, (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Q (x + (s * h) • em)) * smthGrad φ x m =
      ((P (x + h • em) 0 - P x 0) / h * smthGrad φ x 0 +
        (P (x + h • em) 1 - P x 1) / h * smthGrad φ x 1)
      - (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad φ x i)
      + ∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad φ x i := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ S
    · rw [hid x hx 0, hid x hx 1]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      rcases (show m = 0 ∨ m = 1 by fin_cases m <;> simp) with rfl | rfl
      · rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg (by decide : ¬ (1:Fin 2) = 0)]; ring
      · rw [if_neg (by decide : ¬ (0:Fin 2) = 1), if_pos rfl]; ring
    · have hxK : x ∉ tsupport φ := fun h' => hx (hφS h')
      simp [hφ0 x hxK]
  
  have I7s : Integrable (fun x => (P (x + h • em) 0 - P x 0) / h * smthGrad φ x 0 +
      (P (x + h • em) 1 - P x 1) / h * smthGrad φ x 1) := (I7 0).add (I7 1)
  have I7sA : Integrable (fun x => ((P (x + h • em) 0 - P x 0) / h * smthGrad φ x 0 +
      (P (x + h • em) 1 - P x 1) / h * smthGrad φ x 1)
      - (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad φ x i)) := I7s.sub IA
  have hJ : ∫ x, (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Q (x + (s * h) • em)) * smthGrad φ x m =
      ((∫ x, (P (x + h • em) 0 - P x 0) / h * smthGrad φ x 0) +
        ∫ x, (P (x + h • em) 1 - P x 1) / h * smthGrad φ x 1)
      - (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * smthGrad w x j * smthGrad φ x i)
      + ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, F x i * smthGrad φ x i := by
    rw [show (fun x => (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Q (x + (s * h) • em)) * smthGrad φ x m) = _ from
      funext E3]
    rw [integral_add I7sA IB, integral_sub I7s IA, integral_add (I7 0) (I7 1)]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (α : NNReal) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (T : ℝ) (W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hW : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 W (Metric.ball 0 T)) (hW0 : W 0 = 0) (hg0 : smthGrad W 0 = 0) (hH : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖smthGrad W ζ - smthGrad W ζ'‖ ≤ 4 * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) : (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, |W ζ' - W ζ - ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad W ζ j * (ζ' j - ζ j)| ≤ 8 * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ))) ∧ (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖smthGrad W ζ‖ ≤ 4 * (1 + ‖ζ‖)) ∧ (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, |W ζ| ≤ 8 * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2) ∧ (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, |W ζ - W ζ'| ≤ 16 * (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖) ^ 2 * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ))

signature.name: smth_rig_single_bounds
signature.statement: (α : NNReal) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (T : ℝ) (W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hW : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 W (Metric.ball 0 T)) (hW0 : W 0 = 0) (hg0 : smthGrad W 0 = 0) (hH : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖smthGrad W ζ - smthGrad W ζ'‖ ≤ 4 * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) : (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, |W ζ' - W ζ - ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad W ζ j * (ζ' j - ζ j)| ≤ 8 * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ))) ∧ (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖smthGrad W ζ‖ ≤ 4 * (1 + ‖ζ‖)) ∧ (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, |W ζ| ≤ 8 * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2) ∧ (∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, |W ζ - W ζ'| ≤ 16 * (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖) ^ 2 * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  have ha0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (α : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_nonneg α
  have ha1 : (α : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hα1.le
  
  have T0 : ∀ (p h : Fin 2 → ℝ), fderiv ℝ W p h = ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad W p j * h j := by
    intro p h
    have hh : h = ∑ j : Fin 2, h j • (Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    conv_lhs => rw [hh]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smthGrad]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
  
  have pair : ∀ v h : Fin 2 → ℝ, |∑ j : Fin 2, v j * h j| ≤ 2 * ‖v‖ * ‖h‖ := by
    intro v h
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have h0 : |v 0| ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm v 0
    have h1 : |v 1| ≤ ‖v‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm v 1
    have k0 : |h 0| ≤ ‖h‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm h 0
