    have k1 : |h 1| ≤ ‖h‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm h 1
    calc |v 0 * h 0 + v 1 * h 1| ≤ |v 0 * h 0| + |v 1 * h 1| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |v 0| * |h 0| + |v 1| * |h 1| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      _ ≤ ‖v‖ * ‖h‖ + ‖v‖ * ‖h‖ :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul h0 k0 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
            (mul_le_mul h1 k1 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = 2 * ‖v‖ * ‖h‖ := by ring
  have hB : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T) := Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, DifferentiableAt ℝ W x := fun x hx =>
    (hW.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt (hB.mem_nhds hx)
  
  have TAY : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ∀ ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T,
      |W ζ' - W ζ - ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad W ζ j * (ζ' j - ζ j)| ≤
        8 * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) := by
    intro ζ hζ ζ' hζ'
    have hsc : Convex ℝ (Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T ∩ Metric.closedBall ζ ‖ζ' - ζ‖) :=
      (convex_ball _ _).inter (convex_closedBall _ _)
    have hζs : ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T ∩ Metric.closedBall ζ ‖ζ' - ζ‖ :=
      ⟨hζ, Metric.mem_closedBall_self (norm_nonneg _)⟩
    have hζ's : ζ' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T ∩ Metric.closedBall ζ ‖ζ' - ζ‖ :=
      ⟨hζ', by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]⟩
    have hfd : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T ∩ Metric.closedBall ζ ‖ζ' - ζ‖,
        HasFDerivAt (fun y => W y - fderiv ℝ W ζ y) (fderiv ℝ W x - fderiv ℝ W ζ) x :=
      fun x hx => (hdiff x hx.1).hasFDerivAt.sub (fderiv ℝ W ζ).hasFDerivAt
    have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T ∩ Metric.closedBall ζ ‖ζ' - ζ‖,
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => W y - fderiv ℝ W ζ y) x‖ ≤ 8 * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [(hfd x hx).fderiv]
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun h => ?_)
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, T0, T0, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      have e : ∑ j : Fin 2, (smthGrad W x j * h j - smthGrad W ζ j * h j) =
          ∑ j : Fin 2, (smthGrad W x - smthGrad W ζ) j * h j := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
        ring
      rw [e]
      refine le_trans (pair _ _) ?_
      have h1 := hH x hx.1 ζ hζ
      have hxr : ‖x - ζ‖ ≤ ‖ζ' - ζ‖ := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hx.2
      have h2 : ‖x - ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ) ≤ ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg _) hxr ha0
      have h3 : ‖smthGrad W x - smthGrad W ζ‖ ≤ 4 * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := by linarith
      have hn := norm_nonneg h
      calc 2 * ‖smthGrad W x - smthGrad W ζ‖ * ‖h‖ ≤ 2 * (4 * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) * ‖h‖ := by
            gcongr
        _ = 8 * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ) * ‖h‖ := by ring
    have mvt : ‖(W ζ' - fderiv ℝ W ζ ζ') - (W ζ - fderiv ℝ W ζ ζ)‖ ≤
        8 * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ) * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ :=
      hsc.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (fun x hx => (hfd x hx).differentiableAt)
        hbound hζs hζ's
    have hLd : fderiv ℝ W ζ (ζ' - ζ) = ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad W ζ j * (ζ' j - ζ j) := by
      rw [T0]; rfl
    have e2 : W ζ' - W ζ - ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad W ζ j * (ζ' j - ζ j) =
        (W ζ' - fderiv ℝ W ζ ζ') - (W ζ - fderiv ℝ W ζ ζ) := by
      rw [← hLd, map_sub]; ring
    rw [e2, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have e3 : ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) = ‖ζ' - ζ‖ * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_one_add' (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    rw [e3]
    calc _ ≤ 8 * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ) * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ := mvt
      _ = 8 * (‖ζ' - ζ‖ * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) := by ring
  have h0B : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T :=
    fun ζ hζ => Metric.mem_ball_self (lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg ζ) (mem_ball_zero_iff.1 hζ))
  have F1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ^ (α : ℝ) ≤ 1 + t := by
    intro t ht
    rcases le_or_gt t 1 with h | h
    · have := Real.rpow_le_one ht h ha0
      linarith
    · have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le h.le ha1
      rw [Real.rpow_one] at this
      linarith
  have G2 : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, ‖smthGrad W ζ‖ ≤ 4 * (1 + ‖ζ‖) := by
    intro ζ hζ
    have h := hH ζ hζ 0 (h0B ζ hζ)
    rw [hg0, sub_zero, sub_zero] at h
    have := F1 ‖ζ‖ (norm_nonneg _)
    linarith
  have G3 : ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) T, |W ζ| ≤ 8 * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 := by
    intro ζ hζ
    have h := TAY 0 (h0B ζ hζ) ζ hζ
    simp only [hW0, hg0, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, sub_zero] at h
    have hn := norm_nonneg ζ
    have hb : ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 := by
      calc ‖ζ‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow hn (by linarith) (by linarith)
        _ ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ (2 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
        _ = (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 := Real.rpow_two _
    linarith
  refine ⟨TAY, G2, G3, ?_⟩
  intro ζ hζ ζ' hζ'
  have hn := norm_nonneg ζ
  have hn' := norm_nonneg ζ'
  have hr := norm_nonneg (ζ - ζ')
  have hA : 0 ≤ ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hr _
  have hP : 1 ≤ 1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖ := by linarith
  have hPP : 1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖ ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hPPA := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hPP hA
  rcases le_or_gt ‖ζ - ζ'‖ 1 with h1 | h1
  · have E1 := TAY ζ' hζ' ζ hζ
    have E2 : ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) ≤ ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' hr h1 ha0 (by linarith)
    have E5 : ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ≤ ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
      have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' hr h1 ha0 ha1
      rwa [Real.rpow_one] at this
    have E3 : |∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad W ζ' j * (ζ j - ζ' j)| ≤
        2 * ‖smthGrad W ζ'‖ * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ := pair (smthGrad W ζ') (ζ - ζ')
    have E4 := G2 ζ' hζ'
    have S1 : 2 * ‖smthGrad W ζ'‖ * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ≤ 2 * (4 * (1 + ‖ζ'‖)) * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ := by gcongr
    have S2 : 8 * (1 + ‖ζ'‖) * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ≤ 8 * (1 + ‖ζ'‖) * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left E5 (by positivity)
    have S3 : 0 ≤ ‖ζ‖ * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := mul_nonneg hn hA
    have S4 : 0 ≤ ‖ζ'‖ * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := mul_nonneg hn' hA
    have a1 := abs_le.1 E1
    have a3 := abs_le.1 E3
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  · have E1 := abs_le.1 (G3 ζ hζ)
    have E2 := abs_le.1 (G3 ζ' hζ')
    have Q1 : (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have Q2 : (1 + ‖ζ'‖) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hA1 : 1 ≤ ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := Real.one_le_rpow h1.le ha0
    have Q3 : (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖) ^ 2 * 1 ≤ (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖) ^ 2 * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA1 (by positivity)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> nlinarith

informal_problem.statement: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E] (α B : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (T : ℕ → ℝ) (hT : Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) (g : ℕ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → E) (hbd : ∀ k, ∀ ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖ζ‖ < T k → ‖g k ζ‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2) (hhol : ∀ k, ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖ζ‖ < T k → ‖ζ'‖ < T k → ‖g k ζ - g k ζ'‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖) ^ 2 * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ α) : ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ g₀ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → E, ∀ ζ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => g (φ k) ζ) Filter.atTop (nhds (g₀ ζ))

signature.name: smth_rig_extract
signature.statement: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [ProperSpace E] (α B : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (T : ℕ → ℝ) (hT : Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) (g : ℕ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → E) (hbd : ∀ k, ∀ ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖ζ‖ < T k → ‖g k ζ‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖ζ‖) ^ 2) (hhol : ∀ k, ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖ζ‖ < T k → ‖ζ'‖ < T k → ‖g k ζ - g k ζ'‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖ζ'‖) ^ 2 * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ α) : ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∃ g₀ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → E, ∀ ζ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => g (φ k) ζ) Filter.atTop (nhds (g₀ ζ))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let emb : (Fin 2 → ℚ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ) := fun q i => (q i : ℝ)
  let f : ℕ → (Fin 2 → ℚ) → E := fun k q => if ‖emb q‖ < T k then g k (emb q) else 0
  let r : (Fin 2 → ℚ) → ℝ := fun q => B * (1 + ‖emb q‖) ^ 2
  have hf : ∀ k q, f k q ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (r q) := by
    intro k q
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
    by_cases h : ‖emb q‖ < T k
    · simp only [f, if_pos h]
      exact hbd k _ h
    · simp only [f, if_neg h, norm_zero, r]
      positivity
  have hcpt : IsCompact (Set.univ.pi fun q => Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (r q)) :=
    isCompact_univ_pi fun q => isCompact_closedBall _ _
  obtain ⟨a, -, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ := hcpt.tendsto_subseq (x := f) (fun k => Set.mem_univ_pi.2 (hf k))
  have hF : ∀ q, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => f (φ k) q) Filter.atTop (nhds (a q)) :=
    fun q => tendsto_pi_nhds.1 hlim q
  have hTφ : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => T (φ k)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    hT.comp hφ.tendsto_atTop
  have hconv : ∀ q, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => g (φ k) (emb q)) Filter.atTop (nhds (a q)) := by
    intro q
    refine (hF q).congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [hTφ.eventually_gt_atTop ‖emb q‖] with k hk
    simp only [f, if_pos hk]
  have hcauchy : ∀ ζ, CauchySeq (fun k => g (φ k) ζ) := by
    intro ζ
    rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
    intro ε hε
    set M : ℝ := B * (2 + 2 * ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 + 1 with hM
    have hM0 : 0 < M := by positivity
    have hBM : B * (2 + 2 * ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 ≤ M := by linarith
    have hc : 0 < ε / (6 * M) := by positivity
    set δ : ℝ := min (1 / 2) ((ε / (6 * M)) ^ α⁻¹) with hδ
    have hδ0 : 0 < δ := lt_min (by norm_num) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hc _)
    have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    have hδα : δ ^ α ≤ ε / (6 * M) := by
      calc δ ^ α ≤ ((ε / (6 * M)) ^ α⁻¹) ^ α :=
            Real.rpow_le_rpow hδ0.le (min_le_right _ _) hα.le
        _ = ε / (6 * M) := Real.rpow_inv_rpow hc.le hα.ne'
    have hq : ∀ i, ∃ q : ℚ, ζ i - δ < q ∧ (q : ℝ) < ζ i + δ :=
      fun i => exists_rat_btwn (by linarith)
    choose q hq using hq
    have hp : ‖ζ - emb q‖ < δ := by
      rw [pi_norm_lt_iff hδ0]
      intro i
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, emb]
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [(hq i).1, (hq i).2]
    have hpn : ‖emb q‖ ≤ ‖ζ‖ + 1 := by
      have h := norm_sub_le ζ (ζ - emb q)
      rw [sub_sub_cancel] at h
      linarith
    have hcmp : ∀ k, ‖ζ‖ + 1 < T (φ k) → ‖g (φ k) ζ - g (φ k) (emb q)‖ ≤ ε / 6 := by
      intro k hk
      have h1 := hhol (φ k) ζ (emb q) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hz := norm_nonneg ζ
      have hz' := norm_nonneg (emb q)
      have h2 : (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖emb q‖) ^ 2 ≤ (2 + 2 * ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 := by
        apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
        linarith
      have h3 : ‖ζ - emb q‖ ^ α ≤ δ ^ α := Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg _) hp.le hα.le
      have h4 : 0 ≤ ‖ζ - emb q‖ ^ α := Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
      calc ‖g (φ k) ζ - g (φ k) (emb q)‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖ζ‖ + ‖emb q‖) ^ 2 * ‖ζ - emb q‖ ^ α := h1
        _ ≤ B * (2 + 2 * ‖ζ‖) ^ 2 * δ ^ α :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hB) h3 h4 (by positivity)
        _ ≤ M * (ε / (6 * M)) := mul_le_mul hBM hδα (Real.rpow_nonneg hδ0.le _) hM0.le
        _ = ε / 6 := by field_simp
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.1 (hconv q).cauchySeq (ε / 3) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (hTφ.eventually_gt_atTop (‖ζ‖ + 1))
    refine ⟨max N₁ N₂, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
    have hm1 := hN₁ m (le_of_max_le_left hm) n (le_of_max_le_left hn)
    have e1 : dist (g (φ m) ζ) (g (φ m) (emb q)) ≤ ε / 6 := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
      exact hcmp m (hN₂ m (le_of_max_le_right hm))
    have e2 : dist (g (φ n) (emb q)) (g (φ n) ζ) ≤ ε / 6 := by
      rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]
      exact hcmp n (hN₂ n (le_of_max_le_right hn))
    have e3 := dist_triangle4 (g (φ m) ζ) (g (φ m) (emb q)) (g (φ n) (emb q)) (g (φ n) ζ)
    linarith
  have hlim2 : ∀ ζ, ∃ y, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => g (φ k) ζ) Filter.atTop (nhds y) :=
    fun ζ => cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete (hcauchy ζ)
  choose g₀ hg₀ using hlim2
  exact ⟨φ, hφ, g₀, hg₀⟩

informal_problem.statement: (B : ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℝ) (b : ℕ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (G : ℕ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (W : ℕ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hT : Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) (hbc : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (b k) (Metric.ball 0 (T k))) (hGc : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (G k) (Metric.ball 0 (T k))) (hWc : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (smthGrad (W k)) (Metric.ball 0 (T k))) (hbB : ∀ k, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k), ‖b k ζ‖ ≤ B) (hWB : ∀ k, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k), ‖smthGrad (W k) ζ‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖ζ‖)) (hGB : ∀ k, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k), ‖G k ζ‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖ζ‖)) (hb : ∀ ζ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => b k ζ) Filter.atTop (nhds b₀)) (hW : ∀ ζ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => smthGrad (W k) ζ) Filter.atTop (nhds (V ζ))) (hG : ∀ ζ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => G k ζ) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) (hsol : ∀ k, smthLinSol (b k) (G k) (W k) (Metric.ball 0 (T k))) : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * V x j * smthGrad φ x i = 0

signature.name: smth_rig_weak_limit
signature.statement: (B : ℝ) (T : ℕ → ℝ) (b : ℕ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (G : ℕ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (W : ℕ → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hT : Filter.Tendsto T Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) (hbc : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (b k) (Metric.ball 0 (T k))) (hGc : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (G k) (Metric.ball 0 (T k))) (hWc : ∀ k, ContinuousOn (smthGrad (W k)) (Metric.ball 0 (T k))) (hbB : ∀ k, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k), ‖b k ζ‖ ≤ B) (hWB : ∀ k, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k), ‖smthGrad (W k) ζ‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖ζ‖)) (hGB : ∀ k, ∀ ζ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k), ‖G k ζ‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖ζ‖)) (hb : ∀ ζ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => b k ζ) Filter.atTop (nhds b₀)) (hW : ∀ ζ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => smthGrad (W k) ζ) Filter.atTop (nhds (V ζ))) (hG : ∀ ζ, Filter.Tendsto (fun k => G k ζ) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) (hsol : ∀ k, smthLinSol (b k) (G k) (W k) (Metric.ball 0 (T k))) : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * V x j * smthGrad φ x i = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro φ hφ hcs
  have hfd : Continuous (fderiv ℝ φ) := hφ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
  have hgi : ∀ i : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad φ x i) := fun i =>
    hfd.clm_apply continuous_const
  have hgc : Continuous (smthGrad φ) := continuous_pi hgi
  have hg0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport φ → smthGrad φ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : x ∉ tsupport (fderiv ℝ φ) := fun h => hx (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ h)
    have h2 : fderiv ℝ φ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport h1
    funext i
    simp [smthGrad, h2]
  have hgint : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ‖smthGrad φ x‖) := by
    refine Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hgc.norm ?_
    refine hcs.mono' ?_
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    apply hx
    simp [hg0 x h]
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcs.isCompact.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)
  have hev : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.atTop, r < T k := hT.eventually_gt_atTop r
  have hsub : ∀ k, r < T k → tsupport φ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k) :=
    fun k hk => hr.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hk)
  have hcont : ∀ (U : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), IsOpen U → tsupport φ ⊆ U →
      ContinuousOn f U → (∀ x, smthGrad φ x = 0 → f x = 0) → Continuous f := by
    intro U f hU hKU hf hf0
    refine hf.continuous_of_tsupport_subset hU ?_
    refine subset_trans ?_ hKU
    refine closure_minimal ?_ (isClosed_tsupport φ)
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    exact hx (hf0 x (hg0 x h))
  have hL : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      b k x i j * smthGrad (W k) x j * smthGrad φ x i) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * V x j * smthGrad φ x i)) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun x => 4 * (B * (B * (1 + r))) * ‖smthGrad φ x‖) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [hev] with k hk
      refine (hcont _ _ Metric.isOpen_ball (hsub k hk) ?_ ?_).aestronglyMeasurable
      · have hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => b k x i j) (Metric.ball 0 (T k)) :=
          fun i j => (continuous_apply j).comp_continuousOn
            ((continuous_apply i).comp_continuousOn (hbc k))
        have hBj : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => smthGrad (W k) x j)
            (Metric.ball 0 (T k)) := fun j => (continuous_apply j).comp_continuousOn (hWc k)
        refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_))
        exact ((hA i j).mul (hBj j)).mul (hgi i).continuousOn
      · intro x hx
        simp [hx]
    · filter_upwards [hev] with k hk
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
      by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport φ
      · have hxb : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k) := hsub k hk hx
        have hxr : ‖x‖ ≤ r := mem_closedBall_zero_iff.1 (hr hx)
        have hb1 := hbB k x hxb
        have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hb1
        have hw1 : ‖smthGrad (W k) x‖ ≤ B * (1 + r) :=
          le_trans (hWB k x hxb) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hB0)
        have hBr : 0 ≤ B * (1 + r) := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hw1
        have key : ∀ i j : Fin 2, |b k x i j * smthGrad (W k) x j * smthGrad φ x i| ≤
            B * (B * (1 + r)) * ‖smthGrad φ x‖ := by
          intro i j
          have h1 : |b k x i j| ≤ B := by
            rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
            exact le_trans (norm_le_pi_norm (b k x i) j)
              (le_trans (norm_le_pi_norm (b k x) i) hb1)
          have h2 : |smthGrad (W k) x j| ≤ B * (1 + r) := by
            rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
            exact le_trans (norm_le_pi_norm _ j) hw1
          have h3 : |smthGrad φ x i| ≤ ‖smthGrad φ x‖ := by
            rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
            exact norm_le_pi_norm _ i
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hB0) h3 (abs_nonneg _)
            (mul_nonneg hB0 hBr)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
        have k00 := abs_le.1 (key 0 0)
        have k01 := abs_le.1 (key 0 1)
        have k10 := abs_le.1 (key 1 0)
        have k11 := abs_le.1 (key 1 1)
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor <;> linarith [k00.1, k00.2, k01.1, k01.2, k10.1, k10.2, k11.1, k11.2]
      · simp [hg0 x hx]
    · exact hgint.const_mul _
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
      exact tendsto_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ (fun j _ =>
        ((tendsto_pi_nhds.1 (tendsto_pi_nhds.1 (hb x) i) j).mul
          (tendsto_pi_nhds.1 (hW x) j)).mul_const _))
  have hR0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, G k x i * smthGrad φ x i) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∫ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, (0 : ℝ))) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun x => 2 * (B * (1 + r)) * ‖smthGrad φ x‖) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [hev] with k hk
      refine (hcont _ _ Metric.isOpen_ball (hsub k hk) ?_ ?_).aestronglyMeasurable
      · have hGi : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => G k x i) (Metric.ball 0 (T k)) :=
          fun i => (continuous_apply i).comp_continuousOn (hGc k)
        refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
        exact (hGi i).mul (hgi i).continuousOn
      · intro x hx
        simp [hx]
    · filter_upwards [hev] with k hk
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
      by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport φ
      · have hxb : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (T k) := hsub k hk hx
        have hxr : ‖x‖ ≤ r := mem_closedBall_zero_iff.1 (hr hx)
        have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hbB k x hxb)
        have hw1 : ‖G k x‖ ≤ B * (1 + r) :=
          le_trans (hGB k x hxb) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hB0)
        have hBr : 0 ≤ B * (1 + r) := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hw1
        have key : ∀ i : Fin 2, |G k x i * smthGrad φ x i| ≤
            B * (1 + r) * ‖smthGrad φ x‖ := by
          intro i
          have h2 : |G k x i| ≤ B * (1 + r) := by
            rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
            exact le_trans (norm_le_pi_norm _ i) hw1
          have h3 : |smthGrad φ x i| ≤ ‖smthGrad φ x‖ := by
            rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
            exact norm_le_pi_norm _ i
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul h2 h3 (abs_nonneg _) hBr
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
        have k0 := abs_le.1 (key 0)
        have k1 := abs_le.1 (key 1)
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor <;> linarith [k0.1, k0.2, k1.1, k1.2]
      · simp [hg0 x hx]
    · exact hgint.const_mul _
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
      have h := tendsto_finset_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))
        (fun i _ => (tendsto_pi_nhds.1 (hG x) i).mul_const (smthGrad φ x i))
      simpa using h
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_zero] at hR0
  have hE : (fun k => ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      b k x i j * smthGrad (W k) x j * smthGrad φ x i) =ᶠ[Filter.atTop]
      (fun k => ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, G k x i * smthGrad φ x i) := by
    filter_upwards [hev] with k hk
    exact hsol k φ hφ hcs (hsub k hk)
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hL.congr' hE) hR0

informal_problem.statement: (α : NNReal) (hα0 : 0 < α) (H C : ℝ) (W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hV : ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖V ζ - V ζ'‖ ≤ H * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) (hT : ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, |W ζ' - W ζ - ∑ j : Fin 2, V ζ j * (ζ' j - ζ j)| ≤ C * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ))) : ContDiff ℝ 1 W ∧ ∀ ζ, smthGrad W ζ = V ζ

signature.name: smth_rig_diff_of_taylor
signature.statement: (α : NNReal) (hα0 : 0 < α) (H C : ℝ) (W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hV : ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖V ζ - V ζ'‖ ≤ H * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) (hT : ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, |W ζ' - W ζ - ∑ j : Fin 2, V ζ j * (ζ' j - ζ j)| ≤ C * ‖ζ' - ζ‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ))) : ContDiff ℝ 1 W ∧ ∀ ζ, smthGrad W ζ = V ζ

proof.tactics:
by
  have hα : (0 : ℝ) < (α : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.2 hα0
  
  have hlim : ∀ (M : ℝ) (ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => M * ‖x - ζ‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) (nhds ζ) (nhds 0) := by
    intro M ζ
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => ‖x - ζ‖) (nhds ζ) (nhds 0) := by
      have := ((continuous_id.sub (continuous_const (y := ζ))).norm).tendsto ζ
      simpa using this
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (α : ℝ)) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
      have := Real.continuousAt_rpow_const 0 (α : ℝ) (Or.inr hα.le)
      have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ^ (α : ℝ) = 0 := Real.zero_rpow hα.ne'
      rw [ContinuousAt, h0] at this
      exact this
    have h3 := (h2.comp h1).const_mul M
    rw [mul_zero] at h3
    exact h3
  
  have hVc : Continuous V := by
    refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 (fun ζ => ?_)
    show Filter.Tendsto V (nhds ζ) (nhds (V ζ))
    rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    refine squeeze_zero (fun x => norm_nonneg _) (fun x => hV x ζ) (hlim H ζ)
  
  set L : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ((Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) := fun ζ =>
    ∑ j : Fin 2, (V ζ j) • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) with hLdef
  have hLapp : ∀ ζ h : Fin 2 → ℝ, L ζ h = ∑ j : Fin 2, V ζ j * h j := by
    intro ζ h
    simp [hLdef, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply]
  have hLc : Continuous L := by
    refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_)
    exact ((continuous_apply j).comp hVc).smul continuous_const
  have hD : ∀ ζ, HasFDerivAt W (L ζ) ζ := by
    intro ζ
    rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
    intro c hc
    have hl := hlim |C| 0
    simp only [sub_zero] at hl
    filter_upwards [hl.eventually_lt_const hc] with h hh
    have hT' := hT ζ (ζ + h)
    have e1 : ζ + h - ζ = h := add_sub_cancel_left ζ h
    have e2 : ∑ j : Fin 2, V ζ j * ((ζ + h) j - ζ j) = L ζ h := by
      rw [hLapp]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      simp
    rw [e1, e2] at hT'
    have hn : 0 ≤ ‖h‖ := norm_nonneg h
    have hsplit : ‖h‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) = ‖h‖ * ‖h‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_add' hn (by linarith), Real.rpow_one]
    have hp : 0 ≤ ‖h‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := Real.rpow_nonneg hn _
    have hq : 0 ≤ ‖h‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) := Real.rpow_nonneg hn _
    have hC : C * ‖h‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) ≤ |C| * ‖h‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self C) hq
    have hfin : |C| * ‖h‖ ^ (1 + (α : ℝ)) ≤ c * ‖h‖ := by
      rw [hsplit]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh.le hn
      nlinarith
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    linarith
  refine ⟨contDiff_one_iff_hasFDerivAt.2 ⟨L, hLc, hD⟩, fun ζ => ?_⟩
  funext k
  show fderiv ℝ W ζ (Pi.single k 1) = V ζ k
  rw [(hD ζ).fderiv, hLapp]
  simp [Pi.single_apply]

informal_problem.statement: (α : NNReal) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (lam H : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hell : ∀ η : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, η i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * η i * η j) (W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 W) (hH : ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖smthGrad W ζ - smthGrad W ζ'‖ ≤ H * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) (hsol : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad W x j * smthGrad φ x i = 0) : ∀ ζ, smthGrad W ζ = smthGrad W 0

signature.name: smth_rig_liouville
signature.statement: (α : NNReal) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (lam H : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hell : ∀ η : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, η i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * η i * η j) (W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 W) (hH : ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖smthGrad W ζ - smthGrad W ζ'‖ ≤ H * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) (hsol : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad W x j * smthGrad φ x i = 0) : ∀ ζ, smthGrad W ζ = smthGrad W 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hVc : Continuous (smthGrad W) := by
    have hfd : Continuous (fderiv ℝ W) := hW.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
    exact continuous_pi (fun j => hfd.clm_apply continuous_const)
  
  have key : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ ζ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      ‖smthGrad W ζ - smthGrad W 0‖ ≤ 2 * H * δ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
    intro δ hδ ζ
    let β : ContDiffBump (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
    have hρs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (β.normed volume) := β.contDiff_normed
    have hρc : HasCompactSupport (β.normed volume) := β.hasCompactSupport_normed
    have hρ0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ β.normed volume z := fun z => β.nonneg_normed z
    have hρ1 : ∫ z, β.normed volume z = 1 := β.integral_normed
    have hρsupp : ∀ z, β.normed volume z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < δ := by
      intro z hz
      have hz' : z ∈ Function.support (β.normed volume) := hz
      rw [β.support_normed_eq] at hz'
      simpa using hz'
    obtain ⟨hu2, hgu⟩ := smth_liou_moll_smooth (β.normed volume) W hρs hρc hW
    have hgu' : ∀ x, smthGrad (fun x => ∫ z, β.normed volume z * W (x - z)) x =
        fun j => ∫ z, β.normed volume z * smthGrad W (x - z) j := fun x => funext (hgu x)
    have hsol_u : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
        ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j *
          smthGrad (fun x => ∫ z, β.normed volume z * W (x - z)) x j * smthGrad φ x i = 0 := by
      intro φ hφ hφc
      have h := smth_liou_moll_weak b₀ (smthGrad W) hVc (β.normed volume) hρs.continuous hρc
        hsol φ hφ hφc
      simp only [hgu]
      exact h
    obtain ⟨hHu, happ⟩ := smth_liou_moll_holder α H δ hδ (smthGrad W) hVc hH (β.normed volume)
      hρs.continuous hρc hρ0 hρ1 hρsupp
    have hHu' : ∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        ‖smthGrad (fun x => ∫ z, β.normed volume z * W (x - z)) x -
          smthGrad (fun x => ∫ z, β.normed volume z * W (x - z)) y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
      intro x y
      rw [hgu' x, hgu' y]
      exact hHu x y
    have happ' : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        ‖smthGrad (fun x => ∫ z, β.normed volume z * W (x - z)) x - smthGrad W x‖ ≤
          H * δ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
      intro x
      rw [hgu' x]
      exact happ x
    have hL := smth_liou_pointwise b₀ _ hu2 hsol_u
    obtain ⟨A, H', hA2, hAharm, hAH, hback⟩ :=
      smth_liou_cholesky α lam H hlam b₀ hell _ hu2 hL hHu'
    have hconstA := smth_liou_harmonic α hα1 H' _ hA2 hAharm hAH
    have hconst := hback hconstA
    set U := smthGrad (fun x => ∫ z, β.normed volume z * W (x - z)) with hU
    calc ‖smthGrad W ζ - smthGrad W 0‖
        = ‖(smthGrad W ζ - U ζ) + (U ζ - U 0) + (U 0 - smthGrad W 0)‖ := by
          congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ ‖smthGrad W ζ - U ζ‖ + ‖U ζ - U 0‖ + ‖U 0 - smthGrad W 0‖ := norm_add₃_le
      _ ≤ H * δ ^ (α : ℝ) + 0 + H * δ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
          gcongr
          · rw [norm_sub_rev]; exact happ' ζ
          · rw [hconst ζ, sub_self, norm_zero]
          · exact happ' 0
      _ = 2 * H * δ ^ (α : ℝ) := by ring
  
  intro ζ
  have hα' : (0 : ℝ) < (α : ℝ) := hα0
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => δ ^ (α : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := (Real.continuousAt_rpow_const 0 (α : ℝ) (Or.inr (by positivity))).tendsto
    rwa [Real.zero_rpow hα'.ne'] at h
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => 2 * H * δ ^ (α : ℝ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := (tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds (s := Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) h1).const_mul (2 * H)
    rwa [mul_zero] at h
  have hle : ‖smthGrad W ζ - smthGrad W 0‖ ≤ 0 :=
    ge_of_tendsto h2 (eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall (fun δ hδ => key δ hδ ζ))
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_le_zero_iff.mp hle)

subgoal_signatures.statement: (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hV : Continuous V) (ρ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hρ : Continuous ρ) (hρc : HasCompactSupport ρ) (hsol : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * V x j * smthGrad φ x i = 0) : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * (∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) * smthGrad φ x i = 0

subgoal_signatures.statement: (α : NNReal) (H δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hV : Continuous V) (hH : ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖V ζ - V ζ'‖ ≤ H * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) (ρ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hρ : Continuous ρ) (hρc : HasCompactSupport ρ) (hρ0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) (hρ1 : ∫ z, ρ z = 1) (hρs : ∀ z, ρ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < δ) : (∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖(fun j => ∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) - (fun j => ∫ z, ρ z * V (y - z) j)‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) ∧ (∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖(fun j => ∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) - V x‖ ≤ H * δ ^ (α : ℝ))

subgoal_signatures.statement: (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (hsol : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad u x j * smthGrad φ x i = 0) : ∀ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_liou_cholesky
subgoal_signatures.statement: (α : NNReal) (lam H : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hell : ∀ η : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, η i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * η i * η j) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (hL : ∀ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i = 0) (hH : ∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖smthGrad u x - smthGrad u y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) : ∃ (A : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (H' : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z => u (A z)) ∧ (∀ x, smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) y 0) x 0 + smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) y 1) x 1 = 0) ∧ (∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) x - smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) y‖ ≤ H' * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) ∧ ((∀ x, smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) x = smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) 0) → ∀ x, smthGrad u x = smthGrad u 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: smth_liou_harmonic
subgoal_signatures.statement: (α : NNReal) (hα1 : α < 1) (H : ℝ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V) (hharm : ∀ x, smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad V y 0) x 0 + smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad V y 1) x 1 = 0) (hH : ∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖smthGrad V x - smthGrad V y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) : ∀ x, smthGrad V x = smthGrad V 0

signature.statement:

proof.tactics:
by
  have hξ : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k φ z) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hdφ z hz
    have hlin : (fderiv ℝ φ z : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) = 0 :=
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext (fun i => by
        simpa [partialDeriv] using congrFun h0 i)
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun hlin v
    simpa using this
  have hpos := (hpd z hz).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ
  have hN : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a φ z * partialDeriv b φ z := by
    have heq : dotProduct (star (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k φ z))
        (Matrix.mulVec (G z)⁻¹ (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k φ z)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a φ z * partialDeriv b φ z := by
      simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
      ring
    rw [← heq]
    exact hpos
  exact ccs_divx G φ U hU hG hsymm hpd hφ (hcrNormalField G φ) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) z hz hN

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (w h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U) (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U) (z : E3) (hz : z ∈ U)
    (hpdz : (G z).PosDef) (hw0 : w z = 0) (hdw : fderiv ℝ w z ≠ 0) (hh0 : h z ≠ 0) :

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hA : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j = (G z)⁻¹ j i := by
    intro i j
    have hGt : Matrix.transpose (G z) = G z := Matrix.ext fun a b => by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]; exact hsymm z b a
    have h1 := Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv (G z)
    rw [hGt] at h1
    have h2 := congrFun (congrFun h1 j) i
    rw [Matrix.transpose_apply] at h2
    exact h2
  
  have hdw' : ∀ y ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ w y := fun y hy =>
    (hw.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hdh' : ∀ y ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ h y := fun y hy =>
    (hh.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hp1 : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => w y * h y) y =
      partialDeriv a w y * h y + w y * partialDeriv a h y := by
    intro y hy a
    have H : HasFDerivAt (fun y => w y * h y) (w y • fderiv ℝ h y + h y • fderiv ℝ w y) y :=
      (hdw' y hy).hasFDerivAt.mul (hdh' y hy).hasFDerivAt
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [H.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hwd1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y) U :=
    hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by decide)
  have hhd1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ h y) U :=
    hh.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by decide)
  have hdpw : ∀ j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv j w) z := by
    intro j
    have := ((hwd1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp))
    exact this.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)
  have hdph : ∀ j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv j h) z := by
    intro j
    have := ((hhd1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp))
    exact this.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)
  
  have hp2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => w y * h y)) z =
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) z * h z + partialDeriv j w z * partialDeriv i h z +
      partialDeriv i w z * partialDeriv j h z + w z * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h) z := by
    intro i j
    have hev : partialDeriv j (fun y => w y * h y) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        fun y => partialDeriv j w y * h y + w y * partialDeriv j h y :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hz) (fun y hy => hp1 y hy j)
    have hfe := Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ) hev
    have H1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => partialDeriv j w y * h y)
        (partialDeriv j w z • fderiv ℝ h z + h z • fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j w) z) z :=
      (hdpw j).hasFDerivAt.mul (hdh' z hz).hasFDerivAt
    have H2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => w y * partialDeriv j h y)
        (w z • fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j h) z + partialDeriv j h z • fderiv ℝ w z) z :=
      (hdw' z hz).hasFDerivAt.mul (hdph j).hasFDerivAt
    have H : HasFDerivAt (fun y => partialDeriv j w y * h y + w y * partialDeriv j h y)
        ((partialDeriv j w z • fderiv ℝ h z + h z • fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j w) z) +
          (w z • fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j h) z + partialDeriv j h z • fderiv ℝ w z)) z :=
      H1.add H2
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (fun y => w y * h y)) z (e i) = _
    rw [hfe, H.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    unfold partialDeriv
    ring
  
  have e1 : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun y => w y * h y) z = h z * partialDeriv k w z := by
    intro k
    rw [hp1 z hz k, hw0]; ring
  have e2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G (fun y => w y * h y) i j z =
      h z * hessLoc G w i j z + partialDeriv i w z * partialDeriv j h z +
        partialDeriv j w z * partialDeriv i h z := by
    intro i j
    simp only [hessLoc, hp2 i j, e1, hw0, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have fin : ∀ S L Q P c : ℝ,
      ((c * L + 2 * P) / Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 * S) -
        (c ^ 3 * Q + 2 * c ^ 2 * S * P) / Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 * S) ^ 3) * |c| =
      c * (L / Real.sqrt S - Q / Real.sqrt S ^ 3) := by
    intro S L Q P c
    rcases le_or_gt S 0 with hS | hS
    · have h1 : Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 * S) = 0 :=
        Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.2 (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sq_nonneg c) hS)
      have h2 : Real.sqrt S = 0 := Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.2 hS
      simp [h1, h2]
    · rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with hc | hc
      · subst hc; simp
      · have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt S := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hS
        have hsq : Real.sqrt S ^ 2 = S := Real.sq_sqrt hS.le
        have h1 : Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 * S) = |c| * Real.sqrt S := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_mul' _ hS.le, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
        rw [h1]
        generalize Real.sqrt S = s at hs hsq ⊢
        subst hsq
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hc with hc' | hc'
        · rw [abs_of_neg hc']
          field_simp
          ring
        · rw [abs_of_pos hc']
          field_simp
          ring
  have key : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 3, A i j = A j i) →
      ∀ (ν η : Fin 3 → ℝ) (Hw : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
      ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * (c * Hw i j + ν i * η j + ν j * η i)) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * (c * ν i) * (c * ν j)) -
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          A i a * (c * ν a) * (A j b * (c * ν b)) * (c * Hw i j + ν i * η j + ν j * η i)) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * (c * ν i) * (c * ν j)) ^ 3) * |c| =
      c * ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * Hw i j) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ν i * ν j) -
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          A i a * ν a * (A j b * ν b) * Hw i j) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ν i * ν j) ^ 3) := by
    intro A hA ν η Hw c
    have B1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * (c * ν i) * (c * ν j) =
        c ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ν i * ν j := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have B2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * (c * Hw i j + ν i * η j + ν j * η i) =
        c * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * Hw i j) +
          2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ν i * η j := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [hA 1 0, hA 2 0, hA 2 1]
      ring
    have B3 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          A i a * (c * ν a) * (A j b * (c * ν b)) * (c * Hw i j + ν i * η j + ν j * η i) =
        c ^ 3 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          A i a * ν a * (A j b * ν b) * Hw i j) +
        2 * c ^ 2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ν i * ν j) *
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ν i * η j := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [hA 1 0, hA 2 0, hA 2 1]
      ring
    rw [B1, B2, B3]
    exact fin _ _ _ _ c
  
  simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, lapLoc, e1, e2]
  exact key _ hA (fun k => partialDeriv k w z) (fun k => partialDeriv k h z)
    (fun i j => hessLoc G w i j z) (h z)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hpdv : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) U := by
    intro f hf i
    have hD := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf).2
    exact hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hdet3 : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) U := by
    intro H hH
    have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
        H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
          - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
          + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H y)
    rw [hfun]
    have t1 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 0)
    exact ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
  
  have hdetU : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hGi : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) U := by
    intro k l
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := hdet3 G hG
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det) U := by
      apply hdet3
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = l
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hG a b
    refine ((h1.inv hdetU).mul h2).congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
      smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hSpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j φ y := by
    intro y hy
    have hx0 : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k φ y) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hdφ y hy
      have hlin : (fderiv ℝ φ y : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) = 0 :=
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext (fun i => by
          have := congrFun h0 i
          simpa [partialDeriv] using this)
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun hlin v
      simpa using this
    have hpos := (hpd y hy).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx0
    refine lt_of_lt_of_eq hpos ?_
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
    ring
  
  have hdG : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b)) U :=
    fun m a b => hpdv _ (hG a b) m
  have hp : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv k φ) U := hpdv φ hφ
  have hpp : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ)) U :=
    fun i j => hpdv _ (hp j) i
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
      (hGi k l).mul (((hdG i j l).add (hdG j i l)).sub (hdG l i j)))
  have hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G φ i j) U := by
    intro i j
    unfold hessLoc
    exact (hpp i j).sub (ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hΓ k i j).mul (hp k))
  have hLap : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lapLoc G φ) U := by
    unfold lapLoc
    exact ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => (hGi i j).mul (hH i j)
  have hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j φ y) U :=
    ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ((hGi i j).mul (hp i)).mul (hp j)
  have hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j φ y)) U :=
    hS.sqrt (fun y hy => (hSpos y hy).ne')
  have hNne : ∀ y ∈ U, Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j φ y) ≠ 0 :=
    fun y hy => Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.2 (hSpos y hy)
  have hN3 := hN.pow 3
  have hQ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a φ y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b φ y) *
        hessLoc G φ i j y) U :=
    ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ =>
      ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ =>
        (((hGi i a).mul (hp a)).mul ((hGi j b).mul (hp b))).mul (hH i j)
  have hfin := (hLap.div hN hNne).sub (hQ.div hN3 (fun y hy => pow_ne_zero 3 (hNne y hy)))
  exact hfin.congr (fun y _ => rfl)

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ) (hφ₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₁ U)
    (hφ₂ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ₂ U) (hdφ₁ : fderiv ℝ φ₁ y₀ ≠ 0)
    (h1 : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j φ₁ y₀ = partialDeriv j φ₂ y₀)
    (h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁) y₀ =
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂) y₀) (a : Fin 3) :
    partialDeriv a (levelMeanCurvCoord G φ₁) y₀ - partialDeriv a (levelMeanCurvCoord G φ₂) y₀ =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        ((G y₀)⁻¹ i j / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
            (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀ * partialDeriv l φ₁ y₀) -
          (∑ k : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀) *
            (∑ l : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ j l * partialDeriv l φ₁ y₀) /
            Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
              (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀ * partialDeriv l φ₁ y₀) ^ 3) *
        (partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁)) y₀ -
          partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂)) y₀)

(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)

    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)

          (∑ k : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀) *

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have rCongr : ∀ {F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ} {d d' : ℝ}, lmcJAgree a y₀ F₁ F₂ d → d = d' →
      lmcJAgree a y₀ F₁ F₂ d' := by
    intro F₁ F₂ d d' h hd; subst hd; exact h
  have rCommon : ∀ {c : E3 → ℝ}, DifferentiableAt ℝ c y₀ → lmcJAgree a y₀ c c 0 :=
    fun hc => ⟨hc, hc, rfl, sub_self _⟩
  have rMul : ∀ {F₁ F₂ K₁ K₂ : E3 → ℝ} {d d' : ℝ}, lmcJAgree a y₀ F₁ F₂ d →
      lmcJAgree a y₀ K₁ K₂ d' →
      lmcJAgree a y₀ (fun y => F₁ y * K₁ y) (fun y => F₂ y * K₂ y) (d * K₁ y₀ + F₁ y₀ * d') := by
    rintro F₁ F₂ K₁ K₂ d d' ⟨hF₁, hF₂, hFv, hFd⟩ ⟨hK₁, hK₂, hKv, hKd⟩
    refine ⟨hF₁.mul hK₁, hF₂.mul hK₂, by simp only [hFv, hKv], ?_⟩
    unfold partialDeriv at hFd hKd ⊢
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hF₁ hK₁, fderiv_fun_mul hF₂ hK₂]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← hFd, ← hKd, hFv, hKv]
    ring
  have rSub : ∀ {F₁ F₂ K₁ K₂ : E3 → ℝ} {d d' : ℝ}, lmcJAgree a y₀ F₁ F₂ d →
      lmcJAgree a y₀ K₁ K₂ d' →
      lmcJAgree a y₀ (fun y => F₁ y - K₁ y) (fun y => F₂ y - K₂ y) (d - d') := by
    rintro F₁ F₂ K₁ K₂ d d' ⟨hF₁, hF₂, hFv, hFd⟩ ⟨hK₁, hK₂, hKv, hKd⟩
    refine ⟨hF₁.sub hK₁, hF₂.sub hK₂, by simp only [hFv, hKv], ?_⟩
    unfold partialDeriv at hFd hKd ⊢
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub hF₁ hK₁, fderiv_fun_sub hF₂ hK₂]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
    rw [← hFd, ← hKd]
    ring
  have rSum : ∀ {F₁ F₂ : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ} {d : Fin 3 → ℝ},
      (∀ i, lmcJAgree a y₀ (F₁ i) (F₂ i) (d i)) →
      lmcJAgree a y₀ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, F₁ i y) (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, F₂ i y)
        (∑ i : Fin 3, d i) := by
    intro F₁ F₂ d h
    refine ⟨DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun i _ => (h i).1),
      DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun i _ => (h i).2.1), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (h i).2.2.1)
    · unfold partialDeriv
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => (h i).1), fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => (h i).2.1)]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => (h i).2.2.2)
  have rComp : ∀ {F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ} {d : ℝ} (g : ℝ → ℝ) (g' : ℝ), HasDerivAt g g' (F₁ y₀) →
      lmcJAgree a y₀ F₁ F₂ d →
      lmcJAgree a y₀ (fun y => g (F₁ y)) (fun y => g (F₂ y)) (g' * d) := by
    rintro F₁ F₂ d g g' hg ⟨hF₁, hF₂, hFv, hFd⟩
    have hg2 : HasDerivAt g g' (F₂ y₀) := by rw [← hFv]; exact hg
    have k1 := hg.comp_hasFDerivAt y₀ hF₁.hasFDerivAt
    have k2 := hg2.comp_hasFDerivAt y₀ hF₂.hasFDerivAt
    refine ⟨k1.differentiableAt, k2.differentiableAt, by simp only [hFv], ?_⟩
    unfold partialDeriv at hFd ⊢
    rw [show (fun y => g (F₁ y)) = g ∘ F₁ from rfl, show (fun y => g (F₂ y)) = g ∘ F₂ from rfl,
      k1.fderiv, k2.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← hFd]
    ring
  have rDiv : ∀ {A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ : E3 → ℝ} {dA dB : ℝ}, lmcJAgree a y₀ A₁ A₂ dA →
      lmcJAgree a y₀ B₁ B₂ dB → B₁ y₀ ≠ 0 →
      lmcJAgree a y₀ (fun y => A₁ y / B₁ y) (fun y => A₂ y / B₂ y)
        (dA * (B₁ y₀)⁻¹ + A₁ y₀ * (-(B₁ y₀ ^ 2)⁻¹ * dB)) := by
    intro A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ dA dB hA hB hB0
    have hI := rComp (fun t => t⁻¹) _ (hasDerivAt_inv hB0) hB
    have hM := rMul hA hI
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact hM
  
  have hK : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (k : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv k f) U := by
    intro f k hf
    exact (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hD : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → DifferentiableAt ℝ f y₀ := fun f hf =>
    (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy₀)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hGent : ∀ k l, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y k l) y₀ := fun k l => hD _ (hG k l)
  have hdet : (G y₀).det ≠ 0 := (hpd y₀ hy₀).det_pos.ne'
  have hdetD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y).det) y₀ := by
    simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    have h00 := hGent 0 0; have h01 := hGent 0 1; have h02 := hGent 0 2
    have h10 := hGent 1 0; have h11 := hGent 1 1; have h12 := hGent 1 2
    have h20 := hGent 2 0; have h21 := hGent 2 1; have h22 := hGent 2 2
    fun_prop
  have hGi : ∀ k l, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) y₀ := by
    intro k l
    have hfun : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) = fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate k l := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rw [hfun]
    refine (hdetD.inv hdet).mul ?_
    have h00 := hGent 0 0; have h01 := hGent 0 1; have h02 := hGent 0 2
    have h10 := hGent 1 0; have h11 := hGent 1 1; have h12 := hGent 1 2
    have h20 := hGent 2 0; have h21 := hGent 2 1; have h22 := hGent 2 2
    simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;> simp <;> fun_prop
  have hpdG : ∀ i j l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l)) y₀ :=
    fun i j l => hD _ (hK _ _ (hG j l))
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (christoffel G k i j) y₀ := by
    intro k i j
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y
        - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y)) y₀
    exact DifferentiableAt.const_mul (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun l _ =>
      (hGi k l).mul (((hpdG i j l).add (hpdG j i l)).sub (hpdG l i j))) _
  
  have hSpos : 0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀ * partialDeriv l φ₁ y₀ := by
    have hξ : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hdφ₁
      have hlin : (fderiv ℝ φ₁ y₀ : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) = 0 :=
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext (fun i => by
          simpa [partialDeriv] using congrFun h i)
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun hlin v
      simpa using this
    have hpos := (hpd y₀ hy₀).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ
    have heq : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀ * partialDeriv l φ₁ y₀ =
        dotProduct (star (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀))
          (Matrix.mulVec (G y₀)⁻¹ (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀)) := by
      simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
      ring
    rw [heq]; exact hpos
  have hN0 : Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀ * partialDeriv l φ₁ y₀) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hSpos).ne'
  
  have aP : ∀ k, lmcJAgree a y₀ (partialDeriv k φ₁) (partialDeriv k φ₂) 0 := fun k =>
    ⟨hD _ (hK _ _ hφ₁), hD _ (hK _ _ hφ₂), h1 k, by rw [h2 a k, sub_self]⟩
  have aM : ∀ i j, lmcJAgree a y₀ (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁))
      (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂))
      (partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁)) y₀ -
          partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂)) y₀) := fun i j =>
    ⟨hD _ (hK _ _ (hK _ _ hφ₁)), hD _ (hK _ _ (hK _ _ hφ₂)), h2 i j, rfl⟩
  have aHess : ∀ i j, lmcJAgree a y₀ (fun y => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁) y -
        ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k φ₁ y)
      (fun y => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂) y -
        ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k φ₂ y)
      (partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁)) y₀ -
          partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂)) y₀) := fun i j =>
    rCongr (rSub (aM i j) (rSum fun k => rMul (rCommon (hΓ k i j)) (aP k))) (by simp)
  have aS : lmcJAgree a y₀
      (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i φ₁ y * partialDeriv j φ₁ y)
      (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i φ₂ y * partialDeriv j φ₂ y)
      0 :=
    rCongr (rSum fun i => rSum fun j => rMul (rMul (rCommon (hGi i j)) (aP i)) (aP j))
      (by simp)
  have aSqrt : lmcJAgree a y₀
      (fun y => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i φ₁ y * partialDeriv j φ₁ y))
      (fun y => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i φ₂ y * partialDeriv j φ₂ y))
      0 :=
    rCongr (rComp Real.sqrt _ (Real.hasDerivAt_sqrt hSpos.ne') aS) (mul_zero _)
  have aPow : lmcJAgree a y₀
      (fun y => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i φ₁ y * partialDeriv j φ₁ y) ^ 3)
      (fun y => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i φ₂ y * partialDeriv j φ₂ y) ^ 3)
      0 :=
    rCongr (rComp (fun t => t ^ 3) _ (hasDerivAt_pow 3 _) aSqrt) (mul_zero _)
  have aL : lmcJAgree a y₀
      (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j *
        (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁) y -
          ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k φ₁ y))
      (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j *
        (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂) y -
          ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k φ₂ y))
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ i j *
        (partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁)) y₀ -
          partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂)) y₀)) :=
    rCongr (rSum fun i => rSum fun j => rMul (rCommon (hGi i j)) (aHess i j)) (by simp)
  have aQ : lmcJAgree a y₀
      (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i c * partialDeriv c φ₁ y * ((G y)⁻¹ j d * partialDeriv d φ₁ y) *
          (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁) y -
            ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k φ₁ y))
      (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i c * partialDeriv c φ₂ y * ((G y)⁻¹ j d * partialDeriv d φ₂ y) *
          (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂) y -
            ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k φ₂ y))
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        (G y₀)⁻¹ i c * partialDeriv c φ₁ y₀ * ((G y₀)⁻¹ j d * partialDeriv d φ₁ y₀) *
          (partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁)) y₀ -
            partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂)) y₀)) :=
    rCongr (rSum fun i => rSum fun j => rSum fun c => rSum fun d =>
      rMul (rMul (rMul (rCommon (hGi i c)) (aP c)) (rMul (rCommon (hGi j d)) (aP d)))
        (aHess i j)) (by simp only [zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add])
  have aH : lmcJAgree a y₀ (levelMeanCurvCoord G φ₁) (levelMeanCurvCoord G φ₂)
      ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ i j *
        (partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁)) y₀ -
          partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂)) y₀)) *
        (Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀ * partialDeriv l φ₁ y₀))⁻¹ -
       (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        (G y₀)⁻¹ i c * partialDeriv c φ₁ y₀ * ((G y₀)⁻¹ j d * partialDeriv d φ₁ y₀) *
          (partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₁)) y₀ -
            partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j φ₂)) y₀)) *
        (Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k φ₁ y₀ * partialDeriv l φ₁ y₀) ^ 3)⁻¹) :=
    rCongr (rSub (rDiv aL aSqrt hN0) (rDiv aQ aPow (pow_ne_zero 3 hN0)))
      (by simp only [mul_zero, add_zero])
  rw [aH.2.2.2]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (ψ : E3 → ℝ)
    (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U) (hψ0 : ψ y₀ = 0) (t : ℝ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)) U ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)) y₀ = fderiv ℝ ψ y₀ ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)) y₀ =
        partialDeriv j ψ y₀) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2))) y₀ =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) y₀) ∧
      (∀ a i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
          (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)))) y₀ =
        partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ)) y₀ +
          2 * t * ((if i = j then partialDeriv a ψ y₀ else 0) +
            (if a = j then partialDeriv i ψ y₀ else 0) +
            (if a = i then partialDeriv j ψ y₀ else 0)))

signature.name: bump_jets
signature.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (ψ : E3 → ℝ)
    (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U) (hψ0 : ψ y₀ = 0) (t : ℝ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)) U ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)) y₀ = fderiv ℝ ψ y₀ ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)) y₀ =
        partialDeriv j ψ y₀) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2))) y₀ =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) y₀) ∧
      (∀ a i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
          (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)))) y₀ =
        partialDeriv a (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ)) y₀ +
          2 * t * ((if i = j then partialDeriv a ψ y₀ else 0) +
            (if a = j then partialDeriv i ψ y₀ else 0) +
            (if a = i then partialDeriv j ψ y₀ else 0)))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hpdC : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv j f) U := by
    intro f hf j
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) U :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf).2
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdiff : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ f z := by
    intro f hf z hz
    exact (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hprod : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z → DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => f y * g y) z =
        partialDeriv i f z * g z + f z * partialDeriv i g z := by
    intro f g z hf hg i
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hadd : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z → DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => f y + g y) z =
        partialDeriv i f z + partialDeriv i g z := by
    intro f g z hf hg i
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hg]
    rfl
  have hloc : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3), z ∈ U → (∀ y ∈ U, f y = g y) → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i f z = partialDeriv i g z := by
    intro f g z hz hfg i
    have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 z] g := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hz) hfg
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hconst : ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : E3) (i : Fin 3), partialDeriv i (fun _ => c) z = 0 := by
    intro c z i
    unfold partialDeriv
    simp
  
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ : ∃ h : E3 → ℝ, h = fun y => 1 + t * ‖y - y₀‖ ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hφ : (fun z => ψ z * (1 + t * ‖z - y₀‖ ^ 2)) = fun z => ψ z * h z := by
    rw [hh]
  rw [hφ]
  have hhC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h := by
    rw [hh]
    exact contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul
      ((contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)))
  have hhD : ∀ z, DifferentiableAt ℝ h z := fun z => (hhC.differentiable (by simp)) z
  have hh0 : h y₀ = 1 := by rw [hh]; simp
  have hhpd : ∀ (z : E3) (j : Fin 3), partialDeriv j h z = 2 * t * (z j - y₀ j) := by
    intro z j
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y - y₀) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3) z :=
      (hasFDerivAt_id z).sub_const y₀
    have h2 := ((hd.norm_sq).const_mul t).const_add 1
    rw [hh]
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h2.fderiv]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    ring
  
  have hcH : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (z : E3), HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => 2 * t * (y j - y₀ j))
      ((2 * t) • (PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) z := by
    intro j z
    have := (((PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) j).hasFDerivAt (x := z)).sub_const
      (y₀ j)).const_mul (2 * t)
    convert this using 1
  have hcD : ∀ (j : Fin 3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : E3 => 2 * t * (y j - y₀ j)) z :=
    fun j z => (hcH j z).differentiableAt
  have hcpd : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      partialDeriv i (fun y : E3 => 2 * t * (y j - y₀ j)) z = if i = j then 2 * t else 0 := by
    intro z i j
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [(hcH j z).fderiv]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; simp
    · simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hij, Ne.symm hij]
  
  have hψD : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z := hdiff ψ hψ
  have hψ1C : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv j ψ) U := hpdC ψ hψ
  have hψ1D : ∀ j, ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv j ψ) z :=
    fun j => hdiff _ (hψ1C j)
  have hψ2D : ∀ i j, ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ)) z :=
    fun i j => hdiff _ (hpdC _ (hψ1C j) i)
  
  have hA : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ U, partialDeriv j (fun y => ψ y * h y) y =
      partialDeriv j ψ y * h y + ψ y * (2 * t * (y j - y₀ j)) := by
    intro j y hy
    rw [hprod ψ h y (hψD y hy) (hhD y) j, hhpd y j]
  
  have hB : ∀ i j, ∀ z ∈ U, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => ψ y * h y)) z =
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) z * h z + partialDeriv j ψ z * (2 * t * (z i - y₀ i)) +
        (partialDeriv i ψ z * (2 * t * (z j - y₀ j)) + ψ z * (if i = j then 2 * t else 0)) := by
    intro i j z hz
    rw [hloc _ (fun y => partialDeriv j ψ y * h y + ψ y * (2 * t * (y j - y₀ j))) z hz (hA j) i]
    rw [hadd (fun y => partialDeriv j ψ y * h y) (fun y => ψ y * (2 * t * (y j - y₀ j))) z
      ((hψ1D j z hz).mul (hhD z)) ((hψD z hz).mul (hcD j z)) i]
    rw [hprod (partialDeriv j ψ) h z (hψ1D j z hz) (hhD z) i,
      hprod ψ (fun y : E3 => 2 * t * (y j - y₀ j)) z (hψD z hz) (hcD j z) i, hhpd, hcpd]
  refine ⟨hψ.mul hhC.contDiffOn, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hψD y₀ hy₀) (hhD y₀), hψ0, hh0, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
  · intro j
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hψD y₀ hy₀) (hhD y₀), hψ0, hh0, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
  · intro i j
    rw [hB i j y₀ hy₀, hh0, hψ0]
    simp
  · intro a i j
    rw [hloc _ (fun z => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) z * h z +
        partialDeriv j ψ z * (2 * t * (z i - y₀ i)) +
        (partialDeriv i ψ z * (2 * t * (z j - y₀ j)) + ψ z * (if i = j then 2 * t else 0)))
        y₀ hy₀ (hB i j) a]
    have d1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) z * h z) y₀ :=
      (hψ2D i j y₀ hy₀).mul (hhD y₀)
    have d2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z * (2 * t * (z i - y₀ i))) y₀ :=
      (hψ1D j y₀ hy₀).mul (hcD i y₀)
    have d3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv i ψ z * (2 * t * (z j - y₀ j))) y₀ :=
      (hψ1D i y₀ hy₀).mul (hcD j y₀)
    have d4 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ψ z * (if i = j then 2 * t else 0)) y₀ :=
      (hψD y₀ hy₀).mul (differentiableAt_const _)
    rw [hadd (fun z => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) z * h z +
        partialDeriv j ψ z * (2 * t * (z i - y₀ i)))
      (fun z => partialDeriv i ψ z * (2 * t * (z j - y₀ j)) + ψ z * (if i = j then 2 * t else 0))
      y₀ (d1.add d2) (d3.add d4) a]
    rw [hadd _ _ y₀ d1 d2 a, hadd _ _ y₀ d3 d4 a]
    rw [hprod (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ)) h y₀ (hψ2D i j y₀ hy₀) (hhD y₀) a,
      hprod (partialDeriv j ψ) (fun z : E3 => 2 * t * (z i - y₀ i)) y₀ (hψ1D j y₀ hy₀)
        (hcD i y₀) a,
      hprod (partialDeriv i ψ) (fun z : E3 => 2 * t * (z j - y₀ j)) y₀ (hψ1D i y₀ hy₀)
        (hcD j y₀) a,
      hprod ψ (fun _ : E3 => if i = j then 2 * t else 0) y₀ (hψD y₀ hy₀)
        (differentiableAt_const _) a,
      hh0, hhpd, hcpd, hcpd, hconst, hψ0]
    simp only [sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_mul, mul_one]
    split_ifs <;> ring

informal_problem.statement:
(M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hM : M.PosDef)
    (hMs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, M i j = M j i) (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hξ : ξ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (M⁻¹ i j / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, M⁻¹ k l * ξ k * ξ l) -
        (∑ k : Fin 3, M⁻¹ i k * ξ k) * (∑ l : Fin 3, M⁻¹ j l * ξ l) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, M⁻¹ k l * ξ k * ξ l) ^ 3) *
      ((if i = j then ξ a else 0) + (if a = j then ξ i else 0) + (if a = i then ξ j else 0)) =
        c * ξ a

signature.name: bump_trace_coeff
signature.statement:
(M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hM : M.PosDef)
    (hMs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, M i j = M j i) (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hξ : ξ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ a : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (M⁻¹ i j / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, M⁻¹ k l * ξ k * ξ l) -
        (∑ k : Fin 3, M⁻¹ i k * ξ k) * (∑ l : Fin 3, M⁻¹ j l * ξ l) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, M⁻¹ k l * ξ k * ξ l) ^ 3) *
      ((if i = j then ξ a else 0) + (if a = j then ξ i else 0) + (if a = i then ξ j else 0)) =
        c * ξ a

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsym : ∀ i j : Fin 3, M⁻¹ i j = M⁻¹ j i := by
    have hT : M.transpose = M := Matrix.ext (fun i j => (hMs j i))
    have h := Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv M
    rw [hT] at h
    intro i j
    have := congrFun (congrFun h j) i
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using this
  have hpos : ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, x ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, M⁻¹ k l * x k * x l := by
    intro x hx
    have h := hM.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h ⊢
    convert h using 1
    ring
  generalize M⁻¹ = A at hsym hpos ⊢
  
  have hs : 0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A k l * ξ k * ξ l := hpos ξ hξ
  have hr2 := Real.sq_sqrt hs.le
  have hr := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs
  generalize Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A k l * ξ k * ξ l) = r at hr2 hr ⊢
  obtain ⟨s, hsdef⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A k l * ξ k * ξ l := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hsdef] at hs hr2
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i, u i = ∑ k : Fin 3, A i k * ξ k := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  simp only [← hu]
  have hF2 : ∑ j : Fin 3, u j * ξ j = s := by
    rw [hsdef]; simp only [hu, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  have hF3 : ∀ a, ∑ i : Fin 3, A i a * ξ i = u a := by
    intro a; rw [hu a]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [hsym])
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
  
  have generic : ∀ (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ), (∀ a, ∑ j : Fin 3, B a j * ξ j = 0) →
      (∀ a, ∑ i : Fin 3, B i a * ξ i = 0) → ∀ a, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B i j *
        ((if i = j then ξ a else 0) + (if a = j then ξ i else 0) + (if a = i then ξ j else 0)) =
        (∑ i : Fin 3, B i i) * ξ a := by
    intro B h1 h2 a
    have e1 := h1 a
    have e2 := h2 a
    fin_cases a <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three] at e1 e2 ⊢ <;> linear_combination e1 + e2
  have h1 : ∀ a, ∑ j : Fin 3, (A a j / r - u a * u j / r ^ 3) * ξ j = 0 := by
    intro a
    have : ∑ j : Fin 3, (A a j / r - u a * u j / r ^ 3) * ξ j =
        (∑ j : Fin 3, A a j * ξ j) / r - u a * (∑ j : Fin 3, u j * ξ j) / r ^ 3 := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [this, ← hu a, hF2, ← hr2]
    field_simp
    ring
  have h2 : ∀ a, ∑ i : Fin 3, (A i a / r - u i * u a / r ^ 3) * ξ i = 0 := by
    intro a
    have : ∑ i : Fin 3, (A i a / r - u i * u a / r ^ 3) * ξ i =
        (∑ i : Fin 3, A i a * ξ i) / r - u a * (∑ j : Fin 3, u j * ξ j) / r ^ 3 := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [this, hF3 a, hF2, ← hr2]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ k i, w k i = s * (if i = k then 1 else 0) - u k * ξ i :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hQ : ∀ k, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * w k i * w k j = s * (s * A k k - u k * u k) := by
    intro k
    have ec := hsdef
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at ec
    fin_cases k
    · have ea := (hu 0).symm
      have eb := hF3 0
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at ea eb
      simp [hw, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination (-s * u 0) * ea + (-s * u 0) * eb - (u 0) ^ 2 * ec
    · have ea := (hu 1).symm
      have eb := hF3 1
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at ea eb
      simp [hw, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination (-s * u 1) * ea + (-s * u 1) * eb - (u 1) ^ 2 * ec
    · have ea := (hu 2).symm
      have eb := hF3 2
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at ea eb
      simp [hw, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination (-s * u 2) * ea + (-s * u 2) * eb - (u 2) ^ 2 * ec
  have hnn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ s * A k k - u k * u k := by
    intro k
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * w k i * w k j := by
      by_cases hwk : w k = 0
      · simp [hwk]
      · exact (hpos _ hwk).le
    rw [hQ k] at h0
    exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hs).mp h0
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, ξ m ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    exact hξ (funext hcon)
  have hstrict : ∀ k, k ≠ m → 0 < s * A k k - u k * u k := by
    intro k hkm
    have hwk : w k ≠ 0 := by
      intro hw0
      have hcm := congrFun hw0 m
      rw [hw, if_neg (Ne.symm hkm)] at hcm
      have huk : u k = 0 := by
        simp only [mul_zero, zero_sub, Pi.zero_apply, neg_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero] at hcm
        tauto
      have hck := congrFun hw0 k
      rw [hw, if_pos rfl, huk] at hck
      simp at hck
      exact hs.ne' hck
    have h0 := hpos _ hwk
    rw [hQ k] at h0
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hs).mp h0
  have hgap : 0 < (∑ i : Fin 3, A i i) * s - ∑ i : Fin 3, u i * u i := by
    have e0 := hnn 0
    have e1 := hnn 1
    have e2 := hnn 2
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    by_cases hm0 : m = 0
    · have := hstrict 1 (by rw [hm0]; decide)
      linarith
    · have := hstrict 0 (fun h => hm0 h.symm)
      linarith
  
  refine ⟨∑ i : Fin 3, (A i i / r - u i * u i / r ^ 3), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hc : ∑ i : Fin 3, (A i i / r - u i * u i / r ^ 3) =
        ((∑ i : Fin 3, A i i) * s - ∑ i : Fin 3, u i * u i) / r ^ 3 := by
      rw [← hr2]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hc]
    exact div_pos hgap (pow_pos hr 3)
  · intro a
    exact generic (fun i j => A i j / r - u i * u j / r ^ 3) h1 h2 a

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U)
    (φ K : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 φ U) (hK : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 K U)
    (hφ0 : φ y₀ = 0) (hzero : ∀ z ∈ U, φ z = 0 → K z = 0)
    (hpos : 0 < partialDeriv a φ y₀ * partialDeriv a K y₀) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ Metric.ball y₀ ε ⊆ U ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ε, φ z ≤ 0 → K z ≤ 0

signature.name: sign_transfer_axis
signature.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U)
    (φ K : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 φ U) (hK : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 K U)
    (hφ0 : φ y₀ = 0) (hzero : ∀ z ∈ U, φ z = 0 → K z = 0)
    (hpos : 0 < partialDeriv a φ y₀ * partialDeriv a K y₀) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ Metric.ball y₀ ε ⊆ U ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ε, φ z ≤ 0 → K z ≤ 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have dirpos : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → ∀ v : E3, 0 < fderiv ℝ f y₀ v →
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball y₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ f y ∧ 0 < fderiv ℝ f y v := by
    intro f hf v hv
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) U := hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl
    have hdir : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y v) U := hcont.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, 0 < fderiv ℝ f y v :=
      continuousAt_const.eventually_lt (hdir.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hy₀)) hv
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (hev.and (hU.mem_nhds hy₀))
    refine ⟨r, hr, fun y hy => (hball y hy).2, fun y hy => ⟨?_, (hball y hy).1⟩⟩
    exact (hf.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hball y hy).2)
  
  have linelt : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (v : E3) (r : ℝ),
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y ∧ 0 < fderiv ℝ f y v) →
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → z + t • v ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r →
        f z < f (z + t • v) := by
    intro f v r hf z hz t ht hzt
    have hseg : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) t, z + s • v ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r := by
      intro s hs
      have h1 : 0 ≤ s / t := div_nonneg hs.1 ht.le
      have h2 : s / t ≤ 1 := (div_le_one ht).mpr hs.2
      have := (convex_ball y₀ r).add_smul_mem hz hzt ⟨h1, h2⟩
      rwa [smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ s ht.ne'] at this
    have hderiv : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) t,
        HasDerivAt (fun s => f (z + s • v)) (fderiv ℝ f (z + s • v) v) s := by
      intro s hs
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z + s • v) v s := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const v).const_add z
      exact (hf _ (hseg s hs)).1.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hl
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun s => f (z + s • v)) (Set.Icc 0 t) :=
      fun s hs => (hderiv s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξeq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun s => f (z + s • v))
      (fun s => fderiv ℝ f (z + s • v) v) ht hcont
      (fun s hs => hderiv s (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hs))
    have hpos' : 0 < fderiv ℝ f (z + ξ • v) v := (hf _ (hseg ξ (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hξ))).2
    rw [hξeq] at hpos'
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, sub_zero] at hpos'
    have := (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right ht).mp hpos'
    linarith
  
  have segzero : ∀ (z v : E3) (δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ → (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) δ, z + s • v ∈ U) →
      φ z ≤ 0 → 0 < φ (z + δ • v) → ∃ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) δ, φ (z + s • v) = 0 := by
    intro z v δ hδ hseg h0 h1
    have hline : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => z + s • v) :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
    have hg : ContinuousOn (fun s => φ (z + s • v)) (Set.Icc 0 δ) :=
      hφ.continuousOn.comp hline.continuousOn hseg
    have hmem : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (φ (z + (0:ℝ) • v)) (φ (z + δ • v)) := by
      rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
      exact ⟨h0, h1.le⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hs0⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hδ hg hmem
    exact ⟨s, hs, hs0⟩
  
  have hc : partialDeriv a φ y₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_mul] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
  have hφv : 0 < fderiv ℝ φ y₀ (partialDeriv a φ y₀ • e a) := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_self_pos.mpr hc
  have hKv : 0 < fderiv ℝ K y₀ (partialDeriv a φ y₀ • e a) := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact hpos
  generalize partialDeriv a φ y₀ • e a = v at hφv hKv
  have hvn : 0 < ‖v‖ := by
    rw [norm_pos_iff]
    rintro rfl
    simp at hφv
  
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hr₁U, H₁⟩ := dirpos φ hφ v hφv
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, -, H₂⟩ := dirpos K hK v hKv
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R, R = min r₁ r₂ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR0 : 0 < R := hRdef ▸ lt_min hr₁ hr₂
  have hRr₁ : R ≤ r₁ := hRdef ▸ min_le_left _ _
  have hRr₂ : R ≤ r₂ := hRdef ▸ min_le_right _ _
  have HR1 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R, DifferentiableAt ℝ φ y ∧ 0 < fderiv ℝ φ y v :=
    fun y hy => H₁ y (Metric.ball_subset_ball hRr₁ hy)
  have HR2 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R, DifferentiableAt ℝ K y ∧ 0 < fderiv ℝ K y v :=
    fun y hy => H₂ y (Metric.ball_subset_ball hRr₂ hy)
  have hRU : Metric.ball y₀ R ⊆ U := (Metric.ball_subset_ball hRr₁).trans hr₁U
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδdef⟩ : ∃ δ, δ = R / (2 * ‖v‖) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := hδdef ▸ div_pos hR0 (by positivity)
  have hδv : δ * ‖v‖ = R / 2 := by
    rw [hδdef]
    field_simp
  have hy₁ : y₀ + δ • v ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg hδ0.le, hδv]
    linarith
  have hφy₁ : 0 < φ (y₀ + δ • v) := by
    have := linelt φ v R HR1 y₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hR0) δ hδ0 hy₁
    rwa [hφ0] at this
  have hcy₁ : ContinuousAt φ (y₀ + δ • v) :=
    hφ.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds (hRU hy₁))
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηball⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hcy₁ hφy₁)
  
  refine ⟨min η (R / 2), lt_min hη (by linarith), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (Metric.ball_subset_ball ((min_le_right _ _).trans (by linarith))).trans hRU
  · intro z hz hφz
    have hzd : ‖z - y₀‖ < min η (R / 2) := by rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
    have hzη : ‖z - y₀‖ < η := lt_of_lt_of_le hzd (min_le_left _ _)
    have hzR2 : ‖z - y₀‖ < R / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hzd (min_le_right _ _)
    have hseg : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) δ, z + s • v ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      have e1 : z + s • v - y₀ = (z - y₀) + s • v := by abel
      rw [e1]
      have h2 : ‖s • v‖ ≤ δ * ‖v‖ := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs.1]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs.2 (norm_nonneg _)
      calc ‖(z - y₀) + s • v‖ ≤ ‖z - y₀‖ + ‖s • v‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ < R := by linarith
    have hend : 0 < φ (z + δ • v) := by
      have hmem : z + δ • v ∈ Metric.ball (y₀ + δ • v) η := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        have e2 : z + δ • v - (y₀ + δ • v) = z - y₀ := by abel
        rw [e2]
        exact hzη
      exact hηball _ hmem
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hs0⟩ := segzero z v δ hδ0.le (fun s hs => hRU (hseg s hs)) hφz hend
    have hKs : K (z + s • v) = 0 := hzero _ (hRU (hseg s hs)) hs0
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs.1 with h | h
    · rw [← h, zero_smul, add_zero] at hKs
      exact hKs.le
    · have hzR : z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
        linarith
      have := linelt K v R HR2 z hzR s h (hseg s hs)
      linarith

informal_problem.statement: (ρ W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hρ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ) (hρc : HasCompactSupport ρ) (hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 W) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x => ∫ z, ρ z * W (x - z)) ∧ ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (j : Fin 2), smthGrad (fun x => ∫ z, ρ z * W (x - z)) x j = ∫ z, ρ z * smthGrad W (x - z) j

signature.name: smth_liou_moll_smooth
signature.statement: (ρ W : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hρ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ) (hρc : HasCompactSupport ρ) (hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 W) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x => ∫ z, ρ z * W (x - z)) ∧ ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (j : Fin 2), smthGrad (fun x => ∫ z, ρ z * W (x - z)) x j = ∫ z, ρ z * smthGrad W (x - z) j

proof.tactics:
by
  have hρcont : Continuous ρ := hρ.continuous
  have hρint : Integrable ρ := hρcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hρc
  have hWcont : Continuous W := hW.continuous
  have hdW : Continuous (fderiv ℝ W) := hW.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
  have hWdiff : Differentiable ℝ W := hW.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hconv : (fun x => ∫ z, ρ z * W (x - z)) =
      convolution ρ W (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume := by
    ext x
    simp [convolution_def]
  have h1 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x => ∫ z, ρ z * W (x - z)) := by
    rw [hconv]
    exact contDiff_infty.mp
      (hρc.contDiff_convolution_left (n := ⊤) _ hρ hWcont.locallyIntegrable) 2
  refine ⟨h1, fun x j => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ z, ρ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ ≤ R := by
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hρc.isCompact.isBounded.subset_closedBall 0
