    exact ⟨R, fun z hz => by
      have := hR (subset_tsupport ρ hz)
      simpa using this⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x (R + 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hdW.continuousOn
  have hF'cont : ∀ y, Continuous (fun z => ρ z • fderiv ℝ W (y - z)) := fun y =>
    hρcont.smul (hdW.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))
  have key : HasFDerivAt (fun x => ∫ z, ρ z * W (x - z))
      (∫ z, ρ z • fderiv ℝ W (x - z)) x := by
    refine hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (bound := fun z => ‖ρ z‖ * C)
      (F := fun y z => ρ z * W (y - z)) (F' := fun y z => ρ z • fderiv ℝ W (y - z))
      (ball_mem_nhds x one_pos) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y =>
        (hρcont.mul (hWcont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact (hρcont.mul (hWcont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hρc.mul_right)
    · exact (hF'cont x).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z y hy => ?_
      rw [norm_smul]
      by_cases hz : ρ z = 0
      · simp only [hz, norm_zero, zero_mul]
        exact le_refl _
      · refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC _ ?_) (norm_nonneg _)
        rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have h1 := hR z hz
        have h2 : ‖y - x‖ < 1 := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hy
        calc ‖y - z - x‖ = ‖(y - x) - z‖ := by congr 1; abel
          _ ≤ ‖y - x‖ + ‖z‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ R + 1 := by linarith
    · exact hρint.norm.mul_const C
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z y _ => ?_
      have h := ((hWdiff (y - z)).hasFDerivAt.comp y ((hasFDerivAt_id y).sub_const z)).const_mul (ρ z)
      simpa using h
  have hint : Integrable (fun z => ρ z • fderiv ℝ W (x - z)) :=
    (hF'cont x).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hρc.smul_right
  show fderiv ℝ (fun x => ∫ z, ρ z * W (x - z)) x (Pi.single j 1) = _
  rw [key.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hint]
  simp [smthGrad]

informal_problem.statement: (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hV : Continuous V) (ρ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hρ : Continuous ρ) (hρc : HasCompactSupport ρ) (hsol : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * V x j * smthGrad φ x i = 0) : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * (∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) * smthGrad φ x i = 0

signature.name: smth_liou_moll_weak
signature.statement: (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hV : Continuous V) (ρ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hρ : Continuous ρ) (hρc : HasCompactSupport ρ) (hsol : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * V x j * smthGrad φ x i = 0) : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * (∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) * smthGrad φ x i = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro φ hφ hφc
  have hgradc : ∀ i : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad φ x i) := by
    intro i
    have h := (hφ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply
      (continuous_const (y := (Pi.single i (1:ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)))
    simpa [smthGrad] using h
  have hgrad0 : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport φ → smthGrad φ x i = 0 := by
    intro i x hx
    have h0 : fderiv ℝ φ x = 0 := by
      have h1 : x ∉ Function.support (fderiv ℝ φ) := fun h => hx (support_fderiv_subset ℝ h)
      simpa using h1
    simp [smthGrad, h0]
  
  have hshift : ∀ z : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * V (x - z) j * smthGrad φ x i = 0 := by
    intro z
    have hφzs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => φ (y + z)) := hφ.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
    have hφzc : HasCompactSupport (fun y => φ (y + z)) := by
      have := hφc.comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.addRight z)
      simpa [Function.comp_def, Homeomorph.coe_addRight] using this
    have hgz : ∀ y (i : Fin 2), smthGrad (fun y => φ (y + z)) y i = smthGrad φ (y + z) i := by
      intro y i
      simp only [smthGrad]
      rw [fderiv_comp_add_right]
    have h := hsol (fun y => φ (y + z)) hφzs hφzc
    simp only [hgz] at h
    have h2 := MeasureTheory.integral_sub_right_eq_self (μ := (volume : Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)))
      (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * V y j * smthGrad φ (y + z) i) z
    simp only [sub_add_cancel] at h2
    rw [h2]
    exact h
  
  have hK : IsCompact (tsupport φ ×ˢ tsupport ρ) := hφc.prod hρc
  let F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x z =>
    ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * (ρ z * V (x - z) j) * smthGrad φ x i
  have hFc : Continuous (Function.uncurry F) := by
    apply continuous_finset_sum
    intro i _
    apply continuous_finset_sum
    intro j _
    exact (continuous_const.mul ((hρ.comp continuous_snd).mul ((continuous_apply j).comp
      (hV.comp (continuous_fst.sub continuous_snd))))).mul ((hgradc i).comp continuous_fst)
  have hFs : HasCompactSupport (Function.uncurry F) := by
    apply HasCompactSupport.intro hK
    rintro ⟨x, z⟩ hp
    simp only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair, F]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport φ
    · have hz : z ∉ tsupport ρ := fun hz => hp ⟨hx, hz⟩
      have hρz : ρ z = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz
      simp [hρz]
    · simp [hgrad0 _ x hx]
  have hFint : Integrable (Function.uncurry F) (volume.prod volume) :=
    hFc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hFs
  have hinner : ∀ x, ∫ z, F x z =
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * (∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) * smthGrad φ x i := by
    intro x
    have hg : ∀ j : Fin 2, Integrable (fun z => ρ z * V (x - z) j) := by
      intro j
      exact (hρ.mul ((continuous_apply j).comp (hV.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)))
        ).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hρc.mul_right
    simp only [F]
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _
      (fun j _ => ((hg j).const_mul _).mul_const _))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ((hg j).const_mul _).mul_const _)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [integral_mul_const, integral_const_mul]
  have hfact : ∀ z, ∫ x, F x z =
      ρ z * ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * V (x - z) j * smthGrad φ x i := by
    intro z
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext x
    simp only [F, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  calc ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * (∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) * smthGrad φ x i
      = ∫ x, ∫ z, F x z := by
        congr 1
        funext x
        rw [hinner]
    _ = ∫ z, ∫ x, F x z := integral_integral_swap hFint
    _ = ∫ z, ρ z * ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * V (x - z) j * smthGrad φ x i := by
        congr 1
        funext z
        exact hfact z
    _ = 0 := by simp only [hshift, mul_zero, integral_zero]

informal_problem.statement: (α : NNReal) (H δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hV : Continuous V) (hH : ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖V ζ - V ζ'‖ ≤ H * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) (ρ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hρ : Continuous ρ) (hρc : HasCompactSupport ρ) (hρ0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) (hρ1 : ∫ z, ρ z = 1) (hρs : ∀ z, ρ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < δ) : (∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖(fun j => ∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) - (fun j => ∫ z, ρ z * V (y - z) j)‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) ∧ (∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖(fun j => ∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) - V x‖ ≤ H * δ ^ (α : ℝ))

signature.name: smth_liou_moll_holder
signature.statement: (α : NNReal) (H δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hV : Continuous V) (hH : ∀ ζ ζ' : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖V ζ - V ζ'‖ ≤ H * ‖ζ - ζ'‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) (ρ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hρ : Continuous ρ) (hρc : HasCompactSupport ρ) (hρ0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) (hρ1 : ∫ z, ρ z = 1) (hρs : ∀ z, ρ z ≠ 0 → ‖z‖ < δ) : (∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖(fun j => ∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) - (fun j => ∫ z, ρ z * V (y - z) j)‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) ∧ (∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖(fun j => ∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) - V x‖ ≤ H * δ ^ (α : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hH0 : 0 ≤ H := by
    have h := hH (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) 0
    have he : ‖((fun _ : Fin 2 => (1:ℝ)) - 0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)‖ = 1 := by
      rw [sub_zero, pi_norm_const, norm_one]
    rw [he, Real.one_rpow, mul_one] at h
    exact (norm_nonneg _).trans h
  
  have avg : ∀ f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Continuous f → ∀ c : ℝ,
      (∀ z, ρ z ≠ 0 → |f z| ≤ c) → |∫ z, ρ z * f z| ≤ c := by
    intro f hf c hfc
    have hg : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ρ z * c) :=
      (hρ.mul continuous_const).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hρc.mul_right
    have hb : ∀ z, ‖ρ z * f z‖ ≤ ρ z * c := by
      intro z
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hρ0 z)]
      by_cases h0 : ρ z = 0
      · simp [h0]
      · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfc z h0) (hρ0 z)
    have h := MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb)
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_mul_const, hρ1, one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact h
  
  have hint : ∀ h : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Continuous h →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ρ z * h z) :=
    fun h hh => (hρ.mul hh).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hρc.mul_right
  have hVc : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (j : Fin 2), Continuous (fun z => V (x - z) j) :=
    fun x j => (continuous_apply j).comp (hV.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))
  refine ⟨fun x y => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · 
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg hH0 (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))).2 (fun j => ?_)
    have i1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ρ z * V (x - z) j) := hint _ (hVc x j)
    have i2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ρ z * V (y - z) j) := hint _ (hVc y j)
    show ‖(∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) - ∫ z, ρ z * V (y - z) j‖ ≤ _
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_sub i1 i2, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    simp_rw [← mul_sub]
    refine avg _ ((hVc x j).sub (hVc y j)) _ (fun z _ => ?_)
    have h1 := norm_le_pi_norm (V (x - z) - V (y - z)) j
    have h2 := hH (x - z) (y - z)
    rw [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right] at h2
    rw [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1.trans h2
  · 
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg hH0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hδ.le _))).2 (fun j => ?_)
    have i1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ρ z * V (x - z) j) := hint _ (hVc x j)
    have i2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ρ z * V x j) :=
      hint (fun _ => V x j) continuous_const
    have hc : (∫ z, ρ z * V x j) = V x j := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_mul_const, hρ1, one_mul]
    show ‖(∫ z, ρ z * V (x - z) j) - V x j‖ ≤ _
    rw [← hc, ← MeasureTheory.integral_sub i1 i2, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    simp_rw [← mul_sub]
    refine avg _ ((hVc x j).sub continuous_const) _ (fun z hz => ?_)
    have h1 := norm_le_pi_norm (V (x - z) - V x) j
    have h2 := hH (x - z) x
    have e : x - z - x = -z := by abel
    rw [e, norm_neg] at h2
    rw [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    have h3 : ‖z‖ ^ (α : ℝ) ≤ δ ^ (α : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg z) (hρs z hz).le α.2
    calc |V (x - z) j - V x j| ≤ H * ‖z‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := h1.trans h2
      _ ≤ H * δ ^ (α : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hH0

informal_problem.statement: (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (hsol : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad u x j * smthGrad φ x i = 0) : ∀ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i = 0

signature.name: smth_liou_pointwise
signature.statement: (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (hsol : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad u x j * smthGrad φ x i = 0) : ∀ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hu1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ u) := hu.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  have hf : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => smthGrad u y j) := fun j =>
    hu1.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hDc : ∀ i j : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i) :=
    fun i j => ((hf j).continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ,
      L = fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hLc : Continuous L := by
    rw [hL]
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuous_finset_sum _ (fun j _ =>
      continuous_const.mul (hDc i j)))
  have hibp : ∀ φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      ∫ x, φ x * L x = 0 := by
    intro φ hφ hφc
    have hφd : Differentiable ℝ φ := hφ.differentiable (by simp)
    have hφc' : Continuous φ := hφ.continuous
    have hψ : ∀ i : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => smthGrad φ x i) := fun i =>
      (hφ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hψc : ∀ i : Fin 2, HasCompactSupport (fun x => smthGrad φ x i) := fun i =>
      hφc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) _
    have I1 : ∀ i j : Fin 2,
        Integrable (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i * φ x) := fun i j =>
      ((hDc i j).mul hφc').integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hφc.mul_left
    have I2 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => smthGrad u x j * smthGrad φ x i) := fun i j =>
      ((hf j).continuous.mul (hψ i)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hψc i).mul_left
    have I3 : ∀ j : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => smthGrad u x j * φ x) := fun j =>
      ((hf j).continuous.mul hφc').integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hφc.mul_left
    have P : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ∫ x, smthGrad u x j * smthGrad φ x i =
        -∫ x, smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i * φ x := by
      intro i j
      exact integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable
        (f := fun y => smthGrad u y j) (g := φ) (v := (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))
        (I1 i j) (I2 i j) (I3 j) ((hf j).differentiable one_ne_zero) hφd
    have e1 : ∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad u x j * smthGrad φ x i =
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * ∫ x, smthGrad u x j * smthGrad φ x i := by
      have hint : ∀ i j : Fin 2,
          Integrable (fun x => b₀ i j * smthGrad u x j * smthGrad φ x i) := by
        intro i j
        simpa only [mul_assoc] using (I2 i j).const_mul (b₀ i j)
      rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hint i j))]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hint i j)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      funext x
      ring
    have e2 : ∫ x, φ x * L x =
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j *
          ∫ x, smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i * φ x := by
      have hint : ∀ i j : Fin 2,
          Integrable (fun x => b₀ i j * (smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i * φ x)) :=
        fun i j => (I1 i j).const_mul (b₀ i j)
      have hfun : (fun x => φ x * L x) = fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
          b₀ i j * (smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i * φ x) := by
        funext x
        rw [hL]
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
        ring
      rw [hfun, integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hint i j))]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hint i j)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [integral_const_mul]
    have h0 := hsol φ hφ hφc
    rw [e1] at h0
    simp only [P, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_eq_zero] at h0
    rw [e2]
    exact h0
  have hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)), L x = 0 :=
    ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero hLc.locallyIntegrable
      (fun g hg hgc => by simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hibp g hg hgc)
  have hL0 : L = fun _ => 0 :=
    (Continuous.ae_eq_iff_eq volume hLc continuous_const).1 hae
  intro x
  have hx := congrFun hL0 x
  rw [hL] at hx
  exact hx

informal_problem.statement: (α : NNReal) (lam H : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hell : ∀ η : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, η i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * η i * η j) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (hL : ∀ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i = 0) (hH : ∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖smthGrad u x - smthGrad u y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) : ∃ (A : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (H' : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z => u (A z)) ∧ (∀ x, smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) y 0) x 0 + smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) y 1) x 1 = 0) ∧ (∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) x - smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) y‖ ≤ H' * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) ∧ ((∀ x, smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) x = smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) 0) → ∀ x, smthGrad u x = smthGrad u 0)

signature.name: smth_liou_cholesky
signature.statement: (α : NNReal) (lam H : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (b₀ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hell : ∀ η : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, η i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * η i * η j) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ 2 u) (hL : ∀ x, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, b₀ i j * smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i = 0) (hH : ∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖smthGrad u x - smthGrad u y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) : ∃ (A : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (H' : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun z => u (A z)) ∧ (∀ x, smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) y 0) x 0 + smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) y 1) x 1 = 0) ∧ (∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) x - smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) y‖ ≤ H' * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) ∧ ((∀ x, smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) x = smthGrad (fun z => u (A z)) 0) → ∀ x, smthGrad u x = smthGrad u 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨a, s, t, ha, ht, ha2, has, hst⟩ : ∃ a s t : ℝ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < t ∧ a ^ 2 = b₀ 0 0 ∧
      2 * (a * s) = b₀ 0 1 + b₀ 1 0 ∧ s ^ 2 + t ^ 2 = b₀ 1 1 := by
    have h1 : lam ≤ b₀ 0 0 := by
      have := hell ![1, 0]
      calc lam = lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, (![1, 0] : Fin 2 → ℝ) i ^ 2 := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]; ring
        _ ≤ _ := this
        _ = b₀ 0 0 := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]; ring
    have hp : 0 < b₀ 0 0 := lt_of_lt_of_le hlam h1
    have h2 : lam * (((b₀ 0 1 + b₀ 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 + b₀ 0 0 ^ 2) ≤
        b₀ 0 0 * (b₀ 0 0 * b₀ 1 1 - ((b₀ 0 1 + b₀ 1 0) / 2) ^ 2) := by
      have := hell ![-((b₀ 0 1 + b₀ 1 0) / 2), b₀ 0 0]
      calc lam * (((b₀ 0 1 + b₀ 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 + b₀ 0 0 ^ 2)
          = lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, (![-((b₀ 0 1 + b₀ 1 0) / 2), b₀ 0 0] : Fin 2 → ℝ) i ^ 2 := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]; ring
        _ ≤ _ := this
        _ = _ := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]; ring
    have hD : 0 < b₀ 0 0 * b₀ 1 1 - ((b₀ 0 1 + b₀ 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have e1 : b₀ 0 0 * (b₀ 0 0 * b₀ 1 1 - ((b₀ 0 1 + b₀ 1 0) / 2) ^ 2) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hp.le hc
      have e2 : 0 < lam * (((b₀ 0 1 + b₀ 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 + b₀ 0 0 ^ 2) := by positivity
      linarith
    have hsp : Real.sqrt (b₀ 0 0) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hp).ne'
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt (b₀ 0 0), ((b₀ 0 1 + b₀ 1 0) / 2) / Real.sqrt (b₀ 0 0),
      Real.sqrt ((b₀ 0 0 * b₀ 1 1 - ((b₀ 0 1 + b₀ 1 0) / 2) ^ 2) / b₀ 0 0),
      Real.sqrt_pos.2 hp, Real.sqrt_pos.2 (div_pos hD hp), Real.sq_sqrt hp.le, ?_, ?_⟩
    · field_simp
    · rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hp.le, Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg hD.le hp.le)]
      field_simp
      ring
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL0, hL1⟩ : ∃ L : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ y, L y 0 = a * y 0) ∧ (∀ y, L y 1 = s * y 0 + t * y 1) :=
    ⟨ContinuousLinearMap.pi ![a • ContinuousLinearMap.proj 0,
      s • ContinuousLinearMap.proj 0 + t • ContinuousLinearMap.proj 1],
      fun y => by simp, fun y => by simp⟩
  have hLe0 : L (Pi.single 0 1) =
      a • (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) + s • (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hL0, hL1]
  have hLe1 : L (Pi.single 1 1) = t • (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hL0, hL1]
  
  have hchain : ∀ f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Differentiable ℝ f → ∀ y w,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => f (L z)) y w = fderiv ℝ f (L y) (L w) := by
    intro f hf y w
    have h : HasFDerivAt (fun z => f (L z)) ((fderiv ℝ f (L y)).comp L) y :=
      (hf (L y)).hasFDerivAt.comp y L.hasFDerivAt
    rw [h.fderiv]
    rfl
  have hc0 : ∀ f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Differentiable ℝ f → ∀ y,
      smthGrad (fun z => f (L z)) y 0 = a * smthGrad f (L y) 0 + s * smthGrad f (L y) 1 := by
    intro f hf y
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => f (L z)) y (Pi.single 0 1) =
      a * fderiv ℝ f (L y) (Pi.single 0 1) + s * fderiv ℝ f (L y) (Pi.single 1 1)
    rw [hchain f hf, hLe0, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hc1 : ∀ f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, Differentiable ℝ f → ∀ y,
      smthGrad (fun z => f (L z)) y 1 = t * smthGrad f (L y) 1 := by
    intro f hf y
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => f (L z)) y (Pi.single 1 1) = t * fderiv ℝ f (L y) (Pi.single 1 1)
    rw [hchain f hf, hLe1, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hud : Differentiable ℝ u := hu.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hD1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ u) := hu.fderiv_right (by norm_num)
  have hGd : ∀ m : Fin 2, Differentiable ℝ (fun y => smthGrad u y m) := by
    intro m
    exact (hD1.clm_apply contDiff_const).differentiable (by norm_num)
  have hhess : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (i j : Fin 2), smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y j) x i =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) := by
    intro x i j
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (Pi.single j 1)) x (Pi.single i 1) = _
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply ((hD1.differentiable (by norm_num)) x) (differentiableAt_const _)]
    simp
  have hsym : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y 1) x 0 = smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y 0) x 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [hhess, hhess]
    exact (hu.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField])) _ _
  
  have hlin2 : ∀ (F K : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (c d : ℝ), Differentiable ℝ F → Differentiable ℝ K →
      ∀ x i, smthGrad (fun y => c * F y + d * K y) x i =
        c * smthGrad F x i + d * smthGrad K x i := by
    intro F K c d hF hK x i
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => c * F y + d * K y) x (Pi.single i 1) =
      c * fderiv ℝ F x (Pi.single i 1) + d * fderiv ℝ K x (Pi.single i 1)
    have h : HasFDerivAt (fun y => c * F y + d * K y)
        (c • fderiv ℝ F x + d • fderiv ℝ K x) x :=
      ((hF x).hasFDerivAt.const_mul c).add ((hK x).hasFDerivAt.const_mul d)
    rw [h.fderiv]
    simp
  have hlin1 : ∀ (K : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (d : ℝ), Differentiable ℝ K →
      ∀ x i, smthGrad (fun y => d * K y) x i = d * smthGrad K x i := by
    intro K d hK x i
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => d * K y) x (Pi.single i 1) = d * fderiv ℝ K x (Pi.single i 1)
    rw [fderiv_const_mul (hK x)]
    simp
  
  have hV0 : ∀ y, smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) y 0 =
      a * smthGrad u (L y) 0 + s * smthGrad u (L y) 1 := hc0 u hud
  have hV1 : ∀ y, smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) y 1 = t * smthGrad u (L y) 1 := hc1 u hud
  have hGLd : ∀ m : Fin 2, Differentiable ℝ (fun z => smthGrad u (L z) m) :=
    fun m => (hGd m).comp L.differentiable
  have hv2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 (u ∘ ⇑L) := hu.comp_continuousLinearMap
  refine ⟨L, (|a| + |s| + |t|) * max H 0 * (|a| + |s| + |t|) ^ (α : ℝ),
    hv2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro x
    have e0 : (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) y 0) =
        fun y => a * smthGrad u (L y) 0 + s * smthGrad u (L y) 1 := funext hV0
    have e1 : (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) y 1) =
        fun y => t * smthGrad u (L y) 1 := funext hV1
    rw [e0, e1, hlin2 _ _ a s (hGLd 0) (hGLd 1), hlin1 _ t (hGLd 1),
      hc0 _ (hGd 0), hc0 _ (hGd 1), hc1 _ (hGd 1)]
    have hLx := hL (L x)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hLx
    have hs := hsym (L x)
    linear_combination hLx + smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y 0) (L x) 0 * ha2 +
      smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y 0) (L x) 1 * has +
      smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y 1) (L x) 1 * hst + (a * s - b₀ 0 1) * hs
  · 
    intro x y
    have hK0 : 0 ≤ |a| + |s| + |t| := by positivity
    have hHp : 0 ≤ max H 0 := le_max_right _ _
    have hd := norm_nonneg (x - y)
    have hx0 : |x 0 - y 0| ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (x - y) 0
      rwa [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have hx1 : |x 1 - y 1| ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (x - y) 1
      rwa [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have hE : ‖L x - L y‖ ≤ (|a| + |s| + |t|) * ‖x - y‖ := by
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2 ?_
      intro i
      rw [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      fin_cases i
      · show |L x 0 - L y 0| ≤ _
        rw [hL0, hL0, ← mul_sub, abs_mul]
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx0 (abs_nonneg a)
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg s, abs_nonneg t]
      · show |L x 1 - L y 1| ≤ _
        rw [hL1, hL1]
        have e : s * x 0 + t * x 1 - (s * y 0 + t * y 1) =
            s * (x 0 - y 0) + t * (x 1 - y 1) := by ring
        rw [e]
        have e1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx0 (abs_nonneg s)
        have e2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx1 (abs_nonneg t)
        calc |s * (x 0 - y 0) + t * (x 1 - y 1)|
            ≤ |s * (x 0 - y 0)| + |t * (x 1 - y 1)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |s| * |x 0 - y 0| + |t| * |x 1 - y 1| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          _ ≤ (|a| + |s| + |t|) * ‖x - y‖ := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg a]
    have hΔ : ‖smthGrad u (L x) - smthGrad u (L y)‖ ≤
        max H 0 * ((|a| + |s| + |t|) ^ (α : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) := by
      calc ‖smthGrad u (L x) - smthGrad u (L y)‖ ≤ H * ‖L x - L y‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := hH _ _
        _ ≤ max H 0 * ‖L x - L y‖ ^ (α : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
        _ ≤ max H 0 * ((|a| + |s| + |t|) * ‖x - y‖) ^ (α : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg _) hE α.2) hHp
        _ = _ := by rw [Real.mul_rpow hK0 hd]
    have hn := norm_nonneg (smthGrad u (L x) - smthGrad u (L y))
    have h0 : |smthGrad u (L x) 0 - smthGrad u (L y) 0| ≤
        ‖smthGrad u (L x) - smthGrad u (L y)‖ := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (smthGrad u (L x) - smthGrad u (L y)) 0
      rwa [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have h1 : |smthGrad u (L x) 1 - smthGrad u (L y) 1| ≤
        ‖smthGrad u (L x) - smthGrad u (L y)‖ := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (smthGrad u (L x) - smthGrad u (L y)) 1
      rwa [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have hV : ‖smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) x - smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) y‖ ≤
        (|a| + |s| + |t|) * ‖smthGrad u (L x) - smthGrad u (L y)‖ := by
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by positivity)).2 ?_
      intro i
      rw [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      fin_cases i
      · show |smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) x 0 - smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) y 0| ≤ _
        rw [hV0, hV0]
        have e : a * smthGrad u (L x) 0 + s * smthGrad u (L x) 1 -
            (a * smthGrad u (L y) 0 + s * smthGrad u (L y) 1) =
            a * (smthGrad u (L x) 0 - smthGrad u (L y) 0) +
              s * (smthGrad u (L x) 1 - smthGrad u (L y) 1) := by ring
        rw [e]
        have e1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h0 (abs_nonneg a)
        have e2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg s)
        calc _ ≤ |a * (smthGrad u (L x) 0 - smthGrad u (L y) 0)| +
              |s * (smthGrad u (L x) 1 - smthGrad u (L y) 1)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = |a| * |smthGrad u (L x) 0 - smthGrad u (L y) 0| +
              |s| * |smthGrad u (L x) 1 - smthGrad u (L y) 1| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg t]
      · show |smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) x 1 - smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) y 1| ≤ _
        rw [hV1, hV1, ← mul_sub, abs_mul]
        have e2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg t)
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg a, abs_nonneg s]
    calc ‖smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) x - smthGrad (fun z => u (L z)) y‖
        ≤ (|a| + |s| + |t|) * ‖smthGrad u (L x) - smthGrad u (L y)‖ := hV
      _ ≤ (|a| + |s| + |t|) *
          (max H 0 * ((|a| + |s| + |t|) ^ (α : ℝ) * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΔ hK0
      _ = _ := by ring
  · 
    intro hc z
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, L y = z := by
      refine ⟨![z 0 / a, (z 1 - s * (z 0 / a)) / t], ?_⟩
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · show L _ 0 = z 0
        rw [hL0]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero]
        field_simp
      · show L _ 1 = z 1
        rw [hL1]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
        field_simp
        ring
    have k1 := congrFun (hc y) 1
    have k0 := congrFun (hc y) 0
    rw [hV1, hV1, hy, map_zero] at k1
    rw [hV0, hV0, hy, map_zero] at k0
    have g1 : smthGrad u z 1 = smthGrad u 0 1 := mul_left_cancel₀ ht.ne' k1
    rw [g1] at k0
    have g0 : smthGrad u z 0 = smthGrad u 0 0 := mul_left_cancel₀ ha.ne' (by linarith)
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact g0
    · exact g1

informal_problem.statement: (α : NNReal) (hα1 : α < 1) (H : ℝ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V) (hharm : ∀ x, smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad V y 0) x 0 + smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad V y 1) x 1 = 0) (hH : ∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖smthGrad V x - smthGrad V y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) : ∀ x, smthGrad V x = smthGrad V 0

signature.name: smth_liou_harmonic
signature.statement: (α : NNReal) (hα1 : α < 1) (H : ℝ) (V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V) (hharm : ∀ x, smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad V y 0) x 0 + smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad V y 1) x 1 = 0) (hH : ∀ x y : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖smthGrad V x - smthGrad V y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ (α : ℝ)) : ∀ x, smthGrad V x = smthGrad V 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have liou : ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ), Differentiable ℂ f → ∀ (β C : ℝ), β < 1 →
      (∀ w w' : ℂ, ‖f w - f w'‖ ≤ C * ‖w - w'‖ ^ β) → ∀ w, f w = f 0 := by
    intro f hf β C hβ hHf
    have hd : ∀ w₀, deriv f w₀ = 0 := by
      intro w₀
      have hb : ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ‖deriv f w₀‖ ≤ C * R ^ (β - 1) := by
        intro R hR
        have h1 : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun w => f w - f w₀) (Metric.ball w₀ R) :=
          (hf.sub_const (f w₀)).diffContOnCl
        have h2 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere w₀ R, ‖(fun w => f w - f w₀) z‖ ≤ C * R ^ β := by
          intro z hz
          have hz' : ‖z - w₀‖ = R := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hz
          have := hHf z w₀
          rw [hz'] at this
          exact this
        have h3 := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hR h1 h2
        rw [deriv_sub_const] at h3
        rw [Real.rpow_sub_one hR.ne', ← mul_div_assoc]
        exact h3
      have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun R : ℝ => C * R ^ (β - 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (y := 1 - β) (by linarith)).const_mul C
        rw [mul_zero, neg_sub] at this
        exact this
      have hle : ‖deriv f w₀‖ ≤ 0 :=
        ge_of_tendsto hlim ((Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0).mono hb)
      exact norm_le_zero_iff.mp hle
    intro w
    exact is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hf hd w 0
  
  have hV1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ V) := hV.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)
  have hdV : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) := hV1.differentiable one_ne_zero
  have hP : ∀ k : Fin 2, Differentiable ℝ (fun y => smthGrad V y k) := by
    intro k
    have : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ V y (Pi.single k 1)) := hV1.clm_apply contDiff_const
    exact this.differentiable one_ne_zero
  
  have hD2 : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (i k : Fin 2), smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad V y k) x i =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single k 1) := by
    intro x i k
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ V y (Pi.single k 1)) x (Pi.single i 1) = _
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hdV x) (differentiableAt_const _)]
    simp
  have hsymm : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad V y 0) x 1 = smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad V y 1) x 0 := by
    intro x
    rw [hD2, hD2]
    have hs : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ V x :=
      hV.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField])
    exact hs _ _
  
  let cL : ℂ →L[ℝ] (Fin 2 → ℝ) := ContinuousLinearMap.pi ![Complex.reCLM, Complex.imCLM]
  have hcL0 : ∀ z : ℂ, cL z 0 = z.re := fun z => by simp [cL]
  have hcL1 : ∀ z : ℂ, cL z 1 = z.im := fun z => by simp [cL]
  have hc1 : cL 1 = Pi.single 0 1 := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [cL]
  have hcI : cL Complex.I = Pi.single 1 1 := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [cL]
  
  set P₀ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun y => smthGrad V y 0 with hP₀def
  set P₁ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun y => smthGrad V y 1 with hP₁def
  set f : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => ((P₀ (cL w) : ℝ) : ℂ) - Complex.I * ((P₁ (cL w) : ℝ) : ℂ) with hfdef
  have hderiv : ∀ w : ℂ, HasFDerivAt f (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp ((fderiv ℝ P₀ (cL w)).comp cL) -
      Complex.I • Complex.ofRealCLM.comp ((fderiv ℝ P₁ (cL w)).comp cL)) w := by
    intro w
    have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun w => ((P₀ (cL w) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp ((fderiv ℝ P₀ (cL w)).comp cL)) w :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp w (((hP 0) (cL w)).hasFDerivAt.comp w cL.hasFDerivAt)
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w => ((P₁ (cL w) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (Complex.ofRealCLM.comp ((fderiv ℝ P₁ (cL w)).comp cL)) w :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp w (((hP 1) (cL w)).hasFDerivAt.comp w cL.hasFDerivAt)
    exact h0.sub (h1.const_mul Complex.I)
  have hf : Differentiable ℂ f := by
    intro w
    refine differentiableAt_complex_iff_differentiableAt_real.2 ⟨(hderiv w).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    rw [(hderiv w).fderiv]
    have hcr1 := hharm (cL w)
    have hcr2 := hsymm (cL w)
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Complex.ofRealCLM_apply, hc1, hcI, smul_eq_mul]
    have e1 : ((fderiv ℝ P₀ (cL w) (Pi.single 1 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        ((fderiv ℝ P₁ (cL w) (Pi.single 0 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast hcr2
    have e2 : ((fderiv ℝ P₀ (cL w) (Pi.single 0 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) +
        ((fderiv ℝ P₁ (cL w) (Pi.single 1 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hcr1
    linear_combination e1 - Complex.I * e2 +
      ((fderiv ℝ P₁ (cL w) (Pi.single 0 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I_sq
  
  have hH0 : 0 ≤ H := by
    have h := hH 0 (Pi.single 0 1)
    have hn : ‖(0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) - Pi.single 0 1‖ = 1 := by
      rw [zero_sub, norm_neg, Pi.norm_single, norm_one]
    rw [hn, Real.one_rpow, mul_one] at h
    exact (norm_nonneg _).trans h
  have hcn : ∀ w w' : ℂ, ‖cL w - cL w'‖ ≤ ‖w - w'‖ := by
    intro w w'
    rw [← map_sub]
    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)).2 (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [hcL0, Real.norm_eq_abs] using Complex.abs_re_le_norm (w - w')
    · simpa [hcL1, Real.norm_eq_abs] using Complex.abs_im_le_norm (w - w')
  have hhol : ∀ w w' : ℂ, ‖f w - f w'‖ ≤ 2 * H * ‖w - w'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) := by
    intro w w'
    have e : f w - f w' = ((P₀ (cL w) - P₀ (cL w') : ℝ) : ℂ) -
        Complex.I * ((P₁ (cL w) - P₁ (cL w') : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      simp only [hfdef]; push_cast; ring
    have hA : |P₀ (cL w) - P₀ (cL w')| ≤ ‖smthGrad V (cL w) - smthGrad V (cL w')‖ := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (smthGrad V (cL w) - smthGrad V (cL w')) 0
      simpa [hP₀def, Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
    have hB : |P₁ (cL w) - P₁ (cL w')| ≤ ‖smthGrad V (cL w) - smthGrad V (cL w')‖ := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm (smthGrad V (cL w) - smthGrad V (cL w')) 1
      simpa [hP₁def, Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
    have hpow : ‖cL w - cL w'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) ≤ ‖w - w'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow (norm_nonneg _) (hcn w w') α.2
    have hHx := hH (cL w) (cL w')
    have hm : H * ‖cL w - cL w'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) ≤ H * ‖w - w'‖ ^ (α : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hH0
    have hn : ‖f w - f w'‖ ≤ |P₀ (cL w) - P₀ (cL w')| + |P₁ (cL w) - P₁ (cL w')| := by
      rw [e]
      refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    linarith
  have hα' : (α : ℝ) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hα1
  have hconst := liou f hf (α : ℝ) (2 * H) hα' hhol
  
  intro x
  have hx : cL ⟨x 0, x 1⟩ = x := by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [cL]
  have hw := hconst ⟨x 0, x 1⟩
  simp only [hfdef, hx, map_zero] at hw
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re hw
  have him := congrArg Complex.im hw
  simp at hre him
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [hP₀def] using hre
  · simpa [hP₁def] using him

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f ψ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (hsymm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (β : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (h1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i ψ y = c * partialDeriv i f y)
    (h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) y =
      c * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y + β i * partialDeriv j f y +
        β j * partialDeriv i f y) :
    levelMeanCurvCoord G ψ y * |c| = c * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y

signature.name: levelMeanCurvCoord_rescale
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f ψ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (hsymm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (β : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (h1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i ψ y = c * partialDeriv i f y)
    (h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) y =
      c * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y + β i * partialDeriv j f y +
        β j * partialDeriv i f y) :
    levelMeanCurvCoord G ψ y * |c| = c * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y

proof.tactics:
by
  have hs1 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G ψ i j y = c * hessLoc G f i j y +
      β i * partialDeriv j f y + β j * partialDeriv i f y := by
    intro i j
    unfold hessLoc
    rw [h2 i j]
    simp only [h1, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have key : ∀ (L T B S : ℝ), ((c * L + 2 * B) / Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 * S) -
      (c ^ 3 * T + 2 * c ^ 2 * B * S) / Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 * S) ^ 3) * |c| =
      c * (L / Real.sqrt S - T / Real.sqrt S ^ 3) := by
    intro L T B S
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 * S) = |c| * Real.sqrt S := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    rw [hsq]
    have hA : |c| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.mpr hc
    have hA2 : |c| ^ 2 = c ^ 2 := sq_abs c
    by_cases hn : Real.sqrt S = 0
    · rw [hn]; simp
    · have hS : 0 ≤ S := by
        by_contra hneg
        push_neg at hneg
        exact hn (Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.mpr hneg.le)
      have hn2 : Real.sqrt S ^ 2 = S := Real.sq_sqrt hS
      obtain ⟨n, hnd⟩ : ∃ n, Real.sqrt S = n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [hnd] at hn hn2 ⊢
      subst hn2
      rw [show (|c| * n) ^ 3 = |c| * c ^ 2 * n ^ 3 by rw [← hA2]; ring]
      field_simp
      ring
  have eS : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * (c * partialDeriv i f y) *
      (c * partialDeriv j f y)) =
      c ^ 2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have eL : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * (c * hessLoc G f i j y +
      β i * partialDeriv j f y + β j * partialDeriv i f y)) =
      c * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * hessLoc G f i j y) +
      2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * β i * partialDeriv j f y) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hsymm 1 0, hsymm 2 0, hsymm 2 1]
    ring
  have eT : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i a * (c * partialDeriv a f y) * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * (c * partialDeriv b f y)) *
        (c * hessLoc G f i j y + β i * partialDeriv j f y + β j * partialDeriv i f y)) =
      c ^ 3 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a f y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b f y) *
          hessLoc G f i j y) +
      2 * c ^ 2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * β i * partialDeriv j f y) *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  unfold levelMeanCurvCoord lapLoc
  simp only [hs1, h1]
  rw [eS, eL, eT]
  exact key _ _ _ _

informal_problem.statement:
(F ψ : E3 → ℝ) (b : Fin 3) (y : E3) (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F y)
    (hψ : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 ψ y) (hψ0 : ψ y = 0)
    (hid : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 y, F (w - ψ w • e b) = 0) (hFb : partialDeriv b F y ≠ 0) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i ψ y = (partialDeriv b F y)⁻¹ * partialDeriv i F y) ∧
    ∃ β : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) y =
      (partialDeriv b F y)⁻¹ * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) y +
        β i * partialDeriv j F y + β j * partialDeriv i F y

signature.name: implicit_graph_derivs
signature.statement:
(F ψ : E3 → ℝ) (b : Fin 3) (y : E3) (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F y)
    (hψ : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 ψ y) (hψ0 : ψ y = 0)
    (hid : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 y, F (w - ψ w • e b) = 0) (hFb : partialDeriv b F y ≠ 0) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i ψ y = (partialDeriv b F y)⁻¹ * partialDeriv i F y) ∧
    ∃ β : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) y =
      (partialDeriv b F y)⁻¹ * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) y +
        β i * partialDeriv j F y + β j * partialDeriv i F y

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have chain : ∀ (h : E3 → ℝ) (j : Fin 3) (w : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ h (w - ψ w • e b) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ w →
      partialDeriv j (fun z => h (z - ψ z • e b)) w =
        partialDeriv j h (w - ψ w • e b) - partialDeriv j ψ w * partialDeriv b h (w - ψ w • e b) := by
    intro h j w hh hψw
    have hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : E3 => z - ψ z • e b) w :=
      differentiableAt_id.sub (hψw.smul_const (e b))
    have hγd : fderiv ℝ (fun z : E3 => z - ψ z • e b) w (e j) =
        e j - (fderiv ℝ ψ w (e j)) • e b := by
      rw [fderiv_fun_sub differentiableAt_fun_id (hψw.smul_const (e b)), fderiv_smul_const hψw]
      simp
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_comp' w hh hγ, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hγd, map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have pd_sub_mul : ∀ (u p v : E3 → ℝ) (j : Fin 3) (x : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ u x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ p x → DifferentiableAt ℝ v x →
      partialDeriv j (fun w => u w - p w * v w) x =
        partialDeriv j u x - (p x * partialDeriv j v x + v x * partialDeriv j p x) := by
    intro u p v j x hu hp hv
    unfold partialDeriv
    have hpv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => p w * v w) x := hp.mul hv
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub hu hpv, fderiv_fun_mul hp hv]
    simp
  
  have evD : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f y → ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, DifferentiableAt ℝ f z := by
    intro f hf
    exact (hf.eventually (by simp)).mono fun z hz => hz.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have dDf : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f y → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y := by
    intro f hf
    exact (hf.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have dD : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f y → ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv i f) y := by
    intro f hf i
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e i)) y
    exact (dDf f hf).clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e i))
  
  have pp : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f y → ∀ k m : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv m (partialDeriv k f) y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y (e m) (e k) := by
    intro f hf k m
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e k)) y (e m) = _
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply (dDf f hf) (differentiableAt_const (e k))]
    simp
  have schwarz : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f y → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y = partialDeriv j (partialDeriv i f) y := by
    intro f hf i j
    rw [pp f hf, pp f hf]
    exact hf.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]) _ _
  
  have hγy : y - ψ y • e b = y := by rw [hψ0, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hγt : Tendsto (fun w : E3 => w - ψ w • e b) (𝓝 y) (𝓝 y) := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun w : E3 => w - ψ w • e b) y :=
      continuousAt_id.sub (hψ.continuousAt.smul continuousAt_const)
    have h : Tendsto (fun w : E3 => w - ψ w • e b) (𝓝 y) (𝓝 (y - ψ y • e b)) := hc.tendsto
    rwa [hγy] at h
  
  have first : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 y, partialDeriv i F (w - ψ w • e b) -
      partialDeriv i ψ w * partialDeriv b F (w - ψ w • e b) = 0 := by
    intro i
    filter_upwards [hγt.eventually (evD F hF), evD ψ hψ, hid.eventually_nhds] with w h1 h2 h3
    rw [← chain F i w h1 h2]
    have h0 : (fun z => F (z - ψ z • e b)) =ᶠ[𝓝 w] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := h3
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h0.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have claim1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i ψ y = (partialDeriv b F y)⁻¹ * partialDeriv i F y := by
    intro i
    have h := (first i).self_of_nhds
    rw [hγy] at h
    rw [eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq₀ hFb]
    linear_combination -h
  
  have second : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => partialDeriv j F (w - ψ w • e b) -
      partialDeriv j ψ w * partialDeriv b F (w - ψ w • e b)) y = 0 := by
    intro i j
    have h0 : (fun w => partialDeriv j F (w - ψ w • e b) -
        partialDeriv j ψ w * partialDeriv b F (w - ψ w • e b)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := first j
    show fderiv ℝ _ y (e i) = 0
    rw [h0.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  refine ⟨claim1, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨fun m => -((partialDeriv b F y)⁻¹ ^ 2) * partialDeriv m (partialDeriv b F) y +
    (partialDeriv b F y)⁻¹ ^ 3 / 2 * partialDeriv b (partialDeriv b F) y * partialDeriv m F y, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  beta_reduce
  have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ y := hψ.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : E3 => z - ψ z • e b) y :=
    differentiableAt_id.sub (hψd.smul_const (e b))
  have hdA : ∀ m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv m F) (y - ψ y • e b) := by
    intro m
    rw [hγy]
    exact dD F hF m
  have hAd : ∀ m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv m F (w - ψ w • e b)) y :=
    fun m => by have h := (hdA m).comp y hγ; exact h
  have E1 := pd_sub_mul (fun w => partialDeriv j F (w - ψ w • e b)) (partialDeriv j ψ)
    (fun w => partialDeriv b F (w - ψ w • e b)) i y (hAd j) (dD ψ hψ j) (hAd b)
  beta_reduce at E1
  rw [second i j] at E1
  have C1 := chain (partialDeriv j F) i y (hdA j) hψd
  have C2 := chain (partialDeriv b F) i y (hdA b) hψd
  rw [hγy] at C1 C2 E1
  rw [C1, C2, schwarz F hF b j, claim1 i, claim1 j] at E1
  have hc : (partialDeriv b F y)⁻¹ * partialDeriv b F y = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hFb
  linear_combination (partialDeriv b F y)⁻¹ * E1 - partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) y * hc

informal_problem.statement:
(F : E3 → ℝ) (y₀ : E3) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball y₀ ε)) (hF0 : F y₀ = 0) (b : Fin 3)
    (hb : partialDeriv b F y₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (V : E3 → ℝ) (ρ η : ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ 0 < η ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V {x : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ} ∧
      V (sepPlaneProj b y₀) = y₀ b ∧
      sepCyl b y₀ ρ η ⊆ Metric.ball y₀ ε ∧
      (∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀)‖ < ρ → |V (sepPlaneProj b z) - y₀ b| < η) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ sepCyl b y₀ ρ η, (F z = 0 ↔ z b = V (sepPlaneProj b z)) ∧
        (0 < F z ↔ 0 < partialDeriv b F y₀ * (z b - V (sepPlaneProj b z))) ∧
        0 < partialDeriv b F y₀ * partialDeriv b F z

signature.statement:
(F : E3 → ℝ) (y₀ : E3) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball y₀ ε)) (hF0 : F y₀ = 0) (b : Fin 3)
    (hb : partialDeriv b F y₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (V : E3 → ℝ) (ρ η : ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ 0 < η ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V {x : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ} ∧
      V (sepPlaneProj b y₀) = y₀ b ∧
      sepCyl b y₀ ρ η ⊆ Metric.ball y₀ ε ∧
      (∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀)‖ < ρ → |V (sepPlaneProj b z) - y₀ b| < η) ∧
      ∀ z ∈ sepCyl b y₀ ρ η, (F z = 0 ↔ z b = V (sepPlaneProj b z)) ∧

        0 < partialDeriv b F y₀ * partialDeriv b F z

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hsignlemma : ∀ (d A u : ℝ), d ≠ 0 → (d * A = 0 ↔ u = 0) → (0 < d * A ↔ 0 < u) →
      (0 < A ↔ 0 < d * u) := by
    intro d A u hd h1 h2
    have hneg : d * A < 0 → u < 0 := by
      intro h
      rcases lt_trichotomy u 0 with hu | hu | hu
      · exact hu
      · exact absurd (h1.2 hu) (ne_of_lt h)
      · exact absurd (h2.2 hu) (not_lt.2 h.le)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hd with hd' | hd'
    · constructor
      · intro hA
        have := hneg (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hd' hA)
        nlinarith
      · intro hdu
        rcases lt_trichotomy A 0 with hA | hA | hA
        · have := h2.1 (mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hd' hA)
          nlinarith
        · have := h1.1 (by rw [hA, mul_zero])
          rw [this, mul_zero] at hdu
          exact absurd hdu (lt_irrefl _)
        · exact hA
    · constructor
      · intro hA
        have := h2.1 (mul_pos hd' hA)
        nlinarith
      · intro hdu
        rcases lt_trichotomy A 0 with hA | hA | hA
        · have := hneg (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hd' hA)
          nlinarith
        · have := h1.1 (by rw [hA, mul_zero])
          rw [this, mul_zero] at hdu
          exact absurd hdu (lt_irrefl _)
        · exact hA
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : E3 →L[ℝ] E3, ∀ x, P x = sepPlaneProj b x :=
    ⟨ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - (EuclideanSpace.proj b : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e b),
      fun x => by simp [sepPlaneProj]⟩
  have hP1 : ∀ x : E3, (sepPlaneProj b x) b = 0 := by
    intro x; simp [sepPlaneProj]
  have hP2 : ∀ (x : E3) (t : ℝ), sepPlaneProj b (x + t • e b) = sepPlaneProj b x := by
    intro x t
    have h : (x + t • e b) b = x b + t := by simp
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, h, add_smul]; abel
  have hP3 : ∀ x : E3, sepPlaneProj b (sepPlaneProj b x) = sepPlaneProj b x := by
    intro x
    show sepPlaneProj b x - (sepPlaneProj b x) b • e b = sepPlaneProj b x
    rw [hP1 x, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hP4 : ∀ (x : E3) (t : ℝ), (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b) b = t := by
    intro x t; simp [hP1]
  have hP5 : ∀ x : E3, sepPlaneProj b x + (x b) • e b = x := by
    intro x; show x - (x b) • e b + (x b) • e b = x; exact sub_add_cancel _ _
  have hP6 : ∀ x y : E3, sepPlaneProj b (x - y) = sepPlaneProj b x - sepPlaneProj b y := by
    intro x y; simp only [← hP]; exact map_sub P x y
  have hP7 : ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ≤ ‖sepPlaneProj b v‖ + |v b| := by
    intro v
    calc ‖v‖ = ‖sepPlaneProj b v + (v b) • e b‖ := by rw [hP5]
      _ ≤ ‖sepPlaneProj b v‖ + ‖(v b) • e b‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖sepPlaneProj b v‖ + |v b| := by rw [norm_smul]; simp
  
  generalize hd : partialDeriv b F y₀ = d at hb ⊢
  have hball_open : IsOpen (Metric.ball y₀ ε) := Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hFat : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ε, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F z :=
    fun z hz => hF.contDiffAt (hball_open.mem_nhds hz)
  have hone : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by simp
  have hn0 : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hpdcont : ContinuousOn (fun z => partialDeriv b F z) (Metric.ball y₀ ε) :=
    (hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hball_open hone).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hr₁b⟩ : ∃ r₁ > 0, ∀ z, dist z y₀ < r₁ → 0 < d * partialDeriv b F z := by
    have hca : ContinuousAt (fun z => d * partialDeriv b F z) y₀ :=
      continuousAt_const.mul
        (hpdcont.continuousAt (hball_open.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hε)))
    have hpos : 0 < d * partialDeriv b F y₀ := by rw [hd]; exact mul_self_pos.mpr hb
    exact Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.1 (hca.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hpos))
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hr₀ε, hsign⟩ : ∃ r₀, 0 < r₀ ∧ r₀ ≤ ε ∧
      ∀ z, dist z y₀ < r₀ → 0 < d * partialDeriv b F z :=
    ⟨min ε r₁, lt_min hε hr₁, min_le_left _ _,
      fun z hz => hr₁b z (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_right _ _))⟩
  have hinball : ∀ z, dist z y₀ < r₀ → z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ε :=
    fun z hz => lt_of_lt_of_le hz hr₀ε
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, η = r₀ / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hηpos : 0 < η := by rw [hη]; exact half_pos hr₀
  have hηη : η + η = r₀ := by rw [hη]; ring
  
  have hseg : ∀ (x : E3) (t : ℝ), ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < η → |t - y₀ b| ≤ η →
      dist (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b) y₀ < r₀ := by
    intro x t hx ht
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have h1 : sepPlaneProj b (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b - y₀) = sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀) := by
      rw [hP6 (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b) y₀, hP2, hP3, hP6 x y₀]
    have h2 : (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b - y₀) b = t - y₀ b := by
      rw [PiLp.sub_apply, hP4]
    have h3 := hP7 (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b - y₀)
    rw [h1, h2] at h3
    linarith
  have hline : ∀ x : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < η →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η), dist (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b) y₀ < r₀ := by
    intro x hx t ht
    exact hseg x t hx (abs_sub_le_iff.2 ⟨by linarith [ht.2], by linarith [ht.1]⟩)
  
  have hmono : ∀ x : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < η →
      StrictMonoOn (fun t => d * F (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b))
        (Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η)) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun t => d * F (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b))
        (Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η)) := by
    intro x hx
    have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η),
        HasDerivAt (fun t => d * F (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b))
          (d * partialDeriv b F (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b)) t := by
      intro t ht
      have hin := hline x hx t ht
      have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b) :=
        (hFat _ (hinball _ hin)).differentiableAt hn0
      have hℓ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => sepPlaneProj b x + s • e b) (e b) t := by
        have h := ((hasDerivAt_id' t).smul_const (e b)).const_add (sepPlaneProj b x)
        rwa [one_smul] at h
      exact (hFd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hℓ).const_mul d
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun t => d * F (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b))
        (Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η)) :=
      fun t ht => (hderiv t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    refine ⟨strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Icc _ _) hcont ?_, hcont⟩
    intro t ht
    rw [interior_Icc] at ht
    have htI : t ∈ Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η) := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht
    rw [(hderiv t htI).deriv]
    exact hsign _ (hline x hx t htI)
  
  have hP0 : sepPlaneProj b (y₀ - y₀) = 0 := by rw [sub_self, ← hP, map_zero]
  have hy₀η : ‖sepPlaneProj b (y₀ - y₀)‖ < η := by rw [hP0, norm_zero]; exact hηpos
  have hcen : sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b) • e b = y₀ := hP5 y₀
  obtain ⟨hsm0, -⟩ := hmono y₀ hy₀η
  have hIc : y₀ b ∈ Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hIl : y₀ b - η ∈ Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η) := ⟨le_refl _, by linarith⟩
  have hIr : y₀ b + η ∈ Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η) := ⟨by linarith, le_refl _⟩
  have hq1 : 0 < d * F (sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b + η) • e b) := by
    have h := hsm0 hIc hIr (by linarith)
    simp only [hcen, hF0, mul_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hq2 : d * F (sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b - η) • e b) < 0 := by
    have h := hsm0 hIl hIc (by linarith)
    simp only [hcen, hF0, mul_zero] at h
    exact h
  
  have hFq1 : ContinuousAt F (sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b + η) • e b) :=
    (hFat _ (hinball _ (hline y₀ hy₀η _ hIr))).continuousAt
  have hFq2 : ContinuousAt F (sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b - η) • e b) :=
    (hFat _ (hinball _ (hline y₀ hy₀η _ hIl))).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨ρ', hρ', hpers⟩ : ∃ ρ' > 0, ∀ v : E3, dist v 0 < ρ' →
      0 < d * F (sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b + η) • e b + v) ∧
      d * F (sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b - η) • e b + v) < 0 := by
    have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun v : E3 => sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b + η) • e b + v) 0 :=
      continuousAt_const.add continuousAt_id
    have hc2 : ContinuousAt (fun v : E3 => sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b - η) • e b + v) 0 :=
      continuousAt_const.add continuousAt_id
    have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun v => d * F (sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b + η) • e b + v)) 0 :=
      continuousAt_const.mul (hFq1.comp_of_eq hc1 (add_zero _))
    have h2 : ContinuousAt (fun v => d * F (sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b - η) • e b + v)) 0 :=
      continuousAt_const.mul (hFq2.comp_of_eq hc2 (add_zero _))
    have hq1' : (0 : ℝ) < d * F (sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b + η) • e b + 0) := by
      rwa [add_zero]
    have hq2' : d * F (sepPlaneProj b y₀ + (y₀ b - η) • e b + 0) < 0 := by
      rwa [add_zero]
    have e1 := h1.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hq1')
    have e2 := h2.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hq2')
    exact Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.1 (e1.and e2)
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = min η ρ' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := by rw [hρ]; exact lt_min hηpos hρ'
  have hρη : ρ ≤ η := by rw [hρ]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hρρ' : ρ ≤ ρ' := by rw [hρ]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hshift : ∀ (x : E3) (s : ℝ), sepPlaneProj b y₀ + s • e b + sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀) =
      sepPlaneProj b x + s • e b := by
    intro x s; rw [hP6]; abel
  
  have hroot : ∀ x : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ → ∃ t : ℝ, y₀ b - η < t ∧
      t < y₀ b + η ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η), (d * F (sepPlaneProj b x + s • e b) = 0 ↔ s = t) ∧
        (0 < d * F (sepPlaneProj b x + s • e b) ↔ t < s) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxη : ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < η := lt_of_lt_of_le hx hρη
    obtain ⟨hsm, hco⟩ := hmono x hxη
    have hv := hpers (sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀))
      (by rw [dist_zero_right]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx hρρ')
    rw [hshift, hshift] at hv
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := hv
    have hle : y₀ b - η ≤ y₀ b + η := by linarith
    obtain ⟨t, ⟨ht1, ht2⟩, ht0⟩ := intermediate_value_Ioo hle hco ⟨hB, hA⟩
    have ht0' : d * F (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b) = 0 := ht0
    have htI : t ∈ Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η) := ⟨ht1.le, ht2.le⟩
    refine ⟨t, ht1, ht2, fun s hs => ⟨⟨fun h => hsm.injOn hs htI (h.trans ht0'.symm), ?_⟩, ?_⟩⟩
    · rintro rfl; exact ht0'
    · have key : d * F (sepPlaneProj b x + t • e b) < d * F (sepPlaneProj b x + s • e b) ↔
          t < s := hsm.lt_iff_lt htI hs
      rw [ht0'] at key
      exact key
  choose! V hV1 hV2 hV3 using hroot
  have hVI : ∀ x : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ →
      V x ∈ Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η) :=
    fun x hx => ⟨(hV1 x hx).le, (hV2 x hx).le⟩
  have hmemr₀ : ∀ x : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ →
      dist (sepPlaneProj b x + V x • e b) y₀ < r₀ :=
    fun x hx => hline x (lt_of_lt_of_le hx hρη) _ (hVI x hx)
  have hzeroV : ∀ x : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ →
      F (sepPlaneProj b x + V x • e b) = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have h := ((hV3 x hx (V x) (hVI x hx)).1).2 rfl
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_left hb
  have hderV : ∀ x : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ →
      partialDeriv b F (sepPlaneProj b x + V x • e b) ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx h
    have := hsign _ (hmemr₀ x hx)
    rw [h, mul_zero] at this
    exact lt_irrefl _ this
  have hunV : ∀ x : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ → ∀ s : ℝ, y₀ b - η < s →
      s < y₀ b + η → F (sepPlaneProj b x + s • e b) = 0 → s = V x := by
    intro x hx s hs1 hs2 hs
    exact ((hV3 x hx s ⟨hs1.le, hs2.le⟩).1).1 (by rw [hs, mul_zero])
  have hDopen : IsOpen {x : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ} := by
    have : {x : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ} = {x : E3 | ‖P (x - y₀)‖ < ρ} := by
      simp only [hP]
    rw [this]
    exact isOpen_lt (P.continuous.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm
      continuous_const
  
  have hsmooth : ∀ x₀ : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (x₀ - y₀)‖ < ρ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ V x₀ := by
    intro x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ : ∃ z₀ : E3, z₀ = sepPlaneProj b x₀ + V x₀ • e b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hz₀U : z₀ ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ε := by rw [hz₀]; exact hinball _ (hmemr₀ x₀ hx₀)
    have hFz₀ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F z₀ := hFat z₀ hz₀U
    have hκ : partialDeriv b F z₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [hz₀]; exact hderV x₀ hx₀
    have hFz₀0 : F z₀ = 0 := by rw [hz₀]; exact hzeroV x₀ hx₀
    have hFdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z₀ := hFz₀.differentiableAt hn0
    have hΨ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => P z + F z • e b) z₀ :=
      P.contDiff.contDiffAt.add (hFz₀.smul contDiffAt_const)
    have hL : HasFDerivAt (fun z => P z + F z • e b)
        (P + (fderiv ℝ F z₀).smulRight (e b)) z₀ :=
      P.hasFDerivAt.add (hFdiff.hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e b))
    have hLapp : ∀ v : E3, (P + (fderiv ℝ F z₀).smulRight (e b)) v =
        sepPlaneProj b v + (fderiv ℝ F z₀ v) • e b := by
      intro v
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, hP]
    have hinj : Function.Injective (P + (fderiv ℝ F z₀).smulRight (e b)) := by
      refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 ?_
      intro v hv
      rw [hLapp] at hv
      have h1 : fderiv ℝ F z₀ v = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w b) hv
        simpa [hP1] using h
      rw [h1, zero_smul, add_zero] at hv
      have hv' : v = (v b) • e b := by
        have h := hP5 v
        rw [hv, zero_add] at h
        exact h.symm
      have h2 : fderiv ℝ F z₀ v = v b * partialDeriv b F z₀ := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hv']
        rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
        rfl
      have hvb : v b = 0 := by
        rw [h1] at h2
        exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h2.symm).resolve_right hκ
      rw [hv', hvb, zero_smul]
    let f' : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3 :=
      (LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo
        ((P + (fderiv ℝ F z₀).smulRight (e b) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)
        hinj).toContinuousLinearEquiv
    have hf' : HasFDerivAt (fun z => P z + F z • e b) (f' : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) z₀ := by
      have hfL : (f' : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) = P + (fderiv ℝ F z₀).smulRight (e b) := by
        ext v; rfl
      rw [hfL]; exact hL
    have hn : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
    have hs : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun z => P z + F z • e b) (f' : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) z₀ :=
      hΨ.hasStrictFDerivAt' hf' hn
    have hG1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (hΨ.localInverse hf' hn) (P z₀ + F z₀ • e b) :=
      hΨ.to_localInverse hf' hn
    have hG2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (P z₀ + F z₀ • e b),
        P (hΨ.localInverse hf' hn y) + F (hΨ.localInverse hf' hn y) • e b = y :=
      hs.eventually_right_inverse
    have hG4 : hΨ.localInverse hf' hn (P z₀ + F z₀ • e b) = z₀ :=
      hs.localInverse_apply_image
    generalize hΨ.localInverse hf' hn = G at hG1 hG2 hG4
    have hΨz₀ : P z₀ + F z₀ • e b = P x₀ := by
      rw [hFz₀0, zero_smul, add_zero, hP, hP, hz₀, hP2, hP3]
    rw [hΨz₀] at hG1 hG2 hG4
    have hW : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => (G (P x)) b) x₀ := by
      have h := hG1.comp x₀ P.contDiff.contDiffAt
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj b : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp x₀ h
    have hev1 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, x ∈ {x : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ} :=
      hDopen.mem_nhds hx₀
    have hev2 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, P (G (P x)) + F (G (P x)) • e b = P x :=
      (P.continuous.tendsto x₀).eventually hG2
    have hval : (G (P x₀)) b = V x₀ := by rw [hG4, hz₀, hP4]
    have hev3 : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, (G (P x)) b ∈ Set.Ioo (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η) := by
      apply hW.continuousAt.eventually_mem
      show Set.Ioo (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η) ∈ 𝓝 ((G (P x₀)) b)
      rw [hval]
      exact isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ⟨hV1 x₀ hx₀, hV2 x₀ hx₀⟩
    have hVW : V =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀] fun x => (G (P x)) b := by
      filter_upwards [hev1, hev2, hev3] with x hx1 hx2 hx3
      show V x = (G (P x)) b
      generalize G (P x) = w at hx2 hx3 ⊢
      rw [hP, hP] at hx2
      have hFw : F w = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u b) hx2
        simpa [hP1] using h
      rw [hFw, zero_smul, add_zero] at hx2
      have hw : sepPlaneProj b x + (w b) • e b = w := by
        rw [← hx2, hP5]
      have h := hunV x hx1 (w b) hx3.1 hx3.2 (by rw [hw]; exact hFw)
      exact h.symm
    exact hW.congr_of_eventuallyEq hVW
  
  have hPP : ∀ z : E3, sepPlaneProj b (sepPlaneProj b z - y₀) = sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀) := by
    intro z; rw [hP6 (sepPlaneProj b z) y₀, hP3, hP6 z y₀]
  have hcylr : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl b y₀ ρ η, dist z y₀ < r₀ := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀)‖ < ρ ∧ |z b - y₀ b| < η := hz
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have h := hP7 (z - y₀)
    rw [PiLp.sub_apply] at h
    linarith [hz'.1, hz'.2]
  refine ⟨V, ρ, η, hρpos, hηpos, fun x hx => (hsmooth x hx).contDiffWithinAt, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hD : ‖sepPlaneProj b (sepPlaneProj b y₀ - y₀)‖ < ρ := by
      rw [hPP, hP0, norm_zero]; exact hρpos
    have h := ((hV3 _ hD (y₀ b) hIc).1).1
    rw [hP3, hP5, hF0, mul_zero] at h
    exact (h rfl).symm
  · intro z hz
    exact hinball z (hcylr z hz)
  · intro z hz
    have hD : ‖sepPlaneProj b (sepPlaneProj b z - y₀)‖ < ρ := by rw [hPP]; exact hz
    rw [abs_sub_lt_iff]
    constructor <;> linarith [hV1 _ hD, hV2 _ hD]
  · intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀)‖ < ρ ∧ |z b - y₀ b| < η := hz
    have hD : ‖sepPlaneProj b (sepPlaneProj b z - y₀)‖ < ρ := by rw [hPP]; exact hz'.1
    have hzI : z b ∈ Set.Icc (y₀ b - η) (y₀ b + η) := by
      have := hz'.2
      rw [abs_lt] at this
      exact ⟨by linarith [this.1], by linarith [this.2]⟩
    have h := hV3 _ hD (z b) hzI
    rw [hP3, hP5] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hsign z (hcylr z hz)⟩
    · rw [← h1]
      constructor
      · intro h; rw [h, mul_zero]
      · intro h; exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_left hb
    · exact hsignlemma d (F z) (z b - V (sepPlaneProj b z)) hb (h1.trans sub_eq_zero.symm)
        (h2.trans sub_pos.symm)

informal_problem.statement:
(V : E3 → ℝ) (b : Fin 3) (y₀ : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V {x : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ}) :
    ∃ W : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ W ∧
      ∀ x : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ / 2 →
        W (sepPlaneProj b x) = V (sepPlaneProj b x)

signature.name: plane_function_globalize
signature.statement:
(V : E3 → ℝ) (b : Fin 3) (y₀ : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V {x : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ}) :
    ∃ W : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ W ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  have hPsub : ∀ v w : E3, sepPlaneProj b (v - w) = sepPlaneProj b v - sepPlaneProj b w := by
    intro v w
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]; abel
  have hPP : ∀ v : E3, sepPlaneProj b (sepPlaneProj b v) = sepPlaneProj b v := by
    intro v
    have h0 : (sepPlaneProj b v) b = 0 := by simp [sepPlaneProj, e]
    conv_lhs => rw [sepPlaneProj]
    simp only [h0, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hPnorm : ∀ v : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    by_cases hib : i = b
    · subst hib
      simp [sepPlaneProj, e]
      positivity
    · simp [sepPlaneProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hib]
  set c := sepPlaneProj b y₀ with hc
  have hPc : ∀ w : E3, sepPlaneProj b (w - y₀) = sepPlaneProj b (w - c) := by
    intro w
    rw [hPsub, hPsub, hc, hPP]
  have hDopen : IsOpen {x : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ} := by
    apply isOpen_lt _ continuous_const
    unfold sepPlaneProj
    fun_prop
  have hsub : Metric.closedBall c (3 * ρ / 4) ⊆ {x : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ} := by
    intro w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hw
    show ‖sepPlaneProj b (w - y₀)‖ < ρ
    rw [hPc]
    linarith [hPnorm (w - c)]
  let β : ContDiffBump c := ⟨ρ / 2, 3 * ρ / 4, by positivity, by linarith⟩
  refine ⟨fun x => β x * V x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ {x : E3 | ‖sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀)‖ < ρ}
    · exact (β.contDiff.contDiffAt).mul (hV.contDiffAt (hDopen.mem_nhds hx))
    · have hxs : x ∉ tsupport β := by
        rw [β.tsupport_eq]
        exact fun h => hx (hsub h)
      have hev := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hxs
      refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
      simp [hy]
  · intro x hx
    have hmem : sepPlaneProj b x ∈ Metric.closedBall c β.rIn := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
      have h1 : sepPlaneProj b x - c = sepPlaneProj b (x - y₀) := by rw [hc, ← hPsub]
      rw [h1]
      exact le_of_lt hx
    show β (sepPlaneProj b x) * V (sepPlaneProj b x) = V (sepPlaneProj b x)
    rw [β.one_of_mem_closedBall hmem, one_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(V : E3 → ℝ) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (b : Fin 3) (y₀ : E3)
    (hd : ∀ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj b w)) y₀| ≤ 1) :
    ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀)‖ < ρ₀ →
      |V (sepPlaneProj b z) - V (sepPlaneProj b y₀)| ≤ 4 * ‖sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀)‖

signature.name: graph_slab_bound
signature.statement:
(V : E3 → ℝ) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (b : Fin 3) (y₀ : E3)
    (hd : ∀ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj b w)) y₀| ≤ 1) :
    ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀)‖ < ρ₀ →
      |V (sepPlaneProj b z) - V (sepPlaneProj b y₀)| ≤ 4 * ‖sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀)‖

proof.tactics:
by
  have hPcd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (sepPlaneProj b) := by
    unfold sepPlaneProj; fun_prop
  have hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj b w)) := hV.comp hPcd
  have hdi : ∀ i : Fin 3, |fderiv ℝ (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj b w)) y₀ (e i)| ≤ 1 :=
    fun i => hd i
  
  have hop : ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj b w)) y₀‖ ≤ 3 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by norm_num) (fun v => ?_)
    set L := fderiv ℝ (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj b w)) y₀ with hLdef
    have hv : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hL : L v = v 0 * L (e 0) + v 1 * L (e 1) + v 2 * L (e 2) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hvi : ∀ i, |v i| ≤ ‖v‖ := fun i => by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le v i
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
    have hterm : ∀ i, |v i * L (e i)| ≤ ‖v‖ := fun i => by
      rw [abs_mul]
      have h1 := hdi i
      have h2 := hvi i
      have h3 := abs_nonneg (v i)
      have h4 := abs_nonneg (L (e i))
      nlinarith
    rw [hL, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hsum := abs_add_three (v 0 * L (e 0)) (v 1 * L (e 1)) (v 2 * L (e 2))
    linarith [hterm 0, hterm 1, hterm 2]
  
  have hc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj b w))) :=
    hF.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδb⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hc.continuousAt 1 one_pos
  have hbd : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y₀ δ,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj b w)) x‖ ≤ 4 := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hδb (Metric.mem_ball.mp hx)
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at h1
    have h2 := norm_le_insert' (fderiv ℝ (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj b w)) x)
      (fderiv ℝ (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj b w)) y₀)
    linarith
  have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y₀ δ,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => V (sepPlaneProj b w)) x :=
    fun x _ => hF.differentiable (by simp) x
  
  have hPid : ∀ z : E3, sepPlaneProj b (y₀ + sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀)) = sepPlaneProj b z := by
    intro z
    unfold sepPlaneProj
    ext j
    by_cases hj : j = b
    · subst hj; simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    · simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hj]
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have hy : y₀ + sepPlaneProj b (z - y₀) ∈ Metric.ball y₀ δ := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact hz
  have hmv := (convex_ball y₀ δ).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff hbd
    (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ) hy
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, Real.norm_eq_abs, hPid z] at hmv
  exact hmv

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (D U Jc Γc : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hD : IsOpen D) (hDJ : Disjoint D Jc) (hDΓ : Disjoint D Γc)
    (hJΓ : Disjoint Jc Γc) (hJcl : closure Jc ∩ U ⊆ Jc) (hΓcl : closure Γc ∩ U ⊆ Γc)
    (hside : ∀ y ∈ Γc ∩ U, ∃ (V : Set E3) (φ : E3 → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ y ∈ V ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ V ∧ (∀ z ∈ V, fderiv ℝ φ z ≠ 0) ∧ V ∩ D = V ∩ {z | 0 < φ z}) :
    hullPerG G D U (Jc ∪ Γc) ≤ hullPerG G D U Jc

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (D U Jc Γc : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
