    (hside : ∀ y ∈ Γc ∩ U, ∃ (V : Set E3) (φ : E3 → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ y ∈ V ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ V ∧ (∀ z ∈ V, fderiv ℝ φ z ≠ 0) ∧ V ∩ D = V ∩ {z | 0 < φ z}) :
    hullPerG G D U (Jc ∪ Γc) ≤ hullPerG G D U Jc

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have L1 : ∀ (K₁ K₂ : Set E3), (∀ X : E3 → E3, (∀ y, y ∉ K₁ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) →
      HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U →
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →
      (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ Y : E3 → E3,
        ((∀ y, y ∉ K₂ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ U ∧
          (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) ∧
          ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G Y y| ≤ C) ∧
        (∫ y in D, sepDensDiv G X y) - ε ≤ ∫ y in D, sepDensDiv G Y y) →
      hullPerG G D U K₁ ≤ hullPerG G D U K₂ := by
    intro K₁ K₂ happrox
    unfold hullPerG
    refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
    refine ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε _ => ?_
    obtain ⟨Y, hY, hint⟩ := happrox X hX.1 hX.2.1 hX.2.2.1 hX.2.2.2.1 hX.2.2.2.2 ε
      (NNReal.coe_pos.2 hε)
    calc ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in D, sepDensDiv G X y)
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ y in D, sepDensDiv G Y y) + ε) :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith)
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in D, sepDensDiv G Y y) + ENNReal.ofReal ε :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_add_le
      _ ≤ _ := by
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
          gcongr
          exact le_iSup_of_le Y (le_iSup_of_le hY le_rfl)
  
  have L7 : ∀ (K V : Set E3) (φ : E3 → ℝ), IsCompact K → IsOpen V → ContinuousOn φ V →
      (∀ τ : ℝ, MeasurableSet (K ∩ {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < φ y ∧ φ y < τ}) ∧
        volume (K ∩ {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < φ y ∧ φ y < τ}) < ⊤) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => (volume (K ∩ {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < φ y ∧
        φ y < 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)})).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro K V φ hK hV hφ
    have hopen : ∀ τ : ℝ, IsOpen {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < φ y ∧ φ y < τ} := by
      intro τ
      have h := hφ.isOpen_inter_preimage hV (isOpen_Ioo (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := τ))
      convert h using 1
    have hmeas : ∀ τ : ℝ, MeasurableSet (K ∩ {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < φ y ∧ φ y < τ}) := fun τ =>
      hK.isClosed.measurableSet.inter (hopen τ).measurableSet
    have hfin : ∀ τ : ℝ, volume (K ∩ {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < φ y ∧ φ y < τ}) < ⊤ := fun τ =>
      (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_left).trans_lt hK.measure_lt_top
    refine ⟨fun τ => ⟨hmeas τ, hfin τ⟩, ?_⟩
    have hanti : Antitone (fun m : ℕ => K ∩ {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < φ y ∧ φ y < 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)}) := by
      intro a b hab y hy
      refine ⟨hy.1, hy.2.1, hy.2.2.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hy.2.2.2 ?_⟩
      have h : (a : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hab
      exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
    have hlim := tendsto_measure_iInter_atTop (μ := volume)
      (fun m : ℕ => (hmeas (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1))).nullMeasurableSet) hanti
      ⟨0, (hfin _).ne⟩
    have hempty : (⋂ m : ℕ, K ∩ {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < φ y ∧ φ y < 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)}) = ∅ := by
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
      intro y hy
      rw [Set.mem_iInter] at hy
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt (hy 0).2.2.1
      exact absurd (hy n).2.2.2 (not_lt.2 hn.le)
    rw [hempty, measure_empty] at hlim
    have h2 := (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal ENNReal.zero_ne_top).comp hlim
    simpa using h2
  
  have L8 : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (r : ℕ) (B : Fin r → ℝ) (A : Fin r → Set E3), Integrable f →
      Integrable g → (∀ i, 0 ≤ B i) → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) → (∀ i, volume (A i) < ⊤) →
      (∀ z ∈ D, g z - ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (A i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z ≤ f z) →
      (∫ z in D, g z) - ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (volume (A i)).toReal ≤ ∫ z in D, f z := by
    intro f g r B A hf hg hB hA hAfin hpt
    have hind : ∀ i, Integrable ((A i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) := fun i =>
      (integrable_indicator_iff (hA i)).2 (integrableOn_const (hAfin i).ne)
    have hsum : Integrable (fun z => ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (A i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ fun i _ => (hind i).const_mul (B i)
    have h1 : ∫ z in D, (g z - ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (A i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) ≤
        ∫ z in D, f z :=
      setIntegral_mono_on (hg.sub hsum).integrableOn hf.integrableOn hD.measurableSet hpt
    have h2 : ∫ z in D, (g z - ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (A i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) =
        (∫ z in D, g z) - ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (volume (A i ∩ D)).toReal := by
      rw [integral_sub hg.integrableOn hsum.integrableOn,
        integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ((hind i).const_mul (B i)).integrableOn)]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_indicator_const _ (hA i)]
      simp [Measure.restrict_apply (hA i), measureReal_def]
    have h3 : ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (volume (A i ∩ D)).toReal ≤
        ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (volume (A i)).toReal :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (ENNReal.toReal_mono (hAfin i).ne (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_left)) (hB i)
    linarith
  
  have L9 : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (C : ℝ), HasCompactSupport Z → (∀ y, |sepDensDiv G Z y| ≤ C) →
      Integrable (sepDensDiv G Z) := by
    intro Z C hZ hZC
    have hmeas : Measurable (sepDensDiv G Z) := by
      have h : sepDensDiv G Z = fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) y (e i) := rfl
      rw [h]
      exact Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ _ _)
    have hsupp : Function.support (sepDensDiv G Z) ⊆ tsupport Z := by
      intro y hy
      by_contra hyt
      apply hy
      have hev : Z =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hyt
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
      have hev' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
        simp [hz]
      rw [hev'.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    rw [← integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset hsupp]
    refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded hZ.measure_lt_top.ne hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
      (M := C) ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hZC y
  
  have L5 : ∀ (K : Set E3) (X Y : E3 → E3) (C : ℝ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U →
      (∀ y ∈ K, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) → (∀ y, y ∉ K → Y =ᶠ[𝓝 y] X) →
      (∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C) → ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G Y y| ≤ C' := by
    intro K X Y C hK hKU hYK hYX hX5
    have hs : ∀ y ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y := by
      intro y hy
      have hent : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) y :=
        fun i j => (hG i j).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
      have h00 := hent 0 0
      have h01 := hent 0 1
      have h02 := hent 0 2
      have h10 := hent 1 0
      have h11 := hent 1 1
      have h12 := hent 1 2
      have h20 := hent 2 0
      have h21 := hent 2 1
      have h22 := hent 2 2
      have hdet : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) y := by
        have : (fun z => (G z).det) = fun z => G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2
            - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2
            + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0 + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1
            - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0 :=
          funext fun z => Matrix.det_fin_three _
        rw [this]
        fun_prop
      exact hdet.sqrt (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
    have hcont : ∀ y ∈ K, ContinuousAt (sepDensDiv G Y) y := by
      intro y hy
      have hterm : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousAt
          (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * Y w i) z (e i)) y := by
        intro i
        have hYi : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => Y z i) y :=
          (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp y (hYK y hy)
        have hh : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * Y w i) y :=
          (hs y (hKU hy)).mul hYi
        exact ((hh.fderiv_right (m := 0) (by simp)).continuousAt).clm_apply continuousAt_const
      have h : sepDensDiv G Y = fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3,
          fderiv ℝ (fun w => Real.sqrt (G w).det * Y w i) z (e i) := rfl
      rw [h]
      fun_prop
    obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (fun y hy => (hcont y hy).continuousWithinAt)
    refine ⟨max C C₁, fun y => ?_⟩
    by_cases hy : y ∈ K
    · have := hC₁ y hy
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this.trans (le_max_right _ _)
    · have heq : sepDensDiv G Y y = sepDensDiv G X y := by
        unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
            (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
          filter_upwards [hYX y hy] with z hz
          rw [hz]
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      rw [heq]
      exact (hX5 y).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have L4 : ∀ (X : E3 → E3) (r : ℕ) (χ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Set E3)
      (φ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (τ : ℝ), tsupport X ⊆ U →
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →
      (∀ i z, 0 ≤ χ i z) → (∀ z, ∑ i, χ i z ≤ 1) → (∀ i, tsupport (χ i) ⊆ V i ∩ U) →
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j *
        (X y + ∑ i : Fin r, (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
          (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) i *
        (X y + ∑ i : Fin r, (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
          (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) j ≤ 1 := by
    intro X r χ V φ τ hX3 hX4 hχ0 hχ1 hχV
    have qconv : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, A.PosDef →
        ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun v : E3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * v i * v j) := by
      intro A hA
      refine ⟨convex_univ, fun x _ y _ a b ha hb hab => ?_⟩
      have hq := hA.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (fun i => (x - y) i)
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three, star_trivial, PiLp.sub_apply]
        at hq
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
      subst hb'
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hb) hq]
    have qnorm : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, A.PosDef → ∀ ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j *
          ((Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b))⁻¹ *
            ∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ξ k) *
          ((Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b))⁻¹ *
            ∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ j k * ξ k) ≤ 1 := by
      intro A hA ξ
      set S := ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b with hS
      set c := (Real.sqrt S)⁻¹ with hc
      have hmul : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hA.det_pos.ne')
      have h1 : dotProduct (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ ξ) (Matrix.mulVec A (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ ξ)) =
          dotProduct (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ ξ) ξ := by
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hmul, Matrix.one_mulVec]
      have hQ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * (c * ∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i k * ξ k) *
          (c * ∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ j k * ξ k) = c ^ 2 * S := by
        simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h1
        rw [hS]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        linear_combination c ^ 2 * h1
      rw [hQ]
      by_cases hS0 : 0 < S
      · rw [hc, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hS0.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hS0.ne']
      · have : Real.sqrt S = 0 := Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.2 (not_lt.1 hS0)
        rw [hc, this]
        simp
    intro y
    set Yy := X y + ∑ i : Fin r, (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
          (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y) with hYy
    by_cases hyU : y ∈ U
    · set A := G y with hA
      have hApd : A.PosDef := hpd y hyU
      set lam : Fin r → ℝ := fun i => χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))
        with hlam
      have hlam0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ lam i := fun i =>
        mul_nonneg (hχ0 i y) (sub_nonneg.2 (Real.smoothTransition.le_one _))
      have hlamχ : ∀ i, lam i ≤ χ i y := fun i => by
        have h1 := hχ0 i y
        have h2 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1)
        simp only [hlam]
        nlinarith
      have hlam1 : ∑ i, lam i ≤ 1 :=
        (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hlamχ i).trans (hχ1 y)
      let w : Option (Fin r) → ℝ := fun o => o.elim (1 - ∑ i, lam i) lam
      let p : Option (Fin r) → E3 := fun o => o.elim (X y)
        (fun i => -(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y))
      have hrep : Yy = ∑ o : Option (Fin r), w o • p o := by
        rw [hYy, Fintype.sum_option]
        simp only [w, p, Option.elim]
        simp only [smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_smul, one_smul, Finset.sum_smul]
        abel
      have hw0 : ∀ o ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Option (Fin r))), 0 ≤ w o := by
        intro o _
        cases o with
        | none => simp only [w, Option.elim]; linarith
        | some i => exact hlam0 i
      have hw1 : ∑ o ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Option (Fin r))), w o = 1 := by
        rw [Fintype.sum_option]
        simp only [w, Option.elim]
        ring
      have hJ := (qconv A hApd).map_sum_le hw0 hw1 (fun o _ => Set.mem_univ (p o))
      rw [← hrep] at hJ
      refine hJ.trans ?_
      rw [Fintype.sum_option]
      simp only [w, p, Option.elim, smul_eq_mul]
      have hN : ∀ i, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y)) a *
          (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y)) b ≤ 1 := by
        intro i
        have := qnorm A hApd (fun k => partialDeriv k (φ i) y)
        simpa [hcrNormalField, calUnitNormal, hA] using this
      have hsum : ∑ i, lam i * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b *
          (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y)) a * (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y)) b ≤ ∑ i, lam i :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hN i) (hlam0 i)
          linarith
      have hX := hX4 y
      have : (1 - ∑ i, lam i) * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * X y a * X y b ≤
          1 - ∑ i, lam i := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX (sub_nonneg.2 hlam1)
        linarith
      linarith
    · have hX0 : X y = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hyU (hX3 h))
      have hχy : ∀ i, χ i y = 0 := fun i =>
        image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hyU ((hχV i h).2))
      have : Yy = 0 := by
        rw [hYy, hX0]
        simp [hχy]
      rw [this]
      simp
  apply L1 (Jc ∪ Γc) Jc
  intro X hX1 hX2 hX3 hX4 hX5 ε hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hX5
  obtain ⟨r, χ, V, φ, hχ, hχ0, hχ1, hχΓ, hχc, hχV, hχJ, hV, hφ, hdφ, hVD⟩ :=
    onesided_cutoff_family D U Jc Γc (tsupport X) hU hX2 hX3 hJΓ hJcl hΓcl hside
  obtain ⟨Yf, hYf⟩ : ∃ Yf : ℝ → E3 → E3, Yf = fun τ y => X y + ∑ i : Fin r,
      (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
        (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXD : ∀ z ∈ D, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X z := fun z hz => hX1 z (fun h => h.elim
      (Set.disjoint_left.1 hDJ hz) (Set.disjoint_left.1 hDΓ hz))
  obtain ⟨B, hB0, hBpt⟩ := collar_div_pointwise G D U X Yf C r χ V φ hU hG hpd hXD hX4 hC hχ
    hχ0 hχ1 hχc hχV hV hφ hdφ hVD (fun τ y => by rw [hYf])
  have hcol := fun i => L7 (tsupport (χ i)) (V i) (φ i) (hχc i) (hV i)
    (hφ i).continuousOn
  have htend : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (volume (tsupport (χ i) ∩
      {y | y ∈ V i ∧ 0 < φ i y ∧ φ i y < 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)})).toReal) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := tendsto_finset_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r))
      (fun i _ => ((hcol i).2.const_mul (B i)))
    simpa using h
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (htend.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)).exists
  have hτ : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨hY1, hYK, hY2, hY3⟩ := collar_field_regular G D U Jc Γc X (Yf (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1))) r χ
    V φ (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) hU hG hpd hDΓ hX1 hX2 hX3 hχ hχΓ hχc hχV hχJ hV hφ hdφ hVD hτ
    (by rw [hYf])
  have hY4 : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Yf (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) y i *
      Yf (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) y j ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    rw [hYf]
    exact L4 X r χ V φ (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)) hX3 hX4 hχ0 hχ1 hχV y
  have hKc : IsCompact (⋃ i, tsupport (χ i)) := isCompact_iUnion hχc
  have hKU : (⋃ i, tsupport (χ i)) ⊆ U :=
    Set.iUnion_subset fun i => (hχV i).trans Set.inter_subset_right
  obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := L5 (⋃ i, tsupport (χ i)) X
    (Yf (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1))) C hKc hKU
    (fun y hy => by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hy
      exact hYK i y hi)
    (fun y hy => by
      filter_upwards [hKc.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      have h0 : ∀ i, χ i z = 0 := fun i =>
        image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hz (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, h⟩))
      simp [hYf, h0])
    hC
  have hintX := L9 X C hX2 hC
  have hintY := L9 (Yf (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1))) C' hY2 hC'
  have hcmp := L8 (sepDensDiv G (Yf (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1))))
    (sepDensDiv G X) r B
    (fun i => tsupport (χ i) ∩ {y | y ∈ V i ∧ 0 < φ i y ∧ φ i y < 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)})
    hintY hintX hB0
    (fun i => ((hcol i).1 _).1) (fun i => ((hcol i).1 _).2) (hBpt _ hτ)
  refine ⟨Yf (1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)), ⟨hY1, hY2, hY3, hY4, C', hC'⟩, ?_⟩
  linarith

subgoal_signatures.name: onesided_cutoff_family
subgoal_signatures.statement: (D U Jc Γc T : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hT : IsCompact T) (hTU : T ⊆ U) (hJΓ : Disjoint Jc Γc) (hJcl : closure Jc ∩ U ⊆ Jc) (hΓcl : closure Γc ∩ U ⊆ Γc) (hside : ∀ y ∈ Γc ∩ U, ∃ (V : Set E3) (φ : E3 → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ y ∈ V ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ V ∧ (∀ z ∈ V, fderiv ℝ φ z ≠ 0) ∧ V ∩ D = V ∩ {z | 0 < φ z}) : ∃ (r : ℕ) (χ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Set E3) (φ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ), (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ i)) ∧ (∀ i z, 0 ≤ χ i z) ∧ (∀ z, ∑ i, χ i z ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Γc ∩ T, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, z ∈ T → ∑ i, χ i z = 1) ∧ (∀ i, IsCompact (tsupport (χ i))) ∧ (∀ i, tsupport (χ i) ⊆ V i ∩ U) ∧ (∀ i, Disjoint (tsupport (χ i)) (Jc ∩ T)) ∧ (∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) ∧ (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (V i)) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V i, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ i, V i ∩ D = V i ∩ {z | 0 < φ i z})

subgoal_signatures.name: collar_field_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (D U Jc Γc : Set E3) (X Y : E3 → E3) (r : ℕ) (χ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Set E3) (φ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hDΓ : Disjoint D Γc) (hX1 : ∀ y, y ∉ Jc ∪ Γc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) (hX2 : HasCompactSupport X) (hX3 : tsupport X ⊆ U) (hχ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ i)) (hχΓ : ∀ y ∈ Γc ∩ tsupport X, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, z ∈ tsupport X → ∑ i, χ i z = 1) (hχc : ∀ i, IsCompact (tsupport (χ i))) (hχV : ∀ i, tsupport (χ i) ⊆ V i ∩ U) (hχJ : ∀ i, Disjoint (tsupport (χ i)) (Jc ∩ tsupport X)) (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (V i)) (hdφ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V i, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0) (hVD : ∀ i, V i ∩ D = V i ∩ {z | 0 < φ i z}) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hY : Y = fun y => X y + ∑ i : Fin r, (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) • (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) : (∀ y, y ∉ Jc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ tsupport (χ i), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ U

subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (D U : Set E3) (X : E3 → E3) (Y : ℝ → E3 → E3) (C : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (χ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Set E3) (φ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hXD : ∀ z ∈ D, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X z) (hX4 : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) (hX5 : ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C) (hχ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ i)) (hχ0 : ∀ i z, 0 ≤ χ i z) (hχ1 : ∀ z, ∑ i, χ i z ≤ 1) (hχc : ∀ i, IsCompact (tsupport (χ i))) (hχV : ∀ i, tsupport (χ i) ⊆ V i ∩ U) (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (V i)) (hdφ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V i, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0) (hVD : ∀ i, V i ∩ D = V i ∩ {z | 0 < φ i z}) (hY : ∀ τ y, Y τ y = X y + ∑ i : Fin r, (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) • (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) : ∃ B : Fin r → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ B i) ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ D, sepDensDiv G X z - ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (tsupport (χ i) ∩ {y | y ∈ V i ∧ 0 < φ i y ∧ φ i y < τ}).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z ≤ sepDensDiv G (Y τ) z

signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig : Set M) (hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) (p : M) (hp : p ∈ Sig) : ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), eigGraphChart Sig p a u r δ

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set κ := chartAt E3 p with hκ
  set c : E3 := κ p with hcdef
  have hps : p ∈ κ.source := mem_chart_source E3 p
  have hct : c ∈ κ.target := κ.map_source hps
  
  obtain ⟨V₀, f₀, -, hV₀o, hpV₀, hf₀, hdf₀, hV₀S, -⟩ := hSm.2 p hp Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
  set U : Set E3 := κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' V₀ with hUdef
  have hUo : IsOpen U := κ.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage κ.open_target hV₀o
  have hcU : c ∈ U := by
    refine ⟨hct, ?_⟩
    show κ.symm (κ p) ∈ V₀
    rw [κ.left_inv hps]; exact hpV₀
  set Φ₀ : E3 → ℝ := fun z => f₀ (κ.symm z) with hΦ₀def
  have hΦt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ₀ κ.target :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.1 (hf₀.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ₀ U := hΦt.mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hzero : ∀ z ∈ U, (κ.symm z ∈ Sig ↔ Φ₀ z = 0) := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 := Set.ext_iff.1 hV₀S (κ.symm z)
    constructor
    · intro h; exact (h1.1 ⟨hz.2, h⟩).2
    · intro h; exact (h1.2 ⟨hz.2, h⟩).2
  have h0 : Φ₀ c = 0 := by
    have h1 := (hzero c hcU).1
    rw [show κ.symm c = p from κ.left_inv hps] at h1
    exact h1 hp
  have hDne : fderiv ℝ Φ₀ c ≠ 0 := by
    intro H
    have hev : f₀ =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (Φ₀ ∘ κ) := by
      filter_upwards [κ.open_source.mem_nhds hps] with x hx
      show f₀ x = f₀ (κ.symm (κ x))
      rw [κ.left_inv hx]
    have hΦm : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) Φ₀ (κ p) :=
      ((hΦ.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hcU)).contMDiffAt).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hκm : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ p :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hps
    have hc := mfderiv_comp p hΦm hκm
    rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv, H, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp, ← hev.mfderiv_eq] at hc
    exact hdf₀ p hpV₀ hc
  have hexa : ∃ a : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ Φ₀ c (e a) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hno
    push_neg at hno
    apply hDne
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    have hv : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [e]
    rw [hv]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, hno, smul_zero, add_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  obtain ⟨a, hd⟩ := hexa
  
  have hpadd : ∀ x y : E3, sepPlaneProj a (x + y) = sepPlaneProj a x + sepPlaneProj a y := by
    intro x y
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, add_smul]
    abel
  have hpsmul : ∀ (r : ℝ) (x : E3), sepPlaneProj a (r • x) = r • sepPlaneProj a x := by
    intro r x
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_sub, mul_smul]
  have hplin : IsLinearMap ℝ (sepPlaneProj a) := ⟨hpadd, hpsmul⟩
  let Lp : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (IsLinearMap.mk' _ hplin)
  have hpsub : ∀ x y : E3, sepPlaneProj a (x - y) = sepPlaneProj a x - sepPlaneProj a y :=
    fun x y => map_sub Lp x y
  have hea : (e a) a = 1 := by simp [e]
  have hPa : ∀ w : E3, (sepPlaneProj a w) a = 0 := by
    intro w
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hea, mul_one,
      sub_self]
  have hPe : sepPlaneProj a (e a) = 0 := by
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, hea, one_smul, sub_self]
  have hrec : ∀ z : E3, sepPlaneProj a z + (z a) • e a = z := by
    intro z
    simp only [sepPlaneProj, sub_add_cancel]
  have hPP : ∀ (w : E3) (t : ℝ),
      sepPlaneProj a (sepPlaneProj a w + t • e a) = sepPlaneProj a w := by
    intro w t
    rw [hpadd, hpsmul, hPe, smul_zero, add_zero]
    show sepPlaneProj a w - (sepPlaneProj a w) a • e a = sepPlaneProj a w
    rw [hPa, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hPPi : ∀ w : E3, sepPlaneProj a (sepPlaneProj a w) = sepPlaneProj a w := by
    intro w
    show sepPlaneProj a w - (sepPlaneProj a w) a • e a = sepPlaneProj a w
    rw [hPa, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hPcoord : ∀ (w : E3) (t : ℝ), (sepPlaneProj a w + t • e a) a = t := by
    intro w t
    simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hPa, hea, mul_one, zero_add]
  have hea1 : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  have hPnorm : ∀ v : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : i = a
    · rw [hi, hPa, norm_zero]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖v a‖]
    · simp [sepPlaneProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hi]
  have hPrev : ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ≤ ‖sepPlaneProj a v‖ + |v a| := by
    intro v
    calc ‖v‖ = ‖sepPlaneProj a v + (v a) • e a‖ := by rw [hrec v]
      _ ≤ ‖sepPlaneProj a v‖ + ‖(v a) • e a‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖sepPlaneProj a v‖ + |v a| := by rw [norm_smul, hea1, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  
  set Ψ : E3 → E3 := fun z => sepPlaneProj a z + Φ₀ z • e a with hΨdef
  have hΦd : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ₀ z := fun z hz =>
    (hΦ.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hΨc : ∀ z ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Ψ z := fun z hz =>
    Lp.contDiff.contDiffAt.add ((hΦ.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)).smul contDiffAt_const)
  have hΨd : ∀ z ∈ U, HasFDerivAt Ψ (Lp + (fderiv ℝ Φ₀ z).smulRight (e a)) z := fun z hz =>
    Lp.hasFDerivAt.add ((hΦd z hz).hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e a))
  have hequiv : ∀ z ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ₀ z (e a) ≠ 0 →
      ∃ L : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3, HasFDerivAt Ψ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) z := by
    intro z hz hdz
    set D := fderiv ℝ Φ₀ z with hD
    set Lz : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := Lp + D.smulRight (e a) with hLz
    have hinj : Function.Injective (Lz : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) := by
      refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero (Lz : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)).2 fun v hv => ?_
      have hv' : sepPlaneProj a v + D v • e a = 0 := hv
      have h1 : (sepPlaneProj a v + D v • e a) a = (0 : E3) a := by rw [hv']
      rw [hPcoord] at h1
      have hDv : D v = 0 := by simpa using h1
      have h2 : sepPlaneProj a (sepPlaneProj a v + D v • e a) = sepPlaneProj a 0 := by rw [hv']
      rw [hPP] at h2
      have hπv : sepPlaneProj a v = 0 := by
        rw [h2]; simp [sepPlaneProj]
      have h3 : D v = v a * D (e a) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← hrec v]
        rw [hπv, zero_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hDv] at h3
      have hva : v a = 0 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h3.symm with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd h hdz
      rw [← hrec v, hπv, hva, zero_smul, add_zero]
    refine ⟨(LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo _ hinj).toContinuousLinearEquiv, ?_⟩
    have hco : ((LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo _ hinj).toContinuousLinearEquiv : E3 →L[ℝ] E3)
        = Lz := ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => rfl
    rw [hco]
    exact hΨd z hz
  obtain ⟨Lc, hLc⟩ := hequiv c hcU hd
  have hn : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  obtain ⟨H, hHcoe, hcH, hΨcH⟩ : ∃ H : OpenPartialHomeomorph E3 E3,
      (H : E3 → E3) = Ψ ∧ c ∈ H.source ∧ Ψ c ∈ H.target :=
    ⟨_, ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe (hΨc c hcU) hLc hn,
      ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source (hΨc c hcU) hLc hn,
      ContDiffAt.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target (hΨc c hcU) hLc hn⟩
  have hΨc0 : Ψ c = sepPlaneProj a c := by
    show sepPlaneProj a c + Φ₀ c • e a = sepPlaneProj a c
    rw [h0, zero_smul, add_zero]
  set G : Set E3 := U ∩ (fun z => fderiv ℝ Φ₀ z (e a)) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ with hGdef
  have hGo : IsOpen G := by
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ Φ₀ z (e a)) U :=
      (hΦ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    exact hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hUo isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hcG : c ∈ G := ⟨hcU, hd⟩
  set T : Set E3 := H.target ∩ H.symm ⁻¹' G with hTdef
  have hTo : IsOpen T := H.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage H.open_target hGo
  have hπcT : sepPlaneProj a c ∈ T := by
    rw [← hΨc0]
    refine ⟨hΨcH, ?_⟩
    show H.symm (Ψ c) ∈ G
    rw [← hHcoe, H.left_inv hcH]; exact hcG
  set w : E3 → ℝ := fun y => (H.symm y) a with hwdef
  have hws : ∀ y ∈ T, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ w y := by
    intro y hy
    have hxG : H.symm y ∈ G := hy.2
    obtain ⟨Lx, hLx⟩ := hequiv (H.symm y) hxG.1 hxG.2
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (H : E3 → E3) (Lx : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (H.symm y) := by
      rw [hHcoe]; exact hLx
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (H : E3 → E3) (H.symm y) := by
      rw [hHcoe]; exact hΨc _ hxG.1
    have h3 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (H.symm : E3 → E3) y := H.contDiffAt_symm hy.1 h1 h2
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp y h3
  obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, hb₁⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hTo _ hπcT
  obtain ⟨ε₂, hε₂, hb₂⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (H.open_source.inter hUo) c ⟨hcH, hcU⟩
  set ε := min ε₁ ε₂ with hεdef
  have hε : 0 < ε := lt_min hε₁ hε₂
  have hwsε : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (sepPlaneProj a c) ε, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ w y :=
    fun y hy => hws y (hb₁ (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hy))
  have hgr : ∀ z : E3, ‖z - c‖ < ε → z ∈ U ∧ (Φ₀ z = 0 ↔ z a = w (sepPlaneProj a z)) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzb : z ∈ Metric.ball c ε₂ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_right _ _)
    obtain ⟨hzH, hzU⟩ := hb₂ hzb
    have hπz : sepPlaneProj a z ∈ T := by
      apply hb₁
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, ← hpsub]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hPnorm _) (lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_left _ _))
    refine ⟨hzU, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hz0
      have hHz : H z = sepPlaneProj a z := by
        rw [hHcoe]
        show sepPlaneProj a z + Φ₀ z • e a = sepPlaneProj a z
        rw [hz0, zero_smul, add_zero]
      show z a = (H.symm (sepPlaneProj a z)) a
      rw [← hHz, H.left_inv hzH]
    · intro hza
      set y := H.symm (sepPlaneProj a z) with hydef
      have hyΨ : Ψ y = sepPlaneProj a z := by
        rw [← hHcoe]; exact H.right_inv hπz.1
      have hyΨ' : sepPlaneProj a y + Φ₀ y • e a = sepPlaneProj a z := hyΨ
      have hπy : sepPlaneProj a y = sepPlaneProj a z := by
        have h1 := congrArg (sepPlaneProj a) hyΨ'
        rwa [hPP, hPPi] at h1
      have hΦy : Φ₀ y = 0 := by
        have h1 : (sepPlaneProj a y + Φ₀ y • e a) a = (sepPlaneProj a z) a := by rw [hyΨ']
        rw [hPcoord, hPa] at h1
        exact h1
      have hya : y a = z a := hza.symm
      have hyz : y = z := by
        rw [← hrec y, ← hrec z, hπy, hya]
      rw [← hyz]; exact hΦy
  
  set x₀ := sepPlaneProj a c with hx₀
  let β : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨ε / 2, 3 * ε / 4, by positivity, by linarith⟩
  set u : E3 → ℝ := fun y => β y * w y with hudef
  have huw : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (ε / 2), u y = w y := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : β y = 1 := β.one_of_mem_closedBall (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
    show β y * w y = w y
    rw [h1, one_mul]
  have hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hy : dist y x₀ < ε
    · exact (β.contDiff.contDiffAt).mul (hwsε y hy)
    · push_neg at hy
      have hnot : y ∉ tsupport β := by
        rw [β.tsupport_eq]
        intro hmem
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hmem
        have hro : β.rOut = 3 * ε / 4 := rfl
        linarith
      have hev : u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hnot] with x hx
        show β x * w x = 0
        rw [hx]; simp
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  
  have hwc : w x₀ = c a := ((hgr c (by simpa using hε)).2.1 h0).symm
  have hwcont : ContinuousAt w x₀ := (hwsε x₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hε)).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηw⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.1 hwcont (ε / 4) (by positivity)
  have hr : 0 < min η (ε / 4) := lt_min hη (by positivity)
  have hdisc : ∀ z : E3, ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ < min η (ε / 4) →
      u (sepPlaneProj a z) = w (sepPlaneProj a z) ∧ |w (sepPlaneProj a z) - c a| < ε / 4 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hpsub] at hz
    have h1 : dist (sepPlaneProj a z) x₀ < min η (ε / 4) := by rw [dist_eq_norm]; exact hz
    refine ⟨huw _ ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball]; linarith [min_le_right η (ε / 4)]
    · have h2 := hηw (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (min_le_left _ _))
      rw [Real.dist_eq, hwc] at h2; exact h2
  have hcyl : ∀ z ∈ sepCyl a c (min η (ε / 4)) (ε / 4), ‖z - c‖ < ε := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hz1, hz2⟩ := hz
    have h3 := hPrev (z - c)
    have h4 : (z - c) a = z a - c a := PiLp.sub_apply _ _ _ _
    rw [h4] at h3
    linarith [min_le_right η (ε / 4)]
  refine ⟨a, u, min η (ε / 4), ε / 4, hr, by positivity, hu, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    exact (hgr z (hcyl z hz)).1.1
  · intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖sepPlaneProj a (z - c)‖ < min η (ε / 4) := hz
    show |u (sepPlaneProj a z) - c a| < ε / 4
    rw [(hdisc z hz').1]
    exact (hdisc z hz').2
  · intro z hz
    have hz' : z ∈ sepCyl a c (min η (ε / 4)) (ε / 4) := hz
    obtain ⟨hzU, hiff⟩ := hgr z (hcyl z hz')
    obtain ⟨hz1, -⟩ := hz'
    show κ.symm z ∈ Sig ↔ z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z)
    rw [hzero z hzU, hiff, (hdisc z hz1).1]

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig : Set M) (hSc : IsCompact Sig) (hgraph : ∀ p ∈ Sig, ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), eigGraphChart Sig p a u r δ) : ∃ P : EigPatchedSurface M Sig, (∀ j, ∃ (z : M) (F : E2 → E3), eigSurfParam Sig z (P.W j) F ∧ P.param j = (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ∧ P.h j = pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) ∧ ∀ w : M → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) → eigSmoothAlong Sig w

signature.name: eig_patched_atlas
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig : Set M) (hSc : IsCompact Sig) (hgraph : ∀ p ∈ Sig, ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), eigGraphChart Sig p a u r δ) : ∃ P : EigPatchedSurface M Sig, (∀ j, ∃ (z : M) (F : E2 → E3), eigSurfParam Sig z (P.W j) F ∧ P.param j = (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ∧ P.h j = pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) ∧ ∀ w : M → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) → eigSmoothAlong Sig w

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hexp3 : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (v : E3) (m : Fin 3),
      (L v) m = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k * (L (e k)) m := by
    intro L v m
    have hv : v = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k • e k := by
      ext i
      simp [Pi.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    simp [map_smul]
  have hexp2 : ∀ (L : E2 →L[ℝ] E3) (v : E2) (m : Fin 3),
      (L v) m = ∑ k : Fin 2, v k * (L (e2 k)) m := by
    intro L v m
    have hv : v = ∑ k : Fin 2, v k • e2 k := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    simp [map_smul]
  
  have s2 : ∀ (p : M) (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), eigGraphChart Sig p a u r δ →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (epaGraphParam a u) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (epaPlaneCoord a) ∧
      eigSurfParam Sig p {x : E2 | ‖epaPlaneEmb a x - sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r}
        (epaGraphParam a u) ∧
      IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ) ∧
      p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (epaGraphParam a u x))
        {x : E2 | ‖epaPlaneEmb a x - sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r} ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun y => epaPlaneCoord a (chartAt E3 p y))
        ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ) ∧
      (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (epaGraphParam a u x)) ''
          {x : E2 | ‖epaPlaneEmb a x - sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r} =
        ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ) ∩ Sig ∧
      (∀ x ∈ {x : E2 | ‖epaPlaneEmb a x - sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r},
        epaPlaneCoord a (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm (epaGraphParam a u x))) = x) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ, y ∈ Sig →
        epaGraphParam a u (epaPlaneCoord a (chartAt E3 p y)) = chartAt E3 p y) := by
    intro p a u r δ hG
    obtain ⟨hr, hδ, hu, hcyl, hheight, hgr⟩ := hG
    
    have hEs : ∀ (x : E2) (m : Fin 2), (epaPlaneEmb a x) (a.succAbove m) = x m := by
      intro x m
      simp [epaPlaneEmb, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      fin_cases m <;> simp
    have hEa : ∀ x : E2, (epaPlaneEmb a x) a = 0 := by
      intro x
      simp [epaPlaneEmb, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.ne_succAbove]
    have hCm : ∀ (z : E3) (m : Fin 2), (epaPlaneCoord a z) m = z (a.succAbove m) := by
      intro z m
      simp [epaPlaneCoord, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      fin_cases m <;> simp
    have hCE : ∀ x : E2, epaPlaneCoord a (epaPlaneEmb a x) = x := by
      intro x
      ext m
      rw [hCm, hEs]
    have hEC : ∀ z : E3, epaPlaneEmb a (epaPlaneCoord a z) = sepPlaneProj a z := by
      intro z
      ext i
      by_cases hi : i = a
      · subst hi
        simp [hEa, sepPlaneProj]
      · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hi
        rw [hEs, hCm]
        simp [sepPlaneProj, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne]
    have hCadd : ∀ (y : E3) (t : ℝ), epaPlaneCoord a (y + t • e a) = epaPlaneCoord a y := by
      intro y t
      ext m
      rw [hCm, hCm]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne]
    have hπsub : ∀ z c : E3, sepPlaneProj a (z - c) = sepPlaneProj a z - sepPlaneProj a c := by
      intro z c
      simp only [sepPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
      abel
    have hFa : ∀ x : E2, (epaGraphParam a u x) a = u (epaPlaneEmb a x) := by
      intro x
      simp [epaGraphParam, hEa]
    have hπF : ∀ x : E2, sepPlaneProj a (epaGraphParam a u x) = epaPlaneEmb a x := by
      intro x
      rw [sepPlaneProj, hFa, epaGraphParam, add_sub_cancel_right]
    have hCF : ∀ x : E2, epaPlaneCoord a (epaGraphParam a u x) = x := by
      intro x
      rw [epaGraphParam, hCadd, hCE]
    have hFC : ∀ z : E3, z a = u (sepPlaneProj a z) →
        epaGraphParam a u (epaPlaneCoord a z) = z := by
      intro z hz
      rw [epaGraphParam, hEC, ← hz, sepPlaneProj, sub_add_cancel]
    
    have hEsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (epaPlaneEmb a) := by
      unfold epaPlaneEmb
      refine ContDiff.sum fun k _ => ?_
      exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff).smul contDiff_const
    have hCsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (epaPlaneCoord a) := by
      unfold epaPlaneCoord
      refine ContDiff.sum fun k _ => ?_
      exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj (a.succAbove k) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff).smul contDiff_const
    have hFsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (epaGraphParam a u) := by
      unfold epaGraphParam
      exact hEsm.add ((hu.comp hEsm).smul contDiff_const)
    
    have K1 : ∀ x ∈ {x : E2 | ‖epaPlaneEmb a x - sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r},
        epaGraphParam a u x ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ := by
      intro x hx
      have h1 : ‖sepPlaneProj a (epaGraphParam a u x - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r := by
        rw [hπsub, hπF]
        exact hx
      refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
      have h2 := hheight _ h1
      rw [hπF] at h2
      rw [hFa]
      exact h2
    have hcont_pi : Continuous (fun z : E3 => sepPlaneProj a z) := by
      unfold sepPlaneProj
      exact continuous_id.sub
        (((EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous).smul continuous_const)
    have hcylo : IsOpen (sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ) := by
      have hca : Continuous (fun z : E3 => z a) :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
      exact (isOpen_lt ((hcont_pi.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm)
        continuous_const).inter
        (isOpen_lt ((hca.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const)
    have hWo : IsOpen {x : E2 | ‖epaPlaneEmb a x - sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r} :=
      isOpen_lt ((hEsm.continuous.sub continuous_const).norm) continuous_const
    have hSP : eigSurfParam Sig p
        {x : E2 | ‖epaPlaneEmb a x - sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r}
        (epaGraphParam a u) := by
      refine ⟨hWo, hFsm.contDiffOn, fun x hx => ⟨hcyl (K1 x hx), ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · refine (hgr _ (K1 x hx)).2 ?_
        rw [hπF, hFa]
      · have hcomp : (fderiv ℝ (epaPlaneCoord a) (epaGraphParam a u x)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (epaGraphParam a u) x) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2 := by
          rw [← fderiv_comp x (hCsm.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
            (hFsm.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt]
          have hid : epaPlaneCoord a ∘ epaGraphParam a u = id := funext hCF
          rw [hid, fderiv_id]
        intro v w hvw
        have h := congrArg (fderiv ℝ (epaPlaneCoord a) (epaGraphParam a u x)) hvw
        have hv := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] E2 => L v) hcomp
        have hw := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] E2 => L w) hcomp
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] at hv hw
        rw [← hv, ← hw, h]
    refine ⟨hFsm, hCsm, hSP, (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage hcylo,
      ⟨mem_chart_source E3 p, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show ‖sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p - chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r ∧
        |chartAt E3 p p a - chartAt E3 p p a| < δ
      simp [sepPlaneProj, hr, hδ]
    · exact (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.comp hFsm.continuous.continuousOn
        (fun x hx => hcyl (K1 x hx))
    · exact hCsm.continuous.comp_continuousOn
        ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
    · ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_target (hcyl (K1 x hx)), ?_⟩, (hSP.2.2 x hx).2.1⟩
        show chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm (epaGraphParam a u x)) ∈
          sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv (hcyl (K1 x hx))]
        exact K1 x hx
      · rintro ⟨⟨hys, hyc⟩, hyS⟩
        have hyc' : chartAt E3 p y ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ := hyc
        have hgy : (chartAt E3 p y) a = u (sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p y)) := by
          refine (hgr _ hyc').1 ?_
          rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hys]
          exact hyS
        refine ⟨epaPlaneCoord a (chartAt E3 p y), ?_, ?_⟩
        · show ‖epaPlaneEmb a (epaPlaneCoord a (chartAt E3 p y)) -
            sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r
          rw [hEC, ← hπsub]
          exact hyc'.1
        · show (chartAt E3 p).symm (epaGraphParam a u (epaPlaneCoord a (chartAt E3 p y))) = y
          rw [hFC _ hgy, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hys]
    · intro x hx
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv (hcyl (K1 x hx)), hCF]
    · rintro y ⟨hys, hyc⟩ hyS
      have hyc' : chartAt E3 p y ∈ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ := hyc
      refine hFC _ ((hgr _ hyc').1 ?_)
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hys]
      exact hyS
  
  have s3 : ∀ (G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : E3 → E3) (F₁ F₂ : E2 → E3)
      (τ : E2 → E2) (x : E2), DifferentiableAt ℝ F₁ x → DifferentiableAt ℝ T (F₁ x) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F₂ (τ x) → DifferentiableAt ℝ τ x →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, G₁ (F₁ x) i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ T (F₁ x) (e i) a * G₂ (T (F₁ x)) a b * fderiv ℝ T (F₁ x) (e j) b) →
      ((fun x' => F₂ (τ x')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun x' => T (F₁ x'))) →
      ∀ a b : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G₁ F₁ x a b = ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 a) c * pullMetric2 G₂ F₂ (τ x) c d * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) d := by
    intro G₁ G₂ T F₁ F₂ τ x hF₁ hT hF₂ hτ hgram hgerm a b
    have h0 : F₂ (τ x) = T (F₁ x) := hgerm.eq_of_nhds
    have e1 : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => T (F₁ x')) x = (fderiv ℝ T (F₁ x)).comp (fderiv ℝ F₁ x) :=
      (hT.hasFDerivAt.comp x hF₁.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
    have e2' : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => F₂ (τ x')) x = (fderiv ℝ F₂ (τ x)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ x) :=
      (hF₂.hasFDerivAt.comp x hτ.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
    have hchain : ∀ v : E2, fderiv ℝ T (F₁ x) (fderiv ℝ F₁ x v) =
        fderiv ℝ F₂ (τ x) (fderiv ℝ τ x v) := by
      intro v
      have h := e2'.symm.trans (hgerm.fderiv_eq.trans e1)
      exact (congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] E3 => L v) h).symm
    have key : ∀ v : E2, ∀ m : Fin 3,
        ∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F₁ x v) k * (fderiv ℝ T (F₁ x) (e k)) m =
          ∑ c : Fin 2, (fderiv ℝ τ x v) c * (fderiv ℝ F₂ (τ x) (e2 c)) m := by
      intro v m
      rw [← hexp3 (fderiv ℝ T (F₁ x)) (fderiv ℝ F₁ x v) m,
        ← hexp2 (fderiv ℝ F₂ (τ x)) (fderiv ℝ τ x v) m, hchain]
    have L1 : pullMetric2 G₁ F₁ x a b = ∑ m : Fin 3, ∑ n : Fin 3,
        (∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F₁ x (e2 a)) k * (fderiv ℝ T (F₁ x) (e k)) m) *
          G₂ (T (F₁ x)) m n *
          (∑ k : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F₁ x (e2 b)) k * (fderiv ℝ T (F₁ x) (e k)) n) := by
      simp only [pullMetric2, hgram, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [L1]
    simp only [key]
    rw [← h0]
    simp only [pullMetric2, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have cpd : ∀ (p : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro p y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  
  have s5 : ∀ (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3), eigSurfParam Sig z W F →
      (∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun x => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x a b) W) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ W, (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x).PosDef := by
    intro z W F hF
    obtain ⟨hWo, hFs, hpt⟩ := hF
    refine ⟨fun a b => ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    · have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x) W :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hWo).1 hFs).2
      have hc : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (k : Fin 3),
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) k) W := by
        intro i k
        have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) W :=
          hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
      have hG : ∀ k l : Fin 3,
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) k l) W :=
        fun k l => (g.smooth z k l).comp hFs (fun x hx => (hpt x hx).1)
      simp only [pullMetric2]
      refine ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => ?_
      exact ((hc a k).mul (hG k l)).mul (hc b l)
    · have hG0 := cpd z (F x) (hpt x hx).1
      have hDinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x) := (hpt x hx).2.2
      set D : E2 →L[ℝ] E3 := fderiv ℝ F x with hDdef
      set G₀ : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) with hG₀def
      set B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) ℝ := Matrix.of fun k i => (D (e2 i)) k with hB
      have heq : pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x =
          Matrix.conjTranspose B * G₀ * B := by
        ext i j
        simp [pullMetric2, B, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [heq]
      refine hG0.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same ?_
      intro v w hvw
      have hD' : D ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm v) =
          D ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm w) := by
        ext k
        rw [hexp2, hexp2]
        have := congrFun hvw k
        simp [B, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] at this
        simpa [mul_comm] using this
      exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.injective (hDinj hD')
  
  have hexpE : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
    intro v
    ext k
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  have cca : ∀ (Φ : E3 → M) (τ : E3 → E3) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y →
      MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ (τ y) → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff (Φ ∘ τ) y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a * g.coeff Φ (τ y) a b * fderiv ℝ τ y (e j) b := by
    intro Φ τ y hτ hΦ i j
    set L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ (τ y) with hLdef
    set B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := g.g (Φ (τ y)) with hBdef
    have hL : ∀ v : E3, L v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • L (e a) := by
      intro v
      conv_lhs => rw [hexpE v]
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul]
    have hchain : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y v = L (fderiv ℝ τ y v) := by
      intro v
      rw [mfderiv_comp_apply y hΦ hτ.mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      rfl
    have hlhs : g.coeff (Φ ∘ τ) y i j =
        B (L (fderiv ℝ τ y (e i))) (L (fderiv ℝ τ y (e j))) := by
      show g.g (Φ (τ y)) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y (e j)) = _
      rw [hchain, hchain]
    have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff Φ (τ y) a b = B (L (e a)) (L (e b)) := fun a b => rfl
    rw [hlhs, hL (fderiv ℝ τ y (e i)), hL (fderiv ℝ τ y (e j))]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, hc]
    conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
    ring
  have sct : ∀ (p₁ p₂ : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₁).target →
      (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₂).source →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) := by
    intro p₁ p₂ y hy hy₂
    have hA : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₁) hy
    have hB : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p₂) ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₂) hy₂
    have hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hB.comp y hA)
    have hΦ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p₂).symm
        (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₂)
        ((chartAt E3 p₂).map_source hy₂)
    have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) =
        (chartAt E3 p₁).symm z := by
      have hO := (chartAt E3 p₁).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 p₂).open_source
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hy, hy₂⟩)
        (fun z hz => (chartAt E3 p₂).left_inv hz.2)
    refine ⟨hτ, ?_⟩
    intro i j
    have hfun : (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 y] ⇑(chartAt E3 p₁).symm := hev
    have hmf := hfun.mfderiv_eq (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, E3))
    have hpt : (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y =
        (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y := (chartAt E3 p₂).left_inv hy₂
    have key : g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j =
        g.coeff (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y i j := by
      show _ = g.g ((⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y (e j))
      rw [hmf, hpt]
      rfl
    rw [key]
    exact cca _ _ y hτ hΦ i j
  
  have s1 : ∀ (z q : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3) (L : E3 → E2), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target) → ContDiff ℝ ∞ L →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => L (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))))
        (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
    intro z q W F L hF hFt hL
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 z).symm)
        ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart (x := q)).comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (fun y hy => hy.2)
    have h2 := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    have h3 := h2.comp (hF.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun x hx => ⟨hFt x hx.1, hx.2⟩)
    exact hL.comp_contDiffOn h3
  
  have s4 : ∀ (P : EigPatchedSurface M Sig), (∀ j (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3), IsOpen W →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W → (∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => P.proj j ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)))
        (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹' P.O j)) →
      ∀ w : M → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) →
        eigSmoothAlong Sig w := by
    intro P hP w hw z W F hSP
    obtain ⟨hWo, hFs, hpt⟩ := hSP
    have hψc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) W :=
      (chartAt E3 z).continuousOn_symm.comp hFs.continuousOn (fun x hx => (hpt x hx).1)
    refine contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn (fun x hx => ?_)
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover (hpt x hx).2.1)
    refine ⟨W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹' P.O j,
      hψc.isOpen_inter_preimage hWo (P.O_open j), ⟨hx, hj⟩, ?_⟩
    have hτ := hP j z W F hWo hFs (fun x hx => (hpt x hx).1)
    have key : ∀ x' ∈ W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹' P.O j,
        P.proj j ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')) ∈ P.W j ∧
          P.param j (P.proj j ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) = (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x') := by
      intro x' hx'
      have hmem : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x') ∈ P.O j ∩ Sig := ⟨hx'.2, (hpt x' hx'.1).2.1⟩
      rw [← P.image_eq j] at hmem
      obtain ⟨x'', hx''W, hx''⟩ := hmem
      rw [← hx'', P.proj_param j x'' hx''W]
      exact ⟨hx''W, rfl⟩
    have hcomp := (hw j).comp hτ (fun x' hx' => (key x' hx').1)
    refine (hcomp.congr (fun x' hx' => ?_)).mono Set.inter_subset_right
    show w ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')) = w (P.param j (P.proj j ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))))
    rw [(key x' hx').2]
  
  choose! a u r δ hG using hgraph
  obtain ⟨Ff, hFf⟩ : ∃ Ff : M → E2 → E3, ∀ p, Ff p = epaGraphParam (a p) (u p) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Cf, hCf⟩ : ∃ Cf : M → E3 → E2, ∀ p, Cf p = epaPlaneCoord (a p) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Wf, hWf⟩ : ∃ Wf : M → Set E2, ∀ p,
      Wf p = {x : E2 | ‖epaPlaneEmb (a p) x - sepPlaneProj (a p) (chartAt E3 p p)‖ < r p} :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Of, hOf⟩ : ∃ Of : M → Set M, ∀ p,
      Of p = (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' sepCyl (a p) (chartAt E3 p p) (r p) (δ p) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hOfsub : ∀ p, Of p ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := by
    intro p y hy
    rw [hOf] at hy
    exact hy.1
  have S2 : ∀ p ∈ Sig, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Ff p) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Cf p) ∧
      eigSurfParam Sig p (Wf p) (Ff p) ∧ IsOpen (Of p) ∧ p ∈ Of p ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (Ff p x)) (Wf p) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Cf p (chartAt E3 p y)) (Of p) ∧
      (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (Ff p x)) '' Wf p = Of p ∩ Sig ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Wf p, Cf p (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm (Ff p x))) = x) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Of p, y ∈ Sig → Ff p (Cf p (chartAt E3 p y)) = chartAt E3 p y) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hFf, hCf, hWf, hOf]
    exact s2 p (a p) (u p) (r p) (δ p) (hG p hp)
  
  obtain ⟨t, htS, hcov⟩ := hSc.elim_nhds_subcover Of
    (fun p hp => (S2 p hp).2.2.2.1.mem_nhds (S2 p hp).2.2.2.2.1)
  
  obtain ⟨pts, hpts, hsurj⟩ : ∃ pts : Fin t.card → M, (∀ j, pts j ∈ Sig) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ t, ∃ j, pts j = p :=
    ⟨fun j => (t.equivFin.symm j : M), fun j => htS _ (t.equivFin.symm j).2,
      fun p hp => ⟨t.equivFin ⟨p, hp⟩, by simp⟩⟩
  
  have hτs : ∀ j k : Fin t.card, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun x => Cf (pts k) (chartAt E3 (pts k) ((chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x))))
      (Wf (pts j) ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x)) ⁻¹' Of (pts k)) := by
    intro j k
    refine (s1 (pts j) (pts k) (Wf (pts j)) (Ff (pts j)) (Cf (pts k))
      (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.1.2.1 (fun x hx => ((S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.1.2.2 x hx).1)
      (S2 _ (hpts k)).2.1).mono ?_
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨hx.1, hOfsub (pts k) hx.2⟩
  
  have hcompat : ∀ j k : Fin t.card,
      ∀ x ∈ Wf (pts j) ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x)) ⁻¹' Of (pts k),
      ∀ i₁ i₂ : Fin 2,
      pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm) (Ff (pts j)) x i₁ i₂ =
        ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
          fderiv ℝ (fun x' => Cf (pts k) (chartAt E3 (pts k)
              ((chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x')))) x (e2 i₁) c *
            pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pts k)).symm) (Ff (pts k))
              (Cf (pts k) (chartAt E3 (pts k) ((chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x)))) c d *
          fderiv ℝ (fun x' => Cf (pts k) (chartAt E3 (pts k)
              ((chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x')))) x (e2 i₂) d := by
    intro j k x hx i₁ i₂
    have hx1 : x ∈ Wf (pts j) := hx.1
    have hx2 : (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x) ∈ Of (pts k) := hx.2
    have hy : Ff (pts j) x ∈ (chartAt E3 (pts j)).target :=
      ((S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.1.2.2 x hx1).1
    obtain ⟨hT, hgram⟩ := sct (pts j) (pts k) _ hy (hOfsub _ hx2)
    have hU : IsOpen (Wf (pts j) ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x)) ⁻¹'
        Of (pts k)) :=
      (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.2.2.2.1.isOpen_inter_preimage (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.1.1
        (S2 _ (hpts k)).2.2.2.1
    have hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => Cf (pts k) (chartAt E3 (pts k)
        ((chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x')))) x :=
      (((hτs j k).differentiableOn (by simp)) x hx).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    have hF₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (Ff (pts j)) x :=
      ((S2 _ (hpts j)).1.differentiable (by simp)) x
    have hF₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (Ff (pts k)) (Cf (pts k) (chartAt E3 (pts k)
        ((chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x)))) :=
      ((S2 _ (hpts k)).1.differentiable (by simp)) _
    have hgerm : (fun x' => Ff (pts k) (Cf (pts k) (chartAt E3 (pts k)
        ((chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x'))))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun x' => (fun z => chartAt E3 (pts k) ((chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm z)) (Ff (pts j) x')) := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with x' hx'
      have hx'1 : x' ∈ Wf (pts j) := hx'.1
      have hx'2 : (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x') ∈ Of (pts k) := hx'.2
      exact (S2 _ (hpts k)).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 _ hx'2 ((S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.1.2.2 x' hx'1).2.1
    exact s3 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm)
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pts k)).symm)
      (fun z => chartAt E3 (pts k) ((chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm z)) (Ff (pts j)) (Ff (pts k))
      (fun x' => Cf (pts k) (chartAt E3 (pts k) ((chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x'))))
      x hF₁ hT hF₂ hτ hgram hgerm i₁ i₂
  
  let P : EigPatchedSurface M Sig :=
    { n := t.card
      W := fun j => Wf (pts j)
      param := fun j x => (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm (Ff (pts j) x)
      proj := fun j y => Cf (pts j) (chartAt E3 (pts j) y)
      O := fun j => Of (pts j)
      h := fun j => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pts j)).symm) (Ff (pts j))
      W_open := fun j => (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.1.1
      O_open := fun j => (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.2.1
      param_cont := fun j => (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.2.2.2.1
      proj_cont := fun j => (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.2.2.2.2.1
      image_eq := fun j => (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
      proj_param := fun j => (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
      cover := by
        intro y hy
        obtain ⟨p, hpt, hyp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcov hy)
        obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hsurj p hpt
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hyp⟩
      trans_smooth := hτs
      h_smooth := fun j => (s5 (pts j) _ _ (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.1).1
      h_posDef := fun j => (s5 (pts j) _ _ (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.1).2
      h_compat := hcompat }
  refine ⟨P, fun j => ⟨pts j, Ff (pts j), (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.2.1, rfl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  
  refine s4 P ?_
  intro j z W F _ hF hFt
  refine (s1 z (pts j) W F (Cf (pts j)) hF hFt (S2 _ (hpts j)).2.1).mono ?_
  intro x hx
  exact ⟨hx.1, hOfsub (pts j) hx.2⟩

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig : Set M) (hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) : ∃ V : M → ℝ, eigSmoothAlong Sig V ∧ ∀ (O : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen O → ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f → (∀ x ∈ O, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) → O ∩ Sig = O ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} → ∀ (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3) (x₀ : E2), eigSurfParam Sig z W F → x₀ ∈ W → (∀ x ∈ W, (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ O) → lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) (fun x => (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))))⁻¹) x₀ + (V ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x₀)) + (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x₀))))⁻¹ * g.jacobiDeriv f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x₀))) * (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x₀))))⁻¹ = 0

signature.name: eig_jacobi_potential
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig : Set M) (hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) : ∃ V : M → ℝ, eigSmoothAlong Sig V ∧ ∀ (O : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen O → ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f → (∀ x ∈ O, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) → O ∩ Sig = O ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} → ∀ (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3) (x₀ : E2), eigSurfParam Sig z W F → x₀ ∈ W → (∀ x ∈ W, (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ O) → lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) (fun x => (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))))⁻¹) x₀ + (V ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x₀)) + (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x₀))))⁻¹ * g.jacobiDeriv f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x₀))) * (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x₀))))⁻¹ = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hlapc : ∀ (h₁ h₂ : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : E2 → ℝ) (U : Set E2) (x : E2),
      IsOpen U → x ∈ U → Set.EqOn h₁ h₂ U → Set.EqOn w₁ w₂ U → lap2 h₁ w₁ x = lap2 h₂ w₂ x := by
    intro h₁ h₂ w₁ w₂ U x hU hx hh hw
    have hUx : U ∈ 𝓝 x := hU.mem_nhds hx
    have hhx : h₁ x = h₂ x := hh hx
    have hent : ∀ (a b k : Fin 2),
        pd2 k (fun z => h₁ z a b) x = pd2 k (fun z => h₂ z a b) x := by
      intro a b k
      have hev : (fun z => h₁ z a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => h₂ z a b) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem hUx (fun y hy => by simp only [hh hy])
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => h₁ z a b) x (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ (fun z => h₂ z a b) x (e2 k)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h₁ k i j x = christoffel2 h₂ k i j x := by
      intro k i j
      simp only [christoffel2, hhx, hent]
    have hw1 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k w₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] pd2 k w₂ := by
      intro k
      filter_upwards [hUx] with y hy
      have hev : w₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] w₂ := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun t ht => hw ht)
      show fderiv ℝ w₁ y (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ w₂ y (e2 k)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]

      intro i k
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 k w₁) x (e2 i) = fderiv ℝ (pd2 k w₂) x (e2 i)

  have hdat : ∀ y : M, ∃ (Vy : Set M) (fy : M → ℝ), y ∈ Sig → (IsOpen Vy ∧ y ∈ Vy ∧

    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Sig
    · obtain ⟨V, f, -, hVo, hyV, hf, hdf, hVS, -⟩ := hSm.2 y hy Set.univ Filter.univ_mem

  choose Vd fd hd using hdat
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : M → ℝ, ∀ y : M, V y = ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 y).symm)

  have hsym : ∀ (p : M) (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),

    intro O f hO hf hdf hOS z W F x₀ hSP hx₀ hWO
    obtain ⟨hWo, hFs, hpt⟩ := hSP
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : M, (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x₀) = q := ⟨_, rfl⟩

    have hqO : q ∈ O := hq ▸ hWO x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨hVo, hqV, hfq, hdfq, hVS⟩ := hd q hqS

    have hy₀ : chartAt E3 q q ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (O ∩ Vd q) := by
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 q).map_source (mem_chart_source E3 q), ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) ∈ O ∩ Vd q
      rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 q)]
      exact ⟨hqO, hqV⟩
    obtain ⟨hΦs, hΦd⟩ := ejp_chart_transfer g q f hf
    obtain ⟨hΦqs, hΦqd⟩ := ejp_chart_transfer g q (fd q) hfq
    have hΦU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))

    have hΦqU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fd q ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))

      hΦqs.mono (fun w hw => hw.1)
    have hdΦU : ∀ w ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (O ∩ Vd q),

      intro w hw
      have h1 := (hΦd ((chartAt E3 q).symm w) ((chartAt E3 q).map_target hw.1)
        (hdf _ hw.2.1)).1
      rwa [(chartAt E3 q).right_inv hw.1] at h1
    have hdΦqU : ∀ w ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (O ∩ Vd q),

    have hGU : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j)
        ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (O ∩ Vd q)) :=
      fun i j => (g.smooth q i j).mono (fun w hw => hw.1)
    have hPU : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (O ∩ Vd q),
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef := fun y hy => hPD q y hy.1
    
    have hcz : ContinuousOn (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) W :=
      (chartAt E3 z).continuousOn_symm.comp hFs.continuousOn (fun x hx => (hpt x hx).1)
    have hW'o : IsOpen (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹'
        ((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ Vd q)) :=
      hcz.isOpen_inter_preimage hWo ((chartAt E3 q).open_source.inter hVo)
    have hx₀W' : x₀ ∈ W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹'
        ((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ Vd q) := by
      refine ⟨hx₀, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x₀) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source ∩ Vd q
      rw [hq]
      exact ⟨mem_chart_source E3 q, hqV⟩
    obtain ⟨hFt, hFti, hpm⟩ := ejp_chart_reparam g z q F
      (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ Vd q)) hW'o
      (hFs.mono (fun x hx => hx.1)) (fun x hx => ⟨(hpt x hx.1).1, hx.2.1, (hpt x hx.1).2.2⟩)
    have hpts : ∀ x ∈ W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹'
        ((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ Vd q),
        chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ∈
          (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (O ∩ Vd q) ∧
        f ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)))) = 0 ∧

      have hxO : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ O := hWO x hx.1
      have hxS : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig := (hpt x hx.1).2.1
      have hxV : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Vd q := hx.2.2
      refine ⟨⟨(chartAt E3 q).map_source hsrc, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) ∈ O ∩ Vd q

      · rw [hli]
        have h' : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Vd q ∩ Sig := ⟨hxV, hxS⟩

    have hw : Set.EqOn
        (fun x => (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))))⁻¹)

        (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ Vd q)) := by
      intro x hx

    obtain ⟨-, -, hψs, -⟩ := ejp_level_regularity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)

    have hs2 := ejp_immersion_lap2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
      (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) _ hU'o hGU
      (hsym q) hPU hΦU hdΦU hψs (fun x' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) _ hW'o hFt
      (fun x hx => ⟨(hpts x hx).1, (hpts x hx).2.1, hFti x hx⟩) x₀ hx₀W'
    have hs1 := ejp_ambient_identity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
      (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) _ hU'o hGU (hsym q) hPU hΦU hdΦU (chartAt E3 q q) hy₀
    have hs3 := ejp_pot_congr (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)

      (hsym q) hPU hΦqU hΦU hdΦqU hdΦU (fun x' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) _

    rw [hψq, hJq, hV q]
    linear_combination hlap1 + hs2 + hs1 - ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q q) * hs3
  
  refine ⟨V, ?_, hid⟩
  intro z W F hSP
  obtain ⟨hWo, hFs, hpt⟩ := hSP
  have hcz : ContinuousOn (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) W :=
    (chartAt E3 z).continuousOn_symm.comp hFs.continuousOn (fun x hx => (hpt x hx).1)
  refine contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn (fun x hx => ?_)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : M, (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) = y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hyS : y ∈ Sig := hy ▸ (hpt x hx).2.1
  obtain ⟨hVo, hyV, hfy, hdfy, hVS⟩ := hd y hyS

  obtain ⟨hΦs, hΦd⟩ := ejp_chart_transfer g z (fd y) hfy
  have hΦU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => fd y ((chartAt E3 z).symm w))

    fun i j => (g.smooth z i j).mono (fun w hw => hw.1)

  obtain ⟨hSpos, -, hψs, hPots⟩ := ejp_level_regularity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)

  have hFU : ∀ x' ∈ W ∩ (fun x' => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')) ⁻¹' Vd y,

    fun x' hx' => ⟨(hpt x' hx'.1).1, hx'.2⟩
  have hzero : ∀ x' ∈ W ∩ (fun x' => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')) ⁻¹' Vd y,

    intro x' hx'
    have h' : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x') ∈ Vd y ∩ Sig := ⟨hx'.2, (hpt x' hx'.1).2.1⟩
    rw [hVS] at h'
    exact h'.2
  have hclaim : ∀ x' ∈ W ∩ (fun x' => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')) ⁻¹' Vd y,
      V ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')) =
        ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun w => fd y ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x') := by
    intro x' hx'
    have hSP0 : eigSurfParam Sig z (W ∩ (fun x' => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')) ⁻¹' Vd y) F :=
      ⟨hW₀o, hFs.mono (fun _ h => h.1), fun x'' h => hpt x'' h.1⟩
    have h1 := hid (Vd y) (fd y) hVo hfy hdfy hVS z _ F x' hSP0 hx' (fun x'' h => h.2)
    have hwz : Set.EqOn
        (fun x'' => (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (fd y) (fd y) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x''))))⁻¹)
        (fun x'' => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun w => fd y ((chartAt E3 z).symm w))
          (F x''))
        (W ∩ (fun x' => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')) ⁻¹' Vd y) := by
      intro x'' hx''
      have h := (hΦd ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'')) ((chartAt E3 z).map_target (hpt x'' hx''.1).1)
        (hdfy _ hx''.2)).2.1
      rw [(chartAt E3 z).right_inv (hpt x'' hx''.1).1] at h
      simp only [ejpPsi]
      rw [h]
    have hL := hlapc (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
      (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) _ _ _ x' hW₀o hx' (fun _ _ => rfl) hwz
    have hs2 := ejp_immersion_lap2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
      (fun w => fd y ((chartAt E3 z).symm w))
      (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun w => fd y ((chartAt E3 z).symm w))) _ hUzo hGU
      (hsym z) hPU hΦU hdΦU hψs F _ hW₀o (hFs.mono (fun _ h => h.1))
      (fun x'' h => ⟨hFU x'' h, hzero x'' h, (hpt x'' h.1).2.2⟩) x' hx'
    have hs1 := ejp_ambient_identity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
      (fun w => fd y ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) _ hUzo hGU (hsym z) hPU hΦU hdΦU (F x') (hFU x' hx')
    have hJ := (hΦd ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')) ((chartAt E3 z).map_target (hpt x' hx'.1).1)

    rw [(chartAt E3 z).right_inv (hpt x' hx'.1).1] at hJ
    have hψ : (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (fd y) (fd y) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))))⁻¹ =
        ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun w => fd y ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x') :=
      hwz hx'
    rw [hL, hs2, hJ, hψ] at h1
    have hψpos : 0 < ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun w => fd y ((chartAt E3 z).symm w))
        (F x') := inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hSpos _ (hFU x' hx')))
    have hprod : (V ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')) -
        ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun w => fd y ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x')) *
        ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun w => fd y ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x') = 0 := by
      linear_combination h1 - hs1
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with h | h
    · linarith
    · exact absurd h hψpos.ne'
  have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x' => ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
      (fun w => fd y ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x'))
      (W ∩ (fun x' => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')) ⁻¹' Vd y) :=
    hPots.comp (hFs.mono (fun _ h => h.1)) (fun x' hx' => hFU x' hx')
  exact (hcomp.congr hclaim).mono Set.inter_subset_right

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_ambient_identity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y a b * hessLoc G (ejpPsi G Φ) a b y) - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y c d * hessLoc G Φ c d y) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y a * partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y) / ejpS G Φ y + ejpPot G Φ y * ejpPsi G Φ y = -(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 2 * ejpJac G Φ y

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_immersion_lap2
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ u : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFW : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ U ∧ Φ (F x) = 0 ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : lap2 (pullMetric2 G F) (fun x' => u (F x')) x = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ (F x) a b * hessLoc G u a b (F x)) - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ (F x) c d * hessLoc G Φ c d (F x)) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ (F x) a * partialDeriv a u (F x)) / ejpS G Φ (F x)

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_pot_congr
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ Φ' : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hΦ' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ' U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (hdΦ' : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ' y ≠ 0) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFW : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ U ∧ Φ (F x) = 0 ∧ Φ' (F x) = 0 ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : ejpPot G Φ' (F x) = ejpPot G Φ (F x)

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_level_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) : (∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ejpS G Φ y) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpS G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPsi G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPot G Φ) U

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_chart_transfer
subgoal_signatures.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z).target ∧ ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ≠ 0 ∧ g.gradInner f f x = ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ∧ g.jacobiDeriv f x = ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x)

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_chart_reparam
subgoal_signatures.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z q : M) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFW : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) W ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) x)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x = pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun x' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) x
