proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hr, hδ, hu, hcyl, hheight, hgr⟩ := hG
  
  
  
  have hexpE : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ d : Fin 3, v d • e d := by
    intro v
    ext k
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  
  
  have cpd : ∀ (p : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target →
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro p y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  have cca : ∀ (Φ : E3 → M) (τ : E3 → E3) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y →
      MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ (τ y) → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff (Φ ∘ τ) y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a * g.coeff Φ (τ y) a b * fderiv ℝ τ y (e j) b := by
    intro Φ τ y hτ hΦ i j
    set L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ (τ y) with hLdef
    set B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := g.g (Φ (τ y)) with hBdef
    have hL : ∀ v : E3, L v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • L (e a) := by
      intro v
      conv_lhs => rw [hexpE v]
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul]
    have hchain : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y v = L (fderiv ℝ τ y v) := by
      intro v
      rw [mfderiv_comp_apply y hΦ hτ.mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      rfl
    have hlhs : g.coeff (Φ ∘ τ) y i j =
        B (L (fderiv ℝ τ y (e i))) (L (fderiv ℝ τ y (e j))) := by
      show g.g (Φ (τ y)) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (Φ ∘ τ) y (e j)) = _
      rw [hchain, hchain]
    have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff Φ (τ y) a b = B (L (e a)) (L (e b)) := fun a b => rfl
    rw [hlhs, hL (fderiv ℝ τ y (e i)), hL (fderiv ℝ τ y (e j))]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, hc]
    conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
    ring
  
  have sct : ∀ (p₁ p₂ : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₁).target →
      (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₂).source →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) := by
    intro p₁ p₂ y hy hy₂
    have hA : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₁) hy
    have hB : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p₂) ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₂) hy₂
    have hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hB.comp y hA)
    have hΦ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p₂).symm
        (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 p₂)
        ((chartAt E3 p₂).map_source hy₂)
    have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) =
        (chartAt E3 p₁).symm z := by
      have hO := (chartAt E3 p₁).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 p₂).open_source
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hy, hy₂⟩)
        (fun z hz => (chartAt E3 p₂).left_inv hz.2)
    refine ⟨hτ, ?_⟩
    intro i j
    have hfun : (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 y] ⇑(chartAt E3 p₁).symm := hev
    have hmf := hfun.mfderiv_eq (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, E3))
    have hpt : (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y =
        (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y := (chartAt E3 p₂).left_inv hy₂
    have key : g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j =
        g.coeff (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y i j := by
      show _ = g.g ((⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (⇑(chartAt E3 p₂).symm ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z))) y (e j))
      rw [hmf, hpt]
      rfl
    rw [key]
    exact cca _ _ y hτ hΦ i j
  
  have galg : ∀ (A Gm Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P Pt : Fin 3 → ℝ), A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * Gm a b * A b j) →
      (∀ i, Pt i = ∑ a : Fin 3, P a * A a i) →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ i j * Pt i * Pt j =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * P i * P j := by
    intro A Gm Gt P Pt hA hGt hPt
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * Gm * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hM : A * Gt⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A = Gm⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv]
      calc A * (A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹) * Matrix.transpose A
          = (A * A⁻¹) * Gm⁻¹ * (Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A) := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = Gm⁻¹ := by
            rw [hAB, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, hAB, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul,
              Matrix.mul_one]
    have hM' : ∀ a b, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A a i * Gt⁻¹ i j * A b j = Gm⁻¹ a b := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hM]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [hPt, ← hM']
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hgrad : ∀ (f0 : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f0 →
      ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source, ∀ Ψ : E3 → ℝ,
      (fun z => f0 ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p x)] Ψ →
      g.gradInner f0 f0 x = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i Ψ (chartAt E3 p x) * partialDeriv j Ψ (chartAt E3 p x) := by
    intro f0 hf0 x hxs Ψ hΨ
    have hyt : chartAt E3 p x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).map_source hxs
    have hsx : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) = x := (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs
    have hy₂ : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) ∈ (chartAt E3 x).source := by
      rw [hsx]; exact mem_chart_source E3 x
    obtain ⟨hτd, hgram⟩ := sct p x (chartAt E3 p x) hyt hy₂
    have hτy : chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x)) = chartAt E3 x x := by
      rw [hsx]
    have hgram' : ∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) i j =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p x) (e i) a *
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x x) a b *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p x) (e j) b := by
      intro i j
      rw [hgram i j, hτy]
    have hO : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x).source) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 x).open_source
    have hev : Ψ =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p x)]
        fun z => f0 ((chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) := by
      filter_upwards [hΨ, hO.mem_nhds ⟨hyt, hy₂⟩] with z hz1 hz2
      have hz2' : (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ (chartAt E3 x).source := hz2.2
      rw [(chartAt E3 x).left_inv hz2']
      exact hz1.symm
    have hh0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f0 ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) (chartAt E3 x).target := by
      have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f0 ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) (chartAt E3 x).target :=
        hf0.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
    have hxt : chartAt E3 x x ∈ (chartAt E3 x).target :=
      (chartAt E3 x).map_source (mem_chart_source E3 x)
    have hh0d : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => f0 ((chartAt E3 x).symm z))
        (chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))) := by
      rw [hτy]
      exact (hh0.contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 x).open_target.mem_nhds hxt)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hchain : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i Ψ (chartAt E3 p x) =
        ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d (fun z => f0 ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) (chartAt E3 x x) *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p x) (e i) d := by
      intro i
      have e1 : partialDeriv i Ψ (chartAt E3 p x) =
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => f0 ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) (chartAt E3 x x)

  have hβin : β.rIn = ε / 3 := by rw [hβdef]
  have hβout : β.rOut = 2 * ε / 3 := by rw [hβdef]
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : E3 → ℝ, B = fun z => β z * Φ z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : dist z (chartAt E3 p p) < ε
    · rw [hBdef]
      exact (β.contDiff.contDiffAt).mul (hΦsm.contDiffAt (hcylo.mem_nhds (hballcyl z hz)))
    · have hz' : 2 * ε / 3 < dist z (chartAt E3 p p) := by
        push_neg at hz
        linarith
      have hev : B =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        have hO : IsOpen {y : E3 | 2 * ε / 3 < dist y (chartAt E3 p p)} :=
          isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)
        filter_upwards [hO.mem_nhds hz'] with y hy
        have hy' : 2 * ε / 3 < dist y (chartAt E3 p p) := hy
        rw [hBdef]
        show β y * Φ y = 0
        rw [β.zero_of_le_dist (by rw [hβout]; exact le_of_lt hy'), zero_mul]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hBts : tsupport B ⊆ closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (2 * ε / 3) := by
    rw [hBdef, ← hβout, ← β.tsupport_eq]
    exact tsupport_mul_subset_left
  have hBc : IsCompact (tsupport B) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall _ _).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) hBts
  have hcb : closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (2 * ε / 3) ⊆ sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) r δ := by
    intro z hz
    apply hballcyl z
    have := mem_closedBall.mp hz
    linarith
  have hBΦ : ∀ z, dist z (chartAt E3 p p) < ε / 3 → B z = Φ z := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hBdef]
    show β z * Φ z = Φ z
    rw [β.one_of_mem_closedBall (by rw [hβin]; exact mem_closedBall.mpr hz.le), one_mul]
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨f, hfdef⟩ : ∃ f : M → ℝ,
      f = (chartAt E3 p).source.indicator (fun x => B (chartAt E3 p x)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hf_src : ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source, f x = B (chartAt E3 p x) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hfdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
  have hKsub : ∀ x, x ∉ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' tsupport B → f x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxs : x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source
    · rw [hf_src x hxs]
      by_contra hne
      apply hx
      exact ⟨chartAt E3 p x, subset_tsupport _ hne, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs⟩
    · rw [hfdef, Set.indicator_of_notMem hxs]
  have hKc : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 p).symm '' tsupport B) :=
    hBc.image_of_continuousOn
      ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.mono (hBts.trans (hcb.trans hcyl)))
  have hKs : (chartAt E3 p).symm '' tsupport B ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_target (hcyl (hcb (hBts hy)))
  have hfsm : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f := by
    intro x
    by_cases hxs : x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source
    · have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => B (chartAt E3 p y) := by
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).open_source.mem_nhds hxs] with y hy
        exact hf_src y hy
      have hc : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun y => B (chartAt E3 p y)) x :=
        hB.contMDiff.contMDiffAt.comp x
          ((contMDiffOn_chart (x := p)).contMDiffAt ((chartAt E3 p).open_source.mem_nhds hxs))
      exact hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    · have hxK : x ∉ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' tsupport B := fun h => hxs (hKs h)
      have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hKc.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxK] with y hy
        exact hKsub y hy
      exact contMDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  
  
  
  have hloc : ∀ y, dist y (chartAt E3 p p) < ε / 3 →
      (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] Φ := by
    intro y hy
    filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (mem_ball.mpr hy)] with z hz
    have hz' : dist z (chartAt E3 p p) < ε / 3 := mem_ball.mp hz
    have hzt : z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := hcyl (hballcyl z (by linarith))
    rw [hf_src _ ((chartAt E3 p).map_target hzt), (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hzt]
    exact hBΦ z hz'
  have hiff : ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' ball (chartAt E3 p p) (ε / 3),
      (x ∈ Sig ↔ f x = 0) := by
    rintro x ⟨hxs, hxb⟩
    have hxb' : dist (chartAt E3 p x) (chartAt E3 p p) < ε / 3 := hxb
    have hyc := hballcyl _ (by linarith)
    rw [hf_src x hxs, hBΦ _ hxb', hΦ0 _ hyc, hΦ₁v, sub_eq_zero, ← hgr _ hyc,
      (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs]
  refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' ball (chartAt E3 p p) (ε / 3), f,
    (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage isOpen_ball,
    ⟨mem_chart_source E3 p, mem_ball_self (by positivity)⟩, hfsm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro x ⟨hxs, hxb⟩ hm
    have hxb' : dist (chartAt E3 p x) (chartAt E3 p p) < ε / 3 := hxb
    have hyt : chartAt E3 p x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).map_source hxs
    have hsx : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) = x := (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs
    have hmdf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x)) :=
      hfsm.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hmds : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) :=
      ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞)).contMDiffAt
        ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds hyt)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hcomp := mfderiv_comp (chartAt E3 p x) hmdf hmds
    have hm' : ∀ x₁ : M, x₁ = x → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x₁ = 0 := by
      rintro _ rfl
      exact hm
    rw [hm' _ hsx, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp, mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at hcomp
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ Φ (chartAt E3 p x) = 0 := by
      rw [← (hloc _ hxb').fderiv_eq]
      exact hcomp
    exact (hballS (mem_ball.mpr (by linarith))).2 hfd
  · ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxV, hxS⟩
      exact ⟨hxV, (hiff x hxV).1 hxS⟩
    · rintro ⟨hxV, hx0⟩
      exact ⟨hxV, (hiff x hxV).2 hx0⟩
  · rintro x ⟨⟨hxs, hxb⟩, hxS⟩
    have hxb' : dist (chartAt E3 p x) (chartAt E3 p p) < ε / 3 := hxb
    have hyc := hballcyl _ (by linarith)
    have hgraph : (chartAt E3 p x) a = u (sepPlaneProj a (chartAt E3 p x)) :=
      (hgr _ hyc).1 (by rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs]; exact hxS)
    have hΦ₁0 : Φ₁ (chartAt E3 p x) = 0 := by rw [hΦ₁v, hgraph, sub_self]
    have hwx : w (chartAt E3 p x) = φ x := by
      rw [hwφ _ hgraph, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs]
    rw [hgrad f hfsm x hxs Φ (hloc _ hxb'), ← hwx]
    exact hΦnorm _ hyc hΦ₁0

informal_problem.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X) (hS : IsCompact S) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (V : X → ℝ) (hV : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => V (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) : ∃ lam φ : X → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ S, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ q ∈ U, q ∈ S → lam q = lam p) ∧ (∀ p ∈ S, 0 ≤ φ p) ∧ (∀ p ∈ S, ∃ q ∈ connectedComponentIn S p, φ q ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => φ (P.param j x)) (P.W j) ∧ ∀ x ∈ P.W j, lap2 (P.h j) (fun x' => φ (P.param j x')) x + (V (P.param j x) + lam (P.param j x)) * φ (P.param j x) = 0

signature.name: eig_patched_principal
signature.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X) (hS : IsCompact S) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (V : X → ℝ) (hV : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => V (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) : ∃ lam φ : X → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ S, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ q ∈ U, q ∈ S → lam q = lam p) ∧ (∀ p ∈ S, 0 ≤ φ p) ∧ (∀ p ∈ S, ∃ q ∈ connectedComponentIn S p, φ q ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => φ (P.param j x)) (P.W j) ∧ ∀ x ∈ P.W j, lap2 (P.h j) (fun x' => φ (P.param j x')) x + (V (P.param j x) + lam (P.param j x)) * φ (P.param j x) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hlapc : ∀ (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (f g : E2 → ℝ) (U : Set E2), IsOpen U →
      Set.EqOn f g U → ∀ x ∈ U, lap2 h f x = lap2 h g x := by
    intro h f g U hU hfg x hx
    have h1 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] pd2 k g := by
      intro k
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
      show fderiv ℝ f y (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ g y (e2 k)
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (hfg.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy))]
    have h2 : ∀ i k : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 k f) x = pd2 i (pd2 k g) x := by
      intro i k
      show fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 i) = fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 i)
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (h1 k)]
    have h3 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k f x = pd2 k g x := fun k => (h1 k).eq_of_nhds
    simp only [lap2, h2, h3]
  have hP1 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ S := by
    intro j x hx
    have hmem : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at hmem
    exact hmem.2
  
  have hloc : ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ N : Set X, IsOpen N ∧ q ∈ N ∧ N ∩ S ⊆ connectedComponentIn S q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hq)
    have hqim : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hj, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hxW, rfl⟩ := hqim
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (P.W_open j) x hxW
    refine ⟨P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹' Metric.ball x r,
      (P.proj_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open j) Metric.isOpen_ball, ⟨hj, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show P.proj j (P.param j x) ∈ Metric.ball x r
      rw [P.proj_param j x hxW]
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr
    · have hconn : IsPreconnected (P.param j '' Metric.ball x r) :=
        (convex_ball x r).isPreconnected.image _ ((P.param_cont j).mono hball)
      have hsub : P.param j '' Metric.ball x r ⊆ connectedComponentIn S (P.param j x) :=
        hconn.subset_connectedComponentIn ⟨x, Metric.mem_ball_self hr, rfl⟩
          (by rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩; exact hP1 j z (hball hz))
      rintro y ⟨⟨hyO, hyB⟩, hyS⟩
      have hyim : y ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hyO, hyS⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hzW, rfl⟩ := hyim
      apply hsub
      refine ⟨z, ?_, rfl⟩
      have hz : P.proj j (P.param j z) ∈ Metric.ball x r := hyB
      rwa [P.proj_param j z hzW] at hz
  choose! N hNo hqN hNS using hloc
  have hcomp : ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ U ∩ S = connectedComponentIn S p ∧
      IsCompact (connectedComponentIn S p) := by
    intro p hp
    refine ⟨⋃ q ∈ connectedComponentIn S p, N q,
      isOpen_biUnion (fun q hq => hNo q (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ hq)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hy, hyS⟩
        obtain ⟨q, hq, hyq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hy
        have hqS : q ∈ S := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ hq
        rw [connectedComponentIn_eq hq]
        exact hNS q hqS ⟨hyq, hyS⟩
      · intro hy
        have hyS : y ∈ S := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ hy
        exact ⟨Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨y, hy, hqN y hyS⟩, hyS⟩
    · have hcl : closure (connectedComponentIn S p) ⊆ connectedComponentIn S p :=
        isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.closure.subset_connectedComponentIn
          (subset_closure (mem_connectedComponentIn hp))
          (closure_minimal (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _) hS.isClosed)
      exact hS.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_of_closure_subset hcl)
        (connectedComponentIn_subset _ _)
  
  have hcore : ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ (U : Set X) (lam : ℝ) (φ : X → ℝ), IsOpen U ∧
      U ∩ S = connectedComponentIn S p ∧ (∀ q ∈ U ∩ S, 0 ≤ φ q) ∧ (∃ q ∈ U ∩ S, φ q ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => φ (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' U) ∧
        ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' U, lap2 (P.h j) (fun x' => φ (P.param j x')) x +
          (V (P.param j x) + lam) * φ (P.param j x) = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨U, hUo, hUS, hCc⟩ := hcomp p hp
    have hC : IsCompact (U ∩ S) := by rw [hUS]; exact hCc
    have hne : (U ∩ S).Nonempty := ⟨p, by rw [hUS]; exact mem_connectedComponentIn hp⟩
    obtain ⟨P', hP'1, hP'2⟩ : ∃ P' : EigPatchedSurface X (U ∩ S),
        (∀ j : Fin P'.n, ∃ k : Fin P.n, P'.W j = P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' U ∧
          P'.param j = P.param k ∧ P'.h j = P.h k) ∧
        ∀ k : Fin P.n, ∃ j : Fin P'.n, P'.W j = P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' U ∧
          P'.param j = P.param k ∧ P'.h j = P.h k := by
      refine ⟨{ n := P.n
                W := fun j => P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' U
                param := P.param
                proj := P.proj
                O := fun j => P.O j ∩ U
                h := P.h
                W_open := fun j => (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) hUo
                O_open := fun j => (P.O_open j).inter hUo
                param_cont := fun j => (P.param_cont j).mono Set.inter_subset_left
                proj_cont := fun j => (P.proj_cont j).mono Set.inter_subset_left
                image_eq := ?_
                proj_param := fun j x hx => P.proj_param j x hx.1
                cover := ?_
                trans_smooth := fun j k =>
                  (P.trans_smooth j k).mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2.1⟩)
                h_smooth := fun j a b => (P.h_smooth j a b).mono Set.inter_subset_left
                h_posDef := fun j x hx => P.h_posDef j x hx.1
                h_compat := fun j k x hx a b => P.h_compat j k x ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2.1⟩ a b },
        fun j => ⟨j, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, fun k => ⟨k, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
      · intro j
        show P.param j '' (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' U) = (P.O j ∩ U) ∩ (U ∩ S)
        rw [Set.image_inter_preimage, P.image_eq j]
        ext y
        simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff]
        tauto
      · intro y hy
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hy.2)
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hj, hy.1⟩
    have hV' : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => V (P'.param j x)) (P'.W j) := by
      intro j
      obtain ⟨k, hW, hpar, -⟩ := hP'1 j
      rw [hW, hpar]
      exact (hV k).mono Set.inter_subset_left
    obtain ⟨lam, u, δ, K, c₀, hu, hnn, hδ, hbd, hK, hc₀, hnd, hEL⟩ :=
      eig_variational_sequence (U ∩ S) hC hne P' V hV'
    obtain ⟨ψ, w, G, hψ, hL2, hconv, hgrad, hweak⟩ :=
      eig_local_weak_limit P'.n P'.W P'.W_open P'.h P'.h_smooth P'.h_posDef
        (fun j x => V (P'.param j x) + lam) (fun j => (hV' j).add contDiffOn_const)
        (fun n j x => u n (P'.param j x)) hu hbd δ hδ hEL
    have hreg : ∀ j, ∃ w' : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' (P'.W j) ∧
        (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (P'.W j)), w j x = w' x) ∧
        ∀ x ∈ P'.W j, lap2 (P'.h j) w' x + (V (P'.param j x) + lam) * w' x = 0 := fun j =>
      eig_local_regularity (P'.W j) (P'.W_open j) (P'.h j) (P'.h_smooth j) (P'.h_posDef j)
        (fun x => V (P'.param j x) + lam) ((hV' j).add contDiffOn_const) (w j) (G j)
        (hL2 j) (hgrad j) (hweak j)
    choose w' hw's hw'ae hw'eq using hreg
    have hconv' : ∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P'.W j →
        Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (u (ψ m) (P'.param j x) - w' j x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      intro j L hL hLW
      have hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ L → w j x = w' j x := by
        have h1 := (ae_restrict_iff' (P'.W_open j).measurableSet).1 (hw'ae j)
        filter_upwards [h1] with x hx hxL
        exact hx (hLW hxL)
      refine (hconv j L hL hLW).congr (fun m => ?_)
      refine setIntegral_congr_ae hL.isClosed.measurableSet ?_
      filter_upwards [hae] with x hx hxL
      rw [hx hxL]
    obtain ⟨φ, hφw, hφnn, q, hqS, hq0⟩ := eig_patch_limit_glue (U ∩ S) P' (fun n => u (ψ n))
      (fun n => hu (ψ n)) (fun n => hnn (ψ n)) K hK c₀ hc₀ (fun n => hnd (ψ n)) w' hw's hconv'
    refine ⟨U, lam, φ, hUo, hUS, hφnn, ⟨q, hqS, hq0⟩, fun k => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hW, hpar, hh⟩ := hP'2 k
    rw [← hW, ← hpar, ← hh]
    have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun x' => φ (P'.param j x')) (w' j) (P'.W j) := fun x hx => hφw j x hx
    refine ⟨(hw's j).congr hEq, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rw [hlapc (P'.h j) _ (w' j) (P'.W j) (P'.W_open j) hEq x hx, hφw j x hx]
    exact hw'eq j x hx
  
  choose! Uc lamC φC hUo hUS hφnn hφnz hφeq using hcore
  let D : X → X := fun q =>
    if h : ∃ p, p ∈ S ∧ connectedComponentIn S p = connectedComponentIn S q then h.choose else q
  have hkey : ∀ (C C' : Set X) (h : ∃ p, p ∈ S ∧ connectedComponentIn S p = C)
      (h' : ∃ p, p ∈ S ∧ connectedComponentIn S p = C'), C = C' → h.choose = h'.choose := by
    rintro C C' h h' rfl
    rfl
  have hDS : ∀ q ∈ S, D q ∈ S ∧ connectedComponentIn S (D q) = connectedComponentIn S q := by
    intro q hq
    have hex : ∃ p, p ∈ S ∧ connectedComponentIn S p = connectedComponentIn S q := ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    have hD : D q = hex.choose := dif_pos hex
    rw [hD]
    exact hex.choose_spec
  have hDeq : ∀ q ∈ S, ∀ q', q' ∈ S →
      connectedComponentIn S q' = connectedComponentIn S q → D q' = D q := by
    intro q hq q' hq' hc
    have hex : ∃ p, p ∈ S ∧ connectedComponentIn S p = connectedComponentIn S q := ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    have hex' : ∃ p, p ∈ S ∧ connectedComponentIn S p = connectedComponentIn S q' :=
      ⟨q', hq', rfl⟩
    have hD : D q = hex.choose := dif_pos hex
    have hD' : D q' = hex'.choose := dif_pos hex'
    rw [hD, hD']
    exact hkey _ _ hex' hex hc
  have hU : ∀ q ∈ S, q ∈ Uc (D q) ∧ ∀ q' ∈ Uc (D q) ∩ S, D q' = D q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨hDqS, hDcc⟩ := hDS q hq
    have hUeq : Uc (D q) ∩ S = connectedComponentIn S q := by rw [hUS (D q) hDqS, hDcc]
    have hqU : q ∈ Uc (D q) ∩ S := by rw [hUeq]; exact mem_connectedComponentIn hq
    refine ⟨hqU.1, fun q' hq' => ?_⟩
    have hq'c : q' ∈ connectedComponentIn S q := by rw [← hUeq]; exact hq'
    exact hDeq q hq q' hq'.2 (connectedComponentIn_eq hq'c).symm
  refine ⟨fun q => lamC (D q), fun q => φC (D q) q, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.gradInner f f (Φ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff Φ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i h x * partialDeriv j h x

signature.name: gradInner_eq_coord
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.gradInner f f (Φ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff Φ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i h x * partialDeriv j h x

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hu : ∀ u : E3, u = ∑ d : Fin 3, u d • e d := by
    intro u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hcomp_e : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) a = v a := by
    intro v a
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  have hcompo : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z → ∀ l d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z = (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) d := by
    intro ψ z hψ l d
    have hfun : (fun v => ψ v d) = (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ ψ := by
      funext v; simp
    rw [partialDeriv, hfun, fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj d).differentiableAt hψ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp
  have pd_comp : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ψ z) → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d F (ψ z) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z := by
    intro F ψ z hψ hF l
    have h1 : partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z = fderiv ℝ F (ψ z) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (F ∘ ψ) z (e l) = _
      rw [fderiv_comp z hF hψ]
      rfl
    rw [h1, hu (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)), map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcompo ψ z hψ]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d _
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  
  have grad_alg : ∀ (A Gm Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P Pt : Fin 3 → ℝ), A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * Gm a b * A b j) →
      (∀ i, Pt i = ∑ a : Fin 3, P a * A a i) →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ i j * Pt i * Pt j =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * P i * P j := by
    intro A Gm Gt P Pt hA hGt hPt
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * Gm * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hM : A * Gt⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A = Gm⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv]
      calc A * (A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹) * Matrix.transpose A
          = (A * A⁻¹) * Gm⁻¹ * (Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A) := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = Gm⁻¹ := by
            rw [hAB, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, hAB, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul,
              Matrix.mul_one]
    have hM' : ∀ a b, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A a i * Gt⁻¹ i j * A b j = Gm⁻¹ a b := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hM]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [hPt, ← hM']
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have h2 : IsOpen (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w))
        (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source) := by
    have hΦ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ Φ.source := Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun
    refine ⟨hΦ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Φ.open_source
      (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).open_source, ?_⟩
    have hc : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 (Φ x))
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source := contMDiffOn_chart
    have hcomp := hc.comp (hΦ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun w hw => hw.2)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcomp
  have hxU : x ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source := ⟨hx, mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x)⟩
  have hψd : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z := fun z hz =>
    (h2.2.contDiffAt (h2.1.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hM1 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z) := by
    intro z hz
    have hev : (Φ : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ∘ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w))) := by
      filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
      exact ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hw.2).symm
    rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp z
      (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 (Φ x))
        ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source hz.2)) (hψd z hz).mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
  have hM1' : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source, ∀ u : E3,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z u) := by
    intro z hz u
    rw [hM1 z hz]
    rfl
  
  have s1 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff Φ z i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) z *
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) a b *
            partialDeriv j (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) b) z := by
    intro z hz i j
    have hq : (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) = Φ z :=
      (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hz.2
    have hgq : g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))) = g.g (Φ z) :=
      congrArg g.g hq
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        D = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΦD : ∀ u : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u =
        D (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z u) := by
      intro u
      rw [hM1' z hz u, hD]
      rfl
    have hcD : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) a b
        = g.g (Φ z) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hgq, hD]
      rfl
    have hJ : ∀ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (e k)
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) d) z • e d := by
      intro k
      rw [hu (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (e k))]
      simp only [hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)]
    simp only [hcD]
    show g.g (Φ z) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z (e i))
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z (e j)) = _
    rw [hΦD, hΦD, hJ i, hJ j]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have s3 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
      (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) z).det
        ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz hdet
    obtain ⟨v, hv0, hJv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
    have hloc := PartialDiffeomorph.isLocalDiffeomorphAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ hz.1
    have hinj : ∀ u : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u = 0 → u = 0 := by
      intro u hu0
      rw [← hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv_coe (by simp)] at hu0
      exact (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv (by simp)).map_eq_zero_iff.mp hu0
    have hw : fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
      ext a
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul]
      have := congrFun hJv a
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
        hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)] at this
      simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        WithLp.ofLp_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [← this]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    have h0 : (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
      apply hinj
      rw [hM1' z hz, hw]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero _
    apply hv0
    funext a
    rw [← hcomp_e v a, h0]
    rfl
  
  have huW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target := by
    have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm)
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target :=
      hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
  have hmapsW : chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x) ∈ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target :=
    (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source hxU.2
  have hud : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) :=
    (huW.contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).open_target.mem_nhds hmapsW)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hequ : h =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun w => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)))) := by
    filter_upwards [hfh, h2.1.mem_nhds hxU] with z hz1 hz2
    show h z = f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)))
    rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hz2.2]
    exact hz1.symm
  have hPt : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i h x = ∑ a : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) *
        (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x) a i := by
    intro i
    have e1 : partialDeriv i h x = partialDeriv i
        (fun w => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)))) x := by
      show fderiv ℝ h x (e i) = fderiv ℝ _ x (e i)
      rw [hequ.fderiv_eq]
    rw [e1, pd_comp (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w))
      x (hψd x hxU) hud i]
    rfl
  have hL : g.gradInner f f (Φ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) *
        partialDeriv j (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) := rfl
  rw [hL]
  exact (grad_alg (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) x)
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))) (g.coeff Φ x)
    (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))
    (fun i => partialDeriv i h x) (s3 x hxU) (fun i j => s1 x hxU i j) hPt).symm

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig : Set M) (hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) (q : M) (hq : q ∈ Sig) (V : Set M)
    (f : M → ℝ) (hVo : IsOpen V) (hqV : q ∈ V) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hdf : ∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) (hVS : V ∩ Sig = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0})
    {ι : Type*} (t : Finset ι) (β fi : ι → M → ℝ) (Vi : ι → Set M)
    (hVio : ∀ i ∈ t, IsOpen (Vi i)) (hβ : ∀ i ∈ t, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (β i))
    (hβs : ∀ i ∈ t, tsupport (β i) ⊆ Vi i)
    (hfi : ∀ i ∈ t, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fi i))
    (hdfi : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ x ∈ Vi i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fi i) x ≠ 0)
    (hViS : ∀ i ∈ t, Vi i ∩ Sig = Vi i ∩ (fi i) ⁻¹' {0})
    (hgrad : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ x ∈ V ∩ Vi i ∩ Sig, g.gradInner (fi i) (fi i) x = g.gradInner f f x)
    (D : M → ℝ) (hD : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ D) (hDpos : ∀ x, 0 < D x) (N₀ : Set M)
    (hN₀ : N₀ ∈ 𝓝 q) (hDS : ∀ x ∈ N₀, D x = ∑ i ∈ t, β i x) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x, w x = (∑ i ∈ t, β i x * fi i x ^ 2) / D x) :
    ∃ (U : Set E3) (Q : E3 → ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ chartAt E3 q q ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
      (∀ y ∈ U, (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ V) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q U ∧
      (∀ y ∈ U, w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ^ 2 * Q y) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ U, f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = 0 → Q y = 1) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ U, f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = 0 →
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y
          = 0) ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q) ≠ 0

    (Sig : Set M) (hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) (q : M) (hq : q ∈ Sig) (V : Set M)
    (f : M → ℝ) (hVo : IsOpen V) (hqV : q ∈ V) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hdf : ∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) (hVS : V ∩ Sig = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0})
    {ι : Type*} (t : Finset ι) (β fi : ι → M → ℝ) (Vi : ι → Set M)
    (hVio : ∀ i ∈ t, IsOpen (Vi i)) (hβ : ∀ i ∈ t, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (β i))
    (hβs : ∀ i ∈ t, tsupport (β i) ⊆ Vi i)
    (hfi : ∀ i ∈ t, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fi i))
    (hdfi : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ x ∈ Vi i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fi i) x ≠ 0)
    (hViS : ∀ i ∈ t, Vi i ∩ Sig = Vi i ∩ (fi i) ⁻¹' {0})
    (hgrad : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ x ∈ V ∩ Vi i ∩ Sig, g.gradInner (fi i) (fi i) x = g.gradInner f f x)
    (D : M → ℝ) (hD : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ D) (hDpos : ∀ x, 0 < D x) (N₀ : Set M)
    (hN₀ : N₀ ∈ 𝓝 q) (hDS : ∀ x ∈ N₀, D x = ∑ i ∈ t, β i x) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x, w x = (∑ i ∈ t, β i x * fi i x ^ 2) / D x) :
    ∃ (U : Set E3) (Q : E3 → ℝ), IsOpen U ∧ chartAt E3 q q ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
      (∀ y ∈ U, (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ V) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q U ∧
      (∀ y ∈ U, w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ^ 2 * Q y) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ U, f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = 0 → Q y = 1) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ U, f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = 0 →

  have hcb3 : Metric.closedBall y₀ (r₄ / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball y₀ r₃ := hcb4.trans hB43
  obtain ⟨CH, hCH⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall y₀ (r₄ / 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (hHc.continuousOn.mono hcb3)
  have hWs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W U := ((hf.pow 2).mul hQ).congr hW
  have hdWc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ W) U := hWs.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU hn1
  have hpW : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv i W) U := fun i =>
    hdWc.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hP := ginv_contDiffOn G U hG hGpd
  have hΓ : ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i W y * partialDeriv j W y) U := by
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro i _
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro j _
    exact (((hP i j).continuousOn).mul (hpW i)).mul (hpW j)
  obtain ⟨CG, hCG⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall y₀ (r₄ / 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (hΓ.mono (hcb3.trans hB3U))
  
  refine ⟨r₄ / 2, hr, max CH CG, hcb3.trans hB3U, fun y hy hfy => ?_⟩
  have hy4 : y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r₄ := hcb4 hy
  have hy3 : y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r₃ := hB43 hy4
  have hy2 : y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r₂ := hB32 hy3
  have hFy : F y ≠ 0 := fun h => hfy ((hFzero y hy2).1 h)
  have hWev : W =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun z => F z ^ 2 :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy2) (fun z hz => hWF z hz)
  have hF2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F y := (hFs.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy2)).of_le hn2
  have hsq := lmcCoord_sq G F W y hF2 hWev hFy
  obtain ⟨hpos, hneg⟩ := hsign y hy4
  have hHW : levelMeanCurvCoord G W y < 0 := by
    rw [hsq]
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hFy with h | h
    · rw [if_neg (not_lt.2 h.le)]
      have := hneg h
      linarith
    · rw [if_pos h]
      have := hpos h
      linarith
  have habs : |levelMeanCurvCoord G W y| = |levelMeanCurvCoord G F y| := by
    rw [hsq, abs_mul]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  refine ⟨?_, hHW, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    have h00 : levelMeanCurvCoord G W y = 0 := by
      simp [levelMeanCurvCoord, partialDeriv, h0]
    linarith
  · rw [habs]
    have h := hCH y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact h.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · have h := hCG y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h.trans (le_max_right _ _))

subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (f a F : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hF : ∀ y ∈ U, F y = f y + f y ^ 2 * a y) (y₁ : E3) (hy₁ : y₁ ∈ U) (hf0 : f y₁ = 0) (hdf : fderiv ℝ f y₁ ≠ 0) : levelMeanCurvCoord G F y₁ = levelMeanCurvCoord G f y₁ ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y₁ = partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G f) y₁

subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (hF0 : F y₀ = 0) (hdF : fderiv ℝ F y₀ ≠ 0) (hH0 : ∀ y ∈ U, F y = 0 → levelMeanCurvCoord G F y = 0) (hjac : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y₀ * partialDeriv j F y₀ < 0) : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball y₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, (0 < F y → levelMeanCurvCoord G F y < 0) ∧ (F y < 0 → 0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G F y)

subgoal_signatures.name: lmcCoord_sq
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F W : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F y) (hW : W =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun z => F z ^ 2) (hF0 : F y ≠ 0) : levelMeanCurvCoord G W y = (if 0 < F y then 1 else -1) * levelMeanCurvCoord G F y

by
  
  have fermat : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (x : M), ((∀ y, f y ≤ f x) ∨ (∀ y, f x ≤ f y)) →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x = 0 := by
    intro f x hext
    by_cases hdf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x
    · rw [hdf.mfderiv, ModelWithCorners.range_eq_univ, fderivWithin_univ]
      have hF : ∀ y, writtenInExtChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) x f y =
          f ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm y) := by
        intro y
        simp [writtenInExtChartAt, extChartAt_model_space_eq_id]
      have hF0 : writtenInExtChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) x f (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) = f x := by
        rw [hF, extChartAt_to_inv]
      rcases hext with h | h
      · apply IsLocalMax.fderiv_eq_zero
        exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => by rw [hF0, hF]; exact h _)
      · apply IsLocalMin.fderiv_eq_zero
        exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => by rw [hF0, hF]; exact h _)
    · exact mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt hdf
  have hd : 0 < b - a := by linarith
  
  have hH1 : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((s - a) / (b - a)) ∧
      1 - Real.smoothTransition ((s - a) / (b - a)) ≤ 1 := by
    intro s
    have h1 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg ((s - a) / (b - a))
    have h2 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one ((s - a) / (b - a))
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hH2 : ∀ s : ℝ, s ≤ a → 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((s - a) / (b - a)) = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hd.le)]
    ring
  have hH3 : ∀ s : ℝ, b ≤ s → 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((s - a) / (b - a)) = 0 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le ((le_div_iff₀ hd).2 (by linarith))]
    ring
  have hH5 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((s - a) / (b - a))) :=
    contDiff_const.sub ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).comp
      ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const _))
  
  have hC6 : ∀ c : ℝ, c ≤ t₀ → IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c} ∧
      IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c} := by
    intro c hc
    have heq : {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c} = {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Iic c := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Iic]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        exact ⟨⟨h1, h2.trans hc⟩, h2⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨h1, _⟩, h2⟩
        exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hcl : IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c} := by
      rw [heq]
      exact ContinuousOn.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed (hwc.mono (fun x hx => hx.1))
        hcpt.isClosed isClosed_Iic
    exact ⟨hcl, hcpt.of_isClosed_subset hcl (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.trans hc⟩)⟩
  have hC7 : IsCompact {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b} := by
    have heq : {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b} =
        {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Icc a b := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Icc]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
        exact ⟨⟨h1, h3.trans hb⟩, h2, h3⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨h1, _⟩, h2, h3⟩
        exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    have hcl : IsClosed {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b} := by
      rw [heq]
      exact ContinuousOn.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed (hwc.mono (fun x hx => hx.1))
        hcpt.isClosed isClosed_Icc
    exact hcpt.of_isClosed_subset hcl (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.2.trans hb⟩)
  have hKb : IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ b} := (hC6 b hb).1
  
  set φ : M → ℝ := O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
    with hφ
  have hφin : ∀ x ∈ O, φ x = 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hφ, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
  have hφout : ∀ x, x ∉ O → φ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hφ, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
  have hC2 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ O
    · rw [hφin x hx]; exact hH1 _
    · rw [hφout x hx]; exact ⟨le_refl _, zero_le_one⟩
  have hV1 : ∀ x ∈ O, w x ≤ a → φ x = 1 := by
    intro x hx hwa
    rw [hφin x hx]; exact hH2 _ hwa
  have hV0 : ∀ x, x ∉ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ b} → φ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
    · have hbw : b ≤ w x := by
        by_contra hlt
        exact hx ⟨hxO, le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hlt)⟩
      rw [hφin x hxO]; exact hH3 _ hbw
    · exact hφout x hxO
  have hC4 : ∀ x, φ x ≠ 0 → x ∈ O ∧ w x < b := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hcon
    apply hx
    apply hV0
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    apply hcon
    refine ⟨h1, lt_of_le_of_ne h2 ?_⟩
    intro hwb
    apply hx
    rw [hφin x h1]
    exact hH3 _ hwb.ge
  
  have hC1 : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ := by
    intro x
    by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
    · by_cases hxS : x ∈ Sig
      · have hwx : w x < a := by rw [hw0 x hxO hxS]; exact ha
        have hN : O ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Iio a ∈ 𝓝 x :=
          (hwc.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_Iio).mem_nhds ⟨hxO, hwx⟩
        have heq : φ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hN (fun y hy => hV1 y hy.1 (le_of_lt hy.2))
        exact contMDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
      · have hD : IsOpen (O \ Sig) := hO.sdiff hSig
        have hwx : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w x :=
          hws.contMDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds ⟨hxO, hxS⟩)
        have hc := hH5.comp_contMDiffAt hwx
        refine hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds hxO) (fun y hy => hφin y hy)
    · have hN : {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ b}ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 x :=
        hKb.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds (fun h => hxO h.1)
      have heq : φ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hN (fun y hy => hV0 y hy)
      exact contMDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  
  have hC3 : ∀ x ∈ O, w x ≤ a → φ x = 1 ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) φ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx hwa
    have h1 := hV1 x hx hwa
    refine ⟨h1, fermat φ x (Or.inl (fun y => ?_))⟩
    rw [h1]; exact (hC2 y).2
  have hC5 : ∀ x, x ∉ {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b} →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) φ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
    · by_cases hwa : w x ≤ a
      · exact (hC3 x hxO hwa).2
      · have hbw : b < w x := by
          by_contra hle
          exact hx ⟨hxO, le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hwa), le_of_not_gt hle⟩
        have h0 : φ x = 0 := by rw [hφin x hxO]; exact hH3 _ hbw.le
        refine fermat φ x (Or.inr (fun y => ?_))
        rw [h0]; exact (hC2 y).1
    · have h0 : φ x = 0 := hφout x hxO
      refine fermat φ x (Or.inr (fun y => ?_))
      rw [h0]; exact (hC2 y).1
  exact ⟨hC1, hC2, hC3, hC4, hC5, hC6, hC7⟩

    (hVs : ∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p)

      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Kᶜ))
    (hVd : ∀ (p : M) (ψ : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ → IsCompact (tsupport ψ) →
      tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y,
        y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) →
        |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y| ≤ C)
    (hV1 : ∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (calDivSum g q φ E V) ≤ hullRiemPer g E Ω K

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ : ∃ I : M → (M → ℝ) → ℝ, I = fun p ψ =>
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  suffices H : ∀ (n : ℕ) (Ω : Set M), IsOpen Ω → ∀ (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ),
      calPartition q φ Ω → ENNReal.ofReal (calDivSum g q φ E V) ≤ hullRiemPer g E Ω K from
    H n Ω hΩ q φ hφ
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro Ω _ q φ _
    simp [calDivSum]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro Ω hΩ q φ hφ
    obtain ⟨hsm, hnn, hsum, hsupp⟩ := hφ
    by_cases hPtop : hullRiemPer g E Ω K = ⊤
    · rw [hPtop]; exact le_top
    
    have hmono : ∀ U : Set M, U ⊆ Ω → hullRiemPer g E U K ≤ hullRiemPer g E Ω K := by
      intro U hU
      have h := hullRiemPer_disjoint_sum_le g E Ω K (fun _ : Fin 1 => U) (fun _ => hU)
        (fun i j hij => absurd (Subsingleton.elim i j) hij)
      simpa using h
    have hfin : ∀ U : Set M, U ⊆ Ω → hullRiemPer g E U K ≠ ⊤ := fun U hU =>
      ne_top_of_le_ne_top hPtop (hmono U hU)
    have hconv : ∀ (U : Set M), U ⊆ Ω → ∀ (x c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c →
        ENNReal.ofReal x ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * hullRiemPer g E U K →
        x ≤ c * (hullRiemPer g E U K).toReal := by
      intro U hU x c hc h
      have h2 := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal
        (ENNReal.mul_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (hfin U hU))).1 h
      rwa [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hc] at h2
    have hpv0 : 0 ≤ (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    
    have hφ1 : ∀ j x, φ j x ≤ 1 := fun j x =>
      le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => hnn k x) (Finset.mem_univ j)) (hsum x)
    have hφ0src : ∀ x, φ 0 x ≠ 0 → x ∈ Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (q 0)).source := fun x hx =>
      (hsupp 0).2 (subset_tsupport _ hx)
    have hprod : ∀ (w : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w →
        (∀ x, 0 ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ 1) → ∀ j,
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => w x * φ j x) ∧
        IsCompact (tsupport (fun x => w x * φ j x)) ∧
        tsupport (fun x => w x * φ j x) ⊆ tsupport w ∩ (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) ∧
        (∀ x, |w x * φ j x| ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ w x * φ j x) := by
      intro w hw hw01 j
      refine ⟨hw.mul (hsm j),
        (hsupp j).1.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) (tsupport_mul_subset_right),
        fun x hx => ⟨tsupport_mul_subset_left hx, (hsupp j).2 (tsupport_mul_subset_right hx)⟩,
        fun x => ?_, fun x => mul_nonneg (hw01 x).1 (hnn j x)⟩
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hw01 x).1 (hnn j x))]
      exact mul_le_one₀ (hw01 x).2 (hnn j x) (hφ1 j x)
    have hΛeq : calDivSum g q φ E V = ∑ j, I (q j) (φ j) := by subst hI; rfl
    
    have hstar : ∀ N : ℕ, 0 < N → ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u →
        calDivSum g q φ E V ≤ (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal +
          8 * N * u * (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal
          + (n + 1) * (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal / N := by
      intro N hN u hu
      have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
      
      have hBsub : ∀ i : Fin N, Ω ∩ {x | u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) - 2 * u < φ 0 x ∧
          φ 0 x < u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) + 2 * u} ⊆ Ω := fun i => Set.inter_subset_left
      have hBdisj : Pairwise (fun i j : Fin N =>
          Disjoint (Ω ∩ {x | u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) - 2 * u < φ 0 x ∧
            φ 0 x < u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) + 2 * u})
          (Ω ∩ {x | u * (8 * ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) - 2 * u < φ 0 x ∧
            φ 0 x < u * (8 * ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) + 2 * u})) := by
        intro i j hij
        rw [Set.disjoint_left]
        rintro x ⟨-, h1, h2⟩ ⟨-, h3, h4⟩
        have hne : (i : ℕ) ≠ (j : ℕ) := fun h => hij (Fin.ext h)
        rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
        · have h' : ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h' hu.le]
        · have h' : ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h' hu.le]
      have hBsum := hullRiemPer_disjoint_sum_le g E Ω K _ hBsub hBdisj
      have hBreal : ∑ i : Fin N, (hullRiemPer g E (Ω ∩ {x | u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) - 2 * u
          < φ 0 x ∧ φ 0 x < u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) + 2 * u}) K).toReal ≤
          (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal := by
        rw [← ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun i _ => hfin _ (hBsub i))]
        exact ENNReal.toReal_mono hPtop hBsum
      obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ : ∃ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)),
          (hullRiemPer g E (Ω ∩ {x | u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) - 2 * u < φ 0 x ∧
            φ 0 x < u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) + 2 * u}) K).toReal
            ≤ (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal / N := by
        refine Finset.exists_le_of_sum_le ⟨⟨0, hN⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩ ?_
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
          mul_div_cancel₀ _ hNpos.ne']
        exact hBreal
      set t : ℝ := u * (8 * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 4) with ht
      set B : Set M := Ω ∩ {x | t - 2 * u < φ 0 x ∧ φ 0 x < t + 2 * u} with hB
      have hi' : (hullRiemPer g E B K).toReal ≤ (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal / N := hi
      have hBsub' : B ⊆ Ω := Set.inter_subset_left
      have hBopen : IsOpen B := hΩ.inter
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const (hsm 0).continuous).inter
          (isOpen_lt (hsm 0).continuous continuous_const))
      have ht0 : 0 < t := by positivity
      have htle : t ≤ 8 * N * u := by
        have hiN : ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast i.isLt
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hiN hu.le]
      
      obtain ⟨a, b, γ, ha, hb, hγ, h01, hsa, hsb, hsγ⟩ := calCut_functions (φ 0) (hsm 0) t u hu
      have h01a : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x ∧ a x ≤ 1 := fun x => ⟨(h01 x).1, (h01 x).2.1⟩
      have h01b : ∀ x, 0 ≤ b x ∧ b x ≤ 1 := fun x => ⟨(h01 x).2.2.1, (h01 x).2.2.2.1⟩
      have h01γ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ γ x ∧ γ x ≤ 1 := fun x => ⟨(h01 x).2.2.2.2.1, (h01 x).2.2.2.2.2.1⟩
      have hsum3 : ∀ x, a x + γ x + b x = 1 := fun x => (h01 x).2.2.2.2.2.2
      have hPa := hprod a ha h01a
      have hPb := hprod b hb h01b
      have hPγ := hprod γ hγ h01γ
      have hta' : tsupport a ⊆ tsupport (φ 0) := fun x hx =>
        subset_tsupport _ (ht0.trans (hsa hx)).ne'
      have hta : tsupport a ⊆ Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (q 0)).source := fun x hx =>
        hφ0src x (ht0.trans (hsa hx)).ne'
      set Ωa : Set M := Ω ∩ {x | t < φ 0 x} with hΩadef
      set Ωb : Set M := Ω ∩ {x | φ 0 x < t} with hΩbdef
      have hΩa : IsOpen Ωa := hΩ.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (hsm 0).continuous)
      have hΩb : IsOpen Ωb := hΩ.inter (isOpen_lt (hsm 0).continuous continuous_const)
      have hΩasub : Ωa ⊆ Ω := Set.inter_subset_left
      have hΩbsub : Ωb ⊆ Ω := Set.inter_subset_left
      have hdab : Disjoint Ωa Ωb := Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x h1 h2 =>
        lt_asymm (show t < φ 0 x from h1.2) (show φ 0 x < t from h2.2)
      
      have hsplit : ∀ j, I (q j) (φ j) = I (q j) (fun x => a x * φ j x) +
          I (q j) (fun x => γ x * φ j x) + I (q j) (fun x => b x * φ j x) := by
        intro j
        have hw : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (![a, γ, b] k) ∧
            ∀ x, 0 ≤ ![a, γ, b] k x ∧ ![a, γ, b] k x ≤ 1 := by
          intro k
          fin_cases k
          · exact ⟨ha, h01a⟩
          · exact ⟨hγ, h01γ⟩
          · exact ⟨hb, h01b⟩
        have h : I (q j) (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, ![a, γ, b] k x * φ j x) =
            ∑ k : Fin 3, I (q j) (fun x => ![a, γ, b] k x * φ j x) := by
          subst hI
          exact hull_calPiece_div_integral_sum g E K hE hEK (q j)
            (fun k x => ![a, γ, b] k x * φ j x)
            (fun k => (hprod _ (hw k).1 (hw k).2 j).1)
            (fun k => (hprod _ (hw k).1 (hw k).2 j).2.1)
            (fun k x hx => ((hprod _ (hw k).1 (hw k).2 j).2.2.1 hx).2.2) V hVs
            (fun k => hVd (q j) _ (hprod _ (hw k).1 (hw k).2 j).1
              (hprod _ (hw k).1 (hw k).2 j).2.1
              (fun x hx => ((hprod _ (hw k).1 (hw k).2 j).2.2.1 hx).2.2))
        have hfun : (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, ![a, γ, b] k x * φ j x) = φ j := by
          funext x
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
            Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons]
          linear_combination (φ j x) * hsum3 x
        rw [hfun, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h
        simpa only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] using h
      
      have hAj : ∀ j, I (q j) (fun x => a x * φ j x) = I (q 0) (fun x => a x * φ j x) := by
        intro j
        subst hI
        exact hull_calPiece_div_integral_chart_eq g K (q j) (q 0) _ (hPa j).1 (hPa j).2.1
          (fun x hx => ⟨((hPa j).2.2.1 hx).2.2, (hta ((hPa j).2.2.1 hx).1).2⟩) V hVs E hE hEK
      have hAsum : I (q 0) (fun x => ∑ j, a x * φ j x) =
          ∑ j, I (q 0) (fun x => a x * φ j x) := by
        subst hI
        exact hull_calPiece_div_integral_sum g E K hE hEK (q 0) (fun j x => a x * φ j x)
          (fun j => (hPa j).1) (fun j => (hPa j).2.1)
          (fun j x hx => (hta ((hPa j).2.2.1 hx).1).2) V hVs
          (fun j => hVd (q 0) _ (hPa j).1 (hPa j).2.1
            (fun x hx => (hta ((hPa j).2.2.1 hx).1).2))
      have hψa_eq : (fun x => ∑ j, a x * φ j x) = fun x => a x * ∑ j, φ j x := by
        funext x; rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      have hψa_sm : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => ∑ j, a x * φ j x) := by
        rw [hψa_eq]; exact ha.mul (contMDiff_finset_sum fun j _ => hsm j)
      have hψa_ts : tsupport (fun x => ∑ j, a x * φ j x) ⊆ tsupport a := by
        rw [hψa_eq]; exact tsupport_mul_subset_left
      have hψa_b : ∀ x, |∑ j, a x * φ j x| ≤ 1 := by
        intro x
        have e := congrFun hψa_eq x
        simp only at e
        have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, φ j x := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hnn j x
        rw [e, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (h01a x).1 hs0)]
        exact mul_le_one₀ (h01a x).2 hs0 (hsum x)
      have hA := hull_calPiece_div_le g E Ωa K hE hK hKi hEK hΩa (q 0)
        (fun x => ∑ j, a x * φ j x) hψa_sm
        ((hsupp 0).1.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) (hψa_ts.trans hta'))
        (fun x hx => ⟨⟨(hta (hψa_ts hx)).1, hsa (hψa_ts hx)⟩, (hta (hψa_ts hx)).2⟩) 1 one_pos
        hψa_b V hVs hVd hV1
      have hAR : I (q 0) (fun x => ∑ j, a x * φ j x) ≤ 1 * (hullRiemPer g E Ωa K).toReal :=
        hconv Ωa hΩasub _ 1 zero_le_one (by subst hI; exact hA)
      
      have hΓj : ∀ j, I (q j) (fun x => γ x * φ j x) ≤ (hullRiemPer g E B K).toReal := by
        intro j
        have h := hull_calPiece_div_le g E B K hE hK hKi hEK hBopen (q j)
          (fun x => γ x * φ j x) (hPγ j).1 (hPγ j).2.1
          (fun x hx => ⟨⟨((hPγ j).2.2.1 hx).2.1, hsγ ((hPγ j).2.2.1 hx).1⟩,
            ((hPγ j).2.2.1 hx).2.2⟩) 1 one_pos (hPγ j).2.2.2.1 V hVs hVd hV1
        have h2 : I (q j) (fun x => γ x * φ j x) ≤ 1 * (hullRiemPer g E B K).toReal :=
          hconv B hBsub' _ 1 zero_le_one (by subst hI; exact h)
        linarith
      have hγsum : ∑ j, I (q j) (fun x => γ x * φ j x) ≤
          (n + 1) * (hullRiemPer g E B K).toReal := by
        calc _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin (n + 1), (hullRiemPer g E B K).toReal :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hΓj j
          _ = _ := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
              push_cast; ring
      
      have hbφ0 : ∀ x, |b x * φ 0 x| ≤ t := by
        intro x
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (h01b x).1 (hnn 0 x))]
        by_cases hbx : b x = 0
        · rw [hbx, zero_mul]; exact ht0.le
        · have h1 : φ 0 x < t := hsb (subset_tsupport _ hbx)
          have h2 : b x * φ 0 x ≤ φ 0 x := mul_le_of_le_one_left (hnn 0 x) (h01b x).2
          linarith
      have hHead := hull_calPiece_div_le g E Ωb K hE hK hKi hEK hΩb (q 0)
        (fun x => b x * φ 0 x) (hPb 0).1 (hPb 0).2.1
        (fun x hx => ⟨⟨((hPb 0).2.2.1 hx).2.1, hsb ((hPb 0).2.2.1 hx).1⟩,
          ((hPb 0).2.2.1 hx).2.2⟩) t ht0 hbφ0 V hVs hVd hV1
      have hHeadR : I (q 0) (fun x => b x * φ 0 x) ≤ t * (hullRiemPer g E Ωb K).toReal :=
        hconv Ωb hΩbsub _ t ht0.le (by subst hI; exact hHead)
      have hpart' : calPartition (fun j : Fin n => q j.succ) (fun j x => b x * φ j.succ x) Ωb := by
        refine ⟨fun j => (hPb j.succ).1, fun j x => (hPb j.succ).2.2.2.2 x, fun x => ?_,
          fun j => ⟨(hPb j.succ).2.1, fun y hy => ⟨⟨((hPb j.succ).2.2.1 hy).2.1,
            hsb ((hPb j.succ).2.2.1 hy).1⟩, ((hPb j.succ).2.2.1 hy).2.2⟩⟩⟩
        have e : ∑ j : Fin n, b x * φ j.succ x = b x * ∑ j : Fin n, φ j.succ x := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        have hs := hsum x
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hs
        have hnn' : 0 ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, φ j.succ x := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hnn _ x
        have h2 : b x * ∑ j : Fin n, φ j.succ x ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, φ j.succ x :=
          mul_le_of_le_one_left hnn' (h01b x).2
        rw [e]
        linarith [hnn 0 x]
      have hTail := ih Ωb hΩb _ _ hpart'
      have hTailR : calDivSum g (fun j : Fin n => q j.succ) (fun j x => b x * φ j.succ x) E V ≤
          (hullRiemPer g E Ωb K).toReal :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal (hfin Ωb hΩbsub)).1 hTail
      have hbsplit : ∑ j, I (q j) (fun x => b x * φ j x) = I (q 0) (fun x => b x * φ 0 x) +
          calDivSum g (fun j : Fin n => q j.succ) (fun j x => b x * φ j.succ x) E V := by
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
        congr 1
        subst hI
        rfl
      have hasum : ∑ j, I (q j) (fun x => a x * φ j x) =
          I (q 0) (fun x => ∑ j, a x * φ j x) := by
        rw [hAsum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hAj j
      
      have hab := hullRiemPer_disjoint_sum_le g E Ω K ![Ωa, Ωb]
        (by
          intro k
          fin_cases k
          · exact hΩasub
          · exact hΩbsub)
        (by
          intro k l hkl
          fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l
          · exact absurd rfl hkl
          · exact hdab
          · exact hdab.symm
          · exact absurd rfl hkl)
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hab
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at hab
      have habR := ENNReal.toReal_mono hPtop hab
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_add (hfin _ hΩasub) (hfin _ hΩbsub)] at habR
      have hpa0 : 0 ≤ (hullRiemPer g E Ωa K).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      have hpb0 : 0 ≤ (hullRiemPer g E Ωb K).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      have hpB0 : 0 ≤ (hullRiemPer g E B K).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      have hT1 : t * (hullRiemPer g E Ωb K).toReal ≤
          8 * N * u * (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal :=
        mul_le_mul htle (by linarith) hpb0 (by positivity)
      have hT2 : (n + 1) * (hullRiemPer g E B K).toReal ≤
          (n + 1) * (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal / N := by
        rw [mul_div_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi' (by positivity)
      rw [hΛeq, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hsplit j, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
        Finset.sum_add_distrib, hasum, hbsplit]
      linarith
    
    have hΛ : calDivSum g q φ E V ≤ (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal := by
      refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε => ?_
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 * (n + 1) * (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal / ε)
      have hNpos' : (0 : ℝ) < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) hN
      have hNpos : 0 < N := by exact_mod_cast hNpos'
      have h1 := hstar N hNpos (ε / (16 * N * ((hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal + 1)))
        (by positivity)
      have e1 : 8 * (N : ℝ) * (ε / (16 * N * ((hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal + 1))) *
          (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal =
          ε / 2 * ((hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal / ((hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal + 1)) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      have e2 : (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal / ((hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal + 1) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; linarith
      have e4 : ε / 2 * ((hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal / ((hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal + 1))
          ≤ ε / 2 :=
        mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) e2
      have e3 : (n + 1) * (hullRiemPer g E Ω K).toReal / N ≤ ε / 2 := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hNpos']
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ hε] at hN
        linarith
      rw [e1] at h1
      linarith
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hΛ).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hPtop).le

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig E O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (t₀ a b : ℝ) (hE : IsOpen E) (hfr : frontier E = Sig)
    (hO : IsOpen O) (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀}) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O)

    (hdw : ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0)
    (hbd : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, w x ≤ t₀ → g.gradInner w w x ≤ C ∧ |g.levelMeanCurv w x| ≤ C)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ t₀) :
    ∃ V : M → E3,
      (∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p)
        ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3))
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Sigᶜ)) ∧

          y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) →
          |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y| ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x, V x ≠ 0 → x ∈ E ∧ x ∈ O ∧ w x < b) ∧

        IsOpen O'' → {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ b} ⊆ O'' → (∀ x ∈ O'', ∑ j, φ j x = 1) →
        calDivSum g q φ E V =
          calVolSum g q φ E (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner
            (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))))
            (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) x)) -
          calVolSum g q φ E (fun x =>
            O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x *

by

  obtain ⟨ζ, hζdef⟩ : ∃ ζ : M → ℝ,
      ζ = O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hζs, hζ01, -, hζ0, -, hcl, -⟩ :=
    collar_cutoff_props Sig O w t₀ a b hSigc hO hcpt hwc hw0 hws ha hab hb
  rw [← hζdef] at hζs hζ01 hζ0
  rw [← hζdef]

    intro x hx; rw [hζdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]

  have hζH : ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, ζ x ≠ 0 → |g.levelMeanCurv w x| ≤ C₀ := by
    intro x hx h

  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : M → E3, U = fun x => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm

        (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : M → E3, V = E.indicator (fun x => (-(ζ x)) • U x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs2 := fun p => chart_unit_normal_calculus g (O \ Sig) w hDo hws hdw p
  have hVE : ∀ x ∈ E, V x = (-(ζ x)) • U x := by
    intro x hx; rw [hVdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
  have hVsupp : ∀ x, V x ≠ 0 → x ∈ E ∧ x ∈ O ∧ w x < b := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxE : x ∈ E

        intro h0; apply hx; rw [hVE x hxE, h0, neg_zero, zero_smul]

    by_contra h
