      ((integrable_indicator_iff hK.measurableSet).2
        (integrableOn_const hK.measure_lt_top.ne)).integrableOn
    exact Integrable.mono' hgi hm ((ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hS) fun y hy => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hb y hy)
  have hsplit : ∀ (S : Set E3) (Df Af Bf Rf : E3 → ℝ), MeasurableSet S → IntegrableOn Df S →
      IntegrableOn Af S → IntegrableOn Bf S → (∀ y ∈ S, Df y = Af y - Bf y + Rf y) →
      ∫ y in S, Df y = (∫ y in S, Af y) - (∫ y in S, Bf y) + ∫ y in S, Rf y := by
    intro S Df Af Bf Rf hS hD hA hB h
    have hAB : IntegrableOn (fun y => Af y - Bf y) S := hA.sub hB
    have h3 : IntegrableOn (fun y => Df y - Af y + Bf y) S := (hD.sub hA).add hB
    have hR : IntegrableOn Rf S := by
      refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun h3 (fun y hy => ?_) hS
      rw [h y hy]
      ring
    rw [setIntegral_congr_fun hS h, integral_add hAB hR, integral_sub hA hB]
  
  have hchart : ∀ (p : M) (ψ : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ →
      IsCompact (tsupport ψ) → tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x ∧ ψ x ≤ 1) →
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y =
      (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner ζ ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det) -
      (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
          (ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det) +
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
              (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3) := by
    intro p ψ hψ hψc hψs hψ01
    obtain ⟨⟨CD, hCD⟩, hvan, hform⟩ := hpiece p ψ hψ hψc hψs
    have hSo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hE.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source)
        Set.inter_subset_right
    have hSm := hSo.measurableSet
    have hST : chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source hx.2
    have hSS : chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ⊆
        (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Sigᶜ := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source hx.2, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) ∉ Sig
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx.2]
      exact fun hs => Set.disjoint_left.1 hESig hx.1 hs
    have hSsig : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ ⟨x', hx', hxx'⟩
      have hx'x : x' = x := (chartAt E3 p).injOn hx'.2 hx.2 hxx'
      rw [hx'x] at hx'
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hESig hx.1 hx'.1
    have hKc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ) :=
      hψc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono hψs)
    have hKt : chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source (hψs hx)
    have hψK : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ →
        ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = 0 := by
      intro y hy hyK
      by_contra h
      exact hyK ⟨_, subset_tsupport _ h, (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hy⟩
    have hψabs : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ 1 := fun x => abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [(hψ01 x).1], (hψ01 x).2⟩
    have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z i j)
        (chartAt E3 p).target := g.smooth p
    have hpd : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).PosDef :=
      fun z hz => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p z hz
    have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det)
        (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      (ccs_sqrtdet_smooth _ _ hGs (fun z hz => (hpd z hz).det_pos)).continuousOn
    have hψp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hψ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    have hζp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hζs.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    have hginv := ginv_contDiffOn _ _ hGs hpd
    have hdζ : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z)
        (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      hζp.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 p).open_target (by simp)
    have hdψ : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z)
        (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      hψp.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 p).open_target (by simp)
    have hQζ : ContinuousOn (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      simp only [partialDeriv]
      refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
      exact (((hginv i j).continuousOn).mul (hdζ.clm_apply continuousOn_const)).mul
        (hdζ.clm_apply continuousOn_const)
    let Φp : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      PartialDiffeomorph.mk (chartAt E3 p).symm.toPartialEquiv (chartAt E3 p).open_target
        (chartAt E3 p).open_source contMDiffOn_chart_symm contMDiffOn_chart
    have hgζ : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, g.gradInner ζ ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y :=
      fun y hy => gradInner_eq_coord g Φp ζ (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) hζs y hy
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
    
    obtain ⟨MA, hMA⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (((hQζ.sqrt).mul hdetc).mono hKt)
    have hAi : IntegrableOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner ζ ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)
        (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) := by
      have hA' : IntegrableOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
            partialDeriv i (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
            partialDeriv j (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)
          (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) := by
        refine hint _ _ _ MA hSm hKc ?_ ?_
        · exact (((hψp.continuousOn.mul hQζ.sqrt).mul hdetc).mono hST).aestronglyMeasurable hSm
        · intro y hy
          by_cases hyK : y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyK]
            have h1 := hMA y hyK
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
            rw [mul_assoc, abs_mul]
            nlinarith [hψabs ((chartAt E3 p).symm y), abs_nonneg (Real.sqrt
              (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
                partialDeriv i (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
                partialDeriv j (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) *
              Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det),
              abs_nonneg (ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))]
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyK, hψK y (hST hy) hyK]
            simp
      refine hA'.congr_fun (fun y hy => ?_) hSm
      rw [hgζ y (hST hy)]
    
    have hRm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3))
        (volume.restrict (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))) :=
      ((hdetc.mono hST).mul ((hdψ.mono hST).clm_apply ((hVs p).continuousOn.mono hSS))).aestronglyMeasurable hSm
    
    have hDm : Measurable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V)) := by
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ _ _
    have hDi : IntegrableOn (fun y => sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y)
        (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) := by
      refine hint _ _ _ CD hSm hKc hDm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      intro y hy
      by_cases hyK : y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyK]
        exact hCD y (hSsig y hy)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyK, hvan y hyK, abs_zero]
    
    obtain ⟨Md, hMd⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hdetc.mono hKt)
    have hBi : IntegrableOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
        (ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)
        (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) := by
      refine hint _ _ _ (|C₀| * Md) hSm hKc ?_ ?_
      · refine ((hAi.1.add hRm).sub hDm.aestronglyMeasurable).congr ?_
        refine (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hSm) fun y hy => ?_
        simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply]
        rw [hform y hy]
        ring
      · intro y hy
        by_cases hyK : y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyK]
          have h1 := hMd y hyK
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
          have hd0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
          have hMd0 : 0 ≤ Md := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) h1
          have hζH' : |ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)|
              ≤ |C₀| := by
            by_cases hz : ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = 0
            · rw [hz, zero_mul, abs_zero]; exact abs_nonneg _
            · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hy
              have hxe : (chartAt E3 p).symm y = x := by
                rw [← hxy, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx.2]
              have hxS : x ∉ Sig := fun hs => Set.disjoint_left.1 hESig hx.1 hs
              rw [hxe] at hz ⊢
              have hH := hζH x ⟨(hζ0 x hz).1, hxS⟩ hz
              rw [abs_mul]
              have := hζ01 x
              have hζa : |ζ x| ≤ 1 := abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, this.2⟩
              nlinarith [abs_nonneg (ζ x), abs_nonneg (g.levelMeanCurv w x), le_abs_self C₀]
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          have hψa := hψabs ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          have hP1 : |ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)| *
              |ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)| ≤
              1 * |C₀| := mul_le_mul hψa hζH' (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          rw [one_mul] at hP1
          exact mul_le_mul hP1 h1 (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyK, hψK y (hST hy) hyK]
          simp
    exact hsplit _ _ _ _ _ hSm hDi hAi hBi hform
  
  have ham : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < a / ((m : ℝ) + 2) := fun m => div_pos ha (by positivity)
  have hamb : ∀ m : ℕ, a / ((m : ℝ) + 2) < 2 * a / ((m : ℝ) + 2) := fun m =>
    div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
  have hbm : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 * a / ((m : ℝ) + 2) ≤ t₀ := by
    intro m
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg m
    nlinarith
  have hcut := fun m : ℕ => collar_cutoff_props Sig O w t₀ (a / ((m : ℝ) + 2))
    (2 * a / ((m : ℝ) + 2)) hSigc hO hcpt hwc hw0 hws (ham m) (hamb m) (hbm m)
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℕ → M → ℝ, c = fun (m : ℕ) (x : M) => 1 - O.indicator (fun x =>
      1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a / ((m : ℝ) + 2)) /
        (2 * a / ((m : ℝ) + 2) - a / ((m : ℝ) + 2)))) x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hcm : ∀ m x, c m x = 1 - O.indicator (fun x =>
      1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a / ((m : ℝ) + 2)) /
        (2 * a / ((m : ℝ) + 2) - a / ((m : ℝ) + 2)))) x := by
    intro m x; rw [hcdef]
  have hc1 : ∀ m x, |c m x| ≤ 1 := by
    intro m x
    have h := (hcut m).2.1 x
    rw [hcm, abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
  have hcs : ∀ m, calSmoothField (fun x => c m x • V x) := by
    intro m qq y hy
    refine ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt ?_
    by_cases hxS : (chartAt E3 qq).symm y ∈ Sig
    · obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ : ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 ((chartAt E3 qq).symm y), ∀ x' ∈ N, c m x' • V x' = 0 := by
        by_cases hxO : (chartAt E3 qq).symm y ∈ O
        · refine ⟨{x' | x' ∈ O ∧ w x' < a / ((m : ℝ) + 2)},
            (hwc.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_Iio).mem_nhds
              ⟨hxO, by
                show w ((chartAt E3 qq).symm y) < a / ((m : ℝ) + 2)
                rw [hw0 _ hxO hxS]; exact ham m⟩, fun x' hx' => ?_⟩
          rw [hcm, ((hcut m).2.2.1 x' hx'.1 hx'.2.le).1, sub_self, zero_smul]
        · refine ⟨{x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ b}ᶜ, hKb.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds (fun h => hxO h.1),
            fun x' hx' => ?_⟩
          rw [hKbV x' hx', smul_zero]
      have h2 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y,
          c m ((chartAt E3 qq).symm z) • V ((chartAt E3 qq).symm z) = 0 :=
        (((chartAt E3 qq).continuousAt_symm hy).eventually hN).mono fun z hz => hN0 _ hz
      refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : E3))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [h2] with z hz
      simp only [hz, map_zero]
    · have hVa := (hVs qq).contDiffAt
        (((chartAt E3 qq).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hSigc.isOpen_compl).mem_nhds ⟨hy, hxS⟩)
      have hca : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => c m ((chartAt E3 qq).symm z)) y := by
        have h := (contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp ((hcut m).1.comp_contMDiffOn
          contMDiffOn_chart_symm)).contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 qq).open_target.mem_nhds hy)
        simp only [hcm]
        exact contDiffAt_const.sub h
      refine (hca.smul hVa).congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul _ _ _
  have hlim : ∀ x ∈ E, Tendsto (fun m => c m x) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    intro x hxE
    refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
    by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
    · have hxS : x ∉ Sig := fun hs => Set.disjoint_left.1 hESig hxE hs
      have hwx := hwpos x hxO hxS
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge (2 * a / w x)
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N] with m hm
      have hmN : (N : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_le.2 hm
      have hb' : 2 * a / ((m : ℝ) + 2) ≤ w x := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hwx] at hN
        nlinarith
      have h0 : O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a / ((m : ℝ) + 2)) /
          (2 * a / ((m : ℝ) + 2) - a / ((m : ℝ) + 2)))) x = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        have := ((hcut m).2.2.2.1 x h).2
        linarith
      rw [hcm, h0, sub_zero]
    · filter_upwards with m
      rw [hcm, Set.indicator_of_notMem hxO, sub_zero]
  have hR0 := jump_partition_div_cancel g Ω' O'' E q φ hφ hO'' h1 hE V hV1
    (fun x hx => hKO'' ⟨(hVsupp x hx).2.1, (hVsupp x hx).2.2.le⟩) c hc1 hcs hlim
  
  have hψ01 : ∀ j x, 0 ≤ φ j x ∧ φ j x ≤ 1 := fun j x =>
    ⟨hφ.2.1 j x, (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => hφ.2.1 i x) (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans
      (hφ.2.2.1 x)⟩
  simp only [calDivSum, calVolSum]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hchart (q j) (φ j) (hφ.1 j) (hφ.2.2.2 j).1
    ((hφ.2.2.2 j).2.trans Set.inter_subset_right) (hψ01 j))]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hR0, add_zero]

subgoal_signatures.name: collar_cutoff_props
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (Sig O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ)
    (t₀ a b : ℝ) (hSig : IsClosed Sig) (hO : IsOpen O) (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀})
    (hwc : ContinuousOn w O) (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ Sig → w x = 0)
    (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ Sig)) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ t₀) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
        (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ∧
        O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O, w x ≤ a →
        O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x = 1 ∧
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x, O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ≠ 0 →
        x ∈ O ∧ w x < b) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b} →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) x = 0) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, c ≤ t₀ → IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c} ∧ IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c}) ∧
      IsCompact {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b}

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.gradInner f f (Φ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff Φ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i h x * partialDeriv j h x

    have hpos : ∀ y ∈ S,
        0 ≤ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y))).det :=
      fun y hy => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p₂ _
        ((chartAt E3 p₂).map_source (hSs y hy))).det_pos.le
    have hcv := sep_density_change S hS _ hdiff hinj _ _
      (fun y hy => (sep_chart_transition g p₁ p₂ y (hSt hy) (hSs y hy)).2.1) hpos
      (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal (F ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z)))
    rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae
        (ae_of_all _ fun y => mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hF _)) hI₁.aestronglyMeasurable,
      integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae
        (ae_of_all _ fun y => mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hF _)) hI₂.aestronglyMeasurable]
    congr 1
    have e1 : ∫⁻ z in (fun y => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) '' S,
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm z).det *
          F ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z)) =
        ∫⁻ z in (fun y => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) '' S,
          ENNReal.ofReal (F ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z)) *
            ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm z).det) := by
      refine lintegral_congr fun z => ?_
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), mul_comm]
    have e2 : ∫⁻ y in S, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y).det *
          F ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) =
        ∫⁻ y in S, ENNReal.ofReal (F ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm
            (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)))) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y).det) := by
      refine setLIntegral_congr_fun hS fun y hy => ?_
      rw [(chartAt E3 p₂).left_inv (hSs y hy), ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), mul_comm]
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact hcv.symm
  
  
  have key : ∀ F0 : M → ℝ, F0 = (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) →
      ∑ k, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k,
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y).det * F0 ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y) ≤
      calVolSum g q φ E F0 := by
    intro F0 hF0
    have hF0nn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F0 x := fun x => by rw [hF0]; exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hF0z : ∀ x, x ∉ Kf → F0 x = 0 := fun x hx => by
      rw [hF0]; show Real.sqrt _ = 0; rw [hgz x hx, Real.sqrt_zero]
    have hF0c : ∀ p : M, ContinuousOn (fun y => F0 ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      intro p
      rw [hF0]
      exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn (hgradc p)
    have hφc : ∀ (p : M) (j : Fin n),
        ContinuousOn (fun y => φ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      fun p j => (hφ.1 j).continuous.comp_continuousOn (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm
    
    have hTt : ∀ k, T k ⊆ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).target := by
      intro k y hy
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := (hT k).2 hy
      exact (chartAt E3 (pp k)).map_source ((hW k).2 hw)
    have hAinv : ∀ k, ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k,
        (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y ∈ E ∧ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y ∈ W k := by
      intro k y hy
      obtain ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hyT⟩ := hy
      refine ⟨by rw [(chartAt E3 (pp k)).left_inv hx.2]; exact hx.1, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hwx⟩ := (hT k).2 hyT
      rw [← hwx, (chartAt E3 (pp k)).left_inv ((hW k).2 hw)]
      exact hw
    have hAm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k) :=
      fun k => (hE (pp k)).inter (hT k).1.measurableSet
    
    have hIakj : ∀ k j, IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y).det *
        (φ j ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y) * F0 ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y)))
        (chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k) volume := by
      intro k j
      refine intK _ (T k) _ (hT k).1 ?_ (hAm k) (fun y hy hyT => absurd hy.2 hyT)
      exact ((hsqdet (pp k)).mul ((hφc (pp k) j).mul (hF0c (pp k)))).mono (hTt k)
    
    have hIF : ∀ j, IntegrableOn (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z).det *
        (φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z) * F0 ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)))
        (chartAt E3 (q j) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source)) volume := by
      intro j
      have hsub : tsupport (φ j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source :=
        fun x hx => ((hφ.2.2.2 j).2 hx).2
      have hKc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 (q j) '' tsupport (φ j)) :=
        (hφ.2.2.2 j).1.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 (q j)).continuousOn.mono hsub)
      have hKt : chartAt E3 (q j) '' tsupport (φ j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (q j)).target := by
        rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        exact (chartAt E3 (q j)).map_source (hsub hx)
      refine intK _ _ _ hKc ?_ (hE (q j)) ?_
      · exact ((hsqdet (q j)).mul ((hφc (q j) j).mul (hF0c (q j)))).mono hKt
      · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ hz
        have hx0 : φ j x = 0 := by
          by_contra hne
          exact hz ⟨x, subset_tsupport _ hne, rfl⟩
        simp only [(chartAt E3 (q j)).left_inv hx.2, hx0, zero_mul, mul_zero]
    
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Fin m → Fin n → Set E3, U = fun k j =>
        (fun y => chartAt E3 (q j) ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y)) ''
          ((chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k) ∩
            (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hkj : ∀ k j, MeasurableSet (U k j) ∧
        U k j ⊆ chartAt E3 (q j) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) ∧
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k,
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y).det *
            (φ j ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y) * F0 ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y)) =
        ∫ z in U k j, Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z).det *
          (φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z) * F0 ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) := by
      intro k j
      have ho : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).target ∩
          (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) :=
        (chartAt E3 (pp k)).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage
          (chartAt E3 (pp k)).open_target (chartAt E3 (q j)).open_source
      have hSeq : (chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k) ∩
            (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (q j)).source =
          (chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k) ∩
            ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).target ∩
              (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hyA, hy⟩
          exact ⟨hyA, hTt k hyA.2, hy⟩
        · rintro ⟨hyA, -, hy⟩
          exact ⟨hyA, hy⟩
      have hSm : MeasurableSet ((chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k) ∩
          (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) := by
        rw [hSeq]
        exact (hAm k).inter ho.measurableSet
      have hUR : (fun y => chartAt E3 (q j) ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y)) ''
          ((chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k) ∩
            (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) ⊆
          chartAt E3 (q j) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) := by
        rintro _ ⟨y, ⟨hyA, hys⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨_, ⟨(hAinv k y hyA).1, hys⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨hmU, hEq⟩ := pairEq (pp k) (q j) _ hSm
        (fun y hy => hTt k hy.1.2) (fun y hy => hy.2) (fun x => φ j x * F0 x)
        (fun x => mul_nonneg (hφ.2.1 j x) (hF0nn x))
        ((hIakj k j).mono_set Set.inter_subset_left) ((hIF j).mono_set hUR)
      have hrestr := setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (μ := volume)
        (f := fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y).det *
            (φ j ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y) * F0 ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y)))
        (hAm k) (Set.inter_subset_left (t := (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (q j)).source))
        (by
          intro y hy
          have hx0 : φ j ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y) = 0 := by
            by_contra hne
            exact hy.2 ⟨hy.1, ((hφ.2.2.2 j).2 (subset_tsupport _ hne)).2⟩
          simp only [hx0, zero_mul, mul_zero])
      refine ⟨by rw [hU]; exact hmU, by rw [hU]; exact hUR, ?_⟩
      rw [hrestr, hU]
      exact hEq
    have hUd : ∀ j, Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (U k j) (U l j)) := by
      intro j k l hkl
      simp only [hU]
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      rintro _ ⟨y, ⟨hyA, hys⟩, rfl⟩ ⟨y', ⟨hyA', hys'⟩, hyy⟩
      have hxx : (chartAt E3 (pp l)).symm y' = (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y :=
        (chartAt E3 (q j)).injOn hys' hys hyy
      have hl := (hAinv l y' hyA').2
      rw [hxx] at hl
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hWd hkl) (hAinv k y hyA).2 hl
    
    have hk : ∀ k, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k,
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y).det * F0 ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y) =
        ∑ j, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k,
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y).det *
            (φ j ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y) * F0 ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y)) := by
      intro k
      rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hIakj k j)]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun (hAm k) fun y _ => ?_
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      by_cases hx : (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y ∈ Kf
      · rw [h1 _ (hKfO hx), one_mul]
      · rw [hF0z _ hx, mul_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    calc ∑ k, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k,
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y).det * F0 ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y)
        = ∑ k, ∑ j, ∫ z in U k j, Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z).det *
            (φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z) * F0 ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
          rw [hk k]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => (hkj k j).2.2
      _ = ∑ j, ∑ k, ∫ z in U k j, Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z).det *
            (φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z) * F0 ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) :=
          Finset.sum_comm
      _ ≤ ∑ j, ∫ z in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z).det *
              (φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z) * F0 ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
          exact famle (fun k => U k j) _ _ (fun k => (hkj k j).1) (fun k => (hkj k j).2.1)
            (hUd j) (hE (q j))
            (fun z _ => mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (hφ.2.1 j _) (hF0nn _)))
            (hIF j)
      _ = calVolSum g q φ E F0 := by
          unfold calVolSum
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
          congr 1
          funext z
          ring
  exact key _ rfl

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.gradInner f f (Φ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff Φ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i h x * partialDeriv j h x

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: sep_chart_transition
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p₁ p₂ : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₁).target)
    (hy₂ : (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₂).source) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) ∧
    (∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y = ∑ a : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z))
            (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)))

subgoal_signatures.name: sep_density_change
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(s : Set E3) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (τ : E3 → E3)
    (hτ : ∀ y ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y) (hinj : Set.InjOn τ s)
    (G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hlaw : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 3, G₁ y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a * G₂ (τ y) a b * fderiv ℝ τ y (e j) b)
    (hpos : ∀ y ∈ s, 0 ≤ (G₂ (τ y)).det) (ψ : E3 → ENNReal) :
    ∫⁻ z in τ '' s, ψ z * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (G₂ z).det) =
      ∫⁻ y in s, ψ (τ y) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (G₁ y).det)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig E O W : Set M) (w χ : M → ℝ) (p : M) (t ε c C : ℝ) (hE : IsOpen E)
    (hfr : frontier E = Sig) (hO : IsOpen O) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hWs : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source) (hct : c < t) (hC₁ : IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c})
    (hCt : IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t + ε}) (hχ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ χ)
    (hχ01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1)
    (hχ1 : ∀ x ∈ O, w x ≤ t → χ x = 1 ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) χ x = 0)
    (hχ0 : ∀ x, χ x ≠ 0 → x ∈ O ∧ w x < t + ε) (Y : E3 → E3)
    (hY : (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) ∧
      HasCompactSupport Y ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ chartAt E3 p '' W ∧
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1))
    (hYC : ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) Y y| ≤ C) :
    ((∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) →
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => (1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) • Y z) y) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun z => (1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) • Y z) ∧
      tsupport (fun z => (1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) • Y z) ⊆
        chartAt E3 p '' (W \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c}) ∧
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j *
        ((1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) • Y y) i *
        ((1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) • Y y) j ≤ 1) ∧
      ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (fun z => (1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) • Y z) y| ≤ C') ∧
    ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((E \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) Y y ≤
      (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
          (fun z => (1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) • Y z) y) +
      C * (volume (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ {x | x ∈ O ∧ t < w x ∧ w x < t + ε} ∩
        (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ tsupport Y)).toReal +
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩ tsupport Y,
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
          Real.sqrt (g.gradInner χ χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))

signature.name: collar_member_split
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig E O W : Set M) (w χ : M → ℝ) (p : M) (t ε c C : ℝ) (hE : IsOpen E)
    (hfr : frontier E = Sig) (hO : IsOpen O) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hWs : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source) (hct : c < t) (hC₁ : IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c})
    (hCt : IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t + ε}) (hχ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ χ)
    (hχ01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1)
    (hχ1 : ∀ x ∈ O, w x ≤ t → χ x = 1 ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) χ x = 0)
    (hχ0 : ∀ x, χ x ≠ 0 → x ∈ O ∧ w x < t + ε) (Y : E3 → E3)
    (hY : (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) ∧
      HasCompactSupport Y ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ chartAt E3 p '' W ∧
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1))
    (hYC : ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) Y y| ≤ C) :
    ((∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) →
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => (1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) • Y z) y) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun z => (1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) • Y z) ∧
      tsupport (fun z => (1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) • Y z) ⊆
        chartAt E3 p '' (W \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c}) ∧
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j *
        ((1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) • Y y) i *
        ((1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) • Y y) j ≤ 1) ∧
      ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (fun z => (1 - χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) • Y z) y| ≤ C') ∧
    ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((E \ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) Y y ≤
      (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),

      have h2 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one ((w x - α) / (β - α))

    intro α β hαβ x hx

subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig E O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (t₀ a b : ℝ) (hE : IsOpen E) (hfr : frontier E = Sig) (hO : IsOpen O) (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀}) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O) (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ Sig → w x = 0) (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ Sig)) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (hbd : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, w x ≤ t₀ → g.gradInner w w x ≤ C ∧ |g.levelMeanCurv w x| ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ t₀) (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (q : M) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det) (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (W₀ : Set E3) (hW₀ : IsOpen W₀)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) W₀)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W₀, (G y).PosDef) (k : ℕ) (φ : Fin k → E3 → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) W₀) (hdφ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ W₀, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0)
    (V K' E : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) (hVW : V ⊆ W₀) (hK' : IsCompact K') (hK'V : K' ⊆ V)
    (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hEK : ∀ z ∈ E, z ∈ W₀ → (∃ i, φ i z ≤ 0) → z ∈ K')
    (hcal : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ K', φ i z ≤ 0 → sepDensDiv G (hcrNormalField G (φ i)) z ≤ 0)
    (X : E3 → E3) (hXs : ∀ z ∈ W₀, (∀ i, 0 < φ i z) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X z)
    (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) (hXV : tsupport X ⊆ V)
    (hXn : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1)

    ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ {z | z ∈ W₀ ∧ ∀ i, 0 < φ i z}, sepDensDiv G X y) ≤
      sepPerG G E V

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨T, χ, hTc, hTW, hTV, hχs, hχ0, hχ1, hχT, hXT, hχX, hχK⟩ :
      ∃ (T : Set E3) (χ : E3 → ℝ), IsCompact T ∧ T ⊆ W₀ ∧ T ⊆ V ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ ∧
        (∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y) ∧ (∀ y, χ y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y, y ∉ T → χ y = 0) ∧
        (∀ y, y ∉ T → X y = 0) ∧ (∀ y ∈ tsupport X, χ y = 1) ∧
        (∀ z ∈ K', ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, χ y = 1) := by
    have hT₀c : IsCompact (tsupport X ∪ K') := hXc.isCompact.union hK'
    have hT₀V : tsupport X ∪ K' ⊆ V := Set.union_subset hXV hK'V
    obtain ⟨O, hO, hT₀O, hOV, hOc⟩ := exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hT₀c hV hT₀V
    have hT₀O' : tsupport X ∪ K' ⊆ interior O := by rw [hO.interior_eq]; exact hT₀O
    obtain ⟨f, hf1, hf0, hf01⟩ := exists_contMDiffMap_one_nhds_of_subset_interior 𝓘(ℝ, E3)
      (n := ⊤) hT₀c.isClosed hT₀O'
    refine ⟨closure O, ⇑f, hOc, hOV.trans hVW, hOV, contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp f.contMDiff,
      fun y => (hf01 y).1, fun y => (hf01 y).2,
      fun y hy => hf0 y (fun h => hy (subset_closure h)),
      fun y hy => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
        (fun h => hy (subset_closure (hT₀O (Or.inl h)))),
      fun y hy => hf1.self_of_nhdsSet y (Or.inl hy),
      fun z hz => hf1.filter_mono (nhds_le_nhdsSet (Set.mem_union_right (tsupport X) hz))⟩
  
  have hNall : ∀ i : Fin k,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hcrNormalField G (φ i)) W₀ ∧
      (∀ y ∈ W₀, ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 →
          |fderiv ℝ (φ i) y w| ≤ fderiv ℝ (φ i) y (hcrNormalField G (φ i) y)) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          G y a b * hcrNormalField G (φ i) y a * hcrNormalField G (φ i) y b ≤ 1) := by
    intro i
    have hu := sfr_normal_unit G W₀ hpd (φ i) (hdφ i)
    obtain ⟨_, hc2, hc3⟩ := ccs_normal_props G (φ i) W₀ hW₀ hG hpd (hφ i)
      (hcrNormalField G (φ i)) (fun z _ a => rfl)
    exact ⟨hc2.mono (fun y hy => ⟨hy, (hu y hy).1⟩),
      fun y hy w hw => hc3 y hy (hu y hy).1 w hw, fun y hy => (hu y hy).2.le⟩
  
  have F0 : ∀ W : E3 → E3, (∀ y, y ∉ T → W y = 0) → ∀ z, z ∉ T → sepDensDiv G W z = 0 := by
    intro W hW z hz
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    unfold partialDeriv
    have hev : (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * W y i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hTc.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hz] with y hy
      rw [hW y hy]
      simp
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have F2 : ∀ W : E3 → E3, Measurable (sepDensDiv G W) := by
    intro W
    show Measurable (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W z i) y (e i))
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ _ _
  
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : ℕ → Set E3, ∀ j z,
      z ∈ R j ↔ (z ∈ W₀ ∧ ∀ i : Fin k, j ≤ (i : ℕ) → 0 < φ i z) :=
    ⟨fun j => {z | z ∈ W₀ ∧ ∀ i : Fin k, j ≤ (i : ℕ) → 0 < φ i z}, fun _ _ => Iff.rfl⟩
  have hRW : ∀ j, R j ⊆ W₀ := fun j z hz => ((hR j z).1 hz).1
  have hRo : ∀ j, IsOpen (R j) := by
    intro j
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hzW, hzφ⟩ := (hR j z).1 hz
    have h1 : ∀ i : Fin k, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, j ≤ (i : ℕ) → 0 < φ i y := by
      intro i
      by_cases hji : j ≤ (i : ℕ)
      · have hc : ContinuousAt (φ i) z := (hφ i).continuousOn.continuousAt (hW₀.mem_nhds hzW)
        filter_upwards [hc.tendsto.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (hzφ i hji))] with y hy
        exact fun _ => hy
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y h => absurd h hji
    filter_upwards [hW₀.mem_nhds hzW, Filter.eventually_all.2 h1] with y hy1 hy2
    exact (hR j y).2 ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
  have hRm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (R j) := fun j => (hRo j).measurableSet
  have hR0 : E ∩ {z | z ∈ W₀ ∧ ∀ i, 0 < φ i z} = E ∩ R 0 := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hR]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      exact ⟨h1, h2, fun i _ => h3 i⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      exact ⟨h1, h2, fun i => h3 i (Nat.zero_le _)⟩
  have hRk : ∀ z, z ∈ R k ↔ z ∈ W₀ := by
    intro z
    rw [hR]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, fun i hi => absurd i.isLt (not_lt.2 hi)⟩⟩
  have hRsucc : ∀ j (hj : j < k), ∀ z, z ∈ R j ↔ (z ∈ R (j + 1) ∧ 0 < φ ⟨j, hj⟩ z) := by
    intro j hj z
    rw [hR, hR]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      exact ⟨⟨h1, fun i hi => h2 i (by omega)⟩, h2 ⟨j, hj⟩ le_rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩
      refine ⟨h1, fun i hi => ?_⟩
      rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hi with h | h
      · have hi' : i = ⟨j, hj⟩ := Fin.ext h.symm
        rw [hi']
        exact h3
      · exact h2 i h
  
  apply ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε _
  obtain ⟨η, hηdef⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, η = (ε : ℝ) / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hη : 0 < η := by
    rw [hηdef]
    exact div_pos (by exact_mod_cast hε) (by positivity)
  
  have key : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ k → ∃ Z : E3 → E3,
      (∀ z ∈ R j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Z z) ∧ (∀ y, y ∉ T → Z y = 0) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * Z y a * Z y b ≤ χ y ^ 2) ∧
      (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ R j, |sepDensDiv G Z z| ≤ C) ∧
      ∫ y in E ∩ {z | z ∈ W₀ ∧ ∀ i, 0 < φ i z}, sepDensDiv G X y ≤
        (∫ y in E ∩ R j, sepDensDiv G Z y) + (j : ℝ) * η := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro _
      refine ⟨X, fun z hz => ?_, hXT, fun y hy => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (hR 0 z).1 hz
        exact hXs z h1 fun i => h2 i (Nat.zero_le _)
      · by_cases hyX : y ∈ tsupport X
        · rw [hχX y hyX, one_pow]
          exact hXn y
        · have h0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hyX
          calc ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * X y a * X y b = (0 : ℝ) := by simp [h0]
            _ ≤ χ y ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hXd
        refine ⟨C, fun z hz => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (hR 0 z).1 hz
        exact hC z h1 fun i => h2 i (Nat.zero_le _)
      · rw [hR0]
        simp
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj1
      have hj : j < k := by omega
      obtain ⟨Z, hZ1, hZ2, hZ3, ⟨CZ, hZ4⟩, hZ5⟩ := ih (by omega)
      obtain ⟨hN, hNcs, hN1⟩ := hNall ⟨j, hj⟩
      have hSW : R (j + 1) ⊆ W₀ := hRW (j + 1)
      have hYs : ∀ z ∈ R (j + 1), 0 < φ ⟨j, hj⟩ z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Z z :=
        fun z hz hp => hZ1 z ((hRsucc j hj z).2 ⟨hz, hp⟩)
      have hYd : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ R (j + 1), 0 < φ ⟨j, hj⟩ z → |sepDensDiv G Z z| ≤ C :=
        ⟨CZ, fun z hz hp => hZ4 z ((hRsucc j hj z).2 ⟨hz, hp⟩)⟩
      obtain ⟨⟨Cg, hCg⟩, hg0, hτ⟩ := sfr_wall_field_div G W₀ hW₀ hG hpd (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) (hφ _)
        hN hNcs χ hχs hχ0 hχ1 T hTc hTW hχT (R (j + 1)) hSW Z hYs hZ3 hYd
      have hreg : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
          (∀ z ∈ R (j + 1), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (sfrWall G (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) χ τ Z) z) ∧
          (∀ y, y ∉ T → sfrWall G (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) χ τ Z y = 0) ∧
          (∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            G y a b * sfrWall G (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) χ τ Z y a * sfrWall G (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) χ τ Z y b
              ≤ χ y ^ 2) :=
        fun τ hτ0 => sfr_wall_field_regular G W₀ hW₀ hpd (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) (hφ _) hN hN1 χ hχs
          hχ0 hχ1 T hχT (R (j + 1)) hSW Z hYs hZ2 hZ3 τ hτ0
      have hA : MeasurableSet (E ∩ R j) := hE.inter (hRm j)
      have hB : MeasurableSet (E ∩ R (j + 1)) := hE.inter (hRm (j + 1))
      have hAB : E ∩ R j ⊆ E ∩ R (j + 1) := fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, ((hRsucc j hj z).1 hz.2).1⟩
      have hφm : AEStronglyMeasurable (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) (volume.restrict (E ∩ R j)) :=
        ((hφ ⟨j, hj⟩).continuousOn.aestronglyMeasurable hW₀.measurableSet).mono_measure
          (Measure.restrict_mono (fun z hz => hRW j hz.2) le_rfl)
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ0, hint⟩ := sfr_wall_limit (E ∩ R j) (E ∩ R (j + 1)) T hA hB hAB hTc
        (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) hφm
        (fun z hz => ((hRsucc j hj z).1 hz.2).2)
        (sepDensDiv G Z) (sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) y))
        (fun τ => sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) χ τ Z))
        (F2 _).aestronglyMeasurable (F2 _).aestronglyMeasurable
        (fun τ _ => (F2 _).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (max CZ Cg)
        (fun z hz => (hZ4 z hz.2).trans (le_max_left _ _))
        (fun z _ => (hCg z).trans (le_max_right _ _))
        (fun τ hτ0 => by
          obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := (hτ τ hτ0).1
          exact ⟨C', fun z hz => hC' z hz.2⟩)
        (fun z _ hzT => F0 Z hZ2 z hzT)
        (fun z _ hzT => hg0 z hzT)
        (fun τ hτ0 z _ hzT => F0 _ (hreg τ hτ0).2.1 z hzT)
        (fun τ hτ0 z hz =>
          (hτ τ hτ0).2.1 z ((hRsucc j hj z).1 hz.2).1 ((hRsucc j hj z).1 hz.2).2)
        (fun τ hτ0 z hzB hzA => by
          have hzS := hzB.2
          have hnot : ¬ 0 < φ ⟨j, hj⟩ z :=
            fun hp => hzA ⟨hzB.1, (hRsucc j hj z).2 ⟨hzS, hp⟩⟩
          have hle : φ ⟨j, hj⟩ z ≤ 0 := not_lt.1 hnot
          have hzK : z ∈ K' := hEK z hzB.1 (hSW hzS) ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, hle⟩
          show 0 ≤ sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) χ τ Z) z
          rw [(hτ τ hτ0).2.2 z hzS hle (hχK z hzK)]
          linarith [hcal ⟨j, hj⟩ z hzK hle])
        η hη
      refine ⟨sfrWall G (φ ⟨j, hj⟩) χ τ Z, (hreg τ hτ0).1, (hreg τ hτ0).2.1,
        (hreg τ hτ0).2.2, (hτ τ hτ0).1, ?_⟩
      push_cast
      linarith
  
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ1, hZ2, hZ3, _, hZ5⟩ := key k le_rfl
  have hZs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Z := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ W₀
    · exact hZ1 z ((hRk z).2 hz)
    · have hzT : z ∉ T := fun h => hz (hTW h)
      have hev : Z =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
        filter_upwards [hTc.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hzT] with y hy
        exact hZ2 y hy
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hZsupp : Function.support Z ⊆ T := fun y hy => by
    by_contra h
    exact hy (hZ2 y h)
  have hZc : HasCompactSupport Z := HasCompactSupport.intro hTc hZ2
  have hZt : tsupport Z ⊆ V := (closure_minimal hZsupp hTc.isClosed).trans hTV
  have hZn : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Z y i * Z y j ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ W₀
    · have h1 := hZ3 y hy
      have h2 : χ y ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [hχ0 y, hχ1 y]
      linarith
    · have h0 : Z y = 0 := hZ2 y (fun h => hy (hTW h))
      simp [h0]
  have hper : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G Z y) ≤ sepPerG G E V := by
    unfold sepPerG
    exact le_iSup_of_le Z (le_iSup_of_le ⟨hZs, hZc, hZt, hZn⟩ le_rfl)
  have heq : ∫ y in E ∩ R k, sepDensDiv G Z y = ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G Z y := by
    symm
    refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hE Set.inter_subset_left ?_
    intro z hz
    have hzW : z ∉ W₀ := fun h => hz.2 ⟨hz.1, (hRk z).2 h⟩
    exact F0 Z hZ2 z (fun h => hzW (hTW h))
  rw [heq] at hZ5
  have hkη : (k : ℝ) * η ≤ ε := by
    rw [hηdef, mul_div_assoc', div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [ε.coe_nonneg]
  calc ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ {z | z ∈ W₀ ∧ ∀ i, 0 < φ i z}, sepDensDiv G X y)
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G Z y) + (k : ℝ) * η) :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hZ5
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G Z y) + ENNReal.ofReal ((k : ℝ) * η) :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_add_le
    _ ≤ sepPerG G E V + (ε : ENNReal) := by
        refine add_le_add hper ?_
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hkη

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_normal_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) : IsOpen {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z → ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 → |fderiv ℝ f z w| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (X z)

subgoal_signatures.name: sfr_normal_unit
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (W₀ : Set E3)

subgoal_signatures.name: sfr_wall_field_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (W₀ : Set E3)
    (hW₀ : IsOpen W₀) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W₀, (G y).PosDef) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ W₀)
    (hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hcrNormalField G φ) W₀)
    (hN1 : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      G y a b * hcrNormalField G φ y a * hcrNormalField G φ y b ≤ 1)
    (χ : E3 → ℝ) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (hχ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y) (hχ1 : ∀ y, χ y ≤ 1)
    (T : Set E3) (hχT : ∀ y, y ∉ T → χ y = 0)
    (S : Set E3) (hSW : S ⊆ W₀)
    (Y : E3 → E3) (hYs : ∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y z)
    (hYT : ∀ y, y ∉ T → Y y = 0)
    (hYn : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * Y y a * Y y b ≤ χ y ^ 2)
    (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    (∀ z ∈ S, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z) ∧
    (∀ y, y ∉ T → sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y = 0) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      G y a b * sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y a * sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y b ≤ χ y ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: sfr_wall_field_div
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (W₀ : Set E3) (hW₀ : IsOpen W₀)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) W₀)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W₀, (G y).PosDef) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ W₀)
    (hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hcrNormalField G φ) W₀)
    (hNcs : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 →
      |fderiv ℝ φ y w| ≤ fderiv ℝ φ y (hcrNormalField G φ y))
    (χ : E3 → ℝ) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (hχ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y) (hχ1 : ∀ y, χ y ≤ 1)
    (T : Set E3) (hT : IsCompact T) (hTW : T ⊆ W₀) (hχT : ∀ y, y ∉ T → χ y = 0)
    (S : Set E3) (hSW : S ⊆ W₀)
    (Y : E3 → E3) (hYs : ∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y z)
    (hYn : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * Y y a * Y y b ≤ χ y ^ 2)
    (hYd : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z → |sepDensDiv G Y z| ≤ C) :
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, |sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z| ≤ C) ∧
    (∀ z, z ∉ T → sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z = 0) ∧
    ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
      (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, |sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z| ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z →
        sfrTheta φ τ z * sepDensDiv G Y z -
            (1 - sfrTheta φ τ z) * sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z ≤
          sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ S, φ z ≤ 0 → (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, χ y = 1) →
        sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z = -sepDensDiv G (hcrNormalField G φ) z)

subgoal_signatures.name: sfr_wall_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A B T : Set E3) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (hAB : A ⊆ B) (hT : IsCompact T) (φ : E3 → ℝ)
    (hφm : AEStronglyMeasurable φ (volume.restrict A)) (hφA : ∀ z ∈ A, 0 < φ z)
    (f g : E3 → ℝ) (F : ℝ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict A))
    (hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable g (volume.restrict A))
    (hFm : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → AEStronglyMeasurable (F τ) (volume.restrict B))
    (C : ℝ) (hfC : ∀ z ∈ A, |f z| ≤ C) (hgC : ∀ z ∈ A, |g z| ≤ C)
    (hFC : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ B, |F τ z| ≤ C')
    (hfT : ∀ z ∈ A, z ∉ T → f z = 0) (hgT : ∀ z ∈ A, z ∉ T → g z = 0)
    (hFT : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ B, z ∉ T → F τ z = 0)
    (hpos : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ A,
      sfrTheta φ τ z * f z - (1 - sfrTheta φ τ z) * g z ≤ F τ z)
    (hneg : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ B, z ∉ A → 0 ≤ F τ z)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ ∫ z in A, f z ≤ (∫ z in B, F τ z) + η

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (B : Set E3) (hB : IsOpen B)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) B)

    (Kc : Set E3) (hKc : ∀ z ∈ B, (∃ i, φ i z = 0) → z ∈ Kc)
