proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hDo : ∀ s : Fin k → Bool, IsOpen (hspSector B φ s) := by
    intro s
    have e : hspSector B φ s =
        B ∩ ⋂ i, (B ∩ (fun z => (if s i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * φ i z) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) := by
      ext z
      simp only [hspSector, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter,
        Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioi]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, fun i => ⟨h1, h2 i⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, fun i => (h2 i).2⟩
    rw [e]
    refine hB.inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i => ?_)
    exact (continuousOn_const.mul (hφ i).continuousOn).isOpen_inter_preimage hB isOpen_Ioi
  
  have hDdisj : ∀ s t : Fin k → Bool, s ≠ t → ∀ z, z ∈ hspSector B φ s →
      z ∉ hspSector B φ t := by
    intro s t hst z hzs hzt
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, s i ≠ t i := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      exact hst (funext h)
    have h1 := hzs.2 i
    have h2 := hzt.2 i
    cases hs : s i <;> cases ht : t i <;> rw [hs, ht] at hi <;>
      simp only [hs, ht, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h1 h2 <;>
      first | exact hi rfl | linarith
  
  have hDcov : ∀ z ∈ B, (∀ i, φ i z ≠ 0) →
      z ∈ hspSector B φ (fun i => decide (0 < φ i z)) := by
    intro z hz h0
    refine ⟨hz, fun i => ?_⟩
    by_cases hp : 0 < φ i z
    · have hd : decide (0 < φ i z) = true := decide_eq_true hp
      simp only [hd, ↓reduceIte, one_mul]
      exact hp
    · have hd : decide (0 < φ i z) = false := decide_eq_false hp
      have hn : φ i z < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.1 hp) (h0 i)
      simp only [hd, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      linarith
  
  have c1 : ∀ (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      (∀ z ∈ U, fderiv ℝ f z ≠ 0) → volume (U ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}) = 0 := by
    intro U hU f hf hdf
    have hfd : ∀ z ∈ U, HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f z) z := fun z hz =>
      (((hf.differentiableOn (by simp)) z hz).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).hasFDerivAt
    refine measure_null_of_locally_null _ fun x hx => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f x (e a) ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      apply hdf x hx.1
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.coe_injective
      refine (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext fun i => ?_
      simpa using hcon i
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e a)) U :=
      (hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hVo : IsOpen (U ∩ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e a)) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) :=
      hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hU isOpen_compl_singleton
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεV⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hVo x ⟨hx.1, ha⟩
    set δ := ε / 2 with hδdef
    have hδ : 0 < δ := by positivity
    have hδV : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x δ, z ∈ U ∧ fderiv ℝ f z (e a) ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hz' : z ∈ Metric.ball x ε := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
        rw [Metric.mem_ball]
        linarith
      exact ⟨(hεV hz').1, (hεV hz').2⟩
    refine ⟨Metric.closedBall x δ ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine mem_nhdsWithin.2 ⟨Metric.ball x δ, Metric.isOpen_ball, Metric.mem_ball_self hδ,
        fun z hz => ⟨Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz.1, hz.2.2⟩⟩
    
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛdef⟩ : ∃ Λ : E3 → E3,
        Λ = fun z => z + (f z - EuclideanSpace.proj a z) • e a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ'def⟩ : ∃ Λ' : E3 → (E3 →L[ℝ] E3), Λ' = fun z =>
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 +
          (fderiv ℝ f z - (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)).smulRight (e a) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΛd : ∀ z ∈ U, HasFDerivAt Λ (Λ' z) z := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hΛdef, hΛ'def]
      exact (hasFDerivAt_id z).add
        (((hfd z hz).sub (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt).smul_const (e a))
    have hΛ'inj : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x δ, Function.Injective (Λ' z) := by
      intro z hz
      rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
      intro v hv
      have hcoord : ∀ b : Fin 3, v b + (fderiv ℝ f z v - v a) * (if b = a then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
        intro b
        have h := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w b) hv
        simpa [hΛ'def, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h
      have hvb : ∀ b, b ≠ a → v b = 0 := by
        intro b hb
        simpa [hb] using hcoord b
      have hfv : fderiv ℝ f z v = 0 := by
        simpa using hcoord a
      have hvrep : v = v a • e a := by
        ext b
        by_cases hb : b = a
        · subst hb; simp
        · simp [hb, hvb b hb, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      have hva : v a = 0 := by
        rw [hvrep, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hfv
        rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hfv with h | h
        · simpa using h
        · exact absurd h (hδV z hz).2
      rw [hvrep, hva, zero_smul]
    have hdet : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x δ, (Λ' z).det ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hu : IsUnit (Λ' z : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) := by
        rw [LinearMap.isUnit_iff_ker_eq_bot]
        exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.2 (hΛ'inj z hz)
      exact (LinearMap.isUnit_det _ hu).ne_zero
    
    have hline : ∀ z : E3, ∀ t : ℝ, z + t • e a ∈ U →
        HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (z + s • e a)) (fderiv ℝ f (z + t • e a) (e a)) t := by
      intro z t hzt
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => z + s • e a) (e a) t := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (e a)).const_add z
      exact (hfd _ hzt).comp_hasDerivAt t hl
    
    have hlt : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x δ ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}, ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall x δ ∩ f ⁻¹' {0},
        Λ z = Λ w → ¬ z a < w a := by
      intro z hz w hw hzw hlt'
      have hfz : f z = 0 := hz.2
      have hfw : f w = 0 := hw.2
      set τ := w a - z a with hτ
      have hτpos : 0 < τ := by rw [hτ]; linarith
      have hwz : w = z + τ • e a := by
        have h := hzw
        rw [hΛdef] at h
        simp only [hfz, hfw] at h
        ext b
        have hb := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u b) h
        by_cases hba : b = a
        · subst hba
          simp [hτ]
        · simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hba] at hb ⊢
          linarith
      have hmem : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 τ, z + t • e a ∈ Metric.closedBall x δ := by
        intro t ht
        have h1 : z + (t / τ) • (w - z) ∈ Metric.closedBall x δ :=
          (convex_closedBall x δ).add_smul_sub_mem hz.1 hw.1
            ⟨div_nonneg ht.1 hτpos.le, (div_le_one hτpos).2 ht.2⟩
        have h2 : (t / τ) • (w - z) = t • e a := by
          rw [hwz, add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hτpos.ne']
        rwa [h2] at h1
      have hgc : ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => f (z + s • e a)) (Set.Icc 0 τ) := fun t ht =>
        (hline z t (hδV _ (hmem t ht)).1).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      have hg0 : (fun s : ℝ => f (z + s • e a)) 0 = (fun s : ℝ => f (z + s • e a)) τ := by
        simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
        rw [hfz, ← hwz, hfw]
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero hτpos hgc hg0
        fun t ht => hline z t (hδV _ (hmem t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht))).1
      exact (hδV _ (hmem c (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hc))).2 hc0
    have hinj : Set.InjOn Λ (Metric.closedBall x δ ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}) := by
      intro z hz w hw hzw
      have h1 := hlt z hz w hw hzw
      have h2 := hlt w hw z hz hzw.symm
      have hza : z a = w a := le_antisymm (not_lt.1 h2) (not_lt.1 h1)
      have hfz : f z = 0 := hz.2
      have hfw : f w = 0 := hw.2
      have h := hzw
      rw [hΛdef] at h
      simp only [hfz, hfw] at h
      ext b
      have hb := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u b) h
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hza] at hb
      exact hb
    
    have hS₀m : MeasurableSet (Metric.closedBall x δ ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}) :=
      ((hf.continuousOn.mono fun z hz => (hδV z hz).1).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed
        Metric.isClosed_closedBall isClosed_singleton).measurableSet
    have hcov := lintegral_abs_det_fderiv_eq_addHaar_image volume hS₀m
      (fun z hz => (hΛd z (hδV z hz.1).1).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hinj
    have himg : volume (Λ '' (Metric.closedBall x δ ∩ f ⁻¹' {0})) = 0 := by
      have hP : LinearMap.ker ((EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) ≠ ⊤ := by
        intro htop
        have : e a ∈ LinearMap.ker ((EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) := by
          rw [htop]; exact Submodule.mem_top
        simp at this
      refine measure_mono_null ?_ (Measure.addHaar_submodule volume _ hP)
      rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      have hfz : f z = 0 := hz.2
      simp [hΛdef, hfz]
    rw [himg] at hcov
    have hmeas : AEMeasurable (fun z => ENNReal.ofReal |(fderiv ℝ Λ z).det|)
        (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall x δ ∩ f ⁻¹' {0})) :=
      (ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp (continuous_abs.measurable.comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.continuous_det.measurable.comp (measurable_fderiv ℝ Λ)))).aemeasurable
    have hae := (lintegral_eq_zero_iff' hmeas).1 hcov
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, ae_restrict_iff' hS₀m] at hae
    rw [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem]
    filter_upwards [hae] with z hz hzS
    have h1 := hz hzS
    rw [(hΛd z (hδV z hzS.1).1).fderiv] at h1
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero] at h1
    exact hdet z hzS.1 (abs_nonpos_iff.1 h1)
  
  have hnull : volume {z | z ∈ B ∧ ∃ i, φ i z = 0} = 0 := by
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_iUnion_null fun i =>
      c1 B hB (φ i) (hφ i) (hdφ i))
    rintro z ⟨hz, i, hi⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, hz, hi⟩
  
  have hdiv_congr : ∀ (X₁ X₂ : E3 → E3) (y : E3), X₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] X₂ →
      sepDensDiv G X₁ y = sepDensDiv G X₂ y := by
    intro X₁ X₂ y h
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have h' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X₁ z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X₂ z i) := h.mono fun z hz => by simp only [hz]
    rw [h'.fderiv_eq]
  have hdiv0 : ∀ y, sepDensDiv G 0 y = 0 := by
    intro y
    simp [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
  
  have hdetB : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) B := by
    have e : (fun z => (G z).det) = fun z =>
        G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
          - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
          + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0 :=
      funext fun z => Matrix.det_fin_three _
    rw [e]
    have a1 := ((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 2)
    have a2 := ((hG 0 0).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 1)
    have a3 := ((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 2)
    have a4 := ((hG 0 1).mul (hG 1 2)).mul (hG 2 0)
    have a5 := ((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 0)).mul (hG 2 1)
    have a6 := ((hG 0 2).mul (hG 1 1)).mul (hG 2 0)
    exact ((((a1.sub a2).sub a3).add a4).add a5).sub a6
  
  have c2 : ∀ (h : (Fin k → Bool) → E3 → ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (M : ℝ), 0 ≤ M →
      (∀ j, Differentiable ℝ (h j)) → (∀ j z, ‖fderiv ℝ (h j) z‖ ≤ M) →
      (∀ z, f z = 0 ∨ ∃ j, f z = h j z) → ∀ y v : E3, |fderiv ℝ f y v| ≤ M * ‖v‖ := by
    intro h f M hM0 hh hM hsel y v
    by_cases hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f y
    swap
    · rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hd]
      simpa using mul_nonneg hM0 (norm_nonneg v)
    obtain ⟨H, hHdef⟩ : ∃ H : Option (Fin k → Bool) → E3 → ℝ,
        H = fun o => o.elim (fun _ => 0) h := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hHd : ∀ o, Differentiable ℝ (H o) := by
      intro o
      cases o with
      | none => simp only [hHdef, Option.elim]; exact differentiable_const 0
      | some j => simp only [hHdef, Option.elim]; exact hh j
    have hHsel : ∀ z, ∃ o, f z = H o z := by
      intro z
      rcases hsel z with h0 | ⟨j, hj⟩
      · exact ⟨none, by simp only [hHdef, Option.elim]; exact h0⟩
      · exact ⟨some j, by simp only [hHdef, Option.elim]; exact hj⟩
    have hHb : ∀ o, |fderiv ℝ (H o) y v| ≤ M * ‖v‖ := by
      intro o
      cases o with
      | none =>
        simp only [hHdef, Option.elim]
        simp [mul_nonneg hM0 (norm_nonneg v)]
      | some j =>
        simp only [hHdef, Option.elim]
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM j y) (norm_nonneg v))
    have hl : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y + t • v) v 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const v).const_add y
    have hl0 : y = (fun t : ℝ => y + t • v) 0 := by simp
    have hF : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (y + t • v)) (fderiv ℝ f y v) 0 :=
      hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hl hl0
    have hHo : ∀ o, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => H o (y + t • v)) (fderiv ℝ (H o) y v) 0 :=
      fun o => ((hHd o) y).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hl hl0
    obtain ⟨o, hfreq⟩ : ∃ o, ∃ᶠ t in 𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ), f (y + t • v) = H o (y + t • v) := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have hall : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ), ∀ o, f (y + t • v) ≠ H o (y + t • v) :=
        Filter.eventually_all.2 hcon
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hall.exists
      obtain ⟨o, ho⟩ := hHsel (y + t • v)
      exact ht o ho
    have hbase : f y = H o y := by
      have h1 := tendsto_nhds_unique_of_frequently_eq
        (hF.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
        ((hHo o).continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds) hfreq
      simpa using h1
    have heq : fderiv ℝ f y v = fderiv ℝ (H o) y v := by
      refine tendsto_nhds_unique_of_frequently_eq hF.tendsto_slope_zero
        (hHo o).tendsto_slope_zero (hfreq.mono fun t ht => ?_)
      simp only [zero_add, zero_smul, add_zero]
      rw [ht, hbase]
    rw [heq]
    exact hHb o
  
  have key0 : ∀ Y : (Fin k → Bool) → E3 → E3,
      (∀ s, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y s) ∧ HasCompactSupport (Y s) ∧ tsupport (Y s) ⊆ W ∧
        ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Y s y i * Y s y j ≤ 1) →
      ENNReal.ofReal (∑ s, ∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y s) y) ≤
        hullPerG G E W Kc := by
    intro Y hY
    obtain ⟨X, hXdef⟩ : ∃ X : E3 → E3,
        X = fun z => ∑ s, (hspSector B φ s).indicator (Y s) z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hX_on : ∀ s z, z ∈ hspSector B φ s → X z = Y s z := by
      intro s z hz
      simp only [hXdef]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single s]
      · exact Set.indicator_of_mem hz _
      · intro t _ hts
        exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (hDdisj s t (Ne.symm hts) z hz) _
      · intro h
        exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ s) h
    have hX_off : ∀ z, (∀ s, z ∉ hspSector B φ s) → X z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      simp only [hXdef]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun s _ => Set.indicator_of_notMem (hz s) _
    have hsel : ∀ z, X z = 0 ∨ ∃ s, X z = Y s z := by
      intro z
      by_cases h : ∃ s, z ∈ hspSector B φ s
      · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h
        exact Or.inr ⟨s, hX_on s z hs⟩
      · push_neg at h
        exact Or.inl (hX_off z h)
    obtain ⟨K0, hK0⟩ : ∃ K0 : Set E3, K0 = ⋃ s, tsupport (Y s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hK0c : IsCompact K0 := by
      rw [hK0]
      exact isCompact_iUnion fun s => (hY s).2.1
    have hK0W : K0 ⊆ W := by
      rw [hK0]
      exact Set.iUnion_subset fun s => (hY s).2.2.1
    have hYz : ∀ s z, z ∉ K0 → Y s z = 0 := by
      intro s z hz
      exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport fun h => hz (hK0 ▸ Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨s, h⟩)
    have hXz : ∀ z, z ∉ K0 → X z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      rcases hsel z with h | ⟨s, h⟩
      · exact h
      · rw [h, hYz s z hz]
    have htsX : tsupport X ⊆ K0 := by
      refine closure_minimal ?_ hK0c.isClosed
      intro z hz
      by_contra h
      exact hz (hXz z h)
    have hXc : HasCompactSupport X := hK0c.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure htsX
    have hXn : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1 := by
      intro y
      rcases hsel y with h | ⟨s, h⟩
      · rw [h]; simp
      · rw [h]; exact (hY s).2.2.2 y
    have hXeq_near : ∀ s y, y ∈ hspSector B φ s → X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] Y s := by
      intro s y hy
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hDo s).mem_nhds hy) fun z hz => hX_on s z hz
    have hXzero_near : ∀ y, y ∉ K0 → X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := by
      intro y hy
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hK0c.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy)
        fun z hz => hXz z hz
    
    have hXs : ∀ y, y ∉ Kc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y := by
      intro y hy
      by_cases h : ∃ s, y ∈ hspSector B φ s
      · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h
        exact ((hY s).1.contDiffAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hXeq_near s y hs)
      · push_neg at h
        by_cases hyK : y ∈ K0
        · exfalso
          have hyB : y ∈ B := hWB (hK0W hyK)
          apply hy
          refine hKc y hyB ?_
          by_contra hw
          push_neg at hw
          exact h _ (hDcov y hyB hw)
        · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hXzero_near y hyK)
    
    have hgs : ∀ s (i : Fin 3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y s z i) := by
      intro s i
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro z
      have hYi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Y s z i) :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp (hY s).1
      by_cases hz : z ∈ B
      · have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) z := hdetB.contDiffAt (hB.mem_nhds hz)
        exact (h1.sqrt (hpd z hz).det_pos.ne').mul hYi.contDiffAt
      · have hzt : z ∉ tsupport (Y s) := fun h => hz (hWB ((hY s).2.2.1 h))
        have hev : Y s =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hzt
        refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
        exact hev.mono fun w hw => by simp [hw]
    have hbd : ∀ s (i : Fin 3), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z,
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y s z i) z‖ ≤ C := by
      intro s i
      have hcs : HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y s z i) := by
        refine (hY s).2.1.mono' fun z hz => subset_tsupport _ ?_
        intro h
        apply hz
        simp [h]
      exact (hcs.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).exists_bound_of_continuous
        ((hgs s i).continuous_fderiv (by simp))
    choose Mb hMb using hbd
    have hXdiv : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C := by
      refine ⟨∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ s, max (Mb s i) 0, fun y => ?_⟩
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
      have hsel_i : ∀ z, Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i = 0 ∨
          ∃ s, Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i = Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y s z i := by
        intro z
        rcases hsel z with h | ⟨s, h⟩
        · left; rw [h]; simp
        · right; exact ⟨s, by rw [h]⟩
      have := c2 (fun s z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y s z i)
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) (∑ s, max (Mb s i) 0)
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun s _ => le_max_right _ _)
        (fun s => (hgs s i).differentiable (by simp))
        (fun s z => (hMb s i z).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans
          (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun s => max (Mb s i) 0)
            (fun _ _ => le_max_right _ _) (Finset.mem_univ s))))
        hsel_i y (e i)
      rwa [EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one] at this
    
    have hfc : ∀ s, Continuous (sepDensDiv G (Y s)) := by
      intro s
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
        ((hgs s i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hfsupp : ∀ s y, y ∉ tsupport (Y s) → sepDensDiv G (Y s) y = 0 := by
      intro s y hy
      rw [hdiv_congr (Y s) 0 y (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy), hdiv0]
    have hfint : ∀ s, Integrable (sepDensDiv G (Y s)) := fun s =>
      (hfc s).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        ((hY s).2.1.mono' fun y hy => by
          by_contra h
          exact hy (hfsupp s y h))
    have hpt : ∀ y, y ∉ {z | z ∈ B ∧ ∃ i, φ i z = 0} →
        sepDensDiv G X y = ∑ s, (hspSector B φ s).indicator (sepDensDiv G (Y s)) y := by
      intro y hyZ
      by_cases h : ∃ s, y ∈ hspSector B φ s
      · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := h
        rw [hdiv_congr X (Y s) y (hXeq_near s y hs), Finset.sum_eq_single s]
        · exact (Set.indicator_of_mem hs _).symm
        · intro t _ hts
          exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (hDdisj s t (Ne.symm hts) y hs) _
        · intro h
          exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ s) h
      · push_neg at h
        have hyB : y ∉ B := by
          intro hyB
          refine h _ (hDcov y hyB ?_)
          intro i hi
          exact hyZ ⟨hyB, i, hi⟩
        have hyK : y ∉ K0 := fun hy => hyB (hWB (hK0W hy))
        rw [hdiv_congr X 0 y (hXzero_near y hyK), hdiv0,
          Finset.sum_eq_zero fun s _ => Set.indicator_of_notMem (h s) _]
    have hint : ∫ y in E, sepDensDiv G X y =
        ∑ s, ∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y s) y := by
      have hae : ∀ᵐ y ∂volume, y ∉ {z | z ∈ B ∧ ∃ i, φ i z = 0} :=
        measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hnull
      rw [integral_congr_ae (ae_restrict_of_ae (hae.mono fun y hy => hpt y hy))]
      rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun s _ =>
        ((hfint s).indicator (hDo s).measurableSet).integrableOn)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
      rw [integral_indicator (hDo s).measurableSet,
        Measure.restrict_restrict (hDo s).measurableSet, Set.inter_comm]
    rw [← hint]
    unfold hullPerG
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le X ⟨hXs, hXc, htsX.trans hK0W, hXn, hXdiv⟩ le_rfl
  
  have hP0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (0 : E3 → E3) ∧ HasCompactSupport (0 : E3 → E3) ∧
      tsupport (0 : E3 → E3) ⊆ W ∧
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (0 : E3 → E3) y i * (0 : E3 → E3) y j ≤ 1 := by
    refine ⟨contDiff_const, HasCompactSupport.zero, ?_, fun y => by simp⟩
    rw [tsupport_zero]
    exact Set.empty_subset _
  have key : ∀ Y : (Fin k → Bool) → E3 → E3,
      (∀ s, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y s) ∧ HasCompactSupport (Y s) ∧ tsupport (Y s) ⊆ W ∧
        ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Y s y i * Y s y j ≤ 1) →
      ∑ s, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y s) y) ≤
        hullPerG G E W Kc := by
    intro Y hY
    obtain ⟨Y', hY'def⟩ : ∃ Y' : (Fin k → Bool) → E3 → E3, Y' = fun s =>
        if 0 ≤ ∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y s) y then Y s else 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hY'P : ∀ s, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y' s) ∧ HasCompactSupport (Y' s) ∧ tsupport (Y' s) ⊆ W ∧
        ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Y' s y i * Y' s y j ≤ 1 := by
      intro s
      by_cases h : 0 ≤ ∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y s) y
      · simp only [hY'def, if_pos h]; exact hY s
      · simp only [hY'def, if_neg h]; exact hP0
    have ha' : ∀ s, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y s) y) =
          ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y' s) y) ∧
        0 ≤ ∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y' s) y := by
      intro s
      by_cases h : 0 ≤ ∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y s) y
      · constructor
        · simp only [hY'def, if_pos h]
        · simp only [hY'def, if_pos h]; exact h
      · simp only [hY'def, if_neg h, hdiv0, integral_zero, le_refl, and_true,
          ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_of_nonpos (le_of_lt (not_le.1 h))
    calc ∑ s, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y s) y)
        = ∑ s, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y' s) y) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => (ha' s).1
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ s, ∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y' s) y) :=
          (ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg fun s _ => (ha' s).2).symm
      _ ≤ hullPerG G E W Kc := key0 Y' hY'P
  
  obtain ⟨P, hPdef⟩ : ∃ P : (E3 → E3) → Prop, P = fun X : E3 → E3 => ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧
      HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ W ∧
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hPiff : ∀ X : E3 → E3, P X ↔ (ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧
      HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ W ∧
      ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) := fun X => by rw [hPdef]
  have hrw : ∀ s, sepPerG G (E ∩ hspSector B φ s) W = ⨆ a : {X : E3 → E3 // P X},
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G a.1 y) := by
    intro s
    rw [hPdef]
    unfold sepPerG
    exact iSup_subtype'
  haveI hne : Nonempty {X : E3 → E3 // P X} := ⟨⟨0, (hPiff 0).2 hP0⟩⟩
  have lat : ∀ (T : Finset (Fin k → Bool)) (c : ENNReal),
      (∀ Y : (Fin k → Bool) → {X : E3 → E3 // P X}, c + ∑ s ∈ T,
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y s).1 y) ≤
          hullPerG G E W Kc) →
      c + ∑ s ∈ T, (⨆ a : {X : E3 → E3 // P X},
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G a.1 y)) ≤
          hullPerG G E W Kc := by
    intro T
    refine Finset.induction_on T ?_ ?_
    · intro c h
      simpa using h (fun _ => Classical.arbitrary _)
    · intro t T ht ih c h
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ht, ← add_assoc, add_comm c, add_assoc, ENNReal.iSup_add]
      refine iSup_le fun a => ?_
      rw [← add_assoc, add_comm _ c]
      refine ih _ fun Y => ?_
      have h1 := h (Function.update Y t a)
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ht, Function.update_self] at h1
      have h2 : ∑ s ∈ T, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s,
            sepDensDiv G (Function.update Y t a s).1 y) =
          ∑ s ∈ T, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in E ∩ hspSector B φ s, sepDensDiv G (Y s).1 y) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs => by
          have hst : s ≠ t := by
            rintro rfl
            exact ht hs
          rw [Function.update_of_ne hst]
      rw [h2, ← add_assoc] at h1
      exact h1
  unfold hspSectorPer
  simp only [hrw]
  have hfin := lat Finset.univ 0 fun Y => by
    rw [zero_add]
    exact key (fun s => (Y s).1) fun s => (hPiff _).1 (Y s).2
  rwa [zero_add] at hfin

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U B : Set E3) (k : ℕ)
    (φ : Fin k → E3 → ℝ) (Φ₁ Φ₂ V K' : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hDm : ∀ s : Fin k → Bool, MeasurableSet (hspSector B φ s))
    (hΦ₁ : MeasurableSet Φ₁) (hΦ₂ : MeasurableSet Φ₂) (hV : IsOpen V) (hVU : V ⊆ U)
    (hK' : IsCompact K') (hK'V : K' ⊆ V) (hsd : symmDiff Φ₁ Φ₂ ⊆ K')
    (hfin : hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ V < ⊤)
    (hcmp : ∀ V₁ V₂ : Set E3, IsOpen V₁ → IsOpen V₂ → K' ⊆ V₂ → IsCompact (closure V₂) →
      closure V₂ ⊆ V₁ → V₁ ⊆ V →
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ V₂ ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ V₁ + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (V₁ \ K')) :
    hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ V ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ V

signature.name: sectorPer_local_compare
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U B : Set E3) (k : ℕ)
    (φ : Fin k → E3 → ℝ) (Φ₁ Φ₂ V K' : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hDm : ∀ s : Fin k → Bool, MeasurableSet (hspSector B φ s))
    (hΦ₁ : MeasurableSet Φ₁) (hΦ₂ : MeasurableSet Φ₂) (hV : IsOpen V) (hVU : V ⊆ U)
    (hK' : IsCompact K') (hK'V : K' ⊆ V) (hsd : symmDiff Φ₁ Φ₂ ⊆ K')
    (hfin : hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ V < ⊤)
    (hcmp : ∀ V₁ V₂ : Set E3, IsOpen V₁ → IsOpen V₂ → K' ⊆ V₂ → IsCompact (closure V₂) →
      closure V₂ ⊆ V₁ → V₁ ⊆ V →
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ V₂ ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ V₁ + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (V₁ \ K')) :
    hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ V ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ V

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hK'c : IsClosed K' := hK'.isClosed
  have hE₁ : ∀ s : Fin k → Bool, MeasurableSet (Φ₁ ∩ hspSector B φ s) :=
    fun s => hΦ₁.inter (hDm s)
  have hE₂ : ∀ s : Fin k → Bool, MeasurableSet (Φ₂ ∩ hspSector B φ s) :=
    fun s => hΦ₂.inter (hDm s)
  
  have mono : ∀ (E A₁ A₂ : Set E3), A₁ ⊆ A₂ → sepPerG G E A₁ ≤ sepPerG G E A₂ := by
    intro E A₁ A₂ hA
    unfold sepPerG
    exact iSup₂_mono' fun X hX => ⟨X, ⟨hX.1, hX.2.1, hX.2.2.1.trans hA, hX.2.2.2⟩, le_rfl⟩
  have monoS : ∀ (Φ W₁ W₂ : Set E3), W₁ ⊆ W₂ →
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ W₁ ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ Φ W₂ := by
    intro Φ W₁ W₂ h
    unfold hspSectorPer
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ => mono _ _ _ h
  
  have densZero : ∀ (X : E3 → E3) (y : E3), y ∉ tsupport X → sepDensDiv G X y = 0 := by
    intro X y hy
    have hX : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    unfold partialDeriv
    have h : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hX] with z hz
      simp [hz]
    rw [h.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have congrP : ∀ (E₁ E₂ A : Set E3), MeasurableSet E₁ → MeasurableSet E₂ → E₁ ∩ A = E₂ ∩ A →
      sepPerG G E₁ A = sepPerG G E₂ A := by
    intro E₁ E₂ A h1 h2 h
    unfold sepPerG
    refine iSup_congr fun X => iSup_congr fun hX => ?_
    congr 1
    rw [← integral_indicator h1, ← integral_indicator h2]
    congr 1
    funext y
    by_cases hyA : y ∈ A
    · have hiff := Set.ext_iff.mp h y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, hyA, and_true] at hiff
      by_cases hy1 : y ∈ E₁
      · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy1, hiff.mp hy1]
      · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy1, (not_congr hiff).mp hy1]
    · have hz := densZero X y (fun hy => hyA (hX.2.2.1 hy))
      simp [Set.indicator_apply, hz]
  have congrS : ∀ W : Set E3, Φ₁ ∩ W = Φ₂ ∩ W →
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ W = hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ W := by
    intro W h
    unfold hspSectorPer
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => congrP _ _ W (hE₁ s) (hE₂ s) ?_
    ext y
    have hy := Set.ext_iff.mp h y
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff] at hy ⊢
    tauto
  
  have two : ∀ (E : Set E3), MeasurableSet E → ∀ A₁ A₂ : Set E3, Disjoint A₁ A₂ →
      sepPerG G E A₁ + sepPerG G E A₂ ≤ sepPerG G E (A₁ ∪ A₂) := by
    intro E hE A₁ A₂ hA
    have h := sepPerG_sum_le G E hE 2 ![A₁, A₂] (by
      intro i j hij
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [hA, hA.symm])
    have hU2 : (⋃ i, ![A₁, A₂] i) = A₁ ∪ A₂ := by
      ext x
      simp [Fin.exists_fin_two]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hU2] at h
    simpa using h
  have twoS : ∀ Φ : Set E3, (∀ s : Fin k → Bool, MeasurableSet (Φ ∩ hspSector B φ s)) →
      ∀ W₁ W₂ : Set E3, Disjoint W₁ W₂ →
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ W₁ + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ W₂ ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ Φ (W₁ ∪ W₂) := by
    intro Φ hΦ W₁ W₂ h
    unfold hspSectorPer
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ => two _ (hΦ s) _ _ h
  have unionS : ∀ Φ : Set E3, (∀ s : Fin k → Bool, MeasurableSet (Φ ∩ hspSector B φ s)) →
      ∀ W₁ W₂ : Set E3, IsOpen W₁ → IsOpen W₂ → W₁ ⊆ U → W₂ ⊆ U →
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ (W₁ ∪ W₂) ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ Φ W₁ + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ W₂ := by
    intro Φ hΦ W₁ W₂ h1 h2 h3 h4
    unfold hspSectorPer
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ =>
      sepPerG_union_le G U _ W₁ W₂ hU hG hdet (hΦ s) h1 h2 h3 h4
  
  have collar : ∀ E : Set E3, MeasurableSet E → sepPerG G E V < ⊤ →
      ∀ ε : ENNReal, 0 < ε → ∃ C : Set E3, IsOpen C ∧ K' ⊆ C ∧ C ⊆ V ∧
        sepPerG G E (C \ K') < ε := by
    intro E hE hfinE ε hε
    by_contra hH
    push_neg at hH
    set δ : ENNReal := min ε 1 / 2 with hδ
    have hm0 : min ε 1 ≠ 0 := (lt_min hε one_pos).ne'
    have hmt : min ε 1 ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.one_ne_top (min_le_right _ _)
    have hδ0 : δ ≠ 0 := (ENNReal.half_pos hm0).ne'
    have hδε : δ < ε := lt_of_lt_of_le (ENNReal.half_lt_self hm0 hmt) (min_le_left _ _)
    have claim : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ C : Set E3, IsOpen C ∧ K' ⊆ C ∧ C ⊆ V ∧
        (n : ENNReal) * δ + sepPerG G E (C \ K') ≤ sepPerG G E (V \ K') := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => exact ⟨V, hV, hK'V, subset_rfl, by simp⟩
      | succ n ih =>
        obtain ⟨C, hCo, hK'C, hCV, hC⟩ := ih
        have h1 : δ < sepPerG G E (C \ K') := lt_of_lt_of_le hδε (hH C hCo hK'C hCV)
        unfold sepPerG at h1
        obtain ⟨X, h1⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.mp h1
        obtain ⟨hX, h1⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.mp h1
        have hT : IsCompact (tsupport X) := hX.2.1
        have hCK : IsOpen (C \ K') := hCo.sdiff hK'c
        obtain ⟨O, hOo, hTO, hOC, -⟩ :=
          exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hT hCK hX.2.2.1
        refine ⟨C \ closure O, hCo.sdiff isClosed_closure, ?_, Set.diff_subset.trans hCV, ?_⟩
        · intro x hx
          exact ⟨hK'C hx, fun hxO => (hOC hxO).2 hx⟩
        · have hδO : δ ≤ sepPerG G E O := by
            unfold sepPerG
            refine le_trans h1.le ?_
            apply le_iSup₂_of_le X ⟨hX.1, hX.2.1, hTO, hX.2.2.2⟩
            exact le_rfl
          have hdisj : Disjoint O ((C \ closure O) \ K') := by
            rw [Set.disjoint_left]
            intro x hxO hx
            exact hx.1.2 (subset_closure hxO)
          have hsub : O ∪ ((C \ closure O) \ K') ⊆ C \ K' := by
            intro x hx
            rcases hx with hx | hx
            · exact hOC (subset_closure hx)
            · exact ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2⟩
          have h2 := (two E hE _ _ hdisj).trans (mono E _ _ hsub)
          calc ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ENNReal) * δ + sepPerG G E ((C \ closure O) \ K')
              = (n : ENNReal) * δ + (δ + sepPerG G E ((C \ closure O) \ K')) := by
                push_cast; ring
            _ ≤ (n : ENNReal) * δ + sepPerG G E (C \ K') := by
                gcongr
                exact (add_le_add hδO le_rfl).trans h2
            _ ≤ _ := hC
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENNReal.exists_nat_mul_gt hδ0 hfinE.ne
    obtain ⟨C, -, -, -, hC⟩ := claim n
    have hle : (n : ENNReal) * δ ≤ sepPerG G E V :=
      le_trans le_self_add (hC.trans (mono E _ _ Set.diff_subset))
    exact absurd hn (not_lt.mpr hle)
  
  have collarS : ∀ η : ENNReal, 0 < η → ∃ C : Set E3, IsOpen C ∧ K' ⊆ C ∧ C ⊆ V ∧
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (C \ K') ≤ η := by
    intro η hη
    have hη' : 0 < η / (Fintype.card (Fin k → Bool) : ENNReal) :=
      ENNReal.div_pos hη.ne' (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)
    have hfs : ∀ s : Fin k → Bool, sepPerG G (Φ₁ ∩ hspSector B φ s) V < ⊤ := by
      intro s
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hfin
      unfold hspSectorPer
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun s => sepPerG G (Φ₁ ∩ hspSector B φ s) V)
        (fun _ _ => zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ s)
    choose C hCo hK'C hCV hCε using fun s => collar _ (hE₁ s) (hfs s) _ hη'
    refine ⟨V ∩ ⋂ s, C s, hV.inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite hCo),
      Set.subset_inter hK'V (Set.subset_iInter hK'C), Set.inter_subset_left, ?_⟩
    unfold hspSectorPer
    calc ∑ s, sepPerG G (Φ₁ ∩ hspSector B φ s) ((V ∩ ⋂ s, C s) \ K')
        ≤ ∑ _s : Fin k → Bool, η / (Fintype.card (Fin k → Bool) : ENNReal) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ =>
            (mono _ _ _ (Set.diff_subset_diff_left
              (Set.inter_subset_right.trans (Set.iInter_subset _ s)))).trans (hCε s).le
      _ = (Fintype.card (Fin k → Bool) : ENNReal) *
          (η / (Fintype.card (Fin k → Bool) : ENNReal)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ η := ENNReal.mul_div_le
  
  refine ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε _ => ?_
  have hε' : (0 : ENNReal) < (ε : ENNReal) / 2 :=
    ENNReal.half_pos (ENNReal.coe_pos.mpr hε).ne'
  obtain ⟨C, hCo, hK'C, hCV, hx⟩ := collarS _ hε'
  obtain ⟨B', hBo, hK'B, hBC, -⟩ := exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hK' hCo hK'C
  obtain ⟨A, hAo, hK'A, hAB, hAc⟩ := exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hK' hBo hK'B
  have hBV : B' ⊆ V := (subset_closure.trans hBC).trans hCV
  have hAV : A ⊆ V := (subset_closure.trans hAB).trans hBV
  have hd : hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ V ≤
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ A + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (V \ K') := by
    refine (monoS Φ₁ V (A ∪ (V \ K')) ?_).trans
      (unionS Φ₁ hE₁ A (V \ K') hAo (hV.sdiff hK'c)
        (hAV.trans hVU) (Set.diff_subset.trans hVU))
    intro y hy
    by_cases h : y ∈ K'
    · exact Or.inl (hK'A h)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hy, h⟩
  have he : hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (V \ K') ≤
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (C \ K') + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (V \ closure B') := by
    refine (monoS Φ₁ _ ((C \ K') ∪ (V \ closure B')) ?_).trans
      (unionS Φ₁ hE₁ _ _ (hCo.sdiff hK'c) (hV.sdiff isClosed_closure)
        (Set.diff_subset.trans (hCV.trans hVU)) (Set.diff_subset.trans hVU))
    rintro y ⟨hyV, hyK⟩
    by_cases h : y ∈ closure B'
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hBC h, hyK⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hyV, h⟩
  have hf : hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ A ≤
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ B' + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (C \ K') :=
    (hcmp B' A hBo hAo hK'A hAc hAB hBV).trans
      (add_le_add le_rfl (monoS Φ₁ _ _ (Set.diff_subset_diff_left (subset_closure.trans hBC))))
  have hg : hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (V \ closure B') =
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ (V \ closure B') := by
    refine congrS _ ?_
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
      by_contra h
      exact h2.2 (subset_closure (hK'B (hsd (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨h1, h⟩)))))
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
      refine ⟨?_, h2⟩
      by_contra h
      exact h2.2 (subset_closure (hK'B (hsd (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨h1, h⟩)))))
  have hh : hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ B' + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ (V \ closure B') ≤
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ V := by
    refine (twoS Φ₂ hE₂ _ _ ?_).trans (monoS Φ₂ _ _ (Set.union_subset hBV Set.diff_subset))
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro y hyB hy
    exact hy.2 (subset_closure hyB)
  have he' : hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (V \ K') ≤
      hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (C \ K') + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ (V \ closure B') := by
    rw [← hg]; exact he
  calc hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ V
      ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ A + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (V \ K') := hd
    _ ≤ (hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ B' + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (C \ K')) +
        (hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (C \ K') + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ (V \ closure B')) :=
        add_le_add hf he'
    _ = (hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ B' + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ (V \ closure B')) +
        (hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (C \ K') + hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₁ (C \ K')) := by ring
    _ ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ V + ((ε : ENNReal) / 2 + (ε : ENNReal) / 2) :=
        add_le_add hh (add_le_add hx hx)
    _ = hspSectorPer G B φ Φ₂ V + ε := by rw [ENNReal.add_halves]

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerG_sum_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (E : Set E3) (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Set E3) (hdisj : Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (A k) (A l))) :
    ∑ k, sepPerG G E (A k) ≤ sepPerG G E (⋃ k, A k)

subgoal_signatures.name: sepPerG_union_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U E A B : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (hAU : A ⊆ U) (hBU : B ⊆ U) :
    sepPerG G E (A ∪ B) ≤ sepPerG G E A + sepPerG G E B

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F₁ F₂ Ω K : Set M) (p : M) (ε : ℝ)
    (hBΩ : Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε ⊆ chartAt E3 p '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
    (k : ℕ) (φ : Fin k → E3 → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε))
    (hdφ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0)
    (hwall : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε,
      ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ K ↔ ∃ i, φ i z = 0))
    (K' V₁ V₂ : Set E3) (hF₁ : sepChartMeas F₁) (hF₂ : sepChartMeas F₂) (hK' : IsCompact K')
    (hV₁ : IsOpen V₁) (hV₂ : IsOpen V₂) (hK'V₂ : K' ⊆ V₂) (hV₂c : IsCompact (closure V₂))
    (hV₂V₁ : closure V₂ ⊆ V₁) (hV₁B : V₁ ⊆ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε)
    (hsd : symmDiff F₁ F₂ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' K') :
    hullRiemPer g F₂ Ω K +
        hspSectorPer (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε) φ
          (chartAt E3 p '' (F₁ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) V₂ ≤
      hullRiemPer g F₁ Ω K +
        hspSectorPer (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε) φ
          (chartAt E3 p '' (F₂ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) V₁ +
        hspSectorPer (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε) φ
          (chartAt E3 p '' (F₁ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) (V₁ \ K')

    (hBΩ : Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε ⊆ chartAt E3 p '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
    (k : ℕ) (φ : Fin k → E3 → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε))
    (hdφ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0)
    (hwall : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε,
      ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ K ↔ ∃ i, φ i z = 0))
    (K' V₁ V₂ : Set E3) (hF₁ : sepChartMeas F₁) (hF₂ : sepChartMeas F₂) (hK' : IsCompact K')
    (hV₁ : IsOpen V₁) (hV₂ : IsOpen V₂) (hK'V₂ : K' ⊆ V₂) (hV₂c : IsCompact (closure V₂))
    (hV₂V₁ : closure V₂ ⊆ V₁) (hV₁B : V₁ ⊆ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε)
    (hsd : symmDiff F₁ F₂ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).symm '' K') :
    hullRiemPer g F₂ Ω K +
        hspSectorPer (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε) φ
          (chartAt E3 p '' (F₁ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) V₂ ≤
      hullRiemPer g F₁ Ω K +
        hspSectorPer (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε) φ
          (chartAt E3 p '' (F₂ ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) V₁ +

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set κ := chartAt E3 p with hκ
  set G := g.coeff κ.symm with hGdef
  set B := Metric.ball (κ p) ε with hBdef
  
  have hBt : B ⊆ κ.target := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hBΩ hz
    exact κ.map_source hx.2
  have hF2 : ∀ S : Set E3, S ⊆ B → κ.symm '' S ⊆ Ω ∩ κ.source := by
    rintro S hS _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hBΩ (hS hz)
    rw [κ.left_inv hx.2]
    exact hx
  have himg : ∀ S : Set E3, S ⊆ B → κ '' (κ.symm '' S) = S := fun S hS =>
    κ.toPartialEquiv.image_symm_image_of_subset_target (hS.trans hBt)
  have hopen : ∀ S : Set E3, IsOpen S → S ⊆ B → IsOpen (κ.symm '' S) := fun S hS hSB =>
    κ.isOpen_image_symm_of_subset_target hS (hSB.trans hBt)
  have hcpt : ∀ S : Set E3, IsCompact S → S ⊆ B → IsCompact (κ.symm '' S) := fun S hS hSB =>
    hS.image_of_continuousOn (κ.continuousOn_symm.mono (hSB.trans hBt))
  have hV₂B : V₂ ⊆ B := subset_closure.trans (hV₂V₁.trans hV₁B)
  have hcV₂B : closure V₂ ⊆ B := hV₂V₁.trans hV₁B
  have hK'B : K' ⊆ B := hK'V₂.trans hV₂B
  have hDB : V₁ \ K' ⊆ B := Set.diff_subset.trans hV₁B
  
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ S : Set M, S = κ.symm '' K' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V₁', hV₁'def⟩ : ∃ S : Set M, S = κ.symm '' V₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V₂', hV₂'def⟩ : ∃ S : Set M, S = κ.symm '' V₂ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂def⟩ : ∃ S : Set M, S = κ.symm '' closure V₂ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ S : Set M, S = κ.symm '' (V₁ \ K') := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsd' : symmDiff F₁ F₂ ⊆ L := by rw [hLdef]; exact hsd
  have hLo : IsOpen Lᶜ := by rw [hLdef]; exact (hcpt K' hK' hK'B).isClosed.isOpen_compl
  have hC₂o : IsOpen C₂ᶜ := by rw [hC₂def]; exact (hcpt _ hV₂c hcV₂B).isClosed.isOpen_compl
  have hV₁'o : IsOpen V₁' := by rw [hV₁'def]; exact hopen V₁ hV₁ hV₁B
  have hV₂'o : IsOpen V₂' := by rw [hV₂'def]; exact hopen V₂ hV₂ hV₂B
  have hDo : IsOpen D := by rw [hDdef]; exact hopen _ (hV₁.sdiff hK'.isClosed) hDB
  have hV₁'s : V₁' ⊆ κ.source := by rw [hV₁'def]; exact fun x hx => (hF2 V₁ hV₁B hx).2
  have hV₂'Ω : V₂' ⊆ Ω ∩ κ.source := by rw [hV₂'def]; exact hF2 V₂ hV₂B
  have hDs : D ⊆ κ.source := by rw [hDdef]; exact fun x hx => (hF2 _ hDB hx).2
  have hV₁'img : κ '' V₁' = V₁ := by rw [hV₁'def]; exact himg V₁ hV₁B
  have hV₂'img : κ '' V₂' = V₂ := by rw [hV₂'def]; exact himg V₂ hV₂B
  have hDimg : κ '' D = V₁ \ K' := by rw [hDdef]; exact himg _ hDB
  have hLV₁' : L ⊆ V₁' := by
    rw [hLdef, hV₁'def]; exact Set.image_mono (hK'V₂.trans (subset_closure.trans hV₂V₁))
  have hV₂'C₂ : V₂' ⊆ C₂ := by rw [hV₂'def, hC₂def]; exact Set.image_mono subset_closure
  
  have hZnull : volume (⋃ i, B ∩ φ i ⁻¹' {0}) = 0 :=
    measure_iUnion_null fun i => submersion_zero_null B Metric.isOpen_ball (φ i) (hφ i) (hdφ i)
  obtain ⟨Z, hZdef⟩ : ∃ S : Set E3, S = {z | z ∈ B ∧ ∃ i, φ i z = 0} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hZB : Z ⊆ B := by rw [hZdef]; exact fun z hz => hz.1
  have hNw : sepChartNull (κ.symm '' Z) := by
    refine sepChartNull_of_image_null p _ (fun x hx => (hF2 Z hZB hx).2) ?_
    show volume (κ '' (κ.symm '' Z)) = 0
    rw [himg Z hZB]
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ hZnull
    rw [hZdef]
    rintro z ⟨hzB, i, hi⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, hzB, hi⟩
  have hnullmono : ∀ S : Set M, S ⊆ κ.symm '' Z → sepChartNull S := fun S hS q =>
    measure_mono_null (Set.image_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hS)) (hNw q)
  have hwallsub : ∀ S : Set E3, S ⊆ B → K ∩ κ.symm '' S ⊆ κ.symm '' Z := by
    rintro S hSB x ⟨hxK, z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨z, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [hZdef]
    exact ⟨hSB hz, (hwall z (hSB hz)).1 hxK⟩
  
  have hmono : ∀ E U U' : Set M, U ⊆ U' → hullRiemPer g E U K ≤ hullRiemPer g E U' K := by
    intro E U U' hUU'
    unfold hullRiemPer
    refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun q => iSup_mono fun W => ?_
    exact iSup_le fun h => le_iSup_of_le
      ⟨fun j => ⟨(h.1 j).1, (h.1 j).2.trans (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hUU')⟩, h.2⟩ le_rfl
  
  have hloc : ∀ E₁ E₂ U : Set M, sepChartMeas E₁ → sepChartMeas E₂ →
      (∀ x ∈ U, (x ∈ E₁ ↔ x ∈ E₂)) → hullRiemPer g E₁ U K ≤ hullRiemPer g E₂ U K := by
    intro E₁ E₂ U hE₁ hE₂ hU
    unfold hullRiemPer
    refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun q => iSup_mono fun W => iSup_mono fun h => ?_
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
    unfold hullPerG
    refine iSup_mono fun X => iSup_mono fun hX => ?_
    apply le_of_eq
    congr 1
    rw [← integral_indicator (hE₁ (q j)), ← integral_indicator (hE₂ (q j))]
    congr 1
    funext y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport X
    · obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hX.2.2.1 hy
      have hws := (h.1 j).2 hw
      have key : ∀ E : Set M, chartAt E3 (q j) w ∈
          chartAt E3 (q j) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) ↔ w ∈ E := by
        intro E
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxw⟩
          have hxw' := (chartAt E3 (q j)).injOn hx.2 hws.2 hxw
          rw [← hxw']
          exact hx.1
        · intro hwE
          exact ⟨w, ⟨hwE, hws.2⟩, rfl⟩
      by_cases h1 : w ∈ E₁
      · have h2 : w ∈ E₂ := (hU w hws.1).1 h1
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ((key E₁).2 h1), Set.indicator_of_mem ((key E₂).2 h2)]
      · have h2 : w ∉ E₂ := fun h2 => h1 ((hU w hws.1).2 h2)
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h' => h1 ((key E₁).1 h')),
          Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h' => h2 ((key E₂).1 h'))]
    · have h0 : sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) X y = 0 := by
        have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy
        unfold sepDensDiv
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
        have hev' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z).det * X z i)
            =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := hev.mono fun z hz => by simp [hz]
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [hev'.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      simp only [Set.indicator, h0, ite_self]
  
  have hs9 : hullRiemPer g F₂ Ω K ≤
      hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₂ ∩ κ.source)) V₁ + hullRiemPer g F₁ (Ω ∩ Lᶜ) K := by
    have h1 : hullRiemPer g F₂ Ω K ≤
        hullRiemPer g F₂ (Ω ∩ V₁') K + hullRiemPer g F₂ (Ω ∩ Lᶜ) K :=
      hullRiemPer_union_le_of_null g F₂ Ω K V₁' Lᶜ hV₁'o hLo
        (fun x _ => by
          by_cases hx : x ∈ L
          · exact Or.inl (hLV₁' hx)
          · exact Or.inr hx)
        (hnullmono _ (by rw [hV₁'def]; exact hwallsub V₁ hV₁B))
    have h2 : hullRiemPer g F₂ (Ω ∩ V₁') K ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₂ ∩ κ.source)) V₁ := by
      refine (hmono _ _ _ Set.inter_subset_right).trans ?_
      have h : hullRiemPer g F₂ V₁' K ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₂ ∩ κ.source)) (κ '' V₁') :=
        hullRiemPer_chart_sector_le g K F₂ hF₂ p ε hBt k φ hφ hdφ hwall V₁' hV₁'s
          (by rw [hV₁'img]; exact hV₁B)
      rwa [hV₁'img] at h
    have h3 : hullRiemPer g F₂ (Ω ∩ Lᶜ) K ≤ hullRiemPer g F₁ (Ω ∩ Lᶜ) K := by
      refine hloc F₂ F₁ _ hF₂ hF₁ fun x hx => ⟨fun h2 => ?_, fun h1 => ?_⟩
      · by_contra h1
        exact hx.2 (hsd' (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨h2, h1⟩)))
      · by_contra h2
        exact hx.2 (hsd' (Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨h1, h2⟩)))
    exact h1.trans (add_le_add h2 h3)
  
  have hs10 : hullRiemPer g F₁ (Ω ∩ Lᶜ) K ≤
      hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) (V₁ \ K') + hullRiemPer g F₁ (Ω ∩ C₂ᶜ) K := by
    have h1 : hullRiemPer g F₁ (Ω ∩ Lᶜ) K ≤
        hullRiemPer g F₁ ((Ω ∩ Lᶜ) ∩ D) K + hullRiemPer g F₁ ((Ω ∩ Lᶜ) ∩ C₂ᶜ) K :=
      hullRiemPer_union_le_of_null g F₁ (Ω ∩ Lᶜ) K D C₂ᶜ hDo hC₂o
        (fun x hx => by
          by_cases hxC : x ∈ C₂
          · left
            rw [hC₂def] at hxC
            obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hxC
            rw [hDdef]
            refine ⟨z, ⟨hV₂V₁ hz, fun hzK => hx.2 ?_⟩, rfl⟩
            rw [hLdef]
            exact ⟨z, hzK, rfl⟩
          · exact Or.inr hxC)
        (hnullmono _ (by rw [hDdef]; exact hwallsub _ hDB))
    have h2 : hullRiemPer g F₁ ((Ω ∩ Lᶜ) ∩ D) K ≤
        hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) (V₁ \ K') := by
      refine (hmono _ _ _ Set.inter_subset_right).trans ?_
      have h : hullRiemPer g F₁ D K ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) (κ '' D) :=
        hullRiemPer_chart_sector_le g K F₁ hF₁ p ε hBt k φ hφ hdφ hwall D hDs
          (by rw [hDimg]; exact hDB)
      rwa [hDimg] at h
    have h3 : hullRiemPer g F₁ ((Ω ∩ Lᶜ) ∩ C₂ᶜ) K ≤ hullRiemPer g F₁ (Ω ∩ C₂ᶜ) K :=
      hmono _ _ _ fun x hx => ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2⟩
    exact h1.trans (add_le_add h2 h3)
  
  obtain ⟨Kc, hKcdef⟩ : ∃ S : Set E3, S = κ '' (K ∩ κ.source) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKcw : ∀ z ∈ B, (∃ i, φ i z = 0) → z ∈ Kc := by
    intro z hz hw
    rw [hKcdef]
    exact ⟨κ.symm z, ⟨(hwall z hz).2 hw, κ.map_target (hBt hz)⟩, κ.right_inv (hBt hz)⟩
  have hglue : hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) V₂ ≤
      hullPerG G (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) V₂ Kc :=
    sector_glue_le_hullPerG G B Metric.isOpen_ball
      (fun i j => (g.smooth p i j).mono hBt) (fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y (hBt hy))
      k φ hφ hdφ Kc hKcw (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) V₂ (hF₁ p) hV₂ hV₂B
  have hone : hullPerG G (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) V₂ Kc ≤ hullRiemPer g F₁ V₂' K := by
    rw [← hV₂'img, hKcdef]
    unfold hullRiemPer
    refine le_iSup_of_le 1 (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ => p) (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ => V₂')
      (le_iSup_of_le ⟨fun _ => ⟨hV₂'o, fun x hx => ⟨hx, (hV₂'Ω hx).2⟩⟩,
        fun a b hab => (hab (Subsingleton.elim a b)).elim⟩ ?_)))
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one]
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Ω ∩ C₂ᶜ) V₂' :=
    Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x hx hx2 => hx.2 (hV₂'C₂ hx2)
  have hsum := hullRiemPer_disjoint_sum_le g F₁ Ω K ![Ω ∩ C₂ᶜ, V₂']
    (by
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact Set.inter_subset_left
      · exact fun x hx => (hV₂'Ω hx).1)
    (by
      intro i j hij
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
      · exact absurd rfl hij
      · exact hdisj
      · exact hdisj.symm
      · exact absurd rfl hij)
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at hsum
  have hs11 : hullRiemPer g F₁ (Ω ∩ C₂ᶜ) K + hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) V₂ ≤
      hullRiemPer g F₁ Ω K :=
    (add_le_add le_rfl (hglue.trans hone)).trans hsum
  
  calc hullRiemPer g F₂ Ω K + hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) V₂
      ≤ (hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₂ ∩ κ.source)) V₁ +
          (hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) (V₁ \ K') +
            hullRiemPer g F₁ (Ω ∩ C₂ᶜ) K)) +
          hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) V₂ :=
        add_le_add (hs9.trans (add_le_add le_rfl hs10)) le_rfl
    _ = hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₂ ∩ κ.source)) V₁ +
          hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) (V₁ \ K') +
          (hullRiemPer g F₁ (Ω ∩ C₂ᶜ) K + hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) V₂) := by
        ring
    _ ≤ hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₂ ∩ κ.source)) V₁ +
          hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) (V₁ \ K') + hullRiemPer g F₁ Ω K :=
        add_le_add le_rfl hs11
    _ = hullRiemPer g F₁ Ω K + hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₂ ∩ κ.source)) V₁ +
          hspSectorPer G B φ (κ '' (F₁ ∩ κ.source)) (V₁ \ K') := by
        ring

by

    intro S hS
    have hcl : IsClosed (S ∩ T) := by
      rw [← closure_subset_iff_isClosed]
      intro z hz

    intro y

      exact ⟨V, φ, fun _ => hV⟩
    · exact ⟨∅, 0, fun h' => absurd h' h⟩
  choose Vf φf hVf using hside'

  obtain ⟨t, ht, hcov⟩ := hK.elim_nhds_subcover (fun y => Vf y ∩ B ∩ (Jc ∩ T)ᶜ)

    intro y hy
    have h1 := hcov hy
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at h1

    have hc : c (t.equivFin ⟨x, hx⟩) = x := by
      simp only [c, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := SmoothPartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate 𝓘(ℝ, E3) hLc.isClosed
    (fun i => Vf (c i) ∩ B ∩ (Jc ∩ T)ᶜ) hWo hLW
  have hmem : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ tsupport (f i), z ∈ Vf (c i) ∧ z ∈ B ∧ z ∉ Jc ∩ T := by
    intro i z hz
    have h : z ∈ Vf (c i) ∩ B ∩ (Jc ∩ T)ᶜ := hf i hz
    exact ⟨h.1.1, h.1.2, h.2⟩
  have hcU : ∀ i, c i ∈ Γc ∩ U := fun i => ⟨(hcK i).1, hTU (hcK i).2⟩
  
  refine ⟨t.card, fun i => ⇑(f i), fun i => Vf (c i), fun i => φf (c i), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp (f i).contMDiff
  · intro i z
    exact f.nonneg i z
  · intro z
    have h := f.sum_le_one z
    rwa [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype] at h
  · intro y hy
    filter_upwards [isOpen_interior.mem_nhds (hKL hy)] with z hz _
    have h := f.sum_eq_one (interior_subset hz)
    rwa [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype] at h
  · intro i
    exact hBc.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _)
      (fun z hz => subset_closure (hmem i z hz).2.1)
  · intro i z hz
    exact ⟨(hmem i z hz).1, hBU (subset_closure (hmem i z hz).2.1)⟩
  · intro i
    exact Set.subset_compl_iff_disjoint_right.mp (fun z hz => (hmem i z hz).2.2)
  · intro i
    exact (hVf (c i) (hcU i)).1
  · intro i
    exact (hVf (c i) (hcU i)).2.2.1
  · intro i
    exact (hVf (c i) (hcU i)).2.2.2.1
  · intro i
    exact (hVf (c i) (hcU i)).2.2.2.2

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (D U Jc Γc : Set E3) (X Y : E3 → E3) (r : ℕ) (χ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Set E3) (φ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hDΓ : Disjoint D Γc) (hX1 : ∀ y, y ∉ Jc ∪ Γc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) (hX2 : HasCompactSupport X) (hX3 : tsupport X ⊆ U) (hχ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ i)) (hχΓ : ∀ y ∈ Γc ∩ tsupport X, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, z ∈ tsupport X → ∑ i, χ i z = 1) (hχc : ∀ i, IsCompact (tsupport (χ i))) (hχV : ∀ i, tsupport (χ i) ⊆ V i ∩ U) (hχJ : ∀ i, Disjoint (tsupport (χ i)) (Jc ∩ tsupport X)) (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (V i)) (hdφ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V i, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0) (hVD : ∀ i, V i ∩ D = V i ∩ {z | 0 < φ i z}) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hY : Y = fun y => X y + ∑ i : Fin r, (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) • (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) : (∀ y, y ∉ Jc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ tsupport (χ i), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ U

signature.name: collar_field_regular
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (D U Jc Γc : Set E3) (X Y : E3 → E3) (r : ℕ) (χ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Set E3) (φ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (τ : ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hDΓ : Disjoint D Γc) (hX1 : ∀ y, y ∉ Jc ∪ Γc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) (hX2 : HasCompactSupport X) (hX3 : tsupport X ⊆ U) (hχ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ i)) (hχΓ : ∀ y ∈ Γc ∩ tsupport X, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, z ∈ tsupport X → ∑ i, χ i z = 1) (hχc : ∀ i, IsCompact (tsupport (χ i))) (hχV : ∀ i, tsupport (χ i) ⊆ V i ∩ U) (hχJ : ∀ i, Disjoint (tsupport (χ i)) (Jc ∩ tsupport X)) (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (V i)) (hdφ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V i, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0) (hVD : ∀ i, V i ∩ D = V i ∩ {z | 0 < φ i z}) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hY : Y = fun y => X y + ∑ i : Fin r, (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) • (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) : (∀ y, y ∉ Jc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ tsupport (χ i), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) ∧ HasCompactSupport Y ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ U

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hN : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V i ∩ U, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (hcrNormalField G (φ i)) z := by
    intro i z hz
    have hT : IsOpen (V i ∩ U) := (hV i).inter hU
    have hGT : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) (V i ∩ U) :=
      fun a b => (hG a b).mono Set.inter_subset_right
    have hdet : ∀ w ∈ V i ∩ U, (G w).det ≠ 0 := fun w hw => (hpd w hw.2).det_pos.ne'
    have hinv : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ a b) (V i ∩ U) := by
      intro a b
      have hd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => (G w).det) (V i ∩ U) := by
        simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
        have := hGT
        fun_prop
      have hadj : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => (G w).adjugate a b) (V i ∩ U) := by
        have := hGT
        simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
        fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp <;> fun_prop
      have heq : (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ a b) = fun w => ((G w).det)⁻¹ * (G w).adjugate a b := by
        funext w
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [heq]
      exact (hd.inv hdet).mul hadj
    have hpf : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => partialDeriv k (φ i) w) (V i ∩ U) := by
      intro k
      have h1 := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hT).mp
        ((hφ i).mono Set.inter_subset_left)).2
      exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hNq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G w)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (φ i) w * partialDeriv b (φ i) w) (V i ∩ U) :=
      ContDiffOn.sum (fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun b _ => ((hinv a b).mul (hpf a)).mul (hpf b)))
    have hQ : ∀ w ∈ V i ∩ U, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G w)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (φ i) w * partialDeriv b (φ i) w := by
      intro w hw
      have hξ0 : (fun a : Fin 3 => partialDeriv a (φ i) w) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hdφ i w hw.1
        have hcomp : ∀ a : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (φ i) w (e a) = 0 := fun a => congrFun h0 a
        have hL : ((fderiv ℝ (φ i) w : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) =
            ((0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) := by
          apply (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext
          intro a
          simpa using hcomp a
        exact ContinuousLinearMap.coe_injective hL
      have hpos := (hpd w hw.2).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ0
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial, Fin.sum_univ_three] at hpos
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linarith [hpos]
    have hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hcrNormalField G (φ i)) (V i ∩ U) := by
      rw [contDiffOn_piLp]
      intro k
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => calUnitNormal G (φ i) w k) (V i ∩ U) := by
        unfold calUnitNormal
        refine ContDiffOn.mul ?_ ?_
        · exact (hNq.sqrt (fun w hw => (hQ w hw).ne')).inv
            (fun w hw => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hQ w hw)).ne')
        · exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun m _ => (hinv k m).mul (hpf m))
      exact h1.congr (fun w _ => rfl)
    exact hS.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hz)
  
  have hb : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞
        (fun y => χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
        (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y))) := by
    intro i
    have hst : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
    have key : ∀ z, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
          (fun y => χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) z ∧
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
          (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y))) z := by
      intro z
      by_cases hz : z ∈ tsupport (χ i)
      · have hzVU := hχV i hz
        have hφz : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (φ i) z := (hφ i).contDiffAt ((hV i).mem_nhds hzVU.1)
        have hin : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => 2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1) z :=
          (contDiffAt_const.mul (hφz.div_const τ)).sub contDiffAt_const
        have hcomp : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1)) z :=
          hst.contDiffAt.comp z hin
        have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
            (fun y => χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) z :=
          (hχ i).contDiffAt.mul (contDiffAt_const.sub hcomp)
        exact ⟨h1, h1.smul (hN i z hzVU).neg⟩
      · have hev : χ i =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hz
        constructor
        · refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
          filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
          simp [hy]
        · refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : E3))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
          filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
          simp [hy]
    exact ⟨contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.2 fun z => (key z).1,
      contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.2 fun z => (key z).2⟩
  have hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin r,
      (χ i z * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i z / τ) - 1))) •
        (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) z))) :=
    ContDiff.sum (fun i _ => (hb i).2)
  have hYeq : ∀ z, Y z = X z + ∑ i : Fin r,
      ((χ i z * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i z / τ) - 1))) •
          (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) z)) -
        (χ i z * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i z / τ) - 1))) • X z) := by
    intro z
    simp only [hY, smul_sub]
  
  have P3 : ∀ y, y ∉ Jc ∪ Γc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y := by
    intro y hy
    have hXy := hX1 y hy
    have hfun : Y = fun z => X z + ∑ i : Fin r,
        ((χ i z * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i z / τ) - 1))) •
            (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) z)) -
          (χ i z * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i z / τ) - 1))) • X z) := funext hYeq
    rw [hfun]
    exact hXy.add (ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ =>
      ((hb i).2.contDiffAt.sub ((hb i).1.contDiffAt.smul hXy)))
  
  have P1 : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y := by
    intro y hy
    have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy
    refine hWs.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
    rw [hYeq z]
    simp [hz]
  
  have P2 : ∀ y ∈ Γc ∩ tsupport X, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y := by
    intro y hy
    have hyD : y ∉ D := fun h => Set.disjoint_left.1 hDΓ h hy.1
    have hA : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y,
        χ i z * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i z / τ) - 1)) = χ i z := by
      intro i
      by_cases hyV : y ∈ V i
      · have hφy : φ i y ≤ 0 := by
          by_contra h
          push_neg at h
          have hmem : y ∈ V i ∩ D := by rw [hVD i]; exact ⟨hyV, h⟩
          exact hyD hmem.2
        have hc : ContinuousAt (φ i) y :=
          (hφ i).continuousOn.continuousAt ((hV i).mem_nhds hyV)
        have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, φ i z < τ / 2 :=
          hc.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by linarith)
        filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
        have h1 : 2 * (φ i z / τ) - 1 ≤ 0 := by
          have : φ i z / τ < 1 / 2 := by rw [div_lt_iff₀ hτ]; linarith
          linarith
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos h1]
        ring
      · have hyK : y ∉ tsupport (χ i) := fun h => hyV (hχV i h).1
        filter_upwards [notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hyK] with z hz
        simp [hz]
    have hAll : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i,
        χ i z * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i z / τ) - 1)) = χ i z :=
      Filter.eventually_all.2 hA
    refine hWs.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hAll, hχΓ y hy] with z hz1 hz2
    rw [hYeq z, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_smul]
    by_cases hzT : z ∈ tsupport X
    · have hs : ∑ i : Fin r,
          χ i z * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i z / τ) - 1)) = 1 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hz1 i)]
        exact hz2 hzT
      rw [hs, one_smul]
      abel
    · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hzT]
      simp
  have Y1 : ∀ y, y ∉ Jc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y := by
    intro y hyJ
    by_cases hyΓ : y ∈ Γc
    · by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
      · exact P2 y ⟨hyΓ, hyT⟩
      · exact P1 y hyT
    · exact P3 y (fun h => h.elim hyJ hyΓ)
  have Y2 : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ tsupport (χ i), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y := by
    intro i y hy
    by_cases hyJ : y ∈ Jc
    · have hyT : y ∉ tsupport X := fun h => Set.disjoint_left.1 (hχJ i) hy ⟨hyJ, h⟩
      exact P1 y hyT
    · exact Y1 y hyJ
  
  have hK : IsCompact (tsupport X ∪ ⋃ i, tsupport (χ i)) :=
    hX2.isCompact.union (isCompact_iUnion hχc)
  have hvan : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X ∪ ⋃ i, tsupport (χ i) → Y y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, not_or, not_exists] at hy
    have hX0 : X y = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy.1
    have hχ0 : ∀ i, χ i y = 0 := fun i => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (hy.2 i)
    rw [hYeq y]
    simp [hX0, hχ0]
  have hsub : tsupport Y ⊆ tsupport X ∪ ⋃ i, tsupport (χ i) :=
    closure_minimal (fun y hy => by_contra fun h => hy (hvan y h)) hK.isClosed
  exact ⟨Y1, Y2, hK.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport Y) hsub,
    hsub.trans (Set.union_subset hX3
      (Set.iUnion_subset fun i => (hχV i).trans Set.inter_subset_right))⟩

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (D U : Set E3) (X : E3 → E3) (Y : ℝ → E3 → E3) (C : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (χ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Set E3) (φ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hXD : ∀ z ∈ D, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X z) (hX4 : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) (hX5 : ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C) (hχ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ i)) (hχ0 : ∀ i z, 0 ≤ χ i z) (hχ1 : ∀ z, ∑ i, χ i z ≤ 1) (hχc : ∀ i, IsCompact (tsupport (χ i))) (hχV : ∀ i, tsupport (χ i) ⊆ V i ∩ U) (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (V i)) (hdφ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V i, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0) (hVD : ∀ i, V i ∩ D = V i ∩ {z | 0 < φ i z}) (hY : ∀ τ y, Y τ y = X y + ∑ i : Fin r, (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) • (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) : ∃ B : Fin r → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ B i) ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ D, sepDensDiv G X z - ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (tsupport (χ i) ∩ {y | y ∈ V i ∧ 0 < φ i y ∧ φ i y < τ}).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z ≤ sepDensDiv G (Y τ) z

signature.name: collar_div_pointwise
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (D U : Set E3) (X : E3 → E3) (Y : ℝ → E3 → E3) (C : ℝ) (r : ℕ) (χ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Set E3) (φ : Fin r → E3 → ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hXD : ∀ z ∈ D, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X z) (hX4 : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) (hX5 : ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C) (hχ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ i)) (hχ0 : ∀ i z, 0 ≤ χ i z) (hχ1 : ∀ z, ∑ i, χ i z ≤ 1) (hχc : ∀ i, IsCompact (tsupport (χ i))) (hχV : ∀ i, tsupport (χ i) ⊆ V i ∩ U) (hV : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (V i)) (hdφ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ V i, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0) (hVD : ∀ i, V i ∩ D = V i ∩ {z | 0 < φ i z}) (hY : ∀ τ y, Y τ y = X y + ∑ i : Fin r, (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) • (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) : ∃ B : Fin r → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ B i) ∧ ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ D, sepDensDiv G X z - ∑ i : Fin r, B i * (tsupport (χ i) ∩ {y | y ∈ V i ∧ 0 < φ i y ∧ φ i y < τ}).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z ≤ sepDensDiv G (Y τ) z

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsqrt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) U :=
    ccs_sqrtdet_smooth G U hG (fun z hz => (hpd z hz).det_pos)
  have hsat : ∀ y ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y :=
    fun y hy => hsqrt.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
  have hmulD : ∀ (W : E3 → E3) (y : E3), y ∈ U → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ W y → ∀ a : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W z a) y := by
    intro W y hy hW a
    have hWa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => W z a) y :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp y hW
    exact ((hsat y hy).mul hWa).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hexp : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E3), L v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a * L (e a) := by
    intro L v
    have hv : v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
      ext k
      fin_cases k <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    simp [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hgerm : ∀ (W W' : E3 → E3) (z : E3), W =ᶠ[𝓝 z] W' →
      sepDensDiv G W z = sepDensDiv G W' z := by
    intro W W' z h
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    have hev : (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * W y a) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * W' y a) := by
      filter_upwards [h] with y hy
      rw [hy]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hdiv0 : ∀ z : E3, sepDensDiv G (fun _ => (0 : E3)) z = 0 := by
    intro z
    simp [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
  
  have hlin : ∀ (W : E3 → E3) (Z : Fin r → E3 → E3) (z : E3),
      (∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * W y a) z) →
      (∀ (i : Fin r) (a : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * Z i y a) z) →
      sepDensDiv G (fun y => W y + ∑ i, Z i y) z = sepDensDiv G W z + ∑ i, sepDensDiv G (Z i) z := by
    intro W Z z hW hZ
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    have h : ∀ a : Fin 3, (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (W y + ∑ i, Z i y) a) =
        fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * W y a + ∑ i, Real.sqrt (G y).det * Z i y a := by

    obtain ⟨P, hP0, hP⟩ := hPgen (χ i) (tsupport (χ i)) (hχ i) (hχc i)
      (fun y hy => (hχV i hy).2)
    exact ⟨R, P, hR0, hP0, hR, hP⟩
  choose R P hR0 hP0 hR hP using hRP
  refine ⟨fun i => R i + C + 2 * P i, fun i => by have := hR0 i; have := hP0 i; linarith, ?_⟩
  intro τ hτ z hzD
  have hind0 : ∀ i : Fin r, 0 ≤ (tsupport (χ i) ∩ {y | y ∈ V i ∧ 0 < φ i y ∧ φ i y < τ}).indicator
      (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z := fun i => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun _ _ => zero_le_one) _
  by_cases hzU : z ∈ U
  swap
  · 
    have hKc : IsClosed (⋃ i, tsupport (χ i)) := isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun i => isClosed_tsupport _
    have hzK : z ∉ ⋃ i, tsupport (χ i) := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 h
      exact hzU ((hχV i hi).2)
    have hev : Y τ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] X := by
      filter_upwards [hKc.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hzK] with y hy
      have h0 : ∀ i, χ i y = 0 := fun i =>
        image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hy (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, h⟩))
      rw [hY]
      simp [h0]
    rw [hgerm _ _ z hev]
    have : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin r, (R i + C + 2 * P i) *
        (tsupport (χ i) ∩ {y | y ∈ V i ∧ 0 < φ i y ∧ φ i y < τ}).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (by have := hR0 i; have := hP0 i; linarith) (hind0 i)
    linarith
  · have hXa : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y a) z :=
      hmulD X z hzU (hXD z hzD)
    have hper : ∀ i : Fin r,
        (∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det *
          ((χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
            (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) a) z) ∧
        -((R i + C + 2 * P i) * (tsupport (χ i) ∩ {y | y ∈ V i ∧ 0 < φ i y ∧ φ i y < τ}).indicator
          (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) ≤
          sepDensDiv G (fun y => (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
            (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) z := by
      intro i
      by_cases hzK : z ∈ tsupport (χ i)
      · have hzT : z ∈ V i ∩ U := hχV i hzK
        have hχd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (χ i) z := (hχ i).differentiable (by simp) z
        have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (φ i) z :=
          ((hφ i).contDiffAt ((hV i).mem_nhds hzT.1)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hNd := hmulD (fun y => -(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y)) z hzU (hNat i z hzT)
        have hbd := hbdiff (χ i) (φ i) τ z hχd hφd
        refine ⟨fun a => ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hfun : (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det *
              ((χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
                (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) a) =
              fun y => (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) *
                  (Real.sqrt (G y).det * (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y)) a) -
                (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) *
                  (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y a) := by
            funext y
            simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul]
            ring
          rw [hfun]
          exact (hbd.mul (hNd a)).sub (hbd.mul (hXa a))
        · have hχ1' : χ i z ≤ 1 :=
            (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hχ0 j z) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans (hχ1 z)
          have hsign : fderiv ℝ (φ i) z (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) z)) ≤ fderiv ℝ (φ i) z (X z) := by
            rw [map_neg]
            have h1 := (hNfacts i).2 z hzT (X z) (hX4 z)
            have h2 := neg_abs_le (fderiv ℝ (φ i) z (X z))
            linarith
          obtain ⟨p1, p2⟩ := s4 (fun y => -(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y)) (χ i) (φ i) τ (R i) (P i) z hτ
            hχd hφd hXa hNd (hχ0 i z) hχ1' (hR i z hzK)
            (hP i z hzK _ (hunit (φ i) z hzU)) (hP i z hzK _ (hX4 z)) hsign
          by_cases hlt : φ i z < τ
          · have hpos : 0 < φ i z := by
              have h : z ∈ V i ∩ D := ⟨hzT.1, hzD⟩
              rw [hVD i] at h
              exact h.2
            rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show z ∈ tsupport (χ i) ∩ {y | y ∈ V i ∧ 0 < φ i y ∧ φ i y < τ}
              from ⟨hzK, hzT.1, hpos, hlt⟩)]
            linarith
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show z ∉ tsupport (χ i) ∩ {y | y ∈ V i ∧ 0 < φ i y ∧ φ i y < τ}
              from fun h => hlt h.2.2.2), p1 (not_lt.1 hlt)]
            simp
      · have hχev : χ i =ᶠ[𝓝 z] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hzK
        have hZev : (fun y => (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
            (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
          filter_upwards [hχev] with y hy
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hy
          simp [hy]
        refine ⟨fun a => ?_, ?_⟩
        · have hev : (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det *
              ((χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
                (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) a) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
            filter_upwards [hZev] with y hy
            rw [hy]
            simp
          exact (differentiableAt_const (0 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
        · rw [hgerm _ _ z hZev, hdiv0, Set.indicator_of_notMem
            (show z ∉ tsupport (χ i) ∩ {y | y ∈ V i ∧ 0 < φ i y ∧ φ i y < τ} from fun h => hzK h.1)]
          simp
    have hYeq : Y τ = fun y => X y + ∑ i : Fin r,
        (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
          (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y) := funext (hY τ)
    rw [hYeq, hlin X (fun i y => (χ i y * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ i y / τ) - 1))) •
      (-(hcrNormalField G (φ i) y) - X y)) z hXa (fun i => (hper i).1)]
    have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r))) fun i _ => (hper i).2
    rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at hsum
    linarith

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_normal_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) : IsOpen {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z → ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 → |fderiv ℝ f z w| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (X z)

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_div_local
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V W₁ W₂ : E3 → E3) (h₁ h₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, V z i = h₁ z * W₁ z i + h₂ z * W₂ z i) (hh₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ h₁ y) (hh₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ h₂ y) (hW₁ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₁ z i) y) (hW₂ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₂ z i) y) : sepDensDiv G V y = h₁ y * sepDensDiv G W₁ y + Real.sqrt (G y).det * fderiv ℝ h₁ y (W₁ y) + (h₂ y * sepDensDiv G W₂ y + Real.sqrt (G y).det * fderiv ℝ h₂ y (W₂ y))

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_sqrtdet_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) T

subgoal_signatures.name: sep_h_props
subgoal_signatures.statement:
ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1) ∧ Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1) ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 1 / 2 → Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1) = 0) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1) = 1) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) t) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, (t ≤ 1 / 2 ∨ 1 ≤ t) → deriv (fun t : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition (2 * t - 1)) t = 0)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (K E : Set M) (hE : sepChartMeas E) (p : M) (ε : ℝ)
    (hBt : Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target)
    (k : ℕ) (φ : Fin k → E3 → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε))
    (hdφ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0)
    (hwall : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε,
      ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ K ↔ ∃ i, φ i z = 0))
    (O : Set M) (hO : O ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source)
    (hOB : chartAt E3 p '' O ⊆ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε) :
    hullRiemPer g E O K ≤
      hspSectorPer (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε) φ
        (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) (chartAt E3 p '' O)

signature.name: hullRiemPer_chart_sector_le
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (K E : Set M) (hE : sepChartMeas E) (p : M) (ε : ℝ)
    (hBt : Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target)
    (k : ℕ) (φ : Fin k → E3 → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε))
    (hdφ : ∀ i, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε, fderiv ℝ (φ i) z ≠ 0)
    (hwall : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε,
      ((chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ K ↔ ∃ i, φ i z = 0))
    (O : Set M) (hO : O ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source)
    (hOB : chartAt E3 p '' O ⊆ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε) :
    hullRiemPer g E O K ≤
      hspSectorPer (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε) φ
