proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set κ := chartAt E3 p with hκ
  set B := Metric.ball (κ p) ε with hBdef
  have hmemS : ∀ (U : Set E3) (ψ : Fin k → E3 → ℝ) (s : Fin k → Bool) (z : E3),
      z ∈ hspSector U ψ s ↔ z ∈ U ∧ ∀ i, 0 < (if s i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ i z :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => Iff.rfl
  
  have hsecOpen : ∀ (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ∀ (ψ : Fin k → E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ i, ContinuousOn (ψ i) U) → ∀ s : Fin k → Bool, IsOpen (hspSector U ψ s) := by
    intro U hU ψ hψ s
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro z hz
    rw [hmemS] at hz
    have h1 : ∀ i, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, 0 < (if s i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ i y := by
      intro i
      have hc : ContinuousAt (fun y => (if s i then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * ψ i y) z :=
        continuousAt_const.mul ((hψ i).continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hz.1))
      exact continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hc (hz.2 i)
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_all.2 h1, hU.mem_nhds hz.1] with y hy hyU
    exact (hmemS U ψ s y).2 ⟨hyU, hy⟩
  
  have hmonoR : ∀ (G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U U' : Set E3), U ⊆ U' →
      sepPerG G' F U ≤ sepPerG G' F U' := by
    intro G' F U U' hUU'
    unfold sepPerG
    exact iSup_mono fun X => iSup_le fun hX =>
      le_iSup_of_le (⟨hX.1, hX.2.1, hX.2.2.1.trans hUU', hX.2.2.2⟩ :
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ U' ∧
          ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G' y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) le_rfl
  
  have hwallT : ∀ (q' : M) (R : Set E3), IsOpen R → R ⊆ (chartAt E3 q').target →
      (∀ z ∈ R, (chartAt E3 q').symm z ∈ κ.source) →
      (∀ z ∈ R, κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z) ∈ B) → ∀ i,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => φ i (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z))) R ∧
        ∀ z ∈ R, fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ i (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z))) z ≠ 0 := by
    intro q' R hR hRt hRs hRB i
    have hTo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q').target ∩ (chartAt E3 q').symm ⁻¹' κ.source) :=
      (chartAt E3 q').isOpen_inter_preimage_symm κ.open_source
    have hT'o : IsOpen (κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) :=
      κ.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 q').open_source
    have hRT : R ⊆ (chartAt E3 q').target ∩ (chartAt E3 q').symm ⁻¹' κ.source :=
      fun z hz => ⟨hRt hz, hRs z hz⟩
    have hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z))
        ((chartAt E3 q').target ∩ (chartAt E3 q').symm ⁻¹' κ.source) := by
      have h : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (κ ∘ (chartAt E3 q').symm)
          ((chartAt E3 q').target ∩ (chartAt E3 q').symm ⁻¹' κ.source) :=
        (contMDiffOn_chart (x := p)).comp
          ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := q')).mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun z hz => hz.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h
    have hσ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (κ.symm y))
        (κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) := by
      have h : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 q' ∘ κ.symm)
          (κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) :=
        (contMDiffOn_chart (x := q')).comp
          ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := p)).mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun z hz => hz.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h
    refine ⟨(hφ i).comp (hτ.mono hRT) (fun z hz => hRB z hz), fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have hw' : (chartAt E3 q').symm z ∈ (chartAt E3 q').source :=
      (chartAt E3 q').map_target (hRt hz)
    have hwκ : (chartAt E3 q').symm z ∈ κ.source := hRs z hz
    have hy₀ : κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z) ∈ κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source := by
      refine ⟨κ.map_source hwκ, ?_⟩
      show κ.symm (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) ∈ (chartAt E3 q').source
      rw [κ.left_inv hwκ]; exact hw'
    have hσy : chartAt E3 q' (κ.symm (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z))) = z := by
      rw [κ.left_inv hwκ, (chartAt E3 q').right_inv (hRt hz)]
    have hdτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) z :=
      (hτ.contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds (hRT hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hdτ' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z))
        (chartAt E3 q' (κ.symm (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)))) := by rw [hσy]; exact hdτ
    have hdσ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (κ.symm y))
        (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) :=
      (hσ.contDiffAt (hT'o.mem_nhds hy₀)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hdf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (φ i) (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) :=
      ((hφ i).contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hRB z hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hev : ((fun z => κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) ∘ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (κ.symm y)))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z))] id := by
      filter_upwards [hT'o.mem_nhds hy₀] with y hy
      show κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm (chartAt E3 q' (κ.symm y))) = y
      rw [(chartAt E3 q').left_inv hy.2, κ.right_inv hy.1]
    have hcomp : fderiv ℝ ((fun z => κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) ∘
          (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (κ.symm y))) (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) =
        (fderiv ℝ (fun z => κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z))
          (chartAt E3 q' (κ.symm (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z))))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (κ.symm y)) (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z))) :=
      fderiv_comp _ hdτ' hdσ
    rw [hσy, hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id] at hcomp
    have hid : ∀ v, fderiv ℝ (fun z => κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) z
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (κ.symm y)) (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) v) = v := by
      intro v
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => L v) hcomp
      simpa using h1.symm
    intro h0
    apply hdφ i (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) (hRB z hz)
    have hc : fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ i (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z))) z =
        (fderiv ℝ (φ i) (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun z => κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) z) := fderiv_comp z hdf hdτ
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, ← hid v]
    have h2 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ =>
      L (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (κ.symm y)) (κ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) v))
      (hc.symm.trans h0)
    simpa using h2
  
  have hS4 : ∀ (G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (R : Set E3), IsOpen R →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G' y a b) R) → (∀ y ∈ R, (G' y).PosDef) →
      ∀ (ψ : Fin k → E3 → ℝ), (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ψ i) R) →
      (∀ i, ∀ z ∈ R, fderiv ℝ (ψ i) z ≠ 0) →
      ∀ (Kc : Set E3), (∀ z ∈ R, z ∈ Kc → ∃ i, ψ i z = 0) →
      ∀ (F : Set E3), MeasurableSet F →
      hullPerG G' F R Kc ≤ ∑ s : Fin k → Bool, sepPerG G' (F ∩ hspSector R ψ s) R := by
    intro G' R hR hG' hpd' ψ hψ hdψ Kc hKc F hF
    unfold hullPerG
    refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
    obtain ⟨hX1, hX2, hX3, hX4, C, hX5⟩ := hX
    
    have hf0 : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → sepDensDiv G' X y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy
      unfold sepDensDiv
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
      have hev' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G' z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        hev.mono fun z hz => by simp [hz]
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev'.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    
    have hfm : Measurable (fun y => sepDensDiv G' X y) :=
      Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ _ _
    have hTm : MeasurableSet (tsupport X) := (isClosed_tsupport X).measurableSet
    have hfint : Integrable (sepDensDiv G' X) := by
      have hon : IntegrableOn (sepDensDiv G' X) (tsupport X) :=
        Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded hX2.isCompact.measure_lt_top.ne

    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E U K A B : Set M) (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B)
    (hUAB : U ⊆ A ∪ B) (hnull : sepChartNull (K ∩ A)) :

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E U K A B : Set M) (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B)
    (hUAB : U ⊆ A ∪ B) (hnull : sepChartNull (K ∩ A)) :
    hullRiemPer g E U K ≤ hullRiemPer g E (U ∩ A) K + hullRiemPer g E (U ∩ B) K

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ (ψ h : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ y → ∀ (Mb : ℝ),
      (∀ z, |h z| ≤ Mb) → ∀ (i : Fin 3),
      |partialDeriv i (fun z => ψ z * h z) y - ψ y * partialDeriv i h y| ≤
        Mb * ‖fderiv ℝ ψ y‖ := by
    intro ψ h y hψ Mb hM i
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ Mb := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hM y)
    have he : ‖e i‖ = 1 := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    have hop : |fderiv ℝ ψ y (e i)| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ ψ y‖ := by
      have := (fderiv ℝ ψ y).le_opNorm (e i)
      rw [he, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact this
    unfold partialDeriv
    by_cases hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ h y
    · have hfm : (fun z => ψ z * h z) = ψ * h := rfl
      rw [hfm, fderiv_mul hψ hh]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [show ψ y * (fderiv ℝ h y) (e i) + h y * (fderiv ℝ ψ y) (e i) -
          ψ y * (fderiv ℝ h y) (e i) = h y * (fderiv ℝ ψ y) (e i) by ring, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hM y) hop (abs_nonneg _) hM0
    · rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hh]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero, sub_zero]
      by_cases hψy : ψ y ≠ 0
      · have hnd : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ψ z * h z) y := by
          intro hd
          apply hh
          have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (ψ z * h z) * (ψ z)⁻¹) y :=
            hd.mul (hψ.inv hψy)
          refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
          filter_upwards [hψ.continuousAt.eventually_ne hψy] with z hz
          field_simp
        rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hnd]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, abs_zero]
        positivity
      · push_neg at hψy
        by_cases hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ψ z * h z) y
        · have hℓ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y + t • e i) (e i) 0 := by
            simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const (e i)).const_add y
          have hℓ0 : y = y + (0 : ℝ) • e i := by simp
          have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ψ (y + t • e i) * h (y + t • e i))
              (fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ z * h z) y (e i)) 0 :=
            hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hℓ hℓ0
          have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ψ (y + t • e i)) (fderiv ℝ ψ y (e i)) 0 :=
            hψ.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hℓ hℓ0
          have t1 := h1.tendsto_slope_zero
          have t2 := h2.tendsto_slope_zero
          simp only [zero_add, zero_smul, add_zero, hψy, zero_mul, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at t1 t2
          have t1' := t1.abs
          have t2' := (t2.abs).const_mul Mb
          have key : |fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ z * h z) y (e i)| ≤
              Mb * |fderiv ℝ ψ y (e i)| := by
            refine le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' t1' t2' fun t => ?_
            have hb := hM (y + t • e i)
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul]
            have h3 : 0 ≤ |t⁻¹| * |ψ (y + t • e i)| := by positivity
            nlinarith
          exact key.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hop hM0)
        · rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hd]
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, abs_zero]
          positivity
  
  have s2 : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Set E3),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => G y i j) T) →
      (∀ y ∈ T, ∀ v : E3, v ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * v i * v j) →
      ∀ (X : E3 → E3), HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ T →
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →
      ∃ Mb : ℝ, ∀ (z : E3) (i : Fin 3), |Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i| ≤ Mb := by
    intro G T hG hpos X hXc hXT hXn
    have hK0c : IsCompact (tsupport X) := hXc.isCompact
    rcases (tsupport X).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hE | hNE
    · refine ⟨0, fun z i => ?_⟩
      have hz : z ∉ tsupport X := by rw [hE]; exact Set.notMem_empty z
      have h0 : X z i = 0 := by simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz]
      rw [h0, mul_zero, abs_zero]
    · have hGK : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => G y i j) (tsupport X) :=
        fun i j => (hG i j).mono hXT
      have hdet : ContinuousOn (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) (tsupport X) := by
        have heq : (fun z => (G z).det) = fun z =>
            G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
              - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
              + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0 := by
          funext z; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
        have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun z => (G z).det) (tsupport X) := by
          rw [heq]
          have h := hGK
          exact (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub
            (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
            (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
            (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
        exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn h1
      obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hK0c.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hdet
      have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous fun v : E3 => v i := fun i => by fun_prop
      have hQc : ContinuousOn
          (fun p : E3 × E3 => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G p.1 i j * p.2 i * p.2 j)
          (tsupport X ×ˢ sphere (0 : E3) 1) := by
        refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
        refine (((hGK i j).comp continuousOn_fst (fun p hp => hp.1)).mul ?_).mul ?_
        · exact ((hcoord i).comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
        · exact ((hcoord j).comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
      have hPc : IsCompact (tsupport X ×ˢ sphere (0 : E3) 1) :=
        hK0c.prod (isCompact_sphere 0 1)
      have hPne : (tsupport X ×ˢ sphere (0 : E3) 1).Nonempty :=
        hNE.prod (NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.2 zero_le_one)
      obtain ⟨⟨z₀, v₀⟩, hp₀, hmin⟩ := hPc.exists_isMinOn hPne hQc
      have hv₀ : v₀ ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        have h1 := hp₀.2
        rw [h] at h1
        simp at h1
      have hlam0 : 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G z₀ i j * v₀ i * v₀ j :=
        hpos z₀ (hXT hp₀.1) v₀ hv₀
      obtain ⟨lam, hlamdef⟩ : ∃ l : ℝ, l = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G z₀ i j * v₀ i * v₀ j :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hlamdef] at hlam0
      have hXb : ∀ z i, |X z i| ≤ 1 + 1 / lam := by
        intro z i
        have hl1 : 0 < 1 / lam := one_div_pos.2 hlam0
        by_cases hz : X z = 0
        · have h0 : X z i = 0 := by simp [hz]
          rw [h0, abs_zero]; linarith
        · have hzK : z ∈ tsupport X := subset_tsupport X (Function.mem_support.2 hz)
          have hwn : 0 < ‖X z‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hz
          have hvs : ‖X z‖⁻¹ • X z ∈ sphere (0 : E3) 1 := by
            rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm,
              inv_mul_cancel₀ hwn.ne']
          have hQw : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * X z a * X z b =
              ‖X z‖ ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
                G z a b * (‖X z‖⁻¹ • X z) a * (‖X z‖⁻¹ • X z) b := by
            simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
            field_simp
          have hle := isMinOn_iff.mp hmin (z, ‖X z‖⁻¹ • X z) ⟨hzK, hvs⟩
          simp only at hle
          rw [← hlamdef] at hle
          have hQ1 := hXn z
          have hsq : ‖X z‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / lam := by
            rw [le_div_iff₀ hlam0]
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖X z‖]
          have hi : |X z i| ≤ ‖X z‖ := by
            have := PiLp.norm_apply_le (X z) i
            rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖X z‖ - 1)]
      refine ⟨|S| * (1 + 1 / lam), fun z i => ?_⟩
      have hl1 : 0 < 1 / lam := one_div_pos.2 hlam0
      by_cases hz : z ∈ tsupport X
      · rw [abs_mul]
        have h1 : |Real.sqrt (G z).det| ≤ |S| := by
          have := hS z hz
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
          exact this.trans (le_abs_self S)
        exact mul_le_mul h1 (hXb z i) (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)
      · have h0 : X z i = 0 := by simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz]
        rw [h0, mul_zero, abs_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
  
  have s3 : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Set E3), IsOpen T →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) T →
      ∀ (Kc : Set E3) (X : E3 → E3), (∀ y, y ∉ Kc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) →
      tsupport X ⊆ T → ∀ (ψ₁ ψ₂ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ₁ → ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ₂ →
      (∀ y ∈ tsupport X, ψ₁ y + ψ₂ y = 1) → ∀ (y : E3), y ∉ Kc ∩ tsupport ψ₁ →
      sepDensDiv G X y =
        sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψ₁ z • X z) y + sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψ₂ z • X z) y := by
    intro G T hT hsq Kc X hXs hXT ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁ hψ₂ hsum y hy
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    by_cases hyX : y ∈ tsupport X
    · by_cases hyK : y ∈ Kc
      · have hy1 : y ∉ tsupport ψ₁ := fun h => hy ⟨hyK, h⟩
        have hψ0 : ψ₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hy1
        have e1 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψ₁ z • X z) i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
            fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
          hψ0.mono fun z hz => by simp [hz]
        have e2 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψ₂ z • X z) i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
            fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i := by
          refine hψ0.mono fun z hz => ?_
          by_cases hzX : z ∈ tsupport X
          · have h1 := hsum z hzX
            have h2 : ψ₁ z = 0 := hz
            have h3 : ψ₂ z = 1 := by linarith
            simp [h3]
          · simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hzX]
        rw [e1.fderiv_eq, e2.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      · have hyT : y ∈ T := hXT hyX
        have hsqy : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y :=
          (hsq.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hyT)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hXi : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => X z i) y :=
          (((contDiffAt_piLp _).1 (hXs y hyK)) i).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have f1 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψ₁ z • X z) i) =
            fun z => ψ₁ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
          funext z; simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
        have f2 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψ₂ z • X z) i) =
            fun z => ψ₂ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
          funext z; simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
        have d1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ψ₁ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i)) y :=
          (hψ₁.differentiable (by simp) y).mul (hsqy.mul hXi)
        have d2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ψ₂ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i)) y :=
          (hψ₂.differentiable (by simp) y).mul (hsqy.mul hXi)
        have hf : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =
            (fun z => ψ₁ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i)) +
              (fun z => ψ₂ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i)) := by
          funext z
          simp only [Pi.add_apply]
          by_cases hzX : z ∈ tsupport X
          · have h1 := hsum z hzX
            have : ψ₁ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) +
                ψ₂ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i)
                = (ψ₁ z + ψ₂ z) * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by ring
            rw [this, h1, one_mul]
          · simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hzX]
        rw [f1, f2, hf, fderiv_add d1 d2, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    · have hX0 : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hyX
      have e0 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        hX0.mono fun z hz => by simp [hz]
      have e1 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψ₁ z • X z) i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        hX0.mono fun z hz => by simp [hz]
      have e2 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψ₂ z • X z) i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        hX0.mono fun z hz => by simp [hz]
      rw [e0.fderiv_eq, e1.fderiv_eq, e2.fderiv_eq]
      simp
  
  have s4 : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X : E3 → E3), HasCompactSupport X →
      ∀ (C : ℝ), (∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C) → Integrable (sepDensDiv G X) := by
    intro G X hXc C hC
    have hmeas : Measurable (sepDensDiv G X) := by
      have : sepDensDiv G X = fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y (e i) := rfl
      rw [this]
      exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ _ _
    have hsupp : Function.support (sepDensDiv G X) ⊆ tsupport X := by
      intro y hy
      by_contra hy'
      apply hy
      have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy'
      unfold sepDensDiv
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
      have hev' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        hev.mono fun z hz => by simp [hz]
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev'.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hon : IntegrableOn (sepDensDiv G X) (tsupport X) :=
      Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded hXc.isCompact.measure_lt_top.ne
        hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
        (M := C) (ae_of_all _ fun y => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hC y)
    exact (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset hsupp).1 hon
  
  have HL : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Set E3), IsOpen T →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) T) →
      (∀ y ∈ T, 0 < (G y).det) →
      (∀ y ∈ T, ∀ v : E3, v ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * v i * v j) →
      ∀ (F O OA OB Kc : Set E3), O ⊆ T → IsOpen OA → IsOpen OB → O ⊆ OA ∪ OB →
      volume (Kc ∩ OA) = 0 →
      hullPerG G F O Kc ≤ hullPerG G F (O ∩ OA) Kc + hullPerG G F (O ∩ OB) Kc := by
    intro G T hT hG hdet hpos F O OA OB Kc hOT hOA hOB hO hnullc
    have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) T := by
      have hdetC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) T := by
        have heq : (fun z => (G z).det) = fun z =>
            G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
              - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
              + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0 := by
          funext z; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
        rw [heq]
        have h := hG
        exact (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub
          (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
          (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
          (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
      exact hdetC.sqrt (fun x hx => (hdet x hx).ne')
    have hzero : ∀ (Y : E3 → E3) (y : E3), y ∉ tsupport Y → sepDensDiv G Y y = 0 := by
      intro Y y hy
      have hev : Y =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy
      unfold sepDensDiv
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
      have hev' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        hev.mono fun z hz => by simp [hz]
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev'.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have cutoff : ∀ T₀ : Set E3, IsCompact T₀ → T₀ ⊆ OA ∪ OB →
        ∃ ψ₁ ψ₂ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ₁ ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ₂ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ₁ x) ∧
          (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ₂ x) ∧ (∀ x, ψ₁ x + ψ₂ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ T₀, ψ₁ x + ψ₂ x = 1) ∧
          tsupport ψ₁ ⊆ OA ∧ tsupport ψ₂ ⊆ OB := by
      intro T₀ hT₀ hTAB
      let V : Bool → Set E3 := fun b => cond b OA OB
      have hVo : ∀ b, IsOpen (V b) := by
        intro b; cases b
        · exact hOB
        · exact hOA
      have hcov : T₀ ⊆ ⋃ b, V b := by
        intro x hx
        rcases hTAB hx with h | h
        · exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨true, h⟩
        · exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨false, h⟩
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ :=
        SmoothPartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate 𝓘(ℝ, E3) hT₀.isClosed V hVo hcov
      refine ⟨f true, f false, contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp (f true).contMDiff,
        contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp (f false).contMDiff, f.nonneg true, f.nonneg false, ?_, ?_,
        hf true, hf false⟩
      · intro x
        have h := f.sum_le_one x
        rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype, Fintype.sum_bool] at h
        exact h
      · intro x hx
        have h := f.sum_eq_one hx
        rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype, Fintype.sum_bool] at h
        exact h
    have key3 : ∀ (C D : ℝ) (a b : Fin 3 → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → c ≤ 1 → |∑ i, b i| ≤ C →
        (∀ i, |a i - c * b i| ≤ D) → |∑ i, a i| ≤ C + 3 * D := by
      intro C D a b c hc0 hc1 hb ha
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hb ⊢
      have hcb : |c * (b 0 + b 1 + b 2)| ≤ C := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc0]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (b 0 + b 1 + b 2)]
      have hexp : c * (b 0 + b 1 + b 2) = c * b 0 + c * b 1 + c * b 2 := by ring
      rw [hexp] at hcb
      have h0 := ha 0
      have h1 := ha 1
      have h2 := ha 2
      rw [abs_le] at h0 h1 h2 hcb ⊢
      constructor <;> linarith
    unfold hullPerG
    refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
    obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXO, hXn, C, hC⟩ := hX
    obtain ⟨ψ₁, ψ₂, hψ₁s, hψ₂s, hψ₁0, hψ₂0, hsum1, hsumT, hψ₁A, hψ₂B⟩ :=
      cutoff (tsupport X) hXc (hXO.trans hO)
    have hψ₁1 : ∀ x, ψ₁ x ≤ 1 := fun x => by linarith [hsum1 x, hψ₂0 x]
    have hψ₂1 : ∀ x, ψ₂ x ≤ 1 := fun x => by linarith [hsum1 x, hψ₁0 x]
    obtain ⟨Mb, hM⟩ := s2 G T (fun i j => (hG i j).continuousOn) hpos X hXc (hXO.trans hOT) hXn
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ Mb := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hM 0 0)
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hC 0)
    have adm : ∀ (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (W : Set E3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) →
        (∀ x, ψ x ≤ 1) → tsupport ψ ⊆ W →
        ((∀ y, y ∉ Kc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ z • X z) y) ∧
          HasCompactSupport (fun z => ψ z • X z) ∧
          tsupport (fun z => ψ z • X z) ⊆ O ∩ W ∧
          (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (ψ y • X y) i * (ψ y • X y) j ≤ 1) ∧
          ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψ z • X z) y| ≤ C') := by
      intro ψ W hψ hψ0 hψ1 hψW
      have hs2 : HasCompactSupport (fun y => ψ y • X y) := by
        have := hXc.smul_left (f := ψ)
        exact this
      refine ⟨fun y hy => hψ.contDiffAt.smul (hXs y hy), hs2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro y hy
        exact ⟨hXO (tsupport_smul_subset_right ψ X hy), hψW (tsupport_smul_subset_left ψ X hy)⟩
      · intro y
        have heq : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * (ψ y • X y) i * (ψ y • X y) j =
            ψ y ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j := by
          simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
          ring
        rw [heq]
        have h1 := hXn y
        have h2 := hψ0 y
        have h3 := hψ1 y
        have h4 : ψ y ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (ψ y)) (sub_nonneg.2 h1)]
      · obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hXc.isCompact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
          (hψ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).continuousOn
        refine ⟨C + 3 * (Mb * |D|), fun y => ?_⟩
        by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport X
        · have hDy : ‖fderiv ℝ ψ y‖ ≤ |D| := (hD y hy).trans (le_abs_self D)
          have hfun : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψ z • X z) i) =
              fun z => ψ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
            intro i; funext z; simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
          have hr : ∀ i : Fin 3,
              |partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψ z • X z) i) y -
                ψ y * partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y| ≤
                  Mb * |D| := by
            intro i
            rw [hfun i]
            exact (s1 ψ _ y (hψ.differentiable (by simp) y) Mb (fun z => hM z i) i).trans
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDy hM0)
          exact key3 C (Mb * |D|)
            (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (ψ z • X z) i) y)
            (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y)
            (ψ y) (hψ0 y) (hψ1 y) (hC y) hr
        · rw [hzero _ y (fun h => hy (tsupport_smul_subset_right ψ X h)), abs_zero]
          positivity
    have adm₁ := adm ψ₁ OA hψ₁s hψ₁0 hψ₁1 hψ₁A
    have adm₂ := adm ψ₂ OB hψ₂s hψ₂0 hψ₂1 hψ₂B
    obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := adm₁.2.2.2.2
    obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := adm₂.2.2.2.2
    have i₁ : Integrable (sepDensDiv G (fun y => ψ₁ y • X y)) (volume.restrict F) :=
      (s4 G _ adm₁.2.1 C₁ hC₁).integrableOn
    have i₂ : Integrable (sepDensDiv G (fun y => ψ₂ y • X y)) (volume.restrict F) :=
      (s4 G _ adm₂.2.1 C₂ hC₂).integrableOn
    have hae : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict F), sepDensDiv G X y =
        sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψ₁ z • X z) y + sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψ₂ z • X z) y := by
      refine ae_restrict_of_ae ?_
      refine ae_iff.2 (measure_mono_null ?_ hnullc)
      intro y hy
      by_contra hy'
      have hy'' : y ∉ Kc ∩ tsupport ψ₁ := fun h => hy' ⟨h.1, hψ₁A h.2⟩
      exact hy (s3 G T hT hsq Kc X hXs (hXO.trans hOT) ψ₁ ψ₂ hψ₁s hψ₂s hsumT y hy'')
    have hint : ∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G X y =
        (∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψ₁ z • X z) y) +
          ∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G (fun z => ψ₂ z • X z) y :=
      (integral_congr_ae hae).trans (integral_add i₁ i₂)
    rw [hint]
    refine le_trans ENNReal.ofReal_add_le (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
    · exact le_iSup₂_of_le (fun y => ψ₁ y • X y) adm₁ le_rfl
    · exact le_iSup₂_of_le (fun y => ψ₂ y • X y) adm₂ le_rfl
  
  have hposDef : ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target →
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro q y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  have hQpos : ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → ∀ v : E3, v ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * v i * v j := by
    intro q y hy v hv
    have hx : (fun i => v i : Fin 3 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hv
      ext i
      exact congrFun h i
    have h := (hposDef q y hy).dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
    have key : star (fun i => v i : Fin 3 → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).mulVec (fun i => v i) =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * v i * v j := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [key] at h
    exact h
  
  have hchart : ∀ (q : M) (Wk : Set M), Wk ⊆ U ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source →
      hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
          (chartAt E3 q '' Wk) (chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) ≤
        hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
            (chartAt E3 q '' (Wk ∩ A)) (chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) +
          hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
            (chartAt E3 q '' (Wk ∩ B)) (chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) := by
    intro q Wk hWs
    have hWsrc : Wk ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source := fun x hx => (hWs hx).2
    have hOT : chartAt E3 q '' Wk ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hWsrc hx)
    have hOA : IsOpen (chartAt E3 q '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) :=
      (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hA.inter (chartAt E3 q).open_source)
        Set.inter_subset_right
    have hOB : IsOpen (chartAt E3 q '' (B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) :=
      (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hB.inter (chartAt E3 q).open_source)
        Set.inter_subset_right
    have hO : chartAt E3 q '' Wk ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∪
        chartAt E3 q '' (B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
      rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      rcases hUAB (hWs hx).1 with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨x, ⟨h, hWsrc hx⟩, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨x, ⟨h, hWsrc hx⟩, rfl⟩
    have hnullq : volume (chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩
        chartAt E3 q '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) = 0 := by
      rw [← (chartAt E3 q).injOn.image_inter Set.inter_subset_right Set.inter_subset_right]
      have hset : (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩ (A ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) =
          (K ∩ A) ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, _⟩
          exact ⟨⟨h1, h3⟩, h2⟩
        · rintro ⟨⟨h1, h3⟩, h2⟩
          exact ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3, h2⟩
      rw [hset]
      exact hnull q
    have hinter : ∀ S : Set M, chartAt E3 q '' Wk ∩ chartAt E3 q '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) =
        chartAt E3 q '' (Wk ∩ S) := by
      intro S
      rw [← (chartAt E3 q).injOn.image_inter hWsrc Set.inter_subset_right]
      congr 1
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2, _⟩
        exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        exact ⟨h1, h2, hWsrc h1⟩
    have h := HL (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target (chartAt E3 q).open_target
      (g.smooth q) (fun y hy => (hposDef q y hy).det_pos) (hQpos q)
      (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) (chartAt E3 q '' Wk)
      (chartAt E3 q '' (A ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) (chartAt E3 q '' (B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
      (chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) hOT hOA hOB hO hnullq
    rwa [hinter A, hinter B] at h
  unfold hullRiemPer
  refine iSup_le fun n => iSup_le fun p => iSup_le fun W => iSup_le fun hW => ?_
  have hWA : (∀ k, IsOpen (W k ∩ A) ∧ W k ∩ A ⊆ (U ∩ A) ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) ∧
      Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (W k ∩ A) (W l ∩ A)) :=
    ⟨fun k => ⟨(hW.1 k).1.inter hA,
        fun x hx => ⟨⟨((hW.1 k).2 hx.1).1, hx.2⟩, ((hW.1 k).2 hx.1).2⟩⟩,
      fun k l hkl => (hW.2 hkl).mono Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_left⟩
  have hWB : (∀ k, IsOpen (W k ∩ B) ∧ W k ∩ B ⊆ (U ∩ B) ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) ∧
      Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (W k ∩ B) (W l ∩ B)) :=
    ⟨fun k => ⟨(hW.1 k).1.inter hB,
        fun x hx => ⟨⟨((hW.1 k).2 hx.1).1, hx.2⟩, ((hW.1 k).2 hx.1).2⟩⟩,
      fun k l hkl => (hW.2 hkl).mono Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_left⟩
  refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hchart (p k) (W k) (hW.1 k).2) ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine add_le_add ?_ ?_
  · exact le_iSup_of_le n (le_iSup_of_le p (le_iSup_of_le (fun k => W k ∩ A)
      (le_iSup_of_le hWA le_rfl)))
  · exact le_iSup_of_le n (le_iSup_of_le p (le_iSup_of_le (fun k => W k ∩ B)
      (le_iSup_of_le hWB le_rfl)))

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E3) (hW : IsOpen W) (f : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W) (hdf : ∀ z ∈ W, fderiv ℝ f z ≠ 0) :
    volume (W ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}) = 0

signature.name: submersion_zero_null
signature.statement:
(W : Set E3) (hW : IsOpen W) (f : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W) (hdf : ∀ z ∈ W, fderiv ℝ f z ≠ 0) :
    volume (W ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  refine measure_null_of_locally_null _ ?_
  intro z₀ hz₀
  obtain ⟨hz₀W, hfz₀⟩ := hz₀
  set ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := fderiv ℝ f z₀ with hℓdef
  have hℓ : ℓ ≠ 0 := hdf z₀ hz₀W
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := ContinuousLinearMap.exists_ne_zero hℓ
  set v : E3 := (ℓ w)⁻¹ • w with hvdef
  have hv : ℓ v = 1 := by
    rw [hvdef, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hw]
  clear_value v
  
  set K : Submodule ℝ E3 := LinearMap.ker (ℓ : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) with hKdef
  have hmemK : ∀ y, y ∈ (K : Set E3) ↔ ℓ y = 0 := by
    intro y
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hKdef, LinearMap.mem_ker, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe]
  have hKne : K ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro hK
    have hvK : v ∈ (K : Set E3) := by rw [hK]; exact Submodule.mem_top
    rw [hmemK, hv] at hvK
    exact one_ne_zero hvK
  have hK0 : volume (K : Set E3) = 0 := MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_submodule volume K hKne
  
  have h1 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) W := hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW h1
  have hcontv : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z v) W := hcont.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  set O : Set E3 := W ∩ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z v) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ with hOdef
  have hO : IsOpen O := hcontv.isOpen_inter_preimage hW isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hz₀O : z₀ ∈ O := by
    refine ⟨hz₀W, ?_⟩
    show fderiv ℝ f z₀ v ∈ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℝ)
    rw [← hℓdef, hv]
    exact one_ne_zero
  
  have hfstrict : HasStrictFDerivAt f ℓ z₀ :=
    (hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hz₀W)).hasStrictFDerivAt (by simp)
  have hΦstrict0 : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y + (f y - ℓ y) • v)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 + (ℓ - ℓ).smulRight v) z₀ :=
    (hasStrictFDerivAt_id z₀).add ((hfstrict.sub ℓ.hasStrictFDerivAt).smul_const v)
  have hid : ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 + (ℓ - ℓ).smulRight v =
      ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ E3 : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) := by
    ext x : 1
    simp
  have hs : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y + (f y - ℓ y) • v)
      ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ E3 : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) z₀ :=
    hΦstrict0.congr_fderiv hid
  set P := HasStrictFDerivAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph (fun y : E3 => y + (f y - ℓ y) • v) hs
    with hPdef
  have hz₀P : z₀ ∈ P.source := hs.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
  have hPcoe : (P : E3 → E3) = fun y : E3 => y + (f y - ℓ y) • v :=
    hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe
  have hΦder : ∀ z ∈ W, HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y + (f y - ℓ y) • v)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 + (fderiv ℝ f z - ℓ).smulRight v) z := by
    intro z hz
    have hfz : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f z) z :=
      ((hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    exact (hasFDerivAt_id z).add ((hfz.sub ℓ.hasFDerivAt).smul_const v)
  have hkey : ∀ z, ℓ (P z) = f z := by
    intro z
    rw [hPcoe]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hv, mul_one]
    ring
  refine ⟨W ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∩ (P.source ∩ O),
    inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ ((P.open_source.inter hO).mem_nhds ⟨hz₀P, hz₀O⟩), ?_⟩
  set S : Set E3 := P.target ∩ P.symm ⁻¹' O ∩ (K : Set E3) with hSdef
  have hsub : W ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∩ (P.source ∩ O) ⊆ P.symm '' S := by
    rintro z ⟨⟨hzW, hfz⟩, hzP, hzO⟩
    refine ⟨P z, ⟨⟨P.map_source hzP, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, P.left_inv hzP⟩
    · show P.symm (P z) ∈ O
      rw [P.left_inv hzP]
      exact hzO
    · rw [hmemK, hkey]
      exact hfz
  refine measure_mono_null hsub ?_
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ P.symm S := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨⟨hyT, hyO⟩, _⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨hzW, hzv⟩ := (hyO : P.symm y ∈ O)
    have hm : fderiv ℝ f (P.symm y) v ≠ 0 := hzv
    set m : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := fderiv ℝ f (P.symm y) with hmdef
    have hμv : (m - ℓ) v = m v - 1 := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, hv]
    let A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 + (m - ℓ).smulRight v
    let B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - ((m v)⁻¹ • (m - ℓ)).smulRight v
    have hA : ∀ x, A x = x + (m - ℓ) x • v := fun x => rfl
    have hB : ∀ x, B x = x - ((m v)⁻¹ * (m - ℓ) x) • v := fun x => rfl
    have hAB : ∀ x, A (B x) = x := by
      intro x
      rw [hA, hB, map_sub, map_smul, hμv, smul_eq_mul]
      have hc : (m - ℓ) x - (m v)⁻¹ * (m - ℓ) x * (m v - 1) = (m v)⁻¹ * (m - ℓ) x := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [hc]
      abel
    have hBA : ∀ x, B (A x) = x := by
      intro x
      rw [hB, hA, map_add, map_smul, hμv, smul_eq_mul]
      have hc : (m v)⁻¹ * ((m - ℓ) x + (m - ℓ) x * (m v - 1)) = (m - ℓ) x := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [hc]
      abel
    let eqv : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3 := ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse A B hBA hAB
    have he : (eqv : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 + (m - ℓ).smulRight v := rfl
    have hPd : HasFDerivAt P (eqv : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (P.symm y) := by
      rw [hPcoe, he]
      exact hΦder _ hzW
    exact (P.hasFDerivAt_symm hyT hPd).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  exact MeasureTheory.addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn_of_addHaar_eq_zero volume hdiff
    (measure_mono_null (fun y hy => hy.2) hK0)

signature.name: sfr_normal_unit
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (W₀ : Set E3)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W₀, (G y).PosDef) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (hdφ : ∀ z ∈ W₀, fderiv ℝ φ z ≠ 0) :
    ∀ y ∈ W₀,
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a φ y * partialDeriv b φ y ∧
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        G y a b * hcrNormalField G φ y a * hcrNormalField G φ y b = 1

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y hy
  have hA : (G y).PosDef := hpd y hy
  have quad : ∀ (B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, B a b * x a * x b = dotProduct x (B.mulVec x) := by
    intro B x
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => by ring))
  set ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun a => partialDeriv a φ y with hξdef
  have hξne : ξ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hdφ y hy
    have hL : ∀ a : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ φ y (e a) = 0 := fun a => congrFun h0 a
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.coe_injective
    refine (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext (fun i => ?_)
    simp only [OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    exact hL i
  set s : ℝ := ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a φ y * partialDeriv b φ y
    with hsdef
  have hs_eq : s = dotProduct ξ ((G y)⁻¹.mulVec ξ) := quad (G y)⁻¹ ξ
  have hs : 0 < s := by
    rw [hs_eq]
    have h := hA.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξne
    simpa using h
  refine ⟨hs, ?_⟩
  set w : Fin 3 → ℝ := (G y)⁻¹.mulVec ξ with hwdef
  have hN : ∀ a : Fin 3, hcrNormalField G φ y a = (Real.sqrt s)⁻¹ * w a := by
    intro a
    rfl
  have hdet : IsUnit (G y).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hA.det_pos)
  have hAw : (G y).mulVec w = ξ := by
    rw [hwdef, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hQw : dotProduct w ((G y).mulVec w) = s := by
    rw [hAw, dotProduct_comm, hs_eq]
  have hsum : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      G y a b * hcrNormalField G φ y a * hcrNormalField G φ y b =
      ((Real.sqrt s)⁻¹) ^ 2 * dotProduct w ((G y).mulVec w) := by
    rw [← quad, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
    rw [hN a, hN b]
    ring
  rw [hsum, hQw, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hs.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs.ne']

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (W₀ : Set E3)
    (hW₀ : IsOpen W₀) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W₀, (G y).PosDef) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ W₀)
    (hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hcrNormalField G φ) W₀)
    (hN1 : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      G y a b * hcrNormalField G φ y a * hcrNormalField G φ y b ≤ 1)
    (χ : E3 → ℝ) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (hχ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y) (hχ1 : ∀ y, χ y ≤ 1)
    (T : Set E3) (hχT : ∀ y, y ∉ T → χ y = 0)
    (S : Set E3) (hSW : S ⊆ W₀)
    (Y : E3 → E3) (hYs : ∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y z)
    (hYT : ∀ y, y ∉ T → Y y = 0)
    (hYn : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * Y y a * Y y b ≤ χ y ^ 2)
    (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    (∀ z ∈ S, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z) ∧
    (∀ y, y ∉ T → sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y = 0) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      G y a b * sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y a * sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y b ≤ χ y ^ 2)

signature.name: sfr_wall_field_regular
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (W₀ : Set E3)
    (hW₀ : IsOpen W₀) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W₀, (G y).PosDef) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ W₀)
    (hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hcrNormalField G φ) W₀)
    (hN1 : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      G y a b * hcrNormalField G φ y a * hcrNormalField G φ y b ≤ 1)
    (χ : E3 → ℝ) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (hχ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y) (hχ1 : ∀ y, χ y ≤ 1)
    (T : Set E3) (hχT : ∀ y, y ∉ T → χ y = 0)
    (S : Set E3) (hSW : S ⊆ W₀)
    (Y : E3 → E3) (hYs : ∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y z)
    (hYT : ∀ y, y ∉ T → Y y = 0)
    (hYn : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * Y y a * Y y b ≤ χ y ^ 2)
    (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    (∀ z ∈ S, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z) ∧
    (∀ y, y ∉ T → sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y = 0) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      G y a b * sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y a * sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y b ≤ χ y ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hθ01 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ sfrTheta φ τ y ∧ sfrTheta φ τ y ≤ 1 := fun y =>
    ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
  have hcoord : ∀ (y : E3) (a : Fin 3), sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y a =
      sfrTheta φ τ y * Y y a - ((1 - sfrTheta φ τ y) * χ y) * hcrNormalField G φ y a := by
    intro y a
    simp only [sfrWall, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    have hzW : W₀ ∈ 𝓝 z := hW₀.mem_nhds (hSW hz)
    have hφz : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φ z := hφ.contDiffAt hzW
    have hNz : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (hcrNormalField G φ) z := hN.contDiffAt hzW
    have hχz : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ χ z := hχ.contDiffAt
    have hθz : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => sfrTheta φ τ y) z := by
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => 2 * (φ y / τ) - 1) z :=
        (contDiffAt_const.mul (hφz.div_const τ)).sub contDiffAt_const
      exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp_contDiffAt z h1
    rcases lt_or_ge 0 (φ z) with hpos | hneg
    · have hYz : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y z := hYs z hz hpos
      exact (hθz.smul hYz).sub (((contDiffAt_const.sub hθz).mul hχz).smul hNz)
    · have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, φ y < τ / 2 :=
        hφz.continuousAt.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by linarith)
      have heq : sfrWall G φ χ τ Y =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun y => -(χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
        have h0 : sfrTheta φ τ y = 0 := by
          unfold sfrTheta
          apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
          have : φ y / τ < 1 / 2 := by rw [div_lt_iff₀ hτ]; linarith
          linarith
        simp only [sfrWall, h0, zero_smul, sub_zero, one_mul, zero_sub]
      exact (hχz.smul hNz).neg.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  · intro y hy
    simp [sfrWall, hYT y hy, hχT y hy]
  · intro y hy
    simp only [hcoord]
    obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := hθ01 y
    have hu := hYn y hy
    have hn := hN1 y hy
    have hd : 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b *
        (Y y a + χ y * hcrNormalField G φ y a) * (Y y b + χ y * hcrNormalField G φ y b) := by
      have h := (hpd y hy).posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
        (fun a => Y y a + χ y * hcrNormalField G φ y a)
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h ⊢
      linarith
    have h1 := mul_nonneg ht0 (sub_nonneg.2 hu)
    have h2 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 ht1) (sq_nonneg (χ y))) (sub_nonneg.2 hn)
    have h3 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht0 (sub_nonneg.2 ht1)) hd
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (W₀ : Set E3) (hW₀ : IsOpen W₀)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) W₀)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W₀, (G y).PosDef) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ W₀)
    (hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hcrNormalField G φ) W₀)
    (hNcs : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 →
      |fderiv ℝ φ y w| ≤ fderiv ℝ φ y (hcrNormalField G φ y))
    (χ : E3 → ℝ) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (hχ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y) (hχ1 : ∀ y, χ y ≤ 1)
    (T : Set E3) (hT : IsCompact T) (hTW : T ⊆ W₀) (hχT : ∀ y, y ∉ T → χ y = 0)
    (S : Set E3) (hSW : S ⊆ W₀)
    (Y : E3 → E3) (hYs : ∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y z)
    (hYn : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * Y y a * Y y b ≤ χ y ^ 2)
    (hYd : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z → |sepDensDiv G Y z| ≤ C) :
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, |sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z| ≤ C) ∧
    (∀ z, z ∉ T → sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z = 0) ∧
    ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
      (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, |sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z| ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z →
        sfrTheta φ τ z * sepDensDiv G Y z -
            (1 - sfrTheta φ τ z) * sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z ≤
          sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ S, φ z ≤ 0 → (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, χ y = 1) →
        sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z = -sepDensDiv G (hcrNormalField G φ) z)

signature.name: sfr_wall_field_div
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (W₀ : Set E3) (hW₀ : IsOpen W₀)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) W₀)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W₀, (G y).PosDef) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ W₀)
    (hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hcrNormalField G φ) W₀)
    (hNcs : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 →
      |fderiv ℝ φ y w| ≤ fderiv ℝ φ y (hcrNormalField G φ y))
    (χ : E3 → ℝ) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (hχ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y) (hχ1 : ∀ y, χ y ≤ 1)
    (T : Set E3) (hT : IsCompact T) (hTW : T ⊆ W₀) (hχT : ∀ y, y ∉ T → χ y = 0)
    (S : Set E3) (hSW : S ⊆ W₀)
    (Y : E3 → E3) (hYs : ∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y z)
    (hYn : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * Y y a * Y y b ≤ χ y ^ 2)
    (hYd : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z → |sepDensDiv G Y z| ≤ C) :
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z, |sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z| ≤ C) ∧
    (∀ z, z ∉ T → sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z = 0) ∧
    ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ →
      (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ S, |sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z| ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ S, 0 < φ z →
        sfrTheta φ τ z * sepDensDiv G Y z -
            (1 - sfrTheta φ τ z) * sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z ≤
          sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ S, φ z ≤ 0 → (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, χ y = 1) →
        sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z = -sepDensDiv G (hcrNormalField G φ) z)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hρ : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) y := by
    intro y hy
    have hGa : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) y :=
      fun i j => (hG i j).contDiffAt (hW₀.mem_nhds hy)
    have hdet : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) y := by
      have e1 : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y =>
          G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2 - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1
            - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2 + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0
            + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
        funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
      rw [e1]
      have h00 := hGa 0 0
      have h01 := hGa 0 1
      have h02 := hGa 0 2
      have h10 := hGa 1 0
      have h11 := hGa 1 1
      have h12 := hGa 1 2
      have h20 := hGa 2 0
      have h21 := hGa 2 1
      have h22 := hGa 2 2
      exact ((((((h00.mul h11).mul h22).sub ((h00.mul h12).mul h21)).sub
        ((h01.mul h10).mul h22)).add ((h01.mul h12).mul h20)).add
        ((h02.mul h10).mul h21)).sub ((h02.mul h11).mul h20)
    exact hdet.sqrt (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hproj : ∀ (V : E3 → E3) (y : E3) (i : Fin 3), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ V y →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => V z i) y := by
    intro V y i h
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp y h
  
  have hb : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) := by
    intro i
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ W₀
    · have hNi : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => hcrNormalField G φ z i) y :=
        hproj _ y i (hN.contDiffAt (hW₀.mem_nhds hy))
      have e1 : (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) =
          fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y * hcrNormalField G φ y i) := by
        funext y; simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [e1]
      exact (hρ y hy).mul (hχ.contDiffAt.mul hNi)
    · have hyT : y ∉ T := fun h => hy (hTW h)
      have hev : (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hT.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hyT] with x hx
        simp [hχT x hx]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hpdb : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (y : E3) (i : Fin 3), ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ C →
      |partialDeriv i f y| ≤ C := by
    intro f C y i h
    have h1 : ‖fderiv ℝ f y (e i)‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ * ‖e i‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
    have h2 : ‖e i‖ = 1 := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    rw [h2, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1.trans h
  have hbB : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) y‖ ≤ C := by
    intro i
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport
        (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) :=
      HasCompactSupport.intro hT (fun y hy => by simp [hχT y hy])
    exact (hcs.fderiv ℝ).exists_bound_of_continuous ((hb i).continuous_fderiv (by simp))
  obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := hbB 0
  obtain ⟨C1, hC1⟩ := hbB 1
  obtain ⟨C2, hC2⟩ := hbB 2
  have hdivB : ∀ z, |sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z| ≤ C0 + C1 + C2 := by
    intro z
    simp only [sepDensDiv]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have a0 := hpdb _ _ z 0 (hC0 z)
    have a1 := hpdb _ _ z 1 (hC1 z)
    have a2 := hpdb _ _ z 2 (hC2 z)
    exact (abs_add_three _ _ _).trans (by linarith)
  have hzero : ∀ z, z ∉ T → sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    have hev : (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hT.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hz] with x hx
      simp [hχT x hx]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have hBN : ∀ z, (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, χ y = 1) →
      sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z = sepDensDiv G (hcrNormalField G φ) z := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have hev : (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * hcrNormalField G φ y i) := by
      filter_upwards [hz] with y hy
      simp [hy]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  
  have hQs : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t : ℝ) (u : E3),
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * (t • u) a * (t • u) b =
        t ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * u a * u b := by
    intro A t u
    simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hN0 : ∀ y ∈ W₀, 0 ≤ fderiv ℝ φ y (hcrNormalField G φ y) := by
    intro y hy
    have h := hNcs y hy 0 (by simp)
    simpa using h
  have hcs : ∀ y ∈ W₀, ∀ (u : E3) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c →
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * u a * u b ≤ c ^ 2 →
      |fderiv ℝ φ y u| ≤ c * fderiv ℝ φ y (hcrNormalField G φ y) := by
    intro y hy u c hc hu
    rcases hc.lt_or_eq with hc | hc
    · have hw := hNcs y hy (c⁻¹ • u) (by
        rw [hQs]
        calc c⁻¹ ^ 2 * _ ≤ c⁻¹ ^ 2 * c ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (by positivity)
          _ = 1 := by field_simp)
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hc)] at hw
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw hc.le
      rwa [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_mul] at h2
    · rw [← hc] at hu ⊢
      rw [zero_mul]
      by_contra hpos
      push_neg at hpos
      have hu' : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * u a * u b ≤ 0 := by simpa using hu
      have ht : 0 < (|fderiv ℝ φ y (hcrNormalField G φ y)| + 1) / |fderiv ℝ φ y u| := by
        positivity
      have hw := hNcs y hy
        (((|fderiv ℝ φ y (hcrNormalField G φ y)| + 1) / |fderiv ℝ φ y u|) • u) (by
          rw [hQs]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((|fderiv ℝ φ y (hcrNormalField G φ y)| + 1) /
            |fderiv ℝ φ y u|)])
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos ht, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hpos.ne'] at hw
      linarith [le_abs_self (fderiv ℝ φ y (hcrNormalField G φ y))]
  
  have hρc : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) W₀ :=
    fun y hy => (hρ y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hFc : ContinuousOn
      (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * fderiv ℝ φ y (hcrNormalField G φ y)) W₀ :=
    hρc.mul ((hφ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW₀ (by simp)).clm_apply hN.continuousOn)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hT.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hFc.mono hTW)
  
  have hs'0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition x :=
    fun x => Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
  obtain ⟨H, hH0, hH⟩ : ∃ H : ℝ, 0 ≤ H ∧ ∀ x, deriv Real.smoothTransition x ≤ H := by
    have hc : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) :=
      (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).continuous_deriv le_rfl
    obtain ⟨H₀, hH₀⟩ :=
      (isCompact_Icc (a := (-1 : ℝ)) (b := 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max H₀ 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x => ?_⟩
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 2
    · have h1 := hH₀ x hx
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h1.trans (le_max_left _ _))
    · have h0 : deriv Real.smoothTransition x = 0 := by
        rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or] at hx
        rcases hx with h | h
        · push_neg at h
          have hev : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
            filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds (show x < 0 by linarith)] with t ht
            exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt ht)
          rw [hev.deriv_eq]
          simp
        · push_neg at h
          have hev : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
            filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds (show (1 : ℝ) < x by linarith)] with t ht
            exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (le_of_lt ht)
          rw [hev.deriv_eq]
          simp
      rw [h0]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨⟨C0 + C1 + C2, hdivB⟩, hzero, fun τ hτ => ?_⟩
  
  have hbeyond : ∀ z ∈ W₀, φ z ≤ 0 →
      sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z =
        -sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z := by
    intro z hz hφz
    have hφc : ContinuousAt φ z := hφ.continuousOn.continuousAt (hW₀.mem_nhds hz)
    have hlt : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, φ y < τ / 2 :=
      hφc.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by linarith)
    simp only [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have hev : (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y i) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        -(fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) := by
      filter_upwards [hlt] with y hy
      have h0 : sfrTheta φ τ y = 0 := by
        unfold sfrTheta
        apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
        have h1 : φ y / τ < 1 / 2 := by rw [div_lt_iff₀ hτ]; linarith
        linarith
      simp [sfrWall, h0]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_neg, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply]
  
  have hformula : ∀ z ∈ W₀, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y z →
      sepDensDiv G (sfrWall G φ χ τ Y) z =
        sfrTheta φ τ z * sepDensDiv G Y z
          - (1 - sfrTheta φ τ z) * sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z
          + Real.sqrt (G z).det *
              (deriv Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1) * (2 * τ⁻¹)) *
              (fderiv ℝ φ z (Y z) + χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z)) := by
    intro z hz hYz
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ z :=
      (hφ.contDiffAt (hW₀.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hψ : HasFDerivAt (fun y => 2 * (φ y * τ⁻¹) - 1) ((2 : ℝ) • (τ⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ φ z)) z :=
      ((hφd.hasFDerivAt.mul_const τ⁻¹).const_mul 2).sub_const 1
    have hθeq : sfrTheta φ τ = Real.smoothTransition ∘ (fun y => 2 * (φ y * τ⁻¹) - 1) := by
      funext y
      simp [sfrTheta, div_eq_mul_inv]
    have hθ : HasFDerivAt (sfrTheta φ τ)
        (deriv Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1) • ((2 : ℝ) • (τ⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ φ z))) z := by
      rw [hθeq]
      exact (((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by norm_num))
        _).hasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt z hψ
    have hd : ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ (sfrTheta φ τ) z v =
        deriv Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1) * (2 * (τ⁻¹ * fderiv ℝ φ z v)) := by
      intro v
      rw [hθ.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hdecomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y i) =
        fun y => sfrTheta φ τ y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * Y y i) +
          (sfrTheta φ τ y - 1) * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) := by
      intro i
      funext y
      simp only [sfrWall, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hpart : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y i) z =
          sfrTheta φ τ z * partialDeriv i (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * Y y i) z
            + (Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) * fderiv ℝ (sfrTheta φ τ) z (e i)
            + ((sfrTheta φ τ z - 1) *
                partialDeriv i (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) z
              + (Real.sqrt (G z).det * (χ z • hcrNormalField G φ z) i) *
                  fderiv ℝ (sfrTheta φ τ) z (e i)) := by
      intro i
      have hYi : HasFDerivAt (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * Y y i)
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * Y y i) z) z :=
        ((hρ z hz).differentiableAt (by simp)).mul
          ((hproj Y z i hYz).differentiableAt (by simp)) |>.hasFDerivAt
      have hbi : HasFDerivAt (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i)
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) z) z :=
        ((hb i).differentiable (by simp) z).hasFDerivAt
      have hθ' : HasFDerivAt (sfrTheta φ τ) (fderiv ℝ (sfrTheta φ τ) z) z :=
        hθ.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
      have hall := (hθ'.mul hYi).add ((hθ'.sub_const 1).mul hbi)
      have key : HasFDerivAt (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * sfrWall G φ χ τ Y y i)
          (sfrTheta φ τ z • fderiv ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * Y y i) z
            + (Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) • fderiv ℝ (sfrTheta φ τ) z
            + ((sfrTheta φ τ z - 1) •
                fderiv ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) i) z
              + (Real.sqrt (G z).det * (χ z • hcrNormalField G φ z) i) •
                  fderiv ℝ (sfrTheta φ τ) z)) z := by
        rw [hdecomp i]
        exact hall
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [key.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hsum : ∀ v : E3, ∑ i : Fin 3, v i * fderiv ℝ (sfrTheta φ τ) z (e i) =
        fderiv ℝ (sfrTheta φ τ) z v := by
      intro v
      have hv : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
        ext j
        fin_cases j <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      conv_rhs => rw [hv]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have h1 := hsum (Y z)
    have h2 := hsum (χ z • hcrNormalField G φ z)
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h1 h2
    have hA := hd (Y z)
    have hB := hd (χ z • hcrNormalField G φ z)
    have hφs : fderiv ℝ φ z (χ z • hcrNormalField G φ z) =
        χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z) := by
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [sepDensDiv]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three, hpart 0, hpart 1, hpart 2]
    linear_combination (Real.sqrt (G z).det) * h1 + (Real.sqrt (G z).det) * h2
      + (Real.sqrt (G z).det) * hA + (Real.sqrt (G z).det) * hB
      + Real.sqrt (G z).det * deriv Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1) * (2 * τ⁻¹) * hφs
  
  have hextra : ∀ z ∈ W₀,
      0 ≤ Real.sqrt (G z).det *
              (deriv Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1) * (2 * τ⁻¹)) *
              (fderiv ℝ φ z (Y z) + χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z)) ∧
      Real.sqrt (G z).det *
              (deriv Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1) * (2 * τ⁻¹)) *
              (fderiv ℝ φ z (Y z) + χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z)) ≤
        H * (2 * τ⁻¹) * (2 * |M|) := by
    intro z hz
    have hτi : 0 < 2 * τ⁻¹ := by have := inv_pos.2 hτ; linarith
    have k1 := hs'0 (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1)
    have k2 := hH (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1)
    have hρ0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (G z).det := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hYc := hcs z hz (Y z) (χ z) (hχ0 z) (hYn z hz)
    have hab := abs_le.1 (show |fderiv ℝ φ z (Y z)| ≤ χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z)
      from hYc)
    have hβ0 : 0 ≤ fderiv ℝ φ z (Y z) + χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z) := by
      linarith [hab.1]
    have hβ1 : fderiv ℝ φ z (Y z) + χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z) ≤
        2 * (χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z)) := by
      linarith [hab.2]
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z) :=
      mul_nonneg hρ0 (hN0 z hz)
    have hχP : χ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z)) ≤ |M| := by
      by_cases hzT : z ∈ T
      · have h1 := hM z hzT
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
        have h2 : Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z) ≤ |M| :=
          (le_abs_self _).trans (h1.trans (le_abs_self _))
        calc χ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z))
            ≤ Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z) :=
              mul_le_of_le_one_left hP0 (hχ1 z)
          _ ≤ |M| := h2
      · rw [hχT z hzT, zero_mul]
        exact abs_nonneg _
    have hc0 : 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1) * (2 * τ⁻¹) :=
      mul_nonneg k1 hτi.le
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hρ0 hc0) hβ0, ?_⟩
    calc Real.sqrt (G z).det *
              (deriv Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1) * (2 * τ⁻¹)) *
              (fderiv ℝ φ z (Y z) + χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z))
        = (deriv Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1) * (2 * τ⁻¹)) *
            (Real.sqrt (G z).det *
              (fderiv ℝ φ z (Y z) + χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z))) := by ring
      _ ≤ (deriv Real.smoothTransition (2 * (φ z * τ⁻¹) - 1) * (2 * τ⁻¹)) *
            (2 * (χ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z)))) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hc0
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hβ1 hρ0
          calc Real.sqrt (G z).det *
                (fderiv ℝ φ z (Y z) + χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z))
              ≤ Real.sqrt (G z).det * (2 * (χ z * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z))) := this
            _ = 2 * (χ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ φ z (hcrNormalField G φ z))) := by
              ring
      _ ≤ H * (2 * τ⁻¹) * (2 * |M|) := by
          apply mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right k2 hτi.le) (by linarith)
          · have := mul_nonneg (hχ0 z) hP0
            linarith
          · exact mul_nonneg hH0 hτi.le
  obtain ⟨CY, hCY⟩ := hYd
  refine ⟨⟨|CY| + (C0 + C1 + C2) + H * (2 * τ⁻¹) * (2 * |M|), fun z hzS => ?_⟩,
    fun z hzS hφz => ?_, fun z hzS hφz hχz => ?_⟩
  · have hz := hSW hzS
    have hτi : 0 < 2 * τ⁻¹ := by have := inv_pos.2 hτ; linarith
    have hK0 : 0 ≤ H * (2 * τ⁻¹) * (2 * |M|) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hH0 hτi.le) (by have := abs_nonneg M; linarith)
    have hCY0 := abs_nonneg CY
    by_cases hφz : φ z ≤ 0
    · rw [hbeyond z hz hφz, abs_neg]
      have := hdivB z
      linarith
    · push_neg at hφz
      rw [hformula z hz (hYs z hzS hφz)]
      obtain ⟨e0, e1⟩ := hextra z hz
      have hθ0 : 0 ≤ sfrTheta φ τ z := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      have hθ1 : sfrTheta φ τ z ≤ 1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
      have hY1 : |sfrTheta φ τ z * sepDensDiv G Y z| ≤ |CY| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hθ0]
        calc sfrTheta φ τ z * |sepDensDiv G Y z| ≤ |sepDensDiv G Y z| :=
              mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hθ1
          _ ≤ CY := hCY z hzS hφz
          _ ≤ |CY| := le_abs_self _
      have hB1 : |(1 - sfrTheta φ τ z) *
          sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z| ≤ C0 + C1 + C2 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
        calc (1 - sfrTheta φ τ z) * |sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z|
            ≤ |sepDensDiv G (fun y => χ y • hcrNormalField G φ y) z| :=
              mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
          _ ≤ C0 + C1 + C2 := hdivB z
      obtain ⟨y1, y2⟩ := abs_le.1 hY1
      obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_le.1 hB1
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith
  · have hz := hSW hzS
    rw [hformula z hz (hYs z hzS hφz)]
    have := (hextra z hz).1
    linarith
  · have hz := hSW hzS
    rw [hbeyond z hz hφz, hBN z hχz]

informal_problem.statement:
(A B T : Set E3) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (hAB : A ⊆ B) (hT : IsCompact T) (φ : E3 → ℝ)
    (hφm : AEStronglyMeasurable φ (volume.restrict A)) (hφA : ∀ z ∈ A, 0 < φ z)
    (f g : E3 → ℝ) (F : ℝ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict A))
    (hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable g (volume.restrict A))
    (hFm : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → AEStronglyMeasurable (F τ) (volume.restrict B))
    (C : ℝ) (hfC : ∀ z ∈ A, |f z| ≤ C) (hgC : ∀ z ∈ A, |g z| ≤ C)
    (hFC : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ B, |F τ z| ≤ C')
    (hfT : ∀ z ∈ A, z ∉ T → f z = 0) (hgT : ∀ z ∈ A, z ∉ T → g z = 0)
    (hFT : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ B, z ∉ T → F τ z = 0)
    (hpos : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ A,
      sfrTheta φ τ z * f z - (1 - sfrTheta φ τ z) * g z ≤ F τ z)
    (hneg : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ B, z ∉ A → 0 ≤ F τ z)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ ∫ z in A, f z ≤ (∫ z in B, F τ z) + η

signature.statement:
(A B T : Set E3) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (hAB : A ⊆ B) (hT : IsCompact T) (φ : E3 → ℝ)
    (hφm : AEStronglyMeasurable φ (volume.restrict A)) (hφA : ∀ z ∈ A, 0 < φ z)
    (f g : E3 → ℝ) (F : ℝ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict A))
    (hgm : AEStronglyMeasurable g (volume.restrict A))
    (hFm : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → AEStronglyMeasurable (F τ) (volume.restrict B))
    (C : ℝ) (hfC : ∀ z ∈ A, |f z| ≤ C) (hgC : ∀ z ∈ A, |g z| ≤ C)
    (hFC : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ B, |F τ z| ≤ C')
    (hfT : ∀ z ∈ A, z ∉ T → f z = 0) (hgT : ∀ z ∈ A, z ∉ T → g z = 0)
    (hFT : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ B, z ∉ T → F τ z = 0)
    (hpos : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ A,
      sfrTheta φ τ z * f z - (1 - sfrTheta φ τ z) * g z ≤ F τ z)
    (hneg : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∀ z ∈ B, z ∉ A → 0 ≤ F τ z)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ ∫ z in A, f z ≤ (∫ z in B, F τ z) + η

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hTm : MeasurableSet T := hT.measurableSet
  have hTfin : volume T < ⊤ := hT.measure_lt_top
  have hind : ∀ (S : Set E3) (D : ℝ),
      Integrable (T.indicator (fun _ => D)) (volume.restrict S) := by
    intro S D
    refine (integrable_indicator_iff hTm).2 ?_
    exact integrableOn_const (ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (Measure.restrict_apply_le S T) hTfin))
  
  have hINT : ∀ (S : Set E3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (D : ℝ), MeasurableSet S →
      AEStronglyMeasurable u (volume.restrict S) → (∀ z ∈ S, |u z| ≤ D) →
      (∀ z ∈ S, z ∉ T → u z = 0) → Integrable u (volume.restrict S) := by
    intro S u D hS hu hD h0
    refine Integrable.mono' (hind S |D|) hu ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hS ?_
    intro z hz
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    by_cases hzT : z ∈ T
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hzT]
      exact (hD z hz).trans (le_abs_self D)
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hzT, h0 z hz hzT, abs_zero]
  have hFi : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → IntegrableOn (F τ) B := by
    intro τ hτ
    obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := hFC τ hτ
    exact hINT B (F τ) C' hB (hFm τ hτ) hC' (hFT τ hτ)
  
  have hθ0 : ∀ τ z, 0 ≤ sfrTheta φ τ z := fun τ z => by
    unfold sfrTheta; exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
  have hθ1 : ∀ τ z, sfrTheta φ τ z ≤ 1 := fun τ z => by
    unfold sfrTheta; exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
  have hθm : ∀ τ : ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => sfrTheta φ τ z) (volume.restrict A) := by
    intro τ
    have h : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => 2 * (φ z / τ) - 1) (volume.restrict A) :=
      (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t : ℝ => 2 * (t / τ) - 1).comp_aestronglyMeasurable hφm
    unfold sfrTheta
    exact Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp_aestronglyMeasurable h
  obtain ⟨τs, hτs⟩ : ∃ τs : ℕ → ℝ, τs = fun m : ℕ => 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hτpos : ∀ m, 0 < τs m := fun m => by rw [hτs]; positivity
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : ℕ → E3 → ℝ, H = fun m z =>
      sfrTheta φ (τs m) z * f z - (1 - sfrTheta φ (τs m) z) * g z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hHm : ∀ m, AEStronglyMeasurable (H m) (volume.restrict A) := by
    intro m
    rw [hH]
    exact ((hθm (τs m)).mul hfm).sub ((aestronglyMeasurable_const.sub (hθm (τs m))).mul hgm)
  have hHC : ∀ m, ∀ z ∈ A, |H m z| ≤ C := by
    intro m z hz
    simp only [hH]
    have t0 := hθ0 (τs m) z
    have t1 := hθ1 (τs m) z
    have hf := abs_le.mp (hfC z hz)
    have hg := abs_le.mp (hgC z hz)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg t0 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ C + f z),
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t1) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ C - g z)]
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg t0 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ C - f z),
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t1) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ C + g z)]
  have hH0 : ∀ m, ∀ z ∈ A, z ∉ T → H m z = 0 := by
    intro m z hz hzT
    simp only [hH, hfT z hz hzT, hgT z hz hzT, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hHi : ∀ m, IntegrableOn (H m) A := fun m =>
    hINT A (H m) C hA (hHm m) (hHC m) (hH0 m)
  
  have hlim : ∀ z ∈ A, Tendsto (fun m => H m z) atTop (𝓝 (f z)) := by
    intro z hz
    have hp := hφA z hz
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge (1 / φ z)

    intro m hm
    have hm' : (N : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_le.2 hm
    have h1 : 1 ≤ φ z * ((m : ℝ) + 1) := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hp] at hN
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm' hp.le]
    have h2 : 1 ≤ 2 * (φ z / τs m) - 1 := by
      rw [hτs]
      simp only
      rw [div_div_eq_mul_div, div_one]
      linarith
    have h3 : sfrTheta φ (τs m) z = 1 := by
      unfold sfrTheta
      exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le h2
    simp only [hH, h3]
    ring
  
  have hDCT : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ z in A, H m z) atTop (𝓝 (∫ z in A, f z)) := by
    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (T.indicator (fun _ => |C|)) hHm
      (hind A |C|) ?_ ?_
    · intro m
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hA ?_
      intro z hz
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      by_cases hzT : z ∈ T
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hzT]
        exact (hHC m z hz).trans (le_abs_self C)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hzT, hH0 m z hz hzT, abs_zero]
    · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hA hlim
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (hDCT.eventually (lt_mem_nhds
    (show (∫ z in A, f z) - η < ∫ z in A, f z by linarith))).exists
  
  have hFiB := hFi (τs m) (hτpos m)
  have hc1 : ∫ z in A, H m z ≤ ∫ z in A, F (τs m) z := by
    refine setIntegral_mono_on (hHi m) (hFiB.mono_set hAB) hA ?_
    intro z hz
    simp only [hH]
    exact hpos (τs m) (hτpos m) z hz
  have hc2 : 0 ≤ ∫ z in B \ A, F (τs m) z :=
    setIntegral_nonneg (hB.diff hA) (fun z hz => hneg (τs m) (hτpos m) z hz.1 hz.2)
  have hc3 := integral_inter_add_diff hA hFiB
  rw [Set.inter_eq_right.2 hAB] at hc3
  exact ⟨τs m, hτpos m, by linarith⟩
