by
  
  have alg : ∀ (g Hs Ric : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (N X φ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (T : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (ψ s : ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 3, Hs i j = Hs j i) → (∀ a b c : Fin 3, T a b c = T b a c) → 0 < s → ψ ^ 2 * s = 1 → (∀ a : Fin 3, X a = ∑ c : Fin 3, N c * Hs a c) → (∀ i : Fin 3, N i = ∑ j : Fin 3, g i j * φ j) → (∀ b : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, g a c * (T b c a - T a c b) = ∑ d : Fin 3, Ric b d * N d) → (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g a b - N a * N b / s) * (3 * ψ ^ 5 * X a * X b - ψ ^ 3 * ((∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ e : Fin 3, g c e * Hs a e * Hs b c) + ∑ c : Fin 3, N c * T b c a))) - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, (g c d - N c * N d / s) * Hs c d) * (∑ a : Fin 3, N a * (-ψ ^ 3 * X a)) / s + ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (g i j - N i * N j / s) * Hs j k * (g k l - N k * N l / s) * Hs l i) / s + (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, Ric j k * N j * N k) / s) * ψ = -ψ ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g i j * ((-ψ ^ 3 * X i) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, g a b * Hs a b) + ψ * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, g a b * T a b i) - 3 * ψ ^ 2 * (-ψ ^ 3 * X i) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, N a * N b * Hs a b) - ψ ^ 3 * ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (∑ e : Fin 3, g a e * Hs i e) * N b * Hs a b) + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, N a * (∑ e : Fin 3, g b e * Hs i e) * Hs a b) + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, N a * N b * T a b i)) * φ j := by
    intro g Hs Ric N X φ T ψ s hHs hT hs hψ hX hN hRic
    have hinv : s⁻¹ = ψ ^ 2 := by
      field_simp
      linarith
    have key : ∀ D : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g i j * D i * φ j =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, D i * N i := by
      intro D
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [hN i, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      ring
    have hRc : ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, Ric j k * N j * N k =
        ∑ j : Fin 3, N j * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, g a c * (T j c a - T a c j) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [hRic j, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      ring
    rw [key, hRc]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, hinv]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hX]
    simp only [hHs 1 0, hHs 2 0, hHs 2 1, hT 1 0, hT 2 0, hT 2 1]
    ring
  
  have hs : 0 < ejpS G Φ y := (ejp_level_regularity G Φ U hU hG hpos hΦ hdΦ).1 y hy
  have hψ : ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 2 * ejpS G Φ y = 1 := by
    simp only [ejpPsi]
    rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hs.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs.ne']
  
  obtain ⟨-, -, hHs, hT⟩ := ejp_sym_facts G Φ U hU hsymm hΦ y hy
  
  have hV : ∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((fun (d : Fin 3) (w : E3) => ejpN G Φ w d) d) U :=
    fun d => (ejp_coord_smooth G Φ U hU hG hpos hΦ).2.2.2.2 d
  have hRic : ∀ b : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ a c * (ejpHess3 G Φ y b c a - ejpHess3 G Φ y a c b) =
        ∑ d : Fin 3, ricci G b d y * ejpN G Φ y d := by
    intro b
    have h7 := ejp_div_commutator G U hU hG hsymm hpos (fun (d : Fin 3) (w : E3) => ejpN G Φ w d)
      hV y hy b
    have h8 := ejp_divN_covariant G Φ U hU hG hsymm hpos hΦ hdΦ y hy b
    rw [← h8]
    exact h7
  
  have h5 : ∀ a b : Fin 3, hessLoc G (ejpPsi G Φ) a b y =
      3 * ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 5 * (∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y) *
        (∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ b c y) -
      ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 3 * ((∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ c e * hessLoc G Φ a e y *
        hessLoc G Φ b c y) + ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * ejpHess3 G Φ y b c a) :=
    fun a b => ejp_hess_psi G Φ U hU hG hsymm hpos hΦ hdΦ y hy a b
  have h4 := (ejp_first_derivs G Φ U hU hG hsymm hpos hΦ hdΦ y hy).2.2
  have h6 := ejp_lmc_deriv G Φ U hU hG hsymm hpos hΦ hdΦ y hy
  simp only [h5]
  simp only [h4]
  simp only [ejpJac, h6]
  
  exact alg (fun i j => (G y)⁻¹ i j) (fun i j => hessLoc G Φ i j y)
    (fun i j => ricci G i j y) (ejpN G Φ y) (fun a => ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y)
    (fun j => partialDeriv j Φ y) (ejpHess3 G Φ y) (ejpPsi G Φ y) (ejpS G Φ y) hHs hT hs hψ
    (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hRic

def ejpHess3 (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (a b c : Fin 3) : ℝ :=

    - ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k c a y * hessLoc G Φ k b y
    - ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k c b y * hessLoc G Φ a k y

  have hFU : ∀ x' ∈ W, F x' ∈ U := fun x' h => (hFW x' h).1

    have hev : (fun x'' => Φ (F x'')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x'] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=

    intro i j
    have hev : pd2 j (fun x'' => Φ (F x'')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun x'' h => hlev1 x'' h j)
    show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (fun x'' => Φ (F x''))) x (e2 i) = 0
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  obtain ⟨hΦ1, hΦ2'⟩ := ejpl_chain2 Φ U hU hΦ F W hW hF hFU x hx
  
  have htan : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Φ (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) c = 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [← hΦ1 i]

  have hΦ2 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,

      + ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Φ (F x) * pd2 i (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) c) x = 0 := by
    intro i j
    rw [← hΦ2' i j]
    exact hlev2 i j
  
  have hA : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (i j : Fin 2), pd2 i (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) c) x =
      pd2 j (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 i)) c) x := by
    intro c i j
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x :=

        - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) k i j x * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 k)) c) =

            * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) b)
        - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) k i j x * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 k)) c)

subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hdΦ : fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) ≠ 0) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (htan : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Φ (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) c = 0) : 0 < ejpS G Φ (F x) ∧ pullMetric2 G F x * (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ = 1 ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ i j * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) a * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) b = ejpP G Φ (F x) a b) ∧ ∀ T : Fin 3 → ℝ, (∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * T c * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 m)) d = 0) → ∀ c : Fin 3, ejpS G Φ (F x) * T c = (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d Φ (F x) * T d) * ejpN G Φ (F x) c

    intro H hH
    have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
        H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
          - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
          + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H y)
    rw [hfun]
    have t1 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 0)
    exact ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
  
  have hdetU : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hpos y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hGi : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) U := by
    intro k l
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := hdet3 G hG
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det) U := by
      apply hdet3
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = l
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hG a b
    refine ((h1.inv hdetU).mul h2).congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
      smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hSpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i Φ y * partialDeriv j Φ y := by
    intro y hy
    have hx0 : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k Φ y) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hdΦ y hy
      have hlin : (fderiv ℝ Φ y : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) = 0 :=
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext (fun i => by
          have := congrFun h0 i
          simpa [partialDeriv] using this)
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun hlin v
      simpa using this
    have hpd' := (hpos y hy).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx0
    refine lt_of_lt_of_eq hpd' ?_
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
    ring
  have hSpos' : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ejpS G Φ y := hSpos
  have hSne : ∀ y ∈ U, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Φ y * partialDeriv b Φ y) ≠ 0 :=
    fun y hy => (hSpos y hy).ne'
  have hSne' : ∀ y ∈ U, ejpS G Φ y ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hSpos' y hy).ne'
  
  have hdG : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b)) U :=
    fun m a b => hpdv _ (hG a b) m
  have hp : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv k Φ) U := hpdv Φ hΦ
  have hpp : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j Φ)) U :=
    fun i j => hpdv _ (hp j) i
  
  have hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Φ y * partialDeriv b Φ y) U :=
    ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ((hGi i j).mul (hp i)).mul (hp j)
  have hS' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpS G Φ) U := hS.congr (fun y _ => rfl)
  
  have hPsi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPsi G Φ) U :=
    ((hS'.sqrt hSne').inv (fun y hy => Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.2 (hSpos' y hy))).congr
      (fun y _ => rfl)
  
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
      (hGi k l).mul (((hdG i j l).add (hdG j i l)).sub (hdG l i j)))
  have hdΓ : ∀ m k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv m (christoffel G k i j)) U :=
    fun m k i j => hpdv _ (hΓ k i j) m
  have hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G Φ i j) U := by
    intro i j
    unfold hessLoc
    exact (hpp i j).sub (ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hΓ k i j).mul (hp k))
  have hRic : ∀ j k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ricci G j k) U := by
    intro j k
    have h : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (christoffel G i j k) y - partialDeriv j (christoffel G i i k) y)
        + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3,
          (christoffel G i i p y * christoffel G p j k y
            - christoffel G i j p y * christoffel G p i k y)) U :=
      (ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => (hdΓ i i j k).sub (hdΓ j i i k)).add
        (ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun p _ =>
          ((hΓ i i p).mul (hΓ p j k)).sub ((hΓ i j p).mul (hΓ p i k)))
    exact h.congr (fun y _ => rfl)
  have hN : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b Φ y) U :=
    fun a => ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ => (hGi a b).mul (hp b)
  have hNe : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ejpN G Φ y a) U :=
    fun a => (hN a).congr (fun y _ => rfl)
  
  have hQ : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j -
      (∑ a : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a Φ y) *
        (∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b Φ y) /
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Φ y * partialDeriv b Φ y)) U := by
    intro i j
    exact ((hGi i j).sub (((hN i).mul (hN j)).div hS hSne)).congr (fun y _ => rfl)
  have hNum : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      ((G y)⁻¹ i j - (∑ a : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a Φ y) *
          (∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b Φ y) /
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Φ y * partialDeriv b Φ y)) *
        hessLoc G Φ j k y *
        ((G y)⁻¹ k l - (∑ a : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv a Φ y) *
          (∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ l b * partialDeriv b Φ y) /
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Φ y * partialDeriv b Φ y)) *
        hessLoc G Φ l i y) U :=
    ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ =>
      ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (((hQ i j).mul (hH j k)).mul (hQ k l)).mul (hH l i)
  have hSF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (secondFundSq G Φ) U :=
    (hNum.div hS hSne).congr (fun y _ => rfl)
  
  have hNumR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
      ricci G j k y * ejpN G Φ y j * ejpN G Φ y k) U :=
    ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => ((hRic j k).mul (hNe j)).mul (hNe k)
  have hRT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpRic G Φ) U :=
    (hNumR.div hS' hSne').congr (fun y _ => rfl)
  
  have hPot : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPot G Φ) U := (hSF.add hRT).congr (fun y _ => rfl)
  exact ⟨hSpos', hS', hPsi, hPot⟩

informal_problem.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z).target ∧ ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ≠ 0 ∧ g.gradInner f f x = ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ∧ g.jacobiDeriv f x = ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x)

signature.name: ejp_chart_transfer
signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z).target ∧ ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ≠ 0 ∧ g.gradInner f f x = ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ∧ g.jacobiDeriv f x = ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hu : ∀ u : E3, u = ∑ d : Fin 3, u d • e d := by
    intro u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hcomp_e : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) a = v a := by
    intro v a
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  have hcompo : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z → ∀ l d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z = (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) d := by
    intro ψ z hψ l d
    have hfun : (fun v => ψ v d) = (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ ψ := by
      funext v; simp
    rw [partialDeriv, hfun, fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj d).differentiableAt hψ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp
  have pd_comp : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ψ z) → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d F (ψ z) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z := by
    intro F ψ z hψ hF l
    have h1 : partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z = fderiv ℝ F (ψ z) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (F ∘ ψ) z (e l) = _
      rw [fderiv_comp z hF hψ]
      rfl
    rw [h1, hu (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)), map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcompo ψ z hψ]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d _
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  
  have bil_alg : ∀ (A Gm Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P Q Pt Qt : Fin 3 → ℝ), A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * Gm a b * A b j) →
      (∀ i, Pt i = ∑ a : Fin 3, P a * A a i) → (∀ j, Qt j = ∑ b : Fin 3, Q b * A b j) →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ i j * Pt i * Qt j =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ a b * P a * Q b := by
    intro A Gm Gt P Q Pt Qt hA hGt hPt hQt
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * Gm * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hM : A * Gt⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A = Gm⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv]
      calc A * (A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹) * Matrix.transpose A
          = (A * A⁻¹) * Gm⁻¹ * (Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A) := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = Gm⁻¹ := by
            rw [hAB, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, hAB, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul,
              Matrix.mul_one]
    have hM' : ∀ a b, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A a i * Gt⁻¹ i j * A b j = Gm⁻¹ a b := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hM]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [hPt, hQt, ← hM']
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have pair : ∀ (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ) (x : E3),
      x ∈ Φ.source → g.gradInner u w (Φ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff Φ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun y => u (Φ y)) x *
          partialDeriv j (fun y => w (Φ y)) x := by
    intro Φ u w x hx
    have h2 : IsOpen (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w))
          (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source) := by
      have hΦ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ Φ.source := Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun
      refine ⟨hΦ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Φ.open_source
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).open_source, ?_⟩
      have hc : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 (Φ x))
          (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source := contMDiffOn_chart
      have hcomp := hc.comp (hΦ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun w hw => hw.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcomp
    have hxU : x ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source :=
      ⟨hx, mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x)⟩
    have hψd : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z := fun z hz =>
      (h2.2.contDiffAt (h2.1.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hM1 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z) := by
      intro z hz
      have hev : (Φ : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
          ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ∘ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w))) := by
        filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
        exact ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hw.2).symm
      rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp z
        (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 (Φ x))
          ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source hz.2)) (hψd z hz).mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
    have hM1' : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source, ∀ u : E3,
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))
            (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z u) := by
      intro z hz u
      rw [hM1 z hz]
      rfl
    
    have s1 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        g.coeff Φ z i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) z *
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) a b *
              partialDeriv j (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) b) z := by
      intro z hz i j
      have hq : (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) = Φ z :=
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hz.2
      have hgq : g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z))) = g.g (Φ z) :=
        congrArg g.g hq
      obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
          D = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hΦD : ∀ u : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u =
          D (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z u) := by
        intro u
        rw [hM1' z hz u, hD]
        rfl
      have hcD : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ z)) a b
          = g.g (Φ z) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
        intro a b
        rw [← hgq, hD]
        rfl
      have hJ : ∀ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (e k)
          = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) d) z • e d := by
        intro k
        rw [hu (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (e k))]
        simp only [hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)]
      simp only [hcD]
      show g.g (Φ z) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z (e j)) = _
      rw [hΦD, hΦD, hJ i, hJ j]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    
    have s3 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
        (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) z).det
          ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz hdet
      obtain ⟨v, hv0, hJv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
      have hloc := PartialDiffeomorph.isLocalDiffeomorphAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ hz.1
      have hinj : ∀ u : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u = 0 → u = 0 := by
        intro u hu0
        rw [← hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv_coe (by simp)] at hu0
        exact (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv (by simp)).map_eq_zero_iff.mp hu0
      have hw : fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
        ext a
        rw [map_sum]
        simp only [map_smul]
        have := congrFun hJv a
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
          hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)] at this
        simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          WithLp.ofLp_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
        rw [← this]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      have h0 : (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
        apply hinj
        rw [hM1' z hz, hw]
        exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero _
      apply hv0
      funext a
      rw [← hcomp_e v a, h0]
      rfl
    
    have hVo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' Φ.target) :=
      (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).open_target
        Φ.open_target
    have hσ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v => Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v))
        ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' Φ.target) := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm Φ.target :=
        Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun
      have h3 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm
          (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      have hcomp := h1.comp (h3.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun v hv => hv.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcomp
    have hyV : chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x) ∈
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' Φ.target := by
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source (mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x)), ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) ∈ Φ.target
      rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x))]
      exact Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hx
    have hσy : Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))) = x := by
      rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x))]
      exact Φ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hx
    have hσd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v => Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v))
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) :=
      (hσ.contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds hyV)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    
    have chain : ∀ (u0 : M → ℝ) (j : Fin 3), partialDeriv j (fun y => u0 (Φ y)) x =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun v => u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v))
            (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) *
          partialDeriv j (fun w' => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w') a) x := by
      intro u0 j
      by_cases hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v => u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v))
          (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))
      · have hev : (fun y => u0 (Φ y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
            (fun y => (fun v => u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ y))) := by
          filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hxU] with y hy
          show u0 (Φ y) = u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ y)))
          rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hy.2]
        have e1 : partialDeriv j (fun y => u0 (Φ y)) x = partialDeriv j
            (fun y => (fun v => u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ y))) x := by
          unfold partialDeriv
          rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
        rw [e1]
        exact pd_comp _ (fun w' => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w')) x (hψd x hxU) hd j
      · have hnd : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u0 (Φ y)) x := by
          intro hdx
          apply hd
          have hdx' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u0 (Φ y))
              (Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))) := by
            rw [hσy]; exact hdx
          have hc := hdx'.comp (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) hσd
          refine hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
          filter_upwards [hVo.mem_nhds hyV] with v hv
          have hr := Φ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hv.2
          show u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v) =
            u0 (Φ (Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)))
          exact congrArg u0 hr.symm
        have e1 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u0 (Φ y)) x = 0 := fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hnd
        have e2 : fderiv ℝ (fun v => u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) = 0 :=
          fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hd
        simp only [partialDeriv, e1, e2, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, zero_mul,
          Finset.sum_const_zero]
    have halg := bil_alg
      (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w' => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w') a) x)
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))) (g.coeff Φ x)
      (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun v => u ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))
      (fun b => partialDeriv b (fun v => w ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))
      (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun y => u (Φ y)) x)
      (fun j => partialDeriv j (fun y => w (Φ y)) x)
      (s3 x hxU) (fun i j => s1 x hxU i j) (fun i => chain u i) (fun j => chain w j)
    have hL : g.gradInner u w (Φ x) = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))⁻¹ a b *
          partialDeriv a (fun v => u ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) *
          partialDeriv b (fun v => w ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) := rfl
    rw [hL]
    exact halg.symm
  
  have hchart : ∀ q : M, ∃ Ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      Ψ.source = (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ ∀ y : E3, Ψ y = (chartAt E3 q).symm y := by
    intro q
    exact ⟨⟨(chartAt E3 q).symm.toPartialEquiv, (chartAt E3 q).open_target,
      (chartAt E3 q).open_source, contMDiffOn_chart_symm, contMDiffOn_chart⟩, rfl, fun y => rfl⟩
  
  have transfer : ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source, ∀ u w : M → ℝ,
      g.gradInner u w x = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (chartAt E3 z x))⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun v => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm v)) (chartAt E3 z x) *
          partialDeriv j (fun v => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm v)) (chartAt E3 z x) := by
    intro x hx u w
    obtain ⟨Ψ, hsrc, hΨ⟩ := hchart z
    have hfun : (⇑Ψ : E3 → M) = (chartAt E3 z).symm := funext hΨ
    have hy : chartAt E3 z x ∈ Ψ.source := by
      rw [hsrc]; exact (chartAt E3 z).map_source hx
    have h1 := pair Ψ u w _ hy
    rw [hfun, (chartAt E3 z).left_inv hx] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have hlmc : ∀ q : M, ∀ v ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target,
      g.levelMeanCurv f ((chartAt E3 q).symm v) =
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) v := by
    intro q v hv
    obtain ⟨Ψ, hsrc, hΨ⟩ := hchart q
    have hfun : (⇑Ψ : E3 → M) = (chartAt E3 q).symm := funext hΨ
    have hvs : v ∈ Ψ.source := by rw [hsrc]; exact hv
    have h1 := levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Ψ f (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) hf v hvs
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z' => by rw [hΨ]))
    rw [hfun] at h1
    exact h1
  have hpdH : ∀ q : M, ∀ v ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
          (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) v =
        partialDeriv i (fun y => g.levelMeanCurv f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) v := by
    intro q v hv i
    have hev : (fun y => g.levelMeanCurv f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 v]
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) := by
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).open_target.mem_nhds hv] with y hy
      exact hlmc q y hy
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  
  have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z).target := by
    have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ (chartAt E3 z).symm) (chartAt E3 z).target :=
      hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
  refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
  intro x hx hdf
  
  have hB2 := transfer x hx f f
  
  have hB1 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hzero : g.gradInner f f x = 0 := by
      rw [hB2]
      simp only [partialDeriv, h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero,
        Finset.sum_const_zero]
    have hL : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
      have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x :=
        hf.contMDiffAt.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
      rw [hmd.mfderiv]
      simp [writtenInExtChartAt]
      rfl
    have hLne : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hL]; exact hdf
    have hPD := coeff_chart_symm_posDef g x (chartAt E3 x x)
      ((chartAt E3 x).map_source (mem_chart_source E3 x))
    have hv : (fun i : Fin 3 =>
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) (e i)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hv0
      apply hLne
      ext1 u
      rw [hu u, map_sum]
      have h0' : ∀ i : Fin 3,
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) (e i) = 0 :=
        fun i => congrFun hv0 i
      simp [map_smul, h0']
    have h1 := hPD.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
    have h3 : g.gradInner f f x =
        dotProduct (star (fun i : Fin 3 =>
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) (e i)))
        (Matrix.mulVec (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x x))⁻¹ (fun i : Fin 3 =>
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) (e i))) := by
      show ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, _ = _
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      simp only [partialDeriv]
      ring
    rw [← h3, hzero] at h1
    exact lt_irrefl _ h1
  
  have hB3 : g.jacobiDeriv f x = ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
      (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) := by
    have hJ : g.jacobiDeriv f x = g.gradInner (g.levelMeanCurv f) f x := by
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.jacobiDeriv, RiemannianMetric3.gradInner,
        hpdH x (chartAt E3 x x) ((chartAt E3 x).map_source (mem_chart_source E3 x))]
    rw [hJ, transfer x hx]
    simp only [ejpJac, hpdH z (chartAt E3 z x) ((chartAt E3 z).map_source hx)]
  exact ⟨hB1, hB2, hB3⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: levelMeanCurv_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ x) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) h x

informal_problem.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z q : M) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFW : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) W ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) x)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x = pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun x' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) x

signature.name: ejp_chart_reparam
signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z q : M) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFW : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) W ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) x)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x = pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun x' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hexp : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
    intro v
    ext k
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  
  have hquad : ∀ (φ : E3 → M) (y v w : E3),
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * g.coeff φ y k l * w l =
        g.g (φ y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y v) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y w) := by
    intro φ y v w
    conv_rhs => rw [hexp v, hexp w]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
    ring
  
  have htrans : ∀ a b : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => chartAt E3 b ((chartAt E3 a).symm w))
      ((chartAt E3 a).target ∩ (chartAt E3 a).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 b).source) := by
    intro a b
    have h₃ := (contMDiffOn_chart (x := b) (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞)).comp
      ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := a) (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞)).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
      (fun w hw => hw.2)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h₃
  have hΩo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) :=
    (chartAt E3 z).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 q).open_source
  have hΩ'o : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source) :=
    (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 z).open_source
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo F W
      ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) :=
    fun x hx => ⟨(hFW x hx).1, (hFW x hx).2.1⟩
  have hτd : ∀ x ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x) :=
    fun x hx => ((htrans z q).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
      (hΩo.mem_nhds (hmaps hx))
  have hFd : ∀ x ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x :=
    fun x hx => (hF.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
  have hchain : ∀ x ∈ W, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) x =
      (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x)).comp (fderiv ℝ F x) :=
    fun x hx => fderiv_comp' x (hτd x hx) (hFd x hx)
  refine ⟨(htrans z q).comp hF hmaps, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hy := hmaps hx
    have hτy : chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ∈
        (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source := by
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 q).map_source hy.2, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source
      rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hy.2]
      exact (chartAt E3 z).map_target hy.1
    have hσd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v => chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q).symm v))
        (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) :=
      ((htrans q z).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hΩ'o.mem_nhds hτy)
    have hev : (fun w => chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm w))))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 (F x)] id := by
      filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hy] with w hw
      show chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm w))) = w
      rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hw.2, (chartAt E3 z).right_inv hw.1]
    have hcomp : fderiv ℝ
        (fun w => chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)))) (F x) =
        (fderiv ℝ (fun v => chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q).symm v))
          (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x)) :=
      fderiv_comp' (F x) hσd (hτd x hx)
    have hid := hcomp.symm.trans (hev.fderiv_eq.trans fderiv_id)
    have hleft : Function.LeftInverse
        (fderiv ℝ (fun v => chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q).symm v))
          (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))))
        (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x)) := by
      intro a
      have := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => L a) hid
      simpa using this
    rw [hchain x hx, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp']
    exact hleft.injective.comp (hFW x hx).2.2
  · intro x hx
    have hy := hmaps hx
    have hfun : (⇑(chartAt E3 q).symm ∘ (fun w => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 (F x)] ⇑(chartAt E3 z).symm := by
      filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hy] with w hw
      exact (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hw.2
    have hmf := hfun.mfderiv_eq (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, E3))
    have hΦ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm
        (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 q)
        ((chartAt E3 q).map_source hy.2)
    have hmchain : ∀ u : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) u =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)))
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x) u) := by
      intro u
      rw [← hmf]
      have h1 := mfderiv_comp_apply (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (I'' := 𝓘(ℝ, E3))
        (F x) hΦ (hτd x hx).mdifferentiableAt u
      rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at h1
      exact h1
    have hpt : (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) =
        (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) := (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hy.2
    funext i j
    show ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) k *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) l =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) x (e2 i)) k *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) k l *
        (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x'))) x (e2 j)) l
    rw [hquad, hquad, hchain x hx, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      hpt, hmchain, hmchain]
    rfl

informal_problem.statement: (w : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ U) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : (∀ j : Fin 2, pd2 j (fun x' => w (F x')) x = ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c w (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) c) ∧ ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (fun x' => w (F x'))) x = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b w) (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) a * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) b) + ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c w (F x) * pd2 i (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) c) x

signature.name: ejpl_chain2
signature.statement: (w : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ U) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : (∀ j : Fin 2, pd2 j (fun x' => w (F x')) x = ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c w (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) c) ∧ ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (fun x' => w (F x'))) x = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b w) (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) a * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) b) + ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c w (F x) * pd2 i (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) c) x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hexp : ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E3), ℓ v = ∑ c : Fin 3, v c * ℓ (e c) := by
    intro ℓ v
    have hv : v = ∑ c : Fin 3, v c • e c := by
      ext k
      fin_cases k <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hfirst : ∀ (w' : E3 → ℝ) (x0 : E2), DifferentiableAt ℝ w' (F x0) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F x0 → ∀ j : Fin 2,
      pd2 j (fun x' => w' (F x')) x0 =
        ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c w' (F x0) * (fderiv ℝ F x0 (e2 j)) c := by
    intro w' x0 hw' hF' j
    show fderiv ℝ (fun x' => w' (F x')) x0 (e2 j) = _
    rw [fderiv_comp' x0 hw' hF', ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hexp]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_)
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  have hFd : ∀ x' ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x' := fun x' hx' =>
    (hF.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx')
  have hwd : ∀ x' ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ w (F x') := fun x' hx' =>
    (hw.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hFU x' hx'))
  have hwfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ w) U :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hw).2
  have hFfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) W :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW).1 hF).2
  have hPd : ∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv c w) (F x) := by
    intro c
    have h : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ w z (e c)) U := hwfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hFU x hx))
  have hDd : ∀ (j : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) c) x := by
    intro j c
    let Λ : (E2 →L[ℝ] E3) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj c).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 (e2 j))
    have hfun : (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) c) = Λ ∘ fderiv ℝ F := rfl
    rw [hfun]
    exact Λ.differentiableAt.comp x
      ((hFfd.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx))
  refine ⟨fun j => hfirst w x (hwd x hx) (hFd x hx) j, ?_⟩
  intro i j
  have hev : pd2 j (fun x'' => w (F x'')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      fun x' => ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c w (F x') * (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) c :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx)
      (fun x' hx' => hfirst w x' (hwd x' hx') (hFd x' hx') j)
  show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (fun x'' => w (F x''))) x (e2 i) = _
  rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hPx : ∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => partialDeriv c w (F x')) x :=
    fun c => (hPd c).comp x (hFd x hx)
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
    (A := fun c x' => partialDeriv c w (F x') * (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) c)
    (fun c _ => (hPx c).fun_mul (hDd j c))]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have hterm : ∀ c : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun x' => partialDeriv c w (F x') * (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) c) x (e2 i)
        = partialDeriv c w (F x) * pd2 i (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) c) x
          + (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) c *
            ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv c w) (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) a := by
    intro c
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hPx c) (hDd j c)]
    rw [← hfirst (partialDeriv c w) x (hPd c) (hFd x hx) i]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  simp only [hterm]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ U) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) (m i j : Fin 2) : pd2 m (fun z => pullMetric2 G F z i j) x = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (pd2 m (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 i)) k) x * G (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) l + (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) k * G (F x) k l * pd2 m (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) l) x + (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) k * (∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun y => G y k l) (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 m)) r) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) l)

signature.name: ejpl_pull_deriv
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ U) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) (m i j : Fin 2) : pd2 m (fun z => pullMetric2 G F z i j) x = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (pd2 m (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 i)) k) x * G (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) l + (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) k * G (F x) k l * pd2 m (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j)) l) x + (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) k * (∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun y => G y k l) (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 m)) r) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) l)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hWx : W ∈ 𝓝 x := hW.mem_nhds hx
  have hUy : U ∈ 𝓝 (F x) := hU.mem_nhds (hFU x hx)
  have h1 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  have hFdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x :=
    ((hF.contDiffAt hWx).of_le h1).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x :=
    ((hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := 1) (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).contDiffAt
      hWx).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hGd : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y k l) (F x) :=
    fun k l => (((hG k l).contDiffAt hUy).of_le h1).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hcol : ∀ (w : E2) (k : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ F z w) k) x := by
    intro w k
    let Λ : (E2 →L[ℝ] E3) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj k).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 w)
    have hfun : (fun z => (fderiv ℝ F z w) k) = Λ ∘ fderiv ℝ F := rfl
    rw [hfun]
    exact Λ.differentiableAt.comp x hFd
  have hBd : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G (F z) k l) x :=
    fun k l => (hGd k l).comp x hFdx
  have hexp : ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (u : E3), ℓ u = ∑ r : Fin 3, ℓ (e r) * u r := by
    intro ℓ u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr,
      EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => mul_comm _ _)
  have hB' : ∀ k l : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun z => G (F z) k l) x (e2 m) =
      ∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun y => G y k l) (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 m)) r := by
    intro k l
    have hc : (fun z => G (F z) k l) = (fun y => G y k l) ∘ F := rfl
    rw [hc, fderiv_comp x (hGd k l) hFdx, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      hexp (fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y k l) (F x))]
    rfl
  have hT : ∀ k l : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt
      (fun z => (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 i)) k * G (F z) k l * (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 j)) l)
      (((fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) k * G (F x) k l) • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 j)) l) x
        + (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) l • ((fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) k • fderiv ℝ (fun z => G (F z) k l) x
          + G (F x) k l • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 i)) k) x)) x := by
    intro k l
    exact ((hcol (e2 i) k).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul (hBd k l).hasFDerivAt).fun_mul
      (hcol (e2 j) l).hasFDerivAt
  have hsum := HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
    (fun k _ => HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun l _ => hT k l))
  show fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
    (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 i)) k * G (F z) k l * (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 j)) l) x (e2 m) = _
  rw [hsum.fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_))
  rw [hB' k l]
  simp only [pd2]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hdΦ : fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) ≠ 0) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (htan : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Φ (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) c = 0) : 0 < ejpS G Φ (F x) ∧ pullMetric2 G F x * (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ = 1 ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ i j * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) a * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) b = ejpP G Φ (F x) a b) ∧ ∀ T : Fin 3 → ℝ, (∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * T c * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 m)) d = 0) → ∀ c : Fin 3, ejpS G Φ (F x) * T c = (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d Φ (F x) * T d) * ejpN G Φ (F x) c

signature.name: ejpl_proj_linalg
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hdΦ : fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) ≠ 0) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (htan : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Φ (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) c = 0) : 0 < ejpS G Φ (F x) ∧ pullMetric2 G F x * (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ = 1 ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ i j * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) a * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) b = ejpP G Φ (F x) a b) ∧ ∀ T : Fin 3 → ℝ, (∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * T c * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 m)) d = 0) → ∀ c : Fin 3, ejpS G Φ (F x) * T c = (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d Φ (F x) * T d) * ejpN G Φ (F x) c

proof.tactics:
by
  
  open Matrix in
  have alg : ∀ (Gm Gi : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), Gm * Gi = 1 →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, Gm a b = Gm b a) → ∀ (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (D : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ξ c * D c i = 0) → ∀ (hm hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 2, hm i j = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, D k i * Gm k l * D l j) →
      hm * hi = 1 → (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gi i j * ξ i * ξ j ≠ 0) →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, hi i j * D a i * D b j =
        Gi a b - (∑ r : Fin 3, Gi a r * ξ r) * (∑ r : Fin 3, Gi b r * ξ r) /
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gi i j * ξ i * ξ j)) ∧
      (∀ T : Fin 3 → ℝ, (∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Gm c d * T c * D d m = 0) →
        ∀ c : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gi i j * ξ i * ξ j) * T c =
          (∑ d : Fin 3, ξ d * T d) * (∑ b : Fin 3, Gi c b * ξ b)) := by
    intro Gm Gi hGi hGs ξ D htan hm hi hh hhi hs
    set s : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gi i j * ξ i * ξ j with hsdef
    set ν : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun a => ∑ r : Fin 3, Gi a r * ξ r with hνdef
    have hGiGm : Gi * Gm = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hGi
    have hGν : ∀ a, ∑ b, Gm a b * ν b = ξ a := by
      intro a
      have h1 : Gm *ᵥ (Gi *ᵥ ξ) = ξ := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hGi, Matrix.one_mulVec]
      exact congrFun h1 a
    have hνξ : ∑ c, ξ c * ν c = s := by
      simp only [hνdef, hsdef, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
    have hDν : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ c, ∑ d, D c i * Gm c d * ν d = 0 := by
      intro i
      have h : ∀ c, ∑ d, D c i * Gm c d * ν d = ξ c * D c i := by
        intro c
        rw [← hGν c, Finset.sum_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => by ring)
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => h c)]
      exact htan i
    have hνD : ∀ j : Fin 2, ∑ c, ∑ d, ν c * Gm c d * D d j = 0 := by
      intro j
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      have h : ∀ d, ∑ c, ν c * Gm c d * D d j = ξ d * D d j := by
        intro d
        rw [← hGν d, Finset.sum_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => by rw [hGs c d]; ring)
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => h d)]
      exact htan j
    have hνν : ∑ c, ∑ d, ν c * Gm c d * ν d = s := by
      have h : ∀ c, ∑ d, ν c * Gm c d * ν d = ξ c * ν c := by
        intro c
        rw [← hGν c, Finset.sum_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => by ring)
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => h c)]
      exact hνξ
    set B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := Matrix.of fun c k => ![D c 0, D c 1, ν c] k with hB
    set K : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := !![hi 0 0, hi 0 1, 0; hi 1 0, hi 1 1, 0; 0, 0, s⁻¹]
      with hK
    have hGent : ∀ k l, (Bᵀ * Gm * B) k l = ∑ c, ∑ d, B c k * Gm c d * B d l := by
      intro k l
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hGhat : Bᵀ * Gm * B = !![hm 0 0, hm 0 1, 0; hm 1 0, hm 1 1, 0; 0, 0, s] := by
      ext k l
      rw [hGent]
      fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;> simp [hB, hh, hDν, hνD, hνν]
    have hhi' : ∀ i j, hm i 0 * hi 0 j + hm i 1 * hi 1 j =
        (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) i j := by
      intro i j
      rw [← hhi, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have h00 := hhi' 0 0
    have h01 := hhi' 0 1
    have h10 := hhi' 1 0
    have h11 := hhi' 1 1
    simp only [Matrix.one_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_ne, ne_eq, zero_ne_one, one_ne_zero,
      not_false_eq_true] at h00 h01 h10 h11
    have hGK : Bᵀ * Gm * B * K = 1 := by
      rw [hGhat]
      ext k l
      fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;> simp [hK, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, hs] <;>
        linarith
    have hcomm : (B * K) * (Bᵀ * Gm) = 1 := by
      rw [mul_eq_one_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      exact hGK
    have hBKB : B * (K * Bᵀ) = Gi := by
      have h := congrArg (· * Gi) hcomm
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, hGi, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul] at h
      exact h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro a b
      have h := congrFun (congrFun hBKB a) b
      simp only [hB, hK, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.transpose_apply,
        Matrix.of_apply] at h
      simp at h
      show ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, hi i j * D a i * D b j = Gi a b - ν a * ν b / s
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      rw [← h]
      field_simp
      ring
    · intro T hT c
      show s * T c = (∑ d : Fin 3, ξ d * T d) * ν c
      have hT2 : T = B *ᵥ (K *ᵥ (Bᵀ *ᵥ (Gm *ᵥ T))) := by
        rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
          Matrix.mul_assoc B K Bᵀ, hBKB, hGiGm, Matrix.one_mulVec]
      have hw : ∀ k, (Bᵀ *ᵥ (Gm *ᵥ T)) k = ∑ c, B c k * ∑ d, Gm c d * T d := fun k => rfl
      have hw01 : ∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c, D c m * ∑ d, Gm c d * T d = 0 := by
        intro m
        rw [← hT m, Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_)
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => by rw [hGs d c]; ring)
      have hw2 : ∑ c, ν c * ∑ d, Gm c d * T d = ∑ d, ξ d * T d := by
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
        rw [← hGν d, Finset.sum_mul]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => by rw [hGs d c]; ring)
      have hw0' : (Bᵀ *ᵥ (Gm *ᵥ T)) 0 = 0 := by
        rw [hw]; simpa [hB] using hw01 0
      have hw1' : (Bᵀ *ᵥ (Gm *ᵥ T)) 1 = 0 := by
        rw [hw]; simpa [hB] using hw01 1
      have hw2' : (Bᵀ *ᵥ (Gm *ᵥ T)) 2 = ∑ d, ξ d * T d := by
        rw [hw]; simpa [hB] using hw2
      have hKw : K *ᵥ (Bᵀ *ᵥ (Gm *ᵥ T)) = ![0, 0, s⁻¹ * ∑ d, ξ d * T d] := by
        generalize Bᵀ *ᵥ (Gm *ᵥ T) = w at hw0' hw1' hw2' ⊢
        ext k
        fin_cases k <;> simp [hK, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, hw0', hw1', hw2']
      have hc : T c = ν c * (s⁻¹ * ∑ d, ξ d * T d) := by
        have h := congrFun hT2 c
        rw [hKw] at h
        rw [h]
        simp [hB, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [hc]
      field_simp
  
  have hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, G (F x) a b = G (F x) b a := by
    intro a b
    have h := hpos.isHermitian.apply a b
    simp only [star_trivial] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hGi : G (F x) * (G (F x))⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpos.det_pos.ne')
  
  have hξ : (fun c : Fin 3 => partialDeriv c Φ (F x)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hdΦ
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.coe_injective
    refine (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext (fun i => ?_)
    have hi := congrFun h i
    simp only [partialDeriv, Pi.zero_apply] at hi
    simpa [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply] using hi
  
  have hS : 0 < ejpS G Φ (F x) := by
    have h := (hpos.inv).dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ
    have heq : star (fun c : Fin 3 => partialDeriv c Φ (F x)) ⬝ᵥ
        ((G (F x))⁻¹.mulVec (fun c : Fin 3 => partialDeriv c Φ (F x))) = ejpS G Φ (F x) := by
      simp only [ejpS, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
    rw [heq] at h
    exact h
  
  have hker : ∀ w : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      (Matrix.of fun c i => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) c : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) ℝ).mulVec w = 0 →
      w = 0 := by
    intro w hw
    have hv : fderiv ℝ F x (∑ i, w i • e2 i) = 0 := by
      apply PiLp.ext
      intro c
      have hc := congrFun hw c
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.zero_apply] at hc
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, WithLp.ofLp_sum, PiLp.zero_apply]
      rw [← hc]
      simp [Finset.sum_apply, mul_comm]
    have hv0 : (∑ i, w i • e2 i) = 0 := hinj (by rw [hv, map_zero])
    funext i
    have h := congrArg (fun v : E2 => v i) hv0
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply] at h
    fin_cases i <;> simpa using h
  have hinjD : Function.Injective
      (Matrix.of fun c i => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) c : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) ℝ).mulVec := by
    intro w₁ w₂ h
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hker _ (by rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, h, sub_self]))
  have hmpd := hpos.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hinjD
  have hmeq : pullMetric2 G F x =
      (Matrix.of fun c i => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) c : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) ℝ).conjTranspose *
        G (F x) * (Matrix.of fun c i => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) c : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) ℝ) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [pullMetric2, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.of_apply,
      star_trivial, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have hhi : pullMetric2 G F x * (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rw [hmeq]
    exact Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hmpd.det_pos.ne')
  have hs : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i Φ (F x) *
      partialDeriv j Φ (F x) ≠ 0 := hS.ne'
  obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := alg (G (F x)) (G (F x))⁻¹ hGi hGs (fun c => partialDeriv c Φ (F x))
    (fun c i => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) c) htan (pullMetric2 G F x) (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹
    (fun i j => rfl) hhi hs
  exact ⟨hS, hhi, fun a b => h3 a b, fun T hT c => h4 T hT c⟩

informal_problem.statement: (Gm Gi : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hGi : Gm * Gi = 1) (hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, Gm a b = Gm b a) (dG : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (D : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (A : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (i j : Fin 2), A c i j = A c j i) (hm hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, hm i j = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, D k i * Gm k l * D l j) (hhi : hm * hi = 1) (dh : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hdh : ∀ m i j : Fin 2, dh m i j = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (A k m i * Gm k l * D l j + D k i * Gm k l * A l m j + D k i * (∑ r : Fin 3, dG r k l * D r m) * D l j)) (Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hΓ : ∀ k a b : Fin 3, Γ k a b = 1 / 2 * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gi k l * (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) (Γ2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hΓ2 : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j = 1 / 2 * ∑ l : Fin 2, hi k l * (dh i j l + dh j i l - dh l i j)) (i j m : Fin 2) : ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Gm c d * (A c i j + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b * D a i * D b j) - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * D c k) * D d m = 0

signature.name: ejpl_tension_normal
signature.statement: (Gm Gi : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hGi : Gm * Gi = 1) (hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, Gm a b = Gm b a) (dG : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (D : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (A : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (i j : Fin 2), A c i j = A c j i) (hm hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, hm i j = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, D k i * Gm k l * D l j) (hhi : hm * hi = 1) (dh : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hdh : ∀ m i j : Fin 2, dh m i j = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (A k m i * Gm k l * D l j + D k i * Gm k l * A l m j + D k i * (∑ r : Fin 3, dG r k l * D r m) * D l j)) (Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hΓ : ∀ k a b : Fin 3, Γ k a b = 1 / 2 * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gi k l * (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) (Γ2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hΓ2 : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j = 1 / 2 * ∑ l : Fin 2, hi k l * (dh i j l + dh j i l - dh l i j)) (i j m : Fin 2) : ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Gm c d * (A c i j + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b * D a i * D b j) - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * D c k) * D d m = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have lower : ∀ {n : ℕ} (M Mi : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ), M * Mi = 1 →
      (∀ a b : Fin n, M a b = M b a) →
      ∀ (X : Fin n → ℝ) (d : Fin n), ∑ c : Fin n, M c d * (∑ l : Fin n, Mi c l * X l) = X d := by
    intro n M Mi hMi hMs X d
    have key : ∀ l : Fin n, ∑ c : Fin n, M c d * Mi c l = if d = l then 1 else 0 := by
      intro l
      rw [← Matrix.one_apply, ← hMi, Matrix.mul_apply]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => by rw [hMs])
    calc ∑ c : Fin n, M c d * (∑ l : Fin n, Mi c l * X l)
        = ∑ c : Fin n, ∑ l : Fin n, M c d * Mi c l * X l := by
          simp only [Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
      _ = ∑ l : Fin n, (∑ c : Fin n, M c d * Mi c l) * X l := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = X d := by
          simp only [key, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hL : ∀ d a b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, Gm c d * Γ c a b
      = 1 / 2 * (dG a b d + dG b a d - dG d a b) := by
    intro d a b
    have h := lower Gm Gi hGi hGs (fun l => 1 / 2 * (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) d
    beta_reduce at h
    rw [← h]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_)
    rw [hΓ c a b]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
    ring
  have hms : ∀ p q : Fin 2, hm p q = hm q p := by
    intro p q
    rw [hh p q, hh q p]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hGs 1 0, hGs 2 0, hGs 2 1]
    ring
  have hQ : ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * hm k m = 1 / 2 * (dh i j m + dh j i m - dh m i j) := by
    have h := lower hm hi hhi hms (fun l => 1 / 2 * (dh i j l + dh j i l - dh l i j)) m
    beta_reduce at h
    rw [← h]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [hΓ2 k i j]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
    ring
  have e1 : ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Gm c d * (A c i j + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b * D a i * D b j) - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * D c k) * D d m
      = (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Gm c d * A c i j * D d m)
        + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, (∑ c : Fin 3, Gm c d * Γ c a b) * D a i * D b j * D d m)
        - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * hm k m := by
    simp only [hh, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  rw [e1, hQ]
  simp only [hL]
  rw [hdh i j m, hdh j i m, hdh m i j]
  simp only [hA _ j i, hA _ m i, hA _ m j]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  rw [hGs 1 0, hGs 2 0, hGs 2 1]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ u : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (D : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (A : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (Γ2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hS : ejpS G Φ y ≠ 0) (hM : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, hi i j * D a i * D b j = ejpP G Φ y a b) (htan : ∀ k : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Φ y * D c k = 0) (hΦ2 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b Φ) y * D a i * D b j) + ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Φ y * A c i j = 0) (hnorm : ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ejpS G Φ y * (A c i j + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G c a b y * D a i * D b j) - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * D c k) = (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d Φ y * (A d i j + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G d a b y * D a i * D b j) - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * D d k)) * ejpN G Φ y c) : (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, hi i j * (((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b u) y * D a i * D b j) + ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c u y * A c i j) - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c u y * D c k)) = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y a b * hessLoc G u a b y) - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y c d * hessLoc G Φ c d y) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y a * partialDeriv a u y) / ejpS G Φ y

signature.name: ejpl_assembly
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ u : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (D : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (A : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (Γ2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hS : ejpS G Φ y ≠ 0) (hM : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, hi i j * D a i * D b j = ejpP G Φ y a b) (htan : ∀ k : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Φ y * D c k = 0) (hΦ2 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b Φ) y * D a i * D b j) + ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Φ y * A c i j = 0) (hnorm : ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ejpS G Φ y * (A c i j + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G c a b y * D a i * D b j) - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * D c k) = (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d Φ y * (A d i j + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G d a b y * D a i * D b j) - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * D d k)) * ejpN G Φ y c) : (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, hi i j * (((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b u) y * D a i * D b j) + ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c u y * A c i j) - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c u y * D c k)) = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y a b * hessLoc G u a b y) - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y c d * hessLoc G Φ c d y) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y a * partialDeriv a u y) / ejpS G Φ y

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hC : ∀ H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      hi i j * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, H a b * D a i * D b j)) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y a b * H a b := by
    intro H
    have hM' := hM
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three] at hM' ⊢
    linear_combination H 0 0 * hM' 0 0 + H 0 1 * hM' 0 1 + H 0 2 * hM' 0 2
      + H 1 0 * hM' 1 0 + H 1 1 * hM' 1 1 + H 1 2 * hM' 1 2
      + H 2 0 * hM' 2 0 + H 2 1 * hM' 2 1 + H 2 2 * hM' 2 2
  
  have hN : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ejpS G Φ y * (∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c u y *
      (A c i j + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G c a b y * D a i * D b j)
        - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * D c k)) =
      -(∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ a b y * D a i * D b j) *
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y a * partialDeriv a u y) := by
    intro i j
    have h0 := hnorm i j 0
    have h1 := hnorm i j 1
    have h2 := hnorm i j 2
    have hq := hΦ2 i j
    have t0 := htan 0
    have t1 := htan 1
    simp only [hessLoc, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0 h1 h2 hq t0 t1 ⊢
    linear_combination partialDeriv 0 u y * h0 + partialDeriv 1 u y * h1
      + partialDeriv 2 u y * h2
      + (ejpN G Φ y 0 * partialDeriv 0 u y + ejpN G Φ y 1 * partialDeriv 1 u y
          + ejpN G Φ y 2 * partialDeriv 2 u y) * hq
      - (ejpN G Φ y 0 * partialDeriv 0 u y + ejpN G Φ y 1 * partialDeriv 1 u y
          + ejpN G Φ y 2 * partialDeriv 2 u y) * Γ2 0 i j * t0
      - (ejpN G Φ y 0 * partialDeriv 0 u y + ejpN G Φ y 1 * partialDeriv 1 u y
          + ejpN G Φ y 2 * partialDeriv 2 u y) * Γ2 1 i j * t1
  
  have hNd : ∀ i j : Fin 2, (∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c u y *
      (A c i j + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G c a b y * D a i * D b j)
        - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * D c k)) =
      -(∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ a b y * D a i * D b j) *
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y a * partialDeriv a u y) / ejpS G Φ y := by
    intro i j
    rw [eq_div_iff hS]
    linear_combination hN i j
  
  have hK : ∀ i j : Fin 2, (((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b u) y * D a i * D b j)
        + ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c u y * A c i j)
        - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c u y * D c k) =
      (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, hessLoc G u a b y * D a i * D b j)
        + ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c u y *
          (A c i j + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G c a b y * D a i * D b j)
            - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * D c k) := by
    intro i j
    simp only [hessLoc, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hB : ∀ i j : Fin 2, (((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b u) y * D a i * D b j)
        + ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c u y * A c i j)
        - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ2 k i j * ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c u y * D c k) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (hessLoc G u a b y - hessLoc G Φ a b y *
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y a * partialDeriv a u y) / ejpS G Φ y) * D a i * D b j := by
    intro i j
    have k1 := hK i j
    have k2 := hNd i j
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three] at k1 k2 ⊢
    linear_combination k1 + k2
  
  simp only [hB]
  have hC' := hC (fun a b => hessLoc G u a b y - hessLoc G Φ a b y *
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y a * partialDeriv a u y) / ejpS G Φ y)
  simp only at hC'
  rw [hC']
  
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) : (∀ (w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U → ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i w) U) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G Φ a b) U) ∧ (∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ejpN G Φ y d) U)

signature.name: ejp_coord_smooth
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) : (∀ (w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U → ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i w) U) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G Φ a b) U) ∧ (∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ejpN G Φ y d) U)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hpdv : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) U := by
    intro f hf i
    have hD := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf).2
    exact hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdet3 : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) U := by
    intro H hH
    have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
        H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
          - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
          + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H y)
    rw [hfun]
    have t1 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 0)
    exact ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
  have hdetU : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hpos y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hGi : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) U := by
    intro k l
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := hdet3 G hG
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det) U := by
      apply hdet3
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = l
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hG a b
    refine ((h1.inv hdetU).mul h2).congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have hdG : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b)) U :=
    fun m a b => hpdv _ (hG a b) m
  have hp : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv k Φ) U := hpdv Φ hΦ
  have hpp : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j Φ)) U :=
    fun i j => hpdv _ (hp j) i
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
      (hGi k l).mul (((hdG i j l).add (hdG j i l)).sub (hdG l i j)))
  have hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G Φ i j) U := by
    intro i j
    unfold hessLoc
    exact (hpp i j).sub (ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hΓ k i j).mul (hp k))
  have hN : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b Φ y) U :=
    fun a => ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ => (hGi a b).mul (hp b)
  have hNe : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ejpN G Φ y a) U :=
    fun a => (hN a).congr (fun y _ => rfl)
  exact ⟨hpdv, hGi, hΓ, hH, hNe⟩

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : (∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y = christoffel G k j i y) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ a b y = hessLoc G Φ b a y) ∧ (∀ a b c : Fin 3, ejpHess3 G Φ y a b c = ejpHess3 G Φ y b a c)

signature.name: ejp_sym_facts
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : (∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y = christoffel G k j i y) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ a b y = hessLoc G Φ b a y) ∧ (∀ a b c : Fin 3, ejpHess3 G Φ y a b c = ejpHess3 G Φ y b a c)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hA : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i := by
    have hT : Matrix.transpose (G y) = G y := Matrix.ext fun i j => hsymm y j i
    have h1 : Matrix.transpose ((G y)⁻¹) = (G y)⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hT]
    intro i j
    have h2 := congrFun (congrFun h1 j) i
    rw [Matrix.transpose_apply] at h2
    exact h2
  
  have hB : ∀ (z : E3) (k i j : Fin 3), christoffel G k i j z = christoffel G k j i z := by
    intro z k i j
    have hf : (fun w => G w j i) = (fun w => G w i j) := funext fun w => hsymm w j i
    unfold christoffel
    rw [hf]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    ring
  
  have hS : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b Φ) z = partialDeriv b (partialDeriv a Φ) z := by
    intro z hz
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Φ z := hΦ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
    have h2' : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
    have h2 : minSmoothness ℝ 2 ≤ ∞ := by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      exact h2'
    have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ Φ z := hc.isSymmSndFDerivAt h2
    have h12 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ∞ := by
      rw [one_add_one_eq_two]
      exact h2'
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) z :=
      (hc.fderiv_right (m := 1) h12).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have key : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b Φ) z = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) z (e a) (e b) := by
      intro a b
      have hpd : partialDeriv b Φ = fun w => (fderiv ℝ Φ w) ((fun _ : E3 => e b) w) := rfl
      have h3 := fderiv_clm_apply (c := fderiv ℝ Φ) (u := fun _ : E3 => e b) hd
        (differentiableAt_const (e b))
      unfold partialDeriv at hpd ⊢
      rw [hpd, h3]
      simp
    intro a b
    rw [key a b, key b a]
    exact hsym.eq (e a) (e b)
  
  have hC : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ a b : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ a b z = hessLoc G Φ b a z := by
    intro z hz a b
    simp only [hessLoc]
    rw [hS z hz a b]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by rw [hB z k a b]
  refine ⟨hA, fun k i j => hB y k i j, fun a b => hC y hy a b, ?_⟩
  
  intro a b c
  have hev : hessLoc G Φ a b =ᶠ[𝓝 y] hessLoc G Φ b a :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hC z hz a b)
  have hpd : partialDeriv c (hessLoc G Φ a b) y = partialDeriv c (hessLoc G Φ b a) y := by
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have h1 : ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k c a y * hessLoc G Φ k b y =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k c a y * hessLoc G Φ b k y :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by rw [hC y hy k b])
  have h2 : ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k c b y * hessLoc G Φ a k y =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k c b y * hessLoc G Φ k a y :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by rw [hC y hy a k])
  simp only [ejpHess3]
  rw [hpd, h1, h2]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : (∀ a c : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => ejpN G Φ z c) y = ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ c e * hessLoc G Φ a e y - ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G c a e y * ejpN G Φ y e) ∧ (∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (ejpS G Φ) y = 2 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y) ∧ (∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y = -(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y)

signature.name: ejp_first_derivs
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : (∀ a c : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => ejpN G Φ z c) y = ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ c e * hessLoc G Φ a e y - ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G c a e y * ejpN G Φ y e) ∧ (∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (ejpS G Φ) y = 2 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y) ∧ (∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y = -(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hUy : U ∈ 𝓝 y := hU.mem_nhds hy
  
  have hpdv : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) U := by
    intro f hf i
    have hD := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf).2
    exact hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hdet3 : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) U := by
    intro H hH
    have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
        H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
          - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
          + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H y)
    rw [hfun]
    have t1 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 0)
    exact ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
  
  have hdetU : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hpos y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hGi : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) U := by
    intro k l
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := hdet3 G hG
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det) U := by
      apply hdet3
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = l
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hG a b
    refine ((h1.inv hdetU).mul h2).congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
      smul_eq_mul]
