  have hs0 : 0 < ejpS G Φ y := by
    have hx0 : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k Φ y) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hdΦ y hy
      have hlin : (fderiv ℝ Φ y : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) = 0 :=
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext (fun i => by
          have := congrFun h0 i
          simpa [partialDeriv] using this)
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun hlin v
      simpa using this
    have hpd' := (hpos y hy).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx0
    refine lt_of_lt_of_eq hpd' ?_
    simp only [ejpS, star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
    ring
  
  have hp : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv k Φ) U := hpdv Φ hΦ
  have hS' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpS G Φ) U :=
    (ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ =>
      ((hGi i j).mul (hp i)).mul (hp j)).congr (fun z _ => rfl)
  have hN : ∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ejpN G Φ z d) U :=
    fun d => (ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ => (hGi d b).mul (hp b)).congr (fun z _ => rfl)
  have hdiff : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → DifferentiableAt ℝ f y :=
    fun f hf => (hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hUy
  have hAd : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z i j) y :=
    fun i j => hdiff _ (hG i j)
  have hBd : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y :=
    fun i j => hdiff _ (hGi i j)
  have hφd : ∀ b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv b Φ) y := fun b => hdiff _ (hp b)
  have hNd : ∀ d : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ejpN G Φ z d) y :=
    fun d => hdiff _ (hN d)
  have hSd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (ejpS G Φ) y := hdiff _ hS'
  
  have hR1 : ∀ (f g : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3), (∀ b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f b) y) →
      (∀ b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (g b) y) →
      partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ b : Fin 3, f b z * g b z) y =
        ∑ b : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (f b) y * g b y + f b y * partialDeriv a (g b) y) := by
    intro f g a hf hg
    unfold partialDeriv
    have hsum := fderiv_fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun b z => f b z * g b z) (x := y)
      (fun b _ => ((hf b).mul (hg b) : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => f b z * g b z) y))
    beta_reduce at hsum
    rw [hsum, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hf b) (hg b)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hinvsym : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i := by
    intro i j
    have hT : Matrix.transpose (G y) = G y := Matrix.ext (fun i j => hsymm y j i)
    have h := Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv (G y)
    rw [hT] at h
    have h' := congrFun (congrFun h j) i
    rw [Matrix.transpose_apply] at h'
    exact h'
  have hdAsym : ∀ m i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => G z i j) y =
      partialDeriv m (fun z => G z j i) y := by
    intro m i j
    have hf : (fun z => G z i j) = (fun z => G z j i) := funext fun z => hsymm z i j
    rw [hf]
  
  have hE : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k c) y * G y c l
      + (G y)⁻¹ k c * partialDeriv m (fun z => G z c l) y) = 0 := by
    intro m k l
    have h1 := hR1 (fun c z => (G z)⁻¹ k c) (fun c z => G z c l) m (fun c => hBd k c)
      (fun c => hAd c l)
    beta_reduce at h1
    have hev : (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k c * G z c l) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) k l := by
      filter_upwards [hUy] with z hz
      rw [← Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ ((isUnit_iff_ne_zero).2 (hdetU z hz))]
    have h0 : partialDeriv m (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k c * G z c l) y = 0 := by
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    rw [h1] at h0
    exact h0
  
  have hinvd : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y =
      -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y * (G y)⁻¹ b l := by
    intro m k l
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
        D = Matrix.of fun k l => partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨dA, hdA⟩ : ∃ dA : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
        dA = Matrix.of fun i j => partialDeriv m (fun z => G z i j) y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hM : D * G y + (G y)⁻¹ * dA = 0 := by
      ext k' l'
      simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, hD, hdA, Matrix.of_apply,
        Matrix.zero_apply]
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact hE m k' l'
    have hAB : G y * (G y)⁻¹ = 1 :=
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ ((isUnit_iff_ne_zero).2 (hdetU y hy))
    have hDe : D = -((G y)⁻¹ * dA * (G y)⁻¹) := by
      calc D = D * (G y * (G y)⁻¹) := by rw [hAB, Matrix.mul_one]
        _ = (D * G y) * (G y)⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = (-((G y)⁻¹ * dA)) * (G y)⁻¹ := by rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hM]
        _ = -((G y)⁻¹ * dA * (G y)⁻¹) := by rw [Matrix.neg_mul]
    have h' := congrFun (congrFun hDe k) l
    simp only [hD, hdA, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply] at h'
    rw [h']
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hcomp : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y =
      -∑ a : Fin 3, (christoffel G k m a y * (G y)⁻¹ a l
        + christoffel G l m a y * (G y)⁻¹ k a) := by
    intro m k l
    rw [hinvd m k l]
    simp only [christoffel, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [hinvsym l 0, hinvsym l 1, hinvsym l 2, hdAsym m 1 0, hdAsym m 2 0,
      hdAsym m 2 1]
    ring
  
  have hi : ∀ a c : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => ejpN G Φ z c) y =
      ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ c e * hessLoc G Φ a e y
        - ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G c a e y * ejpN G Φ y e := by
    intro a c
    have h1 := hR1 (fun b z => (G z)⁻¹ c b) (fun b => partialDeriv b Φ) a (fun b => hBd c b) hφd
    beta_reduce at h1
    have hNfun : (fun z => ejpN G Φ z c) =
        fun z => ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ c b * partialDeriv b Φ z := rfl
    rw [hNfun, h1]
    simp only [hcomp]
    simp only [hessLoc, ejpN, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hSfun : ejpS G Φ = fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i Φ z * ejpN G Φ z i := by
    funext z
    simp only [ejpS, ejpN, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
    ring
  have hii : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (ejpS G Φ) y =
      2 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y := by
    intro a
    have h1 := hR1 (fun i => partialDeriv i Φ) (fun i z => ejpN G Φ z i) a hφd hNd
    beta_reduce at h1
    rw [hSfun, h1]
    simp only [hi]
    simp only [hessLoc, ejpN, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [hinvsym 1 0, hinvsym 2 0, hinvsym 2 1]
    ring
  
  have hiii : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y =
      -(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y := by
    intro a
    have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt (ejpS G Φ y) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hs0
    have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹)
        (-(1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (ejpS G Φ y))) / Real.sqrt (ejpS G Φ y) ^ 2) (ejpS G Φ y) :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_sqrt hs0.ne').fun_inv hr.ne'
    have hd2 := hd1.comp_hasFDerivAt y hSd.hasFDerivAt
    have hpsi : ejpPsi G Φ = (fun x => (Real.sqrt x)⁻¹) ∘ ejpS G Φ := rfl
    have h3 : partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y =
        (-(1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (ejpS G Φ y))) / Real.sqrt (ejpS G Φ y) ^ 2) *
          partialDeriv a (ejpS G Φ) y := by
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hpsi, hd2.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [h3, hii a]
    simp only [ejpPsi]
    ring
  exact ⟨hi, hii, hiii⟩

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) (a b : Fin 3) : hessLoc G (ejpPsi G Φ) a b y = 3 * ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 5 * (∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y) * (∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ b c y) - ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 3 * ((∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ c e * hessLoc G Φ a e y * hessLoc G Φ b c y) + ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * ejpHess3 G Φ y b c a)

signature.name: ejp_hess_psi
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) (a b : Fin 3) : hessLoc G (ejpPsi G Φ) a b y = 3 * ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 5 * (∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y) * (∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ b c y) - ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 3 * ((∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ c e * hessLoc G Φ a e y * hessLoc G Φ b c y) + ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * ejpHess3 G Φ y b c a)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h1 := ejp_first_derivs G Φ U hU hG hsymm hpos hΦ hdΦ y hy
  have hreg := ejp_level_regularity G Φ U hU hG hpos hΦ hdΦ
  have hsm := ejp_coord_smooth G Φ U hU hG hpos hΦ
  have hUy : U ∈ 𝓝 y := hU.mem_nhds hy
  have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (ejpPsi G Φ) y :=
    (hreg.2.2.1.contDiffAt hUy).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hNd : ∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ejpN G Φ z c) y :=
    fun c => ((hsm.2.2.2.2 c).contDiffAt hUy).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hHd : ∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (hessLoc G Φ b c) y :=
    fun c => ((hsm.2.2.2.1 b c).contDiffAt hUy).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hev : partialDeriv b (ejpPsi G Φ) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
      (fun z => -(ejpPsi G Φ z) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ z c * hessLoc G Φ b c z) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem hUy
      (fun z hz => (ejp_first_derivs G Φ U hU hG hsymm hpos hΦ hdΦ z hz).2.2 b)
  have hfun : (fun z => -(ejpPsi G Φ z) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ z c * hessLoc G Φ b c z) =
      (fun z => -(ejpPsi G Φ z * ejpPsi G Φ z * ejpPsi G Φ z) *
        (ejpN G Φ z 0 * hessLoc G Φ b 0 z + ejpN G Φ z 1 * hessLoc G Φ b 1 z
          + ejpN G Φ z 2 * hessLoc G Φ b 2 z)) := by
    funext z
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hfull := ((hψd.hasFDerivAt.fun_mul hψd.hasFDerivAt).fun_mul hψd.hasFDerivAt).fun_neg.fun_mul
    ((((hNd 0).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul (hHd 0).hasFDerivAt).fun_add
      ((hNd 1).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul (hHd 1).hasFDerivAt)).fun_add
      ((hNd 2).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul (hHd 2).hasFDerivAt))
  have hd2 : partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b (ejpPsi G Φ)) y =
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => -(ejpPsi G Φ z * ejpPsi G Φ z * ejpPsi G Φ z) *
        (ejpN G Φ z 0 * hessLoc G Φ b 0 z + ejpN G Φ z 1 * hessLoc G Φ b 1 z
          + ejpN G Φ z 2 * hessLoc G Φ b 2 z)) y (e a) := by
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv b (ejpPsi G Φ)) y (e a) = _
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hfun]
  have hψ' : ∀ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (ejpPsi G Φ) y (e k) =
      -(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ k c y := fun k => h1.2.2 k
  have hN' : ∀ c : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun z => ejpN G Φ z c) y (e a) =
      ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ c e * hessLoc G Φ a e y
        - ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G c a e y * ejpN G Φ y e := fun c => h1.1 a c
  have hT' : ∀ c : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (hessLoc G Φ b c) y (e a) = ejpHess3 G Φ y b c a
      + ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y * hessLoc G Φ k c y
      + ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k a c y * hessLoc G Φ b k y := by
    intro c
    show partialDeriv a (hessLoc G Φ b c) y = _
    simp only [ejpHess3]
    ring
  have hdef : hessLoc G (ejpPsi G Φ) a b y = partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b (ejpPsi G Φ)) y
      - ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y * partialDeriv k (ejpPsi G Φ) y := rfl
  rw [hdef, hd2, hfull.fderiv]
  simp only [h1.2.2, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul, hψ', hN', hT']
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_level_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) : (∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ejpS G Φ y) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpS G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPsi G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPot G Φ) U

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_coord_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) : (∀ (w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U → ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i w) U) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G Φ a b) U) ∧ (∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ejpN G Φ y d) U)

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_first_derivs
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : (∀ a c : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => ejpN G Φ z c) y = ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ c e * hessLoc G Φ a e y - ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G c a e y * ejpN G Φ y e) ∧ (∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (ejpS G Φ) y = 2 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y) ∧ (∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y = -(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y)

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) (a : Fin 3) : partialDeriv a (levelMeanCurvCoord G Φ) y = (-(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * hessLoc G Φ i j y) + ejpPsi G Φ y * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * ejpHess3 G Φ y i j a) - 3 * ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 2 * (-(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y i * ejpN G Φ y j * hessLoc G Φ i j y) - ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 3 * ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i e * hessLoc G Φ a e y) * ejpN G Φ y j * hessLoc G Φ i j y) + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y i * (∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j e * hessLoc G Φ a e y) * hessLoc G Φ i j y) + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y i * ejpN G Φ y j * ejpHess3 G Φ y i j a)

signature.name: ejp_lmc_deriv
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) (a : Fin 3) : partialDeriv a (levelMeanCurvCoord G Φ) y = (-(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * hessLoc G Φ i j y) + ejpPsi G Φ y * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * ejpHess3 G Φ y i j a) - 3 * ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 2 * (-(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y i * ejpN G Φ y j * hessLoc G Φ i j y) - ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 3 * ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i e * hessLoc G Φ a e y) * ejpN G Φ y j * hessLoc G Φ i j y) + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y i * (∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j e * hessLoc G Φ a e y) * hessLoc G Φ i j y) + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y i * ejpN G Φ y j * ejpHess3 G Φ y i j a)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hinf : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hD : ∀ w : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U → DifferentiableAt ℝ w y :=
    fun w hw => (hw.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt hinf
  obtain ⟨hpd, hinvs, -, hhess, hNs⟩ := ejp_coord_smooth G Φ U hU hG hpos hΦ
  obtain ⟨hSpos, hSs, hψs, -⟩ := ejp_level_regularity G Φ U hU hG hpos hΦ hdΦ
  obtain ⟨hgis, -, -, -⟩ := ejp_sym_facts G Φ U hU hsymm hΦ y hy
  have dGi : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y :=
    fun i j => hD _ (hinvs i j)
  have dG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z i j) y := fun i j => hD _ (hG i j)
  have dH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (hessLoc G Φ i j) y := fun i j => hD _ (hhess i j)
  have dN : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ejpN G Φ z i) y := fun i => hD _ (hNs i)
  have d1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv i Φ) y := fun i => hD _ (hpd Φ hΦ i)
  
  have pm : ∀ f g : E3 → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y → DifferentiableAt ℝ g y →
      partialDeriv a (fun z => f z * g z) y =
        partialDeriv a f y * g y + f y * partialDeriv a g y := by
    intro f g hf hg
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have ps : ∀ F : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F i) y) →
      partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i, F i z) y = ∑ i, partialDeriv a (F i) y := by
    intro F hF
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => hF i)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have pS1 : ∀ f g : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i) y) →
      (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (g i) y) →
      partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i, f i z * g i z) y =
        ∑ i, (partialDeriv a (f i) y * g i y + f i y * partialDeriv a (g i) y) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    rw [ps (fun i z => f i z * g i z) (fun i => (hf i).fun_mul (hg i))]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => pm _ _ (hf i) (hg i))
  have pS2 : ∀ f g : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, (∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i j) y) →
      (∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (g i j) y) →
      partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i, ∑ j, f i j z * g i j z) y =
        ∑ i, ∑ j, (partialDeriv a (f i j) y * g i j y + f i j y * partialDeriv a (g i j) y) := by
    intro f g hf hg
    rw [ps (fun i z => ∑ j, f i j z * g i j z)
      (fun i => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun j _ => (hf i j).fun_mul (hg i j)))]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => pS1 (f i) (g i) (hf i) (hg i))
  have pS3 : ∀ f g h : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, (∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i j) y) →
      (∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (g i j) y) → (∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (h i j) y) →
      partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i, ∑ j, f i j z * g i j z * h i j z) y =
        ∑ i, ∑ j, (partialDeriv a (f i j) y * g i j y * h i j y
          + f i j y * partialDeriv a (g i j) y * h i j y
          + f i j y * g i j y * partialDeriv a (h i j) y) := by
    intro f g h hf hg hh
    rw [pS2 (fun i j z => f i j z * g i j z) h (fun i j => (hf i j).fun_mul (hg i j)) hh]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
    beta_reduce
    rw [pm _ _ (hf i j) (hg i j)]
    ring
  
  have hdet : ∀ z ∈ U, (G z).det ≠ 0 := fun z hz => (hpos z hz).det_pos.ne'
  have hE : ∀ p l : Fin 3, ∑ b, G y p b * partialDeriv a (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ b l) y
      + ∑ b, partialDeriv a (fun z => G z p b) y * (G y)⁻¹ b l = 0 := by
    intro p l
    have h1 := pS1 (fun b z => G z p b) (fun b z => (G z)⁻¹ b l) (fun b => dG p b)
      (fun b => dGi b l)
    have h2 : partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ b, G z p b * (G z)⁻¹ b l) y = 0 := by
      have hev : (fun z => ∑ b, G z p b * (G z)⁻¹ b l) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          fun _ => if p = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
        filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G z)
          (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hdet z hz))) p) l
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
        exact this
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    beta_reduce at h1
    rw [h1, Finset.sum_add_distrib] at h2
    linarith
  have hinvD : ∀ k l : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y =
      -∑ p : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ k p * partialDeriv a (fun z => G z p q) y * (G y)⁻¹ q l := by
    let X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun b l => partialDeriv a (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ b l) y
    let D : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun p b => partialDeriv a (fun z => G z p b) y
    have hM : G y * X = -(D * (G y)⁻¹) := by
      ext p l'
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
      simp only [X, D, Matrix.of_apply]
      exact hE p l'
    have hX : X = -((G y)⁻¹ * (D * (G y)⁻¹)) := by
      calc X = ((G y)⁻¹ * G y) * X := by
            rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hdet y hy)), Matrix.one_mul]
        _ = (G y)⁻¹ * (G y * X) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [hM, Matrix.mul_neg]
    intro k l
    have hkl := congrFun (congrFun hX k) l
    simp only [X, D, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply] at hkl
    rw [hkl]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro q _
    ring
  
  have hdGs : ∀ c p q : Fin 3, partialDeriv c (fun z => G z p q) y =
      partialDeriv c (fun z => G z q p) y := by
    intro c p q
    have : (fun z => G z p q) = (fun z => G z q p) := funext fun z => hsymm z p q
    rw [this]
  have s10 : ∀ c, partialDeriv c (fun z => G z 1 0) y = partialDeriv c (fun z => G z 0 1) y :=
    fun c => hdGs c 1 0
  have s20 : ∀ c, partialDeriv c (fun z => G z 2 0) y = partialDeriv c (fun z => G z 0 2) y :=
    fun c => hdGs c 2 0
  have s21 : ∀ c, partialDeriv c (fun z => G z 2 1) y = partialDeriv c (fun z => G z 1 2) y :=
    fun c => hdGs c 2 1
  have compat : ∀ k l : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y =
      -∑ e : Fin 3, (christoffel G k a e y * (G y)⁻¹ e l
        + christoffel G l a e y * (G y)⁻¹ k e) := by
    intro k l
    rw [hinvD k l]
    simp only [christoffel, Fin.sum_univ_three, hgis l 0, hgis l 1, hgis l 2, s10, s20, s21]
    ring
  
  have hdN : ∀ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => ejpN G Φ z c) y =
      ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ c e * hessLoc G Φ a e y
        - ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G c a e y * ejpN G Φ y e := by
    intro c
    have h1 := pS1 (fun b z => (G z)⁻¹ c b) (fun b => partialDeriv b Φ) (fun b => dGi c b) d1
    beta_reduce at h1
    simp only [ejpN]
    rw [h1]
    simp only [compat, hessLoc, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hdS : partialDeriv a (ejpS G Φ) y =
      2 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y := by
    have h1 := pS3 (fun i j z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) (fun i j => partialDeriv i Φ)
      (fun i j => partialDeriv j Φ) (fun i j => dGi i j) (fun i j => d1 i) (fun i j => d1 j)
    beta_reduce at h1
    have e1 : ejpS G Φ = fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G z)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i Φ z * partialDeriv j Φ z := rfl
    rw [e1, h1]
    simp only [compat, ejpN, hessLoc, Fin.sum_univ_three, hgis 1 0, hgis 2 0, hgis 2 1]
    ring
  
  have hdψ : partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y =
      -(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y := by
    have hS0 : ejpS G Φ y ≠ 0 := (hSpos y hy).ne'
    have hr0 : Real.sqrt (ejpS G Φ y) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hSpos y hy)).ne'
    have hSd : HasFDerivAt (ejpS G Φ) (fderiv ℝ (ejpS G Φ) y) y := (hD _ hSs).hasFDerivAt
    have hsq := hSd.sqrt hS0
    have hinv := (hasDerivAt_inv hr0).comp_hasFDerivAt y hsq
    have key : fderiv ℝ (ejpPsi G Φ) y = (-(Real.sqrt (ejpS G Φ y) ^ 2)⁻¹) •
        ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (ejpS G Φ y))) • fderiv ℝ (ejpS G Φ) y) := hinv.fderiv
    have h2 : fderiv ℝ (ejpS G Φ) y (e a) =
        2 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y := hdS
    show fderiv ℝ (ejpPsi G Φ) y (e a) = _
    rw [key]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [h2]
    simp only [ejpPsi]
    field_simp
  
  have hdL : partialDeriv a (lapLoc G Φ) y =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * ejpHess3 G Φ y i j a := by
    have h1 := pS2 (fun i j z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) (fun i j => hessLoc G Φ i j) dGi dH
    beta_reduce at h1
    have e1 : lapLoc G Φ = fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G z)⁻¹ i j * hessLoc G Φ i j z := rfl
    rw [e1, h1]
    simp only [compat, ejpHess3, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hdQ : partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      ejpN G Φ z i * ejpN G Φ z j * hessLoc G Φ i j z) y =
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i e * hessLoc G Φ a e y) *
        ejpN G Φ y j * hessLoc G Φ i j y) +
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y i *
        (∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j e * hessLoc G Φ a e y) * hessLoc G Φ i j y) +
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y i * ejpN G Φ y j * ejpHess3 G Φ y i j a := by
    have h1 := pS3 (fun i j z => ejpN G Φ z i) (fun i j z => ejpN G Φ z j)
      (fun i j => hessLoc G Φ i j) (fun i j => dN i) (fun i j => dN j) dH
    beta_reduce at h1
    rw [h1]
    simp only [hdN, ejpHess3, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hform : levelMeanCurvCoord G Φ = fun z => ejpPsi G Φ z * lapLoc G Φ z -
      ejpPsi G Φ z ^ 3 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        ejpN G Φ z i * ejpN G Φ z j * hessLoc G Φ i j z := by
    funext z
    have hQ : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G z)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a Φ z * ((G z)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b Φ z) *
          hessLoc G Φ i j z) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ z i * ejpN G Φ z j * hessLoc G Φ i j z := by
      simp only [ejpN, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, ejpPsi, ejpS]
    rw [hQ, div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
    ring
  
  have dψ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (ejpPsi G Φ) y := hD _ hψs
  have dL : DifferentiableAt ℝ (lapLoc G Φ) y := by
    have e1 : lapLoc G Φ = fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G z)⁻¹ i j * hessLoc G Φ i j z := rfl
    rw [e1]
    exact DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun i _ =>
      DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun j _ => (dGi i j).fun_mul (dH i j)))
  have dQ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      ejpN G Φ z i * ejpN G Φ z j * hessLoc G Φ i j z) y :=
    DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun i _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun j _ =>
      ((dN i).fun_mul (dN j)).fun_mul (dH i j)))
  have dψ3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ejpPsi G Φ z ^ 3) y := dψ.fun_pow 3
  have hp3 : partialDeriv a (fun z => ejpPsi G Φ z ^ 3) y =
      3 * ejpPsi G Φ y ^ 2 * partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y := by
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_pow 3 dψ]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
    norm_num
  have hsub : partialDeriv a (fun z => ejpPsi G Φ z * lapLoc G Φ z -
      ejpPsi G Φ z ^ 3 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        ejpN G Φ z i * ejpN G Φ z j * hessLoc G Φ i j z) y =
      partialDeriv a (fun z => ejpPsi G Φ z * lapLoc G Φ z) y -
      partialDeriv a (fun z => ejpPsi G Φ z ^ 3 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        ejpN G Φ z i * ejpN G Φ z j * hessLoc G Φ i j z) y := by
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub (dψ.fun_mul dL) (dψ3.fun_mul dQ)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
  rw [hform, hsub, pm _ _ dψ dL, pm _ _ dψ3 dQ, hp3, hdψ, hdL, hdQ]
  simp only [lapLoc]
  ring

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_coord_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) : (∀ (w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U → ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i w) U) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G Φ a b) U) ∧ (∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ejpN G Φ y d) U)

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_level_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) : (∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ejpS G Φ y) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpS G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPsi G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPot G Φ) U

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_sym_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : (∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y = christoffel G k j i y) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ a b y = hessLoc G Φ b a y) ∧ (∀ a b c : Fin 3, ejpHess3 G Φ y a b c = ejpHess3 G Φ y b a c)

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (V : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hV : ∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (V d) U) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) (b : Fin 3) : ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => partialDeriv b (V a) z + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a b d z * V d z) y + ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G a a e y * (partialDeriv b (V e) y + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G e b d y * V d y) - ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G e a b y * (partialDeriv e (V a) y + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a e d y * V d y)) - partialDeriv b (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (V a) z + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a a d z * V d z)) y = ∑ d : Fin 3, ricci G b d y * V d y

signature.name: ejp_div_commutator
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (V : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hV : ∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (V d) U) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) (b : Fin 3) : ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => partialDeriv b (V a) z + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a b d z * V d z) y + ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G a a e y * (partialDeriv b (V e) y + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G e b d y * V d y) - ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G e a b y * (partialDeriv e (V a) y + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a e d y * V d y)) - partialDeriv b (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (V a) z + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a a d z * V d z)) y = ∑ d : Fin 3, ricci G b d y * V d y

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have alg : ∀ (Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (dΓ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (dv : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (ddv : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, Γ k i j = Γ k j i) → (∀ m n d : Fin 3, ddv m n d = ddv n m d) →
      ∀ b : Fin 3,
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ((ddv a b a + ∑ d : Fin 3, (dΓ a a b d * v d + Γ a b d * dv a d))
        + ∑ e : Fin 3, Γ a a e * (dv b e + ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ e b d * v d)
        - ∑ e : Fin 3, Γ e a b * (dv e a + ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ a e d * v d))
      - ∑ a : Fin 3, (ddv b a a + ∑ d : Fin 3, (dΓ b a a d * v d + Γ a a d * dv b d))
      = ∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ i : Fin 3, (dΓ i i b d - dΓ b i i d)
          + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ i i p * Γ p b d - Γ i b p * Γ p i d)) * v d) := by
    intro Γ dΓ v dv ddv hΓ hdd b
    fin_cases b <;>
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.isValue, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk] <;>
      simp only [hΓ 0 1 0, hΓ 0 2 0, hΓ 0 2 1, hΓ 1 1 0, hΓ 1 2 0, hΓ 1 2 1, hΓ 2 1 0, hΓ 2 2 0,
        hΓ 2 2 1, hdd 1 0 0, hdd 1 0 1, hdd 1 0 2, hdd 2 0 0, hdd 2 0 1, hdd 2 0 2, hdd 2 1 0,
        hdd 2 1 1, hdd 2 1 2] <;>
      ring
  
  have hN : U ∈ 𝓝 y := hU.mem_nhds hy
  have hinf : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hpd : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U → ∀ c : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv c w) U := by
    intro w hw c
    have h := hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (m := ∞) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    exact h.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hDV : ∀ d, DifferentiableAt ℝ (V d) y :=
    fun d => ((hV d).contDiffAt hN).differentiableAt hinf
  have hDpV : ∀ c d, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv c (V d)) y :=
    fun c d => ((hpd (V d) (hV d) c).contDiffAt hN).differentiableAt hinf
  have hGd : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z i j) y :=
    fun i j => ((hG i j).contDiffAt hN).differentiableAt hinf
  have hdet : (G y).det ≠ 0 := (hpos y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hinv : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y := by
    intro k l
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z).det) y := by
      simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      fun_prop
    have ha : ∀ k l, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z).adjugate k l) y := by
      intro k l
      fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three] <;> fun_prop
    have : (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) = fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹ * (G z).adjugate k l := by
      funext z
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [this]
    exact (hd.inv hdet).mul (ha k l)
  have hP : ∀ p q r : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv p (fun z => G z q r)) y :=
    fun p q r => ((hpd _ (hG q r) p).contDiffAt hN).differentiableAt hinf
  have hDΓ : ∀ k i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (christoffel G k i j) y := by
    intro k i j
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y
        - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y)) y
    exact (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun l _ =>
      (hinv k l).mul (((hP i j l).add (hP j i l)).sub (hP l i j)))).const_mul _
  
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y = christoffel G k j i y := by
    intro k i j
    simp only [christoffel]
    rw [show (fun z => G z j i) = (fun z => G z i j) from funext (fun z => hsymm z j i)]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
    ring
  have h2 : minSmoothness ℝ 2 ≤ ∞ := by
    rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
    first
    | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
    | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
  have hdd : ∀ m n d : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (partialDeriv n (V d)) y =
      partialDeriv n (partialDeriv m (V d)) y := by
    intro m n d
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (V d) y := (hV d).contDiffAt hN
    have hsym := hc.isSymmSndFDerivAt h2
    have hD2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (V d)) y :=
      (hc.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).differentiableAt hinf
    have key : ∀ p q : Fin 3, partialDeriv p (partialDeriv q (V d)) y =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (V d)) y (e p) (e q) := by
      intro p q
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hD2 (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    rw [key, key, hsym]
  
  have hexp : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (g h : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f y →
      (∀ d, DifferentiableAt ℝ (g d) y) → (∀ d, DifferentiableAt ℝ (h d) y) →
      partialDeriv a (fun z => f z + ∑ d : Fin 3, g d z * h d z) y =
        partialDeriv a f y + ∑ d : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv a (g d) y * h d y + g d y * partialDeriv a (h d) y) := by
    intro f g h a hf hg hh
    have hp : ∀ d, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => g d z * h d z) y := fun d => (hg d).mul (hh d)
    have hs : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ∑ d : Fin 3, g d z * h d z) y :=
      DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun d _ => hp d)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hs, fderiv_fun_sum (fun d _ => hp d), ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hg d) (hh d)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hsum : ∀ (F : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (c : Fin 3), (∀ d, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F d) y) →
      partialDeriv c (fun z => ∑ d : Fin 3, F d z) y = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv c (F d) y := by
    intro F c hF
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun d _ => hF d), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  
  have hX : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => partialDeriv b (V a) z
      + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a b d z * V d z) y =
      partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b (V a)) y + ∑ d : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv a (christoffel G a b d) y * V d y
          + christoffel G a b d y * partialDeriv a (V d) y) :=
    fun a => hexp (partialDeriv b (V a)) (christoffel G a b) V a (hDpV b a)
      (fun d => hDΓ a b d) hDV
  have hDF : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv a (V a) z
      + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a a d z * V d z) y :=
    fun a => (hDpV a a).add (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun d _ => (hDΓ a a d).mul (hDV d)))
  have hY : partialDeriv b (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (V a) z
      + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a a d z * V d z)) y =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv b (partialDeriv a (V a)) y + ∑ d : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv b (christoffel G a a d) y * V d y
          + christoffel G a a d y * partialDeriv b (V d) y)) := by
    refine (hsum (fun a z => partialDeriv a (V a) z
      + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a a d z * V d z) b hDF).trans ?_
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hexp (partialDeriv a (V a)) (christoffel G a a) V b
      (hDpV a a) (fun d => hDΓ a a d) hDV)
  rw [hY]
  simp only [hX]
  simp only [ricci]
  exact alg (fun k i j => christoffel G k i j y)
    (fun m k i j => partialDeriv m (christoffel G k i j) y) (fun d => V d y)
    (fun m d => partialDeriv m (V d) y) (fun m n d => partialDeriv m (partialDeriv n (V d)) y)
    hΓ hdd b

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) (b : Fin 3) : ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => partialDeriv b (fun w => ejpN G Φ w a) z + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a b d z * ejpN G Φ z d) y + ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G a a e y * (partialDeriv b (fun w => ejpN G Φ w e) y + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G e b d y * ejpN G Φ y d) - ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G e a b y * (partialDeriv e (fun w => ejpN G Φ w a) y + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a e d y * ejpN G Φ y d)) - partialDeriv b (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun w => ejpN G Φ w a) z + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a a d z * ejpN G Φ z d)) y = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a c * (ejpHess3 G Φ y b c a - ejpHess3 G Φ y a c b)

signature.name: ejp_divN_covariant
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) (b : Fin 3) : ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => partialDeriv b (fun w => ejpN G Φ w a) z + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a b d z * ejpN G Φ z d) y + ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G a a e y * (partialDeriv b (fun w => ejpN G Φ w e) y + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G e b d y * ejpN G Φ y d) - ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G e a b y * (partialDeriv e (fun w => ejpN G Φ w a) y + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a e d y * ejpN G Φ y d)) - partialDeriv b (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun w => ejpN G Φ w a) z + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a a d z * ejpN G Φ z d)) y = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a c * (ejpHess3 G Φ y b c a - ejpHess3 G Φ y a c b)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcs := ejp_coord_smooth G Φ U hU hG hpos hΦ
  have hnhds : U ∈ 𝓝 y := hU.mem_nhds hy
  have hdGi : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y := fun i j =>
    ((hcs.2.1 i j).contDiffAt hnhds).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hdH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (hessLoc G Φ i j) y := fun i j =>
    ((hcs.2.2.2.1 i j).contDiffAt hnhds).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hdG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z i j) y := fun i j =>
    ((hG i j).contDiffAt hnhds).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hdet : (G y).det ≠ 0 := ((hpos y hy).det_pos).ne'
  have hcomp : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y =
      -∑ a : Fin 3, (christoffel G k m a y * (G y)⁻¹ a l + christoffel G l m a y * (G y)⁻¹ k a) :=
    fun m k l => ejp_inv_compat G y hdG hsymm hdet m k l
  
  have hprod : ∀ (f g : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (m : Fin 3), (∀ c, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f c) y) →
      (∀ c, DifferentiableAt ℝ (g c) y) →
      partialDeriv m (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, f c z * g c z) y =
        ∑ c : Fin 3, (partialDeriv m (f c) y * g c y + f c y * partialDeriv m (g c) y) := by
    intro f g m hf hg
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun c z => f c z * g c z)
      (fun c _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_mul (hf c) (hg c)), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_)
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hf c) (hg c)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hmix : ∀ a b m : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv m (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c * hessLoc G Φ b c z) y =
        ∑ c : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a c * ejpHess3 G Φ y b c m
          - ∑ p : Fin 3, christoffel G a m p y * (∑ c : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ p c * hessLoc G Φ b c y)
          + ∑ p : Fin 3, christoffel G p m b y * (∑ c : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a c * hessLoc G Φ p c y) := by
    intro a b m
    have h := hprod (fun c z => (G z)⁻¹ a c) (fun c => hessLoc G Φ b c) m
      (fun c => hdGi a c) (fun c => hdH b c)
    beta_reduce at h
    rw [h]
    simp only [hcomp, ejpHess3, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hlap : partialDeriv b (lapLoc G Φ) y =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a c * ejpHess3 G Φ y a c b := by
    have hd : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c * hessLoc G Φ a c z) y := fun a =>
      DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun c z => (G z)⁻¹ a c * hessLoc G Φ a c z)
        (fun c _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_mul (hdGi a c) (hdH a c))
    have e1 : partialDeriv b (lapLoc G Φ) y =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv b (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c * hessLoc G Φ a c z) y := by
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c * hessLoc G Φ a c z) y (e b) = _
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
        (A := fun a z => ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c * hessLoc G Φ a c z) (fun a _ => hd a),
        ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
      rfl
    rw [e1]
    simp only [hmix]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hF : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ a b' : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv b' (fun w => ejpN G Φ w a) z + ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a b' d z * ejpN G Φ z d =
        ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c * hessLoc G Φ b' c z := by
    intro z hz a b'
    rw [(ejp_first_derivs G Φ U hU hG hsymm hpos hΦ hdΦ z hz).1 b' a]
    ring
  
  have hT1 : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => partialDeriv b (fun w => ejpN G Φ w a) z +
      ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a b d z * ejpN G Φ z d) y =
      partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c * hessLoc G Φ b c z) y := by
    intro a
    have hev : (fun z => partialDeriv b (fun w => ejpN G Φ w a) z +
        ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a b d z * ejpN G Φ z d) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c * hessLoc G Φ b c z) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hnhds (fun z hz => hF z hz a b)
    show fderiv ℝ _ y (e a) = fderiv ℝ _ y (e a)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hT2 : partialDeriv b (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun w => ejpN G Φ w a) z +
      ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a a d z * ejpN G Φ z d)) y = partialDeriv b (lapLoc G Φ) y := by
    have hev : (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun w => ejpN G Φ w a) z +
        ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G a a d z * ejpN G Φ z d)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] lapLoc G Φ :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hnhds (fun z hz => by
        show _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * hessLoc G Φ i j z
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hF z hz a a))
    show fderiv ℝ _ y (e b) = fderiv ℝ _ y (e b)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  rw [hT2, hlap]
  simp only [hT1]
  simp only [hmix]
  simp only [hF y hy]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_first_derivs
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : (∀ a c : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => ejpN G Φ z c) y = ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ c e * hessLoc G Φ a e y - ∑ e : Fin 3, christoffel G c a e y * ejpN G Φ y e) ∧ (∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (ejpS G Φ) y = 2 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y) ∧ (∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y = -(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 3 * ∑ c : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y c * hessLoc G Φ a c y)

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_inv_compat
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y : E3) (hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y) (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hdet : (G y).det ≠ 0) (m k l : Fin 3) : partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y = -∑ a : Fin 3, (christoffel G k m a y * (G y)⁻¹ a l + christoffel G l m a y * (G y)⁻¹ k a)

signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y : E3) (hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y) (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hdet : (G y).det ≠ 0) (m k l : Fin 3) : partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y = -∑ a : Fin 3, (christoffel G k m a y * (G y)⁻¹ a l + christoffel G l m a y * (G y)⁻¹ k a)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hdetD : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => H z a b) y) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (H z).det) y := by
    intro H hH
    have hfun : (fun z => (H z).det) = fun z =>
        H z 0 0 * H z 1 1 * H z 2 2 - H z 0 0 * H z 1 2 * H z 2 1
        - H z 0 1 * H z 1 0 * H z 2 2 + H z 0 1 * H z 1 2 * H z 2 0
        + H z 0 2 * H z 1 0 * H z 2 1 - H z 0 2 * H z 1 1 * H z 2 0 := by
      funext z; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H z)
    rw [hfun]
    have h00 := hH 0 0
    have h01 := hH 0 1
    have h02 := hH 0 2
    have h10 := hH 1 0
    have h11 := hH 1 1
    have h12 := hH 1 2
    have h20 := hH 2 0
    have h21 := hH 2 1
    have h22 := hH 2 2
    fun_prop
  have hDd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z).det) y := hdetD G hG
  have hPd : ∀ k' l' : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k' l') y := by
    intro k' l'
    have hfun : (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k' l') =
        fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹ * ((G z).updateRow l' (Pi.single k' 1)).det := by
      funext z
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
        smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hfun]
    refine (hDd.inv hdet).mul (hdetD _ ?_)
    intro a b
    by_cases hal : a = l'
    · subst hal
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
      exact differentiableAt_const _
    · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hal]
      exact hG a b
  have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, (G z).det ≠ 0 := hDd.continuousAt.eventually_ne hdet
  have hE : ∀ a l' : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ b l') y
      + ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y * (G y)⁻¹ b l' = 0 := by
    intro a l'
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * (G z)⁻¹ b l')
        (∑ b : Fin 3, (G y a b • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ b l') y
          + (G y)⁻¹ b l' • fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y)) y := by
      have hs := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
        (A := fun b z => G z a b * (G z)⁻¹ b l')
        (fun b _ => (hG a b).hasFDerivAt.mul (hPd b l').hasFDerivAt)
      convert hs using 1
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * (G z)⁻¹ b l')
        (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y := by
      apply (hasFDerivAt_const (if a = l' then (1 : ℝ) else 0) y).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
      have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G z) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz)) a) l'
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
      exact this
    have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e m)) (h1.unique h2)
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h3
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [← h3, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring
  have hU : IsUnit (G y).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet
  have hGP : G y * (G y)⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G y) hU
  have hPG : (G y)⁻¹ * G y = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (G y) hU
  let X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun b l' => partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ b l') y
  let D : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun a b => partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y
  let Γm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun p a => christoffel G p m a y
  have hM : G y * X = -(D * (G y)⁻¹) := by
    ext a l'
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
    simp only [X, D, Matrix.of_apply]
    exact hE a l'
  have hX : X = -((G y)⁻¹ * (D * (G y)⁻¹)) := by
    calc X = ((G y)⁻¹ * G y) * X := by rw [hPG, Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = (G y)⁻¹ * (G y * X) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [hM, Matrix.mul_neg]
  
  have hlow : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (V : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ p : Fin 3, G y c p * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l' : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ p l' * V l') =
        (1 / 2) * V c := by
    intro c V
    have h1 : ∑ p : Fin 3, G y c p * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l' : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ p l' * V l')
        = (1 / 2) * Matrix.mulVec (G y) (Matrix.mulVec (G y)⁻¹ V) c := by
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l' _
      ring
    rw [h1, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hGP, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hlowΓ : ∀ c i j : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, G y c p * christoffel G p i j y =
      (1 / 2) * (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j c) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i c) y
        - partialDeriv c (fun z => G z i j) y) := by
    intro c i j
    simp only [christoffel]
    exact hlow c (fun l' => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l') y
      + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l') y - partialDeriv l' (fun z => G z i j) y)
  have hDmat : D = Matrix.transpose Γm * G y + G y * Γm := by
    ext a b
    simp only [D, Γm, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.transpose_apply]
    have e1 : ∑ p : Fin 3, christoffel G p m a y * G y p b =
        ∑ p : Fin 3, G y b p * christoffel G p m a y := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro p _
      rw [hsymm y p b]
      ring
    have hsd : partialDeriv m (fun z => G z b a) y = partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y := by
      have hf : (fun z => G z b a) = (fun z => G z a b) := funext (fun z => hsymm z b a)
      rw [hf]
    rw [e1, hlowΓ b m a, hlowΓ a m b, hsd]
    ring
  
  have hfin : X = -((G y)⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose Γm + Γm * (G y)⁻¹) := by
    rw [hX, hDmat]
    have h4 : (G y)⁻¹ * ((Matrix.transpose Γm * G y + G y * Γm) * (G y)⁻¹) =
        (G y)⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose Γm * (G y * (G y)⁻¹) + ((G y)⁻¹ * G y) * Γm * (G y)⁻¹ := by
      simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [h4, hGP, hPG, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul]
  have hkl := congrFun (congrFun hfin k) l
  simp only [X, Γm, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.transpose_apply] at hkl
  rw [hkl, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hA : ∑ a : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k a * christoffel G l m a y =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, christoffel G l m a y * (G y)⁻¹ k a :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => mul_comm _ _)
  rw [hA]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X) (hS : IsCompact S) (hne : S.Nonempty) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (V : X → ℝ) (hV : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => V (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) : ∃ (lam : ℝ) (u : ℕ → X → ℝ) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (K : Fin P.n → Set E2) (c₀ : ℝ), (∀ n j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u n (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧ (∀ n, ∀ q ∈ S, 0 ≤ u n q) ∧ Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n, ∫ x in L, ((u n (P.param j x)) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x' => u n (P.param j x')) x) ^ 2) ≤ C) ∧ (∀ j, IsCompact (K j) ∧ K j ⊆ P.W j) ∧ 0 < c₀ ∧ (∀ n, c₀ ≤ ∑ j, ∫ x in K j, (u n (P.param j x)) ^ 2) ∧ ∀ j (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W j → ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ n (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ n + 2 * t * (∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b (fun x' => u n (P.param j x')) x * pd2 a ζ x - (V (P.param j x) + lam) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * u n (P.param j x) * ζ x)) + t ^ 2 * M

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hP1 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ P.O j ∧ P.param j x ∈ S := by
    intro j x hx
    have hmem : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hP3 : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) = P.param j x := by
    intro j k x hx
    have hq : P.param j x ∈ P.O k ∩ S := ⟨hx.2, (hP1 j x hx.1).2⟩
    rw [← P.image_eq k] at hq
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hq
    rw [← hyx, P.proj_param k y hy]
    exact ⟨hy, rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, K, hρnn, hρs, hρ1, hK, hρK, hρO⟩ :=
    eig_partition_unity S hS P (fun k ζ h1 h2 h3 => eig_lift_smooth S P k ζ h1 h2 h3)
  have hρc : ∀ j k, ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k) :=
    fun j k => (hρs j k).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨hlin, hsmul, hcongr, hmono, hnn, ⟨A, hA0, hAb⟩, hposI⟩ :=
    eig_wint_facts S P ρ K hρnn (fun j => hρc j j) hK hρK
  
  obtain ⟨Cl, hCl⟩ : ∃ Cl : Set (X → ℝ), ∀ w, w ∈ Cl ↔
      ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w (P.param j x)) (P.W j) :=
    ⟨{w | ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w (P.param j x)) (P.W j)}, fun w => Iff.rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨NF, hNF⟩ : ∃ NF : (X → ℝ) → (X → ℝ) → Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ,
      ∀ w v j x, NF w v j x = w (P.param j x) * v (P.param j x) :=
    ⟨fun w v j x => w (P.param j x) * v (P.param j x), fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨BF, hBF⟩ : ∃ BF : (X → ℝ) → (X → ℝ) → Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ,

eig_variational_sequence.definitions:
def eigWInt {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det

def eigGam {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (u v : X → ℝ) (j : Fin P.n) (x : E2) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b (fun x' => u (P.param j x')) x *
    pd2 a (fun x' => v (P.param j x')) x

def eigWInt {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det

def eigGam {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (u v : X → ℝ) (j : Fin P.n) (x : E2) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b (fun x' => u (P.param j x')) x *
    pd2 a (fun x' => v (P.param j x')) x

by

  have core : ∀ (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → ∀ (c : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn c U →

      w j x = w k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) := by
    intro j k
    have hmapsto : ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k :=
      fun x hx => (hmap j k x hx).1
    have htr := s2 _ (P.W k) (hopen j k) (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) (P.trans_smooth j k)
      hmapsto (hinj j k) (hdet j k) (fun n y => u n (P.param k y)) (w k)
      (fun n => (hu n k).continuousOn) (hw k).continuousOn (hconv k)
    apply s1 _ (hopen j k) (fun n x => u n (P.param j x)) (w j)
      (fun x => w k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
      (fun n => (hu n j).continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
      ((hw j).continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
      ((hw k).continuousOn.comp (P.trans_smooth j k).continuousOn hmapsto)
      (fun L hL hLU => hconv j L hL (hLU.trans Set.inter_subset_left))
    intro L hL hLU
    refine (htr L hL hLU).congr (fun n => ?_)
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun hL.measurableSet (fun x hx => ?_)
    simp only [(hmap j k x (hLU hx)).2]
  
  let φ : X → ℝ := fun q =>
    if h : ∃ j, q ∈ P.O j then w h.choose (P.proj h.choose q) else 0
  have hφ : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ P.W k, φ (P.param k x) = w k x := by
    intro k x hx
    have h : ∃ j, P.param k x ∈ P.O j := ⟨k, (hP1 k x hx).1⟩
    have e : φ (P.param k x) = w h.choose (P.proj h.choose (P.param k x)) := dif_pos h
    rw [e, hcons k h.choose x ⟨hx, h.choose_spec⟩]
  
  have hwnn : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ w j x := fun j =>
    s4 (P.W j) (P.W_open j) (fun n x => u n (P.param j x)) (w j)
      (fun n => (hu n j).continuousOn) (fun n x hx => hnn n _ (hP1 j x hx).2)
      (hw j).continuousOn (hconv j)
  refine ⟨φ, hφ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q hq
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hq)
    have hqim : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
      rw [P.image_eq j]
      exact ⟨hj, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hqim
    rw [hφ j x hx]
    exact hwnn j x hx
  
  · by_contra H
    push_neg at H
    have hw0 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, w j x = 0 := fun j x hx => by
      rw [← hφ j x hx]
      exact H _ (hP1 j x hx).2
    have hj : ∀ j, Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in K j, (u n (P.param j x)) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      intro j
      refine (hconv j (K j) (hK j).1 (hK j).2).congr (fun n => ?_)
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun (hK j).1.measurableSet (fun x hx => ?_)
      simp only [hw0 j x ((hK j).2 hx), sub_zero]
    have hlim := tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hj j)
    rw [Finset.sum_const_zero] at hlim
    have := ge_of_tendsto' hlim hnd
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsm : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) : ∃ (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) ∧ (∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) ∧ ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), lap2 h w x = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k w x

signature.name: esm_lap2_coeff_form
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsm : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) : ∃ (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) ∧ (∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) ∧ ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), lap2 h w x = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k w x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => h x a b) W :=
    fun a b => (hsm a b).continuousOn
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x).det) W := by
    simp only [Matrix.det_fin_two]
    exact ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).sub ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0))
  have hdet : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).det ≠ 0 := fun x hx => ((hpd x hx).det_pos).ne'
  have hinvc : ContinuousOn (fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹) W := hdetc.inv₀ hdet
  have hform : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), (h x)⁻¹ i j = ((h x).det)⁻¹ * (h x).adjugate i j := by
    intro x i j
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ i j) W := by
    intro i j
    simp only [hform]
    refine hinvc.mul ?_
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
    · exact hc 1 1
    · exact (hc 0 1).neg
    · exact (hc 1 0).neg
    · exact hc 0 0
  have hpd2 : ∀ a b l : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 l (fun z => h z a b) x) W := by
    intro a b l
    exact ((hsm a b).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => christoffel2 h k i j x) W := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel2
    refine continuousOn_const.mul ?_
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun l _ => ?_)
    exact (hA k l).mul (((hpd2 j l i).add (hpd2 i l j)).sub (hpd2 i j l))
  refine ⟨fun x => (h x)⁻¹,
    fun x k => -(∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * christoffel2 h k i j x),
    hA, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k
    refine ContinuousOn.neg ?_
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_)
    exact (hA i j).mul (hΓ k i j)
  · intro x hx i j
    have hH := (hpd x hx).isHermitian.inv
    have h1 := hH.apply i j
    simp only [star_trivial] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  · intro x hx ξ hξ
    have hP := (hpd x hx).inv
    have hv : (fun i => ξ i) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hξ
      ext i
      simpa using congrFun h0 i
    have h1 := hP.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial] at h1
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    linarith
  · intro w x
    simp only [lap2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w c : E2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) (hB : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) (hAs : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (hc : ContinuousOn c W) (hnn : ∀ x ∈ W, 0 ≤ w x) (heq : ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k w x + c x * w x = 0) (z x₁ : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z R, 0 < w x) (hx₁ : dist x₁ z = R) (hw₁ : w x₁ = 0) : False

signature.name: esm_hopf_touching
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w c : E2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) (hB : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) (hAs : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (hc : ContinuousOn c W) (hnn : ∀ x ∈ W, 0 ≤ w x) (heq : ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k w x + c x * w x = 0) (z x₁ : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z R, 0 < w x) (hx₁ : dist x₁ z = R) (hw₁ : w x₁ = 0) : False

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hx₁W : x₁ ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hx₁])
  have hmin1 : IsLocalMin w x₁ := by
    filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hx₁W] with y hy
    rw [hw₁]
    exact hnn y hy
  have hdw1 : fderiv ℝ w x₁ = 0 := hmin1.fderiv_eq_zero
  
  obtain ⟨m₀, Λ, β, Γ, m, hm₀, hΛ, hβ, hΓ, hm, hK, hSin⟩ :=
    esm_hopf_constants W A B w c hA hB hApos hw.continuousOn hc z R hR hball hpos
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α : ℝ, α = 1 + (4 * Λ + 4 * β * R + Γ) / (4 * m₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hα1 : 1 ≤ α := by
    have : 0 ≤ (4 * Λ + 4 * β * R + Γ) / (4 * m₀) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hα0 : 0 < α := by linarith
  
  have hbar : ∀ (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (b : Fin 2 → ℝ) (y : E2),
      m₀ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, y i * a i j * y j → (∀ i : Fin 2, |a i i| ≤ Λ) →
      (∀ k : Fin 2, |b k| ≤ β) → ‖y‖ ≤ R →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a i j * ((4 * α ^ 2 * y i * y j
          - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, b k * (-2 * α * y k * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        - Γ * (Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) := by
    intro a b y hq ha hb hy
    have hE := Real.exp_pos (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
    have hER := Real.exp_pos (-α * R ^ 2)
    have hy0 : |y 0| ≤ R := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le y 0
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      linarith
    have hy1 : |y 1| ≤ R := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le y 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      linarith
    have htr : a 0 0 + a 1 1 ≤ 2 * Λ := by
      have h0 := le_abs_self (a 0 0)
      have h1 := le_abs_self (a 1 1)
      linarith [ha 0, ha 1]
    have hb0 : b 0 * y 0 ≤ β * R := by
      calc b 0 * y 0 ≤ |b 0 * y 0| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |b 0| * |y 0| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ β * R := mul_le_mul (hb 0) hy0 (abs_nonneg _) hβ
    have hb1 : b 1 * y 1 ≤ β * R := by
      calc b 1 * y 1 ≤ |b 1 * y 1| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |b 1| * |y 1| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ β * R := mul_le_mul (hb 1) hy1 (abs_nonneg _) hβ
    have h4 : 4 * α * m₀ = 4 * m₀ + 4 * Λ + 4 * β * R + Γ := by
      rw [hα]
      field_simp
      ring
    set q := ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, y i * a i j * y j with hqdef
    have hP : 0 < 4 * α ^ 2 * q - 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1) - 2 * α * (b 0 * y 0 + b 1 * y 1) - Γ := by
      have e1 : 4 * α ^ 2 * m₀ ≤ 4 * α ^ 2 * q := by
        have : 0 ≤ 4 * α ^ 2 := by positivity
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq this
      have e2 : 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1) ≤ 2 * α * (2 * Λ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htr (by positivity)
      have e3 : 2 * α * (b 0 * y 0 + b 1 * y 1) ≤ 2 * α * (2 * β * R) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have e4 : 4 * α ^ 2 * m₀ - 4 * α * Λ - 4 * α * β * R - Γ = 4 * α * m₀ + (α - 1) * Γ := by
        linear_combination α * h4
      have e5 : 0 < 4 * α * m₀ + (α - 1) * Γ := by
        have : 0 ≤ (α - 1) * Γ := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hΓ
        have : 0 < 4 * α * m₀ := by positivity
        linarith
      nlinarith
    have hkey : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a i j * ((4 * α ^ 2 * y i * y j
          - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, b k * (-2 * α * y k * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        - Γ * (Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2))
        = Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * (4 * α ^ 2 * q - 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1)
          - 2 * α * (b 0 * y 0 + b 1 * y 1) - Γ) + Γ * Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2) := by
      rw [hqdef]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, if_pos (rfl : (0 : Fin 2) = 0), if_pos (rfl : (1 : Fin 2) = 1),
        if_neg (show ¬((0 : Fin 2) = 1) by decide), if_neg (show ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 0) by decide),
        if_true]
      ring
    rw [hkey]
    have := mul_pos hE hP
    have := mul_nonneg hΓ hER.le
    linarith
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : E2 → ℝ, ∀ x, v x = Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, fun x => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hvs, hvD, hv1, hv2⟩ := esm_barrier_derivs z α R v hv
  have hV1 : ∀ x, dist x z = R → v x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hv, ← dist_eq_norm, hx, sub_self]
  have hV2 : ∀ x, v x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    have h1 : Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
      have := sq_nonneg ‖x - z‖
      nlinarith
    have h2 := Real.exp_pos (-α * R ^ 2)
    rw [hv]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ : ∃ y₀ : E2, y₀ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (z - x₁) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hV3 : 0 < fderiv ℝ v x₁ y₀ := by
    rw [hvD x₁ y₀]
    have hs : ∑ k : Fin 2, (x₁ - z) k * y₀ k = -(1 / 2) * ‖x₁ - z‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      simp [hy₀, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      ring
    rw [hs, ← dist_eq_norm, hx₁]
    rw [show -2 * α * (-(1 / 2) * R ^ 2) = α * R ^ 2 by ring]
    positivity
  
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w x - m * v x) W :=
    hw.sub (contDiffOn_const.mul hvs.contDiffOn)
  
  have hlin : ∀ x ∈ W, fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y - m * v y) x = fderiv ℝ w x - m • fderiv ℝ v x ∧
      (∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => w y - m * v y) x = pd2 k w x - m * pd2 k v x) ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (fun y => w y - m * v y)) x
        = pd2 i (pd2 j w) x - m * pd2 i (pd2 j v) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hdf : ∀ y ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ w y := fun y hy =>
      (hw.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)
    have hdg : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ v y := fun y => hvs.differentiable (by simp) y
    have h1 : ∀ y ∈ W, fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y - m * v y) y = fderiv ℝ w y - m • fderiv ℝ v y := by
      intro y hy
      exact ((hdf y hy).hasFDerivAt.sub ((hdg y).hasFDerivAt.const_mul m)).fderiv
    have h2 : ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ k : Fin 2,
        pd2 k (fun y => w y - m * v y) y = pd2 k w y - m * pd2 k v y := by
      intro y hy k
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y - m * v y) y (e2 k)
        = fderiv ℝ w y (e2 k) - m * fderiv ℝ v y (e2 k)
      rw [h1 y hy]
      rfl
    have hdpf : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) x := by
      intro j
      have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) W :=
        (hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      exact (hc.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
    have hdpg : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) x := by
      intro j
      have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) :=
        (hvs.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const
      exact hc.differentiable (by simp) x
    refine ⟨h1 x hx, h2 x hx, fun i j => ?_⟩
    have hev : pd2 j (fun y => w y - m * v y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j) - m * fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => h2 y hy j)
    show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (fun y => w y - m * v y)) x (e2 i)
      = fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) x (e2 i)
        - m * fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) x (e2 i)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hD := ((hdpf j).hasFDerivAt.sub ((hdpg j).hasFDerivAt.const_mul m)).fderiv
    exact congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e2 i)) hD
  have hstrict : ∀ x : E2, R / 2 < dist x z → dist x z < R →
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j (fun x => w x - m * v x)) x
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k (fun x => w x - m * v x) x
        - Γ * (fun x => w x - m * v x) x < 0 := by
    intro x h1 h2
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]; exact h2.le)
    obtain ⟨-, hp1, hp2⟩ := hlin x hxW
    obtain ⟨hq, ha, hb, hcx⟩ := hK x h1.le h2.le
    have hineq := hbar (A x) (B x) (x - z) hq ha hb
      (by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact h2.le)
    have he := heq x hxW
    have hcw : 0 ≤ (c x + Γ) * w x :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith [neg_abs_le (c x)]) (hnn x hxW)
    have hTv := mul_pos hm hineq
    simp only [hp1, hp2, hv1, hv2, hv x] at hTv ⊢
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hTv he ⊢
    linarith
  have hout : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R → 0 ≤ (fun x => w x - m * v x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hx])
    show 0 ≤ w x - m * v x
    rw [hV1 x hx, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact hnn x hxW
  have hin : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → 0 ≤ (fun x => w x - m * v x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hSin x hx
    have h2 := hV2 x
    show 0 ≤ w x - m * v x
    nlinarith
  
  have hApsd : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j := by
    intro x hx ξ
    by_cases hξ : ξ = 0
    · subst hξ
      simp
    · exact (hApos x hx ξ hξ).le
  have hmp := esm_annulus_min_principle W hW A B (fun x => w x - m * v x) Γ z R hR hball hu hAs
    hApsd hΓ hstrict hin hout
  
  have hu1 : w x₁ - m * v x₁ = 0 := by
    rw [hw₁, hV1 x₁ hx₁]
    ring
  have hseg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 →
      (fun x => w x - m * v x) x₁ ≤ (fun x => w x - m * v x) (x₁ + t • y₀) := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    have hd : dist (x₁ + t • y₀) z = (1 - t / 2) * R := by
      have e1 : x₁ + t • y₀ - z = (1 - t / 2) • (x₁ - z) := by
        rw [hy₀]
        module

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hcongr : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (h₁ h₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      h₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] h₂ → levelMeanCurvCoord G h₁ y = levelMeanCurvCoord G h₂ y := by
    intro G h₁ h₂ y hh
    have hp : ∀ k, partialDeriv k h₁ y = partialDeriv k h₂ y := by
      intro k
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hh.fderiv_eq]
    have hg : ∀ j, partialDeriv j h₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] partialDeriv j h₂ := by
      intro j
      exact (Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ) hh).mono fun z hz => by
        simp only [partialDeriv, hz]
    have hpp : ∀ i j, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h₁) y =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h₂) y := by
      intro i j
      show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j h₁) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j h₂) y (e i)
      rw [(hg j).fderiv_eq]
    have hH : ∀ i j, hessLoc G h₁ i j y = hessLoc G h₂ i j y := by
      intro i j
      simp only [hessLoc, hp, hpp]
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, lapLoc, hH, hp]
  
  have hqsrc : q ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := mem_chart_source E3 q
  have hy₀t : chartAt E3 q q ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).map_source hqsrc
  have hy₀q : (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) = q := (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hqsrc
  have hcd : ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    fun u hu => contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hdiff : ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) y :=
    fun u hu y hy => ((hcd u hu).contDiffAt
      ((chartAt E3 q).open_target.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hnd : ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ≠ 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y ≠ 0 := by
    intro u hu y hy hmu h0
    apply hmu
    have hx : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
    have hκx : chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = y := (chartAt E3 q).right_inv hy
    have hev : u =ᶠ[𝓝 ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)]
        (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ∘ (chartAt E3 q) := by
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).open_source.mem_nhds hx] with x hx'
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hx']
    rw [hev.mfderiv_eq]
    have hd1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
        (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) := by
      rw [hκx]
      exact mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.2 (hdiff u hu y hy)
    have hd2 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      ((contMDiffOn_chart (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞)).contMDiffAt
        ((chartAt E3 q).open_source.mem_nhds hx)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    rw [mfderiv_comp _ hd1 hd2, hκx, mfderiv_eq_fderiv, h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp]
  
  obtain ⟨V', f', hV'V, hV'o, hqV', hf', hdf', hV'S, hmin, -, -⟩ :=
    hSm.2 q hq V (hVo.mem_nhds hqV)
  have hΩo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' V') :=
    (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hV'o
  have hy₀Ω : chartAt E3 q q ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' V' := by
    refine ⟨hy₀t, ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) ∈ V'
    rw [hy₀q]
    exact hqV'
  have hzero : ∀ x ∈ V', f x = 0 → f' x = 0 := by
    intro x hx h0
    have h1 : x ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hV'V hx, h0⟩
    rw [← hVS] at h1
    have h2 : x ∈ V' ∩ Sig := ⟨hx, h1.2⟩
    rw [hV'S] at h2
    exact h2.2
  have hfq : f q = 0 := by
    have h1 : q ∈ V ∩ Sig := ⟨hqV, hq⟩
    rw [hVS] at h1
    exact h1.2
  have hf0 : (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q) = 0 := by
    show f ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q)) = 0
    rw [hy₀q]
    exact hfq
  have hdf0 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q) ≠ 0 :=
    hnd f hf _ hy₀t (by rw [hy₀q]; exact hdf q hqV)
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr, u, hball, hu, hdiv⟩ := coord_division
    ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' V') hΩo
    (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (fun z => f' ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
    ((hcd f hf).mono Set.inter_subset_left) ((hcd f' hf').mono Set.inter_subset_left)
    (chartAt E3 q q) hy₀Ω hf0 hdf0 (fun y hy h0 => hzero _ hy.2 h0)
  have hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y j i :=
    fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
    { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 q).symm.toPartialEquiv
      open_source := (chartAt E3 q).open_target
      open_target := (chartAt E3 q).open_source
      contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
  refine ⟨Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) r, Metric.isOpen_ball, Metric.mem_ball_self hr,
    fun y hy => (hball hy).1, fun z hzO h0 => ?_⟩
  have hzΩ := hball hzO
  have hzt : z ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := hzΩ.1
  have hzV' : (chartAt E3 q).symm z ∈ V' := hzΩ.2
  have hgerm : (fun y => f' ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
      (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * u y) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzO) hdiv
  have hd₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) z := hdiff f hf z hzt
  have hd₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ u z :=
    (hu.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzO)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f' ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) z =
      u z • fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) z := by
    have hm : HasFDerivAt (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * u y)
        ((fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) z • fderiv ℝ u z +
          u z • fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) z) z :=
      hd₁.hasFDerivAt.mul hd₂.hasFDerivAt
    rw [hgerm.fderiv_eq, hm.fderiv]
    simp only [h0, zero_smul, zero_add]
  have huz : u z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hu0
    apply hnd f' hf' z hzt (hdf' _ hzV')
    rw [hfd, hu0, zero_smul]
  have hf'z : f' ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) = 0 := hzero _ hzV' h0
  have hE1 := lmc_mul_zero (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) r)
    Metric.isOpen_ball hsymm (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) u
    ((hcd f hf).mono (fun y hy => (hball hy).1)) hu z hzO
    (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q z hzt) h0 (hnd f hf z hzt (hdf _ (hV'V hzV'))) huz
  have hgermH : levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
      (fun y => f' ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) z =
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * u y) z :=
    hcongr _ _ _ z hgerm
  have hlmc : g.levelMeanCurv f' ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) =
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun y => f' ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) z :=
    levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φ f' (fun y => f' ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) hf' z hzt
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl))
  have hH0 : levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
      (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * u y) z = 0 := by
    rw [← hgermH, ← hlmc]
    exact hmin _ hzV' hf'z
  rw [hH0, zero_mul] at hE1
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hE1.symm).resolve_left huz
