        exact contDiffAt_const
  
  have s3 : ∀ (K : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ K → ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : E3), ℓ w = 1 →
      (∀ z : E3, ℓ z = 0 → K z = 0) → ∀ z : E3,
      K z = ℓ z * ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ K (z - ((1 - t) * ℓ z) • w) w := by
    intro K hK ℓ w hw hK0 z
    set c := ℓ z with hc
    have hKd : Differentiable ℝ K := hK.differentiable (by simp)
    have hp : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => z - ((1 - t) * c) • w) (c • w) t := by
      intro t
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (1 - t) * c) (-c) t := by
        have := ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub 1).mul_const c
        simpa using this
      have h2 := (h1.smul_const w).const_sub z
      simpa using h2
    have hφ : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => K (z - ((1 - t) * c) • w))
        (c * fderiv ℝ K (z - ((1 - t) * c) • w) w) t := by
      intro t
      have := (hKd (z - ((1 - t) * c) • w)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hp t)
      simpa [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] using this
    have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => c * fderiv ℝ K (z - ((1 - t) * c) • w) w) := by
      have h1 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => z - ((1 - t) * c) • w) := by fun_prop
      exact continuous_const.mul
        (((hK.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).comp h1).clm_apply continuous_const)
    have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun t _ => hφ t)
      (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hFTC
    have h0 : K (z - ((1 - 0) * c) • w) = 0 := by
      apply hK0
      simp [hc, hw]
    rw [hFTC, h0]
    simp
  
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ : ∃ ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ℓ = fderiv ℝ f y₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, ℓ v ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    exact hdf (hℓ ▸ ContinuousLinearMap.ext hcon)
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : E3, ℓ w = 1 :=
    ⟨(ℓ v)⁻¹ • v, by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv]⟩
  
  have hdfc : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y w) U :=
    (hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  obtain ⟨U', hU'def⟩ : ∃ U' : Set E3, U' = U ∩ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y w) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hU' : IsOpen U' := hU'def ▸ hdfc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hmemU' : ∀ y, y ∈ U' ↔ y ∈ U ∧ fderiv ℝ f y w ≠ 0 := by
    intro y; rw [hU'def]; rfl
  have hU'U : U' ⊆ U := fun y hy => ((hmemU' y).1 hy).1
  have hy₀' : y₀ ∈ U' := by
    rw [hmemU']
    refine ⟨hy₀, ?_⟩
    rw [← hℓ, hw]
    exact one_ne_zero
  
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘdef⟩ : ∃ Θ : E3 → E3, Θ = fun y => y + (f y - ℓ y) • w := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΘs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Θ U := by
    rw [hΘdef]
    exact contDiffOn_id.add ((hf.sub ℓ.contDiff.contDiffOn).smul contDiffOn_const)
  have hΘℓ : ∀ y, ℓ (Θ y) = f y := by
    intro y
    rw [hΘdef]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hw]
    ring
  have hinv : ∀ y ∈ U', ∃ A : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3, HasFDerivAt Θ (A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hmemU'] at hy
    have hfd : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f y) y :=
      ((hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy.1)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := s2 (fderiv ℝ f y - ℓ) w (by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, hw]
      intro h0
      apply hy.2
      linarith)
    refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
    rw [hA, hΘdef]
    exact (hasFDerivAt_id y).add ((hfd.sub ℓ.hasFDerivAt).smul_const w)
  
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ := hinv y₀ hy₀'
  have hΘa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Θ y₀ := hΘs.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy₀)
  obtain ⟨P, hPc, hy₀P, hz₀P⟩ : ∃ P : OpenPartialHomeomorph E3 E3,
      (P : E3 → E3) = Θ ∧ y₀ ∈ P.source ∧ Θ y₀ ∈ P.target :=
    ⟨ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph Θ hΘa hA₀ (by simp),
      ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe hΘa hA₀ (by simp),
      ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hΘa hA₀ (by simp),
      ContDiffAt.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target hΘa hA₀ (by simp)⟩
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀def⟩ : ∃ z₀ : E3, z₀ = Θ y₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hO : IsOpen (P.target ∩ P.symm ⁻¹' (P.source ∩ U')) :=
    P.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage P.open_target (P.open_source.inter hU')
  have hz₀O : z₀ ∈ P.target ∩ P.symm ⁻¹' (P.source ∩ U') := by
    rw [hz₀def]
    refine ⟨hz₀P, ?_⟩
    show P.symm (Θ y₀) ∈ P.source ∩ U'
    have : P.symm (P y₀) = y₀ := P.left_inv hy₀P
    rw [hPc] at this
    rw [this]
    exact ⟨hy₀P, hy₀'⟩
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρO⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hO z₀ hz₀O
  have hΨ1 : ∀ z ∈ ball z₀ ρ, P.symm z ∈ U' ∧ Θ (P.symm z) = z := by
    intro z hzb
    refine ⟨(hρO hzb).2.2, ?_⟩
    have := P.right_inv (hρO hzb).1
    rw [hPc] at this
    exact this
  have hΨs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (P.symm : E3 → E3) (ball z₀ ρ) := by
    intro z hzb
    have hzt := (hρO hzb).1
    have hΨz : P.symm z ∈ P.source ∩ U' := (hρO hzb).2
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hinv (P.symm z) hΨz.2
    refine (P.contDiffAt_symm hzt (f₀' := A) ?_ ?_).contDiffWithinAt
    · rw [hPc]; exact hA
    · rw [hPc]; exact hΘs.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hU'U hΨz.2))
  have hO' : IsOpen ((P.source ∩ U') ∩ Θ ⁻¹' ball z₀ (ρ / 4)) :=
    (hΘs.continuousOn.mono (fun y hy => hU'U hy.2)).isOpen_inter_preimage
      (P.open_source.inter hU') isOpen_ball
  have hy₀O' : y₀ ∈ (P.source ∩ U') ∩ Θ ⁻¹' ball z₀ (ρ / 4) := by
    refine ⟨⟨hy₀P, hy₀'⟩, ?_⟩
    show Θ y₀ ∈ ball z₀ (ρ / 4)
    rw [← hz₀def]
    exact mem_ball_self (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrO⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hO' y₀ hy₀O'
  have hy1 : ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r, y ∈ U ∧ Θ y ∈ ball z₀ (ρ / 4) ∧ P.symm (Θ y) = y := by
    intro y hy
    refine ⟨hU'U (hrO hy).1.2, (hrO hy).2, ?_⟩
    have := P.left_inv (hrO hy).1.1
    rw [hPc] at this
    exact this
  
  have hks : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => h (P.symm z)) (ball z₀ ρ) :=
    hh.comp hΨs (fun z hzb => hU'U (hΨ1 z hzb).1)
  have hk0 : ∀ z ∈ ball z₀ ρ, ℓ z = 0 → h (P.symm z) = 0 := by
    intro z hzb hlz
    have h1 := hΨ1 z hzb
    apply hz (P.symm z) (hU'U h1.1)
    rw [← hΘℓ, h1.2, hlz]
  
  obtain ⟨χ, hχin, hχout⟩ : ∃ χ : ContDiffBump z₀, χ.rIn = ρ / 4 ∧ χ.rOut = ρ / 2 :=
    ⟨⟨ρ / 4, ρ / 2, by positivity, by linarith⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hsuppχ : ∀ z, χ z ≠ 0 → dist z z₀ < ρ / 2 := by
    intro z hzχ
    have : z ∈ Function.support χ := hzχ
    rw [χ.support_eq, hχout] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : E3 → ℝ, K = fun z => χ z * h (P.symm z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ K := hKdef ▸ s5 z₀ ρ _ χ hks χ.contDiff hsuppχ
  have hK0 : ∀ z, ℓ z = 0 → K z = 0 := by
    intro z hlz
    rw [hKdef]
    by_cases hzb : z ∈ ball z₀ ρ
    · show χ z * h (P.symm z) = 0
      rw [hk0 z hzb hlz, mul_zero]
    · have : χ z = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        apply hzb
        have := hsuppχ z hne
        show dist z z₀ < ρ
        linarith
      show χ z * h (P.symm z) = 0
      rw [this, zero_mul]
  have hKk : ∀ z ∈ ball z₀ (ρ / 4), K z = h (P.symm z) := by
    intro z hzb
    have : χ z = 1 := χ.one_of_mem_closedBall (by rw [hχin]; exact ball_subset_closedBall hzb)
    rw [hKdef]
    show χ z * h (P.symm z) = h (P.symm z)
    rw [this, one_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : E3 → ℝ,
      V = fun z => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ K (z - ((1 - t) * ℓ z) • w) w := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKV : ∀ z, K z = ℓ z * V z := by
    intro z
    rw [hVdef]
    exact s3 K hKs ℓ w hw hK0 z
  have hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V := by
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ K) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hKs).2
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × ℝ => p.1 - ((1 - p.2) * ℓ p.1) • w) :=
      contDiff_fst.sub (((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd).mul
        (ℓ.contDiff.comp contDiff_fst)).smul contDiff_const)
    have hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry
        (fun (z : E3) (t : ℝ) => fderiv ℝ K (z - ((1 - t) * ℓ z) • w) w)) :=
      (h1.comp h2).clm_apply contDiff_const
    rw [hVdef]
    exact contDiff_infty.2 (fun n => s4 n ℝ _ (contDiff_infty.1 hG n) 0 1)
  
  refine ⟨r, hr, fun y => V (Θ y), fun y hy => (hy1 y hy).1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hVs.comp_contDiffOn (hΘs.mono (fun y hy => (hy1 y hy).1))
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨_, hΘy, hΨΘ⟩ := hy1 y hy
    calc h y = h (P.symm (Θ y)) := by rw [hΨΘ]
      _ = K (Θ y) := (hKk _ hΘy).symm
      _ = ℓ (Θ y) * V (Θ y) := hKV _
      _ = f y * V (Θ y) := by rw [hΘℓ]

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (f a F : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hF : ∀ y ∈ U, F y = f y + f y ^ 2 * a y) (y₁ : E3) (hy₁ : y₁ ∈ U) (hf0 : f y₁ = 0) (hdf : fderiv ℝ f y₁ ≠ 0) : levelMeanCurvCoord G F y₁ = levelMeanCurvCoord G f y₁ ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y₁ = partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G f) y₁

signature.name: jacobiCoord_invariance
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (f a F : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hF : ∀ y ∈ U, F y = f y + f y ^ 2 * a y) (y₁ : E3) (hy₁ : y₁ ∈ U) (hf0 : f y₁ = 0) (hdf : fderiv ℝ f y₁ ≠ 0) : levelMeanCurvCoord G F y₁ = levelMeanCurvCoord G f y₁ ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y₁ = partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G f) y₁

proof.tactics:
by
  have hn0 : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hdiffU : ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ U → ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ φ z :=
    fun φ hφ z hz => (hφ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt hn0
  have hpdU : ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ U → ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i φ) U :=
    fun φ hφ i => (hφ.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hfirst : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j, partialDeriv j F z =
      (1 + 2 * f z * a z) * partialDeriv j f z + f z ^ 2 * partialDeriv j a z := by
    intro z hz j
    have hfz := (hdiffU f hf z hz).hasFDerivAt
    have haz := (hdiffU a ha z hz).hasFDerivAt
    have hev : F =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun w => f w + f w ^ 2 * a w :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hz) hF
    have hd := hfz.add ((hfz.pow 2).mul haz)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [show fderiv ℝ F z = _ from hev.fderiv_eq.trans hd.fderiv]
    simp
    ring
  have hsecond : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) y =
      (1 + 2 * f y * a y) * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y
        + 2 * a y * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y
        + 2 * f y * (partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j a y + partialDeriv i a y * partialDeriv j f y)
        + f y ^ 2 * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j a) y := by
    intro y hy i j
    have hev : partialDeriv j F =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun z =>
        (1 + 2 * f z * a z) * partialDeriv j f z + f z ^ 2 * partialDeriv j a z :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hfirst z hz j)
    have hfy := (hdiffU f hf y hy).hasFDerivAt
    have hay := (hdiffU a ha y hy).hasFDerivAt
    have hpf := (hdiffU _ (hpdU f hf j) y hy).hasFDerivAt
    have hpa := (hdiffU _ (hpdU a ha j) y hy).hasFDerivAt
    have hd := (((hasFDerivAt_const (1 : ℝ) y).add ((hfy.const_mul 2).fun_mul hay)).fun_mul hpf).add
      ((hfy.pow 2).fun_mul hpa)
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j F) y (e i) = _
    rw [show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j F) y = _ from hev.fderiv_eq.trans hd.fderiv]
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    simp
    ring
  
  have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f y₁ := hdiffU f hf y₁ hy₁
  have had : DifferentiableAt ℝ a y₁ := hdiffU a ha y₁ hy₁
  have hpf : ∀ k, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k f) y₁ := fun k => hdiffU _ (hpdU f hf k) y₁ hy₁
  have hpa : ∀ k, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k a) y₁ := fun k => hdiffU _ (hpdU a ha k) y₁ hy₁
  have hppf : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f)) y₁ :=
    fun i j => hdiffU _ (hpdU _ (hpdU f hf j) i) y₁ hy₁
  have hppa : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j a)) y₁ :=
    fun i j => hdiffU _ (hpdU _ (hpdU a ha j) i) y₁ hy₁
  have hGd : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y i j) y₁ := fun i j => hdiffU _ (hG i j) y₁ hy₁
  have hdet : ∀ M : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, (∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => M y i j) y₁) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (M y).det) y₁ := by
    intro M hM
    simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    have h00 := hM 0 0; have h01 := hM 0 1; have h02 := hM 0 2
    have h10 := hM 1 0; have h11 := hM 1 1; have h12 := hM 1 2
    have h20 := hM 2 0; have h21 := hM 2 1; have h22 := hM 2 2
    fun_prop
  have hPd : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) y₁ := by
    intro i j
    have e1 : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) = fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate i j := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [e1]
    have hadj : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y).adjugate i j) y₁ := by
      simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
      apply hdet (fun y => (G y).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1))
      intro k l
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_apply]
      by_cases hkj : k = j
      · simp only [hkj, ↓reduceIte]; exact differentiableAt_const _
      · simp only [hkj, ↓reduceIte]; exact hGd k l
    exact ((hdet G hGd).inv (hGpd y₁ hy₁).det_pos.ne').mul hadj
  have hpGd : ∀ m r t, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv m (fun z => G z r t)) y₁ :=
    fun m r t => hdiffU _ (hpdU _ (hG r t) m) y₁ hy₁
  have hΓd : ∀ k i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (christoffel G k i j) y₁ := by
    intro k i j
    have e1 : christoffel G k i j = fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y
          - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y) := rfl
    rw [e1]
    exact (differentiableAt_const _).mul (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun l _ =>
      (hPd k l).mul (((hpGd i j l).add (hpGd j i l)).sub (hpGd l i j)))
  
  have hsym : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i := by
    intro y hy i j
    have h := (hGpd y hy).inv.1.apply i j
    simpa using h.symm
  have hpos : 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y₁)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y₁ * partialDeriv j f y₁ := by
    have hp : (fun i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i f y₁) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hdf
      have hz : ∀ i, fderiv ℝ f y₁ (e i) = 0 := fun i => congrFun h0 i
      ext1 w
      have hw : w = w 0 • e 0 + w 1 • e 1 + w 2 • e 2 := by
        ext k; fin_cases k <;> simp
      rw [hw]
      simp [hz]
    have h := (Matrix.posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec.mp (hGpd y₁ hy₁).inv).2 hp
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three, star_trivial] at h ⊢
    linarith
  
  have jet : ∀ (Ψ : E3 × ℝ → ℝ) (A B : E3 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ (y₁, 0) →
      (A =ᶠ[𝓝 y₁] fun y => Ψ (y, f y ^ 2)) → (B =ᶠ[𝓝 y₁] fun y => Ψ (y, 0)) →
      A y₁ = B y₁ ∧ ∀ i, partialDeriv i A y₁ = partialDeriv i B y₁ := by
    intro Ψ A B hΨ hA hB
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => f y ^ 2) (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y₁ := by
      have := hfd.hasFDerivAt.pow 2
      simpa [hf0] using this
    have hγ1 := (hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) y₁).prodMk h2
    have hγ0 := (hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) y₁).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) y₁)
    have hpt : (id y₁, f y₁ ^ 2) = (y₁, (0 : ℝ)) := by simp [hf0]
    have hΨ1 : HasFDerivAt Ψ (fderiv ℝ Ψ (y₁, 0)) (id y₁, f y₁ ^ 2) := by
      rw [hpt]; exact hΨ.hasFDerivAt
    have c1 := hΨ1.comp y₁ hγ1
    have c0 := hΨ.hasFDerivAt.comp y₁ hγ0
    have eA := hA.fderiv_eq.trans c1.fderiv
    have eB := hB.fderiv_eq.trans c0.fderiv
    refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩
    · rw [hA.eq_of_nhds, hB.eq_of_nhds]; simp [hf0]
    · unfold partialDeriv; rw [eA, eB]
  
  obtain ⟨Ex, hEx⟩ : ∃ Ex : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ → (Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ,
      Ex = fun P v h => (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * h i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * v i * v j) -
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P i a * v a * (P j b * v b) * h i j) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * v i * v j) ^ 3 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlmc : ∀ φ y, levelMeanCurvCoord G φ y =
      Ex ((G y)⁻¹) (fun k => partialDeriv k φ y) (fun i j => hessLoc G φ i j y) := by
    intro φ y; rw [hEx]; rfl
  have key : ∀ P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, (∀ i j, P i j = P j i) → ∀ (v u : Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (h : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (c : ℝ), 0 < c →
      Ex P (fun k => c * v k) (fun i j => c * h i j + v i * u j + u i * v j) = Ex P v h := by
    intro P hP v u h c hc
    rw [hEx]
    dsimp only
    have R1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (c * v i) * (c * v j) =
        c ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * v i * v j := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have R3 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (c * h i j + v i * u j + u i * v j) =
        c * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * h i j
          + 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * u i * v j := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; rw [hP 1 0, hP 2 0, hP 2 1]; ring
    have R4 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        P i a * (c * v a) * (P j b * (c * v b)) * (c * h i j + v i * u j + u i * v j) =
        c ^ 3 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          P i a * v a * (P j b * v b) * h i j)
        + 2 * c ^ 2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * v i * v j) *
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * u i * v j) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [R1, R3, R4]
    generalize ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * v i * v j = N
    generalize ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * h i j = L
    generalize ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * u i * v j = β
    generalize ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      P i a * v a * (P j b * v b) * h i j = Q
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq hc.le]
    by_cases hs : Real.sqrt N = 0
    · simp [hs]
    · have hNpos : 0 < N := Real.sqrt_pos.mp (lt_of_le_of_ne (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hs))
      have hN : N = Real.sqrt N ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hNpos.le).symm
      generalize Real.sqrt N = s at hs hN ⊢
      subst hN
      have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := hc.ne'
      field_simp
      ring
  
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : E3 × ℝ → Fin 3 → ℝ, v = fun x k =>
      partialDeriv k f x.1 + x.2 * (partialDeriv k a x.1 / (1 + 2 * f x.1 * a x.1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : E3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, E = fun y i j =>
      (2 * a y * f y ^ 2 / (1 + 2 * f y * a y) ^ 3 - 4 * f y / (1 + 2 * f y * a y) ^ 2) *
        partialDeriv i a y * partialDeriv j a y
        + partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j a) y / (1 + 2 * f y * a y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hh, hhh⟩ : ∃ hh : E3 × ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, hh = fun x i j =>
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) x.1 + x.2 * E x.1 i j
        - ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j x.1 * v x k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨uu, huu⟩ : ∃ uu : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, uu = fun y k =>
      a y * v (y, f y ^ 2) k - 2 * a y * f y ^ 2 * partialDeriv k a y / (1 + 2 * f y * a y)
        + 2 * f y * partialDeriv k a y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : E3 × ℝ → ℝ, Ψ = fun x => Ex ((G x.1)⁻¹) (v x) (hh x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have s12 : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < 1 + 2 * f y * a y → levelMeanCurvCoord G F y = Ψ (y, f y ^ 2) := by
    intro y hyU hc
    have hc0 : 1 + 2 * f y * a y ≠ 0 := hc.ne'
    have e1 : (fun k => partialDeriv k F y) = fun k => (1 + 2 * f y * a y) * v (y, f y ^ 2) k := by
      funext k
      rw [hfirst y hyU k]
      simp only [hv]
      field_simp
      try ring
    have e2 : (fun i j => hessLoc G F i j y) = fun i j => (1 + 2 * f y * a y) * hh (y, f y ^ 2) i j
        + v (y, f y ^ 2) i * uu y j + uu y i * v (y, f y ^ 2) j := by
      funext i j
      simp only [hessLoc, hsecond y hyU i j, hfirst y hyU, hhh, huu, hv, hE, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hlmc F y, e1, e2, key ((G y)⁻¹) (hsym y hyU) (v (y, f y ^ 2)) (uu y) (hh (y, f y ^ 2)) _ hc,
      hΨ]
  
  have s13 : ∀ y, Ψ (y, 0) = levelMeanCurvCoord G f y := by
    intro y
    have e1 : v (y, 0) = fun k => partialDeriv k f y := by
      funext k; simp [hv]
    have e2 : hh (y, 0) = fun i j => hessLoc G f i j y := by
      funext i j; simp only [hhh, e1, hessLoc, zero_mul, add_zero]
    rw [hlmc f y, hΨ]
    simp only [e1, e2]
  
  have hcd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => 1 + 2 * f y * a y) y₁ :=
    (differentiableAt_const _).add ((hfd.const_mul 2).mul had)
  have hc1 : 1 + 2 * f y₁ * a y₁ ≠ 0 := by rw [hf0]; norm_num
  have hlift : ∀ g : E3 → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ g y₁ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E3 × ℝ => g x.1) (y₁, 0) :=
    fun g hg => hg.comp (y₁, 0) differentiableAt_fst
  have dc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E3 × ℝ => 1 + 2 * f x.1 * a x.1) (y₁, 0) := hlift _ hcd
  have dP : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E3 × ℝ => (G x.1)⁻¹ i j) (y₁, 0) :=
    fun i j => hlift _ (hPd i j)
  have hcd3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (1 + 2 * f y * a y) ^ 3) y₁ := hcd.pow 3
  have hcd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (1 + 2 * f y * a y) ^ 2) y₁ := hcd.pow 2
  have dv : ∀ k, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => v x k) (y₁, 0) := by
    intro k
    simp only [hv, div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact (hlift _ (hpf k)).add (differentiableAt_snd.mul ((hlift _ (hpa k)).mul (dc.inv hc1)))
  have dE : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => E y i j) y₁ := by
    intro i j
    simp only [hE, div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact (((((had.const_mul 2).mul (hfd.pow 2)).mul (hcd3.inv (pow_ne_zero 3 hc1))).sub
      ((hfd.const_mul 4).mul (hcd2.inv (pow_ne_zero 2 hc1)))).mul (hpa i)).mul (hpa j) |>.add
      ((hppa i j).mul (hcd.inv hc1))
  have dhh : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => hh x i j) (y₁, 0) := by
    intro i j
    simp only [hhh]
    exact ((hlift _ (hppf i j)).add (differentiableAt_snd.mul (hlift _ (dE i j)))).sub
      (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun k _ => (hlift _ (hΓd k i j)).mul (dv k))
  have hv0 : v (y₁, 0) = fun k => partialDeriv k f y₁ := by funext k; simp [hv]
  have hN : 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G (y₁, (0 : ℝ)).1)⁻¹ i j * v (y₁, 0) i * v (y₁, 0) j := by
    rw [hv0]; exact hpos
  have dN : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E3 × ℝ =>
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G x.1)⁻¹ i j * v x i * v x j) (y₁, 0) :=
    DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun i _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun j _ =>
      ((dP i j).mul (dv i)).mul (dv j)
  have dS : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E3 × ℝ =>
      Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G x.1)⁻¹ i j * v x i * v x j)) (y₁, 0) :=
    dN.sqrt hN.ne'
  have dS3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E3 × ℝ =>
      Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G x.1)⁻¹ i j * v x i * v x j) ^ 3) (y₁, 0) :=
    dS.pow 3
  have hS0 : (fun x : E3 × ℝ =>
      Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G x.1)⁻¹ i j * v x i * v x j)) (y₁, 0) ≠ 0 :=
    Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hN
  have hS3 : (fun x : E3 × ℝ =>
      Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G x.1)⁻¹ i j * v x i * v x j) ^ 3) (y₁, 0) ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero 3 hS0
  have dL : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E3 × ℝ =>
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G x.1)⁻¹ i j * hh x i j) (y₁, 0) :=
    DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun i _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun j _ => (dP i j).mul (dhh i j)
  have dQ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E3 × ℝ =>
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G x.1)⁻¹ i a * v x a * ((G x.1)⁻¹ j b * v x b) * hh x i j) (y₁, 0) :=
    DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun i _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun j _ =>
      DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun a _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun b _ =>
        (((dP i a).mul (dv a)).mul ((dP j b).mul (dv b))).mul (dhh i j)
  have dΨ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ (y₁, 0) := by
    simp only [hΨ, hEx, div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact (dL.mul (dS.inv hS0)).sub (dQ.mul (dS3.inv hS3))
  
  have hc1pos : 0 < (fun y => 1 + 2 * f y * a y) y₁ := by
    show 0 < 1 + 2 * f y₁ * a y₁
    rw [hf0]; norm_num
  have hVn : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₁, y ∈ U ∧ 0 < 1 + 2 * f y * a y :=
    Filter.Eventually.and (hU.mem_nhds hy₁)
      (hcd.continuousAt.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hc1pos))
  have hA : levelMeanCurvCoord G F =ᶠ[𝓝 y₁] fun y => Ψ (y, f y ^ 2) := by
    filter_upwards [hVn] with y hy using s12 y hy.1 hy.2
  have hB : levelMeanCurvCoord G f =ᶠ[𝓝 y₁] fun y => Ψ (y, 0) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => (s13 y).symm)
  exact jet Ψ _ _ dΨ hA hB

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (hF0 : F y₀ = 0) (hdF : fderiv ℝ F y₀ ≠ 0) (hH0 : ∀ y ∈ U, F y = 0 → levelMeanCurvCoord G F y = 0) (hjac : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y₀ * partialDeriv j F y₀ < 0) : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball y₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, (0 < F y → levelMeanCurvCoord G F y < 0) ∧ (F y < 0 → 0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G F y)

signature.name: lmcCoord_sign
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (hF0 : F y₀ = 0) (hdF : fderiv ℝ F y₀ ≠ 0) (hH0 : ∀ y ∈ U, F y = 0 → levelMeanCurvCoord G F y = 0) (hjac : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y₀ * partialDeriv j F y₀ < 0) : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball y₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, (0 < F y → levelMeanCurvCoord G F y < 0) ∧ (F y < 0 → 0 < levelMeanCurvCoord G F y)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hn1 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hn0 : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  
  have hdFc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ F) U := hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU hn1
  obtain ⟨U', hU'def⟩ : ∃ U' : Set E3, U' = U ∩ (fderiv ℝ F) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hU' : IsOpen U' := by
    rw [hU'def]; exact hdFc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hU'U : U' ⊆ U := by rw [hU'def]; exact Set.inter_subset_left
  have hU'reg : ∀ y ∈ U', fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hU'def] at hy
    exact hy.2
  have hy₀' : y₀ ∈ U' := by rw [hU'def]; exact ⟨hy₀, hdF⟩
  have hHs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) U' :=
    lmcCoord_contDiffOn G U' hU' (fun i j => (hG i j).mono hU'U)
      (fun y hy => hGpd y (hU'U hy)) F (hF.mono hU'U) hU'reg
  
  obtain ⟨v, hFv, hHv⟩ : ∃ v : E3, 0 < fderiv ℝ F y₀ v ∧
      fderiv ℝ (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y₀ v < 0 := by
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, P = (G y₀)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPpd : P.PosDef := by rw [hP]; exact (hGpd y₀ hy₀).inv
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ : ∃ ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ, ξ = fun j => fderiv ℝ F y₀ (e j) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : Fin 3 → ℝ, c = fun i => ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * ξ j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have heval : ∀ L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, L (∑ i : Fin 3, c i • e i) = ∑ i : Fin 3, c i * L (e i) := by
      intro L
      rw [map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hξne : ξ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hdF
      have h0' : ∀ j : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ F y₀ (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) = 0 := by
        intro j
        have h := congrFun h0 j
        rw [hξ] at h
        exact h
      ext x
      have hx := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr x
      rw [← hx, map_sum]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, h0']
    refine ⟨∑ i : Fin 3, c i • e i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [heval]
      have hpos := hPpd.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξne
      have hq : star ξ ⬝ᵥ P.mulVec ξ = ∑ i : Fin 3, c i * fderiv ℝ F y₀ (e i) := by
        simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, hc, hξ]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        ring
      linarith
    · rw [heval]
      have h2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, c i * fderiv ℝ (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y₀ (e i) =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ i j *
            partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y₀ * partialDeriv j F y₀ := by
        rw [hc]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
        simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
        rw [hP, hξ]
        simp only [partialDeriv]
        ring
      rw [h2]
      exact hjac
  
  have hdHc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (levelMeanCurvCoord G F)) U' :=
    hHs.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU' hn1
  have hHvc : ContinuousAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y v) y₀ :=
    (hdHc.clm_apply continuousOn_const).continuousAt (hU'.mem_nhds hy₀')
  have hevU' : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, y ∈ U' := hU'.mem_nhds hy₀'
  have hevH : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, fderiv ℝ (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y v < (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) y :=
    hHvc.eventually_lt continuousAt_const hHv
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρB⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.1 (hevU'.and hevH)
  
  have hcross : ∀ (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (w : E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U' → Φ y₀ = 0 →
      0 < fderiv ℝ Φ y₀ w → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, 0 < Φ y →
        ∃ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ ∧ Φ (y - τ • w) = 0 ∧ y - τ • w ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ := by
    intro Φ w hΦ hΦ0 hΦw
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = fderiv ℝ Φ y₀ w := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have ha0 : 0 < a := by rw [ha]; exact hΦw
    have hdΦc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ Φ) U' := hΦ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU' hn1
    have hc1 : ContinuousAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ Φ y w) y₀ :=
      (hdΦc.clm_apply continuousOn_const).continuousAt (hU'.mem_nhds hy₀')
    have hc2 : ContinuousAt (fun y => ‖fderiv ℝ Φ y‖) y₀ :=
      (hdΦc.continuousAt (hU'.mem_nhds hy₀')).norm
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = ‖fderiv ℝ Φ y₀‖ + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hL0 : 0 < L := by rw [hL]; positivity
    have e2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, (fun _ => a / 2) y < fderiv ℝ Φ y w :=
      continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hc1 (by simp only; linarith)
    have e3 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, ‖fderiv ℝ Φ y‖ < (fun _ => L) y :=
      hc2.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by simp only; linarith)
    obtain ⟨ρ₁, hρ₁, hB1⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.1 (hevU'.and (e2.and e3))
    obtain ⟨ρ₂, hρ₂⟩ : ∃ ρ₂ : ℝ, ρ₂ = min ρ ρ₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hρ₂pos : 0 < ρ₂ := by rw [hρ₂]; exact lt_min hρ hρ₁
    have hB2 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ₂,
        x ∈ U' ∧ a / 2 < fderiv ℝ Φ x w ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ Φ x‖ < L := by
      intro x hx
      have h := hB1 x (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by rw [hρ₂]; exact min_le_right _ _) hx)
      exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩
    have hB2ρ : Metric.ball y₀ ρ₂ ⊆ Metric.ball y₀ ρ :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (by rw [hρ₂]; exact min_le_left _ _)
    have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ₂, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x := fun x hx =>
      (hΦ.contDiffAt (hU'.mem_nhds (hB2 x hx).1)).differentiableAt hn0
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = 1 + L * ‖w‖ / (a / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hK1 : 1 ≤ K := by
      rw [hK]
      have : 0 ≤ L * ‖w‖ / (a / 2) := by positivity
      linarith
    have hK0 : 0 < K := by linarith
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = ρ₂ / (2 * K) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hr0 : 0 < r := by rw [hr]; positivity
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = L * r / (a / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hT0 : 0 < T := by rw [hT]; positivity
    have hrK : r * K = ρ₂ / 2 := by
      rw [hr]; field_simp
    have hrT : r + T * ‖w‖ = ρ₂ / 2 := by
      rw [← hrK, hT, hK]; ring
    have hTc : T * (a / 2) = L * r := by
      rw [hT]; field_simp
    have hrρ₂ : r < ρ₂ := by
      have : r ≤ r * K := le_mul_of_one_le_right hr0.le hK1
      linarith
    refine ⟨r, hr0, fun y hy hΦy => ?_⟩
    have hyB : y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hrρ₂.le hy
    have hy0B : y₀ ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ₂ := Metric.mem_ball_self hρ₂pos
    have hlip := (convex_ball y₀ ρ₂).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff
      (fun x hx => (hB2 x hx).2.2.le) hy0B hyB
    have hdist : ‖y - y₀‖ < r := by
      rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hy
    have hΦlt : Φ y < L * r := by
      rw [hΦ0, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hlip
      calc Φ y ≤ |Φ y| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ L * ‖y - y₀‖ := hlip
        _ < L * r := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hdist hL0
    have hseg : ∀ σ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, y - σ • w ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ₂ := by
      intro σ hσ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      have h1 : y - σ • w - y₀ = (y - y₀) - σ • w := by abel
      rw [h1]
      have h2 : σ * ‖w‖ ≤ T * ‖w‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hσ.2 (norm_nonneg w)
      calc ‖(y - y₀) - σ • w‖ ≤ ‖y - y₀‖ + ‖σ • w‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = ‖y - y₀‖ + σ * ‖w‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hσ.1]
        _ < r + T * ‖w‖ := by linarith
        _ = ρ₂ / 2 := hrT
        _ < ρ₂ := half_lt_self hρ₂pos
    have hfd : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ₂,
        HasFDerivWithinAt Φ (fderiv ℝ Φ x) (Metric.ball y₀ ρ₂) x :=
      fun x hx => (hdiff x hx).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
    have hTB : y - T • w ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ₂ := hseg T ⟨hT0.le, le_refl T⟩
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ, hmvt⟩ := domain_mvt hfd (convex_ball y₀ ρ₂) hyB hTB
    have hζB : ζ ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ₂ := (convex_ball y₀ ρ₂).segment_subset hyB hTB hζ
    have hζw := (hB2 ζ hζB).2.1
    have hmvt' : Φ (y - T • w) - Φ y = -(T * fderiv ℝ Φ ζ w) := by
      rw [hmvt, sub_sub_cancel_left, map_neg, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hΦT : Φ (y - T • w) < 0 := by
      have h3 : T * (a / 2) < T * fderiv ℝ Φ ζ w := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hζw hT0
      linarith
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun σ : ℝ => Φ (y - σ • w)) (Set.Icc 0 T) := by
      have h4 : ContinuousOn (Φ ∘ fun σ : ℝ => y - σ • w) (Set.Icc 0 T) :=
        hΦ.continuousOn.comp
          (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)).continuousOn
          (fun σ hσ => (hB2 _ (hseg σ hσ)).1)
      exact h4
    have h0mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc ((fun σ : ℝ => Φ (y - σ • w)) T)
        ((fun σ : ℝ => Φ (y - σ • w)) 0) := by
      simp only [zero_smul, sub_zero]
      exact ⟨hΦT.le, hΦy.le⟩
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hτ0⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' hT0.le hcont h0mem
    have hτ0' : Φ (y - τ • w) = 0 := hτ0
    have hτpos : 0 < τ := by
      rcases hτ.1.lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        rw [← h, zero_smul, sub_zero] at hτ0'
        linarith
    exact ⟨τ, hτpos, hτ0', hB2ρ (hseg τ hτ)⟩
  
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hc₁⟩ := hcross F v (hF.mono hU'U) hF0 hFv
  have hFnv : 0 < fderiv ℝ (fun y => -F y) y₀ (-v) := by
    rw [show (fun y => -F y) = -F from rfl, fderiv_neg, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply,
      map_neg, neg_neg]
    exact hFv
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hc₂⟩ := hcross (fun y => -F y) (-v) (hF.neg.mono hU'U)
    (by simp [hF0]) hFnv
  have hHd : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ, HasFDerivWithinAt (levelMeanCurvCoord G F)
      (fderiv ℝ (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) x) (Metric.ball y₀ ρ) x := fun x hx =>
    ((hHs.contDiffAt (hU'.mem_nhds (hρB x hx).1)).differentiableAt hn0).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
  refine ⟨min (min r₁ r₂) ρ, lt_min (lt_min hr₁ hr₂) hρ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    exact hU'U (hρB y (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hy)).1
  · intro y hy
    have hy1 : y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r₁ :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)) hy
    have hy2 : y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r₂ :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)) hy
    have hyρ : y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hy
    constructor
    · intro hFy
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hz0, hzB⟩ := hc₁ y hy1 hFy
      have hHz : levelMeanCurvCoord G F (y - τ • v) = 0 := hH0 _ (hU'U (hρB _ hzB).1) hz0
      obtain ⟨ζ, hζ, hmvt⟩ := domain_mvt hHd (convex_ball y₀ ρ) hzB hyρ
      have hζB : ζ ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ := (convex_ball y₀ ρ).segment_subset hzB hyρ hζ
      have hneg : fderiv ℝ (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) ζ v < 0 := (hρB ζ hζB).2
      rw [hHz, sub_zero, sub_sub_cancel, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hmvt
      rw [hmvt]
      exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hτ hneg
    · intro hFy
      have hFy' : 0 < (fun y => -F y) y := neg_pos.mpr hFy
      obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hz0, hzB⟩ := hc₂ y hy2 hFy'
      have hz0' : -F (y - τ • -v) = 0 := hz0
      have hHz : levelMeanCurvCoord G F (y - τ • -v) = 0 :=
        hH0 _ (hU'U (hρB _ hzB).1) (neg_eq_zero.mp hz0')
      obtain ⟨ζ, hζ, hmvt⟩ := domain_mvt hHd (convex_ball y₀ ρ) hzB hyρ
      have hζB : ζ ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ := (convex_ball y₀ ρ).segment_subset hzB hyρ hζ
      have hneg : fderiv ℝ (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) ζ v < 0 := (hρB ζ hζB).2
      rw [hHz, sub_zero, sub_sub_cancel, map_smul, map_neg, smul_eq_mul] at hmvt
      rw [hmvt]
      exact mul_pos hτ (neg_pos.mpr hneg)

subgoal_signatures.name: lmcCoord_contDiffOn
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (hdf : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ f y ≠ 0) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (levelMeanCurvCoord G f) U

signature.name: lmcCoord_contDiffOn
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (hdf : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ f y ≠ 0) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (levelMeanCurvCoord G f) U

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hpdv : ∀ h : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i h) U := by
    intro h hh i
    have hD := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hh).2
    exact hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hdet3 : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) U := by
    intro H hH
    have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
        H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
          - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
          + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H y)
    rw [hfun]
    have t1 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 0)
    exact ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
  
  have hdetU : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hGpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hGi : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) U := by
    intro k l
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := hdet3 G hG
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det) U := by
      apply hdet3
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = l
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hG a b
    refine ((h1.inv hdetU).mul h2).congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
      smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hSpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y := by
    intro y hy
    have hx0 : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k f y) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hdf y hy
      have hlin : (fderiv ℝ f y : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) = 0 :=
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext (fun i => by
          have := congrFun h0 i
          simpa [partialDeriv] using this)
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
      have := LinearMap.congr_fun hlin v
      simpa using this
    have hpos := (hGpd y hy).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx0
    refine lt_of_lt_of_eq hpos ?_
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
    ring
  
  have hdG : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b)) U :=
    fun m a b => hpdv _ (hG a b) m
  have hp : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv k f) U := hpdv f hf
  have hpp : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f)) U :=
    fun i j => hpdv _ (hp j) i
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
      (hGi k l).mul (((hdG i j l).add (hdG j i l)).sub (hdG l i j)))
  have hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G f i j) U := by
    intro i j
    unfold hessLoc
    exact (hpp i j).sub (ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hΓ k i j).mul (hp k))
  have hLap : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lapLoc G f) U := by
    unfold lapLoc
    exact ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => (hGi i j).mul (hH i j)
  have hS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y) U :=
    ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ((hGi i j).mul (hp i)).mul (hp j)
  have hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y)) U :=
    hS.sqrt (fun y hy => (hSpos y hy).ne')
  have hNne : ∀ y ∈ U, Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y) ≠ 0 :=
    fun y hy => Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.2 (hSpos y hy)
  have hN3 := hN.pow 3
  have hQ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a f y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b f y) *
        hessLoc G f i j y) U :=
    ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ =>
      ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ =>
        (((hGi i a).mul (hp a)).mul ((hGi j b).mul (hp b))).mul (hH i j)
  have hfin := (hLap.div hN hNne).sub (hQ.div hN3 (fun y hy => pow_ne_zero 3 (hNne y hy)))
  exact hfin.congr (fun y _ => rfl)

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U

signature.name: ginv_contDiffOn
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdet : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) U := by
    intro H hH
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3),
        ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℝ) * ∏ k, H y (σ k) k) U :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun σ _ => contDiffOn_const.mul (contDiffOn_prod fun k _ => hH (σ k) k)
    refine h1.congr ?_
    intro y _
    exact Matrix.det_apply' (H y)
  have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).adjugate i j) U := by
    intro i j
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1)).det) U := by
      apply hdet (fun y => (G y).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1))
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = j
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hG a b
    refine h2.congr ?_
    intro y _
    exact Matrix.adjugate_apply (G y) i j
  have hne : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hGpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
  intro i j
  have h3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate i j) U :=
    ((hdet G hG).inv hne).mul (hadj i j)
  refine h3.congr ?_
  intro y _
  rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, smul_eq_mul]

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F W : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F y) (hW : W =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun z => F z ^ 2) (hF0 : F y ≠ 0) : levelMeanCurvCoord G W y = (if 0 < F y then 1 else -1) * levelMeanCurvCoord G F y

signature.name: lmcCoord_sq
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F W : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F y) (hW : W =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun z => F z ^ 2) (hF0 : F y ≠ 0) : levelMeanCurvCoord G W y = (if 0 < F y then 1 else -1) * levelMeanCurvCoord G F y

proof.tactics:
by
  have hFy : DifferentiableAt ℝ F y := hF.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F z := hF.eventually (by decide)
  have hWW := hW.eventuallyEq_nhds
  have key : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv j W z = 2 * F z * partialDeriv j F z := by
    filter_upwards [hev, hWW] with z hz hWz
    intro j
    have hdz : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z := hz.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have h : HasFDerivAt (fun x => F x * F x) (F z • fderiv ℝ F z + F z • fderiv ℝ F z) z :=
      hdz.hasFDerivAt.mul hdz.hasFDerivAt
    have hfun : (fun x => F x ^ 2) = fun x => F x * F x := by
      funext x; ring
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hWz.fderiv_eq, hfun, h.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have h1 : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j W y = 2 * F y * partialDeriv j F y :=
    key.self_of_nhds
  have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y :=
    (hF.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j W) y =
      2 * (partialDeriv i F y * partialDeriv j F y + F y * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) y) := by
    intro i j
    have hgj : DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv j F) y := by
      unfold partialDeriv
      exact hg.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)
    have hEq : partialDeriv j W =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun z => 2 * F z * partialDeriv j F z :=
      key.mono fun z hz => hz j
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun z => 2 * F z * partialDeriv j F z)
        ((2 * F y) • fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j F) y + partialDeriv j F y • (2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ F y) y :=
      (hFy.hasFDerivAt.const_mul 2).mul hgj.hasFDerivAt
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j W) y (e i) = _
    rw [hEq.fderiv_eq, hd.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    unfold partialDeriv
    ring
  have hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G W i j y =
      2 * partialDeriv i F y * partialDeriv j F y + 2 * F y * hessLoc G F i j y := by
    intro i j
    simp only [hessLoc, h2 i j, h1]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have e1 : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i W y * partialDeriv j W y) =
      4 * F y ^ 2 *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i F y * partialDeriv j F y) := by
    simp only [h1]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have e2 : lapLoc G W y =
      2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i F y * partialDeriv j F y) +
        2 * F y * lapLoc G F y := by
    simp only [lapLoc, hH]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have e3 : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a W y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b W y) * hessLoc G W i j y) =
      8 * F y ^ 2 *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i F y * partialDeriv j F y) ^ 2 +
      8 * F y ^ 3 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a F y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b F y) *
          hessLoc G F i j y) := by
    simp only [h1, hH]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have scalar : ∀ c s L Q : ℝ, c ≠ 0 →
      (2 * s + 2 * c * L) / Real.sqrt (4 * c ^ 2 * s) -
        (8 * c ^ 2 * s ^ 2 + 8 * c ^ 3 * Q) / Real.sqrt (4 * c ^ 2 * s) ^ 3 =
      (if 0 < c then 1 else -1) * (L / Real.sqrt s - Q / Real.sqrt s ^ 3) := by
    intro c s L Q hc0
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (4 * c ^ 2 * s) = 2 * |c| * Real.sqrt s := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), show (4 : ℝ) * c ^ 2 = (2 * c) ^ 2 by ring,
        Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_two]
    rw [hsq]
    rcases le_or_gt s 0 with hs | hs
    · rw [Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.2 hs]
      simp
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ s = r ^ 2 :=
        ⟨Real.sqrt s, Real.sqrt_pos.2 hs, (Real.sq_sqrt hs.le).symm⟩
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
      have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := hr.ne'
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hc0 with hc | hc
      · rw [if_neg (not_lt.2 hc.le), abs_of_neg hc]
        field_simp
        ring
      · rw [if_pos hc, abs_of_pos hc]
        field_simp
        ring
  rw [levelMeanCurvCoord, levelMeanCurvCoord, e2, e3, e1]
  exact scalar _ _ _ _ hF0

signature.name: rellich_local_cauchy
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (u : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hu : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u n) W) (hbd : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n, ∫ x in L, ((u n x) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u n) x) ^ 2) ≤ C) : ∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ ∧ ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l → ∫ x in L, (u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x) ^ 2 < ε

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hUc : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (u n) W := fun n => (hu n).continuousOn
  have hdc : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (pd2 k f) W := by
    intro f hf k
    have h1 := hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hGc : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k f x) ^ 2) W := by
    intro f hf
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => (hdc f hf k).pow 2)
  have hHc : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (fun x => (u n x) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u n) x) ^ 2) W :=
    fun n => ((hUc n).pow 2).add (hGc _ (hu n))
  have hsq_le : ∀ K : Set E2, IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → ∀ n,
      ∫ x in K, (u n x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in K, ((u n x) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u n) x) ^ 2) := by
    intro K hK hKW n
    refine setIntegral_mono_on (((hUc n).pow 2).mono hKW |>.integrableOn_compact hK)
      ((hHc n).mono hKW |>.integrableOn_compact hK) hK.measurableSet (fun x _ => ?_)
    have : 0 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u n) x) ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨Qo, hQo⟩ : ∃ Qo : ℝ → ℤ × ℤ → Set E2, ∀ s z, Qo s z = {x : E2 | (z.1 : ℝ) * s ≤ x 0 ∧
      x 0 < (z.1 : ℝ) * s + s ∧ (z.2 : ℝ) * s ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < (z.2 : ℝ) * s + s} :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Qc, hQc⟩ : ∃ Qc : ℝ → ℤ × ℤ → Set E2, ∀ s z, Qc s z = {x : E2 | (z.1 : ℝ) * s ≤ x 0 ∧
      x 0 ≤ (z.1 : ℝ) * s + s ∧ (z.2 : ℝ) * s ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ (z.2 : ℝ) * s + s} :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hQcpt : ∀ s, 0 < s → ∀ z, IsCompact (Qc s z) := by
    intro s hs z; rw [hQc]; exact (grid_square_facts s hs).1 z
  have hQmeas : ∀ s, 0 < s → ∀ z, MeasurableSet (Qo s z) := by
    intro s hs z; rw [hQo]; exact (grid_square_facts s hs).2.1 z
  have hQdisj : ∀ s, 0 < s → ∀ z z', z ≠ z' → Disjoint (Qo s z) (Qo s z') := by
    intro s hs z z' hzz; rw [hQo, hQo]; exact (grid_square_facts s hs).2.2 z z' hzz
  have hQoc : ∀ s z, Qo s z ⊆ Qc s z := by
    intro s z x hx
    rw [hQo] at hx
    rw [hQc]
    exact ⟨hx.1, hx.2.1.le, hx.2.2.1, hx.2.2.2.le⟩
  have hpoin : ∀ v : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v W → ∀ s, 0 < s → ∀ z, Qc s z ⊆ W →
      ∫ x in Qo s z, v x ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in Qo s z, v x) ^ 2 / s ^ 2 +
        s ^ 2 * ∫ x in Qo s z, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k v x) ^ 2 := by
    intro v hv s hs z hsub
    rw [hQc] at hsub
    rw [hQo]
    exact poincare_halfopen_square W hW v hv _ _ s hs hsub
  have hcover : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → ∀ s, 0 < s → ∃ Z : Finset (ℤ × ℤ),
      (∀ x ∈ L, ∃ z ∈ Z, x ∈ Qo s z) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Z, ∃ y ∈ L, ∀ x ∈ Qc s z, dist x y ≤ 2 * s := by
    intro L hL s hs
    obtain ⟨Z, h1, h2⟩ := grid_cover_compact L hL s hs
    refine ⟨Z, fun x hx => ?_, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨z, hz, h⟩ := h1 x hx
      exact ⟨z, hz, by rw [hQo]; exact h⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, h⟩ := h2 z hz
      refine ⟨y, hy, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      rw [hQc] at hx
      exact h x hx.1 hx.2.1 hx.2.2.1 hx.2.2.2
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℕ → ℕ × ℤ × ℤ → ℝ, ∀ n j z, a n (j, z) =
      if Qc (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) z ⊆ W then ∫ x in Qo (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) z, u n x else 0 :=
    ⟨fun n d => if Qc (1 / ((d.1 : ℝ) + 1)) d.2 ⊆ W then
      ∫ x in Qo (1 / ((d.1 : ℝ) + 1)) d.2, u n x else 0, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hb : ∀ d : ℕ × ℤ × ℤ, ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ n, |a n d| ≤ R := by
    rintro ⟨j, z⟩
    have hs : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    by_cases hsub : Qc (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) z ⊆ W
    · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd _ (hQcpt _ hs z) hsub
      refine ⟨(volume.real (Qc (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) z) + C) / 2, fun n => ?_⟩
      rw [ha, if_pos hsub]
      have h1 := cell_integral_abs_bound _ _ (hQcpt _ hs z) (hQmeas _ hs z) (hQoc _ z) (u n)
        ((hUc n).mono hsub)
      have h2 := hsq_le _ (hQcpt _ hs z) hsub n
      have h3 := hC n
      linarith
    · refine ⟨0, fun n => ?_⟩
      rw [ha, if_neg hsub]
      simp
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hcau⟩ := bounded_seq_countable_diag a hb
  refine ⟨ψ, hψ, fun L hL hLW ε hε => ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hK'W⟩ := hL.exists_cthickening_subset_open hW hLW
  have hK' : IsCompact (cthickening δ L) := hL.cthickening
  obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := hbd _ hK' hK'W
  have hCp : 0 < |C'| + 1 := by positivity
  have hτ : 0 < min (δ / 2) (ε / (8 * (|C'| + 1))) := lt_min (by linarith) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hτ
  obtain ⟨s, hsdef⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hsdef] at hj
  have hs : 0 < s := by rw [hsdef]; positivity
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hsdef]
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) + 1 := by have := (Nat.cast_nonneg j : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j); linarith
    exact (div_le_one (by positivity)).mpr this
  have hs2δ : 2 * s < δ := by
    have := lt_of_lt_of_le hj (min_le_left _ _)
    linarith
  have hsε : 8 * s * (|C'| + 1) < ε := by
    have h := lt_of_lt_of_le hj (min_le_right _ _)
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at h
    linarith
  have ha' : ∀ n z, a n (j, z) = if Qc s z ⊆ W then ∫ x in Qo s z, u n x else 0 := by
    intro n z; rw [ha, hsdef]
  obtain ⟨Z, hZcov, hZnear⟩ := hcover L hL s hs
  have hQcK : ∀ z ∈ Z, Qc s z ⊆ cthickening δ L := by
    intro z hz x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hd⟩ := hZnear z hz
    exact Metric.mem_cthickening_of_dist_le x y δ L hy (by linarith [hd x hx])
  have hQcW : ∀ z ∈ Z, Qc s z ⊆ W := fun z hz => (hQcK z hz).trans hK'W
  have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((Z.card : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hη : 0 < min 1 (ε * s ^ 2 / (2 * ((Z.card : ℝ) + 1))) := lt_min one_pos (by positivity)
  have hc := fun z : ℤ × ℤ => hcau (j, z) _ hη
  choose Nf hNf using hc
  refine ⟨Z.sup Nf, fun m l hm hl => ?_⟩
  
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x) W := (hu _).sub (hu _)
  have hint : ∀ n z, z ∈ Z → IntegrableOn (u n) (Qo s z) := fun n z hz =>
    (((hUc n).mono (hQcW z hz)).integrableOn_compact (hQcpt s hs z)).mono_set (hQoc s z)
  have hD : ∀ z ∈ Z, (∫ x in Qo s z, (u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x)) ^ 2 / s ^ 2 ≤
      ε / (2 * ((Z.card : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    intro z hz
    have heq : ∫ x in Qo s z, (u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x) = a (ψ m) (j, z) - a (ψ l) (j, z) := by
      rw [ha', ha', if_pos (hQcW z hz), if_pos (hQcW z hz)]
      exact integral_sub (hint _ z hz) (hint _ z hz)
    have hlt := hNf z m l (le_trans (Finset.le_sup hz) hm) (le_trans (Finset.le_sup hz) hl)
    rw [heq]
    set D := a (ψ m) (j, z) - a (ψ l) (j, z)
    set η := min 1 (ε * s ^ 2 / (2 * ((Z.card : ℝ) + 1))) with hηdef
    have hη1 : η ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
    have hη2 : η ≤ ε * s ^ 2 / (2 * ((Z.card : ℝ) + 1)) := min_le_right _ _
    have habs : 0 ≤ |D| := abs_nonneg D
    have hDsq : D ^ 2 = |D| ^ 2 := (sq_abs D).symm
    have hmul : |D| * |D| ≤ η * η := mul_le_mul hlt.le hlt.le habs hη.le
    have hD2 : D ^ 2 ≤ η := by nlinarith
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    calc D ^ 2 ≤ ε * s ^ 2 / (2 * ((Z.card : ℝ) + 1)) := le_trans hD2 hη2
      _ = ε / (2 * ((Z.card : ℝ) + 1)) * s ^ 2 := by ring
  have hsumD : ∑ z ∈ Z, (∫ x in Qo s z, (u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x)) ^ 2 / s ^ 2 ≤ ε / 2 := by
    have h1 := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul Z
      (fun z => (∫ x in Qo s z, (u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x)) ^ 2 / s ^ 2)
      (ε / (2 * ((Z.card : ℝ) + 1))) hD
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul] at h1
    have h2 : (Z.card : ℝ) * (ε / (2 * ((Z.card : ℝ) + 1))) ≤ ε / 2 := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc', div_le_div_iff₀ hcard (by norm_num)]
      nlinarith
    linarith
  
  have hstar : ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x => u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x) x) ^ 2 ≤
      2 * ((u (ψ m) x) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u (ψ m)) x) ^ 2) +
      2 * ((u (ψ l) x) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u (ψ l)) x) ^ 2) := by
    intro x hx
    have hdm : DifferentiableAt ℝ (u (ψ m)) x :=
      ((hu _).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
    have hdl : DifferentiableAt ℝ (u (ψ l)) x :=
      ((hu _).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
    have hpd : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun x => u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x) x =
        pd2 k (u (ψ m)) x - pd2 k (u (ψ l)) x := by
      intro k
      simp only [pd2]
      have hfd : HasFDerivAt (fun x => u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x)
          (fderiv ℝ (u (ψ m)) x - fderiv ℝ (u (ψ l)) x) x :=
        hdm.hasFDerivAt.sub hdl.hasFDerivAt
      rw [hfd.fderiv]
      rfl
    simp only [hpd, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (pd2 0 (u (ψ m)) x + pd2 0 (u (ψ l)) x),
      sq_nonneg (pd2 1 (u (ψ m)) x + pd2 1 (u (ψ l)) x), sq_nonneg (u (ψ m) x),
      sq_nonneg (u (ψ l) x)]
  have hgrad : ∫ x in cthickening δ L, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x => u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x) x) ^ 2
      ≤ 4 * (|C'| + 1) := by
    have hI1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => (u (ψ m) x) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u (ψ m)) x) ^ 2)
        (cthickening δ L) volume := ((hHc (ψ m)).mono hK'W).integrableOn_compact hK'
    have hI2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => (u (ψ l) x) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u (ψ l)) x) ^ 2)
        (cthickening δ L) volume := ((hHc (ψ l)).mono hK'W).integrableOn_compact hK'
    have h1 : ∫ x in cthickening δ L,
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x => u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x) x) ^ 2 ≤
        ∫ x in cthickening δ L, (2 * ((u (ψ m) x) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u (ψ m)) x) ^ 2) +
          2 * ((u (ψ l) x) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u (ψ l)) x) ^ 2)) :=
      setIntegral_mono_on ((hGc _ hf).mono hK'W |>.integrableOn_compact hK')
        ((hI1.const_mul 2).add (hI2.const_mul 2)) hK'.measurableSet
        (fun x hx => hstar x (hK'W hx))
    rw [integral_add (hI1.const_mul 2) (hI2.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul] at h1
    have h2 := hC' (ψ m)
    have h3 := hC' (ψ l)
    have h4 := le_abs_self C'
    linarith
  
  have hsum := cell_sum_bound (cthickening δ L) L hK' Z (Qo s) (fun z _ => hQmeas s hs z)
    (fun z _ z' _ h => hQdisj s hs z z' h) (fun z hz => (hQoc s z).trans (hQcK z hz))
    (fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨z, hz, h⟩ := hZcov x hx
      exact Set.mem_biUnion hz h)
    (fun x => (u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x) ^ 2)
    (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x => u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x) x) ^ 2)
    ((((hUc _).sub (hUc _)).pow 2).mono hK'W) ((hGc _ hf).mono hK'W)
    (fun x => sq_nonneg _) (fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _))
    (fun z => (∫ x in Qo s z, (u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x)) ^ 2 / s ^ 2) (s ^ 2) (sq_nonneg s)
    (fun z hz => hpoin _ hf s hs z (hQcW z hz))
  have hfin1 : s ^ 2 * ∫ x in cthickening δ L,
      ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x => u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x) x) ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 * (4 * (|C'| + 1)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgrad (sq_nonneg s)
  have hfin2 : s ^ 2 * (4 * (|C'| + 1)) ≤ s * (4 * (|C'| + 1)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) (by positivity)
  linarith

subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : E2 → ℝ) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v W) (a b s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hsub : {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} ⊆ W) : ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, v x ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, v x) ^ 2 / s ^ 2 + s ^ 2 * ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k v x) ^ 2

by
  
  have s1 : ∃ K : ℕ → Set E2, (∀ j, IsCompact (K j)) ∧ (∀ j, K j ⊆ W) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≤ j → K i ⊆ K j) ∧ ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ j, L ⊆ K j := by

      apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      · apply Metric.isClosed_closedBall.inter
        have : {x : E2 | ∀ y, y ∉ W → 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ dist x y} =
            ⋂ y ∈ Wᶜ, {x | 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ dist x y} := by
          ext x; simp
        rw [this]
        exact isClosed_biInter fun y _ =>
          isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)
      · exact Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset Set.inter_subset_left
    · intro j x hx
      by_contra h
      have h1 := hx.2 x h
      rw [dist_self] at h1
      have : (0:ℝ) < 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      linarith
    · intro i j hij x hx
      have hij' : (i : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hij
      refine ⟨Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hij' hx.1, fun y hy => ?_⟩
      have h1 : 1 / ((j:ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 / ((i:ℝ) + 1) :=
        one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
      exact h1.trans (hx.2 y hy)
    · intro L hL hLW
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδW⟩ := hL.exists_thickening_subset_open hW hLW
      obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0:E2)).1 hL.isBounded
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max R (1/δ))
      refine ⟨j, fun x hx => ⟨Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall
        (le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hj)) (hR hx), fun y hy => ?_⟩⟩
      have h1 : 1/δ < (j:ℝ) + 1 := by linarith [le_max_right R (1/δ)]
      have h2 : 1 / ((j:ℝ)+1) < δ := by
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ hδ] at h1
        linarith
      have h3 : δ ≤ dist x y := by
        by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        apply hy
        apply hδW
        rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
        exact ⟨x, hx, by rw [dist_comm]; exact h⟩
      linarith
  
  have s2 : ∀ (μ : Measure E2) (f : E2 → ℝ), MemLp f 2 μ →
      (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ < ε ^ 2 → eLpNorm f 2 μ < ENNReal.ofReal ε) ∧
      (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε → eLpNorm f 2 μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε → ∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ ε ^ 2) := by
    intro μ f hf
    have h := hf.eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm two_ne_zero ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top
    have hI : 0 ≤ ∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ := integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
    have e1 : (fun a => ‖f a‖ ^ (2:ENNReal).toReal) = fun a => f a ^ 2 := by
      funext a
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have hid : ∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ = ((eLpNorm f 2 μ).toReal) ^ 2 := by
      rw [h, e1, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Real.rpow_nonneg hI _), ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, ← one_div,
        ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sq_sqrt hI]
    have ha : 0 ≤ (eLpNorm f 2 μ).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    have he : eLpNorm f 2 μ = ENNReal.ofReal (eLpNorm f 2 μ).toReal :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hf.eLpNorm_lt_top.ne).symm
    refine ⟨fun ε hε hlt => ?_, fun ε hε hle => ?_⟩
    · rw [hid] at hlt
      have : (eLpNorm f 2 μ).toReal < ε := by nlinarith
      rw [he]
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hε).2 this
    · have h2 : (eLpNorm f 2 μ).toReal ≤ ε := ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hε hle
      rw [hid]
      nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKW, hKmono, hKabs⟩ := s1
  have hmem : ∀ (φ : E2 → ℝ) (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ContinuousOn φ W →
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
    intro φ L hL hLW hφ
    exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq ((hφ.mono hLW).aestronglyMeasurable hL.measurableSet)).2
      (((hφ.mono hLW).pow 2).integrableOn_compact hL)
  have hvK : ∀ m i, MemLp (v m) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) :=
    fun m i => hmem _ _ (hKc i) (hKW i) (hv m)
  have hcauK : ∀ i (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l →
      eLpNorm (v m - v l) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) < ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    intro i ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hcauchy (K i) (hKc i) (hKW i) (ε ^ 2) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨N, fun m l hm hl => ?_⟩
    exact (s2 _ _ ((hvK m i).sub (hvK l i))).1 ε hε (hN m l hm hl)
  
  choose N hN using fun j => hcauK j ((1/2:ℝ) ^ j) (by positivity)
  set n : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => j + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (j+1), N k with hn_def
  have hn_ge : ∀ j, j ≤ n j := fun j => Nat.le_add_right _ _
  have hNn : ∀ j, N j ≤ n j := fun j =>
    le_add_left (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.self_mem_range_succ j))
  have hn_mono : Monotone n := by
    intro a b hab
    exact Nat.add_le_add hab (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)))
  set w : E2 → ℝ := fun x => limUnder atTop (fun t => v (n t) x) with hw_def
  have hae : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (K i)),
      Tendsto (fun t => v (n t) x) atTop (𝓝 (w x)) := by
    intro i
    have hclaim : ∀ T a b : ℕ, T ≤ a → T ≤ b →
        eLpNorm (v (n (a + i)) - v (n (b + i))) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) <
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2:ℝ) ^ T) := by
      intro T a b ha hb
      have hM1 : N (T + i) ≤ n (a + i) := (hNn _).trans (hn_mono (by omega))
      have hM2 : N (T + i) ≤ n (b + i) := (hNn _).trans (hn_mono (by omega))
      calc eLpNorm (v (n (a + i)) - v (n (b + i))) 2 (volume.restrict (K i))
          ≤ eLpNorm (v (n (a + i)) - v (n (b + i))) 2 (volume.restrict (K (T + i))) :=
            eLpNorm_mono_measure _ (Measure.restrict_mono (hKmono i (T+i) (by omega)) le_rfl)
        _ < ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2:ℝ) ^ (T + i)) := hN (T + i) _ _ hM1 hM2
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2:ℝ) ^ T) :=
            ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega))
    have hBsum : ∑' T : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2:ℝ) ^ T) ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun _ => by positivity) summable_geometric_two]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    have hc := MeasureTheory.Lp.ae_tendsto_of_cauchy_eLpNorm (f := fun t => v (n (t + i)))
      (fun t => (hvK (n (t + i)) i).aestronglyMeasurable) (by norm_num : (1:ENNReal) ≤ 2)
      hBsum hclaim
    filter_upwards [hc] with x hx
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hx
    have hl' : Tendsto (fun t => v (n t) x) atTop (𝓝 l) :=
      (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat (f := fun t => v (n t) x) i).1 hl
    exact tendsto_nhds_limUnder ⟨l, hl'⟩
  
  have hlim : ∀ i, MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N' : ℕ, ∀ m, N' ≤ m →
      eLpNorm (v m - w) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    intro i
    have hw : AEStronglyMeasurable w (volume.restrict (K i)) :=
      aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae atTop (fun t => (hvK (n t) i).aestronglyMeasurable) (hae i)
    have hbound : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N' : ℕ, ∀ m, N' ≤ m →
        eLpNorm (v m - w) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ := hcauK i ε hε
      refine ⟨N', fun m hm => ?_⟩
      have hF := MeasureTheory.Lp.eLpNorm_lim_le_liminf_eLpNorm (p := 2)
        (fun t => (hvK m i).aestronglyMeasurable.sub (hvK (n t) i).aestronglyMeasurable) (v m - w) (by
          filter_upwards [hae i] with x hx
          simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
          exact tendsto_const_nhds.sub hx)
      refine hF.trans ?_
      refine Filter.liminf_le_of_frequently_le' ?_
      refine Filter.Eventually.frequently ?_
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N'] with t ht
      exact (hN' m (n t) hm (ht.trans (hn_ge t))).le
    refine ⟨?_, hbound⟩
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hbound 1 one_pos
    have h1 : MemLp (v N₁ - w) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) :=
      ⟨(hvK N₁ i).aestronglyMeasurable.sub hw,
        lt_of_le_of_lt (hN₁ N₁ le_rfl) ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top⟩
    have : w = v N₁ - (v N₁ - w) := by funext x; simp
    rw [this]
    exact (hvK N₁ i).sub h1
  
  refine ⟨w, fun L hL hLW => ?_, fun L hL hLW => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨j, hLj⟩ := hKabs L hL hLW
    exact (hlim j).1.mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono hLj le_rfl)
  · obtain ⟨j, hLj⟩ := hKabs L hL hLW
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    have hη : 0 < Real.sqrt (ε / 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ := (hlim j).2 _ hη
    refine ⟨N', fun m hm => ?_⟩
    have hD : MemLp (v m - w) 2 (volume.restrict (K j)) := (hvK m j).sub (hlim j).1
    have h1 : ∫ x in K j, (v m x - w x) ^ 2 ≤ Real.sqrt (ε / 2) ^ 2 :=
      (s2 _ _ hD).2 _ hη.le (hN' m hm)
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)] at h1
    have h2 : ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in K j, (v m x - w x) ^ 2 :=
      setIntegral_mono_set hD.integrable_sq (Eventually.of_forall fun x => sq_nonneg _)
        hLj.eventuallyLE
    have h3 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2 :=
      setIntegral_nonneg hL.measurableSet (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg h3]
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (f : ℕ → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n k, ContinuousOn (f n k) W) (hbd : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n k, ∫ x in L, (f n k x) ^ 2 ≤ C) : ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ ∀ k (φ : E2 → ℝ), Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ W → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, f (ψ m) k x * φ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, G k x * φ x))

signature.name: l2loc_weak_subseq
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (f : ℕ → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n k, ContinuousOn (f n k) W) (hbd : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n k, ∫ x in L, (f n k x) ^ 2 ≤ C) : ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ ∀ k (φ : E2 → ℝ), Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ W → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, f (ψ m) k x * φ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, G k x * φ x))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hF0 : ∀ n x, 0 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 2, (f n k x) ^ 2 :=
    fun n x => Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => sq_nonneg _
  have hFc : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 2, (f n k x) ^ 2) W :=
    fun n => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun k _ => (hf n k).pow 2
  have hFb : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n,
      ∫ x in L, ∑ k : Fin 2, (f n k x) ^ 2 ≤ C := by
    intro L hL hLW
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd L hL hLW
    refine ⟨2 * C, fun n => ?_⟩
    have hI : ∀ k, IntegrableOn (fun x => (f n k x) ^ 2) L := fun k =>
      (((hf n k).mono hLW).pow 2).integrableOn_compact hL
    calc ∫ x in L, ∑ k : Fin 2, (f n k x) ^ 2 = ∑ k : Fin 2, ∫ x in L, (f n k x) ^ 2 :=
          integral_finset_sum _ fun k _ => hI k
      _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin 2, C := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hC n k
      _ = 2 * C := by rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρm, hρ0, hρW, hρpos, hρint⟩ := l2loc_exhaustion_weight W hW
    (fun n x => ∑ k : Fin 2, (f n k x) ^ 2) hF0 hFc hFb
  have hsq : ∀ x, Real.sqrt (ρ x) ^ 2 = ρ x := fun x => Real.sq_sqrt (hρ0 x)
  
  have hg : ∀ n k, MemLp (fun x => Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x) 2 volume ∧
      ∫ x, (Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    intro n k
    have hmeasW : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x)
        (volume.restrict W) :=
      hρm.sqrt.aestronglyMeasurable.mul ((hf n k).aestronglyMeasurable hW.measurableSet)
    have hind : (W.indicator fun x => Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x) =
        fun x => Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ W
      · simp [hx]
      · simp [hx, hρW x hx]
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x) volume := by
      rw [← hind]; exact (aestronglyMeasurable_indicator_iff hW.measurableSet).2 hmeasW
    have hpt : ∀ x, (Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x) ^ 2 ≤ ρ x * ∑ k' : Fin 2, (f n k' x) ^ 2 := by
      intro x
      rw [mul_pow, hsq]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hρ0 x)
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k' => (f n k' x) ^ 2) (fun k' _ => sq_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_univ k)
    have hI : Integrable (fun x => (Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x) ^ 2) volume := by
      refine Integrable.mono' (hρint n).1 (hmeas.pow 2) ?_
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]; exact hpt x
    refine ⟨(memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hmeas).2 hI, ?_⟩
    exact le_trans (integral_mono hI (hρint n).1 hpt) (hρint n).2
  
  let X : ℕ → Fin 2 → Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure E2) := fun n k => (hg n k).1.toLp _
  have hinner : ∀ A B : Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure E2), inner ℝ A B = ∫ x, A x * B x := by
    intro A B
    rw [L2.inner_def]
    congr 1
    funext x
    simp [mul_comm]
  have htoLp : ∀ (u w : E2 → ℝ) (hu : MemLp u 2 volume) (hw : MemLp w 2 volume),
      inner ℝ (hu.toLp u) (hw.toLp w) = ∫ x, u x * w x := by
    intro u w hu hw
    rw [hinner]
    refine integral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [hu.coeFn_toLp, hw.coeFn_toLp] with x h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2]
  have hXn : ∀ n k, ‖X n k‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro n k
    have h1 : ‖X n k‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      show inner ℝ ((hg n k).1.toLp _) ((hg n k).1.toLp _) ≤ 1
      rw [htoLp]
      calc ∫ x, Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x * (Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x)
          = ∫ x, (Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x) ^ 2 := by
            congr 1; funext x; ring
        _ ≤ 1 := (hg n k).2
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (X n k)]
  
  obtain ⟨φ₀, Γ₀, hφ₀, h₀⟩ := hilbert_bdd_weak_subseq (fun n => X n 0) 1 (fun n => hXn n 0)
  obtain ⟨φ₁, Γ₁, hφ₁, h₁⟩ :=
    hilbert_bdd_weak_subseq (fun m => X (φ₀ m) 1) 1 (fun m => hXn _ 1)
  let Γ : Fin 2 → Lp ℝ 2 (volume : Measure E2) := ![Γ₀, Γ₁]
  have hΓ : ∀ k y, Tendsto (fun m => inner ℝ (X ((φ₀ ∘ φ₁) m) k) y) atTop
      (𝓝 (inner ℝ (Γ k) y)) := by
    intro k y
    fin_cases k
    · exact (h₀ y).comp hφ₁.tendsto_atTop
    · exact h₁ y
  
  have hdiv : ∀ (γ : E2 → ℝ), MemLp γ 2 volume → ∀ (L : Set E2), MeasurableSet L →
      ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → (∀ x ∈ L, c ≤ ρ x) →
      MemLp (fun x => γ x / Real.sqrt (ρ x)) 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
    intro γ hγ L hL c hc hcL
    have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => γ x / Real.sqrt (ρ x)) (volume.restrict L) :=
      (hγ.1.aemeasurable.div hρm.sqrt.aemeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable.restrict
    refine MemLp.of_le ((hγ.restrict L).const_mul (Real.sqrt c)⁻¹) hm ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' hL).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
    have hsc : 0 < Real.sqrt c := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hc
    have hle : Real.sqrt c ≤ Real.sqrt (ρ x) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hcL x hx)
    have hsr : 0 < Real.sqrt (ρ x) := lt_of_lt_of_le hsc hle
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hsc,
      abs_of_pos hsr, inv_mul_eq_div]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _) hsc hle
  refine ⟨φ₀ ∘ φ₁, fun k x => Γ k x / Real.sqrt (ρ x), hφ₀.comp hφ₁, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · intro L hL hLW k
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcL⟩ := hρpos L hL hLW
    exact hdiv _ (Lp.memLp (Γ k)) L hL.measurableSet c hc hcL
  
  · intro k φ hφ hφc hφW
    show Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, f ((φ₀ ∘ φ₁) m) k x * φ x) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x, Γ k x / Real.sqrt (ρ x) * φ x))
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcL⟩ := hρpos (tsupport φ) hφc hφW
    have hφL : MemLp φ 2 volume := hφ.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hφc
    have hzS := hdiv φ hφL (tsupport φ) (isClosed_tsupport φ).measurableSet c hc hcL
    have hzind : (tsupport φ).indicator (fun x => φ x / Real.sqrt (ρ x)) =
        fun x => φ x / Real.sqrt (ρ x) := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport φ
      · simp [hx]
      · simp [hx, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]
    have hz : MemLp (fun x => φ x / Real.sqrt (ρ x)) 2 volume := by
      rw [← hzind]
      exact (memLp_indicator_iff_restrict (isClosed_tsupport φ).measurableSet).2 hzS
    have ha : ∀ n x, Real.sqrt (ρ x) * f n k x * (φ x / Real.sqrt (ρ x)) = f n k x * φ x := by
      intro n x
      by_cases h0 : φ x = 0
      · simp [h0]
      · have hx : x ∈ tsupport φ := subset_tsupport φ (Function.mem_support.2 h0)
        have hsr : 0 < Real.sqrt (ρ x) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (lt_of_lt_of_le hc (hcL x hx))
        field_simp
    have hL : ∀ m, ∫ x, f ((φ₀ ∘ φ₁) m) k x * φ x =
        inner ℝ (X ((φ₀ ∘ φ₁) m) k) (hz.toLp _) := by
      intro m
      show _ = inner ℝ ((hg _ k).1.toLp _) (hz.toLp _)
      rw [htoLp]
      exact integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => (ha _ x).symm)
    have hR : ∫ x, Γ k x / Real.sqrt (ρ x) * φ x = inner ℝ (Γ k) (hz.toLp _) := by
      rw [hinner]
      refine integral_congr_ae ?_
      filter_upwards [hz.coeFn_toLp] with x hx
      rw [hx]
      ring
    rw [hR]
    exact Tendsto.congr (fun m => (hL m).symm) (hΓ k _)

subgoal_signatures.name: l2loc_exhaustion_weight

signature.name: ibp_open_test
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ) (hζW : tsupport ζ ⊆ W) (k : Fin 2) : ∫ x, u x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, pd2 k u x * ζ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hvan : ∀ x, x ∉ W → (ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0) := by
    intro x hx
    exact notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (fun h => hx (hζW h))
  have hζ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ W → ζ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hζW h))
  have hdζ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ W → pd2 k ζ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ ζ x = fderiv ℝ (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) x :=
      Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (hvan x hx)
    simp only [pd2, h1, fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  
  have hFder : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y)
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x) x ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k) = pd2 k u x * ζ x + u x * pd2 k ζ x := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ W
    · have hu' : HasFDerivAt u (fderiv ℝ u x) x :=
        ((hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
      have hζ' : HasFDerivAt ζ (fderiv ℝ ζ x) x :=
        (hζ.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
      have hm : HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y) (u x • fderiv ℝ ζ x + ζ x • fderiv ℝ u x) x :=
        hu'.mul hζ'
      refine ⟨hm.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt, ?_⟩
      rw [hm.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, pd2]
      ring
    · have hF0 : (fun y => u y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := by
        filter_upwards [hvan x hx] with y hy
        simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hy
        simp [hy]
      have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y) (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x :=
        (hasFDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq hF0
      refine ⟨hd.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt, ?_⟩
      rw [hd.fderiv, hζ0 x hx, hdζ0 x hx]
      simp
  have hFd : Differentiable ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) :=
    fun x => (hFder x).1.differentiableAt
  have hprod : (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k)) =
      fun x => pd2 k u x * ζ x + u x * pd2 k ζ x := funext fun x => (hFder x).2
  
  have helper : ∀ (a φ : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn a W → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ W →
      HasCompactSupport φ → Integrable (fun x => a x * φ x) := by
    intro a φ ha hφ hφW hφc
    have hcont : Continuous (fun x => a x * φ x) := by
      refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => ?_
      by_cases hx : x ∈ W
      · exact (ha.continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).mul hφ.continuousAt
      · have h0 : φ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (fun h => hx (hφW h))
        have h1 : (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => a y * φ y) := by
          filter_upwards [h0] with y hy
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hy
          simp [hy]
        exact continuousAt_const.congr h1
    exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hφc.mul_left)
  
  have hdu : ContinuousOn (pd2 k u) W :=
    (hu.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hdζc : Continuous (pd2 k ζ) :=
    (hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hdζs : tsupport (pd2 k ζ) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
    refine closure_minimal (fun x hx => ?_) (isClosed_tsupport ζ)
    refine support_fderiv_subset ℝ ?_
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
    intro h0
    apply hx
    simp [pd2, h0]
  have hg₁ : Integrable (fun x => pd2 k u x * ζ x) :=
    helper _ _ hdu hζ.continuous hζW hζc
  have hg₂ : Integrable (fun x => u x * pd2 k ζ x) :=
    helper _ _ hu.continuousOn hdζc (hdζs.trans hζW) (hζc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e2 k))
  have hF : Integrable (fun x => u x * ζ x) :=
    helper _ _ hu.continuousOn hζ.continuous hζW hζc
  have hF' : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k)) := by
    rw [hprod]; exact hg₁.add hg₂
  
  have h := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
    (f := fun y => u y * ζ y) (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (v := e2 k)
    (by simpa using hF') (by simp) (by simpa using hF) hFd (differentiable_const 1)
  have hzero : ∫ x, fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k) = 0 := by
    simp only [fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero, integral_zero,
      mul_one] at h
    linarith
  
  rw [hprod, integral_add hg₁ hg₂] at hzero
  linarith
