signature.name: l2_compact_pairing
signature.statement: (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) : (∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f L → MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ f φ : E2 → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L → Integrable (fun x => f x * φ x)) ∧ ∀ (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (w φ : E2 → ℝ), (∀ m, MemLp (v m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) → MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, v m x * φ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, w x * φ x))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hLm : MeasurableSet L := hL.measurableSet
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict L) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hL.measure_lt_top.ne
  have hZ : ∀ (g φ : E2 → ℝ), tsupport φ ⊆ L → ∀ x, x ∉ L → g x * φ x = 0 := by
    intro g φ hφL x hx
    rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hφL h)), mul_zero]
  have hQ : ∀ φ : E2 → ℝ, Continuous φ → IntegrableOn (fun x => φ x ^ 2) L := fun φ hφ =>
    (hφ.pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hL
  have hAM : ∀ a b t : ℝ, 0 < t → |a * b| ≤ t / 2 * a ^ 2 + 1 / (2 * t) * b ^ 2 := by
    intro a b t ht
    rw [abs_mul]
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (t * |a| - |b|) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have h2 : |a| ^ 2 = a ^ 2 := sq_abs a
    have h3 : |b| ^ 2 = b ^ 2 := sq_abs b
    have key : 2 * t * (|a| * |b|) ≤ t ^ 2 * a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have e : t / 2 * a ^ 2 + 1 / (2 * t) * b ^ 2 = (t ^ 2 * a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) / (2 * t) := by
      field_simp
    rw [e, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    linarith
  have hAM1 : ∀ a b : ℝ, |a * b| ≤ 1 / 2 * a ^ 2 + 1 / 2 * b ^ 2 := by
    intro a b
    rw [abs_mul]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|a| - |b|), sq_abs a, sq_abs b]
  have part1 : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f L → MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
    intro f hf
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hL.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf
    exact MemLp.of_bound (hf.aestronglyMeasurable hLm) C (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hLm hC)
  have part2 : ∀ f φ : E2 → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L →
      Integrable (fun x => f x * φ x) := by
    intro f φ hf hφ hφL
    have hg : Integrable (fun x => 1 / 2 * f x ^ 2 + 1 / 2 * φ x ^ 2) (volume.restrict L) :=
      (hf.integrable_sq.const_mul _).add ((hQ φ hφ).const_mul _)
    have hOn : IntegrableOn (fun x => f x * φ x) L := by
      refine Integrable.mono' hg (hf.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hφ.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hAM1 (f x) (φ x)
    exact hOn.integrable_of_forall_notMem_eq_zero (hZ f φ hφL)
  have part3 : ∀ (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (w φ : E2 → ℝ), (∀ m, MemLp (v m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) →
      MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L →
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, v m x * φ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, w x * φ x)) := by
    intro v w φ hv hw hφ hφL hconv
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ, P = ∫ x in L, φ x ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ P := by
      rw [hP]
      exact setIntegral_nonneg hLm (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hD : ∀ m, Integrable (fun x => (v m x - w x) ^ 2) (volume.restrict L) := fun m =>
      ((hv m).sub hw).integrable_sq
    have hbound : ∀ m (t : ℝ), 0 < t →
        |(∫ x, v m x * φ x) - ∫ x, w x * φ x| ≤
          t / 2 * (∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) + 1 / (2 * t) * P := by
      intro m t ht
      have e1 : (∫ x, v m x * φ x) - ∫ x, w x * φ x = ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) * φ x := by
        rw [← integral_sub (part2 _ _ (hv m) hφ hφL) (part2 _ _ hw hφ hφL)]
        rw [setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
          (fun x hx => hZ (fun y => v m y - w y) φ hφL x hx)]
        congr 1
        funext x
        ring
      rw [e1, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have hH1 : Integrable (fun x => t / 2 * (v m x - w x) ^ 2) (volume.restrict L) :=
        (hD m).const_mul _
      have hH2 : Integrable (fun x => 1 / (2 * t) * φ x ^ 2) (volume.restrict L) :=
        (hQ φ hφ).const_mul _
      have hpt : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict L), ‖(v m x - w x) * φ x‖ ≤
          t / 2 * (v m x - w x) ^ 2 + 1 / (2 * t) * φ x ^ 2 := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hAM _ _ t ht
      have hle : ‖∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) * φ x‖ ≤
          ∫ x in L, (t / 2 * (v m x - w x) ^ 2 + 1 / (2 * t) * φ x ^ 2) :=
        norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hH1.add hH2) hpt
      rw [integral_add hH1 hH2, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, ← hP] at hle
      exact hle
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    have ht : 0 < (P + 1) / ε := by positivity
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hconv (ε / ((P + 1) / ε)) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨N, fun m hm => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hN m hm
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at h1
    have h2 := hbound m _ ht
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have hDlt : (∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) < ε / ((P + 1) / ε) :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) h1
    have h3 : (P + 1) / ε / 2 * (∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) < ε / 2 := by
      have hm' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hDlt (by positivity : 0 < (P + 1) / ε / 2)
      have e : (P + 1) / ε / 2 * (ε / ((P + 1) / ε)) = ε / 2 := by
        field_simp
      linarith
    have h4 : 1 / (2 * ((P + 1) / ε)) * P < ε / 2 := by
      have e : 1 / (2 * ((P + 1) / ε)) * P = ε * P / (2 * (P + 1)) := by
        field_simp
      rw [e, div_lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
      nlinarith
    linarith
  exact ⟨part1, part2, part3⟩

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (c : E2 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c W) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ) (hζW : tsupport ζ ⊆ W) : (∀ a b : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a ζ x) ∧ tsupport (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a ζ x) ⊆ tsupport ζ) ∧ Continuous (fun x => c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * ζ x) ∧ tsupport (fun x => c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * ζ x) ⊆ tsupport ζ

signature.name: el_coeff_continuous
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (c : E2 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c W) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ) (hζW : tsupport ζ ⊆ W) : (∀ a b : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a ζ x) ∧ tsupport (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a ζ x) ⊆ tsupport ζ) ∧ Continuous (fun x => c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * ζ x) ∧ tsupport (fun x => c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * ζ x) ⊆ tsupport ζ

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hd : ∀ a : Fin 2, Continuous (pd2 a ζ) ∧ tsupport (pd2 a ζ) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
    intro a
    constructor
    · have h1 : Continuous (fderiv ℝ ζ) := hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
      have h2 : Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ ζ x (e2 a)) := h1.clm_apply continuous_const
      exact h2
    · refine closure_minimal ?_ (isClosed_tsupport ζ)
      intro x hx
      have hne : fderiv ℝ ζ x ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        simp [pd2, h0]
      exact tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ (subset_tsupport _ hne)
  
  have glue : ∀ F g : E2 → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ W, ContinuousAt F x) → Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ W →
      Continuous (fun x => F x * g x) ∧ tsupport (fun x => F x * g x) ⊆ tsupport g := by
    intro F g hF hg hgW
    refine ⟨continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => ?_, tsupport_mul_subset_right⟩
    by_cases hx : x ∈ W
    · exact (hF x hx).mul hg.continuousAt
    · have hxg : x ∉ tsupport g := fun h' => hx (hgW h')
      have hev : g =ᶠ[nhds x] 0 := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).1 hxg
      have hev2 : (fun y => F y * g y) =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
        simp [hy]
      exact continuousAt_const.congr hev2.symm
  
  have hent : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousAt (fun y => h y i j) x := fun x hx i j =>
    (hh i j).continuousOn.continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
  have hcx : ∀ x ∈ W, ContinuousAt c x := fun x hx =>
    hc.continuousOn.continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
  
  have hdet : ∀ x ∈ W, ContinuousAt (fun y => (h y).det) x := by
    intro x hx
    have e : (fun y => (h y).det) = fun y => h y 0 0 * h y 1 1 - h y 0 1 * h y 1 0 := by
      funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_two (h y)
    rw [e]
    exact ((hent x hx 0 0).mul (hent x hx 1 1)).sub ((hent x hx 0 1).mul (hent x hx 1 0))
  
  have hsq : ∀ x ∈ W, ContinuousAt (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det) x := fun x hx =>
    (hdet x hx).sqrt
  
  have hinv : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousAt (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a b) x := by
    intro x hx a b
    have hrepr : (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a b) = fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹ * (h y).adjugate a b := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rw [hrepr]
    have hadj : ContinuousAt (fun y => (h y).adjugate a b) x := by
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] <;>
        first
        | exact hent x hx _ _
        | exact (hent x hx _ _).neg
    exact ((hdet x hx).inv₀ (hpos x hx).det_pos.ne').mul hadj
  
  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hF : ∀ x ∈ W, ContinuousAt (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a b) x :=
      fun x hx => (hsq x hx).mul (hinv x hx a b)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := glue _ _ hF (hd a).1 ((hd a).2.trans hζW)
    exact ⟨h1, h2.trans (hd a).2⟩
  · have hF : ∀ x ∈ W, ContinuousAt (fun y => c y * Real.sqrt (h y).det) x :=
      fun x hx => (hcx x hx).mul (hsq x hx)
    exact glue _ _ hF hζ.continuous hζW

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E U K : Set M) (hE : IsOpen E) (hK : IsClosed K) (hKi : interior K = ∅) (hEK : Disjoint E K) (hU : IsOpen U) (p : M) (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hψb : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ c) (V : M → E3) (hVs : ∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Kᶜ)) (hVd : ∀ (p : M) (ψ : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ → IsCompact (tsupport ψ) → tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) → |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y| ≤ C) (hV1 : ∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * hullRiemPer g E U K

signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E U K : Set M) (hE : IsOpen E) (hK : IsClosed K) (hKi : interior K = ∅) (hEK : Disjoint E K) (hU : IsOpen U) (p : M) (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hψb : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ c) (V : M → E3) (hVs : ∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Kᶜ)) (hVd : ∀ (p : M) (ψ : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ → IsCompact (tsupport ψ) → tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) → |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y| ≤ C) (hV1 : ∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c * hullRiemPer g E U K

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have kill : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (D : Set E3),
      interior D = ∅ → (∀ y ∈ D, 0 < (G y).det) → ∃ X' : E3 → E3,
        (∀ y, y ∉ D → X' y = X y) ∧ (∀ y ∈ D, sepDensDiv G X' y = 0) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ D, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X' y i * X' y j ≤ 1) := by
    intro G X D hD hdet
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : E3 → ℝ,
        s = fun y => (1 + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, |G y a b|)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hσ : ∀ y, 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, |G y a b| := fun y =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _
    have hspos : ∀ y, 0 < s y := fun y => by
      rw [hs]; exact inv_pos.mpr (by linarith [hσ y])
    have hs1 : ∀ y, s y * (1 + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, |G y a b|) = 1 := fun y => by
      rw [hs]; exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (by linarith [hσ y])
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : Fin 3 → E3 → Prop, L = fun i y =>
        Tendsto (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) (𝓝[Dᶜ] y) (𝓝 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨X', hX'X, hX'D⟩ : ∃ X' : E3 → E3, (∀ y, y ∉ D → X' y = X y) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ D, ∀ i, X' y i = if L i y then s y else 0) :=
      ⟨fun y => if y ∈ D then WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => if L i y then s y else 0) else X y,
        fun y hy => if_neg hy, fun y hy i => by simp only [if_pos hy]⟩
    have hne : ∀ y, (𝓝[Dᶜ] y).NeBot := by
      intro y
      rw [← mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot, closure_compl, hD, Set.compl_empty]
      exact Set.mem_univ y
    have hnd : ∀ y ∈ D, ∀ i : Fin 3,
        ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X' z i) y := by
      intro y hy i hdiff
      have h1 : Tendsto (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X' z i) (𝓝[Dᶜ] y)
          (𝓝 (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X' y i)) :=
        hdiff.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
      have h2 : Tendsto (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) (𝓝[Dᶜ] y)
          (𝓝 (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X' y i)) := by
        refine h1.congr' ?_
        filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz
        rw [hX'X z hz]
      haveI := hne y
      have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt (G y).det := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hdet y hy)
      by_cases hLi : L i y
      · have hL' : Tendsto (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) (𝓝[Dᶜ] y) (𝓝 0) := by
          rw [hL] at hLi; exact hLi
        have h3 := tendsto_nhds_unique h2 hL'
        rw [hX'D y hy i, if_pos hLi] at h3
        have := mul_pos hsq (hspos y)
        linarith
      · rw [hX'D y hy i, if_neg hLi, mul_zero] at h2
        apply hLi
        rw [hL]; exact h2
    refine ⟨X', hX'X, fun y hy => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    · unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
      rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt (hnd y hy i)]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply _
    · have ha : ∀ i, |X' y i| ≤ s y := by
        intro i
        rw [hX'D y hy i]
        split_ifs
        · rw [abs_of_pos (hspos y)]
        · rw [abs_zero]; exact (hspos y).le
      have hsy := hspos y
      have hs1y := hs1 y
      have hσy := hσ y
      calc ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X' y i * X' y j
          ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |G y i j| * (s y * s y) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
            calc G y i j * X' y i * X' y j ≤ |G y i j * X' y i * X' y j| := le_abs_self _
              _ = |G y i j| * (|X' y i| * |X' y j|) := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]; ring
              _ ≤ |G y i j| * (s y * s y) := by
                apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (abs_nonneg _)
                exact mul_le_mul (ha i) (ha j) (abs_nonneg _) hsy.le
        _ = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, |G y a b|) * (s y * s y) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_mul]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
            rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        _ ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  
  have admiss : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F U Kc D : Set E3), MeasurableSet F →
      Disjoint F D → IsCompact D → D ⊆ Kc → D ⊆ U → ∀ (X X' : E3 → E3),
      (∀ y, y ∉ Kc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U →
      (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) →
      (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, y ∉ D → |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C) → (∀ y, y ∉ D → X' y = X y) →
      (∀ y ∈ D, sepDensDiv G X' y = 0) →
      (∀ y ∈ D, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X' y i * X' y j ≤ 1) →
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G X y) ≤ hullPerG G F U Kc := by
    intro G F U Kc D hF hFD hD hDKc hDU X X' hXs hXc hXU hXn hXd hX'X hX'd hX'n
    have hDcl : IsClosed D := hD.isClosed
    have hg0 : ∀ y, y ∉ D → X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] X := fun y hy => by
      filter_upwards [hDcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz using hX'X z hz
    have hdivEq : ∀ y, y ∉ D → sepDensDiv G X' y = sepDensDiv G X y := by
      intro y hy
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X' z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
        filter_upwards [hg0 y hy] with z hz
        rw [hz]
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hQc : IsCompact (tsupport X ∪ D) := hXc.isCompact.union hD
    have hQcl : IsClosed (tsupport X ∪ D) := (isClosed_tsupport X).union hDcl
    have hX'0 : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X ∪ D → X' y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Set.mem_union, not_or] at hy
      rw [hX'X y hy.2]
      exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy.1
    have hX's : ∀ y, y ∉ Kc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X' y := fun y hy =>
      (hXs y hy).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hg0 y (fun h => hy (hDKc h)))
    have hX'c : HasCompactSupport X' := HasCompactSupport.intro hQc hX'0
    have hX'U : tsupport X' ⊆ U := by
      have h1 : tsupport X' ⊆ tsupport X ∪ D :=
        closure_minimal (fun y hy => by_contra fun h => hy (hX'0 y h)) hQcl
      exact h1.trans (Set.union_subset hXU hDU)
    have hX'n' : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X' y i * X' y j ≤ 1 := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ D
      · exact hX'n y hy
      · rw [hX'X y hy]; exact hXn y
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hXd
    have hX'd' : ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X' y| ≤ max C 0 := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ D
      · rw [hX'd y hy, abs_zero]; exact le_max_right _ _
      · rw [hdivEq y hy]; exact (hC y hy).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have hint : ∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G X' y = ∫ y in F, sepDensDiv G X y :=
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hF
        (fun y hy => hdivEq y (Set.disjoint_left.mp hFD hy))
    unfold hullPerG
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le X' ⟨hX's, hX'c, hX'U, hX'n', ⟨max C 0, hX'd'⟩⟩
      (le_of_eq (by rw [hint]))
  
  have hψs' : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := hψs.trans Set.inter_subset_right
  have hKc : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ) :=
    hψc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono hψs')
  have hKcl : IsClosed ((chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ) := hKc.isClosed
  have hKt : (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source (hψs' hx)
  have hval : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, calPiece p ψ V y =
      (ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) • mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p)
        ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3) := by
    intro y hy
    unfold calPiece
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
  have hval0 : ∀ y ∉ (chartAt E3 p).target, calPiece p ψ V y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold calPiece
    rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy]
  have hZ : ∀ y ∉ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ, calPiece p ψ V y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hyt : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
    · have hx : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∉ tsupport ψ := fun hx =>
        hy ⟨_, hx, (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hyt⟩
      rw [hval y hyt, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx, zero_smul]
    · exact hval0 y hyt
  
  have hCK : ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (calPiece p ψ V) y := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hψ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    have hT'o : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Kᶜ) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hK.isOpen_compl
    have hT'P : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (calPiece p ψ V)
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Kᶜ) :=
      ((h1.mono Set.inter_subset_left).smul (hVs p)).congr (fun y hy => hval y hy.1)
    by_cases hyt : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
    · have hyK : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∉ K := fun h =>
        hy ⟨_, ⟨h, (chartAt E3 p).map_target hyt⟩, (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hyt⟩
      exact hT'P.contDiffAt (hT'o.mem_nhds ⟨hyt, hyK⟩)
    · have hy' : y ∉ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ := fun h => hyt (hKt h)
      have hev : calPiece p ψ V =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
        filter_upwards [hKcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy'] with z hz using hZ z hz
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hHC : HasCompactSupport (calPiece p ψ V) := HasCompactSupport.intro hKc hZ
  have hT : tsupport (calPiece p ψ V) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ :=
    closure_minimal (fun y hy => by_contra fun h => hy (hZ y h)) hKcl
  
  set X : E3 → E3 := fun z => c⁻¹ • calPiece p ψ V z with hXdef
  have hXs : ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y :=
    fun y hy => (hCK y hy).const_smul c⁻¹
  have hXK : HasCompactSupport X := hHC.mono (fun y hy h => hy (by simp [hXdef, h]))
  have hXT : tsupport X ⊆ (chartAt E3 p) '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
    (tsupport_smul_subset_right (fun _ => c⁻¹) (calPiece p ψ V)).trans
      (hT.trans (Set.image_mono hψs))
  have hexp : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a : E3),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B (L (e i)) (L (e j)) * a i * a j = B (L a) (L a) := by
    intro L B a
    have ha : a = a 0 • e 0 + a 1 • e 1 + a 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_rhs => rw [ha]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hXN : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
    · have hxs : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
      have hchain : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) w) = w := by
        intro w
        have h := (mdifferentiable_chart (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) p).symm_comp_deriv hxs
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv hy] at h
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun h w
      have hXy : X y = (c⁻¹ * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) • mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3)
          (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := by
        simp only [hXdef, hval y hy, smul_smul]
      have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j * X y i * X y j =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (X y))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (X y)) :=
        hexp _ _ _
      rw [hsum, hXy]
      simp only [map_smul, hchain, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have h1 : |c⁻¹ * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)| ≤ 1 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hc), inv_mul_le_iff₀ hc, mul_one]
        exact hψb _
      have h2 : (c⁻¹ * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (c⁻¹ * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))]
      have h3 := hV1 ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
      have h4 : 0 ≤ (c⁻¹ * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 h4]
    · have hX0 : X y = 0 := by simp [hXdef, hval0 y hy]
      simp [hX0]
  have hXZ : ∀ y, y ∉ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ → X y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    simp [hXdef, hZ y hy]
  
  have hcal : calPiece p ψ V = fun z => c • X z := by
    funext z
    simp only [hXdef, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_smul]
  have hdiv : ∀ y, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y =
      c * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y := by
    intro y
    rw [hcal]
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have hf : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * (c • X z) i) =
        c • (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) := by
      funext z; simp only [Pi.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [hf, fderiv_const_smul_of_field]
    simp
  have hint : ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y =
      c * ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    exact MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hdiv)
  
  have hD₀c : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ tsupport ψ)) :=
    (hψc.inter_left hK).image_of_continuousOn
      ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono (Set.inter_subset_right.trans hψs'))
  have hD₀T : (chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ tsupport ψ) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source (hψs' hx.2)
  have hD₀i : interior ((chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ tsupport ψ)) = ∅ := by
    have hO : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).symm '' interior ((chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ tsupport ψ))) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_symm_of_subset_target isOpen_interior
        (interior_subset.trans hD₀T)
    have hsub : (chartAt E3 p).symm '' interior ((chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ tsupport ψ)) ⊆ K := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := interior_subset hy
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hψs' hx.2)]
      exact hx.1
    have h2 := interior_maximal hsub hO
    rw [hKi] at h2
    exact Set.image_eq_empty.mp (Set.subset_empty_iff.mp h2)
  have hD₀Kc : (chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ tsupport ψ) ⊆
      chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
    Set.image_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_right _ hψs')
  have hD₀U : (chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ tsupport ψ) ⊆
      (chartAt E3 p) '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
    (Set.image_mono Set.inter_subset_right).trans (Set.image_mono hψs)
  have hposdef : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  have hdet : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ tsupport ψ),
      0 < (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det :=
    fun y hy => (hposdef y (hD₀T hy)).det_pos
  have hSo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hE.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right
  have hSD : Disjoint (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
      ((chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ tsupport ψ)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ ⟨x', hx', hxx'⟩
    have hx'x : x' = x := (chartAt E3 p).injOn (hψs' hx'.2) hx.2 hxx'
    rw [hx'x] at hx'
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hEK hx.1 hx'.1
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hVd p ψ hψ hψc hψs'
  have hXd : ∀ y, y ∉ (chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ tsupport ψ) →
      |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y| ≤ max (c⁻¹ * C) 0 := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hyK : y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)
    · obtain ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩ := hyK
      have hyψ : chartAt E3 p x' ∉ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ := by
        rintro ⟨x, hx, hxx'⟩
        have hxx : x = x' := (chartAt E3 p).injOn (hψs' hx) hx'.2 hxx'
        rw [hxx] at hx
        exact hy ⟨x', ⟨hx'.1, hx⟩, rfl⟩
      have h0 : sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X (chartAt E3 p x') = 0 := by
        unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
        have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i)
            =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p x')] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [hKcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hyψ] with z hz
          rw [hXZ z hz]
          simp
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      rw [h0, abs_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    · have h1 := hC y hyK
      rw [hdiv y, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc] at h1
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le)
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_mul] at h2
      exact h2.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  
  obtain ⟨X', hX'X, hX'd, hX'n⟩ := kill (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X
    ((chartAt E3 p) '' (K ∩ tsupport ψ)) hD₀i hdet
  have hS4 : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y) ≤
      hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (chartAt E3 p '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :=
    admiss _ _ _ _ _ hSo.measurableSet hSD hD₀c hD₀Kc hD₀U X X' hXs hXK hXT hXN ⟨_, hXd⟩
      hX'X hX'd hX'n
  
  have hS5 : hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (chartAt E3 p '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ≤ hullRiemPer g E U K := by
    unfold hullRiemPer
    refine le_iSup_of_le 1 (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ => p) (le_iSup_of_le
      (fun _ => U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) (le_iSup_of_le
      ⟨fun _ => ⟨hU.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source, subset_rfl⟩,
        fun k l hkl => absurd (Subsingleton.elim k l) hkl⟩ ?_)))
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_one]
  
  rw [hint, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc.le]
  exact mul_le_mul_left' (hS4.trans hS5) _

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (K : Set M) (p q : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (hφ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ) (hφc : IsCompact (tsupport φ)) (hφs : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) (V : M → E3) (hVs : ∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Kᶜ)) (E : Set M) (hE : IsOpen E) (hEK : Disjoint E K) : ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ V) y = ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q φ V) y

signature.name: hull_calPiece_div_integral_chart_eq
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (K : Set M) (p q : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (hφ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ) (hφc : IsCompact (tsupport φ)) (hφs : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) (V : M → E3) (hVs : ∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Kᶜ)) (E : Set M) (hE : IsOpen E) (hEK : Disjoint E K) : ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ V) y = ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q φ V) y

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hKp : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := fun x hx => (hφs hx).1
  have hKq : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source := fun x hx => (hφs hx).2
  
  have hW : ∀ x ∈ E, x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det *
        calPiece q φ V z i) (chartAt E3 q x) := by
    intro x hxE hxq i
    have hOq : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' E) :=
      (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hE
    have hy0 : chartAt E3 q x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' E := by
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 q).map_source hxq, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q x) ∈ E
      rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxq]
      exact hxE
    have hOqK : (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' E ⊆
        (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' Kᶜ :=
      fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, Set.disjoint_left.mp hEK hz.2⟩
    set w : E3 → E3 := fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
        ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3) with hwdef
    have hwO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' E) :=
      (hVs q).mono hOqK
    have hwi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w y i)
        ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' E) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hwO
    have hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y a b)
        (chartAt E3 q).target := fun a b => g.smooth q a b
    have hdetpos : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, 0 < (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det :=
      fun y hy => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q y hy).det_pos
    have hdetT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
        (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      have e : (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det) = fun y =>
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 0 0 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 1 1 *
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 2 2
          - g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 0 0 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 1 2 *
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 2 1
          - g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 0 1 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 1 0 *
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 2 2
          + g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 0 1 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 1 2 *
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 2 0
          + g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 0 2 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 1 0 *
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 2 1
          - g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 0 2 * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 1 1 *
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y 2 0 := by
        funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
      rw [e]
      have h := hGs
      exact (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
        (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
        (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
    have hsqT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
        (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      hdetT.sqrt (fun y hy => (hdetpos y hy).ne')
    have hφT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (φ ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm)
          (chartAt E3 q).target :=
        hφ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    have H := (hsqT.mono Set.inter_subset_left).mul ((hφT.mono Set.inter_subset_left).mul hwi)
    refine ((H.contDiffAt (hOq.mem_nhds hy0)).differentiableAt (by simp)).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hOq.mem_nhds hy0] with z hz
    congr 1
    simp only [calPiece]
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz.1, WithLp.ofLp_smul]
    rfl
  
  have zeroOff : ∀ r : M, tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 r).source →
      ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y : E3), y ∉ chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ →
        sepDensDiv G (calPiece r φ V) y = 0 := by
    intro r hKr G y hy
    have hKrc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ) :=
      hφc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 r).continuousOn.mono hKr)
    have hz : ∀ z, z ∉ chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ → calPiece r φ V z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      unfold calPiece
      by_cases hzt : z ∈ (chartAt E3 r).target
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hzt]
        have h0 : φ ((chartAt E3 r).symm z) = 0 := by
          by_contra h0
          exact hz ⟨_, subset_tsupport _ h0, (chartAt E3 r).right_inv hzt⟩
        simp [h0]
      · exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hzt _
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * calPiece r φ V z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hKrc.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz'
      rw [hz z hz']
      simp
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have restrict : ∀ r : M, tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 r).source →
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 r '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 r).source),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 r).symm) (calPiece r φ V) y =
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 r '' (E ∩ tsupport φ),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 r).symm) (calPiece r φ V) y := by
    intro r hKr
    have hKrc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ) :=
      hφc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 r).continuousOn.mono hKr)
    have hfun : sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 r).symm) (calPiece r φ V) =
        (chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ).indicator
          (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 r).symm) (calPiece r φ V)) := by
      funext y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, zeroOff r hKr _ y hy]
    have hset : chartAt E3 r '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 r).source) ∩ chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ =
        chartAt E3 r '' (E ∩ tsupport φ) := by
      rw [← Set.InjOn.image_inter (chartAt E3 r).injOn Set.inter_subset_right hKr]
      congr 1
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hxE, -⟩, hxK⟩
        exact ⟨hxE, hxK⟩
      · rintro ⟨hxE, hxK⟩
        exact ⟨⟨hxE, hKr hxK⟩, hxK⟩
    conv_lhs => rw [hfun]
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_indicator hKrc.measurableSet, hset]
  
  have hAp_meas : MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ tsupport φ)) := by
    have hKpc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ) :=
      hφc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono hKp)
    have hSopen : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hE.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source)
        Set.inter_subset_right
    have h := hSopen.measurableSet.inter hKpc.measurableSet
    rwa [← Set.InjOn.image_inter (chartAt E3 p).injOn Set.inter_subset_right hKp,
      show E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ tsupport φ = E ∩ tsupport φ from by
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨hxE, -⟩, hxK⟩
          exact ⟨hxE, hxK⟩
        · rintro ⟨hxE, hxK⟩
          exact ⟨⟨hxE, hKp hxK⟩, hxK⟩] at h
  
  set τ : E3 → E3 := fun z => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) with hτdef
  set O : Set E3 := (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source
    with hOdef
  have hOopen : IsOpen O :=
    (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 q).open_source
  have hApO : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ tsupport φ), y ∈ O := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source (hKp hx.2), ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hKp hx.2)]
    exact hKq hx.2
  have himg : τ '' (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ tsupport φ)) = chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ tsupport φ) := by
    rw [Set.image_image]
    refine Set.image_congr ?_
    intro x hx
    simp only [τ, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hKp hx.2)]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn τ (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ tsupport φ)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x₁, hx₁, rfl⟩ _ ⟨x₂, hx₂, rfl⟩ h
    simp only [τ, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hKp hx₁.2),
      (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hKp hx₂.2)] at h
    rw [(chartAt E3 q).injOn (hKq hx₁.2) (hKq hx₂.2) h]
  have hderiv : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ tsupport φ),
      HasFDerivWithinAt τ (fderiv ℝ τ y) (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ tsupport φ)) y := by
    intro y hy
    exact (sep_chart_transition g p q y (hApO y hy).1 (hApO y hy).2).1.hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
  have hcov := MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hAp_meas
    hderiv hinj (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q φ V))
  
  have hτsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ O := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 q ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) O :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart (x := q)).comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (fun z hz => hz.2)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  have detne : ∀ y ∈ O, (fderiv ℝ τ y).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hτt : τ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).map_source hy.2
    have hback : (chartAt E3 q).symm (τ y) = (chartAt E3 p).symm y := (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hy.2
    have hσsrc : (chartAt E3 q).symm (τ y) ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := by
      rw [hback]
      exact (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy.1
    have hσ := (sep_chart_transition g q p (τ y) hτt hσsrc).1
    have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y := (sep_chart_transition g p q y hy.1 hy.2).1
    have hev : (fun w => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm w)) ∘ τ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] id := by
      filter_upwards [hOopen.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, id, τ, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hz.2,
        (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hz.1]
    have hcomp : (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm w)) (τ y)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ τ y) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 := by
      rw [← fderiv_comp y hσ hτd, hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id]
    have hdet := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => LinearMap.det (L : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)) hcomp
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, LinearMap.det_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id,
      LinearMap.det_id] at hdet
    exact right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hdet
  
  have vecLaw : ∀ y ∈ O, fderiv ℝ τ y (calPiece p φ V y) = calPiece q φ V (τ y) := by
    intro y hy
    have hxp : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy.1
    have hxq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := hy.2
    have hτt : τ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).map_source hy.2
    have hback : (chartAt E3 q).symm (τ y) = (chartAt E3 p).symm y := (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hy.2
    have hcpx : chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = y := (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hy.1
    unfold calPiece
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy.1, Set.indicator_of_mem hτt]
    show _ = (fun z => (φ z • mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) z (V z) : E3))
      ((chartAt E3 q).symm (τ y))
    rw [hback]
    simp only [map_smul]
    congr 1
    have hcp : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hxp
    have hτm : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) τ
        (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := by
      rw [hcpx]
      exact (mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hxq).comp y
        (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy.1)
    have hev : (chartAt E3 q : M → E3) =ᶠ[𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)] τ ∘ chartAt E3 p := by
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).open_source.mem_nhds hxp] with w hw
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, τ, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hw]
    have h1 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (τ ∘ chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
      hev.mfderiv_eq
    have h2 := mfderiv_comp ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) hτm hcp
    have h3 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) τ (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =
        fderiv ℝ τ y := by
      rw [hcpx, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
    rw [h1, h2]
    show (fderiv ℝ τ y) _ = (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) τ (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)))
      ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)))
    rw [h3]
    rfl
  
  have pw : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ tsupport φ),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ V) y =
        |(fderiv ℝ τ y).det| • sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q φ V) (τ y) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [smul_eq_mul]
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hy' : chartAt E3 p x ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ tsupport φ) := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hτx : τ (chartAt E3 p x) = chartAt E3 q x := by
      simp only [τ, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hKp hx.2)]
    exact sepDensDiv_transition_pointwise O hOopen τ hτsmooth (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece p φ V) (calPiece q φ V)
      (fun z hz i j => (sep_chart_transition g p q z hz.1 hz.2).2.1 i j)
      (fun z hz => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q (τ z)
        ((chartAt E3 q).map_source hz.2)).det_pos.le)
      vecLaw _ (hApO _ hy') (detne _ (hApO _ hy'))
      (fun i => by rw [hτx]; exact hW x hx.1 (hKq hx.2) i)
  
  rw [restrict p hKp, restrict q hKq, ← himg, hcov]
  exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hAp_meas pw

subgoal_signatures.name: sep_chart_transition
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p₁ p₂ : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₁).target)
    (hy₂ : (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₂).source) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₁).symm y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) ∧
    (∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y = ∑ a : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p₂).symm z))
            (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)))

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: sepDensDiv_transition_pointwise
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (τ : E3 → E3)
    (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ O) (G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P₁ P₂ : E3 → E3)
    (hlaw : ∀ z ∈ O, ∀ i j : Fin 3, G₁ z i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ τ z (e i) a * G₂ (τ z) a b * fderiv ℝ τ z (e j) b)
    (hpos : ∀ z ∈ O, 0 ≤ (G₂ (τ z)).det)
    (hvec : ∀ z ∈ O, fderiv ℝ τ z (P₁ z) = P₂ (τ z))
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ O) (hdet : (fderiv ℝ τ y).det ≠ 0)
    (hW : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G₂ z).det * P₂ z i) (τ y)) :
    sepDensDiv G₁ P₁ y = |(fderiv ℝ τ y).det| * sepDensDiv G₂ P₂ (τ y)

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E K : Set M) (hE : IsOpen E) (hEK : Disjoint E K) (p : M) {m : ℕ} (ψ : Fin m → M → ℝ) (hψ : ∀ k, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ k)) (hψc : ∀ k, IsCompact (tsupport (ψ k))) (hψs : ∀ k, tsupport (ψ k) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source) (V : M → E3) (hVs : ∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Kᶜ)) (hVd : ∀ k, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) → |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p (ψ k) V) y| ≤ C) : ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p (fun x => ∑ k, ψ k x) V) y = ∑ k, ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p (ψ k) V) y

signature.name: hull_calPiece_div_integral_sum
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E K : Set M) (hE : IsOpen E) (hEK : Disjoint E K) (p : M) {m : ℕ} (ψ : Fin m → M → ℝ) (hψ : ∀ k, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ k)) (hψc : ∀ k, IsCompact (tsupport (ψ k))) (hψs : ∀ k, tsupport (ψ k) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source) (V : M → E3) (hVs : ∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Kᶜ)) (hVd : ∀ k, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) → |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p (ψ k) V) y| ≤ C) : ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p (fun x => ∑ k, ψ k x) V) y = ∑ k, ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p (ψ k) V) y

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hposdef : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  set T : Set E3 := (chartAt E3 p).target with hTdef
  set S : Set E3 := chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) with hSdef
  set w : E3 → E3 := fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p)
      ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3) with hwdef
  set G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm with hGdef
  have hTo : IsOpen T := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
  
  have hSo : IsOpen S := (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source
    (hE.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source) Set.inter_subset_right
  have hSm : MeasurableSet S := hSo.measurableSet
  have hST : S ⊆ T := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source hx.2
  have hSK : ∀ y ∈ S, (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∉ K := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx.2]
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hEK hx.1
  have hSKc : ∀ y ∈ S, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) := by
    intro y hy hyK
    obtain ⟨x', hx', rfl⟩ := hyK
    apply hSK _ hy
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx'.2]
    exact hx'.1
  have hwS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w S :=
    (hVs p).mono (fun y hy => ⟨hST hy, hSK y hy⟩)
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) T := fun i j => g.smooth p i j
  have hdetpos : ∀ y ∈ T, 0 < (G y).det := fun y hy =>
    (hposdef y hy).det_pos
  have hdetT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) T := by
    have e : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y => G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2
        - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1
        - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2 + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0
        + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
      funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
    rw [e]
    have h := hGs
    exact (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
      (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
      (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
  have hsqT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) T :=
    hdetT.sqrt (fun y hy => (hdetpos y hy).ne')
  have hwi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w y i) S := by
    intro i
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hwS
  have hψT : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ψ k ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) T := by
    intro k
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ k ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      (hψ k).comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  
  have hcp : ∀ (φ : M → ℝ) (z : E3) (i : Fin 3),
      calPiece p φ V z i = T.indicator (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * w y i) z := by
    intro φ z i
    by_cases hz : z ∈ T
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
      simp only [calPiece]
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
      rw [WithLp.ofLp_smul]
      rfl
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
      simp only [calPiece]
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
      simp
  
  have hKc : ∀ k, IsCompact ((chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport (ψ k)) := fun k =>
    (hψc k).image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono (hψs k))
  have hvan : ∀ k (y : E3) (i : Fin 3), y ∉ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport (ψ k) →
      T.indicator (fun y => ψ k ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * w y i) y = 0 := by
    intro k y i hy
    by_cases hyT : y ∈ T
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyT]
      have h0 : ψ k ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = 0 := by
        apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
        intro hmem
        exact hy ⟨_, hmem, (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hyT⟩
      rw [h0, zero_mul]
    · exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hyT _
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : Fin m → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, ∀ k i z, F k i z =
      Real.sqrt (G z).det * T.indicator (fun y => ψ k ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * w y i) z :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hF : ∀ k (i : Fin 3) (z : E3), z ∈ S → DifferentiableAt ℝ (F k i) z := by
    intro k i z hz
    have hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det * (ψ k ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * w y i)) S :=
      (hsqT.mono hST).mul (((hψT k).mono hST).mul (hwi i))
    refine ((hH.contDiffAt (hSo.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hSo.mem_nhds hz] with y hy
    rw [hFdef, Set.indicator_of_mem (hST hy)]
  have hk_pt : ∀ k (i : Fin 3),
      (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * calPiece p (ψ k) V z i) = F k i := by
    intro k i; funext z; rw [hFdef, hcp]
  have hsum_pt : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * calPiece p (fun x => ∑ k, ψ k x) V z i)
        = fun z => ∑ k, F k i z := by
    intro i; funext z
    simp only [hFdef]
    rw [hcp, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    by_cases hz : z ∈ T
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hz, Finset.sum_mul]
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have hdiv_k : ∀ k, sepDensDiv G (calPiece p (ψ k) V) =
      fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (F k i) y := by
    intro k; funext y
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [hk_pt k i]
  have hdiv : ∀ y ∈ S, sepDensDiv G (calPiece p (fun x => ∑ k, ψ k x) V) y =
      ∑ k, sepDensDiv G (calPiece p (ψ k) V) y := by
    intro y hy
    simp only [hdiv_k]
    unfold sepDensDiv
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [hsum_pt i]
    unfold partialDeriv
    have hfs : (fun z => ∑ k, F k i z) = ∑ k, F k i := by
      funext z; rw [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [hfs, fderiv_sum (fun k _ => hF k i y hy)]
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  
  have hint : ∀ k, Integrable (sepDensDiv G (calPiece p (ψ k) V)) (volume.restrict S) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hVd k
    have hmeas : Measurable (sepDensDiv G (calPiece p (ψ k) V)) := by
      rw [hdiv_k k]
      refine Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
      exact measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ (F k i) (e i)
    have hzero : ∀ y, y ∉ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport (ψ k) →
        sepDensDiv G (calPiece p (ψ k) V) y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hdiv_k k]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
      have hev : F k i =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [(hKc k).isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        rw [hFdef, hvan k z i hz, mul_zero]
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hQm : MeasurableSet ((chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport (ψ k)) := (hKc k).isClosed.measurableSet
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (sepDensDiv G (calPiece p (ψ k) V))
        (S ∩ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport (ψ k)) volume := by
      refine Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := C) ?_ hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      · exact (lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
          (hKc k).measure_lt_top).ne
      · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (hSm.inter hQm) (fun y hy => ?_)
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hC y (hSKc y hy.1)
    exact h1.of_forall_diff_eq_zero hSm (fun y hy => hzero y (fun hyQ => hy.2 ⟨hy.1, hyQ⟩))
  rw [setIntegral_congr_fun hSm hdiv]
  exact integral_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => hint k)

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w c : E2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) (hB : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) (hwc : ContinuousOn w W) (hc : ContinuousOn c W) (z : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z R, 0 < w x) : ∃ m₀ Λ β Γ m : ℝ, 0 < m₀ ∧ 0 ≤ Λ ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ 0 ≤ Γ ∧ 0 < m ∧ (∀ x : E2, R / 2 ≤ dist x z → dist x z ≤ R → m₀ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (x - z) i * A x i j * (x - z) j ∧ (∀ i : Fin 2, |A x i i| ≤ Λ) ∧ (∀ k : Fin 2, |B x k| ≤ β) ∧ |c x| ≤ Γ) ∧ ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → m ≤ w x

signature.name: esm_hopf_constants
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w c : E2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) (hB : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) (hwc : ContinuousOn w W) (hc : ContinuousOn c W) (z : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z R, 0 < w x) : ∃ m₀ Λ β Γ m : ℝ, 0 < m₀ ∧ 0 ≤ Λ ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ 0 ≤ Γ ∧ 0 < m ∧ (∀ x : E2, R / 2 ≤ dist x z → dist x z ≤ R → m₀ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (x - z) i * A x i j * (x - z) j ∧ (∀ i : Fin 2, |A x i i| ≤ Λ) ∧ (∀ k : Fin 2, |B x k| ≤ β) ∧ |c x| ≤ Γ) ∧ ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → m ≤ w x

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have P1 : ∀ (K : Set E2) (f : E2 → ℝ), IsCompact K → ContinuousOn f K →
      (∀ x ∈ K, 0 < f x) → ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, m ≤ f x := by
    intro K f hK hf hfpos
    rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty K with hK0 | hKne
    · refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      rw [hK0] at hx
      exact absurd hx (Set.notMem_empty x)
    · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hmin⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn hKne hf
      exact ⟨f x₀, hfpos x₀ hx₀, fun x hx => hmin hx⟩
  have P2 : ∀ (K : Set E2) (f : E2 → ℝ), IsCompact K → ContinuousOn f K →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, |f x| ≤ C := by
    intro K f hK hf
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have := hC x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact le_trans this (le_max_left _ _)
  
  set K : Set E2 := {x | R / 2 ≤ dist x z ∧ dist x z ≤ R} with hKdef
  have hKcl : IsClosed K :=
    (isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)).inter
      (isClosed_le (continuous_id.dist continuous_const) continuous_const)
  have hKsub : K ⊆ Metric.closedBall z R := fun x hx => Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr hx.2
  have hKc : IsCompact K := (isCompact_closedBall z R).of_isClosed_subset hKcl hKsub
  have hKW : K ⊆ W := hKsub.trans hball
  have hSc : IsCompact (Metric.sphere z (R / 2)) := isCompact_sphere z (R / 2)
  have hSball : Metric.sphere z (R / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball z R :=
    Metric.sphere_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hSW : Metric.sphere z (R / 2) ⊆ W :=
    hSball.trans (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hball)
  
  have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x : E2 => (x - z) i) := fun i =>
    (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) i).comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  have hq : ContinuousOn
      (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (x - z) i * A x i j * (x - z) j) W := by
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro i _
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro j _
    exact (((hcoord i).continuousOn).mul (hA i j)).mul (hcoord j).continuousOn
  have hqpos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (x - z) i * A x i j * (x - z) j := by
    intro x hx
    have hd : 0 < dist x z := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) hx.1
    have hne : x - z ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (dist_pos.mp hd)
    exact hApos x (hKW hx) (x - z) hne
  
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀, hm₀K⟩ := P1 K _ hKc (hq.mono hKW) hqpos
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, hC₀K⟩ := P2 K (fun x => A x 0 0) hKc ((hA 0 0).mono hKW)
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁, hC₁K⟩ := P2 K (fun x => A x 1 1) hKc ((hA 1 1).mono hKW)
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀, hD₀K⟩ := P2 K (fun x => B x 0) hKc ((hB 0).mono hKW)
  obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁, hD₁K⟩ := P2 K (fun x => B x 1) hKc ((hB 1).mono hKW)
  obtain ⟨Γ, hΓ, hΓK⟩ := P2 K c hKc (hc.mono hKW)
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmS⟩ := P1 (Metric.sphere z (R / 2)) w hSc (hwc.mono hSW)
    (fun x hx => hpos x (hSball hx))
  refine ⟨m₀, C₀ + C₁, D₀ + D₁, Γ, m, hm₀, add_nonneg hC₀ hC₁, add_nonneg hD₀ hD₁, hΓ, hm,
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x h1 h2
    have hxK : x ∈ K := ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have a0 : |A x 0 0| ≤ C₀ := hC₀K x hxK
    have a1 : |A x 1 1| ≤ C₁ := hC₁K x hxK
    have b0 : |B x 0| ≤ D₀ := hD₀K x hxK
    have b1 : |B x 1| ≤ D₁ := hD₁K x hxK
    refine ⟨hm₀K x hxK, ?_, ?_, hΓK x hxK⟩
    · rw [Fin.forall_fin_two]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · rw [Fin.forall_fin_two]
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact hmS x (Metric.mem_sphere.mpr hx)

informal_problem.statement: (z : E2) (α R : ℝ) (v : E2 → ℝ) (hv : ∀ x, v x = Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v ∧ (∀ x d : E2, fderiv ℝ v x d = -2 * α * (∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * d k) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)) ∧ (∀ (x : E2) (j : Fin 2), pd2 j v x = -2 * α * (x - z) j * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)) ∧ ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), pd2 i (pd2 j v) x = (4 * α ^ 2 * (x - z) i * (x - z) j - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)

signature.name: esm_barrier_derivs
signature.statement: (z : E2) (α R : ℝ) (v : E2 → ℝ) (hv : ∀ x, v x = Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v ∧ (∀ x d : E2, fderiv ℝ v x d = -2 * α * (∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * d k) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)) ∧ (∀ (x : E2) (j : Fin 2), pd2 j v x = -2 * α * (x - z) j * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)) ∧ ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), pd2 i (pd2 j v) x = (4 * α ^ 2 * (x - z) i * (x - z) j - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hv' : v = fun y => Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2) := funext hv
  subst hv'
  have hinner : ∀ x d : E2, inner ℝ (x - z) d = ∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * d k := by
    intro x d
    simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => mul_comm _ _)
  have hE : ∀ x : E2, ∃ E' : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2)) E' x ∧
      ∀ d : E2, E' d = -2 * α * (∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * d k) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro x
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => y - z) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2) x :=
      (hasFDerivAt_id x).sub_const z
    refine ⟨_, (h1.norm_sq.const_mul (-α)).exp, fun d => ?_⟩
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, hinner]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
    push_cast
    ring
  have h2 : ∀ x d : E2, fderiv ℝ (fun y : E2 => Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) x d
      = -2 * α * (∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * d k) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro x d
    obtain ⟨E', hE1, hE2⟩ := hE x
    rw [(hE1.sub_const (Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2))).fderiv, hE2]
  have hsingle : ∀ (x : E2) (j : Fin 2), ∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * (e2 j) k = (x - z) j := by
    intro x j
    simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have h3 : ∀ (x : E2) (j : Fin 2),
      pd2 j (fun y : E2 => Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) x
        = -2 * α * (x - z) j * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro x j
    show fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 j) = _
    rw [h2, hsingle]
  refine ⟨?_, h2, h3, ?_⟩
  · exact ((contDiff_const.mul ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).norm_sq ℝ)).exp).sub
      contDiff_const
  · intro x i j
    have hfun : pd2 j (fun y : E2 => Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2))
        = fun y : E2 => -2 * α * ((y - z) j * Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2)) := by
      funext y
      rw [h3]
      ring
    rw [hfun]
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y : E2 => -2 * α * ((y - z) j * Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2))) x (e2 i) = _
    have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => (y - z) j) (PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) j) x := by
      have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun f : E2 => f.ofLp j) (PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) j) x :=
        PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 x j
      have h := h0.sub_const (z j)
      refine h.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
      simp
    obtain ⟨E', hE1, hE2⟩ := hE x
    have hP : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => -2 * α * ((y - z) j * Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2)))
        ((-2 * α) • ((x - z) j • E' + Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) •
          PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) j)) x :=
      (hc.mul hE1).const_mul (-2 * α)
    rw [hP.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      hE2, PiLp.proj_apply, hsingle]
    simp only [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp only [if_true]
      ring
    · simp only [hij, Ne.symm hij, if_false]
      ring

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ) (Γ : ℝ) (z : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W) (hAs : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) (hApsd : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) (hΓ : 0 ≤ Γ) (hstrict : ∀ x : E2, R / 2 < dist x z → dist x z < R → ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j u) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k u x - Γ * u x < 0) (hin : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → 0 ≤ u x) (hout : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R → 0 ≤ u x) : ∀ x : E2, R / 2 ≤ dist x z → dist x z ≤ R → 0 ≤ u x

signature.name: esm_annulus_min_principle
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ) (Γ : ℝ) (z : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W) (hAs : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) (hApsd : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) (hΓ : 0 ≤ Γ) (hstrict : ∀ x : E2, R / 2 < dist x z → dist x z < R → ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j u) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k u x - Γ * u x < 0) (hin : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → 0 ≤ u x) (hout : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R → 0 ≤ u x) : ∀ x : E2, R / 2 ≤ dist x z → dist x z ≤ R → 0 ≤ u x

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s2 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), IsLocalMin g a → ContinuousAt g a →
      0 ≤ deriv (deriv g) a := by
    intro g a hmin hc
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hd : deriv g a = 0 := hmin.deriv_eq_zero
    have hmax : IsLocalMax g a := isLocalMax_of_deriv_deriv_neg h hd hc
    have hconst : g =ᶠ[𝓝 a] fun _ => g a :=
      (hmin.and hmax).mono fun t ht => le_antisymm ht.2 ht.1
    have h0 : deriv g =ᶠ[𝓝 a] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      hconst.deriv.mono fun t ht => by rw [ht, deriv_const]
    have h00 : deriv (deriv g) a = 0 := by
      rw [h0.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    linarith
  
  have s4 : ∀ (M H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, M i j = M j i) →
      (∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * M i j * ξ j) →
      (∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * H i j * ξ j) →
      0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, M i j * H i j := by
    intro M H hMs hM hH
    have key : ∀ (N : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (a b : ℝ),
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (!₂[a, b] : E2) i * N i j * (!₂[a, b] : E2) j
          = a * N 0 0 * a + a * N 0 1 * b + (b * N 1 0 * a + b * N 1 1 * b) := by
      intro N a b
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have kH : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a * H 0 0 * a + a * H 0 1 * b + (b * H 1 0 * a + b * H 1 1 * b) := by
      intro a b
      have := hH !₂[a, b]
      rwa [key] at this
    have kM : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a * M 0 0 * a + a * M 0 1 * b + (b * M 1 0 * a + b * M 1 1 * b) := by
      intro a b
      have := hM !₂[a, b]
      rwa [key] at this
    have hM10 : M 1 0 = M 0 1 := hMs 1 0
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hp := kH 1 0
    have hs := kH 0 1
    have hd := kM 0 1
    have h4 := kH (-((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)) (H 0 0)
    have h5 := kM (H 0 0) ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)
    rw [hM10] at h5 ⊢
    have hp' : 0 ≤ H 0 0 := by linarith
    have hs' : 0 ≤ H 1 1 := by linarith
    have hd' : 0 ≤ M 1 1 := by linarith
    rcases hp'.lt_or_eq with hpos | hzero
    · have e4 : H 0 0 * (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2) ≥ 0 := by
        nlinarith
      have hdisc : 0 ≤ H 0 0 * H 1 1 - ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hpos hc
        linarith
      have e5 : H 0 0 * (M 0 0 * H 0 0 + M 0 1 * H 0 1 + (M 0 1 * H 1 0 + M 1 1 * H 1 1))
          = (H 0 0 * M 0 0 * H 0 0 + H 0 0 * M 0 1 * ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)
              + (((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) * M 0 1 * H 0 0
                + ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) * M 1 1 * ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)))
            + M 1 1 * (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2) := by
        ring
      have hprod : 0 ≤ H 0 0 * (M 0 0 * H 0 0 + M 0 1 * H 0 1 + (M 0 1 * H 1 0 + M 1 1 * H 1 1)) := by
        rw [e5]
        have := mul_nonneg hd' hdisc
        linarith
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hpos hc
      linarith
    · have hp0 : H 0 0 = 0 := hzero.symm
      have h6 := kH (-(1 + H 1 1)) ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)
      rw [hp0] at h6
      have e6 : -(1 + H 1 1) * 0 * -(1 + H 1 1) + -(1 + H 1 1) * H 0 1 * ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)
          + ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2 * H 1 0 * -(1 + H 1 1)
            + (H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2 * H 1 1 * ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2))
          = -(((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 * (2 + H 1 1)) := by
        ring
      rw [e6] at h6
      have hq2 : ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 * (2 + H 1 1) ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have hq0 : ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have := mul_pos hc (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 + H 1 1 by linarith)
        linarith
      have hq : H 0 1 + H 1 0 = 0 := by
        have : (H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2 = 0 := by
          have := sq_nonneg ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)
          exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp (le_antisymm hq0 this)
        linarith
      have e7 : M 0 0 * H 0 0 + M 0 1 * H 0 1 + (M 0 1 * H 1 0 + M 1 1 * H 1 1)
          = M 0 0 * H 0 0 + M 0 1 * (H 0 1 + H 1 0) + M 1 1 * H 1 1 := by ring
      rw [e7, hq, hp0]
      have := mul_nonneg hd' hs'
      linarith
  
  have s3 : ∀ (x ξ : E2), x ∈ W → ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => u (x + t • ξ)) 0 ∧
      deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => u (x + t • ξ))) 0
        = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * pd2 i (pd2 j u) x * ξ j := by
    intro x ξ hx
    have hp : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) ξ t := by
      intro t
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const ξ).const_add x
    have hpc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
    have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ u y := fun y hy =>
      (hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)
    have hx0 : x + (0 : ℝ) • ξ = x := by simp
    have h0T : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) ⁻¹' W := by
      show x + (0 : ℝ) • ξ ∈ W
      rw [hx0]; exact hx
    have hT : (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) ⁻¹' W ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℝ) :=
      (hW.preimage hpc).mem_nhds h0T
    have hlin : ∀ L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ, L ξ = ξ 0 * L (e2 0) + ξ 1 * L (e2 1) := by
      intro L
      have hξ : ξ = ξ 0 • e2 0 + ξ 1 • e2 1 := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [e2]
      conv_lhs => rw [hξ]
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hg1 : ∀ t ∈ (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) ⁻¹' W,
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => u (x + t • ξ)) (fderiv ℝ u (x + t • ξ) ξ) t := by
      intro t ht
      exact (hdiff _ ht).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hp t)
    have hev : deriv (fun t : ℝ => u (x + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun t => ξ 0 * pd2 0 u (x + t • ξ) + ξ 1 * pd2 1 u (x + t • ξ) := by
      filter_upwards [hT] with t ht
      rw [(hg1 t ht).deriv, hlin]
      rfl
    have hpd : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 j u) x := by
      intro j
      have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (e2 j)) W :=
        (hu.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      exact (hc.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
    have hφ : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ξ 0 * pd2 0 u y + ξ 1 * pd2 1 u y)
        (ξ 0 • fderiv ℝ (pd2 0 u) x + ξ 1 • fderiv ℝ (pd2 1 u) x) (x + (0 : ℝ) • ξ) := by
      rw [hx0]
      exact ((hpd 0).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (ξ 0)).add ((hpd 1).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (ξ 1))
    have hcomp : HasDerivAt
        (fun t : ℝ => ξ 0 * pd2 0 u (x + t • ξ) + ξ 1 * pd2 1 u (x + t • ξ))
        ((ξ 0 • fderiv ℝ (pd2 0 u) x + ξ 1 • fderiv ℝ (pd2 1 u) x) ξ) 0 := by
      have := hφ.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) (hp 0)
      exact this
    have hpd2 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (pd2 j u) x (e2 i) = pd2 i (pd2 j u) x :=
      fun _ _ => rfl
    refine ⟨(hg1 0 h0T).continuousAt, ?_⟩
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, hcomp.deriv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hlin (fderiv ℝ (pd2 0 u) x), hlin (fderiv ℝ (pd2 1 u) x)]
    simp only [hpd2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  intro x₀ hx₀1 hx₀2
  have hKc : IsCompact ({x : E2 | R / 2 ≤ dist x z} ∩ {x | dist x z ≤ R}) := by
    refine (isCompact_closedBall z R).of_isClosed_subset ?_ ?_
    · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)).inter
        (isClosed_le (continuous_id.dist continuous_const) continuous_const)
    · intro x hx
      exact Metric.mem_closedBall.2 hx.2
  have hKW : {x : E2 | R / 2 ≤ dist x z} ∩ {x | dist x z ≤ R} ⊆ W :=
    fun x hx => hball (Metric.mem_closedBall.2 hx.2)
  have hx₀K : x₀ ∈ {x : E2 | R / 2 ≤ dist x z} ∩ {x | dist x z ≤ R} := ⟨hx₀1, hx₀2⟩
  obtain ⟨xs, hxsK, hxsmin⟩ := hKc.exists_isMinOn ⟨x₀, hx₀K⟩ (hu.continuousOn.mono hKW)
  have hmn := isMinOn_iff.mp hxsmin
  have hle : u xs ≤ u x₀ := hmn x₀ hx₀K
  by_contra hneg0
  push_neg at hneg0
  have hneg : u xs < 0 := lt_of_le_of_lt hle hneg0
  have h1 : R / 2 < dist xs z := lt_of_le_of_ne hxsK.1 (fun h => by
    have := hin xs h.symm
    linarith)
  have h2 : dist xs z < R := lt_of_le_of_ne hxsK.2 (fun h => by
    have := hout xs h
    linarith)
  have hxsW : xs ∈ W := hKW hxsK
  have hO : IsOpen ({x : E2 | R / 2 < dist x z} ∩ {x | dist x z < R}) :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_id.dist continuous_const) continuous_const)
  have hmin : IsLocalMin u xs := by
    refine Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds ⟨h1, h2⟩) ?_
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hy1 hy2
    exact hmn y ⟨le_of_lt hy1, le_of_lt hy2⟩
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ u xs = 0 := hmin.fderiv_eq_zero
  have hB : ∑ k : Fin 2, B xs k * pd2 k u xs = 0 := by
    simp [pd2, hfd]
  have hH : ∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      ξ i * (Matrix.of fun i j => pd2 i (pd2 j u) xs) i j * ξ j := by
    intro ξ
    obtain ⟨hc, hQ⟩ := s3 xs ξ hxsW
    have hloc : IsLocalMin (fun t : ℝ => u (xs + t • ξ)) 0 := by
      have hcont : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => xs + t • ξ) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 xs) := by
        have := ((continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const) :
          Continuous (fun t : ℝ => xs + t • ξ))).tendsto 0
        simpa using this
      have h0 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 xs, u xs ≤ u y := hmin
      have h1' := hcont.eventually h0
      have hz : u (xs + (0 : ℝ) • ξ) = u xs := by simp
      show ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), u (xs + (0 : ℝ) • ξ) ≤ u (xs + t • ξ)
      rw [hz]
      exact h1'
    have := s2 _ 0 hloc hc
    rw [hQ] at this
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
    exact this
  have hT := s4 (A xs) (Matrix.of fun i j => pd2 i (pd2 j u) xs) (hAs xs hxsW)
    (hApsd xs hxsW) hH
  simp only [Matrix.of_apply] at hT
  have hst := hstrict xs h1 h2
  rw [hB] at hst
  have : Γ * u xs ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hΓ hneg.le
  linarith
