informal_problem.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (k : Fin P.n) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hc : HasCompactSupport ζ) (hs : tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W k) : ∃ Z : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Z (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧ (∀ q, q ∉ P.O k → Z q = 0) ∧ (∀ q ∈ P.O k, Z q = ζ (P.proj k q)) ∧ ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∉ P.param k '' tsupport ζ → ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Z (P.param j x') = 0

signature.name: eig_lift_smooth
signature.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (k : Fin P.n) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hc : HasCompactSupport ζ) (hs : tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W k) : ∃ Z : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Z (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧ (∀ q, q ∉ P.O k → Z q = 0) ∧ (∀ q ∈ P.O k, Z q = ζ (P.proj k q)) ∧ ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∉ P.param k '' tsupport ζ → ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Z (P.param j x') = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hP1 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ P.O j ∧ P.param j x ∈ S := by
    intro j x hx
    have hmem : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at hmem
    exact hmem
  set F : Set X := P.param k '' tsupport ζ with hFdef
  have hFO : F ⊆ P.O k := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (hP1 k y (hs hy)).1
  have hFc : IsClosed F :=
    (hc.isCompact.image_of_continuousOn ((P.param_cont k).mono hs)).isClosed
  set Z : X → ℝ := fun q => if q ∈ P.O k then ζ (P.proj k q) else 0 with hZdef
  have hZ0 : ∀ q, q ∉ P.O k → Z q = 0 := fun q hq => by simp only [hZdef, if_neg hq]
  have hZf : ∀ q ∈ P.O k, Z q = ζ (P.proj k q) := fun q hq => by simp only [hZdef, if_pos hq]
  
  have hstar : ∀ q ∈ S, q ∉ F → Z q = 0 := by
    intro q hqS hqF
    by_cases hqO : q ∈ P.O k
    · have hq : q ∈ P.O k ∩ S := ⟨hqO, hqS⟩
      rw [← P.image_eq k] at hq
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyq⟩ := hq
      rw [hZf q hqO, ← hyq, P.proj_param k y hy]
      by_contra hne
      exact hqF ⟨y, subset_tsupport ζ (Function.mem_support.mpr hne), hyq⟩
    · exact hZ0 q hqO
  
  have hNopen : ∀ j, IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' Fᶜ) := fun j =>
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) hFc.isOpen_compl
  have hNzero : ∀ j, ∀ x' ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' Fᶜ, Z (P.param j x') = 0 := by
    intro j x' hx'
    exact hstar _ (hP1 j x' hx'.1).2 hx'.2
  refine ⟨Z, ?_, hZ0, hZf, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    refine contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn (fun x hx => ?_)
    by_cases hxO : P.param j x ∈ P.O k
    · refine ⟨P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
        (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k), ⟨hx, hxO⟩, ?_⟩
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x' => ζ (P.proj k (P.param j x')))
          (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := hζ.comp_contDiffOn (P.trans_smooth j k)
      refine (h1.mono Set.inter_subset_right).congr ?_
      intro y hy
      exact hZf _ hy.2.2
    · have hxF : P.param j x ∉ F := fun h => hxO (hFO h)
      refine ⟨P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' Fᶜ, hNopen j, ⟨hx, hxF⟩, ?_⟩
      refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr ?_
      intro y hy
      exact hNzero j y hy.2
  · intro j x hx hxF
    exact Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hNopen j).mem_nhds ⟨hx, hxF⟩) (hNzero j)

informal_problem.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (hS : IsCompact S) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (hlift : ∀ (k : Fin P.n) (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W k → ∃ Z : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Z (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧ (∀ q, q ∉ P.O k → Z q = 0) ∧ (∀ q ∈ P.O k, Z q = ζ (P.proj k q)) ∧ ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∉ P.param k '' tsupport ζ → ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Z (P.param j x') = 0) : ∃ (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (K : Fin P.n → Set E2), (∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q) ∧ (∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k)) ∧ (∀ q ∈ S, ∑ j, ρ j q = 1) ∧ (∀ j, IsCompact (K j) ∧ K j ⊆ P.W j) ∧ (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ K j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0) ∧ (∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)

signature.name: eig_partition_unity
signature.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (hS : IsCompact S) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (hlift : ∀ (k : Fin P.n) (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W k → ∃ Z : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Z (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧ (∀ q, q ∉ P.O k → Z q = 0) ∧ (∀ q ∈ P.O k, Z q = ζ (P.proj k q)) ∧ ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∉ P.param k '' tsupport ζ → ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Z (P.param j x') = 0) : ∃ (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (K : Fin P.n → Set E2), (∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q) ∧ (∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k)) ∧ (∀ q ∈ S, ∑ j, ρ j q = 1) ∧ (∀ j, IsCompact (K j) ∧ K j ⊆ P.W j) ∧ (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ K j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0) ∧ (∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hF1 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ P.O j ∧ P.param j x ∈ S := by
    intro j x hx
    have hmem : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at hmem
    exact hmem
  
  have hpt : ∀ q : S, ∃ (j : Fin P.n) (f : E2 → ℝ), (q : X) ∈ P.O j ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ f ∧
      HasCompactSupport f ∧ tsupport f ⊆ P.W j ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) ∧ f (P.proj j q) = 1 := by
    rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hq)
    have hq' : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hj, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxq⟩ := hq'
    obtain ⟨f, hfs, hfc, hfd, hfr, hf1⟩ :=
      exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) ((P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx)
    refine ⟨j, f, hj, hfd, hfc, hfs, fun y => (hfr ⟨y, rfl⟩).1, ?_⟩
    show f (P.proj j q) = 1
    rw [← hxq, P.proj_param j x hx]
    exact hf1
  choose J F hJO hFs hFc hFW hFnn hF1' using hpt
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : S → Set X, ∀ q, U q = P.O (J q) ∩ P.proj (J q) ⁻¹' {y | 0 < F q y} :=
    ⟨fun q => P.O (J q) ∩ P.proj (J q) ⁻¹' {y | 0 < F q y}, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hUo : ∀ q, IsOpen (U q) := by
    intro q
    rw [hU]
    exact (P.proj_cont (J q)).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open (J q))
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (hFs q).continuous)
  have hcov : S ⊆ ⋃ q, U q := by
    intro q hq
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [hU]
    refine ⟨hJO ⟨q, hq⟩, ?_⟩
    show 0 < F ⟨q, hq⟩ (P.proj (J ⟨q, hq⟩) q)
    rw [hF1' ⟨q, hq⟩]
    exact one_pos
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hS.elim_finite_subcover U hUo hcov
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ : ∃ ζ : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, ∀ j y,
      ζ j y = ∑ q ∈ t.filter (fun q => J q = j), F q y :=
    ⟨fun j y => ∑ q ∈ t.filter (fun q => J q = j), F q y, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hζfun : ∀ j, ζ j = fun y => ∑ q ∈ t.filter (fun q => J q = j), F q y :=
    fun j => funext (hζ j)
  have hζs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ζ j) := by
    intro j
    rw [hζfun j]
    exact ContDiff.sum (fun q _ => hFs q)
  have hζT : ∀ j, tsupport (ζ j) ⊆ ⋃ q ∈ t.filter (fun q => J q = j), tsupport (F q) := by
    intro j
    refine closure_minimal ?_ (isClosed_biUnion_finset (fun q _ => isClosed_tsupport _))
    intro y hy
    rw [Function.mem_support, hζ] at hy
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqy⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hy
    exact Set.mem_biUnion hq (subset_tsupport _ hqy)
  have hζW : ∀ j, tsupport (ζ j) ⊆ P.W j := by
    intro j
    refine (hζT j).trans ?_
    intro y hy
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hy
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hyq⟩ := hy
    have hJ : J q = j := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hq).2
    rw [← hJ]
    exact hFW q hyq
  have hζc : ∀ j, HasCompactSupport (ζ j) := by
    intro j
    exact ((t.filter (fun q => J q = j)).isCompact_biUnion (fun q _ => hFc q)).of_isClosed_subset
      (isClosed_tsupport _) (hζT j)
  have hζnn : ∀ j x, 0 ≤ ζ j x := by
    intro j x
    rw [hζ]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun q _ => hFnn q x)
  have hζcov : ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ j, q ∈ P.O j ∧ 0 < ζ j (P.proj j q) := by
    intro q hq
    have hq2 := ht hq
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hq2
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀t, hqU⟩ := hq2
    rw [hU] at hqU
    refine ⟨J q₀, hqU.1, ?_⟩
    have hmem : q₀ ∈ t.filter (fun q => J q = J q₀) := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hq₀t, rfl⟩
    have hlt : 0 < F q₀ (P.proj (J q₀) q) := hqU.2
    calc (0 : ℝ) < F q₀ (P.proj (J q₀) q) := hlt
      _ ≤ ∑ q' ∈ t.filter (fun q => J q = J q₀), F q' (P.proj (J q₀) q) :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun q' => F q' (P.proj (J q₀) q))
            (fun q' _ => hFnn q' _) hmem
      _ = ζ (J q₀) (P.proj (J q₀) q) := (hζ _ _).symm
  
  have hL := fun j => hlift j (ζ j) (hζs j) (hζc j) (hζW j)
  choose Z hZs hZ0 hZf _ using hL
  have hZnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ Z j q := by
    intro j q
    by_cases hq : q ∈ P.O j
    · rw [hZf j q hq]
      exact hζnn _ _
    · rw [hZ0 j q hq]
  have hσpos : ∀ q ∈ S, 0 < ∑ i, Z i q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨j, hjO, hlt⟩ := hζcov q hq
    have h1 : 0 < Z j q := by
      rw [hZf j q hjO]
      exact hlt
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => Z i q)
      (fun i _ => hZnn i q) (Finset.mem_univ j))
  refine ⟨fun j q => Z j q / ∑ i, Z i q, fun j => tsupport (ζ j), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j q
    exact div_nonneg (hZnn j q) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hZnn i q))
  · intro j k
    refine (hZs j k).div (ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => hZs i k)) ?_
    intro x hx
    exact (hσpos _ (hF1 k x hx).2).ne'
  · intro q hq
    rw [← Finset.sum_div]
    exact div_self (hσpos q hq).ne'
  · intro j
    exact ⟨hζc j, hζW j⟩
  · intro j x hx hxK
    show Z j (P.param j x) / _ = 0
    rw [hZf j _ (hF1 j x hx).1, P.proj_param j x hx, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hxK,
      zero_div]
  · intro j q hq
    show Z j q / _ = 0
    rw [hZ0 j q hq, zero_div]

informal_problem.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (j k : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ) : (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) = (∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) ∧ (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j) MeasureTheory.volume)

signature.name: eig_chart_cov
signature.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (j k : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ) : (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) = (∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) ∧ (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j) MeasureTheory.volume)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hF : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ P.W i, P.param i x ∈ P.O i ∩ S := fun i x hx => by
    rw [← P.image_eq i]; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  
  have hG : ∀ i, ∀ q ∈ P.O i ∩ S, P.proj i q ∈ P.W i ∧ P.param i (P.proj i q) = q := by
    intro i q hq
    rw [← P.image_eq i] at hq
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hq
    rw [P.proj_param i y hy]
    exact ⟨hy, rfl⟩
  have hAo : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)
  have hAm : MeasurableSet (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := hAo.measurableSet
  have hK : ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∧
      P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) = P.param j x :=
    fun x hx => hG k _ ⟨hx.2, (hF j x hx.1).2⟩
  
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := by
    intro x hx x' hx' hxx
    have hxx' : P.proj k (P.param j x) = P.proj k (P.param j x') := hxx
    have h1 : P.param j x = P.param j x' := by
      rw [← (hK x hx).2, ← (hK x' hx').2, hxx']
    rw [← P.proj_param j x hx.1, ← P.proj_param j x' hx'.1, h1]
  
  have himg : (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) =
      P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(hK x hx).1, ?_⟩
      show P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) ∈ P.O j
      rw [(hK x hx).2]
      exact (hF j x hx.1).1
    · rintro ⟨hy, hyO⟩
      obtain ⟨hxW, hxq⟩ := hG j (P.param k y) ⟨hyO, (hF k y hy).2⟩
      refine ⟨P.proj j (P.param k y), ⟨hxW, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · show P.param j (P.proj j (P.param k y)) ∈ P.O k
        rw [hxq]
        exact (hF k y hy).1
      · show P.proj k (P.param j (P.proj j (P.param k y))) = y
        rw [hxq, P.proj_param k y hy]
  
  have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      HasFDerivWithinAt (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x))
        (fderiv ℝ (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) x) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x))
        (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
      (P.trans_smooth j k).differentiableOn (by simp)
    exact ((hd x hx).differentiableAt (hAo.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
  
  have hjac : ∀ (f : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) (H H' : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 2, H' a b = ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, f (e2 a) c * H c d * f (e2 b) d) →
      Real.sqrt H'.det = |f.det| * Real.sqrt H.det := by
    intro f H H' hc
    have hdet : f.det = f (e2 0) 0 * f (e2 1) 1 - f (e2 1) 0 * f (e2 0) 1 := by
      change LinearMap.det (f : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E2) = _
      rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis, Matrix.det_fin_two]
      simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, e2]
    have hH' : H'.det = f.det ^ 2 * H.det := by
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, Matrix.det_fin_two, hc 0 0, hc 0 1, hc 1 0, hc 1 1, hdet]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    rw [hH', Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  have hpt : Set.EqOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
      (fun x => |(fderiv ℝ (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) x).det| •
        (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
      (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hjac _ _ _ (P.h_compat j k x hx)]
    ring
  constructor
  · have h1 := MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hAm hdiff hinj
      (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det)
    rw [himg] at h1
    exact (setIntegral_congr_fun hAm hpt).trans h1.symm
  · have h2 := MeasureTheory.integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hAm
      hdiff hinj (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det)
    rw [himg] at h2
    exact (integrableOn_congr_fun hpt hAm).trans h2.symm

informal_problem.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (u v : X → ℝ) (hu : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hv : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (j k : Fin P.n) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) : eigGam P u v j x = eigGam P u v k (P.proj k (P.param j x))

signature.name: eig_grad_pair_compat
signature.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (u v : X → ℝ) (hu : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hv : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (j k : Fin P.n) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) : eigGam P u v j x = eigGam P u v k (P.proj k (P.param j x))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hD : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)
  
  have hP3 : ∀ x' ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      P.proj k (P.param j x') ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x')) = P.param j x' := by
    intro x' hx'
    have h1 : P.param j x' ∈ P.O j ∩ S := by
      rw [← P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨x', hx'.1, rfl⟩
    have h2 : P.param j x' ∈ P.param k '' P.W k := by
      rw [P.image_eq k]; exact ⟨hx'.2, h1.2⟩
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hyeq⟩ := h2
    rw [← hyeq, P.proj_param k y' hy']
    exact ⟨hy', rfl⟩
  have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x :=
    ((P.trans_smooth j k).contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hyW : P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k := (hP3 x hx).1
  
  have chain : ∀ (w : X → ℝ), (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
      ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (fun x' => w (P.param j x')) x =
        ∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) c *
          pd2 c (fun y => w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) := by
    intro w hw b
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) :=
      ((hw k).contDiffAt ((P.W_open k).mem_nhds hyW)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hev : (fun x' => w (P.param j x')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        ((fun y => w (P.param k y)) ∘ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x'))) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hD.mem_nhds hx)
        (fun x' hx' => by simp only [Function.comp, (hP3 x' hx').2])
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_comp x hfd hτd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    have hw' : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) =
        ∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) c • e2 c := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, Fin.sum_univ_two, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hw']
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  set J : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun c a => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 a) c with hJ
  have hKJ : P.h j x = J.transpose * P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * J := by
    ext a b
    rw [P.h_compat j k x hx a b]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hdetK : 0 < (P.h j x).det := (P.h_posDef j x hx.1).det_pos
  have hJdet : IsUnit J.det := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h0
    have : (P.h j x).det = 0 := by
      rw [hKJ, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, h0]; simp
    linarith
  have hJTdet : IsUnit J.transpose.det := by rwa [Matrix.det_transpose]
  have hinv : J * (P.h j x)⁻¹ * J.transpose = (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ := by
    rw [hKJ, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, ← Matrix.mul_assoc J J⁻¹,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv J hJdet, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul J.transpose hJTdet, Matrix.mul_one]
  have e : ∀ d c : Fin 2, (J * (P.h j x)⁻¹ * J.transpose) d c =
      (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ d c := fun d c => by rw [hinv]
  have e00 := e 0 0
  have e01 := e 0 1
  have e10 := e 1 0
  have e11 := e 1 1
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply,
    Fin.sum_univ_two] at e00 e01 e10 e11
  simp only [eigGam, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  rw [chain u hu 0, chain u hu 1, chain v hv 0, chain v hv 1]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  linear_combination
    (pd2 0 (fun y => u (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
      pd2 0 (fun y => v (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e00 +
    (pd2 1 (fun y => u (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
      pd2 0 (fun y => v (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e01 +
    (pd2 0 (fun y => u (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
      pd2 1 (fun y => v (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e10 +
    (pd2 1 (fun y => u (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
      pd2 1 (fun y => v (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e11

informal_problem.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (K : Fin P.n → Set E2) (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q) (hρc : ∀ j k, ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k)) (hρ1 : ∀ q ∈ S, ∑ j, ρ j q = 1) (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (K j) ∧ K j ⊆ P.W j) (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ K j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0) (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0) (k : Fin P.n) (hcov : ∀ (j : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ), (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) = (∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) ∧ (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j) MeasureTheory.volume)) (F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ) (hF : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) (hcompat : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, F j x = F k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) : (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W k → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∉ P.param k '' L → F j x = 0) → eigWInt P ρ F = ∫ x in P.W k, F k x * Real.sqrt (P.h k x).det) ∧ ((∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ F j x) → ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W k → ∫ x in L, F k x * Real.sqrt (P.h k x).det ≤ eigWInt P ρ F)

signature.name: eig_integral_localize
signature.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (K : Fin P.n → Set E2) (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q) (hρc : ∀ j k, ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k)) (hρ1 : ∀ q ∈ S, ∑ j, ρ j q = 1) (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (K j) ∧ K j ⊆ P.W j) (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ K j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0) (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0) (k : Fin P.n) (hcov : ∀ (j : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ), (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) = (∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) ∧ (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j) MeasureTheory.volume)) (F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ) (hF : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) (hcompat : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, F j x = F k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) : (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W k → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∉ P.param k '' L → F j x = 0) → eigWInt P ρ F = ∫ x in P.W k, F k x * Real.sqrt (P.h k x).det) ∧ ((∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ F j x) → ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W k → ∫ x in L, F k x * Real.sqrt (P.h k x).det ≤ eigWInt P ρ F)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hP1 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ P.O j ∧ P.param j x ∈ S := by
    intro j x hx
    have hmem : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at hmem
    exact hmem
  
  have hP3 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) = P.param j x := by
    intro j x hx
    have hq : P.param j x ∈ P.O k ∩ S := ⟨hx.2, (hP1 j x hx.1).2⟩
    rw [← P.image_eq k] at hq
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hq
    rw [← hyx, P.proj_param k y hy]
    exact ⟨hy, rfl⟩
  
  have s1 : ∀ (W L : Set E2), IsOpen W → IsCompact L → L ⊆ W →
      ∀ (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ),
        (∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) →
      ∀ (r G : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn r W → ContinuousOn G W →
        (∀ x ∈ W, x ∉ L → r x * G x = 0) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => r x * G x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) W
        MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro W L hW hL hLW h hh r G hr hG h0
    have hdet : ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x).det) W := by
      have e : (fun x => (h x).det) = fun x => h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 := by
        funext x
        exact Matrix.det_fin_two (h x)
      rw [e]
      exact ((hh 0 0).continuousOn.mul (hh 1 1).continuousOn).sub
        ((hh 0 1).continuousOn.mul (hh 1 0).continuousOn)
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun x => r x * G x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) W :=
      (hr.mul hG).mul hdet.sqrt
    have hiL : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => r x * G x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) L
        MeasureTheory.volume :=
      (hc.mono hLW).integrableOn_compact hL
    refine hiL.of_forall_diff_eq_zero hW.measurableSet ?_
    intro x hx
    show r x * G x * Real.sqrt (h x).det = 0
    rw [h0 x hx.1 hx.2, zero_mul]
  
  have hAo : ∀ j, IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := fun j =>
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)
  
  have s2 : ∀ j,
      (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
          ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) =
        (∫ y in P.W k, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) ∧
      (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
          (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k)
          MeasureTheory.volume) := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := hcov j (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y)
    have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
        (fun x => ρ j (P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * F k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
        (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := by
      intro x hx
      show ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det =
        ρ j (P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * F k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det
      rw [(hP3 j x hx).2, hcompat j x hx]
    have hzero : ∀ y ∈ P.W k \ (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j),
        ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hy' : P.param k y ∉ P.O j := fun h => hy.2 ⟨hy.1, h⟩
      rw [hρO j _ hy', zero_mul, zero_mul]
    refine ⟨?_, fun hi => ?_⟩
    · calc (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
            ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
          = ∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
              ρ j (P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * F k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
                Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det :=
            MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (hAo j).measurableSet hEq
        _ = ∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j,
              ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det := hc1
        _ = ∫ y in P.W k, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det :=
            (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero
              (P.W_open k).measurableSet Set.inter_subset_left hzero).symm
    · have hi' : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun x => ρ j (P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * F k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
            Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) MeasureTheory.volume :=
        hi.congr_fun hEq (hAo j).measurableSet
      have h1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det)
          (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j) MeasureTheory.volume := hc2.mp hi'
      exact h1.of_forall_diff_eq_zero (P.W_open k).measurableSet hzero
  
  have hP7 : ∀ y ∈ P.W k,
      (∑ j, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) =
        F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det := by
    intro y hy
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, hρ1 _ (hP1 k y hy).2, one_mul]
  refine ⟨fun L hL hLW hL0 => ?_, fun hF0 L hL hLW => ?_⟩
  · 
    have hPL : ∀ y ∈ P.W k, y ∉ L → P.param k y ∉ P.param k '' L := by
      rintro y hy hyL ⟨y', hy', heq⟩
      apply hyL
      have e := congrArg (P.proj k) heq
      rw [P.proj_param k y' (hLW hy'), P.proj_param k y hy] at e
      rw [← e]
      exact hy'
    have hgi : ∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k)
        MeasureTheory.volume := by
      intro j
      exact s1 (P.W k) L (P.W_open k) hL hLW (P.h k) (P.h_smooth k)
        (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) (F k) (hρc j k) (hF k)
        (fun y hy hyL => by
          show ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y = 0
          rw [hL0 k y hy (hPL y hy hyL), mul_zero])
    have hWj : ∀ j, (∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) =
        ∫ y in P.W k, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det := by
      intro j
      rw [← (s2 j).1]
      apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero
        (P.W_open j).measurableSet Set.inter_subset_left
      intro x hx
      have hxO : P.param j x ∉ P.O k := fun h => hx.2 ⟨hx.1, h⟩
      have hxL : P.param j x ∉ P.param k '' L := by
        rintro ⟨y', hy', heq⟩
        apply hxO
        rw [← heq]
        exact (hP1 k y' (hLW hy')).1
      rw [hL0 j x hx.1 hxL, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    have hswap := MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (P.W k))
      Finset.univ (fun j _ => hgi j)
    calc eigWInt P ρ F
        = ∑ j, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := rfl
      _ = ∑ j, ∫ y in P.W k, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hWj j)
      _ = ∫ y in P.W k, ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det :=
          hswap.symm
      _ = ∫ x in P.W k, F k x * Real.sqrt (P.h k x).det :=
          MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (P.W_open k).measurableSet hP7
  · 
    have hfnn : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det :=
      fun j x hx => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hρnn _ _) (hF0 j x hx)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hgnn : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ P.W k, 0 ≤ ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det :=
      fun j y hy => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hρnn _ _) (hF0 k y hy)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hfi : ∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j)
        MeasureTheory.volume := by
      intro j
      exact s1 (P.W j) (K j) (P.W_open j) (hK j).1 (hK j).2 (P.h j) (P.h_smooth j)
        (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x)) (F j) (hρc j j) (hF j)
        (fun x hx hxK => by
          show ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x = 0
          rw [hρK j x hx hxK, zero_mul])
    have hgi : ∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k)
        MeasureTheory.volume := fun j => (s2 j).2 ((hfi j).mono_set Set.inter_subset_left)
    have hle : ∀ j,
        (∫ y in L, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) ≤
          ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
      intro j
      calc (∫ y in L, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det)
          ≤ ∫ y in P.W k, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det :=
            MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set (hgi j)
              (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (P.W_open k).measurableSet (hgnn j))
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x (hx : x ∈ L) => hLW hx))
        _ = ∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
              ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := (s2 j).1.symm
        _ ≤ ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det :=
            MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set (hfi j)
              (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (P.W_open j).measurableSet (hfnn j))
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall
                (fun x (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) => hx.1))
    have hswap := MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict L)
      Finset.univ (fun j _ => (hgi j).mono_set hLW)
    calc (∫ x in L, F k x * Real.sqrt (P.h k x).det)
        = ∫ y in L, ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det :=
          MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hL.measurableSet
            (fun y hy => (hP7 y (hLW hy)).symm)
      _ = ∑ j, ∫ y in L, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det := hswap
      _ ≤ ∑ j, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hle j)
      _ = eigWInt P ρ F := rfl

informal_problem.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (K : Fin P.n → Set E2) (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q) (hρc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (K j) ∧ K j ⊆ P.W j) (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ K j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0) : (∀ (F G H : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ), (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ContinuousOn (G j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ContinuousOn (H j) (P.W j)) → ∀ a b c : ℝ, eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => a * F j x + b * G j x + c * H j x) = a * eigWInt P ρ F + b * eigWInt P ρ G + c * eigWInt P ρ H) ∧ (∀ (F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ) (a : ℝ), eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => a * F j x) = a * eigWInt P ρ F) ∧ (∀ F G : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, F j x = G j x) → eigWInt P ρ F = eigWInt P ρ G) ∧ (∀ F G : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ContinuousOn (G j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K j, F j x ≤ G j x) → eigWInt P ρ F ≤ eigWInt P ρ G) ∧ (∀ F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K j, 0 ≤ F j x) → 0 ≤ eigWInt P ρ F) ∧ (∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K j, 0 ≤ F j x) → eigWInt P ρ F ≤ A * ∑ j, ∫ x in K j, F j x) ∧ (∀ F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∃ j, ∃ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < ρ j (P.param j x)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < F j x) → 0 < eigWInt P ρ F)

signature.name: eig_wint_facts
signature.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (K : Fin P.n → Set E2) (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q) (hρc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (K j) ∧ K j ⊆ P.W j) (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ K j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0) : (∀ (F G H : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ), (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ContinuousOn (G j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ContinuousOn (H j) (P.W j)) → ∀ a b c : ℝ, eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => a * F j x + b * G j x + c * H j x) = a * eigWInt P ρ F + b * eigWInt P ρ G + c * eigWInt P ρ H) ∧ (∀ (F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ) (a : ℝ), eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => a * F j x) = a * eigWInt P ρ F) ∧ (∀ F G : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, F j x = G j x) → eigWInt P ρ F = eigWInt P ρ G) ∧ (∀ F G : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ContinuousOn (G j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K j, F j x ≤ G j x) → eigWInt P ρ F ≤ eigWInt P ρ G) ∧ (∀ F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K j, 0 ≤ F j x) → 0 ≤ eigWInt P ρ F) ∧ (∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K j, 0 ≤ F j x) → eigWInt P ρ F ≤ A * ∑ j, ∫ x in K j, F j x) ∧ (∀ F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∃ j, ∃ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < ρ j (P.param j x)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < F j x) → 0 < eigWInt P ρ F)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hd : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j) := by
    intro j
    have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => P.h j x a b) (P.W j) :=
      fun a b => (P.h_smooth j a b).continuousOn
    have e : (fun x => (P.h j x).det) =
        fun x => P.h j x 0 0 * P.h j x 1 1 - P.h j x 0 1 * P.h j x 1 0 := by
      funext x
      exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
    have hdet : ContinuousOn (fun x => (P.h j x).det) (P.W j) := by
      rw [e]
      exact ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).sub ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0))
    exact hdet.sqrt
  have hdpos : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det :=
    fun j x hx => Real.sqrt_pos.2 (P.h_posDef j x hx).det_pos
  have hvan : ∀ j (F : E2 → ℝ), ∀ x ∈ P.W j \ K j,
      ρ j (P.param j x) * F x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det = 0 := by
    intro j F x hx
    rw [hρK j x hx.1 hx.2]
    ring
  have hint : ∀ j (F : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn F (P.W j) →
      Integrable (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) * F x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
        (volume.restrict (P.W j)) := by
    intro j F hF
    have hcK : ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) * F x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (K j) :=
      (((hρc j).mul hF).mul (hd j)).mono (hK j).2
    exact (hcK.integrableOn_compact (hK j).1).of_forall_diff_eq_zero
      (P.W_open j).measurableSet (hvan j F)
  have hres : ∀ j (F : E2 → ℝ),
      ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det
        = ∫ x in K j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det :=
    fun j F => setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (P.W_open j).measurableSet
      (hK j).2 (hvan j F)
  have hpt : ∀ j (F : E2 → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ K j, 0 ≤ F x) →
      ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ ρ j (P.param j x) * F x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
    intro j F hF x hx
    by_cases hxK : x ∈ K j
    · exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hρnn _ _) (hF x hxK)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    · rw [hρK j x hx hxK]
      simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro F G H hF hG hH a b c
    have key : ∀ j, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * (a * F j x + b * G j x + c * H j x) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det
        = a * (∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
          + b * (∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * G j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
          + c * (∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * H j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) := by
      intro j
      have e : (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) * (a * F j x + b * G j x + c * H j x) *
            Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
          = fun x => (a * (ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
            + b * (ρ j (P.param j x) * G j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det))
            + c * (ρ j (P.param j x) * H j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) := by
        funext x
        ring
      have iF := (hint j _ (hF j)).const_mul a
      have iG := (hint j _ (hG j)).const_mul b
      have iH := (hint j _ (hH j)).const_mul c
      rw [e, integral_add ?_ iH, integral_add iF iG,
        integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
      exact iF.add iG
    simp only [eigWInt]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => key j), Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  · intro F a
    simp only [eigWInt, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext x
    ring
  · intro F G hFG
    simp only [eigWInt]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
      setIntegral_congr_fun (P.W_open j).measurableSet (fun x hx => by simp only [hFG j x hx])
  · intro F G hF hG hFG
    simp only [eigWInt]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => setIntegral_mono_on (hint j _ (hF j)) (hint j _ (hG j))
      (P.W_open j).measurableSet ?_
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxK : x ∈ K j
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hFG j x hxK) (hρnn _ _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    · rw [hρK j x hx hxK]
      simp
  · intro F hF
    simp only [eigWInt]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      setIntegral_nonneg (P.W_open j).measurableSet (hpt j (F j) (hF j))
  · have hb : ∀ j, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K j,
        ‖ρ j (P.param j x) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det‖ ≤ C := fun j =>
      (hK j).1.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (((hρc j).mul (hd j)).mono (hK j).2)
    choose C hC using hb
    have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, |C i| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (C i))
    refine ⟨1 + ∑ i, |C i|, by linarith, fun F hF hF0 => ?_⟩
    simp only [eigWInt]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
    rw [hres j (F j)]
    have hFK : IntegrableOn (F j) (K j) := ((hF j).mono (hK j).2).integrableOn_compact (hK j).1
    have h1 : ∫ x in K j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det
        ≤ ∫ x in K j, (1 + ∑ i, |C i|) * F j x := by
      refine setIntegral_mono_on ?_ (Integrable.const_mul hFK _) (hK j).1.measurableSet ?_
      · exact ((((hρc j).mul (hF j)).mul (hd j)).mono (hK j).2).integrableOn_compact (hK j).1
      · intro x hx
        have h2 : ρ j (P.param j x) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det ≤ 1 + ∑ i, |C i| := by
          have h4 := hC j x hx
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h4
          have h3 : |C j| ≤ ∑ i, |C i| :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => |C i|) (fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
              (Finset.mem_univ j)
          linarith [le_abs_self (ρ j (P.param j x) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det), le_abs_self (C j)]
        calc ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det
            = (ρ j (P.param j x) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) * F j x := by ring
          _ ≤ (1 + ∑ i, |C i|) * F j x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (hF0 j x hx)
    rw [integral_const_mul] at h1
    exact h1
  · rintro F hF ⟨j₀, x₀, hx₀, hρx₀⟩ hFpos
    simp only [eigWInt]
    refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ => setIntegral_nonneg (P.W_open j).measurableSet
      (hpt j (F j) (fun x hx => (hFpos j x ((hK j).2 hx)).le))) ⟨j₀, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    have hg : ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j₀ (P.param j₀ x) * F j₀ x * Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ x).det)
        (P.W j₀) := ((hρc j₀).mul (hF j₀)).mul (hd j₀)
    have hnn := ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (μ := volume) (P.W_open j₀).measurableSet
      (hpt j₀ (F j₀) (fun x hx => (hFpos j₀ x ((hK j₀).2 hx)).le))
    rw [setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae hnn (hint j₀ _ (hF j₀))]
    have hU : IsOpen (P.W j₀ ∩ (fun x => ρ j₀ (P.param j₀ x) * F j₀ x *
        Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ x).det) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hg.isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j₀) isOpen_Ioi
    have hx₀U : x₀ ∈ P.W j₀ ∩ (fun x => ρ j₀ (P.param j₀ x) * F j₀ x *
        Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ x).det) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0 :=
      ⟨hx₀, mul_pos (mul_pos hρx₀ (hFpos j₀ x₀ hx₀)) (hdpos j₀ x₀ hx₀)⟩
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (hU.measure_pos volume ⟨x₀, hx₀U⟩) (measure_mono ?_)
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨(show (0 : ℝ) < _ from hx.2).ne', hx.1⟩

informal_problem.statement: {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α] [Module ℝ α] (C : Set α) (B N : α → α → ℝ) (Pos : α → Prop) (hC : ∀ u ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ C, ∀ t : ℝ, u + t • z ∈ C) (hBq : ∀ u ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ C, ∀ t : ℝ, B (u + t • z) (u + t • z) = B u u + 2 * t * B u z + t ^ 2 * B z z) (hNq : ∀ u ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ C, ∀ t : ℝ, N (u + t • z) (u + t • z) = N u u + 2 * t * N u z + t ^ 2 * N z z) (hN0 : ∀ u ∈ C, 0 ≤ N u u) (hlow : ∃ c₁ : ℝ, ∀ u ∈ C, -c₁ * N u u ≤ B u u) (hex : ∃ u ∈ C, 0 < N u u) (hPos : ∀ u (c : ℝ), Pos u → 0 < c → Pos (c • u)) (hreg : ∀ v ∈ C, 0 < N v v → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ w ∈ C, Pos w ∧ 0 < N w w ∧ B w w ≤ (B v v / N v v + η) * N w w) : ∃ (lam : ℝ) (u : ℕ → α) (δ : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ n, u n ∈ C) ∧ (∀ n, Pos (u n)) ∧ (∀ n, N (u n) (u n) = 1) ∧ (∀ n, B (u n) (u n) = lam + δ n) ∧ Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ ∀ z ∈ C, ∀ n (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ n + 2 * t * (B (u n) z - lam * N (u n) z) + t ^ 2 * (B z z - lam * N z z)
