signature.statement: {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α] [Module ℝ α] (C : Set α) (B N : α → α → ℝ) (Pos : α → Prop) (hC : ∀ u ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ C, ∀ t : ℝ, u + t • z ∈ C) (hBq : ∀ u ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ C, ∀ t : ℝ, B (u + t • z) (u + t • z) = B u u + 2 * t * B u z + t ^ 2 * B z z) (hNq : ∀ u ∈ C, ∀ z ∈ C, ∀ t : ℝ, N (u + t • z) (u + t • z) = N u u + 2 * t * N u z + t ^ 2 * N z z) (hN0 : ∀ u ∈ C, 0 ≤ N u u) (hlow : ∃ c₁ : ℝ, ∀ u ∈ C, -c₁ * N u u ≤ B u u) (hex : ∃ u ∈ C, 0 < N u u) (hPos : ∀ u (c : ℝ), Pos u → 0 < c → Pos (c • u)) (hreg : ∀ v ∈ C, 0 < N v v → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ w ∈ C, Pos w ∧ 0 < N w w ∧ B w w ≤ (B v v / N v v + η) * N w w) : ∃ (lam : ℝ) (u : ℕ → α) (δ : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ n, u n ∈ C) ∧ (∀ n, Pos (u n)) ∧ (∀ n, N (u n) (u n) = 1) ∧ (∀ n, B (u n) (u n) = lam + δ n) ∧ Filter.Tendsto δ Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ ∀ z ∈ C, ∀ n (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ n + 2 * t * (B (u n) z - lam * N (u n) z) + t ^ 2 * (B z z - lam * N z z)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁⟩ := hlow
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀C, hu₀N⟩ := hex
  set R : Set ℝ := {r : ℝ | ∃ v ∈ C, 0 < N v v ∧ B v v / N v v = r} with hRdef
  have hRne : R.Nonempty := ⟨_, u₀, hu₀C, hu₀N, rfl⟩
  have hRbdd : BddBelow R := by
    refine ⟨-c₁, ?_⟩
    rintro r ⟨v, hv, hNv, rfl⟩
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hNv]
    exact hc₁ v hv
  set lam := sInf R with hlam
  have hlamQ : ∀ v ∈ C, lam * N v v ≤ B v v := by
    intro v hv
    rcases (hN0 v hv).lt_or_eq with hNv | hNv
    · have h := csInf_le hRbdd ⟨v, hv, hNv, rfl⟩
      exact (le_div_iff₀ hNv).mp h
    · have h := hc₁ v hv
      rw [← hNv, mul_zero] at h ⊢
      exact h
  have happrox : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ v ∈ C, 0 < N v v ∧ B v v / N v v < lam + ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨r, ⟨v, hv, hNv, rfl⟩, hr⟩ :=
      exists_lt_of_csInf_lt hRne (show sInf R < lam + ε by linarith)
    exact ⟨v, hv, hNv, hr⟩
  have hnorm : ∀ w ∈ C, Pos w → 0 < N w w →
      ∃ u ∈ C, Pos u ∧ N u u = 1 ∧ B u u = B w w / N w w := by
    intro w hw hPw hNw
    set s : ℝ := (Real.sqrt (N w w))⁻¹ with hsdef
    have hs : 0 < s := inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hNw)
    have hs2 : s ^ 2 * N w w = 1 := by
      rw [hsdef, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hNw.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hNw.ne']
    have hid : s • w = w + (s - 1) • w := by rw [sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
    refine ⟨s • w, ?_, hPos w s hPw hs, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hid]; exact hC w hw w hw (s - 1)
    · rw [hid, hNq w hw w hw (s - 1)]
      calc N w w + 2 * (s - 1) * N w w + (s - 1) ^ 2 * N w w = s ^ 2 * N w w := by ring
        _ = 1 := hs2
    · rw [hid, hBq w hw w hw (s - 1), eq_div_iff hNw.ne']
      calc (B w w + 2 * (s - 1) * B w w + (s - 1) ^ 2 * B w w) * N w w
          = B w w * (s ^ 2 * N w w) := by ring
        _ = B w w := by rw [hs2, mul_one]
  have hseq : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u ∈ C, Pos u ∧ N u u = 1 ∧ lam ≤ B u u ∧
      B u u ≤ lam + 2 * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    intro n
    have hε : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hNv, hr⟩ := happrox _ hε
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hPw, hNw, hBw⟩ := hreg v hv hNv _ hε
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hPu, hNu, hBu⟩ := hnorm w hw hPw hNw
    refine ⟨u, hu, hPu, hNu, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h := hlamQ u hu
      rw [hNu, mul_one] at h
      exact h
    · rw [hBu, div_le_iff₀ hNw]
      have h1 : B v v / N v v + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ lam + 2 * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) := by
        linarith
      exact hBw.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hNw.le)
  choose u huC huP huN huL huU using hseq
  refine ⟨lam, u, fun n => B (u n) (u n) - lam, huC, huP, huN, fun n => by ring, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hg : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * (1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (2 : ℝ)
      rwa [mul_zero] at h
    exact squeeze_zero (fun n => sub_nonneg.mpr (huL n)) (fun n => by linarith [huU n]) hg
  · intro z hz n t
    have hy := hlamQ _ (hC (u n) (huC n) z hz t)
    rw [hBq (u n) (huC n) z hz t, hNq (u n) (huC n) z hz t, huN n] at hy
    linarith [hy]

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : E2 → ℝ) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v W) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (H : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hH : ∀ x ∈ W, (H x).PosSemidef) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (v x ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, H x a b * pd2 b (fun x' => Real.sqrt (v x' ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) x * pd2 a (fun x' => Real.sqrt (v x' ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) x ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, H x a b * pd2 b v x * pd2 a v x

signature.name: eig_sqrt_reg
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : E2 → ℝ) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v W) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (H : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hH : ∀ x ∈ W, (H x).PosSemidef) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (v x ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, H x a b * pd2 b (fun x' => Real.sqrt (v x' ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) x * pd2 a (fun x' => Real.sqrt (v x' ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) x ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, H x a b * pd2 b v x * pd2 a v x

proof.tactics:
by
  have htpos : ∀ y, 0 < v y ^ 2 + ε ^ 2 := fun y =>
    add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg _) (pow_pos hε 2)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ((hv.pow 2).add contDiffOn_const).sqrt (fun y _ => (htpos y).ne')
  · intro x hx
    have hdv : DifferentiableAt ℝ v x :=
      (hv.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt v (fderiv ℝ v x) x := hdv.hasFDerivAt
    have h2 := (h1.pow 2).add_const (ε ^ 2)
    have h3 := h2.sqrt (htpos x).ne'
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (v x ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (htpos x)
    set c : ℝ := v x / Real.sqrt (v x ^ 2 + ε ^ 2) with hc
    have hpd : ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (fun x' => Real.sqrt (v x' ^ 2 + ε ^ 2)) x = c * pd2 b v x := by
      intro b
      unfold pd2
      rw [h3.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [hc]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hc2 : c ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      rw [hc, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (htpos x).le, div_le_one (htpos x)]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ε]
    have hQ : 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, H x a b * pd2 b v x * pd2 a v x := by
      have h := (hH x hx).dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (fun b => pd2 b v x)
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial] at h
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      nlinarith [h]
    simp only [hpd]
    have hL : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, H x a b * (c * pd2 b v x) * (c * pd2 a v x) =
        c ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, H x a b * pd2 b v x * pd2 a v x := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    rw [hL]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left hQ hc2

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) (hLW : L ⊆ W) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ w : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W → ∫ x in L, (w x ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k w x) ^ 2) ≤ C * ((∫ x in L, w x * w x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) + ∫ x in L, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w x * pd2 a w x) * Real.sqrt (h x).det)

signature.name: eig_local_energy
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) (hLW : L ⊆ W) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ w : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W → ∫ x in L, (w x ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k w x) ^ 2) ≤ C * ((∫ x in L, w x * w x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) + ∫ x in L, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w x * pd2 a w x) * Real.sqrt (h x).det)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have alg : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.PosDef → ∀ v : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      0 < A 0 0 + A 1 1 ∧
        (∑ k : Fin 2, v k ^ 2) ≤ (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a b * v b * v a := by
    intro A hA v
    have hsym : A 1 0 = A 0 1 := by
      have := hA.isHermitian.apply 0 1
      simpa using this
    have hD : 0 < A.det := hA.det_pos
    have hdet : A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsym]
    have hE : 0 < A 0 0 := hA.diag_pos
    have hG : 0 < A 1 1 := hA.diag_pos
    have hinv : ∀ a b, A⁻¹ a b = A.det⁻¹ * A.adjugate a b := by
      intro a b
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    have i00 : A⁻¹ 0 0 = A.det⁻¹ * A 1 1 := by rw [hinv]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
    have i01 : A⁻¹ 0 1 = A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) := by rw [hinv]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
    have i10 : A⁻¹ 1 0 = A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) := by
      rw [hinv]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, hsym]
    have i11 : A⁻¹ 1 1 = A.det⁻¹ * A 0 0 := by rw [hinv]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, i00, i01, i10, i11]
    have ht : A.det⁻¹ * (A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← hdet]; exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hD.ne'
    have key : (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * (A.det⁻¹ * A 1 1 * v 0 * v 0 + A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) * v 1 * v 0 +
        (A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) * v 0 * v 1 + A.det⁻¹ * A 0 0 * v 1 * v 1)) - (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2) =
        A.det⁻¹ * ((A 1 1 * v 0 - A 0 1 * v 1) ^ 2 + (A 0 1 * v 0 - A 0 0 * v 1) ^ 2) := by
      linear_combination (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2) * ht
    have hnn : 0 ≤ A.det⁻¹ * ((A 1 1 * v 0 - A 0 1 * v 1) ^ 2 + (A 0 1 * v 0 - A 0 0 * v 1) ^ 2) :=
      mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hD.le) (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
    linarith
  
  have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => h x a b) W := fun a b => (hh a b).continuousOn
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x).det) W := by
    have e : (fun x => (h x).det) = fun x => h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 := by
      funext x; exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
    rw [e]
    exact ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).sub ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0))
  have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) W := hdetc.sqrt
  have htc : ContinuousOn (fun x => h x 0 0 + h x 1 1) W := (hc 0 0).add (hc 1 1)
  have hdetinv : ContinuousOn (fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹) W :=
    hdetc.inv₀ (fun x hx => (hpos x hx).det_pos.ne')
  have hadjc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x).adjugate a b) W := by
    intro a b
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] <;>
      first
        | exact hc _ _
        | exact (hc _ _).neg
        | fun_prop
  have hinvc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) W := by
    intro a b
    have e : (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) = fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹ * (h x).adjugate a b := by
      funext x
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rw [e]
    exact hdetinv.mul (hadjc a b)
  
  have hspos : ∀ x ∈ L, 0 < Real.sqrt (h x).det :=
    fun x hx => Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos x (hLW hx)).det_pos
  obtain ⟨m, hm0, hm⟩ := hL.exists_forall_le' (hsc.mono hLW) hspos
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hL.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (htc.mono hLW)
  set T : ℝ := max B 0 with hTdef
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ T := le_max_right _ _
  have hTb : ∀ x ∈ L, h x 0 0 + h x 1 1 ≤ T := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hB x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h1.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  refine ⟨(1 + T) / m, div_nonneg (by linarith) hm0.le, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  
  have hwc : ContinuousOn w W := hw.continuousOn
  have hpdc : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 k w x) W := by
    intro k
    unfold pd2
    exact (hw.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  
  have hpt : ∀ x ∈ L, (w x ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k w x) ^ 2) ≤
      (1 + T) / m * (w x * w x * Real.sqrt (h x).det +
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w x * pd2 a w x) * Real.sqrt (h x).det) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hτ, hPQ⟩ := alg (h x) (hpos x (hLW hx)) (fun k => pd2 k w x)
    have hPQ' : (∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k w x) ^ 2) ≤ (h x 0 0 + h x 1 1) *
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w x * pd2 a w x := hPQ
    set P := ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k w x) ^ 2 with hPdef
    set Q := ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w x * pd2 a w x with hQdef
    set σ := Real.sqrt (h x).det with hσdef
    set τ := h x 0 0 + h x 1 1 with hτdef
    have hP0 : 0 ≤ P := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := by
      by_contra hneg
      push_neg at hneg
      have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hτ hneg
      linarith
    have hτT : τ ≤ T := hTb x hx
    have hPT : P ≤ T * Q := hPQ'.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτT hQ0)
    have hmσ : m ≤ σ := hm x hx
    have hX : w x ^ 2 + P ≤ (1 + T) * (w x * w x + Q) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hT0 (sq_nonneg (w x)), sq_nonneg (w x)]
    have hY : 0 ≤ (1 + T) * (w x * w x + Q) * (σ - m) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (add_nonneg (mul_self_nonneg _) hQ0))
        (sub_nonneg.2 hmσ)
    have hZ : (w x ^ 2 + P) * m ≤ (1 + T) * (w x * w x + Q) * m :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hX hm0.le
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hm0]
    nlinarith [hY, hZ]
  
  have hfc : ContinuousOn (fun x => w x ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k w x) ^ 2) W :=
    (hwc.pow 2).add (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => (hpdc k).pow 2))
  have hg1c : ContinuousOn (fun x => w x * w x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) W :=
    (hwc.mul hwc).mul hsc
  have hg2c : ContinuousOn (fun x => (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
      (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w x * pd2 a w x) * Real.sqrt (h x).det) W :=
    (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
      ((hinvc a b).mul (hpdc b)).mul (hpdc a)).mul hsc
  have hf_int := (hfc.mono hLW).integrableOn_compact (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hL
  have hg1_int := (hg1c.mono hLW).integrableOn_compact (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hL
  have hg2_int := (hg2c.mono hLW).integrableOn_compact (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hL
  have hg_int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => (1 + T) / m * (w x * w x * Real.sqrt (h x).det +
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w x * pd2 a w x) * Real.sqrt (h x).det))
      L MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (hg1_int.add hg2_int).const_mul _
  calc ∫ x in L, (w x ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k w x) ^ 2)
      ≤ ∫ x in L, (1 + T) / m * (w x * w x * Real.sqrt (h x).det +
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w x * pd2 a w x) * Real.sqrt (h x).det) :=
        MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hf_int hg_int hL.measurableSet hpt
    _ = (1 + T) / m * ((∫ x in L, w x * w x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) + ∫ x in L,
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w x * pd2 a w x) * Real.sqrt (h x).det) := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_add hg1_int hg2_int]

informal_problem.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (u v : X → ℝ) (hu : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hv : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (j : Fin P.n) : ContinuousOn (eigGam P u v j) (P.W j) ∧ (∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ eigGam P u u j x) ∧ ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ t : ℝ, eigGam P (u + t • v) (u + t • v) j x = eigGam P u u j x + 2 * t * eigGam P u v j x + t ^ 2 * eigGam P v v j x

signature.name: eig_gam_facts
signature.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (u v : X → ℝ) (hu : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hv : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (j : Fin P.n) : ContinuousOn (eigGam P u v j) (P.W j) ∧ (∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ eigGam P u u j x) ∧ ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ t : ℝ, eigGam P (u + t • v) (u + t • v) j x = eigGam P u u j x + 2 * t * eigGam P u v j x + t ^ 2 * eigGam P v v j x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hW := P.W_open j
  have hU := hu j
  have hV := hv j
  have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => P.h j x a b) (P.W j) :=
    fun a b => (P.h_smooth j a b).continuousOn
  have hdet : ContinuousOn (fun x => (P.h j x).det) (P.W j) := by
    have e : (fun x => (P.h j x).det) =
        fun x => P.h j x 0 0 * P.h j x 1 1 - P.h j x 0 1 * P.h j x 1 0 := by
      funext x; exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
    rw [e]
    exact ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).sub ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0))
  have hdinv : ContinuousOn (fun x => ((P.h j x).det)⁻¹) (P.W j) :=
    hdet.inv₀ (fun x hx => (P.h_posDef j x hx).det_pos.ne')
  have hH : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => (P.h j x)⁻¹ a b) (P.W j) := by
    intro a b
    have hform : ∀ x, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a b = ((P.h j x).det)⁻¹ * (P.h j x).adjugate a b := by
      intro x
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hadj : ContinuousOn (fun x => (P.h j x).adjugate a b) (P.W j) := by
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] <;>
        first | exact hc _ _ | exact (hc _ _).neg
    exact (hdinv.mul hadj).congr (fun x _ => hform x)
  have hdF : ∀ (F : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (P.W j) → ∀ b : Fin 2,
      ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 b F x) (P.W j) := by
    intro F hF b
    have h1 := hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hsym : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ a b : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ b a = (P.h j x)⁻¹ a b := by
    intro x hx a b
    have := (P.h_posDef j x hx).inv.isHermitian.apply a b
    rw [star_trivial] at this
    exact this
  have hlin : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ b : Fin 2,
      pd2 b (fun x' => (u + t • v) (P.param j x')) x =
        pd2 b (fun x' => u (P.param j x')) x + t * pd2 b (fun x' => v (P.param j x')) x := by
    intro x hx t b
    have hdu : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => u (P.param j x')) x :=
      (hU.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
    have hdv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => v (P.param j x')) x :=
      (hV.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
    have hF : HasFDerivAt (fun x' => (u + t • v) (P.param j x'))
        (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => u (P.param j x')) x + t • fderiv ℝ (fun x' => v (P.param j x')) x) x :=
      hdu.hasFDerivAt.add (hdv.hasFDerivAt.const_smul t)
    unfold pd2
    rw [hF.fderiv]
    simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold eigGam
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun b _ =>
      ((hH a b).mul (hdF _ hU b)).mul (hdF _ hV a)))
  · intro x hx
    have h0 := (P.h_posDef j x hx).inv.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
      (fun b => pd2 b (fun x' => u (P.param j x')) x)
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial] at h0
    simp only [eigGam, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    nlinarith [h0]
  · intro x hx t
    simp only [eigGam, hlin x hx t, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hsym x hx 0 1]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) : (∀ x ∈ W, 0 < Real.sqrt (h x).det) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) W ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) W) ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (Real.sqrt (h x).det • (h x)⁻¹).PosDef

signature.name: elr_coeff_smooth
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) : (∀ x ∈ W, 0 < Real.sqrt (h x).det) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) W ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) W) ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (Real.sqrt (h x).det • (h x)⁻¹).PosDef

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdet : ∀ x ∈ W, 0 < (h x).det := fun x hx => (hpos x hx).det_pos
  have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x).det) W := by
    have e : (fun x => (h x).det) = fun x => h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 := by
      funext x; exact Matrix.det_fin_two (h x)
    rw [e]
    exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹) W :=
    hdetS.inv (fun x hx => (hdet x hx).ne')
  have hentry : ∀ (x : E2) (a b : Fin 2),
      (h x)⁻¹ a b = ((h x).det)⁻¹ * (h x).adjugate a b := by
    intro x a b
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  refine ⟨fun x hx => Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hdet x hx),
    hdetS.sqrt (fun x hx => (hdet x hx).ne'), ?_,
    fun x hx => ((hpos x hx).inv).smul (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hdet x hx))⟩
  intro a b
  have e : (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) = fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹ * (h x).adjugate a b := by
    funext x; exact hentry x a b
  rw [e]
  refine hD.mul ?_
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b
  · refine (hh 1 1).congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp
  · refine (hh 0 1).neg.congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp
  · refine (hh 1 0).neg.congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp
  · refine (hh 0 0).congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b u y) x = Real.sqrt (h x).det * lap2 h u x

signature.name: elr_div_identity
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b u y) x = Real.sqrt (h x).det * lap2 h u x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hWx : W ∈ 𝓝 x := hW.mem_nhds hx
  have hE : ∀ i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => h y i j) x := fun i j =>
    ((hh i j).contDiffAt hWx).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hsy : ∀ y ∈ W, h y 1 0 = h y 0 1 := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 := (hpos y hy).isHermitian.apply 0 1
    simpa using h1
  have hsyD : ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => h y 1 0) x = pd2 c (fun y => h y 0 1) x := by
    intro c
    have hev : (fun y => h y 1 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => h y 0 1) := by
      filter_upwards [hWx] with y hy using hsy y hy
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hV : ∀ b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 b u) x := by
    intro b
    have h2le : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ u) x :=
      (hu.contDiffAt hWx).fderiv_right h2le
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (e2 b)) x := h1.clm_apply contDiffAt_const
    exact h2.differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have pd_add : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (f g : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 c (fun y => f y + g y) x = pd2 c f x + pd2 c g x := by
    intro c f g hf hg
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hg]
    rfl
  have pd_sub : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (f g : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 c (fun y => f y - g y) x = pd2 c f x - pd2 c g x := by
    intro c f g hf hg
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [show (fun y => f y - g y) = f - g from rfl, (hf.hasFDerivAt.sub hg.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
    rfl
  have pd_neg : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (f : E2 → ℝ), pd2 c (fun y => -f y) x = -pd2 c f x := by
    intro c f
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [show (fun z => -f z) = -f from rfl, fderiv_neg]
    rfl
  have pd_mul : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (f g : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 c (fun y => f y * g y) x = pd2 c f x * g x + f x * pd2 c g x := by
    intro c f g hf hg
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have pd_inv : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (f : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x ≠ 0 →
      pd2 c (fun y => (f y)⁻¹) x = -pd2 c f x / (f x) ^ 2 := by
    intro c f hf h0
    have h1 := ((hasDerivAt_inv h0).comp_hasFDerivAt x hf.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [show (fun y => (f y)⁻¹) = (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹) ∘ f from rfl, h1]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have pd_sqrt : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (f : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x ≠ 0 →
      pd2 c (fun y => Real.sqrt (f y)) x = pd2 c f x / (2 * Real.sqrt (f x)) := by
    intro c f hf h0
    have h1 := (hf.hasFDerivAt.sqrt h0).fderiv
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [h1]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hdetfun : (fun y => (h y).det) = fun y => h y 0 0 * h y 1 1 - h y 0 1 * h y 1 0 := by
    funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
  have hdetD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (h y).det) x := by
    rw [hdetfun]; exact ((hE 0 0).mul (hE 1 1)).sub ((hE 0 1).mul (hE 1 0))
  have hdetd : ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => (h y).det) x =
      pd2 c (fun y => h y 0 0) x * h x 1 1 + h x 0 0 * pd2 c (fun y => h y 1 1) x
        - (pd2 c (fun y => h y 0 1) x * h x 1 0 + h x 0 1 * pd2 c (fun y => h y 1 0) x) := by
    intro c
    rw [hdetfun, pd_sub c (fun y => h y 0 0 * h y 1 1) (fun y => h y 0 1 * h y 1 0)
        ((hE 0 0).fun_mul (hE 1 1)) ((hE 0 1).fun_mul (hE 1 0)),
      pd_mul c (fun y => h y 0 0) (fun y => h y 1 1) (hE 0 0) (hE 1 1),
      pd_mul c (fun y => h y 0 1) (fun y => h y 1 0) (hE 0 1) (hE 1 0)]
  have hdpos : 0 < (h x).det := (hpos x hx).det_pos
  have hd0 : (h x).det ≠ 0 := hdpos.ne'
  have hSD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det) x := hdetD.sqrt hd0
  have hσσ : Real.sqrt (h x).det * Real.sqrt (h x).det = (h x).det := Real.mul_self_sqrt hdpos.le
  have hσ0 : Real.sqrt (h x).det ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hdpos).ne'
  have hSd : ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det) x =
      Real.sqrt (h x).det / (2 * (h x).det) * pd2 c (fun y => (h y).det) x := by
    intro c
    rw [pd_sqrt c (fun y => (h y).det) hdetD hd0]
    calc pd2 c (fun y => (h y).det) x / (2 * Real.sqrt (h x).det)
        = Real.sqrt (h x).det / (2 * (Real.sqrt (h x).det * Real.sqrt (h x).det))
            * pd2 c (fun y => (h y).det) x := by
          field_simp
      _ = _ := by rw [hσσ]
  
  have hinvpt : ∀ y (a b : Fin 2), (h y)⁻¹ a b = ((h y).det)⁻¹ * (h y).adjugate a b := by
    intro y a b
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hinvfun : ∀ a b : Fin 2,
      (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a b) = fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹ * (h y).adjugate a b := by
    intro a b; funext y; exact hinvpt y a b
  have hA00 : ∀ y, (h y).adjugate 0 0 = h y 1 1 := fun y => by simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hA01 : ∀ y, (h y).adjugate 0 1 = -h y 0 1 := fun y => by simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hA10 : ∀ y, (h y).adjugate 1 0 = -h y 1 0 := fun y => by simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hA11 : ∀ y, (h y).adjugate 1 1 = h y 0 0 := fun y => by simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadjD : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (h y).adjugate a b) x := by
    simp only [Fin.forall_fin_two, hA00, hA01, hA10, hA11]
    exact ⟨⟨hE 1 1, (hE 0 1).neg⟩, ⟨(hE 1 0).neg, hE 0 0⟩⟩
  have hinvD : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a b) x := by
    intro a b
    rw [hinvfun a b]
    exact (hdetD.inv hd0).mul (hadjD a b)
  have hinvd : ∀ c a b : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a b) x =
      -pd2 c (fun y => (h y).det) x / ((h x).det) ^ 2 * (h x).adjugate a b
        + ((h x).det)⁻¹ * pd2 c (fun y => (h y).adjugate a b) x := by
    intro c a b
    have hdi : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹) x := hdetD.inv hd0
    rw [hinvfun a b, pd_mul c (fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹) (fun y => (h y).adjugate a b) hdi (hadjD a b),
      pd_inv c (fun y => (h y).det) hdetD hd0]
  
  have hL : ∀ a : Fin 2,
      pd2 a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b u y) x =
        ∑ b : Fin 2, (pd2 a (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det) x * (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b u x
          + Real.sqrt (h x).det * pd2 a (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a b) x * pd2 b u x
          + Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a (pd2 b u) x) := by
    intro a
    have hsum : (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b u y) =
        fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a 0 * pd2 0 u y
          + Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a 1 * pd2 1 u y := by
      funext y; exact Fin.sum_univ_two _
    have d2 : ∀ b : Fin 2,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a b) x :=
      fun b => hSD.fun_mul (hinvD a b)
    have d3 : ∀ b : Fin 2,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b u y) x :=
      fun b => (d2 b).fun_mul (hV b)
    rw [hsum, pd_add a (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a 0 * pd2 0 u y)
        (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a 1 * pd2 1 u y) (d3 0) (d3 1),
      pd_mul a (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a 0) (pd2 0 u) (d2 0) (hV 0),
      pd_mul a (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a 1) (pd2 1 u) (d2 1) (hV 1),
      pd_mul a (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det) (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a 0) hSD (hinvD a 0),
      pd_mul a (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det) (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a 1) hSD (hinvD a 1),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hL 0, hL 1]
  simp only [lap2, christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp only [hSd, hinvd, hdetd]
  simp only [hinvpt x, hA00, hA01, hA10, hA11, pd_neg]
  simp only [hsyD, hsy x hx]
  generalize Real.sqrt (h x).det = σ
  have hdeq : (h x).det = h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 0 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsy x hx]
  generalize (h x).det = d at hdeq hd0 ⊢
  field_simp
  subst hdeq
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (c : E2 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c W) (w w' : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ ∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, G k x * ζ x)) (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x - c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * w x * ζ x) = 0) (hw' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' W) (hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict W), w x = w' x) : ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w' y) x + c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * w' x = 0

signature.name: elr_weak_to_strong
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (c : E2 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c W) (w w' : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ ∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, G k x * ζ x)) (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x - c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * w x * ζ x) = 0) (hw' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' W) (hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict W), w x = w' x) : ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w' y) x + c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * w' x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hWm : MeasurableSet W := hW.measurableSet
  
  have hfdz : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∀ x, x ∉ W → ζ x = 0 ∧ ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a ζ x = 0 := by
    intro ζ hζW x hx
    have hx' : x ∉ tsupport ζ := fun hm => hx (hζW hm)
    refine ⟨image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx', fun a => ?_⟩
    have hx'' : x ∉ tsupport (fderiv ℝ ζ) := fun hm => hx' (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ hm)
    have h0 : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx''
    show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e2 a) = 0
    rw [h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  
  have hpdtest : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W →
      ∀ a : Fin 2, Continuous (pd2 a ζ) ∧ HasCompactSupport (pd2 a ζ) ∧ tsupport (pd2 a ζ) ⊆ W := by
    intro ζ hζ hζc hζW a
    have hcont : Continuous (pd2 a ζ) := by
      show Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ ζ x (e2 a))
      exact (hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hsupp : Function.support (pd2 a ζ) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxn
      apply hx
      have h0 : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 :=
        image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun hm => hxn (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ hm))
      show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e2 a) = 0
      rw [h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    exact ⟨hcont, hζc.mono' hsupp, (closure_minimal hsupp (isClosed_tsupport ζ)).trans hζW⟩
  
  have hpd_smooth : ∀ u : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W → ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 i u) W := by
    intro u hu i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ u) W := ContDiffOn.fderiv_of_isOpen (m := ∞) hu hW (by simp)
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ u x (e2 i)) W
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have s1 : ∀ u φ : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn u W → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      tsupport φ ⊆ W → Integrable (fun x => u x * φ x) := by
    intro u φ hu hφ hφc hφW
    have hcont : Continuous (fun x => u x * φ x) := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ W
      · exact (hu.continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).mul hφ.continuousAt
      · have hO : (tsupport φ)ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 x :=
          (isClosed_tsupport φ).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds (fun hm => hx (hφW hm))
        have hev : (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => u y * φ y) := by
          filter_upwards [hO] with y hy
          rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy, mul_zero]
        exact continuousAt_const.congr hev
    exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.mul_left (f := u) hφc)
  have hpdw'cont : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (pd2 k w') W := fun k =>
    (hpd_smooth w' hw' k).continuousOn
  
  have ibpL : ∀ u : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W → ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ →
      HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      ∫ x, u x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, pd2 k u x * ζ x) := by
    intro u hu ζ hζ hζc hζW k
    have hvan : ∀ x, x ∉ W → (ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0) := fun x hx =>
      notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (fun hm => hx (hζW hm))
    have hFder : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x) x ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k) = pd2 k u x * ζ x + u x * pd2 k ζ x := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ W
      · have hu' : HasFDerivAt u (fderiv ℝ u x) x :=
          ((hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
        have hζ' : HasFDerivAt ζ (fderiv ℝ ζ x) x :=
          (hζ.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
        have hm : HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y)
            (u x • fderiv ℝ ζ x + ζ x • fderiv ℝ u x) x := hu'.mul hζ'
        refine ⟨hm.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt, ?_⟩
        rw [hm.fderiv]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, pd2]
        ring
      · have hF0 : (fun y => u y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
          filter_upwards [hvan x hx] with y hy
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hy
          simp [hy]
        have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y) (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x :=
          (hasFDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq hF0
        refine ⟨hd.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt, ?_⟩
        rw [hd.fderiv, (hfdz ζ hζW x hx).1, (hfdz ζ hζW x hx).2 k]
        simp
    have hFd : Differentiable ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) :=
      fun x => (hFder x).1.differentiableAt
    have hprod : (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k)) =
        fun x => pd2 k u x * ζ x + u x * pd2 k ζ x := funext fun x => (hFder x).2
    have hpz := hpdtest ζ hζ hζc hζW k
    have hg₁ : Integrable (fun x => pd2 k u x * ζ x) :=
      s1 _ ζ (hpd_smooth u hu k).continuousOn hζ.continuous hζc hζW
    have hg₂ : Integrable (fun x => u x * pd2 k ζ x) :=
      s1 u (pd2 k ζ) hu.continuousOn hpz.1 hpz.2.1 hpz.2.2
    have hF : Integrable (fun x => u x * ζ x) := s1 u ζ hu.continuousOn hζ.continuous hζc hζW
    have hF' : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k)) := by
      rw [hprod]; exact hg₁.add hg₂
    have hI := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
      (f := fun y => u y * ζ y) (g := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (v := e2 k)
      (by simpa using hF') (by simp) (by simpa using hF) hFd (differentiable_const 1)
    have hzero : ∫ x, fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k) = 0 := by
      simp only [fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero, integral_zero,
        mul_one] at hI
      linarith
    rw [hprod, integral_add hg₁ hg₂] at hzero
    linarith
  have haeW : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ W → w x = w' x := (ae_restrict_iff' hWm).1 hae
  
  have s2 : ∀ k : Fin 2, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ W → G k x = pd2 k w' x := by
    intro k
    have hloc : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => G k x - pd2 k w' x) W volume := by
      rw [locallyIntegrableOn_iff hW.isLocallyClosed]
      intro L hLW hL
      haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict L) :=
        isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 hL.measure_lt_top.ne
      have h1 : IntegrableOn (G k) L volume := ((hL2 L hL hLW).2 k).integrable (by norm_num)
      have h2 : IntegrableOn (pd2 k w') L volume :=
        ((hpdw'cont k).mono hLW).integrableOn_compact hL
      exact h1.sub h2
    have htest : ∀ g : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ W →
        ∫ x, g x • (G k x - pd2 k w' x) = 0 := by
      intro ζ hζ hζc hζW
      have e1 : ∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x = ∫ x, w' x * pd2 k ζ x := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [haeW] with x hx
        by_cases hxW : x ∈ W
        · rw [hx hxW]
        · rw [(hfdz ζ hζW x hxW).2 k, mul_zero, mul_zero]
      have e2 := ibpL w' hw' ζ hζ hζc hζW k
      have e3 := hgrad ζ hζ hζc hζW k
      have iG : Integrable (fun x => G k x * ζ x) := by
        haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (tsupport ζ)) :=
          isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 (IsCompact.measure_lt_top hζc).ne
        have hGi : IntegrableOn (G k) (tsupport ζ) volume :=
          ((hL2 _ hζc hζW).2 k).integrable (by norm_num)
        have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => G k x * ζ x) (tsupport ζ) volume :=
          hGi.mul_continuousOn hζ.continuous.continuousOn hζc
        refine (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset ?_).1 h1
        intro x hx
        by_contra hxn
        exact hx (show G k x * ζ x = 0 by rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hxn, mul_zero])
      have iP : Integrable (fun x => pd2 k w' x * ζ x) :=
        s1 _ ζ (hpdw'cont k) hζ.continuous hζc hζW
      have e4 : ∫ x, ζ x • (G k x - pd2 k w' x) = ∫ x, (G k x * ζ x - pd2 k w' x * ζ x) := by
        congr 1; funext x; rw [smul_eq_mul]; ring
      have e5 : ∫ x, (G k x * ζ x - pd2 k w' x * ζ x)
          = (∫ x, G k x * ζ x) - ∫ x, pd2 k w' x * ζ x := integral_sub iG iP
      rw [e4, e5]
      linarith
    have := hW.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero hloc htest
    filter_upwards [this] with x hx hxW
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (hx hxW)
  
  have s3 : ∀ F : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn F W → (∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∫ x, F x * ζ x = 0) → ∀ x ∈ W, F x = 0 := by
    intro F hF h0
    have hloc : LocallyIntegrableOn F W volume := hF.locallyIntegrableOn hWm
    have h1 := hW.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero hloc (fun g hg hgc hgW => by
      have hfun : (fun x => g x • F x) = fun x => F x * g x :=
        funext fun x => by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      rw [hfun]
      exact h0 g hg hgc hgW)
    have h2 : F =ᵐ[volume.restrict W] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := (ae_restrict_iff' hWm).2 h1
    intro x hx
    exact Measure.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq h2 hW hF continuousOn_const hx
  
  have hdet : ∀ x ∈ W, 0 < (h x).det := fun x hx => (hpos x hx).det_pos
  have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x).det) W := by
    have he : (fun x => (h x).det) = fun x => h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 := by
      funext x; exact Matrix.det_fin_two (h x)
    rw [he]
    exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) W :=
    hdetS.sqrt (fun x hx => (hdet x hx).ne')
  have hinv : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) W := by
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹) W :=
      hdetS.inv (fun x hx => (hdet x hx).ne')
    have hentry : ∀ (x : E2) (a b : Fin 2),
        (h x)⁻¹ a b = ((h x).det)⁻¹ * (h x).adjugate a b := by
      intro x a b
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    intro a b
    have he : (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) = fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹ * (h x).adjugate a b := by
      funext x; exact hentry x a b
    rw [he]
    refine hD.mul ?_
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b
    · refine (hh 1 1).congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp
    · refine (hh 0 1).neg.congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp
    · refine (hh 1 0).neg.congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp
    · refine (hh 0 0).congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ,
      V = fun a y => ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w' y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQdef⟩ : ∃ Q : E2 → ℝ, Q = fun x => c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * w' x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVa : ∀ a y, V a y = ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h y).det * (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w' y := by
    intro a y; rw [hVdef]
  have hV : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (V a) W := by
    intro a
    rw [hVdef]
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun b _ => (hsq.mul (hinv a b)).mul (hpd_smooth w' hw' b))
  have hdV : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (pd2 a (V a)) W := fun a =>
    (hpd_smooth _ (hV a) a).continuousOn
  have hQ : ContinuousOn Q W := by
    rw [hQdef]
    exact ((hc.mul hsq).mul hw').continuousOn
  
  have hall : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ W → (∀ b : Fin 2, G b x = pd2 b w' x) ∧ w x = w' x := by
    have hG' : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ b : Fin 2, x ∈ W → G b x = pd2 b w' x := ae_all_iff.2 s2
    filter_upwards [hG', haeW] with x h1 h2 hx
    exact ⟨fun b => h1 b hx, h2 hx⟩
  
  have hgoal : ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (V a) x + Q x = 0 := by
    refine s3 (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (V a) x + Q x)
      ((continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hdV a)).add hQ) ?_
    intro ζ hζ hζc hζW
    have hIJ : ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x
          - c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * w x * ζ x)
        = ∫ x, (V 0 x * pd2 0 ζ x + V 1 x * pd2 1 ζ x - Q x * ζ x) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hall] with x hx
      by_cases hxW : x ∈ W
      · obtain ⟨hGx, hwx⟩ := hx hxW
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hGx, hwx, hVa, hQdef]
        ring
      · obtain ⟨hz, hpz⟩ := hfdz ζ hζW x hxW
        simp [hz, hpz]
    have hJ : ∫ x, (V 0 x * pd2 0 ζ x + V 1 x * pd2 1 ζ x - Q x * ζ x) = 0 :=
      hIJ.symm.trans (hweak ζ hζ hζc hζW)
    have hpz := hpdtest ζ hζ hζc hζW
    have iV : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => V a x * pd2 a ζ x) := fun a =>
      s1 (V a) (pd2 a ζ) (hV a).continuousOn (hpz a).1 (hpz a).2.1 (hpz a).2.2
    have iD : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => pd2 a (V a) x * ζ x) := fun a =>
      s1 _ ζ (hdV a) hζ.continuous hζc hζW
    have iQ : Integrable (fun x => Q x * ζ x) := s1 Q ζ hQ hζ.continuous hζc hζW
    have ibp : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∫ x, V a x * pd2 a ζ x = -(∫ x, pd2 a (V a) x * ζ x) := fun a =>
      ibpL (V a) (hV a) ζ hζ hζc hζW a
    have e1 : ∫ x, (V 0 x * pd2 0 ζ x + V 1 x * pd2 1 ζ x - Q x * ζ x)
        = (∫ x, (V 0 x * pd2 0 ζ x + V 1 x * pd2 1 ζ x)) - ∫ x, Q x * ζ x :=
      integral_sub ((iV 0).add (iV 1)) iQ
    have e2 : ∫ x, (V 0 x * pd2 0 ζ x + V 1 x * pd2 1 ζ x)
        = (∫ x, V 0 x * pd2 0 ζ x) + ∫ x, V 1 x * pd2 1 ζ x := integral_add (iV 0) (iV 1)
    have e3 : ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (V a) x + Q x) * ζ x
        = ∫ x, ((pd2 0 (V 0) x * ζ x + pd2 1 (V 1) x * ζ x) + Q x * ζ x) := by
      congr 1; funext x; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    have e4 : ∫ x, ((pd2 0 (V 0) x * ζ x + pd2 1 (V 1) x * ζ x) + Q x * ζ x)
        = (∫ x, (pd2 0 (V 0) x * ζ x + pd2 1 (V 1) x * ζ x)) + ∫ x, Q x * ζ x :=
      integral_add ((iD 0).add (iD 1)) iQ
    have e5 : ∫ x, (pd2 0 (V 0) x * ζ x + pd2 1 (V 1) x * ζ x)
        = (∫ x, pd2 0 (V 0) x * ζ x) + ∫ x, pd2 1 (V 1) x * ζ x := integral_add (iD 0) (iD 1)
    show ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (V a) x + Q x) * ζ x = 0
    rw [e3, e4, e5]
    have i0 := ibp 0
    have i1 := ibp 1
    linarith
  intro x hx
  have hx' := hgoal x hx
  rw [hVdef, hQdef] at hx'
  exact hx'

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hloc : ∀ x ∈ W, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x r ⊆ W ∧ ∃ v : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v (Metric.ball x r) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)), w y = v y) : ∃ w' : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' W ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict W), w x = w' x

signature.name: elr_glue_local
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hloc : ∀ x ∈ W, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x r ⊆ W ∧ ∃ v : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v (Metric.ball x r) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)), w y = v y) : ∃ w' : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' W ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict W), w x = w' x

proof.tactics:
by
  choose! r hr hrW v hv hvae using hloc
  
  have hover : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ z ∈ W,
      Set.EqOn (v x) (v z) (Metric.ball x (r x) ∩ Metric.ball z (r z)) := by
    intro x hx z hz
    have h1 : ∀ᵐ y ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict
        (Metric.ball x (r x) ∩ Metric.ball z (r z))), w y = v x y :=
      MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset Set.inter_subset_left (hvae x hx)
    have h2 : ∀ᵐ y ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict
        (Metric.ball x (r x) ∩ Metric.ball z (r z))), w y = v z y :=
      MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset Set.inter_subset_right (hvae z hz)
    have h12 : v x =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict
        (Metric.ball x (r x) ∩ Metric.ball z (r z))] v z := by
      filter_upwards [h1, h2] with y hy1 hy2
      rw [← hy1, hy2]
    exact MeasureTheory.Measure.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq h12
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball)
      ((hv x hx).continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
      ((hv z hz).continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_right)
  
  have hloc' : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x (r x), v y y = v x y := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have hyW : y ∈ W := hrW x hx hy
    have hyy : y ∈ Metric.ball y (r y) := Metric.mem_ball_self (hr y hyW)
    exact (hover x hx y hyW ⟨hy, hyy⟩).symm
  refine ⟨fun y => v y y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn (fun x hx => ?_)
    refine ⟨Metric.ball x (r x), Metric.isOpen_ball, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr x hx), ?_⟩
    exact ((hv x hx).mono Set.inter_subset_right).congr (fun y hy => hloc' x hx y hy.2)
  · have hball : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ᵐ y ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Metric.ball x (r x))),
        w y = v y y := by
      intro x hx
      filter_upwards [hvae x hx, MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_ball] with y h1 h2
      rw [h1, hloc' x hx y h2]
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hTU⟩ := TopologicalSpace.isOpen_iUnion_countable
      (fun i : W => Metric.ball i.1 (r i.1)) (fun i => Metric.isOpen_ball)
    have hcovW : (⋃ i : W, Metric.ball i.1 (r i.1)) = W := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · exact Set.iUnion_subset fun i => hrW i.1 i.2
      · intro x hx
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr x hx)⟩
    have hcov : (⋃ i ∈ T, Metric.ball (i : E2) (r i)) = W := hTU.trans hcovW
    rw [← hcov]
    exact (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_biUnion_iff _ hT _).2 (fun i _ => hball i.1 i.2)

informal_problem.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ U, (A x).PosDef) (q : E2 → ℝ) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U) (k : ℕ) (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hv : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ ∀ m, MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, v x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, G m x * ζ x)) (hF : ∀ a : Fin 2, elrSob (k + 1) U (F a)) (hf : elrSob k U f) (heq : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x - q x * v x * ζ x) = ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, F a x * pd2 a ζ x + f x * ζ x)) : elrSob (k + 2) U v

signature.name: elr_sob_bootstrap
signature.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ U, (A x).PosDef) (q : E2 → ℝ) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U) (k : ℕ) (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hv : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ ∀ m, MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, v x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, G m x * ζ x)) (hF : ∀ a : Fin 2, elrSob (k + 1) U (F a)) (hf : elrSob k U f) (heq : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x - q x * v x * ζ x) = ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, F a x * pd2 a ζ x + f x * ζ x)) : elrSob (k + 2) U v

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hunf : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : E2 → ℝ), elrSob (j + 1) U φ ↔
      ((∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
        ∃ Gφ : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
          tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, φ x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, Gφ m x * ζ x)) ∧
          ∀ m : Fin 2, elrSob j U (Gφ m)) := fun _ _ => Iff.rfl
  
  have hmono : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : E2 → ℝ), elrSob (j + 1) U φ → elrSob j U φ := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro φ h
      exact ((hunf 0 φ).1 h).1
    | succ j ih =>
      intro φ h
      obtain ⟨hL2, Gφ, hw, hG⟩ := (hunf (j + 1) φ).1 h
      exact (hunf j φ).2 ⟨hL2, Gφ, hw, fun m => ih (Gφ m) (hG m)⟩
  
  have hzero : ∀ n : ℕ, elrSob n U (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro L _ _
      exact MeasureTheory.MemLp.zero
    | succ n ih =>
      refine (hunf n _).2 ⟨fun L _ _ => MeasureTheory.MemLp.zero, fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ), ?_, fun _ => ih⟩
      intro ζ _ _ _ m
      simp
  
  have hL2of : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : E2 → ℝ), elrSob j U φ →
      ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
    intro j φ h
    cases j with
    | zero => exact h
    | succ j => exact ((hunf j φ).1 h).1
  
  have hpd : ∀ ψ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 m ψ) U := by
    intro ψ hψ m
    have h1 := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hψ).2
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hlin : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ₁ φ₂ : E2 → ℝ) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ), elrSob j U φ₁ → elrSob j U φ₂ →
      elrSob j U (fun x => c₁ * φ₁ x + c₂ * φ₂ x) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro φ₁ φ₂ c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ L hL hLU
      exact ((h₁ L hL hLU).const_mul c₁).add ((h₂ L hL hLU).const_mul c₂)
    | succ j ih =>
      intro φ₁ φ₂ c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂
      obtain ⟨hL₁, G₁, hw₁, hG₁⟩ := (hunf j φ₁).1 h₁
      obtain ⟨hL₂, G₂, hw₂, hG₂⟩ := (hunf j φ₂).1 h₂

  have hgain : ∀ (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ),

      ∃ H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ,
        (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → ∀ n m, MemLp (H n m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧

          fun n m => hL2of k _ (hHk n m) L hL hLU, fun a => hFL2 a L hL hLU,

      have hFt : ∀ m a : Fin 2, elrSob (k + 1) U (fun x => DF a m x -
          ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x - (if a = m then f x else 0)) := by

        have t2 : ∀ b : Fin 2, elrSob (k + 1) U (fun x => pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x) :=

        exact hz (hδW hzL)
  have hKm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (K j) := fun j => (hKc j).measurableSet
  
  obtain ⟨a, hapos, hasum, hbound⟩ : ∃ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 < a j) ∧ Summable a ∧
      ∀ j n, a j * ∫ x in K j, F n x ≤ 1 / 2 / 2 ^ j := by
    choose C hC using fun j => hFb (K j) (hKc j) (hKW j)
    have hC'1 : ∀ j, (1 : ℝ) ≤ max (C j) 1 := fun j => le_max_right _ _
    have hC'pos : ∀ j, (0 : ℝ) < max (C j) 1 := fun j => lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (hC'1 j)
    have hapos : ∀ j, (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 / 2 ^ j / max (C j) 1 :=
      fun j => div_pos (by positivity) (hC'pos j)
    refine ⟨fun j => 1 / 2 / 2 ^ j / max (C j) 1, hapos, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => (hapos j).le)
        (fun j => div_le_self (by positivity) (hC'1 j)) (summable_geometric_two' 1)
    · intro j n
      calc 1 / 2 / 2 ^ j / max (C j) 1 * ∫ x in K j, F n x
          ≤ 1 / 2 / 2 ^ j / max (C j) 1 * max (C j) 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hC j n).trans (le_max_left _ _)) (hapos j).le
        _ = 1 / 2 / 2 ^ j := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hC'pos j).ne'
  
  obtain ⟨S, hSx⟩ : ∃ S : E2 → ENNReal, ∀ x,
      S x = ∑' j, ENNReal.ofReal (a j) * (K j).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) x :=
    ⟨_, fun x => rfl⟩
  have hSle : ∀ x, S x ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∑' j, a j) := by
    intro x
    rw [hSx x, ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun j => (hapos j).le) hasum]
    refine ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun j => ?_
    by_cases hx : x ∈ K j
    · simp [hx]
    · simp [hx]
  have hSne : ∀ x, S x ≠ ⊤ := fun x => ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (hSle x)
  have hSm : Measurable S := by
    have hS : S = fun x => ∑' j, ENNReal.ofReal (a j) * (K j).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) x :=
      funext hSx
    rw [hS]
    exact Measurable.ennreal_tsum fun j => (measurable_const.indicator (hKm j)).const_mul _
  have hρW : ∀ x, x ∉ W → (S x).toReal = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have h0 : S x = 0 := by
      rw [hSx x]
      refine ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero.2 fun j => ?_
      have : x ∉ K j := fun h => hx (hKW j h)
      simp [this]
    simp [h0]
  refine ⟨fun x => (S x).toReal, hSm.ennreal_toReal, fun x => ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, hρW, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro L hL hLW
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hKcov L hL hLW
    refine ⟨a j, hapos j, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hxK : x ∈ K j := hj hx
    have h1 : ENNReal.ofReal (a j) ≤ S x := by
      rw [hSx x]
      calc ENNReal.ofReal (a j)
          = ENNReal.ofReal (a j) * (K j).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) x := by simp [hxK]
        _ ≤ ∑' i, ENNReal.ofReal (a i) * (K i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) x :=
            ENNReal.le_tsum (f := fun i => ENNReal.ofReal (a i) *
              (K i).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) x) j
    have h2 := ENNReal.toReal_mono (hSne x) h1
    rwa [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hapos j).le] at h2
  · intro n
    have hmeasW : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (S x).toReal * F n x) (volume.restrict W) :=
      hSm.ennreal_toReal.aestronglyMeasurable.mul ((hFc n).aestronglyMeasurable hW.measurableSet)
    have hind : (W.indicator fun x => (S x).toReal * F n x) = fun x => (S x).toReal * F n x := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ W
      · simp [hx]
      · simp [hx, hρW x hx]
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (S x).toReal * F n x) volume := by
      rw [← hind]; exact (aestronglyMeasurable_indicator_iff hW.measurableSet).2 hmeasW
    have hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ (S x).toReal * F n x := fun x => mul_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (hF0 n x)
    obtain ⟨T, hTx⟩ : ∃ T : ℕ → E2 → ENNReal, ∀ j,
        T j = (K j).indicator (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (a j) * ENNReal.ofReal (F n x)) :=
      ⟨_, fun j => rfl⟩
    have hpt : ∀ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((S x).toReal * F n x) = ∑' j, T j x := by
      intro x
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (hSne x), hSx x,
        ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]
      refine tsum_congr fun j => ?_
      rw [hTx j]
      by_cases hx : x ∈ K j
      · simp [hx]
      · simp [hx]
    have hTm : ∀ j, AEMeasurable (T j) volume := by
      intro j
      rw [hTx j]
      refine (aemeasurable_indicator_iff (hKm j)).2 ?_
      exact (((hFc n).mono (hKW j)).aemeasurable (hKm j)).ennreal_ofReal.const_mul _
    have hTint : ∀ j, ∫⁻ x, T j x ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 / 2 ^ j) := by
      intro j
      have hI : IntegrableOn (F n) (K j) := ((hFc n).mono (hKW j)).integrableOn_compact (hKc j)
      rw [hTx j, lintegral_indicator (hKm j), lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top,
        ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hI (ae_of_all _ (hF0 n)),
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (hapos j).le]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hbound j n)
    have hlin : ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((S x).toReal * F n x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 1 := by
      calc ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((S x).toReal * F n x) = ∫⁻ x, ∑' j, T j x :=
            lintegral_congr fun x => hpt x
        _ = ∑' j, ∫⁻ x, T j x := lintegral_tsum hTm
        _ ≤ ∑' j : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 / 2 ^ j) := ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hTint
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑' j : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) / 2 / 2 ^ j) :=
            (ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun j => by positivity) (summable_geometric_two' 1)).symm
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal 1 := by rw [tsum_geometric_two' 1]
    have hInt : Integrable (fun x => (S x).toReal * F n x) volume := by
      refine ⟨hmeas, ?_⟩
      rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal (ae_of_all _ hnn)]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hlin ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
    refine ⟨hInt, ?_⟩
    rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ hnn) hmeas]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal zero_le_one hlin

informal_problem.statement: {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (x : ℕ → H) (B : ℝ) (hx : ∀ n, ‖x n‖ ≤ B) : ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (g : H), StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ y : H, Tendsto (fun m => inner ℝ (x (φ m)) y) atTop (𝓝 (inner ℝ g y))

signature.name: hilbert_bdd_weak_subseq
signature.statement: {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [CompleteSpace H] (x : ℕ → H) (B : ℝ) (hx : ∀ n, ‖x n‖ ≤ B) : ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (g : H), StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ y : H, Tendsto (fun m => inner ℝ (x (φ m)) y) atTop (𝓝 (inner ℝ g y))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hx 0)
  
  have hs : IsCompact (Set.univ.pi (fun k : ℕ => Set.Icc (-(B * ‖x k‖)) (B * ‖x k‖))) :=
    isCompact_univ_pi (fun k => isCompact_Icc)
  have hv : ∀ n, (fun k : ℕ => inner ℝ (x n) (x k)) ∈
      Set.univ.pi (fun k : ℕ => Set.Icc (-(B * ‖x k‖)) (B * ‖x k‖)) := by
    intro n
    simp only [Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, true_implies, Set.mem_Icc]
    intro k
    have h1 : |inner ℝ (x n) (x k)| ≤ ‖x n‖ * ‖x k‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    have h2 : ‖x n‖ * ‖x k‖ ≤ B * ‖x k‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hx n) (norm_nonneg _)
    exact abs_le.mp (h1.trans h2)
  obtain ⟨c, -, φ, hφ, hc⟩ := hs.tendsto_subseq hv
  have hφk : ∀ k, Tendsto (fun m => inner ℝ (x (φ m)) (x k)) atTop (𝓝 (c k)) := by
    intro k
    exact (tendsto_pi_nhds.1 hc) k
  have hz : ∀ m, ‖x (φ m)‖ ≤ B := fun m => hx (φ m)
  
  let S : Submodule ℝ H :=
    { carrier := {y | ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun m => inner ℝ (x (φ m)) y) atTop (𝓝 L)}
      add_mem' := by
        rintro a b ⟨La, ha⟩ ⟨Lb, hb⟩
        refine ⟨La + Lb, ?_⟩
        simpa only [inner_add_right] using ha.add hb
      zero_mem' := ⟨0, by simp⟩
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro r a ⟨La, ha⟩
        refine ⟨r * La, ?_⟩
        simpa only [real_inner_smul_right] using ha.const_mul r }
  have hSmem : ∀ y, y ∈ S ↔ ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun m => inner ℝ (x (φ m)) y) atTop (𝓝 L) :=
    fun y => Iff.rfl
  have hScl : IsClosed (S : Set H) := by
    refine isClosed_of_closure_subset ?_
    intro y hy
    have hcs : CauchySeq (fun m => inner ℝ (x (φ m)) y) := by
      rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff']
      intro ε hε
      have hδ : 0 < ε / (4 * (B + 1)) := by positivity
      obtain ⟨y', hy'S, hyy'⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.1 hy _ hδ
      obtain ⟨L', hL'⟩ := (hSmem y').1 hy'S
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff'.1 hL'.cauchySeq (ε / 2) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
      have hkey : B * (ε / (4 * (B + 1))) ≤ ε / 4 := by
        rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)]
        nlinarith
      have hb : ∀ j, |inner ℝ (x (φ j)) (y - y')| ≤ ε / 4 := by
        intro j
        calc |inner ℝ (x (φ j)) (y - y')| ≤ ‖x (φ j)‖ * ‖y - y'‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
          _ ≤ B * (ε / (4 * (B + 1))) := by
            apply mul_le_mul (hz j) _ (norm_nonneg _) hB0
            rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hyy'.le
          _ ≤ ε / 4 := hkey
      have hsplit : inner ℝ (x (φ n)) y - inner ℝ (x (φ N)) y =
          inner ℝ (x (φ n)) (y - y') + (inner ℝ (x (φ n)) y' - inner ℝ (x (φ N)) y')
            - inner ℝ (x (φ N)) (y - y') := by
        rw [inner_sub_right, inner_sub_right]; ring
      have h1 := hN n hn
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at h1 ⊢
      rw [hsplit]
      have e1 := abs_le.mp (hb n)
      have e2 := abs_le.mp (hb N)
      have e3 := abs_lt.mp h1
      rw [abs_lt]
      constructor <;> linarith [e1.1, e1.2, e2.1, e2.2, e3.1, e3.2]
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hcs
    exact (hSmem y).2 ⟨L, hL⟩
  
  let K : Submodule ℝ H := (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range x)).topologicalClosure
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range x) ≤ S := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact (hSmem _).2 ⟨c k, hφk k⟩
  have hKS : K ≤ S := Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ hspan hScl
  have hxK : ∀ n, x n ∈ K := fun n =>
    Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨n, rfl⟩)
  have hKoS : Kᗮ ≤ S := by
    intro y hy
    refine (hSmem y).2 ⟨0, ?_⟩
    have h0 : (fun m => inner ℝ (x (φ m)) y) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      funext m
      exact Submodule.inner_right_of_mem_orthogonal (hxK (φ m)) hy
    rw [h0]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  haveI : CompleteSpace K := (Submodule.isClosed_topologicalClosure _).completeSpace_coe
  have hsup : K ⊔ Kᗮ = ⊤ := Submodule.sup_orthogonal_of_completeSpace
  have hall : ∀ y, ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun m => inner ℝ (x (φ m)) y) atTop (𝓝 L) := by
    intro y
    have hy : y ∈ K ⊔ Kᗮ := by rw [hsup]; exact Submodule.mem_top
    exact (hSmem y).1 (sup_le hKS hKoS hy)
  
  choose f hf using hall
  let T : ℕ → H →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun m => innerSL ℝ (x (φ m))
  have hT : Tendsto (fun m y => T m y) atTop (𝓝 f) := by
    rw [tendsto_pi_nhds]
    intro y
    simpa [T, innerSL_apply] using hf y
  have hTb : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range T) := by
    rw [isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le]
    refine ⟨B, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    simp only [T, innerSL_apply_norm]
    exact hz m
  let ℓ : H →L[ℝ] ℝ := ContinuousLinearMap.ofTendstoOfBoundedRange f T hT hTb
  refine ⟨φ, (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ H).symm ℓ, hφ, fun y => ?_⟩
  rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]
  have hℓ : ℓ y = f y := by
    simp [ℓ, ContinuousLinearMap.ofTendstoOfBoundedRange_apply]
  rw [hℓ]
  exact hf y

informal_problem.statement: {ι : Type} [Countable ι] (a : ℕ → ι → ℝ) (hb : ∀ d : ι, ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ n, |a n d| ≤ R) : ∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ ∧ ∀ d : ι, ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l → |a (ψ m) d - a (ψ l) d| < η

signature.name: bounded_seq_countable_diag
signature.statement: {ι : Type} [Countable ι] (a : ℕ → ι → ℝ) (hb : ∀ d : ι, ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ n, |a n d| ≤ R) : ∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ ∧ ∀ d : ι, ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l → |a (ψ m) d - a (ψ l) d| < η

proof.tactics:
by
  choose R hR using hb
  have hK : IsCompact (Set.univ.pi (fun d : ι => Set.Icc (-R d) (R d))) :=
    isCompact_univ_pi (fun d => isCompact_Icc)
  have hx : ∀ n, a n ∈ Set.univ.pi (fun d : ι => Set.Icc (-R d) (R d)) := by
    intro n
    rw [Set.mem_univ_pi]
    intro d
    exact abs_le.mp (hR d n)
  obtain ⟨c, _, ψ, hψ, hlim⟩ := hK.tendsto_subseq hx
  refine ⟨ψ, hψ, fun d η hη => ?_⟩
  have hd : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a (ψ n) d) Filter.atTop (nhds (c d)) :=
    tendsto_pi_nhds.mp hlim d
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hd (η / 2) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨N, fun m l hm hl => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hN m hm
  have h2 := hN l hl
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at h1 h2
  have h3 := abs_lt.mp h1
  have h4 := abs_lt.mp h2
  rw [abs_lt]
  constructor <;> linarith [h3.1, h3.2, h4.1, h4.2]

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : E2 → ℝ) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v W) (a b s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hsub : {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} ⊆ W) : ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, v x ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, v x) ^ 2 / s ^ 2 + s ^ 2 * ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k v x) ^ 2

signature.name: poincare_halfopen_square
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : E2 → ℝ) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v W) (a b s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hsub : {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} ⊆ W) : ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, v x ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, v x) ^ 2 / s ^ 2 + s ^ 2 * ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k v x) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have h₁ : a ≤ a + s := by linarith
  have h₂ : b ≤ b + s := by linarith
  
  have hvc : ContinuousOn v W := hv.continuousOn
  have hdc : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (pd2 k v) W := by
    intro k
    have h1 := hv.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hdiff : ∀ p ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ v p := fun p hp =>
    (hv.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp)
  
  have hPcont : Continuous (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (!₂[z.1, z.2] : E2)) := by
    have h : (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => (!₂[z.1, z.2] : E2)) = fun z => z.1 • e2 0 + z.2 • e2 1 := by
      funext z
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [h]
    fun_prop
  have hS_mem : ∀ x y : ℝ, x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + s) → y ∈ Set.Icc b (b + s) →
      (!₂[x, y] : E2) ∈ {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} := by
    intro x y hx hy
    exact ⟨hx.1, hx.2, hy.1, hy.2⟩
  
  have hline0 : ∀ x y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (!₂[t, y] : E2)) (e2 0) x := by
    intro x y
    have h : (fun t : ℝ => (!₂[t, y] : E2)) = fun t => (!₂[x, y] : E2) + (t - x) • e2 0 := by
      funext t
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [h]
    have := (((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const x).smul_const (e2 0)).const_add (!₂[x, y] : E2)
    simpa using this
  have hline1 : ∀ x y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (!₂[x, t] : E2)) (e2 1) y := by
    intro x y
    have h : (fun t : ℝ => (!₂[x, t] : E2)) = fun t => (!₂[x, y] : E2) + (t - y) • e2 1 := by
      funext t
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [h]
    have := (((hasDerivAt_id y).sub_const y).smul_const (e2 1)).const_add (!₂[x, y] : E2)
    simpa using this
  have hsl0 : ∀ x y : ℝ, (!₂[x, y] : E2) ∈ W →
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => v !₂[t, y]) (pd2 0 v !₂[x, y]) x := by
    intro x y hxy
    exact (hdiff _ hxy).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt x (hline0 x y)
  have hsl1 : ∀ x y : ℝ, (!₂[x, y] : E2) ∈ W →
      HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => v !₂[x, t]) (pd2 1 v !₂[x, y]) y := by
    intro x y hxy
    exact (hdiff _ hxy).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt y (hline1 x y)
  
  obtain ⟨pa, hpadef⟩ : ∃ pa : ℝ → ℝ, pa = fun t => (Set.projIcc a (a + s) h₁ t : ℝ) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨pb, hpbdef⟩ : ∃ pb : ℝ → ℝ, pb = fun t => (Set.projIcc b (b + s) h₂ t : ℝ) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpa : Continuous pa := by rw [hpadef]; exact continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_projIcc
  have hpb : Continuous pb := by rw [hpbdef]; exact continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_projIcc
  have hpa_mem : ∀ t, pa t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + s) := fun t => by
    rw [hpadef]; exact (Set.projIcc a (a + s) h₁ t).2
  have hpb_mem : ∀ t, pb t ∈ Set.Icc b (b + s) := fun t => by
    rw [hpbdef]; exact (Set.projIcc b (b + s) h₂ t).2
  have hpa_eq : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a (a + s), pa t = t := fun t ht => by
    simp only [hpadef, Set.projIcc_of_mem h₁ ht]
  have hpb_eq : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc b (b + s), pb t = t := fun t ht => by
    simp only [hpbdef, Set.projIcc_of_mem h₂ ht]
  obtain ⟨Pc, hPcdef⟩ : ∃ Pc : ℝ × ℝ → E2, ∀ z, Pc z = !₂[pa z.1, pb z.2] := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hPc : Continuous Pc := by
