    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg s]

informal_problem.statement: (K L : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (Z : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (Q : ℤ × ℤ → Set E2) (hQm : ∀ z ∈ Z, MeasurableSet (Q z)) (hQd : ∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ z' ∈ Z, z ≠ z' → Disjoint (Q z) (Q z')) (hQK : ∀ z ∈ Z, Q z ⊆ K) (hLQ : L ⊆ ⋃ z ∈ Z, Q z) (F G : E2 → ℝ) (hF : ContinuousOn F K) (hG : ContinuousOn G K) (hF0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) (hG0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ G x) (c : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hcell : ∀ z ∈ Z, ∫ x in Q z, F x ≤ c z + t * ∫ x in Q z, G x) : ∫ x in L, F x ≤ (∑ z ∈ Z, c z) + t * ∫ x in K, G x

signature.name: cell_sum_bound
signature.statement: (K L : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (Z : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)) (Q : ℤ × ℤ → Set E2) (hQm : ∀ z ∈ Z, MeasurableSet (Q z)) (hQd : ∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ z' ∈ Z, z ≠ z' → Disjoint (Q z) (Q z')) (hQK : ∀ z ∈ Z, Q z ⊆ K) (hLQ : L ⊆ ⋃ z ∈ Z, Q z) (F G : E2 → ℝ) (hF : ContinuousOn F K) (hG : ContinuousOn G K) (hF0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ F x) (hG0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ G x) (c : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hcell : ∀ z ∈ Z, ∫ x in Q z, F x ≤ c z + t * ∫ x in Q z, G x) : ∫ x in L, F x ≤ (∑ z ∈ Z, c z) + t * ∫ x in K, G x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hFK : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn F K := hF.integrableOn_compact hK
  have hGK : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn G K := hG.integrableOn_compact hK
  have hUK : (⋃ z ∈ Z, Q z) ⊆ K := Set.iUnion₂_subset (fun z hz => hQK z hz)
  have hFU : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn F (⋃ z ∈ Z, Q z) := hFK.mono_set hUK
  have hpw : (↑Z : Set (ℤ × ℤ)).Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint Q) :=
    fun z hz z' hz' hne => hQd z (Finset.mem_coe.1 hz) z' (Finset.mem_coe.1 hz') hne
  have hA : ∫ x in L, F x ≤ ∫ x in ⋃ z ∈ Z, Q z, F x :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set hFU (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hF0) hLQ.eventuallyLE
  have hB : ∫ x in ⋃ z ∈ Z, Q z, F x = ∑ z ∈ Z, ∫ x in Q z, F x :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_biUnion_finset Z hQm hpw (fun z hz => hFK.mono_set (hQK z hz))
  have hB' : ∫ x in ⋃ z ∈ Z, Q z, G x = ∑ z ∈ Z, ∫ x in Q z, G x :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_biUnion_finset Z hQm hpw (fun z hz => hGK.mono_set (hQK z hz))
  have hC : ∑ z ∈ Z, ∫ x in Q z, F x ≤ ∑ z ∈ Z, (c z + t * ∫ x in Q z, G x) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z hz => hcell z hz)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← hB'] at hC
  have hD0 : ∫ x in ⋃ z ∈ Z, Q z, G x ≤ ∫ x in K, G x :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set hGK (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hG0) hUK.eventuallyLE
  have hD : t * ∫ x in ⋃ z ∈ Z, Q z, G x ≤ t * ∫ x in K, G x :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD0 ht
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (K Q : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (hQ : MeasurableSet Q) (hQK : Q ⊆ K) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f K) : |∫ x in Q, f x| ≤ (volume.real K + ∫ x in K, f x ^ 2) / 2

signature.name: cell_integral_abs_bound
signature.statement: (K Q : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (hQ : MeasurableSet Q) (hQK : Q ⊆ K) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f K) : |∫ x in Q, f x| ≤ (volume.real K + ∫ x in K, f x ^ 2) / 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.measurableSet
  have habsK : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => |f x|) K MeasureTheory.volume :=
    hf.abs.integrableOn_compact hK
  have hsqK : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) K MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (hf.pow 2).integrableOn_compact hK
  have honeK : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun _ : E2 => (1 : ℝ)) K MeasureTheory.volume :=
    continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hK
  have h1 : |∫ x in Q, f x| ≤ ∫ x in Q, |f x| :=
    MeasureTheory.abs_integral_le_integral_abs
  have h2 : ∫ x in Q, |f x| ≤ ∫ x in K, |f x| :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set habsK
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => abs_nonneg (f x))) hQK.eventuallyLE
  have h3 : ∫ x in K, |f x| ≤ ∫ x in K, (1 + f x ^ 2) / 2 :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on habsK ((honeK.add hsqK).div_const 2) hKm
      (fun x _ => by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|f x| - 1), sq_abs (f x)])
  have h4 : ∫ x in K, (1 + f x ^ 2) / 2 = (volume.real K + ∫ x in K, f x ^ 2) / 2 := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_div, MeasureTheory.integral_add honeK hsqK,
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (G : E2 → ℝ) (a b s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hG : ContinuousOn G {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s}) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn G {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} MeasureTheory.volume ∧ (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, G x) = (∫ y in b..b + s, ∫ x in a..a + s, G !₂[x, y]) ∧ (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, G x) = (∫ x in a..a + s, ∫ y in b..b + s, G !₂[x, y])

signature.name: square_iterated_integral
signature.statement: (G : E2 → ℝ) (a b s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hG : ContinuousOn G {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s}) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn G {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} MeasureTheory.volume ∧ (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, G x) = (∫ y in b..b + s, ∫ x in a..a + s, G !₂[x, y]) ∧ (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, G x) = (∫ x in a..a + s, ∫ y in b..b + s, G !₂[x, y])

proof.tactics:
by
  have h₁ : a ≤ a + s := by linarith
  have h₂ : b ≤ b + s := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨ee, hee⟩ : ∃ ee : E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ,
      ee = (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have he : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving ee MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume := by
    rw [hee]
    exact (MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ).comp
      (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 2))
  have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding ee := ee.measurableEmbedding
  have hee_apply : ∀ x : E2, ee x = (x 0, x 1) := by
    intro x; rw [hee]; rfl
  have hee_symm : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ee.symm p = (!₂[p.1, p.2] : E2) := by
    intro p; rw [hee]; rfl
  have hQ : {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} =
      ee ⁻¹' (Set.Ico a (a + s) ×ˢ Set.Ico b (b + s)) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, hee_apply, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Ico]
    tauto
  have hpt : ∀ x : E2, G !₂[(ee x).1, (ee x).2] = G x := by
    intro x
    rw [← hee_symm, ee.symm_apply_apply]
  
  have hP : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (!₂[p.1, p.2] : E2)) := by
    have h : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (!₂[p.1, p.2] : E2)) =
        fun p => p.1 • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ) +
          p.2 • EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ) := by
      funext p
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [h]
    fun_prop
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (!₂[p.1, p.2] : E2))
      (Set.Icc a (a + s) ×ˢ Set.Icc b (b + s))
      {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} :=
    fun p hp => ⟨hp.1.1, hp.1.2, hp.2.1, hp.2.2⟩
  have hg : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G !₂[p.1, p.2])
      (Set.Icc a (a + s) ×ˢ Set.Icc b (b + s)) :=
    hG.comp hP.continuousOn hmaps
  have hR : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G !₂[p.1, p.2])
      (Set.Ico a (a + s) ×ˢ Set.Ico b (b + s)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (hg.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)).mono_set
      (Set.prod_mono Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self)
  have hswapmaps : Set.MapsTo Prod.swap (Set.Icc b (b + s) ×ˢ Set.Icc a (a + s))
      (Set.Icc a (a + s) ×ˢ Set.Icc b (b + s)) := fun z hz => ⟨hz.2, hz.1⟩
  have hR' : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => G !₂[z.swap.1, z.swap.2])
      (Set.Ico b (b + s) ×ˢ Set.Ico a (a + s)) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    ((hg.comp continuous_swap.continuousOn hswapmaps).integrableOn_compact
      (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)).mono_set
      (Set.prod_mono Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self)
  
  have hIco : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c d : ℝ), c ≤ d → ∫ t in Set.Ico c d, f t = ∫ t in c..d, f t := by
    intro f c d hcd
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Ico_eq_integral_Ioo, ← MeasureTheory.integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo,
      intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hcd]
  
  have hint : (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, G x) =
      ∫ p in Set.Ico a (a + s) ×ˢ Set.Ico b (b + s), G !₂[p.1, p.2] := by
    have h := he.setIntegral_preimage_emb hemb (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G !₂[p.1, p.2])
      (Set.Ico a (a + s) ×ˢ Set.Ico b (b + s))
    simp only [hpt] at h
    rw [hQ]
    exact h
  
  have hX : (∫ p in Set.Ico a (a + s) ×ˢ Set.Ico b (b + s), G !₂[p.1, p.2]) =
      ∫ x in a..a + s, ∫ y in b..b + s, G !₂[x, y] := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod] at hR
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_prod _ hR]
    simp only [hIco _ b (b + s) h₂]
    exact hIco _ a (a + s) h₁
  
  have hY : (∫ p in Set.Ico a (a + s) ×ˢ Set.Ico b (b + s), G !₂[p.1, p.2]) =
      ∫ y in b..b + s, ∫ x in a..a + s, G !₂[x, y] := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod] at hR'
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.volume_eq_prod,
      ← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_prod_swap (Set.Ico a (a + s)) (Set.Ico b (b + s)),
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_prod _ hR']
    simp only [Prod.swap_prod_mk]
    simp only [hIco _ a (a + s) h₁]
    exact hIco _ b (b + s) h₂
  refine ⟨?_, hint.trans hY, hint.trans hX⟩
  have h := (he.integrableOn_comp_preimage hemb (f := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G !₂[p.1, p.2])
    (s := Set.Ico a (a + s) ×ˢ Set.Ico b (b + s))).mpr hR
  rw [hQ]
  refine h.congr_fun (fun x _ => ?_) (ee.measurable (measurableSet_Ico.prod measurableSet_Ico))
  exact hpt x

informal_problem.statement: (c s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc c (c + s))) (hf' : ContinuousOn f' (Set.Icc c (c + s))) (hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo c (c + s), HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) : ∫ x in c..c + s, f x ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in c..c + s, f x) ^ 2 / s + s ^ 2 * ∫ x in c..c + s, f' x ^ 2

signature.name: poincare_interval
signature.statement: (c s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc c (c + s))) (hf' : ContinuousOn f' (Set.Icc c (c + s))) (hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo c (c + s), HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) : ∫ x in c..c + s, f x ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in c..c + s, f x) ^ 2 / s + s ^ 2 * ∫ x in c..c + s, f' x ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcs : c ≤ c + s := by linarith
  
  have hCS : ∀ p q : ℝ, p ≤ q → ∀ h : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn h (Set.Icc p q) →
      (∫ x in p..q, h x) ^ 2 ≤ (q - p) * ∫ x in p..q, h x ^ 2 := by
    intro p q hpq h hh
    obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : ℝ, J = ∫ x in p..q, h x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable h MeasureTheory.volume p q := hh.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hpq
    have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => h x ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume p q :=
      (hh.pow 2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hpq
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ x in p..q, ((q - p) * h x - J) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hpq (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hexp : (∫ x in p..q, ((q - p) * h x - J) ^ 2) =
        (q - p) ^ 2 * (∫ x in p..q, h x ^ 2) - 2 * (q - p) * J * J + (q - p) * J ^ 2 := by
      have e : (fun x => ((q - p) * h x - J) ^ 2) =
          fun x => ((q - p) ^ 2 * h x ^ 2 - (2 * (q - p) * J) * h x) + J ^ 2 := by
        funext x; ring
      rw [e, intervalIntegral.integral_add ((hi2.const_mul _).sub (hi1.const_mul _))
          intervalIntegrable_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hi2.const_mul _) (hi1.const_mul _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, ← hJ]
    rw [hexp] at hnn
    rw [← hJ]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hpq with hpq' | hpq'
    · subst hpq'
      have hJ0 : J = 0 := by rw [hJ]; exact intervalIntegral.integral_same
      rw [hJ0]; simp
    · have hL : 0 < q - p := by linarith
      nlinarith
  have hII : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc c (c + s)) →
      IntervalIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume c (c + s) :=
    fun g hg => hg.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hcs
  
  have hvar : (∫ x in c..c + s, f x ^ 2) =
      (∫ x in c..c + s, (f x - f c) ^ 2) + 2 * f c * (∫ x in c..c + s, f x) - s * f c ^ 2 := by
    have e : (fun x => (f x - f c) ^ 2) = fun x => (f x ^ 2 - (2 * f c) * f x) + f c ^ 2 := by
      funext x; ring
    rw [e, intervalIntegral.integral_add ((hII _ (hf.pow 2)).sub ((hII _ hf).const_mul _))
        intervalIntegrable_const,
      intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hII _ (hf.pow 2)) ((hII _ hf).const_mul _),
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hpt : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc c (c + s), (f x - f c) ^ 2 ≤ s * ∫ t in c..c + s, f' t ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx
    have hsub : Set.Icc c x ⊆ Set.Icc c (c + s) := Set.Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hx.2
    have hftc : (∫ t in c..x, f' t) = f x - f c :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hx.1 (hf.mono hsub)
        (fun t ht => hd t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_le hx.2⟩)
        ((hf'.mono hsub).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hx.1)
    have h1 := hCS c x hx.1 f' (hf'.mono hsub)
    rw [hftc] at h1
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ∫ t in c..x, f' t ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hx.1 (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have h3 : (∫ t in c..x, f' t ^ 2) ≤ ∫ t in c..c + s, f' t ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_interval le_rfl hx.1 hx.2
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => sq_nonneg (f' t))) (hII _ (hf'.pow 2))
    have h4 : x - c ≤ s := by linarith [hx.2]
    have h5 : 0 ≤ x - c := by linarith [hx.1]
    have h6 : (x - c) * (∫ t in c..x, f' t ^ 2) ≤ s * ∫ t in c..c + s, f' t ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul h4 h3 h2 hs.le
    linarith
  have hmono : (∫ x in c..c + s, (f x - f c) ^ 2) ≤
      ∫ x in c..c + s, s * ∫ t in c..c + s, f' t ^ 2 :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hcs (hII _ ((hf.sub continuousOn_const).pow 2))
      intervalIntegrable_const hpt
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul] at hmono
  have hcc : c + s - c = s := by ring
  rw [hcc] at hmono
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := hs.ne'
  have hId : (∫ x in c..c + s, f x) ^ 2 / s - 2 * f c * (∫ x in c..c + s, f x) + s * f c ^ 2 =
      ((∫ x in c..c + s, f x) - f c * s) ^ 2 / s := by
    field_simp; ring
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ((∫ x in c..c + s, f x) - f c * s) ^ 2 / s := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hs.le
  rw [hvar]
  nlinarith [hmono, hId, hnn]

informal_problem.statement: (a b s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (F F2 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hF : Continuous F) (hF2 : Continuous F2) (hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + s), ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioo b (b + s), HasDerivAt (fun t => F (x, t)) (F2 (x, y)) y) : ∫ y in b..b + s, (∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, y)) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ y in b..b + s, ∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, y)) ^ 2 / s + s ^ 3 * ∫ x in a..a + s, ∫ y in b..b + s, F2 (x, y) ^ 2

signature.name: mean_slice_bound
signature.statement: (a b s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (F F2 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hF : Continuous F) (hF2 : Continuous F2) (hd : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + s), ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioo b (b + s), HasDerivAt (fun t => F (x, t)) (F2 (x, y)) y) : ∫ y in b..b + s, (∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, y)) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ y in b..b + s, ∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, y)) ^ 2 / s + s ^ 3 * ∫ x in a..a + s, ∫ y in b..b + s, F2 (x, y) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have h₁ : a ≤ a + s := by linarith
  have h₂ : b ≤ b + s := by linarith
  
  have CS : ∀ p q : ℝ, p ≤ q → ∀ h : ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn h (Set.Icc p q) →
      (∫ x in p..q, h x) ^ 2 ≤ (q - p) * ∫ x in p..q, h x ^ 2 := by
    intro p q hpq h hh
    have hi : IntervalIntegrable h volume p q := hh.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hpq
    have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => h x ^ 2) volume p q :=
      (hh.pow 2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hpq
    obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : ℝ, J = ∫ x in p..q, h x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨H0, hH0⟩ : ∃ H0 : ℝ, H0 = ∫ x in p..q, h x ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hJ, ← hH0]
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ x in p..q, ((q - p) * h x - J) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hpq (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hexp : ∫ x in p..q, ((q - p) * h x - J) ^ 2 = (q - p) * ((q - p) * H0 - J ^ 2) := by
      have e1 : ∀ x, ((q - p) * h x - J) ^ 2 =
          ((q - p) ^ 2 * h x ^ 2 - (2 * (q - p) * J) * h x) + J ^ 2 := fun x => by ring
      simp_rw [e1]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((hi2.const_mul _).sub (hi.const_mul _))
          intervalIntegrable_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hi2.const_mul _) (hi.const_mul _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, ← hJ, ← hH0]
      ring
    rw [hexp] at hnn
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hpq with hpq' | hpq'
    · subst hpq'
      have : J = 0 := by rw [hJ, intervalIntegral.integral_same]
      rw [this]; simp
    · have hL : 0 < q - p := by linarith
      have := (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hL).mp hnn
      linarith
  
  have hGc : Continuous (fun y => ∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, y)) :=
    intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      (f := fun y x => F (x, y)) (by exact hF.comp continuous_swap) a (a + s)
  have hHc : Continuous (fun x => ∫ y in b..b + s, F2 (x, y) ^ 2) :=
    intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      (f := fun x y => F2 (x, y) ^ 2) (by exact hF2.pow 2) b (b + s)
  have hFx : ∀ y : ℝ, Continuous (fun x => F (x, y)) := fun y =>
    hF.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hFy : ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun t => F (x, t)) := fun x =>
    hF.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  have hF2y : ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun t => F2 (x, t)) := fun x =>
    hF2.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  
  have VAR : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous g → ∀ lam : ℝ,
      ∫ y in b..b + s, g y ^ 2 ≤ (∫ y in b..b + s, g y) ^ 2 / s + ∫ y in b..b + s, (g y - lam) ^ 2 := by
    intro g hg lam
    have hi : IntervalIntegrable g volume b (b + s) := hg.intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => g x ^ 2) volume b (b + s) :=
      (hg.pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
    obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ : ∃ I : ℝ, I = ∫ y in b..b + s, g y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = ∫ y in b..b + s, g y ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hexp : ∫ y in b..b + s, (g y - lam) ^ 2 = A - 2 * lam * I + s * lam ^ 2 := by
      have e1 : ∀ y, (g y - lam) ^ 2 = (g y ^ 2 - (2 * lam) * g y) + lam ^ 2 := fun y => by ring
      simp_rw [e1]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hi2.sub (hi.const_mul _)) intervalIntegrable_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub hi2 (hi.const_mul _),
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul,
        ← hI, ← hA]
      ring
    rw [hexp, ← hI, ← hA]
    have hsq : (I - lam * s) ^ 2 / s = I ^ 2 / s - 2 * lam * I + s * lam ^ 2 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have hnn : 0 ≤ (I - lam * s) ^ 2 / s := div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hs.le
    linarith
  
  have SEG : ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + s), ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc b (b + s),
      (F (x, y) - F (x, b)) ^ 2 ≤ s * ∫ t in b..b + s, F2 (x, t) ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have hftc : ∫ t in b..y, F2 (x, t) = F (x, y) - F (x, b) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hy.1 (hFy x).continuousOn
        (fun t ht => hd x hx t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_le hy.2⟩)
        ((hF2y x).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    have hcs := CS b y hy.1 (fun t => F2 (x, t)) (hF2y x).continuousOn
    rw [hftc] at hcs
    have hmono : ∫ t in b..y, F2 (x, t) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ t in b..b + s, F2 (x, t) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_interval le_rfl hy.1 hy.2
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => sq_nonneg (F2 (x, t)))
        (((hF2y x).pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ t in b..y, F2 (x, t) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hy.1 (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hyb : y - b ≤ s := by linarith [hy.2]
    calc (F (x, y) - F (x, b)) ^ 2 ≤ (y - b) * ∫ t in b..y, F2 (x, t) ^ 2 := hcs
      _ ≤ s * ∫ t in b..b + s, F2 (x, t) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul hyb hmono hnn hs.le
  
  have PT : ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc b (b + s),
      ((∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, y)) - ∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, b)) ^ 2 ≤
        s * (s * ∫ x in a..a + s, ∫ y in b..b + s, F2 (x, y) ^ 2) := by
    intro y hy
    have e1 : (∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, y)) - (∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, b)) =
        ∫ x in a..a + s, (F (x, y) - F (x, b)) :=
      (intervalIntegral.integral_sub ((hFx y).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((hFx b).intervalIntegrable _ _)).symm
    have hcs := CS a (a + s) h₁ (fun x => F (x, y) - F (x, b))
      ((hFx y).sub (hFx b)).continuousOn
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at hcs
    have hint : ∫ x in a..a + s, (F (x, y) - F (x, b)) ^ 2 ≤
        ∫ x in a..a + s, s * ∫ t in b..b + s, F2 (x, t) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on h₁ ((((hFx y).sub (hFx b)).pow 2).intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((continuous_const.mul hHc).intervalIntegrable _ _) (fun x hx => SEG x hx y hy)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hint
    rw [e1]
    calc (∫ x in a..a + s, (F (x, y) - F (x, b))) ^ 2
        ≤ s * ∫ x in a..a + s, (F (x, y) - F (x, b)) ^ 2 := hcs
      _ ≤ s * (s * ∫ x in a..a + s, ∫ y in b..b + s, F2 (x, y) ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint hs.le
  
  have hB : ∫ y in b..b + s, ((∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, y)) - ∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, b)) ^ 2 ≤
      s ^ 3 * ∫ x in a..a + s, ∫ y in b..b + s, F2 (x, y) ^ 2 := by
    have hm := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (μ := volume) h₂
      (((hGc.sub continuous_const).pow 2).intervalIntegrable b (b + s))
      (intervalIntegrable_const (c := s * (s * ∫ x in a..a + s, ∫ y in b..b + s, F2 (x, y) ^ 2)))
      PT
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, add_sub_cancel_left] at hm
    calc _ ≤ _ := hm
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hA := VAR (fun y => ∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, y)) hGc (∫ x in a..a + s, F (x, b))
  simp only at hA
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (g : E2 → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g volume) (η : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hηc : ∀ j, Continuous (η j)) (hη0 : ∀ j y, 0 ≤ η j y) (hη1 : ∀ j, ∫ y, η j y = 1) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ : Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0)) (hηs : ∀ j (y : E2), δ j ≤ ‖y‖ → η j y = 0) : (∀ j, Integrable (fun x => (∫ t, η j t * g (x - t)) - g x) volume) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, |(∫ t, η j t * g (x - t)) - g x|) atTop (𝓝 0)

signature.name: elr_moll_L1
signature.statement: (g : E2 → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g volume) (η : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hηc : ∀ j, Continuous (η j)) (hη0 : ∀ j y, 0 ≤ η j y) (hη1 : ∀ j, ∫ y, η j y = 1) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ : Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0)) (hηs : ∀ j (y : E2), δ j ≤ ‖y‖ → η j y = 0) : (∀ j, Integrable (fun x => (∫ t, η j t * g (x - t)) - g x) volume) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, |(∫ t, η j t * g (x - t)) - g x|) atTop (𝓝 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hconv : ∀ (k ζ : E2 → ℝ), (fun x => ∫ t, ζ t * k (x - t)) =
      convolution ζ k (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume := by
    intro k ζ
    funext x
    rw [convolution_def]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have contract : ∀ (ζ : E2 → ℝ), Continuous ζ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ζ y) → (∫ y, ζ y = 1) →
      ∀ r : ℝ, (∀ y : E2, r ≤ ‖y‖ → ζ y = 0) → ∀ h : E2 → ℝ, Integrable h volume →
      (∀ x : E2, Integrable (fun t => ζ t * h (x - t)) volume) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => ∫ t, ζ t * h (x - t)) volume ∧
      ∫ x, |∫ t, ζ t * h (x - t)| ≤ ∫ x, |h x| := by
    intro ζ hc h0 h1 r hs h hh
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport ζ := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E2) r) ?_
      intro y hy
      apply hs
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at hy
      exact le_of_lt (not_le.mp hy)
    have hζi : Integrable ζ volume := hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hc.bounded_above_of_compact_support hcs
    have hi : ∀ x : E2, Integrable (fun t => ζ t * h (x - t)) volume := by
      intro x
      exact (hh.comp_sub_left x).bdd_mul hc.aestronglyMeasurable (Eventually.of_forall hC)
    have hTi : ∀ k : E2 → ℝ, Integrable k volume →
        Integrable (fun x => ∫ t, ζ t * k (x - t)) volume := by
      intro k hk
      rw [hconv k ζ]
      exact hζi.integrable_convolution (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) hk
    refine ⟨hi, hTi h hh, ?_⟩
    have hpt : ∀ x, |∫ t, ζ t * h (x - t)| ≤ ∫ t, ζ t * |h (x - t)| := by
      intro x
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      refine (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      refine integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun t => ?_)
      simp only [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (h0 t)]
    have e : (fun x => ∫ t, ζ t * |h (x - t)|) =
        convolution ζ (fun y => |h y|) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume :=
      hconv (fun y => |h y|) ζ
    have hHi : Integrable (fun x => ∫ t, ζ t * |h (x - t)|) volume := hTi (fun y => |h y|) hh.abs
    have hH : ∫ x, (∫ t, ζ t * |h (x - t)|) = ∫ x, |h x| := by
      rw [e, integral_convolution (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) hζi hh.abs]
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h1, one_mul]
    calc ∫ x, |∫ t, ζ t * h (x - t)| ≤ ∫ x, (∫ t, ζ t * |h (x - t)|) :=
          integral_mono_of_nonneg (Eventually.of_forall fun x => abs_nonneg _) hHi
            (Eventually.of_forall hpt)
      _ = ∫ x, |h x| := hH
  
  have cc : ∀ γ : E2 → ℝ, Continuous γ → HasCompactSupport γ →
      Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, |(∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) - γ x|) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro γ hγc hγs
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0 : E2)).1 hγs.isCompact.isBounded
    have hSm : MeasurableSet (closedBall (0 : E2) (T + 1)) := isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet
    have hSf : volume (closedBall (0 : E2) (T + 1)) < ⊤ := measure_closedBall_lt_top
    have hV0 : 0 ≤ volume.real (closedBall (0 : E2) (T + 1)) := measureReal_nonneg
    obtain ⟨ε', hε'0, hVε⟩ : ∃ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' ∧ volume.real (closedBall (0 : E2) (T + 1)) * ε' < ε := by
      refine ⟨ε / (2 * (volume.real (closedBall (0 : E2) (T + 1)) + 1)), by positivity, ?_⟩
      rw [mul_div_assoc', div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hργ⟩ :=
      Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.1 (hγs.uniformContinuous_of_continuous hγc) ε' hε'0
    filter_upwards [hδ.eventually_lt_const (lt_min hρ one_pos)] with j hj
    have hjρ : δ j < ρ := lt_of_lt_of_le hj (min_le_left _ _)
    have hj1 : δ j < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hj (min_le_right _ _)
    have hγ0 : ∀ y, T < ‖y‖ → γ y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      intro hmem
      have := hT hmem
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at this
      linarith
    have hbd : ∀ x, |(∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) - γ x| ≤ ε' := by
      intro x
      have e := congrFun (hconv γ (η j)) x
      simp only at e
      rw [e, ← Real.dist_eq]
      refine dist_convolution_le (R := ρ) (le_of_lt hε'0) ?_ (hη0 j) (hη1 j)
        hγc.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      · intro y hy
        rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
        by_contra hc
        exact hy (hηs j y (le_trans hjρ.le (not_lt.mp hc)))
      · intro y hy
        exact (hργ (mem_ball.mp hy)).le
    have hvan : ∀ x, x ∉ closedBall (0 : E2) (T + 1) → |(∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) - γ x| = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] at hx
      have h1 : γ x = 0 := hγ0 x (by linarith)
      have h2 : ∀ t, η j t * γ (x - t) = 0 := by
        intro t
        by_cases ht : δ j ≤ ‖t‖
        · rw [hηs j t ht, zero_mul]
        · push_neg at ht
          rw [hγ0 (x - t) ?_, mul_zero]
          have := norm_sub_norm_le x t
          linarith
      simp [h1, h2]
    have hle : ∀ x, |(∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) - γ x| ≤
        (closedBall (0 : E2) (T + 1)).indicator (fun _ => ε') x := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ closedBall (0 : E2) (T + 1)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]; exact hbd x
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, hvan x hx]
    have hint : Integrable ((closedBall (0 : E2) (T + 1)).indicator (fun _ : E2 => ε')) volume :=
      (integrable_indicator_iff hSm).2 (integrableOn_const hSf.ne)
    have hI : ∫ x, (closedBall (0 : E2) (T + 1)).indicator (fun _ : E2 => ε') x =
        volume.real (closedBall (0 : E2) (T + 1)) * ε' := by
      rw [integral_indicator hSm, setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul]
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ x, |(∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) - γ x| :=
      integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
    have hmono := integral_mono_of_nonneg (Eventually.of_forall fun x => abs_nonneg _) hint
      (Eventually.of_forall hle)
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hnn]
    linarith
  
  refine ⟨fun j => ((contract (η j) (hηc j) (hη0 j) (hη1 j) (δ j) (hηs j) g hg).2.1).sub hg, ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨γ, hγs, hγε, hγc, hγi⟩ :=
    hg.exists_hasCompactSupport_integral_sub_le (show (0 : ℝ) < ε / 4 by positivity)
  filter_upwards [(Metric.tendsto_nhds.1 (cc γ hγc hγs)) (ε / 4) (by positivity)] with j hj
  have hnn0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x, |(∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) - γ x| := integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hnn0] at hj
  obtain ⟨ig, Tg, cg⟩ := contract (η j) (hηc j) (hη0 j) (hη1 j) (δ j) (hηs j) g hg
  obtain ⟨iγ, Tγ, cγ⟩ := contract (η j) (hηc j) (hη0 j) (hη1 j) (δ j) (hηs j) γ hγi
  obtain ⟨id, Td, cd⟩ := contract (η j) (hηc j) (hη0 j) (hη1 j) (δ j) (hηs j)
    (fun y => g y - γ y) (hg.sub hγi)
  have hlin : ∀ x, (∫ t, η j t * g (x - t)) - (∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) =
      ∫ t, η j t * (g (x - t) - γ (x - t)) := by
    intro x
    rw [← integral_sub (ig x) (iγ x)]
    congr 1
    funext t
    ring
  have hpt : ∀ x, |(∫ t, η j t * g (x - t)) - g x| ≤
      (|∫ t, η j t * (g (x - t) - γ (x - t))| + |(∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) - γ x|) +
        |γ x - g x| := by
    intro x
    rw [← hlin x]
    have e : (∫ t, η j t * g (x - t)) - g x =
        ((∫ t, η j t * g (x - t)) - (∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t))) +
          ((∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) - γ x) + (γ x - g x) := by ring
    rw [e]
    exact abs_add_three _ _ _
  have i1 : Integrable (fun x => |∫ t, η j t * (g (x - t) - γ (x - t))|) volume := Td.abs
  have i2 : Integrable (fun x => |(∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) - γ x|) volume := (Tγ.sub hγi).abs
  have i3 : Integrable (fun x => |γ x - g x|) volume := (hγi.sub hg).abs
  have i12 : Integrable (fun x => |∫ t, η j t * (g (x - t) - γ (x - t))| +
      |(∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) - γ x|) volume := i1.add i2
  have hmono : ∫ x, |(∫ t, η j t * g (x - t)) - g x| ≤
      ∫ x, ((|∫ t, η j t * (g (x - t) - γ (x - t))| + |(∫ t, η j t * γ (x - t)) - γ x|) +
        |γ x - g x|) :=
    integral_mono_of_nonneg (Eventually.of_forall fun x => abs_nonneg _) (i12.add i3)
      (Eventually.of_forall hpt)
  rw [integral_add i12 i3, integral_add i1 i2] at hmono
  have hgγ : ∫ x, |g x - γ x| ≤ ε / 4 := by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hγε
  have h3 : ∫ x, |γ x - g x| = ∫ x, |g x - γ x| := by
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact abs_sub_comm _ _
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ x, |(∫ t, η j t * g (x - t)) - g x| := integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hnn]
  have cd' : ∫ x, |∫ t, η j t * (g (x - t) - γ (x - t))| ≤ ∫ x, |g x - γ x| := cd
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (U : Set E2) (K : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (f g : E2 → ℝ) (hf : IntegrableOn f K volume) (hg : IntegrableOn g K volume) (m : Fin 2) (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, f x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, g x * ζ x)) (η : E2 → ℝ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hηs : ∀ y : E2, δ ≤ ‖y‖ → η y = 0) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∫ t, η t * K.indicator f (z - t)) ∧ ∀ x : E2, Metric.closedBall x δ ⊆ K → pd2 m (fun z => ∫ t, η t * K.indicator f (z - t)) x = ∫ t, η t * K.indicator g (x - t)

signature.name: elr_moll_transfer
signature.statement: (U : Set E2) (K : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (f g : E2 → ℝ) (hf : IntegrableOn f K volume) (hg : IntegrableOn g K volume) (m : Fin 2) (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, f x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, g x * ζ x)) (η : E2 → ℝ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hηs : ∀ y : E2, δ ≤ ‖y‖ → η y = 0) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∫ t, η t * K.indicator f (z - t)) ∧ ∀ x : E2, Metric.closedBall x δ ⊆ K → pd2 m (fun z => ∫ t, η t * K.indicator f (z - t)) x = ∫ t, η t * K.indicator g (x - t)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hfo : Integrable (K.indicator f) volume :=
    (integrable_indicator_iff hK.measurableSet).2 hf
  have hloc : LocallyIntegrable (K.indicator f) volume := hfo.locallyIntegrable
  have hcη : HasCompactSupport η := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E2) δ) (fun y hy => ?_)
    apply hηs
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hy
    exact hy.le
  have hconv : (fun z => ∫ t, η t * K.indicator f (z - t)) =
      MeasureTheory.convolution η (K.indicator f) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume := by
    funext z
    rw [MeasureTheory.convolution_def]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hconv]
    exact hcη.contDiff_convolution_left (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) hη hloc
  · intro x hx
    have hD := hcη.hasFDerivAt_convolution_left (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ)
      (hη.of_le (by simp)) hloc x
    have hE := HasCompactSupport.convolutionExists_left
      (ContinuousLinearMap.precompL E2 (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ))
      (hcη.fderiv ℝ) (hη.continuous_fderiv (by simp)) hloc
    have hI := hE x
    unfold MeasureTheory.ConvolutionExistsAt at hI
    have hpd : pd2 m (fun z => ∫ t, η t * K.indicator f (z - t)) x =
        ∫ t, pd2 m η t * K.indicator f (x - t) := by
      unfold pd2
      rw [hconv, hD.fderiv, MeasureTheory.convolution_def,
        ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hI]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.precompL_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ : ∃ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ζ = fun y => η (x - y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hout : ∀ y, y ∉ K → δ < ‖x - y‖ := by
      intro y hy
      have h' : y ∉ Metric.closedBall x δ := fun h => hy (hx h)
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, not_le, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at h'
      exact h'
    have hvan : ∀ y, y ∉ Metric.closedBall x δ → ζ y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, not_le, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at hy
      rw [hζ]
      exact hηs _ hy.le
    have hζs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ := by
      rw [hζ]
      exact hη.comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)
    have hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ := HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall x δ) hvan
    have hζt : tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.closedBall x δ :=
      closure_minimal (Function.support_subset_iff'.2 hvan) Metric.isClosed_closedBall
    have hζd : ∀ y, pd2 m ζ y = -pd2 m η (x - y) := by
      intro y
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt η (fderiv ℝ η (x - y)) (x - y) :=
        ((hη.differentiable (by simp)) (x - y)).hasFDerivAt
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y' : E2 => x - y') (-ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2) y := by
        simpa using (hasFDerivAt_id y).const_sub x
      have h3 := h1.comp y h2
      unfold pd2
      rw [show ζ = η ∘ (fun y' => x - y') from hζ, h3.fderiv]
      simp
    have hηt : tsupport η ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 δ := by
      refine closure_minimal (Function.support_subset_iff'.2 fun y hy => ?_)
        Metric.isClosed_closedBall
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hy
      exact hηs _ hy.le
    have hηd : ∀ t, δ < ‖t‖ → pd2 m η t = 0 := by
      intro t ht
      have hnt : t ∉ tsupport (fderiv ℝ η) := by
        intro h
        have h' := hηt (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ h)
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at h'
        linarith
      unfold pd2
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hnt]
      rfl
    have hW := hweak ζ hζs hζc (hζt.trans (hx.trans hKU))
    rw [hpd]
    have e2' : ∫ t, pd2 m η t * K.indicator f (x - t) =
        ∫ y, pd2 m η (x - y) * K.indicator f y := by
      have h := MeasureTheory.integral_sub_left_eq_self
        (fun y => pd2 m η (x - y) * K.indicator f y) volume x
      simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at h
      exact h
    have e3 : (fun y => pd2 m η (x - y) * K.indicator f y) = fun y => -(f y * pd2 m ζ y) := by
      funext y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ K
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy, hζd]; ring
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, hζd, hηd _ (hout y hy)]; ring
    have e6 : (fun y => g y * ζ y) = fun y => η (x - y) * K.indicator g y := by
      funext y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ K
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy, hζ]; ring
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, hζ, hηs _ (hout y hy).le, mul_zero]
    have e7 : ∫ y, η (x - y) * K.indicator g y = ∫ t, η t * K.indicator g (x - t) := by
      have h := MeasureTheory.integral_sub_left_eq_self
        (fun t => η t * K.indicator g (x - t)) volume x
      simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at h
      exact h
    rw [e2', e3, MeasureTheory.integral_neg, hW, neg_neg, e6, e7]

informal_problem.statement: (x₀ : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ψ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R, |ψ x| ≤ C * ((∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |ψ y|) + (∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 0 ψ y|) + (∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 1 ψ y|) + (∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|))

signature.name: elr_sup_local
signature.statement: (x₀ : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ ψ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ R, |ψ x| ≤ C * ((∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |ψ y|) + (∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 0 ψ y|) + (∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 1 ψ y|) + (∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have T_smooth : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ∀ k : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd2 k f) := by
    intro f hf k
    have h := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hf).2
    exact h.clm_apply contDiff_const
  
  have T_supp : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), tsupport (pd2 k f) ⊆ tsupport f := by
    intro f k
    refine (closure_mono ?_).trans (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ)
    intro y hy
    simp only [Function.mem_support] at hy ⊢
    intro h0
    apply hy
    simp [pd2, h0]
  have T_hcs : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ), HasCompactSupport f → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      HasCompactSupport (pd2 k f) := fun f hc k => hc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e2 k)
  
  have T_mul : ∀ (a b : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ a → ContDiff ℝ ∞ b → ∀ (k : Fin 2) (y : E2),
      pd2 k (fun z => a z * b z) y = pd2 k a y * b y + a y * pd2 k b y := by
    intro a b ha hb k y
    have hda : DifferentiableAt ℝ a y := (ha.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    have hdb : DifferentiableAt ℝ b y := (hb.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    show fderiv ℝ (a * b) y (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ a y (e2 k) * b y + a y * fderiv ℝ b y (e2 k)
    rw [fderiv_mul hda hdb]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have T_add : ∀ (p q : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ p → ContDiff ℝ ∞ q → ∀ (k : Fin 2) (y : E2),
      pd2 k (fun z => p z + q z) y = pd2 k p y + pd2 k q y := by
    intro p q hp hq k y
    have hdp : DifferentiableAt ℝ p y := (hp.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    have hdq : DifferentiableAt ℝ q y := (hq.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    show fderiv ℝ (p + q) y (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ p y (e2 k) + fderiv ℝ q y (e2 k)
    rw [fderiv_add hdp hdq]
    rfl
  
  have T_line : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ (k : Fin 2) (x : E2),
      Integrable (fun s : ℝ => |pd2 k f (x + s • e2 k)|) ∧
        |f x| ≤ ∫ s : ℝ, |pd2 k f (x + s • e2 k)| := by
    intro f hf hc k x
    have hpc : Continuous (pd2 k f) := (T_smooth f hf k).continuous
    have hdf : Differentiable ℝ f := hf.differentiable (by simp)
    obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀⟩ := hc.isCompact.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : E2)
    obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = max T₀ 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hT : tsupport f ⊆ closedBall (0 : E2) T :=
      hT₀.trans (closedBall_subset_closedBall (by rw [hTdef]; exact le_max_left _ _))
    have hT0 : 0 ≤ T := by rw [hTdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
    have hnorm : ∀ s : ℝ, |s| - ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x + s • e2 k‖ := by
      intro s
      have h1 : ‖s • e2 k‖ = |s| := by
        rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h2 := norm_sub_le (x + s • e2 k) x
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left, h1] at h2
      linarith
    have hout : ∀ s : ℝ, T + ‖x‖ < |s| → x + s • e2 k ∉ tsupport f := by
      intro s hs hmem
      have h1 := hT hmem
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at h1
      have h2 := hnorm s
      linarith
    have hzero : ∀ s : ℝ, T + ‖x‖ < |s| → f (x + s • e2 k) = 0 := fun s hs =>
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (hout s hs)
    have hzero' : ∀ s : ℝ, T + ‖x‖ < |s| → pd2 k f (x + s • e2 k) = 0 := fun s hs =>
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hout s hs (T_supp f k h))
    have hgc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => pd2 k f (x + s • e2 k)) :=
      hpc.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))
    have hint : Integrable (fun s : ℝ => |pd2 k f (x + s • e2 k)|) := by
      refine hgc.abs.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ?_
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : ℝ) (T + ‖x‖)) ?_
      intro s hs
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, Real.norm_eq_abs, not_le] at hs
      rw [hzero' s hs, abs_zero]
    refine ⟨hint, ?_⟩
    have hderiv : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (x + s • e2 k))
        (pd2 k f (x + s • e2 k)) s := by
      intro s
      have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x + s • e2 k) (e2 k) s := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const (e2 k)).const_add x
      exact (hdf (x + s • e2 k)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hγ
    have hxn := norm_nonneg x
    have hA0 : -(T + ‖x‖ + 1) ≤ 0 := by linarith
    have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (a := -(T + ‖x‖ + 1)) (b := 0)
      (fun s _ => hderiv s) (hgc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
    have hfA : f (x + (-(T + ‖x‖ + 1)) • e2 k) = 0 := by
      apply hzero
      rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      linarith
    rw [hfA, zero_smul, add_zero, sub_zero] at hftc
    calc |f x| = |∫ s in (-(T + ‖x‖ + 1))..0, pd2 k f (x + s • e2 k)| := by rw [hftc]
      _ ≤ ∫ s in (-(T + ‖x‖ + 1))..0, |pd2 k f (x + s • e2 k)| :=
          intervalIntegral.abs_integral_le_integral_abs hA0
      _ = ∫ s in Set.Ioc (-(T + ‖x‖ + 1)) 0, |pd2 k f (x + s • e2 k)| :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hA0
      _ ≤ ∫ s, |pd2 k f (x + s • e2 k)| :=
          setIntegral_le_integral hint (Eventually.of_forall fun s => abs_nonneg _)
  
  have T_fub : ∀ (G : E2 → ℝ), Continuous G → HasCompactSupport G → ∀ x : E2,
      Integrable (fun s : ℝ => ∫ t : ℝ, G (x + s • e2 0 + t • e2 1)) ∧
        ∫ s : ℝ, ∫ t : ℝ, G (x + s • e2 0 + t • e2 1) = ∫ y, G y := by
    intro G hG hc x
    let Φ : E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ :=
      (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow
    have hΦ : MeasurePreserving Φ volume volume :=
      (MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ).comp
        (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 2))
    have hΦs : MeasurePreserving Φ.symm volume volume := hΦ.symm Φ
    have hP : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, Φ.symm p = p.1 • e2 0 + p.2 • e2 1 := by
      intro p
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Φ, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> rfl
    have hGi : Integrable G := hG.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hc
    have hFi : Integrable (fun y => G (x + y)) := hGi.comp_add_left x
    have hFeq : ∫ y, G (x + y) = ∫ y, G y := integral_add_left_eq_self G x
    have hint : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => G (x + Φ.symm p)) :=
      (hΦs.integrable_comp_emb Φ.symm.measurableEmbedding).2 hFi
    have h1 : ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, G (x + Φ.symm p) = ∫ y, G (x + y) :=
      hΦs.integral_comp' (fun y => G (x + y))
    have h2 : ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, G (x + Φ.symm p) = ∫ s, ∫ t, G (x + Φ.symm (s, t)) :=
      integral_prod _ hint
    have h3 := hint.integral_prod_left
    have hpt : ∀ s t : ℝ, G (x + Φ.symm (s, t)) = G (x + s • e2 0 + t • e2 1) := by
      intro s t
      rw [hP, add_assoc]
    rw [h1, hFeq] at h2
    simp only [hpt] at h2 h3
    exact ⟨h3, h2.symm⟩
  
  have hglob : ∀ φ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∀ x : E2,
      |φ x| ≤ ∫ y, |pd2 1 (pd2 0 φ) y| := by
    intro φ hφ hφc x
    have hg₀ := T_smooth φ hφ 0
    have hg₀c := T_hcs φ hφc 0
    have hH := (T_smooth _ hg₀ 1).continuous
    have hHc := T_hcs _ hg₀c 1
    obtain ⟨hI₀, hb₀⟩ := T_line φ hφ hφc 0 x
    obtain ⟨hI₁, hfub⟩ := T_fub (fun y => |pd2 1 (pd2 0 φ) y|) hH.abs hHc.abs x
    have hpt : ∀ s : ℝ, |pd2 0 φ (x + s • e2 0)| ≤
        ∫ t, |pd2 1 (pd2 0 φ) (x + s • e2 0 + t • e2 1)| :=
      fun s => (T_line _ hg₀ hg₀c 1 (x + s • e2 0)).2
    calc |φ x| ≤ ∫ s : ℝ, |pd2 0 φ (x + s • e2 0)| := hb₀
      _ ≤ ∫ s : ℝ, ∫ t : ℝ, |pd2 1 (pd2 0 φ) (x + s • e2 0 + t • e2 1)| :=
          integral_mono hI₀ hI₁ hpt
      _ = ∫ y, |pd2 1 (pd2 0 φ) y| := hfub
  
  let b : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨R, 3 * R / 2, hR, by linarith⟩
  have hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (⇑b : E2 → ℝ) := b.contDiff
  have hχc : HasCompactSupport (⇑b : E2 → ℝ) := b.hasCompactSupport
  have hχ1 : ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ R, b y = 1 := fun y hy =>
    b.one_of_mem_closedBall (ball_subset_closedBall hy)
  have hχs : tsupport (⇑b : E2 → ℝ) = closedBall x₀ (3 * R / 2) := b.tsupport_eq
  have hbd : ∀ F : E2 → ℝ, Continuous F → HasCompactSupport F → ∃ C, ∀ y, |F y| ≤ C := by
    intro F hF hFc
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hF.bounded_above_of_compact_support hFc
    exact ⟨C, fun y => by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hC y⟩
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hbd b hχ.continuous hχc
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := hbd (pd2 0 b) (T_smooth b hχ 0).continuous (T_hcs b hχc 0)
  obtain ⟨C₃, hC₃⟩ := hbd (pd2 1 b) (T_smooth b hχ 1).continuous (T_hcs b hχc 1)
  obtain ⟨C₄, hC₄⟩ := hbd (pd2 1 (pd2 0 b)) (T_smooth _ (T_smooth b hχ 0) 1).continuous
    (T_hcs _ (T_hcs b hχc 0) 1)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = max 0 (max (max C₁ C₂) (max C₃ C₄)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by rw [hM]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hM1 : ∀ y, |b y| ≤ M := fun y => (hC₁ y).trans (by
    rw [hM]; exact le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) (le_max_right _ _))
  have hM2 : ∀ y, |pd2 0 b y| ≤ M := fun y => (hC₂ y).trans (by
    rw [hM]; exact le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _)) (le_max_right _ _))
  have hM3 : ∀ y, |pd2 1 b y| ≤ M := fun y => (hC₃ y).trans (by
    rw [hM]; exact le_trans (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_right _ _))
  have hM4 : ∀ y, |pd2 1 (pd2 0 b) y| ≤ M := fun y => (hC₄ y).trans (by
    rw [hM]; exact le_trans (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) (le_max_right _ _))
  refine ⟨M, hM0, ?_⟩
  
  intro ψ hψ x hx
  have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => b z * ψ z) := hχ.mul hψ
  have hφc : HasCompactSupport (fun z => b z * ψ z) := hχc.mul_right
  have hφx : b x * ψ x = ψ x := by rw [hχ1 x hx, one_mul]
  have hψ0 := T_smooth ψ hψ 0
  have hb0 := T_smooth b hχ 0
  
  have h0φ : pd2 0 (fun z => b z * ψ z) = fun z => pd2 0 b z * ψ z + b z * pd2 0 ψ z :=
    funext fun z => T_mul b ψ hχ hψ 0 z
  have hE : ∀ y, pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => b z * ψ z)) y =
      pd2 1 (pd2 0 b) y * ψ y + pd2 0 b y * pd2 1 ψ y +
        (pd2 1 b y * pd2 0 ψ y + b y * pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y) := by
    intro y
    rw [h0φ, T_add _ _ (hb0.mul hψ) (hχ.mul hψ0) 1 y, T_mul _ _ hb0 hψ 1 y,
      T_mul _ _ hχ hψ0 1 y]
  have hpw : ∀ y, |pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => b z * ψ z)) y| ≤
      M * (|ψ y| + |pd2 0 ψ y| + |pd2 1 ψ y| + |pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|) := by
    intro y
    rw [hE y]
    calc _ ≤ |pd2 1 (pd2 0 b) y * ψ y| + |pd2 0 b y * pd2 1 ψ y| +
          (|pd2 1 b y * pd2 0 ψ y| + |b y * pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|) :=
          (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) (abs_add_le _ _))
      _ = |pd2 1 (pd2 0 b) y| * |ψ y| + |pd2 0 b y| * |pd2 1 ψ y| +
          (|pd2 1 b y| * |pd2 0 ψ y| + |b y| * |pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|) := by
          simp only [abs_mul]
      _ ≤ M * |ψ y| + M * |pd2 1 ψ y| + (M * |pd2 0 ψ y| + M * |pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|) :=
          add_le_add (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM4 y) (abs_nonneg _))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM2 y) (abs_nonneg _)))
            (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM3 y) (abs_nonneg _))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM1 y) (abs_nonneg _)))
      _ = M * (|ψ y| + |pd2 0 ψ y| + |pd2 1 ψ y| + |pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|) := by ring
  have hsupp : tsupport (pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => b z * ψ z))) ⊆ tsupport (⇑b : E2 → ℝ) :=
    (T_supp _ 1).trans ((T_supp _ 0).trans (tsupport_mul_subset_left))
  have hvan : ∀ y ∉ ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => b z * ψ z)) y| = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : y ∉ tsupport (pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => b z * ψ z))) := by
      intro hm
      have h1 := hsupp hm
      rw [hχs, mem_closedBall] at h1
      rw [mem_ball, not_lt] at hy
      linarith
    rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy', abs_zero]
  have hrestr : ∫ y in ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => b z * ψ z)) y| =
      ∫ y, |pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => b z * ψ z)) y| :=
    setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hvan
  have hIB : ∀ F : E2 → ℝ, Continuous F → IntegrableOn F (ball x₀ (2 * R)) := fun F hF =>
    (hF.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall x₀ (2 * R))).mono_set
      ball_subset_closedBall
  have c0 := hψ.continuous
  have c1 := hψ0.continuous
  have c2 := (T_smooth ψ hψ 1).continuous
  have c3 := (T_smooth _ hψ0 1).continuous
  have cH := (T_smooth _ (T_smooth _ hφ 0) 1).continuous
  have hmono : ∫ y in ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => b z * ψ z)) y| ≤
      ∫ y in ball x₀ (2 * R), M * (|ψ y| + |pd2 0 ψ y| + |pd2 1 ψ y| + |pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|) :=
    setIntegral_mono_on (hIB _ cH.abs)
      (hIB _ (continuous_const.mul (((c0.abs.add c1.abs).add c2.abs).add c3.abs)))
      measurableSet_ball (fun y _ => hpw y)
  have hlin : ∫ y in ball x₀ (2 * R), M * (|ψ y| + |pd2 0 ψ y| + |pd2 1 ψ y| + |pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|)
      = M * ((∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |ψ y|) + (∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 0 ψ y|)
        + (∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 1 ψ y|)
        + (∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|)) := by
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add, integral_add, integral_add]
    · exact hIB _ c0.abs
    · exact hIB _ c1.abs
    · exact hIB _ (c0.abs.add c1.abs)
    · exact hIB _ c2.abs
    · exact hIB _ ((c0.abs.add c1.abs).add c2.abs)
    · exact hIB _ c3.abs
  calc |ψ x| = |b x * ψ x| := by rw [hφx]
    _ ≤ ∫ y, |pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => b z * ψ z)) y| := hglob _ hφ hφc x
    _ = ∫ y in ball x₀ (2 * R), |pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => b z * ψ z)) y| := hrestr.symm
    _ ≤ _ := hmono
    _ = _ := hlin

informal_problem.statement: (B B₂ : Set E2) (hB₂ : IsOpen B₂) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hsup : ∀ ψ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ∀ x ∈ B, |ψ x| ≤ C * ((∫ y in B₂, |ψ y|) + (∫ y in B₂, |pd2 0 ψ y|) + (∫ y in B₂, |pd2 1 ψ y|) + (∫ y in B₂, |pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|))) (F : ℕ → List (Fin 2) → E2 → ℝ) (hF : ∀ j w, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F j w)) (hpd : ∀ j w (m : Fin 2), ∀ y ∈ B₂, pd2 m (F j w) y = F j (m :: w) y) (g : List (Fin 2) → E2 → ℝ) (hint : ∀ j w, Integrable (fun x => F j w x - g w x) volume) (hL1 : ∀ w, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, |F j w x - g w x|) atTop (𝓝 0)) : ∀ w, ∃ u : E2 → ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => F j w) u atTop B

signature.name: elr_unif_cauchy
signature.statement: (B B₂ : Set E2) (hB₂ : IsOpen B₂) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hsup : ∀ ψ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → ∀ x ∈ B, |ψ x| ≤ C * ((∫ y in B₂, |ψ y|) + (∫ y in B₂, |pd2 0 ψ y|) + (∫ y in B₂, |pd2 1 ψ y|) + (∫ y in B₂, |pd2 1 (pd2 0 ψ) y|))) (F : ℕ → List (Fin 2) → E2 → ℝ) (hF : ∀ j w, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F j w)) (hpd : ∀ j w (m : Fin 2), ∀ y ∈ B₂, pd2 m (F j w) y = F j (m :: w) y) (g : List (Fin 2) → E2 → ℝ) (hint : ∀ j w, Integrable (fun x => F j w x - g w x) volume) (hL1 : ∀ w, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, |F j w x - g w x|) atTop (𝓝 0)) : ∀ w, ∃ u : E2 → ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => F j w) u atTop B

proof.tactics:
by
  intro w
  
  have hd : ∀ (j k : ℕ) (v : List (Fin 2)) (m : Fin 2), ∀ y ∈ B₂,
      pd2 m (fun x => F j v x - F k v x) y = F j (m :: v) y - F k (m :: v) y := by
    intro j k v m y hy
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (F j v) y :=
      ((hF j v).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (F k v) y :=
      ((hF k v).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    rw [← hpd j v m y hy, ← hpd k v m y hy]
    unfold pd2
    rw [show (fun x => F j v x - F k v x) = F j v - F k v from rfl, fderiv_sub h1 h2]
    rfl
  
  have hmix : ∀ (j k : ℕ), ∀ y ∈ B₂,
      pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun x => F j w x - F k w x)) y
        = F j (1 :: 0 :: w) y - F k (1 :: 0 :: w) y := by
    intro j k y hy
    have hev : pd2 0 (fun x => F j w x - F k w x)
        =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun x => F j (0 :: w) x - F k (0 :: w) x) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hB₂.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hd j k w 0 z hz)
    rw [← hd j k (0 :: w) 1 y hy]
    have hfd := hev.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
    unfold pd2 at hfd ⊢
    rw [hfd]
  
  have hsplit : ∀ (a b c : E2 → ℝ), Integrable (fun x => a x - c x) volume →
      Integrable (fun x => b x - c x) volume →
      (∫ y in B₂, |a y - b y|) ≤ (∫ x, |a x - c x|) + (∫ x, |b x - c x|) := by
    intro a b c ha hb
    have hab : Integrable (fun x => a x - b x) volume := by
      refine (ha.sub hb).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
      ring
    calc (∫ y in B₂, |a y - b y|) ≤ ∫ x, |a x - b x| :=
          setIntegral_le_integral hab.abs (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ ∫ x, (|a x - c x| + |b x - c x|) := by
          refine integral_mono hab.abs (ha.abs.add hb.abs) (fun x => ?_)
          have h := abs_sub_le (a x) (c x) (b x)
          rw [abs_sub_comm (c x) (b x)] at h
          exact h
      _ = (∫ x, |a x - c x|) + (∫ x, |b x - c x|) := integral_add ha.abs hb.abs
  
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ j, S j = (∫ x, |F j w x - g w x|)
      + (∫ x, |F j (0 :: w) x - g (0 :: w) x|) + (∫ x, |F j (1 :: w) x - g (1 :: w) x|)
      + (∫ x, |F j (1 :: 0 :: w) x - g (1 :: 0 :: w) x|) := ⟨_, fun j => rfl⟩
  have hS : Tendsto S atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := (((hL1 w).add (hL1 (0 :: w))).add (hL1 (1 :: w))).add (hL1 (1 :: 0 :: w))
    simp only [add_zero] at h
    exact h.congr (fun j => (hSdef j).symm)
  
  have hbound : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ B, |F j w x - F k w x| ≤ C * (S j + S k) := by
    intro j k x hx
    have hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => F j w x - F k w x) := (hF j w).sub (hF k w)
    have h0 := hsup _ hψ x hx
    have e2 : (∫ y in B₂, |pd2 0 (fun x => F j w x - F k w x) y|)
        = ∫ y in B₂, |F j (0 :: w) y - F k (0 :: w) y| :=
      setIntegral_congr_fun hB₂.measurableSet (fun y hy => by simp only [hd j k w 0 y hy])
    have e3 : (∫ y in B₂, |pd2 1 (fun x => F j w x - F k w x) y|)
        = ∫ y in B₂, |F j (1 :: w) y - F k (1 :: w) y| :=
      setIntegral_congr_fun hB₂.measurableSet (fun y hy => by simp only [hd j k w 1 y hy])
    have e4 : (∫ y in B₂, |pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun x => F j w x - F k w x)) y|)
        = ∫ y in B₂, |F j (1 :: 0 :: w) y - F k (1 :: 0 :: w) y| :=
      setIntegral_congr_fun hB₂.measurableSet (fun y hy => by simp only [hmix j k y hy])
    rw [e2, e3, e4] at h0
    have i1 := hsplit (F j w) (F k w) (g w) (hint j w) (hint k w)
    have i2 := hsplit (F j (0 :: w)) (F k (0 :: w)) (g (0 :: w)) (hint j _) (hint k _)
    have i3 := hsplit (F j (1 :: w)) (F k (1 :: w)) (g (1 :: w)) (hint j _) (hint k _)
    have i4 := hsplit (F j (1 :: 0 :: w)) (F k (1 :: 0 :: w)) (g (1 :: 0 :: w))
      (hint j _) (hint k _)
    have hsum : (∫ y in B₂, |F j w y - F k w y|)
        + (∫ y in B₂, |F j (0 :: w) y - F k (0 :: w) y|)
        + (∫ y in B₂, |F j (1 :: w) y - F k (1 :: w) y|)
        + (∫ y in B₂, |F j (1 :: 0 :: w) y - F k (1 :: 0 :: w) y|) ≤ S j + S k := by
      rw [hSdef j, hSdef k]
      linarith
    exact h0.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hC)
  
  have hUC : UniformCauchySeqOn (fun j => F j w) atTop B := by
    rw [Metric.uniformCauchySeqOn_iff]
    intro ε hε
    have hden : 0 < 2 * C + 1 := by linarith
    have hδ : 0 < ε / (2 * C + 1) := div_pos hε hden
    have hδeq : ε / (2 * C + 1) * (2 * C + 1) = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden.ne'
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hS _ hδ
    refine ⟨N, fun m hm n hn x hx => ?_⟩
    have hm' := hN m hm
    have hn' := hN n hn
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hm' hn'
    have hm'' := (abs_lt.1 hm').2
    have hn'' := (abs_lt.1 hn').2
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have hb := hbound m n x hx
    have hkey : C * (S m + S n) ≤ C * (2 * (ε / (2 * C + 1))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hC
    nlinarith
  
  refine ⟨fun x => limUnder atTop (fun j => F j w x), ?_⟩
  refine hUC.tendstoUniformlyOn_of_tendsto (fun x hx => ?_)
  exact (hUC.cauchySeq hx).tendsto_limUnder

informal_problem.statement: (B : Set E2) (hB : IsOpen B) (F : ℕ → List (Fin 2) → E2 → ℝ) (u : List (Fin 2) → E2 → ℝ) (hd : ∀ j w, ∀ x ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F j w) x) (hpd : ∀ j w (m : Fin 2), ∀ x ∈ B, pd2 m (F j w) x = F j (m :: w) x) (hconv : ∀ w, TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => F j w) (u w) atTop B) : ∀ w, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u w) B

signature.name: elr_unif_tree_smooth
signature.statement: (B : Set E2) (hB : IsOpen B) (F : ℕ → List (Fin 2) → E2 → ℝ) (u : List (Fin 2) → E2 → ℝ) (hd : ∀ j w, ∀ x ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F j w) x) (hpd : ∀ j w (m : Fin 2), ∀ x ∈ B, pd2 m (F j w) x = F j (m :: w) x) (hconv : ∀ w, TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => F j w) (u w) atTop B) : ∀ w, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u w) B

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hrepr : ∀ L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      L = ∑ m : Fin 2, L (e2 m) • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
    intro L
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
    have hv : v = ∑ m : Fin 2, v.ofLp m • e2 m := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, Fin.sum_univ_two, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hL : L v = ∑ m : Fin 2, v.ofLp m * L (e2 m) := by
      calc L v = L (∑ m : Fin 2, v.ofLp m • e2 m) := congrArg L hv
        _ = ∑ m : Fin 2, v.ofLp m * L (e2 m) := by
          rw [map_sum]
          simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hL, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    rfl
  
  have hπ : ∀ m : Fin 2, ‖(EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro m
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun v => ?_)
    rw [one_mul]
    exact PiLp.norm_apply_le v m
  
  have hfd : ∀ j w, ∀ x ∈ B, HasFDerivAt (F j w)
      (∑ m : Fin 2, F j (m :: w) x • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x := by
    intro j w x hx
    have h := (hd j w x hx).hasFDerivAt
    have heq : fderiv ℝ (F j w) x =
        ∑ m : Fin 2, F j (m :: w) x • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
      calc fderiv ℝ (F j w) x
          = ∑ m : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (F j w) x (e2 m) • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
            hrepr _
        _ = _ := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => by rw [← hpd j w m x hx]; rfl)
    exact h.congr_fderiv heq
  
  have hlim : ∀ w, ∀ x ∈ B, HasFDerivAt (u w)
      (∑ m : Fin 2, u (m :: w) x • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x := by
    intro w x hx
    refine hasFDerivAt_of_tendstoUniformlyOn (f := fun j => F j w)
      (f' := fun j y => ∑ m : Fin 2, F j (m :: w) y • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ))
      (g' := fun y => ∑ m : Fin 2, u (m :: w) y • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ))
      hB ?_ (fun j y hy => hfd j w y hy) (fun y hy => (hconv w).tendsto_at hy) hx
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    intro ε hε
    filter_upwards [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 (hconv (0 :: w)) (ε / 2) (by linarith),
      Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.1 (hconv (1 :: w)) (ε / 2) (by linarith)] with j h0 h1 y hy
    have a0 := h0 y hy
    have a1 := h1 y hy
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at a0 a1
    set π0 := (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) with hπ0
    set π1 := (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) with hπ1
    set c0 := u (0 :: w) y - F j (0 :: w) y with hc0
    set c1 := u (1 :: w) y - F j (1 :: w) y with hc1
    have e : (∑ m : Fin 2, u (m :: w) y • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) -
        (∑ m : Fin 2, F j (m :: w) y • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) =
        c0 • π0 + c1 • π1 := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hc0, hc1, sub_smul]
      abel
    show dist (∑ m : Fin 2, u (m :: w) y • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ))
      (∑ m : Fin 2, F j (m :: w) y • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) < ε
    rw [dist_eq_norm, e]
    have n0 : ‖π0‖ ≤ 1 := hπ 0
    have n1 : ‖π1‖ ≤ 1 := hπ 1
    calc ‖c0 • π0 + c1 • π1‖ ≤ ‖c0 • π0‖ + ‖c1 • π1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = |c0| * ‖π0‖ + |c1| * ‖π1‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ |c0| * 1 + |c1| * 1 := by
          gcongr
      _ < ε := by linarith
  
  have hQ : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ w, ContDiffOn ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (u w) B := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro w
      rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiffOn_zero]
      exact fun x hx => (hlim w x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    | succ n ih =>
      intro w
      rw [Nat.cast_succ, contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hB]
      refine ⟨fun x hx => (hlim w x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h
        exact absurd h (WithTop.natCast_ne_top n)
      · have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun x => ∑ m : Fin 2,
            u (m :: w) x • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) B :=
          ContDiffOn.sum (fun m _ => (ih (m :: w)).smul contDiffOn_const)
        exact hs.congr (fun x hx => (hlim w x hx).fderiv)
  intro w
  exact contDiffOn_infty.2 (fun n => hQ n w)

informal_problem.statement: (j : ℕ) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (φ : E2 → ℝ) (hφ : elrSob (j + 1) U φ) (G' : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hG'L2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → ∀ m, MemLp (G' m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hG' : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, φ x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, G' m x * ζ x)) : ∀ m : Fin 2, elrSob j U (G' m)

signature.name: elr_sob_grad_any
signature.statement: (j : ℕ) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (φ : E2 → ℝ) (hφ : elrSob (j + 1) U φ) (G' : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hG'L2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → ∀ m, MemLp (G' m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hG' : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, φ x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, G' m x * ζ x)) : ∀ m : Fin 2, elrSob j U (G' m)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ φ₁ φ₂ : E2 → ℝ,
      (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp φ₁ 2 (volume.restrict L)) →
      (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp φ₂ 2 (volume.restrict L)) →
      (∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U →
        ∫ x, φ₁ x * ζ x = ∫ x, φ₂ x * ζ x) →
      ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict U), φ₁ x = φ₂ x := by
    intro φ₁ φ₂ h₁ h₂ h
    have hloc : MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => φ₁ x - φ₂ x) U volume := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.locallyIntegrableOn_iff hU.isLocallyClosed]
      intro k hkU hk
      haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict k) :=
        isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 hk.measure_lt_top.ne
      exact ((h₁ k hk hkU).sub (h₂ k hk hkU)).integrable (by norm_num)
    have h0 := hU.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero hloc (by
      intro g hg hgc hgU
      have hK : IsCompact (tsupport g) := hgc
      have hint : ∀ ψ : E2 → ℝ, MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (tsupport g)) →
          Integrable (fun x => ψ x * g x) := by
        intro ψ hψ
        haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (tsupport g)) :=
          isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 hK.measure_lt_top.ne
        have hi1 : IntegrableOn ψ (tsupport g) volume := hψ.integrable (by norm_num)
        have hi2 := hi1.mul_continuousOn hg.continuous.continuousOn hK
        refine (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset ?_).1 hi2
        intro x hx
        exact subset_tsupport g (fun h0 => hx (by simp [h0]))
      have i1 := hint φ₁ (h₁ _ hK hgU)
      have i2 := hint φ₂ (h₂ _ hK hgU)
      have e : (fun x => g x • (φ₁ x - φ₂ x)) = fun x => φ₁ x * g x - φ₂ x * g x := by
        funext x; simp only [smul_eq_mul]; ring
      rw [e, integral_sub i1 i2, h g hg hgc hgU, sub_self])
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' hU.measurableSet]
    filter_upwards [h0] with x hx hxU
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (hx hxU)
  
  have s2 : ∀ (i : ℕ) (ψ ψ' : E2 → ℝ), elrSob i U ψ →
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict U), ψ x = ψ' x) → elrSob i U ψ' := by
    intro i ψ ψ' hψ hae
    have hL2 : (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict L)) →
        ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp ψ' 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
      intro h L hL hLU
      exact (h L hL hLU).ae_eq (ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hLU hae)
    cases i with
    | zero => exact hL2 hψ
    | succ i =>
      obtain ⟨hψL2, Γ, hΓw, hΓ⟩ := hψ
      refine ⟨hL2 hψL2, Γ, ?_, hΓ⟩
      intro ζ hζ hζc hζU n
      refine (integral_congr_ae ?_).trans (hΓw ζ hζ hζc hζU n)
      have h1 := (ae_restrict_iff' hU.measurableSet).1 hae
      filter_upwards [h1] with x hx
      by_cases hxU : x ∈ U
      · rw [hx hxU]
      · have hxt : x ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h => hxU (hζU h)
        have h0 : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 := by
          by_contra hne
          exact hxt (support_fderiv_subset ℝ hne)
        simp [pd2, h0]
  
  intro m
  obtain ⟨_, G, hw, hG⟩ := hφ
  have hGL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
    cases j with
    | zero => exact hG m
    | succ i => exact (hG m).1
  have hae := s1 (G m) (G' m) hGL2 (fun L hL hLU => hG'L2 L hL hLU m)
    (fun ζ hζ hζc hζU => neg_inj.1 ((hw ζ hζ hζc hζU m).symm.trans (hG' ζ hζ hζc hζU m)))
  exact s2 j (G m) (G' m) (hG m) hae

signature.statement: (j : ℕ) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (ψ : E2 → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U) (φ : E2 → ℝ) (hφ : elrSob j U φ) : elrSob j U (fun x => ψ x * φ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hP : ∀ K : Set E2, IsCompact K → ∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict K) →
      Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ K → Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) := by
    intro K hK f g hf hg hgK
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict K) :=
      isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 hK.measure_lt_top.ne
    have hf1 : Integrable f (volume.restrict K) := hf.integrable (by norm_num)
    have hgc : HasCompactSupport g := hK.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport g) hgK
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hg.bounded_above_of_compact_support hgc
    have hon : IntegrableOn (fun x => f x * g x) K := by
      refine (hf1.norm.const_mul C).mono' (hf1.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hg.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_
      rw [norm_mul, mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC x) (norm_nonneg _)
    refine hon.integrable_of_forall_notMem_eq_zero ?_
    intro x hx
    simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hgK h))]
  
  have hL2mul : ∀ g f : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn g U →
      (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L)) →
      ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp (fun x => g x * f x) 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
    intro g f hg hf L hL hLU
    have hgL : ContinuousOn g L := hg.mono hLU
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hL.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hgL
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => g x * f x) (volume.restrict L) :=
      (hgL.aestronglyMeasurable hL.measurableSet).mul (hf L hL hLU).aestronglyMeasurable
    refine MemLp.of_le_mul (c := C) (hf L hL hLU) hmeas ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hL.measurableSet ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC x hx) (norm_nonneg _)
  
  have hcm : ∀ g : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn g U → ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, Continuous ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U →
      Continuous (fun x => g x * ζ x) := by
    intro g hg ζ hζ hζU
    refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x => ?_
    by_cases hx : x ∈ U
    · exact (hg.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).mul hζ.continuousAt
    · have hev : (fun y => g y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h => hx (hζU h))] with y hy
        simp [hy]
      exact continuousAt_const.congr hev.symm
  
  have htest : ∀ ψ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ U →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ψ x * ζ x) ∧
        ∀ (m : Fin 2) (x : E2), pd2 m (fun y => ψ y * ζ y) x = pd2 m ψ x * ζ x + ψ x * pd2 m ζ x := by
    intro ψ hψ ζ hζ hζU
    have hev : ∀ x, x ∉ U → ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := fun x hx =>
      notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h => hx (hζU h))
    have hev2 : ∀ x, x ∉ U → (fun y => ψ y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      filter_upwards [hev x hx] with y hy
      simp [hy]
    refine ⟨contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.2 fun x => ?_, fun m x => ?_⟩
    · by_cases hx : x ∈ U
      · exact (hψ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).mul hζ.contDiffAt
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hev2 x hx)
    · by_cases hx : x ∈ U
      · have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x :=
          (hψ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x := hζ.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by simp)
        simp only [pd2]
        change (fderiv ℝ (ψ * ζ) x) (e2 m) = _
        rw [fderiv_mul h1 h2]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · have hζx : ζ x = 0 := (hev x hx).self_of_nhds
        have hdζ : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 := by
          rw [(hev x hx).fderiv_eq]
          exact fderiv_const_apply _
        simp only [pd2]
        rw [(hev2 x hx).fderiv_eq, hdζ, hζx]
        simp
  
  have hpd : ∀ ψ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 m ψ) U := by
    intro ψ hψ m
    have h1 := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hψ).2
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hunf : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : E2 → ℝ), elrSob (j + 1) U φ ↔
      ((∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
        ∃ Gφ : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
          tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, φ x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, Gφ m x * ζ x)) ∧
          ∀ m : Fin 2, elrSob j U (Gφ m)) := fun _ _ => Iff.rfl
  have hmono : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : E2 → ℝ), elrSob (j + 1) U φ → elrSob j U φ := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro φ h
      exact ((hunf 0 φ).1 h).1
    | succ j ih =>
      intro φ h
      obtain ⟨hL2, Gφ, hw, hG⟩ := (hunf (j + 1) φ).1 h
      exact (hunf j φ).2 ⟨hL2, Gφ, hw, fun m => ih (Gφ m) (hG m)⟩
  have hL2of : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : E2 → ℝ), elrSob j U φ →
      ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
    intro j φ h
    cases j with
    | zero => exact h
    | succ j => exact ((hunf j φ).1 h).1
  have hdζ : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → ∀ m : Fin 2,
      Continuous (pd2 m ζ) ∧ tsupport (pd2 m ζ) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
    intro ζ hζ m
    refine ⟨(hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const, ?_⟩
    refine closure_minimal ?_ (isClosed_tsupport ζ)
    intro x hx
    apply support_fderiv_subset ℝ
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    intro h0
    exact (Function.mem_support.mp hx) (by show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e2 m) = 0; rw [h0]; rfl)
  have hlin : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ₁ φ₂ : E2 → ℝ) (c₁ c₂ : ℝ), elrSob j U φ₁ → elrSob j U φ₂ →
      elrSob j U (fun x => c₁ * φ₁ x + c₂ * φ₂ x) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro φ₁ φ₂ c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ L hL hLU
      exact ((h₁ L hL hLU).const_mul c₁).add ((h₂ L hL hLU).const_mul c₂)
    | succ j ih =>
      intro φ₁ φ₂ c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂
      obtain ⟨hL₁, G₁, hw₁, hG₁⟩ := (hunf j φ₁).1 h₁
      obtain ⟨hL₂, G₂, hw₂, hG₂⟩ := (hunf j φ₂).1 h₂
      refine (hunf j _).2 ⟨fun L hL hLU =>
        ((hL₁ L hL hLU).const_mul c₁).add ((hL₂ L hL hLU).const_mul c₂),
        fun m x => c₁ * G₁ m x + c₂ * G₂ m x, ?_, fun m => ih _ _ _ _ (hG₁ m) (hG₂ m)⟩
      intro ζ hζ hζc hζU m
      have hK : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc
      have hζcont : Continuous ζ := hζ.continuous
      obtain ⟨hdc, hds⟩ := hdζ ζ hζ m
      have i1 := hP _ hK φ₁ (pd2 m ζ) (hL₁ _ hK hζU) hdc hds
      have i2 := hP _ hK φ₂ (pd2 m ζ) (hL₂ _ hK hζU) hdc hds
      have j1 := hP _ hK (G₁ m) ζ (hL2of j _ (hG₁ m) _ hK hζU) hζcont subset_rfl
      have j2 := hP _ hK (G₂ m) ζ (hL2of j _ (hG₂ m) _ hK hζU) hζcont subset_rfl
      have ee1 := hw₁ ζ hζ hζc hζU m
      have ee2 := hw₂ ζ hζ hζc hζU m
      calc ∫ x, (c₁ * φ₁ x + c₂ * φ₂ x) * pd2 m ζ x
          = ∫ x, (c₁ * (φ₁ x * pd2 m ζ x) + c₂ * (φ₂ x * pd2 m ζ x)) := by
            congr 1; funext x; ring
        _ = c₁ * (∫ x, φ₁ x * pd2 m ζ x) + c₂ * (∫ x, φ₂ x * pd2 m ζ x) := by
            rw [integral_add (i1.const_mul c₁) (i2.const_mul c₂), integral_const_mul,
              integral_const_mul]
        _ = -(c₁ * (∫ x, G₁ m x * ζ x) + c₂ * (∫ x, G₂ m x * ζ x)) := by
            rw [ee1, ee2]; ring
        _ = -(∫ x, (c₁ * (G₁ m x * ζ x) + c₂ * (G₂ m x * ζ x))) := by
            rw [integral_add (j1.const_mul c₁) (j2.const_mul c₂), integral_const_mul,
              integral_const_mul]
        _ = -(∫ x, (c₁ * G₁ m x + c₂ * G₂ m x) * ζ x) := by
            congr 2; funext x; ring
  
  induction j generalizing ψ φ with
  | zero =>
    exact hL2mul ψ φ hψ.continuousOn hφ
  | succ j ih =>
    obtain ⟨hL2, Gφ, hw, hG⟩ := (hunf j φ).1 hφ
    have hGL2 : ∀ m, ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp (Gφ m) 2 (volume.restrict L) :=
      fun m => hL2of j _ (hG m)
    have hψφ := hL2mul ψ φ hψ.continuousOn hL2
    refine (hunf j _).2 ⟨hψφ, fun m x => pd2 m ψ x * φ x + ψ x * Gφ m x, ?_, fun m => ?_⟩
    · intro ζ hζ hζc hζU m
      have hK : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc
      obtain ⟨hχs, hprod⟩ := htest ψ hψ ζ hζ hζU
      have hχc : HasCompactSupport (fun x => ψ x * ζ x) := hζc.mul_left
      have hχsupp : tsupport (fun x => ψ x * ζ x) ⊆ tsupport ζ := tsupport_mul_subset_right
      have hχU : tsupport (fun x => ψ x * ζ x) ⊆ U := hχsupp.trans hζU
      have hid := hw (fun x => ψ x * ζ x) hχs hχc hχU m
      beta_reduce at hid
      obtain ⟨hdc, hds⟩ := hdζ ζ hζ m
      have ia : Integrable (fun x => φ x * (pd2 m ψ x * ζ x)) :=
        hP _ hK φ (fun x => pd2 m ψ x * ζ x) (hL2 _ hK hζU)
          (hcm _ (hpd ψ hψ m).continuousOn ζ hζ.continuous hζU) tsupport_mul_subset_right
      have ib : Integrable (fun x => ψ x * φ x * pd2 m ζ x) :=
        hP _ hK (fun x => ψ x * φ x) (pd2 m ζ) (hψφ _ hK hζU) hdc hds
      have ic : Integrable (fun x => Gφ m x * (ψ x * ζ x)) :=
        hP _ hK (Gφ m) (fun x => ψ x * ζ x) (hGL2 m _ hK hζU) hχs.continuous hχsupp
      have hL : ∫ x, φ x * pd2 m (fun y => ψ y * ζ y) x =
          (∫ x, φ x * (pd2 m ψ x * ζ x)) + ∫ x, ψ x * φ x * pd2 m ζ x := by
        rw [← integral_add ia ib]
        congr 1; funext x; rw [hprod m x]; ring
      have hR : ∫ x, (pd2 m ψ x * φ x + ψ x * Gφ m x) * ζ x =
          (∫ x, φ x * (pd2 m ψ x * ζ x)) + ∫ x, Gφ m x * (ψ x * ζ x) := by
        rw [← integral_add ia ic]
        congr 1; funext x; ring
      show ∫ x, ψ x * φ x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, (pd2 m ψ x * φ x + ψ x * Gφ m x) * ζ x)
      rw [hL] at hid
      rw [hR]
      linarith
    · have h1 := ih (pd2 m ψ) (hpd ψ hψ m) φ (hmono j φ hφ)
      have h2 := ih ψ hψ (Gφ m) (hG m)
      have h3 := hlin j _ _ 1 1 h1 h2
      convert h3 using 1
      funext x
      ring

informal_problem.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (q : E2 → ℝ) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U) (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (DF : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ m, MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ a, MemLp (F a) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ a m, MemLp (DF a m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgradF : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ a m : Fin 2, ∫ x, F a x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, DF a m x * ζ x)) (heq : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x - q x * v x * ζ x) = ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, F a x * pd2 a ζ x + f x * ζ x)) : (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp (fun x => q x * v x + f x - ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, (q x * v x + f x - ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x) * ζ x
