signature.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (q : E2 → ℝ) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U) (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (DF : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ m, MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ a, MemLp (F a) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ a m, MemLp (DF a m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgradF : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ a m : Fin 2, ∫ x, F a x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, DF a m x * ζ x)) (heq : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x - q x * v x * ζ x) = ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, F a x * pd2 a ζ x + f x * ζ x)) : (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp (fun x => q x * v x + f x - ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, (q x * v x + f x - ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x) * ζ x

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hpair : ∀ K : Set E2, IsCompact K → ∀ g φ : E2 → ℝ, MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict K) →
      ContinuousOn φ K → (∀ x, x ∉ K → φ x = 0) → Integrable (fun x => g x * φ x) := by
    intro K hK g φ hg hφ h0
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict K) :=
      isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hK.measure_lt_top.ne
    have hg1 : Integrable g (volume.restrict K) := hg.integrable (by norm_num)
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hφ
    have hon : IntegrableOn (fun x => g x * φ x) K :=
      hg1.mul_bdd (hφ.aestronglyMeasurable hK.measurableSet)
        (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hK.measurableSet hC)
    refine (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset ?_).mp hon
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxK
    exact hx (by simp [h0 x hxK])
  
  have hbmul : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → ∀ c φ : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn c L →
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L) → MemLp (fun x => c x * φ x) 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
    intro L hL c φ hc hφ
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hL.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hc
    refine hφ.of_le_mul (c := C)
      ((hc.aestronglyMeasurable hL.measurableSet).mul hφ.aestronglyMeasurable)
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hL.measurableSet ?_)
    intro x hx
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC x hx) (norm_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro L hL hLU
    obtain ⟨hv, -, -, hDF, hf⟩ := hL2 L hL hLU
    have hqv := hbmul L hL q v (hq.continuousOn.mono hLU) hv
    have hS : MemLp (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x) 2 (volume.restrict L) :=
      memLp_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hDF a a)
    exact (hqv.add hf).sub hS
  · intro ζ hζ hζc hζU
    have hK : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc
    obtain ⟨hv, hG, hF, hDF, hf⟩ := hL2 (tsupport ζ) hK hζU
    have hζ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → ζ x = 0 := fun x hx => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
    have hdζc : ∀ a : Fin 2, Continuous (pd2 a ζ) := fun a =>
      (hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hdζ0 : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → pd2 a ζ x = 0 := by
      intro a x hx
      have h1 : x ∉ Function.support (fderiv ℝ ζ) := fun h => hx (support_fderiv_subset ℝ h)
      have h2 : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 := by
        by_contra h; exact h1 h
      show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e2 a) = 0
      rw [h2]; rfl
    
    have hX : ∀ a b : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x) := by
      intro a b
      have h := hpair (tsupport ζ) hK (G b) (fun x => A x a b * pd2 a ζ x) (hG b)
        (((hA a b).continuousOn.mono hζU).mul (hdζc a).continuousOn)
        (fun x hx => by simp [hdζ0 a x hx])
      refine h.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
      simp only; ring
    have hY : Integrable (fun x => q x * v x * ζ x) := by
      have h := hpair (tsupport ζ) hK v (fun x => q x * ζ x) hv
        ((hq.continuousOn.mono hζU).mul hζ.continuous.continuousOn)
        (fun x hx => by simp [hζ0 x hx])
      refine h.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
      simp only; ring
    have hZ : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => F a x * pd2 a ζ x) := fun a =>
      hpair (tsupport ζ) hK (F a) (pd2 a ζ) (hF a) (hdζc a).continuousOn (hdζ0 a)
    have hW : Integrable (fun x => f x * ζ x) :=
      hpair (tsupport ζ) hK f ζ hf hζ.continuous.continuousOn hζ0
    have hD : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => DF a a x * ζ x) := fun a =>
      hpair (tsupport ζ) hK (DF a a) ζ (hDF a a) hζ.continuous.continuousOn hζ0
    have hS : Integrable (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => hX a b))
    have hZs : Integrable (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, F a x * pd2 a ζ x) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hZ a)
    have hDs : Integrable (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x * ζ x) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hD a)
    
    have e0 := heq ζ hζ hζc hζU
    have h1 : ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x - q x * v x * ζ x) =
        (∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x) -
          ∫ x, q x * v x * ζ x := integral_sub hS hY
    have h2 : ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, F a x * pd2 a ζ x + f x * ζ x) =
        (∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, F a x * pd2 a ζ x) + ∫ x, f x * ζ x := integral_add hZs hW
    have h3 : ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, F a x * pd2 a ζ x = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∫ x, F a x * pd2 a ζ x :=
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hZ a)
    have h4 : ∫ x, (q x * v x + f x - ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x) * ζ x =
        ∫ x, (q x * v x * ζ x + f x * ζ x - ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x * ζ x) := by
      congr 1; funext x; rw [sub_mul, Finset.sum_mul]; ring
    have h5a : ∫ x, (q x * v x * ζ x + f x * ζ x - ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x * ζ x) =
        (∫ x, (q x * v x * ζ x + f x * ζ x)) - ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x * ζ x :=
      integral_sub (hY.add hW) hDs
    have h5b : ∫ x, (q x * v x * ζ x + f x * ζ x) =
        (∫ x, q x * v x * ζ x) + ∫ x, f x * ζ x := integral_add hY hW
    have h5 : ∫ x, (q x * v x * ζ x + f x * ζ x - ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x * ζ x) =
        ((∫ x, q x * v x * ζ x) + ∫ x, f x * ζ x) - ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x * ζ x := by
      rw [h5a, h5b]
    have h6 : ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, DF a a x * ζ x = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∫ x, DF a a x * ζ x :=
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hD a)
    have g0 := hgradF ζ hζ hζc hζU 0 0
    have g1 := hgradF ζ hζ hζc hζU 1 1
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h3 h6
    rw [h4, h5, h6]
    rw [h1, h2, h3] at e0
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (q : E2 → ℝ) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U) (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (DF : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ m, MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ n m, MemLp (H n m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ a, MemLp (F a) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ a m, MemLp (DF a m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, v x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, G m x * ζ x)) (hgradG : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ n m : Fin 2, ∫ x, G n x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, H n m x * ζ x)) (hgradF : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ a m : Fin 2, ∫ x, F a x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, DF a m x * ζ x)) (heq : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x - q x * v x * ζ x) = ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, F a x * pd2 a ζ x + f x * ζ x)) (m : Fin 2) : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * H m b x * pd2 a ζ x - q x * G m x * ζ x) = ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, (DF a m x - ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x - (if a = m then f x else 0)) * pd2 a ζ x + pd2 m q x * v x * ζ x)

signature.name: elr_deriv_eq
signature.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (q : E2 → ℝ) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U) (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (DF : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ m, MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ n m, MemLp (H n m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ a, MemLp (F a) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ a m, MemLp (DF a m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, v x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, G m x * ζ x)) (hgradG : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ n m : Fin 2, ∫ x, G n x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, H n m x * ζ x)) (hgradF : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ a m : Fin 2, ∫ x, F a x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, DF a m x * ζ x)) (heq : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x - q x * v x * ζ x) = ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, F a x * pd2 a ζ x + f x * ζ x)) (m : Fin 2) : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * H m b x * pd2 a ζ x - q x * G m x * ζ x) = ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, (DF a m x - ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x - (if a = m then f x else 0)) * pd2 a ζ x + pd2 m q x * v x * ζ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ζ hζ hζc hζU
  
  have L2P : ∀ (K : Set E2), IsCompact K → ∀ g φ : E2 → ℝ, MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict K) →
      Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ K → Integrable (fun x => g x * φ x) := by
    intro K hK g φ hg hφ hs
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict K) := isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 hK.measure_lt_top.ne
    have hg1 : IntegrableOn g K := hg.integrable (by norm_num)
    have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => g x * φ x) K := hg1.mul_continuousOn hφ.continuousOn hK
    refine (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset ?_).1 h2
    exact (Function.support_mul_subset_right g φ).trans ((subset_tsupport φ).trans hs)
  
  have T1 : ∀ χ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ → HasCompactSupport χ → ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd2 i χ) ∧ HasCompactSupport (pd2 i χ) ∧ tsupport (pd2 i χ) ⊆ tsupport χ := by
    intro χ hχ hχc i
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ((contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hχ).2).clm_apply contDiff_const
    · exact HasCompactSupport.fderiv_apply ℝ hχc (e2 i)
    · refine closure_minimal ?_ (isClosed_tsupport χ)
      intro x hx
      apply support_fderiv_subset ℝ
      rw [Function.mem_support]
      intro h0
      exact (Function.mem_support.mp hx) (by show fderiv ℝ χ x (e2 i) = 0; rw [h0]; rfl)
  
  have Tcomm : ∀ χ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ → ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      pd2 i (pd2 j χ) = pd2 j (pd2 i χ) := by
    intro χ hχ i j
    have hd : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ χ) :=
      ((contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hχ).2).differentiable (by simp)
    have key : ∀ k l : Fin 2, ∀ x, pd2 k (pd2 l χ) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ χ) x (e2 k) (e2 l) := by
      intro k l x
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ χ y (e2 l)) x (e2 k) = _
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hd x) (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    funext x
    rw [key, key]
    exact (hχ.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      first
        | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
        | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
        | norm_num)).eq _ _
  
  have T2 : ∀ φ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ U → ∀ χ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ →
      HasCompactSupport χ → tsupport χ ⊆ U →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => φ x * χ x) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x => φ x * χ x) ∧
        tsupport (fun x => φ x * χ x) ⊆ tsupport χ := by
    intro φ hφ χ hχ hχc hχU
    refine ⟨?_, HasCompactSupport.mul_left hχc, tsupport_mul_subset_right⟩
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ U
    · exact (hφ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).mul hχ.contDiffAt
    · have hx' : x ∉ tsupport χ := fun h => hx (hχU h)
      have hev : χ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hx'
      have hev2 : (fun y => φ y * χ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
        simp [hy]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev2
  
  have hpdU : ∀ φ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ U → ∀ l : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 l φ) U := by
    intro φ hφ l
    have h1 := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hφ).2
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have WL : ∀ ψ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → ∀ (φ : E2 → ℝ) (Gφ : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ),
      (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧
        ∀ l, MemLp (Gφ l) 2 (volume.restrict L)) →
      (∀ χ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ → HasCompactSupport χ → tsupport χ ⊆ U →
        ∀ l : Fin 2, ∫ x, φ x * pd2 l χ x = -(∫ x, Gφ l x * χ x)) →
      ∀ χ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ → HasCompactSupport χ → tsupport χ ⊆ U → ∀ l : Fin 2,
        ∫ x, ψ x * φ x * pd2 l χ x = -(∫ x, pd2 l ψ x * φ x * χ x) - ∫ x, ψ x * Gφ l x * χ x := by
    intro ψ hψ φ Gφ hφL hφg χ hχ hχc hχU l
    have hKχ : IsCompact (tsupport χ) := hχc
    have P' := L2P (tsupport χ) hKχ
    have hφK := (hφL (tsupport χ) hKχ hχU).1
    have tχ := T2 ψ hψ χ hχ hχc hχU
    have tdl := T1 χ hχ hχc l
    have t1 := T2 (pd2 l ψ) (hpdU ψ hψ l) χ hχ hχc hχU
    have t2 := T2 ψ hψ (pd2 l χ) tdl.1 tdl.2.1 (tdl.2.2.trans hχU)
    have i1 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * (pd2 l ψ x * χ x)) :=
      P' φ _ hφK t1.1.continuous t1.2.2
    have i2 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * (ψ x * pd2 l χ x)) :=
      P' φ _ hφK t2.1.continuous (t2.2.2.trans tdl.2.2)
    have hprod : ∀ x, pd2 l (fun y => ψ y * χ y) x = pd2 l ψ x * χ x + ψ x * pd2 l χ x := by
      intro x
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => ψ y * χ y) x (e2 l) =
        fderiv ℝ ψ x (e2 l) * χ x + ψ x * fderiv ℝ χ x (e2 l)
      by_cases hx : x ∈ U
      · have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x :=
          (hψ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hχd : DifferentiableAt ℝ χ x := hχ.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by simp)
        first
          | rw [fderiv_fun_mul hψd hχd]
          | rw [show (fun y => ψ y * χ y) = ψ * χ from rfl, fderiv_mul hψd hχd]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · have hx' : x ∉ tsupport χ := fun h => hx (hχU h)
        have hev : χ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hx'
        have hev2 : (fun y => ψ y * χ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
          simp [hy]
        have hχx : χ x = 0 := hev.eq_of_nhds
        rw [hev2.fderiv_eq, hev.fderiv_eq, hχx]
        simp
    have h5 : ∫ x, φ x * pd2 l (fun y => ψ y * χ y) x = -(∫ x, Gφ l x * (ψ x * χ x)) :=
      hφg _ tχ.1 tχ.2.1 (tχ.2.2.trans hχU) l
    have h4 : ∫ x, φ x * pd2 l (fun y => ψ y * χ y) x =
        (∫ x, φ x * (pd2 l ψ x * χ x)) + ∫ x, φ x * (ψ x * pd2 l χ x) := by
      rw [← integral_add i1 i2]
      congr 1
      funext x
      rw [hprod x]
      ring
    have e1 : ∫ x, ψ x * φ x * pd2 l χ x = ∫ x, φ x * (ψ x * pd2 l χ x) := by
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    have e2' : ∫ x, pd2 l ψ x * φ x * χ x = ∫ x, φ x * (pd2 l ψ x * χ x) := by
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    have e3 : ∫ x, ψ x * Gφ l x * χ x = ∫ x, Gφ l x * (ψ x * χ x) := by
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    rw [e1, e2', e3]
    linarith
  
  have HS : ∀ χ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ → HasCompactSupport χ → tsupport χ ⊆ U →
      ∀ n l : Fin 2, ∫ x, H n l x * χ x = ∫ x, H l n x * χ x := by
    intro χ hχ hχc hχU n l
    have t1 := T1 χ hχ hχc l
    have t2 := T1 χ hχ hχc n
    have h1 := hgradG χ hχ hχc hχU n l
    have h2 := hgradG χ hχ hχc hχU l n
    have h3 := hgrad (pd2 l χ) t1.1 t1.2.1 (t1.2.2.trans hχU) n
    have h4 := hgrad (pd2 n χ) t2.1 t2.2.1 (t2.2.2.trans hχU) l
    rw [Tcomm χ hχ n l] at h3
    linarith
  
  have hK : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc
  have P := L2P (tsupport ζ) hK
  obtain ⟨hLv, hLG, hLH, hLF, hLDF, hLf⟩ := hL2 (tsupport ζ) hK hζU
  have hIc : ∀ (g φ h : E2 → ℝ), MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict (tsupport ζ)) → Continuous φ →
      tsupport φ ⊆ tsupport ζ → (∀ x, g x * φ x = h x) → Integrable h := by
    intro g φ h hg hφ hs he
    exact (P g φ hg hφ hs).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall he)
  
  have tz : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd2 a ζ) ∧ HasCompactSupport (pd2 a ζ) ∧
      tsupport (pd2 a ζ) ⊆ tsupport ζ := T1 ζ hζ hζc
  have tψ := tz m
  have tψa : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd2 a (pd2 m ζ)) ∧ HasCompactSupport (pd2 a (pd2 m ζ)) ∧
      tsupport (pd2 a (pd2 m ζ)) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
    intro a
    have h := T1 (pd2 m ζ) tψ.1 tψ.2.1 a
    exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.trans tψ.2.2⟩
  have hcomm : ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (pd2 m ζ) = pd2 m (pd2 a ζ) := fun a => Tcomm ζ hζ a m
  have hzU : ∀ a : Fin 2, tsupport (pd2 a ζ) ⊆ U := fun a => (tz a).2.2.trans hζU
  
  have termA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ∫ x, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a (pd2 m ζ) x =
      -(∫ x, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x * pd2 a ζ x) -
        ∫ x, A x a b * H m b x * pd2 a ζ x := by
    intro a b
    have h : ∫ x, A x a b * G b x * pd2 m (pd2 a ζ) x =
        -(∫ x, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x * pd2 a ζ x) -
          ∫ x, A x a b * H b m x * pd2 a ζ x :=
      WL (fun y => A y a b) (hA a b) (G b) (H b)
        (fun L hL hLU => ⟨(hL2 L hL hLU).2.1 b, fun l => (hL2 L hL hLU).2.2.1 b l⟩)
        (fun χ h1 h2 h3 l => hgradG χ h1 h2 h3 b l) (pd2 a ζ) (tz a).1 (tz a).2.1 (hzU a) m
    have tA := T2 (fun y => A y a b) (hA a b) (pd2 a ζ) (tz a).1 (tz a).2.1 (hzU a)
    have hs : ∫ x, H b m x * (A x a b * pd2 a ζ x) = ∫ x, H m b x * (A x a b * pd2 a ζ x) :=
      HS (fun x => A x a b * pd2 a ζ x) tA.1 tA.2.1 (tA.2.2.trans (hzU a)) b m
    have e1 : ∫ x, A x a b * H b m x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, H b m x * (A x a b * pd2 a ζ x) := by
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    have e2 : ∫ x, A x a b * H m b x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, H m b x * (A x a b * pd2 a ζ x) := by
      congr 1; funext x; ring
    rw [hcomm a, h, e1, e2, hs]
  have termQ : ∫ x, q x * v x * pd2 m ζ x =
      -(∫ x, pd2 m q x * v x * ζ x) - ∫ x, q x * G m x * ζ x :=
    WL q hq v G (fun L hL hLU => ⟨(hL2 L hL hLU).1, (hL2 L hL hLU).2.1⟩) hgrad ζ hζ hζc hζU m
  have termF : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∫ x, F a x * pd2 a (pd2 m ζ) x = -(∫ x, DF a m x * pd2 a ζ x) := by
    intro a
    rw [hcomm a]
    exact hgradF (pd2 a ζ) (tz a).1 (tz a).2.1 (hzU a) a m
  have hI : ∀ a : Fin 2, (∫ x, (if a = m then f x else 0) * pd2 a ζ x) =
      if a = m then ∫ x, f x * pd2 m ζ x else 0 := by
    intro a
    by_cases h : a = m <;> simp [h]
  have hIsum : ∑ a : Fin 2, (∫ x, (if a = m then f x else 0) * pd2 a ζ x) =
      ∫ x, f x * pd2 m ζ x := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hI a)]
    simp
  
  have S2 : ∀ (g : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (h : E2 → ℝ), (∀ a b, Integrable (g a b)) →
      Integrable h →
      ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, g a b x - h x) =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (∫ x, g a b x) - ∫ x, h x := by
    intro g h hg hh
    have hg' : ∀ a, Integrable (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 2, g a b x) :=
      fun a => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => hg a b)
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hg' a)) hh,
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hg' a)]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    exact integral_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => hg a b)
  have S1 : ∀ (g : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (h : E2 → ℝ), (∀ a, Integrable (g a)) → Integrable h →
      ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, g a x + h x) = ∑ a : Fin 2, (∫ x, g a x) + ∫ x, h x := by
    intro g h hg hh
    rw [integral_add (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hg a)) hh,
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hg a)]
  
  have iEA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => A x a b * G b x * pd2 a (pd2 m ζ) x) := by
    intro a b
    have t := T2 (fun y => A y a b) (hA a b) (pd2 a (pd2 m ζ)) (tψa a).1 (tψa a).2.1
      ((tψa a).2.2.trans hζU)
    exact hIc (G b) (fun x => A x a b * pd2 a (pd2 m ζ) x) _ (hLG b) t.1.continuous
      (t.2.2.trans (tψa a).2.2) (fun x => by beta_reduce; ring)
  have iEq : Integrable (fun x => q x * v x * pd2 m ζ x) := by
    have t := T2 q hq (pd2 m ζ) tψ.1 tψ.2.1 (tψ.2.2.trans hζU)
    exact hIc v (fun x => q x * pd2 m ζ x) _ hLv t.1.continuous (t.2.2.trans tψ.2.2)
      (fun x => by beta_reduce; ring)
  have iEF : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => F a x * pd2 a (pd2 m ζ) x) := fun a =>
    P _ _ (hLF a) (tψa a).1.continuous (tψa a).2.2
  have iEf : Integrable (fun x => f x * pd2 m ζ x) := P _ _ hLf tψ.1.continuous tψ.2.2
  have iTA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => A x a b * H m b x * pd2 a ζ x) := by
    intro a b
    have t := T2 (fun y => A y a b) (hA a b) (pd2 a ζ) (tz a).1 (tz a).2.1 (hzU a)
    exact hIc (H m b) (fun x => A x a b * pd2 a ζ x) _ (hLH m b) t.1.continuous
      (t.2.2.trans (tz a).2.2) (fun x => by beta_reduce; ring)
  have iTq : Integrable (fun x => q x * G m x * ζ x) := by
    have t := T2 q hq ζ hζ hζc hζU
    exact hIc (G m) (fun x => q x * ζ x) _ (hLG m) t.1.continuous t.2.2
      (fun x => by beta_reduce; ring)
  have iTq2 : Integrable (fun x => pd2 m q x * v x * ζ x) := by
    have t := T2 (pd2 m q) (hpdU q hq m) ζ hζ hζc hζU
    exact hIc v (fun x => pd2 m q x * ζ x) _ hLv t.1.continuous t.2.2
      (fun x => by beta_reduce; ring)
  have splitR : ∀ a : Fin 2,
      Integrable (fun x => (DF a m x - ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x -
        (if a = m then f x else 0)) * pd2 a ζ x) ∧
      ∫ x, (DF a m x - ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x -
        (if a = m then f x else 0)) * pd2 a ζ x =
        (∫ x, DF a m x * pd2 a ζ x) -
          ∑ b : Fin 2, (∫ x, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x * pd2 a ζ x) -
          ∫ x, (if a = m then f x else 0) * pd2 a ζ x := by
    intro a
    have hite : MemLp (fun x => if a = m then f x else 0) 2 (volume.restrict (tsupport ζ)) := by
      by_cases h : a = m
      · simp only [if_pos h]; exact hLf
      · simp only [if_neg h]; exact MemLp.zero
    have i1 : Integrable (fun x => DF a m x * pd2 a ζ x) :=
      P _ _ (hLDF a m) (tz a).1.continuous (tz a).2.2
    have i2 : ∀ b : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x * pd2 a ζ x) := by
      intro b
      have t := T2 (pd2 m (fun y => A y a b)) (hpdU _ (hA a b) m) (pd2 a ζ) (tz a).1 (tz a).2.1
        (hzU a)
      exact hIc (G b) (fun x => pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * pd2 a ζ x) _ (hLG b) t.1.continuous
        (t.2.2.trans (tz a).2.2) (fun x => by beta_reduce; ring)
    have i3 : Integrable (fun x => (if a = m then f x else 0) * pd2 a ζ x) :=
      P _ _ hite (tz a).1.continuous (tz a).2.2
    have i2s : Integrable (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x * pd2 a ζ x) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => i2 b)
    have heqf : (fun x => (DF a m x - ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x -
        (if a = m then f x else 0)) * pd2 a ζ x) =
        fun x => DF a m x * pd2 a ζ x -
          ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x * pd2 a ζ x -
          (if a = m then f x else 0) * pd2 a ζ x := by
      funext x
      rw [sub_mul, sub_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [heqf]
    have i12 : Integrable (fun x => DF a m x * pd2 a ζ x -
        ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun y => A y a b) x * G b x * pd2 a ζ x) := i1.sub i2s
    refine ⟨i12.sub i3, ?_⟩
    rw [integral_sub i12 i3, integral_sub i1 i2s,
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => i2 b)]
  
  have E := heq (pd2 m ζ) tψ.1 tψ.2.1 (tψ.2.2.trans hζU)
  rw [S2 _ _ iEA iEq, S1 _ _ iEF iEf] at E
  rw [S2 _ _ iTA iTq, S1 _ _ (fun a => (splitR a).1) iTq2]
  have r0 := (splitR 0).2
  have r1 := (splitR 1).2
  have a00 := termA 0 0
  have a01 := termA 0 1
  have a10 := termA 1 0
  have a11 := termA 1 1
  have f0 := termF 0
  have f1 := termF 1
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at E hIsum r0 r1 ⊢
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ U, (A x).PosDef) (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (g : E2 → ℝ) (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ m, MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, v x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, G m x * ζ x)) (heq : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, g x * ζ x) : ∀ x₀ ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ∃ H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r → ∀ n m, MemLp (H n m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r → ∀ n m : Fin 2, ∫ x, G n x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, H n m x * ζ x)

signature.name: elr_local_H2
signature.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ U, (A x).PosDef) (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (g : E2 → ℝ) (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ m, MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, v x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, G m x * ζ x)) (heq : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, g x * ζ x) : ∀ x₀ ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ∃ H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r → ∀ n m, MemLp (H n m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r → ∀ n m : Fin 2, ∫ x, G n x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, H n m x * ζ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x₀ hx₀
  
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hU x₀ hx₀
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρε⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ 5 * ρ = ε := ⟨ε / 5, by positivity, by ring⟩
  have hKU : Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ) ⊆ U :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hεU
  have hK3U : Metric.closedBall x₀ (3 * ρ) ⊆ U :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)).trans hKU
  have hB3K3 : Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ) ⊆ Metric.closedBall x₀ (3 * ρ) := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have hB3U : Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ) ⊆ U := hB3K3.trans hK3U
  have hB1B3 : Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ) := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hB1U : Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ U := hB1B3.trans hB3U
  have hKc : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)) := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  obtain ⟨-, hGK, -⟩ := hL2 _ hKc hKU
  
  obtain ⟨θ, Λ, Λ', hθ, -, hΛ'0, hell, hΛ, hΛ', hLip⟩ :=
    elr_ellip_consts U hU A hA hApos (Metric.closedBall x₀ (3 * ρ)) (isCompact_closedBall _ _)
      (convex_closedBall _ _) hK3U
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hCacc⟩ := elr_caccioppoli x₀ ρ hρ A (fun a b => (hA a b).mono hB3U) θ Λ Λ' hθ
    (fun x hx => hell x (hB3K3 hx)) (fun x hx => hΛ x (hB3K3 hx)) (fun x hx => hΛ' x (hB3K3 hx))
  obtain ⟨Cη, -, hker⟩ := elr_moll_kernel
  
  have hδpos : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 < ρ * (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) := fun j => by positivity
  have hδρ : ∀ j : ℕ, ρ * (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ ρ := by
    intro j
    have h1 : 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg j : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right hρ.le h1
  have hδlim : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => ρ * (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat).const_mul ρ
  choose η hηs hηc hη0 hηsupp hη1 hηd using
    fun j : ℕ => hker (ρ * (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1))) (hδpos j)
  
  have hbound : ∀ (j : ℕ) (n : Fin 2),
      (∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ ρ, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (pd2 n (fun x => ∫ y, η j (x - y) *
        (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y)) x) ^ 2) ≤
      C * ((∑ k : Fin 2, ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), G k y ^ 2) +
        (∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), g y ^ 2) +
        ∑ a : Fin 2, 8 * Λ' ^ 2 * (Cη ^ 2 + 1) *
          ∑ b : Fin 2, ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), G b y ^ 2) := by
    intro j n
    obtain ⟨hu, hΨ, hgr, hdiv, hI1, hI2⟩ :=
      elr_mollified_system U hU A hA v G g hL2 hgrad heq x₀ ρ hρ hKU _ (hδpos j) (hδρ j) (η j)
        (hηs j) (hηc j) (hη0 j) (hηsupp j) (hη1 j)
    have hRj := elr_moll_commutator U hU A hA G x₀ ρ hρ hKU hGK Λ' hΛ'0
      (fun x hx => hΛ' x (hB3K3 hx)) (fun x hx y hy => hLip x (hB3K3 hx) y (hB3K3 hy)) Cη _
      (hδpos j) (hδρ j) (η j) (hηs j) (hηc j) (hη0 j) (hηsupp j) (hη1 j) (hηd j)
    have heqn : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y =>
        ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b (fun x => ∫ y, η j (x - y) *
          (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y) y +
        ((∫ z, η j (y - z) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator
            (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) z) -
          ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * ∫ z, η j (y - z) *
            (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (G b) z)) x =
        -(∫ y, η j (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator g y) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [← hdiv x hx]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
      have hev : (fun y =>
          ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b (fun x => ∫ y, η j (x - y) *
            (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y) y +
          ((∫ z, η j (y - z) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator
              (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) z) -
            ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * ∫ z, η j (y - z) *
              (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (G b) z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          (fun y => ∫ z, η j (y - z) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator
              (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) z) := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
        simp only [hgr y hy]
        ring
      exact congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e2 a)) hev.fderiv_eq
    have hcac := hCacc (fun x => ∫ y, η j (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y)
      (fun a x => (∫ y, η j (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator
          (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) -
        ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * ∫ y, η j (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (G b) y)
      (fun x => ∫ y, η j (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator g y)
      hu (fun a => (hRj a).1) hΨ.continuous.continuousOn heqn n
    exact hcac.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (add_le_add (add_le_add hI1 hI2) (Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => (hRj a).2)) hC0)
  
  have hlim : ∀ n : Fin 2, ∃ Hn : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ,
      (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρ → ∀ k, MemLp (Hn k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρ →
        ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x, G n x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, Hn k x * ζ x) := by
    intro n
    refine elr_moll_limit x₀ ρ hρ (G n) (hGK n) _ hδpos hδlim η hηs hηc hη0 hηsupp hη1
      (fun j => pd2 n (fun x => ∫ y, η j (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y))
      ?_ ?_ _ (fun j => hbound j n)
    · intro j
      obtain ⟨hu, -⟩ :=
        elr_mollified_system U hU A hA v G g hL2 hgrad heq x₀ ρ hρ hKU _ (hδpos j) (hδρ j) (η j)
          (hηs j) (hηc j) (hη0 j) (hηsupp j) (hη1 j)
      have hfd := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hu).2
      exact hfd.clm_apply contDiff_const
    · intro j x hx
      obtain ⟨-, -, hgr, -⟩ :=
        elr_mollified_system U hU A hA v G g hL2 hgrad heq x₀ ρ hρ hKU _ (hδpos j) (hδρ j) (η j)
          (hηs j) (hηc j) (hη0 j) (hηsupp j) (hη1 j)
      exact hgr x (hB1B3 hx) n
  
  choose H hHL2 hHw using hlim
  exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hB1U, H, fun L hL hLB n m => hHL2 n L hL hLB m,
    fun ζ h1 h2 h3 n m => hHw n ζ h1 h2 h3 m⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: elr_moll_kernel
subgoal_signatures.statement: ∃ Cη : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cη ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ η : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ η ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) ∧ (∀ z, δ ≤ ‖z‖ → η z = 0) ∧ (∫ z, η z) = 1 ∧ ∀ m : Fin 2, (∫ z, ‖z‖ * |pd2 m η z|) ≤ Cη

subgoal_signatures.name: elr_ellip_consts
subgoal_signatures.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ U, (A x).PosDef) (K : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKc : Convex ℝ K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) : ∃ θ Λ Λ' : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ 0 ≤ Λ ∧ 0 ≤ Λ' ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, θ * ∑ a : Fin 2, ξ a ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * ξ a * ξ b) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ a b : Fin 2, |A x a b| ≤ Λ) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ a b c : Fin 2, |pd2 c (fun y => A y a b) x| ≤ Λ') ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ∀ a b : Fin 2, |A y a b - A x a b| ≤ Λ' * ‖y - x‖

subgoal_signatures.name: elr_mollified_system
subgoal_signatures.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (g : E2 → ℝ) (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ m, MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, v x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, G m x * ζ x)) (heq : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, g x * ζ x) (x₀ : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hKU : Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ) ⊆ U) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ) (η : E2 → ℝ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η) (hηc : HasCompactSupport η) (hη0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) (hηs : ∀ z, δ ≤ ‖z‖ → η z = 0) (hη1 : (∫ z, η z) = 1) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator g y) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y) x = ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (G b) y) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) x = -(∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator g y)) ∧ (∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y) x) ^ 2) ≤ (∑ k : Fin 2, ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), G k y ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), (∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator g y) ^ 2) ≤ ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), g y ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: elr_moll_commutator
subgoal_signatures.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hKU : Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ) ⊆ U) (hGL2 : ∀ b : Fin 2, MemLp (G b) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)))) (Λ' : ℝ) (hΛ'0 : 0 ≤ Λ') (hΛ' : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∀ a b c : Fin 2, |pd2 c (fun y => A y a b) x| ≤ Λ') (hLip : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∀ a b : Fin 2, |A y a b - A x a b| ≤ Λ' * ‖y - x‖) (Cη : ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ) (η : E2 → ℝ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η) (hηc : HasCompactSupport η) (hη0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) (hηs : ∀ z, δ ≤ ‖z‖ → η z = 0) (hη1 : (∫ z, η z) = 1) (hηd : ∀ m : Fin 2, (∫ z, ‖z‖ * |pd2 m η z|) ≤ Cη) : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) - ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (G b) y) (Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ)) ∧ (∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x => (∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) - ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (G b) y) x) ^ 2) ≤ 8 * Λ' ^ 2 * (Cη ^ 2 + 1) * ∑ b : Fin 2, ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), G b y ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: elr_caccioppoli
subgoal_signatures.statement: (x₀ : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ))) (θ Λ Λ' : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hell : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, θ * ∑ a : Fin 2, ξ a ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * ξ a * ξ b) (hΛ : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∀ a b : Fin 2, |A x a b| ≤ Λ) (hΛ' : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∀ a b c : Fin 2, |pd2 c (fun y => A y a b) x| ≤ Λ') : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (u : E2 → ℝ) (R : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (Ψ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → (∀ a, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (R a) (Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ))) → ContinuousOn Ψ (Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ)) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b u y + R a y) x = -Ψ x) → ∀ n : Fin 2, (∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ ρ, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (pd2 n u) x) ^ 2) ≤ C * ((∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k u x) ^ 2) + (∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), Ψ x ^ 2) + ∑ a : Fin 2, ∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (R a) x) ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: elr_moll_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement: (x₀ : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (φ : E2 → ℝ) (hφ : MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)))) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (hδ0 : ∀ j, 0 < δ j) (hδ : Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0)) (η : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hη : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (η j)) (hηc : ∀ j, HasCompactSupport (η j)) (hη0 : ∀ j z, 0 ≤ η j z) (hηs : ∀ j z, δ j ≤ ‖z‖ → η j z = 0) (hη1 : ∀ j, (∫ z, η j z) = 1) (w : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (w j)) (hwφ : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, w j x = ∫ y, η j (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ y) (M : ℝ) (hM : ∀ j, (∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ ρ, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (w j) x) ^ 2) ≤ M) : ∃ H : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρ → ∀ k, MemLp (H k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρ → ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x, φ x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, H k x * ζ x)

signature.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (φ : E2 → ℝ) (hφ : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hloc : ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x r ⊆ U ∧ ∃ H : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ Metric.ball x r → ∀ m, MemLp (H m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball x r → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ y, φ y * pd2 m ζ y = -(∫ y, H m y * ζ y)) : ∃ H : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → ∀ m, MemLp (H m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ y, φ y * pd2 m ζ y = -(∫ y, H m y * ζ y)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  choose! r hr hball Hx hHL2 hHw using hloc
  
  have hfin : ∀ K : Set E2, IsCompact K → IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict K) := by
    intro K hK
    exact ⟨by rw [Measure.restrict_apply_univ]; exact hK.measure_lt_top⟩
  
  have hint : ∀ K : Set E2, IsCompact K → ∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict K) →
      Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ K → Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) := by
    intro K hK f g hf hg hgK
    haveI := hfin K hK
    have hgc : HasCompactSupport g := hK.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport g) hgK
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hg.bounded_above_of_compact_support hgc
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => f x * g x) K :=
      (hf.integrable one_le_two).mul_bdd hg.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hC)
    refine (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset ?_).mp h1
    intro x hx
    apply hgK
    apply subset_tsupport g
    intro h0
    apply hx
    simp [h0]
  
  have huniq : ∀ V : Set E2, IsOpen V → ∀ f₁ f₂ : E2 → ℝ,
      (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ V → MemLp f₁ 2 (volume.restrict L)) →
      (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ V → MemLp f₂ 2 (volume.restrict L)) →
      (∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ V →
        ∫ x, f₁ x * ζ x = ∫ x, f₂ x * ζ x) →
      ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict V), f₁ x = f₂ x := by
    intro V hV f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ h
    have hli : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => f₁ x - f₂ x) V volume := by
      rw [locallyIntegrableOn_iff hV.isLocallyClosed]
      intro k hkV hk
      haveI := hfin k hk
      exact ((h₁ k hk hkV).sub (h₂ k hk hkV)).integrable one_le_two
    have hz := hV.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero hli (fun g hg hgc hgV => by
      have i1 := hint _ hgc f₁ g (h₁ _ hgc hgV) hg.continuous subset_rfl
      have i2 := hint _ hgc f₂ g (h₂ _ hgc hgV) hg.continuous subset_rfl
      calc ∫ x, g x • (f₁ x - f₂ x) = ∫ x, (f₁ x * g x - f₂ x * g x) := by
            congr 1; funext x; rw [smul_eq_mul]; ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [integral_sub i1 i2, h g hg hgc hgV, sub_self])
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' hV.measurableSet]
    filter_upwards [hz] with x hx hxV
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hx hxV)
  
  have hov : ∀ m : Fin 2, ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ z ∈ U,
      ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (ball x (r x) ∩ ball z (r z))), Hx x m y = Hx z m y := by
    intro m x hx z hz
    refine huniq _ (isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_ball) _ _
      (fun L hL hLs => hHL2 x hx L hL (hLs.trans Set.inter_subset_left) m)
      (fun L hL hLs => hHL2 z hz L hL (hLs.trans Set.inter_subset_right) m) ?_
    intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have e1 := hHw x hx ζ hζ hζc (hζs.trans Set.inter_subset_left) m
    have e2 := hHw z hz ζ hζ hζc (hζs.trans Set.inter_subset_right) m
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨T, hTU, hTc, hTeq⟩ := TopologicalSpace.isOpen_biUnion_countable U
    (fun x => ball x (r x)) (fun x _ => isOpen_ball)
  haveI : Countable T := hTc.to_subtype
  obtain ⟨H, hHdef⟩ : ∃ H : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, ∀ m y, H m y =
      if h : ∃ x ∈ T, y ∈ ball x (r x) then Hx h.choose m y else 0 := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hHae : ∀ m : Fin 2, ∀ i ∈ U, ∀ᵐ y ∂volume, y ∈ ball i (r i) → H m y = Hx i m y := by
    intro m i hi
    have hall : ∀ᵐ y ∂volume, ∀ x : T, y ∈ ball x.1 (r x.1) ∩ ball i (r i) →
        Hx x.1 m y = Hx i m y := by
      rw [ae_all_iff]
      intro x
      exact (ae_restrict_iff' (isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_ball).measurableSet).1
        (hov m x.1 (hTU x.2) i hi)
    filter_upwards [hall] with y hy hyi
    have hex : ∃ x ∈ T, y ∈ ball x (r x) := by
      have hmem : y ∈ ⋃ x ∈ U, ball x (r x) := Set.mem_biUnion hi hyi
      rw [← hTeq] at hmem
      obtain ⟨x, hxT, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hmem
      exact ⟨x, hxT, hyx⟩
    rw [hHdef, dif_pos hex]
    exact hy ⟨hex.choose, hex.choose_spec.1⟩ ⟨hex.choose_spec.2, hyi⟩
  
  have hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → ∀ m, MemLp (H m) 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
    intro L hL hLU m
    have hunion : ∀ A B : Set E2, MeasurableSet A → MemLp (H m) 2 (volume.restrict A) →
        MemLp (H m) 2 (volume.restrict B) → MemLp (H m) 2 (volume.restrict (A ∪ B)) := by
      intro A B hA hMA hMB
      have h1 : MemLp (H m) 2 ((volume.restrict (A ∪ B)).restrict A) :=
        hMA.mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono subset_rfl Measure.restrict_le_self)
      have h2 : MemLp (H m) 2 ((volume.restrict (A ∪ B)).restrict Aᶜ) := by
        rw [Measure.restrict_restrict hA.compl]
        refine hMB.mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono ?_ le_rfl)
        intro y hy
        rcases hy.2 with h | h
        · exact absurd h hy.1
        · exact h
      have h3 := MemLp.piecewise hA h1 h2
      rwa [Set.piecewise_same] at h3
    obtain ⟨t, htL, hLt⟩ := hL.elim_nhds_subcover (fun x => closedBall x (r x / 2))
      (fun x hx => closedBall_mem_nhds x (half_pos (hr x (hLU hx))))
    have hpiece : ∀ x ∈ t, MemLp (H m) 2 (volume.restrict (L ∩ closedBall x (r x / 2))) := by
      intro x hx
      have hxU : x ∈ U := hLU (htL x hx)
      have hsub : L ∩ closedBall x (r x / 2) ⊆ ball x (r x) := by
        intro y hy
        have h1 : dist y x ≤ r x / 2 := hy.2
        have h2 := hr x hxU
        show dist y x < r x
        linarith
      have hM := hHL2 x hxU _ (hL.inter_right isClosed_closedBall) hsub m
      refine hM.ae_eq ?_
      have hae := ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hsub
        ((ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_ball).2 (hHae m x hxU))
      filter_upwards [hae] with y hy
      exact hy.symm
    have hfinset : ∀ s : Finset E2, (∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ t) →
        MemLp (H m) 2 (volume.restrict (⋃ x ∈ s, L ∩ closedBall x (r x / 2))) := by
      intro s
      refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
      · intro _
        simp [memLp_measure_zero]
      · intro a s ha ih hs
        rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
        exact hunion _ _ (hL.inter_right isClosed_closedBall).isClosed.measurableSet
          (hpiece a (hs a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)))
          (ih (fun x hx => hs x (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hx)))
    refine (hfinset t (fun x hx => hx)).mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono ?_ le_rfl)
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hLt hy)
    exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨x, hx, hy, hyx⟩
  
  refine ⟨H, hL2, ?_⟩
  intro ζ hζ hζc hζU m
  have hK : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc
  obtain ⟨t, htK, hKt⟩ := hK.elim_nhds_subcover (fun x => ball x (r x))
    (fun x hx => ball_mem_nhds x (hr x (hζU hx)))
  have hcov : tsupport ζ ⊆ ⋃ i : t, ball i.1 (r i.1) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hKt hy)
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hyx⟩
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := SmoothPartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate 𝓘(ℝ, E2) (isClosed_tsupport ζ)
    (fun i : t => ball i.1 (r i.1)) (fun i => isOpen_ball) hcov
  have hρs : ∀ i : t, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ρ i) := fun i => contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp (ρ i).contMDiff
  obtain ⟨ζs, hζs⟩ : ∃ ζs : t → E2 → ℝ, ∀ i y, ζs i y = ρ i y * ζ y := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hζs' : ∀ i, ζs i = fun y => ρ i y * ζ y := fun i => funext (hζs i)
  have hζs_smooth : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ζs i) := by
    intro i; rw [hζs' i]; exact (hρs i).mul hζ
  have hζs_supp : ∀ i, tsupport (ζs i) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
    intro i; rw [hζs' i]; exact tsupport_mul_subset_right
  have hζs_ball : ∀ i : t, tsupport (ζs i) ⊆ ball i.1 (r i.1) := by
    intro i; rw [hζs' i]; exact tsupport_mul_subset_left.trans (hρ i)
  have hζs_cpt : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (ζs i) := fun i =>
    hK.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) (hζs_supp i)
  have hsum : ∀ y, ζ y = ∑ i, ζs i y := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport ζ
    · have h1 := ρ.sum_eq_one hy
      rw [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype] at h1
      simp only [hζs]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, h1, one_mul]
    · simp [hζs, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy]
  have hζfun : ζ = fun y => ∑ i, ζs i y := funext hsum
  have hpd : ∀ y, pd2 m ζ y = ∑ i, pd2 m (ζs i) y := by
    intro y
    unfold pd2
    rw [hζfun, fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => ((hζs_smooth i).differentiable (by simp)) y),
      ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have hφK := hφ _ hK hζU
  have hHK := hL2 _ hK hζU m
  have hdcont : ∀ i, Continuous (pd2 m (ζs i)) := fun i =>
    ((hζs_smooth i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hdsupp : ∀ i, tsupport (pd2 m (ζs i)) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
    intro i
    refine (closure_minimal ?_ (isClosed_tsupport (ζs i))).trans (hζs_supp i)
    intro x hx
    apply support_fderiv_subset ℝ
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    intro h0
    exact (Function.mem_support.mp hx) (by show fderiv ℝ (ζs i) x (e2 m) = 0; rw [h0]; rfl)
  have i1 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun y => φ y * pd2 m (ζs i) y) := fun i =>
    hint _ hK φ _ hφK (hdcont i) (hdsupp i)
  have i2 : ∀ i, Integrable (fun y => H m y * ζs i y) := fun i =>
    hint _ hK (H m) _ hHK (hζs_smooth i).continuous (hζs_supp i)
  have hloc_i : ∀ i : t, ∫ y, φ y * pd2 m (ζs i) y = -(∫ y, H m y * ζs i y) := by
    intro i
    have hiU : i.1 ∈ U := hζU (htK i.1 i.2)
    rw [hHw i.1 hiU (ζs i) (hζs_smooth i) (hζs_cpt i) (hζs_ball i) m]
    congr 1
    refine integral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [hHae m i.1 hiU] with y hy
    by_cases hyb : y ∈ ball i.1 (r i.1)
    · rw [hy hyb]
    · have h0 : ζs i y = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hyb (hζs_ball i h))
      simp [h0]
  calc ∫ y, φ y * pd2 m ζ y = ∫ y, ∑ i, φ y * pd2 m (ζs i) y := by
        congr 1; funext y; rw [hpd y, Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ i, ∫ y, φ y * pd2 m (ζs i) y := integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => i1 i)
    _ = ∑ i, -(∫ y, H m y * ζs i y) := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hloc_i i)
    _ = -(∑ i, ∫ y, H m y * ζs i y) := Finset.sum_neg_distrib _
    _ = -(∫ y, ∑ i, H m y * ζs i y) := by rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => i2 i)]
    _ = -(∫ y, H m y * ζ y) := by congr 2; funext y; rw [hsum y, Finset.mul_sum]

informal_problem.statement: ∃ Cη : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cη ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ η : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ η ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) ∧ (∀ z, δ ≤ ‖z‖ → η z = 0) ∧ (∫ z, η z) = 1 ∧ ∀ m : Fin 2, (∫ z, ‖z‖ * |pd2 m η z|) ≤ Cη

signature.name: elr_moll_kernel
signature.statement: ∃ Cη : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cη ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ η : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ η ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) ∧ (∀ z, δ ≤ ‖z‖ → η z = 0) ∧ (∫ z, η z) = 1 ∧ ∀ m : Fin 2, (∫ z, ‖z‖ * |pd2 m η z|) ≤ Cη

proof.tactics:
by
  let β : ContDiffBump (0 : E2) := ⟨1 / 2, 1, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  set η₁ : E2 → ℝ := β.normed MeasureTheory.volume with hη₁def
  have hη₁s : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η₁ := β.contDiff_normed
  have hη₁d : Differentiable ℝ η₁ := hη₁s.differentiable (by simp)
  have hη₁0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ η₁ x := fun x => β.nonneg_normed x
  have hη₁int : ∫ x, η₁ x = 1 := β.integral_normed
  have hη₁supp : Function.support η₁ = Metric.ball 0 1 := β.support_normed_eq
  
  have hpd : ∀ (c s : ℝ) (m : Fin 2) (z : E2),
      pd2 m (fun y => c * η₁ (s • y)) z = c * (s * pd2 m η₁ (s • z)) := by
    intro c s m z
    have hψ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : E2 => η₁ (s • y)) z :=
      (hη₁d (s • z)).comp z ((differentiableAt_id).const_smul s)
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_const_mul hψ c, fderiv_comp_smul]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hint : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ →
      (∫ z, (δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * f (δ⁻¹ • z)) = ∫ z, f z := by
    intro f δ hδ
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.integral_comp_inv_smul_of_nonneg MeasureTheory.volume f hδ.le,
      finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have hI : ∀ m : Fin 2, 0 ≤ ∫ w, ‖w‖ * |pd2 m η₁ w| := fun m =>
    MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun w => mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))
  refine ⟨(∫ w, ‖w‖ * |pd2 0 η₁ w|) + (∫ w, ‖w‖ * |pd2 1 η₁ w|),
    add_nonneg (hI 0) (hI 1), ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ
  have hδi : 0 < δ⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 hδ
  have hδ2 : 0 < δ ^ 2 := pow_pos hδ 2
  have hnorm : ∀ z : E2, ‖δ⁻¹ • z‖ = δ⁻¹ * ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hδi]
  have hvan : ∀ z : E2, δ ≤ ‖z‖ → (δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * η₁ (δ⁻¹ • z) = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 : 1 ≤ ‖δ⁻¹ • z‖ := by
      rw [hnorm]
      calc (1 : ℝ) = δ⁻¹ * δ := (inv_mul_cancel₀ hδ.ne').symm
        _ ≤ δ⁻¹ * ‖z‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz hδi.le
    have h2 : δ⁻¹ • z ∉ Function.support η₁ := by
      rw [hη₁supp, mem_ball_zero_iff]
      exact not_lt.2 h1
    rw [Function.notMem_support.mp h2, mul_zero]
  refine ⟨fun z => (δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * η₁ (δ⁻¹ • z), ?_, ?_, ?_, hvan, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact contDiff_const.mul (hη₁s.comp (contDiff_const_smul δ⁻¹))
  · refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E2) δ) ?_
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] at hz
    exact hvan z hz.le
  · intro z
    exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hδ2.le) (hη₁0 _)
  · rw [hint η₁ δ hδ, hη₁int]
  · intro m
    have hpt : ∀ z : E2, ‖z‖ * |pd2 m (fun y => (δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * η₁ (δ⁻¹ • y)) z| =
        (δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (‖δ⁻¹ • z‖ * |pd2 m η₁ (δ⁻¹ • z)|) := by
      intro z
      rw [hpd, hnorm, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hδ2), abs_of_pos hδi]
      have : ‖z‖ = δ * (δ⁻¹ * ‖z‖) := by field_simp
      calc ‖z‖ * ((δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (δ⁻¹ * |pd2 m η₁ (δ⁻¹ • z)|))
          = (δ * (δ⁻¹ * ‖z‖)) * ((δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (δ⁻¹ * |pd2 m η₁ (δ⁻¹ • z)|)) := by
            rw [← this]
        _ = (δ * δ⁻¹) * ((δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (δ⁻¹ * ‖z‖ * |pd2 m η₁ (δ⁻¹ • z)|)) := by ring
        _ = (δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (δ⁻¹ * ‖z‖ * |pd2 m η₁ (δ⁻¹ • z)|) := by
            rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hδ.ne', one_mul]
    have heq : (∫ z, ‖z‖ * |pd2 m (fun y => (δ ^ 2)⁻¹ * η₁ (δ⁻¹ • y)) z|) =
        ∫ w, ‖w‖ * |pd2 m η₁ w| := by
      simp_rw [hpt]
      exact hint (fun w => ‖w‖ * |pd2 m η₁ w|) δ hδ
    rw [heq]
    fin_cases m
    · exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (hI 1)
    · exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (hI 0)

informal_problem.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ U, (A x).PosDef) (K : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKc : Convex ℝ K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) : ∃ θ Λ Λ' : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ 0 ≤ Λ ∧ 0 ≤ Λ' ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, θ * ∑ a : Fin 2, ξ a ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * ξ a * ξ b) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ a b : Fin 2, |A x a b| ≤ Λ) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ a b c : Fin 2, |pd2 c (fun y => A y a b) x| ≤ Λ') ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ∀ a b : Fin 2, |A y a b - A x a b| ≤ Λ' * ‖y - x‖

signature.name: elr_ellip_consts
signature.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ U, (A x).PosDef) (K : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKc : Convex ℝ K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) : ∃ θ Λ Λ' : ℝ, 0 < θ ∧ 0 ≤ Λ ∧ 0 ≤ Λ' ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, θ * ∑ a : Fin 2, ξ a ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * ξ a * ξ b) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ a b : Fin 2, |A x a b| ≤ Λ) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ∀ a b c : Fin 2, |pd2 c (fun y => A y a b) x| ≤ Λ') ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ∀ a b : Fin 2, |A y a b - A x a b| ≤ Λ' * ‖y - x‖

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hdiff : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun x => A x a b) U := fun a b =>
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 (hA a b)).1
  have hDcont : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fun x => A x a b)) U := fun a b =>
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 (hA a b)).2.continuousOn
  have hcont : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x a b) U := fun a b =>
    (hA a b).continuousOn
  
  have hsym : ∀ x ∈ U, A x 1 0 = A x 0 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have h := (hApos x hx).isHermitian.apply 1 0
    rw [star_trivial] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hdet : ∀ x ∈ U, 0 < A x 0 0 * A x 1 1 - A x 0 1 * A x 1 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have h := (hApos x hx).det_pos
    rwa [Matrix.det_fin_two] at h
  have htr : ∀ x ∈ U, 0 < A x 0 0 + A x 1 1 := by
    intro x hx
    have h := (hApos x hx).trace_pos
    rwa [Matrix.trace_fin_two] at h
  have hkey : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      (A x 0 0 * A x 1 1 - A x 0 1 * A x 1 0) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ξ a ^ 2 ≤
        (A x 0 0 + A x 1 1) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * ξ a * ξ b := by
    intro x hx ξ
    have hs := hsym x hx
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hs]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (A x 0 0 * ξ 0 + A x 0 1 * ξ 1),
      sq_nonneg (A x 0 1 * ξ 0 + A x 1 1 * ξ 1)]
  
  have hmcont : ContinuousOn (fun x => (A x 0 0 * A x 1 1 - A x 0 1 * A x 1 0) /
      (A x 0 0 + A x 1 1)) U := by
    apply ContinuousOn.div
    · exact ((hcont 0 0).mul (hcont 1 1)).sub ((hcont 0 1).mul (hcont 1 0))
    · exact (hcont 0 0).add (hcont 1 1)
    · intro x hx
      exact (htr x hx).ne'
  
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hθm⟩ := hK.exists_forall_le' (hmcont.mono hKU) (a := 0)
    (fun x hx => div_pos (hdet x (hKU hx)) (htr x (hKU hx)))
  have hell : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      θ * ∑ a : Fin 2, ξ a ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * ξ a * ξ b := by
    intro x hx ξ
    have hxU := hKU hx
    have h1 : θ ≤ (A x 0 0 * A x 1 1 - A x 0 1 * A x 1 0) / (A x 0 0 + A x 1 1) := hθm x hx
    have ht := htr x hxU
    have hk := hkey x hxU ξ
    have hS : 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ξ a ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => sq_nonneg _)
    rw [le_div_iff₀ ht] at h1
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hS
    have h3 : (A x 0 0 + A x 1 1) * (θ * ∑ a : Fin 2, ξ a ^ 2) ≤
        (A x 0 0 + A x 1 1) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * ξ a * ξ b := by
      nlinarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h3 ht
  
  have hle : ∀ (F : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (a b : Fin 2),
      F a b ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, |F a b| := by
    intro F a b
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans
      ((Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun b => |F a b|) (fun b _ => abs_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_univ b)).trans
      (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a => ∑ b : Fin 2, |F a b|)
        (fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => abs_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ a)))
  have hnn : ∀ (F : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ), 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, |F a b| := fun F =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => abs_nonneg _))
  choose C hC using fun a b => hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn ((hcont a b).mono hKU)
  choose D hD using fun a b => hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn ((hDcont a b).mono hKU)
  have hDB : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ a b : Fin 2,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => A y a b) x‖ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, |D a b| :=
    fun x hx a b => (hD a b x hx).trans (hle D a b)
  refine ⟨θ, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, |C a b|, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, |D a b|, hθ,
    hnn C, hnn D, hell, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx a b
    have h := hC a b x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact h.trans (hle C a b)
  · intro x hx a b c
    have h1 : ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => A y a b) x (e2 c)‖ ≤
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => A y a b) x‖ * ‖e2 c‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
    have h2 : ‖e2 c‖ = 1 := by simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    rw [h2, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1.trans (hDB x hx a b)
  · intro x hx y hy a b
    have h := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := fun z => A z a b)
      (fun z hz => (hdiff a b).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hKU hz)))
      (fun z hz => hDB z hz a b) hKc hx hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact h

informal_problem.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (g : E2 → ℝ) (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ m, MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, v x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, G m x * ζ x)) (heq : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, g x * ζ x) (x₀ : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hKU : Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ) ⊆ U) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ) (η : E2 → ℝ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η) (hηc : HasCompactSupport η) (hη0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) (hηs : ∀ z, δ ≤ ‖z‖ → η z = 0) (hη1 : (∫ z, η z) = 1) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator g y) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y) x = ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (G b) y) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) x = -(∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator g y)) ∧ (∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y) x) ^ 2) ≤ (∑ k : Fin 2, ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), G k y ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), (∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator g y) ^ 2) ≤ ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), g y ^ 2

signature.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) U) (v : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (g : E2 → ℝ) (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ m, MemLp (G m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict L)) (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, v x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, G m x * ζ x)) (heq : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, g x * ζ x) (x₀ : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hKU : Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ) ⊆ U) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ) (η : E2 → ℝ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η) (hηc : HasCompactSupport η) (hη0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) (hηs : ∀ z, δ ≤ ‖z‖ → η z = 0) (hη1 : (∫ z, η z) = 1) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator g y) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y) x = ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (G b) y) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) x = -(∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator g y)) ∧ (∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator v y) x) ^ 2) ≤ (∑ k : Fin 2, ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), G k y ^ 2) ∧ (∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), (∫ y, η (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator g y) ^ 2) ≤ ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), g y ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  set K := Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ) with hKdef
  have hKc : IsCompact K := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have hKm : MeasurableSet K := measurableSet_closedBall
  obtain ⟨hvK, hGK, hgK⟩ := hL2 K hKc hKU
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict K) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 (ne_of_lt hKc.measure_lt_top)
  
  have htr : ∀ φ : E2 → ℝ, MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict K) →
      Integrable (K.indicator φ) ∧ MemLp (K.indicator φ) 2 volume ∧
      (∫ y, K.indicator φ y ^ 2) = ∫ y in K, φ y ^ 2 := by
    intro φ hφ
    refine ⟨(integrable_indicator_iff hKm).2 (hφ.integrable (by norm_num)),
      (memLp_indicator_iff_restrict hKm).2 hφ, ?_⟩
    have hsq : (fun y => K.indicator φ y ^ 2) = K.indicator (fun y => φ y ^ 2) := by
      funext y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ K
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy]
    rw [hsq, integral_indicator hKm]
  have hvon : IntegrableOn v K volume := hvK.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hGon : ∀ b, IntegrableOn (G b) K volume := fun b => (hGK b).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hgon : IntegrableOn g K volume := hgK.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hvI : Integrable (K.indicator v) := (integrable_indicator_iff hKm).2 hvon
  have hgI : Integrable (K.indicator g) := (integrable_indicator_iff hKm).2 hgon
  have hGI : ∀ b, Integrable (K.indicator (G b)) := fun b => (integrable_indicator_iff hKm).2 (hGon b)
  have hVon : ∀ a : Fin 2, IntegrableOn (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) K volume := by
    intro a
    refine integrable_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => ?_)
    exact IntegrableOn.continuousOn_mul ((hA a b).continuousOn.mono hKU) (hGon b) hKc
  have hVI : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable (K.indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y)) :=
    fun a => (integrable_indicator_iff hKm).2 (hVon a)
  
  have hgeo : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), Metric.closedBall x δ ⊆ K := by
    intro x hx z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
    show dist z x₀ ≤ 4 * ρ
    have := dist_triangle z x x₀
    linarith
  
  have hηt : tsupport η ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 δ := by
    refine closure_minimal (Function.support_subset_iff'.2 fun y hy => ?_)
      Metric.isClosed_closedBall
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hy
    exact hηs _ hy.le
  have hηd : ∀ (a : Fin 2) t, δ < ‖t‖ → pd2 a η t = 0 := by
    intro a t ht
    have hnt : t ∉ tsupport (fderiv ℝ η) := by
      intro h
      have h' := hηt (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ h)
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at h'
      linarith
    unfold pd2
    rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hnt]
    rfl
  
  have hC34 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), (∀ b : Fin 2,
      pd2 b (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * K.indicator v y) x =
        ∫ y, η (x - y) * K.indicator (G b) y) ∧
      ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) *
        K.indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) x =
          -(∫ y, η (x - y) * K.indicator g y) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxK := hgeo x hx
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ : ∃ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ζ = fun y => η (x - y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hout : ∀ y, y ∉ K → δ < ‖x - y‖ := by
      intro y hy
      have h' : y ∉ Metric.closedBall x δ := fun h => hy (hxK h)
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, not_le, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at h'
      exact h'
    have hvan : ∀ y, y ∉ Metric.closedBall x δ → ζ y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, not_le, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at hy
      rw [hζ]
      exact hηs _ hy.le
    have hζs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ := by
      rw [hζ]
      exact hη.comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id)
    have hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ := HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall x δ) hvan
    have hζt : tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.closedBall x δ :=
      closure_minimal (Function.support_subset_iff'.2 hvan) Metric.isClosed_closedBall
    have hζU : tsupport ζ ⊆ U := hζt.trans (hxK.trans hKU)
    have hζd : ∀ (a : Fin 2) y, pd2 a ζ y = -pd2 a η (x - y) := by
      intro a y
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt η (fderiv ℝ η (x - y)) (x - y) :=
        ((hη.differentiable (by simp)) (x - y)).hasFDerivAt
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y' : E2 => x - y') (-ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2) y := by
        simpa using (hasFDerivAt_id y).const_sub x
      have h3 := h1.comp y h2
      unfold pd2
      rw [show ζ = η ∘ (fun y' => x - y') from hζ, h3.fderiv]
      simp
    have hmul : ∀ φ : E2 → ℝ, (fun y => φ y * ζ y) = fun y => η (x - y) * K.indicator φ y := by
      intro φ
      funext y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ K
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy, hζ]; ring
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, hζ, hηs _ (hout y hy).le, mul_zero]
    refine ⟨fun b => ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      have hW := hgrad ζ hζs hζc hζU b
      have e1 : (fun y => v y * pd2 b ζ y) = fun y => -(pd2 b η (x - y) * K.indicator v y) := by
        funext y
        by_cases hy : y ∈ K
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy, hζd]; ring
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, hζd, hηd _ _ (hout y hy)]; ring
      rw [e1, hmul, MeasureTheory.integral_neg] at hW
      rw [(elr_moll_deriv η _ hη hηc hvI).2 b x]
      linarith
    · 
      have hW := heq ζ hζs hζc hζU
      have e1 : (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y * pd2 a ζ y) =
          fun y => -(∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a η (x - y) *
            K.indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) := by
        funext y
        by_cases hy : y ∈ K
        · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Set.indicator_of_mem hy, hζd]
          ring
        · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, hζd, hηd _ _ (hout y hy)]
          ring
      rw [e1, hmul, MeasureTheory.integral_neg] at hW
      have hint : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable (fun y => pd2 a η (x - y) *
          K.indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) := by
        intro a
        have hc : Continuous (pd2 a η) :=

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hpdc : ∀ (u : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → ∀ k : Fin 2, Continuous (pd2 k u) := by
    intro u hu k
    exact (hu.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  
  have hbd : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρ →
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n k, ∫ x in L, ((fun n k => pd2 k (w n)) n k x) ^ 2 ≤ C := by
    intro L hL hLB
    refine ⟨M, fun n k => ?_⟩
    have hS : Continuous (fun x => ∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 m (w n) x) ^ 2) :=
      continuous_finset_sum _ (fun m _ => (hpdc _ (hw n) m).pow 2)
    have hg : Continuous (fun x => (pd2 k (w n) x) ^ 2) := (hpdc _ (hw n) k).pow 2
    have hSB : IntegrableOn (fun x => ∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 m (w n) x) ^ 2) (Metric.ball x₀ ρ) :=
      (hS.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall x₀ ρ)).mono_set
        Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have h1 : ∫ x in L, (pd2 k (w n) x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in L, ∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 m (w n) x) ^ 2 :=
      setIntegral_mono (hg.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hL)
        (hS.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hL)
        (fun x => Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun m => (pd2 m (w n) x) ^ 2)
          (fun m _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ k))
    have h2 : ∫ x in L, ∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 m (w n) x) ^ 2 ≤
        ∫ x in Metric.ball x₀ ρ, ∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 m (w n) x) ^ 2 :=
      setIntegral_mono_set hSB
        (ae_of_all _ (fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m _ => sq_nonneg _))) hLB.eventuallyLE
    exact h1.trans (h2.trans (hM n))
  obtain ⟨ψ, H, hψ, hHL2, hconv⟩ := l2loc_weak_subseq (Metric.ball x₀ ρ) Metric.isOpen_ball
    (fun n k => pd2 k (w n)) (fun n k => (hpdc _ (hw n) k).continuousOn) hbd
  refine ⟨H, hHL2, ?_⟩
  intro ζ hζ hζc hζB k
  
  have hDcont : Continuous (pd2 k ζ) := hpdc ζ hζ k
  have hsupp : Function.support (pd2 k ζ) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
    intro x hx
    apply support_fderiv_subset ℝ
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    intro h0
    exact (Function.mem_support.mp hx) (by show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e2 k) = 0; rw [h0]; rfl)
  have hDc : HasCompactSupport (pd2 k ζ) := hζc.mono' hsupp
  have hDs : tsupport (pd2 k ζ) ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρ :=
    (closure_minimal hsupp (isClosed_tsupport ζ)).trans hζB
  
  have hBK : Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ) :=
    Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith))
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ))) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 (measure_closedBall_lt_top).ne
  have hφi : IntegrableOn φ (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)) := hφ.integrable one_le_two
  have hfi : Integrable ((Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ) :=
    (integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_closedBall).2 hφi
  obtain ⟨hint, hL1⟩ := elr_moll_L1 ((Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ) hfi η
    (fun j => (hη j).continuous) hη0 hη1 δ hδ hηs
  have hwc : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ,
      w j x = ∫ t, η j t * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ (x - t) := by
    intro j x hx
    rw [hwφ j x hx]
    have := integral_sub_left_eq_self
      (fun t => η j t * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ (x - t)) (μ := volume) x
    simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hDcont.bounded_above_of_compact_support hDc
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hC x₀)
  have I2 : ∀ j, Integrable (fun x => ((∫ t, η j t * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ
      (x - t)) - (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ x) * pd2 k ζ x) := by
    intro j
    exact (hint j).mul_bdd hDcont.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ hC)
  have hkey : ∀ j, (∫ x, w j x * pd2 k ζ x) - ∫ x, φ x * pd2 k ζ x
      = ∫ x, ((∫ t, η j t * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ (x - t)) -
          (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ x) * pd2 k ζ x := by
    intro j
    have I1 : Integrable (fun x => w j x * pd2 k ζ x) :=
      ((hw j).continuous.mul hDcont).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hDc.mul_left
    have hpt : (fun x => φ x * pd2 k ζ x) = fun x => w j x * pd2 k ζ x -
        ((∫ t, η j t * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ (x - t)) -
          (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ x) * pd2 k ζ x := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : pd2 k ζ x = 0
      · simp [hx]
      · have hxB : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ := hDs (subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hx))
        rw [hwc j x hxB, Set.indicator_of_mem (hBK hxB)]
        ring
    rw [hpt, integral_sub I1 (I2 j)]
    ring
  have hP : Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, w j x * pd2 k ζ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, φ x * pd2 k ζ x)) := by
    rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    have hL1C := hL1.const_mul C
    rw [mul_zero] at hL1C
    refine squeeze_zero (fun j => norm_nonneg _) (fun j => ?_) hL1C
    rw [hkey j, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc |∫ x, ((∫ t, η j t * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ (x - t)) -
            (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ x) * pd2 k ζ x|
        ≤ ∫ x, |((∫ t, η j t * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ (x - t)) -
            (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ x) * pd2 k ζ x| :=
          abs_integral_le_integral_abs
      _ ≤ ∫ x, C * |(∫ t, η j t * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ (x - t)) -
            (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ x| := by
          refine integral_mono (I2 j).abs ((hint j).abs.const_mul C) (fun x => ?_)
          have hx := hC x
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hx
          simp only [abs_mul]
          rw [mul_comm C]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = C * ∫ x, |(∫ t, η j t * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ (x - t)) -
            (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator φ x| := integral_const_mul _ _
  
  have hibp : ∀ n, ∫ x, w n x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, pd2 k (w n) x * ζ x) :=
    fun n => ibp_open_test (Metric.ball x₀ ρ) Metric.isOpen_ball (w n) (hw n).contDiffOn
      ζ hζ hζc hζB k
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, w (ψ m) x * pd2 k ζ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, φ x * pd2 k ζ x)) :=
    hP.comp hψ.tendsto_atTop
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, w (ψ m) x * pd2 k ζ x) atTop
      (𝓝 (-(∫ x, H k x * ζ x))) :=
    Tendsto.congr (fun m => (hibp (ψ m)).symm) (hconv k ζ hζ.continuous hζc hζB).neg
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2

proof.tactics:
by
  have hloc : LocallyIntegrable φ volume := hφ.locallyIntegrable
  have hsw : ∀ (k : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), ∫ y, k (x - y) * φ y = ∫ t, k t * φ (x - t) := by
    intro k x
    have h := MeasureTheory.integral_sub_left_eq_self
      (fun t => k t * φ (x - t)) volume x
    simp only [sub_sub_cancel] at h
    exact h
  have hconv : (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * φ y) =
      MeasureTheory.convolution η φ (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume := by
    funext x
    rw [hsw η x, MeasureTheory.convolution_def]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hconv]
    exact hηc.contDiff_convolution_left (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) hη hloc
  · intro m x
    have hD := hηc.hasFDerivAt_convolution_left (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ)
      (hη.of_le (by simp)) hloc x
    have hE := HasCompactSupport.convolutionExists_left
      (ContinuousLinearMap.precompL E2 (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ))
      (hηc.fderiv ℝ) (hη.continuous_fderiv (by simp)) hloc
    have hI := hE x
    unfold MeasureTheory.ConvolutionExistsAt at hI
    have hpd : pd2 m (fun x => ∫ y, η (x - y) * φ y) x =
        ∫ t, pd2 m η t * φ (x - t) := by
      unfold pd2
      rw [hconv, hD.fderiv, MeasureTheory.convolution_def,
        ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hI]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.precompL_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hpd, hsw (pd2 m η) x]
