proof.tactics:
by
  
  have wcs : ∀ (w ψ : E2 → ℝ), (∀ y, 0 ≤ w y) → Integrable w →
      Integrable (fun y => w y * ψ y) → Integrable (fun y => w y * ψ y ^ 2) →
      (∫ y, w y * ψ y) ^ 2 ≤ (∫ y, w y) * (∫ y, w y * ψ y ^ 2) := by
    intro w ψ hw0 hw hwψ hwψ2
    have key : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ (∫ y, w y) * (c * c) + (-2 * (∫ y, w y * ψ y)) * c +
        (∫ y, w y * ψ y ^ 2) := by
      intro c
      have h1 : (fun y => w y * (ψ y - c) ^ 2) =
          fun y => (w y * ψ y ^ 2 - (2 * c) * (w y * ψ y)) + (c * c) * w y := by
        funext y; ring
      have h2 : 0 ≤ ∫ y, w y * (ψ y - c) ^ 2 :=
        integral_nonneg (fun y => mul_nonneg (hw0 y) (sq_nonneg _))
      have hA : Integrable (fun y => w y * ψ y ^ 2 - 2 * c * (w y * ψ y)) :=
        hwψ2.sub (hwψ.const_mul (2 * c))
      have e1 : ∫ y, (w y * ψ y ^ 2 - 2 * c * (w y * ψ y) + c * c * w y) =
          (∫ y, (w y * ψ y ^ 2 - 2 * c * (w y * ψ y))) + ∫ y, c * c * w y :=
        integral_add hA (hw.const_mul (c * c))
      have e2 : ∫ y, (w y * ψ y ^ 2 - 2 * c * (w y * ψ y)) =
          (∫ y, w y * ψ y ^ 2) - ∫ y, 2 * c * (w y * ψ y) :=
        integral_sub hwψ2 (hwψ.const_mul (2 * c))
      have e3 : ∫ y, 2 * c * (w y * ψ y) = 2 * c * ∫ y, w y * ψ y := integral_const_mul _ _
      have e4 : ∫ y, c * c * w y = c * c * ∫ y, w y := integral_const_mul _ _
      rw [h1, e1, e2, e3, e4] at h2
      nlinarith [h2]
    have hd := discrim_le_zero key
    unfold discrim at hd
    nlinarith [hd]
  have hkI : Integrable k := hk.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hkc
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hk.bounded_above_of_compact_support hkc
  have hφ2 : Integrable (fun y => φ y ^ 2) := hφ.integrable_sq
  have slice : ∀ x : E2, Integrable (fun y => k (x - y)) ∧ Integrable (fun y => k (x - y) * φ y) ∧
      Integrable (fun y => k (x - y) * |φ y|) ∧ Integrable (fun y => k (x - y) * φ y ^ 2) ∧
      (∫ y, k (x - y)) = ∫ z, k z := by
    intro x
    have ha : Integrable (fun y => k (x - y)) := hkI.comp_sub_left x
    have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => k (x - y)) volume :=
      (hk.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hd : Integrable (fun y => k (x - y) * φ y ^ 2) :=
      hφ2.bdd_mul hm (ae_of_all _ (fun y => hB (x - y)))
    have hdom : Integrable (fun y => (k (x - y) + k (x - y) * φ y ^ 2) / 2) :=
      (ha.add hd).div_const 2
    have hb : Integrable (fun y => k (x - y) * φ y) := by
      refine hdom.mono' (hm.mul hφ.1) (ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_))
      show ‖k (x - y) * φ y‖ ≤ (k (x - y) + k (x - y) * φ y ^ 2) / 2
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hk0 _), ← sq_abs (φ y)]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (hk0 (x - y)) (sq_nonneg (|φ y| - 1))]
    have hc : Integrable (fun y => k (x - y) * |φ y|) := by
      refine hb.abs.congr (ae_of_all _ (fun y => ?_))
      simp only [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hk0 (x - y))]
    exact ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd, integral_sub_left_eq_self k volume x⟩
  
  have hQeq : (fun x => ∫ y, k (x - y) * φ y ^ 2) =
      MeasureTheory.convolution (fun y => φ y ^ 2) k (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume := by
    funext x
    rw [MeasureTheory.convolution_def]
    congr 1
    funext t
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hQi : Integrable (fun x => ∫ y, k (x - y) * φ y ^ 2) := by
    rw [hQeq]
    exact hφ2.integrable_convolution _ hkI
  have hQint : (∫ x, ∫ y, k (x - y) * φ y ^ 2) = (∫ z, k z) * (∫ y, φ y ^ 2) := by
    rw [hQeq, MeasureTheory.integral_convolution _ hφ2 hkI]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∫ z, k z := integral_nonneg hk0
  have hI0 : 0 ≤ ∫ y, φ y ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun y => sq_nonneg _)
  have hQ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ∫ y, k (x - y) * φ y ^ 2 :=
    fun x => integral_nonneg (fun y => mul_nonneg (hk0 _) (sq_nonneg _))
  have hsC : (∫ z, k z) ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hs0 hC 2
  have hfin : (∫ z, k z) * ((∫ z, k z) * (∫ y, φ y ^ 2)) ≤ C ^ 2 * (∫ y, φ y ^ 2) := by
    nlinarith
  have main : ∀ F : E2 → ℝ, (∀ x, F x ^ 2 ≤ (∫ z, k z) * ∫ y, k (x - y) * φ y ^ 2) →
      (∫ x in S, F x ^ 2) ≤ C ^ 2 * (∫ y, φ y ^ 2) := by
    intro F hF
    calc (∫ x in S, F x ^ 2) ≤ ∫ x in S, (∫ z, k z) * ∫ y, k (x - y) * φ y ^ 2 :=
          integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ (fun x => sq_nonneg _))
            (hQi.const_mul (∫ z, k z)).restrict (ae_of_all _ hF)
      _ ≤ ∫ x, (∫ z, k z) * ∫ y, k (x - y) * φ y ^ 2 :=
          setIntegral_le_integral (hQi.const_mul (∫ z, k z))
            (ae_of_all _ (fun x => mul_nonneg hs0 (hQ0 x)))
      _ = (∫ z, k z) * ((∫ z, k z) * (∫ y, φ y ^ 2)) := by rw [integral_const_mul, hQint]
      _ ≤ C ^ 2 * (∫ y, φ y ^ 2) := hfin
  refine ⟨main _ (fun x => ?_), main _ (fun x => ?_)⟩
  · obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd, he⟩ := slice x
    have h := wcs (fun y => k (x - y)) (fun y => |φ y|) (fun y => hk0 _) ha hc
      (by simpa only [sq_abs] using hd)
    simp only [sq_abs] at h
    rw [he] at h
    exact h
  · obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hd, he⟩ := slice x
    have h := wcs (fun y => k (x - y)) φ (fun y => hk0 _) ha hb hd
    beta_reduce at h
    rw [he] at h
    exact h

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (S : Set M) (hS : IsOpen S) (u ψ : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (q : M) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det) (chartAt E3 q '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))

signature.name: chart_gradNorm_integrableOn
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (S : Set M) (hS : IsOpen S) (u ψ : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (q : M) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det) (chartAt E3 q '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hG : ContinuousOn (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j => (g.smooth q i j).continuousOn
  have hdetc : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ => A.det) := continuous_id.matrix_det
  have hsqdet : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn (hdetc.comp_continuousOn hG)
  have hinvc : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    intro i j
    have hadj : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ => A.adjugate i j) :=
      (continuous_id.matrix_adjugate).matrix_elem i j
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)⁻¹ *
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).adjugate i j) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      ((hdetc.comp_continuousOn hG).inv₀
        fun y hy => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q y hy).det_pos.ne').mul
        (hadj.comp_continuousOn hG)
    refine h1.congr fun y _ => ?_
    simp only [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hgradc : ContinuousOn (fun y => g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 q).symm.toPartialEquiv
        open_source := (chartAt E3 q).open_target
        open_target := (chartAt E3 q).open_source
        contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
        contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
    have hup : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn
        (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      intro i
      exact (hup.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 q).open_target (by simp)).clm_apply
        continuousOn_const
    have hR : ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
      exact ((hinvc i j).mul (hpd i)).mul (hpd j)
    refine hR.congr fun y hy => ?_
    exact gradInner_eq_coord g Φ u (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) hu y hy
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
  have hψT : ContinuousOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    hψ.continuous.comp_continuousOn (chartAt E3 q).continuousOn_symm
  have hhc : ContinuousOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
      Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) *
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    (hψT.mul (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn hgradc)).mul hsqdet
  have hKc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 q '' tsupport ψ) :=
    hψc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn.mono hψs)
  have hKT : chartAt E3 q '' tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hψs hx)
  have hAm : MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 q '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) :=
    ((chartAt E3 q).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hS.inter (chartAt E3 q).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right).measurableSet
  have h0 : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source),
      y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' tsupport ψ →
      ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det = 0 := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨_, hxU⟩, rfl⟩ hyK
    have hψx : ψ x = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hyK ⟨x, subset_tsupport ψ hne, rfl⟩
    rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxU, hψx, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  have hInd := ((hhc.mono hKT).integrableOn_compact (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hKc).integrable_indicator
    hKc.measurableSet
  refine (hInd.integrableOn (s := chartAt E3 q '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))).congr_fun
    (fun y hy => ?_) hAm
  by_cases hyK : y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' tsupport ψ
  · simp [Set.indicator, hyK]
  · simp only [Set.indicator, hyK, if_false]
    exact (h0 y hy hyK).symm

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.gradInner f f (Φ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff Φ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i h x * partialDeriv j h x

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig E O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (t₀ a b : ℝ) (hE : IsOpen E) (hfr : frontier E = Sig) (hO : IsOpen O) (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀}) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O) (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ Sig → w x = 0) (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ Sig)) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (hbd : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, w x ≤ t₀ → g.gradInner w w x ≤ C ∧ |g.levelMeanCurv w x| ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ t₀) (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (q : M) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det) (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))

signature.name: collar_curv_integrableOn
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig E O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (t₀ a b : ℝ) (hE : IsOpen E) (hfr : frontier E = Sig) (hO : IsOpen O) (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀}) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O) (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ Sig → w x = 0) (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ Sig)) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (hbd : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, w x ≤ t₀ → g.gradInner w w x ≤ C ∧ |g.levelMeanCurv w x| ≤ C) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ t₀) (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (q : M) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det) (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ : ∃ f : M → ℝ,
      f = O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hζ]
  
  have hSigc : IsClosed Sig := hfr ▸ isClosed_frontier
  have hEsig : ∀ x ∈ E, x ∉ Sig := by
    intro x hx hxS
    rw [← hfr, hE.frontier_eq] at hxS
    exact hxS.2 hx
  have hD : IsOpen (O \ Sig) := hO.sdiff hSigc
  set T : Set E3 := (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (O \ Sig) with hTdef
  set K : Set E3 := (chartAt E3 q) '' tsupport ψ with hKdef
  have hT : IsOpen T := (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hD
  have hTt : T ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target := Set.inter_subset_left
  have hTO : ∀ y ∈ T, (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ O \ Sig := fun y hy => hy.2
  have hKc : IsCompact K := hψc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn.mono hψs)
  have hKt : K ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hψs hx)
  have ht : MeasurableSet ((chartAt E3 q) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) :=
    ((chartAt E3 q).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hE.inter (chartAt E3 q).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right).measurableSet
  
  have hζ01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [hζ]
    by_cases hx : x ∈ O
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      have h1 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg ((w x - a) / (b - a))
      have h2 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one ((w x - a) / (b - a))
      constructor <;> linarith
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
      exact ⟨le_refl _, zero_le_one⟩
  have hζ0 : ∀ x, ζ x ≠ 0 → x ∈ O ∧ w x < b := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hζ] at hx
    by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
    · refine ⟨hxO, ?_⟩
      by_contra hge
      push_neg at hge
      apply hx
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxO]
      have h1 : 1 ≤ (w x - a) / (b - a) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        linarith
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le h1]
      ring
    · exact absurd (Set.indicator_of_notMem hxO _) hx
  
  have hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j)
      (chartAt E3 q).target := fun i j => g.smooth q i j
  have hpd : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef :=
    fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q y hy
  have hGc : ContinuousOn (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    apply continuousOn_pi.2
    intro i
    apply continuousOn_pi.2
    intro j
    exact (hG i j).continuousOn
  have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn ((continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hGc)
  
  obtain ⟨hwq, hK2⟩ := chart_unit_normal_calculus g (O \ Sig) w hD hws hdw q
  have hlmc : ∀ y ∈ T, g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) =
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
    intro y hy
    have h := (hK2 ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ⟨hTO y hy, (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy.1⟩).2.1
    rwa [(chartAt E3 q).right_inv hy.1] at h
  have hdf : ∀ y ∈ T, fderiv ℝ (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy h0
    have h := (hK2 ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ⟨hTO y hy, (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy.1⟩).1
    rw [(chartAt E3 q).right_inv hy.1] at h
    simp [partialDeriv, h0] at h
  have hL := lmcCoord_contDiffOn (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) T hT
    (fun i j => (hG i j).mono hTt) (fun y hy => hpd y (hTt hy)) _ hwq hdf
  have hHc : ContinuousOn (fun y => g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) T :=
    hL.continuousOn.congr (fun y hy => hlmc y hy)
  
  have hψq : ContinuousOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    hψ.continuous.comp_continuousOn (chartAt E3 q).continuousOn_symm
  have hζc : ContinuousOn (fun y => ζ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) T := by
    have hw' : ContinuousOn (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) T :=
      hwc.comp ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn_symm.mono hTt) (fun y hy => (hTO y hy).1)
    have h1 : ContinuousOn
        (fun y => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) - a) / (b - a))) T :=
      continuousOn_const.sub (Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp_continuousOn
        ((hw'.sub continuousOn_const).div_const _))
    refine h1.congr ?_
    intro y hy
    simp only [hζ, Set.indicator_of_mem (hTO y hy).1]
  have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * (ζ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
      g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det) T :=
    ((hψq.mono hTt).mul (hζc.mul hHc)).mul (hsc.mono hTt)
  
  obtain ⟨Mψ, hMψ⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn ((hψq.mul hsc).mono hKt)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd
  have hζH : ∀ y ∈ T, |ζ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)|
      ≤ max C 0 := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hz : ζ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = 0
    · rw [hz, zero_mul, abs_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    · have hwb := (hζ0 _ hz).2
      have hHx := (hC _ (hTO y hy) (by linarith)).2
      have h01 := hζ01 ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h01.1]
      calc ζ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * |g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)| ≤ 1 * C :=
            mul_le_mul h01.2 hHx (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ ≤ max C 0 := by rw [one_mul]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hSm : MeasurableSet (T ∩ K) := hT.measurableSet.inter hKc.isClosed.measurableSet
  have hSfin : MeasureTheory.volume (T ∩ K) < ⊤ :=
    (MeasureTheory.measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right).trans_lt hKc.measure_lt_top
  have hmeas := (hFc.mono (Set.inter_subset_left : T ∩ K ⊆ T)).aestronglyMeasurable
    (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hSm
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ y ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (T ∩ K)),
      ‖ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * (ζ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
        g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det‖
        ≤ Mψ * max C 0 := by
    refine MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hSm (fun y hy => ?_)
    have h1 : ‖ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det‖ ≤ Mψ :=
      hMψ y hy.2
    have h2 := hζH y hy.1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1 ⊢
    have e : ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * (ζ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
        g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det
        = (ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det) *
          (ζ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) := by ring
    rw [e, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans h1)
  have hS := MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.of_bound hSfin hmeas _ hbound
  refine hS.of_forall_diff_eq_zero ht ?_
  
  rintro _ ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxE, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hyTK⟩
  simp only [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxs]
  by_cases hyT : chartAt E3 q x ∈ T
  · have hxK : chartAt E3 q x ∉ K := fun h => hyTK ⟨hyT, h⟩
    have hψx : ψ x = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hxK ⟨x, subset_tsupport _ h, rfl⟩
    rw [hψx]
    ring
  · have hxO : x ∉ O := by
      intro hxO
      apply hyT
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 q).map_source hxs, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q x) ∈ O \ Sig
      rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxs]
      exact ⟨hxO, hEsig x hxE⟩
    have hζx : ζ x = 0 := by
      rw [hζ]
      exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hxO _
    rw [hζx]
    ring

subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (D : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (hD : IsOpen D) (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w D) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ D, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (p : M) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D) ∧ ∀ x ∈ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) * partialDeriv b (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ g.levelMeanCurv w x = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) : E3) = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) i) ∧ g.g x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) = 1

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig E O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (t₀ a b c d : ℝ) (hE : IsOpen E) (hfr : frontier E = Sig) (hO : IsOpen O) (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀}) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O) (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ Sig → w x = 0) (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ Sig)) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ t₀) (hc : 0 < c) (hcd : c < d) (hd : d ≤ t₀) : ∃ Z : M → E3, calSmoothField Z ∧ (∀ x, Z x ≠ 0 → x ∈ E ∧ x ∈ O ∧ x ∉ Sig ∧ w x ≤ t₀) ∧ (∀ x ∈ frontier E, ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Z x' = 0) ∧ ∀ (p : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target → (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ E → (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ O → (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∉ Sig → ∀ i : Fin 3, @id E3 (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) i = (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c))) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) - O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) * calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y i

signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig E O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (t₀ a b c d : ℝ) (hE : IsOpen E) (hfr : frontier E = Sig) (hO : IsOpen O) (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀}) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O) (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ Sig → w x = 0) (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ Sig)) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ O \ Sig, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ t₀) (hc : 0 < c) (hcd : c < d) (hd : d ≤ t₀) : ∃ Z : M → E3, calSmoothField Z ∧ (∀ x, Z x ≠ 0 → x ∈ E ∧ x ∈ O ∧ x ∉ Sig ∧ w x ≤ t₀) ∧ (∀ x ∈ frontier E, ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Z x' = 0) ∧ ∀ (p : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target → (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ E → (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ O → (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∉ Sig → ∀ i : Fin 3, @id E3 (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) i = (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c))) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) - O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) * calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y i

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hSigc : IsClosed Sig := hfr ▸ isClosed_frontier
  have hESig : Disjoint E Sig := by
    rw [← hfr, hE.frontier_eq]; exact Set.disjoint_sdiff_right
  have hclE : closure E ⊆ E ∪ Sig := by
    rw [← hfr, closure_eq_self_union_frontier]
  have hDo : IsOpen (O \ Sig) := hO.sdiff hSigc
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζdef⟩ : ∃ ζ : M → ℝ,
      ζ = O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨χ, hχdef⟩ : ∃ χ : M → ℝ,
      χ = O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hζs, -, hζ1, hζ0, -, hcl, -⟩ :=
    collar_cutoff_props Sig O w t₀ a b hSigc hO hcpt hwc hw0 hws ha hab hb
  obtain ⟨hχs, -, hχ1, hχ0, -, -, -⟩ :=
    collar_cutoff_props Sig O w t₀ c d hSigc hO hcpt hwc hw0 hws hc hcd hd
  rw [← hζdef] at hζs hζ1 hζ0
  rw [← hχdef] at hχs hχ1 hχ0
  rw [← hζdef, ← hχdef]
  have hK₀ : IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} := (hcl t₀ le_rfl).1
  have hNm : IsOpen (O ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Iio (min a c)) := hwc.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_Iio
  
  have hζK : ∀ x, x ∉ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} → ζ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    exact hx ⟨(hζ0 x h).1, by linarith [(hζ0 x h).2]⟩
  have hχK : ∀ x, x ∉ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} → χ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    exact hx ⟨(hχ0 x h).1, by linarith [(hχ0 x h).2]⟩
  have hNmΘ : ∀ x ∈ O ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Iio (min a c), χ x - ζ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hw : w x < min a c := hx.2
    rw [(hζ1 x hx.1 (le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hw (min_le_left a c)))).1,
      (hχ1 x hx.1 (le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hw (min_le_right a c)))).1, sub_self]
  have hΘsupp : ∀ x, χ x - ζ x ≠ 0 → x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀ := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hζx : ζ x = 0
    · have hχx : χ x ≠ 0 := by
        intro h; apply hx; rw [h, hζx, sub_zero]
      exact ⟨(hχ0 x hχx).1, by linarith [(hχ0 x hχx).2]⟩
    · exact ⟨(hζ0 x hζx).1, by linarith [(hζ0 x hζx).2]⟩
  have hΘloc : ∀ x, (x ∈ Sig ∨ x ∉ O) → ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, χ x' - ζ x' = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
    · have hxS : x ∈ Sig := hx.resolve_right (fun h => h hxO)
      have hw : w x = 0 := hw0 x hxO hxS
      have hmem : x ∈ O ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Iio (min a c) :=
        ⟨hxO, show w x < min a c by rw [hw]; exact lt_min ha hc⟩
      filter_upwards [hNm.mem_nhds hmem] with x' hx'
      exact hNmΘ x' hx'
    · filter_upwards [hK₀.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds (fun h => hxO h.1)] with x' hx'
      rw [hζK x' hx', hχK x' hx', sub_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : M → E3, U = fun x => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
      (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm)
        (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Z, hZdef⟩ : ∃ Z : M → E3, Z = E.indicator (fun x => (χ x - ζ x) • U x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs2 := fun p => chart_unit_normal_calculus g (O \ Sig) w hDo hws hdw p
  have hZE : ∀ x ∈ E, Z x = (χ x - ζ x) • U x := by
    intro x hx; rw [hZdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
  have hZnE : ∀ x, x ∉ E → Z x = 0 := by
    intro x hx; rw [hZdef, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
  have hZΘ : ∀ x, χ x - ζ x = 0 → Z x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxE : x ∈ E
    · rw [hZE x hxE, hx, zero_smul]
    · exact hZnE x hxE
  have hZsupp : ∀ x, Z x ≠ 0 → x ∈ E ∧ x ∈ O ∧ x ∉ Sig ∧ w x ≤ t₀ := by
    intro x hx
    have hxE : x ∈ E := by
      by_contra h; exact hx (hZnE x h)
    have hΘ : χ x - ζ x ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (hZΘ x h)
    exact ⟨hxE, (hΘsupp x hΘ).1, fun hs => Set.disjoint_left.1 hESig hxE hs, (hΘsupp x hΘ).2⟩
  have hZloc : ∀ x, x ∉ E ∩ (O \ Sig) → ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Z x' = 0 := by
    intro x hxED
    by_cases hxc : x ∈ closure E
    · have hor : x ∈ Sig ∨ x ∉ O := by
        rcases hclE hxc with h | h
        · right
          intro hxO
          exact hxED ⟨h, hxO, fun hs => Set.disjoint_left.1 hESig h hs⟩
        · exact Or.inl h
      filter_upwards [hΘloc x hor] with x' hx'
      exact hZΘ x' hx'
    · filter_upwards [isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxc] with x' hx'
      exact hZnE x' (fun h => hx' (subset_closure h))
  
  have hZfr : ∀ x ∈ frontier E, ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Z x' = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hfr] at hx
    exact hZloc x (fun h => h.2.2 hx)
  
  have hZrep : ∀ p : M, ∀ x ∈ E ∩ (O \ Sig) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source,
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) x (Z x) : E3) =
        (χ x - ζ x) • (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal
          (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) i) := by
    intro p x hx
    rw [hZE x hx.1.1, ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, hUdef]
    rw [((hs2 p).2 x ⟨hx.1.2, hx.2⟩).2.2.1]
  
  have hZs : calSmoothField Z := by
    unfold calSmoothField
    intro p y hyt
    refine ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt ?_
    by_cases hx : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ E ∩ (O \ Sig)
    · have hW : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (E ∩ (O \ Sig))) :=
        (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (hE.inter hDo)
      have hT' : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (O \ Sig)) :=
        (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hDo
      obtain ⟨hNo, hNs, -⟩ := ccs_normal_props (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) _ hT'
        (fun i j => (g.smooth p i j).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (fun z hz => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p z hz.1) (hs2 p).1
        (fun z => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal
          (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z i))
        (fun z _ i => rfl)
      have hζp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
        contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hζs.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
      have hχp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
        contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hχs.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
      have hev : (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p)
          ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          fun z => (χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) - ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) •
            (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
            (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
              (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z i) := by
        filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds ⟨hyt, hx⟩] with z hz
        have := hZrep p ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) ⟨hz.2, (chartAt E3 p).map_target hz.1⟩
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv hz.1] at this
        exact this
      refine ContDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_ hev
      have hA1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
          (fun z => χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) - ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y :=
        (hχp.sub hζp).contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds hyt)
      have hA2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
          (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
            (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z i)) y := by
        apply hNs.contDiffAt
        apply hNo.mem_nhds
        refine ⟨⟨hyt, hx.2⟩, ?_⟩
        have := ((hs2 p).2 _ ⟨hx.2, (chartAt E3 p).map_target hyt⟩).1
        rwa [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv hyt] at this
      exact hA1.smul hA2
    · have hev := hZloc _ hx
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (chartAt E3 p).symm y := (chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm hyt
      have h2 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) = 0 := hcont.eventually hev
      refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : E3))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [h2] with z hz
      simp [hz]
  
  refine ⟨Z, hZs, hZsupp, hZfr, ?_⟩
  intro p y hyt hxE hxO hxS i
  have hxsrc : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hyt
  have h := hZrep p ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) ⟨⟨hxE, hxO, hxS⟩, hxsrc⟩
  rw [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv hyt] at h
  have h2 := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v i) h
  refine h2.trans ?_
  rfl

subgoal_signatures.name: collar_cutoff_props
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (Sig O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ)
    (t₀ a b : ℝ) (hSig : IsClosed Sig) (hO : IsOpen O) (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀})
    (hwc : ContinuousOn w O) (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ Sig → w x = 0)
    (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ Sig)) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ t₀) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
        (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ∧
        O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O, w x ≤ a →
        O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x = 1 ∧
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x, O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ≠ 0 →
        x ∈ O ∧ w x < b) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b} →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) x = 0) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, c ≤ t₀ → IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c} ∧ IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c}) ∧
      IsCompact {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b}

subgoal_signatures.name: chart_unit_normal_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (D : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (hD : IsOpen D) (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w D) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ D, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (p : M) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D) ∧ ∀ x ∈ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) * partialDeriv b (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ g.levelMeanCurv w x = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) : E3) = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) i) ∧ g.g x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) = 1

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_normal_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) : IsOpen {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z → ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 → |fderiv ℝ f z w| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (X z)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxE, hxs⟩, hxy⟩ := hy
  have hyt : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := hxy ▸ (chartAt E3 q).map_source hxs
  have hsy : (chartAt E3 q).symm y = x := by rw [← hxy]; exact (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxs
  have hSigc : IsClosed Sig := hfr ▸ isClosed_frontier
  have hxS : x ∉ Sig := by
    rw [← hfr, hE.frontier_eq]
    exact fun h => h.2 hxE
  have hK0 : IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} := hcpt.isClosed
  obtain ⟨hζs, -, -, hζ0, -⟩ :=
    collar_cutoff_props Sig O w t₀ a b hSigc hO hcpt hwc hw0 hws ha hab hb
  obtain ⟨hχs, -, -, hχ0, -⟩ :=
    collar_cutoff_props Sig O w t₀ c d hSigc hO hcpt hwc hw0 hws hc hcd hd
  have s5 : ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
    intro u hu
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    have h2 := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    exact (h2.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
      ((chartAt E3 q).open_target.mem_nhds hyt)
  by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
  · 
    have hD : IsOpen (O \ Sig) := hO.sdiff hSigc
    have hxD : x ∈ O \ Sig := ⟨hxO, hxS⟩
    obtain ⟨hf, hpt⟩ := chart_unit_normal_calculus g (O \ Sig) w hD hws hdw q
    obtain ⟨hQ, hH, -⟩ := hpt x ⟨hxD, hxs⟩
    rw [hxy] at hQ hH
    obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Set E3,
        T = (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (O \ Sig) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hTdef] at hf
    have hTo : IsOpen T := by rw [hTdef]; exact (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hD
    have hyT : y ∈ T := by
      rw [hTdef]
      exact ⟨hyt, by rw [Set.mem_preimage, hsy]; exact hxD⟩
    have hWo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (E ∩ (O \ Sig))) :=
      (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (hE.inter hD)
    have hyW : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (E ∩ (O \ Sig)) :=
      ⟨hyt, by rw [Set.mem_preimage, hsy]; exact ⟨hxE, hxD⟩⟩
    have hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z i j) T := by
      intro i j
      rw [hTdef]
      exact (g.smooth q i j).mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).PosDef := by
      intro z hz
      rw [hTdef] at hz
      exact coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q z hz.1
    have hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z j i :=
      fun z i j => g.symm _ _ _
    obtain ⟨N, hNdef⟩ : ∃ N : E3 → E3, N = fun z => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
        (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
          (fun z' => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z')) z i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hNi : ∀ z i, N z i = calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun z' => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z')) z i := by
      intro z i
      rw [hNdef]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨hT'o, hNs, -⟩ := ccs_normal_props (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
      (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) T hTo hG hpd hf N (fun z _ i => hNi z i)
    have hNd : DifferentiableAt ℝ N y :=
      (hNs.contDiffAt (hT'o.mem_nhds ⟨hyT, hQ⟩)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hsd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det) y := by
      have h1 := ccs_sqrtdet_smooth (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target
        (g.smooth q) (fun z hz => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q z hz).det_pos)
      exact (h1.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        ((chartAt E3 q).open_target.mem_nhds hyt)
    have hW1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det * N z i) y :=
      fun i => hsd.mul ((differentiableAt_piLp 2).mp hNd i)
    
    have hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, calPiece q ψ Z z i =
        (ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) *
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) -
            O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))) * N z i + (0 : ℝ) * (0 : E3) i := by
      filter_upwards [hWo.mem_nhds hyW] with z hz i
      have h1 := hZq z hz.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2.1 hz.2.2.2 i
      have e1 : calPiece q ψ Z z i = ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) *
          @id E3 (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)
            (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))) i := by
        simp only [calPiece, Set.indicator_of_mem hz.1]
        rfl
      rw [e1, h1, hNi]
      simp only [PiLp.zero_apply, mul_zero, add_zero]
      ring
    
    have hdiv := ccs_div_local (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q ψ Z) N (fun _ => (0 : E3))
      (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) *
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) -
            O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)))
      (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) y hloc ((s5 ψ hψ).mul ((s5 _ hχs).sub (s5 _ hζs)))
      (differentiableAt_const _) hW1 (fun i => by simp)
    simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hdiv
    
    have hdivN := ccs_divx (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) T hTo
      hG hsymm hpd hf N (fun z _ i => hNi z i) y hyT hQ
    
    have hleib : fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) *
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) -
            O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))) y (N y) =
        ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
          (fderiv ℝ (fun z => O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y (N y) -
            fderiv ℝ (fun z => O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y (N y)) +
        (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) -
            O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y (N y) := by
      have hB : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) *
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) -
            O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)))
          (ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) •
            (fderiv ℝ (fun z => O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y -
            fderiv ℝ (fun z => O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) +
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) -
            O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) •
            fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) y :=
        (s5 ψ hψ).hasFDerivAt.mul ((s5 _ hχs).hasFDerivAt.sub (s5 _ hζs).hasFDerivAt)
      rw [hB.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    
    have hexp : ∀ (L' : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E3), L' v = ∑ i, v i * L' (e i) := by
      intro L' v
      conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr v]
      simp [map_sum, map_smul]
    obtain ⟨Qv, hQv⟩ : ∃ Qv : ℝ, Qv = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ a b *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv b (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hQ' : 0 < Qv := by rw [hQv]; exact hQ
    have hsQ : 0 < Real.sqrt Qv := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hQ'
    have hwd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y :=
      (hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hTo.mem_nhds hyT)
    have hLN : fderiv ℝ (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y (N y) = Real.sqrt Qv := by
      rw [hexp]
      simp only [hNi, calUnitNormal]
      rw [← hQv]
      have e2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, (Real.sqrt Qv)⁻¹ * (∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i k *
            partialDeriv k (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) *
            fderiv ℝ (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y (e i) = (Real.sqrt Qv)⁻¹ * Qv := by
        rw [hQv]
        simp only [partialDeriv, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [e2, inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ hsQ.ne']
      exact (Real.mul_self_sqrt hQ'.le).symm
    have hcut : ∀ α β : ℝ, α < β →
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α)))) →
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α)))
            ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y (N y) =
          -Real.sqrt (g.gradInner
            (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α))))
            (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α))))
            ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) := by
      intro α β hαβ hcs
      have hβα : 0 < β - α := by linarith
      obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ, σ = (w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) - α) / (β - α) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ : ∃ lam : ℝ, lam = deriv Real.smoothTransition σ * (β - α)⁻¹ :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hlam0 : 0 ≤ lam := by
        rw [hlam]
        exact mul_nonneg Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hβα.le)
      have hst : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition σ)
          ((w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) - α) / (β - α)) := by
        rw [← hσ]
        exact ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by norm_num) σ).hasDerivAt
      have hin : HasFDerivAt (fun z => (w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) - α) / (β - α))
          ((β - α)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) y := by
        have h1 := (hwd.hasFDerivAt.sub_const α).const_mul (β - α)⁻¹
        have e3 : (fun z => (w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) - α) / (β - α)) =
            fun z => (β - α)⁻¹ * (w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) - α) := by
          funext z
          rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
        rw [e3]
        exact h1
      have hF : HasFDerivAt
          (fun z => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) - α) / (β - α)))
          (-(deriv Real.smoothTransition σ •
            ((β - α)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y))) y := by
        have h2 := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (h₂ := Real.smoothTransition) y hst hin
        exact h2.const_sub 1
      have hev : (fun z => O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α)))
            ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          fun z => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) - α) / (β - α)) := by
        filter_upwards [hTo.mem_nhds hyT] with z hz
        rw [hTdef] at hz
        exact Set.indicator_of_mem hz.2.1 _
      have hcder : fderiv ℝ (fun z => O.indicator
            (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α))) ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
          -(deriv Real.smoothTransition σ •
            ((β - α)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y)) :=
        (hF.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).fderiv
      have hpc : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => O.indicator
            (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α))) ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
          -lam * partialDeriv k (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
        intro k
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [hcder, hlam]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      have hgr := gradInner_eq_coord g
        { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 q).symm.toPartialEquiv,
          open_source := (chartAt E3 q).open_target,
          open_target := (chartAt E3 q).open_source,
          contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm,
          contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
        (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α))))
        (fun z => O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α)))
          ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) hcs y hyt (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
      have hgr' : g.gradInner
            (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α))))
            (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α))))
            ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
            partialDeriv i (fun z => O.indicator
              (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α))) ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y *
            partialDeriv j (fun z => O.indicator
              (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α))) ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y :=
        hgr
      have hgv : g.gradInner
            (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α))))
            (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - α) / (β - α))))
            ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = lam ^ 2 * Qv := by
        rw [hgr']
        simp only [hpc]
        rw [hQv]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [hgv, Real.sqrt_mul' _ hQ'.le, Real.sqrt_sq hlam0, hcder]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hLN, hlam]
      ring
    have hcζ := hcut a b hab hζs
    have hcχ := hcut c d hcd hχs
    
    have hRy : (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3) =
        (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) -
            O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
              ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) • N y := by
      refine PiLp.ext fun i => ?_
      rw [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hNi]
      exact hZq y hyt (by rw [hsy]; exact hxE) (by rw [hsy]; exact hxO) (by rw [hsy]; exact hxS) i
    have hH' : g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) =
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      rw [hsy]; exact hH
    
    rw [hdiv, hdivN, hleib, hcζ, hcχ, hRy, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hH']
    ring
  · 
    have hxK : x ∉ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} := fun h => hxO h.1
    have hZ0' : ∀ x', x' ∉ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} → Z x' = 0 := by
      intro x' hx'
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨-, h1, -, h2⟩ := hZ0 x' hne
      exact hx' ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have hP : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, calPiece q ψ Z z = 0 := by
      have hVo := (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hK0.isOpen_compl
      have hyV : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩
          (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀}ᶜ :=
        ⟨hyt, by rw [Set.mem_preimage, hsy]; exact hxK⟩
      filter_upwards [hVo.mem_nhds hyV] with z hz
      have hZz : Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) = 0 := hZ0' _ hz.2
      simp only [calPiece, Set.indicator_of_mem hz.1, hZz, map_zero, smul_zero]
    have hL : sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q ψ Z) y = 0 := by
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
      have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det * calPiece q ψ Z z i)
          =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := hP.mono fun z hz => by simp [hz]
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hgz : ∀ u : M → ℝ, (∀ x', x' ∉ {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} → u x' = 0) →
        g.gradInner u u x = 0 := by
      intro u hu
      have hu' : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, u x' = 0 :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hK0.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxK) fun x' hx' => hu x' hx'
      have hc' := (chartAt E3 x).continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 x)
      have hlx : (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x x) = x :=
        (chartAt E3 x).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x)
      have hu'' : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 ((chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x x)), u x' = 0 := by
        rw [hlx]; exact hu'
      have h2 : (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 x).symm y')) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 x x)]
          fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := hc'.tendsto.eventually hu''
      have hpd0 : ∀ i, partialDeriv i (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 x).symm y'))
          (chartAt E3 x x) = 0 := by
        intro i
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [h2.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, hpd0, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    have hζx : O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x = 0 :=
      Set.indicator_of_notMem hxO _
    have hχx : O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c))) x = 0 :=
      Set.indicator_of_notMem hxO _
    have hgζ := hgz (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))))
      (fun x' hx' => by
        by_contra hne
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hζ0 x' hne
        exact hx' ⟨h1, by linarith⟩)
    have hgχ := hgz (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - c) / (d - c))))
      (fun x' hx' => by
        by_contra hne
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hχ0 x' hne
        exact hx' ⟨h1, by linarith⟩)
    have hZx : Z x = 0 := hZ0' x hxK
    rw [hL, hsy, hζx, hχx, hgζ, hgχ, hZx]
    simp

subgoal_signatures.name: collar_cutoff_props
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (Sig O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ)
    (t₀ a b : ℝ) (hSig : IsClosed Sig) (hO : IsOpen O) (hcpt : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀})
    (hwc : ContinuousOn w O) (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ Sig → w x = 0)
    (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ Sig)) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ t₀) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
        (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ∧
        O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O, w x ≤ a →
        O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x = 1 ∧
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x, O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a))) x ≠ 0 →
        x ∈ O ∧ w x < b) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∉ {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b} →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)
          (O.indicator (fun x => 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))) x = 0) ∧
      (∀ c : ℝ, c ≤ t₀ → IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c} ∧ IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ c}) ∧
      IsCompact {y | y ∈ O ∧ a ≤ w y ∧ w y ≤ b}

subgoal_signatures.name: chart_unit_normal_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (D : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (hD : IsOpen D) (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w D) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ D, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (p : M) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D) ∧ ∀ x ∈ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) * partialDeriv b (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ g.levelMeanCurv w x = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) : E3) = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) i) ∧ g.g x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) = 1

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_div_local
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V W₁ W₂ : E3 → E3) (h₁ h₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, V z i = h₁ z * W₁ z i + h₂ z * W₂ z i) (hh₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ h₁ y) (hh₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ h₂ y) (hW₁ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₁ z i) y) (hW₂ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₂ z i) y) : sepDensDiv G V y = h₁ y * sepDensDiv G W₁ y + Real.sqrt (G y).det * fderiv ℝ h₁ y (W₁ y) + (h₂ y * sepDensDiv G W₂ y + Real.sqrt (G y).det * fderiv ℝ h₂ y (W₂ y))

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_divx
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ T) (hN : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y) : sepDensDiv G X y = Real.sqrt (G y).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y

subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) : IsOpen {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z → ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 → |fderiv ℝ f z w| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (X z)

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :

      (g.coeff Φ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i h x * partialDeriv j h x

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E : Set M) (hE : IsOpen E) (Z : M → E3) (hZ : calSmoothField Z) (hZfr : ∀ x ∈ frontier E, ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Z x' = 0) (q : M) (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) : ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q ψ Z) y = 0 ∧ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det * fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q ψ Z))
