proof.tactics:
by
  have h1inf : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  have hSo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) :=
    (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hE.inter (chartAt E3 q).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right
  have hST : chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨-, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source hx
  obtain ⟨hF, hInt⟩ := calPiece_regular g q ψ hψ hψc hψs Z hZ
  have hKc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 q '' tsupport ψ) :=
    hψc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn.mono hψs)
  have hKcl : IsClosed (chartAt E3 q '' tsupport ψ) := hKc.isClosed
  have hKT : chartAt E3 q '' tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hψs hx)
  have hψoff : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, z ∉ chartAt E3 q '' tsupport ψ →
      ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) = 0 := by
    intro z hz hzK
    apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
    intro hx
    exact hzK ⟨(chartAt E3 q).symm z, hx, (chartAt E3 q).right_inv hz⟩
  have hoff : ∀ z, z ∉ chartAt E3 q '' tsupport ψ → calPiece q ψ Z z = 0 := by
    intro z hzK
    by_cases hz : z ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target
    · simp [calPiece, hz, hψoff z hz hzK]
    · simp [calPiece, hz]
  have hfr : ∀ y ∈ frontier (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)),
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, calPiece q ψ Z z = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hSo.frontier_eq] at hy
    obtain ⟨hycl, hyS⟩ := hy
    by_cases hyK : y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' tsupport ψ
    · obtain ⟨x, hxK, rfl⟩ := hyK
      have hxU : x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := hψs hxK
      have hyT : chartAt E3 q x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).map_source hxU
      have hxE : x ∉ E := fun h => hyS ⟨x, ⟨h, hxU⟩, rfl⟩
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q x) :=
        (chartAt E3 q).continuousAt_symm hyT
      have hxcl : x ∈ closure E := by
        have h1 := mem_closure_image hcont hycl
        rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxU] at h1
        refine closure_mono ?_ h1
        rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x', ⟨hx'E, hx'U⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hx'U]
        exact hx'E
      have hxfr : x ∈ frontier E := by
        rw [hE.frontier_eq]
        exact ⟨hxcl, hxE⟩
      have hZev := hZfr x hxfr
      have htend : Tendsto (chartAt E3 q).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 q x)) (𝓝 x) := by
        have := hcont.tendsto
        rwa [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxU] at this
      filter_upwards [htend.eventually hZev, (chartAt E3 q).open_target.mem_nhds hyT] with z hz hzT
      simp [calPiece, hzT, hz]
    · exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hKcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hyK) (fun z hz => hoff z hz)
  have hPc : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport
      (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det * calPiece q ψ Z z i) := by
    intro i
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro hKc (fun z hz => ?_)
    simp [hoff z hz]
  have hflux := ccs_flux_zero (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q ψ Z) _ hSo
    (fun i => (hF i).of_le h1inf) hPc hfr
  
  have hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      hψ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  have hG : ContinuousOn (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    apply continuousOn_pi.2
    intro i
    apply continuousOn_pi.2
    intro j
    exact (g.smooth q i j).continuousOn
  have hdet : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn ((continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hG)
  have hfd : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    hΨ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 q).open_target h1inf
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det *
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    hdet.mul (hfd.clm_apply (hZ q).continuousOn)
  have hzero : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' tsupport ψ →
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
            (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3) = 0 := by
    intro y hyT hyK
    have hev : (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [((chartAt E3 q).open_target.inter hKcl.isOpen_compl).mem_nhds
        ⟨hyT, hyK⟩] with z hz
      exact hψoff z hz.1 hz.2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have hI2 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det *
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) := by
    refine IntegrableOn.of_forall_diff_eq_zero
      (ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact hKc (hcont.mono hKT)) hSo.measurableSet ?_
    rintro y ⟨hyS, hyK⟩
    exact hzero y (hST hyS) hyK
  exact ⟨hflux, hI2, hInt⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_flux_zero
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P : E3 → E3) (Q₀ : Set E3) (hQ₀ : IsOpen Q₀) (hP : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * P z i)) (hPc : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasCompactSupport (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * P z i)) (hfr : ∀ y ∈ frontier Q₀, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, P z = 0) : ∫ z in Q₀, sepDensDiv G P z = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: calPiece_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (q : M) (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) (W : M → E3) (hW : calSmoothField W) : (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det * calPiece q ψ W z i)) ∧ Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q ψ W))

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) (i j : Fin 2) : pd2 i (pd2 j f) x = pd2 j (pd2 i f) x

signature.name: elr_cacc_pd2_comm
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) (i j : Fin 2) : pd2 i (pd2 j f) x = pd2 j (pd2 i f) x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hfx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x := hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
  have hfx2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x := by
    have h := contDiffAt_infty.1 hfx 2
    first
      | exact h
      | simpa using h
      | exact_mod_cast h
  have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x :=
    (hfx2.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by first | exact le_of_eq one_add_one_eq_two | norm_num)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hbridge : ∀ a b : Fin 2,
      pd2 a (pd2 b f) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x (e2 a) (e2 b) := by
    intro a b
    have h := fderiv_clm_apply (c := fderiv ℝ f) (u := fun _ : E2 => e2 b) hD
      (differentiableAt_const _)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e2 b)) x (e2 a) = _
    rw [h]
    simp
  have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f x :=
    hfx2.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by first | simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField] | rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField])
  rw [hbridge i j, hbridge j i]
  exact hsymm.eq _ _

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (V : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hV : ∀ a, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (V a) W) (Ψ : E2 → ℝ) (hΨ : ContinuousOn Ψ W) (heq : ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (V a) x = -Ψ x) (ψ : E2 → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ) (hψW : tsupport ψ ⊆ W) (n : Fin 2) : Integrable (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 n (V a) x * pd2 a ψ x + Ψ x * pd2 n ψ x) ∧ ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 n (V a) x * pd2 a ψ x + Ψ x * pd2 n ψ x) = 0

signature.name: elr_cacc_weak_diff
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (V : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hV : ∀ a, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (V a) W) (Ψ : E2 → ℝ) (hΨ : ContinuousOn Ψ W) (heq : ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (V a) x = -Ψ x) (ψ : E2 → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ) (hψW : tsupport ψ ⊆ W) (n : Fin 2) : Integrable (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 n (V a) x * pd2 a ψ x + Ψ x * pd2 n ψ x) ∧ ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 n (V a) x * pd2 a ψ x + Ψ x * pd2 n ψ x) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hT : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd2 k f) ∧ HasCompactSupport (pd2 k f) ∧ tsupport (pd2 k f) ⊆ tsupport f := by
    intro f hf hfc k
    have hsupp : Function.support (pd2 k f) ⊆ Function.support (fderiv ℝ f) := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
      intro h0
      apply hx
      simp [pd2, h0]
    refine ⟨?_, (hfc.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).mono hsupp,
      (closure_mono hsupp).trans (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ)⟩
    exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hf).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
  
  have hCM : ∀ (f φ : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn f W → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      tsupport φ ⊆ W → Integrable (fun x => f x * φ x) := by
    intro f φ hf hφ hφc hφW
    have hcont : Continuous (fun x => f x * φ x) :=
      (hf.mul hφ.continuousOn).continuous_of_tsupport_subset hW
        ((tsupport_mul_subset_right).trans hφW)
    exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hφc.mul_left
  
  have hcomm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) x = pd2 j (pd2 i ψ) x := by
    have hfd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ ψ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hψ).2
    have key : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2),
        pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (e2 i) (e2 j) := by
      intro x i j
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x := (hfd.differentiable (by simp)) x
      have h := hd.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e2 j) x)
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ψ y (e2 j)) x (e2 i) = _
      rw [h.fderiv]
      simp
    intro x i j
    have hs := (hψ.contDiffAt (x := x)).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      simp only [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
    rw [key, key]
    exact hs (e2 i) (e2 j)
  
  have ibp : ∀ (u : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W → ∀ (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ →
      HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      ∫ x, u x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, pd2 k u x * ζ x) := by
    intro u hu ζ hζ hζc hζW k
    have hvan : ∀ x, x ∉ W → (ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0) := by
      intro x hx
      exact notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (fun h => hx (hζW h))
    have hζ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ W → ζ x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hζW h))
    have hdζ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ W → pd2 k ζ x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have h1 : fderiv ℝ ζ x = fderiv ℝ (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) x :=
        Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (hvan x hx)
      simp only [pd2, h1, fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    have hFder : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x) x ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k) = pd2 k u x * ζ x + u x * pd2 k ζ x := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ W
      · have hu' : HasFDerivAt u (fderiv ℝ u x) x :=
          ((hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
        have hζ' : HasFDerivAt ζ (fderiv ℝ ζ x) x :=
          (hζ.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
        have hm : HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y) (u x • fderiv ℝ ζ x + ζ x • fderiv ℝ u x) x :=
          hu'.mul hζ'
        refine ⟨hm.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt, ?_⟩
        rw [hm.fderiv]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, pd2]
        ring
      · have hF0 : (fun y => u y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := by
          filter_upwards [hvan x hx] with y hy
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hy
          simp [hy]
        have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y) (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x :=
          (hasFDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq hF0
        refine ⟨hd.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt, ?_⟩
        rw [hd.fderiv, hζ0 x hx, hdζ0 x hx]
        simp
    have hFd : Differentiable ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) :=
      fun x => (hFder x).1.differentiableAt
    have hprod : (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k)) =
        fun x => pd2 k u x * ζ x + u x * pd2 k ζ x := funext fun x => (hFder x).2
    have hdu : ContinuousOn (pd2 k u) W :=
      (hu.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    obtain ⟨hdζ1, hdζ2, hdζs⟩ := hT ζ hζ hζc k
    have hg₁ : Integrable (fun x => pd2 k u x * ζ x) :=
      hCM _ _ hdu hζ.continuous hζc hζW
    have hg₂ : Integrable (fun x => u x * pd2 k ζ x) :=
      hCM _ _ hu.continuousOn hdζ1.continuous hdζ2 (hdζs.trans hζW)
    have hF : Integrable (fun x => u x * ζ x) :=
      hCM _ _ hu.continuousOn hζ.continuous hζc hζW
    have hF' : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k)) := by
      rw [hprod]; exact hg₁.add hg₂
    have h := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
      (f := fun y => u y * ζ y) (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (v := e2 k)
      (by simpa using hF') (by simp) (by simpa using hF) hFd (differentiable_const 1)
    have hzero : ∫ x, fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k) = 0 := by
      simp only [fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero, integral_zero,
        mul_one] at h
      linarith
    rw [hprod, integral_add hg₁ hg₂] at hzero
    linarith
  obtain ⟨hTn1, hTn2, -⟩ := hT ψ hψ hψc n
  have hTW : ∀ k, tsupport (pd2 k ψ) ⊆ W := fun k => (hT ψ hψ hψc k).2.2.trans hψW
  have hcV : ∀ a k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (pd2 k (V a)) W := fun a k =>
    ((((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW).1 (hV a)).2).clm_apply
      contDiffOn_const).continuousOn
  have hJ1 : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => pd2 n (V a) x * pd2 a ψ x) := fun a =>
    hCM _ _ (hcV a n) (hT ψ hψ hψc a).1.continuous (hT ψ hψ hψc a).2.1 (hTW a)
  have hJ2 : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => pd2 a (V a) x * pd2 n ψ x) := fun a =>
    hCM _ _ (hcV a a) hTn1.continuous hTn2 (hTW n)
  have hJ3 : Integrable (fun x => Ψ x * pd2 n ψ x) :=
    hCM _ _ hΨ hTn1.continuous hTn2 (hTW n)
  have hsumI : Integrable (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 n (V a) x * pd2 a ψ x) :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hJ1 a)
  refine ⟨hsumI.add hJ3, ?_⟩
  
  have hI : ∀ a : Fin 2,
      ∫ x, pd2 n (V a) x * pd2 a ψ x = ∫ x, pd2 a (V a) x * pd2 n ψ x := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3⟩ := hT ψ hψ hψc a
    have h1 := ibp (V a) (hV a) (pd2 a ψ) ha1 ha2 (ha3.trans hψW) n
    have h2 := ibp (V a) (hV a) (pd2 n ψ) hTn1 hTn2 (hTW n) a
    have h3 : (fun x => V a x * pd2 n (pd2 a ψ) x) = (fun x => V a x * pd2 a (pd2 n ψ) x) := by
      funext x
      rw [hcomm x n a]
    rw [h3, h2] at h1
    linarith
  
  have hpt : ∀ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (V a) x * pd2 n ψ x = -(Ψ x * pd2 n ψ x) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ W
    · rw [← Finset.sum_mul, heq x hx, neg_mul]
    · have h0 : pd2 n ψ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hTW n h))
      simp [h0]
  have hS : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∫ x, pd2 a (V a) x * pd2 n ψ x = -(∫ x, Ψ x * pd2 n ψ x) := by
    rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hJ2 a), ← integral_neg]
    exact congrArg (fun F : E2 → ℝ => ∫ x, F x) (funext hpt)
  rw [integral_add hsumI hJ3, integral_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hJ1 a),
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hI a), hS]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) W) (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (R : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hR : ∀ a, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (R a) W) (χ : E2 → ℝ) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (n : Fin 2) : (∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b u y + R a y) W) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => χ y ^ 2 * pd2 n u y) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 n (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b u y + R a y) x = ∑ b : Fin 2, (pd2 n (fun y => A y a b) x * pd2 b u x + A x a b * pd2 n (pd2 b u) x) + pd2 n (R a) x) ∧ ∀ (x : E2) (k : Fin 2), pd2 k (fun y => χ y ^ 2 * pd2 n u y) x = χ x ^ 2 * pd2 k (pd2 n u) x + 2 * χ x * pd2 k χ x * pd2 n u x

signature.name: elr_cacc_expand
signature.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) W) (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (R : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hR : ∀ a, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (R a) W) (χ : E2 → ℝ) (hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ) (n : Fin 2) : (∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b u y + R a y) W) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => χ y ^ 2 * pd2 n u y) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 n (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b u y + R a y) x = ∑ b : Fin 2, (pd2 n (fun y => A y a b) x * pd2 b u x + A x a b * pd2 n (pd2 b u) x) + pd2 n (R a) x) ∧ ∀ (x : E2) (k : Fin 2), pd2 k (fun y => χ y ^ 2 * pd2 n u y) x = χ x ^ 2 * pd2 k (pd2 n u) x + 2 * χ x * pd2 k χ x * pd2 n u x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hpdc : ∀ b : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pd2 b u) := fun b =>
    (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hu).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hdU : ∀ (b : Fin 2) (x : E2), DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 b u) x :=
    fun b x => ((hpdc b).differentiable (by simp)) x
  have pd_add : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (x : E2) (f g : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g x → pd2 c (fun y => f y + g y) x = pd2 c f x + pd2 c g x := by
    intro c x f g hf hg
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hg]
    rfl
  have pd_mul : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (x : E2) (f g : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g x → pd2 c (fun y => f y * g y) x = pd2 c f x * g x + f x * pd2 c g x := by
    intro c x f g hf hg
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, (hχ.pow 2).mul (hpdc n), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a
    have hfun : (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b u y + R a y) =
        fun y => (A y a 0 * pd2 0 u y + A y a 1 * pd2 1 u y) + R a y := by
      funext y; rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hfun]
    exact (((hA a 0).mul (hpdc 0).contDiffOn).add ((hA a 1).mul (hpdc 1).contDiffOn)).add (hR a)
  · intro x hx a
    have hWx : W ∈ 𝓝 x := hW.mem_nhds hx
    have dA : ∀ b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => A y a b) x := fun b =>
      ((hA a b).contDiffAt hWx).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have dR : DifferentiableAt ℝ (R a) x := ((hR a).contDiffAt hWx).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have d3 : ∀ b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => A y a b * pd2 b u y) x := fun b =>
      (dA b).fun_mul (hdU b x)
    have dS : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => A y a 0 * pd2 0 u y + A y a 1 * pd2 1 u y) x :=
      (d3 0).fun_add (d3 1)
    have hfun : (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b u y + R a y) =
        fun y => (A y a 0 * pd2 0 u y + A y a 1 * pd2 1 u y) + R a y := by
      funext y; rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have h1 := pd_add n x (fun y => A y a 0 * pd2 0 u y + A y a 1 * pd2 1 u y) (R a) dS dR
    have h2 := pd_add n x (fun y => A y a 0 * pd2 0 u y) (fun y => A y a 1 * pd2 1 u y) (d3 0) (d3 1)
    have h3 := pd_mul n x (fun y => A y a 0) (pd2 0 u) (dA 0) (hdU 0 x)
    have h4 := pd_mul n x (fun y => A y a 1) (pd2 1 u) (dA 1) (hdU 1 x)
    beta_reduce at h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [hfun, h1, h2, h3, h4, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  · intro x k
    have dχ : DifferentiableAt ℝ χ x := (hχ.differentiable (by simp)) x
    have dχ2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => χ y ^ 2) x := ((hχ.pow 2).differentiable (by simp)) x
    have hsq : (fun y => χ y ^ 2) = fun y => χ y * χ y := by funext y; ring
    have hsqd : pd2 k (fun y => χ y ^ 2) x = pd2 k χ x * χ x + χ x * pd2 k χ x := by
      rw [hsq]; exact pd_mul k x χ χ dχ dχ
    have h5 := pd_mul k x (fun y => χ y ^ 2) (pd2 n u) dχ2 (hdU n x)
    beta_reduce at h5
    rw [h5, hsqd]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: (θ Λ Λ' M c Ψ : ℝ) (n : Fin 2) (A D : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (g X h q P : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) (hell : θ * ∑ a : Fin 2, X a ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a b * X a * X b) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, |A a b| ≤ Λ) (hD : ∀ a b : Fin 2, |D a b| ≤ Λ') (hh : ∀ a : Fin 2, |h a| ≤ M) (hq : ∀ a : Fin 2, q a ^ 2 ≤ P a) : θ / 2 * (c ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, X a ^ 2) ≤ (∑ a : Fin 2, (∑ b : Fin 2, (D a b * g b + A a b * X b) + q a) * (c ^ 2 * X a + 2 * c * h a * g n) + Ψ * (c ^ 2 * X n + 2 * c * h n * g n)) + (4 / θ + 4 * M + 32 * Λ' ^ 2 / θ + 8 * M * Λ' + 128 * Λ ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / θ) * (∑ k : Fin 2, g k ^ 2 + Ψ ^ 2 + ∑ a : Fin 2, P a)

signature.name: elr_cacc_pointwise
signature.statement: (θ Λ Λ' M c Ψ : ℝ) (n : Fin 2) (A D : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (g X h q P : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) (hell : θ * ∑ a : Fin 2, X a ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a b * X a * X b) (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, |A a b| ≤ Λ) (hD : ∀ a b : Fin 2, |D a b| ≤ Λ') (hh : ∀ a : Fin 2, |h a| ≤ M) (hq : ∀ a : Fin 2, q a ^ 2 ≤ P a) : θ / 2 * (c ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, X a ^ 2) ≤ (∑ a : Fin 2, (∑ b : Fin 2, (D a b * g b + A a b * X b) + q a) * (c ^ 2 * X a + 2 * c * h a * g n) + Ψ * (c ^ 2 * X n + 2 * c * h n * g n)) + (4 / θ + 4 * M + 32 * Λ' ^ 2 / θ + 8 * M * Λ' + 128 * Λ ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / θ) * (∑ k : Fin 2, g k ^ 2 + Ψ ^ 2 + ∑ a : Fin 2, P a)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨ι, hιdef⟩ : ∃ ι : ℝ, ι = 1 / θ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hι : 0 < ι := by rw [hιdef]; positivity
  have hθι : θ * ι = 1 := by rw [hιdef]; field_simp
  have hΛ' : 0 ≤ Λ' := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hD 0 0)
  have hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hA 0 0)
  have hc2 : c ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  
  have young : ∀ a b : ℝ, a * b ≤ θ / 8 * a ^ 2 + 2 * ι * b ^ 2 := by
    intro a b
    have key : θ * (θ / 8 * a ^ 2 + 2 * ι * b ^ 2 - a * b) = (θ * a - 4 * b) ^ 2 / 8 := by
      linear_combination (2 * b ^ 2) * hθι
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (θ * a - 4 * b) ^ 2 / 8 := by positivity
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have h2 : θ * (θ / 8 * a ^ 2 + 2 * ι * b ^ 2 - a * b) < 0 :=
      mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hθ (by linarith)
    linarith
  have young' : ∀ a b B : ℝ, b ^ 2 ≤ B → a * b ≤ θ / 8 * a ^ 2 + 2 * ι * B := by
    intro a b B hb
    have h1 := young a b
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hι.le
    linarith
  have cross : ∀ t x y B : ℝ, |t| ≤ B → -(2 * t * x * y) ≤ B * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) := by
    intro t x y B ht
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp ht
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ B + t by linarith) (sq_nonneg (x + y)),
      mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ B - t by linarith) (sq_nonneg (x - y))]
  have sqcomb : ∀ u v x y B : ℝ, |u| ≤ B → |v| ≤ B →
      (u * x + v * y) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * B ^ 2 * (x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) := by
    intro u v x y B hu hv
    obtain ⟨hu1, hu2⟩ := abs_le.mp hu
    obtain ⟨hv1, hv2⟩ := abs_le.mp hv
    have hu' : u ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 := sq_le_sq' hu1 hu2
    have hv' : v ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 := sq_le_sq' hv1 hv2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u * x - v * y), mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu' (sq_nonneg x),
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv' (sq_nonneg y)]
  
  have hn : n = 0 ∨ n = 1 := by fin_cases n <;> simp
  have hgn : g n ^ 2 ≤ g 0 ^ 2 + g 1 ^ 2 := by
    rcases hn with rfl | rfl <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (g 0), sq_nonneg (g 1)]
  have hXn : X n ^ 2 ≤ X 0 ^ 2 + X 1 ^ 2 := by
    rcases hn with rfl | rfl <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X 0), sq_nonneg (X 1)]
  have hYn : (c * X n) ^ 2 ≤ (c * X 0) ^ 2 + (c * X 1) ^ 2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXn (sq_nonneg c)
    nlinarith
  have hG0 : 0 ≤ g 0 ^ 2 + g 1 ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hP0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ P a := fun a => le_trans (sq_nonneg _) (hq a)
  have hcq : ∀ a, (-(c * q a)) ^ 2 ≤ P a := by
    intro a
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc2 (sq_nonneg (q a))
    nlinarith [hq a]
  have hch : ∀ a, |c * h a| ≤ M := by
    intro a
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc0]
    calc c * |h a| ≤ 1 * M := mul_le_mul hc1 (hh a) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = M := one_mul M
  have hchD : ∀ a b, |c * h a * D a b| ≤ M * Λ' := by
    intro a b
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc0]
    calc c * |h a| * |D a b| ≤ 1 * M * Λ' :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hc1 (hh a) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one) (hD a b)
            (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = M * Λ' := by ring
  
  have hZ : ∀ a, (-(c * (D a 0 * g 0 + D a 1 * g 1))) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Λ' ^ 2 * (g 0 ^ 2 + g 1 ^ 2) := by
    intro a
    have h1 := sqcomb (D a 0) (D a 1) (g 0) (g 1) Λ' (hD a 0) (hD a 1)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc2 (sq_nonneg (D a 0 * g 0 + D a 1 * g 1))
    nlinarith
  have T1a := young' (c * X 0) _ _ (hZ 0)
  have T1b := young' (c * X 1) _ _ (hZ 1)
  
  have T2a := young' (c * X 0) _ _ (hcq 0)
  have T2b := young' (c * X 1) _ _ (hcq 1)
  
  have hh2 : h 0 ^ 2 + h 1 ^ 2 ≤ 2 * M ^ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hh 0)
    obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hh 1)
    nlinarith [sq_le_sq' a1 a2, sq_le_sq' b1 b2]
  have hU : ∀ b, (-(2 * g n * (h 0 * A 0 b + h 1 * A 1 b))) ^ 2 ≤
      16 * Λ ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * (g 0 ^ 2 + g 1 ^ 2) := by
    intro b
    have h1 := sqcomb (A 0 b) (A 1 b) (h 0) (h 1) Λ (hA 0 b) (hA 1 b)
    have h2 : (h 0 * A 0 b + h 1 * A 1 b) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Λ ^ 2 * M ^ 2 := by
      have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh2 (show 0 ≤ 2 * Λ ^ 2 by positivity)
      nlinarith
    have h4 := mul_le_mul hgn h2 (sq_nonneg _) hG0
    nlinarith
  have T3a := young' (c * X 0) _ _ (hU 0)
  have T3b := young' (c * X 1) _ _ (hU 1)
  
  have T4_00 := cross _ (g n) (g 0) _ (hchD 0 0)
  have T4_01 := cross _ (g n) (g 1) _ (hchD 0 1)
  have T4_10 := cross _ (g n) (g 0) _ (hchD 1 0)
  have T4_11 := cross _ (g n) (g 1) _ (hchD 1 1)
  
  have T5a := cross _ (g n) (q 0) _ (hch 0)
  have T5b := cross _ (g n) (q 1) _ (hch 1)
  
  have hcΨ : (-(c * Ψ)) ^ 2 ≤ Ψ ^ 2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc2 (sq_nonneg Ψ)
    nlinarith
  have T6 := young' (c * X n) _ _ hcΨ
  have T7 := cross _ Ψ (g n) _ (hch n)
  
  have p1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hYn (show 0 ≤ θ / 8 by positivity)
  have hMΛ' : 0 ≤ M * Λ' := mul_nonneg hM hΛ'
  have p2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgn hMΛ'
  have p3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgn hM
  have p4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hq 0) hM
  have p5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hq 1) hM
  have hE : θ * ((c * X 0) ^ 2 + (c * X 1) ^ 2) ≤
      c ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a b * X a * X b := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hell (sq_nonneg c)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at this ⊢
    nlinarith
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hE
  have hKG : 0 ≤ (4 * ι + M + 24 * ι * Λ' ^ 2 + 2 * M * Λ' + 64 * ι * Λ ^ 2 * M ^ 2) *
      (g 0 ^ 2 + g 1 ^ 2) := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hG0
  have hKΨ : 0 ≤ (2 * ι + 3 * M + 32 * ι * Λ' ^ 2 + 8 * M * Λ' + 128 * ι * Λ ^ 2 * M ^ 2) *
      Ψ ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (sq_nonneg _)
  have hKP : 0 ≤ (2 * ι + 3 * M + 32 * ι * Λ' ^ 2 + 8 * M * Λ' + 128 * ι * Λ ^ 2 * M ^ 2) *
      (P 0 + P 1) := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (add_nonneg (hP0 0) (hP0 1))
  rw [show (4 / θ + 4 * M + 32 * Λ' ^ 2 / θ + 8 * M * Λ' + 128 * Λ ^ 2 * M ^ 2 / θ) =
      4 * ι + 4 * M + 32 * Λ' ^ 2 * ι + 8 * M * Λ' + 128 * Λ ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * ι by
    rw [hιdef]; ring]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (K : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (hAc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun y => A y a b) K) (hG : ∀ b : Fin 2, IntegrableOn (G b) K volume) (η : E2 → ℝ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η) (hηc : HasCompactSupport η) (hη0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) (δ : ℝ) (x : E2) (hdη : ∀ (m : Fin 2) (y : E2), δ < ‖x - y‖ → pd2 m η (x - y) = 0) (Λ' : ℝ) (a k : Fin 2) (hLipx : ∀ y : E2, ‖x - y‖ ≤ δ → ∀ b : Fin 2, |A y a b - A x a b| ≤ Λ' * ‖y - x‖) (hDx : ∀ b : Fin 2, |pd2 k (fun y => A y a b) x| ≤ Λ') : |(∫ y, pd2 k η (x - y) * K.indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) - ∑ b : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun y => A y a b) x * (∫ y, η (x - y) * K.indicator (G b) y) + A x a b * ∫ y, pd2 k η (x - y) * K.indicator (G b) y)| ≤ Λ' * ∑ b : Fin 2, ∫ y, (‖x - y‖ * |pd2 k η (x - y)| + η (x - y)) * |K.indicator (G b) y|

signature.name: elr_mc_pointwise
signature.statement: (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (K : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (hAc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun y => A y a b) K) (hG : ∀ b : Fin 2, IntegrableOn (G b) K volume) (η : E2 → ℝ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η) (hηc : HasCompactSupport η) (hη0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) (δ : ℝ) (x : E2) (hdη : ∀ (m : Fin 2) (y : E2), δ < ‖x - y‖ → pd2 m η (x - y) = 0) (Λ' : ℝ) (a k : Fin 2) (hLipx : ∀ y : E2, ‖x - y‖ ≤ δ → ∀ b : Fin 2, |A y a b - A x a b| ≤ Λ' * ‖y - x‖) (hDx : ∀ b : Fin 2, |pd2 k (fun y => A y a b) x| ≤ Λ') : |(∫ y, pd2 k η (x - y) * K.indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) - ∑ b : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun y => A y a b) x * (∫ y, η (x - y) * K.indicator (G b) y) + A x a b * ∫ y, pd2 k η (x - y) * K.indicator (G b) y)| ≤ Λ' * ∑ b : Fin 2, ∫ y, (‖x - y‖ * |pd2 k η (x - y)| + η (x - y)) * |K.indicator (G b) y|

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsingle : ∀ (D e α g : E2 → ℝ) (β : ℝ), (∀ y : E2, δ < ‖x - y‖ → D y = 0) →
      (∀ y : E2, ‖x - y‖ ≤ δ → |α y - α x| ≤ Λ' * ‖y - x‖) → |β| ≤ Λ' → (∀ y : E2, 0 ≤ e y) →
      Integrable (fun y => D y * (α y * g y)) → Integrable (fun y => D y * g y) →
      Integrable (fun y => e y * g y) → Integrable (fun y => (‖x - y‖ * |D y| + e y) * |g y|) →
      |(∫ y, D y * (α y * g y)) - (β * (∫ y, e y * g y) + α x * ∫ y, D y * g y)| ≤
        Λ' * ∫ y, (‖x - y‖ * |D y| + e y) * |g y| := by
    intro D e α g β hD0 hLip hβ he0 h1 h2 h3 h4
    have heq : (∫ y, D y * (α y * g y)) - (β * (∫ y, e y * g y) + α x * ∫ y, D y * g y) =
        ∫ y, (D y * (α y * g y) - (β * (e y * g y) + α x * (D y * g y))) := by
      have hadd : Integrable (fun y => β * (e y * g y) + α x * (D y * g y)) :=
        (h3.const_mul β).add (h2.const_mul (α x))
      rw [integral_sub h1 hadd,
        integral_add (h3.const_mul β) (h2.const_mul (α x)), integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    rw [heq, ← integral_const_mul, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    refine norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (h4.const_mul Λ') (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hF : D y * (α y * g y) - (β * (e y * g y) + α x * (D y * g y)) =
        D y * (α y - α x) * g y - β * (e y * g y) := by ring
    rw [hF]
    have t1 : |D y * (α y - α x) * g y| ≤ Λ' * (‖x - y‖ * |D y| * |g y|) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      rcases le_or_gt ‖x - y‖ δ with h | h
      · have hl := hLip y h
        rw [norm_sub_rev] at hl
        have hD := abs_nonneg (D y)
        have hg := abs_nonneg (g y)
        calc |D y| * |α y - α x| * |g y| ≤ |D y| * (Λ' * ‖x - y‖) * |g y| := by gcongr
          _ = Λ' * (‖x - y‖ * |D y| * |g y|) := by ring
      · rw [hD0 y h]
        simp
    have t2 : |β * (e y * g y)| ≤ Λ' * (e y * |g y|) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (he0 y)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hβ (mul_nonneg (he0 y) (abs_nonneg _))
    calc |D y * (α y - α x) * g y - β * (e y * g y)|
        ≤ |D y * (α y - α x) * g y| + |β * (e y * g y)| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ Λ' * (‖x - y‖ * |D y| * |g y|) + Λ' * (e y * |g y|) := add_le_add t1 t2
      _ = Λ' * ((‖x - y‖ * |D y| + e y) * |g y|) := by ring
  
  have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.measurableSet
  have hg : ∀ b : Fin 2, Integrable (K.indicator (G b)) :=
    fun b => (integrable_indicator_iff hKm).2 (hG b)
  have hAg : ∀ b : Fin 2, Integrable (K.indicator (fun y => A y a b * G b y)) :=
    fun b => (integrable_indicator_iff hKm).2 (IntegrableOn.continuousOn_mul (hAc a b) (hG b) hK)
  
  have hfd0 : ∀ z : E2, z ∉ tsupport (fderiv ℝ η) → pd2 k η z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    show fderiv ℝ η z (e2 k) = 0
    rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz]
    rfl
  have hpdc : Continuous (pd2 k η) :=
    (hη.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hpds : HasCompactSupport (pd2 k η) :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro (hηc.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)) hfd0
  have hκc : Continuous (fun z : E2 => ‖z‖ * |pd2 k η z| + η z) :=
    (continuous_norm.mul hpdc.abs).add hη.continuous
  have hκs : HasCompactSupport (fun z : E2 => ‖z‖ * |pd2 k η z| + η z) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro ((hηc.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).union hηc) ?_
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_union, not_or] at hz
    rw [hfd0 z hz.1, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz.2]
    simp
  
  have hki : ∀ (κ φ : E2 → ℝ), Continuous κ → HasCompactSupport κ → Integrable φ →
      Integrable (fun y => κ (x - y) * φ y) := by
    intro κ φ hκ hκc' hφ
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hκ.bounded_above_of_compact_support hκc'
    exact hφ.bdd_mul (hκ.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (ae_of_all _ fun y => hC (x - y))
  
  have i1 : ∀ b : Fin 2, Integrable (fun y => pd2 k η (x - y) * (A y a b * K.indicator (G b) y)) := by
    intro b
    refine (hki _ _ hpdc hpds (hAg b)).congr (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
    simp only
    rw [Set.indicator_mul_right]
  have i2 : ∀ b : Fin 2, Integrable (fun y => pd2 k η (x - y) * K.indicator (G b) y) :=
    fun b => hki _ _ hpdc hpds (hg b)
  have i3 : ∀ b : Fin 2, Integrable (fun y => η (x - y) * K.indicator (G b) y) :=
    fun b => hki _ _ hη.continuous hηc (hg b)
  have i4 : ∀ b : Fin 2, Integrable
      (fun y => (‖x - y‖ * |pd2 k η (x - y)| + η (x - y)) * |K.indicator (G b) y|) :=
    fun b => hki _ _ hκc hκs (hg b).abs
  
  have h5 : ∀ y : E2, pd2 k η (x - y) * K.indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y =
      ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 k η (x - y) * (A y a b * K.indicator (G b) y) := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ K
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hy, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy]
  have hI : (∫ y, pd2 k η (x - y) * K.indicator (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y) =
      ∑ b : Fin 2, ∫ y, pd2 k η (x - y) * (A y a b * K.indicator (G b) y) := by
    rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => i1 b)]
    exact integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ h5)
  
  rw [hI, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => ?_)
  exact hsingle (fun y => pd2 k η (x - y)) (fun y => η (x - y)) (fun y => A y a b)
    (K.indicator (G b)) (pd2 k (fun y => A y a b) x) (fun y h => hdη k y h)
    (fun y h => hLipx y h b) (hDx b) (fun y => hη0 (x - y)) (i1 b) (i2 b) (i3 b) (i4 b)

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (D : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (hD : IsOpen D) (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w D) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ D, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (p : M) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D) ∧ ∀ x ∈ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) * partialDeriv b (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ g.levelMeanCurv w x = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) : E3) = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) i) ∧ g.g x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) = 1

signature.name: chart_unit_normal_calculus
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (D : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (hD : IsOpen D) (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w D) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ D, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (p : M) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D) ∧ ∀ x ∈ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) * partialDeriv b (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ g.levelMeanCurv w x = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) : E3) = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) i) ∧ g.g x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) = 1

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have riesz : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ),
      (∀ v : E3, v ≠ 0 → 0 < B v v) → ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ∃ v : E3, ∀ u : E3, B v u = ℓ u := by
    intro B hpos ℓ
    let Dl := InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E3
    let T : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3 :=
      { toFun := fun v => Dl.symm (B v)
        map_add' := fun v u => by simp
        map_smul' := fun c v => by simp }
    have hinj : Function.Injective T := by
      intro v u hvu
      have h1 : B v = B u := by
        have := congrArg Dl hvu
        simpa [T] using this
      by_contra hne
      have h2 := hpos (v - u) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
      have h3 : B (v - u) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, h1, sub_self]
      rw [h3] at h2
      simp at h2
    have hsurj := LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsurj (Dl.symm ℓ)
    refine ⟨v, fun u => ?_⟩
    have h1 : B v = ℓ := by
      have := congrArg Dl hv
      simpa [T] using this
    rw [h1]
  
  have grad_rep : ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → ∀ (N : E3),
      MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) →
      (∀ v : E3, g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) N v =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) v : ℝ)) →
      ∀ u : E3, u = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) N →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, u i =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i k *
          partialDeriv k (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) ∧
      g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) N N =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ a b *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv b (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
    intro q y hy N hρd hN u hu
    have hx : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hx
    have hinv : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y v) = v := by
      have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)).comp
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
      have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
        apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
        exact hz
      rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
      intro v
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L v) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        K = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        L = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hKL : ∀ v, K (L v) = v := by intro v; rw [hK, hL]; exact hinv v
    have hKinj : Function.Injective K := by
      have hsurj : Function.Surjective (K : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) := fun v => ⟨L v, hKL v⟩
      exact LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mpr hsurj
    have hLK : ∀ v, L (K v) = v := fun v => hKinj (hKL (K v))
    have hchain : ∀ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv b (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (L (e b)) := by
      intro b
      have h1 := mfderiv_comp y hρd hf
      rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at h1
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [show (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) = w ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm from rfl, h1, hL]
      rfl
    have hw' : L u = N := by rw [hu, ← hK]; exact hLK _
    have hexp : u = ∑ a : Fin 3, u a • e a := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have h1 : ∀ b : Fin 3, g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (L u) (L (e b)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, u a * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y a b := by
      intro b
      conv_lhs => rw [hexp]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, hL]
      rfl
    have hsys : ∀ b : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, u a * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y a b =
        partialDeriv b (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      intro b
      rw [← h1 b, hw', hN, hchain b]
    have hmv : (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).mulVec (fun a => u a) =
        fun b => partialDeriv b (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      funext b
      rw [← hsys b]
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
      have hs : g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y b a = g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y a b := by
        simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        exact g.symm _ _ _
      rw [hs]
      ring
    have hdet : IsUnit (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det :=
      isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q y hy).det_pos.ne'
    have hsol : (fun a => u a) = ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹).mulVec
        (fun b => partialDeriv b (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) := by
      have h2 := congrArg (fun v => ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹).mulVec v) hmv
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec] at h2
      exact h2
    have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, u i = ∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i k *
        partialDeriv k (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      intro i
      have h2 := congrFun hsol i
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using h2
    refine ⟨hcomp, ?_⟩
    have h3 : ∀ c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, c (L u) = ∑ b : Fin 3, u b * c (L (e b)) := by
      intro c
      conv_lhs => rw [hexp]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← hw', h3 (g.g _ (L u))]
    simp only [h1, hsys]
    simp only [hcomp, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
    ring
  
  have hcl1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D) := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (w ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D) :=
      hws.comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hy.2)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  refine ⟨hcl1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hxD, hxp⟩ := hx
  have hwx : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x :=
    (hws.contMDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hxD)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := riesz (g.g x) (g.posDef x) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)
  have hrep : ∀ q : M, x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source →
      ∀ u : E3, u = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) x N →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, u i =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q x))⁻¹ i k *
          partialDeriv k (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q x)) ∧
      g.g x N N = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q x))⁻¹ a b *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q x) *
          partialDeriv b (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q x) := by
    intro q hq u hu
    have hy : (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q x) = x := (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hq
    have h := grad_rep q (chartAt E3 q x) ((chartAt E3 q).map_source hq) N
    rw [hy] at h
    exact h hwx (fun v => hN v) u hu
  have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hdw x hxD
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
    have h1 := hN v
    rw [h0, map_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h1
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    exact h1.symm
  have hn : 0 < g.g x N N := g.posDef x N hN0
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : E3, X = (Real.sqrt (g.g x N N))⁻¹ • N := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hnu : ∀ q : M, x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source →
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q x) i) =
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) x X : E3) := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : E3, u = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) x N := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hrep q hq u hu
    have hwu : (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) x X : E3) =
        (Real.sqrt (g.g x N N))⁻¹ • u := by
      rw [hX, map_smul, hu]
    rw [hwu]
    refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
    rw [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h1 i, h2]
    rfl
  have hid : ∀ v : E3, (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x) x v : E3) = v := by
    intro v
    rw [mfderiv_chartAt_eq_tangentCoordChange (mem_chart_source E3 x)]
    exact tangentCoordChange_self (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (mem_extChartAt_source x)
  have hνx : (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i) = X := by
    rw [hnu x (mem_chart_source E3 x), hid]
  
  have hlmc : g.levelMeanCurv w x = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) := by
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (SmoothBumpFunction.nhds_basis_tsupport (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) x).mem_iff.1
      (hD.mem_nhds hxD)
    have hbD : tsupport (b : M → ℝ) ⊆ D := hb.2
    obtain ⟨wt, hwt⟩ : ∃ wt : M → ℝ, wt = fun y => b y * w y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hwts : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ wt := by
      rw [hwt]
      apply contMDiff_of_tsupport
      intro y hy
      have hyD : y ∈ D := hbD (tsupport_mul_subset_left hy)
      exact (b.contMDiff.contMDiffAt).mul (hws.contMDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hyD))
    have hwtx : wt =ᶠ[𝓝 x] w := by
      filter_upwards [b.eventuallyEq_one] with y hy
      rw [hwt]
      simp [hy]
    have key : ∀ q : M, x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source →
        g.levelMeanCurv wt x = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
          (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q x) := by
      intro q hq
      let Φq : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
        PartialDiffeomorph.mk (chartAt E3 q).symm.toPartialEquiv (chartAt E3 q).open_target
          (chartAt E3 q).open_source contMDiffOn_chart_symm contMDiffOn_chart
      have hy : (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q x) = x := (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hq
      have hT : Tendsto (chartAt E3 q).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 q x)) (𝓝 x) := by
        have := ((chartAt E3 q).continuousAt_symm ((chartAt E3 q).map_source hq)).tendsto
        rwa [hy] at this
      have hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (chartAt E3 q x), wt (Φq z) = w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) :=
        hT.eventually hwtx
      have h := levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φq wt (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) hwts
        (chartAt E3 q x) ((chartAt E3 q).map_source hq) hfh
      conv_lhs => rw [← hy]
      exact h
    rw [← key p hxp, key x (mem_chart_source E3 x)]
    rfl
  refine ⟨?_, hlmc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← (hrep p hxp _ rfl).2]
    exact hn
  · rw [hνx, hnu p hxp]
  · rw [hνx, hX]
    simp only [map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_inv, Real.mul_self_sqrt hn.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn.ne']

subgoal_signatures.name: levelMeanCurv_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ x) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) h x

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig E D : Set M) (w ζ ψ : M → ℝ) (V : M → E3) (a b C₀ : ℝ) (p : M)
    (hE : IsOpen E) (hD : IsOpen D) (hSig : IsClosed Sig) (hESig : Disjoint E Sig) (hab : a < b)
    (hws : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D))
    (hQ : ∀ x ∈ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))⁻¹ a b *
        partialDeriv a (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) *
        partialDeriv b (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x))
    (hH : ∀ x ∈ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source, g.levelMeanCurv w x =
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 p x))
    (hζ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ζ) (hζ01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1)
    (hζD : ∀ x ∈ D, ζ x = 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
    (hζH : ∀ x ∈ D, ζ x ≠ 0 → |g.levelMeanCurv w x| ≤ C₀)
    (hVrep : ∀ x ∈ E ∩ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source,
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) x (V x) : E3) =
        (-(ζ x)) • (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal
          (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) i))
    (hVloc : ∀ x, x ∉ Sig → x ∉ E ∩ D → ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, V x' = 0)
    (hEζ : ∀ x ∈ E, x ∉ D → ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, ζ x' = 0)
    (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ))
    (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source) :
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) →
      |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y| ≤ C) ∧
    (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y = 0) ∧
    ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y =
        ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner ζ ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det -
          ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
            (ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det +
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
            fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
                (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)

signature.name: jump_piece_div
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig E D : Set M) (w ζ ψ : M → ℝ) (V : M → E3) (a b C₀ : ℝ) (p : M)
    (hE : IsOpen E) (hD : IsOpen D) (hSig : IsClosed Sig) (hESig : Disjoint E Sig) (hab : a < b)
    (hws : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D))
    (hQ : ∀ x ∈ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))⁻¹ a b *
        partialDeriv a (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) *
        partialDeriv b (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x))
    (hH : ∀ x ∈ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source, g.levelMeanCurv w x =
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 p x))
    (hζ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ζ) (hζ01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1)
    (hζD : ∀ x ∈ D, ζ x = 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w x - a) / (b - a)))
    (hζH : ∀ x ∈ D, ζ x ≠ 0 → |g.levelMeanCurv w x| ≤ C₀)
    (hVrep : ∀ x ∈ E ∩ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source,
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) x (V x) : E3) =
        (-(ζ x)) • (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal
          (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) i))
    (hVloc : ∀ x, x ∉ Sig → x ∉ E ∩ D → ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, V x' = 0)
    (hEζ : ∀ x ∈ E, x ∉ D → ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, ζ x' = 0)
    (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ))
    (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source) :
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' (Sig ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) →
      |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y| ≤ C) ∧
    (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y = 0) ∧
    ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y =
        ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner ζ ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det -
          ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
            (ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det +
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
            fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
                (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hKc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ) :=
    hψc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono hψs)
  have hKt : chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source (hψs hx)
  have hTo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source ((hE.inter hD).inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right
  have hTt : chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source hx.2
  have hTtD : chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ⊆
      (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source hx.2, ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) ∈ D
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx.2]; exact hx.1.2
  
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z i j)
      (chartAt E3 p).target := g.smooth p
  have hpd : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).PosDef :=
    fun z hz => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p z hz
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det)
      (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    (ccs_sqrtdet_smooth _ _ hGs (fun z hz => (hpd z hz).det_pos)).continuousOn
  have hψp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hψ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hζp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hζ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hginv := ginv_contDiffOn _ _ hGs hpd
  have hdζ : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z)
      (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    hζp.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 p).open_target (by simp)
  have hdψ : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z)
      (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    hψp.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 p).open_target (by simp)
  have hQζ : ContinuousOn (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z)⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
    exact (((hginv i j).continuousOn).mul (hdζ.clm_apply continuousOn_const)).mul
      (hdζ.clm_apply continuousOn_const)
  have hQψ : ContinuousOn (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z)⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
    exact (((hginv i j).continuousOn).mul (hdψ.clm_apply continuousOn_const)).mul
      (hdψ.clm_apply continuousOn_const)
  
  let Φp : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
    PartialDiffeomorph.mk (chartAt E3 p).symm.toPartialEquiv (chartAt E3 p).open_target
      (chartAt E3 p).open_source contMDiffOn_chart_symm contMDiffOn_chart
  have hgζ : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, g.gradInner ζ ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y :=
    fun y hy => gradInner_eq_coord g Φp ζ (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) hζ y hy
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
  
  have F2 : ∀ (X : E3 → E3) (y : E3), (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X z = 0) →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y = 0 := by
    intro X y hX
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hX] with z hz
      simp [hz]
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have F3 : ∀ z, z ∉ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ → calPiece p ψ V z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    unfold calPiece
    by_cases hzt : z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hzt]
      have h0 : ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hz ⟨_, subset_tsupport _ h, (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hzt⟩
      simp only [h0, zero_smul]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hzt]
  
  have F4 : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target,
      (∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).symm y), V x' = 0) →
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, calPiece p ψ V z = 0 := by
    intro y hy hV
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, V ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) = 0 :=
      ((chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm hy).eventually hV
    filter_upwards [h2] with z hz
    unfold calPiece
    by_cases hzt : z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hzt]; simp [hz]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hzt]
  
  have s4 : ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    apply F2
    filter_upwards [hKc.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
    exact F3 z hz
  
  have hQT : ∀ z ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z)⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z *
        partialDeriv j (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z := by
    rintro _ ⟨x', ⟨⟨_, hx'D⟩, hx's⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hQ x' ⟨hx'D, hx's⟩
  have hζT : ∀ z ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) =
        1 - Real.smoothTransition ((w ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) - a) / (b - a)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x', ⟨⟨_, hx'D⟩, hx's⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx's]
    exact hζD x' hx'D
  have hXT : ∀ z ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      calPiece p ψ V z = (-(ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) * ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) •
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal
          (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z i) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x', ⟨⟨hx'E, hx'D⟩, hx's⟩, rfl⟩
    unfold calPiece
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ((chartAt E3 p).map_source hx's)]
    beta_reduce
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx's, hVrep x' ⟨⟨hx'E, hx'D⟩, hx's⟩, smul_smul, mul_neg]
  
  have s5 : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y =
        ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner ζ ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det -
          ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
            (ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det +
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
            fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
                (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨hxE, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    have hx : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) = x := (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hxs
    have hyt : chartAt E3 p x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).map_source hxs
    have hxS : x ∉ Sig := fun hs => Set.disjoint_left.1 hESig hxE hs
    by_cases hxD : x ∈ D
    · have hyT : chartAt E3 p x ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
        ⟨x, ⟨⟨hxE, hxD⟩, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
      have hs2 := collar_rep_div_euclid (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))
        (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (fun y => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (calPiece p ψ V) a b hab hTo
        (fun i j => (hGs i j).mono hTt) (fun z i j => g.symm _ _ _)
        (fun z hz => hpd z (hTt hz)) (hws.mono hTtD) hQT (hψp.mono hTt) hζT hXT
        (chartAt E3 p x) hyT
      beta_reduce at hs2
      have e1 := hgζ _ hyt
      have e2 : g.levelMeanCurv w ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x)) =
          levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
            (chartAt E3 p x) := by
        rw [hx]; exact hH x ⟨hxD, hxs⟩
      have e3 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p x)
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))
            (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))) : E3) =
          -(ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))) *
            fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p x)
              ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal
                (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
                (chartAt E3 p x) i)) := by
        rw [hx, hVrep x ⟨⟨hxE, hxD⟩, hxs⟩, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hs2, e1, e2, e3]
      ring
    · have hVev : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x)), V x' = 0 := by
        rw [hx]; exact hVloc x hxS (fun h => hxD h.2)
      have hζev : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x)), ζ x' = 0 := by
        rw [hx]; exact hEζ x hxE hxD
      rw [F2 _ _ (F4 _ hyt hVev)]
      have hζp0 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p x), ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) = 0 :=
        ((chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm hyt).eventually hζev
      have hpd0 : ∀ i : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p x) = 0 := by
        intro i
        have hev : (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p x)]
            fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := hζp0
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      rw [hgζ _ hyt]
      simp only [hpd0, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, Real.sqrt_zero]
      rw [hζev.self_of_nhds, hVev.self_of_nhds]
      simp
  
  obtain ⟨B1, hB1⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hdetc.mono hKt)
  obtain ⟨B2, hB2⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hψp.continuousOn.mono hKt)
  obtain ⟨B3, hB3⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hQζ.mono hKt)
  obtain ⟨B4, hB4⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hQψ.mono hKt)
  refine ⟨⟨max (B1 * (B2 * Real.sqrt B3 + B2 * |C₀| + Real.sqrt B4)) 0, ?_⟩, s4, s5⟩
  intro y hyS
  by_cases hyK : y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport ψ
  swap
  · rw [s4 y hyK, abs_zero]; exact le_max_right _ _
  refine le_trans ?_ (le_max_left _ _)
  have hyt := hKt hyK
  have h1 : |Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det| ≤ B1 := by
    have := hB1 y hyK; rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  have h2 : |ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)| ≤ B2 := by
    have := hB2 y hyK; rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  have h3 : |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y| ≤ B3 := by
    have := hB3 y hyK; rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  have h4 : |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y| ≤ B4 := by
    have := hB4 y hyK; rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  have hB1n : 0 ≤ B1 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) h1
  have hB2n : 0 ≤ B2 := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) h2
  have hCn : 0 ≤ B1 * (B2 * Real.sqrt B3 + B2 * |C₀| + Real.sqrt B4) :=
    mul_nonneg hB1n (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hB2n (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
      (mul_nonneg hB2n (abs_nonneg _))) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  have hxs : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hyt
  have hκx : chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = y := (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hyt
  have hxS : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∉ Sig := fun hs => hyS ⟨_, ⟨hs, hxs⟩, hκx⟩
  by_cases hxED : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ E ∩ D
  swap
  · have hVev : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).symm y), V x' = 0 := hVloc _ hxS hxED
    rw [F2 _ _ (F4 y hyt hVev), abs_zero]
    exact hCn
  have hyE : y ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) := ⟨_, ⟨hxED.1, hxs⟩, hκx⟩
  rw [s5 y hyE]
  have hQx := hQ _ ⟨hxED.2, hxs⟩
  rw [hκx] at hQx
  have hrep := hVrep _ ⟨hxED, hxs⟩
  rw [hrep, hκx, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hgζ y hyt]
  have hSg0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hSg : Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det ≤ B1 := le_trans (le_abs_self _) h1
  have hR30 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => ζ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

    have hST : chartAt E3 (q j) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (q j)).target := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact (chartAt E3 (q j)).map_source hx.2
    have hφs : tsupport (φ j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source :=
      (hφ.2.2.2 j).2.trans Set.inter_subset_right
    have hKc : IsCompact (chartAt E3 (q j) '' tsupport (φ j)) :=
      (hφ.2.2.2 j).1.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 (q j)).continuousOn.mono hφs)
    refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
      ((chartAt E3 (q j) '' tsupport (φ j)).indicator (fun _ => B)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro m
      have hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z a b)
          (chartAt E3 (q j)).target := g.smooth (q j)
      have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z).det)
          (chartAt E3 (q j)).target :=
        (ccs_sqrtdet_smooth _ _ hGs
          (fun z hz => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g (q j) z hz).det_pos)).continuousOn
      have hφp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z))
          (chartAt E3 (q j)).target :=
        contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp ((hφ.1 j).comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
      have hdφ : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) z)
          (chartAt E3 (q j)).target :=
        hφp.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 (q j)).open_target (by simp)
      have hrep : ContinuousOn (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j))
          ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)
          (c m ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) • V ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) : E3))
          (chartAt E3 (q j)).target := (hcs m (q j)).continuousOn
      exact ((hdetc.mul (hdφ.clm_apply hrep)).mono hST).aestronglyMeasurable hSm
    · exact ((integrable_indicator_iff hKc.measurableSet).2
        (integrableOn_const hKc.measure_lt_top.ne)).integrableOn
    · intro m
      refine (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hSm) fun y hy => ?_
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hlin m j y, abs_mul]
      have hBy := hB y (hST hy)
      have hc := hc1 m ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)
      calc _ ≤ 1 * |Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det *
              fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) y
                (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j)) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)
                  (V ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) : E3)| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = _ := one_mul _
        _ ≤ _ := hBy
    · refine (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hSm) fun y hy => ?_
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
      have hxE : (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm (chartAt E3 (q j) x) ∈ E := by
        rw [(chartAt E3 (q j)).left_inv hx.2]; exact hx.1
      have hcl := (hlim _ hxE).mul_const (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm
          (chartAt E3 (q j) x)).det *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) (chartAt E3 (q j) x)
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j))
            ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm (chartAt E3 (q j) x))
            (V ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm (chartAt E3 (q j) x))) : E3))
      rw [one_mul] at hcl
      exact hcl.congr (fun m => (hlin m j (chartAt E3 (q j) x)).symm)
  have hsum := tendsto_finset_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)) (fun j _ => hT j)
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hsum (tendsto_const_nhds.congr (fun m => (hm0 m).symm))

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Set E3) (f ψ ζ : E3 → ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (hQ : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f z * partialDeriv j f z) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ T) (hζ : ∀ z ∈ T, ζ z = 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((f z - a) / (b - a))) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, X z = (-(ψ z * ζ z)) • (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal G f z i)) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ T) : sepDensDiv G X y = Real.sqrt (G y).det * (ψ y * Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i ζ y * partialDeriv j ζ y) - ψ y * ζ y * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y - ζ y * fderiv ℝ ψ y ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal G f y i)))

signature.name: collar_rep_div_euclid
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Set E3) (f ψ ζ : E3 → ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (hQ : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f z * partialDeriv j f z) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ T) (hζ : ∀ z ∈ T, ζ z = 1 - Real.smoothTransition ((f z - a) / (b - a))) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, X z = (-(ψ z * ζ z)) • (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal G f z i)) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ T) : sepDensDiv G X y = Real.sqrt (G y).det * (ψ y * Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i ζ y * partialDeriv j ζ y) - ψ y * ζ y * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y - ζ y * fderiv ℝ ψ y ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal G f y i)))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hTy : T ∈ 𝓝 y := hT.mem_nhds hy
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : E3 → E3, N = fun z =>
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal G f z i) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hNi : ∀ z i, N z i = calUnitNormal G f z i := by
    intro z i; rw [hN]; rfl
  have hNy : N y = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal G f y i) := by
    rw [hN]
  have hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det := fun z hz => (hpd z hz).det_pos
  have hsd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y :=
    ((ccs_sqrtdet_smooth G T hG hdet).contDiffAt hTy).differentiableAt (by simp)
  obtain ⟨hSo, hNs, -⟩ := ccs_normal_props G f T hT hG hpd hf N (fun z _ i => hNi z i)
  have hNd : DifferentiableAt ℝ N y :=
    (hNs.contDiffAt (hSo.mem_nhds ⟨hy, hQ y hy⟩)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hNid : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => N z i) y := fun i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt.comp y hNd
  have hW₁ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * N z i) y :=
    fun i => hsd.mul (hNid i)
  have hW₂ : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (fun _ => (0 : E3)) z i) y := by
    intro i; simp
  have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ y := (hψ.contDiffAt hTy).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f y := (hf.contDiffAt hTy).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hexp : ∀ (h : E3 → ℝ) (v : E3), fderiv ℝ h y v = ∑ i : Fin 3, v i * partialDeriv i h y := by
    intro h v
    have hv : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
      ext j; fin_cases j <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, partialDeriv]
  
  have hst : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition
      (deriv Real.smoothTransition ((f y - a) / (b - a))) ((f y - a) / (b - a)) :=
    ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by norm_num) _).hasDerivAt
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition ((f y - a) / (b - a)) :=
    Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
  have hu : HasFDerivAt (fun z => (f z - a) / (b - a)) ((b - a)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ f y) y := by
    have h := (hfd.hasFDerivAt.sub_const a).const_mul (b - a)⁻¹
    convert h using 1
    funext z; rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
  have hζF : HasFDerivAt ζ (-(deriv Real.smoothTransition ((f y - a) / (b - a)) •
      (b - a)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ f y)) y := by
    have h := (hst.comp_hasFDerivAt y hu).const_sub 1
    refine h.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hTy] with z hz
    rw [hζ z hz]; rfl
  have hζd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ y := hζF.differentiableAt
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = deriv Real.smoothTransition ((f y - a) / (b - a)) * (b - a)⁻¹ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc : 0 ≤ c := by
    rw [hcdef]; exact mul_nonneg hs0 (inv_nonneg.2 (by linarith))
  have hζL : ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ ζ y v = -(c * fderiv ℝ f y v) := by
    intro v
    rw [hζF.fderiv, hcdef]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hpz : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i ζ y = -(c * partialDeriv i f y) := by
    intro i; unfold partialDeriv; exact hζL _
  
  have key : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ξ i * ξ j →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ((Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b))⁻¹ *
        ∑ k : Fin 3, A i k * ξ k) * ξ i =
      Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b) := by
    intro A ξ hpos
    have hs := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hpos
    have hsq := Real.mul_self_sqrt hpos.le
    have h1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ((Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b))⁻¹ *
        ∑ k : Fin 3, A i k * ξ k) * ξ i =
        (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b))⁻¹ *
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [h1]
    calc (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b))⁻¹ *
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b)
        = (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b))⁻¹ *
          (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b) *
            Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b)) := by rw [hsq]
      _ = Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * ξ a * ξ b) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs.ne', one_mul]
  have hfN : fderiv ℝ f y (N y) = Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y) := by
    rw [hexp f (N y)]
    simp only [hNi, calUnitNormal]
    exact key ((G y)⁻¹) (fun k => partialDeriv k f y) (hQ y hy)
  have hslope : fderiv ℝ ζ y (N y) = -Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i ζ y * partialDeriv j ζ y) := by
    have hQζ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i ζ y * partialDeriv j ζ y =
        c ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j f y := by
      simp only [hpz, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [hζL, hfN, hQζ, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg c), Real.sqrt_sq hc]
  
  have hh₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => -(ψ z * ζ z)) y := (hψd.mul hζd).neg
  have hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      X z i = (fun z => -(ψ z * ζ z)) z * N z i + (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) z * (fun _ => (0 : E3)) z i := by
    filter_upwards [hTy] with z hz i
    rw [hX z hz, hNi]
    simp
  have h1 := ccs_div_local G X N (fun _ => (0 : E3)) (fun z => -(ψ z * ζ z)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) y
    hloc hh₁ (differentiableAt_const _) hW₁ hW₂
  have h2 := ccs_divx G f T hT hG hsymm hpd hf N (fun z _ i => hNi z i) y hy (hQ y hy)
  have h3 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => -(ψ z * ζ z)) y (N y) =
      -(ψ y * fderiv ℝ ζ y (N y) + ζ y * fderiv ℝ ψ y (N y)) := by
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun z => -(ψ z * ζ z))
        (-(ψ y • fderiv ℝ ζ y + ζ y • fderiv ℝ ψ y)) y :=
      (hψd.hasFDerivAt.mul hζd.hasFDerivAt).neg
    rw [hd.fderiv]
    simp [smul_eq_mul]
  beta_reduce at h1
  simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at h1
  rw [← hNy, h1, h2, h3, hslope]
  ring
