subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_normal_props
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) : IsOpen {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z → ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 → |fderiv ℝ f z w| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (X z)

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_div_local
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V W₁ W₂ : E3 → E3) (h₁ h₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (hloc : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ i : Fin 3, V z i = h₁ z * W₁ z i + h₂ z * W₂ z i) (hh₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ h₁ y) (hh₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ h₂ y) (hW₁ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₁ z i) y) (hW₂ : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * W₂ z i) y) : sepDensDiv G V y = h₁ y * sepDensDiv G W₁ y + Real.sqrt (G y).det * fderiv ℝ h₁ y (W₁ y) + (h₂ y * sepDensDiv G W₂ y + Real.sqrt (G y).det * fderiv ℝ h₂ y (W₂ y))

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_divx
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ T) (hN : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y) : sepDensDiv G X y = Real.sqrt (G y).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f h : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (hpd : (G y).PosDef) (hQ : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y) : |fderiv ℝ h y ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal G f y i))| ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a h y * partialDeriv b h y)

signature.name: normal_deriv_cs_bound
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f h : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (hpd : (G y).PosDef) (hQ : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y) : |fderiv ℝ h y ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal G f y i))| ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a h y * partialDeriv b h y)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hlin : ∀ u : Fin 3 → ℝ, fderiv ℝ h y ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm u) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, u i * partialDeriv i h y := by
    intro u
    have hw : (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm u = ∑ i : Fin 3, u i • e i := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [hw, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, partialDeriv]
  rw [hlin]
  
  have hB : ((G y)⁻¹).PosDef := hpd.inv
  have hsym : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i := by
    intro i j
    have := hB.isHermitian.apply j i
    simpa using this
  have hpsd : ∀ u : Fin 3 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * u i * u j := by
    intro u
    have := hB.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg u
    simp [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three] at this ⊢
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQd⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ, Q = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hPd⟩ : ∃ P : ℝ, P = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a h y * partialDeriv b h y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hSd⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i k * partialDeriv k f y) * partialDeriv i h y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hQd] at hQ
  rw [← hPd]
  have hL : ∑ i : Fin 3, calUnitNormal G f y i * partialDeriv i h y = (Real.sqrt Q)⁻¹ * S := by
    rw [hQd, hSd]
    simp only [calUnitNormal, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  rw [hL]
  
  have hexp : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j *
      (Q * partialDeriv i h y - S * partialDeriv i f y) *
      (Q * partialDeriv j h y - S * partialDeriv j f y) = Q * (Q * P - S ^ 2) := by
    have h10 := hsym 1 0
    have h20 := hsym 2 0
    have h21 := hsym 2 1
    rw [hQd, hPd, hSd]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [h10, h20, h21]
    ring
  have hnn := hpsd (fun i => Q * partialDeriv i h y - S * partialDeriv i f y)
  rw [hexp] at hnn
  have hCS : S ^ 2 ≤ Q * P := by
    have := (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hQ).mp hnn
    linarith
  
  apply Real.abs_le_sqrt
  have hsq : Real.sqrt Q ^ 2 = Q := Real.sq_sqrt hQ.le
  rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, hsq, ← div_eq_inv_mul, div_le_iff₀ hQ]
  linarith

signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hG : ContinuousOn (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j => (g.smooth p i j).continuousOn
  have hdetc : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ => A.det) := continuous_id.matrix_det
  have hsqdet : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn (hdetc.comp_continuousOn hG)
  have hinvc : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    intro i j
    have hadj : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ => A.adjugate i j) :=
      (continuous_id.matrix_adjugate).matrix_elem i j
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)⁻¹ *
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).adjugate i j) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      ((hdetc.comp_continuousOn hG).inv₀
        fun y hy => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y hy).det_pos.ne').mul
        (hadj.comp_continuousOn hG)
    refine h1.congr fun y _ => ?_
    simp only [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
    { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 p).symm.toPartialEquiv
      open_source := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
      open_target := (chartAt E3 p).open_source
      contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
  have hup : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn
      (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    intro i
    exact (hup.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 p).open_target (by simp)).clm_apply
      continuousOn_const
  have hR : ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
    exact ((hinvc i j).mul (hpd i)).mul (hpd j)
  have hgrad : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y := by
    intro y hy
    exact gradInner_eq_coord g Φ u (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) hu y hy
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
  have hgradc : ContinuousOn (fun y => g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    hR.congr fun y hy => hgrad y hy
  exact ⟨hup, hgrad, hsqdet.mul (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn hgradc)⟩

signature.name: chart_field_comp_bound
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (Y : E3 → E3) (hYc : HasCompactSupport Y) (hYt : tsupport Y ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target)
    (hYn : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ (z : E3) (i : Fin 3),
      |Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * Y z i| ≤ B

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set G := g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm with hGdef
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun z => G z i j) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    fun i j => (g.smooth p i j).continuousOn
  have hGc : ContinuousOn G (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j => hGs i j
  have hadj : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContinuousOn (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G z).adjugate i i)) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    intro i
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun z => (G z).adjugate) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      (Continuous.matrix_adjugate continuous_id).comp_continuousOn hGc
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun z => (G z).adjugate i i) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      continuousOn_pi.1 (continuousOn_pi.1 h1 i) i
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn h2
  have hH : ContinuousOn (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, Real.sqrt ((G z).adjugate i i)) (tsupport Y) :=
    (continuousOn_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hadj i).mono hYt
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hYc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hH
  refine ⟨max b 0, le_max_right _ _, fun z i => ?_⟩
  by_cases hz : z ∈ tsupport Y
  · have hzt := hYt hz
    have hA : (G z).PosDef := coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p z hzt
    have hdet : 0 < (G z).det := hA.det_pos
    have hinvpos : 0 < (G z)⁻¹ i i := hA.inv.diag_pos
    have hCS := smth_quad_cauchySchwarz (G z) hA (fun j => Y z j) (Pi.single i 1)
    beta_reduce at hCS
    have e1 : ∑ k : Fin 3, Y z k * (Pi.single i (1:ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ) k = Y z i := by
      simp [Pi.single_apply]
    have e2 : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k l * (Pi.single i (1:ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ) k *
        (Pi.single i (1:ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ) l = (G z)⁻¹ i i := by
      simp [Pi.single_apply]
    rw [e1, e2] at hCS
    have hsq : (Y z i) ^ 2 ≤ (G z)⁻¹ i i :=
      hCS.trans (mul_le_of_le_one_left hinvpos.le (hYn z))
    have hinvadj : (G z).det * (G z)⁻¹ i i = (G z).adjugate i i := by
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', ← mul_assoc,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ hdet.ne', one_mul]
    have hkey : (Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) ^ 2 ≤ (G z).adjugate i i := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hdet.le, ← hinvadj]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hdet.le
    have h3 : |Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i| ≤ Real.sqrt ((G z).adjugate i i) :=
      Real.abs_le_sqrt hkey
    have h4 : Real.sqrt ((G z).adjugate i i) ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, Real.sqrt ((G z).adjugate j j) :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => Real.sqrt ((G z).adjugate j j))
        (fun j _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have h5 := hb z hz
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h5
    calc |Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i| ≤ Real.sqrt ((G z).adjugate i i) := h3
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, Real.sqrt ((G z).adjugate j j) := h4
      _ ≤ |∑ j : Fin 3, Real.sqrt ((G z).adjugate j j)| := le_abs_self _
      _ ≤ b := h5
      _ ≤ max b 0 := le_max_left _ _
  · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz]
    simp

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (s : E3 → ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3)
    (y : E3) (hs : DifferentiableAt ℝ s y)
    (hF : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) y) :
    sepDensDiv G (fun z => s z • Y z) y =
      s y * sepDensDiv G Y y + Real.sqrt (G y).det * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i s y * Y y i

proof.tactics:
by
  have key : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (s z • Y z) i) y =
        s y * partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) y +
          Real.sqrt (G y).det * (partialDeriv i s y * Y y i) := by
    intro i
    have h1 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (s z • Y z) i) =
        (fun z => s z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i)) := by
      funext z
      simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h1, fderiv_fun_mul hs (hF i)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  unfold sepDensDiv
  dsimp only
  simp only [key]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]

signature.name: sepDensDiv_smul_dev_le
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (s : E3 → ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3)
    (y : E3) (hs : DifferentiableAt ℝ s y) (hs0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ s z) (B : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ (z : E3) (i : Fin 3), |Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i| ≤ B) :
    |sepDensDiv G (fun z => s z • Y z) y - s y * sepDensDiv G Y y| ≤
      ∑ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i s y| * B

proof.tactics:
by
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hB y 0)
  
  have s1 : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, (∀ z, |f z| ≤ B) → s y = 0 →
      HasFDerivAt (fun z => s z * f z) (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y := by
    intro f hf hsy
    have hmin : IsLocalMin s y :=
      Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => by rw [hsy]; exact hs0 z)
    have hd : HasFDerivAt s (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y := by
      have h := hs.hasFDerivAt
      rwa [hmin.fderiv_eq_zero] at h
    have hso := hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero.mp hd
    simp only [hsy, sub_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at hso
    rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero]
    simp only [hsy, zero_mul, sub_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    have hO : (fun h : E3 => s (y + h) * f (y + h)) =O[𝓝 0] (fun h => s (y + h)) := by
      refine Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound B (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun h => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hf _) (abs_nonneg _)
    exact hO.trans_isLittleO hso
  
  have s2 : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, s y ≠ 0 → ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ f y →
      ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => s z * f z) y := by
    intro f hsy hf h
    apply hf
    have hne : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, s z ≠ 0 := hs.continuousAt.eventually_ne hsy
    have hinv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (s z)⁻¹) y := hs.inv hsy
    have hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => s z * f z * (s z)⁻¹) y := h.mul hinv
    refine hq.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hne] with z hz
    field_simp
  
  have s3 : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      |fderiv ℝ (fun z => s z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i)) y (e i) -
        s y * fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) y (e i)| ≤
        |fderiv ℝ s y (e i)| * B := by
    intro i
    by_cases hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) y
    · have hm : HasFDerivAt (fun z => s z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i))
          (s y • fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) y +
            (Real.sqrt (G y).det * Y y i) • fderiv ℝ s y) y :=
        hs.hasFDerivAt.mul hF.hasFDerivAt
      rw [hm.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [show s y * fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) y (e i) +
          Real.sqrt (G y).det * Y y i * fderiv ℝ s y (e i) -
          s y * fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) y (e i) =
          Real.sqrt (G y).det * Y y i * fderiv ℝ s y (e i) by ring]
      rw [abs_mul, mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB y i) (abs_nonneg _)
    · by_cases hsy : s y = 0
      · rw [(s1 _ (fun z => hB z i) hsy).fderiv, hsy]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, zero_mul, sub_zero, abs_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hB0
      · rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt (s2 _ hsy hF),
          fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hF]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero, sub_zero, abs_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hB0
  
  have s4 : ∀ i : Fin 3, (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (s z • Y z) i) =
      fun z => s z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) := by
    intro i
    funext z
    simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
  simp_rw [s4]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => s3 i)

by

    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
    have h2 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
      rw [hz]
      simp
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h2.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  refine ⟨hA, fun hX C hC => ?_⟩
  have hmeas : Measurable (sepDensDiv G X) := by
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _
      (fun i _ => measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) (e i))
  have hK : IsCompact (tsupport X) := hX.isCompact
  have hon : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (sepDensDiv G X) (tsupport X) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded (M := C) hK.measure_lt_top.ne
      hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun a => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hC a))
  exact hon.integrable_of_forall_notMem_eq_zero hA

informal_problem.statement:
(T A S K : Set E3) (D Dt J : E3 → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hT : MeasurableSet T) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hK : MeasurableSet K)
    (hTA : T ⊆ A) (hSfin : MeasureTheory.volume S ≠ ⊤) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hD : MeasureTheory.Integrable D MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hDt : MeasureTheory.Integrable Dt MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hJ : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn J (A ∩ K) MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hJ0 : ∀ y ∈ A ∩ K, 0 ≤ J y)
    (hpt : ∀ y ∈ T, D y ≤ Dt y + C * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y + K.indicator J y)
    (hzero : ∀ y ∈ A \ T, Dt y = 0) :
    ∫ y in T, D y ≤ (∫ y in A, Dt y) + C * (MeasureTheory.volume S).toReal +
      ∫ y in A ∩ K, J y

signature.name: setIntegral_split_le
signature.statement:
(T A S K : Set E3) (D Dt J : E3 → ℝ) (C : ℝ)
    (hT : MeasurableSet T) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hK : MeasurableSet K)
    (hTA : T ⊆ A) (hSfin : MeasureTheory.volume S ≠ ⊤) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hD : MeasureTheory.Integrable D MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hDt : MeasureTheory.Integrable Dt MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hJ : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn J (A ∩ K) MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hJ0 : ∀ y ∈ A ∩ K, 0 ≤ J y)
    (hpt : ∀ y ∈ T, D y ≤ Dt y + C * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y + K.indicator J y)
    (hzero : ∀ y ∈ A \ T, Dt y = 0) :
    ∫ y in T, D y ≤ (∫ y in A, Dt y) + C * (MeasureTheory.volume S).toReal +
      ∫ y in A ∩ K, J y

proof.tactics:
by
  have hS1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff hS).2 (MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hSfin)
  have I1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn Dt T MeasureTheory.volume := hDt.integrableOn
  have I2 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => C * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y) T
      MeasureTheory.volume := (hS1.const_mul C).integrableOn
  have hAK1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable ((A ∩ K).indicator J) MeasureTheory.volume :=
    hJ.integrable_indicator (hA.inter hK)
  have I3 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (K.indicator J) T MeasureTheory.volume := by
    refine hAK1.integrableOn.congr_fun ?_ hT
    intro y hy
    by_cases hyK : y ∈ K
    · have hyAK : y ∈ A ∩ K := ⟨hTA hy, hyK⟩
      simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hyAK, Set.indicator_of_mem hyK]
    · have hyAK : y ∉ A ∩ K := fun h => hyK h.2
      simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyAK, Set.indicator_of_notMem hyK]
  have E1 : ∫ y in T, D y ≤ ∫ y in T,
      (Dt y + C * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y + K.indicator J y) :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hD.integrableOn ((I1.add I2).add I3) hT hpt
  have E2 : ∫ y in T, (Dt y + C * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y + K.indicator J y) =
      (∫ y in T, Dt y) + C * (∫ y in T, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y) +
        ∫ y in T, K.indicator J y := by
    have I12 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun y => Dt y + C * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y) T MeasureTheory.volume :=
      I1.add I2
    have h1 : ∫ y in T, (Dt y + C * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y + K.indicator J y) =
        (∫ y in T, (Dt y + C * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y)) +
          ∫ y in T, K.indicator J y := MeasureTheory.integral_add I12 I3
    have h2 : ∫ y in T, (Dt y + C * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y) =
        (∫ y in T, Dt y) + ∫ y in T, C * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_add I1 I2
    have h3 : ∫ y in T, C * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y =
        C * ∫ y in T, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul C _
    rw [h1, h2, h3]
  have E3 : ∫ y in A, Dt y = ∫ y in T, Dt y :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hA hTA hzero
  have E4 : ∫ y in T, S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y ≤ (MeasureTheory.volume S).toReal := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_indicator hS, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_mono hSfin (MeasureTheory.measure_mono Set.inter_subset_right)
  have E4' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left E4 hC
  have E5 : ∫ y in T, K.indicator J y ≤ ∫ y in A ∩ K, J y := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_indicator hK]
    exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set hJ
      (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (hA.inter hK) hJ0)
      (Set.inter_subset_inter_left K hTA).eventuallyLE
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ ρ₂ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₂ ∧ ∀ Sig : Set M, IsCompact Sig → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig → ∀ q ∈ Sig, q ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source → chartAt E3 z q ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) r → ∃ F : E2 → E3, F 0 = chartAt E3 z q ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ₂) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ₂, F x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig ∧ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F x x) k * g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x x) l = ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∧ ∀ w : E2, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x x x) k + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) k a b (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x x) a * (fderiv ℝ F x x) b) * g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x w) l = 0

signature.name: surface_radial_geodesic_map
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ ρ₂ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₂ ∧ ∀ Sig : Set M, IsCompact Sig → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig → ∀ q ∈ Sig, q ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source → chartAt E3 z q ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) r → ∃ F : E2 → E3, F 0 = chartAt E3 z q ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ₂) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ₂, F x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig ∧ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F x x) k * g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x x) l = ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∧ ∀ w : E2, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x x x) k + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) k a b (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x x) a * (fderiv ℝ F x x) b) * g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x w) l = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmG⟩ := chart_metric_lower_bound g z r hball
  have hsm : 0 < Real.sqrt m := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hm
  have hsq : Real.sqrt m ^ 2 = m := Real.sq_sqrt hm.le
  refine ⟨r * Real.sqrt m / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro Sig _hSc hSm q hq hqs hqb
  obtain ⟨hscpt, N, W, Φ, hWΦ, hcov0⟩ := minimal_set_chart_cover g z r hr hball Sig hSm
  have hy0t : chartAt E3 z q ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target := (chartAt E3 z).map_source hqs
  have hy0S : (chartAt E3 z).symm (chartAt E3 z q) ∈ Sig := by
    rw [(chartAt E3 z).left_inv hqs]; exact hq
  set G := g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm with hGdef
  set c := chartAt E3 z z with hcdef
  set y₀ := chartAt E3 z q with hy₀def
  
  have hBt : Metric.ball c (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target :=
    Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hball
  have hGsm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) :=
    fun i j => (g.smooth z i j).mono hBt
  have hGs : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i := fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  have hGpd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball c (4 * r), (G y).PosDef :=
    fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g z y (hBt hy)
  have hmO : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball c (4 * r), ∀ v : E3,
      m * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * G y k l * v l :=
    fun y hy v => hmG y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy) v
  have hZO : Metric.closedBall c (3 * r) ⊆ Metric.ball c (4 * r) :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hqb' : dist y₀ c < r := hqb
  have hy0Z : y₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]; linarith
  
  have hSZ : IsClosed ({y : E3 | (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig} ∩ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r)) := by
    have he : {y : E3 | (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig} ∩ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r) =
        {y : E3 | y ∈ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig} := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      exact and_comm
    rw [he]
    exact hscpt.isClosed
  have hagree : ∀ (i j : Fin N) (y v : E3), y ∈ W i → y ∈ W j → (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig →
      fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y v = 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (Φ j) y v = 0 ∧ sprayA G (Φ j) y v = sprayA G (Φ i) y v := by
    intro i j y v hi hj hyS hv
    exact spray_defining_fn_agree G (W i) (W j) (hWΦ i).1 (hWΦ j).1
      (fun a b => (hGsm a b).mono (hWΦ i).2.1) hGs (fun y' hy' => hGpd y' ((hWΦ i).2.1 hy'))
      (Φ i) (Φ j) (hWΦ i).2.2.1 (hWΦ j).2.2.1 (hWΦ i).2.2.2.1 (hWΦ j).2.2.2.1
      (fun y' hy' => by rw [(hWΦ i).2.2.2.2 y' hy'.1, (hWΦ j).2.2.2.2 y' hy'.2])
      y v ⟨hi, hj⟩ (((hWΦ i).2.2.2.2 y hi).2 hyS) hv
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, X, _hψ0, hψ1, hψW, hXs, hXc, hXf⟩ := surface_spray_field G c r hr hGsm hGpd W Φ
    (fun i => ⟨(hWΦ i).1, (hWΦ i).2.1⟩) (fun i => (hWΦ i).2.2.1) (fun i => (hWΦ i).2.2.2.1)
    {y : E3 | y ∈ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig} hscpt
    (fun y hy => Set.mem_iUnion.2 (hcov0 y hy.1 hy.2))
  obtain ⟨Fl, hFls, hFl0, hFl⟩ := ode_flow_contDiff X hXs hXc
  have hXS : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig} ∩ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r),
      ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ≤ r → (∀ i, y ∈ W i → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y v = 0) → ∀ j, y ∈ W j →
      X (y, v) = (v, -sprayGam G y v - sprayA G (Φ j) y v) := by
    intro y hy v hv htan j hj
    rw [hXf y hy.2 v hv]
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ, ψ i y • sprayA G (Φ i) y v = ψ i y • sprayA G (Φ j) y v := by
      intro i _
      by_cases h0 : ψ i y = 0
      · rw [h0, zero_smul, zero_smul]
      · rw [(hagree j i y v hj (hψW i y h0) hy.1 (htan j hj)).2]
    have hsum : ∑ i, ψ i y • sprayA G (Φ i) y v = sprayA G (Φ j) y v := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, ← Finset.sum_smul, hψ1 y ⟨hy.2, hy.1⟩, one_smul]
    simp only [sprayQ, hsum]
  
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hcov0 _ hy0Z hy0S
  obtain ⟨L, hLtan, hLiso⟩ := tangent_isometry_exists (G y₀) (hGpd _ (hZO hy0Z))
    (fderiv ℝ (Φ i₀) y₀) ((hWΦ i₀).2.2.2.1 _ hi₀)
  have hv₀ : ∀ x : E2, ∀ i, y₀ ∈ W i → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y₀ (L x) = 0 :=
    fun x i hi => (hagree i₀ i _ (L x) hi₀ hi hy0S (hLtan x)).1
  
  have hFsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E2 => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1) := by
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E2 => ((1 : ℝ), (y₀, L x))) :=
      contDiff_const.prodMk (contDiff_const.prodMk L.contDiff)
    exact contDiff_fst.comp (hFls.comp h1)
  
  have hinv : ∀ x : E2, ‖x‖ < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      t * ‖x‖ < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 → ∀ t' ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t,
      (Fl t' (y₀, L x)).1 ∈ {y : E3 | (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig} ∩ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r) ∧
      ‖(Fl t' (y₀, L x)).1 - y₀‖ ≤ t' * (‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m) ∧
      ‖(Fl t' (y₀, L x)).2‖ ≤ ‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m ∧
      (∀ i, (Fl t' (y₀, L x)).1 ∈ W i →
        fderiv ℝ (Φ i) (Fl t' (y₀, L x)).1 (Fl t' (y₀, L x)).2 = 0) ∧
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (Fl t' (y₀, L x)).2 k * G (Fl t' (y₀, L x)).1 k l *
        (Fl t' (y₀, L x)).2 l =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (L x) k * G y₀ k l * (L x) l := by
    intro x hx t ht htx
    have hμ0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m := div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hsm.le
    have htμ : t * (‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m) < r / 2 := by
      rw [← mul_div_assoc]
      calc t * ‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 / Real.sqrt m :=
            div_lt_div_of_pos_right htx hsm
        _ = r / 2 := by field_simp
    have hμr : ‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m ≤ r := by
      have : ‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m < r / 2 := by
        calc ‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 / Real.sqrt m :=
              div_lt_div_of_pos_right hx hsm
          _ = r / 2 := by field_simp
      linarith
    have hμv : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (L x) k * G y₀ k l * (L x) l ≤
        m * (‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m) ^ 2 := by
      have e1 : m * (‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m) ^ 2 = ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [div_pow, hsq]; field_simp
      rw [hLiso x, e1]
    have hballsub : Metric.closedBall y₀ (t * (‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m)) ⊆ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r) := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hy ⊢
      have := dist_triangle y y₀ c
      linarith
    exact spray_flow_invariance G (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) Metric.isOpen_ball hGsm hGs hGpd m hm hmO
      W Φ (fun i => ⟨(hWΦ i).1, (hWΦ i).2.1⟩) (fun i => (hWΦ i).2.2.1) (fun i => (hWΦ i).2.2.2.1)
      {y : E3 | (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig} (Metric.closedBall c (3 * r))
      (fun i y hy => (hWΦ i).2.2.2.2 y hy) hZO hSZ (fun y hy => hcov0 y hy.2 hy.1) r X
      (hXs.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)) hXc hXS Fl hFl0 hFl y₀ (L x) ⟨hy0S, hy0Z⟩ (hv₀ x)
      (‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m) t hμ0 ht hμv hμr hballsub
  
  have hball2 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (r * Real.sqrt m / 2),
      (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 ∈ {y : E3 | (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig} ∩ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r) ∧
      ‖(Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 - y₀‖ ≤ ‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m ∧ ‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m < r / 2 ∧
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).2 k * G (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 k l *
        (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).2 l =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (L x) k * G y₀ k l * (L x) l := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hx
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, -, h5⟩ := hinv x hx 1 zero_le_one (by rw [one_mul]; exact hx) 1
      ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
    refine ⟨h1, by rw [one_mul] at h2; exact h2, ?_, h5⟩
    calc ‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 / Real.sqrt m := div_lt_div_of_pos_right hx hsm
      _ = r / 2 := by field_simp
  have hF0 : (Fl 1 (y₀, L 0)).1 = y₀ := by
    have h := (hball2 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self (by positivity))).2.1
    rw [norm_zero, zero_div] at h
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_le_zero_iff.mp h)
  
  have hsymm_apply : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → ℝ) (k : Fin 3), (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm f k = f k :=
    fun f k => by simp
  have hsmul_apply : ∀ (a : ℝ) (v : E3) (k : Fin 3), (a • v) k = a * v k := fun a v k => by simp
  have hsub_apply : ∀ (v w : E3) (k : Fin 3), (v - w) k = v k - w k := fun v w k => by simp
  have hneg_apply : ∀ (v : E3) (k : Fin 3), (-v) k = -v k := fun v k => by simp
  have hsum_apply : ∀ (f : Fin N → E3) (k : Fin 3), (∑ i, f i) k = ∑ i, f i k :=
    fun f k => by simp
  
  have hQhom : ∀ (y v : E3) (a : ℝ), sprayQ G Φ ψ y (a • v) = (a ^ 2) • sprayQ G Φ ψ y v := by
    intro y v a
    have hGam : sprayGam G y (a • v) = (a ^ 2) • sprayGam G y v := by
      ext k
      simp only [sprayGam, hsymm_apply, hsmul_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
    have hA : ∀ i, sprayA G (Φ i) y (a • v) = (a ^ 2) • sprayA G (Φ i) y v := by
      intro i
      have hH : ∑ i' : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, hessLoc G (Φ i) i' j y * (a • v) i' * (a • v) j =
          a ^ 2 * ∑ i' : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, hessLoc G (Φ i) i' j y * v i' * v j := by
        simp only [hsmul_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
      simp only [sprayA, hH, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      ring
    simp only [sprayQ]
    rw [hGam, smul_sub, smul_neg, Finset.smul_sum]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [hA i, smul_comm])
  
  have hpairA : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), (∀ k l, A k l = A l k) → IsUnit A.det →
      ∀ (s : ℝ) (d u : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (s * ∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k m * d m) * A k l * u l =
        s * ∑ l : Fin 3, d l * u l := by
    intro A hs hdet s d u
    have hinvA : ∀ l m : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k m * A k l = (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) l m := by
      intro l m
      rw [← Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hdet, Matrix.mul_apply]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by rw [hs l k]; ring)
    have e00 := hinvA 0 0
    have e01 := hinvA 0 1
    have e02 := hinvA 0 2
    have e10 := hinvA 1 0
    have e11 := hinvA 1 1
    have e12 := hinvA 1 2
    have e20 := hinvA 2 0
    have e21 := hinvA 2 1
    have e22 := hinvA 2 2
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_ne, ne_eq, Fin.reduceEq,
      not_false_eq_true] at e00 e01 e02 e10 e11 e12 e20 e21 e22 ⊢
    linear_combination (s * d 0 * u 0) * e00 + (s * d 1 * u 0) * e01 + (s * d 2 * u 0) * e02 +
      (s * d 0 * u 1) * e10 + (s * d 1 * u 1) * e11 + (s * d 2 * u 1) * e12 +
      (s * d 0 * u 2) * e20 + (s * d 1 * u 2) * e21 + (s * d 2 * u 2) * e22
  have hfd : ∀ (Ψ : E3 → ℝ) (y u : E3), fderiv ℝ Ψ y u = ∑ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l Ψ y * u l := by
    intro Ψ y u
    have hu' : u = u 0 • e 0 + u 1 • e 1 + u 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hu']
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, partialDeriv]
    ring
  have hpair : ∀ (Ψ : E3 → ℝ) (y v u : E3), y ∈ Metric.ball c (4 * r) →
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (sprayA G Ψ y v) k * G y k l * u l =
        ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, hessLoc G Ψ i j y * v i * v j) /
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Ψ y * partialDeriv b Ψ y)) *
          fderiv ℝ Ψ y u := by
    intro Ψ y v u hy
    rw [hfd Ψ y u]
    have hdet : IsUnit (G y).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hGpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin 3, (sprayA G Ψ y v) k =
        ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, hessLoc G Ψ i j y * v i * v j) /
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Ψ y * partialDeriv b Ψ y)) *
          ∑ m : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k m * partialDeriv m Ψ y := by
      intro k
      simp [sprayA]
    simp only [hk]
    exact hpairA (G y) (fun k l => hGs y k l) hdet _ (fun l => partialDeriv l Ψ y) (fun l => u l)
  
  have hnormal : ∀ (y v u : E3), y ∈ Metric.ball c (4 * r) →
      (∀ i, ψ i y ≠ 0 → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y u = 0) →
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, ((sprayQ G Φ ψ y v) k +
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y * v a * v b) * G y k l * u l = 0 := by
    intro y v u hy hu
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin 3, (sprayQ G Φ ψ y v) k +
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y * v a * v b =
        ∑ i, -(ψ i y * (sprayA G (Φ i) y v) k) := by
      intro k
      simp only [sprayQ, sprayGam, hsub_apply, hneg_apply, hsum_apply, hsmul_apply, hsymm_apply,
        Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      ring
    simp only [hk]
    have hexch : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (∑ i, -(ψ i y * (sprayA G (Φ i) y v) k)) * G y k l * u l =
        ∑ i, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, -(ψ i y * (sprayA G (Φ i) y v) k) * G y k l * u l := by
      calc _ = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ i, ∑ l : Fin 3,
            -(ψ i y * (sprayA G (Φ i) y v) k) * G y k l * u l := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
            simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
            exact Finset.sum_comm
        _ = _ := Finset.sum_comm
    rw [hexch]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
    by_cases h0 : ψ i y = 0
    · simp [h0]
    · have hP := hpair (Φ i) y v u hy
      rw [hu i h0, mul_zero] at hP
      calc ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, -(ψ i y * (sprayA G (Φ i) y v) k) * G y k l * u l
          = -(ψ i y) * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (sprayA G (Φ i) y v) k * G y k l * u l := by
            simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by ring))
        _ = 0 := by rw [hP, mul_zero]
  
  have hfst : ∀ (f : ℝ → E3 × E3) (f' : E3 × E3) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt f f' t →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (f s).1) f'.1 t := by
    intro f f' t h
    have h2 := (hasFDerivAt_fst : HasFDerivAt (Prod.fst : E3 × E3 → E3)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E3 E3) (f t)).comp_hasDerivAt t h
    exact h2
  have hsnd : ∀ (f : ℝ → E3 × E3) (f' : E3 × E3) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt f f' t →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (f s).2) f'.2 t := by
    intro f f' t h
    have h2 := (hasFDerivAt_snd : HasFDerivAt (Prod.snd : E3 × E3 → E3)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E3 E3) (f t)).comp_hasDerivAt t h
    exact h2
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := ContDiff.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hXc hXs (by simp)
  
  refine ⟨fun x => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1, hF0, hFsm.contDiffOn, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨hxS, hxd, hμ2, hspd⟩ := hball2 x hx
  have hFx2 : (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 ∈ Metric.ball c (2 * r) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    have := dist_triangle (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 y₀ c
    rw [dist_eq_norm (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 y₀] at this
    linarith
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · subst hx0
    exact ⟨hFx2, hxS.1, by simp, fun w => by simp⟩
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx0
  have hxlt : ‖x‖ < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hx
  have hT1 : 1 < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 / ‖x‖ := by rw [lt_div_iff₀ hxpos]; linarith
  have htT : ∀ t : ℝ, t < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 / ‖x‖ → t * ‖x‖ < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 :=
    fun t ht => (lt_div_iff₀ hxpos).mp ht
  have hXt : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 / ‖x‖ →
      X (Fl t (y₀, L x)) =
        ((Fl t (y₀, L x)).2, sprayQ G Φ ψ (Fl t (y₀, L x)).1 (Fl t (y₀, L x)).2) := by
    intro t ht0 htT'
    obtain ⟨h1, -, h3, -, -⟩ := hinv x hxlt t ht0 (htT t htT') t ⟨ht0, le_rfl⟩
    exact hXf _ h1.2 _ (by linarith)
  have hhom : ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → lam < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 / ‖x‖ →
      Fl 1 (y₀, lam • L x) = ((Fl lam (y₀, L x)).1, lam • (Fl lam (y₀, L x)).2) := by
    intro lam hl hlT
    refine spray_flow_homogeneity X K hK Fl hFl0 hFl (sprayQ G Φ ψ) hQhom
      {p : E3 × E3 | p.1 ∈ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r) ∧ ‖p.2‖ ≤ r}
      (fun p hp => hXf p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2) y₀ (L x) lam hl ?_
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨h1, -, h3, -, -⟩ := hinv x hxlt lam hl.le (htT lam hlT) t ht
    have hlμ : lam * (‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m) < r / 2 := by
      rw [← mul_div_assoc]
      calc lam * ‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m < r * Real.sqrt m / 2 / Real.sqrt m :=
            div_lt_div_of_pos_right (htT lam hlT) hsm
        _ = r / 2 := by field_simp
    have hlη : lam * ‖(Fl t (y₀, L x)).2‖ ≤ lam * (‖x‖ / Real.sqrt m) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hl.le
    refine ⟨⟨h1.2, by linarith⟩, h1.2, ?_⟩
    show ‖lam • (Fl t (y₀, L x)).2‖ ≤ r
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hl]
    linarith
  have hγd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (r * Real.sqrt m / 2 / ‖x‖),
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (Fl s (y₀, L x)).1) (Fl t (y₀, L x)).2 t := by
    intro t ht
    have h := hfst _ _ t (hFl t (y₀, L x))
    rw [hXt t ht.1.le ht.2] at h
    exact h
  have hηd : HasDerivAt (fun s => (Fl s (y₀, L x)).2)
      (sprayQ G Φ ψ (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).2) 1 := by
    have h := hsnd _ _ 1 (hFl 1 (y₀, L x))
    rw [hXt 1 zero_le_one hT1] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨hd1, hd2⟩ := ray_derivatives_of_eqOn (fun x => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1)
    (hFsm.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)) x (r * Real.sqrt m / 2 / ‖x‖) hT1
    (fun s => (Fl s (y₀, L x)).1) (fun s => (Fl s (y₀, L x)).2)
    (sprayQ G Φ ψ (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).2)
    (fun t ht => by
      show (Fl 1 (y₀, L (t • x))).1 = (Fl t (y₀, L x)).1
      rw [map_smul, hhom t ht.1 ht.2])
    hγd hηd
  have hd1' : fderiv ℝ (fun x => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1) x x = (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).2 := hd1
  have hd2' : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1)) x x x =
      sprayQ G Φ ψ (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).2 := hd2
  
  have htanw : ∀ w : E2, ∀ i, ψ i (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 ≠ 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (Φ i) (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 (fderiv ℝ (fun x => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1) x w) = 0 := by
    intro w i h0
    have hyW : (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 ∈ W i := hψW i _ h0
    have hFc : Continuous (fun x : E2 => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1) := hFsm.continuous
    have hev : (fun x' : E2 => Φ i ((fun x : E2 => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1) x')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      have h1 : (fun x : E2 => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1) ⁻¹' W i ∈ 𝓝 x :=
        hFc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds ((hWΦ i).1.mem_nhds hyW)
      have h2 : Metric.ball (0 : E2) (r * Real.sqrt m / 2) ∈ 𝓝 x := Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx
      filter_upwards [h1, h2] with x' hx'1 hx'2
      exact ((hWΦ i).2.2.2.2 _ hx'1).2 (hball2 x' hx'2).1.1
    have hdΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (Φ i) (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1 :=
      ((hWΦ i).2.2.1.contDiffAt ((hWΦ i).1.mem_nhds hyW)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hdF : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x : E2 => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1) x :=
      (hFsm.differentiable (by simp)) x
    have hcomp := fderiv_comp x hdΦ hdF
    have hzero : fderiv ℝ (Φ i ∘ fun x : E2 => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1) x = 0 := by
      rw [show (Φ i ∘ fun x : E2 => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1) =
          fun x' => Φ i ((fun x : E2 => (Fl 1 (y₀, L x)).1) x') from rfl, hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    rw [hzero] at hcomp
    have h3 := congrArg (fun T : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T w) hcomp
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp',
      Function.comp_apply] at h3
    exact h3.symm
  refine ⟨hFx2, hxS.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hd1']
    exact hspd.trans (hLiso x)
  · intro w
    rw [hd2', hd1']
    exact hnormal _ _ _ (hZO hxS.2) (htanw w)

subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) O) (hGs : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ O, (G y).PosDef) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmG : ∀ y ∈ O, ∀ v : E3, m * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * G y k l * v l) {N : ℕ} (W : Fin N → Set E3) (Φ : Fin N → E3 → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i) ∧ W i ⊆ O) (hΦ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ i) (W i)) (hdΦ : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W i, fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y ≠ 0) (S Z : Set E3) (hSW : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W i, (Φ i y = 0 ↔ y ∈ S)) (hZO : Z ⊆ O) (hSZ : IsClosed (S ∩ Z)) (hcov : ∀ y ∈ S ∩ Z, ∃ i, y ∈ W i) (Rv : ℝ) (X : E3 × E3 → E3 × E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ 1 X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) (hXS : ∀ y ∈ S ∩ Z, ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ≤ Rv → (∀ i, y ∈ W i → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y v = 0) → ∀ j, y ∈ W j → X (y, v) = (v, -sprayGam G y v - sprayA G (Φ j) y v)) (Fl : ℝ → E3 × E3 → E3 × E3) (hFl0 : ∀ p, Fl 0 p = p) (hFl : ∀ (t : ℝ) (p : E3 × E3), HasDerivAt (fun s => Fl s p) (X (Fl t p)) t) (y₀ v₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ S ∩ Z) (hv₀ : ∀ i, y₀ ∈ W i → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y₀ v₀ = 0) (μ T : ℝ) (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hμv : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l ≤ m * μ ^ 2) (hμR : μ ≤ Rv) (hball : Metric.closedBall y₀ (T * μ) ⊆ Z) : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 ∈ S ∩ Z ∧ ‖(Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 - y₀‖ ≤ t * μ ∧ ‖(Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2‖ ≤ μ ∧ (∀ i, (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 ∈ W i → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 = 0) ∧ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 k * G (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 k l * (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 l = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0) (ρ : ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ U) (hspeed : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F x x) k * G (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x x) l = ‖x‖ ^ 2) (hnormal : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ w : E2, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x x x) k + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x x) a * (fderiv ℝ F x x) b) * G (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x w) l = 0) : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j * x j = x i

signature.name: radial_geodesic_normal_form
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0) (ρ : ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ U) (hspeed : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F x x) k * G (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x x) l = ‖x‖ ^ 2) (hnormal : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ w : E2, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x x x) k + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x x) a * (fderiv ℝ F x x) b) * G (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x w) l = 0) : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j * x j = x i

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ a b l : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y * G y k l =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (partialDeriv a (fun z => G z b l) y + partialDeriv b (fun z => G z a l) y
        - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z a b) y) := by
    intro y hy a b l
    have hinv : G y * (G y)⁻¹ = 1 :=
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hdet y hy))
    have hentry : ∀ m : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, G y l k * (G y)⁻¹ k m = if l = m then 1 else 0 := by
      intro m
      have h := congrFun (congrFun hinv l) m
      rwa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : Fin 3 → ℝ, T = fun m => partialDeriv a (fun z => G z b m) y
        + partialDeriv b (fun z => G z a m) y - partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have h1 : ∀ k, christoffel G k a b y = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ m : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k m * T m := by
      intro k; rw [hT]; rfl
    have h2 : ∑ k : Fin 3, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ m : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k m * T m) * G y k l =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ m : Fin 3, T m * ∑ k : Fin 3, G y l k * (G y)⁻¹ k m := by
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_))
      rw [hsymm y k l]; ring
    simp only [h1]
    rw [h2]
    simp only [hentry, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    subst hT
    rfl
  
  have s5 : ∀ (Gm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Γ dG : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (u v A B : Fin 3 → ℝ) (s : ℝ),
      (∀ k l : Fin 3, Gm k l = Gm l k) →
      (∀ a b l : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, Γ k a b * Gm k l = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) →
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (A k + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ k a b * u a * u b) * Gm k l * v l = 0 →
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, ((B k + v k) * Gm k l * u l + u k * (∑ a : Fin 3, dG a k l * v a) * u l
        + u k * Gm k l * (B l + v l)) = 2 * s →
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, ((A k + u k) * Gm k l * v l + u k * (∑ a : Fin 3, dG a k l * u a) * v l
        + u k * Gm k l * B l) = s := by
    intro Gm Γ dG u v A B s hsy hΓ hN hS
    have hΓsum : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, u a * u b * v l * (∑ k : Fin 3, Γ k a b * Gm k l) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          u a * u b * v l * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ =>
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by rw [hΓ a b l])))
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hΓsum hN hS ⊢
    simp only [hsy 1 0, hsy 2 0, hsy 2 1] at hΓsum hN hS ⊢
    linear_combination hN + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * hS - hΓsum
  
  have hexp : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (d : E3), L d = ∑ a : Fin 3, L (e a) * d a := by
    intro L d
    have hd : ∑ a : Fin 3, d a • e a = d := by
      have h := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr d
      simpa using h
    conv_lhs => rw [← hd]
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  have hpr : ∀ (m : Fin 3) (z : E3), (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) z = z m :=
    fun m z => rfl
  
  have pair : ∀ (p q : E2 → E3) (p' q' : E2 →L[ℝ] E3) (y : E2),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F y → HasFDerivAt p p' y → HasFDerivAt q q' y →
      (∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z k l) (F y)) →
      ∃ D : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
        HasFDerivAt (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, p x k * G (F x) k l * q x l) D y ∧
        ∀ v : E2, D v = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, ((p' v) k * G (F y) k l * q y l
          + p y k * (∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => G z k l) (F y) * (fderiv ℝ F y v) a) * q y l
          + p y k * G (F y) k l * (q' v) l) := by
    intro p q p' q' y hFy hp hq hGy
    have hpc : ∀ k : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun x => p x k)
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp p') y :=
      fun k => (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp y hp
    have hqc : ∀ l : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun x => q x l)
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj l : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp q') y :=
      fun l => (EuclideanSpace.proj l : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp y hq
    have hGc : ∀ k l : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun x => G (F x) k l)
        ((fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z k l) (F y)).comp (fderiv ℝ F y)) y :=
      fun k l => (hGy k l).hasFDerivAt.comp y hFy.hasFDerivAt
    have hterm : ∀ k l : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun x => p x k * G (F x) k l * q x l)
        ((p y k * G (F y) k l) • ((EuclideanSpace.proj l : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp q')
          + q y l • (p y k • ((fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z k l) (F y)).comp (fderiv ℝ F y))
            + G (F y) k l • ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp p'))) y :=
      fun k l => ((hpc k).mul (hGc k l)).mul (hqc l)
    refine ⟨_, HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (fun k _ => HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (fun l _ => hterm k l)),
      fun v => ?_⟩
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul, hpr]
    rw [hexp (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z k l) (F y)) (fderiv ℝ F y v)]
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    ring
  
  have hFa : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F y :=
    fun y hy => hF.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy)
  have hdF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) :=
    hF.fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball (by simp)
  have hFd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, DifferentiableAt ℝ F y :=
    fun y hy => (hFa y hy).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hDd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y :=
    fun y hy => (hdF.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hp : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, HasFDerivAt (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x x)
      ((fderiv ℝ F y).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y).flip y) y :=
    fun y hy => (hDd y hy).hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_id y)
  have hq : ∀ w : E2, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, HasFDerivAt (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x w)
      ((fderiv ℝ F y).comp (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y).flip w) y :=
    fun w y hy => (hDd y hy).hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const w y)
  have hsymF : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ v w : E2,
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y v w = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y w v := by
    intro y hy v w
    exact (hFa y hy).isSymmSndFDerivAt
      (by rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact ENat.LEInfty.out) v w
  
  have euler : ∀ w : E2, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∃ D : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      HasFDerivAt (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ F x x) k * G (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x w) l) D y ∧
      D y = inner ℝ y w := by
    intro w y hy
    have hGd : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z k l) (F y) := fun k l =>
      ((hG k l).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hFU y hy))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    obtain ⟨D, hD, hDv⟩ := pair (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x x) (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x w) _ _ y
      (hFd y hy) (hp y hy) (hq w y hy) hGd
    obtain ⟨DS, hDS, hDSv⟩ := pair (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x x) (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x x) _ _ y
      (hFd y hy) (hp y hy) (hp y hy) hGd
    have hnorm : HasFDerivAt (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ F x x) k * G (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x x) l)
        (2 • (innerSL ℝ y).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2)) y := by
      have h1 := (hasFDerivAt_id y).norm_sq
      refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy] with x hx
      exact hspeed x hx
    have hSeq : DS = 2 • (innerSL ℝ y).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2) := hDS.unique hnorm
    have hS := hDSv w
    rw [hSeq] at hS
    have hpy : ∀ v, ((fderiv ℝ F y).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2)
        + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y).flip y) v = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y v y + fderiv ℝ F y v := by
      intro v
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
      exact add_comm _ _
    have hqy : ∀ v, ((fderiv ℝ F y).comp (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] E2)
        + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y).flip w) v = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y v w := by
      intro v
      simp
    refine ⟨D, hD, ?_⟩
    rw [hDv y]
    simp only [hpy, hqy] at hS ⊢
    rw [hsymF y hy w y] at hS
    simp only [PiLp.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, innerSL_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hS ⊢
    exact s5 (G (F y)) (fun k a b => christoffel G k a b (F y))
      (fun a k l => partialDeriv a (fun z => G z k l) (F y))
      (fun k => (fderiv ℝ F y y) k) (fun k => (fderiv ℝ F y w) k)
      (fun k => (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y y y) k) (fun k => (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) y y w) k)
      (inner ℝ y w) (fun k l => hsymm (F y) k l) (s1 (F y) (hFU y hy)) (hnormal y hy w)
      (hS.symm.trans ((two_nsmul _).trans (two_mul _).symm))
  
  have s6 : ∀ E : E2 → ℝ, (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, DifferentiableAt ℝ E y) → E 0 = 0 →
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, fderiv ℝ E y y = 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, E x = 0 := by
    intro E hE h0 hrad x hx
    have hseg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, t • x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := by
      intro t ht
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hx ⊢
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht.1]
      calc t * ‖x‖ ≤ 1 * ‖x‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht.2 (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖x‖ := one_mul _
        _ < ρ := hx
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => E (t • x)) (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
      intro t ht
      have hsm : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => t • x) := continuous_id.smul continuous_const
      exact (ContinuousAt.comp (g := E) (f := fun t : ℝ => t • x) (x := t)
        (hE _ (hseg t ht)).continuousAt hsm.continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
    have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => E (t • x)) (fderiv ℝ E (t • x) x) t := by
      intro t ht
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t • x) ((1 : ℝ) • x) t := (hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const x
      rw [one_smul] at h1
      exact (hE _ (hseg t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h1
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hceq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun t : ℝ => E (t • x))
      (fun t => fderiv ℝ E (t • x) x) zero_lt_one hcont hderiv
    have hc0 : fderiv ℝ E (c • x) x = 0 := by
      have h := hrad (c • x) (hseg c (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hc))
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hc.1)
    rw [hc0] at hceq
    simp only [one_smul, zero_smul, h0, sub_zero, div_one] at hceq
    exact hceq.symm
  
  have s4 : ∀ x : E2, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j * x j =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F x x) k * G (F x) k l * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) l := by
    intro x i
    have hx : x 0 • e2 0 + x 1 • e2 1 = x := by
      have h := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).sum_repr x
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using h
    have hLx' : fderiv ℝ F x x = x 0 • fderiv ℝ F x (e2 0) + x 1 • fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1) := by
      rw [← map_smul, ← map_smul, ← map_add, hx]
    have hLx : ∀ m : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F x x) m =
        x 0 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 0)) m + x 1 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1)) m := by
      intro m
      rw [hLx']
      simp
    simp only [pullMetric2, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three, hLx]
    simp only [hsymm (F x) 1 0, hsymm (F x) 2 0, hsymm (F x) 2 1]
    ring
  
  intro x hx i
  have hE : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ F y y) k * G (F y) k l * (fderiv ℝ F y (e2 i)) l - innerSL ℝ (e2 i) y) y ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ F y y) k * G (F y) k l * (fderiv ℝ F y (e2 i)) l - innerSL ℝ (e2 i) y) y y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨D, hD, hDy⟩ := euler (e2 i) y hy
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ F y y) k * G (F y) k l * (fderiv ℝ F y (e2 i)) l - innerSL ℝ (e2 i) y)
        (D - innerSL ℝ (e2 i)) y := hD.sub (innerSL ℝ (e2 i)).hasFDerivAt
    refine ⟨h2.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    rw [h2.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, hDy, innerSL_apply, real_inner_comm]
    exact sub_self _
  have hE0 := s6 (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ F y y) k * G (F y) k l * (fderiv ℝ F y (e2 i)) l - innerSL ℝ (e2 i) y)
    (fun y hy => (hE y hy).1) (by simp) (fun y hy => (hE y hy).2) x hx
  rw [s4 x i]
  simp only [innerSL_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_one, one_mul] at hE0
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ k : ℝ, 0 ≤ k ∧ ∀ Sig : Set M, IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig → ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (F : E2 → E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) → ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) x ≤ k

signature.name: pullback_gauss_upper_bound
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ k : ℝ, 0 ≤ k ∧ ∀ Sig : Set M, IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig → ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (F : E2 → E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball 0 ρ) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ Sig ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) → ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) x ≤ k

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hU : IsOpen (chartAt E3 z).target := (chartAt E3 z).open_target
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j)
      (chartAt E3 z).target := fun i j => g.smooth z i j
  have hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y j i :=
    fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  have hGpos : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y).PosDef :=
    fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g z y hy
  have hB : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r)) := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have hBU : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)).trans hball
  obtain ⟨K₀, hK₀, hamb⟩ := gs_amb_plane_bound _ _ hU hGs hGsymm hGpos _ hB hBU
  refine ⟨K₀, hK₀, ?_⟩
  intro Sig hSig ρ F hF hFx
  have hs : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hFB : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (2 * r) :=
    fun x hx => Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hFx x hx).1
  have hFU : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target :=
    fun x hx => hBU (hFB x hx)
  have hinj : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x) :=
    fun x hx => (hFx x hx).2.2
  obtain ⟨-, hhsymm, hhpos, -, -, -, ha0⟩ :=
    gs_regularity _ _ hU hGs hGsymm hGpos F _ hs hF hFU hinj
  
  have hkey : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V →
      (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ V → V ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).source →
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f → (∀ y ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f y ≠ 0) →
      V ∩ Sig = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} →
        (levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y))
            (F x) = 0 ↔ gsMeanCurv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x = 0) := by
    intro x hx V f hV hpV _hVs hf hdf hVS
    have hpsrc : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source :=
      (chartAt E3 z).map_target (hFU x hx)
    have hκp : chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = F x :=
      (chartAt E3 z).right_inv (hFU x hx)
    have hcm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ (chartAt E3 z).symm) (chartAt E3 z).target :=
      hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    have hcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcm
    have hcda : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F x) :=
      hcd.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hFU x hx))
    have hf2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F x) :=
      hcda.of_le (by norm_cast)
    have hdf' : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F x) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hdf _ hpV
      have h0' : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y))
          (chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) = 0 := by
        rw [hκp]; exact h0
      have heq : f =ᶠ[𝓝 ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))]
          ((fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) ∘ (chartAt E3 z)) := by
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 z).open_source.mem_nhds hpsrc] with q hq
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, (chartAt E3 z).left_inv hq]
      have hmem : chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target :=
        (chartAt E3 z).map_source hpsrc
      have hd1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y))
          (chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) :=
        (hcm.contMDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hmem)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
      have hd2 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas _ _) hpsrc
      rw [heq.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp _ hd1 hd2, mfderiv_eq_fderiv, h0']
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp _
    have hzero : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F y) = 0 := by
      have hW : (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' V ∈ 𝓝 (F x) :=
        ((chartAt E3 z).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hV).mem_nhds ⟨hFU x hx, hpV⟩
      have hFc : ContinuousAt F x := hF.continuousOn.continuousAt (hs.mem_nhds hx)
      filter_upwards [hFc.preimage_mem_nhds hW, hs.mem_nhds hx] with y hy hys
      have h1 : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F y) ∈ V ∩ Sig := ⟨hy.2, (hFx y hys).2.1⟩
      rw [hVS] at h1
      exact h1.2
    exact (gs_levelset_param _ F _ _ hs x hx hF (hinj x hx) hGsymm (hGpos _ (hFU x hx)) hf2 hdf'
      hzero).2
  
  have hH : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, gsMeanCurv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hpsrc : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source :=
      (chartAt E3 z).map_target (hFU x hx)
    obtain ⟨V, f, hVO, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hVS, hHf, -, -⟩ :=
      hSig.2 _ (hFx x hx).2.1 _ ((chartAt E3 z).open_source.mem_nhds hpsrc)
    have hf0 : f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = 0 := by
      have h1 : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ V ∩ Sig := ⟨hpV, (hFx x hx).2.1⟩
      rw [hVS] at h1
      exact h1.2
    have hlmc := hHf _ hpV hf0
    let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 z).symm.toPartialEquiv
        open_source := (chartAt E3 z).open_target
        open_target := (chartAt E3 z).open_source
        contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
        contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
    have hc := levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φ f (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) hf (F x)
      (hFU x hx) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
    have hΦ : (Φ : E3 → M) (F x) = (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) := rfl
    rw [hΦ, hlmc] at hc
    exact (hkey x hx V f hVo hpV hVO hf hdf hVS).1 hc.symm
  
  intro x hx
  have hgauss := gs_gauss_equation _ _ hU hGs hGsymm hGpos F _ hs hF hFU hinj x hx
  rw [hH x hx] at hgauss
  have hdetpos : 0 < (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x).det :=
    (hhpos x hx).det_pos
  have hdet : (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x).det =
      pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 0 0 *
        pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 1 1 -
      pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 0 1 ^ 2 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hhsymm x hx 1 0]
    ring
  have hb := hamb (F x) (hFB x hx) (gsTan F 0 x) (gsTan F 1 x)
  change |gsAmbPlane (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x| ≤
      K₀ * (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 0 0 *
        pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 1 1 -
      pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x 0 1 ^ 2) at hb
  rw [← hdet] at hb
  have hA : |gsAmbPlane (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x /
      (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x).det| ≤ K₀ := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hdetpos, div_le_iff₀ hdetpos]
    exact hb
  obtain ⟨-, hA2⟩ := abs_le.mp hA
  have hax := ha0 x hx
  rw [hgauss]
  linarith

    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :

subgoal_signatures.name: levelMeanCurv_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ x) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) h x

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_levelset_param
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (f : E3 → ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f (F x)) (hdf : fderiv ℝ f (F x) ≠ 0) (hzero : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f (F y) = 0) : secondFundSq G f (F x) = gsSffSq G F x ∧ (levelMeanCurvCoord G f (F x) = 0 ↔ gsMeanCurv G F x = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullMetric2 G F x i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j = pullMetric2 G F x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, (pullMetric2 G F x).PosDef) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSff G F i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsSff G F i j x = gsSff G F j i x) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSffSq G F) s ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ gsSffSq G F x)

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_gauss_equation
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 G F) x = gsAmbPlane G F x / (pullMetric2 G F x).det + (gsMeanCurv G F x ^ 2 - gsSffSq G F x) / 2

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_amb_plane_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (B : Set E3) (hB : IsCompact B) (hBU : B ⊆ U) : ∃ K₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ K₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ B, ∀ X Y : E3, |∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, G y m l * riemannLocal G l i j k y * X i * Y j * Y k * X m| ≤ K₀ * ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * G y a b * X b) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y a * G y a b * Y b) - (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * G y a b * Y b) ^ 2)

signature.name: normal_form_posDef_extends
signature.statement: (k ρ : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hkρ : Real.sqrt k * ρ ≤ 1) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hsymm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), h x i j = h x j i) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (hK : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) s, (h x).PosDef) → ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) s, gaussCurv2 h x ≤ k) : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (h x).PosDef

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have h0 : h 0 = 1 := normal_form_center_eq_one ρ hρ h hs hnf
  
  have hPiff : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ,
      y ∈ {x : E2 | x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∧ 0 < h x 0 0 ∧ 0 < (h x).det} ↔
        (h y).PosDef := by
    intro y hy
    rw [posDef_two_iff (h y) (hsymm y 0 1)]
    exact ⟨fun hP => hP.2, fun hP => ⟨hy, hP⟩⟩
  have hc : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) :=
    fun i j => (hs i j).continuousOn
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x).det) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := by
    have e : (fun x => (h x).det) = fun x => h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 := by
      funext x
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
    rw [e]
    exact ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).sub ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0))
  have hPopen : IsOpen {x : E2 | x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∧ 0 < h x 0 0 ∧ 0 < (h x).det} := by
    have h1 : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∩ (fun x => h x 0 0) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (hc 0 0).isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball isOpen_Ioi
    have h2 : IsOpen ((Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∩ (fun x => h x 0 0) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) ∩
        (fun x => (h x).det) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (hdetc.mono Set.inter_subset_left).isOpen_inter_preimage h1 isOpen_Ioi
    convert h2 using 1
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioi]
    tauto
  have hP0 : (0 : E2) ∈ {x : E2 | x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∧ 0 < h x 0 0 ∧ 0 < (h x).det} := by
    refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hρ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h0]; simp
    · rw [h0]; simp
  
  have hstep : ∀ S : ℝ, 0 < S → S < ρ →
      Metric.ball (0 : E2) S ⊆
        {x : E2 | x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∧ 0 < h x 0 0 ∧ 0 < (h x).det} →
      Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) S ⊆
        {x : E2 | x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∧ 0 < h x 0 0 ∧ 0 < (h x).det} := by
    intro S hS hSρ hBS x hx
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff] at hx
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hx with hlt | heq
    · exact hBS (mem_ball_zero_iff.2 hlt)
    have hxρ : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := mem_ball_zero_iff.2 (by rw [heq]; exact hSρ)
    rw [hPiff x hxρ]
    have hSρ' : Metric.ball (0 : E2) S ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hSρ.le
    have hPDS : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) S, (h y).PosDef :=
      fun y hy => (hPiff y (hSρ' hy)).1 (hBS hy)
    have hKS := hK S hS hSρ.le hPDS
    have hdetS : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) S, (h y).det ≠ 0 :=
      fun y hy => (hPDS y hy).det_pos.ne'
    obtain ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩ : ∃ θ : E2, ‖θ‖ = 1 ∧ x = S • θ := by
      refine ⟨S⁻¹ • x, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [norm_smul, heq, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hS, inv_mul_cancel₀ hS.ne']
      · rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hS.ne', one_smul]
    have hθsq : θ 0 ^ 2 + θ 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h1 := EuclideanSpace.norm_eq θ
      rw [hθ, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
      have h2 := congrArg (fun t => t ^ 2) h1
      simp only at h2
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)] at h2
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs] at h2
      linarith
    have hnτ : ∀ τ : ℝ, ‖τ • θ‖ = |τ| := by
      intro τ
      rw [norm_smul, hθ, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hcoord : ∀ (τ : ℝ) (i : Fin 2), (τ • θ) i = τ * θ i := by
      intro τ i
      simp [PiLp.smul_apply]
    set q : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1 ^ 2 - 2 * h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 * θ 1 +
      h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 ^ 2 with hqdef
    
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun τ : ℝ => τ • θ) (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := by
      intro τ hτ
