signature.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) : ContinuousOn (gaussCurv2 h) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ → ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, Real.sqrt (h x).det = Real.pi * r ^ 2 - (1 / 2) * ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * Real.sqrt (h x).det

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsym : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x j i = h x i j := by
    intro x hx i j
    have := (hnf x hx).1.isHermitian.apply i j
    simpa using this
  have hdetpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, 0 < (h x).det := fun x hx => (hnf x hx).1.det_pos
  
  have hKc : ContinuousOn (gaussCurv2 h) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
    
    have hU : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hpdS : ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w (Metric.ball 0 ρ) → ∀ i : Fin 2,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 i w) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
      intro w hw i
      have hf := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hw).2
      exact hf.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x).det) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
      have e : (fun x => (h x).det) = fun x => h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 := by
        funext x
        rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
      rw [e]
      exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
    have hdi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) :=
      hd.inv (fun x hx => (hdetpos x hx).ne')
    have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x).adjugate i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
      intro i j
      have e : (fun x => (h x).adjugate i j) = fun x =>
          (!![h x 1 1, -h x 0 1; -h x 1 0, h x 0 0] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) i j := by
        funext x
        rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
      rw [e]
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
      · simpa using hh 1 1
      · simpa using (hh 0 1).neg
      · simpa using (hh 1 0).neg
      · simpa using hh 0 0
    have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
      intro i j
      refine (hdi.mul (hadj i j)).congr ?_
      intro x _
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, smul_eq_mul]
    have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
      intro k i j
      unfold christoffel2
      exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hinv k l).mul
        (((hpdS _ (hh j l) i).add (hpdS _ (hh i l) j)).sub (hpdS _ (hh i j) l)))
    have hric : ∀ j k : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ricci2 h j k) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
      intro j k
      unfold ricci2
      exact (ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => (hpdS _ (hchr i j k) i).sub (hpdS _ (hchr i i k) j)).add
        (ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun p _ =>
          ((hchr i i p).mul (hchr p j k)).sub ((hchr i j p).mul (hchr p i k)))
    have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gaussCurv2 h) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
      unfold gaussCurv2
      exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ =>
        (hinv j k).mul (hric j k))
    exact hG.continuousOn
  
  obtain ⟨h', h'def⟩ : ∃ h' : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ,
      h' = fun x => Matrix.of fun i j => (h x i j + h x j i) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have h'sym : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), h' x i j = h' x j i := by
    intro x i j
    rw [h'def]
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
    ring
  have h'eq : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, h' x = h x := by
    intro x hx
    ext i j
    rw [h'def]
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
    rw [hsym x hx i j]
    ring
  have h'smooth : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h' x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
    intro i j
    rw [h'def]
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
    exact ((hh i j).add (hh j i)).div_const 2
  have h'nf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ,
      (h' x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h' x i j * x j = x i := by
    intro x hx
    rw [h'eq x hx]
    exact hnf x hx
  have hK' : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, gaussCurv2 h' x = gaussCurv2 h x := by
    
    have hball : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hpd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ a b c : Fin 2,
        pd2 c (fun z => h' z a b) y = pd2 c (fun z => h z a b) y := by
      intro y hy a b c
      have hev : (fun z => h' z a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => h z a b) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hball.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => by simp only [h'eq z hz])
      unfold pd2
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev]
    have hchr : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ k i j : Fin 2,
        christoffel2 h' k i j y = christoffel2 h k i j y := by
      intro y hy k i j
      simp only [christoffel2, h'eq y hy, hpd y hy]
    intro x hx
    have hpdc : ∀ c k i j : Fin 2,
        pd2 c (christoffel2 h' k i j) x = pd2 c (christoffel2 h k i j) x := by
      intro c k i j
      have hev : christoffel2 h' k i j =ᶠ[𝓝 x] christoffel2 h k i j :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hball.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hchr y hy k i j)
      unfold pd2
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev]
    simp only [gaussCurv2, ricci2, h'eq x hx, hpdc, hchr x hx]
  refine ⟨hKc, ?_⟩
  intro r hr hrρ
  
  have hcl : Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) r ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hrρ
  have hc : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.closedBall 0 r) :=
    fun i j => ((hh i j).continuousOn).mono hcl
  have hu : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) r) := by
    have e : (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) =
        fun x => Real.sqrt (h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0) := by
      funext x
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
    rw [e]
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn
      (((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).sub ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0)))
  have hf2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * Real.sqrt (h x).det)
      (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) r) :=
    ((((continuous_const.sub continuous_norm).pow 2).continuousOn).mul (hKc.mono hcl)).mul hu
  
  have hθ0 : ∀ φ : ℝ, (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 : E2) 0 = Real.cos φ := by
    intro φ
    simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hθ1 : ∀ φ : ℝ, (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 : E2) 1 = Real.sin φ := by
    intro φ
    simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hθn : ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖(Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 : E2)‖ = 1 := by
    intro φ
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, hθ0, hθ1, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      sq_abs, sq_abs, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, Real.sqrt_one]
  have hsn : ∀ θ : E2, ‖θ‖ = 1 → ∀ s : ℝ, ‖s • θ‖ = |s| := by
    intro θ hθ s
    rw [norm_smul, hθ, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have h2le : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  
  have hray : ∀ φ : ℝ,
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * Real.sqrt (h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det =
        r ^ 2 / 2 - (1 / 2) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r,
          s * ((r - ‖s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)‖) ^ 2 *
            gaussCurv2 h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) *
            Real.sqrt (h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det) := by
    intro φ
    obtain ⟨θ, hθdef⟩ : ∃ θ : E2, θ = Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hθdef]
    have hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1 := hθdef ▸ hθn φ
    have hmem : ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| < ρ → τ • θ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := by
      intro τ hτ
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, hsn θ hθ τ]
      exact hτ
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ τ : ℝ, q τ = h' (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1 ^ 2 -
        2 * h' (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 * θ 1 + h' (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 ^ 2 := ⟨_, fun τ => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨R0, R1, R2, R3⟩ := normal_ray_jacobi ρ h' hρ h'smooth h'sym h'nf θ hθ q hq
    have hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ, 0 < q τ := by
      intro τ hτ
      have hτ' : |τ| < ρ := abs_lt.mpr ⟨hτ.1, hτ.2⟩
      rw [R1 τ hτ', h'eq _ (hmem τ hτ')]
      exact hdetpos _ (hmem τ hτ')
    have T := ray_taylor_identity ρ r q (fun t => gaussCurv2 h' (t • θ)) hr hrρ
      (R2.of_le h2le) hpos R0 R3
    have e1 : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * Real.sqrt (h (s • θ)).det =
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * Real.sqrt (q s) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hr.le] at hs
      have hs' : |s| < ρ := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
        linarith [hs.2]
      simp only
      rw [R1 s hs', h'eq _ (hmem s hs')]
    have e2 : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * ((r - ‖s • θ‖) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h (s • θ) *
          Real.sqrt (h (s • θ)).det) =
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, (r - s) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h' (s • θ) * (s * Real.sqrt (q s)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hr.le] at hs
      have hs' : |s| < ρ := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
        linarith [hs.2]
      simp only
      rw [R1 s hs', h'eq _ (hmem s hs'), hK' _ (hmem s hs'), hsn θ hθ s, abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
      ring
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact T
  
  have hEu : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, Real.sqrt (h x).det =
      ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r,
        s * Real.sqrt (h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det :=
    (integral_ball_polar_E2 r (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) hr hu).2
  have hP := integral_ball_polar_E2 r
    (fun x => (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) hr hf2
  have hIf : IntervalIntegrable (fun φ : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r,
      s * ((r - ‖s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)‖) ^ 2 *
        gaussCurv2 h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) *
        Real.sqrt (h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det))

  have hEf : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * Real.sqrt (h x).det =
      ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r,
        s * ((r - ‖s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)‖) ^ 2 *
          gaussCurv2 h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) *
          Real.sqrt (h (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det) := hP.2
  rw [hEu, hEf, intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun φ _ => hray φ),
    intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const (hIf.const_mul (1 / 2)),
    intervalIntegral.integral_const, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (ρ ε : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (a b : E2 → ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (ha : ContinuousOn a (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hb : ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hK : ContinuousOn (gaussCurv2 h) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hpt : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, 0 ≤ a x ∧ -(a x) / 2 - ε ≤ gaussCurv2 h x ∧ -ε ≤ b x) (hGB : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ → ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, Real.sqrt (h x).det = Real.pi * r ^ 2 - (1 / 2) * ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) (hstab : ∀ (r M : ℝ) (Ψ Θ : E2 → ℝ), 0 < r → r < ρ → ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ Ψ x) → (∀ x : E2, r ≤ ‖x‖ → Ψ x = 0) → Measurable Θ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ Θ x ∧ Θ x ≤ M) → (∀ x : E2, r ≤ ‖x‖ → Θ x = 0) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * pd2 i Ψ x * pd2 j Ψ x ≤ 4 * Ψ x * Θ x) → ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (a x + b x) * Ψ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det ≤ ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, Θ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ → 3 * ε * r ^ 2 ≤ 1 → ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, Real.sqrt (h x).det ≤ 4 * Real.pi * r ^ 2

signature.name: normal_disc_area_bound
signature.statement: (ρ ε : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (a b : E2 → ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (ha : ContinuousOn a (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hb : ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hK : ContinuousOn (gaussCurv2 h) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hpt : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, 0 ≤ a x ∧ -(a x) / 2 - ε ≤ gaussCurv2 h x ∧ -ε ≤ b x) (hGB : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ → ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, Real.sqrt (h x).det = Real.pi * r ^ 2 - (1 / 2) * ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) (hstab : ∀ (r M : ℝ) (Ψ Θ : E2 → ℝ), 0 < r → r < ρ → ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ Ψ x) → (∀ x : E2, r ≤ ‖x‖ → Ψ x = 0) → Measurable Θ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ Θ x ∧ Θ x ≤ M) → (∀ x : E2, r ≤ ‖x‖ → Θ x = 0) → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * pd2 i Ψ x * pd2 j Ψ x ≤ 4 * Ψ x * Θ x) → ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (a x + b x) * Ψ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det ≤ ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, Θ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ → 3 * ε * r ^ 2 ≤ 1 → ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, Real.sqrt (h x).det ≤ 4 * Real.pi * r ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro r hr hrρ hsmall
  have hr2 : 0 < r ^ 2 := by positivity
  
  have hP : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => (max 0 z) ^ 2) (2 * max 0 y) y := by
    intro y
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
    intro c hc
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds y hc] with z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hz
    have hb : |max 0 z ^ 2 - max 0 y ^ 2 - (z - y) * (2 * max 0 y)| ≤ (z - y) ^ 2 := by
      rcases le_total 0 z with h1 | h1 <;> rcases le_total 0 y with h2 | h2
      · rw [max_eq_right h1, max_eq_right h2, abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith
      · rw [max_eq_right h1, max_eq_left h2, abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith
      · rw [max_eq_left h1, max_eq_right h2, abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith
      · rw [max_eq_left h1, max_eq_left h2, abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, smul_eq_mul]
    calc |max 0 z ^ 2 - max 0 y ^ 2 - (z - y) * (2 * max 0 y)| ≤ (z - y) ^ 2 := hb
      _ = |z - y| * |z - y| := by rw [← sq_abs, sq]
      _ ≤ c * |z - y| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hz.le (abs_nonneg _)
  
  obtain ⟨mf, hmf⟩ : ∃ mf : ℝ → ℝ, mf = fun t => max 0 (1 - t / r ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨qf, hqf⟩ : ∃ qf : ℝ → ℝ, qf = fun t => 1 - t / r ^ 2 / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F, hFd⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, F = fun t => r ^ 2 * mf t ^ 2 * qf t ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hDd⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ → ℝ, D = fun t => -(mf t * qf t * (2 * qf t + mf t)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hF : ∀ t, HasDerivAt F (D t) t := by
    intro t
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 - t / r ^ 2) (-(1 / r ^ 2)) t :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id' t).div_const (r ^ 2)).const_sub 1
    have h2 := (hP (1 - t / r ^ 2)).comp t h1
    have h4 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 - t / r ^ 2 / 2) (-(1 / r ^ 2 / 2)) t :=
      (((hasDerivAt_id' t).div_const (r ^ 2)).div_const 2).const_sub 1
    have h5 := (h2.mul (h4.mul h4)).const_mul (r ^ 2)
    simp only [hFd, hDd, hmf, hqf]
    convert h5 using 1
    · funext s; simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Function.comp_apply]; ring
    · simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Function.comp_apply]; field_simp; ring
  have hDc : Continuous D := by
    simp only [hDd, hmf, hqf]; fun_prop
  have hFC1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 F := by
    rw [contDiff_one_iff_deriv]
    refine ⟨fun t => (hF t).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    have : deriv F = D := funext fun t => (hF t).deriv
    rw [this]; exact hDc
  have hDval : ∀ t, D t = -(max 0 (1 - t / r ^ 2) * (1 - t / r ^ 2 / 2) *
      (2 * (1 - t / r ^ 2 / 2) + max 0 (1 - t / r ^ 2))) := by
    intro t; simp only [hDd, hmf, hqf]
  
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨd⟩ : ∃ Ψ : E2 → ℝ, Ψ = fun x => F (‖x‖ ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΨC1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ := by
    rw [hΨd]; exact hFC1.comp (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ)
  have hΨfd : ∀ x : E2, HasFDerivAt Ψ (D (‖x‖ ^ 2) • (2 • innerSL ℝ x)) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hΨd]
    exact (hF (‖x‖ ^ 2)).comp_hasFDerivAt x (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq x).hasFDerivAt
  have hpd : ∀ x : E2, ∀ i : Fin 2, pd2 i Ψ x = (2 * D (‖x‖ ^ 2)) * x i := by
    intro x i
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [(hΨfd x).fderiv]
    simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right] <;> ring
  have hΨval : ∀ x : E2, Ψ x = r ^ 2 * (max 0 (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2)) ^ 2 *
      (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2 / 2) ^ 2 := by
    intro x; simp only [hΨd, hFd, hmf, hqf]
  
  have S1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → 0 ≤ r ^ 2 * (max 0 (1 - y)) ^ 2 * (1 - y / 2) ^ 2 ∧
      r ^ 2 * (max 0 (1 - y)) ^ 2 * (1 - y / 2) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by
    intro y hy
    refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    rcases le_total (1 - y) 0 with h1 | h1
    · rw [max_eq_left h1]; norm_num <;> positivity
    · rw [max_eq_right h1]
      have hp0 : 0 ≤ (1 - y) * (1 - y / 2) := mul_nonneg h1 (by linarith)
      have hp1 : (1 - y) * (1 - y / 2) ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      have hp2 : ((1 - y) * (1 - y / 2)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      calc r ^ 2 * (1 - y) ^ 2 * (1 - y / 2) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * ((1 - y) * (1 - y / 2)) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ r ^ 2 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp2 hr2.le
        _ = r ^ 2 := mul_one _
  have S2 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → r ^ 2 * (max 0 (1 - y)) ^ 2 * (1 - y / 2) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    intro y hy; rw [max_eq_left (by linarith)]; ring
  have S3 : ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 ≤ σ → σ ≤ 1 →
      r ^ 2 * (1 - σ) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 * (max 0 (1 - σ ^ 2)) ^ 2 * (1 - σ ^ 2 / 2) ^ 2 := by
    intro σ h0 h1
    have hs2 : σ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    rw [max_eq_right (by linarith)]
    have e : 1 - σ ≤ (1 - σ ^ 2) * (1 - σ ^ 2 / 2) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg h0 (sq_nonneg (1 - σ))) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + σ / 2)]
    have e' := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - σ) e 2
    calc r ^ 2 * (1 - σ) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 * ((1 - σ ^ 2) * (1 - σ ^ 2 / 2)) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e' hr2.le
      _ = r ^ 2 * (1 - σ ^ 2) ^ 2 * (1 - σ ^ 2 / 2) ^ 2 := by ring
  have S4 : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y →
      (2 * -(max 0 (1 - y) * (1 - y / 2) * (2 * (1 - y / 2) + max 0 (1 - y)))) ^ 2 * (y * r ^ 2)
        ≤ 8 * (r ^ 2 * (max 0 (1 - y)) ^ 2 * (1 - y / 2) ^ 2) := by
    intro y hy
    rcases le_total (1 - y) 0 with h1 | h1
    · rw [max_eq_left h1]; simp
    · rw [max_eq_right h1]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg ((1 - y) * (1 - y / 2) * r))
        (sq_nonneg (2 * y - 1))) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 - y)]
  
  have hΨb : ∀ x : E2, 0 ≤ Ψ x ∧ Ψ x ≤ r ^ 2 := fun x => by
    rw [hΨval]; exact S1 _ (by positivity)
  have hΨ0 : ∀ x : E2, r ≤ ‖x‖ → Ψ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx; rw [hΨval]; apply S2
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hr2, one_mul]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hr.le hx 2
  have hΨlow : ∀ x : E2, ‖x‖ ≤ r → (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 ≤ Ψ x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hΨval]
    have hσ0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ / r := by positivity
    have hσ1 : ‖x‖ / r ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hr).mpr hx
    have e1 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2 = (‖x‖ / r) ^ 2 := by rw [div_pow]
    have e2' : r - ‖x‖ = r * (1 - ‖x‖ / r) := by field_simp
    rw [e1, e2', mul_pow]; exact S3 _ hσ0 hσ1
  have hcb : ∀ x : E2, (2 * D (‖x‖ ^ 2)) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 8 * Ψ x := by
    intro x
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2 := by positivity
    have := S4 _ hy0
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hr2.ne'] at this
    rw [hDval, hΨval]; exact this
  
  have hquad : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ c : ℝ,
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * (c * x i) * (c * x j) = c ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro x hx c
    obtain ⟨hpdx, hfix⟩ := hnf x hx
    have hdet : IsUnit (h x).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpdx.det_pos.ne'
    have hv : Matrix.mulVec (h x) (fun i => x i) = (fun i => x i) := by
      funext i
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using hfix i
    have hv' : Matrix.mulVec (h x)⁻¹ (fun i => x i) = (fun i => x i) := by
      calc Matrix.mulVec (h x)⁻¹ (fun i => x i)
          = Matrix.mulVec (h x)⁻¹ (Matrix.mulVec (h x) (fun i => x i)) := by rw [hv]
        _ = (fun i => x i) := by
          rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have H0 := congrFun hv' 0
    have H1 := congrFun hv' 1
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two] at H0 H1
    have hn : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        sq_abs, sq_abs]
    rw [hn]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    linear_combination c ^ 2 * x 0 * H0 + c ^ 2 * x 1 * H1
  
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘd⟩ : ∃ Θ : E2 → ℝ, Θ = (Metric.ball (0 : E2) r).indicator (fun _ => (2 : ℝ)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΘin : ∀ x : E2, ‖x‖ < r → Θ x = 2 := by
    intro x hx; rw [hΘd]; exact Set.indicator_of_mem (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hx) _
  have hΘout : ∀ x : E2, r ≤ ‖x‖ → Θ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx; rw [hΘd]
    exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun hm => absurd (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hm) (not_lt.mpr hx)) _
  have hΘb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Θ x ∧ Θ x ≤ 2 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : ‖x‖ < r
    · rw [hΘin x hx]; norm_num
    · rw [hΘout x (not_lt.mp hx)]; norm_num
  have hmB : MeasurableSet (Metric.ball (0 : E2) r) := Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  have hmBρ : MeasurableSet (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet
  have hΘm : Measurable Θ := by rw [hΘd]; exact measurable_const.indicator hmB
  
  have hgrad : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      (h x)⁻¹ i j * pd2 i Ψ x * pd2 j Ψ x ≤ 4 * Ψ x * Θ x := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [hpd x]
    rw [hquad x hx]
    have hc := hcb x
    by_cases hxr : ‖x‖ < r
    · rw [hΘin x hxr]; linarith
    · have hrx : r ≤ ‖x‖ := not_lt.mp hxr
      have h0 := hΨ0 x hrx
      rw [hΘout x hrx, h0]
      rw [h0] at hc
      linarith
  have hS := hstab r 2 Ψ Θ hr hrρ hΨC1 (fun x => (hΨb x).1) hΨ0 hΘm hΘb hΘout hgrad
  
  have hsub : Metric.ball (0 : E2) r ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hrρ.le
  have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ \ Metric.ball 0 r, r ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    intro x hx
    have := hx.2
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, not_lt] at this
    exact this
  have e5 : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (a x + b x) * Ψ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det =
      ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, (a x + b x) * Ψ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det := by
    apply setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hmBρ hsub
    intro x hx
    rw [hΨ0 x (hdiff x hx)]; ring
  have e6 : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, Θ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det =
      2 * ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, Real.sqrt (h x).det := by
    have e6a : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, Θ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det =
        ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, Θ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det := by
      apply setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hmBρ hsub
      intro x hx
      rw [hΘout x (hdiff x hx), zero_mul]
    rw [e6a, ← integral_const_mul]
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun hmB
    intro x hx
    dsimp only
    rw [hΘin x (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hx)]
  rw [e5, e6] at hS
  
  have hu : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := by
    have hc : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) :=
      fun i j => (hh i j).continuousOn
    have e : (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) =
        fun x => Real.sqrt (h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0) := by
      funext x; rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
    rw [e]
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn
      (((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).sub ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0)))
  have hcl : Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) r ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hrρ
  have hint : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall 0 r) →
      IntegrableOn f (Metric.ball 0 r) := fun f hf =>
    (hf.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall 0 r)).mono_set Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have hucl : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) r) :=
    hu.mono hcl
  have hScl : ContinuousOn (fun x => (a x + b x) * Ψ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det)
      (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) r) :=
    (((ha.mono hcl).add (hb.mono hcl)).mul hΨC1.continuous.continuousOn).mul hucl
  have hIu := hint _ hucl
  have hIS := hint _ hScl
  have hIK : IntegrableOn
      (fun x => -(1 / 2) * ((r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * Real.sqrt (h x).det))
      (Metric.ball 0 r) :=
    hint _ (continuousOn_const.mul
      (((((continuous_const.sub continuous_norm).pow 2).continuousOn).mul (hK.mono hcl)).mul hucl))
  have hIR : IntegrableOn
      (fun x => 1 / 4 * ((a x + b x) * Ψ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) +
        (3 / 4 * ε * r ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (h x).det) (Metric.ball 0 r) :=
    hint _ ((continuousOn_const.mul hScl).add (continuousOn_const.mul hucl))
  
  have hpoint : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) r,
      -(1 / 2) * ((r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) ≤
        1 / 4 * ((a x + b x) * Ψ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) +
          (3 / 4 * ε * r ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (h x).det := by
    intro x hx
    have hxr : ‖x‖ < r := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hx
    obtain ⟨ha0, hKx, hbx⟩ := hpt x (hsub hx)
    have hu0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (h x).det := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    obtain ⟨hΨ0x, hΨr⟩ := hΨb x
    have hw : (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 ≤ Ψ x := hΨlow x hxr.le
    have hw0 : 0 ≤ (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have p1 : 0 ≤ (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (h x).det * (gaussCurv2 h x + a x / 2 + ε) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hw0 hu0) (by linarith)
    have p2 : 0 ≤ (Ψ x - (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2) * a x * Real.sqrt (h x).det :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) ha0) hu0
    have p3 : 0 ≤ (r ^ 2 - (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2) * ε * Real.sqrt (h x).det :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hε) hu0
    have p4 : 0 ≤ (b x + ε) * Ψ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hΨ0x) hu0
    have p5 : 0 ≤ ε * (r ^ 2 - Ψ x) * Real.sqrt (h x).det :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hε (by linarith)) hu0
    linarith
  have hmono := setIntegral_mono_on hIK hIR hmB hpoint
  have eL : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r,
      -(1 / 2) * ((r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) =
      -(1 / 2) * ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r,
        (r - ‖x‖) ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * Real.sqrt (h x).det :=
    integral_const_mul _ _
  have eR : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, (1 / 4 * ((a x + b x) * Ψ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) +
        (3 / 4 * ε * r ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (h x).det) =
      1 / 4 * (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, (a x + b x) * Ψ x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) +
        (3 / 4 * ε * r ^ 2) * ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, Real.sqrt (h x).det := by
    rw [integral_add (hIS.const_mul _) (hIu.const_mul _), integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  rw [eL, eR] at hmono
  have hGB' := hGB r hr hrρ
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, Real.sqrt (h x).det :=
    setIntegral_nonneg hmB (fun x _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall hA0
  nlinarith

      rw [hWdet]
      exact hQne.isUnit
    have hX : P * Gm = 1 := by
      calc P * Gm = P * Gm * (W * W⁻¹) := by
            rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv W hWu, Matrix.mul_one]
        _ = (P * Gm * W) * W⁻¹ := (Matrix.mul_assoc (P * Gm) W W⁻¹).symm
        _ = W * W⁻¹ := by rw [hXW]
        _ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv W hWu
    have hAP : A = P := by
      rw [← hAdef]
      exact Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hX
    
    have hν : ∀ i, ∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * d a = lam * n i := by
      intro i
      rw [hnent]
      simp only [hlam, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hSd : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a b * d a * d b = lam ^ 2 * Q := by
      rw [← hQdef]
      simp only [hlam, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    intro i j
    rw [hν i, hν j, hSd, hAP, hPe]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hP := projection (G (F x)) (hGsymm (F x)) hGpos (fun a k => gsTan F a x k)
    (fun k => partialDeriv k f (F x)) hN hd0 hdT
  have hof : (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin 2 => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      gsTan F a x k * G (F x) k l * gsTan F b x l) = pullMetric2 G F x := rfl
  simp only [hof] at hP
  
  have trace_cycle : ∀ (K : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (Hm : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : Fin 3 → ℝ) (S : ℝ),
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, K a b * T a i * T b j) * Hm j k *
          (∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, K c q * T c k * T q l) * Hm l i) =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, K a b * K c q *
          (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, T b j * Hm j k * T c k) *
          (∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, T q l * Hm l i * T a i) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, K a b * T a i * T b j) * Hm i j) =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, K a b * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, T a i * Hm i j * T b j) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (A i j - (∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * d a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, A j b * d b) / S) * Hm i j) =
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * Hm i j) -
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            A i a * d a * (A j b * d b) * Hm i j) / S := by
    intro K T Hm A d S
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
  obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := trace_cycle (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ (fun a k => gsTan F a x k)
    (fun j k => hessLoc G f j k (F x)) (G (F x))⁻¹ (fun k => partialDeriv k f (F x))
    (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f (F x) * partialDeriv b f (F x))
  beta_reduce at c1 c2 c3
  
  have hNN : 0 < gsCrossN F x 0 ^ 2 + gsCrossN F x 1 ^ 2 + gsCrossN F x 2 ^ 2 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    apply hN
    have h0 : gsCrossN F x 0 ^ 2 = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (gsCrossN F x 0), sq_nonneg (gsCrossN F x 1), sq_nonneg (gsCrossN F x 2)]
    have h1 : gsCrossN F x 1 ^ 2 = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (gsCrossN F x 0), sq_nonneg (gsCrossN F x 1), sq_nonneg (gsCrossN F x 2)]
    have h2 : gsCrossN F x 2 ^ 2 = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (gsCrossN F x 0), sq_nonneg (gsCrossN F x 1), sq_nonneg (gsCrossN F x 2)]
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · exact pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp h0
    · exact pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp h1
    · exact pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp h2
  have alg : ∀ u0 u1 u2 v0 v1 v2 d0 d1 d2 : ℝ, d0 * u0 + d1 * u1 + d2 * u2 = 0 →
      d0 * v0 + d1 * v1 + d2 * v2 = 0 →
      d0 * ((u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) ^ 2 + (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) ^ 2 + (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) ^ 2) =
          (d0 * (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) + d1 * (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) + d2 * (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0)) *
            (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) ∧
      d1 * ((u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) ^ 2 + (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) ^ 2 + (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) ^ 2) =
          (d0 * (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) + d1 * (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) + d2 * (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0)) *
            (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) ∧
      d2 * ((u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) ^ 2 + (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) ^ 2 + (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) ^ 2) =
          (d0 * (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) + d1 * (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) + d2 * (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0)) *
            (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) := by
    intro u0 u1 u2 v0 v1 v2 d0 d1 d2 h0 h1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · linear_combination ((u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) * u2 - (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) * u1) * h1
        - ((u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) * v2 - (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) * v1) * h0
    · linear_combination ((u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) * u0 - (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) * u2) * h1
        - ((u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) * v0 - (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) * v2) * h0
    · linear_combination ((u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) * u1 - (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) * u0) * h1
        - ((u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) * v1 - (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) * v0) * h0
  have hT0 := hdT 0
  have hT1 := hdT 1
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hT0 hT1
  obtain ⟨k0, k1, k2⟩ := alg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hT0 hT1
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ : ∃ lam : ℝ, ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k f (F x) = lam * gsCrossN F x k := by
    refine ⟨(partialDeriv 0 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 0 + partialDeriv 1 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 1
      + partialDeriv 2 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 2) /
        (gsCrossN F x 0 ^ 2 + gsCrossN F x 1 ^ 2 + gsCrossN F x 2 ^ 2), ?_⟩
    have k0' : partialDeriv 0 f (F x) *
        (gsCrossN F x 0 ^ 2 + gsCrossN F x 1 ^ 2 + gsCrossN F x 2 ^ 2) =
        (partialDeriv 0 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 0 + partialDeriv 1 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 1
          + partialDeriv 2 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 2) * gsCrossN F x 0 := k0
    have k1' : partialDeriv 1 f (F x) *
        (gsCrossN F x 0 ^ 2 + gsCrossN F x 1 ^ 2 + gsCrossN F x 2 ^ 2) =
        (partialDeriv 0 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 0 + partialDeriv 1 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 1
          + partialDeriv 2 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 2) * gsCrossN F x 1 := k1
    have k2' : partialDeriv 2 f (F x) *
        (gsCrossN F x 0 ^ 2 + gsCrossN F x 1 ^ 2 + gsCrossN F x 2 ^ 2) =
        (partialDeriv 0 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 0 + partialDeriv 1 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 1
          + partialDeriv 2 f (F x) * gsCrossN F x 2) * gsCrossN F x 2 := k2
    intro k
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hNN.ne']
    fin_cases k
    · exact k0'
    · exact k1'
    · exact k2'
  have hlam0 : lam ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hd0
    funext k
    show partialDeriv k f (F x) = 0
    rw [hlam k, h, zero_mul]
  
  have hnLpos : 0 < gsNormLen G F x := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hQ
  have hnL2 : gsNormLen G F x ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l :=
    Real.sq_sqrt hQ.le
  have hlnL : lam * gsNormLen G F x ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hlam0 hnLpos.ne'
  have hS : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G (F x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f (F x) * partialDeriv b f (F x)) =
      (lam * gsNormLen G F x) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, hnL2]
    simp only [hlam, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hSpos : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G (F x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f (F x) * partialDeriv b f (F x) := by
    rw [hS]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg _) (pow_ne_zero 2 hlnL).symm
  
  have hΓ : ∀ m p n : Fin 3, christoffel G m p n (F x) = christoffel G m n p (F x) := by
    intro m p n
    have e1 : (fun z => G z n p) = (fun z => G z p n) := funext fun z => hGsymm z n p
    unfold christoffel
    rw [e1]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l _
    ring
  have h10 : ∀ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k 1 0 (F x) = christoffel G k 0 1 (F x) :=
    fun k => hΓ k 1 0
  have h20 : ∀ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k 2 0 (F x) = christoffel G k 0 2 (F x) :=
    fun k => hΓ k 2 0
  have h21 : ∀ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k 2 1 (F x) = christoffel G k 1 2 (F x) :=
    fun k => hΓ k 2 1
  have hIIsymm : ∀ b c : Fin 2, gsSff G F b c x = gsSff G F c b x := by
    intro b c
    unfold gsSff gsCovHess
    rw [hHsymm b c]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, h10, h20, h21]
    ring
  have hhm : (pullMetric2 G F x).transpose = pullMetric2 G F x := by
    ext a b
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, pullMetric2]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l _
    rw [hGsymm (F x) l k]
    ring
  have hKsymm : ∀ a b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a b = (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ b a := by
    intro a b
    have h := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv (pullMetric2 G F x)) a) b
    rw [hhm, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h
    exact h.symm
  
  have hHt : ∀ b c : Fin 2, (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
      gsTan F b x j * hessLoc G f j k (F x) * gsTan F c x k) =
      -(lam * gsNormLen G F x) * gsSff G F b c x := by
    intro b c
    have hII : gsSff G F b c x * gsNormLen G F x =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k * gsCovHess G F b c x k := by
      unfold gsSff
      exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hnLpos.ne'
    have hc := hchain b c
    simp only [hessLoc, gsCovHess, hlam, Fin.sum_univ_three] at hII hc ⊢
    linear_combination hc + lam * hII
  
  have h1 : secondFundSq G f (F x) = gsSffSq G F x := by
    unfold secondFundSq
    simp only [hP]
    rw [c1]
    simp only [hHt]
    rw [hS]
    unfold gsSffSq gsInner
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hKsymm 1 0, hIIsymm 1 0]
    rw [div_eq_iff (pow_ne_zero 2 hlnL)]
    ring
  
  have hXY : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * hessLoc G f i j (F x)) -
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G (F x))⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a f (F x) *
          ((G (F x))⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b f (F x)) * hessLoc G f i j (F x)) /
      (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G (F x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f (F x) * partialDeriv b f (F x)) =
      -(lam * gsNormLen G F x) * gsMeanCurv G F x := by
    rw [← c3]
    simp only [hP]
    rw [c2]
    simp only [hHt]
    unfold gsMeanCurv gsTrace
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have alg2 : ∀ X Y S r : ℝ, 0 < S → 0 < r → r ^ 2 = S →
      X / r - Y / r ^ 3 = (X - Y / S) / r := by
    intro X Y S r hS0 hr0 hr2
    have hrne : r ≠ 0 := hr0.ne'
    rw [← hr2]
    field_simp
  have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G (F x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f (F x) * partialDeriv b f (F x)) :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 hSpos
  have hlmc : levelMeanCurvCoord G f (F x) =
      -(lam * gsNormLen G F x) * gsMeanCurv G F x /
        Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G (F x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f (F x) * partialDeriv b f (F x)) := by
    rw [← hXY]
    unfold levelMeanCurvCoord lapLoc
    exact alg2 _ _ _ _ hSpos hr (Real.sq_sqrt hSpos.le)
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  rw [hlmc, div_eq_zero_iff, mul_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · rintro ((h | h) | h)
    · exact absurd h (neg_ne_zero.mpr hlnL)
    · exact h
    · exact absurd h hr.ne'
  · intro h
    exact Or.inl (Or.inr h)

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullMetric2 G F x i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j = pullMetric2 G F x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, (pullMetric2 G F x).PosDef) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSff G F i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsSff G F i j x = gsSff G F j i x) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSffSq G F) s ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ gsSffSq G F x)

signature.name: gs_regularity
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullMetric2 G F x i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j = pullMetric2 G F x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, (pullMetric2 G F x).PosDef) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSff G F i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsSff G F i j x = gsSff G F j i x) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSffSq G F) s ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ gsSffSq G F x)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hFU' : Set.MapsTo F s U := fun x hx => hFU x hx
  
  have hpdv : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) U := by
    intro f hf i
    have hD := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf).2
    exact hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdet3 : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) U := by
    intro H hH
    have t1 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 0)
    exact (((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6).congr
      (fun y _ => Matrix.det_fin_three (H y))
  have hdetU : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hGpos y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hGi : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) U := by
    intro k l
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := hdet3 G hG
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det) U := by
      apply hdet3
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = l
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hG a b
    refine ((h1.inv hdetU).mul h2).congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have hdG : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b)) U :=
    fun m a b => hpdv _ (hG a b) m
  have hΓU : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
      (hGi k l).mul (((hdG i j l).add (hdG j i l)).sub (hdG l i j)))
  
  have hΓsym : ∀ (z : E3) (k i j : Fin 3), christoffel G k i j z = christoffel G k j i z := by
    intro z k i j
    have hf : (fun w => G w j i) = (fun w => G w i j) := funext fun w => hGsymm w j i
    unfold christoffel
    rw [hf]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    ring
  
  have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) s := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 hF).2
  have hT : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) s := fun j =>
    hD.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : E2 => e2 j) s)
  have htan : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (k : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => gsTan F i x k) s := by
    intro i k
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hT i)).congr
      (fun x _ => rfl)
  have hT2 : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 j))) s :=
    fun j => ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 (hT j)).2
  have hhess : ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (k : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => gsHessF F i j x k) s := by
    intro i j k
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn
      ((hT2 j).clm_apply (contDiffOn_const : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : E2 => e2 i) s))).congr
      (fun x _ => rfl)
  
  have hHsym : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsHessF F i j x = gsHessF F j i x := by
    intro x hx i j
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F x := hF.contDiffAt (hs.mem_nhds hx)
    have h2' : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
    have h2 : minSmoothness ℝ 2 ≤ ∞ := by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      exact h2'
    have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ F x := hc.isSymmSndFDerivAt h2
    have h12 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ∞ := by
      rw [one_add_one_eq_two]
      exact h2'
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x :=
      (hc.fderiv_right (m := 1) h12).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have key : ∀ a b : Fin 2, gsHessF F a b x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x (e2 a) (e2 b) := by
      intro a b
      have h3 := fderiv_clm_apply (c := fderiv ℝ F) (u := fun _ : E2 => e2 b) hd
        (differentiableAt_const (e2 b))
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 b)) x (e2 a) = _
      rw [h3]
      simp
    rw [key i j, key j i]
    exact hsym.eq (e2 i) (e2 j)
  
  have crossNe : ∀ (D : E2 →L[ℝ] E3), Function.Injective D →
      ¬ (D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 2 - D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 1 = 0 ∧
         D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 0 - D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 2 = 0 ∧
         D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 1 - D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 0 = 0) := by
    intro D hDi hN
    obtain ⟨n0, n1, n2⟩ := hN
    have hb : D (e2 1) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have h1 : e2 1 = 0 := hDi (by rw [h0, map_zero])
      have h2 := congrArg (fun v : E2 => v 1) h1
      simp at h2
    apply hb
    have c0 : ∀ m : Fin 3,
        ((D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) •
          D (e2 0) - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
            D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) • D (e2 1)) m = (0 : E3) m := by
      have key : ∀ m : Fin 3,
          ((D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) •
            D (e2 0) - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) • D (e2 1)) m =
          (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) m - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) m := by
        intro m
        simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have k0 : (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) 0 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) 0 = 0 := by
        linear_combination (D (e2 1) 1) * n2 - (D (e2 1) 2) * n1
      have k1 : (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) 1 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) 1 = 0 := by
        linear_combination (D (e2 1) 2) * n0 - (D (e2 1) 0) * n2
      have k2 : (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) 2 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) 2 = 0 := by
        linear_combination (D (e2 1) 0) * n1 - (D (e2 1) 1) * n0
      intro m
      rw [key m, PiLp.zero_apply]
      fin_cases m
      · exact k0
      · exact k1
      · exact k2
    have hv : D ((D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) •
          e2 0 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
            D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) • e2 1) = D 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, map_zero]
      exact PiLp.ext c0
    have hv0 := congrArg (fun v : E2 => v 0) (hDi hv)
    simp at hv0
    have s0 := sq_nonneg (D (e2 1) 0)
    have s1 := sq_nonneg (D (e2 1) 1)
    have s2 := sq_nonneg (D (e2 1) 2)
    have z0 : D (e2 1) 0 = 0 := by nlinarith
    have z1 : D (e2 1) 1 = 0 := by nlinarith
    have z2 : D (e2 1) 2 = 0 := by nlinarith
    refine PiLp.ext fun m => ?_
    fin_cases m
    · simpa using z0
    · simpa using z1
    · simpa using z2
  have hq : ∀ x ∈ s,
      0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l := by
    intro x hx
    have hNne : gsCrossN F x ≠ 0 := by
      intro hN0
      apply crossNe (fderiv ℝ F x) (hinj x hx)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [gsCrossN, gsTan] using congrFun hN0 0
      · simpa [gsCrossN, gsTan] using congrFun hN0 1
      · simpa [gsCrossN, gsTan] using congrFun hN0 2
    have hpos := (hGpos (F x) (hFU x hx)).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hNne
    have e : dotProduct (star (gsCrossN F x)) (Matrix.mulVec (G (F x))⁻¹ (gsCrossN F x)) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial]
      ring
    rw [← e]
    exact hpos
  
  have hGF : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G (F x) k l) s :=
    fun k l => (hG k l).comp hF hFU'
  have hinvF : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (G (F x))⁻¹ k l) s :=
    fun k l => (hGi k l).comp hF hFU'
  have hchrF : ∀ k m n : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => christoffel G k m n (F x)) s :=
    fun k m n => (hΓU k m n).comp hF hFU'
  have hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullMetric2 G F x i j) s := fun i j =>
    (ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
      ((htan i k).mul (hGF k l)).mul (htan j l)).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
  have hhsym : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j = pullMetric2 G F x j i := by
    intro x _ i j
    simp only [pullMetric2]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    rw [hGsymm (F x) l k]
    ring
  have hPD : ∀ x ∈ s, (pullMetric2 G F x).PosDef := by
    intro x hx
    let J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) ℝ := Matrix.of fun k i => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) k
    have hvec : ∀ (u : Fin 2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 3),
        (fderiv ℝ F x (u 0 • e2 0 + u 1 • e2 1)) k = (J.mulVec u) k := by
      intro u k
      simp only [J, map_add, map_smul, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.of_apply]
      ring
    have hJ : Function.Injective J.mulVec := by
      intro v w hvw
      have h1 : fderiv ℝ F x (v 0 • e2 0 + v 1 • e2 1) =
          fderiv ℝ F x (w 0 • e2 0 + w 1 • e2 1) :=
        PiLp.ext fun k => by rw [hvec v k, hvec w k, hvw]
      have h2 := hinj x hx h1
      funext i
      have h3 := congrArg (fun z : E2 => z i) h2
      fin_cases i
      · simpa using h3
      · simpa using h3
    have heq : pullMetric2 G F x = J.conjTranspose * G (F x) * J := by
      ext i j
      simp only [pullMetric2, J, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.of_apply,
        star_trivial, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    exact (hGpos (F x) (hFU x hx)).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hJ
  
  have hN : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => gsCrossN F x k) s := by
    intro k
    fin_cases k
    · exact (((htan 0 1).mul (htan 1 2)).sub ((htan 0 2).mul (htan 1 1))).congr
        (fun x _ => rfl)
    · exact (((htan 0 2).mul (htan 1 0)).sub ((htan 0 0).mul (htan 1 2))).congr
        (fun x _ => rfl)
    · exact (((htan 0 0).mul (htan 1 1)).sub ((htan 0 1).mul (htan 1 0))).congr
        (fun x _ => rfl)
  have hCov : ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (k : Fin 3),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => gsCovHess G F i j x k) s := fun i j k =>
    ((hhess i j k).add (ContDiffOn.sum fun m _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun n _ =>
      ((hchrF k m n).mul (htan i m)).mul (htan j n))).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
  have hQ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l) s :=
    ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => ((hinvF k l).mul (hN k)).mul (hN l)
  have hLen : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsNormLen G F) s :=
    (hQ.sqrt (fun x hx => (hq x hx).ne')).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
  have hLen0 : ∀ x ∈ s, gsNormLen G F x ≠ 0 := fun x hx => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hq x hx)).ne'
  have hII : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSff G F i j) s := fun i j =>
    ((ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hN k).mul (hCov i j k)).div hLen hLen0).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
  
  have hIIsym : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsSff G F i j x = gsSff G F j i x := by
    intro x hx i j
    have hc : ∀ k : Fin 3, gsCovHess G F i j x k = gsCovHess G F j i x k := by
      intro k
      simp only [gsCovHess]
      rw [hHsym x hx i j]
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      rw [hΓsym (F x) k n m]
      ring
    unfold gsSff
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by rw [hc k]
  
  have hhinv : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a b) s := by
    have hdet : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < (pullMetric2 G F x).det := fun x hx => (hPD x hx).det_pos
    have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (pullMetric2 G F x).det) s :=
      (((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))).congr
        (fun x _ => Matrix.det_fin_two _)
    have hDi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ((pullMetric2 G F x).det)⁻¹) s :=
      hdetS.inv (fun x hx => (hdet x hx).ne')
    intro a b
    have e : (fun x => (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a b) =
        fun x => ((pullMetric2 G F x).det)⁻¹ * (pullMetric2 G F x).adjugate a b := by
      funext x
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    rw [e]
    refine hDi.mul ?_
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b
    · refine (hh 1 1).congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp
    · refine (hh 0 1).neg.congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp
    · refine (hh 1 0).neg.congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp
    · refine (hh 0 0).congr (fun x _ => ?_)
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; simp
  have hSq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSffSq G F) s := by
    have h : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ i a * (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ j b * gsSff G F i j x *
          gsSff G F a b x) s :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ =>
        ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ =>
          (((hhinv i a).mul (hhinv j b)).mul (hII i j)).mul (hII a b)
    exact h.congr (fun x _ => rfl)
  have inner2 : ∀ (P S : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ), P.PosDef → S 0 1 = S 1 0 →
      0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        P i a * P j b * S i j * S a b := by
    intro P S hP hS
    have hq10 : P 1 0 = P 0 1 := by
      have := hP.isHermitian.apply 0 1
      simpa using this
    have hp : 0 < P 0 0 := hP.diag_pos
    have hDp : 0 < P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 0 1 := by
      have := hP.det_pos
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hq10] at this
      exact this
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hq10, ← hS]
    have hX : 0 ≤ (S 0 0 * P 0 0 ^ 2 + 2 * S 0 1 * P 0 0 * P 0 1 + S 1 1 * P 0 1 ^ 2) ^ 2 +
        2 * (P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 0 1) * (S 0 1 * P 0 0 + S 1 1 * P 0 1) ^ 2 +
        (S 1 1 * (P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 0 1)) ^ 2 :=
      add_nonneg (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hDp.le) (sq_nonneg _))) (sq_nonneg _)
    refine (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left (pow_pos hp 2)).mp ?_
    nlinarith [hX]
  have hSqnn : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ gsSffSq G F x := fun x hx =>
    inner2 _ (fun i j => gsSff G F i j x) (hPD x hx).inv (hIIsym x hx 0 1)
  exact ⟨hh, hhsym, hPD, hII, hIIsym, hSq, hSqnn⟩

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 G F) x = gsAmbPlane G F x / (pullMetric2 G F x).det + (gsMeanCurv G F x ^ 2 - gsSffSq G F x) / 2

signature.name: gs_gauss_equation
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 G F) x = gsAmbPlane G F x / (pullMetric2 G F x).det + (gsMeanCurv G F x ^ 2 - gsSffSq G F x) / 2

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨hh, hhsymm, hhpos, -, hSsymm, -, -⟩ :=
    gs_regularity G U hU hG hGsymm hGpos F s hs hF hFU hinj
  have hdetpos : 0 < (pullMetric2 G F x).det := (hhpos x hx).det_pos
  have hdet : (pullMetric2 G F x).det ≠ 0 := hdetpos.ne'
  have hGx : (G (F x)).PosDef := hGpos (F x) (hFU x hx)
  
  have hint := gge_gauss_intrinsic (pullMetric2 G F) s hs hh hhsymm hhpos x hx
  
  have hkos := gge_koszul_tangent G U hU hG hGsymm hGpos F s hs hF hFU
  
  have hder := gge_koszul_deriv G U hU hG hGpos F s hs hF hFU x hx
  have hdΓ1 : ∀ k m i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) m i j) x =
      pd2 k (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        gsTan F m z a * G (F z) a b * gsCovHess G F i j z b) x := by
    intro k m i j
    have hev : ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) m i j =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        gsTan F m z a * G (F z) a b * gsCovHess G F i j z b) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hx) (fun z hz => hkos z hz m i j)
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  
  have hcl : ∀ {W : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℝ W] (c : E2 → E2 →L[ℝ] W)
      (u v : E2), DifferentiableAt ℝ c x → fderiv ℝ (fun z => c z u) x v = fderiv ℝ c x v u := by
    intro W _ _ c u v hc
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply hc (differentiableAt_const _)]
    simp
  have hs4 : (∀ i j : Fin 2, gsHessF F i j x = gsHessF F j i x) ∧
      ∀ (k i j : Fin 2) (b : Fin 3), pd2 k (fun z => gsHessF F i j z b) x =
        pd2 i (fun z => gsHessF F k j z b) x := by
    have hFat : ∀ z ∈ s, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F z := fun z hz => hF.contDiffAt (hs.mem_nhds hz)
    have hD1at : ∀ z ∈ s, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) z :=
      fun z hz => (hFat z hz).fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)
    have hD2at : ∀ z ∈ s, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F)) z :=
      fun z hz => (hD1at z hz).fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)
    have hH : ∀ z ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2,
        gsHessF F i j z = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z (e2 i) (e2 j) := by
      intro z hz i j
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z := (hD1at z hz).differentiableAt (by simp)
      unfold gsHessF
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    have hsymF : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ F x :=
      (hFat x hx).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp <;> norm_cast)
    have hsymD1 : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x :=
      (hD1at x hx).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp <;> norm_cast)
    have hD2d : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F)) x :=
      (hD2at x hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hT3 : ∀ (k i j : Fin 2) (b : Fin 3), pd2 k (fun z => gsHessF F i j z b) x =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F)) x (e2 k) (e2 i) (e2 j) b := by
      intro k i j b
      have hev : (fun z => gsHessF F i j z b) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z (e2 i) (e2 j) b) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hx) (fun z hz => by dsimp only; rw [hH z hz i j])
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      have hL : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z (e2 i) (e2 j)) x :=
        (hD2d.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)).clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)
      have hproj : (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z (e2 i) (e2 j) b) =
          (EuclideanSpace.proj b : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘
            (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z (e2 i) (e2 j)) := by
        funext z; rfl
      rw [hproj, fderiv_comp x (EuclideanSpace.proj b).differentiableAt hL,
        ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      have e1 := hcl (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z (e2 i)) (e2 j) (e2 k)
        (hD2d.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _))
      have e2' := hcl (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F)) (e2 i) (e2 k) hD2d
      rw [e1, e2']
      rfl
    refine ⟨fun i j => ?_, fun k i j b => ?_⟩
    · rw [hH x hx i j, hH x hx j i]
      exact hsymF (e2 i) (e2 j)
    · rw [hT3 k i j b, hT3 i k j b, hsymD1 (e2 k) (e2 i)]
  obtain ⟨hA, hT⟩ := hs4
  
  have hsplit : ∀ k m i j : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
      G (F x) c d * gsCovHess G F k m x c * gsCovHess G F i j x d =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a b *
        ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) a k m x * ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) b i j x +
      gsSff G F k m x * gsSff G F i j x := by
    intro k m i j
    have h5 := gge_normal_split G F x hGsymm hGx (hinj x hx)
      (fun c => gsCovHess G F k m x c) (fun d => gsCovHess G F i j x d)
    simp only [← hkos x hx] at h5
    rw [h5]
    congr 1
    simp only [gsSff]
    rw [div_mul_div_comm, sq]
  
  have hΓ2 : ∀ l i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) l i j x =
      ∑ q : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ l q * ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) q i j x := by
    intro l i j
    simp only [christoffel2, ggeGam1, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro q _
    ring
  have hGi : G (F x) * (G (F x))⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G (F x)) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hGx.det_pos.ne')
  have hdG : ∀ r a b : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun y => G y a b) (F x) =
      partialDeriv r (fun y => G y b a) (F x) := by
    intro r a b
    have : (fun y => G y a b) = (fun y => G y b a) := funext fun y => hGsymm y a b
    rw [this]

      have h1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
          A i j k m * u i * v j * w k * w m = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
          ∑ m : Fin 3, A i j m k * u i * v j * w m * w k :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Finset.sum_comm
      have h2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
          A i j m k * u i * v j * w m * w k = -∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
          ∑ m : Fin 3, A i j k m * u i * v j * w k * w m := by
        simp only [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
        rw [hA2 i j m k]
        ring
      linarith
    have shift : ∀ c : ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        A i j k m * X i * (Y - c • X) j * (Y - c • X) k * X m =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
          A i j k m * X i * Y j * Y k * X m := by
      intro c
      have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
          A i j k m * X i * (Y - c • X) j * (Y - c • X) k * X m =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
            A i j k m * X i * Y j * Y k * X m
          - c * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
            A i j k m * X i * X j * Y k * X m)
          - c * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
            A i j k m * X i * Y j * X k * X m)
          + c ^ 2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
            A i j k m * X i * X j * X k * X m) := by
        simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [e1, V1 X Y X, V2 X Y X, V1 X X X]
      ring
    have crude : ∀ u v : E3, |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        A i j k m * u i * v j * v k * u m| ≤
        M * (∑ i : Fin 3, |u i|) ^ 2 * (∑ j : Fin 3, |v j|) ^ 2 := by
      intro u v
      calc _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
            |A i j k m * u i * v j * v k * u m| := by
            refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
            refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_)
            refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_)
            exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
            M * (|u i| * |v j| * |v k| * |u m|) := by
            refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ =>
              Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => ?_
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul]
            have h0 : 0 ≤ |u i| * |v j| * |v k| * |u m| := by positivity
            calc |A i j k m| * |u i| * |v j| * |v k| * |u m|
                = |A i j k m| * (|u i| * |v j| * |v k| * |u m|) := by ring
              _ ≤ M * (|u i| * |v j| * |v k| * |u m|) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hAM i j k m) h0
        _ = M * (∑ i : Fin 3, |u i|) ^ 2 * (∑ j : Fin 3, |v j|) ^ 2 := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
            ring
    have hsq : ∀ u : E3, (∑ i : Fin 3, |u i|) ^ 2 ≤ 3 * ∑ i : Fin 3, u i ^ 2 := by
      intro u
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      have h0 := sq_abs (u 0)
      have h1 := sq_abs (u 1)
      have h2 := sq_abs (u 2)
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|u 0| - |u 1|), sq_nonneg (|u 1| - |u 2|),
        sq_nonneg (|u 0| - |u 2|)]
    have hN0 : ∀ u : E3, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, u i ^ 2 := fun u =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
    have hcX := hcoerP X
    by_cases ha : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * P a b * X b) = 0
    · 
      have hNX : ∑ i : Fin 3, X i ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
        rw [ha] at hcX
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        have := mul_pos hμ hcon
        linarith
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hNX
      have e0 : X 0 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.1
        (le_antisymm (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X 0), sq_nonneg (X 1), sq_nonneg (X 2)])
          (sq_nonneg _))
      have e1 : X 1 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.1
        (le_antisymm (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X 0), sq_nonneg (X 1), sq_nonneg (X 2)])
          (sq_nonneg _))
      have e2 : X 2 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.1
        (le_antisymm (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X 0), sq_nonneg (X 1), sq_nonneg (X 2)])
          (sq_nonneg _))
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, e0, e1, e2]
    · have hapos : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * P a b * X b := by
        have := mul_nonneg hμ.le (hN0 X)
        exact lt_of_le_of_ne (by linarith) (Ne.symm ha)
      set qa := ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * P a b * X b with hqa
      set qb := ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * P a b * Y b with hqb
      set qd := ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y a * P a b * Y b with hqd
      have hBexp : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (Y - (qb / qa) • X) a * P a b *
          (Y - (qb / qa) • X) b = qd - (qb / qa) * qb
            - (qb / qa) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y a * P a b * X b)
            + (qb / qa) ^ 2 * qa := by
        simp only [hqa, hqb, hqd, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      have hsym : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y a * P a b * X b = qb := by
        simp only [hqb, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        rw [hP 1 0, hP 2 0, hP 2 1]
        ring
      have hgram : qa * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (Y - (qb / qa) • X) a * P a b *
          (Y - (qb / qa) • X) b) = qa * qd - qb ^ 2 := by
        rw [hBexp, hsym]
        field_simp
        ring
      set Y' := Y - (qb / qa) • X with hY'
      set Bp := ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y' a * P a b * Y' b with hBp
      have hcY := hcoerP Y'
      have hS := shift (qb / qa)
      rw [← hS]
      have hc := crude X Y'
      have hs1 := hsq X
      have hs2 := hsq Y'
      have hs1n : 0 ≤ (∑ i : Fin 3, |X i|) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have hs2n : 0 ≤ (∑ i : Fin 3, |Y' i|) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have hNY := hN0 Y'
      have hNX := hN0 X
      have e1 : μ * (∑ i : Fin 3, |X i|) ^ 2 ≤ 3 * qa := by nlinarith
      have e2 : μ * (∑ i : Fin 3, |Y' i|) ^ 2 ≤ 3 * Bp := by nlinarith
      have e3 : μ ^ 2 * ((∑ i : Fin 3, |X i|) ^ 2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, |Y' i|) ^ 2) ≤
          9 * (qa * Bp) := by
        have := mul_le_mul e1 e2 (by positivity) (by linarith)
        nlinarith
      have e4 : M * (∑ i : Fin 3, |X i|) ^ 2 * (∑ j : Fin 3, |Y' j|) ^ 2 ≤
          9 * M / μ ^ 2 * (qa * Bp) := by
        rw [show 9 * M / μ ^ 2 * (qa * Bp) = M * (9 * (qa * Bp)) / μ ^ 2 by ring,
          le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 hM0]
      rw [← hgram]
      exact hc.trans e4
  
  refine ⟨9 * M / μ ^ 2, div_nonneg (by linarith) (by positivity), fun y hy X Y => ?_⟩
  have hR1 : ∀ l i j k : Fin 3, riemannLocal G l i j k y = -riemannLocal G l j i k y := by
    intro l i j k
    simp only [riemannLocal, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    ring
  have hrearr : ∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
      G y m l * riemannLocal G l i j k y * X i * Y j * Y k * X m =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        (∑ l : Fin 3, G y m l * riemannLocal G l i j k y) * X i * Y j * Y k * X m := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  rw [hrearr]
  refine key (G y) (fun i j k m => ∑ l : Fin 3, G y m l * riemannLocal G l i j k y)
    (hGsymm y) (hcoer y hy) ?_ (fun i j k m => hanti y (hBU hy) i j k m)
    (fun i j k m => hM y hy i j k m) X Y
  intro i j k m
  show ∑ l : Fin 3, G y m l * riemannLocal G l i j k y =
    -∑ l : Fin 3, G y m l * riemannLocal G l j i k y
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
  rw [hR1 l i j k]
  ring

gs_simons_intrinsic.definitions:
def gsRiem2 (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (m l i k : Fin 2) (x : E2) : ℝ :=
  pd2 l (christoffel2 h m i k) x - pd2 i (christoffel2 h m l k) x
    + ∑ p : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h m l p x * christoffel2 h p i k x
        - christoffel2 h m i p x * christoffel2 h p l k x)

subgoal_signatures.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) (hhsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j y = christoffel2 h k j i y) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j) k i j y = 0) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m))

  have hfun : (fun z => pullMetric2 G F z k i) = (fun z => pullMetric2 G F z i k) :=

  have hΓ2 : ∀ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) m k i x =

    (fun y c => gsTan F j y c) (g1 j) x hx k i
  have hcov : ∀ l : Fin 3,

    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
    rw [← hcov c]
    ring

  unfold gsAmbCod
  congr 1
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

def gsrF4 (R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (X Y Z W : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, R a b c m * X a * Y b * Z c * W m

def gsrF5 (D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (V X Y Z W : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
    D r a b c m * V r * X a * Y b * Z c * W m

def gsrRm (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (a b c m : Fin 3) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ l : Fin 3, G y m l * riemannLocal G l a b c y

def gsrDRm (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (r a b c m : Fin 3) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  partialDeriv r (gsrRm G a b c m) y
    - ∑ q : Fin 3, (christoffel G q r a y * gsrRm G q b c m y
      + christoffel G q r b y * gsrRm G a q c m y
      + christoffel G q r c y * gsrRm G a b q m y
      + christoffel G q r m y * gsrRm G a b c q y)

def gsrNu (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (e : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  (∑ b : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ e b * gsCrossN F x b) / gsNormLen G F x

def gsrDT (R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (DR : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Fv : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (ν : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (II : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (l k i j : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  gsrF5 DR (Fv l) (Fv k) (Fv i) (Fv j) ν
    + II l k * gsrF4 R ν (Fv i) (Fv j) ν
    + II l i * gsrF4 R (Fv k) ν (Fv j) ν
    + II l j * gsrF4 R (Fv k) (Fv i) ν ν
    - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, hi a b * II l b * gsrF4 R (Fv k) (Fv i) (Fv j) (Fv a)

def gsrE (R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (DR : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Fv : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (ν : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (II : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (i j : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, hi k l *
    (gsrDT R DR Fv ν hi II i k j l + gsrDT R DR Fv ν hi II l k i j)

def gsrRm (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (a b c m : Fin 3) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
