    apply ContDiffOn.mul contDiffOn_const
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro l _
    exact (hinv k l).mul (((hpd _ (hG j l) i).add (hpd _ (hG i l) j)).sub (hpd _ (hG i j) l))
  have hric : ∀ j k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ricci G j k y) U := by
    intro j k
    simp only [ricci]
    apply ContDiffOn.add
    · apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro i _
      exact (hpd _ (hchr i j k) i).sub (hpd _ (hchr i i k) j)
    · apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro i _
      apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro p _
      exact ((hchr i i p).mul (hchr p j k)).sub ((hchr i j p).mul (hchr p i k))
  set T : Set (E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ)) := K ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 with hTdef
  have hT : IsCompact T := hK.prod (isCompact_sphere 0 1)
  set num : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun p => ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
    ricci G j k p.1 * (∑ b : Fin 3, (G p.1)⁻¹ j b * p.2 b) *
      (∑ b : Fin 3, (G p.1)⁻¹ k b * p.2 b) with hnumdef
  set den : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun p => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    (G p.1)⁻¹ i j * p.2 i * p.2 j with hdendef
  have hAc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun p : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => (G p.1)⁻¹ i j) T :=
    fun i j => ((hinv i j).continuousOn.mono hKU).comp continuous_fst.continuousOn
      (fun p hp => hp.1)
  have hBc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun p : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => ricci G i j p.1) T :=
    fun i j => ((hric i j).continuousOn.mono hKU).comp continuous_fst.continuousOn
      (fun p hp => hp.1)
  have hxc : ∀ b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun p : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => p.2 b) T := fun b =>
    ((continuous_apply b).comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
  have hnum : ContinuousOn num T := by
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro j _
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro k _
    refine ((hBc j k).mul ?_).mul ?_
    · apply continuousOn_finset_sum
      intro b _
      exact (hAc j b).mul (hxc b)
    · apply continuousOn_finset_sum
      intro b _
      exact (hAc k b).mul (hxc b)
  have hden : ContinuousOn den T := by
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro i _
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro j _
    exact ((hAc i j).mul (hxc i)).mul (hxc j)
  have hdenpos : ∀ p ∈ T, 0 < den p := by
    rintro ⟨y, u⟩ ⟨hy, hu⟩
    have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at hu
      simp at hu
    have hP := (hpos y (hKU hy)).inv
    have h1 := hP.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hu0
    have h2 : dotProduct (star u) (Matrix.mulVec (G y)⁻¹ u) = den (y, u) := by
      simp only [hdendef, star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    linarith
  have hf : ContinuousOn (fun p => num p / den p) T :=
    hnum.div hden (fun p hp => (hdenpos p hp).ne')
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hT.bddBelow_image hf
  refine ⟨max 0 (-m), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro Φ y hy hd
  set ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun i => partialDeriv i Φ y with hξdef
  have hξ0 : ξ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hd
    have hz : ∀ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ Φ y (e i) = 0 := by
      intro i
      have := congrFun h i
      simpa [hξdef, partialDeriv] using this
    have hv : ∀ v : E3, v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
      intro v
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
    rw [hv v, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, hz 0, hz 1, hz 2]
    simp
  have hr : 0 < ‖ξ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hξ0
  set u : Fin 3 → ℝ := ‖ξ‖⁻¹ • ξ with hudef
  have hu : u ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 := by
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, hudef, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne']
  have hmem : (y, u) ∈ T := ⟨hy, hu⟩
  have hle : m ≤ num (y, u) / den (y, u) := hm ⟨(y, u), hmem, rfl⟩
  have hnu : num (y, u) = (‖ξ‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * num (y, ξ) := by
    simp only [hnumdef, hudef, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hdu : den (y, u) = (‖ξ‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * den (y, ξ) := by
    simp only [hdendef, hudef, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hc : (‖ξ‖⁻¹) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [hnu, hdu, mul_div_mul_left _ _ hc] at hle
  have hratio : ejpRic G Φ y = num (y, ξ) / den (y, ξ) := rfl
  rw [hratio]
  linarith [le_max_right 0 (-m)]

informal_problem.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r), ∀ v : E3, m * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y k l * v l

signature.name: chart_metric_lower_bound
signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) : ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r), ∀ v : E3, m * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y k l * v l

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm with hGdef
  set B := Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) with hBdef
  set Q : E3 × E3 → ℝ := fun p => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, p.2 k * G p.1 k l * p.2 l with hQdef
  by_cases hB : B.Nonempty
  swap
  · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun y hy v => absurd ⟨y, hy⟩ hB⟩
  have hGc : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => G y k l) (chartAt E3 z).target :=
    fun k l => (g.smooth z k l).continuousOn
  have hQc : ContinuousOn Q (B ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : E3) 1) := by
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo Prod.fst (B ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : E3) 1) (chartAt E3 z).target :=
      fun p hp => hball hp.1
    have hcoord : ∀ k : Fin 3, Continuous (fun p : E3 × E3 => p.2 k) := fun k =>
      (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ k).comp continuous_snd
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun l _ => ?_))
    exact (((hcoord k).continuousOn).mul ((hGc k l).comp continuous_fst.continuousOn hmaps)).mul
      (hcoord l).continuousOn
  have he0 : (e 0) ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : E3) 1 := by
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one]
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hmin⟩ := ((isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod
    (isCompact_sphere (0 : E3) 1)).exists_isMinOn (hB.prod ⟨e 0, he0⟩) hQc
  have hbridge : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (v : E3),
      dotProduct (star (WithLp.ofLp v)) (Matrix.mulVec A (WithLp.ofLp v)) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * A k l * v l := by
    intro A v
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
  have hposdef : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, (G y).PosDef := by
    intro y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source := (chartAt E3 z).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 z) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 z) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 z) ∘ (chartAt E3 z).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 z) ∘ (chartAt E3 z).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 z).eventually_right_inverse hy] with w hw
      exact hw
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [hGdef, RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : dotProduct (star x) ((G y).mulVec x) =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [hGdef, map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  have hm : 0 < Q p₀ := by
    have hpd := hposdef p₀.1 (hball hp₀.1)
    have hu : p₀.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have h' := hp₀.2
      rw [h, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_zero] at h'
      exact zero_ne_one h'
    have hu' : WithLp.ofLp p₀.2 ≠ 0 := by
      rwa [Ne, WithLp.ofLp_eq_zero]
    have h3 := hpd.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hu'
    rw [hbridge] at h3
    exact h3
  have hhom : ∀ (y v : E3) (t : ℝ), Q (y, t • v) = t ^ 2 * Q (y, v) := by
    intro y v t
    simp only [hQdef, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by ring))
  refine ⟨Q p₀, hm, fun y hy v => ?_⟩
  show Q p₀ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q (y, v)
  by_cases hv : v = 0
  · subst hv
    simp [hQdef]
  · have ht : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
    have hu : ‖v‖⁻¹ • v ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : E3) 1 := by
      rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht.ne']
    have h1 := isMinOn_iff.mp hmin (y, ‖v‖⁻¹ • v) ⟨hy, hu⟩
    rw [hhom] at h1
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (sq_nonneg ‖v‖)
    calc Q p₀ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖v‖⁻¹ ^ 2 * Q (y, v) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 := h2
      _ = Q (y, v) := by field_simp

informal_problem.statement: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (X : E → E) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) : ∃ Fl : ℝ → E → E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => Fl p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ x, Fl 0 x = x) ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E), HasDerivAt (fun s => Fl s x) (X (Fl t x)) t

signature.name: ode_flow_contDiff
signature.statement: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (X : E → E) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) : ∃ Fl : ℝ → E → E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => Fl p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ x, Fl 0 x = x) ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E), HasDerivAt (fun s => Fl s x) (X (Fl t x)) t

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hbounds : ∀ (F : Type u_2) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (V : F → F),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ V → HasCompactSupport V →
      ∃ (K : NNReal) (B : ℝ), LipschitzWith K V ∧ (∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ V y‖ ≤ K) ∧
        (∀ x, ‖V x‖ ≤ B) ∧ UniformContinuous (fderiv ℝ V) ∧ Differentiable ℝ V := by
    intro F _ _ V hV hVc
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := ContDiff.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hVc hV (by simp)
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hV.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hVc
    refine ⟨K, B, hK, fun y => norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ hK, hB, ?_,
      hV.differentiable (by simp)⟩
    exact (hVc.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).uniformContinuous_of_continuous
      (hV.continuous_fderiv (by simp))
  
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (F : Type u_2) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
      [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] (V : F → F), ContDiff ℝ ∞ V → HasCompactSupport V →
      ∀ Ψ : ℝ → F → F, (∀ x, Ψ 0 x = x) →
      (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : F), HasDerivAt (fun s => Ψ s x) (V (Ψ t x)) t) →
      ContDiff ℝ n (fun p : ℝ × F => Ψ p.1 p.2) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro F _ _ _ V hV hVc Ψ hΨ0 hΨ
      obtain ⟨K, B, hKL, -, hB, -, -⟩ := hbounds F V hV hVc
      exact contDiff_zero.2 (ode_flow_continuous_init V K hKL B hB Ψ hΨ0 hΨ)
    | succ n ih =>
      intro F _ _ _ V hV hVc Ψ hΨ0 hΨ
      
      have hderiv : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ∃ G : ℝ → F × (F →L[ℝ] F) → F × (F →L[ℝ] F),
          ContDiff ℝ n (fun q : ℝ × (F × (F →L[ℝ] F)) => G q.1 q.2) ∧
          ∀ t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, ∀ x₀ : F,
            HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × F => Ψ p.1 p.2)
              ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ F).smulRight (V (Ψ t₀ x₀)) +
                (G t₀ (x₀, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F)).2.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ F))
              (t₀, x₀) := by
        intro T hT
        obtain ⟨K, B, hKL, hDK, hB, hU, hD⟩ := hbounds F V hV hVc
        obtain ⟨Z, hZs, hZc, hZf, hZb⟩ :=
          augmented_field_exists V hV hVc K hDK (Real.exp (K * T)) (Real.exp_pos _)
        obtain ⟨KZ, BZ, hZL, -, hZB, -, -⟩ := hbounds (F × (F →L[ℝ] F)) Z hZs hZc
        haveI : CompleteSpace (F × (F →L[ℝ] F)) := FiniteDimensional.complete ℝ _
        obtain ⟨G, hG0, hG⟩ := ode_global_flow_exists Z KZ hZL BZ hZB
        have hGs := ih (F × (F →L[ℝ] F)) Z hZs hZc G hG0 hG
        have hid := augmented_flow_ident V K hKL T Z hZf hZb Ψ hΨ0 hΨ G hG0 hG
        have hest := flow_variational_estimate V hD K hKL hDK hU Ψ hΨ0 hΨ T
          (fun t x => (G t (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F)).2)
          (fun x => by simp only [hG0])
          (fun x t ht => (hid x t ht).2.2)
        refine ⟨G, hGs, ?_⟩
        intro t₀ ht₀ x₀
        have ht₀I : t₀ ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht₀
        refine hasFDerivAt_uncurry_of_uniform Ψ
          (fun t x => (G t (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F)).2) t₀ x₀ (V (Ψ t₀ x₀)) (hΨ t₀ x₀)
          ((hid x₀ t₀ ht₀I).2.2.continuousAt) ?_
        intro ε hε
        obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := hest ε hε
        have hpos : 0 < T - |t₀| := by
          rw [sub_pos, abs_lt]
          exact ⟨ht₀.1, ht₀.2⟩
        refine ⟨min δ (T - |t₀|), lt_min hδ hpos, ?_⟩
        intro t ht h hh
        have h2 : |t - t₀| < T - |t₀| := lt_of_lt_of_le ht (min_le_right _ _)
        have hh' : ‖h‖ < δ := lt_of_lt_of_le hh (min_le_left _ _)
        have htI : t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T := by
          have h3 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub t t₀
          have h4 : |t| ≤ T := by linarith
          exact ⟨(abs_le.mp h4).1, (abs_le.mp h4).2⟩
        exact hδ' x₀ h hh' t htI
      have hn : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = (n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 := by push_cast; rfl
      have hmem : ∀ t : ℝ, t ∈ Set.Ioo (-(|t| + 1)) (|t| + 1) := by
        intro t
        constructor
        · linarith [neg_abs_le t]
        · linarith [le_abs_self t]
      rw [hn, contDiff_succ_iff_fderiv]
      refine ⟨?_, by simp, ?_⟩
      · intro p
        obtain ⟨G, -, hG⟩ := hderiv (|p.1| + 1) (by positivity)
        exact (hG p.1 (hmem p.1) p.2).differentiableAt
      · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
        intro p
        obtain ⟨G, hGs, hG⟩ := hderiv (|p.1| + 1) (by positivity)
        have hΦ := ih F V hV hVc Ψ hΨ0 hΨ
        have ha : ContDiff ℝ n (fun q : ℝ × F => V (Ψ q.1 q.2)) :=
          (hV.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).comp hΦ
        have hb : ContDiff ℝ n
            (fun q : ℝ × F => (G q.1 (q.2, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F)).2) :=
          contDiff_snd.comp (hGs.comp
            (contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_snd.prodMk contDiff_const)))
        have hL : ContDiff ℝ n (fun q : ℝ × F =>
            (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ F).smulRight (V (Ψ q.1 q.2)) +
              (G q.1 (q.2, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F)).2.comp
                (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ F)) :=
          (contDiff_const.smulRight ha).add (hb.clm_comp contDiff_const)
        apply hL.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        have hU : Set.Ioo (-(|p.1| + 1)) (|p.1| + 1) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set F) ∈ nhds p :=
          (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds ⟨hmem p.1, Set.mem_univ _⟩
        filter_upwards [hU] with q hq
        exact (hG q.1 hq.1 q.2).fderiv
  
  obtain ⟨K, B, hKL, -, hB, -, -⟩ := hbounds E X hX hXc
  haveI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℝ E
  obtain ⟨Fl, hFl0, hFl⟩ := ode_global_flow_exists X K hKL B hB
  exact ⟨Fl, contDiff_infty.2 (fun n => key n E X hX hXc Fl hFl0 hFl), hFl0, hFl⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: ode_global_flow_exists

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hy₁ : y₀ ∈ W₁ := hy₀.1
  have hy₂ : y₀ ∈ W₂ := hy₀.2
  have h2inf : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  have h112 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 2 := by norm_num
  
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀ w ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    exact hdΦ₁ y₀ hy₁ (ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => by simpa using h x)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : E3, fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀ u = 1 :=
    ⟨(fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀ w)⁻¹ • w, by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hw]⟩
  
  have hΦ₁at : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Φ₁ y₀ := hΦ₁.contDiffAt (hW₁.mem_nhds hy₁)
  let F : E3 → E3 := fun y => y + (Φ₁ y - fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀ (y - y₀)) • u
  have hFc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F y₀ := by
    have hl : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀ (y - y₀)) y₀ :=
      (fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp y₀ (contDiffAt_id.sub contDiffAt_const)
    exact contDiffAt_id.add ((hΦ₁at.sub hl).smul contDiffAt_const)
  have hF' : HasFDerivAt F ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ E3 : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) y₀ := by
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt Φ₁ (fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀) y₀ :=
      (hΦ₁at.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀ (y - y₀)) (fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀) y₀ := by
      have := (fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀).hasFDerivAt.comp y₀ ((hasFDerivAt_id y₀).sub_const y₀)
      exact this.congr_fderiv (ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun _ => by simp)
    have h3 := (hasFDerivAt_id y₀).add ((h1.sub h2).smul_const u)
    refine h3.congr_fderiv ?_
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    simp
  have hn : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hFy₀ : F y₀ = y₀ := by simp [F, hΦ₀]
  have hΦF : ∀ y, fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀ (F y - y₀) = Φ₁ y := by
    intro y
    simp only [F, map_sub, map_add, map_smul, hu, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψc, hψd, hψ0, hψr⟩ : ∃ ψ : E3 → E3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ψ y₀ ∧
      (∀ x, fderiv ℝ ψ y₀ x = x) ∧ ψ y₀ = y₀ ∧ ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y₀, F (ψ z) = z := by
    have hstrict := hFc.hasStrictFDerivAt' hF' hn
    refine ⟨hFc.localInverse hF' hn, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := hFc.to_localInverse hF' hn
      rwa [hFy₀] at this
    · have := hstrict.to_localInverse
      rw [hFy₀] at this
      intro x
      rw [show hFc.localInverse hF' hn = HasStrictFDerivAt.localInverse F _ y₀ hstrict from rfl,
        this.hasFDerivAt.fderiv]
      simp
    · have := hFc.localInverse_apply_image hF' hn
      rwa [hFy₀] at this
    · have := hstrict.eventually_right_inverse
      rw [hFy₀] at this
      exact this
  have hψ2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 ψ y₀ := hψc.of_le h2inf
  have hψev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y₀, DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z :=
    (hψ2.eventually (by simp)).mono fun z hz => hz.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hdψ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) y₀ :=
    (hψ2.fderiv_right (m := 1) h112).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  
  have key : ∀ (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (W : Set E3), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ W → y₀ ∈ W → ∀ x : E3,
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0:ℝ), Φ (ψ (y₀ + t • x)) = 0) →

        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y₀ x x + fderiv ℝ Φ y₀ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) y₀ x x) = 0 := by
    intro Φ W hW hΦ hyW x hz
    have hc : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => y₀ + s • x) x t := by

      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const x).const_add y₀
    have hcont : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => y₀ + s • x) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 y₀) := by
      have := (hc 0).continuousAt.tendsto

    have hγcont : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ψ (y₀ + s • x)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 y₀) := by
      have := hψc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hcont
      rwa [hψ0] at this
    have hγ : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0:ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun s => ψ (y₀ + s • x)) (fderiv ℝ ψ (y₀ + t • x) x) t := by
      filter_upwards [hcont.eventually hψev] with t ht
      exact ht.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hc t)
    have hη : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ ψ (y₀ + s • x) x)
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) y₀ x x) 0 := by
      have h1 := hdψ.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 (hc 0) (by simp)
      have h2 := h1.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) x)
      refine h2.congr_deriv ?_
      simp
    have hΦd : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0:ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (ψ (y₀ + t • x)) := by
      filter_upwards [hγcont.eventually (hW.eventually_mem hyW)] with t ht
      exact (hΦ.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds ht)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hD0 : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0:ℝ),
        fderiv ℝ Φ (ψ (y₀ + t • x)) (fderiv ℝ ψ (y₀ + t • x) x) = 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hγ, hΦd, hz.eventually_nhds] with t h1 h2 h3
      have hA : HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (ψ (y₀ + s • x)))
          (fderiv ℝ Φ (ψ (y₀ + t • x)) (fderiv ℝ ψ (y₀ + t • x) x)) t :=
        h2.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h1
      have hB : HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (ψ (y₀ + s • x))) 0 t :=
        (hasDerivAt_const t (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq h3
      exact hA.unique hB
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have := hD0.self_of_nhds
      simpa [hψ0, hψd] using this
    · have hdΦ' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y₀ :=
        (((hΦ.of_le h2inf).fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := 1) h112).contDiffAt
          (hW.mem_nhds hyW)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ Φ (ψ (y₀ + t • x)))
          (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y₀ x) 0 := by
        have := hdΦ'.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hγ.self_of_nhds (by simp [hψ0])
        refine this.congr_deriv ?_
        simp [hψd]
      have hE := h1.clm_apply hη
      have hF0 : HasDerivAt
          (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ Φ (ψ (y₀ + t • x)) (fderiv ℝ ψ (y₀ + t • x) x)) 0 0 :=
        (hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) (0:ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hD0
      have := hE.unique hF0
      simpa [hψ0, hψd] using this
  
  have hcurve : ∀ x : E3, fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀ x = 0 →
      (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0:ℝ), Φ₁ (ψ (y₀ + t • x)) = 0) ∧
        (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0:ℝ), Φ₂ (ψ (y₀ + t • x)) = 0) := by
    intro x hx
    have hcont : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => y₀ + s • x) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 y₀) := by
      have : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => y₀ + s • x) := by fun_prop
      simpa using this.tendsto 0
    have hγcont : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ψ (y₀ + s • x)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 y₀) := by
      have := hψc.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hcont
      rwa [hψ0] at this
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0:ℝ), Φ₁ (ψ (y₀ + t • x)) = 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hcont.eventually hψr] with t ht
      have := hΦF (ψ (y₀ + t • x))
      rw [ht] at this
      rw [← this]
      simp [hx]
    have hW12 : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0:ℝ), ψ (y₀ + t • x) ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ :=
      hγcont.eventually ((hW₁.inter hW₂).eventually_mem hy₀)
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    filter_upwards [h1, hW12] with t ht hw
    exact (hzero _ hw).1 ht
  
  have hker : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀ x = 0 → fderiv ℝ Φ₂ y₀ x = 0 := fun x hx =>
    (key Φ₂ W₂ hW₂ hΦ₂ hy₂ x (hcurve x hx).2).1
  obtain ⟨c, hprop⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ x, fderiv ℝ Φ₂ y₀ x = c * fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀ x := by
    refine ⟨fderiv ℝ Φ₂ y₀ u, fun x => ?_⟩
    have h := hker (x - (fderiv ℝ Φ₁ y₀ x) • u)
      (by rw [map_sub, map_smul, hu, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, sub_self])
    rw [map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, sub_eq_zero] at h
    rw [h, mul_comm]
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hc
    apply hdΦ₂ y₀ hy₂
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    simp [hprop x, hc]
  
  have k1 := (key Φ₁ W₁ hW₁ hΦ₁ hy₁ v (hcurve v hv).1).2
  have k2 := (key Φ₂ W₂ hW₂ hΦ₂ hy₂ v (hcurve v hv).2).2
  rw [hprop (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) y₀ v v)] at k2
  have hB : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ₂) y₀ v v = c * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ₁) y₀ v v := by
    linear_combination k2 - c * k1
  
  have hquad : ∀ (Φ : E3 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y₀ →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j Φ) y₀ * v i * v j =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y₀ v v := by
    intro Φ hd
    have h41 : ∀ i j, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j Φ) y₀ =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y₀ (e i) (e j) := by
      intro i j
      have h : HasFDerivAt (fun z => fderiv ℝ Φ z (e j))
          ((fderiv ℝ Φ y₀).comp (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y₀).flip (e j)) y₀ :=
        hd.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e j) y₀)
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ Φ z (e j)) y₀ (e i) = _
      rw [h.fderiv]
      simp
    have hv_exp : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    simp only [h41, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    conv_rhs => rw [hv_exp]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hdd : ∀ (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (W : Set E3), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ W → y₀ ∈ W →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y₀ := fun Φ W hW hΦ hyW =>
    (((hΦ.of_le h2inf).fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := 1) h112).contDiffAt
      (hW.mem_nhds hyW)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hd : ∀ k, partialDeriv k Φ₂ y₀ = c * partialDeriv k Φ₁ y₀ := fun k => hprop (e k)
  have hsplit : ∀ Φ : E3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ i j y₀ * v i * v j =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j Φ) y₀ * v i * v j -
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y₀ * partialDeriv k Φ y₀) * v i * v j := by
    intro Φ
    simp only [hessLoc, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  have hH : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ₂ i j y₀ * v i * v j =
      c * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ₁ i j y₀ * v i * v j := by
    rw [hsplit, hsplit, hquad Φ₁ (hdd Φ₁ W₁ hW₁ hΦ₁ hy₁), hquad Φ₂ (hdd Φ₂ W₂ hW₂ hΦ₂ hy₂), hB,
      mul_sub]
    congr 1
    simp only [hd, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    ring
  have hN : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Φ₂ y₀ * partialDeriv b Φ₂ y₀ =
      c ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y₀)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Φ₁ y₀ * partialDeriv b Φ₁ y₀ := by
    simp only [hd, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    ring
  have hfun : (fun k => ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l Φ₂ y₀) =
      c • (fun k => ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l Φ₁ y₀) := by
    funext k
    simp only [hd, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    ring
  have hX : (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
        (fun k => ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l Φ₂ y₀) =
      c • (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
        (fun k => ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l Φ₁ y₀) := by
    rw [hfun, map_smul]
  have hs : ∀ H N : ℝ, c * H / (c ^ 2 * N) * c = H / N := by
    intro H N
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, show c * H * c = c ^ 2 * H by ring,
      mul_div_mul_left _ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 hc0)]
  refine ⟨hker v hv, ?_⟩
  unfold sprayA
  rw [hH, hN, hX, smul_smul, hs]

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) (Sig : Set M) (hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) : IsCompact {y : E3 | y ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (3 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig} ∧ ∃ (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Set E3) (Φ : Fin N → E3 → ℝ), (∀ i, IsOpen (W i) ∧ W i ⊆ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ i) (W i) ∧ (∀ y ∈ W i, fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ y ∈ W i, (Φ i y = 0 ↔ (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig)) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (3 * r), (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig → ∃ i, y ∈ W i

signature.name: minimal_set_chart_cover
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target) (Sig : Set M) (hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) : IsCompact {y : E3 | y ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (3 * r) ∧ (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig} ∧ ∃ (N : ℕ) (W : Fin N → Set E3) (Φ : Fin N → E3 → ℝ), (∀ i, IsOpen (W i) ∧ W i ⊆ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ i) (W i) ∧ (∀ y ∈ W i, fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ y ∈ W i, (Φ i y = 0 ↔ (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig)) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (3 * r), (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig → ∃ i, y ∈ W i

proof.tactics:
by
  have hB3t : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (3 * r) ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)).trans hball
  have hK : IsCompact {y : E3 | y ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (3 * r) ∧
      (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig} := by
    have hcl : IsClosed (Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (3 * r) ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Sig) :=
      ((chartAt E3 z).continuousOn_symm.mono hB3t).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed
        Metric.isClosed_closedBall hSm.1
    exact (isCompact_closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (3 * r)).of_isClosed_subset hcl
      Set.inter_subset_left
  have hloc : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 z z) (3 * r), (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Sig →
      ∃ (W : Set E3) (Φ : E3 → ℝ), IsOpen W ∧ y ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ W ∧ (∀ y' ∈ W, fderiv ℝ Φ y' ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ y' ∈ W, (Φ y' = 0 ↔ (chartAt E3 z).symm y' ∈ Sig) := by
    intro y hy hyS
    have hyB : y ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hy
    have hyt : y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target := hB3t hy
    have hOo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 z).source ∩ (chartAt E3 z) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r)) :=
      (chartAt E3 z).isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hpO : (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈
        (chartAt E3 z).source ∩ (chartAt E3 z) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) := by
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 z).map_target hyt, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r)
      rw [(chartAt E3 z).right_inv hyt]
      exact hyB
    obtain ⟨V, f, hVO, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hVS, -⟩ := hSm.2 _ hyS _ (hOo.mem_nhds hpO)
    have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) (chartAt E3 z).target := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ (chartAt E3 z).symm) (chartAt E3 z).target :=
        hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    have hfd : ∀ y' ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target,
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') ≠ 0 →
        fderiv ℝ (fun y'' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y'')) y' ≠ 0 := by
      intro y' hy' hd h0
      apply hd
      have hxs : (chartAt E3 z).symm y' ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source := (chartAt E3 z).map_target hy'
      have hκx : chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') = y' := (chartAt E3 z).right_inv hy'
      have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')]
          (fun y'' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y'')) ∘ (chartAt E3 z) := by
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 z).open_source.mem_nhds hxs] with w hw
        simp only [Function.comp, (chartAt E3 z).left_inv hw]
      have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y'' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y'')) y' :=
        hsm.contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 z).open_target.mem_nhds hy')
      have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun y'' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y''))
          (chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) := by
        rw [hκx]
        exact (hc.differentiableAt (by simp)).mdifferentiableAt
      have hκ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 z) hxs
      have hz : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun y'' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y''))
          (chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) = 0 := by
        rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv, hκx]
        exact h0
      rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp _ hg hκ, hz]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp _
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' V, fun y' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y'),
      (chartAt E3 z).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hVo, ⟨hyt, hpV⟩, ?_,
      hsm.mono Set.inter_subset_left, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro y' ⟨hy't, hy'V⟩
      have h : (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 z z) (4 * r) :=
        (hVO hy'V).2
      rwa [(chartAt E3 z).right_inv hy't] at h
    · rintro y' ⟨hy't, hy'V⟩
      exact hfd y' hy't (hdf _ hy'V)
    · rintro y' ⟨_, hy'V⟩
      constructor
      · intro h0
        have h1 : (chartAt E3 z).symm y' ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hy'V, h0⟩
        rw [← hVS] at h1
        exact h1.2
      · intro hS
        have h1 : (chartAt E3 z).symm y' ∈ V ∩ Sig := ⟨hy'V, hS⟩
        rw [hVS] at h1
        exact h1.2
  refine ⟨hK, ?_⟩
  choose! Wp Φp hWp using hloc
  obtain ⟨t, htK, htcov⟩ := hK.elim_nhds_subcover Wp
    (fun y hy => (hWp y hy.1 hy.2).1.mem_nhds (hWp y hy.1 hy.2).2.1)
  refine ⟨t.card, fun i => Wp (t.equivFin.symm i : E3), fun i => Φp (t.equivFin.symm i : E3),
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨hi1, hi2⟩ := htK _ (t.equivFin.symm i).2
    obtain ⟨h1, -, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := hWp _ hi1 hi2
    exact ⟨h1, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩
  · intro y hy hyS
    have hyc := htcov ⟨hy, hyS⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hxt, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hyc
    refine ⟨t.equivFin ⟨x, hxt⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hyx

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) (Metric.ball c (4 * r))) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball c (4 * r), (G y).PosDef) {N : ℕ} (W : Fin N → Set E3) (Φ : Fin N → E3 → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i) ∧ W i ⊆ Metric.ball c (4 * r)) (hΦ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ i) (W i)) (hdΦ : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W i, fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y ≠ 0) (s : Set E3) (hs : IsCompact s) (hsW : s ⊆ ⋃ i, W i) : ∃ (ψ : Fin N → E3 → ℝ) (X : E3 × E3 → E3 × E3), (∀ i y, 0 ≤ ψ i y) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∑ i, ψ i y = 1) ∧ (∀ i y, ψ i y ≠ 0 → y ∈ W i) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r), ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ≤ r → X (y, v) = (v, sprayQ G Φ ψ y v)

signature.name: surface_spray_field
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) (Metric.ball c (4 * r))) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball c (4 * r), (G y).PosDef) {N : ℕ} (W : Fin N → Set E3) (Φ : Fin N → E3 → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i) ∧ W i ⊆ Metric.ball c (4 * r)) (hΦ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ i) (W i)) (hdΦ : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W i, fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y ≠ 0) (s : Set E3) (hs : IsCompact s) (hsW : s ⊆ ⋃ i, W i) : ∃ (ψ : Fin N → E3 → ℝ) (X : E3 × E3 → E3 × E3), (∀ i y, 0 ≤ ψ i y) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∑ i, ψ i y = 1) ∧ (∀ i y, ψ i y ≠ 0 → y ∈ W i) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c (3 * r), ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ≤ r → X (y, v) = (v, sprayQ G Φ ψ y v)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hBo : IsOpen (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) := Metric.isOpen_ball
  
  have hdet : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) (Metric.ball c (4 * r))) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) := by
    intro H hH
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3),
        ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℝ) * ∏ k, H y (σ k) k) (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun σ _ => contDiffOn_const.mul (contDiffOn_prod fun k _ => hH (σ k) k)
    refine h1.congr ?_
    intro y _
    exact Matrix.det_apply' (H y)
  have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).adjugate i j)
      (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) := by
    intro i j
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1)).det)
        (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) := by
      apply hdet (fun y => (G y).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1))
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = j
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hG a b
    refine h2.congr ?_
    intro y _
    exact Matrix.adjugate_apply (G y) i j
  have hne : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball c (4 * r), (G y).det ≠ 0 :=
    fun y hy => (hGpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hGinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) := by
    intro i j
    have h3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate i j)
        (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) :=
      ((hdet G hG).inv hne).mul (hadj i j)
    refine h3.congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hpd : ∀ (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ a : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a f) U := by
    intro U hU f hf a
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e a)) U
    exact (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hΓ : ∀ k a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k a b) (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) := by
    intro k a b
    have hP : ∀ x y z : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv x (fun w => G w y z))
        (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) :=
      fun x y z => hpd _ hBo _ (hG y z) x
    have h4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
        (partialDeriv a (fun z => G z b l) y + partialDeriv b (fun z => G z a l) y
          - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z a b) y)) (Metric.ball c (4 * r)) :=
      contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hGinv k l).mul
        (((hP a b l).add (hP b a l)).sub (hP l a b)))
    exact h4
  
  have hHess : ∀ i : Fin N, ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G (Φ i) a b) (W i) := by
    intro i a b
    have hΓW : ∀ k a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k a b) (W i) :=
      fun k a b => (hΓ k a b).mono (hW i).2
    have h1 : ∀ x : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv x (Φ i)) (W i) :=
      fun x => hpd _ (hW i).1 _ (hΦ i) x
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b (Φ i))) (W i) :=
      hpd _ (hW i).1 _ (h1 b) a
    unfold hessLoc
    exact h2.sub (ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hΓW k a b).mul (h1 k))
  
  have hcoord : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => p.2 a) :=
    fun a => ((EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff).comp contDiff_snd
  have hfst : ∀ (U : Set E3) (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => f p.1) (U ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set E3)) :=
    fun U f hf => hf.comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp.1)
  have hvec : ∀ (S : Set (E3 × E3)) (F : Fin 3 → E3 × E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F k) S) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun k => F k p)) S := by
    intro S F hF
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (contDiffOn_pi.2 hF)
  
  have hGam : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => sprayGam G p.1 p.2)
      (Metric.ball c (4 * r) ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    unfold sprayGam
    refine hvec _ (fun k p => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b p.1 * p.2 a * p.2 b) ?_
    intro k
    exact ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ =>
      ((hfst _ _ (hΓ k a b)).mul (hcoord a).contDiffOn).mul (hcoord b).contDiffOn
  
  have hNpos : ∀ i : Fin N, ∀ y ∈ W i, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (Φ i) y * partialDeriv b (Φ i) y := by
    intro i y hy
    have hd0 : (fun a : Fin 3 => partialDeriv a (Φ i) y) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hdΦ i y hy
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
      intro u
      have h0' : ∀ a : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y (e a) = 0 := fun a => congrFun h0 a
      have hu' : u = u 0 • e 0 + u 1 • e 1 + u 2 • e 2 := by
        ext j; fin_cases j <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      rw [hu']
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, h0', smul_zero, add_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    have hpos := (hGpd y ((hW i).2 hy)).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hd0
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum] at hpos
    refine lt_of_lt_of_eq hpos ?_
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    ring
  
  have hA : ∀ i : Fin N, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => sprayA G (Φ i) p.1 p.2)
      (W i ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
    intro i
    have hWo := (hW i).1
    have h1 : ∀ x : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv x (Φ i)) (W i) :=
      fun x => hpd _ hWo _ (hΦ i) x
    have hGiW : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) (W i) :=
      fun a b => (hGinv a b).mono (hW i).2
    have hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 =>
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, hessLoc G (Φ i) a b p.1 * p.2 a * p.2 b) (W i ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ =>
        ((hfst _ _ (hHess i a b)).mul (hcoord a).contDiffOn).mul (hcoord b).contDiffOn
    have hNs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (Φ i) y * partialDeriv b (Φ i) y) (W i) :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ => ((hGiW a b).mul (h1 a)).mul (h1 b)
    have hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 =>
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, hessLoc G (Φ i) a b p.1 * p.2 a * p.2 b) /
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            (G p.1)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (Φ i) p.1 * partialDeriv b (Φ i) p.1))
        (W i ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      hH.div (hfst _ _ hNs) (fun p hp => (hNpos i p.1 hp.1).ne')
    have hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
        (fun k => ∑ l : Fin 3, (G p.1)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l (Φ i) p.1)) (W i ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      hvec _ (fun k p => ∑ l : Fin 3, (G p.1)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l (Φ i) p.1) (fun k =>
        hfst _ _ (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hGiW k l).mul (h1 l)))
    exact hq.smul hv
  
  have hext : ∀ (h : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ h → ∀ (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → tsupport h ⊆ U →
      ∀ (P : E3 × E3 → E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => h p.1 • P p) := by
    intro h hh U hU hsupp P hP
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p.1 ∈ U
    · exact ((hh.comp contDiff_fst).contDiffAt).smul
        (hP.contDiffAt ((hU.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds ⟨hp, Set.mem_univ _⟩))
    · have h0 : h =ᶠ[𝓝 p.1] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h' => hp (hsupp h'))
      have h1 : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 p, h q.1 = (0 : E3 → ℝ) q.1 := (continuous_fst.tendsto p).eventually h0
      have h2 : (fun q : E3 × E3 => h q.1 • P q) =ᶠ[𝓝 p] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
        filter_upwards [h1] with q hq
        rw [hq, Pi.zero_apply, zero_smul]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq h2
  
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := SmoothPartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) hs.isClosed W
    (fun i => (hW i).1) hsW
  have hψs : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => f i y) := fun i => contMDiff_iff_contDiff.1 (f i).contMDiff
  have hψ0 : ∀ i y, 0 ≤ f i y := fun i y => f.nonneg i y
  have hψ1 : ∀ y ∈ s, ∑ i, f i y = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    have := f.sum_eq_one hy
    rwa [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype] at this
  have hψW : ∀ i, tsupport (fun y => f i y) ⊆ W i := fun i => hf i
  
  let χ : ContDiffBump c := ⟨3 * r, 7 * r / 2, by positivity, by linarith⟩
  let β : ContDiffBump (0 : E3) := ⟨r, 2 * r, hr, by linarith⟩
  have hχs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ := χ.contDiff
  have hβs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ β := β.contDiff
  have hχB : tsupport χ ⊆ Metric.ball c (4 * r) := by
    rw [χ.tsupport_eq]
    exact Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by show 7 * r / 2 < 4 * r; linarith)
  have hT0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => χ p.1 • sprayGam G p.1 p.2) :=
    hext χ hχs _ hBo hχB (fun p => sprayGam G p.1 p.2) hGam
  have hTi : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => f i p.1 • sprayA G (Φ i) p.1 p.2) :=
    fun i => hext (fun y => f i y) (hψs i) (W i) (hW i).1 (hψW i) _ (hA i)
  refine ⟨fun i y => f i y, fun p => (χ p.1 * β p.2) • (p.2, sprayQ G Φ (fun i y => f i y) p.1 p.2),
    hψ0, hψ1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i y hy
    exact hψW i (subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hy))
  · have hXeq : (fun p : E3 × E3 => (χ p.1 * β p.2) • (p.2, sprayQ G Φ (fun i y => f i y) p.1 p.2)) =
        fun p => ((χ p.1 * β p.2) • p.2, -(β p.2 • (χ p.1 • sprayGam G p.1 p.2)) -
          ∑ i, (χ p.1 * β p.2) • (f i p.1 • sprayA G (Φ i) p.1 p.2)) := by
      funext p
      simp only [Prod.smul_mk, sprayQ]
      congr 1
      rw [smul_sub, smul_neg, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul (β p.2), mul_comm (β p.2)]
    rw [hXeq]
    have hcb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => χ p.1 * β p.2) :=
      (hχs.comp contDiff_fst).mul (hβs.comp contDiff_snd)
    refine (hcb.smul contDiff_snd).prodMk ?_
    refine (((hβs.comp contDiff_snd).smul hT0).neg).sub ?_
    exact ContDiff.sum fun i _ => hcb.smul (hTi i)
  · refine HasCompactSupport.intro ((isCompact_closedBall c (7 * r / 2)).prod
      (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) (2 * r))) ?_
    intro p hp
    have hz : χ p.1 * β p.2 = 0 := by
      rw [Set.mem_prod, not_and_or] at hp
      rcases hp with h1 | h1
      · have h3 : χ p.1 = 0 := by
          rw [← Function.notMem_support, χ.support_eq]
          exact fun h' => h1 (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall h')
        rw [h3, zero_mul]
      · have h3 : β p.2 = 0 := by
          rw [← Function.notMem_support, β.support_eq]
          exact fun h' => h1 (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall h')
        rw [h3, mul_zero]
    show (χ p.1 * β p.2) • (p.2, sprayQ G Φ (fun i y => f i y) p.1 p.2) = 0
    rw [hz, zero_smul]
  · intro y hy v hv
    have h1 : χ y = 1 := χ.one_of_mem_closedBall hy
    have h2 : β v = 1 := β.one_of_mem_closedBall (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 hv)
    show (χ y * β v) • (v, sprayQ G Φ (fun i y => f i y) y v) = (v, sprayQ G Φ (fun i y => f i y) y v)
    rw [h1, h2, one_mul, one_smul]

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) O) (hGs : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ O, (G y).PosDef) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmG : ∀ y ∈ O, ∀ v : E3, m * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * G y k l * v l) {N : ℕ} (W : Fin N → Set E3) (Φ : Fin N → E3 → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i) ∧ W i ⊆ O) (hΦ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ i) (W i)) (hdΦ : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W i, fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y ≠ 0) (S Z : Set E3) (hSW : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W i, (Φ i y = 0 ↔ y ∈ S)) (hZO : Z ⊆ O) (hSZ : IsClosed (S ∩ Z)) (hcov : ∀ y ∈ S ∩ Z, ∃ i, y ∈ W i) (Rv : ℝ) (X : E3 × E3 → E3 × E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ 1 X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) (hXS : ∀ y ∈ S ∩ Z, ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ≤ Rv → (∀ i, y ∈ W i → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y v = 0) → ∀ j, y ∈ W j → X (y, v) = (v, -sprayGam G y v - sprayA G (Φ j) y v)) (Fl : ℝ → E3 × E3 → E3 × E3) (hFl0 : ∀ p, Fl 0 p = p) (hFl : ∀ (t : ℝ) (p : E3 × E3), HasDerivAt (fun s => Fl s p) (X (Fl t p)) t) (y₀ v₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ S ∩ Z) (hv₀ : ∀ i, y₀ ∈ W i → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y₀ v₀ = 0) (μ T : ℝ) (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hμv : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l ≤ m * μ ^ 2) (hμR : μ ≤ Rv) (hball : Metric.closedBall y₀ (T * μ) ⊆ Z) : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 ∈ S ∩ Z ∧ ‖(Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 - y₀‖ ≤ t * μ ∧ ‖(Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2‖ ≤ μ ∧ (∀ i, (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 ∈ W i → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 = 0) ∧ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 k * G (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 k l * (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 l = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l

signature.name: spray_flow_invariance
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) O) (hGs : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ O, (G y).PosDef) (m : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hmG : ∀ y ∈ O, ∀ v : E3, m * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * G y k l * v l) {N : ℕ} (W : Fin N → Set E3) (Φ : Fin N → E3 → ℝ) (hW : ∀ i, IsOpen (W i) ∧ W i ⊆ O) (hΦ : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Φ i) (W i)) (hdΦ : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W i, fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y ≠ 0) (S Z : Set E3) (hSW : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W i, (Φ i y = 0 ↔ y ∈ S)) (hZO : Z ⊆ O) (hSZ : IsClosed (S ∩ Z)) (hcov : ∀ y ∈ S ∩ Z, ∃ i, y ∈ W i) (Rv : ℝ) (X : E3 × E3 → E3 × E3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ 1 X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) (hXS : ∀ y ∈ S ∩ Z, ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ≤ Rv → (∀ i, y ∈ W i → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y v = 0) → ∀ j, y ∈ W j → X (y, v) = (v, -sprayGam G y v - sprayA G (Φ j) y v)) (Fl : ℝ → E3 × E3 → E3 × E3) (hFl0 : ∀ p, Fl 0 p = p) (hFl : ∀ (t : ℝ) (p : E3 × E3), HasDerivAt (fun s => Fl s p) (X (Fl t p)) t) (y₀ v₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ S ∩ Z) (hv₀ : ∀ i, y₀ ∈ W i → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) y₀ v₀ = 0) (μ T : ℝ) (hμ : 0 ≤ μ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hμv : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l ≤ m * μ ^ 2) (hμR : μ ≤ Rv) (hball : Metric.closedBall y₀ (T * μ) ⊆ Z) : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 T, (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 ∈ S ∩ Z ∧ ‖(Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 - y₀‖ ≤ t * μ ∧ ‖(Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2‖ ≤ μ ∧ (∀ i, (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 ∈ W i → fderiv ℝ (Φ i) (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 = 0) ∧ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 k * G (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 k l * (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 l = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hfst : ∀ (f : ℝ → E3 × E3) (f' : E3 × E3) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt f f' t →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (f s).1) f'.1 t := by
    intro f f' t h
    exact (hasFDerivAt_fst : HasFDerivAt (Prod.fst : E3 × E3 → E3)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E3 E3) (f t)).comp_hasDerivAt t h
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := ContDiff.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hXc hX (by simp)
  have hc : Continuous (fun s => Fl s (y₀, v₀)) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun t => (hFl t (y₀, v₀)).continuousAt
  have hγc : Continuous (fun s => (Fl s (y₀, v₀)).1) := continuous_fst.comp hc
  have hηc : Continuous (fun s => (Fl s (y₀, v₀)).2) := continuous_snd.comp hc
  
  have hspd : ∀ y ∈ O, ∀ v : E3,
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * G y k l * v l
        = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l → ‖v‖ ≤ μ := by
    intro y hy v hv
    have h1 := hmG y hy v
    rw [hv] at h1
    have h2 : m * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ m * μ ^ 2 := h1.trans hμv
    have h3 : ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ μ ^ 2 := le_of_mul_le_mul_left h2 hm
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]
  
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : Set ℝ, A = {t : ℝ | (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 ∈ S ∩ Z ∧
      ‖(Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 - y₀‖ ≤ t * μ ∧ ‖(Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2‖ ≤ μ ∧
      (∀ i, (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 ∈ W i →
        fderiv ℝ (Φ i) (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 = 0) ∧
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 k * G (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 k l *
        (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 l = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ A := by
    rw [hA, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hFl0]
    refine ⟨hy₀, by simp, hspd y₀ (hZO hy₀.2) v₀ rfl, hv₀, rfl⟩
  
  have hAclosed : IsClosed A := by
    apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨x, hxA, hxt⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.1 ht
    rw [hA] at hxA
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hxA
    rw [hA, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have hγx : Tendsto (fun n => (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).1) atTop (𝓝 (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1) :=
      (hγc.tendsto t).comp hxt
    have hηx : Tendsto (fun n => (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).2) atTop (𝓝 (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2) :=
      (hηc.tendsto t).comp hxt
    have h1 : (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 ∈ S ∩ Z :=
      hSZ.mem_of_tendsto hγx (Eventually.of_forall fun n => (hxA n).1)
    refine ⟨h1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' ((hγx.sub_const y₀).norm) (hxt.mul_const μ)
        (fun n => (hxA n).2.1)
    · exact le_of_tendsto' hηx.norm (fun n => (hxA n).2.2.1)
    · intro i hi
      have hf : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ (Φ i)) (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 :=
        ((hΦ i).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (hW i).1 (by simp)).continuousAt
          ((hW i).1.mem_nhds hi)
      have hcont : ContinuousAt
          (fun s => fderiv ℝ (Φ i) (Fl s (y₀, v₀)).1 (Fl s (y₀, v₀)).2) t :=
        (ContinuousAt.comp (f := fun s => (Fl s (y₀, v₀)).1) (x := t) hf
          hγc.continuousAt).clm_apply hηc.continuousAt
      have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => fderiv ℝ (Φ i) (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).1 (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).2)
          atTop (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ (Φ i) (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2)) :=
        hcont.tendsto.comp hxt
      have hev : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).1 ∈ W i := hγx ((hW i).1.mem_nhds hi)
      have hlim0 : Tendsto (fun n => fderiv ℝ (Φ i) (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).1 (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).2)
          atTop (𝓝 0) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (hev.mono fun n hn => ((hxA n).2.2.2.1 i hn).symm)
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlim hlim0
    · have hGt : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (fun y => G y k l) (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 :=
        fun k l => (hG k l).continuousOn.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds (hZO h1.2))
      have hco : ∀ k : Fin 3, Continuous (fun s => (Fl s (y₀, v₀)).2 k) :=
        fun k => (EuclideanSpace.proj k).continuous.comp hηc
      have hGt' : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (fun s => G (Fl s (y₀, v₀)).1 k l) t :=
        fun k l => ContinuousAt.comp (f := fun s => (Fl s (y₀, v₀)).1) (x := t) (hGt k l)
          hγc.continuousAt
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun s => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          (Fl s (y₀, v₀)).2 k * G (Fl s (y₀, v₀)).1 k l * (Fl s (y₀, v₀)).2 l) t := by
        unfold ContinuousAt
        refine tendsto_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ (fun l _ => ?_))
        exact (((hco k).continuousAt.mul (hGt' k l)).mul (hco l).continuousAt :)
      have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).2 k * G (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).1 k l * (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).2 l)
          atTop (𝓝 (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
            (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 k * G (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).1 k l * (Fl t (y₀, v₀)).2 l)) :=
        hcont.tendsto.comp hxt
      have hlim' : Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).2 k * G (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).1 k l * (Fl (x n) (y₀, v₀)).2 l)
          atTop (𝓝 (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l)) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.congr (fun n => ((hxA n).2.2.2.2).symm)
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlim hlim'
  
  have hopen : ∀ τ ∈ A ∩ Set.Ico 0 T, A ∈ 𝓝[>] τ := by

    rw [hA, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hτ

    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov _ hP1
    have hΦj : Φ j (Fl τ (y₀, v₀)).1 = 0 := (hSW j _ hj).2 hP1.1
    obtain ⟨ε, ζ, hε, hζ0, hζ⟩ := local_spray_invariant G (W j) (hW j).1
      (fun a b => (hG a b).mono (hW j).2) hGs (fun y hy => hGpd y ((hW j).2 hy)) (Φ j) (hΦ j)
      (hdΦ j) (Fl τ (y₀, v₀)).1 (Fl τ (y₀, v₀)).2 hj hΦj (hP4 j hj)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = min (ε / 2) (T - τ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hδpos : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; exact lt_min (half_pos hε) (sub_pos.2 hτT)
    have hδε : δ ≤ ε / 2 := by rw [hδ]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hδT : δ ≤ T - τ := by rw [hδ]; exact min_le_right _ _
    have hIcc : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) δ, u ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε := by
      intro u hu

      · linarith [hu.1]
      · linarith [hu.2]
    have hζ1d : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, HasDerivAt (fun s => (ζ s).1) (ζ u).2 u :=
      fun u hu => hfst _ _ u (hζ u hu).1
    have hspeed : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,

            norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _

      intro u hu

        hΦd.comp_hasDerivAt u hd
      have hev : (fun s => Φ i (ζ s).1) =ᶠ[𝓝 u] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hu'.1 hu'.2,

        (hζ u hu').2.1
      rw [Prod.mk.eta] at hX'
      rw [hX']
      exact (hζ u hu').1
    
    have hfd : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun s => Fl (τ + s) (y₀, v₀)) (X (Fl (τ + u) (y₀, v₀))) u :=
      fun u => HasDerivAt.comp_const_add τ u (hFl (τ + u) (y₀, v₀))
    have hEq := ODE_solution_unique (v := fun _ => X) (K := K) (fun _ => hK)
      (f := fun s => Fl (τ + s) (y₀, v₀)) (g := ζ) (a := 0) (b := δ)
      (fun u _ => (hfd u).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun u _ => (hfd u).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun u hu => (hζX u hu).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun u hu => (hζX u (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hu)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (by simp [hζ0])
    have hflow : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) δ, Fl (τ + u) (y₀, v₀) = ζ u := fun u hu => hEq hu
    have hPu : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) δ, τ + u ∈ A := by
      intro u hu
      have hu' := hIcc u hu
      rw [hA, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hflow u hu]
      exact ⟨hZmem u hu, hposY u hu, hζ2 u hu', htan u hu, hspeed u hu'⟩
    have hsub : Set.Icc τ (τ + δ) ⊆ A := by
      intro t ht
      have h := hPu (t - τ) ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
      have e : τ + (t - τ) = t := by ring
      rw [e] at h

  have hsubA := IsClosed.Icc_subset_of_forall_mem_nhdsWithin (hAclosed.inter isClosed_Icc) h0 hopen
  intro t ht
  have h := hsubA ht
  rw [hA, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h

proof.tactics:
by
  have hc : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ((Fl (lam * s) (y₀, v₀)).1, lam • (Fl (lam * s) (y₀, v₀)).2))
        (X ((Fl (lam * s) (y₀, v₀)).1, lam • (Fl (lam * s) (y₀, v₀)).2)) s := by
    intro s hs

      ⟨mul_nonneg hlam.le hs.1, by nlinarith [hs.2]⟩
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := hreg (lam * s) hts
    have ha : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => lam * s) lam s := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul lam
    have hG : HasDerivAt (fun s' : ℝ => Fl (lam * s') (y₀, v₀))
        (lam • X (Fl (lam * s) (y₀, v₀))) s :=
      (hFl (lam * s) (y₀, v₀)).scomp s ha
    rw [hR _ hA] at hG
    let L : (E × E) →L[ℝ] (E × E) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E).prodMap (lam • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)
    have hL := L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hG
    have hfun : (L ∘ fun s' : ℝ => Fl (lam * s') (y₀, v₀)) =
        fun s' : ℝ => ((Fl (lam * s') (y₀, v₀)).1, lam • (Fl (lam * s') (y₀, v₀)).2) := by
      funext s'
      rfl
    rw [hfun] at hL

    rw [hR _ hB]
    simp [L, hQ, smul_smul, sq]
  have hd : ∀ s, HasDerivAt (fun s => Fl s (y₀, lam • v₀)) (X (Fl s (y₀, lam • v₀))) s :=
    fun s => hFl s _

    (HasDerivAt.continuousOn (fun s _ => hd s))
    (fun t _ => (hd t).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (HasDerivAt.continuousOn (fun s hs => hc s hs))
    (fun t ht => (hc t (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self ht)).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (by simp [hFl0])
  have h1 := heq (⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ : (1:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
  simpa using h1

  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : E3 → E3 → ℝ,
      ∀ u w : E3, B u w = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, u k * A k l * w l := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hsymmA : ∀ i j : Fin 3, A i j = A j i := by
    intro i j
    have h := hA.isHermitian.apply i j
    simp only [star_trivial] at h
    linarith [h]
  have hBsymm : ∀ u w : E3, B u w = B w u := by
    intro u w
    simp only [hB, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hsymmA 1 0, hsymmA 2 0, hsymmA 2 1]
    ring
  have hBsmulL : ∀ (s : ℝ) (u w : E3), B (s • u) w = s * B u w := by
    intro s u w
    simp only [hB, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hBsmulR : ∀ (s : ℝ) (u w : E3), B u (s • w) = s * B u w := by
    intro s u w
    simp only [hB, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hBaddL : ∀ u v w : E3, B (u + v) w = B u w + B v w := by
    intro u v w
    simp only [hB, PiLp.add_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hBaddR : ∀ u v w : E3, B u (v + w) = B u v + B u w := by
    intro u v w
    simp only [hB, PiLp.add_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hBsubR : ∀ u v w : E3, B u (v - w) = B u v - B u w := by
    intro u v w
    simp only [hB, PiLp.sub_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hBpos : ∀ u : E3, u ≠ 0 → 0 < B u u := by
    intro u hu
    have hx : (WithLp.ofLp u : Fin 3 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      exact hu (by ext i; simpa using congrFun h i)
    have h := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
    convert h using 1
    simp only [hB, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have he : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (e i) j = if j = i then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro i j
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hgen : ∀ i j m : Fin 3, j ≠ i → m ≠ i → m ≠ j → ℓ (e i) ≠ 0 →
      ∃ w₁ w₂ : E3, ℓ w₁ = 0 ∧ ℓ w₂ = 0 ∧ w₁ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, w₂ - s • w₁ ≠ 0 := by
    intro i j m hji hmi hmj hi
    refine ⟨ℓ (e i) • e j - ℓ (e j) • e i, ℓ (e i) • e m - ℓ (e m) • e i, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    · simp only [map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    · intro h
      have h' := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v j) h
      simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, he, if_pos rfl, if_neg hji,
        PiLp.zero_apply, ↓reduceIte, mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h'
      exact hi h'
    · intro s h
      have h' := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v m) h
      simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, he, if_pos rfl, if_neg hmi,
        if_neg hmj, PiLp.zero_apply, ↓reduceIte, mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h'
      exact hi h'
  have hex : ∃ k : Fin 3, ℓ (e k) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    apply hℓ
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    have hv : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [hv]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcon, mul_zero, add_zero,
      ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, smul_zero]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨w₁, w₂, h₁, h₂, hw₁, hw₂⟩ :
      ∃ w₁ w₂ : E3, ℓ w₁ = 0 ∧ ℓ w₂ = 0 ∧ w₁ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, w₂ - s • w₁ ≠ 0 := by
    fin_cases k
    · exact hgen 0 1 2 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) hk
    · exact hgen 1 0 2 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) hk
    · exact hgen 2 0 1 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) hk
  
  have hq₁ : 0 < B w₁ w₁ := hBpos w₁ hw₁
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = B w₁ w₂ / B w₁ w₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hq₂ : 0 < B (w₂ - c • w₁) (w₂ - c • w₁) := hBpos _ (hw₂ c)
  have horth : B w₁ (w₂ - c • w₁) = 0 := by
    rw [hBsubR, hBsmulR, hc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hq₁.ne', sub_self]
  have horth' : B (w₂ - c • w₁) w₁ = 0 := by rw [hBsymm, horth]
  have hnorm1 : ∀ (u : E3), 0 < B u u →
      B ((Real.sqrt (B u u))⁻¹ • u) ((Real.sqrt (B u u))⁻¹ • u) = 1 := by
    intro u hu
    rw [hBsmulL, hBsmulR, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_inv, Real.mul_self_sqrt hu.le,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hu.ne']
  obtain ⟨u₁, u₂, hℓ₁, hℓ₂, hQ₁, hQ₂, hB₁₂, hB₂₁⟩ : ∃ u₁ u₂ : E3, ℓ u₁ = 0 ∧ ℓ u₂ = 0 ∧
      B u₁ u₁ = 1 ∧ B u₂ u₂ = 1 ∧ B u₁ u₂ = 0 ∧ B u₂ u₁ = 0 := by
    refine ⟨(Real.sqrt (B w₁ w₁))⁻¹ • w₁,
      (Real.sqrt (B (w₂ - c • w₁) (w₂ - c • w₁)))⁻¹ • (w₂ - c • w₁),
      ?_, ?_, hnorm1 _ hq₁, hnorm1 _ hq₂, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [map_smul, h₁, smul_zero]
    · rw [map_smul, map_sub, map_smul, h₁, h₂, smul_zero, sub_zero, smul_zero]
    · rw [hBsmulL, hBsmulR, horth, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    · rw [hBsmulL, hBsmulR, horth', mul_zero, mul_zero]
  
  let L : E2 →L[ℝ] E3 := (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : Fin 2)).smulRight u₁ +
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (1 : Fin 2)).smulRight u₂
  have hL : ∀ x : E2, L x = x 0 • u₁ + x 1 • u₂ := by
    intro x
    rfl
  refine ⟨L, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [hL, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, hℓ₁, hℓ₂, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
  · intro x
    rw [← hB, hL]
    simp only [hBaddL, hBaddR, hBsmulL, hBsmulR, hQ₁, hQ₂, hB₁₂, hB₂₁]
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) : h 0 = 1

signature.name: normal_form_center_eq_one
signature.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) : h 0 = 1

proof.tactics:
by
  ext i j
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun x => h x i j) (0 : E2) :=
    ((hs i j).continuousOn).continuousAt
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hρ))
  set v : E2 := EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) with hv
  have hpath : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t • v) (nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0))
      (nhds (0 : E2)) := by
    have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t • v) (nhds (0 : ℝ)) (nhds ((0 : ℝ) • v)) :=
      (continuous_id.smul continuous_const).tendsto 0
    rw [zero_smul] at h0
    exact h0.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  have hlim := hcont.tendsto.comp hpath
  have hev : ∀ᶠ t in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0),
      (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) i j = ((fun x => h x i j) ∘ (fun t : ℝ => t • v)) t := by
    have hIoo : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) ρ ∈ nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0) := Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hρ
    filter_upwards [hIoo] with t ht
    have hmem : t • v ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := by
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_smul, hv, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht.1]
      exact ht.2
    have h1 := hnf _ hmem i
    have h2 : ∑ k : Fin 2, h (t • v) i k * (t • v) k = h (t • v) i j * t := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · simp [hv]
      · intro b _ hb
        simp [hv, hb]
      · simp
    have h3 : (t • v) i = t * (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) i j := by
      simp [hv, Matrix.one_apply, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [h2, h3] at h1
    have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := ht.1.ne'
    show (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) i j = h (t • v) i j
    exact (mul_right_cancel₀ ht0 (by rw [h1, mul_comm])).symm
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlim (tendsto_const_nhds.congr' hev)

informal_problem.statement: (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsym : H 0 1 = H 1 0) : H.PosDef ↔ 0 < H 0 0 ∧ 0 < H.det

signature.name: posDef_two_iff
signature.statement: (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsym : H 0 1 = H 1 0) : H.PosDef ↔ 0 < H 0 0 ∧ 0 < H.det

proof.tactics:
by
  constructor
  · intro hH
    exact ⟨hH.diag_pos (i := 0), hH.det_pos⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hdet⟩
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two] at hdet
    refine Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos ?_ ?_
    · refine Matrix.IsHermitian.ext ?_
      intro i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [hsym]
    · intro x hx
      have hx' : x 0 ≠ 0 ∨ x 1 ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        apply hx
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        · simpa using hc.1
        · simpa using hc.2
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial]
      rw [← hsym] at hdet ⊢
      have key : H 0 0 * (x 0 * (H 0 0 * x 0 + H 0 1 * x 1) + x 1 * (H 0 1 * x 0 + H 1 1 * x 1))
          = (H 0 0 * x 0 + H 0 1 * x 1) ^ 2 + (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * x 1 ^ 2 := by
        ring
      by_contra hQ
      push_neg at hQ
      have h1 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos ha.le hQ
      rcases hx' with h0 | h1'
      · by_cases hx1 : x 1 = 0
        · rw [hx1] at key h1
          have : 0 < (H 0 0 * x 0) ^ 2 := by
            have : H 0 0 * x 0 ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero ha.ne' h0
            positivity
          nlinarith
        · have : 0 < (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * x 1 ^ 2 := by
            have : 0 < x 1 ^ 2 := by positivity
            exact mul_pos hdet this
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (H 0 0 * x 0 + H 0 1 * x 1)]
      · have : 0 < (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * x 1 ^ 2 := by
          have : 0 < x 1 ^ 2 := by positivity
          exact mul_pos hdet this
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (H 0 0 * x 0 + H 0 1 * x 1)]

informal_problem.statement: (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsym : H 0 1 = H 1 0) (x : E2) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hnf : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, H i j * x j = x i) : H.PosDef ↔ 0 < H 0 0 * x 1 ^ 2 - 2 * H 0 1 * x 0 * x 1 + H 1 1 * x 0 ^ 2

signature.name: normal_form_posDef_iff
signature.statement: (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsym : H 0 1 = H 1 0) (x : E2) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hnf : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, H i j * x j = x i) : H.PosDef ↔ 0 < H 0 0 * x 1 ^ 2 - 2 * H 0 1 * x 0 * x 1 + H 1 1 * x 0 ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have h0 : H 0 0 * x 0 + H 0 1 * x 1 = x 0 := by
    have h := hnf 0
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
    exact h
  have h1 : H 0 1 * x 0 + H 1 1 * x 1 = x 1 := by
    have h := hnf 1
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
    rw [hsym]
    exact h
  have hx' : x 0 ≠ 0 ∨ x 1 ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    apply hx
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hc.1, hc.2]
  have hn : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by
    rcases hx' with h | h
    · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero h, sq_nonneg (x 1)]
    · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero h, sq_nonneg (x 0)]
  have hquad : ∀ v : Fin 2 → ℝ, dotProduct (star v) (H.mulVec v) =
      v 0 * (H 0 0 * v 0 + H 0 1 * v 1) + v 1 * (H 1 0 * v 0 + H 1 1 * v 1) := by
    intro v
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, star_trivial, Pi.star_apply]
  have hherm : H.IsHermitian := by
    apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [hsym]
  have key : ∀ n Q m α β : ℝ, 0 < n → 0 < Q → 0 < m → α ^ 2 + β ^ 2 = n * m →
      0 < n * α ^ 2 + Q * β ^ 2 := by
    intro n Q m α β hn hQ hm hab
    rcases eq_or_ne α 0 with ha | ha
    · subst ha
      have hb : 0 < β ^ 2 := by nlinarith [mul_pos hn hm]
      nlinarith [mul_pos hQ hb]
    · have ha2 : 0 < α ^ 2 := by positivity
      nlinarith [mul_pos hn ha2, mul_nonneg hQ.le (sq_nonneg β)]
  constructor
  · intro hP
    have hv : (![x 1, -x 0] : Fin 2 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have e0 := congrFun h 0
      have e1 := congrFun h 1
      simp at e0 e1
      rcases hx' with h' | h'
      · exact h' e1
      · exact h' e0
    have hpos := hP.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
    rw [hquad] at hpos
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at hpos
    rw [← hsym] at hpos
    linarith
  · intro hQ
    refine Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos hherm ?_
    intro v hv
    rw [hquad, ← hsym]
    have hv' : v 0 ≠ 0 ∨ v 1 ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      apply hv
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [hc.1, hc.2]
    have hm : 0 < v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 := by
      rcases hv' with h | h
      · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero h, sq_nonneg (v 1)]
      · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero h, sq_nonneg (v 0)]
    have hid : (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) ^ 2 *
        (v 0 * (H 0 0 * v 0 + H 0 1 * v 1) + v 1 * (H 0 1 * v 0 + H 1 1 * v 1)) =
        (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * (v 0 * x 0 + v 1 * x 1) ^ 2 +
          (H 0 0 * x 1 ^ 2 - 2 * H 0 1 * x 0 * x 1 + H 1 1 * x 0 ^ 2) *
            (v 0 * x 1 - v 1 * x 0) ^ 2 := by
      linear_combination
        ((v 0 * x 0 + v 1 * x 1) ^ 2 * x 0 +
          2 * (v 0 * x 0 + v 1 * x 1) * (v 0 * x 1 - v 1 * x 0) * x 1) * h0 +
        ((v 0 * x 0 + v 1 * x 1) ^ 2 * x 1 -
          2 * (v 0 * x 0 + v 1 * x 1) * (v 0 * x 1 - v 1 * x 0) * x 0) * h1
    have hlag : (v 0 * x 0 + v 1 * x 1) ^ 2 + (v 0 * x 1 - v 1 * x 0) ^ 2 =
        (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2) := by ring
    have hpos := key _ _ _ _ _ hn hQ hm hlag
    rw [← hid] at hpos
    by_contra hF
    push_neg at hF
    have hn2 : 0 ≤ (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
    nlinarith [mul_nonpos_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨hn2, hF⟩)]

informal_problem.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (L : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, L (e2 j) i = A i j) (hAA : A.transpose * A = 1) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) U) (hdet : ∀ x ∈ U, (h x).det ≠ 0) (y₀ : E2) (hy₀ : L y₀ ∈ U) : gaussCurv2 (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) y₀ = gaussCurv2 h (L y₀)

signature.name: gaussCurv2_orthogonal_comp
signature.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (L : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, L (e2 j) i = A i j) (hAA : A.transpose * A = 1) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) U) (hdet : ∀ x ∈ U, (h x).det ≠ 0) (y₀ : E2) (hy₀ : L y₀ ∈ U) : gaussCurv2 (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) y₀ = gaussCurv2 h (L y₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hAA' : A * A.transpose = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hAA
  have e00 : A 0 0 * A 0 0 + A 0 1 * A 0 1 = 1 := by
    have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hAA' 0) 0
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
    linear_combination h1
  have e01 : A 0 0 * A 1 0 + A 0 1 * A 1 1 = 0 := by
    have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hAA' 0) 1
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
    linear_combination h1
  have e11 : A 1 0 * A 1 0 + A 1 1 * A 1 1 = 1 := by
    have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hAA' 1) 1
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
    linear_combination h1
  have hstar : ∀ E : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ,
      ∑ l : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, A q l * A d l * E q d = ∑ q : Fin 2, E q q := by
    intro E
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    linear_combination E 0 0 * e00 + (E 0 1 + E 1 0) * e01 + E 1 1 * e11
  
  have hinv : ∀ M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, (A.transpose * M * A)⁻¹ = A.transpose * M⁻¹ * A := by
    intro M
    rw [Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hAA,
      Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv hAA', Matrix.mul_assoc]
  
  have s4 : ∀ (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (dH dHt : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ c i j : Fin 2, dHt c i j =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a i * A b j * ∑ d : Fin 2, A d c * dH d a b) →
      ∀ k i j : Fin 2, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (A.transpose * H * A) k l *
          (dHt i j l + dHt j i l - dHt l i j) =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A p k * A a i * A b j *
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, H p l * (dH a b l + dH b a l - dH l a b)) := by
    intro H dH dHt hd k i j
    have hM : ∀ l : Fin 2, (A.transpose * H * A) k l =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, A p k * H p q * A q l := by
      intro l; simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (A.transpose * H * A) k l *
          (dHt i j l + dHt j i l - dHt l i j)
        = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, A q l * A d l *
            (∑ p : Fin 2, A p k * H p q * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a i * A b j *
              (dH a b d + dH b a d - dH d a b)) := by
          simp only [hM, hd, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ q : Fin 2, (∑ p : Fin 2, A p k * H p q * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
            A a i * A b j * (dH a b q + dH b a q - dH q a b)) := by
          rw [hstar (fun q d => ∑ p : Fin 2, A p k * H p q * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
            A a i * A b j * (dH a b d + dH b a d - dH d a b))]
      _ = _ := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
  
  have s5 : ∀ (G Gt : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (D Dt : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ k i j : Fin 2, Gt k i j =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A p k * A a i * A b j * G p a b) →
      (∀ c k i j : Fin 2, Dt c k i j = ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        A p k * A a i * A b j * ∑ d : Fin 2, A d c * D d p a b) →
      ∀ j k : Fin 2,
      (∑ i : Fin 2, (Dt i i j k - Dt j i i k) +
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, (Gt i i p * Gt p j k - Gt i j p * Gt p i k)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b k * (∑ i : Fin 2, (D i i a b - D a i i b) +
          ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, (G i i p * G p a b - G i a p * G p i b)) := by
    intro G Gt D Dt hG hD j k
    have hD1 : ∑ i : Fin 2, Dt i i j k =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b k * ∑ i : Fin 2, D i i a b := by
      calc ∑ i : Fin 2, Dt i i j k
          = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, A p i * A d i *
              (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b k * D d p a b) := by
            simp only [hD, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
        _ = ∑ p : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b k * D p p a b) :=
            hstar (fun p d => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b k * D d p a b)
        _ = _ := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    have hD2 : ∑ i : Fin 2, Dt j i i k =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b k * ∑ i : Fin 2, D a i i b := by
      calc ∑ i : Fin 2, Dt j i i k
          = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, A p i * A a i *
              (∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, A b k * A d j * D d p a b) := by
            simp only [hD, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
        _ = ∑ p : Fin 2, (∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, A b k * A d j * D d p p b) :=
            hstar (fun p a => ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, A b k * A d j * D d p a b)
        _ = _ := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    have hQ1 : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, Gt i i p * Gt p j k =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b k * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, G i i p * G p a b := by
      calc ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, Gt i i p * Gt p j k
          = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, A q i * A a i *
              (∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A b p * G q a b * Gt p j k) := by
            simp only [hG, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
        _ = ∑ q : Fin 2, (∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A b p * G q q b * Gt p j k) :=
            hstar (fun q a => ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A b p * G q a b * Gt p j k)
        _ = ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ r : Fin 2, A b p * A r p *
              ((∑ q : Fin 2, G q q b) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a j * A c k * G r a c) := by
            simp only [hG, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
        _ = ∑ b : Fin 2, ((∑ q : Fin 2, G q q b) *
              ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a j * A c k * G b a c) :=
            hstar (fun b r => (∑ q : Fin 2, G q q b) *
              ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a j * A c k * G r a c)
        _ = _ := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    have hQ2 : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, Gt i j p * Gt p i k =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b k * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, G i a p * G p i b := by
      calc ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, Gt i j p * Gt p i k
          = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, ∑ s : Fin 2, A q i * A s i *
              (∑ p : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b p * G q a b) *
                (∑ r : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A r p * A c k * G r s c)) := by
            simp only [hG, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
        _ = ∑ q : Fin 2, (∑ p : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b p * G q a b) *
                (∑ r : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A r p * A c k * G r q c)) :=
            hstar (fun q s => ∑ p : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b p * G q a b) *
                (∑ r : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A r p * A c k * G r s c))
        _ = ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ r : Fin 2, A b p * A r p *
              (∑ q : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 2, A a j * G q a b) * (∑ c : Fin 2, A c k * G r q c)) := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
        _ = ∑ b : Fin 2, (∑ q : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 2, A a j * G q a b) *
              (∑ c : Fin 2, A c k * G b q c)) :=
            hstar (fun b r => ∑ q : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 2, A a j * G q a b) *
              (∑ c : Fin 2, A c k * G r q c))
        _ = _ := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    have split : (∑ i : Fin 2, (Dt i i j k - Dt j i i k) +
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, (Gt i i p * Gt p j k - Gt i j p * Gt p i k)) =
        (∑ i : Fin 2, Dt i i j k - ∑ i : Fin 2, Dt j i i k) +
        (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, Gt i i p * Gt p j k -
          ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, Gt i j p * Gt p i k) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    rw [split, hD1, hD2, hQ1, hQ2]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
  
  have s6 : ∀ (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (Rm Rt : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ j k : Fin 2, Rt j k = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b k * Rm a b) →
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, (A.transpose * H * A) j k * Rt j k =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, H j k * Rm j k := by
    intro H Rm Rt hR
    have hM : ∀ j k : Fin 2, (A.transpose * H * A) j k =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, A p j * H p q * A q k := by
      intro j k; simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    congr 1
    calc ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, (A.transpose * H * A) j k * Rt j k
        = ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, A p j * A a j *
            (∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A q k * A b k * (H p q * Rm a b)) := by
          simp only [hM, hR, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
      _ = ∑ p : Fin 2, (∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A q k * A b k * (H p q * Rm p b)) :=
          hstar (fun p a => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A q k * A b k * (H p q * Rm a b))
      _ = ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A q k * A b k * (∑ p : Fin 2, H p q * Rm p b) := by
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
      _ = ∑ q : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, H p q * Rm p q := hstar (fun q b => ∑ p : Fin 2, H p q * Rm p b)
      _ = ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, H j k * Rm j k := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
  
  have hLe : ∀ c : Fin 2, L (e2 c) = ∑ d : Fin 2, A d c • e2 d := by
    intro c
    ext m
    rw [hA]
    fin_cases m <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hchain : ∀ (φ : E2 → ℝ) (y : E2), DifferentiableAt ℝ φ (L y) → ∀ c : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (fun z => φ (L z)) y = ∑ d : Fin 2, A d c * pd2 d φ (L y) := by
    intro φ y hφ c
