    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => φ (L z)) ((fderiv ℝ φ (L y)).comp L) y :=
      hφ.hasFDerivAt.comp y L.hasFDerivAt
    simp only [pd2, h1.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hLe, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hd2 : ∀ (w : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (φ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (x : E2),
      (∀ a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (φ a b) x) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, w a b * φ a b z) x ∧
      ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, w a b * φ a b z) x =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, w a b * pd2 c (φ a b) x := by
    intro w φ x hφ
    have H : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, w a b * φ a b z)
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, w a b • fderiv ℝ (φ a b) x) x := by
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum; intro a _
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum; intro b _
      exact (hφ a b).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (w a b)
    refine ⟨H.differentiableAt, fun c => ?_⟩
    simp only [pd2, H.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have hd3 : ∀ (w : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (φ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (x : E2),
      (∀ p a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (φ p a b) x) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, w p a b * φ p a b z) x ∧
      ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun z => ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, w p a b * φ p a b z) x =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, w p a b * pd2 c (φ p a b) x := by
    intro w φ x hφ
    have H : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, w p a b * φ p a b z)
        (∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, w p a b • fderiv ℝ (φ p a b) x) x := by
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum; intro p _
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum; intro a _
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum; intro b _
      exact (hφ p a b).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (w p a b)
    refine ⟨H.differentiableAt, fun c => ?_⟩
    simp only [pd2, H.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h z a b) x :=
    fun x hx a b => ((hs a b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
  have hpdiff : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ i a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 i (fun z => h z a b)) x := by
    intro x hx i a b
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => h z a b) y) U :=
      (hs a b).fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => h z a b) y (e2 i)) U :=
      h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h2.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
  have hinvdiff : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ k l : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ k l) x := by
    intro x hx k l
    have e : (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ k l) = fun z =>
        (h z 0 0 * h z 1 1 - h z 0 1 * h z 1 0)⁻¹ * (h z).adjugate k l := by
      funext z
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.det_fin_two]
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h z 0 0 * h z 1 1 - h z 0 1 * h z 1 0) x :=
      ((hdiff x hx 0 0).mul (hdiff x hx 1 1)).sub ((hdiff x hx 0 1).mul (hdiff x hx 1 0))
    have hne : h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 ≠ 0 := by
      have := hdet x hx
      rwa [Matrix.det_fin_two] at this
    rw [e]
    refine (hD.fun_inv hne).mul ?_
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, hdiff x hx]
  have hΓdiff : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (christoffel2 h k i j) x := by
    intro x hx k i j
    have e : christoffel2 h k i j = fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
        (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x) := by
      funext x; rfl
    rw [e]
    refine DifferentiableAt.const_mul ?_ _
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    refine DifferentiableAt.add ?_ ?_ <;>
    exact (hinvdiff x hx _ _).mul
      (((hpdiff x hx _ _ _).add (hpdiff x hx _ _ _)).sub (hpdiff x hx _ _ _))
  have hconj : ∀ y : E2, L y ∈ U → ∀ c i j : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (fun z => (A.transpose * h (L z) * A) i j) y =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a i * A b j *
          ∑ d : Fin 2, A d c * pd2 d (fun x => h x a b) (L y) := by
    intro y hy c i j
    obtain ⟨hD, hP⟩ := hd2 (fun a b => A a i * A b j) (fun a b x => h x a b) (L y)
      (fun a b => hdiff (L y) hy a b)
    have hP' : ∀ d : Fin 2,
        pd2 d (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a i * A b j * h x a b) (L y) =
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a i * A b j * pd2 d (fun x => h x a b) (L y) :=
      fun d => hP d
    calc pd2 c (fun z => (A.transpose * h (L z) * A) i j) y
        = pd2 c (fun z => (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a i * A b j * h x a b) (L z)) y := by
          congr 1; funext z
          simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
      _ = ∑ d : Fin 2, A d c *
            pd2 d (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a i * A b j * h x a b) (L y) :=
          hchain (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a i * A b j * h x a b) y hD c
      _ = ∑ d : Fin 2, A d c *
            ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a i * A b j * pd2 d (fun x => h x a b) (L y) := by
          simp only [hP']
      _ = _ := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
  have hΓ : ∀ y : E2, L y ∈ U → ∀ k i j : Fin 2,
      christoffel2 (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) k i j y =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A p k * A a i * A b j * christoffel2 h p a b (L y) := by
    intro y hy k i j
    have key := s4 (h (L y))⁻¹ (fun d a b => pd2 d (fun x => h x a b) (L y))
      (fun c a b => pd2 c (fun z => (A.transpose * h (L z) * A) a b) y)
      (fun c a b => hconj y hy c a b) k i j
    simp only [christoffel2, hinv]
    exact key
  have hV : IsOpen (L ⁻¹' U) := hU.preimage L.continuous
  have hDΓ : ∀ c k i j : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (christoffel2 (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) k i j) y₀ =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A p k * A a i * A b j *
          ∑ d : Fin 2, A d c * pd2 d (christoffel2 h p a b) (L y₀) := by
    intro c k i j
    have hev : christoffel2 (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) k i j =ᶠ[𝓝 y₀]
        fun y => (fun x => ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          A p k * A a i * A b j * christoffel2 h p a b x) (L y) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hy₀) (fun y hy => hΓ y hy k i j)
    obtain ⟨hD, hP⟩ := hd3 (fun p a b => A p k * A a i * A b j) (christoffel2 h) (L y₀)
      (fun p a b => hΓdiff (L y₀) hy₀ p a b)
    have hP' : ∀ d : Fin 2, pd2 d (fun x => ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          A p k * A a i * A b j * christoffel2 h p a b x) (L y₀) =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          A p k * A a i * A b j * pd2 d (christoffel2 h p a b) (L y₀) :=
      fun d => hP d
    calc pd2 c (christoffel2 (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) k i j) y₀
        = pd2 c (fun y => (fun x => ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
            A p k * A a i * A b j * christoffel2 h p a b x) (L y)) y₀ := by
          unfold pd2; rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      _ = ∑ d : Fin 2, A d c * pd2 d (fun x => ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
            A p k * A a i * A b j * christoffel2 h p a b x) (L y₀) :=
          hchain (fun x => ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
            A p k * A a i * A b j * christoffel2 h p a b x) y₀ hD c
      _ = ∑ d : Fin 2, A d c * ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
            A p k * A a i * A b j * pd2 d (christoffel2 h p a b) (L y₀) := by
          simp only [hP']
      _ = _ := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
  have hRic : ∀ j k : Fin 2, ricci2 (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) j k y₀ =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a j * A b k * ricci2 h a b (L y₀) := by
    intro j k
    have key := s5 (fun p a b => christoffel2 h p a b (L y₀))
      (fun k i j => christoffel2 (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) k i j y₀)
      (fun d p a b => pd2 d (christoffel2 h p a b) (L y₀))
      (fun c k i j => pd2 c (christoffel2 (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) k i j) y₀)
      (fun k i j => hΓ y₀ hy₀ k i j) hDΓ j k
    simp only [ricci2]
    exact key
  have key := s6 (h (L y₀))⁻¹ (fun a b => ricci2 h a b (L y₀))
    (fun j k => ricci2 (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) j k y₀) hRic
  simp only [gaussCurv2, hinv]
  exact key

informal_problem.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (P : Set E2) (hP : IsOpen P) (h0 : (0 : E2) ∈ P) (hstep : ∀ S : ℝ, 0 < S → S < ρ → Metric.ball (0 : E2) S ⊆ P → Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) S ⊆ P) : Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ⊆ P

signature.name: ball_subset_of_closedBall_step
signature.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (P : Set E2) (hP : IsOpen P) (h0 : (0 : E2) ∈ P) (hstep : ∀ S : ℝ, 0 < S → S < ρ → Metric.ball (0 : E2) S ⊆ P → Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) S ⊆ P) : Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ⊆ P

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx
  by_contra hxP
  have hT : IsClosed Pᶜ := hP.isClosed_compl
  have hne : (Pᶜ).Nonempty := ⟨x, hxP⟩
  have h0T : (0 : E2) ∉ Pᶜ := fun h => h h0
  have hSpos : 0 < Metric.infDist (0 : E2) Pᶜ := (hT.notMem_iff_infDist_pos hne).1 h0T
  have hSle : Metric.infDist (0 : E2) Pᶜ ≤ dist (0 : E2) x := Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem hxP
  have hxρ : dist (0 : E2) x < ρ := by
    rw [dist_comm]; exact Metric.mem_ball.1 hx
  have hball : Metric.ball (0 : E2) (Metric.infDist (0 : E2) Pᶜ) ⊆ P := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : dist (0 : E2) y < Metric.infDist (0 : E2) Pᶜ := by
      rw [dist_comm]; exact Metric.mem_ball.1 hy
    have := Metric.notMem_of_dist_lt_infDist hy'
    simpa using this
  have hcl := hstep _ hSpos (lt_of_le_of_lt hSle hxρ) hball
  obtain ⟨y, hyT, hyd⟩ := hT.exists_infDist_eq_dist hne (0 : E2)
  have hyc : y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (Metric.infDist (0 : E2) Pᶜ) := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_comm, hyd]
  exact hyT (hcl hyc)

informal_problem.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hsymm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), h x i j = h x j i) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (hUρ : U ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ) (htU : t • e2 0 ∈ U) (hdet : ∀ x ∈ U, (h x).det ≠ 0) (q : ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ τ : ℝ, q τ = h (τ • e2 0) 1 1) : 4 * t * q t ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h (t • e2 0) = t * deriv q t ^ 2 - 2 * t * q t * deriv (deriv q) t - 4 * q t * deriv q t

signature.name: normal_form_axis_curvature
signature.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hsymm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), h x i j = h x j i) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (hUρ : U ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ) (htU : t • e2 0 ∈ U) (hdet : ∀ x ∈ U, (h x).det ≠ 0) (q : ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ τ : ℝ, q τ = h (τ • e2 0) 1 1) : 4 * t * q t ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h (t • e2 0) = t * deriv q t ^ 2 - 2 * t * q t * deriv (deriv q) t - 4 * q t * deriv q t

proof.tactics:
by
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := ht.ne'
  
  have hsU : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) U := fun i j => (hs i j).mono hUρ
  have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h z a b) x :=
    fun x hx a b => ((hsU a b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
  have hpdiff : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ i a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 i (fun z => h z a b)) x := by
    intro x hx i a b
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => h z a b) y) U :=
      (hsU a b).fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => h z a b) y (e2 i)) U :=
      h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h2.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
  have hinvE : ∀ (z : E2) (k l : Fin 2), (h z)⁻¹ k l =
      (h z 0 0 * h z 1 1 - h z 0 1 * h z 1 0)⁻¹ * (h z).adjugate k l := by
    intro z k l
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.det_fin_two]
  have hinvdiff : ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ k l : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ k l) x := by
    intro x hx k l
    have e : (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ k l) = fun z =>
        (h z 0 0 * h z 1 1 - h z 0 1 * h z 1 0)⁻¹ * (h z).adjugate k l := by
      funext z
      exact hinvE z k l
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h z 0 0 * h z 1 1 - h z 0 1 * h z 1 0) x :=
      ((hdiff x hx 0 0).mul (hdiff x hx 1 1)).sub ((hdiff x hx 0 1).mul (hdiff x hx 1 0))
    have hne : h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 ≠ 0 := by
      have := hdet x hx
      rwa [Matrix.det_fin_two] at this
    rw [e]
    refine (hD.fun_inv hne).mul ?_
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, hdiff x hx]
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (j : Fin 2) (y : E2),
      HasFDerivAt (fun z : E2 => z j) (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
    fun j y => (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
  have hpc : ∀ (m j : Fin 2) (y : E2), pd2 m (fun z : E2 => z j) y = if m = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro m j y
    simp only [pd2, (hcoord j y).fderiv]
    fin_cases m <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hpn : ∀ (m j : Fin 2) (y : E2), pd2 m (fun z : E2 => -(z j)) y = -(if m = j then 1 else 0) := by
    intro m j y
    have H : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E2 => -(z j)) (-(EuclideanSpace.proj j : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) y :=
      (hcoord j y).neg
    simp only [pd2, H.fderiv]
    fin_cases m <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  have hconst : ∀ (f0 g0 f1 g1 r : E2 → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (y : E2), y ∈ U →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f0 y → DifferentiableAt ℝ g0 y → DifferentiableAt ℝ f1 y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g1 y → DifferentiableAt ℝ r y →
      (∀ z ∈ U, f0 z * g0 z + f1 z * g1 z + r z = c) → ∀ m : Fin 2,
      pd2 m f0 y * g0 y + f0 y * pd2 m g0 y + (pd2 m f1 y * g1 y + f1 y * pd2 m g1 y) +
        pd2 m r y = 0 := by
    intro f0 g0 f1 g1 r c y hy h0 h0' h1 h1' hr hid m
    have H : HasFDerivAt (fun z => f0 z * g0 z + f1 z * g1 z + r z)
        (f0 y • fderiv ℝ g0 y + g0 y • fderiv ℝ f0 y + (f1 y • fderiv ℝ g1 y + g1 y • fderiv ℝ f1 y)
          + fderiv ℝ r y) y :=
      ((h0.hasFDerivAt.mul h0'.hasFDerivAt).add (h1.hasFDerivAt.mul h1'.hasFDerivAt)).add
        hr.hasFDerivAt
    have H2 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => f0 z * g0 z + f1 z * g1 z + r z) (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
      (hasFDerivAt_const c y).congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) hid)
    have := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e2 m)) (H.unique H2)
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at this
    simp only [pd2]
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ : ∃ x₀ : E2, x₀ = t • e2 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hxU : x₀ ∈ U := by rw [hx₀]; exact htU
  have hx0 : x₀ 0 = t := by rw [hx₀]; simp
  have hx1 : x₀ 1 = 0 := by rw [hx₀]; simp
  have hxB : x₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := hUρ hxU
  have h00 : h x₀ 0 0 = 1 := by
    have e := hnf x₀ hxB 0
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hx0, hx1] at e
    have : (h x₀ 0 0 - 1) * t = 0 := by linear_combination e
    have := (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_right ht0
    linarith
  have h10 : h x₀ 1 0 = 0 := by
    have e := hnf x₀ hxB 1
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hx0, hx1] at e
    have : h x₀ 1 0 * t = 0 := by linear_combination e
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_right ht0
  have h01 : h x₀ 0 1 = 0 := by rw [hsymm]; exact h10
  have hQ0 : h x₀ 1 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have := hdet x₀ hxU
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, h00, h01, h10] at this
    simpa using this
  have hi00 : (h x₀)⁻¹ 0 0 = 1 := by
    rw [hinvE]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, h00, h01, h10, hQ0]
  have hi01 : (h x₀)⁻¹ 0 1 = 0 := by
    rw [hinvE]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, h00, h01, h10]
  have hi10 : (h x₀)⁻¹ 1 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hinvE]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, h00, h01, h10]
  have hi11 : (h x₀)⁻¹ 1 1 = (h x₀ 1 1)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hinvE]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, h00, h01, h10]
  have hfs : (fun z => h z 0 1) = (fun z => h z 1 0) := funext fun z => hsymm z 0 1
  
  have J1 : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ i k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun w => h w i 0) z * z 0 +
      pd2 k (fun w => h w i 1) z * z 1 + h z i k = if i = k then 1 else 0 := by
    intro z hz i k
    have e := hconst (fun w => h w i 0) (fun w => w 0) (fun w => h w i 1) (fun w => w 1)
      (fun w => -(w i)) 0 z hz (hdiff z hz i 0) (hcoord 0 z).differentiableAt (hdiff z hz i 1)
      (hcoord 1 z).differentiableAt (hcoord i z).neg.differentiableAt
      (by
        intro w hw
        have := hnf w (hUρ hw) i
        rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at this
        linarith) k
    simp only [hpc, hpn] at e
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases k <;> simp at e ⊢ <;> linarith
  have J2 : ∀ i k l : Fin 2, pd2 l (pd2 k (fun w => h w i 0)) x₀ * x₀ 0 +
      pd2 k (fun w => h w i 0) x₀ * (if l = 0 then 1 else 0) +
      (pd2 l (pd2 k (fun w => h w i 1)) x₀ * x₀ 1 +
        pd2 k (fun w => h w i 1) x₀ * (if l = 1 then 1 else 0)) +
      pd2 l (fun w => h w i k) x₀ = 0 := by
    intro i k l
    have e := hconst (pd2 k (fun w => h w i 0)) (fun w => w 0) (pd2 k (fun w => h w i 1))
      (fun w => w 1) (fun w => h w i k) (if i = k then 1 else 0) x₀ hxU (hpdiff x₀ hxU k i 0)
      (hcoord 0 x₀).differentiableAt (hpdiff x₀ hxU k i 1) (hcoord 1 x₀).differentiableAt
      (hdiff x₀ hxU i k) (fun z hz => J1 z hz i k) l
    simpa only [hpc] using e
  have d000 : pd2 0 (fun z => h z 0 0) x₀ = 0 := by
    have e := J1 x₀ hxU 0 0
    rw [if_pos rfl, hx0, hx1, h00] at e
    have : pd2 0 (fun z => h z 0 0) x₀ * t = 0 := by linear_combination e
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_right ht0
  have d100 : pd2 1 (fun z => h z 0 0) x₀ = 0 := by
    have e := J1 x₀ hxU 0 1
    rw [if_neg (by decide), hx0, hx1, h01] at e
    have : pd2 1 (fun z => h z 0 0) x₀ * t = 0 := by linear_combination e
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_right ht0
  have d010 : pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 0) x₀ = 0 := by
    have e := J1 x₀ hxU 1 0
    rw [if_neg (by decide), hx0, hx1, h10] at e
    have : pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 0) x₀ * t = 0 := by linear_combination e
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_right ht0
  have d110 : pd2 1 (fun z => h z 1 0) x₀ = (1 - h x₀ 1 1) / t := by
    have e := J1 x₀ hxU 1 1
    rw [if_pos rfl, hx0, hx1] at e
    rw [eq_div_iff ht0]
    linear_combination e
  have d001 : pd2 0 (fun z => h z 0 1) x₀ = 0 := by rw [hfs]; exact d010
  have d101 : pd2 1 (fun z => h z 0 1) x₀ = (1 - h x₀ 1 1) / t := by rw [hfs]; exact d110
  have e1100 : pd2 1 (pd2 1 (fun z => h z 0 0)) x₀ = -(2 * pd2 1 (fun z => h z 0 1) x₀) / t := by
    have e := J2 0 1 1
    rw [if_neg (by decide), if_pos rfl, hx0, hx1] at e
    rw [eq_div_iff ht0]
    linear_combination e
  have e1010 : pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 0)) x₀ =
      -(pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀ + pd2 1 (fun z => h z 1 0) x₀) / t := by
    have e := J2 1 0 1
    rw [if_neg (by decide), if_pos rfl, hx0, hx1] at e
    rw [eq_div_iff ht0]
    linear_combination e
  have e0110 : pd2 0 (pd2 1 (fun z => h z 1 0)) x₀ =
      -(pd2 1 (fun z => h z 1 0) x₀ + pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀) / t := by
    have e := J2 1 1 0
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg (by decide), hx0, hx1] at e
    rw [eq_div_iff ht0]
    linear_combination e
  have e1001 : pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun z => h z 0 1)) x₀ =
      -(pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀ + pd2 1 (fun z => h z 1 0) x₀) / t := by rw [hfs]; exact e1010
  have e0101 : pd2 0 (pd2 1 (fun z => h z 0 1)) x₀ =
      -(pd2 1 (fun z => h z 1 0) x₀ + pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀) / t := by rw [hfs]; exact e0110
  
  have hmul : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ a l : Fin 2,
      h z a 0 * (h z)⁻¹ 0 l + h z a 1 * (h z)⁻¹ 1 l + 0 = if a = l then 1 else 0 := by
    intro z hz a l
    have hu : IsUnit (h z).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hdet z hz)
    have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (h z) hu) a) l
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.one_apply] at this
    rw [add_zero, this]
  have hDHi : ∀ a l m : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun z => h z a 0) x₀ * (h x₀)⁻¹ 0 l +
      h x₀ a 0 * pd2 m (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 l) x₀ +
      (pd2 m (fun z => h z a 1) x₀ * (h x₀)⁻¹ 1 l + h x₀ a 1 * pd2 m (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 l) x₀) +
      pd2 m (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x₀ = 0 :=
    fun a l m => hconst (fun z => h z a 0) (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 l) (fun z => h z a 1)
      (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 l) (fun _ => 0) (if a = l then 1 else 0) x₀ hxU (hdiff x₀ hxU a 0)
      (hinvdiff x₀ hxU 0 l) (hdiff x₀ hxU a 1) (hinvdiff x₀ hxU 1 l) (differentiableAt_const _)
      (fun z hz => hmul z hz a l) m
  have hpd0 : ∀ m : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x₀ = 0 := by intro m; simp [pd2]
  have dHi0_00 : pd2 0 (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 0) x₀ = 0 := by
    have e := hDHi 0 0 0
    rw [d000, d001, hi00, hi10, h00, h01, hpd0] at e
    linarith
  have dHi0_01 : pd2 0 (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 1) x₀ = 0 := by
    have e := hDHi 0 1 0
    rw [d000, d001, h00, h01, hpd0] at e
    linarith
  have dHi0_11 : pd2 0 (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 1) x₀ =
      -(pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀) / h x₀ 1 1 ^ 2 := by
    have e := hDHi 1 1 0
    rw [d010, h10, hi11, hpd0] at e
    rw [eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero 2 hQ0)]
    field_simp at e
    linear_combination e
  have dHi1_01 : pd2 1 (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 1) x₀ =
      -(pd2 1 (fun z => h z 0 1) x₀) / h x₀ 1 1 := by
    have e := hDHi 0 1 1
    rw [d100, h00, h01, hi11, hpd0] at e
    rw [eq_div_iff hQ0]
    field_simp at e
    linear_combination e
  
  have hDΓ : ∀ k i j m : Fin 2, pd2 m (christoffel2 h k i j) x₀ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2,
      (pd2 m (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ k l) x₀ *
          (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x₀ + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x₀ - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x₀) +
        (h x₀)⁻¹ k l * (pd2 m (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l)) x₀ + pd2 m (pd2 j (fun z => h z i l)) x₀ -
          pd2 m (pd2 l (fun z => h z i j)) x₀)) := by
    intro k i j m
    have hB : ∀ l : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ k l *
        (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x))
        ((h x₀)⁻¹ k l • (fderiv ℝ (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l)) x₀ +
            fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (fun z => h z i l)) x₀ - fderiv ℝ (pd2 l (fun z => h z i j)) x₀) +
          (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x₀ + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x₀ -
            pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x₀) • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ k l) x₀) x₀ := by
      intro l
      exact (hinvdiff x₀ hxU k l).hasFDerivAt.mul
        ((((hpdiff x₀ hxU i j l).hasFDerivAt).add (hpdiff x₀ hxU j i l).hasFDerivAt).sub
          (hpdiff x₀ hxU l i j).hasFDerivAt)
    have H : HasFDerivAt (christoffel2 h k i j) ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ∑ l : Fin 2,
        ((h x₀)⁻¹ k l • (fderiv ℝ (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l)) x₀ +
            fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (fun z => h z i l)) x₀ - fderiv ℝ (pd2 l (fun z => h z i j)) x₀) +
          (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x₀ + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x₀ -
            pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x₀) • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ k l) x₀)) x₀ := by
      have e : christoffel2 h k i j = fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
          (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x) := by
        funext x; rfl
      rw [e]
      apply HasFDerivAt.const_mul
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
      intro l _
      exact hB l
    show fderiv ℝ (christoffel2 h k i j) x₀ (e2 m) = _
    rw [H.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [pd2]
    ring
  
  have Γ000 : christoffel2 h 0 0 0 x₀ = 0 := by
    simp only [christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hi00, hi01, d000, d100, d001]
    ring
  have Γ001 : christoffel2 h 0 0 1 x₀ = 0 := by
    simp only [christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hi00, hi01, d100, d001, d010, d101]
    ring
  have Γ010 : christoffel2 h 0 1 0 x₀ = 0 := by
    simp only [christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hi00, hi01, d100, d010, d101, d110]
    ring
  have Γ011 : christoffel2 h 0 1 1 x₀ =
      (1 - h x₀ 1 1) / t - pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀ / 2 := by
    simp only [christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hi00, hi01, d110]
    ring
  have Γ100 : christoffel2 h 1 0 0 x₀ = 0 := by
    simp only [christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hi10, hi11, d000, d100, d001]
    ring
  have Γ101 : christoffel2 h 1 0 1 x₀ = pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀ / (2 * h x₀ 1 1) := by
    simp only [christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hi10, hi11, d100, d010, d101]
    field_simp
    ring
  have Γ110 : christoffel2 h 1 1 0 x₀ = pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀ / (2 * h x₀ 1 1) := by
    simp only [christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hi10, hi11, d010, d101, d110]
    field_simp
    ring
  have Γ111 : christoffel2 h 1 1 1 x₀ = pd2 1 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀ / (2 * h x₀ 1 1) := by
    simp only [christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hi10, hi11, d110]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have P1 : pd2 1 (christoffel2 h 1 0 0) x₀ =
      -(pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀ / (h x₀ 1 1 * t)) := by
    rw [hDΓ]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hi10, hi11, d000, d100, d001, d101, d110, e1100, e1001]
    field_simp
    ring
  have P2 : pd2 0 (christoffel2 h 1 1 0) x₀ =
      (pd2 0 (pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1)) x₀ / h x₀ 1 1 -
        pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀ ^ 2 / h x₀ 1 1 ^ 2) / 2 := by
    rw [hDΓ]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hi10, hi11, d100, d010, d101, d110, e0101, e0110, dHi0_11]
    field_simp
    ring
  have P3 : pd2 0 (christoffel2 h 0 1 1) x₀ =
      -((pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀ + (1 - h x₀ 1 1) / t) / t) -
        pd2 0 (pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1)) x₀ / 2 := by
    rw [hDΓ]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hi00, hi01, d110, e0110, dHi0_00, dHi0_01]
    field_simp
    ring
  have P4 : pd2 1 (christoffel2 h 0 0 1) x₀ =
      -((1 - h x₀ 1 1) * pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀ / (2 * t * h x₀ 1 1)) -
        (1 - h x₀ 1 1) / t ^ 2 := by
    rw [hDΓ]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hi00, hi01, d100, d001, d010, d101, d110, e1010, e1100,
      e1001, dHi1_01]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hray : ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (τ : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ w (τ • e2 0) →
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => w (s • e2 0)) (pd2 0 w (τ • e2 0)) τ := by
    intro w τ hw
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s • e2 0) ((1 : ℝ) • e2 0) τ :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' τ).smul_const (e2 0)
    have h2 := hw.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt τ h1
    simpa [pd2, Function.comp_def] using h2
  have hV : IsOpen {s : ℝ | s • e2 0 ∈ U} := hU.preimage (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
  have hqfun : q = fun s => h (s • e2 0) 1 1 := funext hq
  have hdq : ∀ s ∈ {s : ℝ | s • e2 0 ∈ U}, deriv q s = pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) (s • e2 0) := by
    intro s hs
    rw [hqfun]
    exact (hray (fun z => h z 1 1) s (hdiff _ hs 1 1)).deriv
  have hdq_t : deriv q t = pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) x₀ := by rw [hdq t htU, hx₀]
  have hddq_t : deriv (deriv q) t = pd2 0 (pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1)) x₀ := by
    have hev : deriv q =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun s => pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1) (s • e2 0) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds htU) hdq
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, hx₀]
    exact (hray (pd2 0 (fun z => h z 1 1)) t (hpdiff _ htU 0 1 1)).deriv
  have hqt : q t = h x₀ 1 1 := by rw [hq t, hx₀]
  
  rw [← hx₀, hdq_t, hddq_t, hqt]
  simp only [gaussCurv2, ricci2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hi00, hi01, hi10, hi11, Γ000, Γ001, Γ010, Γ011,
    Γ100, Γ101, Γ110, Γ111, P1, P2, P3, P4]
  field_simp
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hsymm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), h x i j = h x j i) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (θ : E2) (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) : ∃ (L : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, L (e2 j) i = A i j) ∧ A.transpose * A = 1 ∧ (∀ y : E2, ‖L y‖ = ‖y‖) ∧ (∀ τ : ℝ, L (τ • e2 0) = τ • θ) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) ∧ (∀ (y : E2) (i j : Fin 2), (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j = (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) j i) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j * y j = y i) ∧ (∀ y : E2, (A.transpose * h (L y) * A).det = (h (L y)).det) ∧ (∀ τ : ℝ, (A.transpose * h (L (τ • e2 0)) * A) 1 1 = h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1 ^ 2 - 2 * h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 * θ 1 + h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 ^ 2)

signature.name: normal_form_rotate
signature.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hsymm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), h x i j = h x j i) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (θ : E2) (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) : ∃ (L : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, L (e2 j) i = A i j) ∧ A.transpose * A = 1 ∧ (∀ y : E2, ‖L y‖ = ‖y‖) ∧ (∀ τ : ℝ, L (τ • e2 0) = τ • θ) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) ∧ (∀ (y : E2) (i j : Fin 2), (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j = (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) j i) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j * y j = y i) ∧ (∀ y : E2, (A.transpose * h (L y) * A).det = (h (L y)).det) ∧ (∀ τ : ℝ, (A.transpose * h (L (τ • e2 0)) * A) 1 1 = h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1 ^ 2 - 2 * h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 * θ 1 + h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hθsq : θ 0 ^ 2 + θ 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h1 := EuclideanSpace.norm_eq θ
    rw [hθ, Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1
    have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt (‖θ 0‖ ^ 2 + ‖θ 1‖ ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by rw [← h1]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs] at h2
    linarith
  let A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := !![θ 0, -θ 1; θ 1, θ 0]
  let L : E2 →L[ℝ] E2 := Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A
  have hA00 : A 0 0 = θ 0 := rfl
  have hA01 : A 0 1 = -θ 1 := rfl
  have hA10 : A 1 0 = θ 1 := rfl
  have hA11 : A 1 1 = θ 0 := rfl
  have hLc : ∀ (y : E2) (i : Fin 2), L y i = ∑ j : Fin 2, A i j * y j := by
    intro y i
    have := congrFun (Matrix.ofLp_toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) A y) i
    rw [this]
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  have hL0 : ∀ y : E2, L y 0 = θ 0 * y 0 - θ 1 * y 1 := by
    intro y
    rw [hLc, Fin.sum_univ_two, hA00, hA01] <;> ring
  have hL1 : ∀ y : E2, L y 1 = θ 1 * y 0 + θ 0 * y 1 := by
    intro y
    rw [hLc, Fin.sum_univ_two, hA10, hA11] <;> ring
  have hentry : ∀ (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (i j : Fin 2), (A.transpose * H * A) i j =
      (A 0 i * H 0 0 + A 1 i * H 1 0) * A 0 j + (A 0 i * H 0 1 + A 1 i * H 1 1) * A 1 j := by
    intro H i j
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hAA : A.transpose * A = 1 := by
    have e : ∀ i j : Fin 2, (A.transpose * A) i j = A 0 i * A 0 j + A 1 i * A 1 j := by
      intro i j
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ext i j
    rw [e]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · show A 0 0 * A 0 0 + A 1 0 * A 1 0 = 1
      rw [hA00, hA10]; linear_combination hθsq
    · show A 0 0 * A 0 1 + A 1 0 * A 1 1 = 0
      rw [hA00, hA01, hA10, hA11]; ring
    · show A 0 1 * A 0 0 + A 1 1 * A 1 0 = 0
      rw [hA00, hA01, hA10, hA11]; ring
    · show A 0 1 * A 0 1 + A 1 1 * A 1 1 = 1
      rw [hA01, hA11]; linear_combination hθsq
  have hLn : ∀ y : E2, ‖L y‖ = ‖y‖ := by
    intro y
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    congr 1
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    rw [hL0, hL1]
    linear_combination (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) * hθsq
  have hc1 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, L (e2 j) i = A i j := by
    intro i j
    rw [hLc]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [e2, Fin.sum_univ_two, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hc4 : ∀ τ : ℝ, L (τ • e2 0) = τ • θ := by
    intro τ
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · show L (τ • e2 0) 0 = (τ • θ) 0
      rw [hL0]
      simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> ring
    · show L (τ • e2 0) 1 = (τ • θ) 1
      rw [hL1]
      simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> ring
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo L (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hy ⊢
    rw [hLn]
    exact hy
  have hcomp : ∀ b e : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h (L y) b e) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) :=
    fun b e => (hs b e).comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn hmaps
  have hc5 : ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ) := by
    intro i j
    have hf : (fun y => (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j) = fun y =>
        (A 0 i * h (L y) 0 0 + A 1 i * h (L y) 1 0) * A 0 j +
          (A 0 i * h (L y) 0 1 + A 1 i * h (L y) 1 1) * A 1 j :=
      funext fun y => hentry _ i j
    rw [hf]
    exact (((contDiffOn_const.mul (hcomp 0 0)).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hcomp 1 0))).mul
      contDiffOn_const).add
      (((contDiffOn_const.mul (hcomp 0 1)).add (contDiffOn_const.mul (hcomp 1 1))).mul
        contDiffOn_const)
  have hc6 : ∀ (y : E2) (i j : Fin 2),
      (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j = (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) j i := by
    intro y i j
    rw [hentry, hentry, hsymm (L y) 1 0]
    ring
  have hc7 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ∑ j : Fin 2, (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j * y j = y i := by
    intro y hy i
    have E0 := hnf (L y) (hmaps hy) 0
    have E1 := hnf (L y) (hmaps hy) 1
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hL0, hL1] at E0 E1
    have key0 : ∑ j : Fin 2, (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) 0 j * y j = y 0 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hentry, hentry, hA00, hA01, hA10, hA11]
      linear_combination θ 0 * E0 + θ 1 * E1 + y 0 * hθsq
    have key1 : ∑ j : Fin 2, (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) 1 j * y j = y 1 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hentry, hentry, hA00, hA01, hA10, hA11]
      linear_combination (-θ 1) * E0 + θ 0 * E1 + y 1 * hθsq
    fin_cases i
    · exact key0
    · exact key1
  have hdetA : A.det * A.det = 1 := by
    have := congrArg Matrix.det hAA
    rwa [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at this
  have hc8 : ∀ y : E2, (A.transpose * h (L y) * A).det = (h (L y)).det := by
    intro y
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
    linear_combination (h (L y)).det * hdetA
  have hc9 : ∀ τ : ℝ, (A.transpose * h (L (τ • e2 0)) * A) 1 1 =
      h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1 ^ 2 - 2 * h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 * θ 1 + h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 ^ 2 := by
    intro τ
    rw [hc4, hentry, hA01, hA11, hsymm (τ • θ) 1 0]
    ring
  exact ⟨L, A, hc1, hAA, hLn, hc4, hc5, hc6, hc7, hc8, hc9⟩

informal_problem.statement: (k S : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hS : 0 < S) (hkS : k * S ^ 2 ≤ 1) (q q1 q2 : ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico 0 S, HasDerivAt q (q1 τ) τ) (hq1 : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico 0 S, HasDerivAt q1 (q2 τ) τ) (hq0 : q 0 = 1) (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico 0 S, 0 < q τ) (hode : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 S, τ * q1 τ ^ 2 - 2 * τ * q τ * q2 τ - 4 * q τ * q1 τ ≤ 4 * k * τ * q τ ^ 2) : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 S, 1 / 4 ≤ q τ

signature.name: sturm_q_lower_bound
signature.statement: (k S : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hS : 0 < S) (hkS : k * S ^ 2 ≤ 1) (q q1 q2 : ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico 0 S, HasDerivAt q (q1 τ) τ) (hq1 : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico 0 S, HasDerivAt q1 (q2 τ) τ) (hq0 : q 0 = 1) (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico 0 S, 0 < q τ) (hode : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 S, τ * q1 τ ^ 2 - 2 * τ * q τ * q2 τ - 4 * q τ * q1 τ ≤ 4 * k * τ * q τ ^ 2) : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 S, 1 / 4 ≤ q τ

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have mono : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico 0 S, HasDerivAt f (f' τ) τ) →
      (∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 S, 0 ≤ f' τ) → ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico 0 S, f 0 ≤ f τ := by
    intro f f' hf hf' τ hτ
    have hmono : MonotoneOn f (Set.Ico 0 S) := by
      apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ico 0 S)
      · exact HasDerivAt.continuousOn hf
      · rw [interior_Ico]
        intro x hx
        exact (hf x (Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self hx)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      · rw [interior_Ico]
        intro x hx
        rw [(hf x (Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self hx)).deriv]
        exact hf' x hx
    exact hmono ⟨le_refl 0, lt_of_le_of_lt hτ.1 hτ.2⟩ hτ hτ.1
  
  have hp : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico 0 S, 1 / 2 ≤ 1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2 ∧ 1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2 ≤ 1 := by
    intro τ hτ
    have h1 : τ ^ 2 ≤ S ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hτ.1 hτ.2.le 2
    have h2 : k * τ ^ 2 ≤ k * S ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hk
    have h3 : 0 ≤ k * τ ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hk (sq_nonneg τ)
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hP : ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) (-(k * τ)) τ := by
    intro τ
    have := (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 τ).const_mul k).div_const 2).const_sub 1
    convert this using 1
    push_cast
    ring
  
  have hPhi : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico 0 S, HasDerivAt
      (fun t => t ^ 2 * (q1 t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) + 2 * k * t * q t) / Real.sqrt (q t))
      ((2 * q τ * (2 * τ * q1 τ * (1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2) + 6 * k * τ ^ 2 * q τ
          + τ ^ 2 * q2 τ * (1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2) + k * τ ^ 3 * q1 τ)
        - q1 τ * (τ ^ 2 * (q1 τ * (1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2) + 2 * k * τ * q τ)))
        / (2 * q τ * Real.sqrt (q τ))) τ := by
    intro τ hτ
    have hqd := hq τ hτ
    have hq1d := hq1 τ hτ
    have hqp := hpos τ hτ
    have h2kt : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 2 * k * t) (2 * k) τ := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id τ).const_mul (2 * k)
    have hN : HasDerivAt (fun t => t ^ 2 * (q1 t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) + 2 * k * t * q t))
        (2 * τ * q1 τ * (1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2) + 6 * k * τ ^ 2 * q τ
          + τ ^ 2 * q2 τ * (1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2) + k * τ ^ 3 * q1 τ) τ := by
      have := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 τ).mul ((hq1d.mul (hP τ)).add (h2kt.mul hqd))
      convert this using 1
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.add_apply]
      push_cast
      ring
    have hsq : HasDerivAt (fun t => Real.sqrt (q t)) (q1 τ / (2 * Real.sqrt (q τ))) τ :=
      hqd.sqrt hqp.ne'
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (q τ) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hqp
    have hdiv := hN.div hsq hs.ne'
    convert hdiv using 1
    have hss : q τ = Real.sqrt (q τ) ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hqp.le).symm
    set s := Real.sqrt (q τ) with hsdef
    rw [hss]
    field_simp
  
  have hH : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ico 0 S, HasDerivAt (fun t => q t / (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) ^ 2)
      ((q1 τ * (1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2) + 2 * k * τ * q τ) / (1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2) ^ 3) τ := by
    intro τ hτ
    have hpne : 1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2 ≠ 0 := by
      have := (hp τ hτ).1
      intro h
      linarith
    have hdiv := (hq τ hτ).div ((hP τ).pow 2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hpne)
    convert hdiv using 1
    simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hPhid : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 S,
      0 ≤ (2 * q t * (2 * t * q1 t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) + 6 * k * t ^ 2 * q t
          + t ^ 2 * q2 t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) + k * t ^ 3 * q1 t)
        - q1 t * (t ^ 2 * (q1 t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) + 2 * k * t * q t)))
        / (2 * q t * Real.sqrt (q t)) := by
    intro t ht
    have htI := Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self ht
    have hqp := hpos t htI
    obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hp t htI
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (q t) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hqp
    apply div_nonneg _ (by positivity)
    have key := hode t ht
    have htp : 0 ≤ t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) := mul_nonneg ht.1.le (by linarith)
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key htp
    have h2 : 0 ≤ k * t ^ 2 * q t ^ 2 * (3 - (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2)) := by
      apply mul_nonneg
      · positivity
      · linarith
    have hid : 2 * q t * (2 * t * q1 t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) + 6 * k * t ^ 2 * q t
          + t ^ 2 * q2 t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) + k * t ^ 3 * q1 t)
        - q1 t * (t ^ 2 * (q1 t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) + 2 * k * t * q t))
        = -(t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2)) * (t * q1 t ^ 2 - 2 * t * q t * q2 t - 4 * q t * q1 t)
          + 12 * k * t ^ 2 * q t ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [hid]
    nlinarith [h1, h2]
  
  have hV : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 S, 0 ≤ q1 t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) + 2 * k * t * q t := by
    intro t ht
    have htI := Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self ht
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (q t) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos t htI)
    have hΦ := mono _ _ hPhi hPhid t htI
    simp only [ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, zero_mul,
      zero_div] at hΦ
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hs, zero_mul] at hΦ
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    have : t ^ 2 * (q1 t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) + 2 * k * t * q t) < 0 :=
      mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by have := ht.1; positivity) hneg
    linarith
  
  have hHd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 S,
      0 ≤ (q1 t * (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) + 2 * k * t * q t) / (1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2) ^ 3 := by
    intro t ht
    have := (hp t (Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self ht)).1
    apply div_nonneg (hV t ht)
    have : 0 < 1 - k * t ^ 2 / 2 := by linarith
    positivity
  intro τ hτ
  have hτI := Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self hτ
  have hHm := mono _ _ hH hHd τ hτI
  simp only [hq0, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, mul_zero,
    zero_div, sub_zero, one_pow, div_one] at hHm
  obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hp τ hτI
  have hp0 : 0 < (1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2) ^ 2 := by
    have : 0 < 1 - k * τ ^ 2 / 2 := by linarith
    positivity
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hp0, one_mul] at hHm
  nlinarith [hHm, hp1]

informal_problem.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) (hhsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) : ∀ x ∈ s, gaussCurv2 h x * (h x).det = ggeRiem0110 h x

signature.name: gge_gauss_intrinsic
signature.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) (hhsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) : ∀ x ∈ s, gaussCurv2 h x * (h x).det = ggeRiem0110 h x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx
  
  have pd_add : ∀ (u v : E2 → ℝ) (y : E2) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ u y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ v y → pd2 k (fun z => u z + v z) y = pd2 k u y + pd2 k v y := by
    intro u v y k hu hv
    show fderiv ℝ (u + v) y (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ u y (e2 k) + fderiv ℝ v y (e2 k)
    rw [(hu.hasFDerivAt.add hv.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
    rfl
  have pd_mul : ∀ (u v : E2 → ℝ) (y : E2) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ u y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ v y → pd2 k (fun z => u z * v z) y = u y * pd2 k v y + v y * pd2 k u y := by
    intro u v y k hu hv
    show fderiv ℝ (u * v) y (e2 k) = u y * fderiv ℝ v y (e2 k) + v y * fderiv ℝ u y (e2 k)
    rw [(hu.hasFDerivAt.mul hv.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have dmul : ∀ (u v : E2 → ℝ) (y : E2), DifferentiableAt ℝ u y → DifferentiableAt ℝ v y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => u z * v z) y := fun u v y hu hv => hu.mul hv
  have pd_congr : ∀ (u v : E2 → ℝ) (y : E2) (k : Fin 2), u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] v → pd2 k u y = pd2 k v y := by
    intro u v y k huv
    unfold pd2
    rw [huv.fderiv_eq]
  have pd_const : ∀ (c : ℝ) (y : E2) (k : Fin 2), pd2 k (fun _ => c) y = 0 := by
    intro c y k
    simp [pd2]
  
  have hpdC : ∀ a b k : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 k (fun w => h w a b)) s := by
    intro a b k
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun w => h w a b)) s :=
      (hh a b).fderiv_of_isOpen hs (m := ∞) (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hΓ1C : ∀ m i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ggeGam1 h m i j) s := by
    intro m i j
    exact (contDiffOn_const (c := (1 / 2 : ℝ))).mul
      (((hpdC j m i).add (hpdC i m j)).sub (hpdC i j m))
  have hΓ1d : ∀ m i j : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ (ggeGam1 h m i j) z :=
    fun m i j z hz => ((hΓ1C m i j).contDiffAt (hs.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hd : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h z a b) x :=
    fun a b => ((hh a b).contDiffAt (hs.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hcompat : ∀ z ∈ s, ∀ k a b : Fin 2,
      pd2 k (fun w => h w a b) z = ggeGam1 h a k b z + ggeGam1 h b k a z := by
    intro z hz k a b
    have e : pd2 k (fun w => h w b a) z = pd2 k (fun w => h w a b) z := by
      apply pd_congr
      filter_upwards [hs.mem_nhds hz] with w hw
      exact hhsymm w hw b a
    simp only [ggeGam1]
    rw [e]
    ring
  
  have hunitz : ∀ z ∈ s, IsUnit (h z).det := fun z hz =>
    isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hhpos z hz).det_pos.ne'
  have hunitx := hunitz x hx
  have hmulz : ∀ z ∈ s, h z * (h z)⁻¹ = 1 := fun z hz => Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (hunitz z hz)
  have hent : ∀ z, (h z)⁻¹ 0 0 = ((h z).det)⁻¹ * h z 1 1 ∧
      (h z)⁻¹ 0 1 = ((h z).det)⁻¹ * -h z 0 1 ∧
      (h z)⁻¹ 1 0 = ((h z).det)⁻¹ * -h z 1 0 ∧
      (h z)⁻¹ 1 1 = ((h z).det)⁻¹ * h z 0 0 := by
    intro z
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    simp [Matrix.smul_apply]
  have hdetd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z).det) x := by
    have e : (fun z => (h z).det) = fun z => h z 0 0 * h z 1 1 - h z 0 1 * h z 1 0 :=
      funext fun z => Matrix.det_fin_two _
    rw [e]
    exact ((hd 0 0).mul (hd 1 1)).sub ((hd 0 1).mul (hd 1 0))
  have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ((h z).det)⁻¹) x := hdetd.inv hunitx.ne_zero
  have hinvd : ∀ l q : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ l q) x := by
    simp only [Fin.forall_fin_two]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · have e : (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 0) = fun z => ((h z).det)⁻¹ * h z 1 1 :=
        funext fun z => (hent z).1
      rw [e]; exact hD.mul (hd 1 1)
    · have e : (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 1) = fun z => ((h z).det)⁻¹ * -h z 0 1 :=
        funext fun z => (hent z).2.1
      rw [e]; exact hD.mul (hd 0 1).neg
    · have e : (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 0) = fun z => ((h z).det)⁻¹ * -h z 1 0 :=
        funext fun z => (hent z).2.2.1
      rw [e]; exact hD.mul (hd 1 0).neg
    · have e : (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 1) = fun z => ((h z).det)⁻¹ * h z 0 0 :=
        funext fun z => (hent z).2.2.2
      rw [e]; exact hD.mul (hd 0 0)
  have hE : ∀ k a q : Fin 2,
      h x a 0 * pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 q) x + (h x)⁻¹ 0 q * pd2 k (fun z => h z a 0) x +
        (h x a 1 * pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 q) x + (h x)⁻¹ 1 q * pd2 k (fun z => h z a 1) x)
        = 0 := by
    intro k a q
    have hev : (fun z => h z a 0 * (h z)⁻¹ 0 q + h z a 1 * (h z)⁻¹ 1 q) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun _ => (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) a q := by
      filter_upwards [hs.mem_nhds hx] with z hz
      have := congrFun (congrFun (hmulz z hz) a) q
      simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using this
    have h0 := pd_congr _ _ x k hev
    rw [pd_add _ _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hd a 0) (hinvd 0 q)) (dmul _ _ _ (hd a 1) (hinvd 1 q)),
      pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hd a 0) (hinvd 0 q), pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hd a 1) (hinvd 1 q),
      pd_const] at h0
    linarith
  have hinvmul : (h x)⁻¹ * h x = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hunitx
  have I00 : (h x)⁻¹ 0 0 * h x 0 0 + (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * h x 1 0 = 1 := by
    have := congrFun (congrFun hinvmul 0) 0
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using this
  have I01 : (h x)⁻¹ 0 0 * h x 0 1 + (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * h x 1 1 = 0 := by
    have := congrFun (congrFun hinvmul 0) 1
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using this
  have I10 : (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 * h x 0 0 + (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 * h x 1 0 = 0 := by
    have := congrFun (congrFun hinvmul 1) 0
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using this
  have I11 : (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 * h x 0 1 + (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 * h x 1 1 = 1 := by
    have := congrFun (congrFun hinvmul 1) 1
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using this
  have hdhi : ∀ k l q : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ l q) x =
      -∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ l a * pd2 k (fun z => h z a b) x * (h x)⁻¹ b q := by
    intro k
    simp only [Fin.forall_fin_two, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · linear_combination (h x)⁻¹ 0 0 * hE k 0 0 + (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * hE k 1 0
        - pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 0) x * I00 - pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 0) x * I01
    · linear_combination (h x)⁻¹ 0 0 * hE k 0 1 + (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * hE k 1 1
        - pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 1) x * I00 - pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 1) x * I01
    · linear_combination (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 * hE k 0 0 + (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 * hE k 1 0
        - pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 0) x * I10 - pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 0) x * I11
    · linear_combination (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 * hE k 0 1 + (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 * hE k 1 1
        - pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 1) x * I10 - pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 1) x * I11
  
  have hΓfun : ∀ l i j : Fin 2,
      christoffel2 h l i j = fun z => ∑ q : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ l q * ggeGam1 h q i j z := by
    intro l i j
    funext z
    simp only [christoffel2, ggeGam1, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro q _
    ring
  have hΓx : ∀ l i j : Fin 2,
      christoffel2 h l i j x = ∑ q : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ l q * ggeGam1 h q i j x := by
    intro l i j
    rw [hΓfun l i j]
  have hdΓ : ∀ k l i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (christoffel2 h l i j) x =
      ∑ q : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ l q) x * ggeGam1 h q i j x +
        ∑ q : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ l q * pd2 k (ggeGam1 h q i j) x := by
    intro k l i j
    rw [hΓfun l i j]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [pd_add _ _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hinvd l 0) (hΓ1d 0 i j x hx))
        (dmul _ _ _ (hinvd l 1) (hΓ1d 1 i j x hx)),
      pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hinvd l 0) (hΓ1d 0 i j x hx), pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hinvd l 1) (hΓ1d 1 i j x hx)]
    ring
  
  have hS : pd2 0 (ggeGam1 h 1 1 0) x - pd2 1 (ggeGam1 h 1 0 0) x
      + pd2 0 (ggeGam1 h 0 1 1) x - pd2 1 (ggeGam1 h 0 0 1) x = 0 := by
    have hA : pd2 0 (pd2 1 (fun w => h w 1 0)) x =
        pd2 0 (ggeGam1 h 1 1 0) x + pd2 0 (ggeGam1 h 0 1 1) x := by
      have hev : pd2 1 (fun w => h w 1 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          fun z => ggeGam1 h 1 1 0 z + ggeGam1 h 0 1 1 z := by
        filter_upwards [hs.mem_nhds hx] with z hz
        exact hcompat z hz 1 1 0
      rw [pd_congr _ _ x 0 hev, pd_add _ _ _ _ (hΓ1d 1 1 0 x hx) (hΓ1d 0 1 1 x hx)]
    have hB : pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun w => h w 1 0)) x =
        pd2 1 (ggeGam1 h 1 0 0) x + pd2 1 (ggeGam1 h 0 0 1) x := by
      have hev : pd2 0 (fun w => h w 1 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          fun z => ggeGam1 h 1 0 0 z + ggeGam1 h 0 0 1 z := by
        filter_upwards [hs.mem_nhds hx] with z hz
        exact hcompat z hz 0 1 0
      rw [pd_congr _ _ x 1 hev, pd_add _ _ _ _ (hΓ1d 1 0 0 x hx) (hΓ1d 0 0 1 x hx)]
    have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => h w 1 0) x := (hh 1 0).contDiffAt (hs.mem_nhds hx)
    have hdf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun w => h w 1 0)) x :=
      (hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ (fun w => h w 1 0) x :=
      hf.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp <;> norm_cast)
    have e2e : ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (fun w => h w 1 0)) x =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun w => h w 1 0)) x (e2 i) (e2 j) := by
      intro i j
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun w => h w 1 0) z (e2 j)) x (e2 i) = _
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hdf (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    have hsw : pd2 0 (pd2 1 (fun w => h w 1 0)) x = pd2 1 (pd2 0 (fun w => h w 1 0)) x := by
      rw [e2e, e2e]
      exact hsym (e2 0) (e2 1)
    linarith
  
  have hT : Matrix.transpose (h x) = h x := by
    ext i j
    exact hhsymm x hx j i
  have hsymi : (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 = (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 := by
    have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv (h x)) 0) 1
    rw [hT] at this
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using this
  have hdetrel : (h x).det * ((h x)⁻¹ 0 0 * (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 - (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * (h x)⁻¹ 0 1) = 1 := by
    have := Matrix.det_nonsing_inv_mul_det (h x) hunitx
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsymi] at this
    linarith
  have hc : (h x)⁻¹ 0 0 * (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 - (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, mul_zero] at hdetrel
    exact zero_ne_one hdetrel
  have hcx : ∀ k a b : Fin 2,
      pd2 k (fun w => h w a b) x = ggeGam1 h a k b x + ggeGam1 h b k a x := hcompat x hx
  
  refine mul_right_cancel₀ hc ?_
  rw [mul_assoc (gaussCurv2 h x), hdetrel, mul_one]
  simp only [gaussCurv2, ricci2, ggeRiem0110, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp only [hdΓ, hΓx, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp only [hdhi, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp only [hcx, hsymi]
  linear_combination
    (-((h x)⁻¹ 0 0 * (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 - (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * (h x)⁻¹ 0 1) / 2) * hS

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) : ∀ z ∈ s, ∀ m i j : Fin 2, ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) m i j z = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, gsTan F m z a * G (F z) a b * gsCovHess G F i j z b

signature.name: gge_koszul_tangent
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) : ∀ z ∈ s, ∀ m i j : Fin 2, ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) m i j z = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, gsTan F m z a * G (F z) a b * gsCovHess G F i j z b

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have alg : ∀ (Gm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), (∀ a b : Fin 3, Gm a b = Gm b a) →
      ∀ (dG Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ a c d : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Gm a b * Γ b c d =
        1 / 2 * (dG c d a + dG d c a - dG a c d)) →
      ∀ (D : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (A : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ (c : Fin 3) (i j : Fin 2), A c i j = A c j i) →
      ∀ (dh : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ m i j : Fin 2, dh m i j = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (A k m i * Gm k l * D l j + D k i * Gm k l * A l m j +
          D k i * (∑ r : Fin 3, dG r k l * D r m) * D l j)) →
      ∀ m i j : Fin 2, 1 / 2 * (dh i j m + dh j i m - dh m i j) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a m * Gm a b *
          (A b i j + ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c i * D d j) := by
    intro Gm hGs dG Γ hlow D A hA dh hdh m i j
    have hR : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a m * Gm a b *
          (A b i j + ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c i * D d j) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a m * Gm a b * A b i j +
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
            D a m * D c i * D d j * (∑ b : Fin 3, Gm a b * Γ b c d) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [hR, hdh i j m, hdh j i m, hdh m i j]
    simp only [hlow]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, fun c => hA c j i, fun c => hA c i m, fun c => hA c j m,
      hGs 1 0, hGs 2 0, hGs 2 1]
    ring
  intro z hz m i j
  have hzs : s ∈ 𝓝 z := hs.mem_nhds hz
  have hUy : U ∈ 𝓝 (F z) := hU.mem_nhds (hFU z hz)
  have h1 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  have hFdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z :=
    ((hF.contDiffAt hzs).of_le h1).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z :=
    ((hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hs (m := 1) (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).contDiffAt
      hzs).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hGd : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y k l) (F z) :=
    fun k l => (((hG k l).contDiffAt hUy).of_le h1).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hcol : ∀ (w : E2) (k : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' w) k) z := by
    intro w k
    let Λ : (E2 →L[ℝ] E3) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj k).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ E3 w)
    have hfun : (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' w) k) = Λ ∘ fderiv ℝ F := rfl
    rw [hfun]
    exact Λ.differentiableAt.comp z hFd
  have hBd : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => G (F x') k l) z :=
    fun k l => (hGd k l).comp z hFdx
  have hexp : ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (u : E3), ℓ u = ∑ r : Fin 3, ℓ (e r) * u r := by
    intro ℓ u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr,
      EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => mul_comm _ _)
  have hB' : ∀ (m' : Fin 2) (k l : Fin 3), fderiv ℝ (fun x' => G (F x') k l) z (e2 m') =
      ∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun y => G y k l) (F z) * (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 m')) r := by
    intro m' k l
    have hc : (fun x' => G (F x') k l) = (fun y => G y k l) ∘ F := rfl
    rw [hc, fderiv_comp z (hGd k l) hFdx, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      hexp (fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y k l) (F z))]
    rfl
  
  have hpull : ∀ m' i' j' : Fin 2, pd2 m' (fun w => pullMetric2 G F w i' j') z =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (pd2 m' (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 i')) k) z * G (F z) k l * (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 j')) l +
          (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 i')) k * G (F z) k l * pd2 m' (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 j')) l) z +
          (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 i')) k *
            (∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun y => G y k l) (F z) * (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 m')) r) *
            (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 j')) l) := by
    intro m' i' j'
    have hT : ∀ k l : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt
        (fun w => (fderiv ℝ F w (e2 i')) k * G (F w) k l * (fderiv ℝ F w (e2 j')) l)
        (((fderiv ℝ F z (e2 i')) k * G (F z) k l) • fderiv ℝ (fun w => (fderiv ℝ F w (e2 j')) l) z
          + (fderiv ℝ F z (e2 j')) l • ((fderiv ℝ F z (e2 i')) k • fderiv ℝ (fun w => G (F w) k l) z
            + G (F z) k l • fderiv ℝ (fun w => (fderiv ℝ F w (e2 i')) k) z)) z := by
      intro k l
      exact ((hcol (e2 i') k).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul (hBd k l).hasFDerivAt).fun_mul
        (hcol (e2 j') l).hasFDerivAt
    have hsum := HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
      (fun k _ => HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun l _ => hT k l))
    show fderiv ℝ (fun w => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (fderiv ℝ F w (e2 i')) k * G (F w) k l * (fderiv ℝ F w (e2 j')) l) z (e2 m') = _
    rw [hsum.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_))
    rw [hB' m' k l]
    simp only [pd2]
    ring
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (m' i' : Fin 2) (k : Fin 3),
      pd2 m' (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 i')) k) z = gsHessF F m' i' z k := by
    intro m' i' k
    have hL : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 i')) z :=
      hFd.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)
    have hproj : (fun x' => (fderiv ℝ F x' (e2 i')) k) =
        (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 i')) := by
      funext y; rfl
    unfold pd2
    rw [hproj, fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj k).differentiableAt hL,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    rfl
  have hdh : ∀ m' i' j' : Fin 2, pd2 m' (fun w => pullMetric2 G F w i' j') z =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (gsHessF F m' i' z k * G (F z) k l * gsTan F j' z l +
          gsTan F i' z k * G (F z) k l * gsHessF F m' j' z l +
          gsTan F i' z k * (∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun y => G y k l) (F z) * gsTan F m' z r) *
            gsTan F j' z l) := by
    intro m' i' j'
    rw [hpull m' i' j']
    simp only [hcoord]
    rfl
  
  have hA : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (i' j' : Fin 2), gsHessF F i' j' z c = gsHessF F j' i' z c := by
    have hFat : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F z := hF.contDiffAt hzs
    have hH : ∀ i' j' : Fin 2,
        gsHessF F i' j' z = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z (e2 i') (e2 j') := by
      intro i' j'
      unfold gsHessF
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hFd (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    have hsymF : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ F z := hFat.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp <;> norm_cast)
    intro c i' j'
    rw [hH i' j', hH j' i', hsymF (e2 i') (e2 j')]
  
  have hGz : (G (F z)).PosDef := hGpos (F z) (hFU z hz)
  have hGi : G (F z) * (G (F z))⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hGz.det_pos.ne')
  have hδ : ∀ a l : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G (F z) a b * (G (F z))⁻¹ b l = if a = l then 1 else 0 := by
    intro a l
    rw [← Matrix.mul_apply, hGi, Matrix.one_apply]
  have hlow : ∀ a c d : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G (F z) a b * christoffel G b c d (F z) =
      1 / 2 * (partialDeriv c (fun y => G y d a) (F z) + partialDeriv d (fun y => G y c a) (F z)
        - partialDeriv a (fun y => G y c d) (F z)) := by
    intro a c d
    have e1 : ∀ b : Fin 3, G (F z) a b * christoffel G b c d (F z) =
        ∑ l : Fin 3, 1 / 2 * (partialDeriv c (fun y => G y d l) (F z) +
          partialDeriv d (fun y => G y c l) (F z) - partialDeriv l (fun y => G y c d) (F z)) *
          (G (F z) a b * (G (F z))⁻¹ b l) := by
      intro b
      simp only [christoffel, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by ring)
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => e1 b), Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [← Finset.mul_sum, hδ, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
      Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  
  have key := alg (G (F z)) (hGsymm (F z))
    (fun r k l => partialDeriv r (fun y => G y k l) (F z))
    (fun b c d => christoffel G b c d (F z)) hlow
    (fun c i' => gsTan F i' z c) (fun c m' i' => gsHessF F m' i' z c) hA
    (fun m' i' j' => pd2 m' (fun w => pullMetric2 G F w i' j') z) hdh m i j
  unfold ggeGam1 gsCovHess
  exact key

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ k m i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, gsTan F m z a * G (F z) a b * gsCovHess G F i j z b) x = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (gsHessF F k m x a * G (F x) a b * gsCovHess G F i j x b + gsTan F m x a * (∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun y => G y a b) (F x) * gsTan F k x r) * gsCovHess G F i j x b + gsTan F m x a * G (F x) a b * (pd2 k (fun z => gsHessF F i j z b) x + ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (christoffel G b c d) (F x) * gsTan F k x r) * gsTan F i x c * gsTan F j x d + christoffel G b c d (F x) * (gsHessF F k i x c * gsTan F j x d + gsTan F i x c * gsHessF F k j x d))))

signature.name: gge_koszul_deriv
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ k m i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, gsTan F m z a * G (F z) a b * gsCovHess G F i j z b) x = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (gsHessF F k m x a * G (F x) a b * gsCovHess G F i j x b + gsTan F m x a * (∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun y => G y a b) (F x) * gsTan F k x r) * gsCovHess G F i j x b + gsTan F m x a * G (F x) a b * (pd2 k (fun z => gsHessF F i j z b) x + ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (christoffel G b c d) (F x) * gsTan F k x r) * gsTan F i x c * gsTan F j x d + christoffel G b c d (F x) * (gsHessF F k i x c * gsTan F j x d + gsTan F i x c * gsHessF F k j x d))))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx k m i j
  
  have hmul : ∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z * g z) x = pd2 k f x * g x + f x * pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hadd : ∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z + g z) x = pd2 k f x + pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
  have hsum : ∀ f : Fin 3 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f a) x) →
      pd2 k (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, f a z) x = ∑ a : Fin 3, pd2 k (f a) x := by
    intro f hf
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun a _ => hf a), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  
  have hexp : ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E3), ℓ v = ∑ c : Fin 3, v c * ℓ (e c) := by
    intro ℓ v
    have hv : v = ∑ c : Fin 3, v c • e c := by
      ext t
      fin_cases t <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x :=
    (hF.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hs.mem_nhds hx)
  have hchain : ∀ w : E3 → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ w (F x) →
      pd2 k (fun z => w (F z)) x = ∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r w (F x) * gsTan F k x r := by
    intro w hw
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => w (F z)) x (e2 k) = _
    rw [fderiv_comp' x hw hFd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hexp]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_)
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  
  have hcoord : ∀ φ : E2 → E3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ s → ∀ c : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => φ z c) x ∧
        pd2 k (fun z => φ z c) x = fderiv ℝ φ x (e2 k) c := by
    intro φ hφ c
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x :=
      (hφ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hs.mem_nhds hx)
    have hfun : (fun z => φ z c) = (EuclideanSpace.proj c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ φ := rfl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hfun]
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj c).differentiableAt.comp x hφd
    · unfold pd2
      rw [hfun, fderiv_comp x (EuclideanSpace.proj c).differentiableAt hφd,
        ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      rfl
  have hFfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) s :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 hF).2
  have hΨ : ∀ p : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 p)) s :=
    fun p => hFfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hHs : ∀ p q : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => gsHessF F p q z) s := by
    intro p q
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 q))) s :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 (hΨ q)).2
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have dT : ∀ (p : Fin 2) (a : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => gsTan F p z a) x :=
    fun p a => (hcoord _ (hΨ p) a).1
  have pT : ∀ (p : Fin 2) (a : Fin 3), pd2 k (fun z => gsTan F p z a) x = gsHessF F k p x a :=
    fun p a => (hcoord _ (hΨ p) a).2
  have dH : ∀ b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => gsHessF F i j z b) x :=
    fun b => (hcoord _ (hHs i j) b).1
  
  have hpdv : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ r : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv r f) U := by
    intro f hf r
    have hD := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf).2
    exact hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdet3 : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) U := by
    intro H hH
    have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
        H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
          - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
          + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H y)
    rw [hfun]
    have t1 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 0)
    exact ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
  have hdetU : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hGpos y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hGi : ∀ p q : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ p q) U := by
    intro p q
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := hdet3 G hG
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow q (Pi.single p 1)).det) U := by
      apply hdet3
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = q
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hG a b
    refine ((h1.inv hdetU).mul h2).congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have hdG : ∀ r a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv r (fun z => G z a b)) U :=
    fun r a b => hpdv _ (hG a b) r
  have hΓ : ∀ b c d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G b c d) U := by
    intro b c d
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
      (hGi b l).mul (((hdG c d l).add (hdG d c l)).sub (hdG l c d)))
  have hFxU : U ∈ 𝓝 (F x) := hU.mem_nhds (hFU x hx)
  have dG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) (F x) :=
    fun a b => ((hG a b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hFxU
  have dΓ : ∀ b c d : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (christoffel G b c d) (F x) :=
    fun b c d => ((hΓ b c d).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hFxU
  have dGF : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G (F z) a b) x :=
    fun a b => (dG a b).comp x hFd
  have dΓF : ∀ b c d : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => christoffel G b c d (F z)) x :=
    fun b c d => (dΓ b c d).comp x hFd
  
  have hV : ∀ b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => gsCovHess G F i j z b) x ∧
      pd2 k (fun z => gsCovHess G F i j z b) x = pd2 k (fun z => gsHessF F i j z b) x +
        ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (christoffel G b c d) (F x) *
          gsTan F k x r) * gsTan F i x c * gsTan F j x d + christoffel G b c d (F x) *
          (gsHessF F k i x c * gsTan F j x d + gsTan F i x c * gsHessF F k j x d)) := by
    intro b
    have hVeq : (fun z => gsCovHess G F i j z b) = fun z => gsHessF F i j z b +
        ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
          christoffel G b c d (F z) * gsTan F i z c * gsTan F j z d := rfl
    have d3 : ∀ c d : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => christoffel G b c d (F z) * gsTan F i z c * gsTan F j z d) x :=
      fun c d => ((dΓF b c d).fun_mul (dT i c)).fun_mul (dT j d)
    have d2 : ∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => ∑ d : Fin 3, christoffel G b c d (F z) * gsTan F i z c * gsTan F j z d) x :=
      fun c => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun d _ => d3 c d)
    have d1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        christoffel G b c d (F z) * gsTan F i z c * gsTan F j z d) x :=
      DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun c _ => d2 c)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hVeq]
      exact (dH b).fun_add d1
    · rw [hVeq, hadd _ _ (dH b) d1, hsum _ d2]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_)
      rw [hsum _ (d3 c)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)
      rw [hmul _ _ ((dΓF b c d).fun_mul (dT i c)) (dT j d), hmul _ _ (dΓF b c d) (dT i c),
        hchain _ (dΓ b c d), pT, pT]
      ring
  
  have dTg : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => gsTan F m z a * G (F z) a b) x :=
    fun a b => (dT m a).fun_mul (dGF a b)
  have dTgV : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun z => gsTan F m z a * G (F z) a b * gsCovHess G F i j z b) x :=
    fun a b => (dTg a b).fun_mul (hV b).1
  have dS : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun z => ∑ b : Fin 3, gsTan F m z a * G (F z) a b * gsCovHess G F i j z b) x :=
    fun a => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => dTgV a b)
  rw [hsum _ dS]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
  rw [hsum _ (dTgV a)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
  rw [hmul _ _ (dTg a b) (hV b).1, hmul _ _ (dT m a) (dGF a b), pT, (hV b).2,
    hchain _ (dG a b)]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (P Q : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * Q d = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a b * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, gsTan F a x c * G (F x) c d * P d) * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, gsTan F b x c * G (F x) c d * Q d) + (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * P c) * (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * Q c) / gsNormLen G F x ^ 2

signature.name: gge_normal_split
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (P Q : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * Q d = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a b * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, gsTan F a x c * G (F x) c d * P d) * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, gsTan F b x c * G (F x) c d * Q d) + (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * P c) * (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * Q c) / gsNormLen G F x ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have core : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (D : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (N : Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (h : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (P Q : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ i j, A i j = A j i) →
      N = ![D 0 1 * D 1 2 - D 0 2 * D 1 1, D 0 2 * D 1 0 - D 0 0 * D 1 2,
        D 0 0 * D 1 1 - D 0 1 * D 1 0] →
      (∀ i j, h i j = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, D i k * A k l * D j l) →
      (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * N k * N l) ≠ 0 →
      ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, A c d * P c * Q d =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, h⁻¹ a b *
            (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, D a c * A c d * P d) *
            (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, D b c * A c d * Q d) +
          (∑ c : Fin 3, N c * P c) * (∑ c : Fin 3, N c * Q c) /
            (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * N k * N l) := by
    intro A D N h P Q hsym hN hh hS
    have n0 : N 0 = D 0 1 * D 1 2 - D 0 2 * D 1 1 := by rw [hN]; rfl
    have n1 : N 1 = D 0 2 * D 1 0 - D 0 0 * D 1 2 := by rw [hN]; rfl
    have n2 : N 2 = D 0 0 * D 1 1 - D 0 1 * D 1 0 := by rw [hN]; rfl
    have k00 : A.adjugate 0 0 = A 1 1 * A 2 2 - A 1 2 * A 2 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]; rfl
    have k01 : A.adjugate 0 1 = -(A 0 1 * A 2 2) + A 0 2 * A 2 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]; rfl
    have k02 : A.adjugate 0 2 = A 0 1 * A 1 2 - A 0 2 * A 1 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]; rfl
    have k10 : A.adjugate 1 0 = -(A 1 0 * A 2 2) + A 1 2 * A 2 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]; rfl
    have k11 : A.adjugate 1 1 = A 0 0 * A 2 2 - A 0 2 * A 2 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]; rfl
    have k12 : A.adjugate 1 2 = -(A 0 0 * A 1 2) + A 0 2 * A 1 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]; rfl
    have k20 : A.adjugate 2 0 = A 1 0 * A 2 1 - A 1 1 * A 2 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]; rfl
    have k21 : A.adjugate 2 1 = -(A 0 0 * A 2 1) + A 0 1 * A 2 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]; rfl
    have k22 : A.adjugate 2 2 = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 1 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]; rfl
    have a00 : h.adjugate 0 0 = h 1 1 := by rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; rfl
    have a01 : h.adjugate 0 1 = -h 0 1 := by rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; rfl
    have a10 : h.adjugate 1 0 = -h 1 0 := by rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; rfl
    have a11 : h.adjugate 1 1 = h 0 0 := by rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]; rfl
    have hAi : A⁻¹ = A.det⁻¹ • A.adjugate := by rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    have hSs : (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k l * N k * N l) =
        A.det⁻¹ * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A.adjugate k l * N k * N l := by
      rw [hAi]
      simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      ring
    have hCB : h.det = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A.adjugate k l * N k * N l := by
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
      simp only [hh, Fin.sum_univ_three, k00, k01, k02, k10, k11, k12, k20, k21, k22, n0, n1, n2]
      rw [hsym 1 0, hsym 2 0, hsym 2 1]
      ring
    have key : (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A.adjugate k l * N k * N l) *
          (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, A c d * P c * Q d) =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, h.adjugate a b *
            (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, D a c * A c d * P d) *
            (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, D b c * A c d * Q d) +
          A.det * ((∑ c : Fin 3, N c * P c) * (∑ c : Fin 3, N c * Q c)) := by
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, a00, a01, a10, a11, hh, Fin.sum_univ_three,
        k00, k01, k02, k10, k11, k12, k20, k21, k22, n0, n1, n2]
      rw [hsym 1 0, hsym 2 0, hsym 2 1]
      ring
    generalize hs : (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A.adjugate k l * N k * N l) = s at hSs hCB key
    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; apply hS; rw [hSs, h0, mul_zero]
    have hinv : h⁻¹ = s⁻¹ • h.adjugate := by rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', hCB]
    have hL : ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, A c d * P c * Q d =
        s⁻¹ * (s * ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, A c d * P c * Q d) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs0, one_mul]
    rw [hL, key, hSs, hinv]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    field_simp
  
  have hN : gsCrossN F x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hN0
    have n0 : gsTan F 0 x 1 * gsTan F 1 x 2 - gsTan F 0 x 2 * gsTan F 1 x 1 = 0 := by
      have := congrFun hN0 0; exact this
    have n1 : gsTan F 0 x 2 * gsTan F 1 x 0 - gsTan F 0 x 0 * gsTan F 1 x 2 = 0 := by
      have := congrFun hN0 1; exact this
    have n2 : gsTan F 0 x 0 * gsTan F 1 x 1 - gsTan F 0 x 1 * gsTan F 1 x 0 = 0 := by
      have := congrFun hN0 2; exact this
    have hLa : fderiv ℝ F x (e2 0) = gsTan F 0 x := rfl
    have hLb : fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1) = gsTan F 1 x := rfl
    set a := gsTan F 0 x with ha
    set b := gsTan F 1 x with hb
    have hv : fderiv ℝ F x ((b 0 ^ 2 + b 1 ^ 2 + b 2 ^ 2) • e2 0 -
        (a 0 * b 0 + a 1 * b 1 + a 2 * b 2) • e2 1) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, hLa, hLb]
      ext m
      fin_cases m
      · simp
        linear_combination b 1 * n2 - b 2 * n1
      · simp
        linear_combination b 2 * n0 - b 0 * n2
      · simp
        linear_combination b 0 * n1 - b 1 * n0
    have hv0 := hinj (hv.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    have hβ : b 0 ^ 2 + b 1 ^ 2 + b 2 ^ 2 = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun v : E2 => v 0) hv0
      simpa using this
    have hb0 : b 0 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b 0), sq_nonneg (b 1), sq_nonneg (b 2)]
    have hb1 : b 1 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b 0), sq_nonneg (b 1), sq_nonneg (b 2)]
    have hb2 : b 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b 0), sq_nonneg (b 1), sq_nonneg (b 2)]
    have hb' : fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1) = 0 := by
      rw [hLb]
      ext m
      fin_cases m <;> simp [hb0, hb1, hb2]
    have h1 := hinj (hb'.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    have h2 := congrArg (fun v : E2 => v 1) h1
    simp at h2
  
  have hSpos : 0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l := by
    have h1 := hGpos.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hN
    have e : dotProduct (star (gsCrossN F x)) ((G (F x))⁻¹.mulVec (gsCrossN F x)) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      ring
    rw [← e]; exact h1
  have hlen : gsNormLen G F x ^ 2 = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l := Real.sq_sqrt hSpos.le
  rw [hlen]
  exact core (G (F x)) (fun i c => gsTan F i x c) (gsCrossN F x) (pullMetric2 G F x) P Q
    (hGsymm _) rfl (fun i j => rfl) hSpos.ne'

informal_problem.statement: (Gm Gi : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hGi : Gm * Gi = 1) (hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, Gm a b = Gm b a) (dG : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hdG : ∀ r a b : Fin 3, dG r a b = dG r b a) (Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hΓ : ∀ k a b : Fin 3, Γ k a b = 1 / 2 * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gi k l * (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) (dΓ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (D : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (A : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ c : Fin 3, A c 0 1 = A c 1 0) (T : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hT : ∀ b : Fin 3, T b 0 1 1 = T b 1 0 1) (V : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hV : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (i j : Fin 2), V b i j = A b i j + ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c i * D d j) (Γ1 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (dΓ1 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hdΓ1 : ∀ k m i j : Fin 2, dΓ1 k m i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (A a k m * Gm a b * V b i j + D a m * (∑ r : Fin 3, dG r a b * D r k) * V b i j + D a m * Gm a b * (T b k i j + ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ r : Fin 3, dΓ r b c d * D r k) * D c i * D d j + Γ b c d * (A c k i * D d j + D c i * A d k j))))) (hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (Γ2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hΓ2 : ∀ l i j : Fin 2, Γ2 l i j = ∑ q : Fin 2, hi l q * Γ1 q i j) (II : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hsplit : ∀ k m i j : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Gm c d * V c k m * V d i j = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, hi a b * Γ1 a k m * Γ1 b i j + II k m * II i j) : dΓ1 0 0 1 1 - dΓ1 1 0 0 1 - ∑ l : Fin 2, Γ1 l 0 0 * Γ2 l 1 1 + ∑ l : Fin 2, Γ1 l 1 0 * Γ2 l 0 1 = (∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, Gm m l * (dΓ i l j k - dΓ j l i k + ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ l i p * Γ p j k - Γ l j p * Γ p i k)) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0) + (II 0 0 * II 1 1 - II 0 1 * II 1 0)

signature.name: gge_gauss_extrinsic_alg
