signature.statement: (Gm Gi : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hGi : Gm * Gi = 1) (hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, Gm a b = Gm b a) (dG : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hdG : ∀ r a b : Fin 3, dG r a b = dG r b a) (Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hΓ : ∀ k a b : Fin 3, Γ k a b = 1 / 2 * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gi k l * (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) (dΓ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (D : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (A : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ c : Fin 3, A c 0 1 = A c 1 0) (T : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hT : ∀ b : Fin 3, T b 0 1 1 = T b 1 0 1) (V : Fin 3 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hV : ∀ (b : Fin 3) (i j : Fin 2), V b i j = A b i j + ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c i * D d j) (Γ1 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (dΓ1 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hdΓ1 : ∀ k m i j : Fin 2, dΓ1 k m i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (A a k m * Gm a b * V b i j + D a m * (∑ r : Fin 3, dG r a b * D r k) * V b i j + D a m * Gm a b * (T b k i j + ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ r : Fin 3, dΓ r b c d * D r k) * D c i * D d j + Γ b c d * (A c k i * D d j + D c i * A d k j))))) (hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (Γ2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hΓ2 : ∀ l i j : Fin 2, Γ2 l i j = ∑ q : Fin 2, hi l q * Γ1 q i j) (II : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hsplit : ∀ k m i j : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Gm c d * V c k m * V d i j = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, hi a b * Γ1 a k m * Γ1 b i j + II k m * II i j) : dΓ1 0 0 1 1 - dΓ1 1 0 0 1 - ∑ l : Fin 2, Γ1 l 0 0 * Γ2 l 1 1 + ∑ l : Fin 2, Γ1 l 1 0 * Γ2 l 0 1 = (∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, Gm m l * (dΓ i l j k - dΓ j l i k + ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ l i p * Γ p j k - Γ l j p * Γ p i k)) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0) + (II 0 0 * II 1 1 - II 0 1 * II 1 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hδ : ∀ x q : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, Gm l x * Gi l q = if x = q then 1 else 0 := by
    intro x q
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hGi x) q
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by rw [hGs l x])
  have hhalf : ∀ x r a : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, Gm l x * Γ l r a
      = 1 / 2 * (dG r a x + dG a r x - dG x r a) := by
    intro x r a
    have e : ∑ l : Fin 3, Gm l x * Γ l r a = 1 / 2 * ∑ q : Fin 3,
        (∑ l : Fin 3, Gm l x * Gi l q) * (dG r a q + dG a r q - dG q r a) := by
      simp only [hΓ, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by ring))
    rw [e]
    simp only [hδ, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hcomp : ∀ r a b : Fin 3, dG r a b = ∑ l : Fin 3, (Gm l b * Γ l r a + Gm a l * Γ l r b) := by
    intro r a b
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have e2 : ∑ l : Fin 3, Gm a l * Γ l r b = ∑ l : Fin 3, Gm l a * Γ l r b :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by rw [hGs a l])
    rw [e2, hhalf b r a, hhalf a r b]
    linarith [hdG r a b]
  
  have hII : ∀ k m i j : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, Γ1 l k m * Γ2 l i j
      = (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Gm c d * V c k m * V d i j) - II k m * II i j := by
    intro k m i j
    rw [hsplit k m i j]
    simp only [hΓ2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have hP : ∀ k m i j : Fin 2, dΓ1 k m i j =
      (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a k m * Gm a b * V b i j)
      + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a m * (∑ r : Fin 3, dG r a b * D r k) * V b i j)
      + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a m * Gm a b * T b k i j)
      + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a m * Gm a b * ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
          (∑ r : Fin 3, dΓ r b c d * D r k) * D c i * D d j)
      + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a m * Gm a b * ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
          Γ b c d * (A c k i * D d j + D c i * A d k j)) := by
    intro k m i j
    rw [hdΓ1]
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add]
    ring
  
  have hT3 : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b * T b 0 1 1)
      = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b * T b 1 0 1) := by
    simp only [hT]
  
  have hC6 : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a 0 0 * Gm a b * V b 1 1)
      - (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a 1 0 * Gm a b * V b 0 1)
      - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Gm c d * V c 0 0 * V d 1 1)
      + (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Gm c d * V c 1 0 * V d 0 1)
      = -(∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Gm a b * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ a c d * D c 0 * D d 0) * V b 1 1)
        + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Gm a b * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ a c d * D c 1 * D d 0) * V b 0 1 := by
    simp only [fun b => hV b 0 0, fun b => hV b 1 0]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hC2 : ∀ k m i j : Fin 2,
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a m * (∑ r : Fin 3, dG r a b * D r k) * V b i j
      = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Gm a b * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ a c d * D c k * D d m) * V b i j
        + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a m * Gm a b * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c k * V d i j) := by
    intro k m i j
    simp only [hcomp]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hC3 : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b * ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        (∑ r : Fin 3, dΓ r b c d * D r 0) * D c 1 * D d 1)
      - (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b * ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        (∑ r : Fin 3, dΓ r b c d * D r 1) * D c 0 * D d 1)
      = ∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
          Gm m l * (dΓ i l j k - dΓ j l i k) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0 := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hC4 : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 0 * V d 1 1))
      - (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 1 * V d 0 1))
      + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b * ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
          Γ b c d * (A c 0 1 * D d 1 + D c 1 * A d 0 1))
      - (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b * ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
          Γ b c d * (A c 1 0 * D d 1 + D c 0 * A d 1 1))
      = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b *
          ((∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 0 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 1 * D f 1))
           - ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 1 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 0 * D f 1)) := by
    have Ib : ∀ b : Fin 3,
        (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 0 * V d 1 1)
        - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 1 * V d 0 1)
        + (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * (A c 0 1 * D d 1 + D c 1 * A d 0 1))
        - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * (A c 1 0 * D d 1 + D c 0 * A d 1 1))
        = (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 0 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 1 * D f 1))
           - ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 1 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 0 * D f 1) := by
      intro b
      simp only [hV, hA, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
    rw [← Ib b]
    ring
  
  have hC5a : ∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        Gm m l * (∑ p : Fin 3, Γ l i p * Γ p j k) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0
      = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b *
          (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 0 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 1 * D f 1)) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hC5b : ∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        Gm m l * (∑ p : Fin 3, Γ l j p * Γ p i k) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0
      = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b *
          (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 1 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 0 * D f 1)) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hC5 : ∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        Gm m l * (∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ l i p * Γ p j k - Γ l j p * Γ p i k)) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0
      = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b *
          ((∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 0 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 1 * D f 1))
           - ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 1 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 0 * D f 1)) := by
    have e1 : ∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        Gm m l * (∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ l i p * Γ p j k - Γ l j p * Γ p i k)) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0
        = (∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
            Gm m l * (∑ p : Fin 3, Γ l i p * Γ p j k) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0)
          - ∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
            Gm m l * (∑ p : Fin 3, Γ l j p * Γ p i k) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0 := by
      simp only [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ =>
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ =>
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; ring)))))
    have e2 : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b *
          ((∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 0 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 1 * D f 1))
           - ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 1 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 0 * D f 1))
        = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b *
          (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 0 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 1 * D f 1)))
          - ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, D a 0 * Gm a b *
          (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, Γ b c d * D c 1 * (∑ e : Fin 3, ∑ f : Fin 3, Γ d e f * D e 0 * D f 1)) := by
      simp only [mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [e1, e2, hC5a, hC5b]
  
  have hR : (∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, Gm m l * (dΓ i l j k - dΓ j l i k + ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ l i p * Γ p j k - Γ l j p * Γ p i k)) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0)
      = (∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
          Gm m l * (dΓ i l j k - dΓ j l i k) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0)
        + ∑ l : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
          Gm m l * (∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ l i p * Γ p j k - Γ l j p * Γ p i k)) * D i 0 * D j 1 * D k 1 * D m 0 := by
    simp only [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ =>
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ =>
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => by ring)))))
  
  have hPa := hP 0 0 1 1
  have hPb := hP 1 0 0 1
  have hII00 := hII 0 0 1 1
  have hII10 := hII 1 0 0 1
  have hC2a := hC2 0 0 1 1
  have hC2b := hC2 1 0 0 1
  linear_combination hPa - hPb - hII00 + hII10 + hC6 + hC2a - hC2b + hT3 + hC3 + hC4 - hC5 - hR

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j k m : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G y m l * riemannLocal G l i j k y = -∑ l : Fin 3, G y k l * riemannLocal G l i j m y

signature.name: amb_rm_antisymm
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j k m : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G y m l * riemannLocal G l i j k y = -∑ l : Fin 3, G y k l * riemannLocal G l i j m y

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have lower : ∀ (g gi : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Fin 3 → ℝ), g * gi = 1 →
      ∀ m : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * (1 / 2 * ∑ q : Fin 3, gi l q * T q) = 1 / 2 * T m := by
    intro g gi T h1 m
    have hδ : ∀ q : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * gi l q = if m = q then 1 else 0 := by
      intro q
      have := congrFun (congrFun h1 m) q
      rwa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
    have e : ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * (1 / 2 * ∑ q : Fin 3, gi l q * T q) =
        1 / 2 * ∑ q : Fin 3, (∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * gi l q) * T q := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [e]
    simp only [hδ, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  
  have core : ∀ (g gi : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Γ dg : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (ddg dΓ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      g * gi = 1 → (∀ a b : Fin 3, g a b = g b a) → (∀ c a b : Fin 3, dg c a b = dg c b a) →
      (∀ c d a b : Fin 3, ddg c d a b = ddg d c a b) →
      (∀ l j k : Fin 3, Γ l j k = 1 / 2 * ∑ q : Fin 3, gi l q * (dg j k q + dg k j q - dg q j k)) →
      (∀ i m j k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (dg i m l * Γ l j k + g m l * dΓ i l j k) =
          1 / 2 * (ddg i j k m + ddg i k j m - ddg i m j k)) →
      ∀ i j k m : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * (dΓ i l j k - dΓ j l i k +
          ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ l i p * Γ p j k - Γ l j p * Γ p i k)) =
        -∑ l : Fin 3, g k l * (dΓ i l j m - dΓ j l i m +
          ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ l i p * Γ p j m - Γ l j p * Γ p i m)) := by
    intro g gi Γ dg ddg dΓ h1 hg h3 h4 h5 h6 i j k m
    have ha : ∀ m j k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * Γ l j k =
        1 / 2 * (dg j k m + dg k j m - dg m j k) := by
      intro m j k
      simp only [h5]
      exact lower g gi (fun q => dg j k q + dg k j q - dg q j k) h1 m
    have hD : ∀ i m j k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * dΓ i l j k =
        1 / 2 * (ddg i j k m + ddg i k j m - ddg i m j k) - ∑ l : Fin 3, dg i m l * Γ l j k := by
      intro i m j k
      have := h6 i m j k
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at this
      linarith
    have hQ : ∀ m a b c : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * ∑ p : Fin 3, Γ l a p * Γ p b c =
        ∑ p : Fin 3, 1 / 2 * (dg a p m + dg p a m - dg m a p) * Γ p b c := by
      intro m a b c
      have e : ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * ∑ p : Fin 3, Γ l a p * Γ p b c =
          ∑ p : Fin 3, (∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * Γ l a p) * Γ p b c := by
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
      rw [e]
      simp only [ha]
    have hMC : ∀ i m j k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, dg i m l * Γ l j k =
        ∑ p : Fin 3, 1 / 2 * (dg i p m + dg p i m - dg m i p) * Γ p j k +
        ∑ l : Fin 3, 1 / 2 * (dg i m l + dg m i l - dg l i m) * Γ l j k := by
      intro i m j k
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      rw [h3 i l m]
      ring
    have hS0 : ∀ a b c d : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ q : Fin 3, g l q * Γ q a b) * Γ l c d =
        ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ q : Fin 3, g l q * Γ q c d) * Γ l a b := by
      intro a b c d
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [hg 1 0, hg 2 0, hg 2 1]
      ring
    have hS : ∀ a b c d : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, 1 / 2 * (dg a b l + dg b a l - dg l a b) * Γ l c d =
        ∑ l : Fin 3, 1 / 2 * (dg c d l + dg d c l - dg l c d) * Γ l a b := by
      intro a b c d
      have := hS0 a b c d
      simp only [ha] at this
      exact this
    have hE : ∀ i j k m : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * (dΓ i l j k - dΓ j l i k +
          ∑ p : Fin 3, (Γ l i p * Γ p j k - Γ l j p * Γ p i k)) =
        ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * dΓ i l j k - ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * dΓ j l i k +
          ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * ∑ p : Fin 3, Γ l i p * Γ p j k -
          ∑ l : Fin 3, g m l * ∑ p : Fin 3, Γ l j p * Γ p i k := by
      intro i j k m
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have e1 := hE i j k m
    have e2 := hE i j m k
    have d1 := hD i m j k
    have d2 := hD j m i k
    have d3 := hD i k j m
    have d4 := hD j k i m
    have q1 := hQ m i j k
    have q2 := hQ m j i k
    have q3 := hQ k i j m
    have q4 := hQ k j i m
    have c1 := hMC i m j k
    have c2 := hMC j m i k
    have c3 := hMC i k j m
    have c4 := hMC j k i m
    have s1 := hS j m i k
    have s2 := hS j k i m
    have w1 := h4 i j k m
    have w2 := h4 i j m k
    linarith
  
  have hinv : ∀ z ∈ U, G z * (G z)⁻¹ = 1 := fun z hz =>
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G z) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hGpos z hz).det_pos.ne')
  
  have hlow : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ m j k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G z m l * christoffel G l j k z =
      1 / 2 * (partialDeriv j (fun w => G w k m) z + partialDeriv k (fun w => G w j m) z -
        partialDeriv m (fun w => G w j k) z) := by
    intro z hz m j k
    exact lower (G z) (G z)⁻¹ (fun q => partialDeriv j (fun w => G w k q) z +
      partialDeriv k (fun w => G w j q) z - partialDeriv q (fun w => G w j k) z) (hinv z hz) m
  
  have pd_add : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (f h : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ h y →
      partialDeriv c (fun z => f z + h z) y = partialDeriv c f y + partialDeriv c h y := by
    intro c f h y hf hh
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hh]
    rfl
  have pd_sub : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (f h : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ h y →
      partialDeriv c (fun z => f z - h z) y = partialDeriv c f y - partialDeriv c h y := by
    intro c f h y hf hh
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub hf hh]
    rfl
  have pd_mul : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (f h : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ h y →
      partialDeriv c (fun z => f z * h z) y = partialDeriv c f y * h y + f y * partialDeriv c h y := by
    intro c f h y hf hh
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hh]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have pd_cmul : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (a : ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f y →
      partialDeriv c (fun z => a * f z) y = a * partialDeriv c f y := by
    intro c a f y hf
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [fderiv_const_mul hf a]
    rfl
  have pd_sum : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (F : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), (∀ l, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F l) y) →
      partialDeriv c (fun z => ∑ l : Fin 3, F l z) y = ∑ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv c (F l) y := by
    intro c F y hF
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun l _ => hF l)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  
  have hpd : ∀ c a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b)) U := by
    intro c a b
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y (e c)) U
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 (hG a b)).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have h6all : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i m j k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z m l) y * christoffel G l j k y +
        G y m l * partialDeriv i (christoffel G l j k) y) =
      1 / 2 * (partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (fun w => G w k m) z) y +
        partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv k (fun w => G w j m) z) y -
        partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv m (fun w => G w j k) z) y) := by
    intro y hy i m j k
    have hy' : U ∈ 𝓝 y := hU.mem_nhds hy
    have dG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y := fun a b =>
      ((hG a b).contDiffAt hy').differentiableAt (by simp)
    have dC : ∀ l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (christoffel G l j k) y := fun l =>
      ((hΓ l j k).contDiffAt hy').differentiableAt (by simp)
    have dP : ∀ c a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b)) y :=
      fun c a b => ((hpd c a b).contDiffAt hy').differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hev : (fun z => ∑ l : Fin 3, G z m l * christoffel G l j k z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => 1 / 2 * (partialDeriv j (fun w => G w k m) z +
          partialDeriv k (fun w => G w j m) z - partialDeriv m (fun w => G w j k) z)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem hy' (fun z hz => hlow z hz m j k)
    have key : partialDeriv i (fun z => ∑ l : Fin 3, G z m l * christoffel G l j k z) y =
        partialDeriv i (fun z => 1 / 2 * (partialDeriv j (fun w => G w k m) z +
          partialDeriv k (fun w => G w j m) z - partialDeriv m (fun w => G w j k) z)) y :=
      congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e i)) hev.fderiv_eq
    have hL : partialDeriv i (fun z => ∑ l : Fin 3, G z m l * christoffel G l j k z) y =
        ∑ l : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z m l) y * christoffel G l j k y +
          G y m l * partialDeriv i (christoffel G l j k) y) := by
      rw [pd_sum i (fun l z => G z m l * christoffel G l j k z) y
        (fun l => (dG m l).mul (dC l))]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      exact pd_mul i (fun z => G z m l) (christoffel G l j k) y (dG m l) (dC l)
    have hR : partialDeriv i (fun z => 1 / 2 * (partialDeriv j (fun w => G w k m) z +
          partialDeriv k (fun w => G w j m) z - partialDeriv m (fun w => G w j k) z)) y =
        1 / 2 * (partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (fun w => G w k m) z) y +
          partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv k (fun w => G w j m) z) y -
          partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv m (fun w => G w j k) z) y) := by
      rw [pd_cmul i (1 / 2) (fun z => partialDeriv j (fun w => G w k m) z +
          partialDeriv k (fun w => G w j m) z - partialDeriv m (fun w => G w j k) z) y
          (((dP j k m).add (dP k j m)).sub (dP m j k))]
      rw [pd_sub i (fun z => partialDeriv j (fun w => G w k m) z +
          partialDeriv k (fun w => G w j m) z) (partialDeriv m (fun w => G w j k)) y
          ((dP j k m).add (dP k j m)) (dP m j k)]
      rw [pd_add i (partialDeriv j (fun w => G w k m)) (partialDeriv k (fun w => G w j m)) y
          (dP j k m) (dP k j m)]
    rw [← hL, key, hR]
  
  have hschwarz : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ c d a b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv c (fun z => partialDeriv d (fun w => G w a b) z) y =
      partialDeriv d (fun z => partialDeriv c (fun w => G w a b) z) y := by
    intro y hy c d a b
    have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => G w a b) y := (hG a b).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
    have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ (fun w => G w a b) y := by
      apply hf.isSymmSndFDerivAt
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      first
        | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
        | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
        | simp
        | norm_num
    have hdf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w a b)) y :=
      (hf.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by
        first
          | exact_mod_cast (le_top : ((1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
          | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
          | simp
          | norm_num)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have conv : ∀ c d : Fin 3, partialDeriv c (fun z => partialDeriv d (fun w => G w a b) z) y =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w a b)) y (e c) (e d) := by
      intro c d
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w a b) z (e d)) y (e c) = _
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hdf (differentiableAt_const (e d))]
      simp
    rw [conv, conv]
    exact hsym.eq (e c) (e d)
  
  intro y hy i j k m
  have hc := core (G y) ((G y)⁻¹) (fun l j k => christoffel G l j k y)
    (fun c a b => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y)
    (fun c d a b => partialDeriv c (fun z => partialDeriv d (fun w => G w a b) z) y)
    (fun i l j k => partialDeriv i (christoffel G l j k) y)
    (hinv y hy) (hGsymm y)
    (fun c a b => by
      show partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y = partialDeriv c (fun z => G z b a) y
      rw [show (fun z => G z a b) = (fun z => G z b a) from funext fun z => hGsymm z a b])
    (fun c d a b => hschwarz y hy c d a b)
    (fun l j k => rfl)
    (fun i m j k => h6all y hy i m j k) i j k m
  simpa only [riemannLocal] using hc

informal_problem.statement: {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (V : F → F) (K : NNReal) (hVL : LipschitzWith K V) (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ x, ‖V x‖ ≤ B) : ∃ Ψ : ℝ → F → F, (∀ x, Ψ 0 x = x) ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : F), HasDerivAt (fun s => Ψ s x) (V (Ψ t x)) t

signature.name: ode_global_flow_exists
signature.statement: {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F] (V : F → F) (K : NNReal) (hVL : LipschitzWith K V) (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ x, ‖V x‖ ≤ B) : ∃ Ψ : ℝ → F → F, (∀ x, Ψ 0 x = x) ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : F), HasDerivAt (fun s => Ψ s x) (V (Ψ t x)) t

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hS1 : ∀ (x : F) (T : ℝ), 0 < T → ∃ α : ℝ → F, α 0 = x ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt α (V (α t)) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t := by
    intro x T hT
    let t₀ : Set.Icc (-T) T := ⟨0, by constructor <;> linarith⟩
    have hBL : B ≤ ((Real.toNNReal B : NNReal) : ℝ) := Real.le_coe_toNNReal B
    have hTn : ((Real.toNNReal T : NNReal) : ℝ) = T := Real.coe_toNNReal T hT.le
    have hPL : IsPicardLindelof (fun _ => V) t₀ x (Real.toNNReal B * Real.toNNReal T) 0
        (Real.toNNReal B) K := by
      apply IsPicardLindelof.of_time_independent
      · intro y _
        exact (hB y).trans hBL
      · exact hVL.lipschitzOnWith
      · have ht0 : ((t₀ : ℝ)) = 0 := rfl
        rw [ht0, NNReal.coe_mul, hTn, NNReal.coe_zero, sub_zero, sub_zero, zero_sub, neg_neg,
          max_self]
    obtain ⟨α, h0, hd⟩ := hPL.exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt₀
    exact ⟨α, h0, hd⟩
  
  have hS2 : ∀ (T₁ T₂ : ℝ), 0 < T₁ → 0 < T₂ → ∀ (α β : ℝ → F),
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T₁) T₁, HasDerivWithinAt α (V (α t)) (Set.Icc (-T₁) T₁) t) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T₂) T₂, HasDerivWithinAt β (V (β t)) (Set.Icc (-T₂) T₂) t) →
      α 0 = β 0 → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < T₁ → |t| < T₂ → α t = β t := by
    intro T₁ T₂ hT₁ hT₂ α β hα hβ h0 t ht₁ ht₂
    have hS : 0 < min T₁ T₂ := lt_min hT₁ hT₂
    have gen : ∀ (γ : ℝ → F) (T' : ℝ), min T₁ T₂ ≤ T' →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T') T', HasDerivWithinAt γ (V (γ t)) (Set.Icc (-T') T') t) →
        ContinuousOn γ (Set.Icc (-(min T₁ T₂)) (min T₁ T₂)) ∧
          ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-(min T₁ T₂)) (min T₁ T₂), HasDerivAt γ (V (γ t)) t := by
      intro γ T' hST' hγ
      refine ⟨fun t ht => ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
      · have htT : t ∈ Set.Icc (-T') T' := ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
        exact (hγ t htT).continuousWithinAt.mono (Set.Icc_subset_Icc (neg_le_neg hST') hST')
      · have h1 : -T' < t := by linarith [ht.1]
        have h2 : t < T' := by linarith [ht.2]
        exact (hγ t ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds h1 h2)
    obtain ⟨hαc, hαd⟩ := gen α T₁ (min_le_left _ _) hα
    obtain ⟨hβc, hβd⟩ := gen β T₂ (min_le_right _ _) hβ
    have hEq := ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc (v := fun _ => V) (s := fun _ => Set.univ) (K := K)
      (fun _ _ => hVL.lipschitzOnWith)
      (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-(min T₁ T₂)) (min T₁ T₂) from ⟨by linarith, hS⟩)
      hαc hαd (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) hβc hβd (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) h0
    have htS : |t| < min T₁ T₂ := lt_min ht₁ ht₂
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_lt.mp htS
    exact hEq ⟨h1.le, h2.le⟩
  
  have hA : ∀ (x : F) (T : ℝ), ∃ α : ℝ → F, 0 < T → (α 0 = x ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivWithinAt α (V (α t)) (Set.Icc (-T) T) t) := by
    intro x T
    by_cases hT : 0 < T
    · obtain ⟨α, h0, hd⟩ := hS1 x T hT
      exact ⟨α, fun _ => ⟨h0, hd⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨fun _ => x, fun h => absurd h hT⟩
  choose α hα using hA
  have hpos : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < |s| + 1 := fun s => by positivity
  refine ⟨fun t x => α x (|t| + 1) t, fun x => (hα x (|0| + 1) (hpos 0)).1, ?_⟩
  intro t x
  obtain ⟨-, hd⟩ := hα x (|t| + 1) (hpos t)
  have h := abs_lt.mp (show |t| < |t| + 1 by linarith)
  have hαt : HasDerivAt (α x (|t| + 1)) (V (α x (|t| + 1) t)) t :=
    (hd t ⟨h.1.le, h.2.le⟩).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds h.1 h.2)
  apply hαt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds h.1 h.2] with s hs
  have h0eq : α x (|s| + 1) 0 = α x (|t| + 1) 0 :=
    (hα x _ (hpos s)).1.trans (hα x _ (hpos t)).1.symm
  exact hS2 (|s| + 1) (|t| + 1) (hpos s) (hpos t) _ _ (hα x _ (hpos s)).2 hd h0eq s
    (by linarith) (abs_lt.mpr ⟨hs.1, hs.2⟩)

informal_problem.statement: {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (V : F → F) (K : NNReal) (hVL : LipschitzWith K V) (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ x, ‖V x‖ ≤ B) (Ψ : ℝ → F → F) (hΨ0 : ∀ x, Ψ 0 x = x) (hΨ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : F), HasDerivAt (fun s => Ψ s x) (V (Ψ t x)) t) : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × F => Ψ p.1 p.2)

signature.name: ode_flow_continuous_init
signature.statement: {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (V : F → F) (K : NNReal) (hVL : LipschitzWith K V) (B : ℝ) (hB : ∀ x, ‖V x‖ ≤ B) (Ψ : ℝ → F → F) (hΨ0 : ∀ x, Ψ 0 x = x) (hΨ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : F), HasDerivAt (fun s => Ψ s x) (V (Ψ t x)) t) : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × F => Ψ p.1 p.2)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have gron : ∀ (W : F → F), LipschitzWith K W → ∀ Φ : ℝ → F → F, (∀ x, Φ 0 x = x) →
      (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : F), HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ s x) (W (Φ t x)) t) →
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ∀ x y : F, dist (Φ t x) (Φ t y) ≤ dist x y * Real.exp (K * t) := by
    intro W hW Φ hΦ0 hΦ t ht x y
    have hcx : Continuous (fun s => Φ s x) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun s => (hΦ s x).continuousAt
    have hcy : Continuous (fun s => Φ s y) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun s => (hΦ s y).continuousAt
    have h := dist_le_of_trajectories_ODE (v := fun _ => W) (K := K) (fun _ => hW)
      (f := fun s => Φ s x) (g := fun s => Φ s y) (a := 0) (b := t) (δ := dist x y)
      hcx.continuousOn (fun s _ => (hΦ s x).hasDerivWithinAt)
      hcy.continuousOn (fun s _ => (hΦ s y).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (by simp only [hΦ0]; exact le_rfl) t ⟨ht, le_rfl⟩
    simpa only [sub_zero] using h
  
  have two : ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ x y : F, dist (Ψ t x) (Ψ t y) ≤ dist x y * Real.exp (K * |t|) := by
    intro t x y
    rcases le_or_gt 0 t with ht | ht
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg ht]
      exact gron V hVL Ψ hΨ0 hΨ t ht x y
    · have hd : ∀ (s₀ : ℝ) (z : F),
          HasDerivAt (fun s => Ψ (-s) z) ((fun w => -V w) (Ψ (-s₀) z)) s₀ := by
        intro s₀ z
        have h1 := (hΨ (-s₀) z).scomp s₀ (hasDerivAt_neg s₀)
        simp only [neg_one_smul] at h1
        exact h1
      have h := gron (fun w => -V w) hVL.neg (fun s z => Ψ (-s) z)
        (fun z => by simp only [neg_zero, hΨ0]) hd (-t) (by linarith) x y
      simp only [neg_neg] at h
      rw [abs_of_neg ht]
      exact h
  have hspace : ∀ t : ℝ, Continuous (fun y => Ψ t y) := by
    intro t
    refine (LipschitzWith.of_dist_le' (K := Real.exp (K * |t|)) ?_).continuous
    intro x y
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact two t x y
  have htime : ∀ x : F, LipschitzWith B.toNNReal (fun s => Ψ s x) := by
    intro x
    refine lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_deriv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (fun s => (hΨ s x).differentiableAt) ?_
    intro s
    rw [(hΨ s x).deriv, ← NNReal.coe_le_coe, coe_nnnorm, Real.coe_toNNReal']
    exact le_max_of_le_left (hB _)
  exact continuous_prod_of_continuous_lipschitzWith (fun p : ℝ × F => Ψ p.1 p.2) B.toNNReal
    hspace htime

informal_problem.statement: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (X : E → E) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) (K : NNReal) (hDX : ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ X y‖ ≤ K) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) : ∃ Z : E × (E →L[ℝ] E) → E × (E →L[ℝ] E), ContDiff ℝ ∞ Z ∧ HasCompactSupport Z ∧ (∀ (x : E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E), ‖A‖ ≤ R → Z (x, A) = (X x, (fderiv ℝ X x).comp A)) ∧ ∀ p, ‖(Z p).2‖ ≤ K * ‖p.2‖

signature.name: augmented_field_exists
signature.statement: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (X : E → E) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hXc : HasCompactSupport X) (K : NNReal) (hDX : ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ X y‖ ≤ K) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) : ∃ Z : E × (E →L[ℝ] E) → E × (E →L[ℝ] E), ContDiff ℝ ∞ Z ∧ HasCompactSupport Z ∧ (∀ (x : E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E), ‖A‖ ≤ R → Z (x, A) = (X x, (fderiv ℝ X x).comp A)) ∧ ∀ p, ‖(Z p).2‖ ≤ K * ‖p.2‖

proof.tactics:
by
  let f : ContDiffBump (0 : E →L[ℝ] E) := ⟨R, R + 1, hR, by linarith⟩
  have hfs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun A : E →L[ℝ] E => f A) := f.contDiff (n := ⊤)
  have hDXs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ X) := hX.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)
  refine ⟨fun p => f p.2 • (X p.1, (fderiv ℝ X p.1).comp p.2), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (hfs.comp contDiff_snd).smul
      ((hX.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk ((hDXs.comp contDiff_fst).clm_comp contDiff_snd))
  · refine HasCompactSupport.intro (hXc.isCompact.prod f.hasCompactSupport.isCompact) ?_
    intro p hp
    rw [Set.mem_prod, not_and_or] at hp
    rcases hp with h | h
    · have h1 : X p.1 = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport h
      have h2 : fderiv ℝ X p.1 = 0 := fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport ℝ h
      simp only [h1, h2, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp, Prod.mk_zero_zero, smul_zero]
    · have h1 : f p.2 = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport h
      simp only [h1, zero_smul]
  · intro x A hA
    have h1 : f A = 1 := f.one_of_mem_closedBall (by
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]; exact hA)
    simp only [h1, one_smul]
  · intro p
    show ‖f p.2 • (fderiv ℝ X p.1).comp p.2‖ ≤ K * ‖p.2‖
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg f.nonneg]
    have h1 : ‖(fderiv ℝ X p.1).comp p.2‖ ≤ K * ‖p.2‖ :=
      ((fderiv ℝ X p.1).opNorm_comp_le p.2).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hDX p.1) (norm_nonneg _))
    have h2 : f p.2 ≤ 1 := f.le_one
    have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖(fderiv ℝ X p.1).comp p.2‖ := norm_nonneg _
    nlinarith [f.nonneg (x := p.2)]

informal_problem.statement: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (X : E → E) (K : NNReal) (hXL : LipschitzWith K X) (T : ℝ) (Z : E × (E →L[ℝ] E) → E × (E →L[ℝ] E)) (hZ : ∀ (x : E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E), ‖A‖ ≤ Real.exp (K * T) → Z (x, A) = (X x, (fderiv ℝ X x).comp A)) (hZb : ∀ p, ‖(Z p).2‖ ≤ K * ‖p.2‖) (Fl : ℝ → E → E) (hFl0 : ∀ x, Fl 0 x = x) (hFl : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E), HasDerivAt (fun s => Fl s x) (X (Fl t x)) t) (G : ℝ → E × (E →L[ℝ] E) → E × (E →L[ℝ] E)) (hG0 : ∀ p, G 0 p = p) (hG : ∀ (t : ℝ) (p : E × (E →L[ℝ] E)), HasDerivAt (fun s => G s p) (Z (G t p)) t) : ∀ (x : E), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, (G t (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).1 = Fl t x ∧ ‖(G t (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2‖ ≤ Real.exp (K * |t|) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => (G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2) ((fderiv ℝ X (Fl t x)).comp (G t (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2) t

signature.name: augmented_flow_ident
signature.statement: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (X : E → E) (K : NNReal) (hXL : LipschitzWith K X) (T : ℝ) (Z : E × (E →L[ℝ] E) → E × (E →L[ℝ] E)) (hZ : ∀ (x : E) (A : E →L[ℝ] E), ‖A‖ ≤ Real.exp (K * T) → Z (x, A) = (X x, (fderiv ℝ X x).comp A)) (hZb : ∀ p, ‖(Z p).2‖ ≤ K * ‖p.2‖) (Fl : ℝ → E → E) (hFl0 : ∀ x, Fl 0 x = x) (hFl : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E), HasDerivAt (fun s => Fl s x) (X (Fl t x)) t) (G : ℝ → E × (E →L[ℝ] E) → E × (E →L[ℝ] E)) (hG0 : ∀ p, G 0 p = p) (hG : ∀ (t : ℝ) (p : E × (E →L[ℝ] E)), HasDerivAt (fun s => G s p) (Z (G t p)) t) : ∀ (x : E), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, (G t (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).1 = Fl t x ∧ ‖(G t (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2‖ ≤ Real.exp (K * |t|) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => (G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2) ((fderiv ℝ X (Fl t x)).comp (G t (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2) t

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x
  have hKnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (K : ℝ) := K.coe_nonneg
  
  have hd1 : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => (G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).1)
      (Z (G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E))).1 s := fun s => by
    have h := (hasFDerivAt_fst (𝕜 := ℝ) (p := G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E))).comp_hasDerivAt
      s (hG s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E))
    exact h
  have hd2 : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => (G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2)
      (Z (G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E))).2 s := fun s => by
    have h := (hasFDerivAt_snd (𝕜 := ℝ) (p := G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E))).comp_hasDerivAt
      s (hG s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E))
    exact h
  have hA0 : ‖(G 0 (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hG0]; exact ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le
  
  have fwd : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → (E →L[ℝ] E)), (∀ s, HasDerivAt f (f' s) s) →
      (∀ s, ‖f' s‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) * ‖f s‖) → ‖f 0‖ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ‖f t‖ ≤ Real.exp ((K : ℝ) * t) := by
    intro f f' hf hb h0 t ht
    have h := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le (a := 0) (b := t) (f := f)
      (f' := f') (δ := 1) (K := (K : ℝ)) (ε := 0)
      (fun s _ => (hf s).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) (fun s _ => (hf s).hasDerivWithinAt) h0
      (fun s _ => by rw [add_zero]; exact hb s) t ⟨ht, le_refl t⟩
    rw [gronwallBound_ε0, sub_zero, one_mul] at h
    exact h
  
  have hbound : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖(G t (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2‖ ≤ Real.exp ((K : ℝ) * |t|) := by
    intro t
    rcases le_or_gt 0 t with ht | ht
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg ht]
      exact fwd _ _ hd2 (fun s => hZb _) hA0 t ht
    · rw [abs_of_neg ht]
      have h := fwd (fun s => (G (-s) (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2)
        (fun s => -(Z (G (-s) (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E))).2)
        (fun s => by
          have h1 := (hd2 (-s)).scomp s (hasDerivAt_neg' s)
          simpa [Function.comp_def] using h1)
        (fun s => by rw [norm_neg]; exact hZb _)
        (by simpa using hA0) (-t) (by linarith)
      simpa using h
  intro t ht
  
  have hZs : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, Z (G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)) =
      (X (G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).1,
        (fderiv ℝ X (G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).1).comp
          (G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2) := by
    intro s hs
    have h1 : ‖(G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).2‖ ≤ Real.exp ((K : ℝ) * T) :=
      (hbound s).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_le.mpr ⟨hs.1, hs.2⟩) hKnn))
    exact hZ _ _ h1
  
  have hfirst : (G t (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).1 = Fl t x := by
    have hT0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T := by linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hT0 with hT0 | hT0
    · have htz : t = 0 := by
        have h1 := ht.1
        have h2 := ht.2
        rw [← hT0] at h1 h2
        linarith
      subst htz
      rw [hG0, hFl0]
    · have h := ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc (v := fun _ => X) (s := fun _ => Set.univ)
        (K := K) (a := -T) (b := T) (t₀ := 0)
        (f := fun s => (G s (x, ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)).1) (g := fun s => Fl s x)
        (fun _ _ => hXL.lipschitzOnWith) ⟨by linarith, hT0⟩
        (fun s _ => (hd1 s).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
        (fun s hs => (hd1 s).congr_deriv (by rw [hZs s (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hs)]))
        (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
        (fun s _ => (hFl s x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
        (fun s _ => hFl s x)
        (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
        (by simp only [hG0, hFl0])
      exact h ht
  refine ⟨hfirst, hbound t, ?_⟩
  have h := hd2 t
  rw [hZs t ht] at h
  rw [← hfirst]
  exact h

informal_problem.statement: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (X : E → E) (hX : Differentiable ℝ X) (K : NNReal) (hXL : LipschitzWith K X) (hDX : ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ X y‖ ≤ K) (hDXu : UniformContinuous (fderiv ℝ X)) (Fl : ℝ → E → E) (hFl0 : ∀ x, Fl 0 x = x) (hFl : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E), HasDerivAt (fun s => Fl s x) (X (Fl t x)) t) (T : ℝ) (Y : ℝ → E → (E →L[ℝ] E)) (hY0 : ∀ x, Y 0 x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) (hY : ∀ (x : E), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivAt (fun s => Y s x) ((fderiv ℝ X (Fl t x)).comp (Y t x)) t) : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ (x h : E), ‖h‖ < δ → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖Fl t (x + h) - Fl t x - Y t x h‖ ≤ ε * ‖h‖

signature.name: flow_variational_estimate
signature.statement: {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (X : E → E) (hX : Differentiable ℝ X) (K : NNReal) (hXL : LipschitzWith K X) (hDX : ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ X y‖ ≤ K) (hDXu : UniformContinuous (fderiv ℝ X)) (Fl : ℝ → E → E) (hFl0 : ∀ x, Fl 0 x = x) (hFl : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E), HasDerivAt (fun s => Fl s x) (X (Fl t x)) t) (T : ℝ) (Y : ℝ → E → (E →L[ℝ] E)) (hY0 : ∀ x, Y 0 x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E) (hY : ∀ (x : E), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivAt (fun s => Y s x) ((fderiv ℝ X (Fl t x)).comp (Y t x)) t) : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ (x h : E), ‖h‖ < δ → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖Fl t (x + h) - Fl t x - Y t x h‖ ≤ ε * ‖h‖

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have fwd : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → E) (k ε δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ k → 0 ≤ ε →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ‖f' t‖ ≤ k * ‖f t‖ + ε) → ‖f 0‖ ≤ δ →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ‖f t‖ ≤ (δ + ε * t) * Real.exp (k * t) := by
    intro f f' k ε δ hk hε hf hb h0 t ht
    have hg := norm_le_gronwallBound_of_norm_deriv_right_le (f := f) (f' := f') (δ := δ)
      (K := k) (ε := ε) (a := 0) (b := T)
      (fun s hs => (hf s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun s hs => (hf s (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hs)).hasDerivWithinAt) h0
      (fun s hs => hb s (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hs)) t ht
    rw [sub_zero] at hg
    refine hg.trans ?_
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hk with hk0 | hkpos
    · subst hk0
      simp [gronwallBound_K0]
    · rw [gronwallBound_of_K_ne_0 hkpos.ne']
      have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := ht.1
      have e1 := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(k * t))
      have e2 : Real.exp (-(k * t)) * Real.exp (k * t) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
      have epos := Real.exp_pos (k * t)
      have e3 : Real.exp (k * t) - 1 ≤ k * t * Real.exp (k * t) := by nlinarith
      have hεk : 0 ≤ ε / k := div_nonneg hε hk
      have e4 : ε / k * (Real.exp (k * t) - 1) ≤ ε / k * (k * t * Real.exp (k * t)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 hεk
      have e5 : ε / k * (k * t * Real.exp (k * t)) = ε * t * Real.exp (k * t) := by
        field_simp
      nlinarith
  
  have gron : ∀ (f f' : ℝ → E) (k ε δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ k → 0 ≤ ε →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, HasDerivAt f (f' t) t) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖f' t‖ ≤ k * ‖f t‖ + ε) → ‖f 0‖ ≤ δ →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖f t‖ ≤ (δ + ε * |t|) * Real.exp (k * |t|) := by
    intro f f' k ε δ hk hε hf hb h0 t ht
    have hsub : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, s ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T :=
      fun s hs => ⟨by linarith [hs.1, hs.2], hs.2⟩
    have hsub' : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, -s ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T :=
      fun s hs => ⟨by linarith [hs.2], by linarith [hs.1, hs.2]⟩
    rcases le_total 0 t with h | h
    · have := fwd f f' k ε δ hk hε (fun s hs => hf s (hsub s hs)) (fun s hs => hb s (hsub s hs))
        h0 t ⟨h, ht.2⟩
      rwa [abs_of_nonneg h]
    · have := fwd (fun s => f (-s)) (fun s => -f' (-s)) k ε δ hk hε ?_ ?_ (by simpa using h0)
        (-t) ⟨by linarith, by linarith [ht.1]⟩
      · simp only [neg_neg] at this
        rwa [abs_of_nonpos h]
      · intro s hs
        have := (hf (-s) (hsub' s hs)).scomp s (hasDerivAt_neg s)
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using this
      · intro s hs
        simpa using hb (-s) (hsub' s hs)
  
  have taylor : ∀ η > 0, ∃ r > 0, ∀ a y : E, ‖y - a‖ < r →
      ‖X y - X a - fderiv ℝ X a (y - a)‖ ≤ η * ‖y - a‖ := by
    intro η hη
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hu⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.mp hDXu η hη
    refine ⟨r, hr, fun a y hy => ?_⟩
    exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le' (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := X) (s := Metric.ball a r)
      (φ := fderiv ℝ X a) (C := η) (fun z _ => hX z)
      (fun z hz => by
        have := hu (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz)
        rw [dist_eq_norm] at this
        exact this.le)
      (convex_ball a r) (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
      (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; exact hy)
  
  intro ε hε
  rcases lt_or_ge T 0 with hT | hT
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun x h _ t ht => ?_⟩
    exfalso
    linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
  have hk : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) := K.coe_nonneg
  set M := Real.exp ((K : ℝ) * T) with hMdef
  have hM : 0 < M := Real.exp_pos _
  have hM1 : 1 ≤ M := Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg hk hT)
  set C := T * M * M + 1 with hCdef
  have hC : 0 < C := by positivity
  have hCne : C ≠ 0 := hC.ne'
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hTB⟩ := taylor (ε / C) (div_pos hε hC)
  refine ⟨r / M, div_pos hr hM, fun x h hh t ht => ?_⟩
  have hhM : ‖h‖ * M < r := (lt_div_iff₀ hM).mp hh
  have hexp : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, Real.exp ((K : ℝ) * |s|) ≤ M := fun s hs =>
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_le.mpr ⟨hs.1, hs.2⟩) hk)
  have hsep : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (-T) T, ‖Fl s (x + h) - Fl s x‖ ≤ ‖h‖ * M := by
    intro s hs
    have := gron (fun s => Fl s (x + h) - Fl s x) (fun s => X (Fl s (x + h)) - X (Fl s x))
      (K : ℝ) 0 ‖h‖ hk le_rfl (fun s _ => (hFl s (x + h)).sub (hFl s x))
      (fun s _ => by simp only [add_zero]; exact hXL.norm_sub_le _ _) (by simp [hFl0]) s hs
    simp only [zero_mul, add_zero] at this
    exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hexp s hs) (norm_nonneg _))
  have hρ := gron (fun s => Fl s (x + h) - Fl s x - Y s x h)
    (fun s => X (Fl s (x + h)) - X (Fl s x) - fderiv ℝ X (Fl s x) (Y s x h)) (K : ℝ)
    (ε / C * (‖h‖ * M)) 0 hk (by positivity) ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
  · have ha : |t| ≤ T := abs_le.mpr ⟨ht.1, ht.2⟩
    have he := hexp t ht
    have haa : 0 ≤ ε / C * (‖h‖ * M) := by positivity
    have h1 : ε / C * (‖h‖ * M) * |t| ≤ ε / C * (‖h‖ * M) * T :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha haa
    have h2 : (ε / C * (‖h‖ * M) * |t|) * Real.exp ((K : ℝ) * |t|) ≤
        (ε / C * (‖h‖ * M) * T) * M :=
      mul_le_mul h1 he (Real.exp_pos _).le (mul_nonneg haa hT)
    have h3 : (ε / C * (‖h‖ * M) * T) * M = ε / C * ‖h‖ * (T * M * M) := by ring
    have h4 : ε / C * ‖h‖ * (T * M * M) ≤ ε / C * ‖h‖ * C :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by rw [hCdef]; linarith) (by positivity)
    have h5 : ε / C * ‖h‖ * C = ε * ‖h‖ := by field_simp
    simp only [zero_add] at hρ
    linarith
  · intro s hs
    have h1 := (hY x s hs).clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const s h)
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, map_zero, add_zero] at h1
    exact ((hFl s (x + h)).sub (hFl s x)).sub h1
  · intro s hs
    have hd := hsep s hs
    have key : X (Fl s (x + h)) - X (Fl s x) - fderiv ℝ X (Fl s x) (Y s x h) =
        (X (Fl s (x + h)) - X (Fl s x) - fderiv ℝ X (Fl s x) (Fl s (x + h) - Fl s x)) +
          fderiv ℝ X (Fl s x) (Fl s (x + h) - Fl s x - Y s x h) := by
      rw [map_sub (fderiv ℝ X (Fl s x)) (Fl s (x + h) - Fl s x)]
      abel
    simp only []
    rw [key]
    have t1 := hTB (Fl s x) (Fl s (x + h)) (lt_of_le_of_lt hd hhM)
    have t2 := ContinuousLinearMap.le_of_opNorm_le _ (hDX (Fl s x))
      (Fl s (x + h) - Fl s x - Y s x h)
    have t3 : ε / C * ‖Fl s (x + h) - Fl s x‖ ≤ ε / C * (‖h‖ * M) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (by positivity)
    refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
    linarith
  · simp [hFl0, hY0]

informal_problem.statement: {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (Φ : ℝ → E → F) (Y : ℝ → E → (E →L[ℝ] F)) (t₀ : ℝ) (x₀ : E) (v : F) (ht : HasDerivAt (fun t => Φ t x₀) v t₀) (hYc : ContinuousAt (fun t => Y t x₀) t₀) (hunif : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t : ℝ, |t - t₀| < δ → ∀ h : E, ‖h‖ < δ → ‖Φ t (x₀ + h) - Φ t x₀ - Y t x₀ h‖ ≤ ε * ‖h‖) : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × E => Φ p.1 p.2) ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).smulRight v + (Y t₀ x₀).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E)) (t₀, x₀)

signature.name: hasFDerivAt_uncurry_of_uniform
signature.statement: {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (Φ : ℝ → E → F) (Y : ℝ → E → (E →L[ℝ] F)) (t₀ : ℝ) (x₀ : E) (v : F) (ht : HasDerivAt (fun t => Φ t x₀) v t₀) (hYc : ContinuousAt (fun t => Y t x₀) t₀) (hunif : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t : ℝ, |t - t₀| < δ → ∀ h : E, ‖h‖ < δ → ‖Φ t (x₀ + h) - Φ t x₀ - Y t x₀ h‖ ≤ ε * ‖h‖) : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × E => Φ p.1 p.2) ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E).smulRight v + (Y t₀ x₀).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E)) (t₀, x₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
  intro c hc
  have hε : 0 < c / 3 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, h1⟩ := hunif (c / 3) hε
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h2⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hYc (c / 3) hε
  have h3 := hasDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero.mp ht
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff] at h3
  obtain ⟨δ₃, hδ₃, h3'⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (h3 hε)
  rw [Metric.eventually_nhds_iff]
  refine ⟨min δ₁ (min δ₂ δ₃), lt_min hδ₁ (lt_min hδ₂ hδ₃), ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨s, h⟩ hp
  rw [dist_zero_right] at hp
  have hs : ‖s‖ ≤ ‖(s, h)‖ := norm_fst_le (s, h)
  have hh : ‖h‖ ≤ ‖(s, h)‖ := norm_snd_le (s, h)
  have hpδ1 : ‖(s, h)‖ < δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hp (min_le_left _ _)
  have hpδ2 : ‖(s, h)‖ < δ₂ :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hp (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hpδ3 : ‖(s, h)‖ < δ₃ :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hp (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  have habs : |t₀ + s - t₀| = ‖s‖ := by rw [add_sub_cancel_left, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have e1 : ‖Φ (t₀ + s) (x₀ + h) - Φ (t₀ + s) x₀ - Y (t₀ + s) x₀ h‖ ≤ c / 3 * ‖h‖ :=
    h1 (t₀ + s) (by rw [habs]; linarith) h (by linarith)
  have e2 : ‖Y (t₀ + s) x₀ - Y t₀ x₀‖ < c / 3 := by
    have := h2 (x := t₀ + s) (by rw [Real.dist_eq, habs]; linarith)
    rwa [dist_eq_norm] at this
  have e3 : ‖Φ (t₀ + s) x₀ - Φ t₀ x₀ - s • v‖ ≤ c / 3 * ‖s‖ := by
    have := h3' (y := s) (by rw [dist_zero_right]; linarith)
    exact this
  have e2' : ‖(Y (t₀ + s) x₀ - Y t₀ x₀) h‖ ≤ c / 3 * ‖h‖ :=
    le_trans (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right e2.le (norm_nonneg _))
  have m1 : c / 3 * ‖h‖ ≤ c / 3 * ‖(s, h)‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh hε.le
  have m2 : c / 3 * ‖s‖ ≤ c / 3 * ‖(s, h)‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hε.le
  calc _ = ‖(Φ (t₀ + s) (x₀ + h) - Φ (t₀ + s) x₀ - Y (t₀ + s) x₀ h) +
          (Y (t₀ + s) x₀ - Y t₀ x₀) h + (Φ (t₀ + s) x₀ - Φ t₀ x₀ - s • v)‖ := by
        congr 1
        simp only [Prod.mk_add_mk, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst',
          ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd',
          ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
        abel
    _ ≤ ‖Φ (t₀ + s) (x₀ + h) - Φ (t₀ + s) x₀ - Y (t₀ + s) x₀ h‖ +
          ‖(Y (t₀ + s) x₀ - Y t₀ x₀) h‖ + ‖Φ (t₀ + s) x₀ - Φ t₀ x₀ - s • v‖ := norm_add₃_le
    _ ≤ c * ‖(s, h)‖ := by linarith

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (W : Set E3) (hW : IsOpen W) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) W) (hGs : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ W, (G y).PosDef) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ W) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ W, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y₀ v₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ W) (hΦ₀ : Φ y₀ = 0) (hv₀ : fderiv ℝ Φ y₀ v₀ = 0) : ∃ (ε : ℝ) (ζ : ℝ → E3 × E3), 0 < ε ∧ ζ 0 = (y₀, v₀) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, HasDerivAt ζ ((ζ t).2, -sprayGam G (ζ t).1 (ζ t).2 - sprayA G Φ (ζ t).1 (ζ t).2) t ∧ (ζ t).1 ∈ W ∧ Φ (ζ t).1 = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ Φ (ζ t).1 (ζ t).2 = 0 ∧ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (ζ t).2 k * G (ζ t).1 k l * (ζ t).2 l = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l

signature.name: local_spray_invariant
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (W : Set E3) (hW : IsOpen W) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) W) (hGs : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ W, (G y).PosDef) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ W) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ W, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y₀ v₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ W) (hΦ₀ : Φ y₀ = 0) (hv₀ : fderiv ℝ Φ y₀ v₀ = 0) : ∃ (ε : ℝ) (ζ : ℝ → E3 × E3), 0 < ε ∧ ζ 0 = (y₀, v₀) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, HasDerivAt ζ ((ζ t).2, -sprayGam G (ζ t).1 (ζ t).2 - sprayA G Φ (ζ t).1 (ζ t).2) t ∧ (ζ t).1 ∈ W ∧ Φ (ζ t).1 = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ Φ (ζ t).1 (ζ t).2 = 0 ∧ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (ζ t).2 k * G (ζ t).1 k l * (ζ t).2 l = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l

proof.tactics:
by
  have h2inf : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  have h1inf : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  have h112 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ 2 := by norm_num
  
  have hsymm_apply : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → ℝ) (k : Fin 3),
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm f k = f k := fun f k => by simp
  have hsmul_apply : ∀ (c : ℝ) (v : E3) (k : Fin 3), (c • v) k = c * v k := fun c v k => by simp
  have hsub_apply : ∀ (v w : E3) (k : Fin 3), (v - w) k = v k - w k := fun v w k => by simp
  have hneg_apply : ∀ (v : E3) (k : Fin 3), (-v) k = -v k := fun v k => by simp
  
  have hlin : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (u : E3), L u = ∑ m : Fin 3, L (e m) * u m := by
    intro L u
    have hu : u = u 0 • e 0 + u 1 • e 1 + u 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hu]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : E3 → ℝ, N = fun y =>
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Φ y * partialDeriv b Φ y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hNe : ∀ y, N y =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Φ y * partialDeriv b Φ y :=
    fun y => by rw [hN]
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : E3 → E3 → ℝ, H = fun y v =>
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ i j y * v i * v j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hHe : ∀ y v, H y v = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ i j y * v i * v j :=
    fun y v => by rw [hH]
  have hsA : ∀ (y v : E3) (k : Fin 3),
      sprayA G Φ y v k = H y v / N y * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l Φ y := by
    intro y v k
    simp only [sprayA, hsmul_apply, hsymm_apply, hNe, hHe]
  have hsG : ∀ (y v : E3) (k : Fin 3),
      sprayGam G y v k = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y * v a * v b := by
    intro y v k
    simp only [sprayGam, hsymm_apply]
  
  
  have hNpos : ∀ y ∈ W, 0 < N y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hNe]
    have hξ : (fun a : Fin 3 => partialDeriv a Φ y) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hdΦ y hy
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun u => ?_
      rw [hlin (fderiv ℝ Φ y) u]
      have h' : ∀ m : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ Φ y (e m) = 0 := fun m => congrFun h m
      simp [h']
    have h := (hGpd y hy).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum] at h
    refine lt_of_lt_of_eq h (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_)
    ring
  
  
  have hGinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) W := by
    have hdetK : ∀ K : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
        (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => K y a b) W) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (K y).det) W := by
      intro K hK
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3),
          ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℝ) * ∏ k, K y (σ k) k) W :=
        ContDiffOn.sum fun σ _ => contDiffOn_const.mul (contDiffOn_prod fun k _ => hK (σ k) k)
      refine h1.congr ?_
      intro y _
      exact Matrix.det_apply' (K y)
    have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).adjugate i j) W := by
      intro i j
      have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1)).det) W := by
        apply hdetK (fun y => (G y).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1))
        intro a b
        by_cases hab : a = j
        · subst hab
          simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
          exact contDiffOn_const
        · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
          exact hG a b
      refine h2.congr ?_
      intro y _
      exact Matrix.adjugate_apply (G y) i j
    have hne : ∀ y ∈ W, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hGpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
    intro i j
    have h3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate i j) W :=
      ((hdetK G hG).inv hne).mul (hadj i j)
    refine h3.congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, smul_eq_mul]
  
  
  have hPd : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => partialDeriv i f y) W := by
    intro f hf i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) W := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW).1 hf).2
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hpΦ : ∀ l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => partialDeriv l Φ y) W := hPd Φ hΦ
  have hchr : ∀ k a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => christoffel G k a b y) W := by
    intro k a b
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hGinv k l).mul
      (((hPd _ (hG b l) a).add (hPd _ (hG a l) b)).sub (hPd _ (hG a b) l)))
  have hhess : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => hessLoc G Φ i j y) W := by
    intro i j
    unfold hessLoc
    exact (hPd _ (hpΦ j) i).sub (ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hchr k i j).mul (hpΦ k))
  
  
  have hy₀W : W ∈ 𝓝 y₀ := hW.mem_nhds hy₀
  have hca : ∀ c : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c W →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => c p.1) (y₀, v₀) :=
    fun c hc => (hc.contDiffAt hy₀W).comp (y₀, v₀) contDiffAt_fst
  have hco : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => p.2 a) (y₀, v₀) := fun a =>
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp contDiff_snd).contDiffAt
  have hGam : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => sprayGam G p.1 p.2) (y₀, v₀) := by
    have h : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => fun k : Fin 3 =>
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b p.1 * p.2 a * p.2 b) (y₀, v₀) :=
      contDiffAt_pi.2 fun k => ContDiffAt.sum fun a _ => ContDiffAt.sum fun b _ =>
        ((hca _ (hchr k a b)).mul (hco a)).mul (hco b)
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp (y₀, v₀) h
  have hAc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => sprayA G Φ p.1 p.2) (y₀, v₀) := by
    have hNc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 =>
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G p.1)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Φ p.1 * partialDeriv b Φ p.1)
        (y₀, v₀) :=
      ContDiffAt.sum fun a _ => ContDiffAt.sum fun b _ =>
        ((hca _ (hGinv a b)).mul (hca _ (hpΦ a))).mul (hca _ (hpΦ b))
    have hHc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 =>
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, hessLoc G Φ i j p.1 * p.2 i * p.2 j) (y₀, v₀) :=
      ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => ContDiffAt.sum fun j _ =>
        ((hca _ (hhess i j)).mul (hco i)).mul (hco j)
    have hnc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm
        (fun k => ∑ l : Fin 3, (G p.1)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l Φ p.1)) (y₀, v₀) := by
      have h : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × E3 => fun k : Fin 3 =>
          ∑ l : Fin 3, (G p.1)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l Φ p.1) (y₀, v₀) :=
        contDiffAt_pi.2 fun k => ContDiffAt.sum fun l _ => (hca _ (hGinv k l)).mul (hca _ (hpΦ l))
      exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp (y₀, v₀) h
    have hN0 : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G (y₀, v₀).1)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a Φ (y₀, v₀).1 *
        partialDeriv b Φ (y₀, v₀).1) ≠ 0 := by
      have := (hNpos y₀ hy₀).ne'
      rw [hNe] at this
      exact this
    exact (hHc.div hNc hN0).smul hnc
  have hV : ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun p : E3 × E3 => (p.2, -sprayGam G p.1 p.2 - sprayA G Φ p.1 p.2)) (y₀, v₀) :=
    (contDiffAt_snd.prodMk (hGam.neg.sub hAc)).of_le h1inf
  
  
  have hdd : ∀ y ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y := fun y hy =>
    (((hΦ.of_le h2inf).fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := 1) h112).contDiffAt
      (hW.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hquad : ∀ y u : E3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j Φ) y * u i * u j =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y u u := by
    intro y u hd
    have h41 : ∀ i j, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j Φ) y =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y (e i) (e j) := by
      intro i j
      have h : HasFDerivAt (fun z => fderiv ℝ Φ z (e j))
          ((fderiv ℝ Φ y).comp (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) y).flip (e j)) y :=
        hd.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e j) y)
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ Φ z (e j)) y (e i) = _
      rw [h.fderiv]
      simp
    have hv_exp : u = u 0 • e 0 + u 1 • e 1 + u 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    simp only [h41, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    conv_rhs => rw [hv_exp]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hwd : ∀ (γ η : ℝ → E3) (t : ℝ) (a : E3), HasDerivAt γ (η t) t → HasDerivAt η a t →
      γ t ∈ W → HasDerivAt (fun s => fderiv ℝ Φ (γ s) (η s))
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j Φ) (γ t) * η t i * η t j +
          ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k Φ (γ t) * a k) t := by
    intro γ η t a hγ hη hγW
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) (γ t) := hdd (γ t) hγW
    have hE := (hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hγ).clm_apply hη
    refine hE.congr_deriv ?_
    show fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) (γ t) (η t) (η t) + fderiv ℝ Φ (γ t) a = _
    rw [hquad (γ t) (η t) hd]
    rw [hlin (fderiv ℝ Φ (γ t)) a]
    rfl
  
  
  have hlin2 : ∀ (p X Y : Fin 3 → ℝ) (s : ℝ),
      ∑ k : Fin 3, p k * (-X k - s * Y k) = -(∑ k : Fin 3, p k * X k) - s * ∑ k : Fin 3, p k * Y k := by
    intro p X Y s
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have htan : ∀ y v : E3, N y ≠ 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j Φ) y * v i * v j +
        ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k Φ y * (-sprayGam G y v - sprayA G Φ y v) k = 0 := by
    intro y v hNy
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin 3, (-sprayGam G y v - sprayA G Φ y v) k =
        -(∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y * v a * v b) -
          H y v / N y * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l Φ y := by
      intro k
      rw [hsub_apply, hneg_apply, hsG, hsA]
    simp only [hk]
    have ha : ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k Φ y *
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y * v a * v b) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y * partialDeriv k Φ y) * v a * v b := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hb : ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k Φ y * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l Φ y =
        N y := by
      rw [hNe]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hc : H y v = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b Φ) y * v a * v b -
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y * partialDeriv k Φ y) * v a * v b := by
      rw [hHe]
      simp only [hessLoc, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [hlin2, ha, hb, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hNy, hc]
    ring
  
  
  have hσd : ∀ (γ η : ℝ → E3) (t : ℝ) (a : E3), HasDerivAt γ (η t) t → HasDerivAt η a t →
      γ t ∈ W → HasDerivAt (fun s => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, η s k * G (γ s) k l * η s l)
        (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (a k * G (γ t) k l * η t l +
          η t k * fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z k l) (γ t) (η t) * η t l +
          η t k * G (γ t) k l * a l)) t := by
    intro γ η t a hγ hη hγW
    have hcoη : ∀ k : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => η s k) (a k) t := fun k =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hη
    have hGd : ∀ k l : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s => G (γ s) k l)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z k l) (γ t) (η t)) t := fun k l =>
      (((hG k l).contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hγW)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt
        t hγ
    refine HasDerivAt.fun_sum fun k _ => HasDerivAt.fun_sum fun l _ => ?_
    have h := ((hcoη k).mul (hGd k l)).mul (hcoη l)
    exact h.congr_deriv (by simp only [Pi.mul_apply]; ring)
  
  
  have hpairA : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), (∀ k l, A k l = A l k) → IsUnit A.det →
      ∀ (s : ℝ) (d u : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (s * ∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k m * d m) * A k l * u l =
        s * ∑ l : Fin 3, d l * u l := by
    intro A hs hdet s d u
    have hinvA : ∀ l m : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k m * A k l =
        (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) l m := by
      intro l m
      rw [← Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hdet, Matrix.mul_apply]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by rw [hs l k]; ring)
    have e00 := hinvA 0 0
    have e01 := hinvA 0 1
    have e02 := hinvA 0 2
    have e10 := hinvA 1 0
    have e11 := hinvA 1 1
    have e12 := hinvA 1 2
    have e20 := hinvA 2 0
    have e21 := hinvA 2 1
    have e22 := hinvA 2 2
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.one_apply_eq, Matrix.one_apply_ne, ne_eq, Fin.reduceEq,
      not_false_eq_true] at e00 e01 e02 e10 e11 e12 e20 e21 e22 ⊢
    linear_combination (s * d 0 * u 0) * e00 + (s * d 1 * u 0) * e01 + (s * d 2 * u 0) * e02 +
      (s * d 0 * u 1) * e10 + (s * d 1 * u 1) * e11 + (s * d 2 * u 1) * e12 +
      (s * d 0 * u 2) * e20 + (s * d 1 * u 2) * e21 + (s * d 2 * u 2) * e22
  have hmetQ : ∀ y v : E3, IsUnit (G y).det →
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, sprayA G Φ y v k * G y k l * v l =
        H y v / N y * fderiv ℝ Φ y v := by
    intro y v hdet
    simp only [hsA]
    rw [hlin (fderiv ℝ Φ y) v]
    exact hpairA (G y) (fun k l => hGs y k l) hdet _ (fun l => partialDeriv l Φ y) (fun l => v l)
  have hmetP : ∀ y v : E3, IsUnit (G y).det →
      2 * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, sprayGam G y v k * G y k l * v l =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z k l) y v * v l := by
    intro y v hdet
    have hδ : ∀ l m : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, G y k l * (G y)⁻¹ k m = if l = m then 1 else 0 := by
      intro l m
      have h := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G y) hdet) l) m
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h
      rw [← h]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by rw [hGs y k l]
    have hlowX : ∀ (l : Fin 3) (X : Fin 3 → ℝ),
        ∑ k : Fin 3, G y k l * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ m : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k m * X m) = (1 / 2) * X l := by
      intro l X
      calc ∑ k : Fin 3, G y k l * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ m : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k m * X m)
          = ∑ m : Fin 3, (1 / 2 * X m) * ∑ k : Fin 3, G y k l * (G y)⁻¹ k m := by
            simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring
        _ = (1 / 2) * X l := by
            simp only [hδ, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    have hlow : ∀ a b l : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, G y k l * christoffel G k a b y =
        (1 / 2) * (partialDeriv a (fun z => G z b l) y + partialDeriv b (fun z => G z a l) y
          - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z a b) y) := by
      intro a b l
      exact hlowX l (fun m => partialDeriv a (fun z => G z b m) y +
        partialDeriv b (fun z => G z a m) y - partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y)
    have e2 : ∀ k l : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z k l) y v =
        ∑ m : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => G z k l) y * v m := fun k l => hlin _ v
    simp only [hsG, e2]
    have r1 : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y * v a * v b) * G y k l * v l =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          v a * v b * v l * ∑ k : Fin 3, G y k l * christoffel G k a b y := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [r1]
    simp only [hlow]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  
  have hD0 : ∀ y v : E3, y ∈ W → fderiv ℝ Φ y v = 0 →
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, ((-sprayGam G y v - sprayA G Φ y v) k * G y k l * v l +
        v k * fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z k l) y v * v l +
        v k * G y k l * (-sprayGam G y v - sprayA G Φ y v) l) = 0 := by
    intro y v hy hw
    have hdet : IsUnit (G y).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 (hGpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
    have hP := hmetP y v hdet
    have hQ := hmetQ y v hdet
    rw [hw, mul_zero] at hQ
    have hsym : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * G y k l * (-sprayGam G y v - sprayA G Φ y v) l =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (-sprayGam G y v - sprayA G Φ y v) k * G y k l * v l := by
      conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => by
        rw [hGs y l k]; ring
    have hsplit : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (-sprayGam G y v - sprayA G Φ y v) k * G y k l * v l =
        -(∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, sprayGam G y v k * G y k l * v l) -
          ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, sprayA G Φ y v k * G y k l * v l := by
      simp only [hsub_apply, hneg_apply, sub_mul, neg_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [hsym, hsplit]
    linarith
  
  
  obtain ⟨α, hα0, ε₁, hε₁, hα⟩ :=
    hV.exists_forall_mem_closedBall_exists_eq_forall_mem_Ioo_hasDerivAt₀ 0
  have h0mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 - ε₁) (0 + ε₁) := by
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hαc : ContinuousAt α 0 := (hα 0 h0mem).continuousAt
  have hS : {t : ℝ | (α t).1 ∈ W} ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℝ) := by
    have h1 : (α 0).1 ∈ W := by rw [hα0]; exact hy₀
    exact (continuous_fst.continuousAt.comp hαc).preimage_mem_nhds (hW.mem_nhds h1)
  obtain ⟨ε₂, hε₂, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.1 hS
  have hε : 0 < min ε₁ ε₂ := lt_min hε₁ hε₂
  have hI1 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂), t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 - ε₁) (0 + ε₁) := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 := min_le_left ε₁ ε₂
    constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
  have hWI : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂), (α t).1 ∈ W := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 := min_le_right ε₁ ε₂
    apply hball
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
  have hαI : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂), HasDerivAt α
      ((α t).2, -sprayGam G (α t).1 (α t).2 - sprayA G Φ (α t).1 (α t).2) t :=
    fun t ht => hα t (hI1 t ht)
  have h0I : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂) := ⟨neg_lt_zero.2 hε, hε⟩
  have hconst : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂), HasDerivAt f 0 t) →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂), f t = f 0 := by
    intro f hf t ht
    exact isOpen_Ioo.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero isPreconnected_Ioo
      (fun s hs => (hf s hs).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
      (fun s hs => (hf s hs).deriv) ht h0I
  have hγ : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂),
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (α s).1) (α t).2 t := fun t ht =>
    (hasFDerivAt_fst : HasFDerivAt (Prod.fst : E3 × E3 → E3)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E3 E3) (α t)).comp_hasDerivAt t (hαI t ht)
  have hη : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂),
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (α s).2) (-sprayGam G (α t).1 (α t).2 - sprayA G Φ (α t).1 (α t).2) t :=
    fun t ht => (hasFDerivAt_snd : HasFDerivAt (Prod.snd : E3 × E3 → E3)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E3 E3) (α t)).comp_hasDerivAt t (hαI t ht)
  
  
  have hwz : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂), fderiv ℝ Φ (α t).1 (α t).2 = 0 := by
    have hw0 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂),
        HasDerivAt (fun s => fderiv ℝ Φ (α s).1 (α s).2) 0 t := by
      intro t ht
      have h := hwd (fun s => (α s).1) (fun s => (α s).2) t _ (hγ t ht) (hη t ht) (hWI t ht)
      exact h.congr_deriv (htan (α t).1 (α t).2 (hNpos _ (hWI t ht)).ne')
    intro t ht
    have h := hconst _ hw0 t ht
    simp only [hα0] at h
    rw [h]
    exact hv₀
  
  have hΦz : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂), Φ (α t).1 = 0 := by
    have hd0 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂), HasDerivAt (fun s => Φ (α s).1) 0 t := by
      intro t ht
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (α t).1 :=
        (hΦ.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds (hWI t ht))).differentiableAt (by simp)
      exact (hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hγ t ht)).congr_deriv (hwz t ht)
    intro t ht
    have h := hconst _ hd0 t ht
    simp only [hα0] at h
    rw [h]
    exact hΦ₀
  
  have hσz : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂),
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (α t).2 k * G (α t).1 k l * (α t).2 l =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v₀ k * G y₀ k l * v₀ l := by
    have hd0 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-min ε₁ ε₂) (min ε₁ ε₂), HasDerivAt
        (fun s => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (α s).2 k * G (α s).1 k l * (α s).2 l) 0 t := by
      intro t ht
      have h := hσd (fun s => (α s).1) (fun s => (α s).2) t _ (hγ t ht) (hη t ht) (hWI t ht)
      exact h.congr_deriv (hD0 (α t).1 (α t).2 (hWI t ht) (hwz t ht))
    intro t ht
    have h := hconst _ hd0 t ht
    simp only [hα0] at h
    exact h
  
  refine ⟨min ε₁ ε₂, α, hε, hα0, fun t ht => ⟨hαI t ht, hWI t ht, hΦz t ht, hwz t ht, hσz t ht⟩⟩

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (W : E2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hW : ∀ c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => W y c) s) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ (k i : Fin 2) (l : Fin 3), gcCovAlong G F (fun y c => gcCovAlong G F W i y c) k x l - gcCovAlong G F (fun y c => gcCovAlong G F W k y c) i x l = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, riemannLocal G l a b c (F x) * gsTan F k x a * gsTan F i x b * W x c

signature.name: gc_ricci_commute
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (W : E2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hW : ∀ c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => W y c) s) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ (k i : Fin 2) (l : Fin 3), gcCovAlong G F (fun y c => gcCovAlong G F W i y c) k x l - gcCovAlong G F (fun y c => gcCovAlong G F W k y c) i x l = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, riemannLocal G l a b c (F x) * gsTan F k x a * gsTan F i x b * W x c

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro x hx k i l
  have hx' : s ∈ 𝓝 x := hs.mem_nhds hx
  
  have hpdv : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) U := by
    intro f hf i
    have hD := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf).2
    exact hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdet3 : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) U := by
    intro H hH
    have t1 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 0)
    exact (((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6).congr
      (fun y _ => Matrix.det_fin_three (H y))
  have hdetU : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hGpos y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hGi : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) U := by
    intro k l
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := hdet3 G hG
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det) U := by
      apply hdet3
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = l
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hG a b
    refine ((h1.inv hdetU).mul h2).congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have hdG : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b)) U :=
    fun m a b => hpdv _ (hG a b) m
  have hΓU : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
      (hGi k l).mul (((hdG i j l).add (hdG j i l)).sub (hdG l i j)))
  
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x := (hF.contDiffAt hx').differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) s := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 hF).2
  have hT : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 j)) s := fun j =>
    hD.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : E2 => e2 j) s)
  have htan : ∀ (j : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsTan F j y c) s := by
    intro j c
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hT j)).congr
      (fun y _ => rfl)
  have htanD : ∀ (j k : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3),
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => gsTan F j y c) x (e2 k) = gsHessF F k j x c := by
    intro j k c
    have hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 j)) x :=
      ((hT j).contDiffAt hx').differentiableAt (by simp)
    have he : (fun y => gsTan F j y c) =
        (EuclideanSpace.proj c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 j)) := rfl
    rw [he, fderiv_comp x (EuclideanSpace.proj c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt hφ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    rfl
  
  have hchain : ∀ g : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U → ∀ j : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => g (F y)) x (e2 j) = ∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r g (F x) * gsTan F j x r := by
    intro g hg j
    have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (F x) :=
      (hg.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hFU x hx))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    rw [show (fun y => g (F y)) = g ∘ F from rfl, fderiv_comp x hgd hFd,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    have hv : fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j) = ∑ r : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) r • e r := by
      ext m
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    rw [hv, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    simp [partialDeriv, gsTan, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  have schwarz : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] (f : E2 → V),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s → ∀ a b : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e2 b)) x (e2 a) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e2 a)) x (e2 b) := by
    intro V _ _ f hf a b
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x := hf.contDiffAt hx'
    have h2' : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
    have h2 : minSmoothness ℝ 2 ≤ ∞ := by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      exact h2'
    have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f x := hc.isSymmSndFDerivAt h2
    have h12 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ∞ := by
      rw [one_add_one_eq_two]
      exact h2'
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x :=
      (hc.fderiv_right (m := 1) h12).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have key : ∀ a b : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e2 b)) x (e2 a) =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x (e2 a) (e2 b) := by
      intro a b
      have h3 := fderiv_clm_apply (c := fderiv ℝ f) (u := fun _ : E2 => e2 b) hd
        (differentiableAt_const (e2 b))
      rw [h3]
      simp
    rw [key a b, key b a]
    exact hsym.eq (e2 a) (e2 b)
  
  have key1 : ∀ (k i : Fin 2), pd2 k (fun y => gcCovAlong G F W i y l) x =
      pd2 k (pd2 i (fun y => W y l)) x + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        ((∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (christoffel G l a b) (F x) * gsTan F k x r) *
            gsTan F i x a * W x b +
          christoffel G l a b (F x) * gsHessF F k i x a * W x b +
          christoffel G l a b (F x) * gsTan F i x a * pd2 k (fun y => W y b) x) := by
    intro k i
    have hθ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun y' => W y' l) y (e2 i)) s :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 (hW l)).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have d1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => pd2 i (fun y' => W y' l) y) x :=
      (hθ.contDiffAt hx').differentiableAt (by simp)
    have dΓ : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => christoffel G l a b (F y)) x :=
      fun a b => (((hΓU l a b).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hFU x hx))).differentiableAt
        (by simp)).comp x hFd
    have dT : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => gsTan F i y a) x :=
      fun a => ((htan i a).contDiffAt hx').differentiableAt (by simp)
    have dW : ∀ b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y b) x :=
      fun b => ((hW b).contDiffAt hx').differentiableAt (by simp)
    have dP : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun y => christoffel G l a b (F y) * gsTan F i y a * W y b) x :=
      fun a b => ((dΓ a b).mul (dT a)).mul (dW b)
    have dS : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G l a b (F y) * gsTan F i y a * W y b) x :=
      fun a => (DifferentiableAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) fun b _ => dP a b).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by simp [Finset.sum_apply])
    have dSS : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G l a b (F y) * gsTan F i y a * W y b) x :=
      (DifferentiableAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) fun a _ => dS a).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by simp [Finset.sum_apply])
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => pd2 i (fun y' => W y' l) y +
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G l a b (F y) * gsTan F i y a * W y b) x (e2 k) = _
    rw [fderiv_fun_add d1 dSS, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      fderiv_fun_sum (fun a _ => dS a), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun b _ => dP a b),
      ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul (show DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun y => christoffel G l a b (F y) * gsTan F i y a) x from (dΓ a b).mul (dT a)) (dW b),
      fderiv_fun_mul (dΓ a b) (dT a)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hchain _ (hΓU l a b) k, htanD i k a]
    simp only [pd2]
    ring
  
  have u1 : ∀ k i : Fin 2, gcCovAlong G F (fun y c => gcCovAlong G F W i y c) k x l =
      pd2 k (fun y => gcCovAlong G F W i y l) x + ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
