        christoffel G l a b (F x) * gsTan F k x a * gcCovAlong G F W i x b := fun _ _ => rfl
  have hAB : pd2 k (pd2 i (fun y => W y l)) x = pd2 i (pd2 k (fun y => W y l)) x :=
    schwarz (fun y => W y l) (hW l) k i
  have hHF : gsHessF F k i x = gsHessF F i k x := schwarz F hF k i
  rw [u1 k i, u1 i k, key1 k i, key1 i k, hAB, hHF]
  simp only [gcCovAlong, riemannLocal, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : 0 < gsNormLen G F x ∧ (∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * gsTan F m x c = 0) ∧ (∀ P : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * gcNu G F x d = (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * P c) / gsNormLen G F x) ∧ (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcNu G F x c * gcNu G F x d = 1) ∧ (∀ P Q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * Q d = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a b * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F a x c * P d) * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F b x c * Q d) + (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * gcNu G F x d) * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * Q c * gcNu G F x d))

signature.name: gc_frame
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : 0 < gsNormLen G F x ∧ (∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * gsTan F m x c = 0) ∧ (∀ P : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * gcNu G F x d = (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * P c) / gsNormLen G F x) ∧ (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcNu G F x c * gcNu G F x d = 1) ∧ (∀ P Q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * Q d = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a b * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F a x c * P d) * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F b x c * Q d) + (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * gcNu G F x d) * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * Q c * gcNu G F x d))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hdet : (G (F x)).det ≠ 0 := hGpos.det_pos.ne'
  have hGG : G (F x) * (G (F x))⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet)
  have hR : ∀ c k : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * (G (F x))⁻¹ d k = if c = k then 1 else 0 := by
    intro c k
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hGG c) k
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h
    exact h
  have key : ∀ X : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * X c *
      (∑ k : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ d k * gsCrossN F x k) = ∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * X c := by
    intro X
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    have e1 : ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * X c * (∑ k : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ d k * gsCrossN F x k) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, X c * gsCrossN F x k * (∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * (G (F x))⁻¹ d k) := by
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
      ring
    rw [e1]
    simp only [hR, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    ring
  
  have crossNe : ∀ (D : E2 →L[ℝ] E3), Function.Injective D →
      ¬ (D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 2 - D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 1 = 0 ∧
         D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 0 - D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 2 = 0 ∧
         D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 1 - D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 0 = 0) := by
    intro D hDi hN
    obtain ⟨n0, n1, n2⟩ := hN
    have hb : D (e2 1) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have h1 : e2 1 = 0 := hDi (by rw [h0, map_zero])
      have h2 := congrArg (fun v : E2 => v 1) h1
      simp at h2
    apply hb
    have c0 : ∀ m : Fin 3,
        ((D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) •
          D (e2 0) - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
            D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) • D (e2 1)) m = (0 : E3) m := by
      have key : ∀ m : Fin 3,
          ((D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) •
            D (e2 0) - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) • D (e2 1)) m =
          (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) m - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) m := by
        intro m
        simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have k0 : (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) 0 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) 0 = 0 := by
        linear_combination (D (e2 1) 1) * n2 - (D (e2 1) 2) * n1
      have k1 : (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) 1 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) 1 = 0 := by
        linear_combination (D (e2 1) 2) * n0 - (D (e2 1) 0) * n2
      have k2 : (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) 2 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) 2 = 0 := by
        linear_combination (D (e2 1) 0) * n1 - (D (e2 1) 1) * n0
      intro m
      rw [key m, PiLp.zero_apply]
      fin_cases m
      · exact k0
      · exact k1
      · exact k2
    have hv : D ((D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) •
          e2 0 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
            D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) • e2 1) = D 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, map_zero]
      exact PiLp.ext c0
    have hv0 := congrArg (fun v : E2 => v 0) (hDi hv)
    simp at hv0
    have s0 := sq_nonneg (D (e2 1) 0)
    have s1 := sq_nonneg (D (e2 1) 1)
    have s2 := sq_nonneg (D (e2 1) 2)
    have z0 : D (e2 1) 0 = 0 := by nlinarith
    have z1 : D (e2 1) 1 = 0 := by nlinarith
    have z2 : D (e2 1) 2 = 0 := by nlinarith
    refine PiLp.ext fun m => ?_
    fin_cases m
    · simpa using z0
    · simpa using z1
    · simpa using z2
  have hNne : gsCrossN F x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hN0
    apply crossNe (fderiv ℝ F x) hinj
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [gsCrossN, gsTan] using congrFun hN0 0
    · simpa [gsCrossN, gsTan] using congrFun hN0 1
    · simpa [gsCrossN, gsTan] using congrFun hN0 2
  have hq0 : 0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l := by
    have hpos := hGpos.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hNne
    have e : dotProduct (star (gsCrossN F x)) (Matrix.mulVec (G (F x))⁻¹ (gsCrossN F x)) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial]
      ring
    rw [← e]
    exact hpos
  obtain ⟨q, hqdef⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ,
      q = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hq : 0 < q := by rw [hqdef]; exact hq0
  have hnpos : 0 < gsNormLen G F x := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq0
  have hnn : gsNormLen G F x * gsNormLen G F x = q := by
    rw [hqdef]; exact Real.mul_self_sqrt hq0.le
  
  have htan : ∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * gsTan F m x c = 0 := by
    refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [gsCrossN, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    · simp [gsCrossN, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
  
  have hb : ∀ P : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * gcNu G F x d =
      (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * P c) / gsNormLen G F x := by
    intro P
    rw [← key P, Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
    simp only [gcNu]
    ring
  
  have hNnu : ∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * gcNu G F x c = q / gsNormLen G F x := by
    rw [hqdef, Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    simp only [gcNu]
    rw [mul_div_assoc', Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    ring
  have hd : ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcNu G F x c * gcNu G F x d = 1 := by
    rw [hb (gcNu G F x), hNnu, div_div, hnn, div_self hq.ne']
  
  obtain ⟨ip, hip⟩ : ∃ ip : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ,
      ∀ X Y, ip X Y = ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * X c * Y d := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ a c, t a c = gsTan F a x c :=
    ⟨fun a c => gsTan F a x c, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ d, w d = ∑ k : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ d k * gsCrossN F x k :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hsym : ∀ X Y, ip X Y = ip Y X := by
    intro X Y
    rw [hip, hip, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
    rw [hGsymm (F x) d c]
    ring
  have hNt : gsCrossN F x = ![t 0 1 * t 1 2 - t 0 2 * t 1 1, t 0 2 * t 1 0 - t 0 0 * t 1 2,
      t 0 0 * t 1 1 - t 0 1 * t 1 0] := by
    simp only [ht]
    rfl
  have hA : ∀ Z : Fin 3 → ℝ, (Matrix.of fun c i => ![t 0 c, t 1 c, Z c] i).det =
      ∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * Z c := by
    intro Z
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_three, hNt]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have gram : ∀ X Y : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      (!![ip (t 0) (t 0), ip (t 0) (t 1), ip (t 0) Y;
          ip (t 1) (t 0), ip (t 1) (t 1), ip (t 1) Y;
          ip X (t 0), ip X (t 1), ip X Y] : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ).det =
        (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * X c) * (G (F x)).det *
          (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * Y c) := by
    intro X Y
    have hM : (!![ip (t 0) (t 0), ip (t 0) (t 1), ip (t 0) Y;
          ip (t 1) (t 0), ip (t 1) (t 1), ip (t 1) Y;
          ip X (t 0), ip X (t 1), ip X Y] : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) =
        Matrix.transpose (Matrix.of fun c i => ![t 0 c, t 1 c, X c] i) * G (F x) *
          (Matrix.of fun c i => ![t 0 c, t 1 c, Y c] i) := by
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
        simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, hip] <;> ring
    rw [hM, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, hA, hA]
  have gram' : ∀ X Y : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      ip (t 0) (t 0) * ip (t 1) (t 1) * ip X Y - ip (t 0) (t 0) * ip (t 1) Y * ip X (t 1)
        - ip (t 0) (t 1) * ip (t 1) (t 0) * ip X Y + ip (t 0) (t 1) * ip (t 1) Y * ip X (t 0)
        + ip (t 0) Y * ip (t 1) (t 0) * ip X (t 1) - ip (t 0) Y * ip (t 1) (t 1) * ip X (t 0) =
      (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * X c) * (G (F x)).det *
          (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * Y c) := by
    intro X Y
    rw [← gram X Y, Matrix.det_fin_three]
    rfl
  have hipw : ∀ X, ip X w = ∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * X c := by
    intro X
    rw [hip, ← key X]
    simp only [hw]
  have htw : ∀ a : Fin 2, ip (t a) w = 0 := by
    intro a
    rw [hipw]
    simp only [ht]
    exact htan a
  have hNw : ∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * w c = q := by
    rw [hqdef]
    simp only [hw, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    ring
  have hD : ip (t 0) (t 0) * ip (t 1) (t 1) - ip (t 0) (t 1) * ip (t 1) (t 0) =
      q * (G (F x)).det := by
    have g := gram' w w
    rw [hsym w (t 0), hsym w (t 1), htw 0, htw 1, hipw w, hNw] at g
    have h2 : (ip (t 0) (t 0) * ip (t 1) (t 1) - ip (t 0) (t 1) * ip (t 1) (t 0)
        - q * (G (F x)).det) * q = 0 := by
      linear_combination g
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h | h
    · linarith
    · exact absurd h hq.ne'
  have hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x a b = ip (t a) (t b) := by
    intro a b
    rw [hip]
    simp only [pullMetric2, ht, gsTan]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
    ring
  have he : ∀ P Q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * Q d =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a b *
        (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F a x c * P d) *
        (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F b x c * Q d) +
      (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * gcNu G F x d) *
        (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * Q c * gcNu G F x d) := by
    intro P Q
    rw [hb P, hb Q, div_mul_div_comm, hnn, ← hip P Q]
    have eP : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F a x c * P d =
        ip (t a) P := by
      intro a; rw [hip]; simp only [ht]
    have eQ : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F a x c * Q d =
        ip (t a) Q := by
      intro a; rw [hip]; simp only [ht]
    simp only [eP, eQ]
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.det_fin_two]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, smul_eq_mul, hh]
    have g := gram' P Q
    rw [hsym P (t 0), hsym P (t 1)] at g
    have hDne : ip (t 0) (t 0) * ip (t 1) (t 1) - ip (t 0) (t 1) * ip (t 1) (t 0) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hD]; exact mul_ne_zero hq.ne' hdet
    have hu : (ip (t 0) (t 0) * ip (t 1) (t 1) - ip (t 0) (t 1) * ip (t 1) (t 0))⁻¹ *
        (ip (t 0) (t 0) * ip (t 1) (t 1) - ip (t 0) (t 1) * ip (t 1) (t 0)) = 1 :=
      inv_mul_cancel₀ hDne
    have hv : q⁻¹ * q = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hq.ne'
    linear_combination
      (ip (t 0) (t 0) * ip (t 1) (t 1) - ip (t 0) (t 1) * ip (t 1) (t 0))⁻¹ * g +
      (-(ip P Q) + (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * P c) * (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * Q c) *
          q⁻¹) * hu +
      (-((∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * P c) * (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * Q c)) *
          (ip (t 0) (t 0) * ip (t 1) (t 1) - ip (t 0) (t 1) * ip (t 1) (t 0))⁻¹ *
          (G (F x)).det) * hv +
      (-((∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * P c) * (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * Q c)) *
          (ip (t 0) (t 0) * ip (t 1) (t 1) - ip (t 0) (t 1) * ip (t 1) (t 0))⁻¹ * q⁻¹) * hD
  exact ⟨hnpos, htan, hb, hd, he⟩

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : (∀ (i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsTan F i y c) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ (k i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), pd2 k (fun y' => gsTan F i y' c) y = gsHessF F k i y c) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i : Fin 2, gsHessF F k i y = gsHessF F i k y) ∧ (∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsCovHess G F i j y c) s) ∧ (∀ l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gcNu G F y l) s) ∧ (∀ a b c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G a b c) U)

signature.name: gc_jets
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : (∀ (i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsTan F i y c) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ (k i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), pd2 k (fun y' => gsTan F i y' c) y = gsHessF F k i y c) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i : Fin 2, gsHessF F k i y = gsHessF F i k y) ∧ (∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsCovHess G F i j y c) s) ∧ (∀ l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gcNu G F y l) s) ∧ (∀ a b c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G a b c) U)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hFU' : Set.MapsTo F s U := fun x hx => hFU x hx
  
  have hpdv : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) U := by
    intro f hf i
    have hD := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf).2
    exact hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdet3 : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) U := by
    intro H hH
    have t1 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 0)
    exact (((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6).congr
      (fun y _ => Matrix.det_fin_three (H y))
  have hdetU : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hGpos y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hGi : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) U := by
    intro k l
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) U := hdet3 G hG
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det) U := by
      apply hdet3
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = l
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hG a b
    refine ((h1.inv hdetU).mul h2).congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have hdG : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b)) U :=
    fun m a b => hpdv _ (hG a b) m
  have hΓU : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
      (hGi k l).mul (((hdG i j l).add (hdG j i l)).sub (hdG l i j)))
  
  have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) s := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 hF).2
  have hT : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) s := fun j =>
    hD.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : E2 => e2 j) s)
  have htan : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (k : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => gsTan F i x k) s := by
    intro i k
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hT i)).congr
      (fun x _ => rfl)
  have hT2 : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 j))) s :=
    fun j => ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 (hT j)).2
  have hhess : ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (k : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => gsHessF F i j x k) s := by
    intro i j k
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn
      ((hT2 j).clm_apply (contDiffOn_const : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun _ : E2 => e2 i) s))).congr
      (fun x _ => rfl)
  
  have hJ2 : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ (k i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3),
      pd2 k (fun y' => gsTan F i y' c) y = gsHessF F k i y c := by
    intro y hy k i c
    have hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => fderiv ℝ F y' (e2 i)) y :=
      ((hT i).contDiffAt (hs.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have e1 : (fun y' => gsTan F i y' c) =
        fun y' => (EuclideanSpace.proj c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (fderiv ℝ F y' (e2 i)) := rfl
    unfold pd2
    rw [e1, fderiv_comp' y (EuclideanSpace.proj c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt hφ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    rfl
  
  have hHsym : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsHessF F i j x = gsHessF F j i x := by
    intro x hx i j
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F x := hF.contDiffAt (hs.mem_nhds hx)
    have h2' : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
    have h2 : minSmoothness ℝ 2 ≤ ∞ := by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      exact h2'
    have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ F x := hc.isSymmSndFDerivAt h2
    have h12 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ∞ := by
      rw [one_add_one_eq_two]
      exact h2'
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x :=
      (hc.fderiv_right (m := 1) h12).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have key : ∀ a b : Fin 2, gsHessF F a b x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) x (e2 a) (e2 b) := by
      intro a b
      have h3 := fderiv_clm_apply (c := fderiv ℝ F) (u := fun _ : E2 => e2 b) hd
        (differentiableAt_const (e2 b))
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 b)) x (e2 a) = _
      rw [h3]
      simp
    rw [key i j, key j i]
    exact hsym.eq (e2 i) (e2 j)
  
  have crossNe : ∀ (D : E2 →L[ℝ] E3), Function.Injective D →
      ¬ (D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 2 - D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 1 = 0 ∧
         D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 0 - D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 2 = 0 ∧
         D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 1 - D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 0 = 0) := by
    intro D hDi hN
    obtain ⟨n0, n1, n2⟩ := hN
    have hb : D (e2 1) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have h1 : e2 1 = 0 := hDi (by rw [h0, map_zero])
      have h2 := congrArg (fun v : E2 => v 1) h1
      simp at h2
    apply hb
    have c0 : ∀ m : Fin 3,
        ((D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) •
          D (e2 0) - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
            D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) • D (e2 1)) m = (0 : E3) m := by
      have key : ∀ m : Fin 3,
          ((D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) •
            D (e2 0) - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) • D (e2 1)) m =
          (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) m - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) m := by
        intro m
        simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have k0 : (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) 0 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) 0 = 0 := by
        linear_combination (D (e2 1) 1) * n2 - (D (e2 1) 2) * n1
      have k1 : (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) 1 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) 1 = 0 := by
        linear_combination (D (e2 1) 2) * n0 - (D (e2 1) 0) * n2
      have k2 : (D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) *
            D (e2 0) 2 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
              D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) * D (e2 1) 2 = 0 := by
        linear_combination (D (e2 1) 0) * n1 - (D (e2 1) 1) * n0
      intro m
      rw [key m, PiLp.zero_apply]
      fin_cases m
      · exact k0
      · exact k1
      · exact k2
    have hv : D ((D (e2 1) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 1) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 + D (e2 1) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) •
          e2 0 - (D (e2 0) 0 * D (e2 1) 0 + D (e2 0) 1 * D (e2 1) 1 +
            D (e2 0) 2 * D (e2 1) 2) • e2 1) = D 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, map_zero]
      exact PiLp.ext c0
    have hv0 := congrArg (fun v : E2 => v 0) (hDi hv)
    simp at hv0
    have s0 := sq_nonneg (D (e2 1) 0)
    have s1 := sq_nonneg (D (e2 1) 1)
    have s2 := sq_nonneg (D (e2 1) 2)
    have z0 : D (e2 1) 0 = 0 := by nlinarith
    have z1 : D (e2 1) 1 = 0 := by nlinarith
    have z2 : D (e2 1) 2 = 0 := by nlinarith
    refine PiLp.ext fun m => ?_
    fin_cases m
    · simpa using z0
    · simpa using z1
    · simpa using z2
  have hq : ∀ x ∈ s,
      0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l := by
    intro x hx
    have hNne : gsCrossN F x ≠ 0 := by
      intro hN0
      apply crossNe (fderiv ℝ F x) (hinj x hx)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [gsCrossN, gsTan] using congrFun hN0 0
      · simpa [gsCrossN, gsTan] using congrFun hN0 1
      · simpa [gsCrossN, gsTan] using congrFun hN0 2
    have hpos := (hGpos (F x) (hFU x hx)).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hNne
    have e : dotProduct (star (gsCrossN F x)) (Matrix.mulVec (G (F x))⁻¹ (gsCrossN F x)) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial]
      ring
    rw [← e]
    exact hpos
  
  have hinvF : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (G (F x))⁻¹ k l) s :=
    fun k l => (hGi k l).comp hF hFU'
  have hchrF : ∀ k m n : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => christoffel G k m n (F x)) s :=
    fun k m n => (hΓU k m n).comp hF hFU'
  have hN : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => gsCrossN F x k) s := by
    intro k
    fin_cases k
    · exact (((htan 0 1).mul (htan 1 2)).sub ((htan 0 2).mul (htan 1 1))).congr
        (fun x _ => rfl)
    · exact (((htan 0 2).mul (htan 1 0)).sub ((htan 0 0).mul (htan 1 2))).congr
        (fun x _ => rfl)
    · exact (((htan 0 0).mul (htan 1 1)).sub ((htan 0 1).mul (htan 1 0))).congr
        (fun x _ => rfl)
  have hCov : ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (k : Fin 3),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => gsCovHess G F i j x k) s := fun i j k =>
    ((hhess i j k).add (ContDiffOn.sum fun m _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun n _ =>
      ((hchrF k m n).mul (htan i m)).mul (htan j n))).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
  have hQ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (G (F x))⁻¹ k l * gsCrossN F x k * gsCrossN F x l) s :=
    ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => ((hinvF k l).mul (hN k)).mul (hN l)
  have hLen : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsNormLen G F) s :=
    (hQ.sqrt (fun x hx => (hq x hx).ne')).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
  have hLen0 : ∀ x ∈ s, gsNormLen G F x ≠ 0 := fun x hx => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hq x hx)).ne'
  have hNu : ∀ l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gcNu G F y l) s := fun l =>
    ((ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hinvF l k).mul (hN k)).div hLen hLen0).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
  exact ⟨htan, hJ2, fun y hy k i => hHsym y hy k i, hCov, hNu, hΓU⟩

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (gsSff G F i j) x = ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcCovAlong G F (fun y c' => gsCovHess G F i j y c') k x c * gcNu G F x d - ∑ p : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) p i j x * gsSff G F k p x

signature.name: gc_dII
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (gsSff G F i j) x = ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcCovAlong G F (fun y c' => gsCovHess G F i j y c') k x c * gcNu G F x d - ∑ p : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) p i j x * gsSff G F k p x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx k i j
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, J4, J5, -⟩ := gc_jets G U hU hG hGsymm hGpos F s hs hF hFU hinj
  
  have hloc : gsSff G F i j =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
      G (F y) c d * gsCovHess G F i j y c * gcNu G F y d) := by
    filter_upwards [hs.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    rw [(gc_frame G F y hGsymm (hGpos _ (hFU y hy)) (hinj y hy)).2.2.1
      (fun c => gsCovHess G F i j y c)]
    rfl
  have hA : pd2 k (gsSff G F i j) x = pd2 k (fun y => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
      G (F y) c d * gsCovHess G F i j y c * gcNu G F y d) x := by
    unfold pd2
    rw [hloc.fderiv_eq]
  
  have hdiff : ∀ φ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ s → DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x := fun φ h =>
    (h.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hs.mem_nhds hx)
  have hB := gc_metric_compat G U hU hG hGsymm hGpos F s hs hF hFU
    (fun y c => gsCovHess G F i j y c) (gcNu G F) x hx
    (fun c => hdiff _ (J4 i j c)) (fun c => hdiff _ (J5 c)) k
  rw [hA, hB]
  
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hpars⟩ := gc_frame G F x hGsymm (hGpos _ (hFU x hx)) (hinj x hx)
  have hT2 := hpars (fun c => gsCovHess G F i j x c) (fun d => gcCovAlong G F (gcNu G F) k x d)
  obtain ⟨hW1, hW2⟩ := gc_weingarten G U hU hG hGsymm hGpos F s hs hF hFU hinj x hx k
  have hSW : ∀ u v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * u c * v d =
      ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * v c * u d := by
    intro u v
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
    rw [hGsymm (F x) d c]
    ring
  have hK : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F a x c *
      gsCovHess G F i j x d = ∑ p : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) p i j x *
        pullMetric2 G F x p a := by
    intro a
    rw [hSW (fun c => gsTan F a x c) (fun d => gsCovHess G F i j x d)]
    exact gc_koszul G U hU hG hGsymm hGpos F s hs hF hFU hinj x hx i j a
  simp only [hK, hW2, hW1, mul_zero, add_zero] at hT2
  rw [hT2]
  
  have hpos := (gs_regularity G U hU hG hGsymm hGpos F s hs hF hFU hinj).2.2.1 x hx
  have hh : pullMetric2 G F x * (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpos.det_pos.ne')
  have e : ∀ p b : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x p a * (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a b =
      if p = b then 1 else 0 := by
    intro p b
    have := congrFun (congrFun hh p) b
    rwa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
  have e00 := e 0 0
  have e01 := e 0 1
  have e10 := e 1 0
  have e11 := e 1 1
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, if_true, Fin.isValue] at e00 e01 e10 e11
  norm_num at e00 e01 e10 e11
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  linear_combination
    (-(christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) 0 i j x * gsSff G F k 0 x)) * e00 +
    (-(christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) 0 i j x * gsSff G F k 1 x)) * e01 +
    (-(christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) 1 i j x * gsSff G F k 0 x)) * e10 +
    (-(christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) 1 i j x * gsSff G F k 1 x)) * e11

signature.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) (hhsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j y = christoffel2 h k j i y) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j) k i j y = 0) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hD : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s → ∀ y ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y :=
    fun f hf y hy => (hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hs.mem_nhds hy)
  
  have hDr : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pd2 k f x) s :=
    fun f k hf => ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 hf).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hL : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (y : E2), y ∈ s → (∀ z ∈ s, f z = g z) →
      ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k f y = pd2 k g y := by
    intro f g y hy hfg k
    have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 y] g := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hy) hfg
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hdetpos : ∀ y ∈ s, 0 < (h y).det := fun y hy => (hhpos y hy).det_pos
  
  have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s := by
    have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).det) s := by
      have e : (fun y => (h y).det) = fun y => h y 0 0 * h y 1 1 - h y 0 1 * h y 1 0 := by
        funext y
        exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
      rw [e]
      exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
    have hdi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹) s :=
      hdet.inv (fun y hy => (hdetpos y hy).ne')
    intro i j
    have e : (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) = fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹ * (h y).adjugate i j := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [e]
    refine hdi.mul ?_
    simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp <;>
      first
      | exact hh _ _
      | exact (hh _ _).neg
  
  have hinvsymm : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i := by
    intro y hy i j
    have := ((hhpos y hy).isHermitian.inv).apply i j
    simpa using this.symm
  
  have hPH : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      ∑ m : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i m * h y m j = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro y hy i j
    have hu : IsUnit (h y).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 (hdetpos y hy).ne'
    have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (h y) hu) i) j
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
    exact this
  have hHP : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      ∑ m : Fin 2, h y i m * (h y)⁻¹ m j = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro y hy i j
    have hu : IsUnit (h y).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 (hdetpos y hy).ne'
    have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (h y) hu) i) j
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
    exact this
  have hPHt : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ l j : Fin 2,
      ∑ m : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ m l * h y m j = if l = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro y hy l j
    rw [← hPH y hy l j]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => by rw [hinvsymm y hy m l])
  
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s := by
    intro k i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => christoffel2 h k i j x) s
    unfold christoffel2
    refine contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => ?_)
    exact (hinv k l).mul (((hDr _ i (hh j l)).add (hDr _ j (hh i l))).sub (hDr _ l (hh i j)))
  
  have hΓsymm : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j y = christoffel2 h k j i y := by
    intro y hy k i j
    have hloc : ∀ l : Fin 2, pd2 l (fun z => h z j i) y = pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) y :=
      fun l => hL _ _ y hy (fun z hz => hhsymm z hz j i) l
    unfold christoffel2
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by rw [hloc l]; ring)
  
  have hcompat : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j) k i j y = 0 := by
    intro y hy k i j
    have hloc : pd2 k (fun z => h z j i) y = pd2 k (fun z => h z i j) y :=
      hL _ _ y hy (fun z hz => hhsymm z hz j i) k
    have K1 : ∑ l : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun z => h z i l) y + pd2 i (fun z => h z k l) y
        - pd2 l (fun z => h z k i) y) * ∑ m : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ m l * h y m j =
        pd2 k (fun z => h z i j) y + pd2 i (fun z => h z k j) y
          - pd2 j (fun z => h z k i) y := by
      simp [hPHt y hy]
    have K2 : ∑ l : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun z => h z j l) y + pd2 j (fun z => h z k l) y
        - pd2 l (fun z => h z k j) y) * ∑ m : Fin 2, h y i m * (h y)⁻¹ m l =
        pd2 k (fun z => h z j i) y + pd2 j (fun z => h z k i) y
          - pd2 i (fun z => h z k j) y := by
      simp [hHP y hy]
    show pd2 k (fun z => h z i j) y - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m k i y * h y m j
      - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m k j y * h y i m = 0
    simp only [christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two] at K1 K2 ⊢
    linear_combination (-1 / 2 : ℝ) * K1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * K2 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * hloc
  
  have hS1 : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k a b : Fin 2, ∑ m : Fin 2, ((h y)⁻¹ a m * pd2 k (fun z => h z m b) y
      + h y m b * pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a m) y) = 0 := by
    intro y hy k a b
    have dP : ∀ a m : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a m) y :=
      fun a m => hD _ (hinv a m) y hy
    have dH : ∀ m b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h z m b) y :=
      fun m b => hD _ (hh m b) y hy
    have h1 : pd2 k (fun z => ∑ m : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a m * h z m b) y = 0 := by
      rw [hL (fun z => ∑ m : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a m * h z m b)
        (fun _ => if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) y hy (fun z hz => hPH z hz a b) k]
      simp [pd2]
    have h2 : pd2 k (fun z => ∑ m : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a m * h z m b) y =
        ∑ m : Fin 2, ((h y)⁻¹ a m * pd2 k (fun z => h z m b) y
          + h y m b * pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a m) y) := by
      simp only [pd2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a 0 * h z 0 b + (h z)⁻¹ a 1 * h z 1 b)
          (((h y)⁻¹ a 0 • fderiv ℝ (fun z => h z 0 b) y
              + h y 0 b • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a 0) y)
            + ((h y)⁻¹ a 1 • fderiv ℝ (fun z => h z 1 b) y
              + h y 1 b • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a 1) y)) y :=
        ((dP a 0).hasFDerivAt.mul (dH 0 b).hasFDerivAt).add
          ((dP a 1).hasFDerivAt.mul (dH 1 b).hasFDerivAt)
      rw [hd.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← h2, h1]
  
  have hdinv : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y =
      -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j
        + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m) := by
    intro y hy k i j
    have hC : ∀ a b : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => h z a b) y
        - ∑ p : Fin 2, christoffel2 h p k a y * h y p b
        - ∑ p : Fin 2, christoffel2 h p k b y * h y a p = 0 :=
      fun a b => hcompat y hy k a b
    have T1 : ∑ b : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ b j * ∑ m : Fin 2, ((h y)⁻¹ i m * pd2 k (fun z => h z m b) y
        + h y m b * pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i m) y) = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun b _ => by rw [hS1 y hy k i b, mul_zero])
    have T2 : ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i a) y * ∑ m : Fin 2, h y a m * (h y)⁻¹ m j =
        pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y := by
      simp [hHP y hy]
    have T3 : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * (pd2 k (fun z => h z a b) y
        - ∑ p : Fin 2, christoffel2 h p k a y * h y p b
        - ∑ p : Fin 2, christoffel2 h p k b y * h y a p) * (h y)⁻¹ b j = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun a _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun b _ => by rw [hC a b]; ring))
    have T4 : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * christoffel2 h p k a y *
        ∑ m : Fin 2, h y p m * (h y)⁻¹ m j =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * christoffel2 h j k a y := by
      simp [hHP y hy]
    have T5 : ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, (∑ m : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i m * h y m p) *
        christoffel2 h p k b y * (h y)⁻¹ b j =
        ∑ b : Fin 2, christoffel2 h i k b y * (h y)⁻¹ b j := by
      simp [hPH y hy]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at T1 T2 T3 T4 T5 ⊢
    linear_combination T1 - T2 - T3 - T4 - T5
  exact ⟨hinv, hinvsymm, hΓ, hΓsymm, hcompat, hdinv⟩
