      (ContDiffOn.sum fun m _ => (hΓ m k j).mul (hA i m))
  · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
      (h x)⁻¹ i a * (h x)⁻¹ j b * A i j x * B a b x) s
    exact ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ =>
      ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ => (((hinv i a).mul (hinv j b)).mul (hA i j)).mul (hB a b)

informal_problem.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) (hdinv : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m)) (A B : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A i j) s) (hB : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (B i j) s) : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (gsInner h A B) y = gsInner h (gsCovD2 h A k) B y + gsInner h A (gsCovD2 h B k) y

signature.name: gs2_inner_leibniz
signature.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) (hdinv : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m)) (A B : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (A i j) s) (hB : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (B i j) s) : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (gsInner h A B) y = gsInner h (gsCovD2 h A k) B y + gsInner h A (gsCovD2 h B k) y

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y hy k
  have hPd : ∀ i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ i j) y := fun i j =>
    ((hinv i j).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hs.mem_nhds hy)
  have hAd : ∀ i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (A i j) y := fun i j =>
    ((hA i j).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hs.mem_nhds hy)
  have hBd : ∀ i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (B i j) y := fun i j =>
    ((hB i j).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hs.mem_nhds hy)
  have hprod : ∀ (p q u v : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ p y → DifferentiableAt ℝ q y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ u y → DifferentiableAt ℝ v y →
      pd2 k (fun x => p x * q x * u x * v x) y =
        pd2 k p y * q y * u y * v y + p y * pd2 k q y * u y * v y +
          p y * q y * pd2 k u y * v y + p y * q y * u y * pd2 k v y := by
    intro p q u v hp hq hu hv
    unfold pd2
    have hpq : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => p x * q x) y := hp.mul hq
    have hpqu : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => p x * q x * u x) y := hpq.mul hu
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hpqu hv, fderiv_fun_mul hpq hu, fderiv_fun_mul hp hq]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hsum : ∀ (F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ), (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F i) y) →
      pd2 k (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, F i x) y = ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 k (F i) y := by
    intro F hF
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => hF i), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have hD4 : ∀ i j a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ i a * (h x)⁻¹ j b * A i j x * B a b x) y := fun i j a b =>
    (((hPd i a).mul (hPd j b)).mul (hAd i j)).mul (hBd a b)
  have d3 : ∀ i j a : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i a * (h x)⁻¹ j b * A i j x * B a b x) y :=
    fun i j a => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => hD4 i j a b)
  have d2 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i a * (h x)⁻¹ j b * A i j x * B a b x) y :=
    fun i j => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun a _ => d3 i j a)
  have d1 : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun x => ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (h x)⁻¹ i a * (h x)⁻¹ j b * A i j x * B a b x) y :=
    fun i => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun j _ => d2 i j)
  have e1 : pd2 k (gsInner h A B) y = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
      pd2 k (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ i a * (h x)⁻¹ j b * A i j x * B a b x) y := by
    show pd2 k (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
      (h x)⁻¹ i a * (h x)⁻¹ j b * A i j x * B a b x) y = _
    rw [hsum _ d1]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [hsum _ (d2 i)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    rw [hsum _ (d3 i j)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    rw [hsum _ (fun b => hD4 i j a b)]
  have e2 : ∀ i j a b : Fin 2,
      pd2 k (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ i a * (h x)⁻¹ j b * A i j x * B a b x) y =
        pd2 k (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ i a) y * (h y)⁻¹ j b * A i j y * B a b y +
          (h y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 k (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ j b) y * A i j y * B a b y +
          (h y)⁻¹ i a * (h y)⁻¹ j b * pd2 k (A i j) y * B a b y +
          (h y)⁻¹ i a * (h y)⁻¹ j b * A i j y * pd2 k (B a b) y := fun i j a b =>
    hprod _ _ _ _ (hPd i a) (hPd j b) (hAd i j) (hBd a b)
  rw [e1]
  simp only [e2, hdinv y hy k]
  simp only [gsInner, gsCovD2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) (hdinv : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m)) : (∀ T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (T i j) s) → ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (gsTrace h T) y = ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD2 h T b k l y) ∧ (∀ D : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ i j k : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (D i j k) s) → ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ a b : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h D a l k b y = gsCovD1 h (fun b' z => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ k l * D l k b' z) a b y)

signature.name: gs2_contraction_leibniz
signature.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) (hdinv : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m)) : (∀ T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (T i j) s) → ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (gsTrace h T) y = ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD2 h T b k l y) ∧ (∀ D : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ i j k : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (D i j k) s) → ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ a b : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h D a l k b y = gsCovD1 h (fun b' z => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ k l * D l k b' z) a b y)

proof.tactics:
by
  have prod : ∀ (P T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (y : E2),
      (∀ k l : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (P k l) y) →
      (∀ k l : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (T k l) y) → ∀ b : Fin 2,
      pd2 b (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, P k l z * T k l z) y =
        ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (pd2 b (P k l) y * T k l y + P k l y * pd2 b (T k l) y) := by
    intro P T y hP hT b
    unfold pd2
    have hd : ∀ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)),
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ∑ l : Fin 2, P k l z * T k l z) y :=
      fun k _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun l _ => (hP k l).fun_mul (hT k l))
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum hd, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun l _ => (hP k l).fun_mul (hT k l)), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hP k l) (hT k l)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hdiff : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s → ∀ y ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y :=
    fun f hf y hy => (hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hs.mem_nhds hy)
  refine ⟨fun T hT y hy b => ?_, fun D hD y hy a b => ?_⟩
  · have e := prod (fun k l z => (h z)⁻¹ k l) T y (fun k l => hdiff _ (hinv k l) y hy)
      (fun k l => hdiff _ (hT k l) y hy) b
    show pd2 b (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ k l * T k l z) y = _
    rw [e]
    simp only [hdinv y hy, gsCovD2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  · have e := prod (fun k l z => (h z)⁻¹ k l) (fun k l => D l k b) y
      (fun k l => hdiff _ (hinv k l) y hy) (fun k l => hdiff _ (hD l k b) y hy) a
    show _ = pd2 a (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ k l * D l k b z) y -
      ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m a b y *
        (∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * D l k m y)
    rw [e]
    simp only [hdinv y hy, gsCovD3, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring

informal_problem.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s) (hΓsymm : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j y = christoffel2 h k j i y) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hT : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (T i j) s) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ l i k j : Fin 2, gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h T) l i k j x - gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h T) i l k j x = -∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x * T m j x - ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i j x * T k m x

signature.name: gs2_ricci_identity
signature.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s) (hΓsymm : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j y = christoffel2 h k j i y) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hT : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (T i j) s) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ l i k j : Fin 2, gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h T) l i k j x - gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h T) i l k j x = -∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x * T m j x - ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i j x * T k m x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx l i k j
  have hU : s ∈ 𝓝 x := hs.mem_nhds hx
  
  have dΓ : ∀ m a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (christoffel2 h m a b) x := fun m a b =>
    ((hΓ m a b).contDiffAt hU).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have dT : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (T a b) x := fun a b =>
    ((hT a b).contDiffAt hU).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have dpT : ∀ c a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 c (T a b)) x := by
    intro c a b
    have hf' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (T a b)) s :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 (hT a b)).2
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (T a b) y (e2 c)) s :=
      hf'.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := e2 c))
    exact (h2.contDiffAt hU).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have schwarz : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s → ∀ a b : Fin 2,
      pd2 a (pd2 b f) x = pd2 b (pd2 a f) x := by
    intro f hf a b
    have hfx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x := hf.contDiffAt hU
    have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f x := hfx.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; norm_cast)
    have hdf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x :=
      ((((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 hf).2).contDiffAt hU).differentiableAt
        (by simp)
    have key : ∀ a b : Fin 2, pd2 a (pd2 b f) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x (e2 a) (e2 b) := by
      intro a b
      have H : HasFDerivAt (pd2 b f)
          ((fderiv ℝ f x).comp (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x).flip (e2 b)) x :=
        hdf.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e2 b) x)
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 b f) x (e2 a) = _
      rw [H.fderiv]
      simp
    rw [key a b, key b a]
    exact hsym (e2 a) (e2 b)
  
  have expand : ∀ a b c d : Fin 2, pd2 a (gsCovD2 h T b c d) x =
      pd2 a (pd2 b (T c d)) x
        - ∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 a (christoffel2 h m b c) x * T m d x
            + christoffel2 h m b c x * pd2 a (T m d) x)
        - ∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 a (christoffel2 h m b d) x * T c m x
            + christoffel2 h m b d x * pd2 a (T c m) x) := by
    intro a b c d
    have H : HasFDerivAt (fun y => pd2 b (T c d) y
          - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m b c y * T m d y
          - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m b d y * T c m y)
        (fderiv ℝ (pd2 b (T c d)) x
          - ∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h m b c x • fderiv ℝ (T m d) x
              + T m d x • fderiv ℝ (christoffel2 h m b c) x)
          - ∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h m b d x • fderiv ℝ (T c m) x
              + T c m x • fderiv ℝ (christoffel2 h m b d) x)) x :=
      ((dpT b c d).hasFDerivAt.sub
        (HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) fun m _ =>
          (dΓ m b c).hasFDerivAt.mul (dT m d).hasFDerivAt)).sub
        (HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) fun m _ =>
          (dΓ m b d).hasFDerivAt.mul (dT c m).hasFDerivAt)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => pd2 b (T c d) y
          - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m b c y * T m d y
          - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m b d y * T c m y) x (e2 a) = _
    rw [H.fderiv]
    simp only [pd2, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  simp only [gsCovD3]
  rw [expand l i k j, expand i l k j, schwarz (T k j) (hT k j) i l]
  simp only [gsCovD2, gsRiem2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  rw [hΓsymm x hx 0 i l, hΓsymm x hx 1 i l]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x : E2) (hpos : (h x).PosDef) (hanti : ∀ l i k j : Fin 2, ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x * h x m j + ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i j x * h x k m = 0) : ∀ m l i k : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x = gaussCurv2 h x * (h x i k * (if m = l then 1 else 0) - h x l k * (if m = i then 1 else 0))

signature.name: gs2_curvature_2d
signature.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x : E2) (hpos : (h x).PosDef) (hanti : ∀ l i k j : Fin 2, ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x * h x m j + ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i j x * h x k m = 0) : ∀ m l i k : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x = gaussCurv2 h x * (h x i k * (if m = l then 1 else 0) - h x l k * (if m = i then 1 else 0))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have alg : ∀ (H P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (r : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (K : ℝ),
      H 1 0 = H 0 1 → H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1 ≠ 0 →
      (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * P 0 0 = H 1 1 →
      (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * P 0 1 = -H 0 1 →
      (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * P 1 0 = -H 0 1 →
      (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * P 1 1 = H 0 0 →
      (∀ m l i k : Fin 2, r m i l k = -r m l i k) →
      (∀ l i k j : Fin 2, ∑ m : Fin 2, r m l i k * H m j + ∑ m : Fin 2, r m l i j * H k m = 0) →
      K = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, P a b * ∑ c : Fin 2, r c c a b →
      ∀ m l i k : Fin 2, r m l i k =
        K * (H i k * (if m = l then 1 else 0) - H l k * (if m = i then 1 else 0)) := by
    intro H P r K hsymm hd hP00 hP01 hP10 hP11 hr hant hK
    have hdiag : ∀ m l k : Fin 2, r m l l k = 0 := fun m l k => by linarith [hr m l l k]
    have hswap : ∀ m k : Fin 2, r m 1 0 k = -r m 0 1 k := fun m k => hr m 0 1 k
    have hK' : K = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (-P 0 0 * r 1 0 1 0 - P 0 1 * r 1 0 1 1
        + P 1 0 * r 0 0 1 0 + P 1 1 * r 0 0 1 1) := by
      rw [hK]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      rw [hdiag 0 0 0, hdiag 0 0 1, hdiag 1 1 0, hdiag 1 1 1, hswap 1 0, hswap 1 1]
      ring
    have h1 := hant 0 1 0 0
    have h2 := hant 0 1 1 1
    have h3 := hant 0 1 0 1
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hsymm] at h1 h2 h3
    have hN : (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * (2 * K) =
        -H 1 1 * r 1 0 1 0 + H 0 1 * r 1 0 1 1 - H 0 1 * r 0 0 1 0 + H 0 0 * r 0 0 1 1 := by
      linear_combination (2 * (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1)) * hK'
        + (-r 1 0 1 0) * hP00 + (-r 1 0 1 1) * hP01 + (r 0 0 1 0) * hP10 + (r 0 0 1 1) * hP11
    have c00 : (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * (2 * r 0 0 1 0 - 2 * K * H 0 1) = 0 := by
      linear_combination H 1 1 * h1 - H 0 1 * h3 - H 0 1 * hN
    have c01 : (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * (2 * r 0 0 1 1 - 2 * K * H 1 1) = 0 := by
      linear_combination H 1 1 * h3 - H 0 1 * h2 - H 1 1 * hN
    have c10 : (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * (2 * r 1 0 1 0 + 2 * K * H 0 0) = 0 := by
      linear_combination H 0 0 * h3 - H 0 1 * h1 + H 0 0 * hN
    have c11 : (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - H 0 1 * H 0 1) * (2 * r 1 0 1 1 + 2 * K * H 0 1) = 0 := by
      linear_combination H 0 0 * h2 - H 0 1 * h3 + H 0 1 * hN
    have E00 : r 0 0 1 0 = K * H 0 1 := by
      have := (mul_eq_zero.mp c00).resolve_left hd; linarith
    have E01 : r 0 0 1 1 = K * H 1 1 := by
      have := (mul_eq_zero.mp c01).resolve_left hd; linarith
    have E10 : r 1 0 1 0 = -(K * H 0 0) := by
      have := (mul_eq_zero.mp c10).resolve_left hd; linarith
    have E11 : r 1 0 1 1 = -(K * H 0 1) := by
      have := (mul_eq_zero.mp c11).resolve_left hd; linarith
    intro m l i k
    fin_cases m <;> fin_cases l <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases k <;>
      simp [hsymm, hdiag, hswap, E00, E01, E10, E11] <;> ring
  
  have hR2 : ∀ m l i k : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m i l k x = -gsRiem2 h m l i k x := by
    intro m l i k
    simp only [gsRiem2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have hR1 : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ricci2 h a b x = ∑ c : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h c c a b x := by
    intro a b
    simp only [ricci2, gsRiem2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hK : gaussCurv2 h x = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
      (h x)⁻¹ a b * ∑ c : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h c c a b x := by
    unfold gaussCurv2
    simp only [hR1]
  
  have hs : h x 1 0 = h x 0 1 := by
    have := hpos.isHermitian.apply 1 0
    simpa using this.symm
  have hdet : 0 < (h x).det := hpos.det_pos
  have hdpos : 0 < h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 0 1 := by
    have e := Matrix.det_fin_two (h x)
    rw [hs] at e
    rw [← e]
    exact hdet
  have hU : IsUnit (h x).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hdet)
  have hmul : h x * (h x)⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (h x) hU
  have m00 : h x 0 0 * (h x)⁻¹ 0 0 + h x 0 1 * (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 = 1 := by
    have := congrFun (congrFun hmul 0) 0
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using this
  have m01 : h x 0 0 * (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 + h x 0 1 * (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 = 0 := by
    have := congrFun (congrFun hmul 0) 1
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using this
  have m10 : h x 1 0 * (h x)⁻¹ 0 0 + h x 1 1 * (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 = 0 := by
    have := congrFun (congrFun hmul 1) 0
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using this
  have m11 : h x 1 0 * (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 + h x 1 1 * (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 = 1 := by
    have := congrFun (congrFun hmul 1) 1
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using this
  rw [hs] at m10 m11
  have hP00 : (h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 0 1) * (h x)⁻¹ 0 0 = h x 1 1 := by
    linear_combination h x 1 1 * m00 - h x 0 1 * m10
  have hP01 : (h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 0 1) * (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 = -h x 0 1 := by
    linear_combination h x 1 1 * m01 - h x 0 1 * m11
  have hP10 : (h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 0 1) * (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 = -h x 0 1 := by
    linear_combination h x 0 0 * m10 - h x 0 1 * m00
  have hP11 : (h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 0 1) * (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 = h x 0 0 := by
    linear_combination h x 0 0 * m11 - h x 0 1 * m01
  
  exact alg (h x) (h x)⁻¹ (fun m l i k => gsRiem2 h m l i k x) (gaussCurv2 h x)
    hs (ne_of_gt hdpos) hP00 hP01 hP10 hP11 hR2 hanti hK

informal_problem.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (D : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (x : E2) (hpos : (h x).PosDef) : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * gsInner h (D i) (D j) x

signature.name: gs2_grad_sq_nonneg
signature.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (D : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (x : E2) (hpos : (h x).PosDef) : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * gsInner h (D i) (D j) x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hP : ((h x)⁻¹).PosDef := hpos.inv
  have hp : 0 < (h x)⁻¹ 0 0 := hP.diag_pos
  have hsym : (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 = (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 := by
    have h1 := hP.isHermitian.apply 1 0
    simp only [star_trivial] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hdet0 : 0 < ((h x)⁻¹).det := hP.det_pos
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsym] at hdet0
  simp only [gsInner, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp only [hsym]
  set p := (h x)⁻¹ 0 0 with hpdef
  set q := (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 with hqdef
  set r := (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 with hrdef
  obtain ⟨δ, hδdef⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = p * r - q ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ : 0 ≤ δ := by rw [hδdef]; nlinarith
  have hp3 : 0 < p ^ 3 := pow_pos hp 3
  rw [← mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hp3]
  have hR : 0 ≤
      (p * (p * (p * D 0 0 0 x + q * D 0 0 1 x) + q * (p * D 0 1 0 x + q * D 0 1 1 x))
        + q * (p * (p * D 1 0 0 x + q * D 1 0 1 x) + q * (p * D 1 1 0 x + q * D 1 1 1 x))) ^ 2
      + δ * (p * (p * D 0 0 1 x + q * D 0 1 1 x) + q * (p * D 1 0 1 x + q * D 1 1 1 x)) ^ 2
      + δ * (p * (p * D 0 1 0 x + q * D 0 1 1 x) + q * (p * D 1 1 0 x + q * D 1 1 1 x)) ^ 2
      + δ ^ 2 * (p * D 0 1 1 x + q * D 1 1 1 x) ^ 2
      + δ * (p * (p * D 1 0 0 x + q * D 1 0 1 x) + q * (p * D 1 1 0 x + q * D 1 1 1 x)) ^ 2
      + δ ^ 2 * (p * D 1 0 1 x + q * D 1 1 1 x) ^ 2
      + δ ^ 2 * (p * D 1 1 0 x + q * D 1 1 1 x) ^ 2
      + δ ^ 3 * (D 1 1 1 x) ^ 2 := by
    exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (add_nonneg
      (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hδ (sq_nonneg _))) (mul_nonneg hδ (sq_nonneg _)))
      (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hδ 2) (sq_nonneg _))) (mul_nonneg hδ (sq_nonneg _)))
      (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hδ 2) (sq_nonneg _))) (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hδ 2) (sq_nonneg _)))
      (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hδ 3) (sq_nonneg _))
  refine hR.trans_eq ?_
  rw [hδdef]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (S : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hinvsymm : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) (hIn : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S j)) s) (hL1 : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (gsInner h S S) y = gsInner h (gsCovD2 h S k) S y + gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S k) y) (hL2 : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ j k : Fin 2, pd2 k (gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S j)) y = gsInner h (gsCovD2 h S k) (gsCovD2 h S j) y + gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h (gsCovD2 h S j) k) y) : ∀ x ∈ s, lap2 h (gsInner h S S) x = 2 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * gsInner h (gsCovD2 h S i) (gsCovD2 h S j) x + 2 * gsInner h S (fun a b y => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) l k a b y) x

signature.name: gs2_bochner
signature.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (S : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hinvsymm : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) (hIn : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S j)) s) (hL1 : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (gsInner h S S) y = gsInner h (gsCovD2 h S k) S y + gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S k) y) (hL2 : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ j k : Fin 2, pd2 k (gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S j)) y = gsInner h (gsCovD2 h S k) (gsCovD2 h S j) y + gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h (gsCovD2 h S j) k) y) : ∀ x ∈ s, lap2 h (gsInner h S S) x = 2 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * gsInner h (gsCovD2 h S i) (gsCovD2 h S j) x + 2 * gsInner h S (fun a b y => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) l k a b y) x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx
  have hsx : s ∈ 𝓝 x := hs.mem_nhds hx
  
  have s1 : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ A B : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, gsInner h A B y = gsInner h B A y := by
    intro y hy A B
    simp only [gsInner, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hinvsymm y hy 1 0]
    ring
  
  have hd1 : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k : Fin 2,
      pd2 k (gsInner h S S) y = 2 * gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S k) y := by
    intro y hy k
    rw [hL1 y hy k, s1 y hy (gsCovD2 h S k) S]
    ring
  
  have s3 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (gsInner h S S)) x =
      2 * (gsInner h (gsCovD2 h S i) (gsCovD2 h S j) x +
        gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h (gsCovD2 h S j) i) x) := by
    intro i j
    have hev : pd2 j (gsInner h S S) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => 2 * gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S j) y) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hsx (fun y hy => hd1 y hy j)
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S j)) x :=
      ((hIn j).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hsx
    have e1 : pd2 i (pd2 j (gsInner h S S)) x =
        fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (gsInner h S S)) x (e2 i) := rfl
    have e2' : fderiv ℝ (gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S j)) x (e2 i) =
        pd2 i (gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S j)) x := rfl
    rw [e1, hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_mul hdiff 2, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, e2', hL2 x hx j i]
  
  have s5 : ∀ i j a b : Fin 2, gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) i j a b x =
      gsCovD2 h (gsCovD2 h S j) i a b x -
        ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m i j x * gsCovD2 h S m a b x := by
    intro i j a b
    simp only [gsCovD3, gsCovD2]
    ring
  
  have s6 : gsInner h S (fun a b y => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2,
        (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) l k a b y) x =
      ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
        (gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h (gsCovD2 h S k) l) x -
          ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m l k x * gsInner h S (gsCovD2 h S m) x) := by
    simp only [gsInner, s5, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  rw [s6, lap2]
  simp only [s3, hd1 x hx, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  rw [hinvsymm x hx 1 0]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (S : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) (hSsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, S i j x = S j i x) (htr : ∀ x ∈ s, gsTrace h S x = 0) (hinvsymm : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) (hDS : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsCovD2 h S k i j) s) (hRic : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ l i k j : Fin 2, gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) l i k j x - gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) i l k j x = -∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x * S m j x - ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i j x * S k m x) (hK : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ m l i k : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x = gaussCurv2 h x * (h x i k * (if m = l then 1 else 0) - h x l k * (if m = i then 1 else 0))) (hTr : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (gsTrace h S) y = ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD2 h S b k l y) (hCon : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ a b : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) a l k b y = gsCovD1 h (fun b' z => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD2 h S l k b' z) a b y) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ a b : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) l k a b x = 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * S a b x + gsSimonsE h (gsCodazzi h S) a b x

signature.name: gs2_weitzenbock
signature.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (S : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) (hSsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, S i j x = S j i x) (htr : ∀ x ∈ s, gsTrace h S x = 0) (hinvsymm : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) (hDS : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsCovD2 h S k i j) s) (hRic : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ l i k j : Fin 2, gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) l i k j x - gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) i l k j x = -∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x * S m j x - ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i j x * S k m x) (hK : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ m l i k : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x = gaussCurv2 h x * (h x i k * (if m = l then 1 else 0) - h x l k * (if m = i then 1 else 0))) (hTr : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (gsTrace h S) y = ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD2 h S b k l y) (hCon : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ a b : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) a l k b y = gsCovD1 h (fun b' z => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD2 h S l k b' z) a b y) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ a b : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) l k a b x = 2 * gaussCurv2 h x * S a b x + gsSimonsE h (gsCodazzi h S) a b x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx a b
  
  have hdiff : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (gsCovD2 h S k i j) x := fun k i j =>
    ((hDS k i j).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hs.mem_nhds hx)
  have hpdC : ∀ l k i j : Fin 2, pd2 l (gsCodazzi h S k i j) x =
      pd2 l (gsCovD2 h S k i j) x - pd2 l (gsCovD2 h S i k j) x := by
    intro l k i j
    have e : gsCodazzi h S k i j = fun y => gsCovD2 h S k i j y - gsCovD2 h S i k j y := rfl
    rw [e]
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hdiff k i j) (hdiff i k j), ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
  have s1 : ∀ l k : Fin 2, gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) l k a b x =
      gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) l a k b x + gsCovD3 h (gsCodazzi h S) l k a b x := by
    intro l k
    rw [gsCovD3, gsCovD3, gsCovD3, hpdC]
    simp only [gsCodazzi, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have hU : IsUnit (h x).det := IsUnit.mk0 _ (hhpos x hx).det_pos.ne'
  have I1 : ∀ i l : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, h x i k * (h x)⁻¹ k l = if i = l then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i l
    have e := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (h x) hU) i) l
    rwa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at e
  have I2 : ∀ k j : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l * h x l j = if k = j then 1 else 0 := by
    intro k j
    have e := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (h x) hU) k) j
    rwa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at e
  have htr' := htr x hx
  unfold gsTrace at htr'
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at htr'
  have s2 : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
      (-∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l a k x * S m b x - ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l a b x * S k m x) =
      2 * gaussCurv2 h x * S a b x := by
    intro a b
    simp only [hK x hx]
    have ha : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := by fin_cases a <;> simp
    have hb : b = 0 ∨ b = 1 := by fin_cases b <;> simp
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl
    · have c1 := I1 0 0; have c2 := I1 0 1; have c3 := I2 0 0; have c4 := I2 1 1
      have c5 := I2 0 0; have c6 := I2 1 0; have c7 := hSsymm x hx 0 0
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.isValue, eq_self_iff_true, if_true, if_false,
        Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte] at c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 ⊢
      linear_combination (-gaussCurv2 h x) * S 0 0 x * c1 + (-gaussCurv2 h x) * S 1 0 x * c2
        + gaussCurv2 h x * S 0 0 x * c3 + gaussCurv2 h x * S 0 0 x * c4
        - gaussCurv2 h x * h x 0 0 * htr' + gaussCurv2 h x * S 0 0 x * c5
        + gaussCurv2 h x * S 1 0 x * c6 - gaussCurv2 h x * c7
    · have c1 := I1 0 0; have c2 := I1 0 1; have c3 := I2 0 0; have c4 := I2 1 1
      have c5 := I2 0 1; have c6 := I2 1 1; have c7 := hSsymm x hx 0 1
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.isValue, eq_self_iff_true, if_true, if_false,
        Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte] at c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 ⊢
      linear_combination (-gaussCurv2 h x) * S 0 1 x * c1 + (-gaussCurv2 h x) * S 1 1 x * c2
        + gaussCurv2 h x * S 0 1 x * c3 + gaussCurv2 h x * S 0 1 x * c4
        - gaussCurv2 h x * h x 0 1 * htr' + gaussCurv2 h x * S 0 0 x * c5
        + gaussCurv2 h x * S 1 0 x * c6 - gaussCurv2 h x * c7
    · have c1 := I1 1 0; have c2 := I1 1 1; have c3 := I2 0 0; have c4 := I2 1 1
      have c5 := I2 0 0; have c6 := I2 1 0; have c7 := hSsymm x hx 1 0
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.isValue, eq_self_iff_true, if_true, if_false,
        Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte] at c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 ⊢
      linear_combination (-gaussCurv2 h x) * S 0 0 x * c1 + (-gaussCurv2 h x) * S 1 0 x * c2
        + gaussCurv2 h x * S 1 0 x * c3 + gaussCurv2 h x * S 1 0 x * c4
        - gaussCurv2 h x * h x 1 0 * htr' + gaussCurv2 h x * S 0 1 x * c5
        + gaussCurv2 h x * S 1 1 x * c6 - gaussCurv2 h x * c7
    · have c1 := I1 1 0; have c2 := I1 1 1; have c3 := I2 0 0; have c4 := I2 1 1
      have c5 := I2 0 1; have c6 := I2 1 1; have c7 := hSsymm x hx 1 1
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.isValue, eq_self_iff_true, if_true, if_false,
        Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte] at c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 ⊢
      linear_combination (-gaussCurv2 h x) * S 0 1 x * c1 + (-gaussCurv2 h x) * S 1 1 x * c2
        + gaussCurv2 h x * S 1 1 x * c3 + gaussCurv2 h x * S 1 1 x * c4
        - gaussCurv2 h x * h x 1 1 * htr' + gaussCurv2 h x * S 0 1 x * c5
        + gaussCurv2 h x * S 1 1 x * c6 - gaussCurv2 h x * c7
  
  have hpdS : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (S i j) y = pd2 k (S j i) y := by
    intro y hy k i j
    have hev : S i j =ᶠ[𝓝 y] S j i :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hSsymm z hz i j)
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have Dsym : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsCovD2 h S k i j y = gsCovD2 h S k j i y := by
    intro y hy k i j
    simp only [gsCovD2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    linear_combination hpdS y hy k i j - christoffel2 h 0 k i y * hSsymm y hy 0 j
      - christoffel2 h 1 k i y * hSsymm y hy 1 j - christoffel2 h 0 k j y * hSsymm y hy i 0
      - christoffel2 h 1 k j y * hSsymm y hy i 1
  have T0 : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ c : Fin 2,
      ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD2 h S c k l y = 0 := by
    intro y hy c
    rw [← hTr y hy c]
    have hev : gsTrace h S =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => htr z hz)
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have veq : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ c : Fin 2,
      ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD2 h S l k c y =
        ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCodazzi h S k c l y := by
    intro y hy c
    have t := T0 y hy c
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at t
    simp only [gsCodazzi, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    linear_combination -((h y)⁻¹ 0 0) * Dsym y hy 0 c 0 - (h y)⁻¹ 0 1 * Dsym y hy 0 c 1
      - (h y)⁻¹ 1 0 * Dsym y hy 1 c 0 - (h y)⁻¹ 1 1 * Dsym y hy 1 c 1
      + (gsCovD2 h S 1 0 c y - gsCovD2 h S 0 1 c y) * hinvsymm y hy 0 1 + t
  have s3 : gsCovD1 h (fun b' z => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD2 h S l k b' z)
        a b x =
      gsCovD1 h (fun j' y => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCodazzi h S k j' l y)
        a b x := by
    have hev : (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD2 h S l k b z) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCodazzi h S k b l y) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => veq y hy b)
    have e1 : pd2 a (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD2 h S l k b z) x =
        pd2 a (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l * gsCodazzi h S k b l y) x := by
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    unfold gsCovD1
    rw [e1]
    simp only [veq x hx]
  
  have hQ : ∀ k l : Fin 2, gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) l k a b x =
      gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) a l k b x +
        (-∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l a k x * S m b x - ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l a b x * S k m x)
        + gsCovD3 h (gsCodazzi h S) l k a b x := by
    intro k l
    have e1 := s1 l k
    have e2 := hRic x hx l a k b
    linarith
  have hsum : ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) l k a b x =
      ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h S) a l k b x
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
          (-∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l a k x * S m b x - ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l a b x * S k m x)
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l * gsCovD3 h (gsCodazzi h S) l k a b x := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
    rw [hQ k l]
    ring
  rw [hsum, hCon x hx a b, s2 a b, s3, gsSimonsE]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) : (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧ ∀ a b c m : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsrRm G a b c m) U

signature.name: gsr_curv_contDiffOn
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) : (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧ ∀ a b c m : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsrRm G a b c m) U

proof.tactics:
by
  have hP : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ c : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv c f) U := by
    intro f hf c
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) U := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
      (hGinv k l).mul (((hP _ (hG j l) i).add (hP _ (hG i l) j)).sub (hP _ (hG i j) l)))
  have hRiem : ∀ l i j k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (riemannLocal G l i j k) U := by
    intro l i j k
    unfold riemannLocal
    exact ((hP _ (hΓ l j k) i).sub (hP _ (hΓ l i k) j)).add (ContDiffOn.sum fun p _ =>
      ((hΓ l i p).mul (hΓ p j k)).sub ((hΓ l j p).mul (hΓ p i k)))
  have hRm : ∀ a b c m : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsrRm G a b c m) U := by
    intro a b c m
    unfold gsrRm
    exact ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hG m l).mul (hRiem l a b c)
  exact ⟨hΓ, hRm⟩

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) (hRm : ∀ a b c m : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsrRm G a b c m) U) (B : Set E3) (hB : IsCompact B) (hBU : B ⊆ U) : ∃ A₀ A₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ A₀ ∧ 0 ≤ A₁ ∧ ∀ y ∈ B, (∀ X Y Z W : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * G y a b * X b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y a * G y a b * Y b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Z a * G y a b * Z b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, W a * G y a b * W b ≤ 1 → |gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m y) X Y Z W| ≤ A₀) ∧ (∀ V X Y Z W : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, V a * G y a b * V b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * G y a b * X b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y a * G y a b * Y b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Z a * G y a b * Z b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, W a * G y a b * W b ≤ 1 → |gsrF5 (fun r a b c m => gsrDRm G r a b c m y) V X Y Z W| ≤ A₁)

signature.name: gsr_curv_bounds
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) (hRm : ∀ a b c m : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsrRm G a b c m) U) (B : Set E3) (hB : IsCompact B) (hBU : B ⊆ U) : ∃ A₀ A₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ A₀ ∧ 0 ≤ A₁ ∧ ∀ y ∈ B, (∀ X Y Z W : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * G y a b * X b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y a * G y a b * Y b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Z a * G y a b * Z b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, W a * G y a b * W b ≤ 1 → |gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m y) X Y Z W| ≤ A₀) ∧ (∀ V X Y Z W : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, V a * G y a b * V b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * G y a b * X b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y a * G y a b * Y b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Z a * G y a b * Z b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, W a * G y a b * W b ≤ 1 → |gsrF5 (fun r a b c m => gsrDRm G r a b c m y) V X Y Z W| ≤ A₁)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hcoer⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ ∀ y ∈ B, ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      μ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, v a * G y a b * v b := by
    rcases B.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hBe | hBne
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun y hy => by simp [hBe] at hy⟩
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ, ∀ p, φ p = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        p.2 a * G p.1 a b * p.2 b := ⟨_, fun p => rfl⟩
    have hK : IsCompact (B ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1) :=
      hB.prod (isCompact_sphere 0 1)
    have hKne : (B ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1).Nonempty :=
      hBne.prod (NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.mpr zero_le_one)
    have hφc : ContinuousOn φ (B ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1) := by
      have hφ' : φ = fun p => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, p.2 a * G p.1 a b * p.2 b := funext hφ
      rw [hφ']
      have hc2 : ∀ a : Fin 3, Continuous (fun p : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => p.2 a) := fun a =>
        (continuous_apply a).comp continuous_snd
      have hc1 : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun p : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => G p.1 a b)
          (B ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1) := fun a b =>
        ((hG a b).continuousOn.mono hBU).comp continuous_fst.continuousOn (fun p hp => hp.1)
      apply continuousOn_finset_sum
      intro a _
      apply continuousOn_finset_sum
      intro b _
      exact (((hc2 a).continuousOn).mul (hc1 a b)).mul (hc2 b).continuousOn
    obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀K, hp₀min⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn hKne hφc
    refine ⟨φ p₀, ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨hy₀, hv₀⟩ := hp₀K
      have hv0 : p₀.2 ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        rw [Metric.mem_sphere, h, dist_self] at hv₀
        norm_num at hv₀
      have hpos := (hGpos p₀.1 (hBU hy₀)).dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0
      have e2 : φ p₀ = star p₀.2 ⬝ᵥ ((G p₀.1).mulVec p₀.2) := by
        rw [hφ]
        simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [e2]
      exact hpos
    · intro y hy v
      by_cases hv : v = 0
      · subst hv
        simp
      · have hr : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
        have hu : ‖v‖⁻¹ • v ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 := by
          rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne']
        have hmin : φ p₀ ≤ φ (y, ‖v‖⁻¹ • v) := isMinOn_iff.1 hp₀min _ ⟨hy, hu⟩
        have hφu : φ (y, ‖v‖⁻¹ • v) = (‖v‖⁻¹) ^ 2 *
            ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, v a * G y a b * v b := by
          rw [hφ]
          simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
        rw [hφu] at hmin
        have hr2 : 0 < ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmin hr2.le
        have e3 : ‖v‖ ^ 2 * ((‖v‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, v a * G y a b * v b) =
            ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, v a * G y a b * v b := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_pow, one_mul]
        rw [e3] at this
        linarith
  
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hvec⟩ : ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 ≤ κ ∧ ∀ y ∈ B, ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, v a * G y a b * v b ≤ 1 → ∀ a : Fin 3, |v a| ≤ κ := by
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt (1 / μ), Real.sqrt_nonneg _, ?_⟩
    intro y hy v hv a
    apply Real.abs_le_sqrt
    have h1 : μ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := (hcoer y hy v).trans hv
    have h2 : ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / μ := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hμ]
      linarith
    have h3 : |v a| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact norm_le_pi_norm v a
    have h4 : |v a| ^ 2 ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h3 2
    rw [sq_abs] at h4
    linarith
  
  have hRc : ∀ a b c m : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (gsrRm G a b c m) U :=
    fun a b c m => (hRm a b c m).continuousOn
  have hΓc : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (christoffel G k i j) U :=
    fun k i j => (hΓ k i j).continuousOn
  have hdRc : ∀ r a b c m : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv r (gsrRm G a b c m)) U := by
    intro r a b c m
    show ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ (gsrRm G a b c m) y (e r)) U
    exact ((hRm a b c m).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hDc : ∀ r a b c m : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (gsrDRm G r a b c m) U := by
    intro r a b c m
    have e1 : gsrDRm G r a b c m = fun y => partialDeriv r (gsrRm G a b c m) y
        - ∑ q : Fin 3, (christoffel G q r a y * gsrRm G q b c m y
          + christoffel G q r b y * gsrRm G a q c m y
          + christoffel G q r c y * gsrRm G a b q m y
          + christoffel G q r m y * gsrRm G a b c q y) := rfl
    rw [e1]
    exact (hdRc r a b c m).sub (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun q _ =>
      ((((hΓc q r a).mul (hRc q b c m)).add ((hΓc q r b).mul (hRc a q c m))).add
        ((hΓc q r c).mul (hRc a b q m))).add ((hΓc q r m).mul (hRc a b c q)))
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀, hM0b⟩ : ∃ M₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ M₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ B, ∀ a b c m : Fin 3,
      |gsrRm G a b c m y| ≤ M₀ := by
    obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : E3 → (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
        ∀ y a b c m, F y a b c m = gsrRm G a b c m y :=
      ⟨fun y a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m y, fun _ _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
    have hF : ContinuousOn F B := by
      refine continuousOn_pi.2 fun a => continuousOn_pi.2 fun b => continuousOn_pi.2 fun c =>
        continuousOn_pi.2 fun m => ?_
      simp only [hFdef]
      exact (hRc a b c m).mono hBU
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hB.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hF
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun y hy a b c m => ?_⟩
    have h := hC y hy
    calc |gsrRm G a b c m y| = ‖F y a b c m‖ := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hFdef]
      _ ≤ ‖F y a b c‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ m
      _ ≤ ‖F y a b‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ c
      _ ≤ ‖F y a‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ b
      _ ≤ ‖F y‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ a
      _ ≤ max C 0 := h.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁, hM1b⟩ : ∃ M₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ M₁ ∧ ∀ y ∈ B, ∀ r a b c m : Fin 3,
      |gsrDRm G r a b c m y| ≤ M₁ := by
    obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : E3 → (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
        ∀ y r a b c m, F y r a b c m = gsrDRm G r a b c m y :=
      ⟨fun y r a b c m => gsrDRm G r a b c m y, fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
    have hF : ContinuousOn F B := by
      refine continuousOn_pi.2 fun r => continuousOn_pi.2 fun a => continuousOn_pi.2 fun b =>
        continuousOn_pi.2 fun c => continuousOn_pi.2 fun m => ?_
      simp only [hFdef]
      exact (hDc r a b c m).mono hBU
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hB.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hF
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun y hy r a b c m => ?_⟩
    have h := hC y hy
    calc |gsrDRm G r a b c m y| = ‖F y r a b c m‖ := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hFdef]
      _ ≤ ‖F y r a b c‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ m
      _ ≤ ‖F y r a b‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ c
      _ ≤ ‖F y r a‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ b
      _ ≤ ‖F y r‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ a
      _ ≤ ‖F y‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ r
      _ ≤ max C 0 := h.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have step : ∀ p q s : ℝ, p ≤ q → 0 ≤ q → |s| ≤ κ → p * |s| ≤ q * κ :=
    fun p q s h1 h2 h3 => mul_le_mul h1 h3 (abs_nonneg _) h2
  have n1 : ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ M * κ := fun M hM => mul_nonneg hM hκ
  refine ⟨81 * M₀ * κ ^ 4, 243 * M₁ * κ ^ 5,
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hM₀) (pow_nonneg hκ 4),
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hM₁) (pow_nonneg hκ 5), ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  refine ⟨fun X Y Z W hX hY hZ hW => ?_, fun V X Y Z W hV hX hY hZ hW => ?_⟩
  · have bX := hvec y hy X hX
    have bY := hvec y hy Y hY
    have bZ := hvec y hy Z hZ
    have bW := hvec y hy W hW
    unfold gsrF4
    calc _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
          |gsrRm G a b c m y * X a * Y b * Z c * W m| := by
          refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_)
          refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => ?_)
          refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => ?_)
          exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, M₀ * κ * κ * κ * κ := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ =>
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => ?_
          simp only [abs_mul]
          have h1 := step _ _ _ (hM0b y hy a b c m) hM₀ (bX a)
          have h2 := step _ _ _ h1 (n1 _ hM₀) (bY b)
          have h3 := step _ _ _ h2 (n1 _ (n1 _ hM₀)) (bZ c)
          exact step _ _ _ h3 (n1 _ (n1 _ (n1 _ hM₀))) (bW m)
      _ = 81 * M₀ * κ ^ 4 := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          push_cast
          ring
  · have bV := hvec y hy V hV
    have bX := hvec y hy X hX
    have bY := hvec y hy Y hY
    have bZ := hvec y hy Z hZ
    have bW := hvec y hy W hW
    unfold gsrF5
    calc _ ≤ ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
          |gsrDRm G r a b c m y * V r * X a * Y b * Z c * W m| := by
          refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun r _ => ?_)
          refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_)
          refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => ?_)
          refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => ?_)
          exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
          M₁ * κ * κ * κ * κ * κ := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun r _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ =>
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ =>
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => ?_
          simp only [abs_mul]
          have h0 := step _ _ _ (hM1b y hy r a b c m) hM₁ (bV r)
          have h1 := step _ _ _ h0 (n1 _ hM₁) (bX a)
          have h2 := step _ _ _ h1 (n1 _ (n1 _ hM₁)) (bY b)
          have h3 := step _ _ _ h2 (n1 _ (n1 _ (n1 _ hM₁))) (bZ c)
          exact step _ _ _ h3 (n1 _ (n1 _ (n1 _ (n1 _ hM₁)))) (bW m)
      _ = 243 * M₁ * κ ^ 5 := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          push_cast
          ring

informal_problem.statement: (Gm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Fv : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (ν : Fin 3 → ℝ) (L hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (DR : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (II : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (A₀ A₁ : ℝ) (hA₀ : 0 ≤ A₀) (hA₁ : 0 ≤ A₁) (hhi : ∀ i j : Fin 2, hi i j = ∑ t : Fin 2, L i t * L j t) (hunit : ∀ c : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 2, L i c * Fv i a) * Gm a b * (∑ i : Fin 2, L i c * Fv i b) ≤ 1) (hνν : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ν a * Gm a b * ν b ≤ 1) (hR : ∀ X Y Z W : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * Gm a b * X b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y a * Gm a b * Y b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Z a * Gm a b * Z b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, W a * Gm a b * W b ≤ 1 → |gsrF4 R X Y Z W| ≤ A₀) (hDR : ∀ V X Y Z W : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, V a * Gm a b * V b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, X a * Gm a b * X b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Y a * Gm a b * Y b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Z a * Gm a b * Z b ≤ 1 → ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, W a * Gm a b * W b ≤ 1 → |gsrF5 DR V X Y Z W| ≤ A₁) : |∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, hi i a * hi j b * II i j * gsrE R DR Fv ν hi II a b| ≤ 16 * A₁ * Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, hi i a * hi j b * II i j * II a b) + 80 * A₀ * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, hi i a * hi j b * II i j * II a b
