subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullMetric2 G F x i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j = pullMetric2 G F x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, (pullMetric2 G F x).PosDef) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSff G F i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsSff G F i j x = gsSff G F j i x) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSffSq G F) s ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ gsSffSq G F x)

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ k : Fin 2, (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcCovAlong G F (gcNu G F) k x c * gcNu G F x d = 0) ∧ (∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F m x c * gcCovAlong G F (gcNu G F) k x d = -gsSff G F k m x)

signature.name: gc_weingarten
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ k : Fin 2, (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcCovAlong G F (gcNu G F) k x c * gcNu G F x d = 0) ∧ (∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F m x c * gcCovAlong G F (gcNu G F) k x d = -gsSff G F k m x)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx k
  obtain ⟨J1, J2, -, -, J5, -⟩ := gc_jets G U hU hG hGsymm hGpos F s hs hF hFU hinj
  have hdiff : ∀ φ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ s → DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x := fun φ h =>
    (h.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hs.mem_nhds hx)
  have hνd : ∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => gcNu G F y c) x := fun c => hdiff _ (J5 c)
  have htd : ∀ (m : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => gsTan F m y c) x :=
    fun m c => hdiff _ (J1 m c)
  have hSW : ∀ u v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * u c * v d =
      ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * v c * u d := by
    intro u v
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
    rw [hGsymm (F x) d c]
    ring
  have hfx := gc_frame G F x hGsymm (hGpos _ (hFU x hx)) (hinj x hx)
  refine ⟨?_, fun m => ?_⟩
  · 
    have h1 : pd2 k (fun y => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        G (F y) c d * gcNu G F y c * gcNu G F y d) x = 0 := by
      have hev : (fun y => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
          G (F y) c d * gcNu G F y c * gcNu G F y d) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy =>
          (gc_frame G F y hGsymm (hGpos _ (hFU y hy)) (hinj y hy)).2.2.2.1)
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hpr : pd2 k (fun y => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        G (F y) c d * gcNu G F y c * gcNu G F y d) x =
        ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcCovAlong G F (gcNu G F) k x c * gcNu G F x d +
        ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcNu G F x c * gcCovAlong G F (gcNu G F) k x d :=
      gc_metric_compat G U hU hG hGsymm hGpos F s hs hF hFU (gcNu G F) (gcNu G F) x hx hνd hνd k
    have hB : ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcNu G F x c *
        gcCovAlong G F (gcNu G F) k x d =
        ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcCovAlong G F (gcNu G F) k x c *
        gcNu G F x d :=
      hSW (gcNu G F x) (fun d => gcCovAlong G F (gcNu G F) k x d)
    linarith
  · 
    have h2 : pd2 k (fun y => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        G (F y) c d * gsTan F m y c * gcNu G F y d) x = 0 := by
      have hev : (fun y => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
          G (F y) c d * gsTan F m y c * gcNu G F y d) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
        refine Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => ?_)
        have fr := gc_frame G F y hGsymm (hGpos _ (hFU y hy)) (hinj y hy)
        show ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F y) c d * gsTan F m y c * gcNu G F y d = 0
        rw [show ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F y) c d * gsTan F m y c * gcNu G F y d =
            (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F y c * gsTan F m y c) / gsNormLen G F y from
            fr.2.2.1 (fun c => gsTan F m y c), fr.2.1 m, zero_div]
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hpr : pd2 k (fun y => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        G (F y) c d * gsTan F m y c * gcNu G F y d) x =
        ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d *
          gcCovAlong G F (fun y c' => gsTan F m y c') k x c * gcNu G F x d +
        ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F m x c *
          gcCovAlong G F (gcNu G F) k x d :=
      gc_metric_compat G U hU hG hGsymm hGpos F s hs hF hFU (fun y c' => gsTan F m y c')
        (gcNu G F) x hx (htd m) hνd k
    have hDt : ∀ c : Fin 3, gcCovAlong G F (fun y c' => gsTan F m y c') k x c =
        gsCovHess G F k m x c := by
      intro c
      unfold gcCovAlong gsCovHess
      rw [J2 x hx k m c]
    have hA : ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d *
        gcCovAlong G F (fun y c' => gsTan F m y c') k x c * gcNu G F x d = gsSff G F k m x := by
      simp only [hDt]
      exact hfx.2.2.1 (fun c => gsCovHess G F k m x c)
    linarith

subgoal_signatures.name: gc_metric_compat
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (V W : E2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ s) (hV : ∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => V y c) x) (hW : ∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y c) x) (k : Fin 2) : pd2 k (fun y => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F y) c d * V y c * W y d) x = ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcCovAlong G F V k x c * W x d + ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * V x c * gcCovAlong G F W k x d

subgoal_signatures.name: gc_frame
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : 0 < gsNormLen G F x ∧ (∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * gsTan F m x c = 0) ∧ (∀ P : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * gcNu G F x d = (∑ c : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x c * P c) / gsNormLen G F x) ∧ (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gcNu G F x c * gcNu G F x d = 1) ∧ (∀ P Q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * Q d = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a b * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F a x c * P d) * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * gsTan F b x c * Q d) + (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * P c * gcNu G F x d) * (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * Q c * gcNu G F x d))

subgoal_signatures.name: gc_jets
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : (∀ (i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsTan F i y c) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ (k i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), pd2 k (fun y' => gsTan F i y' c) y = gsHessF F k i y c) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i : Fin 2, gsHessF F k i y = gsHessF F i k y) ∧ (∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsCovHess G F i j y c) s) ∧ (∀ l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gcNu G F y l) s) ∧ (∀ a b c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G a b c) U)

informal_problem.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hsymm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), h x i j = h x j i) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (θ : E2) (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) (q : ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ τ : ℝ, q τ = h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1 ^ 2 - 2 * h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 * θ 1 + h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 ^ 2) : q 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| < ρ → q τ = (h (τ • θ)).det) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < ρ → 4 * t * q t ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h (t • θ) = t * deriv q t ^ 2 - 2 * t * q t * deriv (deriv q) t - 4 * q t * deriv q t

signature.name: normal_ray_jacobi
signature.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hsymm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), h x i j = h x j i) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (θ : E2) (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) (q : ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ τ : ℝ, q τ = h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1 ^ 2 - 2 * h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 * θ 1 + h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 ^ 2) : q 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| < ρ → q τ = (h (τ • θ)).det) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < ρ → 4 * t * q t ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h (t • θ) = t * deriv q t ^ 2 - 2 * t * q t * deriv (deriv q) t - 4 * q t * deriv q t

proof.tactics:
by
  have hnf₂ : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i :=
    fun x hx => (hnf x hx).2
  have hdetB : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (h x).det ≠ 0 :=
    fun x hx => ((hnf x hx).1.det_pos).ne'
  have h0 : h 0 = 1 := normal_form_center_eq_one ρ hρ h hs hnf₂
  have F1 : θ 0 ^ 2 + θ 1 ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have h1 := hθ
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs,
      sq_abs] at h1
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ θ 0 ^ 2 + θ 1 ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h3 := Real.sq_sqrt h2
    rw [h1] at h3
    linarith
  have F2 : ∀ τ : ℝ, ‖τ • θ‖ = |τ| := by
    intro τ
    rw [norm_smul, hθ, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hmem : ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| < ρ → τ • θ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := by
    intro τ hτ
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, F2]
    exact hτ
  
  have hq0 : q 0 = 1 := by
    have a1 : (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) 0 0 = 1 := Matrix.one_apply_eq 0
    have a2 : (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) 0 1 = 0 := Matrix.one_apply_ne (by decide)
    have a3 : (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) 1 1 = 1 := Matrix.one_apply_eq 1
    rw [hq, zero_smul, h0, a1, a2, a3]
    linarith
  
  have hdet : ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| < ρ → q τ = (h (τ • θ)).det := by
    intro τ hτ
    by_cases hτ0 : τ = 0
    · subst hτ0
      rw [hq0, zero_smul, h0, Matrix.det_one]
    · have hx := hmem τ hτ
      have r0 := hnf₂ _ hx 0
      have r1 := hnf₂ _ hx 1
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at r0 r1
      have hsy : h (τ • θ) 1 0 = h (τ • θ) 0 1 := hsymm _ 1 0
      rw [hsy] at r1
      have E1 : h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 0 + h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 1 - θ 0 = 0 := by
        have e : τ * (h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 0 + h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 1 - θ 0) = 0 := by
          linear_combination r0
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp e).resolve_left hτ0
      have E2 : h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 + h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 1 - θ 1 = 0 := by
        have e : τ * (h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 + h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 1 - θ 1) = 0 := by
          linear_combination r1
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp e).resolve_left hτ0
      rw [hq τ, Matrix.det_fin_two, hsy]
      linear_combination
        -(h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 - h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 1) * E1
        + (h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 - h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1) * E2
        + (h (τ • θ) 0 0 * h (τ • θ) 1 1 - h (τ • θ) 0 1 ^ 2) * F1
  
  have hcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) := by
    have hσ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun τ : ℝ => τ • θ) (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) :=
      (contDiff_id.smul contDiff_const).contDiffOn
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun τ : ℝ => τ • θ) (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := by
      intro τ hτ
      exact hmem τ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨hτ.1, hτ.2⟩)
    have hc : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun τ : ℝ => h (τ • θ) i j) (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) :=
      fun i j => (hs i j).comp hσ hmaps
    have e : q = fun τ => h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1 ^ 2 - 2 * h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 * θ 1 +
        h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 ^ 2 := funext hq
    rw [e]
    exact (((hc 0 0).mul contDiffOn_const).sub
      (((contDiffOn_const.mul (hc 0 1)).mul contDiffOn_const).mul contDiffOn_const)).add
      ((hc 1 1).mul contDiffOn_const)
  
  obtain ⟨L, A, R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9⟩ := normal_form_rotate ρ h hs hsymm hnf₂ θ hθ
  refine ⟨hq0, hdet, hcd, ?_⟩
  intro t ht htρ
  have htU : t • e2 0 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one,
      mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht]
    exact htρ
  have hdet' : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ,
      ((fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) y).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    show (A.transpose * h (L y) * A).det ≠ 0
    rw [R8 y]
    apply hdetB
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, R3 y]
    rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hy
  have hq' : ∀ τ : ℝ, q τ = (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) (τ • e2 0) 1 1 :=
    fun τ => (hq τ).trans (R9 τ).symm
  have AX := normal_form_axis_curvature ρ (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) R5 R6 R7 t ht
    (Metric.ball 0 ρ) Metric.isOpen_ball subset_rfl htU hdet' q hq'
  have hy₀ : L (t • e2 0) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := by
    rw [R4 t]
    exact hmem t (by rw [abs_of_pos ht]; exact htρ)
  have ROT := gaussCurv2_orthogonal_comp h L A R1 R2 (Metric.ball 0 ρ) Metric.isOpen_ball hs
    hdetB (t • e2 0) hy₀
  rw [ROT, R4 t] at AX
  exact AX

subgoal_signatures.name: normal_form_center_eq_one
subgoal_signatures.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) : h 0 = 1

subgoal_signatures.name: normal_form_rotate
subgoal_signatures.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hsymm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), h x i j = h x j i) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (θ : E2) (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) : ∃ (L : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, L (e2 j) i = A i j) ∧ A.transpose * A = 1 ∧ (∀ y : E2, ‖L y‖ = ‖y‖) ∧ (∀ τ : ℝ, L (τ • e2 0) = τ • θ) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) ∧ (∀ (y : E2) (i j : Fin 2), (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j = (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) j i) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (A.transpose * h (L y) * A) i j * y j = y i) ∧ (∀ y : E2, (A.transpose * h (L y) * A).det = (h (L y)).det) ∧ (∀ τ : ℝ, (A.transpose * h (L (τ • e2 0)) * A) 1 1 = h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1 ^ 2 - 2 * h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 * θ 1 + h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: normal_form_axis_curvature
subgoal_signatures.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hsymm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), h x i j = h x j i) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (hUρ : U ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ) (htU : t • e2 0 ∈ U) (hdet : ∀ x ∈ U, (h x).det ≠ 0) (q : ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ τ : ℝ, q τ = h (τ • e2 0) 1 1) : 4 * t * q t ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h (t • e2 0) = t * deriv q t ^ 2 - 2 * t * q t * deriv (deriv q) t - 4 * q t * deriv q t

subgoal_signatures.name: gaussCurv2_orthogonal_comp
subgoal_signatures.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (L : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, L (e2 j) i = A i j) (hAA : A.transpose * A = 1) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) U) (hdet : ∀ x ∈ U, (h x).det ≠ 0) (y₀ : E2) (hy₀ : L y₀ ∈ U) : gaussCurv2 (fun y => A.transpose * h (L y) * A) y₀ = gaussCurv2 h (L y₀)

informal_problem.statement: (r : ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall 0 r)) : IntervalIntegrable (fun φ : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) MeasureTheory.volume (-Real.pi) Real.pi ∧ ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, f x = ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))

signature.name: integral_ball_polar_E2
signature.statement: (r : ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall 0 r)) : IntervalIntegrable (fun φ : ℝ => ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) MeasureTheory.volume (-Real.pi) Real.pi ∧ ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, f x = ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hθn : ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖(Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 : E2)‖ = 1 := by
    intro φ
    have h0 : (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 : E2) 0 = Real.cos φ := by
      simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have h1 : (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 : E2) 1 = Real.sin φ := by
      simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, h0, h1, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      sq_abs, sq_abs, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, Real.sqrt_one]
  have hsn : ∀ s φ : ℝ, ‖s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 : E2)‖ = |s| := by
    intro s φ
    rw [norm_smul, hθn, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  
  have hΦ : MeasurePreserving
      ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow :
        E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ) volume volume :=
    (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 2)).trans
      (MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ)
  have hΦsymm : ∀ a b : ℝ,
      ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow :
        E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ).symm (a, b) = a • e2 0 + b • e2 1 := by
    intro a b
    have h : ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow :
        E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ) (a • e2 0 + b • e2 1) = (a, b) := by
      simp [MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow_apply, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [← h, MeasurableEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hpolar : ∀ g : E2 → ℝ, ∫ x, g x = ∫ p in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
      p.1 * g (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) := by
    intro g
    have h1 : ∫ x, g x = ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, g
        (((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow :
          E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ).symm p) := by
      rw [← hΦ.integral_comp' (fun p => g
        (((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow :
          E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ).symm p))]
      simp only [MeasurableEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [h1, ← integral_comp_polarCoord_symm, polarCoord_target]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun (measurableSet_Ioi.prod measurableSet_Ioo) ?_
    intro p _
    simp only [polarCoord_symm_apply, hΦsymm, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ,
      F p = p.1 * f (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) := ⟨_, fun p => rfl⟩
  have hpi : -Real.pi ≤ Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  
  have hFc : ContinuousOn F (Set.Icc 0 r ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) := by
    have hFeq : F = fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        p.1 * f (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) := funext hF
    have hP : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1))
        (Set.Icc 0 r ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) (Metric.closedBall 0 r) := by
      intro p hp
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, hsn, abs_of_nonneg hp.1.1]
      exact hp.1.2
    rw [hFeq]
    exact continuous_fst.continuousOn.mul (hf.comp hP.continuousOn hmaps)
  have hint : IntegrableOn F (Set.Icc 0 r ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) :=
    hFc.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
  have hμ : (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)).restrict (Set.Ioo 0 r ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi) =
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Ioo 0 r)).prod
        ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi)) := by
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_restrict]
  have hint' : Integrable F (((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Ioo 0 r)).prod
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi))) := by
    rw [← hμ]
    exact hint.mono_set (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
  have hinner : ∀ y : ℝ, ∫ x in Set.Ioo 0 r, F (x, y) = ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, F (x, y) := by
    intro y
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hr.le, integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo]
  have hinner' : ∀ y : ℝ, ∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..r, F (x, y) =
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * f (s • (Real.cos y • e2 0 + Real.sin y • e2 1)) := by
    intro y
    simp only [hF]
  constructor
  · have h := hint'.integral_prod_right
    simp only [hinner, hinner'] at h
    exact (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioo_of_le hpi).2 h
  · have hT : MeasurableSet (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi) :=
      measurableSet_Ioi.prod measurableSet_Ioo
    have hS : MeasurableSet (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) r ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi) :=
      measurableSet_Ioo.prod measurableSet_Ioo
    have hST : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) r ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi ⊆
        Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi :=
      Set.prod_mono Set.Ioo_subset_Ioi_self subset_rfl
    calc ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, f x
        = ∫ x, (Metric.ball (0 : E2) r).indicator f x :=
          (integral_indicator measurableSet_ball).symm
      _ = ∫ p in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
            p.1 * (Metric.ball (0 : E2) r).indicator f
              (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) := hpolar _
      _ = ∫ p in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) r ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
            p.1 * (Metric.ball (0 : E2) r).indicator f
              (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) := by
          refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hT hST ?_
          rintro p ⟨⟨hp1, hp2⟩, hpS⟩
          have hp1' : (0 : ℝ) < p.1 := hp1
          have hrp : r ≤ p.1 := by
            by_contra hlt
            push_neg at hlt
            exact hpS ⟨⟨hp1', hlt⟩, hp2⟩
          have hnm : p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1) ∉
              Metric.ball (0 : E2) r := by
            rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, hsn, abs_of_pos hp1']
            exact not_lt.2 hrp
          rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hnm, mul_zero]
      _ = ∫ p in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) r ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi, F p := by
          refine setIntegral_congr_fun hS ?_
          rintro p ⟨⟨hp1, hp2⟩, _⟩
          have hm : p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1) ∈
              Metric.ball (0 : E2) r := by
            rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, hsn, abs_of_pos hp1]
            exact hp2
          show p.1 * (Metric.ball (0 : E2) r).indicator f
            (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) = F p
          rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hm, hF]
      _ = ∫ y in Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi, ∫ x in Set.Ioo 0 r, F (x, y) := by
          rw [hμ]
          exact integral_prod_symm F hint'
      _ = ∫ y in Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
            ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * f (s • (Real.cos y • e2 0 + Real.sin y • e2 1)) := by
          simp only [hinner, hinner']
      _ = ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
            ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hpi, integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo]

informal_problem.statement: (ρ r : ℝ) (q k : ℝ → ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r < ρ) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 q (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ)) (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ, 0 < q τ) (hq0 : q 0 = 1) (hode : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < ρ → 4 * t * q t ^ 2 * k t = t * deriv q t ^ 2 - 2 * t * q t * deriv (deriv q) t - 4 * q t * deriv q t) : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * Real.sqrt (q s) = r ^ 2 / 2 - (1 / 2) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, (r - s) ^ 2 * k s * (s * Real.sqrt (q s))

signature.name: ray_taylor_identity
signature.statement: (ρ r : ℝ) (q k : ℝ → ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrρ : r < ρ) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 q (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ)) (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ, 0 < q τ) (hq0 : q 0 = 1) (hode : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < ρ → 4 * t * q t ^ 2 * k t = t * deriv q t ^ 2 - 2 * t * q t * deriv (deriv q) t - 4 * q t * deriv q t) : ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, s * Real.sqrt (q s) = r ^ 2 / 2 - (1 / 2) * ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..r, (r - s) ^ 2 * k s * (s * Real.sqrt (q s))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have key : ∀ (J J1 J2 : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) r, HasDerivAt J (J1 u) u) →
      (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) r, HasDerivAt J1 (J2 u) u) → ContinuousOn J2 (Set.Icc 0 r) →
      J 0 = 0 → J1 0 = 1 → (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) r, J2 u = -(k u * J u)) →
      ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..r, J s = r ^ 2 / 2 - (1 / 2) * ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..r, (r - s) ^ 2 * k s * J s := by
    intro J J1 J2 hJ hJ1 hJ2c hJ0 hJ10 hode'
    have hJc : ContinuousOn J (Set.Icc 0 r) :=
      fun u hu => (hJ u hu).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hPhi : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc (0:ℝ) r,
        HasDerivAt (fun u => (r - u) ^ 2 * J1 u + 2 * (r - u) * J u)
          ((r - u) ^ 2 * J2 u - 2 * J u) u := by
      intro u hu
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hr.le] at hu
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun u => r - u) (-1) u := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).const_sub r
      have h2 := ((h1.pow 2).mul (hJ1 u hu)).add ((h1.const_mul 2).mul (hJ u hu))
      convert h2 using 1
      norm_num
      ring
    have hpolyc : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => (r - u) ^ 2) (Set.Icc 0 r) :=
      (continuousOn_const.sub continuousOn_id).pow 2
    have hA : IntervalIntegrable (fun u => (r - u) ^ 2 * J2 u) MeasureTheory.volume 0 r := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hr.le]
      exact hpolyc.mul hJ2c
    have hB : IntervalIntegrable (fun u => 2 * J u) MeasureTheory.volume 0 r := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hr.le]
      exact continuousOn_const.mul hJc
    have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hPhi (hA.sub hB)
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hA hB, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hFTC
    have hcongr : ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..r, (r - u) ^ 2 * J2 u =
        ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..r, -((r - u) ^ 2 * k u * J u) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u hu => ?_)
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hr.le] at hu
      rw [hode' u hu]
      ring
    rw [hcongr, intervalIntegral.integral_neg] at hFTC
    simp only [sub_zero, hJ0, hJ10] at hFTC
    linear_combination (-1/2 : ℝ) * hFTC
  
  have alg : ∀ t Q Q1 Q2 K : ℝ, 0 < Q →
      4 * t * Q ^ 2 * K = t * Q1 ^ 2 - 2 * t * Q * Q2 - 4 * Q * Q1 →
      2 * (Q1 / (2 * Real.sqrt Q)) + t * ((Q2 * (2 * Real.sqrt Q) - Q1 * (2 * (Q1 / (2 * Real.sqrt Q)))) / (2 * Real.sqrt Q) ^ 2)
        = -(K * (t * Real.sqrt Q)) := by
    intro t Q Q1 Q2 K hQ h
    have hS : 0 < Real.sqrt Q := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hQ
    have hSS : Real.sqrt Q ^ 2 = Q := Real.sq_sqrt hQ.le
    rw [← hSS] at h
    generalize Real.sqrt Q = S at h hS ⊢
    have e : 2 * (Q1 / (2 * S)) + t * ((Q2 * (2 * S) - Q1 * (2 * (Q1 / (2 * S)))) / (2 * S) ^ 2)
        = (4 * S ^ 2 * Q1 + 2 * t * S ^ 2 * Q2 - t * Q1 ^ 2) / (4 * S ^ 3) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [e, div_eq_iff (by positivity)]
    linear_combination h
  
  have hUo : IsOpen (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) := isOpen_Ioo
  have hq1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (deriv q) (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) := hq.deriv_of_isOpen hUo (by norm_num)
  have hq2c : ContinuousOn (deriv (deriv q)) (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) :=
    hq1.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen hUo le_rfl
  have hqc : ContinuousOn q (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) := hq.continuousOn
  have hq1c : ContinuousOn (deriv q) (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) := hq1.continuousOn
  have hd0 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ, HasDerivAt q (deriv q t) t := fun t ht =>
    ((hq.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hUo.mem_nhds ht)).hasDerivAt
  have hd1 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ, HasDerivAt (deriv q) (deriv (deriv q) t) t := fun t ht =>
    ((hq1.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hUo.mem_nhds ht)).hasDerivAt
  have hne : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ, 2 * Real.sqrt (q t) ≠ 0 := fun t ht =>
    (mul_pos two_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos t ht))).ne'
  have hw : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ, HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.sqrt (q s))
      (deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t))) t := fun t ht => (hd0 t ht).sqrt (hpos t ht).ne'
  have hv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ, HasDerivAt (fun s => deriv q s / (2 * Real.sqrt (q s)))
      ((deriv (deriv q) t * (2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) - deriv q t * (2 * (deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t))))) / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) ^ 2) t :=
    fun t ht => (hd1 t ht).div ((hw t ht).const_mul 2) (hne t ht)
  have D1 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ, HasDerivAt (fun s => s * Real.sqrt (q s))
      (Real.sqrt (q t) + t * (deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t)))) t := fun t ht =>
    ((hasDerivAt_id' t).mul (hw t ht)).congr_deriv (by ring)
  have D2 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.sqrt (q s) + s * (deriv q s / (2 * Real.sqrt (q s))))
        (2 * (deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t))) + t * ((deriv (deriv q) t * (2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) - deriv q t * (2 * (deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t))))) / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) ^ 2)) t :=
    fun t ht => ((hw t ht).add ((hasDerivAt_id' t).mul (hv t ht))).congr_deriv (by ring)
  have hsc : ContinuousOn (fun t => 2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) :=
    continuousOn_const.mul hqc.sqrt
  have hvc : ContinuousOn (fun t => deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t))) (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) :=
    hq1c.div hsc hne
  have C2 : ContinuousOn (fun t => 2 * (deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t))) + t * ((deriv (deriv q) t * (2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) - deriv q t * (2 * (deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t))))) / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) ^ 2)) (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) :=
    (continuousOn_const.mul hvc).add (continuousOn_id.mul
      (((hq2c.mul hsc).sub (hq1c.mul (continuousOn_const.mul hvc))).div (hsc.pow 2)
        (fun t ht => pow_ne_zero 2 (hne t ht))))
  
  have hsub : Set.Icc (0:ℝ) r ⊆ Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ := fun u hu =>
    ⟨by linarith [hu.1], by linarith [hu.2]⟩
  exact key (fun s => s * Real.sqrt (q s))
    (fun s => Real.sqrt (q s) + s * (deriv q s / (2 * Real.sqrt (q s))))
    (fun t => 2 * (deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t))) + t * ((deriv (deriv q) t * (2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) - deriv q t * (2 * (deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t))))) / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) ^ 2))
    (fun u hu => D1 u (hsub hu)) (fun u hu => D2 u (hsub hu)) (C2.mono hsub)
    (by simp) (by simp [hq0])
    (fun u hu => alg u (q u) (deriv q u) (deriv (deriv q) u) (k u)
      (hpos u (hsub (Set.Ioc_subset_Icc_self hu))) (hode u hu.1 (by linarith [hu.2])))

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hcompat : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ r a b : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun z => G z a b) y = ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y a e * christoffel G e r b y + G y b e * christoffel G e r a y)) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (htan : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsTan F i y c) s) (htanD : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ (k i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), pd2 k (fun y' => gsTan F i y' c) y = gsHessF F k i y c) (hν : ∀ e : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsrNu G F y e) s) (horth : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, gsrNu G F y a * G (F y) a b * gsTan F i y b = 0) (hunit : ∀ y ∈ s, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, gsrNu G F y a * G (F y) a b * gsrNu G F y b = 1) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ l : Fin 2, (∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (pd2 l (fun y => gsrNu G F y a) x + ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3, christoffel G a r q (F x) * gsTan F l x r * gsrNu G F x q) * G (F x) a b * gsTan F i x b = -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, gsrNu G F x a * G (F x) a b * gsCovHess G F l i x b) ∧ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (pd2 l (fun y => gsrNu G F y a) x + ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3, christoffel G a r q (F x) * gsTan F l x r * gsrNu G F x q) * G (F x) a b * gsrNu G F x b = 0

signature.name: gsr_nu_deriv_relations
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hcompat : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ r a b : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun z => G z a b) y = ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y a e * christoffel G e r b y + G y b e * christoffel G e r a y)) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (htan : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsTan F i y c) s) (htanD : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ (k i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), pd2 k (fun y' => gsTan F i y' c) y = gsHessF F k i y c) (hν : ∀ e : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsrNu G F y e) s) (horth : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, gsrNu G F y a * G (F y) a b * gsTan F i y b = 0) (hunit : ∀ y ∈ s, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, gsrNu G F y a * G (F y) a b * gsrNu G F y b = 1) : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ l : Fin 2, (∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (pd2 l (fun y => gsrNu G F y a) x + ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3, christoffel G a r q (F x) * gsTan F l x r * gsrNu G F x q) * G (F x) a b * gsTan F i x b = -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, gsrNu G F x a * G (F x) a b * gsCovHess G F l i x b) ∧ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (pd2 l (fun y => gsrNu G F y a) x + ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3, christoffel G a r q (F x) * gsTan F l x r * gsrNu G F x q) * G (F x) a b * gsrNu G F x b = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro x hx l
  have hx' : s ∈ 𝓝 x := hs.mem_nhds hx
  have hdiff : ∀ φ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ s → DifferentiableAt ℝ φ x :=
    fun φ h => (h.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hx'
  have hνd : ∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => gsrNu G F y c) x :=
    fun c => hdiff _ (hν c)
  have htd : ∀ (m : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => gsTan F m y c) x :=
    fun m c => hdiff _ (htan m c)
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x := (hF.contDiffAt hx').differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hGd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z a b) (F x) := fun a b =>
    ((hG a b).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hFU x hx))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hAd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G (F y) a b) x := fun a b =>
    (hGd a b).comp x hFd
  
  have hchain : ∀ a b : Fin 3, pd2 l (fun y => G (F y) a b) x =
      ∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun z => G z a b) (F x) * gsTan F l x r := by
    intro a b
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => G (F y) a b) x (e2 l) = _
    rw [show (fun y => G (F y) a b) = (fun z => G z a b) ∘ F from rfl,
      fderiv_comp x (hGd a b) hFd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    have hv : fderiv ℝ F x (e2 l) = ∑ r : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 l)) r • e r := by
      ext m
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    rw [hv, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    simp [partialDeriv, gsTan, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  have hbil : ∀ V W : E2 → Fin 3 → ℝ, (∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => V y c) x) →
      (∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y c) x) →
      pd2 l (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, V y a * G (F y) a b * W y b) x =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (pd2 l (fun y => V y a) x * G (F x) a b * W x b +
          V x a * pd2 l (fun y => G (F y) a b) x * W x b +
          V x a * G (F x) a b * pd2 l (fun y => W y b) x) := by
    intro V W hV hW
    have dP : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => V y a * G (F y) a b * W y b) x :=
      fun a b => ((hV a).mul (hAd a b)).mul (hW b)
    have dS : ∀ a : Fin 3,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, V y a * G (F y) a b * W y b) x :=
      fun a => (DifferentiableAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) fun b _ => dP a b).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by simp [Finset.sum_apply])
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun a _ => dS a), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun b _ => dP a b), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul (show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => V y a * G (F y) a b) x from
        (hV a).mul (hAd a b)) (hW b), fderiv_fun_mul (hV a) (hAd a b)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have alg : ∀ (Gm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), (∀ a b : Fin 3, Gm a b = Gm b a) →
      ∀ (Γ P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ r a b : Fin 3, P r a b = ∑ e : Fin 3, (Gm a e * Γ e r b + Gm b e * Γ e r a)) →
      ∀ (T v w dv dw : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (dv a * Gm a b * w b + v a * (∑ r : Fin 3, P r a b * T r) * w b +
          v a * Gm a b * dw b) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (dv a + ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3, Γ a r q * T r * v q) *
            Gm a b * w b +
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, v a * Gm a b *
            (dw b + ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3, Γ b r q * T r * w q) := by
    intro Gm hGs Γ P hP T v w dv dw
    simp only [hP, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [hGs 1 0, hGs 2 0, hGs 2 1]
    ring
  have hP : ∀ r a b : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (fun z => G z a b) (F x) =
      ∑ e : Fin 3, (G (F x) a e * christoffel G e r b (F x) +
        G (F x) b e * christoffel G e r a (F x)) := hcompat (F x) (hFU x hx)
  have key : ∀ V W : E2 → Fin 3 → ℝ, (∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => V y c) x) →
      (∀ c : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => W y c) x) →
      pd2 l (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, V y a * G (F y) a b * W y b) x =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (pd2 l (fun y => V y a) x + ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3,
            christoffel G a r q (F x) * gsTan F l x r * V x q) * G (F x) a b * W x b +
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, V x a * G (F x) a b *
            (pd2 l (fun y => W y b) x + ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3,
              christoffel G b r q (F x) * gsTan F l x r * W x q) := by
    intro V W hV hW
    rw [hbil V W hV hW]
    simp only [hchain]
    exact alg (G (F x)) (hGsymm (F x)) (fun e r b => christoffel G e r b (F x))
      (fun r a b => partialDeriv r (fun z => G z a b) (F x)) hP
      (fun r => gsTan F l x r) (fun a => V x a) (fun b => W x b)
      (fun a => pd2 l (fun y => V y a) x) (fun b => pd2 l (fun y => W y b) x)
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 : pd2 l (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        gsrNu G F y a * G (F y) a b * gsTan F i y b) x = 0 := by
      have hev : (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          gsrNu G F y a * G (F y) a b * gsTan F i y b) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem hx' (fun y hy => horth y hy i)
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hk := key (fun y a => gsrNu G F y a) (fun y b => gsTan F i y b) hνd (htd i)
    beta_reduce at hk
    rw [h0] at hk
    have hcov : ∀ b : Fin 3, pd2 l (fun y => gsTan F i y b) x + ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3,
        christoffel G b r q (F x) * gsTan F l x r * gsTan F i x q = gsCovHess G F l i x b := by
      intro b
      unfold gsCovHess
      rw [htanD x hx l i b]
    simp only [hcov] at hk
    linarith
  · have h1 : pd2 l (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        gsrNu G F y a * G (F y) a b * gsrNu G F y b) x = 0 := by
      have hev : (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          gsrNu G F y a * G (F y) a b * gsrNu G F y b) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem hx' (fun y hy => hunit y hy)
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hk := key (fun y a => gsrNu G F y a) (fun y b => gsrNu G F y b) hνd hνd
    beta_reduce at hk
    rw [h1] at hk
    have hswap : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, gsrNu G F x a * G (F x) a b *
        (pd2 l (fun y => gsrNu G F y b) x + ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3,
          christoffel G b r q (F x) * gsTan F l x r * gsrNu G F x q) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (pd2 l (fun y => gsrNu G F y a) x + ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3,
          christoffel G a r q (F x) * gsTan F l x r * gsrNu G F x q) * G (F x) a b *
          gsrNu G F x b := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      rw [hGsymm (F x) a b]
      ring
    linarith

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hRm : ∀ a b c m : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsrRm G a b c m) U) (htan : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsTan F i y c) s) (htanD : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ (k i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), pd2 k (fun y' => gsTan F i y' c) y = gsHessF F k i y c) (hν : ∀ e : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsrNu G F y e) s) (hrep : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsAmbCod G F k i j y = gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F y)) (fun a => gsTan F k y a) (fun a => gsTan F i y a) (fun a => gsTan F j y a) (gsrNu G F y)) : ∀ x ∈ s, (∀ k i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (gsAmbCod G F k i j) x) ∧ ∀ l k i j : Fin 2, pd2 l (gsAmbCod G F k i j) x = gsrF5 (fun r a b c m => partialDeriv r (gsrRm G a b c m) (F x)) (fun r => gsTan F l x r) (fun a => gsTan F k x a) (fun a => gsTan F i x a) (fun a => gsTan F j x a) (gsrNu G F x) + gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F x)) (fun a => gsHessF F l k x a) (fun a => gsTan F i x a) (fun a => gsTan F j x a) (gsrNu G F x) + gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F x)) (fun a => gsTan F k x a) (fun a => gsHessF F l i x a) (fun a => gsTan F j x a) (gsrNu G F x) + gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F x)) (fun a => gsTan F k x a) (fun a => gsTan F i x a) (fun a => gsHessF F l j x a) (gsrNu G F x) + gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F x)) (fun a => gsTan F k x a) (fun a => gsTan F i x a) (fun a => gsTan F j x a) (fun m => pd2 l (fun y => gsrNu G F y m) x)

signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hRm : ∀ a b c m : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsrRm G a b c m) U) (htan : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsTan F i y c) s) (htanD : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ (k i : Fin 2) (c : Fin 3), pd2 k (fun y' => gsTan F i y' c) y = gsHessF F k i y c) (hν : ∀ e : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => gsrNu G F y e) s) (hrep : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsAmbCod G F k i j y = gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F y)) (fun a => gsTan F k y a) (fun a => gsTan F i y a) (fun a => gsTan F j y a) (gsrNu G F y)) : ∀ x ∈ s, (∀ k i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (gsAmbCod G F k i j) x) ∧ ∀ l k i j : Fin 2, pd2 l (gsAmbCod G F k i j) x = gsrF5 (fun r a b c m => partialDeriv r (gsrRm G a b c m) (F x)) (fun r => gsTan F l x r) (fun a => gsTan F k x a) (fun a => gsTan F i x a) (fun a => gsTan F j x a) (gsrNu G F x) + gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F x)) (fun a => gsHessF F l k x a) (fun a => gsTan F i x a) (fun a => gsTan F j x a) (gsrNu G F x) + gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F x)) (fun a => gsTan F k x a) (fun a => gsHessF F l i x a) (fun a => gsTan F j x a) (gsrNu G F x) + gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F x)) (fun a => gsTan F k x a) (fun a => gsTan F i x a) (fun a => gsHessF F l j x a) (gsrNu G F x) + gsrF4 (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F x)) (fun a => gsTan F k x a) (fun a => gsTan F i x a) (fun a => gsTan F j x a) (fun m => pd2 l (fun y => gsrNu G F y m) x)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx
  have hxn : s ∈ 𝓝 x := hs.mem_nhds hx
  
  have H1 : ∀ (l : Fin 2) (f g : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 l (fun y => f y * g y) x = pd2 l f x * g x + f x * pd2 l g x := by
    intro l f g hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have H2 : ∀ (l : Fin 2) (A : Fin 3 → E2 → ℝ), (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (A a) x) →
      pd2 l (fun y => ∑ a, A a y) x = ∑ a, pd2 l (A a) x := by
    intro l A hA
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun a _ => hA a), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  
  have hSum4 : ∀ (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E2 → ℝ),
      (∀ a b c m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (P a b c m) x) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ m, P a b c m y) x ∧
      ∀ l : Fin 2, pd2 l (fun y => ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ m, P a b c m y) x =
        ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ m, pd2 l (P a b c m) x := by
    intro P hP
    have h1 : ∀ a b c, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ m, P a b c m y) x :=
      fun a b c => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun m _ => hP a b c m)
    have h2 : ∀ a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ c, ∑ m, P a b c m y) x :=
      fun a b => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun c _ => h1 a b c)
    have h3 : ∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ m, P a b c m y) x :=
      fun a => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => h2 a b)
    refine ⟨DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun a _ => h3 a), fun l => ?_⟩
    rw [H2 l (fun a y => ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ m, P a b c m y) h3]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    rw [H2 l (fun b y => ∑ c, ∑ m, P a b c m y) (h2 a)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
    rw [H2 l (fun c y => ∑ m, P a b c m y) (h1 a b)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_)
    exact H2 l (P a b c) (hP a b c)
  
  have hLeib : ∀ (ρ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E2 → ℝ) (X Y Z W : Fin 3 → E2 → ℝ),
      (∀ a b c m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (ρ a b c m) x) → (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (X a) x) →
      (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (Y a) x) → (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (Z a) x) →
      (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (W a) x) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => gsrF4 (fun a b c m => ρ a b c m y) (fun a => X a y)
        (fun a => Y a y) (fun a => Z a y) (fun a => W a y)) x ∧
      ∀ l : Fin 2, pd2 l (fun y => gsrF4 (fun a b c m => ρ a b c m y) (fun a => X a y)
        (fun a => Y a y) (fun a => Z a y) (fun a => W a y)) x =
        gsrF4 (fun a b c m => pd2 l (ρ a b c m) x) (fun a => X a x) (fun a => Y a x)
            (fun a => Z a x) (fun a => W a x) +
          gsrF4 (fun a b c m => ρ a b c m x) (fun a => pd2 l (X a) x) (fun a => Y a x)
            (fun a => Z a x) (fun a => W a x) +
          gsrF4 (fun a b c m => ρ a b c m x) (fun a => X a x) (fun a => pd2 l (Y a) x)
            (fun a => Z a x) (fun a => W a x) +
          gsrF4 (fun a b c m => ρ a b c m x) (fun a => X a x) (fun a => Y a x)
            (fun a => pd2 l (Z a) x) (fun a => W a x) +
          gsrF4 (fun a b c m => ρ a b c m x) (fun a => X a x) (fun a => Y a x)
            (fun a => Z a x) (fun a => pd2 l (W a) x) := by
    intro ρ X Y Z W hρ hX hY hZ hW
    have hP := hSum4 (fun a b c m y => ρ a b c m y * X a y * Y b y * Z c y * W m y)
      (fun a b c m => ((((hρ a b c m).fun_mul (hX a)).fun_mul (hY b)).fun_mul (hZ c)).fun_mul (hW m))
    refine ⟨hP.1, fun l => ?_⟩
    have hPd : ∀ a b c m, pd2 l (fun y => ρ a b c m y * X a y * Y b y * Z c y * W m y) x =
        pd2 l (ρ a b c m) x * X a x * Y b x * Z c x * W m x +
        ρ a b c m x * pd2 l (X a) x * Y b x * Z c x * W m x +
        ρ a b c m x * X a x * pd2 l (Y b) x * Z c x * W m x +
        ρ a b c m x * X a x * Y b x * pd2 l (Z c) x * W m x +
        ρ a b c m x * X a x * Y b x * Z c x * pd2 l (W m) x := by
      intro a b c m
      rw [H1 l _ _ ((((hρ a b c m).fun_mul (hX a)).fun_mul (hY b)).fun_mul (hZ c)) (hW m),
        H1 l _ _ (((hρ a b c m).fun_mul (hX a)).fun_mul (hY b)) (hZ c),
        H1 l _ _ ((hρ a b c m).fun_mul (hX a)) (hY b),
        H1 l _ _ (hρ a b c m) (hX a)]
      ring
    have e1 := hP.2 l
    simp only [gsrF4]
    simp only [gsrF4] at e1
    rw [e1]
    simp only [hPd, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x := (hF.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hxn
  have hwd : ∀ a b c m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (gsrRm G a b c m) (F x) := fun a b c m =>
    ((hRm a b c m).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hFU x hx))
  have hlin : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E3), L v = ∑ r : Fin 3, L (e r) * v r := by
    intro L v
    have hv : v = ∑ r : Fin 3, v r • e r := by
      ext i
      simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => ?_)
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  have hch : ∀ (l : Fin 2) (a b c m : Fin 3), pd2 l (fun y => gsrRm G a b c m (F y)) x =
      ∑ r : Fin 3, partialDeriv r (gsrRm G a b c m) (F x) * gsTan F l x r := by
    intro l a b c m
    unfold pd2
    rw [show (fun y => gsrRm G a b c m (F y)) = gsrRm G a b c m ∘ F from rfl,
      fderiv_comp x (hwd a b c m) hFd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hlin]
    rfl
  
  have hcontract : ∀ (D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (V X Y Z W : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      gsrF4 (fun a b c m => ∑ r : Fin 3, D r a b c m * V r) X Y Z W = gsrF5 D V X Y Z W := by
    intro D V X Y Z W
    simp only [gsrF4, gsrF5, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hρd : ∀ a b c m, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => gsrRm G a b c m (F y)) x :=
    fun a b c m => (hwd a b c m).comp x hFd
  have hTd : ∀ (q : Fin 2) (a : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => gsTan F q y a) x :=
    fun q a => ((htan q a).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hxn
  have hNd : ∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => gsrNu G F y a) x :=
    fun a => ((hν a).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hxn
  have hL := fun k i j : Fin 2 => hLeib (fun a b c m y => gsrRm G a b c m (F y))
    (fun a y => gsTan F k y a) (fun a y => gsTan F i y a) (fun a y => gsTan F j y a)
    (fun a y => gsrNu G F y a) hρd (hTd k) (hTd i) (hTd j) hNd
  have hev : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsAmbCod G F k i j =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => gsrF4
      (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F y)) (fun a => gsTan F k y a) (fun a => gsTan F i y a)
      (fun a => gsTan F j y a) (fun a => gsrNu G F y a)) :=
    fun k i j => Filter.eventually_of_mem hxn (fun y hy => hrep y hy k i j)
  refine ⟨fun k i j => (hL k i j).1.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hev k i j), fun l k i j => ?_⟩
  have h5a : pd2 l (gsAmbCod G F k i j) x = pd2 l (fun y => gsrF4
      (fun a b c m => gsrRm G a b c m (F y)) (fun a => gsTan F k y a) (fun a => gsTan F i y a)
      (fun a => gsTan F j y a) (fun a => gsrNu G F y a)) x := by
    unfold pd2
    rw [(hev k i j).fderiv_eq]
  rw [h5a, (hL k i j).2 l]
  simp only [hch l, htanD x hx, hcontract]

informal_problem.statement: (Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (RmA : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (dRmA DR : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hDR : ∀ r a b c m : Fin 3, DR r a b c m = dRmA r a b c m - ∑ q : Fin 3, (Γ q r a * RmA q b c m + Γ q r b * RmA a q c m + Γ q r c * RmA a b q m + Γ q r m * RmA a b c q)) (D : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (A : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (ν : Fin 3 → ℝ) (dν : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Γ2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (II : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hGauss : ∀ (l k : Fin 2) (e : Fin 3), A l k e + ∑ m : Fin 3, ∑ n : Fin 3, Γ e m n * D l m * D k n = ∑ m : Fin 2, Γ2 m l k * D m e + II l k * ν e) (hWein : ∀ (l : Fin 2) (e : Fin 3), dν l e = -(∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3, Γ e r q * D l r * ν q) - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, hi a b * II l b * D a e) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hT : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, T k i j = gsrF4 RmA (D k) (D i) (D j) ν) (dT : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hdT : ∀ l k i j : Fin 2, dT l k i j = gsrF5 dRmA (D l) (D k) (D i) (D j) ν + gsrF4 RmA (A l k) (D i) (D j) ν + gsrF4 RmA (D k) (A l i) (D j) ν + gsrF4 RmA (D k) (D i) (A l j) ν + gsrF4 RmA (D k) (D i) (D j) (dν l)) : ∀ l k i j : Fin 2, dT l k i j - ∑ m : Fin 2, Γ2 m l k * T m i j - ∑ m : Fin 2, Γ2 m l i * T k m j - ∑ m : Fin 2, Γ2 m l j * T k i m = gsrDT RmA DR D ν hi II l k i j

signature.name: gsr_cod_tensorial_alg
signature.statement: (Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (RmA : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (dRmA DR : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hDR : ∀ r a b c m : Fin 3, DR r a b c m = dRmA r a b c m - ∑ q : Fin 3, (Γ q r a * RmA q b c m + Γ q r b * RmA a q c m + Γ q r c * RmA a b q m + Γ q r m * RmA a b c q)) (D : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (A : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (ν : Fin 3 → ℝ) (dν : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (Γ2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (II : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hGauss : ∀ (l k : Fin 2) (e : Fin 3), A l k e + ∑ m : Fin 3, ∑ n : Fin 3, Γ e m n * D l m * D k n = ∑ m : Fin 2, Γ2 m l k * D m e + II l k * ν e) (hWein : ∀ (l : Fin 2) (e : Fin 3), dν l e = -(∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3, Γ e r q * D l r * ν q) - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, hi a b * II l b * D a e) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hT : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, T k i j = gsrF4 RmA (D k) (D i) (D j) ν) (dT : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hdT : ∀ l k i j : Fin 2, dT l k i j = gsrF5 dRmA (D l) (D k) (D i) (D j) ν + gsrF4 RmA (A l k) (D i) (D j) ν + gsrF4 RmA (D k) (A l i) (D j) ν + gsrF4 RmA (D k) (D i) (A l j) ν + gsrF4 RmA (D k) (D i) (D j) (dν l)) : ∀ l k i j : Fin 2, dT l k i j - ∑ m : Fin 2, Γ2 m l k * T m i j - ∑ m : Fin 2, Γ2 m l i * T k m j - ∑ m : Fin 2, Γ2 m l j * T k i m = gsrDT RmA DR D ν hi II l k i j

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have key : ∀ r a b c m : Fin 3, dRmA r a b c m = DR r a b c m +
      ((∑ q : Fin 3, Γ q r a * RmA q b c m) + (∑ q : Fin 3, Γ q r b * RmA a q c m) +
        (∑ q : Fin 3, Γ q r c * RmA a b q m) + (∑ q : Fin 3, Γ q r m * RmA a b c q)) := by
    intro r a b c m
    rw [hDR]
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    ring
  have s1 : ∀ V X Y Z W : Fin 3 → ℝ, gsrF5 dRmA V X Y Z W = gsrF5 DR V X Y Z W
      + gsrF4 RmA (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * V r * X a) Y Z W
      + gsrF4 RmA X (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * V r * Y a) Z W
      + gsrF4 RmA X Y (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * V r * Z a) W
      + gsrF4 RmA X Y Z (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * V r * W a) := by
    intro V X Y Z W
    have c1 : ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        (∑ q : Fin 3, Γ q r a * RmA q b c m) * V r * X a * Y b * Z c * W m
        = gsrF4 RmA (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * V r * X a) Y Z W := by
      simp only [gsrF4, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have c2 : ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        (∑ q : Fin 3, Γ q r b * RmA a q c m) * V r * X a * Y b * Z c * W m
        = gsrF4 RmA X (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * V r * Y a) Z W := by
      simp only [gsrF4, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have c3 : ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        (∑ q : Fin 3, Γ q r c * RmA a b q m) * V r * X a * Y b * Z c * W m
        = gsrF4 RmA X Y (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * V r * Z a) W := by
      simp only [gsrF4, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have c4 : ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        (∑ q : Fin 3, Γ q r m * RmA a b c q) * V r * X a * Y b * Z c * W m
        = gsrF4 RmA X Y Z (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * V r * W a) := by
      simp only [gsrF4, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [← c1, ← c2, ← c3, ← c4]
    simp only [gsrF5, key, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_assoc]
  
  have g1 : ∀ (W' Q P X Y Z : Fin 3 → ℝ) (c : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      (∀ e : Fin 3, W' e + Q e = ∑ m : Fin 2, c m * D m e + t * P e) →
      gsrF4 RmA W' X Y Z = ∑ m : Fin 2, c m * gsrF4 RmA (D m) X Y Z + t * gsrF4 RmA P X Y Z
        - gsrF4 RmA Q X Y Z := by
    intro W' Q P X Y Z c t h
    have hW : W' = fun e => (∑ m : Fin 2, c m * D m e + t * P e) - Q e :=
      funext fun e => eq_sub_of_add_eq (h e)
    subst hW
    simp only [gsrF4, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have g2 : ∀ (W' Q P X Y Z : Fin 3 → ℝ) (c : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      (∀ e : Fin 3, W' e + Q e = ∑ m : Fin 2, c m * D m e + t * P e) →
      gsrF4 RmA X W' Y Z = ∑ m : Fin 2, c m * gsrF4 RmA X (D m) Y Z + t * gsrF4 RmA X P Y Z
        - gsrF4 RmA X Q Y Z := by
    intro W' Q P X Y Z c t h
    have hW : W' = fun e => (∑ m : Fin 2, c m * D m e + t * P e) - Q e :=
      funext fun e => eq_sub_of_add_eq (h e)
    subst hW
    simp only [gsrF4, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have g3 : ∀ (W' Q P X Y Z : Fin 3 → ℝ) (c : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      (∀ e : Fin 3, W' e + Q e = ∑ m : Fin 2, c m * D m e + t * P e) →
      gsrF4 RmA X Y W' Z = ∑ m : Fin 2, c m * gsrF4 RmA X Y (D m) Z + t * gsrF4 RmA X Y P Z
        - gsrF4 RmA X Y Q Z := by
    intro W' Q P X Y Z c t h
    have hW : W' = fun e => (∑ m : Fin 2, c m * D m e + t * P e) - Q e :=
      funext fun e => eq_sub_of_add_eq (h e)
    subst hW
    simp only [gsrF4, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have g4 : ∀ (W' Q X Y Z : Fin 3 → ℝ) (h : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ e : Fin 3, W' e = -Q e - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, h a b * D a e) →
      gsrF4 RmA X Y Z W' = -gsrF4 RmA X Y Z Q
        - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, h a b * gsrF4 RmA X Y Z (D a) := by
    intro W' Q X Y Z h hW'
    have hW : W' = fun e => -Q e - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, h a b * D a e := funext hW'
    subst hW
    simp only [gsrF4, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  intro l k i j
  have e1 := s1 (D l) (D k) (D i) (D j) ν
  have e2 := g1 (A l k) (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * D l r * D k a) ν
    (D i) (D j) ν (fun m => Γ2 m l k) (II l k) (fun e => hGauss l k e)
  have e3 := g2 (A l i) (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * D l r * D i a) ν
    (D k) (D j) ν (fun m => Γ2 m l i) (II l i) (fun e => hGauss l i e)
  have e4 := g3 (A l j) (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * D l r * D j a) ν
    (D k) (D i) ν (fun m => Γ2 m l j) (II l j) (fun e => hGauss l j e)
  have e5 := g4 (dν l) (fun q => ∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ q r a * D l r * ν a)
    (D k) (D i) (D j) (fun a b => hi a b * II l b) (fun e => hWein l e)
  beta_reduce at e1 e2 e3 e4 e5
  rw [hdT l k i j]
  simp only [hT, gsrDT]
  linear_combination e1 + e2 + e3 + e4 + e5

informal_problem.statement: (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 R)) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (θ : E2) (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • θ)).det) (Set.Ioo (-R) R) ∧ (h 0).det = 1 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < R → 4 * t * (h (t • θ)).det ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h (t • θ) = t * deriv (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • θ)).det) t ^ 2 - 2 * t * (h (t • θ)).det * deriv (deriv (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • θ)).det)) t - 4 * (h (t • θ)).det * deriv (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • θ)).det) t

signature.name: normal_form_ray_jacobi
signature.statement: (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 R)) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (θ : E2) (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • θ)).det) (Set.Ioo (-R) R) ∧ (h 0).det = 1 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < R → 4 * t * (h (t • θ)).det ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h (t • θ) = t * deriv (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • θ)).det) t ^ 2 - 2 * t * (h (t • θ)).det * deriv (deriv (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • θ)).det)) t - 4 * (h (t • θ)).det * deriv (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • θ)).det) t

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hchr : ∀ (h₁ h₂ : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (y : E2), h₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] h₂ →
      ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h₁ k i j y = christoffel2 h₂ k i j y := by
    intro h₁ h₂ y hy k i j
    have hpd : ∀ a b c : Fin 2,
        pd2 c (fun z => h₁ z a b) y = pd2 c (fun z => h₂ z a b) y := by
      intro a b c
      have hev : (fun z => h₁ z a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => h₂ z a b) :=
        hy.mono fun z hz => by simp only [hz]
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [christoffel2, hpd, hy.eq_of_nhds]
  have hloc : ∀ (h₁ h₂ : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x : E2), h₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] h₂ →
      gaussCurv2 h₁ x = gaussCurv2 h₂ x := by
    intro h₁ h₂ x hx
    have hev : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h₁ k i j =ᶠ[𝓝 x] christoffel2 h₂ k i j :=
      fun k i j => hx.eventuallyEq_nhds.mono fun y hy => hchr h₁ h₂ y hy k i j
    have hpdc : ∀ c k i j : Fin 2,
        pd2 c (christoffel2 h₁ k i j) x = pd2 c (christoffel2 h₂ k i j) x := by
      intro c k i j
      unfold pd2
      rw [(hev k i j).fderiv_eq]
    have hric : ∀ j k : Fin 2, ricci2 h₁ j k x = ricci2 h₂ j k x := by
      intro j k
      simp only [ricci2, hpdc, hchr h₁ h₂ x hx]
    simp only [gaussCurv2, hric, hx.eq_of_nhds]
  
  obtain ⟨hs, hs_def⟩ : ∃ hs : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ,
      ∀ x i j, hs x i j = (h x i j + h x j i) / 2 :=
    ⟨fun x => Matrix.of fun i j => (h x i j + h x j i) / 2, fun x i j => rfl⟩
  have hsym : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), hs x i j = hs x j i := by
    intro x i j
    rw [hs_def, hs_def, add_comm]
  have hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => hs x i j) (Metric.ball 0 R) := by
    intro i j
    simp only [hs_def]
    exact ((hh i j).add (hh j i)).div_const 2
  have hagree : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, hs x = h x := by
    intro x hx
    ext i j
    rw [hs_def]
    have e := (hnf x hx).1.isHermitian.apply i j
    rw [star_trivial] at e
    rw [e]
    ring
  have hnf' : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R,
      (hs x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, hs x i j * x j = x i := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hagree x hx]
    exact hnf x hx
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ τ : ℝ, q τ = hs (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1 ^ 2 -
      2 * hs (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 * θ 1 + hs (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 ^ 2 := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hq0, hqdet, hqC, hode⟩ := normal_ray_jacobi R hs hR hsmooth hsym hnf' θ hθ q hq
  have hmem : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-R) R, τ • θ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R := by
    intro τ hτ
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_smul, hθ, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact abs_lt.mpr hτ
  have hDq : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-R) R, (h (τ • θ)).det = q τ := by
    intro τ hτ
    rw [← hagree _ (hmem τ hτ), hqdet τ (abs_lt.mpr hτ)]
  refine ⟨hqC.congr (fun τ hτ => hDq τ hτ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have e := hDq 0 ⟨by linarith, hR⟩
    rw [zero_smul] at e
    rw [e, hq0]
  · intro t ht htR
    have htI : t ∈ Set.Ioo (-R) R := ⟨by linarith, htR⟩
    have hEv : (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • θ)).det) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] q :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds htI) hDq
    have e1 : deriv (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • θ)).det) t = deriv q t := hEv.deriv_eq
    have e2 : deriv (deriv (fun τ : ℝ => (h (τ • θ)).det)) t = deriv (deriv q) t :=
      hEv.deriv.deriv_eq
    have e0 : (h (t • θ)).det = q t := hDq t htI
    have e3 : gaussCurv2 h (t • θ) = gaussCurv2 hs (t • θ) :=
      hloc h hs _ (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hmem t htI))
        (fun x hx => (hagree x hx).symm))
    rw [e1, e2, e0, e3]
    exact hode t ht htR

subgoal_signatures.name: normal_ray_jacobi
subgoal_signatures.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hsymm : ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), h x i j = h x j i) (hnf : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (h x).PosDef ∧ ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * x j = x i) (θ : E2) (hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1) (q : ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ∀ τ : ℝ, q τ = h (τ • θ) 0 0 * θ 1 ^ 2 - 2 * h (τ • θ) 0 1 * θ 0 * θ 1 + h (τ • θ) 1 1 * θ 0 ^ 2) : q 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| < ρ → q τ = (h (τ • θ)).det) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q (Set.Ioo (-ρ) ρ) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < ρ → 4 * t * q t ^ 2 * gaussCurv2 h (t • θ) = t * deriv q t ^ 2 - 2 * t * q t * deriv (deriv q) t - 4 * q t * deriv q t

informal_problem.statement: (μ ε : ℝ) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (q k : ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 q (Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ))) (hq0 : q 0 = 1) (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ), 0 < q τ) (hode : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 / μ → 4 * t * q t ^ 2 * k t = t * deriv q t ^ 2 - 2 * t * q t * deriv (deriv q) t - 4 * q t * deriv q t) (hk : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 / μ → -(μ ^ 2) ≤ k t ∧ k t ≤ ε * μ ^ 2) : (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s < 1 / μ → Real.sqrt (q s) ≤ 2) ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < 1 / μ → -(2 / 3) * ε * μ ^ 2 * s ≤ deriv (fun τ : ℝ => Real.sqrt (q τ)) s

signature.name: jacobi_q_radial_bounds
signature.statement: (μ ε : ℝ) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (q k : ℝ → ℝ) (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 q (Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ))) (hq0 : q 0 = 1) (hpos : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ), 0 < q τ) (hode : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 / μ → 4 * t * q t ^ 2 * k t = t * deriv q t ^ 2 - 2 * t * q t * deriv (deriv q) t - 4 * q t * deriv q t) (hk : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 / μ → -(μ ^ 2) ≤ k t ∧ k t ≤ ε * μ ^ 2) : (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s < 1 / μ → Real.sqrt (q s) ≤ 2) ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < 1 / μ → -(2 / 3) * ε * μ ^ 2 * s ≤ deriv (fun τ : ℝ => Real.sqrt (q τ)) s

proof.tactics:
by
  have hμinv : 0 < 1 / μ := by positivity
  have hIo : IsOpen (Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ)) := isOpen_Ioo
  have hmemI : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t < 1 / μ → t ∈ Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ) :=
    fun t h0 h1 => ⟨by linarith, h1⟩
  have hdq : DifferentiableOn ℝ q (Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ)) := hq.differentiableOn (by norm_num)
  have hq1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (deriv q) (Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ)) :=
    hq.deriv_of_isOpen hIo (by norm_num)
  have hddq : DifferentiableOn ℝ (deriv q) (Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ)) :=
    hq1.differentiableOn (by norm_num)
  have hcdq : ContinuousOn (deriv q) (Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ)) := hq1.continuousOn
  have hqd : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ), HasDerivAt q (deriv q τ) τ :=
    fun τ hτ => ((hdq τ hτ).differentiableAt (hIo.mem_nhds hτ)).hasDerivAt
  have hq'd : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ), HasDerivAt (deriv q) (deriv (deriv q) τ) τ :=
    fun τ hτ => ((hddq τ hτ).differentiableAt (hIo.mem_nhds hτ)).hasDerivAt
  have hS : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ), 0 < Real.sqrt (q τ) :=
    fun τ hτ => Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hpos τ hτ)
  have hud : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ),
      HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (q x)) (deriv q τ / (2 * Real.sqrt (q τ))) τ :=
    fun τ hτ => (hqd τ hτ).sqrt (hpos τ hτ).ne'
  have huc : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (q x)) (Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ)) :=
    fun τ hτ => (hud τ hτ).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hPc : ContinuousOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 * (deriv q x / (2 * Real.sqrt (q x))))
      (Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ)) := by
    refine (continuousOn_pow 2).mul (hcdq.div (continuousOn_const.mul huc) ?_)
    intro x hx
    exact mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero (hS x hx).ne'
  
  have hPd : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < 1 / μ →
      HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 * (deriv q x / (2 * Real.sqrt (q x))))
        (-(k t) * t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) t := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    have htI := hmemI t ht0.le ht1
    have hSt := hS t htI
    have hne : (2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hSt.ne'
    have hp2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (2 * t) t := by simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 2 t
    have h1 := hp2.mul ((hq'd t htI).div ((hud t htI).const_mul 2) hne)
    refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
    have hS2 : Real.sqrt (q t) ^ 2 = q t := Real.sq_sqrt (hpos t htI).le
    have hode' := hode t ht0 ht1
    rw [← hS2] at hode'
    simp only [Pi.div_apply]
    generalize Real.sqrt (q t) = S at hSt hode' ⊢
    generalize deriv q t = A at hode' ⊢
    generalize deriv (deriv q) t = A' at hode' ⊢
    have hS0 : S ≠ 0 := hSt.ne'
    linear_combination (norm := skip) (t / (4 * S ^ 3)) * hode'
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hA : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s < 1 / μ → Real.sqrt (q s) ≤ 6 / 5 := by
    intro s hs0 hs1
    have hKI : Set.Icc 0 s ⊆ Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ) :=
      fun t ht => hmemI t ht.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt ht.2 hs1)
    have hint : ∀ t ∈ interior (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) s), 0 < t ∧ t < 1 / μ := by
      intro t ht
      rw [interior_Icc] at ht
      exact ⟨ht.1, lt_trans ht.2 hs1⟩
    have h0K : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 s := Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr hs0
    obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀K, ht₀max⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn ⟨0, h0K⟩ (huc.mono hKI)
    have hmax : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 s, Real.sqrt (q t) ≤ Real.sqrt (q t₀) := fun t ht => ht₀max ht
    have hu0 : Real.sqrt (q 0) = 1 := by rw [hq0, Real.sqrt_one]
    have hM1 : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (q t₀) := by
      have := hmax 0 h0K
      rw [hu0] at this
      exact this
    have hstepA : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc 0 s, t ^ 2 * (deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t))) ≤
        μ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t₀) / 3 * t ^ 3 := by
      have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 * (deriv q x / (2 * Real.sqrt (q x))) -
          μ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t₀) / 3 * x ^ 3) (Set.Icc 0 s) := by
        refine antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Icc 0 s)
          ((hPc.mono hKI).sub (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow 3)).continuousOn)
          (f' := fun t => -(k t) * t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t) -
            μ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t₀) / 3 * (3 * t ^ 2)) ?_ ?_
        · intro t ht
          obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := hint t ht
          have hp3 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3) (3 * t ^ 2) t := by
            simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 3 t
          exact ((hPd t ht0 ht1).sub (hp3.const_mul _)).hasDerivWithinAt
        · intro t ht
          obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := hint t ht
          have htK : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 s := interior_subset ht
          have hkt := (hk t ht0 ht1).1
          have hu := hmax t htK
          have hX : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t) := by positivity
          have e1 : -(k t) * (t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) ≤ μ ^ 2 * (t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hX
          have e2 : μ ^ 2 * t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t) ≤ μ ^ 2 * t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t₀) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu (by positivity)
          simp only
          nlinarith
      have hf0 : (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 * (deriv q x / (2 * Real.sqrt (q x))) -
          μ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t₀) / 3 * x ^ 3) 0 = 0 := by simp
      intro t ht
      have := hanti h0K ht ht.1
      rw [hf0] at this
      simp only at this
      linarith
    have hstepB : Real.sqrt (q t₀) - μ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t₀) / 6 * t₀ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (q x) -
          μ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t₀) / 6 * x ^ 2) (Set.Icc 0 s) := by
        refine antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (convex_Icc 0 s)
          ((huc.mono hKI).sub (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow 2)).continuousOn)
          (f' := fun t => deriv q t / (2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) -
            μ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t₀) / 6 * (2 * t)) ?_ ?_
        · intro t ht
          obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := hint t ht
          have hp2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (2 * t) t := by
            simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 2 t
          exact ((hud t (hmemI t ht0.le ht1)).sub (hp2.const_mul _)).hasDerivWithinAt
        · intro t ht
          obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := hint t ht
          have htK : t ∈ Set.Icc 0 s := interior_subset ht
          have h1 := hstepA t htK
          simp only
          have ht2 : 0 < t ^ 2 := by positivity
          by_contra hcon
          push_neg at hcon
          have := mul_pos ht2 hcon
          nlinarith
      have hf0 : (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (q x) - μ ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t₀) / 6 * x ^ 2) 0 = 1 := by
        simp [hq0]
      have := hanti h0K ht₀K ht₀K.1
      rw [hf0] at this
      simpa using this
    have hμt : μ * t₀ < 1 := by
      have h := lt_of_le_of_lt ht₀K.2 hs1
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ hμ] at h
      linarith
    have hμt0 : 0 ≤ μ * t₀ := mul_nonneg hμ.le ht₀K.1
    have hsq : μ ^ 2 * t₀ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have hfin : Real.sqrt (q t₀) ≤ 6 / 5 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hsq) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (q t₀))]
    exact le_trans (hmax s (Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr hs0)) hfin
  refine ⟨fun s hs0 hs1 => le_trans (hA s hs0 hs1) (by norm_num), ?_⟩
  
  intro s hs0 hs1
  have hKI : Set.Icc 0 s ⊆ Set.Ioo (-(1 / μ)) (1 / μ) :=
    fun t ht => hmemI t ht.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt ht.2 hs1)
  have hint : ∀ t ∈ interior (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) s), 0 < t ∧ t < 1 / μ := by
    intro t ht
    rw [interior_Icc] at ht
    exact ⟨ht.1, lt_trans ht.2 hs1⟩
  have h0K : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 s := Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr hs0.le
  have hmono : MonotoneOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 * (deriv q x / (2 * Real.sqrt (q x))) +
      2 / 3 * ε * μ ^ 2 * x ^ 3) (Set.Icc 0 s) := by
    refine monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 s)
      ((hPc.mono hKI).add (continuous_const.mul (continuous_pow 3)).continuousOn)
      (f' := fun t => -(k t) * t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t) + 2 / 3 * ε * μ ^ 2 * (3 * t ^ 2)) ?_ ?_
    · intro t ht
      obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := hint t ht
      have hp3 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 3) (3 * t ^ 2) t := by
        simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 3 t
      exact ((hPd t ht0 ht1).add (hp3.const_mul _)).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := hint t ht
      have hkt := (hk t ht0 ht1).2
      have hu2 : Real.sqrt (q t) ≤ 2 := le_trans (hA t ht0.le ht1) (by norm_num)
      have hX0 : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t) := by positivity
      have hX2 : t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t) ≤ t ^ 2 * 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu2 (sq_nonneg t)
      have hεμ : 0 ≤ ε * μ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have e1 : -(ε * μ ^ 2) * (t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) ≤ -(k t) * (t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hX0
      have e2 : ε * μ ^ 2 * (t ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (q t)) ≤ ε * μ ^ 2 * (t ^ 2 * 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX2 hεμ
      simp only
      nlinarith
  have hf0 : (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2 * (deriv q x / (2 * Real.sqrt (q x))) +
      2 / 3 * ε * μ ^ 2 * x ^ 3) 0 = 0 := by simp
  have hsK : s ∈ Set.Icc 0 s := Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr hs0.le
  have h1 := hmono h0K hsK hs0.le
  rw [hf0] at h1
  simp only at h1
  rw [(hud s (hmemI s hs0.le hs1)).deriv]
  have hs2 : 0 < s ^ 2 := by positivity
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have := mul_pos hs2 (sub_pos.mpr hcon)
  nlinarith

informal_problem.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall 0 ρ)) : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, f x) = (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * s) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * s) (Set.Icc 0 ρ)

signature.name: integral_ball_polar_rad
signature.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall 0 ρ)) : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, f x) = (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * s) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * s) (Set.Icc 0 ρ)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hθn : ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖(Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 : E2)‖ = 1 := by
    intro φ
    have h0 : (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 : E2) 0 = Real.cos φ := by
      simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have h1 : (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 : E2) 1 = Real.sin φ := by
      simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, h0, h1, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      sq_abs, sq_abs, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, Real.sqrt_one]
  have hsn : ∀ s φ : ℝ, ‖s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1 : E2)‖ = |s| := by
    intro s φ
    rw [norm_smul, hθn, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hpi : -Real.pi ≤ Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
      f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * s) (Set.Icc 0 ρ) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => max 0 (min s ρ)) :=
      continuous_const.max (continuous_id.min continuous_const)
    have hc0 : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ max 0 (min s ρ) := fun s => le_max_left _ _
    have hcρ : ∀ s : ℝ, max 0 (min s ρ) ≤ ρ := fun s => max_le hρ.le (min_le_right _ _)
    have hQ : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        max 0 (min p.1 ρ) • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) :=
      (hc.comp continuous_fst).smul (by fun_prop)
    have hQmem : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ,
        max 0 (min p.1 ρ) • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1) ∈
          Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) ρ := by
      intro p
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, hsn, abs_of_nonneg (hc0 _)]
      exact hcρ _
    have hG : Continuous (Function.uncurry (fun (s φ : ℝ) =>
        f (max 0 (min s ρ) • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * max 0 (min s ρ))) :=
      (hf.comp_continuous hQ hQmem).mul (hc.comp continuous_fst)
    have hP := intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hG (-Real.pi) Real.pi
    refine hP.continuousOn.congr ?_
    intro s hs
    have hcs : max 0 (min s ρ) = s := by
      rw [min_eq_left hs.2, max_eq_right hs.1]
    simp only [hcs]
  refine ⟨?_, hcont⟩
  
  have hΦ : MeasurePreserving
      ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow :
        E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ) volume volume :=
    (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 2)).trans
      (MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ)
  have hΦsymm : ∀ a b : ℝ,
      ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow :
        E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ).symm (a, b) = a • e2 0 + b • e2 1 := by
    intro a b
    have h : ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow :
        E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ) (a • e2 0 + b • e2 1) = (a, b) := by
      simp [MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow_apply, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [← h, MeasurableEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hpolar : ∀ g : E2 → ℝ, ∫ x, g x = ∫ p in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi,
      p.1 * g (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) := by
    intro g
    have h1 : ∫ x, g x = ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, g
        (((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow :
          E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ).symm p) := by
      rw [← hΦ.integral_comp' (fun p => g
        (((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow :
          E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ).symm p))]
      simp only [MeasurableEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [h1, ← integral_comp_polarCoord_symm, polarCoord_target]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun (measurableSet_Ioi.prod measurableSet_Ioo) ?_
    intro p _
    simp only [polarCoord_symm_apply, hΦsymm, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [smul_add, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ,
      F p = f (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) * p.1 := ⟨_, fun p => rfl⟩
  have hFc : ContinuousOn F (Set.Icc 0 ρ ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) := by
    have hFeq : F = fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        f (p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) * p.1 := funext hF
    have hP : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1)) := by fun_prop
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        p.1 • (Real.cos p.2 • e2 0 + Real.sin p.2 • e2 1))
        (Set.Icc 0 ρ ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) (Metric.closedBall 0 ρ) := by
      intro p hp
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, hsn, abs_of_nonneg hp.1.1]
      exact hp.1.2
    rw [hFeq]
    exact (hf.comp hP.continuousOn hmaps).mul continuous_fst.continuousOn
  have hint : IntegrableOn F (Set.Icc 0 ρ ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) :=
    hFc.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
  have hμ : (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)).restrict (Set.Ioo 0 ρ ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi) =
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Ioo 0 ρ)).prod
        ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi)) := by
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, Measure.prod_restrict]
  have hint' : Integrable F (((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Ioo 0 ρ)).prod
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi))) := by
    rw [← hμ]
    exact hint.mono_set (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
  have hinner : ∀ s : ℝ, ∫ φ in Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi, F (s, φ) =
      ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * s := by
    intro s
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hpi, integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo]
    simp only [hF]
