proof.tactics:
by
  have hU : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) R) := Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hpd : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, (h x).PosDef := fun x hx => (hnf x hx).1
  have h1inf : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  
  have hdetC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x).det) (Metric.ball 0 R) := by
    have e : (fun x => (h x).det) = fun x => h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 := by
      funext x; exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
    rw [e]
    exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have hdetne : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, (h x).det ≠ 0 :=
    fun x hx => (hpd x hx).det_pos.ne'
  have hsqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) (Metric.ball 0 R) :=
    hdetC.sqrt hdetne
  have hinvC : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ i j) (Metric.ball 0 R) := by
    intro i j
    have e : (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ i j) = fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹ * (h x).adjugate i j := by
      funext x
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
      rfl
    rw [e]
    refine (hdetC.inv hdetne).mul ?_
    have hadj : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x).adjugate a b) (Metric.ball 0 R) := by
      intro a b
      simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp
      · exact hh 1 1
      · exact (hh 0 1).neg
      · exact (hh 1 0).neg
      · exact hh 0 0
    exact hadj i j
  have hpdw : ∀ j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (pd2 j w) (Metric.ball 0 R) := by
    intro j
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y) (Metric.ball 0 R) :=
      hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by norm_num)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  set V : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ := fun i z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ i j * pd2 j w z
    with hVdef
  have hV : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (V i) (Metric.ball 0 R) := by
    intro i
    refine (hsqC.of_le h1inf).mul ?_
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => ((hinvC i j).of_le h1inf).mul (hpdw j))
  have hdiv : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R,
      pd2 0 (V 0) x + pd2 1 (V 1) x = Real.sqrt (h x).det * lap2 h w x :=
    fun x hx => lap2_divergence_form (Metric.ball 0 R) hU h w hh hpd hw x hx
  
  have hfix : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.PosDef → ∀ v : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      (∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A i j * v j = v i) → ∀ j : Fin 2, ∑ i : Fin 2, v i * A⁻¹ i j = v j := by
    intro A hA v hv j
    have hsymm : ∀ i k : Fin 2, A i k = A k i := by
      intro i k
      have := hA.isHermitian.apply k i
      simpa using this
    have h1 : Matrix.vecMul v A = v := by
      funext k
      simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct]
      rw [← hv k]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [hsymm i k, mul_comm]
    have hdet : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA.det_pos.ne'
    have h2 : Matrix.vecMul v A⁻¹ = v := by
      calc Matrix.vecMul v A⁻¹ = Matrix.vecMul (Matrix.vecMul v A) A⁻¹ := by rw [h1]
        _ = Matrix.vecMul v (A * A⁻¹) := Matrix.vecMul_vecMul _ _ _
        _ = v := by rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hdet, Matrix.vecMul_one]
    have := congrFun h2 j
    simpa [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct] using this
  
  have hpdC : ∀ i k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 k (V i) x) (Metric.ball 0 R) := by
    intro i k
    exact ((hV i).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  refine ⟨((hpdC 0 0).add (hpdC 1 1)).congr (fun x hx => (hdiv x hx).symm), ?_⟩
  
  intro t ht htR
  have hsub : Metric.ball (0 : E2) t ⊆ Metric.ball 0 R := Metric.ball_subset_ball htR.le
  rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_ball
    (fun x hx => (hdiv x (hsub hx)).symm)]
  rw [divergence_disc_polar R t ht htR (V 0) (V 1) (hV 0) (hV 1)]
  refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun φ _ => ?_)
  have hnorm : ‖Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1‖ = 1 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hx : t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R := by
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_smul, hnorm, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht]
    exact htR
  have hc0 : (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) 0 = t * Real.cos φ := by
    simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hc1 : (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) 1 = t * Real.sin φ := by
    simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hE := hfix _ (hnf _ hx).1 (fun i => (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) i)
    (hnf _ hx).2
  have hE0 := hE 0
  have hE1 := hE 1
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hc0, hc1] at hE0 hE1
  have hD : fderiv ℝ w (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
      (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) =
      Real.cos φ * pd2 0 w (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) +
        Real.sin φ * pd2 1 w (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) := by
    simp only [pd2, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hD]
  simp only [hVdef, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  linear_combination
    (Real.sqrt (h (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det *
      pd2 0 w (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) * hE0 +
    (Real.sqrt (h (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))).det *
      pd2 1 w (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) * hE1

        refine (hasDerivWithinAt_const (0:ℝ) (Set.Iic 0) (0:ℝ)).congr ?_ ?_
        · intro x hx
          rw [max_eq_right (Set.mem_Iic.mp hx)]; norm_num
        · norm_num
      have h2 : HasDerivWithinAt (fun s : ℝ => (max s 0) ^ 2) 0 (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by
        have h : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s ^ 2) 0 0 := by
          simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 2 (0:ℝ)
        refine h.hasDerivWithinAt.congr ?_ ?_
        · intro x hx
          rw [max_eq_left (Set.mem_Ici.mp hx)]
        · simp
      have h3 := h1.union h2
      rw [Set.Iic_union_Ici, hasDerivWithinAt_univ] at h3
      convert h3 using 1
      simp
    · have hev : (fun s : ℝ => (max s 0) ^ 2) =ᶠ[nhds t] (fun s => s ^ 2) := by
        filter_upwards [eventually_gt_nhds ht] with s hs
        rw [max_eq_left hs.le]
      rw [max_eq_left ht.le]
      have h : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s ^ 2) (2 * t) t := by
        simpa using hasDerivAt_pow 2 t
      exact h.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ → ℝ, S = fun t => 1 - 2 * (max t 0) ^ 2
      + 4 * (max (t - 1/2) 0) ^ 2 - 2 * (max (t - 1) 0) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ → ℝ, D = fun t => -4 * max t 0 + 8 * max (t - 1/2) 0
      - 4 * max (t - 1) 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hS : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt S (D t) t := by
    intro t
    have h0 := hq t
    have h1 := (hq (t - 1/2)).comp_sub_const t (1/2)
    have h2 := (hq (t - 1)).comp_sub_const t 1
    have h := (((h0.const_mul 2).const_sub 1).add (h1.const_mul 4)).sub (h2.const_mul 2)
    rw [hSdef, hDdef]
    convert h using 1
    ring
  have hderiv : deriv S = D := funext fun t => (hS t).deriv
  
  have hb : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ S t ∧ S t ≤ 1 ∧ D t ^ 2 ≤ 9 * S t := by
    intro t
    simp only [hSdef, hDdef]
    rcases le_or_gt t 0 with h1 | h1
    · rw [max_eq_right h1, max_eq_right (by linarith : t - 1/2 ≤ 0),
        max_eq_right (by linarith : t - 1 ≤ 0)]
      norm_num
    rcases le_or_gt t (1/2) with h2 | h2
    · rw [max_eq_left h1.le, max_eq_right (by linarith : t - 1/2 ≤ 0),
        max_eq_right (by linarith : t - 1 ≤ 0)]
      have ht2 : t ^ 2 ≤ 1/4 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1.le (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/2 - t)]
      refine ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith [sq_nonneg t], by nlinarith⟩
    rcases le_or_gt t 1 with h3 | h3
    · rw [max_eq_left h1.le, max_eq_left (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ t - 1/2),
        max_eq_right (by linarith : t - 1 ≤ 0)]
      have hw : (1 - t) ^ 2 ≤ 1/4 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 h3) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ t - 1/2)]
      refine ⟨by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - t)], by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - t)],
        by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - t)]⟩
    · rw [max_eq_left h1.le, max_eq_left (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ t - 1/2),
        max_eq_left (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ t - 1)]
      refine ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
  refine ⟨S, ?_, ?_, ?_, fun t => ⟨(hb t).1, (hb t).2.1⟩, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [contDiff_one_iff_deriv]
    refine ⟨fun t => (hS t).differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    rw [hderiv, hDdef]
    exact ((continuous_const.mul (continuous_id.max continuous_const)).add
      (continuous_const.mul ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).max continuous_const))).sub
      (continuous_const.mul ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).max continuous_const))
  · 
    intro t ht
    simp only [hSdef]
    rw [max_eq_right ht, max_eq_right (by linarith : t - 1/2 ≤ 0),
      max_eq_right (by linarith : t - 1 ≤ 0)]
    norm_num
  · 
    intro t ht
    simp only [hSdef]
    rw [max_eq_left (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ t), max_eq_left (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ t - 1/2),
      max_eq_left (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ t - 1)]
    ring
  · intro t
    rw [hderiv]
    exact (hb t).2.2

informal_problem.statement: (N : ℕ) (r₁ : ℝ) (S : ℝ → ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) (hS : ContDiff ℝ 1 S) (hS0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → S t = 1) (hS1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → S t = 0) (hSb : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ S t ∧ S t ≤ 1) (hS' : ∀ t : ℝ, deriv S t ^ 2 ≤ 9 * S t) : ∃ Ψ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ Ψ x ∧ Ψ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x : E2, ‖x‖ ≤ r₁ → Ψ x = 1) ∧ (∀ x : E2, 2 ^ N * r₁ ≤ ‖x‖ → Ψ x = 0) ∧ ∀ x : E2, ∃ c : ℝ, (∀ i : Fin 2, pd2 i Ψ x = c * x i) ∧ (N * Real.log 2) ^ 2 * c ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 4 ≤ 9 * Ψ x ∧ (‖x‖ < r₁ → c = 0)

signature.name: log_step_weight
signature.statement: (N : ℕ) (r₁ : ℝ) (S : ℝ → ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) (hS : ContDiff ℝ 1 S) (hS0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → S t = 1) (hS1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → S t = 0) (hSb : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ S t ∧ S t ≤ 1) (hS' : ∀ t : ℝ, deriv S t ^ 2 ≤ 9 * S t) : ∃ Ψ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ Ψ x ∧ Ψ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x : E2, ‖x‖ ≤ r₁ → Ψ x = 1) ∧ (∀ x : E2, 2 ^ N * r₁ ≤ ‖x‖ → Ψ x = 0) ∧ ∀ x : E2, ∃ c : ℝ, (∀ i : Fin 2, pd2 i Ψ x = c * x i) ∧ (N * Real.log 2) ^ 2 * c ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 4 ≤ 9 * Ψ x ∧ (‖x‖ < r₁ → c = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hNr : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hl2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
  have hΛ : 0 < (N : ℝ) * Real.log 2 := by positivity
  have h2Λ : 0 < 2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by positivity
  have hr2 : 0 < r₁ ^ 2 := by positivity
  
  have hT1 : ∀ x : E2, ‖x‖ ≤ r₁ →
      Real.log (‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) ≤ 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ r₁ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg x) hx 2
    have h2 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hr2).mpr h1
    have h3 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2 := by positivity
    exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (Real.log_nonpos h3 h2) h2Λ.le
  have hT2 : ∀ x : E2, 2 ^ N * r₁ ≤ ‖x‖ →
      1 ≤ Real.log (‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2)) := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : (2 ^ N * r₁) ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hx 2
    have h2 : ((2 : ℝ) ^ N) ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hr2]
      rw [mul_pow] at h1
      exact h1
    have h3 := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) h2
    have h4 : Real.log (((2 : ℝ) ^ N) ^ 2) = 2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2) := by
      rw [Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h4] at h3
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h2Λ, one_mul]
    exact h3
  
  have hloc : ∀ x : E2, ‖x‖ < r₁ →
      (fun y : E2 => S (Real.log (‖y‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2))))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    have hmem : Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁ ∈ 𝓝 x :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hx)
    exact Filter.eventually_of_mem hmem
      (fun y hy => hS0 _ (hT1 y (le_of_lt (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hy))))
  
  have hcd : ∀ x : E2, x ≠ 0 → ContDiffAt ℝ 1
      (fun y : E2 => S (Real.log (‖y‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2)))) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hne : ‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
      div_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx)) hr2.ne'
    have C1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y : E2 => ‖y‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) x :=
      ((contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).contDiffAt).div_const _
    have C2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 Real.log (‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) := Real.contDiffAt_log.mpr hne
    have C3 := (C2.comp x C1).div_const (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2))
    exact hS.contDiffAt.comp x C3
  
  have hpd : ∀ x : E2, x ≠ 0 → ∀ i : Fin 2,
      pd2 i (fun y : E2 => S (Real.log (‖y‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2)))) x =
        deriv S (Real.log (‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2))) /
          (((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) * x i := by
    intro x hx i
    have hxn : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx
    have ht0 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hxn
    have hne : ‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero ht0 hr2.ne'
    have D1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t / r₁ ^ 2) (1 / r₁ ^ 2) (‖x‖ ^ 2) :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' _).div_const _
    have D2 := (D1.log hne).div_const (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2))
    have D4 := ((hS.differentiable one_ne_zero)
      (Real.log (‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2)))).hasDerivAt.comp (‖x‖ ^ 2) D2
    have D5 := (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq x).hasFDerivAt
    have D6 := D4.comp_hasFDerivAt x D5
    have D7 : fderiv ℝ
        (fun y : E2 => S (Real.log (‖y‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2)))) x = _ :=
      D6.fderiv
    unfold pd2
    rw [D7]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, e2,
      EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    simp
    field_simp
  refine ⟨fun y : E2 => S (Real.log (‖y‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2))),
    ?_, fun x => hSb _, fun x hx => hS0 _ (hT1 x hx), fun x hx => hS1 _ (hT2 x hx), ?_⟩
  · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases h : ‖x‖ < r₁
    · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hloc x h)
    · have hx : x ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hr₁ (not_lt.mp h))
      exact hcd x hx
  · intro x
    by_cases h : ‖x‖ < r₁
    · refine ⟨0, fun i => ?_, ?_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      · unfold pd2
        rw [(hloc x h).fderiv_eq]
        simp
      · have := (hSb (Real.log (‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2)))).1
        simp only [ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, mul_zero, zero_mul]
        linarith
    · have hx : x ≠ 0 := norm_pos_iff.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hr₁ (not_lt.mp h))
      have hxn : ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx
      refine ⟨deriv S (Real.log (‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2))) /
          (((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2), hpd x hx, ?_, fun h' => absurd h' h⟩
      have key : ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ^ 2 *
          (deriv S (Real.log (‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2))) /
            (((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 4 =
          deriv S (Real.log (‖x‖ ^ 2 / r₁ ^ 2) / (2 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2))) ^ 2 := by
        field_simp
      rw [key]
      exact hS' _

informal_problem.statement: (N : ℕ) (r₁ ρ : ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) (hρ : 2 ^ N * r₁ < ρ) (hu : ContinuousOn u (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (harea : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 2 ^ N * r₁ → ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, u x ≤ 4 * Real.pi * r ^ 2) : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, 9 / (4 * (N * Real.log 2) ^ 2 * (4 ^ k * r₁ ^ 2)) * (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (2 ^ (k + 1) * r₁)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) * u x ≤ 36 * Real.pi / (N * Real.log 2 ^ 2)

signature.name: log_step_theta_integral
signature.statement: (N : ℕ) (r₁ ρ : ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) (hρ : 2 ^ N * r₁ < ρ) (hu : ContinuousOn u (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (harea : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 2 ^ N * r₁ → ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r, u x ≤ 4 * Real.pi * r ^ 2) : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, 9 / (4 * (N * Real.log 2) ^ 2 * (4 ^ k * r₁ ^ 2)) * (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (2 ^ (k + 1) * r₁)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) * u x ≤ 36 * Real.pi / (N * Real.log 2 ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hNr : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hN0 : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hL2 : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos one_lt_two
  have hL0 : Real.log 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hL2
  have hrk : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range N,
      (0 : ℝ) < 2 ^ (k + 1) * r₁ ∧ (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * r₁ ≤ 2 ^ N * r₁ := by
    intro k hk
    have hk' : k + 1 ≤ N := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
    have hpow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) ≤ 2 ^ N := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hk'
    exact ⟨by positivity, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow hr₁.le⟩
  have hball : ∀ R : ℝ, R < ρ →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x => (Metric.ball (0 : E2) R).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x * u x)
        (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) ∧
      ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ,
          (Metric.ball (0 : E2) R).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x * u x
        = ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, u x := by
    intro R hR
    have hfun : (fun x => (Metric.ball (0 : E2) R).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x * u x) =
        (Metric.ball (0 : E2) R).indicator u := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
    rw [hfun]
    have hint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn u (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) R) :=
      ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall 0 R)
        (hu.mono (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hR))
    have hint2 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (0 : E2) R) :=
      hint.mono_set Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    refine ⟨(hint2.integrable_indicator measurableSet_ball).integrableOn, ?_⟩
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_ball,
      Set.inter_eq_right.mpr (Metric.ball_subset_ball hR.le)]
  have hrw : (fun x => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, 9 / (4 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ^ 2 * (4 ^ k * r₁ ^ 2)) *
        (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (2 ^ (k + 1) * r₁)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) * u x) =
      fun x => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, 9 / (4 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ^ 2 * (4 ^ k * r₁ ^ 2)) *
        ((Metric.ball (0 : E2) (2 ^ (k + 1) * r₁)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x * u x) := by
    funext x
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => mul_assoc _ _ _)
  rw [hrw, MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum]
  · calc ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ,
          9 / (4 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ^ 2 * (4 ^ k * r₁ ^ 2)) *
            ((Metric.ball (0 : E2) (2 ^ (k + 1) * r₁)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x * u x)
        ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, 9 / (4 * ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ^ 2 * (4 ^ k * r₁ ^ 2)) *
            (4 * Real.pi * (2 ^ (k + 1) * r₁) ^ 2) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k hk => ?_)
          obtain ⟨h0, hle⟩ := hrk k hk
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, (hball _ (lt_of_le_of_lt hle hρ)).2]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (harea _ h0 hle) (by positivity)
      _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, 36 * Real.pi / ((N : ℝ) * Real.log 2) ^ 2 := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
          have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ^ k = (2 ^ k) ^ 2 := by
            rw [sq, ← mul_pow]; norm_num
          have e : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * r₁) ^ 2 = 4 * (4 ^ k * r₁ ^ 2) := by
            rw [h4]; ring
          have hk0 : (4 : ℝ) ^ k * r₁ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
          rw [e]
          field_simp
          ring
      _ = 36 * Real.pi / (N * Real.log 2 ^ 2) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
  · intro k hk
    exact MeasureTheory.Integrable.const_mul (hball _ (lt_of_le_of_lt (hrk k hk).2 hρ)).1 _

informal_problem.statement: (r₁ R ρ ε : ℝ) (Ψ u a b : E2 → ℝ) (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) (hr₁R : r₁ ≤ R) (hRρ : R < ρ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hΨ : Continuous Ψ) (hΨb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Ψ x ∧ Ψ x ≤ 1) (hΨ1 : ∀ x : E2, ‖x‖ ≤ r₁ → Ψ x = 1) (hΨ0 : ∀ x : E2, R ≤ ‖x‖ → Ψ x = 0) (hu : ContinuousOn u (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ u x) (ha : ContinuousOn a (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hb : ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hpt : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, 0 ≤ a x ∧ -ε ≤ b x) (hA : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, u x ≤ 4 * Real.pi * R ^ 2) : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁, a x * u x) - 4 * Real.pi * ε * R ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (a x + b x) * Ψ x * u x

signature.name: log_step_lower
signature.statement: (r₁ R ρ ε : ℝ) (Ψ u a b : E2 → ℝ) (hr₁ : 0 < r₁) (hr₁R : r₁ ≤ R) (hRρ : R < ρ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hΨ : Continuous Ψ) (hΨb : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Ψ x ∧ Ψ x ≤ 1) (hΨ1 : ∀ x : E2, ‖x‖ ≤ r₁ → Ψ x = 1) (hΨ0 : ∀ x : E2, R ≤ ‖x‖ → Ψ x = 0) (hu : ContinuousOn u (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ u x) (ha : ContinuousOn a (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hb : ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball 0 ρ)) (hpt : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, 0 ≤ a x ∧ -ε ≤ b x) (hA : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, u x ≤ 4 * Real.pi * R ^ 2) : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁, a x * u x) - 4 * Real.pi * ε * R ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (a x + b x) * Ψ x * u x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hKD : Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) R ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hRρ
  have hC1D : Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) r₁ ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (lt_of_le_of_lt hr₁R hRρ)
  have hB1R : Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁ ⊆ Metric.ball 0 R := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr₁R
  have hBRD : Metric.ball (0 : E2) R ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hRρ.le
  have hB1D : Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁ ⊆ Metric.ball 0 ρ := hB1R.trans hBRD
  have I1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => a x * u x) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁) :=
    (((ha.mul hu).mono hC1D).integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall 0 r₁)).mono_set
      Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have I2 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball (0 : E2) R) :=
    ((hu.mono hKD).integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall 0 R)).mono_set
      Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have I3 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => (a x + b x) * Ψ x * u x)
      (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) R) :=
    ((((ha.add hb).mul hΨ.continuousOn).mul hu).mono hKD).integrableOn_compact
      (isCompact_closedBall 0 R)
  have IF : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => (a x + b x) * Ψ x * u x)
      (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := by
    refine I3.of_forall_diff_eq_zero measurableSet_ball ?_
    intro x hx
    have hx2 : ¬ ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
      intro h; exact hx.2 (mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr h)
    rw [hΨ0 x (le_of_lt (not_le.mp hx2))]
    ring
  have J1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
      ((Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁).indicator (fun x => a x * u x)) :=
    I1.integrable_indicator measurableSet_ball
  have J2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable ((Metric.ball (0 : E2) R).indicator u) :=
    I2.integrable_indicator measurableSet_ball
  have IG : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun x => (Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁).indicator (fun x => a x * u x) x
        - ε * (Metric.ball (0 : E2) R).indicator u x) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) :=
    (J1.sub (J2.const_mul ε)).integrableOn
  have hpw : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ,
      (Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁).indicator (fun x => a x * u x) x
        - ε * (Metric.ball (0 : E2) R).indicator u x ≤ (a x + b x) * Ψ x * u x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨ha0, hb0⟩ := hpt x hx
    have hu0x := hu0 x
    obtain ⟨hΨ0x, hΨ1x⟩ := hΨb x
    by_cases h1 : ‖x‖ < r₁
    · have m1 : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁ := mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr h1
      have m2 : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R := mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 hr₁R)
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem m1, Set.indicator_of_mem m2, hΨ1 x h1.le]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ b x + ε) hu0x]
    · have m1 : x ∉ Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁ := fun h => h1 (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp h)
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem m1]
      by_cases h2 : ‖x‖ < R
      · have m2 : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R := mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr h2
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem m2]
        have hp0 : 0 ≤ Ψ x * u x := mul_nonneg hΨ0x hu0x
        have hpu : Ψ x * u x ≤ u x := mul_le_of_le_one_left hu0x hΨ1x
        have e : (a x + b x) * Ψ x * u x = a x * (Ψ x * u x) + b x * (Ψ x * u x) := by ring
        rw [e]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha0 hp0, mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ b x + ε) hp0,
          mul_nonneg hε (by linarith : 0 ≤ u x - Ψ x * u x)]
      · have m2 : x ∉ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R := fun h => h2 (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp h)
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem m2, hΨ0 x (not_lt.mp h2)]
        simp
  have hM := MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on IG IF measurableSet_ball hpw
  have hG : ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ,
      ((Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁).indicator (fun x => a x * u x) x
        - ε * (Metric.ball (0 : E2) R).indicator u x)
      = (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) r₁, a x * u x) - ε * ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, u x := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub J1.integrableOn (J2.const_mul ε).integrableOn,
      MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_ball,
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_ball,
      Set.inter_eq_right.mpr hB1D, Set.inter_eq_right.mpr hBRD]
  have hεA : ε * ∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, u x ≤ 4 * Real.pi * ε * R ^ 2 := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA hε
    linarith
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x : E2) (c : ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) (hx : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A i j * x j = x i) : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A⁻¹ i j * (c * x i) * (c * x j) = c ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2

signature.name: normal_form_inv_quad
signature.statement: (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x : E2) (c : ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) (hx : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A i j * x j = x i) : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A⁻¹ i j * (c * x i) * (c * x j) = c ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdet : IsUnit A.det := (hA.det_pos).ne'.isUnit
  have hinv : A⁻¹ * A = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A hdet
  have hAv : Matrix.mulVec A (fun j => x j) = fun j => x j := by
    funext i
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    exact hx i
  have hv : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A⁻¹ i j * x j = x i := by
    intro i
    have h1 : Matrix.mulVec (A⁻¹ * A) (fun j => x j) = fun j => x j := by
      rw [hinv, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    rw [← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hAv] at h1
    have h2 := congrFun h1 i
    simpa only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using h2
  have hn : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      sq_abs, sq_abs]
  have h0 := hv 0
  have h1 := hv 1
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h0 h1 ⊢
  rw [hn]
  linear_combination (c ^ 2 * x 0) * h0 + (c ^ 2 * x 1) * h1

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R0 K : ℝ) (S : Set E3) (hR0 : 0 < R0) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hS1 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R0, z ∈ closure S → z ∈ S)
    (hS2 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∃ r > 0, ∃ F : E3 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0))
    (hS3 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∀ (b : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z) → (∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) →
      z b = w (coordPlaneProj b z) →
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r →
        coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b ∈ S) →
      ‖fderiv ℝ w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ 2 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ K)
    (z : E3) (hz : z ∈ S) (hzc : ‖z - c‖ < R0 / 4) (r1 s : ℝ) (hr1 : 0 < r1)
    (hKr1 : K * r1 ≤ 1 / 8) (h4r1 : 4 * r1 ≤ R0) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs : s ≤ 7 / 4)
    (b : Fin 3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (F : E3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r))
    (hSF : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0)) (hF0 : fderiv ℝ F z ≠ 0)
    (hslope : ∀ u, |fderiv ℝ F z (coordPlaneProj b u)| ≤ s * |fderiv ℝ F z (e b)| * ‖u‖) :
    ∃ w : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1} ∧ w z = z b ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ w z‖ ≤ s ∧
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1 →
        coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S ∧
        coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ Metric.ball c R0 ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ s + K * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w y‖ ≤ K ∧
        |w y - z b| ≤ (s + 1 / 8) * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖

signature.name: sheet_through_point
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R0 K : ℝ) (S : Set E3) (hR0 : 0 < R0) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hS1 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R0, z ∈ closure S → z ∈ S)
    (hS2 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∃ r > 0, ∃ F : E3 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0))
    (hS3 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∀ (b : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z) → (∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) →
      z b = w (coordPlaneProj b z) →
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r →
        coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b ∈ S) →
      ‖fderiv ℝ w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ 2 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ K)
    (z : E3) (hz : z ∈ S) (hzc : ‖z - c‖ < R0 / 4) (r1 s : ℝ) (hr1 : 0 < r1)
    (hKr1 : K * r1 ≤ 1 / 8) (h4r1 : 4 * r1 ≤ R0) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs : s ≤ 7 / 4)
    (b : Fin 3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (F : E3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r))
    (hSF : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0)) (hF0 : fderiv ℝ F z ≠ 0)
    (hslope : ∀ u, |fderiv ℝ F z (coordPlaneProj b u)| ≤ s * |fderiv ℝ F z (e b)| * ‖u‖) :
    ∃ w : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1} ∧ w z = z b ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ w z‖ ≤ s ∧
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1 →
        coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S ∧
        coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ Metric.ball c R0 ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ s + K * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w y‖ ≤ K ∧
        |w y - z b| ≤ (s + 1 / 8) * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hP5 : ∀ (y z : E3),
      coordPlaneProj b (y - z) = coordPlaneProj b y - coordPlaneProj b z := by
    intro y z
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hea : (e b) b = 1 := by simp [e]
  have hpa : ∀ q : E3, (coordPlaneProj b q) b = 0 := by
    intro q
    simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
  have hP3 : ∀ q : E3, coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b q) = coordPlaneProj b q := by
    intro q
    conv_lhs => rw [coordPlaneProj, hpa, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hP6 : ∀ u : E3, u = coordPlaneProj b u + (u b) • e b := by
    intro u
    simp [coordPlaneProj]
  have hcontP : Continuous (coordPlaneProj b) := by
    unfold coordPlaneProj
    fun_prop
  have hCylOpen : ∀ (c' : E3) (ρ : ℝ), IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - c')‖ < ρ} := by
    intro c' ρ
    exact isOpen_lt (hcontP.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm continuous_const
  have hzcyl : ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → z ∈ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ} := by
    intro ρ hρ
    show ‖coordPlaneProj b (z - z)‖ < ρ
    simp [coordPlaneProj, hρ]
  have hCylConvex : ∀ ρ : ℝ, Convex ℝ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ} := by
    intro ρ
    rw [convex_iff_forall_pos]
    intro x hx y hy a a' ha ha' haa
    have hlin : coordPlaneProj b (a • x + a' • y - z) =
        a • coordPlaneProj b (x - z) + a' • coordPlaneProj b (y - z) := by
      have ha'' : a' = 1 - a := by linarith
      subst ha''
      ext i
      simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    show ‖coordPlaneProj b (a • x + a' • y - z)‖ < ρ
    rw [hlin]
    have hx' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (x - z)‖ < ρ := hx
    have hy' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ := hy
    calc ‖a • coordPlaneProj b (x - z) + a' • coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖
        ≤ ‖a • coordPlaneProj b (x - z)‖ + ‖a' • coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = a * ‖coordPlaneProj b (x - z)‖ + a' * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha'.le]
      _ < a * ρ + a' * ρ := by
          have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx' ha
          have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy' ha'
          linarith
      _ = ρ := by rw [← add_mul, haa, one_mul]
  
  have hb : fderiv ℝ F z (e b) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hF0
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun u => ?_
    have h1 := hslope u
    rw [h0, abs_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul] at h1
    have h2 : fderiv ℝ F z (coordPlaneProj b u) = 0 := abs_nonpos_iff.mp h1
    calc fderiv ℝ F z u = fderiv ℝ F z (coordPlaneProj b u + (u b) • e b) := by rw [← hP6 u]
      _ = 0 := by rw [map_add, map_smul, h2, h0, smul_zero, add_zero]
      _ = (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) u := rfl
  
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, δ₂, hδ₂, wl, hwlp, hwlc, hwlz, hwlg, -⟩ :=
    ift_planar_graph S z r hr F hF hSF hz b hb
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z :=
    (hF.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))).differentiableAt
      (by simp)
  have hwld : DifferentiableAt ℝ wl z :=
    (hwlc.contDiffAt ((hCylOpen z δ₁).mem_nhds (hzcyl δ₁ hδ₁))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  obtain ⟨htan, -⟩ := graph_tangent_identity S z r hr F hFd
    (fun y hy hyS => (hSF y hy).1 hyS) b wl hwlp hwld hwlz.symm δ₁ hδ₁
    (fun y hy => (hwlg y hy).2.1)
  have heb : fderiv ℝ wl z (e b) = 0 := by
    have h1 := htan (e b)
    rw [hea] at h1
    have h2 : fderiv ℝ F z (e b) * fderiv ℝ wl z (e b) = 0 := by
      rw [mul_sub, mul_one] at h1
      linarith
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left hb
  have hPv : ∀ v, fderiv ℝ wl z (coordPlaneProj b v) = fderiv ℝ wl z v := by
    intro v
    conv_rhs => rw [hP6 v]
    rw [map_add, map_smul, heb, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have hbound : ∀ v, |fderiv ℝ wl z v| ≤ s * ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    have h1 := htan (coordPlaneProj b v)
    rw [hpa, zero_sub, hPv] at h1
    have h2 := hslope v
    rw [h1, abs_mul, abs_neg] at h2
    have hpos : 0 < |fderiv ℝ F z (e b)| := abs_pos.mpr hb
    have h3 : |fderiv ℝ F z (e b)| * |fderiv ℝ wl z v| ≤
        |fderiv ℝ F z (e b)| * (s * ‖v‖) := by
      calc |fderiv ℝ F z (e b)| * |fderiv ℝ wl z v| ≤ s * |fderiv ℝ F z (e b)| * ‖v‖ := h2
        _ = |fderiv ℝ F z (e b)| * (s * ‖v‖) := by ring
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h3 hpos
  have hd0l : ‖fderiv ℝ wl z‖ ≤ s :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ hs0 (fun v => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hbound v)
  
  have hU : ∀ (ρ ρ' : ℝ) (w w' : E3 → ℝ), 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ r1 → 0 < ρ' → ρ' ≤ r1 →
      (∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ} → w z = z b →
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S) →
      ‖fderiv ℝ w z‖ ≤ s →
      (∀ y, w' (coordPlaneProj b y) = w' y) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ'} → w' z = z b →
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ' → coordPlaneProj b y + w' y • e b ∈ S) →
      ‖fderiv ℝ w' z‖ ≤ s →
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < min ρ ρ' → w y = w' y := by
    intro ρ ρ' w w' hρ hρ1 hρ' hρ'1 hw hwc hwz hgr hd hw' hwc' hwz' hgr' hd'
    have hball : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ →
        coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ Metric.ball c R0 :=
      fun y hy => (sheet_slope_apriori c R0 K S hR0 hK hS3 b z hzc ρ s hρ
        (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρ1 hK) hKr1) (by linarith) hs0 hs w hw hwc hwz
        hgr hd y hy).2.2.2
    have hball' : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ' →
        coordPlaneProj b y + w' y • e b ∈ Metric.ball c R0 :=
      fun y hy => (sheet_slope_apriori c R0 K S hR0 hK hS3 b z hzc ρ' s hρ'
        (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρ'1 hK) hKr1) (by linarith) hs0 hs w' hw' hwc'
        hwz' hgr' hd' y hy).2.2.2
    have hsub : {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < min ρ ρ'} ⊆
        {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ} := by
      intro y hy
      have hy' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < min ρ ρ' := hy
      show ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy' (min_le_left _ _)
    have hsub' : {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < min ρ ρ'} ⊆
        {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ'} := by
      intro y hy
      have hy' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < min ρ ρ' := hy
      show ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < ρ'
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy' (min_le_right _ _)
    have hUs : ∀ y, y ∈ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < min ρ ρ'} ↔
        coordPlaneProj b y ∈ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < min ρ ρ'} := by
      intro y
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      rw [hP5 (coordPlaneProj b y) z, hP3, ← hP5]
    exact sheet_uniqueness c R0 S hS2 b _ (hCylOpen z _) (hCylConvex _).isPreconnected hUs
      w w' hw hw' ((hwc.differentiableOn (by simp)).mono hsub) (hwc'.continuousOn.mono hsub')
      (fun y hy => ⟨hgr y (hsub hy), hball y (hsub hy)⟩)
      (fun y hy => ⟨hgr' y (hsub' hy), hball' y (hsub' hy)⟩)
      z (hzcyl _ (lt_min hρ hρ')) (by rw [hwz, hwz'])
  
  have hE : ∀ (R : ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ), 0 < R → R < r1 →
      (∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < R} → w z = z b →
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < R → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S) →
      ‖fderiv ℝ w z‖ ≤ s →
      ∃ R' > R, ∃ w' : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y, w' (coordPlaneProj b y) = w' y) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < R'} ∧ w' z = z b ∧
        (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < R' → coordPlaneProj b y + w' y • e b ∈ S) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ w' z‖ ≤ s := by
    intro R w hR hRr hw hwc hwz hgr hd
    obtain ⟨R', hR', w', h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := sheet_extend_step c R0 K S hR0 hK hS1 hS2 hS3
      b z hzc r1 s hr1 hKr1 h4r1 hs0 hs R hR hRr w hw hwc hwz hgr hd
    refine ⟨R', hR', w', h1, h2, h3, h4, ?_⟩
    have hev : w' =ᶠ[𝓝 z] w :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hCylOpen z R).mem_nhds (hzcyl R hR)) (fun y hy => h5 y hy)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]

        ≤ ‖s • coordPlaneProj a (x - c)‖ + ‖t • coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = s * ‖coordPlaneProj a (x - c)‖ + t * ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hs,
            abs_of_pos ht]
      _ < s * (3 * ρ) + t * (3 * ρ) := by
          have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx hs
          have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy ht
          linarith
      _ = 3 * ρ := by rw [← add_mul, hst, one_mul]
  have hcC : c ∈ C := by
    rw [hmemC, sub_self]
    have : coordPlaneProj a 0 = 0 := by simp [coordPlaneProj]
    rw [this, norm_zero]
    linarith
  have hWd : ∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ y ∈ C, DifferentiableAt ℝ (W z) y := by
    intro z hz y hy
    rw [hC] at hy
    have hO : IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ < 3 * ρ} := by rw [← hC]; exact hCo
    exact ((hW2 z hz).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hy)
  have hWc : ∀ z ∈ Z, ContinuousOn (W z) C := by
    intro z hz; rw [hC]; exact (hW2 z hz).continuousOn
  have hGcont : ∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ y ∈ C,
      ContinuousAt (fun u => coordPlaneProj a u + W z u • e a) y := by
    intro z hz y hy
    exact hPcont.continuousAt.add ((hWd z hz y hy).continuousAt.smul continuousAt_const)
  
  have VU : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball c R0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ y ∈ C, ∀ z' ∈ Z, ∀ y' ∈ C,
      coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a ∈ Metric.ball q δ →
      coordPlaneProj a y' + W z' y' • e a ∈ Metric.ball q δ →
      coordPlaneProj a y = coordPlaneProj a y' → W z y = W z' y' := by
    intro q hq
    by_cases hqS : q ∈ S
    swap
    · 
      have hqcl : q ∉ closure S := fun h => hqS (hS1 q hq h)
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδS⟩ : ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x ∈ S, δ ≤ dist q x := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff] at hqcl
        push_neg at hqcl
        exact hqcl
      refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
      intro z hz y hy z' hz' y' hy' hx hx' hPP
      exfalso
      have h1 := hδS _ (hW3 z hz y ((hmemC y).mp hy)).1.1
      rw [mem_ball, dist_comm] at hx
      linarith
    obtain ⟨r, hr, F, hFc, hFd, hFS⟩ := hS2 q ⟨hqS, hq⟩
    have hFdiff : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball q r, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x := fun x hx =>
      (hFc.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)
    have hDc : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ F) q :=
      (hFc.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball (by simp)).continuousAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))
    by_cases hDa : fderiv ℝ F q (e a) = 0
    · 
      
      have s1 : ∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ y ∈ C, coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a ∈ Metric.ball q r →
          ‖fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a)‖ ≤
            3 * |fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) (e a)| := by
        intro z hz y hy hx
        have hG : HasFDerivAt (fun u => coordPlaneProj a u + W z u • e a)
            (Pl + (fderiv ℝ (W z) y).smulRight (e a)) y := by
          have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun u => coordPlaneProj a u) Pl y := by
            rw [hPfun]; exact Pl.hasFDerivAt
          have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun u => W z u • e a) ((fderiv ℝ (W z) y).smulRight (e a)) y :=
            (hWd z hz y hy).hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e a)
          exact h1.add h2
        have hFG : HasFDerivAt (F ∘ fun u => coordPlaneProj a u + W z u • e a)
            ((fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a)).comp
              (Pl + (fderiv ℝ (W z) y).smulRight (e a))) y :=
          (hFdiff _ hx).hasFDerivAt.comp y hG
        have hev : (F ∘ fun u => coordPlaneProj a u + W z u • e a) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
            fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          have h1 : ∀ᶠ u in 𝓝 y, coordPlaneProj a u + W z u • e a ∈ Metric.ball q r :=
            hG.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)
          filter_upwards [h1, hCo.mem_nhds hy] with u hu1 hu2
          exact (hFS _ hu1).mp ((hW3 z hz u ((hmemC u).mp hu2)).1.1)
        have h0 : HasFDerivAt (F ∘ fun u => coordPlaneProj a u + W z u • e a)
            (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
          (hasFDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) y).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
        have hzero := hFG.unique h0
        have hv : ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) v =
            fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) (e a) *
              (v a - fderiv ℝ (W z) y v) := by
          intro v
          have h := congrArg (fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T v) hzero
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, map_add,
            map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hPl] at h
          have hd : fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) v =
              fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) (coordPlaneProj a v) +
                v a * fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) (e a) := by
            conv_lhs => rw [← hdec v]
            rw [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
          rw [hd]
          linear_combination h
        apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity)
        intro v
        rw [hv v, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
        have hL2 : ‖fderiv ℝ (W z) y‖ ≤ 2 := (hW3 z hz y ((hmemC y).mp hy)).2.2
        have hLv : |fderiv ℝ (W z) y v| ≤ 2 * ‖v‖ := by
          have := (fderiv ℝ (W z) y).le_opNorm v
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
          nlinarith [norm_nonneg v]
        have h1 : |v a - fderiv ℝ (W z) y v| ≤ 3 * ‖v‖ := by
          have ha := abs_le.mp (hcoord v)
          have hb := abs_le.mp hLv
          exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        calc |fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) (e a)| *
              |v a - fderiv ℝ (W z) y v|
            ≤ |fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) (e a)| * (3 * ‖v‖) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = 3 * |fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) (e a)| * ‖v‖ := by ring
      have hD0 : fderiv ℝ F q ≠ 0 := hFd q (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
      have hDpos : 0 < ‖fderiv ℝ F q‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hD0
      obtain ⟨δ0, hδ0, hδ0'⟩ :=
        Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hDc (‖fderiv ℝ F q‖ / 4) (by positivity)
      refine ⟨min δ0 r, lt_min hδ0 hr, ?_⟩
      intro z hz y hy z' hz' y' hy' hx hx' hPP
      exfalso
      have hxr : coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a ∈ Metric.ball q r :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hx
      have hxδ : dist (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) q < δ0 :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hx) (min_le_left _ _)
      have hclose : ‖fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) - fderiv ℝ F q‖ <
          ‖fderiv ℝ F q‖ / 4 := by
        rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hδ0' hxδ
      have hbound := s1 z hz y hy hxr
      have h1 : |fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) (e a)| <
          ‖fderiv ℝ F q‖ / 4 := by
        have heq : fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) (e a) =
            (fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) - fderiv ℝ F q) (e a) := by
          rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, hDa, sub_zero]
        rw [heq]
        calc |(fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) - fderiv ℝ F q) (e a)|
            = ‖(fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) - fderiv ℝ F q) (e a)‖ :=
              (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
          _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) - fderiv ℝ F q‖ * ‖e a‖ :=
              ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
          _ = ‖fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) - fderiv ℝ F q‖ := by
              rw [hea_norm, mul_one]
          _ < _ := hclose
      have h2 : ‖fderiv ℝ F q‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a)‖ +
          ‖fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) - fderiv ℝ F q‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_le (fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a))
          (fderiv ℝ F (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) - fderiv ℝ F q)
        rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at this
      linarith
    · 
      have hcont_ea : ContinuousAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e a)) q :=
        hDc.clm_apply continuousAt_const
      obtain ⟨δ0, hδ0, hne⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hcont_ea.eventually_ne hDa)
      refine ⟨min δ0 r, lt_min hδ0 hr, ?_⟩
      have hB : Metric.ball q (min δ0 r) ⊆ Metric.ball q r :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
      have key : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ x' ∈ S, x ∈ Metric.ball q (min δ0 r) →
          x' ∈ Metric.ball q (min δ0 r) → coordPlaneProj a x = coordPlaneProj a x' →
          ¬ (x a < x' a) := by
        intro x hxS x' hx'S hx hx' hPP hlt
        have hF0 : F x = 0 := (hFS x (hB hx)).mp hxS
        have hF0' : F x' = 0 := (hFS x' (hB hx')).mp hx'S
        have hx'eq : x' = x + (x' a - x a) • e a := by
          have h1 := hdec x
          have h2 := hdec x'
          rw [← hPP] at h2
          calc x' = coordPlaneProj a x + x' a • e a := h2.symm
            _ = (coordPlaneProj a x + x a • e a) + (x' a - x a) • e a := by
                rw [sub_smul]; abel
            _ = x + (x' a - x a) • e a := by rw [h1]
        have hsne : x' a - x a ≠ 0 := by linarith
        have hseg : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (x a) (x' a),
            x + (τ - x a) • e a ∈ Metric.ball q (min δ0 r) := by
          intro τ hτ
          have hθ : (τ - x a) / (x' a - x a) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
            ⟨div_nonneg (by linarith [hτ.1]) (by linarith),
              (div_le_one (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith [hτ.2])⟩
          have hm := (convex_ball q (min δ0 r)).add_smul_sub_mem hx hx' hθ
          have hdiff : x' - x = (x' a - x a) • e a := by
            rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add, add_comm]; exact hx'eq
          have hrw : ((τ - x a) / (x' a - x a)) • (x' - x) = (τ - x a) • e a := by
            rw [hdiff, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hsne]
          rw [hrw] at hm
          exact hm
        have hderiv : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc (x a) (x' a),
            HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => F (x + (τ - x a) • e a))
              (fderiv ℝ F (x + (τ - x a) • e a) (e a)) τ := by
          intro τ hτ
          have hpt := hseg τ hτ
          have hFd' : HasFDerivAt F (fderiv ℝ F (x + (τ - x a) • e a))
              (x + (τ - x a) • e a) := (hFdiff _ (hB hpt)).hasFDerivAt
          have hline : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => x + (τ - x a) • e a) (e a) τ := by
            have := (((hasDerivAt_id τ).sub_const (x a)).smul_const (e a)).const_add x
            simpa using this
          exact hFd'.comp_hasDerivAt τ hline
        obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hτ0⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero
          (f' := fun τ => fderiv ℝ F (x + (τ - x a) • e a) (e a)) hlt
          (fun τ hτ => (hderiv τ hτ).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
          (by
            show F (x + (x a - x a) • e a) = F (x + (x' a - x a) • e a)
            rw [← hx'eq, sub_self, zero_smul, add_zero, hF0, hF0'])
          (fun τ hτ => hderiv τ (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hτ))
        exact hne (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp (hseg τ (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hτ)))
          (min_le_left _ _)) hτ0
      intro z hz y hy z' hz' y' hy' hx hx' hPP
      have hxS := (hW3 z hz y ((hmemC y).mp hy)).1.1
      have hx'S := (hW3 z' hz' y' ((hmemC y').mp hy')).1.1
      have hPx : coordPlaneProj a (coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) =
          coordPlaneProj a (coordPlaneProj a y' + W z' y' • e a) := by
        rw [hPG, hPG, hPP]
      rcases lt_trichotomy ((coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a) a)
          ((coordPlaneProj a y' + W z' y' • e a) a) with h | h | h
      · exact absurd h (key _ hxS _ hx'S hx hx' hPx)
      · rw [hGa, hGa] at h; exact h
      · exact absurd h (key _ hx'S _ hxS hx' hx hPx.symm)
  
  have LC : ∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ z' ∈ Z, ∀ y₀ ∈ C, W z y₀ = W z' y₀ →
      ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, W z y = W z' y := by
    intro z hz z' hz' y₀ hy₀ heq
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hU⟩ := VU _ (hW3 z hz y₀ ((hmemC y₀).mp hy₀)).1.2
    have hc1 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, coordPlaneProj a y + W z y • e a ∈
        Metric.ball (coordPlaneProj a y₀ + W z y₀ • e a) δ :=
      (hGcont z hz y₀ hy₀).preimage_mem_nhds
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ))
    have hc2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 y₀, coordPlaneProj a y + W z' y • e a ∈
        Metric.ball (coordPlaneProj a y₀ + W z y₀ • e a) δ := by
      refine (hGcont z' hz' y₀ hy₀).preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds ?_)
      show coordPlaneProj a y₀ + W z' y₀ • e a ∈
        Metric.ball (coordPlaneProj a y₀ + W z y₀ • e a) δ
      rw [heq]; exact Metric.mem_ball_self hδ
    filter_upwards [hc1, hc2, hCo.mem_nhds hy₀] with y h1 h2 h3
    exact hU z hz y h3 z' hz' y h3 h1 h2 rfl
  
  have hCpre : IsPreconnected C := hCc.isPreconnected
  have ID : ∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ z' ∈ Z, ∀ y₀ ∈ C, W z y₀ = W z' y₀ → ∀ y ∈ C, W z y = W z' y := by
    intro z hz z' hz' y₀ hy₀ heq
    have hsub : C ⊆ {y | ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 y, W z y' = W z' y'} := by
      refine hCpre.subset_of_closure_inter_subset isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds
        ⟨y₀, hy₀, LC z hz z' hz' y₀ hy₀ heq⟩ ?_
      rintro y ⟨hycl, hyC⟩
      by_contra hnot
      have hne : W z y ≠ W z' y := fun h => hnot (LC z hz z' hz' y hyC h)
      have hev : ∀ᶠ y' in 𝓝 y, W z y' ≠ W z' y' :=
        ((((hWc z hz).continuousAt (hCo.mem_nhds hyC)).sub
          ((hWc z' hz').continuousAt (hCo.mem_nhds hyC))).eventually_ne
            (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)).mono fun y' h => sub_ne_zero.mp h
      obtain ⟨y', hy'u, hy'ne⟩ := ((mem_closure_iff_frequently.mp hycl).and_eventually hev).exists
      exact hy'ne (show ∀ᶠ y'' in 𝓝 y', W z y'' = W z' y'' from hy'u).self_of_nhds
    intro y hy
    exact (show ∀ᶠ y'' in 𝓝 y, W z y'' = W z' y'' from hsub hy).self_of_nhds
  have ORD : ∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ z' ∈ Z, W z c < W z' c → ∀ y ∈ C, W z y < W z' y := by
    intro z hz z' hz' hlt y hy
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    obtain ⟨y₂, hy₂, heq⟩ :=
      hCpre.intermediate_value₂ hcC hy (hWc z hz) (hWc z' hz') hlt.le hle
    have := ID z hz z' hz' y₂ hy₂ heq c hcC
    linarith
  
  have FIN : ((fun z => W z c) '' Z).Finite := by
    by_contra hinf
    have hTsub : (fun z => W z c) '' Z ⊆ Set.Icc (c a - 9 * ρ) (c a + 9 * ρ) := by
      rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      have := abs_le.mp (hW3 z hz c ((hmemC c).mp hcC)).2.1
      exact ⟨by linarith [this.1], by linarith [this.2]⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hacc⟩ :=
      Set.Infinite.exists_accPt_of_subset_isCompact hinf isCompact_Icc hTsub
    have hqt : coordPlaneProj a c + t • e a ∈ Metric.ball c R0 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      have hrw : coordPlaneProj a c + t • e a - c = (t - c a) • e a := by
        have h1 := hdec c
        calc coordPlaneProj a c + t • e a - c
            = coordPlaneProj a c + t • e a - (coordPlaneProj a c + c a • e a) := by rw [h1]
          _ = (t - c a) • e a := by rw [sub_smul]; abel
      rw [hrw, norm_smul, hea_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have : |t - c a| ≤ 9 * ρ := abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [ht.1], by linarith [ht.2]⟩
      linarith
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hU⟩ := VU _ hqt
    have hb : ∀ s : ℝ, |s - t| < δ →
        coordPlaneProj a c + s • e a ∈ Metric.ball (coordPlaneProj a c + t • e a) δ := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      have hrw : coordPlaneProj a c + s • e a - (coordPlaneProj a c + t • e a) =
          (s - t) • e a := by rw [sub_smul]; abel
      rw [hrw, norm_smul, hea_norm, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact hs
    have huniq : ∀ z₁ ∈ Z, ∀ z₂ ∈ Z, |W z₁ c - t| < δ → |W z₂ c - t| < δ →
        W z₁ c = W z₂ c := by
      intro z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ h1 h2
      exact hU z₁ hz₁ c hcC z₂ hz₂ c hcC (hb _ h1) (hb _ h2) rfl
    rw [accPt_iff_nhds] at hacc
    obtain ⟨t₁, ⟨ht₁b, z₁, hz₁, hzt₁⟩, ht₁ne⟩ := hacc (Metric.ball t δ) (Metric.ball_mem_nhds t hδ)
    simp only at hzt₁
    subst hzt₁
    have hη : 0 < |W z₁ c - t| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr ht₁ne)
    obtain ⟨t₂, ⟨ht₂b, z₂, hz₂, hzt₂⟩, ht₂ne⟩ :=
      hacc (Metric.ball t |W z₁ c - t|) (Metric.ball_mem_nhds t hη)
    simp only at hzt₂
    subst hzt₂
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at ht₁b ht₂b
    have := huniq z₁ hz₁ z₂ hz₂ ht₁b (lt_trans ht₂b ht₁b)
    rw [this] at ht₂b
    exact lt_irrefl _ ht₂b
  
  have hmem : ∀ i : Fin FIN.toFinset.card, ∃ z ∈ Z, W z c = FIN.toFinset.orderEmbOfFin rfl i := by
    intro i
    have := FIN.toFinset.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl i
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at this
    obtain ⟨z, hz, h⟩ := this
    exact ⟨z, hz, h⟩
  choose zf hzf hzfc using hmem
  refine ⟨FIN.toFinset.card, fun i => W (zf i), fun i => ⟨zf i, hzf i, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i i' hii' y hy
    apply ORD (zf i) (hzf i) (zf i') (hzf i') _ y ((hmemC y).mpr hy)
    rw [hzfc, hzfc]
    exact (FIN.toFinset.orderEmbOfFin rfl).strictMono hii'
  · intro z hz
    have hzs : W z c ∈ Set.range (FIN.toFinset.orderEmbOfFin rfl) := by
      rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin, Finset.mem_coe, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
      exact ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hzs
    refine ⟨i, fun y hy => ID z hz (zf i) (hzf i) c hcC ?_ y ((hmemC y).mpr hy)⟩
    rw [hzfc, hi]

informal_problem.statement:
(b : Fin 3) (w F : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3)
    (hw : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z))
    (hpl : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hz : z b = w (coordPlaneProj b z))
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F z)
    (hvan : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, F (coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b) = 0) :
    (∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j F z =
       partialDeriv b F z * partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z) ∧
    ∃ r s : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) z =
        partialDeriv b F z *
            partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y))) z +
          partialDeriv i (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z * r j +
          s i * partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z

signature.name: graph_jet_relations
signature.statement:
(b : Fin 3) (w F : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3)
    (hw : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z))
    (hpl : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hz : z b = w (coordPlaneProj b z))
    (hF : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F z)
    (hvan : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, F (coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b) = 0) :
    (∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j F z =
       partialDeriv b F z * partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z) ∧
    ∃ r s : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j F) z =
        partialDeriv b F z *
            partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y))) z +
          partialDeriv i (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z * r j +
          s i * partialDeriv j (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z

proof.tactics:
by
  set Fw : E3 → ℝ := fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y) with hFwdef
  
  have hPcd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (coordPlaneProj b) := by
    unfold coordPlaneProj; fun_prop
  have hprojcd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y : E3 => y b) := by fun_prop
  have hFw : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 Fw z :=
    hprojcd.contDiffAt.sub (hw.comp z hPcd.contDiffAt)
  
  have hshear : ∀ y, coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b = y - Fw y • e b := by
    intro y
    simp only [hFwdef, coordPlaneProj, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hz0 : Fw z = 0 := by
    simp only [hFwdef]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hz
  have hγz : z - Fw z • e b = z := by rw [hz0, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hvan' : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, F (y - Fw y • e b) = 0 :=
    hvan.mono fun y hy => by rw [← hshear]; exact hy
  
  have chain : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (h : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ h (y - Fw y • e b) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ Fw y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => h (x - Fw x • e b)) y ∧
      partialDeriv i (fun x => h (x - Fw x • e b)) y =
        partialDeriv i h (y - Fw y • e b) -
          partialDeriv i Fw y * partialDeriv b h (y - Fw y • e b) := by
    intro i h y hh hFwy
    have hγ : HasFDerivAt (fun x : E3 => x - Fw x • e b)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - (fderiv ℝ Fw y).smulRight (e b)) y :=
      (hasFDerivAt_id y).sub (hFwy.hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e b))
    have hc := hh.hasFDerivAt.comp y hγ
    refine ⟨hc.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [show (fun x => h (x - Fw x • e b)) = h ∘ (fun x : E3 => x - Fw x • e b) from rfl,
      hc.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, map_sub, map_smul,
      smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hγc : Tendsto (fun x : E3 => x - Fw x • e b) (𝓝 z) (𝓝 z) := by
    have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun x : E3 => x - Fw x • e b) z :=
      continuousAt_id.sub (hFw.continuousAt.smul continuousAt_const)
    have h : Tendsto (fun x : E3 => x - Fw x • e b) (𝓝 z) (𝓝 (z - Fw z • e b)) := hcont.tendsto
    rwa [hγz] at h
  have hFev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 z, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x :=
    (hF.eventually (by simp)).mono fun x hx => hx.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hFwev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 z, DifferentiableAt ℝ Fw x :=
    (hFw.eventually (by simp)).mono fun x hx => hx.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hFγ : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, DifferentiableAt ℝ F (y - Fw y • e b) := hγc.eventually hFev
  have hfirst : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, ∀ j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv j F (y - Fw y • e b) -
        partialDeriv j Fw y * partialDeriv b F (y - Fw y • e b) = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hFγ, hFwev, hvan'.eventually_nhds] with y h1 h2 h3 j
    obtain ⟨-, hc⟩ := chain j F y h1 h2
    rw [← hc]
    have h3' : (fun x => F (x - Fw x • e b)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := h3
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h3'.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  refine ⟨fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := hfirst.self_of_nhds j
    rw [hγz] at h
    linear_combination h
  
  have hdF : ∀ k, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k F) z := by
    intro k
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) z :=
      (hF.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    exact h1.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e k))
  have hdFw : ∀ k, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k Fw) z := by
    intro k
    have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Fw) z :=
      (hFw.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    exact h1.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e k))
  have hFwz : DifferentiableAt ℝ Fw z := hFw.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hdF' : ∀ k, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k F) (z - Fw z • e b) := fun k => by
    rw [hγz]; exact hdF k
  refine ⟨fun j => partialDeriv b (partialDeriv j F) z -
      partialDeriv j Fw z * partialDeriv b (partialDeriv b F) z,
    fun i => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv b F) z, fun i j => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hA1d, hA1⟩ := chain i (partialDeriv j F) z (hdF' j) hFwz
  obtain ⟨hA3d, hA3⟩ := chain i (partialDeriv b F) z (hdF' b) hFwz
  rw [hγz] at hA1 hA3
  have hev : (fun y => partialDeriv j F (y - Fw y • e b) -
      partialDeriv j Fw y * partialDeriv b F (y - Fw y • e b)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
    hfirst.mono fun y hy => hy j
  have hΨ0 := hev.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
  have hmul : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y => partialDeriv j Fw y * partialDeriv b F (y - Fw y • e b)) z :=
    (hdFw j).mul hA3d
  have hc0 : fderiv ℝ (fun _ : E3 => (0 : ℝ)) z = 0 := by simp
  rw [fderiv_fun_sub hA1d hmul, fderiv_fun_mul (hdFw j) hA3d, hc0] at hΨ0
  have hΨ := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e i)) hΨ0
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, fderiv_const, Pi.zero_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at hΨ
  change partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j F (y - Fw y • e b)) z -
      (partialDeriv j Fw z * partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv b F (y - Fw y • e b)) z +
        partialDeriv b F (z - Fw z • e b) * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j Fw) z) = 0 at hΨ
  rw [hA1, hA3, hγz] at hΨ
  beta_reduce
  linear_combination hΨ

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (hG : (G y).PosDef) (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G f i j y = hessLoc G f j i y)
    (hξ : ∃ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k f y ≠ 0) (t t' : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ht : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i f y * t i = 0)
    (ht' : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i f y * t' i = 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * hessLoc G f i j y * t' j) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * G y i j * t j) *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t' i * G y i j * t' j) *
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a c * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv c f y) *
          secondFundSq G f y)

signature.name: tangent_hess_sq_le
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (hG : (G y).PosDef) (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G f i j y = hessLoc G f j i y)
    (hξ : ∃ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k f y ≠ 0) (t t' : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (ht : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i f y * t i = 0)
    (ht' : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i f y * t' i = 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * hessLoc G f i j y * t' j) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * G y i j * t j) *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t' i * G y i j * t' j) *
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a c * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv c f y) *
          secondFundSq G f y)

proof.tactics:
by
  have key : ∀ (A P H : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (ξ ν t t' : Fin 3 → ℝ) (S : ℝ),
      A.PosDef → ξ ≠ 0 → (∀ i, ν i = ∑ a : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i a * ξ a) →
      S = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b →
      (∀ i j, P i j = A⁻¹ i j - ν i * ν j / S) → (∀ i j, H i j = H j i) →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ξ i * t i = 0 → ∑ i : Fin 3, ξ i * t' i = 0 →
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * H i j * t' j) ^ 2 ≤
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * A i j * t j) *
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t' i * A i j * t' j) *
          (S * ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
            P i j * H j k * P k l * H l i) / S)) := by
    intro A P H ξ ν t t' S hA hξ hν hS hP hH ht ht'
    obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W, W = A⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hWdef] at hν hS hP
    have hW : W.PosDef := by rw [hWdef]; exact hA.inv
    have hWA : W * A = 1 := by
      rw [hWdef]; exact Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA.det_pos.ne')
    have hWs : ∀ i j, W i j = W j i := by
      intro i j
      have h := hW.isHermitian.apply i j
      simp only [star_trivial] at h
      exact h.symm
    have hSpos : 0 < S := by
      have h := hW.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ
      have e : dotProduct (star ξ) (Matrix.mulVec W ξ) = S := by
        rw [hS]
        simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      linarith
    have hS0 : S ≠ 0 := hSpos.ne'
    
    have hquad : ∀ (a : ℝ) (v w : Fin 3 → ℝ),
        dotProduct (star (v - a • w)) (Matrix.mulVec W (v - a • w)) =
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * W i j * v j)
            - 2 * a * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * W i j * w j)
            + a ^ 2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, w i * W i j * w j) := by
      intro a v w
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Pi.sub_apply,
        Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [hWs 1 0, hWs 2 0, hWs 2 1]
      ring
    
    have hPsd : P.PosSemidef := by
      refine Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg ?_ ?_
      · ext i j
        simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial, hP, hWs j i]
        ring
      · intro x
        have h0 := hW.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
          (x - ((∑ i : Fin 3, x i * ν i) / S) • ξ)
        rw [hquad] at h0
        have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, x i * W i j * ξ j = ∑ i : Fin 3, x i * ν i := by
          simp only [hν, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
        have e2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ξ i * W i j * ξ j = S := by
          rw [hS]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
        have e3 : dotProduct (star x) (Matrix.mulVec P x) =
            (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, x i * W i j * x j)
            - (∑ i : Fin 3, x i * ν i) ^ 2 / S := by
          simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, hP,
            Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
        rw [e1, e2] at h0
        rw [e3]
        have e4 : (∑ i : Fin 3, x i * ν i) ^ 2 / S =
            2 * ((∑ i : Fin 3, x i * ν i) / S) * (∑ i : Fin 3, x i * ν i) -
              ((∑ i : Fin 3, x i * ν i) / S) ^ 2 * S := by
          field_simp
          ring
        linarith
    
    have hWu : ∀ s : Fin 3 → ℝ, Matrix.mulVec W (Matrix.mulVec A s) = s := by
      intro s; rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hWA, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hνu : ∀ u : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∑ j : Fin 3, ν j * u j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ξ a * (Matrix.mulVec W u) a := by
      intro u
      simp only [hν, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [hWs 1 0, hWs 2 0, hWs 2 1]
      ring
    have hPu : ∀ (u : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
        (Matrix.mulVec P u) i = (Matrix.mulVec W u) i - ν i / S * ∑ j : Fin 3, ν j * u j := by
      intro u i
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hP, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hrec : ∀ s : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ξ i * s i = 0 →
        ∀ i, s i = ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * (Matrix.mulVec A s) j := by
      intro s hs i
      have h1 := hPu (Matrix.mulVec A s) i
      rw [hνu, hWu, hs, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := Matrix.posSemidef_iff_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self.mp hPsd
    have hPB : ∀ i j, P i j = ∑ α : Fin 3, B α i * B α j := by
      intro i j
      rw [hB, Matrix.mul_apply]
      simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial]
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u, u = Matrix.mulVec A t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ : ∃ u', u' = Matrix.mulVec A t' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have htu := hrec t ht
    have htu' := hrec t' ht'
    rw [← hu] at htu
    rw [← hu'] at htu'
    have hRt : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * A i j * t j = ∑ i : Fin 3, t i * u i := by
      rw [hu]; simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have hRt' : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t' i * A i j * t' j = ∑ i : Fin 3, t' i * u' i := by
      rw [hu']; simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have hQS : ∀ q : ℝ, S * (q / S) = q := fun q => by field_simp
    rw [hRt, hRt', hQS]
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ α, x α = ∑ k : Fin 3, B α k * u k :=
      ⟨fun α => ∑ k : Fin 3, B α k * u k, fun _ => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ α, y α = ∑ k : Fin 3, B α k * u' k :=
      ⟨fun α => ∑ k : Fin 3, B α k * u' k, fun _ => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ : ∃ h : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∀ α β, h α β = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B α i * H i j * B β j :=
      ⟨fun α β => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B α i * H i j * B β j, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
    have htx : ∀ i, t i = ∑ α : Fin 3, B α i * x α := by
      intro i; rw [htu i]; simp only [hPB, hx, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have hty : ∀ i, t' i = ∑ α : Fin 3, B α i * y α := by
      intro i; rw [htu' i]; simp only [hPB, hy, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have hxx : ∑ i : Fin 3, t i * u i = ∑ α : Fin 3, x α ^ 2 := by
      simp only [htx, hx, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have hyy : ∑ i : Fin 3, t' i * u' i = ∑ α : Fin 3, y α ^ 2 := by
      simp only [hty, hy, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have hL : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * H i j * t' j =
        ∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, x α * h α β * y β := by
      simp only [htx, hty, hh, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have hhs : ∀ α β, h β α = h α β := by
      intro α β
      simp only [hh, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [hH 1 0, hH 2 0, hH 2 1]
      ring
    have hQ1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        P i j * H j k * P k l * H l i = ∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, h α β * h β α := by
      simp only [hPB, hh, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hQ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        P i j * H j k * P k l * H l i = ∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, h α β ^ 2 := by
      rw [hQ1]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun α _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun β _ => ?_))
      rw [hhs α β]; ring
    rw [hL, hxx, hyy, hQ]
    
    have cs : (∑ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, x p.1 * y p.2 * h p.1 p.2) ^ 2 ≤
        (∑ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, (x p.1 * y p.2) ^ 2) * ∑ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, h p.1 p.2 ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq _ _ _
    have e1 : ∑ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, x p.1 * y p.2 * h p.1 p.2 =
        ∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, x α * h α β * y β := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have e2 : ∑ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, (x p.1 * y p.2) ^ 2 =
        (∑ α : Fin 3, x α ^ 2) * ∑ β : Fin 3, y β ^ 2 := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have e3 : ∑ p : Fin 3 × Fin 3, h p.1 p.2 ^ 2 = ∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, h α β ^ 2 := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    rw [e1, e2, e3] at cs
    exact cs
  have hξv : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k f y) ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hξ
    intro h0
    exact hk (congrFun h0 k)
  unfold secondFundSq
  exact key (G y)
    (Matrix.of fun i j => (G y)⁻¹ i j -
      (∑ a : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a f y) *
        (∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b f y) /
      (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y))
    (Matrix.of fun i j => hessLoc G f i j y) (fun k => partialDeriv k f y)
    (fun i => ∑ a : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a f y) t t'
    (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y)
    hG hξv (fun i => rfl) rfl (fun i j => rfl) hH ht ht'

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Ω : Set E3) (c : E3)
    (R0 : ℝ) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hball : Metric.closedBall c R0 ⊆ Ω)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) Ω)
    (hpos : ∀ y ∈ Ω, (G y).PosDef) :
    ∃ m Mx Γ : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ 0 ≤ Mx ∧ 0 ≤ Γ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c R0,
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, m * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G y i j * v j) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G y i j * v j ≤ Mx * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * (G y)⁻¹ i j * v j ≤ m⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j y| ≤ Γ)

signature.name: coeff_compact_bounds
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Ω : Set E3) (c : E3)
    (R0 : ℝ) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hball : Metric.closedBall c R0 ⊆ Ω)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) Ω)
    (hpos : ∀ y ∈ Ω, (G y).PosDef) :
    ∃ m Mx Γ : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ 0 ≤ Mx ∧ 0 ≤ Γ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c R0,
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, m * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G y i j * v j) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G y i j * v j ≤ Mx * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * (G y)⁻¹ i j * v j ≤ m⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j y| ≤ Γ)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hs2 : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * A i j * v j ≤
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |A i j|) * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 := by
    intro A v
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    have hi : v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, v k ^ 2 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => v k ^ 2) (fun k _ => sq_nonneg (v k))
        (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hj : v j ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, v k ^ 2 :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => v k ^ 2) (fun k _ => sq_nonneg (v k))
        (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have h1 : v i * A i j * v j ≤ |A i j| * (|v i| * |v j|) := by
      calc v i * A i j * v j ≤ |v i * A i j * v j| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |A i j| * (|v i| * |v j|) := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]; ring
    have h2 : |v i| * |v j| ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, v k ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|v i| - |v j|), sq_abs (v i), sq_abs (v j)]
    calc v i * A i j * v j ≤ |A i j| * (|v i| * |v j|) := h1
      _ ≤ |A i j| * ∑ k : Fin 3, v k ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (abs_nonneg _)
  
  have hbr : ∀ (C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * C i j * v j = dotProduct v (Matrix.mulVec C v) := by
    intro C v
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hbrS : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 = dotProduct v v := by
    intro v
    simp only [dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hs1 : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), A.PosDef → ∀ m : ℝ, 0 < m →
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * A⁻¹ i j * v j ≤ m⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) →
      ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, m * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * A i j * v j := by
    intro A hA m hm hinv v
    have hdet : IsUnit A.det := (hA.det_pos.ne').isUnit
    have hBA : A⁻¹ * A = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A hdet
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hdet
    have hAT : Matrix.transpose A = A := by
      have h := hA.isHermitian
      rw [Matrix.IsHermitian, Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h
      exact h
    have hpsd : 0 ≤ dotProduct (m • v - Matrix.mulVec A v)
        (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ (m • v - Matrix.mulVec A v)) := by
      have h := hA.inv.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (m • v - Matrix.mulVec A v)
      simpa using h
    have hBz : Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ (m • v - Matrix.mulVec A v) =
        m • (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ v) - v := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_smul, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hBA, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hcross : dotProduct (Matrix.mulVec A v) (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ v) = dotProduct v v := by
      rw [dotProduct_comm, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hAT,
        Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hAB, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hid : dotProduct (m • v - Matrix.mulVec A v)
        (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ (m • v - Matrix.mulVec A v)) =
        m ^ 2 * dotProduct v (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ v) - 2 * m * dotProduct v v +
          dotProduct v (Matrix.mulVec A v) := by
      rw [hBz]
      simp only [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul,
        hcross]
      rw [dotProduct_comm (Matrix.mulVec A v) v]
      ring
    have hq := hinv v
    rw [hbr, hbrS] at hq
    rw [hbr, hbrS]
    have hS : 0 ≤ dotProduct v v := by rw [← hbrS]; positivity
    have h3 : m ^ 2 * dotProduct v (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ v) ≤ m * dotProduct v v := by
      calc m ^ 2 * dotProduct v (Matrix.mulVec A⁻¹ v) ≤ m ^ 2 * (m⁻¹ * dotProduct v v) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (by positivity)
        _ = m * dotProduct v v := by field_simp
    nlinarith
  
  have hGc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => G y i j) Ω := fun i j => (hG i j).continuousOn
  have hGm : ContinuousOn G Ω := continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j => hGc i j
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y).det) Ω :=
    (continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hGm
  have hadjc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y).adjugate i j) Ω := by
    intro i j
    have h : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ => A.adjugate i j) :=
      (continuous_apply j).comp ((continuous_apply i).comp (continuous_id.matrix_adjugate))
    exact h.comp_continuousOn hGm
  have hInv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) Ω := by
    intro i j
    have heq : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) = fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate i j := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact (hdetc.inv₀ (fun y hy => (hpos y hy).det_pos.ne')).mul (hadjc i j)
  have hPD : ∀ l i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y) Ω := by
    intro l i j
    unfold partialDeriv
    exact ((hG i j).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hChr : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => christoffel G k i j y) Ω := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun l _ =>
      (hInv k l).mul (((hPD i j l).add (hPD j i l)).sub (hPD l i j)))
  
  have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall c R0) := isCompact_closedBall c R0
  have hPc : ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |G y i j|)
      (Metric.closedBall c R0) :=
    (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      (hGc i j).abs).mono hball
  have hQc : ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |(G y)⁻¹ i j|)
      (Metric.closedBall c R0) :=
    (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      (hInv i j).abs).mono hball
  have hTc : ContinuousOn
      (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j y|)
      (Metric.closedBall c R0) :=
    (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun k _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
      continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ => (hChr k i j).abs).mono hball
  obtain ⟨CP, hCP⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hPc
  obtain ⟨CQ, hCQ⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hQc
  obtain ⟨CT, hCT⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hTc
  
  have hm0 : 0 < (max CQ 0 + 1)⁻¹ := inv_pos.2 (by linarith [le_max_right CQ 0])
  refine ⟨(max CQ 0 + 1)⁻¹, max CP 0, max CT 0, hm0, le_max_right _ _, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hyΩ : y ∈ Ω := hball hy
  have hP : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |G y i j| ≤ max CP 0 := by
    have h := hCP y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  have hQ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |(G y)⁻¹ i j| ≤ max CQ 0 + 1 := by
    have h := hCQ y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    have := le_max_left CQ 0
    linarith [le_abs_self (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |(G y)⁻¹ i j|)]
  have hT : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j y| ≤ max CT 0 := by
    have h := hCT y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  have hS : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 :=
    fun v => Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg (v i)
  have hinvb : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * (G y)⁻¹ i j * v j ≤
      (max CQ 0 + 1)⁻¹⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [inv_inv]
    exact (hs2 _ v).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQ (hS v))
  refine ⟨hs1 (G y) (hpos y hyΩ) _ hm0 hinvb,
    fun v => (hs2 _ v).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hP (hS v)), hinvb, ?_⟩
  intro k i j
  refine le_trans ?_ hT
  calc |christoffel G k i j y| ≤ ∑ j' : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j' y| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j' => |christoffel G k i j' y|)
          (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    _ ≤ ∑ i' : Fin 3, ∑ j' : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i' j' y| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i' => ∑ j' : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i' j' y|)
          (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    _ ≤ ∑ k' : Fin 3, ∑ i' : Fin 3, ∑ j' : Fin 3, |christoffel G k' i' j' y| :=
        Finset.single_le_sum
          (f := fun k' => ∑ i' : Fin 3, ∑ j' : Fin 3, |christoffel G k' i' j' y|)
          (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_univ k)

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (z : E3) (b : Fin 3)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (m Mx Γ Λ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hG : (G z).PosDef)
    (hup : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G z i j * v j ≤ Mx * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2)
