    (hinv : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * (G z)⁻¹ i j * v j ≤ m⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2)
    (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j z| ≤ Γ)
    (hw : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z))
    (hpl : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hslope : ‖fderiv ℝ w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ 2)
    (htan : ∀ t t' : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z * t i = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z * t' i = 0 →
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          t i * hessLoc G (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) i j z * t' j) ^ 2 ≤
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * G z i j * t j) *
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t' i * G z i j * t' j) *
          ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c *
              partialDeriv a (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z *
              partialDeriv c (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z) * Λ ^ 2)) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤
      4 * (5 * Mx * |Λ| * Real.sqrt (9 / m) + 45 * Γ)

signature.name: planar_hessian_bound
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (z : E3) (b : Fin 3)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (m Mx Γ Λ : ℝ) (hm : 0 < m) (hG : (G z).PosDef)
    (hup : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G z i j * v j ≤ Mx * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2)
    (hinv : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * (G z)⁻¹ i j * v j ≤ m⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2)
    (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j z| ≤ Γ)
    (hw : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z))
    (hpl : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hslope : ‖fderiv ℝ w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ 2)
    (htan : ∀ t t' : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z * t i = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z * t' i = 0 →
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          t i * hessLoc G (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) i j z * t' j) ^ 2 ≤
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t i * G z i j * t j) *
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, t' i * G z i j * t' j) *
          ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c *
              partialDeriv a (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z *
              partialDeriv c (fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y)) z) * Λ ^ 2)) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤
      4 * (5 * Mx * |Λ| * Real.sqrt (9 / m) + 45 * Γ)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hea : (e b) b = 1 := by simp [e]
  have hP1 : ∀ (y : E3) (s : ℝ), coordPlaneProj b (y + s • e b) = coordPlaneProj b y := by
    intro y s
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, hea, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
      add_smul]
    abel
  have hP4 : ∀ (y : E3) (s : ℝ), w (y + s • e b) = w y := by
    intro y s
    rw [← hpl (y + s • e b), hP1, hpl]
  have hPcd : ContDiff ℝ 2 (coordPlaneProj b) := by unfold coordPlaneProj; fun_prop
  have hwz : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w z := by
    have h := hw.comp z hPcd.contDiffAt
    have h' : (w ∘ coordPlaneProj b) = w := funext hpl
    rwa [h'] at h
  have hP2 : (fun y => w (y + (z b) • e b)) = w := funext fun y => hP4 y (z b)
  have hP3 : coordPlaneProj b z + (z b) • e b = z := by simp [coordPlaneProj]
  have hL : fderiv ℝ w (coordPlaneProj b z) = fderiv ℝ w z := by
    have h := fderiv_comp_add_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := w) (x := coordPlaneProj b z) ((z b) • e b)
    rw [hP2, hP3] at h
    exact h
  have hB : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w z := by
    have h := iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := w) 2 ((z b) • e b)
      (coordPlaneProj b z)
    rw [hP2, hP3] at h
    exact h
  
  have hb0 : ∀ y : E3, fderiv ℝ w y (e b) = 0 := by
    intro y
    by_cases hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ w y
    · have hℓ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => y + s • e b) (e b) 0 := by
        have h := ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const (e b)).const_add y
        simpa using h
      have hd' : HasFDerivAt w (fderiv ℝ w y) ((fun s : ℝ => y + s • e b) 0) := by
        simpa using hd.hasFDerivAt
      have h1 := hd'.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) hℓ
      have h2 : (w ∘ fun s : ℝ => y + s • e b) = fun _ => w y := funext fun s => hP4 y s
      rw [h2] at h1
      exact h1.unique (hasDerivAt_const 0 (w y))
    · rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hd]
      rfl
  
  set Fw : E3 → ℝ := fun y => y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y) with hFw
  have hF : Fw = fun y => y b - w y := funext fun y => by
    show y b - w (coordPlaneProj b y) = y b - w y
    rw [hpl]
  have hd1 : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ w y → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun y : E3 => y b - w y) y =
        (if l = b then (1:ℝ) else 0) - partialDeriv l w y := by
    intro y hy l
    have hproj : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y b) (EuclideanSpace.proj b : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj b : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have h := (hproj.sub hy.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [show (fun y : E3 => y b - w y) = (fun y : E3 => y b) - w from rfl, h]
    by_cases hl : l = b
    · subst hl; simp [e]
    · simp [e, hl, Ne.symm hl, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, DifferentiableAt ℝ w y :=
    (hwz.eventually (by simp)).mono fun y hy => hy.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hξF : ∀ k, partialDeriv k Fw z = (if k = b then (1:ℝ) else 0) - partialDeriv k w z := by
    intro k
    rw [hF]
    exact hd1 z (hwz.differentiableAt (by norm_num)) k
  have hDF : ∀ k l, partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l Fw) z = -partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l w) z := by
    intro k l
    rw [hF]
    have h' : partialDeriv l (fun y : E3 => y b - w y) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        fun y => (if l = b then (1:ℝ) else 0) - partialDeriv l w y :=
      hev.mono fun y hy => hd1 y hy l
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv l (fun y : E3 => y b - w y)) z (e k) =
      -(fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv l w) z (e k))
    rw [h'.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_sub]
    rfl
  
  have hkey : ∀ a c, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv c w) z =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) z (e a) (e c) := by
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) z :=
      (hwz.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    intro a c
    show fderiv ℝ (fun x => fderiv ℝ w x (e c)) z (e a) = _
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const _)]
    simp
  have hsy : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ w z :=
    hwz.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField])
  have hW0 : ∀ k, partialDeriv k (partialDeriv b w) z = 0 ∧
      partialDeriv b (partialDeriv k w) z = 0 := by
    have h0 : partialDeriv b w = fun _ => 0 := funext fun y => hb0 y
    have h1 : ∀ k, partialDeriv k (partialDeriv b w) z = 0 := by
      intro k
      rw [h0]
      simp [partialDeriv]
    intro k
    refine ⟨h1 k, ?_⟩
    rw [hkey, hsy (e b) (e k), ← hkey]
    exact h1 k
  
  have hξb : partialDeriv b Fw z = 1 := by
    rw [hξF b, if_pos rfl, show partialDeriv b w z = 0 from hb0 z, sub_zero]
  have hξ2 : ∀ k, |partialDeriv k Fw z| ≤ 2 := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : k = b
    · subst hk; rw [hξb]; norm_num
    · rw [hξF k, if_neg hk, zero_sub, abs_neg]
      calc |partialDeriv k w z| = ‖fderiv ℝ w z (e k)‖ := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; rfl
        _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ w z‖ * ‖e k‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ w z‖ := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
        _ ≤ 2 := by rw [← hL]; exact hslope
  have hDb : ∀ k, partialDeriv k (partialDeriv b Fw) z = 0 ∧
      partialDeriv b (partialDeriv k Fw) z = 0 := by
    intro k
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hDF, (hW0 k).1, neg_zero]
    · rw [hDF, (hW0 k).2, neg_zero]
  have hΓ0 : 0 ≤ Γ := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hΓ 0 0 0)
  have hξs : ∑ c : Fin 3, |partialDeriv c Fw z| ≤ 5 := by
    have h1 : ∀ c, |partialDeriv c Fw z| ≤ 2 - (if c = b then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
      intro c
      by_cases hc : c = b
      · subst hc; rw [hξb, if_pos rfl]; norm_num
      · rw [if_neg hc]; linarith [hξ2 c]
    calc ∑ c : Fin 3, |partialDeriv c Fw z|
        ≤ ∑ c : Fin 3, (2 - (if c = b then (1:ℝ) else 0)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => h1 c
      _ = 5 := by simp [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; norm_num
  have hξ9 : ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Fw z ^ 2 ≤ 9 := by
    have h1 : ∀ c, partialDeriv c Fw z ^ 2 ≤ 4 - 3 * (if c = b then (1:ℝ) else 0) := by
      intro c
      by_cases hc : c = b
      · subst hc; rw [hξb, if_pos rfl]; norm_num
      · rw [if_neg hc, ← sq_abs]
        have := hξ2 c
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (partialDeriv c Fw z)]
    calc ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Fw z ^ 2
        ≤ ∑ c : Fin 3, (4 - 3 * (if c = b then (1:ℝ) else 0)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => h1 c
      _ = 9 := by simp [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; norm_num
  have hC : ∀ k l, |∑ c : Fin 3, christoffel G c k l z * partialDeriv c Fw z| ≤ 5 * Γ := by
    intro k l
    calc |∑ c : Fin 3, christoffel G c k l z * partialDeriv c Fw z|
        ≤ ∑ c : Fin 3, |christoffel G c k l z * partialDeriv c Fw z| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ c : Fin 3, Γ * |partialDeriv c Fw z| := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => ?_
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hΓ c k l) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = Γ * ∑ c : Fin 3, |partialDeriv c Fw z| := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ Γ * 5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hξs hΓ0
      _ = 5 * Γ := by ring
  
  have L1 : ∀ (t y : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (c : ℝ),
      (∀ k, t k = (if k = a then (1:ℝ) else 0) - c * (if k = b then (1:ℝ) else 0)) →
      ∑ k : Fin 3, y k * t k = y a - c * y b := by
    intro t y a c ht
    simp only [ht, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    ring
  have L2 : ∀ (t y : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (c : ℝ),
      (∀ k, t k = (if k = a then (1:ℝ) else 0) - c * (if k = b then (1:ℝ) else 0)) →
      ∑ k : Fin 3, t k * y k = y a - c * y b := by
    intro t y a c ht
    rw [← L1 t y a c ht]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => mul_comm _ _
  
  have hquad : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), A.PosDef → ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * A i j * v j := by
    intro A hA v
    by_cases hv : v = 0
    · subst hv; simp
    · have h1 := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
      have h3 : dotProduct (star v) (A.mulVec v) =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * A i j * v j := by
        simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
        ring
      rw [← h3]; exact h1.le
  have hMx : 0 ≤ Mx := by
    have h1 := hup (fun _ => 1)
    have h2 := hquad _ hG (fun _ => 1)
    simp only [one_pow, one_mul, mul_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
      nsmul_eq_mul] at h1 h2
    push_cast at h1
    linarith
  have hα : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, v k ^ 2 ≤ 5 →
      0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G z i j * v j ∧
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G z i j * v j ≤ 5 * Mx := by
    intro v hv
    refine ⟨hquad _ hG v, (hup v).trans ?_⟩
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv hMx
    linarith
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c * partialDeriv a Fw z *
      partialDeriv c Fw z := by
    have h := hquad _ hG.inv (fun k => partialDeriv k Fw z)
    refine le_of_le_of_eq h ?_
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
    ring
  have hS9 : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c * partialDeriv a Fw z *
      partialDeriv c Fw z ≤ 9 / m := by
    have h := hinv (fun k => partialDeriv k Fw z)
    have e1 : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a c * partialDeriv a Fw z *
        partialDeriv c Fw z = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i Fw z * (G z)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv j Fw z := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j _
      ring
    rw [e1]
    refine h.trans ?_
    have hm' : 0 ≤ m⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hm.le
    calc m⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i Fw z ^ 2 ≤ m⁻¹ * 9 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hξ9 hm'
      _ = 9 / m := by ring
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ 5 * Mx * |Λ| * Real.sqrt (9 / m) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hMx) (abs_nonneg _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  
  have hent : ∀ i j, i ≠ b → j ≠ b →
      |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) z| ≤ 5 * Mx * |Λ| * Real.sqrt (9 / m) + 45 * Γ := by
    intro i j hi hj
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ k, t k = (if k = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) -
        partialDeriv i Fw z * (if k = b then (1:ℝ) else 0) := ⟨_, fun k => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t', ht'⟩ : ∃ t : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ k, t k = (if k = j then (1:ℝ) else 0) -
        partialDeriv j Fw z * (if k = b then (1:ℝ) else 0) := ⟨_, fun k => rfl⟩
    have ho : ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k Fw z * t k = 0 := by
      have h := L1 t (fun k => partialDeriv k Fw z) i _ ht
      simp only at h
      rw [h, hξb]; ring
    have ho' : ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k Fw z * t' k = 0 := by
      have h := L1 t' (fun k => partialDeriv k Fw z) j _ ht'
      simp only at h
      rw [h, hξb]; ring
    have hnorm : ∀ (s : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3), a ≠ b →
        (∀ k, s k = (if k = a then (1:ℝ) else 0) -
          partialDeriv a Fw z * (if k = b then (1:ℝ) else 0)) →
        ∑ k : Fin 3, s k ^ 2 ≤ 5 := by
      intro s a ha hs
      have hsa : s a = 1 := by rw [hs, if_pos rfl, if_neg ha]; ring
      have hsb : s b = -partialDeriv a Fw z := by rw [hs, if_neg (Ne.symm ha), if_pos rfl]; ring
      have h := L1 s s a _ hs
      have h2 : ∑ k : Fin 3, s k ^ 2 = ∑ k : Fin 3, s k * s k :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => sq (s k)
      rw [h2, h, hsa, hsb]
      have := hξ2 a
      have h3 : partialDeriv a Fw z ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (partialDeriv a Fw z)]
      nlinarith
    have hn := hnorm t i hi ht
    have hn' := hnorm t' j hj ht'
    have hbil : ∀ X : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, t k * X k l * t' l =
        (X i j - partialDeriv j Fw z * X i b) -
          partialDeriv i Fw z * (X b j - partialDeriv j Fw z * X b b) := by
      intro X
      have h1 : ∀ k, ∑ l : Fin 3, t k * X k l * t' l =
          t k * (X k j - partialDeriv j Fw z * X k b) := by
        intro k
        have h := L1 t' (fun l => t k * X k l) j _ ht'
        rw [h]; ring
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => h1 k]
      exact L2 t (fun k => X k j - partialDeriv j Fw z * X k b) i _ ht
    have hX := htan t t' ho ho'
    have hXe := hbil (fun k l => hessLoc G Fw k l z)
    have hH : ∀ k l, hessLoc G Fw k l z = partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l Fw) z -
        ∑ c : Fin 3, christoffel G c k l z * partialDeriv c Fw z := fun k l => rfl
    rw [hH i j, hH i b, hH b j, hH b b, (hDb i).1, (hDb j).2, (hDb b).1] at hXe
    obtain ⟨hα0, hα5⟩ := hα t hn
    obtain ⟨hα0', hα5'⟩ := hα t' hn'
    have hprod : (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, t k * hessLoc G Fw k l z * t' l) ^ 2 ≤
        (5 * Mx * |Λ| * Real.sqrt (9 / m)) ^ 2 := by
      refine hX.trans ?_
      have h1 := mul_le_mul hα5 hα5' hα0' (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hMx)
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hS9 (sq_nonneg Λ)
      have h3 := mul_le_mul h1 h2 (mul_nonneg hS0 (sq_nonneg Λ)) (mul_self_nonneg _)
      refine h3.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs, Real.sq_sqrt (div_nonneg (by norm_num) hm.le)]
      ring
    have hXabs := abs_le_of_sq_le_sq hprod hR0
    have p2 : |partialDeriv j Fw z * ∑ c : Fin 3, christoffel G c i b z * partialDeriv c Fw z|
        ≤ 2 * (5 * Γ) := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hξ2 j) (hC i b) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    have p3 : |partialDeriv i Fw z * ∑ c : Fin 3, christoffel G c b j z * partialDeriv c Fw z|
        ≤ 2 * (5 * Γ) := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hξ2 i) (hC b j) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    have p4 : |partialDeriv i Fw z * (partialDeriv j Fw z *
        ∑ c : Fin 3, christoffel G c b b z * partialDeriv c Fw z)| ≤ 2 * (2 * (5 * Γ)) := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (hξ2 i) (mul_le_mul (hξ2 j) (hC b b) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
        (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (by norm_num)
    rw [← abs_neg, ← hDF i j]
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_le.mp hXabs
    obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hC i j)
    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := abs_le.mp p2
    obtain ⟨d1, d2⟩ := abs_le.mp p3
    obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := abs_le.mp p4
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hne : ∀ b' : Fin 3, b' + 1 ≠ b' := by decide
  have hK1 : 0 ≤ 5 * Mx * |Λ| * Real.sqrt (9 / m) + 45 * Γ :=
    (abs_nonneg _).trans (hent (b + 1) (b + 1) (hne b) (hne b))
  have hbasis : ∀ u : E3, u = ∑ d : Fin 3, u d • e d := by
    intro u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hbil2 : ∀ u v : E3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) z u v =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, u a * v c * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) z (e a) (e c) := by
    intro u v
    conv_lhs => rw [hbasis u, hbasis v]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    ring
  have hentB : ∀ a c, |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) z (e a) (e c)| ≤
      (5 * Mx * |Λ| * Real.sqrt (9 / m) + 45 * Γ) *
        ((if a = b then (0:ℝ) else 1) * (if c = b then (0:ℝ) else 1)) := by
    intro a c
    rw [← hkey]
    by_cases ha : a = b
    · subst ha; simp [(hW0 c).2]
    · by_cases hc : c = b
      · subst hc; simp [ha, (hW0 a).1]
      · simp only [ha, hc, if_false, mul_one]; exact hent a c ha hc
  have hχ : ∀ b' : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3,
      (if a = b' then (0:ℝ) else 1) * (if c = b' then (0:ℝ) else 1) = 4 := by
    intro b'
    fin_cases b' <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> norm_num
  have hop : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w z‖ ≤ 4 * (5 * Mx * |Λ| * Real.sqrt (9 / m) + 45 * Γ) := by
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound (by linarith) fun v => ?_
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply, Fin.prod_univ_two, hbil2, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc |∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, v 0 a * v 1 c * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) z (e a) (e c)|
        ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, |∑ c : Fin 3, v 0 a * v 1 c * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) z (e a) (e c)| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, |v 0 a * v 1 c * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) z (e a) (e c)| :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ‖v 0‖ * ‖v 1‖ *
            ((5 * Mx * |Λ| * Real.sqrt (9 / m) + 45 * Γ) *
              ((if a = b then (0:ℝ) else 1) * (if c = b then (0:ℝ) else 1))) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => ?_
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          have h1 : |v 0 a| ≤ ‖v 0‖ := by
            have := PiLp.norm_apply_le (v 0) a; rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
          have h2 : |v 1 c| ≤ ‖v 1‖ := by
            have := PiLp.norm_apply_le (v 1) c; rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
          exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) (hentB a c)
            (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = ‖v 0‖ * ‖v 1‖ * (5 * Mx * |Λ| * Real.sqrt (9 / m) + 45 * Γ) *
            ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3,
              ((if a = b then (0:ℝ) else 1) * (if c = b then (0:ℝ) else 1)) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
          ring
      _ = 4 * (5 * Mx * |Λ| * Real.sqrt (9 / m) + 45 * Γ) * (‖v 0‖ * ‖v 1‖) := by
          rw [hχ b]; ring
  rw [hB]
  exact hop

informal_problem.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) U) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ U, (h x).PosDef) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 w U) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ U) : pd2 0 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 0 j * pd2 j w z) x + pd2 1 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 1 j * pd2 j w z) x = Real.sqrt (h x).det * lap2 h w x

signature.name: lap2_divergence_form
signature.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) U) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ U, (h x).PosDef) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 w U) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ U) : pd2 0 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 0 j * pd2 j w z) x + pd2 1 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 1 j * pd2 j w z) x = Real.sqrt (h x).det * lap2 h w x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hxU : U ∈ 𝓝 x := hU.mem_nhds hx
  have hsymm : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h z i j = h z j i := by
    intro z hz i j
    have := (hpd z hz).isHermitian.apply j i
    simpa using this
  have hdh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h z a b) x := fun a b =>
    ((hh a b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hxU
  
  have pmul : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z * g z) x = pd2 k f x * g x + f x * pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have padd : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z + g z) x = pd2 k f x + pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hg]
    rfl
  have psub : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z - g z) x = pd2 k f x - pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub hf hg]
    rfl
  have pneg : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), pd2 k (fun z => -f z) x = -pd2 k f x := by
    intro f k
    unfold pd2
    rw [show (fun z => -f z) = -f from rfl, fderiv_neg]
    rfl
  have pinv : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x ≠ 0 →
      pd2 k (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) x = -pd2 k f x / (f x) ^ 2 := by
    intro f k hf hf0
    unfold pd2
    have H := (hasDerivAt_inv hf0).comp_hasFDerivAt x hf.hasFDerivAt
    rw [show (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) = (fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) ∘ f from rfl, H.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have psqrt : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x ≠ 0 →
      pd2 k (fun z => Real.sqrt (f z)) x = pd2 k f x / (2 * Real.sqrt (f x)) := by
    intro f k hf hf0
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_sqrt hf hf0]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hinvE : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (i j : Fin 2),
      A⁻¹ i j = A.det⁻¹ * A.adjugate i j := by
    intro A i j
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rfl
  have hadj00 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 0 0 = A 1 1 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj01 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 0 1 = -A 0 1 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj10 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 1 0 = -A 1 0 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj11 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 1 1 = A 0 0 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hdetE : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 1 0 :=
    fun A => Matrix.det_fin_two A
  have hDpos : 0 < (h x).det := (hpd x hx).det_pos
  have hD0 : (h x).det ≠ 0 := hDpos.ne'
  have hx10 : h x 1 0 = h x 0 1 := hsymm x hx 1 0
  have hd10 : ∀ l : Fin 2, pd2 l (fun z => h z 1 0) x = pd2 l (fun z => h z 0 1) x := by
    intro l
    have hev : (fun z => h z 1 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => h z 0 1) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hxU (fun z hz => hsymm z hz 1 0)
    unfold pd2
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev]
  
  have hdetfun : (fun z => (h z).det) = fun z => h z 0 0 * h z 1 1 - h z 0 1 * h z 1 0 := by
    funext z; exact hdetE (h z)
  have hdD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z).det) x := by
    rw [hdetfun]; exact ((hdh 0 0).mul (hdh 1 1)).sub ((hdh 0 1).mul (hdh 1 0))
  have hdS : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det) x := hdD.sqrt hD0
  have hdw : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 j w) x := by
    intro j
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y) U := hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by norm_num)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (pd2 j w) U := h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h2.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt hxU
  have hdI : ∀ i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) x := by
    intro i j
    have e : (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) = fun z => ((h z).det)⁻¹ * (h z).adjugate i j :=
      funext fun z => hinvE (h z) i j
    rw [e]
    refine (hdD.inv hD0).mul ?_
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, hadj00]; exact hdh 1 1
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, hadj01]; exact (hdh 0 1).neg
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, hadj10]; exact (hdh 1 0).neg
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, hadj11]; exact hdh 0 0
  
  have pD : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x =
      pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 0) x * h x 1 1 + h x 0 0 * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 1) x -
        (pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 1) x * h x 1 0 + h x 0 1 * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 0) x) := by
    intro k
    rw [hdetfun, psub _ _ k ((hdh 0 0).fun_mul (hdh 1 1)) ((hdh 0 1).fun_mul (hdh 1 0)),
      pmul _ _ k (hdh 0 0) (hdh 1 1), pmul _ _ k (hdh 0 1) (hdh 1 0)]
  have pS : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det) x =
      Real.sqrt (h x).det * pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (2 * (h x).det) := by
    intro k
    rw [psqrt _ k hdD hD0]
    have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (h x).det := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hDpos
    have hss : Real.sqrt (h x).det * Real.sqrt (h x).det = (h x).det :=
      Real.mul_self_sqrt hDpos.le
    generalize Real.sqrt (h x).det = s at hs0 hss ⊢
    rw [← hss]
    field_simp
  have pI00 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 0) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * h x 1 1 +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 1) x := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj00]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 1 1), pinv _ k hdD hD0]
  have pI01 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 1) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * (-h x 0 1) +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * (-pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 1) x) := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj01]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 0 1).fun_neg, pinv _ k hdD hD0, pneg]
  have pI10 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 0) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * (-h x 1 0) +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * (-pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 0) x) := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj10]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 1 0).fun_neg, pinv _ k hdD hD0, pneg]
  have pI11 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 1) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * h x 0 0 +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 0) x := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj11]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 0 0), pinv _ k hdD hD0]
  
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hdA : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i 0 * pd2 0 w z + (h z)⁻¹ i 1 * pd2 1 w z) x :=
    fun i => ((hdI i 0).fun_mul (hdw 0)).fun_add ((hdI i 1).fun_mul (hdw 1))
  rw [pmul _ _ 0 hdS (hdA 0), pmul _ _ 1 hdS (hdA 1),
    padd _ _ 0 ((hdI 0 0).fun_mul (hdw 0)) ((hdI 0 1).fun_mul (hdw 1)),
    padd _ _ 1 ((hdI 1 0).fun_mul (hdw 0)) ((hdI 1 1).fun_mul (hdw 1)),
    pmul _ _ 0 (hdI 0 0) (hdw 0), pmul _ _ 0 (hdI 0 1) (hdw 1),
    pmul _ _ 1 (hdI 1 0) (hdw 0), pmul _ _ 1 (hdI 1 1) (hdw 1),
    pS 0, pS 1, pI00 0, pI01 0, pI10 1, pI11 1, pD 0, pD 1]
  simp only [lap2, christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hinvE (h x), hadj00, hadj01, hadj10, hadj11]
  have hD1 : h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 0 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have e := hdetE (h x)
    rw [hx10] at e
    rw [← e]
    exact hD0
  generalize Real.sqrt (h x).det = s
  simp only [hx10, hd10]
  field_simp
  simp only [hdetE (h x), hx10]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (R t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (htR : t < R) (V₀ V₁ : E2 → ℝ) (hV₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 V₀ (Metric.ball 0 R)) (hV₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 V₁ (Metric.ball 0 R)) : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) t, (pd2 0 V₀ x + pd2 1 V₁ x)) = ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, t * (V₀ (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * Real.cos φ + V₁ (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * Real.sin φ)

signature.name: divergence_disc_polar
signature.statement: (R t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (htR : t < R) (V₀ V₁ : E2 → ℝ) (hV₀ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 V₀ (Metric.ball 0 R)) (hV₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 V₁ (Metric.ball 0 R)) : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) t, (pd2 0 V₀ x + pd2 1 V₁ x)) = ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, t * (V₀ (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * Real.cos φ + V₁ (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * Real.sin φ)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hB : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) R) := Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hnorm : ∀ φ : ℝ, ‖Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1‖ = 1 := by
    intro φ
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hmem : ∀ s φ : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t →
      s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R := by
    intro s φ hs hst
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, norm_smul, hnorm, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs]
    linarith
  have hc0 : ∀ s φ : ℝ, (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) 0 = s * Real.cos φ := by
    intro s φ; simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hc1 : ∀ s φ : ℝ, (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) 1 = s * Real.sin φ := by
    intro s φ; simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hθ0 : ∀ φ : ℝ, (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) 0 = Real.cos φ := by
    intro φ; simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hθ1 : ∀ φ : ℝ, (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) 1 = Real.sin φ := by
    intro φ; simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hd0 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, DifferentiableAt ℝ V₀ y := fun y hy =>
    (hV₀.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hB.mem_nhds hy)
  have hd1 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, DifferentiableAt ℝ V₁ y := fun y hy =>
    (hV₁.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hB.mem_nhds hy)
  have hcf0 : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ V₀ y) (Metric.ball 0 R) :=
    hV₀.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hB le_rfl
  have hcf1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ V₁ y) (Metric.ball 0 R) :=
    hV₁.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hB le_rfl
  obtain ⟨G, hGdef⟩ : ∃ G : E2 → ℝ, G = fun y => y 0 * V₀ y + y 1 * V₁ y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G (Metric.ball 0 R) := by
    rw [hGdef]
    exact (((contDiff_piLp_apply 2 (i := 0)).contDiffOn).mul hV₀).add
      (((contDiff_piLp_apply 2 (i := 1)).contDiffOn).mul hV₁)
  have hcfG : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ G y) (Metric.ball 0 R) :=
    hG.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hB le_rfl
  have hG0 : G 0 = 0 := by rw [hGdef]; simp
  have hGd : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R, ∀ v : E2,
      fderiv ℝ G x v = x 0 * fderiv ℝ V₀ x v + V₀ x * v 0 +
        (x 1 * fderiv ℝ V₁ x v + V₁ x * v 1) := by
    intro x hx v
    have h : HasFDerivAt G ((x 0 • fderiv ℝ V₀ x + V₀ x • PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) 0) +
        (x 1 • fderiv ℝ V₁ x + V₁ x • PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) 1)) x := by
      rw [hGdef]
      exact ((PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 x 0).mul (hd0 x hx).hasFDerivAt).add
        ((PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 x 1).mul (hd1 x hx).hasFDerivAt)
    rw [h.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, PiLp.proj_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
  have hθc : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) := by fun_prop
  have hPc : ∀ s : ℝ, Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) :=
    fun s => hθc.const_smul s
  
  have hf : ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 0 V₀ x + pd2 1 V₁ x) (Metric.closedBall 0 t) :=
    ((hcf0.clm_apply continuousOn_const).add (hcf1.clm_apply continuousOn_const)).mono
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball htR)
  obtain ⟨hpol, -⟩ := integral_ball_polar_rad t ht (fun x => pd2 0 V₀ x + pd2 1 V₁ x) hf
  simp only [] at hpol
  rw [hpol]
  
  obtain ⟨hftc, -⟩ := spherical_mean_ftc R G hG t ht.le htR
  have hRHS : (∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, t * (V₀ (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * Real.cos φ + V₁ (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * Real.sin φ)) = ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, G (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun φ _ => ?_)
    simp only [hGdef, hc0, hc1]
    ring
  rw [hRHS, hftc, hG0, mul_zero, zero_add]
  refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun s hs => ?_)
  rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ht.le] at hs
  obtain ⟨hs0, hst⟩ := hs
  dsimp only
  
  have hA : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => (pd2 0 V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) +
      pd2 1 V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) * s) := by
    have h0 : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) :=
      hcf0.comp_continuous (hPc s) (fun φ => hmem s φ hs0 hst)
    have h1 : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) :=
      hcf1.comp_continuous (hPc s) (fun φ => hmem s φ hs0 hst)
    exact ((h0.clm_apply continuous_const).add (h1.clm_apply continuous_const)).mul continuous_const
  have hBf : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ G (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
      (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) := by
    have h0 : Continuous (fun φ : ℝ => fderiv ℝ G (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) :=
      hcfG.comp_continuous (hPc s) (fun φ => hmem s φ hs0 hst)
    exact h0.clm_apply hθc
  have hderiv : ∀ φ ∈ Set.uIcc (-Real.pi) Real.pi, HasDerivAt
      (fun ψ : ℝ => V₁ (s • (Real.cos ψ • e2 0 + Real.sin ψ • e2 1)) * Real.cos ψ -
        V₀ (s • (Real.cos ψ • e2 0 + Real.sin ψ • e2 1)) * Real.sin ψ)
      ((pd2 0 V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) +
          pd2 1 V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) * s -
        fderiv ℝ G (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
          (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) φ := by
    intro φ _
    have hx := hmem s φ hs0 hst
    have hP : HasDerivAt (fun ψ : ℝ => s • (Real.cos ψ • e2 0 + Real.sin ψ • e2 1))
        (s • ((-Real.sin φ) • e2 0 + Real.cos φ • e2 1)) φ :=
      (((Real.hasDerivAt_cos φ).smul_const (e2 0)).add
        ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin φ).smul_const (e2 1))).const_smul s
    have h0 := (hd0 _ hx).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt φ hP
    have h1 := (hd1 _ hx).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt φ hP
    have hH := (h1.mul (Real.hasDerivAt_cos φ)).sub (h0.mul (Real.hasDerivAt_sin φ))
    refine hH.congr_deriv ?_
    have hD0 : fderiv ℝ V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
        (s • ((-Real.sin φ) • e2 0 + Real.cos φ • e2 1)) =
        s * (-Real.sin φ * pd2 0 V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) +
          Real.cos φ * pd2 1 V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) := by
      simp only [pd2, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hD1 : fderiv ℝ V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
        (s • ((-Real.sin φ) • e2 0 + Real.cos φ • e2 1)) =
        s * (-Real.sin φ * pd2 0 V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) +
          Real.cos φ * pd2 1 V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) := by
      simp only [pd2, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hT0 : fderiv ℝ V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
        (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) =
        Real.cos φ * pd2 0 V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) +
          Real.sin φ * pd2 1 V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) := by
      simp only [pd2, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hT1 : fderiv ℝ V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))
        (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1) =
        Real.cos φ * pd2 0 V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) +
          Real.sin φ * pd2 1 V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) := by
      simp only [pd2, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [hD0, hD1, hGd _ hx, hT0, hT1, hc0, hc1, hθ0, hθ1]
    have hcs := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
    generalize pd2 0 V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) = a00
    generalize pd2 1 V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) = a01
    generalize pd2 0 V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) = a10
    generalize pd2 1 V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) = a11
    generalize V₀ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) = v0
    generalize V₁ (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) = v1
    generalize Real.cos φ = c at hcs ⊢
    generalize Real.sin φ = σ at hcs ⊢
    linear_combination (s * (a00 + a11)) * hcs
  have hF := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv
    ((hA.sub hBf).intervalIntegrable (-Real.pi) Real.pi)
  have hsub := intervalIntegral.integral_sub (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hA.intervalIntegrable (-Real.pi) Real.pi) (hBf.intervalIntegrable (-Real.pi) Real.pi)
  have hper : (V₁ (s • (Real.cos Real.pi • e2 0 + Real.sin Real.pi • e2 1)) * Real.cos Real.pi -
        V₀ (s • (Real.cos Real.pi • e2 0 + Real.sin Real.pi • e2 1)) * Real.sin Real.pi) -
      (V₁ (s • (Real.cos (-Real.pi) • e2 0 + Real.sin (-Real.pi) • e2 1)) * Real.cos (-Real.pi) -
        V₀ (s • (Real.cos (-Real.pi) • e2 0 + Real.sin (-Real.pi) • e2 1)) *
          Real.sin (-Real.pi)) = 0 := by
    rw [Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg, Real.sin_pi, neg_zero, sub_self]
  linarith

subgoal_signatures.name: integral_ball_polar_rad
subgoal_signatures.statement: (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall 0 ρ)) : (∫ x in Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, f x) = (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..ρ, ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * s) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun s : ℝ => ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, f (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) * s) (Set.Icc 0 ρ)

subgoal_signatures.name: spherical_mean_ftc
subgoal_signatures.statement: (R : ℝ) (F : E2 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F (Metric.ball 0 R)) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hsR : s < R) : (∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, F (s • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1))) = 2 * Real.pi * F 0 + (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..s, ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, fderiv ℝ F (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => ∫ φ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, fderiv ℝ F (t • (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) (Real.cos φ • e2 0 + Real.sin φ • e2 1)) (Set.Icc 0 s)

informal_problem.statement:
(S : Set E3) (z : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r))
    (hSF : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0)) (hz : z ∈ S) (b : Fin 3)
    (hb : fderiv ℝ F z (e b) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ δ₁ > 0, ∃ δ₂ > 0, ∃ w : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < δ₁} ∧ w z = z b ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < δ₁ → |w y - z b| < δ₂ ∧
        coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S ∧
        coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ Metric.ball z r) ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < δ₁ → |y b - z b| < δ₂ → y ∈ S → y b = w y)

signature.name: ift_planar_graph
signature.statement:
(S : Set E3) (z : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r))
    (hSF : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0)) (hz : z ∈ S) (b : Fin 3)
    (hb : fderiv ℝ F z (e b) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ δ₁ > 0, ∃ δ₂ > 0, ∃ w : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < δ₁} ∧ w z = z b ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < δ₁ → |w y - z b| < δ₂ ∧
        coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S ∧
        coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ Metric.ball z r) ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < δ₁ → |y b - z b| < δ₂ → y ∈ S → y b = w y)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hea : (e b) b = 1 := by simp [e]
  have he1 : ‖e b‖ = 1 := by simp [e]
  have hpa : ∀ q : E3, (coordPlaneProj b q) b = 0 := by
    intro q
    simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
  have hP3 : ∀ q : E3, coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b q) = coordPlaneProj b q := by
    intro q
    conv_lhs => rw [coordPlaneProj, hpa, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hP5 : ∀ (y z : E3),
      coordPlaneProj b (y - z) = coordPlaneProj b y - coordPlaneProj b z := by
    intro y z
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hP6 : ∀ u : E3, u = coordPlaneProj b u + (u b) • e b := by
    intro u
    simp [coordPlaneProj]
  have hPadd : ∀ (q : E3) (t : ℝ), coordPlaneProj b (q + t • e b) = coordPlaneProj b q := by
    intro q t
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hea, mul_one,
      add_smul]
    abel
  have hcoord : ∀ (q : E3) (t : ℝ), (coordPlaneProj b q + t • e b) b = t := by
    intro q t
    simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, hpa, hea, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add]
  
  obtain ⟨Pr, hPr⟩ : ∃ Pr : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ∀ v : E3, Pr v = v b :=
    ⟨EuclideanSpace.proj b, fun v => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Pb, hPb⟩ : ∃ Pb : E3 →L[ℝ] E3, ∀ v : E3, Pb v = coordPlaneProj b v :=
    ⟨ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - Pr.smulRight (e b), fun v => by
      simp [coordPlaneProj, hPr]⟩
  have hPbfun : (⇑Pb) = coordPlaneProj b := funext hPb
  have hPrfun : (⇑Pr) = fun v : E3 => v b := funext hPr
  have hPc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (coordPlaneProj b) := by
    rw [← hPbfun]; exact Pb.contDiff
  have hPrc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : E3 => v b) := by
    rw [← hPrfun]; exact Pr.contDiff
  
  have hderiv : ∀ y : E3, DifferentiableAt ℝ F y → fderiv ℝ F y (e b) ≠ 0 →
      ∃ f' : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3,
        HasFDerivAt (fun x => coordPlaneProj b x + F x • e b) (f' : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) y := by
    intro y hFd hd
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        ∀ u, L u = coordPlaneProj b u + fderiv ℝ F y u • e b :=
      ⟨Pb + (fderiv ℝ F y).smulRight (e b), fun u => by simp [hPb]⟩
    obtain ⟨Mi, hMi⟩ : ∃ Mi : E3 →L[ℝ] E3, ∀ v, Mi v = coordPlaneProj b v +
        ((fderiv ℝ F y (e b))⁻¹ * (v b - fderiv ℝ F y (coordPlaneProj b v))) • e b :=
      ⟨Pb + ((fderiv ℝ F y (e b))⁻¹ • (Pr - (fderiv ℝ F y).comp Pb)).smulRight (e b),
        fun v => by simp [hPb, hPr]⟩
    have hDsplit : ∀ u, fderiv ℝ F y u =
        fderiv ℝ F y (coordPlaneProj b u) + u b * fderiv ℝ F y (e b) := by
      intro u
      conv_lhs => rw [hP6 u]
      rw [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hLI : Function.LeftInverse Mi L := by
      intro u
      rw [hMi, hL, hPadd, hP3, hcoord, hDsplit u]
      have hc : (fderiv ℝ F y (e b))⁻¹ * (fderiv ℝ F y (coordPlaneProj b u) +
          u b * fderiv ℝ F y (e b) - fderiv ℝ F y (coordPlaneProj b u)) = u b := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [hc]
      exact (hP6 u).symm
    have hRI : Function.RightInverse Mi L := by
      intro v
      rw [hL, hMi, hPadd, hP3, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      have hc : fderiv ℝ F y (coordPlaneProj b v) + (fderiv ℝ F y (e b))⁻¹ *
          (v b - fderiv ℝ F y (coordPlaneProj b v)) * fderiv ℝ F y (e b) = v b := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [hc]
      exact (hP6 v).symm
    refine ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse L Mi hLI hRI, ?_⟩
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (coordPlaneProj b) Pb y := by
      rw [← hPbfun]; exact Pb.hasFDerivAt
    have h2 := hFd.hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e b)
    have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun x => coordPlaneProj b x + F x • e b)
        (Pb + (fderiv ℝ F y).smulRight (e b)) y := h1.add h2
    refine h3.congr_fderiv ?_
    ext1 u
    show (Pb + (fderiv ℝ F y).smulRight (e b)) u = L u
    rw [hL]
    simp [hPb]
  
  have hFz : F z = 0 := (hSF z (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).1 hz
  have hΨc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => coordPlaneProj b x + F x • e b) (Metric.ball z r) :=
    hPc.contDiffOn.add (hF.smul contDiffOn_const)
  have hΨat : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r,
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => coordPlaneProj b x + F x • e b) y :=
    fun y hy => hΨc.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy)
  have hFdiff : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, DifferentiableAt ℝ F y :=
    fun y hy => (hF.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  obtain ⟨f0, hf0⟩ := hderiv z (hFdiff z (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)) hb
  have hΨz := hΨat z (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ, hzΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph E3 E3,
      (⇑Φ = fun x => coordPlaneProj b x + F x • e b) ∧ z ∈ Φ.source :=
    ⟨ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph _ hΨz hf0 (by simp),
      ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe hΨz hf0 (by simp),
      ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hΨz hf0 (by simp)⟩
  have hcontD : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ F) (Metric.ball z r) :=
    hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball (by simp)
  have hcz : ContinuousAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e b)) z :=
    (hcontD.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))).clm_apply
      continuousAt_const
  have hG : {y | fderiv ℝ F y (e b) ≠ 0 ∧ y ∈ Metric.ball z r} ∩ Φ.source ∈ 𝓝 z :=
    Filter.inter_mem ((hcz.eventually_ne hb).and
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))) (Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hzΦ)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεG⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hG
  have hsm : ∀ q ∈ Φ.target, Φ.symm q ∈ Metric.ball z ε → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Φ.symm q := by
    intro q hq hqε
    obtain ⟨⟨hd, hr'⟩, -⟩ := hεG hqε
    obtain ⟨f', hf'⟩ := hderiv _ (hFdiff _ hr') hd
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (⇑Φ) (f' : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (Φ.symm q) := by rw [hΦ]; exact hf'
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (⇑Φ) (Φ.symm q) := by rw [hΦ]; exact hΨat _ hr'
    exact Φ.contDiffAt_symm hq h1 h2
  
  have hΦz : Φ z = coordPlaneProj b z := by
    rw [hΦ]; simp only [hFz, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have hq₀t : coordPlaneProj b z ∈ Φ.target := hΦz ▸ Φ.map_source hzΦ
  have hsymm₀ : Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b z) = z := by
    rw [← hΦz]; exact Φ.left_inv hzΦ
  have hε2 : 0 < ε / 2 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hη₁'⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (Φ.continuousAt_symm hq₀t) (ε / 2) hε2
  obtain ⟨η₂, hη₂, hη₂'⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp Φ.open_target _ hq₀t
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁pos, hδ₁η₁, hδ₁η₂, hδ₁ε⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ η₁ ∧ δ ≤ η₂ ∧ δ ≤ ε / 2 :=
    ⟨min (min η₁ η₂) (ε / 2), lt_min (lt_min hη₁ hη₂) hε2,
      le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _),
      le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _), min_le_right _ _⟩
  have hK : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < δ₁ →
      coordPlaneProj b y ∈ Φ.target ∧ ‖Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y) - z‖ < ε / 2 := by
    intro y hy
    have hd : dist (coordPlaneProj b y) (coordPlaneProj b z) = ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, hP5]
    refine ⟨hη₂' ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, hd]; linarith
    · have h := hη₁' (show dist (coordPlaneProj b y) (coordPlaneProj b z) < η₁ by
        rw [hd]; linarith)
      rw [hsymm₀, dist_eq_norm] at h
      exact h
  have hgraph : ∀ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < δ₁ →
      F (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y)) = 0 ∧
      coordPlaneProj b y + (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y)) b • e b =
        Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hq, -⟩ := hK y hy
    have h1 : coordPlaneProj b (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y)) +
        F (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y)) • e b = coordPlaneProj b y := by
      have := Φ.right_inv hq
      rw [hΦ] at this
      exact this
    have hF0 : F (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y)) = 0 := by
      have h2 := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v b) h1
      simp only [hcoord, hpa] at h2
      exact h2
    refine ⟨hF0, ?_⟩
    rw [hF0, zero_smul, add_zero] at h1
    conv_rhs => rw [hP6 (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y))]
    rw [h1]
  refine ⟨δ₁, hδ₁pos, ε / 2, hε2, fun y => (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y)) b,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    simp only [hP3]
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hq, hx⟩ := hK y hy
    have hxε : Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y) ∈ Metric.ball z ε := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; linarith
    have h1 := hPrc.contDiffAt.comp y ((hsm _ hq hxε).comp y hPc.contDiffAt)
    exact h1.contDiffWithinAt
  · show (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b z)) b = z b
    rw [hsymm₀]
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hq, hx⟩ := hK y hy
    obtain ⟨hF0, hgr⟩ := hgraph y hy
    have hxε : Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y) ∈ Metric.ball z ε := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; linarith
    obtain ⟨⟨-, hxr⟩, -⟩ := hεG hxε
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h := PiLp.norm_apply_le (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y) - z) b
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, PiLp.sub_apply] at h
      show |(Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y)) b - z b| < ε / 2
      linarith
    · show coordPlaneProj b y + (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y)) b • e b ∈ S
      rw [hgr]; exact (hSF _ hxr).2 hF0
    · show coordPlaneProj b y + (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y)) b • e b ∈ Metric.ball z r
      rw [hgr]; exact hxr
  · intro y hy hyb hyS
    have hnorm : ‖y - z‖ ≤ ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ + |y b - z b| := by
      have h := norm_add_le (coordPlaneProj b (y - z)) ((y - z) b • e b)
      rw [← hP6 (y - z), norm_smul, he1, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, PiLp.sub_apply] at h
      exact h
    have hyε : y ∈ Metric.ball z ε := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; linarith
    obtain ⟨⟨-, hyr⟩, hys⟩ := hεG hyε
    have hFy : F y = 0 := (hSF y hyr).1 hyS
    have hΦy : Φ y = coordPlaneProj b y := by
      rw [hΦ]; simp only [hFy, zero_smul, add_zero]
    show y b = (Φ.symm (coordPlaneProj b y)) b
    rw [← hΦy, Φ.left_inv hys]

informal_problem.statement:
(S : Set E3) (x : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) (hSF : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, y ∈ S → F y = 0)
    (b : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hwd : DifferentiableAt ℝ w x) (hx : x b = w x) (r' : ℝ) (hr' : 0 < r')
    (hgr : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < r' → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S) :
    (∀ u, fderiv ℝ F x u = fderiv ℝ F x (e b) * (u b - fderiv ℝ w x u)) ∧
    (fderiv ℝ F x ≠ 0 → fderiv ℝ F x (e b) ≠ 0)

signature.name: graph_tangent_identity
signature.statement:
(S : Set E3) (x : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) (hSF : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, y ∈ S → F y = 0)
    (b : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hwd : DifferentiableAt ℝ w x) (hx : x b = w x) (r' : ℝ) (hr' : 0 < r')
    (hgr : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < r' → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S) :
    (∀ u, fderiv ℝ F x u = fderiv ℝ F x (e b) * (u b - fderiv ℝ w x u)) ∧
    (fderiv ℝ F x ≠ 0 → fderiv ℝ F x (e b) ≠ 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hγx : coordPlaneProj b x + w x • e b = x := by
    rw [← hx]; simp [coordPlaneProj]
  let L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 -
    (EuclideanSpace.proj b : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e b) + (fderiv ℝ w x).smulRight (e b)
  have hLu : ∀ u, L u = u - (u b) • e b + (fderiv ℝ w x u) • e b := by
    intro u; rfl
  have hγ : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b) L x := by
    have h1 := ((hasFDerivAt_id x).sub
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj b : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt).smul_const (e b))).add
      (hwd.hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e b))
    refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    simp [coordPlaneProj]
  have hcont : Continuous (fun y : E3 => ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖) := by
    unfold coordPlaneProj; fun_prop
  have hU1 : {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < r'} ∈ 𝓝 x :=
    (isOpen_lt hcont continuous_const).mem_nhds (by simp [coordPlaneProj, hr'])
  have hU2 : (fun y : E3 => coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b) ⁻¹' Metric.ball x r ∈ 𝓝 x := by
    apply hγ.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
    rw [hγx]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds x hr
  have hev : (F ∘ fun y : E3 => coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [hU1, hU2] with y hy1 hy2
    exact hSF _ hy2 (hgr y hy1)
  have hF' : HasFDerivAt F (fderiv ℝ F x) (coordPlaneProj b x + w x • e b) := by
    rw [hγx]; exact hFd.hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp := hF'.comp x hγ
  have h0 : (fderiv ℝ F x).comp L = 0 :=
    hcomp.unique ((hasFDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev)
  have key : ∀ u, fderiv ℝ F x u = fderiv ℝ F x (e b) * (u b - fderiv ℝ w x u) := by
    intro u
    have h := congrArg (fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T u) h0
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, hLu, map_add,
      map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
    linear_combination h
  refine ⟨key, fun hne h0' => hne ?_⟩
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun u => ?_
  rw [key u, h0', zero_mul]
  rfl

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R0 : ℝ) (S : Set E3)
    (hS2 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∃ r > 0, ∃ F : E3 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0))
    (b : Fin 3) (U : Set E3) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hUc : IsPreconnected U)
    (hUs : ∀ y, y ∈ U ↔ coordPlaneProj b y ∈ U) (w₁ w₂ : E3 → ℝ)
    (hw₁ : ∀ y, w₁ (coordPlaneProj b y) = w₁ y) (hw₂ : ∀ y, w₂ (coordPlaneProj b y) = w₂ y)
    (hd₁ : DifferentiableOn ℝ w₁ U) (hc₂ : ContinuousOn w₂ U)
    (hg₁ : ∀ y ∈ U, coordPlaneProj b y + w₁ y • e b ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0)
    (hg₂ : ∀ y ∈ U, coordPlaneProj b y + w₂ y • e b ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0)
    (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (h₀ : w₁ y₀ = w₂ y₀) :
    ∀ y ∈ U, w₁ y = w₂ y

signature.name: sheet_uniqueness
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R0 : ℝ) (S : Set E3)
    (hS2 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∃ r > 0, ∃ F : E3 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0))
    (b : Fin 3) (U : Set E3) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hUc : IsPreconnected U)
    (hUs : ∀ y, y ∈ U ↔ coordPlaneProj b y ∈ U) (w₁ w₂ : E3 → ℝ)
    (hw₁ : ∀ y, w₁ (coordPlaneProj b y) = w₁ y) (hw₂ : ∀ y, w₂ (coordPlaneProj b y) = w₂ y)
    (hd₁ : DifferentiableOn ℝ w₁ U) (hc₂ : ContinuousOn w₂ U)
    (hg₁ : ∀ y ∈ U, coordPlaneProj b y + w₁ y • e b ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0)
    (hg₂ : ∀ y ∈ U, coordPlaneProj b y + w₂ y • e b ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0)
    (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (h₀ : w₁ y₀ = w₂ y₀) :
    ∀ y ∈ U, w₁ y = w₂ y

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have graph_tangent_identity : ∀ (S : Set E3) (x : E3) (r : ℝ) (_hr : 0 < r) (F : E3 → ℝ)
      (_hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) (_hSF : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, y ∈ S → F y = 0)
      (b : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (_hw : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
      (_hwd : DifferentiableAt ℝ w x) (_hx : x b = w x) (r' : ℝ) (_hr' : 0 < r')
      (_hgr : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < r' → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S),
      (∀ u, fderiv ℝ F x u = fderiv ℝ F x (e b) * (u b - fderiv ℝ w x u)) ∧
      (fderiv ℝ F x ≠ 0 → fderiv ℝ F x (e b) ≠ 0) := by
    intro S x r hr F hFd hSF b w _ hwd hx r' hr' hgr
    have hγx : coordPlaneProj b x + w x • e b = x := by
      rw [← hx]; simp [coordPlaneProj]
    let L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 -
      (EuclideanSpace.proj b : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e b) + (fderiv ℝ w x).smulRight (e b)
    have hLu : ∀ u, L u = u - (u b) • e b + (fderiv ℝ w x u) • e b := by
      intro u; rfl
    have hγ : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b) L x := by
      have h1 := ((hasFDerivAt_id x).sub
        (((EuclideanSpace.proj b : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt).smul_const (e b))).add
        (hwd.hasFDerivAt.smul_const (e b))
      refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
      simp [coordPlaneProj]
    have hcont : Continuous (fun y : E3 => ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖) := by
      unfold coordPlaneProj; fun_prop
    have hU1 : {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < r'} ∈ 𝓝 x :=
      (isOpen_lt hcont continuous_const).mem_nhds (by simp [coordPlaneProj, hr'])
    have hU2 : (fun y : E3 => coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b) ⁻¹' Metric.ball x r ∈ 𝓝 x := by
      apply hγ.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
      rw [hγx]; exact Metric.ball_mem_nhds x hr
    have hev : (F ∘ fun y : E3 => coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hU1, hU2] with y hy1 hy2
      exact hSF _ hy2 (hgr y hy1)
    have hF' : HasFDerivAt F (fderiv ℝ F x) (coordPlaneProj b x + w x • e b) := by
      rw [hγx]; exact hFd.hasFDerivAt
    have hcomp := hF'.comp x hγ
    have h0 : (fderiv ℝ F x).comp L = 0 :=
      hcomp.unique ((hasFDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev)
    have key : ∀ u, fderiv ℝ F x u = fderiv ℝ F x (e b) * (u b - fderiv ℝ w x u) := by
      intro u
      have h := congrArg (fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T u) h0
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, hLu, map_add,
        map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
      linear_combination h
    refine ⟨key, fun hne h0' => hne ?_⟩
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun u => ?_
    rw [key u, h0', zero_mul]
    rfl
  
  have hPt : ∀ (y : E3) (t : ℝ), (coordPlaneProj b y + t • e b) b = t := by
    intro y t
    simp [coordPlaneProj, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPP : ∀ (y : E3) (t : ℝ),
      coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b y + t • e b) = coordPlaneProj b y := by
    intro y t
    show (coordPlaneProj b y + t • e b) - (coordPlaneProj b y + t • e b) b • e b =
      coordPlaneProj b y
    rw [hPt]
    abel
  have hPsub : ∀ y' y : E3,
      coordPlaneProj b (y' - y) = coordPlaneProj b y' - coordPlaneProj b y := by
    intro y' y
    show (y' - y) - (y' - y) b • e b = (y' - y' b • e b) - (y - y b • e b)
    rw [PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hPc : Continuous (coordPlaneProj b) := by
    unfold coordPlaneProj
    fun_prop
  
  have hopen : ∀ y ∈ U, w₁ y = w₂ y → ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 y, w₁ x = w₂ x := by
    intro y hy hyy
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : E3, z = coordPlaneProj b y + w₁ y • e b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hzSB : z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0 := by rw [hz]; exact hg₁ y hy
    obtain ⟨r, hr, F, hF, hF0, hSF⟩ := hS2 z hzSB
    have hFdOn : DifferentiableOn ℝ F (Metric.ball z r) := hF.differentiableOn (by simp)
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z :=
      hFdOn.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))
    have hPz : coordPlaneProj b z = coordPlaneProj b y := by rw [hz, hPP]
    have hPyU : coordPlaneProj b y ∈ U := (hUs y).1 hy
    have hzU : z ∈ U := (hUs z).2 (by rw [hPz]; exact hPyU)
    have hwd : DifferentiableAt ℝ w₁ z := hd₁.differentiableAt (hUo.mem_nhds hzU)
    have hzb : z b = w₁ z := by
      rw [← hw₁ z, hPz, hw₁ y, hz, hPt]
    obtain ⟨r', hr', hball'⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hUo _ hPyU
    have hgr : ∀ y', ‖coordPlaneProj b (y' - z)‖ < r' →
        coordPlaneProj b y' + w₁ y' • e b ∈ S := by
      intro y' hy'
      rw [hPsub, hPz] at hy'
      have h1 : coordPlaneProj b y' ∈ U :=
        hball' (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; exact hy')
      exact (hg₁ y' ((hUs y').2 h1)).1
    have hSF' : ∀ y' ∈ Metric.ball z r, y' ∈ S → F y' = 0 := fun y' h hS => (hSF y' h).1 hS
    have hzb' : fderiv ℝ F z (e b) ≠ 0 :=
      (graph_tangent_identity S z r hr F hFd hSF' b w₁ hw₁ hwd hzb r' hr' hgr).2
        (hF0 z (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))
    
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x (e b)) (Metric.ball z r) :=
      (hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball (by simp)).clm_apply
        continuousOn_const
    have hev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 z, fderiv ℝ F x (e b) ≠ 0 :=
      (hcont.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))).eventually_ne
        hzb'
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεb⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.1 hev
    have hρpos : 0 < min ε r := lt_min hε hr
    have hsubr : Metric.ball z (min ε r) ⊆ Metric.ball z r :=
      Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
    have hρ : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z (min ε r), fderiv ℝ F x (e b) ≠ 0 :=
      fun x hx => hεb x (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hx)
    
    have hK : ∀ (p : E3) (a c' : ℝ), a < c' → p + a • e b ∈ Metric.ball z (min ε r) →
        p + c' • e b ∈ Metric.ball z (min ε r) → F (p + a • e b) = 0 →
        F (p + c' • e b) = 0 → False := by
      intro p a c' hac ha hc hFa hFc
      have hseg : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a c', p + t • e b ∈ Metric.ball z (min ε r) := by
        intro t ht
        have hl : (t - a) / (c' - a) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
          constructor
          · exact div_nonneg (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith)
          · rw [div_le_one (by linarith)]
            linarith [ht.2]
        have hm := (convex_ball z (min ε r)).add_smul_sub_mem ha hc hl
        have hca : c' - a ≠ 0 := by linarith
        have hdiff : p + c' • e b - (p + a • e b) = (c' - a) • e b := by
          rw [sub_smul]
          abel
        have hat : a + (t - a) = t := by ring
        have heq : p + a • e b + ((t - a) / (c' - a)) • (p + c' • e b - (p + a • e b)) =
            p + t • e b := by
          rw [hdiff, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hca, add_assoc, ← add_smul, hat]
        rwa [heq] at hm
      have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a c',
          HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (p + s • e b)) (fderiv ℝ F (p + t • e b) (e b)) t := by
        intro t ht
        have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => p + s • e b) ((1 : ℝ) • e b) t :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id' t).smul_const (e b)).const_add p
        rw [one_smul] at hγ
        have hFt : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (p + t • e b) :=
          hFdOn.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hsubr (hseg t ht)))
        exact hFt.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hγ
      obtain ⟨t, ht, ht0⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero (f := fun s : ℝ => F (p + s • e b))
        (f' := fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ F (p + s • e b) (e b)) hac
        (fun t ht => (hderiv t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
        (by show F (p + a • e b) = F (p + c' • e b); rw [hFa, hFc])
        (fun t ht => hderiv t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht))
      exact hρ _ (hseg t (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)) ht0
    
    have hw₁c : ContinuousAt w₁ y := (hd₁.differentiableAt (hUo.mem_nhds hy)).continuousAt
    have hw₂c : ContinuousAt w₂ y := hc₂.continuousAt (hUo.mem_nhds hy)
    have hγ₁ : ContinuousAt (fun x => coordPlaneProj b x + w₁ x • e b) y :=
      hPc.continuousAt.add (hw₁c.smul continuousAt_const)
    have hγ₂ : ContinuousAt (fun x => coordPlaneProj b x + w₂ x • e b) y :=
      hPc.continuousAt.add (hw₂c.smul continuousAt_const)
    have hz1 : (fun x => coordPlaneProj b x + w₁ x • e b) y ∈ Metric.ball z (min ε r) := by
      show coordPlaneProj b y + w₁ y • e b ∈ Metric.ball z (min ε r)
      rw [← hz]
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self hρpos
    have hz2 : (fun x => coordPlaneProj b x + w₂ x • e b) y ∈ Metric.ball z (min ε r) := by
      show coordPlaneProj b y + w₂ y • e b ∈ Metric.ball z (min ε r)
      rw [← hyy, ← hz]
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self hρpos
    filter_upwards [hγ₁.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz1),
      hγ₂.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz2), hUo.mem_nhds hy]
      with x hx1 hx2 hxU
    have hx1' : coordPlaneProj b x + w₁ x • e b ∈ Metric.ball z (min ε r) := hx1
    have hx2' : coordPlaneProj b x + w₂ x • e b ∈ Metric.ball z (min ε r) := hx2
    have hF1 : F (coordPlaneProj b x + w₁ x • e b) = 0 := (hSF _ (hsubr hx1')).1 (hg₁ x hxU).1
    have hF2 : F (coordPlaneProj b x + w₂ x • e b) = 0 := (hSF _ (hsubr hx2')).1 (hg₂ x hxU).1
    rcases lt_trichotomy (w₁ x) (w₂ x) with h | h | h
    · exact (hK _ _ _ h hx1' hx2' hF1 hF2).elim
    · exact h
    · exact (hK _ _ _ h hx2' hx1' hF2 hF1).elim
  
  intro y₁ hy₁
  by_contra hne
  have hu : IsOpen {x | ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, w₁ x' = w₂ x'} := isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds
  have hv : IsOpen (U ∩ (fun x => w₁ x - w₂ x) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) :=
    (hd₁.continuousOn.sub hc₂).isOpen_inter_preimage hUo isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hcover : U ⊆ {x | ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, w₁ x' = w₂ x'} ∪
      (U ∩ (fun x => w₁ x - w₂ x) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases h : w₁ x = w₂ x
    · exact Or.inl (hopen x hx h)
    · refine Or.inr ⟨hx, ?_⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      exact fun h' => h (sub_eq_zero.1 h')
  have hy₁v : y₁ ∈ U ∩ (fun x => w₁ x - w₂ x) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ := by
    refine ⟨hy₁, ?_⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    exact fun h' => hne (sub_eq_zero.1 h')
  obtain ⟨x, hxU, hxu, hxv⟩ := hUc _ _ hu hv hcover ⟨y₀, hy₀, hopen y₀ hy₀ h₀⟩ ⟨y₁, hy₁, hy₁v⟩
  have hx2 := hxv.2
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx2
  have hxu' : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, w₁ x' = w₂ x' := hxu
  exact hx2 (sub_eq_zero.2 hxu'.self_of_nhds)

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R0 K : ℝ) (S : Set E3) (hR0 : 0 < R0) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hS3 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∀ (b : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z) → (∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) →
      z b = w (coordPlaneProj b z) →
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r →
        coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b ∈ S) →
      ‖fderiv ℝ w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ 2 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ K)
    (b : Fin 3) (z0 : E3) (hz0c : ‖z0 - c‖ < R0 / 4) (r s : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hKr : K * r ≤ 1 / 8) (hrR : 4 * r ≤ R0) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs : s ≤ 7 / 4)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hwc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < r}) (hwz : w z0 = z0 b)
    (hgr : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < r → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S)
    (hd0 : ‖fderiv ℝ w z0‖ ≤ s) :
    ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < r →
      ‖fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ s + K * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w y‖ ≤ K ∧
      |w y - z0 b| ≤ (s + 1 / 8) * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ ∧
      coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ Metric.ball c R0
