proof.tactics:
by
  intro y hy
  
  have hea : (e b) b = 1 := by simp [e]
  have hpa : ∀ q : E3, (coordPlaneProj b q) b = 0 := by
    intro q
    simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
  have hP3 : ∀ q : E3, coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b q) = coordPlaneProj b q := by
    intro q
    conv_lhs => rw [coordPlaneProj, hpa, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hP6 : ∀ u : E3, u = coordPlaneProj b u + (u b) • e b := by
    intro u
    simp [coordPlaneProj]
  have hP5 : ∀ (u v : E3), coordPlaneProj b (u - v) = coordPlaneProj b u - coordPlaneProj b v := by
    intro u v
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hPadd : ∀ (u v : E3),
      coordPlaneProj b (u + v) = coordPlaneProj b u + coordPlaneProj b v := by
    intro u v
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, add_smul]
    abel
  have hPsmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (u : E3), coordPlaneProj b (a • u) = a • coordPlaneProj b u := by
    intro a u
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  have hPe : coordPlaneProj b (e b) = 0 := by
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, hea, one_smul, sub_self]
  have hne : ∀ a : ℝ, ‖a • e b‖ = |a| := by
    intro a
    rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hcontP : Continuous (coordPlaneProj b) := by
    unfold coordPlaneProj
    fun_prop
  have hC : IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < r} :=
    isOpen_lt (hcontP.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm continuous_const
  
  have htrans : ∀ x : E3, (fun v => w (v + (-(x b)) • e b)) = w := by
    intro x
    funext v
    have h1 : coordPlaneProj b (v + (-(x b)) • e b) = coordPlaneProj b v := by
      rw [hPadd, hPsmul, hPe, smul_zero, add_zero]
    show w (v + (-(x b)) • e b) = w v
    rw [← hw (v + (-(x b)) • e b), h1, hw]
  have hPx : ∀ x : E3, x + (-(x b)) • e b = coordPlaneProj b x := by
    intro x
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, neg_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hDtr : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ w x = fderiv ℝ w (coordPlaneProj b x) := by
    intro x
    conv_lhs => rw [← htrans x]
    rw [fderiv_comp_add_right, hPx]
  have hD2tr : ∀ x, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w x = iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b x) := by
    intro x
    conv_lhs => rw [← htrans x]
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_right, hPx]
  
  have hcd : ∀ p : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0)‖ < r → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ w p :=
    fun p hp => hwc.contDiffAt (hC.mem_nhds hp)
  have hdiff : ∀ p : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0)‖ < r → DifferentiableAt ℝ w p :=
    fun p hp => (hcd p hp).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have h11 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ∞ := by
    rw [one_add_one_eq_two]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
  have hdiff2 : ∀ p : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0)‖ < r →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) p :=
    fun p hp => ((hcd p hp).fderiv_right (m := 1) h11).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hcontD : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ w) {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < r} :=
    hwc.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hC (by simp)
  have hHess : ∀ p : E3, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) p‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w p‖ := by
    intro p
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one (f := fderiv ℝ w), norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
  
  have mvt : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (G : E3 → F) (x d : E3)
      (t M : ℝ), 0 ≤ t →
      (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t, DifferentiableAt ℝ G (x + u • d)) →
      (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t, ‖fderiv ℝ G (x + u • d)‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖G (x + t • d) - G x‖ ≤ M * (t * ‖d‖) := by
    intro F _ _ G x d t M ht hd hb
    have hseg : ∀ p ∈ segment ℝ x (x + t • d), ∃ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t, p = x + u • d := by
      intro p hp
      rw [segment_eq_image'] at hp
      obtain ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩ := hp
      refine ⟨θ * t, ⟨mul_nonneg hθ.1 ht, mul_le_of_le_one_left ht hθ.2⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul]
    have h := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := G) (C := M)
      (fun p hp => by obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hseg p hp; exact hd u hu)
      (fun p hp => by obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hseg p hp; exact hb u hu)
      (convex_segment x (x + t • d)) (left_mem_segment ℝ x (x + t • d))
      (right_mem_segment ℝ x (x + t • d))
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht] at h
  
  have boot : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (A B : ℝ), A < B → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc 0 1) → f 0 ≤ A →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t, f u ≤ B) → f t ≤ A) →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f t ≤ A := by
    intro f A B hAB hf h0 hstep
    have claim : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, f t < B := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have hTne : (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici B).Nonempty := by
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hft⟩ := hcon
        exact ⟨t, ht, hft⟩
      have hTc : IsClosed (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici B) :=
        hf.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc isClosed_Ici
      have hTb : BddBelow (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici B) := ⟨0, fun x hx => hx.1.1⟩
      have hτ : sInf (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici B) ∈
          Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici B := hTc.csInf_mem hTne hTb
      obtain ⟨τ, hτdef⟩ : ∃ τ, τ = sInf (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Ici B) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hτdef] at hτ
      have hτ1 : 0 ≤ τ := hτ.1.1
      have hτ2 : τ ≤ 1 := hτ.1.2
      have hτ3 : B ≤ f τ := hτ.2
      have hbelow : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, u < τ → f u < B := by
        intro u hu huτ
        by_contra hfu
        push_neg at hfu
        have : τ ≤ u := by rw [hτdef]; exact csInf_le hTb ⟨hu, hfu⟩
        linarith
      have hτ0 : 0 < τ := by
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hτ1 with h | h
        · exfalso
          rw [← h] at hτ3
          linarith
        · exact h
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδf⟩ := Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff.mp (hf τ hτ.1) (B - A) (by linarith)
      have hu0a : 0 ≤ max 0 (τ - δ / 2) := le_max_left _ _
      have hu0c : τ - δ / 2 ≤ max 0 (τ - δ / 2) := le_max_right _ _
      have hu0b : max 0 (τ - δ / 2) < τ := max_lt hτ0 (by linarith)
      have hu0I : max 0 (τ - δ / 2) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hu0a, by linarith⟩
      have hdist : dist (max 0 (τ - δ / 2)) τ < δ := by
        rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith
      have h1 := hδf hu0I hdist
      have h2 : f (max 0 (τ - δ / 2)) ≤ A :=
        hstep _ hu0I (fun v hv => le_of_lt (hbelow v ⟨hv.1, by linarith [hv.2]⟩
          (by linarith [hv.2])))
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at h1
      linarith [h1.1]
    intro t ht
    exact hstep t ht (fun u hu => le_of_lt (claim u ⟨hu.1, le_trans hu.2 ht.2⟩))
  
  have hess : ∀ p : E3, coordPlaneProj b p = p → ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0)‖ < r →
      ‖fderiv ℝ w p‖ ≤ 2 → |w p - z0 b| ≤ 2 * ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0)‖ →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w p‖ ≤ K := by
    intro p hpp hpC hpd hph
    have hxS : coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b ∈ S := hgr p hpC
    have hPx' : coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b) = p := by
      rw [hPadd, hPsmul, hPe, smul_zero, add_zero, hP3, hpp]
    have hxz : coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b - z0 =
        coordPlaneProj b (p - z0) + (w p - z0 b) • e b := by
      rw [hP5, sub_smul]
      conv_lhs => rw [hP6 z0]
      abel
    have hxn : ‖coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b - z0‖ ≤ 3 * ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0)‖ := by
      rw [hxz]
      calc ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0) + (w p - z0 b) • e b‖
          ≤ ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0)‖ + ‖(w p - z0 b) • e b‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0)‖ + |w p - z0 b| := by rw [hne]
        _ ≤ 3 * ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0)‖ := by linarith
    have hxball : coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b ∈ Metric.ball c R0 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      have h1 := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b) z0 c
      linarith
    have hcd' : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b)) := by
      rw [hPx']
      exact (hcd p hpC).of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
    have hxb : (coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b) b =
        w (coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b)) := by
      rw [hPx']
      simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, hpa, hea, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add]
    have hgr' : ∀ y', ‖coordPlaneProj b (y' - (coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b))‖ <
        r - ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0)‖ →
        coordPlaneProj b y' + w (coordPlaneProj b y') • e b ∈ S := by
      intro y' hy'
      rw [hw]
      apply hgr
      have e1 : coordPlaneProj b (y' - z0) =
          coordPlaneProj b (y' - (coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b)) +
            coordPlaneProj b (p - z0) := by
        rw [hP5 y' z0, hP5 y' (coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b), hP5 p z0, hPx', hpp]
        abel
      rw [e1]
      linarith [norm_add_le (coordPlaneProj b (y' - (coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b)))
        (coordPlaneProj b (p - z0))]
    have hpd' : ‖fderiv ℝ w (coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b p + w p • e b))‖ ≤ 2 := by
      rw [hPx']; exact hpd
    have h := hS3 _ ⟨hxS, hxball⟩ b w (r - ‖coordPlaneProj b (p - z0)‖) (by linarith) hcd' hw
      hxb hgr' hpd'
    rwa [hPx'] at h
  
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d : E3, d = coordPlaneProj b (y - z0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨q0, hq0⟩ : ∃ q0 : E3, q0 = coordPlaneProj b z0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = ‖d‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := by rw [hL]; exact norm_nonneg _
  have hLy : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ = L := by rw [hL, hd]
  have hLr : L < r := by rw [← hLy]; exact hy
  have hdP : coordPlaneProj b d = d := by rw [hd, hP3]
  have hq0P : coordPlaneProj b q0 = q0 := by rw [hq0, hP3]
  have hqP : ∀ u : ℝ, coordPlaneProj b (q0 + u • d) = q0 + u • d := by
    intro u
    rw [hPadd, hPsmul, hdP, hq0P]
  have hqz : ∀ u : ℝ, coordPlaneProj b (q0 + u • d - z0) = u • d := by
    intro u
    rw [hP5, hqP, ← hq0, add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hqn : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖coordPlaneProj b (q0 + u • d - z0)‖ = u * L := by
    intro u hu
    rw [hqz, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hu.1, hL]
  have huL : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, u * L ≤ L := by
    intro u hu
    calc u * L ≤ 1 * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu.2 hL0
      _ = L := one_mul L
  have hqC : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖coordPlaneProj b (q0 + u • d - z0)‖ < r := by
    intro u hu
    rw [hqn u hu]
    linarith [huL u hu]
  have hq1 : q0 + (1 : ℝ) • d = coordPlaneProj b y := by
    rw [one_smul, hd, hq0, hP5, add_sub_cancel]
  have hwq0 : w q0 = z0 b := by rw [hq0, hw z0, hwz]
  have hDq0 : fderiv ℝ w q0 = fderiv ℝ w z0 := by rw [hq0, ← hDtr z0]
  have hKuL : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, K * (u * L) ≤ 1 / 8 := by
    intro u hu
    have h1 : u * L ≤ r := by linarith [huL u hu]
    have h2 : K * (u * L) ≤ K * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hK
    linarith
  have hfc : ContinuousOn (fun u : ℝ => ‖fderiv ℝ w (q0 + u • d)‖) (Set.Icc 0 1) := by
    have hm : Set.MapsTo (fun u : ℝ => q0 + u • d) (Set.Icc 0 1)
        {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < r} := fun u hu => hqC u hu
    have hcm : Continuous (fun u : ℝ => q0 + u • d) := by fun_prop
    exact (hcontD.comp hcm.continuousOn hm).norm
  
  have est : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      (∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t, ‖fderiv ℝ w (q0 + u • d)‖ ≤ 2) →
      ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t,
        |w (q0 + u • d) - z0 b| ≤ 2 * (u * L) ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w (q0 + u • d)‖ ≤ K ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ w (q0 + u • d)‖ ≤ s + K * (u * L) := by
    intro t ht H
    have E1 : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t, |w (q0 + u • d) - z0 b| ≤ 2 * (u * L) := by
      intro u hu
      have h := mvt w q0 d u 2 hu.1
        (fun v hv => hdiff _ (hqC v ⟨hv.1, by linarith [hv.2, hu.2, ht.2]⟩))
        (fun v hv => H v ⟨hv.1, le_trans hv.2 hu.2⟩)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hwq0, ← hL] at h
      exact h
    have E2 : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) t, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w (q0 + u • d)‖ ≤ K := by
      intro u hu
      have hu1 : u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hu.1, le_trans hu.2 ht.2⟩
      apply hess (q0 + u • d) (hqP u) (hqC u hu1) (H u hu)
      rw [hqn u hu1]
      exact E1 u hu
    intro u hu
    refine ⟨E1 u hu, E2 u hu, ?_⟩
    have h := mvt (fderiv ℝ w) q0 d u K hu.1
      (fun v hv => hdiff2 _ (hqC v ⟨hv.1, by linarith [hv.2, hu.2, ht.2]⟩))
      (fun v hv => by rw [hHess]; exact E2 v ⟨hv.1, le_trans hv.2 hu.2⟩)
    rw [← hL] at h
    have h2 : ‖fderiv ℝ w q0‖ ≤ s := by rw [hDq0]; exact hd0
    have h3 := norm_sub_norm_le (fderiv ℝ w (q0 + u • d)) (fderiv ℝ w q0)
    linarith
  
  have hf0 : (fun u : ℝ => ‖fderiv ℝ w (q0 + u • d)‖) 0 ≤ 15 / 8 := by
    show ‖fderiv ℝ w (q0 + (0 : ℝ) • d)‖ ≤ 15 / 8
    rw [zero_smul, add_zero, hDq0]
    linarith
  have hall := boot (fun u : ℝ => ‖fderiv ℝ w (q0 + u • d)‖) (15 / 8) 2 (by norm_num) hfc hf0
    (fun t ht H => by
      show ‖fderiv ℝ w (q0 + t • d)‖ ≤ 15 / 8
      have h1 := (est t ht H t ⟨ht.1, le_refl t⟩).2.2
      have h2 := hKuL t ht
      linarith)
  have H1 : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ w (q0 + u • d)‖ ≤ 2 := by
    intro u hu
    have := hall u hu
    simp only at this
    linarith
  have hE := est 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_refl 1⟩ H1
  have h1I : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨zero_le_one, le_refl 1⟩
  
  have hdrift : |w y - z0 b| ≤ (s + 1 / 8) * L := by
    have h := mvt w q0 d 1 (s + 1 / 8) zero_le_one
      (fun v hv => hdiff _ (hqC v hv))
      (fun v hv => by
        have h1 := (hE v hv).2.2
        have h2 := hKuL v hv
        linarith)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, one_mul, ← hL, hq1, hw y, hwq0] at h
    exact h
  rw [hLy]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hdrift, ?_⟩
  · 
    rw [hDtr y, ← hq1]
    have h := (hE 1 h1I).2.2
    rwa [one_mul] at h
  · 
    rw [hD2tr y, ← hq1]
    exact (hE 1 h1I).2.1
  · 
    have hgz : coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b - z0 = d + (w y - z0 b) • e b := by
      rw [hd, hP5, sub_smul]
      conv_lhs => rw [hP6 z0]
      abel
    have hgn : ‖coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b - z0‖ ≤ 3 * L := by
      rw [hgz]
      have h1 : (s + 1 / 8) * L ≤ 2 * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hL0
      calc ‖d + (w y - z0 b) • e b‖ ≤ ‖d‖ + ‖(w y - z0 b) • e b‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = L + |w y - z0 b| := by rw [hne, hL]
        _ ≤ 3 * L := by linarith
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    have h1 := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b) z0 c
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R0 K : ℝ) (S : Set E3) (hR0 : 0 < R0) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hS1 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R0, z ∈ closure S → z ∈ S)
    (hS2 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∃ r > 0, ∃ F : E3 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0))
    (hS3 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∀ (b : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z) → (∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) →
      z b = w (coordPlaneProj b z) →
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r →
        coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b ∈ S) →
      ‖fderiv ℝ w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ 2 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ K)
    (b : Fin 3) (z0 : E3) (hz0c : ‖z0 - c‖ < R0 / 4) (r1 s : ℝ) (hr1 : 0 < r1)
    (hKr1 : K * r1 ≤ 1 / 8) (h4r1 : 4 * r1 ≤ R0) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs : s ≤ 7 / 4)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hRr : R < r1) (w : E3 → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hwc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R}) (hwz : w z0 = z0 b)
    (hgr : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S)
    (hd0 : ‖fderiv ℝ w z0‖ ≤ s) :
    ∃ R' > R, ∃ w' : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y, w' (coordPlaneProj b y) = w' y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R'} ∧ w' z0 = z0 b ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R' → coordPlaneProj b y + w' y • e b ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → w' y = w y)

signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R0 K : ℝ) (S : Set E3) (hR0 : 0 < R0) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hS1 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R0, z ∈ closure S → z ∈ S)
    (hS2 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∃ r > 0, ∃ F : E3 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0))
    (hS3 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∀ (b : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z) → (∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) →
      z b = w (coordPlaneProj b z) →
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r →
        coordPlaneProj b y + w (coordPlaneProj b y) • e b ∈ S) →
      ‖fderiv ℝ w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ 2 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w (coordPlaneProj b z)‖ ≤ K)
    (b : Fin 3) (z0 : E3) (hz0c : ‖z0 - c‖ < R0 / 4) (r1 s : ℝ) (hr1 : 0 < r1)
    (hKr1 : K * r1 ≤ 1 / 8) (h4r1 : 4 * r1 ≤ R0) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs : s ≤ 7 / 4)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hRr : R < r1) (w : E3 → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hwc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R}) (hwz : w z0 = z0 b)
    (hgr : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S)
    (hd0 : ‖fderiv ℝ w z0‖ ≤ s) :
    ∃ R' > R, ∃ w' : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y, w' (coordPlaneProj b y) = w' y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R'} ∧ w' z0 = z0 b ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R' → coordPlaneProj b y + w' y • e b ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → w' y = w y)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hP5 : ∀ (y z : E3),
      coordPlaneProj b (y - z) = coordPlaneProj b y - coordPlaneProj b z := by
    intro y z
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hpa : ∀ q : E3, (coordPlaneProj b q) b = 0 := by
    intro q
    simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
  have hP3 : ∀ q : E3, coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b q) = coordPlaneProj b q := by
    intro q
    conv_lhs => rw [coordPlaneProj, hpa, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hP7 : ∀ q : E3, q b = 0 → coordPlaneProj b q = q := by
    intro q hq
    simp [coordPlaneProj, hq]
  have hcontP : Continuous (coordPlaneProj b) := by
    unfold coordPlaneProj
    fun_prop
  have hsat : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b y - z0)‖ = ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ := by
    intro y
    rw [hP5, hP3, ← hP5]
  have hCopen : IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R} :=
    isOpen_lt (hcontP.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm continuous_const
  have hCconv : Convex ℝ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R} := by
    rw [convex_iff_forall_pos]
    intro x hx y hy a a' ha ha' haa
    have hlin : coordPlaneProj b (a • x + a' • y - z0) =
        a • coordPlaneProj b (x - z0) + a' • coordPlaneProj b (y - z0) := by
      have ha'' : a' = 1 - a := by linarith
      subst ha''
      ext i
      simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    show ‖coordPlaneProj b (a • x + a' • y - z0)‖ < R
    rw [hlin]
    have hx' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (x - z0)‖ < R := hx
    have hy' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R := hy
    calc ‖a • coordPlaneProj b (x - z0) + a' • coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖
        ≤ ‖a • coordPlaneProj b (x - z0)‖ + ‖a' • coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = a * ‖coordPlaneProj b (x - z0)‖ + a' * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha'.le]
      _ < a * R + a' * R := by
          have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx' ha
          have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy' ha'
          linarith
      _ = R := by rw [← add_mul, haa, one_mul]
  
  have hap := sheet_slope_apriori c R0 K S hR0 hK hS3 b z0 hz0c R s hR
    (le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRr.le hK) hKr1) (by linarith) hs0 hs w hw hwc hwz
    hgr hd0
  have hd2 : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R}, ‖fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ 2 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R := hy
    have h1 := (hap y hy').1
    have h2 : K * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ ≤ K * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy'.le hK
    have h3 : K * R ≤ K * r1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRr.le hK
    linarith
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ w {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R} :=
    hwc.differentiableOn (by simp)
  
  have hlip : ∀ y y', ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y' - z0)‖ < R →
      |w y - w y'| ≤ 2 * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - y')‖ := by
    intro y y' hy hy'
    have hPy : coordPlaneProj b y ∈ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R} := by
      show ‖coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b y - z0)‖ < R
      rw [hsat]
      exact hy
    have hPy' : coordPlaneProj b y' ∈ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R} := by
      show ‖coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b y' - z0)‖ < R
      rw [hsat]
      exact hy'
    have h := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
      (fun x hx => hdiff.differentiableAt (hCopen.mem_nhds hx)) hd2 hCconv hPy' hPy
    rw [hw, hw, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← hP5] at h
    exact h
  
  have hball : ∀ y (t : ℝ), ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ ≤ R → |t - z0 b| ≤ 2 * R →
      coordPlaneProj b y + t • e b ∈ Metric.ball c R0 := by
    intro y t hy ht
    have hv : coordPlaneProj b y + t • e b - c =
        (coordPlaneProj b (y - z0) + (t - z0 b) • e b) + (z0 - c) := by
      ext i
      simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have he : ‖e b‖ = 1 := by simp [e]
    have hnorm : ‖coordPlaneProj b y + t • e b - c‖ < R0 := by
      rw [hv]
      calc ‖(coordPlaneProj b (y - z0) + (t - z0 b) • e b) + (z0 - c)‖
          ≤ ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0) + (t - z0 b) • e b‖ + ‖z0 - c‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ (‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ + ‖(t - z0 b) • e b‖) + ‖z0 - c‖ :=
            by linarith [norm_add_le (coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)) ((t - z0 b) • e b)]
        _ = ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ + |t - z0 b| + ‖z0 - c‖ := by
            rw [norm_smul, he, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ < R0 := by linarith
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    exact hnorm
  
  have hpatch : ∀ q : E3, q b = 0 → ‖q - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R → ∃ ε > 0, ∃ v : E3 → ℝ,
      (∀ y, v (coordPlaneProj b y) = v y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < ε} ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < ε →
        coordPlaneProj b y + v y • e b ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0) ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < ε → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → v y = w y) := by
    intro q hq hqR
    have hq' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (q - z0)‖ = R := by
      rw [hP5, hP7 q hq]
      exact hqR

        (‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ + ρ) / 2 < ρ ∧
        ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < (‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ + ρ) / 2 := by
      intro y hy
      have hn := norm_nonneg (coordPlaneProj b (y - z0))
      refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    let w : E3 → ℝ := fun y => if ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < ρ then
      W ((‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ + ρ) / 2) y else 0
    have hG0 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (y : E3), 0 < t → t < ρ → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < t →
        w y = W t y := by
      intro t y ht htρ hy
      have hyρ : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < ρ := lt_trans hy htρ
      obtain ⟨m1, m2, m3⟩ := hmid y hyρ
      show (if ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < ρ then
        W ((‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ + ρ) / 2) y else 0) = W t y
      rw [if_pos hyρ]
      exact hK _ t y m1 m2 ht htρ (lt_min m3 hy)
    have hev : ∀ (t : ℝ) (y : E3), 0 < t → t < ρ → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < t →
        w =ᶠ[𝓝 y] W t := by
      intro t y ht htρ hy
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hCylOpen t).mem_nhds hy)
        (fun x hx => hG0 t x ht htρ hx)
    have hz : ‖coordPlaneProj b (z0 - z0)‖ < ρ / 2 := by rw [hτz]; linarith
    refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y
      show (if ‖coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b y - z0)‖ < ρ then
          W ((‖coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b y - z0)‖ + ρ) / 2) (coordPlaneProj b y)
          else 0) =
        (if ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < ρ then
          W ((‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ + ρ) / 2) y else 0)
      rw [hτP y]
      split_ifs with hy
      · obtain ⟨m1, m2, m3⟩ := hmid y hy
        exact (hW _ m1 m2).1 y
      · rfl
    · intro y hy
      have hy' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < ρ := hy
      obtain ⟨m1, m2, m3⟩ := hmid y hy'
      have hc := (hW _ m1 m2).2.1.contDiffAt ((hCylOpen _).mem_nhds m3)
      exact (hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hev _ y m1 m2 m3)).contDiffWithinAt
    · rw [hG0 (ρ / 2) z0 (by linarith) (by linarith) hz]
      exact (hW _ (by linarith) (by linarith)).2.2.1
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨m1, m2, m3⟩ := hmid y hy
      rw [hG0 _ y m1 m2 m3]
      exact (hW _ m1 m2).2.2.2.1 y m3
    · rw [(hev (ρ / 2) z0 (by linarith) (by linarith) hz).fderiv_eq]
      exact (hW _ (by linarith) (by linarith)).2.2.2.2
  
  have hinit : Q (min δ0 r1) :=
    hmono δ0 _ ⟨w0, hw0, hw0c, hw0z, hw0g, hd0⟩ (min_le_left _ _)
  let A : Set ℝ := {ρ | 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ r1 ∧ Q ρ}
  have hminA : min δ0 r1 ∈ A := ⟨lt_min hδ0 hr1, min_le_right _ _, hinit⟩
  have hAne : A.Nonempty := ⟨_, hminA⟩
  have hAbdd : BddAbove A := ⟨r1, fun x hx => hx.2.1⟩
  have hs1 : min δ0 r1 ≤ sSup A := le_csSup hAbdd hminA
  have hspos : 0 < sSup A := lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min hδ0 hr1) hs1
  have hsle : sSup A ≤ r1 := csSup_le hAne (fun x hx => hx.2.1)
  have hQs : Q (sSup A) := by
    apply hlim _ hspos hsle
    intro t ht hts
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hta⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup hAne hts
    exact hmono a t ha.2.2 hta.le
  have heq : sSup A = r1 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : sSup A < r1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hsle hne
    obtain ⟨w, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hQs
    obtain ⟨R', hR', hQR'⟩ := hE (sSup A) w hspos hlt h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
    have hlt2 : sSup A < min R' r1 := lt_min hR' hlt
    have hmem : min R' r1 ∈ A :=
      ⟨lt_trans hspos hlt2, min_le_right _ _, hmono R' _ hQR' (min_le_left _ _)⟩
    have := le_csSup hAbdd hmem
    linarith
  rw [heq] at hQs
  exact hQs

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have t_planar (b : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y) (x : E3) :
      fderiv ℝ w x (e b) = 0 := by
    by_cases hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ w x
    · have hline : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • e b) (e b) 0 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const (e b)).const_add x
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt w (fderiv ℝ w x) ((fun t : ℝ => x + t • e b) 0) := by
        simpa using hd.hasFDerivAt
      have hcomp := h2.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hline
      have hconst : (w ∘ fun t : ℝ => x + t • e b) = fun _ => w x := by
        funext t
        simp only [Function.comp]
        rw [← hw (x + t • e b), ← hw x]
        congr 1
        ext j
        by_cases hj : j = b
        · subst hj; simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
        · simp [coordPlaneProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hj]
      rw [hconst] at hcomp
      exact (hcomp.unique (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (w x)))
    · rw [fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hd]; rfl
  
  have t_basic (c j : Fin 3) (u : E3) :
      (coordPlaneProj c u) j = if j = c then 0 else u j := by
    by_cases h : j = c
    · subst h; simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
    · simp [coordPlaneProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, h]
  have t_normP (c : Fin 3) (y : E3) : ‖coordPlaneProj c y‖ ≤ ‖y‖ := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    rw [t_basic]
    split_ifs <;> simp [sq_nonneg]
  have t_coord (y : E3) (j : Fin 3) : |y j| ≤ ‖y‖ := by
    have := PiLp.norm_apply_le y j
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  have t_convex (c : Fin 3) (p : E3) (r : ℝ) :
      Convex ℝ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj c (y - p)‖ < r} := by
    let L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - (EuclideanSpace.proj c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e c)
    have hL : ∀ y, L y = coordPlaneProj c y := by
      intro y
      simp [L, coordPlaneProj]
    have hset : {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj c (y - p)‖ < r} =
        L.toLinearMap ⁻¹' Metric.ball (L p) r := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm,
        ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe]
      rw [← map_sub, hL]
    rw [hset]
    exact (convex_ball _ _).linear_preimage _
  
  have t_lip (b : Fin 3) (p : E3) (r K : ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ)
      (hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - p)‖ < r})
      (hH : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - p)‖ < r → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w y‖ ≤ K) :
      ∀ x y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj b (x - p)‖ < r → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - p)‖ < r →
        ‖fderiv ℝ w x - fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ := by
    have hopen : IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - p)‖ < r} := by
      have : Continuous (coordPlaneProj b) := by unfold coordPlaneProj; fun_prop
      exact isOpen_lt (this.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm continuous_const
    intro x y hx hy
    have hd : ∀ q ∈ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - p)‖ < r},
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) q := by
      intro q hq
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ w q := hc.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hq)
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ w) q :=
        h1.fderiv_right (by exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
      exact h2.differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have hb : ∀ q ∈ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - p)‖ < r},
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) q‖ ≤ K := by
      intro q hq
      rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      exact hH q hq
    exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hd hb (t_convex b p r) hy hx
  
  have t_transfer (a b : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) (D0 Dy Dz : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (μ : ℝ)
      (h0a : D0 (e a) = 0) (hyb : Dy (e b) = 0) (hD0 : ‖D0‖ ≤ 17 / 12)
      (hδ : ‖Dz - Dy‖ ≤ 1 / 100)
      (hμ : ∀ u : E3, u a - D0 u = μ * (u b - Dy u)) :
      ∀ u : E3, |(coordPlaneProj a u) b - Dz (coordPlaneProj a u)| ≤
        7 / 4 * |(e a) b - Dz (e a)| * ‖u‖ := by
    intro u
    have eaa : (e a) a = 1 := by simp [e]
    have eab : (e a) b = 0 := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hab.symm]
    have eba : (e b) a = 0 := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hab]
    have ebb : (e b) b = 1 := by simp [e]
    have hXa : (coordPlaneProj a u) a = 0 := by rw [t_basic]; simp
    have hD0X : D0 (coordPlaneProj a u) = D0 u := by
      simp only [coordPlaneProj, map_sub, map_smul, h0a, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    have hXn : ‖coordPlaneProj a u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := t_normP a u
    set X := coordPlaneProj a u with hX
    have i1 := hμ (e a)
    have i2 := hμ (e b)
    have i3 := hμ X
    rw [eaa, eab, h0a] at i1
    rw [eba, ebb, hyb] at i2
    rw [hXa, hD0X] at i3
    have hμb : |μ| ≤ 17 / 12 := by
      have : μ = -D0 (e b) := by linarith
      rw [this, abs_neg]
      calc |D0 (e b)| = ‖D0 (e b)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖D0‖ * ‖e b‖ := D0.le_opNorm _
        _ = ‖D0‖ := by simp
        _ ≤ 17 / 12 := hD0
    have hμ0 : 0 < |μ| := by
      apply abs_pos.2
      intro h
      rw [h] at i1
      linarith
    set Δ := Dz - Dy with hΔ
    have hΔX : |Δ X| ≤ 1 / 100 * ‖u‖ := by
      calc |Δ X| = ‖Δ X‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖Δ‖ * ‖X‖ := Δ.le_opNorm _
        _ ≤ 1 / 100 * ‖u‖ := mul_le_mul hδ hXn (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    have hΔa : |Δ (e a)| ≤ 1 / 100 := by
      calc |Δ (e a)| = ‖Δ (e a)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖Δ‖ * ‖e a‖ := Δ.le_opNorm _
        _ = ‖Δ‖ := by simp
        _ ≤ 1 / 100 := hδ
    have hD0u : |D0 u| ≤ 17 / 12 * ‖u‖ := by
      calc |D0 u| = ‖D0 u‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖D0‖ * ‖u‖ := D0.le_opNorm _
        _ ≤ 17 / 12 * ‖u‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD0 (norm_nonneg _)
    have hDzX : Dz X = Dy X + Δ X := by rw [hΔ]; simp
    have hDza : Dz (e a) = Dy (e a) + Δ (e a) := by rw [hΔ]; simp
    have k1 : μ * (X b - Dz X) = -D0 u - μ * Δ X := by
      rw [hDzX]; linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) * i3
    have k2 : μ * ((e a) b - Dz (e a)) = 1 - μ * Δ (e a) := by
      rw [hDza, eab]; linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) * i1
    have m1 : |μ| * |X b - Dz X| ≤ 1717 / 1200 * ‖u‖ := by
      rw [← abs_mul, k1]
      have h1 : |μ * Δ X| ≤ 17 / 12 * (1 / 100 * ‖u‖) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hμb hΔX (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      calc |-D0 u - μ * Δ X| ≤ |D0 u| + |μ * Δ X| := by
            rw [show -D0 u - μ * Δ X = -(D0 u) + -(μ * Δ X) by ring]
            refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
            rw [abs_neg, abs_neg]
        _ ≤ 17 / 12 * ‖u‖ + 17 / 12 * (1 / 100 * ‖u‖) := add_le_add hD0u h1
        _ = 1717 / 1200 * ‖u‖ := by ring
    have m2 : 1183 / 1200 ≤ |μ| * |(e a) b - Dz (e a)| := by
      rw [← abs_mul, k2]
      have h1 : |μ * Δ (e a)| ≤ 17 / 12 * (1 / 100) := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul hμb hΔa (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      have h2 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub 1 (μ * Δ (e a))
      rw [abs_one] at h2
      linarith
    have hu0 : 0 ≤ ‖u‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have m3 : |μ| * |X b - Dz X| ≤ |μ| * (7 / 4 * |(e a) b - Dz (e a)| * ‖u‖) := by
      have h3 : 1183 / 1200 * ‖u‖ ≤ |μ| * |(e a) b - Dz (e a)| * ‖u‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right m2 hu0
      nlinarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left m3 hμ0
  
  have t_cross (a b : Fin 3) (hab : a ≠ b) (z0 z : E3) (ρ K r1 : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
      (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hKρ : 1000000 * (K * ρ) ≤ 1) (hr1 : 200 * ρ ≤ r1)
      (hzz : ‖z - z0‖ < 2 * ρ) (w0 wz : E3 → ℝ)
      (hwz : ∀ y, wz (coordPlaneProj b y) = wz y)
      (hd0 : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - z0)‖ < r1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ w0 y)
      (hdz : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ wz y)
      (h0 : w0 z0 = z0 a) (h1 : wz z = z b)
      (hL0 : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - z0)‖ < r1 →
        ‖fderiv ℝ w0 y - fderiv ℝ w0 z0‖ ≤ K * ‖y - z0‖)
      (hLz : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1 →
        ‖fderiv ℝ wz y - fderiv ℝ wz z‖ ≤ K * ‖y - z‖)
      (hs0 : ‖fderiv ℝ w0 z0‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 2) (hD0a : fderiv ℝ w0 z0 (e a) = 0)
      (v : E3) (hva : v a = 1) (hv : ‖v - e a‖ ≤ 4 / 7)
      (htan : v b = fderiv ℝ wz z v) :
      ∃ y : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - z0)‖ < r1 ∧ ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1 ∧
        y a = w0 y ∧ y b = wz y ∧ ‖y - z‖ ≤ 48 * ρ ∧ ‖y - z0‖ ≤ 50 * ρ := by
    set A := fderiv ℝ w0 z0 with hA
    set B := fderiv ℝ wz z with hB
    have hκ0 : 0 ≤ K * ρ := mul_nonneg hK hρ.le
    have hκ1 : K * ρ ≤ 1 / 1000000 := by linarith
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 17 / 12 := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by norm_num)]; norm_num
    have hA' : ‖A‖ ≤ 17 / 12 := hs0.trans hs2
    have hvn : ‖v‖ ≤ 11 / 7 := by
      calc ‖v‖ = ‖(v - e a) + e a‖ := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
        _ ≤ ‖v - e a‖ + ‖e a‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ 4 / 7 + 1 := by
            have : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by simp
            rw [this]; linarith
        _ = 11 / 7 := by norm_num
    have hAv : |A v| ≤ 17 / 12 * (4 / 7) := by
      have : A v = A (v - e a) := by rw [map_sub, hD0a, sub_zero]
      rw [this]
      calc |A (v - e a)| = ‖A (v - e a)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖v - e a‖ := A.le_opNorm _
        _ ≤ 17 / 12 * (4 / 7) := mul_le_mul hA' hv (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    have hAeb : |A (e b)| ≤ 17 / 12 := by
      calc |A (e b)| = ‖A (e b)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖e b‖ := A.le_opNorm _
        _ = ‖A‖ := by simp
        _ ≤ 17 / 12 := hA'
    have cylz : ∀ y, ‖y - z‖ ≤ 48 * ρ → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1 :=
      fun y hy => lt_of_le_of_lt ((t_normP b _).trans hy) (by linarith)
    have cyl0 : ∀ y, ‖y - z0‖ ≤ 50 * ρ → ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - z0)‖ < r1 :=
      fun y hy => lt_of_le_of_lt ((t_normP a _).trans hy) (by linarith)
    
    have hx : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 30 * ρ → ‖(z + t • v) - z‖ ≤ 48 * ρ := by
      intro t ht
      rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc |t| * ‖v‖ ≤ (30 * ρ) * (11 / 7) := mul_le_mul ht hvn (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ 48 * ρ := by linarith
    
    have hSzc : Convex ℝ ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1} ∩
        Metric.closedBall z (48 * ρ)) := (t_convex b z r1).inter (convex_closedBall _ _)
    have hSzd : ∀ q ∈ ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1} ∩
        Metric.closedBall z (48 * ρ)), DifferentiableAt ℝ wz q := fun q hq => hdz q hq.1
    have hSzb : ∀ q ∈ ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1} ∩
        Metric.closedBall z (48 * ρ)), ‖fderiv ℝ wz q - B‖ ≤ 48 * (K * ρ) := by
      intro q hq
      have h := hLz q hq.1
      have hq2 : ‖q - z‖ ≤ 48 * ρ := by
        have := hq.2; rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at this
      calc _ ≤ K * ‖q - z‖ := h
        _ ≤ K * (48 * ρ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq2 hK
        _ = 48 * (K * ρ) := by ring
    have hxS : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 30 * ρ → z + t • v ∈ ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1} ∩
        Metric.closedBall z (48 * ρ)) := by
      intro t ht
      refine ⟨cylz _ (hx t ht), ?_⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]; exact hx t ht
    
    let γ : ℝ → E3 := fun t => coordPlaneProj b (z + t • v) + wz (z + t • v) • e b
    have hγdef : ∀ t, γ t = coordPlaneProj b (z + t • v) + wz (z + t • v) • e b :=
      fun t => rfl
    have hdec : ∀ q : E3, coordPlaneProj b q + q b • e b = q := by
      intro q; simp [coordPlaneProj]
    have hγdiff : ∀ s t : ℝ, |s| ≤ 30 * ρ → |t| ≤ 30 * ρ → ∃ d : ℝ,

      intro s t hs ht
      have hxx : (z + t • v) - (z + s • v) = (t - s) • v := by rw [sub_smul]; abel
      refine ⟨wz (z + t • v) - wz (z + s • v) - B ((z + t • v) - (z + s • v)), ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le' hSzd hSzb hSzc (hxS s hs)

        have e1 : |t - s| * ‖v‖ ≤ |t - s| * (11 / 7) :=

        have e2 : 48 * (K * ρ) * (|t - s| * ‖v‖) ≤ 48 * (K * ρ) * (|t - s| * (11 / 7)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 (by positivity)
        have e3 : K * ρ * |t - s| ≤ 1 / 1000000 * |t - s| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hκ1 (abs_nonneg _)
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (t - s)]
      · rw [hxx, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← htan, hγdef, hγdef]
        ext j
        simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
    have hγ0 : γ 0 = z := by
      rw [hγdef, zero_smul, add_zero, h1]; exact hdec z
    have hγz : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 30 * ρ → ‖γ t - z‖ ≤ 48 * ρ := by
      intro t ht
      obtain ⟨d, hd, he⟩ := hγdiff 0 t (by rw [abs_zero]; positivity) ht
      rw [hγ0, sub_zero] at he
      rw [sub_zero] at hd
      rw [he]
      calc ‖t • v + d • e b‖ ≤ ‖t • v‖ + ‖d • e b‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = |t| * ‖v‖ + |d| := by simp [norm_smul]
        _ ≤ |t| * (11 / 7) + 1 / 10000 * |t| :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvn (abs_nonneg _)) hd
        _ ≤ 48 * ρ := by linarith
    have hγz0 : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 30 * ρ → ‖γ t - z0‖ ≤ 50 * ρ := by
      intro t ht
      have := norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (γ t) z z0
      linarith [hγz t ht]
    have hγa : ∀ t, (γ t) a = z a + t := by
      intro t
      rw [hγdef]
      simp [coordPlaneProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hab, hva]
    have hPP : ∀ (q : E3) (s : ℝ), coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b q + s • e b) =
        coordPlaneProj b q := by
      intro q s
      ext j
      by_cases hj : j = b
      · subst hj; simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
      · simp [coordPlaneProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hj]
    have hγb : ∀ t, (γ t) b = wz (γ t) := by
      intro t
      rw [← hwz (γ t), hγdef, hPP, hwz]
      simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
    
    have hS0c : Convex ℝ ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - z0)‖ < r1} ∩

    have hS0d : ∀ q ∈ ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - z0)‖ < r1} ∩
        Metric.closedBall z0 (50 * ρ)), DifferentiableAt ℝ w0 q := fun q hq => hd0 q hq.1
    have hS0b : ∀ q ∈ ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - z0)‖ < r1} ∩
        Metric.closedBall z0 (50 * ρ)), ‖fderiv ℝ w0 q - A‖ ≤ 50 * (K * ρ) := by
      intro q hq
      have h := hL0 q hq.1
      have hq2 : ‖q - z0‖ ≤ 50 * ρ := by
        have := hq.2; rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at this
      calc _ ≤ K * ‖q - z0‖ := h

        _ = 50 * (K * ρ) := by ring
    have mem0 : ∀ q : E3, ‖q - z0‖ ≤ 50 * ρ →

      intro q hq

    have hψ : ∀ s t : ℝ, |s| ≤ 30 * ρ → |t| ≤ 30 * ρ →

          _ = |t - s| * ‖v‖ + |d| := by simp [norm_smul]
          _ ≤ |t - s| * (11 / 7) + 1 / 10000 * |t - s| :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvn (abs_nonneg _)) hd
          _ ≤ 2 * |t - s| := by linarith [abs_nonneg (t - s)]
      have hAe : |A ((t - s) • v + d • e b)| ≤
          17 / 12 * (4 / 7) * |t - s| + 17 / 12 * (1 / 10000 * |t - s|) := by
        rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
        refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
        · rw [abs_mul, mul_comm]

        · rw [abs_mul, mul_comm]
          exact mul_le_mul hAeb hd (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      have hk : 50 * (K * ρ) * ‖(t - s) • v + d • e b‖ ≤
          50 * (1 / 1000000) * (2 * |t - s|) :=
        mul_le_mul (by linarith) hn (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      have h3 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (w0 (γ t) - w0 (γ s)) (A ((t - s) • v + d • e b))
      have h4 : |w0 (γ t) - w0 (γ s) - A ((t - s) • v + d • e b)| ≤
          50 * (K * ρ) * ‖(t - s) • v + d • e b‖ := h
      linarith [abs_nonneg (t - s)]
    
    have hφ0 : |z a - w0 (γ 0)| < 5 * ρ := by
      rw [hγ0]
      have hz0m := mem0 z0 (by rw [sub_self, norm_zero]; positivity)
      have hzm := mem0 z (by linarith)
      have h := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le' hS0d hS0b hS0c hz0m hzm
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, h0] at h
      have hAz : |A (z - z0)| ≤ 17 / 12 * ‖z - z0‖ := by
        calc |A (z - z0)| = ‖A (z - z0)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
          _ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖z - z0‖ := A.le_opNorm _
          _ ≤ 17 / 12 * ‖z - z0‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA' (norm_nonneg _)
      have hza : |z a - z0 a| ≤ ‖z - z0‖ := by
        have := t_coord (z - z0) a

      have hk : 50 * (K * ρ) * ‖z - z0‖ ≤ 50 * (1 / 1000000) * (2 * ρ) :=
        mul_le_mul (by linarith) hzz.le (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      have h3 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (w0 z - z0 a) (A (z - z0))
      have h5 : |z a - w0 z| ≤ |z a - z0 a| + |w0 z - z0 a| := by
        rw [show z a - w0 z = (z a - z0 a) - (w0 z - z0 a) by ring]
        exact abs_sub _ _
      linarith
    
    let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => z a + t - w0 (γ t)
    have hφdef : ∀ t, φ t = z a + t - w0 (γ t) := fun t => rfl
    have hφc : ContinuousOn φ (Set.Icc (-(30 * ρ)) (30 * ρ)) := by
      refine (LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul (K := 2) ?_).continuousOn
      intro s hs t ht
      have hs' : |s| ≤ 30 * ρ := abs_le.2 hs
      have ht' : |t| ≤ 30 * ρ := abs_le.2 ht
      have h := hψ t s ht' hs'
      rw [Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, hφdef, hφdef]
      have h2 : ((2 : NNReal) : ℝ) = 2 := by norm_num
      rw [h2]
      have h3 : |z a + s - w0 (γ s) - (z a + t - w0 (γ t))| ≤
          |s - t| + |w0 (γ s) - w0 (γ t)| := by
        rw [show z a + s - w0 (γ s) - (z a + t - w0 (γ t)) =
          (s - t) - (w0 (γ s) - w0 (γ t)) by ring]
        exact abs_sub _ _
      linarith [abs_nonneg (s - t)]
    have hTpos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 30 * ρ := by positivity
    have hφT : 0 < φ (30 * ρ) := by
      have h := hψ 0 (30 * ρ) (by rw [abs_zero]; exact hTpos) (by rw [abs_of_nonneg hTpos])
      rw [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hTpos] at h
      rw [hφdef]
      have := (abs_lt.1 hφ0).1
      have := (abs_le.1 h).2
      linarith
    have hφmT : φ (-(30 * ρ)) < 0 := by
      have h := hψ 0 (-(30 * ρ)) (by rw [abs_zero]; exact hTpos)
        (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hTpos])
      rw [sub_zero, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hTpos] at h
      rw [hφdef]
      have := (abs_lt.1 hφ0).2
      have := (abs_le.1 h).1
      linarith
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hφt⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by linarith : -(30 * ρ) ≤ 30 * ρ) hφc
      ⟨hφmT.le, hφT.le⟩
    have ht' : |t| ≤ 30 * ρ := abs_le.2 ht
    refine ⟨γ t, cyl0 _ (hγz0 t ht'), cylz _ (hγz t ht'), ?_, hγb t, hγz t ht', hγz0 t ht'⟩
    rw [hγa]
    rw [hφdef] at hφt
    linarith
  
  intro u
  have hs74 : Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 7 / 4 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by norm_num)]; norm_num
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · 
    subst hab
    have hBa : fderiv ℝ wz z (e a) = 0 := t_planar a wz hwz z
    have hBP : fderiv ℝ wz z (coordPlaneProj a u) = fderiv ℝ wz z u := by
      simp only [coordPlaneProj, map_sub, map_smul, hBa, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    have hPa : (coordPlaneProj a u) a = 0 := by rw [t_basic]; simp
    have hea : (e a) a = 1 := by simp [e]
    rw [hBP, hBa, hPa, hea, sub_zero, abs_one, mul_one, zero_sub, abs_neg]
    calc |fderiv ℝ wz z u| = ‖fderiv ℝ wz z u‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ wz z‖ * ‖u‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ ≤ 7 / 4 * ‖u‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hsz.trans hs74) (norm_nonneg _)
  · 
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have hw'a : (coordPlaneProj a u) a = 0 := by rw [t_basic]; simp
    have hw'n : ‖coordPlaneProj a u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := t_normP a u
    set B := fderiv ℝ wz z with hB
    set w' := coordPlaneProj a u with hw'
    have hℓw : w' b - B w' ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, abs_zero] at hcon
      have : 0 ≤ 7 / 4 * |(e a) b - B (e a)| * ‖u‖ := by positivity
      linarith
    set c := ((e a) b - B (e a)) / (w' b - B w') with hc
    have hea : (e a) a = 1 := by simp [e]
    have hva : (e a - c • w') a = 1 := by
      simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hw'a, hea]; ring
    have hcw : c * (w' b - B w') = (e a) b - B (e a) := by
      rw [hc]; exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hℓw
    have htan : (e a - c • w') b = B (e a - c • w') := by
      simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_sub, map_smul]
      linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) * hcw
    have hv : ‖(e a - c • w') - e a‖ ≤ 4 / 7 := by
      rw [sub_sub_cancel_left, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hc, abs_div]
      have hpos : 0 < |w' b - B w'| := abs_pos.2 hℓw
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hpos]
      have : |(e a) b - B (e a)| * ‖w'‖ ≤ |(e a) b - B (e a)| * ‖u‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw'n (abs_nonneg _)
      linarith
    
    have hr1pos : 0 < r1 := by linarith
    have hz0C : ‖coordPlaneProj a (z0 - z0)‖ < r1 := by simp [coordPlaneProj, hr1pos]
    have hzC : ‖coordPlaneProj b (z - z)‖ < r1 := by simp [coordPlaneProj, hr1pos]
    have hopen : ∀ (c : Fin 3) (p : E3) (r : ℝ),
        IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj c (y - p)‖ < r} := by
      intro c p r
      have : Continuous (coordPlaneProj c) := by unfold coordPlaneProj; fun_prop
      exact isOpen_lt (this.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm continuous_const
    have hd0 : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - z0)‖ < r1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ w0 y := fun y hy =>
      (hc0.contDiffAt ((hopen a z0 r1).mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hdz : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1 → DifferentiableAt ℝ wz y := fun y hy =>
      (hcz.contDiffAt ((hopen b z r1).mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hL0 : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - z0)‖ < r1 →
        ‖fderiv ℝ w0 y - fderiv ℝ w0 z0‖ ≤ K * ‖y - z0‖ :=
      fun y hy => t_lip a z0 r1 K w0 hc0 hH0 y z0 hy hz0C
    have hLz : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z)‖ < r1 →
        ‖fderiv ℝ wz y - B‖ ≤ K * ‖y - z‖ :=
      fun y hy => t_lip b z r1 K wz hcz hHz y z hy hzC
    obtain ⟨y, hy0, hyz, hya, hyb, hyzn, hyz0n⟩ := t_cross a b hab z0 z ρ K r1 hρ hK hKρ hr1 hzz
      w0 wz hwz hd0 hdz h0 h1 hL0 hLz hs0 (t_planar a w0 hw0 z0) (e a - c • w') hva hv htan
    
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := hpar y hy0 hyz hya hyb
    have hD0 : ‖fderiv ℝ w0 y‖ ≤ 17 / 12 := by
      have h1' := norm_le_insert' (fderiv ℝ w0 y) (fderiv ℝ w0 z0)
      have h2 := hL0 y hy0
      have h3 : K * ‖y - z0‖ ≤ K * (50 * ρ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyz0n hK
      have hs : Real.sqrt 2 ≤ 14143 / 10000 := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_le_left (by norm_num)]; norm_num
      linarith
    have hδ : ‖B - fderiv ℝ wz y‖ ≤ 1 / 100 := by
      rw [norm_sub_rev]
      have h2 := hLz y hyz
      have h3 : K * ‖y - z‖ ≤ K * (48 * ρ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hyzn hK
      linarith
    have key := t_transfer a b hab (fderiv ℝ w0 y) (fderiv ℝ wz y) B μ (t_planar a w0 hw0 y)
      (t_planar b wz hwz y) hD0 hδ hμ u
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(a : Fin 3) (c : E3) :
    (∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen (smthDisc a c r) ∧ Convex ℝ (smthDisc a c r)) ∧
    (∀ r r' : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ r' → smthDisc a c r ⊆ smthDisc a c r') ∧
    (∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → ∀ x ∈ smthDisc a c r, ∀ y ∈ smthDisc a c r, ‖x - y‖ ≤ 2 * r) ∧
    (∀ r R : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → 0 < R → ∀ x ∈ smthDisc a c r,
      Metric.ball x R ⊆ smthDisc a c (r + 2 * R)) ∧
    (∀ (r : ℝ) (y : E3), 0 < r → ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ < r → smthHoriz a y ∈ smthDisc a c r)

by
  have hmem : ∀ (r : ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ), x ∈ smthDisc a c r ↔
      (x 0 - c (a.succAbove 0)) ^ 2 + (x 1 - c (a.succAbove 1)) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by
    intro r x
    simp only [smthDisc, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hcoord : ∀ (r : ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ), 0 ≤ r → x ∈ smthDisc a c r → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      |x k - c (a.succAbove k)| < r := by
    intro r x hr hx k
    rw [hmem] at hx
    apply abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq _ hr
    fin_cases k
    · show (x 0 - c (a.succAbove 0)) ^ 2 < r ^ 2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 1 - c (a.succAbove 1))]
    · show (x 1 - c (a.succAbove 1)) ^ 2 < r ^ 2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0 - c (a.succAbove 0))]
  have hsqle : ∀ α β p s : ℝ, α + β = 1 →
      (α * p + β * s) ^ 2 = α * p ^ 2 + β * s ^ 2 - α * β * (p - s) ^ 2 := by
    intro α β p s h
    linear_combination (α * p ^ 2 + β * s ^ 2) * h
  refine ⟨fun r => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hset : smthDisc a c r =
        {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 < r ^ 2} := rfl
    rw [hset]
    exact isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  · rw [convex_iff_forall_pos]
    intro x hx y hy α β hα hβ hαβ
    rw [hmem] at hx hy ⊢
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have e0 : α * x 0 + β * y 0 - c (a.succAbove 0) =
        α * (x 0 - c (a.succAbove 0)) + β * (y 0 - c (a.succAbove 0)) := by
      linear_combination c (a.succAbove 0) * hαβ
    have e1 : α * x 1 + β * y 1 - c (a.succAbove 1) =
        α * (x 1 - c (a.succAbove 1)) + β * (y 1 - c (a.succAbove 1)) := by
      linear_combination c (a.succAbove 1) * hαβ
    rw [e0, e1, hsqle α β _ _ hαβ, hsqle α β _ _ hαβ]
    have hab : 0 ≤ α * β := mul_nonneg hα.le hβ.le
    have h1 := mul_nonneg hab (sq_nonneg ((x 0 - c (a.succAbove 0)) - (y 0 - c (a.succAbove 0))))
    have h2 := mul_nonneg hab (sq_nonneg ((x 1 - c (a.succAbove 1)) - (y 1 - c (a.succAbove 1))))
    have h3 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hx hα
    have h4 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hy hβ
    have h5 : α * r ^ 2 + β * r ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by rw [← add_mul, hαβ, one_mul]
    nlinarith
  · intro r r' hr hrr' x hx
    rw [hmem] at hx ⊢
    have := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr hrr' 2
    linarith
  · intro r hr x hx y hy
    rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    intro k
    rw [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h1 := hcoord r x hr hx k
    have h2 := hcoord r y hr hy k
    rw [abs_lt] at h1 h2
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  · intro r R hr hR x hx z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_pi_lt_iff hR] at hz
    have hw : ∀ k, |z k - x k| < R := fun k => by
      have := hz k
      rwa [Real.dist_eq] at this
    have hu := hcoord r x hr hx
    have hprod : ∀ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) * (z k - x k) ≤ r * R := by
      intro k
      calc (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) * (z k - x k)
          ≤ |(x k - c (a.succAbove k)) * (z k - x k)| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |x k - c (a.succAbove k)| * |z k - x k| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ r * R := mul_le_mul (hu k).le (hw k).le (abs_nonneg _) hr
    have hsq : ∀ k : Fin 2, (z k - x k) ^ 2 ≤ R ^ 2 := by
      intro k
      rw [← sq_abs]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hw k).le 2
    rw [hmem] at hx
    rw [hmem]
    have q0 : (z 0 - c (a.succAbove 0)) ^ 2 = (x 0 - c (a.succAbove 0)) ^ 2 +
        2 * ((x 0 - c (a.succAbove 0)) * (z 0 - x 0)) + (z 0 - x 0) ^ 2 := by ring
    have q1 : (z 1 - c (a.succAbove 1)) ^ 2 = (x 1 - c (a.succAbove 1)) ^ 2 +
        2 * ((x 1 - c (a.succAbove 1)) * (z 1 - x 1)) + (z 1 - x 1) ^ 2 := by ring
    have hp0 := hprod 0
    have hp1 := hprod 1
    have hs0 := hsq 0
    have hs1 := hsq 1
    have hRR : 0 ≤ R ^ 2 := sq_nonneg R
    have hexp : (r + 2 * R) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 + 4 * (r * R) + 4 * R ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [q0, q1, hexp]
    linarith
  · intro r y hr hy
    rw [hmem]
    have hsq : ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ ^ 2 =
        (y (a.succAbove 0) - c (a.succAbove 0)) ^ 2 +
          (y (a.succAbove 1) - c (a.succAbove 1)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [coordPlaneProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne]
    have h := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hy (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero
    rw [hsq] at h
    exact h

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : E3) (ρ K : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (a : Fin 3) (v : E3 → ℝ) (hinv : ∀ y, v (coordPlaneProj a y) = v y)
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v {y | ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ < 3 * ρ})
    (hb : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ < 3 * ρ →
      |v (coordPlaneProj a y) - c a| ≤ 9 * ρ ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ v y‖ ≤ 2 ∧
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 v y‖ ≤ K ∧
      levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun z => z a - v (coordPlaneProj a z))
        (coordPlaneProj a y + v (coordPlaneProj a y) • e a) = 0) :
    (∀ z : E3, v z = v (smthLift a (smthHoriz a z) 0)) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (smthLift a x 0)) (smthDisc a c (3 * ρ)) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ smthDisc a c (3 * ρ),
      |v (smthLift a x 0) - c a| ≤ 9 * ρ ∧
      (∀ m : Fin 2, |smthGrad (fun x' => v (smthLift a x' 0)) x m| ≤ 2) ∧
      (∀ l m : Fin 2,
        |smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad (fun x' => v (smthLift a x' 0)) y l) x m| ≤ K) ∧
      levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun w => w a - v (smthLift a (smthHoriz a w) 0))
        (smthLift a x (v (smthLift a x 0))) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
      (smthLift a x t) j = (Fin.insertNth a t x : Fin 3 → ℝ) j := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have hLa : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift a x t) a = t := by
    intro x t; rw [hcoord]; simp
  have hLs : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (k : Fin 2), (smthLift a x t) (a.succAbove k) = x k := by
    intro x t k; rw [hcoord]; simp
  have hPa : ∀ y : E3, (coordPlaneProj a y) a = 0 := by
    intro y; simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
  have hPs : ∀ (y : E3) (k : Fin 2), (coordPlaneProj a y) (a.succAbove k) = y (a.succAbove k) := by
    intro y k; simp [coordPlaneProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne]
  have hext : ∀ y y' : E3, y a = y' a → (∀ k, y (a.succAbove k) = y' (a.succAbove k)) → y = y' := by
    intro y y' h0 h1
    ext j
    by_cases hj : j = a
    · rw [hj]; exact h0
    · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hj
      exact h1 k
  have hP3 : ∀ z : E3, smthLift a (smthHoriz a z) 0 = coordPlaneProj a z := by
    intro z
    refine hext _ _ ?_ (fun k => ?_)
    · rw [hLa, hPa]
    · rw [hLs, hPs]; rfl
  have hP5 : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, coordPlaneProj a (smthLift a x 0) = smthLift a x 0 := by
    intro x
    refine hext _ _ ?_ (fun k => ?_)
    · rw [hPa, hLa]
    · rw [hPs]
  have hP4 : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthLift a x 0 + t • e a = smthLift a x t := by
    intro x t
    refine hext _ _ ?_ (fun k => ?_)
    · simp [hLa, e]
    · simp [hLs, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne]
  have hsingle : ∀ m : Fin 2, smthLift a (Pi.single m 1) 0 = e (a.succAbove m) := by
    intro m
    refine hext _ _ ?_ (fun k => ?_)
    · rw [hLa]
      simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, (Fin.succAbove_ne a m).symm]
    · rw [hLs]
      simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  have hN : ∀ m : Fin 2, ‖smthLift a (Pi.single m 1) 0‖ = 1 := by
    intro m; rw [hsingle]; simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  have hP6 : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ‖coordPlaneProj a (smthLift a x 0 - c)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a]
    simp [hPa, hPs, hLs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  
  let Lin : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] E3 :=
    { toFun := fun x => smthLift a x 0
      map_add' := fun x y => hext _ _ (by simp [hLa]) (fun k => by simp [hLs])
      map_smul' := fun r x => hext _ _ (by simp [hLa]) (fun k => by simp [hLs]) }
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] E3, ∀ x, L x = smthLift a x 0 :=
    ⟨LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap Lin, fun x => rfl⟩
  
  have hcontP : Continuous (coordPlaneProj a) := by
    unfold coordPlaneProj
    fun_prop
  have hCylOpen : IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ < 3 * ρ} :=
    isOpen_lt (hcontP.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm continuous_const
  have hDopen : IsOpen (smthDisc a c (3 * ρ)) :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_finset_sum _ fun k _ =>
      ((continuous_apply k).sub continuous_const).pow 2) continuous_const
  have hmaps : ∀ x ∈ smthDisc a c (3 * ρ),
      L x ∈ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj a (y - c)‖ < 3 * ρ} := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : ∑ k : Fin 2, (x k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 < (3 * ρ) ^ 2 := hx
    show ‖coordPlaneProj a (L x - c)‖ < 3 * ρ
    rw [hL]
    have h6 := hP6 x
    have hn := norm_nonneg (coordPlaneProj a (smthLift a x 0 - c))
    nlinarith
  
  have hvdiff : ∀ y ∈ smthDisc a c (3 * ρ), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ v (L y) := fun y hy =>
    hv.contDiffAt (hCylOpen.mem_nhds (hmaps y hy))
  have hgrad1 : ∀ y ∈ smthDisc a c (3 * ρ), ∀ k : Fin 2,
      smthGrad (fun x' => v (L x')) y k = fderiv ℝ v (L y) (L (Pi.single k 1)) := by
    intro y hy k
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ v (L y) :=
      (hvdiff y hy).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hc : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => v (L x')) y = (fderiv ℝ v (L y)).comp L := by
      have h := fderiv_comp y hd L.differentiableAt
      rw [L.fderiv] at h
      exact h
    show fderiv ℝ (fun x' => v (L x')) y (Pi.single k 1) = _
    rw [hc, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hgrad2 : ∀ x ∈ smthDisc a c (3 * ρ), ∀ l m : Fin 2,
      smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad (fun x' => v (L x')) y l) x m =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (L x) (L (Pi.single m 1)) (L (Pi.single l 1)) := by
    intro x hx l m
    have hev : (fun y => smthGrad (fun x' => v (L x')) y l) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => fderiv ℝ v (L y) (L (Pi.single l 1))) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hDopen.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hgrad1 y hy l)
    have hΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (L x) :=
      ((hvdiff x hx).fderiv_right (m := 1)
        (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ v (L y)) ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (L x)).comp L) x :=
      hΦ.hasFDerivAt.comp x L.hasFDerivAt
    have h2 := h1.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (L (Pi.single l 1)) x)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad (fun x' => v (L x')) y l) x (Pi.single m 1) = _
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, h2.fderiv]
    simp
  have hnorm2 : ∀ z, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) z‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 v z‖ := by
    intro z
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
  
  have hfun : (fun x' => v (smthLift a x' 0)) = fun x' => v (L x') := by
    funext x'; rw [hL]
  refine ⟨fun z => by rw [hP3]; exact (hinv z).symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hfun]
    exact hv.comp L.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun x hx => hmaps x hx)
  · intro x hx
    have hy := hmaps x hx
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hb (L x) hy
    have hLx : L x = smthLift a x 0 := hL x
    have hPy : coordPlaneProj a (L x) = L x := by rw [hLx, hP5]
    rw [hfun]
    refine ⟨?_, fun m => ?_, fun l m => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hPy, hLx] at h1
      exact h1
    · rw [hgrad1 x hx m, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ v (L x) (L (Pi.single m 1))‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ v (L x)‖ * ‖L (Pi.single m 1)‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ v (L x)‖ := by rw [hL (Pi.single m 1), hN, mul_one]
        _ ≤ 2 := h2
    · rw [hgrad2 x hx l m, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (L x) (L (Pi.single m 1)) (L (Pi.single l 1))‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) (L x)‖ * ‖L (Pi.single m 1)‖ * ‖L (Pi.single l 1)‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm₂ _ _ _
        _ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 v (L x)‖ := by
            rw [hL (Pi.single m 1), hL (Pi.single l 1), hN, hN, mul_one, mul_one, hnorm2]
        _ ≤ K := h3
    · have hf : (fun z => z a - v (coordPlaneProj a z)) =
          (fun w => w a - v (smthLift a (smthHoriz a w) 0)) := by
        funext w; rw [hP3]
      have hpt : coordPlaneProj a (L x) + v (coordPlaneProj a (L x)) • e a =
          smthLift a x (v (smthLift a x 0)) := by
        rw [hPy, hLx, hP4]
      rw [hf, hpt] at h4
      exact h4

informal_problem.statement:

    (hmc : ∀ x ∈ D, levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun w => w a - u (smthHoriz a w))

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Ω : Set E3) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x₀ hx₀
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hD x₀ hx₀
  let χ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨r / 4, r / 2, by positivity, by linarith⟩
  have hχsupp : Function.support χ = Metric.ball x₀ (r / 2) := χ.support_eq
  have hχone : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 4), χ z = 1 :=
    fun z hz => χ.one_of_mem_closedBall hz
  set v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun x => χ x * u x with hv_def
  have hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    rcases le_or_gt (dist y x₀) (r / 2) with hy | hy
    · have hyD : y ∈ D := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_ball]; linarith)
      exact (χ.contDiffAt (n := ⊤)).mul (hu.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hyD))
    · have hW : IsOpen {z : Fin 2 → ℝ | r / 2 < dist z x₀} :=
        isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)
      have hev : v =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        have hz' : z ∉ Function.support χ := by
          rw [hχsupp, Metric.mem_ball, not_lt]
          exact le_of_lt hz
        simp only [hv_def, Function.notMem_support.mp hz', zero_mul]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hvu : v =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀] u := by
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < r / 4)] with z hz
    have h1 : χ z = 1 := hχone z (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz)
    simp only [hv_def, h1, one_mul]
  have h0 : v x₀ = u x₀ := hvu.eq_of_nhds
  
  have hg : (fun y => smthGrad v y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀] (fun y => smthGrad u y) :=
    (hvu.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).mono (fun y hy => by funext k; simp only [smthGrad, hy])
  have hEL : smthELop (smthLag G a) v x₀ = smthELop (smthLag G a) u x₀ := by
    have h1 : smthGrad v x₀ = smthGrad u x₀ := hg.eq_of_nhds
    unfold smthELop
    rw [h0, h1]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    have hk : (fun y => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) (y, v y, smthGrad v y) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀]
        (fun y => fderiv ℝ (smthLag G a) (y, u y, smthGrad u y) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1)) := by
      filter_upwards [hvu, hg] with y hy1 hy2
      rw [hy1, hy2]
    rw [hk.fderiv_eq]
  
  have hx : smthLift a x₀ (v x₀) ∈ Ω := by rw [h0]; exact hlift x₀ hx₀
  have hs1 := smth_ELop_eq_meanCurv G Ω hΩ hG hsymm hpos a v hv x₀ hx
  rw [h0] at hs1
  
  have hH : smthHoriz a (smthLift a x₀ (u x₀)) = x₀ := by
    funext k
    simp [smthHoriz, smthLift]
  have hHc : Continuous (smthHoriz a) := by
    unfold smthHoriz
    fun_prop
  have hgerm : (fun w : E3 => w a - v (smthHoriz a w)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (smthLift a x₀ (u x₀))]
      (fun w => w a - u (smthHoriz a w)) := by
    have hT : Tendsto (smthHoriz a) (𝓝 (smthLift a x₀ (u x₀))) (𝓝 x₀) := by
      have := hHc.tendsto (smthLift a x₀ (u x₀))
      rwa [hH] at this
    filter_upwards [hT.eventually hvu] with w hw
    rw [hw]
  
  have hcong : ∀ (f₁ f₂ : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3),
      f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] f₂ → levelMeanCurvCoord G f₁ z = levelMeanCurvCoord G f₂ z := by
    intro f₁ f₂ z h
    have h1 : ∀ i, partialDeriv i f₁ z = partialDeriv i f₂ z := by
      intro i; unfold partialDeriv; rw [h.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ i j, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₁) z =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₂) z := by
      intro i j
      have h' : partialDeriv j f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] partialDeriv j f₂ :=
        (h.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).mono (fun y hy => by simp only [partialDeriv, hy])
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [show (fun y => fderiv ℝ f₁ y (e j)) = partialDeriv j f₁ from rfl,
        show (fun y => fderiv ℝ f₂ y (e j)) = partialDeriv j f₂ from rfl, h'.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, lapLoc, hessLoc, h1, h2]
  
  rw [← hEL, hs1, hcong _ _ _ hgerm, hmc x₀ hx₀, mul_zero]

(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)

      levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun w => w a - v (smthHoriz a w)) (smthLift a x (v x))
