signature.name: mse_lag_smooth
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Ω : Set E3) (c : E3) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hball : Metric.closedBall c (10 * ρ) ⊆ Ω)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) Ω)
    (hsymm : ∀ y i j, G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ Ω, (G y).PosDef) (a : Fin 3) :
    IsOpen (mseLagDom a Ω) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (smthLag G a) (mseLagDom a Ω) ∧
    IsCompact (mseParamSet a c ρ) ∧ Convex ℝ (mseParamSet a c ρ) ∧
    mseParamSet a c ρ ⊆ mseLagDom a Ω

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hlift_a : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), smthLift a x t a = t := by
    intro x t
    show (Fin.insertNth a t x : Fin 3 → ℝ) a = t
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_same _ _ _
  have hlift_s : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (k : Fin 2), smthLift a x t (a.succAbove k) = x k := by
    intro x t k
    show (Fin.insertNth a t x : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a.succAbove k) = x k
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove _ _ _ _
  
  have hℓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => smthLift a w.1 w.2.1) := by
    have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) =>
        (Fin.insertNth a w.2.1 w.1 : Fin 3 → ℝ)) := by
      rw [contDiff_pi]
      intro i
      rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with h | ⟨j, h⟩
      · subst h
        simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
        exact contDiff_snd.fst
      · subst h
        simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
        exact (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ j).comp contDiff_fst
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp hg
  
  have hq : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => smthCovec a w.2.2 i) := by
    intro i
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with h | ⟨j, h⟩
    · subst h
      simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
      exact contDiff_const
    · subst h
      simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, Pi.neg_apply]
      exact ((contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ j).comp contDiff_snd.snd).neg
  have hqa : ∀ p : Fin 2 → ℝ, smthCovec a p a = 1 := by
    intro p
    simp only [smthCovec, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
  
  have hD : IsOpen (mseLagDom a Ω) := hΩ.preimage hℓ.continuous
  
  have hF : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1) i j) (mseLagDom a Ω) := by
    intro i j
    exact (hG i j).comp hℓ.contDiffOn (fun w hw => hw)
  have hdetH : ∀ H : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => H w i j) (mseLagDom a Ω)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => (H w).det) (mseLagDom a Ω) := by
    intro H hH
    have e : (fun w => (H w).det) = fun w => H w 0 0 * H w 1 1 * H w 2 2
        - H w 0 0 * H w 1 2 * H w 2 1 - H w 0 1 * H w 1 0 * H w 2 2
        + H w 0 1 * H w 1 2 * H w 2 0 + H w 0 2 * H w 1 0 * H w 2 1
        - H w 0 2 * H w 1 1 * H w 2 0 := by
      funext w
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
    rw [e]
    have t1 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 0)
    exact ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
  have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).adjugate i j)
      (mseLagDom a Ω) := by
    intro i j
    simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
    apply hdetH (fun w => (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1))
    intro r k
    by_cases hr : r = j
    · subst hr
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
      exact contDiffOn_const
    · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hr]
      exact hF r k
  have hdetF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).det)
      (mseLagDom a Ω) := hdetH _ hF
  have hdetpos : ∀ w ∈ mseLagDom a Ω, 0 < (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).det :=
    fun w hw => (hpos _ hw).det_pos
  have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹ i j)
      (mseLagDom a Ω) := by
    intro i j
    have e : (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹ i j) =
        fun w => ((G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).det)⁻¹ * (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).adjugate i j := by
      funext w
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rw [e]
    exact (hdetF.inv (fun w hw => (hdetpos w hw).ne')).mul (hadj i j)
  have hQ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹ i j * smthCovec a w.2.2 i * smthCovec a w.2.2 j)
      (mseLagDom a Ω) :=
    ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ =>
      ((hinv i j).mul (hq i).contDiffOn).mul (hq j).contDiffOn))
  have hQpos : ∀ w ∈ mseLagDom a Ω, 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹ i j * smthCovec a w.2.2 i * smthCovec a w.2.2 j := by
    intro w hw
    have hPD : (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹.PosDef := (hpos _ hw).inv
    have hv : smthCovec a w.2.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have h1 := hqa w.2.2
      rw [h] at h1
      simp at h1
    have h1 := hPD.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
    refine lt_of_lt_of_eq h1 ?_
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial, Pi.star_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring
  have hLag : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (smthLag G a) (mseLagDom a Ω) := by
    have e : smthLag G a = fun w => Real.sqrt (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).det *
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1))⁻¹ i j *
          smthCovec a w.2.2 i * smthCovec a w.2.2 j) := rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (hdetF.sqrt (fun w hw => (hdetpos w hw).ne')).mul
      (hQ.sqrt (fun w hw => (hQpos w hw).ne'))
  
  have hclosed : IsClosed (mseParamSet a c ρ) := by
    have h1 : IsClosed {w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) |
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (w.1 k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ (3 * ρ) ^ 2} :=
      isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    have h2 : IsClosed {w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | |w.2.1 - c a| ≤ 9 * ρ} :=
      isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    have h3 : IsClosed {w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | ‖w.2.2‖ ≤ 2} :=
      isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    exact h1.inter (h2.inter h3)
  have hbox : mseParamSet a c ρ ⊆ Metric.closedBall (fun k : Fin 2 => c (a.succAbove k)) (3 * ρ) ×ˢ
      (Metric.closedBall (c a) (9 * ρ) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) 2) := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hw
    refine Set.mem_prod.2 ⟨?_, Set.mem_prod.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_pi_le_iff (by positivity)]
      intro k
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have hk : (w.1 k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ (3 * ρ) ^ 2 := by
        refine le_trans ?_ h1
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => (w.1 k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2)
          (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ k)
      exact abs_le.mpr (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hk (by positivity))
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq]
      exact h2
    · rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
      exact h3
  have hcompact : IsCompact (mseParamSet a c ρ) :=
    ((isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod ((isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod
      (isCompact_closedBall _ _))).of_isClosed_subset hclosed hbox
  
  have hconv : Convex ℝ (mseParamSet a c ρ) := by
    intro w₁ hw₁ w₂ hw₂ α β hα hβ hαβ
    obtain ⟨h11, h12, h13⟩ := hw₁
    obtain ⟨h21, h22, h23⟩ := hw₂
    have hb : β = 1 - α := by linarith
    subst hb
    refine And.intro ?_ (And.intro ?_ ?_)
    · show ∑ k : Fin 2, ((α • w₁.1 + (1 - α) • w₂.1) k - c (a.succAbove k)) ^ 2 ≤ (3 * ρ) ^ 2
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h11 h21 ⊢
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h11 hα, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h21 hβ,
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hα hβ) (sq_nonneg (w₁.1 0 - w₂.1 0)),
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hα hβ) (sq_nonneg (w₁.1 1 - w₂.1 1))]
    · show |α * w₁.2.1 + (1 - α) * w₂.2.1 - c a| ≤ 9 * ρ
      obtain ⟨a1, b1⟩ := abs_le.mp h12
      obtain ⟨a2, b2⟩ := abs_le.mp h22
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a1 hα, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b1 hα,
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left a2 hβ, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left b2 hβ]
    · show ‖α • w₁.2.2 + (1 - α) • w₂.2.2‖ ≤ 2
      calc ‖α • w₁.2.2 + (1 - α) • w₂.2.2‖ ≤ ‖α • w₁.2.2‖ + ‖(1 - α) • w₂.2.2‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = α * ‖w₁.2.2‖ + (1 - α) * ‖w₂.2.2‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hα, Real.norm_of_nonneg hβ]
        _ ≤ 2 := by
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h13 hα, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h23 hβ]
  
  have hsub5 : mseParamSet a c ρ ⊆ mseLagDom a Ω := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hw
    show smthLift a w.1 w.2.1 ∈ Ω
    apply hball
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a]
    simp only [Real.dist_eq, sq_abs, hlift_a, hlift_s]
    have ht : (w.2.1 - c a) ^ 2 ≤ (9 * ρ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h2 2
    refine Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ρ]
  exact ⟨hD, hLag, hcompact, hconv, hsub5⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Ω : Set E3) (c : E3) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hball : Metric.closedBall c (10 * ρ) ⊆ Ω)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) Ω)
    (hsymm : ∀ y i j, G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ Ω, (G y).PosDef) (a : Fin 3) :
    ∃ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam ∧ ∀ w ∈ mseParamSet a c ρ, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp (smthLag G a) i j w * ξ i * ξ j

signature.name: mse_lag_elliptic
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Ω : Set E3) (c : E3) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hball : Metric.closedBall c (10 * ρ) ⊆ Ω)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) Ω)
    (hsymm : ∀ y i j, G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ Ω, (G y).PosDef) (a : Fin 3) :
    ∃ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam ∧ ∀ w ∈ mseParamSet a c ρ, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp (smthLag G a) i j w * ξ i * ξ j

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hOo, hΛ, hKc, -, hKO⟩ := mse_lag_smooth G Ω c ρ hΩ hρ hball hG hsymm hpos a
  
  
  
  have hs3 : ∀ c₀ A B C : ℝ, 0 < c₀ → 0 < C → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < A - 2 * B * s + C * s ^ 2) →
      0 < deriv (fun t : ℝ =>
        deriv (fun s : ℝ => c₀ * Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * s + C * s ^ 2)) t) 0 := by
    intro c₀ A B C hc₀ hC hφ
    have hφd : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => A - 2 * B * s + C * s ^ 2)
        (-2 * B + 2 * C * s) s := by
      intro s
      have h1 := ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul (2 * B)).const_sub A
      have h2 := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 s).const_mul C
      convert h1.add h2 using 1
      simp; ring
    have hsq : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => c₀ * Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * s + C * s ^ 2))
        (c₀ * ((-2 * B + 2 * C * s) / (2 * Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * s + C * s ^ 2)))) s := by
      intro s
      exact ((hφd s).sqrt (hφ s).ne').const_mul c₀
    have hfun : deriv (fun s => c₀ * Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * s + C * s ^ 2)) =
        fun t => c₀ * ((-2 * B + 2 * C * t) / (2 * Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * t + C * t ^ 2))) := by
      funext t
      exact (hsq t).deriv
    rw [hfun]
    have hN : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -2 * B + 2 * C * t) (2 * C) 0 := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).const_mul (2 * C)).const_add (-2 * B)
      simpa using this
    have hD : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * t + C * t ^ 2))
        (2 * ((-2 * B + 2 * C * 0) / (2 * Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * 0 + C * 0 ^ 2)))) 0 :=
      ((hφd 0).sqrt (hφ 0).ne').const_mul 2
    set r := Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * 0 + C * 0 ^ 2) with hr
    have hA0 : A - 2 * B * 0 + C * 0 ^ 2 = A := by ring
    have hrpos : 0 < r := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hφ 0)
    have hr2 : r ^ 2 = A := by
      rw [hr, Real.sq_sqrt (hφ 0).le, hA0]
    have hDne : 2 * r ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hdiv := (hN.div hD hDne).const_mul c₀
    show 0 < deriv (fun t => c₀ * ((-2 * B + 2 * C * t) /
      (2 * Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * t + C * t ^ 2)))) 0
    rw [show deriv (fun t => c₀ * ((-2 * B + 2 * C * t) /
      (2 * Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * t + C * t ^ 2)))) 0 = _ from hdiv.deriv, ← hr]
    have hdisc : 0 < A * C - B ^ 2 := by
      have h := hφ (B / C)
      have e : A - 2 * B * (B / C) + C * (B / C) ^ 2 = (A * C - B ^ 2) / C := by
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [e] at h
      exact (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hC).mp h
    have key : (2 * C * (2 * r) - (-2 * B + 2 * C * 0) * (2 * ((-2 * B + 2 * C * 0) / (2 * r)))) /
        (2 * r) ^ 2 = (A * C - B ^ 2) / (r * r ^ 2) := by
      rw [← hr2]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [key]
    exact mul_pos hc₀ (div_pos hdisc (by positivity))
  
  
  
  have hs4 : ∀ (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)), (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).PosDef →
      ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ξ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ c₀ A B C : ℝ, 0 < c₀ ∧ 0 < C ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < A - 2 * B * s + C * s ^ 2) ∧
        ∀ s : ℝ, smthLag G a (w + s • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ)) =
          c₀ * Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * s + C * s ^ 2) := by
    intro w hw ξ hξ
    set y := smthLift a w.1 w.2.1 with hy
    set M := (G y)⁻¹ with hM
    set q := smthCovec a w.2.2 with hq
    set ι : Fin 3 → ℝ := Fin.insertNth a (0 : ℝ) ξ with hι
    have hMpos : M.PosDef := hw.inv
    have hform : ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, x ≠ 0 →
        0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * x i * x j := by
      intro x hx
      have h := hMpos.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
      have e : dotProduct (star x) (M.mulVec x) =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * x i * x j := by
        simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [← e]
      exact h
    have hι0 : ι ≠ 0 := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hξ
      intro h
      have h' := congrFun h (a.succAbove k)
      simp [hι, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove] at h'
      exact hk h'
    have hcov : ∀ s : ℝ, smthCovec a (w.2.2 + s • ξ) = fun i => q i - s * ι i := by
      intro s
      funext i
      rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
      · simp [hq, hι, smthCovec]
      · simp [hq, hι, smthCovec]
        ring
    set A := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * q i * q j with hA
    set B := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * (q i * ι j + ι i * q j) with hB
    set C := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * ι i * ι j with hC
    have hexp : ∀ s : ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * (q i - s * ι i) * (q j - s * ι j) =
        A - 2 * B * s + C * s ^ 2 := by
      intro s
      simp only [hA, hB, hC, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt (G y).det, A, B, C, Real.sqrt_pos.2 hw.det_pos, hform ι hι0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro s
      rw [← hexp s]
      apply hform
      intro h
      have h' := congrFun h a
      simp [hq, hι, smthCovec] at h'
    · intro s
      have h1 : (w + s • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ)).1 = w.1 := by simp
      have h2 : (w + s • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ)).2.1 = w.2.1 := by simp
      have h3 : (w + s • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ)).2.2 = w.2.2 + s • ξ := by simp
      unfold smthLag
      rw [h1, h2, h3, hcov s, ← hexp s]
  
  
  
  have hs2 : ∀ (Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
      (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ O →
      (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (mseLpp Λ i j) O) ∧
      ∀ w ∈ O, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp Λ i j w * ξ i * ξ j =
          deriv (fun t : ℝ =>
            deriv (fun s : ℝ => Λ (w + s • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ))) t) 0 := by
    intro Λ O hO hΛ
    have h3 : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
    have hΛ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun y => fderiv ℝ Λ y) O := hΛ.fderiv_of_isOpen hO h3
    have hdΛ : ∀ v ∈ O, DifferentiableAt ℝ Λ v := fun v hv =>
      (hΛ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hv)
    have hdΛ1 : ∀ v ∈ O, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) v := fun v hv =>
      (hΛ1.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hv)
    have hLpp : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ∀ w ∈ O, mseLpp Λ i j w =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), Pi.single j 1)
          ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), Pi.single i 1) := by
      intro i j w hw
      have h := (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ),
        (Pi.single i 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ))).hasFDerivAt.comp w (hdΛ1 w hw).hasFDerivAt
      have e : fderiv ℝ (mseLp Λ i) w = (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ),
        (Pi.single i 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ))).comp (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w) := h.fderiv
      unfold mseLpp
      rw [e]
      rfl
    have hcont : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (mseLpp Λ i j) O := by
      intro i j
      have hc1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (mseLp Λ i) O := hΛ1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      have hc2 := hc1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by norm_num)
      exact hc2.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    refine ⟨hcont, ?_⟩
    intro w hw ξ
    have hΞE : ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ) =
        ξ 0 • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) +
        ξ 1 • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) := by
      ext k
      · simp
      · simp
      · fin_cases k <;> simp
    have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp Λ i j w * ξ i * ξ j =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Λ) w ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ) ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      rw [hLpp 0 0 w hw, hLpp 0 1 w hw, hLpp 1 0 w hw, hLpp 1 1 w hw, hΞE]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hline : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => w + s • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ))
        ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ) t := by
      intro t
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ)).const_add w
    have hI : {t : ℝ | w + t • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ) ∈ O} ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℝ) := by
      have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => w + t • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ)) := by fun_prop
      exact hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (by simpa using hO.mem_nhds hw)
    have hev : deriv (fun s : ℝ => Λ (w + s • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ))) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun t => fderiv ℝ Λ (w + t • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ))
          ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ) := by
      filter_upwards [hI] with t ht
      exact ((hdΛ _ ht).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hline t)).deriv
    rw [hev.deriv_eq, hsum]
    have h2 := (hdΛ1 (w + (0 : ℝ) • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ))
      (by simpa using hw)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) (hline 0)
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at h2
    have h4 := (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ
      ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) h2
    exact h4.deriv.symm
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨hcont, hline⟩ := hs2 (smthLag G a) (mseLagDom a Ω) hOo hΛ
  set K := mseParamSet a c ρ with hKdef
  have hell : ∀ w ∈ K, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ξ ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp (smthLag G a) i j w * ξ i * ξ j := by
    intro w hw ξ hξ
    have hwO : w ∈ mseLagDom a Ω := hKO hw
    have hPD : (G (smthLift a w.1 w.2.1)).PosDef := hpos _ hwO
    obtain ⟨c₀, A, B, C, hc₀, hC, hφ, hfor⟩ := hs4 w hPD ξ hξ
    rw [hline w hwO ξ]
    have hf : (fun s : ℝ => smthLag G a (w + s • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), ξ))) =
        fun s : ℝ => c₀ * Real.sqrt (A - 2 * B * s + C * s ^ 2) := funext hfor
    rw [hf]
    exact hs3 c₀ A B C hc₀ hC hφ
  
  
  
  rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty K with hKe | hKne
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    rw [hKe] at hx
    exact absurd hx (Set.notMem_empty x)
  set S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ) := Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ) 1 with hSdef
  have hS : IsCompact S := isCompact_sphere 0 1
  have hP : IsCompact (K ×ˢ S) := hKc.prod hS
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ := hKne
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁⟩ : S.Nonempty := NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.mpr zero_le_one
  have hPne : (K ×ˢ S).Nonempty := ⟨(x₁, η₁), Set.mk_mem_prod hx₁ hη₁⟩
  have hcontP : ContinuousOn
      (fun p : ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) × (Fin 2 → ℝ) =>
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp (smthLag G a) i j p.1 * p.2 i * p.2 j) (K ×ˢ S) := by
    have hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn
        (fun p : ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) × (Fin 2 → ℝ) =>
          mseLpp (smthLag G a) i j p.1) (K ×ˢ S) := fun i j =>
      ((hcont i j).mono hKO).comp continuousOn_fst (fun p hp => (Set.mem_prod.mp hp).1)
    have hC : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn
        (fun p : ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => p.2 i) (K ×ˢ S) :=
      fun i => ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_)
    exact ((hA i j).mul (hC i)).mul (hC j)
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hmin⟩ := hP.exists_isMinOn hPne hcontP
  set m : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp (smthLag G a) i j p₀.1 * p₀.2 i * p₀.2 j
    with hmdef
  have hmin' : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ η ∈ S,
      m ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp (smthLag G a) i j x * η i * η j := by
    intro x hx η hη
    exact (isMinOn_iff.mp hmin) (x, η) (Set.mk_mem_prod hx hη)
  have hm : 0 < m := by
    obtain ⟨hx₀, hη₀⟩ := Set.mem_prod.mp hp₀
    have hn : ‖p₀.2‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hη₀
    have hne : p₀.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, norm_zero] at hn
      exact zero_ne_one hn
    exact hell p₀.1 hx₀ p₀.2 hne
  refine ⟨m / 2, half_pos hm, ?_⟩
  intro x hx ξ
  by_cases hξ : ξ = 0
  · subst hξ
    simp
  have hr : 0 < ‖ξ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hξ
  set r : ℝ := ‖ξ‖ with hrdef
  set η : Fin 2 → ℝ := r⁻¹ • ξ with hηdef
  have hηn : ‖η‖ = 1 := by
    rw [hηdef, norm_smul, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne']
  have hηS : η ∈ S := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr hηn
  have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 2, ξ i = r * η i := by
    intro i
    rw [hηdef, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_mul]
  have hhom : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp (smthLag G a) i j x * ξ i * ξ j =
      r ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp (smthLag G a) i j x * η i * η j := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hcoord 0, hcoord 1]
    ring
  have hbd : ∀ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    have h1 : |ξ i| ≤ r := by
      have := norm_le_pi_norm ξ i
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have h2 : 0 ≤ |ξ i| := abs_nonneg _
    rw [← sq_abs]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ h2 h1 2
  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ 2 * r ^ 2 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    linarith [hbd 0, hbd 1]
  have hmq := hmin' x hx η hηS
  rw [hhom]
  have hr2 : 0 ≤ r ^ 2 := sq_nonneg r
  calc m / 2 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ m / 2 * (2 * r ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by linarith)
    _ = r ^ 2 * m := by ring
    _ ≤ r ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp (smthLag G a) i j x * η i * η j :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmq hr2

subgoal_signatures.name: mse_lag_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Ω : Set E3) (c : E3) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hball : Metric.closedBall c (10 * ρ) ⊆ Ω)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) Ω)
    (hsymm : ∀ y i j, G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ Ω, (G y).PosDef) (a : Fin 3) :
    IsOpen (mseLagDom a Ω) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (smthLag G a) (mseLagDom a Ω) ∧
    IsCompact (mseParamSet a c ρ) ∧ Convex ℝ (mseParamSet a c ρ) ∧
    mseParamSet a c ρ ⊆ mseLagDom a Ω

informal_problem.statement:
(β₀ β₁ β₂ d : ℝ) : ∃ B : NNReal, ∀ (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))
    (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), IsOpen S → Convex ℝ S → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ‖x - y‖ ≤ d) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u S →
    (∀ x ∈ S, |u x| ≤ β₀ ∧ (∀ m : Fin 2, |smthGrad u x m| ≤ β₁) ∧
      ∀ l m : Fin 2, |smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y l) x m| ≤ β₂) →
    mseQC 1 B u S

signature.name: mse_QC_base
signature.statement:
(β₀ β₁ β₂ d : ℝ) : ∃ B : NNReal, ∀ (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))
    (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), IsOpen S → Convex ℝ S → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ‖x - y‖ ≤ d) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u S →
    (∀ x ∈ S, |u x| ≤ β₀ ∧ (∀ m : Fin 2, |smthGrad u x m| ≤ β₁) ∧
      ∀ l m : Fin 2, |smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y l) x m| ≤ β₂) →
    mseQC 1 B u S

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hclm : ∀ (L : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (γ : ℝ), 0 ≤ γ →
      (∀ m : Fin 2, |L (Pi.single m 1)| ≤ γ) → ‖L‖ ≤ 2 * γ := by
    intro L γ hγ hL
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound L (by linarith) (fun h => ?_)
    have hdec : h = h 0 • (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) + h 1 • (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) := by
      funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp
    have hLh : L h = h 0 * L (Pi.single 0 1) + h 1 * L (Pi.single 1 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hdec]
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have h0 : |h 0| ≤ ‖h‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm h 0
    have h1 : |h 1| ≤ ‖h‖ := by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact norm_le_pi_norm h 1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hLh]
    calc |h 0 * L (Pi.single 0 1) + h 1 * L (Pi.single 1 1)|
        ≤ |h 0 * L (Pi.single 0 1)| + |h 1 * L (Pi.single 1 1)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |h 0| * |L (Pi.single 0 1)| + |h 1| * |L (Pi.single 1 1)| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      _ ≤ ‖h‖ * γ + ‖h‖ * γ :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul h0 (hL 0) (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
            (mul_le_mul h1 (hL 1) (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = 2 * γ * ‖h‖ := by ring
  
  have hhold : ∀ (γ : ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), Convex ℝ S →
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ‖x - y‖ ≤ d) → (∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) →
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ m : Fin 2, |smthGrad f x m| ≤ γ) →
      HolderOnWith (Real.toNNReal (2 * |γ|) * Real.toNNReal |d| ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2))
        (1 / 2 : NNReal) f S := by
    intro γ S f hS hd hf hg
    have hder : ∀ x ∈ S, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖₊ ≤ Real.toNNReal (2 * |γ|) := by
      intro x hx
      have := hclm (fderiv ℝ f x) |γ| (abs_nonneg _)
        (fun m => (hg x hx m).trans (le_abs_self γ))
      rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, coe_nnnorm, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by positivity)]
      exact this
    have hlip := Convex.lipschitzOnWith_of_nnnorm_fderiv_le hf hder hS
    have hhol1 := hlip.holderOnWith
    have hdiam : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, edist x y ≤ ((Real.toNNReal |d| : NNReal) : ENNReal) := by
      intro x hx y hy
      rw [edist_dist, dist_eq_norm, ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal,
        Real.coe_toNNReal _ (abs_nonneg _)]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ((hd x hx y hy).trans (le_abs_self d))
    have h2 := HolderOnWith.of_le hdiam hhol1 (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : NNReal) ≤ 1)
    have hexp : ((1 : NNReal) : ℝ) - ((1 / 2 : NNReal) : ℝ) = (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by
      push_cast; norm_num
    rw [hexp] at h2
    exact h2
  
  obtain ⟨B, hB0, hB1, hBH1, hBH2⟩ : ∃ B : NNReal, Real.toNNReal |β₀| ≤ B ∧
      Real.toNNReal |β₁| ≤ B ∧
      Real.toNNReal (2 * |β₁|) * Real.toNNReal |d| ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ≤ B ∧
      Real.toNNReal (2 * |β₂|) * Real.toNNReal |d| ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ≤ B :=
    ⟨Real.toNNReal |β₀| + Real.toNNReal |β₁| +
        (Real.toNNReal (2 * |β₁|) * Real.toNNReal |d| ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2) +
          Real.toNNReal (2 * |β₂|) * Real.toNNReal |d| ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)),
      le_self_add.trans le_self_add, le_add_self.trans le_self_add,
      le_self_add.trans le_add_self, le_add_self.trans le_add_self⟩
  refine ⟨B, ?_⟩
  intro S u hSo hSc hd hu hb
  
  have hR1 : ∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ u x := fun x hx =>
    (hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hSo.mem_nhds hx)
  have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ u) S :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hSo).mp hu).2
  have hR2 : ∀ m : Fin 2, ∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => smthGrad u y m) x := by
    intro m x hx
    have h' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (Pi.single m 1)) S :=
      hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h'.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hSo.mem_nhds hx)
  have cB0 : |β₀| ≤ (B : ℝ) := by
    have := NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr hB0
    rwa [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (abs_nonneg _)] at this
  have cB1 : |β₁| ≤ (B : ℝ) := by
    have := NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr hB1
    rwa [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (abs_nonneg _)] at this
  show ((∀ x ∈ S, |u x| ≤ (B : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith B (1 / 2 : NNReal) u S) ∧
      ∀ m : Fin 2, ((∀ x ∈ S, |smthGrad u x m| ≤ (B : ℝ)) ∧
        HolderOnWith B (1 / 2 : NNReal) (fun x => smthGrad u x m) S)
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun m => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro x hx
    linarith [(hb x hx).1, le_abs_self β₀]
  · exact (hhold β₁ S u hSc hd hR1 (fun x hx m => (hb x hx).2.1 m)).mono_const hBH1
  · intro x hx
    linarith [(hb x hx).2.1 m, le_abs_self β₁]
  · exact (hhold β₂ S (fun y => smthGrad u y m) hSc hd (hR2 m)
      (fun x hx l => (hb x hx).2.2 m l)).mono_const hBH2

informal_problem.statement:
(Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (O 𝒦 : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΛ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ O)
    (h𝒦 : IsCompact 𝒦) (h𝒦c : Convex ℝ 𝒦) (h𝒦O : 𝒦 ⊆ O) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hell : ∀ w ∈ 𝒦, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp Λ i j w * ξ i * ξ j)
    (k : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ B' : NNReal, ∀ (D S T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      IsOpen D → IsOpen S → S ⊆ D → (∀ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x R ⊆ S) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u D → (∀ x ∈ D, (x, u x, smthGrad u x) ∈ 𝒦) →
      (∀ x ∈ D, smthELop Λ u x = 0) →
      mseQC (k + 1) B u S → mseQC (k + 2) B' u T

signature.name: mse_quasilinear_step
signature.statement:
(Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (O 𝒦 : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΛ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ O)
    (h𝒦 : IsCompact 𝒦) (h𝒦c : Convex ℝ 𝒦) (h𝒦O : 𝒦 ⊆ O) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hell : ∀ w ∈ 𝒦, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp Λ i j w * ξ i * ξ j)
    (k : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ B' : NNReal, ∀ (D S T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      IsOpen D → IsOpen S → S ⊆ D → (∀ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x R ⊆ S) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u D → (∀ x ∈ D, (x, u x, smthGrad u x) ∈ 𝒦) →
      (∀ x ∈ D, smthELop Λ u x = 0) →
      mseQC (k + 1) B u S → mseQC (k + 2) B' u T

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hD1 : ∀ (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O →
      ∀ v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => fderiv ℝ f w v) O := by
    intro f hf v
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hf).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hLp : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mseLp Λ i) O := fun i => hD1 Λ hΛ _
  have hLz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mseLz Λ) O := hD1 Λ hΛ _
  have hLpp : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mseLpp Λ i j) O := fun i j => hD1 _ (hLp i) _
  have hLpx : ∀ i m : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mseLpx Λ i m) O := fun i m => hD1 _ (hLp i) _
  have hLpz : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mseLpz Λ i) O := fun i => hD1 _ (hLp i) _
  have hproj : ∀ m : Fin 2,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => w.2.2 m) O := by
    intro m
    exact ((contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ m).comp (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_snd)).contDiffOn
  
  set ΦF : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := fun m i w =>
    (if i = m then mseLz Λ w else 0) - mseLpx Λ i m w - mseLpz Λ i w * w.2.2 m with hΦF_def
  have hΦF : ∀ m i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ΦF m i) O := by
    intro m i
    have hif : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞

by
  
  have hA : ∀ (k : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), mseQC k B f S →

    intro k B f h x hx
    cases k with
    | zero => exact h.1 x hx
    | succ k => exact h.1.1 x hx
  have hle : ∀ k : ℕ, ((k : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := fun k => WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top

      mseQC m β u S → ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ j : Fin n → Fin 2,
        |iteratedFDeriv ℝ n u x (fun k => (Pi.single (j k) (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))| ≤ (β : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro m _ u _ hQ x hx j
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply]
      exact hA m β u hQ x hx
    | succ n ih =>
      intro m hm u hu hQ x hx j
      obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ : ∃ m', m = m' + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
      have hder : ∀ i : Fin 2, mseQC m' β (fun x => smthGrad u x i) S := hQ.2
      have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ u) S :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hS).1 hu).2
      have hu' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
          (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (Pi.single (j (Fin.last n)) (1 : ℝ))) S :=
        hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right]
      rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hS hx]
      rw [← iteratedFDerivWithin_clm_apply_const_apply hS.uniqueDiffOn hfd (hle n) hx]
      rw [iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hS hx]
      exact ih m' (by omega) _ hu' (hder (j (Fin.last n))) x hx (fun k => j k.castSucc)
  
  have s2 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ℝ)
      (B : ℝ), 0 ≤ B →
      (∀ j : Fin n → Fin 2, |f (fun k => (Pi.single (j k) (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))| ≤ B) →
      ‖f‖ ≤ 2 ^ n * B := by
    intro n f B hB h
    refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.opNorm_le_bound
      (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by norm_num) n) hB) (fun v => ?_)
    have hv : v = fun k => ∑ i : Fin 2, v k i • (Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) := by
      funext k
      ext t
      simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    have hfv : f v = ∑ r : Fin n → Fin 2,
        (∏ k, v k (r k)) * f (fun k => (Pi.single (r k) (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.map_sum]

    rw [hfv]
    calc ‖∑ r : Fin n → Fin 2,
          (∏ k, v k (r k)) * f (fun k => (Pi.single (r k) (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))‖

          ‖(∏ k, v k (r k)) * f (fun k => (Pi.single (r k) (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))‖ :=
          norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _r : Fin n → Fin 2, (∏ k, ‖v k‖) * B := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro r _
          rw [norm_mul, norm_prod]
          apply mul_le_mul _ (by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h r) (norm_nonneg _)
            (Finset.prod_nonneg fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
          exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)
            (fun k _ => norm_le_pi_norm (v k) (r k))
      _ = 2 ^ n * B * ∏ k, ‖v k‖ := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin,
            Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          push_cast
          ring
  
  let L : E3 →L[ℝ] (Fin 2 → ℝ) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun k : Fin 2 => EuclideanSpace.proj (a.succAbove k))
  have hLz : ∀ z, L z = smthHoriz a z := by
    intro z
    funext k
    simp [L, smthHoriz]
  have hL1 : ‖L‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun z => ?_)

    refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg z)).2 (fun k => ?_)

    funext z
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, hLz]
  have hyS : L y ∈ S := by rw [hLz]; exact hy

  have key : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun z => u (smthHoriz a z)) y =

  rw [key]
  calc ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ n u (smthHoriz a y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fun _ => L)‖

        gcongr
        exact Finset.prod_le_one (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun _ _ => hL1)

        rw [hcc m hm, hpy, smul_smul]

    refine ⟨_, hβs, ?_⟩

        · refine ⟨⟨interior_subset (hFK hxF), frontier_subset_closure hxF⟩, ?_⟩
          show τ x ≤ δ
          rw [hτF x hxF]; exact hδ.le
        · exact ⟨⟨hNK hxN, subset_closure hxU⟩, hxI⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨hxK, hxc⟩, hxI⟩
        rw [hcl] at hxc
        rcases hxc with h | h
        · have hτx : τ x < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt hxI hδε
          exact Or.inr ⟨⟨h, hdia x hxK hτx, hτx⟩, hxI⟩
        · exact Or.inl h
    rw [heq]
    exact (hKcl.inter isClosed_closure).inter (IsClosed.preimage hτc isClosed_Iic)
  have hτ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ := by
    intro δ hδ
    refine ⟨interior K ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Iio (min δ ε),
      isOpen_interior.inter (hτc.isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_Iio), fun x hx => ⟨hFK hx, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show τ x < min δ ε
      rw [hτF x hx]; exact lt_min hδ hε
    · rintro x ⟨hxU, hxK, hxτ⟩
      have h1 : τ x < min δ ε := hxτ
      exact ⟨⟨hxK, lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (min_le_right _ _)⟩, lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  
  have hgoodOut : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ ∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, τ x = |f x| := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨β, hβ, hev⟩ := hgood p hp
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hto, hpt⟩ := eventually_nhds_iff.1 hev
    refine ⟨t ∩ N₁, β, hto.inter hN₁o, ⟨hpt, hKN₁ hp⟩, hβ, fun x hx => (ht x hx.1).2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hxV, hxF⟩
        refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
        have h1 : τ x = 0 := hτF x hxF
        rw [(ht x hxV.1).1] at h1
        exact abs_eq_zero.mp h1
      · rintro ⟨hxV, hx0⟩
        refine ⟨hxV, ?_⟩
        by_contra hxF
        have h1 : 0 < τ x := hτpos x hxV.2 hxF
        rw [(ht x hxV.1).1, hx0, abs_zero] at h1
        exact lt_irrefl 0 h1
    · intro x hx
      exact (ht x hx.1.1.1).1
  
  exact ⟨N, ε, τ, hNo, hFN, hNc, hε, hτsm.mono (fun x hx => hUF x hx.1),
    fun x hx => hreg x (hKW (hNK hx.2)).2 (hτb x hx).1, hτb, hτp, hτi, hτ0, hgoodOut⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨φ, lam, hlam, hdata⟩ := jacobi_eigen_data g (frontier U) hFc hfront
  
  have hstab := collar_jacobi_nonneg g U hUo hFc hfront N ε σ hNo hFN hNc hε hσs hσr hσb
    hσp hσi hσ0 hWO φ lam hlam hdata
  
  obtain ⟨P, pr, hPpr, hcomp⟩ := good_collar_leaf_patched g U hUo hFc hfront N ε σ hNo hFN
    hNc hε hσs hσr hσb hσp hσi hσ0 hgood
  
  have hLc : IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) := by
    have h := hσp (ε / 2) (ε / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    rwa [Set.Icc_self] at h
  
  have hloc : ∀ (h₁ h₂ : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x : E2), h₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] h₂ →
      gaussCurv2 h₁ x = gaussCurv2 h₂ x := by
    intro h₁ h₂ x hev
    have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h₁ k i j =ᶠ[𝓝 x] christoffel2 h₂ k i j := by
      intro k i j
      filter_upwards [hev.eventuallyEq_nhds] with y hy
      have hpd : ∀ a b c : Fin 2,
          pd2 c (fun z => h₁ z a b) y = pd2 c (fun z => h₂ z a b) y := by
        intro a b c
        have he : (fun z => h₁ z a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => h₂ z a b) :=
          hy.mono (fun z hz => by simp only [hz])
        unfold pd2
        rw [he.fderiv_eq]
      have hyy : h₁ y = h₂ y := hy.eq_of_nhds
      simp only [christoffel2, hyy, hpd]
    have hx : h₁ x = h₂ x := hev.eq_of_nhds
    have hchrx : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h₁ k i j x = christoffel2 h₂ k i j x :=
      fun k i j => (hchr k i j).eq_of_nhds
    have hpdc : ∀ c k i j : Fin 2,
        pd2 c (christoffel2 h₁ k i j) x = pd2 c (christoffel2 h₂ k i j) x := by
      intro c k i j
      unfold pd2
      rw [(hchr k i j).fderiv_eq]
    simp only [gaussCurv2, ricci2, hx, hpdc, hchrx]
  
  have hprF : ∀ q ∈ U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}, pr q ∈ frontier U ∧ 0 < φ (pr q) := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hq)
    have hmem : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
      rw [P.image_eq j]
      exact ⟨hj, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hmem
    obtain ⟨z, F, hF, hpr, -⟩ := hPpr j
    rw [hpr x hx]
    have hS : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ frontier U := (hF.2.2 x hx).2.1
    exact ⟨hS, (hdata _ hS).1⟩
  
  have hKeq : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∃ (z : M) (F : E2 → E3), eigSurfParam (frontier U) z (P.W j) F ∧
      (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) = pr (P.param j x) ∧
      ∃ T : ℝ, 0 ≤ T ∧ (T = 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x = 0) ∧
        0 ≤ gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x ∧ 0 < φ (pr (P.param j x)) ∧
        gaussCurv2 (fun y => (φ (pr (P.param j y))) ^ 2 • P.h j y) x *
            (φ (pr (P.param j x))) ^ 2 =
          lam (pr (P.param j x)) + g.scalarCurvature (pr (P.param j x)) / 2 +
            gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x / 2 + T := by
    intro j x hx
    obtain ⟨z, F, hF, hpr, hh⟩ := hPpr j
    obtain ⟨-, hpos, hA, T, hT, hT0, hid⟩ :=
      jacobi_conformal_curvature g (frontier U) hfront φ lam hdata z (P.W j) F hF x hx
    have hev : (fun y => (φ (pr (P.param j y))) ^ 2 • P.h j y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => (φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) ^ 2 •
          pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F y) := by
      filter_upwards [(P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx] with y hy
      rw [hpr y hy, hh]
    refine ⟨z, F, hF, (hpr x hx).symm, T, hT, hT0, hA, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hpr x hx]
      exact hpos
    · rw [hloc _ _ x hev, hpr x hx]
      exact hid
  
  have hKnn : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      0 ≤ gaussCurv2 (fun y => (φ (pr (P.param j y))) ^ 2 • P.h j y) x := by
    intro j x hx
    obtain ⟨z, F, hF, hq, T, hT, -, hA, hpos, hid⟩ := hKeq j x hx
    have hS : pr (P.param j x) ∈ frontier U := by
      rw [← hq]
      exact (hF.2.2 x hx).2.1
    have h1 := hstab _ hS
    have h2 := hR (pr (P.param j x))
    have hsum : 0 ≤ gaussCurv2 (fun y => (φ (pr (P.param j y))) ^ 2 • P.h j y) x *
        (φ (pr (P.param j x))) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hid]
      linarith
    have hp2 : 0 < (φ (pr (P.param j x))) ^ 2 := by positivity
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    nlinarith
  
  refine patched_conformal_curvature_liftable _ hLc P (fun q => φ (pr q)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · 
    intro j
    obtain ⟨z, F, hF, hpr, -⟩ := hPpr j
    rcases (P.W j).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hne | ⟨x, hx⟩
    · rw [hne]
      exact contDiffOn_empty
    · obtain ⟨hsm, -⟩ :=
        jacobi_conformal_curvature g (frontier U) hfront φ lam hdata z (P.W j) F hF x hx
      refine hsm.congr ?_
      intro y hy
      show φ (pr (P.param j y)) = φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))
      rw [hpr y hy]
  · 
    intro q hq
    exact (hprF q hq).2
  · 
    intro j x hx
    exact hKnn j x hx
  · 
    intro q hq
    show ∃ j, ∃ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) q ∧
      0 < gaussCurv2 (fun y => (φ (pr (P.param j y))) ^ 2 • P.h j y) x
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    refine degenerate_frontier_rigidity g hR U hUo hFc hfront hnone N ε σ hNo hFN hNc hε hσs
      hσr hσb hσp hσi hσ0 hgood hWO φ lam hlam hdata (pr q) (hprF q hq).1 ?_
    intro q' hq'
    rw [← hcomp q hq] at hq'
    obtain ⟨q'', hq'', rfl⟩ := hq'
    have hq''L : q'' ∈ U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2} := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _ hq''
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hq''L)
    have hmem : q'' ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
      rw [P.image_eq j]
      exact ⟨hj, hq''L⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hmem
    obtain ⟨z, F, hF, hqe, T, hT, hT0, hA, hpos, hid⟩ := hKeq j x hx
    have hK0 : gaussCurv2 (fun y => (φ (pr (P.param j y))) ^ 2 • P.h j y) x = 0 :=
      le_antisymm (hcon j x hx hq'') (hKnn j x hx)
    rw [hK0, zero_mul] at hid
    have hS : pr (P.param j x) ∈ frontier U := by
      rw [← hqe]
      exact (hF.2.2 x hx).2.1
    have h1 := hstab _ hS
    have h2 := hR (pr (P.param j x))
    refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, z, P.W j, F, x, hF, hx, hqe, by linarith,
      hT0 (by linarith)⟩

by
  
  have hcompat : ∀ (X : Set M) (hX : IsOpen X) (f : M → ℝ) (a b m : ℝ) (ham : a < m)
      (hmb : m < b) (hfs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f X)
      (hfr : ∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0)
      (hfb : ∀ x ∈ X, a < f x ∧ f x < b)
      (hfp : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → IsCompact (X ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d)),
      ∃ e : ↥X ≃ₜ ↥(X ∩ f ⁻¹' {m}) × ↥(Set.Ioo a b), ∀ x : ↥X, ((e x).2 : ℝ) = f x := by
    intro X hX f a b m ham hmb hfs hfr hfb hfp
    obtain ⟨V, hVs, hVf⟩ := tau_gradient_field g X hX f hfs hfr
    have hloc : ∀ x₀ ∈ X, ∃ (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (ψ : M → ℝ → M), IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ X ∧
        0 < ε ∧ ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => ψ p.1 p.2) (N ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ x ∈ N, ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
          ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, ψ x s ∈ X :=
      fun x₀ hx₀ => local_flow_of_contMDiffAt X hX V x₀ hx₀ (hVs x₀ hx₀)
    have huniq : ∀ (γ γ' : ℝ → M) (α β t₀ : ℝ), t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
        IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → IsMIntegralCurveOn γ' V (Set.Ioo α β) →
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ' t ∈ X) → γ t₀ = γ' t₀ →
        Set.EqOn γ γ' (Set.Ioo α β) :=
      fun γ γ' α β t₀ ht₀ hγ hγ' hγX hγ'X h₀ =>
        integral_curve_eqOn_of_mem X V hVs γ γ' α β t₀ ht₀ hγ hγ' hγX hγ'X h₀
    have hflin : ∀ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β s₀ : ℝ), s₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
        IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) →
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo α β, f (γ s) = f (γ s₀) + (s - s₀) :=
      fun γ α β s₀ hs₀ hγ hγX =>
        tau_affine_along_integral_curve X hX f hfs V hVf γ α β s₀ hs₀ hγ hγX
    have hunif : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → ∃ (O : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (Ψ : M → ℝ → M),
        IsOpen O ∧ X ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Ψ p.1 p.2) (O ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ x ∈ O, Ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (Ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
          ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, Ψ x s ∈ X :=
      fun c d hc hd => uniform_flow_on_compact X (X ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d) Set.inter_subset_left
        (hfp c d hc hd) V hloc huniq
    have hunif' : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → ∃ (O : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (Ψ : M → ℝ → M),
        X ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
        ∀ x ∈ O, Ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (Ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
          ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, Ψ x s ∈ X := by
      intro c d hc hd
      obtain ⟨O, ε, Ψ, _, h1, h2, h3, _, h5⟩ := hunif c d hc hd
      exact ⟨O, ε, Ψ, h1, h2, h3, h5⟩
    have hlong : ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ T₁ T₂ : ℝ, T₁ ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ T₂ → a < f x + T₁ → f x + T₂ < b →
        ∃ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β : ℝ), α < T₁ ∧ T₂ < β ∧ γ 0 = x ∧
          IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X :=
      fun x hx T₁ T₂ h1 h2 h3 h4 =>
        long_integral_curve_exists X f a b V hfb huniq hflin hunif' x hx T₁ T₂ h1 h2 h3 h4
    obtain ⟨Θ, hΘX, hΘ0, hΘadd, hΘc⟩ :=
      global_flow_assembly X hX f a b hfs.continuousOn hfb V huniq hflin hunif hlong
    have hF1 : ∀ x ∈ X, Θ x (m - f x) ∈ X ∧ f (Θ x (m - f x)) = m := by
      intro x hx
      have h := hΘX x hx (m - f x) (by linarith [(hfb x hx).1]) (by linarith [(hfb x hx).2])
      exact ⟨h.1, by rw [h.2]; ring⟩
    have hG1 : ∀ y ∈ X, f y = m → ∀ t : ℝ, a < t → t < b →
        Θ y (t - m) ∈ X ∧ f (Θ y (t - m)) = t := by
      intro y hy hym t ht1 ht2
      have h := hΘX y hy (t - m) (by rw [hym]; linarith) (by rw [hym]; linarith)
      exact ⟨h.1, by rw [h.2, hym]; ring⟩
    let F : ↥X → ↥(X ∩ f ⁻¹' {m}) × ↥(Set.Ioo a b) := fun x =>
      (⟨Θ x.1 (m - f x.1), (hF1 x.1 x.2).1, (hF1 x.1 x.2).2⟩, ⟨f x.1, hfb x.1 x.2⟩)
    let G : ↥(X ∩ f ⁻¹' {m}) × ↥(Set.Ioo a b) → ↥X := fun p =>
      ⟨Θ p.1.1 (p.2.1 - m), (hG1 p.1.1 p.1.2.1 p.1.2.2 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2).1⟩
    have hleft : ∀ x : ↥X, G (F x) = x := by
      intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      show Θ (Θ x.1 (m - f x.1)) (f x.1 - m) = x.1
      have hb := hfb x.1 x.2
      rw [hΘadd x.1 x.2 (m - f x.1) (f x.1 - m) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        (by linarith)]
      rw [show m - f x.1 + (f x.1 - m) = 0 by ring]
      exact hΘ0 x.1 x.2
    have hright : ∀ p : ↥(X ∩ f ⁻¹' {m}) × ↥(Set.Ioo a b), F (G p) = p := by
      rintro ⟨⟨y, hyX, hym⟩, ⟨t, ht1, ht2⟩⟩
      have hym' : f y = m := hym
      have hz := hG1 y hyX hym' t ht1 ht2
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply Subtype.ext
        show Θ (Θ y (t - m)) (m - f (Θ y (t - m))) = y
        rw [hz.2]
        rw [hΘadd y hyX (t - m) (m - t) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)]
        rw [show t - m + (m - t) = 0 by ring]
        exact hΘ0 y hyX
      · apply Subtype.ext
        show f (Θ y (t - m)) = t
        exact hz.2
    have hS : ∀ x : ↥X, (x.1, m - f x.1) ∈
        {p : M × ℝ | p.1 ∈ X ∧ a < f p.1 + p.2 ∧ f p.1 + p.2 < b} := by
      intro x
      refine ⟨x.2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show a < f x.1 + (m - f x.1)
        linarith
      · show f x.1 + (m - f x.1) < b
        linarith
    have hS' : ∀ p : ↥(X ∩ f ⁻¹' {m}) × ↥(Set.Ioo a b), (p.1.1, p.2.1 - m) ∈
        {q : M × ℝ | q.1 ∈ X ∧ a < f q.1 + q.2 ∧ f q.1 + q.2 < b} := by
      intro p
      have h1 : f p.1.1 = m := p.1.2.2
      have h2 := p.2.2
      refine ⟨p.1.2.1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show a < f p.1.1 + (p.2.1 - m)
        linarith [h2.1]
      · show f p.1.1 + (p.2.1 - m) < b
        linarith [h2.2]
    have hfr' : Continuous (fun x : ↥X => f x.1) := hfs.continuousOn.restrict
    have hFc : Continuous F := by
      refine Continuous.prodMk ?_ ?_
      · refine Continuous.subtype_mk ?_ _
        have hsel : Continuous (fun x : ↥X => (x.1, m - f x.1)) :=
          continuous_subtype_val.prodMk (continuous_const.sub hfr')
        exact hΘc.comp_continuous hsel hS
      · exact hfr'.subtype_mk _
    have hGc : Continuous G := by
      refine Continuous.subtype_mk ?_ _
      have hsel : Continuous
          (fun p : ↥(X ∩ f ⁻¹' {m}) × ↥(Set.Ioo a b) => (p.1.1, p.2.1 - m)) :=
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
          ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).sub continuous_const)
      exact hΘc.comp_continuous hsel hS'
    exact ⟨⟨⟨F, G, hleft, hright⟩, hFc, hGc⟩, fun x => rfl⟩
  
  have hthin : ∀ (N₀ : Set M) (ε₀ : ℝ) (f : M → ℝ), frontier U ⊆ N₀ → IsCompact (closure N₀) →
      0 < ε₀ → (∀ x ∈ U ∩ N₀, 0 < f x ∧ f x < ε₀) →
      (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε₀ → IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N₀ ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ))) →
      ∀ O : Set M, IsOpen O → frontier U ⊆ O →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < ε₀ ∧ U ∩ N₀ ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ ⊆ O := by
    intro N₀ ε₀ f hFN₀ hNc₀ hε₀ hfb hfi O hOo hFO
    by_contra hcon
    have hbad : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε₀ → ∃ x, x ∈ U ∩ N₀ ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ ∧ x ∉ O := by
      intro δ h1 h2
      by_contra h3
      apply hcon
      refine ⟨δ, h1, h2, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxO
      exact h3 ⟨x, hx, hxO⟩
    let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ε₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 2)
    have hd0 : ∀ n, 0 < d n := fun n => div_pos hε₀ (by positivity)
    have hdlt : ∀ n, d n < ε₀ := fun n =>
      div_lt_self hε₀ (by have := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n; linarith)
    have hmono : ∀ n, d (n + 1) ≤ d n := by
      intro n
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hε₀.le (by positivity)
      push_cast
      linarith
    let t : ℕ → Set M := fun n => (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N₀ ∩ f ⁻¹' Set.Iic (d n))) ∩ Oᶜ
    have htdec : ∀ n, t (n + 1) ⊆ t n := by
      intro n x hx
      refine ⟨?_, hx.2⟩
      rcases hx.1 with h | ⟨hxUN, hxle⟩
      · exact Or.inl h
      · right
        refine ⟨hxUN, ?_⟩
        show f x ≤ d n
        exact le_trans hxle (hmono n)
    have htne : ∀ n, (t n).Nonempty := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxO⟩ := hbad (d n) (hd0 n) (hdlt n)
      exact ⟨x, Or.inr hx, hxO⟩
    have htcl : ∀ n, IsClosed (t n) := fun n =>
      (hfi (d n) (hd0 n) (hdlt n)).inter hOo.isClosed_compl
    have htc : IsCompact (t 0) := by
      refine hNc₀.of_isClosed_subset (htcl 0) ?_
      intro x hx
      rcases hx.1 with h | h
      · exact subset_closure (hFN₀ h)
      · exact subset_closure h.1.2
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
      IsCompact.nonempty_iInter_of_sequence_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed t htdec htne htc htcl
    rw [Set.mem_iInter] at hx
    have hxn : ∀ n, x ∈ U ∩ N₀ ∧ f x ≤ d n := by
      intro n
      have h := hx n
      rcases h.1 with h1 | h1
      · exact absurd (hFO h1) h.2
      · exact ⟨h1.1, h1.2⟩
    have hfx : 0 < f x := (hfb x (hxn 0).1).1
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (ε₀ / f x)
    have h1 : ε₀ < (n : ℝ) * f x := (div_lt_iff₀ hfx).mp hn
    have h2 : d n < f x := by
      show ε₀ / ((n : ℝ) + 2) < f x
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    have h3 := (hxn n).2
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨O₁, hO₁o, hFO₁, hO₁⟩ := hτ0 ε hε
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂0, hc₂ε', hc₂⟩ := hthin N' ε' σ hFN' hNc' hε' hσb hσi O₁ hO₁o hFO₁
  have hA : ∀ y, y ∈ U ∩ N' → σ y ≤ c₂ → y ∈ U ∩ N := by
    intro y hy hσy
    have h1 : y ∈ O₁ := hc₂ ⟨hy, hσy⟩
    exact ⟨hy.1, (hO₁ ⟨hy.1, h1⟩).1⟩
  obtain ⟨O₂, hO₂o, hFO₂, hO₂⟩ := hσ0 c₂ hc₂0
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδε, hδ⟩ := hthin N ε τ hFN hNc hε hτb hτi O₂ hO₂o hFO₂
  have hB : ∀ x, x ∈ U ∩ N → τ x ≤ δ → x ∈ U ∩ N' ∧ σ x < c₂ := by
    intro x hx hτx
    have h1 : x ∈ O₂ := hδ ⟨hx, hτx⟩
    have h2 := hO₂ ⟨hx.1, h1⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hx.1, h2.1⟩, h2.2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hcompat (U ∩ N) (hUo.inter hNo) τ 0 ε (ε / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    hτs hτr hτb hτp
  obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := hcompat (U ∩ N') (hUo.inter hNo') σ 0 ε' c hc0 hcε hσs hσr hσb hσp
  have hT1 : ∀ (l : ↥(U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' {ε / 2})) (t : ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) ε)),
      τ (e.symm (l, t)).1 = t := by
    intro l t
    have h := he (e.symm (l, t))
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hT2 : ∀ (l : ↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c})) (t : ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) ε')),
      σ (e'.symm (l, t)).1 = t := by
    intro l t
    have h := he' (e'.symm (l, t))
    rw [e'.apply_symm_apply] at h
    exact h.symm
  
  let δ' : ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) ε) := ⟨δ, hδ0, hδε⟩
  have hzB : ∀ l : ↥(U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}),
      (e.symm (l, δ')).1 ∈ U ∩ N' ∧ σ (e.symm (l, δ')).1 < c₂ := by
    intro l
    exact hB _ (e.symm (l, δ')).2 (hT1 l δ').le
  let k : ↥(U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) → ↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂) :=
    fun l => ((e' ⟨(e.symm (l, δ')).1, (hzB l).1⟩).1,
      ⟨σ (e.symm (l, δ')).1, (hσb _ (hzB l).1).1, (hzB l).2⟩)
  have hk : Continuous k := by
    have hz : Continuous (fun l : ↥(U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) => e.symm (l, δ')) :=
      e.symm.continuous.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    have hz' : Continuous (fun l : ↥(U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) =>
        (⟨(e.symm (l, δ')).1, (hzB l).1⟩ : ↥(U ∩ N'))) :=
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp hz).subtype_mk _
    refine Continuous.prodMk (continuous_fst.comp (e'.continuous.comp hz')) ?_
    refine Continuous.subtype_mk ?_ _
    exact (hσs.continuousOn.restrict).comp hz'
  let ι : ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂) → ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) ε') := fun s =>
    ⟨s.1, s.2.1, s.2.2.trans hc₂ε'⟩
  have hι : Continuous ι := continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _
  have hyA : ∀ p : ↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂),
      (e'.symm (p.1, ι p.2)).1 ∈ U ∩ N := by
    intro p
    refine hA _ (e'.symm (p.1, ι p.2)).2 ?_
    rw [hT2]
    exact p.2.2.2.le
  let j : ↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂) → ↥(U ∩ N ∩ τ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) :=
    fun p => (e ⟨(e'.symm (p.1, ι p.2)).1, hyA p⟩).1
  have hj : Continuous j := by
    have hy : Continuous (fun p : ↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂) =>
        e'.symm (p.1, ι p.2)) :=
      e'.symm.continuous.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk (hι.comp continuous_snd))
    have hy' : Continuous (fun p : ↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂) =>
        (⟨(e'.symm (p.1, ι p.2)).1, hyA p⟩ : ↥(U ∩ N))) :=
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp hy).subtype_mk _
    exact continuous_fst.comp (e.continuous.comp hy')
  have hjk : ∀ l, j (k l) = l := by
    intro l
    have h1 : ((k l).1, ι (k l).2) = e' ⟨(e.symm (l, δ')).1, (hzB l).1⟩ := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · rfl
      · apply Subtype.ext
        show σ (e.symm (l, δ')).1 = ((e' ⟨(e.symm (l, δ')).1, (hzB l).1⟩).2 : ℝ)
        exact (he' ⟨(e.symm (l, δ')).1, (hzB l).1⟩).symm
    have h2 : e'.symm ((k l).1, ι (k l).2) = ⟨(e.symm (l, δ')).1, (hzB l).1⟩ := by
      rw [h1, e'.symm_apply_apply]
    have h3 : (⟨(e'.symm ((k l).1, ι (k l).2)).1, hyA (k l)⟩ : ↥(U ∩ N)) = e.symm (l, δ') := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      show (e'.symm ((k l).1, ι (k l).2)).1 = (e.symm (l, δ')).1
      rw [h2]
    show (e ⟨(e'.symm ((k l).1, ι (k l).2)).1, hyA (k l)⟩).1 = l
    rw [h3, e.apply_symm_apply]
  
  have hP : ∀ θ : C(↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂), Circle),
      ∃ φ : C(↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂), ℝ),
        ∀ x, θ x = Circle.exp (φ x) := by
    intro θ
    let m : ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂) := ⟨c₂ / 2, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    let sl : C(↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}), ↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂)) :=
      ⟨fun l => (l, m), by fun_prop⟩
    obtain ⟨φ₀, hφ₀⟩ := hL' (θ.comp sl)
    have hmem : ∀ (s : unitInterval) (t : ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂)),
        (m : ℝ) + (s : ℝ) * ((t : ℝ) - m) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂ := by
      intro s t
      have h := (convex_Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂).add_smul_sub_mem m.2 t.2 ⟨s.2.1, s.2.2⟩
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h
    let gmap : C(unitInterval × (↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂)),
        ↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂)) :=
      ⟨fun p => (p.2.1, ⟨(m : ℝ) + (p.1 : ℝ) * ((p.2.2 : ℝ) - m), hmem p.1 p.2.2⟩), by
        refine continuous_snd.fst.prodMk (Continuous.subtype_mk ?_ _)
        fun_prop⟩
    let ψ : C(↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂), Circle) :=
      ⟨fun x => θ x * (θ (x.1, m))⁻¹, by fun_prop⟩
    let H : C(unitInterval × (↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂)), Circle) :=
      ψ.comp gmap
    have H0 : ∀ x : ↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂),
        H (0, x) = Circle.exp
          ((0 : C(↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂), ℝ)) x) := by
      intro x
      have : (⟨(m : ℝ) + ((0 : unitInterval) : ℝ) * ((x.2 : ℝ) - m), hmem 0 x.2⟩ :
          ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂)) = m := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp
      simp only [H, ψ, gmap, ContinuousMap.comp_apply, ContinuousMap.coe_mk, this]
      simp
    let Ht := Circle.isCoveringMap_exp.liftHomotopy H 0 H0
    have hlift := Circle.isCoveringMap_exp.liftHomotopy_lifts H 0 H0
    let φ' : C(↥(U ∩ N' ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) × ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂), ℝ) :=
      ⟨fun x => φ₀ x.1 + Ht (1, x), by fun_prop⟩
    refine ⟨φ', fun x => ?_⟩
    have h1 : Circle.exp (Ht (1, x)) = H (1, x) := congrFun hlift (1, x)
    have h2 : (⟨(m : ℝ) + ((1 : unitInterval) : ℝ) * ((x.2 : ℝ) - m), hmem 1 x.2⟩ :
        ↥(Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) c₂)) = x.2 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp
    have h3 : H (1, x) = θ x * (θ (x.1, m))⁻¹ := by
      simp only [H, ψ, gmap, ContinuousMap.comp_apply, ContinuousMap.coe_mk, h2]
    have h4 : θ (x.1, m) = Circle.exp (φ₀ x.1) := hφ₀ x.1
    have hcomm : ∀ A B : Circle, B = A * (B * A⁻¹) := fun A B => by
      rw [mul_comm B, mul_inv_cancel_left]
    simp only [φ', ContinuousMap.coe_mk, Circle.exp_add, h1, h3, ← h4]
    exact hcomm _ _
  
  intro θ
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hP (θ.comp ⟨j, hj⟩)
  refine ⟨φ.comp ⟨k, hk⟩, fun l => ?_⟩
  have h := hφ (k l)
  calc θ l = θ (j (k l)) := by rw [hjk l]
    _ = Circle.exp (φ (k l)) := h

      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → IsMIntegralCurveOn γ' V (Set.Ioo α β) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ' t ∈ X) → γ t₀ = γ' t₀ →
      Set.EqOn γ γ' (Set.Ioo α β))
    (hτlin : ∀ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β s₀ : ℝ), s₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) →

      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ' t ∈ X) → γ t₀ = γ' t₀ →
      Set.EqOn γ γ' (Set.Ioo α β))
    (hτlin : ∀ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β s₀ : ℝ), s₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) →
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo α β, τ (γ s) = τ (γ s₀) + (s - s₀))
    (hunif : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → ∃ (O : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (Ψ : M → ℝ → M),
      IsOpen O ∧ X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Ψ p.1 p.2) (O ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, Ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (Ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, Ψ x s ∈ X)
    (hlong : ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ T₁ T₂ : ℝ, T₁ ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ T₂ → a < τ x + T₁ → τ x + T₂ < b →
      ∃ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β : ℝ), α < T₁ ∧ T₂ < β ∧ γ 0 = x ∧
        IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) :
    ∃ Θ : M → ℝ → M,
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∀ s : ℝ, a < τ x + s → τ x + s < b → Θ x s ∈ X ∧ τ (Θ x s) = τ x + s) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, Θ x 0 = x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∀ s s' : ℝ, a < τ x + s → τ x + s < b → a < τ x + s + s' →
        τ x + s + s' < b → Θ (Θ x s) s' = Θ x (s + s')) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 p.2)
        {p : M × ℝ | p.1 ∈ X ∧ a < τ p.1 + p.2 ∧ τ p.1 + p.2 < b}

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R0 : ℝ) (S : Set E3)
    (hS1 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R0, z ∈ closure S → z ∈ S)
    (hS2 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∃ r > 0, ∃ F : E3 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0))
    (b : Fin 3) (z0 : E3) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (w : E3 → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hwc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R}) (hwz : w z0 = z0 b)
    (hgr : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S)
    (hlip : ∀ y y', ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y' - z0)‖ < R →
      |w y - w y'| ≤ 2 * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - y')‖)
    (hball : ∀ y (t : ℝ), ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ ≤ R → |t - z0 b| ≤ 2 * R →
      coordPlaneProj b y + t • e b ∈ Metric.ball c R0)
    (q : E3) (hq : ‖coordPlaneProj b (q - z0)‖ = R) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ v : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y, v (coordPlaneProj b y) = v y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < ε} ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < ε →
        coordPlaneProj b y + v y • e b ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0) ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < ε → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → v y = w y)

signature.name: sheet_boundary_patch
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R0 : ℝ) (S : Set E3)
    (hS1 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R0, z ∈ closure S → z ∈ S)
    (hS2 : ∀ z ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0, ∃ r > 0, ∃ F : E3 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball z r) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, (y ∈ S ↔ F y = 0))
    (b : Fin 3) (z0 : E3) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (w : E3 → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hwc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R}) (hwz : w z0 = z0 b)
    (hgr : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S)
    (hlip : ∀ y y', ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y' - z0)‖ < R →
      |w y - w y'| ≤ 2 * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - y')‖)
    (hball : ∀ y (t : ℝ), ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ ≤ R → |t - z0 b| ≤ 2 * R →
      coordPlaneProj b y + t • e b ∈ Metric.ball c R0)
    (q : E3) (hq : ‖coordPlaneProj b (q - z0)‖ = R) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ v : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y, v (coordPlaneProj b y) = v y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < ε} ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < ε →
        coordPlaneProj b y + v y • e b ∈ S ∩ Metric.ball c R0) ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < ε → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → v y = w y)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hP5 : ∀ (y z : E3),
      coordPlaneProj b (y - z) = coordPlaneProj b y - coordPlaneProj b z := by
    intro y z
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hpa : ∀ q : E3, (coordPlaneProj b q) b = 0 := by
    intro q
    simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
  have hP3 : ∀ q : E3, coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b q) = coordPlaneProj b q := by
    intro q
    conv_lhs => rw [coordPlaneProj, hpa, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hcontP : Continuous (coordPlaneProj b) := by
    unfold coordPlaneProj
    fun_prop
  have he : ‖e b‖ = 1 := by simp [e]
  have hgpb : ∀ (y : E3) (s : ℝ), (coordPlaneProj b y + s • e b) b = s := by
    intro y s
    simp [hpa, e]
  have hPgp : ∀ (y : E3) (s : ℝ),
      coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b y + s • e b) = coordPlaneProj b y := by
    intro y s
    conv_lhs => rw [coordPlaneProj, hgpb]
    simp
  have hPsmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (v : E3), coordPlaneProj b (a • v) = a • coordPlaneProj b v := by
    intro a v
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_sub, mul_smul]
  have hPn : ∀ v : E3, ‖coordPlaneProj b v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by
    intro v
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : i = b
    · rw [hi, hpa]
      simp only [norm_zero, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow]
      positivity
    · have hvi : (coordPlaneProj b v) i = v i := by
        simp [coordPlaneProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hi]
      exact le_of_eq (by rw [hvi])
  have hsat : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b y - z0)‖ =
      ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ := by
    intro y
    rw [hP5, hP3, ← hP5]
  have hCopen : IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R} :=
    isOpen_lt (hcontP.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm continuous_const
  
  have hL : LipschitzOnWith 2 w {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R} := by
    apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
    have h1 := hlip x y hx hy
    have h2 := hPn (x - y)
    push_cast
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R →
      |w y - t| ≤ 2 * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ := by
    obtain ⟨W, hWL, hWeq⟩ := hL.extend_real
    refine ⟨W (coordPlaneProj b q), fun y hy => ?_⟩
    have hPy : coordPlaneProj b y ∈ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R} := by
      show ‖coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b y - z0)‖ < R
      rw [hsat]
      exact hy
    have h1 : w y = W (coordPlaneProj b y) := by
      rw [← hw y]
      exact hWeq hPy
    have h2 := hWL.dist_le_mul (coordPlaneProj b y) (coordPlaneProj b q)
    have h3 : dist (coordPlaneProj b y) (coordPlaneProj b q) =
        ‖coordPlaneProj b y - coordPlaneProj b q‖ := dist_eq_norm _ _
    rw [h3] at h2
    push_cast at h2
    rw [h1, ← Real.dist_eq, hP5]
    exact h2
  
  have hz0C : ‖coordPlaneProj b (z0 - z0)‖ < R := by
    rw [sub_self]
    simpa [coordPlaneProj] using hR
  have hnq : ‖coordPlaneProj b (z0 - q)‖ = R := by
    rw [hP5, norm_sub_rev, ← hP5, hq]
  have htb : |t - z0 b| ≤ 2 * R := by
    have h := ht z0 hz0C
    rw [hnq, hwz, abs_sub_comm] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : E3, p = coordPlaneProj b q + t • e b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpB : p ∈ Metric.ball c R0 := by
    rw [hp]
    exact hball q t (le_of_eq hq) htb
  have hPp : coordPlaneProj b p = coordPlaneProj b q := by rw [hp, hPgp]
  have hpb : p b = t := by rw [hp, hgpb]
  have hPpq : ∀ y, coordPlaneProj b (y - p) = coordPlaneProj b (y - q) := by
    intro y
    rw [hP5, hP5, hPp]
  have hD : ∀ y (s : ℝ), ‖(coordPlaneProj b y + s • e b) - p‖ ≤
      ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ + |s - t| := by
    intro y s
    have h1 : (coordPlaneProj b y + s • e b) - p =
        coordPlaneProj b (y - q) + (s - t) • e b := by
      rw [hp, hP5, sub_smul]
      abel
    rw [h1]
    calc ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q) + (s - t) • e b‖
        ≤ ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ + ‖(s - t) • e b‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ + |s - t| := by
          rw [norm_smul, he, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  
  have hX : ∀ δ > 0, ∃ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R ∧
      ‖(coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b) - p‖ < δ := by
    intro δ hδ
    obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, η = min (1 / 2) (δ / (6 * R)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hη0 : 0 < η := by
      rw [hη]
      exact lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hδ (mul_pos (by norm_num) hR))
    have hη1 : η ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [hη]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hη2 : η ≤ δ / (6 * R) := by rw [hη]; exact min_le_right _ _
    have hηR : η * R ≤ δ / 6 := by
      have h1 : η * R ≤ δ / (6 * R) * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hη2 hR.le
      have h2 : δ / (6 * R) * R = δ / 6 := by
        rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_mul_right _ _ hR.ne']
      linarith
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : E3, y = z0 + (1 - η) • (q - z0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hyC : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R := by
      have h1 : y - z0 = (1 - η) • (q - z0) := by
        rw [hy]
        abel
      rw [h1, hPsmul, norm_smul, hq, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 - η by linarith)]
      nlinarith
    have hyq : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ = η * R := by
      have h1 : y - q = (-η) • (q - z0) := by
        rw [hy, sub_smul, one_smul, neg_smul]
        abel
      rw [h1, hPsmul, norm_smul, hq, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hη0]
    refine ⟨y, hyC, ?_⟩
    have h1 := hD y (w y)
    have h2 := ht y hyC
    rw [hyq] at h1 h2
    linarith
  have hpcl : p ∈ closure S := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨y, hyC, hy⟩ := hX ε hε
    exact ⟨_, hgr y hyC, by rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]; exact hy⟩
  have hpS : p ∈ S := hS1 p hpB hpcl
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr, F, hF, hF0, hSF⟩ := hS2 p ⟨hpS, hpB⟩
  
  have hb : fderiv ℝ F p (e b) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hα : 0 < ‖fderiv ℝ F p‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hF0 p (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))
    have hcont : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ F) p :=
      (hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball (by simp)).continuousAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr))
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδc⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.1 hcont (‖fderiv ℝ F p‖ / 8) (div_pos hα (by norm_num))
    obtain ⟨y, hyC, hyp⟩ := hX (min δ r) (lt_min hδ hr)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : E3, x = coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hx] at hyp
    have hxp_r : ‖x - p‖ < r := lt_of_lt_of_le hyp (min_le_right _ _)
    have hxp_d : ‖x - p‖ < δ := lt_of_lt_of_le hyp (min_le_left _ _)
    have hxball : x ∈ Metric.ball p r := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      exact hxp_r
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x :=
      (hF.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hxball)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hSF' : ∀ x' ∈ Metric.ball x (r - ‖x - p‖), x' ∈ S → F x' = 0 := by
      intro x' hx' hx'S
      have h1 : x' ∈ Metric.ball p r := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx' ⊢
        have h2 := dist_triangle x' x p
        rw [dist_eq_norm x p] at h2
        linarith
      exact (hSF x' h1).1 hx'S
    have hPx : coordPlaneProj b x = coordPlaneProj b y := by rw [hx, hPgp]
    have hxC' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (x - z0)‖ = ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ := by
      rw [hP5, hPx, ← hP5]
    have hxC : x ∈ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R} := by
      show ‖coordPlaneProj b (x - z0)‖ < R
      rw [hxC']
      exact hyC
    have hwd : DifferentiableAt ℝ w x :=
      (hwc.contDiffAt (hCopen.mem_nhds hxC)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hxw : x b = w x := by
      rw [← hw x, hPx, hw, hx, hgpb]
    have hr' : 0 < R - ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ := by linarith
    have hgr' : ∀ y', ‖coordPlaneProj b (y' - x)‖ < R - ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ →
        coordPlaneProj b y' + w y' • e b ∈ S := by
      intro y' hy'
      apply hgr
      have h1 : coordPlaneProj b (y' - z0) =
          coordPlaneProj b (y' - x) + coordPlaneProj b (x - z0) := by
        rw [hP5, hP5, hP5]
        abel
      rw [h1]
      calc ‖coordPlaneProj b (y' - x) + coordPlaneProj b (x - z0)‖
          ≤ ‖coordPlaneProj b (y' - x)‖ + ‖coordPlaneProj b (x - z0)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ < R := by rw [hxC']; linarith
    have htan := (graph_tangent_identity S x (r - ‖x - p‖) (by linarith) F hFd hSF' b w hw
      hwd hxw _ hr' hgr').1
    have hdw : ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ ≤ 2 := by
      have h := norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitzOn ℝ (hCopen.mem_nhds hxC) hL
      push_cast at h
      exact h
    have hbd : ‖fderiv ℝ F x‖ ≤ 3 * |fderiv ℝ F x (e b)| := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity)
      intro u
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, htan u, abs_mul]
      have h1 : |u b| ≤ ‖u‖ := by
        have := PiLp.norm_apply_le u b
        rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      have h2 : |fderiv ℝ w x u| ≤ 2 * ‖u‖ := by
        have := (fderiv ℝ w x).le_opNorm u
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        calc |fderiv ℝ w x u| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ * ‖u‖ := this
          _ ≤ 2 * ‖u‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdw (norm_nonneg u)
      have h3 : |u b - fderiv ℝ w x u| ≤ 3 * ‖u‖ := by
        obtain ⟨h1a, h1b⟩ := abs_le.1 h1
        obtain ⟨h2a, h2b⟩ := abs_le.1 h2
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor <;> linarith
      have h4 := abs_nonneg (fderiv ℝ F x (e b))
      calc |fderiv ℝ F x (e b)| * |u b - fderiv ℝ w x u|
          ≤ |fderiv ℝ F x (e b)| * (3 * ‖u‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 h4
        _ = 3 * |fderiv ℝ F x (e b)| * ‖u‖ := by ring
    have h5 : ‖fderiv ℝ F x - fderiv ℝ F p‖ < ‖fderiv ℝ F p‖ / 8 := by
      have := hδc (show dist x p < δ by rw [dist_eq_norm]; exact hxp_d)
      rwa [dist_eq_norm] at this
    have h6 : |fderiv ℝ F x (e b)| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ F x - fderiv ℝ F p‖ := by
      have h7 : fderiv ℝ F x (e b) = (fderiv ℝ F x - fderiv ℝ F p) (e b) := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, h0, sub_zero]
      rw [h7, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc ‖(fderiv ℝ F x - fderiv ℝ F p) (e b)‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ F x - fderiv ℝ F p‖ * ‖e b‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ F x - fderiv ℝ F p‖ := by rw [he, mul_one]
    have h8 : ‖fderiv ℝ F p‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ F x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ F x - fderiv ℝ F p‖ := by
      have := norm_sub_norm_le (fderiv ℝ F p) (fderiv ℝ F x)
      rw [norm_sub_rev] at this
      linarith
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ : ∃ r' : ℝ, r' = min r (R0 - dist p c) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hr'0 : 0 < r' := by
    rw [hr']
    exact lt_min hr (sub_pos.2 (Metric.mem_ball.1 hpB))
  have hsub1 : Metric.ball p r' ⊆ Metric.ball p r :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (by rw [hr']; exact min_le_left _ _)
  have hsub2 : Metric.ball p r' ⊆ Metric.ball c R0 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hy ⊢
    have h1 := dist_triangle y p c
    have h2 : r' ≤ R0 - dist p c := by rw [hr']; exact min_le_right _ _
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, δ₂, hδ₂, v, hvp, hvc, hvz, hvg, hvu⟩ :=
    ift_planar_graph S p r' hr'0 F (hF.mono hsub1) (fun y hy => hSF y (hsub1 hy)) hpS b hb
  
  refine ⟨min δ₁ (δ₂ / 2), lt_min hδ₁ (by linarith), v, hvp, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine hvc.mono ?_
    intro y hy
    have hy' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < min δ₁ (δ₂ / 2) := hy
    show ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - p)‖ < δ₁
    rw [hPpq]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy' (min_le_left _ _)
  · intro y hy
    have hy1 : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - p)‖ < δ₁ := by
      rw [hPpq]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy (min_le_left _ _)
    exact ⟨(hvg y hy1).2.1, hsub2 (hvg y hy1).2.2⟩
  · intro y hy hyC
    obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ : ∃ Y : E3, Y = coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPY : coordPlaneProj b Y = coordPlaneProj b y := by rw [hY, hPgp]
    have hYb : Y b = w y := by rw [hY, hgpb]
    have hY1 : ‖coordPlaneProj b (Y - p)‖ < δ₁ := by
      rw [hPpq, hP5, hPY, ← hP5]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hy (min_le_left _ _)
    have hY2 : |Y b - p b| < δ₂ := by
      rw [hYb, hpb]
      have h1 := ht y hyC
      have h2 : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < δ₂ / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hy (min_le_right _ _)
      linarith
    have hYS : Y ∈ S := by
      rw [hY]
      exact hgr y hyC
    have h1 := hvu Y hY1 hY2 hYS
    rw [hYb, ← hvp Y, hPY, hvp] at h1
    exact h1.symm

subgoal_signatures.name: graph_tangent_identity
subgoal_signatures.statement:

subgoal_signatures.statement:

informal_problem.statement:
(T : Set E3) (b : Fin 3) (z0 : E3) (R : ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ)

signature.name: sheet_collar_uniform
signature.statement:
(T : Set E3) (b : Fin 3) (z0 : E3) (R : ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ)
    (hpatch : ∀ q : E3, q b = 0 → ‖q - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R → ∃ ε > 0, ∃ v : E3 → ℝ,

proof.tactics:
by
  have hP5 : ∀ (y z : E3),
      coordPlaneProj b (y - z) = coordPlaneProj b y - coordPlaneProj b z := by
    intro y z
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hP7 : ∀ q : E3, q b = 0 → coordPlaneProj b q = q := by
    intro q hq
    simp [coordPlaneProj, hq]
  set Γ : Set E3 := {x | x b = 0 ∧ ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R} with hΓ
  have hcpt : IsCompact Γ := by
    have h1 : Γ = Metric.sphere (coordPlaneProj b z0) R ∩ {x : E3 | x b = 0} := by
      ext x
      simp only [hΓ, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, mem_sphere_iff_norm]
      exact And.comm
    rw [h1]
    refine (isCompact_sphere _ _).inter_right (isClosed_eq ?_ continuous_const)
    fun_prop
  have h' : ∀ q : Γ, ∃ ε > 0, ∃ v : E3 → ℝ,
      (∀ y, v (coordPlaneProj b y) = v y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - (q : E3))‖ < ε} ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - (q : E3))‖ < ε → coordPlaneProj b y + v y • e b ∈ T) ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - (q : E3))‖ < ε → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R →
        v y = w y) :=
    fun q => hpatch q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2
  choose ε hε v hv using h'
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hL⟩ := lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric hcpt
    (c := fun i : Γ => Metric.ball (i : E3) (ε i)) (fun i => Metric.isOpen_ball)
    (fun x hx => Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hε ⟨x, hx⟩)⟩)
  have hincl : ∀ x ∈ Γ, ∀ i : Γ, Metric.ball x δ ⊆ Metric.ball (i : E3) (ε i) →
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < δ → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - (i : E3))‖ < ε i := by
    intro x hx i hi y hy
    rw [hP5, hP7 x hx.1] at hy
    rw [hP5, hP7 (i : E3) i.2.1]
    have hm : coordPlaneProj b y ∈ Metric.ball x δ := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      exact hy
    have hm' := hi hm
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hm'
    exact hm'
  have hfam : ∀ x : E3, ∃ f : E3 → ℝ, x ∈ Γ →
      (∀ y, f (coordPlaneProj b y) = f y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < δ} ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < δ → coordPlaneProj b y + f y • e b ∈ T) ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < δ → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → f y = w y) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Γ
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hL x hx
      obtain ⟨hA, hB, hC, hD⟩ := hv i
      exact ⟨v i, fun _ => ⟨hA, hB.mono (fun y hy => hincl x hx i hi y hy),
        fun y hy => hC y (hincl x hx i hi y hy),
        fun y hy hyR => hD y (hincl x hx i hi y hy) hyR⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨fun _ => 0, fun h => absurd h hx⟩
  choose p hp using hfam
  exact ⟨δ, hδ, p, fun x hxb hxR => hp x ⟨hxb, hxR⟩⟩

signature.statement:

    (hx' : x' b = 0) (hx'R : ‖x' - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R) (hxx' : x ≠ x')
    (p₁ p₂ : E3 → ℝ) (hp₁ : ∀ y, p₁ (coordPlaneProj b y) = p₁ y)
    (hp₂ : ∀ y, p₂ (coordPlaneProj b y) = p₂ y)
    (hp₁c : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p₁ {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η})
    (hp₂c : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ p₂ {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x')‖ < η})
