proof.tactics:
by
  intro y hy hy'
  have hP5 : ∀ (u v : E3),
      coordPlaneProj b (u - v) = coordPlaneProj b u - coordPlaneProj b v := by
    intro u v
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hpa : ∀ q : E3, (coordPlaneProj b q) b = 0 := by
    intro q
    simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
  have hP3 : ∀ q : E3, coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b q) = coordPlaneProj b q := by
    intro q
    conv_lhs => rw [coordPlaneProj, hpa, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hP7 : ∀ q : E3, q b = 0 → coordPlaneProj b q = q := by
    intro q hq
    simp [coordPlaneProj, hq]
  have hcontP : Continuous (coordPlaneProj b) := by
    unfold coordPlaneProj
    fun_prop
  have hopen : ∀ q : E3, IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < η} := fun q =>
    isOpen_lt (hcontP.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm continuous_const
  have hconv : ∀ q : E3, Convex ℝ {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - q)‖ < η} := by
    intro q
    rw [convex_iff_forall_pos]
    intro u hu v hv a a' ha ha' haa
    have hlin : coordPlaneProj b (a • u + a' • v - q) =
        a • coordPlaneProj b (u - q) + a' • coordPlaneProj b (v - q) := by
      have ha'' : a' = 1 - a := by linarith
      subst ha''
      ext i
      simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    show ‖coordPlaneProj b (a • u + a' • v - q)‖ < η
    rw [hlin]
    have hu' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (u - q)‖ < η := hu
    have hv' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (v - q)‖ < η := hv
    calc ‖a • coordPlaneProj b (u - q) + a' • coordPlaneProj b (v - q)‖
        ≤ ‖a • coordPlaneProj b (u - q)‖ + ‖a' • coordPlaneProj b (v - q)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = a * ‖coordPlaneProj b (u - q)‖ + a' * ‖coordPlaneProj b (v - q)‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha.le, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha'.le]
      _ < a * η + a' * η := by
          have h1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hu' ha
          have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hv' ha'
          linarith
      _ = η := by rw [← add_mul, haa, one_mul]
  have hsat : ∀ (q u : E3),
      coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b u - q) = coordPlaneProj b (u - q) := by
    intro q u
    rw [hP5, hP3, ← hP5]
  have hUo : IsOpen ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η} ∩
      {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x')‖ < η}) := (hopen x).inter (hopen x')
  have hUc : IsPreconnected ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η} ∩
      {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x')‖ < η}) := ((hconv x).inter (hconv x')).isPreconnected
  have hUs : ∀ u, u ∈ ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η} ∩
      {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x')‖ < η}) ↔ coordPlaneProj b u ∈
      ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η} ∩
      {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x')‖ < η}) := by
    intro u
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hsat]
  have hd₁ : DifferentiableOn ℝ p₁ ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η} ∩
      {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x')‖ < η}) :=
    (hp₁c.mono Set.inter_subset_left).differentiableOn (by simp)
  have hc₂ : ContinuousOn p₂ ({y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η} ∩
      {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x')‖ < η}) :=
    (hp₂c.mono Set.inter_subset_right).continuousOn
  
  have hdiffb : (x' - x) b = 0 := by
    simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, hx, hx', sub_zero]
  have hxx2 : ‖x' - x‖ < 2 * η := by
    have h1 : x' - x = coordPlaneProj b (y - x) - coordPlaneProj b (y - x') := by
      rw [← hP5, show y - x - (y - x') = x' - x by abel, hP7 _ hdiffb]
    rw [h1]
    have h2 := norm_sub_le (coordPlaneProj b (y - x)) (coordPlaneProj b (y - x'))
    linarith
  have hmx : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x') - x = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x' - x) := by
    ext i
    simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hmx' : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x') - x' = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x - x') := by
    ext i
    simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hmb : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x')) b = 0 := by
    simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.add_apply, hx, hx', add_zero, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero]
  have hm1 : ‖coordPlaneProj b ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x') - x)‖ < η := by
    rw [hmx, hP7 _ (by simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, hdiffb, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero]),
      norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num)]
    linarith
  have hm2 : ‖coordPlaneProj b ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x') - x')‖ < η := by
    have hdb : (x - x') b = 0 := by simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, hx, hx', sub_zero]
    rw [hmx', hP7 _ (by simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, hdb, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero]),
      norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num), norm_sub_rev]
    linarith
  have hmz : ‖coordPlaneProj b ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x') - z0)‖ < R := by
    have he : coordPlaneProj b ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x') - z0) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((x - coordPlaneProj b z0) + (x' - coordPlaneProj b z0)) := by
      rw [hP5, hP7 _ hmb]
      ext i
      simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hpl := parallelogram_law_with_norm ℝ (x - coordPlaneProj b z0)
      (x' - coordPlaneProj b z0)
    have hsub : (x - coordPlaneProj b z0) - (x' - coordPlaneProj b z0) = x - x' := by abel
    rw [hsub, hxR, hx'R] at hpl
    have hpos : 0 < ‖x - x'‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxx')
    have hn0 := norm_nonneg ((x - coordPlaneProj b z0) + (x' - coordPlaneProj b z0))
    have hlt : ‖(x - coordPlaneProj b z0) + (x' - coordPlaneProj b z0)‖ < 2 * R := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      nlinarith
    rw [he, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by norm_num)]
    linarith
  have h₀ : p₁ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x')) = p₂ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (x + x')) :=
    (hp₁w _ hm1 hmz).trans (hp₂w _ hm2 hmz).symm
  exact sheet_uniqueness c R0 S hS2 b _ hUo hUc hUs p₁ p₂ hp₁ hp₂ hd₁ hc₂
    (fun u hu => hp₁g u hu.1) (fun u hu => hp₂g u hu.2) _ ⟨hm1, hm2⟩ h₀ y ⟨hy, hy'⟩

    (hwc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R}) (hwz : w z0 = z0 b)
    (hgr : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S)
    (pc : E3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ∀ y, pc x (coordPlaneProj b y) = pc x y)
    (hpc : ∀ x : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pc x) {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η})
    (hpg : ∀ x : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η → coordPlaneProj b y + pc x y • e b ∈ S)
    (hpw : ∀ x : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → pc x y = w y)
    (hpp : ∀ x x' : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      x' b = 0 → ‖x' - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x')‖ < η → pc x y = pc x' y) :
    ∃ w' : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y, w' (coordPlaneProj b y) = w' y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R + η} ∧ w' z0 = z0 b ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R + η → coordPlaneProj b y + w' y • e b ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → w' y = w y)

signature.name: sheet_collar_glue
signature.statement:
(S : Set E3) (b : Fin 3) (z0 : E3) (R η : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ y, w (coordPlaneProj b y) = w y)
    (hwc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R}) (hwz : w z0 = z0 b)
    (hgr : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → coordPlaneProj b y + w y • e b ∈ S)
    (pc : E3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ∀ y, pc x (coordPlaneProj b y) = pc x y)
    (hpc : ∀ x : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pc x) {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η})
    (hpg : ∀ x : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η → coordPlaneProj b y + pc x y • e b ∈ S)
    (hpw : ∀ x : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → pc x y = w y)
    (hpp : ∀ x x' : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      x' b = 0 → ‖x' - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x')‖ < η → pc x y = pc x' y) :
    ∃ w' : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y, w' (coordPlaneProj b y) = w' y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R + η} ∧ w' z0 = z0 b ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R + η → coordPlaneProj b y + w' y • e b ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R → w' y = w y)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hP5 : ∀ (y z : E3),
      coordPlaneProj b (y - z) = coordPlaneProj b y - coordPlaneProj b z := by
    intro y z
    simp only [coordPlaneProj, PiLp.sub_apply, sub_smul]
    abel
  have hpa : ∀ q : E3, (coordPlaneProj b q) b = 0 := by
    intro q
    simp [coordPlaneProj, e]
  have hP3 : ∀ q : E3, coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b q) = coordPlaneProj b q := by
    intro q
    conv_lhs => rw [coordPlaneProj, hpa, zero_smul, sub_zero]
  have hP7 : ∀ q : E3, q b = 0 → coordPlaneProj b q = q := by
    intro q hq
    simp [coordPlaneProj, hq]
  have hcontP : Continuous (coordPlaneProj b) := by
    unfold coordPlaneProj
    fun_prop
  have hP6 : ∀ y, coordPlaneProj b (coordPlaneProj b y - z0) = coordPlaneProj b (y - z0) := by
    intro y
    rw [hP5, hP3, ← hP5]
  have hCylOpen : ∀ (x : E3) (r : ℝ), IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < r} :=
    fun x r => isOpen_lt (hcontP.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).norm continuous_const
  
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ : ∃ π : E3 → E3, ∀ y, π y = coordPlaneProj b z0 +
      (R / ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖) • coordPlaneProj b (y - z0) := ⟨_, fun y => rfl⟩
  have hrad : ∀ y, R ≤ ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ →
      (π y) b = 0 ∧ ‖π y - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R ∧
      ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - π y)‖ = ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ - R := by
    intro y hy
    have hN : 0 < ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hR hy
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ R / ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ := div_nonneg hR.le hN.le
    have ht1 : R / ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hN).mpr hy
    have htN : R / ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ * ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ = R :=
      div_mul_cancel₀ R hN.ne'
    have h1 : (π y) b = 0 := by
      rw [hπ]
      simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, hpa, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
    refine ⟨h1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hπ, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul_of_nonneg ht0, htN]
    · have key : coordPlaneProj b (y - π y) =
          (1 - R / ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖) • coordPlaneProj b (y - z0) := by
        have e1 : coordPlaneProj b (y - π y) = coordPlaneProj b y - π y := by
          rw [hP5, hP7 _ h1]
        rw [e1, hπ, sub_smul, one_smul]
        generalize R / ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ = t
        rw [hP5 y z0]
        abel
      rw [key, norm_smul_of_nonneg (by linarith), sub_mul, one_mul, htN]
  
  obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ : ∃ w' : E3 → ℝ, ∀ y, w' y =
      if ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R then w y else pc (π y) y := ⟨_, fun y => rfl⟩
  
  have hK0 : ∀ x : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η → ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R + η := by
    intro x hx hxR y hy
    have h1 : coordPlaneProj b (y - z0) =
        (coordPlaneProj b y - x) + (x - coordPlaneProj b z0) := by
      rw [hP5]; abel
    have h2 : coordPlaneProj b (y - x) = coordPlaneProj b y - x := by rw [hP5, hP7 x hx]
    rw [h1]
    calc ‖(coordPlaneProj b y - x) + (x - coordPlaneProj b z0)‖
        ≤ ‖coordPlaneProj b y - x‖ + ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ < R + η := by rw [← h2, hxR]; linarith
  have hK1 : ∀ x : E3, x b = 0 → ‖x - coordPlaneProj b z0‖ = R →
      ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - x)‖ < η → w' y = pc x y := by
    intro x hx hxR y hy
    rw [hw']
    split_ifs with hN
    · exact (hpw x hx hxR y hy hN).symm
    · obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3⟩ := hrad y (not_lt.mp hN)
      have h0 := hK0 x hx hxR y hy
      exact hpp (π y) x r1 r2 hx hxR y (by rw [r3]; linarith) hy
  
  have hplan : ∀ y, w' (coordPlaneProj b y) = w' y := by
    intro y
    have hπP : π (coordPlaneProj b y) = π y := by rw [hπ, hπ, hP6]
    rw [hw', hw', hP6, hπP]
    split_ifs with hN
    · exact hw y
    · obtain ⟨r1, r2, -⟩ := hrad y (not_lt.mp hN)
      exact hp (π y) r1 r2 y
  
  have hcentre : w' z0 = z0 b := by
    have hN0 : ‖coordPlaneProj b (z0 - z0)‖ = 0 := by
      rw [sub_self, hP7 0 (by simp), norm_zero]
    rw [hw', if_pos (by rw [hN0]; exact hR), hwz]
  
  have hgraph : ∀ y, ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R + η →
      coordPlaneProj b y + w' y • e b ∈ S := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hw']
    split_ifs with hN
    · exact hgr y hN
    · obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3⟩ := hrad y (not_lt.mp hN)
      exact hpg (π y) r1 r2 y (by rw [r3]; linarith)
  
  have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' {y | ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R + η} := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R + η := hy
    apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
    by_cases hN : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - z0)‖ < R
    · have hU : {u : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (u - z0)‖ < R} ∈ 𝓝 y :=
        (hCylOpen z0 R).mem_nhds hN
      have hev : w' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] w :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem hU (fun u hu => by rw [hw']; exact if_pos hu)
      exact (hwc.contDiffAt hU).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    · obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3⟩ := hrad y (not_lt.mp hN)
      have hyx : ‖coordPlaneProj b (y - π y)‖ < η := by rw [r3]; linarith
      have hU : {u : E3 | ‖coordPlaneProj b (u - π y)‖ < η} ∈ 𝓝 y :=
        (hCylOpen (π y) η).mem_nhds hyx
      have hev : w' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] pc (π y) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem hU (fun u hu => hK1 (π y) r1 r2 u hu)
      exact ((hpc (π y) r1 r2).contDiffAt hU).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  exact ⟨w', hplan, hsmooth, hcentre, hgraph, fun y hy => by rw [hw']; exact if_pos hy⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Ω V F : Set M) (w σ : M → ℝ) (r₁ : ℝ) (hΩo : IsOpen Ω)
    (hΩc : IsConnected Ω) (hF : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g F) (hΩF : Disjoint Ω F) (hVo : IsOpen V)
    (hw : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w V) (hSc : IsCompact (V ∩ w ⁻¹' {0}))
    (hSF : Disjoint (V ∩ w ⁻¹' {0}) F)
    (hdw : ∀ x ∈ V, w x = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ x ∈ V, w x = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv w x < 0) (hΩV : ∀ x ∈ Ω ∩ V, 0 < w x)
    (hfr : frontier Ω ⊆ (V ∩ w ⁻¹' {0}) ∪ F) (hmeet : (closure Ω ∩ (V ∩ w ⁻¹' {0})).Nonempty)
    (hσ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ) (hσc : ∀ s : ℝ, IsCompact {p : M | σ p ≤ s})
    (hσH : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ σ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv σ p)
    (hfrσ : frontier Ω ⊆ {p : M | σ p < r₁}) (hfar : (Ω ∩ {p : M | r₁ < σ p}).Nonempty) :
    ∃ S : Set M, IsCompact S ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S ∧ S ⊆ Ω ∧ S.Nonempty

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have himg : ∀ (X : Set M) (p : M), chartAt E3 p '' (X ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =
      (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' X := by
    intro X p
    rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact (chartAt E3 p).image_source_inter_eq' X
  have hOpenMeas : ∀ A : Set M, IsOpen A → sepChartMeas A := by
    intro A hA p
    exact ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hA.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right).measurableSet
  have hMeasInter : ∀ A B : Set M, sepChartMeas A → IsOpen B → sepChartMeas (A ∩ B) := by
    intro A B hA hB p
    have h1 := hA p
    have h2 := hOpenMeas B hB p
    rw [himg] at h1 h2 ⊢
    have heq : (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (A ∩ B) =
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' A) ∩
          ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' B) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
      tauto
    rw [heq]
    exact h1.inter h2
  have hMeasDiff : ∀ A B : Set M, sepChartMeas A → IsOpen B → sepChartMeas (A \ B) := by
    intro A B hA hB p
    have h1 := hA p
    have h2 := hOpenMeas B hB p
    rw [himg] at h1 h2 ⊢
    have heq : (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (A \ B) =
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' A) \
          ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' B) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_diff]
      tauto
    rw [heq]
    exact h1.diff h2
  have hNullMono : ∀ A B : Set M, sepChartNull B → A ⊆ B → sepChartNull A := by
    intro A B hB hAB p
    exact measure_mono_null (Set.image_subset _ (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hAB)) (hB p)
  have hN0 : ∀ N : Set M, IsOpen N → N.Nonempty → ¬ sepChartNull N := by
    rintro N hN ⟨x, hx⟩ hnull
    have h1 : IsOpen (chartAt E3 x '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source)) :=
      (chartAt E3 x).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hN.inter (chartAt E3 x).open_source)
        Set.inter_subset_right
    have h2 : (chartAt E3 x '' (N ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source)).Nonempty :=
      ⟨chartAt E3 x x, x, ⟨hx, mem_chart_source E3 x⟩, rfl⟩
    have h3 := h1.measure_pos volume h2
    rw [hnull x] at h3
    exact lt_irrefl _ h3
  have hmonoG : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (A U K₁ K₂ : Set E3), K₁ ⊆ K₂ →
      hullPerG G A U K₁ ≤ hullPerG G A U K₂ := by
    intro G A U K₁ K₂ h
    unfold hullPerG
    refine iSup_mono fun X => iSup_le fun hX => ?_
    refine le_iSup_of_le (⟨fun y hy => hX.1 y (fun h' => hy (h h')), hX.2⟩ :
      (∀ y, y ∉ K₂ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
      tsupport X ⊆ U ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C) le_rfl
  have hmono : ∀ (A U K₁ K₂ : Set M), K₁ ⊆ K₂ →
      hullRiemPer g A U K₁ ≤ hullRiemPer g A U K₂ := by
    intro A U K₁ K₂ h
    unfold hullRiemPer
    refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun p => iSup_mono fun W => iSup_mono fun _ => ?_
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ =>
      hmonoG _ _ _ _ _ (Set.image_subset _ (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ h))
  
  
  
  have hσcont : Continuous σ := hσ.continuous
  have hwcont : ContinuousOn w V := hw.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨hfrEq, hPc, ⟨U₀, hU₀o, hPU₀, hU₀P⟩, hKFm, hside⟩ :=
    trapped_frontier_structure g Ω V F w hΩo hF hΩF hVo hw hSc hSF hdw hΩV hfr
  set P : Set M := V ∩ w ⁻¹' {0} ∩ closure Ω with hPdef
  set KF : Set M := frontier Ω ∩ F with hKFdef
  have hPclosed : IsClosed P := hPc.isClosed
  have hKFclosed : IsClosed KF := isClosed_frontier.inter hF.1
  have hfrΩ : ∀ x, x ∈ frontier Ω → x ∉ Ω := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hΩo.frontier_eq] at hx
    exact hx.2
  have hcl_fr : ∀ x, x ∈ closure Ω → x ∉ Ω → x ∈ frontier Ω := by
    intro x h1 h2
    rw [hΩo.frontier_eq]
    exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have hPfr : P ⊆ frontier Ω := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hfrEq]
    exact Or.inl hx
  have hKFfr : KF ⊆ frontier Ω := Set.inter_subset_left
  have hPσ : ∀ x ∈ P, σ x < r₁ := fun x hx => hfrσ (hPfr hx)
  have hKFσ : ∀ x ∈ KF, σ x < r₁ := fun x hx => hfrσ hx.1
  have hPF : ∀ x ∈ P, x ∉ F := fun x hx hxF => Set.disjoint_left.1 hSF hx.1 hxF
  
  
  
  set A₀ : Set M := Ω ∩ {p : M | r₁ < σ p} with hA₀def
  have hA₀o : IsOpen A₀ := hΩo.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hσcont)
  have hA₀sub : A₀ ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < σ p} := Set.inter_subset_right
  have hA₀Ω : A₀ ⊆ Ω := Set.inter_subset_left
  have hclA₀ : closure A₀ ⊆ {p : M | r₁ ≤ σ p} :=
    (closure_mono hA₀sub).trans (closure_lt_subset_le continuous_const hσcont)
  have hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < σ p} \ A₀) := by
    have heq : {p : M | r₁ < σ p} \ A₀ = {p : M | r₁ < σ p} ∩ (closure Ω)ᶜ := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        refine ⟨h1, fun hc => ?_⟩
        by_cases hxΩ : x ∈ Ω
        · exact h2 ⟨hxΩ, h1⟩
        · have h3 : σ x < r₁ := hfrσ (hcl_fr x hc hxΩ)
          have h4 : r₁ < σ x := h1
          linarith
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        exact ⟨h1, fun h => h2 (subset_closure h.1)⟩
    rw [heq]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hσcont).inter isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
  have hclA₀fr : Disjoint (closure A₀) (frontier Ω) := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x h1 h2 => ?_
    have h3 : σ x < r₁ := hfrσ h2
    have h4 : r₁ ≤ σ x := hclA₀ h1
    linarith
  have hclA₀KF : Disjoint (closure A₀) KF := hclA₀fr.mono_right hKFfr
  have hnull : sepChartNull (frontier Ω) :=
    locally_regular_zero_set_chartNull (frontier Ω) (fun y hy => by
      obtain ⟨N, f, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, -⟩ := hside y hy
      exact ⟨N, f, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩)
  have hOo : IsOpen {p : M | σ p < r₁ + 2} := isOpen_lt hσcont continuous_const
  have hA₀m : sepChartMeas A₀ := hOpenMeas A₀ hA₀o

        ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ)).prod
          ((fderiv ℝ u y).prod (fderiv ℝ (smthGrad u) y))) y :=
      (hasFDerivAt_id y).prodMk (hud.hasFDerivAt.prodMk hgd.hasFDerivAt)
    have hUder : fderiv ℝ (fun z => (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y (Pi.single m 1) =
        ((Pi.single m 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ), smthGrad u y m,
          fun k => smthGrad (fun z => smthGrad u z k) y m) := by
      rw [h1.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
      refine Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext rfl ?_)
      funext k
      show fderiv ℝ (smthGrad u) y (Pi.single m 1) k =
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => smthGrad u z k) y (Pi.single m 1)
      rw [fderiv_pi (fun k => hDx (hgradC hu k) y hy)]
      rfl
    have hcomp : fderiv ℝ (fun z => Φ (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y =
        (fderiv ℝ Φ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun z => (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y) :=
      fderiv_comp y hΦd h1.differentiableAt
    have hv : (((Pi.single m 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ), smthGrad u y m,
          fun k => smthGrad (fun z => smthGrad u z k) y m) : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) =
        ((Pi.single m 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ))
        + smthGrad u y m • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ))
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun z => smthGrad u z k) y m •
            ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single k 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)
      · simp
      · simp
      · funext l
        fin_cases l <;> simp
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => Φ (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y (Pi.single m 1) = _
    rw [hcomp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hUder, hv, map_add, map_add, map_sum,
      map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have hLp : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mseLp Λ i) O := fun i =>
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hΛ).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hLz : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (mseLz Λ) O :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hΛ).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hf : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => mseLp Λ i (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) D :=
    fun i => (hLp i).comp hU hmaps
  have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) D := hLz.comp hU hmaps
  
  have hflux : ∀ y ∈ D, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      (∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp Λ i j (y, u y, smthGrad u y) * smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad u x m) y j
        - ((if i = m then mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y) else 0)
          - mseLpx Λ i m (y, u y, smthGrad u y)
          - mseLpz Λ i (y, u y, smthGrad u y) * smthGrad u y m))
      = smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ i (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y m
        - (if i = m then mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y) else 0) := by
    intro y hy i
    have h := hchain (mseLp Λ i) (hLp i) y hy
    have hs : ∀ k : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun z => smthGrad u z k) y m =
        smthGrad (fun z => smthGrad u z m) y k := fun k => hsymm u hu y hy m k
    have hsum : ∑ k : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (mseLp Λ i) (y, u y, smthGrad u y) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1)
          * smthGrad (fun z => smthGrad u z k) y m =
        ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp Λ i j (y, u y, smthGrad u y) *
          smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad u x m) y j :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by
        show mseLpp Λ i k (y, u y, smthGrad u y) * smthGrad (fun z => smthGrad u z k) y m = _
        rw [hs k])
    rw [h, hsum]
    show _ = mseLpx Λ i m (y, u y, smthGrad u y)
        + mseLpz Λ i (y, u y, smthGrad u y) * smthGrad u y m
        + ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp Λ i j (y, u y, smthGrad u y) *
          smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad u x m) y j - _
    ring
  
  unfold mseDivSol
  intro x hx
  have hloc : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      smthGrad (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp Λ i j (y, u y, smthGrad u y) *
          smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad u x m) y j
        - ((if i = m then mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y) else 0)
          - mseLpx Λ i m (y, u y, smthGrad u y)
          - mseLpz Λ i (y, u y, smthGrad u y) * smthGrad u y m)) x i
      = smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ i (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y m) x i
        - (if i = m then smthGrad (fun y => mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) x i else 0) := by
    intro i
    have hev : (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 2, mseLpp Λ i j (y, u y, smthGrad u y) *
          smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad u x m) y j
        - ((if i = m then mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y) else 0)
          - mseLpx Λ i m (y, u y, smthGrad u y)
          - mseLpz Λ i (y, u y, smthGrad u y) * smthGrad u y m)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ i (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y m
          - (if i = m then mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y) else 0)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hD.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hflux y hy i)
    show fderiv ℝ _ x (Pi.single i 1) = _
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    by_cases him : i = m
    · have hW : (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ i (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y m
          - (if i = m then mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y) else 0)) =
          (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ i (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y m
            - mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) := by
        funext y
        rw [if_pos him]
      rw [hW, fderiv_fun_sub (hDx (hgradC (hf i) m) x hx) (hDx hg x hx), if_pos him,
        ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
      rfl
    · have hW : (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ i (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y m
          - (if i = m then mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y) else 0)) =
          (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ i (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y m) := by
        funext y
        rw [if_neg him, sub_zero]
      rw [hW, if_neg him, sub_zero]
      rfl
  
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hloc i), Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ m, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ m),
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hsymm _ (hf i) x hx i m)]
  
  have hh : ∀ y ∈ D, (smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ 0 (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y 0
      + smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ 1 (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y 1)
      - mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y) = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have h0 := hEL y hy
    have e : smthELop Λ u y = mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y) -
        ∑ i : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ i (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y i := rfl
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at e
    linarith
  have hev2 : (fun y => (smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ 0 (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y 0
      + smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ 1 (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y 1)
      - mseLz Λ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hD.mem_nhds hx) hh
  have hd0 := hev2.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
  have hda : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ 0 (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y 0
      + smthGrad (fun z => mseLp Λ 1 (z, u z, smthGrad u z)) y 1) x :=
    (hDx (hgradC (hf 0) 0) x hx).add (hDx (hgradC (hf 1) 1) x hx)
  rw [fderiv_const_apply, fderiv_fun_sub hda (hDx hg x hx),
    fderiv_fun_add (hDx (hgradC (hf 0) 0) x hx) (hDx (hgradC (hf 1) 1) x hx)] at hd0
  have h2 := congrArg (fun L => L (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) hd0
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h2
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  exact h2

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (s t : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      s ≤ t → mseQC t B f S → mseQC s B f S) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℕ) (B B' : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      B ≤ B' → mseQC s B f S → mseQC s B' f S) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      T ⊆ S → mseQC s B f S → mseQC s B f T)

signature.name: mse_QC_mono
signature.statement:
(∀ (s t : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      s ≤ t → mseQC t B f S → mseQC s B f S) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℕ) (B B' : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      B ≤ B' → mseQC s B f S → mseQC s B' f S) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      T ⊆ S → mseQC s B f S → mseQC s B f T)

proof.tactics:
by
  have base_mono : ∀ (B B' : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      B ≤ B' → T ⊆ S →
      ((∀ x ∈ S, |f x| ≤ (B : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith B (1 / 2 : NNReal) f S) →
      ((∀ x ∈ T, |f x| ≤ (B' : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith B' (1 / 2 : NNReal) f T) := by
    intro B B' f S T hB hTS h
    exact ⟨fun x hx => (h.1 x (hTS hx)).trans (NNReal.coe_le_coe.2 hB),
      (h.2.mono hTS).mono_const hB⟩
  have gen : ∀ (s : ℕ) (B B' : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      B ≤ B' → T ⊆ S → mseQC s B f S → mseQC s B' f T := by
    intro s
    induction s with
    | zero =>
      intro B B' f S T hB hTS h
      exact base_mono B B' f S T hB hTS h
    | succ s ih =>
      intro B B' f S T hB hTS h
      exact ⟨base_mono B B' f S T hB hTS h.1, fun m => ih B B' _ S T hB hTS (h.2 m)⟩
  have drop : ∀ (t : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      mseQC (t + 1) B f S → mseQC t B f S := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero =>
      intro B f S h
      exact h.1
    | succ t ih =>
      intro B f S h
      exact ⟨h.1, fun m => ih B _ S (h.2 m)⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s t B f S hst h
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hst
    clear hst
    induction d with
    | zero => exact h
    | succ d ih => exact ih (drop (s + d) B f S h)
  · intro s B B' f S hB h
    exact gen s B B' f S S hB subset_rfl h
  · intro s B f S T hTS h
    exact gen s B B f S T le_rfl hTS h

informal_problem.statement:
(Φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (O 𝒦 : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ O)
    (h𝒦 : IsCompact 𝒦) (h𝒦c : Convex ℝ 𝒦) (h𝒦O : 𝒦 ⊆ O) (s : ℕ) (B : NNReal) :
    ∃ C : NNReal, ∀ (D S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      IsOpen D → S ⊆ D → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u D → (∀ x ∈ D, (x, u x, smthGrad u x) ∈ 𝒦) →
      mseQC (s + 1) B u S → mseQC s C (fun x => Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x)) S

signature.name: mse_QC_comp
signature.statement:
(Φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (O 𝒦 : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ O)
    (h𝒦 : IsCompact 𝒦) (h𝒦c : Convex ℝ 𝒦) (h𝒦O : 𝒦 ⊆ O) (s : ℕ) (B : NNReal) :
    ∃ C : NNReal, ∀ (D S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      IsOpen D → S ⊆ D → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u D → (∀ x ∈ D, (x, u x, smthGrad u x) ∈ 𝒦) →
      mseQC (s + 1) B u S → mseQC s C (fun x => Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x)) S

proof.tactics:
by
  have hD1 : ∀ (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O →
      ∀ v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => fderiv ℝ f w v) O := by
    intro f hf v
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hf).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  revert Φ
  induction s with
  | zero =>
    intro Φ hΦ
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := mse_comp_level0 Φ O 𝒦 hO hΦ h𝒦 h𝒦c h𝒦O B
    exact ⟨C₀, fun D S u _ hSD _ hK hQ => hC₀ S u (fun x hx => hK x (hSD hx)) hQ⟩
  | succ s ih =>
    intro Φ hΦ
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := mse_comp_level0 Φ O 𝒦 hO hΦ h𝒦 h𝒦c h𝒦O B
    choose Cx hCx using fun m : Fin 2 =>
      ih (fun w => fderiv ℝ Φ w (Pi.single m 1, 0, 0)) (hD1 Φ hΦ _)
    obtain ⟨Cz, hCz⟩ := ih (fun w => fderiv ℝ Φ w (0, 1, 0)) (hD1 Φ hΦ _)
    choose Cp hCp using fun k : Fin 2 =>
      ih (fun w => fderiv ℝ Φ w (0, 0, Pi.single k 1)) (hD1 Φ hΦ _)
    refine ⟨C₀ + ((Cx 0 + Cx 1) +
      (2 ^ (s + 1) * Cz * B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * Cp 0 * B + 2 ^ (s + 1) * Cp 1 * B))), ?_⟩
    intro D S u hD hSD hu hK hQ
    have hQ1 : mseQC 1 B u S := mse_QC_mono.1 1 (s + 2) B u S (by omega) hQ
    have hQs : mseQC (s + 1) B u S := mse_QC_mono.1 (s + 1) (s + 2) B u S (by omega) hQ
    have hUO : ∀ x ∈ D, (x, u x, smthGrad u x) ∈ O := fun x hx => h𝒦O (hK x hx)
    have hdu : ∀ m : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => smthGrad u x m) D := fun m =>
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hu).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hddu : ∀ k m : Fin 2,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x m) D := fun k m =>
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 (hdu k)).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (x, u x, smthGrad u x)) D :=
      contDiffOn_id.prodMk (hu.prodMk (contDiffOn_pi.2 fun m => hdu m))
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun x => (x, u x, smthGrad u x)) D O := fun x hx => hUO x hx
    have hcomp : ∀ f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => f (x, u x, smthGrad u x)) D :=
      fun f hf => hf.comp hU hmaps
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact mse_QC_mono.2.1 0 C₀ _ _ S le_self_add
        (hC₀ S u (fun x hx => hK x (hSD hx)) hQ1)
    intro m
    
    have sA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun x => fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (Pi.single m 1, 0, 0)) D :=
      hcomp _ (hD1 Φ hΦ _)
    have sZ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (0, 1, 0)) D :=
      hcomp _ (hD1 Φ hΦ _)
    have sP : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun x => fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1)) D :=
      fun k => hcomp _ (hD1 Φ hΦ _)
    
    have hA : mseQC s (Cx m)
        (fun x => fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (Pi.single m 1, 0, 0)) S :=
      hCx m D S u hD hSD hu hK hQs
    have hZ : mseQC s Cz (fun x => fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (0, 1, 0)) S :=
      hCz D S u hD hSD hu hK hQs
    have hP : ∀ k : Fin 2, mseQC s (Cp k)
        (fun x => fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1)) S :=
      fun k => hCp k D S u hD hSD hu hK hQs
    have hg : mseQC s B (fun x => smthGrad u x m) S :=
      mse_QC_mono.1 s (s + 1) B _ S (Nat.le_succ s) (hQ.2 m)
    have hh : ∀ k : Fin 2, mseQC s B (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x m) S :=
      fun k => (hQ.2 k).2 m
    have hZg := mse_QC_mul s Cz B D S _ _ hD hSD sZ (hdu m) hZ hg
    have hPh : ∀ k : Fin 2, mseQC s (2 ^ (s + 1) * Cp k * B)
        (fun x => fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1) *
          smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x m) S :=
      fun k => mse_QC_mul s (Cp k) B D S _ _ hD hSD (sP k) (hddu k m) (hP k) (hh k)
    have hS1 := (mse_QC_add_sub s _ _ D S _ _ hD hSD sA (sZ.mul (hdu m)) hA hZg).1
    have hS2 := (mse_QC_add_sub s _ _ D S _ _ hD hSD ((sP 0).mul (hddu 0 m))
      ((sP 1).mul (hddu 1 m)) (hPh 0) (hPh 1)).1
    have hS3 := (mse_QC_add_sub s _ _ D S _ _ hD hSD (sA.add (sZ.mul (hdu m)))
      (((sP 0).mul (hddu 0 m)).add ((sP 1).mul (hddu 1 m))) hS1 hS2).1
    have hS4 := mse_QC_congr s _ D S _
      (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => Φ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) x m) hD hSD
      (fun x hx => by
        show _ = smthGrad (fun y => Φ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) x m
        rw [mse_comp_chain Φ O hO hΦ D hD u hu hUO m x hx, Fin.sum_univ_two]) hS3
    refine mse_QC_mono.2.1 s _ _ _ S ?_ hS4
    have hCm : Cx m ≤ Cx 0 + Cx 1 := by
      fin_cases m
      · exact le_self_add
      · exact le_add_self
    calc Cx m + 2 ^ (s + 1) * Cz * B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * Cp 0 * B + 2 ^ (s + 1) * Cp 1 * B)
        = Cx m + (2 ^ (s + 1) * Cz * B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * Cp 0 * B + 2 ^ (s + 1) * Cp 1 * B)) := by
          ring
      _ ≤ (Cx 0 + Cx 1) +
          (2 ^ (s + 1) * Cz * B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * Cp 0 * B + 2 ^ (s + 1) * Cp 1 * B)) := by
          gcongr
      _ ≤ _ := le_add_self

subgoal_signatures.name: mse_QC_mono
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(∀ (s t : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      s ≤ t → mseQC t B f S → mseQC s B f S) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℕ) (B B' : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      B ≤ B' → mseQC s B f S → mseQC s B' f S) ∧
    (∀ (s : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      T ⊆ S → mseQC s B f S → mseQC s B f T)

subgoal_signatures.name: mse_QC_congr
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(s : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (D S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hSD : S ⊆ D) (hfg : ∀ x ∈ D, f x = g x) (hf : mseQC s B f S) :
    mseQC s B g S

subgoal_signatures.name: mse_QC_add_sub
subgoal_signatures.statement:

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(Φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ O)
    (D : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hD : IsOpen D) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u D)
    (hUO : ∀ x ∈ D, (x, u x, smthGrad u x) ∈ O) (m : Fin 2) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ D) :
    smthGrad (fun y => Φ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) x m =
      fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (Pi.single m 1, 0, 0) +
      fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (0, 1, 0) * smthGrad u x m +
      ∑ k : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1) *
        smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x m

informal_problem.statement:
(s : ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (B : NNReal) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ B' : NNReal, ∀ (D S T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
      (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      IsOpen D → IsOpen S → S ⊆ D → (∀ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x R ⊆ S) →
      (∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => a x i j) D) → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => F x i) D) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w D →
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j) →
      (∀ i j, mseQC s B (fun x => a x i j) S) → (∀ i, mseQC s B (fun x => F x i) S) →
      (∀ x ∈ S, |w x| ≤ B) → mseDivSol a F w S → mseQC (s + 1) B' w T

signature.statement:
(s : ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (B : NNReal) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ B' : NNReal, ∀ (D S T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
      (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      IsOpen D → IsOpen S → S ⊆ D → (∀ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x R ⊆ S) →
      (∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => a x i j) D) → (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => F x i) D) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w D →
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ξ i ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j) →
      (∀ i j, mseQC s B (fun x => a x i j) S) → (∀ i, mseQC s B (fun x => F x i) S) →

proof.tactics:
by
  induction s generalizing B R hR with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨B', hB'⟩ := mse_lin_base lam hlam B R hR
    exact ⟨B', fun D S T a F w hD hS hSD hT ha hF hw hell hQa hQF hwB hsol =>
      hB' D S T a F w hD hS hSD hT ha hF hw hell hQa hQF hwB hsol⟩
  | succ s ih =>
    have hR2 : 0 < R / 2 := half_pos hR
    obtain ⟨Bw, hBw⟩ := ih B (R / 2) hR2
    obtain ⟨B3, hB3⟩ := ih (max B (max Bw (B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw + 2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw))))
      (R / 2) hR2
    refine ⟨max Bw B3, ?_⟩
    intro D S T a F w hD hS hSD hT ha hF hw hell hQa hQF hwB hsol
    
    have hpd : ∀ f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f D → ∀ m : Fin 2,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => smthGrad f x m) D := by
      intro f hf m
      exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hf).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    
    have hT'o : IsOpen (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) :=
      isOpen_biUnion (fun x _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
    have hT'S : ∀ z ∈ (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)), Metric.ball z (R / 2) ⊆ S := by
      intro z hz q hq
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hz
      obtain ⟨x, hxT, hzx⟩ := hz
      apply hT x hxT
      rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hq hzx ⊢
      calc dist q x ≤ dist q z + dist z x := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < R / 2 + R / 2 := add_lt_add hq hzx
        _ = R := by ring
    have hT'sub : (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) ⊆ S :=
      fun z hz => hT'S z hz (Metric.mem_ball_self hR2)
    have hT'D : (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) ⊆ D := hT'sub.trans hSD
    have hTT' : ∀ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2) ⊆ (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) :=
      fun x hx z hz => Set.mem_biUnion hx hz
    have hTsub : T ⊆ (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) :=
      fun x hx => hTT' x hx (Metric.mem_ball_self hR2)
    
    have hW : mseQC (s + 1) Bw w (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) :=
      hBw D S _ a F w hD hS hSD hT'S ha hF hw hell
        (fun i j => mse_QC_mono.1 s (s + 1) B _ S (Nat.le_succ s) (hQa i j))
        (fun i => mse_QC_mono.1 s (s + 1) B _ S (Nat.le_succ s) (hQF i)) hwB hsol
    have hBBm : B ≤ max B (max Bw (B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw + 2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw))) :=
      le_max_left _ _
    have hBwBm : Bw ≤ max B (max Bw (B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw + 2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw))) :=
      (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    have hBFBm : B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw + 2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw) ≤
        max B (max Bw (B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw + 2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw))) :=
      (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    
    have hstep : ∀ m : Fin 2, mseQC (s + 1) B3 (fun x => smthGrad w x m) T := by
      intro m
      have hsolm := mse_divsol_deriv S hS a F w (fun i j => (ha i j).mono hSD)
        (fun i => (hF i).mono hSD) (hw.mono hSD) hsol m
      have hsumsm : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ j : Fin 2,
          smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m * smthGrad w x j) D := by
        intro i
        exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => (hpd _ (ha i j) m).mul (hpd _ hw j))
      have hFm : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => F y i) x m -
          ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m * smthGrad w x j) D :=
        fun i => (hpd _ (hF i) m).sub (hsumsm i)
      have hQFm : ∀ i, mseQC s
          (max B (max Bw (B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw + 2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw))))
          (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => F y i) x m -
            ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m * smthGrad w x j)
          (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) := by
        intro i
        have hp : ∀ j, mseQC s (2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw)
            (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m * smthGrad w x j)
            (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) := by
          intro j
          have h1 : mseQC s B (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m)
              (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) :=
            mse_QC_mono.2.2 s B _ S _ hT'sub ((hQa i j).2 m)
          have h2 : mseQC s Bw (fun x => smthGrad w x j) (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) :=
            hW.2 j
          exact mse_QC_mul s B Bw D _ _ _ hD hT'D (hpd _ (ha i j) m) (hpd _ hw j) h1 h2
        have hsum : mseQC s (2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw + 2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw)
            (fun x => ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m * smthGrad w x j)
            (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) := by
          have h := (mse_QC_add_sub s _ _ D _ _ _ hD hT'D
            ((hpd _ (ha i 0) m).mul (hpd _ hw 0)) ((hpd _ (ha i 1) m).mul (hpd _ hw 1))
            (hp 0) (hp 1)).1
          have heq : (fun x => ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m * smthGrad w x j) =
              (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => a y i 0) x m * smthGrad w x 0 +
                smthGrad (fun y => a y i 1) x m * smthGrad w x 1) := by
            funext x
            rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
          rw [heq]
          exact h
        have hdiff := (mse_QC_add_sub s _ _ D _ _ _ hD hT'D (hpd _ (hF i) m) (hsumsm i)
          (mse_QC_mono.2.2 s B _ S _ hT'sub ((hQF i).2 m)) hsum).2
        exact mse_QC_mono.2.1 s _ _ _ _ hBFBm hdiff
      have hQam : ∀ i j, mseQC s
          (max B (max Bw (B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw + 2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw))))
          (fun x => a x i j) (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) := by
        intro i j
        exact mse_QC_mono.2.1 s B _ _ _ hBBm (mse_QC_mono.2.2 s B _ S _ hT'sub
          (mse_QC_mono.1 s (s + 1) B _ S (Nat.le_succ s) (hQa i j)))
      have hbd : ∀ x ∈ (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)), |smthGrad w x m| ≤
          ((max B (max Bw (B + (2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw + 2 ^ (s + 1) * B * Bw))) : NNReal) : ℝ) := by
        intro x hx
        have h0 : mseQC 0 Bw (fun x => smthGrad w x m) (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) :=
          mse_QC_mono.1 0 s Bw _ _ (Nat.zero_le s) (hW.2 m)
        exact (h0.1 x hx).trans (NNReal.coe_le_coe.2 hBwBm)
      exact hB3 D (⋃ x ∈ T, Metric.ball x (R / 2)) T a
        (fun x i => smthGrad (fun y => F y i) x m -
          ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) x m * smthGrad w x j)
        (fun x => smthGrad w x m) hD hT'o hT'D hTT' ha hFm (hpd _ hw m)
        (fun x hx ξ => hell x (hT'sub hx) ξ) hQam hQFm hbd
        (fun x hx => hsolm x (hT'sub hx))
    
    refine ⟨?_, fun m => mse_QC_mono.2.1 (s + 1) B3 (max Bw B3) _ T (le_max_right _ _) (hstep m)⟩
    exact (mse_QC_mono.2.1 (s + 1) Bw (max Bw B3) w T (le_max_left _ _)
      (mse_QC_mono.2.2 (s + 1) Bw w _ T hTsub hW)).1

by

  have hstar : ∀ (S : Set E3) (c : E3), IsOpen S → StarConvex ℝ c S → c ∈ S →
      ∀ φ : E3 → Y, ContinuousOn φ S → ∀ z₀ ∈ S, ∀ x : X, p x = φ z₀ →

    haveI : ContractibleSpace S := hS.contractibleSpace ⟨c, hc⟩
    haveI : SimplyConnectedSpace S := SimplyConnectedSpace.ofContractible S

    obtain ⟨F', ⟨hF'0, hF'p⟩, -⟩ := hp.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts
      ⟨S.restrict φ, hφ.restrict⟩ ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ x hx
    refine ⟨fun z => if hz : z ∈ S then F' ⟨z, hz⟩ else x, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
      have hres : S.restrict (fun z => if hz : z ∈ S then F' ⟨z, hz⟩ else x) = F' := by

        show (if hz : (z : E3) ∈ S then F' ⟨z, hz⟩ else x) = F' z
        rw [dif_pos z.2]
      rw [hres]
      exact F'.continuous
    · show (if hz : z₀ ∈ S then F' ⟨z₀, hz⟩ else x) = x
      rw [dif_pos hz₀]
      exact hF'0
    · intro z hz
      show p (if hz : z ∈ S then F' ⟨z, hz⟩ else x) = φ z

      exact congrFun hF'p ⟨z, hz⟩
  
  have hglue : ∀ (U V : Set E3), IsOpen U → IsOpen V → IsPreconnected (U ∩ V) →
      (U ∩ V).Nonempty → ∀ φ : E3 → Y,
      (∀ t₀ ∈ U, ∀ x : X, p x = φ t₀ →
        ∃ F : E3 → X, ContinuousOn F U ∧ F t₀ = x ∧ ∀ t ∈ U, p (F t) = φ t) →
      (∀ t₀ ∈ V, ∀ x : X, p x = φ t₀ →
        ∃ F : E3 → X, ContinuousOn F V ∧ F t₀ = x ∧ ∀ t ∈ V, p (F t) = φ t) →
      ∀ t₀ ∈ U, ∀ x : X, p x = φ t₀ →
        ∃ F : E3 → X, ContinuousOn F (U ∪ V) ∧ F t₀ = x ∧ ∀ t ∈ U ∪ V, p (F t) = φ t := by
    intro U V hU hV hUV hne φ hLU hLV t₀ ht₀ x hx
    obtain ⟨FU, hFUc, hFU0, hFUp⟩ := hLU t₀ ht₀ x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hzU, hzV⟩ := hne
    obtain ⟨FV, hFVc, hFVz, hFVp⟩ := hLV z hzV (FU z) (hFUp z hzU)
    haveI : PreconnectedSpace (U ∩ V : Set E3) := Subtype.preconnectedSpace hUV
    have heq := hp.eq_of_comp_eq (g₁ := (U ∩ V).restrict FU) (g₂ := (U ∩ V).restrict FV)
      (hFUc.mono Set.inter_subset_left).restrict (hFVc.mono Set.inter_subset_right).restrict
      (by
        funext t
        show p (FU t) = p (FV t)
        rw [hFUp t t.2.1, hFVp t t.2.2])
      ⟨z, hzU, hzV⟩ hFVz.symm
    have hagree : ∀ t ∈ U ∩ V, FU t = FV t := fun t ht => congrFun heq ⟨t, ht⟩
    refine ⟨fun t => if t ∈ U then FU t else FV t, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ContinuousOn.union_of_isOpen ?_ ?_ hU hV
      · refine hFUc.congr (fun t ht => ?_)
        show (if t ∈ U then FU t else FV t) = FU t
        rw [if_pos ht]
      · refine hFVc.congr (fun t ht => ?_)
        show (if t ∈ U then FU t else FV t) = FV t
        by_cases htU : t ∈ U
        · rw [if_pos htU]
          exact hagree t ⟨htU, ht⟩
        · rw [if_neg htU]
    · show (if t₀ ∈ U then FU t₀ else FV t₀) = x
      rw [if_pos ht₀]
      exact hFU0
    · intro t ht
      show p (if t ∈ U then FU t else FV t) = φ t
      by_cases htU : t ∈ U
      · rw [if_pos htU]
        exact hFUp t htU
      · rw [if_neg htU]
        exact hFVp t (ht.resolve_left htU)
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (σ a b : ℝ) (z : E3) (i : Fin 3),
      (a • (σ • e 0) + b • z) i = a * (σ * (if i = 0 then 1 else 0)) + b * z i := by
    intro σ a b z i
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hopen : ∀ σ : ℝ, IsOpen {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)} := by
    intro σ
    have hcl : IsClosed {z : E3 | z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0} := by
      refine (isClosed_eq (f := fun z : E3 => z 1) (by fun_prop) continuous_const).inter
        ((isClosed_eq (f := fun z : E3 => z 2) (by fun_prop) continuous_const).inter
          (isClosed_le (f := fun z : E3 => σ * z 0) (by fun_prop) continuous_const))
    exact hcl.isOpen_compl
  have hsc : ∀ σ : ℝ, σ ≠ 0 →
      StarConvex ℝ (σ • e 0) {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)} := by
    intro σ hσ z hz a b ha hb hab
    have hσσ : 0 < σ * σ := mul_self_pos.mpr hσ
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz ⊢
    rintro ⟨h1, h2, h0⟩
    have e1 : (if (1 : Fin 3) = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
    have e2 : (if (2 : Fin 3) = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0 := if_neg (by decide)
    rw [hcoord, e1, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_add] at h1
    rw [hcoord, e2, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_add] at h2
    rw [hcoord, if_pos rfl, mul_one] at h0
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hb with hb0 | hbpos
    · subst hb0
      have ha1 : a = 1 := by linarith
      subst ha1
      nlinarith
    · apply hz
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h | h
        · exact absurd h hbpos.ne'
        · exact h
      · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h | h
        · exact absurd h hbpos.ne'
        · exact h
      · by_contra hpos
        push_neg at hpos
        nlinarith [mul_pos hbpos hpos, mul_nonneg ha hσσ.le]
  have hcen : ∀ σ : ℝ, σ ≠ 0 → σ • e 0 ∈ {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)} := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hσσ : 0 < σ * σ := mul_self_pos.mpr hσ
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    rintro ⟨-, -, h0⟩
    have h00 : (σ • e 0) 0 = σ := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [h00] at h0
    linarith
  have hXne : ∀ σ : ℝ, ∀ z : E3, z ∈ {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)} → z ≠ 0 := by
    rintro σ z hz rfl
    exact hz ⟨by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
  
  have hD : IsPreconnected {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0)} := by
    have hC : IsConnected ({0}ᶜ : Set ℂ) :=
      isConnected_compl_singleton_of_one_lt_rank (by rw [Complex.rank_real_complex]; norm_num) 0
    have hT : IsPreconnected ((Set.univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℂ)) :=
      isPreconnected_univ.prod hC.isPreconnected
    have himg : (fun q : ℝ × ℂ => q.1 • e 0 + q.2.re • e 1 + q.2.im • e 2) ''
        ((Set.univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℂ)) = {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0)} := by
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_univ, true_and,
        Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Prod.exists]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, ζ, hζ, rfl⟩ ⟨h1, h2⟩
        apply hζ
        simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] at h1 h2
        exact Complex.ext h1 h2
      · intro hz
        refine ⟨z 0, ⟨z 1, z 2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro h
          apply hz
          exact ⟨congrArg Complex.re h, congrArg Complex.im h⟩
        · ext i
          fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [← himg]
    exact hT.image _ (Continuous.continuousOn (by fun_prop))
  have hinter : {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} ∩
      {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (-1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} = {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0)} := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ ⟨a, b⟩
      rcases le_total (z 0) 0 with h | h
      · exact h1 ⟨a, b, by linarith⟩
      · exact h2 ⟨a, b, by linarith⟩
    · intro h
      exact ⟨fun ⟨a, b, _⟩ => h ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b, _⟩ => h ⟨a, b⟩⟩
  have hpre : IsPreconnected ({z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} ∩
      {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (-1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)}) := by
    rw [hinter]; exact hD
  have hne : ({z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} ∩
      {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (-1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)}).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨e 1, ?_⟩
    rw [hinter]
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hneX : ∀ z : E3, z ≠ 0 → z ∈ {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} ∪
      {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (-1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} := by
    intro z hz
    by_contra hc
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_or, not_not] at hc
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, ⟨-, -, h4⟩⟩ := hc
    apply hz
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, PiLp.zero_apply]
      linarith
    · simpa using h1
    · simpa using h2
  
  have hnh : ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → ‖(1 - 1 / ‖y‖) • y‖ = ‖y‖ - 1 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy0 : 0 < ‖y‖ := by linarith
    have hpos : 0 < 1 - 1 / ‖y‖ := by rw [sub_pos, div_lt_one hy0]; exact hy
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos, sub_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hy0.ne', one_mul]
  have hng : ∀ z : E3, z ≠ 0 → ‖(1 + 1 / ‖z‖) • z‖ = ‖z‖ + 1 := by
    intro z hz
    have hz0 : 0 < ‖z‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hz
    have hpos : 0 < 1 + 1 / ‖z‖ := by positivity
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hpos, add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hz0.ne', one_mul]
  have hgh : ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ →
      (1 + 1 / ‖(1 - 1 / ‖y‖) • y‖) • ((1 - 1 / ‖y‖) • y) = y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hnh y hy, smul_smul]
    have hy0 : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h1 : ‖y‖ - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hprod : (1 + 1 / (‖y‖ - 1)) * (1 - 1 / ‖y‖) = 1 := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hprod, one_smul]
  have hH0 : ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → (1 - 1 / ‖y‖) • y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy h0
    have := hnh y hy
    rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
    linarith
  have hHc : ContinuousOn (fun y : E3 => (1 - 1 / ‖y‖) • y) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} :=
    (continuousOn_const.sub (continuousOn_const.div continuous_norm.continuousOn
      (fun y hy => (lt_trans one_pos hy).ne'))).smul continuousOn_id
  have hGc : ContinuousOn (fun z : E3 => (1 + 1 / ‖z‖) • z) {z : E3 | z ≠ 0} :=
    (continuousOn_const.add (continuousOn_const.div continuous_norm.continuousOn
      (fun z hz => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz))).smul continuousOn_id
  
  set φ : E3 → Y := fun z => f ((1 + 1 / ‖z‖) • z) with hφdef
  have hφc : ContinuousOn φ {z : E3 | z ≠ 0} := by
    refine hf.comp hGc (fun z hz => ?_)
    show 1 < ‖(1 + 1 / ‖z‖) • z‖
    rw [hng z hz]
    have := norm_pos_iff.mpr (show z ≠ 0 from hz)
    linarith
  have hL : ∀ σ : ℝ, σ ≠ 0 → ∀ t₀ ∈ {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)},
      ∀ x : X, p x = φ t₀ → ∃ F : E3 → X,
        ContinuousOn F {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)} ∧ F t₀ = x ∧
          ∀ t ∈ {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ σ * z 0 ≤ 0)}, p (F t) = φ t :=
    fun σ hσ t₀ ht₀ x hx => hstar _ _ (hopen σ) (hsc σ hσ) (hcen σ hσ) φ
      (hφc.mono (fun z hz => hXne σ z hz)) t₀ ht₀ x hx
  have hL1 := hL 1 one_ne_zero
  have hL2 := hL (-1) (by norm_num)
  have hmem := hneX _ (hH0 y₀ hy₀)
  have hx' : p x₀ = φ ((1 - 1 / ‖y₀‖) • y₀) := by
    show p x₀ = f ((1 + 1 / ‖(1 - 1 / ‖y₀‖) • y₀‖) • ((1 - 1 / ‖y₀‖) • y₀))
    rw [hgh y₀ hy₀]
    exact hx₀
  obtain ⟨Ft, hFtc, hFt0, hFtp⟩ : ∃ Ft : E3 → X,
      ContinuousOn Ft ({z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} ∪
        {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (-1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)}) ∧
      Ft ((1 - 1 / ‖y₀‖) • y₀) = x₀ ∧
      ∀ t ∈ {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)} ∪
        {z : E3 | ¬(z 1 = 0 ∧ z 2 = 0 ∧ (-1 : ℝ) * z 0 ≤ 0)}, p (Ft t) = φ t := by
    rcases hmem with h | h
    · exact hglue _ _ (hopen 1) (hopen (-1)) hpre hne φ hL1 hL2 _ h x₀ hx'
    · obtain ⟨Ft, ha, hb, hc⟩ := hglue _ _ (hopen (-1)) (hopen 1)
        (by rw [Set.inter_comm]; exact hpre) (by rw [Set.inter_comm]; exact hne) φ hL2 hL1 _ h
        x₀ hx'
      rw [Set.union_comm] at ha hc
      exact ⟨Ft, ha, hb, hc⟩
  refine ⟨fun y => Ft ((1 - 1 / ‖y‖) • y), ?_, hFt0, ?_⟩
  · exact hFtc.comp hHc (fun y hy => hneX _ (hH0 y hy))
  · intro y hy
    show p (Ft ((1 - 1 / ‖y‖) • y)) = f y
    rw [hFtp _ (hneX _ (hH0 y hy))]
    show f ((1 + 1 / ‖(1 - 1 / ‖y‖) • y‖) • ((1 - 1 / ‖y‖) • y)) = f y
    rw [hgh y hy]

informal_problem.statement: (f : M → ℝ) (x : M) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (hx : f x = 0) (hdf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) : ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 x, (∃ z ∈ O, 0 < f z) ∧ (∃ z ∈ O, f z < 0)

signature.name: frontier_sign_change
signature.statement: (f : M → ℝ) (x : M) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (hx : f x = 0) (hdf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) : ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 x, (∃ z ∈ O, 0 < f z) ∧ (∃ z ∈ O, f z < 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro O hO
  have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x := by
    by_contra h
    exact hdf (mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt h)
  have hmf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x =
      fderiv ℝ (f ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm) (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) := by
    rw [hmd.mfderiv, ModelWithCorners.range_eq_univ, fderivWithin_univ]
    congr 1
  have hc : ContinuousAt (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) :=
    continuousAt_extChartAt_symm x
  have hinv : (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) = x :=
    extChartAt_to_inv x
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hmax : IsLocalMax f ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x)) := by
      rw [hinv]
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem hO (fun z hz => (h z hz).trans_eq hx.symm)
    exact hdf (hmf.trans (hmax.comp_continuous hc).fderiv_eq_zero)
  · by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hmin : IsLocalMin f ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x)) := by
      rw [hinv]
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem hO (fun z hz => hx.trans_le (h z hz))
    exact hdf (hmf.trans (hmin.comp_continuous hc).fderiv_eq_zero)

informal_problem.statement: (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (hfront : HasMinimalFrontier g U) : (∀ (V₁ V₂ : Set M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ) (p₁ p₂ x : M), IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V₁ f₁ p₁ → IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V₂ f₂ p₂ → V₁ ∩ U = V₁ ∩ {z | 0 < f₁ z} → V₂ ∩ U = V₂ ∩ {z | f₂ z ≠ 0} → x ∈ V₁ → x ∈ V₂ → x ∉ frontier U) ∧ (∀ (V₁ V₂ : Set M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ) (p₁ p₂ x : M), IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V₁ f₁ p₁ → IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V₂ f₂ p₂ → x ∈ V₁ → x ∈ V₂ → x ∈ frontier U → ∃ N : Set M, IsOpen N ∧ x ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ V₁ ∩ V₂ ∧ ((∀ z ∈ N, (0 < f₁ z ↔ 0 < f₂ z) ∧ (f₁ z < 0 ↔ f₂ z < 0)) ∨ (∀ z ∈ N, (0 < f₁ z ↔ f₂ z < 0) ∧ (f₁ z < 0 ↔ 0 < f₂ z))))

signature.name: frontier_chart_compare
signature.statement: (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (hfront : HasMinimalFrontier g U) : (∀ (V₁ V₂ : Set M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ) (p₁ p₂ x : M), IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V₁ f₁ p₁ → IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V₂ f₂ p₂ → V₁ ∩ U = V₁ ∩ {z | 0 < f₁ z} → V₂ ∩ U = V₂ ∩ {z | f₂ z ≠ 0} → x ∈ V₁ → x ∈ V₂ → x ∉ frontier U) ∧ (∀ (V₁ V₂ : Set M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ) (p₁ p₂ x : M), IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V₁ f₁ p₁ → IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V₂ f₂ p₂ → x ∈ V₁ → x ∈ V₂ → x ∈ frontier U → ∃ N : Set M, IsOpen N ∧ x ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ V₁ ∩ V₂ ∧ ((∀ z ∈ N, (0 < f₁ z ↔ 0 < f₂ z) ∧ (f₁ z < 0 ↔ f₂ z < 0)) ∨ (∀ z ∈ N, (0 < f₁ z ↔ f₂ z < 0) ∧ (f₁ z < 0 ↔ 0 < f₂ z))))

proof.tactics:
by
  have frontier_sign_change : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (x : M), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      f x = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 →
      ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 x, (∃ z ∈ O, 0 < f z) ∧ (∃ z ∈ O, f z < 0) := by
    intro f x _hf hx hdf O hO
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x := by
      by_contra h
      exact hdf (mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt h)
    have hmf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x =
        fderiv ℝ (f ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm) (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) := by
      rw [hmd.mfderiv, ModelWithCorners.range_eq_univ, fderivWithin_univ]
      congr 1
    have hc : ContinuousAt (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) :=
      continuousAt_extChartAt_symm x
    have hinv : (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) = x :=
      extChartAt_to_inv x
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have hmax : IsLocalMax f ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x)) := by
        rw [hinv]
        exact Filter.eventually_of_mem hO (fun z hz => (h z hz).trans_eq hx.symm)
      exact hdf (hmf.trans (hmax.comp_continuous hc).fderiv_eq_zero)
    · by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have hmin : IsLocalMin f ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x)) := by
        rw [hinv]
        exact Filter.eventually_of_mem hO (fun z hz => hx.trans_le (h z hz))
      exact hdf (hmf.trans (hmin.comp_continuous hc).fderiv_eq_zero)
  have hchart : ∀ {V : Set M} {f : M → ℝ} {p : M}, IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p →
      IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∧
      IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) := by
    intro V f p h
    unfold IsMinimalFrontierChart at h
    exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1⟩
  have hzero : ∀ {V : Set M} {f : M → ℝ} {p x : M}, IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p → x ∈ V →
      (x ∈ frontier U ↔ f x = 0) := by
    intro V f p x hC hx
    have hz := (hchart hC).2.2.2.2.1
    constructor
    · intro hxf
      have h1 : x ∈ V ∩ frontier U := ⟨hx, hxf⟩
      rw [hz] at h1
      exact h1.2
    · intro h0
      have h1 : x ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hx, h0⟩
      rw [← hz] at h1
      exact h1.2
  
  have hclass : ∀ (N : Set M) (h k : M → ℝ), ContinuousOn h N →
      (∀ z ∈ N, h z = 0 ↔ k z = 0) →
      IsPreconnected (N ∩ {z | 0 < k z}) → IsPreconnected (N ∩ {z | k z < 0}) →
      (∃ z ∈ N, 0 < h z) → (∃ z ∈ N, h z < 0) →
      (∀ z ∈ N, (0 < h z ↔ 0 < k z) ∧ (h z < 0 ↔ k z < 0)) ∨
      (∀ z ∈ N, (0 < h z ↔ k z < 0) ∧ (h z < 0 ↔ 0 < k z)) := by
    intro N h k hcont hz hP hQ hp hn
    obtain ⟨zp, hzpN, hzp⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨zn, hznN, hzn⟩ := hn
    have hconst : ∀ S : Set M, S ⊆ N → IsPreconnected S → (∀ z ∈ S, k z ≠ 0) →
        ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, 0 < h a → 0 < h b := by
      intro S hSN hS hk a ha b hb hha
      by_contra hhb
      have hb0 : h b ≠ 0 := fun e => hk b hb ((hz b (hSN hb)).1 e)
      have hbneg : h b < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hhb) hb0
      have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (h b) (h a) := ⟨hbneg.le, hha.le⟩
      obtain ⟨c, hcS, hc⟩ := hS.intermediate_value hb ha (hcont.mono hSN) hmem
      exact hk c hcS ((hz c (hSN hcS)).1 hc)
    have hPN : N ∩ {z | 0 < k z} ⊆ N := Set.inter_subset_left
    have hQN : N ∩ {z | k z < 0} ⊆ N := Set.inter_subset_left
    have hPk : ∀ z ∈ N ∩ {z | 0 < k z}, k z ≠ 0 := fun z hz' => ne_of_gt hz'.2
    have hQk : ∀ z ∈ N ∩ {z | k z < 0}, k z ≠ 0 := fun z hz' => ne_of_lt hz'.2
    have hkp : k zp ≠ 0 := fun e => (ne_of_gt hzp) ((hz zp hzpN).2 e)
    have hkn : k zn ≠ 0 := fun e => (ne_of_lt hzn) ((hz zn hznN).2 e)
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkp with hkp' | hkp'
    · 
      have hkn' : 0 < k zn := by
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkn with h1 | h1
        · have := hconst _ hQN hQ hQk zp ⟨hzpN, hkp'⟩ zn ⟨hznN, h1⟩ hzp
          linarith
        · exact h1
      right
      intro z hzN
      rcases lt_trichotomy (k z) 0 with h1 | h1 | h1
      · have h2 : 0 < h z := hconst _ hQN hQ hQk zp ⟨hzpN, hkp'⟩ z ⟨hzN, h1⟩ hzp
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> intro _ <;> linarith
      · have h2 : h z = 0 := (hz z hzN).2 h1
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> intro _ <;> linarith
      · have h2 : h z < 0 := by
          by_contra hc
          have h0 : h z ≠ 0 := fun e => (ne_of_gt h1) ((hz z hzN).1 e)
          have hpos : 0 < h z := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hc) (Ne.symm h0)
          have := hconst _ hPN hP hPk z ⟨hzN, h1⟩ zn ⟨hznN, hkn'⟩ hpos
          linarith
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> intro _ <;> linarith
    · 
      have hkn' : k zn < 0 := by
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkn with h1 | h1
        · exact h1
        · have := hconst _ hPN hP hPk zp ⟨hzpN, hkp'⟩ zn ⟨hznN, h1⟩ hzp
          linarith
      left
      intro z hzN
      rcases lt_trichotomy (k z) 0 with h1 | h1 | h1
      · have h2 : h z < 0 := by
          by_contra hc
          have h0 : h z ≠ 0 := fun e => (ne_of_lt h1) ((hz z hzN).1 e)
          have hpos : 0 < h z := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hc) (Ne.symm h0)
          have := hconst _ hQN hQ hQk z ⟨hzN, h1⟩ zn ⟨hznN, hkn'⟩ hpos
          linarith
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> intro _ <;> linarith
      · have h2 : h z = 0 := (hz z hzN).2 h1
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> intro _ <;> linarith
      · have h2 : 0 < h z := hconst _ hPN hP hPk zp ⟨hzpN, hkp'⟩ z ⟨hzN, h1⟩ hzp
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> intro _ <;> linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro V₁ V₂ f₁ f₂ p₁ p₂ x h1 h2 hone htwo hx1 hx2 hxf
    obtain ⟨hV1o, -, hs1, hd1, -⟩ := hchart h1
    obtain ⟨hV2o, -⟩ := hchart h2
    have hf0 : f₁ x = 0 := (hzero h1 hx1).1 hxf
    have hO : V₁ ∩ V₂ ∈ 𝓝 x := (hV1o.inter hV2o).mem_nhds ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
    obtain ⟨z, ⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hzneg⟩ := (frontier_sign_change f₁ x hs1 hf0 (hd1 x hx1) _ hO).2
    have hzU : z ∉ U := by
      intro hzU
      have hm : z ∈ V₁ ∩ U := ⟨hz1, hzU⟩
      rw [hone] at hm
      have : 0 < f₁ z := hm.2
      linarith
    have hzF : z ∉ frontier U := fun hzF => (ne_of_lt hzneg) ((hzero h1 hz1).1 hzF)
    have hf2 : f₂ z ≠ 0 := fun e => hzF ((hzero h2 hz2).2 e)
    have hm : z ∈ V₂ ∩ {z | f₂ z ≠ 0} := ⟨hz2, hf2⟩
    rw [← htwo] at hm
    exact hzU hm.2
  · 
    intro V₁ V₂ f₁ f₂ p₁ p₂ x h1 h2 hx1 hx2 hxf
    obtain ⟨hV1o, -, hs1, hd1, -⟩ := hchart h1
    obtain ⟨hV2o, -, hs2, hd2, -⟩ := hchart h2
    have hO : V₁ ∩ V₂ ∈ 𝓝 x := (hV1o.inter hV2o).mem_nhds ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
    obtain ⟨V₃, f₃, hsub, h3⟩ := hfront x hxf (V₁ ∩ V₂) hO
    obtain ⟨hV3o, hxV3, -, -, -, hP3, hQ3⟩ := hchart h3
    have hV3 : V₃ ∈ 𝓝 x := hV3o.mem_nhds hxV3
    have hz1 : ∀ z ∈ V₃, f₁ z = 0 ↔ f₃ z = 0 := fun z hz =>
      ((hzero h1 (hsub hz).1).symm).trans (hzero h3 hz)
    have hz2 : ∀ z ∈ V₃, f₂ z = 0 ↔ f₃ z = 0 := fun z hz =>
      ((hzero h2 (hsub hz).2).symm).trans (hzero h3 hz)
    have hsc1 := frontier_sign_change f₁ x hs1 ((hzero h1 hx1).1 hxf) (hd1 x hx1) V₃ hV3
    have hsc2 := frontier_sign_change f₂ x hs2 ((hzero h2 hx2).1 hxf) (hd2 x hx2) V₃ hV3
    have c1 := hclass V₃ f₁ f₃ hs1.continuous.continuousOn hz1 hP3 hQ3 hsc1.1 hsc1.2
    have c2 := hclass V₃ f₂ f₃ hs2.continuous.continuousOn hz2 hP3 hQ3 hsc2.1 hsc2.2
    refine ⟨V₃, hV3o, hxV3, hsub, ?_⟩
    rcases c1 with a₁ | o₁ <;> rcases c2 with a₂ | o₂
    · left
      intro z hz
      exact ⟨(a₁ z hz).1.trans (a₂ z hz).1.symm, (a₁ z hz).2.trans (a₂ z hz).2.symm⟩
    · right
      intro z hz
      exact ⟨(a₁ z hz).1.trans (o₂ z hz).2.symm, (a₁ z hz).2.trans (o₂ z hz).1.symm⟩
    · right
      intro z hz
      exact ⟨(o₁ z hz).1.trans (a₂ z hz).2.symm, (o₁ z hz).2.trans (a₂ z hz).1.symm⟩
    · left
      intro z hz
      exact ⟨(o₁ z hz).1.trans (o₂ z hz).1.symm, (o₁ z hz).2.trans (o₂ z hz).2.symm⟩

informal_problem.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X) (σ : X → X → ℝ) (hagree : ∀ (W : Set X) (φ₁ φ₂ : X → Bool), IsOpen W → IsFlipSection S σ W φ₁ → IsFlipSection S σ W φ₂ → IsOpen {x | x ∈ W ∧ φ₁ x = φ₂ x}) (hex : ∀ (q : X) (b : Bool) (O : Set X), O ∈ 𝓝 q → ∃ (W : Set X) (φ : X → Bool), IsOpen W ∧ q ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ O ∧ IsFlipSection S σ W φ ∧ φ q = b) : ∃ (_ : TopologicalSpace (FlipPt X)) (_ : T2Space (FlipPt X)) (π : FlipPt X → X) (lab : FlipPt X → Bool), Function.Bijective (fun z => (π z, lab z)) ∧ IsCoveringMap π ∧ (∀ (W : Set X) (φ : X → Bool), IsOpen W → IsFlipSection S σ W φ → IsOpen {w : FlipPt X | π w ∈ W ∧ lab w = φ (π w)}) ∧ (∀ (z : FlipPt X) (N : Set (FlipPt X)), N ∈ 𝓝 z → ∃ (W : Set X) (φ : X → Bool), IsOpen W ∧ π z ∈ W ∧ IsFlipSection S σ W φ ∧ φ (π z) = lab z ∧ ∀ w : FlipPt X, π w ∈ W → lab w = φ (π w) → w ∈ N)

signature.name: flip_etale_space
signature.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X) (σ : X → X → ℝ) (hagree : ∀ (W : Set X) (φ₁ φ₂ : X → Bool), IsOpen W → IsFlipSection S σ W φ₁ → IsFlipSection S σ W φ₂ → IsOpen {x | x ∈ W ∧ φ₁ x = φ₂ x}) (hex : ∀ (q : X) (b : Bool) (O : Set X), O ∈ 𝓝 q → ∃ (W : Set X) (φ : X → Bool), IsOpen W ∧ q ∈ W ∧ W ⊆ O ∧ IsFlipSection S σ W φ ∧ φ q = b) : ∃ (_ : TopologicalSpace (FlipPt X)) (_ : T2Space (FlipPt X)) (π : FlipPt X → X) (lab : FlipPt X → Bool), Function.Bijective (fun z => (π z, lab z)) ∧ IsCoveringMap π ∧ (∀ (W : Set X) (φ : X → Bool), IsOpen W → IsFlipSection S σ W φ → IsOpen {w : FlipPt X | π w ∈ W ∧ lab w = φ (π w)}) ∧ (∀ (z : FlipPt X) (N : Set (FlipPt X)), N ∈ 𝓝 z → ∃ (W : Set X) (φ : X → Bool), IsOpen W ∧ π z ∈ W ∧ IsFlipSection S σ W φ ∧ φ (π z) = lab z ∧ ∀ w : FlipPt X, π w ∈ W → lab w = φ (π w) → w ∈ N)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hxx : ∀ a b : Bool, xor (xor a b) b = a := by decide
  
  have hR : ∀ (W W' : Set X) (φ : X → Bool), IsFlipSection S σ W φ → W' ⊆ W →
      IsFlipSection S σ W' φ :=
    fun W W' φ h hsub q hq => h q (hsub hq)
  have hN : ∀ (W : Set X) (φ : X → Bool) (c : Bool), IsFlipSection S σ W φ →
      IsFlipSection S σ W (fun x => xor c (φ x)) := by
    intro W φ c h q hq
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h q hq
    refine ⟨fun hqS => (h1 hqS).mono (fun x hx => by simp only [hx]),
      fun hqS => (h2 hqS).mono ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨fun hp => by simp only [hx.1 hp], fun hn => ?_⟩
    show xor c (φ x) = !(xor c (φ q))
    rw [hx.2 hn]
    cases c <;> cases φ q <;> rfl
  
  set 𝓑 : Set (Set (FlipPt X)) := {B | ∃ (W : Set X) (φ : X → Bool), IsOpen W ∧
    IsFlipSection S σ W φ ∧ B = {z : FlipPt X | z.1 ∈ W ∧ z.2 = φ z.1}} with h𝓑
  letI τ : TopologicalSpace (FlipPt X) := TopologicalSpace.generateFrom 𝓑
  have hsheet : ∀ (W : Set X) (φ : X → Bool), IsOpen W → IsFlipSection S σ W φ →
      IsOpen {z : FlipPt X | z.1 ∈ W ∧ z.2 = φ z.1} :=
    fun W φ hW hφ => TopologicalSpace.isOpen_generateFrom_of_mem ⟨W, φ, hW, hφ, rfl⟩
  
  have hB : TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis 𝓑 := by
    refine TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis.mk ?_ ?_ rfl
    · rintro t₁ ⟨W₁, φ₁, hW₁, h₁, rfl⟩ t₂ ⟨W₂, φ₂, hW₂, h₂, rfl⟩ z ⟨⟨hz1, hz1'⟩, ⟨hz2, hz2'⟩⟩
      have hA : IsOpen {x | x ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ ∧ φ₁ x = φ₂ x} :=
        hagree _ φ₁ φ₂ (hW₁.inter hW₂) (hR _ _ _ h₁ Set.inter_subset_left)
          (hR _ _ _ h₂ Set.inter_subset_right)
      refine ⟨{z : FlipPt X | z.1 ∈ {x | x ∈ W₁ ∩ W₂ ∧ φ₁ x = φ₂ x} ∧ z.2 = φ₁ z.1},
        ⟨_, φ₁, hA, hR _ _ _ h₁ (fun x hx => hx.1.1), rfl⟩,
        ⟨⟨⟨hz1, hz2⟩, hz1'.symm.trans hz2'⟩, hz1'⟩, ?_⟩
      rintro w ⟨⟨⟨hw1, hw2⟩, hwe⟩, hw⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hw1, hw⟩, ⟨hw2, hw.trans hwe⟩⟩
    · refine Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun z => ?_)
      obtain ⟨W, φ, hW, hzW, -, hφ, hφz⟩ := hex z.1 z.2 Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
      exact ⟨_, ⟨W, φ, hW, hφ, rfl⟩, hzW, hφz.symm⟩
  
  have hπ : Continuous (fun z : FlipPt X => z.1) := by
    rw [continuous_def]
    intro O hO
    rw [hB.isOpen_iff]
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨W, φ, hW, hzW, hWO, hφ, hφz⟩ := hex z.1 z.2 O (hO.mem_nhds hz)
    exact ⟨_, ⟨W, φ, hW, hφ, rfl⟩, ⟨hzW, hφz.symm⟩, fun w hw => hWO hw.1⟩
  
  have hT2 : T2Space (FlipPt X) := by
    refine ⟨fun z₁ z₂ hne => ?_⟩
    by_cases h1 : z₁.1 = z₂.1
    · have h2 : z₁.2 ≠ z₂.2 := fun h => hne (Prod.ext h1 h)
      obtain ⟨W, φ, hW, hzW, -, hφ, hφz⟩ := hex z₁.1 z₁.2 Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
      refine ⟨_, _, hsheet W φ hW hφ, hsheet W (fun x => xor true (φ x)) hW (hN W φ true hφ),
        ⟨hzW, hφz.symm⟩, ⟨h1 ▸ hzW, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · show z₂.2 = xor true (φ z₂.1)
        rw [← h1, hφz, Bool.true_xor]
        exact Bool.eq_not_of_ne (Ne.symm h2)
      · rw [Set.disjoint_left]
        rintro w ⟨_, hw1⟩ ⟨_, hw2⟩
        change w.2 = xor true (φ w.1) at hw2
        rw [hw1, Bool.true_xor] at hw2
        exact Bool.not_ne_self _ hw2.symm
    · obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hzu, hzv, huv⟩ := t2_separation h1
      obtain ⟨W₁, φ₁, hW₁, hz1, hW₁u, hφ₁, hφz₁⟩ := hex z₁.1 z₁.2 u (hu.mem_nhds hzu)
      obtain ⟨W₂, φ₂, hW₂, hz2, hW₂v, hφ₂, hφz₂⟩ := hex z₂.1 z₂.2 v (hv.mem_nhds hzv)
      refine ⟨_, _, hsheet W₁ φ₁ hW₁ hφ₁, hsheet W₂ φ₂ hW₂ hφ₂, ⟨hz1, hφz₁.symm⟩,
        ⟨hz2, hφz₂.symm⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      rintro w ⟨hw1, _⟩ ⟨hw2, _⟩
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp huv (hW₁u hw1) (hW₂v hw2)
  
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (fun z : FlipPt X => (z.1, z.2)) :=
    ⟨fun a b h => Prod.ext (congrArg Prod.fst h) (congrArg Prod.snd h), fun q => ⟨q, rfl⟩⟩
  
  choose Wc φc hWc hxWc hsubc hφc hbc using fun x : X => hex x true Set.univ Filter.univ_mem
  have htriv : ∀ x : X, ∃ e : Trivialization Bool (fun z : FlipPt X => z.1), x ∈ e.baseSet := by
    intro x
    let pe : PartialEquiv (FlipPt X) (X × Bool) :=
      { toFun := fun z => (z.1, xor z.2 (φc x z.1))
        invFun := fun y => ((y.1, xor y.2 (φc x y.1)) : X × Bool)
        source := {z | z.1 ∈ Wc x}
        target := Wc x ×ˢ Set.univ
        map_source' := fun z hz => ⟨hz, Set.mem_univ _⟩
        map_target' := fun y hy => hy.1
        left_inv' := fun z _ => Prod.ext rfl (hxx _ _)
        right_inv' := fun y _ => Prod.ext rfl (hxx _ _) }
    have hcont_to : ContinuousOn pe pe.source := by
      refine continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt (fun z hz => ?_)
      show ContinuousAt (fun w : FlipPt X => ((w.1, xor w.2 (φc x w.1)) : X × Bool)) z
      refine ContinuousAt.prodMk hπ.continuousAt ?_
      have hopen := hsheet (Wc x) (fun y => xor (xor z.2 (φc x z.1)) (φc x y)) (hWc x)
        (hN (Wc x) (φc x) (xor z.2 (φc x z.1)) (hφc x))
      have hzmem : z ∈ {w : FlipPt X | w.1 ∈ Wc x ∧
          w.2 = (fun y => xor (xor z.2 (φc x z.1)) (φc x y)) w.1} := ⟨hz, (hxx _ _).symm⟩
      refine (continuousAt_const :
        ContinuousAt (fun _ : FlipPt X => xor z.2 (φc x z.1)) z).congr ?_
      filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hzmem] with w hw
      show xor z.2 (φc x z.1) = xor w.2 (φc x w.1)
      rw [hw.2, hxx]
    have hcont_inv : ContinuousOn pe.invFun pe.target := by
      refine continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt (fun y hy => ?_)
      rw [ContinuousAt, hB.nhds_hasBasis.tendsto_right_iff]
      rintro t ⟨⟨W', ψ', hW', hψ', rfl⟩, hyt⟩
      have hA : IsOpen {x' | x' ∈ Wc x ∩ W' ∧ (fun x'' => xor y.2 (φc x x'')) x' = ψ' x'} :=
        hagree _ _ _ ((hWc x).inter hW')
          (hR _ _ _ (hN (Wc x) (φc x) y.2 (hφc x)) Set.inter_subset_left)
          (hR _ _ _ hψ' Set.inter_subset_right)
      have hyA : y ∈ {x' | x' ∈ Wc x ∩ W' ∧ (fun x'' => xor y.2 (φc x x'')) x' = ψ' x'} ×ˢ
          ({y.2} : Set Bool) :=
        ⟨⟨⟨hy.1, hyt.1⟩, hyt.2⟩, rfl⟩
      filter_upwards [(hA.prod (isOpen_discrete _)).mem_nhds hyA] with y' hy'
      obtain ⟨⟨⟨_, hy'W'⟩, hy'e⟩, hy'2⟩ := hy'
      refine ⟨hy'W', ?_⟩
      have h2 : y'.2 = y.2 := hy'2
      show xor y'.2 (φc x y'.1) = ψ' y'.1
      rw [h2]
      exact hy'e
    let oph : OpenPartialHomeomorph (FlipPt X) (X × Bool) :=
      OpenPartialHomeomorph.mk pe (hπ.isOpen_preimage _ (hWc x)) ((hWc x).prod isOpen_univ)
        hcont_to hcont_inv
    exact ⟨Trivialization.mk oph (Wc x) (hWc x) rfl rfl (fun p _ => rfl), hxWc x⟩
  choose e he using htriv
  have hcov : IsCoveringMap (fun z : FlipPt X => z.1) :=
    IsCoveringMap.mk _ (fun _ => Bool) e he
  refine ⟨τ, hT2, fun z => z.1, fun z => z.2, hbij, hcov, hsheet, ?_⟩
  intro z N hN
  obtain ⟨t, ⟨W, φ, hW, hφ, rfl⟩, hzt, htN⟩ := hB.mem_nhds_iff.mp hN
  exact ⟨W, φ, hW, hzt.1, hφ, hzt.2.symm, fun w hw1 hw2 => htN ⟨hw1, hw2⟩⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(s : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (D S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hSD : S ⊆ D) (hfg : ∀ x ∈ D, f x = g x) (hf : mseQC s B f S) :
    mseQC s B g S

signature.name: mse_QC_congr
signature.statement:
(s : ℕ) (B : NNReal) (D S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hSD : S ⊆ D) (hfg : ∀ x ∈ D, f x = g x) (hf : mseQC s B f S) :
    mseQC s B g S

proof.tactics:
by
  have lvl0 : ∀ f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, (∀ x ∈ D, f x = g x) →
      ((∀ x ∈ S, |f x| ≤ (B : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith B (1 / 2 : NNReal) f S) →
      ((∀ x ∈ S, |g x| ≤ (B : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith B (1 / 2 : NNReal) g S) := by
    intro f g hfg h
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
    · rw [← hfg x (hSD hx)]
      exact h.1 x hx
    · rw [← hfg x (hSD hx), ← hfg y (hSD hy)]
      exact h.2 x hx y hy
  induction s generalizing f g with
  | zero => exact lvl0 f g hfg hf
  | succ s ih =>
    refine ⟨lvl0 f g hfg hf.1, fun m => ?_⟩
    refine ih (fun x => smthGrad f x m) (fun x => smthGrad g x m) ?_ (hf.2 m)
    intro x hx
    have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g := Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hD.mem_nhds hx) hfg
    simp only [smthGrad]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]

informal_problem.statement:
(s : ℕ) (B₁ B₂ : NNReal) (D S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hSD : S ⊆ D) (hfD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f D) (hgD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g D)
    (hf : mseQC s B₁ f S) (hg : mseQC s B₂ g S) :
