signature.name: mse_QC_add_sub
signature.statement:
(s : ℕ) (B₁ B₂ : NNReal) (D S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hSD : S ⊆ D) (hfD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f D) (hgD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g D)
    (hf : mseQC s B₁ f S) (hg : mseQC s B₂ g S) :
    mseQC s (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => f x + g x) S ∧ mseQC s (B₁ + B₂) (fun x => f x - g x) S

proof.tactics:
by
  have lvl0 : ∀ (f g h : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      ((∀ x ∈ S, |f x| ≤ (B₁ : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith B₁ (1 / 2 : NNReal) f S) →
      ((∀ x ∈ S, |g x| ≤ (B₂ : ℝ)) ∧ HolderOnWith B₂ (1 / 2 : NNReal) g S) →
      ((∀ x ∈ S, h x = f x + g x) ∨ (∀ x ∈ S, h x = f x - g x)) →
      ((∀ x ∈ S, |h x| ≤ ((B₁ + B₂ : NNReal) : ℝ)) ∧
        HolderOnWith (B₁ + B₂) (1 / 2 : NNReal) h S) := by
    intro f g h hf hg hh
    obtain ⟨hf0, hfH⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨hg0, hgH⟩ := hg
    rcases hh with hE | hE
    · refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
      · rw [hE x hx, NNReal.coe_add]
        exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hf0 x hx) (hg0 x hx))
      · rw [hE x hx, hE y hy, ENNReal.coe_add, add_mul]
        exact (edist_add_add_le _ _ _ _).trans
          (add_le_add (hfH.edist_le hx hy) (hgH.edist_le hx hy))
    · refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
      · rw [hE x hx, NNReal.coe_add]
        exact (abs_sub _ _).trans (add_le_add (hf0 x hx) (hg0 x hx))
      · rw [hE x hx, hE y hy, ENNReal.coe_add, add_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]
        refine (edist_add_add_le _ _ _ _).trans ?_
        rw [edist_neg_neg]
        exact add_le_add (hfH.edist_le hx hy) (hgH.edist_le hx hy)
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ f g h : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f D → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g D →
      mseQC n B₁ f S → mseQC n B₂ g S →
      ((∀ x ∈ D, h x = f x + g x) ∨ (∀ x ∈ D, h x = f x - g x)) →
      mseQC n (B₁ + B₂) h S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro f g h _ _ hf hg hh
      exact lvl0 f g h hf hg
        (hh.imp (fun H x hx => H x (hSD hx)) (fun H x hx => H x (hSD hx)))
    | succ n ih =>
      intro f g h hfc hgc hf hg hh
      refine ⟨lvl0 f g h hf.1 hg.1
        (hh.imp (fun H x hx => H x (hSD hx)) (fun H x hx => H x (hSD hx))), fun m => ?_⟩
      have hf' := (contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hfc
      have hg' := (contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hgc
      refine ih (fun x => smthGrad f x m) (fun x => smthGrad g x m) (fun x => smthGrad h x m)
        (hf'.2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const) (hg'.2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const)
        (hf.2 m) (hg.2 m) ?_
      rcases hh with hE | hE
      · left
        intro x hx
        have hev : h =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => f y + g y) :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem (hD.mem_nhds hx) hE
        have hfx := hf'.1.differentiableAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)
        have hgx := hg'.1.differentiableAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)
        simp only [smthGrad]
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_add hfx hgx]
        rfl
      · right
        intro x hx
        have hev : h =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => f y - g y) :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem (hD.mem_nhds hx) hE
        have hfx := hf'.1.differentiableAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)
        have hgx := hg'.1.differentiableAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)
        simp only [smthGrad]
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub hfx hgx]
        rfl
  exact ⟨key s f g _ hfD hgD hf hg (Or.inl (fun x _ => rfl)),
    key s f g _ hfD hgD hf hg (Or.inr (fun x _ => rfl))⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(s : ℕ) (B₁ B₂ : NNReal) (D S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hSD : S ⊆ D) (hfD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f D) (hgD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g D)
    (hf : mseQC s B₁ f S) (hg : mseQC s B₂ g S) :
    mseQC s (2 ^ (s + 1) * B₁ * B₂) (fun x => f x * g x) S

signature.name: mse_QC_mul
signature.statement:
(s : ℕ) (B₁ B₂ : NNReal) (D S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (f g : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hD : IsOpen D) (hSD : S ⊆ D) (hfD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f D) (hgD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g D)
    (hf : mseQC s B₁ f S) (hg : mseQC s B₂ g S) :
    mseQC s (2 ^ (s + 1) * B₁ * B₂) (fun x => f x * g x) S

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hol : ∀ (C : NNReal) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, dist (F x) (F y) ≤ (C : ℝ) * dist x y ^ ((1 / 2 : NNReal) : ℝ)) →
      HolderOnWith C (1 / 2 : NNReal) F S := by
    intro C F h x hx y hy
    rw [edist_dist, edist_dist, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg dist_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg _),
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (NNReal.coe_nonneg _)]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (h x hx y hy)
  
  have q0mul : ∀ (F G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), mseQC 0 B₁ F S → mseQC 0 B₂ G S →
      mseQC 0 (2 * B₁ * B₂) (fun x => F x * G x) S := by
    intro F G hF hG
    obtain ⟨hF0, hF1⟩ := hF
    obtain ⟨hG0, hG1⟩ := hG
    have hB1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ B₁ := B₁.2
    have hB2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ B₂ := B₂.2
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, hol _ _ fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
    · have h1 := hF0 x hx
      have h2 := hG0 x hx
      rw [abs_mul, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat]
      have := mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hB1
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hB1 hB2]
    · have h1 := hF1.dist_le hx hy
      have h2 := hG1.dist_le hx hy
      have ha := hF0 x hx
      have hb := hG0 y hy
      set t := dist x y ^ ((1 / 2 : NNReal) : ℝ) with ht
      have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg _
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at h1 h2 ⊢
      rw [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat]
      have e : F x * G x - F y * G y = F x * (G x - G y) + G y * (F x - F y) := by ring
      rw [e]
      calc |F x * (G x - G y) + G y * (F x - F y)|
          ≤ |F x * (G x - G y)| + |G y * (F x - F y)| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |F x| * |G x - G y| + |G y| * |F x - F y| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ (B₁ : ℝ) * (B₂ * t) + B₂ * (B₁ * t) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul ha h2 (abs_nonneg _) hB1) (mul_le_mul hb h1 (abs_nonneg _) hB2)
        _ = 2 * B₁ * B₂ * t := by ring
  
  have q0add : ∀ (C₁ C₂ : NNReal) (F G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), mseQC 0 C₁ F S → mseQC 0 C₂ G S →
      mseQC 0 (C₁ + C₂) (fun x => F x + G x) S := by
    intro C₁ C₂ F G hF hG
    obtain ⟨hF0, hF1⟩ := hF
    obtain ⟨hG0, hG1⟩ := hG
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, hol _ _ fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
    · rw [NNReal.coe_add]
      exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hF0 x hx) (hG0 x hx))
    · have h1 := hF1.dist_le hx hy
      have h2 := hG1.dist_le hx hy
      set t := dist x y ^ ((1 / 2 : NNReal) : ℝ) with ht
      rw [Real.dist_eq] at h1 h2 ⊢
      rw [NNReal.coe_add]
      have e : F x + G x - (F y + G y) = (F x - F y) + (G x - G y) := by ring
      rw [e, add_mul]
      exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add h1 h2)
  
  have hsm : ∀ (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (m : Fin 2), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F D →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => smthGrad F x m) D := fun F m hF =>
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hF).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdiff : ∀ (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F D → ∀ x ∈ D, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x :=
    fun F hF x hx =>
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hF).1.differentiableAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)
  have hlb : ∀ (F G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F D → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G D →
      ∀ (m : Fin 2), ∀ x ∈ D,
      smthGrad (fun y => F y * G y) x m = smthGrad F x m * G x + F x * smthGrad G x m := by
    intro F G hF hG m x hx
    show (fderiv ℝ (F * G) x) (Pi.single m 1) =
      (fderiv ℝ F x) (Pi.single m 1) * G x + F x * (fderiv ℝ G x) (Pi.single m 1)
    rw [fderiv_mul (hdiff F hF x hx) (hdiff G hG x hx)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have q0mono : ∀ (C C' : NNReal) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), C ≤ C' →
      mseQC 0 C F S → mseQC 0 C' F S := by
    intro C C' F hC hF
    obtain ⟨hF0, hF1⟩ := hF
    have hC' : (C : ℝ) ≤ C' := hC
    refine ⟨fun x hx => (hF0 x hx).trans hC', hol _ _ fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
    exact (hF1.dist_le hx hy).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC' (Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg _))
  have qmono : ∀ (n : ℕ) (C C' : NNReal) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), C ≤ C' →
      mseQC n C F S → mseQC n C' F S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact q0mono
    | succ n ih =>
      intro C C' F hC hF
      exact ⟨q0mono C C' F hC hF.1, fun m => ih C C' _ hC (hF.2 m)⟩
  have qdrop : ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : NNReal) (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      mseQC (n + 1) C F S → mseQC n C F S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro C F hF
      exact hF.1
    | succ n ih =>
      intro C F hF
      exact ⟨hF.1, fun m => ih C _ (hF.2 m)⟩
  have q0congr : ∀ (C : NNReal) (F G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ D, F x = G x) →
      mseQC 0 C F S → mseQC 0 C G S := by
    intro C F G hFG hF
    obtain ⟨hF0, hF1⟩ := hF
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, hol _ _ fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
    · rw [← hFG x (hSD hx)]
      exact hF0 x hx
    · rw [← hFG x (hSD hx), ← hFG y (hSD hy)]
      exact hF1.dist_le hx hy
  have qcongr : ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : NNReal) (F G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ D, F x = G x) →
      mseQC n C F S → mseQC n C G S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => exact q0congr
    | succ n ih =>
      intro C F G hFG hF
      refine ⟨q0congr C F G hFG hF.1, fun m => ih C _ _ (fun x hx => ?_) (hF.2 m)⟩
      show fderiv ℝ F x (Pi.single m 1) = fderiv ℝ G x (Pi.single m 1)
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hD.mem_nhds hx) hFG)]
  
  have qadd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (C₁ C₂ : NNReal) (F G : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F D → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G D →
      mseQC n C₁ F S → mseQC n C₂ G S → mseQC n (C₁ + C₂) (fun x => F x + G x) S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro C₁ C₂ F G _ _ hF hG
      exact q0add C₁ C₂ F G hF hG
    | succ n ih =>
      intro C₁ C₂ F G hFD hGD hF hG
      refine ⟨q0add C₁ C₂ F G hF.1 hG.1, fun m => ?_⟩
      have h := ih C₁ C₂ _ _ (hsm F m hFD) (hsm G m hGD) (hF.2 m) (hG.2 m)
      refine qcongr n _ _ _ (fun x hx => ?_) h
      show fderiv ℝ F x (Pi.single m 1) + fderiv ℝ G x (Pi.single m 1) =
        fderiv ℝ (F + G) x (Pi.single m 1)
      rw [fderiv_add (hdiff F hFD x hx) (hdiff G hGD x hx)]
      rfl
  
  induction s generalizing f g with
  | zero =>
    exact qmono 0 _ _ _ (le_of_eq (by norm_num)) (q0mul f g hf hg)
  | succ n ih =>
    have h2 : (2 : NNReal) ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1 + 1) := le_self_pow₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
    have hle : 2 * B₁ * B₂ ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1 + 1) * B₁ * B₂ :=
      mul_le_mul_right' (mul_le_mul_right' h2 _) _
    refine ⟨q0mono _ _ _ hle (q0mul f g hf.1 hg.1), fun m => ?_⟩
    have hfs := qdrop n B₁ f hf
    have hgs := qdrop n B₂ g hg
    have h1 := ih _ g (hsm f m hfD) hgD (hf.2 m) hgs
    have h2 := ih f _ hfD (hsm g m hgD) hfs (hg.2 m)
    have h3 := qadd n _ _ _ _ ((hsm f m hfD).mul hgD) (hfD.mul (hsm g m hgD)) h1 h2
    have h4 := qcongr n _ _ (fun x => smthGrad (fun y => f y * g y) x m)
      (fun x hx => (hlb f g hfD hgD m x hx).symm) h3
    refine qmono n _ _ _ (le_of_eq ?_) h4
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
(Φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ O)
    (D : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hD : IsOpen D) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u D)
    (hUO : ∀ x ∈ D, (x, u x, smthGrad u x) ∈ O) (m : Fin 2) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ D) :
    smthGrad (fun y => Φ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) x m =
      fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (Pi.single m 1, 0, 0) +
      fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (0, 1, 0) * smthGrad u x m +
      ∑ k : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1) *
        smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x m

signature.name: mse_comp_chain
signature.statement:
(Φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ O)
    (D : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hD : IsOpen D) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u D)
    (hUO : ∀ x ∈ D, (x, u x, smthGrad u x) ∈ O) (m : Fin 2) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ D) :
    smthGrad (fun y => Φ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) x m =
      fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (Pi.single m 1, 0, 0) +
      fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (0, 1, 0) * smthGrad u x m +
      ∑ k : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) (0, 0, Pi.single k 1) *
        smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x m

proof.tactics:
by
  have hΦd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) :=
    (hΦ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds (hUO x hx))
  have hud : DifferentiableAt ℝ u x :=
    (hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)
  have hgd : ∀ k : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x := by
    intro k
    have hC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (Pi.single k 1)) D :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD).1 hu).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (hC.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)
  have hU' : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (y, u y, smthGrad u y))
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ)).prod ((fderiv ℝ u x).prod
        (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun k => fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x))) x :=
    (hasFDerivAt_id x).prodMk
      (hud.hasFDerivAt.prodMk (hasFDerivAt_pi.2 fun k => (hgd k).hasFDerivAt))
  have hchain : fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) x =
      (fderiv ℝ Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x)).comp
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ)).prod ((fderiv ℝ u x).prod
          (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun k => fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x))) :=
    (hΦd.hasFDerivAt.comp x hU').fderiv
  have hvec : ((Pi.single m 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ), fderiv ℝ u x (Pi.single m 1),
      fun k => fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x (Pi.single m 1)) =
      ((Pi.single m 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) +
        smthGrad u x m • ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (1 : ℝ), (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) +
        (smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y 0) x m •
            ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) +
          smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad u y 1) x m •
            ((0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), (0 : ℝ), (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ℝ))) := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)
    · simp
    · simp [smthGrad]
    · funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [smthGrad]
  show fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)) x (Pi.single m 1) = _
  rw [hchain]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
  have hpi : (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun k => fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x)
      (Pi.single m 1) = fun k => fderiv ℝ (fun y => smthGrad u y k) x (Pi.single m 1) := rfl
  rw [hpi, hvec, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(Φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (O 𝒦 : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ O)
    (h𝒦 : IsCompact 𝒦) (h𝒦c : Convex ℝ 𝒦) (h𝒦O : 𝒦 ⊆ O) (B : NNReal) :
    ∃ C : NNReal, ∀ (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      (∀ x ∈ S, (x, u x, smthGrad u x) ∈ 𝒦) →
      mseQC 1 B u S → mseQC 0 C (fun x => Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x)) S

signature.name: mse_comp_level0
signature.statement:
(Φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (O 𝒦 : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ O)
    (h𝒦 : IsCompact 𝒦) (h𝒦c : Convex ℝ 𝒦) (h𝒦O : 𝒦 ⊆ O) (B : NNReal) :
    ∃ C : NNReal, ∀ (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      (∀ x ∈ S, (x, u x, smthGrad u x) ∈ 𝒦) →
      mseQC 1 B u S → mseQC 0 C (fun x => Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x)) S

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hexp : (((1 / 2 : NNReal)) : ℝ) = 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have holder_of_dist : ∀ (C : NNReal) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, |f x - f y| ≤ (C : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (dist x y)) →
      HolderOnWith C (1 / 2 : NNReal) f S := by
    intro C f S h x hx y hy
    rw [edist_dist, edist_dist, hexp, Real.dist_eq]
    calc ENNReal.ofReal |f x - f y| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((C : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (dist x y)) :=
          ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (h x hx y hy)
      _ = (C : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (dist x y) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul C.coe_nonneg, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow,
            ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg dist_nonneg (by norm_num)]
  
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ Φ O := hΦ.differentiableOn (by simp)
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := h𝒦.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hΦ.continuousOn.mono h𝒦O)
  obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀⟩ := h𝒦.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    ((hΦ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)).mono h𝒦O)
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ max M₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ max L₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hMb : ∀ w ∈ 𝒦, |Φ w| ≤ max M₀ 0 := fun w hw => by
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact (hM₀ w hw).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hLip : ∀ w ∈ 𝒦, ∀ w' ∈ 𝒦, |Φ w - Φ w'| ≤ max L₀ 0 * ‖w - w'‖ := by
    intro w hw w' hw'
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
      (fun z hz => hdiff.differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds (h𝒦O hz)))
      (fun z hz => (hL₀ z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)) h𝒦c hw' hw
  
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁⟩ := h𝒦.isBounded.exists_norm_le
  have hδ : ∀ w ∈ 𝒦, ‖w‖ ≤ max δ₁ 0 := fun w hw => (hδ₁ w hw).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ) :=
    le_trans (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _)
  have hMC : 0 ≤ max (max M₀ 0) (max L₀ 0 * max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ)) :=
    le_max_of_le_left hM0
  refine ⟨Real.toNNReal (max (max M₀ 0) (max L₀ 0 * max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ))),
    fun S u hK hQ => ?_⟩
  have hC : ((Real.toNNReal (max (max M₀ 0)
      (max L₀ 0 * max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ))) : NNReal) : ℝ) =
      max (max M₀ 0) (max L₀ 0 * max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ)) :=
    Real.coe_toNNReal _ hMC
  have hu : HolderOnWith B (1 / 2 : NNReal) u S := hQ.1.2
  have hg : ∀ k : Fin 2, HolderOnWith B (1 / 2 : NNReal) (fun x => smthGrad u x k) S :=
    fun k => (hQ.2 k).2
  
  have hlift : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
      ‖(x, u x, smthGrad u x) - (y, u y, smthGrad u y)‖ ≤
        max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (dist x y) := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (dist x y) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hBK : (B : ℝ) ≤ max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ) := le_max_right _ _
    have h2 : |u x - u y| ≤ max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (dist x y) := by
      have := hu.dist_le hx hy
      rw [hexp, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.dist_eq] at this
      exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBK ht0)
    have h3 : ∀ k : Fin 2, |smthGrad u x k - smthGrad u y k| ≤
        max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (dist x y) := by
      intro k
      have := (hg k).dist_le hx hy
      rw [hexp, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.dist_eq] at this
      exact this.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hBK ht0)
    have h1 : ‖x - y‖ ≤ max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (dist x y) := by
      have hx' : ‖x‖ ≤ max δ₁ 0 := (norm_fst_le _).trans (hδ _ (hK x hx))
      have hy' : ‖y‖ ≤ max δ₁ 0 := (norm_fst_le _).trans (hδ _ (hK y hy))
      have hd : dist x y ≤ 2 * max δ₁ 0 := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm]; linarith [norm_sub_le x y]
      have htK : Real.sqrt (dist x y) ≤ max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ) :=
        (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hd).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      calc ‖x - y‖ = Real.sqrt (dist x y) * Real.sqrt (dist x y) := by
            rw [Real.mul_self_sqrt dist_nonneg, dist_eq_norm]
        _ ≤ max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (dist x y) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htK ht0
    rw [Prod.mk_sub_mk, Prod.mk_sub_mk, Prod.norm_mk, Prod.norm_mk]
    refine max_le h1 (max_le ?_ ?_)
    · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h2
    · refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK0 ht0)).2 (fun k => ?_)
      rw [Pi.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h3 k
  
  refine And.intro (fun x hx => ?_) (holder_of_dist _ _ S (fun x hx y hy => ?_))
  · rw [hC]; exact (hMb _ (hK x hx)).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · rw [hC]
    calc |Φ (x, u x, smthGrad u x) - Φ (y, u y, smthGrad u y)|
        ≤ max L₀ 0 * ‖(x, u x, smthGrad u x) - (y, u y, smthGrad u y)‖ :=
          hLip _ (hK x hx) _ (hK y hy)
      _ ≤ max L₀ 0 * (max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (dist x y)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hlift x hx y hy) hL0
      _ = (max L₀ 0 * max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (dist x y) := by ring
      _ ≤ max (max M₀ 0) (max L₀ 0 * max (Real.sqrt (2 * max δ₁ 0)) (B : ℝ)) *
            Real.sqrt (dist x y) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hFc : IsCompact (frontier U))
    (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hNc : IsCompact (closure N)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x ≠ 0)
    (hσb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x ∧ σ x < ε)
    (hσp : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d))
    (hσi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ)))
    (hσ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)
    (hWO : ∀ (x₀ : M) (a b : ℝ) (w : M → ℝ), x₀ ∈ U ∩ N → 0 < a → a < b → b < ε →
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, σ x ≤ a → w x < 0) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, b ≤ σ x → 0 < w x) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) →
      ∃ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ g.levelMeanCurv w x)
    (φ lam : M → ℝ)
    (hlam : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ q ∈ V, q ∈ frontier U → lam q = lam p)
    (hdata : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, 0 < φ p ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
        V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ V ∩ frontier U, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧
          g.jacobiDeriv f x = lam x / φ x) :
    ∀ p ∈ frontier U, 0 ≤ lam p

    (hWO : ∀ (x₀ : M) (a b : ℝ) (w : M → ℝ), x₀ ∈ U ∩ N → 0 < a → a < b → b < ε →
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro p₀ hp₀
  by_contra hneg
  push_neg at hneg
  have hX : IsOpen (U ∩ N) := hUo.inter hNo
  have hFU : ∀ x ∈ frontier U, x ∉ U := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hUo.frontier_eq] at hx
    exact hx.2
  
  obtain ⟨O, w, t₀, hO, -, hp₀O, ht₀, hK₀, hwc, hw0, hwpos, hws, hdw, hH, -⟩ :=
    unstable_collar_function g (frontier U) N hFc hfront hNo hFN φ lam hlam hdata p₀ hp₀ hneg
  
  obtain ⟨V, f, hVN, hVo, hp₀V, -, -, hVS, -, hP, hNg⟩ :=
    hfront.2 p₀ hp₀ N (hNo.mem_nhds (hFN hp₀))
  have hf0 : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ U → f x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hxV hxU hfx
    have h : x ∈ V ∩ frontier U := by
      rw [hVS]
      exact ⟨hxV, hfx⟩
    exact hFU x h.2 hxU
  have hside : ∀ S : Set M, S ⊆ V → (∀ x ∈ S, f x ≠ 0) → IsPreconnected S →
      ∀ x₁ ∈ S, x₁ ∈ U → S ⊆ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₁ := by
    intro S hSV hSf hSc x₁ hx₁S hx₁U
    have hcov : S ⊆ U ∪ (closure U)ᶜ := by
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxU : x ∈ U
      · exact Or.inl hxU
      · right
        intro hxc
        have hxF : x ∈ frontier U := by
          rw [hUo.frontier_eq]
          exact ⟨hxc, hxU⟩
        have h : x ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := by
          rw [← hVS]
          exact ⟨hSV hx, hxF⟩
        exact hSf x hx h.2
    have hdisj : Disjoint U (closure U)ᶜ :=
      Disjoint.mono_left subset_closure disjoint_compl_right
    have hSU : S ⊆ U :=
      IsPreconnected.subset_left_of_subset_union hUo isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl hdisj hcov
        ⟨x₁, hx₁S, hx₁U⟩ hSc
    exact hSc.subset_connectedComponentIn hx₁S (fun x hx => ⟨hSU hx, hVN (hSV hx)⟩)
  have hp₀cl : p₀ ∈ closure (V ∩ U) := by
    rw [_root_.mem_closure_iff]
    intro W hW hp₀W
    have h1 : p₀ ∈ closure U := frontier_subset_closure hp₀
    obtain ⟨y, hyWV, hyU⟩ := _root_.mem_closure_iff.1 h1 (W ∩ V) (hW.inter hVo) ⟨hp₀W, hp₀V⟩
    exact ⟨y, hyWV.1, hyWV.2, hyU⟩
  have hVU : V ∩ U = (V ∩ U ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∪ (V ∩ U ∩ {x | f x < 0}) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxV, hxU⟩
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hf0 x hxV hxU) with h | h
      · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hxV, hxU⟩, h⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hxV, hxU⟩, h⟩
    · rintro (⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩) <;> exact h
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hp₀C⟩ :
      ∃ x₀ ∈ U ∩ N, p₀ ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) := by
    rw [hVU, closure_union] at hp₀cl
    rcases hp₀cl with h | h
    · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ : (V ∩ U ∩ {x | 0 < f x}).Nonempty := by
        by_contra hne
        rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
        rw [hne, closure_empty] at h
        exact h
      refine ⟨x₀, ⟨hx₀.1.2, hVN hx₀.1.1⟩, closure_mono ?_ h⟩
      intro y hy
      exact hside (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) Set.inter_subset_left (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx.2) hP
        x₀ ⟨hx₀.1.1, hx₀.2⟩ hx₀.1.2 ⟨hy.1.1, hy.2⟩
    · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ : (V ∩ U ∩ {x | f x < 0}).Nonempty := by
        by_contra hne
        rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
        rw [hne, closure_empty] at h
        exact h
      refine ⟨x₀, ⟨hx₀.1.2, hVN hx₀.1.1⟩, closure_mono ?_ h⟩
      intro y hy
      exact hside (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) Set.inter_subset_left (fun x hx => ne_of_lt hx.2) hNg
        x₀ ⟨hx₀.1.1, hx₀.2⟩ hx₀.1.2 ⟨hy.1.1, hy.2⟩
  set C := connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ with hCdef
  have hCX : C ⊆ U ∩ N := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _
  have hCN : C ⊆ N := fun x hx => (hCX hx).2
  have hσc : ContinuousOn σ (U ∩ N) := hσs.continuousOn
  
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘX, hΘ0, hΘc⟩ := tau_flow_exists g (U ∩ N) hX σ 0 ε hσs hσr hσb hσp
  
  have hpc : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsPreconnected (C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ) := by
    intro δ _ hδ
    rcases (C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hS | ⟨y₀, hy₀C, hy₀δ⟩
    · rw [hS]
      exact isPreconnected_empty
    have hD : IsPreconnected (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) :=
      isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.prod isPreconnected_Ioo
    have hιc : ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => (p.1, p.2 - σ p.1)) (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) := by
      refine continuousOn_fst.prodMk (continuousOn_snd.sub ?_)
      exact hσc.comp continuousOn_fst (fun p hp => hCX hp.1)
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : M × ℝ => (p.1, p.2 - σ p.1)) (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ)
        {p : M × ℝ | p.1 ∈ U ∩ N ∧ 0 < σ p.1 + p.2 ∧ σ p.1 + p.2 < ε} := by
      intro p hp
      refine ⟨hCX hp.1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show 0 < σ p.1 + (p.2 - σ p.1)
        linarith [hp.2.1]
      · show σ p.1 + (p.2 - σ p.1) < ε
        linarith [hp.2.2]
    have hψc : ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) :=
      hΘc.comp hιc hmaps
    have himg := hD.image _ hψc
    have hψX : ∀ p ∈ C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ,
        Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1) ∈ U ∩ N ∧ σ (Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) = p.2 := by
      intro p hp
      have h := hΘX p.1 (hCX hp.1) (p.2 - σ p.1) (by linarith [hp.2.1]) (by linarith [hp.2.2])
      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
      rw [h.2]
      ring
    have hback : ∀ y ∈ C, Θ y (σ y - σ y) = y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [sub_self]
      exact hΘ0 y (hCX hy)
    have hy₀img : y₀ ∈ (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) '' (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) :=
      ⟨(y₀, σ y₀), ⟨hy₀C, (hσb y₀ (hCX hy₀C)).1, hy₀δ⟩, hback y₀ hy₀C⟩
    have himgC : (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) '' (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) ⊆ C := by
      have h1 := himg.subset_connectedComponentIn hy₀img
        (by
          rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
          exact (hψX p hp).1)
      rw [← connectedComponentIn_eq hy₀C] at h1
      exact h1
    have heq : (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) '' (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) =
        C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨himgC ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        show σ (Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) < δ
        rw [(hψX p hp).2]
        exact hp.2.2
      · rintro y ⟨hyC, hyδ⟩
        exact ⟨(y, σ y), ⟨hyC, (hσb y (hCX hyC)).1, hyδ⟩, hback y hyC⟩
    rw [← heq]
    exact himg
  
  have hthin : ∀ O' : Set M, IsOpen O' → closure C ∩ frontier U ⊆ O' →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < ε ∧ C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ ⊆ O' := by
    intro O' hO' hFO'
    have hδpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := fun n => div_pos hε (by positivity)
    have hδlt : ∀ n : ℕ, ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2) < ε := by
      intro n
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := n.cast_nonneg
      nlinarith
    have hδanti : ∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2) ≤ ε / ((m : ℝ) + 2) := by
      intro m n hmn
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hε.le (by positivity)
      have : (m : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_le.mpr hmn
      linarith
    let T : ℕ → Set M := fun n => closure (C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic (ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2))) \ O'
    have hTc : ∀ n, IsClosed (T n) := fun n => isClosed_closure.sdiff hO'
    have hTanti : Antitone T := by
      intro m n hmn
      apply Set.diff_subset_diff_left
      apply closure_mono
      intro x hx
      exact ⟨hx.1, le_trans hx.2 (hδanti m n hmn)⟩
    have hdir : Directed (· ⊇ ·) T := hTanti.directed_ge
    have hcl : ∀ n : ℕ, closure (C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic (ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2))) ⊆
        frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic (ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2))) := by
      intro n
      apply (hσi _ (hδpos n) (hδlt n)).closure_subset_iff.2
      intro x hx
      exact Or.inr ⟨hCX hx.1, hx.2⟩
    have hempty : closure N ∩ ⋂ n, T n = ∅ := by
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
      rintro x ⟨-, hx⟩
      rw [Set.mem_iInter] at hx
      have hxO : x ∉ O' := (hx 0).2
      have hxC : x ∈ closure C := closure_mono Set.inter_subset_left (hx 0).1
      by_cases hxF : x ∈ frontier U
      · exact hxO (hFO' ⟨hxC, hxF⟩)
      · have hall : ∀ n : ℕ, x ∈ U ∩ N ∧ σ x ≤ ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by
          intro n
          rcases hcl n (hx n).1 with h | h
          · exact absurd h hxF
          · exact ⟨h.1, h.2⟩
        have hpos := (hσb x (hall 0).1).1
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (ε / σ x)
        have h1 := (hall n).2
        have h2 : ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2) < σ x := by
          rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          rw [div_lt_iff₀ hpos] at hn
          nlinarith
        exact absurd h1 (not_le.2 h2)
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hNc.elim_directed_family_closed T hTc hempty hdir
    refine ⟨ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2), hδpos n, hδlt n, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxO
    have hxT : x ∈ T n := ⟨subset_closure hx, hxO⟩
    have hxN : x ∈ closure N := subset_closure (hCN hx.1)
    have h : x ∈ closure N ∩ T n := ⟨hxN, hxT⟩
    rw [hn] at h
    exact h
  
  have hFCpc : IsPreconnected (closure C ∩ frontier U) := by
    intro u v hu hv hKuv hKu hKv
    by_contra hne
    rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
    have hKc : IsCompact (closure C ∩ frontier U) := hFc.inter_left isClosed_closure
    have hnot : ∀ x ∈ closure C ∩ frontier U, x ∈ u → x ∈ v → False := by
      intro x hxK hxu hxv
      have h : x ∈ closure C ∩ frontier U ∩ (u ∩ v) := ⟨hxK, hxu, hxv⟩
      rw [hne] at h
      exact h
    have hdisj : Disjoint ((closure C ∩ frontier U) \ v) ((closure C ∩ frontier U) \ u) := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      rintro x ⟨hxK, hxv⟩ ⟨-, hxu⟩
      rcases hKuv hxK with h | h
      · exact hxu h
      · exact hxv h
    obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hK1A, hK2B, hAB⟩ :=
      SeparatedNhds.of_isCompact_isCompact (hKc.diff hv) (hKc.diff hu) hdisj
    have hKAB : closure C ∩ frontier U ⊆ A ∪ B := by
      intro x hxK
      by_cases hxv : x ∈ v
      · by_cases hxu : x ∈ u
        · exact (hnot x hxK hxu hxv).elim
        · exact Or.inr (hK2B ⟨hxK, hxu⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (hK1A ⟨hxK, hxv⟩)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδε, hδsub⟩ := hthin (A ∪ B) (hA.union hB) hKAB
    have hSsub : C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ ⊆ A ∪ B := fun x hx =>
      hδsub ⟨hx.1, show σ x ≤ δ from le_of_lt hx.2⟩
    have hmeet : ∀ W : Set M, IsOpen W → (closure C ∩ frontier U ∩ W).Nonempty →
        (C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ ∩ W).Nonempty := by
      rintro W hW ⟨p, hpK, hpW⟩
      obtain ⟨O', hO'o, hFO', hCO'⟩ := hσ0 δ hδ0
      obtain ⟨y, hyWO, hyC⟩ :=
        _root_.mem_closure_iff.1 hpK.1 (W ∩ O') (hW.inter hO'o) ⟨hpW, hFO' hpK.2⟩
      exact ⟨y, ⟨hyC, (hCO' ⟨(hCX hyC).1, hyWO.2⟩).2⟩, hyWO.1⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hpK, hpu⟩ := hKu
    have hpA : p ∈ A := hK1A ⟨hpK, fun hpv => hnot p hpK hpu hpv⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqK, hqv⟩ := hKv
    have hqB : q ∈ B := hK2B ⟨hqK, fun hqu => hnot q hqK hqu hqv⟩
    obtain ⟨z, -, hzA, hzB⟩ :=
      hpc δ hδ0 hδε A B hA hB hSsub (hmeet A hA ⟨p, hpK, hpA⟩) (hmeet B hB ⟨q, hqK, hqB⟩)
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hAB hzA hzB
  
  have hFCO : closure C ∩ frontier U ⊆ O := by
    intro x₁ hx₁
    by_contra hx₁O
    have hZc : IsClosed ({x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} ∩ frontier U) :=
      (hK₀.inter_right isClosed_frontier).isClosed
    have hcov : closure C ∩ frontier U ⊆ O ∪ ({x | x ∈ O ∧ w x ≤ t₀} ∩ frontier U)ᶜ := by
      intro x _
      by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
      · exact Or.inl hxO
      · exact Or.inr (fun hxZ => hxO hxZ.1.1)
    obtain ⟨y, hyK, hyO, hyZ⟩ := hFCpc O _ hO hZc.isOpen_compl hcov
      ⟨p₀, ⟨hp₀C, hp₀⟩, hp₀O⟩ ⟨x₁, hx₁, fun hxZ => hx₁O hxZ.1.1⟩
    apply hyZ
    refine ⟨⟨hyO, ?_⟩, hyK.2⟩
    rw [hw0 y hyO hyK.2]
    exact ht₀.le
  
  exact collar_cutoff_contradiction g U hUo N ε σ hNo hε hσs hσb hσp hWO x₀ hx₀ hthin
    O w hO hwc hw0 hwpos hws hdw hH hFCO

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (X : Set M) (hX : IsOpen X) (τ : M → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hτs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X)
    (hτr : ∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0)
    (hτb : ∀ x ∈ X, a < τ x ∧ τ x < b)
    (hτp : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → IsCompact (X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d)) :
    ∃ Θ : M → ℝ → M,
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∀ s : ℝ, a < τ x + s → τ x + s < b → Θ x s ∈ X ∧ τ (Θ x s) = τ x + s) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, Θ x 0 = x) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 p.2)
        {p : M × ℝ | p.1 ∈ X ∧ a < τ p.1 + p.2 ∧ τ p.1 + p.2 < b}

subgoal_signatures.name: collar_cutoff_contradiction
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (hUo : IsOpen U)
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x ∧ σ x < ε)
    (hσp : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d))
    (hWO : ∀ (x₀ : M) (a b : ℝ) (w : M → ℝ), x₀ ∈ U ∩ N → 0 < a → a < b → b < ε →
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, σ x ≤ a → w x < 0) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, b ≤ σ x → 0 < w x) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) →
      ∃ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ g.levelMeanCurv w x)
    (x₀ : M) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U ∩ N)
    (hthin : ∀ O : Set M, IsOpen O →
      closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ O →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < ε ∧ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ ⊆ O)
    (O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (hO : IsOpen O) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O)
    (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ frontier U → w x = 0)
    (hwpos : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∉ frontier U → 0 < w x)
    (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ frontier U))
    (hdw : ∀ x ∈ O \ frontier U, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ x ∈ O \ frontier U, g.levelMeanCurv w x < 0)
    (hFCO : closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ O) :
    False

search_metadata.last_error: Approved at the commit gate. The glue compiles and uses all three children. unstable_collar_function is an already-proved DAG edge carrying the Fischer-Colbrie-Schoen analysis. tau_flow_exists is a standard true flow-completeness statement, and its proof route is the existing compiled glue of proper_submersion_interval_trivial. The crux collar_cutoff_contradiction is true: I checked the w' = chi(sigma)(w-t)+(1-chi(sigma)) sign premises (a<=delta2, a<=delta1/4, the band minimum m0>t forces zeros into sigma<delta1/2, w'=1 identically where chi=0), and the germ w'=w-t gives regularity and H<0. Blueprint steps s3-s5 were inlined into the compiled glue, and findings.md has a Divergence entry naming where the crux went. The evidence and falsification sections are substantive.

    ejp_level_regularity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ U hU hGU hGposU hΦ hdΦ
  obtain ⟨hFxU, -, hux, hjac⟩ := hloc x hxs
  have hzero : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, Φ (F y) = 0 :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hxs) (fun y hy => (hloc y hy).2.1)
  have hev : (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]

    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hxs) (fun y hy => (hloc y hy).2.2.1)

      lap2 h w₁ x = lap2 h w₂ x := by

    have h1 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j w₁) x = pd2 i (pd2 j w₂) x := by

        filter_upwards [hw.eventuallyEq_nhds] with y hy
        show fderiv ℝ w₁ y (e2 j) = fderiv ℝ w₂ y (e2 j)
        rw [hy.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j w₁) x (e2 i) = fderiv ℝ (pd2 j w₂) x (e2 i)
      rw [hj.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k w₁ x = pd2 k w₂ x := by
      intro k
      show fderiv ℝ w₁ x (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ w₂ x (e2 k)
      rw [hw.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [lap2, h1, h2]
  
  have hlapψ := ejp_immersion_lap2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ
    (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ) U hU hGU hGsymm hGposU hΦ hdΦ hψ F s hs
    (hFs.mono hsW) (fun y hy => ⟨(hloc y hy).1, (hloc y hy).2.1, hinj y (hsW hy)⟩) x hxs
  have hamb := ejp_ambient_identity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ U hU hGU hGsymm hGposU
    hΦ hdΦ (F x) hFxU
  rw [← hux, hjac] at hamb
  have hL : lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
      (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x =
      -(ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x)) * φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) -
        φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) * lam ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) := by
    rw [hlapc _ _ _ hev, hlapψ]
    have e1 : φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ^ 2 *
        (lam ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) / φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) =
        φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) * lam ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) := by
      field_simp <;> ring
    linear_combination hamb - e1
  have hLdiv : lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
      (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x / φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) =
      -(ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x)) - lam ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) := by
    rw [hL, div_eq_iff hu0.ne']
    ring
  
  have hconf := gaussCurv2_conformal_mul (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
    (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) W hWo hh hhsymm hhpos hu hupos x hx
  beta_reduce at hconf
  
  have hgauss := gs_gauss_equation (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (chartAt E3 z).target
    (chartAt E3 z).open_target hGs hGsymm hGpos F W hWo hFs hFU hinj x hx
  
  have hΦ2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 Φ (F x) :=
    (hΦ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hFxU)).of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
  have hsff := (gs_levelset_param (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F Φ s hs x hxs (hFs.mono hsW)
    (hinj x hx) hGsymm (hGpos _ (hFU x hx)) hΦ2 (hdΦ _ hFxU) hzero).1

      gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x + ejpRic (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) := by
    rw [← hsff]
    rfl
  
  have htan : ∀ i : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hΦd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (F x) :=
      (hΦ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hFxU)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x :=
      (hFs.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hc : fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (F y)) x = (fderiv ℝ Φ (F x)).comp (fderiv ℝ F x) :=
      fderiv_comp x hΦd hFd
    have h0 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (F y)) x = 0 := by
      rw [(show (fun y => Φ (F y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) from hzero).fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_const_apply _
    have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e2 i)) (hc.symm.trans h0)
    simpa using h3

    (chartAt E3 z).open_target hGs hGsymm hGpos Φ F x (hFU x hx) (hinj x hx) (hdΦ _ hFxU) htan
  
  let Φc : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
    { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 z).symm.toPartialEquiv
      open_source := (chartAt E3 z).open_target
      open_target := (chartAt E3 z).open_source
      contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
  have hR : g.scalarCurvature ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) =
      scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (F x) :=
    scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff g Φc (F x) (hFU x hx)
  
  have hhinv : ((pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹).PosDef := (hhpos x hx).inv
  have hQv : (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹ a b *
      pd2 a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x *
      pd2 b (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x) =
      dotProduct (star (fun a : Fin 2 => pd2 a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x))
        (Matrix.mulVec (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹
          (fun a : Fin 2 => pd2 a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x)) := by
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hQnn : 0 ≤ (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
      (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹ a b *
      pd2 a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x *
      pd2 b (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x) := by
    by_cases hv0 : (fun a : Fin 2 => pd2 a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x) = 0
    · have h0 : ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x = 0 :=
        fun a => congrFun hv0 a
      simp [h0]
    · rw [hQv]
      exact (hhinv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0).le
  refine ⟨hu, hu0, hA2 x hx,
    gsMeanCurv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x ^ 2 / 2 +
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹ a b *
        pd2 a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x *
        pd2 b (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x) / φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ^ 2,
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact add_nonneg (by positivity) (div_nonneg hQnn (sq_nonneg _))
  · intro hT0
    have hH2 : 0 ≤ gsMeanCurv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
    have hQu : 0 ≤ (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹ a b *
        pd2 a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x *
        pd2 b (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x) / φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ^ 2 :=
      div_nonneg hQnn (sq_nonneg _)
    have hQu0 : (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹ a b *
        pd2 a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x *
        pd2 b (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x) / φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ^ 2
        = 0 := by linarith
    have hQ0 : (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹ a b *
        pd2 a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x *
        pd2 b (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x) = 0 := by
      rcases div_eq_zero_iff.mp hQu0 with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h (pow_ne_zero 2 hu0.ne')
    have hpd : ∀ k : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x (e2 k) = 0 := by
      intro k
      by_contra hne
      have hv0 : (fun a : Fin 2 => pd2 a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x) ≠ 0 :=
        fun h => hne (congrFun h k)
      have hp := hhinv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0
      rw [← hQv, hQ0] at hp
      exact lt_irrefl _ hp
    have hvec : ∀ w : E2, w = ∑ k : Fin 2, w k • e2 k := by
      intro w
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      apply PiLp.ext
      intro i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun w => ?_
    rw [hvec w]
    simp [map_sum, map_smul, hpd]
  · linear_combination hconf - hLdiv + hgauss + hpot - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * hR - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * htrace

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_chart_transfer
subgoal_signatures.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z).target ∧ ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ≠ 0 ∧ g.gradInner f f x = ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ∧ g.jacobiDeriv f x = ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x)

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_level_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) : (∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ejpS G Φ y) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpS G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPsi G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPot G Φ) U

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_immersion_lap2
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ u : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFW : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ U ∧ Φ (F x) = 0 ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : lap2 (pullMetric2 G F) (fun x' => u (F x')) x = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ (F x) a b * hessLoc G u a b (F x)) - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ (F x) c d * hessLoc G Φ c d (F x)) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ (F x) a * partialDeriv a u (F x)) / ejpS G Φ (F x)

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_ambient_identity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y a b * hessLoc G (ejpPsi G Φ) a b y) - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y c d * hessLoc G Φ c d y) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y a * partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y) / ejpS G Φ y + ejpPot G Φ y * ejpPsi G Φ y = -(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 2 * ejpJac G Φ y

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullMetric2 G F x i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j = pullMetric2 G F x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, (pullMetric2 G F x).PosDef) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSff G F i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsSff G F i j x = gsSff G F j i x) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSffSq G F) s ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ gsSffSq G F x)

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_gauss_equation
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 G F) x = gsAmbPlane G F x / (pullMetric2 G F x).det + (gsMeanCurv G F x ^ 2 - gsSffSq G F x) / 2

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_levelset_param
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (f : E3 → ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f (F x)) (hdf : fderiv ℝ f (F x) ≠ 0) (hzero : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f (F y) = 0) : secondFundSq G f (F x) = gsSffSq G F x ∧ (levelMeanCurvCoord G f (F x) = 0 ↔ gsMeanCurv G F x = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: jcc_scalar_trace
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)

subgoal_signatures.name: gaussCurv2_conformal_mul
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ) (s : Set E2)
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y i j) s)
    (hsymm : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h y i j = h y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ s, (h y).PosDef)

        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a u x * pd2 b u x) / (u x) ^ 2

      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ ∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, σ x = |f x|) :
    ∃ (P : EigPatchedSurface M (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2})) (pr : M → M),
      (∀ j, ∃ (z : M) (F : E2 → E3), eigSurfParam (frontier U) z (P.W j) F ∧
        (∀ x ∈ P.W j, pr (P.param j x) = (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ∧
        P.h j = pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2},
        pr '' connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) q =
          connectedComponentIn (frontier U) (pr q)

signature.name: good_collar_leaf_patched
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hFc : IsCompact (frontier U))
    (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hNc : IsCompact (closure N)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x ≠ 0)
    (hσb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x ∧ σ x < ε)
    (hσp : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d))
    (hσi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ)))
    (hσ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)
    (hgood : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ ∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, σ x = |f x|) :
    ∃ (P : EigPatchedSurface M (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2})) (pr : M → M),
      (∀ j, ∃ (z : M) (F : E2 → E3), eigSurfParam (frontier U) z (P.W j) F ∧
        (∀ x ∈ P.W j, pr (P.param j x) = (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ∧
        P.h j = pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) ∧
      ∀ q ∈ U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2},
        pr '' connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) q =
          connectedComponentIn (frontier U) (pr q)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hX : IsOpen (U ∩ N) := hUo.inter hNo
  have hLc : IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) := by
    have h := hσp (ε / 2) (ε / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    rwa [Set.Icc_self] at h
  have hLX : U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2} ⊆ U ∩ N := Set.inter_subset_left
  
  obtain ⟨PF, hPF, -⟩ := eig_patched_atlas g (frontier U) hFc
    (fun p hp => eig_graph_chart_exists g (frontier U) hfront p hp)
  
  obtain ⟨Ng, hNg1, hNg2, hNg3⟩ := normalized_gradient_operator g
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘX, hΘ0, hΘadd, hΘc⟩ :=
    collar_global_flow g (U ∩ N) hX σ 0 ε hσs hσr hσb hσp
  obtain ⟨A, prn, hAo, hFA, hprnc, hprnF, hloc⟩ :=
    near_frontier_projection U hUo N σ hNo hFN hσs hσr (fun x hx => (hσb x hx).1) hgood
      Ng hNg1 hNg2 hNg3
  
  have hthin0 : ∀ O : Set M, IsOpen O → frontier U ⊆ O →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < ε ∧ U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ ⊆ O := by
    intro O hOo hFO
    by_contra hcon
    have hbad : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → ∃ x, x ∈ U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ ∧ x ∉ O := by
      intro δ h1 h2
      by_contra h3
      apply hcon
      refine ⟨δ, h1, h2, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxO
      exact h3 ⟨x, hx, hxO⟩
    let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2)
    have hd0 : ∀ n, 0 < d n := fun n => div_pos hε (by positivity)
    have hdlt : ∀ n, d n < ε := fun n =>
      div_lt_self hε (by have := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n; linarith)
    have hmono : ∀ n, d (n + 1) ≤ d n := by
      intro n
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hε.le (by positivity)
      push_cast
      linarith
    let t : ℕ → Set M := fun n => (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic (d n))) ∩ Oᶜ
    have htdec : ∀ n, t (n + 1) ⊆ t n := by
      intro n x hx
      refine ⟨?_, hx.2⟩
      rcases hx.1 with h | ⟨hxUN, hxle⟩
      · exact Or.inl h
      · right
        refine ⟨hxUN, ?_⟩
        show σ x ≤ d n
        exact le_trans hxle (hmono n)
    have htne : ∀ n, (t n).Nonempty := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxO⟩ := hbad (d n) (hd0 n) (hdlt n)
      exact ⟨x, Or.inr hx, hxO⟩
    have htcl : ∀ n, IsClosed (t n) := fun n =>
      (hσi (d n) (hd0 n) (hdlt n)).inter hOo.isClosed_compl
    have htc : IsCompact (t 0) := by
      refine hNc.of_isClosed_subset (htcl 0) ?_
      intro x hx
      rcases hx.1 with h | h
      · exact subset_closure (hFN h)
      · exact subset_closure h.1.2
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
      IsCompact.nonempty_iInter_of_sequence_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed t htdec htne htc htcl
    rw [Set.mem_iInter] at hx
    have hxn : ∀ n, x ∈ U ∩ N ∧ σ x ≤ d n := by
      intro n
      have h := hx n
      rcases h.1 with h1 | h1
      · exact absurd (hFO h1) h.2
      · exact ⟨h1.1, h1.2⟩
    have hfx : 0 < σ x := (hσb x (hxn 0).1).1
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (ε / σ x)
    have h1 : ε < (n : ℝ) * σ x := (div_lt_iff₀ hfx).mp hn
    have h2 : d n < σ x := by
      show ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2) < σ x
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    have h3 := (hxn n).2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδε, hδsub⟩ := hthin0 A hAo hFA
  have hthin : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, σ x ≤ δ → x ∈ A := fun x hx hle => hδsub ⟨hx, hle⟩
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : M → M, ∀ x, Φ x = Θ x (δ - σ x) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr⟩ : ∃ pr : M → M, ∀ x, pr x = prn (Φ x) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  
  have hΦX : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, Φ x ∈ A ∩ U ∩ N ∧ σ (Φ x) = δ := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hΘX x hx (δ - σ x) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    rw [← hΦ x] at h1
    have hσΦ : σ (Φ x) = δ := by rw [h1.2]; ring
    have hA : Φ x ∈ A := hthin (Φ x) h1.1 (le_of_eq hσΦ)
    exact ⟨⟨⟨hA, h1.1.1⟩, h1.1.2⟩, hσΦ⟩
  
  have hΦc : ContinuousOn Φ (U ∩ N) := by
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun x : M => (x, δ - σ x)) (U ∩ N) :=
      continuousOn_id.prodMk (continuousOn_const.sub hσs.continuousOn)
    have h2 := hΘc.comp h1 (fun x hx => by
      show x ∈ U ∩ N ∧ 0 < σ x + (δ - σ x) ∧ σ x + (δ - σ x) < ε
      exact ⟨hx, by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    exact h2.congr (fun x _ => hΦ x)
  have hprc : ContinuousOn pr (U ∩ N) := by
    have h := hprnc.comp hΦc (fun x hx => (hΦX x hx).1)
    exact h.congr (fun x _ => hpr x)
  
  have hprF : ∀ w ∈ U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}, pr w ∈ frontier U := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hpr w]
    exact hprnF (Φ w) (hΦX w (hLX hw)).1
  
  have hsec : ∀ w ∈ U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}, ∃ (A' Ω : Set M) (s : M → M), IsOpen A' ∧ w ∈ A' ∧
      IsOpen Ω ∧ ContinuousOn s (Ω ∩ frontier U) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Ω ∩ frontier U, s y ∈ A' ∩ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) ∧ pr (s y) = y) ∧
      ∀ w' ∈ A' ∩ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}), pr w' ∈ Ω ∧ s (pr w') = w' := by
    intro w hw
    have hwX : w ∈ U ∩ N := hw.1
    obtain ⟨hyA, hyσ⟩ := hΦX w hwX
    obtain ⟨B, Ω, sec, hBo, hyB, hΩo, hsecc, hsec1, hsec2⟩ := hloc (Φ w) hyA
    refine ⟨U ∩ N ∩ Φ ⁻¹' B, Ω, fun y' => Θ (sec y') (ε / 2 - δ),
      hΦc.isOpen_inter_preimage hX hBo, ⟨hwX, hyB⟩, hΩo, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y' : M => (sec y', ε / 2 - δ)) (Ω ∩ frontier U) :=
        hsecc.prodMk continuousOn_const
      refine hΘc.comp h1 (fun y' hy' => ?_)
      obtain ⟨hx', hx'σ, -⟩ := hsec1 y' hy'
      show sec y' ∈ U ∩ N ∧ 0 < σ (sec y') + (ε / 2 - δ) ∧ σ (sec y') + (ε / 2 - δ) < ε
      rw [hx'σ, hyσ]
      exact ⟨⟨hx'.1.2, hx'.2⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · intro y' hy'
      obtain ⟨hx', hx'σ, hx'pr⟩ := hsec1 y' hy'
      have hx'X : sec y' ∈ U ∩ N := ⟨hx'.1.2, hx'.2⟩
      have hσx' : σ (sec y') = δ := by rw [hx'σ, hyσ]
      have h1 := hΘX (sec y') hx'X (ε / 2 - δ) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hσs' : σ (Θ (sec y') (ε / 2 - δ)) = ε / 2 := by rw [h1.2, hσx']; ring
      have hΦs : Φ (Θ (sec y') (ε / 2 - δ)) = sec y' := by
        rw [hΦ, hσs']
        rw [hΘadd (sec y') hx'X (ε / 2 - δ) (δ - ε / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
          (by linarith) (by linarith)]
        rw [show ε / 2 - δ + (δ - ε / 2) = 0 by ring, hΘ0 (sec y') hx'X]
      refine ⟨⟨⟨h1.1, ?_⟩, h1.1, hσs'⟩, ?_⟩
      · show Φ (Θ (sec y') (ε / 2 - δ)) ∈ B
        rw [hΦs]
        exact hx'.1.1.1
      · show pr (Θ (sec y') (ε / 2 - δ)) = y'
        rw [hpr, hΦs, hx'pr]
    · intro w' hw'
      obtain ⟨⟨hw'X, hw'B⟩, -, hw'σ⟩ := hw'
      have hw'σ' : σ w' = ε / 2 := hw'σ
      obtain ⟨hΦw'A, hΦw'σ⟩ := hΦX w' hw'X
      have hmem : Φ w' ∈ B ∩ A ∩ U ∩ N := ⟨⟨⟨hw'B, hΦw'A.1.1⟩, hΦw'A.1.2⟩, hΦw'A.2⟩
      obtain ⟨hΩ, hsecpr⟩ := hsec2 (Φ w') hmem (by rw [hΦw'σ, hyσ])
      refine ⟨by rw [hpr]; exact hΩ, ?_⟩
      show Θ (sec (pr w')) (ε / 2 - δ) = w'
      rw [hpr, hsecpr, hΦ, hw'σ']
      rw [hΘadd w' hw'X (δ - ε / 2) (ε / 2 - δ) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        (by linarith) (by linarith)]
      rw [show δ - ε / 2 + (ε / 2 - δ) = 0 by ring, hΘ0 w' hw'X]
  
  have hcomp_nhds : ∀ (S : Set M) (P : EigPatchedSurface M S) (q : M), q ∈ S →
      ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ q ∈ O ∧ O ∩ S ⊆ connectedComponentIn S q := by
    intro S P q hq
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hq)
    have hmem : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hj, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hqx⟩ := hmem
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (P.W_open j) x₀ hx₀
    have hpc : IsPreconnected (P.param j '' Metric.ball x₀ r) :=
      (convex_ball x₀ r).isPreconnected.image _ ((P.param_cont j).mono hball)
    have hsubS : P.param j '' Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ S := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      have h : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hball hx, rfl⟩
      rw [P.image_eq j] at h
      exact h.2
    have hsubC : P.param j '' Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ connectedComponentIn S q :=
      hpc.subset_connectedComponentIn ⟨x₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr, hqx⟩ hsubS
    refine ⟨P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r,
      (P.proj_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open j) Metric.isOpen_ball, ⟨hj, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show P.proj j q ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r
      rw [← hqx, P.proj_param j x₀ hx₀]
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr
    · rintro w ⟨⟨hwO, hwB⟩, hwS⟩
      have hw : w ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hwO, hwS⟩
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hw
      apply hsubC
      refine ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩
      have h : P.proj j (P.param j x) ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r := hwB
      rwa [P.proj_param j x hx] at h
  
  obtain ⟨Q, κ, hQ⟩ := patched_surface_pullback (frontier U) (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) PF hLc
    (U ∩ N) hX hLX pr hprc hprF hsec
  refine ⟨Q, pr, fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨hWsub, hheq, hKI⟩ := hQ j
    obtain ⟨z, Fk, hFk, hparam, hh⟩ := hPF (κ j)
    refine ⟨z, Fk, ⟨Q.W_open j, hFk.2.1.mono hWsub, fun x hx => hFk.2.2 x (hWsub hx)⟩,
      fun x hx => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hKI x hx, hparam]
    · rw [hheq, hh]
  · exact local_section_component_image (frontier U) (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) hLc pr
      (hprc.mono hLX) hprF
      (fun q hq => hcomp_nhds (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {ε / 2}) Q q hq) hsec

subgoal_signatures.name: normalized_gradient_operator
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) :
    ∃ Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x,
      (∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), Ng x (-ℓ) = -Ng x ℓ) ∧
      (∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ℓ (Ng x ℓ) = 1) ∧
      ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
        (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
        ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
          (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_graph_chart_exists
subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig : Set M) (hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) (p : M) (hp : p ∈ Sig) : ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), eigGraphChart Sig p a u r δ

subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Sig : Set M) (hSc : IsCompact Sig) (hgraph : ∀ p ∈ Sig, ∃ (a : Fin 3) (u : E3 → ℝ) (r δ : ℝ), eigGraphChart Sig p a u r δ) : ∃ P : EigPatchedSurface M Sig, (∀ j, ∃ (z : M) (F : E2 → E3), eigSurfParam Sig z (P.W j) F ∧ P.param j = (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ∧ P.h j = pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) ∧ ∀ w : M → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) → eigSmoothAlong Sig w

subgoal_signatures.name: collar_global_flow
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (X : Set M) (hX : IsOpen X) (τ : M → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hτs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X)
    (hτr : ∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0)
    (hτb : ∀ x ∈ X, a < τ x ∧ τ x < b)
    (hτp : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → IsCompact (X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d)) :
    ∃ Θ : M → ℝ → M,
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∀ s : ℝ, a < τ x + s → τ x + s < b → Θ x s ∈ X ∧ τ (Θ x s) = τ x + s) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, Θ x 0 = x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∀ s s' : ℝ, a < τ x + s → τ x + s < b → a < τ x + s + s' →
        τ x + s + s' < b → Θ (Θ x s) s' = Θ x (s + s')) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 p.2)
        {p : M × ℝ | p.1 ∈ X ∧ a < τ p.1 + p.2 ∧ τ p.1 + p.2 < b}

subgoal_signatures.name: near_frontier_projection
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (U : Set M) (hUo : IsOpen U) (N : Set M) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N)
    (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x ≠ 0)
    (hσpos : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x)
    (hgood : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ ∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, σ x = |f x|)
    (Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hNg1 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), Ng x (-ℓ) = -Ng x ℓ)
    (hNg2 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ℓ (Ng x ℓ) = 1)
    (hNg3 : ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
        (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
        ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
          (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x) :
    ∃ (A : Set M) (prn : M → M), IsOpen A ∧ frontier U ⊆ A ∧
      ContinuousOn prn (A ∩ U ∩ N) ∧ (∀ y ∈ A ∩ U ∩ N, prn y ∈ frontier U) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ A ∩ U ∩ N, ∃ (B Ω : Set M) (sec : M → M), IsOpen B ∧ y ∈ B ∧ IsOpen Ω ∧
        ContinuousOn sec (Ω ∩ frontier U) ∧
        (∀ y' ∈ Ω ∩ frontier U, sec y' ∈ B ∩ A ∩ U ∩ N ∧ σ (sec y') = σ y ∧ prn (sec y') = y') ∧

Blueprint sections 4-5 are concrete, and nothing restates §10 or an ancestor. Notes for the children are in findings.md.

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (U : Set M)
    (hUo : IsOpen U) (hFc : IsCompact (frontier U)) (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (hnone : ∀ S : Set M, IsCompact S → IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S → S ⊆ U → S = ∅)
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hNc : IsCompact (closure N)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x ≠ 0)
    (hσb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x ∧ σ x < ε)
    (hσp : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d))
    (hσi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ)))
    (hσ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)
    (hgood : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ ∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, σ x = |f x|)
    (hWO : ∀ (x₀ : M) (a b : ℝ) (w : M → ℝ), x₀ ∈ U ∩ N → 0 < a → a < b → b < ε →
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, σ x ≤ a → w x < 0) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, b ≤ σ x → 0 < w x) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) →
      ∃ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ g.levelMeanCurv w x)
    (φ lam : M → ℝ)
    (hlam : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ q ∈ V, q ∈ frontier U → lam q = lam p)
    (hdata : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, 0 < φ p ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
        V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ V ∩ frontier U, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧
          g.jacobiDeriv f x = lam x / φ x)
    (p₀ : M) (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ frontier U)
    (hdeg : ∀ q ∈ connectedComponentIn (frontier U) p₀, lam q = 0 ∧ g.scalarCurvature q = 0 ∧
      ∃ (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2), eigSurfParam (frontier U) z W F ∧ x ∈ W ∧
        (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) = q ∧ gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x = 0 ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x = 0) :
    False
