proof.tactics:
by
  have hX : IsOpen (U ∩ N) := hUo.inter hNo
  have hFU : ∀ x ∈ frontier U, x ∉ U := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hUo.frontier_eq] at hx
    exact hx.2
  
  obtain ⟨V, f, hVN, hVo, hp₀V, -, -, hVS, -, hP, hNg⟩ :=
    hfront.2 p₀ hp₀ N (hNo.mem_nhds (hFN hp₀))
  have hf0 : ∀ x ∈ V, x ∈ U → f x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hxV hxU hfx
    have h : x ∈ V ∩ frontier U := by
      rw [hVS]
      exact ⟨hxV, hfx⟩
    exact hFU x h.2 hxU
  have hside : ∀ S : Set M, S ⊆ V → (∀ x ∈ S, f x ≠ 0) → IsPreconnected S →
      ∀ x₁ ∈ S, x₁ ∈ U → S ⊆ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₁ := by
    intro S hSV hSf hSc x₁ hx₁S hx₁U
    have hcov : S ⊆ U ∪ (closure U)ᶜ := by
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxU : x ∈ U
      · exact Or.inl hxU
      · right
        intro hxc
        have hxF : x ∈ frontier U := by
          rw [hUo.frontier_eq]
          exact ⟨hxc, hxU⟩
        have h : x ∈ V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := by
          rw [← hVS]
          exact ⟨hSV hx, hxF⟩
        exact hSf x hx h.2
    have hdisj : Disjoint U (closure U)ᶜ :=
      Disjoint.mono_left subset_closure disjoint_compl_right
    have hSU : S ⊆ U :=
      IsPreconnected.subset_left_of_subset_union hUo isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl hdisj hcov
        ⟨x₁, hx₁S, hx₁U⟩ hSc
    exact hSc.subset_connectedComponentIn hx₁S (fun x hx => ⟨hSU hx, hVN (hSV hx)⟩)
  have hp₀cl : p₀ ∈ closure (V ∩ U) := by
    rw [_root_.mem_closure_iff]
    intro W hW hp₀W
    have h1 : p₀ ∈ closure U := frontier_subset_closure hp₀
    obtain ⟨y, hyWV, hyU⟩ := _root_.mem_closure_iff.1 h1 (W ∩ V) (hW.inter hVo) ⟨hp₀W, hp₀V⟩
    exact ⟨y, hyWV.1, hyWV.2, hyU⟩
  have hVU : V ∩ U = (V ∩ U ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∪ (V ∩ U ∩ {x | f x < 0}) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxV, hxU⟩
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hf0 x hxV hxU) with h | h
      · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨hxV, hxU⟩, h⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨hxV, hxU⟩, h⟩
    · rintro (⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩) <;> exact h
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hp₀C⟩ :
      ∃ x₀ ∈ U ∩ N, p₀ ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) := by
    rw [hVU, closure_union] at hp₀cl
    rcases hp₀cl with h | h
    · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ : (V ∩ U ∩ {x | 0 < f x}).Nonempty := by
        by_contra hne
        rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
        rw [hne, closure_empty] at h
        exact h
      refine ⟨x₀, ⟨hx₀.1.2, hVN hx₀.1.1⟩, closure_mono ?_ h⟩
      intro y hy
      exact hside (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) Set.inter_subset_left (fun x hx => ne_of_gt hx.2) hP
        x₀ ⟨hx₀.1.1, hx₀.2⟩ hx₀.1.2 ⟨hy.1.1, hy.2⟩
    · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ : (V ∩ U ∩ {x | f x < 0}).Nonempty := by
        by_contra hne
        rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
        rw [hne, closure_empty] at h
        exact h
      refine ⟨x₀, ⟨hx₀.1.2, hVN hx₀.1.1⟩, closure_mono ?_ h⟩
      intro y hy
      exact hside (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) Set.inter_subset_left (fun x hx => ne_of_lt hx.2) hNg
        x₀ ⟨hx₀.1.1, hx₀.2⟩ hx₀.1.2 ⟨hy.1.1, hy.2⟩
  set C := connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ with hCdef
  have hCX : C ⊆ U ∩ N := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _
  have hCN : C ⊆ N := fun x hx => (hCX hx).2
  have hσc : ContinuousOn σ (U ∩ N) := hσs.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘX, hΘ0, hΘc⟩ := tau_flow_exists g (U ∩ N) hX σ 0 ε hσs hσr hσb hσp
  have hpc : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsPreconnected (C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ) := by
    intro δ _ hδ
    rcases (C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hS | ⟨y₀, hy₀C, hy₀δ⟩
    · rw [hS]
      exact isPreconnected_empty
    have hD : IsPreconnected (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) :=
      isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.prod isPreconnected_Ioo
    have hιc : ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => (p.1, p.2 - σ p.1)) (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) := by
      refine continuousOn_fst.prodMk (continuousOn_snd.sub ?_)
      exact hσc.comp continuousOn_fst (fun p hp => hCX hp.1)
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : M × ℝ => (p.1, p.2 - σ p.1)) (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ)
        {p : M × ℝ | p.1 ∈ U ∩ N ∧ 0 < σ p.1 + p.2 ∧ σ p.1 + p.2 < ε} := by
      intro p hp
      refine ⟨hCX hp.1, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show 0 < σ p.1 + (p.2 - σ p.1)
        linarith [hp.2.1]
      · show σ p.1 + (p.2 - σ p.1) < ε
        linarith [hp.2.2]
    have hψc : ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) :=
      hΘc.comp hιc hmaps
    have himg := hD.image _ hψc
    have hψX : ∀ p ∈ C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ,
        Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1) ∈ U ∩ N ∧ σ (Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) = p.2 := by
      intro p hp
      have h := hΘX p.1 (hCX hp.1) (p.2 - σ p.1) (by linarith [hp.2.1]) (by linarith [hp.2.2])
      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
      rw [h.2]
      ring
    have hback : ∀ y ∈ C, Θ y (σ y - σ y) = y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [sub_self]
      exact hΘ0 y (hCX hy)
    have hy₀img : y₀ ∈ (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) '' (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) :=
      ⟨(y₀, σ y₀), ⟨hy₀C, (hσb y₀ (hCX hy₀C)).1, hy₀δ⟩, hback y₀ hy₀C⟩
    have himgC : (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) '' (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) ⊆ C := by
      have h1 := himg.subset_connectedComponentIn hy₀img
        (by
          rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
          exact (hψX p hp).1)
      rw [← connectedComponentIn_eq hy₀C] at h1
      exact h1
    have heq : (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) '' (C ×ˢ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ) =
        C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · rintro _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨himgC ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        show σ (Θ p.1 (p.2 - σ p.1)) < δ
        rw [(hψX p hp).2]
        exact hp.2.2
      · rintro y ⟨hyC, hyδ⟩
        exact ⟨(y, σ y), ⟨hyC, (hσb y (hCX hyC)).1, hyδ⟩, hback y hyC⟩
    rw [← heq]
    exact himg
  have hthin : ∀ O' : Set M, IsOpen O' → closure C ∩ frontier U ⊆ O' →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < ε ∧ C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ ⊆ O' := by
    intro O' hO' hFO'
    have hδpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := fun n => div_pos hε (by positivity)
    have hδlt : ∀ n : ℕ, ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2) < ε := by
      intro n
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := n.cast_nonneg
      nlinarith
    have hδanti : ∀ m n : ℕ, m ≤ n → ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2) ≤ ε / ((m : ℝ) + 2) := by
      intro m n hmn
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hε.le (by positivity)
      have : (m : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_le.mpr hmn
      linarith
    let T : ℕ → Set M := fun n => closure (C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic (ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2))) \ O'
    have hTc : ∀ n, IsClosed (T n) := fun n => isClosed_closure.sdiff hO'
    have hTanti : Antitone T := by
      intro m n hmn
      apply Set.diff_subset_diff_left
      apply closure_mono
      intro x hx
      exact ⟨hx.1, le_trans hx.2 (hδanti m n hmn)⟩
    have hdir : Directed (· ⊇ ·) T := hTanti.directed_ge
    have hcl : ∀ n : ℕ, closure (C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic (ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2))) ⊆
        frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic (ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2))) := by
      intro n
      apply (hσi _ (hδpos n) (hδlt n)).closure_subset_iff.2
      intro x hx
      exact Or.inr ⟨hCX hx.1, hx.2⟩
    have hempty : closure N ∩ ⋂ n, T n = ∅ := by
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
      rintro x ⟨-, hx⟩
      rw [Set.mem_iInter] at hx
      have hxO : x ∉ O' := (hx 0).2
      have hxC : x ∈ closure C := closure_mono Set.inter_subset_left (hx 0).1
      by_cases hxF : x ∈ frontier U
      · exact hxO (hFO' ⟨hxC, hxF⟩)
      · have hall : ∀ n : ℕ, x ∈ U ∩ N ∧ σ x ≤ ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by
          intro n
          rcases hcl n (hx n).1 with h | h
          · exact absurd h hxF
          · exact ⟨h.1, h.2⟩
        have hpos := (hσb x (hall 0).1).1
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (ε / σ x)
        have h1 := (hall n).2
        have h2 : ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2) < σ x := by
          rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          rw [div_lt_iff₀ hpos] at hn
          nlinarith
        exact absurd h1 (not_le.2 h2)
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hNc.elim_directed_family_closed T hTc hempty hdir
    refine ⟨ε / ((n : ℝ) + 2), hδpos n, hδlt n, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxO
    have hxT : x ∈ T n := ⟨subset_closure hx, hxO⟩
    have hxN : x ∈ closure N := subset_closure (hCN hx.1)
    have h : x ∈ closure N ∩ T n := ⟨hxN, hxT⟩
    rw [hn] at h
    exact h
  have hFCpc : IsPreconnected (closure C ∩ frontier U) := by
    intro u v hu hv hKuv hKu hKv
    by_contra hne
    rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
    have hKc : IsCompact (closure C ∩ frontier U) := hFc.inter_left isClosed_closure
    have hnot : ∀ x ∈ closure C ∩ frontier U, x ∈ u → x ∈ v → False := by
      intro x hxK hxu hxv
      have h : x ∈ closure C ∩ frontier U ∩ (u ∩ v) := ⟨hxK, hxu, hxv⟩
      rw [hne] at h
      exact h
    have hdisj : Disjoint ((closure C ∩ frontier U) \ v) ((closure C ∩ frontier U) \ u) := by
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      rintro x ⟨hxK, hxv⟩ ⟨-, hxu⟩
      rcases hKuv hxK with h | h
      · exact hxu h
      · exact hxv h
    obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hK1A, hK2B, hAB⟩ :=
      SeparatedNhds.of_isCompact_isCompact (hKc.diff hv) (hKc.diff hu) hdisj
    have hKAB : closure C ∩ frontier U ⊆ A ∪ B := by
      intro x hxK
      by_cases hxv : x ∈ v
      · by_cases hxu : x ∈ u
        · exact (hnot x hxK hxu hxv).elim
        · exact Or.inr (hK2B ⟨hxK, hxu⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (hK1A ⟨hxK, hxv⟩)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδε, hδsub⟩ := hthin (A ∪ B) (hA.union hB) hKAB
    have hSsub : C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ ⊆ A ∪ B := fun x hx =>
      hδsub ⟨hx.1, show σ x ≤ δ from le_of_lt hx.2⟩
    have hmeet : ∀ W : Set M, IsOpen W → (closure C ∩ frontier U ∩ W).Nonempty →
        (C ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ ∩ W).Nonempty := by
      rintro W hW ⟨p, hpK, hpW⟩
      obtain ⟨O', hO'o, hFO', hCO'⟩ := hσ0 δ hδ0
      obtain ⟨y, hyWO, hyC⟩ :=
        _root_.mem_closure_iff.1 hpK.1 (W ∩ O') (hW.inter hO'o) ⟨hpW, hFO' hpK.2⟩
      exact ⟨y, ⟨hyC, (hCO' ⟨(hCX hyC).1, hyWO.2⟩).2⟩, hyWO.1⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hpK, hpu⟩ := hKu
    have hpA : p ∈ A := hK1A ⟨hpK, fun hpv => hnot p hpK hpu hpv⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqK, hqv⟩ := hKv
    have hqB : q ∈ B := hK2B ⟨hqK, fun hqu => hnot q hqK hqu hqv⟩
    obtain ⟨z, -, hzA, hzB⟩ :=
      hpc δ hδ0 hδε A B hA hB hSsub (hmeet A hA ⟨p, hpK, hpA⟩) (hmeet B hB ⟨q, hqK, hqB⟩)
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hAB hzA hzB
  
  haveI : LocallyConnectedSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyConnectedSpace E3 M
  have hCo : IsOpen C := hX.connectedComponentIn
  have hx₀C : x₀ ∈ C := mem_connectedComponentIn hx₀
  have hFCS : closure C ∩ frontier U ⊆ connectedComponentIn (frontier U) p₀ :=
    hFCpc.subset_connectedComponentIn ⟨hp₀C, hp₀⟩ Set.inter_subset_right
  have hlamC : ∀ q ∈ closure C ∩ frontier U, lam q = 0 := fun q hq => (hdeg q (hFCS hq)).1
  have hCcl : ∀ y ∈ closure C, y ∈ U ∩ N → y ∈ C := by
    intro y hyc hyX
    have hpre : IsPreconnected (insert y C) :=
      isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.subset_closure (Set.subset_insert y C)
        (Set.insert_subset hyc subset_closure)
    have hsub : insert y C ⊆ U ∩ N := Set.insert_subset hyX hCX
    exact hpre.subset_connectedComponentIn (Set.mem_insert_of_mem y hx₀C) hsub
      (Set.mem_insert y C)
  
  obtain ⟨O, w, hcm, t₀, S, P, z, Y, hO, hON, hFCO, ht₀, hwc, hw0, hwpos, hK, hws, hdw, hH,
    hsurj, hcm0, hcmc, hcmd, hSc, hSne, hYs, hhs, hYt, hY0, hYt', hcomp⟩ :=
    degenerate_cmc_foliation g U hUo hFc hfront N ε σ hNo hFN hNc hε hσs hσr hσb hσp hσi hσ0
      hgood φ lam hlam hdata x₀ p₀ hx₀ ⟨hp₀C, hp₀⟩ hthin hFCpc hlamC
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, Kc, hρnn, hρs, hρ1, hKc, hρK, hρO⟩ :=
    eig_partition_unity S hSc P (fun k ζ hζ hc hs => eig_lift_smooth S P k ζ hζ hc hs)
  
  have h0mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₀) t₀ := ⟨by linarith, ht₀⟩
  have hYts : ∀ j, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₀) t₀, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Y j t) (P.W j) := by
    intro j t ht
    have hm : Set.MapsTo (fun x : E2 => (t, x)) (P.W j) (Set.Ioo (-t₀) t₀ ×ˢ P.W j) :=
      fun x hx => ⟨ht, hx⟩
    exact (hYs j).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffOn hm
  have hpd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₀) t₀, ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z j)).symm) (Y j t) x).PosDef := by
    intro t ht j x hx
    exact (gs_regularity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z j)).symm) (chartAt E3 (z j)).target
      (chartAt E3 (z j)).open_target (fun a b => g.smooth (z j) a b)
      (fun y a b => g.symm _ _ _) (fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g (z j) y hy)
      (Y j t) (P.W j) (P.W_open j) (hYts j t ht) (fun x hx => (hYt j t ht x hx).1)
      (fun x hx => (hYt j t ht x hx).2)).2.2.1 x hx
  have hms : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₀) t₀, ∀ j (a b : Fin 2),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z j)).symm) (Y j t) x a b)
        (P.W j) := by
    intro t ht j a b
    have hm : Set.MapsTo (fun x : E2 => (t, x)) (P.W j) (Set.Ioo (-t₀) t₀ ×ˢ P.W j) :=
      fun x hx => ⟨ht, hx⟩
    exact (hhs j a b).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffOn hm
  
  have hTC := patched_family_total_curvature_const S hSc P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hρ1 hKc hρK hρO
    (-t₀) t₀ (fun t j => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z j)).symm) (Y j t))
    (fun j c d => hhs j c d) hpd (fun t ht j k x hx c d => (hcomp t ht j k x hx).2 c d)
  have hflat : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z j)).symm) (Y j 0)) x = 0 := by
    intro j
    exact degenerate_component_flat g U hUo hfront φ lam hdata p₀ hp₀ hdeg (z j) (P.W j) (Y j 0)
      ⟨P.W_open j, hYts j 0 h0mem,
        fun x hx => ⟨(hYt j 0 h0mem x hx).1, (hY0 j x hx).2, (hYt j 0 h0mem x hx).2⟩⟩
      (fun x hx => hFCS (hY0 j x hx))
  have hTC0 : (∑ j, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) *
      gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z j)).symm) (Y j 0)) x *
        Real.sqrt (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z j)).symm) (Y j 0) x).det) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    rw [hflat j x hx]
    ring
  
  have hQo : IsOpen (O ∩ C ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Iio t₀) :=
    hws.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (hO.inter hCo) isOpen_Iio
  have hne : ∃ j, ∃ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < ρ j (P.param j x) := by
    obtain ⟨q, hqS⟩ := hSne
    have h1 := hρ1 q hqS
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, 0 < ρ j q := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have : ∑ j, ρ j q ≤ 0 := Finset.sum_nonpos (fun j _ => hcon j)
      linarith
    have hqO : q ∈ P.O j := by
      by_contra hq
      rw [hρO j q hq] at hj
      exact lt_irrefl _ hj
    have hqim : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
      rw [P.image_eq j]
      exact ⟨hqO, hqS⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hqim
    exact ⟨j, x, hx, hj⟩
  have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₀, deriv hcm t ≤ 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have ht' : t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₀) t₀ := ⟨by linarith [ht.1], ht.2⟩
    have htot : eigWInt (P.withMetric
        (fun j => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z j)).symm) (Y j t)) (hms t ht') (hpd t ht')
        (fun j k x hx a b => (hcomp t ht' j k x hx).2 a b)) ρ
        (fun j x => gaussCurv2 ((P.withMetric
          (fun j => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z j)).symm) (Y j t)) (hms t ht')
          (hpd t ht') (fun j k x hx a b => (hcomp t ht' j k x hx).2 a b)).h j) x) ≤ 0 :=
      le_of_eq ((hTC t ht' 0 h0mem).trans hTC0)
    exact cmc_leaf_monotone g hR S (P.withMetric
        (fun j => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z j)).symm) (Y j t)) (hms t ht') (hpd t ht')
        (fun j k x hx a b => (hcomp t ht' j k x hx).2 a b))
      ρ Kc hρnn hρs hρ1 hKc hρK hρO hne z (fun j => Y j t)
      (fun j => hYts j t ht') (fun j x hx => hYt j t ht' x hx) (fun j => rfl)
      (fun j k x hx => (hcomp t ht' j k x hx).1) (O ∩ C ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Iio t₀) hQo w
      (hws.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun x hx => hdw x hx.1) hcm
      (fun x hx => hH x hx.1 hx.2) t
      (fun j x hx => ⟨⟨(hYt' j t ht x hx).1,
        show w _ < t₀ by rw [(hYt' j t ht x hx).2]; exact ht.2⟩, (hYt' j t ht x hx).2⟩)
      (hcmd.differentiableAt (Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2)) htot
  
  have hanti : AntitoneOn hcm (Set.Ico 0 t₀) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Ico 0 t₀) hcmc
    · rw [interior_Ico]
      exact hcmd
    · intro x hx
      rw [interior_Ico] at hx
      exact hderiv x hx
  have hle : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₀, hcm t ≤ 0 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [← hcm0]
    exact hanti ⟨le_refl 0, ht₀⟩ ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩ ht.1.le
  
  by_cases hz : ∃ t₁ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₀, hcm t₁ = 0
  · obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, hcm1⟩ := hz
    have hKcl : IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∩ closure C ∧ w x ≤ t₀} := hK.isClosed
    have hwK : ContinuousOn w {x | x ∈ O ∩ closure C ∧ w x ≤ t₀} :=
      hwc.mono (fun x hx => hx.1)
    have hS₁eq : {x | x ∈ O ∩ closure C ∧ w x = t₁} =
        {x | x ∈ O ∩ closure C ∧ w x ≤ t₀} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t₁} := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hx, hwx⟩
        exact ⟨⟨hx, by rw [hwx]; exact ht₁.2.le⟩, hwx⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨hx, -⟩, hwx⟩
        exact ⟨hx, hwx⟩
    have hS₁c : IsClosed {x | x ∈ O ∩ closure C ∧ w x = t₁} := by
      rw [hS₁eq]
      exact hwK.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hKcl isClosed_singleton
    have hS₁k : IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∩ closure C ∧ w x = t₁} := by
      refine hK.of_isClosed_subset hS₁c ?_
      rintro x ⟨hx, hwx⟩
      exact ⟨hx, by rw [hwx]; exact ht₁.2.le⟩
    have hS₁Q : {x | x ∈ O ∩ closure C ∧ w x = t₁} ⊆ O ∩ C := by
      rintro x ⟨⟨hxO, hxc⟩, hwx⟩
      have hxF : x ∉ frontier U := by
        intro hxF
        have := hw0 x ⟨hxO, hxc⟩ hxF
        rw [hwx] at this
        exact (ne_of_gt ht₁.1) this
      have hxU : x ∈ U := by
        have hxcU : x ∈ closure U := closure_mono (fun y hy => (hCX hy).1) hxc
        by_contra hxU
        apply hxF
        rw [hUo.frontier_eq]
        exact ⟨hxcU, hxU⟩
      exact ⟨hxO, hCcl x hxc ⟨hxU, hON hxO⟩⟩
    have hmin : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g {x | x ∈ O ∩ closure C ∧ w x = t₁} := by
      refine regular_level_isMinimalSurfaceSet g (O ∩ C) (hO.inter hCo) w hws t₁ _ hS₁c hS₁Q
        ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro x hx
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨-, hwx⟩
          exact hwx
        · intro hwx
          exact ⟨⟨hx.1, subset_closure hx.2⟩, hwx⟩
      · intro x hx
        exact hdw x (hS₁Q hx)
      · intro x hx
        rw [hH x (hS₁Q hx) (by rw [hx.2]; exact ht₁.2), hx.2, hcm1]
    have hempty := hnone _ hS₁k hmin (fun x hx => (hCX (hS₁Q hx).2).1)
    obtain ⟨x, hxOC, hwx⟩ := hsurj t₁ ht₁
    have hx : x ∈ {x | x ∈ O ∩ closure C ∧ w x = t₁} := ⟨⟨hxOC.1, subset_closure hxOC.2⟩, hwx⟩
    rw [hempty] at hx
    exact hx
  · push_neg at hz
    exact collar_side_cutoff_contradiction g U hUo N ε σ hNo hε hσs hσb hσp hWO x₀ hx₀ hthin
      O w t₀ hO ht₀ hFCO hwc hw0 hwpos hws hdw
      (fun x hx hlt => lt_of_le_of_ne (by rw [hH x hx hlt]; exact hle _ ⟨hwpos x hx, hlt⟩)
        (by rw [hH x hx hlt]; exact hz _ ⟨hwpos x hx, hlt⟩))

    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (h' : Fin P.n → E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ j (a b : Fin 2), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h' j x a b) (P.W j))

          fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) d) :

  { P with h := h', h_smooth := hs, h_posDef := hp, h_compat := hc }

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M)
    (hUo : IsOpen U) (hFc : IsCompact (frontier U)) (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hNc : IsCompact (closure N)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x ≠ 0)
    (hσb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x ∧ σ x < ε)
    (hσp : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d))
    (hσi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ)))
    (hσ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hfermat : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (x : M), mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 →
      ¬ IsLocalMax f x ∧ ¬ IsLocalMin f x := by
    intro f x hdf
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x := by
      by_contra h
      exact hdf (mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt h)
    have hw' : writtenInExtChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) x f =
        f ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm := by
      funext z
      simp [writtenInExtChartAt, extChartAt_model_space_eq_id]
    have h0 : (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) = x :=
      extChartAt_to_inv x
    have ht : Tendsto (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (𝓝 (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x)) (𝓝 x) := by
      have hca : ContinuousAt (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) :=
        continuousAt_extChartAt_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) x
      have := hca.tendsto
      rwa [h0] at this
    have hmf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x =
        fderiv ℝ (f ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm) (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) := by
      rw [hmd.mfderiv, hw', ModelWithCorners.range_eq_univ, fderivWithin_univ]
    constructor
    · intro hloc
      have hlm : IsLocalMax (f ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm) (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) := by
        have hev := ht.eventually hloc
        filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
        simp only [Function.comp, h0]
        exact hz
      exact hdf (hmf.trans hlm.fderiv_eq_zero)
    · intro hloc
      have hlm : IsLocalMin (f ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x).symm) (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x) := by
        have hev := ht.eventually hloc
        filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
        simp only [Function.comp, h0]
        exact hz
      exact hdf (hmf.trans hlm.fderiv_eq_zero)
  
  have hsign : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (x : M), f x = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 →
      ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 x, (∃ z ∈ O, 0 < f z) ∧ (∃ z ∈ O, f z < 0) := by
    intro f x hx hdf O hO
    obtain ⟨hmax, hmin⟩ := hfermat f x hdf
    constructor
    · by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact hmax (Filter.eventually_of_mem hO (fun z hz => by rw [hx]; exact hc z hz))
    · by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact hmin (Filter.eventually_of_mem hO (fun z hz => by rw [hx]; exact hc z hz))
  have hclsides : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (N : Set M) (x : M), IsOpen N → x ∈ N → f x = 0 →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 →
      x ∈ closure (N ∩ {z | 0 < f z}) ∧ x ∈ closure (N ∩ {z | f z < 0}) := by
    intro f N x hNo hxN hx0 hdf
    constructor
    · rw [mem_closure_iff_nhds]
      intro t ht
      obtain ⟨⟨u, hu, hupos⟩, -⟩ :=
        hsign f x hx0 hdf (t ∩ N) (Filter.inter_mem ht (hNo.mem_nhds hxN))
      exact ⟨u, hu.1, hu.2, hupos⟩
    · rw [mem_closure_iff_nhds]
      intro t ht
      obtain ⟨-, ⟨u, hu, huneg⟩⟩ :=
        hsign f x hx0 hdf (t ∩ N) (Filter.inter_mem ht (hNo.mem_nhds hxN))
      exact ⟨u, hu.1, hu.2, huneg⟩
  
  have hP₀c : IsClosed (V ∩ w ⁻¹' {0}) := hSc.isClosed
  have hFc : IsClosed F := hF.1
  have hPΩ : ∀ x, x ∈ V ∩ w ⁻¹' {0} → x ∉ Ω := by
    intro x hx hxΩ
    have h1 := hΩV x ⟨hxΩ, hx.1⟩
    have h2 : w x = 0 := hx.2
    linarith
  have hfrΩ : ∀ x, x ∈ closure Ω → x ∉ Ω → x ∈ frontier Ω := by
    intro x h1 h2
    rw [hΩo.frontier_eq]
    exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
  have hC1 : frontier Ω = (V ∩ w ⁻¹' {0} ∩ closure Ω) ∪ (frontier Ω ∩ F) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rcases hfr hz with h | h
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h, frontier_subset_closure hz⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hz, h⟩
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact hfrΩ z h.2 (hPΩ z h.1)

    rw [e1, e2] at hl
    rw [hcg, hl]
  
  have hmfChart : ∀ x₀ y : M, y ∈ V → y ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).source →
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w y = 0 ↔
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) (chartAt E3 x₀ y) = 0) := by
    intro x₀ y hyV hys
    obtain ⟨hWo, hh⟩ := hsm x₀
    set κ := chartAt E3 x₀ with hκ
    have hy : κ y ∈ κ.target := κ.map_source hys
    have hwd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w y :=
      (hw.contMDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds hyV)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    constructor
    · intro H
      have hfd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w (κ.symm (κ y)) := by
        rw [κ.left_inv hys]; exact hwd
      have hsd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ.symm (κ y) :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hy
      have hc := mfderiv_comp (κ y) hfd hsd
      have H' : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w (κ.symm (κ y)) = 0 := by
        rw [κ.left_inv hys]; exact H
      rw [H', ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp, mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at hc
      exact hc
    · intro H
      have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ y :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hys
      have hyW : κ y ∈ κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' V :=
        ⟨hy, show κ.symm (κ y) ∈ V by rw [κ.left_inv hys]; exact hyV⟩
      have hhd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun z => w (κ.symm z)) (κ y) := by
        have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => w (κ.symm z)) (κ y) :=
          (hh.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hyW)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        exact h1.mdifferentiableAt
      have hc := mfderiv_comp y hhd hmd
      have h2 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun z => w (κ.symm z)) (κ y) = 0 := by
        rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv]; exact H
      have hev : w =ᶠ[𝓝 y] ((fun z => w (κ.symm z)) ∘ κ) := by
        filter_upwards [κ.open_source.mem_nhds hys] with x hx
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, κ.left_inv hx]
      rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, hc, h2, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp]
  
  have hLcont : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ) (W : Set E3), IsOpen W →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) W) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h W →
      ∀ z₀ ∈ W, (G z₀).det ≠ 0 →
      Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G z₀)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i h z₀ * partialDeriv j h z₀) ≠ 0 →
      ContinuousAt (levelMeanCurvCoord G h) z₀ := by
    intro G h W hW hG hh z₀ hz₀ hdet hN
    have hWn : W ∈ 𝓝 z₀ := hW.mem_nhds hz₀
    have hsum : ∀ F : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, (∀ l, ContinuousAt (F l) z₀) →
        ContinuousAt (fun y => ∑ l, F l y) z₀ := by
      intro F hF
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      exact ((hF 0).add (hF 1)).add (hF 2)
    have hpd : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F W → ∀ k, ContinuousAt (partialDeriv k F) z₀ := by
      intro F hF k
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ F z (e k)) W :=
        (hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
      exact h1.continuousAt hWn
    have hh1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h W := hh.of_le (by simp)
    have hd1 : ∀ k, ContinuousAt (partialDeriv k h) z₀ := hpd h hh1
    have hd2 : ∀ i k, ContinuousAt (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv k h)) z₀ := by
      intro i k
      apply hpd
      have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ h y) W := by
        refine hh.fderiv_of_isOpen hW ?_
        first
        | (norm_num; exact_mod_cast (le_top : ((2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)))
        | exact_mod_cast (le_top : ((2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤))
        | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
        | (norm_num; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
        | (norm_num; decide)
        | decide
      exact h2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hdG : ∀ k a b, ContinuousAt (partialDeriv k (fun z => G z a b)) z₀ :=
      fun k a b => hpd _ ((hG a b).of_le (by simp)) k
    have hGc : ContinuousAt G z₀ :=
      continuousAt_pi.2 fun i => continuousAt_pi.2 fun j => (hG i j).continuousOn.continuousAt hWn
    have hRI : ContinuousAt Ring.inverse (G z₀).det := by
      rw [Ring.inverse_eq_inv']; exact continuousAt_inv₀ hdet
    have hinv : ContinuousAt (fun z => (G z)⁻¹) z₀ :=
      (continuousAt_matrix_inv (G z₀) hRI).comp hGc
    have hGi : ∀ i j, ContinuousAt (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) z₀ :=
      fun i j => continuousAt_pi.1 (continuousAt_pi.1 hinv i) j
    have hchr : ∀ k i j, ContinuousAt (christoffel G k i j) z₀ := by
      intro k i j
      have : ContinuousAt (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
          (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y
            - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y)) z₀ :=
        continuousAt_const.mul (hsum _ fun l => (hGi k l).mul
          (((hdG i j l).add (hdG j i l)).sub (hdG l i j)))
      exact this
    have hhess : ∀ i j, ContinuousAt (hessLoc G h i j) z₀ := by
      intro i j
      have : ContinuousAt (fun y => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h) y -
          ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k h y) z₀ :=
        (hd2 i j).sub (hsum _ fun k => (hchr k i j).mul (hd1 k))
      exact this
    have hlap : ContinuousAt (fun y => lapLoc G h y) z₀ := by
      have : ContinuousAt (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * hessLoc G h i j y)
          z₀ :=
        hsum _ fun i => hsum _ fun j => (hGi i j).mul (hhess i j)
      exact this
    have hQ : ContinuousAt (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i h y * partialDeriv j h y) z₀ :=
      hsum _ fun i => hsum _ fun j => ((hGi i j).mul (hd1 i)).mul (hd1 j)
    have hB : ContinuousAt (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a h y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b h y) *
          hessLoc G h i j y) z₀ :=
      hsum _ fun i => hsum _ fun j => hsum _ fun a => hsum _ fun b =>
        (((hGi i a).mul (hd1 a)).mul ((hGi j b).mul (hd1 b))).mul (hhess i j)
    have hn := hQ.sqrt
    have key := (hlap.div hn hN).sub (hB.div (hn.pow 3) (pow_ne_zero 3 hN))
    exact key
  
  have hlmcEv : ∀ x₀ ∈ P, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x₀, g.levelMeanCurv w y < 0 := by
    intro x₀ hx₀
    have hx₀V := hPV hx₀
    obtain ⟨hWo, hh⟩ := hsm x₀
    have hxs : x₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).source := mem_chart_source E3 x₀
    have hL0 : levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm)
        (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) < 0 := by
      have h := hH x₀ hx₀
      rw [hlmcChart x₀ x₀ hx₀V hxs] at h
      exact h
    set κ := chartAt E3 x₀ with hκ
    have hz₀ : κ x₀ ∈ κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' V :=
      ⟨κ.map_source hxs, show κ.symm (κ x₀) ∈ V by rw [κ.left_inv hxs]; exact hx₀V⟩
    have hN : Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff κ.symm (κ x₀))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => w (κ.symm z)) (κ x₀) *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => w (κ.symm z)) (κ x₀)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro H0
      have h0 : levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff κ.symm) (fun z => w (κ.symm z)) (κ x₀) = 0 := by
        unfold levelMeanCurvCoord
        rw [H0]
        simp
      linarith
    have hdet : (g.coeff κ.symm (κ x₀)).det ≠ 0 :=
      (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g x₀ (κ x₀) (κ.map_source hxs)).det_pos.ne'
    have hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => g.coeff κ.symm z i j)
        (κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' V) :=
      fun i j => (g.smooth x₀ i j).mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have hcont := hLcont (g.coeff κ.symm) (fun z => w (κ.symm z)) _ hWo hG hh (κ x₀) hz₀ hdet hN
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (κ x₀),
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff κ.symm) (fun z => w (κ.symm z)) z < 0 :=
      hcont.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hL0)
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x₀,
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff κ.symm) (fun z => w (κ.symm z)) (κ y) < 0 :=
      (κ.continuousAt hxs).eventually h1
    filter_upwards [h2, hVo.mem_nhds hx₀V, κ.open_source.mem_nhds hxs] with y hy hyV hys
    rw [hlmcChart x₀ y hyV hys]
    exact hy
  have hmfEv : ∀ x₀ ∈ P, ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x₀, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w y ≠ 0 := by
    intro x₀ hx₀
    have hx₀V := hPV hx₀
    obtain ⟨hWo, hh⟩ := hsm x₀
    have hxs : x₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).source := mem_chart_source E3 x₀
    have hA : fderiv ℝ (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) ≠ 0 :=
      fun H => hdw x₀ hx₀ ((hmfChart x₀ x₀ hx₀V hxs).2 H)
    set κ := chartAt E3 x₀ with hκ
    have hz₀ : κ x₀ ∈ κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' V :=
      ⟨κ.map_source hxs, show κ.symm (κ x₀) ∈ V by rw [κ.left_inv hxs]; exact hx₀V⟩
    have hB : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ (fun z => w (κ.symm z))) (κ x₀) :=
      (hh.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hWo (by simp)).continuousAt (hWo.mem_nhds hz₀)
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (κ x₀), fderiv ℝ (fun z => w (κ.symm z)) z ≠ 0 :=
      hB.eventually_ne hA
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x₀, fderiv ℝ (fun z => w (κ.symm z)) (κ y) ≠ 0 :=
      (κ.continuousAt hxs).eventually h1
    filter_upwards [h2, hVo.mem_nhds hx₀V, κ.open_source.mem_nhds hxs] with y hy hyV hys
    exact fun H => hy ((hmfChart x₀ y hyV hys).1 H)
  
  set S : Set M := {x | x ∈ V ∧ x ∈ Q ∧ x ∈ U₀ ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0 ∧
    g.levelMeanCurv w x < 0} with hSdef
  set O : Set M := interior S with hOdef
  have hOo : IsOpen O := isOpen_interior
  have hPO : P ⊆ O := by
    intro x₀ hx₀
    rw [hOdef, mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds]
    filter_upwards [hVo.mem_nhds (hPV hx₀), hQo.mem_nhds (hPQ hx₀), hU₀.mem_nhds (hPU₀ hx₀),
      hmfEv x₀ hx₀, hlmcEv x₀ hx₀] with y h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩
  have hOS : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ V ∧ x ∈ Q ∧ x ∈ U₀ ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0 ∧
      g.levelMeanCurv w x < 0 := fun x hx => by
    have h : x ∈ S := interior_subset hx
    exact h
  have hwO : ContinuousOn w O := hw.continuousOn.mono fun x hx => (hOS x hx).1
  have hz : ∀ x ∈ O, w x = 0 → x ∈ P :=
    fun x hx h0 => hU₀P x ⟨(hOS x hx).2.2.1, (hOS x hx).1⟩ h0
  haveI : LocallyCompactSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyCompactSpace E3 M
  obtain ⟨N, hNo, hPN, hNO, hNc⟩ := exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hPc hOo hPO
  have hNO' : N ⊆ O := subset_closure.trans hNO
  have hFrc : IsCompact (closure N \ N) := hNc.diff hNo
  have hFrO : closure N \ N ⊆ O := fun x hx => hNO hx.1
  have hFrpos : ∀ x ∈ closure N \ N, 0 < |w x| := by
    intro x hx
    apply abs_pos.2
    intro h0
    exact hx.2 (hPN (hz x (hFrO hx) h0))
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hμle⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ ∀ x ∈ closure N \ N, μ ≤ |w x| := by
    rcases (closure N \ N).eq_empty_or_nonempty with he | hne
    · refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      simp [he] at hx
    · obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hmin⟩ :=
        hFrc.exists_isMinOn hne (continuous_abs.comp_continuousOn (hwO.mono hFrO))
      refine ⟨|w x₁|, hFrpos x₁ hx₁, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      exact isMinOn_iff.1 hmin x hx
  set T : Set M := N ∩ (fun x => |w x|) ⁻¹' Set.Iio μ with hTdef
  have hTo : IsOpen T :=
    (continuous_abs.comp_continuousOn (hwO.mono hNO')).isOpen_inter_preimage hNo isOpen_Iio
  have hPT : P ⊆ T := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨hPN hx, ?_⟩
    show |w x| < μ
    rw [hP0 x hx, abs_zero]
    exact hμ
  have hTN : closure T ⊆ closure N := closure_mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hTO : closure T ⊆ O := hTN.trans hNO
  refine ⟨T, μ, hTo, hPT, hNc.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure hTN,
    fun x hx => ⟨(hOS x (hTO hx)).1, (hOS x (hTO hx)).2.1⟩, hμ, ?_,
    fun x hx => ⟨(hOS x (hTO hx)).2.2.2.1, (hOS x (hTO hx)).2.2.2.2⟩⟩
  intro x hxT hxnT
  by_cases hxN : x ∈ N
  · by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    exact hxnT ⟨hxN, hlt⟩
  · exact hμle x ⟨hTN hxT, hxN⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: levelMeanCurv_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ x) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) h x

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)

    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (S : Set M) (hS : ∀ y ∈ S, ∃ (N : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen N ∧ y ∈ N ∧ ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f N ∧ (∀ x ∈ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧ N ∩ S ⊆ f ⁻¹' {0}) : sepChartNull S

signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (S : Set M) (hS : ∀ y ∈ S, ∃ (N : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen N ∧ y ∈ N ∧ ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f N ∧ (∀ x ∈ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧ N ∩ S ⊆ f ⁻¹' {0}) : sepChartNull S

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (φ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : E3), φ w = 1 →
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - φ.smulRight w).det = 0 := by
    intro φ w hw
    have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      simp at hw
    have hker : w ∈ LinearMap.ker
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - φ.smulRight w : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) := by
      simp [hw]
    show LinearMap.det _ = 0
    rw [LinearMap.det_eq_zero_iff_ker_ne_bot]
    exact (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).2 ⟨w, hker, hw0⟩
  
  have s2 : ∀ (s O : Set E3) (h : E3 → ℝ) (φ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w z : E3), z ∈ s → O ∈ 𝓝 z →
      HasFDerivAt h φ z → (∀ u ∈ s ∩ O, h u = 0) →
      HasFDerivWithinAt (fun u : E3 => u) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - φ.smulRight w) s z := by
    intro s O h φ w z hz hO hh h0
    have hψ : HasFDerivAt (fun u => u - h u • w)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - φ.smulRight w) z :=
      (hasFDerivAt_id z).sub (hh.smul_const w)
    have h1 : HasFDerivWithinAt (fun u : E3 => u)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - φ.smulRight w) (s ∩ O) z := by
      refine hψ.hasFDerivWithinAt.congr ?_ ?_
      · intro u hu
        simp [h0 u hu]
      · simp [h0 z ⟨hz, mem_of_mem_nhds hO⟩]
    exact (hasFDerivWithinAt_inter hO).1 h1
  intro p
  set φp := chartAt E3 p with hφp
  
  have s3 : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (N : Set M) (x : M), IsOpen N → x ∈ N →
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f N →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 → x ∈ φp.source →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun u => f (φp.symm u)) (φp x) ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun u => f (φp.symm u)) (φp x) ≠ 0 := by
    intro f N x hNo hxN hf hdf hxs
    have hzt : φp x ∈ φp.target := φp.map_source hxs
    have hσz : φp.symm (φp x) = x := φp.left_inv hxs
    have hσ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φp.symm (φp x) :=
      ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (n := ∞)).contMDiffAt
        (φp.open_target.mem_nhds hzt)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hφx : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φp x :=
      ((contMDiffOn_chart (n := ∞)).contMDiffAt
        (φp.open_source.mem_nhds hxs)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hfx' : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x :=
      (hf.contMDiffAt (hNo.mem_nhds hxN)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hfx : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f (φp.symm (φp x)) := by
      rw [hσz]; exact hfx'
    have hcomp : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f ∘ φp.symm) (φp x) := hfx.comp _ hσ
    refine ⟨mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.1 hcomp, ?_⟩
    intro h0
    have hσ' : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φp.symm (φp x) := hσ
    have hev : (φp.symm ∘ φp) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] id := by
      filter_upwards [φp.open_source.mem_nhds hxs] with u hu
      exact φp.left_inv hu
    have hid : (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φp.symm (φp x)).comp
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φp x) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 := by
      rw [← mfderiv_comp x hσ' hφx, hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_id]
      rfl
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun u => f (φp.symm u)) (φp x) =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f (φp.symm (φp x))).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φp.symm (φp x)) := by
      rw [← mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      exact mfderiv_comp (φp x) hfx hσ
    have hfd' : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f (φp.symm (φp x)) =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x := by
      rw [hσz]
    apply hdf
    ext v
    have h1 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φp.symm (φp x)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φp x v) = v := by
      have := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => L v) hid
      simpa using this
    have h2 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φp x v))
      (hfd.symm.trans h0)
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, hfd'] at h2
    have h3 : (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x) ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φp.symm (φp x))
        ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φp x) v)) = 0 := h2
    rw [h1] at h3
    simpa using h3
  show volume (φp '' (S ∩ φp.source)) = 0
  have key : ∀ z : E3, ∃ L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3, z ∈ φp '' (S ∩ φp.source) →
      HasFDerivWithinAt (fun u : E3 => u) L (φp '' (S ∩ φp.source)) z ∧ L.det = 0 := by
    intro z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ φp '' (S ∩ φp.source)
    · obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxS, hxs⟩, rfl⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨N, f, hNo, hxN, hf, hdf, hNS⟩ := hS x hxS
      obtain ⟨hdiff, hne⟩ := s3 f N x hNo hxN hf (hdf x hxN) hxs
      set φ := fderiv ℝ (fun u => f (φp.symm u)) (φp x) with hφdef
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, φ v ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        exact hne (ContinuousLinearMap.ext hcon)
      have hw : φ ((φ v)⁻¹ • v) = 1 := by
        rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv]
      refine ⟨ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - φ.smulRight ((φ v)⁻¹ • v),
        fun _ => ⟨?_, s1 φ _ hw⟩⟩
      refine s2 _ (φp.target ∩ φp.symm ⁻¹' N) (fun u => f (φp.symm u)) φ _ (φp x)
        ⟨x, ⟨hxS, hxs⟩, rfl⟩ ?_ hdiff.hasFDerivAt ?_
      · refine (φp.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hNo).mem_nhds ⟨φp.map_source hxs, ?_⟩
        show φp.symm (φp x) ∈ N
        rw [φp.left_inv hxs]
        exact hxN
      · rintro u ⟨⟨x', ⟨hx'S, hx's⟩, rfl⟩, -, hu2⟩
        have hx'N : x' ∈ N := by
          have h3 : φp.symm (φp x') ∈ N := hu2
          rwa [φp.left_inv hx's] at h3
        have h4 : f x' = 0 := hNS ⟨hx'N, hx'S⟩
        show f (φp.symm (φp x')) = 0
        rw [φp.left_inv hx's]
        exact h4
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hz⟩
  choose L hL using key
  have hnull := MeasureTheory.addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_det_fderivWithin_eq_zero (μ := volume)
    (fun z hz => (hL z hz).1) (fun z hz => (hL z hz).2)
  simpa using hnull

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U K R : Set M) (hF : sepChartMeas F) (hR : IsOpen R) (hK : IsClosed K) (hRK : frontier R ⊆ K) (hKnull : sepChartNull K) (hside : ∀ y ∈ frontier R, ∃ (N : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen N ∧ y ∈ N ∧ ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f N ∧ (∀ x ∈ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧ N ∩ frontier R ⊆ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ (N ∩ R = N ∩ {x | 0 < f x} ∨ N ∩ R = N ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0})) : hullRiemPer g (F ∩ R) U K ≤ hullRiemPer g F U K
