signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U K R : Set M) (hF : sepChartMeas F) (hR : IsOpen R) (hK : IsClosed K) (hRK : frontier R ⊆ K) (hKnull : sepChartNull K) (hside : ∀ y ∈ frontier R, ∃ (N : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen N ∧ y ∈ N ∧ ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f N ∧ (∀ x ∈ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧ N ∩ frontier R ⊆ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ (N ∩ R = N ∩ {x | 0 < f x} ∨ N ∩ R = N ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0})) : hullRiemPer g (F ∩ R) U K ≤ hullRiemPer g F U K

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have junk : ∀ (φ h : E3 → ℝ) (V : Set E3) (y : E3), IsOpen V → y ∈ V →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ φ y → φ y = 0 → fderiv ℝ φ y ≠ 0 →
      (∀ z ∈ V, φ z < 0 → h z = 0) → fderiv ℝ h y = 0 := by
    intro φ h V y hV hyV hφd hφ0 hdφ hh
    by_cases hhd : DifferentiableAt ℝ h y
    swap
    · exact fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hhd
    set Λ := fderiv ℝ φ y with hΛ
    set L := fderiv ℝ h y with hL
    have hray : ∀ v : E3, Λ v < 0 → h y = 0 ∧ L v = 0 := by
      intro v hv
      have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y + t • v) v 0 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const v).const_add y
      have hψ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => φ (y + t • v)) (Λ v) 0 := by
        have h1 := hφd.hasFDerivAt
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt φ Λ ((fun t : ℝ => y + t • v) 0) := by simpa using h1
        exact h2.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hγ
      have hk : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => h (y + t • v)) (L v) 0 := by
        have h1 := hhd.hasFDerivAt
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt h L ((fun t : ℝ => y + t • v) 0) := by simpa using h1
        exact h2.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hγ
      have hslψ := hψ.tendsto_slope_zero_right
      have hneg : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), t⁻¹ • (φ (y + (0 + t) • v) - φ (y + (0 : ℝ) • v)) < 0 :=
        hslψ.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hv)
      have hpos : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), 0 < t := self_mem_nhdsWithin
      have hinV : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), y + t • v ∈ V := by
        have hc : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => y + t • v) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 y) := by
          have := hγ.continuousAt.tendsto
          simpa using this
        exact nhdsWithin_le_nhds (hc (hV.mem_nhds hyV))
      have hk0 : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), h (y + t • v) = 0 := by
        filter_upwards [hneg, hpos, hinV] with t h1 h2 h3
        apply hh _ h3
        simp only [zero_add, zero_smul, add_zero, hφ0, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at h1
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have : 0 ≤ t⁻¹ * φ (y + t • v) := mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 h2.le) hc
        linarith
      have hy0 : h y = 0 := by
        have h1 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => h (y + t • v)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (h (y + (0:ℝ) • v))) :=
          hk.continuousAt.tendsto.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
        have h2 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => h (y + t • v)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) :=
          tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (hk0.mono fun t ht => ht.symm)
        have := tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2
        simpa using this
      refine ⟨hy0, ?_⟩
      have h1 := hk.tendsto_slope_zero_right
      have h2 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹ • (h (y + (0 + t) • v) - h (y + (0 : ℝ) • v)))
          (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
        refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
        filter_upwards [hk0] with t ht
        simp [ht, hy0]
      exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2
    have hu : ∃ u : E3, Λ u ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      exact hdφ (ContinuousLinearMap.ext hc)
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hu
    set v₀ : E3 := (-(Λ u)⁻¹) • u with hv₀
    have hΛv₀ : Λ v₀ = -1 := by
      rw [hv₀, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, neg_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hu]
    have hLv₀ : L v₀ = 0 := (hray v₀ (by rw [hΛv₀]; norm_num)).2
    ext w
    have hw : Λ (w + (Λ w + 1) • v₀) = -1 := by
      rw [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hΛv₀]; ring
    have h1 := (hray (w + (Λ w + 1) • v₀) (by rw [hw]; norm_num)).2
    rw [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hLv₀, mul_zero, add_zero] at h1
    simpa using h1
  
  have key : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (D U Kc Rc : Set E3), IsOpen Rc →
      volume Kc = 0 → (∀ y ∈ U, y ∈ closure Rc → y ∉ Rc → y ∈ Kc) →
      (∀ y ∈ U, y ∈ closure Rc → y ∉ Rc → ∃ (V : Set E3) (φ : E3 → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ y ∈ V ∧
        (V ⊆ closure Rc ∨ (ContinuousOn φ V ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ φ y ∧ φ y = 0 ∧
          fderiv ℝ φ y ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ z ∈ V, φ z < 0 → z ∉ Rc))) →
      hullPerG G (D ∩ Rc) U Kc ≤ hullPerG G D U Kc := by
    intro G D U Kc Rc hRc hKc hfr hsd
    unfold hullPerG
    refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
    obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXU, hXn, C, hC⟩ := hX
    set X' : E3 → E3 := (closure Rc).indicator X with hX'def
    have hF4 : ∀ (Y Z : E3 → E3) (y : E3), Y =ᶠ[𝓝 y] Z →
        sepDensDiv G Y y = sepDensDiv G Z y := by
      intro Y Z y hYZ
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      have : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z z i) := by
        filter_upwards [hYZ] with z hz
        rw [hz]
      rw [this.fderiv_eq]
    have hzero : ∀ y, sepDensDiv G (0 : E3 → E3) y = 0 := by
      intro y
      simp [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
    have hF1 : ∀ y, y ∉ tsupport X → X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := by
      intro y hy
      filter_upwards [(isClosed_tsupport X).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      have h0 : X z = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz
      simp [X', h0]
    have hF2 : ∀ y, y ∈ Rc → X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] X := by
      intro y hy
      filter_upwards [hRc.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact Set.indicator_of_mem (subset_closure hz) X
    have hF3 : ∀ y, y ∉ closure Rc → X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := by
      intro y hy
      filter_upwards [isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hz X
    have hF6 : ∀ y, y ∈ tsupport X → y ∈ closure Rc → y ∉ Rc →
        sepDensDiv G X' y = sepDensDiv G X y ∨ sepDensDiv G X' y = 0 := by
      intro y hyT hyc hyR
      obtain ⟨V, φ, hV, hyV, hcase⟩ := hsd y (hXU hyT) hyc hyR
      rcases hcase with hVc | ⟨hφc, hφd, hφ0, hdφ, hneg⟩
      · left
        apply hF4
        filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds hyV] with z hz
        exact Set.indicator_of_mem (hVc hz) X
      · right
        have hO : IsOpen (V ∩ φ ⁻¹' Set.Iio 0) := hφc.isOpen_inter_preimage hV isOpen_Iio
        have hdisj : Disjoint (V ∩ φ ⁻¹' Set.Iio 0) Rc :=
          Set.disjoint_left.2 fun z hz hzR => hneg z hz.1 hz.2 hzR
        have hdisj' : Disjoint (V ∩ φ ⁻¹' Set.Iio 0) (closure Rc) := hdisj.closure_right hO
        unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
        have hj := junk φ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X' z i) V y hV hyV hφd hφ0 hdφ ?_
        · rw [hj]; rfl
        · intro z hz hφz
          have h0 : X' z = 0 := Set.indicator_of_notMem (Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj' ⟨hz, hφz⟩) X
          simp [h0]
    have A1 : ∀ y, y ∉ Kc → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X' y := by
      intro y hyK
      by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
      · by_cases hyR : y ∈ Rc
        · exact (hXs y hyK).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hF2 y hyR)
        · by_cases hyc : y ∈ closure Rc
          · exact absurd (hfr y (hXU hyT) hyc hyR) hyK
          · exact (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : E3))).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hF3 y hyc)
      · exact (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : E3))).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hF1 y hyT)
    have hsupp : Function.support X' ⊆ Function.support X := by
      rw [hX'def, Set.support_indicator]; exact Set.inter_subset_right
    have A2 : HasCompactSupport X' := hXc.mono hsupp
    have A3 : tsupport X' ⊆ U := (closure_mono hsupp).trans hXU
    have A4 : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X' y i * X' y j ≤ 1 := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ closure Rc
      · have h1 : X' y = X y := Set.indicator_of_mem hy X
        rw [h1]; exact hXn y
      · have h1 : X' y = 0 := Set.indicator_of_notMem hy X
        rw [h1]; simp
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hC 0)
    have A5 : ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X' y| ≤ C := by
      intro y
      by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
      · by_cases hyR : y ∈ Rc
        · rw [hF4 _ _ y (hF2 y hyR)]; exact hC y
        · by_cases hyc : y ∈ closure Rc
          · rcases hF6 y hyT hyc hyR with h | h
            · rw [h]; exact hC y
            · rw [h, abs_zero]; exact hC0
          · rw [hF4 _ _ y (hF3 y hyc), hzero y, abs_zero]; exact hC0
      · rw [hF4 _ _ y (hF1 y hyT), hzero y, abs_zero]; exact hC0
    have hpt : ∀ y, y ∉ Kc → sepDensDiv G X' y = Rc.indicator (sepDensDiv G X) y := by
      intro y hyK
      by_cases hyR : y ∈ Rc
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyR, hF4 _ _ y (hF2 y hyR)]
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyR]
        by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
        · by_cases hyc : y ∈ closure Rc
          · exact absurd (hfr y (hXU hyT) hyc hyR) hyK
          · rw [hF4 _ _ y (hF3 y hyc), hzero]
        · rw [hF4 _ _ y (hF1 y hyT), hzero]
    have hae : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure E3), y ∉ Kc := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.1 hKc
    have hint : ∫ y in D, sepDensDiv G X' y = ∫ y in D ∩ Rc, sepDensDiv G X y := by
      rw [← setIntegral_indicator hRc.measurableSet]
      refine integral_congr_ae ?_
      exact ae_restrict_of_ae (hae.mono fun y hy => hpt y hy)
    refine le_iSup₂_of_le X' ⟨A1, A2, A3, A4, C, A5⟩ ?_
    rw [hint]
  
  unfold hullRiemPer
  refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun p => iSup_mono fun W => iSup_mono fun hW => ?_
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
  set κ := chartAt E3 (p k) with hκ
  have hWs : W k ⊆ κ.source := fun x hx => ((hW.1 k).2 hx).2
  have hWt : κ '' W k ⊆ κ.target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact κ.map_source (hWs hx)
  have hopen : ∀ O : Set M, IsOpen O → IsOpen (κ '' (O ∩ κ.source)) := fun O hO =>
    κ.isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hO.inter κ.open_source) Set.inter_subset_right
  have himg : κ '' ((F ∩ R) ∩ κ.source) = κ '' (F ∩ κ.source) ∩ κ '' (R ∩ κ.source) := by
    rw [← κ.injOn.image_inter Set.inter_subset_right Set.inter_subset_right]
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff]
    tauto
  have hpull : ∀ y ∈ κ.target, y ∈ closure (κ '' (R ∩ κ.source)) →
      y ∉ κ '' (R ∩ κ.source) → κ.symm y ∈ frontier R := by
    intro y hyt hyc hyR
    have hx : κ.symm y ∈ closure (κ.symm '' (κ '' (R ∩ κ.source))) :=
      mem_closure_image (κ.continuousAt_symm hyt) hyc
    have hsub : κ.symm '' (κ '' (R ∩ κ.source)) ⊆ R := by
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨a, ⟨haR, has⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [κ.left_inv has]
      exact haR
    rw [hR.frontier_eq]
    exact ⟨closure_mono hsub hx, fun hxR => hyR ⟨κ.symm y, ⟨hxR, κ.map_target hyt⟩,
      κ.right_inv hyt⟩⟩
  rw [himg]
  refine key _ _ _ _ _ (hopen R hR) (hKnull (p k)) ?_ ?_
  · intro y hy hyc hyR
    exact ⟨κ.symm y, ⟨hRK (hpull y (hWt hy) hyc hyR), κ.map_target (hWt hy)⟩,
      κ.right_inv (hWt hy)⟩
  · intro y hy hyc hyR
    have hyt := hWt hy
    have hxfr := hpull y hyt hyc hyR
    obtain ⟨x, hxs, rfl⟩ : ∃ x ∈ κ.source, κ x = y :=
      ⟨κ.symm y, κ.map_target hyt, κ.right_inv hyt⟩
    rw [κ.left_inv hxs] at hxfr
    obtain ⟨N, f, hNo, hxN, hf, hdf, hNfr, hcase⟩ := hside x hxfr
    have hVo := hopen N hNo
    have hyV : κ x ∈ κ '' (N ∩ κ.source) := ⟨x, ⟨hxN, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨κ '' (N ∩ κ.source), fun z => f (κ.symm z), hVo, hyV, ?_⟩
    rcases hcase with h1 | h2
    · 
      right
      have hVt : κ '' (N ∩ κ.source) ⊆ κ.target := by
        rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        exact κ.map_source hw.2
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo κ.symm (κ '' (N ∩ κ.source)) N := by
        rintro _ ⟨w, ⟨hwN, hws⟩, rfl⟩
        rw [κ.left_inv hws]
        exact hwN
      have hφs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f (κ.symm z)) (κ '' (N ∩ κ.source)) := by
        have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ κ.symm) (κ '' (N ∩ κ.source)) :=
          hf.comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono hVt) hmaps
        exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
      have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => f (κ.symm z)) (κ x) :=
        (hφs.contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds hyV)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      refine ⟨hφs.continuousOn, hφd, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show f (κ.symm (κ x)) = 0
        rw [κ.left_inv hxs]
        exact hNfr ⟨hxN, hxfr⟩
      · intro h0
        have hκd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ x :=
          mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 (p k)) hxs
        have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => f (κ.symm z)) ∘ κ := by
          filter_upwards [κ.open_source.mem_nhds hxs] with v hv
          simp only [Function.comp_apply, κ.left_inv hv]
        have hm : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x =
            mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ((fun z => f (κ.symm z)) ∘ κ) x := hev.mfderiv_eq
        rw [mfderiv_comp x hφd.mdifferentiableAt hκd, mfderiv_eq_fderiv, h0] at hm
        apply hdf x hxN
        rw [hm]
        rfl
      · rintro _ ⟨w, ⟨hwN, hws⟩, rfl⟩ hneg ⟨b, ⟨hbR, hbs⟩, hb⟩
        have hbw : b = w := κ.injOn hbs hws hb
        rw [hbw] at hbR
        have hw : w ∈ N ∩ {x | 0 < f x} := h1 ▸ ⟨hwN, hbR⟩
        have hneg' : f w < 0 := by
          have h := hneg
          simp only [κ.left_inv hws] at h
          exact h
        exact absurd hw.2 (not_lt.2 hneg'.le)
    · 
      left
      rintro _ ⟨w, ⟨hwN, hws⟩, rfl⟩
      have hwcl : w ∈ closure R := by
        by_contra hwc
        have hO : (closure R)ᶜ ∩ N ∈ 𝓝 w :=
          Filter.inter_mem (isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hwc) (hNo.mem_nhds hwN)
        have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 w] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [hO] with v hv
          by_contra hfv
          have hvR : v ∈ N ∩ R := h2 ▸ (⟨hv.2, hfv⟩ : v ∈ N ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0})
          exact hv.1 (subset_closure hvR.2)
        have hm : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f w = 0 := by
          rw [hev.mfderiv_eq]
          exact mfderiv_const
        exact hdf w hwN hm
      have hw2 : w ∈ closure (κ.source ∩ R) := κ.open_source.inter_closure ⟨hws, hwcl⟩
      have hw3 := mem_closure_image (κ.continuousAt hws) hw2
      rw [Set.inter_comm] at hw3
      exact hw3

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U K L : Set M) (hK : IsClosed K) (hL : IsClosed L) (hKL : Disjoint K L) (hFL : Disjoint (closure F) L) : hullRiemPer g F U (K ∪ L) ≤ hullRiemPer g F U K

signature.name: hullRiemPer_union_cut_le
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U K L : Set M) (hK : IsClosed K) (hL : IsClosed L) (hKL : Disjoint K L) (hFL : Disjoint (closure F) L) : hullRiemPer g F U (K ∪ L) ≤ hullRiemPer g F U K

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ (A B : Set E3), IsClosed A → IsClosed B → Disjoint A B →
      ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y ∧ χ y ≤ 1) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ A, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1) ∧ (∀ y ∈ B, ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0) := by
    intro A B hA hB hAB
    obtain ⟨f, hf0, hf1, hf01⟩ :=
      exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_nhds_of_isClosed 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (n := ⊤) hB hA hAB.symm
    refine ⟨f, ?_, fun y => ⟨(hf01 y).1, (hf01 y).2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp f.contMDiff
    · exact eventually_nhdsSet_iff_forall.mp hf1
    · exact eventually_nhdsSet_iff_forall.mp hf0
  
  have s3 : ∀ (q : M) (T : Set E3), IsCompact T → T ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target →
      Disjoint (closure ((chartAt E3 q) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩ T) ∪
          closure ((chartAt E3 q) '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩ T))
        (closure ((chartAt E3 q) '' (L ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩ T)) := by
    intro q T hT hTt
    have hS : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 q).symm '' T) :=
      hT.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn_symm.mono hTt)
    have hSs : (chartAt E3 q).symm '' T ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact (chartAt E3 q).map_target (hTt hy)
    have hA : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 q) '' ((closure F ∪ K) ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm '' T)) :=
      (hS.inter_left (isClosed_closure.union hK)).image_of_continuousOn
        ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn.mono (Set.inter_subset_right.trans hSs))
    have hB : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 q) '' (L ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm '' T)) :=
      (hS.inter_left hL).image_of_continuousOn
        ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn.mono (Set.inter_subset_right.trans hSs))
    have hA' : closure ((chartAt E3 q) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩ T) ∪
        closure ((chartAt E3 q) '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩ T) ⊆
        (chartAt E3 q) '' ((closure F ∪ K) ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm '' T) := by
      refine Set.union_subset (closure_minimal ?_ hA.isClosed) (closure_minimal ?_ hA.isClosed)
      · rintro _ ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxF, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hyT⟩
        exact ⟨x, ⟨Or.inl (subset_closure hxF), (chartAt E3 q) x, hyT,
          (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxs⟩, rfl⟩
      · rintro _ ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxK, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hyT⟩
        exact ⟨x, ⟨Or.inr hxK, (chartAt E3 q) x, hyT, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    have hB' : closure ((chartAt E3 q) '' (L ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ∩ T) ⊆
        (chartAt E3 q) '' (L ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm '' T) := by
      refine closure_minimal ?_ hB.isClosed
      rintro _ ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxL, hxs⟩, rfl⟩, hyT⟩
      exact ⟨x, ⟨hxL, (chartAt E3 q) x, hyT, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    refine Disjoint.mono hA' hB' ?_
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨x₁, ⟨hx₁, hx₁S⟩, rfl⟩ ⟨x₂, ⟨hx₂L, hx₂S⟩, hx⟩
    have hx12 : x₂ = x₁ := (chartAt E3 q).injOn (hSs hx₂S) (hSs hx₁S) hx
    subst hx12
    rcases hx₁ with h | h
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hFL h hx₂L
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hKL h hx₂L
  
  have key : ∀ (q : M) (W : Set M), W ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source →
      hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
          (chartAt E3 q '' W) (chartAt E3 q '' ((K ∪ L) ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) ≤
        hullPerG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
          (chartAt E3 q '' W) (chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) := by
    intro q W hW
    
    have hpd : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef := by
      intro y hy
      have hq : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
      have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
      have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hq
      have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)).comp
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
      have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
        apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
        exact hz
      rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
      have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w) = w := by
        intro w
        have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
        simpa using h1
      have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
        intro w hw
        rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
      apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
      · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
        intro i j
        simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
        exact g.symm _ _ _
      · intro x hx
        have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          apply hx
          funext j
          have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
          fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
        have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
        have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) _ hDv
        have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).mulVec x =
            g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
          simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
            ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
            RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
          ring
        rw [key]
        exact hpos
    
    have hJ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
        (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      have hent : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j)
          (chartAt E3 q).target := fun i j => g.smooth q i j
      have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
          (chartAt E3 q).target := by
        simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
        have e3 := fun a b c d a' b' => ((hent a b).mul (hent c d)).mul (hent a' b')
        exact (((((e3 0 0 1 1 2 2).sub (e3 0 0 1 2 2 1)).sub (e3 0 1 1 0 2 2)).add
          (e3 0 1 1 2 2 0)).add (e3 0 2 1 0 2 1)).sub (e3 0 2 1 1 2 0)
      exact hdet.sqrt (fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne')
    have hTo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).open_target
    unfold hullPerG
    refine iSup₂_le fun X hX => ?_
    obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXU, hXn, C, hXd⟩ := hX
    have hTX : tsupport X ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hXU hy
      exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hW hx)
    have hsep := s3 q (tsupport X) hXc hTX
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ, hχb, hχA, hχB⟩ :=
      s1 _ _ (isClosed_closure.union isClosed_closure) isClosed_closure hsep
    have hχF : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), y ∈ tsupport X →
        ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1 :=
      fun y hy hyT => hχA y (Or.inl (subset_closure ⟨hy, hyT⟩))
    have hχK : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), y ∈ tsupport X →
        ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1 :=
      fun y hy hyT => hχA y (Or.inr (subset_closure ⟨hy, hyT⟩))
    have hχL : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (L ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), y ∈ tsupport X →
        ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0 :=
      fun y hy hyT => hχB y (subset_closure ⟨hy, hyT⟩)
    obtain ⟨X', hX'⟩ : ∃ X' : E3 → E3, ∀ y, X' y = χ y • X y := ⟨fun y => χ y • X y, fun _ => rfl⟩
    generalize hG : g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm = G at hJ hXn hXd ⊢
    
    have hloc : ∀ (Z₁ Z₂ : E3 → E3) (y : E3), Z₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] Z₂ →
        sepDensDiv G Z₁ y = sepDensDiv G Z₂ y := by
      intro Z₁ Z₂ y h
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      have h' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z₁ z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z₂ z i) :=
        h.mono fun z hz => by simp only [hz]
      rw [h'.fderiv_eq]
    have hzero : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (y : E3), y ∉ tsupport Z → sepDensDiv G Z y = 0 := by
      intro Z y hy
      rw [hloc Z 0 y (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy)]
      simp [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
    have hcoord : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (y : E3), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Z y → ∀ i : Fin 3,
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => Z z i) y := by
      intro Z y hZ i
      exact (contDiffAt_piLp _).1 hZ i
    have hc : ∀ z (i : Fin 3), X' z i = χ z * X z i := by
      intro z i
      rw [hX' z]
      rfl
    
    have ha : ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X' y := by
      intro y hyK
      by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
      · by_cases hyL : y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (L ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)
        · have h0 := hχL y hyL hyT
          have hev : X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
            filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
            rw [hX' z, hz, zero_smul]
          exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
        · have hyKL : y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' ((K ∪ L) ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
            rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxKL, hxs⟩, hxy⟩
            rcases hxKL with hxK | hxL
            · exact hyK ⟨x, ⟨hxK, hxs⟩, hxy⟩
            · exact hyL ⟨x, ⟨hxL, hxs⟩, hxy⟩
          have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => χ z • X z) y := hχ.contDiffAt.smul (hXs y hyKL)
          have hfun : X' = fun z => χ z • X z := funext hX'
          rw [hfun]
          exact h1
      · have h0 : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hyT
        have hev : X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
          filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
          rw [hX' z, hz, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero]
        exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    
    have hsupp : Function.support X' ⊆ Function.support X := by
      intro y hy h0
      apply hy
      rw [hX' y, h0, smul_zero]
    have hb : HasCompactSupport X' := hXc.mono hsupp
    have hTT : tsupport X' ⊆ tsupport X := closure_mono hsupp
    have hcU : tsupport X' ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' W := hTT.trans hXU
    have hd : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X' y i * X' y j ≤ 1 := by
      intro y
      have hs := hXn y
      have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X' y i * X' y j =
          (χ y) ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j := by
        simp only [hc, Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        ring
      rw [e1]
      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hχb y
      have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (sq_nonneg (χ y))
      nlinarith
    
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : Set E3, D = tsupport X \
        ({y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1} ∪ {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0}) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hDc : IsCompact D := by
      rw [hD]
      exact hXc.isCompact.diff (isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds.union isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds)
    have hDs : ∀ y ∈ D, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hD] at hy
      obtain ⟨hyT, hyn⟩ := hy
      apply hXs
      rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxKL, hxs⟩, hxy⟩
      rcases hxKL with hxK | hxL
      · exact hyn (Or.inl (hχK y ⟨x, ⟨hxK, hxs⟩, hxy⟩ hyT))
      · exact hyn (Or.inr (hχL y ⟨x, ⟨hxL, hxs⟩, hxy⟩ hyT))
    have hprod : ∀ y, y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y →
        sepDensDiv G X' y = χ y * sepDensDiv G X y +
          ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i χ y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i) := by
      intro y hyT hyX
      have hJy := hJ.contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hyT)
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      have hh : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y :=
        (hJy.mul (hcoord X y hyX i)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hχd : DifferentiableAt ℝ χ y := hχ.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by simp)
      have e1 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X' z i) =
          fun z => χ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
        funext z
        rw [hc z i]
        ring
      have hder : HasFDerivAt (fun z => χ z * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i))
          (χ y • fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y +
            (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i) • fderiv ℝ χ y) y :=
        hχd.hasFDerivAt.mul hh.hasFDerivAt
      rw [e1, hder.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hΦc : ContinuousOn
        (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i χ y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i)) D := by
      apply continuousOn_finset_sum
      intro i _ y hy
      have hyX := hDs y hy
      have hyT : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
        rw [hD] at hy
        exact hTX hy.1
      have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun y => partialDeriv i χ y) y := by
        unfold partialDeriv
        exact ((hχ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const).continuousAt
      have h2 : ContinuousAt (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y :=
        ((hJ.contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hyT)).mul (hcoord X y hyX i)).continuousAt
      exact (h1.mul h2).continuousWithinAt
    obtain ⟨M0, hM0⟩ := hDc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hΦc
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hXd 0)
    have hbd : ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X' y| ≤ C' := by
      refine ⟨C + max M0 0, fun y => ?_⟩
      have hm1 := le_max_left M0 0
      have hm2 := le_max_right M0 0
      by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
      · by_cases hy1 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 1
        · have hev : X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] X := by
            filter_upwards [hy1] with z hz
            rw [hX' z, hz, one_smul]
          rw [hloc X' X y hev]
          linarith [hXd y]
        · by_cases hy0 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, χ z = 0
          · have hev : X' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := by
              filter_upwards [hy0] with z hz
              rw [hX' z, hz, zero_smul]
              rfl
            rw [hloc X' 0 y hev]
            have h00 : sepDensDiv G 0 y = 0 := by simp [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
            rw [h00, abs_zero]
            linarith
          · have hyD : y ∈ D := by
              rw [hD]
              exact ⟨hyT, fun h => h.elim hy1 hy0⟩
            rw [hprod y (hTX hyT) (hDs y hyD)]
            have h1 := hM0 y hyD
            simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
            have h2 := hXd y
            obtain ⟨hχ0, hχ1⟩ := hχb y
            have h3 : |χ y * sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hχ0]
              calc χ y * |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ 1 * C := mul_le_mul hχ1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
                _ = C := one_mul C
            have h3' := abs_le.1 h3
            have h1' := abs_le.1 h1
            rw [abs_le]
            constructor <;> linarith [h3'.1, h3'.2, h1'.1, h1'.2]
      · rw [hzero X' y (fun h => hyT (hTT h)), abs_zero]
        linarith
    
    have hFO : chartAt E3 q '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) ⊆
        {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z} := by
      intro y hy
      show ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z
      by_cases hyT : y ∈ tsupport X
      · filter_upwards [hχF y hy hyT] with z hz
        rw [hX' z, hz, one_smul]
      · have h0 : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hyT
        filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
        rw [hX' z, hz, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero]
    have hOo : IsOpen {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z} := isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds
    have hf : ∀ y ∈ {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z}, sepDensDiv G X' y = sepDensDiv G X y :=
      fun y hy => hloc X' X y hy
    have hint : ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), sepDensDiv G X' y =
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), sepDensDiv G X y := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      have h1 : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict {y | ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, X' z = X z}),
          sepDensDiv G X' y = sepDensDiv G X y :=
        ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hOo.measurableSet hf
      exact ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset hFO h1
    rw [← hint]
    exact le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun (Y : E3 → E3) (_ :
        (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Y y) ∧
        HasCompactSupport Y ∧ tsupport Y ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' W ∧
        (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * Y y i * Y y j ≤ 1) ∧
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G Y y| ≤ C) =>
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), sepDensDiv G Y y))
      X' ⟨ha, hb, hcU, hd, hbd⟩ le_rfl
  
  unfold hullRiemPer
  refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun p => iSup_mono fun W => iSup_mono fun h =>
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
  exact key (p k) (W k) (fun x hx => ((h.1 k).2 hx).2)

informal_problem.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F F' U K : Set M) (h : sepChartNull (symmDiff F F')) : hullRiemPer g F U K = hullRiemPer g F' U K

signature.name: hullRiemPer_congr_chartNull
signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F F' U K : Set M) (h : sepChartNull (symmDiff F F')) : hullRiemPer g F U K = hullRiemPer g F' U K

proof.tactics:
by
  have key : ∀ (q : M) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U' Kc : Set E3),
      hullPerG G (chartAt E3 q '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) U' Kc =
        hullPerG G (chartAt E3 q '' (F' ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) U' Kc := by
    intro q G U' Kc
    have hsub : symmDiff (chartAt E3 q '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source))
        (chartAt E3 q '' (F' ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) ⊆
        chartAt E3 q '' (symmDiff F F' ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
      intro y hy
      rcases Set.mem_symmDiff.1 hy with ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxF, hxS⟩, rfl⟩, hn⟩ | ⟨⟨x, ⟨hxF', hxS⟩, rfl⟩, hn⟩
      · exact ⟨x, ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inl ⟨hxF, fun h' => hn ⟨x, ⟨h', hxS⟩, rfl⟩⟩), hxS⟩, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨x, ⟨Set.mem_symmDiff.2 (Or.inr ⟨hxF', fun h' => hn ⟨x, ⟨h', hxS⟩, rfl⟩⟩), hxS⟩, rfl⟩
    have hae := MeasureTheory.measure_symmDiff_eq_zero_iff.1
      (MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null hsub (h q))
    unfold hullPerG
    refine iSup_congr fun X => iSup_congr fun _ => ?_
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_set hae]
  unfold hullRiemPer
  simp only [key]

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U K T : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (b c : ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hK : IsClosed K) (hT : IsOpen T) (hw : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w T) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hslab : IsCompact (closure (T ∩ {x | -c ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ b}))) (hslabT : closure (T ∩ {x | -c ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ b}) ⊆ T ∩ U) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ T, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (hmc : ∀ x ∈ T, -c ≤ w x → w x ≤ b → g.levelMeanCurv w x < 0) (hKT : ∀ x ∈ K ∩ T, w x = 0) (hFm : sepChartMeas F) (hFT : ∀ x ∈ F ∩ T, 0 < w x) (hfin : hullRiemPer g F U K < ⊤) (hmin : hullRiemPer g F U K ≤ hullRiemPer g (F \ (T ∩ {x | w x < b})) U K) : sepChartNull (F ∩ T ∩ {x | w x < b})

signature.name: hullMinimizer_slab_null
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F U K T : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (b c : ℝ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hK : IsClosed K) (hT : IsOpen T) (hw : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w T) (hb : 0 < b) (hc : 0 < c) (hslab : IsCompact (closure (T ∩ {x | -c ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ b}))) (hslabT : closure (T ∩ {x | -c ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ b}) ⊆ T ∩ U) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ T, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (hmc : ∀ x ∈ T, -c ≤ w x → w x ≤ b → g.levelMeanCurv w x < 0) (hKT : ∀ x ∈ K ∩ T, w x = 0) (hFm : sepChartMeas F) (hFT : ∀ x ∈ F ∩ T, 0 < w x) (hfin : hullRiemPer g F U K < ⊤) (hmin : hullRiemPer g F U K ≤ hullRiemPer g (F \ (T ∩ {x | w x < b})) U K) : sepChartNull (F ∩ T ∩ {x | w x < b})

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  
  
  have himg : ∀ (X : Set M) (p : M), chartAt E3 p '' (X ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =
      (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' X := by
    intro X p
    rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact (chartAt E3 p).image_source_inter_eq' X
  have hOpenMeas : ∀ A : Set M, IsOpen A → sepChartMeas A := by
    intro A hA p
    exact ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hA.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right).measurableSet
  have hMeasInter : ∀ A B : Set M, sepChartMeas A → IsOpen B → sepChartMeas (A ∩ B) := by
    intro A B hA hB p
    have h1 := hA p
    have h2 := hOpenMeas B hB p
    rw [himg] at h1 h2 ⊢
    have heq : (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (A ∩ B) =
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' A) ∩
          ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' B) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
      tauto
    rw [heq]
    exact h1.inter h2
  have hMeasDiff : ∀ A B : Set M, sepChartMeas A → IsOpen B → sepChartMeas (A \ B) := by
    intro A B hA hB p
    have h1 := hA p
    have h2 := hOpenMeas B hB p
    rw [himg] at h1 h2 ⊢
    have heq : (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (A \ B) =
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' A) \
          ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' B) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_diff]
      tauto
    rw [heq]
    exact h1.diff h2
  have hmonoG : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (A U K₁ K₂ : Set E3), K₁ ⊆ K₂ →
      hullPerG G A U K₁ ≤ hullPerG G A U K₂ := by
    intro G A U K₁ K₂ h
    unfold hullPerG
    refine iSup_mono fun X => iSup_le fun hX => ?_
    refine le_iSup_of_le (⟨fun y hy => hX.1 y (fun h' => hy (h h')), hX.2⟩ :
      (∀ y, y ∉ K₂ → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
      tsupport X ⊆ U ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ C) le_rfl
  have hmono : ∀ (A U K₁ K₂ : Set M), K₁ ⊆ K₂ →
      hullRiemPer g A U K₁ ≤ hullRiemPer g A U K₂ := by
    intro A U K₁ K₂ h
    unfold hullRiemPer
    refine iSup_mono fun n => iSup_mono fun p => iSup_mono fun W => iSup_mono fun _ => ?_
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ =>
      hmonoG _ _ _ _ _ (Set.image_subset _ (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ h))
  have hwc : ContinuousOn w T := hw.continuousOn
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨Z, hZdef⟩ : ∃ Z : Set M, Z = T ∩ {x | w x < b} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hZdef] at hmin
  obtain ⟨F', hF'def⟩ : ∃ F' : Set M, F' = F \ Z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hF'def] at hmin
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : Set M, D = F ∩ T ∩ {x | w x < b} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hDdef]
  obtain ⟨Sl, hSldef⟩ : ∃ Sl : Set M, Sl = closure (T ∩ {x | -c ≤ w x ∧ w x ≤ b}) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hSldef] at hslab hslabT
  have hZo : IsOpen Z := by rw [hZdef]; exact hwc.isOpen_inter_preimage hT isOpen_Iio
  have hF'm : sepChartMeas F' := by rw [hF'def]; exact hMeasDiff F Z hFm hZo
  have hDZ : D = F ∩ Z := by rw [hDdef, hZdef, Set.inter_assoc]
  have hDm : sepChartMeas D := by rw [hDZ]; exact hMeasInter F Z hFm hZo
  have hSlT : Sl ⊆ T := fun x hx => (hslabT hx).1
  have hSlU : Sl ⊆ U := fun x hx => (hslabT hx).2
  have hmemSl : ∀ x ∈ T, -c ≤ w x → w x ≤ b → x ∈ Sl := fun x hx h1 h2 => by
    rw [hSldef]; exact subset_closure ⟨hx, h1, h2⟩
  have hDSl : D ⊆ Sl := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hDdef] at hx
    obtain ⟨⟨hxF, hxT⟩, hxb⟩ := hx
    have h0 := hFT x ⟨hxF, hxT⟩
    have hxb' : w x < b := hxb
    exact hmemSl x hxT (by linarith) hxb'.le
  have hFF' : ∀ x, x ∉ D → (x ∈ F' ↔ x ∈ F) := by
    intro x hxD
    rw [hF'def]
    constructor
    · exact fun h => h.1
    · intro hxF
      refine ⟨hxF, fun hxZ => hxD ?_⟩
      rw [hDZ]; exact ⟨hxF, hxZ⟩
  have hF'Z : ∀ x ∈ F', x ∉ Z := by rw [hF'def]; exact fun x hx => hx.2
  
  
  
  have bump : ∀ (Ω₁ K₁ : Set M), IsOpen Ω₁ → IsCompact K₁ → K₁ ⊆ Ω₁ →
      ∃ (β : M → ℝ) (O : Set M), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ β x ∧ β x ≤ 1) ∧
        IsOpen O ∧ K₁ ⊆ O ∧ (∀ x ∈ O, β x = 1) ∧ IsCompact (tsupport β) ∧
        tsupport β ⊆ Ω₁ := by
    intro Ω₁ K₁ hΩ₁ hK₁ hK₁Ω
    have hP0 : calPartition (fun j : Fin 0 => (j.elim0 : M))
        (fun j : Fin 0 => (j.elim0 : M → ℝ)) Ω₁ :=
      ⟨fun j => j.elim0, fun j => j.elim0, fun x => by simp, fun j => j.elim0⟩
    obtain ⟨n, q, φ, O, hφ, hOo, hKO, hφ1, -⟩ := calPartition_extend g Ω₁ hΩ₁ _ _ hP0 ∅
      isOpen_empty (fun x hx => hx.elim) K₁ hK₁ hK₁Ω
    have hsub : tsupport (fun x => ∑ j, φ j x) ⊆ ⋃ j, tsupport (φ j) := by
      unfold tsupport
      rw [← closure_iUnion_of_finite]
      apply closure_mono
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hx
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hj⟩
    have hc : IsCompact (⋃ j, tsupport (φ j)) := isCompact_iUnion fun j => (hφ.2.2.2 j).1
    refine ⟨fun x => ∑ j, φ j x, O, ?_, ?_, hOo, fun x hx => hKO (Or.inl hx), hφ1,
      hc.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) hsub,
      hsub.trans (Set.iUnion_subset fun j => (hφ.2.2.2 j).2.trans Set.inter_subset_left)⟩
    · exact contMDiff_finset_sum fun j _ => hφ.1 j
    · intro x
      exact ⟨Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hφ.2.1 j x, hφ.2.2.1 x⟩
  have hKSl : IsCompact (K ∩ Sl) := hslab.inter_left hK
  have hKTSl : K ∩ T ⊆ K ∩ Sl := fun x hx =>
    ⟨hx.1, hmemSl x hx.2 (by rw [hKT x hx]; linarith) (by rw [hKT x hx]; linarith)⟩
  have hKSlZ : K ∩ Sl ⊆ Z := by
    intro x hx
    have hxT := hSlT hx.2
    rw [hZdef]
    refine ⟨hxT, ?_⟩
    show w x < b
    rw [hKT x ⟨hx.1, hxT⟩]
    exact hb
  obtain ⟨Λ, OΛ, hΛs, hΛ01, hOΛo, hKOΛ, hΛ1, -, hΛZ⟩ := bump Z (K ∩ Sl) hZo hKSl hKSlZ
  have hZT : Z ⊆ T := by rw [hZdef]; exact Set.inter_subset_left
  have hKΛ : K ∩ tsupport Λ ⊆ OΛ := fun x hx => hKOΛ (hKTSl ⟨hx.1, hZT (hΛZ hx.2)⟩)
  obtain ⟨ζ, Oζ, hζs, -, hOζo, hSlOζ, hζ1, hζc, hζTU⟩ :=
    bump (T ∩ U) Sl (hT.inter hU) hslab hslabT
  have hζT : tsupport ζ ⊆ T := hζTU.trans Set.inter_subset_left
  have hζcont : Continuous ζ := hζs.continuous
  obtain ⟨μ₀, Oμ, hμs, -, hOμo, hζOμ, hμ1, -, hμT⟩ := bump T (tsupport ζ) hT hζc hζT
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρdef⟩ : ∃ ρ : M → ℝ, ρ = fun x => -(μ₀ x * w x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hwt : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => μ₀ x * w x) := by
    apply contMDiff_of_tsupport
    intro x hx
    have hxT : x ∈ T := hμT (tsupport_mul_subset_left hx)
    exact (hμs.contMDiffAt).mul (hw.contMDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hxT))
  have hρs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ := by rw [hρdef]; exact hwt.neg
  obtain ⟨Tt, hTtdef⟩ : ∃ Tt : Set M, Tt = T ∩ Oμ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hTto : IsOpen Tt := by rw [hTtdef]; exact hT.inter hOμo
  have hTtT : Tt ⊆ T := by rw [hTtdef]; exact Set.inter_subset_left
  have hgerm : ∀ x ∈ Tt, (fun y => μ₀ y * w y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] w := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hTtdef] at hx
    filter_upwards [hOμo.mem_nhds hx.2] with y hy
    rw [hμ1 y hy, one_mul]
  have hρTt : ∀ x ∈ Tt, ρ x = -w x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hTtdef] at hx
    rw [hρdef]
    show -(μ₀ x * w x) = -w x
    rw [hμ1 x hx.2, one_mul]
  have hdρ : ∀ x ∈ Tt, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hρdef, show (fun x => -(μ₀ x * w x)) = -(fun x => μ₀ x * w x) from rfl, mfderiv_neg,
      (hgerm x hx).mfderiv_eq]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (hdw x (hTtT hx))
  have hsuppζ : ∀ x, ζ x ≠ 0 → x ∈ tsupport ζ := fun x hx => subset_tsupport _ hx
  have hζTt : tsupport ζ ⊆ Tt := fun x hx => by rw [hTtdef]; exact ⟨hζT hx, hζOμ hx⟩
  have hSlTt : Sl ⊆ Tt := fun x hx =>
    hζTt (hsuppζ x (by rw [hζ1 x (hSlOζ hx)]; norm_num))
  have hDTt : D ⊆ Tt := fun x hx => hSlTt (hDSl hx)
  have hDeq : F ∩ Tt ∩ {x | -b < ρ x} = D := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hxF, hxT⟩, hxb⟩
      have h1 : -b < ρ x := hxb
      rw [hρTt x hxT] at h1
      rw [hDdef]
      exact ⟨⟨hxF, hTtT hxT⟩, show w x < b by linarith⟩
    · intro hx
      have hxT := hDTt hx
      have hx' := hx
      rw [hDdef] at hx'
      obtain ⟨⟨hxF, -⟩, hxb⟩ := hx'
      have hxb' : w x < b := hxb
      refine ⟨⟨hxF, hxT⟩, ?_⟩
      show -b < ρ x
      rw [hρTt x hxT]
      linarith
  have hF'eq : F \ (Tt ∩ {x | -b < ρ x}) = F' := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxF, hxn⟩
      rw [hF'def]
      refine ⟨hxF, fun hxZ => hxn ?_⟩
      have hxD : x ∈ D := by rw [hDZ]; exact ⟨hxF, hxZ⟩
      rw [← hDeq] at hxD
      exact ⟨hxD.1.2, hxD.2⟩
    · intro hx
      rw [hF'def] at hx
      obtain ⟨hxF, hxZ⟩ := hx
      refine ⟨hxF, fun hxR => hxZ ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨hxT, hxb⟩ := hxR
      have h1 : -b < ρ x := hxb
      rw [hρTt x hxT] at h1
      rw [hZdef]
      exact ⟨hTtT hxT, show w x < b by linarith⟩
  
  
  
  have hpd : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (h : E3 → ℝ),
      partialDeriv i (fun z => -h z) = fun z => -partialDeriv i h z := by
    intro i h
    funext z
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [show (fun z => -h z) = -h from rfl, fderiv_neg]
    rfl
  have hhess : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) (y : E3),
      hessLoc G (fun z => -h z) i j y = -hessLoc G h i j y := by
    intro G h i j y
    simp only [hessLoc, hpd]
    simp only [mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    ring
  have hlap : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      lapLoc G (fun z => -h z) y = -lapLoc G h y := by
    intro G h y
    simp only [lapLoc, hhess, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  have hneg_lmc : ∀ (f : M → ℝ) (p : M),
      g.levelMeanCurv (fun x => -f x) p = -g.levelMeanCurv f p := by
    intro f p
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.levelMeanCurv, RiemannianMetric3.gradInner]
    rw [hlap (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))]
    simp only [hpd, hhess, neg_mul, mul_neg, neg_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    ring
  have hposD : ∀ x ∈ D, 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ x := by
    intro x hx
    have hxT := hDTt hx
    have h1 : g.levelMeanCurv ρ x = -g.levelMeanCurv (fun y => μ₀ y * w y) x := by
      rw [hρdef]
      exact hneg_lmc (fun y => μ₀ y * w y) x
    rw [levelMeanCurv_congr_of_eventuallyEq g _ w x (hgerm x hxT)] at h1
    have hx' := hx
    rw [hDdef] at hx'
    obtain ⟨⟨hxF, hxT'⟩, hxb⟩ := hx'
    have hxb' : w x < b := hxb
    have h0 := hFT x ⟨hxF, hxT'⟩
    have h2 := hmc x hxT' (by linarith) hxb'.le
    linarith
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨Ωs, hΩsdef⟩ : ∃ Ωs : Set M, Ωs = U ∩ {x | 3 / 4 < ζ x} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΩso : IsOpen Ωs := by rw [hΩsdef]; exact hU.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hζcont)
  have hΩsTt : Ωs ⊆ Tt := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hΩsdef] at hx
    have h1 : (3 / 4 : ℝ) < ζ x := hx.2
    exact hζTt (hsuppζ x (show (0 : ℝ) < ζ x by linarith).ne')
  have hSlΩs : Sl ⊆ Ωs := fun x hx => by
    rw [hΩsdef]
    exact ⟨hSlU hx, show (3 / 4 : ℝ) < ζ x by rw [hζ1 x (hSlOζ hx)]; norm_num⟩
  have hP0 : calPartition (fun j : Fin 0 => (j.elim0 : M))
      (fun j : Fin 0 => (j.elim0 : M → ℝ)) Ωs :=
    ⟨fun j => j.elim0, fun j => j.elim0, fun x => by simp, fun j => j.elim0⟩
  obtain ⟨n0, q0, φ0, O0, hφ0, hO0o, hKO0, hφ01, -⟩ := calPartition_extend g Ωs hΩso _ _ hP0 ∅
    isOpen_empty (fun x hx => hx.elim) Sl hslab hSlΩs
  have hDO0 : D ⊆ O0 := fun x hx => hKO0 (Or.inl (hDSl hx))
  obtain ⟨Gain, hGain⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ,
      calVolSum g q0 φ0 D (fun x => g.levelMeanCurv ρ x) = G := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hY0 : calSmoothField (0 : M → E3) := by
    intro q
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, map_zero]
    exact contDiffOn_const
  have hY01 : ∀ x, g.g x ((0 : M → E3) x) ((0 : M → E3) x) ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    simp
  have hDO0' : F ∩ Tt ∩ {x | -b < ρ x} ⊆ O0 := by rw [hDeq]; exact hDO0
  obtain ⟨hint0, -⟩ := slab_calibration_step g ρ (-b) Tt Ωs F O0 hρs hTto hdρ hΩsTt hFm q0 φ0
    hφ0 hO0o hφ01 hDO0' 0 hY0 hY01 1 one_pos

        rintro ⟨α, β⟩

        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_coe, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, map_add, map_smul,

        refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
        · simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.smul_fst, smul_eq_mul]
          rw [mul_zero, add_zero, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hw]
        · simp only [Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul]
          ring
      have hmap := (hstrict.prodMk hG).map_nhds_eq_of_surj hsurj
      have himg : (fun z : E3 => (F z, z a - u (sepPlaneProj a z))) '' Metric.ball c ε ∈

        rw [← hmap]; exact Filter.image_mem_map hBn
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hball'⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.1 himg

      have h1 := hzer z hz hHz.1

    have hΨ : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun z => Pclm z + F z • e a) (Pclm + F'.smulRight (e a)) c :=

      have hval : F' (Pclm y) + (y a - F' (Pclm y)) / F' (e a) * F' (e a) = y a := by

        ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, map_add, map_smul, hPP, hPe]

    have himg2 : (fun z => Pclm z + F z • e a) '' Metric.ball c ε ∈

  have hBn : Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hε)
  have hFc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (f ⟨0, hk⟩) (chartAt E3 p p) := (hfC ⟨0, hk⟩).contDiffAt hBn
  have hstrict : HasStrictFDerivAt (f ⟨0, hk⟩) (fderiv ℝ (f ⟨0, hk⟩) (chartAt E3 p p))

  obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, hball₁⟩ := key (f ⟨0, hk⟩) (chartAt E3 p p) ε hε hstrict
    (hfd ⟨0, hk⟩ _ (Metric.mem_ball_self hε)) (hf0 ⟨0, hk⟩) hzer
  refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p) ⁻¹' sepCyl a (chartAt E3 p p) (min r ε₁) δ,

  · exact Filter.inter_mem ((chartAt E3 p).open_source.mem_nhds hpsrc)

      ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hxc'.1 (min_le_left _ _), hxc'.2⟩

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (S : ℕ → Set M) (hS : ∀ n, IsCompact (S n) ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (S n)) (m : ℕ)

    (W : Set E3) (hW : W ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)) :
    ∃ (ε : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (f : Fin k → E3 → ℝ), 0 < ε ∧ 0 < k ∧
      Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε ⊆ W ∩ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) (Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε)) ∧
      (∀ i, f i (chartAt E3 p p) = 0) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε, fderiv ℝ (f i) z ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) ε, f i z = 0 →
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (f i) z = 0) ∧

    intro x hx x' hx'

  have hloc : ∀ y ∈ T, HolderOnWith M (1 / 2 : NNReal) (smthGrad w) (Metric.ball y (R / 4)) ∧

        fun x hx i j => (hQa i j).1 x (hsub1 hx),
        hHa.mono hsub1,
        fun x hx i => (hQF i).1 x (hsub1 hx),
        hHF.mono hsub1,
        fun x hx => hwB x (hsub1 hx),
        (hw.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).mono hsubD,

  have hgradC : ∀ {f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ}, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f S → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => smthGrad f y k) S :=
    fun hf k => ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hS).1 hf).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hsymm : ∀ (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f S → ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      smthGrad (fun z => smthGrad f z j) y i = smthGrad (fun z => smthGrad f z i) y j := by
    intro f hf y hy i j
    have hFy : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f y := hf.contDiffAt (hS.mem_nhds hy)
    have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f y := hFy.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
    have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y :=
      ((((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hS).1 hf).2).contDiffAt
        (hS.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have key : ∀ k : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun z => smthGrad f z k) y =
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y).flip (Pi.single k 1) := by
      intro k
      have h1 := fderiv_clm_apply hd2
        (differentiableAt_const (Pi.single k (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ))
      rw [fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_zero, zero_add] at h1
      exact h1
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => smthGrad f z j) y (Pi.single i 1) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => smthGrad f z i) y (Pi.single j 1)
    rw [key j, key i, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
    exact hsym _ _
  
  have hexp : ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      smthGrad (fun z => ∑ j : Fin 2, a z i j * smthGrad w z j - F z i) y m =
        ∑ j : Fin 2, (smthGrad (fun z => a z i j) y m * smthGrad w y j +
          a y i j * smthGrad (fun z => smthGrad w z j) y m) - smthGrad (fun z => F z i) y m := by
    intro y hy i
    have hprod : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => a z i j * smthGrad w z j) y :=
      fun j => (hSx (ha i j) y hy).mul (hSx (hgradC hw j) y hy)
    have hfun : (fun z => ∑ j : Fin 2, a z i j * smthGrad w z j - F z i) =
        (fun z => (a z i 0 * smthGrad w z 0 + a z i 1 * smthGrad w z 1) - F z i) := by
      funext z
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hsumd : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => a z i 0 * smthGrad w z 0 + a z i 1 * smthGrad w z 1) y :=
      (hprod 0).add (hprod 1)
    show fderiv ℝ _ y (Pi.single m 1) = _
    rw [hfun, fderiv_fun_sub hsumd (hSx (hF i) y hy),
      fderiv_fun_add (hprod 0) (hprod 1),
      fderiv_fun_mul (hSx (ha i 0) y hy) (hSx (hgradC hw 0) y hy),
      fderiv_fun_mul (hSx (ha i 1) y hy) (hSx (hgradC hw 1) y hy)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    unfold smthGrad
    ring
  
  have hflux : ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      (∑ j : Fin 2, a y i j * smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad w x m) y j
        - (smthGrad (fun y => F y i) y m -
          ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) y m * smthGrad w y j))
      = smthGrad (fun z => ∑ j : Fin 2, a z i j * smthGrad w z j - F z i) y m := by
    intro y hy i
    rw [hexp y hy i]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hsymm w hw y hy m 0, hsymm w hw y hy m 1]
    ring
  
  have hV : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ j : Fin 2, a z i j * smthGrad w z j - F z i) S :=
    fun i => (ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => (ha i j).mul (hgradC hw j))).sub (hF i)
  
  unfold mseDivSol
  intro x hx
  have hloc : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      smthGrad (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 2, a y i j * smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad w x m) y j
        - (smthGrad (fun y => F y i) y m -
          ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) y m * smthGrad w y j)) x i
      = smthGrad (fun y => smthGrad
          (fun z => ∑ j : Fin 2, a z i j * smthGrad w z j - F z i) y m) x i := by
    intro i
    have hev : (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 2, a y i j * smthGrad (fun x => smthGrad w x m) y j
        - (smthGrad (fun y => F y i) y m -
          ∑ j : Fin 2, smthGrad (fun y => a y i j) y m * smthGrad w y j)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => smthGrad
          (fun z => ∑ j : Fin 2, a z i j * smthGrad w z j - F z i) y m) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hS.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hflux y hy i)
    show fderiv ℝ _ x (Pi.single i 1) = fderiv ℝ _ x (Pi.single i 1)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hloc i),
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hsymm _ (hV i) x hx i m)]
  
  have hev2 : (fun y => smthGrad (fun z => ∑ j : Fin 2, a z 0 j * smthGrad w z j - F z 0) y 0
      + smthGrad (fun z => ∑ j : Fin 2, a z 1 j * smthGrad w z j - F z 1) y 1)
      =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hS.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => by
      have h := hsol y hy
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
      exact h)
  have hd0 := hev2.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
  rw [fderiv_const_apply, fderiv_fun_add (hSx (hgradC (hV 0) 0) x hx)
    (hSx (hgradC (hV 1) 1) x hx)] at hd0
  have h2 := congrArg (fun L => L (Pi.single m (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ)) hd0
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h2
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  exact h2

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (U : Set M) (hUo : IsOpen U) (Ψ : C(M, Circle))
    (hΨs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) ∞ (fun x : M => (Ψ x : ℂ)))
    (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (hΨK : ∀ x : M, x ∉ K → Ψ x = 1) :
    ∃ (K' : Set M) (φ₀ : M → ℝ), IsCompact K' ∧ K ⊆ K' ∧ K' ⊆ U ∧
      (∀ x : M, Circle.exp (φ₀ x) = Ψ x) ∧ (∀ x : M, x ∉ K' → φ₀ x = 0) ∧
      dualChartMeas φ₀ ∧
      ∀ Ω Kc : Set M, IsOpen Ω → IsClosed Kc → Disjoint Kc K' →
        dualRiemVar g (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) φ₀ Ω Kc < ⊤

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have first_hit : ∀ {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n → ℝ), (∀ j, a j = 0 ∨ a j = 1) →
      ((∀ j, a j = 0) ∧ ∑ j, a j * (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - a l)) * b j = 0) ∨
        ∃ j, a j = 1 ∧ ∑ j', a j' * (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j', (1 - a l)) * b j' = b j := by
    intro n a b ha
    by_cases h : ∀ j, a j = 0
    · left
      refine ⟨h, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun j _ => ?_)⟩
      rw [h j]; ring
    · right
      push_neg at h
      have hne : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => a j = 1)).Nonempty := by
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h
        refine ⟨j, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩⟩
        rcases ha j with h0 | h1
        · exact absurd h0 hj
        · exact h1
      have hj₀ : a ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => a j = 1)).min' hne) = 1 :=
        (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.min'_mem _ hne)).2
      have hlt : ∀ l, l < (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => a j = 1)).min' hne → a l = 0 := by
        intro l hl
        rcases ha l with h0 | h1
        · exact h0
        · exact absurd (Finset.min'_le _ l (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h1⟩))
            (not_le.2 hl)
      refine ⟨(Finset.univ.filter (fun j => a j = 1)).min' hne, hj₀, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => a j = 1)).min' hne)]
      · have hP : ∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio ((Finset.univ.filter (fun j => a j = 1)).min' hne),
            (1 - a l) = 1 :=
          Finset.prod_eq_one (fun l hl => by rw [hlt l (Finset.mem_Iio.1 hl)]; ring)
        rw [hP, hj₀]; ring
      · intro j' _ hj'
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hj' with hl | hg
        · rw [hlt j' hl]; ring
        · rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_Iio.2 hg) (by rw [hj₀]; ring)]; ring
      · intro h'
        exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h'
  
  obtain ⟨N, x, r, ℓ, O, hr, hO, hOt, hOU, hQO, hℓs, hℓΨ, hℓB, hcovK⟩ :=
    dual_cube_cover U hUo Ψ hΨs K hK hKU
  have hs2 := fun j : Fin N => plateau_cube_seq (chartAt E3 (x j) (x j)) (r j) (hr j)
  choose χ Cχ hχs hχ01 hχ1 hχsupp hχev hcube hχint using hs2
  have hQ3c : ∀ j : Fin N,
      IsCompact {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 3 * r j} :=
    fun j => hcube j (3 * r j)
  have hQ3t : ∀ j : Fin N,
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 3 * r j} ⊆
        (chartAt E3 (x j)).target := fun j => (hQO j).trans (hOt j)
  have hQ23 : ∀ j : Fin N,
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 2 * r j} ⊆
        {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 3 * r j} := by
    intro j y hy
    have hy' : ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 2 * r j := hy
    show ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 3 * r j
    intro i
    have h1 := hy' i
    have h2 := hr j
    linarith
  have hs3 := fun j : Fin N => chart_bump_family_le g (x j) _ (hQ3c j) (hQ3t j)
  choose c' hc'0 hfam' using hs3
  have hK3c : ∀ j : Fin N, IsCompact ((chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 3 * r j}) :=
    fun j => (hQ3c j).image_of_continuousOn
      ((chartAt E3 (x j)).continuousOn_symm.mono (hQ3t j))
  
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : ℕ → Fin N → M → ℝ, u = fun m j =>
      (chartAt E3 (x j)).source.indicator (fun z => χ j m (chartAt E3 (x j) z)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ : ∃ Λ : Fin N → M → ℝ, Λ = fun j =>
      (chartAt E3 (x j)).source.indicator (fun z => ℓ j (chartAt E3 (x j) z)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : Fin N → M → ℝ, a = fun j =>
      ((chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
        {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 2 * r j}).indicator
        (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K', hK'⟩ : ∃ K' : Set M, K' = ⋃ j, (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 3 * r j} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : ℕ → M → ℝ, φ = fun m z =>
      ∑ j, u m j z * (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - u m l z)) * Λ j z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨φ₀, hφ₀⟩ : ∃ φ₀ : M → ℝ, φ₀ = fun z =>
      ∑ j, a j z * (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - a l z)) * Λ j z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hu_src : ∀ m j z, z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source →
      u m j z = χ j m (chartAt E3 (x j) z) := by
    intro m j z hz; rw [hu]; exact Set.indicator_of_mem hz _
  have hu_nsrc : ∀ m j z, z ∉ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source → u m j z = 0 := by
    intro m j z hz; rw [hu]; exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hz _
  have hΛ_src : ∀ j z, z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source → Λ j z = ℓ j (chartAt E3 (x j) z) := by
    intro j z hz; rw [hΛ]; exact Set.indicator_of_mem hz _
  have hΛ_nsrc : ∀ j z, z ∉ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source → Λ j z = 0 := by
    intro j z hz; rw [hΛ]; exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hz _
  have hfQ : ∀ j m, ∀ y, y ∉ {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 3 * r j} →
      χ j m y = 0 := by
    intro j m y hy
    by_contra hne
    apply hy
    show ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 3 * r j
    intro i
    have h1 := hχsupp j m y hne i
    have h2 := hr j
    linarith
  have h7 : ∀ m j, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u m j) ∧ ∀ z, u m j z ≠ 0 →
      z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
        {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 3 * r j} := by
    intro m j
    rw [hu]
    exact chart_extend_contMDiff (x j) (χ j m) (hχs j m) _ (hQ3c j) (hQ3t j) (hfQ j m)
  have hu01 : ∀ m j z, 0 ≤ u m j z ∧ u m j z ≤ 1 := by
    intro m j z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source
    · rw [hu_src m j z hz]; exact hχ01 j m _
    · rw [hu_nsrc m j z hz]; exact ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩
  have hutsupp : ∀ m j, tsupport (u m j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 3 * r j} := fun m j =>
    closure_minimal (fun z hz => (h7 m j).2 z (Function.mem_support.1 hz)) (hK3c j).isClosed
  have hK3D : ∀ j : Fin N, (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 3 * r j} ⊆
        (chartAt E3 (x j)).source ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) ⁻¹' O j := by
    rintro j _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 (x j)).map_target (hQ3t j hy), ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, (chartAt E3 (x j)).right_inv (hQ3t j hy)]
    exact hQO j hy
  have hDo : ∀ j : Fin N, IsOpen ((chartAt E3 (x j)).source ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) ⁻¹' O j) :=
    fun j => (chartAt E3 (x j)).isOpen_inter_preimage (hO j)
  have hΛs : ∀ j : Fin N, ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (Λ j)
      ((chartAt E3 (x j)).source ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) ⁻¹' O j) := by
    intro j
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun z => ℓ j (chartAt E3 (x j) z))
        ((chartAt E3 (x j)).source ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) ⁻¹' O j) :=
      (hℓs j).contMDiffOn.comp (contMDiffOn_chart.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (fun z hz => hz.2)
    exact h1.congr (fun z hz => hΛ_src j z hz.1)
  have hΛΨ : ∀ j : Fin N, ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source ∩ chartAt E3 (x j) ⁻¹' O j,
      Circle.exp (Λ j z) = Ψ z := by
    intro j z hz
    rw [hΛ_src j z hz.1, hℓΨ j _ hz.2, (chartAt E3 (x j)).left_inv hz.1]
  have hΛB : ∀ j z, |Λ j z| ≤ 2 * Real.pi := by
    intro j z
    by_cases hz : z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source
    · rw [hΛ_src j z hz]; exact hℓB _ _
    · rw [hΛ_nsrc j z hz, abs_zero]; positivity
  have hcovQ : ∀ z ∈ K, ∃ j, z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source ∧ chartAt E3 (x j) z ∈
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 2 * r j} := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨j, hzs, hzc⟩ := hcovK z hz
    refine ⟨j, hzs, ?_⟩
    show ∀ i : Fin 3, |chartAt E3 (x j) z i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 2 * r j
    intro i
    have h1 := hzc i
    have h2 := hr j
    linarith
  have hcov : ∀ m, ∀ z ∈ K, ∃ j, u m j z = 1 := by
    intro m z hz
    obtain ⟨j, hzs, hzQ⟩ := hcovQ z hz
    exact ⟨j, by rw [hu_src m j z hzs]; exact hχ1 j m _ hzQ⟩
  have hA_src : ∀ j z, z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 2 * r j} →
      z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source ∧ chartAt E3 (x j) z ∈
        {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 2 * r j} := by
    rintro j _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 (x j)).map_target (hQ3t j (hQ23 j hy)), ?_⟩
    rw [(chartAt E3 (x j)).right_inv (hQ3t j (hQ23 j hy))]
    exact hy
  have ha1 : ∀ j z, z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 2 * r j} → a j z = 1 := by
    intro j z hz; rw [ha]; exact Set.indicator_of_mem hz _
  have ha0 : ∀ j z, z ∉ (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 2 * r j} → a j z = 0 := by
    intro j z hz; rw [ha]; exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hz _
  
  have hK'c : IsCompact K' := by rw [hK']; exact isCompact_iUnion hK3c
  have hK'U : K' ⊆ U := by
    rw [hK']
    refine Set.iUnion_subset (fun j => ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hOU j ⟨y, hQO j hy, rfl⟩
  have hAK' : ∀ j z, z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).symm ''
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 2 * r j} → z ∈ K' := by
    rintro j _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [hK']
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, y, hQ23 j hy, rfl⟩
  have hKK' : K ⊆ K' := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨j, hzs, hzQ⟩ := hcovQ z hz
    exact hAK' j z ⟨_, hzQ, (chartAt E3 (x j)).left_inv hzs⟩
  
  have hconv : ∀ j z, Tendsto (fun m => u m j z) atTop (𝓝 (a j z)) := by
    intro j z
    by_cases hzs : z ∈ (chartAt E3 (x j)).source
    · by_cases hzQ : chartAt E3 (x j) z ∈
          {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, |y i - chartAt E3 (x j) (x j) i| ≤ 2 * r j}
      · rw [ha1 j z ⟨_, hzQ, (chartAt E3 (x j)).left_inv hzs⟩]
        refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr (fun m => ?_)
        rw [hu_src m j z hzs, hχ1 j m _ hzQ]
      · rw [ha0 j z (fun hzA => hzQ (hA_src j z hzA).2)]
        refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
        filter_upwards [hχev j _ hzQ] with m hm
        rw [hu_src m j z hzs, hm]
    · rw [ha0 j z (fun hzA => hzs (hA_src j z hzA).1)]
      exact tendsto_const_nhds.congr (fun m => (hu_nsrc m j z hzs).symm)
  have hlim : ∀ z, Tendsto (fun m => φ m z) atTop (𝓝 (φ₀ z)) := by
    intro z
