proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨V, hVs, hVτ⟩ := tau_gradient_field g X hX τ hτs hτr
  have hloc : ∀ x₀ ∈ X, ∃ (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (ψ : M → ℝ → M), IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ X ∧
      0 < ε ∧ ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => ψ p.1 p.2) (N ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ N, ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, ψ x s ∈ X :=
    fun x₀ hx₀ => local_flow_of_contMDiffAt X hX V x₀ hx₀ (hVs x₀ hx₀)
  have huniq : ∀ (γ γ' : ℝ → M) (α β t₀ : ℝ), t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → IsMIntegralCurveOn γ' V (Set.Ioo α β) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ' t ∈ X) → γ t₀ = γ' t₀ →
      Set.EqOn γ γ' (Set.Ioo α β) :=
    fun γ γ' α β t₀ ht₀ hγ hγ' hγX hγ'X h₀ =>
      integral_curve_eqOn_of_mem X V hVs γ γ' α β t₀ ht₀ hγ hγ' hγX hγ'X h₀
  have hτlin : ∀ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β s₀ : ℝ), s₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) →
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo α β, τ (γ s) = τ (γ s₀) + (s - s₀) :=
    fun γ α β s₀ hs₀ hγ hγX =>
      tau_affine_along_integral_curve X hX τ hτs V hVτ γ α β s₀ hs₀ hγ hγX
  have hunif : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → ∃ (O : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (Ψ : M → ℝ → M),
      IsOpen O ∧ X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Ψ p.1 p.2) (O ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, Ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (Ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, Ψ x s ∈ X :=
    fun c d hc hd => uniform_flow_on_compact X (X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d) Set.inter_subset_left
      (hτp c d hc hd) V hloc huniq
  have hunif' : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → ∃ (O : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (Ψ : M → ℝ → M),
      X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, Ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (Ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, Ψ x s ∈ X := by
    intro c d hc hd
    obtain ⟨O, ε, Ψ, _, h1, h2, h3, _, h5⟩ := hunif c d hc hd
    exact ⟨O, ε, Ψ, h1, h2, h3, h5⟩
  have hlong : ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ T₁ T₂ : ℝ, T₁ ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ T₂ → a < τ x + T₁ → τ x + T₂ < b →
      ∃ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β : ℝ), α < T₁ ∧ T₂ < β ∧ γ 0 = x ∧
        IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X :=
    fun x hx T₁ T₂ h1 h2 h3 h4 =>
      long_integral_curve_exists X τ a b V hτb huniq hτlin hunif' x hx T₁ T₂ h1 h2 h3 h4
  obtain ⟨Θ, hF1, hF2, -, hF4⟩ :=
    global_flow_assembly X hX τ a b hτs.continuousOn hτb V huniq hτlin hunif hlong
  exact ⟨Θ, hF1, hF2, hF4⟩

    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (hUo : IsOpen U)
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x ∧ σ x < ε)
    (hσp : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d))
    (hWO : ∀ (x₀ : M) (a b : ℝ) (w : M → ℝ), x₀ ∈ U ∩ N → 0 < a → a < b → b < ε →
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, σ x ≤ a → w x < 0) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, b ≤ σ x → 0 < w x) →
      (∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) →
      ∃ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ g.levelMeanCurv w x)
    (x₀ : M) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U ∩ N)
    (hthin : ∀ O : Set M, IsOpen O →
      closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ O →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < ε ∧ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ ⊆ O)
    (O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (hO : IsOpen O) (hwc : ContinuousOn w O)
    (hw0 : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ frontier U → w x = 0)
    (hwpos : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∉ frontier U → 0 < w x)
    (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O \ frontier U))
    (hdw : ∀ x ∈ O \ frontier U, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ x ∈ O \ frontier U, g.levelMeanCurv w x < 0)
    (hFCO : closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ O) :
    False

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  haveI : LocallyConnectedSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyConnectedSpace E3 M
  
  have s1 : ∀ (W v : M → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : M), W =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => v z - t) →
      g.levelMeanCurv W x = g.levelMeanCurv v x := by
    intro W v t x h
    have hT : Tendsto (chartAt E3 x).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 x x)) (𝓝 x) := by
      have h1 := (chartAt E3 x).continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 x)
      rw [ContinuousAt, (chartAt E3 x).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x)] at h1
      exact h1
    have ha : (fun y => W ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 x x)]
        (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 x).symm y) - t) := hT.eventually h
    have hb : ∀ j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv j (fun y => W ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) =
          partialDeriv j (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) := by
      intro j
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [ha.fderiv_eq, fderiv_sub_const]
    have hc : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun y => W ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 x x)]
        partialDeriv j (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) := by
      intro j
      filter_upwards [ha.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)] with y hy
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hy, fderiv_sub_const]
    have hd : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => W ((chartAt E3 x).symm y))) (chartAt E3 x x) =
          partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 x).symm y))) (chartAt E3 x x) := by
      intro i j
      show fderiv ℝ _ _ (e i) = fderiv ℝ _ _ (e i)
      rw [(hc j).fderiv_eq]
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.levelMeanCurv, RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, lapLoc, hessLoc,
      hb, hd]
  
  have s2 : ∀ (W v : M → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : M), W =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => v z - t) →
      MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) v x →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) W x = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) v x := by
    intro W v t x h hv
    rw [h.mfderiv_eq]
    have h2 := hv.hasMFDerivAt.sub (hasMFDerivAt_const (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)) t x)
    rw [sub_zero] at h2
    exact h2.mfderiv
  
  have s3 : ∀ (X K : Set M), IsOpen X → IsCompact K → K ⊆ X → ∀ y₀ : M,
      IsCompact (connectedComponentIn X y₀ ∩ K) := by
    intro X K hX hK hKX y₀
    have hcl : closure (connectedComponentIn X y₀) ∩ X ⊆ connectedComponentIn X y₀ := by
      rintro y ⟨hy, hyX⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hzy, hzD⟩ := _root_.mem_closure_iff.1 hy _ hX.connectedComponentIn
        (mem_connectedComponentIn hyX)
      rw [connectedComponentIn_eq hzD, ← connectedComponentIn_eq hzy]
      exact mem_connectedComponentIn hyX
    have heq : connectedComponentIn X y₀ ∩ K = closure (connectedComponentIn X y₀) ∩ K := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · exact Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ subset_closure
      · rintro y ⟨hy, hyK⟩
        exact ⟨hcl ⟨hy, hKX hyK⟩, hyK⟩
    rw [heq]
    exact hK.inter_left isClosed_closure
  
  have s4 : ∀ m : ℝ, 0 < m → ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ ∧
      (∀ s : ℝ, s ≤ m / 2 → ψ s = s - m / 4) ∧
      (∀ s : ℝ, 3 * m / 4 ≤ s → ψ s = 1) ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, m / 2 < s → 0 < ψ s) := by
    intro m hm
    refine ⟨fun s => (1 - Real.smoothTransition ((s - m / 2) / (m / 4))) * (s - m / 4) +
      Real.smoothTransition ((s - m / 2) / (m / 4)), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hρ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => Real.smoothTransition ((s - m / 2) / (m / 4))) :=
        Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).div_const _)
      exact ((contDiff_const.sub hρ).mul (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)).add hρ
    · intro s hs
      have h0 : (s - m / 2) / (m / 4) ≤ 0 :=
        div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
      simp only [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos h0]
      ring
    · intro s hs
      have h1 : 1 ≤ (s - m / 2) / (m / 4) := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        linarith
      simp only [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le h1]
      ring
    · intro s hs
      have hn := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg ((s - m / 2) / (m / 4))
      have hl := Real.smoothTransition.le_one ((s - m / 2) / (m / 4))
      have hA : 0 < s - m / 4 := by linarith
      dsimp only
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hl with h | h
      · have := mul_pos (sub_pos.2 h) hA
        linarith
      · rw [h]
        linarith
  
  set C := connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ with hCdef
  have hCX : C ⊆ U ∩ N := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _
  have hCF : ∀ x ∈ C, x ∉ frontier U := by
    intro x hx hxF
    rw [hUo.frontier_eq] at hxF
    exact hxF.2 (hCX hx).1
  have hX : IsOpen (U ∩ N) := hUo.inter hNo
  have hσc : ContinuousOn σ (U ∩ N) := hσs.continuousOn
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδε, hδ⟩ := hthin O hO hFCO
  have hCO : ∀ x ∈ C, σ x < δ → x ∈ O \ frontier U := fun x hx hσx =>
    ⟨hδ ⟨hx, (le_of_lt hσx : σ x ≤ δ)⟩, hCF x hx⟩
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm0, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ x ∈ C, δ / 2 ≤ σ x → σ x ≤ δ → m ≤ w x := by
    have hK : IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc (δ / 2) δ) := hσp (δ / 2) δ (by linarith) hδε
    have hB := s3 (U ∩ N) _ hX hK Set.inter_subset_left x₀
    rcases (C ∩ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc (δ / 2) δ)).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hE | hne
    · refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun x hx h1 h2 => ?_⟩
      exfalso
      have hxB : x ∈ C ∩ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc (δ / 2) δ) := ⟨hx, hCX hx, h1, h2⟩
      rw [hE] at hxB
      exact hxB
    · have hBO : C ∩ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc (δ / 2) δ) ⊆ O := fun x hx =>
        hδ ⟨hx.1, (hx.2.2.2 : σ x ≤ δ)⟩
      obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hmin⟩ := hB.exists_isMinOn hne (hwc.mono hBO)
      refine ⟨w x₁, hwpos x₁ (hBO hx₁) (hCF x₁ hx₁.1), fun x hx h1 h2 => ?_⟩
      exact (isMinOn_iff.1 hmin) x ⟨hx, hCX hx, h1, h2⟩
  
  have hO₂ : IsOpen (O ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Iio (m / 4)) := hwc.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_Iio
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀0, ha₀ε, ha₀⟩ := hthin (O ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Iio (m / 4)) hO₂ (by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨hFCO hx, ?_⟩
    show w x < m / 4
    rw [hw0 x (hFCO hx) hx.2]
    linarith)
  obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = min a₀ (δ / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by rw [ha_def]; exact lt_min ha₀0 (by linarith)
  have haa₀ : a ≤ a₀ := by rw [ha_def]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have haδ : a ≤ δ / 2 := by rw [ha_def]; exact min_le_right _ _
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψs, hψlin, hψone, hψpos⟩ := s4 m hm0
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : M → ℝ, W = fun x => if σ x < δ then ψ (w x) else 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW1 : ∀ x, σ x < δ → W x = ψ (w x) := fun x h => by rw [hW]; exact if_pos h
  have hW2 : ∀ x, ¬ σ x < δ → W x = 1 := fun x h => by rw [hW]; exact if_neg h
  have hR2 : ∀ x ∈ C, δ / 2 < σ x → W x = 1 := by
    intro x hx h
    by_cases hlt : σ x < δ
    · rw [hW1 x hlt]
      apply hψone
      have := hm x hx h.le hlt.le
      linarith
    · exact hW2 x hlt
  
  have hWs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ W C := by
    apply contMDiffOn_of_locally_contMDiffOn
    intro x hx
    by_cases hlt : σ x < δ
    · refine ⟨U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ, hσc.isOpen_inter_preimage hX isOpen_Iio,
        ⟨hCX hx, hlt⟩, ?_⟩
      have hsub : C ∩ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ) ⊆ O \ frontier U := fun z hz =>
        hCO z hz.1 hz.2.2
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun z => ψ (w z))
          (C ∩ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)) :=
        hψs.contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn (hws.mono hsub)
      exact h1.congr (fun z hz => hW1 z hz.2.2)
    · refine ⟨U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (δ / 2), hσc.isOpen_inter_preimage hX isOpen_Ioi,
        ⟨hCX hx, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · show δ / 2 < σ x
        push_neg at hlt
        linarith
      · exact contMDiffOn_const.congr (fun z hz => hR2 z hz.1 hz.2.2)
  
  have hneg : ∀ x ∈ C, σ x ≤ a → W x < 0 := by
    intro x hx h
    have h1 := ha₀ ⟨hx, (le_trans h haa₀ : σ x ≤ a₀)⟩
    have h1' : w x < m / 4 := h1.2
    have hlt : σ x < δ := by linarith
    rw [hW1 x hlt, hψlin (w x) (by linarith)]
    linarith
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ C, δ ≤ σ x → 0 < W x := by
    intro x hx h
    rw [hW2 x (not_lt.2 h)]
    exact one_pos
  
  have hzero : ∀ x ∈ C, W x = 0 → W =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => w z - m / 4) ∧ x ∈ O \ frontier U := by
    intro x hx h0
    have hlt : σ x < δ := by
      by_contra hc
      rw [hW2 x hc] at h0
      exact one_ne_zero h0
    have hxO := hCO x hx hlt
    rw [hW1 x hlt] at h0
    have hle : w x ≤ m / 2 := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have := hψpos (w x) hc
      linarith
    have hwx : w x = m / 4 := by
      rw [hψlin _ hle] at h0
      linarith
    refine ⟨?_, hxO⟩
    have hVo : IsOpen ((U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ) ∩ (O ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Iio (m / 2))) :=
      (hσc.isOpen_inter_preimage hX isOpen_Iio).inter (hwc.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_Iio)
    have hxV : x ∈ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ) ∩ (O ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Iio (m / 2)) :=
      ⟨⟨hCX hx, hlt⟩, hxO.1, show w x < m / 2 by linarith⟩
    filter_upwards [hVo.mem_nhds hxV] with z hz
    rw [hW1 z hz.1.2, hψlin _ (le_of_lt hz.2.2)]
  
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hWx, hHx⟩ := hWO x₀ a δ W hx₀ ha0 (by linarith) hδε hWs hneg hpos (by
    intro x hx h0
    obtain ⟨hev, hxO⟩ := hzero x hx h0
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x :=
      (hws.contMDiffAt ((hO.sdiff isClosed_frontier).mem_nhds hxO)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    rw [s2 W w (m / 4) x hev hmd]
    exact hdw x hxO)
  obtain ⟨hev, hxO⟩ := hzero x hx hWx
  rw [s1 W w (m / 4) x hev] at hHx
  have := hH x hxO
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i)
    (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hFx : F x ∈ U)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (hdΦ : fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) ≠ 0)
    (htan : ∀ i : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) = 0) :
    scalarCurvatureLocal G (F x) =
      2 * ejpRic G Φ (F x) + 2 * gsAmbPlane G F x / (pullMetric2 G F x).det

signature.name: jcc_scalar_trace
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i)
    (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hFx : F x ∈ U)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (hdΦ : fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) ≠ 0)
    (htan : ∀ i : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) = 0) :
    scalarCurvatureLocal G (F x) =
      2 * ejpRic G Φ (F x) + 2 * gsAmbPlane G F x / (pullMetric2 G F x).det

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have cross : ∀ (Rm : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P Gi : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (N : Fin 3 → ℝ) (S : ℝ),
      (∀ i j k m : Fin 3, Rm i j k m = -Rm j i k m) →
      (∀ i j k m : Fin 3, Rm i j k m = -Rm i j m k) →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, Gi a b = P a b + N a * N b / S) →
      ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, Gi j k * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, Gi i m * Rm i j k m =
        ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, P i m * Rm i j k m +
          2 * ((∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
            (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, Gi i m * Rm i j k m) * N j * N k) / S) := by
    intro Rm P Gi N S h1 h2 hGi
    have z1 : ∀ i k m : Fin 3, Rm i i k m = 0 := fun i k m => by linarith [h1 i i k m]
    have z2 : ∀ i j k : Fin 3, Rm i j k k = 0 := fun i j k => by linarith [h2 i j k k]
    have a10 : ∀ k m : Fin 3, Rm 1 0 k m = -Rm 0 1 k m := fun k m => h1 1 0 k m
    have a20 : ∀ k m : Fin 3, Rm 2 0 k m = -Rm 0 2 k m := fun k m => h1 2 0 k m
    have a21 : ∀ k m : Fin 3, Rm 2 1 k m = -Rm 1 2 k m := fun k m => h1 2 1 k m
    have b10 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Rm i j 1 0 = -Rm i j 0 1 := fun i j => h2 i j 1 0
    have b20 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Rm i j 2 0 = -Rm i j 0 2 := fun i j => h2 i j 2 0
    have b21 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Rm i j 2 1 = -Rm i j 1 2 := fun i j => h2 i j 2 1
    simp only [hGi, Fin.sum_univ_three, z1, z2, a10, a20, a21, b10, b20, b21, neg_neg,
      mul_neg, neg_mul, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, neg_zero]
    ring
  
  have tang : ∀ (Rm : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (hm : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ i j k m : Fin 3, Rm i j k m = -Rm j i k m) →
      (∀ i j k m : Fin 3, Rm i j k m = -Rm i j m k) →
      ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ c d * T c j * T d k) *
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, (∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ c d * T c i * T d m) *
            Rm i j k m =
        2 * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
          Rm i j k m * T 0 i * T 1 j * T 1 k * T 0 m) / hm.det := by
    intro Rm hm T h1 h2
    have z1 : ∀ i k m : Fin 3, Rm i i k m = 0 := fun i k m => by linarith [h1 i i k m]
    have z2 : ∀ i j k : Fin 3, Rm i j k k = 0 := fun i j k => by linarith [h2 i j k k]
    have a10 : ∀ k m : Fin 3, Rm 1 0 k m = -Rm 0 1 k m := fun k m => h1 1 0 k m
    have a20 : ∀ k m : Fin 3, Rm 2 0 k m = -Rm 0 2 k m := fun k m => h1 2 0 k m
    have a21 : ∀ k m : Fin 3, Rm 2 1 k m = -Rm 1 2 k m := fun k m => h1 2 1 k m
    have b10 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Rm i j 1 0 = -Rm i j 0 1 := fun i j => h2 i j 1 0
    have b20 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Rm i j 2 0 = -Rm i j 0 2 := fun i j => h2 i j 2 0
    have b21 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, Rm i j 2 1 = -Rm i j 1 2 := fun i j => h2 i j 2 1
    have hdi : hm.det⁻¹ = hm⁻¹ 0 0 * hm⁻¹ 1 1 - hm⁻¹ 0 1 * hm⁻¹ 1 0 := by
      rw [← Matrix.det_fin_two, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, hdi]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_two, z1, z2, a10, a20, a21, b10, b20, b21,
      neg_neg, mul_neg, neg_mul, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, neg_zero]
    ring
  
  have hpos : (G (F x)).PosDef := hGpos (F x) hFx
  have hdet : (G (F x)).det ≠ 0 := hpos.det_pos.ne'
  
  have hrl : ∀ (l i j k : Fin 3) (y : E3),
      riemannLocal G l i j k y = -riemannLocal G l j i k y := by
    intro l i j k y
    simp only [riemannLocal, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    ring
  
  have hvec3 : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ c : Fin 3, v c • e c := by
    intro v
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have htan' : ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Φ (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) c = 0 := by
    intro i
    have h0 := htan i
    rw [hvec3 (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)), map_sum] at h0
    rw [← h0]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_)
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, partialDeriv, mul_comm]
  
  obtain ⟨-, -, hP, -⟩ := ejpl_proj_linalg G Φ F x hpos hdΦ hinj htan'
  have hGi : ∀ a b : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ a b =
      (∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ c d * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 c)) a *
        (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 d)) b) + ejpN G Φ (F x) a * ejpN G Φ (F x) b / ejpS G Φ (F x) := by
    intro a b
    have h := hP a b
    unfold ejpP at h
    linarith
  
  have hΓ := (ejp_coord_smooth G (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) U hU hG hGpos contDiffOn_const).2.2.1
  have h2 : ∀ i j k m : Fin 3,
      ∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) m l * riemannLocal G l i j k (F x) =
        -∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) k l * riemannLocal G l i j m (F x) :=
    amb_rm_antisymm G U hU hG hGsymm hGpos hΓ (F x) hFx
  
  have h1 : ∀ i j k m : Fin 3,
      ∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) m l * riemannLocal G l i j k (F x) =
        -∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) m l * riemannLocal G l j i k (F x) := by
    intro i j k m
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
    rw [hrl l i j k (F x)]
    ring
  
  have hδ : ∀ i l : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i m * G (F x) m l = if i = l then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i l
    have hGG : (G (F x))⁻¹ * G (F x) = 1 :=
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet)
    have := congrFun (congrFun hGG i) l
    rwa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
  have hraise : ∀ j k : Fin 3, ricci G j k (F x) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i m *
        ∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) m l * riemannLocal G l i j k (F x) := by
    intro j k
    have ha1 : ricci G j k (F x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, riemannLocal G i i j k (F x) := by
      simp only [ricci, riemannLocal, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [ha1]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    symm
    calc ∑ m : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i m * ∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) m l * riemannLocal G l i j k (F x)
        = ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ m : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i m * G (F x) m l) *
            riemannLocal G l i j k (F x) := by
          simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => ?_))
          ring
      _ = riemannLocal G i i j k (F x) := by
          simp only [hδ, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ,
            if_true]
  
  have hR : scalarCurvatureLocal G (F x) =
      ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ j k * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i m *
        ∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) m l * riemannLocal G l i j k (F x) := by
    unfold scalarCurvatureLocal
    simp only [hraise]
  have hRic : ejpRic G Φ (F x) =
      (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i m *
        ∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) m l * riemannLocal G l i j k (F x)) *
          ejpN G Φ (F x) j * ejpN G Φ (F x) k) / ejpS G Φ (F x) := by
    unfold ejpRic
    simp only [hraise]
  
  have hamb : gsAmbPlane G F x =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3,
        (∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) m l * riemannLocal G l i j k (F x)) *
          (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 0)) i * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1)) j * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1)) k *
            (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 0)) m := by
    unfold gsAmbPlane gsTan
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hX := cross (fun i j k m => ∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) m l * riemannLocal G l i j k (F x))
    (fun a b => ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ c d * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 c)) a *
        (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 d)) b)
    (fun a b => (G (F x))⁻¹ a b) (fun a => ejpN G Φ (F x) a) (ejpS G Φ (F x)) h1 h2 hGi
  have hY := tang (fun i j k m => ∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) m l * riemannLocal G l i j k (F x))
    (pullMetric2 G F x) (fun c a => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 c)) a) h1 h2
  beta_reduce at hX hY
  linear_combination hR + hX + hY - 2 * hRic - (2 / (pullMetric2 G F x).det) * hamb

subgoal_signatures.name: ejpl_proj_linalg
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hdΦ : fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) ≠ 0) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (htan : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c Φ (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) c = 0) : 0 < ejpS G Φ (F x) ∧ pullMetric2 G F x * (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ = 1 ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ i j * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) a * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 j)) b = ejpP G Φ (F x) a b) ∧ ∀ T : Fin 3 → ℝ, (∀ m : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, G (F x) c d * T c * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 m)) d = 0) → ∀ c : Fin 3, ejpS G Φ (F x) * T c = (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d Φ (F x) * T d) * ejpN G Φ (F x) c

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_coord_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) : (∀ (w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U → ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i w) U) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G Φ a b) U) ∧ (∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ejpN G Φ y d) U)

subgoal_signatures.name: amb_rm_antisymm
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j k m : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G y m l * riemannLocal G l i j k y = -∑ l : Fin 3, G y k l * riemannLocal G l i j m y

informal_problem.statement:
(h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ) (s : Set E2)
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y i j) s)
    (hsymm : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h y i j = h y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ s, (h y).PosDef)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u s) (hupos : ∀ y ∈ s, 0 < u y) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ s) :
    gaussCurv2 (fun y => (u y) ^ 2 • h y) x * (u x) ^ 2 =
      gaussCurv2 h x - lap2 h u x / u x +
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a u x * pd2 b u x) / (u x) ^ 2

signature.name: gaussCurv2_conformal_mul
signature.statement:
(h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ) (s : Set E2)
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y i j) s)
    (hsymm : ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h y i j = h y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ s, (h y).PosDef)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u s) (hupos : ∀ y ∈ s, 0 < u y) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ s) :
    gaussCurv2 (fun y => (u y) ^ 2 • h y) x * (u x) ^ 2 =
      gaussCurv2 h x - lap2 h u x / u x +
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a u x * pd2 b u x) / (u x) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have inv_entry_pd2 : ∀ (G : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x : E2)
      (hG : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)
      (hdet : (G x).det ≠ 0) (m : Fin 2),
      ∀ k l : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x ∧
        pd2 m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x =
          -∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
            (G x)⁻¹ k a * pd2 m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l := (by
    intro G x hG hdet m
    have hdetD : ∀ H : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ,
        (∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => H y a b) x) →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (H y).det) x := by
      intro H hH
      have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
          H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 := by
        funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_two (H y)
      rw [hfun]
      have h00 := hH 0 0
      have h01 := hH 0 1
      have h10 := hH 1 0
      have h11 := hH 1 1
      fun_prop
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y).det) x := hdetD G hG
    have hP : ∀ k l : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x := by
      intro k l
      have hfun : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) =
          fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det := by
        funext y
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
          smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hfun]
      refine (hD.inv hdet).mul (hdetD _ ?_)
      intro a b
      by_cases hal : a = l
      · subst hal
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact differentiableAt_const _
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hal]
        exact hG a b
    have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (G y).det ≠ 0 := hD.continuousAt.eventually_ne hdet
    have hE : ∀ a l : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, G x a b * pd2 m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
        + ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l = 0 := by
      intro a l
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (∑ b : Fin 2, (G x a b • fderiv ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
            + (G x)⁻¹ b l • fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)) x := by
        have hs := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
          (A := fun b y => G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (fun b _ => (hG a b).hasFDerivAt.mul (hP b l).hasFDerivAt)
        convert hs using 1
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
          (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
        apply (hasFDerivAt_const (if a = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
        have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G y) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy)) a) l
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
        exact this
      have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e2 m)) (h1.unique h2)
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h3
      unfold pd2
      rw [← h3, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      ring
    intro k l
    refine ⟨hP k l, ?_⟩
    let X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun b l => pd2 m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
    let D : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun a b => pd2 m (fun y => G y a b) x
    have hM : G x * X = -(D * (G x)⁻¹) := by
      ext a l'
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
      simp only [X, D, Matrix.of_apply]
      exact hE a l'
    have hX : X = -((G x)⁻¹ * (D * (G x)⁻¹)) := by
      calc X = ((G x)⁻¹ * G x) * X := by
            rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet), Matrix.one_mul]
        _ = (G x)⁻¹ * (G x * X) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [hM, Matrix.mul_neg]
    have hkl := congrFun (congrFun hX k) l
    simp only [X, D, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply] at hkl
    rw [hkl]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring)

  
  have conf_chr : ∀ (G : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ) (z : E2)
      (hG : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => G x a b) z) (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ u z)
      (hsymm : ∀ a b : Fin 2, G z a b = G z b a) (hdet : (G z).det ≠ 0) (hu0 : u z ≠ 0)
      (k i j : Fin 2),
      christoffel2 (fun x => (u x ^ 2) • G x) k i j z = christoffel2 G k i j z +
        ((if k = i then (u z)⁻¹ * pd2 j u z else 0) +
          (if k = j then (u z)⁻¹ * pd2 i u z else 0) -
          G z i j * ∑ l : Fin 2, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ((u z)⁻¹ * pd2 l u z)) := (by
    intro G u z hG hu hsymm hdet hu0 k i j
    have hu2 : u z ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hu0
    have hinvz : (u z ^ 2 • G z)⁻¹ = (u z ^ 2)⁻¹ • (G z)⁻¹ := by
      apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
      rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet),
        smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hu2, one_smul]
    have hprod : ∀ c a b, pd2 c (fun x => u x ^ 2 * G x a b) z =
        u z ^ 2 * pd2 c (fun x => G x a b) z + G z a b * (2 * u z * pd2 c u z) := by
      intro c a b
      have h4 : HasFDerivAt (fun x => u x ^ 2) (((2 : ℕ) * u z ^ (2 - 1) : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ u z) z :=
        (hasDerivAt_pow 2 (u z)).comp_hasFDerivAt z hu.hasFDerivAt
      have h : HasFDerivAt (fun x => u x ^ 2 * G x a b) (u z ^ 2 • fderiv ℝ (fun x => G x a b) z
          + G z a b • (((2 : ℕ) * u z ^ (2 - 1) : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ u z)) z :=
        h4.mul (hG a b).hasFDerivAt
      unfold pd2
      rw [h.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      norm_num
    have hPG : ∀ a b, ∑ l, (G z)⁻¹ a l * G z b l = if a = b then 1 else 0 := by
      intro a b
      have h := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (G z) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet)) a) b
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h
      rw [← h]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => by rw [hsymm b l]
    have hite : ∀ a b (X : ℝ), (if a = b then X else 0) = (∑ l, (G z)⁻¹ a l * G z b l) * X := by
      intro a b X
      rw [hPG]
      split_ifs <;> ring
    rw [hite k i, hite k j]
    simp only [christoffel2, hinvz, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hprod]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    field_simp
    ring)

  have christoffel2_differentiableAt : ∀ (G : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (U : Set E2)
      (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) U) (y : E2)
      (hy : y ∈ U) (hdet : (G y).det ≠ 0) (k i j : Fin 2),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (christoffel2 G k i j) y := (by
    intro G U hU hG y hy hdet k i j
    have hGd : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => G x a b) y := fun a b =>
      ((hG a b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
    have hPd : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => (G x)⁻¹ a b) y := fun a b =>
      (inv_entry_pd2 G y hGd hdet 0 a b).1
    have hdGd : ∀ c a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => pd2 c (fun z => G z a b) x) y := by
      intro c a b
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pd2 c (fun z => G z a b) x) U :=
        ((hG a b).fderiv_of_isOpen hU (le_of_eq rfl)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      exact (h1.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (G x)⁻¹ k l *
      (pd2 i (fun z => G z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => G z i l) x
        - pd2 l (fun z => G z i j) x)) y
    refine DifferentiableAt.const_mul (DifferentiableAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
      (A := fun l x => (G x)⁻¹ k l * (pd2 i (fun z => G z j l) x
        + pd2 j (fun z => G z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => G z i j) x))
      fun l _ => ?_) _
    exact (hPd k l).mul (((hdGd i j l).add (hdGd j i l)).sub (hdGd l i j)))

  have conf_C_pd : ∀ (G : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ)
    (U : Set E2)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) U)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (y : E2) (hy : y ∈ U) (hdet : (G y).det ≠ 0) (hu0 : u y ≠ 0)
    (k i j m : Fin 2),
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (if k = i then (u z)⁻¹ * pd2 j u z else 0) +
        (if k = j then (u z)⁻¹ * pd2 i u z else 0) -
        G z i j * ∑ l : Fin 2, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ((u z)⁻¹ * pd2 l u z)) y ∧
    pd2 m (fun z => (if k = i then (u z)⁻¹ * pd2 j u z else 0) +
        (if k = j then (u z)⁻¹ * pd2 i u z else 0) -
        G z i j * ∑ l : Fin 2, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ((u z)⁻¹ * pd2 l u z)) y =
      (if k = i then (u y)⁻¹ * pd2 m (pd2 j u) y -
          ((u y)⁻¹) ^ 2 * pd2 m u y * pd2 j u y else 0) +
        (if k = j then (u y)⁻¹ * pd2 m (pd2 i u) y -
          ((u y)⁻¹) ^ 2 * pd2 m u y * pd2 i u y else 0) -
        pd2 m (fun z => G z i j) y *
          ∑ l : Fin 2, (G y)⁻¹ k l * ((u y)⁻¹ * pd2 l u y) -
        G y i j * ∑ l : Fin 2,
          ((-∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
              (G y)⁻¹ k a * pd2 m (fun z => G z a b) y * (G y)⁻¹ b l) *
              ((u y)⁻¹ * pd2 l u y) +
            (G y)⁻¹ k l * ((u y)⁻¹ * pd2 m (pd2 l u) y -
              ((u y)⁻¹) ^ 2 * pd2 m u y * pd2 l u y)) := (by
    intro G u U hU hG hu y hy hdet hu0 k i j m
    have hGd : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => G x a b) y := fun a b =>
      ((hG a b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
    have hud : DifferentiableAt ℝ u y :=
      (hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
    have hdud : ∀ a : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 a u) y := by
      intro a
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 a u) U :=
        (hu.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (le_of_eq rfl)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      exact (h1.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
    have hinvE := inv_entry_pd2 G y hGd hdet m
    have hr : HasFDerivAt (fun z => (u z)⁻¹) ((-(u y ^ 2)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ u y) y :=
      (hasDerivAt_inv hu0).comp_hasFDerivAt y hud.hasFDerivAt
    have hψ : ∀ a : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun z => (u z)⁻¹ * pd2 a u z)
        ((u y)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (pd2 a u) y + pd2 a u y • ((-(u y ^ 2)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ u y)) y := by
      intro a
      exact hr.mul (hdud a).hasFDerivAt
    have hS : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∑ l : Fin 2, (G z)⁻¹ k l * ((u z)⁻¹ * pd2 l u z))
        (∑ l : Fin 2, ((G y)⁻¹ k l • ((u y)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (pd2 l u) y
          + pd2 l u y • ((-(u y ^ 2)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ u y))
