    intro a b
    have h' := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv (h x)) b) a
    rw [hGT, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h'
    exact h'
  have hG1 : ∀ a b, Gy a b = Gy b a := by
    intro a b; simp only [hGy]; exact hsymm x hx a b
  have hP1 : ∀ a b, P a b = P b a := by
    intro a b; simp only [hP]; exact hPs a b
  have hdG1 : ∀ c a b, dG c a b = dG c b a := by
    intro c a b
    simp only [hdG]
    have hev : (fun z => h z a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => h z b a) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hx) (fun z hz => hsymm z hz a b)
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hPG1 : ∀ a b, ∑ l, P a l * Gy l b = if a = b then 1 else 0 := by
    intro a b
    simp only [hP, hGy]
    have h' := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (h x) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdy)) a) b
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h'
    exact h'
  have hQ1 : ∀ k, Q k = ∑ l, P k l * ψ l := fun k => by rw [hQ]
  have hdP1 : ∀ m k l, dP m k l = -∑ a, ∑ b, P k a * dG m a b * P b l := fun m k l => by rw [hdP]
  have hC1 : ∀ k i j, C k i j = (if k = i then ψ j else 0) + (if k = j then ψ i else 0)
      - Gy i j * Q k := fun k i j => by rw [hC]
  have hdC1 : ∀ m k i j, dC m k i j = (if k = i then dψ m j else 0) + (if k = j then dψ m i else 0)
      - dG m i j * Q k - Gy i j * ∑ l, (dP m k l * ψ l + P k l * dψ m l) :=
    fun m k i j => by rw [hdC]
  have hΓ1 : ∀ k i j, Γ k i j = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l, P k l * (dG i j l + dG j i l - dG l i j) := by
    intro k i j
    simp only [hΓ, hP, hdG]
    rfl
  
  have hinv : ∀ j k, (u x ^ 2 • h x)⁻¹ j k = (u x ^ 2)⁻¹ * P j k := by
    intro j k
    have h2 : u x ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hu0
    have hm : (u x ^ 2 • h x)⁻¹ = (u x ^ 2)⁻¹ • (h x)⁻¹ := by
      apply Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv
      rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdy),
        smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ h2, one_smul]
    rw [hm, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hPe]
  
  have hΓ' : ∀ a b c, christoffel2 (fun y => (u y) ^ 2 • h y) a b c x = Γ a b c + C a b c := by
    intro a b c
    rw [conf_chr h u x (hGd x hx) (hud x hx) (hsymm x hx) hdy hu0 a b c]
    simp only [hΓ, hC, hQ, hψ, hGy, hP]
  
  have hDΓ' : ∀ m a b c, pd2 m (christoffel2 (fun y => (u y) ^ 2 • h y) a b c) x =
      pd2 m (christoffel2 h a b c) x + dC m a b c := by
    intro m a b c
    have hev : christoffel2 (fun y => (u y) ^ 2 • h y) a b c =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun z =>
        christoffel2 h a b c z + ((if a = b then (u z)⁻¹ * pd2 c u z else 0) +
          (if a = c then (u z)⁻¹ * pd2 b u z else 0) -
          h z b c * ∑ l : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a l * ((u z)⁻¹ * pd2 l u z)) := by
      filter_upwards [hs.mem_nhds hx] with z hz
      exact conf_chr h u z (hGd z hz) (hud z hz) (hsymm z hz) (hdet z hz)
        (hupos z hz).ne' a b c
    obtain ⟨h3d, h3e⟩ := conf_C_pd h u s hs hh hu x hx hdy hu0 a b c m
    have h2 := christoffel2_differentiableAt h s hs hh x hx hdy a b c
    show fderiv ℝ (christoffel2 (fun y => (u y) ^ 2 • h y) a b c) x (e2 m) =
      fderiv ℝ (christoffel2 h a b c) x (e2 m) + dC m a b c
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_add h2 h3d, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    congr 1
    refine h3e.trans ?_
    simp only [hdC, hdψ, hdG, hQ, hdP, hψ, hGy, hP]
  
  have hRic : ∀ j k, ricci2 (fun y => (u y) ^ 2 • h y) j k x = ricci2 h j k x
      + ∑ i, (dC i i j k - dC j i i k)
      + ∑ i, ∑ p, (Γ i i p * C p j k + C i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * C p i k - C i j p * Γ p i k)
      + ∑ i, ∑ p, (C i i p * C p j k - C i j p * C p i k) := by
    intro j k
    simp only [ricci2, hΓ', hDΓ', hΓ, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hL : gaussCurv2 (fun y => (u y) ^ 2 • h y) x = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((u x ^ 2)⁻¹ *
      (∑ j, ∑ k, P j k * ricci2 h j k x +
        (∑ j, ∑ k, P j k * ∑ i, (dC i i j k - dC j i i k)
        + ∑ j, ∑ k, P j k * ∑ i, ∑ p, (Γ i i p * C p j k + C i i p * Γ p j k
            - Γ i j p * C p i k - C i j p * Γ p i k)
        + ∑ j, ∑ k, P j k * ∑ i, ∑ p, (C i i p * C p j k - C i j p * C p i k)))) := by
    unfold gaussCurv2
    simp only [hinv, hRic, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hG2 : gaussCurv2 h x = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j, ∑ k, P j k * ricci2 h j k x := by
    unfold gaussCurv2
    simp only [hPe]
  
  have hD4 := alg_D Gy P dG ψ Q dψ dP dC hG1 hP1 hdG1 hPG1 hQ1 hdP1 hdC1
  have hX5 := alg_X Gy P dG ψ Q Γ C hG1 hP1 hdG1 hPG1 hQ1 hΓ1 hC1
  have hY6 := alg_Y Gy P ψ Q C hG1 hP1 hPG1 hQ1 hC1
  
  have hA : ∑ j, ∑ k, P j k * ∑ i, (dC i i j k - dC j i i k)
        + ∑ j, ∑ k, P j k * ∑ i, ∑ p, (Γ i i p * C p j k + C i i p * Γ p j k
            - Γ i j p * C p i k - C i j p * Γ p i k)
        + ∑ j, ∑ k, P j k * ∑ i, ∑ p, (C i i p * C p j k - C i j p * C p i k)
      = 2 * (-lap2 h u x / u x +
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a u x * pd2 b u x) / u x ^ 2) := by
    rw [hD4, hX5.1, hY6]
    have h5 := hX5.2
    unfold lap2
    simp only [hPe, hdψ, hψ, hΓ] at h5 ⊢
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h5 ⊢
    linear_combination (-2 : ℝ) * h5
  
  have hfin : ∀ (K R S c : ℝ), c ≠ 0 → K = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (c⁻¹ * (R + S)) →
      K * c = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * R + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * S := by
    intro K R S c hc hK
    rw [hK]
    have h1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hc
    linear_combination (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (R + S) * h1
  rw [hfin _ _ _ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 hu0) hL, hG2, hA]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (q : Fin m → X), (∀ i, q i ∈ S) ∧ ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ i, q i ∈ connectedComponentIn S p

signature.name: patched_component_reps
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (q : Fin m → X), (∀ i, q i ∈ S) ∧ ∀ p ∈ S, ∃ i, q i ∈ connectedComponentIn S p

proof.tactics:
by
  have hloc : ∀ p ∈ S, connectedComponentIn S p ∪ Sᶜ ∈ 𝓝 p := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hp)
    have hpS : p ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
      rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hj, hp⟩
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hx₀p⟩ := hpS
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hBW⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (P.W_open j) x₀ hx₀
    have hVo : IsOpen (P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r) :=
      (P.proj_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open j) Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hpV : p ∈ P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r := by
      refine ⟨hj, ?_⟩
      show P.proj j p ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r
      rw [← hx₀p, P.proj_param j x₀ hx₀]
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr
    have hTc : IsPreconnected (P.param j '' Metric.ball x₀ r) :=
      (convex_ball x₀ r).isPreconnected.image (P.param j) ((P.param_cont j).mono hBW)
    have hTS : P.param j '' Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ S := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      have : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hBW hx, rfl⟩
      rw [P.image_eq j] at this
      exact this.2
    have hpT : p ∈ P.param j '' Metric.ball x₀ r :=
      ⟨x₀, Metric.mem_ball_self hr, hx₀p⟩
    have hTcc : P.param j '' Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ connectedComponentIn S p :=
      hTc.subset_connectedComponentIn hpT hTS
    refine Filter.mem_of_superset (hVo.mem_nhds hpV) ?_
    intro y hy
    by_cases hyS : y ∈ S
    · left
      have hy' : y ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
        rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hy.1, hyS⟩
      obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, rfl⟩ := hy'
      have h2 : P.proj j (P.param j x₁) ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r := hy.2
      rw [P.proj_param j x₁ hx₁] at h2
      exact hTcc ⟨x₁, h2, rfl⟩
    · right
      exact hyS
  obtain ⟨t, htS, hcov⟩ := hS.elim_nhds_subcover (fun x => connectedComponentIn S x ∪ Sᶜ) hloc
  refine ⟨t.card, fun i => ((t.equivFin).symm i : X), fun i => htS _ ((t.equivFin).symm i).2, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨x, hxt, hpx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcov hp)
  have hpx' : p ∈ connectedComponentIn S x := by
    rcases hpx with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd hp h
  refine ⟨t.equivFin ⟨x, hxt⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [← connectedComponentIn_eq hpx']
  exact mem_connectedComponentIn (htS x hxt)

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (m : ℕ) (jm : Fin m → Fin P.n) (xm : Fin m → E2)
    (hxm : ∀ i, xm i ∈ P.W (jm i)) :
    ∃ (P' : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ι : Fin P'.n → Fin P.n),
      (∀ l, ∃ a b s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧
        P'.W l = {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}) ∧
      (∀ l, P'.W l ⊆ P.W (ι l)) ∧ (∀ l, P'.param l = P.param (ι l)) ∧
      (∀ l, P'.h l = P.h (ι l)) ∧ ∀ i, ∃ l, ι l = jm i ∧ xm i ∈ P'.W l

signature.name: eig_patched_square_refine
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (hS : IsCompact S)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (m : ℕ) (jm : Fin m → Fin P.n) (xm : Fin m → E2)
    (hxm : ∀ i, xm i ∈ P.W (jm i)) :
    ∃ (P' : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ι : Fin P'.n → Fin P.n),
      (∀ l, ∃ a b s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧
        P'.W l = {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}) ∧
      (∀ l, P'.W l ⊆ P.W (ι l)) ∧ (∀ l, P'.param l = P.param (ι l)) ∧
      (∀ l, P'.h l = P.h (ι l)) ∧ ∀ i, ∃ l, ι l = jm i ∧ xm i ∈ P'.W l

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hSqO : ∀ a b s : ℝ,
      IsOpen {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} := by
    intro a b s
    have c0 : Continuous fun x : E2 => x 0 := PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) 0
    have c1 : Continuous fun x : E2 => x 1 := PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) 1
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const c0).inter ((isOpen_lt c0 continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const c1).inter (isOpen_lt c1 continuous_const)))
  
  have hSqN : ∀ U : Set E2, IsOpen U → ∀ y ∈ U, ∃ a b s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧
      y ∈ {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} ∧
      {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} ⊆ U := by
    intro U hU y hy
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hU y hy
    refine ⟨y 0 - ε / 2, y 1 - ε / 2, ε, hε, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · rintro x ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
      apply hball
      have e0 : (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 < ε ^ 2 / 4 := by
        nlinarith [mul_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < y 0 + ε / 2 - x 0 by linarith)
          (show (0 : ℝ) < x 0 - (y 0 - ε / 2) by linarith)]
      have e1 : (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 < ε ^ 2 / 4 := by
        nlinarith [mul_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < y 1 + ε / 2 - x 1 by linarith)
          (show (0 : ℝ) < x 1 - (y 1 - ε / 2) by linarith)]
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq,
        sq_abs, sq_abs, Real.sqrt_lt' hε]
      nlinarith
  
  have hloc : ∀ q : S, ∃ (j : Fin P.n) (a b s : ℝ), 0 < s ∧
      {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} ⊆ P.W j ∧
      (q : X) ∈ P.O j ∧
      P.proj j q ∈ {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} := by
    intro q
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover q.2)
    have hq : (q : X) ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
      rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hj, q.2⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyq⟩ := hq
    obtain ⟨a, b, s, hs, hys, hsub⟩ := hSqN (P.W j) (P.W_open j) y hy
    refine ⟨j, a, b, s, hs, hsub, hj, ?_⟩
    rw [← hyq, P.proj_param j y hy]
    exact hys
  choose J A B Sd hpos hsub hO hproj using hloc
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hS.elim_finite_subcover
    (fun q : S => P.O (J q) ∩ P.proj (J q) ⁻¹'
      {x : E2 | A q < x 0 ∧ x 0 < A q + Sd q ∧ B q < x 1 ∧ x 1 < B q + Sd q})
    (fun q => (P.proj_cont (J q)).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open (J q)) (hSqO _ _ _))
    (fun p hp => Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hO _, hproj _⟩)
  
  choose am bm sm hsm hxin hsubm using
    fun i => hSqN (P.W (jm i)) (P.W_open (jm i)) (xm i) (hxm i)
  
  let e := t.equivFin
  let pt : Fin t.card → S := fun l => (e.symm l).1
  let D : Fin (t.card + m) → Fin P.n × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ :=
    Fin.append (fun l => (J (pt l), A (pt l), B (pt l), Sd (pt l)))
      (fun i => (jm i, am i, bm i, sm i))
  let Q : Fin (t.card + m) → Set E2 := fun l =>
    {x : E2 | (D l).2.1 < x 0 ∧ x 0 < (D l).2.1 + (D l).2.2.2 ∧
      (D l).2.2.1 < x 1 ∧ x 1 < (D l).2.2.1 + (D l).2.2.2}
  have F1 : ∀ l, 0 < (D l).2.2.2 := by
    intro l
    induction l using Fin.addCases with
    | left l => simp only [D, Fin.append_left]; exact hpos _
    | right i => simp only [D, Fin.append_right]; exact hsm i
  have F2 : ∀ l, Q l ⊆ P.W (D l).1 := by
    intro l
    induction l using Fin.addCases with
    | left l => simp only [Q, D, Fin.append_left]; exact hsub _
    | right i => simp only [Q, D, Fin.append_right]; exact hsubm i
  have F3 : ∀ l, IsOpen (Q l) := fun l => hSqO _ _ _
  have F4 : ∀ l, IsOpen (P.O (D l).1 ∩ P.proj (D l).1 ⁻¹' Q l) := fun l =>
    (P.proj_cont _).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open _) (F3 l)
  have hIm : ∀ l, P.param (D l).1 '' Q l = (P.O (D l).1 ∩ P.proj (D l).1 ⁻¹' Q l) ∩ S := by
    intro l
    ext p
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      have hxW := F2 l hx
      have hm : P.param (D l).1 x ∈ P.O (D l).1 ∩ S := by
        rw [← P.image_eq]; exact ⟨x, hxW, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨hm.1, ?_⟩, hm.2⟩
      show P.proj (D l).1 (P.param (D l).1 x) ∈ Q l
      rw [P.proj_param _ x hxW]
      exact hx
    · rintro ⟨⟨hpO, hpQ⟩, hpS⟩
      have hm : p ∈ P.param (D l).1 '' P.W (D l).1 := by
        rw [P.image_eq]; exact ⟨hpO, hpS⟩
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hm
      refine ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩
      have h' : P.proj (D l).1 (P.param (D l).1 y) ∈ Q l := hpQ
      rwa [P.proj_param _ y hy] at h'
  have hcov : S ⊆ ⋃ l, P.O (D l).1 ∩ P.proj (D l).1 ⁻¹' Q l := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (ht hp)
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Fin.castAdd m (e ⟨q, hq⟩), ?_⟩
    have hpt : pt (e ⟨q, hq⟩) = q := by
      simp only [pt, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hD : D (Fin.castAdd m (e ⟨q, hq⟩)) = (J q, A q, B q, Sd q) := by
      simp only [D, Fin.append_left, hpt]
    simp only [Q, hD]
    exact hpq
  let P' : EigPatchedSurface X S :=
    { n := t.card + m
      W := Q
      param := fun l => P.param (D l).1
      proj := fun l => P.proj (D l).1
      O := fun l => P.O (D l).1 ∩ P.proj (D l).1 ⁻¹' Q l
      h := fun l => P.h (D l).1
      W_open := F3
      O_open := F4
      param_cont := fun l => (P.param_cont _).mono (F2 l)
      proj_cont := fun l => (P.proj_cont _).mono Set.inter_subset_left
      image_eq := hIm
      proj_param := fun l x hx => P.proj_param _ x (F2 l hx)
      cover := hcov
      trans_smooth := fun l k =>
        (P.trans_smooth (D l).1 (D k).1).mono (fun x hx => ⟨F2 l hx.1, hx.2.1⟩)
      h_smooth := fun l a b => (P.h_smooth _ a b).mono (F2 l)
      h_posDef := fun l x hx => P.h_posDef _ x (F2 l hx)
      h_compat := fun l k x hx a b =>
        P.h_compat (D l).1 (D k).1 x ⟨F2 l hx.1, hx.2.1⟩ a b }
  refine ⟨P', fun l => (D l).1, fun l => ⟨(D l).2.1, (D l).2.2.1, (D l).2.2.2, F1 l, rfl⟩,
    fun l => F2 l, fun l => rfl, fun l => rfl, fun i => ⟨Fin.natAdd t.card i, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · simp only [D, Fin.append_right]
  · show xm i ∈ Q (Fin.natAdd t.card i)
    simp only [Q, D, Fin.append_right]
    exact hxin i

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X)
    (hS : IsCompact S) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (θ : C(S, Circle)) :
    ∃ (Ψ : X → Circle) (ψ : C(S, ℝ)),
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (Ψ (P.param j x) : ℂ)) (P.W j)) ∧
      ∀ x : S, θ x = Ψ x * Circle.exp (ψ x)

signature.name: patched_circle_smooth_approx
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X)
    (hS : IsCompact S) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (θ : C(S, Circle)) :
    ∃ (Ψ : X → Circle) (ψ : C(S, ℝ)),
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (Ψ (P.param j x) : ℂ)) (P.W j)) ∧
      ∀ x : S, θ x = Ψ x * Circle.exp (ψ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  haveI : CompactSpace S := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hS
  
  have hP1 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ P.O j ∧ P.param j x ∈ S := by
    intro j x hx
    have hmem : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at hmem
    exact hmem
  
  have hcontS : ∀ F : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => F (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) →
      Continuous (fun s : S => F s) := by
    intro F hF
    have huc : ContinuousOn F S := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hs)
      have hc : ContinuousOn (fun p => F (P.param l (P.proj l p))) (P.O l ∩ S) := by
        refine (hF l).continuousOn.comp ((P.proj_cont l).mono Set.inter_subset_left) ?_
        intro p hp
        have : p ∈ P.param l '' P.W l := by rw [P.image_eq l]; exact hp
        obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := this
        rw [P.proj_param l y hy]; exact hy
      have hc' : ContinuousOn F (P.O l ∩ S) := by
        refine hc.congr ?_
        intro p hp
        have : p ∈ P.param l '' P.W l := by rw [P.image_eq l]; exact hp
        obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := this
        simp only [P.proj_param l y hy]
      refine (hc' s ⟨hl, hs⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin ?_
      rw [Set.inter_comm]
      exact inter_mem_nhdsWithin S ((P.O_open l).mem_nhds hl)
    exact continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict.1 huc
  
  have hlift : ∀ (k : Fin P.n) (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W k →
      ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun x => (fun q => if q ∈ P.O k then ζ (P.proj k q) else 0) (P.param j x)) (P.W j) := by
    intro k ζ hζ hc hs
    set F : Set X := P.param k '' tsupport ζ with hFdef
    have hFO : F ⊆ P.O k := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact (hP1 k y (hs hy)).1
    have hFc : IsClosed F :=
      (hc.isCompact.image_of_continuousOn ((P.param_cont k).mono hs)).isClosed
    set Z : X → ℝ := fun q => if q ∈ P.O k then ζ (P.proj k q) else 0 with hZdef
    have hZ0 : ∀ q, q ∉ P.O k → Z q = 0 := fun q hq => by simp only [hZdef, if_neg hq]
    have hZf : ∀ q ∈ P.O k, Z q = ζ (P.proj k q) := fun q hq => by simp only [hZdef, if_pos hq]
    have hstar : ∀ q ∈ S, q ∉ F → Z q = 0 := by
      intro q hqS hqF
      by_cases hqO : q ∈ P.O k
      · have hq : q ∈ P.O k ∩ S := ⟨hqO, hqS⟩
        rw [← P.image_eq k] at hq
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hyq⟩ := hq
        rw [hZf q hqO, ← hyq, P.proj_param k y hy]
        by_contra hne
        exact hqF ⟨y, subset_tsupport ζ (Function.mem_support.mpr hne), hyq⟩
      · exact hZ0 q hqO
    have hNopen : ∀ j, IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' Fᶜ) := fun j =>
      (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) hFc.isOpen_compl
    have hNzero : ∀ j, ∀ x' ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' Fᶜ, Z (P.param j x') = 0 := by
      intro j x' hx'
      exact hstar _ (hP1 j x' hx'.1).2 hx'.2
    intro j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Z (P.param j x)) (P.W j)
    refine contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn (fun x hx => ?_)
    by_cases hxO : P.param j x ∈ P.O k
    · refine ⟨P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
        (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k), ⟨hx, hxO⟩, ?_⟩
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x' => ζ (P.proj k (P.param j x')))
          (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := hζ.comp_contDiffOn (P.trans_smooth j k)
      refine (h1.mono Set.inter_subset_right).congr ?_
      intro y hy
      exact hZf _ hy.2.2
    · have hxF : P.param j x ∉ F := fun h => hxO (hFO h)
      refine ⟨P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' Fᶜ, hNopen j, ⟨hx, hxF⟩, ?_⟩
      refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr ?_
      intro y hy
      exact hNzero j y hy.2
  
  have hsep : ∀ x y : X, x ∈ S → y ∈ S → x ≠ y → ∃ Z : X → ℝ,
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Z (P.param j z)) (P.W j)) ∧ Z x ≠ Z y := by
    intro x y hx hy hxy
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hx)
    have hxk : x ∈ P.param k '' P.W k := by rw [P.image_eq k]; exact ⟨hk, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ := hxk
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (P.W_open k) a ha
    have hR : ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ R < ε ∧ ∀ b ∈ P.W k, P.param k b = y → R ≤ dist b a := by
      by_cases hyO : y ∈ P.O k
      · have hyk : y ∈ P.param k '' P.W k := by rw [P.image_eq k]; exact ⟨hyO, hy⟩
        obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁, hb₁y⟩ := hyk
        have hne : b₁ ≠ a := by
          intro h
          apply hxy
          rw [← hax, ← hb₁y, h]
        have hd : 0 < dist b₁ a := dist_pos.mpr hne
        refine ⟨min (ε / 2) (dist b₁ a / 2), lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith),
          lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith), ?_⟩
        intro b hb hby
        have hbb : b = b₁ := by
          rw [← P.proj_param k b hb, ← P.proj_param k b₁ hb₁, hby, hb₁y]
        rw [hbb]
        exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
      · refine ⟨ε / 2, by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
        intro b hb hby
        exact absurd (hby ▸ (hP1 k b hb).1) hyO
    obtain ⟨R, hR0, hRε, hRy⟩ := hR
    let ζ : ContDiffBump a := ⟨R / 2, R, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hζs : tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W k := by
      rw [ζ.tsupport_eq]
      intro z hz
      apply hball
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hz (by simpa using hRε)
    refine ⟨fun q => if q ∈ P.O k then ζ (P.proj k q) else 0,
      hlift k ζ ζ.contDiff ζ.hasCompactSupport hζs, ?_⟩
    have hZx : (if x ∈ P.O k then ζ (P.proj k x) else 0) = 1 := by
      rw [if_pos hk, ← hax, P.proj_param k a ha]
      exact ζ.one_of_mem_closedBall (Metric.mem_closedBall_self ζ.rIn_pos.le)
    have hZy : (if y ∈ P.O k then ζ (P.proj k y) else 0) = 0 := by
      by_cases hyO : y ∈ P.O k
      · rw [if_pos hyO]
        have hyk : y ∈ P.param k '' P.W k := by rw [P.image_eq k]; exact ⟨hyO, hy⟩
        obtain ⟨b₁, hb₁, hb₁y⟩ := hyk
        rw [← hb₁y, P.proj_param k b₁ hb₁]
        apply Function.notMem_support.mp
        rw [ζ.support_eq, Metric.mem_ball]
        have := hRy b₁ hb₁ hb₁y
        simp only [ζ]
        linarith
      · rw [if_neg hyO]
    show (if x ∈ P.O k then ζ (P.proj k x) else 0) ≠ (if y ∈ P.O k then ζ (P.proj k y) else 0)
    rw [hZx, hZy]
    exact one_ne_zero
  
  let A : Subalgebra ℝ C(S, ℝ) :=
    { carrier := {g | ∃ F : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => F (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
        ∀ s : S, g s = F s}
      mul_mem' := by
        rintro g₁ g₂ ⟨F₁, hF₁, e₁⟩ ⟨F₂, hF₂, e₂⟩
        exact ⟨fun p => F₁ p * F₂ p, fun j => (hF₁ j).mul (hF₂ j),
          fun s => by simp [e₁, e₂]⟩
      add_mem' := by
        rintro g₁ g₂ ⟨F₁, hF₁, e₁⟩ ⟨F₂, hF₂, e₂⟩
        exact ⟨fun p => F₁ p + F₂ p, fun j => (hF₁ j).add (hF₂ j),
          fun s => by simp [e₁, e₂]⟩
      algebraMap_mem' := by
        intro r
        exact ⟨fun _ => r, fun j => contDiffOn_const,
          fun s => by simp [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]⟩ }
  have hA : A.SeparatesPoints := by
    intro s t hst
    have hst' : (s : X) ≠ (t : X) := Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hst
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hZst⟩ := hsep s t s.2 t.2 hst'
    exact ⟨fun u : S => Z u, ⟨⟨fun u : S => Z u, hcontS Z hZ⟩, ⟨Z, hZ, fun u => rfl⟩, rfl⟩, hZst⟩
  have happrox : ∀ f : C(S, ℝ), ∃ F : X → ℝ,
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => F (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧ ∀ s : S, |F s - f s| < 1 / 4 := by
    intro f
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
      ContinuousMap.exists_mem_subalgebra_near_continuousMap_of_separatesPoints A hA f (1 / 4)
        (by norm_num)
    obtain ⟨F, hF, hgF⟩ := g.2
    refine ⟨F, hF, fun s => ?_⟩
    have h1 := ContinuousMap.norm_coe_le_norm ((g : C(S, ℝ)) - f) s
    rw [ContinuousMap.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, hgF s] at h1
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hg
  
  set θc : S → ℂ := fun s => ((θ s : Circle) : ℂ) with hθcdef
  have hθcc : Continuous θc := continuous_subtype_val.comp θ.continuous
  let f₁ : C(S, ℝ) := ⟨fun s => (θc s).re, Complex.continuous_re.comp hθcc⟩
  let f₂ : C(S, ℝ) := ⟨fun s => (θc s).im, Complex.continuous_im.comp hθcc⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hac⟩ := happrox f₁
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbc⟩ := happrox f₂
  
  set F : X → ℂ := fun p => (a p : ℂ) + (b p : ℂ) * Complex.I with hFdef
  have hFre : ∀ p, (F p).re = a p := by intro p; simp [F]
  have hFim : ∀ p, (F p).im = b p := by intro p; simp [F]
  have hFclose : ∀ s : S, ‖F s - θc s‖ < 1 / 2 := by
    intro s
    have h1 := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im (F s - θc s)
    rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, hFre, hFim] at h1
    have h2 : |a s - (θc s).re| < 1 / 4 := hac s
    have h3 : |b s - (θc s).im| < 1 / 4 := hbc s
    linarith
  have hθn : ∀ s : S, ‖θc s‖ = 1 := fun s => Circle.norm_coe (θ s)
  have hFa : ∀ s : S, |‖F s‖ - 1| < 1 / 2 := by
    intro s
    have h := abs_norm_sub_norm_le (F s) (θc s)
    rw [hθn s] at h
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h (hFclose s)
  have hFpos : ∀ s : S, 0 < ‖F s‖ := by
    intro s
    have h := hFa s
    rw [abs_lt] at h
    linarith [h.1]
  have hF0 : ∀ s : S, F s ≠ 0 := fun s => norm_pos_iff.mp (hFpos s)
  
  have hid : ∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 →
      ((Circle.exp (Complex.arg z) : Circle) : ℂ) = ((‖z‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * z := by
    intro z hz
    have hn : (‖z‖ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz
    have h := Complex.norm_mul_exp_arg_mul_I z
    rw [Circle.coe_exp]
    calc Complex.exp (↑(Complex.arg z) * Complex.I)
        = (‖z‖ : ℂ)⁻¹ * ((‖z‖ : ℂ) * Complex.exp (↑(Complex.arg z) * Complex.I)) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, one_mul]
      _ = ((‖z‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * z := by rw [h, Complex.ofReal_inv]
  set Ψ : X → Circle := fun p => Circle.exp (Complex.arg (F p)) with hΨdef
  
  have hΨs : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (Ψ (P.param j x) : ℂ)) (P.W j) := by
    intro j
    have hGa : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (a (P.param j x) : ℂ)) (P.W j) :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (ha j)
    have hGb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (b (P.param j x) : ℂ)) (P.W j) :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hb j)
    have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => F (P.param j x)) (P.W j) :=
      hGa.add (hGb.mul contDiffOn_const)
    have hG0 : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, F (P.param j x) ≠ 0 := fun x hx =>
      hF0 ⟨P.param j x, (hP1 j x hx).2⟩
    have hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ‖F (P.param j x)‖⁻¹ • F (P.param j x)) (P.W j) := by
      intro x hx
      have hGx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => F (P.param j x)) x :=
        hG.contDiffAt ((P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx)
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℂ => ‖z‖⁻¹) (F (P.param j x)) :=
        (contDiffAt_norm ℝ (hG0 x hx)).inv (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hG0 x hx))
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ((fun z : ℂ => ‖z‖⁻¹) ∘ (fun x => F (P.param j x))) x :=
        h1.comp x hGx
      exact (h2.smul hGx).contDiffWithinAt
    refine hN.congr ?_
    intro x hx
    simp only [Ψ]
    rw [hid _ (hG0 x hx), Complex.real_smul]
  
  set N : S → ℂ := fun s => ((‖F s‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * F s with hNdef
  have hNn : ∀ s, ‖N s‖ = 1 := by
    intro s
    simp only [N, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (hFpos s))]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (hFpos s).ne'
  have hFSc : Continuous (fun s : S => F s) := by
    have hca := hcontS a ha
    have hcb := hcontS b hb
    exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hca).add
      ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hcb).mul continuous_const)
  have hNc : Continuous N := by
    refine (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ?_).mul hFSc
    exact (continuous_norm.comp hFSc).inv₀ (fun s => (hFpos s).ne')
  have hΨN : ∀ s : S, ((Ψ s : Circle) : ℂ) = N s := fun s => hid _ (hF0 s)
  have hNmem : ∀ s, N s ∈ Submonoid.unitSphere ℂ := by
    intro s
    show N s ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : ℂ) 1
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]
    exact hNn s
  have hΨSc : Continuous (fun s : S => Ψ s) := by
    have heq : (fun s : S => Ψ s) = fun s => (⟨N s, hNmem s⟩ : Circle) := by
      funext s
      apply Circle.ext
      rw [hΨN s]
    rw [heq]
    exact hNc.subtype_mk hNmem
  have hNclose : ∀ s, ‖θc s - N s‖ < 1 := by
    intro s
    have hpos := hFpos s
    have e1 : F s - N s = ((1 - ‖F s‖⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) * F s := by
      simp only [N]; push_cast; ring
    have e2 : ‖F s - N s‖ = |‖F s‖ - 1| := by
      rw [e1, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, ← abs_of_pos hpos, ← abs_mul,
        abs_of_pos hpos]
      congr 1
      field_simp
    calc ‖θc s - N s‖ = ‖(θc s - F s) + (F s - N s)‖ := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ ‖θc s - F s‖ + ‖F s - N s‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖F s - θc s‖ + ‖F s - N s‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]
      _ < 1 := by rw [e2]; linarith [hFclose s, hFa s]
  
  let w : C(S, Circle) := ⟨fun s => θ s * (Ψ s)⁻¹, θ.continuous.mul hΨSc.inv⟩
  have hwcoe : ∀ s, ((w s : Circle) : ℂ) = θc s * (N s)⁻¹ := by
    intro s
    show ((θ s * (Ψ s)⁻¹ : Circle) : ℂ) = _
    rw [Circle.coe_mul, Circle.coe_inv, hΨN]
  have hwn : ∀ s, ‖((w s : Circle) : ℂ) - 1‖ < 1 := by
    intro s
    have hN0 : N s ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; have := hNn s; rw [h, norm_zero] at this; exact zero_ne_one this
    have e : θc s * (N s)⁻¹ - 1 = (θc s - N s) * (N s)⁻¹ := by
      field_simp
    rw [hwcoe, e, norm_mul, norm_inv, hNn s, inv_one, mul_one]
    exact hNclose s
  have hslit : ∀ s, ((w s : Circle) : ℂ) ∈ Complex.slitPlane := by
    intro s
    apply Complex.mem_slitPlane_iff.mpr
    left
    have h1 := Complex.abs_re_le_norm (((w s : Circle) : ℂ) - 1)
    have h2 := hwn s
    rw [Complex.sub_re, Complex.one_re] at h1
    have h4 : |(((w s : Circle) : ℂ)).re - 1| < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2
    rw [abs_lt] at h4
    linarith [h4.1]
  let ψ : C(S, ℝ) := ⟨fun s => Complex.arg ((w s : Circle) : ℂ),
    Complex.continuousOn_arg.comp_continuous (continuous_subtype_val.comp w.continuous) hslit⟩
  have hψ : ∀ s, Circle.exp (ψ s) = w s := fun s => Circle.exp_arg (w s)
  refine ⟨Ψ, ψ, hΨs, fun s => ?_⟩
  rw [hψ s]
  show θ s = Ψ s * (θ s * (Ψ s)⁻¹)
  rw [mul_comm (θ s), ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hWc : Convex ℝ W)
    (Ψ : E2 → Circle) (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) W) :
    ∃ θ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ θ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, Ψ x = Circle.exp (θ x)

signature.name: convex_circle_smooth_lift
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hWc : Convex ℝ W)
    (Ψ : E2 → Circle) (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) W) :
    ∃ θ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ θ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, Ψ x = Circle.exp (θ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hcont : ∃ θ : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn θ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, Ψ x = Circle.exp (θ x) := by
    classical
    rcases W.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hE | ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩
    · refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hE]; exact continuousOn_empty _
      · intro x hx; rw [hE] at hx; exact absurd hx (Set.notMem_empty x)
    have hΨc : ContinuousOn Ψ W :=
      ((Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal : Topology.IsInducing ((↑) : Circle → ℂ)).continuousOn_iff).2
        hΨ.continuousOn
    have hres : Continuous (W.restrict Ψ) := hΨc.restrict
    let seg : C(unitInterval × W, W) :=
      ⟨fun p => ⟨x₀ + (p.1 : ℝ) • ((p.2 : E2) - x₀),
        hWc.add_smul_sub_mem hx₀ p.2.2 ⟨p.1.2.1, p.1.2.2⟩⟩, by
        refine Continuous.subtype_mk ?_ _
        fun_prop⟩
    let H : C(unitInterval × W, Circle) :=
      ⟨fun p => W.restrict Ψ (seg p), hres.comp seg.continuous⟩
    let f : C(W, ℝ) := ContinuousMap.const W (Complex.arg (Ψ x₀ : ℂ))
    have H0 : ∀ a, H (0, a) = Circle.exp (f a) := by
      intro a
      simp [H, seg, f, Circle.exp_arg]
    let Θ := Circle.isCoveringMap_exp.liftHomotopy H f H0
    have hlift := Circle.isCoveringMap_exp.liftHomotopy_lifts H f H0
    refine ⟨fun x => if hx : x ∈ W then Θ (1, ⟨x, hx⟩) else 0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
      have hr : W.restrict (fun x => if hx : x ∈ W then Θ (1, ⟨x, hx⟩) else 0) =
          fun a => Θ (1, a) := by
        funext a
        simp [Set.restrict, a.2]
      rw [hr]
      exact Θ.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    · intro x hx
      simp only [dif_pos hx]
      have h1 := congrFun hlift (1, ⟨x, hx⟩)
      simp only [Function.comp] at h1
      rw [h1]
      simp [H, seg]
  obtain ⟨θ, hθc, hθ⟩ := hcont
  refine ⟨θ, ?_, hθ⟩
  
  intro x₁ hx₁
  have hWx₁ : W ∈ 𝓝 x₁ := hW.mem_nhds hx₁
  apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
  set c : ℂ := (((Ψ x₁)⁻¹ : Circle) : ℂ) with hc
  set z : E2 → ℂ := fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ) * c with hzdef
  have hz1 : z x₁ = 1 := by
    simp only [hzdef, hc]
    rw [← Circle.coe_mul, mul_inv_cancel, Circle.coe_one]
  set φ : E2 → ℝ := fun x => θ x₁ + (Complex.log (z x)).im with hφdef
  have hzd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ z x₁ := (hΨ.contDiffAt hWx₁).mul contDiffAt_const
  have hlog : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Complex.log (z x₁) := by
    rw [hz1]
    exact (Complex.contDiffAt_log Complex.one_mem_slitPlane).restrict_scalars ℝ
  have hφd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φ x₁ :=
    contDiffAt_const.add (Complex.imCLM.contDiff.comp_contDiffAt x₁ (hlog.comp x₁ hzd))
  have hexp : ∀ x ∈ W, Circle.exp (φ x) = Circle.exp (θ x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hw : z x = ((Ψ x * (Ψ x₁)⁻¹ : Circle) : ℂ) := by
      simp only [hzdef, hc, Circle.coe_mul]
    simp only [hφdef]
    rw [Circle.exp_add, Complex.log_im, hw, Circle.exp_arg, ← hθ x₁ hx₁, ← hθ x hx,
      mul_comm (Ψ x), mul_inv_cancel_left]
  have hθφ : θ =ᶠ[𝓝 x₁] φ := by
    have hcd : ContinuousAt (fun x => |θ x - φ x|) x₁ :=
      ((hθc.continuousAt hWx₁).sub hφd.continuousAt).abs
    have h0 : |θ x₁ - φ x₁| = 0 := by
      simp [hφdef, hz1]
    have hp : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    have hev : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₁, |θ x - φ x| < 2 * Real.pi :=
      hcd.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by rw [h0]; exact hp)
    filter_upwards [hev, hWx₁] with x hx hxW
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Circle.exp_eq_exp.1 (hexp x hxW).symm
    have hm' : |(m : ℝ)| < 1 := by
      rw [hm, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hp] at hx
      nlinarith
    have hm0 : m = 0 := by
      rw [← Int.abs_lt_one_iff]
      exact_mod_cast hm'
    rw [hm, hm0]
    simp
  exact hφd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hθφ

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (f g : E2 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ W, Circle.exp (f x) = Circle.exp (g x)) :
    ∀ x ∈ W, fderiv ℝ f x = fderiv ℝ g x

signature.name: circle_exp_eq_fderiv_eq
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (f g : E2 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ W, Circle.exp (f x) = Circle.exp (g x)) :
    ∀ x ∈ W, fderiv ℝ f x = fderiv ℝ g x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx
  have hWx : W ∈ 𝓝 x := hW.mem_nhds hx
  have hfc : ContinuousAt f x := hf.continuousOn.continuousAt hWx
  have hgc : ContinuousAt g x := hg.continuousOn.continuousAt hWx
  have hhc : ContinuousAt (fun y => f y - g y) x := hfc.sub hgc
  have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by have := Real.pi_pos; linarith
  have hnear : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, dist (f y - g y) (f x - g x) < 2 * Real.pi :=
    (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hhc) _ hpi
  have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => g y + (f x - g x)) := by
    filter_upwards [hWx, hnear] with y hy hd
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Circle.exp_eq_exp.mp (heq y hy)
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Circle.exp_eq_exp.mp (heq x hx)
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hd
    have hk : (f y - g y) - (f x - g x) = ((m - n : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) := by
      push_cast
      linear_combination hm - hn
    rw [hk, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hpi] at hd
    have h1 : |((m - n : ℤ) : ℝ)| < 1 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      nlinarith
    rw [abs_lt] at h1
    obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := h1
    have h4 : (-1 : ℤ) < m - n := by exact_mod_cast h2
    have h5 : m - n < 1 := by exact_mod_cast h3
    have h6 : m = n := by omega
    subst h6
    linarith
  rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_add_const]

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X)
    (hS : IsCompact S) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (hsq : ∀ j, ∃ a b s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧
      P.W j = {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s})
    (θ : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ) (hθ : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (θ j) (P.W j))
    (hcomp : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      fderiv ℝ (θ j) x = fderiv ℝ (fun x' => θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) x) :
    ∃ u : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
      ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, lap2 (P.h j) (fun x' => θ j x' - u (P.param j x')) x = 0

signature.name: patched_dirichlet_harmonic
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X)
    (hS : IsCompact S) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (hsq : ∀ j, ∃ a b s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧
      P.W j = {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s})
    (θ : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ) (hθ : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (θ j) (P.W j))
    (hcomp : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      fderiv ℝ (θ j) x = fderiv ℝ (fun x' => θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) x) :
    ∃ u : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
      ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, lap2 (P.h j) (fun x' => θ j x' - u (P.param j x')) x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have F1 : ∀ (j k : Fin P.n) (x : E2), x ∈ P.W j → P.param j x ∈ P.O k →
      P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) = P.param j x := by
    intro j k x hx hxk
    have hS' : P.param j x ∈ P.O j ∩ S := by
      rw [← P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hk : P.param j x ∈ P.param k '' P.W k := by
      rw [P.image_eq k]; exact ⟨hxk, hS'.2⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hk
    rw [← hyx, P.proj_param k y hy]
    exact ⟨hy, rfl⟩
  have hOvopen : ∀ j k, IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := fun j k =>
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)
  have hτmaps : ∀ j k, Set.MapsTo (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x))
      (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) (P.W k) := fun j k x hx => (F1 j k x hx.1 hx.2).1
  
  obtain ⟨u, δ, hus, hδ, hgr, hEL1⟩ := dirichlet_variational_sequence S hS P θ hθ hcomp
  have hnorm : ∀ j, ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j →
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n, ∫ x in L, ((θ j x - u n (P.param j x) - c n) ^ 2 +
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x' => θ j x' - u n (P.param j x') - c n) x) ^ 2) ≤ C := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨a, b, s, hs, heq⟩ := hsq j
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := square_poincare_normalize a b s hs
      (fun n x => θ j x - u n (P.param j x))
      (fun n => by rw [← heq]; exact (hθ j).sub (hus n j))
      (fun L hL hLs => hgr j L hL (by rw [heq]; exact hLs))
    exact ⟨c, fun L hL hLs => hc L hL (by rw [← heq]; exact hLs)⟩
  choose cc hcc using hnorm
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, w, G, hψ, hL2, hconv, hgw, hweak⟩ := eig_local_weak_limit P.n P.W P.W_open P.h
    P.h_smooth P.h_posDef (fun _ _ => 0) (fun _ => contDiffOn_const)
    (fun n i x => θ i x - u n (P.param i x) - cc i n)
    (fun n i => ((hθ i).sub (hus n i)).sub contDiffOn_const)
    (fun i L hL hLs => hcc i L hL hLs) δ hδ
    (by
      intro i ζ h1 h2 h3
      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hEL1 i ζ h1 h2 h3
      refine ⟨M, fun n t => ?_⟩
      have hMnt := hM n t
      simp only [pd2, fderiv_sub_const, zero_mul, sub_zero] at hMnt ⊢
      exact hMnt)
  
  have hreg : ∀ i, ∃ w' : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w' (P.W i) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (P.W i)), w i x = w' x) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ P.W i, lap2 (P.h i) w' x = 0 := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨w'', h1, h2, h3⟩ := eig_local_regularity (P.W i) (P.W_open i) (P.h i) (P.h_smooth i)
      (P.h_posDef i) (fun _ => 0) contDiffOn_const (w i) (G i) (hL2 i) (hgw i) (hweak i)
    exact ⟨w'', h1, h2, fun x hx => by simpa using h3 x hx⟩
  choose w' hw's hae hharm using hreg
  have hconv' : ∀ i (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W i →
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (θ i x - u (ψ m) (P.param i x) - cc i (ψ m) - w' i x) ^ 2)
        atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro i L hL hLs
    refine Tendsto.congr (fun m => ?_) (hconv i L hL hLs)
    refine setIntegral_congr_ae hL.measurableSet ?_
    have h1 := hae i
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' (P.W_open i).measurableSet] at h1
    filter_upwards [h1] with x hx hxL
    rw [hx (hLs hxL)]
  
  have hpair : ∀ j k, ∃ e : ℝ, ((P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k).Nonempty →
      Tendsto (fun m => cc j (ψ m) - cc k (ψ m)) atTop (𝓝 e)) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
        w' j x - w' k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) =
          (θ j x - θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) - e := by
    intro j k
    have hs5 := overlap_diff_l2_conv S P j k
      (fun m x => θ j x - u (ψ m) (P.param j x) - cc j (ψ m))
      (fun m y => θ k y - u (ψ m) (P.param k y) - cc k (ψ m)) (w' j) (w' k)
      (fun m => (((hθ j).sub (hus (ψ m) j)).sub contDiffOn_const).continuousOn)
      (fun m => (((hθ k).sub (hus (ψ m) k)).sub contDiffOn_const).continuousOn)
      (hw's j).continuousOn (hw's k).continuousOn
      (fun L hL hLs => hconv' j L hL hLs) (fun L hL hLs => hconv' k L hL hLs)
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => θ j x - θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
        (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
      ((hθ j).mono Set.inter_subset_left).sub ((hθ k).comp (P.trans_smooth j k) (hτmaps j k))
    have hD0 : ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
        fderiv ℝ (fun x => θ j x - θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have hnx : P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k ∈ 𝓝 x := (hOvopen j k).mem_nhds hx
      have hWx : P.W j ∈ 𝓝 x := (P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx.1
      have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (θ j) x :=
        ((hθ j).contDiffAt hWx).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hd3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) x :=
        (((hθ k).comp (P.trans_smooth j k) (hτmaps j k)).contDiffAt hnx).differentiableAt
          (by simp)
      rw [show (fun x => θ j x - θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) =
          (θ j) - (fun x' => θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) from rfl, fderiv_sub hd1 hd3,
        hcomp j k x hx, sub_self]
    have hψc : ContinuousOn (fun x => w' j x - w' k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
        (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
      ((hw's j).continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left).sub
        ((hw's k).continuousOn.comp (P.trans_smooth j k).continuousOn (hτmaps j k))
    have hcv : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k →
        Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, ((θ j x - θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) -
          (cc j (ψ m) - cc k (ψ m)) - (w' j x - w' k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))) ^ 2)
          atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      intro L hL hLs
      refine Tendsto.congr (fun m => ?_) (hs5 L hL hLs)
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hL.measurableSet (fun x hx => ?_)
      have hx' := hLs hx
      have h2 := (F1 j k x hx'.1 hx'.2).2
      simp only [h2]
      ring
    obtain ⟨e, he1, he2⟩ := l2loc_const_limit (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) (hOvopen j k)
      (fun x => θ j x - θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
      (fun x => w' j x - w' k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
      (fun m => cc j (ψ m) - cc k (ψ m)) hD hD0 hψc hcv
    exact ⟨e, he1, he2⟩
  choose e he1 he2 using hpair
  
  have hcob : ∃ c' : Fin P.n → ℝ, ∀ j k, (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k).Nonempty →
      e j k = c' j - c' k := by
    let Lm : (Fin P.n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin P.n → Fin P.n → ℝ) :=
      { toFun := fun c j k => if (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k).Nonempty then c j - c k else 0
        map_add' := by
          intro c d
          funext j k
          simp only [Pi.add_apply]
          split_ifs <;> ring
        map_smul' := by
          intro r c
          funext j k
          simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, RingHom.id_apply]
          split_ifs <;> ring }
    have hclosed : IsClosed ((LinearMap.range Lm : Submodule ℝ (Fin P.n → Fin P.n → ℝ)) :
        Set (Fin P.n → Fin P.n → ℝ)) :=
      Submodule.closed_of_finiteDimensional _
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun m => Lm (fun j => cc j (ψ m))) atTop
        (𝓝 (fun j k => if (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k).Nonempty then e j k else 0)) := by
      rw [tendsto_pi_nhds]
      intro j
      rw [tendsto_pi_nhds]
      intro k
      show Tendsto (fun m => if (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k).Nonempty then
        cc j (ψ m) - cc k (ψ m) else 0) atTop _
      by_cases hV : (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k).Nonempty
      · simp only [if_pos hV]
        exact he1 j k hV
      · simp only [if_neg hV]
        exact tendsto_const_nhds
    have hmem := hclosed.mem_of_tendsto hlim
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun m => LinearMap.mem_range_self Lm _))
    obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := hmem
    refine ⟨c', fun j k hV => ?_⟩
    have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hc' j) k
    change (if (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k).Nonempty then c' j - c' k else 0) =
      (if (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k).Nonempty then e j k else 0) at h1
    rw [if_pos hV, if_pos hV] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  obtain ⟨cs, hcs⟩ := hcob
  
  have hcompat : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      θ j x - w' j x - cs j =
        θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) - w' k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) - cs k := by
    intro j k x hx
    have h1 := he2 j k x hx
    have h2 := hcs j k ⟨x, hx⟩
    linarith
  have hglue : ∃ U : X → ℝ, ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, U (P.param j x) = θ j x - w' j x - cs j := by
    refine ⟨fun q => if hq : ∃ j, q ∈ P.O j ∧ q ∈ S then
      θ hq.choose (P.proj hq.choose q) - w' hq.choose (P.proj hq.choose q) - cs hq.choose
      else 0, ?_⟩
    intro j x hx
    have hq : P.param j x ∈ P.O j ∩ S := by
      rw [← P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hex : ∃ j', P.param j x ∈ P.O j' ∧ P.param j x ∈ S := ⟨j, hq.1, hq.2⟩
    simp only [dif_pos hex]
    exact (hcompat j hex.choose x ⟨hx, hex.choose_spec.1⟩).symm
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := hglue
  
  refine ⟨U, fun j => ?_, fun j x hx => ?_⟩
  · exact (((hθ j).sub (hw's j)).sub contDiffOn_const).congr (fun x hx => hU j x hx)
  · have hev : (fun x' => θ j x' - U (P.param j x')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun x' => w' j x' + cs j) := by
      filter_upwards [(P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx] with y hy
      rw [hU j y hy]
      ring
    have hpd1 : ∀ k, pd2 k (fun x' => w' j x' + cs j) = pd2 k (w' j) := by
      intro k
      funext y
      simp only [pd2, fderiv_add_const]
    have hpdx : ∀ k, pd2 k (fun x' => θ j x' - U (P.param j x')) x = pd2 k (w' j) x := by
      intro k
      rw [← hpd1 k]
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hpd2 : ∀ k l, pd2 l (pd2 k (fun x' => θ j x' - U (P.param j x'))) x =
        pd2 l (pd2 k (w' j)) x := by
      intro k l
      have hev2 : pd2 k (fun x' => θ j x' - U (P.param j x')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] pd2 k (w' j) := by
        filter_upwards [hev.eventuallyEq_nhds] with y hy
        rw [← hpd1 k]
        unfold pd2
        rw [hy.fderiv_eq]
      exact congrArg (fun T : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T (e2 l)) hev2.fderiv_eq
    have hh := hharm j x hx
    unfold lap2 at hh ⊢
    simp only [hpdx, hpd2]
    exact hh

subgoal_signatures.name: dirichlet_variational_sequence
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X)
    (hS : IsCompact S) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (θ : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ) (hθ : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (θ j) (P.W j))
    (hcomp : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      fderiv ℝ (θ j) x = fderiv ℝ (fun x' => θ k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) x) :
    ∃ (u : ℕ → X → ℝ) (δ : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ n j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u n (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
      Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      (∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n,
        ∫ x in L, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x' => θ j x' - u n (P.param j x')) x) ^ 2 ≤ C) ∧
      ∀ j (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W j →
        ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ n (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ n + 2 * t * (∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a b *
            pd2 b (fun x' => θ j x' - u n (P.param j x')) x * pd2 a ζ x) + t ^ 2 * M

subgoal_signatures.name: square_poincare_normalize
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a b s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (v n) {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s})
    (hgrad : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L →
      L ⊆ {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} →
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n, ∫ x in L, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (v n) x) ^ 2 ≤ C) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L →
      L ⊆ {x : E2 | a < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} →
      ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n, ∫ x in L, ((v n x - c n) ^ 2 +
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x' => v n x' - c n) x) ^ 2) ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_local_weak_limit

      intro x hx
      have hxD : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (2 * (ε / 3)) := hsub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx)
      rcases (hnnW x (hcb hxD)).lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        have hxZ : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (2 * (ε / 3)) ∩ v ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hxD, h.symm⟩
        have h2 : dist x₁ z ≤ dist x z := hmin' x hxZ
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx
        linarith
    exact esm_hopf_touching_super (P.W j) (P.W_open j) A B v hA hB hAs hApos hv_smooth hnnW hsup
      z x₁ (dist x₁ z) hR (hsub.trans hcb) hpos rfl hx₁Z.2
  
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ : ∃ φ : X → ℝ, ∀ r, φ r = Q p - Q r := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hφc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => φ (P.param j x)) (P.W j) := fun j =>
    (continuousOn_const.sub (hQs j).continuousOn).congr (fun x _ => hφ _)

    rw [hφ] at h0
    have h1 := hsmax j x hx (by linarith)
    exact h1.mono (fun y hy => by rw [hφ, hy]; ring)
  have h0 : φ p = 0 := by rw [hφ]; ring
  have hprop : ∀ r ∈ connectedComponentIn S p, φ r = 0 := by
    intro q hq
    have hA'o : ∀ j, IsOpen ({x | ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, φ (P.param j y) = 0} ∩ P.W j) :=
      fun j => isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds.inter (P.W_open j)
    have hB'o : ∀ j, IsOpen (P.W j ∩ (fun x => φ (P.param j x)) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) :=
      fun j => (hφc j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) isOpen_compl_singleton
    have hU₁o : IsOpen (⋃ j, (P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹'
        ({x | ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, φ (P.param j y) = 0} ∩ P.W j))) :=
      isOpen_iUnion fun j => (P.proj_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open j) (hA'o j)
    have hU₂o : IsOpen (⋃ j, (P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹'
        (P.W j ∩ (fun x => φ (P.param j x)) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ))) :=
      isOpen_iUnion fun j => (P.proj_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open j) (hB'o j)
    have hcov : S ⊆ (⋃ j, (P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹'
        ({x | ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, φ (P.param j y) = 0} ∩ P.W j))) ∪
        (⋃ j, (P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹' (P.W j ∩ (fun x => φ (P.param j x)) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ))) := by
      intro r hrS
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hrS)
      obtain ⟨hxW, hxr⟩ := hP2 j r hj hrS
      by_cases hr0 : φ r = 0
      · left
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hj, ?_, hxW⟩
        exact hloc j _ hxW (by rw [hxr]; exact hr0)
      · right
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hj, hxW, ?_⟩
        show φ (P.param j (P.proj j r)) ∈ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℝ)
        rw [hxr]
        exact hr0
    have hU₁z : ∀ r ∈ S, r ∈ (⋃ j, (P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹'
        ({x | ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, φ (P.param j y) = 0} ∩ P.W j))) → φ r = 0 := by
      intro r hrS hr1
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hA, -⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hr1
      have hA' : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (P.proj j r), φ (P.param j y) = 0 := hA
      have h1 := hA'.self_of_nhds
      rwa [(hP2 j r hj hrS).2] at h1
    have hU₂z : ∀ r ∈ S, r ∈ (⋃ j, (P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹'
        (P.W j ∩ (fun x => φ (P.param j x)) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ))) → φ r ≠ 0 := by
      intro r hrS hr2
      obtain ⟨j, hj, -, hB⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hr2
      have h1 : φ (P.param j (P.proj j r)) ≠ 0 := hB
      rwa [(hP2 j r hj hrS).2] at h1
    have hCS : connectedComponentIn S p ⊆ S := connectedComponentIn_subset S p
    have hdisj : connectedComponentIn S p ∩ ((⋃ j, (P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹'
        ({x | ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, φ (P.param j y) = 0} ∩ P.W j))) ∩
        (⋃ j, (P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹' (P.W j ∩ (fun x => φ (P.param j x)) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ)))) = ∅ := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      rintro ⟨hxC, hx1, hx2⟩
      exact hU₂z x (hCS hxC) hx2 (hU₁z x (hCS hxC) hx1)
    rcases (isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint.1 (isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn (F := S)
        (x := p))) _ _ hU₁o hU₂o (hCS.trans hcov) hdisj with h | h
    · exact hU₁z q (hCS hq) (h hq)
    · exact absurd h0 (hU₂z p hp (h (mem_connectedComponentIn hp)))

    obtain ⟨j, x, hx, hxc, hKpos⟩ := hK' p hp
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (P.W_open j) x hx
    have hT : P.param j '' Metric.ball x r ⊆ connectedComponentIn S p := by
      have hpre : IsPreconnected (P.param j '' Metric.ball x r) :=
        (convex_ball x r).isPreconnected.image _ ((P.param_cont j).mono hball)
      have hTS : P.param j '' Metric.ball x r ⊆ S := by
        rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact hP1 j y (hball hy)
      have h1 := hpre.subset_connectedComponentIn ⟨x, Metric.mem_ball_self hr, rfl⟩ hTS
      rwa [← connectedComponentIn_eq hxc] at h1
    have hev : qf j =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => Q p := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x hr] with y hy
      rw [← hQ j y (hball hy)]
      have h1 := hprop _ (hT ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)
      rw [hφ] at h1
      linarith
    have hc0 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun _ : E2 => Q p) = fun _ => 0 := by
      intro k
      funext y
      simp [pd2]
    have hc00 : ∀ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun _ : E2 => (0 : ℝ)) x = 0 := by
      intro i
      simp [pd2]
    have hlap0 : lap2 (P.h j) (qf j) x = 0 := by
      rw [hgerm _ _ _ x hev]
      simp [lap2, hc0, hc00]
    have hqx : qf j x = Q p := hev.self_of_nhds
    have h1 := hboch j x hx
    rw [hlap0, hqx] at h1
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have h2 := mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2) hKpos) hcon
    linarith
  
  have hq0 : qf j₀ x₀ = 0 := by
    have h1 := hQ j₀ x₀ hx₀
    have h2 := hmax' _ (hP1 j₀ x₀ hx₀)
    have h3 := hq_nonneg j₀ x₀ hx₀
    linarith
  rw [hqdef] at hq0
  have hξ := ((posDef_inv_quad_facts (P.h j₀ x₀) (P.h_posDef j₀ x₀ hx₀)).1
    (fun a => pd2 a (w j₀) x₀)).2 hq0
  have hzero : ∀ a : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (w j₀) x₀ (e2 a) = 0 := fun a => congrFun hξ a
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.coe_injective
  refine (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis.ext (fun i => ?_)
  simpa using hzero i

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_form_pair_compat
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (f g : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f j) (P.W j)) (hg : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g j) (P.W j))
    (hcf : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      fderiv ℝ (f j) x = fderiv ℝ (fun x' => f k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) x)
    (hcg : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      fderiv ℝ (g j) x = fderiv ℝ (fun x' => g k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) x)
    (j k : Fin P.n) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :
    ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a (f j) x * pd2 b (g j) x =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ a b *
        pd2 a (f k) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 b (g k) (P.proj k (P.param j x))

subgoal_signatures.name: gs2_metric_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) (hhsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j y = christoffel2 h k j i y) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j) k i j y = 0) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m))

subgoal_signatures.name: bochner_lap2_identity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) :
    lap2 h (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w y * pd2 b w y) x =
      2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * (h x)⁻¹ b d *
          (pd2 a (pd2 b w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k a b x * pd2 k w x) *
          (pd2 c (pd2 d w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k c d x * pd2 k w x)) +
        2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b (lap2 h w) x) +
        2 * gaussCurv2 h x * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b w x)

subgoal_signatures.name: posDef_inv_quad_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b ∧
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b = 0 → ξ = 0)) ∧
    (∀ H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        A⁻¹ a c * A⁻¹ b d * H a b * H c d)

subgoal_signatures.name: esm_lap2_coeff_form
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsm : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) : ∃ (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) ∧ (∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) ∧ ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), lap2 h w x = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k w x

subgoal_signatures.name: esm_hopf_touching_super
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) (hB : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) (hAs : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (hnn : ∀ x ∈ W, 0 ≤ w x) (hsup : ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k w x ≤ 0) (z x₁ : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z R, 0 < w x) (hx₁ : dist x₁ z = R) (hw₁ : w x₁ = 0) : False

        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) u) = u) ∧
      (∀ v, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x)
        (tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x v) = v) := by
    intro x₀ x hx
    have hy : chartAt E3 x₀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target := (chartAt E3 x₀).map_source hx
    have hxy : (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) = x := (chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv hx
    have hd1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hy
    have hd2 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀) x :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hx
    have hT : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀) x =
        tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x :=
      mfderiv_chartAt_eq_tangentCoordChange hx
    constructor
    · intro u
      have hd2' : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀)
          ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x)) := by rw [hxy]; exact hd2
      have hc := mfderiv_comp (chartAt E3 x₀ x) hd2' hd1
      have hid : ((chartAt E3 x₀) ∘ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 x₀ x)] id := by
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 x₀).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz using hz
      rw [hid.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_id, hxy, hT] at hc
      have := congrArg (fun L => L u) hc
      simpa using this.symm
    · intro v
      have hc := mfderiv_comp x hd1 hd2
      have hid : ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm ∘ (chartAt E3 x₀)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] id := by
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 x₀).eventually_left_inverse hx] with z hz using hz
      rw [hid.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_id, hT] at hc
      have := congrArg (fun L => L v) hc
      simpa using this.symm
  
  have section_cmd : ∀ (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x) (x₀ : M) (W : E3 → E3),
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 W (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) →
      (∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x (V x) = W (chartAt E3 x₀ x)) →
      ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
        (fun y => (⟨y, V y⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x₀ := by
    intro V x₀ W hW hV
    rw [Bundle.contMDiffAt_section]
    have hc : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 (chartAt E3 x₀) x₀ := by
      have := contMDiffAt_extChartAt (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := 1) (x := x₀)
      simpa [extChartAt_coe] using this
    have h1 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 (fun x => W (chartAt E3 x₀ x)) x₀ :=
      hW.contMDiffAt.comp x₀ hc
    refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hV] with x hx
    rw [← hx, tangentCoordChange_def, TangentBundle.trivializationAt_apply]
    rfl
  
  let wf : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → E3 := fun x ℓ =>
    ∑ i, (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun a b => g.g x (e a) (e b))⁻¹ (fun j => ℓ (e j))) i • e i
  have hwR : ∀ x (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) v, g.g x v (wf x ℓ) = ℓ v := by
    intro x ℓ v
    have h1 := bil_riesz (g.g x) (fun j => ℓ (e j)) (bil_detpos _ (g.posDef x)) v
    calc g.g x v (wf x ℓ) = ∑ j, v j * ℓ (e j) := h1
      _ = ℓ (∑ i, v i • e i) := (lin_expand ℓ (fun i => v i)).symm
      _ = ℓ v := by rw [← vec_expand v]
  have hposℓ : ∀ x (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → 0 < ℓ (wf x ℓ) := by
    intro x ℓ hℓ
    have hw0 : wf x ℓ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hℓ
      ext v
      have := hwR x ℓ v
      rw [h0, map_zero] at this
      simpa using this.symm
    have := g.posDef x (wf x ℓ) hw0
    rwa [hwR] at this
  refine ⟨fun x ℓ => (ℓ (wf x ℓ))⁻¹ • wf x ℓ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro x ℓ
    have hneg : wf x (-ℓ) = -wf x ℓ := by
      refine bil_unique (g.g x) (g.posDef x) _ _ (fun v => ?_)
      rw [hwR, map_neg, hwR]
      rfl
    show ((-ℓ) (wf x (-ℓ)))⁻¹ • wf x (-ℓ) = -((ℓ (wf x ℓ))⁻¹ • wf x ℓ)
    rw [hneg, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, map_neg, neg_neg, smul_neg]
  · 
    intro x ℓ hℓ
    show ℓ ((ℓ (wf x ℓ))⁻¹ • wf x ℓ) = 1
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (hposℓ x ℓ hℓ).ne']
  
  intro X τ hX hτs hτr x₀ hx₀
  have chain_tau : ∀ (x₀ : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target →
      (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y ∈ X → ∀ v : E3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) y v =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm y)
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y v) := by
    intro x₀ y hy hyX v
    have hd1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hy
    have hτd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm y) :=
      (hτs.contMDiffAt (hX.mem_nhds hyX)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hc := mfderiv_comp y hτd hd1
    rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at hc
    exact congrArg (fun L => L v) hc
  have xi_smooth : ∀ (x₀ : M), x₀ ∈ X → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) y (e j))
        (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := by
    intro x₀ hx₀ j
    have hO : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) :=
      (chartAt E3 x₀).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hX
    have hy₀ : chartAt E3 x₀ x₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X :=
      ⟨mem_chart_target E3 x₀, by
        show (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) ∈ X
        rw [(chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x₀)]; exact hx₀⟩
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z))
        ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) := by
      have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (τ ∘ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm)
          ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) :=
        hτs.comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hy.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)))
        ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) :=
      hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hO (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    exact (hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hy₀)
  let ℓ : M → E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun x => mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x
  let w : M → E3 := fun x => wf x (ℓ x)
  let V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x := fun x => (ℓ x (w x))⁻¹ • w x
  show ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
    (fun y => (⟨y, V y⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x₀
  have hwR' : ∀ x v, g.g x v (w x) = ℓ x v := fun x v => hwR x (ℓ x) v
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ X, 0 < ℓ x (w x) := fun x hx => hposℓ x (ℓ x) (hτr x hx)
  let G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm
  let ξ : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun y j => fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) y (e j)
  let c : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun y => Matrix.mulVec (G y)⁻¹ (ξ y)
  let W : E3 → E3 := fun y => (∑ i, c y i * ξ y i)⁻¹ • ∑ i, c y i • e i
  
  have hK : ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).source ∩ X,
      tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x (V x) = W (chartAt E3 x₀ x) ∧
      ℓ x (w x) = ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i * ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i := by
    rintro x ⟨hxs, hxX⟩
    obtain ⟨hTA0, hAT0⟩ := chart_inv x₀ x hxs
    let A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x)
    let T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x
    have hTA : ∀ u, T (A u) = u := hTA0
    have hAT : ∀ v, A (T v) = v := hAT0
    have hy : chartAt E3 x₀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target := (chartAt E3 x₀).map_source hxs
    have hxy : (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) = x := (chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv hxs
    have hG : G (chartAt E3 x₀ x) =
        Matrix.of fun a b => (g.g x).bilinearComp A A (e a) (e b) := by
      ext a b
      simp only [G, RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, Matrix.of_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply]
      rw [hxy]
      rfl
    have hξ : ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x) = fun j => ℓ x (A (e j)) := by
      funext j
      simp only [ξ]
      rw [chain_tau x₀ _ hy (by rw [hxy]; exact hxX), hxy]
      rfl
    have hdetB : (Matrix.of fun a b => (g.g x).bilinearComp A A (e a) (e b)).det ≠ 0 := by
      refine bil_detpos _ (fun v hv => ?_)
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply]
      apply g.posDef
      intro h0
      apply hv
      rw [← hTA v]
      exact (congrArg T h0).trans (map_zero T)
    let u : E3 := ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i • e i
    have hRu : ∀ v, (g.g x).bilinearComp A A v u = ∑ j, v j * ℓ x (A (e j)) := by
      intro v
      have := bil_riesz ((g.g x).bilinearComp A A) (fun j => ℓ x (A (e j))) hdetB v
      simp only [u, c, hG, hξ]
      exact this
    have hAu : ∀ v, g.g x v (A u) = ℓ x v := by
      intro v
      have h1 := hRu (T v)
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply, hAT v] at h1
      rw [h1]
      calc ∑ j, (T v) j * ℓ x (A (e j)) = ((ℓ x).comp A) (∑ i, (T v) i • e i) :=
            (lin_expand ((ℓ x).comp A) (fun i => (T v) i)).symm
        _ = ℓ x v := by
            rw [← vec_expand (T v), ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hAT v]
    have hwAu : w x = A u :=
      bil_unique (g.g x) (g.posDef x) _ _ (fun v => (hwR' x v).trans (hAu v).symm)
    have hlw : ℓ x (w x) = ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i * ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i := by
      rw [hwAu, hξ]
      exact lin_expand ((ℓ x).comp A) (c (chartAt E3 x₀ x))
    refine ⟨?_, hlw⟩
    show T ((ℓ x (w x))⁻¹ • w x) = W (chartAt E3 x₀ x)
    rw [hlw, hwAu, map_smul, hTA]
  
  have hy₀ : chartAt E3 x₀ x₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target := mem_chart_target E3 x₀
  have hGs : ∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => G y i j) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := fun i j =>
    ((g.smooth x₀ i j).contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 x₀).open_target.mem_nhds hy₀)).of_le
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have hK₀ := hK x₀ ⟨mem_chart_source E3 x₀, hx₀⟩
  have hdetG : (G (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀)).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hc0 : c (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) = 0 := by
      simp only [c, Matrix.inv_def, h0, Ring.inverse_zero, zero_smul, Matrix.zero_mulVec]
    have := hpos x₀ hx₀
    rw [hK₀.2, hc0] at this
    simp at this
  have hξs : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => ξ y j) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := fun j =>
    xi_smooth x₀ hx₀ j
  have hcs : ∀ i, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => c y i) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := by
    intro i
    simp only [c, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    exact ContDiffAt.sum fun k _ => (inv_contDiffAt G _ hGs hdetG i k).mul (hξs k)
  have hden : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => ∑ i, c y i * ξ y i) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) :=
    ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => (hcs i).mul (hξs i)
  have hden0 : ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) i * ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hK₀.2]; exact (hpos x₀ hx₀).ne'
  have hWs : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 W (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) :=
    (hden.inv hden0).smul (ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => (hcs i).smul contDiffAt_const)
  refine section_cmd V x₀ W hWs ?_
  filter_upwards [((chartAt E3 x₀).open_source.inter hX).mem_nhds
    ⟨mem_chart_source E3 x₀, hx₀⟩] with x hx using (hK x hx).1

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (X : Set M) (hX : IsOpen X) (τ : M → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hτs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X)
    (hτr : ∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0)
    (hτb : ∀ x ∈ X, a < τ x ∧ τ x < b)
    (hτp : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → IsCompact (X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d)) :
    ∃ Θ : M → ℝ → M,
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∀ s : ℝ, a < τ x + s → τ x + s < b → Θ x s ∈ X ∧ τ (Θ x s) = τ x + s) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, Θ x 0 = x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∀ s s' : ℝ, a < τ x + s → τ x + s < b → a < τ x + s + s' →
        τ x + s + s' < b → Θ (Θ x s) s' = Θ x (s + s')) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 p.2)
        {p : M × ℝ | p.1 ∈ X ∧ a < τ p.1 + p.2 ∧ τ p.1 + p.2 < b}

signature.name: collar_global_flow
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (X : Set M) (hX : IsOpen X) (τ : M → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hτs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X)
    (hτr : ∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0)
    (hτb : ∀ x ∈ X, a < τ x ∧ τ x < b)
    (hτp : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → IsCompact (X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d)) :
    ∃ Θ : M → ℝ → M,
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∀ s : ℝ, a < τ x + s → τ x + s < b → Θ x s ∈ X ∧ τ (Θ x s) = τ x + s) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, Θ x 0 = x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∀ s s' : ℝ, a < τ x + s → τ x + s < b → a < τ x + s + s' →
        τ x + s + s' < b → Θ (Θ x s) s' = Θ x (s + s')) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Θ p.1 p.2)
        {p : M × ℝ | p.1 ∈ X ∧ a < τ p.1 + p.2 ∧ τ p.1 + p.2 < b}

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨V, hVs, hVτ⟩ := tau_gradient_field g X hX τ hτs hτr
  have hloc : ∀ x₀ ∈ X, ∃ (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (ψ : M → ℝ → M), IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ X ∧
      0 < ε ∧ ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => ψ p.1 p.2) (N ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ N, ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, ψ x s ∈ X :=
    fun x₀ hx₀ => local_flow_of_contMDiffAt X hX V x₀ hx₀ (hVs x₀ hx₀)
  have huniq : ∀ (γ γ' : ℝ → M) (α β t₀ : ℝ), t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → IsMIntegralCurveOn γ' V (Set.Ioo α β) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ' t ∈ X) → γ t₀ = γ' t₀ →
      Set.EqOn γ γ' (Set.Ioo α β) :=
    fun γ γ' α β t₀ ht₀ hγ hγ' hγX hγ'X h₀ =>
      integral_curve_eqOn_of_mem X V hVs γ γ' α β t₀ ht₀ hγ hγ' hγX hγ'X h₀
  have hτlin : ∀ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β s₀ : ℝ), s₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) →
      ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo α β, τ (γ s) = τ (γ s₀) + (s - s₀) :=
    fun γ α β s₀ hs₀ hγ hγX =>
      tau_affine_along_integral_curve X hX τ hτs V hVτ γ α β s₀ hs₀ hγ hγX
  have hunif : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → ∃ (O : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (Ψ : M → ℝ → M),
      IsOpen O ∧ X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => Ψ p.1 p.2) (O ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, Ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (Ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, Ψ x s ∈ X :=
    fun c d hc hd => uniform_flow_on_compact X (X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d) Set.inter_subset_left
      (hτp c d hc hd) V hloc huniq
  have hunif' : ∀ c d : ℝ, a < c → d < b → ∃ (O : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (Ψ : M → ℝ → M),
      X ∩ τ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d ⊆ O ∧ O ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, Ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (Ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, Ψ x s ∈ X := by
    intro c d hc hd
    obtain ⟨O, ε, Ψ, _, h1, h2, h3, _, h5⟩ := hunif c d hc hd
    exact ⟨O, ε, Ψ, h1, h2, h3, h5⟩
  have hlong : ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ T₁ T₂ : ℝ, T₁ ≤ 0 → 0 ≤ T₂ → a < τ x + T₁ → τ x + T₂ < b →
      ∃ (γ : ℝ → M) (α β : ℝ), α < T₁ ∧ T₂ < β ∧ γ 0 = x ∧
        IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X :=
    fun x hx T₁ T₂ h1 h2 h3 h4 =>
      long_integral_curve_exists X τ a b V hτb huniq hτlin hunif' x hx T₁ T₂ h1 h2 h3 h4
  exact global_flow_assembly X hX τ a b hτs.continuousOn hτb V huniq hτlin hunif hlong

subgoal_signatures.name: tau_gradient_field
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (X : Set M)
    (hX : IsOpen X) (τ : M → ℝ) (hτs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X)
    (hτr : ∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) :

    (huniq : ∀ (γ γ' : ℝ → M) (α β t₀ : ℝ), t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β →
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β) → IsMIntegralCurveOn γ' V (Set.Ioo α β) →
