informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (U : Set M) (hUo : IsOpen U) (N : Set M) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N)
    (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x ≠ 0)
    (hσpos : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x)
    (hgood : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ ∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, σ x = |f x|)
    (Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hNg1 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), Ng x (-ℓ) = -Ng x ℓ)
    (hNg2 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ℓ (Ng x ℓ) = 1)
    (hNg3 : ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
        (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
        ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
          (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x) :
    ∃ (A : Set M) (prn : M → M), IsOpen A ∧ frontier U ⊆ A ∧
      ContinuousOn prn (A ∩ U ∩ N) ∧ (∀ y ∈ A ∩ U ∩ N, prn y ∈ frontier U) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ A ∩ U ∩ N, ∃ (B Ω : Set M) (sec : M → M), IsOpen B ∧ y ∈ B ∧ IsOpen Ω ∧
        ContinuousOn sec (Ω ∩ frontier U) ∧
        (∀ y' ∈ Ω ∩ frontier U, sec y' ∈ B ∩ A ∩ U ∩ N ∧ σ (sec y') = σ y ∧ prn (sec y') = y') ∧
        (∀ w ∈ B ∩ A ∩ U ∩ N, σ w = σ y → prn w ∈ Ω ∧ sec (prn w) = w)

signature.name: near_frontier_projection
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (U : Set M) (hUo : IsOpen U) (N : Set M) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N)
    (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x ≠ 0)
    (hσpos : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x)
    (hgood : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ ∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, σ x = |f x|)
    (Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hNg1 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), Ng x (-ℓ) = -Ng x ℓ)
    (hNg2 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ℓ (Ng x ℓ) = 1)
    (hNg3 : ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
        (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
        ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
          (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x) :
    ∃ (A : Set M) (prn : M → M), IsOpen A ∧ frontier U ⊆ A ∧
      ContinuousOn prn (A ∩ U ∩ N) ∧ (∀ y ∈ A ∩ U ∩ N, prn y ∈ frontier U) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ A ∩ U ∩ N, ∃ (B Ω : Set M) (sec : M → M), IsOpen B ∧ y ∈ B ∧ IsOpen Ω ∧
        ContinuousOn sec (Ω ∩ frontier U) ∧
        (∀ y' ∈ Ω ∩ frontier U, sec y' ∈ B ∩ A ∩ U ∩ N ∧ σ (sec y') = σ y ∧ prn (sec y') = y') ∧
        (∀ w ∈ B ∩ A ∩ U ∩ N, σ w = σ y → prn w ∈ Ω ∧ sec (prn w) = w)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hV : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
      (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x :=
    hNg3 (U ∩ N) σ (hUo.inter hNo) hσs hσr
  have hFU : ∀ x, x ∈ frontier U → x ∉ U := by
    intro x hx hxU
    rw [hUo.frontier_eq] at hx
    exact hx.2 hxU
  
  have hdata : ∀ p, p ∈ frontier U → ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ) (W W' : Set M) (ε η : ℝ)
      (ψ : M → ℝ → M),
      IsOpen V ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, σ x = |f x|) ∧
      IsOpen W ∧ IsOpen W' ∧ p ∈ W' ∧ W' ⊆ W ∧ W ⊆ V ∩ N ∧ 0 < ε ∧ 0 < η ∧ η ≤ ε / 2 ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun q : M × ℝ => ψ q.1 q.2) (W ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ W, ψ x 0 = x ∧
        IsMIntegralCurveOn (ψ x) (fun z => Ng z (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f z))
          (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, ψ x t ∈ V ∩ N ∧ f (ψ x t) = f x + t) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < ε / 2 → ψ x t ∈ W → ψ (ψ x t) (-t) = x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ W', |f x| < η) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ W', ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < η → ψ x t ∈ W) := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨V, f, hVo, hpV, hf, hdf, hVF, hσf⟩ := hgood p hp
    have hQo : IsOpen (V ∩ N) := hVo.inter hNo
    have hpQ : p ∈ V ∩ N := ⟨hpV, hFN hp⟩
    have hdfQ : ∀ x ∈ V ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 := fun x hx => hdf x hx.1
    have hY := hNg3 (V ∩ N) f hQo hf.contMDiffOn hdfQ
    have hfY : ∀ x ∈ V ∩ N,
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x (Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x)) = 1 :=
      fun x hx => hNg2 x _ (hdfQ x hx)
    have hfp : f p = 0 := by
      have h : p ∈ V ∩ frontier U := ⟨hpV, hp⟩
      rw [hVF] at h
      exact h.2
    obtain ⟨W, ε, ψ, hWo, hpW, hWQ, hε, hψc, hψ⟩ := local_flow_of_contMDiffAt (V ∩ N) hQo
      (fun z => Ng z (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f z)) p hpQ (hY p hpQ)
    have haff : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, f (ψ x t) = f x + t := by
      intro x hx t ht
      obtain ⟨h0, hint, hvals⟩ := hψ x hx
      have h := tau_affine_along_integral_curve (V ∩ N) hQo f hf.contMDiffOn _ hfY (ψ x)
        (-ε) ε 0 ⟨by linarith, hε⟩ hint hvals t ht
      rw [h, h0]
      ring
    have hinv : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < ε / 2 → ψ x t ∈ W → ψ (ψ x t) (-t) = x := by
      intro x hx t ht hz
      obtain ⟨h0, hint, hvals⟩ := hψ x hx
      obtain ⟨hz0, hzint, hzvals⟩ := hψ (ψ x t) hz
      have ht' := abs_lt.mp ht
      have hJ : Set.Ioo (-(ε / 2)) (ε / 2) ⊆ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε :=
        Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hJ2 : Set.Ioo (-(ε / 2)) (ε / 2) ⊆ {s | s + t ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε} := by
        intro s hs
        exact ⟨by linarith [hs.1], by linarith [hs.2]⟩
      have heq := integral_curve_eqOn_of_mem (V ∩ N) _ hY (ψ (ψ x t)) (ψ x ∘ fun s => s + t)
        (-(ε / 2)) (ε / 2) 0 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ (hzint.mono hJ)
        ((hint.comp_add t).mono hJ2) (fun s hs => hzvals s (hJ hs))
        (fun s hs => hvals (s + t) (hJ2 hs)) (by simp [hz0])
      have h := heq (show -t ∈ Set.Ioo (-(ε / 2)) (ε / 2) from ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
      simp only [Function.comp, neg_add_cancel] at h
      rw [h, h0]
    have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun q : M × ℝ => ψ q.1 q.2) (p, 0) :=
      hψc.continuousAt ((hWo.prod isOpen_Ioo).mem_nhds ⟨hpW, by constructor <;> linarith⟩)
    have hpre : (fun q : M × ℝ => ψ q.1 q.2) ⁻¹' W ∈ 𝓝 (p, (0 : ℝ)) := by
      apply hcont.preimage_mem_nhds
      show W ∈ 𝓝 (ψ p 0)
      rw [(hψ p hpW).1]
      exact hWo.mem_nhds hpW
    obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := mem_nhds_prod_iff.1 hpre
    obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁u, hW₁o, hpW₁⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.1 hu
    obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hη₁v⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.1 hv
    have hη : 0 < min η₁ (ε / 2) := lt_min hη₁ (by linarith)
    have hηε : min η₁ (ε / 2) ≤ ε / 2 := min_le_right _ _
    have hηη₁ : min η₁ (ε / 2) ≤ η₁ := min_le_left _ _
    refine ⟨V, f, W, W ∩ W₁ ∩ f ⁻¹' Metric.ball 0 (min η₁ (ε / 2)), ε, min η₁ (ε / 2), ψ,
      hVo, hf, hVF, hσf, hWo,
      (hWo.inter hW₁o).inter (Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hf.continuous), ?_,
      fun x hx => hx.1.1, hWQ, hε, hη, hηε, hψc,
      fun x hx => ⟨(hψ x hx).1, (hψ x hx).2.1, fun t ht => ⟨(hψ x hx).2.2 t ht, haff x hx t ht⟩⟩,
      hinv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨⟨hpW, hpW₁⟩, ?_⟩
      show f p ∈ Metric.ball 0 (min η₁ (ε / 2))
      rw [hfp]
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self hη
    · intro x hx
      have h := hx.2
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, mem_ball_zero_iff, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
      exact h
    · intro x hx t ht
      have h1 : t ∈ v := by
        apply hη₁v
        rw [mem_ball_zero_iff, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        linarith
      exact huv (show (x, t) ∈ u ×ˢ v from ⟨hW₁u hx.1.2, h1⟩)
  choose V f W W' ε η ψ hVo hf hVF hσf hWo hW'o hpW' hW'W hWQ hε hη hηε hψc hψ hψinv hW'f hW'ψ
    using hdata
  
  have hAo : IsOpen (⋃ p, ⋃ hp : p ∈ frontier U, W' p hp) :=
    isOpen_iUnion fun p => isOpen_iUnion fun hp => hW'o p hp
  have hFA : frontier U ⊆ ⋃ p, ⋃ hp : p ∈ frontier U, W' p hp :=
    fun p hp => Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨p, hp, hpW' p hp⟩
  have hFR : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ frontier U), ∀ x ∈ W' p hp, ψ p hp x (-f p hp x) ∈ frontier U := by
    intro p hp x hx
    have hxW := hW'W p hp hx
    have hfx := abs_lt.mp (hW'f p hp x hx)
    have hεp := hε p hp
    have hηε' := hηε p hp
    have ht : -f p hp x ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε p hp) (ε p hp) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨hmem, hfval⟩ := (hψ p hp x hxW).2.2 _ ht
    have h : ψ p hp x (-f p hp x) ∈ V p hp ∩ f p hp ⁻¹' {0} := by
      refine ⟨hmem.1, ?_⟩
      show f p hp (ψ p hp x (-f p hp x)) = 0
      rw [hfval]
      ring
    rw [← hVF p hp] at h
    exact h.2
  
  have hcurve : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ frontier U), ∀ y ∈ W' p hp ∩ (U ∩ N), ∃ c : ℝ → M,
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y), c t ∈ U ∩ N) ∧
      IsMIntegralCurveOn c (fun z => Ng z (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ z))
        (Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y)) ∧
      ContinuousOn c (Set.Ico (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y)) ∧
      c 0 = y ∧ c (-σ y) = ψ p hp y (-f p hp y) ∧ σ y < ε p hp / 2 := by
    intro p hp y hy
    have hyW := hW'W p hp hy.1
    obtain ⟨h0, hint, hval⟩ := hψ p hp y hyW
    have hεp := hε p hp
    have hηε' := hηε p hp
    have hfy' := hW'f p hp y hy.1
    have hyV : y ∈ V p hp := (hWQ p hp hyW).1
    have hσy : σ y = |f p hp y| := hσf p hp y ⟨⟨hyV, hy.2.1⟩, hy.2.2⟩

      intro h
      have h' : y ∈ V p hp ∩ f p hp ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hyV, h⟩
      rw [← hVF p hp] at h'
      exact hFU y h'.2 hy.2.1
    have hσlt : σ y < ε p hp / 2 := by rw [hσy]; linarith
    have hσ0 : 0 < σ y := hσpos y hy.2
    have key : ∀ s : ℝ, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) → f p hp y = s * σ y → ∃ c : ℝ → M,
        (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y), c t ∈ U ∩ N) ∧
        IsMIntegralCurveOn c (fun z => Ng z (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ z))
          (Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y)) ∧
        ContinuousOn c (Set.Ico (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y)) ∧
        c 0 = y ∧ c (-σ y) = ψ p hp y (-f p hp y) ∧ σ y < ε p hp / 2 := by
      intro s hs hfs
      have hss : s * s = 1 := by rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
      have habs : |s| = 1 := by rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> simp
      have hJ : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y), t * s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε p hp) (ε p hp) := by
        intro t ht
        obtain ⟨ht1, ht2⟩ := ht
        rcases hs with rfl | rfl
        · constructor <;> linarith
        · constructor <;> linarith
      have hfc : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ico (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y),
          f p hp (ψ p hp y (t * s)) = s * (σ y + t) := by
        intro t ht
        rw [(hval _ (hJ t ht)).2, hfs]
        ring
      have hpos : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y), 0 < s * f p hp (ψ p hp y (t * s)) := by
        intro t ht
        rw [hfc t (Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self ht), ← mul_assoc, hss, one_mul]
        linarith [ht.1]
      have hnotF : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y), ψ p hp y (t * s) ∉ frontier U := by
        intro t ht hF
        have hV' : ψ p hp y (t * s) ∈ V p hp := (hval _ (hJ t (Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self ht))).1.1
        have h' : ψ p hp y (t * s) ∈ V p hp ∩ frontier U := ⟨hV', hF⟩
        rw [hVF p hp] at h'
        have h0' : f p hp (ψ p hp y (t * s)) = 0 := h'.2
        have h2 := hpos t ht
        rw [h0', mul_zero] at h2
        exact lt_irrefl _ h2
      have hcc : ContinuousOn (fun t => ψ p hp y (t * s)) (Set.Ico (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y)) :=
        hint.continuousOn.comp (continuousOn_id.mul continuousOn_const) (fun t ht => hJ t ht)
      have h0J : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      have hcU : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y), ψ p hp y (t * s) ∈ U := by
        have hpc : IsPreconnected
            ((fun t => ψ p hp y (t * s)) '' Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y)) :=
          isPreconnected_Ioo.image _ (hcc.mono Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self)
        have hsub : (fun t => ψ p hp y (t * s)) '' Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y) ⊆
            U ∪ (closure U)ᶜ := by
          rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
          by_cases h : ψ p hp y (t * s) ∈ U
          · exact Or.inl h
          · right
            intro hcl
            exact hnotF t ht (by rw [hUo.frontier_eq]; exact ⟨hcl, h⟩)
        have hne : ((fun t => ψ p hp y (t * s)) '' Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y) ∩ U).Nonempty :=
          ⟨y, ⟨0, h0J, by simp [h0]⟩, hy.2.1⟩
        have hsU := IsPreconnected.subset_left_of_subset_union hUo isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
          (Disjoint.mono_left subset_closure disjoint_compl_right) hsub hne hpc
        intro t ht
        exact hsU ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      have hfield : ∀ x ∈ V p hp ∩ U ∩ N, 0 < s * f p hp x →
          s • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f p hp) x) =
            Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x) := by
        intro x hx hsx
        have hO : IsOpen (V p hp ∩ U ∩ N ∩ {z | 0 < s * f p hp z}) :=
          (((hVo p hp).inter hUo).inter hNo).inter
            (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_const.mul (hf p hp).continuous))
        have hxO : x ∈ V p hp ∩ U ∩ N ∩ {z | 0 < s * f p hp z} := ⟨hx, hsx⟩
        have hσeq : ∀ z ∈ V p hp ∩ U ∩ N ∩ {z | 0 < s * f p hp z}, σ z = s * f p hp z := by
          intro z hz
          have h2 : 0 < s * f p hp z := hz.2
          rw [hσf p hp z hz.1, ← abs_of_pos h2, abs_mul, habs, one_mul]
        have hev : σ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun z => s * f p hp z :=

        rcases hs with rfl | rfl
        · have hev' : σ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] f p hp :=
            hev.trans (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => one_mul _)

        · have hev' : σ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] -(f p hp) :=
            hev.trans (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by simp)
          rw [hev'.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_neg, hNg1, neg_one_smul]
      refine ⟨fun t => ψ p hp y (t * s), ?_, ?_, hcc, ?_, ?_, hσlt⟩
      · intro t ht
        exact ⟨hcU t ht, (hval _ (hJ t (Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self ht))).1.2⟩
      · have h1 := (hint.comp_mul s).mono
          (fun t (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y)) => hJ t (Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self ht))
        intro t ht
        have h2 := h1 t ht
        have hmem := hval _ (hJ t (Set.Ioo_subset_Ico_self ht))
        have hF := hfield (ψ p hp y (t * s)) ⟨⟨hmem.1.1, hcU t ht⟩, hmem.1.2⟩ (hpos t ht)

    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hfy with hneg | hpos
    · exact key (-1) (Or.inr rfl) (by rw [hσy, abs_of_neg hneg]; ring)
    · exact key 1 (Or.inl rfl) (by rw [hσy, abs_of_pos hpos]; ring)
  
  have hcons : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ frontier U) q (hq : q ∈ frontier U), ∀ y ∈ W' p hp ∩ (U ∩ N),
      y ∈ W' q hq → ψ p hp y (-f p hp y) = ψ q hq y (-f q hq y) := by
    intro p hp q hq y hy hyq
    obtain ⟨cp, hcpX, hcpI, hcpC, hcp0, hcpE, hσp⟩ := hcurve p hp y hy
    obtain ⟨cq, hcqX, hcqI, hcqC, hcq0, hcqE, hσq⟩ := hcurve q hq y ⟨hyq, hy.2⟩
    have hσy := hσpos y hy.2
    have hεp := hε p hp
    have hεq := hε q hq
    have hb : 0 < min (ε p hp) (ε q hq) - σ y := by
      rcases min_cases (ε p hp) (ε q hq) with h | h <;> rw [h.1] <;> linarith
    have hbp : min (ε p hp) (ε q hq) - σ y ≤ ε p hp - σ y := by
      linarith [min_le_left (ε p hp) (ε q hq)]
    have hbq : min (ε p hp) (ε q hq) - σ y ≤ ε q hq - σ y := by
      linarith [min_le_right (ε p hp) (ε q hq)]
    have hsp : Set.Ioo (-σ y) (min (ε p hp) (ε q hq) - σ y) ⊆ Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y) :=
      Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo le_rfl hbp
    have hsq : Set.Ioo (-σ y) (min (ε p hp) (ε q hq) - σ y) ⊆ Set.Ioo (-σ y) (ε q hq - σ y) :=

    have hsp' : Set.Ico (-σ y) (min (ε p hp) (ε q hq) - σ y) ⊆ Set.Ico (-σ y) (ε p hp - σ y) :=
      Set.Ico_subset_Ico le_rfl hbp
    have hsq' : Set.Ico (-σ y) (min (ε p hp) (ε q hq) - σ y) ⊆ Set.Ico (-σ y) (ε q hq - σ y) :=
      Set.Ico_subset_Ico le_rfl hbq
    have heq := integral_curve_eqOn_of_mem (U ∩ N) _ hV cp cq (-σ y)
      (min (ε p hp) (ε q hq) - σ y) 0 ⟨by linarith, hb⟩ (hcpI.mono hsp) (hcqI.mono hsq)
      (fun t ht => hcpX t (hsp ht)) (fun t ht => hcqX t (hsq ht)) (hcp0.trans hcq0.symm)

  obtain ⟨prn, hprn⟩ : ∃ prn : M → M, ∀ y, prn y =
      if h : ∃ p, ∃ hp : p ∈ frontier U, y ∈ W' p hp then
        ψ h.choose h.choose_spec.choose y (-f h.choose h.choose_spec.choose y) else y :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hLF : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ frontier U), ∀ y ∈ W' p hp ∩ (U ∩ N),
      prn y = ψ p hp y (-f p hp y) := by
    intro p hp y hy
    have h : ∃ p, ∃ hp : p ∈ frontier U, y ∈ W' p hp := ⟨p, hp, hy.1⟩
    rw [hprn y, dif_pos h]
    exact hcons _ _ p hp y ⟨h.choose_spec.choose_spec, hy.2⟩ hy.1
  have hDc : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ frontier U), ∀ y ∈ W' p hp,
      ContinuousAt (fun x => ψ p hp x (-f p hp x)) y := by
    intro p hp y hy
    have hyW := hW'W p hp hy

    have hεp := hε p hp
    have hηε' := hηε p hp

    have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun q : M × ℝ => ψ p hp q.1 q.2) (y, -f p hp y) :=

  have hprnc : ContinuousOn prn ((⋃ p, ⋃ hp : p ∈ frontier U, W' p hp) ∩ U ∩ N) := by
    intro y hy

    have hO : W' p hp ∩ (U ∩ N) ∈ 𝓝 y :=
      ((hW'o p hp).inter (hUo.inter hNo)).mem_nhds ⟨hyp, hy.1.2, hy.2⟩
    have heq : (fun x => ψ p hp x (-f p hp x)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] prn :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hO (fun x hx => (hLF p hp x hx).symm)
    exact ((hDc p hp y hyp).congr heq).continuousWithinAt
  have hprnF : ∀ y ∈ (⋃ p, ⋃ hp : p ∈ frontier U, W' p hp) ∩ U ∩ N, prn y ∈ frontier U := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hyp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hy.1.1
    rw [hLF p hp y ⟨hyp, hy.1.2, hy.2⟩]
    exact hFR p hp y hyp
  refine ⟨⋃ p, ⋃ hp : p ∈ frontier U, W' p hp, prn, hAo, hFA, hprnc, hprnF, ?_⟩
  
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hyp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hy.1.1
  have hyW := hW'W p hp hyp
  have hyV : y ∈ V p hp := (hWQ p hp hyW).1
  have hεp := hε p hp
  have hηp := hη p hp
  have hηε' := hηε p hp
  have htη : |f p hp y| < η p hp := hW'f p hp y hyp
  have ht0 : f p hp y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h' : y ∈ V p hp ∩ f p hp ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hyV, h⟩
    rw [← hVF p hp] at h'
    exact hFU y h'.2 hy.1.2
  have htI : f p hp y ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε p hp) (ε p hp) := by
    have h := abs_lt.mp htη
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hσy : σ y = |f p hp y| := hσf p hp y ⟨⟨hyV, hy.1.2⟩, hy.2⟩
  have hBo : IsOpen (W' p hp ∩ U ∩ N ∩ {x | 0 < f p hp x * f p hp y}) :=
    (((hW'o p hp).inter hUo).inter hNo).inter
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const ((hf p hp).continuous.mul continuous_const))
  have hyB : y ∈ W' p hp ∩ U ∩ N ∩ {x | 0 < f p hp x * f p hp y} :=
    ⟨⟨⟨hyp, hy.1.2⟩, hy.2⟩, mul_self_pos.2 ht0⟩
  have hsecc : ContinuousOn (fun x => ψ p hp x (f p hp y)) (W p hp) :=
    (hψc p hp).comp (continuousOn_id.prodMk continuousOn_const) (fun x hx => ⟨hx, htI⟩)
  refine ⟨W' p hp ∩ U ∩ N ∩ {x | 0 < f p hp x * f p hp y},
    W p hp ∩ (fun x => ψ p hp x (f p hp y)) ⁻¹' (W' p hp ∩ U ∩ N ∩ {x | 0 < f p hp x * f p hp y}),
    fun x => ψ p hp x (f p hp y), hBo, hyB, hsecc.isOpen_inter_preimage (hWo p hp) hBo,
    hsecc.mono (fun x hx => hx.1.1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y' hy'
    obtain ⟨⟨hy'W, hy'B⟩, hy'F⟩ := hy'
    have hy'V : y' ∈ V p hp := (hWQ p hp hy'W).1
    have hfy' : f p hp y' = 0 := by
      have h : y' ∈ V p hp ∩ frontier U := ⟨hy'V, hy'F⟩
      rw [hVF p hp] at h
      exact h.2
    have hsB : ψ p hp y' (f p hp y) ∈ W' p hp ∩ U ∩ N ∩ {x | 0 < f p hp x * f p hp y} := hy'B
    have hfs : f p hp (ψ p hp y' (f p hp y)) = f p hp y := by
      rw [((hψ p hp y' hy'W).2.2 _ htI).2, hfy', zero_add]
    have hsV : ψ p hp y' (f p hp y) ∈ V p hp := (hWQ p hp (hW'W p hp hsB.1.1.1)).1
    refine ⟨⟨⟨⟨hsB, Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨p, hp, hsB.1.1.1⟩⟩, hsB.1.1.2⟩, hsB.1.2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show σ (ψ p hp y' (f p hp y)) = σ y
      rw [hσf p hp _ ⟨⟨hsV, hsB.1.1.2⟩, hsB.1.2⟩, hfs, hσy]
    · show prn (ψ p hp y' (f p hp y)) = y'
      rw [hLF p hp _ ⟨hsB.1.1.1, hsB.1.1.2, hsB.1.2⟩, hfs]
      exact hψinv p hp y' hy'W _ (by linarith) (hW'W p hp hsB.1.1.1)
  · intro w hw hσw
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨hwB, hwA⟩, hwU⟩, hwN⟩ := hw
    have hwB' : w ∈ W' p hp ∩ U ∩ N ∩ {x | 0 < f p hp x * f p hp y} := hwB
    have hwW' : w ∈ W' p hp := hwB'.1.1.1
    have hwW := hW'W p hp hwW'
    have hwV : w ∈ V p hp := (hWQ p hp hwW).1
    have hfw : f p hp w = f p hp y := by
      have h1 : |f p hp w| = |f p hp y| := by
        rw [← hσf p hp w ⟨⟨hwV, hwU⟩, hwN⟩, hσw, hσy]
      have h2 : 0 < f p hp w * f p hp y := hwB'.2
      rcases abs_eq_abs.1 h1 with h | h
      · exact h
      · rw [h] at h2
        nlinarith [mul_self_pos.2 ht0]
    have hprw : prn w = ψ p hp w (-f p hp y) := by
      rw [hLF p hp w ⟨hwW', hwU, hwN⟩, hfw]
    have hmemW : ψ p hp w (-f p hp y) ∈ W p hp :=
      hW'ψ p hp w hwW' (-f p hp y) (by rw [abs_neg]; exact htη)
    have hback : ψ p hp (ψ p hp w (-f p hp y)) (f p hp y) = w := by
      have h := hψinv p hp w hwW (-f p hp y) (by rw [abs_neg]; linarith) hmemW
      rwa [neg_neg] at h
    rw [hprw]
    refine ⟨⟨hmemW, ?_⟩, hback⟩
    show ψ p hp (ψ p hp w (-f p hp y)) (f p hp y) ∈
      W' p hp ∩ U ∩ N ∩ {x | 0 < f p hp x * f p hp y}
    rw [hback]
    exact hwB'

subgoal_signatures.name: local_flow_of_contMDiffAt
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (X : Set M) (hX : IsOpen X)
    (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x) (x₀ : M) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ X)
    (hV : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
      (fun y => (⟨y, V y⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x₀) :
    ∃ (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (ψ : M → ℝ → M), IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ X ∧ 0 < ε ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : M × ℝ => ψ p.1 p.2) (N ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ N, ψ x 0 = x ∧ IsMIntegralCurveOn (ψ x) V (Set.Ioo (-ε) ε) ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-ε) ε, ψ x s ∈ X

subgoal_signatures.name: integral_curve_eqOn_of_mem
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (X : Set M)
    (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hV : ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
      (fun y => (⟨y, V y⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x)
    (γ γ' : ℝ → M) (α β t₀ : ℝ) (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Set.Ioo α β)
    (hγ : IsMIntegralCurveOn γ V (Set.Ioo α β)) (hγ' : IsMIntegralCurveOn γ' V (Set.Ioo α β))
    (hγX : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ t ∈ X) (hγ'X : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo α β, γ' t ∈ X)
    (h₀ : γ t₀ = γ' t₀) : Set.EqOn γ γ' (Set.Ioo α β)

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S T : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (hT : IsCompact T) (D : Set X) (hD : IsOpen D) (hTD : T ⊆ D)
    (pr : X → X) (hprc : ContinuousOn pr D) (hprS : ∀ w ∈ T, pr w ∈ S)
    (hsec : ∀ w ∈ T, ∃ (A Ω : Set X) (s : X → X), IsOpen A ∧ w ∈ A ∧ IsOpen Ω ∧
      ContinuousOn s (Ω ∩ S) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Ω ∩ S, s y ∈ A ∩ T ∧ pr (s y) = y) ∧
      ∀ w' ∈ A ∩ T, pr w' ∈ Ω ∧ s (pr w') = w') :
    ∃ (Q : EigPatchedSurface X T) (κ : Fin Q.n → Fin P.n), ∀ j,
      Q.W j ⊆ P.W (κ j) ∧ Q.h j = P.h (κ j) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Q.W j, pr (Q.param j x) = P.param (κ j) x

signature.name: patched_surface_pullback
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S T : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (hT : IsCompact T) (D : Set X) (hD : IsOpen D) (hTD : T ⊆ D)
    (pr : X → X) (hprc : ContinuousOn pr D) (hprS : ∀ w ∈ T, pr w ∈ S)
    (hsec : ∀ w ∈ T, ∃ (A Ω : Set X) (s : X → X), IsOpen A ∧ w ∈ A ∧ IsOpen Ω ∧
      ContinuousOn s (Ω ∩ S) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Ω ∩ S, s y ∈ A ∩ T ∧ pr (s y) = y) ∧
      ∀ w' ∈ A ∩ T, pr w' ∈ Ω ∧ s (pr w') = w') :
    ∃ (Q : EigPatchedSurface X T) (κ : Fin Q.n → Fin P.n), ∀ j,
      Q.W j ⊆ P.W (κ j) ∧ Q.h j = P.h (κ j) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Q.W j, pr (Q.param j x) = P.param (κ j) x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hfin : ∃ (m : ℕ) (A' Ω' : Fin m → Set X) (s' : Fin m → X → X),
      (∀ i, IsOpen (A' i)) ∧ (∀ i, IsOpen (Ω' i)) ∧
      (∀ i, ContinuousOn (s' i) (Ω' i ∩ S)) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ Ω' i ∩ S, s' i y ∈ A' i ∩ T ∧ pr (s' i y) = y) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ w' ∈ A' i ∩ T, pr w' ∈ Ω' i ∧ s' i (pr w') = w') ∧
      ∀ w ∈ T, ∃ i, w ∈ A' i := by
    choose A Ω s hAo hwA hΩo hsc hs1 hs2 using fun v : ↥T => hsec v.1 v.2
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hT.elim_finite_subcover A hAo
      (fun w hw => Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, hwA ⟨w, hw⟩⟩)
    refine ⟨t.card, fun i => A (t.equivFin.symm i : ↥T),
      fun i => Ω (t.equivFin.symm i : ↥T),
      fun i => s (t.equivFin.symm i : ↥T),
      fun i => hAo _, fun i => hΩo _, fun i => hsc _, fun i => hs1 _,
      fun i => hs2 _, ?_⟩
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hwu⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (ht hw)
    refine ⟨t.equivFin ⟨u, hu⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hwu
  obtain ⟨m, A', Ω', s', hAo, hΩo, hsc, hs1, hs2, hC⟩ := hfin
  
  obtain ⟨kk, ii, hkk⟩ : ∃ (kk : Fin (P.n * m) → Fin P.n) (ii : Fin (P.n * m) → Fin m),
      ∀ k i, ∃ j, kk j = k ∧ ii j = i :=
    ⟨fun j => (finProdFinEquiv.symm j).1, fun j => (finProdFinEquiv.symm j).2,
      fun k i => ⟨finProdFinEquiv (k, i), by simp⟩⟩
  
  have hBM : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ P.W k, P.param k x ∈ P.O k ∩ S := fun k x hx => by
    rw [← P.image_eq k]
    exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx
  
  have hKI : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W (kk j) ∩ P.param (kk j) ⁻¹' Ω' (ii j),
      s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x) ∈ A' (ii j) ∩ T ∧
        pr (s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x)) = P.param (kk j) x :=
    fun j x hx => hs1 (ii j) _ ⟨hx.2, (hBM _ x hx.1).2⟩
  have hWo : ∀ j, IsOpen (P.W (kk j) ∩ P.param (kk j) ⁻¹' Ω' (ii j)) := fun j =>
    (P.param_cont (kk j)).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open _) (hΩo _)
  have hdom : ∀ j j', ∀ x ∈ (P.W (kk j) ∩ P.param (kk j) ⁻¹' Ω' (ii j)) ∩
      (fun x => s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x)) ⁻¹'
        (A' (ii j') ∩ (D ∩ pr ⁻¹' (P.O (kk j') ∩ Ω' (ii j')))),
      x ∈ P.W (kk j) ∩ P.param (kk j) ⁻¹' P.O (kk j') := by
    intro j j' x hx
    refine ⟨hx.1.1, ?_⟩
    have h1 : pr (s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x)) ∈ P.O (kk j') := hx.2.2.2.1
    rw [(hKI j x hx.1).2] at h1
    exact h1
  have heq : ∀ j j', ∀ x ∈ P.W (kk j) ∩ P.param (kk j) ⁻¹' Ω' (ii j),
      P.proj (kk j') (pr (s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x))) =
        P.proj (kk j') (P.param (kk j) x) := by
    intro j j' x hx
    rw [(hKI j x hx).2]
  refine ⟨EigPatchedSurface.mk (P.n * m)
      (fun j => P.W (kk j) ∩ P.param (kk j) ⁻¹' Ω' (ii j))
      (fun j x => s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x))
      (fun j w => P.proj (kk j) (pr w))
      (fun j => A' (ii j) ∩ (D ∩ pr ⁻¹' (P.O (kk j) ∩ Ω' (ii j))))
      (fun j => P.h (kk j))
      hWo
      (fun j => (hAo _).inter
        (hprc.isOpen_inter_preimage hD ((P.O_open _).inter (hΩo _))))
      (fun j => (hsc (ii j)).comp
        ((P.param_cont (kk j)).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (fun x hx => ⟨hx.2, (hBM _ x hx.1).2⟩))
      (fun j => (P.proj_cont (kk j)).comp
        (hprc.mono (fun w hw => hw.2.1)) (fun w hw => hw.2.2.1))
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      (fun j a b => (P.h_smooth (kk j) a b).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
      (fun j x hx => P.h_posDef (kk j) x hx.1)
      ?_, kk, fun j => ⟨Set.inter_subset_left, rfl,
        fun x hx => (hKI j x hx).2⟩⟩
  · 
    intro j
    ext w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨hmem, hpr⟩ := hKI j x hx
      refine ⟨⟨hmem.1, hTD hmem.2, ?_⟩, hmem.2⟩
      show pr (s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x)) ∈ P.O (kk j) ∩ Ω' (ii j)
      rw [hpr]
      exact ⟨(hBM _ x hx.1).1, hx.2⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hwA, hwD, hwO, hwΩ⟩, hwT⟩
      have hS : pr w ∈ P.O (kk j) ∩ S := ⟨hwO, hprS w hwT⟩
      rw [← P.image_eq] at hS
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩ := hS
      refine ⟨x, ⟨hx, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · show P.param (kk j) x ∈ Ω' (ii j)
        rw [hxe]
        exact hwΩ
      · show s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x) = w
        rw [hxe]
        exact (hs2 (ii j) w ⟨hwA, hwT⟩).2
  · 
    intro j x hx
    show P.proj (kk j) (pr (s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x))) = x
    rw [(hKI j x hx).2]
    exact P.proj_param _ x hx.1
  · 
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨i, hwi⟩ := hC w hw
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover (hprS w hw))
    obtain ⟨j, rfl, rfl⟩ := hkk k i
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hwi, hTD hw, hk, (hs2 (ii j) w ⟨hwi, hw⟩).1⟩
  · 
    intro j j'
    exact ((P.trans_smooth (kk j) (kk j')).mono (hdom j j')).congr
      (fun x hx => heq j j' x hx.1)
  · 
    intro j j' x hx a b
    have hx' := hdom j j' x hx
    have hev : (fun x' => P.proj (kk j') (pr (s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x')))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun x' => P.proj (kk j') (P.param (kk j) x')) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((hWo j).mem_nhds hx.1) (fun x' hx'' => heq j j' x' hx'')
    have hfd := hev.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
    have hval := heq j j' x hx.1
    show P.h (kk j) x a b = ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj (kk j') (pr (s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x')))) x (e2 a) c *
        P.h (kk j') (P.proj (kk j') (pr (s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x)))) c d *
        fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj (kk j') (pr (s' (ii j) (P.param (kk j) x')))) x (e2 b) d
    rw [hfd, hval]
    exact P.h_compat (kk j) (kk j') x hx' a b

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S T : Set X) (hT : IsCompact T) (pr : X → X) (hprc : ContinuousOn pr T)
    (hprS : ∀ w ∈ T, pr w ∈ S)
    (hTloc : ∀ q ∈ T, ∃ O : Set X, IsOpen O ∧ q ∈ O ∧ O ∩ T ⊆ connectedComponentIn T q)
    (hsec : ∀ w ∈ T, ∃ (A Ω : Set X) (s : X → X), IsOpen A ∧ w ∈ A ∧ IsOpen Ω ∧
      ContinuousOn s (Ω ∩ S) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Ω ∩ S, s y ∈ A ∩ T ∧ pr (s y) = y) ∧
      ∀ w' ∈ A ∩ T, pr w' ∈ Ω ∧ s (pr w') = w') :
    ∀ q ∈ T, pr '' connectedComponentIn T q = connectedComponentIn S (pr q)

signature.name: local_section_component_image
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S T : Set X) (hT : IsCompact T) (pr : X → X) (hprc : ContinuousOn pr T)
    (hprS : ∀ w ∈ T, pr w ∈ S)
    (hTloc : ∀ q ∈ T, ∃ O : Set X, IsOpen O ∧ q ∈ O ∧ O ∩ T ⊆ connectedComponentIn T q)
    (hsec : ∀ w ∈ T, ∃ (A Ω : Set X) (s : X → X), IsOpen A ∧ w ∈ A ∧ IsOpen Ω ∧
      ContinuousOn s (Ω ∩ S) ∧ (∀ y ∈ Ω ∩ S, s y ∈ A ∩ T ∧ pr (s y) = y) ∧
      ∀ w' ∈ A ∩ T, pr w' ∈ Ω ∧ s (pr w') = w') :
    ∀ q ∈ T, pr '' connectedComponentIn T q = connectedComponentIn S (pr q)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro q hq
  have hCT : connectedComponentIn T q ⊆ T := connectedComponentIn_subset T q
  have hqC : q ∈ connectedComponentIn T q := mem_connectedComponentIn hq
  
  have hCloc : ∀ w ∈ connectedComponentIn T q, ∃ O : Set X, IsOpen O ∧ w ∈ O ∧
      O ∩ T ⊆ connectedComponentIn T q := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨O, hO, hwO, hOT⟩ := hTloc w (hCT hw)
    refine ⟨O, hO, hwO, ?_⟩
    rw [connectedComponentIn_eq hw]
    exact hOT
  
  have hCc : IsCompact (connectedComponentIn T q) := by
    obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : Set X,
        K = ⋃₀ {O : Set X | IsOpen O ∧ O ∩ connectedComponentIn T q = ∅} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hK : IsOpen K := by
      rw [hKdef]
      exact isOpen_sUnion (fun O hO => hO.1)
    have hEq : connectedComponentIn T q = T ∩ Kᶜ := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · intro hz
        refine ⟨hCT hz, ?_⟩
        intro hzK
        rw [hKdef] at hzK
        obtain ⟨O, hO, hzO⟩ := hzK
        have hmem : z ∈ O ∩ connectedComponentIn T q := ⟨hzO, hz⟩
        rw [hO.2] at hmem
        exact hmem
      · rintro ⟨hzT, hzK⟩
        by_contra hzC
        obtain ⟨O, hO, hzO, hOT⟩ := hTloc z hzT
        apply hzK
        rw [hKdef]
        refine ⟨O, ⟨hO, ?_⟩, hzO⟩
        ext x
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hxO, hxC⟩
          have hx1 : x ∈ connectedComponentIn T z := hOT ⟨hxO, hCT hxC⟩
          apply hzC
          rw [connectedComponentIn_eq hxC, ← connectedComponentIn_eq hx1]
          exact mem_connectedComponentIn hzT
        · intro hx
          exact hx.elim
    rw [hEq]
    exact hT.inter_right hK.isClosed_compl
  have hprC : ContinuousOn pr (connectedComponentIn T q) := hprc.mono hCT
  have himS : pr '' connectedComponentIn T q ⊆ S := by
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact hprS w (hCT hw)
  have hpqS : pr q ∈ S := hprS q hq
  
  have hsub1 : pr '' connectedComponentIn T q ⊆ connectedComponentIn S (pr q) :=
    (isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.image pr hprC).subset_connectedComponentIn
      (Set.mem_image_of_mem pr hqC) himS
  
  have hclosed : IsClosed (pr '' connectedComponentIn T q) :=
    (hCc.image_of_continuousOn hprC).isClosed
  
  obtain ⟨V, hVo, hCV, hVS⟩ : ∃ V : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ pr '' connectedComponentIn T q ⊆ V ∧
      V ∩ S ⊆ pr '' connectedComponentIn T q := by
    refine ⟨⋃₀ {W : Set X | IsOpen W ∧ W ∩ S ⊆ pr '' connectedComponentIn T q},
      isOpen_sUnion (fun W hW => hW.1), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨A, Ω, s, _hAo, hwA, hΩo, hsc, hsmap, hsinv⟩ := hsec w (hCT hw)
      obtain ⟨O, hOo, hwO, hOT⟩ := hCloc w hw
      obtain ⟨u, huo, hu⟩ := continuousOn_iff'.mp hsc O hOo
      obtain ⟨hprΩ, hspr⟩ := hsinv w ⟨hwA, hCT hw⟩
      refine ⟨u ∩ Ω, ⟨huo.inter hΩo, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rintro y ⟨⟨hyu, hyΩ⟩, hyS⟩
        have hy : y ∈ s ⁻¹' O ∩ (Ω ∩ S) := by
          rw [hu]
          exact ⟨hyu, hyΩ, hyS⟩
        obtain ⟨⟨_, hsyT⟩, hprsy⟩ := hsmap y ⟨hyΩ, hyS⟩
        exact ⟨s y, hOT ⟨hy.1, hsyT⟩, hprsy⟩
      · have hy : pr w ∈ s ⁻¹' O ∩ (Ω ∩ S) := by
          refine ⟨?_, hprΩ, hprS w (hCT hw)⟩
          show s (pr w) ∈ O
          rw [hspr]
          exact hwO
        rw [hu] at hy
        exact ⟨hy.1, hprΩ⟩
    · rintro y ⟨⟨W, hW, hyW⟩, hyS⟩
      exact hW.2 ⟨hyW, hyS⟩
  
  have hsub2 : connectedComponentIn S (pr q) ⊆ pr '' connectedComponentIn T q := by
    have hD : IsPreconnected (connectedComponentIn S (pr q)) :=
      isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn
    have hDS : connectedComponentIn S (pr q) ⊆ S := connectedComponentIn_subset S (pr q)
    have hcover : connectedComponentIn S (pr q) ⊆ V ∪ (pr '' connectedComponentIn T q)ᶜ := by
      intro z _
      by_cases hzI : z ∈ pr '' connectedComponentIn T q
      · exact Or.inl (hCV hzI)
      · exact Or.inr hzI
    have hdisj : connectedComponentIn S (pr q) ∩ (V ∩ (pr '' connectedComponentIn T q)ᶜ) = ∅ := by
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hz, hzV, hzn⟩
        exact absurd (hVS ⟨hzV, hDS hz⟩) hzn
      · intro h
        exact h.elim
    rcases isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint.mp hD V (pr '' connectedComponentIn T q)ᶜ hVo
        hclosed.isOpen_compl hcover hdisj with h | h
    · intro z hz
      exact hVS ⟨h hz, hDS hz⟩
    · exact absurd (Set.mem_image_of_mem pr hqC) (h (mem_connectedComponentIn hpqS))
  exact Set.Subset.antisymm hsub1 hsub2

informal_problem.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ) (p : M) (h : f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 p] f₂) : g.levelMeanCurv f₁ p = g.levelMeanCurv f₂ p

signature.name: levelMeanCurv_congr_of_eventuallyEq
signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ) (p : M) (h : f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 p] f₂) : g.levelMeanCurv f₁ p = g.levelMeanCurv f₂ p

proof.tactics:
by
  have hT : Filter.Tendsto (chartAt E3 p).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)) (𝓝 p) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).tendsto_symm (mem_chart_source E3 p)
  have hF : (fun y => f₁ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
      (fun y => f₂ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := h.comp_tendsto hT
  have hD1 : ∀ a : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (fun y => f₁ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) =
        partialDeriv a (fun y => f₂ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    intro a
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hF.fderiv_eq]
  have hD1' : ∀ j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv j (fun y => f₁ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
        partialDeriv j (fun y => f₂ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := by
    intro j
    filter_upwards [hF.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)] with z hz
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hz]
  have hD2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => f₁ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) (chartAt E3 p p) =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => f₂ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)))
          (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    intro i j
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (fun y => f₁ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) (chartAt E3 p p) (e i) =
      fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (fun y => f₂ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) (chartAt E3 p p) (e i)
    rw [(hD1' j).fderiv_eq]
  have hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f₁ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) i j
          (chartAt E3 p p) =
        hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f₂ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) i j
          (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    intro i j
    simp only [hessLoc, hD2, hD1]
  have hL : lapLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f₁ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 p p) =
      lapLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => f₂ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    simp only [lapLoc, hH]
  have hN : g.gradInner f₁ f₁ p = g.gradInner f₂ f₂ p := by
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, hD1]
  simp only [RiemannianMetric3.levelMeanCurv]
  rw [hL, hN]
  simp only [hD1, hH]

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Λ : M → ℝ) (hΛ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ Λ) (hΛ01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Λ x ∧ Λ x ≤ 1) (K O W : Set M) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΛO : ∀ x ∈ O, Λ x = 1) (hKΛ : K ∩ tsupport Λ ⊆ O) (q : M) (hW : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' W ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X y| ≤ C) : ∃ X' : E3 → E3, ((∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' ((K \ O) ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X' y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X' ∧ tsupport X' ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' W ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * X' y i * X' y j ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X' y| ≤ C) ∧ ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (tsupport Λ ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X' y = sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X y

signature.name: hull_field_inner_cut
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Λ : M → ℝ) (hΛ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ Λ) (hΛ01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Λ x ∧ Λ x ≤ 1) (K O W : Set M) (hO : IsOpen O) (hΛO : ∀ x ∈ O, Λ x = 1) (hKΛ : K ∩ tsupport Λ ⊆ O) (q : M) (hW : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧ tsupport X ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' W ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X y| ≤ C) : ∃ X' : E3 → E3, ((∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' ((K \ O) ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X' y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X' ∧ tsupport X' ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' W ∧ (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * X' y i * X' y j ≤ 1) ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X' y| ≤ C) ∧ ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (tsupport Λ ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) → sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X' y = sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) X y

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hXs, hXc, hXt, hXn, C0, hC0⟩ := hX
  
  have hpd : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  have hent : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j)
      (chartAt E3 q).target := fun i j => g.smooth q i j
  
  have hJ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det)
        (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      have e3 := fun a b c d a' b' => ((hent a b).mul (hent c d)).mul (hent a' b')
      exact (((((e3 0 0 1 1 2 2).sub (e3 0 0 1 2 2 1)).sub (e3 0 1 1 0 2 2)).add
        (e3 0 1 1 2 2 0)).add (e3 0 2 1 0 2 1)).sub (e3 0 2 1 1 2 0)
    exact hdet.sqrt (fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne')
  have hTo : IsOpen (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).open_target
  have hTX : tsupport X ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hXt hy
    exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hW hx)
  
  obtain ⟨lam, hlamdef⟩ : ∃ l : E3 → ℝ, l = fun y => Λ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlamz : ∀ z, lam z = Λ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) := by
    intro z; rw [hlamdef]
  have hlam : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ lam (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (Λ ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      hΛ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    rw [hlamdef]; exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  generalize hG : g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm = G at hpd hent hJ hXn hC0 ⊢
  
  have hloc : ∀ (Z₁ Z₂ : E3 → E3) (y : E3), Z₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] Z₂ →
      sepDensDiv G Z₁ y = sepDensDiv G Z₂ y := by
    intro Z₁ Z₂ y h
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have h' : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z₁ z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Z₂ z i) :=
      h.mono fun z hz => by simp only [hz]
    rw [h'.fderiv_eq]
  have hzero : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (y : E3), y ∉ tsupport Z → sepDensDiv G Z y = 0 := by
    intro Z y hy
    rw [hloc Z 0 y (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy)]
    simp [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
  have hdiv0 : ∀ y, sepDensDiv G (fun _ => (0 : E3)) y = 0 := by
    intro y
    simp [sepDensDiv, partialDeriv]
  have hcoord : ∀ (Z : E3 → E3) (y : E3), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Z y → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => Z z i) y := by
    intro Z y hZ i
    exact (contDiffAt_piLp _).1 hZ i
  
  have hbound : ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ y, ‖X y‖ ≤ B := by
    by_cases hne : (tsupport X).Nonempty
    swap
    · refine ⟨0, fun y => ?_⟩
      have hy : y ∉ tsupport X := fun h => hne ⟨y, h⟩
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy, norm_zero]
    obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁⟩ := hne
    obtain ⟨Q, hQdef⟩ : ∃ Q : E3 × E3 → ℝ,
        Q = fun p => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G p.1 i j * p.2 i * p.2 j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hQc : ContinuousOn Q ((chartAt E3 q).target ×ˢ Set.univ) := by
      rw [hQdef]
      refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
      have hc1 : ContinuousOn (fun p : E3 × E3 => G p.1 i j)
          ((chartAt E3 q).target ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
        (hent i j).continuousOn.comp continuousOn_fst (fun p hp => hp.1)
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun p : E3 × E3 => p.2 i) := by fun_prop
      have hc3 : Continuous (fun p : E3 × E3 => p.2 j) := by fun_prop
      exact (hc1.mul hc2.continuousOn).mul hc3.continuousOn
    have hSc : IsCompact (tsupport X ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : E3) 1) :=
      (HasCompactSupport.isCompact hXc).prod (isCompact_sphere _ _)
    have hSne : (tsupport X ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : E3) 1).Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨(y₁, e 0), hy₁, ?_⟩
      rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one]
    have hSsub : tsupport X ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : E3) 1 ⊆
        (chartAt E3 q).target ×ˢ Set.univ :=
      Set.prod_mono hTX (Set.subset_univ _)
    obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hmin⟩ := hSc.exists_isMinOn hSne (hQc.mono hSsub)
    have hcpos : 0 < Q p₀ := by
      have hy0 : p₀.1 ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := hTX hp₀.1
      have hv0 : ‖p₀.2‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.1 hp₀.2
      have hx : (fun i => p₀.2 i : Fin 3 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have h00 : p₀.2 = 0 := by
          ext i
          simpa using congrFun h0 i
        rw [h00, norm_zero] at hv0
        exact zero_ne_one hv0
      have h1 := (hpd p₀.1 hy0).dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
      have h2 : star (fun i => p₀.2 i : Fin 3 → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (G p₀.1).mulVec (fun i => p₀.2 i)
          = Q p₀ := by
        rw [hQdef]
        simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [← h2]; exact h1
    refine ⟨1 + 1 / Q p₀, fun y => ?_⟩
    have hBpos : 0 < 1 / Q p₀ := by positivity
    by_cases hy0 : X y = 0
    · rw [hy0, norm_zero]; linarith
    have hyX : y ∈ tsupport X := subset_tsupport _ hy0
    have hr : 0 < ‖X y‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hy0
    have hv : (y, ‖X y‖⁻¹ • X y) ∈ tsupport X ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : E3) 1 := by
      refine ⟨hyX, ?_⟩
      rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne']
    have hle : Q p₀ ≤ Q (y, ‖X y‖⁻¹ • X y) := isMinOn_iff.1 hmin _ hv
    have hhom : Q (y, ‖X y‖⁻¹ • X y) = (‖X y‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * Q (y, X y) := by
      rw [hQdef]
      simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hQy : Q (y, X y) ≤ 1 := by rw [hQdef]; exact hXn y
    have h1 : Q p₀ ≤ (‖X y‖⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      calc Q p₀ ≤ (‖X y‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * Q (y, X y) := hle.trans_eq hhom
        _ ≤ (‖X y‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQy (sq_nonneg _)
        _ = _ := mul_one _
    have h2 : Q p₀ * ‖X y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (sq_nonneg ‖X y‖)
      rwa [← mul_pow, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_pow] at h3
    have h3 : ‖X y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / Q p₀ := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hcpos]; linarith
    by_cases hr1 : ‖X y‖ ≤ 1
    · linarith
    · push_neg at hr1
      have h4 : ‖X y‖ ≤ ‖X y‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      linarith
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hbound
  
  have hDex : ∃ D : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ tsupport X, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv i lam y * Real.sqrt (G y).det| ≤ D := by
    have hfd : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ lam y) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      hlam.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hTo (by simp)
    have hcont : ContinuousOn
        (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i lam y * Real.sqrt (G y).det|)
        (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      unfold partialDeriv
      exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
        ((hfd.clm_apply continuousOn_const).mul hJ.continuousOn).abs
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ :=
      (HasCompactSupport.isCompact hXc).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hTX)
    refine ⟨D, fun y hy i => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hD y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)] at h1
    exact le_trans (Finset.single_le_sum
      (f := fun i => |partialDeriv i lam y * Real.sqrt (G y).det|)
      (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)) h1
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hDex
  
  have hO1 : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ O →
      (fun z => (1 - lam z) • X z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
    intro y hy hyO
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, (chartAt E3 q).symm z ∈ O :=
      ((chartAt E3 q).continuousAt_symm hy).preimage_mem_nhds (hO.mem_nhds hyO)
    filter_upwards [h1] with z hz
    rw [hlamz, hΛO _ hz, sub_self, zero_smul]
  have hO0 : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∉ tsupport Λ →
      (fun z => (1 - lam z) • X z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] X := by
    intro y hy hyL
    have h1 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, (chartAt E3 q).symm z ∈ (tsupport Λ)ᶜ :=
      ((chartAt E3 q).continuousAt_symm hy).preimage_mem_nhds
        ((isClosed_tsupport Λ).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hyL)
    filter_upwards [h1] with z hz
    rw [hlamz, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz, sub_zero, one_smul]
  
  have hsm : ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' ((K \ O) ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => (1 - lam z) • X z) y := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hyT : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target
    · by_cases hyK : y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)
      · obtain ⟨k, ⟨hkK, hks⟩, rfl⟩ := hyK
        have hkO : k ∈ O := by
          by_contra hkO
          exact hy ⟨k, ⟨⟨hkK, hkO⟩, hks⟩, rfl⟩
        have h0 := hO1 _ hyT (by rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hks]; exact hkO)
        exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq h0
      · exact (contDiffAt_const.sub (hlam.contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hyT))).smul (hXs y hyK)
    · have h0 : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h => hyT (hTX h))
      have h1 : (fun z => (1 - lam z) • X z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
        filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
        simp [hz]
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq h1
  have hcs : HasCompactSupport (fun z => (1 - lam z) • X z) :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro hXc (fun y hy => by simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy])
  have hts1 : tsupport (fun z => (1 - lam z) • X z) ⊆ tsupport X :=
    tsupport_smul_subset_right (fun z => 1 - lam z) X
  have hts : tsupport (fun z => (1 - lam z) • X z) ⊆ chartAt E3 q '' W := hts1.trans hXt
  have hnorm : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      G y i j * ((1 - lam y) • X y) i * ((1 - lam y) • X y) j ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    have hQ := hXn y
    have hl01 := hΛ01 ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
    have h0 : 0 ≤ 1 - lam y := by rw [hlamz]; linarith
    have h1 : 1 - lam y ≤ 1 := by rw [hlamz]; linarith
    have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        G y i j * ((1 - lam y) • X y) i * ((1 - lam y) • X y) j
        = (1 - lam y) ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y i j * X y i * X y j := by
      simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [e1]
    have h2 : (1 - lam y) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ h0 h1
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQ (sq_nonneg (1 - lam y))
    linarith
  
  have hagree : ∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 q '' (tsupport Λ ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) →
      sepDensDiv G (fun z => (1 - lam z) • X z) y = sepDensDiv G X y := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hyT : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target
    · have hL : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∉ tsupport Λ := by
        intro h
        exact hy ⟨_, ⟨h, (chartAt E3 q).map_target hyT⟩, (chartAt E3 q).right_inv hyT⟩
      exact hloc _ _ y (hO0 y hyT hL)
    · have h1 : y ∉ tsupport X := fun h => hyT (hTX h)
      rw [hzero _ y h1, hzero _ y (fun h => h1 (hts1 h))]
  
  have hbd : ∀ y, |sepDensDiv G (fun z => (1 - lam z) • X z) y| ≤ |C0| + 3 * (|D| * |B|) := by
    intro y
    have hpos : 0 ≤ |C0| + 3 * (|D| * |B|) := by positivity
    have hC0' : |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ |C0| := (hC0 y).trans (le_abs_self _)
    have hDB : 0 ≤ |D| * |B| := by positivity
    by_cases hyT : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target
    · by_cases hyK : y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (K ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)
      · obtain ⟨k, ⟨hkK, hks⟩, rfl⟩ := hyK
        by_cases hkO : k ∈ O
        · rw [hloc _ _ _ (hO1 _ hyT (by rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hks]; exact hkO)), hdiv0,
            abs_zero]
          exact hpos
        · have hkL : k ∉ tsupport Λ := fun h => hkO (hKΛ ⟨hkK, h⟩)
          rw [hloc _ _ _ (hO0 _ hyT (by rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hks]; exact hkL))]
          linarith
      · by_cases hyX : y ∈ tsupport X
        · have hXy := hXs y hyK
          have hJy := hJ.contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hyT)
          have hly : DifferentiableAt ℝ lam y :=
            (hlam.contDiffAt (hTo.mem_nhds hyT)).differentiableAt (by simp)
          have hh : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y :=
            fun i => (hJy.mul (hcoord X y hXy i)).differentiableAt (by simp)
          have hprod : sepDensDiv G (fun z => (1 - lam z) • X z) y =
              (1 - lam y) * sepDensDiv G X y -
                ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i lam y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i) := by
            unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
            rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
            have e1 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * ((1 - lam z) • X z) i) =
                fun z => (1 - lam z) * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) := by
              funext z
              simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
              ring
            have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => (1 - lam z) * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i))
                ((1 - lam y) • fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y +
                  (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i) • (0 - fderiv ℝ lam y)) y :=
              ((hasFDerivAt_const (1 : ℝ) y).sub hly.hasFDerivAt).mul (hh i).hasFDerivAt
            rw [e1, h3.fderiv]
            simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
              ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, smul_eq_mul]
            ring
          rw [hprod]
          have hl01 := hΛ01 ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          have hlz := hlamz y
          have t1 : |(1 - lam y) * sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ |C0| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by rw [hlz]; linarith)]
            calc (1 - lam y) * |sepDensDiv G X y| ≤ 1 * |sepDensDiv G X y| :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by rw [hlz]; linarith) (abs_nonneg _)
              _ ≤ |C0| := by rw [one_mul]; exact hC0'
          have t2 : ∀ i : Fin 3,
              |partialDeriv i lam y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i)| ≤ |D| * |B| := by
            intro i
            have e : partialDeriv i lam y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i) =
                (partialDeriv i lam y * Real.sqrt (G y).det) * X y i := by ring
            rw [e, abs_mul]
            have hXi : |X y i| ≤ |B| := by
              have h5 := PiLp.norm_apply_le (X y) i
              rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h5
              exact h5.trans ((hB y).trans (le_abs_self _))
            exact mul_le_mul ((hD y hyX i).trans (le_abs_self _)) hXi (abs_nonneg _)
              (abs_nonneg _)
          have t3 : |∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i lam y * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y i)| ≤
              3 * (|D| * |B|) := by
            refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
            rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
            linarith [t2 0, t2 1, t2 2]
          have a1 := abs_le.1 t1
          have a3 := abs_le.1 t3
          rw [abs_le]
          constructor <;> linarith [a1.1, a1.2, a3.1, a3.2]
        · rw [hzero _ y (fun h => hyX (hts1 h)), abs_zero]
          exact hpos
    · rw [hzero _ y (fun h => hyT (hTX (hts1 h))), abs_zero]
      exact hpos
  exact ⟨fun z => (1 - lam z) • X z, ⟨hsm, hcs, hts, hnorm, ⟨_, hbd⟩⟩, hagree⟩

informal_problem.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (T Ω F O : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (hT : IsOpen T) (hdρ : ∀ x ∈ T, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ x ≠ 0) (hΩT : Ω ⊆ T) (hF : sepChartMeas F) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (hφ : calPartition q φ Ω) (hO : IsOpen O) (hφ1 : ∀ x ∈ O, ∑ j, φ j x = 1) (hDO : F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x} ⊆ O) (Y : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (hY1 : ∀ x, g.g x (Y x) (Y x) ≤ 1) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : (∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det) (chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source))) ∧ ∃ V : M → E3, calSmoothField V ∧ (∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) ∧ calDivSum g q φ (F \ (T ∩ {x | r < ρ x})) Y + calVolSum g q φ (F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) (fun x => g.levelMeanCurv ρ x) - ε ≤ calDivSum g q φ F V

signature.name: slab_calibration_step
signature.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (T Ω F O : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (hT : IsOpen T) (hdρ : ∀ x ∈ T, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ x ≠ 0) (hΩT : Ω ⊆ T) (hF : sepChartMeas F) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (hφ : calPartition q φ Ω) (hO : IsOpen O) (hφ1 : ∀ x ∈ O, ∑ j, φ j x = 1) (hDO : F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x} ⊆ O) (Y : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (hY1 : ∀ x, g.g x (Y x) (Y x) ≤ 1) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : (∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det) (chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source))) ∧ ∃ V : M → E3, calSmoothField V ∧ (∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) ∧ calDivSum g q φ (F \ (T ∩ {x | r < ρ x})) Y + calVolSum g q φ (F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) (fun x => g.levelMeanCurv ρ x) - ε ≤ calDivSum g q φ F V

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρ.continuous
  
  have himg : ∀ (x : M) (S : Set M), chartAt E3 x '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 x).source) =
      (chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' S := by
    intro x S
    rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact (chartAt E3 x).image_source_inter_eq' S
  have hopenimg : ∀ (x : M) (S : Set M), IsOpen S →
      MeasurableSet ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' S) := by
    intro x S hS
    exact ((chartAt E3 x).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hS).measurableSet
  have hUo : IsOpen {p : M | r < ρ p} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hρc
  have hDm : sepChartMeas (F ∩ T ∩ {p : M | r < ρ p}) := by
    intro x
    have hFp := hF x
    rw [himg] at hFp ⊢
    have e : (chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' (F ∩ T ∩ {p : M | r < ρ p}) =
        ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' F) ∩
          ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' T) ∩
        ((chartAt E3 x).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x).symm ⁻¹' {p : M | r < ρ p}) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
      tauto
    rw [e]
    exact (hFp.inter (hopenimg x _ hT)).inter (hopenimg x _ hUo)
  
  have hN : ∀ (q' : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q').target → (chartAt E3 q').symm y ∈ T →
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm y)⁻¹ a b *
        partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) y *
        partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) y :=
    fun q' y hy hyT => chart_Nsq_pos g ρ hρ q' y hy (hdρ _ hyT)
  
  have hK₀c : IsCompact (⋃ j, tsupport (φ j)) := isCompact_iUnion fun j => (hφ.2.2.2 j).1
  have hK₀T : (⋃ j, tsupport (φ j)) ⊆ T :=
    Set.iUnion_subset fun j => ((hφ.2.2.2 j).2.trans Set.inter_subset_left).trans hΩT
  obtain ⟨μ, Oμ, hμs, hμ01, hKOμ, hμ1, hμT⟩ : ∃ (μ : M → ℝ) (Oμ : Set M),
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ μ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x ∧ μ x ≤ 1) ∧
      (⋃ j, tsupport (φ j)) ⊆ Oμ ∧ (∀ x ∈ Oμ, μ x = 1) ∧ tsupport μ ⊆ T := by
    have hP0 : calPartition (fun j : Fin 0 => (j.elim0 : M))
        (fun j : Fin 0 => (j.elim0 : M → ℝ)) T :=
      ⟨fun j => j.elim0, fun j => j.elim0, fun x => by simp, fun j => j.elim0⟩
    obtain ⟨n', q', φ', O', hφ', -, hKO', hφ'1, -⟩ := calPartition_extend g T hT _ _ hP0 ∅
      isOpen_empty (fun x hx => hx.elim) _ hK₀c hK₀T
    have hsub : tsupport (fun x => ∑ j, φ' j x) ⊆ ⋃ j, tsupport (φ' j) := by
      unfold tsupport
      rw [← closure_iUnion_of_finite]
      apply closure_mono
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hx
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hj⟩
    refine ⟨fun x => ∑ j, φ' j x, O', ?_, ?_, fun x hx => hKO' (Or.inl hx), hφ'1,
      hsub.trans (Set.iUnion_subset fun j => (hφ'.2.2.2 j).2.trans Set.inter_subset_left)⟩
    · exact contMDiff_finset_sum fun j _ => hφ'.1 j
    · intro x
      exact ⟨Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hφ'.2.1 j x, hφ'.2.2.1 x⟩
  have hμφ : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ tsupport (φ j), μ x = 1 :=
    fun j x hx => hμ1 x (hKOμ (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, hx⟩))
  have hφT : ∀ j, tsupport (φ j) ⊆ T ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source :=
    fun j => (hφ.2.2.2 j).2.trans (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hΩT)
  
  have blend : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ V Z : M → E3, calSmoothField V ∧
      (∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) ∧ calSmoothField Z ∧
      ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 (q j)).target, (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y ∈ tsupport (φ j) →
        ∀ wV wY wZ : E3,
        wV = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j)) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)
          (V ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) →
        wY = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j)) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) →
        wZ = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j)) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) →
        ∀ i : Fin 3,
          wV i = (1 - calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y))) * wY i +
            calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm)
                (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) y i ∧
          wZ i = calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm)
                (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) y i := by
    intro η hη
    have hθ := ccs_theta_props r η hη
    have hΘs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => μ x * calTheta r η (ρ x)) :=
      hμs.mul (hθ.1.comp_contMDiff hρ)
    have hΘ01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x * calTheta r η (ρ x) ∧ μ x * calTheta r η (ρ x) ≤ 1 :=
      fun x => ⟨mul_nonneg (hμ01 x).1 (hθ.2.1 _),
        mul_le_one₀ (hμ01 x).2 (hθ.2.1 _) (hθ.2.2.1 _)⟩
    have hΘT : tsupport (fun x => μ x * calTheta r η (ρ x)) ⊆ T :=
      (tsupport_mul_subset_left).trans hμT
    obtain ⟨V, Z, hV, hV1, hZ, hVZ⟩ := slab_blend_field g ρ (fun x => μ x * calTheta r η (ρ x))
      T hρ hT hN hΘs hΘ01 hΘT Y hY hY1
    refine ⟨V, Z, hV, hV1, hZ, fun j y hy hyφ wV wY wZ hwV hwY hwZ i => ?_⟩
    have h := hVZ (q j) y hy wV wY wZ hwV hwY hwZ i
    simp only [hμφ j _ hyφ, one_mul] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨V₁, Z₁, -, -, -, hVZ₁⟩ := blend 1 one_pos
  have hint0 : ∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det)
        (chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source)) ∧
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm)
        (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) y)
        (chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source)) := by
    intro j
    have h := slab_chart_step g ρ r 1 T F hρ hT hF one_pos (q j)
      (fun y hy hyT => hN (q j) y hy hyT) (φ j) (hφ.1 j) (hφ.2.1 j) (hφ.2.2.2 j).1 (hφT j)
      Y V₁ Z₁ hY hY1 (hVZ₁ j)
    exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩
  refine ⟨fun j => (hint0 j).1, ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : Fin n → Set E3, S = fun j => chartAt E3 (q j) ''
      ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hfdef⟩ : ∃ f : Fin n → E3 → ℝ, f = fun j y => ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hddef⟩ : ∃ d : Fin n → E3 → ℝ, d = fun j y => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
      g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ee, heedef⟩ : ∃ ee : Fin n → E3 → ℝ, ee = fun j y =>
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hSm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (S j) := by
    intro j
    rw [hSdef]
    exact hDm (q j)
  have hSt : ∀ j, S j ⊆ (chartAt E3 (q j)).target := by
    intro j
    rw [hSdef]
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨_, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 (q j)).map_source hxs
  have hfc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (f j) (S j) := by
    intro j
    have h : ContinuousOn (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) (S j) :=
      hρc.comp_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 (q j)).continuousOn_symm.mono (hSt j))
    rw [hfdef]
    exact h
  have hfS : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ S j, r < f j y := by
    intro j y hy
    rw [hSdef] at hy
    obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxD, hxs⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [hfdef]
    show r < ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm (chartAt E3 (q j) x))
    rw [(chartAt E3 (q j)).left_inv hxs]
    exact hxD.2
  have hint : ∀ j, IntegrableOn (d j) (S j) ∧ IntegrableOn (ee j) (S j) := by
    intro j
    rw [hSdef, hddef, heedef]
    exact hint0 j
  
  have hlim : ∀ (T' : Set E3), MeasurableSet T' → ∀ (u w : E3 → ℝ), ContinuousOn u T' →
      (∀ y ∈ T', r < u y) → IntegrableOn w T' →
      Tendsto (fun η : ℝ => ∫ y in T', calTheta r η (u y) * w y) (𝓝[>] 0)
        (𝓝 (∫ y in T', w y)) := by
    intro T' hT' u w hu huT hw
    refine tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun y => ‖w y‖) ?_ ?_ hw.norm ?_
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun η => ?_)
      have hθ : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => calTheta r η t) := by
        unfold calTheta
        exact Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp (by fun_prop)
      exact ((hθ.comp_continuousOn hu).aestronglyMeasurable hT').mul hw.aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun η => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
      have h0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (2 * ((u y - r) / η) - 1)
      have h1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (2 * ((u y - r) / η) - 1)
      have hle : ‖calTheta r η (u y)‖ ≤ 1 := by
        unfold calTheta
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg h0]
        exact h1
      rw [norm_mul]
      calc ‖calTheta r η (u y)‖ * ‖w y‖ ≤ 1 * ‖w y‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖w y‖ := one_mul _
    · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hT' (fun y hy => ?_)
      have hδ : 0 < u y - r := sub_pos.2 (huT y hy)
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hδ] with η hη
      have hη0 : 0 < η := hη.1
      have h1 : 1 ≤ 2 * ((u y - r) / η) - 1 := by
        have h2 : 1 < (u y - r) / η := by
          rw [lt_div_iff₀ hη0]
          linarith [hη.2]
        linarith
      unfold calTheta
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le h1, one_mul]
  
  have hΦ : Tendsto (fun η : ℝ => ∑ j, ((∫ y in S j, calTheta r η (f j y) * d j y) +
      ((∫ y in S j, ee j y) - ∫ y in S j, calTheta r η (f j y) * ee j y))) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 (∑ j, ((∫ y in S j, d j y) + ((∫ y in S j, ee j y) - ∫ y in S j, ee j y)))) :=
    tendsto_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => (hlim _ (hSm j) _ _ (hfc j) (hfS j) (hint j).1).add
      (tendsto_const_nhds.sub (hlim _ (hSm j) _ _ (hfc j) (hfS j) (hint j).2)))
  have hL : (∑ j, ((∫ y in S j, d j y) + ((∫ y in S j, ee j y) - ∫ y in S j, ee j y))) =
      calVolSum g q φ (F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) (fun x => g.levelMeanCurv ρ x) := by
    simp only [sub_self, add_zero]
    rw [hSdef, hddef]
    rfl
  rw [hL] at hΦ
  obtain ⟨η, hηΦ, hη⟩ := ((hΦ.eventually (lt_mem_nhds (sub_lt_self _ hε))).and
    eventually_mem_nhdsWithin).exists
  have hη0 : 0 < η := hη
  
  obtain ⟨V, Z, hV, hV1, hZ, hVZ⟩ := blend η hη0
  refine ⟨V, hV, hV1, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨Mt, hMdef⟩ : ∃ Mt : Fin n → ℝ, Mt = fun j => ∫ y in S j,
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) y
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j)) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)
            (Z ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) : E3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hcancel : ∑ j, Mt j = 0 := by
    rw [hMdef, hSdef]
    exact cal_partition_div_cancel g Ω q φ hφ O hO hφ1 Z hZ _ hDm hDO
  
  have hineq : ∀ j, ((∫ y in S j, calTheta r η (f j y) * d j y) + Mt j +
      ((∫ y in S j, ee j y) - ∫ y in S j, calTheta r η (f j y) * ee j y)) ≤
      (∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) V) y) -
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F \ (T ∩ {x | r < ρ x})) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) y := by
    intro j
    have h := slab_chart_step g ρ r η T F hρ hT hF hη0 (q j)
      (fun y hy hyT => hN (q j) y hy hyT) (φ j) (hφ.1 j) (hφ.2.1 j) (hφ.2.2.2 j).1 (hφT j)
      Y V Z hY hY1 (hVZ j)
    rw [hMdef, hSdef, hfdef, hddef, heedef]
    exact h.2.2
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ Finset.univ) => hineq j)
  have e1 : ∑ j, ((∫ y in S j, calTheta r η (f j y) * d j y) + Mt j +
      ((∫ y in S j, ee j y) - ∫ y in S j, calTheta r η (f j y) * ee j y)) =
      ∑ j, ((∫ y in S j, calTheta r η (f j y) * d j y) +
      ((∫ y in S j, ee j y) - ∫ y in S j, calTheta r η (f j y) * ee j y)) + ∑ j, Mt j := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
  rw [e1, hcancel, add_zero, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hsum
  unfold calDivSum

        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).comp

        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by

            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
