signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (p : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) (hd : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) ≠ 0) : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y * partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
  have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy
  have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
  
  have hG : (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef := by
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  
  have hGi : ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹).PosDef := hG.inv
  
  have hρx : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) :=
    hρ.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  have hfc : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (ρ ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y :=
    MDifferentiableAt.comp y hρx hf
  have hκx : (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = y := (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hy
  have hfc' : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (ρ ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      ((chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := by
    rw [hκx]; exact hfc
  have hloc : ((ρ ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) ∘ (chartAt E3 p)) =ᶠ[𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)] ρ := by
    filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_left_inverse hq] with z hz
    simp [Function.comp, hz]
  have hchain0 := mfderiv_comp ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) hfc' hg
  rw [hloc.mfderiv_eq, hκx, mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at hchain0
  
  set ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun a => partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y with hξdef
  have hξ : ξ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hd
    rw [hchain0]
    have hz : fderiv ℝ (ρ ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y = 0 := by
      ext u
      have hu : u = ∑ a, u a • e a := by
        ext j
        fin_cases j <;> simp [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      have hb : ∀ a, fderiv ℝ (ρ ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) y (e a) = 0 := by
        intro a
        have := congrFun h0 a
        exact this
      rw [hu, map_sum]
      simp [map_smul, hb]
    rw [hz, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp]
  
  have hpos := hGi.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ
  have heq : star ξ ⬝ᵥ ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹).mulVec ξ =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ a b *
        partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
        partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y := by
    simp only [hξdef, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  rw [← heq]
  exact hpos

informal_problem.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ Θ : M → ℝ) (T : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (hT : IsOpen T) (hN : ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ T → 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y * partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) (hΘ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ Θ) (hΘ01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Θ x ∧ Θ x ≤ 1) (hΘT : tsupport Θ ⊆ T) (Y : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (hY1 : ∀ x, g.g x (Y x) (Y x) ≤ 1) : ∃ V Z : M → E3, calSmoothField V ∧ (∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) ∧ calSmoothField Z ∧ ∀ q : M, ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, ∀ wV wY wZ : E3, wV = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) → wY = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Y ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) → wZ = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) → ∀ i : Fin 3, wV i = (1 - Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) * wY i + Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i ∧ wZ i = Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i

signature.name: slab_blend_field
signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ Θ : M → ℝ) (T : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (hT : IsOpen T) (hN : ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ T → 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y * partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) (hΘ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ Θ) (hΘ01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Θ x ∧ Θ x ≤ 1) (hΘT : tsupport Θ ⊆ T) (Y : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (hY1 : ∀ x, g.g x (Y x) (Y x) ≤ 1) : ∃ V Z : M → E3, calSmoothField V ∧ (∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) ∧ calSmoothField Z ∧ ∀ q : M, ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, ∀ wV wY wZ : E3, wV = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) → wY = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Y ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) → wZ = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) → ∀ i : Fin 3, wV i = (1 - Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) * wY i + Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i ∧ wZ i = Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have bilin_riesz : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ),
      (∀ v : E3, v ≠ 0 → 0 < B v v) → ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ∃ v : E3, ∀ w : E3, B v w = ℓ w := by
    intro B hpos ℓ
    let D := InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E3
    let Tm : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3 :=
      { toFun := fun v => D.symm (B v)
        map_add' := fun v w => by simp
        map_smul' := fun c v => by simp }
    have hinj : Function.Injective Tm := by
      intro v w hvw
      have h1 : B v = B w := by
        have := congrArg D hvw
        simpa [Tm] using this
      by_contra hne
      have h2 := hpos (v - w) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
      have h3 : B (v - w) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, h1, sub_self]
      rw [h3] at h2
      simp at h2
    have hsurj := LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsurj (D.symm ℓ)
    refine ⟨v, fun w => ?_⟩
    have h1 : B v = ℓ := by
      have := congrArg D hv
      simpa [Tm] using this
    rw [h1]
  
  have blend_quad_le : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ v w : E3, B v w = B w v) →
      (∀ v : E3, 0 ≤ B v v) → ∀ (Y₀ X₀ : E3), B Y₀ Y₀ ≤ 1 → B X₀ X₀ = 1 → ∀ (θ : ℝ),
      0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      B ((1 - θ) • Y₀ + θ • X₀) ((1 - θ) • Y₀ + θ • X₀) ≤ 1 := by
    intro B hsymm hpsd Y₀ X₀ hY₀ hX₀ θ hθ0 hθ1
    have hcs := hpsd (Y₀ - (B Y₀ X₀) • X₀)
    have hXY : B X₀ Y₀ = B Y₀ X₀ := hsymm X₀ Y₀
    simp only [map_sub, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, hX₀, hXY] at hcs
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, hX₀, hXY]
    have hc2 : B Y₀ X₀ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have hc := abs_le.mp (sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one (B Y₀ X₀) |>.mp hc2)
    have ha : 0 ≤ 1 - θ := sub_nonneg.2 hθ1
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha ha) (sub_nonneg.2 hY₀),
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hθ0) (sub_nonneg.2 hc.2)]
  
  have hposdef : ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target →
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef := by
    intro q y hy
    have hq : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hq
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hvx : (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hx
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) _ hDv
      have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).mulVec x =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three,
          map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply,
          star_trivial, RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  
  have grad_chart_rep : ∀ (N : M → E3),
      (∀ (x : M) (w : E3), g.g x (N x) w = (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ x w : ℝ)) →
      ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → ∀ (w : E3),
      w = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (N ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, w i = ∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i k *
        partialDeriv k (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) ∧
      g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (N ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (N ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ a b *
          partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
    intro N hN0 q y hy w hw
    have hx : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy
    have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy
    have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hx
    have hinv : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y v) = v := by
      have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)).comp
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y) := mfderiv_comp y hg hf
      have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id y := by
        apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
        exact hz
      rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
      intro v
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L v) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        K = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        L = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hKL : ∀ v, K (L v) = v := by intro v; rw [hK, hL]; exact hinv v
    have hKinj : Function.Injective K := by
      have hsurj : Function.Surjective (K : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) := fun v => ⟨L v, hKL v⟩
      exact LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mpr hsurj
    have hLK : ∀ v, L (K v) = v := fun v => hKinj (hKL (K v))
    have hρd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      hρ.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hchain : ∀ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (L (e b)) := by
      intro b
      have h1 := mfderiv_comp y hρd hf
      rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at h1
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [show (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) = ρ ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm from rfl, h1, hL]
      rfl
    have hw' : L w = N ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) := by rw [hw, ← hK]; exact hLK _
    have hexp : w = ∑ a : Fin 3, w a • e a := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have h1 : ∀ b : Fin 3, g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (L w) (L (e b)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, w a * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y a b := by
      intro b
      conv_lhs => rw [hexp]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, hL]
      rfl
    have hsys : ∀ b : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, w a * g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y a b =
        partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      intro b
      rw [← h1 b, hw', hN0, hchain b]
    have hmv : (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).mulVec (fun a => w a) =
        fun b => partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      funext b
      rw [← hsys b]
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
      have hs : g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y b a = g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y a b := by
        simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        exact g.symm _ _ _
      rw [hs]
      ring
    have hdet : IsUnit (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det :=
      isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hposdef q y hy).det_pos.ne'
    have hsol : (fun a => w a) = ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹).mulVec
        (fun b => partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) := by
      have h2 := congrArg (fun v => ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹).mulVec v) hmv
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec] at h2
      exact h2
    have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, w i = ∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i k *
        partialDeriv k (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      intro i
      have h2 := congrFun hsol i
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using h2
    refine ⟨hcomp, ?_⟩
    have h3 : ∀ c : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, c (L w) = ∑ b : Fin 3, w b * c (L (e b)) := by
      intro c
      conv_lhs => rw [hexp]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [← hw', h3 (g.g _ (L w))]
    simp only [h1, hsys]
    simp only [hcomp, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
    ring
  
  have unit_normal_contDiffOn : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ)
      (S : Set E3), IsOpen S → (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) S) →
      (∀ z ∈ S, 0 < (G z).det) → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f S → ∀ (n : E3 → E3),
      (∀ z ∈ S, ∀ i : Fin 3, n z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ n {z : E3 | z ∈ S ∧
        0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} := by
    intro G f S hS hG hdet hf n hn
    have hdetT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) S := by
      have e : (fun y => (G y).det) = fun y => G y 0 0 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 2
          - G y 0 0 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 1
          - G y 0 1 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 2 + G y 0 1 * G y 1 2 * G y 2 0
          + G y 0 2 * G y 1 0 * G y 2 1 - G y 0 2 * G y 1 1 * G y 2 0 := by
        funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
      rw [e]
      have h := hG
      exact (((((((h 0 0).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 2)).sub (((h 0 0).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 1))).sub
        (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 2))).add (((h 0 1).mul (h 1 2)).mul (h 2 0))).add
        (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 0)).mul (h 2 1))).sub (((h 0 2).mul (h 1 1)).mul (h 2 0))
    have hdinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹) S :=
      hdetT.inv (fun z hz => (hdet z hz).ne')
    have h00 := hG 0 0
    have h01 := hG 0 1
    have h02 := hG 0 2
    have h10 := hG 1 0
    have h11 := hG 1 1
    have h12 := hG 1 2
    have h20 := hG 2 0
    have h21 := hG 2 1
    have h22 := hG 2 2
    have hadj : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).adjugate a b) S := by
      intro a b
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three] <;> fun_prop
    have hinvE : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) S := by
      intro a b
      have e1 : (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) = fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹ * (G z).adjugate a b := by
        funext z
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [e1]
      exact hdinv.mul (hadj a b)
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) S := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hS (by simp)
    have hpd : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => partialDeriv k f z) S := fun k =>
      hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hNsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z) S :=
      ContDiffOn.sum (fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun b _ => ((hinvE a b).mul (hpd a)).mul (hpd b)))
    have hST : {z : E3 | z ∈ S ∧
        0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ⊆ S :=
      fun z hz => hz.1
    rw [contDiffOn_piLp]
    intro i
    have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => calUnitNormal G f z i) {z : E3 | z ∈ S ∧
        0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} :=
      (((hNsq.mono hST).sqrt (fun z hz => hz.2.ne')).inv
        (fun z hz => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hz.2).ne')).mul
        ((ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hinvE i k).mul (hpd k))).mono hST)
    exact hc.congr (fun z hz => hn z hz.1 i)
  
  have blend_local_smooth : ∀ (S : Set E3), IsOpen S → ∀ (th : E3 → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ th S → ∀ (Yt n : E3 → E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt S → ∀ (U : Set E3),
      IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ n (S ∩ U) →
      (∀ z ∈ S, z ∉ U → ∃ u : Set E3, IsOpen u ∧ z ∈ u ∧ ∀ z' ∈ S ∩ u, th z' = 0) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (1 - th z) • Yt z + th z • n z) S ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => th z • n z) S := by
    intro S hS th hth Yt n hYt U hU hn hzero
    constructor
    · apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      intro z hz
      by_cases hzU : z ∈ U
      · refine ⟨U, hU, hzU, ?_⟩
        exact ((contDiffOn_const.sub (hth.mono Set.inter_subset_left)).smul
          (hYt.mono Set.inter_subset_left)).add ((hth.mono Set.inter_subset_left).smul hn)
      · obtain ⟨u, hu, hzu, hu0⟩ := hzero z hz hzU
        refine ⟨u, hu, hzu, ?_⟩
        refine (hYt.mono Set.inter_subset_left).congr (fun z' hz' => ?_)
        simp [hu0 z' hz']
    · apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      intro z hz
      by_cases hzU : z ∈ U
      · refine ⟨U, hU, hzU, ?_⟩
        exact (hth.mono Set.inter_subset_left).smul hn
      · obtain ⟨u, hu, hzu, hu0⟩ := hzero z hz hzU
        refine ⟨u, hu, hzu, ?_⟩
        refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : E3))).congr (fun z' hz' => ?_)
        simp [hu0 z' hz']
  
  choose Nr hNr using fun x : M => bilin_riesz (g.g x) (g.posDef x)
    (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ x : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)
  have hNr' : ∀ (x : M) (w : E3), g.g x (Nr x) w = (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ x w : ℝ) :=
    fun x w => hNr x w
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ : ∃ X : M → E3, ∀ x, X x = (Real.sqrt (g.g x (Nr x) (Nr x)))⁻¹ • Nr x :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : M → E3, ∀ x, V x = (1 - Θ x) • Y x + Θ x • X x := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ : ∃ Z : M → E3, ∀ x, Z x = Θ x • X x := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ T, 0 < g.g x (Nr x) (Nr x) := by
    intro x hxT
    have h2 := (grad_chart_rep Nr hNr' x (chartAt E3 x x) (mem_chart_target E3 x) _ rfl).2
    rw [(chartAt E3 x).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x)] at h2
    rw [h2]
    exact hN x (chartAt E3 x x) (mem_chart_target E3 x)
      (by rw [(chartAt E3 x).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x)]; exact hxT)
  
  have hrepX : ∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → ∀ w : E3,
      w = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (X ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      w i = calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i := by
    intro q y hy w hw i
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : E3, u = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
        ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Nr ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := grad_chart_rep Nr hNr' q y hy u hu
    have hwu : w = (Real.sqrt (g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Nr ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
        (Nr ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))))⁻¹ • u := by
      rw [hw, hu, hX, map_smul]
    rw [hwu, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, h1 i, h2]
    rfl
  
  have hrep : ∀ q : M, ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, ∀ wV wY wZ : E3,
        wV = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (V ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
        wY = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
        wZ = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) →
        ∀ i : Fin 3,
          wV i = (1 - Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) * wY i +
            Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i ∧
          wZ i = Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i := by
    intro q y hy wV wY wZ hwV hwY hwZ i
    obtain ⟨wX, hwX⟩ : ∃ wX : E3, wX = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
        ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (X ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hX' := hrepX q y hy wX hwX i
    have eV : wV = (1 - Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) • wY +
        Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) • wX := by
      rw [hwV, hwY, hwX, hV, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
    have eZ : wZ = Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) • wX := by
      rw [hwZ, hwX, hZ, map_smul]
    constructor
    · rw [eV, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, hX']
    · rw [eZ, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hX']
  
  have hnorm : ∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    rw [hV x]
    by_cases hx0 : Θ x = 0
    · rw [hx0]
      simpa using hY1 x
    · have hxT : x ∈ T := hΘT (subset_tsupport Θ (Function.mem_support.mpr hx0))
      have hn := hpos x hxT
      have hX1 : g.g x (X x) (X x) = 1 := by
        simp only [hX x, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_inv, Real.mul_self_sqrt hn.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn.ne']
      have hpsd : ∀ v : E3, 0 ≤ g.g x v v := by
        intro v
        by_cases hv : v = 0
        · subst hv; simp
        · exact (g.posDef x v hv).le
      exact blend_quad_le (g.g x) (g.symm x) hpsd (Y x) (X x) (hY1 x) hX1
        (Θ x) (hΘ01 x).1 (hΘ01 x).2
  
  have hsm : ∀ q : M,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
        ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q)
        ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    intro q
    have hS : IsOpen (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).open_target
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ρ ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm)
          (chartAt E3 q).target :=
        hρ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    have hth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (Θ ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm)
          (chartAt E3 q).target :=
        hΘ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    have hn3 := unit_normal_contDiffOn (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
      (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target hS (fun i j => g.smooth q i j)
      (fun z hz => (hposdef q z hz).det_pos) hf
      (fun z => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) z i)) (fun z _ i => rfl)
    have hU : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' T) :=
      (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hT
    have hn5 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => calUnitNormal
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) z i) : E3))
        ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' T)) :=
      hn3.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, hN q z hz.1 hz.2.2⟩)
    have hzero : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target,
        z ∉ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' T →
        ∃ u : Set E3, IsOpen u ∧ z ∈ u ∧ ∀ z' ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ u,
          (fun z => Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) z' = 0 := by
      intro z hz hzU
      have hzT : (chartAt E3 q).symm z ∉ T := fun h => hzU ⟨hz, h⟩
      have hzs : (chartAt E3 q).symm z ∉ tsupport Θ := fun h => hzT (hΘT h)
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (tsupport Θ)ᶜ,
        (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (isClosed_tsupport Θ).isOpen_compl,
        ⟨hz, hzs⟩, fun z' hz' => ?_⟩
      exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz'.2.2
    have h5 := blend_local_smooth (chartAt E3 q).target hS
      (fun z => Θ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) hth
      (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (Y ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3))
      (fun z => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => calUnitNormal
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) z i) : E3))
      (hY q) _ hU hn5 hzero
    constructor
    · refine h5.1.congr (fun y hy => ?_)
      refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
      beta_reduce
      rw [(hrep q y hy _ _ _ rfl rfl rfl i).1, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    · refine h5.2.congr (fun y hy => ?_)
      refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
      beta_reduce
      rw [(hrep q y hy _ _ _ rfl rfl rfl i).2, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact ⟨V, Z, fun q => (hsm q).1, hnorm, fun q => (hsm q).2, hrep⟩

∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y) ≤ (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ V) y) - ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((F \ (T ∩ {x | r < ρ x})) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y

∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((F \ (T ∩ {x | r < ρ x})) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρ.continuous
  
  have hTp : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hT
  have hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z i j)
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T) :=
    fun i j => (g.smooth p i j).mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hpd : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).PosDef :=
    fun z hz => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p z hz.1
  have hdet : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T,
      0 < (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det := fun z hz => (hpd z hz).det_pos
  have hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z j i :=
    fun z i j => g.symm _ _ _
  have hcomp : ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T) := by
    intro u hu
    exact (contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)).mono
      Set.inter_subset_left
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T) := hcomp ρ hρ
  have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T) := hcomp φ hφ
  have hψ0 : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T,
      0 ≤ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z := fun z _ => hφ0 _
  have hφs : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := hφp.trans Set.inter_subset_right
  have hφT : tsupport φ ⊆ T := hφp.trans Set.inter_subset_left
  have hC : IsCompact (chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ) :=
    hφc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono hφs)
  have hCT : chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ ⊆
      (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source (hφs hx), ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x) ∈ T
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hφs hx)]
    exact hφT hx
  have hψC : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T,
      z ∉ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ → (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z = 0 := by
    intro z hz hzC
    by_contra hne
    exact hzC ⟨(chartAt E3 p).symm z, subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.mpr hne),
      (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hz.1⟩
  
  have hvan : ∀ U : M → E3, ∀ z : E3, z ∉ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ →
      calPiece p φ U z = 0 := by
    intro U z hz
    by_cases hzt : z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
    · have hφz : φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) = 0 := by
        apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
        intro hmem
        exact hz ⟨_, hmem, (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hzt⟩
      rw [calPiece, Set.indicator_of_mem hzt]
      simp only [hφz, zero_smul]
    · exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hzt _
  have hdivvan : ∀ U : M → E3, ∀ z : E3, z ∉ chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ U) z = 0 := by
    intro U z hz
    have hO : (chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ)ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 z := hC.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hz
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    have hev : (fun w => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm w).det * calPiece p φ U w i)
        =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hO] with w hw
      rw [hvan U w hw]
      simp
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hfd0 : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∉ tsupport φ →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z = 0 := by
    intro z hz hzφ
    have hU : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (tsupport φ)ᶜ) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (isClosed_tsupport φ).isOpen_compl
    have hev : (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds ⟨hz, hzφ⟩] with w hw
      exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hw.2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hlmc : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target,
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z =
        g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) := by
    intro z hz
    let Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 p).symm.toPartialEquiv
        open_source := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
        open_target := (chartAt E3 p).open_source
        contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
        contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
    have h := levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φ ρ (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) hρ z hz
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
    exact h.symm
  
  obtain ⟨Xt, hXtdef⟩ : ∃ Xt : E3 → E3, Xt = fun y => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i =>
      calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y i) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hXti : ∀ (z : E3) (i : Fin 3), Xt z i =
      calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z i := by
    intro z i
    rw [hXtdef]
  have hnp := ccs_normal_props (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
    _ hTp hG hpd hf Xt (fun z _ i => hXti z i)
  have hXt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xt ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T) :=
    hnp.2.1.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz, hN z hz.1 hz.2⟩)
  have hCS : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T,
      r < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) →
      |fderiv ℝ (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) : E3)| ≤
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z (Xt z) := by
    intro z hz _
    refine hnp.2.2 z hz (hN z hz.1 hz.2) _ ?_
    rw [ccs_rep_norm g Y p z hz.1 _ rfl]
    exact hY1 _
  
  have hBo : IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T ∧
      r < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)} \ ∅) := by
    rw [Set.diff_empty]
    exact hf.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hTp isOpen_Ioi
  obtain ⟨sig, hsigdef⟩ : ∃ sig : E3 → ℝ, sig = fun z =>
      ({z : E3 | z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T ∧
        r < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)} \ ∅).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z -
      (∅ : Set E3).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsig : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T, sig z =
      ({z : E3 | z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T ∧
        r < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)} \ ∅).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z -
      (∅ : Set E3).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z := by
    intro z _
    rw [hsigdef]
  have hsig1 : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T,
      r < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) → sig z = 1 := by
    intro z hz h
    rw [hsig z hz]
    have hm : z ∈ ({z : E3 | z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T ∧
        r < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)} \ ∅) := ⟨⟨hz, h⟩, Set.notMem_empty z⟩
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hm, Set.indicator_of_notMem (Set.notMem_empty z), sub_zero]
  have htheta0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ r → calTheta r η t = 0 :=
    fun t ht => (ccs_theta_props r η hη).2.2.2.1 t (by linarith)
  
  have himg : ∀ S : Set M, chartAt E3 p '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =
      (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' S := by
    intro S
    rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact (chartAt E3 p).image_source_inter_eq' S
  have hmemimg : ∀ (S : Set M) (z : E3), z ∈ chartAt E3 p '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ↔
      z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ S := by
    intro S z
    rw [himg S]
    rfl
  have hFm : MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T)) :=
    (hF p).inter hTp.measurableSet
  have hUo : IsOpen {x : M | r < ρ x} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hρc
  have hSm : MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) := by
    have hFp := hF p
    rw [himg] at hFp ⊢
    have e : (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (F ∩ T ∩ {x : M | r < ρ x}) =
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' F) ∩
          ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T) ∩
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' {x : M | r < ρ x}) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
      tauto
    rw [e]
    exact (hFp.inter hTp.measurableSet).inter
      ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hUo).measurableSet
  have hS : chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =
      symmDiff (chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T)) ∅ ∩
        {z : E3 | r < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)} := by
    rw [himg (F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}), himg F]
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_symmDiff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false,
      Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    tauto
  have hSTp : ∀ z ∈ chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T ∧
        r < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hmemimg] at hz
    exact ⟨⟨hz.1, hz.2.1.2⟩, hz.2.2⟩
  have hsigS : ∀ z ∈ chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      sig z = 1 := fun z hz => hsig1 z (hSTp z hz).1 (hSTp z hz).2
  
  have hW₀o : ∀ z, z ∉ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T →
      calPiece p φ Y z = 0 := fun z hz => hvan Y z (fun h => hz (hCT h))
  have hW₁o : ∀ z, z ∉ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T →
      calPiece p φ V z = 0 := fun z hz => hvan V z (fun h => hz (hCT h))
  have hW₀ : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      calPiece p φ Y z i = (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z *
        (id (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) : E3) i := by
    intro z hz i
    rw [calPiece, Set.indicator_of_mem hz.1, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> rfl
  have hW₁ : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      calPiece p φ V z i = (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) z *
        ((1 - calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) *
          (id (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)
            (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) : E3) i +
          sig z * calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) * Xt z i) := by
    intro z hz i
    by_cases hφz : φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) = 0
    · rw [calPiece, Set.indicator_of_mem hz.1, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      show φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) * _ = φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) * _
      rw [hφz, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    · have hmem : (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ tsupport φ := subset_tsupport φ hφz
      have hst : sig z * calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) =
          calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) := by
        by_cases hr : r < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)
        · rw [hsig1 z hz hr, one_mul]
        · rw [htheta0 _ (le_of_not_gt hr), mul_zero]
      rw [hst, hXti, calPiece, Set.indicator_of_mem hz.1, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        (hVZ z hz.1 hmem _ _ _ rfl rfl rfl i).1] <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨Zt, hZtdef⟩ : ∃ Zt : E3 → E3, Zt = fun y => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i =>
      calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
        calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y i) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hZt : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      Zt z i = calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) * Xt z i := by
    intro z _ i
    rw [hZtdef, hXti]
  
  have hd : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T,
      r < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) →
      φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det =
        φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) Xt z := by
    intro z hz _
    rw [ccs_divx (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      _ hTp hG hsymm hpd hf Xt (fun z _ i => hXti z i) z hz (hN z hz.1 hz.2), hlmc z hz.1]
    ring
  
  have key := ccs_euclid_calib (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
    ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T)
    ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T)
    (chartAt E3 p '' tsupport φ)
    (chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T))
    ∅
    (fun y => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
    (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)
    sig
    (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
      (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3))
    Xt Zt (calPiece p φ Y) (calPiece p φ V) r η hTp hG hdet hf hη hψ hψ0 hC hCT hψC hTp
    (fun _ h => h) (fun z hz _ => hz) ((hY p).mono Set.inter_subset_left) hXt hCS isOpen_empty
    (Set.empty_subset _) hBo hFm Set.inter_subset_right hsig hW₀o hW₀ hW₁o hW₁ hZt hd
  obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3⟩ := key
  rw [← hS] at k1 k2 k3
  
  have k2' : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun y => sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y)
      (chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :=
    k2.congr_fun (fun z hz => by simp only [hsigS z hz, one_mul]) hSm
  have e1 : (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      sig y * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y) =
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hSm (fun z hz => by simp only [hsigS z hz, one_mul])
  have e2 : (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
        (sig y * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y)) =
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        calTheta r η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hSm (fun z hz => by simp only [hsigS z hz, one_mul])
  
  have eM : (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) y (Zt y)) =
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((F ∩ T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
              (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hSm (fun z hz => ?_)
    have hzt : z ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := (hSTp z hz).1.1
    by_cases hmem : (chartAt E3 p).symm z ∈ tsupport φ
    · have hZeq : Zt z = (id (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) : E3) := by
        refine PiLp.ext fun i => ?_
        rw [hZtdef]
        exact ((hVZ z hzt hmem _ _ _ rfl rfl rfl i).2).symm
      simp only [hZeq, id_eq]
    · simp only [hfd0 z hzt hmem, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  
  have e3 : (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ V) y) =
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ V) y := by
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (hF p)
      Set.inter_subset_left ?_
    intro z hz
    exact hdivvan V z (fun h => hz.2 ⟨hz.1, hCT h⟩)
  have htm : MeasurableSet
      (chartAt E3 p '' ((F \ (T ∩ {x | r < ρ x})) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) := by
    have hFp := hF p
    rw [himg F] at hFp
    have e : chartAt E3 p '' ((F \ (T ∩ {x | r < ρ x})) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' F) \
          ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (T ∩ {x | r < ρ x})) := by
      rw [himg (F \ (T ∩ {x | r < ρ x}))]
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_diff]
      tauto
    rw [e]
    exact hFp.diff ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (hT.inter hUo)).measurableSet
  have e4 : (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((F \ (T ∩ {x | r < ρ x})) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y) =
      ∫ y in (chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ∩
        ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' T)) \
          {z : E3 | r < ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)} ∪ ∅,
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y := by
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero htm ?_ ?_
    · intro z hz
      rcases hz with ⟨⟨hzA, hzTp⟩, hzr⟩ | hz0
      · have hA := (hmemimg F z).1 hzA
        exact (hmemimg _ z).2 ⟨hA.1, hA.2, fun h => hzr h.2⟩
      · exact absurd hz0 (Set.notMem_empty z)
    · intro z hz
      apply hdivvan Y z
      intro hzC
      have hzTp := hCT hzC
      have h1 := (hmemimg _ z).1 hz.1
      apply hz.2
      left
      refine ⟨⟨(hmemimg F z).2 ⟨h1.1, h1.2.1⟩, hzTp⟩, ?_⟩
      intro hr
      exact h1.2.2 ⟨hzTp.2, hr⟩
  
  refine ⟨k1, k2', ?_⟩
  rw [e1, e2, eM] at k3
  rw [e3, e4]
  exact k3

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_euclid_calib
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T T' C Ft At : Set E3) (f ψ d sig : E3 → ℝ) (Yt Xt Zt W₀ W₁ : E3 → E3) (r₁ η : ℝ) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (hη : 0 < η) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ T) (hψ0 : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 ≤ ψ z) (hC : IsCompact C) (hCT : C ⊆ T) (hψC : ∀ z ∈ T, z ∉ C → ψ z = 0) (hT'o : IsOpen T') (hT'T : T' ⊆ T) (hT'f : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ ≤ f z → z ∈ T') (hYt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt T) (hXt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Xt T') (hCS : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → |fderiv ℝ f z (Yt z)| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (Xt z)) (hAo : IsOpen At) (hAsub : At ⊆ {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z}) (hBo : IsOpen ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} \ At)) (hFm : MeasurableSet Ft) (hFT : Ft ⊆ T) (hsig : ∀ z ∈ T, sig z = ({z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ r₁ < f z} \ At).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z - At.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) z) (hW₀o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → W₀ z = 0) (hW₀ : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₀ z i = ψ z * Yt z i) (hW₁o : ∀ z, z ∉ T → W₁ z = 0) (hW₁ : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, W₁ z i = ψ z * ((1 - calTheta r₁ η (f z)) * Yt z i + sig z * calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i)) (hZt : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, Zt z i = calTheta r₁ η (f z) * Xt z i) (hd : ∀ z ∈ T, r₁ < f z → d z = ψ z * sepDensDiv G Xt z) : IntegrableOn d (symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun z => sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) (symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∧ (∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, calTheta r₁ η (f z) * d z) + (∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, Real.sqrt (G z).det * fderiv ℝ ψ z (Zt z)) + ((∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z) - ∫ z in symmDiff Ft At ∩ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}, calTheta r₁ η (f z) * (sig z * sepDensDiv G W₀ z)) ≤ (∫ z in Ft, sepDensDiv G W₁ z) - ∫ z in (Ft \ {z : E3 | r₁ < f z}) ∪ At, sepDensDiv G W₀ z

subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ T) (hN : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y) : sepDensDiv G X y = Real.sqrt (G y).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y

subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) : IsOpen {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X {z : E3 | z ∈ T ∧ 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z} ∧ ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f z * partialDeriv b f z → ∀ w : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * w a * w b ≤ 1 → |fderiv ℝ f z w| ≤ fderiv ℝ f z (X z)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (hUo : IsOpen U)
    (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U)) (φ lam : M → ℝ)
    (hdata : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, 0 < φ p ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
        V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ V ∩ frontier U, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧
          g.jacobiDeriv f x = lam x / φ x)
    (p₀ : M) (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ frontier U)
    (hdeg : ∀ q ∈ connectedComponentIn (frontier U) p₀, lam q = 0 ∧ g.scalarCurvature q = 0 ∧
      ∃ (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2), eigSurfParam (frontier U) z W F ∧ x ∈ W ∧
        (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) = q ∧ gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x = 0 ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x = 0)
    (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3) (hF : eigSurfParam (frontier U) z W F)
    (hFS : ∀ x ∈ W, (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ connectedComponentIn (frontier U) p₀) :
    ∀ x ∈ W, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hWo : IsOpen W := hF.1
  have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W := hF.2.1
  have hFt : ∀ y ∈ W, F y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target := fun y hy => (hF.2.2 y hy).1
  have hFS' : ∀ y ∈ W, (chartAt E3 z).symm (F y) ∈ frontier U := fun y hy => (hF.2.2 y hy).2.1
  have hinj : ∀ y ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F y) := fun y hy => (hF.2.2 y hy).2.2
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j)
      (chartAt E3 z).target := fun i j => g.smooth z i j
  have hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y j i :=
    fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  have hGpos : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y).PosDef :=
    fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g z y hy
  
  have hframe : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ frontier U →
      ∃ (U₀ : Set E3) (Φ : E3 → ℝ), IsOpen U₀ ∧ y ∈ U₀ ∧ U₀ ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U₀ ∧ (∀ w ∈ U₀, fderiv ℝ Φ w ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ w ∈ U₀, (chartAt E3 z).symm w ∈ frontier U → Φ w = 0 ∧
          φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm w) = ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ w ∧
          ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ w =
            lam ((chartAt E3 z).symm w) / φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm w) := by
    intro y hyt hyS
    obtain ⟨-, V, f, hVo, hyV, hf, hdf, hVS, hnorm⟩ := hdata _ hyS
    obtain ⟨hfs, htr⟩ := ejp_chart_transfer g z f hf
    have hUo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' V) :=
      (chartAt E3 z).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 z).open_target hVo
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' V, fun w => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm w),
      hUo, ⟨hyt, hyV⟩, Set.inter_subset_left, hfs.mono Set.inter_subset_left, ?_, ?_⟩

  have hGposU : ∀ y ∈ U₀, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y).PosDef := fun y hy => hGpos y (hUt hy)
  obtain ⟨-, -, hψ, -⟩ :=
    ejp_level_regularity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ U₀ hU hGU hGposU hΦ hdΦ
  have hs : IsOpen (W ∩ F ⁻¹' U₀) := hFs.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hWo hU
  have hxs : x ∈ W ∩ F ⁻¹' U₀ := ⟨hx, hFxU⟩
  obtain ⟨-, hux, hjac⟩ := hloc _ hFxU hq
  have hzero : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, Φ (F y) = 0 :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hxs) (fun y hy => (hloc _ hy.2 (hFS' y hy.1)).1)
  have hev : (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hs.mem_nhds hxs) (fun y hy => (hloc _ hy.2 (hFS' y hy.1)).2.1)
  have hu0 : 0 < φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) := (hdata _ hq).1
  have hlapc : ∀ (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : E2 → ℝ), w₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] w₂ →
      lap2 h w₁ x = lap2 h w₂ x := by
    intro h w₁ w₂ hw
    have h1 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j w₁) x = pd2 i (pd2 j w₂) x := by
      intro i j
      have hj : pd2 j w₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] pd2 j w₂ := by
        filter_upwards [hw.eventuallyEq_nhds] with y hy
        show fderiv ℝ w₁ y (e2 j) = fderiv ℝ w₂ y (e2 j)
        rw [hy.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j w₁) x (e2 i) = fderiv ℝ (pd2 j w₂) x (e2 i)
      rw [hj.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k w₁ x = pd2 k w₂ x := by
      intro k
      show fderiv ℝ w₁ x (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ w₂ x (e2 k)
      rw [hw.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [lap2, h1, h2]
  have hlapψ := ejp_immersion_lap2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ
    (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ) U₀ hU hGU hGsymm hGposU hΦ hdΦ hψ F
    (W ∩ F ⁻¹' U₀) hs (hFs.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
    (fun y hy => ⟨hy.2, (hloc _ hy.2 (hFS' y hy.1)).1, hinj y hy.1⟩) x hxs
  have hamb := ejp_ambient_identity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ U₀ hU hGU hGsymm hGposU
    hΦ hdΦ (F x) hFxU
  rw [← hux, hjac] at hamb
  have hL : lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
      (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x =
      -(ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x)) * φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) -
        φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) * lam ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) := by
    rw [hlapc _ _ _ hev, hlapψ]
    have e1 : φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ^ 2 *
        (lam ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) / φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) =
        φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) * lam ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) := by
      field_simp <;> ring
    linear_combination hamb - e1
  
  have hlap0 : lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
      (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x = 0 := by
    have hpd1 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x = 0 := by
      intro k
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x (e2 k) = 0
      rw [hdu x hx]
      simp
    have hpd2 : ∀ i j : Fin 2,
        pd2 i (pd2 j (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y)))) x = 0 := by
      intro i j
      have hj : pd2 j (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hWo.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
        show fderiv ℝ (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) y (e2 j) = 0
        rw [hdu y hy]
        simp
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y)))) x (e2 i) = 0
      rw [hj.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_apply]
      simp
    simp only [lap2, hpd1, hpd2]
    simp
  
  have hΦ2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 Φ (F x) :=
    (hΦ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hFxU)).of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
  have hsff := (gs_levelset_param (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F Φ (W ∩ F ⁻¹' U₀) hs x hxs
    (hFs.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (hinj x hx) hGsymm (hGpos _ (hFt x hx)) hΦ2
    (hdΦ _ hFxU) hzero).1
  have hpot : ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) =
      gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x +
        ejpRic (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) := by
    rw [← hsff]
    rfl
  
  have htan : ∀ i : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hΦd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (F x) :=
      (hΦ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hFxU)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x :=
      (hFs.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hc : fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (F y)) x = (fderiv ℝ Φ (F x)).comp (fderiv ℝ F x) :=
      fderiv_comp x hΦd hFd
    have h0 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (F y)) x = 0 := by
      rw [(show (fun y => Φ (F y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) from hzero).fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_const_apply _
    have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e2 i)) (hc.symm.trans h0)
    simpa using h3
  have htrace := jcc_scalar_trace (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (chartAt E3 z).target
    (chartAt E3 z).open_target hGs hGsymm hGpos Φ F x (hFt x hx) (hinj x hx) (hdΦ _ hFxU) htan
  let Φc : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
    { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 z).symm.toPartialEquiv
      open_source := (chartAt E3 z).open_target
      open_target := (chartAt E3 z).open_source
      contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
  have hR : g.scalarCurvature ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) =
      scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (F x) :=
    scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff g Φc (F x) (hFt x hx)
  
  have hgauss := gs_gauss_equation (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (chartAt E3 z).target
    (chartAt E3 z).open_target hGs hGsymm hGpos F W hWo hFs hFt hinj x hx
  
  have hPu : ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) * φ ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = 0 := by
    have h := hL
    rw [hlap0, hlam0] at h
    linear_combination h
  have hP0 : ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp hPu).resolve_right hu0.ne'
  have hRic0 : ejpRic (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) = 0 := by
    rw [hpot, hA] at hP0
    linarith
  have hR' : scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (F x) = 0 := by
    rw [← hR]
    exact hR0
  have hAmb : gsAmbPlane (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x /
      (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x).det = 0 := by
    rw [htrace, hRic0, mul_div_assoc] at hR'
    linarith
  rw [hgauss, hAmb, hH, hA]
  ring

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_chart_transfer
subgoal_signatures.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z).target ∧ ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ≠ 0 ∧ g.gradInner f f x = ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x) ∧ g.jacobiDeriv f x = ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z x)

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_level_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) : (∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ejpS G Φ y) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpS G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPsi G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPot G Φ) U

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_immersion_lap2
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ u : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFW : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ U ∧ Φ (F x) = 0 ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : lap2 (pullMetric2 G F) (fun x' => u (F x')) x = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ (F x) a b * hessLoc G u a b (F x)) - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ (F x) c d * hessLoc G Φ c d (F x)) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ (F x) a * partialDeriv a u (F x)) / ejpS G Φ (F x)

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_ambient_identity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y a b * hessLoc G (ejpPsi G Φ) a b y) - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y c d * hessLoc G Φ c d y) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y a * partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y) / ejpS G Φ y + ejpPot G Φ y * ejpPsi G Φ y = -(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 2 * ejpJac G Φ y

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_gauss_equation
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 G F) x = gsAmbPlane G F x / (pullMetric2 G F x).det + (gsMeanCurv G F x ^ 2 - gsSffSq G F x) / 2

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_levelset_param
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (f : E3 → ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f (F x)) (hdf : fderiv ℝ f (F x) ≠ 0) (hzero : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f (F y) = 0) : secondFundSq G f (F x) = gsSffSq G F x ∧ (levelMeanCurvCoord G f (F x) = 0 ↔ gsMeanCurv G F x = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]

subgoal_signatures.name: jcc_scalar_trace
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i)
    (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hFx : F x ∈ U)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (hdΦ : fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) ≠ 0)
    (htan : ∀ i : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) = 0) :
    scalarCurvatureLocal G (F x) =
      2 * ejpRic G Φ (F x) + 2 * gsAmbPlane G F x / (pullMetric2 G F x).det

subgoal_signatures.name: surfA2_chart_invariant
