subgoal_signatures.name: chart_volume_family_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Ω O'' E Kf : Set M) (hE : sepChartMeas E) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hφ : calPartition q φ Ω) (hO'' : IsOpen O'') (h1 : ∀ x ∈ O'', ∑ j, φ j x = 1)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hKf : IsCompact Kf) (hKfO : Kf ⊆ O'')
    (hus : ∀ x, x ∉ Kf → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x = 0) {m : ℕ} (pp : Fin m → M)
    (W : Fin m → Set M) (T : Fin m → Set E3)
    (hW : ∀ k, IsOpen (W k) ∧ W k ⊆ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source)
    (hWd : Pairwise (fun k l => Disjoint (W k) (W l)))
    (hT : ∀ k, IsCompact (T k) ∧ T k ⊆ chartAt E3 (pp k) '' W k) :
    ∑ k, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (pp k) '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 (pp k)).source) ∩ T k,
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y).det *
          Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y)) ≤
      calVolSum g q φ E (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x))

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Ψ : C(M, Circle)) (K : Set M) (hK : IsClosed K) (hΨK : ∀ x : M, x ∉ K → Ψ x = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (u : Fin N → M → ℝ) (Λ : Fin N → M → ℝ) (D : Fin N → Set M) (B : ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ j, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u j)) (hu01 : ∀ j x, 0 ≤ u j x ∧ u j x ≤ 1)
    (hD : ∀ j, IsOpen (D j)) (hΛ : ∀ j, ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (Λ j) (D j))
    (huD : ∀ j, tsupport (u j) ⊆ D j) (hΛΨ : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ D j, Circle.exp (Λ j x) = Ψ x)
    (hΛB : ∀ j x, |Λ j x| ≤ B) (hcov : ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ j, u j x = 1) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
        (fun x => ∑ j, u j x * (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - u l x)) * Λ j x) ∧
      ∀ (p : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target → ∀ X : E3,
        |∑ i : Fin 3, (dualOmega (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) p y i -
            partialDeriv i (fun z => ∑ j, u j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) *
              (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - u l ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) *
              Λ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) * X i| ≤
          ((N : ℝ) * B) * ∑ j, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (u j) (u j) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
            Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i k * X i * X k)

signature.name: dual_weight_grad_bound
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Ψ : C(M, Circle)) (K : Set M) (hK : IsClosed K) (hΨK : ∀ x : M, x ∉ K → Ψ x = 1)
    {N : ℕ} (u : Fin N → M → ℝ) (Λ : Fin N → M → ℝ) (D : Fin N → Set M) (B : ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ j, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u j)) (hu01 : ∀ j x, 0 ≤ u j x ∧ u j x ≤ 1)
    (hD : ∀ j, IsOpen (D j)) (hΛ : ∀ j, ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (Λ j) (D j))
    (huD : ∀ j, tsupport (u j) ⊆ D j) (hΛΨ : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ D j, Circle.exp (Λ j x) = Ψ x)
    (hΛB : ∀ j x, |Λ j x| ≤ B) (hcov : ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ j, u j x = 1) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
        (fun x => ∑ j, u j x * (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - u l x)) * Λ j x) ∧
      ∀ (p : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target → ∀ X : E3,
        |∑ i : Fin 3, (dualOmega (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) p y i -
            partialDeriv i (fun z => ∑ j, u j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) *
              (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - u l ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) *
              Λ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) * X i| ≤
          ((N : ℝ) * B) * ∑ j, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (u j) (u j) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
            Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i k * X i * X k)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hdir : ∀ (φ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (X : E3), ∑ i : Fin 3, φ (e i) * X i = φ X := by
    intro φ X
    conv_rhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr X]
    simp [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  
  have hlift : ∀ (p : M) (ℓ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ℓ y →
      (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ((Ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) : ℂ)) = Complex.exp ((ℓ z : ℂ) * Complex.I)) →
      ∀ i : Fin 3, dualOmega (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) p y i = partialDeriv i ℓ y := by
    intro p ℓ y hℓ hev i
    have hre : (fun z => ((Ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) : ℂ)).re) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        fun z => Real.cos (ℓ z) :=
      hev.mono fun z hz => by simp only []; rw [hz, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re]
    have him : (fun z => ((Ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) : ℂ)).im) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        fun z => Real.sin (ℓ z) :=
      hev.mono fun z hz => by simp only []; rw [hz, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im]
    have hre0 : ((Ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℂ)).re = Real.cos (ℓ y) := hre.self_of_nhds
    have him0 : ((Ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℂ)).im = Real.sin (ℓ y) := him.self_of_nhds
    simp only [dualOmega, partialDeriv]
    rw [him.fderiv_eq, hre.fderiv_eq, (hℓ.hasFDerivAt.sin).fderiv, (hℓ.hasFDerivAt.cos).fderiv,
      hre0, him0]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination (fderiv ℝ ℓ y (e i)) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (ℓ y)
  
  have key : ∀ (U L : Fin N → E3 → ℝ) (om : Fin 3 → ℝ) (y X : E3),
      (∀ j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (U j) y) → (∀ j, 0 ≤ U j y ∧ U j y ≤ 1) →
      (∀ j, U j =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 ∨
        (DifferentiableAt ℝ (L j) y ∧ ∀ i, partialDeriv i (L j) y = om i)) →
      ((∃ l, U l y = 1) ∨ ∀ i, om i = 0) → (∀ j, |L j y| ≤ B) →
      |∑ i : Fin 3, (om i - partialDeriv i
          (fun z => ∑ j, U j z * (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l z)) * L j z) y) * X i| ≤
        ((N : ℝ) * B) * ∑ l, |∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (U l) y * X i| := by
    intro U L om y X hU hU01 hcase hom hLB
    have hP0 : ∀ s : Finset (Fin N), 0 ≤ ∏ l ∈ s, (1 - U l y) :=
      fun s => Finset.prod_nonneg (fun l _ => by linarith [(hU01 l).2])
    have hP1 : ∀ s : Finset (Fin N), ∏ l ∈ s, (1 - U l y) ≤ 1 :=
      fun s => Finset.prod_le_one (fun l _ => by linarith [(hU01 l).2])
        (fun l _ => by linarith [(hU01 l).1])
    have hP : ∀ j, HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l z))
        (∑ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (∏ l' ∈ (Finset.Iio j).erase l, (1 - U l' y)) •
          (-fderiv ℝ (U l) y)) y :=
      fun j => HasFDerivAt.finset_prod (fun l _ => (hU l).hasFDerivAt.const_sub 1)
    obtain ⟨W', hW'⟩ : ∃ W' : Fin N → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ∀ j,
        HasFDerivAt (fun z => U j z * ∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l z)) (W' j) y ∧
          |W' j X| ≤ ∑ l, |fderiv ℝ (U l) y X| := by
      refine ⟨fun j => U j y • (∑ l ∈ Finset.Iio j,
          (∏ l' ∈ (Finset.Iio j).erase l, (1 - U l' y)) • (-fderiv ℝ (U l) y)) +
          (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l y)) • fderiv ℝ (U j) y,
        fun j => ⟨(hU j).hasFDerivAt.mul (hP j), ?_⟩⟩
      have hval : (U j y • (∑ l ∈ Finset.Iio j,
          (∏ l' ∈ (Finset.Iio j).erase l, (1 - U l' y)) • (-fderiv ℝ (U l) y)) +
          (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l y)) • fderiv ℝ (U j) y) X =
          U j y * ∑ l ∈ Finset.Iio j,
            (∏ l' ∈ (Finset.Iio j).erase l, (1 - U l' y)) * -(fderiv ℝ (U l) y X) +
          (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l y)) * fderiv ℝ (U j) y X := by
        simp [smul_eq_mul]
      show |(U j y • (∑ l ∈ Finset.Iio j,
          (∏ l' ∈ (Finset.Iio j).erase l, (1 - U l' y)) • (-fderiv ℝ (U l) y)) +
          (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l y)) • fderiv ℝ (U j) y) X| ≤ _
      rw [hval]
      have t1 : |U j y * ∑ l ∈ Finset.Iio j,
          (∏ l' ∈ (Finset.Iio j).erase l, (1 - U l' y)) * -(fderiv ℝ (U l) y X)| ≤
          ∑ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, |fderiv ℝ (U l) y X| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hU01 j).1]
        refine (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) (hU01 j).2).trans ?_
        refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l _ => ?_))
        rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (hP0 _)]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) (hP1 _)
      have t2 : |(∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l y)) * fderiv ℝ (U j) y X| ≤
          |fderiv ℝ (U j) y X| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hP0 _)]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) (hP1 _)
      have t3 : ∑ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, |fderiv ℝ (U l) y X| + |fderiv ℝ (U j) y X| ≤
          ∑ l, |fderiv ℝ (U l) y X| := by
        rw [add_comm, ← Finset.sum_insert (f := fun l => |fderiv ℝ (U l) y X|)
          Finset.notMem_Iio_self]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
          (fun l _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
      exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith)
    have hS : ∀ j, ∃ S' : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
        HasFDerivAt (fun z => U j z * (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l z)) * L j z) S' y ∧
        S' X = L j y * W' j X +
          (U j y * ∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l y)) * ∑ i : Fin 3, om i * X i := by
      intro j
      rcases hcase j with h0 | ⟨hLd, hLom⟩
      · have hw0 : (fun z => U j z * ∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
            fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hz
          rw [hz, zero_mul]
        have hW0 : W' j = 0 :=
          (hW' j).1.unique ((hasFDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) y).congr_of_eventuallyEq hw0)
        have hUy : U j y = 0 := h0.self_of_nhds
        refine ⟨0, (hasFDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) y).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_, ?_⟩
        · filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hz
          rw [hz, zero_mul, zero_mul]
        · rw [hW0, hUy]
          simp
      · refine ⟨_, (hW' j).1.mul hLd.hasFDerivAt, ?_⟩
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        rw [← hdir (fderiv ℝ (L j) y) X]
        have hLe : ∀ i, fderiv ℝ (L j) y (e i) = om i := fun i => hLom i
        simp only [hLe]
        ring
    choose S' hS'd hS'X using hS
    have hF : HasFDerivAt
        (fun z => ∑ j, U j z * (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l z)) * L j z) (∑ j, S' j) y :=
      HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (fun j _ => hS'd j)
    have hFX : ∑ i : Fin 3, (om i - partialDeriv i
          (fun z => ∑ j, U j z * (∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l z)) * L j z) y) * X i =
        (∑ i : Fin 3, om i * X i) - (∑ j, S' j) X := by
      simp only [partialDeriv, hF.fderiv, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      rw [hdir]
    have htel : ∑ j, U j y * ∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - U l y) = 1 - ∏ l, (1 - U l y) := by
      rw [Finset.prod_one_sub_ordered]
      simp only [Finset.filter_gt_eq_Iio]
      ring
    have hPc : (∏ l, (1 - U l y)) * ∑ i : Fin 3, om i * X i = 0 := by
      rcases hom with ⟨l, hl⟩ | h0
      · rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ l) (by rw [hl]; ring), zero_mul]
      · simp [h0]
    rw [hFX, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    simp only [hS'X]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, htel]
    have heq : ∑ i : Fin 3, om i * X i - (∑ j, L j y * W' j X +
        (1 - ∏ l, (1 - U l y)) * ∑ i : Fin 3, om i * X i) = -(∑ j, L j y * W' j X) := by
      linear_combination hPc
    rw [heq, abs_neg]
    calc |∑ j, L j y * W' j X| ≤ ∑ j, |L j y| * |W' j X| :=
          (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
            (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => abs_mul _ _))
      _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin N, B * ∑ l, |∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (U l) y * X i| := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
          have hB : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hLB j)
          refine mul_le_mul (hLB j) ?_ (abs_nonneg _) hB
          refine ((hW' j).2).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
          rw [← hdir (fderiv ℝ (U l) y) X]
          rfl
      _ = ((N : ℝ) * B) * ∑ l, |∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (U l) y * X i| := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro x
    refine contMDiffAt_finset_sum (fun j _ => ?_)
    have hw : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞
        (fun x => u j x * ∏ l ∈ Finset.Iio j, (1 - u l x)) x :=
      (hu j).contMDiffAt.mul
        (contMDiffAt_finset_prod (fun l _ => contMDiffAt_const.sub (hu l).contMDiffAt))
    by_cases hx : x ∈ D j
    · exact hw.mul ((hΛ j).contMDiffAt ((hD j).mem_nhds hx))
    · have h0 : u j =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h => hx (huD j h))
      refine (contMDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
      simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hz
      rw [hz, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  · intro p y hy X
    have hNB : 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) * B := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with h | h
      · simp [h]
      · exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans (hΛB ⟨0, h⟩ p))
    have hUd : ∀ j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => u j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y := fun j =>
      ((chart_pullback_gradInner g (u j) (hu j) p).1.contDiffAt
        ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hcase : ∀ j, (fun z => u j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 ∨
        (DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Λ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y ∧
          ∀ i, partialDeriv i (fun z => Λ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y =
            dualOmega (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) p y i) := by
      intro j
      by_cases hx : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ tsupport (u j)
      · right
        have hxD : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ D j := huD j hx
        have hVo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D j) :=
          (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (hD j)
        have hyV : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D j := ⟨hy, hxD⟩
        have hsm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (Λ j ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
            ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D j) :=
          (hΛ j).comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun z hz => hz.2)
        have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Λ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y :=
          ((contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hsm).contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds hyV)).differentiableAt
            (by simp)
        refine ⟨hdiff, fun i => (hlift p _ y hdiff ?_ i).symm⟩
        filter_upwards [hVo.mem_nhds hyV] with z hz
        rw [← hΛΨ j _ hz.2, Circle.coe_exp]
      · left
        have h0 : u j =ᶠ[𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hx
        exact Filter.Tendsto.eventually ((chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm hy) h0
    have hom : (∃ l, u l ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = 1) ∨
        ∀ i, dualOmega (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) p y i = 0 := by
      by_cases hxK : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ K
      · exact Or.inl (hcov _ hxK)
      · right
        intro i
        have hev : (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Kᶜ ∈ 𝓝 y :=
          ((chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm hy).preimage_mem_nhds (hK.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxK)
        have hev2 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ((Ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) : ℂ)) =
            Complex.exp ((((fun _ : E3 => (0 : ℝ)) z : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) := by
          filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
          rw [hΨK _ hz]
          simp
        rw [hlift p (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) y (differentiableAt_const 0) hev2 i]
        simp [partialDeriv]
    have c4 : ∀ l, |∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => u l ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y * X i| ≤
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (u l) (u l) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i k * X i * X k) := by
      intro l
      have hA := coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y hy
      have hcs := smth_quad_cauchySchwarz _ hA (fun i => X i)
        (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun z => u l ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y)
      have hS := (chart_pullback_gradInner g (u l) (hu l) p).2.1 y hy
      have hQ : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i k * X i * X k := by
        have h := hA.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (fun i => X i)
        simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum] at h
        refine h.trans_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl
          (fun k _ => by ring)))
      rw [← Real.sqrt_mul' _ hQ]
      apply Real.abs_le_sqrt
      have h1 : (∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => u l ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y * X i) =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, X i * partialDeriv i (fun z => u l ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => mul_comm _ _)
      rw [h1, hS, mul_comm]
      exact hcs
    have hkey := key (fun j z => u j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
      (fun j z => Λ j ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
      (fun i => dualOmega (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) p y i) y X hUd (fun j => hu01 j _) hcase hom
      (fun j => hΛB j _)
    refine hkey.trans ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hNB
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l _ => c4 l)

subgoal_signatures.name: chart_pullback_gradInner
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (p : M) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
      (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) (chartAt E3 p).target

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef)
    (X ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, X i * ξ i) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * X i * X j) *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j)

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Ψc : M → ℂ) (Ω Kc L : Set M) (hKc : IsClosed Kc)
    (hL : IsClosed L) (hLKc : Disjoint L Kc)
    (φ₀ : M → ℝ) (φ : ℕ → M → ℝ) (B B' C : ℝ) (hB' : 0 ≤ B')
    (hφs : ∀ m, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (φ m))
    (hφL : ∀ m x, x ∉ L → φ m x = 0)
    (hφB : ∀ m x, |φ m x| ≤ B)
    (hlim : ∀ x, Tendsto (fun m => φ m x) atTop (𝓝 (φ₀ x)))
    {N : ℕ} (u : ℕ → Fin N → M → ℝ)

      |∑ i : Fin 3, (dualOmega Ψc p y i -

      ∑ k, ∫ y in T k, Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y).det *
          Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (u m j) (u m j) ((chartAt E3 (pp k)).symm y)) ≤ C) :
    dualRiemVar g Ψc φ₀ Ω Kc < ⊤

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  suffices hle : dualRiemVar g Ψc φ₀ Ω Kc ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (B' * (N : ℝ) * C) from
    lt_of_le_of_lt hle ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  unfold dualRiemVar
  refine iSup_le fun n => iSup_le fun p => iSup_le fun W => iSup_le fun hcond => ?_
  have hUo : ∀ k, IsOpen (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k) := fun k =>
    (chartAt E3 (p k)).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hcond.1 k).1
      ((hcond.1 k).2.trans Set.inter_subset_right)
  have hUt : ∀ k, chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := by
    rintro k _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 (p k)).map_source ((hcond.1 k).2 hx).2
  have hS5 := fun k => chart_indicator_limit_props (p k) φ₀ φ B
    (fun m => (hφs m).continuous) hφB hlim
  
  have hloc : ∀ k, MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrableOn
      (fun y => φ₀ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k) :=
    fun k => (hS5 k).2.2.2 _ (hUo k) (hUt k)
  have h1 : ∀ k, IsOpen (W k) ∧ W k ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source := fun k =>
    ⟨(hcond.1 k).1, (hcond.1 k).2.trans Set.inter_subset_right⟩
  
  refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_)
    (ennreal_sum_iSup_le_of_choice
      (fun k (X : E3 → E3) =>
        (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) →
          ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
        tsupport X ⊆ chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ∧
        (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y| ≤ C)
      ?_
      (fun k (X : E3 → E3) => ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y,
        (φ₀ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y) * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y +
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det *
            ∑ i : Fin 3, dualOmega Ψc (p k) y i * X y i)))
      (ENNReal.ofReal (B' * (N : ℝ) * C)) ?_)
  · 
    unfold dualVarG
    rw [iSup_neg (not_not.2 (hloc k)), bot_sup_eq]
  · 
    intro k
    refine ⟨0, fun _ _ => contDiffAt_const, HasCompactSupport.zero, ?_, fun y => by simp, 0,
      fun y => ?_⟩
    · simp [tsupport_zero]
    · rw [(sepDensDiv_support_integrable _ _).1 y (by simp [tsupport_zero])]
      simp
  · intro X hX
    have hXt : ∀ k, tsupport (X k) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := fun k =>
      (hX k).2.2.1.trans (hUt k)
    obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : Fin n → ℕ → ℝ, ∀ k m, J k m = ∫ y,
        (φ m ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y) * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (X k) y +
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det *
            ∑ i : Fin 3, dualOmega Ψc (p k) y i * X k y i) := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ : ∃ I : Fin n → ℝ, ∀ k, I k = ∫ y,
        (φ₀ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y) * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (X k) y +
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det *
            ∑ i : Fin 3, dualOmega Ψc (p k) y i * X k y i) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    
    have hIBP : ∀ k m, J k m = ∫ y, Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det *
        ∑ i : Fin 3, (dualOmega Ψc (p k) y i -
          partialDeriv i (fun z => φ m ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm z)) y) * X k y i := by
      intro k m
      have hXs : ∀ y, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (X k) y ∨
          (fun z => φ m ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := by
        intro y
        by_cases hy : y ∈ chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)
        · right
          obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxK, hxs⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
          have hxL : x ∈ Lᶜ := fun hxL => Set.disjoint_left.1 hLKc hxL hxK
          have hyt : chartAt E3 (p k) x ∈ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target :=
            (chartAt E3 (p k)).map_source hxs
          have hmem : (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm ⁻¹' Lᶜ ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 (p k) x) := by
            apply ((chartAt E3 (p k)).continuousAt_symm hyt).preimage_mem_nhds
            rw [(chartAt E3 (p k)).left_inv hxs]
            exact hL.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxL
          filter_upwards [hmem] with z hz
          exact hφL m _ hz
        · left
          exact (hX k).1 y hy
      rw [hJ]
      refine (sepDensDiv_ibp_of_vanishing (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm)
        (chartAt E3 (p k)).target (chartAt E3 (p k)).open_target (g.smooth (p k))
        (fun y hy => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g (p k) y hy).det_pos)
        (fun z => φ m ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm z))
        (chart_pullback_gradInner g (φ m) (hφs m) (p k)).1 (X k) (hX k).2.1 (hXt k) hXs
        (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det *
            ∑ i : Fin 3, dualOmega Ψc (p k) y i * X k y i)).trans ?_
      refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      ring
    
    have hJk : ∀ m k, |J k m| ≤ B' * ∑ j, ∫ y in tsupport (X k),
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det *
          Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (u m j) (u m j) ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) := by

    refine Finset.induction_on S ?_ ?_
    · intro _ t φ
      simp
    · intro a S ha ih hS t φ
      have haR : a ∈ R := hS (Finset.mem_insert_self a S)
      have hSR : S ⊆ R := fun x hx => hS (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hx)
      have h1 : (fun x => φ x + ∑ k ∈ insert a S, t k * (P k).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) =
          (fun x => (fun x => φ x + ∑ k ∈ S, t k * (P k).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) x +
            t a * (P a).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) := by
        funext x
        rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
        ring
      rw [h1, hfree a haR, ih hSR]
  
  obtain ⟨ms, hms⟩ : ∃ ms : ℕ → M → ℤ, ∀ i x,
      ms i x = ns (ψ i) x - ∑ k ∈ R, (P k).indicator (fun _ => m k i) x := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  
  have hPK : ∀ k ∈ R, P k ⊆ Kv := fun k hk => (hRP k hk).2.2.1
  have hmsK : ∀ i, ∀ x : M, x ∉ Kv → ms i x = 0 := by
    intro i x hx
    rw [hms, hnsK (ψ i) x hx, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    · simp
    · intro k hk
      rw [Set.indicator_apply, if_neg (fun h => hx (hPK k hk h))]
  
  have hmsE : ∀ i, dualRiemVar g (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ))
      (fun x => φ₀ x + 2 * Real.pi * (ms i x : ℝ)) Ω Kc ≤
      dualRiemVar g (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ))
        (fun x => φ₀ x + 2 * Real.pi * (ns (ψ i) x : ℝ)) Ω Kc := by
    intro i
    have hfun : (fun x => φ₀ x + 2 * Real.pi * (ms i x : ℝ)) =
        (fun x => (fun x => φ₀ x + 2 * Real.pi * (ns (ψ i) x : ℝ)) x +
          ∑ k ∈ R, (fun k => -(2 * Real.pi * (m k i : ℝ))) k *
            (P k).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) := by
      funext x
      have hterm : ∀ k, (((P k).indicator (fun _ => m k i) x : ℤ) : ℝ) =
          (m k i : ℝ) * (P k).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x := by
        intro k
        by_cases hx : x ∈ P k <;> simp [Set.indicator, hx]
      rw [hms, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => hterm k)]
      have h2 : ∑ k ∈ R, (fun k => -(2 * Real.pi * (m k i : ℝ))) k *
            (P k).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x =
          -(2 * Real.pi * ∑ k ∈ R, (m k i : ℝ) * (P k).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) x) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by ring)
      rw [h2]
      ring
    rw [hfun, hind R (subset_refl R) (fun k => -(2 * Real.pi * (m k i : ℝ)))
      (fun x => φ₀ x + 2 * Real.pi * (ns (ψ i) x : ℝ))]
  
  have himg : ∀ (p : M) (S : Set M), chartAt E3 p '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =
      (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' S := by
    intro p S
    rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact (chartAt E3 p).image_source_inter_eq' S
  have hmeasIff : ∀ S : Set M, sepChartMeas S ↔
      ∀ p : M, MeasurableSet ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' S) := by
    intro S
    simp only [sepChartMeas, himg]
  have hMU : ∀ {ι : Type} [Countable ι] (S : ι → Set M), (∀ i, sepChartMeas (S i)) →
      sepChartMeas (⋃ i, S i) := by
    intro ι _ S hS
    rw [hmeasIff]
    intro p
    rw [Set.preimage_iUnion, Set.inter_iUnion]
    exact MeasurableSet.iUnion fun i => (hmeasIff _).1 (hS i) p
  have hMC : ∀ S : Set M, sepChartMeas S → sepChartMeas Sᶜ := by
    intro S hS
    rw [hmeasIff]
    intro p
    have h1 : (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Sᶜ =
        (chartAt E3 p).target \ ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' S) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_diff]
      tauto
    rw [h1]
    exact (chartAt E3 p).open_target.measurableSet.diff ((hmeasIff S).1 hS p)
  have hMuniv : sepChartMeas (Set.univ : Set M) := by
    rw [hmeasIff]
    intro p
    simpa only [Set.preimage_univ, Set.inter_univ] using (chartAt E3 p).open_target.measurableSet
  have hMunion : ∀ S T : Set M, sepChartMeas S → sepChartMeas T → sepChartMeas (S ∪ T) := by
    intro S T hS hT
    rw [hmeasIff]
    intro p
    rw [Set.preimage_union, Set.inter_union_distrib_left]
    exact ((hmeasIff S).1 hS p).union ((hmeasIff T).1 hT p)
  have hMinter : ∀ S T : Set M, sepChartMeas S → sepChartMeas T → sepChartMeas (S ∩ T) := by
    intro S T hS hT
    have h1 : S ∩ T = (Sᶜ ∪ Tᶜ)ᶜ := by
      rw [Set.compl_union, compl_compl, compl_compl]
    rw [h1]
    exact hMC _ (hMunion _ _ (hMC _ hS) (hMC _ hT))
  have hconst : ∀ q : Prop, sepChartMeas {_x : M | q} := by
    intro q
    by_cases hq : q
    · have h1 : {_x : M | q} = Set.univ := by
        ext x
        simp [hq]
      rw [h1]
      exact hMuniv
    · have h1 : {_x : M | q} = (Set.univ : Set M)ᶜ := by
        ext x
        simp [hq]
      rw [h1]
      exact hMC _ hMuniv
  have hopenM : ∀ U : Set M, IsOpen U → sepChartMeas U := by
    intro U hU p
    rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_source_inter hU).measurableSet
  have hindM : ∀ i, ∀ k ∈ R, ∀ c : ℤ,
      sepChartMeas {x : M | (P k).indicator (fun _ => m k i) x = c} := by
    intro i k hk c
    have h1 : {x : M | (P k).indicator (fun _ => m k i) x = c} =
        (P k ∩ {_x : M | m k i = c}) ∪ ((P k)ᶜ ∩ {_x : M | (0 : ℤ) = c}) := by
      ext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ P k <;> simp [Set.indicator, hx]
    rw [h1]
    exact hMunion _ _ (hMinter _ _ (hopenM _ (hRP k hk).1) (hconst _))
      (hMinter _ _ (hMC _ (hopenM _ (hRP k hk).1)) (hconst _))
  have hsumM : ∀ i, ∀ S : Finset (Fin N), S ⊆ R → ∀ b : ℤ,
      sepChartMeas {x : M | ∑ k ∈ S, (P k).indicator (fun _ => m k i) x = b} := by
    intro i S
    refine Finset.induction_on S ?_ ?_
    · intro _ b
      simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
      exact hconst _
    · intro a S ha ih hS b
      have haR : a ∈ R := hS (Finset.mem_insert_self a S)
      have hSR : S ⊆ R := fun x hx => hS (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hx)
      have h1 : {x : M | ∑ k ∈ insert a S, (P k).indicator (fun _ => m k i) x = b} =
          ⋃ c : ℤ, ({x : M | (P a).indicator (fun _ => m a i) x = c} ∩
            {x : M | ∑ k ∈ S, (P k).indicator (fun _ => m k i) x = b - c}) := by
        ext x
        simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_inter_iff, Finset.sum_insert ha]
        constructor
        · intro h
          exact ⟨_, rfl, by omega⟩
        · rintro ⟨c, h1, h2⟩
          omega
      rw [h1]
      exact hMU _ fun c => hMinter _ _ (hindM i a haR c) (ih hSR (b - c))
  have hmsM : ∀ i (j : ℤ), sepChartMeas {x | ms i x = j} := by
    intro i j
    have h1 : {x | ms i x = j} = ⋃ a : ℤ, ({x : M | ns (ψ i) x = a} ∩
        {x : M | ∑ k ∈ R, (P k).indicator (fun _ => m k i) x = a - j}) := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_inter_iff, hms]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨_, rfl, by omega⟩
      · rintro ⟨a, h1, h2⟩
        omega
    rw [h1]
    exact hMU _ fun a => hMinter _ _ (hns (ψ i) a) (hsumM i R (subset_refl R) (a - j))
  
  have hbadZ : {x | ¬ ∃ j : ℤ, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, ms i x = j} ⊆ Z := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxZ
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hlast x hxZ
    exact hx ⟨j, hj.mono fun i hi => by rw [hms]; exact hi⟩
  have hbad : sepChartNull {x | ¬ ∃ j : ℤ, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, ms i x = j} := by
    intro p
    exact measure_mono_null (Set.image_mono (Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hbadZ)) (hZ p)
  
  exact ⟨ψ, ms, hψ, hmsK, hmsM, hmsE, hbad⟩

    (Ns : ℕ → X → ℤ) (hNs : ∀ i, ∀ x, x ∉ Kv → Ns i x = 0) (m : Fin N → ℕ → ℤ)
    (htame : ∀ k, (∃ c : ℤ, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, m k i = c) ∨
      Filter.Tendsto (fun i => |m k i|) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    (hloc : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ H k, x ∉ Z → ∃ j : ℤ, ∀ᶠ i in Filter.atTop, Ns i x - m k i = j) :
    ∃ (R : Finset (Fin N)) (P : Fin N → Set X),

        Filter.Tendsto (fun i => |m k i|) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop ∧

        Ns i x - ∑ k ∈ R, (P k).indicator (fun _ => m k i) x = j

by
  classical
  intro p C hC hCU
  set κ := chartAt E3 p with hκ
  
  have hUo : IsOpen (κ '' (Ω ∩ κ.source)) := by
    rw [Set.inter_comm]; exact κ.isOpen_image_source_inter hΩ
  have hUt : κ '' (Ω ∩ κ.source) ⊆ κ.target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact κ.map_source hx.2
  
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : ℕ → E3 → ENNReal, ∀ i y, f i y =
      ENNReal.ofReal |((ns i (κ.symm y) : ℝ)) - (n (κ.symm y) : ℝ)| := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  
  have hred : ∀ i, (∫⁻ y in C, ENNReal.ofReal |(φ₀ (κ.symm y) +
        2 * Real.pi * (ns i (κ.symm y) : ℝ)) -
        (φ₀ (κ.symm y) + 2 * Real.pi * (n (κ.symm y) : ℝ))|) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ∫⁻ y in C, f i y := by
    intro i
    rw [← lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
    refine lintegral_congr (fun y => ?_)
    rw [hf]
    have e1 : (φ₀ (κ.symm y) + 2 * Real.pi * (ns i (κ.symm y) : ℝ)) -
        (φ₀ (κ.symm y) + 2 * Real.pi * (n (κ.symm y) : ℝ)) =
        (2 * Real.pi) * ((ns i (κ.symm y) : ℝ) - (n (κ.symm y) : ℝ)) := by ring
    rw [e1, abs_mul, abs_of_pos Real.two_pi_pos, ENNReal.ofReal_mul Real.two_pi_pos.le]
  suffices hFC : Tendsto (fun i => ∫⁻ y in C, f i y) atTop (𝓝 0) by
    have h := ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul hFC
      (Or.inr (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (r := 2 * Real.pi)))
    rw [mul_zero] at h
    exact h.congr (fun i => (hred i).symm)
  
  have hmeasHat : ∀ m : M → ℤ, (∀ j : ℤ, sepChartMeas {x | m x = j}) →
      Measurable (κ.target.indicator (fun y => (m (κ.symm y) : ℝ))) := by
    intro m hm
    have hf' : Measurable (κ.target.indicator (fun y => m (κ.symm y))) := by
      apply measurable_to_countable'
      intro j
      have h1 : κ.target.indicator (fun y => m (κ.symm y)) ⁻¹' {j} =
          (κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' {x | m x = j}) ∪
            (κ.targetᶜ ∩ {_y : E3 | (0 : ℤ) = j}) := by
        ext y
        by_cases hy : y ∈ κ.target <;> simp [Set.indicator, hy]
      have hmj : MeasurableSet (κ.target ∩ κ.symm ⁻¹' {x | m x = j}) := by
        rw [← κ.image_source_inter_eq', Set.inter_comm]; exact hm j p
      rw [h1]
      exact hmj.union (κ.open_target.measurableSet.compl.inter (MeasurableSet.const _))
    have hcast : Measurable (fun z : ℤ => (z : ℝ)) := measurable_of_countable _
    have h2 := hcast.comp hf'
    convert h2 using 1
    funext y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ κ.target <;> simp [Set.indicator, hy]
  
  obtain ⟨û, hû⟩ : ∃ û : ℕ → E3 → ℝ, ∀ i y, û i y =
      κ.target.indicator (fun y => (ns i (κ.symm y) : ℝ)) y := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ŵ, hŵ⟩ : ∃ ŵ : E3 → ℝ, ∀ y, ŵ y =
      κ.target.indicator (fun y => (n (κ.symm y) : ℝ)) y := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hu : ∀ i, Measurable (û i) := by
    intro i
    have e : û i = κ.target.indicator (fun y => (ns i (κ.symm y) : ℝ)) := funext (hû i)
    rw [e]; exact hmeasHat (ns i) (hns i)
  have hEi : ∀ i, dualRiemVar g (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ))
      (fun x => φ₀ x + 2 * Real.pi * (ns i x : ℝ)) Ω Kc < ⊤ :=
    fun i => lt_of_le_of_lt (hbd i) hB
  
  have hrad : ∀ z ∈ κ '' (Ω ∩ κ.source), ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
      Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ κ '' (Ω ∩ κ.source) := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hUo z hz
    exact ⟨ε / 2, by linarith, (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball⟩
  choose! Rf hRpos hRsub using hrad
  
  have hball : ∀ z ∈ C, Tendsto (fun i => ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball z (Rf z / 12), f i y)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro z hzC
    have hzU := hCU hzC
    have hR := hRpos z hzU
    have hRs := hRsub z hzU
    have hRt : Metric.closedBall z (Rf z) ⊆ κ.target := hRs.trans hUt
    have hballt : Metric.ball z (Rf z) ⊆ κ.target := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hRt
    obtain ⟨A, hA0, hAn⟩ := dual_chart_tv_bound g Ψ hΨs Ω Kc hΩ φ₀ hfin₀ p z (Rf z) hR hRs
    obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ : ∃ Λ : ℝ, Λ = A * (B.toReal +
        (dualRiemVar g (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) φ₀ Ω Kc).toReal) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hTVi : ∀ i, ∀ Y : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y → HasCompactSupport Y →
        tsupport Y ⊆ Metric.ball z (Rf z) → (∀ y, ‖Y y‖ ≤ 1) →
        ∫ y, û i y * ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w => Y w k) y ≤ Λ := by
      intro i Y hY hYc hYs hY1
      have heq : (fun y => û i y * ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w => Y w k) y) =
          (fun y => (ns i (κ.symm y) : ℝ) * ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w => Y w k) y) := by
        funext y
        by_cases hy : y ∈ κ.target
        · rw [hû, Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
        · have hyY : y ∉ tsupport Y := fun h => hy (hballt (hYs h))
          have hev := (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq).1 hyY
          have hdiv : ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w => Y w k) y = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro k _
            have hevk : (fun w => Y w k) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
              hev.mono (fun w hw => by simp [hw])
            unfold partialDeriv
            rw [hevk.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_apply]
            simp
          rw [hdiv, mul_zero, mul_zero]
      rw [heq]
      refine ((hAn (ns i) (hEi i)).2 Y hY hYc hYs hY1).trans ?_
      rw [hΛ]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hA0
      have := ENNReal.toReal_mono hB.ne (hbd i)
      linarith
    have hint3 : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (û i) (Metric.ball z (Rf z)) := by
      intro i
      have h1 := ((hAn (ns i) (hEi i)).1).mono_set Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
      refine h1.congr_fun (fun y hy => ?_) measurableSet_ball
      rw [hû, Set.indicator_of_mem (hballt hy)]
    have h3r : 3 * (Rf z / 3) = Rf z := by ring
    have hmod : ∀ (i : ℕ) (h : E3), ‖h‖ ≤ Rf z / 3 →
        ∫⁻ x in Metric.ball z (Rf z / 3), ENNReal.ofReal |û i (x + h) - û i x| ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * Λ) * ‖h‖) := by
      intro i h hh
      have h1 : ∫⁻ x in Metric.ball z (Rf z / 3), ENNReal.ofReal |û i (x + h) - û i x| ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ‖h‖ * Λ) := by
        first
          | exact int_translate_le (M := M) (û i) z (Rf z / 3) Λ (by linarith)
              (by rw [h3r]; exact hint3 i) (by rw [h3r]; exact hTVi i) h hh
          | exact int_translate_le (û i) z (Rf z / 3) Λ (by linarith)
              (by rw [h3r]; exact hint3 i) (by rw [h3r]; exact hTVi i) h hh
      calc _ ≤ _ := h1
        _ = _ := by congr 1; ring
    have hN : volume (κ '' (Z ∩ κ.source)) = 0 := hZ p
    have hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Metric.ball z (Rf z / 3))),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun i => û i x) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (ŵ x)) := by
      rw [ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_ball]
      filter_upwards [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.1 hN] with y hyN hyB
      have hyt : y ∈ κ.target := hballt (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hyB)
      have hxs : κ.symm y ∈ κ.source := κ.map_target hyt
      have hxZ : κ.symm y ∉ Z := fun h => hyN ⟨κ.symm y, ⟨h, hxs⟩, κ.right_inv hyt⟩
      have hev := hconv _ hxZ
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [hev] with i hi
      rw [hû, hŵ, Set.indicator_of_mem hyt, Set.indicator_of_mem hyt, hi]
    have hL1 : Tendsto (fun i => ∫⁻ x in Metric.ball z (Rf z / 3 / 4),
        ENNReal.ofReal |û i x - ŵ x|) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      first
        | exact ae_tendsto_L1_of_translate (M := M) û ŵ z (Rf z / 3) (2 * Λ) (by linarith) hu
            (fun i => (hint3 i).mono_set (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))) hmod hae
        | exact ae_tendsto_L1_of_translate û ŵ z (Rf z / 3) (2 * Λ) (by linarith) hu
            (fun i => (hint3 i).mono_set (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith))) hmod hae
    have h12 : Rf z / 3 / 4 = Rf z / 12 := by ring
    rw [h12] at hL1
    refine hL1.congr (fun i => ?_)
    apply setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_ball
    intro y hy
    have hyt : y ∈ κ.target := hballt (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hy)
    simp only [hû, hŵ, hf, Set.indicator_of_mem hyt]
  
  obtain ⟨t, htC, hcov⟩ := hC.elim_nhds_subcover (fun z => Metric.ball z (Rf z / 12))
    (fun z hz => Metric.ball_mem_nhds z (by have := hRpos z (hCU hz); linarith))
  have hunion : ∀ (s : Finset E3) (i : ℕ),
      ∫⁻ y in (⋃ z ∈ s, Metric.ball z (Rf z / 12)), f i y ≤
        ∑ z ∈ s, ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball z (Rf z / 12), f i y := by
    intro s i
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert, Finset.sum_insert ha]
      exact (lintegral_union_le _ _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl ih)
  
  have hsum : Tendsto (fun i => ∑ z ∈ t, ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball z (Rf z / 12), f i y)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := tendsto_finset_sum t (fun z hz => hball z (htC z hz))
    simpa using h
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hsum
    (fun i => zero_le _) (fun i => ?_)
  exact (lintegral_mono_set hcov).trans (hunion t i)

subgoal_signatures.name: dual_chart_tv_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Ψ : C(M, Circle)) (hΨs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) ∞ (fun x : M => (Ψ x : ℂ)))
    (Ω Kc : Set M) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (φ₀ : M → ℝ)
    (hfin₀ : dualRiemVar g (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) φ₀ Ω Kc < ⊤)
    (p : M) (z : E3) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hB : Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ chartAt E3 p '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ n : M → ℤ,
      dualRiemVar g (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) (fun x => φ₀ x + 2 * Real.pi * (n x : ℝ)) Ω Kc < ⊤ →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => (n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ))
        (Metric.closedBall z R) ∧
      ∀ Y : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y → HasCompactSupport Y → tsupport Y ⊆ Metric.ball z R →
        (∀ y, ‖Y y‖ ≤ 1) →
        ∫ y, (n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => Y w i) y ≤
          A * ((dualRiemVar g (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ))
                (fun x => φ₀ x + 2 * Real.pi * (n x : ℝ)) Ω Kc).toReal +
            (dualRiemVar g (fun x => (Ψ x : ℂ)) φ₀ Ω Kc).toReal)

subgoal_signatures.name: int_translate_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(u : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (r Λ : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hu : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn u (Metric.ball y (3 * r)))
    (hTV : ∀ Y : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y → HasCompactSupport Y →
      tsupport Y ⊆ Metric.ball y (3 * r) → (∀ z, ‖Y z‖ ≤ 1) →
      ∫ z, u z * ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => Y w i) z ≤ Λ)
    (h : E3) (hh : ‖h‖ ≤ r) :
    ∫⁻ x in Metric.ball y r, ENNReal.ofReal |u (x + h) - u x| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ‖h‖ * Λ)

subgoal_signatures.name: ae_tendsto_L1_of_translate
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(u : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (r C : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hu : ∀ i, Measurable (u i))
    (hint : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (u i) (Metric.ball y (2 * r)))
    (hmod : ∀ (i : ℕ) (h : E3), ‖h‖ ≤ r →
      ∫⁻ x in Metric.ball y r, ENNReal.ofReal |u i (x + h) - u i x| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ‖h‖))
    (hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Metric.ball y r)),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun i => u i x) Filter.atTop (𝓝 (w x))) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ∫⁻ x in Metric.ball y (r / 4), ENNReal.ofReal |u i x - w x|)
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)

by
  classical
  
  have s2 : ∀ {ι : Type} {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → ι → ENNReal) (c : ENNReal),
      (∀ x : Fin n → ι, ∑ k, f k (x k) ≤ c) → ∑ k, ⨆ i, f k i ≤ c := by
    intro ι n f c h
    have h1 : ∀ k, (⨆ i, f k i) = ⨆ x : Fin n → ι, f k (x k) := by
      intro k
      apply le_antisymm
      · exact iSup_le fun i => le_iSup_of_le (fun _ => i) le_rfl
      · exact iSup_le fun x => le_iSup _ (x k)
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => h1 k), ENNReal.finsetSum_iSup]
    · exact iSup_le h
    · intro x y
      refine ⟨fun a => if f a (x a) ≤ f a (y a) then y a else x a, fun a => ?_⟩
      by_cases hxy : f a (x a) ≤ f a (y a)
      · dsimp only; rw [if_pos hxy]; exact ⟨hxy, le_rfl⟩
      · dsimp only; rw [if_neg hxy]; exact ⟨le_rfl, (le_total _ _).resolve_left hxy⟩
  
  have s3 : ∀ (V : Set E3), IsOpen V → ∀ (u : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ n, LocallyIntegrableOn (u n) V) →
      (∀ K : Set E3, IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → AEStronglyMeasurable w (volume.restrict K)) →
      (∀ K : Set E3, IsCompact K → K ⊆ V →
        Tendsto (fun n => ∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal |u n y - w y|) atTop (𝓝 0)) →
      LocallyIntegrableOn w V := by
    intro V hV u w hu hw hcv
    rw [locallyIntegrableOn_iff hV.isLocallyClosed]
    intro K hKV hK
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ((hcv K hK hKV).eventually (gt_mem_nhds zero_lt_one)).exists
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (u n) K := (hu n).integrableOn_compact_subset hKV hK
    have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => u n y - w y) K := by
      refine ⟨h1.aestronglyMeasurable.sub (hw K hK hKV), ?_⟩
      rw [HasFiniteIntegral]
      simp_rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs]
      exact lt_trans hn ENNReal.one_lt_top
    have h3 : IntegrableOn (fun y => u n y - (u n y - w y)) K := Integrable.sub h1 h2
    exact h3.congr_fun (fun y _ => sub_sub_cancel _ _) hK.measurableSet
  
  have s4 : ∀ (D T : E3 → ℝ) (K : Set E3) (C : ℝ), MeasurableSet K → Measurable D →
      (∀ y, |D y| ≤ C) → (∀ y, y ∉ K → D y = 0) → ∀ (u : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ n, IntegrableOn (u n) K) → IntegrableOn w K →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal |u n y - w y|) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y, (u n y * D y + T y)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, (w y * D y + T y))) := by
    intro D T K C hKm hDm hC hD0 u w hu hw hcv
    have hprod : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, IntegrableOn f K → Integrable (fun y => f y * D y) := by
      intro f hf
      have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => f y * D y) K :=
        Integrable.mul_bdd hf hDm.aestronglyMeasurable (Eventually.of_forall fun y => by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hC y)
      exact h1.integrable_of_forall_notMem_eq_zero fun y hy => by simp [hD0 y hy]
    by_cases hTi : Integrable T
    · rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
      have hbound : ∀ n, ‖(∫ y, (u n y * D y + T y)) - ∫ y, (w y * D y + T y)‖ ≤
          C * (∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal |u n y - w y|).toReal := by
        intro n
        have hdiff : IntegrableOn (fun y => u n y - w y) K := Integrable.sub (hu n) hw
        have habs : IntegrableOn (fun y => C * |u n y - w y|) K :=
          Integrable.const_mul (Integrable.abs hdiff) C
        have hgi : Integrable (K.indicator fun y => C * |u n y - w y|) :=
          habs.integrable_indicator hKm
        have heq : (∫ y, (u n y * D y + T y)) - ∫ y, (w y * D y + T y) =
            ∫ y, (u n y - w y) * D y := by
          rw [integral_add (hprod _ (hu n)) hTi, integral_add (hprod _ hw) hTi,
            add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, ← integral_sub (hprod _ (hu n)) (hprod _ hw)]
          congr 1
          funext y
          ring

              refine norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hgi (Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
              by_cases hy : y ∈ K
              · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                  mul_comm]
                exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC y) (abs_nonneg _)
              · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, hD0 y hy]
                simp
          _ = C * ∫ y in K, |u n y - w y| := by
              rw [integral_indicator hKm, integral_const_mul]
          _ = C * (∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal |u n y - w y|).toReal := by
              rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ fun y => abs_nonneg _)
                (Integrable.abs hdiff).aestronglyMeasurable]
      have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => C * (∫⁻ y in K, ENNReal.ofReal |u n y - w y|).toReal)

        have := ((ENNReal.tendsto_toReal ENNReal.zero_ne_top).comp hcv).const_mul C

    · have hz : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, IntegrableOn f K → ∫ y, (f y * D y + T y) = 0 := by
        intro f hf
        apply integral_undef
        intro hi
        apply hTi
        have := hi.sub (hprod f hf)
        convert this using 1
        funext y
        simp
      have hfun : (fun n => ∫ y, (u n y * D y + T y)) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        funext fun n => hz _ (hu n)
      rw [hfun, hz _ hw]
      exact tendsto_const_nhds
  
  have hDmeas : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X : E3 → E3),
      Measurable (sepDensDiv G X) := by
    intro G X
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    exact Finset.measurable_sum _ fun i _ => measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ _ _
  have hD0 : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (y : E3),
      y ∉ tsupport X → sepDensDiv G X y = 0 := by
    intro G X y hy
    have hev : X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hy
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    have h2 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
      simp [hz]
    rw [h2.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  rcases eq_or_ne c ⊤ with hc | hc
  · rw [hc]; exact le_top
  have hfin : ∀ i, dualRiemVar g Ψ (φs i) Ω Kc < ⊤ := fun i =>
    lt_of_le_of_lt (hle i) (ENNReal.add_lt_top.2 ⟨lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 hc, ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top⟩)
  
  unfold dualRiemVar
  refine iSup_le fun n => iSup_le fun p => iSup_le fun W => iSup_le fun hfam => ?_
  have hVo : ∀ k, IsOpen (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k) := fun k =>
    (chartAt E3 (p k)).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hfam.1 k).1
      ((hfam.1 k).2.trans Set.inter_subset_right)
  have hVΩ : ∀ k, chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ⊆
      chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) := fun k =>
    Set.image_mono (hfam.1 k).2
  have hVt : ∀ k, chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p k)).target := by
    rintro k _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 (p k)).map_source ((hfam.1 k).2 hx).2
  have hsum_le : ∀ i, ∑ k, dualVarG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (dualOmega Ψ (p k))
      (fun y => φs i ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k)
      (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)) ≤
      dualRiemVar g Ψ (φs i) Ω Kc := fun i => by
    unfold dualRiemVar
    exact le_iSup_of_le n (le_iSup_of_le p (le_iSup_of_le W (le_iSup_of_le hfam le_rfl)))
  
  have hLIi : ∀ i k, LocallyIntegrableOn (fun y => φs i ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k) := by
    intro i k
    by_contra hni
    have h1 : dualVarG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (dualOmega Ψ (p k))
        (fun y => φs i ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k)
        (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)) = ⊤ := by
      unfold dualVarG
      rw [iSup_pos hni]
      exact top_sup_eq _
    have h2 := (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => dualVarG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm)
        (dualOmega Ψ (p k)) (fun y => φs i ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k) (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)))
      (fun _ _ => zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ k)).trans (hsum_le i)
    simp only at h2
    rw [h1] at h2
    exact absurd (lt_of_le_of_lt h2 (hfin i)) (lt_irrefl _)
  
  have hLI : ∀ k, LocallyIntegrableOn (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k) := by
    intro k
    refine s3 _ (hVo k) (fun i y => φs i ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) _ (fun i => hLIi i k) ?_ ?_
    · intro K hK hKV
      refine (hφm (p k)).aestronglyMeasurable.congr ?_
      refine (ae_restrict_iff' hK.measurableSet).2 (Eventually.of_forall fun y hy => ?_)
      exact Set.indicator_of_mem (hVt k (hKV hy)) _
    · intro K hK hKV
      exact hconv (p k) K hK (hKV.trans (hVΩ k))
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef, hFeq⟩ : ∃ F : (E3 → ℝ) → Fin n → (E3 → E3) → ENNReal,
      (∀ v k X, F v k X =
        ⨆ (_ : (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) →
            ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
          tsupport X ⊆ chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ∧
          (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧
          ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y| ≤ C),
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, (v y * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y +
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det *
            ∑ i : Fin 3, dualOmega Ψ (p k) y i * X y i))) ∧
      ∀ v k, dualVarG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (dualOmega Ψ (p k)) v
          (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k) (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)) =
        (⨆ (_ : ¬ LocallyIntegrableOn v (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k)), (⊤ : ENNReal)) ⊔
          ⨆ X, F v k X :=
    ⟨fun v k X =>
      ⨆ (_ : (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) →
            ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ X y) ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
          tsupport X ⊆ chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ∧
          (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1) ∧
          ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y| ≤ C),
        ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y, (v y * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) X y +
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det *
            ∑ i : Fin 3, dualOmega Ψ (p k) y i * X y i)),
      fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hlimEq : ∀ k, dualVarG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (dualOmega Ψ (p k))
      (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k)
      (chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source)) =
      ⨆ X, F (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) k X := by
    intro k
    rw [hFeq, iSup_neg (not_not_intro (hLI k)), bot_sup_eq]
  have happrox : ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : Fin n → (E3 → E3)),
      ∑ k, F (fun y => φs i ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) k (x k) ≤
        c + ENNReal.ofReal (1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    intro i x
    refine le_trans ?_ ((hsum_le i).trans (hle i))
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
    rw [hFeq]
    exact le_sup_of_le_right (le_iSup (fun X => F _ k X) (x k))
  
  have hsel : ∀ x : Fin n → (E3 → E3),
      ∑ k, F (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) k (x k) ≤ c := by
    intro x
    have hterm : ∀ k, Tendsto (fun i => F (fun y => φs i ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) k (x k))
        atTop (𝓝 (F (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) k (x k))) := by
      intro k
      by_cases hadm : (∀ y, y ∉ chartAt E3 (p k) '' (Kc ∩ (chartAt E3 (p k)).source) →
            ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (x k) y) ∧ HasCompactSupport (x k) ∧
          tsupport (x k) ⊆ chartAt E3 (p k) '' W k ∧
          (∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y i j * x k y i * x k y j ≤ 1) ∧
          ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (x k) y| ≤ C
      · simp only [hFdef, iSup_pos hadm]
        obtain ⟨-, hXc, hsub, -, C, hC⟩ := hadm
        have h := s4 (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm) (x k))
          (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y).det *
            ∑ i : Fin 3, dualOmega Ψ (p k) y i * x k y i)
          (tsupport (x k)) C (isClosed_tsupport _).measurableSet (hDmeas _ _) hC (hD0 _ _)
          (fun i y => φs i ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y)) (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 (p k)).symm y))
          (fun i => (hLIi i k).integrableOn_compact_subset hsub hXc.isCompact)
          ((hLI k).integrableOn_compact_subset hsub hXc.isCompact)
          (hconv (p k) _ hXc.isCompact (hsub.trans (hVΩ k)))
        exact (ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.tendsto _).comp h
      · simp only [hFdef, iSup_neg hadm]
        exact tendsto_const_nhds
    have hsumT := tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun k _ => hterm k)
    have hrhs : Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => c + ENNReal.ofReal (1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1))) atTop (𝓝 c) := by
      have h1 : Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => ENNReal.ofReal (1 / ((i : ℝ) + 1))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
        exact (ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
      simpa using h1.const_add c
    exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' hsumT hrhs (fun i => happrox i x)
  
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => hlimEq k]
  exact s2 _ c hsel

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (f g : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f j) (P.W j)) (hg : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g j) (P.W j))
    (hcf : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      fderiv ℝ (f j) x = fderiv ℝ (fun x' => f k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) x)
    (hcg : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      fderiv ℝ (g j) x = fderiv ℝ (fun x' => g k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) x)
    (j k : Fin P.n) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :
    ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a (f j) x * pd2 b (g j) x =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ a b *
        pd2 a (f k) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 b (g k) (P.proj k (P.param j x))

signature.name: eig_form_pair_compat
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (f g : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f j) (P.W j)) (hg : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (g j) (P.W j))
    (hcf : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      fderiv ℝ (f j) x = fderiv ℝ (fun x' => f k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) x)
    (hcg : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      fderiv ℝ (g j) x = fderiv ℝ (fun x' => g k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) x)
    (j k : Fin P.n) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :
    ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a (f j) x * pd2 b (g j) x =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ a b *
        pd2 a (f k) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 b (g k) (P.proj k (P.param j x))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hD : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)
  have hP3 : ∀ x' ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      P.proj k (P.param j x') ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x')) = P.param j x' := by
    intro x' hx'
    have h1 : P.param j x' ∈ P.O j ∩ S := by
      rw [← P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨x', hx'.1, rfl⟩
    have h2 : P.param j x' ∈ P.param k '' P.W k := by
      rw [P.image_eq k]; exact ⟨hx'.2, h1.2⟩
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hyeq⟩ := h2
    rw [← hyeq, P.proj_param k y' hy']
    exact ⟨hy', rfl⟩
  have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x :=
    ((P.trans_smooth j k).contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hyW : P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k := (hP3 x hx).1
  have chain : ∀ (φ : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ), (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (φ i) (P.W i)) →
      fderiv ℝ (φ j) x = fderiv ℝ (fun x' => φ k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) x →
      ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (φ j) x =
        ∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) c *
          pd2 c (φ k) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) := by
    intro φ hφ hcφ b
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (φ k) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) :=
      ((hφ k).contDiffAt ((P.W_open k).mem_nhds hyW)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    unfold pd2
    rw [hcφ, show (fun x' => φ k (P.proj k (P.param j x'))) =
      (φ k) ∘ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) from rfl,
      fderiv_comp x hfd hτd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    have hw' : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) =
        ∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) c • e2 c := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, Fin.sum_univ_two, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hw']
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  set J : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun c a => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 a) c with hJ
  have hKJ : P.h j x = J.transpose * P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * J := by
    ext a b
    rw [P.h_compat j k x hx a b]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hdetK : 0 < (P.h j x).det := (P.h_posDef j x hx.1).det_pos
  have hJdet : IsUnit J.det := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h0
    have : (P.h j x).det = 0 := by
      rw [hKJ, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, h0]; simp
    linarith
  have hJTdet : IsUnit J.transpose.det := by rwa [Matrix.det_transpose]
  have hinv : J * (P.h j x)⁻¹ * J.transpose = (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ := by
    rw [hKJ, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, ← Matrix.mul_assoc J J⁻¹,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv J hJdet, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul J.transpose hJTdet, Matrix.mul_one]
  have e : ∀ c d : Fin 2, (J * (P.h j x)⁻¹ * J.transpose) c d =
      (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ c d := fun c d => by rw [hinv]
  have e00 := e 0 0
  have e01 := e 0 1
  have e10 := e 1 0
  have e11 := e 1 1
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply,
    Fin.sum_univ_two] at e00 e01 e10 e11
  have cf := chain f hf (hcf j k x hx)
  have cg := chain g hg (hcg j k x hx)
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  rw [cf 0, cf 1, cg 0, cg 1]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  linear_combination
    (pd2 0 (f k) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 0 (g k) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e00 +
    (pd2 0 (f k) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 1 (g k) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e01 +
    (pd2 1 (f k) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 0 (g k) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e10 +
    (pd2 1 (f k) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 1 (g k) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e11

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) :
    lap2 h (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w y * pd2 b w y) x =
      2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * (h x)⁻¹ b d *
          (pd2 a (pd2 b w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k a b x * pd2 k w x) *
          (pd2 c (pd2 d w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k c d x * pd2 k w x)) +
        2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b (lap2 h w) x) +
        2 * gaussCurv2 h x * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b w x)

signature.name: bochner_lap2_identity
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) :
    lap2 h (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w y * pd2 b w y) x =
      2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * (h x)⁻¹ b d *
          (pd2 a (pd2 b w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k a b x * pd2 k w x) *
          (pd2 c (pd2 d w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k c d x * pd2 k w x)) +
        2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b (lap2 h w) x) +
        2 * gaussCurv2 h x * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b w x)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsymm : ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h y i j = h y j i := by
    intro y hy i j
    have h1 := (hpos y hy).isHermitian.apply i j
    rw [star_trivial] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have G := gs2_metric_calculus h W hW hh hsymm hpos
  have CL := gs2_contraction_leibniz h W hW G.1 G.2.2.2.2.2
  have hω : ∀ b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 b w) W := by
    intro b
    have h1 := hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := ∞) (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hωω : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 a (pd2 b w)) W := by
    intro a b
    have h1 := (hω b).fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := ∞) (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hH : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) i j) W := by
    intro i j
    have e : gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) i j = fun y =>
        pd2 i (pd2 j w) y - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m i j y * pd2 m w y := by
      funext y; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (hωω i j).sub (ContDiffOn.sum (fun m _ => (G.2.2.1 m i j).mul (hω m)))
  
  have hschwarz : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (y : E2), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f y → ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      pd2 i (pd2 j f) y = pd2 j (pd2 i f) y := by
    intro f y hf i j
    have h2 : minSmoothness ℝ 2 ≤ ∞ := by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
    have hdf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y :=
      (hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have key : ∀ a b : Fin 2, pd2 a (pd2 b f) y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y (e2 a) (e2 b) := by
      intro a b
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e2 b)) y (e2 a) = _
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hdf (differentiableAt_const (e2 b))]
      simp
    rw [key, key]
    exact (hf.isSymmSndFDerivAt h2) (e2 i) (e2 j)
  
  have hS4 : ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) i j y = gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j i y := by
    intro y hy i j
    simp only [gsCovD1]
    rw [hschwarz w y (hw.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)) i j]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => by rw [G.2.2.2.1 y hy m i j])
  
  have hpd0 : ∀ a b c d : Fin 2, pd2 a (gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j) b c d) x = 0 := by
    intro a b c d
    have hev : gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j) b c d =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => G.2.2.2.2.1 y hy b c d)
    show fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 a) = 0
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have hRiem : ∀ m l i k : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x = gaussCurv2 h x *
      (h x i k * (if m = l then 1 else 0) - h x l k * (if m = i then 1 else 0)) := by
    refine gs2_curvature_2d h x (hpos x hx) ?_
    intro l i k j
    have hR := gs2_ricci_identity h W hW G.2.2.1 G.2.2.2.1 (fun i j y => h y i j) hh x hx l i k j
    have hz : ∀ a b c d : Fin 2, gsCovD3 h (gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j)) a b c d x = 0 := by
      intro a b c d
      simp [gsCovD3, hpd0, G.2.2.2.2.1 x hx]
    rw [hz, hz] at hR
    try simp only at hR
    linarith
  have hRc : ∀ i a j : Fin 2, ∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m i a j x * pd2 m w x =
      gaussCurv2 h x * (h x a j * pd2 i w x - h x i j * pd2 a w x) := by
    intro i a j
    simp only [hRiem]
    simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, ite_mul,
      zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    ring
  
  have hdet : IsUnit (h x).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hpos x hx).det_pos.ne'
  have hI : ∀ i k : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * (h x)⁻¹ j k = if i = k then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i k
    have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (h x) hdet) i) k
    rwa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
  have hcontr : ∀ a : Fin 2,
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * (h x a j * pd2 i w x) = pd2 a w x := by
    intro a
    have e1 : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * (h x a j * pd2 i w x) =
        (∑ j : Fin 2, h x a j * (h x)⁻¹ j i) * pd2 i w x := by
      intro i
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [G.2.1 x hx i j]; ring
    simp only [e1, hI]
    simp
  have htrace : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * h x i j = 2 := by
    have e1 : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * h x i j =
        ∑ j : Fin 2, h x i j * (h x)⁻¹ j i := by
      intro i
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      rw [G.2.1 x hx i j]; ring
    simp only [e1, hI]
    norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  
  have hDsym : ∀ i j a : Fin 2,
      gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) i j a x =
        gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) i a j x := by
    intro i j a
    have hev : gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a =ᶠ[𝓝 x] gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) a j :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hS4 y hy j a)
    have hpd : pd2 i (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a) x =
        pd2 i (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) a j) x := by
      show fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 i) = fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [gsCovD2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hpd, hS4 x hx 0 a, hS4 x hx 1 a, hS4 x hx j 0, hS4 x hx j 1]
    ring
  
  have s6 : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j *
      gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) i j a x =
      pd2 a (lap2 h w) x + gaussCurv2 h x * pd2 a w x := by
    intro a
    have htr : gsTrace h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) = lap2 h w := by
      funext y; rfl
    have e6c : pd2 a (lap2 h w) x = ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
        gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) a k l x := by
      have := CL.1 _ hH x hx a
      rwa [htr] at this
    have key : ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) i j a x =
        gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) a i j x -
          gaussCurv2 h x * (h x a j * pd2 i w x - h x i j * pd2 a w x) := by
      intro i j
      have e3 := bl2_oneform_ricci W hW h hh hpos w hw x hx i a j
      rw [hRc i a j] at e3
      rw [hDsym i j a]
      linarith
    have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j *
        gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) i j a x =
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j *
        (gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) a i j x -
          gaussCurv2 h x * (h x a j * pd2 i w x - h x i j * pd2 a w x)) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by rw [key i j]))
    rw [hsum, e6c]
    have hc := hcontr a
    have ht := htrace
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hc ht ⊢
    linear_combination (-(gaussCurv2 h x)) * hc + (gaussCurv2 h x * pd2 a w x) * ht
  
  have e7 : ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      pd2 i (pd2 j (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w y * pd2 b w y)) x -
        ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x *
          pd2 k (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w y * pd2 b w y) x =
      2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          (h x)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) i j a x * pd2 b w x
        + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          (h x)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a x *
            gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) i b x := by
    intro i j
    have hev : pd2 j (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w y * pd2 b w y)
        =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          (h y)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a y * pd2 b w y) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx)
        (fun y hy => bl2_grad_Q W hW h hh hpos w hw y hy j)
    have h1 : pd2 i (pd2 j (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w y * pd2 b w y)) x =
        pd2 i (fun y => 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          (h y)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a y * pd2 b w y) x := by
      show fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 i) = fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    rw [h1]
    simp only [bl2_grad_Q W hW h hh hpos w hw x hx]
    exact bl2_hess_V W hW h hh hpos w hw x hx i j
  rw [lap2]
  simp only [e7]
  have s60 := s6 0
  have s61 := s6 1
  have hg : (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 = (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 := G.2.1 x hx 1 0
  have hHx : ∀ a b : Fin 2, gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) a b x =
      pd2 a (pd2 b w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k a b x * pd2 k w x := fun a b => rfl
  simp only [hHx]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at s60 s61 ⊢
  simp only [hg] at s60 s61 ⊢
  linear_combination (2 * ((h x)⁻¹ 0 0 * pd2 0 w x + (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * pd2 1 w x)) * s60 +
    (2 * ((h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * pd2 0 w x + (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 * pd2 1 w x)) * s61
