    have : Γ * u xs ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hΓ hneg.le
    linarith
  
  have hx₁W : x₁ ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hx₁])
  have hmin1 : IsLocalMin w x₁ := by
    filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hx₁W] with y hy
    rw [hw₁]
    exact hnn y hy
  have hdw1 : fderiv ℝ w x₁ = 0 := hmin1.fderiv_eq_zero
  
  obtain ⟨m₀, Λ, β, Γ, m, hm₀, hΛ, hβ, hΓ, hm, hK, hSin⟩ :=
    hconst W A B w (fun _ => 0) hA hB hApos hw.continuousOn continuousOn_const z R hR hball hpos
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α : ℝ, α = 1 + (4 * Λ + 4 * β * R + Γ) / (4 * m₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hα1 : 1 ≤ α := by
    have : 0 ≤ (4 * Λ + 4 * β * R + Γ) / (4 * m₀) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hα0 : 0 < α := by linarith
  have hbar : ∀ (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (b : Fin 2 → ℝ) (y : E2),
      m₀ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, y i * a i j * y j → (∀ i : Fin 2, |a i i| ≤ Λ) →
      (∀ k : Fin 2, |b k| ≤ β) → ‖y‖ ≤ R →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a i j * ((4 * α ^ 2 * y i * y j
          - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, b k * (-2 * α * y k * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        - Γ * (Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) := by
    intro a b y hq ha hb hy
    have hE := Real.exp_pos (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
    have hER := Real.exp_pos (-α * R ^ 2)
    have hy0 : |y 0| ≤ R := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le y 0
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      linarith
    have hy1 : |y 1| ≤ R := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le y 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      linarith
    have htr : a 0 0 + a 1 1 ≤ 2 * Λ := by
      have h0 := le_abs_self (a 0 0)
      have h1 := le_abs_self (a 1 1)
      linarith [ha 0, ha 1]
    have hb0 : b 0 * y 0 ≤ β * R := by
      calc b 0 * y 0 ≤ |b 0 * y 0| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |b 0| * |y 0| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ β * R := mul_le_mul (hb 0) hy0 (abs_nonneg _) hβ
    have hb1 : b 1 * y 1 ≤ β * R := by
      calc b 1 * y 1 ≤ |b 1 * y 1| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |b 1| * |y 1| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ β * R := mul_le_mul (hb 1) hy1 (abs_nonneg _) hβ
    have h4 : 4 * α * m₀ = 4 * m₀ + 4 * Λ + 4 * β * R + Γ := by
      rw [hα]
      field_simp
      ring
    set q := ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, y i * a i j * y j with hqdef
    have hP : 0 < 4 * α ^ 2 * q - 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1) - 2 * α * (b 0 * y 0 + b 1 * y 1) - Γ := by
      have e1 : 4 * α ^ 2 * m₀ ≤ 4 * α ^ 2 * q := by
        have : 0 ≤ 4 * α ^ 2 := by positivity
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq this
      have e2 : 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1) ≤ 2 * α * (2 * Λ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htr (by positivity)
      have e3 : 2 * α * (b 0 * y 0 + b 1 * y 1) ≤ 2 * α * (2 * β * R) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have e4 : 4 * α ^ 2 * m₀ - 4 * α * Λ - 4 * α * β * R - Γ = 4 * α * m₀ + (α - 1) * Γ := by
        linear_combination α * h4
      have e5 : 0 < 4 * α * m₀ + (α - 1) * Γ := by
        have : 0 ≤ (α - 1) * Γ := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hΓ
        have : 0 < 4 * α * m₀ := by positivity
        linarith
      nlinarith
    have hkey : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a i j * ((4 * α ^ 2 * y i * y j
          - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, b k * (-2 * α * y k * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        - Γ * (Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2))
        = Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * (4 * α ^ 2 * q - 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1)
          - 2 * α * (b 0 * y 0 + b 1 * y 1) - Γ) + Γ * Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2) := by
      rw [hqdef]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, if_pos (rfl : (0 : Fin 2) = 0), if_pos (rfl : (1 : Fin 2) = 1),
        if_neg (show ¬((0 : Fin 2) = 1) by decide), if_neg (show ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 0) by decide),
        if_true]
      ring
    rw [hkey]
    have := mul_pos hE hP
    have := mul_nonneg hΓ hER.le
    linarith
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : E2 → ℝ, ∀ x, v x = Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, fun x => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hvs, hvD, hv1, hv2⟩ := hbarrier z α R v hv
  have hV1 : ∀ x, dist x z = R → v x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hv, ← dist_eq_norm, hx, sub_self]
  have hV2 : ∀ x, v x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    have h1 : Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
      have := sq_nonneg ‖x - z‖
      nlinarith
    have h2 := Real.exp_pos (-α * R ^ 2)
    rw [hv]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ : ∃ y₀ : E2, y₀ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (z - x₁) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hV3 : 0 < fderiv ℝ v x₁ y₀ := by
    rw [hvD x₁ y₀]
    have hs : ∑ k : Fin 2, (x₁ - z) k * y₀ k = -(1 / 2) * ‖x₁ - z‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      simp [hy₀, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      ring
    rw [hs, ← dist_eq_norm, hx₁]
    rw [show -2 * α * (-(1 / 2) * R ^ 2) = α * R ^ 2 by ring]
    positivity
  
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w x - m * v x) W :=
    hw.sub (contDiffOn_const.mul hvs.contDiffOn)
  have hlin : ∀ x ∈ W, fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y - m * v y) x = fderiv ℝ w x - m • fderiv ℝ v x ∧
      (∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => w y - m * v y) x = pd2 k w x - m * pd2 k v x) ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (fun y => w y - m * v y)) x
        = pd2 i (pd2 j w) x - m * pd2 i (pd2 j v) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hdf : ∀ y ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ w y := fun y hy =>
      (hw.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)
    have hdg : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ v y := fun y => hvs.differentiable (by simp) y
    have h1 : ∀ y ∈ W, fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y - m * v y) y = fderiv ℝ w y - m • fderiv ℝ v y := by
      intro y hy
      exact ((hdf y hy).hasFDerivAt.sub ((hdg y).hasFDerivAt.const_mul m)).fderiv
    have h2 : ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ k : Fin 2,
        pd2 k (fun y => w y - m * v y) y = pd2 k w y - m * pd2 k v y := by
      intro y hy k
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y - m * v y) y (e2 k)
        = fderiv ℝ w y (e2 k) - m * fderiv ℝ v y (e2 k)
      rw [h1 y hy]
      rfl
    have hdpf : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) x := by
      intro j
      have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) W :=
        (hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      exact (hc.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
    have hdpg : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) x := by
      intro j
      have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) :=
        (hvs.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const
      exact hc.differentiable (by simp) x
    refine ⟨h1 x hx, h2 x hx, fun i j => ?_⟩
    have hev : pd2 j (fun y => w y - m * v y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j) - m * fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => h2 y hy j)
    show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (fun y => w y - m * v y)) x (e2 i)
      = fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) x (e2 i)
        - m * fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) x (e2 i)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hD := ((hdpf j).hasFDerivAt.sub ((hdpg j).hasFDerivAt.const_mul m)).fderiv
    exact congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e2 i)) hD
  have hstrict : ∀ x : E2, R / 2 < dist x z → dist x z < R →
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j (fun x => w x - m * v x)) x
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k (fun x => w x - m * v x) x
        - Γ * (fun x => w x - m * v x) x < 0 := by
    intro x h1 h2
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]; exact h2.le)
    obtain ⟨-, hp1, hp2⟩ := hlin x hxW
    obtain ⟨hq, ha, hb, -⟩ := hK x h1.le h2.le
    have hineq := hbar (A x) (B x) (x - z) hq ha hb
      (by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact h2.le)
    have hs := hsup x hxW
    have hgw : 0 ≤ Γ * w x := mul_nonneg hΓ (hnn x hxW)
    have hTv := mul_pos hm hineq
    simp only [hp1, hp2, hv1, hv2, hv x] at hTv ⊢
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hTv hs ⊢
    linarith
  have hout : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R → 0 ≤ (fun x => w x - m * v x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hx])
    show 0 ≤ w x - m * v x
    rw [hV1 x hx, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact hnn x hxW
  have hin : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → 0 ≤ (fun x => w x - m * v x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hSin x hx
    have h2 := hV2 x
    show 0 ≤ w x - m * v x
    nlinarith
  
  have hApsd : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j := by
    intro x hx ξ
    by_cases hξ : ξ = 0
    · subst hξ
      simp
    · exact (hApos x hx ξ hξ).le
  have hmp := hminp W hW A B (fun x => w x - m * v x) Γ z R hR hball hu hAs
    hApsd hΓ hstrict hin hout
  
  have hu1 : w x₁ - m * v x₁ = 0 := by
    rw [hw₁, hV1 x₁ hx₁]
    ring
  have hseg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 →
      (fun x => w x - m * v x) x₁ ≤ (fun x => w x - m * v x) (x₁ + t • y₀) := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    have hd : dist (x₁ + t • y₀) z = (1 - t / 2) * R := by
      have e1 : x₁ + t • y₀ - z = (1 - t / 2) • (x₁ - z) := by
        rw [hy₀]
        module
      rw [dist_eq_norm, e1, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith),
        ← dist_eq_norm, hx₁]
    show w x₁ - m * v x₁ ≤ w (x₁ + t • y₀) - m * v (x₁ + t • y₀)
    rw [hu1]
    exact hmp _ (by rw [hd]; nlinarith) (by rw [hd]; nlinarith)
  have hdu : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => w x - m * v x) x₁ :=
    (hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx₁W)
  have h11 : 0 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fun x => w x - m * v x) x₁ y₀ := by
    have hminOn : IsLocalMinOn (fun x => w x - m * v x) (segment ℝ x₁ (x₁ + y₀)) x₁ := by
      apply Filter.eventually_of_mem self_mem_nhdsWithin
      intro p hp
      rw [segment_eq_image'] at hp
      obtain ⟨θ, ⟨h0, h1⟩, rfl⟩ := hp
      have := hseg θ h0 h1
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using this
    exact hminOn.hasFDerivWithinAt_nonneg hdu.hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
      (mem_posTangentConeAt_of_segment_subset subset_rfl)
  
  obtain ⟨hf1, -, -⟩ := hlin x₁ hx₁W
  rw [hf1, hdw1] at h11
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul, zero_sub] at h11
  nlinarith [mul_pos hm hV3]

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) :
    (∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b g x) W) ∧
    (∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ∀ x ∈ W, 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x) ∧
    (∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ t : ℝ,
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a (fun y => f y - t * g y) x *
          pd2 b (fun y => f y - t * g y) x =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x
        - 2 * t * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a g x * pd2 b f x
        + t ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a g x * pd2 b g x) ∧
    ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W →
      ∫ x in L, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k f x) ^ 2 ≤
        C * ∫ x in L, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x) *
          Real.sqrt (h x).det

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hinvsym : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.PosDef → A⁻¹ 1 0 = A⁻¹ 0 1 := by
    intro A hA
    have := hA.isHermitian.inv.apply 0 1
    simpa using this
  have alg : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.PosDef → ∀ v : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      0 < A 0 0 + A 1 1 ∧
        (∑ k : Fin 2, v k ^ 2) ≤ (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a b * v a * v b ∧
        0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a b * v a * v b := by
    intro A hA v
    have hsym : A 1 0 = A 0 1 := by
      have := hA.isHermitian.apply 0 1
      simpa using this
    have hD : 0 < A.det := hA.det_pos
    have hdet : A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsym]
    have hE : 0 < A 0 0 := hA.diag_pos
    have hG : 0 < A 1 1 := hA.diag_pos
    have hinv : ∀ a b, A⁻¹ a b = A.det⁻¹ * A.adjugate a b := by
      intro a b
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    have i00 : A⁻¹ 0 0 = A.det⁻¹ * A 1 1 := by rw [hinv]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
    have i01 : A⁻¹ 0 1 = A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) := by rw [hinv]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
    have i10 : A⁻¹ 1 0 = A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) := by
      rw [hinv]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, hsym]
    have i11 : A⁻¹ 1 1 = A.det⁻¹ * A 0 0 := by rw [hinv]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
    have htr : 0 < A 0 0 + A 1 1 := by linarith
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, i00, i01, i10, i11]
    have ht : A.det⁻¹ * (A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1) = 1 := by
      rw [← hdet]; exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hD.ne'
    have key : (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * (A.det⁻¹ * A 1 1 * v 0 * v 0 + A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) * v 0 * v 1 +
        (A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) * v 1 * v 0 + A.det⁻¹ * A 0 0 * v 1 * v 1)) - (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2) =
        A.det⁻¹ * ((A 1 1 * v 0 - A 0 1 * v 1) ^ 2 + (A 0 1 * v 0 - A 0 0 * v 1) ^ 2) := by
      linear_combination (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2) * ht
    have hnn : 0 ≤ A.det⁻¹ * ((A 1 1 * v 0 - A 0 1 * v 1) ^ 2 + (A 0 1 * v 0 - A 0 0 * v 1) ^ 2) :=
      mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hD.le) (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
    have hle : v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 ≤ (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * (A.det⁻¹ * A 1 1 * v 0 * v 0 +
        A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) * v 0 * v 1 +
        (A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) * v 1 * v 0 + A.det⁻¹ * A 0 0 * v 1 * v 1)) := by linarith
    refine ⟨htr, hle, ?_⟩
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg htr hneg
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0), sq_nonneg (v 1)]
  
  have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => h x a b) W := fun a b => (hh a b).continuousOn
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x).det) W := by
    have e : (fun x => (h x).det) = fun x => h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 := by
      funext x; exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
    rw [e]
    exact ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).sub ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0))
  have hσc : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) W := hdetc.sqrt
  have hσpos : ∀ x ∈ W, 0 < Real.sqrt (h x).det :=
    fun x hx => Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos x hx).det_pos
  have hdetinv : ContinuousOn (fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹) W :=
    hdetc.inv₀ (fun x hx => (hpos x hx).det_pos.ne')
  have hadjc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x).adjugate a b) W := by
    intro a b
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] <;>
      first
        | exact hc _ _
        | exact (hc _ _).neg
        | fun_prop
  have hinvc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) W := by
    intro a b
    have e : (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) = fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹ * (h x).adjugate a b := by
      funext x
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rw [e]
    exact hdetinv.mul (hadjc a b)
  
  have hpdc : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 k f x) W := by
    intro f hf k
    unfold pd2
    exact (hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  
  have P1 : ∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b g x) W := by
    intro f g hf hg
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _
      (fun b _ => ((hinvc a b).mul (hpdc f hf a)).mul (hpdc g hg b)))
  
  have P2 : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ∀ x ∈ W,
      0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x := by
    intro f x hx
    exact (alg (h x) (hpos x hx) (fun k => pd2 k f x)).2.2
  
  have hlin : ∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ t : ℝ,
      ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => f y - t * g y) x = pd2 a f x - t * pd2 a g x := by
    intro f g hf hg x hx t a
    have hWx : W ∈ 𝓝 x := hW.mem_nhds hx
    have hdf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x := (hf.contDiffAt hWx).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hdg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x := (hg.contDiffAt hWx).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => f y - t * g y) (fderiv ℝ f x - t • fderiv ℝ g x) x :=
      hdf.hasFDerivAt.sub (hdg.hasFDerivAt.const_mul t)
    unfold pd2
    rw [hd.fderiv]
    simp
  
  have P3 : ∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ t : ℝ,
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a (fun y => f y - t * g y) x *
          pd2 b (fun y => f y - t * g y) x =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x
        - 2 * t * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a g x * pd2 b f x
        + t ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a g x * pd2 b g x := by
    intro f g hf hg x hx t
    have hB := hinvsym (h x) (hpos x hx)
    simp only [hlin f g hf hg x hx t, Fin.sum_univ_two, hB]
    ring
  
  have P4 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ f : E2 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W →
      ∫ x in L, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k f x) ^ 2 ≤
        C * ∫ x in L, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x) *
          Real.sqrt (h x).det := by
    intro L hL hLW
    have htc : ContinuousOn (fun x => h x 0 0 + h x 1 1) W :=
      (hh 0 0).continuousOn.add (hh 1 1).continuousOn
    have hspos : ∀ x ∈ L, 0 < Real.sqrt (h x).det := fun x hx => hσpos x (hLW hx)
    obtain ⟨m, hm0, hm⟩ := hL.exists_forall_le' (hσc.mono hLW) hspos
    obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hL.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (htc.mono hLW)
    set T : ℝ := max B 0 with hTdef
    have hT0 : 0 ≤ T := le_max_right _ _
    have hTb : ∀ x ∈ L, h x 0 0 + h x 1 1 ≤ T := by
      intro x hx
      have h1 := hB x hx
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h1.trans (le_max_left _ _))
    refine ⟨T / m, div_nonneg hT0 hm0.le, ?_⟩
    intro f hf
    have hpt : ∀ x ∈ L, (∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k f x) ^ 2) ≤
        T / m * ((∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x) *
          Real.sqrt (h x).det) := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨hτ, hPQ, hQ0⟩ := alg (h x) (hpos x (hLW hx)) (fun k => pd2 k f x)
      have hPQ' : (∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k f x) ^ 2) ≤ (h x 0 0 + h x 1 1) *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x := hPQ
      have hQ0' : 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x := hQ0
      set P := ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k f x) ^ 2 with hPdef
      set Q := ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x with hQdef
      set σ := Real.sqrt (h x).det with hσdef
      set τ := h x 0 0 + h x 1 1 with hτdef
      have hτT : τ ≤ T := hTb x hx
      have hPT : P ≤ T * Q := hPQ'.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτT hQ0')
      have hmσ : m ≤ σ := hm x hx
      have hY : 0 ≤ T * Q * (σ - m) :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hT0 hQ0') (sub_nonneg.2 hmσ)
      have hZ : P * m ≤ T * Q * m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hPT hm0.le
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hm0]
      nlinarith [hY, hZ]
    have hfc : ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k f x) ^ 2) W :=
      continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => (hpdc f hf k).pow 2)
    have hgc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x) * Real.sqrt (h x).det) W :=
      (P1 f f hf hf).mul hσc
    have hf_int := (hfc.mono hLW).integrableOn_compact (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hL
    have hg_int := (hgc.mono hLW).integrableOn_compact (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hL
    calc ∫ x in L, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k f x) ^ 2
        ≤ ∫ x in L, T / m * ((∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x) *
          Real.sqrt (h x).det) :=
          MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on hf_int (hg_int.const_mul _) hL.measurableSet hpt
      _ = T / m * ∫ x in L, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x) *
          Real.sqrt (h x).det := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
  exact ⟨P1, P2, P3, P4⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M)
    (hUo : IsOpen U) (hFc : IsCompact (frontier U)) (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hNc : IsCompact (closure N)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x ≠ 0)
    (hσb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x ∧ σ x < ε)
    (hσp : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d))
    (hσi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ)))
    (hσ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)
    (hgood : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ ∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, σ x = |f x|)
    (φ lam : M → ℝ)
    (hdata : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, 0 < φ p ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
        V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ V ∩ frontier U, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧
          g.jacobiDeriv f x = lam x / φ x)
    (x₀ p₀ : M) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U ∩ N)
    (hp₀C : p₀ ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U)
    (hthin : ∀ O : Set M, IsOpen O →
      closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ O →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < ε ∧ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ ⊆ O)
    (hFCpc : IsPreconnected (closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U)) :
    ∃ (S : Set M) (P : EigPatchedSurface M S) (z : Fin P.n → M)
      (Φ : Fin P.n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (Ψ : ℝ → M → M) (s₁ : ℝ),
      0 < s₁ ∧ IsCompact S ∧ S.Nonempty ∧ IsPreconnected S ∧
      (∀ j, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, hpLift s x ∈ (Φ j).source ∧
        Φ j (hpLift s x) = Ψ s (P.param j x) ∧ Ψ s (P.param j x) ∈ (chartAt E3 (z j)).source) ∧
      (∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ 0 ℓ ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ 0 ℓ = p) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ s ℓ ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ s' ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, ∀ ℓ' ∈ S,
        Ψ s ℓ = Ψ s' ℓ' → s = s' ∧ ℓ = ℓ') ∧
      (∀ m ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀,
        σ x ≤ δ → ∃ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 m, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ s ℓ = x) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, s ≠ 0 → Ψ s ℓ ∉ frontier U) ∧
      (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V → Ψ 0 (P.param j x) ∈ V →
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f → (∀ y ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f y ≠ 0) →
        V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} →
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f (Ψ 0 (P.param j x))) * φ (Ψ 0 (P.param j x)) = 1 →
        |partialDeriv 0 (fun y => f (Φ j y)) (hpLift 0 x)| = 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hX : IsOpen (U ∩ N) := hUo.inter hNo
  have hCX : connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ⊆ U ∩ N := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _
  have hx₀C : x₀ ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ := mem_connectedComponentIn hx₀
  have hCcl : ∀ y ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀), y ∈ U ∩ N →
      y ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ := by
    intro y hyc hyX
    have hpre : IsPreconnected (insert y (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀)) :=
      isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.subset_closure (Set.subset_insert y _)
        (Set.insert_subset hyc subset_closure)
    have hsub : insert y (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ⊆ U ∩ N := Set.insert_subset hyX hCX
    exact hpre.subset_connectedComponentIn (Set.mem_insert_of_mem y hx₀C) hsub
      (Set.mem_insert y _)
  have hσc : ContinuousOn σ (U ∩ N) := hσs.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘX, hΘ0, hΘc⟩ := tau_flow_exists g (U ∩ N) hX σ 0 ε hσs hσr hσb hσp
  have hleaf : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → c < ε →
      IsCompact (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) ∧
      IsPreconnected (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) ∧
      (c ≤ σ x₀ → (∃ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, σ x < c) →
        (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}).Nonempty) := by
    intro c hc0 hcε
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      have hK : IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) := by
        have h := hσp c c hc0 hcε
        rwa [Set.Icc_self] at h
      have heq : connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c} =
          closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hyC, hyc⟩
          exact ⟨subset_closure hyC, hCX hyC, hyc⟩
        · rintro ⟨hycl, hyX, hyc⟩
          exact ⟨hCcl y hycl hyX, hyc⟩
      rw [heq]
      exact hK.inter_left isClosed_closure
    · 
      rcases (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hS |
        ⟨y₀, hy₀C, hy₀c⟩
      · rw [hS]
        exact isPreconnected_empty
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun x : M => (x, c - σ x)) (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀)
          {p : M × ℝ | p.1 ∈ U ∩ N ∧ 0 < σ p.1 + p.2 ∧ σ p.1 + p.2 < ε} := by
        intro x hx
        refine ⟨hCX hx, ?_, ?_⟩
        · show 0 < σ x + (c - σ x)
          linarith
        · show σ x + (c - σ x) < ε
          linarith
      have hιc : ContinuousOn (fun x : M => (x, c - σ x)) (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) :=
        continuousOn_id.prodMk (continuousOn_const.sub (hσc.mono hCX))
      have hψc : ContinuousOn (fun x : M => Θ x (c - σ x)) (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) :=
        hΘc.comp hιc hmaps
      have himg := isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.image _ hψc
      have hψX : ∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀,
          Θ x (c - σ x) ∈ U ∩ N ∧ σ (Θ x (c - σ x)) = c := by
        intro x hx
        have h := hΘX x (hCX hx) (c - σ x) (by linarith) (by linarith)
        refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
        rw [h.2]
        ring
      have hback : ∀ y ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, σ y = c → Θ y (c - σ y) = y := by
        intro y hy hyc
        rw [hyc, sub_self]
        exact hΘ0 y (hCX hy)
      have hy₀c' : σ y₀ = c := hy₀c
      have hy₀img : y₀ ∈ (fun x : M => Θ x (c - σ x)) '' connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ :=
        ⟨y₀, hy₀C, hback y₀ hy₀C hy₀c'⟩
      have himgC : (fun x : M => Θ x (c - σ x)) '' connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ⊆
          connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ := by
        have h1 := himg.subset_connectedComponentIn hy₀img
          (by
            rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
            exact (hψX x hx).1)
        rw [← connectedComponentIn_eq hy₀C] at h1
        exact h1
      have heq : (fun x : M => Θ x (c - σ x)) '' connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ =
          connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c} := by
        apply Set.Subset.antisymm
        · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
          exact ⟨himgC ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, (hψX x hx).2⟩
        · rintro y ⟨hyC, hyc⟩
          exact ⟨y, hyC, hback y hyC hyc⟩
      rw [← heq]
      exact himg
    · 
      rintro hcx ⟨x, hxC, hxc⟩
      have hpc : IsPreconnected (σ '' connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) :=
        isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.image _ (hσc.mono hCX)
      obtain ⟨y, hyC, hyc⟩ :=
        hpc.Icc_subset ⟨x, hxC, rfl⟩ ⟨x₀, hx₀C, rfl⟩ ⟨hxc.le, hcx⟩
      exact ⟨y, hyC, hyc⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Ng, hNg1, hNg2, hNg3⟩ := normalized_gradient_smooth g

    (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ x ∈ W, hpLift s x ∈ Φ.source ∧
      Φ (hpLift s x) = Ψ s (pm x) ∧ Ψ s (pm x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source) ∧

      |partialDeriv 0 (fun y => f (Φ y)) (hpLift 0 x)| = 1)

    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M)
    (hUo : IsOpen U) (hFc : IsCompact (frontier U)) (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hNc : IsCompact (closure N)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x ≠ 0)
    (hσb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x ∧ σ x < ε)
    (hσ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)
    (hgood : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ ∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, σ x = |f x|)
    (x₀ : M) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U ∩ N)
    (hFCpc : IsPreconnected (closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U)) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (B : Fin m → Set M) (f : Fin m → M → ℝ),
      closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ ⋃ i, B i ∧
      (∀ i, IsOpen (B i) ∧ B i ⊆ N ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ B i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f i) x ≠ 0) ∧
        B i ∩ frontier U = B i ∩ (f i) ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        B i ∩ frontier U ⊆ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀)) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, 0 < f i x → x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ → σ x = |f i x|) ∧
      (∀ i k, ∀ x ∈ B i ∩ B k, ∃ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f i y = e * f k y)

    (x₀ p₀ : M) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U ∩ N)
    (hp₀C : p₀ ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U)
    (hthin : ∀ O : Set M, IsOpen O →
      closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ O →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < ε ∧ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ ⊆ O)
    (hFCpc : IsPreconnected (closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U))
    (Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)

    (hBcov : closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ ⋃ i, B i)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsOpen (B i) ∧ B i ⊆ N ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ B i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f i) x ≠ 0) ∧

    (hBσ : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ → σ x = |f i x|)

      IsCompact (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) ∧
      IsPreconnected (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) ∧
      (c ≤ σ x₀ → (∃ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, σ x < c) →

    ∃ (S : Set M) (Ψ : ℝ → M → M) (s₁ : ℝ),
      0 < s₁ ∧ IsCompact S ∧ S.Nonempty ∧ IsPreconnected S ∧

      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ s' ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, ∀ ℓ' ∈ S,

      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, s ≠ 0 → Ψ s ℓ ∉ frontier U) ∧
      (∀ ℓ ∈ S, collarSlabChartAt g U φ S Ψ s₁ ℓ)

          = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) d) z • e d := by
        intro k
        rw [hu (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (e k))]
        simp only [hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)]
      simp only [hcD]
      show g.g (Φ z) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z (e j)) = _
      rw [hΦD, hΦD, hJ i, hJ j]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    
    have s3 : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).source,
        (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w) a) z).det
          ≠ 0 := by
      intro z hz hdet
      obtain ⟨v, hv0, hJv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
      have hloc := PartialDiffeomorph.isLocalDiffeomorphAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ hz.1
      have hinj : ∀ u : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ z u = 0 → u = 0 := by
        intro u hu0
        rw [← hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv_coe (by simp)] at hu0
        exact (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv (by simp)).map_eq_zero_iff.mp hu0
      have hw : fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w)) z (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
        ext a
        rw [map_sum]
        simp only [map_smul]
        have := congrFun hJv a
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
          hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)] at this
        simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          WithLp.ofLp_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
        rw [← this]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      have h0 : (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
        apply hinj
        rw [hM1' z hz, hw]
        exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero _
      apply hv0
      funext a
      rw [← hcomp_e v a, h0]
      rfl
    
    have hVo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' Φ.target) :=
      (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).open_target
        Φ.open_target
    have hσ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v => Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v))
        ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' Φ.target) := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm Φ.target :=
        Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun
      have h3 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm
          (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      have hcomp := h1.comp (h3.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun v hv => hv.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcomp
    have hyV : chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x) ∈
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).target ∩ (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm ⁻¹' Φ.target := by
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).map_source (mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x)), ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) ∈ Φ.target
      rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x))]
      exact Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hx
    have hσy : Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))) = x := by
      rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x))]
      exact Φ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hx
    have hσd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v => Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v))
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) :=
      (hσ.contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds hyV)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    
    have chain : ∀ (u0 : M → ℝ) (j : Fin 3), partialDeriv j (fun y => u0 (Φ y)) x =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun v => u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v))
            (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) *
          partialDeriv j (fun w' => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w') a) x := by
      intro u0 j
      by_cases hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun v => u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v))
          (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))
      · have hev : (fun y => u0 (Φ y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
            (fun y => (fun v => u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ y))) := by
          filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hxU] with y hy
          show u0 (Φ y) = u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ y)))
          rw [(chartAt E3 (Φ x)).left_inv hy.2]
        have e1 : partialDeriv j (fun y => u0 (Φ y)) x = partialDeriv j
            (fun y => (fun v => u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ y))) x := by
          unfold partialDeriv
          rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
        rw [e1]
        exact pd_comp _ (fun w' => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w')) x (hψd x hxU) hd j
      · have hnd : ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u0 (Φ y)) x := by
          intro hdx
          apply hd
          have hdx' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u0 (Φ y))
              (Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))) := by
            rw [hσy]; exact hdx
          have hc := hdx'.comp (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) hσd
          refine hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
          filter_upwards [hVo.mem_nhds hyV] with v hv
          have hr := Φ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hv.2
          show u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v) =
            u0 (Φ (Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)))
          exact congrArg u0 hr.symm
        have e1 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u0 (Φ y)) x = 0 := fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hnd
        have e2 : fderiv ℝ (fun v => u0 ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) = 0 :=
          fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt hd
        simp only [partialDeriv, e1, e2, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, zero_mul,
          Finset.sum_const_zero]
    have halg := bil_alg
      (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w' => chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ w') a) x)
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x))) (g.coeff Φ x)
      (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun v => u ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))
      (fun b => partialDeriv b (fun v => w ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))
      (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun y => u (Φ y)) x)
      (fun j => partialDeriv j (fun y => w (Φ y)) x)
      (s3 x hxU) (fun i j => s1 x hxU i j) (fun i => chain u i) (fun j => chain w j)
    have hL : g.gradInner u w (Φ x) = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)))⁻¹ a b *
          partialDeriv a (fun v => u ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) *
          partialDeriv b (fun v => w ((chartAt E3 (Φ x)).symm v)) (chartAt E3 (Φ x) (Φ x)) := rfl
    rw [hL]
    exact halg.symm
  have hpair := pair Φ (g.levelMeanCurv f) f y₀ hy₀src
  have hLΦ : (fun y => g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y₀]
      levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y' => f (Φ y')) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hy₀src) (fun y hy =>
      levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φ f (fun y' => f (Φ y')) hf y hy
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl)))
  have hstar : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y₀)⁻¹ i j *
      partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y' => f (Φ y'))) y₀ *
      partialDeriv j (fun y' => f (Φ y')) y₀ = 0 := by
    have h := hjac
    rw [hja, hpair] at h
    refine Eq.trans ?_ h
    simp only [partialDeriv, hLΦ.fderiv_eq]
    rfl
  
  have hbd : DifferentiableAt ℝ b y₀ :=
    (hb.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy₀U)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hfhat : HasFDerivAt (fun y' => f (Φ y'))
      (ε • (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) y₀ := by
    have h1 := (hf1d y₀).add ((hf1d y₀).mul ((hf1d y₀).mul hbd.hasFDerivAt))
    have hev : (fun y' => f (Φ y')) =ᶠ[𝓝 y₀]
        (fun y => ε * y 0 + ε * y 0 * (ε * y 0 * b y)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy₀U)
        (fun y hy => by
          show f (Φ y) = ε * y 0 + ε * y 0 * (ε * y 0 * b y)
          rw [hform y hy]; ring)
    refine (h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).congr_fderiv ?_
    simp [hy₀0]
  have hpfhat : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun y' => f (Φ y')) y₀ = ε * (e j) 0 := by
    intro j
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y' => f (Φ y')) y₀ (e j) = ε * (e j) 0
    rw [hfhat.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  have hpHf : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y' => f (Φ y'))) y₀ =
      ε * partialDeriv i H y₀ := by
    intro i
    rw [(hjet y₀ hy₀U hy₀0).2 i]
    have hfun : levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y : E3 => ε * y 0) = fun y => ε * H y := funext hH1
    rw [hfun]
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => ε * H y) y₀ (e i) = ε * fderiv ℝ H y₀ (e i)
    rw [fderiv_const_mul hHd, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hd0 : partialDeriv 0 H y₀ = 0 := by
    have h1 := htan 1 (by decide)
    have h2 := htan 2 (by decide)
    have hs := hstar
    simp only [hpHf, hpfhat, Fin.sum_univ_three, h1, h2, he00, he10, he20] at hs
    have hpos : 0 < (G y₀)⁻¹ 0 0 := (hGpd y₀ hy₀src).inv.diag_pos
    have h3 : ε ^ 2 * ((G y₀)⁻¹ 0 0 * partialDeriv 0 H y₀) = 0 := by linear_combination hs
    rw [hε2, one_mul] at h3
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left hpos.ne'
  
  refine ⟨hH0 y₀ hy₀U hy₀0, ?_⟩
  have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => hpLift s x₀) (e 0) 0 := by
    have h := (((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const (e 0)).add_const ((x₀ 0) • e 1)).add_const
      ((x₀ 1) • e 2)
    simp only [id, one_smul] at h
    exact h
  have hfin := hHd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0 : ℝ) hγ rfl
  have hd0' : fderiv ℝ H y₀ (e 0) = 0 := hd0
  rw [hd0'] at hfin
  exact hfin

subgoal_signatures.name: jacobiCoord_invariance
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (f a F : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ a U) (hF : ∀ y ∈ U, F y = f y + f y ^ 2 * a y) (y₁ : E3) (hy₁ : y₁ ∈ U) (hf0 : f y₁ = 0) (hdf : fderiv ℝ f y₁ ≠ 0) : levelMeanCurvCoord G F y₁ = levelMeanCurvCoord G f y₁ ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G F) y₁ = partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord G f) y₁

subgoal_signatures.name: levelMeanCurvCoord_rescale
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f ψ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (hsymm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j = (G y)⁻¹ j i) (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (β : Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (h1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i ψ y = c * partialDeriv i f y)
    (h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ψ) y =
      c * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y + β i * partialDeriv j f y +
        β j * partialDeriv i f y) :
    levelMeanCurvCoord G ψ y * |c| = c * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y

subgoal_signatures.name: levelMeanCurv_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ x) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) h x

subgoal_signatures.name: lmc_contDiffOn
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (φ : E3 → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ U) (hdφ : ∀ z ∈ U, fderiv ℝ φ z ≠ 0) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (levelMeanCurvCoord G φ) U

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_contDiffOn_source
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ φ.source) :
    (g.coeff φ y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: coord_division
subgoal_signatures.statement: (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (f h : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (hf0 : f y₀ = 0) (hdf : fderiv ℝ f y₀ ≠ 0) (hz : ∀ y ∈ U, f y = 0 → h y = 0) : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ u : E3 → ℝ, Metric.ball y₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u (Metric.ball y₀ r) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, h y = f y * u y

subgoal_signatures.name: collar_zero_minimal
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig : Set M) (hSm : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g Sig) (q : M) (hq : q ∈ Sig) (V : Set M)
    (f : M → ℝ) (hVo : IsOpen V) (hqV : q ∈ V) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hdf : ∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) (hVS : V ∩ Sig = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}) :
    ∃ O : Set E3, IsOpen O ∧ chartAt E3 q q ∈ O ∧ O ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
      ∀ y ∈ O, f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = 0 →
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y
          = 0

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (hSc : IsCompact S) (hSne : S.Nonempty) (hSpc : IsPreconnected S)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (s₁ : ℝ) (hs₁ : 0 < s₁)
    (G : Fin P.n → E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hGs : ∀ j (a b : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G j y a b)
      {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ P.W j})
    (hGsymm : ∀ j (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G j y a b = G j y b a)
    (hGpd : ∀ j, ∀ y : E3, |y 0| < s₁ → hpProj y ∈ P.W j → (G j y).PosDef)
    (hGc : ∀ j k, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      G j (hpLift s x) = pullbackMetric (G k)
        (fun y => hpLift (y 0) (P.proj k (P.param j (hpProj y)))) (hpLift s x))
    (hleaf : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      levelMeanCurvCoord (G j) (fun y => y 0) (hpLift 0 x) = 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun s => levelMeanCurvCoord (G j) (fun y => y 0) (hpLift s x)) 0 0) :
    ∃ (t₁ : ℝ) (u : ℝ → X → ℝ) (h : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < t₁ ∧
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => u p.1 (P.param j p.2))
        (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁ ×ˢ P.W j)) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ S, u 0 q = 0) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, ∀ q ∈ S, u t q ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < deriv (fun τ => u τ (P.param j x)) t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
        levelMeanCurvCoord (G j) (fun y => y 0 - u t (P.param j (hpProj y)))
          (hpLift (u t (P.param j x)) x) = h t) ∧
      h 0 = 0 ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁)

      G j (hpLift s x) = pullbackMetric (G k)

      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,

by
  obtain ⟨B, Hop, r, e₁, c, ℓ, ev, C, hιE, hιE0, hr, hHs, hHc, he₁, hc, hℓ, hH0, hD0, hiso,
    hreg, hlin, hev1, hC0, hCb, hslab, htrans⟩ :=

    ls_ift_scale B hιE hιE0 Hop r hr hHs hHc e₁ he₁ c hc ℓ hℓ hH0 hD0 hiso hreg _ hεpos

    intro v w q
    have h1 := congrFun (hlin 1 v w) q

    intro q
    have h1 := hadd 0 0 q

    intro a v q
    have h1 := congrFun (hlin a v 0) q

    intro j x hx
    have hmem : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

    intro t ht
    rw [← hV0e t ht, hιE0]

    intro j

    rw [map_add, map_smul, he₁, hVk p.1 hp.1]

    intro q _
    show ev ((0 : ℝ) • e₁ 0 + V 0) q = 0

    intro t ht q hq

    have hIoo : Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁ ∈ 𝓝 t := Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2

    have hVd : DifferentiableAt ℝ V t := hV0d.congr_of_eventuallyEq hVev.symm

    rw [hcomp.deriv, hlam, hadd, one_smul, hev1 q hq]

      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd.le hC0
    have h2 : C * (1 / (2 * (C + 1))) < 1 := by
      rw [mul_one_div, div_lt_one (by positivity)]
      linarith
    have h3 := neg_abs_le (ev (deriv V t) q)
    linarith
  · 
    intro t ht j x hx

    (hιE : ∀ k, Function.Injective (B.ιE k)) (hιE0 : ∀ v, B.ιE 0 v = v)

    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :

        Hop 0 (t • e₁ 0 + V t) = h t • c 0 ∧ ‖deriv V t‖ < ε) ∧

    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (s₁ : ℝ) (hs₁ : 0 < s₁)
    (G : Fin P.n → E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hGs : ∀ j (a b : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G j y a b)
      {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ P.W j})
    (hGsymm : ∀ j (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G j y a b = G j y b a)
    (hGpd : ∀ j, ∀ y : E3, |y 0| < s₁ → hpProj y ∈ P.W j → (G j y).PosDef)
    (hGc : ∀ j k, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      G j (hpLift s x) = pullbackMetric (G k)
        (fun y => hpLift (y 0) (P.proj k (P.param j (hpProj y)))) (hpLift s x))
    (hleaf : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      levelMeanCurvCoord (G j) (fun y => y 0) (hpLift 0 x) = 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun s => levelMeanCurvCoord (G j) (fun y => y 0) (hpLift s x)) 0 0) :
    ∃ (B : BanachScale) (Hop : ∀ k, B.E k → B.F k) (r : ℝ) (e₁ : ∀ k, B.E k) (c : ∀ k, B.F k)
      (ℓ : B.E 0 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ev : B.E 0 → X → ℝ) (C : ℝ),
      (∀ k, Function.Injective (B.ιE k)) ∧ (∀ v, B.ιE 0 v = v) ∧ 0 < r ∧
      (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Hop k) {v | ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r}) ∧
      (∀ k (v : B.E k), B.ιF k (Hop k v) = Hop 0 (B.ιE k v)) ∧
      (∀ k, B.ιE k (e₁ k) = e₁ 0) ∧ (∀ k, B.ιF k (c k) = c 0) ∧ ℓ (e₁ 0) = 1 ∧
      Hop 0 0 = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) 0 (e₁ 0) = 0 ∧
      (∀ k (v : B.E k), ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r → ∀ f : B.F k,
        ∃! p : B.E k × ℝ, ℓ (B.ιE k p.1) = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (Hop k) v p.1 - p.2 • c k = f) ∧
      (∀ k (v : B.E 0), ‖v‖ < r → ∀ a : ℝ, Hop 0 v = a • c 0 → ∃ w : B.E k, B.ιE k w = v) ∧
      (∀ (a : ℝ) (v w : B.E 0), ev (a • v + w) = fun q => a * ev v q + ev w q) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ S, ev (e₁ 0) q = 1) ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ v, ∀ q ∈ S, |ev v q| ≤ C * ‖v‖) ∧
      (∀ v : B.E 0, ‖v‖ < r → (∀ q ∈ S, ev v q ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁) ∧
        ∀ a : ℝ, Hop 0 v = a • c 0 → ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
          levelMeanCurvCoord (G j) (fun y => y 0 - ev v (P.param j (hpProj y)))
            (hpLift (ev v (P.param j x)) x) = a) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (I : Set ℝ), IsOpen I → ∀ γ : ℝ → B.E k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ γ I →
        ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × E2 => ev (B.ιE k (γ p.1)) (P.param j p.2))

by
  
  have hexp3 : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k • e k := by
    intro v
    ext k
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  
  have hexp2 : ∀ v : E2, v = ∑ c : Fin 2, v c • e2 c := by
    intro v
    ext k
    fin_cases k <;> simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  
  have hs1 : ∀ (φ : E3 → M) (F : E2 → E3) (y : E2) (i j : Fin 2),
      pullMetric2 (g.coeff φ) F y i j =
        g.g (φ (F y)) ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ (F y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (fderiv ℝ F y (e2 i)))
          ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ (F y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (fderiv ℝ F y (e2 j))) := by
    intro φ F y i j
    set L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ (F y) with hLdef
    set B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := g.g (φ (F y)) with hBdef
    have hL : ∀ v : E3, L v = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k • L (e k) := by
      intro v
      conv_lhs => rw [hexp3 v]
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul]
    have hc : ∀ k l : Fin 3, g.coeff φ (F y) k l = B (L (e k)) (L (e l)) := fun k l => rfl
    have hbil : ∀ u w : E3, B (L u) (L w) = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        u k * g.coeff φ (F y) k l * w l := by
      intro u w
      rw [hL u, hL w]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, hc]
      first
        | (refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)); ring1)
        | (rw [Finset.sum_comm]
           refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)); ring1)
    unfold pullMetric2
    exact (hbil _ _).symm
  
  have hp : (chartAt E3 z₁).symm (F₁ x) = (chartAt E3 z₂).symm (F₂ (τ x)) := heq.self_of_nhds
  have hd₁ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z₁).symm (F₁ x) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 z₁) h₁
  have hd₂ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z₂).symm (F₂ (τ x)) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 z₂) h₂
  set L₁ : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z₁).symm (F₁ x) with hL₁
  set L₂ : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z₂).symm (F₂ (τ x)) with hL₂
  have hchain : ∀ v : E2, L₁ (fderiv ℝ F₁ x v) = L₂ (fderiv ℝ F₂ (τ x) (fderiv ℝ τ x v)) := by
    intro v
    have hev : ((chartAt E3 z₁).symm ∘ F₁) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] ((chartAt E3 z₂).symm ∘ (F₂ ∘ τ)) := heq
    have hm := hev.mfderiv_eq (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E2)) (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, E3))
    have h1 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E2) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 z₁).symm ∘ F₁) x v =
        L₁ (fderiv ℝ F₁ x v) := by
      rw [mfderiv_comp_apply x hd₁ hF₁.mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      rfl
    have h2 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E2) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 z₂).symm ∘ (F₂ ∘ τ)) x v =
        L₂ (fderiv ℝ F₂ (τ x) (fderiv ℝ τ x v)) := by
      rw [mfderiv_comp_apply x hd₂ (hF₂.comp x hτ).mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv,
        fderiv_comp x hF₂ hτ]
      rfl
    rw [← h1, ← h2, hm]
    rfl
  
  have hs3 : ∀ u w : E2,
      g.g ((chartAt E3 z₂).symm (F₂ (τ x))) (L₂ (fderiv ℝ F₂ (τ x) u))
          (L₂ (fderiv ℝ F₂ (τ x) w)) =
        ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, u c *
          g.g ((chartAt E3 z₂).symm (F₂ (τ x))) (L₂ (fderiv ℝ F₂ (τ x) (e2 c)))

    intro u w

    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
    first
      | (refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)); ring1)
      | (rw [Finset.sum_comm]
         refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => ?_)); ring1)
  
  intro a b
  have hR : ∀ c d : Fin 2, pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z₂).symm) F₂ (τ x) c d =
      g.g ((chartAt E3 z₂).symm (F₂ (τ x))) (L₂ (fderiv ℝ F₂ (τ x) (e2 c)))

      (L₁ (fderiv ℝ F₁ x (e2 b))) =

          fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) d := by
    rw [hchain, hchain, hp, hs3]
    simp only [hR]
  rw [hs1 _ F₁ x a b]
  exact key

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (U N : Set M) (σ : M → ℝ) (x₀ : M) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hNo : IsOpen N)
    (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U ∩ N)
    (hσ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)
    (S : Set M) (hSc : IsCompact S) (hSne : S.Nonempty) (P : EigPatchedSurface M S)
    (Φ : Fin P.n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (Ψ : ℝ → M → M) (s₁ : ℝ)
    (hs₁ : 0 < s₁)
    (hΦ : ∀ j, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, hpLift s x ∈ (Φ j).source ∧
      Φ j (hpLift s x) = Ψ s (P.param j x))
    (hΨ0 : ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ 0 ℓ ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U)
    (hΨ0s : ∀ p ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ 0 ℓ = p)
    (hΨC : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ s ℓ ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀)
    (hΨinj : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ s' ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, ∀ ℓ' ∈ S,
      Ψ s ℓ = Ψ s' ℓ' → s = s' ∧ ℓ = ℓ')
    (hΨthin : ∀ m ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀,
      σ x ≤ δ → ∃ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 m, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ s ℓ = x)
    (u : ℝ → M → ℝ) (t₁ : ℝ) (ht₁ : 0 < t₁)
    (hus : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => u p.1 (P.param j p.2))
      (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁ ×ˢ P.W j))
    (hu0 : ∀ ℓ ∈ S, u 0 ℓ = 0)
    (hub : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, u t ℓ ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁)
    (hud : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      0 < deriv (fun τ => u τ (P.param j x)) t) :
    ∃ (O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ),
      IsOpen O ∧ O ⊆ N ∧ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      0 < t₀ ∧ t₀ < t₁ ∧
      ContinuousOn w (O ∩ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O ∩ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀), x ∈ frontier U → w x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, 0 < w x) ∧
      IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∩ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∧ w x ≤ t₀} ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x < t₁ ∧ ∃ ℓ ∈ S, x = Ψ (u (w x) ℓ) ℓ) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₀, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ ∈ O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, w (Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ) = t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, u t ℓ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁) ∧
      (∀ j, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
        Φ j (hpLift s x) ∈ O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ →
        0 < partialDeriv 0 (fun y => w (Φ j y)) (hpLift s x))

signature.name: leaf_foliation_coordinate
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (U N : Set M) (σ : M → ℝ) (x₀ : M) (hUo : IsOpen U) (hNo : IsOpen N)
    (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U ∩ N)
    (hσ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)
    (S : Set M) (hSc : IsCompact S) (hSne : S.Nonempty) (P : EigPatchedSurface M S)
    (Φ : Fin P.n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (Ψ : ℝ → M → M) (s₁ : ℝ)
    (hs₁ : 0 < s₁)
    (hΦ : ∀ j, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, hpLift s x ∈ (Φ j).source ∧
      Φ j (hpLift s x) = Ψ s (P.param j x))
    (hΨ0 : ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ 0 ℓ ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U)
    (hΨ0s : ∀ p ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ 0 ℓ = p)
    (hΨC : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ s ℓ ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀)
    (hΨinj : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ s' ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, ∀ ℓ' ∈ S,
      Ψ s ℓ = Ψ s' ℓ' → s = s' ∧ ℓ = ℓ')
    (hΨthin : ∀ m ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀,
      σ x ≤ δ → ∃ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 m, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ s ℓ = x)
    (u : ℝ → M → ℝ) (t₁ : ℝ) (ht₁ : 0 < t₁)
    (hus : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => u p.1 (P.param j p.2))
      (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁ ×ˢ P.W j))
    (hu0 : ∀ ℓ ∈ S, u 0 ℓ = 0)
    (hub : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, u t ℓ ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁)
    (hud : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      0 < deriv (fun τ => u τ (P.param j x)) t) :
    ∃ (O : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (t₀ : ℝ),
      IsOpen O ∧ O ⊆ N ∧ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      0 < t₀ ∧ t₀ < t₁ ∧
      ContinuousOn w (O ∩ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O ∩ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀), x ∈ frontier U → w x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, 0 < w x) ∧
      IsCompact {x | x ∈ O ∩ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∧ w x ≤ t₀} ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, w x < t₁ ∧ ∃ ℓ ∈ S, x = Ψ (u (w x) ℓ) ℓ) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₀, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ ∈ O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, w (Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ) = t) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, u t ℓ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁) ∧
      (∀ j, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
        Φ j (hpLift s x) ∈ O ∩ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ →
        0 < partialDeriv 0 (fun y => w (Φ j y)) (hpLift s x))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set C := connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ with hCdef
  
  have hparS : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ S := by
    intro j x hx
    have h : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at h
    exact h.2
  have hrepS : ∀ ℓ ∈ S, ∃ j, ∃ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x = ℓ := by
    intro ℓ hℓ
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hℓ)
    have h : ℓ ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hj, hℓ⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩ := h
    exact ⟨j, x, hx, hxe⟩
  
  have hmono := fun ℓ (hℓ : ℓ ∈ S) => lfc_u_strictMono S P u t₁ s₁ hu0 hub hud ℓ hℓ
  obtain ⟨hcu, hcΨ⟩ := lfc_joint_continuousOn S P Φ Ψ s₁ hΦ u t₁ hus hub
  have hrange : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, u t ℓ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁ :=
    fun t ht ℓ hℓ => (hmono ℓ hℓ).2.2.1 t ht
  have hinj : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ t' ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, ∀ ℓ' ∈ S,
      Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ = Ψ (u t' ℓ') ℓ' → t = t' ∧ ℓ = ℓ' := by
    intro t ht t' ht' ℓ hℓ ℓ' hℓ' h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hΨinj _ (hrange t ht ℓ hℓ) _ (hrange t' ht' ℓ' hℓ') ℓ hℓ ℓ' hℓ' h
    subst h2
    exact ⟨(hmono ℓ hℓ).1.injOn ⟨by linarith [ht.1], ht.2⟩ ⟨by linarith [ht'.1], ht'.2⟩ h1, rfl⟩
  have hCUN : C ⊆ U ∩ N := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : Set M, ∀ x, x ∈ R ↔ ∃ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, x = Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ :=
    ⟨{x | ∃ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, x = Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ}, fun x => Iff.rfl⟩
  have hRmem : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ ∈ R :=
    fun t ht ℓ hℓ => (hRdef _).2 ⟨t, ht, ℓ, hℓ, rfl⟩
  have hRC : R ⊆ C := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, ℓ, hℓ, rfl⟩ := (hRdef x).1 hx
    exact hΨC _ (hrange t ht ℓ hℓ) ℓ hℓ
  
  obtain ⟨w, hwdef⟩ : ∃ w : M → ℝ, ∀ x, w x =
      if h : ∃ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁ ∧ ∃ ℓ ∈ S, x = Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ then Classical.choose h else 0 :=
    ⟨_, fun x => rfl⟩
  have hW1 : ∀ x ∈ R, w x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁ ∧ ∃ ℓ ∈ S, x = Ψ (u (w x) ℓ) ℓ := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : ∃ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁ ∧ ∃ ℓ ∈ S, x = Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ := (hRdef x).1 hx
    rw [hwdef x, dif_pos hx']
    exact Classical.choose_spec hx'
  have hW2 : ∀ x, x ∉ R → w x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hwdef x, dif_neg (fun h => hx ((hRdef x).2 h))]
  have hW3 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, w (Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ) = t := by
    intro t ht ℓ hℓ
    obtain ⟨h1, ℓ', hℓ', h2⟩ := hW1 _ (hRmem t ht ℓ hℓ)
    exact ((hinj t ht _ h1 ℓ hℓ ℓ' hℓ' h2).1).symm
  
  have ht₀ : (0:ℝ) < t₁ / 2 := by linarith
  have ht₀₁ : t₁ / 2 < t₁ := by linarith
  have hcu0 : ContinuousOn (fun ℓ => u (t₁ / 2) ℓ) S :=
    hcu.comp (continuousOn_const.prodMk continuousOn_id)
      (fun ℓ hℓ => ⟨⟨by linarith, ht₀₁⟩, hℓ⟩)
  obtain ⟨ℓm, hℓmS, hℓmin⟩ := hSc.exists_isMinOn hSne hcu0
  have hm : u (t₁ / 2) ℓm ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁ := hrange _ ⟨ht₀, ht₀₁⟩ ℓm hℓmS
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδthin⟩ := hΨthin _ hm
  obtain ⟨O', hO'o, hFO', hO'sub⟩ := hσ0 δ hδ
  have hthin : ∀ x ∈ C, x ∈ O' → ∃ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 (t₁ / 2), ∃ ℓ ∈ S, x = Ψ (u t ℓ) ℓ := by
    intro x hxC hxO'
    have hxU : x ∈ U := (hCUN hxC).1
    have h1 := hO'sub ⟨hxU, hxO'⟩
    have hσx : σ x < δ := h1.2
    obtain ⟨s, hs, ℓ, hℓ, hΨs⟩ := hδthin x hxC hσx.le
    have hle : u (t₁ / 2) ℓm ≤ u (t₁ / 2) ℓ := hℓmin hℓ
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hts⟩ := (hmono ℓ hℓ).2.2.2 (t₁ / 2) ⟨ht₀, ht₀₁⟩ s
      ⟨hs.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hs.2 hle⟩
    exact ⟨t, ht, ℓ, hℓ, by rw [hts, hΨs]⟩
  have hO'R : ∀ x ∈ R ∩ O', w x < t₁ / 2 := by
    rintro x ⟨hxR, hxO'⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht, ℓ, hℓ, rfl⟩ := hthin x (hRC hxR) hxO'
    rw [hW3 t ⟨ht.1, by linarith [ht.2]⟩ ℓ hℓ]
    exact ht.2
  
  have hLOC : ∀ j, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      ∃ V : Set M, IsOpen V ∧ V ⊆ R ∧ Φ j (hpLift (u t (P.param j x)) x) ∈ V ∧
        ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w V ∧
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w (Φ j (hpLift (u t (P.param j x)) x)) ≠ 0 ∧
        0 < partialDeriv 0 (fun y' => w (Φ j y')) (hpLift (u t (P.param j x)) x) := by
    intro j t ht x hx
    obtain ⟨A, B, T, hpA, hAsub, hBo, hBrep, hAB, hTs, hTd⟩ :=
      lfc_graph_local_inverse (P.W j) (P.W_open j) 0 t₁
        (fun p : ℝ × E2 => u p.1 (P.param j p.2))
        ((hus j).mono (Set.prod_mono (Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) le_rfl) subset_rfl))
        (fun p hp => hud p.1 ⟨by linarith [hp.1.1], hp.1.2⟩ j p.2 hp.2) (t, x) ⟨ht, hx⟩
    have hBΦ : ∀ y' ∈ B, y' ∈ (Φ j).source ∧ Φ j y' ∈ R ∧ w (Φ j y') = T y' := by
      intro y' hy'
      obtain ⟨p, hpA', hy'eq⟩ := hBrep y' hy'
      have hy'eq' : y' = hpLift (u p.1 (P.param j p.2)) p.2 := hy'eq
      have hT' : T (hpLift (u p.1 (P.param j p.2)) p.2) = p.1 := (hAB p hpA').2
      have hp := hAsub hpA'
      have hℓ := hparS j p.2 hp.2
      have hp1 : p.1 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁ := hp.1
      obtain ⟨hsrc, hΦe⟩ := hΦ j _ (hub p.1 ⟨by linarith [hp1.1], hp1.2⟩ _ hℓ) p.2 hp.2
      rw [hy'eq']
      refine ⟨hsrc, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hΦe]; exact hRmem p.1 hp1 _ hℓ
      · rw [hΦe, hW3 p.1 hp1 _ hℓ, hT']
    obtain ⟨hVo, hws, hd⟩ := lfc_chart_transfer (Φ j) B hBo (fun y' hy' => (hBΦ y' hy').1) T hTs
      w (fun y' hy' => (hBΦ y' hy').2.2)
    have hyB : hpLift (u t (P.param j x)) x ∈ B := (hAB (t, x) hpA).1
    have hd0 := hd _ hyB
    have hTpos : 0 < partialDeriv 0 T (hpLift (u t (P.param j x)) x) := hTd
    refine ⟨(Φ j) '' B, hVo, ?_, ⟨_, hyB, rfl⟩, hws, hd0.2 (ne_of_gt hTpos), ?_⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩
      exact (hBΦ y' hy').2.1
    · rw [hd0.1]; exact hTpos
  have hzrep : ∀ z ∈ R, ∃ j, ∃ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∃ x ∈ P.W j,
      z = Φ j (hpLift (u t (P.param j x)) x) := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨t, ht, ℓ, hℓ, rfl⟩ := (hRdef z).1 hz
    obtain ⟨j, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hrepS ℓ hℓ
    refine ⟨j, t, ht, x, hx, ?_⟩
    rw [(hΦ j _ (hub t ⟨by linarith [ht.1], ht.2⟩ _ hℓ) x hx).2]
  have hRo : IsOpen R := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open]
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨j, t, ht, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hzrep z hz
    obtain ⟨V, hVo, hVR, hzV, -⟩ := hLOC j t ht x hx
    exact ⟨V, hVR, hVo, hzV⟩
  have hL2 : ∀ z ∈ R, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w z ∧
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w z ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨j, t, ht, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hzrep z hz
    obtain ⟨V, hVo, hVR, hzV, hws, hdw, -⟩ := hLOC j t ht x hx
    exact ⟨hws.contMDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds hzV), hdw⟩
  have hwR : ContinuousOn w R := fun z hz => (hL2 z hz).1.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hL3 : ∀ j, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, Φ j (hpLift s x) ∈ R →
      0 < partialDeriv 0 (fun y => w (Φ j y)) (hpLift s x) := by
    intro j s hs x hx hR
    obtain ⟨t, ht, ℓ, hℓ, heq⟩ := (hRdef _).1 hR
    rw [(hΦ j s ⟨by linarith [hs.1], hs.2⟩ x hx).2] at heq
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hΨinj s hs _ (hrange t ht ℓ hℓ) _ (hparS j x hx) ℓ hℓ heq
    subst h2
    subst h1
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, hpos⟩ := hLOC j t ht x hx
    exact hpos
  
  set O : Set M := (O' ∪ R) ∩ N with hOdef
  have hOo : IsOpen O := (hO'o.union hRo).inter hNo
  have hON : O ⊆ N := Set.inter_subset_right
  have hRN : R ⊆ N := fun x hx => (hCUN (hRC hx)).2
  have hRU : R ⊆ U := fun x hx => (hCUN (hRC hx)).1
  have hRO : R ⊆ O := fun x hx => ⟨Or.inr hx, hRN hx⟩
  have hFCO : closure C ∩ frontier U ⊆ O := fun x hx => ⟨Or.inl (hFO' hx.2), hFN hx.2⟩
  have hO1 : O ∩ C ⊆ R := by
    rintro x ⟨⟨hx | hx, -⟩, hxC⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, ℓ, hℓ, rfl⟩ := hthin x hxC hx
      exact hRmem t ⟨ht.1, by linarith [ht.2]⟩ ℓ hℓ
    · exact hx
  have hCL : closure C ∩ (U ∩ N) ⊆ C := by
    rintro y ⟨hyc, hyUN⟩
    have hpc : IsPreconnected (insert y C) :=
      isPreconnected_connectedComponentIn.subset_closure (Set.subset_insert y C)
        (Set.insert_subset hyc subset_closure)
    exact hpc.subset_connectedComponentIn (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (mem_connectedComponentIn hx₀))
      (Set.insert_subset hyUN hCUN) (Set.mem_insert y C)
  have hfrU : ∀ x, x ∈ frontier U → x ∉ U := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hUo.frontier_eq] at hx
    exact hx.2
  have hO2 : O ∩ closure C = R ∪ (closure C ∩ frontier U) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxO, hxc⟩
      by_cases hxU : x ∈ U
      · exact Or.inl (hO1 ⟨hxO, hCL ⟨hxc, hxU, hON hxO⟩⟩)
      · right
        refine ⟨hxc, ?_⟩
        rw [hUo.frontier_eq]
        exact ⟨closure_mono (fun y hy => (hCUN hy).1) hxc, hxU⟩
    · rintro (hx | hx)
      · exact ⟨hRO hx, subset_closure (hRC hx)⟩
      · exact ⟨hFCO hx, hx.1⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  
  let Lp : E3 →L[ℝ] E2 :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e2 0) +
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e2 1)
  have hLpEq : ∀ z : E3, Lp z = hpProj z := by
    intro z
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [Lp, hpProj, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hLpfun : (Lp : E3 → E2) = hpProj := funext hLpEq
  have hPe0 : hpProj (e 0) = 0 := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPcd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ hpProj := by
    rw [← hLpfun]; exact Lp.contDiff
  have hPcont : Continuous hpProj := hPcd.continuous
  have hP0 : ∀ y : E3, HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y 0)
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
    fun y => (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
  have hLpd : ∀ y : E3, HasFDerivAt hpProj Lp y := by
    intro y; rw [← hLpfun]; exact Lp.hasFDerivAt
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : E3 → ℝ, F = fun y => y 0 - v (hpProj y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hFd : ∀ y : E3, hpProj y ∈ W → HasFDerivAt F
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) - (fderiv ℝ v (hpProj y)).comp Lp) y := by
    intro y hy
    have hvd : DifferentiableAt ℝ v (hpProj y) :=
      (hv.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)
    rw [hFdef]
    exact (hP0 y).sub (hvd.hasFDerivAt.comp y (hLpd y))
  have hF1 : ∀ y : E3, hpProj y ∈ W → fderiv ℝ F y (e 0) = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [(hFd y hy).fderiv]
    show (e 0 : E3) 0 - fderiv ℝ v (hpProj y) (Lp (e 0)) = 1
    rw [hLpEq, hPe0, map_zero]
    simp [e]
  have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (hpProj ⁻¹' W) := by
    rw [hFdef]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffOn.sub
      (hv.comp hPcd.contDiffOn (fun y hy => hy))
  have hFy0 : F y₀ = 0 := by rw [hFdef]; exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hF0
  have hdf : fderiv ℝ F y₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := hF1 y₀ hy₀W
    rw [h] at this
    simp at this
  
  have hB1 : IsOpen (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' D) :=
    Φ.contMDiffOn.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Φ.open_source hD
  have hBo : IsOpen ((Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' D) ∩ hpProj ⁻¹' W) := hB1.inter (hW.preimage hPcont)
  have hy₀B : y₀ ∈ (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' D) ∩ hpProj ⁻¹' W := ⟨⟨hy₀s, hy₀D⟩, hy₀W⟩
  have hus1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (w ∘ Φ) (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' D) :=
    hw.comp (Φ.contMDiffOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hy.2)
  have hus : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w (Φ y)) ((Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' D) ∩ hpProj ⁻¹' W) :=
    (contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hus1).mono Set.inter_subset_left
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr, μ, hball, hμs, hdiv⟩ := coord_division _ hBo F (fun y => w (Φ y) - w (Φ y₀))
    (hFs.mono Set.inter_subset_right) (hus.sub contDiffOn_const) y₀ hy₀B hFy0 hdf
    (by
      intro y hy hFy
      have h0 : y 0 = v (hpProj y) := by
        rw [hFdef] at hFy; exact sub_eq_zero.mp hFy
      show w (Φ y) - w (Φ y₀) = 0
      rw [hlev y hy.1.1 hy.1.2 hy.2 h0, sub_self])
  
  have hballN : Metric.ball y₀ r ∈ 𝓝 y₀ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds y₀ hr
  have hFdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ F y₀ := (hFd y₀ hy₀W).differentiableAt
  have hμdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ μ y₀ :=
    (hμs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hballN
  have hE : (fun y => w (Φ y) - w (Φ y₀)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y₀] (fun y => F y * μ y) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem hballN hdiv
  have hμeq : partialDeriv 0 (fun y => w (Φ y)) y₀ = μ y₀ := by
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => w (Φ y) - w (Φ y₀)) y₀ = fderiv ℝ (fun y => F y * μ y) y₀ :=
      hE.fderiv_eq
    have h2 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => F y * μ y) y₀ = F y₀ • fderiv ℝ μ y₀ + μ y₀ • fderiv ℝ F y₀ :=
      (hFdiff.hasFDerivAt.mul hμdiff.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
    rw [fderiv_sub_const, h2] at h1
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h1]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hF1 y₀ hy₀W, hFy0]
    ring
  have hμpos : 0 < μ y₀ := hμeq ▸ hw1
  have hμne : μ y₀ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμpos
  
  have hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), g.coeff Φ y i j = g.coeff Φ y j i := by
    intro y i j
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
    exact g.symm _ _ _
  have hs12 : levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) (fun y => F y * μ y) y₀ =
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) F y₀ := by
    have h := lmc_mul_zero (g.coeff Φ) (Metric.ball y₀ r) Metric.isOpen_ball hsymm F μ
      (hFs.mono (fun y hy => (hball hy).2)) hμs y₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
      (coeff_posDef g Φ y₀ hy₀s) hFy0 hdf hμne
    rw [abs_of_pos hμpos] at h
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hμne (h.trans (mul_comm _ _))
  
  have hcongr : ∀ (h₁ h₂ : E3 → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (y : E3), (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, h₁ z = h₂ z + c) →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) h₁ y = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) h₂ y := by
    intro h₁ h₂ c y hev
    have hev' : h₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => h₂ z + c) := hev
    have hd : fderiv ℝ h₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fderiv ℝ h₂ := by
      filter_upwards [hev'.eventuallyEq_nhds] with z hz
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ) hz, fderiv_add_const]
    have hP1 : ∀ k, partialDeriv k h₁ y = partialDeriv k h₂ y := by
      intro k
      show fderiv ℝ h₁ y (e k) = fderiv ℝ h₂ y (e k)
      rw [hd.eq_of_nhds]
    have hP2 : ∀ i j, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h₁) y =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h₂) y := by
      intro i j
      have hj : partialDeriv j h₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] partialDeriv j h₂ := by
        filter_upwards [hd] with z hz
        show fderiv ℝ h₁ z (e j) = fderiv ℝ h₂ z (e j)
        rw [hz]
      show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j h₁) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j h₂) y (e i)
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ) hj]
    have hH : ∀ i j, hessLoc (g.coeff Φ) h₁ i j y = hessLoc (g.coeff Φ) h₂ i j y := by
      intro i j
      simp only [hessLoc, hP2, hP1]
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, lapLoc, hH, hP1]
  have hs13 : levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) (fun y => w (Φ y)) y₀ =
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) (fun y => F y * μ y) y₀ := by
    refine hcongr _ _ (w (Φ y₀)) y₀ ?_
    filter_upwards [hballN] with y hy
    have := hdiv y hy
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨b, -, hb⟩ :=
    (SmoothBumpFunction.nhds_basis_tsupport (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (Φ y₀)).mem_iff.mp
      (hD.mem_nhds hy₀D)
  have hw's : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => b x * w x) := by
    apply contMDiff_of_tsupport
    intro x hx
    have hxb : x ∈ tsupport b := tsupport_mul_subset_left hx
    have hxD : x ∈ D := hb hxb
    exact (b.contMDiff.contMDiffAt).mul (hw.contMDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hxD))
  have hgerm : (fun x => b x * w x) =ᶠ[𝓝 (Φ y₀)] w := by
    filter_upwards [b.eventuallyEq_one] with x hx
    rw [hx, Pi.one_apply, one_mul]
  have hΦc : ContinuousAt Φ y₀ :=
    Φ.contMDiffOn.continuousOn.continuousAt (Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hy₀s)
  have hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y₀, b (Φ z) * w (Φ z) = w (Φ z) := hΦc.tendsto.eventually hgerm
  have hs14 : g.levelMeanCurv w (Φ y₀) =
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) (fun y => w (Φ y)) y₀ := by
    rw [levelMeanCurv_congr_of_eventuallyEq g w (fun x => b x * w x) (Φ y₀) hgerm.symm]
    exact levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φ (fun x => b x * w x) (fun y => w (Φ y)) hw's y₀ hy₀s hfh
  rw [hs14, hs13, hs12, hFdef]

signature.name: slab_graph_param_regular
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (z : M) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (a : ℝ) (v : ℝ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => v p.1 p.2) (Set.Ioo (-a) a ×ˢ W))
    (hsrc : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-a) a, ∀ x ∈ W, hpLift (v t x) x ∈ Φ.source ∧
      Φ (hpLift (v t x) x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source) :

      (Set.Ioo (-a) a ×ˢ W) ∧
