proof.tactics:
by
  have hD : IsOpen (Set.Ioo (-a) a ×ˢ W) := isOpen_Ioo.prod hW
  
  have hOo : IsOpen (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source) :=
    Φ.contMDiffOn.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Φ.open_source (chartAt E3 z).open_source
  have hH : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => chartAt E3 z (Φ y)) (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source) := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun y => chartAt E3 z (Φ y))
        (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source) :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart (x := z)).comp (Φ.contMDiffOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (fun y hy => hy.2)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  have hinv : ∀ y ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source,
      Φ.symm ((chartAt E3 z).symm (chartAt E3 z (Φ y))) = y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [(chartAt E3 z).left_inv hy.2]
    exact Φ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hy.1
  have hQd : ∀ y ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q => Φ.symm ((chartAt E3 z).symm q)) (chartAt E3 z (Φ y)) := by
    intro y hy
    have hTo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Φ.target) :=
      (chartAt E3 z).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm Φ.open_target
    have hq : chartAt E3 z (Φ y) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Φ.target := by
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 z).map_source hy.2, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 z).symm (chartAt E3 z (Φ y)) ∈ Φ.target
      rw [(chartAt E3 z).left_inv hy.2]
      exact Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hy.1
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun q => Φ.symm ((chartAt E3 z).symm q))
        ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Φ.target) :=
      Φ.symm.contMDiffOn.comp ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := z)).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (fun q hq => hq.2)
    have h2 := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    exact (h2.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hTo.mem_nhds hq)
  
  have hPL : ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : E2), hpProj (hpLift s x) = x := by
    intro s x; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hpLift, hpProj, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPeq : hpProj = fun z : E3 => (z 1) • e2 0 + (z 2) • e2 1 := by
    funext z; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPdiff : Differentiable ℝ hpProj := by rw [hPeq]; fun_prop
  have hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => hpLift (v p.1 p.2) p.2) (Set.Ioo (-a) a ×ˢ W) := by
    have hΛ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × E2 => q.1 • e 0 + (q.2 0) • e 1 + (q.2 1) • e 2) := by
      fun_prop
    have hin : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => (v p.1 p.2, p.2)) (Set.Ioo (-a) a ×ˢ W) :=
      hv.prodMk contDiffOn_snd
    exact hΛ.comp_contDiffOn hin
  have hstar : ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo (-a) a ×ˢ W,
      hpLift (v p.1 p.2) p.2 ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source :=
    fun p hp => hsrc p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2
  have hF1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v p.1 p.2) p.2)))
      (Set.Ioo (-a) a ×ˢ W) := hH.comp hL hstar
  have key : ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo (-a) a ×ˢ W,
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v p.1 p.2) p.2))) p :=
    fun p hp => hF1.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hp)
  refine ⟨hF1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c d p hp
    apply ContDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
    have hfd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × E2 =>
        fderiv ℝ (fun x => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v q.1 x) x))) q.2) p := by
      refine ContDiffAt.fderiv
        (f := fun (q : ℝ × E2) (x : E2) => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v q.1 x) x)))
        (g := Prod.snd) (x₀ := p) (m := ∞) (n := ∞) ?_ contDiffAt_snd ?_
      · have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun r : (ℝ × E2) × E2 => (r.1.1, r.2)) (p, p.2) := by
          fun_prop
        have h3 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
            ((fun p : ℝ × E2 => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v p.1 p.2) p.2))) ∘
              (fun r : (ℝ × E2) × E2 => (r.1.1, r.2))) (p, p.2) :=
          ContDiffAt.comp (p, p.2) (key p hp) h2
        exact h3
      · simp
    have hA : ∀ (c' : Fin 2) (k : Fin 3), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × E2 =>
        (fderiv ℝ (fun x => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v q.1 x) x))) q.2 (e2 c')) k) p := by
      intro c' k
      have h1 := hfd.clm_apply (contDiffAt_const (c := e2 c'))
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp p h1
    have hB : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × E2 =>
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v q.1 q.2) q.2))) k l) p := by
      intro k l
      have hmem : chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v p.1 p.2) p.2)) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target :=
        (chartAt E3 z).map_source (hstar p hp).2
      exact ((g.smooth z k l).contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 z).open_target.mem_nhds hmem)).comp p
        (key p hp)
    simp only [pullMetric2]
    apply ContDiffAt.sum
    intro k _
    apply ContDiffAt.sum
    intro l _
    exact ((hA c k).mul (hB k l)).mul (hA d l)
  · intro t ht x hx
    have hy := hsrc t ht x hx
    have hfc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v t x') x'))) x := by
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x' : E2 => (t, x')) x := by fun_prop
      have h3 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
          ((fun p : ℝ × E2 => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v p.1 p.2) p.2))) ∘
            (fun x' : E2 => (t, x'))) x :=
        ContDiffAt.comp x (key (t, x) ⟨ht, hx⟩) h2
      exact h3
    have hfx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v t x') x'))) x :=
      hfc.differentiableAt (by simp)
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 z).map_source hy.2, hfx, ?_⟩
    have hQ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q => hpProj (Φ.symm ((chartAt E3 z).symm q)))
        (chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v t x) x))) :=
      (hPdiff _).comp _ (hQd _ hy)
    have hev : ((fun q => hpProj (Φ.symm ((chartAt E3 z).symm q))) ∘
        (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v t x') x')))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] id := by
      filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hx] with x' hx'
      show hpProj (Φ.symm ((chartAt E3 z).symm (chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v t x') x'))))) = x'
      rw [hinv _ (hsrc t ht x' hx'), hPL]
    have hcomp := fderiv_comp x hQ hfx
    have hid : fderiv ℝ ((fun q => hpProj (Φ.symm ((chartAt E3 z).symm q))) ∘
        (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v t x') x')))) x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2 := by
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id]
    have hli : Function.LeftInverse
        (fderiv ℝ (fun q => hpProj (Φ.symm ((chartAt E3 z).symm q)))
          (chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v t x) x))))
        (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v t x') x'))) x) := by
      intro ξ
      have h := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] E2 => L ξ) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h
    exact hli.injective

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) :
    ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ c : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w z * pd2 b w z) y =
        2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          (h y)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) c a y * pd2 b w y

signature.name: bl2_grad_Q
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) :
    ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ c : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w z * pd2 b w z) y =
        2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          (h y)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) c a y * pd2 b w y

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y hy c
  have hsymm : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h z i j = h z j i := by
    intro z hz i j
    have h1 := (hpos z hz).isHermitian.apply i j
    rw [star_trivial] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have G := gs2_metric_calculus h W hW hh hsymm hpos
  have hPd : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) y := fun a b =>
    ((G.1 a b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)
  have hω : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 a w) W := by
    intro a
    have h1 := hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := ∞) (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hωd : ∀ a : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 a w) y := fun a =>
    ((hω a).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)
  have hprod3 : ∀ (p q u : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ p y → DifferentiableAt ℝ q y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ u y →
      pd2 c (fun x => p x * q x * u x) y =
        pd2 c p y * q y * u y + p y * pd2 c q y * u y + p y * q y * pd2 c u y := by
    intro p q u hp hq hu
    unfold pd2
    have hpq : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => p x * q x) y := hp.mul hq
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hpq hu, fderiv_fun_mul hp hq]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hsum : ∀ (F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ), (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F i) y) →
      pd2 c (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, F i x) y = ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 c (F i) y := by
    intro F hF
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => hF i), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have hD : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b w x) y := fun a b =>
    ((hPd a b).mul (hωd a)).mul (hωd b)
  have d1 : ∀ a : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b w x) y :=
    fun a => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => hD a b)
  have e1 : pd2 c (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w z * pd2 b w z) y =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b w x) y := by
    rw [hsum _ d1]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    rw [hsum _ (fun b => hD a b)]
  have e2 : ∀ a b : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b w x) y =
      pd2 c (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) y * pd2 a w y * pd2 b w y
        + (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 c (pd2 a w) y * pd2 b w y
        + (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w y * pd2 c (pd2 b w) y := fun a b =>
    hprod3 _ _ _ (hPd a b) (hωd a) (hωd b)
  have hg : (h y)⁻¹ 1 0 = (h y)⁻¹ 0 1 := G.2.1 y hy 1 0
  rw [e1]
  simp only [e2, G.2.2.2.2.2 y hy c]
  simp only [gsCovD1, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  rw [hg]
  ring

subgoal_signatures.name: gs2_metric_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) (hhsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j y = christoffel2 h k j i y) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j) k i j y = 0) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m))

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) (i j : Fin 2) :
    pd2 i (fun y => 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (h y)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a y * pd2 b w y) x
      - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x *
        (2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          (h x)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) k a x * pd2 b w x) =
    2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (h x)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) i j a x * pd2 b w x
      + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (h x)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a x * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) i b x

    have h1 := hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := ∞) (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hωω : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 a (pd2 b w)) W := by
    intro a b
    have h1 := (hω b).fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := ∞) (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hH : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) i j) W := by
    intro i j
    have e : gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) i j = fun y =>
        pd2 i (pd2 j w) y - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m i j y * pd2 m w y := by
      funext y; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact (hωω i j).sub (ContDiffOn.sum (fun m _ => (G.2.2.1 m i j).mul (hω m)))
  have hdiff : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → DifferentiableAt ℝ f x := fun f hf =>
    (hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a b) x :=
    fun a b => hdiff _ (G.1 a b)
  have hB : ∀ a : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a) x :=
    fun a => hdiff _ (hH j a)
  have hC : ∀ b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 b w) x := fun b => hdiff _ (hω b)
  have key : ∀ a b : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a b *
      gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a y * pd2 b w y)
      (((h x)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a x) • fderiv ℝ (pd2 b w) x +
        pd2 b w x • ((h x)⁻¹ a b • fderiv ℝ (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a) x +
          gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a x • fderiv ℝ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a b) x)) x :=
    fun a b => ((hA a b).hasFDerivAt.mul (hB a).hasFDerivAt).mul (hC b).hasFDerivAt
  have hF := (HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun a _ =>
    HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun b _ => key a b))).const_mul (2 : ℝ)
  have hL : pd2 i (fun y => 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
      (h y)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a y * pd2 b w y) x =
    2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
      (pd2 i (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a b) x * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a x * pd2 b w x
       + (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 i (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a) x * pd2 b w x
       + (h x)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) j a x * pd2 i (pd2 b w) x) := by
    show fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 i) = _
    rw [hF.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    unfold pd2
    ring
  have hdG : ∀ a b : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a b) x =
      -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h a i m x * (h x)⁻¹ m b + christoffel2 h b i m x * (h x)⁻¹ a m) :=
    fun a b => G.2.2.2.2.2 x hx i a b
  have hdω : ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 b w) x =
      gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) i b x + ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m i b x * pd2 m w x := by
    intro b
    simp only [gsCovD1]
    ring
  rw [hL]
  simp only [gsCovD2]
  simp only [hdG, hdω]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

subgoal_signatures.name: gs2_metric_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) (hhsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j y = christoffel2 h k j i y) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j) k i j y = 0) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m))

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) (l i k : Fin 2) :
    gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) l i k x
      - gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) i l k x =
    -∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x * pd2 m w x

signature.name: bl2_oneform_ricci
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) (l i k : Fin 2) :
    gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) l i k x
      - gsCovD2 h (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w)) i l k x =
    -∑ m : Fin 2, gsRiem2 h m l i k x * pd2 m w x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hsymm : ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h y i j = h y j i := by
    intro y hy i j
    have h1 := (hpos y hy).isHermitian.apply i j
    rw [star_trivial] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have G := gs2_metric_calculus h W hW hh hsymm hpos
  have hU : W ∈ 𝓝 x := hW.mem_nhds hx
  have hω : ∀ b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 b w) W := by
    intro b
    have h1 := hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := ∞) (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hωω : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 a (pd2 b w)) W := by
    intro a b
    have h1 := (hω b).fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := ∞) (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have dΓ : ∀ m a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (christoffel2 h m a b) x := fun m a b =>
    ((G.2.2.1 m a b).contDiffAt hU).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have dω : ∀ m : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 m w) x := fun m =>
    ((hω m).contDiffAt hU).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have dωω : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 a (pd2 b w)) x := fun a b =>
    ((hωω a b).contDiffAt hU).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have schwarz : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ∀ a b : Fin 2,
      pd2 a (pd2 b f) x = pd2 b (pd2 a f) x := by
    intro f hf a b
    have hfx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x := hf.contDiffAt hU
    have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f x := hfx.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; norm_cast)
    have hdf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x :=
      ((((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW).1 hf).2).contDiffAt hU).differentiableAt
        (by simp)
    have key : ∀ a b : Fin 2, pd2 a (pd2 b f) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x (e2 a) (e2 b) := by
      intro a b
      have H : HasFDerivAt (pd2 b f)
          ((fderiv ℝ f x).comp (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x).flip (e2 b)) x :=
        hdf.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e2 b) x)
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 b f) x (e2 a) = _
      rw [H.fderiv]
      simp
    rw [key a b, key b a]
    exact hsym (e2 a) (e2 b)
  
  have expand : ∀ a b c : Fin 2, pd2 a (gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) b c) x =
      pd2 a (pd2 b (pd2 c w)) x
        - ∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 a (christoffel2 h m b c) x * pd2 m w x
            + christoffel2 h m b c x * pd2 a (pd2 m w) x) := by
    intro a b c
    have H : HasFDerivAt (fun y => pd2 b (pd2 c w) y
          - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m b c y * pd2 m w y)
        (fderiv ℝ (pd2 b (pd2 c w)) x
          - ∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h m b c x • fderiv ℝ (pd2 m w) x
              + pd2 m w x • fderiv ℝ (christoffel2 h m b c) x)) x :=
      (dωω b c).hasFDerivAt.sub
        (HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) fun m _ =>
          (dΓ m b c).hasFDerivAt.mul (dω m).hasFDerivAt)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => pd2 b (pd2 c w) y
          - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m b c y * pd2 m w y) x (e2 a) = _
    rw [H.fderiv]
    simp only [pd2, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  simp only [gsCovD2]
  rw [expand l i k, expand i l k, schwarz (pd2 k w) (hω k) l i]
  simp only [gsCovD1, gsRiem2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  rw [G.2.2.2.1 x hx 0 i l, G.2.2.2.1 x hx 1 i l]
  ring

subgoal_signatures.name: gs2_metric_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) (hhsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j y = christoffel2 h k j i y) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j) k i j y = 0) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m))

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (Q : Set M) (hQ : IsOpen Q) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w Q)
    (hdw : ∀ x ∈ Q, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0)
    (hcm : ℝ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ x ∈ Q, g.levelMeanCurv w x = hcm (w x))
    (t : ℝ) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ hcm t) :
    IsOpen ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) - t)
      ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q,
      fderiv ℝ (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') - t) y ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q,
      ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') - t) y =
        g.gradInner w w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q, w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) = t →
      ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') - t) y =
        deriv hcm t * ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') - t) y)

signature.name: cml_chart_data
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (z : M) (Q : Set M) (hQ : IsOpen Q) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w Q)
    (hdw : ∀ x ∈ Q, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0)
    (hcm : ℝ → ℝ) (hH : ∀ x ∈ Q, g.levelMeanCurv w x = hcm (w x))
    (t : ℝ) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ hcm t) :
    IsOpen ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) - t)
      ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q,
      fderiv ℝ (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') - t) y ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q,
      ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') - t) y =
        g.gradInner w w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q, w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) = t →
      ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') - t) y =
        deriv hcm t * ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') - t) y)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hCU := chart_unit_normal_calculus g Q w hQ hw hdw z
  have hUo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q) :=
    (chartAt E3 z).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hQ
  
  have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) - t) =
      partialDeriv i (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) := by
    intro i
    funext y
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_sub_const]
  have hS : ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) - t) =
      ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) := by
    funext y
    simp only [ejpS, hpd]
  have hhess : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) - t) i j =
      hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) i j := by
    intro i j
    funext y
    simp only [hessLoc, hpd]
  have hLc : levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
        (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) - t) =
      levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) := by
    funext y
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, lapLoc, hhess, hpd]
  have hJ : ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) - t) =
      ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) := by
    funext y
    simp only [ejpJac, hLc, hpd]
  
  have hcrux : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Q →
      ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y =
        g.gradInner w w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) := by
    intro y hy hyQ
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, x = (chartAt E3 z).symm y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hx] at hyQ ⊢
    obtain ⟨f, -, hfQ⟩ :=
      (SmoothBumpFunction.nhds_basis_tsupport (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) x).mem_iff.1 (hQ.mem_nhds hyQ)
    obtain ⟨u, hu_def⟩ : ∃ u : M → ℝ, u = fun p => f p * w p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u := by
      rw [hu_def]
      apply contMDiff_of_tsupport
      intro p hp
      have hpQ : p ∈ Q := hfQ (tsupport_mul_subset_left hp)
      exact (f.contMDiff p).mul (hw.contMDiffAt (hQ.mem_nhds hpQ))
    have huw : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 x, u p = w p := by
      filter_upwards [f.eventuallyEq_one] with p hp
      rw [hu_def]
      simp only [Pi.one_apply] at hp
      simp [hp]
    have hgerm : ∀ (q : M) (v : E3), v ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → (chartAt E3 q).symm v = x →
        ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun v' => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm v')) v =
          partialDeriv i (fun v' => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm v')) v := by
      intro q v hv hvx i
      have hc := (chartAt E3 q).continuousAt_symm hv
      have huw' : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 ((chartAt E3 q).symm v), u p = w p := by
        rw [hvx]
        exact huw
      have h1 : (fun v' => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm v')) =ᶠ[𝓝 v]
          (fun v' => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm v')) := hc.eventually huw'
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq h1]
    have hL : g.gradInner w w x = g.gradInner u u x := by
      have h := hgerm x (chartAt E3 x x) (mem_chart_target E3 x)
        ((chartAt E3 x).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x))
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, h]
    have hR := (chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu z).2.1 y hy
    rw [← hx] at hR
    rw [hL, hR]
    have h := hgerm z y hy hx.symm
    simp only [ejpS, h]
  refine ⟨hUo, hCU.1.sub contDiffOn_const, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro y hy hzero
    have hx : (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ Q ∩ (chartAt E3 z).source :=
      ⟨hy.2, (chartAt E3 z).map_target hy.1⟩
    have h1 := (hCU.2 _ hx).1
    rw [(chartAt E3 z).right_inv hy.1] at h1
    have hpz : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) y = 0 := by
      intro a
      rw [← hpd a]
      simp only [partialDeriv]
      rw [hzero]
      rfl
    simp [hpz] at h1
  · 
    intro y hy
    rw [hS]
    exact hcrux y hy.1 hy.2
  · 
    intro y hy hyt
    have hlev : ∀ y' ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' Q,
        levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) y' =
          hcm (w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) := by
      intro y' hy'
      have h1 := (hCU.2 _ ⟨hy'.2, (chartAt E3 z).map_target hy'.1⟩).2.1
      rw [(chartAt E3 z).right_inv hy'.1] at h1
      rw [← h1]
      exact hH _ hy'.2
    have hev : levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
        (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun y' => hcm (w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y'))) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hy) hlev
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) y :=
      (hCU.1.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hUo.mem_nhds hy)
    have hd' : HasDerivAt hcm (deriv hcm t) ((fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) y) := by
      show HasDerivAt hcm (deriv hcm t) (w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y))
      rw [hyt]
      exact hd.hasDerivAt
    have hcomp := hd'.comp_hasFDerivAt y hfd.hasFDerivAt
    have hfd2 : fderiv ℝ (levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
        (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y))) y =
        deriv hcm t • fderiv ℝ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) y := by
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      exact hcomp.fderiv
    have hpdL : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
        (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y))) y =
        deriv hcm t * partialDeriv i (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) y := by
      intro i
      simp only [partialDeriv, hfd2, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hJ, hS]
    simp only [ejpJac, ejpS, hpdL, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring

subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (D : Set M) (w : M → ℝ) (hD : IsOpen D) (hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w D) (hdw : ∀ x ∈ D, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0) (p : M) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' D) ∧ ∀ x ∈ D ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source, 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p x))⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) * partialDeriv b (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ g.levelMeanCurv w x = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) ∧ (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) : E3) = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p x) i) ∧ g.g x ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (fun i => calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) i)) = 1

signature.statement:

    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (z : M)
    (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hUt : U ⊆ (chartAt E3 z).target)
    (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0)
    (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (F : E2 → E3) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W)
    (hFW : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ U ∧ Φ (F x) = 0 ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x))
    (c : ℝ) (hJ : ∀ x ∈ W, ejpJac (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) =

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hFU : ∀ y ∈ W, F y ∈ U := fun y hy => (hFW y hy).1
  have hFt : ∀ y ∈ W, F y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target := fun y hy => hUt (hFU y hy)
  have hΦF : ∀ y ∈ W, Φ (F y) = 0 := fun y hy => (hFW y hy).2.1
  have hinj : ∀ y ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F y) := fun y hy => (hFW y hy).2.2
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j)
      (chartAt E3 z).target := fun i j => g.smooth z i j
  have hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y j i :=
    fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  have hGpos : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y).PosDef :=
    fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g z y hy
  have hGU : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j) U :=
    fun i j => (hGs i j).mono hUt
  have hGposU : ∀ y ∈ U, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y).PosDef := fun y hy => hGpos y (hUt hy)
  obtain ⟨hSpos, -, hψ, -⟩ :=
    ejp_level_regularity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ U hU hGU hGposU hΦ hdΦ
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) W :=
    hψ.comp hF (fun y hy => hFU y hy)
  have hupos : ∀ y ∈ W, 0 < ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y) := by
    intro y hy
    unfold ejpPsi
    exact inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hSpos _ (hFU y hy)))
  obtain ⟨hh, hhsymm, hhpos, -, -, -, hA2⟩ :=
    gs_regularity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (chartAt E3 z).target (chartAt E3 z).open_target
      hGs hGsymm hGpos F W hW hF hFt hinj
  refine ⟨hu, fun x hx => ⟨hupos x hx, ?_⟩⟩
  have hFxU : F x ∈ U := hFU x hx
  have hu0 : 0 < ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) := hupos x hx
  have hS0 : 0 < ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) := hSpos _ hFxU
  have hS2 : ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) ^ 2 *
      ejpS (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) = 1 := by
    unfold ejpPsi
    rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hS0.le, inv_mul_cancel₀ hS0.ne']
  
  have hlap := ejp_immersion_lap2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ
    (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ) U hU hGU hGsymm hGposU hΦ hdΦ hψ F W hW hF hFW x hx
  have hamb := ejp_ambient_identity (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ U hU hGU hGsymm hGposU
    hΦ hdΦ (F x) hFxU
  have hJx := hJ x hx
  have hL : lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
      (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x =
      -(ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x)) *
        ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) - c := by
    linear_combination hlap + hamb -
      ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) ^ 2 * hJx - c * hS2
  have hLdiv : lap2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
      (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x /
        ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) =
      -(ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x)) -
        c * (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x))⁻¹ := by
    rw [hL]
    field_simp
  
  have hconf := gaussCurv2_conformal_mul (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
    (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) W hW hh hhsymm hhpos hu hupos x hx
  beta_reduce at hconf
  
  have hgauss := gs_gauss_equation (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (chartAt E3 z).target
    (chartAt E3 z).open_target hGs hGsymm hGpos F W hW hF hFt hinj x hx
  
  have hzero : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, Φ (F y) = 0 := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) hΦF
  have hΦ2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 Φ (F x) :=
    (hΦ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hFxU)).of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
  have hsff := (gs_levelset_param (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F Φ W hW x hx hF
    (hinj x hx) hGsymm (hGpos _ (hFt x hx)) hΦ2 (hdΦ _ hFxU) hzero).1
  have hpot : ejpPot (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) =
      gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x + ejpRic (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x) := by
    rw [← hsff]
    rfl
  
  have htan : ∀ i : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Φ (F x) (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hΦd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (F x) :=
      (hΦ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hFxU)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x :=
      (hF.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hc : fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (F y)) x = (fderiv ℝ Φ (F x)).comp (fderiv ℝ F x) :=
      fderiv_comp x hΦd hFd
    have h0 : fderiv ℝ (fun y => Φ (F y)) x = 0 := by
      rw [(show (fun y => Φ (F y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) from hzero).fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_const_apply _
    have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e2 i)) (hc.symm.trans h0)
    simpa using h3
  
  have htrace := jcc_scalar_trace (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (chartAt E3 z).target
    (chartAt E3 z).open_target hGs hGsymm hGpos Φ F x (hFt x hx) (hinj x hx) (hdΦ _ hFxU) htan
  
  let Φc : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
    { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 z).symm.toPartialEquiv
      open_source := (chartAt E3 z).open_target
      open_target := (chartAt E3 z).open_source
      contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
  have hRc : g.scalarCurvature ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) =
      scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (F x) :=
    scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff g Φc (F x) (hFt x hx)
  have hRnn : 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) := hR _
  
  have hhinv : ((pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹).PosDef := (hhpos x hx).inv
  have hQv : (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹ a b *
      pd2 a (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x *
      pd2 b (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x) =
      dotProduct (star (fun a : Fin 2 => pd2 a
          (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x))
        (Matrix.mulVec (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹
          (fun a : Fin 2 => pd2 a (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x)) := by
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hQnn : 0 ≤ (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
      (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹ a b *
      pd2 a (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x *
      pd2 b (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x) := by
    by_cases hv0 : (fun a : Fin 2 =>
        pd2 a (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x) = 0
    · have h0 : ∀ a : Fin 2,
          pd2 a (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x = 0 :=
        fun a => congrFun hv0 a
      simp [h0]
    · rw [hQv]
      exact (hhinv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0).le
  have hQdiv := div_nonneg hQnn (sq_nonneg (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x)))
  have hH2 := sq_nonneg (gsMeanCurv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)
  have hstar : gaussCurv2 (fun y => (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) ^ 2 •
        pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F y) x *
        (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x)) ^ 2 =
      c * (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x))⁻¹ +
        g.scalarCurvature ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) / 2 +
        gsSffSq (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x / 2 +
        gsMeanCurv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x ^ 2 / 2 +
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x)⁻¹ a b *
          pd2 a (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x *
          pd2 b (fun y => ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F y)) x) /
          (ejpPsi (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) Φ (F x)) ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination hconf - hLdiv + hgauss + hpot - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * hRc - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * htrace
  rw [hstar]
  linarith [hA2 x hx]

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_level_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) : (∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ejpS G Φ y) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpS G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPsi G Φ) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ejpPot G Φ) U

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_immersion_lap2
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ u : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFW : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ U ∧ Φ (F x) = 0 ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : lap2 (pullMetric2 G F) (fun x' => u (F x')) x = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ (F x) a b * hessLoc G u a b (F x)) - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ (F x) c d * hessLoc G Φ c d (F x)) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ (F x) a * partialDeriv a u (F x)) / ejpS G Φ (F x)

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_ambient_identity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) (hdΦ : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ Φ y ≠ 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y a b * hessLoc G (ejpPsi G Φ) a b y) - (∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, ejpP G Φ y c d * hessLoc G Φ c d y) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ejpN G Φ y a * partialDeriv a (ejpPsi G Φ) y) / ejpS G Φ y + ejpPot G Φ y * ejpPsi G Φ y = -(ejpPsi G Φ y) ^ 2 * ejpJac G Φ y

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullMetric2 G F x i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j = pullMetric2 G F x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, (pullMetric2 G F x).PosDef) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSff G F i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsSff G F i j x = gsSff G F j i x) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSffSq G F) s ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ gsSffSq G F x)

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_gauss_equation
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : ∀ x ∈ s, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 G F) x = gsAmbPlane G F x / (pullMetric2 G F x).det + (gsMeanCurv G F x ^ 2 - gsSffSq G F x) / 2

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_levelset_param
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (f : E3 → ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : (G (F x)).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f (F x)) (hdf : fderiv ℝ f (F x) ≠ 0) (hzero : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f (F y) = 0) : secondFundSq G f (F x) = gsSffSq G F x ∧ (levelMeanCurvCoord G f (F x) = 0 ↔ gsMeanCurv G F x = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff

proof.tactics:
by
  have hinf : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s → ∀ c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 c f) s := by
    intro f hf c
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) s :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 hf).2
    exact hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdet : ∀ y ∈ s, (h y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hpos y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).det) s := by
    have heq : (fun y => (h y).det) = fun y => h y 0 0 * h y 1 1 - h y 0 1 * h y 1 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_two (h y)
    rw [heq]
    exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).adjugate i j) s := by
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] <;>
      first | exact hh _ _ | exact (hh _ _).neg
  have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s := by
    intro i j
    have heq : (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) = fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹ * (h y).adjugate i j := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact (hdetS.inv hdet).mul (hadj i j)
  have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s := by
    intro k i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
      (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x)) s
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hinv k l).mul
      (((hinf _ (hh j l) i).add (hinf _ (hh i l) j)).sub (hinf _ (hh i j) l)))
  have hchrC : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (christoffel2 h k i j) s :=
    fun k i j => (hchr k i j).continuousOn
  have hdchr : ∀ c k i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (pd2 c (christoffel2 h k i j)) s :=
    fun c k i j => (hinf _ (hchr k i j) c).continuousOn
  have hric : ∀ j k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (ricci2 h j k) s := by
    intro j k
    show ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2,
        (pd2 i (christoffel2 h i j k) x - pd2 j (christoffel2 h i i k) x)
      + ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2,
          (christoffel2 h i i p x * christoffel2 h p j k x
            - christoffel2 h i j p x * christoffel2 h p i k x)) s
    exact (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => (hdchr i i j k).sub (hdchr j i i k)).add
      (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun p _ =>
        ((hchrC i i p).mul (hchrC p j k)).sub ((hchrC i j p).mul (hchrC p i k)))
  show ContinuousOn
    (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ j k * ricci2 h j k x) s
  exact continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
    continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun k _ => (hinv j k).continuousOn.mul (hric j k))

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hfam, hfam_def⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → Fin P.n → E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ,
      f = fun s j y => ((v j y) ^ s) ^ 2 • P.h j y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have s1 : ∀ (s : ℝ) (j : Fin P.n) (y : E2) (c d : Fin 2),
      hfam s j y c d = ((v j y) ^ s) ^ 2 * P.h j y c d := by
    intro s j y c d
    rw [hfam_def]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hs : ∀ j (c d : Fin 2), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => hfam p.1 j p.2 c d)
      (Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 2 ×ˢ P.W j) := by
    intro j c d
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => v j p.2) (Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 2 ×ˢ P.W j) :=
      (hv j).comp contDiffOn_snd (fun p hp => hp.2)
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => p.1) (Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 2 ×ˢ P.W j) :=
      contDiffOn_fst
    have hne : ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 2 ×ˢ P.W j, v j p.2 ≠ 0 :=
      fun p hp => (hvpos j p.2 hp.2).ne'
    have hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => P.h j p.2 c d) (Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 2 ×ˢ P.W j) :=
      (P.h_smooth j c d).comp contDiffOn_snd (fun p hp => hp.2)
    have hall := ((hf.rpow hg hne).pow 2).mul hh
    refine hall.congr ?_
    intro p _
    exact s1 p.1 j p.2 c d
  
  have hpos : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 2, ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, (hfam t j x).PosDef := by
    intro t _ j x hx
    rw [hfam_def]
    exact (P.h_posDef j x hx).smul (pow_pos (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hvpos j x hx) t) 2)
  
  have hcompat : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 2, ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      ∀ c d : Fin 2,
      hfam t j x c d = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
        fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 c) c' *
          hfam t k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) c' d' *
          fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 d) d' := by
    intro t _ j k x hx c d
    simp only [s1]
    rw [← hvc j k x hx, P.h_compat j k x hx c d]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have hTC := patched_family_total_curvature_const S hS P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hρ1 hK hρK hρO
    (-1) 2 hfam hs hpos hcompat 0 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩ 1 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  
  have h0 : ∀ j, hfam 0 j = P.h j := by
    intro j
    funext y
    rw [hfam_def]
    simp only [Real.rpow_zero, one_pow, one_smul]
  have h1 : ∀ j, hfam 1 j = fun y => (v j y) ^ 2 • P.h j y := by
    intro j
    funext y
    rw [hfam_def]
    simp only [Real.rpow_one]
  simp only [h0, h1] at hTC
  
  unfold eigWInt
  rw [hTC]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
  congr 1
  funext x
  have hdet : ((v j x) ^ 2 • P.h j x).det = ((v j x) ^ 2) ^ 2 * (P.h j x).det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_smul, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (((v j x) ^ 2) ^ 2 * (P.h j x).det) =
      (v j x) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
  rw [hdet, hsq]
  ring
