  have hpp : ∀ j, ∀ ℓ, ℓ ∈ P.O j → ℓ ∈ S → P.proj j ℓ ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j (P.proj j ℓ) = ℓ := by
    intro j ℓ hO hS
    have h : ℓ ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hO, hS⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [P.proj_param j x hx]
    exact ⟨hx, rfl⟩
  
  have hL : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × E2 => hpLift q.1 q.2) := by
    unfold hpLift cylPt
    fun_prop
  generalize hHdef : hpLift = H at hL hΦ
  
  have hloc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × M => u p.1 p.2)
        ((Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁ ×ˢ S) ∩ (Set.univ ×ˢ P.O j)) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × M => Ψ (u p.1 p.2) p.2)
        ((Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁ ×ˢ S) ∩ (Set.univ ×ˢ P.O j)) := by
    intro j
    set A := (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁ ×ˢ S) ∩ (Set.univ ×ˢ P.O j) with hA
    have hmaps2 : Set.MapsTo (Prod.snd : ℝ × M → M) A (P.O j) := fun p hp => hp.2.2
    have hpc : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × M => P.proj j p.2) A :=
      (P.proj_cont j).comp continuousOn_snd hmaps2
    have hκc : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × M => (p.1, P.proj j p.2)) A :=
      continuousOn_fst.prodMk hpc
    have hκm : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × M => (p.1, P.proj j p.2)) A
        (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁ ×ˢ P.W j) :=
      fun p hp => ⟨hp.1.1, (hpp j p.2 hp.2.2 hp.1.2).1⟩
    have hC1 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × M => u p.1 p.2) A := by
      refine ((hus j).continuousOn.comp hκc hκm).congr ?_
      intro p hp
      simp only [Function.comp]
      rw [(hpp j p.2 hp.2.2 hp.1.2).2]
    refine ⟨hC1, ?_⟩
    have hin : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × M => (u p.1 p.2, P.proj j p.2)) A :=
      hC1.prodMk hpc
    have hlc' : ContinuousOn ((fun q : ℝ × E2 => H q.1 q.2) ∘
        (fun p : ℝ × M => (u p.1 p.2, P.proj j p.2))) A :=
      Continuous.comp_continuousOn hL hin
    have hlc : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × M => H (u p.1 p.2) (P.proj j p.2)) A := hlc'
    have hlm : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × M => H (u p.1 p.2) (P.proj j p.2)) A
        (Φ j).source := by
      intro p hp
      exact (hΦ j _ (hub p.1 hp.1.1 p.2 hp.1.2) _ (hpp j p.2 hp.2.2 hp.1.2).1).1
    have hΦc : ContinuousOn (Φ j : E3 → M) (Φ j).source := (Φ j).contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
    refine (hΦc.comp hlc hlm).congr ?_
    intro p hp
    simp only [Function.comp]
    rw [(hΦ j _ (hub p.1 hp.1.1 p.2 hp.1.2) _ (hpp j p.2 hp.2.2 hp.1.2).1).2,
      (hpp j p.2 hp.2.2 hp.1.2).2]
  have hcov : ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁ ×ˢ S, ∃ j, p.2 ∈ P.O j := by
    intro p hp
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hp.2)
  refine ⟨continuousOn_of_locally_continuousOn fun p hp => ?_,
    continuousOn_of_locally_continuousOn fun p hp => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov p hp
    exact ⟨Set.univ ×ˢ P.O j, isOpen_univ.prod (P.O_open j), ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hj⟩, (hloc j).1⟩
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov p hp
    exact ⟨Set.univ ×ˢ P.O j, isOpen_univ.prod (P.O_open j), ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hj⟩, (hloc j).2⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (a b : ℝ) (v : ℝ × E2 → ℝ)
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W))
    (hd : ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W, 0 < deriv (fun τ => v (τ, p.2)) p.1)
    (p₀ : ℝ × E2) (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W) :
    ∃ (A : Set (ℝ × E2)) (B : Set E3) (T : E3 → ℝ),
      p₀ ∈ A ∧ A ⊆ Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W ∧ IsOpen B ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B, ∃ p ∈ A, y = hpLift (v p) p.2) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ A, hpLift (v p) p.2 ∈ B ∧ T (hpLift (v p) p.2) = p.1) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T B ∧
      0 < partialDeriv 0 T (hpLift (v p₀) p₀.2)

signature.name: lfc_graph_local_inverse
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (a b : ℝ) (v : ℝ × E2 → ℝ)
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W))
    (hd : ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W, 0 < deriv (fun τ => v (τ, p.2)) p.1)
    (p₀ : ℝ × E2) (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W) :
    ∃ (A : Set (ℝ × E2)) (B : Set E3) (T : E3 → ℝ),
      p₀ ∈ A ∧ A ⊆ Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W ∧ IsOpen B ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B, ∃ p ∈ A, y = hpLift (v p) p.2) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ A, hpLift (v p) p.2 ∈ B ∧ T (hpLift (v p) p.2) = p.1) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T B ∧
      0 < partialDeriv 0 T (hpLift (v p₀) p₀.2)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set D : Set (ℝ × E2) := Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W with hDdef
  have hDo : IsOpen D := isOpen_Ioo.prod hW
  
  have hL0 : ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : E2), (hpLift s x) 0 = s := by
    intro s x
    simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPL : ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : E2), hpProj (hpLift s x) = x := by
    intro s x
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hpLift, hpProj, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hLP : ∀ z : E3, hpLift (z 0) (hpProj z) = z := by
    intro z
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hpLift, hpProj, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPadd : ∀ z w : E3, hpProj (z + w) = hpProj z + hpProj w := by
    intro z w
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj]
  have hPsmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (z : E3), hpProj (c • z) = c • hpProj z := by
    intro c z
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj]
  let πₗ : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ × E2 :=
    { toFun := fun z => (z 0, hpProj z)
      map_add' := fun z w => by simp [hPadd]
      map_smul' := fun c z => by simp [hPsmul] }
  let πL : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ × E2 := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap πₗ
  have hπ : ∀ z, πL z = (z 0, hpProj z) := fun z => rfl
  have hπe : πL (e 0) = (1, 0) := by
    rw [hπ]
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · simp [e]
    · ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  let F : ℝ × E2 → ℝ × E2 := fun q => (v q, q.2)
  have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F D := hv.prodMk contDiffOn_snd
  have hcd : ∀ q ∈ D, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F q := fun q hq => hF.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hq)
  have hdiff : ∀ p ∈ D, DifferentiableAt ℝ v p := fun p hp =>
    (hv.contDiffAt (hDo.mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hE : ∀ p ∈ D, ∃ E : (ℝ × E2) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ × E2),
      HasFDerivAt F (E : (ℝ × E2) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E2)) p ∧ 0 < (E.symm (1, 0)).1 := by
    intro p hp
    set Λ := fderiv ℝ v p with hΛ
    set α := Λ ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E2)) with hα
    have hderiv : HasDerivAt (fun τ => v (τ, p.2)) α p.1 := by
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (τ, p.2)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E2)) p.1 :=
        (hasDerivAt_id p.1).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const p.1 p.2)
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt v Λ (p.1, p.2) := by
        rw [Prod.mk.eta]; exact (hdiff p hp).hasFDerivAt
      exact h2.comp_hasDerivAt p.1 h1
    have hαpos : 0 < α := by rw [← hderiv.deriv]; exact hd p hp
    have hα0 : α ≠ 0 := hαpos.ne'
    have hlin : ∀ (c : ℝ) (ξ : E2), Λ (c, ξ) = c * α + Λ (0, ξ) := by
      intro c ξ
      have : ((c, ξ) : ℝ × E2) = c • ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E2)) + ((0 : ℝ), ξ) := by
        refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_ <;> simp
      rw [this, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    let Φ' : (ℝ × E2) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E2) := Λ.prod (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E2)
    let K : (ℝ × E2) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E2) :=
      (α⁻¹ • (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E2 -
        Λ.comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E2).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E2)))).prod
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E2)
    have hΦ'app : ∀ q : ℝ × E2, Φ' q = (Λ q, q.2) := fun q => rfl
    have hKapp : ∀ q : ℝ × E2, K q = (α⁻¹ * (q.1 - Λ (0, q.2)), q.2) := fun q => rfl
    have hleft : Function.LeftInverse K Φ' := by
      rintro ⟨c, ξ⟩
      rw [hΦ'app, hKapp]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
      show α⁻¹ * (Λ (c, ξ) - Λ (0, ξ)) = c
      rw [hlin c ξ]
      calc α⁻¹ * (c * α + Λ (0, ξ) - Λ (0, ξ)) = c * (α⁻¹ * α) := by ring
        _ = c := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hα0, mul_one]
    have hright : Function.RightInverse K Φ' := by
      rintro ⟨s, ξ⟩
      rw [hKapp, hΦ'app]
      refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
      show Λ (α⁻¹ * (s - Λ (0, ξ)), ξ) = s
      rw [hlin]
      calc α⁻¹ * (s - Λ (0, ξ)) * α + Λ (0, ξ) = (s - Λ (0, ξ)) * (α⁻¹ * α) + Λ (0, ξ) := by
            ring
        _ = s := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hα0]; ring
    refine ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse Φ' K hleft hright, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hcoe : ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse Φ' K hleft hright :
          (ℝ × E2) ≃L[ℝ] (ℝ × E2)) : (ℝ × E2) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E2)) = Φ' := by
        exact ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun q => rfl
      rw [hcoe]
      exact (hdiff p hp).hasFDerivAt.prodMk hasFDerivAt_snd
    · rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_equivOfInverse,
        ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse_apply, hKapp]
      have h00 : Λ ((0 : ℝ), (0 : E2)) = 0 := by
        rw [Prod.mk_zero_zero]; exact map_zero Λ
      show 0 < α⁻¹ * ((1 : ℝ) - Λ ((0 : ℝ), (0 : E2)))
      rw [h00, sub_zero, mul_one]
      exact inv_pos.mpr hαpos
  
  obtain ⟨E₀, hE₀, hpos₀⟩ := hE p₀ hp₀
  obtain ⟨h, hhF, hp₀s, hsD, hsm, hder⟩ : ∃ h : OpenPartialHomeomorph (ℝ × E2) (ℝ × E2),
      ((⇑h : ℝ × E2 → ℝ × E2) = F) ∧ p₀ ∈ h.source ∧ h.source ⊆ D ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (⇑h.symm) h.target ∧
      HasFDerivAt (⇑h.symm) (E₀.symm : (ℝ × E2) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E2)) (F p₀) := by
    set h₀ := ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph F (hcd p₀ hp₀) hE₀ (by simp) with hh₀def
    have hh₀ : (⇑h₀ : ℝ × E2 → ℝ × E2) = F :=
      ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe _ _ _
    have hp₀h₀ : p₀ ∈ h₀.source := ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source _ _ _
    have hsrc : (h₀.restr D).source = h₀.source ∩ D := by
      rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restr_source, hDo.interior_eq]
    have hfun : (⇑(h₀.restr D) : ℝ × E2 → ℝ × E2) = F := by
      rw [OpenPartialHomeomorph.restr_apply, hh₀]
    have hp₀s : p₀ ∈ (h₀.restr D).source := by rw [hsrc]; exact ⟨hp₀h₀, hp₀⟩
    refine ⟨h₀.restr D, hfun, hp₀s, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hsrc]; exact Set.inter_subset_right
    · intro q hq
      have ha : (h₀.restr D).symm q ∈ (h₀.restr D).source := (h₀.restr D).map_target hq
      have haD : (h₀.restr D).symm q ∈ D := by rw [hsrc] at ha; exact ha.2
      obtain ⟨E', hE', -⟩ := hE _ haD
      have hC := hcd _ haD
      rw [← hfun] at hE' hC
      exact ((h₀.restr D).contDiffAt_symm hq hE' hC).contDiffWithinAt
    · have hmem : F p₀ ∈ (h₀.restr D).target := by
        rw [← hfun]; exact (h₀.restr D).map_source hp₀s
      have hinv : (h₀.restr D).symm (F p₀) = p₀ := by
        rw [← hfun]; exact (h₀.restr D).left_inv hp₀s
      have hE₀' : HasFDerivAt (⇑(h₀.restr D)) (E₀ : (ℝ × E2) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E2))
          ((h₀.restr D).symm (F p₀)) := by
        rw [hinv, hfun]; exact hE₀
      exact (h₀.restr D).hasFDerivAt_symm hmem hE₀'
  
  have KI : ∀ p : ℝ × E2, πL (hpLift (v p) p.2) = F p := by
    intro p
    rw [hπ, hL0, hPL]
  refine ⟨h.source, πL ⁻¹' h.target, fun z => (h.symm (πL z)).1, hp₀s, hsD,
    h.open_target.preimage πL.continuous, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨h.symm (πL y), h.map_target hy, ?_⟩
    have h1 : F (h.symm (πL y)) = πL y := by rw [← hhF]; exact h.right_inv hy
    rw [hπ] at h1
    have h2 : v (h.symm (πL y)) = y 0 ∧ (h.symm (πL y)).2 = hpProj y := Prod.ext_iff.mp h1
    rw [h2.1, h2.2, hLP]
  · intro p hp
    have hmem : F p ∈ h.target := by rw [← hhF]; exact h.map_source hp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show πL (hpLift (v p) p.2) ∈ h.target
      rw [KI]; exact hmem
    · show (h.symm (πL (hpLift (v p) p.2))).1 = p.1
      rw [KI, ← hhF, h.left_inv hp]
  · intro z hz
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (⇑h.symm) (πL z) :=
      (hsm _ hz).contDiffAt (h.open_target.mem_nhds hz)
    exact (contDiffAt_fst.comp z (h1.comp z πL.contDiff.contDiffAt)).contDiffWithinAt
  · have h1 : HasFDerivAt (⇑h.symm) (E₀.symm : (ℝ × E2) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E2))
        (πL (hpLift (v p₀) p₀.2)) := by
      rw [KI]; exact hder
    have hT : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => (h.symm (πL z)).1)
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E2).comp
          ((E₀.symm : (ℝ × E2) →L[ℝ] (ℝ × E2)).comp πL)) (hpLift (v p₀) p₀.2) :=
      hasFDerivAt_fst.comp _ (h1.comp _ πL.hasFDerivAt)
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hT.fderiv]
    show 0 < (E₀.symm (πL (e 0))).1
    rw [hπe]
    exact hpos₀

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (B : Set E3) (hB : IsOpen B)
    (hBs : B ⊆ Φ.source) (T : E3 → ℝ) (hT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T B) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ y ∈ B, w (Φ y) = T y) :
    IsOpen (Φ '' B) ∧ ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (Φ '' B) ∧
    ∀ y ∈ B, partialDeriv 0 (fun y' => w (Φ y')) y = partialDeriv 0 T y ∧
      (partialDeriv 0 T y ≠ 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w (Φ y) ≠ 0)

signature.name: lfc_chart_transfer
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (B : Set E3) (hB : IsOpen B)
    (hBs : B ⊆ Φ.source) (T : E3 → ℝ) (hT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T B) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ y ∈ B, w (Φ y) = T y) :
    IsOpen (Φ '' B) ∧ ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (Φ '' B) ∧
    ∀ y ∈ B, partialDeriv 0 (fun y' => w (Φ y')) y = partialDeriv 0 T y ∧
      (partialDeriv 0 T y ≠ 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w (Φ y) ≠ 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hO : IsOpen (Φ '' B) := Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source hB hBs
  have hleft : ∀ y ∈ B, Φ.symm (Φ y) = y := fun y hy => Φ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv (hBs hy)
  have hT' : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ T B := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mpr hT
  have hinv : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ.symm (Φ '' B) := by
    refine Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun.mono ?_
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source (hBs hy)
  have hcomp : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (T ∘ Φ.symm) (Φ '' B) := by
    refine hT'.comp hinv ?_
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    show Φ.symm (Φ y) ∈ B
    rw [hleft y hy]
    exact hy
  have hws : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w (Φ '' B) := by
    refine hcomp.congr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    show w (Φ y) = T (Φ.symm (Φ y))
    rw [hleft y hy, hw y hy]
  refine ⟨hO, hws, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have heq : (fun y' => w (Φ y')) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] T := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hB.mem_nhds hy) hw
  have hC3 : partialDeriv 0 (fun y' => w (Φ y')) y = partialDeriv 0 T y := by
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq heq]
  refine ⟨hC3, fun hT0 h0 => hT0 ?_⟩
  have hwA : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w (Φ y) :=
    (hws.contMDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  have hΦA : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ y :=
    (Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.contMDiffAt (Φ.open_source.mem_nhds (hBs hy))).mdifferentiableAt
      (by simp)
  have h1 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (w ∘ Φ) y = 0 := by
    rw [mfderiv_comp y hwA hΦA, h0]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp _
  have h2 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (w ∘ Φ) y = fderiv ℝ T y := by
    have heq' : (w ∘ Φ) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] T := heq
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq heq', mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
  unfold partialDeriv
  rw [← h2, h1]
  rfl

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S D R F O' : Set X) (hSc : IsCompact S) (Ψ' : ℝ → X → X) (w : X → ℝ) (t₀ t₁ : ℝ)
    (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) (ht₀₁ : t₀ < t₁)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × X => Ψ' p.1 p.2) (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁ ×ˢ S))
    (hD : D = R ∪ F) (hRF : Disjoint R F)
    (hF0 : ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ' 0 ℓ ∈ F) (hF0s : ∀ p ∈ F, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ' 0 ℓ = p)
    (hR : ∀ x ∈ R, w x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁ ∧ ∃ ℓ ∈ S, x = Ψ' (w x) ℓ)
    (hRmem : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ' t ℓ ∈ R)
    (hwΨ : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, w (Ψ' t ℓ) = t)
    (hwF : ∀ x ∈ F, w x = 0)
    (hRo : IsOpen R) (hwR : ContinuousOn w R)
    (hO' : IsOpen O') (hFO' : F ⊆ O') (hO'R : ∀ x ∈ R ∩ O', w x < t₀) :
    IsCompact {x | x ∈ D ∧ w x ≤ t₀} ∧ ContinuousOn w D

signature.name: lfc_level_compact_continuous
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S D R F O' : Set X) (hSc : IsCompact S) (Ψ' : ℝ → X → X) (w : X → ℝ) (t₀ t₁ : ℝ)
    (ht₀ : 0 < t₀) (ht₀₁ : t₀ < t₁)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × X => Ψ' p.1 p.2) (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁ ×ˢ S))
    (hD : D = R ∪ F) (hRF : Disjoint R F)
    (hF0 : ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ' 0 ℓ ∈ F) (hF0s : ∀ p ∈ F, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ' 0 ℓ = p)
    (hR : ∀ x ∈ R, w x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁ ∧ ∃ ℓ ∈ S, x = Ψ' (w x) ℓ)
    (hRmem : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ' t ℓ ∈ R)
    (hwΨ : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, w (Ψ' t ℓ) = t)
    (hwF : ∀ x ∈ F, w x = 0)
    (hRo : IsOpen R) (hwR : ContinuousOn w R)
    (hO' : IsOpen O') (hFO' : F ⊆ O') (hO'R : ∀ x ∈ R ∩ O', w x < t₀) :
    IsCompact {x | x ∈ D ∧ w x ≤ t₀} ∧ ContinuousOn w D

proof.tactics:
by
  subst hD
  have hKc : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c →
      IsCompact ((fun p : ℝ × X => Ψ' p.1 p.2) '' (Set.Icc c t₀ ×ˢ S)) := by
    intro c hc
    refine (isCompact_Icc.prod hSc).image_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono ?_)
    exact Set.prod_mono (Set.Icc_subset_Ioo (by linarith) ht₀₁) subset_rfl
  have hwnn : ∀ y ∈ R ∪ F, 0 ≤ w y := by
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · exact (hR y hy).1.1.le
    · exact (hwF y hy).ge
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have heq : {x | x ∈ R ∪ F ∧ w x ≤ t₀} =
        (fun p : ℝ × X => Ψ' p.1 p.2) '' (Set.Icc 0 t₀ ×ˢ S) := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hxD, hxw⟩
        rcases hxD with hx | hx
        · obtain ⟨hw, ℓ, hℓ, hxe⟩ := hR x hx
          exact ⟨(w x, ℓ), ⟨⟨hw.1.le, hxw⟩, hℓ⟩, hxe.symm⟩
        · obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, hxe⟩ := hF0s x hx
          exact ⟨(0, ℓ), ⟨⟨le_rfl, ht₀.le⟩, hℓ⟩, hxe⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨t, ℓ⟩, ⟨⟨ht0, htt⟩, hℓ⟩, rfl⟩
        rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht0 with h | h
        · subst h
          refine ⟨Or.inr (hF0 ℓ hℓ), ?_⟩
          show w (Ψ' 0 ℓ) ≤ t₀
          rw [hwF _ (hF0 ℓ hℓ)]
          exact ht₀.le
        · have ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t₁ := ⟨h, by linarith⟩
          refine ⟨Or.inl (hRmem t ht ℓ hℓ), ?_⟩
          show w (Ψ' t ℓ) ≤ t₀
          rw [hwΨ t ht ℓ hℓ]
          exact htt
    rw [heq]
    exact hKc 0 le_rfl
  · intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact (hwR.continuousAt (hRo.mem_nhds hx)).continuousWithinAt
    · have hw0 : w x = 0 := hwF x hx
      show Filter.Tendsto w (nhdsWithin x (R ∪ F)) (nhds (w x))
      rw [hw0]
      refine tendsto_order.2 ⟨fun a ha => ?_, fun b hb => ?_⟩
      · exact eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall (fun y hy => lt_of_lt_of_le ha (hwnn y hy))
      · have hδpos : 0 < min b t₀ := lt_min hb ht₀
        have hδb : min b t₀ ≤ b := min_le_left _ _
        have hδt : min b t₀ ≤ t₀ := min_le_right _ _
        have hKcl : IsClosed ((fun p : ℝ × X => Ψ' p.1 p.2) '' (Set.Icc (min b t₀) t₀ ×ˢ S)) :=
          (hKc (min b t₀) hδpos.le).isClosed
        have hKR : (fun p : ℝ × X => Ψ' p.1 p.2) '' (Set.Icc (min b t₀) t₀ ×ˢ S) ⊆ R := by
          rintro _ ⟨⟨t, ℓ⟩, ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, hℓ⟩, rfl⟩
          exact hRmem t ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩ ℓ hℓ
        have hxK : x ∉ (fun p : ℝ × X => Ψ' p.1 p.2) '' (Set.Icc (min b t₀) t₀ ×ˢ S) :=
          fun h => Set.disjoint_left.1 hRF (hKR h) hx
        have hV : O' ∩ ((fun p : ℝ × X => Ψ' p.1 p.2) '' (Set.Icc (min b t₀) t₀ ×ˢ S))ᶜ
            ∈ nhds x := (hO'.inter hKcl.isOpen_compl).mem_nhds ⟨hFO' hx, hxK⟩
        filter_upwards [mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds hV, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with y hyV hyD
        rcases hyD with hyR | hyF
        · have hlt : w y < t₀ := hO'R y ⟨hyR, hyV.1⟩
          by_contra hcon
          push_neg at hcon
          obtain ⟨_, ℓ, hℓ, hye⟩ := hR y hyR
          exact hyV.2 ⟨(w y, ℓ), ⟨⟨le_trans hδb hcon, hlt.le⟩, hℓ⟩, hye.symm⟩
        · rw [hwF y hyF]
          exact hb

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) :
    ∃ Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x,
      (∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), Ng x (-ℓ) = -Ng x ℓ) ∧
      (∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ℓ (Ng x ℓ) = 1) ∧
      ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
        (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
        ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
          (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x

signature.name: normalized_gradient_smooth
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) :
    ∃ Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x,
      (∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), Ng x (-ℓ) = -Ng x ℓ) ∧
      (∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ℓ (Ng x ℓ) = 1) ∧
      ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
        (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
        ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
          (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have vec_expand : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i := by
    intro v
    ext j
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  have bil_expand : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z c : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      B (∑ a, z a • e a) (∑ b, c b • e b) =
        dotProduct z (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun a b => B (e a) (e b)) c) := by
    intro B z c
    simp [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  have lin_expand : ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ℓ (∑ b, c b • e b) = ∑ b, c b * ℓ (e b) := by
    intro ℓ c
    simp [map_sum, map_smul]
  have bil_detpos : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ v, v ≠ 0 → 0 < B v v) →
      (Matrix.of fun a b => B (e a) (e b)).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro B hB hdet
    obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
    have hv : (∑ a, z a • e a) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; apply hz0; funext j
      have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v j) h0
      simpa [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply] using this
    have := hB _ hv
    rw [bil_expand, hz] at this
    simp at this
  have bil_riesz : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (Matrix.of fun a b => B (e a) (e b)).det ≠ 0 → ∀ v : E3,
      B v (∑ i, (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun a b => B (e a) (e b))⁻¹ ξ) i • e i) =
        ∑ j, v j * ξ j := by
    intro B ξ hdet v
    conv_lhs => rw [vec_expand v]
    rw [bil_expand, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet),
      Matrix.one_mulVec]
    simp [dotProduct]
  have bil_unique : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ v, v ≠ 0 → 0 < B v v) → ∀ w₁ w₂ : E3,
      (∀ v, B v w₁ = B v w₂) → w₁ = w₂ := by
    intro B hB w₁ w₂ h
    by_contra hne
    have := hB (w₁ - w₂) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
    rw [(B (w₁ - w₂)).map_sub w₁ w₂, h (w₁ - w₂), sub_self] at this
    exact lt_irrefl _ this
  
  have det_contDiffAt : ∀ (H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y₀ : E3),
      (∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j) y₀) →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) y₀ := by
    intro H y₀ hH
    have : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y => ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3),
        ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℝ) * ∏ i, H y (σ i) i := by
      funext y; exact Matrix.det_apply' _
    rw [this]
    refine ContDiffAt.sum fun σ _ => contDiffAt_const.mul ?_
    exact contDiffAt_prod fun i _ => hH _ _
  have inv_contDiffAt : ∀ (H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y₀ : E3),
      (∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j) y₀) → (H y₀).det ≠ 0 → ∀ i k : Fin 3,
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y)⁻¹ i k) y₀ := by
    intro H y₀ hH hd i k
    have hinv : ∀ y, (H y)⁻¹ i k = ((H y).det)⁻¹ * (H y).adjugate i k := by
      intro y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
      simp [Matrix.smul_apply]
    simp only [hinv]
    refine ((det_contDiffAt H y₀ hH).inv hd).mul ?_
    simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
    refine det_contDiffAt _ y₀ fun a b => ?_
    by_cases h : a = k
    · subst h; simp [Matrix.updateRow_apply, contDiffAt_const]
    · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_apply, h, if_false]; exact hH a b
  
  have chart_inv : ∀ (x₀ x : M), x ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).source →
      (∀ u, tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) u) = u) ∧
      (∀ v, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x)
        (tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x v) = v) := by
    intro x₀ x hx
    have hy : chartAt E3 x₀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target := (chartAt E3 x₀).map_source hx
    have hxy : (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) = x := (chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv hx
    have hd1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hy
    have hd2 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀) x :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hx
    have hT : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀) x =
        tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x :=
      mfderiv_chartAt_eq_tangentCoordChange hx
    constructor
    · intro u
      have hd2' : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀)
          ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x)) := by rw [hxy]; exact hd2
      have hc := mfderiv_comp (chartAt E3 x₀ x) hd2' hd1
      have hid : ((chartAt E3 x₀) ∘ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 x₀ x)] id := by
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 x₀).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz using hz
      rw [hid.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_id, hxy, hT] at hc
      have := congrArg (fun L => L u) hc
      simpa using this.symm
    · intro v
      have hc := mfderiv_comp x hd1 hd2
      have hid : ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm ∘ (chartAt E3 x₀)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] id := by
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 x₀).eventually_left_inverse hx] with z hz using hz
      rw [hid.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_id, hT] at hc
      have := congrArg (fun L => L v) hc
      simpa using this.symm
  
  have section_cmd : ∀ (V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x) (x₀ : M) (W : E3 → E3),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ W (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) →
      (∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x (V x) = W (chartAt E3 x₀ x)) →
      ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
        (fun y => (⟨y, V y⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x₀ := by
    intro V x₀ W hW hV
    rw [Bundle.contMDiffAt_section]
    have hc : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 x₀) x₀ := by
      have := contMDiffAt_extChartAt (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞) (x := x₀)
      simpa [extChartAt_coe] using this
    have h1 : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun x => W (chartAt E3 x₀ x)) x₀ :=
      hW.contMDiffAt.comp x₀ hc
    refine h1.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hV] with x hx
    rw [← hx, tangentCoordChange_def, TangentBundle.trivializationAt_apply]
    rfl
  
  let wf : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → E3 := fun x ℓ =>
    ∑ i, (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun a b => g.g x (e a) (e b))⁻¹ (fun j => ℓ (e j))) i • e i
  have hwR : ∀ x (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) v, g.g x v (wf x ℓ) = ℓ v := by
    intro x ℓ v
    have h1 := bil_riesz (g.g x) (fun j => ℓ (e j)) (bil_detpos _ (g.posDef x)) v
    calc g.g x v (wf x ℓ) = ∑ j, v j * ℓ (e j) := h1
      _ = ℓ (∑ i, v i • e i) := (lin_expand ℓ (fun i => v i)).symm
      _ = ℓ v := by rw [← vec_expand v]
  have hposℓ : ∀ x (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → 0 < ℓ (wf x ℓ) := by
    intro x ℓ hℓ
    have hw0 : wf x ℓ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hℓ
      ext v
      have := hwR x ℓ v
      rw [h0, map_zero] at this
      simpa using this.symm
    have := g.posDef x (wf x ℓ) hw0
    rwa [hwR] at this
  refine ⟨fun x ℓ => (ℓ (wf x ℓ))⁻¹ • wf x ℓ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro x ℓ
    have hneg : wf x (-ℓ) = -wf x ℓ := by
      refine bil_unique (g.g x) (g.posDef x) _ _ (fun v => ?_)
      rw [hwR, map_neg, hwR]
      rfl
    show ((-ℓ) (wf x (-ℓ)))⁻¹ • wf x (-ℓ) = -((ℓ (wf x ℓ))⁻¹ • wf x ℓ)
    rw [hneg, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, map_neg, neg_neg, smul_neg]
  · 
    intro x ℓ hℓ
    show ℓ ((ℓ (wf x ℓ))⁻¹ • wf x ℓ) = 1
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (hposℓ x ℓ hℓ).ne']
  
  intro X τ hX hτs hτr x₀ hx₀
  have chain_tau : ∀ (x₀ : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target →
      (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y ∈ X → ∀ v : E3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) y v =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm y)
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y v) := by
    intro x₀ y hy hyX v
    have hd1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hy
    have hτd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm y) :=
      (hτs.contMDiffAt (hX.mem_nhds hyX)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hc := mfderiv_comp y hτd hd1
    rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at hc
    exact congrArg (fun L => L v) hc
  have xi_smooth : ∀ (x₀ : M), x₀ ∈ X → ∀ j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) y (e j))
        (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := by
    intro x₀ hx₀ j
    have hO : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) :=
      (chartAt E3 x₀).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hX
    have hy₀ : chartAt E3 x₀ x₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X :=
      ⟨mem_chart_target E3 x₀, by
        show (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) ∈ X
        rw [(chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x₀)]; exact hx₀⟩
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z))
        ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) := by
      have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (τ ∘ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm)
          ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) :=
        hτs.comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hy.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)))
        ((chartAt E3 x₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ⁻¹' X) :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).mp hf).2
    exact (hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hy₀)
  let ℓ : M → E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := fun x => mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x
  let w : M → E3 := fun x => wf x (ℓ x)
  let V : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x := fun x => (ℓ x (w x))⁻¹ • w x
  show ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
    (fun y => (⟨y, V y⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x₀
  have hwR' : ∀ x v, g.g x v (w x) = ℓ x v := fun x v => hwR x (ℓ x) v
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ X, 0 < ℓ x (w x) := fun x hx => hposℓ x (ℓ x) (hτr x hx)
  let G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm
  let ξ : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun y j => fderiv ℝ (fun z => τ ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm z)) y (e j)
  let c : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun y => Matrix.mulVec (G y)⁻¹ (ξ y)
  let W : E3 → E3 := fun y => (∑ i, c y i * ξ y i)⁻¹ • ∑ i, c y i • e i
  
  have hK : ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).source ∩ X,
      tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x (V x) = W (chartAt E3 x₀ x) ∧
      ℓ x (w x) = ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i * ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i := by
    rintro x ⟨hxs, hxX⟩
    obtain ⟨hTA0, hAT0⟩ := chart_inv x₀ x hxs
    let A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x)
    let T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := tangentCoordChange 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x x₀ x
    have hTA : ∀ u, T (A u) = u := hTA0
    have hAT : ∀ v, A (T v) = v := hAT0
    have hy : chartAt E3 x₀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target := (chartAt E3 x₀).map_source hxs
    have hxy : (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ x) = x := (chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv hxs
    have hG : G (chartAt E3 x₀ x) =
        Matrix.of fun a b => (g.g x).bilinearComp A A (e a) (e b) := by
      ext a b
      simp only [G, RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, Matrix.of_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply]
      rw [hxy]
      rfl
    have hξ : ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x) = fun j => ℓ x (A (e j)) := by
      funext j
      simp only [ξ]
      rw [chain_tau x₀ _ hy (by rw [hxy]; exact hxX), hxy]
      rfl
    have hdetB : (Matrix.of fun a b => (g.g x).bilinearComp A A (e a) (e b)).det ≠ 0 := by
      refine bil_detpos _ (fun v hv => ?_)
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply]
      apply g.posDef
      intro h0
      apply hv
      rw [← hTA v]
      exact (congrArg T h0).trans (map_zero T)
    let u : E3 := ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i • e i
    have hRu : ∀ v, (g.g x).bilinearComp A A v u = ∑ j, v j * ℓ x (A (e j)) := by
      intro v
      have := bil_riesz ((g.g x).bilinearComp A A) (fun j => ℓ x (A (e j))) hdetB v
      simp only [u, c, hG, hξ]
      exact this
    have hAu : ∀ v, g.g x v (A u) = ℓ x v := by
      intro v
      have h1 := hRu (T v)
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply, hAT v] at h1
      rw [h1]
      calc ∑ j, (T v) j * ℓ x (A (e j)) = ((ℓ x).comp A) (∑ i, (T v) i • e i) :=
            (lin_expand ((ℓ x).comp A) (fun i => (T v) i)).symm
        _ = ℓ x v := by
            rw [← vec_expand (T v), ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hAT v]
    have hwAu : w x = A u :=
      bil_unique (g.g x) (g.posDef x) _ _ (fun v => (hwR' x v).trans (hAu v).symm)
    have hlw : ℓ x (w x) = ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i * ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x) i := by
      rw [hwAu, hξ]
      exact lin_expand ((ℓ x).comp A) (c (chartAt E3 x₀ x))
    refine ⟨?_, hlw⟩
    show T ((ℓ x (w x))⁻¹ • w x) = W (chartAt E3 x₀ x)
    rw [hlw, hwAu, map_smul, hTA]
  
  have hy₀ : chartAt E3 x₀ x₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target := mem_chart_target E3 x₀
  have hGs : ∀ i j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := fun i j =>
    (g.smooth x₀ i j).contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 x₀).open_target.mem_nhds hy₀)
  have hK₀ := hK x₀ ⟨mem_chart_source E3 x₀, hx₀⟩
  have hdetG : (G (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀)).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hc0 : c (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) = 0 := by
      simp only [c, Matrix.inv_def, h0, Ring.inverse_zero, zero_smul, Matrix.zero_mulVec]
    have := hpos x₀ hx₀
    rw [hK₀.2, hc0] at this
    simp at this
  have hξs : ∀ j, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => ξ y j) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := fun j =>
    xi_smooth x₀ hx₀ j
  have hcs : ∀ i, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => c y i) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) := by
    intro i
    simp only [c, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    exact ContDiffAt.sum fun k _ => (inv_contDiffAt G _ hGs hdetG i k).mul (hξs k)
  have hden : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i, c y i * ξ y i) (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) :=
    ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => (hcs i).mul (hξs i)
  have hden0 : ∑ i, c (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) i * ξ (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) i ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hK₀.2]; exact (hpos x₀ hx₀).ne'
  have hWs : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ W (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) :=
    (hden.inv hden0).smul (ContDiffAt.sum fun i _ => (hcs i).smul contDiffAt_const)
  refine section_cmd V x₀ W hWs ?_
  filter_upwards [((chartAt E3 x₀).open_source.inter hX).mem_nhds
    ⟨mem_chart_source E3 x₀, hx₀⟩] with x hx using (hK x hx).1

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M)
    (hUo : IsOpen U) (hFc : IsCompact (frontier U)) (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hNc : IsCompact (closure N)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x ≠ 0)
    (hσb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x ∧ σ x < ε)
    (hσ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)
    (hgood : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ ∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, σ x = |f x|)
    (x₀ : M) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U ∩ N)
    (hFCpc : IsPreconnected (closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U)) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (B : Fin m → Set M) (f : Fin m → M → ℝ),
      closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ ⋃ i, B i ∧
      (∀ i, IsOpen (B i) ∧ B i ⊆ N ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ B i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f i) x ≠ 0) ∧
        B i ∩ frontier U = B i ∩ (f i) ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        B i ∩ frontier U ⊆ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀)) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, 0 < f i x → x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ → σ x = |f i x|) ∧
      (∀ i k, ∀ x ∈ B i ∩ B k, ∃ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f i y = e * f k y)

    (hBpos : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, 0 < f i x → x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀)
    (hBσ : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ → σ x = |f i x|)
    (hBsgn : ∀ i k, ∀ x ∈ B i ∩ B k, ∃ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f i y = e * f k y)
    (hleaf : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → c < ε →
      IsCompact (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) ∧
      IsPreconnected (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) ∧
      (c ≤ σ x₀ → (∃ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, σ x < c) →
        (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}).Nonempty)) :
    ∃ (S : Set M) (Ψ : ℝ → M → M) (s₁ : ℝ),
      0 < s₁ ∧ IsCompact S ∧ S.Nonempty ∧ IsPreconnected S ∧
      (∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ 0 ℓ ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ 0 ℓ = p) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ s ℓ ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ s' ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, ∀ ℓ' ∈ S,
        Ψ s ℓ = Ψ s' ℓ' → s = s' ∧ ℓ = ℓ') ∧
      (∀ m ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀,
        σ x ≤ δ → ∃ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 m, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ s ℓ = x) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, s ≠ 0 → Ψ s ℓ ∉ frontier U) ∧
      (∀ ℓ ∈ S, collarSlabChartAt g U φ S Ψ s₁ ℓ)

signature.name: collar_normal_slab_charts
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M)
    (hUo : IsOpen U) (hFc : IsCompact (frontier U)) (hfront : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (N : Set M) (ε : ℝ) (σ : M → ℝ) (hNo : IsOpen N) (hFN : frontier U ⊆ N)
    (hNc : IsCompact (closure N)) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ σ (U ∩ N))
    (hσr : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) σ x ≠ 0)
    (hσb : ∀ x ∈ U ∩ N, 0 < σ x ∧ σ x < ε)
    (hσp : ∀ c d : ℝ, 0 < c → d < ε → IsCompact (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Icc c d))
    (hσi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < ε → IsClosed (frontier U ∪ (U ∩ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ)))
    (hσ0 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ O : Set M, IsOpen O ∧ frontier U ⊆ O ∧
      U ∩ O ⊆ N ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iio δ)
    (hgood : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
      V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ ∀ x ∈ V ∩ U ∩ N, σ x = |f x|)
    (φ lam : M → ℝ)
    (hdata : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, 0 < φ p ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
        V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ V ∩ frontier U, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧
          g.jacobiDeriv f x = lam x / φ x)
    (x₀ p₀ : M) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U ∩ N)
    (hp₀C : p₀ ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U)
    (hthin : ∀ O : Set M, IsOpen O →
      closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ O →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < ε ∧ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' Set.Iic δ ⊆ O)
    (hFCpc : IsPreconnected (closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U))
    (Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hNg1 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), Ng x (-ℓ) = -Ng x ℓ)
    (hNg2 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ℓ (Ng x ℓ) = 1)
    (hNg3 : ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
      (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
        (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x)
    (nB : ℕ) (B : Fin nB → Set M) (f : Fin nB → M → ℝ)
    (hBcov : closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U ⊆ ⋃ i, B i)
    (hB : ∀ i, IsOpen (B i) ∧ B i ⊆ N ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ B i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f i) x ≠ 0) ∧
      B i ∩ frontier U = B i ∩ (f i) ⁻¹' {0} ∧
      B i ∩ frontier U ⊆ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀))
    (hBpos : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, 0 < f i x → x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀)
    (hBσ : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ → σ x = |f i x|)
    (hBsgn : ∀ i k, ∀ x ∈ B i ∩ B k, ∃ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f i y = e * f k y)
    (hleaf : ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → c < ε →
      IsCompact (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) ∧
      IsPreconnected (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}) ∧
      (c ≤ σ x₀ → (∃ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀, σ x < c) →
        (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}).Nonempty)) :
    ∃ (S : Set M) (Ψ : ℝ → M → M) (s₁ : ℝ),
      0 < s₁ ∧ IsCompact S ∧ S.Nonempty ∧ IsPreconnected S ∧
      (∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ 0 ℓ ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U) ∧
      (∀ p ∈ closure (connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∩ frontier U, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ 0 ℓ = p) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ s ℓ ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ s' ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, ∀ ℓ' ∈ S,
        Ψ s ℓ = Ψ s' ℓ' → s = s' ∧ ℓ = ℓ') ∧
      (∀ m ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s₁, ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀,
        σ x ≤ δ → ∃ s ∈ Set.Ioo 0 m, ∃ ℓ ∈ S, Ψ s ℓ = x) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ ℓ ∈ S, s ≠ 0 → Ψ s ℓ ∉ frontier U) ∧
      (∀ ℓ ∈ S, collarSlabChartAt g U φ S Ψ s₁ ℓ)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  haveI : LocallyConnectedSpace M := ChartedSpace.locallyConnectedSpace E3 M
  set C := connectedComponentIn (U ∩ N) x₀ with hCdef
  have hCU : C ⊆ U ∩ N := connectedComponentIn_subset _ _
  have hCo : IsOpen C := (hUo.inter hNo).connectedComponentIn
  have hFCc : IsCompact (closure C ∩ frontier U) := hFc.inter_left isClosed_closure
  have hBo : ∀ i, IsOpen (B i) := fun i => (hB i).1
  have hBN : ∀ i, B i ⊆ N := fun i => (hB i).2.1
  have hfs : ∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i) := fun i => (hB i).2.2.1
  have hdf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f i) x ≠ 0 := fun i => (hB i).2.2.2.1
  have hBF : ∀ i, B i ∩ frontier U = B i ∩ (f i) ⁻¹' {0} := fun i => (hB i).2.2.2.2.1
  have hBC : ∀ i, B i ∩ frontier U ⊆ closure C := fun i => (hB i).2.2.2.2.2
  have hFf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, (x ∈ frontier U ↔ f i x = 0) := by
    intro i x hx
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : x ∈ B i ∩ frontier U := ⟨hx, h⟩
      rw [hBF i] at h'
      exact h'.2
    · intro h
      have h' : x ∈ B i ∩ (f i) ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hx, h⟩
      rw [← hBF i] at h'
      exact h'.2
  have hFC : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, x ∈ frontier U → x ∈ closure C ∩ frontier U :=
    fun i x hx hF => ⟨hBC i ⟨hx, hF⟩, hF⟩
  have habs : ∀ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) → ∀ a : ℝ, |a * e| = |a| := by
    intro e he a
    rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> simp
  have hne : ∀ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) → e ≠ 0 := by
    intro e he
    rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  
  obtain ⟨R, ι, q, B', D, Fl, T, hT, hFCD, hbox⟩ :=
    collar_flow_boxes Ng hNg2 hNg3 nB B f hBo hfs hdf (closure C ∩ frontier U) hFCc hBcov
      (fun i p hp hpB => (hFf i p hpB).1 hp.2)
  have hB'o : ∀ r, IsOpen (B' r) := fun r => (hbox r).1
  have hDo : ∀ r, IsOpen (D r) := fun r => (hbox r).2.1
  have hDB' : ∀ r, D r ⊆ B' r := fun r => (hbox r).2.2.1
  have hB'B : ∀ r, B' r ⊆ B (ι r) := fun r => (hbox r).2.2.2.1
  have hFl := fun r => (hbox r).2.2.2.2.1
  have hFls := fun r => (hbox r).2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hker := fun r => (hbox r).2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hinj := fun r => (hbox r).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hback := fun r => (hbox r).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have hFlB : ∀ r, ∀ y ∈ B' r, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, Fl r t y ∈ B (ι r) :=
    fun r y hy t ht => ((hFl r y hy).2.2 t ht).1.1
  have hFlf : ∀ r, ∀ y ∈ B' r, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T,
      f (ι r) (Fl r t y) = f (ι r) y + t :=
    fun r y hy t ht => ((hFl r y hy).2.2 t ht).2
  have hF0 : ∀ r, ∀ y ∈ B' r, y ∈ frontier U → f (ι r) y = 0 :=
    fun r y hy hF => (hFf (ι r) y (hB'B r hy)).1 hF
  have hmemT : ∀ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) → ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, t * e ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T := by
    intro e he t ht
    rcases he with rfl | rfl
    · simpa using ht
    · simp only [mul_neg, mul_one]
      exact ⟨by linarith [ht.2], by linarith [ht.1]⟩
  
  have hbp : ∀ r, ∀ x ∈ D r, Fl r (-f (ι r) x) x ∈ B' r ∧
      Fl r (-f (ι r) x) x ∈ frontier U ∧ Fl r (f (ι r) x) (Fl r (-f (ι r) x) x) = x ∧
      |f (ι r) x| < T ∧ x ∈ B (ι r) := by
    intro r x hx
    obtain ⟨hfT, hyB', hyl⟩ := hback r x hx
    have hxB' := hDB' r hx
    have hmT : -f (ι r) x ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T := by
      rw [abs_lt] at hfT
      exact ⟨by linarith [hfT.2], by linarith [hfT.1]⟩
    have hy0 : f (ι r) (Fl r (-f (ι r) x) x) = 0 := by
      rw [hFlf r x hxB' _ hmT]; ring
    exact ⟨hyB', (hFf (ι r) _ (hB'B r hyB')).2 hy0, hyl, hfT, hB'B r hxB'⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Λf, Λ, μ, hμ, hΛb, hΛφ, hΛs⟩ :=
    collar_lapse_function g U φ lam hdata nB B f hBo hfs hdf hBF hBsgn
      (closure C ∩ frontier U) hFCc Set.inter_subset_right hBcov
  have hΛpos : ∀ y ∈ closure C ∩ frontier U, 0 < Λf y :=
    fun y hy => lt_of_lt_of_le hμ (hΛb y hy).1
  
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδ₀ε, hthinD⟩ := hthin (⋃ r, D r) (isOpen_iUnion hDo) hFCD
  have hσx₀ : 0 < σ x₀ := (hσb x₀ hx₀).1
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀def⟩ : ∃ m₀ : ℝ, m₀ = min (min δ₀ (σ x₀)) (T / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hm₀ : 0 < m₀ := by
    rw [hm₀def]; exact lt_min (lt_min hδ₀ hσx₀) (by linarith)
  have hm₁ : m₀ ≤ δ₀ := by rw [hm₀def]; exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hm₂ : m₀ ≤ σ x₀ := by rw [hm₀def]; exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hm₃ : m₀ ≤ T / 2 := by rw [hm₀def]; exact min_le_right _ _
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hFO, hUO⟩ := hσ0 m₀ hm₀
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁O, hx₁C⟩ := mem_closure_iff.1 hp₀C.1 O hO (hFO hp₀C.2)
  have hx₁σ : σ x₁ < m₀ := (hUO ⟨(hCU hx₁C).1, hx₁O⟩).2
  have hσx₁ : 0 < σ x₁ := (hσb x₁ (hCU hx₁C)).1
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = (σ x₁ + m₀) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by rw [hcdef]; linarith
  have hcm : c < m₀ := by rw [hcdef]; linarith
  have hx₁c : σ x₁ < c := by rw [hcdef]; linarith
  have hcδ : c < δ₀ := by linarith
  have hcε : c < ε := by linarith
  have hcT : c < T := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hScpt, hSpc, hSne'⟩ := hleaf c hc0 hcε
  have hSne : (C ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}).Nonempty := hSne' (by linarith) ⟨x₁, hx₁C, hx₁c⟩
  
  have hseg : ∀ r, ∀ y ∈ B' r, y ∈ frontier U → ∀ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) →
      ∀ a ∈ Set.Ioo 0 T, Fl r (a * e) y ∈ C → ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 T, Fl r (t * e) y ∈ C := by
    intro r y hy hyF e he a ha haC t ht
    have hsub : Set.Ioo 0 T ⊆ Set.Ioo (-T) T := fun s hs => ⟨by linarith [hs.1], hs.2⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun s => Fl r (s * e) y) (Set.Ioo 0 T) := by
      have h1 := (hFl r y hy).2.1.continuousOn
      refine h1.comp (continuous_mul_right e).continuousOn ?_
      intro s hs
      exact hmemT e he s (hsub hs)
    have hA := isPreconnected_Ioo.image _ hcont
    have hAsub : (fun s => Fl r (s * e) y) '' Set.Ioo 0 T ⊆ U ∪ (closure U)ᶜ := by
      rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      have hsT := hmemT e he s (hsub hs)
      have hzB := hFlB r y hy _ hsT
      have hfz : f (ι r) (Fl r (s * e) y) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hFlf r y hy _ hsT, hF0 r y hy hyF, zero_add]
        exact mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hs.1) (hne e he)
      by_cases hzU : Fl r (s * e) y ∈ U
      · exact Or.inl hzU
      · right
        intro hzc
        apply hfz
        apply (hFf (ι r) _ hzB).1
        rw [hUo.frontier_eq]
        exact ⟨hzc, hzU⟩
    have hAU := hA.subset_left_of_subset_union hUo isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl
      (Disjoint.mono_left subset_closure disjoint_compl_right) hAsub
      ⟨_, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, (hCU haC).1⟩
    have hAX : (fun s => Fl r (s * e) y) '' Set.Ioo 0 T ⊆ U ∩ N := by
      intro z hz
      refine ⟨hAU hz, ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hz
      exact hBN _ (hFlB r y hy _ (hmemT e he s (hsub hs)))
    have hAC := hA.subset_connectedComponentIn ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ hAX
    rw [← connectedComponentIn_eq haC] at hAC
    exact hAC ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  
  have hcurve : ∀ r r' : Fin R, ∀ y ∈ B' r, y ∈ frontier U → ∀ y' ∈ B' r', y' ∈ frontier U →
      ∀ e e' : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) → (e' = 1 ∨ e' = -1) →
      ∀ t₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, t₁ ≠ 0 → Fl r (t₁ * e) y = Fl r' (t₁ * e') y' →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, Fl r (t * e) y = Fl r' (t * e') y' := by
    intro r r' y hy hyF y' hy' hy'F e e' he he' t₁ ht₁ ht₁0 hmeet t ht
    have hγ₁ : IsMIntegralCurveOn ((fun s => Fl r s y) ∘ fun s => s * e)
        (fun x => e • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f (ι r)) x)) (Set.Ioo (-T) T) :=
      ((hFl r y hy).2.1.comp_mul e).mono (fun s hs => hmemT e he s hs)
    have hγ₂ : IsMIntegralCurveOn ((fun s => Fl r' s y') ∘ fun s => s * e')
        (fun x => e' • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f (ι r')) x)) (Set.Ioo (-T) T) :=
      ((hFl r' y' hy').2.1.comp_mul e').mono (fun s hs => hmemT e' he' s hs)
    have key := collar_curves_agree Ng hNg1 hNg3 (B (ι r)) (B (ι r')) (f (ι r)) (f (ι r'))
      (hBo _) (hBo _) (hfs _) (hfs _) (hdf _) (hdf _) (hBsgn (ι r) (ι r')) T
      ((fun s => Fl r s y) ∘ fun s => s * e) ((fun s => Fl r' s y') ∘ fun s => s * e')
      e e' he he' hγ₁ hγ₂
      (fun s hs => hFlB r y hy _ (hmemT e he s hs))
      (fun s hs => hFlB r' y' hy' _ (hmemT e' he' s hs))
      (fun s hs => by
        show f (ι r) (Fl r (s * e) y) = e * s
        rw [hFlf r y hy _ (hmemT e he s hs), hF0 r y hy hyF]; ring)
      (fun s hs => by
        show |f (ι r') (Fl r' (s * e') y')| = |s|
        rw [hFlf r' y' hy' _ (hmemT e' he' s hs), hF0 r' y' hy' hy'F, zero_add]
        exact habs e' he' s)
      t₁ ht₁ ht₁0 hmeet
    exact key ht
  
  have hrepex : ∀ ℓ ∈ C ∩ σ ⁻¹' {c}, ∃ (r : Fin R) (e : ℝ) (y : M), y ∈ B' r ∧
      y ∈ frontier U ∧ (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ Fl r (c * e) y = ℓ ∧ ℓ ∈ D r ∧
      0 < e * f (ι r) ℓ := by
    rintro ℓ ⟨hℓC, hℓc⟩
    have hℓc' : σ ℓ = c := hℓc
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1
      (hthinD ⟨hℓC, show σ ℓ ≤ δ₀ by rw [hℓc']; exact hcδ.le⟩)
    obtain ⟨hyB', hyF, hyl, -, hℓB⟩ := hbp r ℓ hr
    have habsℓ : |f (ι r) ℓ| = c := by rw [← hBσ (ι r) ℓ hℓB hℓC]; exact hℓc'
    rcases (abs_eq hc0.le).1 habsℓ with h | h
    · refine ⟨r, 1, _, hyB', hyF, Or.inl rfl, ?_, hr, ?_⟩
      · rw [mul_one, ← h]; exact hyl
      · rw [h, one_mul]; exact hc0
    · refine ⟨r, -1, _, hyB', hyF, Or.inr rfl, ?_, hr, ?_⟩
      · rw [show c * -1 = f (ι r) ℓ by rw [h]; ring]; exact hyl
      · rw [h]; linarith
  obtain ⟨r₀, -⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (hFCD hp₀C)
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin R) := ⟨r₀⟩
  choose! rr ee yy hrep using hrepex

subgoal_signatures.name: collar_flow_boxes
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hNg2 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ℓ (Ng x ℓ) = 1)
    (hNg3 : ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
      (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
        (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x)
    (nB : ℕ) (B : Fin nB → Set M) (f : Fin nB → M → ℝ)
    (hBo : ∀ i, IsOpen (B i)) (hfs : ∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i))
    (hdf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f i) x ≠ 0)
    (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKB : K ⊆ ⋃ i, B i)
    (hK0 : ∀ i, ∀ p ∈ K, p ∈ B i → f i p = 0) :
    ∃ (R : ℕ) (ι : Fin R → Fin nB) (q : Fin R → M) (B' D : Fin R → Set M)
      (Fl : Fin R → ℝ → M → M) (T : ℝ), 0 < T ∧ K ⊆ ⋃ r, D r ∧ ∀ r,
      IsOpen (B' r) ∧ IsOpen (D r) ∧ D r ⊆ B' r ∧ B' r ⊆ B (ι r) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B' r, Fl r 0 y = y ∧
        IsMIntegralCurveOn (fun t => Fl r t y)
          (fun x => Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f (ι r)) x)) (Set.Ioo (-T) T) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, Fl r t y ∈ B (ι r) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q r)).source ∧
          f (ι r) (Fl r t y) = f (ι r) y + t) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 (q r) (Fl r p.1 ((chartAt E3 (q r)).symm p.2)))
        (Set.Ioo (-T) T ×ˢ (chartAt E3 (q r) '' B' r)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, ∀ u ∈ chartAt E3 (q r) '' B' r, ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
        fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 (q r) (Fl r p.1 ((chartAt E3 (q r)).symm p.2)))
          (t, u) (a, w) = 0 →
        w = -a • fderiv ℝ
          (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 (q r) (Fl r p.1 ((chartAt E3 (q r)).symm p.2)))
          (0, u) (1, 0)) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B' r, ∀ y' ∈ B' r, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, Fl r t y = Fl r t y' → y = y') ∧
      (∀ x ∈ D r, |f (ι r) x| < T ∧ Fl r (-f (ι r) x) x ∈ B' r ∧
        Fl r (f (ι r) x) (Fl r (-f (ι r) x) x) = x)

subgoal_signatures.name: collar_lapse_function
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (φ lam : M → ℝ)
    (hdata : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, 0 < φ p ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
        V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ V ∩ frontier U, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧
          g.jacobiDeriv f x = lam x / φ x)
    (nB : ℕ) (B : Fin nB → Set M) (f : Fin nB → M → ℝ)
    (hBo : ∀ i, IsOpen (B i)) (hfs : ∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i))
    (hdf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f i) x ≠ 0)
    (hBF : ∀ i, B i ∩ frontier U = B i ∩ (f i) ⁻¹' {0})
    (hBsgn : ∀ i k, ∀ x ∈ B i ∩ B k, ∃ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f i y = e * f k y)
    (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKF : K ⊆ frontier U) (hKB : K ⊆ ⋃ i, B i) :
    ∃ (Λf : M → ℝ) (Λ μ : ℝ), 0 < μ ∧ (∀ y ∈ K, μ ≤ Λf y ∧ Λf y ≤ Λ) ∧

The crux slab_chart_from_flow_box, checked against the collarSlabChartAt definition: pj comes from the IFT inverse of Fl(ce,·), Φ from the injective-immersion argument, and the lapse from |u|·lam = φ√gi f' = 1.       (∀ j, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, hpLift s x ∈ (Φ j).source ∧
        Φ j (hpLift s x) = Ψ s (P.param j x) ∧ Ψ s (P.param j x) ∈ (chartAt E3 (z j)).source) ∧
      (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V → Ψ 0 (P.param j x) ∈ V →

        |partialDeriv 0 (fun y => f (Φ j y)) (hpLift 0 x)| = 1)

by
  have h0 : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁ := ⟨by linarith, hs₁⟩
  
  have hPL : ∀ (t : ℝ) (y : E2), hpProj (hpLift t y) = y := by
    intro t y
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj, hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hLs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => hpLift 0 y) := by
    unfold hpLift cylPt
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => y 0) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => y 1) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    exact (contDiff_const.add (h1.smul contDiff_const)).add (h2.smul contDiff_const)
  have hPs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ hpProj := by
    unfold hpProj
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z 1) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z 2) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    have h3 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => (![z 1, z 2] : Fin 2 → ℝ)) := by
      rw [contDiff_pi]
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · simpa using h1
      · simpa using h2
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp h3
  
  have trans : ∀ (W₁ W₂ : Set E2) (O₂ : Set M) (pm₁ pm₂ : E2 → M) (pj₂ : M → E2)
      (Φ₁ Φ₂ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞),
      IsOpen W₁ → IsOpen O₂ → ContinuousOn pm₁ W₁ → (∀ x ∈ W₁, pm₁ x ∈ S) →
      pm₂ '' W₂ = O₂ ∩ S → (∀ x ∈ W₂, pj₂ (pm₂ x) = x) →
      (∀ x ∈ W₁, hpLift 0 x ∈ Φ₁.source ∧ Φ₁ (hpLift 0 x) = Ψ 0 (pm₁ x)) →
      (∀ x ∈ W₂, hpLift 0 x ∈ Φ₂.source ∧ Φ₂ (hpLift 0 x) = Ψ 0 (pm₂ x)) →
      IsOpen (W₁ ∩ pm₁ ⁻¹' O₂) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ W₁ ∩ pm₁ ⁻¹' O₂, pj₂ (pm₁ x) ∈ W₂ ∧ pm₂ (pj₂ (pm₁ x)) = pm₁ x ∧
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x' => pj₂ (pm₁ x')) x := by
    intro W₁ W₂ O₂ pm₁ pm₂ pj₂ Φ₁ Φ₂ hW₁ hO₂ hpm₁ hpm₁S himg₂ hpj₂ hΦ₁ hΦ₂
    have hD : IsOpen (W₁ ∩ pm₁ ⁻¹' O₂) := hpm₁.isOpen_inter_preimage hW₁ hO₂
    have hpt : ∀ x ∈ W₁ ∩ pm₁ ⁻¹' O₂, ∃ x'' ∈ W₂, pm₂ x'' = pm₁ x := by
      intro x hx
      have hmem : pm₁ x ∈ pm₂ '' W₂ := by
        rw [himg₂]
        exact ⟨hx.2, hpm₁S x hx.1⟩
      obtain ⟨x'', hx'', heq⟩ := hmem
      exact ⟨x'', hx'', heq⟩
    have hT : ∀ x ∈ W₁ ∩ pm₁ ⁻¹' O₂, Φ₁ (hpLift 0 x) ∈ Φ₂.target ∧
        hpProj (Φ₂.invFun (Φ₁ (hpLift 0 x))) = pj₂ (pm₁ x) := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨x'', hx'', heq⟩ := hpt x hx
      have e1 : Φ₁ (hpLift 0 x) = Φ₂ (hpLift 0 x'') := by
        rw [(hΦ₁ x hx.1).2, (hΦ₂ x'' hx'').2, heq]
      have e2 : Φ₂.invFun (Φ₂ (hpLift 0 x'')) = hpLift 0 x'' :=
        Φ₂.toPartialEquiv.left_inv' (hΦ₂ x'' hx'').1
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [e1]
        exact Φ₂.toPartialEquiv.map_source (hΦ₂ x'' hx'').1
      · rw [e1, e2, hPL, ← heq, hpj₂ x'' hx'']
    have hTs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x' => hpProj (Φ₂.invFun (Φ₁ (hpLift 0 x'))))
        (W₁ ∩ pm₁ ⁻¹' O₂) := by
      have a1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E2) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun y : E2 => hpLift 0 y)
          (W₁ ∩ pm₁ ⁻¹' O₂) := hLs.contMDiff.contMDiffOn
      have a2 := Φ₁.contMDiffOn_toFun.comp a1 (fun x hx => (hΦ₁ x hx.1).1)
      have a3 := Φ₂.contMDiffOn_invFun.comp a2 (fun x hx => (hT x hx).1)
      have a4 := (hPs.contMDiff.contMDiffOn (s := Set.univ)).comp a3
        (fun x _ => Set.mem_univ _)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp a4
    refine ⟨hD, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x'', hx'', heq⟩ := hpt x hx
    have hpjx : pj₂ (pm₁ x) = x'' := by rw [← heq, hpj₂ x'' hx'']
    refine ⟨by rw [hpjx]; exact hx'', by rw [hpjx]; exact heq, ?_⟩
    have hca := hTs.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)
    refine hca.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hD.mem_nhds hx] with x' hx'

  have metric : ∀ (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (z : M) (W : Set E2),
      IsOpen W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, hpLift 0 x ∈ Φ.source ∧ Φ (hpLift 0 x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source) →

      (∀ x ∈ W, (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
          (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift 0 x'))) x).PosDef) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ W, chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift 0 x)) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∧
          DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift 0 x'))) x) := by
    intro Φ z W hW hsrc
    obtain ⟨-, hsm, hreg⟩ := slab_graph_param_regular g Φ z W hW 1 (fun _ _ => 0)
      contDiffOn_const (fun t _ x hx => hsrc x hx)
    have hι : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E2 => ((0:ℝ), x)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
    have h01 : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-1) 1 := ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
    refine ⟨fun a b => (hsm a b).comp hι.contDiffOn (fun x hx => ⟨h01, hx⟩), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨htgt, -, hinj⟩ := hreg 0 h01 x hx
      have hinj' : Function.Injective
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift 0 x'))) x) := hinj
      have htgt' : chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift 0 x)) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target := htgt
      have hG := coeff_chart_symm_posDef g z _ htgt'
      set D := fderiv ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift 0 x'))) x with hD
      let A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 2) ℝ := Matrix.of fun k i => (D (e2 i)) k
      have hAinj : Function.Injective A.mulVec := by
        intro v w hvw
        have key : ∀ u : Fin 2 → ℝ, A.mulVec u = fun k => (D (u 0 • e2 0 + u 1 • e2 1)) k := by
          intro u
          funext k
          simp [A, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, map_add, map_smul, mul_comm]
        rw [key v, key w] at hvw
        have h2 : D (v 0 • e2 0 + v 1 • e2 1) = D (w 0 • e2 0 + w 1 • e2 1) := by
          ext k
          exact congrFun hvw k
        have h3 := hinj' h2

        fin_cases i
        · have := congrArg (fun u : E2 => u 0) h3
          simpa [EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using this
        · have := congrArg (fun u : E2 => u 1) h3
          simpa [EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using this
      have hPD := hG.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hAinj
      have heq : pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
          (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift 0 x'))) x =
          A.conjTranspose * (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift 0 x)))) * A := by
        ext i j
        simp only [pullMetric2, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, A, Matrix.of_apply,
          star_trivial, Finset.sum_mul]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      rw [heq]
      exact hPD
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨htgt, hdiff, -⟩ := hreg 0 h01 x hx
      exact ⟨htgt, hdiff⟩
  
  have compat : ∀ (z₁ z₂ : M) (Φ₁ Φ₂ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
      (W₁ W₂ : Set E2) (pm₁ pm₂ : E2 → M) (τ : E2 → E2),
      IsOpen W₁ → IsOpen W₂ →
      (∀ x ∈ W₁, hpLift 0 x ∈ Φ₁.source ∧ Φ₁ (hpLift 0 x) = Ψ 0 (pm₁ x) ∧
        Ψ 0 (pm₁ x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z₁).source) →
      (∀ x ∈ W₂, hpLift 0 x ∈ Φ₂.source ∧ Φ₂ (hpLift 0 x) = Ψ 0 (pm₂ x) ∧
        Ψ 0 (pm₂ x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z₂).source) →
      ∀ x ∈ W₁, DifferentiableAt ℝ τ x →

      ∀ a b : Fin 2,

          (fun x' => chartAt E3 z₁ (Φ₁ (hpLift 0 x'))) x a b =
        ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,

            pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z₂).symm)
              (fun x' => chartAt E3 z₂ (Φ₂ (hpLift 0 x'))) (τ x) c d *
            fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) d := by
    intro z₁ z₂ Φ₁ Φ₂ W₁ W₂ pm₁ pm₂ τ hW₁ hW₂ hΦ₁ hΦ₂ x hx hτ hloc
    have hτx : τ x ∈ W₂ := hloc.self_of_nhds.2.1
    have m1 := (metric Φ₁ z₁ W₁ hW₁ (fun y hy => ⟨(hΦ₁ y hy).1, by
      rw [(hΦ₁ y hy).2.1]; exact (hΦ₁ y hy).2.2⟩)).2.2 x hx
    have m2 := (metric Φ₂ z₂ W₂ hW₂ (fun y hy => ⟨(hΦ₂ y hy).1, by
      rw [(hΦ₂ y hy).2.1]; exact (hΦ₂ y hy).2.2⟩)).2.2 (τ x) hτx
    refine pullMetric2_reparam_compat g z₁ z₂ _ _ τ x m1.2 m2.2 hτ m1.1 m2.1 ?_
    filter_upwards [hloc] with x' hx'
    show (chartAt E3 z₁).symm (chartAt E3 z₁ (Φ₁ (hpLift 0 x'))) =
      (chartAt E3 z₂).symm (chartAt E3 z₂ (Φ₂ (hpLift 0 (τ x'))))
    have s1 : Φ₁ (hpLift 0 x') ∈ (chartAt E3 z₁).source := by
      rw [(hΦ₁ x' hx'.1).2.1]; exact (hΦ₁ x' hx'.1).2.2
    have s2 : Φ₂ (hpLift 0 (τ x')) ∈ (chartAt E3 z₂).source := by
      rw [(hΦ₂ _ hx'.2.1).2.1]; exact (hΦ₂ _ hx'.2.1).2.2
    rw [(chartAt E3 z₁).left_inv s1, (chartAt E3 z₂).left_inv s2,
      (hΦ₁ x' hx'.1).2.1, (hΦ₂ _ hx'.2.1).2.1, hx'.2.2]
  
  unfold collarSlabChartAt at hloc
  choose Wc Oc pmc pjc zc Φc hWo hOo hℓO hpmc hpjc himg hpjpm hslab hlapse using hloc
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hS.elim_finite_subcover (fun i : S => Oc i.1 i.2) (fun i => hOo i.1 i.2)
    (fun x hx => Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hℓO x hx⟩)
  have hpmS : ∀ ℓ (hℓ : ℓ ∈ S), ∀ x ∈ Wc ℓ hℓ, pmc ℓ hℓ x ∈ S := by
    intro ℓ hℓ x hx
    have hmem : pmc ℓ hℓ x ∈ pmc ℓ hℓ '' Wc ℓ hℓ := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [himg ℓ hℓ] at hmem
    exact hmem.2
  have htr : ∀ i k : S, IsOpen (Wc i.1 i.2 ∩ pmc i.1 i.2 ⁻¹' Oc k.1 k.2) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Wc i.1 i.2 ∩ pmc i.1 i.2 ⁻¹' Oc k.1 k.2,
        pjc k.1 k.2 (pmc i.1 i.2 x) ∈ Wc k.1 k.2 ∧
        pmc k.1 k.2 (pjc k.1 k.2 (pmc i.1 i.2 x)) = pmc i.1 i.2 x ∧
        ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x' => pjc k.1 k.2 (pmc i.1 i.2 x')) x := fun i k =>
    trans (Wc i.1 i.2) (Wc k.1 k.2) (Oc k.1 k.2) (pmc i.1 i.2) (pmc k.1 k.2) (pjc k.1 k.2)
      (Φc i.1 i.2) (Φc k.1 k.2) (hWo _ _) (hOo _ _) (hpmc _ _) (hpmS _ _) (himg _ _)
      (hpjpm _ _) (fun x hx => ⟨(hslab _ _ 0 h0 x hx).1, (hslab _ _ 0 h0 x hx).2.1⟩)
      (fun x hx => ⟨(hslab _ _ 0 h0 x hx).1, (hslab _ _ 0 h0 x hx).2.1⟩)
  have hmet := fun (i : S) => metric (Φc i.1 i.2) (zc i.1 i.2) (Wc i.1 i.2) (hWo _ _)
    (fun x hx => ⟨(hslab _ _ 0 h0 x hx).1, by
      rw [(hslab _ _ 0 h0 x hx).2.1]; exact (hslab _ _ 0 h0 x hx).2.2⟩)
  let idx : Fin t.card → S := fun j => (t.equivFin.symm j).1
  let P : EigPatchedSurface M S :=
    { n := t.card
      W := fun j => Wc (idx j).1 (idx j).2
      param := fun j => pmc (idx j).1 (idx j).2
      proj := fun j => pjc (idx j).1 (idx j).2
      O := fun j => Oc (idx j).1 (idx j).2
      h := fun j x => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (zc (idx j).1 (idx j).2)).symm)
        (fun x' => chartAt E3 (zc (idx j).1 (idx j).2) (Φc (idx j).1 (idx j).2 (hpLift 0 x'))) x
      W_open := fun j => hWo _ _
      O_open := fun j => hOo _ _
      param_cont := fun j => hpmc _ _
      proj_cont := fun j => hpjc _ _
      image_eq := fun j => himg _ _
      proj_param := fun j => hpjpm _ _
      cover := by
        intro x hx
        have hx' := ht hx
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx'
        obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hx'
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨t.equivFin ⟨i, hi⟩, ?_⟩
        have e : idx (t.equivFin ⟨i, hi⟩) = i := by simp [idx]
        show x ∈ Oc (idx (t.equivFin ⟨i, hi⟩)).1 (idx (t.equivFin ⟨i, hi⟩)).2
        rw [e]
        exact hxi
      trans_smooth := fun j k x hx => ((htr (idx j) (idx k)).2 x hx).2.2.contDiffWithinAt
      h_smooth := fun j a b => (hmet (idx j)).1 a b
      h_posDef := fun j x hx => (hmet (idx j)).2.1 x hx
      h_compat := by
        intro j k x hx a b
        obtain ⟨hD, hpt⟩ := htr (idx j) (idx k)
        exact compat _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (hWo _ _) (hWo _ _) (hslab _ _ 0 h0) (hslab _ _ 0 h0)
          x hx.1 ((hpt x hx).2.2.differentiableAt (by simp))
          (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hD.mem_nhds hx)
            (fun x' hx' => ⟨hx'.1, (hpt x' hx').1, (hpt x' hx').2.1⟩)) a b }
  refine ⟨P, fun j => zc (idx j).1 (idx j).2, fun j => Φc (idx j).1 (idx j).2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j s hs x hx
    exact hslab (idx j).1 (idx j).2 s hs x hx
  · intro j x hx
    exact hlapse (idx j).1 (idx j).2 x hx
