subgoal_signatures.name: pullMetric2_reparam_compat
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (z₁ z₂ : M) (F₁ F₂ : E2 → E3) (τ : E2 → E2) (x : E2)
    (hF₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ F₁ x) (hF₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ F₂ (τ x))
    (hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ x)
    (h₁ : F₁ x ∈ (chartAt E3 z₁).target) (h₂ : F₂ (τ x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z₂).target)
    (heq : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, (chartAt E3 z₁).symm (F₁ x') = (chartAt E3 z₂).symm (F₂ (τ x'))) :
    ∀ a b : Fin 2, pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z₁).symm) F₁ x a b =
      ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 a) c * pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z₂).symm) F₂ (τ x) c d *
          fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) d

subgoal_signatures.name: slab_graph_param_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (z : M) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (a : ℝ) (v : ℝ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => v p.1 p.2) (Set.Ioo (-a) a ×ˢ W))
    (hsrc : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-a) a, ∀ x ∈ W, hpLift (v t x) x ∈ Φ.source ∧
      Φ (hpLift (v t x) x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v p.1 p.2) p.2)))
      (Set.Ioo (-a) a ×ˢ W) ∧
    (∀ c d : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm)
      (fun x => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v p.1 x) x))) p.2 c d) (Set.Ioo (-a) a ×ˢ W)) ∧
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-a) a, ∀ x ∈ W,
      chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v t x) x)) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v t x') x'))) x ∧
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => chartAt E3 z (Φ (hpLift (v t x') x'))) x))

informal_problem.statement:
(B : BanachScale)
    (hιE : ∀ k, Function.Injective (B.ιE k)) (hιE0 : ∀ v, B.ιE 0 v = v)
    (Hop : ∀ k, B.E k → B.F k) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hHs : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Hop k) {v | ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r})
    (hHc : ∀ k (v : B.E k), B.ιF k (Hop k v) = Hop 0 (B.ιE k v))
    (e₁ : ∀ k, B.E k) (he₁ : ∀ k, B.ιE k (e₁ k) = e₁ 0)
    (c : ∀ k, B.F k) (hc : ∀ k, B.ιF k (c k) = c 0)
    (ℓ : B.E 0 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hℓ : ℓ (e₁ 0) = 1)
    (hH0 : Hop 0 0 = 0) (hD0 : fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) 0 (e₁ 0) = 0)
    (hiso : ∀ k (v : B.E k), ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r → ∀ f : B.F k,
      ∃! p : B.E k × ℝ, ℓ (B.ιE k p.1) = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (Hop k) v p.1 - p.2 • c k = f)
    (hreg : ∀ k (v : B.E 0), ‖v‖ < r → ∀ a : ℝ, Hop 0 v = a • c 0 → ∃ w : B.E k, B.ιE k w = v)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (t₁ : ℝ) (V : ℝ → B.E 0) (h : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < t₁ ∧ V 0 = 0 ∧ h 0 = 0 ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, ‖t • e₁ 0 + V t‖ < r ∧
        Hop 0 (t • e₁ 0 + V t) = h t • c 0 ∧ ‖deriv V t‖ < ε) ∧
      (∀ k, ∃ Vk : ℝ → B.E k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vk (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, B.ιE k (Vk t) = V t)

signature.name: ls_ift_scale
signature.statement:
(B : BanachScale)
    (hιE : ∀ k, Function.Injective (B.ιE k)) (hιE0 : ∀ v, B.ιE 0 v = v)
    (Hop : ∀ k, B.E k → B.F k) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hHs : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Hop k) {v | ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r})
    (hHc : ∀ k (v : B.E k), B.ιF k (Hop k v) = Hop 0 (B.ιE k v))
    (e₁ : ∀ k, B.E k) (he₁ : ∀ k, B.ιE k (e₁ k) = e₁ 0)
    (c : ∀ k, B.F k) (hc : ∀ k, B.ιF k (c k) = c 0)
    (ℓ : B.E 0 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hℓ : ℓ (e₁ 0) = 1)
    (hH0 : Hop 0 0 = 0) (hD0 : fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) 0 (e₁ 0) = 0)
    (hiso : ∀ k (v : B.E k), ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r → ∀ f : B.F k,
      ∃! p : B.E k × ℝ, ℓ (B.ιE k p.1) = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (Hop k) v p.1 - p.2 • c k = f)
    (hreg : ∀ k (v : B.E 0), ‖v‖ < r → ∀ a : ℝ, Hop 0 v = a • c 0 → ∃ w : B.E k, B.ιE k w = v)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (t₁ : ℝ) (V : ℝ → B.E 0) (h : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < t₁ ∧ V 0 = 0 ∧ h 0 = 0 ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, ‖t • e₁ 0 + V t‖ < r ∧
        Hop 0 (t • e₁ 0 + V t) = h t • c 0 ∧ ‖deriv V t‖ < ε) ∧
      (∀ k, ∃ Vk : ℝ → B.E k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Vk (Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-t₁) t₁, B.ιE k (Vk t) = V t)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hUo : ∀ k, IsOpen {v : B.E k | ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r} := fun k =>
    isOpen_lt (continuous_norm.comp (B.ιE k).continuous) continuous_const
  have hCA : ∀ k (v : B.E k), ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Hop k) v :=
    fun k v hv => (hHs k).contDiffAt ((hUo k).mem_nhds hv)
  have hDA : ∀ k (v : B.E k), ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r → HasFDerivAt (Hop k) (fderiv ℝ (Hop k) v) v :=
    fun k v hv => ((hCA k v hv).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have h0mem : ∀ k, ‖B.ιE k (0 : B.E k)‖ < r := fun k => by simpa using hr
  
  have hιF : ∀ k, Function.Injective (B.ιF k) := by
    intro k
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro f hf
    have H1 : HasFDerivAt (fun v => B.ιF k (Hop k v)) ((B.ιF k).comp (fderiv ℝ (Hop k) 0)) 0 :=
      (B.ιF k).hasFDerivAt.comp 0 (hDA k 0 (h0mem k))
    have h0' : HasFDerivAt (Hop 0) (fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) 0) (B.ιE k 0) := by
      rw [map_zero]; exact hDA 0 0 (h0mem 0)
    have H2 : HasFDerivAt (fun v => Hop 0 (B.ιE k v)) ((fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) 0).comp (B.ιE k)) 0 :=
      h0'.comp 0 (B.ιE k).hasFDerivAt
    have hfun : (fun v => B.ιF k (Hop k v)) = (fun v => Hop 0 (B.ιE k v)) := funext (hHc k)
    rw [hfun] at H1
    have hcomp := H1.unique H2
    have hpt : ∀ w, B.ιF k (fderiv ℝ (Hop k) 0 w) = fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) 0 (B.ιE k w) := fun w => by
      have := congrArg (fun L => L w) hcomp
      simpa using this
    obtain ⟨⟨w, a⟩, ⟨hw1, hw2⟩, -⟩ := hiso k 0 (h0mem k) f
    simp only at hw1 hw2
    have hl0 : (fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) 0) (B.ιE k w) - a • c 0 = 0 := by
      rw [← hpt, ← hc k, ← map_smul, ← map_sub, hw2, hf]
    have huniq := (hiso 0 0 (h0mem 0) 0).unique (y₁ := (B.ιE k w, a)) (y₂ := (0, 0))
      ⟨by simpa [hιE0] using hw1, hl0⟩ ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at huniq
    have hw0 : w = 0 := hιE k (by rw [huniq.1, map_zero])
    rw [← hw2, hw0, huniq.2]; simp
  
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ : ∃ Φ : ∀ k, ℝ × (B.E k × ℝ) → B.F k × ℝ, ∀ k p, Φ k p =
      (Hop k (p.1 • e₁ k + p.2.1) - p.2.2 • c k, ℓ (B.ιE k p.2.1)) := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hΦz : ∀ k (t : ℝ) (p : B.E k × ℝ), Φ k (t, p) = 0 ↔
      Hop k (t • e₁ k + p.1) = p.2 • c k ∧ ℓ (B.ιE k p.1) = 0 := by
    intro k t p
    rw [hΦ, Prod.mk_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero]
  
  have IFTk : ∀ k (q : ℝ × (B.E k × ℝ)), ‖B.ιE k (q.1 • e₁ k + q.2.1)‖ < r → Φ k q = 0 →
      ∃ ψ : ℝ → B.E k × ℝ, ψ q.1 = q.2 ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ψ q.1 ∧
        (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 q.1, Φ k (t, ψ t) = 0) ∧
        ∀ γ : ℝ → B.E k × ℝ, ContinuousAt γ q.1 → γ q.1 = q.2 →
          (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 q.1, Φ k (t, γ t) = 0) → γ =ᶠ[𝓝 q.1] ψ := by
    intro k q hq hq0
    let A : ℝ × (B.E k × ℝ) →L[ℝ] B.E k :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (B.E k × ℝ)).smulRight (e₁ k) +
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (B.E k) ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (B.E k × ℝ))
    let S : ℝ × (B.E k × ℝ) →L[ℝ] B.F k :=
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (B.E k) ℝ).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (B.E k × ℝ))).smulRight (c k)
    let L : ℝ × (B.E k × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
      (ℓ.comp (B.ιE k)).comp
        ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (B.E k) ℝ).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (B.E k × ℝ)))
    have hA : ∀ p, A p = p.1 • e₁ k + p.2.1 := fun p => by simp [A]
    have hS : ∀ p, S p = p.2.2 • c k := fun p => by simp [S]
    have hL : ∀ p, L p = ℓ (B.ιE k p.2.1) := fun p => by simp [L]
    have hΦfun : Φ k = fun p => (Hop k (A p) - S p, L p) := by
      funext p; rw [hΦ, hA, hS, hL]
    set D := fderiv ℝ (Hop k) (q.1 • e₁ k + q.2.1) with hDdef
    have hHop : HasFDerivAt (Hop k) D (A q) := by rw [hA]; exact hDA k _ hq
    have hHopC : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Hop k) (A q) := by rw [hA]; exact hCA k _ hq
    have hfd : HasFDerivAt (Φ k) (((D.comp A) - S).prod L) q := by
      rw [hΦfun]
      exact ((hHop.comp q A.hasFDerivAt).sub S.hasFDerivAt).prodMk L.hasFDerivAt
    have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Φ k) q := by
      rw [hΦfun]
      exact ((hHopC.comp q A.contDiff.contDiffAt).sub S.contDiff.contDiffAt).prodMk
        L.contDiff.contDiffAt
    have hTapp : ∀ p : B.E k × ℝ,
        ((((D.comp A) - S).prod L).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (B.E k × ℝ))) p =
          (D p.1 - p.2 • c k, ℓ (B.ιE k p.1)) := by
      intro p
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, hA, hS, hL,
        zero_smul, zero_add]
    have hbij : Function.Bijective
        ((((D.comp A) - S).prod L).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (B.E k × ℝ))) := by
      constructor
      · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
        intro p hp
        rw [hTapp] at hp
        have h1 : D p.1 - p.2 • c k = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst hp
        have h2 : ℓ (B.ιE k p.1) = 0 := congrArg Prod.snd hp
        exact (hiso k _ hq 0).unique ⟨h2, h1⟩ ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
      · rintro ⟨f, s⟩
        obtain ⟨⟨w₀, a₀⟩, ⟨h1, h2⟩, -⟩ := hiso k _ hq (f - s • D (e₁ k))
        simp only at h1 h2
        refine ⟨(w₀ + s • e₁ k, a₀), ?_⟩
        rw [hTapp]
        refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
        · simp only
          rw [map_add, map_smul, add_sub_right_comm, h2, sub_add_cancel]
        · simp only
          rw [map_add, map_smul, map_add, map_smul, h1, he₁, hℓ]
          simp
    have hI : IsContDiffImplicitAt ∞ (Φ k) (((D.comp A) - S).prod L) q :=
      IsContDiffImplicitAt.mk hfd hcd hbij (by simp)
    refine ⟨hI.implicitFunction, ?_, hI.contDiffAt_implicitFunction, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hI.eventually_implicitFunction_apply_eq.self_of_nhds rfl
    · filter_upwards [hI.apply_implicitFunction] with t ht
      rw [ht, hq0]
    · intro γ hγ hγ0 hγe
      have hσc : ContinuousAt (fun t => (t, γ t)) q.1 := continuousAt_id.prodMk hγ
      have hσ : Tendsto (fun t => (t, γ t)) (𝓝 q.1) (𝓝 q) := by
        have := hσc.tendsto
        rwa [show ((q.1, γ q.1) : ℝ × (B.E k × ℝ)) = q by rw [hγ0]] at this
      filter_upwards [hσ.eventually hI.eventually_implicitFunction_apply_eq, hγe] with t h1 h2
      exact (h1 (by rw [h2, hq0])).symm
  
  obtain ⟨ψ₀, hψ₀0, hψ₀s, hψ₀e, -⟩ := IFTk 0 ((0 : ℝ), ((0 : B.E 0), (0 : ℝ)))
    (by simpa using hr) (by rw [hΦ]; simp [hH0])
  simp only at hψ₀0 hψ₀s hψ₀e
  have hV0 : (ψ₀ 0).1 = 0 := by rw [hψ₀0]
  have hh0 : (ψ₀ 0).2 = 0 := by rw [hψ₀0]
  
  have hV'0 : deriv (fun t => (ψ₀ t).1) 0 = 0 := by
    have hψ₀d : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ₀ 0 := hψ₀s.differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hVd : HasDerivAt (fun t => (ψ₀ t).1) (deriv (fun t => (ψ₀ t).1) 0) 0 :=
      hψ₀d.fst.hasDerivAt
    have hhd : HasDerivAt (fun t => (ψ₀ t).2) (deriv (fun t => (ψ₀ t).2) 0) 0 :=
      hψ₀d.snd.hasDerivAt
    have hD00 : HasFDerivAt (Hop 0) (fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) 0) ((0 : ℝ) • e₁ 0 + (ψ₀ 0).1) := by
      rw [hV0, zero_smul, add_zero]; exact hDA 0 0 (h0mem 0)
    have hu : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t • e₁ 0 + (ψ₀ t).1)
        ((1 : ℝ) • e₁ 0 + deriv (fun t => (ψ₀ t).1) 0) 0 :=
      ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const (e₁ 0)).add hVd
    have hg : HasDerivAt (fun t => Hop 0 (t • e₁ 0 + (ψ₀ t).1) - (ψ₀ t).2 • c 0)
        (fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) 0 ((1 : ℝ) • e₁ 0 + deriv (fun t => (ψ₀ t).1) 0) -
          deriv (fun t => (ψ₀ t).2) 0 • c 0) 0 :=
      (hD00.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hu).sub (hhd.smul_const (c 0))
    have hgz : (fun t => Hop 0 (t • e₁ 0 + (ψ₀ t).1) - (ψ₀ t).2 • c 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        fun _ => (0 : B.F 0) := by
      filter_upwards [hψ₀e] with t ht
      rw [hΦz] at ht
      rw [ht.1, sub_self]
    have h1 := hg.unique ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (0 : B.F 0)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hgz)
    rw [one_smul, map_add, hD0, zero_add] at h1
    have hlz : (⇑ℓ ∘ fun t => (ψ₀ t).1) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hψ₀e] with t ht
      rw [hΦz, hιE0] at ht
      exact ht.2
    have h2 := (ℓ.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hVd).unique
      ((hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (0 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hlz)
    have huniq := (hiso 0 0 (h0mem 0) 0).unique
      (y₁ := (deriv (fun t => (ψ₀ t).1) 0, deriv (fun t => (ψ₀ t).2) 0)) (y₂ := (0, 0))
      ⟨by simpa [hιE0] using h2, h1⟩ ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
    exact congrArg Prod.fst huniq
  
  have E1 : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), ContinuousAt ψ₀ t := by
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 ψ₀ 0 := hψ₀s.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    filter_upwards [h1.eventually (by simp)] with t ht
    exact ht.continuousAt
  have E2 : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), ‖t • e₁ 0 + (ψ₀ t).1‖ < r := by
    have hc0 : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => ‖t • e₁ 0 + (ψ₀ t).1‖) 0 :=
      ((continuousAt_id.smul continuousAt_const).add hψ₀s.continuousAt.fst).norm
    exact hc0.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by simpa [hV0] using hr)
  have E3 : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), ‖deriv (fun s => (ψ₀ s).1) t‖ < ε := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hu1⟩ := hψ₀s.fst.contDiffOn (m := 1) (by exact_mod_cast le_top) (by simp)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hu
    have hcont : ContinuousAt (deriv (fun s => (ψ₀ s).1)) 0 :=
      ((hu1.mono hball).continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen isOpen_ball le_rfl).continuousAt
        (ball_mem_nhds 0 hδ)
    exact hcont.norm.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by rw [hV'0, norm_zero]; exact hε)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hall⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hψ₀e.and (E1.and (E2.and E3)))
  have hgood : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ, Φ 0 (t, ψ₀ t) = 0 ∧ ContinuousAt ψ₀ t ∧
      ‖t • e₁ 0 + (ψ₀ t).1‖ < r ∧ ‖deriv (fun s => (ψ₀ s).1) t‖ < ε := by
    intro t ht
    apply hall
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_lt]
    exact ⟨ht.1, ht.2⟩
  have hEvI : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ, ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, Φ 0 (s, ψ₀ s) = 0 := fun t ht =>
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2) (fun s hs => (hgood s hs).1)
  
  have hloc0 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ, ∃ ψ' : ℝ → B.E 0 × ℝ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ψ' t ∧
      ψ₀ =ᶠ[𝓝 t] ψ' ∧ ∀ γ : ℝ → B.E 0 × ℝ, ContinuousAt γ t → γ t = ψ₀ t →
        (∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, Φ 0 (s, γ s) = 0) → γ =ᶠ[𝓝 t] ψ' := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨ψ', -, h2, -, h4⟩ := IFTk 0 (t, ψ₀ t)
      (by simpa [hιE0] using (hgood t ht).2.2.1) (hgood t ht).1
    exact ⟨ψ', h2, h4 ψ₀ (hgood t ht).2.1 rfl (hEvI t ht), h4⟩
  have hψ₀C : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ψ₀ t := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨ψ', h2, heq, -⟩ := hloc0 t ht
    exact h2.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  refine ⟨δ, fun t => (ψ₀ t).1, fun t => (ψ₀ t).2, hδ, hV0, hh0,
    fun t ht => (hψ₀C t ht).snd.contDiffWithinAt, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨hz, -, hn, hd⟩ := hgood t ht
    rw [hΦz] at hz
    exact ⟨hn, hz.1, hd⟩
  · intro k
    haveI : Nonempty (B.E k) := ⟨0⟩
    
    have hlift : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-δ) δ, ∃ φ : ℝ → B.E k, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φ t ∧
        ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, B.ιE k (φ s) = (ψ₀ s).1 := by
      intro t ht
      obtain ⟨hz, -, hnorm, -⟩ := hgood t ht
      rw [hΦz] at hz
      obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := hreg k _ hnorm _ hz.1
      have hιw : B.ιE k (w' - t • e₁ k) = (ψ₀ t).1 := by
        rw [map_sub, map_smul, he₁, hw', add_sub_cancel_left]
      have hsum : t • e₁ k + (w' - t • e₁ k) = w' := add_sub_cancel _ _
      have hqn : ‖B.ιE k ((t, (w' - t • e₁ k, (ψ₀ t).2)).1 • e₁ k +
          (t, (w' - t • e₁ k, (ψ₀ t).2)).2.1)‖ < r := by
        simp only
        rw [hsum, hw']
        exact hnorm
      have hqz : Φ k (t, (w' - t • e₁ k, (ψ₀ t).2)) = 0 := by
        rw [hΦz]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only
          rw [hsum]
          apply hιF k
          rw [hHc, hw', map_smul, hc, hz.1]
        · simp only
          rw [hιw]
          have := hz.2
          rwa [hιE0] at this
      obtain ⟨ψk, hψk0, hψks, hψke, -⟩ := IFTk k _ hqn hqz
      simp only at hψk0 hψks hψke
      obtain ⟨ψ', -, heq, huniq⟩ := hloc0 t ht
      have hγc : ContinuousAt (fun s => (B.ιE k (ψk s).1, (ψk s).2)) t :=
        ((B.ιE k).continuous.continuousAt.comp hψks.continuousAt.fst).prodMk
          hψks.continuousAt.snd
      have hγt : (fun s => (B.ιE k (ψk s).1, (ψk s).2)) t = ψ₀ t := by
        simp only
        rw [hψk0]
        simp only
        rw [hιw]
      have hγe : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 t, Φ 0 (s, (fun s => (B.ιE k (ψk s).1, (ψk s).2)) s) = 0 := by
        filter_upwards [hψke] with s hs
        rw [hΦz] at hs ⊢
        simp only
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← he₁ k, ← (B.ιE k).map_smul, ← map_add, ← hHc k, hs.1, map_smul, hc]
        · rw [hιE0]; exact hs.2
      have hfin := (huniq _ hγc hγt hγe).trans heq.symm
      refine ⟨fun s => (ψk s).1, hψks.fst, ?_⟩
      filter_upwards [hfin] with s hs
      exact congrArg Prod.fst hs
    refine ⟨fun t => Function.invFun (B.ιE k) ((ψ₀ t).1), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      obtain ⟨φ, hφs, hφe⟩ := hlift t ht
      have hev : (fun t => Function.invFun (B.ιE k) ((ψ₀ t).1)) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] φ := by
        filter_upwards [hφe] with s hs
        rw [← hs]
        exact Function.leftInverse_invFun (hιE k) (φ s)
      exact (hφs.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev).contDiffWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      obtain ⟨φ, -, hφe⟩ := hlift t ht
      exact Function.invFun_eq ⟨φ t, hφe.self_of_nhds⟩

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (hSc : IsCompact S) (hSne : S.Nonempty) (hSpc : IsPreconnected S)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (s₁ : ℝ) (hs₁ : 0 < s₁)
    (G : Fin P.n → E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hGs : ∀ j (a b : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G j y a b)
      {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ P.W j})
    (hGsymm : ∀ j (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G j y a b = G j y b a)
    (hGpd : ∀ j, ∀ y : E3, |y 0| < s₁ → hpProj y ∈ P.W j → (G j y).PosDef)
    (hGc : ∀ j k, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      G j (hpLift s x) = pullbackMetric (G k)
        (fun y => hpLift (y 0) (P.proj k (P.param j (hpProj y)))) (hpLift s x))
    (hleaf : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      levelMeanCurvCoord (G j) (fun y => y 0) (hpLift 0 x) = 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun s => levelMeanCurvCoord (G j) (fun y => y 0) (hpLift s x)) 0 0) :
    ∃ (B : BanachScale) (Hop : ∀ k, B.E k → B.F k) (r : ℝ) (e₁ : ∀ k, B.E k) (c : ∀ k, B.F k)
      (ℓ : B.E 0 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ev : B.E 0 → X → ℝ) (C : ℝ),
      (∀ k, Function.Injective (B.ιE k)) ∧ (∀ v, B.ιE 0 v = v) ∧ 0 < r ∧
      (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Hop k) {v | ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r}) ∧
      (∀ k (v : B.E k), B.ιF k (Hop k v) = Hop 0 (B.ιE k v)) ∧
      (∀ k, B.ιE k (e₁ k) = e₁ 0) ∧ (∀ k, B.ιF k (c k) = c 0) ∧ ℓ (e₁ 0) = 1 ∧
      Hop 0 0 = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) 0 (e₁ 0) = 0 ∧
      (∀ k (v : B.E k), ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r → ∀ f : B.F k,
        ∃! p : B.E k × ℝ, ℓ (B.ιE k p.1) = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (Hop k) v p.1 - p.2 • c k = f) ∧
      (∀ k (v : B.E 0), ‖v‖ < r → ∀ a : ℝ, Hop 0 v = a • c 0 → ∃ w : B.E k, B.ιE k w = v) ∧
      (∀ (a : ℝ) (v w : B.E 0), ev (a • v + w) = fun q => a * ev v q + ev w q) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ S, ev (e₁ 0) q = 1) ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ (∀ v, ∀ q ∈ S, |ev v q| ≤ C * ‖v‖) ∧
      (∀ v : B.E 0, ‖v‖ < r → (∀ q ∈ S, ev v q ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁) ∧
        ∀ a : ℝ, Hop 0 v = a • c 0 → ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
          levelMeanCurvCoord (G j) (fun y => y 0 - ev v (P.param j (hpProj y)))
            (hpLift (ev v (P.param j x)) x) = a) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (I : Set ℝ), IsOpen I → ∀ γ : ℝ → B.E k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ γ I →
        ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × E2 => ev (B.ιE k (γ p.1)) (P.param j p.2))
          (I ×ˢ P.W j))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hparS : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ S := by
    intro j x hx
    have h : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at h
    exact h.2
  have hT : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) = P.param j x := by
    intro j k x hx
    have h1 : P.param j x ∈ P.O k ∩ S := ⟨hx.2, hparS j x hx.1⟩
    rw [← P.image_eq k] at h1
    obtain ⟨x'', hx'', hxe⟩ := h1
    rw [← hxe, P.proj_param k x'' hx'']
    exact ⟨hx'', rfl⟩
  have hSpar : ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ j, ∃ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x = q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hq)
    have h : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hj, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxq⟩ := h
    exact ⟨j, x, hx, hxq⟩
  
  have hα0 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 := by norm_num
  have hα1 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1 := by norm_num
  have hCD2 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → 2 ≤ m →
      pcrHolLoc (1 / 2) m w U → ∀ x ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x := by
    intro m w U hU hm hw x hx
    have h1 := hw.1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    exact h1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hm)
  
  have hbasic : ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set E2), IsOpen U →
      (∀ c : ℝ, pcrHolLoc (1 / 2) m (fun _ => c) U) ∧
      (∀ w₁ w₂ : E2 → ℝ, pcrHolLoc (1 / 2) m w₁ U → pcrHolLoc (1 / 2) m w₂ U →
        pcrHolLoc (1 / 2) m (fun x => w₁ x + w₂ x) U) ∧
      (∀ w₁ w₂ : E2 → ℝ, pcrHolLoc (1 / 2) m w₁ U → Set.EqOn w₁ w₂ U →
        pcrHolLoc (1 / 2) m w₂ U) := by
    intro m U hU
    refine ⟨fun c => ?_, fun w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ => ?_, fun w₁ w₂ h₁ heq => ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨contDiffOn_const, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hU x hx
      refine ⟨ρ, hρ, hball, 0, fun y _ z _ => ?_⟩
      have hc : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun _ : E2 => c) y =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun _ : E2 => c) z := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with h | h
        · subst h
          ext v
          simp [iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply]
        · rw [iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp h)]
          rfl
      rw [hc, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_mul]
    · refine ⟨h₁.1.add h₂.1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨ρ₁, hρ₁, hb₁, C₁, hC₁⟩ := h₁.2 x hx
      obtain ⟨ρ₂, hρ₂, hb₂, C₂, hC₂⟩ := h₂.2 x hx
      have hs1 : Metric.ball x (min ρ₁ ρ₂) ⊆ Metric.ball x ρ₁ :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
      have hs2 : Metric.ball x (min ρ₁ ρ₂) ⊆ Metric.ball x ρ₂ :=
        Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
      have hadd : ∀ u ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x => w₁ x + w₂ x) u =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₁ u + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₂ u := fun u hu =>
        iteratedFDeriv_add_apply' (h₁.1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hu))
          (h₂.1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hu))
      refine ⟨min ρ₁ ρ₂, lt_min hρ₁ hρ₂, hs1.trans hb₁, C₁ + C₂, fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [hadd y (hb₁ (hs1 hy)), hadd z (hb₁ (hs1 hz))]
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₁ y + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₂ y -
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₁ z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₂ z)‖
          = ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₁ y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₁ z) +
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₂ y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₂ z)‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₁ y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₁ z‖ +
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₂ y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₂ z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ C₁ * dist y z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + C₂ * dist y z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
            add_le_add (hC₁ y (hs1 hy) z (hs1 hz)) (hC₂ y (hs2 hy) z (hs2 hz))
        _ = (C₁ + C₂) * dist y z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by ring
    · refine ⟨h₁.1.congr (fun x hx => (heq hx).symm), fun x hx => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hb, C, hC⟩ := h₁.2 x hx
      have hit : ∀ u ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₂ u = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w₁ u := by
        intro u hu
        have hev : w₂ =ᶠ[𝓝 u] w₁ :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hu) (fun y hy => (heq hy).symm)
        exact (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds
      refine ⟨ρ, hρ, hb, C, fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [hit y (hb hy), hit z (hb hz)]

    exact h2.mfderiv
  
  have hdeq : ∀ j k y, y ∈ Vf (pt j) → y ∈ Vf (pt k) → y ∈ frontier U →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (hf (pt j)) y = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (hf (pt k)) y := by
    intro j k y hyj hyk hyF
    have hsj := hfs _ (hptK j)
    have hsk := hfs _ (hptK k)
    have hVjk : IsOpen (Vf (pt j) ∩ Vf (pt k)) := (hVfo _ (hptK j)).inter (hVfo _ (hptK k))
    have hAo : IsOpen (Vf (pt j) ∩ Vf (pt k) ∩ {z | 0 < hf (pt j) z}) :=
      hVjk.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hsj.continuous)
    have hAeq : ∀ z ∈ Vf (pt j) ∩ Vf (pt k) ∩ {z | 0 < hf (pt j) z},
        hf (pt j) z = hf (pt k) z := by
      intro z hz
      have hzC : z ∈ C := ((hfC _ (hptK j)) z hz.1.1).1 hz.2
      rw [← hfσ _ (hptK j) z hz.1.1 hzC, hfσ _ (hptK k) z hz.1.2 hzC]
    have hyA : y ∈ closure (Vf (pt j) ∩ Vf (pt k) ∩ {z | 0 < hf (pt j) z}) := by
      rw [mem_closure_iff_nhds]
      intro O hO
      have h0 : hf (pt j) y = 0 := ((hfF _ (hptK j)) y hyj).1 hyF
      obtain ⟨⟨z, hzO, hz⟩, -⟩ := frontier_sign_change (hf (pt j)) y hsj h0
        (hdf _ (hptK j) y hyj) (O ∩ (Vf (pt j) ∩ Vf (pt k)))
        (Filter.inter_mem hO (hVjk.mem_nhds ⟨hyj, hyk⟩))
      exact ⟨z, hzO.1, hzO.2, hz⟩
    have hzeroA : ∀ z ∈ Vf (pt j) ∩ Vf (pt k) ∩ {z | 0 < hf (pt j) z},
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (hf (pt j) - hf (pt k)) z = 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have hev : (hf (pt j) - hf (pt k)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hAo.mem_nhds hz] with x hx
        rw [Pi.sub_apply, hAeq x hx, sub_self]
      rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_const]
    have hy0 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (hf (pt j) - hf (pt k)) y = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      have hev := mfderiv_ne_zero_eventually Set.univ (hf (pt j) - hf (pt k))
        isOpen_univ (hsj.sub hsk).contMDiffOn y (Set.mem_univ y) hne
      obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 hyA _ hev
      exact absurd (hzeroA z hz2) hz1
    rw [mfderiv_sub (hsj.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)) (hsk.mdifferentiableAt (by simp))] at hy0
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 hy0
  
  have hT1 : ∀ y, c < S y → y ∈ frontier U → ρ y = 0 ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy hyF
    have hz : ∀ j, y ∈ Vf (pt j) → hf (pt j) y = 0 := fun j hj => ((hfF _ (hptK j)) y hj).1 hyF
    refine ⟨hval y hy 0 hz, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hposj y hy
    have hyj₀ := hψV j₀ y hj₀
    rw [hdρ y hy hz j₀ (fun j hj => hdeq j j₀ y hj hyj₀ hyF)]
    exact hdf _ (hptK j₀) y hyj₀
  have hT2 : ∀ y, c < S y → y ∈ C → ρ y = σ y := fun y hy hyC =>
    hval y hy (σ y) (fun j hj => (hfσ _ (hptK j) y hj hyC).symm)
  have hT3 : ∀ y, c < S y → y ∉ frontier U → y ∉ C → ρ y < 0 := by
    intro y hy hyF hyC
    refine hneg y hy (fun j hj => ?_)
    have h1 : hf (pt j) y ≠ 0 := fun h => hyF (((hfF _ (hptK j)) y hj).2 h)
    have h2 : ¬ 0 < hf (pt j) y := fun h => hyC (((hfC _ (hptK j)) y hj).1 h)
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.1 h2) h1
  
  refine ⟨1, fun _ => {y | c < S y} ∩ interior {y | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ y ≠ 0},
    fun _ => ρ, ?_, fun _ => ⟨?_, ?_, hρs, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, fun _ x hx hpos => ?_,
    fun _ x hx hxC => ?_,
    fun _ _ x _ => ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => (one_mul _).symm⟩⟩
  · intro x hx
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨0, hKc x hx, ?_⟩
    exact mem_interior_iff_mem_nhds.2 (mfderiv_ne_zero_eventually Set.univ ρ isOpen_univ
      hρs.contMDiffOn x (Set.mem_univ x) (hT1 x (hKc x hx) hx.2).2)
  · exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hSs.continuous).inter isOpen_interior
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hposj y hy.1
    exact hVfN _ (hptK j₀) (hψV j₀ y hj₀)
  · intro x hx
    exact interior_subset hx.2
  · ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hy, hyF⟩
      exact ⟨hy, (hT1 y hy.1 hyF).1⟩
    · rintro ⟨hy, hy0⟩
      refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
      have hy0' : ρ y = 0 := hy0
      by_contra hyF
      by_cases hyC : y ∈ C
      · have h1 := hT2 y hy.1 hyC
        have h2 := (hσb y (hCX hyC)).1
        linarith
      · have := hT3 y hy.1 hyF hyC
        linarith
  · rintro y ⟨hy, hyF⟩
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hposj y hy.1
    have hyj₀ := hψV j₀ y hj₀
    rw [mem_closure_iff_nhds]
    intro O hO
    have h0 : hf (pt j₀) y = 0 := ((hfF _ (hptK j₀)) y hyj₀).1 hyF
    obtain ⟨⟨z, hzO, hz⟩, -⟩ := frontier_sign_change (hf (pt j₀)) y (hfs _ (hptK j₀)) h0
      (hdf _ (hptK j₀) y hyj₀) (O ∩ Vf (pt j₀))
      (Filter.inter_mem hO ((hVfo _ (hptK j₀)).mem_nhds hyj₀))
    exact ⟨z, hzO.1, ((hfC _ (hptK j₀)) z hzO.2).1 hz⟩
  · by_contra hxC
    by_cases hxF : x ∈ frontier U
    · have := (hT1 x hx.1 hxF).1
      linarith
    · have := hT3 x hx.1 hxF hxC
      linarith
  · show σ x = |ρ x|
    rw [hT2 x hx.1 hxC, abs_of_pos (hσb x (hCX hxC)).1]

subgoal_signatures.name: frontier_sign_change
subgoal_signatures.statement: (f : M → ℝ) (x : M) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (hx : f x = 0) (hdf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) : ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 x, (∃ z ∈ O, 0 < f z) ∧ (∃ z ∈ O, f z < 0)

    (hdy : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w y ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 y, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (f h : M → ℝ) (W : Set M) (x : M)
    (hW : IsOpen W) (hxW : x ∈ W)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (hh : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ h)
    (hsq : ∀ y ∈ W, f y ^ 2 = h y ^ 2)
    (hdh : h x = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) h x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y = e * h y

signature.name: sq_eq_local_sign
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (f h : M → ℝ) (W : Set M) (x : M)
    (hW : IsOpen W) (hxW : x ∈ W)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (hh : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ h)
    (hsq : ∀ y ∈ W, f y ^ 2 = h y ^ 2)
    (hdh : h x = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) h x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f y = e * h y

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have s1 : ∀ (P Q : M → ℝ), Continuous P → (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, P y * Q y = 0) →
      (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, Q z ≠ 0) → ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, P y = 0 := by
    intro P Q hP hPQ hQ
    filter_upwards [hPQ.eventually_nhds, hQ] with y hy1 hy2
    by_contra hPy
    have h3 : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, Q z = 0 := by
      filter_upwards [hy1, hP.continuousAt.eventually_ne hPy] with z hz1 hz2
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz1).resolve_left hz2
    obtain ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ := (hy2.and_eventually h3).exists
    exact hz1 hz2
  
  have s2 : ∀ (G : E3 → ℝ) (s : Set E3) (a : E3), IsOpen s → a ∈ s → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G s →
      fderiv ℝ G a ≠ 0 → ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 a, ∃ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, G w ≠ 0 := by
    intro G s a hs ha hG hda
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ G) s := hG.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hs (by simp)
    filter_upwards [(hc.continuousAt (hs.mem_nhds ha)).eventually_ne hda] with z hz
    by_contra hfr
    rw [Filter.not_frequently] at hfr
    have hev : G =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := hfr.mono fun w hw => by simpa using hw
    exact hz (by rw [hev.fderiv_eq]; exact fderiv_const_apply _)
  set φ := extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x with hφ
  
  have s3a : ∀ Q : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ Q →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => Q (φ.symm w)) φ.target := by
    intro Q hQ
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hQ.comp_contMDiffOn (contMDiffOn_extChartAt_symm x))
  
  have s3b : ∀ Q : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ Q →
      fderiv ℝ (fun w => Q (φ.symm w)) (φ x) = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) Q x := by
    intro Q hQ
    have hd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) Q x := hQ.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    rw [hd.mfderiv, ModelWithCorners.range_eq_univ, fderivWithin_univ]
    rfl
  
  have s4 : ∀ Q : M → ℝ, (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (φ x), ∃ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, Q (φ.symm w) ≠ 0) →
      ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∃ᶠ y' in 𝓝 y, Q y' ≠ 0 := by
    intro Q hQ
    filter_upwards [(continuousAt_extChartAt x).tendsto.eventually hQ,
      extChartAt_source_mem_nhds (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) x] with y hy hys
    by_contra hfr
    rw [Filter.not_frequently] at hfr
    have hc : ContinuousAt φ.symm (φ y) := continuousAt_extChartAt_symm' hys
    have hc' : Filter.Tendsto φ.symm (𝓝 (φ y)) (𝓝 y) := by
      have := hc.tendsto
      rwa [φ.left_inv hys] at this
    have h0 : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 (φ y), ¬ Q (φ.symm w) ≠ 0 := hc'.eventually hfr
    obtain ⟨w, hw1, hw2⟩ := (hy.and_eventually h0).exists
    exact hw2 hw1
  
  have hWn : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, y ∈ W := hW.mem_nhds hxW
  have hPQ1 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (f y - h y) * (f y + h y) = 0 := hWn.mono fun y hy => by
    rw [show (f y - h y) * (f y + h y) = f y ^ 2 - h y ^ 2 by ring, hsq y hy, sub_self]
  have hPQ2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (f y + h y) * (f y - h y) = 0 := hWn.mono fun y hy => by
    rw [show (f y + h y) * (f y - h y) = f y ^ 2 - h y ^ 2 by ring, hsq y hy, sub_self]
  have hfc := hf.continuous
  have hhc := hh.continuous
  have key : (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, f z + h z ≠ 0) ∨
      (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, f z - h z ≠ 0) := by
    by_cases hx0 : h x = 0
    · have hdx := hdh hx0
      have hT : IsOpen φ.target := isOpen_extChartAt_target x
      have ha : φ x ∈ φ.target := mem_extChartAt_target x
      have hFc := s3a f hf
      have hHc := s3a h hh
      have hne : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
      have hFd := (hFc.differentiableOn hne).differentiableAt (hT.mem_nhds ha)
      have hHd := (hHc.differentiableOn hne).differentiableAt (hT.mem_nhds ha)
      have hadd : fderiv ℝ (fun w => f (φ.symm w) + h (φ.symm w)) (φ x) =
          fderiv ℝ (fun w => f (φ.symm w)) (φ x) + fderiv ℝ (fun w => h (φ.symm w)) (φ x) :=
        fderiv_add hFd hHd
      have hsub : fderiv ℝ (fun w => f (φ.symm w) - h (φ.symm w)) (φ x) =
          fderiv ℝ (fun w => f (φ.symm w)) (φ x) - fderiv ℝ (fun w => h (φ.symm w)) (φ x) :=
        fderiv_sub hFd hHd
      by_cases hp : fderiv ℝ (fun w => f (φ.symm w) + h (φ.symm w)) (φ x) = 0
      · right
        have hm : fderiv ℝ (fun w => f (φ.symm w) - h (φ.symm w)) (φ x) ≠ 0 := by
          intro hm
          apply hdx
          rw [← s3b h hh]
          refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
          show fderiv ℝ (fun w => h (φ.symm w)) (φ x) v = (0 : ℝ)
          have e1 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L v) (hadd.symm.trans hp)
          have e2 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L v) (hsub.symm.trans hm)
          simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at e1 e2 ⊢
          linarith
        exact s4 (fun y => f y - h y) (s2 _ _ _ hT ha (hFc.sub hHc) hm)
      · left
        exact s4 (fun y => f y + h y) (s2 _ _ _ hT ha (hFc.add hHc) hp)
    · by_cases hp : f x + h x = 0
      · right
        have hm : f x - h x ≠ 0 := by
          intro hm
          apply hx0
          linarith
        have hev := (hfc.sub hhc).continuousAt.eventually_ne hm
        exact hev.eventually_nhds.mono fun y hy => hy.frequently
      · left
        have hev := (hfc.add hhc).continuousAt.eventually_ne hp
        exact hev.eventually_nhds.mono fun y hy => hy.frequently
  rcases key with hk | hk
  · refine ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
    have hz := s1 (fun y => f y - h y) (fun y => f y + h y) (hfc.sub hhc) hPQ1 hk
    filter_upwards [hz] with y hy
    linarith
  · refine ⟨-1, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
    have hz := s1 (fun y => f y + h y) (fun y => f y - h y) (hfc.add hhc) hPQ2 hk
    filter_upwards [hz] with y hy
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hNg2 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ℓ (Ng x ℓ) = 1)
    (hNg3 : ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
      (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
        (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x)
    (nB : ℕ) (B : Fin nB → Set M) (f : Fin nB → M → ℝ)
    (hBo : ∀ i, IsOpen (B i)) (hfs : ∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i))
    (hdf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f i) x ≠ 0)
    (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKB : K ⊆ ⋃ i, B i)
    (hK0 : ∀ i, ∀ p ∈ K, p ∈ B i → f i p = 0) :
    ∃ (R : ℕ) (ι : Fin R → Fin nB) (q : Fin R → M) (B' D : Fin R → Set M)
      (Fl : Fin R → ℝ → M → M) (T : ℝ), 0 < T ∧ K ⊆ ⋃ r, D r ∧ ∀ r,
      IsOpen (B' r) ∧ IsOpen (D r) ∧ D r ⊆ B' r ∧ B' r ⊆ B (ι r) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B' r, Fl r 0 y = y ∧
        IsMIntegralCurveOn (fun t => Fl r t y)
          (fun x => Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f (ι r)) x)) (Set.Ioo (-T) T) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, Fl r t y ∈ B (ι r) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q r)).source ∧
          f (ι r) (Fl r t y) = f (ι r) y + t) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 (q r) (Fl r p.1 ((chartAt E3 (q r)).symm p.2)))
        (Set.Ioo (-T) T ×ˢ (chartAt E3 (q r) '' B' r)) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, ∀ u ∈ chartAt E3 (q r) '' B' r, ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
        fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 (q r) (Fl r p.1 ((chartAt E3 (q r)).symm p.2)))
          (t, u) (a, w) = 0 →
        w = -a • fderiv ℝ
          (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 (q r) (Fl r p.1 ((chartAt E3 (q r)).symm p.2)))
          (0, u) (1, 0)) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B' r, ∀ y' ∈ B' r, ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, Fl r t y = Fl r t y' → y = y') ∧
      (∀ x ∈ D r, |f (ι r) x| < T ∧ Fl r (-f (ι r) x) x ∈ B' r ∧
        Fl r (f (ι r) x) (Fl r (-f (ι r) x) x) = x)

signature.name: collar_flow_boxes
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hNg2 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ℓ (Ng x ℓ) = 1)
    (hNg3 : ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
      (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
        (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x)
    (nB : ℕ) (B : Fin nB → Set M) (f : Fin nB → M → ℝ)
    (hBo : ∀ i, IsOpen (B i)) (hfs : ∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i))
    (hdf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f i) x ≠ 0)
    (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKB : K ⊆ ⋃ i, B i)
    (hK0 : ∀ i, ∀ p ∈ K, p ∈ B i → f i p = 0) :
    ∃ (R : ℕ) (ι : Fin R → Fin nB) (q : Fin R → M) (B' D : Fin R → Set M)
      (Fl : Fin R → ℝ → M → M) (T : ℝ), 0 < T ∧ K ⊆ ⋃ r, D r ∧ ∀ r,
