        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
        V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ V ∩ frontier U, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧
          g.jacobiDeriv f x = lam x / φ x)
    (nB : ℕ) (B : Fin nB → Set M) (f : Fin nB → M → ℝ)
    (hBo : ∀ i, IsOpen (B i)) (hfs : ∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i))
    (hdf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f i) x ≠ 0)
    (hBF : ∀ i, B i ∩ frontier U = B i ∩ (f i) ⁻¹' {0})
    (hBsgn : ∀ i k, ∀ x ∈ B i ∩ B k, ∃ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f i y = e * f k y)
    (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKF : K ⊆ frontier U) (hKB : K ⊆ ⋃ i, B i) :
    ∃ (Λf : M → ℝ) (Λ μ : ℝ), 0 < μ ∧ (∀ y ∈ K, μ ≤ Λf y ∧ Λf y ≤ Λ) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ B i ∩ frontier U, Λf y = φ y * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (f i) (f i) y)) ∧
      (∀ i (W : Set E2) (Fh : E2 → E3) (p : M), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fh W →
        (∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
          (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x) ∈ frontier U ∩ B i) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Λf ((chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x))) W)

signature.name: collar_lapse_function
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (φ lam : M → ℝ)
    (hdata : ∀ p ∈ frontier U, 0 < φ p ∧ ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
        ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
        V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
        ∀ x ∈ V ∩ frontier U, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f x) * φ x = 1 ∧
          g.jacobiDeriv f x = lam x / φ x)
    (nB : ℕ) (B : Fin nB → Set M) (f : Fin nB → M → ℝ)
    (hBo : ∀ i, IsOpen (B i)) (hfs : ∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i))
    (hdf : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ B i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (f i) x ≠ 0)
    (hBF : ∀ i, B i ∩ frontier U = B i ∩ (f i) ⁻¹' {0})
    (hBsgn : ∀ i k, ∀ x ∈ B i ∩ B k, ∃ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f i y = e * f k y)
    (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKF : K ⊆ frontier U) (hKB : K ⊆ ⋃ i, B i) :
    ∃ (Λf : M → ℝ) (Λ μ : ℝ), 0 < μ ∧ (∀ y ∈ K, μ ≤ Λf y ∧ Λf y ≤ Λ) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ B i ∩ frontier U, Λf y = φ y * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (f i) (f i) y)) ∧
      (∀ i (W : Set E2) (Fh : E2 → E3) (p : M), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fh W →
        (∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
          (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x) ∈ frontier U ∩ B i) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Λf ((chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x))) W)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hs1 : ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      (∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 p).target) ∧ Continuous (g.gradInner u u) := by
    intro u hu
    have hsm : ∀ p : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      intro p
      have hT : IsOpen (chartAt E3 p).target := (chartAt E3 p).open_target
      have hGe : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y a b)
          (chartAt E3 p).target := fun a b => g.smooth p a b
      have hdetGen : ∀ A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
          (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => A y a b) (chartAt E3 p).target) →
          ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (A y).det) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
        intro A hA
        simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
        have t1 := ((hA 0 0).mul (hA 1 1)).mul (hA 2 2)
        have t2 := ((hA 0 0).mul (hA 1 2)).mul (hA 2 1)
        have t3 := ((hA 0 1).mul (hA 1 0)).mul (hA 2 2)
        have t4 := ((hA 0 1).mul (hA 1 2)).mul (hA 2 0)
        have t5 := ((hA 0 2).mul (hA 1 0)).mul (hA 2 1)
        have t6 := ((hA 0 2).mul (hA 1 1)).mul (hA 2 0)
        exact ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
      have hdet := hdetGen _ hGe
      have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
          (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).adjugate i j) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
        intro i j
        simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
        apply hdetGen
        intro a b
        by_cases hab : a = j
        · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_apply, hab, if_true]
          exact contDiffOn_const
        · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_apply, hab, if_false]
          exact hGe a b
      have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
          (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
        intro i j
        refine ((hdet.inv fun y hy => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y hy).det_pos.ne').mul
          (hadj i j)).congr fun y _ => ?_
        simp only [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have hup := (chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu p).1
      have hfd := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hT).1 hup).2
      have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
          (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y)
          (chartAt E3 p).target := fun i => hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
            partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
            partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
        ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ((hinv i j).mul (hpd i)).mul (hpd j)
      exact hR.congr fun y hy => (chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu p).2.1 y hy
    refine ⟨hsm, continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun x₀ => ?_⟩
    have hH : ContinuousAt (fun y => g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 x₀ x₀) :=
      (hsm x₀).continuousOn.continuousAt
        ((chartAt E3 x₀).open_target.mem_nhds (mem_chart_target E3 x₀))
    have hk : ContinuousAt (chartAt E3 x₀) x₀ := (chartAt E3 x₀).continuousAt (mem_chart_source E3 x₀)
    have hcomp := hH.comp hk
    refine hcomp.congr ?_
    filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 x₀).open_source.mem_nhds (mem_chart_source E3 x₀)] with y hy
    simp only [Function.comp, (chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv hy]
  
  have hs3 : ∀ (u w : M → ℝ) (x : M) (e : ℝ), (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) →
      (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, u y = e * w y) → g.gradInner u u x = g.gradInner w w x := by
    intro u w x e he h
    have hx : x ∈ (chartAt E3 x).source := mem_chart_source E3 x
    have ht : Tendsto (chartAt E3 x).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 x x)) (𝓝 x) := by
      have h1 := (chartAt E3 x).continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 x)
      rw [ContinuousAt, (chartAt E3 x).left_inv hx] at h1
      exact h1
    have h' : (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 x x)]
        (fun z => e * w ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) := ht.eventually h
    have hpd : ∀ i, partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) (chartAt E3 x x) =
        e * partialDeriv i (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) (chartAt E3 x x) := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq h']
      rcases he with rfl | rfl
      · simp only [one_mul]
      · simp only [neg_one_mul]
        rw [show (fun z => -w ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) =
          -(fun z => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) from rfl, fderiv_neg]
        rfl
    have he2 : e * e = 1 := by rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, hpd]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    linear_combination
      ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x x))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) (chartAt E3 x x) *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) (chartAt E3 x x)) * he2
  
  obtain ⟨Λf, hΛdef⟩ : ∃ Λf : M → ℝ, ∀ y, Λf y =
      if h : ∃ i, y ∈ B i ∩ frontier U then
        φ y * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (f h.choose) (f h.choose) y) else 0 :=
    ⟨_, fun y => rfl⟩
  
  have hform : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ B i ∩ frontier U,
      Λf y = φ y * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (f i) (f i) y) := by
    intro i y hy
    have hex : ∃ i, y ∈ B i ∩ frontier U := ⟨i, hy⟩
    have hj := hex.choose_spec
    rw [hΛdef y, dif_pos hex]
    obtain ⟨e, he, hev⟩ := hBsgn hex.choose i y ⟨hj.1, hy.1⟩
    rw [hs3 (f hex.choose) (f i) y e he hev]
  
  have hloc : ∀ y₀ ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V₀ : Set M) (f₀ : M → ℝ), IsOpen V₀ ∧ y₀ ∈ V₀ ∧
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₀ ∧
      ∀ y ∈ V₀ ∩ frontier U, 0 < g.gradInner f₀ f₀ y ∧
        φ y = 1 / Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f₀ f₀ y) := by
    intro y₀ hy₀
    obtain ⟨-, V₀, f₀, hV₀o, hy₀V₀, hf₀s, -, -, hnorm⟩ := hdata y₀ hy₀
    refine ⟨V₀, f₀, hV₀o, hy₀V₀, hf₀s, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    have h1 := (hnorm y hy).1
    have hs : Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f₀ f₀ y) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, zero_mul] at h1
      exact zero_ne_one h1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases lt_or_ge 0 (g.gradInner f₀ f₀ y) with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd (Real.sqrt_eq_zero'.2 h) hs
    · rw [eq_div_iff hs, mul_comm]
      exact h1
  
  have hs2 : ∀ (u : M → ℝ) (x : M), mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0 →
      0 < g.gradInner u u x := by
    intro u x hx
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x := by
      by_contra h
      exact hx (mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt h)
    have hfd : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) := by
      rw [hmd.mfderiv]
      have hr : Set.range (𝓘(ℝ, E3) : E3 → E3) = Set.univ := by simp
      rw [hr, fderivWithin_univ]
      rfl
    set ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun i =>
      partialDeriv i (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) (chartAt E3 x x) with hξdef
    have hξ : ξ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hx
      rw [hfd]
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.coe_injective
      refine (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis.ext fun i => ?_
      have hi := congr_fun h0 i
      simp only [hξdef, partialDeriv, Pi.zero_apply] at hi
      simpa [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply] using hi
    have hA := coeff_chart_symm_posDef g x (chartAt E3 x x) (mem_chart_target E3 x)
    have hpos := hA.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ
    have heq : g.gradInner u u x = dotProduct (star ξ)
        (Matrix.mulVec (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x x))⁻¹ ξ) := by
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply,
        star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum, hξdef]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      ring
    rw [heq]
    exact hpos
  
  have hposB : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ B i, 0 < g.gradInner (f i) (f i) y :=
    fun i y hy => hs2 (f i) y (hdf i y hy)
  
  have hclause3 : ∀ i (W : Set E2) (Fh : E2 → E3) (p : M), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fh W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
        (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x) ∈ frontier U ∩ B i) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Λf ((chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x))) W := by
    intro i W Fh p hW hFh hland
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨-, hx₀F, -⟩ := hland x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨V₀, f₀, hV₀o, hy₀V₀, hf₀s, hV₀⟩ := hloc _ hx₀F
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x)) W :=
      (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.comp hFh.continuousOn (fun x hx => (hland x hx).1)
    have hW₀o : IsOpen (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x)) ⁻¹' V₀) :=
      hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hW hV₀o
    refine ⟨W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x)) ⁻¹' V₀, hW₀o, ⟨hx₀, hy₀V₀⟩, ?_⟩
    have hsub : W ∩ (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x)) ⁻¹' V₀) ⊆ W :=
      fun x hx => hx.1
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo Fh (W ∩ (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x)) ⁻¹' V₀))
        (chartAt E3 p).target := fun x hx => (hland x hx.1).1
    have hH0 := ((hs1 f₀ hf₀s).1 p).comp (hFh.mono hsub) hmaps
    have hHi := ((hs1 (f i) (hfs i)).1 p).comp (hFh.mono hsub) hmaps
    have hpt : ∀ x ∈ W ∩ (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x)) ⁻¹' V₀),
        (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x) ∈ V₀ ∩ frontier U ∧ (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x) ∈ B i :=
      fun x hx => ⟨⟨hx.2.2, (hland x hx.1).2.1⟩, (hland x hx.1).2.2⟩
    have hne0 : ∀ x ∈ W ∩ (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x)) ⁻¹' V₀),
        ((fun y => g.gradInner f₀ f₀ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ∘ Fh) x ≠ 0 :=
      fun x hx => (hV₀ _ (hpt x hx).1).1.ne'
    have hnei : ∀ x ∈ W ∩ (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x)) ⁻¹' V₀),
        ((fun y => g.gradInner (f i) (f i) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ∘ Fh) x ≠ 0 :=
      fun x hx => (hposB i _ (hpt x hx).2).ne'
    have hS0 := hH0.sqrt hne0
    have hSi := hHi.sqrt hnei
    have hq := (contDiffOn_const (c := (1 : ℝ))).div hS0
      (fun x hx => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hV₀ _ (hpt x hx).1).1).ne')
    refine (hq.mul hSi).congr ?_
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hpt x hx
    simp only [Function.comp, Pi.div_apply]
    rw [hform i _ ⟨h2, h1.2⟩, (hV₀ _ h1).2]
  
  have hcontK : ContinuousOn Λf K := by
    intro y₀ hy₀K
    have hy₀F := hKF hy₀K
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (hKB hy₀K)
    obtain ⟨V₀, f₀, hV₀o, hy₀V₀, hf₀s, hV₀⟩ := hloc y₀ hy₀F
    have hc0 := (hs1 f₀ hf₀s).2
    have hci := (hs1 (f i) (hfs i)).2
    have hpos0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f₀ f₀ y₀) :=
      Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hV₀ y₀ ⟨hy₀V₀, hy₀F⟩).1
    have hψ : ContinuousAt (fun y => 1 / Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f₀ f₀ y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (f i) (f i) y)) y₀ :=
      (continuousAt_const.div hc0.continuousAt.sqrt hpos0.ne').mul hci.continuousAt.sqrt
    have heq : ∀ y ∈ K ∩ (B i ∩ V₀), Λf y = 1 / Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f₀ f₀ y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner (f i) (f i) y) := by
      intro y hy
      have hyF := hKF hy.1
      rw [hform i y ⟨hy.2.1, hyF⟩, (hV₀ y ⟨hy.2.2, hyF⟩).2]
    refine hψ.continuousWithinAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_ (heq y₀ ⟨hy₀K, hi, hy₀V₀⟩)
    filter_upwards [inter_mem_nhdsWithin K (((hBo i).inter hV₀o).mem_nhds ⟨hi, hy₀V₀⟩)]
      with y hy
    exact heq y hy
  
  have hposK : ∀ y ∈ K, 0 < Λf y := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (hKB hy)
    rw [hform i y ⟨hi, hKF hy⟩]
    exact mul_pos (hdata y (hKF hy)).1 (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hposB i y hi))
  
  rcases K.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hKe | hKne
  · refine ⟨Λf, 0, 1, one_pos, ?_, hform, hclause3⟩
    intro y hy
    rw [hKe] at hy
    simp at hy
  · obtain ⟨a, haK, ha⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn hKne hcontK
    obtain ⟨b, hbK, hb⟩ := hK.exists_isMaxOn hKne hcontK
    refine ⟨Λf, Λf b, Λf a, hposK a haK, fun y hy => ⟨isMinOn_iff.1 ha y hy,
      isMaxOn_iff.1 hb y hy⟩, hform, hclause3⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: chart_pullback_gradInner
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (p : M) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
      (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) (chartAt E3 p).target

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hNg1 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), Ng x (-ℓ) = -Ng x ℓ)
    (hNg3 : ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
      (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
        (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x)
    (B₁ B₂ : Set M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ) (hB₁ : IsOpen B₁) (hB₂ : IsOpen B₂)
    (hf₁ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₁) (hf₂ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₂)
    (hd₁ : ∀ x ∈ B₁, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x ≠ 0)
    (hd₂ : ∀ x ∈ B₂, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ x ≠ 0)
    (hsgn : ∀ x ∈ B₁ ∩ B₂, ∃ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f₁ y = e * f₂ y)
    (T : ℝ) (γ₁ γ₂ : ℝ → M) (e₁ e₂ : ℝ) (he₁ : e₁ = 1 ∨ e₁ = -1) (he₂ : e₂ = 1 ∨ e₂ = -1)
    (hγ₁ : IsMIntegralCurveOn γ₁ (fun x => e₁ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x))
      (Set.Ioo (-T) T))
    (hγ₂ : IsMIntegralCurveOn γ₂ (fun x => e₂ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ x))
      (Set.Ioo (-T) T))
    (hγ₁B : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, γ₁ t ∈ B₁) (hγ₂B : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, γ₂ t ∈ B₂)
    (hγ₁f : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, f₁ (γ₁ t) = e₁ * t)
    (hγ₂f : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, |f₂ (γ₂ t)| = |t|)
    (t₁ : ℝ) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T) (ht₁0 : t₁ ≠ 0) (hmeet : γ₁ t₁ = γ₂ t₁) :
    Set.EqOn γ₁ γ₂ (Set.Ioo (-T) T)

signature.name: collar_curves_agree
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)
    (hNg1 : ∀ (x : M) (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), Ng x (-ℓ) = -Ng x ℓ)
    (hNg3 : ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
      (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
        (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x)
    (B₁ B₂ : Set M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ) (hB₁ : IsOpen B₁) (hB₂ : IsOpen B₂)
    (hf₁ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₁) (hf₂ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₂)
    (hd₁ : ∀ x ∈ B₁, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x ≠ 0)
    (hd₂ : ∀ x ∈ B₂, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ x ≠ 0)
    (hsgn : ∀ x ∈ B₁ ∩ B₂, ∃ e : ℝ, (e = 1 ∨ e = -1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, f₁ y = e * f₂ y)
    (T : ℝ) (γ₁ γ₂ : ℝ → M) (e₁ e₂ : ℝ) (he₁ : e₁ = 1 ∨ e₁ = -1) (he₂ : e₂ = 1 ∨ e₂ = -1)
    (hγ₁ : IsMIntegralCurveOn γ₁ (fun x => e₁ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x))
      (Set.Ioo (-T) T))
    (hγ₂ : IsMIntegralCurveOn γ₂ (fun x => e₂ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ x))
      (Set.Ioo (-T) T))
    (hγ₁B : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, γ₁ t ∈ B₁) (hγ₂B : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, γ₂ t ∈ B₂)
    (hγ₁f : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, f₁ (γ₁ t) = e₁ * t)
    (hγ₂f : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, |f₂ (γ₂ t)| = |t|)
    (t₁ : ℝ) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T) (ht₁0 : t₁ ≠ 0) (hmeet : γ₁ t₁ = γ₂ t₁) :
    Set.EqOn γ₁ γ₂ (Set.Ioo (-T) T)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hchg : ∀ (γ : ℝ → M) (v w : (x : M) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x) (s : Set ℝ),
      IsMIntegralCurveOn γ v s → (∀ t ∈ s, v (γ t) = w (γ t)) → IsMIntegralCurveOn γ w s := by
    intro γ v w s h hvw t ht
    rw [← hvw t ht]
    exact h t ht
  
  have hV₁s : ∀ x ∈ B₁, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
      (fun y => (⟨y, e₁ • Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x := by
    intro x hx
    rcases he₁ with rfl | rfl
    · have h := hNg3 B₁ f₁ hB₁ hf₁.contMDiffOn hd₁ x hx
      simp only [one_smul]
      exact h.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    · have hd' : ∀ y ∈ B₁, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (-f₁) y ≠ 0 := by
        intro y hy
        rw [mfderiv_neg]
        exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (hd₁ y hy)
      have hneg : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (-f₁) := hf₁.neg
      have h := hNg3 B₁ (-f₁) hB₁ hneg.contMDiffOn hd' x hx
      have heq : (fun y => (⟨y, (-1 : ℝ) • Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ y)⟩ :
          TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) =
          (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (-f₁) y)⟩ :
            TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) := by
        funext y
        rw [mfderiv_neg, hNg1, neg_one_smul]
      rw [heq]
      exact h.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  
  have hloc : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, γ₁ t = γ₂ t → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ) ⊆ Set.Ioo (-T) T ∧
      ((∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ), γ₁ s = γ₂ s) ∨
       (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ), γ₁ s = γ₂ (2 * t - s) ∧ |f₁ (γ₁ s)| = |f₂ (γ₁ s)|)) := by
    intro t ht hmt
    have hx₁ : γ₁ t ∈ B₁ := hγ₁B t ht
    have hx₂ : γ₁ t ∈ B₂ := by rw [hmt]; exact hγ₂B t ht
    obtain ⟨e, he, hev⟩ := hsgn (γ₁ t) ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩
    obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀f, hW₀o, hxW₀⟩ := eventually_nhds_iff.1 hev
    have hWo : IsOpen (W₀ ∩ B₁) := hW₀o.inter hB₁
    have hxW : γ₁ t ∈ W₀ ∩ B₁ := ⟨hxW₀, hx₁⟩
    have hWf : ∀ y ∈ W₀ ∩ B₁, |f₁ y| = |f₂ y| := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hW₀f y hy.1, abs_mul]
      rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> simp
    have hfield : ∀ y ∈ W₀ ∩ B₁, e₁ • Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ y) =
        (e₁ * e * e₂) • (e₂ • Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ y)) := by
      intro y hy
      have hev' : f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => e * f₂ z) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW₀o.mem_nhds hy.1) (fun z hz => hW₀f z hz)
      have hd : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ y =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (fun z => e * f₂ z) y := hev'.mfderiv_eq
      rw [smul_smul]
      have he₂2 : e₁ * e * e₂ * e₂ = e₁ * e := by
        rcases he₂ with rfl | rfl <;> ring
      rw [he₂2]
      rcases he with rfl | rfl
      · have h1 : (fun z => (1 : ℝ) * f₂ z) = f₂ := by funext z; simp
        rw [h1] at hd
        rw [hd, mul_one]
      · have h1 : (fun z => (-1 : ℝ) * f₂ z) = -f₂ := by funext z; simp
        rw [h1, mfderiv_neg] at hd
        rw [hd, hNg1, smul_neg, ← neg_smul, mul_neg_one]
    have hc : e₁ * e * e₂ = 1 ∨ e₁ * e * e₂ = -1 := by
      rcases he₁ with rfl | rfl <;> rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> rcases he₂ with rfl | rfl <;>
        norm_num
    have hc₁ : ContinuousAt γ₁ t := hγ₁.continuousOn.continuousAt (Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2)
    have hc₂ : ContinuousAt γ₂ t := hγ₂.continuousOn.continuousAt (Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2)
    have hS : Set.Ioo (-T) T ∩ γ₁ ⁻¹' (W₀ ∩ B₁) ∩ γ₂ ⁻¹' (W₀ ∩ B₁) ∈ 𝓝 t := by
      refine Filter.inter_mem (Filter.inter_mem (Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2)
        (hc₁ (hWo.mem_nhds hxW))) (hc₂ ?_)
      rw [← hmt]
      exact hWo.mem_nhds hxW
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.1 hS
    rw [Real.ball_eq_Ioo] at hball
    have hIJ : Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ) ⊆ Set.Ioo (-T) T := fun s hs => (hball hs).1.1
    have hI1 : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ), γ₁ s ∈ W₀ ∩ B₁ := fun s hs => (hball hs).1.2
    have hI2 : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ), γ₂ s ∈ W₀ ∩ B₁ := fun s hs => (hball hs).2
    have htI : t ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hγ₁I := hγ₁.mono hIJ
    have hIn : Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ) ∈ 𝓝 t := Ioo_mem_nhds htI.1 htI.2
    have hγ₁A : IsMIntegralCurveAt γ₁
        (fun x => e₁ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x)) t := hγ₁I.isMIntegralCurveAt hIn
    have hsm : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent 1
        (fun y => (⟨y, e₁ • Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ y)⟩ :
          TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) (γ₁ t) := hV₁s _ hx₁
    have hfin : ∀ g : ℝ → M, γ₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 t] g → ∃ δ' : ℝ, 0 < δ' ∧
        Set.Ioo (t - δ') (t + δ') ⊆ Set.Ioo (-T) T ∧
        ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ') (t + δ'), γ₁ s = g s ∧ |f₁ (γ₁ s)| = |f₂ (γ₁ s)| := by
      intro g hg
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεp⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.1 hg
      have hm1 := min_le_left δ ε
      have hm2 := min_le_right δ ε
      refine ⟨min δ ε, lt_min hδ hε, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro s hs
        apply hIJ
        exact ⟨by linarith [hs.1], by linarith [hs.2]⟩
      · intro s hs
        have h1 : s ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ) := ⟨by linarith [hs.1], by linarith [hs.2]⟩
        have h2 : dist s t < ε := by
          rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]
          exact ⟨by linarith [hs.1], by linarith [hs.2]⟩
        exact ⟨hεp h2, hWf _ (hI1 s h1)⟩
    rcases hc with hc | hc
    · have hγ₂I : IsMIntegralCurveOn γ₂ (fun x => e₁ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x))
          (Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ)) := by
        refine hchg γ₂ (fun x => e₂ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ x))
          (fun x => e₁ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x)) _ (hγ₂.mono hIJ) ?_
        intro s hs
        show e₂ • Ng (γ₂ s) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ (γ₂ s)) =
          e₁ • Ng (γ₂ s) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ (γ₂ s))
        rw [hfield _ (hI2 s hs), hc, one_smul]
      have hg := isMIntegralCurveAt_eventuallyEq_of_contMDiffAt_boundaryless
        (v := fun x => e₁ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x))
        hsm hγ₁A (hγ₂I.isMIntegralCurveAt hIn) hmt
      obtain ⟨δ', hδ', hIJ', hag⟩ := hfin γ₂ hg
      exact ⟨δ', hδ', hIJ', Or.inl (fun s hs => (hag s hs).1)⟩
    · have hrefl : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ), 2 * t - s ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ) := by
        intro s hs
        exact ⟨by linarith [hs.2], by linarith [hs.1]⟩
      have hcomp := (hγ₂.comp_mul (-1)).comp_add (-(2 * t))
      have hfun : ((γ₂ ∘ fun x => x * (-1 : ℝ)) ∘ fun x => x + -(2 * t)) =
          fun s => γ₂ (2 * t - s) := by
        funext s
        simp only [Function.comp]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [hfun] at hcomp
      have hγ₃ : IsMIntegralCurveOn (fun s => γ₂ (2 * t - s))
          (fun x => e₁ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x)) (Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ)) := by
        refine hchg (fun s => γ₂ (2 * t - s))
          ((-1 : ℝ) • fun x => e₂ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ x))
          (fun x => e₁ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x)) _ (hcomp.mono ?_) ?_
        · intro s hs
          show (s + -(2 * t)) * -1 ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T
          have h2 : (s + -(2 * t)) * -1 = 2 * t - s := by ring
          rw [h2]
          exact hIJ (hrefl s hs)
        · intro s hs
          show (-1 : ℝ) • (e₂ • Ng (γ₂ (2 * t - s)) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ (γ₂ (2 * t - s)))) =
            e₁ • Ng (γ₂ (2 * t - s)) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ (γ₂ (2 * t - s)))
          rw [hfield _ (hI2 _ (hrefl s hs)), hc]
      have hmt' : γ₁ t = (fun s => γ₂ (2 * t - s)) t := by
        show γ₁ t = γ₂ (2 * t - t)
        rw [show 2 * t - t = t by ring]
        exact hmt
      have hg := isMIntegralCurveAt_eventuallyEq_of_contMDiffAt_boundaryless
        (v := fun x => e₁ • Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x))
        hsm hγ₁A (hγ₃.isMIntegralCurveAt hIn) hmt'
      obtain ⟨δ', hδ', hIJ', hag⟩ := hfin _ hg
      exact ⟨δ', hδ', hIJ', Or.inr (fun s hs => hag s hs)⟩
  
  have hIE : ∀ t δ : ℝ, Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ) ⊆ Set.Ioo (-T) T →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ), γ₁ s = γ₂ s) → 0 < δ →
      t ∈ interior {t | t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T ∧ γ₁ t = γ₂ t} := by
    intro t δ hIJ hag hδ
    have hsub : Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ) ⊆ {t | t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T ∧ γ₁ t = γ₂ t} :=
      fun s hs => ⟨hIJ hs, hag s hs⟩
    have htI : t ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    exact interior_maximal hsub isOpen_Ioo htI
  have hAE : interior {t | t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T ∧ γ₁ t = γ₂ t} ⊆
      {t | t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T ∧ γ₁ t = γ₂ t} := interior_subset
  have hinj : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, ∀ s' ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T, γ₁ s = γ₁ s' → s = s' := by
    intro s hs s' hs' h
    have h1 := hγ₁f s hs
    have h2 := hγ₁f s' hs'
    rw [h] at h1
    rcases he₁ with rfl | rfl <;> linarith
  have hstart : t₁ ∈ interior {t | t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T ∧ γ₁ t = γ₂ t} := by
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hIJ, hag | hrefl⟩ := hloc t₁ ht₁ hmeet
    · exact hIE t₁ δ hIJ hag hδ
    · exfalso
      have hs : t₁ + δ / 2 ∈ Set.Ioo (t₁ - δ) (t₁ + δ) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hrefl _ hs
      have hsJ := hIJ hs
      have hrJ : 2 * t₁ - (t₁ + δ / 2) ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T := hIJ ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      rw [hγ₁f _ hsJ, h1, hγ₂f _ hrJ] at h2
      have h3 : |t₁ + δ / 2| = |t₁ - δ / 2| := by
        have h4 : 2 * t₁ - (t₁ + δ / 2) = t₁ - δ / 2 := by ring
        rw [h4] at h2
        rw [← h2, abs_mul]
        rcases he₁ with rfl | rfl <;> simp
      rcases abs_eq_abs.1 h3 with h | h
      · linarith
      · exact ht₁0 (by linarith)
  have hclosed : closure (interior {t | t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T ∧ γ₁ t = γ₂ t}) ∩ Set.Ioo (-T) T ⊆
      interior {t | t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T ∧ γ₁ t = γ₂ t} := by
    rintro t ⟨htc, htJ⟩
    have hmt : γ₁ t = γ₂ t := by
      have hsub : insert t (interior {t | t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T ∧ γ₁ t = γ₂ t}) ⊆
          Set.Ioo (-T) T := by
        rintro s (rfl | hs)
        · exact htJ
        · exact (hAE hs).1
      have h := Set.EqOn.of_subset_closure (fun s hs => (hAE hs).2)
        (hγ₁.continuousOn.mono hsub) (hγ₂.continuousOn.mono hsub) (Set.subset_insert _ _)
        (Set.insert_subset htc subset_closure)
      exact h (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hIJ, hag | hrefl⟩ := hloc t htJ hmt
    · exact hIE t δ hIJ hag hδ
    · obtain ⟨s', hs'A, hd⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.1 htc δ hδ
      by_cases hst : s' = t
      · rw [← hst]
        exact hs'A
      · exfalso
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at hd
        obtain ⟨hd1, hd2⟩ := abs_lt.1 hd
        have hs'I : s' ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have hrI : 2 * t - s' ∈ Set.Ioo (t - δ) (t + δ) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
        have h1 := (hrefl _ hrI).1
        rw [show 2 * t - (2 * t - s') = s' by ring, ← (hAE hs'A).2] at h1
        have h2 := hinj _ (hIJ hrI) _ (hIJ hs'I) h1
        exact hst (by linarith)
  have hJA : Set.Ioo (-T) T ⊆ interior {t | t ∈ Set.Ioo (-T) T ∧ γ₁ t = γ₂ t} :=
    isPreconnected_Ioo.subset_of_closure_inter_subset isOpen_interior ⟨t₁, ht₁, hstart⟩ hclosed
  intro t ht
  exact (hAE (hJA ht)).2

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (φ : M → ℝ) (S : Set M) (Ψ : ℝ → M → M) (s₁ : ℝ)
    (B : Set M) (f : M → ℝ) (hB : IsOpen B) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hdf : ∀ x ∈ B, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0)
    (hBF : B ∩ frontier U = B ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}) (hFmin : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (q : M) (B' : Set M) (τ : ℝ) (Fl : ℝ → M → M) (hB'o : IsOpen B') (hB'B : B' ⊆ B)
    (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hFl : ∀ y ∈ B', Fl 0 y = y ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ,
        Fl t y ∈ B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧ f (Fl t y) = f y + t)
    (hFls : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2)))
        (Set.Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ (chartAt E3 q '' B')))
    (hker : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ chartAt E3 q '' B', ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
        fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2))) (t, u)
          (a, w) = 0 →
        w = -a • fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2)))
          (0, u) (1, 0))
    (hFlinj : ∀ y ∈ B', ∀ y' ∈ B', ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, Fl t y = Fl t y' → y = y')
    (y₀ : M) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ B' ∩ frontier U) (e c : ℝ) (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hcτ : c < τ)
    (lam : M → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ) (hlam : ∀ y ∈ B' ∩ frontier U, 0 < lam y ∧ lam y ≤ Λ)
    (hlams : ∀ (W : Set E2) (Fh : E2 → E3) (p : M), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fh W →
        (∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x) ∈ frontier U ∩ B) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => lam ((chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x))) W)
    (hlamφ : ∀ y ∈ B' ∩ frontier U, lam y = φ y * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f y))
    (hs₁ : 0 < s₁) (hs₁Λ : s₁ * Λ < τ)
    (O₀ : Set M) (hO₀ : IsOpen O₀) (hℓO₀ : Fl (c * e) y₀ ∈ O₀)
    (hSO : ∀ w ∈ O₀, w ∈ S ↔ ∃ y ∈ B' ∩ frontier U, w = Fl (c * e) y)
    (hΨ : ∀ y ∈ B' ∩ frontier U, Fl (c * e) y ∈ O₀ → ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁,
        Ψ s (Fl (c * e) y) = Fl (s * lam y * e) y) :
    collarSlabChartAt g U φ S Ψ s₁ (Fl (c * e) y₀)

signature.name: slab_chart_from_flow_box
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) (φ : M → ℝ) (S : Set M) (Ψ : ℝ → M → M) (s₁ : ℝ)
    (B : Set M) (f : M → ℝ) (hB : IsOpen B) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hdf : ∀ x ∈ B, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0)
    (hBF : B ∩ frontier U = B ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}) (hFmin : IsMinimalSurfaceSet g (frontier U))
    (q : M) (B' : Set M) (τ : ℝ) (Fl : ℝ → M → M) (hB'o : IsOpen B') (hB'B : B' ⊆ B)
    (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hFl : ∀ y ∈ B', Fl 0 y = y ∧ ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ,
        Fl t y ∈ B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧ f (Fl t y) = f y + t)
    (hFls : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2)))
        (Set.Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ (chartAt E3 q '' B')))
    (hker : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ chartAt E3 q '' B', ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
        fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2))) (t, u)
          (a, w) = 0 →
        w = -a • fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2)))
          (0, u) (1, 0))
    (hFlinj : ∀ y ∈ B', ∀ y' ∈ B', ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, Fl t y = Fl t y' → y = y')
    (y₀ : M) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ B' ∩ frontier U) (e c : ℝ) (he : e = 1 ∨ e = -1) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hcτ : c < τ)
    (lam : M → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ) (hlam : ∀ y ∈ B' ∩ frontier U, 0 < lam y ∧ lam y ≤ Λ)
    (hlams : ∀ (W : Set E2) (Fh : E2 → E3) (p : M), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fh W →
        (∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ (chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x) ∈ frontier U ∩ B) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => lam ((chartAt E3 p).symm (Fh x))) W)
    (hlamφ : ∀ y ∈ B' ∩ frontier U, lam y = φ y * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner f f y))
    (hs₁ : 0 < s₁) (hs₁Λ : s₁ * Λ < τ)
    (O₀ : Set M) (hO₀ : IsOpen O₀) (hℓO₀ : Fl (c * e) y₀ ∈ O₀)
    (hSO : ∀ w ∈ O₀, w ∈ S ↔ ∃ y ∈ B' ∩ frontier U, w = Fl (c * e) y)
    (hΨ : ∀ y ∈ B' ∩ frontier U, Fl (c * e) y ∈ O₀ → ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁,
        Ψ s (Fl (c * e) y) = Fl (s * lam y * e) y) :
    collarSlabChartAt g U φ S Ψ s₁ (Fl (c * e) y₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set κ := chartAt E3 q with hκ
  set Fhat : ℝ × E3 → E3 := fun p => κ (Fl p.1 (κ.symm p.2)) with hFhat
  set Vh : Set E3 := κ '' B' with hVh
  set fh : E3 → ℝ := fun u => f (κ.symm u) with hfh
  have hI0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ := ⟨by linarith, hτ⟩
  
  have CF1 : B' ⊆ κ.source := fun y hy => by
    have h1 := ((hFl y hy).2 0 hI0).1.2
    rwa [(hFl y hy).1] at h1
  
  have hVo : IsOpen Vh := κ.isOpen_image_of_subset_source hB'o CF1
  have hVt : Vh ⊆ κ.target := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact κ.map_source (CF1 hy)
  
  have CF3 : ∀ u ∈ Vh, κ.symm u ∈ B' := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [κ.left_inv (CF1 hy)]
    exact hy
  
  have CF4 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ Vh,
      Fhat (t, u) ∈ κ.target ∧ κ.symm (Fhat (t, u)) = Fl t (κ.symm u) := by
    intro t ht u hu
    have h1 := ((hFl _ (CF3 u hu)).2 t ht).1.2
    exact ⟨κ.map_source h1, κ.left_inv h1⟩
  have CF4' : ∀ u ∈ Vh, Fhat (0, u) = u := by
    intro u hu
    show κ (Fl 0 (κ.symm u)) = u
    rw [(hFl _ (CF3 u hu)).1, κ.right_inv (hVt hu)]
  
  have CF5 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ fh κ.target :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  
  have CF6 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ Vh, fh (Fhat (t, u)) = fh u + t := by
    intro t ht u hu
    show f (κ.symm (Fhat (t, u))) = f (κ.symm u) + t
    rw [(CF4 t ht u hu).2]
    exact ((hFl _ (CF3 u hu)).2 t ht).2
  
  have CF7 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ Vh, ∀ u' ∈ Vh, Fhat (t, u) = Fhat (t, u') → u = u' := by
    intro t ht u hu u' hu' h
    have h1 := ((hFl _ (CF3 u hu)).2 t ht).1.2
    have h2 := ((hFl _ (CF3 u' hu')).2 t ht).1.2
    have h3 : Fl t (κ.symm u) = Fl t (κ.symm u') := κ.injOn h1 h2 h
    have h4 := hFlinj _ (CF3 u hu) _ (CF3 u' hu') t ht h3
    rw [← κ.right_inv (hVt hu), h4, κ.right_inv (hVt hu')]
  
  have CF8 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ Vh, ∀ w : E3,
      fderiv ℝ Fhat (t, u) (0, w) = 0 → w = 0 := by
    intro t ht u hu w h
    have h1 := hker t ht u hu 0 w h
    simpa using h1
  
  have CF9 : ∀ x ∈ B, (x ∈ frontier U ↔ f x = 0) := by
    intro x hx
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h1 : x ∈ B ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} := by rw [← hBF]; exact ⟨hx, h⟩
      exact h1.2
    · intro h
      have h1 : x ∈ B ∩ frontier U := by rw [hBF]; exact ⟨hx, h⟩
      exact h1.2
  
  have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ Vh, ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
      fderiv ℝ fh (Fhat (t, u)) (fderiv ℝ Fhat (t, u) (a, w)) = a + fderiv ℝ fh u w := by
    intro t ht u hu a w
    have hD : IsOpen (Set.Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ Vh) := isOpen_Ioo.prod hVo
    have hmem : (t, u) ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ Vh := ⟨ht, hu⟩
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Fhat (t, u) :=
      (hFls.contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hfd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ fh (Fhat (t, u)) :=
      (CF5.contDiffAt (κ.open_target.mem_nhds (CF4 t ht u hu).1)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hfd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ fh u :=
      (CF5.contDiffAt (κ.open_target.mem_nhds (hVt hu))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hev : (fun p : ℝ × E3 => fh (Fhat p)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (t, u)] (fun p => fh p.2 + p.1) := by
      filter_upwards [hD.mem_nhds hmem] with p hp
      exact CF6 p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => fh (Fhat p)) (t, u) =
        (fderiv ℝ fh (Fhat (t, u))).comp (fderiv ℝ Fhat (t, u)) :=
      fderiv_comp (t, u) hfd1 hFd
    have hs : HasFDerivAt (Prod.snd : ℝ × E3 → E3) (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E3) (t, u) :=
      hasFDerivAt_snd
    have h2a : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × E3 => fh p.2)
        ((fderiv ℝ fh u).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E3)) (t, u) := by
      have hg : HasFDerivAt fh (fderiv ℝ fh u) u := hfd2.hasFDerivAt
      have h := hg.comp (t, u) hs
      exact h
    have h2b : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × E3 => p.1) (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E3) (t, u) :=
      hasFDerivAt_fst
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × E3 => fh p.2 + p.1)
        ((fderiv ℝ fh u).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E3) +
          ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E3) (t, u) :=
      h2a.add h2b
    have h3 := congrArg (fun L : ℝ × E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (a, w))
      (h1.symm.trans (hev.fderiv_eq.trans h2.fderiv))
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst'] at h3
    rw [h3]
    ring
  
  have hy₀B : y₀ ∈ B := hB'B hy₀.1
  have hu₀V : κ y₀ ∈ Vh := ⟨y₀, hy₀.1, rfl⟩
  have hfu₀ : fh (κ y₀) = 0 := by
    show f (κ.symm (κ y₀)) = 0
    rw [κ.left_inv (CF1 hy₀.1)]
    exact (CF9 y₀ hy₀B).1 hy₀.2
  have hdfu₀ : fderiv ℝ fh (κ y₀) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h1 := hderiv 0 hI0 (κ y₀) hu₀V 1 0
    rw [CF4' (κ y₀) hu₀V, h0] at h1
    simp at h1
  
  have hceI : c * e ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ := by
    rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> constructor <;> linarith
  have hcont1 : ContinuousOn (fun u => Fhat (c * e, u)) Vh :=
    hFls.continuousOn.comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun u : E3 => (c * e, u)).continuousOn
      (fun u hu => ⟨hceI, hu⟩)
  have hcont2 : ContinuousOn (fun u => κ.symm (Fhat (c * e, u))) Vh :=
    κ.continuousOn_symm.comp hcont1 (fun u hu => (CF4 _ hceI u hu).1)
  have hAo : IsOpen (Vh ∩ (fun u => κ.symm (Fhat (c * e, u))) ⁻¹' O₀) :=
    hcont2.isOpen_inter_preimage hVo hO₀
  have hu₀A : κ y₀ ∈ Vh ∩ (fun u => κ.symm (Fhat (c * e, u))) ⁻¹' O₀ := by
    refine ⟨hu₀V, ?_⟩
    show κ.symm (Fhat (c * e, κ y₀)) ∈ O₀
    rw [(CF4 _ hceI _ hu₀V).2, κ.left_inv (CF1 hy₀.1)]
    exact hℓO₀
  obtain ⟨W, Fh, x₀, hWo, hx₀W, hFhs, hFhx₀, hFhi, hFhW⟩ :=
    regular_zero_set_local_param _ hAo fh
      (CF5.mono (Set.inter_subset_left.trans hVt)) (κ y₀) hu₀A hfu₀ hdfu₀
  have hFhV : ∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ Vh := fun x hx => (hFhW x hx).1.1
  have hFhO : ∀ x ∈ W, κ.symm (Fhat (c * e, Fh x)) ∈ O₀ := fun x hx => (hFhW x hx).1.2
  have hyt : ∀ x ∈ W, κ.symm (Fh x) ∈ B' ∩ frontier U := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := CF3 _ (hFhV x hx)
    exact ⟨h1, (CF9 _ (hB'B h1)).2 (hFhW x hx).2.1⟩
  have hyx₀ : κ.symm (Fh x₀) = y₀ := by rw [hFhx₀, κ.left_inv (CF1 hy₀.1)]
  
  have hlamW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => lam (κ.symm (Fh x))) W :=
    hlams W Fh q hWo hFhs (fun x hx => ⟨hVt (hFhV x hx), (hyt x hx).2, hB'B (hyt x hx).1⟩)
  have hμs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => lam (κ.symm (Fh x)) * e) W := hlamW.mul contDiffOn_const
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hea : |e| = 1 := by rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  have hlampos : ∀ x ∈ W, 0 < lam (κ.symm (Fh x)) := fun x hx => (hlam _ (hyt x hx)).1
  have hμ0 : ∀ x ∈ W, lam (κ.symm (Fh x)) * e ≠ 0 :=
    fun x hx => mul_ne_zero (hlampos x hx).ne' he0
  
  have HP1 : ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : E2), (hpLift s x) 0 = s := by
    intro s x
    simp [hpLift, cylPt, PositiveMass.e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have HP2 : ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : E2), hpProj (hpLift s x) = x := by
    intro s x
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj, hpLift, cylPt, PositiveMass.e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  obtain ⟨hΩo, hφs, hφi, hφd, hφ0⟩ :=
    flow_graph_injective_immersion τ hτ Vh hVo Fhat hFls CF8 CF7 fh κ.target κ.open_target CF5
      hVt CF6 hderiv W hWo Fh hFhs hFhV (fun x hx => (hFhW x hx).2.1)
      (fun x hx => (hFhW x hx).2.2) hFhi (fun x => lam (κ.symm (Fh x)) * e) hμs hμ0
  set Ω := {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * (lam (κ.symm (Fh (hpProj y))) * e)| < τ} with hΩ
  have hΩI : ∀ y ∈ Ω, y 0 * (lam (κ.symm (Fh (hpProj y))) * e) ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ :=
    fun y hy => abs_lt.mp hy.2
  have hφt : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Fhat (y 0 * (lam (κ.symm (Fh (hpProj y))) * e), Fh (hpProj y)) ∈
      (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    fun y hy => (CF4 _ (hΩI y hy) _ (hFhV _ hy.1)).1
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦs, hΦe⟩ := partialDiffeomorph_of_injOn q Ω hΩo _ hφs hφi hφt hφd
  have hΦsrc : ∀ y ∈ Ω, y ∈ Φ.source := fun y hy => by rw [hΦs]; exact hy
  have hΦf : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Φ y = Fl (y 0 * (lam (κ.symm (Fh (hpProj y))) * e))
      (κ.symm (Fh (hpProj y))) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hΦe y hy]
    exact (CF4 _ (hΩI y hy) _ (hFhV _ hy.1)).2
  have hΦfv : ∀ y ∈ Ω, f (Φ y) = y 0 * (lam (κ.symm (Fh (hpProj y))) * e) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hΦf y hy, ((hFl _ (hyt _ hy.1).1).2 _ (hΩI y hy)).2,
      (CF9 _ (hB'B (hyt _ hy.1).1)).1 (hyt _ hy.1).2, zero_add]
  have hlx : ∀ x ∈ W, hpLift (c / lam (κ.symm (Fh x))) x ∈ Ω ∧
      Φ (hpLift (c / lam (κ.symm (Fh x))) x) = Fl (c * e) (κ.symm (Fh x)) := by
    intro x hx
    have hl := (hlampos x hx).ne'
    have hmul : c / lam (κ.symm (Fh x)) * (lam (κ.symm (Fh x)) * e) = c * e := by
      rw [show c / lam (κ.symm (Fh x)) * (lam (κ.symm (Fh x)) * e) =
        c * e * (lam (κ.symm (Fh x)) / lam (κ.symm (Fh x))) by ring, div_self hl, mul_one]
    have hmem : hpLift (c / lam (κ.symm (Fh x))) x ∈ Ω := by
      refine ⟨by rw [HP2]; exact hx, ?_⟩
      rw [HP1, HP2, hmul]
      exact abs_lt.mpr hceI
    refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
    rw [hΦf _ hmem, HP1, HP2, hmul]
  have hP1 : ∀ x ∈ W, Fl (c * e) (κ.symm (Fh x)) ∈ Φ.target ∧
      Fl (c * e) (κ.symm (Fh x)) ∈ O₀ ∧ Fl (c * e) (κ.symm (Fh x)) ∈ S := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hm, hΦx⟩ := hlx x hx
    have hO : Fl (c * e) (κ.symm (Fh x)) ∈ O₀ := by
      have h1 := hFhO x hx
      rw [(CF4 _ hceI _ (hFhV x hx)).2] at h1
      exact h1
    refine ⟨?_, hO, (hSO _ hO).2 ⟨_, hyt x hx, rfl⟩⟩
    rw [← hΦx]
    exact Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source (hΦsrc _ hm)
  have hpc : Continuous hpProj := by
    unfold hpProj
    apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
    refine continuous_pi (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
    · simpa using (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
  
  refine ⟨W, O₀ ∩ Φ.target, fun x => Fl (c * e) (κ.symm (Fh x)),
    fun w => hpProj (Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm w), q, Φ, hWo, hO₀.inter Φ.open_target,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    have h1 := hP1 x₀ hx₀W
    rw [hyx₀] at h1
    exact ⟨h1.2.1, h1.1⟩
  · 
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => κ.symm (Fhat (c * e, Fh x))) W :=
      hcont2.comp hFhs.continuousOn (fun x hx => hFhV x hx)
    refine h1.congr (fun x hx => ?_)
    exact (CF4 _ hceI _ (hFhV x hx)).2.symm
  · 
    have hcs : ContinuousOn Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm Φ.target :=
      Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun.continuousOn
    exact (hpc.comp_continuousOn hcs).mono Set.inter_subset_right
  · 
    ext w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hP1 x hx
      exact ⟨⟨h2, h1⟩, h3⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hwO, hwt⟩, hwS⟩
      have hys : Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm w ∈ Φ.source := Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_target hwt
      have hyΩ : Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm w ∈ Ω := by rw [← hΦs]; exact hys
      have hΦy : Φ (Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm w) = w := Φ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hwt
      obtain ⟨y', hy', hwy'⟩ := (hSO w hwO).1 hwS
      have hfw1 : f w = (Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm w) 0 *
          (lam (κ.symm (Fh (hpProj (Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm w)))) * e) := by
        rw [← hΦfv _ hyΩ, hΦy]
      have hfw2 : f w = c * e := by
        rw [hwy', ((hFl _ hy'.1).2 _ hceI).2, (CF9 _ (hB'B hy'.1)).1 hy'.2, zero_add]

subgoal_signatures.name: flow_graph_injective_immersion
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (Fhat : ℝ × E3 → E3) (hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fhat (Set.Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ V))
    (hker0 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ w : E3, fderiv ℝ Fhat (t, u) (0, w) = 0 → w = 0)
    (hinj : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ u' ∈ V, Fhat (t, u) = Fhat (t, u') → u = u')
    (fh : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hfh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ fh T) (hVT : V ⊆ T)
    (haff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, fh (Fhat (t, u)) = fh u + t)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
      fderiv ℝ fh (Fhat (t, u)) (fderiv ℝ Fhat (t, u) (a, w)) = a + fderiv ℝ fh u w)
    (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (Fh : E2 → E3) (hFh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fh W)
    (hFhV : ∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ V) (hFh0 : ∀ x ∈ W, fh (Fh x) = 0)
    (hFhd : ∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Fh x)) (hFhi : Set.InjOn Fh W)
    (μ : E2 → ℝ) (hμ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ μ W) (hμ0 : ∀ x ∈ W, μ x ≠ 0) :
    IsOpen {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y)))
      {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ} ∧
    Set.InjOn (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y)))
      {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ} ∧
    (∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ},
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y))) y)) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ W, partialDeriv 0 (fun y : E3 => fh (Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y))))
      (hpLift 0 x) = μ x)

subgoal_signatures.name: defining_function_lapse_ratio

[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig : Set M) (q : M) (hq : q ∈ Sig) (V₁ V₂ : Set M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ)
    (hV₁ : IsOpen V₁) (hV₂ : IsOpen V₂) (hq₁ : q ∈ V₁) (hq₂ : q ∈ V₂)
    (hf₁ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₁) (hf₂ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₂)

    (hd₂ : ∀ x ∈ V₂, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ x ≠ 0)
    (hS₁ : V₁ ∩ Sig = V₁ ∩ f₁ ⁻¹' {0}) (hS₂ : V₂ ∩ Sig = V₂ ∩ f₂ ⁻¹' {0})

    (hinv k l).mul (((hD' j l i).add (hD' i l j)).sub (hD' i j l)))

    refine (((hs 0 0).mul (hs 1 1)).sub ((hs 0 1).mul (hs 1 0))).congr ?_
    intro p _
    simp [Matrix.det_fin_two]
  have hinv : ∀ r s : Fin 2,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => (H p.1 p.2)⁻¹ r s) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W) := by
    intro r s
    have hadj : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => (H p.1 p.2).adjugate r s)
        (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W) := by
      fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] <;>
        first | exact hs _ _ | exact (hs _ _).neg
    refine ((hdetS.inv hdet).mul hadj).congr ?_
    intro p _
    simp [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  
  have hdot : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E2 => deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) k i j p.2) p.1) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W) :=
    fun k i j => hT (fun s x => christoffel2 (H s) k i j x) (hΓ k i j)
  have hpdΓ : ∀ c k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E2 => pd2 c (christoffel2 (H p.1) k i j) p.2) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W) :=
    fun c k i j => hD (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) k i j) (hΓ k i j) c
  have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => Real.sqrt (H p.1 p.2).det) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W) :=
    hdetS.sqrt hdet
  have hgb : ∀ e : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => gbW H p.1 p.2 e)
      (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W) := by
    intro e
    unfold gbW
    exact (ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun c _ => (hinv b c).mul (hdot e b c)).sub
      (ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ => (hinv e b).mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun c _ => hdot c c b))
  have hΨ : ∀ e : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E2 => Real.sqrt (H p.1 p.2).det * gbW H p.1 p.2 e) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W) :=
    fun e => hsq.mul (hgb e)
  have hK : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => gaussCurv2 (H p.1) p.2) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W) := by
    unfold gaussCurv2 ricci2
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ =>
      (hinv j k).mul
        ((ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => (hpdΓ i i j k).sub (hpdΓ j i i k)).add
          (ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun q _ =>
            ((hΓ i i q).mul (hΓ q j k)).sub ((hΓ i j q).mul (hΓ q i k)))))
  have hm : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, Set.MapsTo (fun y : E2 => (t, y)) W (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W) :=
    fun t ht y hy => ⟨ht, hy⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k i j t ht x hx
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => christoffel2 (H p.1) k i j p.2) (t, x) :=
      ((hΓ k i j).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds ⟨ht, hx⟩)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hι : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s : ℝ => (s, x)) t :=
      (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left (𝕜 := ℝ) t x).differentiableAt
    have hc := hd.comp t hι
    exact hc
  · exact (hK.mul hsq).continuousOn
  · intro e
    exact (hD (fun s y => Real.sqrt (H s y).det * gbW H s y e) (hΨ e) e).continuousOn
  · intro t ht e
    exact (hΨ e).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffOn (hm t ht)
  · intro t ht e
    exact ((hgb e).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffOn (hm t ht)).continuousOn
  · intro t ht
    exact (hsq.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffOn (hm t ht)).continuousOn

signature.name: ricci2_two_dim
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ c d : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y c d) W)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W, (h y).PosDef) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) (j k : Fin 2) :
    ricci2 h j k x = gaussCurv2 h x * h x j k

proof.tactics:
by
  have hxU : W ∈ 𝓝 x := hW.mem_nhds hx
  have hsymm : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ a b : Fin 2, h z a b = h z b a := by
    intro z hz a b
    have := (hpd z hz).isHermitian.apply b a
    simpa using this
  have hdh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h z a b) x := fun a b =>
    ((hh a b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hxU
  have hdP : ∀ c a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => pd2 c (fun z => h z a b) y) x := by
    intro c a b
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => h z a b) y) W :=
      (hh a b).fderiv_of_isOpen hW (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => pd2 c (fun z => h z a b) y) W :=
      h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h2.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt hxU
  
  have hschw : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ∀ c e : Fin 2,
      pd2 e (fun y => pd2 c f y) x = pd2 c (fun y => pd2 e f y) x := by
    intro f hf c e
    have hfx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x := hf.contDiffAt hxU
    have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f x := hfx.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    have hdf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x :=
      (hfx.fderiv_right (m := 1) (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have key : ∀ u v : Fin 2,
        pd2 v (fun y => pd2 u f y) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x (e2 v) (e2 u) := by
      intro u v
      unfold pd2
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hdf (differentiableAt_const (e2 u))]
      simp
    rw [key, key]
    exact hsym _ _
  
  have pmul : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z * g z) x = pd2 k f x * g x + f x * pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have padd : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z + g z) x = pd2 k f x + pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hg]
    rfl
  have psub : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z - g z) x = pd2 k f x - pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub hf hg]
    rfl
  have pneg : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), pd2 k (fun z => -f z) x = -pd2 k f x := by
    intro f k
    unfold pd2
    rw [show (fun z => -f z) = -f from rfl, fderiv_neg]
    rfl
  have pcmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x →
      pd2 k (fun z => c * f z) x = c * pd2 k f x := by
    intro c f k hf
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_const_mul hf c]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have pinv : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x ≠ 0 →
      pd2 k (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) x = -pd2 k f x / (f x) ^ 2 := by
    intro f k hf hf0
    unfold pd2
    have H := (hasDerivAt_inv hf0).comp_hasFDerivAt x hf.hasFDerivAt
    rw [show (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) = (fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) ∘ f from rfl, H.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  
  have hinvE : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (i j : Fin 2),
      A⁻¹ i j = A.det⁻¹ * A.adjugate i j := by
    intro A i j
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rfl
  have hadj00 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 0 0 = A 1 1 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj01 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 0 1 = -A 0 1 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj10 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 1 0 = -A 1 0 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj11 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 1 1 = A 0 0 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hdetE : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 1 0 :=
    fun A => Matrix.det_fin_two A
  have hDpos : 0 < (h x).det := (hpd x hx).det_pos
  have hD0 : (h x).det ≠ 0 := hDpos.ne'
  have hdetfun : (fun z => (h z).det) = fun z => h z 0 0 * h z 1 1 - h z 0 1 * h z 1 0 := by
    funext z; exact hdetE (h z)
  have hdD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z).det) x := by
    rw [hdetfun]; exact ((hdh 0 0).mul (hdh 1 1)).sub ((hdh 0 1).mul (hdh 1 0))
  have hdI : ∀ i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) x := by
    intro i j
    have e : (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) = fun z => ((h z).det)⁻¹ * (h z).adjugate i j :=
      funext fun z => hinvE (h z) i j
    rw [e]
    refine (hdD.inv hD0).mul ?_
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, hadj00]; exact hdh 1 1
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, hadj01]; exact (hdh 0 1).neg
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, hadj10]; exact (hdh 1 0).neg
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, hadj11]; exact hdh 0 0
  have pD : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x =
      pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 0) x * h x 1 1 + h x 0 0 * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 1) x -
        (pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 1) x * h x 1 0 + h x 0 1 * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 0) x) := by
    intro k
    rw [hdetfun, psub _ _ k ((hdh 0 0).fun_mul (hdh 1 1)) ((hdh 0 1).fun_mul (hdh 1 0)),
      pmul _ _ k (hdh 0 0) (hdh 1 1), pmul _ _ k (hdh 0 1) (hdh 1 0)]
  have pI00 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 0) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * h x 1 1 +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 1) x := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj00]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 1 1), pinv _ k hdD hD0]
  have pI01 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 1) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * (-h x 0 1) +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * (-pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 1) x) := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj01]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 0 1).fun_neg, pinv _ k hdD hD0, pneg]
  have pI10 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 0) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * (-h x 1 0) +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * (-pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 0) x) := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj10]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 1 0).fun_neg, pinv _ k hdD hD0, pneg]
  have pI11 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 1) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * h x 0 0 +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 0) x := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj11]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 0 0), pinv _ k hdD hD0]
  
  have pdinv : ∀ e k l : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ k l) x =
      -∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k p * pd2 e (fun y => h y p q) x * (h x)⁻¹ q l := by
    intro e k l
    fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l
    all_goals
      simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, pI00, pI01, pI10, pI11, pD,
        Fin.sum_univ_two, hinvE (h x), hadj00, hadj01, hadj10, hadj11]
      field_simp
      simp only [hdetE (h x)]
      ring
  
  have hs2 : ∀ e k i j : Fin 2, pd2 e (christoffel2 h k i j) x =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2,
        ((-∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k p * pd2 e (fun y => h y p q) x * (h x)⁻¹ q l) *
            (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x) +
          (h x)⁻¹ k l *
            (pd2 e (fun y => pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) y) x +
              pd2 e (fun y => pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) y) x -
              pd2 e (fun y => pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) y) x)) := by
    intro e k i j
    have hP : ∀ l : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) y +
        pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) y - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) y) x :=
      fun l => ((hdP i j l).fun_add (hdP j i l)).fun_sub (hdP l i j)
    have hX : ∀ l : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ k l * (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) y +
        pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) y - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) y)) x :=
      fun l => (hdI k l).fun_mul (hP l)
    have hT : ∀ l : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ k l * (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) y +
        pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) y - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) y)) x =
        pd2 e (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ k l) x *
          (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x) +
        (h x)⁻¹ k l * (pd2 e (fun y => pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) y) x +
              pd2 e (fun y => pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) y) x -
              pd2 e (fun y => pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) y) x) := by
      intro l
      rw [pmul _ _ e (hdI k l) (hP l), psub _ _ e ((hdP i j l).fun_add (hdP j i l)) (hdP l i j),
        padd _ _ e (hdP i j l) (hdP j i l)]
    show pd2 e (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ k l *
      (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) y + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) y - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) y)) x = _
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [pcmul _ _ e ((hX 0).fun_add (hX 1)), padd _ _ e (hX 0) (hX 1), hT 0, hT 1]
    simp only [pdinv, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  
  have key : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ), A 1 0 = A 0 1 → A.det ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ), (∀ c, d c 1 0 = d c 0 1) →
      ∀ (dd : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ), (∀ a b, dd 1 0 a b = dd 0 1 a b) →
      ∀ (Γ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
        (∀ k i j, Γ k i j = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, A⁻¹ k l * (d i j l + d j i l - d l i j)) →
      ∀ (dΓ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
        (∀ e k i j, dΓ e k i j = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2,
          ((-∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, A⁻¹ k p * d e p q * A⁻¹ q l) * (d i j l + d j i l - d l i j) +
            A⁻¹ k l * (dd e i j l + dd e j i l - dd e l i j))) →
      ∀ j k : Fin 2,
        (∑ i : Fin 2, (dΓ i i j k - dΓ j i i k) +
            ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k)) =
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a b *
              (∑ i : Fin 2, (dΓ i i a b - dΓ a i i b) +
                ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, (Γ i i p * Γ p a b - Γ i a p * Γ p i b))) * A j k := by
    intro A hA hdet d hd dd hdd Γ hΓ dΓ hdΓ j k
    have hDdef : A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hA]
    fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k <;>
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, hΓ, hdΓ, Fin.sum_univ_two, hinvE A,
        hadj00, hadj01, hadj10, hadj11, hA, hd, hdd]
      generalize A.det = D at hdet hDdef ⊢
      generalize A 0 0 = a at hDdef ⊢
      generalize A 0 1 = b at hDdef ⊢
      generalize A 1 1 = c at hDdef ⊢
      field_simp
      rw [hDdef]
      ring
  
  have hd : ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => h y 1 0) x = pd2 c (fun y => h y 0 1) x := by
    intro c
    have hev : (fun z => h z 1 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => h z 0 1) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hxU (fun z hz => hsymm z hz 1 0)
    unfold pd2
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev]
  have hdd : ∀ a b : Fin 2, pd2 1 (fun y => pd2 0 (fun z => h z a b) y) x =
      pd2 0 (fun y => pd2 1 (fun z => h z a b) y) x :=
    fun a b => hschw _ (hh a b) 0 1
  exact key (h x) (hsymm x hx 1 0) hD0 (fun c a b => pd2 c (fun y => h y a b) x) hd
    (fun e c a b => pd2 e (fun y => pd2 c (fun z => h z a b) y) x) hdd
    (fun k i j => christoffel2 h k i j x) (fun k i j => rfl)
    (fun e k i j => pd2 e (christoffel2 h k i j) x) hs2 j k

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (a b : ℝ)
    (H : ℝ → E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ c d : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => H p.1 p.2 c d) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W))
    (hpos : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ x ∈ W, (H t x).PosDef)
    (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E2 => christoffel2 (H p.1) k i j p.2)
      (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo a b) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W)
    (hric : ∀ j k : Fin 2, ricci2 (H t) j k x = gaussCurv2 (H t) x * H t x j k) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => gaussCurv2 (H s) x * Real.sqrt (H s x).det)
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun y => Real.sqrt (H t y).det * gbW H t y e) x) t

signature.statement:

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have mat2_inv_sqrtDet_hasFDerivAt : ∀ {V : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
      (M : V → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (v : V) (L : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → V →L[ℝ] ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun u => M u a b) (L a b) v) →
      0 < (M v).det →
      (∀ i j : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun u => (M u)⁻¹ i j)
        (-(∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ((M v)⁻¹ i a * (M v)⁻¹ b j) • L a b)) v) ∧
      HasFDerivAt (fun u => Real.sqrt (M u).det)

      fun u => Matrix.det_fin_two _
    have hD : HasFDerivAt (fun u => (M u).det)
        (M v 0 0 • L 1 1 + M v 1 1 • L 0 0 - (M v 0 1 • L 1 0 + M v 1 0 • L 0 1)) v := by
      have h := ((hM 0 0).mul (hM 1 1)).sub ((hM 0 1).mul (hM 1 0))
      simp only [hdet_eq]
      exact h
    have hinvE : ∀ u (i j : Fin 2), (M u)⁻¹ i j = ((M u).det)⁻¹ * (M u).adjugate i j := by
      intro u i j
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    have hdi := (hasFDerivAt_inv hdet.ne').comp v hD
    have hgen : ∀ (f : V → ℝ) (f' : V →L[ℝ] ℝ), HasFDerivAt f f' v →
        HasFDerivAt (fun u => ((M u).det)⁻¹ * f u)
          (((M v).det)⁻¹ • f' + f v • ((ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ
            (-((M v).det ^ 2)⁻¹)).comp
            (M v 0 0 • L 1 1 + M v 1 1 • L 0 0 - (M v 0 1 • L 1 0 + M v 1 0 • L 0 1)))) v := by
      intro f f' hf
      exact hdi.mul hf
    have hd0 : (M v 0 0 * M v 1 1 - M v 0 1 * M v 1 0) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← hdet_eq]; exact hdet.ne'
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j
      simp only [funext (hinvE · i j)]
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
      · have h := hgen _ _ (hM 1 1)
        simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Matrix.of_apply] at h ⊢
        refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
        ext w
        simp [hinvE, Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Fin.sum_univ_two, hdet_eq]
        field_simp
        ring
      · have h := hgen _ _ (hM 0 1).neg
        simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Matrix.of_apply] at h ⊢
        refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
        ext w
        simp [hinvE, Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Fin.sum_univ_two, hdet_eq]
        field_simp
        ring
      · have h := hgen _ _ (hM 1 0).neg
        simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Matrix.of_apply] at h ⊢
        refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
        ext w
        simp [hinvE, Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Fin.sum_univ_two, hdet_eq]
        field_simp
        ring
      · have h := hgen _ _ (hM 0 0)
        simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Matrix.of_apply] at h ⊢
        refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
        ext w
        simp [hinvE, Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Fin.sum_univ_two, hdet_eq]
        field_simp
        ring
    · have h := hD.sqrt hdet.ne'
      refine h.congr_fderiv ?_
      have hs : Real.sqrt (M v).det ^ 2 = (M v).det := Real.sq_sqrt hdet.le
      have hsp : 0 < Real.sqrt (M v).det := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hdet
      have hadj : ∀ a b : Fin 2, (M v)⁻¹ a b = ((M v).det)⁻¹ * (M v).adjugate a b := hinvE v
      simp only [hadj]
      set s := Real.sqrt (M v).det with hsdef
      set d := (M v).det with hddef
      have hk : 1 / (2 * s) = (1 / 2 * s) * d⁻¹ := by
        rw [← hs]; field_simp
      ext w
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.adjugate_fin_two,
        Matrix.of_apply]
      rw [hk]
      simp
      ring
  
  have christoffel2_family_dt_dx_comm : ∀ (k i j : Fin 2),

      unfold pd2

      simp

      intro s y hq
      have h := ((hdiff (s, y) hq).comp s (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left (𝕜 := ℝ) s y)).hasDerivAt
      rw [show (fun s' => christoffel2 (H s') k i j y) = Φ ∘ (fun s' => (s', y)) by
        rw [hΦ]; rfl, h.deriv]
      simp

    have hD2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) (t, x) :=

      (hcd _ hp).isSymmSndFDerivAt

    have hnX : {y : E2 | (t, y) ∈ Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W} ∈ 𝓝 x :=
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hU.mem_nhds hp)
    have hevX : (fun y => deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) k i j y) t) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]

      filter_upwards [hnX] with y hy
      exact htime t y hy
    have hBX := (hD2.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right (𝕜 := ℝ) t x)).clm_apply
      (hasFDerivAt_const ((1, 0) : ℝ × E2) x)

    · exact hBX.differentiableAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq hevX
    · intro e
      have hA : HasDerivAt (fun s => fderiv ℝ Φ (s, x) (0, e2 e))
          (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ) (t, x) (1, 0) (0, e2 e)) t := by
        have h1 := hD2.hasFDerivAt.comp t (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left (𝕜 := ℝ) t x)
        have h2 := (h1.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const ((0, e2 e) : ℝ × E2) t)).hasDerivAt
        convert h2 using 1
        simp

        rw [hsymm (1, 0) (0, e2 e)]

  have gb_variation_algebra : ∀ (h hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hd : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
      (dh Γ Gd : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (dGd : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (K σ : ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 2, h a b = h b a) → (∀ a b : Fin 2, hi a b = hi b a) →
      (∀ a b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hi a c * h c b = if a = b then 1 else 0) →
      (∀ e a b : Fin 2, dh e a b = dh e b a) →
      (∀ k i j : Fin 2,
        Γ k i j = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, hi k l * (dh i j l + dh j i l - dh l i j)) →
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2,
          ((-∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, hi j a * hi b k * hd a b) * (K * h j k) +
            hi j k * (∑ i : Fin 2, (dGd i i j k - dGd j i i k) +
              ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2, (Gd i i p * Γ p j k + Γ i i p * Gd p j k -
                (Gd i j p * Γ p i k + Γ i j p * Gd p i k))))) * σ +
        K * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * σ * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, hi b a * hd a b) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ e : Fin 2,
        (((1 / 2 : ℝ) * σ * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, hi b a * dh e a b) *
            (∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hi b c * Gd e b c -
              ∑ b : Fin 2, hi e b * ∑ c : Fin 2, Gd c c b) +
          σ * (∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
                ((-∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ a' : Fin 2, hi b a * hi a' c * dh e a a') * Gd e b c +
                  hi b c * dGd e e b c) -
              ∑ b : Fin 2, ((-∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ a' : Fin 2, hi e a * hi a' b * dh e a a') *
                  ∑ c : Fin 2, Gd c c b + hi e b * ∑ c : Fin 2, dGd e c c b))) := by
    intro h hi hd dh Γ Gd dGd K σ hsym hisym hinv hdh hΓ
    have i00 : hi 0 0 * h 0 0 + hi 0 1 * h 1 0 = 1 := by
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using hinv 0 0
    have i01 : hi 0 0 * h 0 1 + hi 0 1 * h 1 1 = 0 := by
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using hinv 0 1
    have i10 : hi 1 0 * h 0 0 + hi 1 1 * h 1 0 = 0 := by
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using hinv 1 0
    have i11 : hi 1 0 * h 0 1 + hi 1 1 * h 1 1 = 1 := by
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using hinv 1 1
    have s1 := hsym 1 0
    have s2 := hisym 1 0
    have s3 := hdh 0 1 0
    have s4 := hdh 1 1 0
    simp only [hΓ, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.isValue]
    simp only [s1, s2, s3, s4] at i00 i01 i10 i11 ⊢
    linear_combination (-(1/2) * σ * K) *
      (hd 0 0 * hi 0 0 * i00 + hd 0 0 * hi 0 1 * i01 + hd 0 1 * hi 0 0 * i10 +
        hd 0 1 * hi 0 1 * i11 + hd 1 0 * hi 0 1 * i00 + hd 1 0 * hi 1 1 * i01 +
        hd 1 1 * hi 0 1 * i10 + hd 1 1 * hi 1 1 * i11)

    exact hK.mul hsq

  obtain ⟨hiX, hsX⟩ := mat2_inv_sqrtDet_hasFDerivAt (fun y => H t y) x
    (fun a' b' => fderiv ℝ (fun y => H t y a' b') x) (fun a' b' => (hXd a' b').hasFDerivAt) hdet
  have hgX : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun y => deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) k i j y) t)
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) k i j y) t) x) x :=
    fun k i j => (christoffel2_family_dt_dx_comm k i j).1.hasFDerivAt
  have hR := fun e => gb_rhs_pd2 e _ _ _ hsX hiX hgX
  
  have key := gb_variation_algebra (H t x) (H t x)⁻¹
    (fun a' b' => fderiv ℝ (fun s => H s x a' b') t 1)
    (fun e' a' b' => fderiv ℝ (fun y => H t y a' b') x (e2 e'))
    (fun k i j => christoffel2 (H t) k i j x)
    (fun k i j => deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) k i j x) t)
    (fun e k i j => fderiv ℝ (fun y => deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) k i j y) t) x (e2 e))
    (gaussCurv2 (H t) x) (Real.sqrt (H t x).det) hsym hisym hinv hdh (fun k i j => rfl)
  refine hL.congr_deriv ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => hR e)]
  simp only [hric, gbW, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sum',
    Finset.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at key ⊢
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.isValue] at key ⊢
  linear_combination key
