signature.statement:
(A B : Set E2) (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (τ : E2 → E2)
    (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ A) (hτAB : ∀ x ∈ A, τ x ∈ B)
    (h h' : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh' : ∀ c d : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h' y c d) B)
    (hpd' : ∀ y ∈ B, (h' y).PosDef) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ A, (h x).PosDef)
    (hcomp : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ c d : Fin 2, h x c d = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' * h' (τ x) c' d' * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 d) d')
    (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ A) (m b c : Fin 2) :
    ∑ e : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 e) m * christoffel2 h e b c x =
      ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2,
          christoffel2 h' m p q (τ x) * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) p * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) q +
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c)) x (e2 b) m

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have alg : ∀ (J : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (g hm : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
      (D T dH : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ p q : Fin 2, g p q = g q p) →
      (∀ m b c : Fin 2, T m b c = T m c b) →
      (∀ c d : Fin 2, hm c d = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2, J c' c * g c' d' * J d' d) →
      hm.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ i c d : Fin 2, dH i c d = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
        (T c' i c * g c' d' * J d' d + J c' c * (∑ r : Fin 2, D r c' d' * J r i) * J d' d +
          J c' c * g c' d' * T d' i d)) →
      ∀ m b c : Fin 2,
      ∑ e : Fin 2, J m e * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ e l * (dH b c l + dH c b l - dH l b c)) =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2,
            ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, g⁻¹ m l * (D p q l + D q p l - D l p q)) * J p b * J q c +
          T m b c := by
    intro J g hm D T dH hg hT hhm hdet hdH m b c
    
    have hA : ∀ l : Fin 2, dH b c l + dH c b l - dH l b c = ∑ q : Fin 2, J q l *
        (2 * ∑ p : Fin 2, g q p * T p b c +
          ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ r : Fin 2, (D p r q + D r p q - D q p r) * J p b * J r c) := by
      intro l
      have hT1 : ∀ x, T x c b = T x b c := fun x => hT x c b
      have hT2 : ∀ x, T x l b = T x b l := fun x => hT x l b
      have hT3 : ∀ x, T x l c = T x c l := fun x => hT x l c
      have hg10 : g 1 0 = g 0 1 := hg 1 0
      simp only [hdH, Fin.sum_univ_two, hT1, hT2, hT3, hg10]
      ring
    
    set Jm : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := Matrix.of J with hJm
    have hhm' : hm = Jm.transpose * g * Jm := by
      ext i j
      rw [hhm i j]
      simp only [hJm, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    have hdet' : hm.det = Jm.det * g.det * Jm.det := by
      rw [hhm', Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
    have hJdet : Jm.det ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; apply hdet; rw [hdet', h0]; ring
    have hgdet : g.det ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; apply hdet; rw [hdet', h0]; ring
    have hJu : IsUnit Jm.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hJdet
    have hJtu : IsUnit Jm.transpose.det := by rw [Matrix.det_transpose]; exact hJu
    have hgu : IsUnit g.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hgdet
    have hraiseM : Jm * hm⁻¹ * Jm.transpose = g⁻¹ := by
      rw [hhm', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
      calc Jm * (Jm⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * Jm.transpose⁻¹)) * Jm.transpose
          = (Jm * Jm⁻¹) * g⁻¹ * (Jm.transpose⁻¹ * Jm.transpose) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = g⁻¹ := by
          rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hJu, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hJtu, Matrix.one_mul,
            Matrix.mul_one]
    have hB : ∀ q : Fin 2, ∑ e : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, J m e * hm⁻¹ e l * J q l = g⁻¹ m q := by
      intro q
      have := congrFun (congrFun hraiseM m) q
      rw [← this]
      simp only [hJm, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    have hC : ∑ p : Fin 2, (∑ q : Fin 2, g⁻¹ m q * g q p) * T p b c = T m b c := by
      have h1 : ∀ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, g⁻¹ m q * g q p = (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) m p := by
        intro p
        rw [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul g hgu, Matrix.mul_apply]
      simp only [h1, Matrix.one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
        Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    
    have key : ∀ U : Fin 2 → ℝ, (∀ l : Fin 2, dH b c l + dH c b l - dH l b c =
        ∑ q : Fin 2, J q l * U q) → ∑ e : Fin 2, J m e * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ e l *
        (dH b c l + dH c b l - dH l b c)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ q : Fin 2, g⁻¹ m q * U q := by
      intro U hU
      simp only [hU]
      have hB0 := hB 0
      have hB1 := hB 1
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hB0 hB1 ⊢
      linear_combination (1 / 2 * U 0) * hB0 + (1 / 2 * U 1) * hB1
    rw [key (fun q => 2 * ∑ p : Fin 2, g q p * T p b c +
          ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ r : Fin 2, (D p r q + D r p q - D q p r) * J p b * J r c) hA, ← hC]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have schwarz : ∀ m b c : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c)) x (e2 b) m =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 b)) x (e2 c) m := by
    intro m b c
    have hτx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ τ x := hτ.contDiffAt (hA.mem_nhds hx)
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) x :=
      (hτx.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hrw : ∀ u : E2, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y u) x = (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) x).flip u := by
      intro u
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hD (differentiableAt_const u)]
      simp
    have hsym := hτx.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    rw [hrw, hrw]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
    rw [hsym.eq]
  
  have pull : ∀ i c d : Fin 2,
      pd2 i (fun y => h y c d) x = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c)) x (e2 i) c' * h' (τ x) c' d' *
            fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 d) d' +
          fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' *
            (∑ r : Fin 2, pd2 r (fun y => h' y c' d') (τ x) * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i) r) *
            fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 d) d' +
          fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' * h' (τ x) c' d' *
            fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 d)) x (e2 i) d') := by
    intro i c d
    have hτx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ τ x := hτ.contDiffAt (hA.mem_nhds hx)
    have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ x := hτx.differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) x :=
      (hτx.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    
    have ha : ∀ (u : E2) (k : Fin 2), HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y u k)
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y u) x)) x := by
      intro u k
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y u) x := hD.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const u)
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp x h1.hasFDerivAt
    have hb : ∀ p q : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun y => h' (τ y) p q)
        ((fderiv ℝ (fun z => h' z p q) (τ x)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ x)) x := by
      intro p q
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h' z p q) (τ x) :=
        ((hh' p q).contDiffAt (hB.mem_nhds (hτAB x hx))).differentiableAt (by simp)
      exact h1.hasFDerivAt.comp x hτd.hasFDerivAt
    have hΦ : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
        fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c) c' * h' (τ y) c' d' * fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 d) d')
        (∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
          ((fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' * h' (τ x) c' d') •
              (EuclideanSpace.proj d' : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 d)) x) +
            fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 d) d' •
              (fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' •
                  (fderiv ℝ (fun z => h' z c' d') (τ x)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ x) +
                h' (τ x) c' d' •
                  (EuclideanSpace.proj c' : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
                    (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c)) x)))) x := by
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
      intro c' _
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
      intro d' _
      exact ((ha (e2 c) c').mul (hb c' d')).mul (ha (e2 d) d')
    have hev : (fun y => h y c d) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
        fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c) c' * h' (τ y) c' d' * fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 d) d') :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hA.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hcomp y hy c d)
    have hexp : ∀ v : E2, v = v 0 • e2 0 + v 1 • e2 1 := by
      intro v
      ext k
      fin_cases k <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hp : ∀ (k : Fin 2) (v : E2), (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) v = v k := fun _ _ => rfl
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hΦ.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hv := hexp (fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i))
    have hlin : ∀ p q : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun z => h' z p q) (τ x) (fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i)) =
        ∑ r : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun z => h' z p q) (τ x) (e2 r) * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i) r := by
      intro p q
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, Fin.sum_univ_two, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    simp only [hlin]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d' _ => ?_))
    simp only [hp]
    ring
  
  have hg : ∀ p q : Fin 2, h' (τ x) p q = h' (τ x) q p := by
    intro p q
    have h1 := (hpd' (τ x) (hτAB x hx)).isHermitian.apply p q
    simp only [star_trivial] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have key := alg (fun p b => fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) p) (h' (τ x)) (h x)
    (fun r p q => pd2 r (fun y => h' y p q) (τ x))
    (fun m b c => fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c)) x (e2 b) m)
    (fun i c d => pd2 i (fun y => h y c d) x)
    hg schwarz (hcomp x hx) (hpd x hx).det_pos.ne' pull m b c
  unfold christoffel2
  exact key

informal_problem.statement:
(a b t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo a b)
    (H H' : ℝ → E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x y : E2)
    (J : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hpos : (H t x).PosDef) (hpos' : (H' t y).PosDef)
    (hcomp : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ c d : Fin 2,
      H s x c d = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2, J c' c * H' s y c' d' * J d' d)
    (hchr : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ m p q : Fin 2,
      ∑ e : Fin 2, J m e * christoffel2 (H s) e p q x =
        ∑ p' : Fin 2, ∑ q' : Fin 2, christoffel2 (H' s) m p' q' y * J p' p * J q' q + T m p q)
    (hd : ∀ e p q : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) e p q x) t)
    (hd' : ∀ e p q : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => christoffel2 (H' s) e p q y) t) :
    ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ e : Fin 2, J i e * gbW H t x e = gbW H' t y i

signature.name: gbW_transform
signature.statement:
(a b t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo a b)
    (H H' : ℝ → E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x y : E2)
    (J : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hpos : (H t x).PosDef) (hpos' : (H' t y).PosDef)
    (hcomp : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ c d : Fin 2,
      H s x c d = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2, J c' c * H' s y c' d' * J d' d)
    (hchr : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ m p q : Fin 2,
      ∑ e : Fin 2, J m e * christoffel2 (H s) e p q x =
        ∑ p' : Fin 2, ∑ q' : Fin 2, christoffel2 (H' s) m p' q' y * J p' p * J q' q + T m p q)
    (hd : ∀ e p q : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) e p q x) t)
    (hd' : ∀ e p q : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => christoffel2 (H' s) e p q y) t) :
    ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ e : Fin 2, J i e * gbW H t x e = gbW H' t y i

proof.tactics:
by
  intro i
  
  have hAB : ∀ m p q : Fin 2,
      ∑ e : Fin 2, J m e * deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) e p q x) t =
        ∑ p' : Fin 2, ∑ q' : Fin 2,
          deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H' s) m p' q' y) t * J p' p * J q' q := by
    intro m p q
    have hF : HasDerivAt (fun s => ∑ e : Fin 2, J m e * christoffel2 (H s) e p q x)
        (∑ e : Fin 2, J m e * deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) e p q x) t) t :=
      HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun e _ => ((hd e p q).hasDerivAt).const_mul (J m e))
    have hG0 : HasDerivAt (fun s => ∑ p' : Fin 2, ∑ q' : Fin 2,
          christoffel2 (H' s) m p' q' y * J p' p * J q' q)
        (∑ p' : Fin 2, ∑ q' : Fin 2,
          deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H' s) m p' q' y) t * J p' p * J q' q) t :=
      HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun p' _ => HasDerivAt.fun_sum (fun q' _ =>
        (((hd' m p' q').hasDerivAt).mul_const (J p' p)).mul_const (J q' q)))
    have hG := hG0.add (hasDerivAt_const t (T m p q))
    rw [add_zero] at hG
    have hev : (fun s => ∑ e : Fin 2, J m e * christoffel2 (H s) e p q x) =ᶠ[nhds t]
        (fun s => (∑ p' : Fin 2, ∑ q' : Fin 2,
          christoffel2 (H' s) m p' q' y * J p' p * J q' q) + T m p q) := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2] with s hs
      exact hchr s hs m p q
    exact hF.unique (hG.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev)
  
  have hmat : H t x = J.transpose * H' t y * J := by
    ext c d
    rw [hcomp t ht c d]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hdet : (H t x).det ≠ 0 := hpos.det_pos.ne'
  rw [hmat, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose] at hdet
  have hJ : J.det ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hdet
    rw [h0]
    ring
  have hinv : J * (H t x)⁻¹ * J.transpose = (H' t y)⁻¹ := by
    have hJu : IsUnit J.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hJ
    have hJTu : IsUnit J.transpose.det := by rw [Matrix.det_transpose]; exact hJu
    rw [hmat, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, ← Matrix.mul_assoc J,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv J hJu, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hJTu, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hP : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, J i b * (H t x)⁻¹ b c * J j c =
      (H' t y)⁻¹ i j := by
    intro i j
    rw [← hinv]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  unfold gbW
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ,
      ∀ e p q, deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H s) e p q x) t = A e p q :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ,
      ∀ e p q, deriv (fun s => christoffel2 (H' s) e p q y) t = B e p q :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  simp only [hAdef, hBdef] at hAB ⊢
  generalize (H t x)⁻¹ = P at hP ⊢
  generalize (H' t y)⁻¹ = P' at hP ⊢
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hAB hP ⊢
  have htr : ∀ b : Fin 2, A 0 0 b + A 1 1 b =
      B 0 0 0 * J 0 b + B 0 0 1 * J 1 b + (B 1 1 0 * J 0 b + B 1 1 1 * J 1 b) := by
    intro b
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hJ
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
    linear_combination J 1 1 * hAB 0 0 b - J 0 1 * hAB 1 0 b - J 1 0 * hAB 0 1 b +
      J 0 0 * hAB 1 1 b
  linear_combination P 0 0 * hAB i 0 0 + P 0 1 * hAB i 0 1 + P 1 0 * hAB i 1 0 +
    P 1 1 * hAB i 1 1 +
    B i 0 0 * hP 0 0 + B i 0 1 * hP 0 1 + B i 1 0 * hP 1 0 + B i 1 1 * hP 1 1 -
    (J i 0 * P 0 0 + J i 1 * P 1 0) * htr 0 - (J i 0 * P 0 1 + J i 1 * P 1 1) * htr 1 -
    (B 0 0 0 + B 1 1 0) * hP i 0 - (B 0 0 1 + B 1 1 1) * hP i 1

informal_problem.statement:
(W Kc : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hKc : IsCompact Kc)
    (hKW : Kc ⊆ W) (a b : ℝ) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContinuousOn ζ W)

    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ x ∈ W, HasDerivAt (fun s => F s x) (F' t x) t)

signature.name: integral_hasDerivAt_cutoff
signature.statement:
(W Kc : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hKc : IsCompact Kc)
    (hKW : Kc ⊆ W) (a b : ℝ) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContinuousOn ζ W)
    (hζK : ∀ x ∈ W, x ∉ Kc → ζ x = 0) (F F' : ℝ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × E2 => F p.1 p.2) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W))
    (hF' : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × E2 => F' p.1 p.2) (Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W))
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ x ∈ W, HasDerivAt (fun s => F s x) (F' t x) t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo a b) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x in W, ζ x * F s x) (∫ x in W, ζ x * F' t x) t

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hat, htb⟩ := ht
  set η : ℝ := min (t - a) (b - t) / 2 with hη_def
  have hmin : 0 < min (t - a) (b - t) := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hη : 0 < η := by rw [hη_def]; linarith
  have hη1 : η < t - a := by
    have : min (t - a) (b - t) ≤ t - a := min_le_left _ _
    rw [hη_def]; linarith
  have hη2 : η < b - t := by
    have : min (t - a) (b - t) ≤ b - t := min_le_right _ _
    rw [hη_def]; linarith
  have hball : ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball t η, s ∈ Set.Icc (t - η) (t + η) := by
    intro s hs
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt] at hs
    constructor <;> linarith [hs.1, hs.2]
  have hIcc : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (t - η) (t + η), s ∈ Set.Ioo a b := by
    intro s hs
    exact ⟨by linarith [hs.1], by linarith [hs.2]⟩
  have hWm : MeasurableSet W := hW.measurableSet
  have hcont : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ContinuousOn (fun x => ζ x * F s x) W := by
    intro s hs
    refine hζ.mul ?_
    have hpair : ContinuousOn (fun x : E2 => ((s, x) : ℝ × E2)) W :=
      continuousOn_const.prodMk continuousOn_id
    exact hF.comp hpair (fun x hx => ⟨hs, hx⟩)
  have hcont' : ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ContinuousOn (fun x => ζ x * F' s x) W := by
    intro s hs
    refine hζ.mul ?_
    have hpair : ContinuousOn (fun x : E2 => ((s, x) : ℝ × E2)) W :=
      continuousOn_const.prodMk continuousOn_id
    exact hF'.comp hpair (fun x hx => ⟨hs, hx⟩)
  have hQc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (t - η) (t + η) ×ˢ Kc) := isCompact_Icc.prod hKc
  have hQsub : Set.Icc (t - η) (t + η) ×ˢ Kc ⊆ Set.Ioo a b ×ˢ W :=
    fun p hp => ⟨hIcc _ hp.1, hKW hp.2⟩
  have hQcont : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × E2 => ζ p.2 * F' p.1 p.2)
      (Set.Icc (t - η) (t + η) ×ˢ Kc) := by
    refine ContinuousOn.mul ?_ (hF'.mono hQsub)
    exact hζ.comp continuousOn_snd (fun p hp => hKW hp.2)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hQc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hQcont
  have hKcont : ContinuousOn (fun x => ζ x * F t x) Kc := (hcont t ⟨hat, htb⟩).mono hKW
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hKcont
  have hind : ∀ D : ℝ, MeasureTheory.Integrable (Kc.indicator (fun _ => D))
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict W) := by
    intro D
    refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.restrict ?_
    refine MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator ?_ hKc.measurableSet
    exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hKc.measure_lt_top.ne
  have hmeas : ∀ᶠ s in nhds t, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => ζ x * F s x)
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict W) := by
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds t hη] with s hs
    exact (hcont s (hIcc s (hball s hs))).aestronglyMeasurable hWm
  have hint0 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ζ x * F t x)
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict W) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono' (hind C₀)
      ((hcont t ⟨hat, htb⟩).aestronglyMeasurable hWm) ?_
    refine (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem hWm).mono ?_
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxK : x ∈ Kc
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxK]; exact hC₀ x hxK
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxK, hζK x hx hxK, zero_mul, norm_zero]
  have hbound : Filter.Eventually (fun x => ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball t η,
      ‖ζ x * F' s x‖ ≤ Kc.indicator (fun _ => C) x)
      (MeasureTheory.ae (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict W)) := by
    refine (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem hWm).mono ?_
    intro x hx s hs
    by_cases hxK : x ∈ Kc
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxK]
      exact hC (s, x) ⟨hball s hs, hxK⟩
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxK, hζK x hx hxK, zero_mul, norm_zero]
  have hdiff : Filter.Eventually (fun x => ∀ s ∈ Metric.ball t η,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => ζ x * F s x) (ζ x * F' s x) s)
      (MeasureTheory.ae (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict W)) := by
    refine (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_mem hWm).mono ?_
    intro x hx s hs
    exact (hd s (hIcc s (hball s hs)) x hx).const_mul (ζ x)
  exact (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (Metric.ball_mem_nhds t hη) hmeas
    hint0 ((hcont' t ⟨hat, htb⟩).aestronglyMeasurable hWm) hbound (hind C) hdiff).2

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hρ1 : ∀ q ∈ S, ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (hm : Fin P.n → E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hmc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (hm j x).det) (P.W j))
    (hcov : ∀ (j k : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ),
      (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (hm j x).det) =
        ∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (hm k y).det)
    (Wv : Fin P.n → E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hWc : ∀ j (e : Fin 2), ContinuousOn (fun x => Wv j x e) (P.W j))
    (hWt : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ∑ e : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 e) i * Wv j x e =
        Wv k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) i) :
    ∑ j, ∑ e : Fin 2, ∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
      (Real.sqrt (hm j x).det * Wv j x e) = 0

signature.name: patched_divergence_sum_zero
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hρ1 : ∀ q ∈ S, ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (hm : Fin P.n → E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hmc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (hm j x).det) (P.W j))
    (hcov : ∀ (j k : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ),
      (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (hm j x).det) =
        ∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (hm k y).det)
    (Wv : Fin P.n → E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hWc : ∀ j (e : Fin 2), ContinuousOn (fun x => Wv j x e) (P.W j))
    (hWt : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ∑ e : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 e) i * Wv j x e =
        Wv k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) i) :
    ∑ j, ∑ e : Fin 2, ∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
      (Real.sqrt (hm j x).det * Wv j x e) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have memS : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ S := by
    intro j x hx
    have h : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at h
    exact h.2
  have memO : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ P.O j := by
    intro j x hx
    have h : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at h
    exact h.1
  have hH3 : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) = P.param j x := by
    intro j k x hx
    have h2 : P.param j x ∈ P.param k '' P.W k := by
      rw [P.image_eq k]; exact ⟨hx.2, memS j x hx.1⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := h2
    rw [← hyx, P.proj_param k y hy]
    exact ⟨hy, rfl⟩
  have hAopen : ∀ j k, IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := fun j k =>
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)
  
  have pd_zero : ∀ (u : E2 → ℝ) (y : E2) (V : Set E2), IsOpen V → y ∈ V →
      (∀ z ∈ V, u z = 0) → ∀ i, pd2 i u y = 0 := by
    intro u y V hV hy hu i
    have hev : u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hy) hu
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have pd_cont : ∀ (u : E2 → ℝ) (V : Set E2), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u V → ∀ i,
      ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 i u x) V := by
    intro u V hV hu i
    exact (hu.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  
  have hint : ∀ j (f : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn f (P.W j) →
      (∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → f x = 0) → IntegrableOn f (P.W j) := by
    intro j f hf hf0
    have h1 : IntegrableOn f (Kc j) := (hf.mono (hK j).2).integrableOn_compact (hK j).1
    exact h1.of_forall_diff_eq_zero (P.W_open j).measurableSet (fun x hx => hf0 x hx.1 hx.2)
  
  have s5 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ∀ e,
      pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x = 0 := by
    intro j x hx hxK e
    exact pd_zero _ x (P.W j ∩ (Kc j)ᶜ) ((P.W_open j).inter (hK j).1.isClosed.isOpen_compl)
      ⟨hx, hxK⟩ (fun z hz => hρK j z hz.1 hz.2) e
  
  have s2 : ∀ j k, ∀ y ∈ P.W k, P.param k y ∉ P.O j → ∀ i,
      pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y = 0 := by
    intro j k y hy hyO i
    have hCc : IsCompact (P.param j '' Kc j) :=
      (hK j).1.image_of_continuousOn ((P.param_cont j).mono (hK j).2)
    have hCO : P.param j '' Kc j ⊆ P.O j := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact memO j x ((hK j).2 hx)
    refine pd_zero _ y (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' (P.param j '' Kc j)ᶜ)
      ((P.param_cont k).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open k) hCc.isClosed.isOpen_compl)
      ⟨hy, fun h => hyO (hCO h)⟩ ?_ i
    intro z hz
    by_cases hzO : P.param k z ∈ P.O j
    · have h2 : P.param k z ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
        rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hzO, memS k z hz.1⟩
      obtain ⟨x', hx', hx'z⟩ := h2
      have hx'K : x' ∉ Kc j := fun h => hz.2 ⟨x', h, hx'z⟩
      show ρ j (P.param k z) = 0
      rw [← hx'z]
      exact hρK j x' hx' hx'K
    · exact hρO j _ hzO
  
  have s3 : ∀ k, ∀ y ∈ P.W k, ∀ i, ∑ j, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y = 0 := by
    intro k y hy i
    have hd : ∀ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.n)),
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y :=
      fun j _ => ((hρs j k).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        ((P.W_open k).mem_nhds hy)
    have hsum := fderiv_fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun j y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) hd
    have h0 : fderiv ℝ (fun y' => ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k y')) y = 0 := by
      have hev : (fun y' => ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k y')) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem ((P.W_open k).mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hρ1 _ (memS k z hz))
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have he : ∑ j, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y =
        (∑ j, fderiv ℝ (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y) (e2 i) := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
      rfl
    rw [he, ← hsum, h0]
    simp
  
  have hexp : ∀ (L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E2), L v = ∑ i : Fin 2, v i * L (e2 i) := by
    intro L v
    have hv : v = ∑ i : Fin 2, v i • e2 i := by
      ext m
      fin_cases m <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have s1 : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x * Wv j x e =
        ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
          Wv k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) i := by
    intro j k x hx
    obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := hH3 j k x hx
    have hev : (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) ∘ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hAopen j k).mem_nhds hx) (fun z hz => by
        show ρ j (P.param j z) = ρ j (P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j z)))
        rw [(hH3 j k z hz).2])
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) :=
      ((hρs j k).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt ((P.W_open k).mem_nhds h1)
    have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x :=
      ((P.trans_smooth j k).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        ((hAopen j k).mem_nhds hx)
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x =
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x) := by
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_comp x hφd hτd
    have hpd : ∀ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x =
        ∑ i : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 e) i *
          pd2 i (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) := by
      intro e
      show fderiv ℝ (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x (e2 e) = _
      rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        hexp (fderiv ℝ (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)))]
      rfl
    simp only [hpd, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [← hWt j k x hx i, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => ?_)
    ring
  
  have s4 : ∀ j (g : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn g (P.W j) → (∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → g x = 0) →
      ∫ x in P.W j, g x = ∑ k, ∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, ρ k (P.param j x) * g x := by
    intro j g hg hg0
    have hI : ∀ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.n)),
        Integrable (fun x => ρ k (P.param j x) * g x) (volume.restrict (P.W j)) := by
      intro k _
      refine hint j _ ((hρs k j).continuousOn.mul hg) ?_
      intro x hx hxK
      rw [hg0 x hx hxK, mul_zero]
    calc ∫ x in P.W j, g x = ∫ x in P.W j, ∑ k, ρ k (P.param j x) * g x := by
          refine setIntegral_congr_fun (P.W_open j).measurableSet (fun x hx => ?_)
          show g x = ∑ k, ρ k (P.param j x) * g x
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hρ1 _ (memS j x hx), one_mul]
      _ = ∑ k, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ k (P.param j x) * g x := integral_finset_sum _ hI
      _ = _ := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
          refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (P.W_open j).measurableSet
            Set.inter_subset_left ?_
          intro x hx
          have hxO : P.param j x ∉ P.O k := fun h => hx.2 ⟨hx.1, h⟩
          show ρ k (P.param j x) * g x = 0
          rw [hρO k _ hxO, zero_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : Fin P.n → Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, ∀ j k y, G j k y =
      ρ k (P.param k y) * ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y * Wv k y i :=
    ⟨fun j k y => ρ k (P.param k y) * ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y *
      Wv k y i, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hstep : ∀ j, ∑ e : Fin 2, ∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
      (Real.sqrt (hm j x).det * Wv j x e) =
      ∑ k, ∫ y in P.W k, G j k y * Real.sqrt (hm k y).det := by
    intro j
    have hfc : ∀ e, ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
        (Real.sqrt (hm j x).det * Wv j x e)) (P.W j) :=
      fun e => (pd_cont _ _ (P.W_open j) (hρs j j) e).mul ((hmc j).mul (hWc j e))
    have hf0 : ∀ e, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
        (Real.sqrt (hm j x).det * Wv j x e) = 0 := by
      intro e x hx hxK
      rw [s5 j x hx hxK e, zero_mul]
    rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun e _ => hint j _ (hfc e) (hf0 e))]
    rw [s4 j _ (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun e _ => hfc e))
      (fun x hx hxK => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun e _ => hf0 e x hx hxK))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    have hpt : ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
        ρ k (P.param j x) * ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
          (Real.sqrt (hm j x).det * Wv j x e) =
        G j k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (hm j x).det := by
      intro x hx
      have h3 := s1 j k x hx
      have h2 := (hH3 j k x hx).2
      rw [hG, h2]
      have hsplit : ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
          (Real.sqrt (hm j x).det * Wv j x e) =
          Real.sqrt (hm j x).det * ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x * Wv j x e := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => by ring)
      rw [hsplit, h3]
      ring
    rw [setIntegral_congr_fun (hAopen j k).measurableSet hpt, hcov j k (G j k)]
    refine (setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (P.W_open k).measurableSet
      Set.inter_subset_left ?_).symm
    intro y hy
    have hyO : P.param k y ∉ P.O j := fun h => hy.2 ⟨hy.1, h⟩
    show G j k y * Real.sqrt (hm k y).det = 0
    rw [hG, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => by rw [s2 j k y hy.1 hyO i, zero_mul]), mul_zero,
      zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hstep j), Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k _ => ?_)
  have hGc : ∀ j, IntegrableOn (fun y => G j k y * Real.sqrt (hm k y).det) (P.W k) := by
    intro j
    have hfun : (fun y => G j k y * Real.sqrt (hm k y).det) = fun y =>
        ρ k (P.param k y) * (∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y * Wv k y i) *
          Real.sqrt (hm k y).det := by
      funext y
      rw [hG]
    rw [hfun]
    refine hint k _ (((hρs k k).continuousOn.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ =>
      (pd_cont _ _ (P.W_open k) (hρs j k) i).mul (hWc k i)))).mul (hmc k)) ?_
    intro y hy hyK
    rw [hρK k y hy hyK, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hGc j)]
  refine setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun y hy => ?_)
  show ∑ j, G j k y * Real.sqrt (hm k y).det = 0
  simp only [hG]
  calc ∑ j, ρ k (P.param k y) * (∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y * Wv k y i) *
        Real.sqrt (hm k y).det
      = ∑ i : Fin 2, (ρ k (P.param k y) * Real.sqrt (hm k y).det * Wv k y i) *
          ∑ j, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y := by
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring))
    _ = 0 := by
        simp only [s3 k y hy, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (s₁ : ℝ)
    (G : Fin P.n → E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hGs : ∀ j (a b : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G j y a b)
      {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ P.W j})
    (hGsymm : ∀ j (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G j y a b = G j y b a)
    (hGpd : ∀ j, ∀ y : E3, |y 0| < s₁ → hpProj y ∈ P.W j → (G j y).PosDef)
    (hGc : ∀ j k, ∀ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-s₁) s₁, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      G j (hpLift s x) = pullbackMetric (G k)
        (fun y => hpLift (y 0) (P.proj k (P.param j (hpProj y)))) (hpLift s x))
    (u : X → ℝ) (hu : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hus : ∀ q ∈ S, |u q| < s₁) (j k : Fin P.n) (x : E2)
    (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :
    pcrH (G j) (fun x' => u (P.param j x')) x =
      pcrH (G k) (fun x' => u (P.param k x')) (P.proj k (P.param j x))

    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (s₁ : ℝ)
    (G : Fin P.n → E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hGs : ∀ j (a b : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G j y a b)
      {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ P.W j})
    (hGsymm : ∀ j (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G j y a b = G j y b a)
    (hGpd : ∀ j, ∀ y : E3, |y 0| < s₁ → hpProj y ∈ P.W j → (G j y).PosDef)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hdec : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ d : Fin 3, v d • e d := by
    intro v
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr v]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hcompo : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z → ∀ l d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z = (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) d := by
    intro ψ z hψ l d
    have hfun : (fun v => ψ v d) = (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ ψ := by
      funext v; simp
    rw [partialDeriv, hfun, fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj d).differentiableAt hψ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp
  have dmul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z → DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => f w * g w) z := fun f g z hf hg => hf.mul hg
  have pd_mul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => f w * g w) z = partialDeriv l f z * g z + f z * partialDeriv l g z := by
    intro f g z l hf hg
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_mul hf hg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have pd_sum : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f a) z) →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, f a w) z = ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv l (f a) z := by
    intro f z l hf
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_sum (fun a _ => hf a), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have pd_comp : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ψ z) → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d F (ψ z) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z := by
    intro F ψ z hψ hF l
    have h1 : partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z = fderiv ℝ F (ψ z) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (F ∘ ψ) z (e l) = _
      rw [fderiv_comp z hF hψ]
      rfl
    rw [h1, hdec (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)), map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcompo ψ z hψ]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d _
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  have hpdU : ∀ (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ i,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) U := by
    intro U hU f hf i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) U := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have pullback_partialDeriv : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U V : Set E3),
      IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → (∀ z ∈ U, ψ z ∈ V) →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) V) → ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ l i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv l (partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a)) z * G (ψ z) a b *
              partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z +
            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z *
              (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d (fun y => G y a b) (ψ z) *
                partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z) * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z +
            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z * G (ψ z) a b *
              partialDeriv l (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b)) z) := by
    intro ψ G U V hU hV hψ hmaps hG z hz l i j
    have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z :=
      (hψ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hJd : ∀ a k : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v a)) z := by
      intro a k
      exact ((hpdU U hU _ (contDiffOn_euclidean.mp hψ a) k).contDiffAt
        (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hGd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) (ψ z) := fun a b =>
      ((hG a b).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hmaps z hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hGψd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G (ψ w) a b) z :=
      fun a b => (hGd a b).comp z hψd
    have htd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w *
        G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z :=
      fun a b => dmul _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b)) (hJd b j)
    rw [pd_sum _ _ _ (fun a => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => htd a b))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [pd_sum _ _ _ (fun b => htd a b)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    rw [pd_mul _ _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b)) (hJd b j),
      pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b), pd_comp (fun y => G y a b) ψ z hψd (hGd a b) l]
    ring
  
  have christoffel_pullback_algebra : ∀ (A G Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (dG H dGt : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      A.det ≠ 0 → G.det ≠ 0 → (∀ a b, G a b = G b a) → (∀ c i j, H c i j = H c j i) →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * G a b * A b j) →
      (∀ l i j, dGt l i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (H a l i * G a b * A b j + A a i * (∑ d : Fin 3, dG d a b * A d l) * A b j
          + A a i * G a b * H b l j)) →
      ∀ c i j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ k l *
          (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c l *
          (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) * A a i * A b j + H c i j := by
    intro A G Gt dG H dGt hA hG hGs hH hGt hdGt c i j
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGu : IsUnit G.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hG
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * G * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGiG : G⁻¹ * G = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul G hGu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hα : A * Gt⁻¹ = G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAB, Matrix.one_mul]
    have hα' : ∀ l, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Gt⁻¹ k l = ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * A⁻¹ l b := by
      intro l
      have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hα c) l
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h1
      exact h1
    have hβ : ∀ l, dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j = ∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l *
        (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β)
          + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j) := by
      intro l
      rw [hdGt, hdGt, hdGt]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hH _ j i, hH _ l i, hH _ l j]
      simp only [hGs 1 0, hGs 2 0, hGs 2 1]
      ring
    have eAB : ∀ γ b : Fin 3, A γ 0 * A⁻¹ 0 b + A γ 1 * A⁻¹ 1 b + A γ 2 * A⁻¹ 2 b
        = if γ = b then 1 else 0 := by
      intro γ b
      rw [← Matrix.one_apply, ← hAB, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hcontr : ∀ (u W : Fin 3 → ℝ), ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, u b * A⁻¹ l b) *
        (∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l * W γ) = ∑ b : Fin 3, u b * W b := by
      intro u W
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination
        (u 0 * W 0) * (eAB 0 0).trans (if_pos rfl)
        + (u 1 * W 0) * (eAB 0 1).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 2 * W 0) * (eAB 0 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 0 * W 1) * (eAB 1 0).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 1 * W 1) * (eAB 1 1).trans (if_pos rfl)
        + (u 2 * W 1) * (eAB 1 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 0 * W 2) * (eAB 2 0).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 1 * W 2) * (eAB 2 1).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 2 * W 2) * (eAB 2 2).trans (if_pos rfl)
    have hGG : ∑ a : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * G a b) * H a i j = H c i j := by
      have h2 : ∀ a, ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * G a b = (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) c a := by
        intro a
        rw [← hGiG, Matrix.mul_apply]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => by rw [hGs a b])
      simp only [h2, Matrix.one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
        Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    calc ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ k l *
            (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j))
        = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Gt⁻¹ k l) *
            (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j) := by
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * A⁻¹ l b) * (∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l *
            (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β)
              + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j)) := by
          simp only [hα', hβ]
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b *
            (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β b + dG β α b - dG b α β)
              + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a b * H a i j) := by
          rw [hcontr (fun b => G⁻¹ c b) (fun γ => ∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3,
            A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β) + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j)]
      _ = _ := by
          rw [← hGG]
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
  
  have hbr_alg : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (Γt Γ H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P : Fin 3 → ℝ) (Q : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ c i j, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Γt k i j =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b * A a i * A b j + H c i j) →
      ∀ i j, ((∑ d : Fin 3, (∑ e : Fin 3, Q e d * A e i) * A d j
          + ∑ d : Fin 3, P d * H d i j)
            - ∑ k : Fin 3, Γt k i j * (∑ d : Fin 3, P d * A d k)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * A b j * (Q a b - ∑ k : Fin 3, Γ k a b * P k) := by
    intro A Γt Γ H P Q hT1 i j
    have h0 := hT1 0 i j
    have h1 := hT1 1 i j
    have h2 := hT1 2 i j
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0 h1 h2 ⊢
    linear_combination (-(P 0)) * h0 + (-(P 1)) * h1 + (-(P 2)) * h2
  
  have lmc_alg : ∀ (A Gm Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P Pt : Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (H Ht : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ), A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * Gm a b * A b j) →
      (∀ i, Pt i = ∑ a : Fin 3, P a * A a i) →
      (∀ i j, Ht i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * A b j * H a b) →
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ i j * Pt i * Pt j =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * P i * P j) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ i j * Ht i j =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * H i j) ∧
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          Gt⁻¹ i a * Pt a * (Gt⁻¹ j b * Pt b) * Ht i j =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          Gm⁻¹ i a * P a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * P b) * H i j) := by
    intro A Gm Gt P Pt H Ht hA hGt hPt hHt
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * Gm * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hM : A * Gt⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A = Gm⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv]
      calc A * (A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹) * Matrix.transpose A
          = (A * A⁻¹) * Gm⁻¹ * (Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A) := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = Gm⁻¹ := by
            rw [hAB, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, hAB, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul,
              Matrix.mul_one]
    have hM' : ∀ a b, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A a i * Gt⁻¹ i j * A b j = Gm⁻¹ a b := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hM]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [hPt, ← hM']
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    · simp only [hHt, ← hM']
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    · obtain ⟨νt, hνt⟩ : ∃ νt : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i, νt i = ∑ a : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ i a * Pt a :=
        ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ : ∃ ν : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ d, ν d = ∑ a : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ d a * P a :=
        ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
      have K : ∀ d, ∑ i : Fin 3, A d i * νt i = ν d := by
        intro d
        simp only [hν, hνt, hPt, ← hM']
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      calc ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            Gt⁻¹ i a * Pt a * (Gt⁻¹ j b * Pt b) * Ht i j
          = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, νt i * νt j * Ht i j := by
            simp only [hνt, Fin.sum_univ_three]
            ring
        _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, νt i * νt j *
              (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * A b j * H a b) := by
            simp only [hHt]
        _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
              (∑ i : Fin 3, A a i * νt i) * (∑ j : Fin 3, A b j * νt j) * H a b := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
            ring
        _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ν a * ν b * H a b := by
            simp only [K]
        _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
              Gm⁻¹ i a * P a * (Gm⁻¹ j b * P b) * H i j := by
            simp only [hν, Fin.sum_univ_three]
            ring
  
  have partialDeriv_comm : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) z = partialDeriv j (partialDeriv i f) z := by
    intro f U hU hf z hz i j
    have hfz : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f z := hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
    have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f z :=
      hfz.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simpa using (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞))
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z :=
      (hfz.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by
        rw [one_add_one_eq_two]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have key2 : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b f) z = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z (e a) (e b) := by
      intro a b
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e b)) z (e a) = _
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const _)]
      simp
    rw [key2, key2, hsymm]
  
  have lmc_congr : ∀ (G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u v : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      G =ᶠ[𝓝 y] G' → u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] v → levelMeanCurvCoord G u y = levelMeanCurvCoord G' v y := by
    intro G G' u v y hG huv
    have hy0 : G y = G' y := hG.eq_of_nhds
    have hent : ∀ a b i, partialDeriv i (fun z => G z a b) y
        = partialDeriv i (fun z => G' z a b) y := by
      intro a b i
      have : (fun z => G z a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => G' z a b) :=
        hG.mono (fun z hz => by simp [hz])
      simp only [partialDeriv, this.fderiv_eq]
    have hchr : ∀ k i j, christoffel G k i j y = christoffel G' k i j y := by
      intro k i j
      simp only [christoffel, hy0, hent]
    have h1 : ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l u y = partialDeriv l v y := by
      intro l
      show fderiv ℝ u y (e l) = fderiv ℝ v y (e l)
      rw [huv.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ i l : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv l u) y =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv l v) y := by
      intro i l
      have hev : (partialDeriv l u) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (partialDeriv l v) := by
        filter_upwards [huv.eventuallyEq_nhds] with z hz
        show fderiv ℝ u z (e l) = fderiv ℝ v z (e l)
        rw [hz.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv l u) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv l v) y (e i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hH : ∀ i j, hessLoc G u i j y = hessLoc G' v i j y := by
      intro i j
      simp only [hessLoc, hchr, h1, h2]
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, lapLoc, hy0, hH, h1]
  
  
  have key : ∀ (x : E3) (ψ : E3 → E3) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ)
      (U V : Set E3),
      IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → (∀ z ∈ U, ψ z ∈ V) →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) V) →
      (∀ y a b, G y a b = G y b a) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u V → x ∈ U →
      (G (ψ x)).det ≠ 0 →
      (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => ψ w a) x).det ≠ 0 →
      levelMeanCurvCoord (fun w => Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w)
          (fun w => u (ψ w)) x
        = levelMeanCurvCoord G u (ψ x) := by
    intro x ψ G u U V hUo hVo hψ hmaps hG hGsym huV hxU hdetG hdetJ
    have hψc : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v => ψ v a) U := fun a =>
      contDiffOn_euclidean.mp hψ a
    set Gt : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := fun w => Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 3 =>
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w
      with hGt
    have hH : ∀ c i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) x
        = partialDeriv j (partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v c)) x :=
      fun c i j => partialDeriv_comm _ U hUo (hψc c) x hxU i j
    have hT1 : ∀ c i j : Fin 3,
        ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) x * christoffel Gt k i j x
          = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, christoffel G c a b (ψ x) * partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) x *
            partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) x + partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) x := by
      intro c i j
      have h8 := pullback_partialDeriv ψ G U V hUo hVo hψ hmaps hG x hxU
      have h9 := christoffel_pullback_algebra
        (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => ψ w a) x) (G (ψ x)) (Gt x)
        (fun d a b => partialDeriv d (fun y => G y a b) (ψ x))
        (fun c i j => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) x)
        (fun l i j => partialDeriv l (fun w => Gt w i j) x)
        hdetJ hdetG (fun a b => hGsym _ a b)
        (fun c i j => hH c i j) (fun i j => rfl) (fun l i j => h8 l i j) c i j
      exact h9
    have hψd : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z := fun z hz =>
      (hψ.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hud : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ u (ψ z) := fun z hz =>
      (huV.contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds (hmaps z hz))).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have h7a : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w => u (ψ w)) x
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d u (ψ x) * partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v d) x :=
      fun k => pd_comp u ψ x (hψd x hxU) (hud x hxU) k
    have hJd : ∀ a k : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v a)) x := by
      intro a k
      exact ((hpdU U hUo _ (hψc a) k).contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hxU)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hPd : ∀ d : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv d u) (ψ x) := by
      intro d
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y) V :=
        huV.fderiv_of_isOpen hVo (by norm_num)
      have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (partialDeriv d u) V := h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      exact (h2.contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds (hmaps x hxU))).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hPψd : ∀ d : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv d u (ψ y)) x := fun d =>
      (hPd d).comp x (hψd x hxU)
    have h7b : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun w => u (ψ w))) x
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, (∑ e : Fin 3, partialDeriv e (partialDeriv d u) (ψ x) *
            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v e) x) * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v d) x
          + ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d u (ψ x) * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v d)) x := by
      intro i j
      have hev : (partialDeriv j (fun w => u (ψ w))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          (fun y => ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d u (ψ y) * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v d) y) := by
        filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds hxU] with y hy
        exact pd_comp u ψ y (hψd y hy) (hud y hy) j
      have e1 : partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun w => u (ψ w))) x
          = partialDeriv i (fun y => ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d u (ψ y) *
              partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v d) y) x :=
        congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e i)) hev.fderiv_eq
      rw [e1, pd_sum _ _ _ (fun d => dmul _ _ _ (hPψd d) (hJd d j)), ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d _
      rw [pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hPψd d) (hJd d j),
        pd_comp (partialDeriv d u) ψ x (hψd x hxU) (hPd d) i]
    have hHt : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc Gt (fun w => u (ψ w)) i j x =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => ψ w a) x *
          partialDeriv j (fun w => ψ w b) x * hessLoc G u a b (ψ x) := by
      intro i j
      have hb := hbr_alg (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => ψ w a) x)
        (fun k i j => christoffel Gt k i j x) (fun c a b => christoffel G c a b (ψ x))
        (fun c i j => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) x)
        (fun d => partialDeriv d u (ψ x))
        (fun e d => partialDeriv e (partialDeriv d u) (ψ x)) hT1 i j
      show partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun w => u (ψ w))) x
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel Gt k i j x * partialDeriv k (fun w => u (ψ w)) x = _
      rw [h7b i j]
      simp only [h7a]
      exact hb
    have hall := lmc_alg (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => ψ w a) x)
      (G (ψ x)) (Gt x) (fun a => partialDeriv a u (ψ x))
      (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun w => u (ψ w)) x)
      (fun a b => hessLoc G u a b (ψ x)) (fun i j => hessLoc Gt (fun w => u (ψ w)) i j x)
      hdetJ (fun i j => rfl) h7a hHt
    have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (Gt x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun w => u (ψ w)) x *
          partialDeriv j (fun w => u (ψ w)) x =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (ψ x))⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i u (ψ x) *
          partialDeriv j u (ψ x) := hall.1
    have e2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (Gt x)⁻¹ i j * hessLoc Gt (fun w => u (ψ w)) i j x =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (ψ x))⁻¹ i j * hessLoc G u i j (ψ x) := hall.2.1
    have e3 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (Gt x)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a (fun w => u (ψ w)) x *
            ((Gt x)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b (fun w => u (ψ w)) x) *
            hessLoc Gt (fun w => u (ψ w)) i j x =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G (ψ x))⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a u (ψ x) * ((G (ψ x))⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b u (ψ x)) *
            hessLoc G u i j (ψ x) := hall.2.2
    unfold levelMeanCurvCoord lapLoc
    rw [e1, e2, e3]
  
  have hlift_proj : ∀ y : E3, hpLift (y 0) (hpProj y) = y := by
    intro y
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hpLift, cylPt, hpProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hproj_lift : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x' : E2), hpProj (hpLift t x') = x' := by
    intro t x'
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hpLift, cylPt, hpProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hlift0 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x' : E2), (hpLift t x') 0 = t := by
    intro t x'
    simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hc0 : ∀ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (i : Fin 3), ContDiff ℝ n (fun y : E3 => y i) := fun n i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hc2 : ∀ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (i : Fin 2), ContDiff ℝ n (fun y : E2 => y i) := fun n i =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
  have hprojCD : ∀ n : WithTop ℕ∞, ContDiff ℝ n hpProj := by
    intro n
    have hfun : hpProj = fun z : E3 => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![z 1, z 2] := rfl
    rw [hfun]
    refine (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp ?_
    refine contDiff_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using hc0 n 1
    · simpa using hc0 n 2
  have hslab_open : ∀ Ω' : Set E2, IsOpen Ω' →
      IsOpen {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ Ω'} := by
    intro Ω' hΩ'
    exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (hc0 0 0).continuous) continuous_const).inter
      (hΩ'.preimage (hprojCD 0).continuous)
  
  have hpatch : ∀ x' ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, P.param j x' ∈ S ∧
      P.proj k (P.param j x') ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x')) = P.param j x' := by
    intro x' hx'
    have h1 : P.param j x' ∈ P.O j ∩ S := by
      rw [← P.image_eq j]
      exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx'.1
    have h2 : P.param j x' ∈ P.param k '' P.W k := by
      rw [P.image_eq k]
      exact ⟨hx'.2, h1.2⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzeq⟩ := h2
    have h3 : P.proj k (P.param j x') = z := by
      rw [← hzeq]
      exact P.proj_param k z hz
    refine ⟨h1.2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h3]; exact hz
    · rw [h3]; exact hzeq
  have hΩo : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)
  
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : E3 → E3,
      T = fun y => hpLift (y 0) (P.proj k (P.param j (hpProj y))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hTapp : ∀ y, T y = hpLift (y 0) (P.proj k (P.param j (hpProj y))) := by
    intro y
    rw [hT]
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Set E3,
      U = {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : Set E3, V = {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ P.W k} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemU : ∀ y : E3, y ∈ U ↔ |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k := by
    intro y
    subst hU
    exact Iff.rfl
  have hmemV : ∀ y : E3, y ∈ V ↔ |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ P.W k := by
    intro y
    subst hV
    exact Iff.rfl
  have hUo : IsOpen U := by
    subst hU
    exact hslab_open _ hΩo
  have hVo : IsOpen V := by
    subst hV
    exact hslab_open _ (P.W_open k)
  have hGsV : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G k y a b) V := by
    subst hV
    exact hGs k
  have hτcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => P.proj k (P.param j (hpProj y))) U := by
    subst hU
    exact (P.trans_smooth j k).comp (hprojCD ∞).contDiffOn (fun y hy => hy.2)
  have hTcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ T U := by
    rw [hT]
    exact (((hc0 ∞ 0).contDiffOn.smul contDiffOn_const).add
      (((hc2 ∞ 0).comp_contDiffOn hτcd).smul contDiffOn_const)).add
      (((hc2 ∞ 1).comp_contDiffOn hτcd).smul contDiffOn_const)
  have hTUV : ∀ y ∈ U, T y ∈ V := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' := (hmemU y).mp hy
    rw [hmemV, hTapp, hlift0, hproj_lift]
    exact ⟨hy'.1, (hpatch _ hy'.2).2.1⟩
  have hfk : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun y : E3 => y 0 - u (P.param k (hpProj y))) V := by
    subst hV
    exact (hc0 2 0).contDiffOn.sub ((hu k).comp (hprojCD 2).contDiffOn (fun y hy => hy.2))
  have hTd : ∀ w ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ T w := fun w hw =>
    (hTcd.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hw)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ : ∃ y₀ : E3, y₀ = hpLift (u (P.param j x)) x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hy₀0 : y₀ 0 = u (P.param j x) := by rw [hy₀, hlift0]
  have hy₀p : hpProj y₀ = x := by rw [hy₀, hproj_lift]
  have hy₀1 : |y₀ 0| < s₁ := by
    rw [hy₀0]
    exact hus _ (hpatch x hx).1
  have hy₀U : y₀ ∈ U := by
    rw [hmemU, hy₀p]
    exact ⟨hy₀1, hx⟩
  have hTy₀ : T y₀ = hpLift (u (P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) := by
    rw [hTapp, hy₀0, hy₀p, (hpatch x hx).2.2]
  
  have hGev : G j =ᶠ[𝓝 y₀] (fun w => Matrix.of fun a b : Fin 3 => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (fun v => T v c) w * G k (T w) c d * partialDeriv b (fun v => T v d) w) := by
    filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds hy₀U] with w hw
    have hw' := (hmemU w).mp hw
    have h1 := hGc j k (w 0) (abs_lt.mp hw'.1) (hpProj w) hw'.2
    rw [hlift_proj] at h1
    have h1' : G j w = pullbackMetric (G k) T w := by
      rw [hT]
      exact h1
    rw [h1']
    ext a b
    simp only [pullbackMetric, Matrix.of_apply, hcompo T w (hTd w hw)]
  have hfev : (fun y : E3 => y 0 - u (P.param j (hpProj y))) =ᶠ[𝓝 y₀]
      (fun w => (fun y : E3 => y 0 - u (P.param k (hpProj y))) (T w)) := by
    filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds hy₀U] with w hw
    have hw' := (hmemU w).mp hw
    simp only [hTapp, hlift0, hproj_lift, (hpatch _ hw'.2).2.2]
  
  have hTy₀V := (hmemV _).mp (hTUV y₀ hy₀U)
  have hdetGm : (G k (T y₀)).det ≠ 0 := (hGpd k (T y₀) hTy₀V.1 hTy₀V.2).det_pos.ne'
  have hGy₀ : G j y₀ = Matrix.of fun a b : Fin 3 => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (fun v => T v c) y₀ * G k (T y₀) c d * partialDeriv b (fun v => T v d) y₀ :=
    hGev.eq_of_nhds
  have hdetJ : (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => T w a) y₀).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hGt' : (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin 3 => ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a (fun v => T v c) y₀ * G k (T y₀) c d * partialDeriv b (fun v => T v d) y₀) =
        (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => T w a) y₀).transpose * G k (T y₀) *
          (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w => T w a) y₀) := by
      ext a b
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hpos := (hGpd j y₀ hy₀1 (by rw [hy₀p]; exact hx.1)).det_pos
    rw [hGy₀, hGt', Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, h0] at hpos
    simp at hpos
  
  have hkey := key y₀ T (G k) (fun y : E3 => y 0 - u (P.param k (hpProj y))) U V hUo hVo hTcd
    hTUV hGsV (hGsymm k) hfk hy₀U hdetGm hdetJ
  have hL := lmc_congr (G j) _ _ _ y₀ hGev hfev
  show levelMeanCurvCoord (G j) (fun y => y 0 - u (P.param j (hpProj y)))
      (hpLift (u (P.param j x)) x) =
    levelMeanCurvCoord (G k) (fun y => y 0 - u (P.param k (hpProj y)))
      (hpLift (u (P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))) (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
  rw [← hy₀, hL, ← hTy₀]
  exact hkey

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (s₁ : ℝ)
    (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b)
      {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W})
    (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G y a b = G y b a)
    (hGpd : ∀ y : E3, |y 0| < s₁ → hpProj y ∈ W → (G y).PosDef) :
    ∃ Ψ : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ {z | z.1 ∈ W ∧ |z.2.1| < s₁} ∧
      (∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), x ∈ W → |w x| < s₁ → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x →
        pcrH G w x = Ψ (x, w x, fderiv ℝ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x)) ∧
      (∀ (w p : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), x ∈ W → |w x| < s₁ → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x →
        ContDiffAt ℝ 2 p x →
        HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => pcrH G (fun x' => w x' + ε * p x') x)
          (fderiv ℝ Ψ (x, w x, fderiv ℝ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x)
            (0, p x, fderiv ℝ p x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ p) x)) 0)

(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (s₁ : ℝ)
    (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b)

    (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G y a b = G y b a)
