proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hP1 : ∀ y : E3, hpProj y 0 = y 1 := by
    intro y; simp [hpProj]
  have hP2 : ∀ y : E3, hpProj y 1 = y 2 := by
    intro y; simp [hpProj]
  have hL0 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), (hpLift t x) 0 = t := by
    intro t x; simp [hpLift, cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hL1 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), (hpLift t x) 1 = x 0 := by
    intro t x; simp [hpLift, cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hL2 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), (hpLift t x) 2 = x 1 := by
    intro t x; simp [hpLift, cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hLP : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), hpProj (hpLift t x) = x := by
    intro t x; ext k; fin_cases k
    · simp [hP1, hL1]
    · simp [hP2, hL2]
  have hP0 : hpProj (e 0) = 0 := by
    ext k; fin_cases k
    · simp [hP1, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    · simp [hP2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  let Pl : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E2 :=
    { toFun := hpProj
      map_add' := by
        intro y y'; ext k; fin_cases k
        · simp [hP1]
        · simp [hP2]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c y; ext k; fin_cases k
        · simp [hP1]
        · simp [hP2] }
  let P : E3 →L[ℝ] E2 := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap Pl
  have hP : ∀ y, P y = hpProj y := fun y => rfl
  have hPf : hpProj = ⇑P := funext fun y => (hP y).symm
  let Ll : ℝ × E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E3 :=
    { toFun := fun p => hpLift p.1 p.2
      map_add' := by
        intro p p'; ext k; fin_cases k
        · simp [hL0]
        · simp [hL1]
        · simp [hL2]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c p; ext k; fin_cases k
        · simp [hL0]
        · simp [hL1]
        · simp [hL2] }
  let L : ℝ × E2 →L[ℝ] E3 := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap Ll
  have hL : ∀ t x, L (t, x) = hpLift t x := fun t x => rfl
  let π0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3)
  have hπ0 : ∀ y : E3, π0 y = y 0 := fun y => rfl
  
  
  
  set Sl : Set E3 := {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W} with hSl
  have hSlo : IsOpen Sl := by
    have hcP : Continuous hpProj := by rw [hPf]; exact P.continuous
    exact IsOpen.and (isOpen_lt π0.continuous.abs continuous_const) (hW.preimage hcP)
  set S' : Set (E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) :=
    {z | z.1 ∈ W ∧ |z.2.1| < s₁} with hS'
  have hS'o : IsOpen S' :=
    IsOpen.and (hW.preimage continuous_fst) (isOpen_lt continuous_snd.fst.abs continuous_const)
  
  
  
  have hdet : ∀ M : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => M y a b) Sl) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (M y).det) Sl := by
    intro M hM
    simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
    have h00 := hM 0 0; have h01 := hM 0 1; have h02 := hM 0 2
    have h10 := hM 1 0; have h11 := hM 1 1; have h12 := hM 1 2
    have h20 := hM 2 0; have h21 := hM 2 1; have h22 := hM 2 2
    fun_prop
  have hGpd' : ∀ y ∈ Sl, (G y).PosDef := fun y hy => hGpd y hy.1 hy.2
  have hinv : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) Sl := by
    intro a b
    have hadj : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).adjugate a b) Sl := by
      simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
      apply hdet
      intro c d
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_apply]
      split_ifs
      · exact contDiffOn_const
      · exact hGs c d
    have hd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹) Sl :=
      (hdet G hGs).inv fun y hy => ((hGpd' y hy).det_pos).ne'
    have heq : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) = fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate a b := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact hd.mul hadj
  have hpd : ∀ a b c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b)) Sl := by
    intro a b c
    have h1 := (hGs a b).fderiv_of_isOpen hSlo (m := ∞) (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) Sl := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    apply ContDiffOn.mul contDiffOn_const
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro l _
    exact (hinv k l).mul (((hpd j l i).add (hpd i l j)).sub (hpd i j l))
  have hpos : ∀ y ∈ Sl, ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j := by
    intro y hy v hv
    have h := (hGpd' y hy).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum] at h
    convert h using 2 with i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  
  
  
  have hgraph : ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2) (t : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => y 0 - w (hpProj y)) (hpLift t x) =
          (e i) 0 - fderiv ℝ w x (hpProj (e i))) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => y 0 - w (hpProj y))) (hpLift t x) =
          -(fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x (hpProj (e i)) (hpProj (e j)))) := by
    intro w x t hw
    have hPx : P (hpLift t x) = x := by rw [hP, hLP]
    have hev : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x' := hw.eventually (by decide)
    have hev' : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (hpLift t x), DifferentiableAt ℝ w (P y) := by
      have hT : Tendsto P (𝓝 (hpLift t x)) (𝓝 x) := by
        have := P.continuous.tendsto (hpLift t x)
        rwa [hPx] at this
      exact (hT.eventually hev).mono fun y hy => hy.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hderiv : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ w (P y) → ∀ j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv j (fun y => y 0 - w (hpProj y)) y = (e j) 0 - fderiv ℝ w (P y) (P (e j)) := by
      intro y hy j
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y 0 - w (hpProj y))
          (π0 - (fderiv ℝ w (P y)).comp P) y := by
        rw [hPf]
        exact π0.hasFDerivAt.sub (hy.hasFDerivAt.comp y P.hasFDerivAt)
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [h1.fderiv]
      simp [hπ0]
    have hx2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x :=
      (hw.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩
    · rw [hderiv _ (hev'.self_of_nhds) i, hPx, hP]
    · have heq : partialDeriv j (fun y => y 0 - w (hpProj y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (hpLift t x)]
          fun y => (e j) 0 - fderiv ℝ w (P y) (P (e j)) :=
        hev'.mono fun y hy => hderiv y hy j
      have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ w (P y))
          ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x).comp P) (hpLift t x) := by
        have := hx2.hasFDerivAt
        rw [← hPx] at this
        have h2 := this.comp (hpLift t x) P.hasFDerivAt
        rw [hPx] at h2
        exact h2
      have hB : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (e j) 0 - fderiv ℝ w (P y) (P (e j)))
          (-(((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x).comp P).flip (P (e j)))) (hpLift t x) := by
        have h3 := hA.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (P (e j)) (hpLift t x))
        have h4 := h3.const_sub ((e j) 0)
        convert h4 using 1
        ext v
        simp
      change fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (fun y => y 0 - w (hpProj y))) (hpLift t x) (e i) = _
      rw [heq.fderiv_eq, hB.fderiv]
      simp [hP]
  
  
  
  have hjet : ∀ (w p : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 p x → ∀ ε : ℝ,
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x' => w x' + ε * p x') x ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fun x' => w x' + ε * p x') x = fderiv ℝ w x + ε • fderiv ℝ p x ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => w x' + ε * p x')) x =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x + ε • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ p) x := by
    intro w p x hw hp ε
    have hev : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => w x' + ε * p x') x' =
        fderiv ℝ w x' + ε • fderiv ℝ p x' := by
      filter_upwards [hw.eventually (by decide), hp.eventually (by decide)] with x' hw' hp'
      exact ((hw'.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt.add
        ((hp'.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt.const_mul ε)).fderiv
    have hw2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x :=
      (hw.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hp2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ p) x :=
      (hp.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    refine ⟨hw.add (contDiffAt_const.mul hp), hev.self_of_nhds, ?_⟩
    have hev2 : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => w x' + ε * p x') =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun x' => fderiv ℝ w x' + ε • fderiv ℝ p x' := hev
    rw [hev2.fderiv_eq]
    exact (hw2.hasFDerivAt.add (hp2.hasFDerivAt.const_smul ε)).fderiv
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → ℝ,
      Ψ = fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ i j *
            (-(q.2.2.2 (hpProj (e i)) (hpProj (e j))) -
              ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j (hpLift q.2.1 q.1) *
                ((e k) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e k))))) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ i j *
            ((e i) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e i))) * ((e j) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e j)))) -
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            (G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ i a * ((e a) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e a))) *
              ((G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ j b * ((e b) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e b)))) *
              (-(q.2.2.2 (hpProj (e i)) (hpProj (e j))) -
                ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j (hpLift q.2.1 q.1) *
                  ((e k) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e k))))) /
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ i j *
            ((e i) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e i))) * ((e j) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e j)))) ^ 3 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  
  
  have hB : ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x →
      pcrH G w x = Ψ (x, w x, fderiv ℝ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x) := by
    intro w x hw
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hgraph w x (w x) hw
    rw [hΨ]
    unfold pcrH levelMeanCurvCoord lapLoc hessLoc
    simp only [h1, h2]
  
  
  
  have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ S' := by
    have hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
        hpLift q.2.1 q.1) := by
      have : (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) => hpLift q.2.1 q.1) =
          fun q => L (q.2.1, q.1) := rfl
      rw [this]
      exact L.contDiff.comp (contDiff_snd.fst.prodMk contDiff_fst)
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
        hpLift q.2.1 q.1) S' Sl := by
      intro q hq
      exact ⟨by rw [hL0]; exact hq.2, by rw [hLP]; exact hq.1⟩
    have hGi : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
          (G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ a b) S' :=
      fun a b => (hinv a b).comp hY.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hCh : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
          christoffel G k i j (hpLift q.2.1 q.1)) S' :=
      fun k i j => (hchr k i j).comp hY.contDiffOn hmaps
    have hDF : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
          (e k) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e k))) S' := by
      intro k
      exact contDiffOn_const.sub ((contDiff_snd.snd.fst.clm_apply contDiff_const).contDiffOn)
    have hD2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
          -(q.2.2.2 (hpProj (e i)) (hpProj (e j)))) S' := by
      intro i j
      exact (((contDiff_snd.snd.snd.clm_apply contDiff_const).clm_apply
        contDiff_const).neg).contDiffOn
    have hHS : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
          -(q.2.2.2 (hpProj (e i)) (hpProj (e j))) -
            ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j (hpLift q.2.1 q.1) *
              ((e k) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e k)))) S' :=
      fun i j => (hD2 i j).sub (ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hCh k i j).mul (hDF k))
    have hrad : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ i j *
            ((e i) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e i))) * ((e j) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e j)))) S' :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ((hGi i j).mul (hDF i)).mul (hDF j)
    have hradpos : ∀ q ∈ S', 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ i j *
        ((e i) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e i))) * ((e j) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e j))) := by
      intro q hq
      have hv : (fun k : Fin 3 => (e k) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e k))) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        have := congrFun h 0
        simp [hP0] at this
      exact hpos _ (hmaps hq) _ hv
    have hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
          Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ i j *
            ((e i) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e i))) * ((e j) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e j))))) S' :=
      hrad.sqrt fun q hq => (hradpos q hq).ne'
    have hNne : ∀ q ∈ S', Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ i j *
        ((e i) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e i))) * ((e j) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e j)))) ≠ 0 :=
      fun q hq => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hradpos q hq)).ne'
    have hnum1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ i j *
            (-(q.2.2.2 (hpProj (e i)) (hpProj (e j))) -
              ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j (hpLift q.2.1 q.1) *
                ((e k) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e k))))) S' :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => (hGi i j).mul (hHS i j)
    have hnum2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun q : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =>
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            (G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ i a * ((e a) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e a))) *
              ((G (hpLift q.2.1 q.1))⁻¹ j b * ((e b) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e b)))) *
              (-(q.2.2.2 (hpProj (e i)) (hpProj (e j))) -
                ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j (hpLift q.2.1 q.1) *
                  ((e k) 0 - q.2.2.1 (hpProj (e k))))) S' :=
      ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ =>
        ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ =>
          (((hGi i a).mul (hDF a)).mul ((hGi j b).mul (hDF b))).mul (hHS i j)
    rw [hΨ]
    exact (hnum1.div hN hNne).sub (hnum2.div (hN.pow 3) fun q hq => pow_ne_zero 3 (hNne q hq))
  
  
  
  have hC : ∀ (w p : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), x ∈ W → |w x| < s₁ → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 p x →
      HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => pcrH G (fun x' => w x' + ε * p x') x)
        (fderiv ℝ Ψ (x, w x, fderiv ℝ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x)
          (0, p x, fderiv ℝ p x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ p) x)) 0 := by
    intro w p x hx hwx hw hp
    have hJ : (x, w x, fderiv ℝ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x) ∈ S' := ⟨hx, hwx⟩
    have hd0 := ((hA.contDiffAt (hS'o.mem_nhds hJ)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hfun : (fun ε : ℝ => pcrH G (fun x' => w x' + ε * p x') x) =
        fun ε : ℝ => Ψ (x, w x + ε * p x, fderiv ℝ w x + ε • fderiv ℝ p x,
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x + ε • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ p) x) := by
      funext ε
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hjet w p x hw hp ε
      rw [hB _ x h1, h2, h3]
    have hγ := ((hasDerivAt_id' (x := (0 : ℝ))).smul_const
        ((0 : E2), p x, fderiv ℝ p x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ p) x)).const_add
        (x, w x, fderiv ℝ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x)
    have hc := hd0.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0 : ℝ) hγ (by simp)
    rw [hfun]
    convert hc using 1
    · funext ε
      simp
    · simp
  exact ⟨Ψ, hA, fun w x _ _ hw => hB w x hw, hC⟩

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (hSc : IsCompact S) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (s₁ : ℝ) (hs₁ : 0 < s₁)
    (Ψ : Fin P.n → E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hΨ : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Ψ j) {z | z.1 ∈ P.W j ∧ |z.2.1| < s₁})
    (hcompat : ∀ u : X → ℝ, pcrClass P α 2 u → (∀ q ∈ S, |u q| < s₁) →
      ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
        Ψ j (x, u (P.param j x), fderiv ℝ (fun x' => u (P.param j x')) x,
            fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => u (P.param j x'))) x) =
          Ψ k (P.proj k (P.param j x), u (P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x))),
            fderiv ℝ (fun x' => u (P.param k x')) (P.proj k (P.param j x)),
            fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => u (P.param k x'))) (P.proj k (P.param j x)))) :
    ∃ (B : BanachScale) (evE : ∀ k, B.E k →ₗ[ℝ] (X → ℝ)) (evF : ∀ k, B.F k →ₗ[ℝ] (X → ℝ))
      (Hop : ∀ k, B.E k → B.F k) (r C : ℝ),
      0 < r ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      (∀ k, Function.Injective (evE k)) ∧ (∀ k, Function.Injective (evF k)) ∧
      (∀ k (u : X → ℝ), (∃ v, evE k v = u) ↔ pcrClass P α (k + 2) u) ∧
      (∀ k (f : X → ℝ), (∃ g, evF k g = f) ↔ pcrClass P α k f) ∧
      (∀ k v, evE 0 (B.ιE k v) = evE k v) ∧ (∀ k g, evF 0 (B.ιF k g) = evF k g) ∧
      (∀ v, B.ιE 0 v = v) ∧
      (∀ v q, q ∈ S → |evE 0 v q| ≤ C * ‖v‖) ∧
      (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Hop k) {v | ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r}) ∧
      (∀ k v, B.ιF k (Hop k v) = Hop 0 (B.ιE k v)) ∧
      (∀ v : B.E 0, ‖v‖ < r → (∀ q ∈ S, |evE 0 v q| < s₁) ∧
        ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
          evF 0 (Hop 0 v) (P.param j x) =
            Ψ j (x, evE 0 v (P.param j x), fderiv ℝ (fun x' => evE 0 v (P.param j x')) x,
              fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => evE 0 v (P.param j x'))) x) ∧
          ∀ p : B.E 0, evF 0 (fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) v p) (P.param j x) =
            fderiv ℝ (Ψ j) (x, evE 0 v (P.param j x),
                fderiv ℝ (fun x' => evE 0 v (P.param j x')) x,
                fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => evE 0 v (P.param j x'))) x)
              (0, evE 0 p (P.param j x), fderiv ℝ (fun x' => evE 0 p (P.param j x')) x,
                fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => evE 0 p (P.param j x'))) x)) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (I : Set ℝ), IsOpen I → ∀ γ : ℝ → B.E k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ γ I →
        ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × E2 => evE k (γ p.1) (P.param j p.2)) (I ×ˢ P.W j))

signature.statement:

    (S : Set X) (hSc : IsCompact S) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (s₁ : ℝ) (hs₁ : 0 < s₁)
    (Ψ : Fin P.n → E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hΨ : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Ψ j) {z | z.1 ∈ P.W j ∧ |z.2.1| < s₁})

      (Hop : ∀ k, B.E k → B.F k) (r C : ℝ),

      (∀ k v, evE 0 (B.ιE k v) = evE k v) ∧ (∀ k g, evF 0 (B.ιF k g) = evF k g) ∧
      (∀ v, B.ιE 0 v = v) ∧
      (∀ v q, q ∈ S → |evE 0 v q| ≤ C * ‖v‖) ∧
      (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Hop k) {v | ‖B.ιE k v‖ < r}) ∧
      (∀ k v, B.ιF k (Hop k v) = Hop 0 (B.ιE k v)) ∧
      (∀ v : B.E 0, ‖v‖ < r → (∀ q ∈ S, |evE 0 v q| < s₁) ∧
        ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
          evF 0 (Hop 0 v) (P.param j x) =
            Ψ j (x, evE 0 v (P.param j x), fderiv ℝ (fun x' => evE 0 v (P.param j x')) x,
              fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => evE 0 v (P.param j x'))) x) ∧

              (0, evE 0 p (P.param j x), fderiv ℝ (fun x' => evE 0 p (P.param j x')) x,
                fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => evE 0 p (P.param j x'))) x)) ∧
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (I : Set ℝ), IsOpen I → ∀ γ : ℝ → B.E k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ γ I →

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Bl⟩ := pcr_balls_exist S hSc P
  
  have Pa : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ S ∧ P.param j x ∈ P.O j := by
    intro j x hx
    have h : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq] at h
    exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
  
  have hval0 : ∀ (c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (h : pcrLocAmb c ρ m),
      pcrLocRel c ρ α m w h → ∀ x : Metric.closedBall c ρ,
        (h ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩).1 x (fun _ => 0) = w x := by
    intro c ρ m w h hr x
    have h1 := congrArg (fun T => T (fun _ => (0 : E2))) ((hr ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩).1 x)
    exact h1.trans (iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply _)
  
  have G1 : ∀ m (g : pcrAmb Bl m) (u : X → ℝ), pcrClass P α m u →
      (∀ i, pcrLocRel (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) α m (fun x => u (P.param (Bl.j i) x)) (g i)) →
      pcrEval Bl m g = u := by
    intro m g u hu hrel
    funext q
    simp only [pcrEval, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact (hval0 _ _ _ _ _ (hrel h.choose) _).trans
        (congrArg u h.choose_spec.choose_spec.2)
    · have hq : q ∉ S := fun hq => h (Bl.cover q hq)
      exact (hu.1 q hq).symm
  
  have hT0 : ∀ T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin 0 => E2) ℝ,
      ‖T (fun _ => 0)‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := fun T => by simpa using T.le_opNorm (fun _ => 0)
  have hnormB : ∀ m (g : pcrAmb Bl m) (i : Fin Bl.N), ‖(g i ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩).1‖ ≤ ‖g‖ := by
    intro m g i
    calc ‖(g i ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩).1‖ ≤ ‖g i ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩‖ := norm_fst_le _
      _ ≤ ‖g i‖ := norm_le_pi_norm (g i) _
      _ ≤ ‖g‖ := norm_le_pi_norm g i
  have G4 : ∀ m (g : pcrAmb Bl m) (q : X), |pcrEval Bl m g q| ≤ ‖g‖ := by
    intro m g q
    simp only [pcrEval, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact (hT0 _).trans ((BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_coe_le_norm _ _).trans
        (hnormB m g h.choose))
    · simp
  
  have G2 : ∀ (c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (h h' : pcrLocAmb c ρ m),
      pcrLocRel c ρ α m w h → pcrLocRel c ρ α m w h' → h = h' := by
    intro c ρ m w h h' hr hr'
    funext l
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · exact BoundedContinuousFunction.ext fun x => ((hr l).1 x).trans ((hr' l).1 x).symm
    · exact BoundedContinuousFunction.ext fun p => ((hr l).2 p).trans ((hr' l).2 p).symm
  have G3 : ∀ (c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (O : Set E2), IsOpen O → Metric.closedBall c ρ ⊆ O →
      ∀ (w w' : E2 → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ O, w x = w' x) → ∀ h : pcrLocAmb c ρ m,
        pcrLocRel c ρ α m w h → pcrLocRel c ρ α m w' h := by
    intro c ρ m O hO hK w w' hww' h hr l
    have key : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c ρ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w y = iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w' y := fun y hy =>
      (Filter.EventuallyEq.iteratedFDeriv ℝ
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds (hK hy)) hww') l).eq_of_nhds
    refine ⟨fun x => ((hr l).1 x).trans (key x x.2), fun p => ((hr l).2 p).trans ?_⟩
    rw [key _ p.1.1.2, key _ p.1.2.2]
  
  have hHolCongr : ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → ∀ f f' : E2 → ℝ,
      (∀ x ∈ U, f x = f' x) → pcrHolLoc α m f U → pcrHolLoc α m f' U := by
    intro m U hU f f' hff' hf
    have key : ∀ y ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f' y = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y := fun y hy =>
      (Filter.EventuallyEq.iteratedFDeriv ℝ (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy)
        (fun z hz => (hff' z hz).symm)) m).eq_of_nhds
    refine ⟨hf.1.congr (fun x hx => (hff' x hx).symm), fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hball, C, hC⟩ := hf.2 x hx
    refine ⟨ρ, hρ, hball, C, fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
    rw [key y (hball hy), key z (hball hz)]
    exact hC y hy z hz
  
  have P1 : ∀ (m m' : ℕ) (h : m ≤ m') (i : Fin Bl.N) (w : E2 → ℝ) (g : pcrAmb Bl m'),
      pcrLocRel (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) α m' w (g i) →
        pcrLocRel (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) α m w (pcrLevelProj Bl h g i) := by
    intro m m' h i w g hr l
    exact hr (Fin.castLE (Nat.succ_le_succ h) l)
  have P2 : ∀ (m m' : ℕ) (h : m ≤ m') (g : pcrAmb Bl m'),
      pcrEval Bl m (pcrLevelProj Bl h g) = pcrEval Bl m' g := by
    intro m m' h g
    rfl
  have P4 : ∀ (m m' : ℕ) (h : m ≤ m') (g : pcrAmb Bl m'), g ∈ pcrSp Bl α m' →
      pcrLevelProj Bl h g ∈ pcrSp Bl α m := by
    intro m m' h g hg
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hr⟩ := (pcr_sp_mem_iff P Bl α m' g).1 hg
    exact (pcr_sp_mem_iff P Bl α m _).2 ⟨u, ⟨hu.1, fun j =>
      pcr_holLoc_mono _ (P.W_open j) α hα0 hα1 m m' h _ (hu.2 j)⟩,
      fun i => P1 m m' h i _ g (hr i)⟩
  have hrep : ∀ m (v : pcrSp Bl α m), ∃ u : X → ℝ, pcrClass P α m u ∧
      (∀ i, pcrLocRel (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) α m (fun x => u (P.param (Bl.j i) x))
        ((v : pcrAmb Bl m) i)) ∧ pcrEval Bl m v = u := by
    intro m v
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hr⟩ := (pcr_sp_mem_iff P Bl α m v).1 v.2
    exact ⟨u, hu, hr, G1 m v u hu hr⟩
  have hVc : ∀ m, CompleteSpace (pcrSp Bl α m) := fun m =>
    (pcr_sp_closed P Bl α hα0 hα1 m).completeSpace_coe
  
  let ιE : ∀ k, pcrSp Bl α (k + 2) →L[ℝ] pcrSp Bl α 2 := fun k =>
    ((pcrLevelProj Bl (show 2 ≤ k + 2 by omega)).comp (pcrSp Bl α (k + 2)).subtypeL).codRestrict
      (pcrSp Bl α 2) (fun v => P4 2 (k + 2) (by omega) (v : pcrAmb Bl (k + 2)) v.2)
  let ιF : ∀ k, pcrSp Bl α k →L[ℝ] pcrSp Bl α 0 := fun k =>
    ((pcrLevelProj Bl (show 0 ≤ k by omega)).comp (pcrSp Bl α k).subtypeL).codRestrict
      (pcrSp Bl α 0) (fun v => P4 0 k (by omega) (v : pcrAmb Bl k) v.2)
  let B : BanachScale :=
    { E := fun k => pcrSp Bl α (k + 2)
      nE := fun _ => inferInstance
      sE := fun _ => inferInstance
      cE := fun k => hVc (k + 2)
      F := fun k => pcrSp Bl α k
      nF := fun _ => inferInstance
      sF := fun _ => inferInstance
      cF := fun k => hVc k
      ιE := ιE
      ιF := ιF }
  let evE : ∀ k, B.E k →ₗ[ℝ] (X → ℝ) := fun k =>
    (pcrEval Bl (k + 2)).comp (pcrSp Bl α (k + 2)).subtype
  let evF : ∀ k, B.F k →ₗ[ℝ] (X → ℝ) := fun k => (pcrEval Bl k).comp (pcrSp Bl α k).subtype
  have hinj : ∀ m (v v' : pcrSp Bl α m), pcrEval Bl m v = pcrEval Bl m v' → v = v' := by
    intro m v v' h
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hr, he⟩ := hrep m v
    obtain ⟨u', hu', hr', he'⟩ := hrep m v'
    have huu : u = u' := he.symm.trans (h.trans he')
    subst huu
    exact Subtype.ext (funext fun i => G2 _ _ _ _ _ _ (hr i) (hr' i))
  have hrange : ∀ m (u : X → ℝ), (∃ v : pcrSp Bl α m, pcrEval Bl m v = u) ↔ pcrClass P α m u := by
    intro m u
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨u, hu, -, he⟩ := hrep m v
      rw [he]
      exact hu
    · intro hu
      choose h hh using fun i => pcr_locRel_exists (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) (Bl.ρ_pos i)
        (P.W (Bl.j i)) (P.W_open _) (Bl.sub i) α hα0 hα1 m _ (hu.2 (Bl.j i))
      have hg : (h : pcrAmb Bl m) ∈ pcrSp Bl α m := (pcr_sp_mem_iff P Bl α m h).2 ⟨u, hu, hh⟩
      exact ⟨⟨h, hg⟩, G1 m h u hu hh⟩
  have hιE0 : ∀ v : pcrSp Bl α 2, ιE 0 v = v := fun v => Subtype.ext rfl
  have hext : ∀ m (g g' : pcrAmb Bl m), (∀ i, g i = g' i) → g = g' := fun m g g' h => funext h
  
  let projI : ∀ m (i : Fin Bl.N), pcrAmb Bl m →L[ℝ] pcrLocAmb (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) m := fun m i =>
    { toFun := fun g => g i
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl
      cont := continuous_apply i }
  let T : ∀ k (i : Fin Bl.N), pcrSp Bl α (k + 2) →L[ℝ] pcrLocAmb (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) (k + 2) :=
    fun k i => (projI (k + 2) i).comp (pcrSp Bl α (k + 2)).subtypeL
  have hT : ∀ k i (e : pcrSp Bl α (k + 2)), ∃ w : E2 → ℝ, pcrHolLoc α (k + 2) w (P.W (Bl.j i)) ∧
      pcrLocRel (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) α (k + 2) w (T k i e) := by
    intro k i e
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hr, -⟩ := hrep (k + 2) e
    exact ⟨_, hu.2 (Bl.j i), hr i⟩
  choose N hNs hNrel using fun k i => pcr_loc_nemytskii_smooth (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) (Bl.ρ_pos i)
    (P.W (Bl.j i)) (P.W_open _) (Bl.sub i) α hα0 hα1 s₁ hs₁ (Ψ (Bl.j i)) (hΨ (Bl.j i)) k
    (T k i) (hT k i)
  have hD : ∀ k (v : pcrSp Bl α (k + 2)) i,
      ‖(T k i v ⟨0, by omega⟩).1‖ ≤ ‖ιE k v‖ := fun k v i =>
    hnormB 2 (ιE k v : pcrAmb Bl 2) i
  have hDopen : ∀ j, IsOpen {z : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) |
      z.1 ∈ P.W j ∧ |z.2.1| < s₁} := fun j =>
    ((P.W_open j).preimage continuous_fst).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd)) continuous_const)
  
  obtain ⟨Gl, hGl⟩ : ∃ Gl : (X → ℝ) → X → ℝ, ∀ u q, Gl u q =
      if h : ∃ j', q ∈ S ∧ q ∈ P.O j' then
        Ψ h.choose (P.proj h.choose q, u (P.param h.choose (P.proj h.choose q)),
          fderiv ℝ (fun x' => u (P.param h.choose x')) (P.proj h.choose q),
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => u (P.param h.choose x'))) (P.proj h.choose q))
      else 0 := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have H1 : ∀ u : X → ℝ, pcrClass P α 2 u → (∀ q ∈ S, |u q| < s₁) → ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      Gl u (P.param j x) = Ψ j (x, u (P.param j x), fderiv ℝ (fun x' => u (P.param j x')) x,
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => u (P.param j x'))) x) := by
    intro u hu hus j x hx
    have hex : ∃ j', P.param j x ∈ S ∧ P.param j x ∈ P.O j' := ⟨j, Pa j x hx⟩
    rw [hGl, dif_pos hex]
    exact (hcompat u hu hus j hex.choose x ⟨hx, hex.choose_spec.2⟩).symm
  
  have hM : ∀ k (v : pcrSp Bl α (k + 2)), ‖ιE k v‖ < s₁ → ∀ u : X → ℝ, pcrClass P α (k + 2) u →
      (∀ i, pcrLocRel (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) α (k + 2) (fun x => u (P.param (Bl.j i) x))
        ((v : pcrAmb Bl (k + 2)) i)) →
      pcrClass P α k (Gl u) ∧
        ∀ i, pcrLocRel (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) α k (fun x => Gl u (P.param (Bl.j i) x)) (N k i v) := by
    intro k v hv u hu hr
    have he : pcrEval Bl (k + 2) (v : pcrAmb Bl (k + 2)) = u := G1 _ _ u hu hr
    have hus : ∀ q ∈ S, |u q| < s₁ := by
      intro q _
      rw [← he, ← P2 2 (k + 2) (by omega) (v : pcrAmb Bl (k + 2))]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (G4 2 _ q) hv
    have hu2 : pcrClass P α 2 u := ⟨hu.1, fun j =>
      pcr_holLoc_mono _ (P.W_open j) α hα0 hα1 2 (k + 2) (by omega) _ (hu.2 j)⟩
    refine ⟨⟨fun q hq => ?_, fun j => ?_⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
    · rw [hGl, dif_neg]
      rintro ⟨j', hq', -⟩
      exact hq hq'
    · have h4 := pcr_holLoc_jet_comp (P.W j) (P.W_open j) α hα0 hα1 k
        (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (hu.2 j) _ (hDopen j) (Ψ j) (hΨ j)
        (fun x hx => ⟨hx, hus _ (Pa j x hx).1⟩)
      exact hHolCongr k (P.W j) (P.W_open j) _ _ (fun x hx => (H1 u hu2 hus j x hx).symm) h4
    · have h9 := hNrel k i v (lt_of_le_of_lt (hD k v i) hv) (fun x => u (P.param (Bl.j i) x))
        (hu.2 _) (hr i)
      exact G3 _ _ _ (P.W (Bl.j i)) (P.W_open _) (Bl.sub i) _ _
        (fun x hx => (H1 u hu2 hus (Bl.j i) x hx).symm) _ h9
  have hMem : ∀ k (v : pcrSp Bl α (k + 2)), ‖ιE k v‖ < s₁ →
      ((fun i => N k i v : pcrAmb Bl k)) ∈ pcrSp Bl α k := by
    intro k v hv
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hr, -⟩ := hrep (k + 2) v
    exact (pcr_sp_mem_iff P Bl α k _).2 ⟨Gl u, hM k v hv u hu hr⟩
  obtain ⟨Hop, hHop⟩ : ∃ Hop : ∀ k, pcrSp Bl α (k + 2) → pcrSp Bl α k, ∀ k v, Hop k v =
      if h : ‖ιE k v‖ < s₁ then ⟨(fun i => N k i v : pcrAmb Bl k), hMem k v h⟩ else 0 :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hOpen : ∀ k, IsOpen {v : pcrSp Bl α (k + 2) | ‖ιE k v‖ < s₁} := fun k =>
    isOpen_lt ((ιE k).continuous.norm) continuous_const
  
  have hHs : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Hop k) {v : pcrSp Bl α (k + 2) | ‖ιE k v‖ < s₁} := by
    intro k
    haveI := hVc k
    have hN : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun v => ((fun i => N k i v : pcrAmb Bl k)))
        {v : pcrSp Bl α (k + 2) | ‖ιE k v‖ < s₁} :=
      (contDiffOn_pi (F' := fun i => pcrLocAmb (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) k)).2 fun i =>
        (hNs k i).mono fun v hv => lt_of_le_of_lt (hD k v i) hv
    have hcg : ∀ v ∈ {v : pcrSp Bl α (k + 2) | ‖ιE k v‖ < s₁},
        (pcrSp Bl α k).subtypeₗᵢ (Hop k v) = ((fun i => N k i v : pcrAmb Bl k)) := by
      intro v hv
      have hv' : ‖ιE k v‖ < s₁ := hv
      rw [hHop, dif_pos hv']
      rfl
    exact pcr_contDiffOn_of_isometry_comp (pcrSp Bl α k).subtypeₗᵢ (Hop k) _ (hOpen k)
      (hN.congr hcg)
  
  have hHc : ∀ k (v : pcrSp Bl α (k + 2)), ιF k (Hop k v) = Hop 0 (ιE k v) := by
    intro k v
    by_cases hv : ‖ιE k v‖ < s₁
    · have hv0 : ‖ιE 0 (ιE k v)‖ < s₁ := by rwa [hιE0]
      rw [hHop k v, dif_pos hv, hHop 0 (ιE k v), dif_pos hv0]
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hr, -⟩ := hrep (k + 2) v
      have hu2 : pcrClass P α 2 u := ⟨hu.1, fun j =>
        pcr_holLoc_mono _ (P.W_open j) α hα0 hα1 2 (k + 2) (by omega) _ (hu.2 j)⟩
      have hr2 : ∀ i, pcrLocRel (Bl.c i) (Bl.ρ i) α 2 (fun x => u (P.param (Bl.j i) x))
          ((ιE k v : pcrAmb Bl 2) i) := fun i => P1 2 (k + 2) (by omega) i _ _ (hr i)
      refine Subtype.ext (hext 0 _ _ fun i => ?_)
      have hL := P1 0 k (by omega) i _ (fun i => N k i v) ((hM k v hv u hu hr).2 i)
      have hR := (hM 0 (ιE k v) hv0 u hu2 hr2).2 i
      exact G2 _ _ _ _ _ _ hL hR
    · have hv0 : ¬ ‖ιE 0 (ιE k v)‖ < s₁ := by rwa [hιE0]
      rw [hHop k v, dif_neg hv, hHop 0 (ιE k v), dif_neg hv0, map_zero]
  
  have hValF : ∀ v : pcrSp Bl α 2, ‖v‖ < s₁ → ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      pcrEval Bl 0 (Hop 0 v : pcrAmb Bl 0) (P.param j x) =
        Ψ j (x, pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x),
          fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x')) x,
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x'))) x) := by
    intro v hv j x hx
    have hv' : ‖ιE 0 v‖ < s₁ := by rwa [hιE0]
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hr, he⟩ := hrep 2 v
    have hus : ∀ q ∈ S, |u q| < s₁ := fun q _ => he ▸ lt_of_le_of_lt (G4 2 _ q) hv
    have h1 : pcrEval Bl 0 (Hop 0 v : pcrAmb Bl 0) = Gl u := by
      rw [hHop 0 v, dif_pos hv']
      exact G1 0 _ (Gl u) (hM 0 v hv' u hu hr).1 (hM 0 v hv' u hu hr).2
    rw [h1, he]
    exact H1 u hu hus j x hx
  
  have hjetlin : ∀ (a b : E2 → ℝ) (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ (2 : ℕ) a U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (2 : ℕ) b U → ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ ε : ℝ,
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => a y + ε * b y) x = fderiv ℝ a x + ε • fderiv ℝ b x ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => a y + ε * b y)) x =
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ a) x + ε • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ b) x := by
    intro a b U hU ha hb x hx ε
    have hda : ∀ y ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ a y := fun y hy =>
      (ha.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
    have hdb : ∀ y ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ b y := fun y hy =>
      (hb.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
    have h1 : ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ (fun y => a y + ε * b y) y = fderiv ℝ a y + ε • fderiv ℝ b y :=
      fun y hy => ((hda y hy).hasFDerivAt.add ((hdb y hy).hasFDerivAt.const_mul ε)).fderiv
    have hfa : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ a) x :=
      ((ha.fderiv_of_isOpen (m := 1) hU (by norm_num)).differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt
        (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    have hfb : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ b) x :=
      ((hb.fderiv_of_isOpen (m := 1) hU (by norm_num)).differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt
        (hU.mem_nhds hx)
    refine ⟨h1 x hx, ?_⟩
    have hev : fderiv ℝ (fun y => a y + ε * b y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun y => fderiv ℝ a y + ε • fderiv ℝ b y := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) h1
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact (hfa.hasFDerivAt.add (hfb.hasFDerivAt.const_smul ε)).fderiv
  have hC2 : ∀ (w : pcrSp Bl α 2) j,
      ContDiffOn ℝ (2 : ℕ) (fun x => pcrEval Bl 2 (w : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x)) (P.W j) :=
    fun w j => (((hrange 2 _).1 ⟨w, rfl⟩).2 j).1
  
  have hDerF : ∀ v : pcrSp Bl α 2, ‖v‖ < s₁ → ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ p : pcrSp Bl α 2,
      pcrEval Bl 0 (fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) v p : pcrAmb Bl 0) (P.param j x) =
        fderiv ℝ (Ψ j) (x, pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x),
            fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x')) x,
            fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x'))) x)
          (0, pcrEval Bl 2 (p : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x),
            fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (p : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x')) x,
            fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (p : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x'))) x) := by
    intro v hv j x hx p
    have hv' : ‖ιE 0 v‖ < s₁ := by rwa [hιE0]
    let lam : pcrSp Bl α 0 →L[ℝ] ℝ := LinearMap.mkContinuous
      ((LinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : X => ℝ) (P.param j x)).comp
        ((pcrEval Bl 0).comp (pcrSp Bl α 0).subtype)) 1
      (fun f => by
        rw [one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact G4 0 (f : pcrAmb Bl 0) (P.param j x))
    have hlam : ∀ f : pcrSp Bl α 0, lam f = pcrEval Bl 0 (f : pcrAmb Bl 0) (P.param j x) :=
      fun f => rfl
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (Hop 0) v :=
      ((hHs 0).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt ((hOpen 0).mem_nhds hv')
    have hline : HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => v + ε • p) p 0 := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const p).const_add v
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => Hop 0 (v + ε • p)) (fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) v p) 0 :=
      hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hline (by simp)
    have hφ : HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => lam (Hop 0 (v + ε • p))) (lam (fderiv ℝ (Hop 0) v p)) 0 :=
      lam.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt 0 h2
    have hsmall : ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), ‖v + ε • p‖ < s₁ :=
      hline.continuousAt.norm.eventually_lt continuousAt_const (by simpa using hv)
    have hus : |pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x)| < s₁ :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (G4 2 _ _) hv
    have hlin : ∀ ε : ℝ, (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 ((v + ε • p : pcrSp Bl α 2) : pcrAmb Bl 2)
        (P.param j x')) = fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x') +
          ε * pcrEval Bl 2 (p : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x') := by
      intro ε
      funext x'
      simp [map_add, map_smul]
    have hEv : (fun ε : ℝ => lam (Hop 0 (v + ε • p))) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] fun ε : ℝ => Ψ j
        ((x, pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x),
            fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x')) x,
            fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x'))) x) +
          ε • ((0 : E2), pcrEval Bl 2 (p : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x),
            fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (p : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x')) x,
            fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (p : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x'))) x)) := by
      filter_upwards [hsmall] with ε hε
      have hpt := congrFun (hlin ε) x
      obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := hjetlin _ _ (P.W j) (P.W_open j) (hC2 v j) (hC2 p j) x hx ε
      beta_reduce at hpt e1 e2
      rw [hlam, hValF (v + ε • p) hε j x hx, hpt, hlin ε, e1, e2]
      simp only [Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, smul_zero, add_zero, smul_eq_mul]
    have hΨd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (Ψ j) (x, pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x),
        fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x')) x,
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x'))) x) :=
      ((hΨ j).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt ((hDopen j).mem_nhds ⟨hx, hus⟩)
    have hlz := ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const ((0 : E2), pcrEval Bl 2 (p : pcrAmb Bl 2)
        (P.param j x), fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (p : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x')) x,
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (p : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x'))) x)).const_add
      (x, pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x),
        fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x')) x,
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pcrEval Bl 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) (P.param j x'))) x)
    simp only [id, one_smul] at hlz
    have hψ := hΨd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 hlz (by simp)
    have hfin := (hψ.congr_of_eventuallyEq hEv).unique hφ
    rw [← hlam]
    exact hfin.symm
  
  refine ⟨B, evE, evF, Hop, s₁, 1, hs₁, zero_le_one, fun k => hinj (k + 2), fun k => hinj k,
    fun k u => hrange (k + 2) u, fun k u => hrange k u, fun k v => rfl, fun k g => rfl, hιE0,
    fun v q _ => by rw [one_mul]; exact G4 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) q, hHs, hHc,
    fun v hv => ⟨fun q _ => lt_of_le_of_lt (G4 2 (v : pcrAmb Bl 2) q) hv,

  intro k I hI γ hγ j
  exact pcr_transfer P Bl α hα0 hα1 k I hI γ hγ (fun t => pcrEval Bl (k + 2) (γ t : pcrAmb Bl (k + 2)))
    (fun t => by
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hr, he⟩ := hrep (k + 2) (γ t)
      beta_reduce
      rw [he]
      exact ⟨hu, hr⟩) j

structure PcrBalls {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) where
  N : ℕ
  j : Fin N → Fin P.n
  c : Fin N → E2
  ρ : Fin N → ℝ
  ρ_pos : ∀ i, 0 < ρ i
  sub : ∀ i, Metric.closedBall (c i) (ρ i) ⊆ P.W (j i)
  cover : ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ i, ∃ x ∈ Metric.ball (c i) (ρ i), P.param (j i) x = q


def pcrLocAmb (c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : Type :=
  ∀ l : Fin (m + 1),
    BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ)
        (ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ) ×
      BoundedContinuousFunction {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2}
        (ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ)

instance pcrLocAmb.instNormedAddCommGroup (c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    NormedAddCommGroup (pcrLocAmb c ρ m) :=
  Pi.normedAddCommGroup

instance pcrLocAmb.instNormedSpace (c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : NormedSpace ℝ (pcrLocAmb c ρ m) :=
  Pi.normedSpace


def pcrLocRel (c : E2) (ρ α : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (h : pcrLocAmb c ρ m) : Prop :=
  ∀ l : Fin (m + 1),
    (∀ x : Metric.closedBall c ρ, (h l).1 x = iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w x) ∧
    ∀ p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2},
      (h l).2 p = (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ •
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w p.1.1 - iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w p.1.2)


def pcrAmb {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} {P : EigPatchedSurface X S}
    (B : PcrBalls P) (m : ℕ) : Type :=
  ∀ i : Fin B.N, pcrLocAmb (B.c i) (B.ρ i) m

instance pcrAmb.instNormedAddCommGroup {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X}
    {P : EigPatchedSurface X S} (B : PcrBalls P) (m : ℕ) : NormedAddCommGroup (pcrAmb B m) :=
  Pi.normedAddCommGroup

instance pcrAmb.instNormedSpace {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X}
    {P : EigPatchedSurface X S} (B : PcrBalls P) (m : ℕ) : NormedSpace ℝ (pcrAmb B m) :=
  Pi.normedSpace


def pcrSp {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} {P : EigPatchedSurface X S}
    (B : PcrBalls P) (α : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : Submodule ℝ (pcrAmb B m) :=
  Submodule.span ℝ {g | ∃ u : X → ℝ, pcrClass P α m u ∧
    ∀ i, pcrLocRel (B.c i) (B.ρ i) α m (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) x)) (g i)}


instance pcrLocAmb.instCompleteSpace (c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : CompleteSpace (pcrLocAmb c ρ m) :=
  @Pi.complete _ _ _ (fun _ => inferInstance)


instance pcrAmb.instCompleteSpace {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X}
    {P : EigPatchedSurface X S} (B : PcrBalls P) (m : ℕ) : CompleteSpace (pcrAmb B m) :=
  @Pi.complete _ _ _ (fun _ => inferInstance)


def pcrLevelProj {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} {P : EigPatchedSurface X S}
    (B : PcrBalls P) {m m' : ℕ} (h : m ≤ m') : pcrAmb B m' →L[ℝ] pcrAmb B m where
  toFun g := fun i l => g i (Fin.castLE (Nat.succ_le_succ h) l)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  cont := continuous_pi fun i => continuous_pi fun l =>
    (continuous_apply (Fin.castLE (Nat.succ_le_succ h) l)).comp (continuous_apply i)


def pcrEval {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} {P : EigPatchedSurface X S}
    (B : PcrBalls P) (m : ℕ) : pcrAmb B m →ₗ[ℝ] (X → ℝ) where
  toFun g q := by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ i, ∃ x ∈ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i), P.param (B.j i) x = q then
      (g h.choose ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩).1
        ⟨h.choose_spec.choose, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall h.choose_spec.choose_spec.1⟩
        (fun _ => 0)
    else 0
  map_add' g g' := by
    funext q
    rw [Pi.add_apply]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · simp
  map_smul' a g := by
    funext q
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · simp

def pcrLevelProj {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} {P : EigPatchedSurface X S}
    (B : PcrBalls P) {m m' : ℕ} (h : m ≤ m') : pcrAmb B m' →L[ℝ] pcrAmb B m where
  toFun g := fun i l => g i (Fin.castLE (Nat.succ_le_succ h) l)
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  cont := continuous_pi fun i => continuous_pi fun l =>
    (continuous_apply (Fin.castLE (Nat.succ_le_succ h) l)).comp (continuous_apply i)


def pcrEval {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} {P : EigPatchedSurface X S}
    (B : PcrBalls P) (m : ℕ) : pcrAmb B m →ₗ[ℝ] (X → ℝ) where
  toFun g q := by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ i, ∃ x ∈ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i), P.param (B.j i) x = q then
      (g h.choose ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩).1
        ⟨h.choose_spec.choose, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall h.choose_spec.choose_spec.1⟩
        (fun _ => 0)
    else 0
  map_add' g g' := by
    funext q
    rw [Pi.add_apply]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · simp
  map_smul' a g := by
    funext q
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · simp

def pcrL0A (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y : E3) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
  fun a b => Real.sqrt (G y).det *
    ((G y)⁻¹ a.succ b.succ / Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0) -
      (G y)⁻¹ a.succ 0 * (G y)⁻¹ b.succ 0 / Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0) ^ 3)


def pcrL0Z (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (G y).det * (∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv j f y) /
    Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k f y * partialDeriv l f y)

        (f (P.param j x) + κ) * wd j x := fun j =>
    pcr_div_local_schauder (P.W j) (P.W_open j) (A j) (hA j) (hApd j) α hα0 hα1 _ (hF j)
      (w j) (G j) (hW1 j) (hW2 j) (hW3 j)
  choose w' hw'H hw'ae hw'eq using hloc
  obtain ⟨u, hu0, hu⟩ :=
    pcr_div_overlap_glue S P w w' (fun j => (hw'H j).1.continuousOn) hw'ae hW4
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀def⟩ : ∃ u₀ : X → ℝ, u₀ = fun q => u q - S.indicator (fun _ => u q₀) q :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hu₀p : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, u₀ (P.param j x) = w' j x - u q₀ := by
    intro j x hx

    simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hq, hu0 q hq, sub_zero]
  have hu₀q : u₀ q₀ = 0 := by
    rw [hu₀def]
    simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hq₀, sub_self]

    refine ⟨hu₀off, fun j => ?_⟩
    have hT := pcr_div_holLoc_toolkit α hα0 hα1.le (P.W j) (P.W_open j)
    exact hT.1 2 _ _ (hT.2.1 2 _ (u q₀) (hw'H j)) (fun x hx => (hu₀p j x hx).symm)

    intro j x hx
    have hO := pcr_div_op_toolkit (P.W j) (P.W_open j) (A j) (hA j)
    have e1 : ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A j x' a b *
        pd2 b (fun x'' => u₀ (P.param j x'')) x') x =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A j x' a b *
          pd2 b (fun y => w' j y - u q₀) x') x :=
      hO.2.1 (fun x'' => u₀ (P.param j x'')) (fun y => w' j y - u q₀)
        (fun y hy => hu₀p j y hy) x hx
    have e2 : ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A j x' a b *
        pd2 b (fun y => w' j y - u q₀) x') x =

    have e3 : ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A j x' a b *
        pd2 b (fun _ => u q₀) x') x = 0 :=
      hO.2.2 (fun _ => u q₀) (u q₀) (fun _ _ => rfl) x hx
    rw [e1, e2, e3, sub_zero, ← hw'eq j x hx, neg_neg]
  have heq0 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,

          pd2 b (fun x'' => u₁ (P.param j x'')) x') x -
        ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A j x' a b *
          pd2 b (fun x'' => u₀ (P.param j x'')) x') x :=
      hO.1 (fun x'' => u₁ (P.param j x'')) (fun x'' => u₀ (P.param j x''))

by
  
  obtain ⟨hch, hbr⟩ := pcr_holF_bridge α hα0 hα1
  generalize hιdef : (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm = ι at hch hbr
  have hα'0 : 0 < Real.toNNReal α := Real.toNNReal_pos.2 hα0
  have hα'r : ((Real.toNNReal α : NNReal) : ℝ) = α := Real.coe_toNNReal _ hα0.le
  have hα'1 : Real.toNNReal α < 1 := by
    have h : ((Real.toNNReal α : NNReal) : ℝ) < 1 := by rw [hα'r]; exact hα1
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hα'1' : Real.toNNReal α ≤ 1 := hα'1.le
  have hTo : IsOpen {y : Fin 2 → ℝ | ι y ∈ U} := hU.preimage ι.continuous
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hneg, hcongr, hmono, -, -, -⟩ :=
    pcr_holF_algebra (Real.toNNReal α) hα'0 hα'1' {y : Fin 2 → ℝ | ι y ∈ U} hTo
  
  have hv' : pcrHolF (Real.toNNReal α) (k + 2) (fun y => v (ι y)) {y | ι y ∈ U} :=
    (hbr (k + 2) v U hU).1 hv
  have hp' : pcrHolF (Real.toNNReal α) 2 (fun y => p (ι y)) {y | ι y ∈ U} :=
    (hbr 2 p U hU).1 hp
  have hg' := (hbr k _ U hU).1 hL
  have hd1 : ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (i : Fin 2),
      (fun y => smthGrad (fun y' => w (ι y')) y i) = fun y => pd2 i w (ι y) :=
    fun w i => funext fun y => hch w y i
  have hd2 : ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (i j : Fin 2) (y : Fin 2 → ℝ),
      smthGrad (fun y' => smthGrad (fun y'' => w (ι y'')) y' j) y i =
        pd2 i (pd2 j w) (ι y) := by
    intro w i j y
    rw [hd1 w j]
    exact hch (pd2 j w) y i
  
  obtain ⟨Φa, Φb, Φc, hΦa, hΦb, hΦc, hell, hlin⟩ := pcr_lin_symbol U hU s₁ G hGs hGsymm hGpd
  obtain ⟨u3, hu3⟩ : ∃ u3 : Fin 3 → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ,
      u3 = ![fun y => v (ι y), fun y => smthGrad (fun y' => v (ι y')) y 0,
        fun y => smthGrad (fun y' => v (ι y')) y 1] := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u7, hu7⟩ : ∃ u7 : Fin 7 → (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ,
      u7 = ![fun y => v (ι y), fun y => smthGrad (fun y' => v (ι y')) y 0,
        fun y => smthGrad (fun y' => v (ι y')) y 1,
        fun y => smthGrad (fun y' => smthGrad (fun y'' => v (ι y'')) y' 0) y 0,
        fun y => smthGrad (fun y' => smthGrad (fun y'' => v (ι y'')) y' 1) y 0,
        fun y => smthGrad (fun y' => smthGrad (fun y'' => v (ι y'')) y' 0) y 1,
        fun y => smthGrad (fun y' => smthGrad (fun y'' => v (ι y'')) y' 1) y 1] := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hJ1 : ∀ y, (fun l => u3 l y) = ![v (ι y), pd2 0 v (ι y), pd2 1 v (ι y)] := by
    intro y
    subst hu3
    funext l
    fin_cases l
    · rfl
    · exact hch v y 0
    · exact hch v y 1
  have hJ2 : ∀ y, (fun l => u7 l y) = ![v (ι y), pd2 0 v (ι y), pd2 1 v (ι y),
      pd2 0 (pd2 0 v) (ι y), pd2 0 (pd2 1 v) (ι y), pd2 1 (pd2 0 v) (ι y),
      pd2 1 (pd2 1 v) (ι y)] := by
    intro y
    subst hu7
    funext l
    fin_cases l
    · rfl
    · exact hch v y 0
    · exact hch v y 1
    · exact hd2 v 0 0 y
    · exact hd2 v 0 1 y
    · exact hd2 v 1 0 y
    · exact hd2 v 1 1 y
  have hu30 : ∀ y, u3 0 y = v (ι y) := by intro y; subst hu3; rfl
  have hu70 : ∀ y, u7 0 y = v (ι y) := by intro y; subst hu7; rfl
  have hu3reg : ∀ l, pcrHolF (Real.toNNReal α) (k + 1) (u3 l) {y | ι y ∈ U} := by
    subst hu3
    intro l
    fin_cases l
    · exact hmono (k + 1) (k + 2) _ (by omega) hv'
    · exact hv'.2 0
    · exact hv'.2 1
  have hu7reg : ∀ l, pcrHolF (Real.toNNReal α) k (u7 l) {y | ι y ∈ U} := by
    subst hu7
    intro l
    fin_cases l
    · exact hmono k (k + 2) _ (by omega) hv'
    · exact hmono k (k + 1) _ (by omega) (hv'.2 0)
    · exact hmono k (k + 1) _ (by omega) (hv'.2 1)
    · exact (hv'.2 0).2 0
    · exact (hv'.2 1).2 0
    · exact (hv'.2 0).2 1
    · exact (hv'.2 1).2 1
  have hO3 : IsOpen {z : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 3 → ℝ) | ι z.1 ∈ U ∧ |z.2 0| < s₁} :=
    (hU.preimage (ι.continuous.comp continuous_fst)).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((continuous_apply 0).comp continuous_snd))
        continuous_const)
  have hO7 : IsOpen {z : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 7 → ℝ) | ι z.1 ∈ U ∧ |z.2 0| < s₁} :=
    (hU.preimage (ι.continuous.comp continuous_fst)).inter
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((continuous_apply 0).comp continuous_snd))
        continuous_const)
  have hsm3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => (ι z.1, z.2))
      {z | ι z.1 ∈ U ∧ |z.2 0| < s₁} :=

  have hsm7 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 7 → ℝ) => (ι z.1, z.2))
      {z | ι z.1 ∈ U ∧ |z.2 0| < s₁} :=
    ((ι.contDiff.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd).contDiffOn
  have huO3 : ∀ y ∈ {y : Fin 2 → ℝ | ι y ∈ U},
      (y, fun l => u3 l y) ∈ {z : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 3 → ℝ) | ι z.1 ∈ U ∧ |z.2 0| < s₁} := by
    intro y hy
    refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
    show |u3 0 y| < s₁
    rw [hu30]
    exact hvs _ hy
  have huO7 : ∀ y ∈ {y : Fin 2 → ℝ | ι y ∈ U},
      (y, fun l => u7 l y) ∈ {z : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 7 → ℝ) | ι z.1 ∈ U ∧ |z.2 0| < s₁} := by
    intro y hy
    refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
    show |u7 0 y| < s₁
    rw [hu70]
    exact hvs _ hy
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ,
      a = fun y i j => Φa i j (ι y, fun l => u3 l y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ,
      b = fun y i => -Φb i (ι y, fun l => u7 l y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ,
      c = fun y => -Φc (ι y, fun l => u7 l y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have haP : ∀ y i j, a y i j = Φa i j (ι y, ![v (ι y), pd2 0 v (ι y), pd2 1 v (ι y)]) := by
    intro y i j
    rw [ha, ← hJ1 y]
  have hbP : ∀ y i, b y i = -Φb i (ι y, ![v (ι y), pd2 0 v (ι y), pd2 1 v (ι y),
      pd2 0 (pd2 0 v) (ι y), pd2 0 (pd2 1 v) (ι y), pd2 1 (pd2 0 v) (ι y),
      pd2 1 (pd2 1 v) (ι y)]) := by
    intro y i
    rw [hb, ← hJ2 y]
  have hcP : ∀ y, c y = -Φc (ι y, ![v (ι y), pd2 0 v (ι y), pd2 1 v (ι y),
      pd2 0 (pd2 0 v) (ι y), pd2 0 (pd2 1 v) (ι y), pd2 1 (pd2 0 v) (ι y),
      pd2 1 (pd2 1 v) (ι y)]) := by
    intro y
    rw [hc, ← hJ2 y]
  have haReg : ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      pcrHolF (Real.toNNReal α) (k + 1) (fun x => a x i j) {y | ι y ∈ U} := by
    intro i j
    subst ha
    exact pcr_holF_comp (Real.toNNReal α) hα'0 hα'1' _ hTo 3 (k + 1)
      (fun z => Φa i j (ι z.1, z.2)) _ hO3 ((hΦa i j).comp hsm3 (fun z hz => hz))
      u3 hu3reg huO3
  have hbReg : ∀ i : Fin 2, pcrHolF (Real.toNNReal α) k (fun x => b x i) {y | ι y ∈ U} := by
    intro i
    subst hb
    exact hneg k _ (pcr_holF_comp (Real.toNNReal α) hα'0 hα'1' _ hTo 7 k
      (fun z => Φb i (ι z.1, z.2)) _ hO7 ((hΦb i).comp hsm7 (fun z hz => hz))
      u7 hu7reg huO7)
  have hcReg : pcrHolF (Real.toNNReal α) k c {y | ι y ∈ U} := by
    subst hc
    exact hneg k _ (pcr_holF_comp (Real.toNNReal α) hα'0 hα'1' _ hTo 7 k
      (fun z => Φc (ι z.1, z.2)) _ hO7 (hΦc.comp hsm7 (fun z hz => hz))
      u7 hu7reg huO7)
  have haEll : ∀ x ∈ {y : Fin 2 → ℝ | ι y ∈ U}, ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, ξ ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a x i j * ξ i * ξ j := by
    intro y hy ξ hξ
    subst ha
    exact hell (ι y, fun l => u3 l y) hy (by show |u3 0 y| < s₁; rw [hu30]; exact hvs _ hy)
      ξ hξ
  
  have hstep : ∀ (F : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      (∀ i : Fin 2, pcrHolF (Real.toNNReal α) 1 (fun x => F x i) {y | ι y ∈ U}) →
      pcrHolF (Real.toNNReal α) 1 w {y | ι y ∈ U} →
      smthLinSol a F w {y | ι y ∈ U} → pcrHolF (Real.toNNReal α) 2 w {y | ι y ∈ U} :=
    fun F w hF hw heq => pcr_div_C2alpha _ hTo (Real.toNNReal α) hα'0 hα'1 a F w
      (fun i j => hmono 1 (k + 1) _ (by omega) (haReg i j)) hF haEll hw heq
  
  have hres := pcr_genlin_bootstrap _ hTo (Real.toNNReal α) hα'0 hα'1 a b c k haReg hbReg hcReg
    hstep (fun y => p (ι y)) hp' (hcongr k _ _ (hneg k _ hg') ?_)
  · exact (hbr (k + 2) p U hU).2 hres
  · intro y hy
    have hx : ι y ∈ U := hy
    have hpx : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 p (ι y) :=
      (hp.1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_refl 2)

    beta_reduce
    rw [hD]

def pcrHolF (α : NNReal) : ℕ → ((Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) → Set (Fin 2 → ℝ) → Prop
  | 0, u, S => ContinuousOn u S ∧ ∀ x₀ ∈ S, ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (C : NNReal), 0 < ρ ∧
      Metric.ball x₀ ρ ⊆ S ∧ HolderOnWith C α u (Metric.ball x₀ ρ)
  | k + 1, u, S => (∀ x ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ u x) ∧
      ∀ m : Fin 2, pcrHolF α k (fun x => smthGrad u x m) S

    (hNg3 : ∀ (X : Set M) (τ : M → ℝ), IsOpen X → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ τ X →
      (∀ x ∈ X, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ x ≠ 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ X, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
        (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) τ y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x)
    (B : Set M) (hB : IsOpen B) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hdf : ∀ x ∈ B, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) (q : M) (hq : q ∈ B) :
    ∃ (B' : Set M) (τ : ℝ) (Fl : ℝ → M → M), IsOpen B' ∧ q ∈ B' ∧ B' ⊆ B ∧ 0 < τ ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B', Fl 0 y = y ∧
        IsMIntegralCurveOn (fun t => Fl t y)
          (fun x => Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x)) (Set.Ioo (-τ) τ) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, Fl t y ∈ B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧ f (Fl t y) = f y + t) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2)))
        (Set.Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ (chartAt E3 q '' B')) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ chartAt E3 q '' B', ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
        fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2))) (t, u) (a, w) = 0 →
        w = -a • fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2))) (0, u) (1, 0))

    (Ng : (x : M) → (E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x)

    (B : Set M) (hB : IsOpen B) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hdf : ∀ x ∈ B, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) (q : M) (hq : q ∈ B) :
    ∃ (B' : Set M) (τ : ℝ) (Fl : ℝ → M → M), IsOpen B' ∧ q ∈ B' ∧ B' ⊆ B ∧ 0 < τ ∧
      (∀ y ∈ B', Fl 0 y = y ∧
        IsMIntegralCurveOn (fun t => Fl t y)
          (fun x => Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x)) (Set.Ioo (-τ) τ) ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, Fl t y ∈ B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧ f (Fl t y) = f y + t) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2)))
        (Set.Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ (chartAt E3 q '' B')) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ chartAt E3 q '' B', ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
        fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2))) (t, u) (a, w) = 0 →
        w = -a • fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q (Fl p.1 ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2))) (0, u) (1, 0))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hV : ∀ x ∈ B, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3).tangent ∞
      (fun y => (⟨y, Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f y)⟩ : TangentBundle 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M)) x :=
    hNg3 B f hB hf.contMDiffOn hdf
  have hO : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q) '' (B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) :=
    (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hB.inter (chartAt E3 q).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right
  have hc : chartAt E3 q q ∈ (chartAt E3 q) '' (B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) :=
    ⟨q, ⟨hq, mem_chart_source E3 q⟩, rfl⟩
  have hY : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun u : E3 => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm u)
        (Ng ((chartAt E3 q).symm u) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f ((chartAt E3 q).symm u))) : E3))
      (chartAt E3 q '' (B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) := by
    have hloc : ∀ x ∈ B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source, ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞
        (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) y
          (Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f y)) : E3)) x := by
      intro x hx
      have hbase : x ∈ (trivializationAt E3 (TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) q).baseSet := by
        rw [TangentBundle.trivializationAt_baseSet]; exact hx.2
      have h := ((trivializationAt E3 (TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) q).contMDiffAt_section_iff
        (IB := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞) (s := fun y => Ng y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f y))
        hbase).1 (hV x hx.1)
      refine h.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).open_source.mem_nhds hx.2] with y hy
      rw [TangentBundle.trivializationAt_apply, mfderiv_chartAt_eq_tangentCoordChange hy,
        tangentCoordChange_def]
      rfl
    rintro u ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hsymm : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q x) :=
      contMDiffOn_chart_symm.contMDiffAt
        ((chartAt E3 q).open_target.mem_nhds ((chartAt E3 q).map_source hx.2))
    have hl := hloc x hx
    rw [← (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hx.2] at hl
    exact (contMDiffAt_iff_contDiffAt.1 (hl.comp _ hsymm)).contDiffWithinAt
  
  have hcutoff : ∀ (O : Set E3), IsOpen O → ∀ c ∈ O, ∀ (Y : E3 → E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y O →
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ O ∧
        ∃ X : E3 → E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ X ∧ HasCompactSupport X ∧
          ∀ u ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, X u = Y u := by
    intro O hO c hc Y hY
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεO⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hO c hc
    let β : ContDiffBump c := ⟨ε / 4, ε / 2, by positivity, by linarith⟩
    have hsub : Metric.closedBall c (ε / 2) ⊆ O :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hεO
    have hβ0 : ∀ v, v ∉ Metric.closedBall c (ε / 2) → β v = 0 := by
      intro v hv
      apply Function.notMem_support.1
      rw [β.support_eq]
      exact fun h => hv (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall h)
    refine ⟨ε / 4, by positivity,
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)).trans hsub,
      fun u => β u • Y u, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro u
      by_cases hu : u ∈ Metric.closedBall c (ε / 2)
      · exact (β.contDiff.contDiffAt).smul (hY.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds (hsub hu)))
      · have hev : (fun u => β u • Y u) =ᶠ[𝓝 u] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
          filter_upwards [isClosed_closedBall.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hu] with v hv
          rw [hβ0 v hv, zero_smul]
        exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    · refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall c (ε / 2)) ?_
      intro v hv
      show β v • Y v = 0
      rw [hβ0 v hv, zero_smul]
    · intro u hu
      show β u • Y u = Y u
      rw [β.one_of_mem_closedBall hu, one_smul]
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrO, X, hX, hXc, hXY⟩ := hcutoff _ hO _ hc _ hY
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hF0, hFd⟩ := ode_flow_contDiff X hX hXc
  
  have hkerF : ∀ (t : ℝ) (u : E3) (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
      fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) (t, u) (a, w) = 0 →
      w = -a • fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) (0, u) (1, 0) := by
    have hGd : Differentiable ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) := hF.differentiable (by simp)
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := ContDiff.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hXc hX (by simp)
    have hgrp : ∀ s t u, F (t + s) u = F t (F s u) := by
      intro s t u
      have h := ODE_solution_unique_univ (v := fun _ => X) (s := fun _ => Set.univ) (K := K)
        (f := fun t => F (t + s) u) (g := fun t => F t (F s u)) (t₀ := 0)
        (fun _ => hK.lipschitzOnWith)
        (fun t => ⟨HasDerivAt.comp_add_const t s (hFd (t + s) u), Set.mem_univ _⟩)
        (fun t => ⟨hFd t (F s u), Set.mem_univ _⟩)
        (by simp only [zero_add, hF0])
      exact congrFun h t
    have hDt : ∀ (t : ℝ) (v : E3), HasFDerivAt (F t)
        ((fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) (t, v)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E3)) v := by
      intro t v
      exact (hGd (t, v)).hasFDerivAt.comp v (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right t v)
    have hinj : ∀ (t : ℝ) (u : E3), Function.Injective
        ((fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) (t, u)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E3)) := by
      intro t u
      have hcomp := (hDt (-t) (F t u)).comp u (hDt t u)
      have hid : (F (-t) ∘ F t) = id := by
        funext v
        show F (-t) (F t v) = v
        rw [← hgrp t (-t) v, neg_add_cancel, hF0]
      rw [hid] at hcomp
      have heq := hcomp.unique (hasFDerivAt_id u)
      refine Function.LeftInverse.injective
        (g := fun z => (fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) (-t, F t u)).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E3) z) ?_
      intro v
      have := congrArg (fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => T v) heq
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] using this
    have hflowX : ∀ (t : ℝ) (u : E3),
        ((fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) (t, u)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E3)) (X u)
          = X (F t u) := by
      intro t u
      have hA := (hDt t (F 0 u)).comp_hasDerivAt 0 (hFd 0 u)
      rw [hF0] at hA
      have hB : HasDerivAt (fun s => F (t + s) u) (X (F t u)) 0 := by
        have h := HasDerivAt.comp_const_add t 0 (hFd (t + 0) u)
        rw [add_zero] at h
        exact h
      have hfun : (F t ∘ fun s => F s u) = fun s => F (t + s) u :=
        funext fun s => (hgrp s t u).symm
      rw [hfun] at hA
      exact hA.unique hB
    have hL10 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (u : E3), fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) (t, u) (1, 0) = X (F t u) := by
      intro t u
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s, u)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) t :=
        (hasDerivAt_id t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t u)
      have h2 := (hGd (t, u)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h1
      exact h2.unique (hFd t u)
    intro t u a w hk
    have hdec : fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) (t, u) (a, w) =
        ((fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) (t, u)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E3))
          (a • X u + w) := by
      have hsplit : ((a, w) : ℝ × E3) = a • ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) + ((0 : ℝ), w) :=
        Prod.ext (by simp) (by simp)
      rw [hsplit]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, hL10, hflowX]
      rfl
    rw [hdec] at hk
    have h1 : a • X u + w = 0 := hinj t u (by rw [hk, map_zero])
    have h2 : fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) (0, u) (1, 0) = X u := by
      rw [hL10, hF0]
    rw [h2, neg_smul]
    exact eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero.2 (by rw [add_comm]; exact h1)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hX.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hXc
  have hK₀0 : 0 ≤ max C 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hXK : ∀ v, ‖X v‖ ≤ max C 0 := fun v => (hC v).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hρ0 : 0 < r / 2 := by positivity
  have hK1 : 0 < max C 0 + 1 := by linarith
  have hτ0 : 0 < r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1) := div_pos hρ0 hK1
  have hKτ : max C 0 * (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1)) < r / 2 := by
    rw [← mul_div_assoc, div_lt_iff₀ hK1]
    nlinarith
  have hdisp : ∀ u t, ‖F t u - u‖ ≤ max C 0 * |t| := by
    intro u t
    have h := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (f := fun s => F s u) (f' := fun s => X (F s u))
      (fun s _ => (hFd s u).hasDerivWithinAt) (fun s _ => hXK _) convex_univ
      (Set.mem_univ 0) (Set.mem_univ t)
    simpa only [hF0, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h
  have hstay : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2), ∀ t : ℝ,
      |t| < r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1) → F t u ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) r := by
    intro u hu t ht
    have h1 := hdisp u t
    have h2 : max C 0 * |t| ≤ max C 0 * (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht.le hK₀0
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hu ⊢
    calc dist (F t u) (chartAt E3 q q) ≤ dist (F t u) u + dist u (chartAt E3 q q) :=
          dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < r / 2 + r / 2 := by rw [dist_eq_norm]; linarith
      _ = r := by ring
  
  have hB'o : IsOpen (((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B) :=
    ((chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball).inter hB
  have hqB' : q ∈ ((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B :=
    ⟨⟨mem_chart_source E3 q, Metric.mem_ball_self hρ0⟩, hq⟩
  have hB'src : ((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B
      ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source := fun y hy => hy.1.1
  have hmem : ∀ y ∈ ((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B,
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-(r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1)),
      F t (chartAt E3 q y) ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 q q) r ∧
      (chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y)) ∈ B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧
      chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y))) = F t (chartAt E3 q y) := by
    intro y hy t ht
    have hb := hstay (chartAt E3 q y) hy.1.2 t (abs_lt.2 ht)
    have hcb : F t (chartAt E3 q y) ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 q q) r :=
      Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hb
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzeq⟩ := hrO hcb
    have htgt : F t (chartAt E3 q y) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      rw [← hzeq]; exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source hz.2
    refine ⟨hcb, ?_, (chartAt E3 q).right_inv htgt⟩
    rw [← hzeq, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hz.2]
    exact hz
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-(r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1)) :=
    ⟨by linarith, hτ0⟩
  have hFl0 : ∀ y ∈ ((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B,
      (chartAt E3 q).symm (F 0 (chartAt E3 q y)) = y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hF0, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hy.1.1]
  have hcurve : ∀ y ∈ ((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B,
      IsMIntegralCurveOn (fun t => (chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y)))
        (fun x => Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x))
        (Set.Ioo (-(r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) := by
    intro y hy
    unfold IsMIntegralCurveOn
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨hcb, hzB, htgt⟩ := hmem y hy t ht
    have htg : F t (chartAt E3 q y) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      rw [← htgt]; exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source hzB.2
    have hd := hFd t (chartAt E3 q y)
    rw [hXY _ hcb] at hd
    set x := (chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y)) with hxdef
    have hx : x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := hzB.2
    have hζx : F t (chartAt E3 q y) = chartAt E3 q x := htgt.symm
    have h1 : HasMFDerivAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (fun s => F s (chartAt E3 q y)) t
        (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) x (Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x)))) :=
      hasMFDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.2 (hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt.1 hd)
    have h2 : HasMFDerivAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y))) :=
      (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) htg).hasMFDerivAt
    have h3 := (h2.comp t h1).hasMFDerivWithinAt
      (s := Set.Ioo (-(r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1)))
    have hkey : (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) x (Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x)))) =
        (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x)) := by
      apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_ring
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, one_smul,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.one_apply, one_smul, hζx]
      have hinv0 := (mdifferentiable_chart (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) q).symm_comp_deriv hx
      have hinv := congrArg
        (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => L (Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x))) hinv0
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] using hinv
    rw [hkey] at h3
    exact h3
  have hpt : ∀ y ∈ ((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B,
      (chartAt E3 q).symm (F 0 (chartAt E3 q y)) = y ∧
      IsMIntegralCurveOn (fun t => (chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y)))
        (fun x => Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x))
        (Set.Ioo (-(r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) ∧
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-(r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1)),
        (chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y)) ∈ B ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧
        f ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y))) = f y + t := by
    intro y hy
    refine ⟨hFl0 y hy, hcurve y hy, fun t ht => ⟨(hmem y hy t ht).2.1, ?_⟩⟩
    have haff := tau_affine_along_integral_curve B hB f hf.contMDiffOn
      (fun x => Ng x (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x))
      (fun x hx => hNg2 x _ (hdf x hx))
      (fun t => (chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y))) _ _ 0 h0 (hcurve y hy)
      (fun s hs => (hmem y hy s hs).2.1.1) t ht
    simp only at haff
    rw [haff, hFl0 y hy, sub_zero]
  
  have hWo : IsOpen (Set.Ioo (-(r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1)) ×ˢ
      (chartAt E3 q '' (((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B))) :=
    isOpen_Ioo.prod ((chartAt E3 q).isOpen_image_of_subset_source hB'o hB'src)
  have hGeq : ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo (-(r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1)) ×ˢ
      (chartAt E3 q '' (((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B)),
      chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F p.1 (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2)))) =
        F p.1 p.2 := by
    rintro ⟨t, u⟩ ⟨ht, y, hy, rfl⟩
    simp only
    rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv (hB'src hy)]
    exact (hmem y hy t ht).2.2
  have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F p.1 (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2)))))
      (Set.Ioo (-(r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1)) ×ˢ
      (chartAt E3 q '' (((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B))) :=
    hF.contDiffOn.congr hGeq
  have hev : ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo (-(r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1)) ×ˢ
      (chartAt E3 q '' (((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B)),
      (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F p.1 (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2)))))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun p : ℝ × E3 => F p.1 p.2) :=
    fun p hp => Filter.eventually_of_mem (hWo.mem_nhds hp) hGeq
  have hkernel : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-(r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1))) (r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1)),
      ∀ u ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B),
      ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
      fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F p.1 (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2)))))
        (t, u) (a, w) = 0 →
      w = -a • fderiv ℝ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F p.1 (chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 q).symm p.2)))))
        (0, u) (1, 0) := by
    intro t ht u hu a w hk
    rw [(hev (t, u) ⟨ht, hu⟩).fderiv_eq] at hk
    rw [(hev (0, u) ⟨h0, hu⟩).fderiv_eq]
    exact hkerF t u a w hk
  exact ⟨((chartAt E3 q).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) (r / 2)) ∩ B,
    r / 2 / (max C 0 + 1), fun t y => (chartAt E3 q).symm (F t (chartAt E3 q y)),
    hB'o, hqB', Set.inter_subset_right, hτ0, hpt, hsmooth, hkernel⟩
