informal_problem.statement:
(Ω : Set E3) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h Ω) (u₀ : E3) (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ Ω) (h0 : h u₀ = 0)
    (hd : fderiv ℝ h u₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (W : Set E2) (Fh : E2 → E3) (x₀ : E2), IsOpen W ∧ x₀ ∈ W ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fh W ∧
      Fh x₀ = u₀ ∧ Set.InjOn Fh W ∧
      ∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ Ω ∧ h (Fh x) = 0 ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Fh x)

signature.name: regular_zero_set_local_param
signature.statement:
(Ω : Set E3) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h Ω) (u₀ : E3) (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ Ω) (h0 : h u₀ = 0)
    (hd : fderiv ℝ h u₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (W : Set E2) (Fh : E2 → E3) (x₀ : E2), IsOpen W ∧ x₀ ∈ W ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fh W ∧
      Fh x₀ = u₀ ∧ Set.InjOn Fh W ∧
      ∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ Ω ∧ h (Fh x) = 0 ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Fh x)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := fderiv ℝ h u₀ with hLdef
  
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, L w ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    exact hd (ContinuousLinearMap.ext hcon)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : E3, L v = 1 :=
    ⟨(L w)⁻¹ • w, by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hw]⟩
  
  set A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - L.smulRight v with hAdef
  have hA : ∀ z, A z = z - L z • v := fun z => by
    simp [hAdef]
  
  set P : E3 → E3 := fun u => h u • v + (A u - A u₀) with hPdef
  have hLP : ∀ u, L (P u) = h u := by
    intro u
    simp only [hPdef, hA, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hv]
    ring
  have hP0 : P u₀ = 0 := by
    simp only [hPdef, h0, zero_smul, sub_self, add_zero]
  have hPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P Ω :=
    (hh.smul contDiffOn_const).add ((A.contDiff.sub contDiff_const).contDiffOn)
  have hhd : ∀ u ∈ Ω, HasFDerivAt h (fderiv ℝ h u) u := fun u hu =>
    ((hh.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hu)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have hPd : ∀ u ∈ Ω, HasFDerivAt P ((fderiv ℝ h u).smulRight v + A) u := by
    intro u hu
    exact ((hhd u hu).smul_const v).add (A.hasFDerivAt.sub_const (A u₀))
  have hDinj : ∀ u, fderiv ℝ h u v ≠ 0 →
      Function.Injective ((fderiv ℝ h u).smulRight v + A) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro z hz
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, hA] at hz
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ h u z = 0 := by
      have h2 := congrArg L hz
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_sub, map_smul, hv, map_zero, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h2
      linarith
    rw [h1, zero_smul, zero_add, sub_eq_zero] at hz
    have h2 : L z * fderiv ℝ h u v = 0 := by
      have h3 := congrArg (fderiv ℝ h u) hz
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, h1] at h3
      exact h3.symm
    have h3 : L z = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_right hu
    rw [hz, h3, zero_smul]
  
  set U : Set E3 := Ω ∩ (fun u => fderiv ℝ h u v) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ with hUdef
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun u => fderiv ℝ h u v) Ω :=
    (hh.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩ (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hUo : IsOpen U := hcont.isOpen_inter_preimage hΩ isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hu₀U : u₀ ∈ U := by
    refine ⟨hu₀, ?_⟩
    show L v ∈ ({0}ᶜ : Set ℝ)
    rw [hv]
    exact one_ne_zero
  have hequiv : ∀ u ∈ U, ∃ E' : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3,
      (E' : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) = (fderiv ℝ h u).smulRight v + A := by
    intro u hu
    have hi := hDinj u hu.2
    have hs : Function.Surjective ((fderiv ℝ h u).smulRight v + A) :=
      (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective
        (f := (((fderiv ℝ h u).smulRight v + A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3))).mp hi
    refine ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective ((fderiv ℝ h u).smulRight v + A)
      (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hi) (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hs), ?_⟩
    exact ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_ofBijective _ _ _
  have hcd : ∀ u ∈ Ω, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ P u := fun u hu => hPs.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hu)
  obtain ⟨E₀, hE₀⟩ := hequiv u₀ hu₀U
  have hPd₀ : HasFDerivAt P (E₀ : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) u₀ := by
    rw [hE₀]; exact hPd u₀ hu₀
  
  let Φ := ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph P (hcd u₀ hu₀) hPd₀ (by simp)
  have hΦc : (Φ : E3 → E3) = P := ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe _ _ _
  have hsrc : u₀ ∈ Φ.source := ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source _ _ _
  have htgt : P u₀ ∈ Φ.target := ContDiffAt.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target _ _ _
  set T : Set E3 := Φ.target ∩ Φ.symm ⁻¹' U with hTdef
  have hTo : IsOpen T := Φ.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage Φ.open_target hUo
  have hQP : Φ.symm (P u₀) = u₀ := by
    have := Φ.left_inv hsrc
    rw [hΦc] at this
    exact this
  have hPT : P u₀ ∈ T := ⟨htgt, by show Φ.symm (P u₀) ∈ U; rw [hQP]; exact hu₀U⟩
  have hQ : ∀ y ∈ T, Φ.symm y ∈ U ∧ P (Φ.symm y) = y ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Φ.symm y ∧
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ.symm y) := by
    intro y hy
    have hu : Φ.symm y ∈ U := hy.2
    obtain ⟨E', hE'⟩ := hequiv _ hu
    have hfd : HasFDerivAt Φ (E' : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (Φ.symm y) := by
      rw [hΦc, hE']; exact hPd _ hu.1
    have hcd' : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Φ (Φ.symm y) := by
      rw [hΦc]; exact hcd _ hu.1
    have hPQ : P (Φ.symm y) = y := by
      have := Φ.right_inv hy.1
      rw [hΦc] at this
      exact this
    refine ⟨hu, hPQ, Φ.contDiffAt_symm hy.1 hfd hcd', ?_⟩
    rw [(Φ.hasFDerivAt_symm hy.1 hfd).fderiv]
    exact E'.symm.injective
  
  obtain ⟨J, hJi, hJL⟩ : ∃ J : E2 →L[ℝ] E3, Function.Injective J ∧ ∀ x, L (J x) = 0 := by
    have hsurj : LinearMap.range (L : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) = ⊤ := by
      rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top]
      intro t
      refine ⟨t • v, ?_⟩
      show L (t • v) = t
      rw [map_smul, hv, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have hrk := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (L : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    rw [hsurj, finrank_top, Module.finrank_self, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin] at hrk
    have hK : Module.finrank ℝ E2 = Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (L : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) := by
      rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]; omega
    let eK : E2 ≃ₗ[ℝ] LinearMap.ker (L : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) := LinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq E2 _ hK
    refine ⟨LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      ((LinearMap.ker (L : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)).subtype ∘ₗ eK.toLinearMap), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact eK.injective (Subtype.val_injective hxy)
    · intro x
      exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp (eK x).2
  
  refine ⟨J ⁻¹' T, fun x => Φ.symm (J x), 0, hTo.preimage J.continuous, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show J 0 ∈ T
    rw [map_zero, ← hP0]
    exact hPT
  · intro x hx
    exact ((hQ _ hx).2.2.1.comp x J.contDiff.contDiffAt).contDiffWithinAt
  · show Φ.symm (J 0) = u₀
    rw [map_zero, ← hP0]
    exact hQP
  · intro x hx x' hx' hxx'
    apply hJi
    calc J x = P (Φ.symm (J x)) := ((hQ _ hx).2.1).symm
      _ = P (Φ.symm (J x')) := congrArg P hxx'
      _ = J x' := (hQ _ hx').2.1
  · intro x hx
    refine ⟨(hQ _ hx).1.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hLP, (hQ _ hx).2.1]
      exact hJL x
    · have hQd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ.symm (J x) :=
        (hQ _ hx).2.2.1.differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hcomp : fderiv ℝ (fun x => Φ.symm (J x)) x = (fderiv ℝ Φ.symm (J x)).comp J := by
        have := fderiv_comp x hQd J.differentiableAt
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv] at this
        exact this
      rw [hcomp]
      exact (hQ _ hx).2.2.2.comp hJi

informal_problem.statement:
(τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (Fhat : ℝ × E3 → E3) (hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fhat (Set.Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ V))
    (hker0 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ w : E3, fderiv ℝ Fhat (t, u) (0, w) = 0 → w = 0)
    (hinj : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ u' ∈ V, Fhat (t, u) = Fhat (t, u') → u = u')
    (fh : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hfh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ fh T) (hVT : V ⊆ T)
    (haff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, fh (Fhat (t, u)) = fh u + t)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
      fderiv ℝ fh (Fhat (t, u)) (fderiv ℝ Fhat (t, u) (a, w)) = a + fderiv ℝ fh u w)
    (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (Fh : E2 → E3) (hFh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fh W)
    (hFhV : ∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ V) (hFh0 : ∀ x ∈ W, fh (Fh x) = 0)
    (hFhd : ∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Fh x)) (hFhi : Set.InjOn Fh W)
    (μ : E2 → ℝ) (hμ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ μ W) (hμ0 : ∀ x ∈ W, μ x ≠ 0) :
    IsOpen {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y)))
      {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ} ∧
    Set.InjOn (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y)))
      {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ} ∧
    (∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ},
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y))) y)) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ W, partialDeriv 0 (fun y : E3 => fh (Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y))))
      (hpLift 0 x) = μ x)

signature.statement:
(τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (Fhat : ℝ × E3 → E3) (hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fhat (Set.Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ V))
    (hker0 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ w : E3, fderiv ℝ Fhat (t, u) (0, w) = 0 → w = 0)
    (hinj : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ u' ∈ V, Fhat (t, u) = Fhat (t, u') → u = u')
    (fh : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hfh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ fh T) (hVT : V ⊆ T)
    (haff : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, fh (Fhat (t, u)) = fh u + t)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ, ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ (a : ℝ) (w : E3),
      fderiv ℝ fh (Fhat (t, u)) (fderiv ℝ Fhat (t, u) (a, w)) = a + fderiv ℝ fh u w)
    (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (Fh : E2 → E3) (hFh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fh W)
    (hFhV : ∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ V) (hFh0 : ∀ x ∈ W, fh (Fh x) = 0)
    (hFhd : ∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Fh x)) (hFhi : Set.InjOn Fh W)
    (μ : E2 → ℝ) (hμ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ μ W) (hμ0 : ∀ x ∈ W, μ x ≠ 0) :
    IsOpen {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y)))
      {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ} ∧
    Set.InjOn (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y)))
      {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ} ∧
    (∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | hpProj y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (hpProj y)| < τ},
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y))) y)) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ W, partialDeriv 0 (fun y : E3 => fh (Fhat (y 0 * μ (hpProj y), Fh (hpProj y))))
      (hpLift 0 x) = μ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hadd : ∀ a b : E3, hpProj (a + b) = hpProj a + hpProj b := by
    intro a b; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj]
  have hsmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (a : E3), hpProj (c • a) = c • hpProj a := by
    intro c a; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj]
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : E3 →L[ℝ] E2, hpProj = ⇑P :=
    ⟨LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := hpProj, map_add' := hadd, map_smul' := hsmul }, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : ∀ z : E3, (P z) 0 = z 1 := by
    intro z; rw [← hP]; simp [hpProj]
  have hc1 : ∀ z : E3, (P z) 1 = z 2 := by
    intro z; rw [← hP]; simp [hpProj]
  have hsep : ∀ y y' : E3, y 0 = y' 0 → P y = P y' → y = y' := by
    intro y y' h0 h
    have h1 : y 1 = y' 1 := by rw [← hc0 y, ← hc0 y', h]
    have h2 : y 2 = y' 2 := by rw [← hc1 y, ← hc1 y', h]
    ext j; fin_cases j
    exacts [h0, h1, h2]
  have hl0 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), (hpLift t x) 0 = t := by
    intro t x; simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hlP : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), P (hpLift t x) = x := by
    intro t x; rw [← hP]; ext i; fin_cases i <;>
      simp [hpProj, hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPe0 : P (e 0) = 0 := by
    rw [← hP]; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have he00 : (e 0 : E3) 0 = 1 := by simp [e]
  rw [hP]
  set Ω := {y : E3 | P y ∈ W ∧ |y 0 * μ (P y)| < τ} with hΩdef
  
  have hWp : IsOpen (P ⁻¹' W) := hW.preimage P.continuous
  have hk : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => y 0 * μ (P y)) (P ⁻¹' W) := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => y 0) (P ⁻¹' W) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffOn
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => μ (P y)) (P ⁻¹' W) :=
      hμ.comp P.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun y hy => hy)
    exact h1.mul h2
  have hΩo : IsOpen Ω :=
    (continuous_abs.comp_continuousOn hk.continuousOn).isOpen_inter_preimage hWp isOpen_Iio
  
  have hψs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y))) Ω :=
    (hk.mono (fun y hy => hy.1)).prodMk
      ((hFh.comp P.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun y hy => hy)).mono (fun y hy => hy.1))
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun y : E3 => (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y))) Ω
      (Set.Ioo (-τ) τ ×ˢ V) :=
    fun y hy => ⟨abs_lt.mp hy.2, hFhV _ hy.1⟩
  have hφs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y))) Ω :=
    hFs.comp hψs hmaps
  
  have hval : ∀ y ∈ Ω, fh (Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y))) = y 0 * μ (P y) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [haff _ (abs_lt.mp hy.2) _ (hFhV _ hy.1), hFh0 _ hy.1, zero_add]
  
  have hC3 : Set.InjOn (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y))) Ω := by
    intro y hy y' hy' h
    have h' : Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y)) = Fhat (y' 0 * μ (P y'), Fh (P y')) := h
    have ht : y 0 * μ (P y) = y' 0 * μ (P y') := by
      calc y 0 * μ (P y) = fh (Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y))) := (hval y hy).symm
        _ = fh (Fhat (y' 0 * μ (P y'), Fh (P y'))) := by rw [h']
        _ = y' 0 * μ (P y') := hval y' hy'
    rw [ht] at h'
    have hu := hinj _ (abs_lt.mp hy'.2) _ (hFhV _ hy.1) _ (hFhV _ hy'.1) h'
    have hx : P y = P y' := hFhi hy.1 hy'.1 hu
    rw [hx] at ht
    have h0 : y 0 = y' 0 := mul_right_cancel₀ (hμ0 _ hy'.1) ht
    exact hsep y y' h0 hx
  
  have hkd : ∀ y : E3, P y ∈ W → ∃ ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y 0 * μ (P y)) ℓ y ∧
      ∀ v : E3, ℓ v = v 0 * μ (P y) + y 0 * fderiv ℝ μ (P y) (P v) := by
    intro y hyW
    have hμd : DifferentiableAt ℝ μ (P y) :=
      (hμ.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hyW)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y 0) (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => μ (P y)) ((fderiv ℝ μ (P y)).comp P) y :=
      hμd.hasFDerivAt.comp y P.hasFDerivAt
    refine ⟨_, h0.mul h1, fun v => ?_⟩
    have hpv : (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) v = v 0 := rfl
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul, hpv]
    ring
  
  have htan : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ z : E2, fderiv ℝ fh (Fh x) (fderiv ℝ Fh x z) = 0 := by
    intro x hx z
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Fh x :=
      (hFh.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ fh (Fh x) :=
      (hfh.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds (hVT (hFhV x hx)))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hev : (fh ∘ Fh) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun x' hx' => hFh0 x' hx')
    have h1 := hev.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
    rw [fderiv_comp x hfd hFd, fderiv_const_apply] at h1
    have h2 := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L z) h1
    simpa using h2
  
  have hC4 : ∀ y ∈ Ω,
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y))) y) := by
    intro y hy
    have hyW : P y ∈ W := hy.1
    have ht : y 0 * μ (P y) ∈ Set.Ioo (-τ) τ := abs_lt.mp hy.2
    have hu : Fh (P y) ∈ V := hFhV _ hyW
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Fh (P y) :=
      (hFh.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hyW)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, hℓv⟩ := hkd y hyW
    have hL : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => Fh (P y)) ((fderiv ℝ Fh (P y)).comp P) y :=
      hFd.hasFDerivAt.comp y P.hasFDerivAt
    have hψ := hℓ.prodMk hL
    have hFhatd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y)) :=
      (hFs.contDiffAt ((isOpen_Ioo.prod hV).mem_nhds ⟨ht, hu⟩)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hφd : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y)))
        ((fderiv ℝ Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y))).comp
          (ℓ.prod ((fderiv ℝ Fh (P y)).comp P))) y :=
      hFhatd.hasFDerivAt.comp y hψ
    rw [hφd.fderiv, injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro v hv
    have hv' : fderiv ℝ Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y))
        (ℓ v, fderiv ℝ Fh (P y) (P v)) = 0 := hv
    have hd := hderiv _ ht _ hu (ℓ v) (fderiv ℝ Fh (P y) (P v))
    rw [hv', map_zero, htan _ hyW, add_zero] at hd
    rw [← hd] at hv'
    have hw := hker0 _ ht _ hu _ hv'
    have hPv : P v = 0 := hFhd _ hyW (by rw [hw, map_zero])
    have hℓ0 : ℓ v = v 0 * μ (P y) := by
      rw [hℓv, hPv, map_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
    have hv0 : v 0 = 0 := by
      have h3 : v 0 * μ (P y) = 0 := by rw [← hℓ0, ← hd]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h3 with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h (hμ0 _ hyW)
    exact hsep v 0 (by rw [hv0]; rfl) (by rw [hPv, map_zero])
  
  have hC5 : ∀ x ∈ W, partialDeriv 0 (fun y : E3 => fh (Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y))))
      (hpLift 0 x) = μ x := by
    intro x hx
    have hy1 : hpLift 0 x ∈ Ω :=
      ⟨by rw [hlP]; exact hx, by rw [hl0, zero_mul, abs_zero]; exact hτ⟩
    have hev : (fun y : E3 => fh (Fhat (y 0 * μ (P y), Fh (P y))))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 (hpLift 0 x)] (fun y : E3 => y 0 * μ (P y)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hΩo.mem_nhds hy1) hval
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, hℓv⟩ := hkd (hpLift 0 x) (by rw [hlP]; exact hx)
    rw [hℓ.fderiv, hℓv, hl0, hlP, hPe0, he00, map_zero]
    ring
  exact ⟨hΩo, hφs, hC3, hC4, hC5⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (z : M) (Ω : Set E3)
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (φ : E3 → E3) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ Ω) (hinj : Set.InjOn φ Ω)
    (hφt : ∀ y ∈ Ω, φ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target)
    (hder : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ φ y)) :
    ∃ Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      Φ.source = Ω ∧ ∀ y ∈ Ω, Φ y = (chartAt E3 z).symm (φ y)

signature.name: partialDiffeomorph_of_injOn
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (z : M) (Ω : Set E3)
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (φ : E3 → E3) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ Ω) (hinj : Set.InjOn φ Ω)
    (hφt : ∀ y ∈ Ω, φ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target)
    (hder : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ φ y)) :
    ∃ Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      Φ.source = Ω ∧ ∀ y ∈ Ω, Φ y = (chartAt E3 z).symm (φ y)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hstrict : ∀ y ∈ Ω, ∃ L : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3, HasStrictFDerivAt φ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) y := by
    intro y hy
    let Lin := LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo
      ((fderiv ℝ φ y : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) (hder y hy)
    refine ⟨Lin.toContinuousLinearEquiv, ?_⟩
    have hφy : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φ y := hφ.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hy)
    have h1 := hφy.hasStrictFDerivAt (by simp)
    have heq : ((Lin.toContinuousLinearEquiv : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) = fderiv ℝ φ y :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => by simp [Lin]
    rw [heq]
    exact h1
  
  have hV : IsOpen (φ '' Ω) := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨L, hs⟩ := hstrict y hy
    rw [← hs.map_nhds_eq_of_equiv]
    exact Filter.image_mem_map (hΩ.mem_nhds hy)
  
  have hψpos : ∀ b ∈ φ '' Ω, Function.invFunOn φ Ω b ∈ Ω ∧
      φ (Function.invFunOn φ Ω b) = b := fun b hb => Function.invFunOn_pos hb
  have hψleft : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Function.invFunOn φ Ω (φ y) = y :=
    fun y hy => hinj.leftInvOn_invFunOn hy
  
  have hψsmooth : ∀ y ∈ Ω, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Function.invFunOn φ Ω) (φ y) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨L, hs⟩ := hstrict y hy
    have hφy : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φ y := hφ.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hy)
    have hyP : y ∈ (hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).source :=
      hs.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
    have hPc : ((hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ) : E3 → E3) = φ :=
      hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe
    have hbP : φ y ∈ (hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).target :=
      hs.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target
    have hPy : (hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).symm (φ y) = y := by
      have := (hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).left_inv hyP
      rwa [hPc] at this
    have hsymm : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).symm (φ y) := by
      apply (hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).contDiffAt_symm hbP (f₀' := L)
      · rw [hPy, hPc]; exact hs.hasFDerivAt
      · rw [hPy, hPc]; exact hφy
    have hev : Function.invFunOn φ Ω =ᶠ[𝓝 (φ y)] (hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).symm := by
      have hN1 : (hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).target ∈ 𝓝 (φ y) :=
        (hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).open_target.mem_nhds hbP
      have hN2 : (hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).symm ⁻¹' Ω ∈ 𝓝 (φ y) := by
        apply ((hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).continuousAt_symm hbP).preimage_mem_nhds
        rw [hPy]; exact hΩ.mem_nhds hy
      filter_upwards [hN1, hN2] with b hb1 hb2
      have hφb : φ ((hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).symm b) = b := by
        have := (hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph φ).right_inv hb1
        rwa [hPc] at this
      have h := hψpos b ⟨_, hb2, hφb⟩
      apply hinj h.1 hb2
      rw [h.2, hφb]
    exact hsymm.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hψon : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.invFunOn φ Ω) (φ '' Ω) := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (hψsmooth y hy).contDiffWithinAt
  
  let e₀ : PartialEquiv E3 M :=
    { toFun := fun y => (chartAt E3 z).symm (φ y)
      invFun := fun w => Function.invFunOn φ Ω (chartAt E3 z w)
      source := Ω
      target := (chartAt E3 z).source ∩ (chartAt E3 z) ⁻¹' (φ '' Ω)
      map_source' := fun y hy => ⟨(chartAt E3 z).map_target (hφt y hy), by
        show (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (φ y)) ∈ φ '' Ω
        rw [(chartAt E3 z).right_inv (hφt y hy)]
        exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩
      map_target' := fun w hw => (hψpos _ hw.2).1
      left_inv' := fun y hy => by
        show Function.invFunOn φ Ω ((chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (φ y))) = y
        rw [(chartAt E3 z).right_inv (hφt y hy)]
        exact hψleft y hy
      right_inv' := fun w hw => by
        show (chartAt E3 z).symm (φ (Function.invFunOn φ Ω ((chartAt E3 z) w))) = w
        rw [(hψpos _ hw.2).2]
        exact (chartAt E3 z).left_inv hw.1 }
  have hto : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun y => (chartAt E3 z).symm (φ y)) Ω :=
    (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := z)).comp hφ.contMDiffOn (fun y hy => hφt y hy)
  have hinv : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞
      (fun w => Function.invFunOn φ Ω (chartAt E3 z w))
      ((chartAt E3 z).source ∩ (chartAt E3 z) ⁻¹' (φ '' Ω)) :=
    hψon.contMDiffOn.comp ((contMDiffOn_chart (x := z)).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
      (fun w hw => hw.2)
  refine ⟨{ toPartialEquiv := e₀
            open_source := hΩ
            open_target := (chartAt E3 z).isOpen_inter_preimage hV
            contMDiffOn_toFun := hto
            contMDiffOn_invFun := hinv }, rfl, fun y _ => rfl⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig : Set M) (q : M) (hq : q ∈ Sig) (V₁ V₂ : Set M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ)
    (hV₁ : IsOpen V₁) (hV₂ : IsOpen V₂) (hq₁ : q ∈ V₁) (hq₂ : q ∈ V₂)
    (hf₁ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₁) (hf₂ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₂)
    (hd₁ : ∀ x ∈ V₁, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x ≠ 0)
    (hd₂ : ∀ x ∈ V₂, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ x ≠ 0)
    (hS₁ : V₁ ∩ Sig = V₁ ∩ f₁ ⁻¹' {0}) (hS₂ : V₂ ∩ Sig = V₂ ∩ f₂ ⁻¹' {0})
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ Φ.source) (hΦy : Φ y = q) :
    ∃ u : ℝ, u ≠ 0 ∧ g.gradInner f₂ f₂ q = u ^ 2 * g.gradInner f₁ f₁ q ∧
      partialDeriv 0 (fun y' => f₂ (Φ y')) y = u * partialDeriv 0 (fun y' => f₁ (Φ y')) y

signature.name: defining_function_lapse_ratio
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Sig : Set M) (q : M) (hq : q ∈ Sig) (V₁ V₂ : Set M) (f₁ f₂ : M → ℝ)
    (hV₁ : IsOpen V₁) (hV₂ : IsOpen V₂) (hq₁ : q ∈ V₁) (hq₂ : q ∈ V₂)
    (hf₁ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₁) (hf₂ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f₂)
    (hd₁ : ∀ x ∈ V₁, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₁ x ≠ 0)
    (hd₂ : ∀ x ∈ V₂, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f₂ x ≠ 0)
    (hS₁ : V₁ ∩ Sig = V₁ ∩ f₁ ⁻¹' {0}) (hS₂ : V₂ ∩ Sig = V₂ ∩ f₂ ⁻¹' {0})
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ Φ.source) (hΦy : Φ y = q) :
    ∃ u : ℝ, u ≠ 0 ∧ g.gradInner f₂ f₂ q = u ^ 2 * g.gradInner f₁ f₁ q ∧
      partialDeriv 0 (fun y' => f₂ (Φ y')) y = u * partialDeriv 0 (fun y' => f₁ (Φ y')) y

proof.tactics:
by
  have coord_div : ∀ (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (f h : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U)
      (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U) (hf0 : f y₀ = 0)
      (hdf : fderiv ℝ f y₀ ≠ 0) (hz : ∀ y ∈ U, f y = 0 → h y = 0),
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ u : E3 → ℝ, Metric.ball y₀ r ⊆ U ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u (Metric.ball y₀ r) ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, h y = f y * u y := by
    intro U hU f h hf hh y₀ hy₀ hf0 hdf hz
    
    have s4 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [CompleteSpace F]
        (G : E3 → ℝ → F), ContDiff ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (Function.uncurry G) → ∀ a b : ℝ,
        ContDiff ℝ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun z => ∫ t in a..b, G z t) := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        intro F _ _ _ G hG a b
        rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiff_zero] at hG ⊢
        exact intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' hG a b
      | succ n ih =>
        intro F _ _ _ G hG a b
        rw [Nat.cast_succ] at hG ⊢
        rw [contDiff_succ_iff_hasFDerivAt]
        let D : E3 → ℝ → (E3 →L[ℝ] F) := fun z t =>
          (fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry G) (z, t)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E3 ℝ)
        have hGd : Differentiable ℝ (Function.uncurry G) := hG.differentiable (by simp)
        have hDc : ContDiff ℝ n (Function.uncurry D) := by
          have h1 : ContDiff ℝ n (fderiv ℝ (Function.uncurry G)) := hG.fderiv_right le_rfl
          exact h1.clm_comp contDiff_const
        have hpt : ∀ z t, HasFDerivAt (fun z' => G z' t) (D z t) z := by
          intro z t
          have h := (hGd (z, t)).hasFDerivAt.comp z (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left (𝕜 := ℝ) z t)
          exact h
        refine ⟨fun z => ∫ t in a..b, D z t, ih (E3 →L[ℝ] F) D hDc a b, fun z₀ => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ((isCompact_closedBall z₀ 1).prod
          (isCompact_uIcc (a := a) (b := b))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
          hDc.continuous.continuousOn
        have hGc : Continuous (Function.uncurry G) := hG.continuous
        have hGt : ∀ z, Continuous (G z) := fun z => hGc.comp (Continuous.prodMk_right z)
        have hDt : ∀ z, Continuous (D z) := fun z => hDc.continuous.comp (Continuous.prodMk_right z)
        haveI : SecondCountableTopologyEither ℝ (E3 →L[ℝ] F) :=
          secondCountableTopologyEither_of_left ℝ _
        haveI : SecondCountableTopologyEither ℝ F :=
          secondCountableTopologyEither_of_left ℝ _
        refine intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (μ := volume)
          (bound := fun _ => C) (ball_mem_nhds z₀ one_pos)
          (Eventually.of_forall fun z => (hGt z).aestronglyMeasurable)
          ((hGt z₀).intervalIntegrable a b) (hDt z₀).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
          intervalIntegrable_const ?_
        · refine Eventually.of_forall fun t ht x hx => ?_
          exact hC (x, t) ⟨ball_subset_closedBall hx, Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc ht⟩
        · exact Eventually.of_forall fun t _ x _ => hpt x t
    
    have s2 : ∀ (φ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : E3), 1 + φ w ≠ 0 →
        ∃ A : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3, (A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 + φ.smulRight w := by
      intro φ w hw
      refine ⟨ContinuousLinearEquiv.equivOfInverse (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 + φ.smulRight w)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - (1 + φ w)⁻¹ • φ.smulRight w) ?_ ?_, rfl⟩
      · intro v
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, map_add, map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul]
        match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring
      · intro v
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, map_add, map_smul, map_sub, smul_eq_mul]
        match_scalars <;> field_simp <;> ring
    
    have s5 : ∀ (c : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (k χ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ k (Metric.ball c ρ) →
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ → (∀ z : E3, χ z ≠ 0 → dist z c < ρ / 2) →
        ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => χ z * k z) := by
      intro c ρ k χ hk hχ hsupp
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro z
      by_cases hzc : dist z c < ρ
      · exact (hχ.contDiffOn.mul hk).contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzc)
      · push_neg at hzc
        by_cases hρ : 0 < ρ
        · have hO : IsOpen {z' : E3 | ρ / 2 < dist z' c} :=
            isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)
          have hzO : z ∈ {z' : E3 | ρ / 2 < dist z' c} := by
            show ρ / 2 < dist z c
            linarith
          refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
          filter_upwards [hO.mem_nhds hzO] with z' hz'
          have : χ z' = 0 := by
            by_contra hne
            have := hsupp z' hne
            have h2 : ρ / 2 < dist z' c := hz'
            linarith
          simp [this]
        · have h0 : ∀ z', χ z' = 0 := by
            intro z'
            by_contra hne
            have := hsupp z' hne
            have := dist_nonneg (x := z') (y := c)
            push_neg at hρ
            linarith
          have : (fun z => χ z * k z) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
            funext z'; simp [h0 z']
          rw [this]
          exact contDiffAt_const
    
    have s3 : ∀ (K : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ K → ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : E3), ℓ w = 1 →
        (∀ z : E3, ℓ z = 0 → K z = 0) → ∀ z : E3,
        K z = ℓ z * ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ K (z - ((1 - t) * ℓ z) • w) w := by
      intro K hK ℓ w hw hK0 z
      set c := ℓ z with hc
      have hKd : Differentiable ℝ K := hK.differentiable (by simp)
      have hp : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => z - ((1 - t) * c) • w) (c • w) t := by
        intro t
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (1 - t) * c) (-c) t := by
          have := ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_sub 1).mul_const c
          simpa using this
        have h2 := (h1.smul_const w).const_sub z
        simpa using h2
      have hφ : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => K (z - ((1 - t) * c) • w))
          (c * fderiv ℝ K (z - ((1 - t) * c) • w) w) t := by
        intro t
        have := (hKd (z - ((1 - t) * c) • w)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hp t)
        simpa [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] using this
      have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => c * fderiv ℝ K (z - ((1 - t) * c) • w) w) := by
        have h1 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => z - ((1 - t) * c) • w) := by fun_prop
        exact continuous_const.mul
          (((hK.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).comp h1).clm_apply continuous_const)
      have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (fun t _ => hφ t)
        (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hFTC
      have h0 : K (z - ((1 - 0) * c) • w) = 0 := by
        apply hK0
        simp [hc, hw]
      rw [hFTC, h0]
      simp
    
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ : ∃ ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ℓ = fderiv ℝ f y₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, ℓ v ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hdf (hℓ ▸ ContinuousLinearMap.ext hcon)
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : E3, ℓ w = 1 :=
      ⟨(ℓ v)⁻¹ • v, by rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hv]⟩
    
    have hdfc : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y w) U :=
      (hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    obtain ⟨U', hU'def⟩ : ∃ U' : Set E3, U' = U ∩ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y w) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hU' : IsOpen U' := hU'def ▸ hdfc.isOpen_inter_preimage hU isOpen_compl_singleton
    have hmemU' : ∀ y, y ∈ U' ↔ y ∈ U ∧ fderiv ℝ f y w ≠ 0 := by
      intro y; rw [hU'def]; rfl
    have hU'U : U' ⊆ U := fun y hy => ((hmemU' y).1 hy).1
    have hy₀' : y₀ ∈ U' := by
      rw [hmemU']
      refine ⟨hy₀, ?_⟩
      rw [← hℓ, hw]
      exact one_ne_zero
    
    obtain ⟨Θ, hΘdef⟩ : ∃ Θ : E3 → E3, Θ = fun y => y + (f y - ℓ y) • w := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΘs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Θ U := by
      rw [hΘdef]
      exact contDiffOn_id.add ((hf.sub ℓ.contDiff.contDiffOn).smul contDiffOn_const)
    have hΘℓ : ∀ y, ℓ (Θ y) = f y := by
      intro y
      rw [hΘdef]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hw]
      ring
    have hinv : ∀ y ∈ U', ∃ A : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3, HasFDerivAt Θ (A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hmemU'] at hy
      have hfd : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f y) y :=
        ((hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy.1)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
      obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := s2 (fderiv ℝ f y - ℓ) w (by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, hw]
        intro h0
        apply hy.2
        linarith)
      refine ⟨A, ?_⟩
      rw [hA, hΘdef]
      exact (hasFDerivAt_id y).add ((hfd.sub ℓ.hasFDerivAt).smul_const w)
    
    obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ := hinv y₀ hy₀'
    have hΘa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Θ y₀ := hΘs.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy₀)
    obtain ⟨P, hPc, hy₀P, hz₀P⟩ : ∃ P : OpenPartialHomeomorph E3 E3,
        (P : E3 → E3) = Θ ∧ y₀ ∈ P.source ∧ Θ y₀ ∈ P.target :=
      ⟨ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph Θ hΘa hA₀ (by simp),
        ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe hΘa hA₀ (by simp),
        ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hΘa hA₀ (by simp),
        ContDiffAt.image_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target hΘa hA₀ (by simp)⟩
    obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀def⟩ : ∃ z₀ : E3, z₀ = Θ y₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hO : IsOpen (P.target ∩ P.symm ⁻¹' (P.source ∩ U')) :=
      P.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage P.open_target (P.open_source.inter hU')
    have hz₀O : z₀ ∈ P.target ∩ P.symm ⁻¹' (P.source ∩ U') := by
      rw [hz₀def]
      refine ⟨hz₀P, ?_⟩
      show P.symm (Θ y₀) ∈ P.source ∩ U'
      have : P.symm (P y₀) = y₀ := P.left_inv hy₀P
      rw [hPc] at this
      rw [this]
      exact ⟨hy₀P, hy₀'⟩
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρO⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hO z₀ hz₀O
    have hΨ1 : ∀ z ∈ ball z₀ ρ, P.symm z ∈ U' ∧ Θ (P.symm z) = z := by
      intro z hzb
      refine ⟨(hρO hzb).2.2, ?_⟩
      have := P.right_inv (hρO hzb).1
      rw [hPc] at this
      exact this
    have hΨs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (P.symm : E3 → E3) (ball z₀ ρ) := by
      intro z hzb
      have hzt := (hρO hzb).1
      have hΨz : P.symm z ∈ P.source ∩ U' := (hρO hzb).2
      obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hinv (P.symm z) hΨz.2
      refine (P.contDiffAt_symm hzt (f₀' := A) ?_ ?_).contDiffWithinAt
      · rw [hPc]; exact hA
      · rw [hPc]; exact hΘs.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hU'U hΨz.2))
    have hO' : IsOpen ((P.source ∩ U') ∩ Θ ⁻¹' ball z₀ (ρ / 4)) :=
      (hΘs.continuousOn.mono (fun y hy => hU'U hy.2)).isOpen_inter_preimage
        (P.open_source.inter hU') isOpen_ball
    have hy₀O' : y₀ ∈ (P.source ∩ U') ∩ Θ ⁻¹' ball z₀ (ρ / 4) := by
      refine ⟨⟨hy₀P, hy₀'⟩, ?_⟩
      show Θ y₀ ∈ ball z₀ (ρ / 4)
      rw [← hz₀def]
      exact mem_ball_self (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrO⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hO' y₀ hy₀O'
    have hy1 : ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r, y ∈ U ∧ Θ y ∈ ball z₀ (ρ / 4) ∧ P.symm (Θ y) = y := by
      intro y hy
      refine ⟨hU'U (hrO hy).1.2, (hrO hy).2, ?_⟩
      have := P.left_inv (hrO hy).1.1
      rw [hPc] at this
      exact this
    
    have hks : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => h (P.symm z)) (ball z₀ ρ) :=
      hh.comp hΨs (fun z hzb => hU'U (hΨ1 z hzb).1)
    have hk0 : ∀ z ∈ ball z₀ ρ, ℓ z = 0 → h (P.symm z) = 0 := by
      intro z hzb hlz
      have h1 := hΨ1 z hzb
      apply hz (P.symm z) (hU'U h1.1)
      rw [← hΘℓ, h1.2, hlz]
    
    obtain ⟨χ, hχin, hχout⟩ : ∃ χ : ContDiffBump z₀, χ.rIn = ρ / 4 ∧ χ.rOut = ρ / 2 :=
      ⟨⟨ρ / 4, ρ / 2, by positivity, by linarith⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
    have hsuppχ : ∀ z, χ z ≠ 0 → dist z z₀ < ρ / 2 := by
      intro z hzχ
      have : z ∈ Function.support χ := hzχ
      rw [χ.support_eq, hχout] at this
      exact this
    obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : E3 → ℝ, K = fun z => χ z * h (P.symm z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hKs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ K := hKdef ▸ s5 z₀ ρ _ χ hks χ.contDiff hsuppχ
    have hK0 : ∀ z, ℓ z = 0 → K z = 0 := by
      intro z hlz
      rw [hKdef]
      by_cases hzb : z ∈ ball z₀ ρ
      · show χ z * h (P.symm z) = 0
        rw [hk0 z hzb hlz, mul_zero]
      · have : χ z = 0 := by
          by_contra hne
          apply hzb
          have := hsuppχ z hne
          show dist z z₀ < ρ
          linarith
        show χ z * h (P.symm z) = 0
        rw [this, zero_mul]
    have hKk : ∀ z ∈ ball z₀ (ρ / 4), K z = h (P.symm z) := by
      intro z hzb
      have : χ z = 1 := χ.one_of_mem_closedBall (by rw [hχin]; exact ball_subset_closedBall hzb)
      rw [hKdef]
      show χ z * h (P.symm z) = h (P.symm z)
      rw [this, one_mul]
    
    obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : E3 → ℝ,
        V = fun z => ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ K (z - ((1 - t) * ℓ z) • w) w := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hKV : ∀ z, K z = ℓ z * V z := by
      intro z
      rw [hVdef]
      exact s3 K hKs ℓ w hw hK0 z
    have hVs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V := by
      have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ K) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hKs).2
      have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E3 × ℝ => p.1 - ((1 - p.2) * ℓ p.1) • w) :=
        contDiff_fst.sub (((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd).mul
          (ℓ.contDiff.comp contDiff_fst)).smul contDiff_const)
      have hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry
          (fun (z : E3) (t : ℝ) => fderiv ℝ K (z - ((1 - t) * ℓ z) • w) w)) :=
        (h1.comp h2).clm_apply contDiff_const
      rw [hVdef]
      exact contDiff_infty.2 (fun n => s4 n ℝ _ (contDiff_infty.1 hG n) 0 1)
    
    refine ⟨r, hr, fun y => V (Θ y), fun y hy => (hy1 y hy).1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hVs.comp_contDiffOn (hΘs.mono (fun y hy => (hy1 y hy).1))
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨_, hΘy, hΨΘ⟩ := hy1 y hy
      calc h y = h (P.symm (Θ y)) := by rw [hΨΘ]
        _ = K (Θ y) := (hKk _ hΘy).symm
        _ = ℓ (Θ y) * V (Θ y) := hKV _
        _ = f y * V (Θ y) := by rw [hΘℓ]
  
  have hqs : q ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := mem_chart_source E3 q
  have hy₀t : chartAt E3 q q ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).map_source hqs
  have hsymm : (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) = q := (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hqs
  have hFs : ∀ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target := fun f hf =>
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hFd : ∀ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q) := fun f hf =>
    ((hFs f hf).contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 q).open_target.mem_nhds hy₀t)).differentiableAt
      (by simp)
  
  have hmf : ∀ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f q : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q) := by
    intro f hf
    rw [(hf.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)).mfderiv]
    simp [writtenInExtChartAt, extChartAt, Function.comp_def]
  have hf10 : f₁ q = 0 := by
    have h1 : q ∈ V₁ ∩ f₁ ⁻¹' {0} := hS₁ ▸ ⟨hq₁, hq⟩
    exact h1.2
  have hdF₁ : fderiv ℝ (fun z => f₁ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hmf f₁ hf₁]; exact hd₁ q hq₁
  have hdF₂ : fderiv ℝ (fun z => f₂ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hmf f₂ hf₂]; exact hd₂ q hq₂
  
  have hΘo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (V₁ ∩ V₂)) :=
    (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (hV₁.inter hV₂)
  have hy₀Θ : chartAt E3 q q ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (V₁ ∩ V₂) := by
    refine ⟨hy₀t, ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) ∈ V₁ ∩ V₂
    rw [hsymm]; exact ⟨hq₁, hq₂⟩
  have hz : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (V₁ ∩ V₂),
      f₁ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) = 0 → f₂ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) = 0 := by
    intro z hzΘ h0
    have h1 : (chartAt E3 q).symm z ∈ V₁ ∩ f₁ ⁻¹' {0} := ⟨hzΘ.2.1, h0⟩
    rw [← hS₁] at h1
    have h2 : (chartAt E3 q).symm z ∈ V₂ ∩ Sig := ⟨hzΘ.2.2, h1.2⟩
    rw [hS₂] at h2
    exact h2.2
  
  obtain ⟨r, hr, μ, -, hμ, hdiv⟩ := coord_div _ hΘo (fun z => f₁ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
    (fun z => f₂ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ((hFs f₁ hf₁).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
    ((hFs f₂ hf₂).mono Set.inter_subset_left) _ hy₀Θ (by simp only [hsymm, hf10]) hdF₁ hz
  
  have hball : Metric.ball (chartAt E3 q q) r ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 q q) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
  have hcov : fderiv ℝ (fun z => f₂ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q) =
      μ (chartAt E3 q q) • fderiv ℝ (fun z => f₁ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q) := by
    have hev : (fun z => f₂ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 q q)]
        (fun z => f₁ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) * μ z) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hball hdiv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hμd : DifferentiableAt ℝ μ (chartAt E3 q q) :=
      (hμ.contDiffAt hball).differentiableAt (by simp)
    rw [show (fun z => f₁ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) * μ z) =
        (fun z => f₁ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) * μ from rfl,
      ((hFd f₁ hf₁).hasFDerivAt.mul hμd.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
    simp only [hsymm, hf10, zero_smul, zero_add]
  have hu0 : μ (chartAt E3 q q) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0; apply hdF₂; rw [hcov, h0, zero_smul]
  have hpt : ∀ w : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun z => f₂ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q) w =
      μ (chartAt E3 q q) * fderiv ℝ (fun z => f₁ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q) w := by
    intro w; rw [hcov]; rfl
  
  have hsrc : Φ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source := by rw [hΦy]; exact hqs
  have hΦc : ContinuousAt Φ y :=
    Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.continuousAt (Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hy)
  have hΦmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ y :=
    (Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.contMDiffAt (Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hy)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  have hTd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => chartAt E3 q (Φ y')) y :=
    mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.mp
      ((mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hsrc).comp y hΦmd)
  have hchain : ∀ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      partialDeriv 0 (fun y' => f (Φ y')) y =
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q q)
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y' => chartAt E3 q (Φ y')) y (e 0)) := by
    intro f hf
    have hev : (fun y' => f (Φ y')) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ∘ (fun y' => chartAt E3 q (Φ y')) := by
      filter_upwards [hΦc.preimage_mem_nhds ((chartAt E3 q).open_source.mem_nhds hsrc)]
        with y' hy'
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hy']
    have hFd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
        (chartAt E3 q (Φ y)) := by rw [hΦy]; exact hFd f hf
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_comp y hFd' hTd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hΦy]
  
  refine ⟨μ (chartAt E3 q q), hu0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, partialDeriv, hpt, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring))
  · rw [hchain f₂ hf₂, hchain f₁ hf₁, hpt]

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E3) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) U)
    (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G y a b = G y b a)
    (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) :
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) U) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) U ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, ∀ a b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b = (G y)⁻¹ b a) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => pcrL0A G y a b) U) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, (pcrL0A G y).PosDef)

signature.statement:
(U : Set E3) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) U)
    (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G y a b = G y b a)
    (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) :
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) U) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) U ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, ∀ a b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b = (G y)⁻¹ b a) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => pcrL0A G y a b) U) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, (pcrL0A G y).PosDef)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hdetS : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (H y).det) U := by
    intro H hH
    have e : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
        H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
        - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
        + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_three _
    rw [e]
    exact (((((((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 2)).sub
      (((hH 0 0).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 1))).sub
      (((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 2))).add
      (((hH 0 1).mul (hH 1 2)).mul (hH 2 0))).add
      (((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 0)).mul (hH 2 1))).sub
      (((hH 0 2).mul (hH 1 1)).mul (hH 2 0))
  
  have hadjS : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).adjugate a b) U := by
    intro a b
    have e : (fun y => (G y).adjugate a b) =
        fun y => ((G y).updateRow b (Pi.single a 1)).det := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.adjugate_apply _ _ _
    rw [e]
    apply hdetS
    intro i j
    by_cases hi : i = b
    · subst hi
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
      exact contDiffOn_const
    · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hi]
      exact hGs i j
  have hinv_eq : ∀ y (a b : Fin 3), (G y)⁻¹ a b = ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate a b := by
    intro y a b
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
  have hdetpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det := fun y hy => (hGpd y hy).det_pos
  have hdetne : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hdetpos y hy).ne'
  have hdS := hdetS G hGs
  have T1 : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) U := by
    intro a b
    have e : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) = fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate a b :=
      funext fun y => hinv_eq y a b
    rw [e]
    exact (hdS.inv hdetne).mul (hadjS a b)
  have T3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) U := hdS.sqrt hdetne
  have T4 : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ a b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b = (G y)⁻¹ b a := by
    intro y hy a b
    have h := (hGpd y hy).inv.isHermitian.apply a b
    rw [star_trivial] at h
    exact h.symm
  have T5 : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j := by
    intro y hy v hv
    have h := (hGpd y hy).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h ⊢
    convert h using 1
    ring
  have hM00 : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y)⁻¹ 0 0 := fun y hy => (hGpd y hy).inv.diag_pos
  have hsS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0)) U :=
    (T1 0 0).sqrt (fun y hy => (hM00 y hy).ne')
  have hsne : ∀ y ∈ U, Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0) ≠ 0 :=
    fun y hy => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hM00 y hy)).ne'
  have T6 : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => pcrL0A G y a b) U := by
    intro a b
    exact T3.mul (((T1 a.succ b.succ).div hsS hsne).sub
      (((T1 a.succ 0).mul (T1 b.succ 0)).div (hsS.pow 3)
        (fun y hy => pow_ne_zero 3 (hsne y hy))))
  have T7 : ∀ y ∈ U, (pcrL0A G y).PosDef := by
    intro y hy
    have hMpd : ((G y)⁻¹).PosDef := (hGpd y hy).inv
    have hMs := T4 y hy
    have hm00 : 0 < (G y)⁻¹ 0 0 := hM00 y hy
    have hσ : 0 < Real.sqrt (G y).det := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hdetpos y hy)
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hm00
    have hs2 : Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0) ^ 2 = (G y)⁻¹ 0 0 := Real.sq_sqrt hm00.le
    have hA : ∀ a b, pcrL0A G y a b = Real.sqrt (G y).det *
        ((G y)⁻¹ a.succ b.succ / Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0) -
          (G y)⁻¹ a.succ 0 * (G y)⁻¹ b.succ 0 / Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0) ^ 3) :=
      fun a b => rfl
    set Mi := (G y)⁻¹ with hMi
    set σ := Real.sqrt (G y).det with hσdef
    set s := Real.sqrt (Mi 0 0) with hsdef
    refine Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos ?_ ?_
    · refine Matrix.IsHermitian.ext fun i j => ?_
      rw [star_trivial, hA, hA, hMs j.succ i.succ, mul_comm (Mi j.succ 0)]
    · intro v hv
      have hv' : v 0 ≠ 0 ∨ v 1 ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        apply hv
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        · simpa using hc.1
        · simpa using hc.2
      have hu : (![-(Mi 1 0 * v 0 + Mi 2 0 * v 1), Mi 0 0 * v 0, Mi 0 0 * v 1] : Fin 3 → ℝ)
          ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        have h1 : Mi 0 0 * v 0 = 0 := by simpa using congrFun h0 1
        have h2 : Mi 0 0 * v 1 = 0 := by simpa using congrFun h0 2
        rcases hv' with h | h
        · exact h ((mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_left hm00.ne')
        · exact h ((mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left hm00.ne')
      have hQ := hMpd.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hu
      have hQ' : dotProduct (star (![-(Mi 1 0 * v 0 + Mi 2 0 * v 1), Mi 0 0 * v 0,
            Mi 0 0 * v 1] : Fin 3 → ℝ))
          (Matrix.mulVec Mi (![-(Mi 1 0 * v 0 + Mi 2 0 * v 1), Mi 0 0 * v 0, Mi 0 0 * v 1] :
            Fin 3 → ℝ)) =
          Mi 0 0 * (Mi 0 0 * (Mi 1 1 * v 0 * v 0 + Mi 1 2 * v 0 * v 1 + Mi 2 1 * v 1 * v 0 +
            Mi 2 2 * v 1 * v 1) - (Mi 1 0 * v 0 + Mi 2 0 * v 1) ^ 2) := by
        simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three,
          Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.tail_cons]
        rw [hMs 0 1, hMs 0 2]
        ring
      rw [hQ'] at hQ
      have hX : 0 < Mi 0 0 * (Mi 1 1 * v 0 * v 0 + Mi 1 2 * v 0 * v 1 + Mi 2 1 * v 1 * v 0 +
            Mi 2 2 * v 1 * v 1) - (Mi 1 0 * v 0 + Mi 2 0 * v 1) ^ 2 :=
        (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left hm00).mp hQ
      have hsne' : s ≠ 0 := hs.ne'
      have hQA : dotProduct (star v) (Matrix.mulVec (pcrL0A G y) v) =
          σ * (s ^ 2 * (Mi 1 1 * v 0 * v 0 + Mi 1 2 * v 0 * v 1 + Mi 2 1 * v 1 * v 0 +
            Mi 2 2 * v 1 * v 1) - (Mi 1 0 * v 0 + Mi 2 0 * v 1) ^ 2) / s ^ 3 := by
        simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, hA,
          Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_one_eq_two]
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [hQA, hs2]
      exact div_pos (mul_pos hσ hX) (pow_pos hs 3)
  exact ⟨T1, hdetpos, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(Gj Gk : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (τ : E2 → E2) (x : E2)
    (hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ x) (hGjpd : (Gj (hpLift 0 x)).PosDef)
    (hc : Gj (hpLift 0 x) =
      pullbackMetric Gk (fun y => hpLift (y 0) (τ (hpProj y))) (hpLift 0 x)) :
    Real.sqrt (Gj (hpLift 0 x)).det =
        |(fderiv ℝ τ x).det| * Real.sqrt (Gk (hpLift 0 (τ x))).det ∧
      ∀ c d : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 a) c * pcrL0A Gj (hpLift 0 x) a b * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) d =
        |(fderiv ℝ τ x).det| * pcrL0A Gk (hpLift 0 (τ x)) c d

signature.name: pcr_l0_coeff_compat
signature.statement:
(Gj Gk : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (τ : E2 → E2) (x : E2)
    (hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ x) (hGjpd : (Gj (hpLift 0 x)).PosDef)
    (hc : Gj (hpLift 0 x) =
      pullbackMetric Gk (fun y => hpLift (y 0) (τ (hpProj y))) (hpLift 0 x)) :
    Real.sqrt (Gj (hpLift 0 x)).det =
        |(fderiv ℝ τ x).det| * Real.sqrt (Gk (hpLift 0 (τ x))).det ∧
      ∀ c d : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 a) c * pcrL0A Gj (hpLift 0 x) a b * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) d =
        |(fderiv ℝ τ x).det| * pcrL0A Gk (hpLift 0 (τ x)) c d

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hlift0 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (u : E2), (hpLift t u) 0 = t := by
    intro t u
    simp [hpLift, cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hpx : ∀ (t : ℝ) (u : E2), hpProj (hpLift t u) = u := by
    intro t u
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hpLift, cylPt, hpProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  let Lp : E3 →L[ℝ] E2 := (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e2 0) +
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e2 1)
  have hLp : ∀ z : E3, Lp z = hpProj z := by
    intro z
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [Lp, hpProj, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hprojfun : hpProj = ⇑Lp := funext fun z => (hLp z).symm
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => τ (hpProj y)) ((fderiv ℝ τ x).comp Lp) (hpLift 0 x) := by
    have hτ' : HasFDerivAt τ (fderiv ℝ τ x) (Lp (hpLift 0 x)) := by
      rw [hLp, hpx]
      exact hτ.hasFDerivAt
    rw [hprojfun]
    exact hτ'.comp (hpLift 0 x) Lp.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 : ∀ c : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun y => τ (hpProj y) c)
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj c : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp ((fderiv ℝ τ x).comp Lp)) (hpLift 0 x) :=
    fun c => (EuclideanSpace.proj c : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp (hpLift 0 x) h1
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y 0) (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)
      (hpLift 0 x) := (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
  have hTfun : (fun y : E3 => hpLift (y 0) (τ (hpProj y))) =
      fun y => (y 0) • e 0 + (τ (hpProj y) 0) • e 1 + (τ (hpProj y) 1) • e 2 := by
    funext y
    simp [hpLift, cylPt]
  have hTd : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => hpLift (y 0) (τ (hpProj y)))
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 0) +
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
          ((fderiv ℝ τ x).comp Lp)).smulRight (e 1) +
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
          ((fderiv ℝ τ x).comp Lp)).smulRight (e 2)) (hpLift 0 x) := by
    rw [hTfun]
    exact ((h0.smul_const (e 0)).add ((h2 0).smul_const (e 1))).add ((h2 1).smul_const (e 2))
  have hJ : ∀ (i a : Fin 3),
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E3 => hpLift (y 0) (τ (hpProj y))) (hpLift 0 x) (e a)) i =
      (!![1, 0, 0; 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 0;
        0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 1, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 1] : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i a := by
    intro i a
    rw [hTd.fderiv]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases a <;> simp [Lp, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  have hGmat : Gj (hpLift 0 x) =
      (!![1, 0, 0; 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 0;
        0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 1, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 1] : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ).transpose *
        Gk (hpLift 0 (τ x)) *
      (!![1, 0, 0; 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 0;
        0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 1, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 1] : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) := by
    rw [hc]
    ext a b
    simp only [pullbackMetric, hJ, hlift0, hpx, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
      Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  
  have hdetL : (fderiv ℝ τ x).det = fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 0 * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 1 -
      fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 0 * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 1 := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.det,
      ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis, Matrix.det_fin_two]
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  have hdetJ : (!![1, 0, 0; 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 0;
        0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 1, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 1] : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ).det =
      (fderiv ℝ τ x).det := by
    rw [hdetL, Matrix.det_fin_three]
    simp
    try ring
  have hdetG : (Gj (hpLift 0 x)).det = (fderiv ℝ τ x).det ^ 2 * (Gk (hpLift 0 (τ x))).det := by
    rw [hGmat, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, hdetJ]
    ring
  have hσ : Real.sqrt (Gj (hpLift 0 x)).det =
      |(fderiv ℝ τ x).det| * Real.sqrt (Gk (hpLift 0 (τ x))).det := by
    rw [hdetG, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  refine ⟨hσ, ?_⟩
  
  have hpos : 0 < (Gj (hpLift 0 x)).det := hGjpd.det_pos
  have hJ0 : (fderiv ℝ τ x).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [hdetG, h0] at hpos
    simp at hpos
  have hJu : IsUnit (!![1, 0, 0; 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 0;
        0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 1, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 1] : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ).det := by
    rw [hdetJ]
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hJ0
  have hJTu : IsUnit (!![1, 0, 0; 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 0;
        0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 1, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 1] :
          Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ).transpose.det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_transpose]
    exact hJu
  have hinv : (Gk (hpLift 0 (τ x)))⁻¹ =
      (!![1, 0, 0; 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 0;
        0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 1, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 1] : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) *
        (Gj (hpLift 0 x))⁻¹ *
      (!![1, 0, 0; 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 0;
        0, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 0) 1, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 1) 1] : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ).transpose := by
    rw [hGmat, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hJTu, Matrix.mul_one, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hJu, Matrix.one_mul]
  have h00 : (Gk (hpLift 0 (τ x)))⁻¹ 0 0 = (Gj (hpLift 0 x))⁻¹ 0 0 := by
    rw [hinv]
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hs0 : ∀ c : Fin 2, (Gk (hpLift 0 (τ x)))⁻¹ c.succ 0 =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 a) c * (Gj (hpLift 0 x))⁻¹ a.succ 0 := by
    intro c
    rw [hinv]
    fin_cases c <;>
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;>
      ring
  have hss : ∀ c d : Fin 2, (Gk (hpLift 0 (τ x)))⁻¹ c.succ d.succ =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 a) c * (Gj (hpLift 0 x))⁻¹ a.succ b.succ *
        fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) d := by
    intro c d
    rw [hinv]
    fin_cases c <;> fin_cases d <;>
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;>
      ring
  
  intro c d
  simp only [pcrL0A]
  rw [hσ, h00, hs0 c, hs0 d, hss c d]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) U)
    (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G y a b = G y b a)
    (hGpd : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef)
    (hMs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) U)
    (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U)
    (hS : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k f y * partialDeriv l f y)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    Real.sqrt (G y).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (pcrL0Z G f i) y

proof.tactics:
by
  have h := ccs_divx G f U hU hGs hGsymm hGpd hf (hcrNormalField G f) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
    y hy (hS y hy)
  have s2 : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * hcrNormalField G f z i) = pcrL0Z G f i := by
    intro i

  exact h.symm

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_divx
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hT : IsOpen T) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hpd : ∀ z ∈ T, (G z).PosDef) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f T) (X : E3 → E3) (hX : ∀ z ∈ T, ∀ i : Fin 3, X z i = calUnitNormal G f z i) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ T) (hN : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a f y * partialDeriv b f y) : sepDensDiv G X y = Real.sqrt (G y).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (w T : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2)
    (hw : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x) (hT : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 T x)
    (h0 : T x = w x) (h1 : fderiv ℝ T x = fderiv ℝ w x)
    (h2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ T) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x) (ε : ℝ) :
    pcrH G (fun x' => ε * w x') x = pcrH G (fun x' => ε * T x') x

signature.name: pcr_l0_jet_congr
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (w T : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2)
    (hw : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x) (hT : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 T x)
    (h0 : T x = w x) (h1 : fderiv ℝ T x = fderiv ℝ w x)
    (h2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ T) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x) (ε : ℝ) :
    pcrH G (fun x' => ε * w x') x = pcrH G (fun x' => ε * T x') x

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  
  have hP1 : ∀ y : E3, hpProj y 0 = y 1 := by
    intro y; simp [hpProj]
  have hP2 : ∀ y : E3, hpProj y 1 = y 2 := by
    intro y; simp [hpProj]
  have hL1 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), (hpLift t x) 1 = x 0 := by
    intro t x; simp [hpLift, cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hL2 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), (hpLift t x) 2 = x 1 := by
    intro t x; simp [hpLift, cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hLP : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E2), hpProj (hpLift t x) = x := by
    intro t x; ext k; fin_cases k
    · simp [hP1, hL1]
    · simp [hP2, hL2]
  let Pl : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E2 :=
    { toFun := hpProj
      map_add' := by
        intro y y'; ext k; fin_cases k
        · simp [hP1]
        · simp [hP2]
      map_smul' := by
        intro c y; ext k; fin_cases k
        · simp [hP1]
        · simp [hP2] }
  let P : E3 →L[ℝ] E2 := LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap Pl
  have hP : ∀ y, P y = hpProj y := fun y => rfl
  have hPf : hpProj = ⇑P := funext fun y => (hP y).symm
  let π0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3)
  have hπ0 : ∀ y : E3, π0 y = y 0 := fun y => rfl
  
  
  
  have hgraph : ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2) (t : ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => y 0 - w (hpProj y)) (hpLift t x) =
          (e i) 0 - fderiv ℝ w x (hpProj (e i))) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => y 0 - w (hpProj y))) (hpLift t x) =
          -(fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x (hpProj (e i)) (hpProj (e j)))) := by
    intro w x t hw
    have hPx : P (hpLift t x) = x := by rw [hP, hLP]
    have hev : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x' := hw.eventually (by decide)
    have hev' : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (hpLift t x), DifferentiableAt ℝ w (P y) := by
      have hT : Tendsto P (𝓝 (hpLift t x)) (𝓝 x) := by
        have := P.continuous.tendsto (hpLift t x)
        rwa [hPx] at this
      exact (hT.eventually hev).mono fun y hy => hy.differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    have hderiv : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ w (P y) → ∀ j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv j (fun y => y 0 - w (hpProj y)) y = (e j) 0 - fderiv ℝ w (P y) (P (e j)) := by
      intro y hy j
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y 0 - w (hpProj y))
          (π0 - (fderiv ℝ w (P y)).comp P) y := by
        rw [hPf]
        exact π0.hasFDerivAt.sub (hy.hasFDerivAt.comp y P.hasFDerivAt)
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [h1.fderiv]
      simp [hπ0]
    have hx2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x :=
      (hw.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩
    · rw [hderiv _ (hev'.self_of_nhds) i, hPx, hP]
    · have heq : partialDeriv j (fun y => y 0 - w (hpProj y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (hpLift t x)]
          fun y => (e j) 0 - fderiv ℝ w (P y) (P (e j)) :=
        hev'.mono fun y hy => hderiv y hy j
      have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ w (P y))
          ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x).comp P) (hpLift t x) := by
        have := hx2.hasFDerivAt
        rw [← hPx] at this
        have h2 := this.comp (hpLift t x) P.hasFDerivAt
        rw [hPx] at h2
        exact h2
      have hB : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (e j) 0 - fderiv ℝ w (P y) (P (e j)))
          (-(((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x).comp P).flip (P (e j)))) (hpLift t x) := by
        have h3 := hA.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (P (e j)) (hpLift t x))
        have h4 := h3.const_sub ((e j) 0)
        convert h4 using 1
        ext v
        simp
      change fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (fun y => y 0 - w (hpProj y))) (hpLift t x) (e i) = _
      rw [heq.fderiv_eq, hB.fderiv]
      simp [hP]
  
  
  
  have hcongr : ∀ (u v : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 u x → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 v x →
      u x = v x → fderiv ℝ u x = fderiv ℝ v x →
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) x → pcrH G u x = pcrH G v x := by
    intro u v hu hv huv0 huv1 huv2
    obtain ⟨au, bu⟩ := hgraph u x (v x) hu
    obtain ⟨av, bv⟩ := hgraph v x (v x) hv
    unfold pcrH
    rw [huv0]
    unfold levelMeanCurvCoord lapLoc hessLoc
    simp only [au, bu, av, bv, huv1, huv2]
  
  
  
  have hjet : ∀ (g : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g x →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun x' => ε * g x') x ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fun x' => ε * g x') x = ε • fderiv ℝ g x ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => ε * g x')) x = ε • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) x := by
    intro g hg
    have hev : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => ε * g x') x' = ε • fderiv ℝ g x' := by
      filter_upwards [hg.eventually (by decide)] with x' hg'
      exact ((hg'.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt.const_mul ε).fderiv
    have hg2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) x :=
      (hg.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
    refine ⟨contDiffAt_const.mul hg, hev.self_of_nhds, ?_⟩
    have hev2 : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => ε * g x') =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun x' => ε • fderiv ℝ g x' := hev
    rw [hev2.fderiv_eq]
    exact (hg2.hasFDerivAt.const_smul ε).fderiv
  obtain ⟨cw, dw1, dw2⟩ := hjet w hw
  obtain ⟨cT, dT1, dT2⟩ := hjet T hT
  exact hcongr _ _ cw cT (by simp only [h0]) (by rw [dw1, dT1, h1])
    (by rw [dw2, dT2, h2])

informal_problem.statement:
(A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => A x' a b) x)
    (hw : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x) :
    ∃ T : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ T ∧ T x = w x ∧ fderiv ℝ T x = fderiv ℝ w x ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ T) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x ∧
      ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A x' a b * pd2 b T x') x =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A x' a b * pd2 b w x') x

signature.name: pcr_l0_taylor_reduce
signature.statement:
(A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => A x' a b) x)
    (hw : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 w x) :
    ∃ T : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ T ∧ T x = w x ∧ fderiv ℝ T x = fderiv ℝ w x ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ T) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x ∧
      ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A x' a b * pd2 b T x') x =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A x' a b * pd2 b w x') x

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have formula : ∀ u : E2 → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x →
      ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A x' a b * pd2 b u x') x =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => A x' a b) x (e2 a) * fderiv ℝ u x (e2 b) +
          A x a b * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x (e2 a) (e2 b)) := by
    intro u hu
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    have hpd : ∀ b : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun x' => pd2 b u x')
        ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x).flip (e2 b)) x := by
      intro b
      have h := hu.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e2 b) x)
      unfold pd2
      convert h using 1
      ext v
      simp
    have hsum : HasFDerivAt (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A x' a b * pd2 b u x')
        (∑ b : Fin 2, (A x a b • (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x).flip (e2 b) +
          pd2 b u x • fderiv ℝ (fun x' => A x' a b) x)) x := by
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
      intro b _
      exact (hA a b).hasFDerivAt.mul (hpd b)
    show fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 a) = _
    rw [hsum.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, smul_eq_mul, pd2]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
    ring
  
  have jet : ∃ T : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ T ∧ T x = w x ∧ fderiv ℝ T x = fderiv ℝ w x ∧
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ T) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ T) x := by
    obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L, L = fderiv ℝ w x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B, B = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hsymm : ∀ v v', B v v' = B v' v := by
      have hS := hw.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField])
      intro v v'
      rw [hBdef]
      exact hS v v'
    have h1 : ∀ y : E2, HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => y - x) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2) y :=
      fun y => (hasFDerivAt_id y).sub_const x
    have hT : ∀ y : E2, HasFDerivAt
        (fun y : E2 => w x + L (y - x) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * B (y - x) (y - x))
        (L + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (B (y - x) + B.flip (y - x))) y := by
      intro y
      have hL : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => L (y - x)) L y := by
        have := L.hasFDerivAt.comp y (h1 y)
        rwa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id] at this
      have hB : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => B (y - x)) B y := by
        have := B.hasFDerivAt.comp y (h1 y)
        rwa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id] at this
      have hBB : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => B (y - x) (y - x))
          (B (y - x) + B.flip (y - x)) y := by
        have := hB.clm_apply (h1 y)
        simpa using this
      have := ((hasFDerivAt_const (w x) y).add hL).add (hBB.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ))
      convert this using 1
      simp
    have hfT : fderiv ℝ (fun y : E2 => w x + L (y - x) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * B (y - x) (y - x)) =
        fun y => L + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((B + B.flip) (y - x)) := by
      funext y
      rw [(hT y).fderiv]
      simp
    have hΦ : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => L + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((B + B.flip) (y - x)))
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (B + B.flip)) x := by
      have := (((B + B.flip).hasFDerivAt.comp x (h1 x)).const_smul (1 / 2 : ℝ)).const_add L
      simpa using this
    refine ⟨fun y : E2 => w x + L (y - x) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * B (y - x) (y - x), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => y - x) := contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const
      exact (contDiff_const.add (L.contDiff.comp hs)).add
        (contDiff_const.mul ((B.contDiff.comp hs).clm_apply hs))
    · simp
    · rw [(hT x).fderiv, hLdef]
      simp
    · rw [hfT, hΦ.fderiv, ← hBdef]
      ext v v'
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hsymm v' v]
      ring
    · rw [hfT]
      exact hΦ.differentiableAt
  obtain ⟨T, hTs, h0, h1, h2, hT'⟩ := jet
  have hw' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x :=
    (hw.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨T, hTs, h0, h1, h2, ?_⟩
  rw [formula T hT', formula w hw', h1, h2]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (hGsymm : ∀ a b : Fin 3, G y a b = G y b a) (hGpd : (G y).PosDef)
    (hw : DifferentiableAt ℝ w (hpProj y)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => pcrL0Z G (fun y' => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) 0 y) 0 0 ∧
    ∀ a : Fin 2, HasDerivAt
      (fun ε : ℝ => pcrL0Z G (fun y' => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) a.succ y)
      (-∑ b : Fin 2, pcrL0A G y a b * pd2 b w (hpProj y)) 0

signature.name: pcr_l0_vert_deriv
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (y : E3)
    (hGsymm : ∀ a b : Fin 3, G y a b = G y b a) (hGpd : (G y).PosDef)
    (hw : DifferentiableAt ℝ w (hpProj y)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => pcrL0Z G (fun y' => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) 0 y) 0 0 ∧
    ∀ a : Fin 2, HasDerivAt
      (fun ε : ℝ => pcrL0Z G (fun y' => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) a.succ y)
      (-∑ b : Fin 2, pcrL0A G y a b * pd2 b w (hpProj y)) 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have key : ∀ (σ A B C D E : ℝ) (N S : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ ε, N ε = A + ε * B) →
      (∀ ε, S ε = C + ε * D + ε ^ 2 * E) → 0 < C →
      HasDerivAt (fun ε => σ * N ε / Real.sqrt (S ε))
        ((σ * B * Real.sqrt C - σ * A * (D / (2 * Real.sqrt C))) / (Real.sqrt C) ^ 2) 0 := by
    intro σ A B C D E N S hN hS hC
    have hNf : N = fun ε => A + ε * B := funext hN
    have hSf : S = fun ε => C + ε * D + ε ^ 2 * E := funext hS
    subst hNf hSf
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => σ * (A + ε * B)) (σ * B) 0 := by
      have := (((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).mul_const B).const_add A).const_mul σ
      simpa using this
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => C + ε * D + ε ^ 2 * E) D 0 := by
      have := (((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).mul_const D).const_add C).add
        ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 (0:ℝ)).mul_const E)
      simpa using this
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => Real.sqrt (C + ε * D + ε ^ 2 * E))
        (D / (2 * Real.sqrt C)) 0 := by
      have := h2.sqrt (by simp; exact hC.ne')
      simpa using this
    have hne : Real.sqrt (C + 0 * D + 0 ^ 2 * E) ≠ 0 := by
      have : C + 0 * D + 0 ^ 2 * E = C := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hC
    have h4 := h1.div h3 hne
    have e1 : (fun ε : ℝ => σ * (A + ε * B) / Real.sqrt (C + ε * D + ε ^ 2 * E)) =
        (fun ε : ℝ => σ * (A + ε * B)) / (fun ε => Real.sqrt (C + ε * D + ε ^ 2 * E)) := rfl
    rw [e1]
    convert h4 using 2 <;> simp
  simp only [pcrL0A, pcrL0Z]
  set M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := (G y)⁻¹ with hMdef
  set σ : ℝ := Real.sqrt (G y).det with hσdef
  have hMsymm : ∀ k l : Fin 3, M k l = M l k := by
    intro k l
    have h := hGpd.inv.isHermitian.apply k l
    simp only [star_trivial] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hM0 : 0 < M 0 0 := hGpd.inv.diag_pos
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : E3 →L[ℝ] E2, ∀ z, L z = hpProj z := by
    refine ⟨LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
      { toFun := hpProj, map_add' := ?_, map_smul' := ?_ }, fun z => rfl⟩
    · intro a b; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj]
    · intro c a; ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj]
  have hLe0 : hpProj (e 0) = 0 := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hLe1 : hpProj (e 1) = e2 0 := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj, e, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hLe2 : hpProj (e 2) = e2 1 := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hpProj, e, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  have hD : ∀ ε : ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun y' : E3 => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y'))
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) - ε • (fderiv ℝ w (hpProj y)).comp L) y := by
    intro ε
    have hw' : HasFDerivAt w (fderiv ℝ w (hpProj y)) (L y) := by
      rw [hL]; exact hw.hasFDerivAt
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y' : E3 => w (hpProj y')) ((fderiv ℝ w (hpProj y)).comp L) y := by
      have h := hw'.comp y L.hasFDerivAt
      have hfun : (fun y' : E3 => w (hpProj y')) = w ∘ ⇑L := by
        funext z; simp [hL]
      rw [hfun]; exact h
    have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun y' : E3 => y' 0) (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    exact h0.sub (h1.const_mul ε)
  have hP0 : ∀ ε : ℝ, partialDeriv 0 (fun y' : E3 => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) y = 1 := by
    intro ε
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [(hD ε).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hL, hLe0]
    simp
  have hP1 : ∀ ε : ℝ, partialDeriv 1 (fun y' : E3 => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) y =
      -ε * pd2 0 w (hpProj y) := by
    intro ε
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [(hD ε).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hL, hLe1]
    simp [pd2]
  have hP2 : ∀ ε : ℝ, partialDeriv 2 (fun y' : E3 => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) y =
      -ε * pd2 1 w (hpProj y) := by
    intro ε
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [(hD ε).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hL, hLe2]
    simp [pd2]
  
  have hN : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (ε : ℝ),
      ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * partialDeriv j (fun y' : E3 => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) y =
        M i 0 + ε * (-(M i 1 * pd2 0 w (hpProj y) + M i 2 * pd2 1 w (hpProj y))) := by
    intro i ε
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, hP0, hP1, hP2]
    ring
  have hS : ∀ ε : ℝ,
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, M k l * partialDeriv k (fun y' : E3 => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) y *
          partialDeriv l (fun y' : E3 => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) y =
        M 0 0 + ε * (-((M 0 1 + M 1 0) * pd2 0 w (hpProj y) + (M 0 2 + M 2 0) * pd2 1 w (hpProj y)))
          + ε ^ 2 * (M 1 1 * pd2 0 w (hpProj y) ^ 2 +
            (M 1 2 + M 2 1) * pd2 0 w (hpProj y) * pd2 1 w (hpProj y) +
            M 2 2 * pd2 1 w (hpProj y) ^ 2) := by
    intro ε
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hP0, hP1, hP2]
    ring
  have hderiv := fun i : Fin 3 => key σ (M i 0) _ (M 0 0) _ _
    (fun ε : ℝ => ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j *
      partialDeriv j (fun y' : E3 => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) y)
    (fun ε : ℝ => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      M k l * partialDeriv k (fun y' : E3 => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) y *
        partialDeriv l (fun y' : E3 => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) y)
    (hN i) hS hM0
  have hs : Real.sqrt (M 0 0) ≠ 0 := Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hM0
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt (M 0 0) ^ 2 = M 0 0 := Real.sq_sqrt hM0.le
  refine ⟨?_, fun a => ?_⟩
  · convert hderiv 0 using 1
    rw [hMsymm 1 0, hMsymm 2 0]
    generalize Real.sqrt (M 0 0) = s at hs hs2 ⊢
    rw [← hs2]
    field_simp
    ring
  · convert hderiv a.succ using 1
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_one_eq_two]
    rw [hMsymm 1 0, hMsymm 2 0]
    field_simp
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (s₁ : ℝ) (hs₁ : 0 < s₁)
    (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hMs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b)
      {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W})
    (hσs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W})
    (hσpos : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W}, 0 < Real.sqrt (G y).det)
    (hMpos : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W}, ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j)
    (hAs : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => pcrL0A G y a b)
      {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W})
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hdiv : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W} →
      (∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W},
        0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k f y * partialDeriv l f y) →
      ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W},
        Real.sqrt (G y).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (pcrL0Z G f i) y)
    (hV : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W},
      HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => pcrL0Z G (fun y' => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) 0 y) 0 0 ∧
      ∀ a : Fin 2, HasDerivAt
        (fun ε : ℝ => pcrL0Z G (fun y' => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) a.succ y)
        (-∑ b : Fin 2, pcrL0A G y a b * pd2 b w (hpProj y)) 0)
    (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W)
    (hleaf : levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y => y 0) (hpLift 0 x) = 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun s => levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y => y 0) (hpLift s x)) 0 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => pcrH G (fun x' => ε * w x') x)
      (-(Real.sqrt (G (hpLift 0 x)).det)⁻¹ * ∑ a : Fin 2,
        pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, pcrL0A G (hpLift 0 x') a b * pd2 b w x') x) 0

(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (s₁ : ℝ) (hs₁ : 0 < s₁)
    (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hMs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b)
      {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W})
    (hσs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W})
    (hσpos : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W}, 0 < Real.sqrt (G y).det)
    (hMpos : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W}, ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, v ≠ 0 →

      {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W})
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hdiv : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W} →
      (∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W},
        0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k f y * partialDeriv l f y) →
      ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W},
        Real.sqrt (G y).det * levelMeanCurvCoord G f y =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (pcrL0Z G f i) y)
    (hV : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ W},
      HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => pcrL0Z G (fun y' => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) 0 y) 0 0 ∧
      ∀ a : Fin 2, HasDerivAt
        (fun ε : ℝ => pcrL0Z G (fun y' => y' 0 - ε * w (hpProj y')) a.succ y)
        (-∑ b : Fin 2, pcrL0A G y a b * pd2 b w (hpProj y)) 0)
    (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W)
    (hleaf : levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y => y 0) (hpLift 0 x) = 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun s => levelMeanCurvCoord G (fun y => y 0) (hpLift s x)) 0 0) :
