signature.name: pcr_balls_exist
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (hSc : IsCompact S)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) : Nonempty (PcrBalls P)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let ι := {τ : Fin P.n × E2 × ℝ // 0 < τ.2.2 ∧ Metric.closedBall τ.2.1 τ.2.2 ⊆ P.W τ.1}
  let V : ι → Set X := fun τ => P.O τ.1.1 ∩ P.proj τ.1.1 ⁻¹' Metric.ball τ.1.2.1 τ.1.2.2
  have hVo : ∀ τ, IsOpen (V τ) := fun τ =>
    (P.proj_cont τ.1.1).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open τ.1.1) Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hM : ∀ τ : ι, ∀ q ∈ V τ, q ∈ S →
      ∃ x ∈ Metric.ball τ.1.2.1 τ.1.2.2, P.param τ.1.1 x = q := by
    intro τ q hq hqS
    have hq' : q ∈ P.param τ.1.1 '' P.W τ.1.1 := by
      rw [P.image_eq]; exact ⟨hq.1, hqS⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hq'
    refine ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩
    have h2 : P.proj τ.1.1 (P.param τ.1.1 x) ∈ Metric.ball τ.1.2.1 τ.1.2.2 := hq.2
    rwa [P.proj_param _ x hx] at h2
  have hcov : S ⊆ ⋃ τ, V τ := by
    intro q hqS
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (P.cover hqS)
    have hq' : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq]; exact ⟨hj, hqS⟩
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, rfl⟩ := hq'
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (P.W_open j) x₀ hx₀
    let τ : ι := ⟨(j, x₀, ε / 2), half_pos hε,
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hε)).trans hball⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨τ, hj, ?_⟩
    show P.proj j (P.param j x₀) ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (ε / 2)
    rw [P.proj_param j x₀ hx₀]
    exact Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos hε)
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hSc.elim_finite_subcover V hVo hcov
  let τf : Fin t.card → ι := fun i => (t.equivFin.symm i : ι)
  refine ⟨{
    N := t.card
    j := (fun i => (τf i).1.1)
    c := (fun i => (τf i).1.2.1)
    ρ := (fun i => (τf i).1.2.2)
    ρ_pos := (fun i => (τf i).2.1)
    sub := (fun i => (τf i).2.2)
    cover := ?_ }⟩
  intro q hqS
  obtain ⟨τ', hτ't, hqV⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (ht hqS)
  refine ⟨t.equivFin ⟨τ', hτ't⟩, ?_⟩
  have hτ : τf (t.equivFin ⟨τ', hτ't⟩) = τ' := by simp [τf]
  show ∃ x ∈ Metric.ball (τf (t.equivFin ⟨τ', hτ't⟩)).1.2.1 (τf (t.equivFin ⟨τ', hτ't⟩)).1.2.2,
    P.param (τf (t.equivFin ⟨τ', hτ't⟩)).1.1 x = q
  rw [hτ]
  exact hM τ' q hqV hqS

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
    (m m' : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ m') (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : pcrHolLoc α m' w U) : pcrHolLoc α m w U

signature.name: pcr_holLoc_mono
signature.statement:
(U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
    (m m' : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ m') (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : pcrHolLoc α m' w U) : pcrHolLoc α m w U

proof.tactics:
by
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hm with h | h
  · subst h
    exact hw
  refine ⟨hw.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast hm), fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hxa : ContDiffAt ℝ m' w x := hw.1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
  have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w) x := by
    apply hxa.iteratedFDeriv_right
    have : (1 + m : ℕ) ≤ m' := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  obtain ⟨K, t, ht, hL⟩ := h1.exists_lipschitzOnWith
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) ht)
  have hρ : 0 < min ε (1 / 2) := lt_min hε (by norm_num)
  have hsub : Metric.ball x (min ε (1 / 2)) ⊆ U ∩ t :=
    (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hball
  refine ⟨min ε (1 / 2), hρ, fun y hy => (hsub hy).1, (K : ℝ), fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
  have hdy : dist y x < min ε (1 / 2) := Metric.mem_ball.mp hy
  have hdz : dist z x < min ε (1 / 2) := Metric.mem_ball.mp hz
  have hhalf : min ε (1 / 2) ≤ 1 / 2 := min_le_right _ _
  have hd1 : dist y z ≤ 1 := by
    have := dist_triangle y x z
    rw [dist_comm x z] at this
    linarith
  have hdα : dist y z ≤ dist y z ^ α := by
    have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' dist_nonneg hd1 hα0.le hα1.le
    rwa [Real.rpow_one] at this
  have hLip : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w z‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) * dist y z := by
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    exact hL.dist_le_mul y (hsub hy).2 z (hsub hz).2
  exact hLip.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdα K.coe_nonneg)

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
    (k : ℕ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : pcrHolLoc α (k + 2) w U)
    (D : Set (E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ))) (hD : IsOpen D)
    (Ψ : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → ℝ) (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ D)
    (hjet : ∀ x ∈ U, (x, w x, fderiv ℝ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x) ∈ D) :
    pcrHolLoc α k (fun x => Ψ (x, w x, fderiv ℝ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x)) U

signature.name: pcr_holLoc_jet_comp
signature.statement:
(U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
    (k : ℕ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : pcrHolLoc α (k + 2) w U)
    (D : Set (E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ))) (hD : IsOpen D)
    (Ψ : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → ℝ) (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ D)
    (hjet : ∀ x ∈ U, (x, w x, fderiv ℝ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x) ∈ D) :
    pcrHolLoc α k (fun x => Ψ (x, w x, fderiv ℝ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x)) U

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have F0 : ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (f : E2 → G) (y z : E2),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 f y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 f z‖ = ‖f y - f z‖ := by
    intro G _ _ f y z
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [← map_sub, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
  
  have s1 : ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (m : ℕ) (f : E2 → G),
      pcrHolV α (m + 1) f U ↔ DifferentiableOn ℝ f U ∧ pcrHolV α m (fderiv ℝ f) U := by
    intro G _ _ m f
    have hnorm : ∀ y z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f z‖ =
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) z‖ := by
      intro y z
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_right, iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_right]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [← LinearIsometryEquiv.map_sub, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
    have hω : ((m : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ ω := WithTop.natCast_ne_top m
    have hcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) f U ↔
        DifferentiableOn ℝ f U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ((m : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fderiv ℝ f) U := by
      rw [show ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = ((m : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 by push_cast; rfl,
        contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, -, h3⟩
        exact ⟨h1, h3⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h3⟩
        exact ⟨h1, fun h => absurd h hω, h3⟩
    unfold pcrHolV
    rw [hcd]
    simp only [hnorm]
    exact and_assoc
  
  have s2 : ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (m : ℕ) (f : E2 → G),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) f U → pcrHolV α m f U := by
    intro G _ _ m f hf
    refine ⟨hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ m), fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hU x hx
    have hcb : Metric.closedBall x (ε / 2) ⊆ U :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f) U :=
      (hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin le_rfl hU.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun y hy => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m + 1) hU hy).symm)
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x (ε / 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hcont.mono hcb)
    have hdiff : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball x (ε / 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) v := by
      intro v hv
      exact (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hcb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hv)))).differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv
        (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self m)
    have hbd : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball x (ε / 2), ‖fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) v‖ ≤ max L 0 := by
      intro v hv
      rw [norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv]
      exact (hL v (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hv)).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    refine ⟨ε / 2, by linarith, (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball,
      max L 0 * ε ^ (1 - α), ?_⟩
    intro y hy z hz
    have hmv := (convex_ball x (ε / 2)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff hbd hz hy
    rw [← dist_eq_norm y z] at hmv
    have hd : dist y z < ε := by
      have hy' : dist y x < ε / 2 := hy
      have hz' : dist z x < ε / 2 := hz
      calc dist y z ≤ dist y x + dist z x := dist_triangle_right y z x
        _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := add_lt_add hy' hz'
        _ = ε := by ring
    have key : dist y z ≤ ε ^ (1 - α) * dist y z ^ α := by
      rcases (dist_nonneg (x := y) (y := z)).eq_or_lt with h | h
      · rw [← h, Real.zero_rpow hα0.ne']
        simp
      · calc dist y z = dist y z ^ (1 - α) * dist y z ^ α := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add h]; simp
          _ ≤ ε ^ (1 - α) * dist y z ^ α :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.rpow_le_rpow h.le hd.le (by linarith))
                (Real.rpow_nonneg h.le _)
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖ ≤ max L 0 * dist y z := hmv
      _ ≤ max L 0 * (ε ^ (1 - α) * dist y z ^ α) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key (le_max_right _ _)
      _ = max L 0 * ε ^ (1 - α) * dist y z ^ α := by ring
  
  have s3 : ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (m : ℕ) (f g : E2 → G),
      pcrHolV α m f U → pcrHolV α m g U → pcrHolV α m (fun x => f x + g x) U := by
    intro G _ _ m f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ρf, hρf, hbf, Cf, hCf⟩ := hf.2 x hx
    obtain ⟨ρg, hρg, hbg, Cg, hCg⟩ := hg.2 x hx
    refine ⟨min ρf ρg, lt_min hρf hρg, (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hbf,
      Cf + Cg, ?_⟩
    intro y hy z hz
    have hyf := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hy
    have hzf := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz
    have hyg := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hy
    have hzg := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz
    have hadd : ∀ v ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x => f x + g x) v =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f v + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g v := fun v hv =>
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hf.1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hv)) (hg.1.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hv))
    rw [hadd y (hbf hyf), hadd z (hbf hzf)]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y -
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g z)‖
        = ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z) +
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g z)‖ := by congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖ +
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ Cf * dist y z ^ α + Cg * dist y z ^ α :=
          add_le_add (hCf y hyf z hzf) (hCg y hyg z hzg)
      _ = (Cf + Cg) * dist y z ^ α := by ring
  
  have s3b : ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (m : ℕ) (f g : E2 → G),
      (∀ x ∈ U, f x = g x) → pcrHolV α m f U → pcrHolV α m g U := by
    intro G _ _ m f g hfg hf
    have heq : ∀ y ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y := by
      intro y hy
      have hev : g =ᶠ[𝓝 y] f :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun v hv => (hfg v hv).symm)
      exact (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds
    refine ⟨hf.1.congr (fun y hy => (hfg y hy).symm), fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hb, C, hC⟩ := hf.2 x hx
    refine ⟨ρ, hρ, hb, C, fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
    rw [heq y (hb hy), heq z (hb hz)]
    exact hC y hy z hz
  
  have s4 : ∀ (m : ℕ) {G₁ G₂ G₃ : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G₁] [NormedSpace ℝ G₁]
      [NormedAddCommGroup G₂] [NormedSpace ℝ G₂] [NormedAddCommGroup G₃] [NormedSpace ℝ G₃]
      (β : G₁ →L[ℝ] G₂ →L[ℝ] G₃) (a : E2 → G₁) (b : E2 → G₂),
      pcrHolV α m a U → pcrHolV α m b U → pcrHolV α m (fun x => β (a x) (b x)) U := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro G₁ G₂ G₃ _ _ _ _ _ _ β a b ha hb
      refine ⟨(β.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn ha.1).clm_apply hb.1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨ρa, hρa, hba, Ca, hCa⟩ := ha.2 x hx
      obtain ⟨ρb, hρb, hbb, Cb, hCb⟩ := hb.2 x hx
      have hρ0 : 0 < min ρa ρb := lt_min hρa hρb
      have hb0 : Metric.ball x (min ρa ρb) ⊆ U :=
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hba
      have hcb : Metric.closedBall x (min ρa ρb / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball x (min ρa ρb) :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨Ma, hMa⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x (min ρa ρb / 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (ha.1.continuousOn.mono (hcb.trans hb0))
      obtain ⟨Mb, hMb⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x (min ρa ρb / 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hb.1.continuousOn.mono (hcb.trans hb0))
      refine ⟨min ρa ρb / 2, by linarith, (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcb).trans hb0,
        ‖β‖ * (Ca * max Mb 0 + max Ma 0 * Cb), ?_⟩
      intro y hy z hz
      rw [F0]
      have hyc : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x (min ρa ρb / 2) := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy
      have hzc : z ∈ Metric.closedBall x (min ρa ρb / 2) := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz
      have hya : y ∈ Metric.ball x ρa := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) (hcb hyc)
      have hza : z ∈ Metric.ball x ρa := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) (hcb hzc)
      have hyb : y ∈ Metric.ball x ρb := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) (hcb hyc)
      have hzb : z ∈ Metric.ball x ρb := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) (hcb hzc)
      have h1 : ‖a y - a z‖ ≤ Ca * dist y z ^ α := by rw [← F0]; exact hCa y hya z hza
      have h2 : ‖b y - b z‖ ≤ Cb * dist y z ^ α := by rw [← F0]; exact hCb y hyb z hzb
      have hMa' : ‖a z‖ ≤ max Ma 0 := (hMa z hzc).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      have hMb' : ‖b y‖ ≤ max Mb 0 := (hMb y hyc).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      have hsplit : β (a y) (b y) - β (a z) (b z) =
          β (a y - a z) (b y) + β (a z) (b y - b z) := by
        simp only [map_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
        abel
      calc ‖β (a y) (b y) - β (a z) (b z)‖
          = ‖β (a y - a z) (b y) + β (a z) (b y - b z)‖ := by rw [hsplit]
        _ ≤ ‖β (a y - a z) (b y)‖ + ‖β (a z) (b y - b z)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖β‖ * ‖a y - a z‖ * ‖b y‖ + ‖β‖ * ‖a z‖ * ‖b y - b z‖ :=
            add_le_add (β.le_opNorm₂ _ _) (β.le_opNorm₂ _ _)
        _ ≤ ‖β‖ * (Ca * dist y z ^ α) * max Mb 0 + ‖β‖ * max Ma 0 * (Cb * dist y z ^ α) :=
            add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)) hMb' (by positivity)
                (mul_nonneg (by positivity) ((norm_nonneg _).trans h1)))
              (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMa' (by positivity)) h2 (by positivity)
                (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (le_max_right _ _)))
        _ = ‖β‖ * (Ca * max Mb 0 + max Ma 0 * Cb) * dist y z ^ α := by ring
    | succ m ih =>
      intro G₁ G₂ G₃ _ _ _ _ _ _ β a b ha hb
      obtain ⟨hda, ha'⟩ := (s1 m a).1 ha
      obtain ⟨hdb, hb'⟩ := (s1 m b).1 hb
      have ha0 : pcrHolV α m a U := s2 m a ha.1
      have hb0 : pcrHolV α m b U := s2 m b hb.1
      have T1 := ih (ContinuousLinearMap.precompR E2 β) a (fderiv ℝ b) ha0 hb'
      have T2 := ih (ContinuousLinearMap.precompL E2 β) (fderiv ℝ a) b ha' hb0
      have T := s3 m _ _ T1 T2
      have hder : ∀ x ∈ U, HasFDerivAt (fun y => β (a y) (b y))
          (ContinuousLinearMap.precompR E2 β (a x) (fderiv ℝ b x) +
            ContinuousLinearMap.precompL E2 β (fderiv ℝ a x) (b x)) x := fun x hx =>
        β.hasFDerivAt_of_bilinear (hda.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
          (hdb.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
      exact (s1 m _).2 ⟨fun x hx => (hder x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
        s3b m _ _ (fun x hx => (hder x hx).fderiv.symm) T⟩
  
  have s5 : ∀ (m : ℕ) {G H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
      [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H] (D' : Set G), IsOpen D' →
      ∀ (Φ : G → H), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ D' → ∀ (g : E2 → G), pcrHolV α m g U →
      (∀ x ∈ U, g x ∈ D') → pcrHolV α m (fun x => Φ (g x)) U := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro G H _ _ _ _ D' hD' Φ hΦ g hg hgD
      refine ⟨(hΦ.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).comp hg.1 hgD, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      have hcf : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ Φ) D' := hΦ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hD' (by simp)
      obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, hfε⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.1
        (hcf.continuousAt (hD'.mem_nhds (hgD x hx))) 1 one_pos
      obtain ⟨ε₂, hε₂, hballD⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hD' (g x) (hgD x hx)
      have hdiffΦ : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (g x) (min ε₁ ε₂), DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ v := fun v hv =>
        (hΦ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
          (hD'.mem_nhds (hballD (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hv)))
      have hbdΦ : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (g x) (min ε₁ ε₂),
          ‖fderiv ℝ Φ v‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ Φ (g x)‖ + 1 := by
        intro v hv
        have h := hfε (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hv)
        rw [dist_eq_norm] at h
        have := norm_sub_norm_le (fderiv ℝ Φ v) (fderiv ℝ Φ (g x))
        linarith
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hgδ⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.1
        (hg.1.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)) (min ε₁ ε₂) (lt_min hε₁ hε₂)
      obtain ⟨ρg, hρg, hbg, Cg, hCg⟩ := hg.2 x hx
      refine ⟨min δ ρg, lt_min hδ hρg, (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hbg,
        (‖fderiv ℝ Φ (g x)‖ + 1) * Cg, ?_⟩
      intro y hy z hz
      rw [F0]
      have hy' : g y ∈ Metric.ball (g x) (min ε₁ ε₂) :=
        hgδ (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hy)
      have hz' : g z ∈ Metric.ball (g x) (min ε₁ ε₂) :=
        hgδ (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz)
      have hmv := (convex_ball (g x) (min ε₁ ε₂)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
        hdiffΦ hbdΦ hz' hy'
      have hgH : ‖g y - g z‖ ≤ Cg * dist y z ^ α := by
        rw [← F0]
        exact hCg y (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hy) z
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz)
      calc ‖Φ (g y) - Φ (g z)‖ ≤ (‖fderiv ℝ Φ (g x)‖ + 1) * ‖g y - g z‖ := hmv
        _ ≤ (‖fderiv ℝ Φ (g x)‖ + 1) * (Cg * dist y z ^ α) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgH (by positivity)
        _ = (‖fderiv ℝ Φ (g x)‖ + 1) * Cg * dist y z ^ α := by ring
    | succ m ih =>
      intro G H _ _ _ _ D' hD' Φ hΦ g hg hgD
      obtain ⟨hdg, hg'⟩ := (s1 m g).1 hg
      have hg0 : pcrHolV α m g U := s2 m g hg.1
      obtain ⟨hdΦ, hΦ'⟩ := (contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hD').1 hΦ
      have hA := ih D' hD' (fderiv ℝ Φ) hΦ' g hg0 hgD
      have hB := s4 m (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ E2 G H) (fun x => fderiv ℝ Φ (g x))
        (fderiv ℝ g) hA hg'
      have hder : ∀ x ∈ U, HasFDerivAt (fun y => Φ (g y))
          (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ E2 G H (fderiv ℝ Φ (g x)) (fderiv ℝ g x)) x := by
        intro x hx
        have h1 := (hdΦ.differentiableAt (hD'.mem_nhds (hgD x hx))).hasFDerivAt
        have h2 := (hdg.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply]
        exact h1.comp x h2
      exact (s1 m _).2 ⟨fun x hx => (hder x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
        s3b m _ _ (fun x hx => (hder x hx).fderiv.symm) hB⟩
  
  have hw' : pcrHolV α (k + 2) w U := hw
  obtain ⟨-, h1'⟩ := (s1 (k + 1) w).1 hw'
  obtain ⟨-, h2⟩ := (s1 k (fderiv ℝ w)).1 h1'
  have h1 : pcrHolV α k (fderiv ℝ w) U := s2 k _ h1'.1
  have h0 : pcrHolV α k w U :=
    s2 k w (hw'.1.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : k + 1 ≤ k + 2)))
  have hid : pcrHolV α k (fun x : E2 => x) U := s2 k _ contDiffOn_id
  have pair : ∀ {A B : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A] [NormedAddCommGroup B]
      [NormedSpace ℝ B] (p : E2 → A) (q : E2 → B), pcrHolV α k p U → pcrHolV α k q U →
      pcrHolV α k (fun x => (p x, q x)) U := by
    intro A B _ _ _ _ p q hp hq
    have hl := s5 k Set.univ isOpen_univ (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A B)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A B).contDiff.contDiffOn p hp (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    have hr := s5 k Set.univ isOpen_univ (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B).contDiff.contDiffOn q hq (fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    refine s3b k _ _ (fun x _ => ?_) (s3 k _ _ hl hr)
    simp
  have hJ := pair _ _ hid (pair _ _ h0 (pair _ _ h1 h2))
  exact s5 k D hD Ψ hΨ _ hJ hjet

pcr_holLoc_jet_comp.definitions:
def pcrHolV {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
    (α : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (f : E2 → G) (U : Set E2) : Prop :=
  ContDiffOn ℝ m f U ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ Metric.ball x ρ ⊆ U ∧ ∃ C : ℝ,
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x ρ, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x ρ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖ ≤ C * dist y z ^ α

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hKU : Metric.closedBall c ρ ⊆ U) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (m : ℕ)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : pcrHolLoc α m w U) : ∃ h : pcrLocAmb c ρ m, pcrLocRel c ρ α m w h

signature.name: pcr_locRel_exists
signature.statement:
(c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hKU : Metric.closedBall c ρ ⊆ U) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (m : ℕ)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : pcrHolLoc α m w U) : ∃ h : pcrLocAmb c ρ m, pcrLocRel c ρ α m w h

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have unif : ∀ n : ℕ, pcrHolLoc α n w U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c ρ,
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c ρ,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w z‖ ≤ C * dist y z ^ α := by
    intro n hn
    have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall c ρ) := isCompact_closedBall c ρ
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w) U :=
      (hn.1.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin le_rfl hU.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hU).symm
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hKU)
    choose r hr hrU Cx hCx using fun x : Metric.closedBall c ρ => hn.2 x (hKU x.2)
    have hcov : Metric.closedBall c ρ ⊆
        ⋃ x : Metric.closedBall c ρ, Metric.ball (x : E2) (r x) := by
      intro y hy
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr _)⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover
      (fun x : Metric.closedBall c ρ => Metric.ball (x : E2) (r x))
      (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) hcov
    have hcov2 : Metric.closedBall c ρ ⊆
        ⋃ i : {x : Metric.closedBall c ρ // x ∈ t}, Metric.ball ((i : Metric.closedBall c ρ) : E2)
          (r i) := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (ht hy)
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hyx⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hleb⟩ :=
      lebesgue_number_lemma_of_metric hK (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) hcov2
    have hδα : 0 < δ ^ α := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hδ α
    have hS : 0 ≤ ∑ x ∈ t, |Cx x| := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
    have hT : 0 ≤ 2 * |M| / δ ^ α := div_nonneg (by positivity) hδα.le
    refine ⟨(∑ x ∈ t, |Cx x|) + 2 * |M| / δ ^ α, fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
    have hdα : 0 ≤ dist y z ^ α := Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg α
    rcases lt_or_ge (dist y z) δ with hd | hd
    · obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hsub⟩ := hleb y hy
      have hy' : y ∈ Metric.ball (x : E2) (r x) := hsub (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
      have hz' : z ∈ Metric.ball (x : E2) (r x) :=
        hsub (by rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm]; exact hd)
      have h1 := hCx x y hy' z hz'
      have h2 : Cx x ≤ ∑ x ∈ t, |Cx x| := (le_abs_self _).trans
        (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun x => |Cx x|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _) hx)
      calc _ ≤ Cx x * dist y z ^ α := h1
        _ ≤ ((∑ x ∈ t, |Cx x|) + 2 * |M| / δ ^ α) * dist y z ^ α :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hdα
    · have h1 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w z‖ ≤ 2 * |M| := by
        have e1 := norm_sub_le (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w y) (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w z)
        have e2 := hM y hy
        have e3 := hM z hz
        have e4 := le_abs_self M
        linarith
      have h2 : δ ^ α ≤ dist y z ^ α := Real.rpow_le_rpow hδ.le hd hα0.le
      have h3 : 2 * |M| = 2 * |M| / δ ^ α * δ ^ α := (div_mul_cancel₀ _ hδα.ne').symm
      calc _ ≤ 2 * |M| := h1
        _ = 2 * |M| / δ ^ α * δ ^ α := h3
        _ ≤ 2 * |M| / δ ^ α * dist y z ^ α := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hT
        _ ≤ ((∑ x ∈ t, |Cx x|) + 2 * |M| / δ ^ α) * dist y z ^ α :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hdα
  
  have hcontl : ∀ l : Fin (m + 1), ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (l : ℕ) w) U := by
    intro l
    have hl : ((l : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp l.isLt
    exact (hw.1.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin hl hU.uniqueDiffOn).congr
      (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (l : ℕ) hU).symm
  
  have unifLow : ∀ n : ℕ, n < m → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c ρ,
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c ρ,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w z‖ ≤ C * dist y z ^ α := by
    intro n hn
    have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall c ρ) := isCompact_closedBall c ρ
    have hn' : ((n : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) < (m : WithTop ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w) U :=
      (hw.1.differentiableOn_iteratedFDerivWithin hn' hU.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hU).symm
    have hn1 : (((n + 1 : ℕ)) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (m : WithTop ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hcont1 : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) w) U :=
      (hw.1.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin hn1 hU.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (n + 1) hU).symm
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont1.mono hKU)
    refine ⟨|M| * (2 * ρ) ^ (1 - α), fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
    have hmvt : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w z‖ ≤ |M| * ‖y - z‖ :=
      (convex_closedBall c ρ).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
        (fun x hx => hdiff.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hKU hx)))
        (fun x hx => by
          rw [norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv]
          exact (hM x hx).trans (le_abs_self M)) hz hy
    rw [← dist_eq_norm] at hmvt
    have hd2 : dist y z ≤ 2 * ρ := by
      have e1 := dist_triangle_right y z c
      have e2 : dist y c ≤ ρ := Metric.mem_closedBall.1 hy
      have e3 : dist z c ≤ ρ := Metric.mem_closedBall.1 hz
      linarith
    have hsplit : dist y z = dist y z ^ α * dist y z ^ (1 - α) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add' dist_nonneg (by norm_num : α + (1 - α) ≠ 0)]
      norm_num
    have hpow : dist y z ^ (1 - α) ≤ (2 * ρ) ^ (1 - α) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow dist_nonneg hd2 (by linarith)
    have hdα : 0 ≤ dist y z ^ α := Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg α
    calc _ ≤ |M| * dist y z := hmvt
      _ = |M| * (dist y z ^ α * dist y z ^ (1 - α)) := by rw [← hsplit]
      _ ≤ |M| * (dist y z ^ α * (2 * ρ) ^ (1 - α)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hdα) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = |M| * (2 * ρ) ^ (1 - α) * dist y z ^ α := by ring
  have hall : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ m → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c ρ,
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c ρ,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ n w z‖ ≤ C * dist y z ^ α := by
    intro n hn
    rcases hn.lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact unifLow n h
    · rw [h]; exact unif m hw
  choose C hC using fun l : Fin (m + 1) => hall l (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp l.isLt)
  haveI : CompactSpace (Metric.closedBall c ρ) :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_closedBall c ρ)
  have hpos : ∀ p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2},
      0 < dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α := by
    intro p
    apply Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
    apply dist_pos.2
    intro h
    exact p.2 (Subtype.ext h)
  have hπ1 : Continuous
      (fun p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} =>
        (p.1.1 : E2)) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val)
  have hπ2 : Continuous
      (fun p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} =>
        (p.1.2 : E2)) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val)
  have hqc : ∀ l : Fin (m + 1), Continuous
      (fun p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} =>
        (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ •
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w p.1.1 - iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w p.1.2)) := by
    intro l
    have hd : Continuous
        (fun p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} =>
          dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α) :=
      (hπ1.dist hπ2).rpow_const (fun _ => Or.inr hα0.le)
    have h1 : Continuous
        (fun p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} =>
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w p.1.1) :=
      ((hcontl l).mono hKU).comp_continuous hπ1 (fun p => p.1.1.2)
    have h2 : Continuous
        (fun p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} =>
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w p.1.2) :=
      ((hcontl l).mono hKU).comp_continuous hπ2 (fun p => p.1.2.2)
    exact (hd.inv₀ (fun p => (hpos p).ne')).smul (h1.sub h2)
  have hqb : ∀ (l : Fin (m + 1))
      (p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2}),
      ‖(dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ •
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w p.1.1 - iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w p.1.2)‖ ≤ C l := by
    intro l p
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 (hpos p).le)]
    calc _ ≤ (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ *
          (C l * dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC l _ p.1.1.2 _ p.1.2.2) (inv_nonneg.2 (hpos p).le)
      _ = C l := by rw [mul_comm (C l), inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (hpos p).ne']
  refine ⟨fun l => (BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact
      ⟨fun x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ l w x, ((hcontl l).mono hKU).restrict⟩,
    BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup _ (hqc l) (C l) (hqb l)), ?_⟩
  intro l
  exact ⟨fun x => rfl, fun p => rfl⟩

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (B : PcrBalls P) (α : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (g : pcrAmb B m) :
    g ∈ pcrSp B α m ↔ ∃ u : X → ℝ, pcrClass P α m u ∧
      ∀ i, pcrLocRel (B.c i) (B.ρ i) α m (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) x)) (g i)

signature.name: pcr_sp_mem_iff
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (B : PcrBalls P) (α : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (g : pcrAmb B m) :
    g ∈ pcrSp B α m ↔ ∃ u : X → ℝ, pcrClass P α m u ∧
      ∀ i, pcrLocRel (B.c i) (B.ρ i) α m (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) x)) (g i)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hCD : ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ m w U → ∀ y ∈ U,
      ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ m → ContDiffAt ℝ l w y := by
    intro w U hU hw y hy l hl
    exact (hw.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast hl)
  constructor
  · intro hg
    unfold pcrSp at hg
    induction hg using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx => exact hx
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ⟨fun q _ => rfl, fun j => ⟨contDiffOn_const, fun x hx => ?_⟩⟩,
        fun i l => ⟨fun x => ?_, fun p => ?_⟩⟩
      · obtain ⟨ε, hε, hb⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (P.W_open j) x hx
        refine ⟨ε, hε, hb, 0, fun y _ z _ => ?_⟩
        simp [iteratedFDeriv_zero_fun]
      · have h0 : ((0 : pcrAmb B m) i l) = 0 := rfl
        rw [h0]
        simp [iteratedFDeriv_zero_fun]
      · have h0 : ((0 : pcrAmb B m) i l) = 0 := rfl
        rw [h0]
        simp [iteratedFDeriv_zero_fun]
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hr⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨u', hu', hr'⟩ := hy
      have e : ∀ j, (fun x => (u + u') (P.param j x)) =
          (fun x => u (P.param j x)) + (fun x => u' (P.param j x)) := fun j => rfl
      refine ⟨u + u', ⟨fun q hq => by simp [hu.1 q hq, hu'.1 q hq], fun j => ⟨?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩⟩,
        fun i l => ⟨fun x => ?_, fun p => ?_⟩⟩
      · exact (hu.2 j).1.add (hu'.2 j).1
      · obtain ⟨ρ₁, hρ₁, hb₁, C₁, hC₁⟩ := (hu.2 j).2 x hx
        obtain ⟨ρ₂, hρ₂, hb₂, C₂, hC₂⟩ := (hu'.2 j).2 x hx
        refine ⟨min ρ₁ ρ₂, lt_min hρ₁ hρ₂,
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hb₁, C₁ + C₂, fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
        have hy₁ : y ∈ Metric.ball x ρ₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hy
        have hz₁ : z ∈ Metric.ball x ρ₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz
        have hy₂ : y ∈ Metric.ball x ρ₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hy
        have hz₂ : z ∈ Metric.ball x ρ₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz
        rw [e j, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hCD _ _ (P.W_open j) (hu.2 j).1 y (hb₁ hy₁) m le_rfl)
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open j) (hu'.2 j).1 y (hb₁ hy₁) m le_rfl),
          iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hCD _ _ (P.W_open j) (hu.2 j).1 z (hb₁ hz₁) m le_rfl)
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open j) (hu'.2 j).1 z (hb₁ hz₁) m le_rfl),
          add_sub_add_comm]
        calc _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ C₁ * dist y z ^ α + C₂ * dist y z ^ α :=
            add_le_add (hC₁ y hy₁ z hz₁) (hC₂ y hy₂ z hz₂)
          _ = (C₁ + C₂) * dist y z ^ α := by ring
      · have hl : (l : ℕ) ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp l.isLt
        have hxW : (x : E2) ∈ P.W (B.j i) := B.sub i x.2
        rw [e (B.j i), iteratedFDeriv_add_apply
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open _) (hu.2 _).1 _ hxW l hl)
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open _) (hu'.2 _).1 _ hxW l hl),
          ← (hr i l).1 x, ← (hr' i l).1 x]
        rfl
      · have hl : (l : ℕ) ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp l.isLt
        have h1W : (p.1.1 : E2) ∈ P.W (B.j i) := B.sub i p.1.1.2
        have h2W : (p.1.2 : E2) ∈ P.W (B.j i) := B.sub i p.1.2.2
        rw [e (B.j i), iteratedFDeriv_add_apply
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open _) (hu.2 _).1 _ h1W l hl)
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open _) (hu'.2 _).1 _ h1W l hl),
          iteratedFDeriv_add_apply
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open _) (hu.2 _).1 _ h2W l hl)
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open _) (hu'.2 _).1 _ h2W l hl),
          add_sub_add_comm, smul_add, ← (hr i l).2 p, ← (hr' i l).2 p]
        rfl
    | smul a x _ hx =>
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hr⟩ := hx
      have e : ∀ j, (fun x => (a • u) (P.param j x)) = a • (fun x => u (P.param j x)) :=
        fun j => rfl
      refine ⟨a • u, ⟨fun q hq => by simp [hu.1 q hq], fun j => ⟨?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩⟩,
        fun i l => ⟨fun x => ?_, fun p => ?_⟩⟩
      · exact (hu.2 j).1.const_smul a
      · obtain ⟨ρ₁, hρ₁, hb₁, C₁, hC₁⟩ := (hu.2 j).2 x hx
        refine ⟨ρ₁, hρ₁, hb₁, |a| * C₁, fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
        rw [e j, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open j) (hu.2 j).1 y (hb₁ hy) m le_rfl),
          iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open j) (hu.2 j).1 z (hb₁ hz) m le_rfl),
          ← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC₁ y hy z hz) (abs_nonneg a)
      · have hl : (l : ℕ) ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp l.isLt
        have hxW : (x : E2) ∈ P.W (B.j i) := B.sub i x.2
        rw [e (B.j i), iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open _) (hu.2 _).1 _ hxW l hl), ← (hr i l).1 x]
        rfl
      · have hl : (l : ℕ) ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp l.isLt
        have h1W : (p.1.1 : E2) ∈ P.W (B.j i) := B.sub i p.1.1.2
        have h2W : (p.1.2 : E2) ∈ P.W (B.j i) := B.sub i p.1.2.2
        rw [e (B.j i), iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open _) (hu.2 _).1 _ h1W l hl),
          iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply
            (hCD _ _ (P.W_open _) (hu.2 _).1 _ h2W l hl),
          ← smul_sub, smul_comm _ a, ← (hr i l).2 p]
        rfl
  · intro h
    exact Submodule.subset_span h

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (B : PcrBalls P) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (m : ℕ) :
    IsClosed ((pcrSp B α m : Submodule ℝ (pcrAmb B m)) : Set (pcrAmb B m))

signature.name: pcr_sp_closed
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (B : PcrBalls P) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (m : ℕ) :
    IsClosed ((pcrSp B α m : Submodule ℝ (pcrAmb B m)) : Set (pcrAmb B m))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have Pa : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ S ∧ P.param j x ∈ P.O j := by
    intro j x hx
    have h : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq] at h
    exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
  have hval0 : ∀ (c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (h : pcrLocAmb c ρ m),
      pcrLocRel c ρ α m w h → ∀ x : Metric.closedBall c ρ,
        (h ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩).1 x (fun _ => 0) = w x := by
    intro c ρ w h hr x
    have h1 := congrArg (fun T => T (fun _ => (0 : E2))) ((hr ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩).1 x)
    exact h1.trans (iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply _)
  have G1 : ∀ (h : pcrAmb B m) (v : X → ℝ), pcrClass P α m v →
      (∀ i, pcrLocRel (B.c i) (B.ρ i) α m (fun x => v (P.param (B.j i) x)) (h i)) →
      pcrEval B m h = v := by
    intro h v hv hrel
    funext q
    simp only [pcrEval, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
    split_ifs with hh
    · exact (hval0 _ _ _ _ (hrel hh.choose) _).trans
        (congrArg v hh.choose_spec.choose_spec.2)
    · have hq : q ∉ S := fun hq => hh (B.cover q hq)
      exact (hv.1 q hq).symm
  have hT0 : ∀ T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin 0 => E2) ℝ,
      ‖T (fun _ => 0)‖ ≤ ‖T‖ := fun T => by simpa using T.le_opNorm (fun _ => 0)
  have hnormB : ∀ (h : pcrAmb B m) (i : Fin B.N), ‖(h i ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩).1‖ ≤ ‖h‖ := by
    intro h i
    calc ‖(h i ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩).1‖ ≤ ‖h i ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos m⟩‖ := norm_fst_le _
      _ ≤ ‖h i‖ := norm_le_pi_norm (h i) _
      _ ≤ ‖h‖ := norm_le_pi_norm h i
  have G4 : ∀ (h : pcrAmb B m) (q : X), |pcrEval B m h q| ≤ ‖h‖ := by
    intro h q
    simp only [pcrEval, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
    split_ifs with hh
    · rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact (hT0 _).trans ((BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_coe_le_norm _ _).trans
        (hnormB h hh.choose))
    · simp
  
  refine isClosed_of_closure_subset fun g hg => ?_
  obtain ⟨gs, hgsmem, hgs⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.1 hg
  have hex : ∀ n, ∃ v : X → ℝ, pcrClass P α m v ∧
      ∀ i, pcrLocRel (B.c i) (B.ρ i) α m (fun x => v (P.param (B.j i) x)) (gs n i) :=
    fun n => (pcr_sp_mem_iff P B α m (gs n)).1 (hgsmem n)
  choose us hus hrel using hex
  
  obtain ⟨u, hconv⟩ : ∃ u : X → ℝ, ∀ q, Tendsto (fun n => us n q) atTop (𝓝 (u q)) := by
    refine ⟨pcrEval B m g, fun q => ?_⟩
    let lam : pcrAmb B m →L[ℝ] ℝ := LinearMap.mkContinuous
      ((LinearMap.proj (R := ℝ) (φ := fun _ : X => ℝ) q).comp (pcrEval B m)) 1
      (fun f => by
        rw [one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact G4 f q)
    have h1 : Tendsto (fun n => lam (gs n)) atTop (𝓝 (lam g)) :=
      (lam.continuous.tendsto g).comp hgs
    have h2 : (fun n => lam (gs n)) = fun n => us n q := funext fun n => by
      show pcrEval B m (gs n) q = us n q
      rw [G1 (gs n) (us n) (hus n) (hrel n)]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact h1
  have hU0 : ∀ q, q ∉ S → u q = 0 := by
    intro q hq
    have h1 := hconv q
    have h2 : (fun n => us n q) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := funext fun n => (hus n).1 q hq
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 tendsto_const_nhds
  
  obtain ⟨Gi, hGi⟩ : ∃ Gi : ∀ (i : Fin B.N) (l : Fin (m + 1)),
      E2 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ, ∀ i l x,
      Gi i l x = if hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (B.c i) (B.ρ i) then (g i l).1 ⟨x, hx⟩ else 0 :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hunif : ∀ i (l : Fin (m + 1)), TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun n x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun x' => us n (P.param (B.j i) x')) x) (Gi i l) atTop
      (Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)) := by
    intro i l
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 hgs ε hε
    refine Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨N, fun n hn x hx => ?_⟩
    have hxK : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (B.c i) (B.ρ i) := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx
    have e1 : Gi i l x = (g i l).1 ⟨x, hxK⟩ := by rw [hGi, dif_pos hxK]
    have e2 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun x' => us n (P.param (B.j i) x')) x =
        (gs n i l).1 ⟨x, hxK⟩ := ((hrel n i l).1 ⟨x, hxK⟩).symm
    rw [e1, e2]
    calc dist ((g i l).1 ⟨x, hxK⟩) ((gs n i l).1 ⟨x, hxK⟩) ≤ dist (g i l).1 (gs n i l).1 :=
          BoundedContinuousFunction.dist_coe_le_dist _
      _ ≤ dist (g i l) (gs n i l) := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) Prod.dist_eq.ge
      _ ≤ dist (g i) (gs n i) := dist_le_pi_dist _ _ l
      _ ≤ dist g (gs n) := dist_le_pi_dist _ _ i
      _ = dist (gs n) g := dist_comm _ _
      _ < ε := hN n hn
  have hball : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) x))
      (Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)) ∧
      ∀ l : Fin (m + 1), ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i),
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) x)) x = Gi i l x := fun i =>
    pcr_unif_limit_iteratedFDeriv _ Metric.isOpen_ball m (fun n x => us n (P.param (B.j i) x))
      (fun n => ((hus n).2 (B.j i)).1.mono (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans (B.sub i)))
      (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) x)) (Gi i) (hunif i) (fun x _ => hconv _)
  
  have hq : ∀ i (l : Fin (m + 1))
      (p : {p : Metric.closedBall (B.c i) (B.ρ i) × Metric.closedBall (B.c i) (B.ρ i) //
        p.1 ≠ p.2}),
      (g i l).2 p = (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ •
        ((g i l).1 p.1.1 - (g i l).1 p.1.2) := by
    intro i l p
    have hc1 : Continuous fun k : pcrAmb B m => k i l :=
      (continuous_apply l).comp (continuous_apply i)
    have hcont : Continuous fun k : pcrAmb B m =>
        (k i l).2 p - (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ •
          ((k i l).1 p.1.1 - (k i l).1 p.1.2) := by
      have a := (BoundedContinuousFunction.continuous_eval_const p).comp (continuous_snd.comp hc1)
      have b := (BoundedContinuousFunction.continuous_eval_const p.1.1).comp
        (continuous_fst.comp hc1)
      have c := (BoundedContinuousFunction.continuous_eval_const p.1.2).comp
        (continuous_fst.comp hc1)
      exact a.sub ((b.sub c).const_smul _)
    have h1 : Tendsto (fun n => (gs n i l).2 p - (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ •
        ((gs n i l).1 p.1.1 - (gs n i l).1 p.1.2)) atTop
        (𝓝 ((g i l).2 p - (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ •
          ((g i l).1 p.1.1 - (g i l).1 p.1.2))) := (hcont.tendsto g).comp hgs
    have h2 : (fun n => (gs n i l).2 p - (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ •
        ((gs n i l).1 p.1.1 - (gs n i l).1 p.1.2)) = fun _ => 0 := by
      funext n
      rw [(hrel n i l).2 p, (hrel n i l).1 p.1.1, (hrel n i l).1 p.1.2, sub_self]
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (tendsto_nhds_unique h1 tendsto_const_nhds)
  
  have hhol : ∀ i (x y : Metric.closedBall (B.c i) (B.ρ i)),
      ‖(g i (Fin.last m)).1 x - (g i (Fin.last m)).1 y‖ ≤ ‖g‖ * dist (x : E2) (y : E2) ^ α := by
    intro i x y
    by_cases hxy : x = y
    · rw [hxy, sub_self, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg _)
    · have hd : 0 < dist (x : E2) (y : E2) := dist_pos.2 (fun h => hxy (Subtype.ext h))
      have hdα : 0 < dist (x : E2) (y : E2) ^ α := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hd α
      have e : (g i (Fin.last m)).2 ⟨(x, y), hxy⟩ = (dist (x : E2) (y : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ •
          ((g i (Fin.last m)).1 x - (g i (Fin.last m)).1 y) := hq i _ _
      have e' : (g i (Fin.last m)).1 x - (g i (Fin.last m)).1 y =
          dist (x : E2) (y : E2) ^ α • (g i (Fin.last m)).2 ⟨(x, y), hxy⟩ := by
        rw [e, smul_inv_smul₀ hdα.ne']
      rw [e', norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hdα.le, mul_comm]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ hdα.le
      calc ‖(g i (Fin.last m)).2 ⟨(x, y), hxy⟩‖ ≤ ‖(g i (Fin.last m)).2‖ :=
            BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_coe_le_norm _ _
        _ ≤ ‖g i (Fin.last m)‖ := norm_snd_le _
        _ ≤ ‖g i‖ := norm_le_pi_norm (g i) _
        _ ≤ ‖g‖ := norm_le_pi_norm g i
  
  have hvhol : ∀ i, pcrHolLoc α m (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) x))
      (Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)) := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨(hball i).1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hx' : dist x (B.c i) < B.ρ i := hx
    refine ⟨B.ρ i - dist x (B.c i), by linarith, Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith), ‖g‖,
      fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
    have hyB : y ∈ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i) := Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith) hy
    have hzB : z ∈ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i) := Metric.ball_subset_ball' (by linarith) hz
    have ey := (hball i).2 (Fin.last m) y hyB
    have ez := (hball i).2 (Fin.last m) z hzB
    rw [hGi, dif_pos (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hyB)] at ey
    rw [hGi, dif_pos (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hzB)] at ez
    simp only [Fin.val_last] at ey ez
    rw [ey, ez]
    exact hhol i _ _
  
  have hloc : ∀ j, ∀ x₀ ∈ P.W j, ∃ V : Set E2, IsOpen V ∧ x₀ ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ P.W j ∧
      pcrHolLoc α m (fun x => u (P.param j x)) V := by
    intro j x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨i, y₀, hy₀, hpy₀⟩ := B.cover _ (Pa j x₀ hx₀).1
    have hy₀W : y₀ ∈ P.W (B.j i) := B.sub i (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy₀)
    have hqO : P.param j x₀ ∈ P.O (B.j i) := by
      rw [← hpy₀]
      exact (Pa _ y₀ hy₀W).2
    have hΩ : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O (B.j i)) :=
      (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open _)
    have hτ := P.trans_smooth j (B.j i)
    have hΩ' : IsOpen ((P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O (B.j i)) ∩
        (fun x => P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x)) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)) :=
      hτ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hΩ Metric.isOpen_ball
    refine ⟨_, hΩ', ⟨⟨hx₀, hqO⟩, ?_⟩, fun x hx => hx.1.1, ?_⟩
    · show P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x₀) ∈ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)
      rw [← hpy₀, P.proj_param _ y₀ hy₀W]
      exact hy₀
    · have hcomp := pcr_holLoc_comp_smooth _ _ hΩ' Metric.isOpen_ball α hα0 hα1 m _ (hvhol i)
        (fun x => P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x)) (hτ.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (fun x hx => hx.2)
      have hff' : ∀ x ∈ (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O (B.j i)) ∩
          (fun x => P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x)) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i),
          u (P.param (B.j i) (P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x))) = u (P.param j x) := by
        intro x hx
        have hS : P.param j x ∈ P.O (B.j i) ∩ S := ⟨hx.1.2, (Pa j x hx.1.1).1⟩
        rw [← P.image_eq] at hS
        obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := hS
        rw [← hzx, P.proj_param _ z hz]
      have key : ∀ y ∈ (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O (B.j i)) ∩
          (fun x => P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x)) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i),
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x => u (P.param j x)) y =
            iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) (P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x)))) y :=
        fun y hy => (Filter.EventuallyEq.iteratedFDeriv ℝ (Filter.eventually_of_mem
          (hΩ'.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => (hff' z hz).symm)) m).eq_of_nhds
      refine ⟨hcomp.1.congr (fun x hx => (hff' x hx).symm), fun x hx => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hb, C, hC⟩ := hcomp.2 x hx
      refine ⟨ρ, hρ, hb, C, fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [key y (hb hy), key z (hb hz)]
      exact hC y hy z hz
  have hpatch : ∀ j, pcrHolLoc α m (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j) := by
    intro j
    refine ⟨contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn fun x hx => ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, -, hh⟩ := hloc j x hx
      exact ⟨V, hV, hxV, hh.1.mono Set.inter_subset_right⟩
    · obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hVW, hh⟩ := hloc j x hx
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hb, C, hC⟩ := hh.2 x hxV
      exact ⟨ρ, hρ, hb.trans hVW, C, hC⟩
  
  have hrelg : ∀ i, pcrLocRel (B.c i) (B.ρ i) α m (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) x)) (g i) := by
    intro i
    have hfirst : ∀ (l : Fin (m + 1)) (x : Metric.closedBall (B.c i) (B.ρ i)),
        (g i l).1 x = iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) x)) x := by
      intro l
      have hA : ContinuousOn (Gi i l) (Metric.closedBall (B.c i) (B.ρ i)) := by
        rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
        have : (Metric.closedBall (B.c i) (B.ρ i)).restrict (Gi i l) = (g i l).1 := by
          funext x
          rw [Set.restrict_apply, hGi, dif_pos x.2]
        rw [this]
        exact (g i l).1.continuous
      have hD : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) x)))
          (Metric.closedBall (B.c i) (B.ρ i)) := by
        have h1 := ((hpatch (B.j i)).1).continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (m := l)
          (by exact_mod_cast l.is_le) (P.W_open _).uniqueDiffOn
        exact (h1.congr (fun y hy =>
          (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen _ (P.W_open _) hy).symm)).mono (B.sub i)
      have hEq := Set.EqOn.of_subset_closure (fun x hx => ((hball i).2 l x hx).symm) hA hD
        Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (closure_ball _ (B.ρ_pos i).ne').symm.subset
      intro x
      have := hEq x.2
      rw [hGi, dif_pos x.2] at this
      exact this

    refine ⟨hfirst l, fun p => ?_⟩
    rw [hq i l p, hfirst l p.1.1, hfirst l p.1.2]
  exact (pcr_sp_mem_iff P B α m g).2 ⟨u, ⟨hU0, hpatch⟩, hrelg⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  have key : ∀ (F' A' : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] [CompleteSpace F']
      [NormedAddCommGroup A'] [NormedSpace ℝ A'] (ι' : F' →ₗᵢ[ℝ] A') (f' : E → F') (x : E),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ι' (f' y)) x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f' x ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => ι' (f' y)) x = ι'.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (fderiv ℝ f' x) := by
    intro F' A' _ _ _ _ _ ι' f' x hd
    set L := fderiv ℝ (fun y => ι' (f' y)) x with hLdef
    have hL : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ι' (f' y)) L x := hd.hasFDerivAt
    have hK : IsClosed (Set.range ι') :=
      (ι'.isometry.isUniformInducing.isComplete_range).isClosed
    have hmem : ∀ v, L v ∈ Set.range ι' := by
      intro v
      have ht := hL.lim v (c := fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) (l := Filter.atTop) (by
        simpa [Real.norm_natCast] using tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
      refine hK.mem_of_tendsto ht (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)
      exact ⟨(n : ℝ) • (f' (x + (n : ℝ)⁻¹ • v) - f' x), by simp [map_sub, map_smul]⟩
    choose M₀ hM₀ using hmem
    have hadd : ∀ v w, M₀ (v + w) = M₀ v + M₀ w := fun v w =>
      ι'.injective (by simp [hM₀, map_add])
    have hsmul : ∀ (c : ℝ) v, M₀ (c • v) = c • M₀ v := fun c v =>
      ι'.injective (by simp [hM₀, map_smul])
    let M : E →L[ℝ] F' := LinearMap.mkContinuous
      { toFun := M₀, map_add' := hadd, map_smul' := hsmul } ‖L‖ (fun v => by
        show ‖M₀ v‖ ≤ ‖L‖ * ‖v‖
        rw [← ι'.norm_map, hM₀]
        exact L.le_opNorm v)
    have hMv : ∀ v, M v = M₀ v := fun v => rfl
    have hfd : HasFDerivAt f' M x := by
      rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero] at hL ⊢
      have h1 := Asymptotics.isLittleO_norm_left.mpr hL
      refine Asymptotics.isLittleO_norm_left.mp (h1.congr_left fun k => ?_)
      rw [show ι' (f' (x + k)) - ι' (f' x) - L k = ι' (f' (x + k) - f' x - M₀ k) by
        rw [map_sub, map_sub, hM₀], LinearIsometry.norm_map, hMv]
    refine ⟨hfd.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
    rw [hfd.fderiv]
    ext v
    show L v = ι' (M v)
    rw [hMv, hM₀]
  have P : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (F' A' : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup F'] [NormedSpace ℝ F'] [CompleteSpace F']
      [NormedAddCommGroup A'] [NormedSpace ℝ A'] (ι' : F' →ₗᵢ[ℝ] A') (f' : E → F'),
      ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun x => ι' (f' x)) s → ContDiffOn ℝ n f' s := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro F' A' _ _ _ _ _ ι' f' hc
      rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiffOn_zero] at hc ⊢
      exact (ι'.isometry.comp_continuousOn_iff).mp hc
    | succ n ih =>
      intro F' A' _ _ _ _ _ ι' f' hc
      have hn : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = (n : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 := by push_cast; rfl
      rw [hn, contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs] at hc ⊢
      obtain ⟨hd, -, hc'⟩ := hc
      let Φ : (E →L[ℝ] F') →ₗᵢ[ℝ] (E →L[ℝ] A') :=
        { toLinearMap := (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ E F' A' ι'.toContinuousLinearMap).toLinearMap
          norm_map' := fun L => by
            show ‖ι'.toContinuousLinearMap.comp L‖ = ‖L‖
            exact ι'.norm_toContinuousLinearMap_comp }
      have hpt : ∀ x ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ f' x ∧
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => ι' (f' y)) x = Φ (fderiv ℝ f' x) := fun x hx =>
        key F' A' ι' f' x (hd.differentiableAt (hs.mem_nhds hx))
      refine ⟨fun x hx => (hpt x hx).1.differentiableWithinAt, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hω
        exact absurd hω (by simp)
      refine ih (E →L[ℝ] F') (E →L[ℝ] A') Φ (fderiv ℝ f') ?_
      exact hc'.congr fun x hx => ((hpt x hx).2).symm
  exact contDiffOn_infty.mpr fun n => P n F A ι f (contDiffOn_infty.mp h n)

by
  set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
  classical
  haveI hKc : CompactSpace (Metric.closedBall c ρ) :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_closedBall c ρ)
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set (E2 × (∀ r : Fin (k + 2 + 1),
      ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ)),
      O = {z | z.1 ∈ W ∧ ‖z.2 ⟨0, by omega⟩‖ < s} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemO : ∀ z, z ∈ O ↔ z.1 ∈ W ∧ ‖z.2 ⟨0, by omega⟩‖ < s := by
    intro z; rw [hOdef]; rfl
  have hO : IsOpen O := by
    rw [hOdef]
    exact (hW.preimage continuous_fst).inter
      (isOpen_lt ((continuous_apply _).comp continuous_snd).norm continuous_const)
  have hconv : ∀ a ∈ O, ∀ b ∈ O, a.1 ∈ Metric.closedBall c ρ → b.1 ∈ Metric.closedBall c ρ →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, a + t • (b - a) ∈ O := by
    intro a ha b hb ha1 hb1 t ht
    rw [hmemO] at ha hb ⊢
    refine ⟨hKW ((convex_closedBall c ρ).add_smul_sub_mem ha1 hb1 ht), ?_⟩
    have h := (convex_ball (0 : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin 0 => E2) ℝ) s).add_smul_sub_mem
      (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr ha.2) (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hb.2) ht
    exact mem_ball_zero_iff.mp h
  
  have hFl : ∀ l : Fin (k + 1), ∃ Fl : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (k + 2 + 1),
      ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) →
        ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fl O ∧
      ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → U ⊆ W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ((l : ℕ) + 2 : ℕ) w U → (∀ x ∈ U, |w x| < s) →
        ∀ x ∈ U, Fl (x, fun r => iteratedFDeriv ℝ r w x) =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => Ψ (y, w y, fderiv ℝ w y, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) y)) x := by
    intro l
    obtain ⟨Φl, hΦs, hΦr⟩ := pcr_nem_jet_formula W hW s Ψ hΨ (l : ℕ)
    let prl : (∀ r : Fin (k + 2 + 1), ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) →L[ℝ]

        ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ)

    · refine hΦs.comp (contDiff_fst.prodMk (prl.contDiff.comp contDiff_snd)).contDiffOn ?_
      intro z hz
      rw [hmemO] at hz
      exact And.intro hz.1 hz.2
    · intro w U hU hUW hwU hws x hx
      exact (hΦr w U hU hUW hwU hws x hx).symm
  choose Fl hFls hFlr using hFl
  
  obtain ⟨-, -, Lp, hLp⟩ := pcr_nem_bcf_linear (Z := ↥(Metric.closedBall c ρ)) (A := ℝ) (B := ℝ)
    (ι := Fin (k + 2 + 1))
    (Fi := fun r : Fin (k + 2 + 1) => ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ)
  obtain ⟨-, -, Lq, hLq⟩ := pcr_nem_bcf_linear

    (ι := Fin (k + 2 + 1))
    (Fi := fun r : Fin (k + 2 + 1) => ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ)
  let Tv : E' →L[ℝ] (∀ r : Fin (k + 2 + 1), BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ)

    { toFun := fun e r => (T e r).1

        show (T (a + b) r).1 = (T a r).1 + (T b r).1
        rw [map_add]; rfl
      map_smul' := fun a b => by
        funext r

      BoundedContinuousFunction {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2}

      Jm e x r = (T e r).1 x := fun e x r => hLp (Tv e) x r
  have hQm : ∀ (e : E') (p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2})
      (r : Fin (k + 2 + 1)), Qm e p r = (T e r).2 p := fun e p r => hLq (Tq e) p r
  have hJmO : ∀ e ∈ {e : E' | ‖(T e ⟨0, by omega⟩).1‖ < s}, ∀ x : Metric.closedBall c ρ,

    refine ⟨hKW x.2, ?_⟩
    show ‖Jm e x ⟨0, by omega⟩‖ < s
    rw [hJm e x]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_coe_le_norm _ _) he
  
  have hS2 : ∀ l : Fin (k + 1), ∃ Nv : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ)
      (∀ r : Fin (k + 2 + 1), ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) →
      BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ)
        (ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Nv {g | ∀ z : Metric.closedBall c ρ, ((z : E2), g z) ∈ O} ∧
      ∀ g : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ)
          (∀ r : Fin (k + 2 + 1), ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ),
        (∀ z : Metric.closedBall c ρ, ((z : E2), g z) ∈ O) →
        ∀ z : Metric.closedBall c ρ, Nv g z = Fl l ((z : E2), g z) :=
    fun l => (pcr_nem_omega (⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ : C(Metric.closedBall c ρ, E2))
      O hO (Fl l) (hFls l)).2

    pcr_nem_holder_omega c ρ hρ α hα0 hα1 O hO (Fl l) (hFls l) hconv

        {e : E' | ‖(T e ⟨0, by omega⟩).1‖ < s} := by
      intro l

      have hQs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Qm := by fun_prop
      refine ContDiffOn.prodMk ?_ ?_
      · exact (hNvs l).comp hJs.contDiffOn (fun e he => hJmO e he)
      · exact (hNqs l).comp (hJs.prodMk hQs).contDiffOn (fun e he => hJmO e he)
    exact (contDiffOn_pi (F' := fun l : Fin (k + 1) =>
      BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ)
        (ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ) ×
      BoundedContinuousFunction {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2}
        (ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ))).2 h
  · intro e he w hw hr l
    have hwK : ∀ x : Metric.closedBall c ρ, |w x| < s := by
      intro x

by
  
  have s1 : ∀ {E G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
      [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
      (Ω : Set E2) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (A : E → E2 → G) (D : E → E2 → (E2 →L[ℝ] G))

      (hsmul : ∀ (a : ℝ) (v : E), ∀ z ∈ Ω, A (a • v) z = a • A v z)
      (hA : ∀ (v : E), ∀ z ∈ Ω, ‖A v z‖ ≤ ‖v‖)
      (hD : ∀ (v : E), ∀ z ∈ Ω, ‖D v z‖ ≤ ‖v‖)
      (hder : ∀ (v : E), ∀ z ∈ Ω, HasFDerivAt (A v) (D v z) z)

            (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ

  have s3 : ∀ (c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (U' : Set E2), IsOpen U' → Metric.closedBall c ρ ⊆ U' →

    rw [P.image_eq] at h
    exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩
  have s4 : ∀ x₀ ∈ P.W j, ∃ (i : Fin B.N) (Ω' : Set E2), IsOpen Ω' ∧ x₀ ∈ Ω' ∧ Ω' ⊆ P.W j ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x)) Ω' ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Ω', P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x) ∈ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Ω', P.param (B.j i) (P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x)) = P.param j x := by
    intro x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨i, y₀, hy₀, hq⟩ := B.cover _ (Pa j x₀ hx₀).1
    have hy₀W : y₀ ∈ P.W (B.j i) := B.sub i (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy₀)
    have hqO : P.param j x₀ ∈ P.O (B.j i) := by rw [← hq]; exact (Pa _ y₀ hy₀W).2
    have hΩ₀ : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O (B.j i)) :=
      (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open _)
    have hτ := P.trans_smooth j (B.j i)
    refine ⟨i, (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O (B.j i)) ∩
        (fun x => P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x)) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i),
      hτ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hΩ₀ Metric.isOpen_ball, ⟨⟨hx₀, hqO⟩, ?_⟩,
      fun x hx => hx.1.1, hτ.mono Set.inter_subset_left, fun x hx => hx.2, ?_⟩
    · show P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x₀) ∈ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)
      rw [← hq, P.proj_param _ y₀ hy₀W]
      exact hy₀
    · intro x hx
      have hmem : P.param j x ∈ P.param (B.j i) '' P.W (B.j i) := by
        rw [P.image_eq]
        exact ⟨hx.1.2, (Pa j x hx.1.1).1⟩
      obtain ⟨x', hx', hpx⟩ := hmem
      rw [← hpx, P.proj_param _ x' hx']
  
  have s5 : ∀ i : Fin B.N, ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × E2 => U p.1 (P.param (B.j i) p.2))
      (I ×ˢ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)) := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : (l : ℕ) → pcrSp B α (k + 2) → E2 →
        ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ, ∀ l v z, A l v z =
          if hl : l < k + 2 + 1 then
            (if hz : dist z (B.c i) ≤ B.ρ i then
              (((v : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i) ⟨l, hl⟩).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ else 0) else 0 :=
      ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
    have hAe : ∀ l (hl : l < k + 2 + 1) (v : pcrSp B α (k + 2)) z (hz : dist z (B.c i) ≤ B.ρ i),
        A l v z = (((v : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i) ⟨l, hl⟩).1 ⟨z, hz⟩ := by
      intro l hl v z hz
      rw [hA, dif_pos hl, dif_pos hz]
    have hAb : ∀ l (hl : l < k + 2 + 1) (v : pcrSp B α (k + 2)) z (hz : dist z (B.c i) ≤ B.ρ i),
        ‖A l v z‖ ≤ ‖v‖ := by
      intro l hl v z hz
      rw [hAe l hl v z hz]
      calc _ ≤ ‖(((v : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i) ⟨l, hl⟩).1‖ :=
            BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_coe_le_norm _ _
        _ ≤ ‖((v : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i) ⟨l, hl⟩‖ := norm_fst_le _
        _ ≤ ‖(v : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i‖ := norm_le_pi_norm ((v : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i) _
        _ ≤ ‖(v : pcrAmb B (k + 2))‖ := norm_le_pi_norm (v : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i
        _ = ‖v‖ := rfl
    have hgen : ∀ g ∈ pcrSp B α (k + 2), ∀ (l : ℕ) (hl : l + 1 < k + 2 + 1) (z : E2)
        (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)),
        HasFDerivAt (fun z' : E2 => if hz' : dist z' (B.c i) ≤ B.ρ i then
            ((g : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l, by omega⟩).1 ⟨z', hz'⟩ else 0)
          (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ
            (((g : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l + 1, hl⟩).1
              ⟨z, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz⟩)) z := by
      intro g hg
      induction hg using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem g hg =>
        obtain ⟨u, hu, hr⟩ := hg
        intro l hl z hz
        exact s3 (B.c i) (B.ρ i) (k + 2) (P.W (B.j i)) (P.W_open _) (B.sub i)
          (fun x => u (P.param (B.j i) x)) (hu.2 (B.j i)).1 (g i) (hr i) l hl z hz
      | zero =>
        intro l hl z hz
        have e : ((fun z' : E2 => if hz' : dist z' (B.c i) ≤ B.ρ i then
            ((0 : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l, by omega⟩).1 ⟨z', hz'⟩ else 0) :
              E2 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ) = fun _ => 0 := by
          funext z'
          split_ifs <;> rfl
        have hd : continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ
            (((0 : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l + 1, hl⟩).1 ⟨z, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz⟩) = 0 := by
          rw [← LinearIsometryEquiv.map_zero
            (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ)]
          rfl
        rw [e, hd]
        exact hasFDerivAt_const _ _
      | add g g' _ _ ihg ihg' =>
        intro l hl z hz
        have e : ((fun z' : E2 => if hz' : dist z' (B.c i) ≤ B.ρ i then
            ((g + g' : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l, by omega⟩).1 ⟨z', hz'⟩ else 0) :
              E2 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ) =
            fun z' => ((if hz' : dist z' (B.c i) ≤ B.ρ i then
              ((g : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l, by omega⟩).1 ⟨z', hz'⟩ else 0) :
                ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ) +
              ((if hz' : dist z' (B.c i) ≤ B.ρ i then
              ((g' : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l, by omega⟩).1 ⟨z', hz'⟩ else 0) :
                ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ) := by
          funext z'
          split_ifs
          · rfl
          · simp
        have hd : continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ
            (((g + g' : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l + 1, hl⟩).1 ⟨z, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz⟩) =
            continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ
              (((g : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l + 1, hl⟩).1 ⟨z, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz⟩) +
            continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ
              (((g' : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l + 1, hl⟩).1 ⟨z, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz⟩) := by
          rw [← LinearIsometryEquiv.map_add]
          rfl
        rw [e, hd]
        exact (ihg l hl z hz).add (ihg' l hl z hz)
      | smul a g _ ihg =>
        intro l hl z hz
        have e : ((fun z' : E2 => if hz' : dist z' (B.c i) ≤ B.ρ i then
            ((a • g : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l, by omega⟩).1 ⟨z', hz'⟩ else 0) :
              E2 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ) =
            fun z' => a • ((if hz' : dist z' (B.c i) ≤ B.ρ i then
              ((g : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l, by omega⟩).1 ⟨z', hz'⟩ else 0) :
                ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ) := by
          funext z'
          split_ifs
          · rfl
          · simp
        have hd : continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ
            (((a • g : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l + 1, hl⟩).1 ⟨z, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz⟩) =
            a • continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ
              (((g : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i ⟨l + 1, hl⟩).1 ⟨z, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz⟩) := by
          rw [← LinearIsometryEquiv.map_smul]
          rfl
        rw [e, hd]
        exact (ihg l hl z hz).const_smul a
    have hjoint : ∀ l, l < k + 2 → ∀ (c : ℝ → pcrSp B α (k + 2)) (c' : pcrSp B α (k + 2))
        (t : ℝ) (y : E2), HasDerivAt c c' t → y ∈ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i) →
        HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × E2 => A l (c p.1) p.2)
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ E2).smulRight (A l c' y) +
            (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ
              (A (l + 1) (c t) y)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ E2)) (t, y) := by
      intro l hl c c' t y hc hy
      refine s1 (Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)) Metric.isOpen_ball (A l)
        (fun v z => continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ
          (A (l + 1) v z)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ c c' t hc y hy
      · intro v w z hz
        rw [hAe l (by omega) _ z (Metric.mem_ball.1 hz).le, hAe l (by omega) _ z (Metric.mem_ball.1 hz).le,
          hAe l (by omega) _ z (Metric.mem_ball.1 hz).le]
        rfl
      · intro a v z hz
        rw [hAe l (by omega) _ z (Metric.mem_ball.1 hz).le, hAe l (by omega) _ z (Metric.mem_ball.1 hz).le]
        rfl
      · intro v z hz
        exact hAb l (by omega) v z (Metric.mem_ball.1 hz).le
      · intro v z hz
        rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
        exact hAb (l + 1) (by omega) v z (Metric.mem_ball.1 hz).le
      · intro v z hz
        have hfun : A l v = fun z' : E2 => if hz' : dist z' (B.c i) ≤ B.ρ i then
            (((v : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) i) ⟨l, by omega⟩).1 ⟨z', hz'⟩ else 0 := by
          funext z'
          rw [hA, dif_pos (show l < k + 2 + 1 by omega)]
        show HasFDerivAt (A l v) (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ
          (A (l + 1) v z)) z
        rw [hfun, hAe (l + 1) (by omega) v z (Metric.mem_ball.1 hz).le]
        exact hgen (v : pcrAmb B (k + 2)) v.2 l (by omega) z hz
    have hs2 := s2 (Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)) Metric.isOpen_ball (k + 2) A hjoint k
      (fun t => γ t) hγ 0 (by omega)
    have heval : ∀ t, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i),
        U t (P.param (B.j i) z) = continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ E2 ℝ (A 0 (γ t) z) := by
      intro t z hz
      rw [hAe 0 (by omega) (γ t) z (Metric.mem_ball.1 hz).le, continuousMultilinearCurryFin0_apply]
      have h1 := congrArg (fun T => T (fun _ => (0 : E2)))
        (((hU t).2 i ⟨0, by omega⟩).1 ⟨z, (Metric.mem_ball.1 hz).le⟩)
      exact (h1.trans (iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply _)).symm
    have hev : ContDiff ℝ k
        (fun T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin 0 => E2) ℝ =>
          continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ E2 ℝ T) := by
      apply LinearIsometryEquiv.contDiff
    refine (hev.comp_contDiffOn hs2).congr ?_
    rintro ⟨t, z⟩ ⟨_, hz⟩
    exact heval t z hz
  
  refine contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn ?_
  rintro ⟨t₀, x₀⟩ ⟨_, hx₀⟩
  obtain ⟨i, Ω', hΩ'o, hx₀Ω', _, hτ, hτb, hτp⟩ := s4 x₀ hx₀
  refine ⟨Set.univ ×ˢ Ω', isOpen_univ.prod hΩ'o, ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hx₀Ω'⟩, ?_⟩
  have hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ k (fun p : ℝ × E2 => (p.1, P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j p.2)))
      ((I ×ˢ P.W j) ∩ Set.univ ×ˢ Ω') :=
    contDiffOn_fst.prodMk ((hτ.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)).comp contDiffOn_snd
      (fun p hp => hp.2.2))
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun p : ℝ × E2 => (p.1, P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j p.2)))
      ((I ×ˢ P.W j) ∩ Set.univ ×ˢ Ω') (I ×ˢ Metric.ball (B.c i) (B.ρ i)) :=
    fun p hp => ⟨hp.1.1, hτb _ hp.2.2⟩
  refine ((s5 i).comp hψ hmaps).congr ?_
  rintro ⟨t, x⟩ hp
  show U t (P.param j x) = U t (P.param (B.j i) (P.proj (B.j i) (P.param j x)))
  rw [hτp x hp.2.2]

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 w W)
    (x₀ : E2) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ W) (A₀ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA₀ : A₀.PosDef) :
    (IsLocalMax w x₀ → ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ a b * pd2 a (pd2 b w) x₀ ≤ 0) ∧
    (IsLocalMin w x₀ → 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ a b * pd2 a (pd2 b w) x₀)

signature.name: pcr_kc_hess_trace_sign
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 w W)
    (x₀ : E2) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ W) (A₀ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA₀ : A₀.PosDef) :
    (IsLocalMax w x₀ → ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ a b * pd2 a (pd2 b w) x₀ ≤ 0) ∧
    (IsLocalMin w x₀ → 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ a b * pd2 a (pd2 b w) x₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hdir : ∀ u : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u W → IsLocalMax u x₀ → ∀ ξ : E2,
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x₀ ξ ξ ≤ 0 := by
    intro u hu hmax ξ
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ u) W := hu.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by norm_num)
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x₀ :=
      (hfd.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx₀)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ u y := fun y hy =>
      (hu.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt two_ne_zero
    have hℓ : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x₀ + t • ξ) ξ t := by
      intro t
      have := ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const ξ).const_add x₀
      simpa using this
    have hℓ0 : (fun t : ℝ => x₀ + t • ξ) 0 = x₀ := by simp
    have hℓc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => x₀ + t • ξ) :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
    have hT : (fun t : ℝ => x₀ + t • ξ) ⁻¹' W ∈ 𝓝 (0:ℝ) := by
      apply hℓc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]; exact hW.mem_nhds hx₀
    have hgk : deriv (fun t : ℝ => u (x₀ + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ u (x₀ + t • ξ) ξ) := by
      filter_upwards [hT] with t ht
      have h1 := (hdiff (x₀ + t • ξ) ht).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hℓ t)
      exact h1.deriv
    have hk : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ u (x₀ + t • ξ) ξ)
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x₀ ξ ξ) 0 := by
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y ξ)
          ((fderiv ℝ u x₀).comp (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x₀).flip ξ) x₀ :=
        hD.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const ξ x₀)
      have h1' : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y ξ)
          ((fderiv ℝ u x₀).comp (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x₀).flip ξ)
          ((fun t : ℝ => x₀ + t • ξ) 0) := by
        rw [hℓ0]; exact h1
      have h2 := h1'.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) (hℓ 0)
      simpa using h2
    have hdd : deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => u (x₀ + t • ξ))) 0 = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x₀ ξ ξ := by
      rw [hgk.deriv_eq]; exact hk.deriv
    have hd0 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => u (x₀ + t • ξ)) 0 = 0 := by
      rw [hgk.self_of_nhds]
      simp [hmax.fderiv_eq_zero]
    have hmaxg : IsLocalMax (fun t : ℝ => u (x₀ + t • ξ)) 0 := by
      have : IsLocalMax u (x₀ + (0:ℝ) • ξ) := by simpa using hmax
      exact IsLocalMax.comp_continuous (g := fun t : ℝ => x₀ + t • ξ) (b := (0:ℝ)) this
        hℓc.continuousAt
    have hgc : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => u (x₀ + t • ξ)) 0 := by
      have hx' : x₀ + (0:ℝ) • ξ ∈ W := by simpa using hx₀
      exact ((hdiff _ hx').hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) (hℓ 0)).continuousAt
    by_contra hpos
    push_neg at hpos
    have hming : IsLocalMin (fun t : ℝ => u (x₀ + t • ξ)) 0 :=
      isLocalMin_of_deriv_deriv_pos (by rw [hdd]; exact hpos) hd0 hgc
    have hconst : (fun t : ℝ => u (x₀ + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] fun _ => u (x₀ + (0:ℝ) • ξ) :=
      (Filter.Eventually.and hmaxg hming).mono (fun t ht => le_antisymm ht.1 ht.2)
    have hdg : deriv (fun t : ℝ => u (x₀ + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hconst.eventuallyEq_nhds] with t ht
      rw [ht.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    have h0 : deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => u (x₀ + t • ξ))) 0 = 0 := by
      rw [hdg.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    linarith
  
  have halg : ∀ H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ,
      (∀ s t : ℝ, s ^ 2 * H 0 0 + s * t * (H 0 1 + H 1 0) + t ^ 2 * H 1 1 ≤ 0) →
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ a b * H a b ≤ 0 := by
    intro H hQ
    have hsym : A₀ 1 0 = A₀ 0 1 := by
      have := hA₀.isHermitian.apply 0 1
      simpa using this
    have ha : 0 < A₀ 0 0 := hA₀.diag_pos
    have hdet : 0 < A₀ 0 0 * A₀ 1 1 - A₀ 0 1 * A₀ 1 0 := by
      have := hA₀.det_pos
      rwa [Matrix.det_fin_two] at this
    have h1 := hQ (A₀ 0 0) (A₀ 0 1)
    have h2 := hQ 0 1
    norm_num at h2
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hsym] at hdet ⊢
    have hp := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hdet.le h2
    have key : A₀ 0 0 * (A₀ 0 0 * H 0 0 + A₀ 0 1 * H 0 1 + (A₀ 0 1 * H 1 0 + A₀ 1 1 * H 1 1)) =
        (A₀ 0 0 ^ 2 * H 0 0 + A₀ 0 0 * A₀ 0 1 * (H 0 1 + H 1 0) + A₀ 0 1 ^ 2 * H 1 1) +
          (A₀ 0 0 * A₀ 1 1 - A₀ 0 1 * A₀ 0 1) * H 1 1 := by ring
    by_contra hneg
    push_neg at hneg
    have := mul_pos ha hneg
    linarith
  
  have hentry : ∀ u : E2 → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x₀ → ∀ a b : Fin 2,
      pd2 a (pd2 b u) x₀ = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x₀ (e2 a) (e2 b) := by
    intro u hD a b
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (e2 b))
        ((fderiv ℝ u x₀).comp (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x₀).flip (e2 b)) x₀ :=
      hD.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e2 b) x₀)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (e2 b)) x₀ (e2 a) = _
    rw [h1.fderiv]
    simp
  
  have key : ∀ u : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u W → IsLocalMax u x₀ →
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ a b * pd2 a (pd2 b u) x₀ ≤ 0 := by
    intro u hu hmax
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ u) W := hu.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by norm_num)
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x₀ :=
      (hfd.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx₀)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    simp only [hentry u hD]
    apply halg (fun a b => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x₀ (e2 a) (e2 b))
    intro s t
    have := hdir u hu hmax (s • e2 0 + t • e2 1)
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at this
    nlinarith [this]
  refine ⟨key w hw, fun hmin => ?_⟩
  have h := key (fun x => -w x) hw.neg hmin.neg
  have hneg : ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (fun x => -w x) = fun x => -(pd2 b w x) := by

    rw [fderiv_fun_neg]
    rfl

    intro a b
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [fderiv_fun_neg]
    rfl
  simp only [hneg, hneg2, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h
  linarith

by

      rfl

        pd2 i (pd2 j (fun y => M - w y)) x = -pd2 i (pd2 j w) x := by
      intro i j x

  have hconst : ∀ (W : Set E2) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)

      (∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) →
      (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) →
      ContinuousOn w W → ContinuousOn c W → ∀ (z : E2) (R : ℝ), 0 < R →
      Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W → (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z R, 0 < w x) →
      ∃ m₀ Λ β Γ m : ℝ, 0 < m₀ ∧ 0 ≤ Λ ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ 0 ≤ Γ ∧ 0 < m ∧

        ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → m ≤ w x := by
    intro W A B w c hA hB hApos hwc hc z R hR hball hpos
    have P1 : ∀ (K : Set E2) (f : E2 → ℝ), IsCompact K → ContinuousOn f K →
        (∀ x ∈ K, 0 < f x) → ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, m ≤ f x := by
      intro K f hK hf hfpos
      rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty K with hK0 | hKne
      · refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
        intro x hx
        rw [hK0] at hx

      · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hmin⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn hKne hf

    have P2 : ∀ (K : Set E2) (f : E2 → ℝ), IsCompact K → ContinuousOn f K →

      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf
      refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      have := hC x hx

    set K : Set E2 := {x | R / 2 ≤ dist x z ∧ dist x z ≤ R} with hKdef
    have hKcl : IsClosed K :=
      (isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)).inter

    have hKsub : K ⊆ Metric.closedBall z R := fun x hx => Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr hx.2
    have hKc : IsCompact K := (isCompact_closedBall z R).of_isClosed_subset hKcl hKsub
    have hKW : K ⊆ W := hKsub.trans hball
    have hSc : IsCompact (Metric.sphere z (R / 2)) := isCompact_sphere z (R / 2)
    have hSball : Metric.sphere z (R / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball z R :=
      Metric.sphere_subset_ball (by linarith)
    have hSW : Metric.sphere z (R / 2) ⊆ W :=
      hSball.trans (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hball)
    have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x : E2 => (x - z) i) := fun i =>
      (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) i).comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
    have hq : ContinuousOn
        (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (x - z) i * A x i j * (x - z) j) W := by
      apply continuousOn_finset_sum
      intro i _
      apply continuousOn_finset_sum
      intro j _

    have hqpos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (x - z) i * A x i j * (x - z) j := by
      intro x hx
      have hd : 0 < dist x z := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) hx.1

    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀, hm₀K⟩ := P1 K _ hKc (hq.mono hKW) hqpos
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, hC₀K⟩ := P2 K (fun x => A x 0 0) hKc ((hA 0 0).mono hKW)
    obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁, hC₁K⟩ := P2 K (fun x => A x 1 1) hKc ((hA 1 1).mono hKW)
    obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀, hD₀K⟩ := P2 K (fun x => B x 0) hKc ((hB 0).mono hKW)
    obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁, hD₁K⟩ := P2 K (fun x => B x 1) hKc ((hB 1).mono hKW)
    obtain ⟨Γ, hΓ, hΓK⟩ := P2 K c hKc (hc.mono hKW)
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmS⟩ := P1 (Metric.sphere z (R / 2)) w hSc (hwc.mono hSW)
      (fun x hx => hpos x (hSball hx))
    refine ⟨m₀, C₀ + C₁, D₀ + D₁, Γ, m, hm₀, add_nonneg hC₀ hC₁, add_nonneg hD₀ hD₁, hΓ, hm,
      ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x h1 h2
      have hxK : x ∈ K := ⟨h1, h2⟩
      have a0 : |A x 0 0| ≤ C₀ := hC₀K x hxK
      have a1 : |A x 1 1| ≤ C₁ := hC₁K x hxK
      have b0 : |B x 0| ≤ D₀ := hD₀K x hxK
      have b1 : |B x 1| ≤ D₁ := hD₁K x hxK
      refine ⟨hm₀K x hxK, ?_, ?_, hΓK x hxK⟩
      · rw [Fin.forall_fin_two]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      · rw [Fin.forall_fin_two]
        exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · intro x hx
      exact hmS x (Metric.mem_sphere.mpr hx)
  
  have hbarrier : ∀ (z : E2) (α R : ℝ) (v : E2 → ℝ),
      (∀ x, v x = Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ v ∧ (∀ x d : E2, fderiv ℝ v x d =
        -2 * α * (∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * d k) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ (x : E2) (j : Fin 2), pd2 j v x = -2 * α * (x - z) j * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)) ∧
      ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), pd2 i (pd2 j v) x = (4 * α ^ 2 * (x - z) i * (x - z) j
        - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro z α R v hv
    have hv' : v = fun y => Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2) := funext hv
    subst hv'
    have hinner : ∀ x d : E2, inner ℝ (x - z) d = ∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * d k := by
      intro x d
      simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => mul_comm _ _)
    have hE : ∀ x : E2, ∃ E' : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
        HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2)) E' x ∧
        ∀ d : E2, E' d = -2 * α * (∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * d k) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro x
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => y - z) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2) x :=
        (hasFDerivAt_id x).sub_const z
      refine ⟨_, (h1.norm_sq.const_mul (-α)).exp, fun d => ?_⟩
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, hinner]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
      push_cast
      ring
    have h2 : ∀ x d : E2, fderiv ℝ (fun y : E2 => Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) x d
        = -2 * α * (∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * d k) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro x d
      obtain ⟨E', hE1, hE2⟩ := hE x
      rw [(hE1.sub_const (Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2))).fderiv, hE2]
    have hsingle : ∀ (x : E2) (j : Fin 2), ∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * (e2 j) k = (x - z) j := by
      intro x j
      simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have h3 : ∀ (x : E2) (j : Fin 2),
        pd2 j (fun y : E2 => Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) x

      intro x j
      show fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 j) = _
      rw [h2, hsingle]
    refine ⟨?_, h2, h3, ?_⟩
    · exact ((contDiff_const.mul ((contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).norm_sq ℝ)).exp).sub

    · intro x i j
      have hfun : pd2 j (fun y : E2 => Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2))
