        funext y
        rw [h3]
        ring
      rw [hfun]
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y : E2 => -2 * α * ((y - z) j * Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2))) x (e2 i) = _
      have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => (y - z) j) (PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) j) x := by
        have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun f : E2 => f.ofLp j) (PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) j) x :=
          PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 x j
        have h := h0.sub_const (z j)
        refine h.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
        simp
      obtain ⟨E', hE1, hE2⟩ := hE x
      have hP : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => -2 * α * ((y - z) j * Real.exp (-α * ‖y - z‖ ^ 2)))
          ((-2 * α) • ((x - z) j • E' + Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) •
            PiLp.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) j)) x :=
        (hc.mul hE1).const_mul (-2 * α)
      rw [hP.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        hE2, PiLp.proj_apply, hsingle]
      simp only [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij
        simp only [if_true]
        ring
      · simp only [hij, Ne.symm hij, if_false]
        ring
  
  have hminp : ∀ (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ∀ (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
      (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ) (Γ : ℝ) (z : E2) (R : ℝ), 0 < R →
      Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 u W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) →
      (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) → 0 ≤ Γ →
      (∀ x : E2, R / 2 < dist x z → dist x z < R → ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
        A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j u) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k u x - Γ * u x < 0) →
      (∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → 0 ≤ u x) → (∀ x : E2, dist x z = R → 0 ≤ u x) →
      ∀ x : E2, R / 2 ≤ dist x z → dist x z ≤ R → 0 ≤ u x := by
    intro W hW A B u Γ z R hR hball hu hAs hApsd hΓ hstrict hin hout
    have s2 : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), IsLocalMin g a → ContinuousAt g a →
        0 ≤ deriv (deriv g) a := by
      intro g a hmin hc
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have hd : deriv g a = 0 := hmin.deriv_eq_zero
      have hmax : IsLocalMax g a := isLocalMax_of_deriv_deriv_neg h hd hc
      have hconst : g =ᶠ[𝓝 a] fun _ => g a :=
        (hmin.and hmax).mono fun t ht => le_antisymm ht.2 ht.1
      have h0 : deriv g =ᶠ[𝓝 a] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
        hconst.deriv.mono fun t ht => by rw [ht, deriv_const]
      have h00 : deriv (deriv g) a = 0 := by
        rw [h0.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
      linarith
    have s4 : ∀ (M H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, M i j = M j i) →
        (∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * M i j * ξ j) →
        (∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * H i j * ξ j) →
        0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, M i j * H i j := by
      intro M H hMs hM hH
      have key : ∀ (N : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (a b : ℝ),
          ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (!₂[a, b] : E2) i * N i j * (!₂[a, b] : E2) j
            = a * N 0 0 * a + a * N 0 1 * b + (b * N 1 0 * a + b * N 1 1 * b) := by
        intro N a b
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have kH : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a * H 0 0 * a + a * H 0 1 * b + (b * H 1 0 * a + b * H 1 1 * b) := by
        intro a b
        have := hH !₂[a, b]
        rwa [key] at this
      have kM : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a * M 0 0 * a + a * M 0 1 * b + (b * M 1 0 * a + b * M 1 1 * b) := by
        intro a b
        have := hM !₂[a, b]
        rwa [key] at this
      have hM10 : M 1 0 = M 0 1 := hMs 1 0
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have hp := kH 1 0
      have hs := kH 0 1
      have hd := kM 0 1
      have h4 := kH (-((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)) (H 0 0)
      have h5 := kM (H 0 0) ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)
      rw [hM10] at h5 ⊢
      have hp' : 0 ≤ H 0 0 := by linarith
      have hs' : 0 ≤ H 1 1 := by linarith
      have hd' : 0 ≤ M 1 1 := by linarith
      rcases hp'.lt_or_eq with hpos | hzero
      · have e4 : H 0 0 * (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2) ≥ 0 := by
          nlinarith
        have hdisc : 0 ≤ H 0 0 * H 1 1 - ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 := by
          by_contra hc
          push_neg at hc
          have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hpos hc
          linarith
        have e5 : H 0 0 * (M 0 0 * H 0 0 + M 0 1 * H 0 1 + (M 0 1 * H 1 0 + M 1 1 * H 1 1))
            = (H 0 0 * M 0 0 * H 0 0 + H 0 0 * M 0 1 * ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)
                + (((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) * M 0 1 * H 0 0
                  + ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) * M 1 1 * ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)))
              + M 1 1 * (H 0 0 * H 1 1 - ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2) := by
          ring
        have hprod : 0 ≤ H 0 0 * (M 0 0 * H 0 0 + M 0 1 * H 0 1 + (M 0 1 * H 1 0 + M 1 1 * H 1 1)) := by
          rw [e5]
          have := mul_nonneg hd' hdisc
          linarith
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        have := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hpos hc
        linarith
      · have hp0 : H 0 0 = 0 := hzero.symm
        have h6 := kH (-(1 + H 1 1)) ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)
        rw [hp0] at h6
        have e6 : -(1 + H 1 1) * 0 * -(1 + H 1 1) + -(1 + H 1 1) * H 0 1 * ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)
            + ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2 * H 1 0 * -(1 + H 1 1)
              + (H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2 * H 1 1 * ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2))
            = -(((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 * (2 + H 1 1)) := by
          ring
        rw [e6] at h6
        have hq2 : ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 * (2 + H 1 1) ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have hq0 : ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by
          by_contra hc
          push_neg at hc
          have := mul_pos hc (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 + H 1 1 by linarith)
          linarith
        have hq : H 0 1 + H 1 0 = 0 := by
          have : (H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2 = 0 := by
            have := sq_nonneg ((H 0 1 + H 1 0) / 2)
            exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp (le_antisymm hq0 this)
          linarith
        have e7 : M 0 0 * H 0 0 + M 0 1 * H 0 1 + (M 0 1 * H 1 0 + M 1 1 * H 1 1)
            = M 0 0 * H 0 0 + M 0 1 * (H 0 1 + H 1 0) + M 1 1 * H 1 1 := by ring
        rw [e7, hq, hp0]
        have := mul_nonneg hd' hs'
        linarith
    have s3 : ∀ (x ξ : E2), x ∈ W → ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => u (x + t • ξ)) 0 ∧
        deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => u (x + t • ξ))) 0
          = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * pd2 i (pd2 j u) x * ξ j := by
      intro x ξ hx
      have hp : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) ξ t := by
        intro t
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const ξ).const_add x
      have hpc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) :=
        continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
      have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ u y := fun y hy =>
        (hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)
      have hx0 : x + (0 : ℝ) • ξ = x := by simp
      have h0T : (0 : ℝ) ∈ (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) ⁻¹' W := by
        show x + (0 : ℝ) • ξ ∈ W
        rw [hx0]; exact hx
      have hT : (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) ⁻¹' W ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℝ) :=
        (hW.preimage hpc).mem_nhds h0T
      have hlin : ∀ L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ, L ξ = ξ 0 * L (e2 0) + ξ 1 * L (e2 1) := by
        intro L
        have hξ : ξ = ξ 0 • e2 0 + ξ 1 • e2 1 := by
          ext i
          fin_cases i <;> simp [e2]
        conv_lhs => rw [hξ]
        rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      have hg1 : ∀ t ∈ (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) ⁻¹' W,
          HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => u (x + t • ξ)) (fderiv ℝ u (x + t • ξ) ξ) t := by
        intro t ht
        exact (hdiff _ ht).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hp t)
      have hev : deriv (fun t : ℝ => u (x + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
          fun t => ξ 0 * pd2 0 u (x + t • ξ) + ξ 1 * pd2 1 u (x + t • ξ) := by
        filter_upwards [hT] with t ht
        rw [(hg1 t ht).deriv, hlin]
        rfl
      have hpd : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 j u) x := by
        intro j
        have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (e2 j)) W :=
          (hu.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by norm_num)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
        exact (hc.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
      have hφ : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ξ 0 * pd2 0 u y + ξ 1 * pd2 1 u y)
          (ξ 0 • fderiv ℝ (pd2 0 u) x + ξ 1 • fderiv ℝ (pd2 1 u) x) (x + (0 : ℝ) • ξ) := by
        rw [hx0]
        exact ((hpd 0).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (ξ 0)).add ((hpd 1).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (ξ 1))
      have hcomp : HasDerivAt
          (fun t : ℝ => ξ 0 * pd2 0 u (x + t • ξ) + ξ 1 * pd2 1 u (x + t • ξ))
          ((ξ 0 • fderiv ℝ (pd2 0 u) x + ξ 1 • fderiv ℝ (pd2 1 u) x) ξ) 0 := by
        have := hφ.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) (hp 0)
        exact this
      have hpd2 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (pd2 j u) x (e2 i) = pd2 i (pd2 j u) x :=
        fun _ _ => rfl
      refine ⟨(hg1 0 h0T).continuousAt, ?_⟩
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, hcomp.deriv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hlin (fderiv ℝ (pd2 0 u) x), hlin (fderiv ℝ (pd2 1 u) x)]
      simp only [hpd2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    intro x₀ hx₀1 hx₀2
    have hKc : IsCompact ({x : E2 | R / 2 ≤ dist x z} ∩ {x | dist x z ≤ R}) := by
      refine (isCompact_closedBall z R).of_isClosed_subset ?_ ?_
      · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)).inter
          (isClosed_le (continuous_id.dist continuous_const) continuous_const)
      · intro x hx
        exact Metric.mem_closedBall.2 hx.2
    have hKW : {x : E2 | R / 2 ≤ dist x z} ∩ {x | dist x z ≤ R} ⊆ W :=
      fun x hx => hball (Metric.mem_closedBall.2 hx.2)
    have hx₀K : x₀ ∈ {x : E2 | R / 2 ≤ dist x z} ∩ {x | dist x z ≤ R} := ⟨hx₀1, hx₀2⟩
    obtain ⟨xs, hxsK, hxsmin⟩ := hKc.exists_isMinOn ⟨x₀, hx₀K⟩ (hu.continuousOn.mono hKW)
    have hmn := isMinOn_iff.mp hxsmin
    have hle : u xs ≤ u x₀ := hmn x₀ hx₀K
    by_contra hneg0
    push_neg at hneg0
    have hneg : u xs < 0 := lt_of_le_of_lt hle hneg0
    have h1 : R / 2 < dist xs z := lt_of_le_of_ne hxsK.1 (fun h => by
      have := hin xs h.symm
      linarith)
    have h2 : dist xs z < R := lt_of_le_of_ne hxsK.2 (fun h => by
      have := hout xs h
      linarith)
    have hxsW : xs ∈ W := hKW hxsK
    have hO : IsOpen ({x : E2 | R / 2 < dist x z} ∩ {x | dist x z < R}) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)).inter
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_id.dist continuous_const) continuous_const)
    have hmin : IsLocalMin u xs := by
      refine Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds ⟨h1, h2⟩) ?_
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hy1 hy2
      exact hmn y ⟨le_of_lt hy1, le_of_lt hy2⟩
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ u xs = 0 := hmin.fderiv_eq_zero
    have hB : ∑ k : Fin 2, B xs k * pd2 k u xs = 0 := by
      simp [pd2, hfd]
    have hH : ∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
        ξ i * (Matrix.of fun i j => pd2 i (pd2 j u) xs) i j * ξ j := by
      intro ξ
      obtain ⟨hc, hQ⟩ := s3 xs ξ hxsW
      have hloc : IsLocalMin (fun t : ℝ => u (xs + t • ξ)) 0 := by
        have hcont : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => xs + t • ξ) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 xs) := by
          have := ((continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const) :
            Continuous (fun t : ℝ => xs + t • ξ))).tendsto 0
          simpa using this
        have h0 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 xs, u xs ≤ u y := hmin
        have h1' := hcont.eventually h0
        have hz : u (xs + (0 : ℝ) • ξ) = u xs := by simp
        show ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), u (xs + (0 : ℝ) • ξ) ≤ u (xs + t • ξ)
        rw [hz]
        exact h1'
      have := s2 _ 0 hloc hc
      rw [hQ] at this
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
      exact this
    have hT := s4 (A xs) (Matrix.of fun i j => pd2 i (pd2 j u) xs) (hAs xs hxsW)
      (hApsd xs hxsW) hH
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply] at hT
    have hst := hstrict xs h1 h2
    rw [hB] at hst
    have : Γ * u xs ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hΓ hneg.le
    linarith
  
  have hx₁W : x₁ ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hx₁])
  have hmin1 : IsLocalMin w x₁ := by
    filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hx₁W] with y hy
    rw [hw₁]
    exact hnn y hy
  have hdw1 : fderiv ℝ w x₁ = 0 := hmin1.fderiv_eq_zero
  
  obtain ⟨m₀, Λ, β, Γ, m, hm₀, hΛ, hβ, hΓ, hm, hK, hSin⟩ :=
    hconst W A B w (fun _ => 0) hA hB hApos hw.continuousOn continuousOn_const z R hR hball hpos
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α : ℝ, α = 1 + (4 * Λ + 4 * β * R + Γ) / (4 * m₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hα1 : 1 ≤ α := by
    have : 0 ≤ (4 * Λ + 4 * β * R + Γ) / (4 * m₀) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hα0 : 0 < α := by linarith
  have hbar : ∀ (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (b : Fin 2 → ℝ) (y : E2),
      m₀ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, y i * a i j * y j → (∀ i : Fin 2, |a i i| ≤ Λ) →
      (∀ k : Fin 2, |b k| ≤ β) → ‖y‖ ≤ R →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a i j * ((4 * α ^ 2 * y i * y j
          - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, b k * (-2 * α * y k * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        - Γ * (Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) := by
    intro a b y hq ha hb hy
    have hE := Real.exp_pos (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
    have hER := Real.exp_pos (-α * R ^ 2)
    have hy0 : |y 0| ≤ R := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le y 0
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      linarith
    have hy1 : |y 1| ≤ R := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le y 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      linarith
    have htr : a 0 0 + a 1 1 ≤ 2 * Λ := by
      have h0 := le_abs_self (a 0 0)
      have h1 := le_abs_self (a 1 1)
      linarith [ha 0, ha 1]
    have hb0 : b 0 * y 0 ≤ β * R := by
      calc b 0 * y 0 ≤ |b 0 * y 0| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |b 0| * |y 0| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ β * R := mul_le_mul (hb 0) hy0 (abs_nonneg _) hβ
    have hb1 : b 1 * y 1 ≤ β * R := by
      calc b 1 * y 1 ≤ |b 1 * y 1| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |b 1| * |y 1| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ β * R := mul_le_mul (hb 1) hy1 (abs_nonneg _) hβ
    have h4 : 4 * α * m₀ = 4 * m₀ + 4 * Λ + 4 * β * R + Γ := by
      rw [hα]
      field_simp
      ring
    set q := ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, y i * a i j * y j with hqdef
    have hP : 0 < 4 * α ^ 2 * q - 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1) - 2 * α * (b 0 * y 0 + b 1 * y 1) - Γ := by
      have e1 : 4 * α ^ 2 * m₀ ≤ 4 * α ^ 2 * q := by
        have : 0 ≤ 4 * α ^ 2 := by positivity
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq this
      have e2 : 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1) ≤ 2 * α * (2 * Λ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htr (by positivity)
      have e3 : 2 * α * (b 0 * y 0 + b 1 * y 1) ≤ 2 * α * (2 * β * R) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have e4 : 4 * α ^ 2 * m₀ - 4 * α * Λ - 4 * α * β * R - Γ = 4 * α * m₀ + (α - 1) * Γ := by
        linear_combination α * h4
      have e5 : 0 < 4 * α * m₀ + (α - 1) * Γ := by
        have : 0 ≤ (α - 1) * Γ := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hΓ
        have : 0 < 4 * α * m₀ := by positivity
        linarith
      nlinarith
    have hkey : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a i j * ((4 * α ^ 2 * y i * y j
          - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, b k * (-2 * α * y k * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        - Γ * (Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2))
        = Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * (4 * α ^ 2 * q - 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1)
          - 2 * α * (b 0 * y 0 + b 1 * y 1) - Γ) + Γ * Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2) := by
      rw [hqdef]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, if_pos (rfl : (0 : Fin 2) = 0), if_pos (rfl : (1 : Fin 2) = 1),
        if_neg (show ¬((0 : Fin 2) = 1) by decide), if_neg (show ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 0) by decide),
        if_true]
      ring
    rw [hkey]
    have := mul_pos hE hP
    have := mul_nonneg hΓ hER.le
    linarith
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : E2 → ℝ, ∀ x, v x = Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, fun x => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hvs, hvD, hv1, hv2⟩ := hbarrier z α R v hv
  have hV1 : ∀ x, dist x z = R → v x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hv, ← dist_eq_norm, hx, sub_self]
  have hV2 : ∀ x, v x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    have h1 : Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
      have := sq_nonneg ‖x - z‖
      nlinarith
    have h2 := Real.exp_pos (-α * R ^ 2)
    rw [hv]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ : ∃ y₀ : E2, y₀ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (z - x₁) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hV3 : 0 < fderiv ℝ v x₁ y₀ := by
    rw [hvD x₁ y₀]
    have hs : ∑ k : Fin 2, (x₁ - z) k * y₀ k = -(1 / 2) * ‖x₁ - z‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      simp [hy₀, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      ring
    rw [hs, ← dist_eq_norm, hx₁]
    rw [show -2 * α * (-(1 / 2) * R ^ 2) = α * R ^ 2 by ring]
    positivity
  
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => w x - m * v x) W :=
    hw.sub (contDiffOn_const.mul (contDiff_infty.mp hvs 2).contDiffOn)
  have hlin : ∀ x ∈ W, fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y - m * v y) x = fderiv ℝ w x - m • fderiv ℝ v x ∧
      (∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => w y - m * v y) x = pd2 k w x - m * pd2 k v x) ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (fun y => w y - m * v y)) x
        = pd2 i (pd2 j w) x - m * pd2 i (pd2 j v) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hdf : ∀ y ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ w y := fun y hy =>
      (hw.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)
    have hdg : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ v y := fun y => hvs.differentiable (by simp) y
    have h1 : ∀ y ∈ W, fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y - m * v y) y = fderiv ℝ w y - m • fderiv ℝ v y := by
      intro y hy
      exact ((hdf y hy).hasFDerivAt.sub ((hdg y).hasFDerivAt.const_mul m)).fderiv
    have h2 : ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ k : Fin 2,
        pd2 k (fun y => w y - m * v y) y = pd2 k w y - m * pd2 k v y := by
      intro y hy k
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => w y - m * v y) y (e2 k)
        = fderiv ℝ w y (e2 k) - m * fderiv ℝ v y (e2 k)
      rw [h1 y hy]
      rfl
    have hdpf : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) x := by
      intro j
      have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) W :=
        (hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by norm_num)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      exact (hc.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
    have hdpg : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) x := by
      intro j
      have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) :=
        (hvs.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const
      exact hc.differentiable (by simp) x
    refine ⟨h1 x hx, h2 x hx, fun i j => ?_⟩
    have hev : pd2 j (fun y => w y - m * v y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j) - m * fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => h2 y hy j)
    show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (fun y => w y - m * v y)) x (e2 i)
      = fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) x (e2 i)
        - m * fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) x (e2 i)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hD := ((hdpf j).hasFDerivAt.sub ((hdpg j).hasFDerivAt.const_mul m)).fderiv
    exact congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e2 i)) hD
  have hstrict : ∀ x : E2, R / 2 < dist x z → dist x z < R →
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j (fun x => w x - m * v x)) x
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k (fun x => w x - m * v x) x
        - Γ * (fun x => w x - m * v x) x < 0 := by
    intro x h1 h2
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]; exact h2.le)
    obtain ⟨-, hp1, hp2⟩ := hlin x hxW
    obtain ⟨hq, ha, hb, -⟩ := hK x h1.le h2.le
    have hineq := hbar (A x) (B x) (x - z) hq ha hb
      (by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact h2.le)
    have hs := hsup x hxW
    have hgw : 0 ≤ Γ * w x := mul_nonneg hΓ (hnn x hxW)
    have hTv := mul_pos hm hineq
    simp only [hp1, hp2, hv1, hv2, hv x] at hTv ⊢
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hTv hs ⊢
    linarith
  have hout : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R → 0 ≤ (fun x => w x - m * v x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hx])
    show 0 ≤ w x - m * v x
    rw [hV1 x hx, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact hnn x hxW
  have hin : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → 0 ≤ (fun x => w x - m * v x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hSin x hx
    have h2 := hV2 x
    show 0 ≤ w x - m * v x
    nlinarith
  
  have hApsd : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j := by
    intro x hx ξ
    by_cases hξ : ξ = 0
    · subst hξ
      simp
    · exact (hApos x hx ξ hξ).le
  have hmp := hminp W hW A B (fun x => w x - m * v x) Γ z R hR hball hu hAs
    hApsd hΓ hstrict hin hout
  
  have hu1 : w x₁ - m * v x₁ = 0 := by
    rw [hw₁, hV1 x₁ hx₁]
    ring
  have hseg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 →
      (fun x => w x - m * v x) x₁ ≤ (fun x => w x - m * v x) (x₁ + t • y₀) := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    have hd : dist (x₁ + t • y₀) z = (1 - t / 2) * R := by
      have e1 : x₁ + t • y₀ - z = (1 - t / 2) • (x₁ - z) := by
        rw [hy₀]
        module
      rw [dist_eq_norm, e1, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith),
        ← dist_eq_norm, hx₁]
    show w x₁ - m * v x₁ ≤ w (x₁ + t • y₀) - m * v (x₁ + t • y₀)
    rw [hu1]
    exact hmp _ (by rw [hd]; nlinarith) (by rw [hd]; nlinarith)
  have hdu : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => w x - m * v x) x₁ :=
    (hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx₁W)
  have h11 : 0 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fun x => w x - m * v x) x₁ y₀ := by
    have hminOn : IsLocalMinOn (fun x => w x - m * v x) (segment ℝ x₁ (x₁ + y₀)) x₁ := by
      apply Filter.eventually_of_mem self_mem_nhdsWithin
      intro p hp
      rw [segment_eq_image'] at hp
      obtain ⟨θ, ⟨h0, h1⟩, rfl⟩ := hp
      have := hseg θ h0 h1
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using this
    exact hminOn.hasFDerivWithinAt_nonneg hdu.hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
      (mem_posTangentConeAt_of_segment_subset subset_rfl)
  
  obtain ⟨hf1, -, -⟩ := hlin x₁ hx₁W
  rw [hf1, hdw1] at h11
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul, zero_sub] at h11
  nlinarith [mul_pos hm hV3]

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (φ : E2 → ℝ) (H : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U →
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ ∀ m, MemLp (H m) 2 (volume.restrict L))
    (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U →
      ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, φ x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, H m x * ζ x))
    (p : ℕ) : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp φ p (volume.restrict L)

signature.name: pdls_sobolev_Lp
signature.statement:
(U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (φ : E2 → ℝ) (H : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U →
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ ∀ m, MemLp (H m) 2 (volume.restrict L))
    (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U →
      ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, φ x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, H m x * ζ x))
    (p : ℕ) : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U → MemLp φ p (volume.restrict L)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro L hL hLU
  obtain ⟨K, ψ, H', hK, hψL, hψ0, hψ2, hH'2, hψgrad⟩ :=
    pdls_sob_cutoff U hU φ H hL2 hgrad L hL hLU
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huc, hu2, huS, hlim⟩ := pdls_sob_moll K hK ψ H' hψ0 hψ2 hH'2 hψgrad
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hGN⟩ := pdls_sob_gn_L2
  have hM : ∀ j, (∫ x, u j x ^ (2 * (p + 1))) ≤
      C ^ (2 * p) * ((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 * (∫ x, ψ x ^ 2) *
        (∑ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, H' m x ^ 2) ^ p := by
    intro j
    have h1 := pdls_sob_gn_iter C hC0 hGN (u j) ((hu j).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      (huc j) p
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, (pd2 m (u j) x) ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun m _ => integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _))
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ C ^ (2 * p) * ((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hψ0' : 0 ≤ ∫ x, ψ x ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
    refine h1.trans ?_
    have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ hS0 (huS j) p
    have h2 : C ^ (2 * p) * ((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 * (∫ x, u j x ^ 2) ≤
        C ^ (2 * p) * ((p + 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 * (∫ x, ψ x ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hu2 j) hA0
    exact mul_le_mul h2 hpow (pow_nonneg hS0 _) (mul_nonneg hA0 hψ0')
  have hint : ∀ j, Integrable (fun x => u j x ^ (2 * (p + 1))) := by
    intro j
    refine Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ((hu j).continuous.pow _) ?_
    exact (huc j).comp_left (g := fun t : ℝ => t ^ (2 * (p + 1))) (by simp)
  have hψp : MemLp ψ ((2 * (p + 1) : ℕ) : ENNReal) volume :=
    pdls_sob_fatou u ψ (fun j => (hu j).continuous) hlim p _ hint hM
  have hψL' : MemLp ψ ((2 * (p + 1) : ℕ) : ENNReal) (volume.restrict L) := hψp.restrict L
  have hae : ψ =ᵐ[volume.restrict L] φ :=
    ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hL.measurableSet (fun x hx => hψL x hx)
  have hφL := hψL'.ae_eq hae
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict L) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hL.measure_lt_top.ne
  exact hφL.mono_exponent (by exact_mod_cast (show p ≤ 2 * (p + 1) by omega))

subgoal_signatures.name: pdls_sob_gn_L2
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ v : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 v → HasCompactSupport v →
    (∫ x, v x ^ 2) ≤ C ^ 2 * (∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 m v x) ^ 2)) ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: pdls_sob_gn_iter
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hGN : ∀ v : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 v → HasCompactSupport v →
      (∫ x, v x ^ 2) ≤ C ^ 2 * (∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 m v x) ^ 2)) ^ 2)
    (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ 1 u) (huc : HasCompactSupport u) (k : ℕ) :
    (∫ x, u x ^ (2 * (k + 1))) ≤
      C ^ (2 * k) * ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 * (∫ x, u x ^ 2) *
        (∑ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, (pd2 m u x) ^ 2) ^ k

subgoal_signatures.name: pdls_sob_cutoff
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (φ : E2 → ℝ) (H : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ U →
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ ∀ m, MemLp (H m) 2 (volume.restrict L))
    (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U →
      ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, φ x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, H m x * ζ x))
    (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) (hLU : L ⊆ U) :
    ∃ (K : Set E2) (ψ : E2 → ℝ) (H' : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ), IsCompact K ∧
      (∀ x ∈ L, ψ x = φ x) ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ K → ψ x = 0) ∧ MemLp ψ 2 volume ∧
      (∀ m, MemLp (H' m) 2 volume) ∧
      ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
        ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, ψ x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, H' m x * ζ x)

subgoal_signatures.name: pdls_sob_moll
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(K : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K) (ψ : E2 → ℝ) (H' : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hψ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ K → ψ x = 0) (hψ : MemLp ψ 2 volume) (hH' : ∀ m, MemLp (H' m) 2 volume)
    (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      ∀ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, ψ x * pd2 m ζ x = -(∫ x, H' m x * ζ x)) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u j)) ∧ (∀ j, HasCompactSupport (u j)) ∧
      (∀ j, (∫ x, u j x ^ 2) ≤ ∫ x, ψ x ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ j, (∑ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, (pd2 m (u j) x) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, H' m x ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), Tendsto (fun j => u j x) atTop (𝓝 (ψ x))

subgoal_signatures.name: pdls_sob_fatou
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(f : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (g : E2 → ℝ) (hf : ∀ j, Continuous (f j))
    (hlim : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), Tendsto (fun j => f j x) atTop (𝓝 (g x)))
    (n : ℕ) (B : ℝ) (hint : ∀ j, Integrable (fun x => f j x ^ (2 * (n + 1))) volume)
    (hM : ∀ j, (∫ x, f j x ^ (2 * (n + 1))) ≤ B) :
    MemLp g ((2 * (n + 1) : ℕ) : ENNReal) volume

informal_problem.statement:
(S : Set E2) (hS : IsOpen S)
    (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) S)
    (hApd : ∀ x ∈ S, (A x).PosDef)
    (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
    (F : E2 → ℝ) (hF : pcrHolLoc α 0 F S)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ S →
      MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ ∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ (p : ℝ) * (1 - α))
    (hLp : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ S → ∀ k, MemLp (G k) p (volume.restrict L))
    (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ S →
      ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, G k x * ζ x))
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ S →
      ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, F x * ζ x) :
    ∀ x₀ ∈ S, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ S ∧ ∃ v : E2 → ℝ,
      pcrHolLoc α 1 v (Metric.ball x₀ r) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x₀ r)), w y = v y

signature.name: pdls_C1alpha
signature.statement:
(S : Set E2) (hS : IsOpen S)
    (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) S)
    (hApd : ∀ x ∈ S, (A x).PosDef)
    (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
    (F : E2 → ℝ) (hF : pcrHolLoc α 0 F S)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ S →
      MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ ∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ (p : ℝ) * (1 - α))
    (hLp : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ S → ∀ k, MemLp (G k) p (volume.restrict L))
    (hgrad : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ S →
      ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, G k x * ζ x))
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ S →
      ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * G b x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, F x * ζ x) :
    ∀ x₀ ∈ S, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ S ∧ ∃ v : E2 → ℝ,

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x₀ hx₀
  
  have hFc : ContinuousOn F S := hF.1.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨ρF, hρF, hBF, C₀, hC₀⟩ := hF.2 x₀ hx₀
  have hFhol : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρF, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρF,
      |F y - F z| ≤ max C₀ 0 * dist y z ^ α := by
    intro y hy z hz
    have h := hC₀ y hy z hz
    have e : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 F y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 F z‖ = |F y - F z| := by
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]
      simp only [Function.comp]
      rw [← map_sub, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [e] at h
    exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg _))
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ0, hρ14, hρF8⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ ρ ≤ ρF / 8 :=
    ⟨min (1 / 4) (ρF / 8), lt_min (by norm_num) (by linarith), min_le_left _ _, min_le_right _ _⟩
  have hKc : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)) := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have hKm : MeasurableSet (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)) := measurableSet_closedBall
  have hKconv : Convex ℝ (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)) := convex_closedBall _ _
  have hKF : Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ) ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρF :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hKS : Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ) ⊆ S := hKF.trans hBF
  have hB3K : Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ) ⊆ Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ) :=
    (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have hB2B3 : Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ) ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ) :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hB2K : Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ) ⊆ Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ) := hB2B3.trans hB3K
  have hB3F : Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ) ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ ρF := hB3K.trans hKF
  
  have hp3 : 3 ≤ p := by
    have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := Nat.cast_nonneg p
    have hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp0 hα0.le]
    have h1 : (2 : ℝ) < p := by nlinarith [mul_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < p) hα0]
    have : 2 < p := by exact_mod_cast h1
    omega
  
  haveI hKfin : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ))) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hKc.measure_lt_top.ne
  have hGi : ∀ b, IntegrableOn (G b) (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)) := fun b =>
    ((hL2 _ hKc hKS).2 b).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hwi : IntegrableOn w (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)) :=
    ((hL2 _ hKc hKS).1).integrable (by norm_num)
  have hwint : Integrable ((Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator w) :=
    hwi.integrable_indicator hKm
  have hIntA : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable ((Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator
      (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y)) := by
    intro a
    refine IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator ?_ hKm
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun b _ =>
      IntegrableOn.continuousOn_mul ((hA a b).continuousOn.mono hKS) (hGi b) hKc)
  have hFi : IntegrableOn F (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)) :=
    ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact hKc (hFc.mono hKS)
  have hF2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ S → MemLp F 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
    intro L hL hLW
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hL.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hFc.mono hLW)
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict L) :=
      isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hL.measure_lt_top.ne
    exact MemLp.of_bound ((hFc.mono hLW).aestronglyMeasurable hL.measurableSet) C
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hL.measurableSet hC)
  
  have hFB : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), |F y| ≤ |F x₀| + max C₀ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 := hFhol y (hB3F hy) x₀ (Metric.mem_ball_self hρF)
    have hd : dist y x₀ ≤ 1 := by rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hy; linarith
    have h2 : dist y x₀ ^ α ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one dist_nonneg hd hα0.le
    have h3 : max C₀ 0 * dist y x₀ ^ α ≤ max C₀ 0 :=
      mul_le_of_le_one_right (le_max_right _ _) h2
    have h4 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (F y) (F x₀)
    linarith
  have hFH : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∀ y' ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ),
      |F y - F y'| ≤ max C₀ 0 * dist y y' ^ α := fun y hy y' hy' =>
    hFhol y (hB3F hy) y' (hB3F hy')
  
  have hd1 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), dist x y ≤ 1 := by
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hx hy
    linarith [dist_triangle_right x y x₀]
  have hdα : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ), ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ),
      dist x y ≤ dist x y ^ α := fun x hx y hy => by
    have := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' dist_nonneg (hd1 x hx y hy) hα0.le hα1.le
    simpa using this
  
  obtain ⟨θ, Λ, Λ', hθ, hΛ, hΛ', hell, hAb, hAd, hALip⟩ :=
    elr_ellip_consts S hS A hA hApd _ hKc hKconv hKS
  obtain ⟨c₀, c₁, hc₀, hc₁, hker⟩ := pdls_kernel
  obtain ⟨N, hN0, hNb⟩ : ∃ N : ℝ, 0 ≤ N ∧
      ∀ b, ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), |G b y| ^ p ≤ N :=
    ⟨∑ b : Fin 2, ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), |G b y| ^ p,
      Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => setIntegral_nonneg hKm (fun y _ => by positivity)),
      fun b => Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun b => ∫ y in Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ), |G b y| ^ p)
        (fun b _ => setIntegral_nonneg hKm (fun y _ => by positivity)) (Finset.mem_univ b)⟩
  obtain ⟨Cc, hCc, hcomm⟩ := pdls_comm_holder α p hα0 hα1 hp c₀ c₁ Λ' hc₀ hc₁ hΛ'
  obtain ⟨M₃, hM₃, hosc⟩ := pdls_grad_Lp_osc p hp3 ρ N hρ0 hN0
  obtain ⟨Kc, hKc0, hKcΛ, hKcΛ', hKcR, hBFKc, hKcM⟩ : ∃ Kc : ℝ, 0 ≤ Kc ∧ Λ ≤ Kc ∧ Λ' ≤ Kc ∧
      Cc * (N + 1) ≤ Kc ∧ |F x₀| + max C₀ 0 ≤ Kc ∧ M₃ ≤ Kc := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ Cc * (N + 1) := mul_nonneg hCc (by linarith)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ |F x₀| := abs_nonneg _
    have h3 : 0 ≤ max C₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
    exact ⟨Λ + Λ' + Cc * (N + 1) + (|F x₀| + max C₀ 0) + M₃, by linarith, by linarith,
      by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hCFKc : max C₀ 0 ≤ Kc := by linarith [abs_nonneg (F x₀)]
  obtain ⟨MS, hMS, hsch⟩ :=
    pdls_schauder_ball α θ Kc (2 * ρ) hα0 hα1 hθ hKc0 (by linarith) (by linarith)
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδle, hδlim⟩ : ∃ δ : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 < δ j) ∧ (∀ j, δ j ≤ ρ) ∧
      Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    refine ⟨fun j => ρ * (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)), fun j => mul_pos hρ0 (by positivity),
      fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
        linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg j : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j)]
      show ρ * (1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) ≤ ρ
      nlinarith
    · have h := (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).const_mul ρ
      simpa using h
  have hker' : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ η : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ η ∧ HasCompactSupport η ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ η z) ∧
      (∀ z, δ j ≤ ‖z‖ → η z = 0) ∧ (∫ z, η z) = 1 ∧ (∀ z, |η z| ≤ c₀ / δ j ^ 2) ∧
      ∀ z, ‖fderiv ℝ η z‖ ≤ c₁ / δ j ^ 3 := fun j => hker (δ j) (hδpos j)
  choose η hη hηc hη0 hηs hη1 hηb hηd using hker'
  
  have hunif : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ / 4), ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (2 * ρ / 4),
      ∀ i : Fin 2,
      |pd2 i (fun x => ∫ y', η j (x - y') * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator w y') y|
          ≤ MS ∧
      |pd2 i (fun x => ∫ y', η j (x - y') * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator w y') y -
        pd2 i (fun x => ∫ y', η j (x - y') * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator w y') z|
          ≤ MS * dist y z ^ α := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨hwsm, -, hpdw, hdiv, -, -⟩ := elr_mollified_system S hS A hA w G F
      (fun L hL hLS => ⟨(hL2 L hL hLS).1, (hL2 L hL hLS).2, hF2 L hL hLS⟩) hgrad hweak x₀ ρ hρ0
      hKS (δ j) (hδpos j) (hδle j) (η j) (hη j) (hηc j) (hη0 j) (hηs j) (hη1 j)
    obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : E2 → ℝ,
        W = fun x => ∫ y', η j (x - y') * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator w y' :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hWs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W := by rw [hWdef]; exact hwsm
    have hpdW : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (3 * ρ), ∀ b : Fin 2,
        pd2 b W x = ∫ y, η j (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator (G b) y := by
      rw [hWdef]; exact hpdw
    obtain ⟨cv, hcvdef⟩ : ∃ cv : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, cv = fun a x =>
        ∫ y, η j (x - y) * (Metric.closedBall x₀ (4 * ρ)).indicator
          (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * G b y) y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hcvs : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cv a) := fun a => by
      rw [hcvdef]; exact (elr_moll_deriv (η j) _ (hη j) (hηc j) (hIntA a)).1

      rw [h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    exact ⟨hcont, hζc.mono' hsupp, (closure_minimal hsupp (isClosed_tsupport ζ)).trans hζW⟩
  
  have s1 : ∀ f φ : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f W → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
      tsupport φ ⊆ W → Integrable (fun x => f x * φ x) := by
    intro f φ hf hφ hφc hφW
    have hcont : Continuous (fun x => f x * φ x) := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ W
      · exact (hf.continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).mul hφ.continuousAt
      · have hO : (tsupport φ)ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 x :=
          (isClosed_tsupport φ).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds (fun hm => hx (hφW hm))
        have hev : (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => f y * φ y) := by
          filter_upwards [hO] with y hy
          rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy, mul_zero]
        exact continuousAt_const.congr hev
    exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (HasCompactSupport.mul_left (f := f) hφc)
  
  have ibpL : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f W → ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ →
      HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      ∫ x, f x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, pd2 k f x * ζ x) := by
    intro f hf ζ hζ hζc hζW k
    have hvan : ∀ x, x ∉ W → (ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0) := fun x hx =>
      notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (fun hm => hx (hζW hm))
    have hFder : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (fun y => f y * ζ y)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => f y * ζ y) x) x ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => f y * ζ y) x (e2 k) = pd2 k f x * ζ x + f x * pd2 k ζ x := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ W
      · have hf' : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f x) x :=
          ((hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
        have hζ' : HasFDerivAt ζ (fderiv ℝ ζ x) x :=
          (hζ.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
        have hm : HasFDerivAt (fun y => f y * ζ y)
            (f x • fderiv ℝ ζ x + ζ x • fderiv ℝ f x) x := hf'.mul hζ'
        refine ⟨hm.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt, ?_⟩
        rw [hm.fderiv]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, pd2]
        ring
      · have hF0 : (fun y => f y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
          filter_upwards [hvan x hx] with y hy
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hy
          simp [hy]
        have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => f y * ζ y) (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x :=
          (hasFDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq hF0
        refine ⟨hd.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt, ?_⟩
        rw [hd.fderiv, (hfdz ζ hζW x hx).1, (hfdz ζ hζW x hx).2 k]
        simp
    have hFd : Differentiable ℝ (fun y => f y * ζ y) :=
      fun x => (hFder x).1.differentiableAt
    have hprod : (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => f y * ζ y) x (e2 k)) =
        fun x => pd2 k f x * ζ x + f x * pd2 k ζ x := funext fun x => (hFder x).2
    have hpz := hpdtest ζ hζ hζc hζW k
    have hdf : ContinuousOn (pd2 k f) W :=
      (hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hg₁ : Integrable (fun x => pd2 k f x * ζ x) :=
      s1 _ ζ hdf hζ.continuous hζc hζW
    have hg₂ : Integrable (fun x => f x * pd2 k ζ x) :=
      s1 f (pd2 k ζ) hf.continuousOn hpz.1 hpz.2.1 hpz.2.2
    have hF : Integrable (fun x => f x * ζ x) := s1 f ζ hf.continuousOn hζ.continuous hζc hζW
    have hF' : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => f y * ζ y) x (e2 k)) := by
      rw [hprod]; exact hg₁.add hg₂
    have hI := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
      (f := fun y => f y * ζ y) (g := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (v := e2 k)
      (by simpa using hF') (by simp) (by simpa using hF) hFd (differentiable_const 1)
    have hzero : ∫ x, fderiv ℝ (fun y => f y * ζ y) x (e2 k) = 0 := by
      simp only [fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero, integral_zero,
        mul_one] at hI
      linarith
    rw [hprod, integral_add hg₁ hg₂] at hzero
    linarith
  have hpducont : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (pd2 k u) W := fun k =>
    (hu.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have haeW : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ W → w x = u x := (ae_restrict_iff' hWm).1 hae
  
  have s2 : ∀ k : Fin 2, ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ W → G k x = pd2 k u x := by
    intro k
    have hloc : LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => G k x - pd2 k u x) W volume := by
      rw [locallyIntegrableOn_iff hW.isLocallyClosed]
      intro L hLW hL
      haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict L) :=
        isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 hL.measure_lt_top.ne
      have h1 : IntegrableOn (G k) L volume := ((hL2 L hL hLW).2 k).integrable (by norm_num)
      have h2 : IntegrableOn (pd2 k u) L volume :=
        ((hpducont k).mono hLW).integrableOn_compact hL
      exact h1.sub h2
    have htest : ∀ g : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ W →
        ∫ x, g x • (G k x - pd2 k u x) = 0 := by
      intro ζ hζ hζc hζW
      have e1 : ∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x = ∫ x, u x * pd2 k ζ x := by
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [haeW] with x hx
        by_cases hxW : x ∈ W
        · rw [hx hxW]
        · rw [(hfdz ζ hζW x hxW).2 k, mul_zero, mul_zero]
      have e2 := ibpL u hu ζ hζ hζc hζW k
      have e3 := hgrad ζ hζ hζc hζW k
      have iG : Integrable (fun x => G k x * ζ x) := by
        haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (tsupport ζ)) :=
          isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 (IsCompact.measure_lt_top hζc).ne
        have hGi : IntegrableOn (G k) (tsupport ζ) volume :=
          ((hL2 _ hζc hζW).2 k).integrable (by norm_num)
        have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => G k x * ζ x) (tsupport ζ) volume :=
          hGi.mul_continuousOn hζ.continuous.continuousOn hζc
        refine (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset ?_).1 h1
        intro x hx
        by_contra hxn
        exact hx (show G k x * ζ x = 0 by rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hxn, mul_zero])
      have iP : Integrable (fun x => pd2 k u x * ζ x) :=
        s1 _ ζ (hpducont k) hζ.continuous hζc hζW
      have e4 : ∫ x, ζ x • (G k x - pd2 k u x) = ∫ x, (G k x * ζ x - pd2 k u x * ζ x) := by
        congr 1; funext x; rw [smul_eq_mul]; ring
      have e5 : ∫ x, (G k x * ζ x - pd2 k u x * ζ x)
          = (∫ x, G k x * ζ x) - ∫ x, pd2 k u x * ζ x := integral_sub iG iP
      rw [e4, e5]
      linarith
    have := hW.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero hloc htest
    filter_upwards [this] with x hx hxW
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (hx hxW)
  
  have s3 : ∀ H : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn H W → (∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∫ x, H x * ζ x = 0) → ∀ x ∈ W, H x = 0 := by
    intro H hH h0
    have hloc : LocallyIntegrableOn H W volume := hH.locallyIntegrableOn hWm
    have h1 := hW.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero hloc (fun g hg hgc hgW => by
      have hfun : (fun x => g x • H x) = fun x => H x * g x :=
        funext fun x => by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      rw [hfun]
      exact h0 g hg hgc hgW)
    have h2 : H =ᵐ[volume.restrict W] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := (ae_restrict_iff' hWm).2 h1
    intro x hx
    exact Measure.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq h2 hW hH continuousOn_const hx
  have hall : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ W → ∀ b : Fin 2, G b x = pd2 b u x := by
    have hG' : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ b : Fin 2, x ∈ W → G b x = pd2 b u x := ae_all_iff.2 s2
    filter_upwards [hG'] with x h1 hx
    exact fun b => h1 b hx
  
  have hii : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W →
      ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A x a b * pd2 b u x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, F x * ζ x := by
    intro ζ hζ hζc hζW
    rw [← hweak ζ hζ hζc hζW]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hall] with x hx
    by_cases hxW : x ∈ W
    · simp only [hx hxW]
    · obtain ⟨_, hpz⟩ := hfdz ζ hζW x hxW
      simp [hpz]
  refine ⟨fun k => (ae_restrict_iff' hWm).2 (s2 k), hii, ?_⟩
  
  intro hu2
  have hfd1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ u) W := hu2.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by norm_num)
  have hpd1 : ∀ b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (pd2 b u) W := fun b => by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => fderiv ℝ u x (e2 b)) W
    exact hfd1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hA1 : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => A x a b) W := fun a b =>
    (hA a b).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ,
      V = fun a y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b u y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVa : ∀ a y, V a y = ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b u y := by
    intro a y; rw [hVdef]
  have hV : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (V a) W := by
    intro a
    rw [hVdef]
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun b _ => (hA1 a b).mul (hpd1 b))
  have hdV : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (pd2 a (V a)) W := fun a =>
    ((hV a).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hgoal : ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (V a) x + F x = 0 := by
    refine s3 (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (V a) x + F x)
      ((continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => hdV a)).add hFc) ?_
    intro ζ hζ hζc hζW
    have hJ : ∫ x, (V 0 x * pd2 0 ζ x + V 1 x * pd2 1 ζ x) = ∫ x, F x * ζ x := by
      rw [← hii ζ hζ hζc hζW]
      congr 1; funext x; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hVa]; ring
    have hpz := hpdtest ζ hζ hζc hζW
    have iV : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => V a x * pd2 a ζ x) := fun a =>
      s1 (V a) (pd2 a ζ) (hV a).continuousOn (hpz a).1 (hpz a).2.1 (hpz a).2.2
    have iD : ∀ a : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => pd2 a (V a) x * ζ x) := fun a =>
      s1 _ ζ (hdV a) hζ.continuous hζc hζW
    have iF : Integrable (fun x => F x * ζ x) := s1 F ζ hFc hζ.continuous hζc hζW
    have ibp : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∫ x, V a x * pd2 a ζ x = -(∫ x, pd2 a (V a) x * ζ x) := fun a =>
      ibpL (V a) (hV a) ζ hζ hζc hζW a
    have e2 : ∫ x, (V 0 x * pd2 0 ζ x + V 1 x * pd2 1 ζ x)
        = (∫ x, V 0 x * pd2 0 ζ x) + ∫ x, V 1 x * pd2 1 ζ x := integral_add (iV 0) (iV 1)
    have e3 : ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (V a) x + F x) * ζ x
        = ∫ x, ((pd2 0 (V 0) x * ζ x + pd2 1 (V 1) x * ζ x) + F x * ζ x) := by
      congr 1; funext x; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    have e4 : ∫ x, ((pd2 0 (V 0) x * ζ x + pd2 1 (V 1) x * ζ x) + F x * ζ x)
        = (∫ x, (pd2 0 (V 0) x * ζ x + pd2 1 (V 1) x * ζ x)) + ∫ x, F x * ζ x :=
      integral_add ((iD 0).add (iD 1)) iF
    have e5 : ∫ x, (pd2 0 (V 0) x * ζ x + pd2 1 (V 1) x * ζ x)
        = (∫ x, pd2 0 (V 0) x * ζ x) + ∫ x, pd2 1 (V 1) x * ζ x := integral_add (iD 0) (iD 1)
    show ∫ x, (∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (V a) x + F x) * ζ x = 0
    rw [e3, e4, e5]
    have i0 := ibp 0
    have i1 := ibp 1
    linarith
  intro x hx
  have hx' : ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => ∑ b : Fin 2, A x' a b * pd2 b u x') x + F x = 0 := by
    have h := hgoal x hx
    rw [hVdef] at h
    exact h
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (m : ℕ) :
    (∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (U V : Set E2), IsOpen V → V ⊆ U → pcrHolLoc α m w U → pcrHolLoc α m w V) ∧
    (∀ (W : Set E2) (w : E2 → ℝ), IsOpen W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x r ⊆ W ∧ ∃ v : E2 → ℝ,
        pcrHolLoc α m v (Metric.ball x r) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)), w y = v y) →
      ∃ w' : E2 → ℝ, pcrHolLoc α m w' W ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict W), w x = w' x)

signature.name: pdls_holLoc_glue
signature.statement:
(α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (m : ℕ) :
    (∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (U V : Set E2), IsOpen V → V ⊆ U → pcrHolLoc α m w U → pcrHolLoc α m w V) ∧
    (∀ (W : Set E2) (w : E2 → ℝ), IsOpen W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x r ⊆ W ∧ ∃ v : E2 → ℝ,
        pcrHolLoc α m v (Metric.ball x r) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r)), w y = v y) →
      ∃ w' : E2 → ℝ, pcrHolLoc α m w' W ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict W), w x = w' x)

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w U V hV hVU hw
    refine ⟨hw.1.mono hVU, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεV⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV x hx
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, _, C, H⟩ := hw.2 x (hVU hx)
    refine ⟨min ρ ε, lt_min hρ hε,
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hεV, C, fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
    exact H y (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hy) z
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz)
  · intro W w hW h
    choose! r hr hrW v hv hae using h
    
    have hover : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ x' ∈ W, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x (r x) ∩ Metric.ball x' (r x'),
        v x z = v x' z := by
      intro x hx x' hx' z hz
      have hO : IsOpen (Metric.ball x (r x) ∩ Metric.ball x' (r x')) :=
        Metric.isOpen_ball.inter Metric.isOpen_ball
      have h1 : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x (r x) ∩ Metric.ball x' (r x'))),
          w y = v x y := ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset Set.inter_subset_left (hae x hx)
      have h2 : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x (r x) ∩ Metric.ball x' (r x'))),
          w y = v x' y := ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset Set.inter_subset_right (hae x' hx')
      have h3 : v x =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Metric.ball x (r x) ∩ Metric.ball x' (r x'))] v x' := by
        filter_upwards [h1, h2] with y hy1 hy2
        rw [← hy1, ← hy2]
      exact MeasureTheory.Measure.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq h3 hO
        ((hv x hx).1.continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        ((hv x' hx').1.continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_right) hz
    set w' : E2 → ℝ := fun y => v y y with hw'def
    have hagree : ∀ x ∈ W, Set.EqOn w' (v x) (Metric.ball x (r x)) := by
      intro x hx z hz
      have hzW : z ∈ W := hrW x hx hz
      exact hover z hzW x hx z ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self (hr z hzW), hz⟩
    have hgerm : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x (r x),
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w' y = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (v x) y := by
      intro x hx y hy
      have hev : w' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] v x :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy) (hagree x hx)
      exact (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds
    refine ⟨w', ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
      intro x hx
      refine ⟨Metric.ball x (r x), Metric.isOpen_ball, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr x hx), ?_⟩
      exact ((hv x hx).1.mono Set.inter_subset_right).congr
        (fun y hy => hagree x hx hy.2)
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρB, C, H⟩ := (hv x hx).2 x (Metric.mem_ball_self (hr x hx))
      refine ⟨ρ, hρ, hρB.trans (hrW x hx), C, fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
      rw [hgerm x hx y (hρB hy), hgerm x hx z (hρB hz)]
      exact H y hy z hz
    · obtain ⟨T, hTc, hTU⟩ := TopologicalSpace.isOpen_iUnion_countable
        (fun i : W => Metric.ball (i : E2) (r i)) (fun i => Metric.isOpen_ball)
      have hWU : W = ⋃ i : W, Metric.ball (i : E2) (r i) := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · intro hy
          exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr y hy)⟩
        · intro hy
          obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hy
          exact hrW i i.2 hi
      have hWT : W = ⋃ i ∈ T, Metric.ball (i : E2) (r i) := by rw [hTU]; exact hWU
      rw [hWT]
      refine (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_biUnion_iff
        (fun i : W => Metric.ball (i : E2) (r i)) hTc (fun y => w y = w' y)).2 ?_
      intro i _
      filter_upwards [hae i i.2, ae_restrict_mem Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet] with y hy hyB
      exact hy.trans (hagree i i.2 hyB).symm

informal_problem.statement:
(U V : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (α : ℝ)
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (m : ℕ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : pcrHolLoc α m f V)
    (τ : E2 → E2) (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ U) (hτUV : Set.MapsTo τ U V) :
    pcrHolLoc α m (fun x => f (τ x)) U

signature.name: pcr_holLoc_comp_smooth
signature.statement:
(U V : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (α : ℝ)
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (m : ℕ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : pcrHolLoc α m f V)
    (τ : E2 → E2) (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ U) (hτUV : Set.MapsTo τ U V) :
    pcrHolLoc α m (fun x => f (τ x)) U

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have F0 : ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (f : E2 → G) (y z : E2),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 f y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 f z‖ = ‖f y - f z‖ := by
    intro G _ _ f y z
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [← map_sub, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
  
  have s1 : ∀ (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
      (m : ℕ) (f : E2 → G),
      pcrHolV α (m + 1) f W ↔ DifferentiableOn ℝ f W ∧ pcrHolV α m (fderiv ℝ f) W := by
    intro W hW G _ _ m f
    have hnorm : ∀ y z, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f z‖ =
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) z‖ := by
      intro y z
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_right, iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_right]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [← LinearIsometryEquiv.map_sub, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
    have hω : ((m : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ ω := WithTop.natCast_ne_top m
    have hcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) f W ↔
        DifferentiableOn ℝ f W ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ((m : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fderiv ℝ f) W := by
      rw [show ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) = ((m : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) + 1 by push_cast; rfl,
        contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, -, h3⟩
        exact ⟨h1, h3⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h3⟩
        exact ⟨h1, fun h => absurd h hω, h3⟩
    unfold pcrHolV
    rw [hcd]
    simp only [hnorm]
    exact and_assoc
  
  have s2 : ∀ (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
      (m : ℕ) (f : E2 → G),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) f W → pcrHolV α m f W := by
    intro W hW G _ _ m f hf
    refine ⟨hf.of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ m), fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hW x hx
    have hcb : Metric.closedBall x (ε / 2) ⊆ W :=
      (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f) W :=
      (hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin le_rfl hW.uniqueDiffOn).congr
        (fun y hy => (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (m + 1) hW hy).symm)
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x (ε / 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hcont.mono hcb)
    have hdiff : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball x (ε / 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) v := by
      intro v hv
      exact (hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds (hcb (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hv)))).differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv
        (by exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self m)
    have hbd : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball x (ε / 2), ‖fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) v‖ ≤ max L 0 := by
      intro v hv
      rw [norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv]
      exact (hL v (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hv)).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    refine ⟨ε / 2, by linarith, (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball,
      max L 0 * ε ^ (1 - α), ?_⟩
    intro y hy z hz
    have hmv := (convex_ball x (ε / 2)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff hbd hz hy
    rw [← dist_eq_norm y z] at hmv
    have hd : dist y z < ε := by
      have hy' : dist y x < ε / 2 := hy
      have hz' : dist z x < ε / 2 := hz
      calc dist y z ≤ dist y x + dist z x := dist_triangle_right y z x
        _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := add_lt_add hy' hz'
        _ = ε := by ring
    have key : dist y z ≤ ε ^ (1 - α) * dist y z ^ α := by
      rcases (dist_nonneg (x := y) (y := z)).eq_or_lt with h | h
      · rw [← h, Real.zero_rpow hα0.ne']
        simp
      · calc dist y z = dist y z ^ (1 - α) * dist y z ^ α := by
              rw [← Real.rpow_add h]; simp
          _ ≤ ε ^ (1 - α) * dist y z ^ α :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.rpow_le_rpow h.le hd.le (by linarith))
                (Real.rpow_nonneg h.le _)
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖ ≤ max L 0 * dist y z := hmv
      _ ≤ max L 0 * (ε ^ (1 - α) * dist y z ^ α) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key (le_max_right _ _)
      _ = max L 0 * ε ^ (1 - α) * dist y z ^ α := by ring
  
  have s3 : ∀ (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
      (m : ℕ) (f g : E2 → G),
      pcrHolV α m f W → pcrHolV α m g W → pcrHolV α m (fun x => f x + g x) W := by
    intro W hW G _ _ m f g hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.add hg.1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ρf, hρf, hbf, Cf, hCf⟩ := hf.2 x hx
    obtain ⟨ρg, hρg, hbg, Cg, hCg⟩ := hg.2 x hx
    refine ⟨min ρf ρg, lt_min hρf hρg, (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hbf,
      Cf + Cg, ?_⟩
    intro y hy z hz
    have hyf := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hy
    have hzf := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz
    have hyg := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hy
    have hzg := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hz
    have hadd : ∀ v ∈ W, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x => f x + g x) v =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f v + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g v := fun v hv =>
      iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (hf.1.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hv)) (hg.1.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hv))
    rw [hadd y (hbf hyf), hadd z (hbf hzf)]
    calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y -
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z + iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g z)‖
        = ‖(iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z) +
            (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g z)‖ := by congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f z‖ +
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ Cf * dist y z ^ α + Cg * dist y z ^ α :=
          add_le_add (hCf y hyf z hzf) (hCg y hyg z hzg)
      _ = (Cf + Cg) * dist y z ^ α := by ring
  
  have s3b : ∀ (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ∀ {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
      (m : ℕ) (f g : E2 → G),
      (∀ x ∈ W, f x = g x) → pcrHolV α m f W → pcrHolV α m g W := by
    intro W hW G _ _ m f g hfg hf
    have heq : ∀ y ∈ W, iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y := by
      intro y hy
      have hev : g =ᶠ[𝓝 y] f :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hy) (fun v hv => (hfg v hv).symm)
      exact (hev.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds
    refine ⟨hf.1.congr (fun y hy => (hfg y hy).symm), fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hb, C, hC⟩ := hf.2 x hx
    refine ⟨ρ, hρ, hb, C, fun y hy z hz => ?_⟩
    rw [heq y (hb hy), heq z (hb hz)]
    exact hC y hy z hz
  
  have s4 : ∀ (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ∀ (m : ℕ) {G₁ G₂ G₃ : Type}
      [NormedAddCommGroup G₁] [NormedSpace ℝ G₁]
      [NormedAddCommGroup G₂] [NormedSpace ℝ G₂] [NormedAddCommGroup G₃] [NormedSpace ℝ G₃]
      (β : G₁ →L[ℝ] G₂ →L[ℝ] G₃) (a : E2 → G₁) (b : E2 → G₂),
      pcrHolV α m a W → pcrHolV α m b W → pcrHolV α m (fun x => β (a x) (b x)) W := by
    intro W hW m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro G₁ G₂ G₃ _ _ _ _ _ _ β a b ha hb
      refine ⟨(β.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn ha.1).clm_apply hb.1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨ρa, hρa, hba, Ca, hCa⟩ := ha.2 x hx
      obtain ⟨ρb, hρb, hbb, Cb, hCb⟩ := hb.2 x hx
      have hρ0 : 0 < min ρa ρb := lt_min hρa hρb
      have hb0 : Metric.ball x (min ρa ρb) ⊆ W :=
        (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hba
      have hcb : Metric.closedBall x (min ρa ρb / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball x (min ρa ρb) :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨Ma, hMa⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x (min ρa ρb / 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (ha.1.continuousOn.mono (hcb.trans hb0))
      obtain ⟨Mb, hMb⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x (min ρa ρb / 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
        (hb.1.continuousOn.mono (hcb.trans hb0))
      refine ⟨min ρa ρb / 2, by linarith, (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcb).trans hb0,
        ‖β‖ * (Ca * max Mb 0 + max Ma 0 * Cb), ?_⟩
      intro y hy z hz
      rw [F0]
      have hyc : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x (min ρa ρb / 2) := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy
      have hzc : z ∈ Metric.closedBall x (min ρa ρb / 2) := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz
      have hya : y ∈ Metric.ball x ρa := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) (hcb hyc)
      have hza : z ∈ Metric.ball x ρa := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) (hcb hzc)
      have hyb : y ∈ Metric.ball x ρb := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) (hcb hyc)
      have hzb : z ∈ Metric.ball x ρb := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) (hcb hzc)
      have h1 : ‖a y - a z‖ ≤ Ca * dist y z ^ α := by rw [← F0]; exact hCa y hya z hza
      have h2 : ‖b y - b z‖ ≤ Cb * dist y z ^ α := by rw [← F0]; exact hCb y hyb z hzb
      have hMa' : ‖a z‖ ≤ max Ma 0 := (hMa z hzc).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      have hMb' : ‖b y‖ ≤ max Mb 0 := (hMb y hyc).trans (le_max_left _ _)
      have hsplit : β (a y) (b y) - β (a z) (b z) =
          β (a y - a z) (b y) + β (a z) (b y - b z) := by
        simp only [map_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
        abel
      calc ‖β (a y) (b y) - β (a z) (b z)‖
          = ‖β (a y - a z) (b y) + β (a z) (b y - b z)‖ := by rw [hsplit]
        _ ≤ ‖β (a y - a z) (b y)‖ + ‖β (a z) (b y - b z)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖β‖ * ‖a y - a z‖ * ‖b y‖ + ‖β‖ * ‖a z‖ * ‖b y - b z‖ :=
            add_le_add (β.le_opNorm₂ _ _) (β.le_opNorm₂ _ _)
        _ ≤ ‖β‖ * (Ca * dist y z ^ α) * max Mb 0 + ‖β‖ * max Ma 0 * (Cb * dist y z ^ α) :=
            add_le_add
              (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)) hMb' (by positivity)
                (mul_nonneg (by positivity) ((norm_nonneg _).trans h1)))
              (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hMa' (by positivity)) h2 (by positivity)
                (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (le_max_right _ _)))
        _ = ‖β‖ * (Ca * max Mb 0 + max Ma 0 * Cb) * dist y z ^ α := by ring
    | succ m ih =>
      intro G₁ G₂ G₃ _ _ _ _ _ _ β a b ha hb
      obtain ⟨hda, ha'⟩ := (s1 W hW m a).1 ha
      obtain ⟨hdb, hb'⟩ := (s1 W hW m b).1 hb
      have ha0 : pcrHolV α m a W := s2 W hW m a ha.1
      have hb0 : pcrHolV α m b W := s2 W hW m b hb.1
      have T1 := ih (ContinuousLinearMap.precompR E2 β) a (fderiv ℝ b) ha0 hb'
      have T2 := ih (ContinuousLinearMap.precompL E2 β) (fderiv ℝ a) b ha' hb0
      have T := s3 W hW m _ _ T1 T2
      have hder : ∀ x ∈ W, HasFDerivAt (fun y => β (a y) (b y))
          (ContinuousLinearMap.precompR E2 β (a x) (fderiv ℝ b x) +
            ContinuousLinearMap.precompL E2 β (fderiv ℝ a x) (b x)) x := fun x hx =>
        β.hasFDerivAt_of_bilinear (hda.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
          (hdb.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
      exact (s1 W hW m _).2 ⟨fun x hx => (hder x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
        s3b W hW m _ _ (fun x hx => (hder x hx).fderiv.symm) T⟩
  
  have s5 : ∀ (m : ℕ) {G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] (f : E2 → G),
      pcrHolV α m f V → pcrHolV α m (fun x => f (τ x)) U := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro G _ _ f hf
      refine ⟨hf.1.comp (hτ.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)) hτUV, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨ρ', hρ', hb', C', hC'⟩ := hf.2 (τ x) (hτUV hx)
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, hballU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hU x hx
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hτδ⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.1
        (hτ.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)) ρ' hρ'
      have hmin : 0 < min δ ε := lt_min hδ hε
      have hrδ : min δ ε / 2 < δ := by have := min_le_left δ ε; linarith
      have hcb : Metric.closedBall x (min δ ε / 2) ⊆ U :=
        (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (show min δ ε / 2 < min δ ε by linarith)).trans
          ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right δ ε)).trans hballU)
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := (hτ.mono hcb).exists_lipschitzOnWith (by simp)
        (convex_closedBall x (min δ ε / 2)) (isCompact_closedBall x (min δ ε / 2))
      refine ⟨min δ ε / 2, by linarith, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcb,
        max C' 0 * (K : ℝ) ^ α, ?_⟩
      intro y hy z hz
      rw [F0]
      have hyc : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x (min δ ε / 2) := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy
      have hzc : z ∈ Metric.closedBall x (min δ ε / 2) := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hz
      have hyδ : dist y x < δ := by
        have : dist y x < min δ ε / 2 := hy
        linarith
      have hzδ : dist z x < δ := by
        have : dist z x < min δ ε / 2 := hz
        linarith
      have hτy : τ y ∈ Metric.ball (τ x) ρ' := hτδ hyδ
      have hτz : τ z ∈ Metric.ball (τ x) ρ' := hτδ hzδ
      have h1 : ‖f (τ y) - f (τ z)‖ ≤ C' * dist (τ y) (τ z) ^ α := by
        rw [← F0]; exact hC' _ hτy _ hτz
      have hL : dist (τ y) (τ z) ≤ (K : ℝ) * dist y z := hK.dist_le_mul y hyc z hzc
      have h2 : dist (τ y) (τ z) ^ α ≤ ((K : ℝ) * dist y z) ^ α :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow dist_nonneg hL hα0.le
      have h3 : ((K : ℝ) * dist y z) ^ α = (K : ℝ) ^ α * dist y z ^ α :=
        Real.mul_rpow K.coe_nonneg dist_nonneg
      calc ‖f (τ y) - f (τ z)‖ ≤ C' * dist (τ y) (τ z) ^ α := h1
        _ ≤ max C' 0 * dist (τ y) (τ z) ^ α :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ max C' 0 * ((K : ℝ) * dist y z) ^ α :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (le_max_right _ _)
        _ = max C' 0 * (K : ℝ) ^ α * dist y z ^ α := by rw [h3]; ring
    | succ m ih =>
      intro G _ _ f hf
      obtain ⟨hdf, hf'⟩ := (s1 V hV m f).1 hf
      have hA := ih (fderiv ℝ f) hf'
      obtain ⟨hdτ, hτ'⟩ := (contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hτ
      have hB : pcrHolV α m (fderiv ℝ τ) U :=
        s2 U hU m (fderiv ℝ τ) (hτ'.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
      have hC := s4 U hU m (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ E2 E2 G) (fun x => fderiv ℝ f (τ x))
        (fderiv ℝ τ) hA hB
      have hder : ∀ x ∈ U, HasFDerivAt (fun y => f (τ y))
          (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ E2 E2 G (fderiv ℝ f (τ x)) (fderiv ℝ τ x)) x := by
        intro x hx
        have h1 := (hdf.differentiableAt (hV.mem_nhds (hτUV hx))).hasFDerivAt
        have h2 := (hdτ.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply]
        exact h1.comp x h2
      exact (s1 U hU m _).2 ⟨fun x hx => (hder x hx).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
        s3b U hU m _ _ (fun x hx => (hder x hx).fderiv.symm) hC⟩
  have hf' : pcrHolV α m f V := hf
  exact s5 m f hf'

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (m : ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ m (w n) U) (f : E2 → ℝ)
    (G : ∀ l : Fin (m + 1), E2 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ l : Fin (m + 1),
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (w n) x) (G l) atTop U)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ U, Tendsto (fun n => w n x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ m f U ∧ ∀ l : Fin (m + 1), ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ l f x = G l x

signature.name: pcr_unif_limit_iteratedFDeriv
signature.statement:
(U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (m : ℕ)
    (w : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ m (w n) U) (f : E2 → ℝ)
    (G : ∀ l : Fin (m + 1), E2 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ l : Fin (m + 1),
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n x => iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (w n) x) (G l) atTop U)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ U, Tendsto (fun n => w n x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ m f U ∧ ∀ l : Fin (m + 1), ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ l f x = G l x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcda : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℝ m (w n) x :=
    fun n x hx => (hw n).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
  
  have hstep : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 < m + 1), ∀ x ∈ U,
      HasFDerivAt (G ⟨k, by omega⟩)
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => E2) ℝ
          (G ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ x)) x := by
    intro k hk x hx
    have hfd : ∀ n y, fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (w n)) y =
        continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => E2) ℝ
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (w n) y) := by
      intro n y
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left, Function.comp_apply,
        LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have hunif : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n y => fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (w n)) y)
        (fun y => continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => E2) ℝ
          (G ⟨k + 1, hk⟩ y)) atTop U := by
      have h := UniformContinuous.comp_tendstoUniformlyOn
        (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => E2) ℝ).isometry.uniformContinuous
        (hG ⟨k + 1, hk⟩)
      have e1 : (fun n y => fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (w n)) y) = fun n =>
          (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) => E2) ℝ) ∘
            (fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (w n) y) := by
        funext n y
        exact hfd n y
      rw [e1]
      exact h
    refine hasFDerivAt_of_tendstoUniformlyOn hU hunif (fun n y hy => ?_)
      (fun y hy => (hG ⟨k, by omega⟩).tendsto_at hy) hx
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (w n)) y :=
      (hcda n y hy).differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast (show k < m by omega))
    exact hd.hasFDerivAt
  
  have hid : ∀ k (hk : k < m + 1), ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x = G ⟨k, hk⟩ x := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro hk x hx
      have h1 : Tendsto (fun n => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (w n) x) atTop (𝓝 (G ⟨0, hk⟩ x)) :=
        (hG ⟨0, hk⟩).tendsto_at hx
      have h2 : Tendsto (fun n => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 (w n) x (fun _ => 0)) atTop
          (𝓝 (G ⟨0, hk⟩ x (fun _ => 0))) :=
        ((continuous_eval_const (fun _ : Fin 0 => (0 : E2))).tendsto _).comp h1
      simp only [iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply] at h2
      have h3 := tendsto_nhds_unique (hf x hx) h2
      ext v
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply, Subsingleton.elim v (fun _ => 0)]
      exact h3
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk x hx
      have hev : iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] G ⟨k, by omega⟩ :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => ih (by omega) y hy)
      have hd := (hstep k hk x hx).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left, Function.comp_apply, hd.fderiv,
        LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hcont : ∀ k (hk : k < m + 1), ContinuousOn (G ⟨k, hk⟩) U := by
    intro k hk
    refine (hG ⟨k, hk⟩).continuousOn (Filter.Frequently.of_forall fun n => ?_)
    intro y hy
    exact ((hcda n y hy).continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv
      (by exact_mod_cast (show k ≤ m by omega))).continuousWithinAt
  refine ⟨?_, fun l x hx => hid l.val l.isLt x hx⟩
  apply contDiffOn_of_continuousOn_differentiableOn
  · intro j hj
    have hj' : j ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hj
    exact (hcont j (by omega)).congr (fun y hy =>
      (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hU hy).trans (hid j (by omega) y hy))
  · intro j hj y hy
    have hj' : j < m := by exact_mod_cast hj
    have hev : iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f =ᶠ[𝓝 y] G ⟨j, by omega⟩ :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hid j (by omega) z hz)
    have hd := (hstep j (by omega) y hy).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    exact hd.differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt.congr
      (fun z hz => iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hU hz)
      (iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen j hU hy)

signature.statement:

proof.tactics:
by
  have hHol : ((Module.finrank ℝ E2 : ℕ) : NNReal).HolderConjugate (2 : NNReal) := by
    rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    exact NNReal.HolderConjugate.two_two
  refine ⟨(eLpNormLESNormFDerivOneConst (volume : Measure E2) ((2 : NNReal) : ℝ) : ℝ),
    NNReal.coe_nonneg _, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hvc
  set K : NNReal := eLpNormLESNormFDerivOneConst (volume : Measure E2) ((2 : NNReal) : ℝ) with hK
  have hGN : eLpNorm v ((2 : NNReal) : ENNReal) volume ≤
      (K : ENNReal) * eLpNorm (fderiv ℝ v) 1 volume :=
    eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_fderiv_one (volume : Measure E2) hv hvc hHol
  set X : ℝ := ∫ x, v x ^ 2 with hXdef
  set I : ℝ := ∫ x, Real.sqrt (∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 m v x) ^ 2) with hIdef
  have hX : 0 ≤ X := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hI : 0 ≤ I := integral_nonneg (fun x => Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  
  have hB : eLpNorm v ((2 : NNReal) : ENNReal) volume = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt X) := by
    have hmem : MemLp v 2 (volume : Measure E2) := hv.continuous.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hvc
    have h2 : ((2 : NNReal) : ENNReal) = 2 := by norm_num
    rw [h2, hmem.eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm two_ne_zero ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top]
    congr 1
    have ht : (2 : ENNReal).toReal = 2 := by norm_num
    rw [ht, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, hXdef]
    congr 1
    · congr 1
      funext x
      rw [Real.rpow_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    · norm_num
  
  have hop : ∀ ℓ : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ‖ℓ‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ m : Fin 2, (ℓ (e2 m)) ^ 2) := by
    intro ℓ
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound ℓ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (fun y => ?_)
    have hy : y = y 0 • e2 0 + y 1 • e2 1 := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hly : ℓ y = y 0 * ℓ (e2 0) + y 1 * ℓ (e2 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hy]
      rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hny : ‖y‖ = Real.sqrt (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs,
        sq_abs]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hly, hny, Fin.sum_univ_two, ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
    apply Real.abs_le_sqrt
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ℓ (e2 0) * y 1 - ℓ (e2 1) * y 0)]
  
  have hC : eLpNorm (fderiv ℝ v) 1 volume ≤ ENNReal.ofReal I := by
    have hD : Continuous (fderiv ℝ v) := hv.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero
    have hDc : HasCompactSupport (fderiv ℝ v) := hvc.fderiv ℝ
    have hDi : Integrable (fderiv ℝ v) (volume : Measure E2) :=
      hD.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hDc
    rw [eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm, ← ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm hDi]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    have hgc : Continuous (fun x => Real.sqrt (∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 m v x) ^ 2)) := by
      refine Continuous.sqrt (continuous_finset_sum _ (fun m _ => ?_))
      exact (hD.clm_apply continuous_const).pow 2
    have hgs : HasCompactSupport (fun x => Real.sqrt (∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 m v x) ^ 2)) := by
      refine hDc.mono ?_
      intro x hx h0
      apply hx
      simp only [pd2]
      rw [h0]
      simp
    have hgi : Integrable (fun x => Real.sqrt (∑ m : Fin 2, (pd2 m v x) ^ 2))
        (volume : Measure E2) :=
      hgc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hgs
    rw [hIdef]
    exact integral_mono hDi.norm hgi (fun x => hop (fderiv ℝ v x))
  
  have hKC : (K : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal (K : ℝ) := (ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal).symm
  have hchain : ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt X) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((K : ℝ) * I) := by
    rw [← hB, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (NNReal.coe_nonneg K), ← hKC]
    exact hGN.trans (mul_le_mul_left' hC _)
  have hs : Real.sqrt X ≤ (K : ℝ) * I :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg K) hI)).mp hchain
  have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg X) hs 2
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hX, mul_pow] at hsq
  exact hsq

(C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hGN : ∀ v : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 v → HasCompactSupport v →

    (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ 1 u) (huc : HasCompactSupport u) (k : ℕ) :

      C ^ (2 * k) * ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ) ^ 2 * (∫ x, u x ^ 2) *
        (∑ m : Fin 2, ∫ x, (pd2 m u x) ^ 2) ^ k
