proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have diag : ∀ (Q : Fin N → (ℕ → ℕ) → Prop),
      (∀ i (ψ φ : ℕ → ℕ), Q i ψ → StrictMono φ → Q i (ψ ∘ φ)) →
      (∀ i (ψ : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono ψ → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ Q i (ψ ∘ φ)) →
      ∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ ∧ ∀ i, Q i ψ := by
    intro Q hmono hext
    have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ ∧ ∀ i : Fin N, i.val < k → Q i ψ := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => exact ⟨id, strictMono_id, fun i hi => absurd hi (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
      | succ k ih =>
        obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hQ⟩ := ih
        by_cases hk : k < N
        · obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hQk⟩ := hext ⟨k, hk⟩ ψ hψ
          refine ⟨ψ ∘ φ, hψ.comp hφ, fun i hi => ?_⟩
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hi with hlt | heq
          · exact hmono i ψ φ (hQ i hlt) hφ
          · have hik : i = ⟨k, hk⟩ := Fin.ext heq
            rw [hik]
            exact hQk
        · exact ⟨ψ, hψ, fun i _ => hQ i (lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt (not_lt.mp hk))⟩
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hQ⟩ := key N
    exact ⟨ψ, hψ, fun i => hQ i i.isLt⟩
  
  have quad : ∀ (Bq δ' : ℕ → ℝ) (M : ℝ), Tendsto δ' atTop (𝓝 0) →
      (∀ n (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ' n + 2 * t * Bq n + t ^ 2 * M) → Tendsto Bq atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro Bq δ' M hδ' hq
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    have hM1 : 0 < |M| + 1 := by positivity
    have hs0 : 0 < ε / (|M| + 1) := div_pos hε hM1
    obtain ⟨n0, hn0⟩ := Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hδ' (ε / (|M| + 1) * ε) (mul_pos hs0 hε)
    refine ⟨n0, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hq n (ε / (|M| + 1))
    have h2 := hq n (-(ε / (|M| + 1)))
    have hd := hn0 n hn
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hd ⊢
    have hd' : δ' n < ε / (|M| + 1) * ε := (abs_lt.mp hd).2
    have hsM : ε / (|M| + 1) * |M| < ε := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hM1]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg M]
    have k1 : (ε / (|M| + 1)) ^ 2 * M ≤ ε / (|M| + 1) * (ε / (|M| + 1) * |M|) := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self M) (sq_nonneg (ε / (|M| + 1)))
      nlinarith
    have k2 : ε / (|M| + 1) * (ε / (|M| + 1) * |M|) < ε / (|M| + 1) * ε :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsM hs0
    rw [abs_lt]
    constructor
    · nlinarith
    · nlinarith
  have hmain : ∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ ∧ ∀ i, ∃ (wi : E2 → ℝ) (Gi : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ),
      (∀ (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ W i → MemLp wi 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧
        ∀ k, MemLp (Gi k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      (∀ (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ W i →
        Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (u (ψ m) i x - wi x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧
      (∀ (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W i →
        ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x, wi x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, Gi k x * ζ x)) ∧
      ∀ (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W i →
        ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B i x a b * Gi b x * pd2 a ζ x = ∫ x, g i x * ζ x := by
    apply diag
    · intro i ψ φ hQ hφ
      obtain ⟨wi, Gi, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hQ
      exact ⟨wi, Gi, h1, fun L hL hLW => (h2 L hL hLW).comp hφ.tendsto_atTop, h3, h4⟩
    · intro i σ hσ
      have hUc : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (u n i) (W i) := fun n => (hu n i).continuousOn
      have hUdc : ∀ n (k : Fin 2), ContinuousOn (pd2 k (u n i)) (W i) := by
        intro n k
        have h1 := (hu n i).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (hW i) (by simp)
        exact h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
      have hint : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ W i → ContinuousOn f (W i) →
          IntegrableOn (fun x => f x ^ 2) L := by
        intro f L hL hLW hf
        exact ((hf.mono hLW).pow 2).integrableOn_compact hL
      have hbd2 : ∀ (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ W i → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n,
          (∫ x in L, (u n i x) ^ 2 ≤ C) ∧ ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x in L, (pd2 k (u n i) x) ^ 2 ≤ C := by
        intro L hL hLW
        obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd i L hL hLW
        have hsum : ∀ n, IntegrableOn
            (fun x => (u n i x) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u n i) x) ^ 2) L := by
          intro n
          exact (hint _ L hL hLW (hUc n)).add
            (integrable_finset_sum _ fun k _ => hint _ L hL hLW (hUdc n k))
        refine ⟨C, fun n => ⟨?_, fun k => ?_⟩⟩
        · refine le_trans (setIntegral_mono_on (hint _ L hL hLW (hUc n)) (hsum n)
            hL.measurableSet ?_) (hC n)
          intro x _
          have : 0 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u n i) x) ^ 2 :=
            Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => sq_nonneg _
          linarith
        · refine le_trans (setIntegral_mono_on (hint _ L hL hLW (hUdc n k)) (hsum n)
            hL.measurableSet ?_) (hC n)
          intro x _
          have h1 : (pd2 k (u n i) x) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k' : Fin 2, (pd2 k' (u n i) x) ^ 2 :=
            Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k' => (pd2 k' (u n i) x) ^ 2)
              (fun k' _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ k)
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u n i x)]
      
      obtain ⟨ψ₁, hψ₁, hcau⟩ := rellich_local_cauchy (W i) (hW i) (fun n => u (σ n) i)
        (fun n => hu (σ n) i)
        (fun L hL hLW => by
          obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd i L hL hLW
          exact ⟨C, fun n => hC (σ n)⟩)
      
      obtain ⟨w, hwL2, hwconv⟩ := l2loc_limit_of_cauchy (W i) (hW i)
        (fun m => u (σ (ψ₁ m)) i) (fun m => hUc _)
        (fun L hL hLW => by
          obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd2 L hL hLW
          exact ⟨C, fun m => (hC (σ (ψ₁ m))).1⟩) hcau
      
      obtain ⟨ψ₂, G, hψ₂, hGL2, hGw⟩ := l2loc_weak_subseq (W i) (hW i)
        (fun m k => pd2 k (u (σ (ψ₁ m)) i)) (fun m k => hUdc _ k)
        (fun L hL hLW => by
          obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hbd2 L hL hLW
          exact ⟨C, fun m k => (hC (σ (ψ₁ m))).2 k⟩)
      have hφ : StrictMono (ψ₁ ∘ ψ₂) := hψ₁.comp hψ₂
      have hconv : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W i →
          Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
        fun L hL hLW => (hwconv L hL hLW).comp hψ₂.tendsto_atTop
      
      have hdζ : ∀ (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → ∀ k : Fin 2,
          Continuous (pd2 k ζ) ∧ tsupport (pd2 k ζ) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
        intro ζ hζ k
        refine ⟨(hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const, ?_⟩
        refine closure_minimal (fun x hx => ?_) (isClosed_tsupport ζ)
        refine tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ (subset_tsupport _ ?_)
        rw [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
        intro h0
        apply hx
        simp [pd2, h0]
      refine ⟨ψ₁ ∘ ψ₂, hφ, w, G, fun L hL hLW => ⟨hwL2 L hL hLW, fun k => hGL2 L hL hLW k⟩,
        hconv, ?_, ?_⟩
      · 
        intro ζ hζ hζc hζW k
        have hLc : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc
        obtain ⟨hs7i, -, hs7iii⟩ := l2_compact_pairing (tsupport ζ) hLc
        obtain ⟨hdζc, hdζs⟩ := hdζ ζ hζ k
        have hUL : ∀ m, MemLp (u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i) 2 (volume.restrict (tsupport ζ)) :=
          fun m => hs7i _ ((hUc _).mono hζW)
        have hlim1 : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i x * pd2 k ζ x) atTop
            (𝓝 (∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x)) :=
          hs7iii (fun m => u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i) w (pd2 k ζ) hUL (hwL2 _ hLc hζW) hdζc hdζs
            (hconv _ hLc hζW)
        have hlim2 : Tendsto (fun m => -(∫ x, pd2 k (u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i) x * ζ x)) atTop
            (𝓝 (-(∫ x, G k x * ζ x))) :=
          (hGw k ζ hζ.continuous hζc hζW).neg
        have heq : (fun m => ∫ x, u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i x * pd2 k ζ x) =
            fun m => -(∫ x, pd2 k (u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i) x * ζ x) := by
          funext m
          exact ibp_open_test (W i) (hW i) _ (hu _ i) ζ hζ hζc hζW k
        rw [heq] at hlim1
        exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlim1 hlim2
      · 
        intro ζ hζ hζc hζW
        have hLc : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc
        obtain ⟨hs7i, hs7ii, -⟩ := l2_compact_pairing (tsupport ζ) hLc
        
        have hα : ∀ a b : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => B i x a b * pd2 a ζ x) ∧
            tsupport (fun x => B i x a b * pd2 a ζ x) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
          intro a b
          obtain ⟨hdc, hds⟩ := hdζ ζ hζ a
          have hs : tsupport (fun x => B i x a b * pd2 a ζ x) ⊆ tsupport ζ :=
            (tsupport_mul_subset_right).trans hds
          exact ⟨((hB i a b).mul hdc.continuousOn).continuous_of_tsupport_subset (hW i)
            (hs.trans hζW), hs⟩
        have hαcs : ∀ a b : Fin 2, HasCompactSupport (fun x => B i x a b * pd2 a ζ x) :=
          fun a b => hLc.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) (hα a b).2
        obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hEL i ζ hζ hζc hζW
        have hsplit : ∀ (P : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ),
            (∀ b, MemLp (P b) 2 (volume.restrict (tsupport ζ))) →
            ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B i x a b * P b x * pd2 a ζ x
            = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∫ x, P b x * (B i x a b * pd2 a ζ x) := by
          intro P hP
          have hI : ∀ a b : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => P b x * (B i x a b * pd2 a ζ x)) :=
            fun a b => hs7ii _ _ (hP b) (hα a b).1 (hα a b).2
          have hpt : (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B i x a b * P b x * pd2 a ζ x)
              = fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, P b x * (B i x a b * pd2 a ζ x) := by
            funext x
            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring
          rw [hpt]
          exact (integral_finset_sum _ fun a _ =>
              integrable_finset_sum _ fun b _ => hI a b).trans
            (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => integral_finset_sum _ fun b _ => hI a b)
        have hB0 : Tendsto (fun m => (∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B i x a b *
              pd2 b (u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i) x * pd2 a ζ x) - ∫ x, g i x * ζ x) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
          quad _ (fun m => δ (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m)))) M (hδ.comp (hσ.comp hφ).tendsto_atTop)
            (fun m t => hM (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) t)
        have hdUL : ∀ m (b : Fin 2),
            MemLp (pd2 b (u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i)) 2 (volume.restrict (tsupport ζ)) :=
          fun m b => hs7i _ ((hUdc _ b).mono hζW)
        have hBE : Tendsto (fun m => (∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B i x a b *
              pd2 b (u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i) x * pd2 a ζ x) - ∫ x, g i x * ζ x) atTop
            (𝓝 ((∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∫ x, G b x * (B i x a b * pd2 a ζ x))
              - ∫ x, g i x * ζ x)) := by
          have e1 : (fun m => (∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B i x a b *
                pd2 b (u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i) x * pd2 a ζ x) - ∫ x, g i x * ζ x) =
              fun m => (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∫ x, pd2 b (u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i) x *
                  (B i x a b * pd2 a ζ x)) - ∫ x, g i x * ζ x := by
            funext m
            rw [hsplit (fun b => pd2 b (u (σ (ψ₁ (ψ₂ m))) i)) (hdUL m)]
          rw [e1]
          refine Tendsto.sub (tendsto_finset_sum _ fun a _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ fun b _ => ?_)
            tendsto_const_nhds
          exact hGw b _ (hα a b).1 (hαcs a b) ((hα a b).2.trans hζW)
        have hE0 := tendsto_nhds_unique hBE hB0
        rw [hsplit G (fun b => hGL2 _ hLc hζW b)]
        linarith
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hQ⟩ := hmain
  choose w G hw using hQ
  exact ⟨ψ, w, G, hψ, fun i L hL hLW => (hw i).1 L hL hLW, fun i => (hw i).2.1,
    fun i => (hw i).2.2.1, fun i => (hw i).2.2.2⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: rellich_local_cauchy
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (u : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hu : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u n) W) (hbd : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n, ∫ x in L, ((u n x) ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (u n) x) ^ 2) ≤ C) : ∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ψ ∧ ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l → ∫ x in L, (u (ψ m) x - u (ψ l) x) ^ 2 < ε

subgoal_signatures.name: l2loc_limit_of_cauchy
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hv : ∀ m, ContinuousOn (v m) W) (hbd : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ m, ∫ x in L, (v m x) ^ 2 ≤ C) (hcauchy : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l → ∫ x in L, (v m x - v l x) ^ 2 < ε) : ∃ w : E2 → ℝ, (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: l2loc_weak_subseq
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (f : ℕ → Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (hf : ∀ n k, ContinuousOn (f n k) W) (hbd : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n k, ∫ x in L, (f n k x) ^ 2 ≤ C) : ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ ∀ k (φ : E2 → ℝ), Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ W → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, f (ψ m) k x * φ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, G k x * φ x))

subgoal_signatures.name: ibp_open_test
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ) (hζW : tsupport ζ ⊆ W) (k : Fin 2) : ∫ x, u x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, pd2 k u x * ζ x)

subgoal_signatures.name: l2_compact_pairing
subgoal_signatures.statement: (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) : (∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f L → MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ f φ : E2 → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L → Integrable (fun x => f x * φ x)) ∧ ∀ (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (w φ : E2 → ℝ), (∀ m, MemLp (v m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) → MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, v m x * φ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, w x * φ x))

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (v : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ m j, ContinuousOn (fun x => v m (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (w : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j → MemLp (w j) 2 (volume.restrict L))
    (hconv : ∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j →
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m (P.param j x) - w j x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ j k, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k)),
      w j x = w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))

signature.name: pcr_dw_limit_compat
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (v : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ m j, ContinuousOn (fun x => v m (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (w : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j → MemLp (w j) 2 (volume.restrict L))
    (hconv : ∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j →
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m (P.param j x) - w j x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ j k, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k)),
      w j x = w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hD : ∀ i, (∀ x ∈ P.W i, 0 < Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det) (P.W i) := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨fun x hx => Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (P.h_posDef i x hx).det_pos, ?_⟩
    have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => P.h i x a b) (P.W i) :=
      fun a b => (P.h_smooth i a b).continuousOn
    have e : (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det) =
        fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h i x 0 0 * P.h i x 1 1 - P.h i x 0 1 * P.h i x 1 0) := by
      funext x; rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
    rw [e]
    exact (((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).sub ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0))).sqrt
  
  have hexh : ∀ V : Set E2, IsOpen V → ∀ p : E2 → Prop,
      (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ V → ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict L), p x) →
      ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict V), p x := by
    intro V hV p hp
    obtain ⟨F, hFc, hFV, hFU, hFm⟩ := hV.exists_iUnion_isClosed
    have hLU : (⋃ n : ℕ, F n ∩ Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) n) = V := by
      apply Set.Subset.antisymm
      · exact Set.iUnion_subset fun n => Set.inter_subset_left.trans (hFV n)
      · intro x hx
        rw [← hFU] at hx
        obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hx
        obtain ⟨n₂, hn₂⟩ := exists_nat_ge ‖x‖
        refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨max n₁ n₂, hFm (le_max_left _ _) hn₁, ?_⟩
        rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
        exact hn₂.trans (by exact_mod_cast le_max_right n₁ n₂)
    rw [← hLU, ae_restrict_iUnion_iff]
    intro n
    exact hp _ ((isCompact_closedBall (0 : E2) n).inter_left (hFc n))
      (Set.inter_subset_left.trans (hFV n))
  intro j k
  have hUo : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
    ContinuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (P.param_cont j) (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)
  have hτc : ContinuousOn (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
    (P.trans_smooth j k).continuousOn
  
  have hT : ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j ∧
        P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) = P.param j x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxW, hxO⟩ := hx
    have h1 : P.param j x ∈ P.O j ∩ S := by
      rw [← P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨x, hxW, rfl⟩
    have h2 : P.param j x ∈ P.param k '' P.W k := by
      rw [P.image_eq k]; exact ⟨hxO, h1.2⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := h2
    have hτy : P.proj k (P.param j x) = y := by rw [← hyx, P.proj_param k y hy]
    rw [hτy]
    refine ⟨⟨hy, ?_⟩, hyx⟩
    show P.param k y ∈ P.O j
    rw [hyx]; exact h1.1
  
  have htrans : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k →
      ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ g : E2 → ℝ,
        MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict ((fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' L)) →
        MemLp (fun x => g (P.proj k (P.param j x))) 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧
        ∫ x in L, g (P.proj k (P.param j x)) ^ 2 ≤
          C * ∫ y in (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' L, g y ^ 2 := by
    intro L hL hLU
    have hTc : IsCompact ((fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' L) :=
      hL.image_of_continuousOn (hτc.mono hLU)
    have hTU' : (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' L ⊆ P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact (hT x (hLU hx)).1
    have hmemT : ∀ x ∈ L, P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' L :=
      fun x hx => Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx
    generalize (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' L = T at hTc hTU' hmemT ⊢
    have hTW : T ⊆ P.W k := hTU'.trans Set.inter_subset_left
    have hLW : L ⊆ P.W j := hLU.trans Set.inter_subset_left
    have hLm : MeasurableSet L := hL.measurableSet
    have hTm : MeasurableSet T := hTc.measurableSet
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict T) :=
      isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 hTc.measure_lt_top.ne
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hTc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn ((hD k).2.mono hTW)
    have hM₀ : ∀ y ∈ T, Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det ≤ max M 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have h := hM y hy
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h.trans (le_max_left _ _))
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hμL⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ, 0 < μ ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, μ ≤ Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
      rcases L.eq_empty_or_nonempty with he | hne
      · exact ⟨1, one_pos, by simp [he]⟩
      · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hmin⟩ := hL.exists_isMinOn hne ((hD j).2.mono hLW)
        exact ⟨_, (hD j).1 x₀ (hLW hx₀), fun x hx => hmin hx⟩
    
    have hpull : ∀ G : E2 → ℝ, IntegrableOn G T →
        IntegrableOn (fun x => T.indicator G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) ∧
        IntegrableOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) L ∧
        IntegrableOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x))) L := by
      intro G hG
      have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) T :=
        hG.mul_continuousOn ((hD k).2.mono hTW) hTc
      have h2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => T.indicator G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det)
          (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j) := by
        have e : (fun y => T.indicator G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) =
            T.indicator (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) := by
          funext y; rw [Set.indicator_mul_left]
        rw [e]
        exact ((integrable_indicator_iff hTm).2 h1).integrableOn
      have h3 := (eig_chart_cov S P j k (T.indicator G)).2.2 h2
      have h4 : IntegrableOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) L := by
        refine (h3.mono_set hLU).congr_fun (fun x hx => ?_) hLm
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (hmemT x hx)]
      refine ⟨h3, h4, ?_⟩
      have h5 := h4.mul_continuousOn
        (((hD j).2.mono hLW).inv₀ (fun x hx => ((hD j).1 x (hLW hx)).ne')) hL
      refine h5.congr_fun (fun x hx => ?_) hLm
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ ((hD j).1 x (hLW hx)).ne', mul_one]
    refine ⟨max M 0 / μ, div_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) hμ.le, fun g hg => ?_⟩
    have hgi : IntegrableOn g T := hg.integrable (by norm_num)
    have hg2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => g y ^ 2) T := hg.integrable_sq
    obtain ⟨-, -, hgτ⟩ := hpull g hgi
    obtain ⟨hU2, hint2, hgτ2⟩ := hpull (fun y => g y ^ 2) hg2
    have hmem : MemLp (fun x => g (P.proj k (P.param j x))) 2 (volume.restrict L) :=
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hgτ.aestronglyMeasurable).2 hgτ2
    refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
    have e1 : μ * ∫ x in L, g (P.proj k (P.param j x)) ^ 2 =
        ∫ x in L, μ * g (P.proj k (P.param j x)) ^ 2 := (integral_const_mul _ _).symm
    have e2 : ∫ x in L, μ * g (P.proj k (P.param j x)) ^ 2 ≤
        ∫ x in L, g (P.proj k (P.param j x)) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
      refine setIntegral_mono_on (hgτ2.const_mul μ) hint2 hLm (fun x hx => ?_)
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hμL x hx) (sq_nonneg (g (P.proj k (P.param j x))))]
    have e3 : ∫ x in L, g (P.proj k (P.param j x)) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det =
        ∫ x in L, T.indicator (fun y => g y ^ 2) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hLm (fun x hx => ?_)
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (hmemT x hx)]
    have e4 : ∫ x in L, T.indicator (fun y => g y ^ 2) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det ≤
        ∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, T.indicator (fun y => g y ^ 2)
          (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
      refine setIntegral_mono_set hU2 (ae_of_all _ (fun x => ?_)) hLU.eventuallyLE
      exact mul_nonneg (Set.indicator_nonneg (fun y _ => sq_nonneg (g y)) _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have e5 := (eig_chart_cov S P j k (T.indicator (fun y => g y ^ 2))).1
    have e6 : ∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, T.indicator (fun y => g y ^ 2) y *
          Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det =
        ∫ y in T, g y ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det := by
      have e : (fun y => T.indicator (fun y => g y ^ 2) y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) =
          T.indicator (fun y => g y ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) := by
        funext y; rw [Set.indicator_mul_left]
      rw [e, setIntegral_indicator hTm, Set.inter_eq_right.mpr hTU']
    have e7 : ∫ y in T, g y ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det ≤ ∫ y in T, max M 0 * g y ^ 2 := by
      refine setIntegral_mono_on (hg2.mul_continuousOn ((hD k).2.mono hTW) hTc)
        (hg2.const_mul _) hTm (fun y hy => ?_)
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM₀ y hy) (sq_nonneg (g y))]
    have e8 : ∫ y in T, max M 0 * g y ^ 2 = max M 0 * ∫ y in T, g y ^ 2 :=
      integral_const_mul _ _
    have hfin : μ * ∫ x in L, g (P.proj k (P.param j x)) ^ 2 ≤
        max M 0 * ∫ y in T, g y ^ 2 := by
      rw [e1]
      calc _ ≤ _ := e2
        _ = _ := e3
        _ ≤ _ := e4
        _ = _ := e5
        _ = _ := e6
        _ ≤ _ := e7
        _ = _ := e8
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hμ]
    linarith
  
  refine hexh _ hUo (fun x => w j x = w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ?_
  intro L hL hLU
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hCg⟩ := htrans L hL hLU
  have hLW : L ⊆ P.W j := hLU.trans Set.inter_subset_left
  have hTc : IsCompact ((fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' L) :=
    hL.image_of_continuousOn (hτc.mono hLU)
  have hTW : (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' L ⊆ P.W k := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact (hT x (hLU hx)).1.1
  have hLm : MeasurableSet L := hL.measurableSet
  have hwk := hw k _ hTc hTW
  have hb : MemLp (fun x => w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) 2 (volume.restrict L) :=
    (hCg _ hwk).1
  have hwj := hw j L hL hLW
  have ha : ∀ m, MemLp (fun x => v m (P.param j x)) 2 (volume.restrict L) :=
    fun m => (l2_compact_pairing L hL).1 _ ((hv m j).mono hLW)
  have i0 : Integrable (fun x => (w j x - w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ^ 2)
      (volume.restrict L) := (hwj.sub hb).integrable_sq
  have hbound : ∀ m, ∫ x in L, (w j x - w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ^ 2 ≤
      2 * (∫ x in L, (v m (P.param j x) - w j x) ^ 2) +
        2 * (C * ∫ y in (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' L,
          (v m (P.param k y) - w k y) ^ 2) := by
    intro m
    have hgm : MemLp (fun y => v m (P.param k y) - w k y) 2
        (volume.restrict ((fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' L)) :=
      ((l2_compact_pairing _ hTc).1 _ ((hv m k).mono hTW)).sub hwk
    have h3 := (hCg _ hgm).2
    have e : ∫ x in L, (v m (P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) -
          w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ^ 2 =
        ∫ x in L, (v m (P.param j x) - w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ^ 2 := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hLm (fun x hx => ?_)
      rw [(hT x (hLU hx)).2]
    have i1 : Integrable (fun x => (v m (P.param j x) - w j x) ^ 2) (volume.restrict L) :=
      ((ha m).sub hwj).integrable_sq
    have i2 : Integrable (fun x => (v m (P.param j x) - w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ^ 2)
        (volume.restrict L) := ((ha m).sub hb).integrable_sq
    have hmono : ∫ x in L, (w j x - w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ^ 2 ≤
        ∫ x in L, (2 * (v m (P.param j x) - w j x) ^ 2 +
          2 * (v m (P.param j x) - w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ^ 2) := by
      refine integral_mono i0 ((i1.const_mul 2).add (i2.const_mul 2)) (fun x => ?_)
      simp only
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * v m (P.param j x) - w j x - w k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))]
    rw [integral_add (i1.const_mul 2) (i2.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul] at hmono
    simp only at h3
    rw [e] at h3
    linarith
  have hI0 : ∫ x in L, (w j x - w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · have hlim : Tendsto (fun m => 2 * (∫ x in L, (v m (P.param j x) - w j x) ^ 2) +
          2 * (C * ∫ y in (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' L,
            (v m (P.param k y) - w k y) ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 (2 * 0 + 2 * (C * 0))) :=
        ((hconv j L hL hLW).const_mul 2).add (((hconv k _ hTc hTW).const_mul C).const_mul 2)
      rw [show (2 : ℝ) * 0 + 2 * (C * 0) = 0 by ring] at hlim
      exact ge_of_tendsto' hlim hbound
    · exact setIntegral_nonneg hLm (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hae := (setIntegral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae
    (ae_of_all _ (fun x => sq_nonneg (w j x - w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))))) i0).1 hI0
  filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
  have hx' : (w j x - w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ^ 2 = 0 := hx
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 ((pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).1 hx')

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_chart_cov
subgoal_signatures.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (j k : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ) : (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) = (∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) ∧ (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j) MeasureTheory.volume)

subgoal_signatures.name: l2_compact_pairing
subgoal_signatures.statement: (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) : (∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f L → MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ f φ : E2 → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L → Integrable (fun x => f x * φ x)) ∧ ∀ (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (w φ : E2 → ℝ), (∀ m, MemLp (v m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) → MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, v m x * φ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, w x * φ x))

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (s : ℝ)
    (Ψ : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ {z | z.1 ∈ W ∧ |z.2.1| < s}) (l : ℕ) :
    ∃ Φ : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (l + 2 + 1), ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) →
        ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ {z | z.1 ∈ W ∧ ‖z.2 ⟨0, by omega⟩‖ < s} ∧
      ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → U ⊆ W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (l + 2 : ℕ) w U → (∀ x ∈ U, |w x| < s) →
        ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => Ψ (y, w y, fderiv ℝ w y, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) y)) x =
          Φ (x, fun r => iteratedFDeriv ℝ r w x)

signature.name: pcr_nem_jet_formula
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (s : ℝ)
    (Ψ : E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ {z | z.1 ∈ W ∧ |z.2.1| < s}) (l : ℕ) :
    ∃ Φ : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (l + 2 + 1), ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) →
        ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin l => E2) ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ {z | z.1 ∈ W ∧ ‖z.2 ⟨0, by omega⟩‖ < s} ∧
      ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → U ⊆ W →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (l + 2 : ℕ) w U → (∀ x ∈ U, |w x| < s) →
        ∀ x ∈ U, iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => Ψ (y, w y, fderiv ℝ w y, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) y)) x =
          Φ (x, fun r => iteratedFDeriv ℝ r w x)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hDomOpen : ∀ n : ℕ, IsOpen {z : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (n + 1),
      ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) | z.1 ∈ W ∧ ‖z.2 ⟨0, by omega⟩‖ < s} :=
    fun n => (hW.preimage continuous_fst).inter
      (isOpen_lt ((continuous_apply _).comp continuous_snd).norm continuous_const)
  have hjet : ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), ContDiffAt ℝ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) w x →
      HasFDerivAt (fun y => (fun r : Fin (n + 1) => iteratedFDeriv ℝ r w y :
        ∀ r : Fin (n + 1), ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun r : Fin (n + 1) =>
        continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin ((r : ℕ) + 1) => E2) ℝ
          (iteratedFDeriv ℝ ((r : ℕ) + 1) w x)) x := by
    intro n w x hw
    refine (hasFDerivAt_pi (φ := fun r : Fin (n + 1) => iteratedFDeriv ℝ (r : ℕ) w)).2 fun r => ?_
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ r w) x :=
      hw.differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast r.isLt)
    have h := hd.hasFDerivAt
    rw [fderiv_iteratedFDeriv] at h
    exact h
  induction l with
  | zero =>
    let e0 := continuousMultilinearCurryFin0 ℝ E2 ℝ
    let e1 := continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 ℝ E2 ℝ
    let cL1 := continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin 2 => E2) ℝ
    let Λ : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (0 + 2 + 1), ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) →
        E2 × ℝ × (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) × (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
      fun z => (z.1, e0 (z.2 ⟨0, by omega⟩), e1 (z.2 ⟨1, by omega⟩),
        (e1.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap).comp (cL1 (z.2 ⟨2, by omega⟩)))
    have hΛ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Λ := by
      refine contDiff_fst.prodMk (ContDiff.prodMk ?_ (ContDiff.prodMk ?_ ?_))
      · exact e0.contDiff.comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ)
          (φ := fun r : Fin (0 + 2 + 1) => ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ)
          ⟨0, by omega⟩).contDiff.comp contDiff_snd)
      · exact e1.contDiff.comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ)
          (φ := fun r : Fin (0 + 2 + 1) => ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ)
          ⟨1, by omega⟩).contDiff.comp contDiff_snd)
      · have hcl1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ cL1 := by
          set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
          exact LinearIsometryEquiv.contDiff _
        have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (0 + 2 + 1),
            ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) => cL1 (z.2 ⟨2, by omega⟩)) :=
          hcl1.comp ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ)
          (φ := fun r : Fin (0 + 2 + 1) => ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ)
          ⟨2, by omega⟩).contDiff.comp contDiff_snd)
        exact contDiff_const.clm_comp h2
    refine ⟨fun z => e0.symm (Ψ (Λ z)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine e0.symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hΨ.comp hΛ.contDiffOn ?_)
      intro z hz
      refine ⟨hz.1, ?_⟩
      show |e0 (z.2 ⟨0, by omega⟩)| < s
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map]
      exact hz.2
    · intro w U hU hUW hw hws x hx
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_zero_eq_comp, Function.comp_apply]
      congr 2
      show (x, w x, fderiv ℝ w x, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) x) =
        (x, e0 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 w x), e1 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 w x),
          (e1.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap).comp (cL1 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 w x)))
      refine Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext ?_ (Prod.ext ?_ ?_))
      · simp [e0]
      · ext v
        simp [e1, iteratedFDeriv_one_apply, Fin.snoc]
      · ext a b
        simp [e1, cL1, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply, Fin.snoc]
  | succ l ih =>
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦs, hΦr⟩ := ih
    let cL := continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin (l + 1) => E2) ℝ
    let A : (∀ r : Fin (l + 1 + 2 + 1), ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) →
        (E2 →L[ℝ] E2 × (∀ r : Fin (l + 2 + 1), ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ)) :=
      fun j => (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2).prod (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun r : Fin (l + 2 + 1) =>
        continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin ((r : ℕ) + 1) => E2) ℝ (j r.succ))
    let π : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (l + 1 + 2 + 1), ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) →
        E2 × (∀ r : Fin (l + 2 + 1), ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) :=
      fun z => (z.1, fun r => z.2 (Fin.castSucc r))
    refine ⟨fun z => cL.symm ((fderiv ℝ Φ (π z)).comp (A z.2)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ π := by
        refine contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_pi.2 fun r => ?_)
        exact (ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ)
          (φ := fun r : Fin (l + 1 + 2 + 1) => ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ)
          (Fin.castSucc r)).contDiff.comp contDiff_snd
      have hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (l + 1 + 2 + 1),
          ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) => A z.2) := by
        refine contDiff_clm_apply_iff.2 fun h => ?_
        refine contDiff_const.prodMk (contDiff_pi.2 fun r => ?_)
        have hcl : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ
            (fun _ : Fin ((r : ℕ) + 1) => E2) ℝ) := by
          set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
          exact LinearIsometryEquiv.contDiff _
        have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (l + 1 + 2 + 1),
            ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) =>
            continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin ((r : ℕ) + 1) => E2) ℝ (z.2 r.succ)) :=
          hcl.comp
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj (R := ℝ)
            (φ := fun r : Fin (l + 1 + 2 + 1) => ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ)
            r.succ).contDiff.comp contDiff_snd)
        exact hc.clm_apply contDiff_const
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo π {z : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (l + 1 + 2 + 1),
          ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) | z.1 ∈ W ∧ ‖z.2 ⟨0, by omega⟩‖ < s}
          {z : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (l + 2 + 1),
          ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) | z.1 ∈ W ∧ ‖z.2 ⟨0, by omega⟩‖ < s} :=
        fun z hz => hz
      have hg := (hΦs.fderiv_of_isOpen (hDomOpen (l + 2)) (m := ∞) le_rfl).comp hπ.contDiffOn hmaps
      exact cL.symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hg.clm_comp hA.contDiffOn)
    · intro w U hU hUW hw hws x hx
      have hw2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ((l + 2 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) w U :=
        hw.of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : l + 2 ≤ l + 1 + 2))
      have hIH := hΦr w U hU hUW hw2 hws
      have hev : iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => Ψ (y, w y, fderiv ℝ w y, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ w) y))
          =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => Φ (y, fun r => iteratedFDeriv ℝ r w y) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) hIH
      have hwx : ContDiffAt ℝ ((l + 2 + 1 : ℕ) : WithTop ℕ∞) w x := hw.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
      have hJ := hjet (l + 2) w x hwx
      have hp : (x, fun r : Fin (l + 2 + 1) => iteratedFDeriv ℝ r w x) ∈
          {z : E2 × (∀ r : Fin (l + 2 + 1),
          ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => E2) ℝ) | z.1 ∈ W ∧ ‖z.2 ⟨0, by omega⟩‖ < s} := by
        refine ⟨hUW hx, ?_⟩
        show ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 w x‖ < s
        rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hws x hx
      have hΦd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (x, fun r : Fin (l + 2 + 1) => iteratedFDeriv ℝ r w x) :=
        (hΦs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt ((hDomOpen (l + 2)).mem_nhds hp)
      have hchain : HasFDerivAt (fun y => Φ (y, fun r : Fin (l + 2 + 1) => iteratedFDeriv ℝ r w y))
          ((fderiv ℝ Φ (x, fun r : Fin (l + 2 + 1) => iteratedFDeriv ℝ r w x)).comp
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2).prod (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun r : Fin (l + 2 + 1) =>
              continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin ((r : ℕ) + 1) => E2) ℝ
                (iteratedFDeriv ℝ ((r : ℕ) + 1) w x)))) x :=
        hΦd.hasFDerivAt.comp x ((hasFDerivAt_id x).prodMk hJ)
      rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_eq_comp_left, Function.comp_apply, hev.fderiv_eq, hchain.fderiv]
      rfl

informal_problem.statement:
{Z E V G : Type} [TopologicalSpace Z] [CompactSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
    (π : C(Z, E)) (O : Set (E × V)) (hO : IsOpen O) (F : E × V → G) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F O) :
    IsOpen {g : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V | ∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O} ∧
    ∃ N : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V → BoundedContinuousFunction Z G,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ N {g | ∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O} ∧
      ∀ g : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V, (∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O) → ∀ z, N g z = F (π z, g z)

signature.name: pcr_nem_omega
signature.statement:
{Z E V G : Type} [TopologicalSpace Z] [CompactSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
    (π : C(Z, E)) (O : Set (E × V)) (hO : IsOpen O) (F : E × V → G) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F O) :
    IsOpen {g : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V | ∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O} ∧
    ∃ N : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V → BoundedContinuousFunction Z G,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ N {g | ∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O} ∧
      ∀ g : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V, (∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O) → ∀ z, N g z = F (π z, g z)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set U : Set (BoundedContinuousFunction Z V) := {g | ∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O} with hUdef
  
  have tube : ∀ g : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V, (∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O) →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ (z : Z) (v : V), dist v (g z) < δ → (π z, v) ∈ O := by
    intro g hg
    have hc : Continuous (fun z => (π z, g z)) := π.continuous.prodMk g.continuous
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hsub⟩ := (isCompact_range hc).exists_thickening_subset_open hO
      (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hg)
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun z v hv => hsub ?_⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
    refine ⟨(π z, g z), Set.mem_range_self z, ?_⟩
    rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self, max_eq_right dist_nonneg]
    exact hv
  
  have hUo : IsOpen U := by
    rw [Metric.isOpen_iff]
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, ht⟩ := tube g hg
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun g' hg' z => ht z _ ?_⟩
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (BoundedContinuousFunction.dist_coe_le_dist z) hg'
  
  have opEx : ∀ (G' : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup G'] [NormedSpace ℝ G'] (F' : E × V → G'),
      ContinuousOn F' O → ∃ N : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V → BoundedContinuousFunction Z G',
        ∀ g ∈ U, ∀ z, N g z = F' (π z, g z) := by
    intro G' _ _ F' hF'
    refine ⟨fun g => if h : (∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O) then
      BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact ⟨fun z => F' (π z, g z),
        hF'.comp_continuous (π.continuous.prodMk g.continuous) h⟩ else 0, ?_⟩
    intro g hg z
    have hg' : ∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O := hg
    simp only [dif_pos hg']
    rfl
  
  have Mex : ∀ (G' : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup G'] [NormedSpace ℝ G'],
      ∃ M : BoundedContinuousFunction Z (V →L[ℝ] G') →L[ℝ] BoundedContinuousFunction Z V →L[ℝ]
        BoundedContinuousFunction Z G', ∀ a b z, M a b z = a z (b z) := by
    intro G' _ _
    have key : ∀ (C : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup C] [NormedSpace ℝ C] (β : C →L[ℝ] V →L[ℝ] G'),
        ∃ M : BoundedContinuousFunction Z C →L[ℝ] BoundedContinuousFunction Z V →L[ℝ]
          BoundedContinuousFunction Z G', ∀ a b z, M a b z = β (a z) (b z) := by
      intro C _ _ β
      have hb : ∀ (a : BoundedContinuousFunction Z C)
          (b : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V) (z : Z),
          ‖β (a z) (b z)‖ ≤ ‖β‖ * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ := by
        intro a b z
        calc ‖β (a z) (b z)‖ ≤ ‖β‖ * ‖a z‖ * ‖b z‖ := β.le_opNorm₂ _ _
          _ ≤ ‖β‖ * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ := by
            gcongr
            · exact a.norm_coe_le_norm z
            · exact b.norm_coe_le_norm z
      let app : BoundedContinuousFunction Z C → BoundedContinuousFunction Z V →
          BoundedContinuousFunction Z G' := fun a b =>
        BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup (fun z => β (a z) (b z))
          ((β.continuous.comp a.continuous).clm_apply b.continuous) (‖β‖ * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖)
          (hb a b)
      have happ : ∀ a b z, app a b z = β (a z) (b z) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
      let L := LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ app
        (fun a₁ a₂ b => by
          ext z
          simp only [happ, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply, map_add,
            ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply])
        (fun c a b => by
          ext z
          simp only [happ, BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, map_smul,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply])
        (fun a b₁ b₂ => by
          ext z
          simp only [happ, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply, map_add])
        (fun c a b => by
          ext z
          simp only [happ, BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, map_smul])
      have hbound : ∀ a b, ‖L a b‖ ≤ ‖β‖ * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ := by
        intro a b
        exact BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_ofNormedAddCommGroup_le _
          (by positivity) (hb a b)
      exact ⟨L.mkContinuous₂ ‖β‖ hbound, fun a b z => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := key (V →L[ℝ] G') (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (V →L[ℝ] G'))
    exact ⟨M, fun a b z => by rw [hM]; rfl⟩
  
  have hderiv : ∀ (G' : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup G'] [NormedSpace ℝ G'] (F' : E × V → G'),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F' O →
      ∀ N : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V → BoundedContinuousFunction Z G',
      (∀ g ∈ U, ∀ z, N g z = F' (π z, g z)) →
      ∀ M : BoundedContinuousFunction Z (V →L[ℝ] G') →L[ℝ] BoundedContinuousFunction Z V →L[ℝ]
        BoundedContinuousFunction Z G', (∀ a b z, M a b z = a z (b z)) →
      ∀ g ∈ U, ∀ Dg : BoundedContinuousFunction Z (V →L[ℝ] G'),
      (∀ z, Dg z = (fderiv ℝ F' (π z, g z)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E V)) →
      HasFDerivAt N (M Dg) g := by
    intro G' _ _ F' hF' N hN M hM g hg Dg hDg
    have hg' : ∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O := hg
    obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, ht⟩ := tube g hg'
    obtain ⟨hFd, hFds⟩ := (contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hF'
    set D2 : E × V → V →L[ℝ] G' :=
      fun y => (fderiv ℝ F' y).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E V) with hD2
    have hD2c : ContinuousOn D2 O := hFds.continuousOn.clm_comp continuousOn_const
    have hc : Continuous (fun z => (π z, g z)) := π.continuous.prodMk g.continuous
    have hC := isCompact_range hc
    rw [hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero, Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
    intro ε hε
    have hent := hC.uniformContinuousAt_of_continuousAt D2
      (fun a ha => by
        obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ha
        exact hD2c.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds (hg' z)))
      (Metric.dist_mem_uniformity hε)
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hu⟩ := Metric.mem_uniformity_dist.1 hent
    have hδ : 0 < min δ₀ δ₁ := lt_min hδ₀ hδ₁
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V) hδ] with h hh
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hh
    have hhz : ∀ z, ‖h z‖ < min δ₀ δ₁ := fun z => lt_of_le_of_lt (h.norm_coe_le_norm z) hh
    have hgh : ∀ z, (π z, (g + h) z) ∈ O := by
      intro z
      apply ht
      rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hhz z) (min_le_left _ _)
    show ‖N (g + h) - N g - M Dg h‖ ≤ ε * ‖h‖
    refine (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (by positivity)).2 (fun z => ?_)
    simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
    rw [hN _ hgh z, hN g hg z, hM, BoundedContinuousFunction.coe_add, Pi.add_apply]
    have hφd : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (g z) (min δ₀ δ₁),
        HasFDerivWithinAt (fun v => F' (π z, v) - Dg z v) (D2 (π z, v) - Dg z)
          (Metric.ball (g z) (min δ₀ δ₁)) v := by
      intro v hv
      have hvO : (π z, v) ∈ O := ht z v (lt_of_lt_of_le hv (min_le_left _ _))
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun v => F' (π z, v)) (D2 (π z, v)) v :=
        ((hFd.differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hvO)).hasFDerivAt).comp v
          (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right (π z) v)
      exact (h1.sub (Dg z).hasFDerivAt).hasFDerivWithinAt
    have hbd : ∀ v ∈ Metric.ball (g z) (min δ₀ δ₁), ‖D2 (π z, v) - Dg z‖ ≤ ε := by
      intro v hv
      rw [hDg z]
      have hdist : dist (π z, g z) (π z, v) < δ₁ := by
        rw [Prod.dist_eq, dist_self, max_eq_right dist_nonneg, dist_comm]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le hv (min_le_right _ _)
      have h2 : dist (D2 (π z, g z)) (D2 (π z, v)) < ε := hu hdist ⟨z, rfl⟩
      rw [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at h2
      exact h2.le
    have hmem : g z + h z ∈ Metric.ball (g z) (min δ₀ δ₁) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left]
      exact hhz z
    have hmv := (convex_ball (g z) (min δ₀ δ₁)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le
      (f := fun v => F' (π z, v) - Dg z v) (f' := fun v => D2 (π z, v) - Dg z) hφd hbd
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ) hmem
    have heq : (F' (π z, g z + h z) - Dg z (g z + h z)) - (F' (π z, g z) - Dg z (g z)) =
        F' (π z, g z + h z) - F' (π z, g z) - Dg z (h z) := by
      rw [map_add]; abel
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at hmv
    rw [← heq]
    calc _ ≤ ε * ‖h z‖ := hmv
      _ ≤ ε * ‖h‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h.norm_coe_le_norm z) hε.le
  
  have pre : ∀ (G' : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup G'] [NormedSpace ℝ G'] (F' : E × V → G'),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F' O →
      ∀ N : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V → BoundedContinuousFunction Z G',
      (∀ g ∈ U, ∀ z, N g z = F' (π z, g z)) →
      ∃ (M : BoundedContinuousFunction Z (V →L[ℝ] G') →L[ℝ] BoundedContinuousFunction Z V →L[ℝ]
        BoundedContinuousFunction Z G')
        (N' : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V → BoundedContinuousFunction Z (V →L[ℝ] G')),
        (∀ g ∈ U, ∀ z, N' g z =
          (fun y => (fderiv ℝ F' y).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E V)) (π z, g z)) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ F' y).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E V)) O ∧
        ∀ g ∈ U, HasFDerivAt N (M (N' g)) g := by
    intro G' _ _ F' hF' N hN
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Mex G'
    have hD2s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun y => (fderiv ℝ F' y).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ E V)) O :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).1 hF').2.clm_comp contDiffOn_const
    obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ := opEx (V →L[ℝ] G') _ hD2s.continuousOn
    exact ⟨M, N', hN', hD2s, fun g hg => hderiv G' F' hF' N hN M hM g hg (N' g) (hN' g hg)⟩
  
  have boot : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (G' : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup G'] [NormedSpace ℝ G']
      (F' : E × V → G'), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F' O →
      ∀ N : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V → BoundedContinuousFunction Z G',
      (∀ g ∈ U, ∀ z, N g z = F' (π z, g z)) → ContDiffOn ℝ n N U := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro G' _ _ F' hF' N hN
      obtain ⟨M, N', _, _, hD⟩ := pre G' F' hF' N hN
      rw [Nat.cast_zero, contDiffOn_zero]
      exact fun g hg => (hD g hg).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    | succ n ih =>
      intro G' _ _ F' hF' N hN
      obtain ⟨M, N', hN', hD2s, hD⟩ := pre G' F' hF' N hN
      have hN's : ContDiffOn ℝ n N' U := ih (V →L[ℝ] G') _ hD2s N' hN'
      have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fderiv ℝ N) U :=
        (M.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hN's).congr (fun g hg => by
          rw [(hD g hg).fderiv]; rfl)
      rw [Nat.cast_add_one]
      exact (contDiffOn_succ_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hUo).2
        ⟨fun g hg => (hD g hg).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt,
          fun h => absurd h (by simp), hfd⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := opEx G F hF.continuousOn
  exact ⟨hUo, N, contDiffOn_infty.2 (fun n => boot n G F hF N hN), hN⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have key : ∀ (C : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup C] [NormedSpace ℝ C] (β : C →L[ℝ] A →L[ℝ] B),
        ∃ M : BoundedContinuousFunction Z C →L[ℝ] BoundedContinuousFunction Z A →L[ℝ]
          BoundedContinuousFunction Z B, ∀ a b z, M a b z = β (a z) (b z) := by
      intro C _ _ β
      have hb : ∀ (a : BoundedContinuousFunction Z C)
          (b : BoundedContinuousFunction Z A) (z : Z),
          ‖β (a z) (b z)‖ ≤ ‖β‖ * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ := by
        intro a b z
        calc ‖β (a z) (b z)‖ ≤ ‖β‖ * ‖a z‖ * ‖b z‖ := β.le_opNorm₂ _ _
          _ ≤ ‖β‖ * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ := by
            gcongr
            · exact a.norm_coe_le_norm z
            · exact b.norm_coe_le_norm z
      let app : BoundedContinuousFunction Z C → BoundedContinuousFunction Z A →
          BoundedContinuousFunction Z B := fun a b =>
        BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup (fun z => β (a z) (b z))
          ((β.continuous.comp a.continuous).clm_apply b.continuous) (‖β‖ * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖)
          (hb a b)
      have happ : ∀ a b z, app a b z = β (a z) (b z) := fun _ _ _ => rfl
      let L := LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ app
        (fun a₁ a₂ b => by
          ext z
          simp only [happ, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply, map_add,
            ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply])
        (fun c a b => by
          ext z
          simp only [happ, BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, map_smul,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply])
        (fun a b₁ b₂ => by
          ext z
          simp only [happ, BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply, map_add])
        (fun c a b => by
          ext z
          simp only [happ, BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, map_smul])
      have hbound : ∀ a b, ‖L a b‖ ≤ ‖β‖ * ‖a‖ * ‖b‖ := by
        intro a b
        exact BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_ofNormedAddCommGroup_le _
          (by positivity) (hb a b)
      exact ⟨L.mkContinuous₂ ‖β‖ hbound, fun a b z => rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := key (A →L[ℝ] B) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (A →L[ℝ] B))
    exact ⟨M, fun a b z => by rw [hM]; rfl⟩
  · refine ⟨(ContinuousLinearMap.compLeftContinuousBounded Z
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ A B)).coprod
      (ContinuousLinearMap.compLeftContinuousBounded Z (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ A B)),
      fun ab z => ?_⟩
    simp
  · refine ⟨∑ i : ι, (ContinuousLinearMap.compLeftContinuousBounded Z
        (ContinuousLinearMap.single ℝ Fi i)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i),
      fun f z i => ?_⟩
    simp [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, BoundedContinuousFunction.sum_apply,
      Finset.sum_apply]

(c : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
    {V G : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
    [CompleteSpace G]
    (O : Set (E2 × V)) (hO : IsOpen O) (Φ : E2 × V → G) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ O)
    (hconv : ∀ a ∈ O, ∀ b ∈ O, a.1 ∈ Metric.closedBall c ρ → b.1 ∈ Metric.closedBall c ρ →
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, a + t • (b - a) ∈ O) :
    ∃ Nq : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ) V ×
        BoundedContinuousFunction {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} V →
        BoundedContinuousFunction {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} G,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Nq {gq | ∀ x : Metric.closedBall c ρ, ((x : E2), gq.1 x) ∈ O} ∧
      ∀ gq : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ) V ×
          BoundedContinuousFunction {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} V,
        (∀ x : Metric.closedBall c ρ, ((x : E2), gq.1 x) ∈ O) →
        (∀ p, gq.2 p = (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ • (gq.1 p.1.1 - gq.1 p.1.2)) →
        ∀ p, Nq gq p = (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ •
            (Φ ((p.1.1 : E2), gq.1 p.1.1) - Φ ((p.1.2 : E2), gq.1 p.1.2))

proof.tactics:
by
  haveI : CompactSpace (Metric.closedBall c ρ) :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_closedBall c ρ)
  
  have hdpos : ∀ p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2},
      0 < dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) := by
    intro p
    refine dist_pos.mpr ?_
    intro h
    exact p.2 (Subtype.ext h)
  have hdle : ∀ p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2},
      dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ≤ 2 * ρ := by
    intro p
    have h1 := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp p.1.1.2
    have h2 := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp p.1.2.2
    calc dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ≤ dist (p.1.1 : E2) c + dist c (p.1.2 : E2) :=
          dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ ρ + ρ := by rw [dist_comm c]; exact add_le_add h1 h2
      _ = 2 * ρ := by ring
  let fD : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} → E2 :=
    fun p => (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ • ((p.1.1 : E2) - (p.1.2 : E2))
  have hxc : Continuous (fun p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} =>
      (p.1.1 : E2)) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val)
  have hyc : Continuous (fun p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} =>
      (p.1.2 : E2)) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_subtype_val)
  have hfDc : Continuous fD := by
    have hdα : Continuous (fun p : {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} =>
        dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α) :=
      (hxc.dist hyc).rpow_const (fun p => Or.inl (hdpos p).ne')
    exact (hdα.inv₀ (fun p => (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (hdpos p) α).ne')).smul (hxc.sub hyc)
  have hfDb : ∀ p, ‖fD p‖ ≤ max 1 (2 * ρ) := by
    intro p
    have hd := hdpos p
    have hdα := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hd α
    have hn : ‖fD p‖ = dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) / dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α := by
      simp only [fD, norm_smul, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hdα, ← dist_eq_norm]
      ring
    rw [hn, div_le_iff₀ hdα]
    rcases le_total (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2)) 1 with h1 | h1
    · have h2 : dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ≤ dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α := by
        calc dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) = dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
              (Real.rpow_one _).symm
          _ ≤ _ := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge hd h1 hα1.le
      nlinarith [le_max_left 1 (2 * ρ)]
    · have h2 : 1 ≤ dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α := Real.one_le_rpow h1 hα0.le
      have h3 := hdle p
      have h4 := le_max_right 1 (2 * ρ)
      have h5 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ max 1 (2 * ρ) := le_trans zero_le_one (le_max_left _ _)
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 h5]
  let Dα : BoundedContinuousFunction {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} E2 :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup fD hfDc (max 1 (2 * ρ)) hfDb
  
  have hγc : ∀ f : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ) V,
      Continuous (fun z : (Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ) × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 =>
        f z.1.2 + (z.2 : ℝ) • (f z.1.1 - f z.1.2)) := by
    intro f
    exact (f.continuous.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst)).add
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).smul
        ((f.continuous.comp (continuous_fst.comp continuous_fst)).sub
          (f.continuous.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst))))
  have hγb : ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ) V)
      (z : (Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ) × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
      ‖f z.1.2 + (z.2 : ℝ) • (f z.1.1 - f z.1.2)‖ ≤ 3 * ‖f‖ := by
    intro f z
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ (z.2 : ℝ) := z.2.2.1
    have ht1 : (z.2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := z.2.2.2
    have h1 := f.norm_coe_le_norm z.1.1
    have h2 := f.norm_coe_le_norm z.1.2
    have h3 : ‖f z.1.1 - f z.1.2‖ ≤ ‖f‖ + ‖f‖ := (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add h1 h2)
    have h4 : ‖(z.2 : ℝ) • (f z.1.1 - f z.1.2)‖ = (z.2 : ℝ) * ‖f z.1.1 - f z.1.2‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ht0]
    have h5 := norm_add_le (f z.1.2) ((z.2 : ℝ) • (f z.1.1 - f z.1.2))
    have h6 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 ht0
    have h7 := norm_nonneg f
    nlinarith
  let γL : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ) V →ₗ[ℝ]
      BoundedContinuousFunction ((Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ) × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) V :=
    { toFun := fun f => BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup
        (fun z => f z.1.2 + (z.2 : ℝ) • (f z.1.1 - f z.1.2)) (hγc f) (3 * ‖f‖) (hγb f)
      map_add' := fun f g => by
        ext z
        rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
        show (f + g) z.1.2 + (z.2 : ℝ) • ((f + g) z.1.1 - (f + g) z.1.2) =
          (f z.1.2 + (z.2 : ℝ) • (f z.1.1 - f z.1.2)) + (g z.1.2 + (z.2 : ℝ) • (g z.1.1 - g z.1.2))
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
        module
      map_smul' := fun r f => by
        ext z
        rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply]
        show (r • f) z.1.2 + (z.2 : ℝ) • ((r • f) z.1.1 - (r • f) z.1.2) =
          (RingHom.id ℝ) r • (f z.1.2 + (z.2 : ℝ) • (f z.1.1 - f z.1.2))
        simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
        module }
  let Γ := γL.mkContinuous 3 (fun f => (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (by positivity)).mpr (hγb f))
  have hΓ : ∀ f z, Γ f z = f z.1.2 + (z.2 : ℝ) • (f z.1.1 - f z.1.2) := fun f z => rfl
  
  let ι0 : ℝ → Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one
  have hι0 : Continuous ι0 := continuous_projIcc
  have hIgen : ∀ (Y Y' H : Type) [TopologicalSpace Y] [TopologicalSpace Y'] [NormedAddCommGroup H]
      [NormedSpace ℝ H] (φ : C(Y', Y)),
      ∃ I : BoundedContinuousFunction (Y × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) H →L[ℝ] BoundedContinuousFunction Y' H,
        ∀ a y', I a y' = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, a (φ y', ι0 t) := by
    intro Y Y' H _ _ _ _ φ
    have hIc : ∀ a : BoundedContinuousFunction (Y × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) H,
        Continuous (fun y' : Y' => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, a (φ y', ι0 t)) := by
      intro a
      exact intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        (f := fun y' t => a (φ y', ι0 t))
        (a.continuous.comp ((φ.continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk
          (hι0.comp continuous_snd))) 0 1
    have hIb : ∀ (a : BoundedContinuousFunction (Y × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) H) (y' : Y'),
        ‖∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, a (φ y', ι0 t)‖ ≤ ‖a‖ := by
      intro a y'
      have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (a := 0) (b := 1) (C := ‖a‖)
        (f := fun t => a (φ y', ι0 t)) (fun t _ => a.norm_coe_le_norm _)
      simpa using h
    have hIi : ∀ (a : BoundedContinuousFunction (Y × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) H) (q : Y),
        IntervalIntegrable (fun t => a (q, ι0 t)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 := by
      intro a q
      exact (a.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk hι0)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
    let IL : BoundedContinuousFunction (Y × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) H →ₗ[ℝ]
        BoundedContinuousFunction Y' H :=
      { toFun := fun a => BoundedContinuousFunction.ofNormedAddCommGroup
          (fun y' => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, a (φ y', ι0 t)) (hIc a) ‖a‖ (hIb a)
        map_add' := fun a b => by
          refine BoundedContinuousFunction.ext (fun y' => ?_)
          rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
          show ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (a + b) (φ y', ι0 t) =
            (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, a (φ y', ι0 t)) + ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, b (φ y', ι0 t)
          simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.add_apply]
          exact intervalIntegral.integral_add (hIi a (φ y')) (hIi b (φ y'))
        map_smul' := fun r a => by
          refine BoundedContinuousFunction.ext (fun y' => ?_)
          rw [BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply]
          show ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (r • a) (φ y', ι0 t) =
            (RingHom.id ℝ) r • ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, a (φ y', ι0 t)
          simp only [BoundedContinuousFunction.smul_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
          exact intervalIntegral.integral_smul r _ }
    have hILb : ∀ a, ‖IL a‖ ≤ 1 * ‖a‖ := fun a => by
      rw [one_mul]
      exact (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (f := IL a) (norm_nonneg a)).mpr (fun y' => hIb a y')
    exact ⟨IL.mkContinuous 1 hILb, fun a y' => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := hIgen (Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ)
    {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} (E2 × V →L[ℝ] G)
    ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
  
  let π' : C((Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ) × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, E2) :=
    ⟨fun z => (z.1.2 : E2) + (z.2 : ℝ) • ((z.1.1 : E2) - (z.1.2 : E2)),
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst)).add
        ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).smul
          ((continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_fst.comp continuous_fst)).sub
            (continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst))))⟩
  obtain ⟨-, N', hN's, hN'v⟩ := pcr_nem_omega π' O hO (fderiv ℝ Φ)
    (hΦ.fderiv_of_isOpen (m := ∞) hO le_rfl)
  
  obtain ⟨⟨M, hM⟩, -, -⟩ := pcr_nem_bcf_linear
    (Z := {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2}) (A := E2 × V) (B := G)
    (ι := Unit) (Fi := fun _ => ℝ)
  obtain ⟨-, ⟨P, hP⟩, -⟩ := pcr_nem_bcf_linear
    (Z := {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2}) (A := E2) (B := V)
    (ι := Unit) (Fi := fun _ => ℝ)
  
  have hseg : ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ) V)
      (z : (Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ) × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
      (π' z, Γ f z) = ((z.1.2 : E2), f z.1.2) +
        (z.2 : ℝ) • (((z.1.1 : E2), f z.1.1) - ((z.1.2 : E2), f z.1.2)) := by
    intro f z
    rw [hΓ, Prod.mk_sub_mk, Prod.smul_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk]
    rfl
  have hU : ∀ gq : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ) V ×
      BoundedContinuousFunction {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} V,
      (∀ x : Metric.closedBall c ρ, ((x : E2), gq.1 x) ∈ O) →
      ∀ z, (π' z, Γ gq.1 z) ∈ O := by
    intro gq hgq z
    rw [hseg]
    exact hconv _ (hgq z.1.2) _ (hgq z.1.1) z.1.2.2 z.1.1.2 _ z.2.2
  
  have hftc : ∀ a b : E2 × V, (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, a + t • (b - a) ∈ O) →
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ Φ (a + t • (b - a))) (b - a) = Φ b - Φ a := by
    intro a b hab
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ Φ (a + t • (b - a))) (Set.uIcc 0 1) := by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one]
      refine (hΦ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)).comp ?_ hab
      exact (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)).continuousOn
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply hcont.intervalIntegrable]
    have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Φ (a + t • (b - a)))
        (fderiv ℝ Φ (a + t • (b - a)) (b - a)) t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => a + t • (b - a)) (b - a) t := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (b - a)).const_add a
      have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (a + t • (b - a)) :=
        (hΦ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds (hab t ht))
      exact hd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hl
    have hint2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => fderiv ℝ Φ (a + t • (b - a)) (b - a))
        MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
      (hcont.clm_apply continuousOn_const).intervalIntegrable
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv hint2]
    simp
  
  refine ⟨fun gq => M (I (N' (Γ gq.1))) (P (Dα, gq.2)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hΓs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun gq : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ) V ×
        BoundedContinuousFunction {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} V =>
        Γ gq.1) := Γ.contDiff.comp contDiff_fst
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun gq : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ) V ×
        BoundedContinuousFunction {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} V =>
        N' (Γ gq.1)) {gq | ∀ x : Metric.closedBall c ρ, ((x : E2), gq.1 x) ∈ O} :=
      hN's.comp hΓs.contDiffOn (fun gq hgq => hU gq hgq)
    have hIs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun a : BoundedContinuousFunction ((Metric.closedBall c ρ ×
        Metric.closedBall c ρ) × Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (E2 × V →L[ℝ] G) => I a) := I.contDiff
    have hMs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M := by fun_prop
    have h2 := (hMs.comp hIs).comp_contDiffOn h1
    have h3 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun gq : BoundedContinuousFunction (Metric.closedBall c ρ) V ×
        BoundedContinuousFunction {p : Metric.closedBall c ρ × Metric.closedBall c ρ // p.1 ≠ p.2} V =>
        P (Dα, gq.2)) := P.contDiff.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_snd)
    exact h2.clm_apply h3.contDiffOn
  · intro gq hgq hq p
    have e1 : M (I (N' (Γ gq.1))) (P (Dα, gq.2)) p = (I (N' (Γ gq.1)) p) (Dα p, gq.2 p) := by
      rw [hM, hP]
    have hint : I (N' (Γ gq.1)) p = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
        fderiv ℝ Φ (((p.1.2 : E2), gq.1 p.1.2) +
          t • (((p.1.1 : E2), gq.1 p.1.1) - ((p.1.2 : E2), gq.1 p.1.2))) := by
      rw [hI]
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      have h' : ((ι0 t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : ℝ) = t := by
        rw [show ι0 t = ⟨t, ht⟩ from Set.projIcc_of_mem _ ht]
      show N' (Γ gq.1) (p.1, ι0 t) = _
      rw [hN'v _ (hU gq hgq) (p.1, ι0 t), hseg]
      dsimp only
      rw [h']
    have hpair : (Dα p, gq.2 p) = (dist (p.1.1 : E2) (p.1.2 : E2) ^ α)⁻¹ •
        (((p.1.1 : E2), gq.1 p.1.1) - ((p.1.2 : E2), gq.1 p.1.2)) := by
      rw [hq p, Prod.mk_sub_mk, Prod.smul_mk]
      rfl
    show M (I (N' (Γ gq.1))) (P (Dα, gq.2)) p = _
    rw [e1, hint, hpair, ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul,
      hftc _ _ (fun t ht => hconv _ (hgq p.1.2) _ (hgq p.1.1) p.1.2.2 p.1.1.2 t ht)]

subgoal_signatures.name: pcr_nem_omega
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{Z E V G : Type} [TopologicalSpace Z] [CompactSpace Z]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G]
    (π : C(Z, E)) (O : Set (E × V)) (hO : IsOpen O) (F : E × V → G) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F O) :
    IsOpen {g : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V | ∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O} ∧
    ∃ N : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V → BoundedContinuousFunction Z G,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ N {g | ∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O} ∧
      ∀ g : BoundedContinuousFunction Z V, (∀ z, (π z, g z) ∈ O) → ∀ z, N g z = F (π z, g z)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcr_nem_bcf_linear
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{Z A B ι : Type} [TopologicalSpace Z] [NormedAddCommGroup A]
    [NormedSpace ℝ A] [NormedAddCommGroup B] [NormedSpace ℝ B] [Fintype ι] {Fi : ι → Type}
    [∀ i, NormedAddCommGroup (Fi i)] [∀ i, NormedSpace ℝ (Fi i)] :
    (∃ M : BoundedContinuousFunction Z (A →L[ℝ] B) →L[ℝ] BoundedContinuousFunction Z A →L[ℝ]
        BoundedContinuousFunction Z B, ∀ a b z, M a b z = a z (b z)) ∧
    (∃ P : (BoundedContinuousFunction Z A × BoundedContinuousFunction Z B) →L[ℝ]
        BoundedContinuousFunction Z (A × B), ∀ ab z, P ab z = (ab.1 z, ab.2 z)) ∧
    (∃ Lp : (∀ i, BoundedContinuousFunction Z (Fi i)) →L[ℝ] BoundedContinuousFunction Z (∀ i, Fi i),
        ∀ f z i, Lp f z i = f i z)

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (s₁ : ℝ)
    (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b)
      {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ U})
    (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G y a b = G y b a)
    (hGpd : ∀ y : E3, |y 0| < s₁ → hpProj y ∈ U → (G y).PosDef) (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ (Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ) (O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ))),
      IsOpen O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ O ∧
      (∀ w ∈ O, ∀ q : Fin 2 → ℝ, q ≠ 0 →
        0 < fderiv ℝ (fun w' => fderiv ℝ Λ w' (0, 0, q)) w (0, 0, q)) ∧
      (∀ w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ), |w.2.1| < s₁ →
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm w.1 ∈ U → w ∈ O) ∧
      (∀ u : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 u → ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        (x, u x, smthGrad u x) ∈ O →
        smthELop Λ u x = smthELop (smthLag G 0) u x -
          a * Real.sqrt (G (smthLift 0 x (u x))).det)

signature.statement:

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have F1 : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift 0 x t) 0 = t := by
    intro x t
    simp [smthLift]
  have F2 : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      hpProj (smthLift 0 x t) = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm x := by
    intro x t
    unfold hpProj
    congr 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [smthLift]
      try rfl
    · simp [smthLift]
      try rfl
  have hliftC : ∀ {X : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X] (f : X → Fin 2 → ℝ)
      (g : X → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ g →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p => smthLift 0 (f p) (g p)) := by
    intro X _ _ f g hf hg
    unfold smthLift
    refine (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp ?_
    refine contDiff_pi.2 fun i => ?_
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove 0 i with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · simpa using hg
    · simpa using (contDiff_apply ℝ ℝ j).comp hf
  have hcont0 : Continuous (fun y : E3 => y 0) := PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ 0
  have hcontP : Continuous hpProj := by
    have h : Continuous (fun z : E3 => (![z 1, z 2] : Fin 2 → ℝ)) := by
      refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
      fin_cases i
      · simpa using (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 1)
      · simpa using (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 2)
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp h
  set S3 : Set E3 := {y : E3 | |y 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj y ∈ U} with hS3
  have hS3open : IsOpen S3 :=
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp hcont0) continuous_const).inter (hU.preimage hcontP)
  have memS3 : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ),
      smthLift 0 x t ∈ S3 ↔ |t| < s₁ ∧ (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm x ∈ U := by
    intro x t
    show |(smthLift 0 x t) 0| < s₁ ∧ hpProj (smthLift 0 x t) ∈ U ↔ _
    rw [F1, F2]
  obtain ⟨hOo, hLag, hEll⟩ :=
    smth_lag_props G S3 hS3open hGs hGsymm (fun y hy => hGpd y hy.1 hy.2) 0
  have hσs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) S3 :=
    ccs_sqrtdet_smooth G S3 hGs (fun z hz => (hGpd z hz.1 hz.2).det_pos)
  set O : Set ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) :=
    {w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) | smthLift 0 w.1 w.2.1 ∈ S3} with hOdef
  have memO : ∀ w : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ),
      w ∈ O ↔ |w.2.1| < s₁ ∧ (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm w.1 ∈ U :=
    fun w => memS3 w.1 w.2.1
  
  obtain ⟨I, hIdef⟩ : ∃ I : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ∀ w,
      I w = ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, Real.sqrt (G (smthLift 0 w.1 (s * w.2.1))).det :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, ∀ w, V w = w.2.1 * I w :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hI : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ I O := by
    have hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ((Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) × ℝ =>
        smthLift 0 p.1.1 (p.2 * p.1.2.1)) :=
