proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hT : ∀ (p : M) (S : Set M), chartAt E3 p '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =
      (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' S := by
    intro p S
    rw [Set.inter_comm, OpenPartialHomeomorph.image_source_inter_eq']
  
  have hmeasP : ∀ (P : ℤ → Prop), sepChartMeas {x : M | P (w x)} := by
    intro P p
    rw [hT]
    have e : (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' {x : M | P (w x)} =
        ⋃ j ∈ {j : ℤ | P j},
          (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' {x : M | w x = j} := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion,
        exists_prop]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        exact ⟨_, h2, h1, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨j, hj, h1, h2⟩
        exact ⟨h1, h2 ▸ hj⟩
    rw [e]
    refine MeasurableSet.biUnion (Set.to_countable _) (fun j _ => ?_)
    have h := hwm j p
    rw [hT] at h
    exact h
  have hup : ∀ i : ℕ, sepChartMeas {x : M | (i : ℤ) + 1 ≤ w x} :=
    fun i => hmeasP (fun b => (i : ℤ) + 1 ≤ b)
  have hdn : ∀ i : ℕ, sepChartMeas {x : M | w x ≤ -((i : ℤ) + 1)} :=
    fun i => hmeasP (fun b => b ≤ -((i : ℤ) + 1))
  
  have hvan : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (K : Set E3), IsClosed K →
      (∀ z, z ∉ K → X z = 0) → ∀ y, y ∉ K → sepDensDiv G X y = 0 := by
    intro G X K hK hX y hy
    have hev : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      intro i
      filter_upwards [hK.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      rw [hX z hz]
      simp
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    rw [(hev i).fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hcont : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X : E3 → E3),
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i)) →
      Continuous (sepDensDiv G X) := by
    intro G X hX
    have h : sepDensDiv G X = fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) y (e i) := rfl
    rw [h]
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
      ((hX i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  
  have hpiece0 : ∀ (qq : M) (ψ : M → ℝ) (X : M → E3) (z : E3),
      z ∉ chartAt E3 qq '' tsupport ψ → calPiece qq ψ X z = 0 := by
    intro qq ψ X z hz
    unfold calPiece
    by_cases ht : z ∈ (chartAt E3 qq).target
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
      have h0 : ψ ((chartAt E3 qq).symm z) = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hz ⟨_, subset_tsupport _ hne, (chartAt E3 qq).right_inv ht⟩
      simp [h0]
    · exact Set.indicator_of_notMem ht _
  
  have hlim : ∀ (p : M) (f : E3 → ℝ) (T : Set E3), Continuous f → IsCompact T →
      T ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target → (∀ y, y ∉ T → f y = 0) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ)) T →
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N,
          ((∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ({x | (i : ℤ) + 1 ≤ w x} ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), f y) -
            ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ({x | w x ≤ -((i : ℤ) + 1)} ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), f y))
        atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ) * f y)) := by
    intro p f T hf hTc hTt hfT hwT
    have hsupp : HasCompactSupport f := HasCompactSupport.intro hTc hfT
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hf.bounded_above_of_compact_support hsupp
    have hfi : Integrable f := hf.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hsupp
    have hind : ∀ (P : ℤ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (y : E3),
        (chartAt E3 p '' ({x | P (w x)} ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)).indicator f y =
        (if P (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * f y := by
      intro P _ y
      rw [hT]
      by_cases hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
      · by_cases hP : P (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩
              (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' {x | P (w x)} from ⟨hy, hP⟩), if_pos hP, one_mul]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hP h.2), if_neg hP, zero_mul]
      · have h0 : f y = 0 := hfT y (fun h => hy (hTt h))
        rw [h0, mul_zero]
        exact Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hy h.1) _
    have hsetint : ∀ (P : ℤ → Prop) [DecidablePred P],
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ({x | P (w x)} ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), f y =
        ∫ y, (if P (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * f y := by
      intro P _
      rw [← integral_indicator (hmeasP P p)]
      exact integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hind P))
    have hintP : ∀ (P : ℤ → Prop) [DecidablePred P],
        Integrable (fun y => (if P (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * f y) := by
      intro P _
      exact (hfi.indicator (hmeasP P p)).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hind P))
    
    have hclamp : ∀ (N : ℕ) (b : ℤ) (r : ℝ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N,
        ((if (i : ℤ) + 1 ≤ b then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * r -
          (if b ≤ -((i : ℤ) + 1) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * r) =
        ((max (min b (N : ℤ)) (-(N : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) * r := by
      intro N b r
      induction N with
      | zero => simp
      | succ N ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
        by_cases h1 : (N : ℤ) + 1 ≤ b
        · have h2 : ¬ b ≤ -((N : ℤ) + 1) := by omega
          have e1 : max (min b ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
              max (min b (N : ℤ)) (-(N : ℤ)) + 1 := by
            push_cast
            simp only [max_def, min_def]
            split_ifs <;> omega
          rw [if_pos h1, if_neg h2, e1]
          push_cast
          ring
        · by_cases h2 : b ≤ -((N : ℤ) + 1)
          · have e1 : max (min b ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
                max (min b (N : ℤ)) (-(N : ℤ)) - 1 := by
              push_cast
              simp only [max_def, min_def]
              split_ifs <;> omega
            rw [if_neg h1, if_pos h2, e1]
            push_cast
            ring
          · have e1 : max (min b ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
                max (min b (N : ℤ)) (-(N : ℤ)) := by
              push_cast
              simp only [max_def, min_def]
              split_ifs <;> omega
            rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, e1]
            ring
    have hclb : ∀ (N : ℕ) (b : ℤ), |((max (min b (N : ℤ)) (-(N : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ |(b : ℝ)| := by
      intro N b
      have h : |max (min b (N : ℤ)) (-(N : ℤ))| ≤ |b| := by
        rw [abs_le]
        have h1 := le_abs_self b
        have h2 := neg_abs_le b
        have h3 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (N : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg N
        generalize |b| = B at *
        constructor <;> simp only [max_def, min_def] <;> split_ifs <;> omega
      exact_mod_cast h
    have hFN : ∀ N : ℕ, (fun y => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N,
        ((if (i : ℤ) + 1 ≤ w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * f y -
          (if w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) ≤ -((i : ℤ) + 1) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * f y)) =
        fun y => ((max (min (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (N : ℤ)) (-(N : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) * f y := by
      intro N
      funext y
      exact hclamp N _ _
    have hseq : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N,
        ((∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ({x | (i : ℤ) + 1 ≤ w x} ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), f y) -
          ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ({x | w x ≤ -((i : ℤ) + 1)} ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), f y) =
        ∫ y, ((max (min (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (N : ℤ)) (-(N : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) * f y := by
      intro N
      rw [← hFN N, integral_finset_sum]
      · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [integral_sub (hintP (fun b => (i : ℤ) + 1 ≤ b))
          (hintP (fun b => b ≤ -((i : ℤ) + 1))),
          hsetint (fun b => (i : ℤ) + 1 ≤ b), hsetint (fun b => b ≤ -((i : ℤ) + 1))]
      · intro i _
        exact (hintP (fun b => (i : ℤ) + 1 ≤ b)).sub (hintP (fun b => b ≤ -((i : ℤ) + 1)))
    have hbound : Integrable
        (fun y => ‖T.indicator (fun y => (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ)) y‖ * C) :=
      ((hwT.integrable_indicator hTc.isClosed.measurableSet).norm).mul_const C
    have hlimit : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ =>
        ∫ y, ((max (min (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (N : ℤ)) (-(N : ℤ)) : ℤ) : ℝ) * f y) atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ y, (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ) * f y)) := by
      refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence _ (fun N => ?_) hbound (fun N => ?_) ?_
      · rw [← hFN N]
        apply Integrable.aestronglyMeasurable
        apply integrable_finset_sum
        intro i _
        exact (hintP (fun b => (i : ℤ) + 1 ≤ b)).sub (hintP (fun b => b ≤ -((i : ℤ) + 1)))
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_
        have hCy : |f y| ≤ C := by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC y
        by_cases hy : y ∈ T
        · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hy, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          exact mul_le_mul (hclb N _) hCy (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)
        · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, hfT y hy]
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_
        refine tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const (i₀ := (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)).natAbs)
          fun N hN => ?_
        have h : max (min (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (N : ℤ)) (-(N : ℤ)) =
            w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) := by
          simp only [max_def, min_def]
          split_ifs <;> omega
        rw [h]
    exact hlimit.congr fun N => (hseq N).symm
  
  have hsp : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := fun x hx => (hφs hx).1
  have hsq : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source := fun x hx => (hφs hx).2
  have hKc : ∀ r : M, tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 r).source →
      IsCompact (chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ) := fun r hr =>
    hφc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 r).continuousOn.mono hr)
  have hKt : ∀ r : M, tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 r).source →
      chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 r).target := by
    rintro r hr _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 r).map_source (hr hx)
  have hPc : ∀ r : M, tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 r).source →
      Continuous (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 r).symm) (calPiece r φ V)) := fun r hr =>
    hcont _ _ (calPiece_regular g r φ hφ hφc hr V hV).1
  have hP0 : ∀ r : M, tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 r).source → ∀ y,
      y ∉ chartAt E3 r '' tsupport φ →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 r).symm) (calPiece r φ V) y = 0 := fun r hr =>
    hvan _ _ _ (hKc r hr).isClosed (fun z hz => hpiece0 _ _ _ z hz)
  have hA := hlim p _ _ (hPc p hsp) (hKc p hsp) (hKt p hsp) (hP0 p hsp) hwp
  have hB := hlim q _ _ (hPc q hsq) (hKc q hsq) (hKt q hsq) (hP0 q hsq) hwq
  refine tendsto_nhds_unique hA (hB.congr fun N => ?_)
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [calPiece_div_integral_chart_eq g p q φ hφ hφc hφs V hV _ (hup i),
    calPiece_div_integral_chart_eq g p q φ hφ hφc hφs V hV _ (hdn i)]

subgoal_signatures.name: calPiece_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (q : M) (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) (W : M → E3) (hW : calSmoothField W) : (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm z).det * calPiece q ψ W z i)) ∧ Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q ψ W))

subgoal_signatures.name: calPiece_div_integral_chart_eq
subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p q : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (hφ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ) (hφc : IsCompact (tsupport φ)) (hφs : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) (V : M → E3) (hV : calSmoothField V) (E : Set M) (hE : sepChartMeas E) : ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ V) y = ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q φ V) y

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (n : M → ℤ) (U : Set M) (hU : IsOpen U) (p : M) (ψ : M → ℝ)
    (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ))
    (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hψb : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ c)
    (V₁ V₂ : M → E3) (hV₁ : calSmoothField V₁) (hV₂ : calSmoothField V₂)
    (hV₁1 : ∀ x, g.g x (V₁ x) (V₁ x) ≤ 1) (hV₂1 : ∀ x, g.g x (V₂ x) (V₂ x) ≤ 1) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ y, ((max (n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₁) y) +
        ∫ y, ((max (-n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₂) y) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal c * dualRiemVar g (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) (fun x => (n x : ℝ)) U ∅

signature.name: dual_pair_piece_le
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (n : M → ℤ) (U : Set M) (hU : IsOpen U) (p : M) (ψ : M → ℝ)
    (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ))
    (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hψb : ∀ x, |ψ x| ≤ c)
    (V₁ V₂ : M → E3) (hV₁ : calSmoothField V₁) (hV₂ : calSmoothField V₂)
    (hV₁1 : ∀ x, g.g x (V₁ x) (V₁ x) ≤ 1) (hV₂1 : ∀ x, g.g x (V₂ x) (V₂ x) ≤ 1) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ y, ((max (n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₁) y) +
        ∫ y, ((max (-n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₂) y) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal c * dualRiemVar g (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) (fun x => (n x : ℝ)) U ∅

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hψs' : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source := hψs.trans Set.inter_subset_right
  have hKc : IsCompact ((chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ) :=
    hψc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.mono hψs')
  have hKcl : IsClosed ((chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ) := hKc.isClosed
  have hKt : (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source (hψs' hx)
  
  have hexp : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a : E3),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B (L (e i)) (L (e j)) * a i * a j = B (L a) (L a) := by
    intro L B a
    have ha : a = a 0 • e 0 + a 1 • e 1 + a 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_rhs => rw [ha]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hwit : ∀ (V : M → E3), calSmoothField V → (∀ x, g.g x (V x) (V x) ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (a : ℝ), |a| * c ≤ 1 → ∀ (W : Set E3), (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ ⊆ W →
      ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal (a * ∫ y, f y * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y) ≤
        dualVarG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ)) f W ∅ := by
    intro V hV hV1 a ha W hW f
    have hval : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, calPiece p ψ V y =
        (ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) • mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p)
          ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3) := by
      intro y hy
      unfold calPiece
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
    have hval0 : ∀ y ∉ (chartAt E3 p).target, calPiece p ψ V y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      unfold calPiece
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hy]
    have hZ : ∀ y ∉ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ, calPiece p ψ V y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      by_cases hyt : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
      · have hx : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∉ tsupport ψ := fun hx =>
          hy ⟨_, hx, (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hyt⟩
        rw [hval y hyt, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx, zero_smul]
      · exact hval0 y hyt
    have hCon : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (calPiece p ψ V) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
        contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hψ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
      exact (h1.smul (hV p)).congr hval
    have hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (calPiece p ψ V) := by
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ
      · exact hCon.contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds (hKt hy))
      · have hev : calPiece p ψ V =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : E3) := by
          filter_upwards [hKcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz using hZ z hz
        exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    have hHC : HasCompactSupport (calPiece p ψ V) := HasCompactSupport.intro hKc hZ
    have hT : tsupport (calPiece p ψ V) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ :=
      closure_minimal (fun y hy => by_contra fun h => hy (hZ y h)) hKcl
    
    set X : E3 → E3 := fun z => a • calPiece p ψ V z with hXdef
    have hXC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X := hC.const_smul a
    have hXK : HasCompactSupport X := hHC.mono (fun y hy h => hy (by simp [hXdef, h]))
    have hXT : tsupport X ⊆ W :=
      (tsupport_smul_subset_right (fun _ => a) (calPiece p ψ V)).trans (hT.trans hW)
    have hXN : ∀ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j * X y i * X y j ≤ 1 := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target
      · have hxs : (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source :=
          (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
        have hchain : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) w) = w := by
          intro w
          have h := (mdifferentiable_chart (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) p).symm_comp_deriv hxs
          rw [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv hy] at h
          exact DFunLike.congr_fun h w
        have hXy : X y = (a * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) • mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3)
            (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := by
          simp only [hXdef, hval y hy, smul_smul]
        have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j * X y i * X y j =
            g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (X y))
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm y (X y)) :=
          hexp _ _ _
        rw [hsum, hXy]
        simp only [map_smul, hchain, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        have h1 : |a * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)| ≤ 1 := by
          rw [abs_mul]
          calc |a| * |ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)| ≤ |a| * c :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hψb _) (abs_nonneg a)
            _ ≤ 1 := ha
        have h2 : (a * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
          rw [← sq_abs]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (a * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))]
        have h3 := hV1 ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
        have h4 : 0 ≤ (a * ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 h4]
      · have hX0 : X y = 0 := by simp [hXdef, hval0 y hy]
        simp [hX0]
    
    have hdiv : ∀ y, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y =
        a * sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y := by
      intro y
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      have hf : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * X z i) =
          a • (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * calPiece p ψ V z i) := by
        funext z; simp only [hXdef, Pi.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
      rw [hf, fderiv_const_smul_of_field]
      simp
    
    obtain ⟨hreg, -⟩ := calPiece_regular g p ψ hψ hψc hψs' V hV
    have hFcont : Continuous (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V)) := by
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      refine continuous_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => ?_
      exact ((hreg i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hF0 : ∀ y ∉ (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ,
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V) y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
      have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det * calPiece p ψ V z i)
          =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [hKcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        rw [hZ z hz]; simp
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]; simp
    obtain ⟨C, hCb⟩ := (HasCompactSupport.intro hKc hF0).exists_bound_of_continuous hFcont
    have hbd : ∃ C' : ℝ, ∀ y, |sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) X y| ≤ C' := by
      refine ⟨|a| * C, fun y => ?_⟩
      rw [hdiv y, abs_mul]
      have := hCb y
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (abs_nonneg a)
    
    unfold dualVarG
    refine le_sup_of_le_right (le_iSup₂_of_le X ⟨fun y _ => hXC.contDiffAt, hXK, hXT, hXN, hbd⟩ ?_)
    apply le_of_eq
    congr 1
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    simp only [zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, hdiv y]
    ring
  
  have hV'o : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p) '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hU.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source)
      Set.inter_subset_right
  have hKV : (chartAt E3 p) '' tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p) '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
    Set.image_mono hψs
  have hV't : (chartAt E3 p) '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 p).map_source hx.2
  obtain ⟨W, hWo, hKW, hWcl, hWc⟩ := exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hKc hV'o hKV
  have hWV' : W ⊆ (chartAt E3 p) '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) := subset_closure.trans hWcl
  
  have hsplit := dualVarG_zero_min_max_split (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) _ hV'o
    (fun i j => (g.smooth p i j).mono hV't) (fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _)
    (fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y (hV't hy)) W hWo hWc hWcl
    (fun y => (n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ)) 0
  
  have hcinv : |c⁻¹| * c ≤ 1 :=
    le_of_eq (by rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hc), inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne'])
  have hcinv' : |-c⁻¹| * c ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_neg]; exact hcinv
  have h₁ := hwit V₁ hV₁ hV₁1 c⁻¹ hcinv W hKW
    (fun y => max ((n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ)) 0 - 0)
  have h₂ := hwit V₂ hV₂ hV₂1 (-c⁻¹) hcinv' W hKW
    (fun y => min ((n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ)) 0)
  
  have hmono : dualVarG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ))
        (fun y => (n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ)) W ∅ ≤
      dualVarG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ))
        (fun y => (n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ))
        ((chartAt E3 p) '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ∅ := by
    unfold dualVarG
    refine sup_le (iSup_le fun h => le_sup_of_le_left
      (le_iSup_of_le (fun h' => h (h'.mono_set hWV')) le_rfl))
      (iSup₂_le fun X hX => le_sup_of_le_right
        (le_iSup₂_of_le X ⟨hX.1, hX.2.1, hX.2.2.1.trans hWV', hX.2.2.2⟩ le_rfl))
  have hω : dualOmega (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) p = fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
    funext y i
    simp [dualOmega, partialDeriv]
  have hfam : dualVarG (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ))
        (fun y => (n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ))
        ((chartAt E3 p) '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ∅ ≤
      dualRiemVar g (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) (fun x => (n x : ℝ)) U ∅ := by
    unfold dualRiemVar
    refine le_iSup_of_le 1 (le_iSup_of_le (fun _ => p) (le_iSup_of_le
      (fun _ => U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) (le_iSup_of_le
      ⟨fun _ => ⟨hU.inter (chartAt E3 p).open_source, subset_rfl⟩,
        fun k l hkl => absurd (Subsingleton.elim k l) hkl⟩ ?_)))
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_one, hω, Set.empty_inter, Set.image_empty] <;> exact le_rfl
  
  have h1eq : (∫ y, (max ((n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ)) 0 - 0) *
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₁) y) =
      ∫ y, ((max (n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) *
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₁) y := by
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    simp only [Int.cast_max, Int.cast_zero, sub_zero]
  have h2eq : (∫ y, min ((n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ)) 0 *
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₂) y) =
      -∫ y, ((max (-n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) *
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₂) y := by
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_neg]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    have hm : ((max (-n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        -min ((n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ)) 0 := by
      simp only [Int.cast_max, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_zero]
      rw [← max_neg_neg, neg_zero]
    simp only [hm]
    ring
  have hsum : ((∫ y, ((max (n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₁) y) +
        ∫ y, ((max (-n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) 0 : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₂) y) =
      c * (c⁻¹ * (∫ y, (max ((n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ)) 0 - 0) *
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₁) y) +
        -c⁻¹ * ∫ y, min ((n ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ)) 0 *
          sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p ψ V₂) y) := by
    rw [h1eq, h2eq]
    field_simp
  
  rw [hsum, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc.le]
  refine mul_le_mul_right (ENNReal.ofReal_add_le.trans ?_) _
  refine (add_le_add h₁ h₂).trans ?_
  rw [add_comm]
  exact hsplit.trans (hmono.trans hfam)

signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) : SigmaCompactSpace M

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hA : ∀ n : ℕ, IsCompact {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ (n : ℝ)} := by
    intro n
    have heq : {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ (n : ℝ)} =
        Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (n : ℝ) ∩ {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖} := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      tauto
    rw [heq]
    exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) (n : ℝ)).inter_right
      (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm)
  have hImg : ∀ (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (n : ℕ),
      IsCompact ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ (n : ℝ)}) := by
    intro k n
    have hΦc : ContinuousOn (hAF.ends k).Φ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source :=
      (hAF.ends k).Φ.contMDiffOn.continuousOn
    refine (hA n).image_of_continuousOn (hΦc.mono ?_)
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hx1, _⟩ := hx
    rw [(hAF.ends k).source_eq]
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖
    linarith
  let F : Option (Fin hAF.numEnds × ℕ) → Set M := fun o =>
    match o with
    | none => (⋃ k, (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ
    | some kn => (hAF.ends kn.1).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ (kn.2 : ℝ)}
  refine SigmaCompactSpace.of_countable (Set.range F) (Set.countable_range F) ?_ ?_
  · rintro s ⟨o, rfl⟩
    cases o with
    | none => exact hAF.isCompact_core
    | some kn => exact hImg kn.1 kn.2
  · apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro p
    rw [Set.mem_sUnion]
    by_cases hp : p ∈ (⋃ k, (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ
    · exact ⟨F none, ⟨none, rfl⟩, hp⟩
    · rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not, Set.mem_iUnion] at hp
      obtain ⟨k, x, hx, hxp⟩ := hp
      have hx' : 2 < ‖x‖ := hx
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge ‖x‖
      exact ⟨F (some (k, n)), ⟨some (k, n), rfl⟩, ⟨x, ⟨le_of_lt hx', hn⟩, hxp⟩⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (h : M → ℝ) (hh : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ h) (B : ℝ)
    (ρs : ℕ → ℝ) (hρs : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ≤ ρs n) (W : ℕ → M → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ n : ℕ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (W n))
    (hlap : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M), 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n ≤ ‖y‖} →
      g.lapM (W n) p = h p)
    (hbd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M), 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n < ‖y‖} →
      |W n p| ≤ B)
    (p : M) (hp : 0 < β p) :
    ∃ V : Set M, IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ∀ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ →
      ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (G : M → ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ G ∧
        ∀ q ∈ V, 0 ≤ β q →
          Tendsto (fun m => W (φ (ψ m)) q) atTop (𝓝 (G q)) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun m => partialDeriv i
              (fun y => W (φ (ψ m)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q q)) atTop
            (𝓝 (partialDeriv i (fun y => G ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q q)))) ∧
          (∀ i j : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun m => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
              (fun y => W (φ (ψ m)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) (chartAt E3 q q)) atTop
            (𝓝 (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => G ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)))
              (chartAt E3 q q))))

signature.name: neumann_local_interior
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (h : M → ℝ) (hh : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ h) (B : ℝ)
    (ρs : ℕ → ℝ) (hρs : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ≤ ρs n) (W : ℕ → M → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ n : ℕ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (W n))
    (hlap : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M), 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n ≤ ‖y‖} →
      g.lapM (W n) p = h p)
    (hbd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M), 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n < ‖y‖} →
      |W n p| ≤ B)
    (p : M) (hp : 0 < β p) :
    ∃ V : Set M, IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ∀ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ →
      ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (G : M → ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ G ∧
        ∀ q ∈ V, 0 ≤ β q →
          Tendsto (fun m => W (φ (ψ m)) q) atTop (𝓝 (G q)) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun m => partialDeriv i
              (fun y => W (φ (ψ m)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q q)) atTop
            (𝓝 (partialDeriv i (fun y => G ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q q)))) ∧
          (∀ i j : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun m => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
              (fun y => W (φ (ψ m)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) (chartAt E3 q q)) atTop
            (𝓝 (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => G ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)))
              (chartAt E3 q q))))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hβc : Continuous β := hβ.1.continuous
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, N, hN, hesc⟩ := end_chart_escape g hAF k p
  obtain ⟨N', hN'N, hN'o, hpN'⟩ := mem_nhds_iff.mp hN
  obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt ρ
  obtain ⟨U, hUo, hpU, hUgood⟩ : ∃ U : Set M, IsOpen U ∧ p ∈ U ∧ ∀ x ∈ U, 0 < β x ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → x ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n ≤ ‖y‖} ∧
        x ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n < ‖y‖} := by
    refine ⟨N' ∩ {x | 0 < β x}, hN'o.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hβc), ⟨hpN', hp⟩, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨hx.2, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have h1 : ρ < ρs n := by
      have : (n₀ : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
      linarith [hρs n]
    have hxN : x ∈ N := hN'N hx.1
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩
      have hy' : ρs n ≤ ‖y‖ := hy
      refine hesc y (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 hy') ?_
      rw [hyx]; exact hxN
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩
      have hy' : ρs n < ‖y‖ := hy
      refine hesc y (lt_trans h1 hy') ?_
      rw [hyx]; exact hxN
  
  have hΩo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' U) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 p).open_target hUo
  have hy₀Ω : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' U := by
    refine ⟨mem_chart_target E3 p, ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) ∈ U
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)]
    exact hpU
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩo _ hy₀Ω
  have hballT : Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) R ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target := fun y hy => (hball hy).1
  have hballU : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) R, (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∈ U :=
    fun y hy => (hball hy).2
  
  obtain ⟨hda, hdb, hell, hdu⟩ := nli_chart_data g p
  
  have hCex : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) (R / 2),
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => W n ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y‖ ≤ C := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := nli_interior_bounds (chartAt E3 p p) R hR
      (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹)
      (fun y l => -(∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) l i j y))
      (fun y => h ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      (fun i j => (hda i j).mono hballT) (fun l => (hdb l).mono hballT)
      ((hdu h hh).mono hballT) (fun y hy => hell y (hballT hy)) B m
    refine ⟨C, fun n hn y hy => hC _ ((hdu (W n) (hW n)).mono hballT) ?_ ?_ y hy⟩
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨hβz, hz'⟩ := hUgood _ (hballU z hz)
      exact hbd n _ (le_of_lt hβz) (hz' n hn).2
    · intro z hz
      obtain ⟨hβz, hz'⟩ := hUgood _ (hballU z hz)
      have e := nli_chart_lapM_eq g p (W n) (hW n) z (hballT hz)
      rw [hlap n _ (le_of_lt hβz) (hz' n hn).1] at e
      exact e.symm
  choose C hC using hCex
  
  have hVo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩
      (chartAt E3 p) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) (R / 8)) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 p).open_source Metric.isOpen_ball
  refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) (R / 8), hVo,
    ⟨mem_chart_source E3 p, Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith)⟩, ?_⟩
  intro φ hφ
  have hφge : ∀ j : ℕ, n₀ ≤ φ (j + n₀) := fun j =>
    le_trans (Nat.le_add_left n₀ j) (hφ.id_le (j + n₀))
  
  obtain ⟨f', Bd, hf'c, hf'b, hf'eq, hf'0⟩ := nli_cutoff_bounds (chartAt E3 p p) (R / 2) (R / 8)
    (R / 4) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (fun j z => W (φ (j + n₀)) ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
    (fun j => (hdu _ (hW _)).mono (fun y hy => hballT (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hy)))
    C (fun j m y hy => hC m _ (hφge j) y hy)
  
  obtain ⟨ψ₀, F, hψ₀, hFc, hFconv0, hFconv⟩ := smooth_arzela_ascoli_family (ι := Unit)
    (fun j _ => f' j) Bd (fun j _ => hf'c j) (fun j _ n y => hf'b j n y)
  have hF0 : ∀ y, y ∉ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (R / 4) → F () y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy' : R / 4 ≤ dist y (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, not_le] at hy
      exact le_of_lt hy
    have h1 : Tendsto (fun j => f' (ψ₀ j) y) atTop (𝓝 (F () y)) := hFconv0 () y
    have h2 : (fun j => f' (ψ₀ j) y) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := funext fun j => hf'0 _ y hy'
    rw [h2] at h1
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 tendsto_const_nhds
  
  have hQt : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (R / 4) ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    fun y hy => hballT (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hy)
  obtain ⟨hGs, -⟩ := chart_extend_contMDiff p (F ()) (hFc ()) _ (isCompact_closedBall _ _) hQt hF0
  refine ⟨fun m => ψ₀ m + n₀, (chartAt E3 p).source.indicator (fun x => F () (chartAt E3 p x)),
    hψ₀.add_const n₀, hGs, ?_⟩
  intro q hq _
  
  have hOo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹'
      ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) (R / 8))) :=
    (chartAt E3 q).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 q).open_target hVo
  have hlq : (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) = q :=
    (chartAt E3 q).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 q)
  have hx₀ : chartAt E3 q q ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹'
      ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) (R / 8)) := by
    refine ⟨mem_chart_target E3 q, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, hlq]
    exact hq
  have hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹'
        ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) (R / 8))) := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹'
          ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) (R / 8))) :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart (x := p)).comp ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := q)).mono
        (fun y hy => hy.1)) (fun y hy => hy.2.1)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  obtain ⟨j0, j1, j2⟩ := nli_jet2_comp (fun y => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) _ hOo
    (chartAt E3 q q) hx₀ hτ (fun m => f' (ψ₀ m)) (F ()) (fun m => hf'c _) (hFc ())
    (fun j _ => hFconv () j _)
    (fun m y => W (φ (ψ₀ m + n₀)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
    (fun y => (chartAt E3 p).source.indicator (fun x => F () (chartAt E3 p x))
      ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
    (by
      intro m y hy
      have hx : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := hy.2.1
      have hb : chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) (R / 8) :=
        hy.2.2
      have e : f' (ψ₀ m) (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) =
          W (φ (ψ₀ m + n₀)) ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) :=
        hf'eq (ψ₀ m) _ hb
      rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hx] at e
      exact e.symm)
    (by
      intro y hy
      have hx : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := hy.2.1
      exact Set.indicator_of_mem hx _)
  refine ⟨?_, j1, j2⟩
  have j0' : Tendsto (fun m => W (φ (ψ₀ m + n₀)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q))) atTop
      (𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).source.indicator (fun x => F () (chartAt E3 p x))
        ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q)))) := j0
  rw [hlq] at j0'
  exact j0'

subgoal_signatures.name: end_chart_escape
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∀ p : M, ∃ ρ : ℝ, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∉ N

subgoal_signatures.name: nli_chart_lapM_eq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    g.lapM u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) y
      + ∑ l : Fin 3, (-(∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          christoffel (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) l i j y)) *
          partialDeriv l (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y

subgoal_signatures.name: nli_chart_data
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M) :

    (v : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (hv : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (v n) (Metric.ball y₀ s)) (C : ℕ → ℝ)

subgoal_signatures.name: nli_interior_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(y₀ : E3) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j) (Metric.ball y₀ R))
    (hb : ∀ l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => b y l) (Metric.ball y₀ R))
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Metric.ball y₀ R))
    (hell : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R, ∀ ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ, ξ ≠ 0 →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ξ i * a y i j * ξ j)
    (B : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ v : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v (Metric.ball y₀ R) →
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R, |v y| ≤ B) →
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a y i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j v) y
          + ∑ l : Fin 3, b y l * partialDeriv l v y = f y) →
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (R / 2), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m v y‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: smooth_arzela_ascoli_family

{ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ℕ → ι → E3 → ℝ) (B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ m i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f m i))
    (hb : ∀ m i (n : ℕ) (y : E3), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m i) y‖ ≤ B n) :
    ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (F : ι → E3 → ℝ), StrictMono φ ∧ (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F i)) ∧

    (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ O) (f : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f n)) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (h : M → ℝ) (hh : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ h) (B : ℝ)
    (ρs : ℕ → ℝ) (hρs : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ≤ ρs n) (W : ℕ → M → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ n : ℕ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (W n))
    (hlap : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M), 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n ≤ ‖y‖} →
      g.lapM (W n) p = h p)
    (hneu : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M), β p = 0 → g.gradInner (W n) β p = 0)
    (hbd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : M), 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n < ‖y‖} →
      |W n p| ≤ B)
    (p : M) (hp : β p = 0) :
    ∃ V : Set M, IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ∀ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ →
      ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (G : M → ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ G ∧
        ∀ q ∈ V, 0 ≤ β q →
          Tendsto (fun m => W (φ (ψ m)) q) atTop (𝓝 (G q)) ∧
          (∀ i : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun m => partialDeriv i
              (fun y => W (φ (ψ m)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q q)) atTop
            (𝓝 (partialDeriv i (fun y => G ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q q)))) ∧
          (∀ i j : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun m => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
              (fun y => W (φ (ψ m)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) (chartAt E3 q q)) atTop
            (𝓝 (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => G ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)))
              (chartAt E3 q q))))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hβs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β := hβ.1
  have hreg := hβ.2.1
  
  obtain ⟨Ψ, r₀, hr₀, hsrc, hΨ0, hβΨ⟩ := boundary_flat_chart β hβs p hp (hreg p hp)
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, N, hN, hesc⟩ := end_chart_escape g hAF k p
  have h0 : (0 : E3) ∈ Ψ.source := by rw [hsrc]; exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀
  have hΨc : ContinuousAt Ψ 0 :=
    Ψ.contMDiffOn.continuousOn.continuousAt (Ψ.open_source.mem_nhds h0)
  have hΨN : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 (0 : E3), Ψ z ∈ N :=
    hΨc.preimage_mem_nhds (by rw [hΨ0]; exact hN)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεN⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hΨN
  obtain ⟨r, hrdef⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = min ε r₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hr : 0 < r := by rw [hrdef]; exact lt_min hε hr₀
  have hrr₀ : r ≤ r₀ := by rw [hrdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hrε : r ≤ ε := by rw [hrdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hballsub : Metric.ball (0 : E3) r ⊆ Ψ.source := by
    rw [hsrc]; exact Metric.ball_subset_ball hrr₀
  have hinN : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, Ψ z ∈ N := by
    intro z hz
    apply hεN
    have : dist z 0 < r := hz
    linarith
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt ρ
  have hfar : ∀ n, N₀ ≤ n → ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r,
      Ψ z ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n ≤ ‖y‖} ∧
      Ψ z ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρs n < ‖y‖} := by
    intro n hn z hz
    have h1 : ρ < ρs n := by
      have h2 : (N₀ : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
      linarith [hρs n]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩
      have hy' : ρs n ≤ ‖y‖ := hy
      exact hesc y (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 hy') (by rw [hyz]; exact hinN z hz)
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩
      have hy' : ρs n < ‖y‖ := hy
      exact hesc y (lt_trans h1 hy') (by rw [hyz]; exact hinN z hz)
  
  obtain ⟨hAs, hAsymm, hApd, hΓs⟩ := flat_coeff_regular g Ψ
  have hcomp : ∀ w : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => w (Ψ z)) Ψ.source := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (w ∘ Ψ) Ψ.source :=
      hw.comp_contMDiffOn Ψ.contMDiffOn
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  have hbS : ∀ l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => -∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel (g.coeff Ψ) l i j z) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) r) := by
    intro l
    refine ContDiffOn.neg ?_
    refine ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => ?_))
    exact ((hAs i j).mul (hΓs l i j)).mono hballsub
  have heqS : ∀ n, N₀ ≤ n → ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, 0 ≤ z 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => W n (Ψ y))) z
        + ∑ l : Fin 3, (-∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel (g.coeff Ψ) l i j z) *
          partialDeriv l (fun y => W n (Ψ y)) z = h (Ψ z) := by
    intro n hn z hz hz0
    have hzs : z ∈ Ψ.source := hballsub hz
    have hβz : 0 ≤ β (Ψ z) := by
      rw [hβΨ z (Metric.ball_subset_ball hrr₀ hz)]; exact hz0
    have h1 := hlap n (Ψ z) hβz (hfar n hn z hz).1
    have hinv := lapLocal_chart_invariant g Ψ (W n) Set.univ isOpen_univ
      (hW n).contMDiffOn z hzs trivial
    have e2 : lapM g (W n) (Ψ z) = g.lapM (W n) (Ψ z) := rfl
    rw [e2, h1] at hinv
    rw [← hinv]
    unfold lapLocal
    simp only [Function.comp_def, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hπ : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, ∀ j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv j (fun y => β (Ψ y)) z = if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro z hz j
    have hev : (fun y => β (Ψ y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (fun y : E3 => y 0) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.ball_subset_ball hrr₀ hz)] with y hy
      exact hβΨ y hy
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => β (Ψ y)) z (e j) = _
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    show fderiv ℝ (⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) z (e j) = _
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    show (e j) 0 = _
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, eq_comm]
  have hbcS : ∀ n, N₀ ≤ n → ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, z 0 = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i 0 * partialDeriv i (fun y => W n (Ψ y)) z = 0 := by
    intro n _ z hz hz0
    have hzs : z ∈ Ψ.source := hballsub hz
    have hβz : β (Ψ z) = 0 := by
      rw [hβΨ z (Metric.ball_subset_ball hrr₀ hz)]; exact hz0
    have h1 := hneu n (Ψ z) hβz
    rw [gradInner_flat_chart g Ψ (W n) β (hW n) hβs z hzs] at h1
    simp only [hπ z hz] at h1
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h1 ⊢
    simpa using h1
  have hbdS : ∀ n, N₀ ≤ n → ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, 0 ≤ z 0 → |W n (Ψ z)| ≤ B := by
    intro n hn z hz hz0
    have hβz : 0 ≤ β (Ψ z) := by
      rw [hβΨ z (Metric.ball_subset_ball hrr₀ hz)]; exact hz0
    exact hbd n (Ψ z) hβz (hfar n hn z hz).2
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsr, hCm⟩ := conormal_halfball_estimates r hr (fun z => (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹)
    (fun i j => (hAs i j).mono hballsub) (fun z hz i j => hAsymm z (hballsub hz) i j)
    (fun z hz => hApd z (hballsub hz))
    (fun z l => -∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel (g.coeff Ψ) l i j z)
    hbS (fun z => h (Ψ z)) ((hcomp h hh).mono hballsub) B (fun n z => W n (Ψ z))
    (fun n => (hcomp (W n) (hW n)).mono hballsub) N₀ heqS hbcS hbdS
  choose C hC using hCm
  
  have hs₁pos : 0 < s / 4 := by linarith
  refine ⟨Ψ.target ∩ Ψ.symm ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : E3) (s / 4), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Ψ.symm.contMDiffOn.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Ψ.open_target
      Metric.isOpen_ball
  · rw [← hΨ0]
    refine ⟨Ψ.toPartialEquiv.map_source h0, ?_⟩
    show Ψ.symm (Ψ 0) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (s / 4)
    rw [show Ψ.symm (Ψ 0) = 0 from Ψ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv h0]
    exact Metric.mem_ball_self hs₁pos
  · intro φ hφ
    have hφN : ∀ n, N₀ ≤ φ (n + N₀) := fun n =>
      le_trans (Nat.le_add_left N₀ n) (hφ.id_le (n + N₀))
    have hballs : Metric.ball (0 : E3) s ⊆ Ψ.source := fun z hz =>
      hballsub (Metric.ball_subset_ball hsr.le hz)
    obtain ⟨ψ', F, hψ', hF, hconv⟩ := halfball_jet_compactness s hs
      (fun n z => W (φ (n + N₀)) (Ψ z))
      (fun n => (hcomp (W (φ (n + N₀))) (hW _)).mono hballs) C
      (fun m n z hz hz0 => hC m (φ (n + N₀)) (hφN n) z hz hz0)
    have hsub2 : Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (s / 2) ⊆ Ψ.source := by
      intro z hz
      apply hballsub
      have : dist z 0 ≤ s / 2 := hz
      show dist z 0 < r
      linarith
    obtain ⟨G, hG, hGF⟩ := flat_limit_globalize Ψ F hF (s / 4) (s / 2) hs₁pos (by linarith) hsub2
    refine ⟨fun m => ψ' m + N₀, G, ?_, hG, ?_⟩
    · intro a b hab
      show ψ' a + N₀ < ψ' b + N₀
      exact Nat.add_lt_add_right (hψ' hab) N₀
    · rintro q ⟨hqt, hqs⟩ hq0
      obtain ⟨z, hzdef⟩ : ∃ z : E3, z = Ψ.symm q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hzq : Ψ z = q := by rw [hzdef]; exact Ψ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hqt
      have hzball : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (s / 4) := by rw [hzdef]; exact hqs
      have hzr : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r := Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hzball
      have hzs : z ∈ Ψ.source := hballsub hzr
      have hz0 : 0 ≤ z 0 := by
        rw [← hβΨ z (Metric.ball_subset_ball hrr₀ hzr), hzq]; exact hq0
      have hnorm : ‖z‖ < s / 4 := by
        have := hzball
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at this
        exact this
      have hevG : (fun y => G (Ψ y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] F := by
        filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzball] with y hy
        exact hGF y hy
      have hconv' : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ 2 → Tendsto (fun n => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m
          (fun y => W (φ (ψ' n + N₀)) (Ψ y)) z) atTop
          (𝓝 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => G (Ψ y)) z)) := by
        intro m _
        rw [(hevG.iteratedFDeriv ℝ m).eq_of_nhds]
        exact hconv m z hnorm hz0
      have key := jet2_transfer Ψ z hzs (fun n => W (φ (ψ' n + N₀))) (fun n => hW _) G hG hconv'
      rw [hzq] at key
      exact key

subgoal_signatures.name: lapLocal_chart_invariant
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) (hxV : Φ x ∈ V) :
    lapLocal (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) x = lapM g f (Φ x)

subgoal_signatures.name: boundary_flat_chart
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (β : M → ℝ)
    (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β) (p : M) (hp : β p = 0)
    (hreg : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (Ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (r : ℝ), 0 < r ∧
      Ψ.source = Metric.ball (0 : E3) r ∧ Ψ 0 = p ∧
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, β (Ψ z) = z 0

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_flat_chart
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w)
    (z : E3) (hz : z ∈ Ψ.source) :
    g.gradInner u w (Ψ z) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun y => u (Ψ y)) z * partialDeriv j (fun y => w (Ψ y)) z

subgoal_signatures.name: flat_coeff_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) :
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j) Ψ.source) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Ψ.source, ∀ i j : Fin 3, (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j = (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ j i) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Ψ.source, ((g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹).PosDef) ∧
    (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel (g.coeff Ψ) k i j) Ψ.source)

subgoal_signatures.name: conormal_halfball_estimates
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => A z i j) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) r))
    (hsymm : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, ∀ i j : Fin 3, A z i j = A z j i)
    (hpd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, (A z).PosDef)
    (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hb : ∀ l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => b z l) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) r))
    (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Metric.ball (0 : E3) r)) (B : ℝ)
    (u : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (hu : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u n) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) r)) (N₀ : ℕ)
    (heq : ∀ n, N₀ ≤ n → ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, 0 ≤ z 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A z i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (u n)) z
        + ∑ l : Fin 3, b z l * partialDeriv l (u n) z = f z)
    (hbc : ∀ n, N₀ ≤ n → ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, z 0 = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, A z i 0 * partialDeriv i (u n) z = 0)
    (hbd : ∀ n, N₀ ≤ n → ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, 0 ≤ z 0 → |u n z| ≤ B) :
    ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s < r ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ n, N₀ ≤ n → ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ < s → 0 ≤ z 0 →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (u n) z‖ ≤ C

subgoal_signatures.name: halfball_jet_compactness
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (v : ℕ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (v n) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) s)) (C : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (z : E3), ‖z‖ < s → 0 ≤ z 0 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (v n) z‖ ≤ C m) :
    ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (F : E3 → ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ F ∧
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : E3), ‖z‖ < s / 4 → 0 ≤ z 0 →
        Tendsto (fun k => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (v (ψ k)) z) atTop (𝓝 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m F z))

subgoal_signatures.name: flat_limit_globalize
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (Ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (F : E3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (t₁ t₂ : ℝ) (ht₁ : 0 < t₁) (ht : t₁ < t₂)
    (hsub : Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) t₂ ⊆ Ψ.source) :
    ∃ G : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ G ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) t₁, G (Ψ z) = F z

subgoal_signatures.name: jet2_transfer
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (Ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (z : E3) (hz : z ∈ Ψ.source)
    (u : ℕ → M → ℝ) (hu : ∀ n, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u n))
    (v : M → ℝ) (hv : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v)
    (hconv : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ 2 → Tendsto (fun n => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => u n (Ψ y)) z) atTop
      (𝓝 (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => v (Ψ y)) z))) :
    Tendsto (fun n => u n (Ψ z)) atTop (𝓝 (v (Ψ z))) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun n => partialDeriv i
        (fun y => u n ((chartAt E3 (Ψ z)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Ψ z) (Ψ z))) atTop
      (𝓝 (partialDeriv i (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 (Ψ z)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (Ψ z) (Ψ z))))) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun n => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
        (fun y => u n ((chartAt E3 (Ψ z)).symm y))) (chartAt E3 (Ψ z) (Ψ z))) atTop
      (𝓝 (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 (Ψ z)).symm y)))
        (chartAt E3 (Ψ z) (Ψ z)))))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hext' : ∀ (j : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ), ∃ ψ : ℕ → ℕ,
      StrictMono f → StrictMono ψ ∧ Q j (f ∘ ψ) := by
    intro j f
    by_cases hf : StrictMono f
    · obtain ⟨ψ, h1, h2⟩ := hext j f hf
      exact ⟨ψ, fun _ => ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨id, fun h => absurd h hf⟩
  choose ψ hψ using hext'
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘ0, hΘs⟩ : ∃ Θ : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ, Θ 0 = id ∧ ∀ j, Θ (j + 1) = Θ j ∘ ψ j (Θ j) :=
    ⟨fun j => Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => ℕ → ℕ) id (fun i f => f ∘ ψ i f) j, rfl,
      fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hA : ∀ j, StrictMono (Θ j) := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero => rw [hΘ0]; exact strictMono_id
    | succ i ih => rw [hΘs]; exact ih.comp (hψ i (Θ i) ih).1
  have hB : ∀ j, Q j (Θ (j + 1)) := fun j => by
    rw [hΘs]; exact (hψ j (Θ j) (hA j)).2
  have hC : ∀ j n, n ≤ ψ j (Θ j) n := fun j n => StrictMono.id_le (hψ j (Θ j) (hA j)).1 n
  have hR : ∀ j l n, ∃ m, Θ (j + l) n = Θ j m := by
    intro j l
    induction l with
    | zero => intro n; exact ⟨n, rfl⟩
    | succ l ih =>
      intro n
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ih (ψ (j + l) (Θ (j + l)) n)
      refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
      rw [show j + (l + 1) = (j + l) + 1 from rfl, hΘs, Function.comp_apply]
      exact hm
  obtain ⟨φ, hφdef⟩ : ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, ∀ n, φ n = Θ (n + 1) n := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hφ : StrictMono φ := by
    refine strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun n => ?_
    rw [hφdef, hφdef, hΘs (n + 1), Function.comp_apply]
    exact hA (n + 1) (lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self n) (hC (n + 1) (n + 1)))
  refine ⟨φ, hφ, fun j => ?_⟩
  choose σ hσ using fun l => hR (j + 1) l (l + j)
  have e : ∀ l, φ (l + j) = Θ (j + 1) (σ l) := by
    intro l
    rw [hφdef, ← hσ l, show l + j + 1 = j + 1 + l by omega]
  have hσm : StrictMono σ := by
    refine strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun l => ?_
    have h : φ (l + j) < φ (l + 1 + j) := hφ (by omega)
    rw [e, e] at h
    exact (hA (j + 1)).lt_iff_lt.mp h
  have htail : (fun n => φ (n + j)) = Θ (j + 1) ∘ σ := funext fun l => e l
  apply hshift j φ j
  rw [htail]
  exact hsub j _ σ hσm (hB j)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hpd1 : ∀ (f₁ f₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (k : Fin 3), f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] f₂ →
      partialDeriv k f₁ y = partialDeriv k f₂ y := by
    intro f₁ f₂ y k h
    show fderiv ℝ f₁ y (e k) = fderiv ℝ f₂ y (e k)
    rw [h.fderiv_eq]
  have hjet : ∀ (f₁ f₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), f₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] f₂ →
      f₁ y = f₂ y ∧ (∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k f₁ y = partialDeriv k f₂ y) ∧
      ∀ k l : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l f₁) y = partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l f₂) y := by
    intro f₁ f₂ y h
    refine ⟨h.eq_of_nhds, fun k => hpd1 f₁ f₂ y k h, fun k l => ?_⟩
    apply hpd1
    filter_upwards [h.eventuallyEq_nhds] with z hz
    exact hpd1 f₁ f₂ z l hz
  have hadd : ∀ (A B : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (k : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ A y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ B y →
      partialDeriv k (fun z => A z + B z) y = partialDeriv k A y + partialDeriv k B y := by
    intro A B y k hA hB
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => A z + B z) y (e k) = fderiv ℝ A y (e k) + fderiv ℝ B y (e k)
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hA hB]
    rfl
  
  have hleib : ∀ (S : Finset (Option ℕ)) (a f : Option ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (W : Set E3), IsOpen W →
      ∀ y ∈ W, (∀ i ∈ S, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (a i) W) → (∀ i ∈ S, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) W) →
      (∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => ∑ i ∈ S, a i z * f i z) y =
          ∑ i ∈ S, (a i y * partialDeriv k (f i) y + partialDeriv k (a i) y * f i y)) ∧
      (∀ k l : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l (fun z => ∑ i ∈ S, a i z * f i z)) y =
          ∑ i ∈ S, (a i y * partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l (f i)) y
            + partialDeriv k (a i) y * partialDeriv l (f i) y
            + partialDeriv l (a i) y * partialDeriv k (f i) y
            + partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l (a i)) y * f i y)) := by
    intro S a f W hW y hy ha hf
    have hD : ∀ g : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → ∀ z ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ g z :=
      fun g hg z hz => (hg.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hP : ∀ g : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → ∀ l : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv l g) W := by
      intro g hg l
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ g z) W := hg.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
      exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hfirst : ∀ (b c : Option ℕ → E3 → ℝ), (∀ i ∈ S, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (b i) W) →
        (∀ i ∈ S, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (c i) W) → ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ l : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv l (fun z => ∑ i ∈ S, b i z * c i z) z =
          ∑ i ∈ S, (b i z * partialDeriv l (c i) z + partialDeriv l (b i) z * c i z) := by
      intro b c hb hc z hz l
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum (A := fun i y => b i y * c i y)
        (fun i hi => (hD _ (hb i hi) z hz).mul (hD _ (hc i hi) z hz))]
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
      rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hD _ (hb i hi) z hz) (hD _ (hc i hi) z hz)]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    refine ⟨fun k => hfirst a f ha hf y hy k, fun k l => ?_⟩
    have hev : partialDeriv l (fun z => ∑ i ∈ S, a i z * f i z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        fun z => (∑ i ∈ S, a i z * partialDeriv l (f i) z) +
          ∑ i ∈ S, partialDeriv l (a i) z * f i z := by
      filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      rw [hfirst a f ha hf z hz l, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ∑ i ∈ S, a i z * partialDeriv l (f i) z) y := by
      apply DifferentiableAt.fun_sum
      intro i hi
      exact (hD _ (ha i hi) y hy).mul (hD _ (hP _ (hf i hi) l) y hy)
    have hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ∑ i ∈ S, partialDeriv l (a i) z * f i z) y := by
      apply DifferentiableAt.fun_sum
      intro i hi
      exact (hD _ (hP _ (ha i hi) l) y hy).mul (hD _ (hf i hi) y hy)
    have h1 := hfirst a (fun i => partialDeriv l (f i)) ha (fun i hi => hP _ (hf i hi) l) y hy k
    have h2 := hfirst (fun i => partialDeriv l (a i)) f (fun i hi => hP _ (ha i hi) l) hf y hy k
    rw [hpd1 _ _ y k hev, hadd _ _ y k hA hB, h1, h2, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨U, hUn, hUs⟩ : ∃ U : Option ℕ → Set M, U none = Eᶜ ∧ ∀ j, U (some j) = V j :=
    ⟨fun i => Option.elim i Eᶜ V, rfl, fun j => rfl⟩
  have hUo : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i) := by
    intro i
    cases i with
    | none => rw [hUn]; exact hE.isOpen_compl
    | some j => rw [hUs]; exact hV j
  have hUc : (Set.univ : Set M) ⊆ ⋃ i, U i := by
    intro x _
    by_cases hx : x ∈ E
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hcov hx)
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨some j, by rw [hUs]; exact hj⟩
    · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨none, by rw [hUn]; exact hx⟩
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := SmoothPartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate 𝓘(ℝ, E3) isClosed_univ U hUo hUc
  
  obtain ⟨Gh, hGn, hGs⟩ : ∃ Gh : Option ℕ → M → ℝ, Gh none = (fun _ => 0) ∧
      ∀ j, Gh (some j) = G j :=
    ⟨fun i => Option.elim i (fun _ => 0) G, rfl, fun j => rfl⟩
  have hGsm : ∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (Gh i) := by
    intro i
    cases i with
    | none => rw [hGn]; exact contMDiff_const
    | some j => rw [hGs]; exact hG j
  
  obtain ⟨w, hwdef⟩ : ∃ w : M → ℝ, w = fun x => ∑ᶠ i, χ i x • Gh i x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hwdef]
    exact χ.contMDiff_finsum_smul (n := ⊤) (fun i x _ => (hGsm i).contMDiffAt)
  intro q hqE
  
  have hloc : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 q, (∑ i ∈ χ.fintsupport q, χ i x = 1) ∧
      ∀ F : Option ℕ → M → ℝ, ∑ᶠ i, χ i x * F i x = ∑ i ∈ χ.fintsupport q, χ i x * F i x := by
    filter_upwards [χ.eventually_fintsupport_subset q] with x hx
    have hsupp : ∀ F : Option ℕ → M → ℝ,
        ∑ᶠ i, χ i x * F i x = ∑ i ∈ χ.fintsupport q, χ i x * F i x := by
      intro F
      apply finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset
      intro i hi
      have h1 : χ i x ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hi
      exact hx ((χ.mem_fintsupport_iff x i).mpr (subset_tsupport _ h1))
    refine ⟨?_, hsupp⟩
    have h1 := hsupp (fun _ _ => 1)
    simp only [mul_one] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    exact χ.sum_eq_one (Set.mem_univ x)
  
  have hS : ∀ i ∈ χ.fintsupport q, ∃ j, i = some j ∧ q ∈ V j := by
    intro i hi
    have h1 : q ∈ tsupport (χ i) := (χ.mem_fintsupport_iff q i).mp hi
    have h2 := hχ i h1
    cases i with
    | none => rw [hUn] at h2; exact absurd hqE h2
    | some j => rw [hUs] at h2; exact ⟨j, rfl, h2⟩
  
  have hy₀t : chartAt E3 q q ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := mem_chart_target E3 q
  have hcq : (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) = q :=
    (chartAt E3 q).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 q)
  have htend : Tendsto (chartAt E3 q).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 q q)) (𝓝 q) := by
    have := ((chartAt E3 q).continuousAt_symm hy₀t).tendsto
    rwa [hcq] at this
  have hloc' := htend.eventually hloc
  have hpb : ∀ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    fun f hf => contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hJ : ∀ i ∈ χ.fintsupport q,
      Tendsto (fun n => u n q) atTop (𝓝 (Gh i q)) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun n => partialDeriv k (fun y => u n ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
          (chartAt E3 q q)) atTop
        (𝓝 (partialDeriv k (fun y => Gh i ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q q)))) ∧
      (∀ k l : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun n => partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l
          (fun y => u n ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) (chartAt E3 q q)) atTop
        (𝓝 (partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l (fun y => Gh i ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)))
          (chartAt E3 q q)))) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨j, rfl, hqV⟩ := hS i hi
    rw [hGs]
    exact hconv j q hqV hqE
  
  have hw_ev : (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 q q)]
      fun z => ∑ i ∈ χ.fintsupport q,
        χ i ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) * Gh i ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) := by
    filter_upwards [hloc'] with z hz
    rw [hwdef]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    exact hz.2 Gh
  have hu_ev : ∀ n, (fun y => u n ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 q q)]
      fun z => ∑ i ∈ χ.fintsupport q,
        χ i ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) * u n ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) := by
    intro n
    filter_upwards [hloc'] with z hz
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hz.1, one_mul]
  have hχs : ∀ i ∈ χ.fintsupport q,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => χ i ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    fun i _ => hpb _ (χ i).contMDiff
  have hLw := hleib (χ.fintsupport q) (fun i z => χ i ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
    (fun i z => Gh i ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target (chartAt E3 q).open_target
    (chartAt E3 q q) hy₀t hχs (fun i _ => hpb _ (hGsm i))
  have hLu := fun n => hleib (χ.fintsupport q) (fun i z => χ i ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
    (fun _ z => u n ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target (chartAt E3 q).open_target
    (chartAt E3 q q) hy₀t hχs (fun _ _ => hpb _ (hu n))
  have hcw := hjet _ _ _ hw_ev
  have hcu := fun n => hjet _ _ _ (hu_ev n)
  have hval : ∀ i ∈ χ.fintsupport q, Tendsto (fun n => u n ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q)))
      atTop (𝓝 (Gh i ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q)))) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hcq]
    exact (hJ i hi).1
  refine ⟨?_, fun k => ?_, fun k l => ?_⟩
  · 
    have hwq : w q = ∑ i ∈ χ.fintsupport q, χ i q * Gh i q := by
      have := (hloc.self_of_nhds).2 Gh
      rw [hwdef]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      exact this
    rw [hwq]
    refine Tendsto.congr (fun n => ?_) (tendsto_finset_sum _ (fun i hi => ((hJ i hi).1.const_mul (χ i q))))
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, (hloc.self_of_nhds).1, one_mul]
  · 
    rw [hcw.2.1 k, hLw.1 k]
    refine Tendsto.congr (fun n => (((hcu n).2.1 k).trans ((hLu n).1 k)).symm) ?_
    refine tendsto_finset_sum _ (fun i hi => ?_)
    exact (((hJ i hi).2.1 k).const_mul _).add ((hval i hi).const_mul _)
  · 
    rw [hcw.2.2 k l, hLw.2 k l]
    refine Tendsto.congr (fun n => (((hcu n).2.2 k l).trans ((hLu n).2 k l)).symm) ?_
    refine tendsto_finset_sum _ (fun i hi => ?_)
    exact (((((hJ i hi).2.2 k l).const_mul _).add (((hJ i hi).2.1 l).const_mul _)).add
      (((hJ i hi).2.1 k).const_mul _)).add ((hval i hi).const_mul _)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (ρ : M → ℝ) (r₁ η : ℝ) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ)
    (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p) (hη : 0 < η)
    (Ω : Set M) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (hφ : calPartition q φ Ω)
    (O : Set M) (hO : IsOpen O) (hφ1 : ∀ x ∈ O, ∑ j, φ j x = 1)
    (F : Set M) (hF : sepChartMeas F) (hFU : sepChartMeas (F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}))
    (hFO : ∀ x ∈ F, r₁ < ρ x → x ∈ O)
    (Y V Z : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (hY1 : ∀ x, g.g x (Y x) (Y x) ≤ 1)
    (hZ : calSmoothField Z)
    (hVZ : ∀ q' : M, ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q').target, ∀ wV wY wZ : E3,
      wV = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q') ((chartAt E3 q').symm y)
        (V ((chartAt E3 q').symm y)) →
      wY = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q') ((chartAt E3 q').symm y)
        (Y ((chartAt E3 q').symm y)) →
      wZ = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q') ((chartAt E3 q').symm y)
        (Z ((chartAt E3 q').symm y)) →
      ∀ i : Fin 3,
        wV i = (1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q').symm y))) * wY i +
          calSigma ρ r₁ (∅ : Set M) ((chartAt E3 q').symm y) *
            calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q').symm y)) *
            calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) y i ∧
        wZ i = calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 q').symm y)) *
            calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 q').symm z)) y i) :
    (∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source))) ∧
    ∑ j, ((∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
            calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) *
              (φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
                Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det)) +
          ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
            (1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y))) *
              sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) y) ≤
      ∑ j, ((∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
            sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) V) y) -
          ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F \ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
            sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) y)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hρc : Continuous ρ := hρ.continuous
  have hU1 : IsOpen {x : M | r₁ < ρ x} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hρc
  have hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ (∅ : Set M)) := by
    rw [Set.diff_empty]; exact hU1
  have hφs : ∀ j, tsupport (φ j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source :=
    fun j x hx => ((hφ.2.2.2 j).2 hx).2
  have hsd : symmDiff F (∅ : Set M) = F := symmDiff_bot F
  have hθc : Continuous (calTheta r₁ η) := by
    show Continuous (fun t => Real.smoothTransition (2 * ((t - r₁) / η) - 1))
    exact Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp (by fun_prop)
  have hθ0 : ∀ t, 0 ≤ calTheta r₁ η t := fun t => Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
  have hθ1 : ∀ t, calTheta r₁ η t ≤ 1 := fun t => Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
  have hj : ∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source)) ∧
      (∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
            calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) *
              (φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
                Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det)) +
          (∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det *
              fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) y
                (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j)) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)
                  (Z ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) : E3)) +
          ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
            (1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y))) *
              sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) y ≤
        (∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
            sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) V) y) -
          ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F \ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
            sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) y := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := cal_chart_step g ρ r₁ η ∅ F hρ hmc (Set.empty_subset _) isOpen_empty
      hBo hF hη (q j) (φ j) (hφ.1 j) (hφ.2.1 j) (hφ.2.2.2 j).1 (hφs j) Y V Z hY hY1 (hVZ (q j))
    rw [hsd] at c1 c2 c3
    rw [Set.union_empty] at c3
    have hSm : MeasurableSet
        (chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source)) := hFU (q j)
    have hσ : ∀ y ∈ chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
        calSigma ρ r₁ (∅ : Set M) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) = 1 := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨⟨-, hxU⟩, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [(chartAt E3 (q j)).left_inv hxs]
      have hx' : x ∈ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ (∅ : Set M) := ⟨hxU, Set.notMem_empty x⟩
      simp only [calSigma, Set.indicator_of_mem hx', Set.indicator_empty, sub_zero]
    have hsubT : chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source) ⊆
        (chartAt E3 (q j)).target := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact (chartAt E3 (q j)).map_source hx.2
    have hθm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)))
        (volume.restrict
          (chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source))) :=
      (((hθc.comp hρc).comp_continuousOn (chartAt E3 (q j)).continuousOn_symm).mono hsubT
        ).aestronglyMeasurable hSm
    have hθb : ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict
          (chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source))),
        ‖calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y))‖ ≤ 1 := by
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
      have h0 := hθ0 (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y))
      have h1 := hθ1 (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y))
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hθσ := Integrable.bdd_mul c2 hθm hθb
    have hmerge := integral_sub c2 hθσ
    have hcong : ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
        (calSigma ρ r₁ (∅ : Set M) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
            sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) y -
          calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) *
            (calSigma ρ r₁ (∅ : Set M) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
              sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) y)) =
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' ((F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
          (1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y))) *
            sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) y := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hSm (fun y hy => ?_)
      rw [hσ y hy]
      ring
    refine ⟨c1, ?_⟩
    linarith
  have hcanc := cal_partition_div_cancel g Ω q φ hφ O hO hφ1 Z hZ (F ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) hFU
    (fun x hx => hFO x hx.1 hx.2)
  refine ⟨fun j => (hj j).1, ?_⟩
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) => (hj j).2)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hsum ⊢
  linarith

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (ρ : M → ℝ) (r₁ η : ℝ) (A F : Set M) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ)
    (hmc : ∀ p : M, r₁ ≤ ρ p → 0 < g.levelMeanCurv ρ p)
    (hAsub : A ⊆ {p : M | r₁ < ρ p}) (hAo : IsOpen A)
    (hBo : IsOpen ({p : M | r₁ < ρ p} \ A)) (hF : sepChartMeas F) (hη : 0 < η)
    (p : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (hφ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ) (hφ0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x)
    (hφc : IsCompact (tsupport φ)) (hφp : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).source)
    (Y V Z : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (hY1 : ∀ x, g.g x (Y x) (Y x) ≤ 1)
    (hVZ : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, ∀ wV wY wZ : E3,
        wV = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          (V ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) →
        wY = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) →
        wZ = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) →
        ∀ i : Fin 3,
          wV i = (1 - calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) * wY i +
            calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y i ∧
          wZ i = calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
              calUnitNormal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y i) :
    IntegrableOn (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)
      (chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ∧
    IntegrableOn (fun y => calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y)
      (chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)) ∧
    (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
          (φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) * g.levelMeanCurv ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det)) +
      (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
              (Z ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) +
      ((∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
          calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
            sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y) -
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' ((symmDiff F A ∩ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
          calTheta r₁ η (ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) *
            (calSigma ρ r₁ A ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) *
              sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y)) ≤
    (∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ V) y) -
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (((F \ {x : M | r₁ < ρ x}) ∪ A) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source),
        sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (calPiece p φ Y) y

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hH, hInt⟩ := calPiece_regular g q ψ hψ hψc hψs W hW
  set κ := chartAt E3 q with hκ
  have hKc : IsCompact (κ '' tsupport ψ) :=
    hψc.image_of_continuousOn (κ.continuousOn.mono hψs)
  have hKo : IsOpen (κ '' tsupport ψ)ᶜ := hKc.isClosed.isOpen_compl
  have hX0 : ∀ z, z ∉ κ '' tsupport ψ → calPiece q ψ W z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    unfold calPiece
    by_cases hzt : z ∈ κ.target
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hzt]
      have hψz : ψ (κ.symm z) = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        apply hz
        refine ⟨κ.symm z, subset_tsupport ψ hne, κ.right_inv hzt⟩
      simp only [← hκ, hψz, zero_smul]
    · exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hzt _
  have hb : ∀ y, y ∉ κ '' tsupport ψ →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff κ.symm) (calPiece q ψ W) y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
    unfold partialDeriv
    have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff κ.symm z).det * calPiece q ψ W z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [hKo.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      rw [hX0 z hz]
      simp
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have hDc : Continuous (sepDensDiv (g.coeff κ.symm) (calPiece q ψ W)) := by
    unfold sepDensDiv
    refine continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    unfold partialDeriv
    exact ((hH i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  refine ⟨hInt, hb, fun v hv => ?_⟩
  refine (hv.mul_continuousOn hDc.continuousOn hKc).integrable_of_forall_notMem_eq_zero ?_
  intro y hy
  simp only [hb y hy, mul_zero]

informal_problem.statement:
(p : M) (u : M → ℤ) (hu0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ u x) (E : Set M)
    (hE : MeasurableSet (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)))
    (hlev : ∀ m : ℕ, MeasurableSet
      (chartAt E3 p '' ({x : M | (m : ℤ) + 1 ≤ u x} ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)))
    (P : E3 → ℝ) (hP : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn P (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source)))
    (huP : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => (u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) : ℝ) * P y)
      (chartAt E3 p '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source))) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N,
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 p '' (({x : M | (m : ℤ) + 1 ≤ u x} ∩ E) ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source), P y)
