        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hw1) (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg (h t)) (sq_nonneg (h' t))),
        mul_nonneg hinv (sq_nonneg (h' t))]
    have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => h t ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume a (a + τ) := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable; rw [hu]; exact hhc.pow 2
    have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => h' t ^ 2) MeasureTheory.volume a (a + τ) := by
      apply ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable; rw [hu]; exact hc'.pow 2
    have hmono : (∫ t in a..a + τ, -((-1 / τ) * (h t * h t) +
        (a + τ - t) / τ * (h' t * h t + h t * h' t))) ≤
        ∫ t in a..a + τ, (1 + 1 / τ) * (h t ^ 2 + h' t ^ 2) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hle hψc.intervalIntegrable.neg
        ((hi1.add hi2).const_mul (1 + 1 / τ)) hpt
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_add hi1 hi2] at hmono
    rw [key]; exact hmono
  
  have int2 : ∀ (a K : ℝ) (u v₁ v₂ : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn u (Set.Icc a (a + τ)) →
      ContinuousOn v₁ (Set.Icc a (a + τ)) → ContinuousOn v₂ (Set.Icc a (a + τ)) →
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + τ), u x ≤ K * (v₁ x + v₂ x)) →
      (∫ x in a..a + τ, u x) ≤ K * ((∫ x in a..a + τ, v₁ x) + ∫ x in a..a + τ, v₂ x) := by
    intro a K u v₁ v₂ hu hv₁ hv₂ hle
    have hu' : Set.uIcc a (a + τ) = Set.Icc a (a + τ) := Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)
    have i0 : IntervalIntegrable u MeasureTheory.volume a (a + τ) :=
      ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (by rw [hu']; exact hu)
    have i1 : IntervalIntegrable v₁ MeasureTheory.volume a (a + τ) :=
      ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (by rw [hu']; exact hv₁)
    have i2 : IntervalIntegrable v₂ MeasureTheory.volume a (a + τ) :=
      ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (by rw [hu']; exact hv₂)
    calc (∫ x in a..a + τ, u x) ≤ ∫ x in a..a + τ, K * (v₁ x + v₂ x) :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by linarith) i0 ((i1.add i2).const_mul K) hle
      _ = _ := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_add i1 i2]
  have int4 : ∀ (a K : ℝ) (u v₁ v₂ v₃ v₄ : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn u (Set.Icc a (a + τ)) →
      ContinuousOn v₁ (Set.Icc a (a + τ)) → ContinuousOn v₂ (Set.Icc a (a + τ)) →
      ContinuousOn v₃ (Set.Icc a (a + τ)) → ContinuousOn v₄ (Set.Icc a (a + τ)) →
      (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a (a + τ), u x ≤ K * (v₁ x + v₂ x + v₃ x + v₄ x)) →
      (∫ x in a..a + τ, u x) ≤ K * ((∫ x in a..a + τ, v₁ x) + (∫ x in a..a + τ, v₂ x) +
        (∫ x in a..a + τ, v₃ x) + ∫ x in a..a + τ, v₄ x) := by
    intro a K u v₁ v₂ v₃ v₄ hu hv₁ hv₂ hv₃ hv₄ hle
    have hu' : Set.uIcc a (a + τ) = Set.Icc a (a + τ) := Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)
    have i0 : IntervalIntegrable u MeasureTheory.volume a (a + τ) :=
      ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (by rw [hu']; exact hu)
    have i1 : IntervalIntegrable v₁ MeasureTheory.volume a (a + τ) :=
      ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (by rw [hu']; exact hv₁)
    have i2 : IntervalIntegrable v₂ MeasureTheory.volume a (a + τ) :=
      ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (by rw [hu']; exact hv₂)
    have i3 : IntervalIntegrable v₃ MeasureTheory.volume a (a + τ) :=
      ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (by rw [hu']; exact hv₃)
    have i4 : IntervalIntegrable v₄ MeasureTheory.volume a (a + τ) :=
      ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (by rw [hu']; exact hv₄)
    calc (∫ x in a..a + τ, u x) ≤ ∫ x in a..a + τ, K * (v₁ x + v₂ x + v₃ x + v₄ x) :=
          intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by linarith) i0
            ((((i1.add i2).add i3).add i4).const_mul K) hle
      _ = _ := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_add ((i1.add i2).add i3) i4,
          intervalIntegral.integral_add (i1.add i2) i3, intervalIntegral.integral_add i1 i2]
  
  have sq : ∀ (F F1 F2 F21 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ),
        ContinuousOn (F2 s) (Set.Icc x₂ (x₂ + τ)) ∧ ContinuousOn (F21 s) (Set.Icc x₂ (x₂ + τ))) →
      (ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F s r ^ 2) (Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ)) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F1 s r ^ 2) (Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ)) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F2 s r ^ 2) (Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ)) ∧
        ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F21 s r ^ 2) (Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ))) →
      ContinuousOn (fun s => F1 s x₂) (Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ)) →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ), HasDerivAt (fun s' => F s' x₂) (F1 s x₂) s) →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ), ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc x₂ (x₂ + τ),
        HasDerivAt (fun r' => F s r') (F2 s r) r ∧ HasDerivAt (fun r' => F1 s r') (F21 s r) r) →
      F x₁ x₂ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) ^ 2 *
        ((∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F s r ^ 2) +
         (∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F1 s r ^ 2) +
         (∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F2 s r ^ 2) +
         (∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F21 s r ^ 2)) := by
    intro F F1 F2 F21 hcr hcs hc1 hd1 hd2
    have R1 : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ), F s x₂ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) *
        ((∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F s r ^ 2) + ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F2 s r ^ 2) :=
      fun s hs => line x₂ (F s) (F2 s) (fun r hr => (hd2 s hs r hr).1) (hcr s hs).1
    have R2 : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ), F1 s x₂ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) *
        ((∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F1 s r ^ 2) + ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F21 s r ^ 2) :=
      fun s hs => line x₂ (F1 s) (F21 s) (fun r hr => (hd2 s hs r hr).2) (hcr s hs).2
    have S : F x₁ x₂ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) *
        ((∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, F s x₂ ^ 2) + ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, F1 s x₂ ^ 2) :=
      line x₁ (fun s => F s x₂) (fun s => F1 s x₂) hd1 hc1
    have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun s => F s x₂) (Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ)) := HasDerivAt.continuousOn hd1
    have I1 : (∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, F s x₂ ^ 2) ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) *
        ((∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F s r ^ 2) +
          ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F2 s r ^ 2) :=
      int2 x₁ (1 + 1 / τ) (fun s => F s x₂ ^ 2) _ _ (hFc.pow 2) hcs.1 hcs.2.2.1 R1
    have I2 : (∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, F1 s x₂ ^ 2) ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) *
        ((∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F1 s r ^ 2) +
          ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F21 s r ^ 2) :=
      int2 x₁ (1 + 1 / τ) (fun s => F1 s x₂ ^ 2) _ _ (hc1.pow 2) hcs.2.1 hcs.2.2.2 R2
    calc F x₁ x₂ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) *
        ((∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, F s x₂ ^ 2) + ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, F1 s x₂ ^ 2) := S
      _ ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) * ((1 + 1 / τ) *
            ((∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F s r ^ 2) +
              ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F2 s r ^ 2) +
          (1 + 1 / τ) *
            ((∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F1 s r ^ 2) +
              ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F21 s r ^ 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add I1 I2) hC
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have sl : ∀ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
        (Set.Icc x₀ (x₀ + τ) ×ˢ (Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ) ×ˢ Set.Icc x₂ (x₂ + τ))) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc x₀ (x₀ + τ), ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ),
        ContinuousOn (fun r => F t s r) (Set.Icc x₂ (x₂ + τ))) ∧
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc x₀ (x₀ + τ), ContinuousOn (fun s => F t s x₂) (Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ))) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun t => F t x₁ x₂) (Set.Icc x₀ (x₀ + τ)) := by
    intro F hF
    refine ⟨fun t ht s hs => ?_, fun t ht => ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hF.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).continuousOn
        (fun r hr => ⟨ht, hs, hr⟩)
    · exact hF.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).continuousOn
        (fun s hs => ⟨ht, hs, hx₂⟩)
    · exact hF.comp (continuous_id.prodMk (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_const)).continuousOn
        (fun t ht => ⟨ht, hx₁, hx₂⟩)
  
  obtain ⟨c, cc, cmem, cid⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, (∀ x, Continuous (c x)) ∧
      (∀ x y, c x y ∈ Set.Icc x (x + τ)) ∧ (∀ x y, y ∈ Set.Icc x (x + τ) → c x y = y) :=
    ⟨fun x y => max x (min (x + τ) y),
      fun x => continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min continuous_id),
      fun x y => ⟨le_max_left _ _, max_le (by linarith) (min_le_left _ _)⟩,
      fun x y hy => by
        show max x (min (x + τ) y) = y
        rw [min_eq_right hy.2, max_eq_right hy.1]⟩
  have pc : ∀ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
        (Set.Icc x₀ (x₀ + τ) ×ˢ (Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ) ×ˢ Set.Icc x₂ (x₂ + τ))) →
      (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc x₀ (x₀ + τ),
        ContinuousOn (fun s => ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F t s r ^ 2) (Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ))) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun t => ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F t s r ^ 2)
        (Set.Icc x₀ (x₀ + τ)) := by
    intro F hF
    have hG : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => F (c x₀ p.1) (c x₁ p.2.1) (c x₂ p.2.2)) :=
      hF.comp_continuous (f := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => (c x₀ p.1, c x₁ p.2.1, c x₂ p.2.2))
        (((cc x₀).comp continuous_fst).prodMk (((cc x₁).comp continuous_snd.fst).prodMk
          ((cc x₂).comp continuous_snd.snd)))
        (fun p => ⟨cmem _ _, cmem _ _, cmem _ _⟩)
    have hA : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
        ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F (c x₀ q.1) (c x₁ q.2) (c x₂ r) ^ 2) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        (f := fun (q : ℝ × ℝ) (r : ℝ) => F (c x₀ q.1) (c x₁ q.2) (c x₂ r) ^ 2)
      have hm : Continuous (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => (p.1.1, p.1.2, p.2)) := by fun_prop
      exact (hG.comp hm).pow 2
    have hB : Continuous (fun t : ℝ =>
        ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F (c x₀ t) (c x₁ s) (c x₂ r) ^ 2) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
        (f := fun t s => ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F (c x₀ t) (c x₁ s) (c x₂ r) ^ 2)
      exact hA
    have hAeq : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc x₀ (x₀ + τ), ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc x₁ (x₁ + τ),
        (∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F (c x₀ t) (c x₁ s) (c x₂ r) ^ 2) =
          ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, F t s r ^ 2 := by
      intro t ht s hs
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro r hr
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at hr
      simp only [cid _ _ ht, cid _ _ hs, cid _ _ hr]
    refine ⟨fun t ht => ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (hA.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).continuousOn.congr
        (fun s hs => (hAeq t ht s hs).symm)
    · refine hB.continuousOn.congr (fun t ht => ?_)
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s hs
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at hs
      exact (hAeq t ht s hs).symm
  
  have hcf := hc f (by simp)
  have hcf0 := hc f0 (by simp)
  have hcf1 := hc f1 (by simp)
  have hcf10 := hc f10 (by simp)
  have hcf2 := hc f2 (by simp)
  have hcf20 := hc f20 (by simp)
  have hcf21 := hc f21 (by simp)
  have hcf210 := hc f210 (by simp)
  have Pf : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc x₀ (x₀ + τ), f t x₁ x₂ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) ^ 2 *
      ((∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f t s r ^ 2) +
       (∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f1 t s r ^ 2) +
       (∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f2 t s r ^ 2) +
       (∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f21 t s r ^ 2)) := by
    intro t ht
    exact sq (f t) (f1 t) (f2 t) (f21 t)
      (fun s hs => ⟨(sl f2 hcf2).1 t ht s hs, (sl f21 hcf21).1 t ht s hs⟩)
      ⟨(pc f hcf).1 t ht, (pc f1 hcf1).1 t ht, (pc f2 hcf2).1 t ht, (pc f21 hcf21).1 t ht⟩
      ((sl f1 hcf1).2.1 t ht)
      (fun s hs => (h1 t ht s hs x₂ hx₂).1)
      (fun s hs r hr => ⟨(h2 t ht s hs r hr).1, (h2 t ht s hs r hr).2.2.1⟩)
  have Pf0 : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc x₀ (x₀ + τ), f0 t x₁ x₂ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) ^ 2 *
      ((∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f0 t s r ^ 2) +
       (∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f10 t s r ^ 2) +
       (∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f20 t s r ^ 2) +
       (∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f210 t s r ^ 2)) := by
    intro t ht
    exact sq (f0 t) (f10 t) (f20 t) (f210 t)
      (fun s hs => ⟨(sl f20 hcf20).1 t ht s hs, (sl f210 hcf210).1 t ht s hs⟩)
      ⟨(pc f0 hcf0).1 t ht, (pc f10 hcf10).1 t ht, (pc f20 hcf20).1 t ht,
        (pc f210 hcf210).1 t ht⟩
      ((sl f10 hcf10).2.1 t ht)
      (fun s hs => (h1 t ht s hs x₂ hx₂).2)
      (fun s hs r hr => ⟨(h2 t ht s hs r hr).2.1, (h2 t ht s hs r hr).2.2.2⟩)
  have T : f x₀ x₁ x₂ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) *
      ((∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, f t x₁ x₂ ^ 2) + ∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, f0 t x₁ x₂ ^ 2) :=
    line x₀ (fun t => f t x₁ x₂) (fun t => f0 t x₁ x₂)
      (fun t ht => h0 t ht x₁ hx₁ x₂ hx₂) (sl f0 hcf0).2.2
  have J1 := int4 x₀ ((1 + 1 / τ) ^ 2) (fun t => f t x₁ x₂ ^ 2) _ _ _ _
    ((sl f hcf).2.2.pow 2) (pc f hcf).2 (pc f1 hcf1).2 (pc f2 hcf2).2 (pc f21 hcf21).2 Pf
  have J2 := int4 x₀ ((1 + 1 / τ) ^ 2) (fun t => f0 t x₁ x₂ ^ 2) _ _ _ _
    ((sl f0 hcf0).2.2.pow 2) (pc f0 hcf0).2 (pc f10 hcf10).2 (pc f20 hcf20).2
    (pc f210 hcf210).2 Pf0
  calc f x₀ x₁ x₂ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) *
      ((∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, f t x₁ x₂ ^ 2) + ∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, f0 t x₁ x₂ ^ 2) := T
    _ ≤ (1 + 1 / τ) * (((1 + 1 / τ) ^ 2 *
          ((∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f t s r ^ 2) +
           (∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f1 t s r ^ 2) +
           (∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f2 t s r ^ 2) +
           (∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f21 t s r ^ 2))) +
        ((1 + 1 / τ) ^ 2 *
          ((∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f0 t s r ^ 2) +
           (∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f10 t s r ^ 2) +
           (∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f20 t s r ^ 2) +
           (∫ t in x₀..x₀ + τ, ∫ s in x₁..x₁ + τ, ∫ r in x₂..x₂ + τ, f210 t s r ^ 2)))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add J1 J2) hC
    _ = _ := by
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
        ring

informal_problem.statement:
(z : E3) (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (f : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, z i ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ z i + τ}) :
    ∫ y in {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, z i < y i ∧ y i < z i + τ}, f y =
      ∫ t in z 0..z 0 + τ, ∫ s in z 1..z 1 + τ, ∫ r in z 2..z 2 + τ, f (WithLp.toLp 2 ![t, s, r])

signature.name: box_integral_iterated
signature.statement:
(z : E3) (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (f : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, z i ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ z i + τ}) :
    ∫ y in {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, z i < y i ∧ y i < z i + τ}, f y =
      ∫ t in z 0..z 0 + τ, ∫ s in z 1..z 1 + τ, ∫ r in z 2..z 2 + τ, f (WithLp.toLp 2 ![t, s, r])

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set P : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → E3 := fun p => WithLp.toLp 2 ![p.1, p.2.1, p.2.2] with hPdef
  let Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ≃ᵐ E3 :=
    ((MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ).prodCongr MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.symm).trans
      ((MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0).symm.trans
        (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ)))
  have hΨ : (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → E3) = P := by
    funext p
    obtain ⟨t, s, r⟩ := p
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hmp0 : MeasurePreserving (Ψ : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ → E3) volume volume := by
    have h1 : MeasurePreserving
        ((MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ).prodCongr MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.symm) volume volume :=
      (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure ℝ)).prod (volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ).symm
    have h2 := (volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 0).symm
    have h3 := PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 3)
    exact h3.comp (h2.comp h1)
  have hmp : MeasurePreserving P volume volume := hΨ ▸ hmp0
  have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding P := hΨ ▸ Ψ.measurableEmbedding
  have hpre : P ⁻¹' {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, z i < y i ∧ y i < z i + τ} =
      Set.Ioo (z 0) (z 0 + τ) ×ˢ (Set.Ioo (z 1) (z 1 + τ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (z 2) (z 2 + τ)) := by
    ext p
    obtain ⟨t, s, r⟩ := p
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨h 0, h 1, h 2⟩
    · rintro ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h0
      · exact h1
      · exact h2
  have hPcont : Continuous P := by
    refine (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _).comp ?_
    refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
    fin_cases i
    · exact continuous_fst
    · exact continuous_snd.fst
    · exact continuous_snd.snd
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo P
      (Set.Icc (z 0) (z 0 + τ) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (z 1) (z 1 + τ) ×ˢ Set.Icc (z 2) (z 2 + τ)))
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, z i ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ z i + τ} := by
    rintro ⟨t, s, r⟩ ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ i
    fin_cases i
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
    · exact h2
  have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun p => f (P p))
      (Set.Icc (z 0) (z 0 + τ) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (z 1) (z 1 + τ) ×ˢ Set.Icc (z 2) (z 2 + τ))) :=
    hf.comp hPcont.continuousOn hmaps
  have hK : IsCompact
      (Set.Icc (z 0) (z 0 + τ) ×ˢ (Set.Icc (z 1) (z 1 + τ) ×ˢ Set.Icc (z 2) (z 2 + τ))) :=
    isCompact_Icc.prod (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun p => f (P p))
      (Set.Ioo (z 0) (z 0 + τ) ×ˢ (Set.Ioo (z 1) (z 1 + τ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (z 2) (z 2 + τ))) :=
    (hFc.integrableOn_compact hK).mono_set
      (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self
        (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self))
  have h0 : z 0 ≤ z 0 + τ := by linarith
  have h1 : z 1 ≤ z 1 + τ := by linarith
  have h2 : z 2 ≤ z 2 + τ := by linarith
  rw [← hmp.setIntegral_preimage_emb hemb f _, hpre]
  simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le h0, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le h1,
    intervalIntegral.integral_of_le h2, MeasureTheory.integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo]
  have e1 := setIntegral_prod (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ν := (volume : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)))
    (fun p => f (P p)) hint
  refine e1.trans ?_
  refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo (fun t ht => ?_)
  have hct : ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => f (P (t, q)))
      (Set.Icc (z 1) (z 1 + τ) ×ˢ Set.Icc (z 2) (z 2 + τ)) := by
    refine hFc.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn ?_
    intro q hq
    exact ⟨Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht, hq⟩
  have hint_t : IntegrableOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => f (P (t, q)))
      (Set.Ioo (z 1) (z 1 + τ) ×ˢ Set.Ioo (z 2) (z 2 + τ)) :=
    (hct.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc)).mono_set
      (Set.prod_mono Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
  exact setIntegral_prod (μ := (volume : Measure ℝ)) (ν := (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => f (P (t, q))) hint_t

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (g h : E3 → ℝ) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U) (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) (c : ℝ) :
    (∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => g z * h z) y
        = partialDeriv j g y * h y + g y * partialDeriv j h y) ∧
    ellOp a b (fun z => g z * h z) y = g y * ellOp a b h y + h y * ellOp a b g y
      + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a y i j * (partialDeriv i g y * partialDeriv j h y
          + partialDeriv j g y * partialDeriv i h y) ∧
    ellOp a b (fun z => g z + c * h z) y = ellOp a b g y + c * ellOp a b h y

signature.name: nbs_L_product
signature.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (g h : E3 → ℝ) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U) (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) (c : ℝ) :
    (∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => g z * h z) y
        = partialDeriv j g y * h y + g y * partialDeriv j h y) ∧
    ellOp a b (fun z => g z * h z) y = g y * ellOp a b h y + h y * ellOp a b g y
      + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a y i j * (partialDeriv i g y * partialDeriv j h y
          + partialDeriv j g y * partialDeriv i h y) ∧
    ellOp a b (fun z => g z + c * h z) y = ellOp a b g y + c * ellOp a b h y

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdiff : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      (∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ f z) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 3, ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv j f) z) := by
    intro f hf
    have h1 := (contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 hf
    refine ⟨fun z hz => h1.1.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hz), fun j z hz => ?_⟩
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv j f) U :=
      h1.2.clm_apply (contDiffOn_const (c := e j))
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 h2).1.differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
  obtain ⟨hgd, hgd2⟩ := hdiff g hg
  obtain ⟨hhd, hhd2⟩ := hdiff h hh
  have hL1 : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => g z * h z) z
      = partialDeriv j g z * h z + g z * partialDeriv j h z := by
    intro z hz j
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hgd z hz) (hhd z hz)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hA1 : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => g z + c * h z) z
      = partialDeriv j g z + c * partialDeriv j h z := by
    intro z hz j
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_add (hgd z hz) ((hhd z hz).const_mul c), fderiv_const_mul (hhd z hz) c]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hS : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => g z * h z)) y
      = partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j g) y * h y + partialDeriv j g y * partialDeriv i h y
        + (partialDeriv i g y * partialDeriv j h y
          + g y * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h) y) := by
    intro i j
    have hN : partialDeriv j (fun z => g z * h z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => partialDeriv j g z * h z + g z * partialDeriv j h z) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hL1 z hz j)
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (fun z => g z * h z)) y (e i) = _
    rw [hN.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_add ((hgd2 j y hy).fun_mul (hhd y hy))
        ((hgd y hy).fun_mul (hhd2 j y hy)),
      fderiv_fun_mul (hgd2 j y hy) (hhd y hy), fderiv_fun_mul (hgd y hy) (hhd2 j y hy)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    unfold partialDeriv
    ring
  have hT : ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => g z + c * h z)) y
      = partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j g) y + c * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j h) y := by
    intro i j
    have hN : partialDeriv j (fun z => g z + c * h z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => partialDeriv j g z + c * partialDeriv j h z) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hA1 z hz j)
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (fun z => g z + c * h z)) y (e i) = _
    rw [hN.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_add (hgd2 j y hy) ((hhd2 j y hy).const_mul c),
      fderiv_const_mul (hhd2 j y hy) c]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rfl
  refine ⟨fun j => hL1 y hy j, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [ellOp, hS, hL1 y hy]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  · simp only [ellOp, hT, hA1 y hy]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (v : E3 → ℝ) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v U) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ y : E3, sqSum (n + 1) v y
        = ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (iterPartial σ v) y) ^ 2) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sqSum n v) U ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (sqSum n v) y
        = ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, 2 * iterPartial σ v y * partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v) y) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, ellOp a b (sqSum n v) y = ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3,
        (2 * iterPartial σ v y * ellOp a b (iterPartial σ v) y
          + 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a y i j * partialDeriv i (iterPartial σ v) y
              * partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v) y))

signature.name: nbs_sqSum_identities
signature.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (v : E3 → ℝ) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v U) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ y : E3, sqSum (n + 1) v y
        = ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (iterPartial σ v) y) ^ 2) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sqSum n v) U ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (sqSum n v) y
        = ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, 2 * iterPartial σ v y * partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v) y) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ U, ellOp a b (sqSum n v) y = ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3,
        (2 * iterPartial σ v y * ellOp a b (iterPartial σ v) y
          + 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a y i j * partialDeriv i (iterPartial σ v) y
              * partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v) y))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hP : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv k w) U := by
    intro k w hw
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ w) U := hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e k)) U
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hI0 : ∀ (σ : Fin 0 → Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ), iterPartial σ w = w := by
    intro σ w
    simp [iterPartial]
  have hIc : ∀ (m : ℕ) (k : Fin 3) (τ : Fin m → Fin 3) (w : E3 → ℝ),
      iterPartial (Fin.cons k τ : Fin (m + 1) → Fin 3) w = partialDeriv k (iterPartial τ w) := by
    intro m k τ w
    simp [iterPartial, List.ofFn_succ]
  have hIs : ∀ (m : ℕ) (σ : Fin m → Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (iterPartial σ v) U := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro σ
      rw [hI0]
      exact hv
    | succ m ih =>
      intro σ
      rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail σ, hIc]
      exact hP _ _ (ih _)
  have hD : ∀ w : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U → ∀ y ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ w y := by
    intro w hw y hy
    exact (hw.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hMul : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (p q : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ p y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ q y →
      partialDeriv k (fun z => p z * q z) y = partialDeriv k p y * q y + p y * partialDeriv k q y := by
    intro k p q y hp hq
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hp hq]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hSum : ∀ {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) (k : Fin 3) (F : ι → E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      (∀ t ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F t) y) →
      partialDeriv k (fun z => ∑ t ∈ s, F t z) y = ∑ t ∈ s, partialDeriv k (F t) y := by
    intro ι s k F y hF
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum hF]
    simp
  have hCM : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (p : E3 → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ p y →
      partialDeriv k (fun z => c * p z) y = c * partialDeriv k p y := by
    intro k p c y hp
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_const_mul hp c]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have conj1 : ∀ y : E3, sqSum (n + 1) v y
      = ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (iterPartial σ v) y) ^ 2 := by
    intro y
    show ∑ σ' : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 3, (iterPartial σ' v y) ^ 2 = _
    rw [← (Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => Fin 3)).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
      Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun σ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_))
    show (iterPartial (Fin.cons i σ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 3) v y) ^ 2 = _
    rw [hIc]
  
  have conj2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sqSum n v) U := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, (iterPartial σ v y) ^ 2) U
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun σ _ => (hIs n σ).pow 2)
  
  have hFirst : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (sqSum n v) z
      = ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, 2 * iterPartial σ v z * partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v) z := by
    intro z hz j
    have hd : ∀ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (iterPartial σ v) z :=
      fun σ => hD _ (hIs n σ) z hz
    show partialDeriv j (fun x => ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, (iterPartial σ v x) ^ 2) z = _
    rw [hSum Finset.univ j (fun σ x => (iterPartial σ v x) ^ 2) z (fun σ _ => (hd σ).pow 2)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun σ _ => ?_)
    have hsq : (fun x => (iterPartial σ v x) ^ 2)
        = (fun x => iterPartial σ v x * iterPartial σ v x) := by
      funext x
      ring
    rw [hsq, hMul j _ _ z (hd σ) (hd σ)]
    ring
  
  have hSecond : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (sqSum n v)) y
      = ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, (2 * partialDeriv i (iterPartial σ v) y
          * partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v) y
          + 2 * iterPartial σ v y * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v)) y) := by
    intro y hy i j
    have hN : partialDeriv j (sqSum n v) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, 2 * iterPartial σ v z * partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v) z) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hFirst z hz j)
    have hd : ∀ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (iterPartial σ v) y :=
      fun σ => hD _ (hIs n σ) y hy
    have hd' : ∀ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v)) y :=
      fun σ => hD _ (hP j _ (hIs n σ)) y hy
    have h1 : partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (sqSum n v)) y = partialDeriv i
        (fun z => ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, 2 * iterPartial σ v z * partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v) z) y := by
      show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (sqSum n v)) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ
        (fun z => ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3, 2 * iterPartial σ v z * partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v) z) y (e i)
      rw [hN.fderiv_eq]
    rw [h1, hSum Finset.univ i
      (fun σ z => 2 * iterPartial σ v z * partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v) z) y
      (fun σ _ => ((hd σ).const_mul 2).mul (hd' σ))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun σ _ => ?_)
    rw [hMul i (fun z => 2 * iterPartial σ v z) (partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v)) y
      ((hd σ).const_mul 2) (hd' σ), hCM i _ 2 y (hd σ)]
  
  have conj4 : ∀ y ∈ U, ellOp a b (sqSum n v) y = ∑ σ : Fin n → Fin 3,
      (2 * iterPartial σ v y * ellOp a b (iterPartial σ v) y
        + 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a y i j * partialDeriv i (iterPartial σ v) y
            * partialDeriv j (iterPartial σ v) y) := by
    intro y hy
    show (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a y i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (sqSum n v)) y
      + ∑ l : Fin 3, b y l * partialDeriv l (sqSum n v) y) = _
    simp only [hSecond y hy, hFirst y hy, ellOp]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun σ _ => by ring)
  exact ⟨conj1, conj2, fun y hy j => hFirst y hy j, conj4⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (E : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2) ∧
    (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (c k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2 = r ^ 4 ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c r, r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 = 0) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c r,
      0 ≤ r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 ∧
      r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2) z|
          ≤ 4 * r * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2)) ∧
      ((∀ i j : Fin 3, |a z i j| ≤ E) → (∀ l : Fin 3, |b z l| ≤ E) →
        |ellOp a b (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2) z|
          ≤ 108 * E * r ^ 2 + 12 * E * r ^ 3))

signature.name: nbs_cutoff
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (E : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2) ∧
    (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (c k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2 = r ^ 4 ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c r, r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 = 0) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c r,
      0 ≤ r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 ∧
      r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2) z|
          ≤ 4 * r * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2)) ∧
      ((∀ i j : Fin 3, |a z i j| ≤ E) → (∀ l : Fin 3, |b z l| ≤ E) →
        |ellOp a b (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2) z|
          ≤ 108 * E * r ^ 2 + 12 * E * r ^ 3))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hproj : ∀ (k : Fin 3) (x : E3),
      HasFDerivAt (fun x : E3 => x k) (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x :=
    fun k x => (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
  have hpe : ∀ k i : Fin 3, (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (e i) = if k = i then 1 else 0 := by
    intro k i
    show (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) k = _
    rw [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  have hη : ∀ x : E3, HasFDerivAt (fun x : E3 => r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2)
      (-∑ k : Fin 3, (2 * (x k - c k)) • (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x := by
    intro x
    have h1 : ∀ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)), HasFDerivAt (fun x : E3 => (x k - c k) ^ 2)
        ((2 * (x k - c k)) • (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x := by
      intro k _
      have := ((hproj k x).sub_const (c k)).pow 2
      convert this using 1
      simp
    exact (HasFDerivAt.fun_sum h1).const_sub (r ^ 2)
  have hηe : ∀ (x : E3) (i : Fin 3),
      (-∑ k : Fin 3, (2 * (x k - c k)) • (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (e i)
        = -2 * (x i - c i) := by
    intro x i
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_sum', Finset.sum_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hpe, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    ring
  
  have hζ : ∀ x : E3, HasFDerivAt (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2)
      ((2 * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2)) •
        (-∑ k : Fin 3, (2 * (x k - c k)) • (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ))) x := by
    intro x
    convert (hη x).pow 2 using 1
    simp
  have hd1 : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv i (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2) z
        = -4 * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2) * (z i - c i) := by
    intro i z
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [(hζ z).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hηe, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hfun : ∀ j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv j (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2)
        = fun z => -4 * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2) * (z j - c j) :=
    fun j => funext (hd1 j)
  have hd2 : ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (z : E3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2)) z
        = 8 * (z i - c i) * (z j - c j)
          - 4 * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2) * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
    intro i j z
    rw [hfun j]
    have h : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => -4 * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2) * (z j - c j))
        ((-4 * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2)) • (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)
          + (z j - c j) • ((-4 : ℝ) •
            (-∑ k : Fin 3, (2 * (z k - c k)) • (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)))) z :=
      ((hη z).const_mul (-4)).mul ((hproj j z).sub_const (c j))
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hηe, hpe, smul_eq_mul,
      smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij; simp; ring
    · have hji : ¬ j = i := fun h => hij h.symm
      simp [hij, hji]; ring
  
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2) := by
    have hc : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E3 => (x k - c k) ^ 2) := fun k =>
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff).sub contDiff_const).pow 2
    exact (contDiff_const.sub (ContDiff.sum (fun k _ => hc k))).pow 2
  
  have hdist : ∀ z : E3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 = dist z c ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _))]
    simp [Real.dist_eq, sq_abs]
  refine ⟨hsmooth, by simp; ring, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_sphere] at hz
    rw [hdist z, hz]; ring
  · intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
    have hd0 : 0 ≤ dist z c := dist_nonneg
    have hS : ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by
      rw [hdist z]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hd0 hz 2
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hη0 : 0 ≤ r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 := by linarith
    have hηr : r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by linarith
    have hdi : ∀ i : Fin 3, |z i - c i| ≤ r := by
      intro i
      have h1 : (z i - c i) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => (z k - c k) ^ 2) (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
      have h2 : |z i - c i| ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]; linarith
      exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hr.le (by norm_num)).mp h2
    refine ⟨hη0, hηr, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      rw [hd1 i z, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hη0]
      have h4 : |(-4 : ℝ)| = 4 := by norm_num
      rw [h4]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdi i) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4) hη0)
      linarith
    · intro haE hbE
      have hE : 0 ≤ E := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (haE 0 0)
      have key : ∀ (H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (B : Fin 3 → ℝ),
          (∀ i j, |H i j| ≤ 12 * E * r ^ 2) → (∀ l, |B l| ≤ 4 * E * r ^ 3) →
          |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H i j + ∑ l : Fin 3, B l| ≤ 108 * E * r ^ 2 + 12 * E * r ^ 3 := by
        intro H B hH hB
        calc |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H i j + ∑ l : Fin 3, B l|
            ≤ |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H i j| + |∑ l : Fin 3, B l| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |H i j| + ∑ l : Fin 3, |B l| :=
              add_le_add ((Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
                (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _))
                (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _)
          _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, ∑ _j : Fin 3, 12 * E * r ^ 2 + ∑ _l : Fin 3, 4 * E * r ^ 3 :=
              add_le_add (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hH i j)
                (Finset.sum_le_sum fun l _ => hB l)
          _ = 108 * E * r ^ 2 + 12 * E * r ^ 3 := by
              simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
              push_cast; ring
      have hT : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |a z i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j
          (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2)) z| ≤ 12 * E * r ^ 2 := by
        intro i j
        rw [hd2 i j z, abs_mul]
        have hp : |(z i - c i) * (z j - c j)| ≤ r ^ 2 := by
          rw [abs_mul, sq]
          exact mul_le_mul (hdi i) (hdi j) (abs_nonneg _) hr.le
        have hp' := abs_le.mp hp
        have hin : |8 * (z i - c i) * (z j - c j)
            - 4 * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2) * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)|
              ≤ 12 * r ^ 2 := by
          rw [abs_le]
          split_ifs <;> constructor <;> nlinarith [hp'.1, hp'.2]
        calc |a z i j| * |8 * (z i - c i) * (z j - c j)
            - 4 * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2) * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)|
            ≤ E * (12 * r ^ 2) := mul_le_mul (haE i j) hin (abs_nonneg _) hE
          _ = 12 * E * r ^ 2 := by ring
      have hB : ∀ l : Fin 3, |b z l * partialDeriv l
          (fun x : E3 => (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (x k - c k) ^ 2) ^ 2) z| ≤ 4 * E * r ^ 3 := by
        intro l
        rw [hd1 l z, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hη0]
        have h4 : |(-4 : ℝ)| = 4 := by norm_num
        rw [h4]
        have h5 : 4 * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2) * |z l - c l| ≤ 4 * r ^ 2 * r := by
          have := mul_le_mul hηr (hdi l) (abs_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg r)
          nlinarith
        calc |b z l| * (4 * (r ^ 2 - ∑ k : Fin 3, (z k - c k) ^ 2) * |z l - c l|)
            ≤ E * (4 * r ^ 2 * r) :=
              mul_le_mul (hbE l) h5 (by positivity) hE
          _ = 4 * E * r ^ 3 := by ring
      exact key _ _ hT hB

informal_problem.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hcU : Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ U) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (lam E : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hell : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, ∀ ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        lam * ∑ i : Fin 3, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ξ i * a y i j * ξ j)
    (hbE : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, |b y 0| ≤ E)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U) (K₀ M : ℝ) (hK₀ : 0 ≤ K₀)
    (hLw : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball c r, -K₀ ≤ ellOp a b w y)
    (hwM : ∀ y ∈ Metric.sphere c r, w y ≤ M) :
    ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, w y ≤ M + K₀ * Real.exp (2 * ((E + 1) / lam + 1) * r)

signature.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hcU : Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ U) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (lam E : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hell : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, ∀ ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ,

    (hbE : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, |b y 0| ≤ E)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U) (K₀ M : ℝ) (hK₀ : 0 ≤ K₀)
    (hLw : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball c r, -K₀ ≤ ellOp a b w y)
    (hwM : ∀ y ∈ Metric.sphere c r, w y ≤ M) :
