    have hu₂ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => w (c ((chartAt E3 x).symm z))) U := by
      have h0 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ((w ∘ c) ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) U :=
        hwc.comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono hUsub) (by rw [hU]; exact fun z hz => hz.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h0
    have hGcd : ∀ i l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm z i l) U :=
      fun i l => (g.smooth x i l).mono hUsub
    have hpsd := hpsd_of _ (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g x _ hy).inv
    obtain ⟨s', hs0', hs1', hineq⟩ := smax1_lap_ge (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm)
      (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) (fun z => w (c ((chartAt E3 x).symm z))) U hUopen
      (chartAt E3 x x) hyU hGcd hu₁ hu₂ hpsd ε hε0
    have hFeq : (F ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 x x)]
        (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 x).symm z) + ε * smax1 ((w (c ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) -
          f ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) / ε)) := by
      filter_upwards [hUopen.mem_nhds hyU] with z hz
      have hzV : (chartAt E3 x).symm z ∈ V := by rw [hU] at hz; exact hz.2
      exact hFV _ hzV
    have hLF : lapM g F x = lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm)
        (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 x).symm z) + ε * smax1 ((w (c ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) -
          f ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) / ε)) (chartAt E3 x x) :=
      H1 _ _ _ _ hFeq
    have hL1 : lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 x).symm z))
        (chartAt E3 x x) = lapM g f x := rfl
    have hL2 : lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (fun z => w (c ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)))
        (chartAt E3 x x) = lapM g (fun x => w (c x)) x := rfl
    rw [hL1, hL2] at hineq
    rw [hLF]
    have hRx := hR x
    have hfx := hfl x
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hs1') hfx, mul_nonneg hs0' hwx, mul_nonneg hs0' hRx]
  exact ⟨F, hFs, hF0, hsup, ⟨Kf ∪ K', hKf.union hK'c, hFK⟩, hFp⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: smax1_props
subgoal_signatures.statement:
ContDiff ℝ ∞ smax1 ∧
    (∀ u, deriv smax1 u = Real.smoothTransition ((u + 1) / 2)) ∧
    (∀ u, 0 ≤ deriv (deriv smax1) u) ∧ (∀ u, u ≤ -1 → smax1 u = 0) ∧
    (∀ u, 1 ≤ u → smax1 u = u) ∧ (∀ u, max u 0 ≤ smax1 u) ∧ (∀ u, smax1 u ≤ max u 0 + 1)

subgoal_signatures.name: smax1_lap_ge
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f₁ f₂ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) U)
    (hf₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f₁ U) (hf₂ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f₂ U)
    (hpsd : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s ∧ s ≤ 1 ∧ (1 - s) * lapLocal G f₁ y + s * lapLocal G f₂ y ≤
      lapLocal G (fun x => f₁ x + ε * smax1 ((f₂ x - f₁ x) / ε)) y

subgoal_signatures.name: lapLocal_chart_invariant
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) (hxV : Φ x ∈ V) :
    lapLocal (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) x = lapM g f (Φ x)

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (p₀ : M) (hp₀ : 0 < g.scalarCurvature p₀) :
    ∃ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g f x + g.scalarCurvature x) ∧
      (∃ K : Set M, IsCompact K ∧ ∀ x, x ∉ K → f x = 0) ∧ 0 < f p₀

signature.name: cs_bump_at_positive_scalar
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (p₀ : M) (hp₀ : 0 < g.scalarCurvature p₀) :
    ∃ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g f x + g.scalarCurvature x) ∧
      (∃ K : Set M, IsCompact K ∧ ∀ x, x ∉ K → f x = 0) ∧ 0 < f p₀

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have H1 : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u v : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] v → lapLocal G u y = lapLocal G v y := by
    intro G u v y huv
    have h1 : ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l u y = partialDeriv l v y := by
      intro l
      show fderiv ℝ u y (e l) = fderiv ℝ v y (e l)
      rw [huv.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ i l : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) y =
        partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l v z) y := by
      intro i l
      have hev : (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => partialDeriv l v z) := by
        filter_upwards [huv.eventuallyEq_nhds] with z hz
        show fderiv ℝ u z (e l) = fderiv ℝ v z (e l)
        rw [hz.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) y (e i) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv l v z) y (e i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [lapLocal, h1, h2]
  have H2 : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ) (α γ : ℝ) (y : E3),
      lapLocal G (fun z => α * u z + γ) y = α * lapLocal G u y := by
    intro G u α γ y
    have hP0 : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (l : Fin 3) (z : E3),
        partialDeriv l (fun z => α * w z) z = α * partialDeriv l w z := by
      intro w l z
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z) z (e l) = α * fderiv ℝ w z (e l)
      have : (fun z => α * w z) = α • w := by funext z; simp
      rw [this, fderiv_const_smul_of_field]; rfl
    have hP : ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (γ' : ℝ) (l : Fin 3) (z : E3),
        partialDeriv l (fun z => α * w z + γ') z = α * partialDeriv l w z := by
      intro w γ' l z
      rw [← hP0]
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z + γ') z (e l) = fderiv ℝ (fun z => α * w z) z (e l)
      rw [fderiv_add_const]
    have h2 : ∀ i l : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l (fun z => α * u z + γ) z) y
        = α * partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv l u z) y := by
      intro i l
      have : (fun z => partialDeriv l (fun z => α * u z + γ) z) =
          fun z => α * partialDeriv l u z := by
        funext z; exact hP u γ l z
      rw [this, hP0]
    simp only [lapLocal, h2, hP, hP0, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have lapM_congr : ∀ (u v : M → ℝ) (p : M), u =ᶠ[𝓝 p] v → lapM g u p = lapM g v p := by
    intro u v p huv
    have hc : Tendsto (chartAt E3 p).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)) (𝓝 p) := by
      have := ((chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 p)).tendsto
      rwa [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)] at this
    exact H1 _ _ _ _ (huv.comp_tendsto hc)
  have lap0 : ∀ x : M, lapM g (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x = 0 := by
    intro x
    have e1 : ((fun _ : M => (0 : ℝ)) ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) =
        fun z : E3 => 0 * (fun _ : E3 => (0 : ℝ)) z + 0 := by
      funext z; simp
    show lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) ((fun _ : M => (0 : ℝ)) ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm)
      (chartAt E3 x x) = 0
    rw [e1, H2, zero_mul]
  
  set c := chartAt E3 p₀ with hc
  have hU : IsOpen c.target := c.open_target
  have hy₀ : c p₀ ∈ c.target := mem_chart_target E3 p₀
  have hp₀s : p₀ ∈ c.source := mem_chart_source E3 p₀
  set G := g.coeff c.symm with hG
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) c.target := g.smooth p₀
  have hpd : ∀ y ∈ c.target, (G y).PosDef := fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p₀ y hy
  
  have hdetgen : ∀ N : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ k l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => N y k l) c.target) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (N y).det) c.target := by
    intro N hN
    have t1 := ((hN 0 0).mul (hN 1 1)).mul (hN 2 2)
    have t2 := ((hN 0 0).mul (hN 1 2)).mul (hN 2 1)
    have t3 := ((hN 0 1).mul (hN 1 0)).mul (hN 2 2)
    have t4 := ((hN 0 1).mul (hN 1 2)).mul (hN 2 0)
    have t5 := ((hN 0 2).mul (hN 1 0)).mul (hN 2 1)
    have t6 := ((hN 0 2).mul (hN 1 1)).mul (hN 2 0)
    have hpoly := ((((t1.sub t2).sub t3).add t4).add t5).sub t6
    exact hpoly.congr (fun y _ => Matrix.det_fin_three (N y))
  have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) c.target := hdetgen G hGs
  have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).adjugate i j) c.target := by
    intro i j
    have h := hdetgen (fun y => (G y).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1)) (by
      intro k l
      by_cases hk : k = j
      · subst hk
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hk]
        exact hGs k l)
    exact h.congr (fun y _ => Matrix.adjugate_apply (G y) i j)
  have hinvformula : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      (G y)⁻¹ i j = ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate i j := by
    intro y i j
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
  have hGinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) c.target := by
    intro i j
    have h := (hdet.inv (fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne')).mul (hadj i j)
    exact h.congr (fun y _ => hinvformula y i j)
  
  have hP : ∀ (u : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u c.target → ∀ k : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => partialDeriv k u y) c.target := by
    intro u hu k
    exact (hu.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) c.target := by
    intro k i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y
        - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y)) c.target
    apply contDiffOn_const.mul
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro l _
    exact (hGinv k l).mul (((hP _ (hGs j l) i).add (hP _ (hGs i l) j)).sub (hP _ (hGs i j) l))
  have hRic : ∀ j k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ricci G j k) c.target := by
    intro j k
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (christoffel G i j k) y
        - partialDeriv j (christoffel G i i k) y)
      + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3,
        (christoffel G i i p y * christoffel G p j k y
          - christoffel G i j p y * christoffel G p i k y)) c.target
    apply ContDiffOn.add
    · apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro i _
      exact (hP _ (hΓ i j k) i).sub (hP _ (hΓ i i k) j)
    · apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro i _
      apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro p _
      exact ((hΓ i i p).mul (hΓ p j k)).sub ((hΓ i j p).mul (hΓ p i k))
  have hρ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (scalarCurvatureLocal G) c.target := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j k * ricci G j k y) c.target
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro j _
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro k _
    exact (hGinv j k).mul (hRic j k)
  
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ κ : ℝ, κ = g.scalarCurvature p₀ / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκ0 : 0 < κ := by rw [hκ]; linarith
  have hρ0 : scalarCurvatureLocal G (c p₀) = g.scalarCurvature p₀ := rfl
  have hρcont : ContinuousAt (scalarCurvatureLocal G) (c p₀) :=
    hρ.continuousOn.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hy₀)
  have hev1 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (c p₀), y ∈ c.target := hU.mem_nhds hy₀
  have hev2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (c p₀), κ < scalarCurvatureLocal G y :=
    Filter.Tendsto.eventually hρcont (lt_mem_nhds (by rw [hρ0, hκ]; linarith))
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.1 (hev1.and hev2)
  have hs : 0 < ε / 3 := by linarith
  have hK₀good : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (c p₀) (2 * (ε / 3)),
      y ∈ c.target ∧ κ < scalarCurvatureLocal G y := by
    intro y hy
    apply hball
    have := Metric.mem_closedBall.1 hy
    linarith
  have hK₀sub : Metric.closedBall (c p₀) (2 * (ε / 3)) ⊆ c.target := fun y hy => (hK₀good y hy).1
  
  obtain ⟨β, hβin, hβout⟩ : ∃ β : ContDiffBump (c p₀), β.rIn = ε / 3 ∧ β.rOut = 2 * (ε / 3) :=
    ⟨⟨ε / 3, 2 * (ε / 3), hs, by linarith⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hβcd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (β : E3 → ℝ) := β.contDiff
  have hLβ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lapLocal G β) c.target := by
    have hβ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (β : E3 → ℝ) c.target := hβcd.contDiffOn
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j *
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j β z) y -
        ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k β y)) c.target
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro i _
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro j _
    apply (hGinv i j).mul
    apply (hP _ (hP _ hβ j) i).sub
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro k _
    exact (hΓ k i j).mul (hP _ hβ k)
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (c p₀) (2 * (ε / 3))).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (hLβ.continuousOn.mono hK₀sub)
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, η = κ / (16 * (|L| + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < 16 * (|L| + 1) := by positivity
  have hη0 : 0 < η := by rw [hη]; exact div_pos hκ0 hden
  have hEta : 16 * η * (|L| + 1) = κ := by
    calc 16 * η * (|L| + 1) = κ / (16 * (|L| + 1)) * (16 * (|L| + 1)) := by rw [hη]; ring
      _ = κ := div_mul_cancel₀ κ hden.ne'
  have hEta' : 16 * (η * |L|) + 16 * η = κ := by rw [← hEta]; ring
  have hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => η * β z) := contDiff_const.mul hβcd
  
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : M → ℝ, f = c.source.indicator (fun x => η * β (c x)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfsrc : ∀ x ∈ c.source, f x = η * β (c x) := by
    intro x hx; rw [hf]; exact Set.indicator_of_mem hx _
  have hfout : ∀ x, x ∉ c.source → f x = 0 := by
    intro x hx; rw [hf]; exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hx _
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : Set M, K = c.symm '' Metric.closedBall (c p₀) (2 * (ε / 3)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKc : IsCompact K := by
    rw [hK]
    exact (isCompact_closedBall _ _).image_of_continuousOn (c.continuousOn_symm.mono hK₀sub)
  have hKcl : IsClosed K := hKc.isClosed
  have hKsub : K ⊆ c.source := by
    rw [hK]
    rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact c.map_target (hK₀sub hy)
  have hfzero : ∀ x, x ∉ K → f x = 0 := by
    intro x hxK
    by_cases hxs : x ∈ c.source
    · rw [hfsrc x hxs]
      have hd : 2 * (ε / 3) ≤ dist (c x) (c p₀) := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        apply hxK
        rw [hK]
        exact ⟨c x, Metric.mem_closedBall.2 hcon.le, c.left_inv hxs⟩
      rw [β.zero_of_le_dist (by rw [hβout]; exact hd), mul_zero]
    · exact hfout x hxs
  have hfnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x := by
    intro x
    rw [hf]
    exact Set.indicator_nonneg (fun y _ => mul_nonneg hη0.le β.nonneg) x
  have hfpos : 0 < f p₀ := by
    rw [hfsrc p₀ hp₀s, β.one_of_mem_closedBall (by rw [hβin]; exact Metric.mem_closedBall_self hs.le),
      mul_one]
    exact hη0
  have hfsm : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f := by
    apply contMDiff_of_locally_contMDiffOn
    intro x
    by_cases hxs : x ∈ c.source
    · refine ⟨c.source, c.open_source, hxs, ?_⟩
      exact (hw.contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart).congr (fun z hz => hfsrc z hz)
    · refine ⟨Kᶜ, hKcl.isOpen_compl, fun h => hxs (hKsub h), ?_⟩
      exact (contMDiffOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr (fun z hz => hfzero z hz)
  
  let Φc : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
    ⟨c.symm.toPartialEquiv, c.symm.open_source, c.symm.open_target, contMDiffOn_chart_symm,
      contMDiffOn_chart⟩
  
  have hsup : ∀ x, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g f x + g.scalarCurvature x := by
    intro x
    by_cases hxK : x ∈ K
    · rw [hK] at hxK
      obtain ⟨y, hyK₀, rfl⟩ := hxK
      have hyt : y ∈ c.target := hK₀sub hyK₀
      have hRx : g.scalarCurvature (c.symm y) = scalarCurvatureLocal G y :=
        scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff g Φc y hyt
      have hlap1 : lapM g f (c.symm y) = lapLocal G (f ∘ c.symm) y :=
        (lapLocal_chart_invariant g Φc f Set.univ isOpen_univ hfsm.contMDiffOn y hyt
          (Set.mem_univ _)).symm
      have hev3 : (f ∘ c.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => η * β z + 0) := by
        filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hyt] with z hz
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, add_zero]
        rw [hfsrc _ (c.map_target hz), c.right_inv hz]
      have hlap2 : lapM g f (c.symm y) = η * lapLocal G β y := by
        rw [hlap1, H1 _ _ _ _ hev3, H2]
      have hLy := hL y hyK₀
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hLy
      have hlow : -|L| ≤ lapLocal G β y := by
        have h1 := (abs_le.1 hLy).1
        have h2 := le_abs_self L
        linarith
      have hm : -(η * |L|) ≤ η * lapLocal G β y := by
        rw [← mul_neg]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow hη0.le
      have hκρ := (hK₀good y hyK₀).2
      rw [hlap2, hRx]
      linarith
    · have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hKcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxK) (fun z hz => hfzero z hz)
      rw [lapM_congr _ _ x hev, lap0]
      linarith [hR x]
  exact ⟨f, hfsm, hfnn, hsup, ⟨K, hKc, hfzero⟩, hfpos⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: scalarCurvature_eq_scalarCurvatureLocal_coeff
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) :
    g.scalarCurvature (Φ x) = scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff Φ) x

subgoal_signatures.name: lapLocal_chart_invariant
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) (hxV : Φ x ∈ V) :
    lapLocal (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) x = lapM g f (Φ x)

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) {ι : Type*}
    (t : Finset ι) (ht : t.Nonempty) (f : ι → M → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i))
    (hsup : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ x, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g (f i) x + g.scalarCurvature x) (x : M) :
    0 ≤ 16 * lapM g (fun y => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, f i y) x + g.scalarCurvature x

signature.name: cs_average_supersolution
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) {ι : Type*}
    (t : Finset ι) (ht : t.Nonempty) (f : ι → M → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f i))
    (hsup : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ x, 0 ≤ 16 * lapM g (f i) x + g.scalarCurvature x) (x : M) :
    0 ≤ 16 * lapM g (fun y => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, f i y) x + g.scalarCurvature x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < (t.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.2 ht
  have hU : IsOpen (chartAt E3 x).target := (chartAt E3 x).open_target
  have hy0 : chartAt E3 x x ∈ (chartAt E3 x).target := mem_chart_target E3 x
  have hu : ∀ i ∈ t, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) (chartAt E3 x).target :=
    fun i hi => contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp ((hf i hi).comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  
  have hA : ∀ (w : ι → E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (k : Fin 3), (∀ i ∈ t, DifferentiableAt ℝ (w i) z) →
      partialDeriv k (fun z' => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, w i z') z
        = ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, partialDeriv k (w i) z := by
    intro w z k hw
    have hS : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z' => ∑ i ∈ t, w i z') z := DifferentiableAt.fun_sum hw
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z' => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, w i z') z (e k)
        = ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, fderiv ℝ (w i) z (e k)
    rw [fderiv_const_mul hS, fderiv_fun_sum hw]
    simp [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  
  have hdiff : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 x).target,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z := fun i hi z hz =>
    ((hu i hi).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
  have hpd : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ j : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => partialDeriv j (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z)
        (chartAt E3 x x) := by
    intro i hi j
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm)) (chartAt E3 x).target :=
      (hu i hi).fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => partialDeriv j (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z)
        (chartAt E3 x).target :=
      h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h2.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hy0)
  
  have hfirst : ∀ j : Fin 3, ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 x).target,
      partialDeriv j (fun z' => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z') z
        = ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, partialDeriv j (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z :=
    fun j z hz => hA _ z j (fun i hi => hdiff i hi z hz)
  have hfirst0 : ∀ j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv j (fun z' => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z')
          (chartAt E3 x x)
        = ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, partialDeriv j (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) (chartAt E3 x x) :=
    fun j => hfirst j _ hy0
  
  have hsecond : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (fun z => partialDeriv b
          (fun z' => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z') z) (chartAt E3 x x)
        = ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t,
            partialDeriv a (fun z => partialDeriv b (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z)
              (chartAt E3 x x) := by
    intro a b
    have hev : (fun z => partialDeriv b
          (fun z' => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z') z)
        =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 x x)]
        (fun z => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, partialDeriv b (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy0) (fun z hz => hfirst b z hz)
    have h1 : partialDeriv a (fun z => partialDeriv b
          (fun z' => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z') z) (chartAt E3 x x)
        = partialDeriv a
          (fun z => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, partialDeriv b (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z)
          (chartAt E3 x x) :=
      congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e a)) hev.fderiv_eq
    rw [h1]
    exact hA (fun i z => partialDeriv b (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z) _ a (fun i hi => hpd i hi b)
  
  have key : ∀ (N : ℝ) (Γ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (A : ι → ℝ) (B : ι → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      N * (((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, A i
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, Γ k * (((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, B i k)) =
        ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, N * (A i - ∑ k : Fin 3, Γ k * B i k) := by
    intro N Γ A B
    have e1 : ∀ i ∈ t, N * (A i - ∑ k : Fin 3, Γ k * B i k) =
        N * A i - (N * Γ 0) * B i 0 - (N * Γ 1) * B i 1 - (N * Γ 2) * B i 2 := by
      intro i _
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl e1]
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hlap : lapM g (fun y => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, f i y) x
      = ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, lapM g (f i) x := by
    show lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm)
        (fun z' => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z') (chartAt E3 x x)
      = ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t,
          lapLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) (chartAt E3 x x)
    unfold lapLocal
    have hab : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x x))⁻¹ a b *
          (partialDeriv a (fun z => partialDeriv b
              (fun z' => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z') z)
              (chartAt E3 x x) -
            ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) k a b (chartAt E3 x x) *
              partialDeriv k
                (fun z' => ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z')
                (chartAt E3 x x))
        = ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t,
            (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x x))⁻¹ a b *
              (partialDeriv a (fun z => partialDeriv b (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) z)
                  (chartAt E3 x x) -
                ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm) k a b (chartAt E3 x x) *
                  partialDeriv k (f i ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) (chartAt E3 x x)) := by
      intro a b
      rw [hsecond a b]
      simp only [hfirst0]
      exact key _ _ _ _
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => hab a b))]
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  rw [hlap]
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, (16 * lapM g (f i) x + g.scalarCurvature x) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => hsup i hi x)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum] at hsum
  have hre : 16 * (((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ i ∈ t, lapM g (f i) x) + g.scalarCurvature x
      = ((t.card : ℝ))⁻¹ *
        (16 * ∑ i ∈ t, lapM g (f i) x + (t.card : ℝ) * g.scalarCurvature x) := by
    rw [mul_add, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hn0.ne']
    ring
  rw [hre]
  exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hn0.le) hsum

informal_problem.statement:
(r ρ₂ ρ : ℝ) (hρ₂r : ρ₂ < r) (hρ₂ρ : ρ₂ < ρ)
    (P : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hP : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (P i) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) r))
    (hsupp : ∀ i z, ρ₂ ≤ ‖z‖ → P i z = 0)
    (hface : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, z 0 = 0 → P 0 z = 0) :
    ∫ z in {z : E3 | ‖z‖ < ρ ∧ 0 < z 0}, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (P i) z = 0

signature.name: halfball_divergence_zero
signature.statement:
(r ρ₂ ρ : ℝ) (hρ₂r : ρ₂ < r) (hρ₂ρ : ρ₂ < ρ)
    (P : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hP : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (P i) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) r))
    (hsupp : ∀ i z, ρ₂ ≤ ‖z‖ → P i z = 0)
    (hface : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) r, z 0 = 0 → P 0 z = 0) :
    ∫ z in {z : E3 | ‖z‖ < ρ ∧ 0 < z 0}, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (P i) z = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hloc : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : E3), ρ₂ < ‖y‖ → P i =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro i y hy
    have hU : IsOpen {y : E3 | ρ₂ < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
    exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hsupp i z (le_of_lt hz))
  have hCD : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (P i) := by
    intro i
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : ‖z‖ < r
    · exact (hP i).contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hz))
    · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hloc i z (by linarith [not_lt.mp hz]))
  have hvan : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : E3), ρ₂ < ‖y‖ → partialDeriv i (P i) y = 0 := by
    intro i y hy
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [(hloc i y hy).fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_apply]
    rfl
  have hD : ∀ i, Differentiable ℝ (P i) := fun i => (hCD i).differentiable (by simp)
  have hpc : ∀ i, Continuous (partialDeriv i (P i)) := fun i =>
    ((hCD i).continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have habs : ∀ (x : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3), |x i| ≤ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : E3)‖ := by
    intro x i
    have h := PiLp.norm_apply_le (WithLp.toLp 2 x : E3) i
    rwa [PiLp.toLp_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  set g : E3 → ℝ := fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (P i) z with hgdef
  have hgc : Continuous g := continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hpc i)
  have hg0 : ∀ z : E3, ρ₂ < ‖z‖ → g z = 0 := fun z hz =>
    Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => hvan i z hz)
  
  rcases le_or_gt ρ 0 with hρ | hρ
  · have hE : {z : E3 | ‖z‖ < ρ ∧ 0 < z 0} = ∅ := by
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
      intro h
      linarith [norm_nonneg z]
    rw [hE, setIntegral_empty]
  
  set a : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun i => if i = 0 then 0 else -ρ with ha
  set b : Fin 3 → ℝ := fun _ => ρ with hb
  
  have hT : ∫ z in {z : E3 | ‖z‖ < ρ ∧ 0 < z 0}, g z
      = ∫ x in Set.Icc a b, g (WithLp.toLp 2 x) := by
    have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding (WithLp.toLp 2 : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → E3) := by
      have h := (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ)).measurableEmbedding
      rwa [MeasurableEquiv.coe_toLp] at h
    rw [← (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 3)).setIntegral_preimage_emb hemb g]
    have hae : (Set.univ.pi fun i => Set.Ioo (a i) (b i)) =ᵐ[volume] Set.Icc a b := by
      rw [volume_pi]
      exact Measure.univ_pi_Ioo_ae_eq_Icc
    rw [← setIntegral_congr_set hae]
    symm
    apply setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero
    · exact MeasurableSet.univ_pi (fun _ => measurableSet_Ioo)
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hx
      rw [PiLp.toLp_apply] at h2
      rw [Set.mem_univ_pi]
      intro i
      have hi : |x i| < ρ := lt_of_le_of_lt (habs x i) h1
      rw [abs_lt] at hi
      by_cases h0 : i = 0
      · subst h0
        simp only [ha, hb, if_pos rfl, Set.mem_Ioo]
        exact ⟨h2, hi.2⟩
      · simp only [ha, hb, if_neg h0, Set.mem_Ioo]
        exact hi
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨hxO, hxS⟩ := hx
      rw [Set.mem_univ_pi] at hxO
      have h0 : 0 < x 0 := by
        have := (hxO 0).1
        simpa [ha] using this
      have hn : ρ ≤ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 x : E3)‖ := by
        by_contra hc
        apply hxS
        refine ⟨lt_of_not_ge hc, ?_⟩
        show 0 < (WithLp.toLp 2 x : E3) 0
        rw [PiLp.toLp_apply]
        exact h0
      exact hg0 _ (lt_of_lt_of_le hρ₂ρ hn)
  
  let TL : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] E3 :=
    ((PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ)).symm : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] E3)
  have hTLapp : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, TL v = WithLp.toLp 2 v := fun v =>
    PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv_symm_apply 2 ℝ _ v
  have hTL : ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun y : Fin 3 → ℝ => (WithLp.toLp 2 y : E3)) TL x := by
    intro x
    have h := TL.hasFDerivAt (x := x)
    have hfun : (⇑TL) = fun y : Fin 3 → ℝ => (WithLp.toLp 2 y : E3) := funext hTLapp
    rwa [hfun] at h
  have hFd : ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun (y : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) => P i (WithLp.toLp 2 y))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => (fderiv ℝ (P i) (WithLp.toLp 2 x)).comp TL)) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hasFDerivAt_pi]
    intro i
    exact ((hD i) _).hasFDerivAt.comp x (hTL x)
  have hval : ∀ (x : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => (fderiv ℝ (P i) (WithLp.toLp 2 x)).comp TL))
        (Pi.single i 1) i = g (WithLp.toLp 2 x) := by
    intro x
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.pi_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hTLapp,
      EuclideanSpace.toLp_single]
    rfl
  have hcont : Continuous fun x : Fin 3 → ℝ => g (WithLp.toLp 2 x) :=
    hgc.comp (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _)
  have hab : a ≤ b := by
    intro i
    simp only [ha, hb]
    split_ifs <;> linarith
  have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun (y : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) => P i (WithLp.toLp 2 y)) (Set.Icc a b) :=
    (continuous_pi (fun i => (hD i).continuous.comp (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _))).continuousOn
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun x : Fin 3 → ℝ => ∑ i : Fin 3,
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => (fderiv ℝ (P i) (WithLp.toLp 2 x)).comp TL))
        (Pi.single i 1) i) (Set.Icc a b) volume := by
    simp only [hval]
    exact hcont.integrableOn_Icc
  
  have hdiv := integral_divergence_of_hasFDerivAt_off_countable a b hab
    (fun (y : Fin 3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) => P i (WithLp.toLp 2 y))
    (fun x => ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => (fderiv ℝ (P i) (WithLp.toLp 2 x)).comp TL))
    ∅ Set.countable_empty hFc (fun x _ => hFd x) hint
  
  have hup : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), P i (WithLp.toLp 2 (i.insertNth (b i) y)) = 0 := by
    intro i y
    apply hsupp
    have h := habs (i.insertNth (b i) y) i
    rw [Fin.insertNth_apply_same] at h
    simp only [hb, abs_of_pos hρ] at h
    linarith
  have hlow : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), P i (WithLp.toLp 2 (i.insertNth (a i) y)) = 0 := by
    intro i y
    by_cases h0 : i = 0
    · subst h0
      have hx0 : (WithLp.toLp 2 ((0 : Fin 3).insertNth (a 0) y) : E3) 0 = 0 := by
        rw [PiLp.toLp_apply, Fin.insertNth_apply_same]
        simp [ha]
      by_cases hr : ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 ((0 : Fin 3).insertNth (a 0) y) : E3)‖ < r
      · exact hface _ (mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hr) hx0
      · exact hsupp _ _ (by linarith [not_lt.mp hr])
    · have hai : a i = -ρ := by simp only [ha, if_neg h0]
      rw [hai]
      apply hsupp
      have h := habs (i.insertNth (-ρ) y) i
      rw [Fin.insertNth_apply_same, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hρ] at h
      linarith
  rw [hT]
  calc ∫ x in Set.Icc a b, g (WithLp.toLp 2 x)
      = ∫ x in Set.Icc a b, ∑ i : Fin 3,
          (ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => (fderiv ℝ (P i) (WithLp.toLp 2 x)).comp TL))
            (Pi.single i 1) i :=
        setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc (fun x _ => (hval x).symm)
    _ = 0 := by
        rw [hdiv]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => ?_)
        rw [setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun y _ => hup i y),
          setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun y _ => hlow i y), sub_zero]

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (S : Set M) (hS : IsCompact S) (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKφ : K ⊆ φ.source) :
    ∃ ε₀ C : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ h : RiemannianMetric3 M, (∀ p : M, p ∉ S → h.g p = g.g p) →
        (∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ h.g p ξ ξ ∧ h.g p ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ) →
        ∀ V f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ V → ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
          (∀ p : M, p ∉ S → V p = 0 ∧ f p = 0) → (∀ p : M, |V p| ≤ ε₀) →
          ∃ v : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v ∧

  have hSc : IsClosed S := hS.isClosed
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 p)
  have hmem : (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Sᶜ ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    apply hcont.preimage_mem_nhds
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)]
    exact hSc.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hfar
  have hG : h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)] g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm := by
    filter_upwards [hmem] with y hy
    show coeffMatrix h.g (chartAt E3 p).symm y = coeffMatrix g.g (chartAt E3 p).symm y
    unfold coeffMatrix
    rw [hh _ hy]
  have hhg : h.lapM v p = g.lapM v p := by
    unfold RiemannianMetric3.lapM
    exact hlapcongr _ _ _ _ hG
  
  have hinv := lapLocal_chart_invariant g (hAF.ends j).Φ v Set.univ isOpen_univ
    hv.contMDiffOn x hx1 (Set.mem_univ _)
  have e1 : lapLoc (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) x
      = lapM g v p := hinv
  have e2 : lapM g v p = g.lapM v p := rfl
  rw [e1, e2, ← hhg, hzero]

subgoal_signatures.name: end_chart_escape
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∀ p : M, ∃ ρ : ℝ, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∉ N

subgoal_signatures.name: lapLocal_chart_invariant
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) (hxV : Φ x ∈ V) :
    lapLocal (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) x = lapM g f (Φ x)

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hRic : ∀ (p : M) (j l : Fin 3),
      ricci (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) j l (chartAt E3 p p) = 0)
    (φ : E3 → M) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hφ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ φ U)

    ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ l i j k : Fin 3, riemannLocal (g.coeff φ) l i j k y = 0

signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hRic : ∀ (p : M) (j l : Fin 3),
      ricci (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) j l (chartAt E3 p p) = 0)
    (φ : E3 → M) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hφ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ φ U)
    (hinj : ∀ y ∈ U, Function.Injective (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y)) :
    ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ l i j k : Fin 3, riemannLocal (g.coeff φ) l i j k y = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hu : ∀ u : E3, u = ∑ d : Fin 3, u d • e d := by
    intro u
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr u]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hcomp_e : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) a = v a := by
    intro v a
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  have hcompo : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z → ∀ l d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z = (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) d := by
    intro ψ z hψ l d
    have hfun : (fun v => ψ v d) = (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ ψ := by
      funext v; simp
    rw [partialDeriv, hfun, fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj d).differentiableAt hψ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp
  have dmul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z → DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => f w * g w) z := fun f g z hf hg => hf.mul hg
  have pd_add : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => f w + g w) z = partialDeriv l f z + partialDeriv l g z := by
    intro f g z l hf hg
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_add hf hg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
  have pd_mul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ g z →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => f w * g w) z = partialDeriv l f z * g z + f z * partialDeriv l g z := by
    intro f g z l hf hg
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_mul hf hg, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have pd_sum : ∀ (f : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (z : E3) (l : Fin 3), (∀ a, DifferentiableAt ℝ (f a) z) →
      partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, f a w) z = ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv l (f a) z := by
    intro f z l hf
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_fun_sum (fun a _ => hf a), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have pd_comp : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ψ z) → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d F (ψ z) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z := by
    intro F ψ z hψ hF l
    have h1 : partialDeriv l (fun w => F (ψ w)) z = fderiv ℝ F (ψ z) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (F ∘ ψ) z (e l) = _
      rw [fderiv_comp z hF hψ]
      rfl
    rw [h1, hu (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)), map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcompo ψ z hψ]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d _
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  have hpdU : ∀ (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → ∀ i,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) U := by
    intro U hU f hf i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) U := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have christoffel_contDiffOn : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3), IsOpen V →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V) → (∀ y ∈ V, (G y).det ≠ 0) →
      ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) V := by
    intro G V hV hG hdet k i j
    have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).det) V := by
      simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      repeat (first | apply ContDiffOn.sub | apply ContDiffOn.add | apply ContDiffOn.mul | exact hG _ _)
    have hadj : ∀ a b, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y).adjugate a b) V := by
      intro a b
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
        simp only [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_zero,
          Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.empty_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,
          Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Fin.isValue] <;>
        repeat (first | apply ContDiffOn.sub | apply ContDiffOn.add | apply ContDiffOn.mul | apply ContDiffOn.neg | exact hG _ _)
    have hinv : ∀ a b, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) V := by
      intro a b
      have : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ a b) = fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate a b := by
        funext y
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [this]
      exact (hdetS.inv hdet).mul (hadj a b)
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y
        - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y)) V
    apply ContDiffOn.mul contDiffOn_const
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro l _
    exact (hinv k l).mul
      (((hpdU V hV _ (hG j l) i).add (hpdU V hV _ (hG i l) j)).sub (hpdU V hV _ (hG i j) l))
  have pullback_partialDeriv : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U V : Set E3),
      IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → (∀ z ∈ U, ψ z ∈ V) →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) V) → ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ l i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv l (partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a)) z * G (ψ z) a b *
              partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z +
            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z *
              (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d (fun y => G y a b) (ψ z) *
                partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z) * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z +
            partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z * G (ψ z) a b *
              partialDeriv l (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b)) z) := by
    intro ψ G U V hU hV hψ hmaps hG z hz l i j
    have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z :=
      (hψ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hJd : ∀ a k : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v a)) z := by
      intro a k
      exact ((hpdU U hU _ (contDiffOn_euclidean.mp hψ a) k).contDiffAt
        (hU.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hGd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) (ψ z) := fun a b =>
      ((hG a b).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hmaps z hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hGψd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G (ψ w) a b) z :=
      fun a b => (hGd a b).comp z hψd
    have htd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w *
        G (ψ w) a b * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z :=
      fun a b => dmul _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b)) (hJd b j)
    rw [pd_sum _ _ _ (fun a => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (fun b _ => htd a b))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [pd_sum _ _ _ (fun b => htd a b)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    rw [pd_mul _ _ _ _ (dmul _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b)) (hJd b j),
      pd_mul _ _ _ _ (hJd a i) (hGψd a b), pd_comp (fun y => G y a b) ψ z hψd (hGd a b) l]
    ring
  have christoffel_pullback_algebra : ∀ (A G Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (dG H dGt : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      A.det ≠ 0 → G.det ≠ 0 → (∀ a b, G a b = G b a) → (∀ c i j, H c i j = H c j i) →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * G a b * A b j) →
      (∀ l i j, dGt l i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (H a l i * G a b * A b j + A a i * (∑ d : Fin 3, dG d a b * A d l) * A b j
          + A a i * G a b * H b l j)) →
      ∀ c i j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ k l *
          (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c l *
          (dG a b l + dG b a l - dG l a b)) * A a i * A b j + H c i j := by
    intro A G Gt dG H dGt hA hG hGs hH hGt hdGt c i j
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGu : IsUnit G.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hG
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * G * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGiG : G⁻¹ * G = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul G hGu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hα : A * Gt⁻¹ = G⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hAB, Matrix.one_mul]
    have hα' : ∀ l, ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Gt⁻¹ k l = ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * A⁻¹ l b := by
      intro l
      have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hα c) l
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h1
      exact h1
    have hβ : ∀ l, dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j = ∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l *
        (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β)
          + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j) := by
      intro l
      rw [hdGt, hdGt, hdGt]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hH _ j i, hH _ l i, hH _ l j]
      simp only [hGs 1 0, hGs 2 0, hGs 2 1]
      ring
    have eAB : ∀ γ b : Fin 3, A γ 0 * A⁻¹ 0 b + A γ 1 * A⁻¹ 1 b + A γ 2 * A⁻¹ 2 b
        = if γ = b then 1 else 0 := by
      intro γ b
      rw [← Matrix.one_apply, ← hAB, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hcontr : ∀ (u W : Fin 3 → ℝ), ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, u b * A⁻¹ l b) *
        (∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l * W γ) = ∑ b : Fin 3, u b * W b := by
      intro u W
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination
        (u 0 * W 0) * (eAB 0 0).trans (if_pos rfl)
        + (u 1 * W 0) * (eAB 0 1).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 2 * W 0) * (eAB 0 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 0 * W 1) * (eAB 1 0).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 1 * W 1) * (eAB 1 1).trans (if_pos rfl)
        + (u 2 * W 1) * (eAB 1 2).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 0 * W 2) * (eAB 2 0).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 1 * W 2) * (eAB 2 1).trans (if_neg (by decide))
        + (u 2 * W 2) * (eAB 2 2).trans (if_pos rfl)
    have hGG : ∑ a : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * G a b) * H a i j = H c i j := by
      have h2 : ∀ a, ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * G a b = (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) c a := by
        intro a
        rw [← hGiG, Matrix.mul_apply]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => by rw [hGs a b])
      simp only [h2, Matrix.one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
        Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    calc ∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ k l *
            (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j))
        = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, A c k * Gt⁻¹ k l) *
            (dGt i j l + dGt j i l - dGt l i j) := by
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b * A⁻¹ l b) * (∑ γ : Fin 3, A γ l *
            (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β)
              + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j)) := by
          simp only [hα', hβ]
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ b : Fin 3, G⁻¹ c b *
            (∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3, A α i * A β j * (dG α β b + dG β α b - dG b α β)
              + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a b * H a i j) := by
          rw [hcontr (fun b => G⁻¹ c b) (fun γ => ∑ α : Fin 3, ∑ β : Fin 3,
            A α i * A β j * (dG α β γ + dG β α γ - dG γ α β) + 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, G a γ * H a i j)]
      _ = _ := by
          rw [← hGG]
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
  have christoffel_law_differentiate : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (U : Set E3), IsOpen U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U → ∀ z₀ ∈ U, ∀ (Γt Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ k i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (Γt k i j) z₀) →
      (∀ c a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (Γ c a b) (ψ z₀)) →
      (∀ z ∈ U, ∀ c i j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) z * Γt k i j z =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b (ψ z) * partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z *
          partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z + partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) z) →
      ∀ c l i j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv l (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c)) z₀ * Γt k i j z₀ +
            partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) z₀ * partialDeriv l (Γt k i j) z₀) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d (Γ c a b) (ψ z₀) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z₀) *
              partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z₀ * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z₀ +
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b (ψ z₀) *
            (partialDeriv l (partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a)) z₀ * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z₀ +
              partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z₀ * partialDeriv l (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b)) z₀) +
          partialDeriv l (partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c))) z₀ := by
    intro ψ U hU hψ z₀ hz₀ Γt Γ hΓt hΓ hlaw c l i j
    have hψd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z₀ :=
      (hψ.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz₀)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hJ : ∀ a k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v a)) U :=
      fun a k => hpdU U hU _ (contDiffOn_euclidean.mp hψ a) k
    have hJd : ∀ a k : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v a)) z₀ :=
      fun a k => ((hJ a k).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz₀)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hHd : ∀ a k m : Fin 3,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv k (partialDeriv m (fun v => ψ v a))) z₀ :=
      fun a k m => ((hpdU U hU _ (hJ a m) k).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz₀)).differentiableAt
        (by simp)
    have hΓψd : ∀ c a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Γ c a b (ψ w)) z₀ :=
      fun c a b => (hΓ c a b).comp z₀ hψd
    have hev : (fun w => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) w * Γt k i j w) =ᶠ[𝓝 z₀]
        (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b (ψ w) * partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w *
          partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w + partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) w) := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz₀] with w hw
      exact hlaw w hw c i j
    have hEq : partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun v => ψ v c) w * Γt k i j w) z₀
        = partialDeriv l (fun w => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Γ c a b (ψ w) *
          partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w +
            partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v c)) w) z₀ := by
      exact congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e l)) hev.fderiv_eq
    have hterm : ∀ a b : Fin 3, partialDeriv l (fun w => Γ c a b (ψ w) *
        partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) w * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) w) z₀ =
        (∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d (Γ c a b) (ψ z₀) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z₀) *
          partialDeriv i (fun v => ψ v a) z₀ * partialDeriv j (fun v => ψ v b) z₀ +
        Γ c a b (ψ z₀) *

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  rcases U.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hUe | ⟨y0, hy0⟩
  · subst hUe
    exact ⟨0, contDiffOn_empty, fun z hz => by simp at hz⟩
  
  have hdet : ∀ z ∈ U, (G z).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz h0
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hGv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr h0
    have hw : (WithLp.toLp 2 v : E3) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; apply hv; simpa using congrArg WithLp.ofLp h
    have h1 := hpos z hz (WithLp.toLp 2 v) hw
    have hrow : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (WithLp.toLp 2 v : E3) a * G z a b *
        (WithLp.toLp 2 v : E3) b = v a * ((G z).mulVec v) a := by
      intro a
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      show v a * G z a b * v b = v a * (G z a b * v b)
      ring
    have h2 : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (WithLp.toLp 2 v : E3) a * G z a b *
        (WithLp.toLp 2 v : E3) b = 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hrow a), hGv]
      simp
    linarith
  
  have hΓs := christoffel_contDiffOn G U hU hG hdet
  have hSC := christoffel_symm_compat G U hU hsymm hdet
  obtain ⟨f0, hf0⟩ := exists_gram_frame (G y0) (hsymm y0 hy0) (hpos y0 hy0)
  obtain ⟨f, ψ, hf, hψ, hfy0, hradf, hradψ⟩ :=
    radial_frame_exists U hU hUc y0 hy0 (christoffel G) hΓs f0
  
  have hRm : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ p k j i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv k (christoffel G p j i) z - partialDeriv j (christoffel G p k i) z +
        ∑ m : Fin 3, (christoffel G p k m z * christoffel G m j i z
          - christoffel G p j m z * christoffel G m k i z) = 0 :=
    fun z hz p k j i => hflat z hz p k j i
  have hframe := frame_eq_of_radial U hU hUc y0 hy0 (christoffel G) hΓs hRm f hf hradf
  
  have hclosed : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (f j) z (e k) = fderiv ℝ (f k) z (e j) := by
    intro z hz j k
    rw [hframe z hz k j, hframe z hz j k]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => by rw [(hSC z hz).1 m k j])
  
  have hpot := potential_of_radial U hU hUc y0 hy0 f hf hclosed ψ hψ hradψ
  
  have hgram := gram_of_frame_eq U hU hUc y0 hy0 G hG (christoffel G)
    (fun m k i => (hΓs m k i).continuousOn) (fun z hz => (hSC z hz).2) f hf hframe
    (fun i j => by rw [hfy0 i, hfy0 j]; exact hf0 i j)
  
  exact ⟨ψ, hψ, fun z hz i j => by rw [hpot z hz i, hpot z hz j]; exact hgram z hz i j⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: radial_frame_exists
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hUc : Convex ℝ U) (y0 : E3) (hy0 : y0 ∈ U)
    (Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hΓ : ∀ m k i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Γ m k i) U)
    (f0 : Fin 3 → E3) :
    ∃ (f : Fin 3 → E3 → E3) (ψ : E3 → E3),
      (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) U) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ U ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 3, f i y0 = f0 i) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ U, ∀ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (f i) z (z - y0) =
        ∑ m : Fin 3, (∑ k : Fin 3, (z - y0) k * Γ m k i z) • f m z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ U, fderiv ℝ ψ z (z - y0) = ∑ k : Fin 3, (z - y0) k • f k z)

      partialDeriv k (Γ p j i) z - partialDeriv j (Γ p k i) z +
        ∑ m : Fin 3, (Γ p k m z * Γ m j i z - Γ p j m z * Γ m k i z) = 0)
