    rw [hv0, inner_zero_left] at h1
    have h2 := hpos z hz v hv
    have h3 : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, v a * v b *
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ h z (e a)) (fderiv ℝ h z (e b)) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, v a * G z a b * v b := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      rw [hhG z hz a b]
      ring
    linarith
  have hsurjW : ∀ z ∈ W, Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ h z) := fun z hz =>
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective (f := (fderiv ℝ h z : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3))).1 (hinjW z hz)
  have hunit : ∀ z ∈ W, IsUnit (fderiv ℝ h z) := fun z hz =>
    ContinuousLinearMap.isUnit_iff_bijective.2 ⟨hinjW z hz, hsurjW z hz⟩
  
  have hgram : ∀ z ∈ V ∩ W, ∀ v w : E3,
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ h z v) (fderiv ℝ h z w) =
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ f z v) (fderiv ℝ f z w) := by
    intro z hz v w
    rw [expand (fderiv ℝ h z), expand (fderiv ℝ f z)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    rw [hhG z hz.2 a b, hfG z hz.1 a b]
  have hsurjF : ∀ z ∈ V ∩ W, Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ f z) := by
    intro z hz
    have hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ f z) := by
      rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
      intro v hv
      have h1 := hgram z hz v v
      rw [hv, inner_zero_left, inner_self_eq_zero] at h1
      exact (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).1 (hinjW z hz.2) v h1
    exact (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective (f := (fderiv ℝ f z : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3))).1 hinj
  
  have dgram : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z → ∀ u v w : E3,
      fderiv ℝ (fun t => @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ t v) (fderiv ℝ ψ t w)) z u =
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ z v) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z u w) +
        @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z u v) (fderiv ℝ ψ z w) := by
    intro ψ z hd u v w
    have hlin : ∀ x : E3, HasFDerivAt (fun t => fderiv ℝ ψ t x)
        ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z).flip x) z := by
      intro x
      have := hd.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const x z)
      convert this using 1
      simp
    rw [fderiv_inner_apply ℝ (hlin v).differentiableAt (hlin w).differentiableAt,
      (hlin v).fderiv, (hlin w).fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
  
  have hT : ∀ z ∈ V ∩ W, ∀ u v w : E3,
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ h) z u v) (fderiv ℝ h z w) =
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z u v) (fderiv ℝ f z w) := by
    intro z hz
    have hS : ∀ u v w : E3,
        fderiv ℝ (fun t => @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ h t v) (fderiv ℝ h t w)) z u =
        fderiv ℝ (fun t => @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ f t v) (fderiv ℝ f t w)) z u := by
      intro u v w
      have hev : (fun t => @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ h t v) (fderiv ℝ h t w)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
          (fun t => @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ f t v) (fderiv ℝ f t w)) := by
        filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz] with t ht using hgram t ht v w
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    intro u v w
    have e1 := hS u v w
    have e2 := hS v u w
    have e3 := hS w u v
    rw [dgram h z (hh2 z hz.2), dgram f z (hf2 z hz.1)] at e1 e2 e3
    have sh := (hhs z hz.2).eq
    have sf := (hfs z hz.1).eq
    have c1 := real_inner_comm (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ h) z u w) (fderiv ℝ h z v)
    have c2 := real_inner_comm (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ h) z v w) (fderiv ℝ h z u)
    have c1' := real_inner_comm (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z u w) (fderiv ℝ f z v)
    have c2' := real_inner_comm (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z v w) (fderiv ℝ f z u)
    rw [sh w v, sh v u, sh w u, sf w v, sf v u, sf w u] at *
    linarith
  
  set B : E3 → (E3 →L[ℝ] E3) := fun t =>
    (fderiv ℝ f t).comp (Ring.inverse (fderiv ℝ h t)) with hBdef
  have hBD : ∀ t ∈ V ∩ W, (B t).comp (fderiv ℝ h t) = fderiv ℝ f t := by
    intro t ht
    have := Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ (hunit t ht.2)
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_def] at this
    simp only [hBdef]
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_assoc, this]
    ext x
    simp
  have hBDa : ∀ t ∈ V ∩ W, ∀ x : E3, B t (fderiv ℝ h t x) = fderiv ℝ f t x := by
    intro t ht x
    have := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => L x) (hBD t ht)
    simpa using this
  have hBiso : ∀ t ∈ V ∩ W, ∀ x y : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ (B t x) (B t y) = @inner ℝ E3 _ x y := by
    intro t ht x y
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hsurjW t ht.2 x
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hsurjW t ht.2 y
    rw [hBDa t ht, hBDa t ht, hgram t ht]
  
  have hHB : ∀ z ∈ V ∩ W, ∀ u v : E3,
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z u v = B z (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ h) z u v) := by
    intro z hz u v
    set d := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z u v - B z (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ h) z u v) with hd
    have horth : ∀ w : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ d (fderiv ℝ f z w) = 0 := by
      intro w
      rw [hd, inner_sub_left, ← hT z hz u v w, ← hBDa z hz w, hBiso z hz]
      ring
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hsurjF z hz d
    have := horth w
    rw [hw, inner_self_eq_zero] at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 this
  
  have hBd : ∀ z ∈ V ∩ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ B z := by
    intro z hz
    exact (hf2 z hz.1).clm_comp ((hh2 z hz.2).inverse (hunit z hz.2))
  have hB0 : ∀ z ∈ V ∩ W, fderiv ℝ B z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have hev : (fun t => (B t).comp (fderiv ℝ h t)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fderiv ℝ f := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hz] with t ht using hBD t ht
    have hder := ((hBd z hz).hasFDerivAt.clm_comp (hh2 z hz.2).hasFDerivAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      hev.symm
    have hfd := hder.fderiv
    ext1 u
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro x
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hsurjW z hz.2 x
    have := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => L u v) hfd
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply] at this
    rw [hHB z hz u v] at this
    simpa using this.symm
  
  have hBconst : ∀ {x y : E3}, x ∈ V ∩ W → y ∈ V ∩ W → B x = B y :=
    hU.is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero hVW (fun z hz => (hBd z hz).differentiableWithinAt)
      (fun z hz => hB0 z hz)
  
  have hrig : ∃ A : E3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E3, ∃ b : E3, ∀ z ∈ V ∩ W, f z = A (h z) + b := by
    by_cases hne : (V ∩ W).Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := hne
      let A : E3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E3 :=
        (LinearMap.isometryOfInner (B z₀ : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) (hBiso z₀ hz₀)).toLinearIsometryEquiv rfl
      have hA : ∀ x, A x = B z₀ x := fun x => rfl
      have hφd : ∀ t ∈ V ∩ W, HasFDerivAt (fun x => f x - B z₀ (h x))
          (fderiv ℝ f t - (B z₀).comp (fderiv ℝ h t)) t := by
        intro t ht
        exact (hf1 t ht.1).hasFDerivAt.sub ((B z₀).hasFDerivAt.comp t (hh1 t ht.2).hasFDerivAt)
      have hφ0 : ∀ t ∈ V ∩ W, fderiv ℝ (fun x => f x - B z₀ (h x)) t = 0 := by
        intro t ht
        rw [(hφd t ht).fderiv, ← hBconst ht hz₀, hBD t ht, sub_self]
      refine ⟨A, f z₀ - B z₀ (h z₀), fun z hz => ?_⟩
      have := hU.is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero hVW
        (fun t ht => (hφd t ht).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt) hφ0 hz hz₀
      rw [hA]
      simp only at this
      rw [← this]
      abel
    · refine ⟨LinearIsometryEquiv.refl ℝ E3, 0, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      exact absurd ⟨z, hz⟩ hne
  obtain ⟨A, b, hAb⟩ := hrig
  
  let F : E3 → E3 := fun y => if y ∈ V then f y else A (h y) + b
  have hFV : ∀ z ∈ V, F =ᶠ[𝓝 z] f := by
    intro z hz
    filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds hz] with y hy
    simp [F, hy]
  have hFW : ∀ z ∈ W, F =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (fun y => A (h y) + b) := by
    intro z hz
    filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hz] with y hy
    by_cases hyV : y ∈ V
    · simp [F, hyV, hAb y ⟨hyV, hy⟩]
    · simp [F, hyV]
  refine ⟨F, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro z hz
    rcases hz with hz | hz
    · exact ((hf.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hz)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hFV z hz)).contDiffWithinAt
    · have h' : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => A (h y) + b) z :=
        ((A.contDiff.contDiffAt).comp z (hh.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hz))).add contDiffAt_const
      exact (h'.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hFW z hz)).contDiffWithinAt
  · 
    intro z hz i j
    by_cases hzV : z ∈ V
    · rw [(hFV z hzV).fderiv_eq]
      exact hfG z hzV i j
    · have hzW : z ∈ W := hz.resolve_left hzV
      have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => A (h y) + b)
          ((A.toContinuousLinearEquiv : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).comp (fderiv ℝ h z)) z :=
        ((A.toContinuousLinearEquiv : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).hasFDerivAt.comp z
          (hh1 z hzW).hasFDerivAt).add_const b
      rw [(hFW z hzW).fderiv_eq, hd.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe,
        LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toContinuousLinearEquiv]
      rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_map]
      exact hhG z hzW i j

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (y : E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hy : y ∈ U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ U, (G z).det ≠ 0)
    (j k : Fin 3) : ricci G j k y = ricci G k j y

signature.name: ricci_symm_local
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (y : E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hy : y ∈ U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ U, (G z).det ≠ 0)
    (j k : Fin 3) : ricci G j k y = ricci G k j y

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hyU : U ∈ 𝓝 y := hU.mem_nhds hy
  have hdetx : (G y).det ≠ 0 := hdet y hy
  have hCa : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z a b) y :=
    fun a b => (hG a b).contDiffAt hyU
  have hGd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y :=
    fun a b => (hCa a b).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hfd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b)) y := fun a b =>
    ((hCa a b).fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hdG : ∀ c a b : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) w) y := by
    intro c a b
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b) w (e c)) y
    exact (hfd a b).clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e c))
  
  have hkey : ∀ a b c d : Fin 3, partialDeriv c (fun w => partialDeriv d (fun z => G z a b) w) y
      = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b)) y (e c) (e d) := by
    intro a b c d
    show fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b) w (e d)) y (e c) = _
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hfd a b) (differentiableAt_const (e d))]
    simp
  have hSchw : ∀ a b c d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv c (fun w => partialDeriv d (fun z => G z a b) w) y
        = partialDeriv d (fun w => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) w) y := by
    intro a b c d
    rw [hkey, hkey]
    have h2 : minSmoothness ℝ 2 ≤ (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) := by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      first
        | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
        | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
        | decide
    exact (hCa a b).isSymmSndFDerivAt h2 (e c) (e d)
  
  have hfs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, (fun z => G z a b) = (fun z => G z b a) :=
    fun a b => funext fun z => hsymm z a b
  have s1 : ∀ c i' j' : Fin 3, christoffel G c i' j' = christoffel G c j' i' := by
    intro c i' j'
    funext w
    unfold christoffel
    rw [hfs j' i']
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    ring
  
  have hdetD : ∀ K : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => K w a b) y) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => (K w).det) y := by
    intro K hK
    have hfun : (fun w => (K w).det) = fun w =>
        K w 0 0 * K w 1 1 * K w 2 2 - K w 0 0 * K w 1 2 * K w 2 1
        - K w 0 1 * K w 1 0 * K w 2 2 + K w 0 1 * K w 1 2 * K w 2 0
        + K w 0 2 * K w 1 0 * K w 2 1 - K w 0 2 * K w 1 1 * K w 2 0 := by
      funext w; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (K w)
    rw [hfun]
    have h00 := hK 0 0
    have h01 := hK 0 1
    have h02 := hK 0 2
    have h10 := hK 1 0
    have h11 := hK 1 1
    have h12 := hK 1 2
    have h20 := hK 2 0
    have h21 := hK 2 1
    have h22 := hK 2 2
    fun_prop
  have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => (G w).det) y := hdetD G hGd
  have hP : ∀ c l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ c l) y := by
    intro c l
    have hfun : (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ c l) =
        fun w => ((G w).det)⁻¹ * ((G w).updateRow l (Pi.single c 1)).det := by
      funext w
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
        smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hfun]
    refine (hD.inv hdetx).mul (hdetD _ ?_)
    intro a b
    by_cases hal : a = l
    · subst hal
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
      exact differentiableAt_const _
    · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hal]
      exact hGd a b
  have hev : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 y, (G w).det ≠ 0 := hD.continuousAt.eventually_ne hdetx
  have hinv : ∀ m c l : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ c l) y =
      -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ c a * partialDeriv m (fun w => G w a b) y * (G y)⁻¹ b l := by
    intro m
    have hE : ∀ a l : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * partialDeriv m (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ b l) y
        + ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun w => G w a b) y * (G y)⁻¹ b l = 0 := by
      intro a l
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w => ∑ b : Fin 3, G w a b * (G w)⁻¹ b l)
          (∑ b : Fin 3, (G y a b • fderiv ℝ (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ b l) y
            + (G y)⁻¹ b l • fderiv ℝ (fun w => G w a b) y)) y := by
        have hs := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
          (A := fun b w => G w a b * (G w)⁻¹ b l)
          (fun b _ => (hGd a b).hasFDerivAt.mul (hP b l).hasFDerivAt)
        convert hs using 1
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun w => ∑ b : Fin 3, G w a b * (G w)⁻¹ b l)
          (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y := by
        apply (hasFDerivAt_const (if a = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) y).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        filter_upwards [hev] with w hw
        have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G w) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hw)) a) l
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
        exact this
      have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e m)) (h1.unique h2)
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h3
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [← h3, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      ring
    intro c l
    let X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun b l => partialDeriv m (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ b l) y
    let DD : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun a b => partialDeriv m (fun w => G w a b) y
    have hM : G y * X = -(DD * (G y)⁻¹) := by
      ext a l'
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
      simp only [X, DD, Matrix.of_apply]
      exact hE a l'
    have hX : X = -((G y)⁻¹ * (DD * (G y)⁻¹)) := by
      calc X = ((G y)⁻¹ * G y) * X := by
            rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdetx), Matrix.one_mul]
        _ = (G y)⁻¹ * (G y * X) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [hM, Matrix.mul_neg]
    have hkl := congrFun (congrFun hX c) l
    simp only [X, DD, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply] at hkl
    rw [hkl]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring
  
  have hcf : ∀ m c i' j' : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (christoffel G c i' j') y =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv m (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ c l) y *
            (partialDeriv i' (fun z => G z j' l) y + partialDeriv j' (fun z => G z i' l) y
              - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i' j') y)
          + (G y)⁻¹ c l *
            (partialDeriv m (fun w => partialDeriv i' (fun z => G z j' l) w) y
              + partialDeriv m (fun w => partialDeriv j' (fun z => G z i' l) w) y
              - partialDeriv m (fun w => partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i' j') w) y)) := by
    intro m c i' j'
    have hT : ∀ l ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)), HasFDerivAt (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ c l *
        (partialDeriv i' (fun z => G z j' l) w + partialDeriv j' (fun z => G z i' l) w
          - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i' j') w))
        ((G y)⁻¹ c l • (fderiv ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i' (fun z => G z j' l) w) y
            + fderiv ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv j' (fun z => G z i' l) w) y
            - fderiv ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i' j') w) y)
          + (partialDeriv i' (fun z => G z j' l) y + partialDeriv j' (fun z => G z i' l) y
            - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i' j') y) • fderiv ℝ (fun w => (G w)⁻¹ c l) y) y := by
      intro l _
      exact (hP c l).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul
        (((hdG i' j' l).hasFDerivAt.fun_add (hdG j' i' l).hasFDerivAt).fun_sub
          (hdG l i' j').hasFDerivAt)
    have hS := (HasFDerivAt.fun_sum hT).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    have hDc : HasFDerivAt (christoffel G c i' j') _ y := hS
    show fderiv ℝ (christoffel G c i' j') y (e m) = _
    rw [hDc.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    unfold partialDeriv
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
    ring
  
  have htr : ∀ j' k' : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv j' (christoffel G i i k') y =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3,
        ((-∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv j' (fun z => G z a b) y * (G y)⁻¹ b l) *
          (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z k' l) y + partialDeriv k' (fun z => G z i l) y
            - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i k') y)
        + (G y)⁻¹ i l *
          (partialDeriv j' (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z k' l) w) y
            + partialDeriv j' (fun w => partialDeriv k' (fun z => G z i l) w) y
            - partialDeriv j' (fun w => partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i k') w) y)) := by
    intro j' k'
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [hcf j' i i k']
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    rw [hinv j' i l]
  
  have alg : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, A a b = A b a) → (∀ c a b : Fin 3, D c a b = D c b a) →
      (∀ m c a b : Fin 3, H m c a b = H c m a b) → (∀ m c a b : Fin 3, H m c a b = H m c b a) →
      ∀ j' k' : Fin 3,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3,
          ((-∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A i a * D j' a b * A b l) *
              (D i k' l + D k' i l - D l i k')
            + A i l * (H j' i k' l + H j' k' i l - H j' l i k'))
        = ∑ i : Fin 3, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3,
          ((-∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A i a * D k' a b * A b l) *
              (D i j' l + D j' i l - D l i j')
            + A i l * (H k' i j' l + H k' j' i l - H k' l i j')) := by
    intro A D H hA hD hH1 hH2 j' k'
    have a10 := hA 1 0
    have a20 := hA 2 0
    have a21 := hA 2 1
    have d10 : ∀ c, D c 1 0 = D c 0 1 := fun c => hD c 1 0
    have d20 : ∀ c, D c 2 0 = D c 0 2 := fun c => hD c 2 0
    have d21 : ∀ c, D c 2 1 = D c 1 2 := fun c => hD c 2 1
    have h10 : ∀ m c, H m c 1 0 = H m c 0 1 := fun m c => hH2 m c 1 0
    have h20 : ∀ m c, H m c 2 0 = H m c 0 2 := fun m c => hH2 m c 2 0
    have h21 : ∀ m c, H m c 2 1 = H m c 1 2 := fun m c => hH2 m c 2 1
    have g10 : ∀ a b, H 1 0 a b = H 0 1 a b := fun a b => hH1 1 0 a b
    have g20 : ∀ a b, H 2 0 a b = H 0 2 a b := fun a b => hH1 2 0 a b
    have g21 : ∀ a b, H 2 1 a b = H 1 2 a b := fun a b => hH1 2 1 a b
    fin_cases j' <;> fin_cases k' <;>
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.isValue, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk] <;>
      (try simp only [a10, a20, a21, d10, d20, d21, h10, h20, h21, g10, g20, g21]) <;>
      ring
  
  have hGT : (G y).transpose = G y := by
    ext a b; exact hsymm y b a
  have hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b = (G y)⁻¹ b a := by
    intro a b
    have h := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv (G y)) b) a
    rw [hGT, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h
    exact h
  have e3 := alg (G y)⁻¹ (fun c a b => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y)
    (fun m c a b => partialDeriv m (fun w => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) w) y) hA
    (fun c a b => by
      show partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y = partialDeriv c (fun z => G z b a) y
      rw [hfs a b])
    (fun m c a b => hSchw a b m c)
    (fun m c a b => by
      show partialDeriv m (fun w => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) w) y
        = partialDeriv m (fun w => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z b a) w) y
      rw [hfs a b])
    j k
  beta_reduce at e3
  
  have hd1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (christoffel G i j k) y
      = ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (christoffel G i k j) y :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [s1 i j k]
  have hq : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3,
        (christoffel G i i p y * christoffel G p j k y - christoffel G i j p y * christoffel G p i k y)
      = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3,
        (christoffel G i i p y * christoffel G p k j y - christoffel G i k p y * christoffel G p i j y) := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    congr 1
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
      rw [s1 p j k]
    · conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
      rw [s1 p j i, s1 i p k]
      ring
  have e1 : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (christoffel G i a b) y
        - partialDeriv a (christoffel G i i b) y)
      = ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (christoffel G i a b) y
        - ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (christoffel G i i b) y := fun a b => Finset.sum_sub_distrib _ _
  have h2 := htr j k
  have h3 := htr k j
  unfold ricci
  linarith [e1 j k, e1 k j, hd1, h2, h3, e3, hq]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (y : E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hy : y ∈ U) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hdet : (G y).det ≠ 0)
    (hR : scalarCurvatureLocal G y = 0) (hS : ∀ i j : Fin 3, staticSymLoc G f i j y = 0) :
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k f y +
        f y * ((ricci G i j y + ricci G j i y) / 2)

signature.name: static_hessian_identity
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (y : E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hy : y ∈ U) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (z : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G z i j = G z j i) (hdet : (G y).det ≠ 0)
    (hR : scalarCurvatureLocal G y = 0) (hS : ∀ i j : Fin 3, staticSymLoc G f i j y = 0) :
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y * partialDeriv k f y +
        f y * ((ricci G i j y + ricci G j i y) / 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hfa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f y := hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y :=
    (hfa.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by
      first
      | exact_mod_cast (le_top : ((1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
      | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
      | simp
      | norm_num)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hD2 : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b f) y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y (e a) (e b) := by
    intro a b
    have h1 : partialDeriv b f = fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e b) := rfl
    rw [h1]
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e b)) y (e a) = _
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const _)]
    simp
  have hsymD : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ f y :=
    hfa.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      simp only [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      first
      | exact_mod_cast (le_top : ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
      | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
      | simp
      | norm_num)
  have hcomm : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b f) y = partialDeriv b (partialDeriv a f) y := by
    intro a b
    rw [hD2, hD2]
    exact hsymD.eq _ _
  
  have hΓ : ∀ k a b : Fin 3, christoffel G k a b y = christoffel G k b a y := by
    intro k a b
    unfold christoffel
    rw [show (fun z => G z b a) = (fun z => G z a b) from funext fun z => hsymm z b a]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    ring
  
  have hH : ∀ a b : Fin 3, hessLoc G f a b y = hessLoc G f b a y := by
    intro a b
    unfold hessLoc
    rw [hcomm a b]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by rw [hΓ k a b]
  
  have hAT : (G y).transpose = G y := by
    ext a b
    exact hsymm y b a
  have hBT : ((G y)⁻¹).transpose = (G y)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hAT]
  have hB : ∀ a b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b = (G y)⁻¹ b a := by
    intro a b
    calc (G y)⁻¹ a b = ((G y)⁻¹).transpose a b := by rw [hBT]
      _ = (G y)⁻¹ b a := rfl
  
  have hunit : IsUnit (G y).det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hdet
  have hinv := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (G y) hunit
  have hdiag : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * G y a b = 1 := by
    intro a
    have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hinv a) a
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at h1
    calc ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * G y a b = ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * G y b a :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by rw [hsymm y a b]
      _ = 1 := h1
  have hdiagSum : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * G y a b = 3 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => hdiag a]
    norm_num
  
  have hR1 : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * ricci G a b y = 0 := hR
  have hR2 : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * ricci G b a y = 0 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← hR1]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [hB a b]
  
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = lapLoc G f y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hLsum : L = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * hessLoc G f a b y := by
    rw [hLdef]; rfl
  have hHE : ∀ a b : Fin 3, hessLoc G f a b y =
      f y * ((ricci G a b y + ricci G b a y) / 2) + L * G y a b := by
    intro a b
    have h1 := hS a b
    simp only [staticSymLoc, staticLoc] at h1
    rw [← hLdef, hH b a, hsymm y b a] at h1
    linarith
  
  have h3 : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * hessLoc G f a b y =
      f y / 2 * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * ricci G a b y) +
      f y / 2 * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * ricci G b a y) +
      L * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * G y a b) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, hHE]
    ring
  rw [hR1, hR2, hdiagSum, ← hLsum] at h3
  have hL0 : L = 0 := by linarith
  intro i j
  have h1 := hHE i j
  rw [hL0] at h1
  unfold hessLoc at h1
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R' C' : ℝ, 1 ≤ R' ∧ 0 ≤ C' ∧ ∀ x : E3, R' < ‖x‖ → 0 < (G x).det ∧
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j x| ≤ C' * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |ricci G i j x| ≤ C' * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2))

signature.name: christoffel_ricci_decay
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R' C' : ℝ, 1 ≤ R' ∧ 0 ≤ C' ∧ ∀ x : E3, R' < ‖x‖ → 0 < (G x).det ∧
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j x| ≤ C' * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |ricci G i j x| ≤ C' * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2))

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨R, C, hR1, hC0, hb⟩ := metric_coeff_bounds G q hq hsmooth hdecay
  
  have hpd : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (i : Fin 3), |partialDeriv i f y| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ := by
    intro f y i
    have h1 := (fderiv ℝ f y).le_opNorm (e i)
    have h2 : ‖e i‖ = 1 := by
      rw [show e i = EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) from rfl, EuclideanSpace.norm_single,
        norm_one]
    rw [h2, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hdiff : ∀ x : E3, 1 < ‖x‖ → ∀ a b c : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y) x := by
    intro x hx a b c
    have hxU : {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} ∈ 𝓝 x := hU.mem_nhds hx
    constructor
    · exact ((hsmooth a b).contDiffAt hxU).differentiableAt (by simp)
    · have h1 := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).1 (hsmooth a b)).2
      have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y (e c))
          {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      exact (h2.contDiffAt hxU).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have tri : ∀ X Y : ℝ, |X - Y| ≤ |X| + |Y| := by
    intro X Y
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [le_abs_self X, neg_abs_le X, le_abs_self Y, neg_abs_le Y]
  have tri2 : ∀ X Y : ℝ, |X| ≤ |X - Y| + |Y| := by
    intro X Y
    have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub X Y
    linarith
  
  have hric : ∀ (Γ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (dΓ : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (A D : ℝ), (∀ k i j, |Γ k i j| ≤ A) → (∀ m k i j, |dΓ m k i j| ≤ D) → ∀ j k : Fin 3,
      |∑ i : Fin 3, (dΓ i i j k - dΓ j i i k) + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3,
        (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k)| ≤ 6 * D + 18 * A ^ 2 := by
    intro Γ dΓ A D hΓ hdΓ j k
    have hA : 0 ≤ A := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hΓ 0 0 0)
    have t1 : ∀ i, |dΓ i i j k - dΓ j i i k| ≤ 2 * D := fun i =>
      (tri _ _).trans (by linarith [hdΓ i i j k, hdΓ j i i k])
    have t2 : ∀ i p, |Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k| ≤ 2 * A ^ 2 := by
      intro i p
      have e1 : |Γ i i p * Γ p j k| ≤ A * A := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hΓ _ _ _) (hΓ _ _ _) (abs_nonneg _) hA
      have e2 : |Γ i j p * Γ p i k| ≤ A * A := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hΓ _ _ _) (hΓ _ _ _) (abs_nonneg _) hA
      calc _ ≤ |Γ i i p * Γ p j k| + |Γ i j p * Γ p i k| := tri _ _
        _ ≤ 2 * A ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    calc _ ≤ |∑ i : Fin 3, (dΓ i i j k - dΓ j i i k)| + |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3,
          (Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |dΓ i i j k - dΓ j i i k| + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3,
          |Γ i i p * Γ p j k - Γ i j p * Γ p i k| := by
          gcongr
          · exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
          · exact (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
              (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _)
      _ ≤ 6 * D + 18 * A ^ 2 := by
          simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
          linarith [t1 0, t1 1, t1 2, t2 0 0, t2 0 1, t2 0 2, t2 1 0, t2 1 1, t2 1 2,
            t2 2 0, t2 2 1, t2 2 2]
  
  set B : ℝ := 1 + C with hBdef
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by rw [hBdef]; linarith
  have hCp : 0 ≤ 9720 * B ^ 4 * C ^ 2 + 324 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 + 9 * C :=
    add_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith)
  have hC'0 : 0 ≤ 18 * B ^ 2 * C + 9720 * B ^ 4 * C ^ 2 + 324 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 + 9 * C := by
    have : 0 ≤ 18 * B ^ 2 * C := mul_nonneg (by positivity) hC0
    linarith
  refine ⟨R, 18 * B ^ 2 * C + 9720 * B ^ 4 * C ^ 2 + 324 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 + 9 * C, hR1,
    hC'0, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hx1 : 1 < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt hR1 hx
  have hr0 : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hdet, hb'⟩ := hb x hx
  have hu0n : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _
  have hu1n : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) := Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _
  have hu2n : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2) := Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _
  have hu0 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one_of_one_le_of_nonpos hx1.le (by linarith)
  have hu11 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ≤ ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2) := by
    have e1 : ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) = ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hr0, ← Real.rpow_add hr0]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [e1]
    nlinarith
  set u0 := ‖x‖ ^ (-q) with hu0def
  set u1 := ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) with hu1def
  set u2 := ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2) with hu2def
  have hαn : 0 ≤ C * u1 := mul_nonneg hC0 hu1n
  have hGB : ∀ a b : Fin 3, |G x a b| ≤ B := by
    intro a b
    have h1 := (hb' a b 0).1
    have h2 : |(if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 := by split_ifs <;> simp
    have h3 : C * u0 ≤ C := mul_le_of_le_one_right hC0 hu0
    calc |G x a b| = |(G x a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) +
          (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| := by rw [sub_add_cancel]
      _ ≤ _ := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ B := by rw [hBdef]; linarith
  have hε : ∀ a b : Fin 3, |G x a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * u0 :=
    fun a b => (hb' a b 0).1
  have hα : ∀ c a b : Fin 3, |partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) x| ≤ C * u1 :=
    fun c a b => (hpd _ x c).trans (hb' a b 0).2.1
  have hβ : ∀ m c a b : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y) x| ≤ C * u2 :=
    fun m c a b => (hpd _ x m).trans (hb' a b c).2.2
  have hinv := inv3_entry_bounds (G x) B (C * u0) hdet hGB hε
  have hdet0 : (G x).det ≠ 0 := (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hdet).ne'
  have hPd : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x ∧
      partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x = -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l :=
    fun m => inv_entry_partialDeriv G x (fun a b => (hdiff x hx1 a b 0).1) hdet0 m
  have hdPb : ∀ m k l : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x| ≤ 144 * B ^ 4 * (C * u1) := by
    intro m k l
    rw [(hPd m k l).2, abs_neg]
    have hterm : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
        |(G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l| ≤
          4 * B ^ 2 * (C * u1) * (4 * B ^ 2) := by
      intro a b
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (hinv k a).1 (hα m a b) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity))
        (hinv b l).1 (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hαn)
    calc _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          |(G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l| :=
          (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
            (Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _)
      _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, 4 * B ^ 2 * (C * u1) * (4 * B ^ 2) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => hterm a b
      _ = 144 * B ^ 4 * (C * u1) := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  have hcv := fun m k i j => christoffel_value_bounds (G x)⁻¹
    (fun m k l => partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x)
    (fun c a b => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) x)
    (fun m c a b => partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y) x)
    (4 * B ^ 2) (12 * B ^ 2 * (C * u0)) (144 * B ^ 4 * (C * u1)) (C * u1) (C * u2)
    (fun k l => (hinv k l).1) (fun k l => (hinv k l).2) hdPb hα hβ m k i j
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j x| ≤ 18 * B ^ 2 * (C * u1) := by
    intro k i j
    have h := (hcv 0 k i j).1
    have h' : |christoffel G k i j x| ≤ 9 / 2 * (4 * B ^ 2) * (C * u1) := h
    linarith
  have hdΓ : ∀ m k i j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv m (christoffel G k i j) x| ≤
      648 * B ^ 4 * (C * u1) ^ 2 + 54 * B ^ 2 * (C * u0) * (C * u2) + 3 / 2 * (C * u2) := by
    intro m k i j
    have h := (hcv m k i j).2
    rw [christoffel_partialDeriv_formula G x (fun k l => (hPd 0 k l).1)
      (fun c a b => (hdiff x hx1 a b c).2) m k i j]
    refine (tri2 _ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      (partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j k) y) x
        + partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i k) y) x
        - partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x))).trans ?_
    have h1 := abs_le.1 (hβ m i j k)
    have h2 := abs_le.1 (hβ m j i k)
    have h3 := abs_le.1 (hβ m k i j)
    have hY : |(1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        (partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j k) y) x
          + partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i k) y) x
          - partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x)| ≤ 3 / 2 * (C * u2) :=
      abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2, h3.1, h3.2],
        by linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2, h3.1, h3.2]⟩
    have h' := add_le_add h hY
    refine h'.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    ring
  have hRic : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |ricci G i j x| ≤
      9720 * B ^ 4 * (C * u1) ^ 2 + 324 * B ^ 2 * (C * u0) * (C * u2) + 9 * (C * u2) := by
    intro i j
    have h := hric (fun k i j => christoffel G k i j x)
      (fun m k i j => partialDeriv m (christoffel G k i j) x) _ _ hΓ hdΓ i j
    have h' : |ricci G i j x| ≤ 6 * (648 * B ^ 4 * (C * u1) ^ 2 +
        54 * B ^ 2 * (C * u0) * (C * u2) + 3 / 2 * (C * u2)) +
        18 * (18 * B ^ 2 * (C * u1)) ^ 2 := h
    refine h'.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    ring
  refine ⟨by linarith, fun k i j => ?_, fun i j => ?_⟩
  · calc |christoffel G k i j x| ≤ 18 * B ^ 2 * (C * u1) := hΓ k i j
      _ ≤ (18 * B ^ 2 * C + 9720 * B ^ 4 * C ^ 2 + 324 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 + 9 * C) * u1 := by
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hCp hu1n]
  · have f1 : B ^ 4 * (C ^ 2 * (u1 * u1)) ≤ B ^ 4 * (C ^ 2 * u2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu11 (sq_nonneg C)) (by positivity)
    have f2 : B ^ 2 * (C ^ 2 * (u0 * u2)) ≤ B ^ 2 * (C ^ 2 * u2) := by
      have : u0 * u2 ≤ u2 := by nlinarith
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (sq_nonneg C))
        (by positivity)
    have f3 : 0 ≤ 18 * B ^ 2 * C * u2 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hC0) hu2n
    calc |ricci G i j x| ≤ 9720 * B ^ 4 * (C * u1) ^ 2 + 324 * B ^ 2 * (C * u0) * (C * u2) +
          9 * (C * u2) := hRic i j
      _ ≤ (18 * B ^ 2 * C + 9720 * B ^ 4 * C ^ 2 + 324 * B ^ 2 * C ^ 2 + 9 * C) * u2 := by
          nlinarith [f1, f2, f3]

subgoal_signatures.name: metric_coeff_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R C : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
        |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: inv3_entry_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (B ε : ℝ)
    (hdet : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ A.det)
    (hB : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j| ≤ B)
    (hε : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε) :
    ∀ k l : Fin 3, |A⁻¹ k l| ≤ 4 * B ^ 2 ∧
      |A⁻¹ k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 12 * B ^ 2 * ε

subgoal_signatures.name: inv_entry_partialDeriv
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)
    (hdet : (G x).det ≠ 0) (m : Fin 3) :
    ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x ∧
      partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x =
        -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l

subgoal_signatures.name: christoffel_partialDeriv_formula
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3)
    (hP : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x)
    (hdG : ∀ c a b : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y) x)
    (m k i j : Fin 3) :
    partialDeriv m (christoffel G k i j) x =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x *
            (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) x + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) x
              - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) x)
          + (G x)⁻¹ k l *
            (partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y) x
              + partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y) x
              - partialDeriv m (fun y => partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y) x))

subgoal_signatures.name: christoffel_value_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (dP : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (d1 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (d2 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (b e p α β : ℝ)
    (hPb : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l| ≤ b)
    (hPe : ∀ k l : Fin 3, |P k l - (if k = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ e)
    (hdP : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, |dP m k l| ≤ p)
    (hd1 : ∀ c a b' : Fin 3, |d1 c a b'| ≤ α)
    (hd2 : ∀ m c a b' : Fin 3, |d2 m c a b'| ≤ β) (m k i j : Fin 3) :
    |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, P k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)| ≤ 9 / 2 * b * α ∧
    |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (dP m k l * (d1 i j l + d1 j i l - d1 l i j)
        + P k l * (d2 m i j l + d2 m j i l - d2 m l i j))
      - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (d2 m i j k + d2 m j i k - d2 m k i j)| ≤ 9 / 2 * (p * α + e * β)

informal_problem.statement:
(f : E3 → ℝ) (A : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (q β R C : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hβ : 1 < β) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖})
    (hA : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |A k i j x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1))
    (hB : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3, |B i j x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2))
    (hf0 : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → |f x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - β))
    (hdf : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-β))
    (heq : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) x =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, A k i j x * partialDeriv k f x + B i j x * f x) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, ∀ x : E3, ρ < ‖x‖ → f x = 0

signature.name: decaying_hessian_rigidity
signature.statement:
(f : E3 → ℝ) (A : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (q β R C : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hβ : 1 < β) (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖})
    (hA : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ k i j : Fin 3, |A k i j x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1))
    (hB : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3, |B i j x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2))
    (hf0 : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → |f x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - β))
    (hdf : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-β))
    (heq : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) x =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, A k i j x * partialDeriv k f x + B i j x * f x) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, ∀ x : E3, ρ < ‖x‖ → f x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have tail : ∀ (F F' : ℝ → ℝ) (a M γ : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → 1 < γ →
      (∀ τ, a < τ → HasDerivAt F (F' τ) τ) → (∀ τ, a < τ → |F' τ| ≤ M * τ ^ (-γ)) →
      Tendsto F atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ s, a < s → |F s| ≤ M * s ^ (1 - γ) / (γ - 1) := by
    intro F F' a M γ ha hγ hd hb hF s hs
    have hγ1 : (0:ℝ) < γ - 1 := by linarith
    set Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => M * τ ^ (1 - γ) / (γ - 1) with hΦdef
    have hΦ : ∀ τ, 0 < τ → HasDerivAt Φ (-(M * τ ^ (-γ))) τ := by
      intro τ hτ
      have h1 := ((Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (p := 1 - γ) (Or.inl hτ.ne')).const_mul M).div_const
        (γ - 1)
      convert h1 using 1
      rw [show 1 - γ - 1 = -γ by ring]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hΦlim : Tendsto Φ atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have h1 : Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => τ ^ (-(γ - 1))) atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hγ1
      have h2 := (h1.const_mul M).div_const (γ - 1)
      rw [mul_zero, zero_div] at h2
      refine h2.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards with τ
      simp only [hΦdef]
      rw [show 1 - γ = -(γ - 1) by ring]
    have hint : interior (Set.Ici s) = Set.Ioi s := interior_Ici
    have hcont : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ici s, ContinuousAt F τ ∧ ContinuousAt Φ τ := by
      intro τ hτ
      have hτ' : a < τ := lt_of_lt_of_le hs hτ
      exact ⟨(hd τ hτ').continuousAt, (hΦ τ (by linarith)).continuousAt⟩
    have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun τ => F τ + Φ τ) (Set.Ici s) := by
      apply antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos (f' := fun τ => F' τ + -(M * τ ^ (-γ)))
        (convex_Ici s)
      · intro τ hτ
        exact ((hcont τ hτ).1.add (hcont τ hτ).2).continuousWithinAt
      · intro τ hτ
        rw [hint] at hτ
        have hτ' : a < τ := lt_trans hs hτ
        exact ((hd τ hτ').add (hΦ τ (by linarith))).hasDerivWithinAt
      · intro τ hτ
        rw [hint] at hτ
        have hτ' : a < τ := lt_trans hs hτ
        have := (abs_le.1 (hb τ hτ')).2
        linarith
    have hmono : MonotoneOn (fun τ => F τ - Φ τ) (Set.Ici s) := by
      apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (f' := fun τ => F' τ - -(M * τ ^ (-γ)))
        (convex_Ici s)
      · intro τ hτ
        exact ((hcont τ hτ).1.sub (hcont τ hτ).2).continuousWithinAt
      · intro τ hτ
        rw [hint] at hτ
        have hτ' : a < τ := lt_trans hs hτ
        exact ((hd τ hτ').sub (hΦ τ (by linarith))).hasDerivWithinAt
      · intro τ hτ
        rw [hint] at hτ
        have hτ' : a < τ := lt_trans hs hτ
        have := (abs_le.1 (hb τ hτ')).1
        linarith
    have hss : s ∈ Set.Ici s := Set.self_mem_Ici
    have h1 : 0 ≤ F s + Φ s := by
      have hl : Tendsto (fun τ => F τ + Φ τ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
        simpa using hF.add hΦlim
      refine le_of_tendsto hl ?_
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop s] with T hT
      exact hanti hss hT hT
    have h2 : F s - Φ s ≤ 0 := by
      have hl : Tendsto (fun τ => F τ - Φ τ) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
        simpa using hF.sub hΦlim
      refine ge_of_tendsto hl ?_
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop s] with T hT
      exact hmono hss hT hT
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> simp only [hΦdef] at h1 h2 <;> linarith
  
  have ray : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ) (R₀ γ M D ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ R₀ → 1 < γ → 0 < ε →
      DifferentiableOn ℝ g {x : E3 | R₀ < ‖x‖} →
      (∀ x : E3, R₀ < ‖x‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ ≤ M * ‖x‖ ^ (-γ)) →
      (∀ x : E3, R₀ < ‖x‖ → |g x| ≤ D * ‖x‖ ^ (-ε)) →
      ∀ x : E3, R₀ < ‖x‖ → |g x| ≤ M * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - γ) / (γ - 1) := by
    intro g R₀ γ M D ε hR₀ hγ hε hg hgrad hdec x hx
    have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt hR₀ hx
    set θ : E3 := ‖x‖⁻¹ • x with hθdef
    have hθ : ‖θ‖ = 1 := by
      rw [hθdef, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hxpos.ne']
    have hxθ : ‖x‖ • θ = x := by rw [hθdef, smul_inv_smul₀ hxpos.ne']
    have hnorm : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → ‖τ • θ‖ = τ := by
      intro τ hτ
      rw [norm_smul, hθ, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hτ]
    have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | R₀ < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
    have hmem : ∀ τ : ℝ, R₀ < τ → τ • θ ∈ {x : E3 | R₀ < ‖x‖} := by
      intro τ hτ
      show R₀ < ‖τ • θ‖
      rw [hnorm τ (by linarith)]
      exact hτ
    have key := tail (fun τ => g (τ • θ)) (fun τ => fderiv ℝ g (τ • θ) θ) R₀ M γ hR₀ hγ
      (by
        intro τ hτ
        have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (τ • θ) :=
          (hg _ (hmem τ hτ)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds (hmem τ hτ))
        have h1 := hdiff.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt τ ((hasDerivAt_id τ).smul_const θ)
        simpa using h1)
      (by
        intro τ hτ
        have h1 := (fderiv ℝ g (τ • θ)).le_opNorm θ
        rw [hθ, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
        refine h1.trans ?_
        have h2 := hgrad _ (hmem τ hτ)
        rwa [hnorm τ (by linarith)] at h2)
      (by
        have h1 : Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => D * τ ^ (-ε)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
          simpa using (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hε).const_mul D
        refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ h1
        filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop R₀] with τ hτ
        have h2 := hdec _ (hmem τ hτ)
        rw [hnorm τ (by linarith)] at h2
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h2)
      ‖x‖ hx
    simpa [hxθ] using key
  
  have clm : ∀ L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ‖L‖ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |L (e i)| := by
    intro L
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound L (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => abs_nonneg _)
      fun v => ?_
    have hv : v = ∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hvi : ∀ i : Fin 3, |v i| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
      intro i
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le v i
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
    calc ‖L v‖ = |∑ i : Fin 3, v i * L (e i)| := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
          conv_lhs => rw [hv]
          simp [map_sum, map_smul]
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |v i * L (e i)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖v‖ * |L (e i)| := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hvi i) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = (∑ i : Fin 3, |L (e i)|) * ‖v‖ := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _
  have clm2 : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (i : Fin 3), |L (e i)| ≤ ‖L‖ := by
    intro L i
    have h1 := L.le_opNorm (e i)
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1
  
  obtain ⟨Cp, hCp0, hCCp⟩ : ∃ Cp : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cp ∧ C ≤ Cp := ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, le_max_left _ _⟩
  have hβ1 : 0 < β - 1 := by linarith
  have hβ1' : β - 1 ≠ 0 := hβ1.ne'
  have hqβ : 0 < q + β := by linarith
  have hqβ' : q + β ≠ 0 := hqβ.ne'
  obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ : ∃ K₁ : ℝ, K₁ = Cp * (3 + 1 / (β - 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK₁0 : 0 ≤ K₁ := by
    rw [hK₁]; exact mul_nonneg hCp0 (by have := one_div_pos.2 hβ1; linarith)
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = 9 * K₁ / (q + β) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁⟩ : ∃ s₁ : ℝ, ∀ r ≥ s₁, K * r ^ (-q) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have h := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hq).const_mul K
    rw [mul_zero] at h
    have h2 := h.eventually (Iic_mem_nhds (show (0:ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num))
    obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 h2
    exact ⟨s₁, fun r hr => hs₁ r hr⟩
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ : ∃ s₀ : ℝ, s₀ = max (R + 1) s₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs₀R : R + 1 ≤ s₀ := by rw [hs₀]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hs₀s₁ : s₁ ≤ s₀ := by rw [hs₀]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hs₀pos : 0 ≤ s₀ := by linarith
  have hU : ∀ x : E3, s₀ < ‖x‖ → R < ‖x‖ := fun x hx => by linarith
  have hUR : IsOpen {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hmonoR : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : E3), C * ‖x‖ ^ t ≤ Cp * ‖x‖ ^ t :=
    fun t x => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hCCp (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
  
  have hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f {x : E3 | s₀ < ‖x‖} :=
    (hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).mono fun x hx => hU x hx
  have hpd : ∀ j : Fin 3, DifferentiableOn ℝ (partialDeriv j f) {x : E3 | s₀ < ‖x‖} := by
    intro j
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} :=
      hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hUR
        (by exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e j)) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖} :=
      h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h2.differentiableOn (by simp)).mono fun x hx => hU x hx
  
  have hval : ∀ N : ℝ, 0 ≤ N → (∀ x : E3, s₀ < ‖x‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ N * ‖x‖ ^ (-β)) →
      ∀ x : E3, s₀ < ‖x‖ → |f x| ≤ N * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1) := by
    intro N hN hP
    refine ray f s₀ β N Cp (β - 1) hs₀pos hβ hβ1 hfd hP ?_
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hf0 x (hU x hx)
    rw [show -(β - 1) = 1 - β by ring]
    exact h1.trans (hmonoR _ x)
  
  have hstep : ∀ N : ℝ, 0 ≤ N → (∀ x : E3, s₀ < ‖x‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ N * ‖x‖ ^ (-β)) →
      (∀ x : E3, s₀ < ‖x‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ N / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (-β)) := by
    intro N hN hP
    have hv := hval N hN hP
    have hhess : ∀ y : E3, s₀ < ‖y‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
        |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y| ≤ K₁ * N * ‖y‖ ^ (-(q + 1 + β)) := by
      intro y hy i j
      have hyR := hU y hy
      have hypos : 0 < ‖y‖ := by linarith
      have e1 : ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 1) * ‖y‖ ^ (-β) = ‖y‖ ^ (-(q + 1 + β)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hypos]; ring_nf
      have e2 : ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 2) * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - β) = ‖y‖ ^ (-(q + 1 + β)) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_add hypos]; ring_nf
      rw [heq y hyR i j]
      have hAk : ∀ k : Fin 3,
          |A k i j y * partialDeriv k f y| ≤ Cp * N * ‖y‖ ^ (-(q + 1 + β)) := by
        intro k
        rw [abs_mul, ← e1]
        have ha : |A k i j y| ≤ Cp * ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 1) := (hA y hyR k i j).trans (hmonoR _ y)
        have hd : |partialDeriv k f y| ≤ N * ‖y‖ ^ (-β) := (clm2 _ k).trans (hP y hy)
        calc |A k i j y| * |partialDeriv k f y|
            ≤ (Cp * ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 1)) * (N * ‖y‖ ^ (-β)) :=
              mul_le_mul ha hd (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hCp0 (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))
          _ = Cp * N * (‖y‖ ^ (-q - 1) * ‖y‖ ^ (-β)) := by ring
      have hBf : |B i j y * f y| ≤ Cp * N / (β - 1) * ‖y‖ ^ (-(q + 1 + β)) := by
        rw [abs_mul, ← e2]
        have hb : |B i j y| ≤ Cp * ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 2) := (hB y hyR i j).trans (hmonoR _ y)
        have hff := hv y hy
        calc |B i j y| * |f y| ≤ (Cp * ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 2)) * (N * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1)) :=
              mul_le_mul hb hff (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hCp0 (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))
          _ = Cp * N / (β - 1) * (‖y‖ ^ (-q - 2) * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - β)) := by ring
      calc |∑ k : Fin 3, A k i j y * partialDeriv k f y + B i j y * f y|
          ≤ |∑ k : Fin 3, A k i j y * partialDeriv k f y| + |B i j y * f y| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, |A k i j y * partialDeriv k f y| + |B i j y * f y| :=
            add_le_add (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) le_rfl
        _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, Cp * N * ‖y‖ ^ (-(q + 1 + β)) +
              Cp * N / (β - 1) * ‖y‖ ^ (-(q + 1 + β)) :=
            add_le_add (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hAk k) hBf
        _ = K₁ * N * ‖y‖ ^ (-(q + 1 + β)) := by
            rw [hK₁]
            simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
            field_simp
            ring
    have hgradj : ∀ j : Fin 3, ∀ y : E3, s₀ < ‖y‖ →
        ‖fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f) y‖ ≤ (3 * K₁ * N) * ‖y‖ ^ (-(q + 1 + β)) := by
      intro j y hy
      refine (clm _).trans ?_
      calc ∑ i : Fin 3, |fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f) y (e i)|
          ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, K₁ * N * ‖y‖ ^ (-(q + 1 + β)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hhess y hy i j
        _ = 3 * K₁ * N * ‖y‖ ^ (-(q + 1 + β)) := by
            simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
            ring
    have hpj : ∀ j : Fin 3, ∀ x : E3, s₀ < ‖x‖ →
        |partialDeriv j f x| ≤ 3 * K₁ * N * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - (q + 1 + β)) / (q + 1 + β - 1) := by
      intro j
      refine ray (partialDeriv j f) s₀ (q + 1 + β) (3 * K₁ * N) Cp β hs₀pos (by linarith)
        (by linarith) (hpd j) (hgradj j) ?_
      intro x hx
      exact (clm2 _ j).trans ((hdf x (hU x hx)).trans (hmonoR _ x))
    intro x hx
    have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
    have hr : ‖x‖ ^ (1 - (q + 1 + β)) = ‖x‖ ^ (-q) * ‖x‖ ^ (-β) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hxpos]; ring_nf
    have hsmall : K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ≤ 1 / 2 := hs₁ _ (by linarith)
    calc ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv j f x| := clm _
      _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, 3 * K₁ * N * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - (q + 1 + β)) / (q + 1 + β - 1) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hpj j x hx
      _ = (K * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) * N * ‖x‖ ^ (-β) := by
          rw [hr, hK, show q + 1 + β - 1 = q + β by ring]
          simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          ring
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) * N * ‖x‖ ^ (-β) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall hN)
            (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
      _ = N / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (-β) := by ring
  
  have hall : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : E3, s₀ < ‖x‖ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ Cp * (1 / 2) ^ n * ‖x‖ ^ (-β) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro x hx
      rw [pow_zero, mul_one]
      exact (hdf x (hU x hx)).trans (hmonoR _ x)
    | succ n ih =>
      intro x hx
      have h1 := hstep (Cp * (1 / 2) ^ n) (mul_nonneg hCp0 (by positivity)) ih x hx
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ Cp * (1 / 2) ^ n / 2 * ‖x‖ ^ (-β) := h1
        _ = Cp * (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1) * ‖x‖ ^ (-β) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
  
  refine ⟨s₀, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hb : ∀ n : ℕ, |f x| ≤ (Cp * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1)) * (1 / 2) ^ n := by
    intro n
    have h1 := hval (Cp * (1 / 2) ^ n) (mul_nonneg hCp0 (by positivity)) (hall n) x hx
    calc |f x| ≤ Cp * (1 / 2) ^ n * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1) := h1
      _ = (Cp * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1)) * (1 / 2) ^ n := by ring
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (Cp * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h1 := (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
      (by norm_num)).const_mul (Cp * ‖x‖ ^ (1 - β) / (β - 1))
    rw [mul_zero] at h1
    exact h1
  have h0 : |f x| ≤ 0 := ge_of_tendsto' hlim hb
  exact abs_nonpos_iff.1 h0

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ (ψ : M → ℝ) (q₁ R₁ C₁ : ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ ∧
      (∀ p : M, g.lapM ψ p = 0) ∧ 1 / 2 < q₁ ∧
      (∀ (j' : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), R₁ < ‖x‖ →
        |ψ ((hAF.ends j').Φ x) - (if j' = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q₁) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends j').Φ y)) x‖ ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q₁ - 1))

signature.name: harmonic_end_weight
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ (ψ : M → ℝ) (q₁ R₁ C₁ : ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ ∧
      (∀ p : M, g.lapM ψ p = 0) ∧ 1 / 2 < q₁ ∧
      (∀ (j' : Fin hAF.numEnds) (x : E3), R₁ < ‖x‖ →
        |ψ ((hAF.ends j').Φ x) - (if j' = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q₁) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => ψ ((hAF.ends j').Φ y)) x‖ ≤ C₁ * ‖x‖ ^ (-q₁ - 1))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀2, hcl⟩ := endChart_far_isClosed g hAF k
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, hoff, hon⟩ := end_cutoff_extension (hAF.ends k) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) 1 ρ₀
    le_rfl (by linarith) contDiffOn_const (hcl ρ₀ le_rfl)
  have hconst : ∀ (c : ℝ) (p : M), g.lapM (fun _ => c) p = 0 := by
    intro c p
    have hpc : ∀ (c' : ℝ) (i : Fin 3), partialDeriv i (fun _ : E3 => c') = fun _ => 0 := by
      intro c' i
      funext y
      simp [partialDeriv]
    simp [RiemannianMetric3.lapM, lapLoc, hessLoc, hpc]
  have hsrc : (hAF.ends k).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends k).source_eq
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : Set E3, A = Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (ρ₀ + 1) ∩ {y | ρ₀ ≤ ‖y‖} :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA : IsCompact A := by
    rw [hAdef]
    exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) (ρ₀ + 1)).inter_right
      (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm)
  have hAsrc : A ⊆ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hAdef] at hy
    have h2 : ρ₀ ≤ ‖y‖ := hy.2
    rw [hsrc]
    show 1 < ‖y‖
    linarith
  have hS : IsCompact ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' A) :=
    hA.image_of_continuousOn ((hAF.ends k).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono hAsrc)
  have hlap0 : ∀ p : M, p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' A → g.lapM u₀ p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    by_cases hpin : p ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ₀ ≤ ‖y‖}
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyp⟩ := hpin
      have hy2 : ρ₀ ≤ ‖y‖ := hy
      have hy' : ρ₀ + 1 < ‖y‖ := by
        by_contra hlt
        push_neg at hlt
        apply hp
        refine ⟨y, ?_, hyp⟩
        rw [hAdef]
        refine ⟨?_, hy⟩
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        exact hlt
      have hO : IsOpen ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ₀ + 1 < ‖y‖}) := by
        apply (hAF.ends k).Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source
          (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm)
        intro z hz
        have hz' : ρ₀ + 1 < ‖z‖ := hz
        show z ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source
        rw [hsrc]
        show 1 < ‖z‖
        linarith
      have hEq : ∀ q ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ₀ + 1 < ‖y‖},
          u₀ q = (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) q := by
        rintro q ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        exact hon z (le_of_lt (show ρ₀ + 1 < ‖z‖ from hz))
      rw [((lapM_gradInner_linear_local g u₀ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) u₀ p).2 _ hO
        ⟨y, hy', hyp⟩ hEq).1]
      exact hconst 1 p
    · have hO : IsOpen ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ₀ ≤ ‖y‖})ᶜ := (hcl ρ₀ le_rfl).isOpen_compl
      have hEq : ∀ q ∈ ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ₀ ≤ ‖y‖})ᶜ,
          u₀ q = (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) q := by
        intro q hq
        apply hoff
        intro hq'
        apply hq
        exact Set.image_mono (fun z hz => le_of_lt (show ρ₀ < ‖z‖ from hz)) hq'
      rw [((lapM_gradInner_linear_local g u₀ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) u₀ p).2 _ hO hpin hEq).1]
      exact hconst 0 p
  have hend : ∀ (j' : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), ρ₀ + 1 < ‖y‖ →
      u₀ ((hAF.ends j').Φ y) = if j' = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro j' y hy
    by_cases hj : j' = k
    · subst hj
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      exact hon y hy.le
    · rw [if_neg hj]
      by_contra hne
      have hmem : (hAF.ends j').Φ y ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ₀ < ‖y‖} := by
        by_contra hnm
        exact hne (hoff _ hnm)
      obtain ⟨y'', hy'', hyeq⟩ := hmem
      have hy''2 : ρ₀ < ‖y''‖ := hy''
      have h1 : y ∈ (hAF.ends j').Φ.source := by
        rw [(hAF.ends j').source_eq]
        show 1 < ‖y‖
        linarith
      have h2 : y'' ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.source := by
        rw [(hAF.ends k).source_eq]
        show 1 < ‖y''‖
        linarith
      have t1 := (hAF.ends j').Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source h1
      have t2 := (hAF.ends k).Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source h2
      have t2' : (hAF.ends j').Φ y ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ.target := by
        rw [← hyeq]
        exact t2
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hAF.disjoint hj) t1 t2'
  
  obtain ⟨ε₀, C₀, q', hε₀, hC₀, hq', hsolve⟩ := conformal_linear_solve g hComplete hAF k _ hS
    (hAF.ends k).Φ ∅ isCompact_empty (Set.empty_subset _)
  have hF : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun p => 8 * g.lapM u₀ p) := by
    have := (contMDiff_const (c := (8 : ℝ))).mul (lapM_contMDiff g u₀ hu₀)
    exact this
  have hcomp : ∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3),
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ g.g p ξ ξ ∧ g.g p ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ := by
    intro p ξ
    have h0 : 0 ≤ g.g p ξ ξ := by
      by_cases hξ : ξ = 0
      · subst hξ
        simp
      · exact (g.posDef p ξ hξ).le
    constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hveq, hvdec, -, -⟩ := hsolve g (fun p _ => rfl) hcomp (fun _ => 0)
    (fun p => 8 * g.lapM u₀ p) contMDiff_const hF
    (fun p hp => ⟨rfl, by simp only; rw [hlap0 p hp, mul_zero]⟩)
    (fun p => by simp only [abs_zero]; exact hε₀.le)
  
  have hharm : ∀ p : M, g.lapM (fun q => u₀ q + v q) p = 0 := by
    intro p
    have h1 := ((lapM_gradInner_linear_local g u₀ v u₀ p).1 hu₀ hv 1 1).1
    simp only [one_mul] at h1
    rw [h1]
    have h2 := hveq p
    simp only [zero_mul, add_zero] at h2
    linarith
  
  have hbd : ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (l : ℕ), l ≤ 2 → ∃ c r : ℝ, ∀ x : E3, r < ‖x‖ →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) x‖ ≤ c * ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - (l : ℝ)) := by
    intro j l hl
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (hvdec j l hl).bound
    obtain ⟨r, -, hr⟩ := (Metric.hasBasis_cobounded_compl_closedBall (0 : E3)).eventually_iff.mp hc
    refine ⟨c, r, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hx' : x ∈ (Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) r)ᶜ := by
      rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le]
      exact hx
    have := hr hx'
    rwa [norm_norm, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) _)] at this
  choose c r hcr using hbd
  have h0 : (0 : ℕ) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
  have h1 : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 2 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = ∑ j, (|c j 0 h0| + |c j 1 h1|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = ∑ j, (|r j 0 h0| + |r j 1 h1|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCj : ∀ j, |c j 0 h0| + |c j 1 h1| ≤ C := by
    intro j
    rw [hCdef]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |c j 0 h0| + |c j 1 h1|)
      (fun j _ => by positivity) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hRj : ∀ j, |r j 0 h0| + |r j 1 h1| ≤ R := by
    intro j
    rw [hRdef]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |r j 0 h0| + |r j 1 h1|)
      (fun j _ => by positivity) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  
  refine ⟨fun q => u₀ q + v q, q', max R (ρ₀ + 1), C, hu₀.add hv, hharm, hq', ?_⟩
  intro j' x hx
  have hxR : R < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hx
  have hxa : ρ₀ + 1 < ‖x‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hx
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
  have hr0 : r j' 0 h0 < ‖x‖ := by
    have := hRj j'
    have := le_abs_self (r j' 0 h0)
    have := abs_nonneg (r j' 1 h1)
    linarith
  have hr1 : r j' 1 h1 < ‖x‖ := by
    have := hRj j'
    have := le_abs_self (r j' 1 h1)
    have := abs_nonneg (r j' 0 h0)
    linarith
  have hc0 : c j' 0 h0 ≤ C := by
    have := hCj j'
    have := le_abs_self (c j' 0 h0)
    have := abs_nonneg (c j' 1 h1)
    linarith
  have hc1 : c j' 1 h1 ≤ C := by
    have := hCj j'
    have := le_abs_self (c j' 1 h1)
    have := abs_nonneg (c j' 0 h0)
    linarith
  have hb0 := hcr j' 0 h0 x hr0
  have hb1 := hcr j' 1 h1 x hr1
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hb0
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one] at hb1
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero, Nat.cast_one] at hb0 hb1
  have hW : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | ρ₀ + 1 < ‖y‖},
      u₀ ((hAF.ends j').Φ y) + v ((hAF.ends j').Φ y) =
        (if j' = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + v ((hAF.ends j').Φ y) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hend j' y hy]
  constructor
  · show |u₀ ((hAF.ends j').Φ x) + v ((hAF.ends j').Φ x) - _| ≤ _
    rw [hend j' x hxa, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact hb0.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc0 (Real.rpow_nonneg hxpos.le _))
  · have hev : (fun y => u₀ ((hAF.ends j').Φ y) + v ((hAF.ends j').Φ y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => (if j' = k then (1 : ℝ) else 0) + v ((hAF.ends j').Φ y)) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hxa) hW

subgoal_signatures.name: weighted_gradient_field
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (a f : M → ℝ)
    (ha : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ a) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) :
    ∃ Z : M → E3, calSmoothField Z ∧ (∀ p : M, a p = 0 → Z p = 0) ∧
      (∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → ∀ i : Fin 3,
        (show E3 from mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) i =
          a ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * ∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i k *
            partialDeriv k (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) ∧
      (∀ (P : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (x : E3), x ∈ P.source →
        ∀ w : E3, (∀ i : Fin 3, w i = a (P x) * ∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff P x)⁻¹ i k *
          partialDeriv k (fun z => f (P z)) x) →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) P x w = Z (P x))
