    have htt : Real.sqrt (P + ε) ^ 2 = P + ε := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hst : Real.sqrt P ≤ Real.sqrt (P + ε) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
    have ht0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (P + ε) := lt_of_lt_of_le hs0 hst
    generalize Real.sqrt P = s at hs0 hss hst ht0 ⊢
    generalize Real.sqrt (P + ε) = t at htt hst ht0 ⊢
    have heq : a / (2 * t) - a / (2 * s) = -(a * (t - s)) / (2 * s * t) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have hts : 0 ≤ t - s := by linarith
    rw [heq, abs_div, abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hts,
      abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * s * t)]
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    have hε' : ε = t ^ 2 - s ^ 2 := by linarith
    have hPs : P = s ^ 2 := hss.symm
    rw [hε', hPs]
    have key : (t - s) * (4 * (s ^ 2 * s)) ≤ (t ^ 2 - s ^ 2) * (2 * s * t) := by
      have h3 : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 + s * t - 2 * s ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hts (mul_nonneg hs0.le h3)]
    have ha := abs_nonneg a
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key ha]
  
  have s4 : ∀ (V W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L →
      (∀ x : E3, L ≤ ‖x‖ → ‖x‖ ≤ 2 * L → V x = W x) → cylFlux V L = cylFlux W L := by
    intro V W L hL hVW
    have hnormsq : ∀ t a b : ℝ, ‖cylPt t a b‖ ^ 2 = t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
      intro t a b
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
        Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp [cylPt, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hshell : ∀ t a b : ℝ, L ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 →
        t ^ 2 + a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * L ^ 2 → V (cylPt t a b) = W (cylPt t a b) := by
      intro t a b h1 h2
      have hn := hnormsq t a b
      have h0 := norm_nonneg (cylPt t a b)
      apply hVW
      · nlinarith
      · nlinarith
    have hcs : ∀ r s : ℝ, (r * Real.cos s) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin s) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
      intro r s
      rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, ← mul_add, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
    unfold cylFlux capFlux sideFlux
    congr 1
    · apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro ρ hρ
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hL] at hρ
      obtain ⟨hρ0, hρL⟩ := hρ
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s _
      have h := hcs ρ s
      have hρ2 : ρ ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      simp only
      rw [hshell L _ _ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ρ]) (by nlinarith),
        hshell (-L) _ _ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ρ]) (by nlinarith)]
    · apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at ht
      obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := ht
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
      intro s _
      have h := hcs L s
      have ht2 : t ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      simp only
      rw [hshell t _ _ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]) (by nlinarith)]
  
  have hR02 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R₀ := hXY.1
  have hR01 : R₀ ≤ R₁ := hXY.2.1
  have hR1 : 0 ≤ R₁ := by linarith
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by linarith
  have hUo : IsOpen {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hYX := hXY.2.2.2.2.2.1
  
  have main : ∀ G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x a b) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) →
      (∀ x ∈ {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}, (G x).PosDef) →
      Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => cylFlux (sternVecEps G ε) L) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
        (𝓝 (cylFlux (gradVec G) L)) := by
    intro G hGs hpd
    obtain ⟨hdiff, hinvs, -, -, -⟩ :=
      ejp_coord_smooth G (fun _ => 0) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} hUo hGs hpd contDiffOn_const
    have hPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ 0 0) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := hinvs 0 0
    have hdPs : ∀ l : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv l (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ 0 0)) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
      fun l => hdiff _ hPs l
    have hPpos : ∀ y ∈ {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}, 0 < (G y)⁻¹ 0 0 :=
      fun y hy => (hpd y hy).inv.diag_pos
    have hPc : ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ 0 0) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := hPs.continuousOn
    have hGc : ContinuousOn G {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
      continuousOn_pi.mpr (fun i => continuousOn_pi.mpr (fun j => (hGs i j).continuousOn))
    have hdetc0 : Continuous (fun A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ => A.det) :=
      continuous_id.matrix_det
    have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y).det) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
      hdetc0.comp_continuousOn hGc
    let A : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun y k => Real.sqrt (G y).det *
      ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ 0 0) y
    have hAc : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => A y k) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
      intro k
      exact hdetc.sqrt.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _
        (fun l _ => (hinvs k l).continuousOn.mul (hdPs l).continuousOn))
    have hPd : ∀ y ∈ {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ 0 0) y :=
      fun y hy => (hPs.contDiffAt (hUo.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hform : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε → ∀ y ∈ {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}, ∀ k : Fin 3,
        sternVecEps G ε y k = A y k / (2 * Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0 + ε)) := by
      intro ε hε y hy k
      have hne : (G y)⁻¹ 0 0 + ε ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith [hPpos y hy])
      have hfd : HasFDerivAt (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G z)⁻¹ 0 0 + ε))
          ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0 + ε))) • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ 0 0) y) y :=
        ((hPd y hy).hasFDerivAt.add_const ε).sqrt hne
      have hpl : ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G z)⁻¹ 0 0 + ε)) y =
          (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0 + ε))) * partialDeriv l (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ 0 0) y := by
        intro l
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [hfd.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [sternVecEps, hpl, A]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_div]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l _
      ring
    have hgrad : ∀ y ∈ {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}, ∀ k : Fin 3,
        gradVec G y k = A y k / (2 * Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0)) := by
      intro y hy k
      have hne : (G y)⁻¹ 0 0 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (hPpos y hy)
      have hfd : HasFDerivAt (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G z)⁻¹ 0 0))
          ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0))) • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ 0 0) y) y :=
        (hPd y hy).hasFDerivAt.sqrt hne
      have hpl : ∀ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G z)⁻¹ 0 0)) y =
          (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0))) * partialDeriv l (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ 0 0) y := by
        intro l
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [hfd.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [gradVec, hpl, A]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_div]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro l _
      ring
    
    have hVc : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε → ∀ k : Fin 3,
        ContinuousOn (fun x => sternVecEps G ε x k) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
      intro ε hε k
      have hden : ContinuousOn (fun y => 2 * Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0 + ε)) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
        continuousOn_const.mul ((hPc.add continuousOn_const).sqrt)
      have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun y => A y k / (2 * Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0 + ε)))
          {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
        (hAc k).div hden (fun y hy =>
          ne_of_gt (mul_pos two_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith [hPpos y hy]))))
      exact h2.congr (fun y hy => hform ε hε y hy k)
    have hWc : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => gradVec G x k) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
      intro k
      have hden : ContinuousOn (fun y => 2 * Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0)) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
        continuousOn_const.mul hPc.sqrt
      have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun y => A y k / (2 * Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0)))
          {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
        (hAc k).div hden (fun y hy =>
          ne_of_gt (mul_pos two_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hPpos y hy))))
      exact h2.congr (fun y hy => hgrad y hy k)
    
    have hK : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (2 * L) ∩ {x : E3 | L ≤ ‖x‖}) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall 0 (2 * L)).inter_right (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm)
    have hKU : Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (2 * L) ∩ {x : E3 | L ≤ ‖x‖} ⊆ {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
      fun x hx => lt_of_lt_of_le hL hx.2
    let H : E3 → ℝ := fun y =>
      ∑ k : Fin 3, |A y k| / (4 * ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0 * Real.sqrt ((G y)⁻¹ 0 0)))
    have hHc : ContinuousOn H {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
      apply continuousOn_finset_sum
      intro k _
      apply ContinuousOn.div (hAc k).abs (continuousOn_const.mul (hPc.mul hPc.sqrt))
      intro y hy
      exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos (by norm_num) (mul_pos (hPpos y hy) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hPpos y hy))))
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHc.mono hKU)
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ max M 0 := le_max_right _ _
    have hbound : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε →
        ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (2 * L) ∩ {x : E3 | L ≤ ‖x‖}, ∀ k : Fin 3,
        |sternVecEps G ε x k - gradVec G x k| ≤ max M 0 * ε := by
      intro ε hε x hx k
      have hxU := hKU hx
      rw [hform ε hε x hxU k, hgrad x hxU k]
      have hP := hPpos x hxU
      have h1 := s5 (A x k) _ ε hP hε
      have hden0 : 0 ≤ 4 * ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0 * Real.sqrt ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0)) :=
        mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (mul_nonneg hP.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
      have hterm : |A x k| / (4 * ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0 * Real.sqrt ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0))) ≤ H x := by
        have hP' : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)),
            0 ≤ |A x i| / (4 * ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0 * Real.sqrt ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0))) :=
          fun i _ => div_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hden0
        exact Finset.single_le_sum hP' (Finset.mem_univ k)
      have hHM : H x ≤ max M 0 := by
        have := hM x hx
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) (le_trans this (le_max_left _ _))
      calc _ ≤ |A x k| * ε / (4 * ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0 * Real.sqrt ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0))) := h1
        _ = |A x k| / (4 * ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0 * Real.sqrt ((G x)⁻¹ 0 0))) * ε := by ring
        _ ≤ max M 0 * ε := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hterm.trans hHM) hε
    
    have hflux : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
        |cylFlux (sternVecEps G ε) L - cylFlux (gradVec G) L| ≤
          12 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * (max M 0 * ε) := by
      intro ε hε
      rw [← cylFlux_sub_of_continuousOn (sternVecEps G ε) (gradVec G) R₁ L hR1 hL
        (hVc ε hε.le) hWc]
      let D : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun x =>
        if ‖x‖ ≤ 2 * L then sternVecEps G ε x - gradVec G x else 0
      rw [s4 (fun x => sternVecEps G ε x - gradVec G x) D L hL0.le
        (fun x _ h2 => by simp only [D, if_pos h2])]
      apply cylFlux_abs_le D L (max M 0 * ε) hL0.le (mul_nonneg hM0 hε.le)
      intro x hx k
      by_cases h2 : ‖x‖ ≤ 2 * L
      · simp only [D, if_pos h2, Pi.sub_apply]
        exact hbound ε hε.le x ⟨mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr h2, hx⟩ k
      · simp only [D, if_neg h2, Pi.zero_apply, abs_zero]
        exact mul_nonneg hM0 hε.le
    
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
    intro η hη
    have hc0 : 0 ≤ 12 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * max M 0 :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos.le) (sq_nonneg L)) hM0
    have hκ : 0 < 12 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * max M 0 + 1 := by linarith
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (div_pos hη hκ)] with ε hε
    obtain ⟨hε0, hε1⟩ := hε
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    calc _ ≤ 12 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * (max M 0 * ε) := hflux ε hε0
      _ ≤ (12 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * max M 0 + 1) * ε := by nlinarith
      _ < (12 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * max M 0 + 1) * (η / (12 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * max M 0 + 1)) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hε1 hκ
      _ = η := by field_simp
  
  have hsmoothΦ : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff Φ.Φ y i j) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
    intro i j
    rw [← Φ.source_eq]
    exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g Φ.Φ i j
  obtain ⟨hGs, hreg⟩ := coordChange_regularity (g.coeff Φ.Φ) hsmoothΦ X Y q R₀ R₁ C hXY
  
  have hpdU : ∀ x ∈ {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}, (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y x).PosDef := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hYd, hXd, -⟩ := hreg x hx
    have hYx : Y x ∈ Φ.Φ.source := by
      rw [Φ.source_eq]
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖Y x‖
      linarith [(hYX x hx).1]
    have hA := coeff_posDef g Φ.Φ (Y x) hYx
    have hinv : (X ∘ Y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] id :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hx) (fun z hz => (hYX z hz).2)
    have hid : HasFDerivAt (X ∘ Y) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3) x :=
      (hasFDerivAt_id x).congr_of_eventuallyEq hinv
    have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (X ∘ Y) ((fderiv ℝ X (Y x)).comp (fderiv ℝ Y x)) x :=
      hXd.hasFDerivAt.comp x hYd.hasFDerivAt
    have hleft : ∀ w : E3, fderiv ℝ X (Y x) (fderiv ℝ Y x w) = w := by
      intro w
      have := congrArg (fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => T w) (hcomp.unique hid)
      simpa using this
    let B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := Matrix.of fun i a => (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i
    have hmv : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i : Fin 3,
        B.mulVec v i = (fderiv ℝ Y x (∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a)) i := by
      intro v i
      simp [B, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add, map_smul]
      ring
    have hw : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a) i = v i := by
      intro v i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hBinj : Function.Injective B.mulVec := by
      intro v₁ v₂ hv
      have h1 : fderiv ℝ Y x (∑ a : Fin 3, v₁ a • e a) =
          fderiv ℝ Y x (∑ a : Fin 3, v₂ a • e a) := by
        ext i
        have := congrFun hv i
        rw [hmv, hmv] at this
        exact this
      have h2 := congrArg (fderiv ℝ X (Y x)) h1
      rw [hleft, hleft] at h2
      funext i
      rw [← hw v₁ i, ← hw v₂ i, h2]
    have hPD := hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hBinj
    convert hPD using 1
    ext a b
    simp only [pullbackMetric, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, B, Matrix.of_apply,
      star_trivial, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact main _ hGs hpdU

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_contDiffOn_source
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source

subgoal_signatures.name: coordChange_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C) :
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullbackMetric G Y x a b) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖}) ∧
    ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ X (Y x) ∧
      (∀ a i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i) x) ∧
      (∀ d i : Fin 3,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => partialDeriv i (fun w' => X w' d) w) (Y x)) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => G w i j) (Y x))

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ φ.source) :
    (g.coeff φ y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: cylFlux_sub_of_continuousOn
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(V W : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (R L : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hRL : R < L)
    (hV : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => V x k) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖})
    (hW : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => W x k) {x : E3 | R < ‖x‖}) :
    cylFlux (fun x => V x - W x) L = cylFlux V L - cylFlux W L

subgoal_signatures.name: cylFlux_abs_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(V : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (L M : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hV : ∀ x : E3, L ≤ ‖x‖ → ∀ k : Fin 3, |V x k| ≤ M) :
    |cylFlux V L| ≤ 12 * Real.pi * L ^ 2 * M

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_coord_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) : (∀ (w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U → ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i w) U) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G Φ a b) U) ∧ (∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ejpN G Φ y d) U)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : EndChart M) (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C : ℝ)
    (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C) (L : ℝ) (hL : R₁ < L) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L →
      volume (Set.Icc (-L) L \ A) < ENNReal.ofReal δ →
      curvTerm (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) L - 4 * Real.pi * L - θ ≤
        ∫ t in A, (sternKappa (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) L t - 2 * Real.pi)

signature.name: stern_kappa_comparison
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : EndChart M) (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C : ℝ)
    (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C) (L : ℝ) (hL : R₁ < L) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ A : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ Set.Icc (-L) L →
      volume (Set.Icc (-L) L \ A) < ENNReal.ofReal δ →
      curvTerm (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) L - 4 * Real.pi * L - θ ≤

      · simp only [Fin.mk_one, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]; fun_prop
    have hq1c : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ a b *
        ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] a * ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] b :=
      continuous_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuous_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
        ((hγi.matrix_elem a b).mul (hn a)).mul (hn b)
    have hq2c : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
        cylGam G p.1 L p.2 a b *
        ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] a *
        ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] b :=
      continuous_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuous_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
        ((hγ.matrix_elem a b).mul (hv a)).mul (hv b)
    have hnum : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => L - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] a *
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ f : Fin 2, (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ a f *
          (cylDG G p.1 L p.2 b c f + cylDG G p.1 L p.2 c b f - cylDG G p.1 L p.2 f b c)) *
        ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] b *
        ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] c := by
      refine continuous_const.sub (continuous_finset_sum _ fun a _ =>
        continuous_finset_sum _ fun b _ => continuous_finset_sum _ fun c _ => ?_)
      exact (((hn a).mul (continuous_const.mul (continuous_finset_sum _ fun f _ =>
        (hγi.matrix_elem a f).mul (((hd b c f).add (hd c b f)).sub (hd f b c))))).mul
        (hv b)).mul (hv c)
    have hden : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ a b *
          ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] a * ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] b) *
        Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, cylGam G p.1 L p.2 a b *
          ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] a *
          ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] b) :=
      hq1c.sqrt.mul hq2c.sqrt
    have hden0 : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ,
        Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ a b *
          ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] a * ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] b) *
        Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, cylGam G p.1 L p.2 a b *
          ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] a *
          ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] b) ≠ 0 :=
      fun p => (mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hq1 p)) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hq2 p))).ne'
    have hfin := hnum.mul (hden.inv₀ hden0)
    refine hfin.congr fun p => ?_
    show _ = curvKappa (cylGam G p.1 L p.2) (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ (cylDG G p.1 L p.2) L p.2
    simp only [curvKappa]
    exact (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm
  
  have hκ : Continuous fun t => sternKappa G L t := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      (μ := volume) (f := fun t s => curvIntegrand G t L s) hcont 0 (2 * Real.pi)
    exact h
  have hf : Continuous fun t => sternKappa G L t - 2 * Real.pi := hκ.sub continuous_const
  
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := -L) (b := L)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hf.continuousOn
  set B := max C₀ 0 with hBdef
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_max_right _ _
  have hB1 : 0 < B + 1 := by linarith
  refine ⟨θ / (B + 1), div_pos hθ hB1, fun A hA hAsub hvol => ?_⟩
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun t => sternKappa G L t - 2 * Real.pi) (Set.Icc (-L) L) :=
    hf.integrableOn_Icc
  have hsplit := MeasureTheory.integral_inter_add_diff hA hint
  rw [Set.inter_eq_right.mpr hAsub] at hsplit
  have hfin : volume (Set.Icc (-L) L \ A) < ⊤ := hvol.trans ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hbd' := MeasureTheory.norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const hfin
    (f := fun t => sternKappa G L t - 2 * Real.pi) (C := B)
    (fun t ht => (hC₀ t ht.1).trans (le_max_left _ _))
  have hreal : volume.real (Set.Icc (-L) L \ A) < θ / (B + 1) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_lt_of_lt_ofReal hvol
  have hreal0 : 0 ≤ volume.real (Set.Icc (-L) L \ A) := MeasureTheory.measureReal_nonneg
  have hδeq : θ / (B + 1) * (B + 1) = θ := div_mul_cancel₀ θ hB1.ne'
  have hBθ : B * volume.real (Set.Icc (-L) L \ A) ≤ θ := by
    have : B * volume.real (Set.Icc (-L) L \ A) ≤ B * (θ / (B + 1)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal.le hB0
    have hδ0 : 0 < θ / (B + 1) := div_pos hθ hB1
    nlinarith
  have hdiff : ∫ t in Set.Icc (-L) L \ A, (sternKappa G L t - 2 * Real.pi) ≤ θ := by
    have h1 := le_abs_self (∫ t in Set.Icc (-L) L \ A, (sternKappa G L t - 2 * Real.pi))
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    linarith
  have hId1 : ∫ t in Set.Icc (-L) L, (sternKappa G L t - 2 * Real.pi) =
      ∫ t in (-L)..L, (sternKappa G L t - 2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith), MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
  have hId2 : ∫ t in (-L)..L, (sternKappa G L t - 2 * Real.pi) =
      curvTerm G L - 4 * Real.pi * L := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (hκ.intervalIntegrable _ _)
      (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable _ _), intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
    have hct : curvTerm G L = ∫ t in (-L)..L, sternKappa G L t := rfl
    rw [hct]
    ring
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (hmin : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv β p = 0)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hharm : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → g.lapM u p = 0)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0)
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hXY : CoordChange X Y (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R₀ R₁ C)
    (hRe : Re ≤ R₀)
    (hX : ∀ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ → X y = cylPt (u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y)) (y 1) (y 2))
    (hdom : (∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
        u (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y x) = x 0 ∧ 0 < β (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y x)) ∧
      ∀ L : ℝ, R₁ < L → IsCompact (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L) ∧
        IsOpen (sternOuter (hAF.ends k) Y L) ∧ IsClosed (sternOuterClosed (hAF.ends k) Y L) ∧
        ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < L → IsCompact (sternSide (hAF.ends k) Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}))
    (hconn : ∀ L : ℝ, R₁ < L → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < L →
      (∀ p ∈ sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t},
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0) →
      IsConnected (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}))
    (hchart : ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
      g.coeff (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y) x = pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y x ∧
      g.gradInner u u (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y x) =
        (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y x)⁻¹ 0 0 ∧
      lapLoc (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) (fun z : E3 => z 0) x = 0) :
    ∃ L₁ : ℝ, ∀ L : ℝ, L₁ ≤ L → ∀ {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ),
      sternAdmissible (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L) q φ →
      ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      ∃ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U ∧ volume U < ENNReal.ofReal δ ∧ -L ∈ U ∧ L ∈ U ∧
        (∀ p ∈ sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p = 0 → u p ∈ U) ∧
        ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → ∃ s₁ : ℝ, 0 < s₁ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₁ →
          sternBulk g β u q φ (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' (Set.Icc (-L) L \ U)) ε s +
            sternCollar g β u q φ
              (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' (Set.Icc (-L) L \ U)) ε s - θ ≤
          sternBulk g β u q φ (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L) ε s +
            sternCollar g β u q φ (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L) ε s

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hΨ, hdomL⟩ := hdom
  have hβs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β := hβ.1
  have hβc : Continuous β := hβs.continuous
  have huc : Continuous u := hu.continuous
  have hR1 : 0 ≤ R₁ := by
    have h1 := hXY.1
    have h2 := hXY.2.1
    linarith
  have hnsq : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := (hdomL (R₁ + 2) (by linarith)).1.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    huc.continuousOn
  
  have hd0 : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    apply IsLocalMin.deriv_eq_zero
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos hx]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg y
  have hd1 : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → deriv Real.smoothTransition x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    apply IsLocalMax.deriv_eq_zero
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le hx]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one y
  have hdnn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition x := fun x =>
    Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
  have hdc : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) :=
    (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).continuous_deriv (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨Mη, hMη⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hdc.continuousOn
  have hdle : ∀ x : ℝ, deriv Real.smoothTransition x ≤ Mη := by
    intro x
    by_cases h0 : x ≤ 0
    · rw [hd0 x h0]; exact le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hMη 0 ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩)
    by_cases h1 : 1 ≤ x
    · rw [hd1 x h1]; exact le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hMη 0 ⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩)
    push_neg at h0 h1
    have := hMη x ⟨h0.le, h1.le⟩
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) this
  have hMη0 : 0 ≤ Mη := le_trans (hdnn 0) (hdle 0)
  
  have hH : ∀ a d Wb Z X : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ d → a * d ≤ Wb → 0 ≤ Z → -Z ≤ X →
      -(Wb * Z) ≤ a * X * d := by
    intro a d Wb Z X ha hd hW hZ hX
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hd) (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ X + Z),
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hW) hZ]
  have hH2 : ∀ a Wb Z X : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ Wb → 0 ≤ Z → -Z ≤ X → -(Wb * Z) ≤ a * X := by
    intro a Wb Z X ha hW hZ hX
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ X + Z), mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hW) hZ]
  have hsmall : ∀ S : ℝ, 0 ≤ S → ∀ θ' : ℝ, 0 < θ' → ∃ x : ℝ, 0 < x ∧ x * S ≤ θ' := by
    intro S hS θ' hθ'
    refine ⟨θ' / (S + 1), div_pos hθ' (by linarith), ?_⟩
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨max (R₁ + 2) (|M₀| + 1), ?_⟩
  intro L hL n q φ hadm θ hθ δ hδ
  have hLR2 : R₁ + 2 ≤ L := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hL
  have hLM : |M₀| + 1 ≤ L := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hL
  have hLR : R₁ < L := by linarith
  set Ω := sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L with hΩdef
  have hΩc : IsCompact Ω := (hdomL L hLR).1
  
  have huL : ∀ p ∈ Ω, u p ∈ Set.Icc (-L) L := by
    intro p hp
    by_cases hout : p ∈ sternOuter (hAF.ends k) Y (R₁ + 2)
    · unfold sternOuter at hout
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hout
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx
      have hxn : R₁ < ‖x‖ := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        have h1 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ R₁ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hcon 2
        have h2 := hnsq x
        have h3 : x 0 ^ 2 ≤ (R₁ + 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 1), sq_nonneg (x 2)]
        have h4 : |x 0| ≤ |R₁ + 2| := sq_le_sq.mp h3
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ R₁ + 2)] at h4
        exact hx ⟨h4, by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0)]⟩
      have hin : |x 0| ≤ L ∧ x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 := by
        by_contra hcon
        exact hp.2 (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hcon)
      rw [(hΨ x hxn).1, Set.mem_Icc]
      exact abs_le.mp hin.1
    · have hp' : p ∈ sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y (R₁ + 2) := ⟨hp.1, hout⟩
      have h1 := hM₀ p hp'
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      have h2 := abs_le.mp (le_trans h1 (le_abs_self M₀))
      rw [Set.mem_Icc]
      constructor <;> linarith [h2.1, h2.2]
  obtain ⟨Ω', O, hpart, -, -, -⟩ := hadm
  obtain ⟨hφs, hφ0, -, hφsupp⟩ := hpart
  
  have hchart : ∀ j : Fin n, ∃ A E : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ 0 ≤ E ∧ ∀ η₀ : ℝ, 0 < η₀ → ∃ Dc : ℝ, 0 ≤ Dc ∧
      ∀ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∃ s₃ : ℝ, 0 < s₃ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₃ →
        -(η₀ * A + r * Dc + τ * E) ≤
          ((∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
              φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
                (Real.smoothTransition (β ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) / s) *
                  g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) *
                Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det) +
            (∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (Ω ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
              φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
                (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) / s) *
                  g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) *
                Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det)) -
          ((∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' (Set.Icc (-L) L \ U) ∩
                (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
              φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
                (Real.smoothTransition (β ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) / s) *
                  g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) *
                Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det) +
            (∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' (Set.Icc (-L) L \ U) ∩
                (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
              φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
                (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) / s) *
                  g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y)) *
                Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y).det)) := by
    intro j
    set c := chartAt E3 (q j) with hc
    have hsupp := hφsupp j
    set Kc := c '' (Ω ∩ tsupport (φ j)) with hKcdef
    set D := c '' (Ω ∩ c.source) with hDdef
    have hKcc : IsCompact Kc := (hΩc.inter_right (isClosed_tsupport _)).image_of_continuousOn
      (c.continuousOn.mono (fun x hx => (hsupp.2 hx.2).2))
    have hKD : Kc ⊆ D := Set.image_mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, (hsupp.2 hx.2).2⟩)
    have hKT : Kc ⊆ c.target := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact c.map_source (hsupp.2 hx.2).2
    have hKS : ∀ y ∈ Kc, c.symm y ∈ Ω := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      rw [c.left_inv (hsupp.2 hx.2).2]
      exact hx.1
    have hmeas : ∀ S : Set M, IsClosed S → MeasurableSet (c '' (S ∩ c.source)) := by
      intro S hS
      have h1 : c '' (S ∩ c.source) = c.target \ (c.target ∩ c.symm ⁻¹' Sᶜ) := by
        rw [c.image_eq_target_inter_inv_preimage Set.inter_subset_right]
        ext y
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hy, hyS, -⟩
          exact ⟨hy, fun h => h.2 hyS⟩
        · rintro ⟨hy, hn⟩
          exact ⟨hy, not_not.mp (fun h => hn ⟨hy, h⟩), c.map_target hy⟩
      rw [h1]
      exact c.open_target.measurableSet.diff
        (c.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hS.isOpen_compl).measurableSet
    have hDm : MeasurableSet D := hmeas Ω hΩc.isClosed
    have hvan0 : ∀ y ∈ D \ Kc, φ j (c.symm y) = 0 := by
      rintro _ ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hy⟩
      rw [c.left_inv hx.2]
      exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hy ⟨x, ⟨hx.1, h⟩, rfl⟩)
    have hG : ContinuousOn (g.coeff c.symm) c.target :=
      continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j' => (g.smooth (q j) i j').continuousOn
    have hsd : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff c.symm y).det) c.target :=
      Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn ((continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hG)
    have hψc : ContinuousOn (fun y => φ j (c.symm y)) c.target :=
      (hφs j).continuous.comp_continuousOn c.continuousOn_symm
    have hbc : ContinuousOn (fun y => β (c.symm y)) c.target :=
      hβc.comp_continuousOn c.continuousOn_symm
    have hQ : ContinuousOn (fun y => g.gradInner u u (c.symm y)) c.target :=
      (stern_gradInner_chart g u u Set.univ isOpen_univ hu hu.contMDiffOn (q j)).mono
        (fun y hy => ⟨hy, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    have hnwc : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y))) Kc :=
      Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn (hQ.mono hKT)
    have hwc : ContinuousOn (fun y => φ j (c.symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff c.symm y).det) Kc :=
      (hψc.mono hKT).mul (hsd.mono hKT)
    obtain ⟨Nm₀, hNm₀⟩ := hKcc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hnwc
    obtain ⟨W₀, hW₀⟩ := hKcc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hwc
    have hNm : 0 ≤ max Nm₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
    have hW : 0 ≤ max W₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
    have hnm : ∀ y ∈ Kc, Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y)) ≤ max Nm₀ 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 := hNm₀ y hy
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) (le_trans h1 (le_max_left _ _))
    have hWb : ∀ y ∈ Kc, φ j (c.symm y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff c.symm y).det ≤ max W₀ 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 := hW₀ y hy
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) (le_trans h1 (le_max_left _ _))
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, hbulk⟩ := stern_bad_bulk_pointwise g β u hβc hu hharm (q j) Kc hKcc hKT
    obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁, hcol⟩ :=
      stern_bad_collar_pointwise g β u hβs hβ.2.1 hu hneu (q j) Kc hKcc hKT
    obtain ⟨Cb₀, sb, hsb, hband⟩ := stern_thin_band_volume β hβs hβ.2.1 (q j) Kc hKcc hKT
    have hCb : 0 ≤ max Cb₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
    have hV : 0 ≤ (volume Kc).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u (c.symm z)) c.target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := q j)))
    have hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => β (c.symm z)) c.target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hβs.comp_contMDiffOn (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := q j)))
    refine ⟨max W₀ 0 * (C₀ * (volume Kc).toReal + Mη * C₁ * max Cb₀ 0),
      max W₀ 0 * (Mη * max Cb₀ 0),
      mul_nonneg hW (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC₀ hV) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hMη0 hC₁) hCb)),
      mul_nonneg hW (mul_nonneg hMη0 hCb), fun η₀ hη₀ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨Ca, hCa, hsub⟩ := stern_submersion_preimage_volume Kc c.target hKcc c.open_target hKT
      (fun z => u (c.symm z)) hf (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y))) hnwc
      (fun y hy hn => (stern_bad_chart_indep g β u hβs hβ.2.1 hu hneu (q j) y (hKT hy)
        (Real.sqrt_pos.mp hn)).1) η₀ hη₀
    obtain ⟨Cs, s₆, hCs, hs₆, hslab⟩ := stern_slab_preimage_volume Kc c.target hKcc
      c.open_target hKT (fun z => u (c.symm z)) (fun z => β (c.symm z)) hf hb
      (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y))) hnwc
      (fun y hy hb0 hn => (stern_bad_chart_indep g β u hβs hβ.2.1 hu hneu (q j) y (hKT hy)
        (Real.sqrt_pos.mp hn)).2 hb0) η₀ hη₀
    refine ⟨max W₀ 0 * (C₀ * max Nm₀ 0 * Ca + Mη * C₁ * max Nm₀ 0 * Cs),
      mul_nonneg hW (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC₀ hNm) hCa)
        (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hMη0 hC₁) hNm) hCs)),
      fun U hUo r hr hUr ε hε τ hτ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨s₇, hs₇, hcol'⟩ := hcol ε hε τ hτ
    refine ⟨min (min s₇ sb) s₆, lt_min (lt_min hs₇ hsb) hs₆, fun s hs hss => ?_⟩
    have hs7 : s < s₇ := lt_of_lt_of_le hss (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
    have hsb' : s < sb := lt_of_lt_of_le hss (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
    have hs6 : s < s₆ := lt_of_lt_of_le hss (min_le_right _ _)
    set A := Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' (Set.Icc (-L) L \ U) with hAdef
    have hAc : IsClosed A := hΩc.isClosed.inter ((isClosed_Icc.sdiff hUo).preimage huc)
    set DA := c '' (A ∩ c.source) with hDAdef
    have hDAm : MeasurableSet DA := hmeas A hAc
    have hDAD : DA ⊆ D := Set.image_mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1.1, hx.2⟩)
    have hUin : ∀ y ∈ (D \ DA) ∩ Kc, u (c.symm y) ∈ U := by
      rintro y ⟨⟨-, hyDA⟩, hy⟩
      by_contra hU
      apply hyDA
      exact ⟨c.symm y, ⟨⟨hKS y hy, huL _ (hKS y hy), hU⟩, c.map_target (hKT hy)⟩,
        c.right_inv (hKT hy)⟩
    obtain ⟨hφεs, hlapc, -, -⟩ := stern_phi_chart_reps g u hu ε hε (q j)
    have hgφ : ContinuousOn (fun y => g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) (c.symm y)) Kc :=
      (stern_gradInner_chart g β (sternPhiM g u ε) Set.univ isOpen_univ hβs hφεs.contMDiffOn
        (q j)).mono (fun y hy => ⟨hKT hy, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    have hηc : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.smoothTransition (β (c.symm y) / s)) Kc :=
      Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp_continuousOn ((hbc.mono hKT).div_const s)
    have hη'c : ContinuousOn (fun y => deriv Real.smoothTransition (β (c.symm y) / s)) Kc :=
      hdc.comp_continuousOn ((hbc.mono hKT).div_const s)
    have hfBc : ContinuousOn (fun y => φ j (c.symm y) *
        (Real.smoothTransition (β (c.symm y) / s) * g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) (c.symm y)) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff c.symm y).det) Kc :=
      ((hψc.mono hKT).mul (hηc.mul (hlapc.mono hKT))).mul (hsd.mono hKT)
    have hfCc : ContinuousOn (fun y => φ j (c.symm y) *
        (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β (c.symm y) / s) *
          g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) (c.symm y)) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff c.symm y).det) Kc :=
      ((hψc.mono hKT).mul ((continuousOn_const.mul hη'c).mul hgφ)).mul (hsd.mono hKT)
    have hvan : ∀ y ∈ D \ Kc, φ j (c.symm y) *
          (Real.smoothTransition (β (c.symm y) / s) * g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) (c.symm y)) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff c.symm y).det = 0 ∧
        φ j (c.symm y) * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β (c.symm y) / s) *
          g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) (c.symm y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff c.symm y).det = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hvan0 y hy]
      simp
    have hptB : ∀ y ∈ Kc, -(max W₀ 0 * (C₀ * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y)))) ≤
        φ j (c.symm y) *
          (Real.smoothTransition (β (c.symm y) / s) * g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) (c.symm y)) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff c.symm y).det := by
      intro y hy
      have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y))
      have hη0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (β (c.symm y) / s)
      have hη1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (β (c.symm y) / s)
      refine hH _ _ _ _ _ (hφ0 j _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hWb y hy) (mul_nonneg hC₀ hn) ?_
      by_cases hβp : 0 < β (c.symm y)
      · have h := hbulk y hy hβp ε hε
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hη0 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤
            g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) (c.symm y) + C₀ * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y))),
          mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hη1) (mul_nonneg hC₀ hn)]
      · rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
          (div_nonpos_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨not_lt.mp hβp, hs.le⟩)), zero_mul]
        linarith [mul_nonneg hC₀ hn]
    have hptC : ∀ y ∈ Kc, -(max W₀ 0 * (s⁻¹ * Mη *
        Set.indicator {z | 0 < β (c.symm z) ∧ β (c.symm z) < s} (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y *
        (C₁ * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y)) + τ))) ≤
        φ j (c.symm y) * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β (c.symm y) / s) *
          g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) (c.symm y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff c.symm y).det := by
      intro y hy
      have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y))
      have hZ : 0 ≤ C₁ * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y)) + τ :=
        add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC₁ hn) hτ.le
      have hsi : 0 ≤ s⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.2 hs.le
      by_cases hbnd : 0 < β (c.symm y) ∧ β (c.symm y) < s
      · have hind : Set.indicator {z | 0 < β (c.symm z) ∧ β (c.symm z) < s}
            (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y = 1 := by
          simp [Set.indicator, hbnd]
        rw [hind]
        have hgI := hcol' y hy hbnd.1 (lt_trans hbnd.2 hs7)
        have hY := hH2 _ _ _ _ (hdnn (β (c.symm y) / s)) (hdle (β (c.symm y) / s)) hZ hgI
        have hX := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY hsi
        refine hH _ _ _ _ _ (hφ0 j _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hWb y hy)
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hsi hMη0) zero_le_one) hZ) ?_
        linarith [hX]
      · have hind : Set.indicator {z | 0 < β (c.symm z) ∧ β (c.symm z) < s}
            (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y = 0 := by
          simp [Set.indicator, hbnd]
        have hz : deriv Real.smoothTransition (β (c.symm y) / s) = 0 := by
          by_cases hb0 : β (c.symm y) ≤ 0
          · exact hd0 _ (div_nonpos_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hb0, hs.le⟩))
          · have hbs : s ≤ β (c.symm y) := by
              by_contra hcon
              exact hbnd ⟨lt_of_not_ge hb0, lt_of_not_ge hcon⟩
            exact hd1 _ ((le_div_iff₀ hs).2 (by linarith))
        rw [hind, hz]
        simp
    have h1 : volume ((D \ DA) ∩ Kc ∩ {y | η₀ ≤ Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y))}) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Ca * r) := by
      refine le_trans (measure_mono ?_) (hsub U hUo.measurableSet r hr hUr)
      rintro y ⟨hy, hyn⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hy.2, hUin y hy⟩, hyn⟩
    have h2 : volume ((D \ DA) ∩ Kc ∩ {y | η₀ ≤ Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y))} ∩
        {y | 0 < β (c.symm y) ∧ β (c.symm y) < s}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (s * (Cs * r)) := by
      have h := hslab U hUo.measurableSet r hr hUr s hs hs6
      rw [show Cs * s * r = s * (Cs * r) by ring] at h
      refine le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h
      rintro y ⟨⟨hy, hyn⟩, hyb⟩
      exact ⟨⟨⟨hy.2, hUin y hy⟩, hyn⟩, hyb⟩
    have h3 : volume (Kc ∩ {y | 0 < β (c.symm y) ∧ β (c.symm y) < s}) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (max Cb₀ 0 * s) :=
      le_trans (hband s hs hsb') (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hs.le))
    have key := stern_bad_chart_bound D DA Kc hDm hDAm hDAD hKcc hKD
      (fun y => φ j (c.symm y) *
        (Real.smoothTransition (β (c.symm y) / s) * g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) (c.symm y)) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff c.symm y).det)
      (fun y => φ j (c.symm y) * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β (c.symm y) / s) *
          g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) (c.symm y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff c.symm y).det)
      (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (c.symm y))) (fun y => β (c.symm y))
      hfBc hfCc hnwc (hbc.mono hKT) hvan (max W₀ 0) C₀ C₁ Mη τ (max Cb₀ 0) (max Nm₀ 0)
      (Ca * r) (Cs * r) η₀ s hW hC₀ hC₁ hMη0 hτ.le hCb hNm (mul_nonneg hCa hr)
      (mul_nonneg hCs hr) hη₀.le hs (fun y _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hnm hptB hptC h1 h2 h3
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) key
    ring
  
  choose A E hA hE hrest using hchart
  have hSA : 0 ≤ ∑ j, A j := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hA j)
  have hSE : 0 ≤ ∑ j, E j := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hE j)
  obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀, hη₀A⟩ := hsmall _ hSA (θ / 3) (by linarith)
  have hrest' := fun j => hrest j η₀ hη₀
  choose Dc hDc hrest2 using hrest'
  have hSD : 0 ≤ ∑ j, Dc j := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hDc j)
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδ₀D⟩ := hsmall _ hSD (θ / 3) (by linarith)
  have hnull : volume (u '' {p | p ∈ Ω ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p = 0} ∪ {-L, L}) = 0 :=
    measure_union_null (stern_crit_values_null u hu Ω hΩc) ((Set.toFinite _).measure_zero _)
  obtain ⟨U, hCU, hUo, hUlt⟩ := Set.exists_isOpen_lt_of_lt _ _
    (lt_of_eq_of_lt hnull (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (lt_min hδ hδ₀)))
  have hUδ₀ : volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ₀ :=
    hUlt.le.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (min_le_right _ _))
  refine ⟨U, hUo, lt_of_lt_of_le hUlt (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (min_le_left _ _)),
    hCU (Set.mem_union_right _ (by simp)), hCU (Set.mem_union_right _ (by simp)),
    fun p hp hz => hCU (Set.mem_union_left _ ⟨p, ⟨hp, hz⟩, rfl⟩), fun ε hε _ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, hτE⟩ := hsmall _ hSE (θ / 3) (by linarith)
  have h3 := fun j => hrest2 j U hUo δ₀ hδ₀.le hUδ₀ ε hε τ hτ
  choose s₃ hs₃ hb using h3
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂pos, hs₂le⟩ : ∃ s₂ : ℝ, 0 < s₂ ∧ ∀ j, s₂ ≤ s₃ j := by
    refine ⟨(insert 1 (Finset.univ.image s₃)).min' (Finset.insert_nonempty _ _), ?_, fun j => ?_⟩
    · have hm := Finset.min'_mem (insert 1 (Finset.univ.image s₃)) (Finset.insert_nonempty _ _)
      rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image] at hm
      rcases hm with h | ⟨j, -, hj⟩
      · rw [h]; exact one_pos
      · rw [← hj]; exact hs₃ j
    · exact Finset.min'_le _ _
        (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)))
  refine ⟨s₂, hs₂pos, fun s hs hss => ?_⟩
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun j _ => hb j s hs (lt_of_lt_of_le hss (hs₂le j)))
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum] at hsum
  simp only [sternBulk, sternCollar, calVolSum]
  linarith [hsum, hη₀A, hδ₀D, hτE]

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_phi_chart_reps
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (q : M) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (sternPhiM g u ε) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun y => g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
    IsOpen {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0} ∧
    ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x))
      {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0}

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_gradInner_chart
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (f w : M → ℝ)
    (U : Set M) (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hw : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w U) (q : M) :
    ContinuousOn (fun y => g.gradInner f w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U}

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_crit_values_null
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    volume (u '' {p | p ∈ K ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p = 0}) = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_bad_bulk_pointwise
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (β u : M → ℝ) (hβc : Continuous β) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hharm : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → g.lapM u p = 0) (q : M) (Kc : Set E3) (hKc : IsCompact Kc)
    (hKT : Kc ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Kc, 0 < β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      -(C₀ * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) ≤
        g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_bad_collar_pointwise
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (β u : M → ℝ) (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β)
    (hβr : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0) (q : M) (Kc : Set E3)
    (hKc : IsCompact Kc) (hKT : Kc ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) :
    ∃ C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∃ s₇ : ℝ, 0 < s₇ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Kc,
      0 < β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) → β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) < s₇ →
      -(C₁ * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) + τ) ≤
        g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_bad_chart_indep

  obtain ⟨hφs, hφ0, -, hφsupp⟩ := hpart

    intro x hx

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_band_pointwise
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (β u : M → ℝ) (hβc : Continuous β)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hharm : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → g.lapM u p = 0)
    (p : M) (hp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    0 < g.gradInner u u p ∧
    (0 < β p → -(|sternGaussM g u p| * ε / (2 * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p))) ≤
      g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) p + Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) * sternGaussM g u p) ∧
    g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) p =
      Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) / sternPhiM g u ε p *
        g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) p ∧
    0 ≤ 1 - Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) / sternPhiM g u ε p ∧
    1 - Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) / sternPhiM g u ε p ≤ ε / (2 * g.gradInner u u p)

(D Kc : Set E3) (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hKc : IsCompact Kc)

      have hnum : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => L - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
          ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] a *
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ f : Fin 2, (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ a f *
            (cylDG G p.1 L p.2 b c f + cylDG G p.1 L p.2 c b f - cylDG G p.1 L p.2 f b c)) *
          ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] b *
          ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] c := by
        refine continuous_const.sub (continuous_finset_sum _ fun a _ =>
          continuous_finset_sum _ fun b _ => continuous_finset_sum _ fun c _ => ?_)
        exact (((hn a).mul (continuous_const.mul (continuous_finset_sum _ fun f _ =>
          (hγi.matrix_elem a f).mul (((hd b c f).add (hd c b f)).sub (hd f b c))))).mul
          (hv b)).mul (hv c)
      have hden : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ a b *
            ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] a * ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] b) *
          Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, cylGam G p.1 L p.2 a b *
            ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] a *
            ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] b) :=
        hq1c.sqrt.mul hq2c.sqrt
      have hden0 : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ,
          Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ a b *
            ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] a * ![Real.cos p.2, Real.sin p.2] b) *
          Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, cylGam G p.1 L p.2 a b *
            ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] a *
            ![-(L * Real.sin p.2), L * Real.cos p.2] b) ≠ 0 :=
        fun p => (mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hq1 p)) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hq2 p))).ne'
      have hfin := hnum.mul (hden.inv₀ hden0)
      refine hfin.congr fun p => ?_
      show _ = curvKappa (cylGam G p.1 L p.2) (cylGam G p.1 L p.2)⁻¹ (cylDG G p.1 L p.2) L p.2
      simp only [curvKappa]
      exact (div_eq_mul_inv _ _).symm
    exact intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
      (μ := volume) (f := fun t s => curvIntegrand G t L s) hcont 0 (2 * Real.pi)
  
  refine ⟨R₁ + 1, fun L hL => ?_⟩
  have hLR : R₁ < L := by linarith
  have hκ := hκgen (hAF.ends k) _ R₀ R₁ C hXY L hLR
  intro n q φ hadm A hA hAsub hreg θ hθ
  obtain ⟨κ', hκ'⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun t =>
      2 * Real.pi - sternKappa (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ, F = fun s t =>
      sbgbSliceJ g β u q φ (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L) t s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκ'c : Continuous κ' := by rw [hκ']; exact continuous_const.sub hκ
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hA.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hκ'c.continuousOn
  have hκ'int : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn κ' A := hκ'c.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hA
  have hcoarea := stern_band_coarea g hAF hR k β Re hβ hmin u hu hharm hneu X Y R₀ R₁ C hXY hRe
    hX hdom hconn hchart L hL q φ hadm A hA hAsub hreg
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀, Cb, hbd, hlim⟩ := stern_slice_collar_limit g hAF hR k β Re hβ hmin u hu hharm
    hneu X Y R₀ R₁ C hXY hRe hX hdom hconn hchart L hL q φ hadm A hA hAsub hreg
  have hgb : ∀ t ∈ A, sbgbSliceLim g β u q φ (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L) t ≤ κ' t := by
    intro t ht
    have htL : |t| < L := abs_lt.mpr (hAsub ht)
    rw [hκ']
    refine stern_slice_gauss_bonnet g hAF hR k β Re hβ hmin u hu hharm hneu X Y R₀ R₁ C hXY hRe
      hX hdom hconn hchart L hL q φ hadm t htL ?_
    intro p hp
    refine hreg p hp.1 ?_
    rw [show u p = t from hp.2]
    exact ht
  have hFint : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (F s) A := by
    intro s hs
    rw [hF]
    exact (hcoarea s hs).1
  have hFeq : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      sternBandJ g β u q φ (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' A) s = ∫ t in A, F s t := by
    intro s hs
    rw [hF]
    exact (hcoarea s hs).2
  have hFbd : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₀ → ∀ t ∈ A, |F s t| ≤ Cb := by
    intro s hs hs' t ht
    rw [hF]
    exact hbd s hs hs' t ht
  have hFlim : ∀ t ∈ A, Tendsto (fun s => F s t) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
      (𝓝 (sbgbSliceLim g β u q φ (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L) t)) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hF]
    exact hlim t ht
  
  have hHint : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun t => max (F s t) (κ' t)) A := by
    intro s hs
    refine ((hFint s hs).sup hκ'int).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => ?_)
    simp only [Pi.sup_apply]
  have hmeasA : MeasurableSet A := hA.measurableSet
  have hDCT : Tendsto (fun s => ∫ t in A, max (F s t) (κ' t)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
      (𝓝 (∫ t in A, κ' t)) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun _ => |Cb| + |B|) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
      exact (hHint s hs).aestronglyMeasurable
    · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hs₀] with s hs
      refine (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' hmeasA).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => ?_)
      have ha := abs_le.mp (hFbd s hs.1 hs.2 t ht)
      have hb' : |κ' t| ≤ B := by
        have := hB t ht
        rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      have hb := abs_le.mp hb'
      have h1 := le_abs_self Cb
      have h2 := le_abs_self B
      have h3 := abs_nonneg Cb
      have h4 := abs_nonneg B
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
      constructor
      · exact le_trans (by linarith) (le_max_left _ _)
      · exact max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
    · exact continuous_const.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hA
    · refine (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' hmeasA).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t ht => ?_)
      have h := (hFlim t ht).max (tendsto_const_nhds (x := κ' t))
      rwa [max_eq_right (hgb t ht)] at h
  have hlt : ∫ t in A, κ' t < (∫ t in A, κ' t) + θ := by linarith
  have hev := hDCT (Iio_mem_nhds hlt)
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂, hsub⟩ :=
    mem_nhdsGT_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp (Filter.inter_mem hev (Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hs₀))
  refine ⟨s₂, hs₂, fun s hs hss => ?_⟩
  have hmem := hsub ⟨hs, hss⟩
  have hI : ∫ t in A, max (F s t) (κ' t) < (∫ t in A, κ' t) + θ := hmem.1
  have hmono : ∫ t in A, F s t ≤ ∫ t in A, max (F s t) (κ' t) :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_mono (hFint s hs) (hHint s hs) (fun t => le_max_left _ _)
  have hk2 : κ' = fun t =>
      -(sternKappa (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L t - 2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [hκ']
    funext t
    ring
  have hkint : ∫ t in A, κ' t =
      -(∫ t in A, (sternKappa (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L t - 2 * Real.pi)) := by
    rw [hk2, MeasureTheory.integral_neg]
  rw [hFeq s hs]
  linarith

stern_band_gauss_bonnet.definitions:
def sbgbAreaConst : ℝ :=
  Real.pi / (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) 1)).toReal


def sbgbLenConst : ℝ :=
  1 / (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)).toReal


def sbgbAreaDens (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  sbgbAreaConst * Real.sqrt (G y).det * Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y) / ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖


def sbgbCross (f b : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  ![partialDeriv 1 f y * partialDeriv 2 b y - partialDeriv 2 f y * partialDeriv 1 b y,
    partialDeriv 2 f y * partialDeriv 0 b y - partialDeriv 0 f y * partialDeriv 2 b y,
    partialDeriv 0 f y * partialDeriv 1 b y - partialDeriv 1 f y * partialDeriv 0 b y]


def sbgbEdgeDens (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f b : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  sbgbLenConst *
    Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G y k l * sbgbCross f b y k * sbgbCross f b y l) /
    Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2)


def sbgbSliceInt (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u : M → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M)
    (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (S : Set M) (t : ℝ) (h : M → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (S ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
    φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * h ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
      sbgbAreaDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) y
    ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))


def sbgbEdgeInt (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (β u : M → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M)
    (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (S : Set M) (t : ℝ) (h : M → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, ∫ y in chartAt E3 (q j) '' (S ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∩ β ⁻¹' {0} ∩ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source),
    φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) * h ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm y) *
      sbgbEdgeDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z))
        (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) y
    ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ))


def sbgbSliceJ (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (β u : M → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M)
    (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (S : Set M) (t s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sbgbSliceInt g u q φ S t (fun p => Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) * sternGaussM g u p) -
    sbgbSliceInt g u q φ S t (fun p => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) *
      g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) p / Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p))


def sbgbSliceLim (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (β u : M → ℝ) {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M)
    (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (S : Set M) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sbgbSliceInt g u q φ S t (fun p => sternGaussM g u p) -
    sbgbEdgeInt g β u q φ S t (fun p => g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) p /
      (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner β β p)))

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (hmin : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv β p = 0)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hharm : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → g.lapM u p = 0)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0)
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hXY : CoordChange X Y (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R₀ R₁ C)
    (hRe : Re ≤ R₀)
    (hX : ∀ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ → X y = cylPt (u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y)) (y 1) (y 2))
    (hdom : (∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
        u (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y x) = x 0 ∧ 0 < β (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y x)) ∧
      ∀ L : ℝ, R₁ < L → IsCompact (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L) ∧
        IsOpen (sternOuter (hAF.ends k) Y L) ∧ IsClosed (sternOuterClosed (hAF.ends k) Y L) ∧
        ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < L → IsCompact (sternSide (hAF.ends k) Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}))
    (hconn : ∀ L : ℝ, R₁ < L → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < L →
      (∀ p ∈ sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t},
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0) →
      IsConnected (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}))
    (hchart : ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
      g.coeff (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y) x = pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y x ∧
      g.gradInner u u (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y x) =
        (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y x)⁻¹ 0 0 ∧
      lapLoc (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) (fun z : E3 => z 0) x = 0) :
    ∀ L : ℝ, R₁ + 1 ≤ L → ∀ {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ),
      sternAdmissible (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L) q φ →
      ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < L →
      (∀ p ∈ sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0) →
      sbgbSliceLim g β u q φ (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L) t ≤
        2 * Real.pi - sternKappa (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) L t

search_metadata.last_error: Approved at the commit gate. The three children are, in order: stern_band_coarea (chartwise coarea; sbgbAreaDens is exactly the cofactor-identity density, so this is pure measure theory), stern_slice_collar_limit (a fixed-slice 1-D collar limit with a uniform bound; uses hneu to get |grad^Sigma beta| = |grad beta| on the edge, no topology), and stern_slice_gauss_bonnet. The third child is the named [CRUX] (Gauss-Bonnet with chi <= 1). I checked its sign chain: the edge integrand -<grad beta, grad N>/(N|grad beta|) equals k_g w.r.t. the inward conormal, via hneu and hmin. The compiled DCT-on-max glue consumes all three children. Merging s4/s5/s6 into child 3 and absorbing s1 into children 1-2 is documented under Divergence in findings, so the crux has a home. Blueprint sections 4/5 carry real numerics (2*pi*chi on disc/annulus/caps, curvIntegrand GB, cofactor identity) and edge-case checks F1-F9. Constants are self-normalising, no section 10 lemma is re-proved, and no ancestor is restated. The child-3 prover should split along blueprint s4/s5/s6 and the section 7 sub-split of s6.

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g)
    (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (S : Set M) (hS : IsCompact S) (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKφ : K ⊆ φ.source) :
    ∃ (ε₀ Λ : ℝ) (ρ : Fin hAF.numEnds → ℝ), 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 ≤ Λ ∧ (∀ j, 1 < ρ j) ∧
      ∀ h : RiemannianMetric3 M, (∀ p : M, p ∉ S → h.g p = g.g p) →
        (∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ h.g p ξ ξ ∧ h.g p ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ) →
        ∀ V f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ V → ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
          (∀ p : M, p ∉ S → V p = 0 ∧ f p = 0) → (∀ p : M, |V p| ≤ ε₀) →
          ∃ u : ℕ → M → ℝ,
            (∀ n, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u n) ∧ HasCompactSupport (u n)) ∧
            (∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (L : Set E3),
              IsCompact L → L ⊆ ψ.source → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m, N ≤ m → ∀ n, N ≤ n →
                ∫ y in L, ((u n (ψ y) - u m (ψ y)) ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin 3,
                  (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) y
                    - partialDeriv i (fun z => u m (ψ z)) y) ^ 2) < ε) ∧
            (∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (ζ : E3 → ℝ),
              ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ψ.source →
              Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y, (8 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b *
                    partialDeriv b (fun z => u n (ψ z)) y * partialDeriv a ζ y
                  + (V (ψ y) * u n (ψ y) - f (ψ y)) * ζ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det)
                atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧
            (∀ B : ℝ, (∀ p : M, |f p| ≤ B) → ∀ n,
              ∫ y in K, ((u n (φ y)) ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin 3,
                (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (φ z)) y) ^ 2) ≤ Λ * B ^ 2) ∧
            (∀ B : ℝ, (∀ p : M, |f p| ≤ B) → ∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ),
              ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρ j < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R},
                (u n ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ Λ * B ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨ρA, nA, κ, χ, hA⟩ := cls_atlas_exists g hAF
  obtain ⟨CS, hCS, hPS⟩ := cls_poincare_compact g hAF k ρA κ χ hA S hS
  obtain ⟨ε₀, cS, hε₀, hcS, hcoer⟩ := cls_coercive g hAF ρA κ χ hA S hS CS hCS hPS
  have hT : IsCompact (φ '' K) :=
    hK.image_of_continuousOn (φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono hKφ)
  obtain ⟨CT, hCT, hPT⟩ := cls_poincare_compact g hAF k ρA κ χ hA (φ '' K) hT
  obtain ⟨CK, hCK0, hCK⟩ := cls_chart_energy_bound g hAF ρA κ χ hA φ K hK hKφ CT hCT hPT
  choose ρ CH hρ hCH hHb using fun j => cls_end_hardy g hAF ρA κ χ hA j
  obtain ⟨CHs, hCHsdef⟩ : ∃ CHs : ℝ, CHs = ∑ j, CH j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCHs0 : 0 ≤ CHs := by rw [hCHsdef]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => hCH j
  have hCHle : ∀ j, CH j ≤ CHs := by
    intro j; rw [hCHsdef]; exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hCH j) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  obtain ⟨κ0, hκ0def⟩ : ∃ κ0 : ℝ, κ0 = 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * (4 * cS ^ 2 / (15 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ0 := by rw [hκ0def]; positivity
  refine ⟨ε₀, (CK + CHs) * κ0, ρ, hε₀, mul_nonneg (add_nonneg hCK0 hCHs0) hκ0, hρ, ?_⟩
  
  intro h hh hequiv V f hV hf hVf hVb
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ : ∃ B₀ : ℝ, ∀ p : M, |f p| ≤ B₀ := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC'⟩ := hS.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf.continuous.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max C 0, fun p => ?_⟩
    by_cases hp : p ∈ S
    · have h1 := hC' p hp
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact h1.trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · rw [(hVf p hp).2, abs_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  obtain ⟨hQs, hQa, hQh, hLa, hLh, hD⟩ := cls_form_algebra g hAF ρA κ χ hA h V f hV hf
  have hP0 : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (0 : M → ℝ) ∧ HasCompactSupport (0 : M → ℝ) :=
    ⟨contMDiff_const, HasCompactSupport.zero⟩
  have hPa : ∀ u v : M → ℝ, (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v ∧ HasCompactSupport v) →
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u + v) ∧ HasCompactSupport (u + v)) :=
    fun u v hu hv => ⟨hu.1.add hv.1, hu.2.add hv.2⟩
  have hPs : ∀ (t : ℝ) (u : M → ℝ), (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (t • u) ∧ HasCompactSupport (t • u)) :=
    fun t u hu => ⟨contMDiff_const.smul hu.1, hu.2.mono (Function.support_const_smul_subset t u)⟩
  have hcoer' : ∀ w : M → ℝ, (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧ HasCompactSupport w) →
      (15 / 2 : ℝ) * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner w w) ≤ clsQ h κ χ V w w := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 := (hcoer h hequiv w hw.1 hw.2).1 V hV (fun p hp => (hVf p hp).1) hVb
    have h2 := neg_abs_le (atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => V p * w p * w p))
    have h3 := hD w hw
    unfold clsQ
    linarith
  have hβ : ∀ B : ℝ, (∀ p : M, |f p| ≤ B) → ∀ w : M → ℝ,
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧ HasCompactSupport w) →
      |clsL h κ χ f w| ≤ (cS * B) * Real.sqrt (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner w w)) :=
    fun B hB w hw => (hcoer h hequiv w hw.1 hw.2).2.1 f B hf (fun p hp => (hVf p hp).2) hB
  obtain ⟨u, hPu, hDb, hCa, hEL⟩ := cls_direct_method (X := M → ℝ)
    (fun w : M → ℝ => ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧ HasCompactSupport w) hP0 hPa hPs
    (clsQ h κ χ V) (clsL h κ χ f) (fun w => atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner w w)) (15 / 2)
    (cS * B₀) hQs hQa hQh hLa hLh hD (by norm_num) hcoer' (hβ B₀ hB₀)
  
  have hDg : ∀ B : ℝ, (∀ p : M, |f p| ≤ B) → ∀ n,
      atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner (u n) (u n)) ≤ κ0 * B ^ 2 := by
    intro B hB n
    have h1 : atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner (u n) (u n)) ≤ 4 * (cS * B) ^ 2 / (15 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      hDb (cS * B) (hβ B hB) n
    have h2 := (hcoer h hequiv (u n) (hPu n).1 (hPu n).2).2.2
    have h3 : 4 * (cS * B) ^ 2 / (15 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 = (4 * cS ^ 2 / (15 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2) * B ^ 2 := by
      ring
    have h4 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
    calc atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner (u n) (u n))
        ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner (u n) (u n)) := h2
      _ ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * ((4 * cS ^ 2 / (15 / 2 : ℝ) ^ 2) * B ^ 2) := by
          rw [← h3]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h4
      _ = κ0 * B ^ 2 := by rw [hκ0def]; ring
  refine ⟨u, hPu, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  
  · intro ψ L hL hLψ ε hε
    have hTψ : IsCompact (ψ '' L) :=
      hL.image_of_continuousOn (ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono hLψ)
    obtain ⟨CTψ, hCTψ, hPψ⟩ := cls_poincare_compact g hAF k ρA κ χ hA (ψ '' L) hTψ
    obtain ⟨Cψ, hCψ, hCψb⟩ := cls_chart_energy_bound g hAF ρA κ χ hA ψ L hL hLψ CTψ hCTψ hPψ
    obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = Cψ * (4 * Real.sqrt 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hAdef]; exact mul_nonneg hCψ (by positivity)
    have hA1 : 0 < A + 1 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hCa (ε / (A + 1) * (15 / 2)) (mul_pos (div_pos hε hA1) (by norm_num))
    refine ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
    have hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u n - u m) ∧ HasCompactSupport (u n - u m) :=
      ⟨(hPu n).1.sub (hPu m).1, (hPu n).2.sub (hPu m).2⟩
    have h1 := hCψb (u n) (u m) (hPu n).1 (hPu n).2 (hPu m).1 (hPu m).2
    have h2 := (hcoer h hequiv (u n - u m) hw.1 hw.2).2.2
    have h3 := hcoer' (u n - u m) hw
    have h4 := hN m hm n hn
    have h5 := hD (u n - u m) hw
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt h1 ?_
    have h6 : Cψ * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner (u n - u m) (u n - u m)) ≤
        A * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner (u n - u m) (u n - u m)) := by
      rw [hAdef, mul_assoc]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hCψ
    have h7 : atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner (u n - u m) (u n - u m)) < ε / (A + 1) := by
      linarith
    have h8 := (lt_div_iff₀ hA1).1 h7
    have h9 : A * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner (u n - u m) (u n - u m)) ≤
        (A + 1) * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner (u n - u m) (u n - u m)) := by
      rw [add_mul, one_mul]; linarith
    linarith [mul_comm (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner (u n - u m) (u n - u m))) (A + 1)]
  
  · intro ψ ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨φM, hφM, hφMc, hφeq⟩ :=
      cls_weak_form_chart g hAF ρA κ χ hA h V f hV hf ψ ζ hζ hζc hζs
    exact Tendsto.congr (fun n => hφeq (u n) (hPu n).1 (hPu n).2) (hEL φM ⟨hφM, hφMc⟩)
  
  · intro B hB n
    have hpd0 : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : E3), partialDeriv i (fun _ : E3 => (0 : ℝ)) y = 0 := by
      intro i y; simp [partialDeriv]
    have h1 := hCK (u n) 0 (hPu n).1 (hPu n).2 contMDiff_const HasCompactSupport.zero
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, sub_zero, hpd0] at h1
    have h2 := hDg B hB n
    have hX : 0 ≤ κ0 * B ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hκ0 (sq_nonneg B)
    have h3 : CK * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner (u n) (u n)) ≤ CK * (κ0 * B ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hCK0
    have h4 : (CK + CHs) * κ0 * B ^ 2 = CK * (κ0 * B ^ 2) + CHs * (κ0 * B ^ 2) := by ring
    have h5 : 0 ≤ CHs * (κ0 * B ^ 2) := mul_nonneg hCHs0 hX
    linarith
  
  · intro B hB j n R
    have h1 := hHb j (u n) (hPu n).1 (hPu n).2 R
    have h2 := hDg B hB n
    have hX : 0 ≤ κ0 * B ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hκ0 (sq_nonneg B)
    have h3 : CH j * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner (u n) (u n)) ≤ CH j * (κ0 * B ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (hCH j)
    have h4 : CH j * (κ0 * B ^ 2) ≤ CHs * (κ0 * B ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCHle j) hX
    have h5 : (CK + CHs) * κ0 * B ^ 2 = CK * (κ0 * B ^ 2) + CHs * (κ0 * B ^ 2) := by ring
    have h6 : 0 ≤ CK * (κ0 * B ^ 2) := mul_nonneg hCK0 hX
    linarith

cls_approx_solutions.definitions:
def atlasInt (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (F : M → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, ∫ y in (κ i).source, χ i (κ i y) * F (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det


def IsCLSAtlas (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ ρA ∧ (∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (χ i)) ∧ (∀ i p, 0 ≤ χ i p) ∧
  (∀ p, ∑ i, χ i p = 1) ∧ (∀ i, tsupport (χ i) ⊆ (κ i).target) ∧
  (∀ i, IsCompact (tsupport (χ i)) ∨ ∃ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, κ i = (hAF.ends j).Φ ∧
      (∀ y : E3, ρA + 1 ≤ ‖y‖ → χ i ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 1) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → ‖y‖ ≤ ρA → χ i ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 0))


def clsQ (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (V : M → ℝ) (u w : M → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  8 * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u w) + atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => V p * u p * w p)


def clsL (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (f : M → ℝ) (w : M → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => f p * w p)

and_nodes.definitions_block:
def atlasInt (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ) (F : M → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, ∫ y in (κ i).source, χ i (κ i y) * F (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det


def IsCLSAtlas (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ ρA ∧ (∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (χ i)) ∧ (∀ i p, 0 ≤ χ i p) ∧
  (∀ p, ∑ i, χ i p = 1) ∧ (∀ i, tsupport (χ i) ⊆ (κ i).target) ∧
  (∀ i, IsCompact (tsupport (χ i)) ∨ ∃ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, κ i = (hAF.ends j).Φ ∧
      (∀ y : E3, ρA + 1 ≤ ‖y‖ → χ i ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 1) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → ‖y‖ ≤ ρA → χ i ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 0))


def clsQ (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (V : M → ℝ) (u w : M → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  8 * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u w) + atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => V p * u p * w p)


def clsL (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (f : M → ℝ) (w : M → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => f p * w p)

    exact cwl_chart_compat u (ψc (ψ y)) ψ _ U Metric.isOpen_ball hUo (hBs (ψ y)) hUs (w (ψ y)) wU
      (hw_sm (ψ y)).continuousOn hwc (hw_m0 (ψ y)) hm (hw_t0 (ψ y)) ht _ (hcen (ψ y)) y hy heq
  have hstar : ∀ p : M, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) (r p / 4),
      v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = w p y := fun p y hy =>
    hrep (ψc p) _ (w p) Metric.isOpen_ball (hBs p) (hw_sm p).continuousOn (hw_m0 p) (hw_t0 p) y hy

    apply contMDiff_of_locally_contMDiffOn
    intro p
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) (r p / 4),
      (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 p).open_source

    refine hon.congr ?_

    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hz.1] at h2

  have hloc : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3),

    have hBs' : Metric.ball y (ε / 2 / 4) ⊆ ψ.source := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hsub

      show fderiv ℝ _ x (e i) = fderiv ℝ _ x (e i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    refine ⟨ε / 2 / 4, by positivity, hsub, ?_⟩
    show Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball y (ε / 2 / 4), ((u n (ψ x) - v (ψ x)) ^ 2 +
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) x
        - partialDeriv i (fun z => v (ψ z)) x) ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 0)
    have hint : ∀ n, (∫ x in Metric.ball y (ε / 2 / 4), ((u n (ψ x) - v (ψ x)) ^ 2 +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) x
          - partialDeriv i (fun z => v (ψ z)) x) ^ 2)) =
        (∫ x in Metric.ball y (ε / 2 / 4), (u n (ψ x) - w' x) ^ 2) +
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∫ x in Metric.ball y (ε / 2 / 4),
            (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) x - partialDeriv i w' x) ^ 2 := by
      intro n
      have e1 : (∫ x in Metric.ball y (ε / 2 / 4), ((u n (ψ x) - v (ψ x)) ^ 2 +
          ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) x
            - partialDeriv i (fun z => v (ψ z)) x) ^ 2)) =

        refine setIntegral_congr_fun Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet fun x hx => ?_

      h1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen φ.open_source (by exact_mod_cast le_top)⟩
  
  have hop : ∀ L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ‖L‖ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |L (e i)| := by
    intro L

      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => abs_nonneg _) fun x => ?_
    have hx := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr x

    have hLx : L x = ∑ i : Fin 3, x.ofLp i * L (e i) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hx]

    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hLx, Finset.sum_mul]

      (∀ n, ∫ y in K, ((W n y) ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (W n) y) ^ 2) ≤ a) →

        (partialDeriv i (W n) y - partialDeriv i w y) ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      ∫ y in K, (|w y| + ‖fderiv ℝ w y‖) ≤

          integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul] at h1
        linarith [hE n]
      have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => 2 * a + 2 * ∫ y in K, ((W n y - w y) ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin 3,
            (partialDeriv i (W n) y - partialDeriv i w y) ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 (2 * a + 2 * 0)) :=
        (hconv.const_mul 2).const_add (2 * a)
      have := ge_of_tendsto' hlim hstep
      linarith
    
    have hH : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∫ y in K, (|w y| + ‖fderiv ℝ w y‖) ≤
        (volume : Measure E3).real K * t + 2 * a / t := by
      intro t ht
      have h1 : ∫ y in K, (|w y| + ‖fderiv ℝ w y‖) ≤
          ∫ y in K, (t + ((w y) ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i w y) ^ 2) / t) := by
        refine setIntegral_mono_on (hint _ (hwc.abs.add hwd.norm))
          (hint _ (continuousOn_const.add (hEwc.div_const t))) hKm ?_
        intro y _
        have hb' : ‖fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i w y| := hop (fderiv ℝ w y)
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hb' ⊢
        rw [add_div' _ _ _ ht.ne', le_div_iff₀ ht]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb' ht.le,
          sq_nonneg (2 * |w y| - t), sq_nonneg (2 * |partialDeriv 0 w y| - t),
          sq_nonneg (2 * |partialDeriv 1 w y| - t), sq_nonneg (2 * |partialDeriv 2 w y| - t),
          sq_abs (w y), sq_abs (partialDeriv 0 w y), sq_abs (partialDeriv 1 w y),
          sq_abs (partialDeriv 2 w y)]
      rw [integral_add (hint _ continuousOn_const) (hint _ (hEwc.div_const t)),
        setIntegral_const, integral_div, smul_eq_mul] at h1
      have h2 : (∫ y in K, ((w y) ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i w y) ^ 2)) / t ≤
          2 * a / t := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right ht).2 hEw
      linarith
    
    refine le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε => ?_
    have hm : 0 ≤ (volume : Measure E3).real K := measureReal_nonneg
    have hs : 0 < ε / ((volume : Measure E3).real K + 1) := div_pos hε (by linarith)
    have hs1 : ε / ((volume : Measure E3).real K + 1) * ((volume : Measure E3).real K + 1)
        = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε (by linarith)
    have hsa : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt a := Real.sqrt_nonneg a
    have hsq : Real.sqrt a * Real.sqrt a = a := Real.mul_self_sqrt ha
    have ht : 0 < Real.sqrt a + ε / ((volume : Measure E3).real K + 1) := by linarith
    have h3 := hH _ ht
    have h4 : 2 * a / (Real.sqrt a + ε / ((volume : Measure E3).real K + 1)) ≤
        2 * Real.sqrt a := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ ht]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hsa hs.le]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hm hsa, mul_nonneg hm hs.le]
  have hv' := hreg v hv
  have hu' := fun n => hreg (u n) (hu n)
  exact main (fun z => v (φ z)) (fun n z => u n (φ z)) hv'.1 hv'.2
    (fun n => (hu' n).1) (fun n => (hu' n).2) hE hconv

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (j : Fin hAF.numEnds)
