proof.tactics:
by
  intro ε hε
  set Φ := (hAF.ends j).Φ with hΦ
  have hsrc : Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := (hAF.ends j).source_eq
  set G := g.coeff Φ with hG
  have hq0 : 0 < hAF.q := by linarith [hAF.q_gt]
  have hU1 : IsOpen {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  
  have hwsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => v (Φ y)) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
    rw [← hsrc]; exact (nds_chart_cont g Φ v v hv hv).1
  have hwc : ContinuousOn (fun y => v (Φ y)) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := hwsm.continuousOn
  have hS1 : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (fun y => u n (Φ y)) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
    intro n; rw [← hsrc]; exact (nds_chart_cont g Φ (u n) v (hu n) hv).1.continuousOn
  have hDc : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (Φ z)) y
      - partialDeriv i (fun z => v (Φ z)) y) ^ 2) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
    intro n; rw [← hsrc]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
      (((nds_chart_cont g Φ (u n) v (hu n) hv).2.1 i).sub
        ((nds_chart_cont g Φ v v hv hv).2.1 i)).pow 2
  have hsm : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x a b) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
    intro a b; rw [← hsrc]; exact coeff_contDiffOn_source g Φ a b
  
  obtain ⟨hI, hW2⟩ := cld_hardy_transfer ρ hρ I (fun n y => u n (Φ y)) (fun y => v (Φ y))
    (fun n y => ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (Φ z)) y
      - partialDeriv i (fun z => v (Φ z)) y) ^ 2)
    hS1 hwc hDc (fun n y => Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _) hH
    (fun L hL hLs => hconv L hL (by rw [hsrc]; exact hLs))
  
  obtain ⟨ε₁, C₂, hε₁, hC₂, hSG⟩ := cld_scaled_gradient
  obtain ⟨C₃, hC₃, hSF⟩ := cld_sup_from_gradient C₂ hC₂
  obtain ⟨R₂, hR₂1, hR₂⟩ := cld_rescaled_coeffs G hAF.q hq0 hsm (hAF.decay j) ε₁ hε₁
  
  refine ⟨max (max R₂ 2) (max (max (4 * R₀ / 3) (4 * ρ / 3)) (200 * C₃ * I / ε ^ 2)), ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  simp only [max_lt_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨⟨hxR₂, hx2⟩, ⟨hxR₀, hxρ⟩, hxC⟩ := hx
  have hco := hR₂ x hxR₂
  have hxpos : 0 < ‖x‖ := by linarith
  set s : ℝ := ‖x‖ / 4 with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by rw [hs]; positivity
  have hnorm : ∀ z : E3, ‖x‖ - s * ‖z‖ ≤ ‖x + s • z‖ := by
    intro z
    have h1 := norm_sub_norm_le x (-(s • z))
    rw [norm_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs0.le] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have haff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => x + s • z) :=
    contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.const_smul s)
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun z : E3 => x + s • z) (Metric.ball 0 2) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
    intro z hz
    have hz' : ‖z‖ < 2 := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz
    have h1 := hnorm z
    have h2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz' hs0
    show 1 < ‖x + s • z‖
    linarith
  have hWsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => v (Φ (x + s • z))) (Metric.ball 0 2) :=
    hwsm.comp haff.contDiffOn hmaps
  have heqn : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (x + s • z))⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun y' => v (Φ (x + s • y'))) y) z
        - ∑ k : Fin 3, (s * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            (G (x + s • z))⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j (x + s • z)) *
            partialDeriv k (fun y => v (Φ (x + s • y))) z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have hz1 : ‖z‖ < 1 := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz
    have hp : ‖x‖ - s * ‖z‖ ≤ ‖x + s • z‖ := hnorm z
    have hsz : s * ‖z‖ < s * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz1 hs0
    have hpU : x + s • z ∈ {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by show 1 < ‖x + s • z‖; linarith
    have hpR : R₀ < ‖x + s • z‖ := by linarith
    have h := cld_rescaled_equation G (fun y => v (Φ y)) _ hU1 hwsm x s z hpU
    rw [hlap _ hpR, mul_zero] at h
    exact h
  
  have hball : (v (Φ (x + s • (0 : E3)))) ^ 2 ≤
      C₃ * ∫ y in Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, (v (Φ (x + s • y))) ^ 2 :=
    hSF (fun z => v (Φ (x + s • z))) hWsm
      (hSG (fun z => v (Φ (x + s • z))) (fun z => (G (x + s • z))⁻¹)
        (fun z k => s * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (G (x + s • z))⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j (x + s • z)) hWsm hco heqn)
  rw [smul_zero, add_zero] at hball
  
  have hcv : ∫ y in Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, (v (Φ (x + s • y))) ^ 2
      = (s ^ 3)⁻¹ * ∫ y in Metric.ball x s, (v (Φ y)) ^ 2 :=
    cld_ball_rescale_integral (fun y => v (Φ y) ^ 2) x s hs0
  
  have hcb : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x s, 3 * ‖x‖ / 4 ≤ ‖y‖ := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hy
    have h1 := norm_sub_norm_le x y
    rw [norm_sub_rev] at h1
    linarith
  have hcbU : Metric.closedBall x s ⊆ {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := fun y hy => by
    have := hcb y hy; show 1 < ‖y‖; linarith
  have hf2c : ContinuousOn (fun y => v (Φ y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} :=
    (hwc.pow 2).div (continuous_norm.pow 2).continuousOn
      (fun y hy => pow_ne_zero 2 (lt_trans one_pos hy).ne')
  have hi1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => v (Φ y) ^ 2) (Metric.ball x s) :=
    (ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall x s)
      ((hwc.pow 2).mono hcbU)).mono_set Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have hi2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => v (Φ y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) (Metric.ball x s) :=
    (ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall x s)
      (hf2c.mono hcbU)).mono_set Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have hpt : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x s,
      v (Φ y) ^ 2 ≤ 25 / 16 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 * (v (Φ y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro y hy
    have hyl3 := hcb y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy
    have h1 := norm_sub_norm_le y x
    have hy0 : 0 < ‖y‖ := by linarith
    have hy0' : ‖y‖ ≠ 0 := hy0.ne'
    have hyl : ‖y‖ < 5 * ‖x‖ / 4 := by linarith
    have hq : 0 ≤ v (Φ y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hm := mul_self_lt_mul_self hy0.le hyl
    have hsq : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 25 / 16 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    calc v (Φ y) ^ 2 = ‖y‖ ^ 2 * (v (Φ y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by field_simp
      _ ≤ 25 / 16 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 * (v (Φ y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq hq
  have hstep1 : ∫ y in Metric.ball x s, v (Φ y) ^ 2 ≤
      ∫ y in Metric.ball x s, 25 / 16 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 * (v (Φ y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) :=
    setIntegral_mono_on hi1 (Integrable.const_mul hi2 _) measurableSet_ball hpt
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hstep1
  have hLc : IsCompact ({y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 (2 * ‖x‖)) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall 0 _).inter_left (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm)
  have hLsub : {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 (2 * ‖x‖) ⊆ {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} :=
    fun y hy => lt_of_lt_of_le hρ hy.1
  have hAsub : {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 2 * ‖x‖} ⊆
      {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 (2 * ‖x‖) :=
    fun y hy => ⟨hy.1.le, mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr hy.2.le⟩
  have hiA : IntegrableOn (fun y => v (Φ y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2)
      {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 2 * ‖x‖} :=
    (ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact hLc (hf2c.mono hLsub)).mono_set hAsub
  have hballA : Metric.ball x s ⊆ {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 2 * ‖x‖} := by
    intro y hy
    have hyl3 := hcb y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy
    have h1 := norm_sub_norm_le y x
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hstep3 : ∫ y in Metric.ball x s, v (Φ y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 2 * ‖x‖}, v (Φ y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 :=
    setIntegral_mono_set hiA
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
      hballA.eventuallyLE
  have hW2' : ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 2 * ‖x‖}, v (Φ y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * I :=
    hW2 (2 * ‖x‖)
  have hJ : ∫ y in Metric.ball x s, v (Φ y) ^ 2 ≤ 25 / 16 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 * (2 * I) :=
    hstep1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hstep3.trans hW2') (by positivity))
  
  have hs3 : 0 ≤ (s ^ 3)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have hw2 : v (Φ x) ^ 2 ≤ 200 * C₃ * I / ‖x‖ := by
    calc v (Φ x) ^ 2 ≤ C₃ * ((s ^ 3)⁻¹ * ∫ y in Metric.ball x s, v (Φ y) ^ 2) := by
          rw [← hcv]; exact hball
      _ ≤ C₃ * ((s ^ 3)⁻¹ * (25 / 16 * ‖x‖ ^ 2 * (2 * I))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hJ hs3) hC₃
      _ = 200 * C₃ * I / ‖x‖ := by
          rw [hs]; field_simp; ring
  have hε2 : 0 < ε ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hC : 200 * C₃ * I < ‖x‖ * ε ^ 2 := (div_lt_iff₀ hε2).mp hxC
  have hfin : v (Φ x) ^ 2 ≤ ε ^ 2 := by
    refine hw2.trans ?_
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hxpos]; linarith
  exact abs_le.mpr (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hfin hε.le)

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_contDiffOn_source
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_chart_cont
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv a (fun x => u (κ x))) κ.source) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u w (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.coeff κ x).det) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ a b) κ.source)

subgoal_signatures.name: cld_hardy_transfer
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 1 < ρ) (I : ℝ) (U : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ)
    (D : ℕ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hU : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (U n) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})
    (hw : ContinuousOn w {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})
    (hD : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (D n) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖}) (hD0 : ∀ n y, 0 ≤ D n y)
    (hH : ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ), ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R}, (U n y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ I)
    (hconv : ∀ L : Set E3, IsCompact L → L ⊆ {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y in L, ((U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    0 ≤ I ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R}, (w y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * I

subgoal_signatures.name: cld_scaled_gradient
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ ε₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 < ε₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₂ ∧
    ∀ (W : E3 → ℝ) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W (Metric.ball 0 2) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ z' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
        (∀ i j : Fin 3, |a z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε₁ ∧
           |a z i j - a z' i j| ≤ ε₁ * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
        (∀ k : Fin 3, |b z k| ≤ ε₁ ∧ |b z k - b z' k| ≤ ε₁ * ‖z - z'‖)) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a z i j * partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j W y) z
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, b z k * partialDeriv k W z = 0) →
      ∀ (x : E3) (d K : ℝ), 0 < d → ‖x‖ + d ≤ 1 → (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x d, |W y| ≤ K) →
        ∀ i : Fin 3, d * |partialDeriv i W x| ≤ C₂ * K

subgoal_signatures.name: cld_sup_from_gradient
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(C₂ : ℝ) (hC₂ : 0 ≤ C₂) : ∃ C₃ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₃ ∧
    ∀ W : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W (Metric.ball 0 2) →
      (∀ (x : E3) (d K : ℝ), 0 < d → ‖x‖ + d ≤ 1 → (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x d, |W y| ≤ K) →
        ∀ i : Fin 3, d * |partialDeriv i W x| ≤ C₂ * K) →
      W 0 ^ 2 ≤ C₃ * ∫ y in Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, W y ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: cld_rescaled_coeffs

by
  obtain ⟨ρA, n, κ, χ, hA⟩ := cls_atlas_exists g hAF
  obtain ⟨CS, hCS, hP⟩ := cls_poincare_compact g hAF k ρA κ χ hA S hS
  obtain ⟨ε₀, cS, hε₀, hcS, hcoerAll⟩ := cls_coercive g hAF ρA κ χ hA S hS CS hCS hP
  refine ⟨ε₀, hε₀, ?_⟩
  intro h _hhS hgh V v hV hv hVS hVb heq hdec
  
  obtain ⟨w, hwdef⟩ : ∃ w : M → ℝ, w = fun q => 1 + v q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w := by
    rw [hwdef]; exact contMDiff_const.add hv
  have hwp : ∀ q, w q = 1 + v q := fun q => by rw [hwdef]
  have hpd : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (j : Fin 3),
      partialDeriv j (fun y => 1 + f y) = partialDeriv j f := by
    intro f j; funext y; simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_const_add]
  have heqw : ∀ p, -8 * h.lapM w p + V p * w p = 0 := by
    intro p
    have hl : h.lapM w p = h.lapM v p := by
      rw [hwdef]; simp only [RiemannianMetric3.lapM, lapLoc, hessLoc, hpd]
    rw [hl, hwp p]
    have := heq p
    linarith
  
  have hR : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ →
      |v ((hAF.ends j).Φ x)| ≤ 1 / 2 := fun j => hdec j (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  choose R hR using hR
  obtain ⟨A, hAdef⟩ : ∃ A : Fin hAF.numEnds → Set E3,
      A = fun j => Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (max (R j) 2) ∩ {x : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖x‖} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAc : ∀ j, IsCompact (A j) := by
    intro j; rw [hAdef]
    exact (isCompact_closedBall _ _).inter_right (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm)
  have hAs : ∀ j, A j ⊆ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
    intro j x hx
    rw [hAdef] at hx
    rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq]
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖x‖
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := hx.2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : Set M,
      K = (⋃ j, (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ ∪ ⋃ j, (hAF.ends j).Φ '' A j :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK : IsCompact K := by
    rw [hKdef]
    refine hAF.isCompact_core.union (isCompact_iUnion fun j => ?_)
    exact (hAc j).image_of_continuousOn
      ((hAF.ends j).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono (hAs j))
  have hKv : ∀ p, p ∉ K → |v p| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hKdef, Set.mem_union, not_or, Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not] at hp
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 h1
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hj
    have hxA : x ∉ A j := by
      intro hxA
      exact h2 (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, x, hxA, rfl⟩)
    have hx2 : (2 : ℝ) < ‖x‖ := hx
    have hxR : R j < ‖x‖ := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      apply hxA
      rw [hAdef]
      refine ⟨?_, hx2.le⟩
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
      exact hcon.trans (le_max_left _ _)
    exact hR j x hxR
  have hKw : ∀ p, p ∉ K → 0 < w p := by
    intro p hp
    have h1 := hKv p hp
    rw [hwp p]
    have h2 := (abs_le.1 h1).1
    linarith
  
  have hnn : ∀ p, 0 ≤ w p :=
    clsp_weak_min g h hAF k ρA κ χ hA S ε₀ cS hε₀ hcS (hcoerAll h hgh) V w hV hw hVS hVb heqw
      K hK hKw
  
  have hZc : IsClosed {q : M | w q = 0} := isClosed_eq hw.continuous continuous_const
  have hZo : IsOpen {q : M | w q = 0} := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hN0⟩ := clsp_local_zero_open g hAF ρA κ χ hA h V w hV hw heqw hnn q hq
    exact Filter.mem_of_superset hN fun p hp => hN0 p hp
  obtain ⟨R0, hR0⟩ := hdec k (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  have hfar : w ((hAF.ends k).Φ ((max R0 1 + 1) • e 0)) ≠ 0 := by
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < max R0 1 + 1 := by
      have := le_max_right R0 1
      linarith
    have hnorm : ‖(max R0 1 + 1) • e 0‖ = max R0 1 + 1 := by
      rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos hpos]
    have hlt : R0 < ‖(max R0 1 + 1) • e 0‖ := by
      rw [hnorm]
      have := le_max_left R0 1
      linarith
    have h1 := hR0 _ hlt
    rw [hwp]
    have h2 := (abs_le.1 h1).1
    intro h0
    linarith
  intro p
  rcases (isClopen_iff.1 ⟨hZc, hZo⟩) with hempty | huniv
  · have hne : w p ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have : p ∈ {q : M | w q = 0} := h0
      rw [hempty] at this
      exact this
    have := lt_of_le_of_ne (hnn p) (Ne.symm hne)
    rw [hwp p] at this
    exact this
  · exfalso
    apply hfar
    have : (hAF.ends k).Φ ((max R0 1 + 1) • e 0) ∈ {q : M | w q = 0} := by
      rw [huniv]; exact Set.mem_univ _
    exact this

    have hexp1 : K₂ * (‖y‖ ^ (-q) *
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => P ‖z‖)) y|
        + ‖y‖ ^ (-q) / ‖y‖ * ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun z => P ‖z‖) y|)
        = K₂ * (‖y‖ ^ (-q) *
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => P ‖z‖)) y|)
        + K₂ * (‖y‖ ^ (-q) / ‖y‖ * ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun z => P ‖z‖) y|) := by ring
    have hexp2 : K₂ * (‖y‖ ^ (-q) * (9 * |deriv (deriv P) ‖y‖| + 18 * (|deriv P ‖y‖| / ‖y‖)))
        + K₂ * (‖y‖ ^ (-q) / ‖y‖ * (3 * |deriv P ‖y‖|))
        = 9 * (K₂ * ‖y‖ ^ (-q) * |deriv (deriv P) ‖y‖|)
          + 21 * (K₂ * ‖y‖ ^ (-q) * (|deriv P ‖y‖| / ‖y‖)) := by ring
    have hexp3 : 21 * K₂ * ‖y‖ ^ (-q) * (|deriv (deriv P) ‖y‖| + |deriv P ‖y‖| / ‖y‖)
        = 21 * (K₂ * ‖y‖ ^ (-q) * |deriv (deriv P) ‖y‖|)
          + 21 * (K₂ * ‖y‖ ^ (-q) * (|deriv P ‖y‖| / ‖y‖)) := by ring
    linarith
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hrad⟩ := hrad
  
  have hPs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2)) :=
    ContDiff.rpow_const_of_ne (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.pow 2)) (fun t => by positivity)
  have hSd : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => 1 + t ^ 2) (2 * t) t := by
    intro t
    have := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).const_add 1
    convert this using 1
    norm_num
  have hd1 : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2))
      (-p * t * (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2 - 1)) t := by
    intro t
    have h := (hSd t).rpow_const (p := -p / 2) (Or.inl (by positivity))
    convert h using 1
    ring
  have hD1 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2)) =
      fun t : ℝ => -p * t * (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2 - 1) := by
    funext t; exact (hd1 t).deriv
  have hd2 : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -p * t * (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2 - 1))
      (-p * (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2 - 1) +
        -p * t * (2 * t * (-p / 2 - 1) * (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2 - 1 - 1))) t := by
    intro t
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => -p * t) (-p * 1) t := (hasDerivAt_id' t).const_mul (-p)
    have h2 := (hSd t).rpow_const (p := -p / 2 - 1) (Or.inl (by positivity))
    have h3 := h1.mul h2
    convert h3 using 1
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = 5 * K / (1 - p) + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have h1p : 0 < 1 - p := by linarith
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by
    rw [hBdef]; have : 0 ≤ 5 * K / (1 - p) := div_nonneg (by linarith) h1p.le
    linarith
  have hBp : (1 - p) * B = 5 * K + (1 - p) := by
    rw [hBdef]; field_simp
  refine ⟨max R (B ^ q⁻¹), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hRy : R < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hy
  have hr0 : 0 < ‖y‖ := by linarith
  have hBy : B < ‖y‖ ^ q := by
    have h1 : B ^ q⁻¹ < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hy
    have h2 := Real.rpow_lt_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg hB0 _) h1 hq
    rwa [Real.rpow_inv_rpow hB0 hq.ne'] at h2
  have hrq : 0 < ‖y‖ ^ q := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hr0 q
  obtain ⟨ee, heedef⟩ : ∃ ee : ℝ, ee = K * ‖y‖ ^ (-q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have he0 : 0 ≤ ee := by rw [heedef]; exact mul_nonneg hK (Real.rpow_nonneg hr0.le _)
  have he5 : 5 * ee ≤ 1 - p := by
    have h5K : 5 * K < (1 - p) * ‖y‖ ^ q := by
      have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hBy h1p
      linarith
    rw [heedef, Real.rpow_neg hr0.le,
      show 5 * (K * (‖y‖ ^ q)⁻¹) = 5 * K / ‖y‖ ^ q by ring, div_le_iff₀ hrq]
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = 1 + ‖y‖ ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS0 : 0 < S := by rw [hSdef]; positivity
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ, σ = S ^ (-p / 2 - 1 - 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσ0 : 0 < σ := by rw [hσ]; exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hS0 _
  have hSa : S ^ (-p / 2 - 1) = σ * S := by
    rw [hσ, ← Real.rpow_add_one hS0.ne']
    congr 1; ring
  have v1 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2)) ‖y‖ = -p * ‖y‖ * (σ * S) := by
    rw [(hd1 ‖y‖).deriv, ← hSdef, hSa]
  have v2 : deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2))) ‖y‖ =
      -p * (σ * S) + -p * ‖y‖ * (2 * ‖y‖ * (-p / 2 - 1) * σ) := by
    rw [hD1, (hd2 ‖y‖).deriv, ← hSdef, hSa, ← hσ]
  have hmain : lapLoc G (fun z : E3 => (1 + ‖z‖ ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2)) y ≤
      (deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2))) ‖y‖ +
          2 * deriv (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2)) ‖y‖ / ‖y‖) +
        K * ‖y‖ ^ (-q) * (|deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2))) ‖y‖| +
          |deriv (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2)) ‖y‖| / ‖y‖) :=
    hrad (fun t : ℝ => (1 + t ^ 2) ^ (-p / 2)) hPs y hRy
  rw [v1, v2, ← heedef] at hmain
  have hc : 0 < p * σ := mul_pos hp0 hσ0
  have hA1r : -p * ‖y‖ * (σ * S) / ‖y‖ = -(p * σ * S) := by
    field_simp
  have hL : -p * (σ * S) + -p * ‖y‖ * (2 * ‖y‖ * (-p / 2 - 1) * σ) +
      2 * (-p * ‖y‖ * (σ * S)) / ‖y‖ = p * σ * ((p - 1) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 - 3) := by
    rw [mul_div_assoc, hA1r, hSdef]; ring
  have habs1 : |-p * ‖y‖ * (σ * S)| / ‖y‖ = p * σ * S := by
    rw [← abs_of_pos hr0, ← abs_div, abs_of_pos hr0, hA1r, abs_neg,
      abs_of_pos (mul_pos hc hS0)]
  have hA2 : -p * (σ * S) + -p * ‖y‖ * (2 * ‖y‖ * (-p / 2 - 1) * σ) =
      p * σ * ((p + 2) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 - S) := by ring
  have hr2S : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ S := by rw [hSdef]; linarith
  have habs2 : |-p * (σ * S) + -p * ‖y‖ * (2 * ‖y‖ * (-p / 2 - 1) * σ)| ≤
      p * σ * (S + 3 * ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [hA2, abs_le]
    have hr2 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    constructor
    · have : 0 ≤ p * σ * ((p + 5) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) :=
        mul_nonneg hc.le (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hr2)
      nlinarith
    · have : 0 ≤ p * σ * (2 * S + (1 - p) * ‖y‖ ^ 2) :=
        mul_nonneg hc.le (by nlinarith)
      nlinarith
  have hX : |-p * (σ * S) + -p * ‖y‖ * (2 * ‖y‖ * (-p / 2 - 1) * σ)| +
      |-p * ‖y‖ * (σ * S)| / ‖y‖ ≤ 5 * (p * σ * S) := by
    rw [habs1]
    have : p * σ * (3 * ‖y‖ ^ 2) ≤ p * σ * (3 * S) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hc.le
    nlinarith
  have hE : ee * (|-p * (σ * S) + -p * ‖y‖ * (2 * ‖y‖ * (-p / 2 - 1) * σ)| +
      |-p * ‖y‖ * (σ * S)| / ‖y‖) ≤ ee * (5 * (p * σ * S)) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX he0
  have h5 : ee * (5 * (p * σ * S)) ≤ (1 - p) * (p * σ * S) := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he5 (mul_pos hc hS0).le
    linarith
  have hfin : p * σ * ((p - 1) * ‖y‖ ^ 2 - 3) + (1 - p) * (p * σ * S) = -(p * σ * (2 + p)) := by
    rw [hSdef]; ring
  have hpos : 0 < p * σ * (2 + p) := mul_pos hc (by linarith)
  rw [hL] at hmain
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i) (R C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb0 : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) :
    ∃ R₂ : ℝ, R ≤ R₂ ∧ ∀ y : E3, R₂ < ‖y‖ → ((G y)⁻¹).PosDef

signature.name: cfd_inv_posDef_far
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i) (R C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb0 : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)) :
    ∃ R₂ : ℝ, R ≤ R₂ ∧ ∀ y : E3, R₂ < ‖y‖ → ((G y)⁻¹).PosDef

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨max R ((6 * C + 1) ^ (1 / q)), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hRy : R < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hy
  have hBy : (6 * C + 1) ^ (1 / q) < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hy
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ (6 * C + 1) ^ (1 / q) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
  have hBq : ((6 * C + 1) ^ (1 / q)) ^ q = 6 * C + 1 := by
    rw [one_div, Real.rpow_inv_rpow (by linarith) hq.ne']
  have hP : 6 * C + 1 < ‖y‖ ^ q := by
    rw [← hBq]; exact Real.rpow_lt_rpow hB0 hBy hq
  have hPpos : 0 < ‖y‖ ^ q := by linarith
  obtain ⟨ε, hεdef⟩ : ∃ ε : ℝ, ε = C * ‖y‖ ^ (-q) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hεeq : ε * ‖y‖ ^ q = C := by
    rw [hεdef, Real.rpow_neg (norm_nonneg y), mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hPpos.ne', mul_one]
  have hε0 : 0 ≤ ε := by
    rw [hεdef]; exact mul_nonneg hC (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg y) _)
  have hε6 : 6 * ε < 1 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hPpos.le]
  have hD : ∀ i j : Fin 3, -ε ≤ G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∧
      G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ ε := by
    intro i j
    have := hb0 y hRy i j
    rw [← hεdef] at this
    exact abs_le.mp this
  have pair : ∀ a b d : ℝ, -ε ≤ d → d ≤ ε → 0 ≤ a * d * b + ε / 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
    intro a b d h1 h2
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ε + d) (sq_nonneg (a + b)),
      mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ε - d) (sq_nonneg (a - b))]
  have hGpd : (G y).PosDef := by
    rw [Matrix.posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · ext i j
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, star_trivial]
      exact hsymm y j i
    · intro x hx
      have hp : ∀ i j : Fin 3, 0 ≤ x i * (G y i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) * x j
          + ε / 2 * (x i ^ 2 + x j ^ 2) := fun i j => pair _ _ _ (hD i j).1 (hD i j).2
      have hoff : ∀ i j : Fin 3, i ≠ j →
          0 ≤ x i * G y i j * x j + ε / 2 * (x i ^ 2 + x j ^ 2) := by
        intro i j hij
        have := hp i j
        rw [if_neg hij, sub_zero] at this
        exact this
      have hdiag : ∀ i : Fin 3,
          0 ≤ x i * (G y i i - 1) * x i + ε / 2 * (x i ^ 2 + x i ^ 2) := by
        intro i
        have := hp i i
        rw [if_pos rfl] at this
        exact this
      have h00 := hdiag 0
      have h01 := hoff 0 1 (by decide)
      have h02 := hoff 0 2 (by decide)
      have h10 := hoff 1 0 (by decide)
      have h11 := hdiag 1
      have h12 := hoff 1 2 (by decide)
      have h20 := hoff 2 0 (by decide)
      have h21 := hoff 2 1 (by decide)
      have h22 := hdiag 2
      have hS : 0 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
        by_contra hS
        push_neg at hS
        apply hx
        have e0 : x 0 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp
          (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1), sq_nonneg (x 2)])
        have e1 : x 1 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp
          (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1), sq_nonneg (x 2)])
        have e2 : x 2 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp
          (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1), sq_nonneg (x 2)])
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        · exact e0
        · exact e1
        · exact e2
      have hpos : 0 < (1 - 3 * ε) * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2) :=
        mul_pos (by linarith) hS
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial]
      linarith [h00, h01, h02, h10, h11, h12, h20, h21, h22, hpos]
  exact hGpd.inv

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (z : E3 → ℝ) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 z U) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hpd : ((G x)⁻¹).PosDef) (hmax : IsLocalMax z x) :
    lapLoc G z x ≤ 0

signature.name: cfd_max_lapLoc_nonpos
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (z : E3 → ℝ) (hz : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 z U) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hpd : ((G x)⁻¹).PosDef) (hmax : IsLocalMax z x) :
    lapLoc G z x ≤ 0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hgrad : fderiv ℝ z x = 0 := hmax.fderiv_eq_zero
  have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ z) U := hz.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by norm_num)
  have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ z) x :=
    (hfd.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ z y := fun y hy =>
    (hz.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt two_ne_zero
  
  have hdir : ∀ ξ : E3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ z) x ξ ξ ≤ 0 := by
    intro ξ
    have hℓ : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) ξ t := by
      intro t
      have := ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const ξ).const_add x
      simpa using this
    have hℓ0 : (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) 0 = x := by simp
    have hℓc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
    have hT : (fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) ⁻¹' U ∈ 𝓝 (0:ℝ) := by
      apply hℓc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]; exact hU.mem_nhds hx
    have hgk : deriv (fun t : ℝ => z (x + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0]
        (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ z (x + t • ξ) ξ) := by
      filter_upwards [hT] with t ht
      have h1 := (hdiff (x + t • ξ) ht).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hℓ t)
      exact h1.deriv
    have hk : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ z (x + t • ξ) ξ)
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ z) x ξ ξ) 0 := by
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ z y ξ)
          ((fderiv ℝ z x).comp (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ z) x).flip ξ) x :=
        hD.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const ξ x)
      have h1' : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ z y ξ)
          ((fderiv ℝ z x).comp (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ z) x).flip ξ)
          ((fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) 0) := by
        rw [hℓ0]; exact h1
      have h2 := h1'.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) (hℓ 0)
      simpa using h2
    have hdd : deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => z (x + t • ξ))) 0 = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ z) x ξ ξ := by
      rw [hgk.deriv_eq]; exact hk.deriv
    have hd0 : deriv (fun t : ℝ => z (x + t • ξ)) 0 = 0 := by
      rw [hgk.self_of_nhds]
      simp [hgrad]
    have hmaxg : IsLocalMax (fun t : ℝ => z (x + t • ξ)) 0 := by
      have : IsLocalMax z (x + (0:ℝ) • ξ) := by simpa using hmax
      exact IsLocalMax.comp_continuous (g := fun t : ℝ => x + t • ξ) (b := (0:ℝ)) this
        hℓc.continuousAt
    have hgc : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => z (x + t • ξ)) 0 := by
      have hx' : x + (0:ℝ) • ξ ∈ U := by simpa using hx
      exact ((hdiff _ hx').hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) (hℓ 0)).continuousAt
    by_contra hpos
    push_neg at hpos
    have hming : IsLocalMin (fun t : ℝ => z (x + t • ξ)) 0 :=
      isLocalMin_of_deriv_deriv_pos (by rw [hdd]; exact hpos) hd0 hgc
    have hconst : (fun t : ℝ => z (x + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] fun _ => z (x + (0:ℝ) • ξ) :=
      (Filter.Eventually.and hmaxg hming).mono (fun t ht => le_antisymm ht.1 ht.2)
    have hdg : deriv (fun t : ℝ => z (x + t • ξ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hconst.eventuallyEq_nhds] with t ht
      rw [ht.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    have h0 : deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => z (x + t • ξ))) 0 = 0 := by
      rw [hdg.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    linarith
  
  have hentry : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b z) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ z) x (e a) (e b) := by
    intro a b
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ z y (e b))
        ((fderiv ℝ z x).comp (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) + (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ z) x).flip (e b)) x :=
      hD.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e b) x)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ z y (e b)) x (e a) = _
    rw [h1.fderiv]
    simp
  have hpz : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k z x = 0 := by
    intro k
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hgrad]
    rfl
  have hlap : lapLoc G z x = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G x)⁻¹ i j * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ z) x (e i) (e j) := by
    unfold lapLoc hessLoc
    simp only [hpz, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, sub_zero, hentry]
  rw [hlap]
  
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := Matrix.posSemidef_iff_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self.mp hpd.posSemidef
  have hP : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G x)⁻¹ i j = ∑ k : Fin 3, B k i * B k j := by
    intro i j
    rw [hB, Matrix.mul_apply]
    simp [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  have hq : ∀ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ z) x (B k 0 • e 0 + B k 1 • e 1 + B k 2 • e 2)
      (B k 0 • e 0 + B k 1 • e 1 + B k 2 • e 2) ≤ 0 := fun k => hdir _
  have h0 := hq 0
  have h1 := hq 1
  have h2 := hq 2
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul] at h0 h1 h2
  simp only [hP, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (f₁ f₂ : E3 → ℝ) (h₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₁ U) (h₂ : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₂ U)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U) (s a c : ℝ) :
    lapLoc G (fun y => s * f₁ y - a * f₂ y - c) x = s * lapLoc G f₁ x - a * lapLoc G f₂ x

signature.name: cfd_lapLoc_affine
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (f₁ f₂ : E3 → ℝ) (h₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₁ U) (h₂ : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f₂ U)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U) (s a c : ℝ) :
    lapLoc G (fun y => s * f₁ y - a * f₂ y - c) x = s * lapLoc G f₁ x - a * lapLoc G f₂ x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hd : ∀ z ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ f₁ z ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ f₂ z := fun z hz =>
    ⟨(h₁.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hz),
     (h₂.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)⟩
  have h1 : ∀ z ∈ U, ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun y => s * f₁ y - a * f₂ y - c) z
      = s * partialDeriv j f₁ z - a * partialDeriv j f₂ z := by
    intro z hz j
    have hF : HasFDerivAt (fun y => s * f₁ y - a * f₂ y - c)
        (s • fderiv ℝ f₁ z - a • fderiv ℝ f₂ z) z :=
      (((hd z hz).1.hasFDerivAt.const_mul s).sub
        ((hd z hz).2.hasFDerivAt.const_mul a)).sub_const c
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hF.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hD₁ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f₁) U := h₁.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by norm_num)
  have hD₂ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f₂) U := h₂.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by norm_num)
  have hDx₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f₁) x :=
    (hD₁.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
  have hDx₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f₂) x :=
    (hD₂.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
  have h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun y => s * f₁ y - a * f₂ y - c)) x
        = s * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₁) x - a * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f₂) x := by
    intro i j
    have hev : partialDeriv j (fun y => s * f₁ y - a * f₂ y - c) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun z => s * partialDeriv j f₁ z - a * partialDeriv j f₂ z :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) (fun z hz => h1 z hz j)
    have hg₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv j f₁) x :=
      hDx₁.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e j))
    have hg₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv j f₂) x :=
      hDx₂.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e j))
    have hG : HasFDerivAt (fun z => s * partialDeriv j f₁ z - a * partialDeriv j f₂ z)
        (s • fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f₁) x - a • fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f₂) x) x :=
      (hg₁.hasFDerivAt.const_mul s).sub (hg₂.hasFDerivAt.const_mul a)
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j (fun y => s * f₁ y - a * f₂ y - c)) x (e i)
      = s * fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f₁) x (e i) - a * fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f₂) x (e i)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hG.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  unfold lapLoc hessLoc
  simp only [h2, h1 x hx, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ κ.source) :
    g.gradInner u w (κ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => u (κ z)) x *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => w (κ z)) x

signature.name: gradInner_pdiffeo_formula
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ κ.source) :
    g.gradInner u w (κ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => u (κ z)) x *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => w (κ z)) x

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hbasis : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ d : Fin 3, v d • e d := by
    intro v
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr v]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hcomp_e : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) a = v a := by
    intro v a
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  have hcompo : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z → ∀ l d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z = (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) d := by
    intro ψ z hψ l d
    have hfun : (fun v => ψ v d) = (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ ψ := by
      funext v; simp
    rw [partialDeriv, hfun, fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj d).differentiableAt hψ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp
  have pd_comp : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ψ z) → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w' => F (ψ w')) z
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d F (ψ z) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z := by
    intro F ψ z hψ hF l
    have h1 : partialDeriv l (fun w' => F (ψ w')) z = fderiv ℝ F (ψ z) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (F ∘ ψ) z (e l) = _
      rw [fderiv_comp z hF hψ]
      rfl
    rw [h1, hbasis (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)), map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcompo ψ z hψ]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d _
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  
  have grad_alg : ∀ (A Gm Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P Pt Q Qt : Fin 3 → ℝ), A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * Gm a b * A b j) →
      (∀ i, Pt i = ∑ a : Fin 3, P a * A a i) →
      (∀ i, Qt i = ∑ a : Fin 3, Q a * A a i) →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ i j * Pt i * Qt j =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * P i * Q j := by
    intro A Gm Gt P Pt Q Qt hA hGt hPt hQt
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * Gm * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hM : A * Gt⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A = Gm⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv]
      calc A * (A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹) * Matrix.transpose A
          = (A * A⁻¹) * Gm⁻¹ * (Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A) := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = Gm⁻¹ := by
            rw [hAB, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, hAB, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul,
              Matrix.mul_one]
    have hM' : ∀ a b, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A a i * Gt⁻¹ i j * A b j = Gm⁻¹ a b := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hM]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [hPt, hQt, ← hM']
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have h2 : IsOpen (κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (κ x)).source) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w'))
        (κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (κ x)).source) := by
    have hΦ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ κ κ.source := κ.contMDiffOn_toFun
    refine ⟨hΦ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage κ.open_source
      (chartAt E3 (κ x)).open_source, ?_⟩
    have hc : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 (κ x))
        (chartAt E3 (κ x)).source := contMDiffOn_chart
    have hcomp := hc.comp (hΦ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun w' hw' => hw'.2)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcomp
  have hxU : x ∈ κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (κ x)).source := ⟨hx, mem_chart_source E3 (κ x)⟩
  have hψd : ∀ z ∈ κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (κ x)).source,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w')) z := fun z hz =>
    (h2.2.contDiffAt (h2.1.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hM1 : ∀ z ∈ κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (κ x)).source,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ z =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ z))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w')) z) := by
    intro z hz
    have hev : (κ : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm ∘ (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w'))) := by
      filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hz] with w' hw'
      exact ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).left_inv hw'.2).symm
    rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp z
      (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 (κ x))
        ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).map_source hz.2)) (hψd z hz).mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
  have hM1' : ∀ z ∈ κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (κ x)).source, ∀ v : E3,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ z v =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ z))
          (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w')) z v) := by
    intro z hz v
    rw [hM1 z hz]
    rfl
  
  have s1 : ∀ z ∈ κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (κ x)).source, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      g.coeff κ z i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w') a) z *
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ z)) a b *
            partialDeriv j (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w') b) z := by
    intro z hz i j
    have hq : (chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ z)) = κ z :=
      (chartAt E3 (κ x)).left_inv hz.2
    have hgq : g.g ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ z))) = g.g (κ z) :=
      congrArg g.g hq
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        D = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ z)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΦD : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ z v =
        D (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w')) z v) := by
      intro v
      rw [hM1' z hz v, hD]
      rfl
    have hcD : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ z)) a b
        = g.g (κ z) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hgq, hD]
      rfl
    have hJ : ∀ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w')) z (e k)
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w') d) z • e d := by
      intro k
      rw [hbasis (fderiv ℝ (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w')) z (e k))]
      simp only [hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)]
    simp only [hcD]
    show g.g (κ z) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ z (e i))
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ z (e j)) = _
    rw [hΦD, hΦD, hJ i, hJ j]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have s3 : ∀ z ∈ κ.source ∩ κ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (κ x)).source,
      (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w') a) z).det
        ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz hdet
    obtain ⟨v, hv0, hJv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
    have hloc := PartialDiffeomorph.isLocalDiffeomorphAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ κ hz.1
    have hinj : ∀ y : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ z y = 0 → y = 0 := by
      intro y hy0
      rw [← hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv_coe (by simp)] at hy0
      exact (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv (by simp)).map_eq_zero_iff.mp hy0
    have hw0 : fderiv ℝ (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w')) z (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
      ext a
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul]
      have := congrFun hJv a
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
        hcompo _ z (hψd z hz)] at this
      simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        WithLp.ofLp_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [← this]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    have h0 : (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
      apply hinj
      rw [hM1' z hz, hw0]
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero _
    apply hv0
    funext a
    rw [← hcomp_e v a, h0]
    rfl
  
  have hmapsW : chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ x) ∈ (chartAt E3 (κ x)).target :=
    (chartAt E3 (κ x)).map_source hxU.2
  have chain : ∀ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun z => f (κ z)) x = ∑ a : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ x)) *
          (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 =>
            partialDeriv i (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w') a) x) a i := by
    intro f hf i
    have huW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 (κ x)).target := by
      have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ (chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm)
          (chartAt E3 (κ x)).target :=
        hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
    have hud : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ x)) :=
      (huW.contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).open_target.mem_nhds hmapsW)).differentiableAt
        (by simp)
    have hequ : (fun z => f (κ z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun w' => f ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w')))) := by
      filter_upwards [h2.1.mem_nhds hxU] with z hz2
      show f (κ z) = f ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ z)))
      rw [(chartAt E3 (κ x)).left_inv hz2.2]
    have e1 : partialDeriv i (fun z => f (κ z)) x = partialDeriv i
        (fun w' => f ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w')))) x := by
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => f (κ z)) x (e i) = fderiv ℝ _ x (e i)
      rw [hequ.fderiv_eq]
    rw [e1, pd_comp (fun y => f ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm y)) (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w'))
      x (hψd x hxU) hud i]
    rfl
  have hL : g.gradInner u w (κ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ x)))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ x)) *
        partialDeriv j (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ x)) := rfl
  rw [hL]
  exact (grad_alg (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w' => chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ w') a) x)
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ x))) (g.coeff κ x)
    (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ x)))
    (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun z => u (κ z)) x)
    (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 (κ x)).symm y)) (chartAt E3 (κ x) (κ x)))
    (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun z => w (κ z)) x)
    (s3 x hxU) (fun i j => s1 x hxU i j) (chain u hu) (chain w hw)).symm

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : Re + 1 < ρ) :
    IsCompact (connectedComponentIn ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
      ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0))) ∧
    IsCompact (({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) \
      connectedComponentIn ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
        ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0))) ∧
    (∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ = ρ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ connectedComponentIn
      ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0))) ∧
    (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} →
      p ∉ connectedComponentIn ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
        ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0)) → p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | Re < ‖y‖})

signature.name: nds_component_topology
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : Re + 1 < ρ) :
    IsCompact (connectedComponentIn ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
      ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0))) ∧
    IsCompact (({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) \
      connectedComponentIn ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
        ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0))) ∧
    (∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ = ρ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∈ connectedComponentIn
      ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ((hAF.ends k).Φ (ρ • e 0))) ∧

      (D : Prop), 0 < r ∧ κ.source = Metric.ball c r ∧ κ c = p ∧ (c 0 = 0 ∨ r ≤ c 0) ∧

        (κ x ∈ C ↔ 0 ≤ x 0) ∧ (κ x ∈ S ↔ (D ∧ x 0 = 0)) ∧
        (β (κ x) = 0 ↔ (¬ D ∧ x 0 = 0)) ∧ (¬ D → c 0 = 0 → β (κ x) = x 0) := by
    intro p hp

    have hAC : ∃ (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (c : E3) (r : ℝ) (D : Prop),

  have hcv : ∀ j, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l →

    intro j ε hε

    have h := ((hP _ (U m - U l).2).2 j).1
    rw [hB]
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) h

  have hdiffsub : ∀ j m l (a : Fin 3), ∀ x ∈ ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j),

    have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (U l : M → ℝ) (A.κ j z)) x :=

    rw [hsubU]
    show fderiv ℝ ((fun z => (U m : M → ℝ) (A.κ j z)) - (fun z => (U l : M → ℝ) (A.κ j z))) x

    rw [fderiv_sub hd1 hd2]

        (partialDeriv a (fun z => (U m : M → ℝ) (A.κ j z)) x -
          partialDeriv a (fun z => (U l : M → ℝ) (A.κ j z)) x) ^ 2 < ε := by
    intro j a ε hε

    have h := ((hP _ (U m - U l).2).2 j).2 a

    refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) h

    (fun m => ((hHb j).2.2 _ ((hcc j _ _ (hsm (U m)).1 (hsm (U m)).1).2.1 a)).1) (hcd j a)

  refine ⟨fun m => (U m : M → ℝ), v, Gr, ?_⟩
  unfold ndsWeakSol
  refine ⟨fun m => hsm (U m), fun j => ⟨hvL2 j, fun a => hGL2 j a, hvconv j,
    fun a => hGconv j a, ?_⟩⟩
  
  intro ζ hζ hcs hsupp hD
  have hr := A.r_pos j
  have hhalf : Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j) :=

  have hζ0 : ∀ x ∈ (A.κ j).source, x ∉ tsupport ζ → ζ x = 0 :=

  have hφV : φ ∈ ndsV0 S₀ := by

    refine ⟨hφs, ?_⟩
    by_cases hDj : A.D j
    · obtain ⟨O, hO, hface, hζO⟩ := hD hDj
      refine ⟨(A.κ j '' tsupport ζ)ᶜ ∪ A.κ j '' (O ∩ Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j)),

      · exact (A.κ j).toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source
          (hO.inter Metric.isOpen_ball)
          (fun x hx => (by rw [hball j]; exact hx.2 : x ∈ (A.κ j).source))
      · intro q hq

        · right

      · rintro q (hq | ⟨x, ⟨hxO, hxb⟩, rfl⟩)
        · exact hφ0 q hq
        · rw [hφκ x (by rw [hball j]; exact hxb)]

    · refine ⟨(A.κ j '' tsupport ζ)ᶜ, hKc.isOpen_compl, ?_, fun q hq => hφ0 q hq⟩
      rintro q hq ⟨x, hxQ, rfl⟩
      exact hDj ((A.dir j x (hsupp.trans hhalf hxQ)).1 hq).1
  have hzero : ∀ (q : M) (w : M → ℝ), g.gradInner (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) w q = 0 := by

    rw [hφκ x (by rw [hball j]; exact (hHb j).2.1 hx)]

  have hpz : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j), ∀ i : Fin 3,

    intro x hx i

  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, ∀ a b x,

        partialDeriv a ζ x := ⟨_, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hζd : ∀ a : Fin 3, Continuous (partialDeriv a ζ) := by

  have hwc : ∀ a b, ContinuousOn (w a b) (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j)) := by

    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => hI2 a b)]

nds_weak_solution.definitions:
def ndsInt (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) {β : M → ℝ} {Ω₀ S₀ : Set M} (A : NdsAtlas M β Ω₀ S₀)
    (F : M → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j),
    A.ψ j (A.κ j x) * F (A.κ j x) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det

def ndsV0 [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (S₀ : Set M) : Submodule ℝ (M → ℝ) where
  carrier := {u | ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧
    ∃ N : Set M, IsOpen N ∧ S₀ ⊆ N ∧ ∀ q ∈ N, u q = 0}
  add_mem' := by
    rintro u w ⟨hu, N₁, hN₁, hS₁, hu0⟩ ⟨hw, N₂, hN₂, hS₂, hw0⟩
    show ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u + w) ∧
      ∃ N : Set M, IsOpen N ∧ S₀ ⊆ N ∧ ∀ q ∈ N, (u + w) q = 0
    refine ⟨hu.add hw, N₁ ∩ N₂, hN₁.inter hN₂, Set.subset_inter hS₁ hS₂, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    simp [hu0 q hq.1, hw0 q hq.2]
  zero_mem' := by
    show ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (0 : M → ℝ) ∧
      ∃ N : Set M, IsOpen N ∧ S₀ ⊆ N ∧ ∀ q ∈ N, (0 : M → ℝ) q = 0
    exact ⟨contMDiff_const, Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.subset_univ _, fun q _ => rfl⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro c u ⟨hu, N, hN, hS, hu0⟩
    show ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (c • u) ∧
      ∃ N : Set M, IsOpen N ∧ S₀ ⊆ N ∧ ∀ q ∈ N, (c • u) q = 0
    refine ⟨contMDiff_const.smul hu, N, hN, hS, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    simp [hu0 q hq]

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_pdiffeo_formula
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ κ.source) :
    g.gradInner u w (κ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => u (κ z)) x *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => w (κ z)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: lapM_gradInner_linear_local
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u v w : M → ℝ) (p : M) :
    ((ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) → (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v) → ∀ a b : ℝ,
      g.lapM (fun q => a * u q + b * v q) p = a * g.lapM u p + b * g.lapM v p ∧
      g.gradInner (fun q => a * u q + b * v q) w p = a * g.gradInner u w p + b * g.gradInner v w p) ∧
    (∀ U : Set M, IsOpen U → p ∈ U → (∀ q ∈ U, u q = v q) →
      g.lapM u p = g.lapM v p ∧ g.gradInner u w p = g.gradInner v w p)

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_direct_method
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (B : V → V → ℝ) (L Q : V → ℝ) (CP K : ℝ)
    (hBsymm : ∀ u w, B u w = B w u)
    (hBlin : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (u v w : V), B (a • u + b • v) w = a * B u w + b * B v w)
    (hBnn : ∀ u, 0 ≤ B u u)
    (hLlin : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (u v : V), L (a • u + b • v) = a * L u + b * L v)
    (hQ : ∀ u, 0 ≤ Q u ∧ Q u ≤ CP * B u u)
    (hL : ∀ u, L u ^ 2 ≤ K * Q u) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → V,
      (∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m n, N ≤ m → N ≤ n → B (u m - u n) (u m - u n) < ε) ∧
      (∀ φ : V, Tendsto (fun n => B (u n) φ + L φ) atTop (𝓝 0))

subgoal_signatures.name: l2_cauchy_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : MeasurableSet U) (h : ℕ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ m, MemLp (h m) 2 (volume.restrict U))
    (hc : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l → ∫ x in U, (h m x - h l x) ^ 2 < ε) :

    (hH : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => H (A.κ j x)) (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j))) :

          ≤ CP * ndsInt g A (fun q => g.gradInner u u q) ∧

def sclBulk (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (β u : M → ℝ) (q : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (S : Set M)
    (t s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (S ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source),
    φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
      (Real.smoothTransition (β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) / s) *
        sternGaussM g u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) *
      sbgbAreaDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y
    ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))


def sclBulkLim (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u : M → ℝ) (q : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (S : Set M)
    (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (S ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source),
    φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * sternGaussM g u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
      sbgbAreaDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y
    ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))


def sclCollar (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (β u : M → ℝ) (q : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (S : Set M)
    (t s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (S ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source),
    φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
      (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) / s) *
        g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) /
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) *
      sbgbAreaDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y
    ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))


def sclEdge (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (β u : M → ℝ) (q : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (S : Set M)
    (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (S ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∩ β ⁻¹' {0} ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source),
    φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
      (g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) /
        (Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) *
          Real.sqrt (g.gradInner β β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)))) *
      sbgbEdgeDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
        (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y
    ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ))

search_metadata.last_error: Sound 3-child split. The glue uses all three children: bulk child via hB, collar child via hCo, and chart_collar_trace_limit passed as the hTrace argument to slice_collar_chart_limit (verbatim statement, the pattern of stern_integration_core). Topological localization s1 is proved inline, and sbgbSliceJ/sbgbSliceLim unfold by rfl into the scl* chart summands. Each child is mathematically true and much easier than the parent: the bulk child is fixed-chart DCT with a uniform level-set area bound and an mu-null edge; the trace child is Euclidean and chart-free (sbgbAreaConst=pi/4 normalization and density |grad f|/|grad f x grad b| = 1/|tangential grad b| checked); the collar child is cutoff plus Gram identity plus hneu, with hTrace supplied. The crux (area formula s11, length formula s12) is explicitly housed under chart_collar_trace_limit, and that planner must split them off. findings.md documents the divergence, and blueprint sections 4-5 carry concrete numerics and 16 falsification checks. No duplication of section 10, no recycling, no parameter splitting.

by

  have hA : IsCompact ({t} : Set ℝ) := isCompact_singleton
  have hAsub : ({t} : Set ℝ) ⊆ Set.Ioo (-L) L := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst hx
    exact abs_lt.mp ht
  have hAreg : ∀ p ∈ sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L, u p ∈ ({t} : Set ℝ) →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0 := fun p hp hpt => hreg p ⟨hp, hpt⟩
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀, Cb, -, hlim⟩ := stern_slice_collar_limit g hAF hR k β Re hβ hmin u hu hharm
    hneu X Y R₀ R₁ C hXY hRe hX hdom hconn hchart L hL q φ hadm {t} hA hAsub hAreg
  have hlimt := hlim t (Set.mem_singleton t)
  obtain ⟨S, P, ρ, Kc, b, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11, hcmp⟩ :=
    stern_slice_patched_reduction g hAF hR k β Re hβ hmin u hu hharm hneu X Y R₀ R₁ C hXY hRe hX
      hdom hconn hchart
      (fun F W hW hF hinj hdF W' hW' hW'W h =>
        sbgb_hausdorff_area_formula F W hW hF hinj hdF W' hW' hW'W h)
      (fun z W F hW hF hFt hinj c hlev hreg' x hx hβx =>
        stern_edge_curvature_pointwise g β u hβ.1 hβ.2.1 hu hneu hmin z W F hW hF hFt hinj c
          hlev hreg' x hx hβx)
      (fun G R L' t' hR0 hRL ht' hG hsymm hpd =>
        stern_side_collar_limit G R L' t' hR0 hRL ht' hG hsymm hpd)
      L hL q φ hadm t ht hreg
  have hgb := patched_collar_gauss_bonnet S P ρ Kc h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 b h6 h7 h8 h9 h10 h11
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro θ hθ
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁, hc⟩ := hcmp (θ / 2) (half_pos hθ)
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂, hg⟩ := hgb (θ / 2) (half_pos hθ)

    have e2 := hg s hs.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hs.2 (min_le_right _ _))
    linarith

stern_slice_gauss_bonnet.definitions:
def sgbGradSq2 (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a w x * pd2 c w x


def sgbLevelCurv2 (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2) : ℝ :=
  -((Real.sqrt (h x).det)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det *
      (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a w y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h w y)) x)


def sgbCollarGB {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (b : X → ℝ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x) +
  eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
    Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x) *
    sgbLevelCurv2 (P.h j) (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x)


def sgbSideMetric (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x : E2) :
    Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
  fun a b => G (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) a.succ b.succ


def sgbSideDef (L : ℝ) (x : E2) : ℝ := L ^ 2 - x 0 ^ 2 - x 1 ^ 2
