    have hM' : ∀ a b, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A a i * Gt⁻¹ i j * A b j = Gm⁻¹ a b := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hM]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [hPt, hQt, ← hM']
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hinjG : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, ∀ u : E3,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y u = 0 → u = 0 := by
    intro y hy u hu0
    have hev2 : ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm : E3 → E3) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] id := by
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 q).open_target.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact (chartAt E3 q).right_inv hz
    have hcomp2 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 q) ∘ (chartAt E3 q).symm) y =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y) :=
      mfderiv_comp y
        (mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).map_target hy))
        (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hy)
    rw [hev2.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_id] at hcomp2
    have h3 := congrArg (fun L => L u) hcomp2
    change u = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y u) at h3
    rw [hu0, map_zero] at h3
    exact h3
  
  have hdetG : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy hd
    obtain ⟨v, hv0, hGv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hd
    have hx0 : (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hv0
      funext a
      rw [← hcomp_e v a, h]
      rfl
    have hA0 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) ≠ 0 :=
      fun h => hx0 (hinjG y hy _ h)
    have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) _ hA0
    have hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * v j = 0 := by
      intro i
      have := congrFun hGv i
      simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using this
    have hc : ∀ i j, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j =
        g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (e i))
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (e j)) := fun i j => rfl
    have hzero : g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i)) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, v i * ∑ j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j * v j := by
      simp only [hc, map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [hzero] at hpos
    simp [hrow] at hpos
  
  have key : ∀ y ∈ {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U},
      g.gradInner f w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
    rintro y ⟨hy, hyU⟩
    set p := (chartAt E3 q).symm y with hp
    set τ : E3 → E3 := fun z => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) with hτdef
    have hΩo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
      (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 p).open_source
    have hyΩ : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 p).source :=
      ⟨hy, mem_chart_source E3 p⟩
    have hτs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ
        ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 p).source) := by
      have hc : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 p) (chartAt E3 p).source :=
        contMDiffOn_chart
      have hcs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q).target :=
        contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp
        (hc.comp (hcs.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun z hz => hz.2))
    have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y :=
      (hτs.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hyΩ)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hev : ((chartAt E3 q).symm : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] ((chartAt E3 p).symm ∘ τ) := by
      filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hyΩ] with z hz
      exact ((chartAt E3 p).left_inv hz.2).symm
    have hpt : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      (chartAt E3 p).map_source (mem_chart_source E3 p)
    have hM1 : ∀ u : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y u =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)
          (fderiv ℝ τ y u) := by
      intro u
      have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (τ y) :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hpt
      rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp y hmd hτd.mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      rfl
    
    have s1 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun z => τ z a) y *
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) a b *
            partialDeriv j (fun z => τ z b) y := by
      intro i j
      have hq' : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p :=
        (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
      have hgq : g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)) = g.g p := congrArg g.g hq'
      obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
          D = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hΦD : ∀ u : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y u =
          D (fderiv ℝ τ y u) := by
        intro u
        rw [hM1 u, hD]
        exact rfl
      have hcD : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) a b
          = g.g p (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
        intro a b
        rw [← hgq, hD]
        rfl
      have hJ : ∀ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ τ y (e k)
          = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => τ z d) y • e d := by
        intro k
        rw [hu (fderiv ℝ τ y (e k))]
        simp only [hcompo τ y hτd]
      simp only [hcD]
      show g.g p (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm y (e j)) = _
      rw [hΦD, hΦD, hJ i, hJ j]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    
    have hinj := hinjG y hy
    
    have s3 : (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun z => τ z a) y).det ≠ 0 := by
      intro hdet
      obtain ⟨v, hv0, hJv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
      have hw0 : fderiv ℝ τ y (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
        ext a
        rw [map_sum]
        simp only [map_smul]
        have := congrFun hJv a
        simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
          hcompo τ y hτd] at this
        simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
          WithLp.ofLp_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
        rw [← this]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      have h0 : (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
        apply hinj
        rw [hM1, hw0]
        exact ContinuousLinearMap.map_zero _
      apply hv0
      funext a
      rw [← hcomp_e v a, h0]
      rfl
    
    have hPt : ∀ (h : M → ℝ) (W : Set M), IsOpen W → ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ h W →
        p ∈ W → ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => h ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
          ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => h ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p p) *
            (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun z => τ z a) y) a i := by
      intro h W hW hh hpW i
      have hWo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' W) :=
        (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hW
      have hmem : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' W := by
        refine ⟨hpt, ?_⟩
        show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) ∈ W
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)]
        exact hpW
      have hhs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => h ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
          ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' W) := by
        have hcs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p).target :=
          contMDiffOn_chart_symm
        exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp
          (hh.comp (hcs.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun z hz => hz.2))
      have hhd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p p) :=
        (hhs.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hequ : (fun z => h ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          (fun z => h ((chartAt E3 p).symm (τ z))) := by
        filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hyΩ] with z hz
        show h ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) =
          h ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)))
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hz.2]
      have e1 : partialDeriv i (fun z => h ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
          partialDeriv i (fun z => h ((chartAt E3 p).symm (τ z))) y := by
        show fderiv ℝ _ y (e i) = fderiv ℝ _ y (e i)
        rw [hequ.fderiv_eq]
      rw [e1, pd_comp (fun z => h ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) τ y hτd hhd i]
      rfl
    have hL : g.gradInner f w p = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p p) *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p p) := rfl
    rw [hL]
    exact (grad_alg (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun z => τ z a) y)
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)) (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)
      (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p p))
      (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p p))
      (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y)
      (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y)
      s3 (fun i j => s1 i j)
      (hPt f Set.univ isOpen_univ hf.contMDiffOn (Set.mem_univ _))
      (hPt w U hU hw hyU)).symm
  
  have hVo : IsOpen {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U} :=
    (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hU
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j)
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U} :=
    fun i j => (g.smooth q i j).mono (fun y hy => hy.1)
  have hcs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    contMDiffOn_chart_symm
  have hfc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U} :=
    (contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hf.comp_contMDiffOn hcs)).mono (fun y hy => hy.1)
  have hwc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U} :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hw.comp (hcs.mono (fun y hy => hy.1)) (fun y hy => hy.2))
  have hpd : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U} → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => partialDeriv i F y)
        {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U} :=
    fun F hF i => (hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hVo (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hGc : ContinuousOn (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U} :=
    continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j => (hGs i j).continuousOn
  have hinvM : ContinuousOn (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹)
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U} := by
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det⁻¹ •
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).adjugate)
        {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U} :=
      ((continuous_id.matrix_det.comp_continuousOn hGc).inv₀
        (fun y hy => hdetG y hy.1)).smul (continuous_id.matrix_adjugate.comp_continuousOn hGc)
    refine h1.congr (fun y _ => ?_)
    simp only [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
  have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j)
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U} :=
    fun i j => (continuous_apply j).comp_continuousOn
      ((continuous_apply i).comp_continuousOn hinvM)
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y)
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ U} := by
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro i _
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro j _
    exact ((hinv i j).mul (hpd _ hfc i)).mul (hpd _ hwc j)
  exact hcont.congr key

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (q : M) :
    ContinuousOn (fun y => sternGaussM g u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ≠ 0}

signature.name: stern_gauss_chart
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (q : M) :
    ContinuousOn (fun y => sternGaussM g u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ≠ 0}

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hsymm : ∀ (z : M) (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y j i :=
    fun z y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  have htrans : ∀ a b : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => chartAt E3 b ((chartAt E3 a).symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 a).target ∩ (chartAt E3 a).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 b).source) := by
    intro a b
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ ((chartAt E3 b) ∘ (chartAt E3 a).symm)
        ((chartAt E3 a).target ∩ (chartAt E3 a).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 b).source) :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart).comp (contMDiffOn_chart_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (fun y hy => hy.2)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  have hGc : ∀ (h₁ h₂ : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (W : Set E2), IsOpen W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, h₁ x = h₂ x) → ∀ x ∈ W, gaussCurv2 h₁ x = gaussCurv2 h₂ x := by
    intro h₁ h₂ W hW hhe x hx
    have hpd2 : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ (F : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ → ℝ) (i : Fin 2),
        pd2 i (fun w => F (h₁ w)) z = pd2 i (fun w => F (h₂ w)) z := by
      intro z hz F i
      have hev : (fun w => F (h₁ w)) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (fun w => F (h₂ w)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hz) (fun w hw => by simp only [hhe w hw])
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hpd3 : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ a b c : Fin 2,
        pd2 c (fun w => h₁ w a b) z = pd2 c (fun w => h₂ w a b) z :=
      fun z hz a b c => hpd2 z hz (fun A => A a b) c
    have hchr : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h₁ k i j z = christoffel2 h₂ k i j z := by
      intro z hz k i j
      simp only [christoffel2, hhe z hz, hpd3 z hz]
    have hchrd : ∀ (a b c i : Fin 2),
        pd2 i (christoffel2 h₁ a b c) x = pd2 i (christoffel2 h₂ a b c) x := by
      intro a b c i
      have hev : christoffel2 h₁ a b c =ᶠ[𝓝 x] christoffel2 h₂ a b c :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun w hw => hchr w hw a b c)
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [gaussCurv2, ricci2, hhe x hx, hchrd, hchr x hx]
  have hReg : IsOpen {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0} :=
    isOpen_iff_mem_nhds.mpr (fun x hx => mfderiv_ne_zero_eventually Set.univ u isOpen_univ
      hu.contMDiffOn x trivial hx)
  
  have key : ∀ p : M, p ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0 →
      sternGaussM g u p = levelGaussLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q p) := by
    intro p hp hdp
    have hfq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    have hfp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    obtain ⟨Ω, hΩdef⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set E3, Ω = (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹'
        ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0}) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by
      rw [hΩdef]
      exact (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm ((chartAt E3 p).open_source.inter hReg)
    have hΩmem : ∀ y ∈ Ω, y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
        (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source ∧
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ≠ 0 := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hΩdef] at hy
      exact ⟨hy.1, hy.2.1, hy.2.2⟩
    have hyq : chartAt E3 q p ∈ Ω := by
      rw [hΩdef]
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 q).map_source hp, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q p) ∈
        (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0}
      rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hp]
      exact ⟨mem_chart_source E3 p, hdp⟩
    have hpos : 0 < gradSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
        (chartAt E3 q p) :=
      chart_Nsq_pos g u hu q (chartAt E3 q p) ((chartAt E3 q).map_source hp)
        (by rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hp]; exact hdp)
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q p) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      unfold gradSqLoc gradInnerLoc partialDeriv at hpos
      rw [h0] at hpos
      simp at hpos
    have hhd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) - u p) (chartAt E3 q p) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [fderiv_sub_const]; exact hfd
    have hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) - u p) Ω :=
      (hfq.mono (fun y hy => (hΩmem y hy).1)).sub contDiffOn_const
    have hh0 : (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) - u p) (chartAt E3 q p) = 0 := by
      show u ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q p)) - u p = 0
      rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv hp, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨W, F₂, x₀, hWo, hx₀, hF₂s, hF₂x₀, -, hF₂W⟩ :=
      regular_zero_set_local_param Ω hΩo _ hh _ hyq hh0 hhd
    have hW1 : ∀ x ∈ W, F₂ x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := fun x hx => (hΩmem _ (hF₂W x hx).1).1
    have hW2 : ∀ x ∈ W, (chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x) ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source :=
      fun x hx => (hΩmem _ (hF₂W x hx).1).2.1
    have hW3 : ∀ x ∈ W, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x)) ≠ 0 :=
      fun x hx => (hΩmem _ (hF₂W x hx).1).2.2
    have hW4 : ∀ x ∈ W, u ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x)) = u p := by
      intro x hx
      have h : u ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x)) - u p = 0 := (hF₂W x hx).2.1
      linarith
    have hF₂d : ∀ x ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ F₂ x := fun x hx =>
      (hF₂s.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hΩ'o : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 p).source) :=
      (chartAt E3 q).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 p).open_source
    have hτd : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 p).source,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) y := fun y hy =>
      ((htrans q p).contDiffAt (hΩ'o.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hτinj : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 p).source,
        Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) y) := by
      intro y hy
      have hy2 : (chartAt E3 q).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := hy.2
      have hτy : chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ∈
          (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source := by
        refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source hy2, ?_⟩
        show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hy2]
        exact (chartAt E3 q).map_target hy.1
      have hτ'd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
          (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) :=
        ((htrans p q).contDiffAt (((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm
          (chartAt E3 q).open_source).mem_nhds hτy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hev : (fun z => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) ∘
          (fun y => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] id := by
        filter_upwards [hΩ'o.mem_nhds hy] with y' hy'
        have hy'2 : (chartAt E3 q).symm y' ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := hy'.2
        show chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y'))) = y'
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hy'2, (chartAt E3 q).right_inv hy'.1]
      have hcomp := fderiv_comp y hτ'd (hτd y hy)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id] at hcomp
      intro v w hvw
      have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp v
      have h3 := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp w
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] at h2 h3
      rw [h2, h3]
      exact congrArg _ hvw
    have hF₁s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x))) W :=
      (htrans q p).comp hF₂s (fun x hx => ⟨hW1 x hx, hW2 x hx⟩)
    have hF₁d : ∀ x ∈ W,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x))) x :=
      fun x hx => (hF₁s.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hF₁inj : ∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective
        (fderiv ℝ (fun x => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x))) x) := by
      intro x hx
      have hc := fderiv_comp x (hτd (F₂ x) ⟨hW1 x hx, hW2 x hx⟩) (hF₂d x hx)
      intro v w hvw
      have hvw' : (fderiv ℝ ((fun y => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) ∘ F₂) x) v =
          (fderiv ℝ ((fun y => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) ∘ F₂) x) w := hvw
      rw [hc] at hvw'
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] at hvw'
      exact (hF₂W x hx).2.2 (hτinj (F₂ x) ⟨hW1 x hx, hW2 x hx⟩ hvw')
    have hEq := level_gauss_equation (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target
      (chartAt E3 q).open_target (fun i j => g.smooth q i j) (hsymm q)
      (fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q y hy) _ hfq F₂ W hWo hF₂s hW1
      (fun x hx => (hF₂W x hx).2.2) (u p) hW4
      (fun x hx => chart_Nsq_pos g u hu q (F₂ x) (hW1 x hx) (hW3 x hx)) x₀ hx₀
    have hEp := level_gauss_equation (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p).target
      (chartAt E3 p).open_target (fun i j => g.smooth p i j) (hsymm p)
      (fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y hy) _ hfp
      (fun x => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x))) W hWo hF₁s
      (fun x hx => (chartAt E3 p).map_source (hW2 x hx)) hF₁inj (u p)
      (fun x hx => by
        show u ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x)))) = u p
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hW2 x hx)]
        exact hW4 x hx)
      (fun x hx => chart_Nsq_pos g u hu p (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x)))
        ((chartAt E3 p).map_source (hW2 x hx))
        (by rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hW2 x hx)]; exact hW3 x hx)) x₀ hx₀
    have hmet : ∀ x ∈ W, pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (fun x => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x))) x =
        pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) F₂ x := by
      intro x hx
      have hc := pullMetric2_reparam_compat g p q
        (fun x => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x))) F₂ id x
        (hF₁d x hx) (hF₂d x hx) differentiableAt_id ((chartAt E3 p).map_source (hW2 x hx))
        (hW1 x hx)
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hWo.mem_nhds hx)
          (fun x' hx' => (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (hW2 x' hx')))
      ext a b
      rw [hc a b, fderiv_id]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have e1 := hGc _ _ W hWo hmet x₀ hx₀
    have hx₀' : (chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x₀) = p := by
      rw [hF₂x₀, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hp]
    have hEp' : gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (fun x => chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x)))) x₀ =
        levelGaussLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
          (chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 q).symm (F₂ x₀))) := hEp
    have hEq' : gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) F₂) x₀ =
        levelGaussLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
          (F₂ x₀) := hEq
    rw [hx₀'] at hEp'
    rw [hF₂x₀] at hEq'
    unfold sternGaussM
    exact (hEp'.symm.trans e1).trans hEq'
  set c := chartAt E3 q with hc
  set G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := g.coeff c.symm with hGdef
  set f : E3 → ℝ := fun z => u (c.symm z) with hfdef
  set V : Set E3 := c.target with hVdef
  have hVo : IsOpen V := c.open_target
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V := fun i j => g.smooth q i j
  have hpd : ∀ y ∈ V, (G y).PosDef := fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q y hy
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  obtain ⟨E1, E2, E3', E4, -⟩ := ejp_coord_smooth G f V hVo hGs hpd hf
  
  have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) V :=
    fun i j => (E2 i j).continuousOn
  have hdf : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => partialDeriv i f y) V :=
    fun i => (E1 f hf i).continuousOn
  have hch : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => christoffel G k i j y) V :=
    fun k i j => (E3' k i j).continuousOn
  have hdch : ∀ l k i j : Fin 3,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => partialDeriv l (christoffel G k i j) y) V :=
    fun l k i j => (E1 _ (E3' k i j) l).continuousOn
  have hhes : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => hessLoc G f a b y) V :=
    fun a b => (E4 a b).continuousOn
  have hric : ∀ j k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => ricci G j k y) V := by
    intro j k
    simp only [ricci]
    exact (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => (hdch i i j k).sub (hdch j i i k)).add
      (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun p _ =>
        ((hch i i p).mul (hch p j k)).sub ((hch i j p).mul (hch p i k)))
  have hR : ContinuousOn (fun y => scalarCurvatureLocal G y) V := by
    simp only [scalarCurvatureLocal]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun k _ =>
      (hinv j k).mul (hric j k)
  have hgu : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => gradUpLoc G f y i) V := by
    intro i
    simp only [gradUpLoc]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => (hinv i a).mul (hdf a)
  have hN : ContinuousOn (fun y => gradSqLoc G f y) V := by
    simp only [gradSqLoc, gradInnerLoc]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      ((hinv i j).mul (hdf i)).mul (hdf j)
  have hrg : ContinuousOn (fun y => ricGradLoc G f y) V := by
    simp only [ricGradLoc]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      ((hgu i).mul (hgu j)).mul (hric i j)
  have hlap : ContinuousOn (fun y => lapLoc G f y) V := by
    simp only [lapLoc]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      (hinv i j).mul (hhes i j)
  have hgg : ContinuousOn (fun y => hessGGLoc G f f y) V := by
    simp only [hessGGLoc]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      ((hgu i).mul (hgu j)).mul (hhes i j)
  have hsq : ContinuousOn (fun y => hessSqLoc G f y) V := by
    simp only [hessSqLoc]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
        (((hinv i a).mul (hinv j b)).mul (hhes i j)).mul (hhes a b)
  have hgs : ContinuousOn (fun y => hessGradSqLoc G f y) V := by
    simp only [hessGradSqLoc]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
        ((hinv i j).mul ((hhes i a).mul (hgu a))).mul ((hhes j b).mul (hgu b))
  
  set Rq : Set E3 := {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < gradSqLoc G f y} with hRqdef
  have hRV : Rq ⊆ V := fun y hy => hy.1
  have hne : ∀ y ∈ Rq, gradSqLoc G f y ≠ 0 := fun y hy => hy.2.ne'
  have hne2 : ∀ y ∈ Rq, gradSqLoc G f y ^ 2 ≠ 0 := fun y hy => pow_ne_zero 2 (hy.2.ne')
  have hLG : ContinuousOn (fun y => levelGaussLoc G f y) Rq := by
    simp only [levelGaussLoc]
    have hR' := hR.mono hRV
    have hrg' := hrg.mono hRV
    have hN' := hN.mono hRV
    have hlap' := hlap.mono hRV
    have hgg' := hgg.mono hRV
    have hsq' := hsq.mono hRV
    have hgs' := hgs.mono hRV
    exact continuousOn_const.mul
      (((hR'.sub ((continuousOn_const.mul hrg').div hN' hne)).add
        (((hlap'.sub (hgg'.div hN' hne)).pow 2).div hN' hne)).sub
        (((hsq'.sub ((continuousOn_const.mul hgs').div hN' hne)).add
          ((hgg'.pow 2).div (hN'.pow 2) hne2)).div hN' hne))
  
  have hsub : {y | y ∈ c.target ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u (c.symm y) ≠ 0} ⊆ Rq := by
    intro y hy
    exact ⟨hy.1, chart_Nsq_pos g u hu q y hy.1 hy.2⟩
  refine (hLG.mono hsub).congr ?_
  intro y hy
  have hp : c.symm y ∈ c.source := c.map_target hy.1
  have h := key (c.symm y) hp hy.2
  simp only []
  rw [h, c.right_inv hy.1]

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_coord_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) : (∀ (w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U → ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i w) U) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G Φ a b) U) ∧ (∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ejpN G Φ y d) U)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: chart_Nsq_pos
subgoal_signatures.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (p : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) (hd : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) ≠ 0) : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y * partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y

subgoal_signatures.name: mfderiv_ne_zero_eventually
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (V : Set M) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hVo : IsOpen V) (hw : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w V) (y : M) (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (hdy : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w y ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 y, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w x ≠ 0

subgoal_signatures.name: level_gauss_equation
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ V, (G y).PosDef)
    (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V)
    (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W)
    (hFV : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ V) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x))
    (c : ℝ) (hlev : ∀ x ∈ W, f (F x) = c) (hreg : ∀ x ∈ W, 0 < gradSqLoc G f (F x)) :
    ∀ x ∈ W, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 G F) x = levelGaussLoc G f (F x)

subgoal_signatures.name: regular_zero_set_local_param
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(Ω : Set E3) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hh : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h Ω) (u₀ : E3) (hu₀ : u₀ ∈ Ω) (h0 : h u₀ = 0)
    (hd : fderiv ℝ h u₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (W : Set E2) (Fh : E2 → E3) (x₀ : E2), IsOpen W ∧ x₀ ∈ W ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Fh W ∧
      Fh x₀ = u₀ ∧ Set.InjOn Fh W ∧
      ∀ x ∈ W, Fh x ∈ Ω ∧ h (Fh x) = 0 ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Fh x)

subgoal_signatures.name: pullMetric2_reparam_compat
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (z₁ z₂ : M) (F₁ F₂ : E2 → E3) (τ : E2 → E2) (x : E2)
    (hF₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ F₁ x) (hF₂ : DifferentiableAt ℝ F₂ (τ x))
    (hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ x)
    (h₁ : F₁ x ∈ (chartAt E3 z₁).target) (h₂ : F₂ (τ x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z₂).target)
    (heq : ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, (chartAt E3 z₁).symm (F₁ x') = (chartAt E3 z₂).symm (F₂ (τ x'))) :
    ∀ a b : Fin 2, pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z₁).symm) F₁ x a b =
      ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 a) c * pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z₂).symm) F₂ (τ x) c d *
          fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) d

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (β u : M → ℝ) (hβc : Continuous β)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hharm : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → g.lapM u p = 0)
    (p : M) (hp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    0 < g.gradInner u u p ∧
    (0 < β p → -(|sternGaussM g u p| * ε / (2 * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p))) ≤
      g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) p + Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) * sternGaussM g u p) ∧
    g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) p =
      Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) / sternPhiM g u ε p *
        g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) p ∧
    0 ≤ 1 - Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) / sternPhiM g u ε p ∧
    1 - Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) / sternPhiM g u ε p ≤ ε / (2 * g.gradInner u u p)

signature.name: stern_band_pointwise
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hR : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.scalarCurvature p) (β u : M → ℝ) (hβc : Continuous β)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hharm : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → g.lapM u p = 0)
    (p : M) (hp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    0 < g.gradInner u u p ∧
    (0 < β p → -(|sternGaussM g u p| * ε / (2 * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p))) ≤
      g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) p + Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) * sternGaussM g u p) ∧
    g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) p =
      Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) / sternPhiM g u ε p *
        g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) p ∧
    0 ≤ 1 - Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) / sternPhiM g u ε p ∧
    1 - Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p) / sternPhiM g u ε p ≤ ε / (2 * g.gradInner u u p)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hy₀ : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := mem_chart_target E3 p
  have hsy : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p :=
    (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
  have hQ : 0 < g.gradInner u u p :=
    chart_Nsq_pos g u hu p _ hy₀ (by rw [hsy]; exact hp)
  have hphi : sternPhiM g u ε p = Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p + ε) := rfl
  
  set Q := g.gradInner u u p with hQdef
  set n := Real.sqrt Q with hndef
  set b := Real.sqrt (Q + ε) with hbdef
  have hn : 0 < n := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hQ
  have hb : 0 < b := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
  have hn2 : n ^ 2 = Q := Real.sq_sqrt hQ.le
  have hb2 : b ^ 2 = Q + ε := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  have hnb : n ≤ b := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
  have expand : ε * b - (b - n) * (2 * Q) = (b - n) ^ 2 * (b + 2 * n) := by
    linear_combination (-b) * hb2 + (3 * b - 2 * n) * hn2
  have hexp0 : 0 ≤ (b - n) ^ 2 * (b + 2 * n) := by positivity
  have hc4 : 0 ≤ 1 - n / b := by
    have : n / b ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hb).2 hnb
    linarith
  have hc5 : 1 - n / b ≤ ε / (2 * Q) := by
    have e1 : 1 - n / b = (b - n) / b := by field_simp
    rw [e1, div_le_div_iff₀ hb (by positivity)]
    linarith
  
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j)
      (chartAt E3 p).target := fun i j => g.smooth p i j
  have hsym : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y j i := by
    intro y i j
    exact g.symm _ _ _
  have hpdT : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef :=
    fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y hy
  obtain ⟨hũ, hFeq, -⟩ := chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu p
  have hT : (chartAt E3 p).target ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds hy₀
  
  have hgerm : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f f' : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3),
      f =ᶠ[𝓝 y] f' → lapLoc G f y = lapLoc G f' y := by
    intro G f f' y h
    have h1 : ∀ k, partialDeriv k f y = partialDeriv k f' y := by
      intro k
      simp only [partialDeriv, h.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ j, partialDeriv j f =ᶠ[𝓝 y] partialDeriv j f' := by
      intro j
      filter_upwards [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ) h] with z hz
      simp only [partialDeriv, hz]
    have h3 : ∀ i j, partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f') y := by
      intro i j
      show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j f') y (e i)
      rw [(h2 j).fderiv_eq]
    simp only [lapLoc, hessLoc, h1, h3]
  refine ⟨hQ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro hβp
    have hVo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' {x : M | 0 < β x}) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 p).open_target
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const hβc)
    have hVT : (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' {x : M | 0 < β x} ⊆
        (chartAt E3 p).target := Set.inter_subset_left
    have hy₀V : chartAt E3 p p ∈
        (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' {x : M | 0 < β x} := by
      refine ⟨hy₀, ?_⟩
      show 0 < β ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))
      rw [hsy]; exact hβp
    have hlap : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' {x : M | 0 < β x},
        lapLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have hβy : 0 < β ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) := hy.2
      have h0 := hharm _ hβy.le
      rw [nli_chart_lapM_eq g p u hu y hy.1] at h0
      rw [← h0]
      simp only [lapLoc, hessLoc, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hB := (stern_bochner_local (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' {x : M | 0 < β x}) hVo
      (fun i j => (hGs i j).mono hVT) hsym (fun y hy => hpdT y hy.1)
      (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (hũ.mono hVT) hlap ε hε (chartAt E3 p p) hy₀V).2 hQ
    have hev1 : sternPhiLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) ε
        =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)] fun z => sternPhiM g u ε ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) := by
      filter_upwards [hT] with z hz
      simp only [sternPhiLoc, sternPhiM, gradSqLoc, gradInnerLoc]
      rw [hFeq z hz]
    have hlapeq : lapLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (sternPhiLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) ε)
        (chartAt E3 p p) = g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) p := hgerm _ _ _ _ hev1
    have hB' : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * hessSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
          (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p p) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Q * (g.scalarCurvature p - 2 * sternGaussM g u p) ≤
        b * g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) p := by
      rw [← hlapeq]
      exact hB
    have hH : 0 ≤ hessSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p p) :=
      (stern_kato_alg (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹
        (fun i j => hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
          i j (chartAt E3 p p))
        (hpdT _ hy₀).inv 0 (fun a => ∑ c : Fin 3,
          (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ a c * (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) c)
        (fun _ => rfl)).2.1
    have hQR : 0 ≤ Q * g.scalarCurvature p := mul_nonneg hQ.le (hR p)
    have hbd : -(Q * sternGaussM g u p) ≤ b * g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) p := by
      nlinarith
    
    set K := sternGaussM g u p with hKdef
    set Δ := g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) p with hΔdef
    have t1 : 2 * n * (-(Q * K)) ≤ 2 * n * (b * Δ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbd (by positivity)
    have t2 : 0 ≤ |K| * (ε * b - (b - n) * (2 * Q)) :=
      mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg K) (by rw [expand]; exact hexp0)
    have t3 : 0 ≤ (b - n) * (K + |K|) * (2 * Q) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hnb) (by linarith [neg_abs_le K])) (by positivity)
    have hQb : n * Q * K = n * (n ^ 2) * K := by rw [hn2]
    have hQb2 : Q * b * K = n ^ 2 * b * K := by rw [hn2]
    have hX : b * 0 ≤ b * (2 * n * (Δ + n * K) + |K| * ε) := by
      nlinarith
    have hX' : 0 ≤ 2 * n * (Δ + n * K) + |K| * ε := le_of_mul_le_mul_left hX hb
    rw [neg_le, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  · 
    set F : E3 → ℝ := fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) z with hFdef
    have hsm := ejp_coord_smooth (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))
      (chartAt E3 p).target (chartAt E3 p).open_target hGs hpdT hũ
    have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro i _
      apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro j _
      exact ((hsm.2.1 i j).mul (hsm.1 _ hũ i)).mul (hsm.1 _ hũ j)
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F (chartAt E3 p p) :=
      (hFs.contDiffAt hT).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hF0 : F (chartAt E3 p p) = Q := rfl
    have hne1 : F (chartAt E3 p p) + ε ≠ 0 := by rw [hF0]; linarith
    have hne2 : F (chartAt E3 p p) ≠ 0 := by rw [hF0]; exact hQ.ne'
    have hchain : ∀ j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv j (fun z => sternPhiM g u ε ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p p) =
          n / b * partialDeriv j (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)))
            (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      intro j
      have e1 : (fun z => sternPhiM g u ε ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
          fun z => Real.sqrt (F z + ε) := by
        filter_upwards [hT] with z hz
        simp only [sternPhiM, hFdef]
        rw [hFeq z hz]
      have e2 : (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)))
          =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)] fun z => Real.sqrt (F z) := by
        filter_upwards [hT] with z hz
        simp only [hFdef]
        rw [hFeq z hz]
      have d1 : partialDeriv j (fun z => sternPhiM g u ε ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p p)
          = (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (F (chartAt E3 p p) + ε))) * fderiv ℝ F (chartAt E3 p p) (e j) := by
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [e1.fderiv_eq, fderiv_sqrt (hFd.add_const ε) hne1, fderiv_add_const,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have d2 : partialDeriv j (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)))
          (chartAt E3 p p)
          = (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (F (chartAt E3 p p)))) * fderiv ℝ F (chartAt E3 p p) (e j) := by
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [e2.fderiv_eq, fderiv_sqrt hFd hne2, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [d1, d2, hF0]
      field_simp
      simp only [hbdef, hndef]
      ring
    show ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) *
        partialDeriv j (fun y => sternPhiM g u ε ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) =
      n / sternPhiM g u ε p * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) *
        partialDeriv j (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)))
          (chartAt E3 p p)
    rw [hphi]
    simp only [hchain, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  · rw [hphi]; exact hc4
  · rw [hphi]; exact hc5

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_bochner_local
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ V, (G y).PosDef)
    (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V) (hharm : ∀ y ∈ V, lapLoc G f y = 0)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ y ∈ V, ricGradLoc G f y ≤ sternPhiLoc G f ε y * lapLoc G (sternPhiLoc G f ε) y ∧
      (0 < gradSqLoc G f y →
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * hessSqLoc G f y +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * gradSqLoc G f y * (scalarCurvatureLocal G y - 2 * levelGaussLoc G f y)
          ≤ sternPhiLoc G f ε y * lapLoc G (sternPhiLoc G f ε) y)

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_kato_alg
subgoal_signatures.statement: (A H : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) (ξ w : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ a : Fin 3, w a = ∑ c : Fin 3, A a c * ξ c) : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ξ i * ξ j ∧ 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A i a * A j b * H i j * H a b ∧ 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A i j * (H i a * w a) * (H j b * w b) ∧ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A i j * (H i a * w a) * (H j b * w b) ≤ (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ξ i * ξ j) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A i a * A j b * H i j * H a b

subgoal_signatures.name: nli_chart_lapM_eq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    g.lapM u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) y
      + ∑ l : Fin 3, (-(∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          christoffel (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) l i j y)) *
          partialDeriv l (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y

subgoal_signatures.name: chart_Nsq_pos
subgoal_signatures.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (p : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) (hd : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) ≠ 0) : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y * partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y

subgoal_signatures.name: chart_pullback_gradInner
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (p : M) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
      (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) (chartAt E3 p).target

subgoal_signatures.name: ejp_coord_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Φ : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ U) : (∀ (w : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U → ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i w) U) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U) ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G Φ a b) U) ∧ (∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ejpN G Φ y d) U)

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_chart_symm_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (β : M → ℝ)
    (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β)
    (hβr : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0) (q : M) (Kc : Set E3)
    (hKc : IsCompact Kc) (hKT : Kc ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) :
    ∃ Cb s₀ : ℝ, 0 < s₀ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₀ →
      volume (Kc ∩ {y | 0 < β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ∧ β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) < s}) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Cb * s)

signature.name: stern_thin_band_volume
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (β : M → ℝ)
    (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β)
    (hβr : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0) (q : M) (Kc : Set E3)
    (hKc : IsCompact Kc) (hKT : Kc ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) :
    ∃ Cb s₀ : ℝ, 0 < s₀ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₀ →
      volume (Kc ∩ {y | 0 < β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ∧ β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) < s}) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Cb * s)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set c := chartAt E3 q with hc
  set b : E3 → ℝ := fun y => β (c.symm y) with hbdef
  have hT : IsOpen c.target := c.open_target
  
  have hbT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b c.target := by
    have : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (β ∘ c.symm) c.target :=
      hβ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp this
  have hreg : ∀ y ∈ c.target, b y = 0 → fderiv ℝ b y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy hb0 hd
    have hxs : c.symm y ∈ c.source := c.map_target hy
    have hcx : c (c.symm y) = y := c.right_inv hy
    have hbd : DifferentiableAt ℝ b y :=
      (hbT.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hev : β =ᶠ[𝓝 (c.symm y)] (b ∘ c) := by
      filter_upwards [c.open_source.mem_nhds hxs] with z hz
      show β z = β (c.symm (c z))
      rw [c.left_inv hz]
    have hmc : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) c (c.symm y) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hxs
    have hmb : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) b (c (c.symm y)) := by
      rw [hcx]; exact hbd.mdifferentiableAt
    have hb0' : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) b (c (c.symm y)) = 0 := by
      rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv, hcx]; exact hd
    have h1 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β (c.symm y) = 0 := by
      rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp (c.symm y) hmb hmc, hb0']
      exact ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp _
    exact hβr (c.symm y) hb0 h1
  
  have growth : ∀ y₀ ∈ c.target, fderiv ℝ b y₀ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ R cc : ℝ, ∃ v : E3, 0 < R ∧ 0 < cc ∧ ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R) ⊆ c.target ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ R → b y + cc * t ≤ b (y + t • v) := by
    intro y₀ hy₀ hd
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, fderiv ℝ b y₀ w ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hd (ContinuousLinearMap.ext hcon)
    have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      simp at hw
    have hwn : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hw0
    have hwi : 0 < ‖w‖⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hwn
    obtain ⟨v, hv1, hav⟩ : ∃ v : E3, ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < fderiv ℝ b y₀ v := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hw with h | h
      · refine ⟨-(‖w‖⁻¹ • w), ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hwn.ne']
        · rw [map_neg, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
          nlinarith
      · refine ⟨‖w‖⁻¹ • w, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hwn.ne']
        · rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
          exact mul_pos hwi h
    have hfc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ b) c.target :=
      hbT.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hT (by simp)
    have hfca : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ b) y₀ := hfc.continuousAt (hT.mem_nhds hy₀)
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hδ₁'⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hfca (fderiv ℝ b y₀ v / 2)
      (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hδ₂'⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hT y₀ hy₀
    have hδ : 0 < min δ₁ δ₂ := lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂
    have hballT : Metric.ball y₀ (min δ₁ δ₂) ⊆ c.target :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hδ₂'
    have hder : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (min δ₁ δ₂), fderiv ℝ b y₀ v / 2 < fderiv ℝ b z v := by
      intro z hz
      have hz1 : dist z y₀ < δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_left _ _)
      have h1 := hδ₁' hz1
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at h1
      have h2 : ‖(fderiv ℝ b z - fderiv ℝ b y₀) v‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ b z - fderiv ℝ b y₀‖ * ‖v‖ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      rw [hv1, mul_one, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h2
      have h3 := neg_abs_le (fderiv ℝ b z v - fderiv ℝ b y₀ v)
      linarith
    refine ⟨min δ₁ δ₂ / 2, fderiv ℝ b y₀ v / 2, v, by linarith, by linarith, hv1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [show 2 * (min δ₁ δ₂ / 2) = min δ₁ δ₂ by ring]
      exact hballT
    · intro y hy t ht0 htR
      have hseg : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ t → y + τ • v ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (min δ₁ δ₂) := by
        intro τ hτ0 hτt
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hy ⊢
        calc dist (y + τ • v) y₀ ≤ dist (y + τ • v) y + dist y y₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ = τ + dist y y₀ := by
              rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hv1, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                abs_of_nonneg hτ0]
          _ < min δ₁ δ₂ := by linarith
      have hderiv : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ t →
          HasDerivAt (fun τ => b (y + τ • v)) (fderiv ℝ b (y + τ • v) v) τ := by
        intro τ hτ0 hτt
        have hmem := hballT (hseg τ hτ0 hτt)
        have hbd : DifferentiableAt ℝ b (y + τ • v) :=
          (hbT.contDiffAt (hT.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hp : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => y + τ • v) v τ := by
          simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id τ).smul_const v).const_add y
        exact hbd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt τ hp
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht0 with h | h
      · subst h
        simp
      · have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun τ => b (y + τ • v)) (Set.Icc 0 t) := by
          intro τ hτ
          exact (hderiv τ hτ.1 hτ.2).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
        obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξeq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun τ => b (y + τ • v))
          (fun τ => fderiv ℝ b (y + τ • v) v) h hcont
          (fun τ hτ => hderiv τ hτ.1.le hτ.2.le)
        have hgt := hder _ (hseg ξ hξ.1.le hξ.2.le)
        rw [hξeq] at hgt
        simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, sub_zero] at hgt
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ h] at hgt
        linarith
  
  have pack : ∀ (y₀ v : E3) (R cc : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < cc → ‖v‖ = 1 →
      ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball y₀ R) →
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ R → b y + cc * t ≤ b (y + t • v)) →
      ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < R * cc →
        volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R))).toReal / (R * cc) * s) := by
    intro y₀ v R cc hR hcc hv hbc hgrow s hs hsR
    have hUo : IsOpen (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) :=
      hbc.isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball (isOpen_Ioo (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := s))
    have hhpos : 0 < s / cc := div_pos hs hcc
    have hx1 : 1 < R * cc / s := by rw [lt_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith
    have hN1 : 0 < ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ := Nat.floor_pos.mpr hx1.le
    have hNx : (⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ R * cc / s := Nat.floor_le (by linarith)
    have hxN : R * cc / s < ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hNh : (⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) * (s / cc) ≤ R := by
      calc (⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) * (s / cc) ≤ R * cc / s * (s / cc) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hNx hhpos.le
        _ = R := by field_simp
    have hUkm : ∀ k : ℕ, MeasurableSet
        ((fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) := fun k =>
      (measurable_add_const _) hUo.measurableSet
    have hUkv : ∀ k : ℕ, volume
        ((fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) =
        volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) := fun k =>
      measure_preimage_add_right volume _ _
    have hUksub : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊,
        (fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ⊆ Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R) := by
      intro k hk z hz
      have hkN : (k : ℝ) ≤ ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ := by exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_range.mp hk).le
      have hd : dist (z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) y₀ < R := hz.1
      have hkh : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) * (s / cc) := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hhpos.le
      have hkh2 : (k : ℝ) * (s / cc) ≤ ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ * (s / cc) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkN hhpos.le
      have hdz : dist z (z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) = (k : ℝ) * (s / cc) := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, sub_add_cancel_left, norm_neg, norm_smul, hv, mul_one,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hkh]
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      calc dist z y₀ ≤ dist z (z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) +
            dist (z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) y₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < (k : ℝ) * (s / cc) + R := by rw [hdz]; linarith
        _ ≤ 2 * R := by linarith
    have key : ∀ j k : ℕ, j < k → k < ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ → Disjoint
        ((fun z => z + (-((j : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}))
        ((fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) := by
      intro j k hjk hkN
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro z hzj hzk
      have hj : z + (-((j : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v ∈
          Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s} := hzj
      have hk : z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v ∈
          Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s} := hzk
      have hjk' : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hjk
      have hkN' : (k : ℝ) ≤ ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ := by exact_mod_cast hkN.le
      have hj0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j := Nat.cast_nonneg j
      have ht0 : s / cc ≤ ((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc) := by nlinarith
      have htR : ((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc) ≤ R := by
        have : ((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc) ≤ (⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) * (s / cc) := by nlinarith
        linarith
      have heq : z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v + (((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc)) • v =
          z + (-((j : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v := by
        rw [add_assoc, ← add_smul]
        congr 2
        ring
      have hg := hgrow _ hk.1 (((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc)) (by linarith) htR
      rw [heq] at hg
      have h1 : 0 < b (z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) := hk.2.1
      have h2 : b (z + (-((j : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) < s := hj.2.2
      have h3 : cc * (s / cc) ≤ cc * (((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht0 hcc.le
      have hcs : cc * (s / cc) = s := by field_simp
      linarith
    have hdisj : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (↑(Finset.range ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊) : Set ℕ)
        (fun k : ℕ => (fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) := by
      intro j hj k hk hne
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h' | h'
      · exact key j k h' (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      · exact (key k j h' (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)).symm
    have hsum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊, volume
        ((fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) ≤
        volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R)) := by
      rw [← measure_biUnion_finset hdisj (fun k _ => hUkm k)]
      exact measure_mono (Set.iUnion₂_subset hUksub)
    simp only [hUkv, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
    have hWt : volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R)) ≠ ⊤ := measure_ball_lt_top.ne
    have hUt : volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro htop
      rw [htop, ENNReal.mul_top (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))] at hsum
      exact hWt (top_le_iff.mp hsum)
    have hreal : (⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) *
        (volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})).toReal ≤
        (volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R))).toReal := by
      have := ENNReal.toReal_mono hWt hsum
      rwa [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_natCast] at this
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hUt]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    have hU0 : 0 ≤ (volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})).toReal :=
      ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    have hN1' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ := by exact_mod_cast hN1
    have hRc : R * cc ≤ 2 * ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ * s := by
      have h2N : R * cc / s ≤ 2 * ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ := by linarith
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hs] at h2N
      linarith
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hR hcc)]
    calc (volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})).toReal * (R * cc)
        ≤ (volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})).toReal *
            (2 * ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ * s) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRc hU0
      _ = 2 * s * ((⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) *
            (volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})).toReal) := by ring
      _ ≤ 2 * s * (volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R))).toReal :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal (by linarith)
      _ = 2 * (volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R))).toReal * s := by ring
  
  have hloc : ∀ y₀ ∈ Kc, ∃ r C s₁ : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 < s₁ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₁ →
      volume (Metric.ball y₀ r ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * s) := by
    intro y₀ hy₀
    have hy₀T := hKT hy₀
    by_cases hb0 : b y₀ = 0
    · obtain ⟨R, cc, v, hR, hcc, hv, hball, hgrow⟩ := growth y₀ hy₀T (hreg y₀ hy₀T hb0)
      have hbc : ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball y₀ R) :=
        hbT.continuousOn.mono ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball)
      refine ⟨R, 2 * (volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R))).toReal / (R * cc), R * cc, hR,
        div_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two ENNReal.toReal_nonneg) (mul_pos hR hcc).le,
        mul_pos hR hcc, ?_⟩
      exact pack y₀ v R cc hR hcc hv hbc hgrow
    · have hm : 0 < |b y₀| := abs_pos.mpr hb0
      have hca : ContinuousAt b y₀ := hbT.continuousOn.continuousAt (hT.mem_nhds hy₀T)
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hca (|b y₀| / 2) (by linarith)
      refine ⟨r, 0, |b y₀| / 2, hr, le_rfl, by linarith, fun s hs hss => ?_⟩
      have hempty : Metric.ball y₀ r ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s} = ∅ := by
        rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        rintro z ⟨hz, hz1, hz2⟩
        have h1 : dist (b z) (b y₀) < |b y₀| / 2 := hr' hz
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at h1
        have h2 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (b y₀) (b z)
        have h3 : |b y₀ - b z| = |b z - b y₀| := abs_sub_comm _ _
        rw [abs_of_pos hz1] at h2
        linarith
      rw [hempty, measure_empty]
      exact zero_le _
  
  choose! r C s₁ hr hC hs₁ hbd using hloc
  obtain ⟨t, htK, hcover⟩ := hKc.elim_nhds_subcover (fun y => Metric.ball y (r y))
    (fun y hy => Metric.ball_mem_nhds y (hr y hy))
  refine ⟨∑ y ∈ t, C y, (insert 1 (t.image s₁)).min' (Finset.insert_nonempty _ _), ?_,
    fun s hs hss => ?_⟩
  · have hm := Finset.min'_mem (insert 1 (t.image s₁)) (Finset.insert_nonempty _ _)
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image] at hm
    rcases hm with h | ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩
    · rw [h]; exact one_pos
    · rw [← hy']; exact hs₁ y (htK y hy)
  · have hle : ∀ y ∈ t, s < s₁ y := fun y hy => lt_of_lt_of_le hss
      (Finset.min'_le _ _ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hy)))
    calc volume (Kc ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})
        ≤ volume (⋃ y ∈ t, (Metric.ball y (r y) ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) := by
          apply measure_mono
          rintro z ⟨hzK, hz⟩
          have hzc := hcover hzK
          rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hzc ⊢
          obtain ⟨y, hy, hzy⟩ := hzc
          exact ⟨y, hy, hzy, hz⟩
      _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ t, volume (Metric.ball y (r y) ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) :=
          measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ t, ENNReal.ofReal (C y * s) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun y hy => hbd y (htK y hy) s hs (hle y hy))
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ y ∈ t, C y * s) :=
          (ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun y hy => mul_nonneg (hC y (htK y hy)) hs.le)).symm
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((∑ y ∈ t, C y) * s) := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(D Kc : Set E3) (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hKc : IsCompact Kc)
    (hKD : Kc ⊆ D) (b Af Cf : E3 → ℝ) (hb : ContinuousOn b Kc) (hA : ContinuousOn Af Kc)
    (hC : ContinuousOn Cf Kc) (Cb s₀ : ℝ)
    (hband : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₀ →
      volume (Kc ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Cb * s)) :
    ∃ Λ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Λ ∧ ∀ ε s : ℝ, 0 < ε → 0 < s → s < s₀ →
      ∀ fB fC f1 f2 : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn fB Kc → ContinuousOn fC Kc → ContinuousOn f1 Kc →
        ContinuousOn f2 Kc →
        (∀ y ∈ D \ Kc, fB y = 0 ∧ fC y = 0 ∧ f1 y = 0 ∧ f2 y = 0) →
        (∀ y ∈ Kc, -(ε * Af y) ≤ fB y + f1 y) →
        (∀ y ∈ Kc, -(ε / s * Cf y * Set.indicator {z | 0 < b z ∧ b z < s} (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y) ≤
          fC y - f2 y) →
        -(ε * Λ) ≤ (∫ y in D, fB y) + (∫ y in D, fC y) + (∫ y in D, f1 y) - (∫ y in D, f2 y)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hC
  set M₀ := max M 0 with hM₀def
  have hM₀0 : 0 ≤ M₀ := le_max_right _ _
  have hM₀ : ∀ y ∈ Kc, |Cf y| ≤ M₀ := fun y hy =>
    le_trans (by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hM y hy) (le_max_left _ _)
  refine ⟨max (∫ y in Kc, Af y) 0 + M₀ * max Cb 0,
    add_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) (mul_nonneg hM₀0 (le_max_right _ _)), ?_⟩
  intro ε s hε hs hss fB fC f1 f2 hfB hfC hf1 hf2 hvan hbulk hbandpt
  have hKm : MeasurableSet Kc := hKc.measurableSet
  have eB : ∫ y in D, fB y = ∫ y in Kc, fB y :=
    setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hD hKD (fun y hy => (hvan y hy).1)
  have eC : ∫ y in D, fC y = ∫ y in Kc, fC y :=
    setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hD hKD (fun y hy => (hvan y hy).2.1)
  have e1 : ∫ y in D, f1 y = ∫ y in Kc, f1 y :=
    setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hD hKD (fun y hy => (hvan y hy).2.2.1)
  have e2 : ∫ y in D, f2 y = ∫ y in Kc, f2 y :=
    setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hD hKD (fun y hy => (hvan y hy).2.2.2)
  have iB : IntegrableOn fB Kc := hfB.integrableOn_compact hKc
  have iC : IntegrableOn fC Kc := hfC.integrableOn_compact hKc
  have i1 : IntegrableOn f1 Kc := hf1.integrableOn_compact hKc
  have i2 : IntegrableOn f2 Kc := hf2.integrableOn_compact hKc
  have iB1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => fB y + f1 y) Kc := (hfB.add hf1).integrableOn_compact hKc
  have iC2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => fC y - f2 y) Kc := (hfC.sub hf2).integrableOn_compact hKc
  have iA' : IntegrableOn (fun y => -(ε * Af y)) Kc :=
    ((continuousOn_const.mul hA).neg).integrableOn_compact hKc
  have hsum1 : ∫ y in Kc, (fB y + f1 y) = (∫ y in Kc, fB y) + ∫ y in Kc, f1 y :=
    integral_add iB i1
  have hsum2 : ∫ y in Kc, (fC y - f2 y) = (∫ y in Kc, fC y) - ∫ y in Kc, f2 y :=
    integral_sub iC i2
  
  have hI1 : -(ε * max (∫ y in Kc, Af y) 0) ≤ ∫ y in Kc, (fB y + f1 y) := by
    have hmono : ∫ y in Kc, -(ε * Af y) ≤ ∫ y in Kc, (fB y + f1 y) :=
      setIntegral_mono_on iA' iB1 hKm hbulk
    have hc : ∫ y in Kc, -(ε * Af y) = -(ε * ∫ y in Kc, Af y) := by
      rw [integral_neg, integral_const_mul]
    have : ε * ∫ y in Kc, Af y ≤ ε * max (∫ y in Kc, Af y) 0 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) hε.le
    linarith
  
  have hI2 : -(ε * (M₀ * max Cb 0)) ≤ ∫ y in Kc, (fC y - f2 y) := by
    obtain ⟨U, hUo, hUeq⟩ := (_root_.continuousOn_iff'.mp hb) (Set.Ioo 0 s) isOpen_Ioo
    have hWm : MeasurableSet (U ∩ Kc) := hUo.measurableSet.inter hKm
    have hWsub : U ∩ Kc ⊆ Kc := Set.inter_subset_right
    have hmemW : ∀ y ∈ Kc, (y ∈ {z | 0 < b z ∧ b z < s} ↔ y ∈ U ∩ Kc) := by
      intro y hy
      rw [← hUeq]
      simp [Set.mem_Ioo, hy]
    have hKW : Kc ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s} = U ∩ Kc := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hy, hy'⟩
        exact (hmemW y hy).1 hy'
      · intro hy
        exact ⟨hWsub hy, (hmemW y (hWsub hy)).2 hy⟩
    have hvol : volume (U ∩ Kc) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Cb * s) := by
      rw [← hKW]
      exact hband s hs hss
    have hes0 : 0 ≤ ε / s := div_nonneg hε.le hs.le
    have hpt : ∀ y ∈ Kc,
        -(ε / s * M₀) * (U ∩ Kc).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y ≤ fC y - f2 y := by
      intro y hy
      have h := hbandpt y hy
      by_cases hyW : y ∈ U ∩ Kc
      · have hyB : y ∈ {z | 0 < b z ∧ b z < s} := (hmemW y hy).2 hyW
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyW]
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyB] at h
        have hcf : Cf y ≤ M₀ := le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hM₀ y hy)
        have : ε / s * Cf y ≤ ε / s * M₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcf hes0
        linarith
      · have hyB : y ∉ {z | 0 < b z ∧ b z < s} := fun h' => hyW ((hmemW y hy).1 h')
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyW]
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyB] at h
        linarith
    have igW : IntegrableOn
        (fun y => -(ε / s * M₀) * (U ∩ Kc).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y) Kc := by
      have h1 : IntegrableOn ((U ∩ Kc).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) Kc :=
        IntegrableOn.indicator
          (continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hKc : IntegrableOn (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) Kc) hWm
      exact Integrable.const_mul h1 _
    have hmono := setIntegral_mono_on igW iC2 hKm hpt
    have hcomp : ∫ y in Kc, -(ε / s * M₀) * (U ∩ Kc).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y
        = -(ε / s * M₀) * volume.real (U ∩ Kc) := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, setIntegral_indicator hWm, setIntegral_const,
        Set.inter_eq_right.mpr hWsub, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have hreal : volume.real (U ∩ Kc) ≤ s * max Cb 0 := by
      rw [measureReal_def]
      have h1 := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hvol
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal'] at h1
      refine le_trans h1 (max_le ?_ (mul_nonneg hs.le (le_max_right _ _)))
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) hs.le
    have hfin : -(ε / s * M₀) * (s * max Cb 0) = -(ε * (M₀ * max Cb 0)) := by
      have hss' : ε / s * s = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε hs.ne'
      calc -(ε / s * M₀) * (s * max Cb 0) = -((ε / s * s) * (M₀ * max Cb 0)) := by ring
        _ = -(ε * (M₀ * max Cb 0)) := by rw [hss']
    have hle : -(ε / s * M₀) * (s * max Cb 0) ≤ -(ε / s * M₀) * volume.real (U ∩ Kc) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hreal (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hes0 hM₀0])
    linarith
  rw [eB, eC, e1, e2]
  have hsplit : -(ε * (max (∫ y in Kc, Af y) 0 + M₀ * max Cb 0)) =
      -(ε * max (∫ y in Kc, Af y) 0) + -(ε * (M₀ * max Cb 0)) := by ring
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : Re + 1 < ρ)
    (hcl : IsClosed ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖}))
    (p : M) (hp0 : 0 < β p) (hpF : p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
    (hpS : p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ‖y‖ = ρ}) :
    ∃ (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (c : E3) (r : ℝ) (D : Prop),
      0 < r ∧ κ.source = Metric.ball c r ∧ κ c = p ∧ (c 0 = 0 ∨ r ≤ c 0) ∧ (D → c 0 = 0) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c r,
        (κ x ∈ ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ↔ 0 ≤ x 0) ∧
        (κ x ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ‖y‖ = ρ} ↔ (D ∧ x 0 = 0)) ∧
        (β (κ x) = 0 ↔ (¬ D ∧ x 0 = 0)) ∧
        (¬ D → c 0 = 0 → β (κ x) = x 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hβc : Continuous β := hβ.1.continuous
  
  have hpFb : p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy, hyp⟩
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (show ρ ≤ ‖y‖ from hy) with h | h
    · exact hpF ⟨y, h, hyp⟩
    · exact hpS ⟨y, h.symm, hyp⟩
  
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Set M,
      U = {q : M | 0 < β q} ∩ ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖})ᶜ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUo : IsOpen U := by
    rw [hU]; exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hβc).inter hcl.isOpen_compl
  have hpch : p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := mem_chart_source E3 p
  have hTo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' U) :=
    (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 p).open_target hUo
  have hy₀T : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' U := by
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_source hpch, ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) ∈ U
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hpch, hU]
    exact ⟨hp0, hpFb⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hTo (chartAt E3 p p) hy₀T
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : E3, c = (2 * δ) • e 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc0 : c 0 = 2 * δ := by
    rw [hc]; simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : E3, v = chartAt E3 p p - c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hdist : ∀ x : E3, dist (x + v) (chartAt E3 p p) = dist x c := by
    intro x
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, hv]
    congr 1
    abel
  have hdist' : ∀ w : E3, dist (w - v) c = dist w (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    intro w
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, hv]
    congr 1
    abel
  have hcoord : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c δ, δ < x 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hd : dist x c < δ := hx
    have hcd : |x 0 - c 0| ≤ dist x c := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq,
        Real.dist_eq]
      apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
      have h1 : 0 ≤ |x 1 - c 1| ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have h2 : 0 ≤ |x 2 - c 2| ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      linarith
    have h3 := (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_le_of_lt hcd hd)).1
    rw [hc0] at h3
    linarith
  have hxT : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c δ,
      x + v ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' U := by
    intro x hx
    apply hball
    show dist (x + v) (chartAt E3 p p) < δ
    rw [hdist]
    exact hx
  
  have hto : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun x : E3 => (chartAt E3 p).symm (x + v))
      (Metric.ball c δ) :=
    (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := p)).comp
      ((contDiff_id.add contDiff_const).contDiffOn (s := Metric.ball c δ)).contMDiffOn
      (fun x hx => (hxT x hx).1)
  have hinv : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun w : M => chartAt E3 p w - v)
      ((chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) δ) :=
    (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn
      ((contMDiffOn_chart (x := p)).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
  let e₀ : PartialEquiv E3 M :=
    { toFun := fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (x + v)
      invFun := fun w => chartAt E3 p w - v
      source := Metric.ball c δ
      target := (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) δ
      map_source' := fun x hx => ⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_target (hxT x hx).1, by
        show chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm (x + v)) ∈ Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) δ
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv (hxT x hx).1]
        show dist (x + v) (chartAt E3 p p) < δ
        rw [hdist]
        exact hx⟩
      map_target' := fun w hw => by
        show dist (chartAt E3 p w - v) c < δ
        rw [hdist']
        exact hw.2
      left_inv' := fun x hx => by
        show chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm (x + v)) - v = x
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv (hxT x hx).1, add_sub_cancel_right]
      right_inv' := fun w hw => by
        show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p w - v + v) = w
        rw [sub_add_cancel]
        exact (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hw.1 }
  obtain ⟨κ, hκs, hκ⟩ : ∃ κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      κ.source = Metric.ball c δ ∧ ∀ x, κ x = (chartAt E3 p).symm (x + v) :=
    ⟨{ toPartialEquiv := e₀
       open_source := Metric.isOpen_ball
       open_target := (chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball
       contMDiffOn_toFun := hto
       contMDiffOn_invFun := hinv }, rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
  
  have hFb : ∀ q : M, q ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} →
      q ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} := by
    rintro q ⟨y, hy, hyq⟩
    exact ⟨y, le_of_lt (show ρ < ‖y‖ from hy), hyq⟩
  have hSb : ∀ q : M, q ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ‖y‖ = ρ} →
      q ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} := by
    rintro q ⟨y, hy, hyq⟩
    exact ⟨y, le_of_eq (show ‖y‖ = ρ from hy).symm, hyq⟩
  have hκU : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c δ, 0 < β (κ x) ∧
      κ x ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} := by
    intro x hx
    have h := (hxT x hx).2
    rw [hκ x]
    have h' : (chartAt E3 p).symm (x + v) ∈ U := h
    rw [hU] at h'
    exact h'
  refine ⟨κ, c, δ, False, hδ, hκs, ?_, Or.inr (by rw [hc0]; linarith), fun h => h.elim, ?_⟩
  · rw [hκ c, hv, add_sub_cancel]
    exact (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hpch
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hβx, hFx⟩ := hκU x hx
    have hx0 := hcoord x hx
    refine ⟨⟨fun _ => by linarith, fun _ => ⟨le_of_lt hβx, fun h => hFx (hFb _ h)⟩⟩,
      ⟨fun h => (hFx (hSb _ h)).elim, fun h => h.1.elim⟩,
      ⟨fun h => absurd h (ne_of_gt hβx), fun h => by linarith [h.2]⟩,
      fun _ h => by rw [hc0] at h; linarith⟩

      0 < r ∧ κ.source = Metric.ball c r ∧ κ c = p ∧ (c 0 = 0 ∨ r ≤ c 0) ∧ (D → c 0 = 0) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c r,

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : Re + 1 < ρ)
    (hcl : IsClosed ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖}))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hpF : p ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy, hyp⟩
    have hy' : ρ ≤ ‖y‖ := hy
    have hRe2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Re := hβ.2.2.1
    have h1 := hβ.2.2.2.1 y (by linarith)
    rw [hyp, hp0] at h1
    exact lt_irrefl _ h1
  obtain ⟨Ψ, r₀, hr₀, hΨsrc, hΨ0, hΨβ⟩ := boundary_flat_chart β hβ.1 p hp0 (hβ.2.1 p hp0)
  have hΨcont : ContinuousAt Ψ 0 := by
    apply Ψ.contMDiffOn.continuousOn.continuousAt
    rw [hΨsrc]
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball_self hr₀)
  have hnhds : ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖})ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 (Ψ 0) := by
    rw [hΨ0]
    exact hcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hpF
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hΨcont.preimage_mem_nhds hnhds)
  have hr : 0 < min r₀ r₁ := lt_min hr₀ hr₁
  have hsub0 : Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁) ⊆ Metric.ball 0 r₀ :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)
  have hsub1 : Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁) ⊆ Metric.ball 0 r₁ :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)
  have hsubΨ : Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁) ⊆ Ψ.toPartialEquiv.source := by
    intro x hx
    show x ∈ Ψ.source
    rw [hΨsrc]
    exact hsub0 hx
  have hesrc : (Ψ.toPartialEquiv.restr (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁))).source =
      Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁) := by
    rw [PartialEquiv.restr_source]
    exact Set.inter_eq_right.mpr hsubΨ
  have hopen_s : IsOpen (Ψ.toPartialEquiv.restr (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁))).source := by
    rw [hesrc]
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hopen_t : IsOpen (Ψ.toPartialEquiv.restr (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁))).target := by
    rw [PartialEquiv.restr_target]
    exact Ψ.contMDiffOn_invFun.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Ψ.open_target
      Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hsm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞
      (⇑(Ψ.toPartialEquiv.restr (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁))))
      (Ψ.toPartialEquiv.restr (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁))).source := by
    rw [PartialEquiv.restr_coe, PartialEquiv.restr_source]
    exact Ψ.contMDiffOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hsmi : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞
      (Ψ.toPartialEquiv.restr (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁))).invFun
      (Ψ.toPartialEquiv.restr (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁))).target := by
    rw [PartialEquiv.restr_target]
    exact Ψ.contMDiffOn_invFun.mono Set.inter_subset_left
  let κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
    PartialDiffeomorph.mk (Ψ.toPartialEquiv.restr (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁)))
      hopen_s hopen_t hsm hsmi
  have hκv : ∀ x : E3, κ x = Ψ x := fun x => rfl
  have hκsrc : κ.source = Metric.ball (0 : E3) (min r₀ r₁) := hesrc
  refine ⟨κ, 0, min r₀ r₁, False, hr, hκsrc, ?_, Or.inl (by simp), fun h => h.elim, ?_⟩
  · rw [hκv]
    exact hΨ0
  intro x hx
  have hxβ : β (κ x) = x 0 := by
    rw [hκv]
    exact hΨβ x (hsub0 hx)
  have hxF : κ x ∉ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} := by
    rw [hκv]
    exact hball (hsub1 hx)
  refine ⟨⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩, ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h.1.elim⟩,
    ⟨fun h => ⟨not_false, by rw [← hxβ]; exact h⟩, fun h => by rw [hxβ]; exact h.2⟩,
    fun _ _ => hxβ⟩
  · rw [← hxβ]
    exact h.1
  · show 0 ≤ β (κ x)
    rw [hxβ]
    exact h
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩
    have hy' : ρ < ‖y‖ := hy
    exact hxF ⟨y, show ρ ≤ ‖y‖ from le_of_lt hy', hyx⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := h
    have hy' : ‖y‖ = ρ := hy
    exact (hxF ⟨y, show ρ ≤ ‖y‖ from le_of_eq hy'.symm, hyx⟩).elim

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)

        (κ x ∈ ({q : M | 0 ≤ β q} \ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) ↔ 0 ≤ x 0) ∧
        (κ x ∈ (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {y : E3 | ‖y‖ = ρ} ↔ (D ∧ x 0 = 0)) ∧

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
