      have := min_le_left δ₀ (s - dist xs c)
      rw [hδdef]; linarith
    have hδd : δ < s - dist xs c := by
      have := min_le_right δ₀ (s - dist xs c)
      rw [hδdef]; linarith
    
    let β : ContDiffBump xs := ⟨δ / 2, δ, by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hβC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ β := β.contDiff
    have hβc : HasCompactSupport β := β.hasCompactSupport
    have hβts : tsupport β ⊆ Metric.ball c s := by
      rw [β.tsupport_eq]
      intro y hy
      have hy' : dist y xs ≤ δ := hy
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      have := dist_triangle y xs c
      linarith
    have hβρ : tsupport β ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ := subset_trans hβts hsρ'
    have hβnn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ β y := fun y => β.nonneg
    have hβsupp : ∀ y, β y ≠ 0 → dist y xs < δ := by
      intro y hy
      have hm : y ∈ Function.support β := hy
      rw [β.support_eq] at hm
      exact hm
    have hβpos : ∀ y, dist y xs < δ → 0 < β y := by
      intro y hy
      have hm : y ∈ Function.support β := by rw [β.support_eq]; exact hy
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hβnn y) (Ne.symm hm)
    
    have hPC : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => V i y * β y) := fun i =>
      (hcut (V i) (hV i) β hβC hβc hβρ).1
    have hPc : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (fun y => V i y * β y) := fun i =>
      (hcut (V i) (hV i) β hβC hβc hβρ).2.1
    have hPts : ∀ i, tsupport (fun y => V i y * β y) ⊆ tsupport β := fun i =>
      (hcut (V i) (hV i) β hβC hβc hβρ).2.2
    have hσψnn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ σ * (V 0 y * β y) := by
      intro y
      by_cases hy : β y = 0
      · rw [hy]; ring_nf; exact le_refl _
      · have h1 := hball (lt_trans (hβsupp y hy) hδδ₀)
        rw [← mul_assoc]
        exact mul_nonneg h1.le (hβnn y)
    have hσψpos : ∀ y, dist y xs < δ → 0 < σ * (V 0 y * β y) := by
      intro y hy
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      exact mul_pos (hball (lt_trans hy hδδ₀)) (hβpos y hy)
    
    obtain ⟨lam, hlam⟩ : ∃ f : ℝ → ℝ, f = fun t => 1 - Real.smoothTransition (t ^ 2 / δ ^ 2) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hlamC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ lam := by
      rw [hlam]
      exact contDiff_const.sub (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
        ((contDiff_id.pow 2).div_const _))
    have hlam0 : lam 0 = 1 := by
      rw [hlam]
      simp only
      rw [show (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 / δ ^ 2 = 0 by ring, Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos le_rfl]
      ring
    have hlamδ : ∀ t, δ ≤ |t| → lam t = 0 := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hlam]
      simp only
      have h1 : δ ^ 2 ≤ t ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs t]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hδ.le ht 2
      have h2 : 1 ≤ t ^ 2 / δ ^ 2 := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        linarith
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le h2]
      ring
    have hlamD : ∀ t, deriv lam t =
        -(deriv Real.smoothTransition (t ^ 2 / δ ^ 2) * (2 * t / δ ^ 2)) := by
      intro t
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2 / δ ^ 2) (2 * t / δ ^ 2) t := by
        have := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 t).div_const (δ ^ 2)
        simpa using this
      have h2 : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition (t ^ 2 / δ ^ 2))
          (t ^ 2 / δ ^ 2) :=
        ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by simp) _).hasDerivAt
      have h3 := (h2.comp t h1).const_sub 1
      rw [hlam]
      exact h3.deriv
    have hdnp : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → deriv lam t ≤ 0 := by
      intro t ht
      rw [hlamD t]
      have h1 : 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition (t ^ 2 / δ ^ 2) :=
        Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
      have h2 : 0 ≤ 2 * t / δ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have := mul_nonneg h1 h2
      linarith
    have hdcont : Continuous (deriv lam) := hlamC.continuous_deriv (by simp)
    obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, ht₁d⟩ := exists_deriv_eq_slope lam hδ hlamC.continuous.continuousOn
      (hlamC.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableOn
    have ht₁neg : deriv lam t₁ < 0 := by
      rw [ht₁d, hlam0, hlamδ δ (le_of_eq (abs_of_pos hδ).symm)]
      have : (0 - 1) / (δ - 0) = -(1 / δ) := by ring
      rw [this]
      have : 0 < 1 / δ := by positivity
      linarith
    
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr⟩ : ∃ p : E3 → E3, p = fun x => x - (x 0) • e 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hprC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ pr := by
      rw [hpr]
      exact contDiff_id.sub (hπ0C.smul contDiff_const)
    have hcoord : ∀ (x : E3) (t : ℝ), (x + t • e 0) 0 = x 0 + t := by
      intro x t
      simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hpr_face : ∀ x : E3, x 0 = 0 → pr x = x := by
      intro x hx
      rw [hpr]
      simp [hx]
    have hpr_line : ∀ (x : E3) (t : ℝ), pr (x + t • e 0) = pr x := by
      intro x t
      rw [hpr]
      simp only
      rw [hcoord, add_smul]
      abel
    have hpr_dist : ∀ x : E3, ‖x - xs‖ ≤ ‖pr x - xs‖ + |x 0| := by
      intro x
      have : x - xs = (pr x - xs) + (x 0) • e 0 := by rw [hpr]; simp only; abel
      rw [this]
      refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : E3 → ℝ, K = fun x => lam (x 0) * (V 0 (pr x) * β (pr x)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hKC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ K := by
      rw [hK]
      exact (hlamC.comp hπ0C).mul ((hPC 0).comp hprC)
    have hKc : HasCompactSupport K := by
      refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall xs (2 * δ)) ?_
      intro x hx
      rw [hK]
      simp only
      by_cases h0 : δ ≤ |x 0|
      · rw [hlamδ _ h0, zero_mul]
      · by_cases h1 : β (pr x) = 0
        · rw [h1, mul_zero, mul_zero]
        · exfalso
          apply hx
          rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
          have h2 := hβsupp _ h1
          rw [dist_eq_norm] at h2
          have := hpr_dist x
          push_neg at h0
          linarith
    have hK0 : ∀ x, partialDeriv 0 K x = deriv lam (x 0) * (V 0 (pr x) * β (pr x)) := by
      intro x
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • e 0) (e 0) 0 := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const (e 0)).const_add x
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (K ∘ fun t : ℝ => x + t • e 0) (fderiv ℝ K x (e 0)) 0 :=
        HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq 0 ((hKC.differentiable (by simp)) x).hasFDerivAt hl
          (by simp)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (K ∘ fun t : ℝ => x + t • e 0)
          (deriv lam (x 0) * (V 0 (pr x) * β (pr x))) 0 := by
        have hfun : (K ∘ fun t : ℝ => x + t • e 0) =
            fun t => lam (x 0 + t) * (V 0 (pr x) * β (pr x)) := by
          funext t
          simp only [Function.comp, hK, hcoord, hpr_line]
        rw [hfun]
        have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun t => lam (x 0 + t)) (deriv lam (x 0)) 0 := by
          have := ((hlamC.differentiable (by simp)) (x 0 + 0)).hasDerivAt.comp_const_add (x 0) 0
          simpa using this
        exact h3.mul_const _
      exact h1.unique h2
    
    have hQC : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞
        (fun x => V i x * β x - (if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * K x) := fun i =>
      (hPC i).sub (contDiff_const.mul hKC)
    have hQc : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport
        (fun x => V i x * β x - (if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * K x) := fun i =>
      (hPc i).sub hKc.mul_left
    have hQface : ∀ x : E3, x 0 = 0 →
        (fun x => V 0 x * β x - (if (0 : Fin 3) = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * K x) x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [if_true, one_mul, hK, hx, hlam0, hpr_face x hx]
      ring
    have hQ := hdiv (fun i x => V i x * β x - (if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * K x)
      hQC hQc hQface
    have hQpt : ∀ x, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i
        (fun x => V i x * β x - (if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * K x) x =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => V i y * β y) x - partialDeriv 0 K x := by
      intro x
      have hone : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i
          (fun x => V i x * β x - (if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * K x) x =
          partialDeriv i (fun y => V i y * β y) x -
            (if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * partialDeriv i K x := by
        intro i
        unfold partialDeriv
        have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => V i y * β y) x :=
          ((hPC i).differentiable (by simp)) x
        have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * K y) x :=
          ((contDiff_const.mul hKC).differentiable (by simp)) x
        rw [show (fun x => V i x * β x - (if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * K x) =
          (fun y => V i y * β y) - (fun y => (if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * K y) from rfl,
          fderiv_sub hd1 hd2, fderiv_const_mul ((hKC.differentiable (by simp)) x)]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [hone, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      simp
      ring
    have hIP : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => V i y * β y) x) :=
      integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ =>
        (hpdC _ (hPC i) i).continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hpd_cs _ i (hPc i)))
    have hIK : Integrable (partialDeriv 0 K) :=
      (hpdC _ hKC 0).continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hpd_cs _ 0 hKc)
    have hsplit : (∫ x in {x : E3 | 0 < x 0},
        ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => V i y * β y) x) -
        ∫ x in {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}, partialDeriv 0 K x = 0 := by
      rw [← integral_sub hIP.integrableOn hIK.integrableOn]
      exact (setIntegral_congr_fun hHalfmeas (fun x _ => (hQpt x).symm)).trans hQ
    
    have hD6 : ∫ x in {x : E3 | 0 < x 0},
        ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => V i y * β y) x = 0 := by
      rw [setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hHalfmeas
        (Set.inter_subset_right : fcrHalf c s ⊆ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0})]
      · refine (setIntegral_congr_fun (hHmeas s) (fun x hx => ?_)).trans (hint β hβC hβc hβts)
        have hxρ : x ∈ Metric.ball c ρ := hsρ' hx.1
        show ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => V i y * β y) x =
          ∑ a : Fin 3, V a x * partialDeriv a β x + F x * β x
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hprod (V i) (hV i) β hβC i x hxρ),
          Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, heq x hx.1 (le_of_lt hx.2)]
        ring
      · intro x hx
        have hxt : x ∉ tsupport β := fun h => hx.2 ⟨hβts h, hx.1⟩
        exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => hpd_out _ i x (fun h => hxt (hPts i h)))
    have hD7 : ∫ x in {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}, -(σ * partialDeriv 0 K x) = 0 := by
      rw [integral_neg, integral_const_mul]
      have : ∫ x in {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}, partialDeriv 0 K x = 0 := by linarith
      rw [this]; ring
    
    have hnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}]
        fun x => -(σ * partialDeriv 0 K x) := by
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hHalfmeas (fun x hx => ?_)
      show 0 ≤ -(σ * partialDeriv 0 K x)
      rw [hK0 x]
      have h1 := hdnp (x 0) (le_of_lt hx)
      have h2 := hσψnn (pr x)
      have : -(σ * (deriv lam (x 0) * (V 0 (pr x) * β (pr x)))) =
          (-deriv lam (x 0)) * (σ * (V 0 (pr x) * β (pr x))) := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) h2
    have hpos : 0 < ∫ x in {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}, -(σ * partialDeriv 0 K x) := by
      rw [setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae hnn (hIK.const_mul σ).neg.integrableOn]
      obtain ⟨O, hO⟩ : ∃ O : Set E3,
          O = {x : E3 | deriv lam (x 0) < 0} ∩ {x : E3 | dist (pr x) xs < δ} ∩
            {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} :=
        ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hOo : IsOpen O := by
        rw [hO]
        refine ((isOpen_lt (hdcont.comp hπ0) continuous_const).inter
          (isOpen_lt (hprC.continuous.dist continuous_const) continuous_const)).inter
          (isOpen_lt continuous_const hπ0)
      have hOne : O.Nonempty := by
        refine ⟨xs + t₁ • e 0, ?_⟩
        rw [hO]
        refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · show deriv lam ((xs + t₁ • e 0) 0) < 0
          rw [hcoord, hxs0, zero_add]; exact ht₁neg
        · show dist (pr (xs + t₁ • e 0)) xs < δ
          rw [hpr_line, hpr_face xs hxs0, dist_self]; exact hδ
        · show 0 < (xs + t₁ • e 0) 0
          rw [hcoord, hxs0, zero_add]; exact ht₁.1
      have hOsub : O ⊆ Function.support (fun x => -(σ * partialDeriv 0 K x)) ∩
          {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} := by
        intro x hx
        rw [hO] at hx
        obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩ := hx
        refine ⟨?_, h3⟩
        show -(σ * partialDeriv 0 K x) ≠ 0
        rw [hK0 x]
        have h4 := hσψpos (pr x) h2
        have h1' : deriv lam (x 0) < 0 := h1
        have : -(σ * (deriv lam (x 0) * (V 0 (pr x) * β (pr x)))) =
            (-deriv lam (x 0)) * (σ * (V 0 (pr x) * β (pr x))) := by ring
        rw [this]
        exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos (by linarith) h4)
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hOo.measure_pos volume hOne) (measure_mono hOsub)
    linarith
  
  have heq := hS4 (fun a y => ∑ b : Fin 3, A y a b * partialDeriv b v' y) hV
    (fun ζ h1 h2 h3 => hB ζ h1 h2 (subset_trans h3 Set.inter_subset_left))
  have hcon := hS6 (fun a y => ∑ b : Fin 3, A y a b * partialDeriv b v' y) hV hB heq
  exact ⟨fun x hx hx0 => heq x hx hx0, fun x hx hx0 => hcon x hx hx0⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    volume (u '' {p | p ∈ K ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p = 0}) = 0

signature.name: stern_crit_values_null
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    volume (u '' {p | p ∈ K ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p = 0}) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, -, htK⟩ := hK.elim_nhds_subcover (fun x => (chartAt E3 x).source)
    (fun x _ => chart_source_mem_nhds E3 x)
  have hpiece : ∀ x : M, volume ((fun z => u ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) ''
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 x).target ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 x).symm z)) y = 0}) = 0 := by
    intro x
    exact morse_sard_E3 _ _ (chartAt E3 x).open_target
      (contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := x))))
  refine measure_mono_null ?_
    ((measure_biUnion_null_iff t.countable_toSet).mpr (fun x _ => hpiece x))
  rintro v ⟨p, ⟨hpK, hp0⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hxt, hpx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (htK hpK)
  have hy : chartAt E3 x p ∈ (chartAt E3 x).target := (chartAt E3 x).map_source hpx
  have hinv : (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x p) = p := (chartAt E3 x).left_inv hpx
  refine Set.mem_biUnion (x := x) (Finset.mem_coe.mpr hxt) ⟨chartAt E3 x p, ⟨hy, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · have hsymm : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x p) :=
      mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 x) hy
    have hu' : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u
        ((chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x p)) := hu.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have h0 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x p)) = 0 := by
      rw [hinv]; exact hp0
    have hcomp := mfderiv_comp (chartAt E3 x p) hu' hsymm
    rw [← mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
    show mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (u ∘ (chartAt E3 x).symm) (chartAt E3 x p) = 0
    rw [hcomp, h0]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp _
  · show u ((chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x p)) = u p
    rw [hinv]

subgoal_signatures.name: morse_sard_E3
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(f : E3 → ℝ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V) :
    MeasureTheory.volume (f '' {y | y ∈ V ∧ fderiv ℝ f y = 0}) = 0

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (β u : M → ℝ) (hβc : Continuous β) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hharm : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → g.lapM u p = 0) (q : M) (Kc : Set E3) (hKc : IsCompact Kc)
    (hKT : Kc ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Kc, 0 < β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      -(C₀ * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) ≤
        g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)

signature.name: stern_bad_bulk_pointwise
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (β u : M → ℝ) (hβc : Continuous β) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hharm : ∀ p : M, 0 ≤ β p → g.lapM u p = 0) (q : M) (Kc : Set E3) (hKc : IsCompact Kc)
    (hKT : Kc ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) :
    ∃ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Kc, 0 < β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      -(C₀ * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) ≤
        g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  rcases Kc.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hE | hne
  · exact ⟨0, le_rfl, fun y hy => by simp [hE] at hy⟩
  
  have hT : IsOpen (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).open_target
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j)
      (chartAt E3 q).target := fun i j => g.smooth q i j
  have hpdT : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef :=
    fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q y hy
  have hsym : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y j i :=
    fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  obtain ⟨hfs, hgrad, -⟩ := chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu q
  obtain ⟨hpart, hinv, hchr, -, -⟩ := ejp_coord_smooth (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
    (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target hT hGs hpdT hfs
  
  have hlapchart : ∀ (w : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w →
      ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, g.lapM w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) =
        lapLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
    intro w hw y hy
    rw [nli_chart_lapM_eq g q w hw y hy]
    simp only [lapLoc, hessLoc, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have hcongr : ∀ (F₁ F₂ : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), F₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] F₂ →
      lapLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) F₁ y = lapLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) F₂ y := by
    intro F₁ F₂ y h
    have h1 : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k F₁ y = partialDeriv k F₂ y := by
      intro k

subgoal_signatures.name: nli_chart_lapM_eq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)

      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *

      + ∑ l : Fin 3, (-(∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          christoffel (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) l i j y)) *
          partialDeriv l (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ V, (G y).PosDef)
    (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V) (hharm : ∀ y ∈ V, lapLoc G f y = 0)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ y ∈ V, ricGradLoc G f y ≤ sternPhiLoc G f ε y * lapLoc G (sternPhiLoc G f ε) y ∧
      (0 < gradSqLoc G f y →
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * hessSqLoc G f y +
            (1 / 2 : ℝ) * gradSqLoc G f y * (scalarCurvatureLocal G y - 2 * levelGaussLoc G f y)
          ≤ sternPhiLoc G f ε y * lapLoc G (sternPhiLoc G f ε) y)

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (β u : M → ℝ) (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β)
    (hβr : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0) (q : M) (Kc : Set E3)
    (hKc : IsCompact Kc) (hKT : Kc ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) :
    ∃ C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∃ s₇ : ℝ, 0 < s₇ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Kc,
      0 < β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) → β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) < s₇ →
      -(C₁ * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) + τ) ≤
        g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)

signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (β u : M → ℝ) (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β)
    (hβr : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0) (q : M) (Kc : Set E3)
    (hKc : IsCompact Kc) (hKT : Kc ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target) :
    ∃ C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 < τ → ∃ s₇ : ℝ, 0 < s₇ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Kc,
      0 < β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) → β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) < s₇ →
      -(C₁ * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) + τ) ≤
        g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hT : IsOpen (chartAt E3 q).target := (chartAt E3 q).open_target
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j)
      (chartAt E3 q).target := fun i j => g.smooth q i j
  have hpdT : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef :=
    fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q y hy
  have hsym : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y j i :=
    fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  obtain ⟨hfs, hgrad, -⟩ := chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu q
  obtain ⟨hbs, -, -⟩ := chart_pullback_gradInner g β hβ q
  obtain ⟨-, hinv, -, -, -⟩ := ejp_coord_smooth (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
    (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target hT hGs hpdT hfs
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hhess, -⟩ := ejp_coord_smooth (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
    (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target hT hGs hpdT hbs
  
  have hinvsym : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j = (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ j i := by
    intro y i j
    have hT' : Matrix.transpose (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y) =
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y := by
      ext a b
      exact hsym y b a
    have h := Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)
    rw [hT'] at h
    have h2 := congrFun (congrFun h j) i
    rw [Matrix.transpose_apply] at h2
    exact h2
  
  have hmix : ∀ (w₁ w₂ : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w₁ →
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w₂ → ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target,
        g.gradInner w₁ w₂ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) =
          gradInnerLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => w₁ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
            (fun z => w₂ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
    obtain ⟨P, hPs, hPeq⟩ := partialDiffeomorph_of_injOn q (chartAt E3 q).target hT id
      contDiffOn_id (Set.injOn_id _) (fun z hz => hz)
      (fun z _ => by rw [fderiv_id]; exact fun a b h => by simpa using h)
    intro w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ y hy
    have hTy : (chartAt E3 q).target ∈ 𝓝 y := hT.mem_nhds hy
    have hyP : y ∈ P.source := by rw [hPs]; exact hy
    have hPy : P y = (chartAt E3 q).symm y := by simp only [hPeq y hy, id_eq]
    have hev : (P : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (chartAt E3 q).symm :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hTy (fun z hz => by simp only [hPeq z hz, id_eq])
    have hev₁ : (fun z => w₁ (P z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => w₁ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hTy (fun z hz => by simp only [hPeq z hz, id_eq])
    have hev₂ : (fun z => w₂ (P z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => w₂ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hTy (fun z hz => by simp only [hPeq z hz, id_eq])
    have hcoeff : g.coeff P y = g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y := by
      unfold RiemannianMetric3.coeff coeffMatrix
      rw [hPy, hev.mfderiv_eq]
    have hpd₁ : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => w₁ (P z)) y =
        partialDeriv i (fun z => w₁ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev₁]
    have hpd₂ : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => w₂ (P z)) y =
        partialDeriv i (fun z => w₂ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev₂]
    have hform := gradInner_pdiffeo_formula g P w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ y hyP
    rw [hPy] at hform
    rw [hform]
    simp only [gradInnerLoc, hcoeff, hpd₁, hpd₂]
  
  have hbdry : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = 0 →
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) =
        -(hessGGLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
            (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) /
          sternPhiM g u ε ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) := by
    intro y hy hby ε hε
    have hneuV : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) = 0 →
        gradInnerLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
          (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) z = 0 := by
      intro z hz hbz
      rw [← hmix u β hu hβ z hz]
      exact hneu _ hbz
    have hdb : 0 < gradSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y :=
      chart_Nsq_pos g β hβ q y hy (hβr _ hby)
    have hN := stern_neumann_local (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target hT hGs
      hsym hpdT (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
      hfs hbs hneuV y hy hby hdb ε hε
    obtain ⟨hφs, -, -, -⟩ := stern_phi_chart_reps g u hu ε hε q
    have hev : (fun z => sternPhiM g u ε ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        sternPhiLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ε := by
      filter_upwards [hT.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact congrArg (fun t => Real.sqrt (t + ε)) (hgrad z hz)
    have hpdΦ : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun z => sternPhiM g u ε ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
          partialDeriv i (sternPhiLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
            (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ε) y := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hval : sternPhiM g u ε ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) =
        sternPhiLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ε y :=
      hev.eq_of_nhds
    have h1 := hmix β (sternPhiM g u ε) hβ hφs y hy
    have h2 : gradInnerLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
        (fun z => sternPhiM g u ε ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
        gradInnerLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
          (sternPhiLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ε)
          (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      unfold gradInnerLoc
      simp only [hpdΦ]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
      rw [hinvsym y j i]
      ring
    have h3 : gradInnerLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (sternPhiLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ε)
        (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
        -(hessGGLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
            (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y /
          sternPhiLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ε y) := by
      linarith [hN]
    rw [h1, h2, hval, h3]
    ring
  
  rcases Kc.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hE | hne
  · exact ⟨0, le_rfl, fun ε _ τ _ => ⟨1, one_pos, fun y hy => by simp [hE] at hy⟩⟩
  
  have hsingle : ∀ (F : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ), (∀ a b, 0 ≤ F a b) → ∀ i j,
      F i j ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, F a b := by
    intro F hF i j
    calc F i j ≤ ∑ b : Fin 3, F i b :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun b => F i b) (fun b _ => hF i b) (Finset.mem_univ j)
      _ ≤ ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, F a b :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a => ∑ b : Fin 3, F a b)
            (fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => hF a b)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hSc : ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (|(g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j| +
        |hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) i j y|))
      Kc := by
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_))
    exact (((hinv i j).continuousOn.mono hKT).abs).add (((hhess i j).continuousOn.mono hKT).abs)
  obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hSc
  obtain ⟨cb, hcb0, hent⟩ : ∃ cb : ℝ, 0 ≤ cb ∧ ∀ y ∈ Kc, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |(g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j| ≤ cb ∧
        |hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) i j y| ≤
          cb := by
    refine ⟨max h₀ 0, le_max_right _ _, fun y hy i j => ?_⟩
    have hS := hh₀ y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hS
    have hle : |(g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j| +
        |hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) i j y| ≤
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (|(g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ a b| +
          |hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) a b y|) :=
      hsingle (fun a b => |(g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ a b| +
        |hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) a b y|)
        (fun a b => add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) i j
    have hm := le_max_left h₀ 0
    have hab := le_abs_self (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (|(g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ a b| +
        |hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) a b y|))
    have hx1 := abs_nonneg ((g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j)
    have hx2 := abs_nonneg
      (hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) i j y)
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hsph : (Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1).Nonempty :=
    NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.mpr zero_le_one
  have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun p : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm p.1)⁻¹ i j * p.2 i * p.2 j)
      (Kc ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1) := by
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_))
    refine ContinuousOn.mul (ContinuousOn.mul ?_ ?_) ?_
    · exact ((hinv i j).continuousOn.mono hKT).comp continuousOn_fst (fun p hp => hp.1)
    · exact ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
    · exact ((continuous_apply j).comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hmin⟩ := (hKc.prod (isCompact_sphere (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1)).exists_isMinOn
    (hne.prod hsph) hFc
  obtain ⟨μ, hμdef⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ, μ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm p₀.1)⁻¹ i j * p₀.2 i * p₀.2 j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hμ : 0 < μ := by
    rw [hμdef]
    have hv0 : p₀.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have h1 := hp₀.2
      rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, h0, norm_zero] at h1
      exact zero_ne_one h1
    have h0 := (hpdT _ (hKT hp₀.1)).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum] at h0
    refine lt_of_lt_of_eq h0 ?_
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
    ring
  have hcoer : ∀ y ∈ Kc, ∀ (d : Fin 3 → ℝ) (k : Fin 3),
      μ * d k ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j * d i * d j := by
    intro y hy d k
    by_cases hd : d = 0
    · subst hd
      simp
    have hn : ‖d‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hd
    have hv : ‖d‖⁻¹ • d ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : Fin 3 → ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn]
    have hm : μ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
        (‖d‖⁻¹ • d) i * (‖d‖⁻¹ • d) j := by
      rw [hμdef]
      exact isMinOn_iff.mp hmin (y, ‖d‖⁻¹ • d) ⟨hy, hv⟩
    have hscale : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
        (‖d‖⁻¹ • d) i * (‖d‖⁻¹ • d) j) = (‖d‖⁻¹) ^ 2 *
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j * d i * d j := by
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_))
      ring
    rw [hscale] at hm
    have hdk : d k ^ 2 ≤ ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h1 := norm_le_pi_norm d k
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      calc d k ^ 2 = |d k| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖d‖ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h1 2
    calc μ * d k ^ 2 ≤ μ * ‖d‖ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdk hμ.le
      _ ≤ ((‖d‖⁻¹) ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j * d i * d j) * ‖d‖ ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm (sq_nonneg _)
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j * d i * d j := by
          field_simp
  
  have hwb : ∀ (a0 a1 a2 x0 x1 x2 c : ℝ), |a0| ≤ c → |a1| ≤ c → |a2| ≤ c →
      |a0 * x0 + a1 * x1 + a2 * x2| ≤ c * (|x0| + |x1| + |x2|) := by
    intro a0 a1 a2 x0 x1 x2 c h0 h1 h2
    have e0 : |a0 * x0| ≤ c * |x0| := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h0 (abs_nonneg _)
    have e1 : |a1 * x1| ≤ c * |x1| := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (abs_nonneg _)
    have e2 : |a2 * x2| ≤ c * |x2| := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (abs_nonneg _)
    have t1 := abs_add_le (a0 * x0 + a1 * x1) (a2 * x2)
    have t2 := abs_add_le (a0 * x0) (a1 * x1)
    linarith
  have halg : ∀ (H R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (d : Fin 3 → ℝ) (c μ : ℝ), 0 < μ →
      (∀ i j, |H i j| ≤ c) → (∀ i j, |R i j| ≤ c) →
      (∀ k, μ * d k ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H i j * d i * d j) →
      -(81 * c ^ 3 / μ * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H i j * d i * d j) ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (∑ a : Fin 3, H i a * d a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, H j b * d b) * R i j := by
    intro H R d c μ hμ hH hR hq
    have hc : 0 ≤ c := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hH 0 0)
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ |d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2| := by positivity
    have hcS : 0 ≤ c * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|) := mul_nonneg hc hS0
    have hw : ∀ i, |∑ a : Fin 3, H i a * d a| ≤ c * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|) := by
      intro i
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      exact hwb _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (hH i 0) (hH i 1) (hH i 2)
    have hterm : ∀ i j, -(c ^ 3 * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|) ^ 2) ≤
        (∑ a : Fin 3, H i a * d a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, H j b * d b) * R i j := by
      intro i j
      have hbd : |(∑ a : Fin 3, H i a * d a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, H j b * d b) * R i j| ≤
          c ^ 3 * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|) ^ 2 := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        calc |∑ a : Fin 3, H i a * d a| * |∑ b : Fin 3, H j b * d b| * |R i j|
            ≤ (c * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|)) * (c * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|)) * c :=
              mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (hw i) (hw j) (abs_nonneg _) hcS) (hR i j) (abs_nonneg _)
                (mul_nonneg hcS hcS)
          _ = c ^ 3 * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|) ^ 2 := by ring
      exact (abs_le.mp hbd).1
    have hsum : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (-(c ^ 3 * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|) ^ 2)) ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (∑ a : Fin 3, H i a * d a) * (∑ b : Fin 3, H j b * d b) * R i j :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hterm i j))
    have hconst : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (-(c ^ 3 * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|) ^ 2)) =
        -(9 * (c ^ 3 * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|) ^ 2)) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hS2 : (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|) ^ 2 ≤ 3 * (d 0 ^ 2 + d 1 ^ 2 + d 2 ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|d 0| - |d 1|), sq_nonneg (|d 1| - |d 2|), sq_nonneg (|d 0| - |d 2|),
        sq_abs (d 0), sq_abs (d 1), sq_abs (d 2)]
    generalize hQ : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H i j * d i * d j) = Q at hq ⊢
    have hq0 := hq 0
    have hq1 := hq 1
    have hq2 := hq 2
    have hmu : μ * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|) ^ 2 ≤ 9 * Q := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS2 hμ.le]
    have hfin : 9 * (c ^ 3 * (|d 0| + |d 1| + |d 2|) ^ 2) ≤ 81 * c ^ 3 / μ * Q := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hμ]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmu (pow_nonneg hc 3)]
    linarith
  
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ 81 * cb ^ 3 / μ :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (pow_nonneg hcb0 3)) hμ.le
  have hupper : ∀ y ∈ Kc,
      hessGGLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
          (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y ≤
        81 * cb ^ 3 / μ *
          gradSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
    intro y hy
    have hA : -(81 * cb ^ 3 / μ *
          gradSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          gradUpLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i *
            gradUpLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y j *
              -hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
                i j y :=
      halg (fun i j => (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i j)
        (fun i j => -hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
          i j y)
        (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) cb μ hμ
        (fun i j => (hent y hy i j).1)
        (fun i j => by rw [abs_neg]; exact (hent y hy i j).2)
        (fun k => hcoer y hy (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) k)
    have heq : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          gradUpLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y i *
            gradUpLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y j *
              -hessLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
                i j y =
        -hessGGLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z))
          (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
      simp only [hessGGLoc, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    linarith
  have hQ0 : ∀ y ∈ Kc,
      0 ≤ gradSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : μ * (partialDeriv 0 (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) ^ 2 ≤
        gradSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y :=
      hcoer y hy (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) 0
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (partialDeriv 0 (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y)]
  
  have hkey : ∀ (Q X C ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ Q → 0 ≤ C → 0 < ε → X ≤ C * Q →
      0 ≤ -X / Real.sqrt (Q + ε) + C * Real.sqrt Q := by
    intro Q X C ε hQ hC hε hX
    have hP : 0 < Real.sqrt (Q + ε) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
    have hs := Real.sqrt_nonneg Q
    have hsP : Real.sqrt Q ≤ Real.sqrt (Q + ε) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hsq : Real.sqrt Q * Real.sqrt Q = Q := Real.mul_self_sqrt hQ
    have h1 : X ≤ C * Real.sqrt Q * Real.sqrt (Q + ε) := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsP (mul_nonneg hC hs)
      nlinarith
    have h2 : X / Real.sqrt (Q + ε) ≤ C * Real.sqrt Q := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hP]
      linarith
    rw [neg_div]
    linarith
  
  refine ⟨81 * cb ^ 3 / μ, hC0, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε τ hτ
  obtain ⟨hφs, -, -, -⟩ := stern_phi_chart_reps g u hu ε hε q
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : E3 → ℝ, H = fun y =>
      g.gradInner β (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) +
        81 * cb ^ 3 / μ * Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hHc : ContinuousOn H Kc := by
    rw [hH]
    refine ContinuousOn.add ?_ ?_
    · exact (stern_gradInner_chart g β (sternPhiM g u ε) Set.univ isOpen_univ hβ
        hφs.contMDiffOn q).mono (fun y hy => ⟨hKT hy, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    · refine continuousOn_const.mul ?_
      exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn
        ((stern_gradInner_chart g u u Set.univ isOpen_univ hu hu.contMDiffOn q).mono
          (fun y hy => ⟨hKT hy, Set.mem_univ _⟩))
  have hbc : ContinuousOn (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) Kc :=
    (hβ.continuous.comp_continuousOn (chartAt E3 q).continuousOn_symm).mono hKT
  have h0 : ∀ y ∈ Kc, β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = 0 → 0 ≤ H y := by
    intro y hy hby
    have hyT := hKT hy
    have hid := hbdry y hyT hby ε hε
    have hQ : g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) =
        gradSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y :=
      hgrad y hyT
    have hΦ : sternPhiM g u ε ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) =
        Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
          (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y + ε) := by
      unfold sternPhiM
      rw [hQ]
    simp only [hH]
    rw [hid, hΦ, hQ]
    exact hkey _ _ _ _ (hQ0 y hy) hC0 hε (hupper y hy)
  obtain ⟨s₇, hs₇, hext⟩ : ∃ s₇ : ℝ, 0 < s₇ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Kc, 0 < β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) →
      β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) < s₇ → -τ ≤ H y := by
    have hK'c : IsCompact (Kc ∩ H ⁻¹' Set.Iic (-τ)) :=
      hKc.of_isClosed_subset (hHc.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hKc.isClosed isClosed_Iic)
        Set.inter_subset_left
    rcases (Kc ∩ H ⁻¹' Set.Iic (-τ)).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hE' | hne'
    · refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun y hy _ _ => ?_⟩
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have hmem : y ∈ Kc ∩ H ⁻¹' Set.Iic (-τ) := ⟨hy, le_of_lt hcon⟩
      rw [hE'] at hmem
      exact hmem
    · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hmin'⟩ := hK'c.exists_isMinOn hne' (hbc.abs.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
      refine ⟨|β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y₀)|, ?_, fun y hy hb0 hbs' => ?_⟩
      · rcases (abs_nonneg (β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y₀))).lt_or_eq with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          have hb0 : β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y₀) = 0 := abs_eq_zero.mp h.symm
          have h1 := h0 y₀ hy₀.1 hb0
          have h2 : H y₀ ≤ -τ := hy₀.2
          linarith
      · by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        have hmem : y ∈ Kc ∩ H ⁻¹' Set.Iic (-τ) := ⟨hy, le_of_lt hcon⟩
        have h1 : |β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y₀)| ≤ |β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)| :=
          isMinOn_iff.mp hmin' y hmem
        rw [abs_of_pos hb0] at h1
        linarith
  refine ⟨s₇, hs₇, fun y hy hb0 hbs' => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hext y hy hb0 hbs'
  simp only [hH] at h1
  linarith

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_phi_chart_reps
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (q : M) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (sternPhiM g u ε) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun y => g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
    IsOpen {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0} ∧
    ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x))
      {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0}

(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V)
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ V, (G y).PosDef)
    (f b : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b V)
    (hneuV : ∀ z ∈ V, b z = 0 → gradInnerLoc G f b z = 0)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ V) (hby : b y = 0) (hdb : 0 < gradSqLoc G b y)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    -(gradInnerLoc G (sternPhiLoc G f ε) b y) = hessGGLoc G b f y / sternPhiLoc G f ε y

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_pdiffeo_formula
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ κ.source) :
    g.gradInner u w (κ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => u (κ z)) x *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => w (κ z)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: partialDiffeomorph_of_injOn

    (hφt : ∀ y ∈ Ω, φ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target)
    (hder : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ φ y)) :
    ∃ Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      Φ.source = Ω ∧ ∀ y ∈ Ω, Φ y = (chartAt E3 z).symm (φ y)

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (β u : M → ℝ) (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β)
    (hβr : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0) (q : M) (y : E3)
    (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target) (hpos : 0 < g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y ≠ 0 ∧
      (β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = 0 → ∀ a c : ℝ,
        a • fderiv ℝ (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y +
          c • fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y = 0 → a = 0 ∧ c = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hexp : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
    intro v
    ext k
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  set ch := chartAt E3 q with hch
  set x := ch.symm y with hx
  set ch' := chartAt E3 x with hch'
  set y' := ch' x with hy'
  have hxs : x ∈ ch.source := ch.map_target hy
  have hy'T : y' ∈ ch'.target := mem_chart_target E3 x
  have hback : ch'.symm y' = x := ch'.left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 x)
  have hA : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ch'.symm y' :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 x) hy'T
  have hB : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ch (ch'.symm y') := by
    rw [hback]; exact mdifferentiableAt_atlas (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (chart_mem_atlas E3 q) hxs
  have hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ch (ch'.symm z)) y' :=
    mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.mp (hB.comp y' hA)
  have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y', ch.symm (ch (ch'.symm z)) = ch'.symm z := by
    have hO := ch'.isOpen_inter_preimage_symm ch.open_source
    exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO.mem_nhds ⟨hy'T, (show ch'.symm y' ∈ ch.source by rw [hback]; exact hxs)⟩)
      (fun z hz => ch.left_inv hz.2)
  have hTy : ch (ch'.symm y') = y := by rw [hback]; exact ch.right_inv hy
  have chain : ∀ f : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f →
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => f (ch'.symm z)) y' =
        (fderiv ℝ (fun z => f (ch.symm z)) y).comp (fderiv ℝ (fun z => ch (ch'.symm z)) y') := by
    intro f hf
    have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f (ch.symm z)) ch.target :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hf.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => f (ch.symm z)) (ch (ch'.symm y')) := by
      rw [hTy]
      exact (hc.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (ch.open_target.mem_nhds hy)
    have hU : (fun z => f (ch'.symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y']
        ((fun z => f (ch.symm z)) ∘ (fun z => ch (ch'.symm z))) := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [hz]
    rw [hU.fderiv_eq, fderiv_comp y' hd hτ, hTy]
  have hgi : ∀ w : M → ℝ, g.gradInner u w x = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff ch'.symm y')⁻¹ i j * fderiv ℝ (fun z => u (ch'.symm z)) y' (e i) *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => w (ch'.symm z)) y' (e j) := fun w => rfl
  have hmf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β x = fderiv ℝ (fun z => β (ch'.symm z)) y' := by
    have hh : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β x := hβ.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    rw [hh.mfderiv]
    simp [writtenInExtChartAt, Function.comp_def]
    rfl
  have hAc : fderiv ℝ (fun z => u (ch.symm z)) y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => u (ch'.symm z)) y' = 0 := by
      rw [chain u hu, h0]; simp
    have h2 := hgi u
    rw [h1] at h2
    simp at h2
    linarith
  refine ⟨hAc, fun hβ0 a c hrel => ?_⟩
  have hrel' : a • fderiv ℝ (fun z => β (ch'.symm z)) y' +
      c • fderiv ℝ (fun z => u (ch'.symm z)) y' = 0 := by
    rw [chain β hβ, chain u hu, ← ContinuousLinearMap.smul_comp,
      ← ContinuousLinearMap.smul_comp, ← ContinuousLinearMap.add_comp, hrel]
    simp
  have hcomp : ∀ i : Fin 3, a * fderiv ℝ (fun z => β (ch'.symm z)) y' (e i) +
      c * fderiv ℝ (fun z => u (ch'.symm z)) y' (e i) = 0 := by
    intro i
    have := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e i)) hrel'
    simpa using this
  have alg : ∀ (B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P Q : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B i j * P i * Q j = 0) →
      (0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B i j * P i * P j) →
      (∀ i, a * Q i + c * P i = 0) → c = 0 := by
    intro B P Q hT hS hc
    have e1 : c * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B i j * P i * P j) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B i j * P i * (a * Q j + c * P j) -
          a * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B i j * P i * Q j := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have e2 : c * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B i j * P i * P j) = 0 := by
      rw [e1, hT]; simp [hc]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp e2 with h | h
    · exact h
    · linarith
  have hc0 : c = 0 := by
    have hT := hgi β
    rw [hneu x hβ0] at hT
    have hS := hgi u
    rw [hS] at hpos
    exact alg _ (fun i => fderiv ℝ (fun z => u (ch'.symm z)) y' (e i))
      (fun i => fderiv ℝ (fun z => β (ch'.symm z)) y' (e i)) hT.symm hpos hcomp
  refine ⟨?_, hc0⟩
  by_contra ha
  have hV0 : ∀ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun z => β (ch'.symm z)) y' (e i) = 0 := by
    intro i
    have h := hcomp i
    rw [hc0, zero_mul, add_zero] at h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left ha
  have hVz : fderiv ℝ (fun z => β (ch'.symm z)) y' = 0 := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
    conv_lhs => rw [hexp v]
    simp [map_sum, map_smul, hV0]
  exact hβr x hβ0 (by rw [hmf]; exact hVz)

informal_problem.statement:
(K O : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hKO : K ⊆ O) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O) (nw : E3 → ℝ)
    (hnw : ContinuousOn nw K) (hreg : ∀ y ∈ K, 0 < nw y → fderiv ℝ f y ≠ 0)
    (η₀ : ℝ) (hη₀ : 0 < η₀) :
    ∃ Ca : ℝ, 0 ≤ Ca ∧ ∀ U : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet U → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r →
      volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r →
      volume (K ∩ f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | η₀ ≤ nw y}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Ca * r)

signature.statement:
(K O : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hKO : K ⊆ O) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O) (nw : E3 → ℝ)
    (hnw : ContinuousOn nw K) (hreg : ∀ y ∈ K, 0 < nw y → fderiv ℝ f y ≠ 0)
    (η₀ : ℝ) (hη₀ : 0 < η₀) :
    ∃ Ca : ℝ, 0 ≤ Ca ∧ ∀ U : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet U → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r →
      volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r →
      volume (K ∩ f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | η₀ ≤ nw y}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Ca * r)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hD : ∀ (ψ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 + ψ.smulRight (e a)).det = 1 + ψ (e a) := by
    intro ψ a
    have hdet : (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 + ψ.smulRight (e a)).det =
        (LinearMap.toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis
          (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis
          ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 + ψ.smulRight (e a)) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)).det :=
      (LinearMap.det_toMatrix _ _).symm
    rw [hdet, Matrix.det_fin_three]
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    fin_cases a <;> simp [e]
  
  have hV : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (c : E3) (ρ : ℝ), 0 ≤ ρ → ∀ (U : Set ℝ), MeasurableSet U →
      ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r →
      volume {z : E3 | z a ∈ U ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ a → |z i - c i| < ρ} ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (4 * ρ ^ 2 * r) := by
    intro a c ρ hρ U hU r hr hUr
    set s : Fin 3 → Set ℝ := fun i => if i = a then U else Set.Ioo (c i - ρ) (c i + ρ) with hs
    have hsub : {z : E3 | z a ∈ U ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ a → |z i - c i| < ρ} ⊆
        (WithLp.ofLp) ⁻¹' (Set.univ.pi s) := by
      rintro z ⟨hza, hzi⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ_pi]
      intro i
      by_cases hi : i = a
      · subst hi; simp [hs, hza]
      · have := hzi i hi
        simp only [hs, if_neg hi, Set.mem_Ioo]
        constructor <;> linarith [(abs_lt.mp this).1, (abs_lt.mp this).2]
    have hsm : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (s i) := by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : i = a
      · simp [hs, hi, hU]
      · simp only [hs, if_neg hi]; exact measurableSet_Ioo
    have hvol : volume ((WithLp.ofLp : E3 → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) ⁻¹' (Set.univ.pi s)) =
        ∏ i, volume (s i) := by
      rw [(PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp (Fin 3)).measure_preimage
        (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hsm).nullMeasurableSet, volume_pi_pi]
    have hother : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase a, volume (s i) = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ρ) := by
      intro i hi
      have hia : i ≠ a := Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi
      simp only [hs, if_neg hia, Real.volume_Ioo]
      congr 1; ring
    have hprod : ∏ i, volume (s i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ρ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun i => volume (s i)) (Finset.mem_univ a),
        Finset.prod_congr rfl hother, Finset.prod_const,
        Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ a)]
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      have : s a = U := by simp [hs]
      rw [this]
      gcongr
    calc volume {z : E3 | z a ∈ U ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ a → |z i - c i| < ρ}
        ≤ volume ((WithLp.ofLp : E3 → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) ⁻¹' (Set.univ.pi s)) := measure_mono hsub
      _ = ∏ i, volume (s i) := hvol
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ρ) ^ 2 := hprod
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (4 * ρ ^ 2 * r) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by linarith), ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hr]
        congr 1; ring
  
  have hI : ∀ (B : Set E3), Convex ℝ B → ∀ (a : Fin 3),
      (∀ y ∈ B, HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f y) y) → (∀ y ∈ B, fderiv ℝ f y (e a) ≠ 0) →
      Set.InjOn (fun y => y + (f y - y a) • e a) B := by
    intro B hB a hfd hne y hy z hz hyz
    have hcoord : ∀ i, (y + (f y - y a) • e a) i = (z + (f z - z a) • e a) i := fun i => by
      simp only at hyz
      rw [hyz]
    have hi : ∀ i, i ≠ a → y i = z i := by
      intro i hia
      have := hcoord i
      simpa [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hia] using this
    have hfa : f y = f z := by
      have := hcoord a
      simpa [EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using this
    have hzy : z - y = (z a - y a) • e a := by
      ext i
      by_cases hia : i = a
      · subst hia; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      · simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hia, hi i hia]
    set γ : ℝ → E3 := fun s => y + s • (z - y) with hγ
    have hγB : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, γ s ∈ B := fun s hs => hB.add_smul_sub_mem hy hz hs
    have hderiv : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun s => f (γ s)) (fderiv ℝ f (γ s) (z - y)) s := by
      intro s hs
      have h1 : HasDerivAt γ (z - y) s :=
        (((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const (z - y)).const_add y).congr_deriv (one_smul ℝ _)
      exact (hfd _ (hγB s hs)).comp_hasDerivAt s h1
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc0⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_zero (f := fun s => f (γ s))
      (f' := fun s => fderiv ℝ f (γ s) (z - y)) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1)
      (fun s hs => (hderiv s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (by simp [hγ, hfa])
      (fun s hs => hderiv s (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hs))
    have hc0' : fderiv ℝ f (γ c) (z - y) = 0 := hc0
    rw [hzy, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hc0'
    have hne' := hne _ (hγB c (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hc))
    have hza : z a - y a = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hc0' with h | h
      · exact h
      · exact absurd h hne'
    have : z - y = 0 := by rw [hzy, hza, zero_smul]
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp this).symm
  
  have hlocal : ∀ y₀ ∈ O, fderiv ℝ f y₀ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ ρ C : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ U : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet U → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r →
        volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r →
        volume (Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ f ⁻¹' U) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r) := by
    intro y₀ hy₀ hd
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e a) ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      apply hd
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
      have hv : v = ∑ i, v i • e i := by
        ext j
        simp [Pi.single_apply]
      rw [hv, map_sum]
      simp [hcon]
    set lam := fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e a) with hlam
    have hj : 0 < |lam| / 2 := by
      have := abs_pos.mpr ha
      linarith
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e a)) O :=
      (hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hca : ContinuousAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e a)) y₀ :=
      hcont.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds hy₀)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδc⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hca (|lam| / 2) hj
    obtain ⟨ε', hε', hε'O⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hO y₀ hy₀
    set ρ := min δ ε' with hρ
    have hρpos : 0 < ρ := lt_min hδ hε'
    have hBO : Metric.ball y₀ ρ ⊆ O := fun y hy =>
      hε'O (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hy)
    have hbig : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ, |lam| / 2 < |fderiv ℝ f y (e a)| := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 := hδc (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hy) (min_le_left _ _))
      rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] at h1
      have h2 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub lam (fderiv ℝ f y (e a))
      linarith
    have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ, HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f y) y := by
      intro y hy
      exact ((hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        (hO.mem_nhds (hBO hy))).hasFDerivAt
    set F' : E3 → E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := fun y => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 +
        (fderiv ℝ f y - EuclideanSpace.proj a).smulRight (e a) with hF'
    have hFd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ ρ,
        HasFDerivAt (fun y => y + (f y - y a) • e a) (F' y) y := by
      intro y hy
      exact (hasFDerivAt_id y).add
        (((hdiff y hy).sub (EuclideanSpace.proj a).hasFDerivAt).smul_const (e a))
    have hpe : EuclideanSpace.proj a (e a) = 1 := by
      show (e a) a = 1
      simp
    have hdet : ∀ y, (F' y).det = fderiv ℝ f y (e a) := by
      intro y
      simp only [hF']
      rw [hD]
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, hpe]
      ring
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun y => y + (f y - y a) • e a) (Metric.ball y₀ ρ) :=
      hI _ (convex_ball y₀ ρ) a hdiff (fun y hy => by
        have := hbig y hy
        intro h0
        rw [h0, abs_zero] at this
        linarith)
    have hSmeas : ∀ U : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet U → MeasurableSet (Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ f ⁻¹' U) := by
      intro U hU
      have hm : Measurable ((Metric.ball y₀ ρ).piecewise f (fun _ => (0:ℝ))) :=
        ContinuousOn.measurable_piecewise (hf.continuousOn.mono hBO) continuousOn_const
          measurableSet_ball
      have : Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ f ⁻¹' U =
          Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ ((Metric.ball y₀ ρ).piecewise f (fun _ => (0:ℝ))) ⁻¹' U := by
        ext y
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨hy, hyU⟩
          exact ⟨hy, by simpa [Set.piecewise, hy] using hyU⟩
        · rintro ⟨hy, hyU⟩
          exact ⟨hy, by simpa [Set.piecewise, hy] using hyU⟩
      rw [this]
      exact measurableSet_ball.inter (hm hU)
    refine ⟨ρ, 4 * ρ ^ 2 / (|lam| / 2), hρpos, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro U hU r hr hUr
    have hS := hSmeas U hU
    have hcov := lintegral_abs_det_fderiv_eq_addHaar_image volume hS
      (fun y hy => (hFd y hy.1).hasFDerivWithinAt) (hinj.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
    have hlow : ENNReal.ofReal (|lam| / 2) * volume (Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ f ⁻¹' U) ≤
        ∫⁻ y in Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ f ⁻¹' U, ENNReal.ofReal |(F' y).det| := by
      rw [← setLIntegral_const]
      exact setLIntegral_mono' hS (fun y hy =>
        ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by rw [hdet]; exact (hbig y hy.1).le))
    have himg : (fun y => y + (f y - y a) • e a) '' (Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ f ⁻¹' U) ⊆
        {z : E3 | z a ∈ U ∧ ∀ i, i ≠ a → |z i - y₀ i| < ρ} := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, ⟨hyB, hyU⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
      · simpa [EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using hyU
      · have h1 : (y + (f y - y a) • e a) i = y i := by
          simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, hi]
        rw [h1]
        have h2 := PiLp.norm_apply_le (y - y₀) i
        have h3 : ‖y - y₀‖ < ρ := mem_ball_iff_norm.mp hyB
        have h4 : (y - y₀) i = y i - y₀ i := by simp
        rw [h4, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h2
        linarith
    have hslab := hV a y₀ ρ hρpos.le U hU r hr hUr
    have hchain : ENNReal.ofReal (|lam| / 2) * volume (Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ f ⁻¹' U) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (4 * ρ ^ 2 * r) :=
      hlow.trans (hcov.le.trans ((measure_mono himg).trans hslab))
    have hfin : volume (Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ f ⁻¹' U) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (4 * ρ ^ 2 * r) / ENNReal.ofReal (|lam| / 2) := by
      rw [ENNReal.le_div_iff_mul_le (Or.inl (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hj).ne')
        (Or.inl ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top), mul_comm]
      exact hchain
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos hj] at hfin
    refine hfin.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    congr 1
    ring
  
  have hK'c : IsCompact (K ∩ nw ⁻¹' Set.Ici η₀) :=
    hK.of_isClosed_subset (hnw.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hK.isClosed isClosed_Ici)
      Set.inter_subset_left
  have hloc : ∀ y ∈ K ∩ nw ⁻¹' Set.Ici η₀, ∃ ρ C : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ U : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet U → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r →
        volume (Metric.ball y ρ ∩ f ⁻¹' U) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r) := fun y hy =>
    hlocal y (hKO hy.1) (hreg y hy.1 (lt_of_lt_of_le hη₀ hy.2))
  
  choose! ρ C hρ hC hb using hloc
  obtain ⟨t, htK, hcover⟩ := hK'c.elim_nhds_subcover (fun y => Metric.ball y (ρ y))
    (fun y hy => Metric.ball_mem_nhds y (hρ y hy))
  refine ⟨∑ y ∈ t, C y, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun y hy => hC y (htK y hy)), ?_⟩
  intro U hU r hr hUr
  calc volume (K ∩ f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | η₀ ≤ nw y})
      ≤ volume (⋃ y ∈ t, (Metric.ball y (ρ y) ∩ f ⁻¹' U)) := by
        apply measure_mono
        rintro x ⟨⟨hxK, hxU⟩, hxn⟩
        have := hcover ⟨hxK, hxn⟩
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at this ⊢
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := this
        exact ⟨y, hy, hxy, hxU⟩
    _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ t, volume (Metric.ball y (ρ y) ∩ f ⁻¹' U) := measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ t, ENNReal.ofReal (C y * r) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun y hy => hb y (htK y hy) U hU r hr hUr)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ y ∈ t, C y * r) :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun y hy => mul_nonneg (hC y (htK y hy)) hr)).symm
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((∑ y ∈ t, C y) * r) := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(K O : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hKO : K ⊆ O) (f b : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b O)
    (nw : E3 → ℝ) (hnw : ContinuousOn nw K)
    (hind : ∀ y ∈ K, b y = 0 → 0 < nw y → ∀ a c : ℝ,
      a • fderiv ℝ b y + c • fderiv ℝ f y = 0 → a = 0 ∧ c = 0)
    (η₀ : ℝ) (hη₀ : 0 < η₀) :
    ∃ Cs s₆ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cs ∧ 0 < s₆ ∧ ∀ U : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet U → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r →
      volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₆ →
      volume (K ∩ f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | η₀ ≤ nw y} ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Cs * s * r)

signature.statement:
(K O : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hKO : K ⊆ O) (f b : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b O)
    (nw : E3 → ℝ) (hnw : ContinuousOn nw K)

    (η₀ : ℝ) (hη₀ : 0 < η₀) :

      volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₆ →

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hdet : ∀ (l m : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
      (l.smulRight (e 0) + m.smulRight (e 1) +
        (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 2)).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis
          (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis
          ((l.smulRight (e 0) + m.smulRight (e 1) +
            (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 2)) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)).det :=
    fun l m i => (LinearMap.det_toMatrix _ _).symm
  have hdet0 : ∀ l m : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      (l.smulRight (e 0) + m.smulRight (e 1) +
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 2)).det =
      l (e 1) * m (e 2) - l (e 2) * m (e 1) := by
    intro l m
    rw [hdet, Matrix.det_fin_three]
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    try ring
  have hdet1 : ∀ l m : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      (l.smulRight (e 0) + m.smulRight (e 1) +
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 2)).det =
      l (e 2) * m (e 0) - l (e 0) * m (e 2) := by
    intro l m
    rw [hdet, Matrix.det_fin_three]
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    try ring
  have hdet2 : ∀ l m : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      (l.smulRight (e 0) + m.smulRight (e 1) +
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 2)).det =
      l (e 0) * m (e 1) - l (e 1) * m (e 0) := by
    intro l m
    rw [hdet, Matrix.det_fin_three]
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    try ring
  
  have hext : ∀ φ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, φ (e 0) = 0 → φ (e 1) = 0 → φ (e 2) = 0 → φ = 0 := by
    intro φ h0 h1 h2
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    have hv : v = ∑ j, v j • e j := by
      ext j
      simp [Pi.single_apply]
    rw [hv, map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, h0, h1, h2]
    ring
  
  have hgood : ∀ l m : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ a c : ℝ, a • l + c • m = 0 → a = 0 ∧ c = 0) →
      ∃ i : Fin 3, (l.smulRight (e 0) + m.smulRight (e 1) +
        (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 2)).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro l m hlm
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have c0 := hcon 0
    have c1 := hcon 1
    have c2 := hcon 2
    rw [hdet0] at c0
    rw [hdet1] at c1
    rw [hdet2] at c2
    have hz : (-(l (e 0) * m (e 0) + l (e 1) * m (e 1) + l (e 2) * m (e 2))) • l +
        (l (e 0) ^ 2 + l (e 1) ^ 2 + l (e 2) ^ 2) • m = 0 := by
      apply hext
      · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        linear_combination (-(l (e 1))) * c2 + l (e 2) * c1
      · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        linear_combination l (e 0) * c2 - l (e 2) * c0
      · simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        linear_combination (-(l (e 0))) * c1 + l (e 1) * c0
    have hγ := (hlm _ _ hz).2
    have hp0 : l (e 0) = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (l (e 0)), sq_nonneg (l (e 1)), sq_nonneg (l (e 2))]
    have hp1 : l (e 1) = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (l (e 0)), sq_nonneg (l (e 1)), sq_nonneg (l (e 2))]
    have hp2 : l (e 2) = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (l (e 0)), sq_nonneg (l (e 1)), sq_nonneg (l (e 2))]
    have hl : l = 0 := hext l hp0 hp1 hp2
    have h10 := (hlm 1 0 (by rw [hl]; simp)).1
    exact one_ne_zero h10
  
  have hstrict : ∀ y₀ ∈ O, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      HasStrictFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => b y • e 0 + f y • e 1 + y i • e 2)
        ((fderiv ℝ b y₀).smulRight (e 0) + (fderiv ℝ f y₀).smulRight (e 1) +
          (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 2)) y₀ := by
    intro y₀ hy₀ i
    have hb' : HasStrictFDerivAt b (fderiv ℝ b y₀) y₀ :=
      (hb.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hy₀)).hasStrictFDerivAt (by simp)
    have hf' : HasStrictFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f y₀) y₀ :=
      (hf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hy₀)).hasStrictFDerivAt (by simp)
    have hp : HasStrictFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y i) (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y₀ :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasStrictFDerivAt
    exact ((hb'.smul_const (e 0)).add (hf'.smul_const (e 1))).add (hp.smul_const (e 2))
  
  have hexp : ∀ (F : E3 → E3) (A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (y₀ : E3), HasStrictFDerivAt F A y₀ →
      A.det ≠ 0 → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ S : Set E3, S ⊆ Metric.ball y₀ ρ →
        ENNReal.ofReal m * volume S ≤ volume (F '' S) := by
    intro F A y₀ hF hA
    have hd : 0 < |A.det| := abs_pos.mpr hA
    set m₀ : NNReal := (|A.det| / 2).toNNReal with hm₀
    have hlt : (m₀ : ENNReal) < ENNReal.ofReal |A.det| :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hd).mpr (by linarith)
    have hev := mul_le_addHaar_image_of_lt_det (volume : Measure E3) A hlt
    have hpos : ∀ᶠ δ : NNReal in 𝓝[>] 0, 0 < δ := self_mem_nhdsWithin
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδpos⟩ := (hev.and hpos).exists
    obtain ⟨t, ht, happrox⟩ := hF.approximates_deriv_on_nhds (Or.inr hδpos)
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρt⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp ht
    refine ⟨ρ, hρ, |A.det| / 2, by linarith, fun S hS => ?_⟩
    exact hδ S F (happrox.mono_set (hS.trans hρt))
  
  have hbox : ∀ (U : Set ℝ), MeasurableSet U → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r →
      ∀ s R : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ R →
      volume {z : E3 | z 0 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s ∧ z 1 ∈ U ∧ z 2 ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R} ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * R * s * r) := by
    intro U hU r hr hUr s R hs hR
    set T : Fin 3 → Set ℝ := ![Set.Ioo 0 s, U, Set.Icc (-R) R] with hT
    have hsub : {z : E3 | z 0 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s ∧ z 1 ∈ U ∧ z 2 ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R} ⊆
        (WithLp.ofLp : E3 → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) ⁻¹' (Set.univ.pi T) := by
      rintro z ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_univ_pi]
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h0
      · exact h1
      · exact h2
    have hTm : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (T i) := by
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact measurableSet_Ioo
      · exact hU
      · exact measurableSet_Icc
    have hvol : volume ((WithLp.ofLp : E3 → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) ⁻¹' (Set.univ.pi T)) =
        ∏ i, volume (T i) := by
      rw [(PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp (Fin 3)).measure_preimage
        (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hTm).nullMeasurableSet, volume_pi_pi]
    have hprod : ∏ i, volume (T i) =
        ENNReal.ofReal s * volume U * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * R) := by
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_three]
      show volume (Set.Ioo 0 s) * volume U * volume (Set.Icc (-R) R) = _
      rw [Real.volume_Ioo, Real.volume_Icc, sub_zero, show R - -R = 2 * R by ring]
    calc volume {z : E3 | z 0 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s ∧ z 1 ∈ U ∧ z 2 ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R}
        ≤ volume ((WithLp.ofLp : E3 → (Fin 3 → ℝ)) ⁻¹' (Set.univ.pi T)) := measure_mono hsub
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal s * volume U * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * R) := by rw [hvol, hprod]
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s * ENNReal.ofReal r * ENNReal.ofReal (2 * R) := by gcongr
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * R * s * r) := by
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hs, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg hs hr)]
        congr 1
        ring
  
  have hlocal : ∀ y₀ ∈ K, b y₀ = 0 → η₀ ≤ nw y₀ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ U : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet U → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r →
        ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
        volume (Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ (f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (C * s * r) := by
    intro y₀ hy₀K hb0 hnw0
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hgood _ _ (hind y₀ hy₀K hb0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hη₀ hnw0))
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, m, hm, hS⟩ := hexp _ _ y₀ (hstrict y₀ (hKO hy₀K) i) hi
    have hR : 0 ≤ ‖y₀‖ + ρ := add_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hρ.le
    refine ⟨ρ, hρ, 2 * (‖y₀‖ + ρ) / m,
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hR) hm.le, ?_⟩
    intro U hU r hr hUr s hs
    have himg : (fun y : E3 => b y • e 0 + f y • e 1 + y i • e 2) ''
        (Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ (f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) ⊆
        {z : E3 | z 0 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s ∧ z 1 ∈ U ∧
          z 2 ∈ Set.Icc (-(‖y₀‖ + ρ)) (‖y₀‖ + ρ)} := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, ⟨hyB, hyU, hyb⟩, rfl⟩
      have h0 : (b y • e 0 + f y • e 1 + y i • e 2) 0 = b y := by
        simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      have h1 : (b y • e 0 + f y • e 1 + y i • e 2) 1 = f y := by
        simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      have h2 : (b y • e 0 + f y • e 1 + y i • e 2) 2 = y i := by
        simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show (b y • e 0 + f y • e 1 + y i • e 2) 0 ∈ Set.Ioo 0 s
        rw [h0]; exact hyb
      · show (b y • e 0 + f y • e 1 + y i • e 2) 1 ∈ U
        rw [h1]; exact hyU
      · show (b y • e 0 + f y • e 1 + y i • e 2) 2 ∈ Set.Icc (-(‖y₀‖ + ρ)) (‖y₀‖ + ρ)
        rw [h2]
        have h3 := PiLp.norm_apply_le y i
        have h4 : ‖y - y₀‖ < ρ := mem_ball_iff_norm.mp hyB
        have h5 := norm_sub_norm_le y y₀
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h3
        exact abs_le.mp (by linarith)
    have hchain : ENNReal.ofReal m *
        volume (Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ (f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (‖y₀‖ + ρ) * s * r) :=
      (hS _ Set.inter_subset_left).trans ((measure_mono himg).trans
        (hbox U hU r hr hUr s _ hs.le hR))
    have hfin : volume (Metric.ball y₀ ρ ∩ (f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (‖y₀‖ + ρ) * s * r) / ENNReal.ofReal m := by
      rw [ENNReal.le_div_iff_mul_le (Or.inl (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr hm).ne')
        (Or.inl ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top), mul_comm]
      exact hchain
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos hm] at hfin
    refine hfin.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    congr 1
    ring
  
  have hK₁ : IsCompact (K ∩ nw ⁻¹' Set.Ici η₀) :=
    hK.of_isClosed_subset (hnw.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hK.isClosed isClosed_Ici)
      Set.inter_subset_left
  have hbK₁ : ContinuousOn b (K ∩ nw ⁻¹' Set.Ici η₀) :=
    hb.continuousOn.mono (fun y hy => hKO hy.1)
  have hK₀ : IsCompact (K ∩ nw ⁻¹' Set.Ici η₀ ∩ b ⁻¹' {0}) :=
    hK₁.of_isClosed_subset (hbK₁.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hK₁.isClosed isClosed_singleton)
      Set.inter_subset_left
  have hloc : ∀ y ∈ K ∩ nw ⁻¹' Set.Ici η₀ ∩ b ⁻¹' {0}, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ U : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet U → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → volume U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r →
        ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
        volume (Metric.ball y ρ ∩ (f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (C * s * r) :=
    fun y hy => hlocal y hy.1.1 hy.2 hy.1.2
  choose! ρ hρ C hC hbd using hloc
  obtain ⟨t, htK, hcover⟩ := hK₀.elim_nhds_subcover (fun y => Metric.ball y (ρ y))
    (fun y hy => Metric.ball_mem_nhds y (hρ y hy))
  have hWo : IsOpen (⋃ y ∈ t, Metric.ball y (ρ y)) :=
    isOpen_biUnion (fun y _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
  obtain ⟨s₆, hs₆, hthin⟩ : ∃ s₆ : ℝ, 0 < s₆ ∧ ∀ y ∈ K ∩ nw ⁻¹' Set.Ici η₀, 0 < b y →
      b y < s₆ → y ∈ ⋃ y ∈ t, Metric.ball y (ρ y) := by
    by_cases hne : ((K ∩ nw ⁻¹' Set.Ici η₀) \ ⋃ y ∈ t, Metric.ball y (ρ y)).Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨y', hy', hmin⟩ := (hK₁.diff hWo).exists_isMinOn hne
        (continuous_abs.comp_continuousOn (hbK₁.mono Set.diff_subset))
      have hb' : b y' ≠ 0 := fun h => hy'.2 (hcover ⟨hy'.1, h⟩)
      refine ⟨|b y'|, abs_pos.mpr hb', fun y hy hpos hlt => ?_⟩
      by_contra hyW
      have hle : |b y'| ≤ |b y| := isMinOn_iff.mp hmin y ⟨hy, hyW⟩
      rw [abs_of_pos hpos] at hle
      linarith
    · refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun y hy _ _ => ?_⟩
      by_contra hyW
      exact hne ⟨y, hy, hyW⟩
  refine ⟨∑ y ∈ t, C y, s₆, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun y hy => hC y (htK y hy)), hs₆, ?_⟩
  intro U hU r hr hUr s hs hss
  calc volume (K ∩ f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | η₀ ≤ nw y} ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})
      ≤ volume (⋃ y ∈ t, (Metric.ball y (ρ y) ∩ (f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}))) := by
        apply measure_mono
        rintro x ⟨⟨⟨hxK, hxU⟩, hxn⟩, hxb⟩
        have hxW := hthin x ⟨hxK, hxn⟩ hxb.1 (lt_trans hxb.2 hss)
        simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hxW ⊢
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hxW
        exact ⟨y, hy, hxy, hxU, hxb⟩
    _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ t, volume (Metric.ball y (ρ y) ∩ (f ⁻¹' U ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) :=
        measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ t, ENNReal.ofReal (C y * s * r) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun y hy => hbd y (htK y hy) U hU r hr hUr s hs)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ y ∈ t, C y * s * r) :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun y hy =>
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hC y (htK y hy)) hs.le) hr)).symm
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((∑ y ∈ t, C y) * s * r) := by rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(D DA Kc : Set E3) (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hDA : MeasurableSet DA)
    (hDAD : DA ⊆ D) (hKc : IsCompact Kc) (hKD : Kc ⊆ D)
    (fB fC nw b : E3 → ℝ) (hfB : ContinuousOn fB Kc) (hfC : ContinuousOn fC Kc)
    (hnw : ContinuousOn nw Kc) (hb : ContinuousOn b Kc)
    (hvan : ∀ y ∈ D \ Kc, fB y = 0 ∧ fC y = 0)
    (W C₀ C₁ Mη τ Cb Nm a₁ a₂ η₀ s : ℝ) (hW : 0 ≤ W) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (hMη : 0 ≤ Mη) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hCb : 0 ≤ Cb) (hNm : 0 ≤ Nm) (ha₁ : 0 ≤ a₁) (ha₂ : 0 ≤ a₂)
    (hη₀ : 0 ≤ η₀) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hn0 : ∀ y ∈ Kc, 0 ≤ nw y) (hnm : ∀ y ∈ Kc, nw y ≤ Nm)
    (hptB : ∀ y ∈ Kc, -(W * (C₀ * nw y)) ≤ fB y)
    (hptC : ∀ y ∈ Kc, -(W * (s⁻¹ * Mη * Set.indicator {z | 0 < b z ∧ b z < s}
      (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y * (C₁ * nw y + τ))) ≤ fC y)
    (h1 : volume ((D \ DA) ∩ Kc ∩ {y | η₀ ≤ nw y}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a₁)
    (h2 : volume ((D \ DA) ∩ Kc ∩ {y | η₀ ≤ nw y} ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (s * a₂))
    (h3 : volume (Kc ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Cb * s)) :
    -(W * (C₀ * (η₀ * (volume Kc).toReal + Nm * a₁) + Mη * C₁ * (η₀ * Cb + Nm * a₂) +
        Mη * τ * Cb)) ≤
      ((∫ y in D, fB y) + (∫ y in D, fC y)) - ((∫ y in DA, fB y) + (∫ y in DA, fC y))

signature.statement:
(D DA Kc : Set E3) (hD : MeasurableSet D) (hDA : MeasurableSet DA)
    (hDAD : DA ⊆ D) (hKc : IsCompact Kc) (hKD : Kc ⊆ D)
    (fB fC nw b : E3 → ℝ) (hfB : ContinuousOn fB Kc) (hfC : ContinuousOn fC Kc)
    (hnw : ContinuousOn nw Kc) (hb : ContinuousOn b Kc)
    (hvan : ∀ y ∈ D \ Kc, fB y = 0 ∧ fC y = 0)
    (W C₀ C₁ Mη τ Cb Nm a₁ a₂ η₀ s : ℝ) (hW : 0 ≤ W) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) (hC₁ : 0 ≤ C₁)
    (hMη : 0 ≤ Mη) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (hCb : 0 ≤ Cb) (hNm : 0 ≤ Nm) (ha₁ : 0 ≤ a₁) (ha₂ : 0 ≤ a₂)
    (hη₀ : 0 ≤ η₀) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hn0 : ∀ y ∈ Kc, 0 ≤ nw y) (hnm : ∀ y ∈ Kc, nw y ≤ Nm)
    (hptB : ∀ y ∈ Kc, -(W * (C₀ * nw y)) ≤ fB y)
    (hptC : ∀ y ∈ Kc, -(W * (s⁻¹ * Mη * Set.indicator {z | 0 < b z ∧ b z < s}
      (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) y * (C₁ * nw y + τ))) ≤ fC y)
    (h1 : volume ((D \ DA) ∩ Kc ∩ {y | η₀ ≤ nw y}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a₁)
    (h2 : volume ((D \ DA) ∩ Kc ∩ {y | η₀ ≤ nw y} ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (s * a₂))
    (h3 : volume (Kc ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Cb * s)) :
