      ((∫ y in D, fB y) + (∫ y in D, fC y)) - ((∫ y in DA, fB y) + (∫ y in DA, fC y))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hred : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f Kc → (∀ y ∈ D \ Kc, f y = 0) →
      (∫ y in D, f y) - (∫ y in DA, f y) = ∫ y in (D \ DA) ∩ Kc, f y := by
    intro f hf hv
    have hIK : IntegrableOn f Kc := hf.integrableOn_compact hKc
    have hID : IntegrableOn f D := hIK.of_forall_diff_eq_zero hD hv
    rw [← integral_diff hDA hID hDAD]
    refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (hD.diff hDA)
      Set.inter_subset_left ?_
    intro x hx
    exact hv x ⟨hx.1.1, fun hk => hx.2 ⟨hx.1, hk⟩⟩
  have eB := hred fB hfB (fun y hy => (hvan y hy).1)
  have eC := hred fC hfC (fun y hy => (hvan y hy).2)
  set S := (D \ DA) ∩ Kc with hSdef
  have hS : MeasurableSet S := (hD.diff hDA).inter hKc.measurableSet
  have hSK : S ⊆ Kc := Set.inter_subset_right
  have hSfin : volume S < ⊤ := lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono hSK) hKc.measure_lt_top
  have hSle : (volume S).toReal ≤ (volume Kc).toReal :=
    ENNReal.toReal_mono hKc.measure_lt_top.ne (measure_mono hSK)
  have hconst : ∀ c : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun _ : E3 => c) S volume :=
    fun c => integrableOn_const hSfin.ne
  have hreal : ∀ (A : Set E3) (c : ℝ), ∫ _ in A, c = (volume A).toReal * c := by
    intro A c
    rw [setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, Measure.real]
  
  set T := Kc ∩ nw ⁻¹' Set.Ici η₀ with hTdef
  have hTm : MeasurableSet T :=
    (hnw.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hKc.isClosed isClosed_Ici).measurableSet
  set Bd := Kc \ (Kc ∩ b ⁻¹' (Set.Ioo 0 s)ᶜ) with hBddef
  have hBdm : MeasurableSet Bd :=
    hKc.measurableSet.diff
      (hb.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hKc.isClosed isOpen_Ioo.isClosed_compl).measurableSet
  have hBdmem : ∀ y ∈ Kc, (y ∈ Bd ↔ (0 < b y ∧ b y < s)) := by
    intro y hy
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, h⟩
      by_contra hc
      exact h ⟨hy, hc⟩
    · intro h
      exact ⟨hy, fun h' => h'.2 h⟩
  have hIfB : IntegrableOn fB S volume := (hfB.integrableOn_compact hKc).mono_set hSK
  have hIfC : IntegrableOn fC S volume := (hfC.integrableOn_compact hKc).mono_set hSK
  
  have hk : 0 ≤ W * C₀ := mul_nonneg hW hC₀
  have hBulk : -(W * (C₀ * (η₀ * (volume Kc).toReal + Nm * a₁))) ≤ ∫ y in S, fB y := by
    have hmono : ∫ y in S, ((-(W * C₀ * η₀)) + T.indicator (fun _ => -(W * C₀ * Nm)) y) ≤
        ∫ y in S, fB y := by
      refine setIntegral_mono_on ((hconst _).add ((hconst _).indicator hTm)) hIfB hS ?_
      intro y hy
      have hyK := hSK hy
      have h0 := hptB y hyK
      have hnmy := hnm y hyK
      by_cases hyT : y ∈ T
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyT]
        have : W * C₀ * nw y ≤ W * C₀ * Nm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnmy hk
        have : 0 ≤ W * C₀ * η₀ := mul_nonneg hk hη₀
        have e : W * (C₀ * nw y) = W * C₀ * nw y := by ring
        linarith
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyT]
        have hlt : nw y < η₀ := by
          by_contra hc
          exact hyT ⟨hyK, le_of_not_gt hc⟩
        have : W * C₀ * nw y ≤ W * C₀ * η₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlt.le hk
        have e : W * (C₀ * nw y) = W * C₀ * nw y := by ring
        linarith
    rw [integral_add (hconst _) ((hconst _).indicator hTm), setIntegral_indicator hTm,
      hreal, hreal] at hmono
    have hST : (volume (S ∩ T)).toReal ≤ a₁ := by
      refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal ha₁ (le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h1)
      rintro y ⟨hyS, hyT⟩
      exact ⟨hyS, hyT.2⟩
    have i1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hSle (mul_nonneg hk hη₀)
    have i2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hST (mul_nonneg hk hNm)
    have e : W * (C₀ * (η₀ * (volume Kc).toReal + Nm * a₁)) =
        W * C₀ * η₀ * (volume Kc).toReal + W * C₀ * Nm * a₁ := by ring
    have e2 : (volume S).toReal * -(W * C₀ * η₀) + (volume (S ∩ T)).toReal * -(W * C₀ * Nm) =
        -(W * C₀ * η₀ * (volume S).toReal) - W * C₀ * Nm * (volume (S ∩ T)).toReal := by ring
    linarith
  
  set K := W * s⁻¹ * Mη with hKdef
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hW (inv_nonneg.2 hs.le)) hMη
  have hKC1 : 0 ≤ K * C₁ := mul_nonneg hK hC₁
  have hKs : K * s = W * Mη := by
    calc K * s = W * Mη * (s⁻¹ * s) := by rw [hKdef]; ring
      _ = W * Mη := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hs.ne', mul_one]
  have hCol : -(W * (Mη * C₁ * (η₀ * Cb + Nm * a₂) + Mη * τ * Cb)) ≤ ∫ y in S, fC y := by
    have hmono : ∫ y in S, (Bd.indicator (fun _ => -(K * (C₁ * η₀ + τ))) y +
        (T ∩ Bd).indicator (fun _ => -(K * C₁ * Nm)) y) ≤ ∫ y in S, fC y := by
      refine setIntegral_mono_on (((hconst _).indicator hBdm).add
        ((hconst _).indicator (hTm.inter hBdm))) hIfC hS ?_
      intro y hy
      have hyK := hSK hy
      have h0 := hptC y hyK
      have hnmy := hnm y hyK
      by_cases hband : 0 < b y ∧ b y < s
      · have hyB : y ∈ Bd := (hBdmem y hyK).2 hband
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show y ∈ {z | 0 < b z ∧ b z < s} from hband)] at h0
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hyB]
        have e : W * (s⁻¹ * Mη * 1 * (C₁ * nw y + τ)) = K * C₁ * nw y + K * τ := by
          rw [hKdef]; ring
        by_cases hyT : y ∈ T
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (show y ∈ T ∩ Bd from ⟨hyT, hyB⟩)]
          have : K * C₁ * nw y ≤ K * C₁ * Nm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnmy hKC1
          have : 0 ≤ K * C₁ * η₀ := mul_nonneg hKC1 hη₀
          have e2 : K * (C₁ * η₀ + τ) = K * C₁ * η₀ + K * τ := by ring
          linarith
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show y ∉ T ∩ Bd from fun h => hyT h.1)]
          have hlt : nw y < η₀ := by
            by_contra hc
            exact hyT ⟨hyK, le_of_not_gt hc⟩
          have : K * C₁ * nw y ≤ K * C₁ * η₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlt.le hKC1
          have e2 : K * (C₁ * η₀ + τ) = K * C₁ * η₀ + K * τ := by ring
          linarith
      · have hyB : y ∉ Bd := fun h => hband ((hBdmem y hyK).1 h)
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem (show y ∉ {z | 0 < b z ∧ b z < s} from hband)] at h0
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyB,
          Set.indicator_of_notMem (show y ∉ T ∩ Bd from fun h => hyB h.2)]
        have e : W * (s⁻¹ * Mη * 0 * (C₁ * nw y + τ)) = 0 := by ring
        linarith
    rw [integral_add ((hconst _).indicator hBdm) ((hconst _).indicator (hTm.inter hBdm)),
      setIntegral_indicator hBdm, setIntegral_indicator (hTm.inter hBdm),
      hreal, hreal] at hmono
    have hv1 : (volume (S ∩ Bd)).toReal ≤ Cb * s := by
      refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (mul_nonneg hCb hs.le)
        (le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h3)
      rintro y ⟨hyS, hyB⟩
      exact ⟨hSK hyS, (hBdmem y (hSK hyS)).1 hyB⟩
    have hv2 : (volume (S ∩ (T ∩ Bd))).toReal ≤ s * a₂ := by
      refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (mul_nonneg hs.le ha₂)
        (le_trans (measure_mono ?_) h2)
      rintro y ⟨hyS, hyT, hyB⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hyS, hyT.2⟩, (hBdmem y (hSK hyS)).1 hyB⟩
    have hP : 0 ≤ K * (C₁ * η₀ + τ) :=
      mul_nonneg hK (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC₁ hη₀) hτ)
    have hQ : 0 ≤ K * C₁ * Nm := mul_nonneg hKC1 hNm
    have i1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv1 hP
    have i2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv2 hQ
    have e1 : K * (C₁ * η₀ + τ) * (Cb * s) = W * Mη * (C₁ * η₀ + τ) * Cb := by
      rw [show K * (C₁ * η₀ + τ) * (Cb * s) = (K * s) * (C₁ * η₀ + τ) * Cb by ring, hKs]
    have e2 : K * C₁ * Nm * (s * a₂) = W * Mη * C₁ * Nm * a₂ := by
      rw [show K * C₁ * Nm * (s * a₂) = (K * s) * C₁ * Nm * a₂ by ring, hKs]
    have e3 : W * (Mη * C₁ * (η₀ * Cb + Nm * a₂) + Mη * τ * Cb) =
        W * Mη * (C₁ * η₀ + τ) * Cb + W * Mη * C₁ * Nm * a₂ := by ring
    have e4 : (volume (S ∩ Bd)).toReal * -(K * (C₁ * η₀ + τ)) +
        (volume (S ∩ (T ∩ Bd))).toReal * -(K * C₁ * Nm) =
        -(K * (C₁ * η₀ + τ) * (volume (S ∩ Bd)).toReal) -
          K * C₁ * Nm * (volume (S ∩ (T ∩ Bd))).toReal := by ring
    linarith
  have e : -(W * (C₀ * (η₀ * (volume Kc).toReal + Nm * a₁) + Mη * C₁ * (η₀ * Cb + Nm * a₂) +
        Mη * τ * Cb)) = -(W * (C₀ * (η₀ * (volume Kc).toReal + Nm * a₁))) +
        -(W * (Mη * C₁ * (η₀ * Cb + Nm * a₂) + Mη * τ * Cb)) := by ring
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(U W O : Set E3) (c : E3) (R : ℝ) (v : E3 → ℝ)
    (hU : MeasurableSet U) (hUc : Convex ℝ U) (hUR : U ⊆ Metric.closedBall c R)
    (hO : IsOpen O) (hRO : Metric.closedBall c R ⊆ O)
    (hW : MeasurableSet W) (hWU : W ⊆ U) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v O) :
    (MeasureTheory.volume W).toReal * ∫ x in U, v x ^ 2 ≤
      2 * (MeasureTheory.volume U).toReal *
        ((∫ x in W, v x ^ 2) + 32 * R ^ 2 * ∫ x in U, ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a v x) ^ 2)

signature.statement:
(U W O : Set E3) (c : E3) (R : ℝ) (v : E3 → ℝ)
    (hU : MeasurableSet U) (hUc : Convex ℝ U) (hUR : U ⊆ Metric.closedBall c R)
    (hO : IsOpen O) (hRO : Metric.closedBall c R ⊆ O)
    (hW : MeasurableSet W) (hWU : W ⊆ U) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v O) :
    (MeasureTheory.volume W).toReal * ∫ x in U, v x ^ 2 ≤
      2 * (MeasureTheory.volume U).toReal *
        ((∫ x in W, v x ^ 2) + 32 * R ^ 2 * ∫ x in U, ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a v x) ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have c1 : ∀ (U : Set E3), MeasurableSet U → Convex ℝ U → ∀ (G : E3 → ENNReal) (p : E3),
      p ∈ U → ∀ (s : ℝ), 1 / 2 ≤ s → s ≤ 1 →
      ∫⁻ x in U, G (p + s • (x - p)) ≤ 8 * ∫⁻ z in U, G z := by
    intro U hU hUc G p hp s hs1 hs2
    have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith
    have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ U, HasFDerivWithinAt (fun x : E3 => p + s • (x - p))
        (s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3) U x := by
      intro x _
      have h1 := ((((hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) x).sub_const p).const_smul s).const_add p)
      exact h1.hasFDerivWithinAt
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x : E3 => p + s • (x - p)) U := by
      intro x _ y _ hxy
      have h2 : s • (x - p) = s • (y - p) := add_left_cancel hxy
      have h3 : x - p = y - p := smul_right_injective E3 hs0.ne' h2
      exact sub_left_injective h3
    have hcov := lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_det_fderiv_mul volume hU hderiv hinj G
    have hdet : (s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3).det = s ^ 3 := by
      show LinearMap.det ((s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) = s ^ 3
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id, LinearMap.det_smul,
        LinearMap.det_id, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
      ring
    rw [hdet] at hcov
    have himg : (fun x : E3 => p + s • (x - p)) '' U ⊆ U := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact hUc.add_smul_sub_mem hp hx ⟨hs0.le, hs2⟩
    have hs3 : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ |s ^ 3| := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul hs1 hs1 (by norm_num) hs0.le]
    have hchain : ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 8) * ∫⁻ x in U, G (p + s • (x - p)) ≤
        ∫⁻ z in U, G z := by
      calc ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 8) * ∫⁻ x in U, G (p + s • (x - p))
          ≤ ∫⁻ x in U, ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 8) * G (p + s • (x - p)) :=
            lintegral_const_mul_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in U, ENNReal.ofReal |s ^ 3| * G (p + s • (x - p)) := by
            refine lintegral_mono fun x => ?_
            exact mul_le_mul_right' (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hs3) _
        _ = ∫⁻ z in (fun x : E3 => p + s • (x - p)) '' U, G z := hcov.symm
        _ ≤ ∫⁻ z in U, G z := lintegral_mono_set himg
    have h8 : (8 : ENNReal) * ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 8) = 1 := by
      rw [show (8 : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal 8 by simp, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
      norm_num
    calc ∫⁻ x in U, G (p + s • (x - p))
        = 8 * (ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 8) * ∫⁻ x in U, G (p + s • (x - p))) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, h8, one_mul]
      _ ≤ 8 * ∫⁻ z in U, G z := mul_le_mul_left' hchain _
  
  have c4 : ∀ (U W : Set E3) (f : E3 → ℝ), W ⊆ U →
      AEMeasurable f (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict W) →
      MeasureTheory.volume W * ∫⁻ x in U, ENNReal.ofReal (f x ^ 2) ≤
        2 * MeasureTheory.volume U * (∫⁻ y in W, ENNReal.ofReal (f y ^ 2)) +
          2 * ∫⁻ x in U, ∫⁻ y in U, ENNReal.ofReal ((f x - f y) ^ 2) := by
    intro U W f hWU hf
    have hpt : ∀ a b : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (a ^ 2) ≤
        2 * ENNReal.ofReal (b ^ 2) + 2 * ENNReal.ofReal ((a - b) ^ 2) := by
      intro a b
      have h : a ^ 2 ≤ 2 * b ^ 2 + 2 * (a - b) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - 2 * b)]
      calc ENNReal.ofReal (a ^ 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * b ^ 2 + 2 * (a - b) ^ 2) :=
            ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h
        _ = _ := by
            rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (by positivity) (by positivity),
              ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num), ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
            simp
    have hx : ∀ x, ENNReal.ofReal (f x ^ 2) * MeasureTheory.volume W ≤
        2 * (∫⁻ y in W, ENNReal.ofReal (f y ^ 2)) +
          2 * ∫⁻ y in W, ENNReal.ofReal ((f x - f y) ^ 2) := by
      intro x
      rw [← setLIntegral_const]
      calc ∫⁻ _ in W, ENNReal.ofReal (f x ^ 2)
          ≤ ∫⁻ y in W, (2 * ENNReal.ofReal (f y ^ 2) +
              2 * ENNReal.ofReal ((f x - f y) ^ 2)) :=
            lintegral_mono fun y => hpt _ _
        _ = _ := by
            rw [lintegral_add_left' (((hf.pow_const 2).ennreal_ofReal).const_mul 2),
              lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (by simp), lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (by simp)]
    calc MeasureTheory.volume W * ∫⁻ x in U, ENNReal.ofReal (f x ^ 2)
        ≤ ∫⁻ x in U, MeasureTheory.volume W * ENNReal.ofReal (f x ^ 2) :=
          lintegral_const_mul_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in U, (2 * (∫⁻ y in W, ENNReal.ofReal (f y ^ 2)) +
            2 * ∫⁻ y in W, ENNReal.ofReal ((f x - f y) ^ 2)) := by
          refine lintegral_mono fun x => ?_
          rw [mul_comm]
          exact hx x
      _ = 2 * (∫⁻ y in W, ENNReal.ofReal (f y ^ 2)) * MeasureTheory.volume U +
            2 * ∫⁻ x in U, ∫⁻ y in W, ENNReal.ofReal ((f x - f y) ^ 2) := by
          rw [lintegral_add_left measurable_const, setLIntegral_const,
            lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (by simp)]
      _ ≤ 2 * (∫⁻ y in W, ENNReal.ofReal (f y ^ 2)) * MeasureTheory.volume U +
            2 * ∫⁻ x in U, ∫⁻ y in U, ENNReal.ofReal ((f x - f y) ^ 2) := by
          gcongr with x
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have c2 : ∀ (U : Set E3), MeasurableSet U → Convex ℝ U → ∀ (G : E3 → ENNReal), Measurable G →
      ∫⁻ x in U, ∫⁻ y in U, ∫⁻ t in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, G (y + t • (x - y))
        ≤ 8 * MeasureTheory.volume U * ∫⁻ z in U, G z := by
    intro U hU hUc G hG
    have h1 : ∀ x : E3, ∫⁻ y in U, ∫⁻ t in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, G (y + t • (x - y)) =
        ∫⁻ t in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∫⁻ y in U, G (y + t • (x - y)) := by
      intro x
      refine lintegral_lintegral_swap ?_
      exact (hG.comp (Continuous.measurable (f := fun q : E3 × ℝ => q.1 + q.2 • (x - q.1))
        (by fun_prop))).aemeasurable
    simp_rw [h1]
    have hK : Measurable (fun q : E3 × ℝ => ∫⁻ y in U, G (y + q.2 • (q.1 - y))) := by
      have hm : Measurable (fun r : (E3 × ℝ) × E3 => G (r.2 + r.1.2 • (r.1.1 - r.2))) :=
        hG.comp (Continuous.measurable (by fun_prop))
      exact hm.lintegral_prod_right'
    rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap hK.aemeasurable]
    have hbound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        ∫⁻ x in U, ∫⁻ y in U, G (y + t • (x - y)) ≤
          8 * (∫⁻ z in U, G z) * MeasureTheory.volume U := by
      intro t ht
      rcases le_or_gt (1 / 2 : ℝ) t with h | h
      · rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap (f := fun x y : E3 => G (y + t • (x - y)))
          ((hG.comp (Continuous.measurable
          (f := fun q : E3 × E3 => q.2 + t • (q.1 - q.2)) (by fun_prop))).aemeasurable)]
        calc ∫⁻ y in U, ∫⁻ x in U, G (y + t • (x - y))
            ≤ ∫⁻ y in U, 8 * ∫⁻ z in U, G z := by
              refine setLIntegral_mono' hU fun y hy => ?_
              exact c1 U hU hUc G y hy t h ht.2
          _ = _ := setLIntegral_const _ _
      · have heq : ∀ x y : E3, y + t • (x - y) = x + (1 - t) • (y - x) := by
          intro x y
          module
        simp_rw [heq]
        calc ∫⁻ x in U, ∫⁻ y in U, G (x + (1 - t) • (y - x))
            ≤ ∫⁻ x in U, 8 * ∫⁻ z in U, G z := by
              refine setLIntegral_mono' hU fun x hx => ?_
              exact c1 U hU hUc G x hx (1 - t) (by linarith) (by linarith [ht.1])
          _ = _ := setLIntegral_const _ _
    calc ∫⁻ t in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∫⁻ x in U, ∫⁻ y in U, G (y + t • (x - y))
        ≤ ∫⁻ t in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 8 * (∫⁻ z in U, G z) * MeasureTheory.volume U :=
          setLIntegral_mono' measurableSet_Icc hbound
      _ = 8 * (∫⁻ z in U, G z) * MeasureTheory.volume U := by
          rw [setLIntegral_const, Real.volume_Icc]
          simp
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have c3 : ∀ (x y : E3), x ∈ Metric.closedBall c R → y ∈ Metric.closedBall c R →
      ENNReal.ofReal ((v x - v y) ^ 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 * R ^ 2) *
        ∫⁻ t in Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
          ENNReal.ofReal (∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a v (y + t • (x - y))) ^ 2) := by
    intro x y hx hy
    set w : E3 := x - y with hwdef
    have hγB : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, y + t • w ∈ Metric.closedBall c R :=
      fun t ht => (convex_closedBall c R).add_smul_sub_mem hy hx ht
    have hγO : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, y + t • w ∈ O := fun t ht => hRO (hγB t ht)
    have hfd : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ v) O := hv.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)
    have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ O, DifferentiableAt ℝ v z :=
      fun z hz => (hv.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hz)
    have hγc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => y + t • w) := by fun_prop
    have hγmap : Set.MapsTo (fun t : ℝ => y + t • w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) O :=
      fun t ht => hγO t ht
    have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w)) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hfd.comp hγc.continuousOn hγmap
    have hφc : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w) w) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
      hFc.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hpc : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => partialDeriv a v (y + t • w))
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := fun a => hFc.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hGc : ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a v (y + t • w)) ^ 2)
        (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => (hpc a).pow 2
    have hI1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w) w) volume 0 1 :=
      hφc.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one
    have hI2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t : ℝ => (fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w) w) ^ 2) volume 0 1 :=
      (hφc.pow 2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one
    have hIG : IntervalIntegrable
        (fun t : ℝ => ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a v (y + t • w)) ^ 2) volume 0 1 :=
      hGc.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc zero_le_one
    have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => v (y + t • w)) (fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w) w) t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      have hγd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y + t • w) w t := by
        simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const w).const_add y
      exact (hdiff _ (hγO t ht)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hγd
    have hFTC : ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w) w = v x - v y := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv hI1]
      simp [hwdef]
    set m : ℝ := ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w) w with hm
    have hJ : m ^ 2 ≤ ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w) w) ^ 2 := by
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, (fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w) w - m) ^ 2 :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one fun t _ => sq_nonneg _
      have hexp : (fun t : ℝ => (fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w) w - m) ^ 2) =
          fun t => ((fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w) w) ^ 2 - (2 * m) * fderiv ℝ v (y + t • w) w) +
            m ^ 2 := by
        funext t; ring
      rw [hexp, intervalIntegral.integral_add (hI2.sub (hI1.const_mul _))
          intervalIntegrable_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_sub hI2 (hI1.const_mul _), intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const, ← hm] at h0
      simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at h0
      nlinarith
    have hwsum : ∑ a : Fin 3, w a • e a = w := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hwn : ∑ a : Fin 3, (w a) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * R ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = ∑ a : Fin 3, (w a) ^ 2 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
        simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

      hOpn a _ hUo Set.inter_subset_left
    have hS := (hCts b).isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball hT
    have hyS : y ∈ Metric.ball (A.c b) (A.r b) ∩
        A.κ b ⁻¹' (A.κ a '' (Metric.ball (A.c a) (A.r a) ∩ {w : E3 | 0 < w 0})) :=
      ⟨hy, ⟨x, ⟨hx, hx0⟩, hxy⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hS y hyS
    have hz := hshift y (-(ε / 2))
    have hzS := hball (show y + (-(ε / 2)) • e 0 ∈ Metric.ball y ε by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, hz.2, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      linarith)
    obtain ⟨hzB, w, ⟨hwB, hw0⟩, hwz⟩ := hzS
    have hΩ : A.κ b (y + (-(ε / 2)) • e 0) ∈ Ω₀ := by
      rw [← hwz]
      exact (A.dom a w hwB).2 (show 0 < w 0 from hw0).le
    have h := (A.dom b _ hzB).1 hΩ
    rw [hz.1] at h
    linarith
  
  have hcover : ∀ q ∈ Ω₀, ∃ j : Fin A.n, ∃ x ∈ Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j / 8),
      A.κ j x = q := by
    intro q hq
    have hne : ∑ j, A.ψ j q ≠ 0 := by rw [A.ψ_sum q hq]; exact one_ne_zero
    obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hne
    have hq' : q ∈ tsupport (A.ψ j) := subset_tsupport _ hj
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxq⟩ := (A.ψ_supp j).2 hq'
    exact ⟨j, x, hx, hxq⟩
  
  have hlink : ∀ (j k : Fin A.n) (y : E3), y ∈ Metric.ball (A.c k) (A.r k / 8) → 0 ≤ y 0 →
      A.κ k y ∈ A.κ j '' Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j / 2) →
      ∃ y' : E3, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ Metric.closedBall y' ρ ⊆ ndsHalf (A.c k) (A.r k) ∧
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y' ρ, A.κ k z ∈ A.κ j '' ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j) := by
    intro j k y hy hy0 hyT
    have hrk := A.r_pos k
    have hT : IsOpen (A.κ j '' Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j / 2)) :=
      hOpn j _ Metric.isOpen_ball (hB2 j)
    have hS := (hCts k).isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball hT
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hS y ⟨hB8 k hy, hyT⟩
    obtain ⟨ε', hε'def⟩ : ∃ ε' : ℝ, ε' = min ε (A.r k / 8) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hε'0 : 0 < ε' := by rw [hε'def]; exact lt_min hε (by linarith)
    have hε'1 : ε' ≤ ε := by rw [hε'def]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hε'2 : ε' ≤ A.r k / 8 := by rw [hε'def]; exact min_le_right _ _
    have hy' := hshift y (ε' / 2)
    have hyc : dist y (A.c k) < A.r k / 8 := hy
    have key : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall (y + (ε' / 2) • e 0) (ε' / 8),
        z ∈ ndsHalf (A.c k) (A.r k) ∧ z ∈ Metric.ball y ε := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
      have h1 : dist z y < ε' := by
        have h := dist_triangle z (y + (ε' / 2) • e 0) y
        rw [hy'.2, abs_of_pos (by linarith)] at h
        linarith
      have h2 : dist z (A.c k) < A.r k / 2 := by
        have h := dist_triangle z y (A.c k)
        linarith
      have h3 : 0 < z 0 := by
        have h := hcrd z (y + (ε' / 2) • e 0)
        rw [hy'.1] at h
        have h' := (abs_le.mp (h.trans hz)).1
        linarith
      refine ⟨(⟨h2, h3⟩ : z ∈ Metric.ball (A.c k) (A.r k / 2) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}), ?_⟩
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      linarith
    refine ⟨y + (ε' / 2) • e 0, ε' / 8, by linarith, fun z hz => (key z hz).1, ?_⟩
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hzH, hzb⟩ := key z hz
    have hzH' : z ∈ Metric.ball (A.c k) (A.r k / 2) ∧ 0 < z 0 := hzH
    obtain ⟨_, x', hx'B, hx'eq⟩ := hball hzb
    have hx'0 : 0 < x' 0 := hface k j z x' (hB2 k hzH'.1) (hB2 j hx'B) hx'eq.symm hzH'.2
    exact ⟨x', (⟨hx'B, hx'0⟩ : x' ∈ Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j / 2) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}),
      hx'eq⟩
  
  obtain ⟨q, hqS, hqΩ⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨j₀, x₀, hx₀, hx₀q⟩ := hcover q hqΩ
  have hD₀ : A.D j₀ := ((A.dir j₀ x₀ (hB8 j₀ hx₀)).1 (by rw [hx₀q]; exact hqS)).1
  refine ⟨j₀, hD₀, ?_⟩
  
  intro k₁
  by_contra hk₁
  let Re : Set (Fin A.n) := {k | Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun j' k' : Fin A.n => ∃ y : E3, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧
        Metric.closedBall y ρ ⊆ ndsHalf (A.c k') (A.r k') ∧
        ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y ρ, A.κ k' z ∈ A.κ j' '' ndsHalf (A.c j') (A.r j')) j₀ k}
  let P : Set M := ⋃ j ∈ Re, A.κ j '' Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j / 8)
  let Q : Set M := ⋃ j ∈ Reᶜ, A.κ j '' Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j / 8)
  have hP : IsOpen P := isOpen_biUnion (fun j _ => hOpn j _ Metric.isOpen_ball (hB8 j))
  have hQ : IsOpen Q := isOpen_biUnion (fun j _ => hOpn j _ Metric.isOpen_ball (hB8 j))
  have hcov : Ω₀ ⊆ P ∪ Q := by
    intro q' hq'
    obtain ⟨j, x, hx, hxq⟩ := hcover q' hq'
    by_cases hj : j ∈ Re
    · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨j, hj, x, hx, hxq⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨j, hj, x, hx, hxq⟩)
  have hPn : (Ω₀ ∩ P).Nonempty :=
    ⟨q, hqΩ, Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨j₀, Relation.ReflTransGen.refl, x₀, hx₀, hx₀q⟩⟩
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ A.c k₁ 0 := by
    rcases A.center k₁ with h | h
    · rw [h]
    · linarith [A.r_pos k₁]
  have hcm : A.c k₁ ∈ Metric.ball (A.c k₁) (A.r k₁ / 8) :=
    Metric.mem_ball_self (by linarith [A.r_pos k₁])
  have hQn : (Ω₀ ∩ Q).Nonempty :=
    ⟨A.κ k₁ (A.c k₁), (A.dom k₁ _ (hB8 k₁ hcm)).2 hc0,
      Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨k₁, hk₁, A.c k₁, hcm, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨q', hq'Ω, hq'P, hq'Q⟩ := hconn P Q hP hQ hcov hPn hQn
  obtain ⟨j, hj, x, hx, hxq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hq'P
  obtain ⟨k, hk, y, hy, hyq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hq'Q
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y 0 := (A.dom k y (hB8 k hy)).1 (by rw [hyq]; exact hq'Ω)
  have hyT : A.κ k y ∈ A.κ j '' Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j / 2) :=
    ⟨x, hB82 j hx, by rw [hxq, hyq]⟩
  exact hk (Relation.ReflTransGen.tail hj (hlink j k y hy hy0 hyT))

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (κ κ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (V : Set E3)
    (hV : MeasurableSet V) (hVs : V ⊆ κ'.source)
    (hWs : Metric.closedBall y ρ ⊆ κ.source)
    (hWV : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y ρ, κ z ∈ κ' '' V) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ h : M → ℝ, Continuous h → IntegrableOn (fun x => h (κ' x) ^ 2) V →
      ∫ z in Metric.closedBall y ρ, h (κ z) ^ 2 ≤ C * ∫ x in V, h (κ' x) ^ 2

signature.name: nds_chart_transfer
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (κ κ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (V : Set E3)
    (hV : MeasurableSet V) (hVs : V ⊆ κ'.source)
    (hWs : Metric.closedBall y ρ ⊆ κ.source)
    (hWV : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y ρ, κ z ∈ κ' '' V) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ h : M → ℝ, Continuous h → IntegrableOn (fun x => h (κ' x) ^ 2) V →
      ∫ z in Metric.closedBall y ρ, h (κ z) ^ 2 ≤ C * ∫ x in V, h (κ' x) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hκ_ms : ∀ z ∈ κ.source, κ z ∈ κ.target := fun z hz => κ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hz
  have hκ_li : ∀ z ∈ κ.source, κ.symm (κ z) = z := fun z hz => κ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hz
  have hκ_ri : ∀ p ∈ κ.target, κ (κ.symm p) = p := fun p hp => κ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hp
  have hκ'_ms : ∀ z ∈ κ'.source, κ' z ∈ κ'.target := fun z hz => κ'.toPartialEquiv.map_source hz
  have hκ'_li : ∀ z ∈ κ'.source, κ'.symm (κ' z) = z := fun z hz => κ'.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hz
  have hκ'_inj : Set.InjOn κ' κ'.source := κ'.toPartialEquiv.injOn
  
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ : ∃ τ : E3 → E3, ∀ x, τ x = κ.symm (κ' x) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : E3 → E3, ∀ z, σ z = κ'.symm (κ z) := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hO : IsOpen (κ'.source ∩ κ' ⁻¹' κ.target) :=
    κ'.contMDiffOn.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage κ'.open_source κ.open_target
  have hτs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ (κ'.source ∩ κ' ⁻¹' κ.target) := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (κ.symm ∘ κ') (κ'.source ∩ κ' ⁻¹' κ.target) := by
      refine κ.symm.contMDiffOn.comp (κ'.contMDiffOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left) ?_
      intro x hx
      exact hx.2
    exact (contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1).congr (fun x _ => hτ x)
  have hσc : ContinuousOn σ (Metric.closedBall y ρ) := by
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun z => κ'.symm (κ z)) (Metric.closedBall y ρ) := by
      refine κ'.symm.contMDiffOn.continuousOn.comp (κ.contMDiffOn.continuousOn.mono hWs) ?_
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀V, hx₀⟩ := hWV z hz
      show κ z ∈ κ'.target
      rw [← hx₀]
      exact hκ'_ms x₀ (hVs hx₀V)
    exact h1.congr (fun z _ => hσ z)
  have hkey : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall y ρ, σ z ∈ V ∧ κ' (σ z) = κ z ∧ τ (σ z) = z := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀V, hx₀⟩ := hWV z hz
    have hx₀s := hVs hx₀V
    have h1 : σ z = x₀ := by
      rw [hσ, ← hx₀]
      exact hκ'_li x₀ hx₀s
    have h2 : κ' (σ z) = κ z := by rw [h1, hx₀]
    refine ⟨by rw [h1]; exact hx₀V, h2, ?_⟩
    rw [hτ, h2]
    exact hκ_li z (hWs hz)
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : Set E3, S = σ '' Metric.closedBall y ρ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hScpt : IsCompact S := by
    rw [hSdef]
    exact (isCompact_closedBall y ρ).image_of_continuousOn hσc
  have hSV : S ⊆ V := by
    rw [hSdef]
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact (hkey z hz).1
  have hSO : S ⊆ κ'.source ∩ κ' ⁻¹' κ.target := by
    rw [hSdef]
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hVs (hkey z hz).1, ?_⟩
    show κ' (σ z) ∈ κ.target
    rw [(hkey z hz).2.1]
    exact hκ_ms z (hWs hz)
  have hκτ : ∀ x ∈ S, κ (τ x) = κ' x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hτ]
    exact hκ_ri _ (hSO hx).2
  have himg : τ '' S = Metric.closedBall y ρ := by
    rw [hSdef]
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [(hkey w hw).2.2]
      exact hw
    · intro hz
      exact ⟨σ z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, (hkey z hz).2.2⟩
  have hinj : Set.InjOn τ S := by
    intro x₁ h₁ x₂ h₂ he
    apply hκ'_inj (hVs (hSV h₁)) (hVs (hSV h₂))
    rw [← hκτ x₁ h₁, ← hκτ x₂ h₂, he]
  
  have hfc : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ τ x) (κ'.source ∩ κ' ⁻¹' κ.target) :=
    hτs.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)
  have hdc : ContinuousOn (fun x => |(fderiv ℝ τ x).det|) S :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.continuous_det.comp_continuousOn hfc).abs).mono hSO
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ := hScpt.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hdc
  have hB : ∀ x ∈ S, |(fderiv ℝ τ x).det| ≤ max 0 B₀ := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hB₀ x hx
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs] at h1
    exact h1.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hdiff : DifferentiableOn ℝ τ (κ'.source ∩ κ' ⁻¹' κ.target) := hτs.differentiableOn (by simp)
  have hder : ∀ x ∈ S, HasFDerivWithinAt τ (fderiv ℝ τ x) S x := fun x hx =>
    ((hdiff x (hSO hx)).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds (hSO hx))).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
  have hSm : MeasurableSet S := hScpt.measurableSet
  refine ⟨max 0 B₀, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro h _ hint
  have hcov := MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hSm hder hinj
    (fun z => h (κ z) ^ 2)
  have hid : ∀ x ∈ S, h (κ (τ x)) ^ 2 = h (κ' x) ^ 2 := fun x hx => by rw [hκτ x hx]
  have hintS : IntegrableOn (fun x => h (κ' x) ^ 2) S := hint.mono_set hSV
  calc ∫ z in Metric.closedBall y ρ, h (κ z) ^ 2
      = ∫ z in τ '' S, h (κ z) ^ 2 := by rw [himg]
    _ = ∫ x in S, |(fderiv ℝ τ x).det| • h (κ (τ x)) ^ 2 := hcov
    _ = ∫ x in S, |(fderiv ℝ τ x).det| * h (κ' x) ^ 2 := by
        refine setIntegral_congr_fun hSm (fun x hx => ?_)
        simp only [smul_eq_mul, hid x hx]
    _ ≤ ∫ x in S, max 0 B₀ * h (κ' x) ^ 2 := by
        refine integral_mono_of_nonneg ?_ (Integrable.const_mul hintS _) ?_
        · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hSm
            (fun x _ => mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
        · exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hSm
            (fun x hx => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB x hx) (sq_nonneg _))
    _ = max 0 B₀ * ∫ x in S, h (κ' x) ^ 2 := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ max 0 B₀ * ∫ x in V, h (κ' x) ^ 2 := by
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (le_max_left _ _)
        exact setIntegral_mono_set hint (ae_of_all _ (fun x => sq_nonneg _)) hSV.eventuallyLE

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    {β : M → ℝ} {Ω₀ S₀ : Set M} (A : NdsAtlas M β Ω₀ S₀) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      (∀ j, ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j),
          ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => u (A.κ j z)) x) ^ 2
        ≤ K * ndsInt g A (fun q => g.gradInner u u q)) ∧
      ndsInt g A (fun q => u q ^ 2) ≤
        K * ∑ j, ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j), (u (A.κ j x)) ^ 2

signature.name: nds_energy_compare
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    {β : M → ℝ} {Ω₀ S₀ : Set M} (A : NdsAtlas M β Ω₀ S₀) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      (∀ j, ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j),
          ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => u (A.κ j z)) x) ^ 2
        ≤ K * ndsInt g A (fun q => g.gradInner u u q)) ∧
      ndsInt g A (fun q => u q ^ 2) ≤
        K * ∑ j, ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j), (u (A.κ j x)) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hHb := fun j => nds_half_basic (A.c j) (A.r j) (A.r_pos j)
  have hball : ∀ j, (A.κ j).source = Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j) := A.source_eq
  have hKs : ∀ j, Metric.closedBall (A.c j) (A.r j / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j) :=
    fun j => Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith [A.r_pos j])
  have hHK : ∀ j, ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j) ⊆ Metric.closedBall (A.c j) (A.r j / 2) :=
    fun j x hx => Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx.1
  have hdetc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det)
      (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j)) := by
    intro j
    have h := (nds_chart_cont g (A.κ j) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
      contMDiff_const contMDiff_const).2.2.2.1
    rw [hball j] at h
    exact h
  have hinvc : ∀ j (a b : Fin 3), ContinuousOn (fun x => (g.coeff (A.κ j) x)⁻¹ a b)
      (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j)) := by
    intro j a b
    have h := (nds_chart_cont g (A.κ j) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
      contMDiff_const contMDiff_const).2.2.2.2 a b
    rw [hball j] at h
    exact h
  
  have hell : ∀ j, ∃ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (A.c j) (A.r j / 2),
      ∀ ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ, lam * ∑ a : Fin 3, ξ a ^ 2 ≤
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det *
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (A.κ j) x)⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : Set (Fin 3 → ℝ), S = {ζ | ∑ a : Fin 3, ζ a ^ 2 = 1} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hSc : IsCompact S := by
      refine (isCompact_univ_pi (fun _ : Fin 3 => isCompact_Icc (a := (-1 : ℝ)) (b := 1))).of_isClosed_subset ?_ ?_
      · rw [hS]
        exact isClosed_eq (continuous_finset_sum _ fun a _ => (continuous_apply a).pow 2)
          continuous_const
      · intro ζ hζ
        rw [hS] at hζ
        have hζ' : ∑ a : Fin 3, ζ a ^ 2 = 1 := hζ
        rw [Set.mem_univ_pi]
        intro a
        have h1 : ζ a ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
          have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun b => ζ b ^ 2) (fun b _ => sq_nonneg (ζ b))
            (Finset.mem_univ a)
          linarith
        exact Set.mem_Icc.mpr (abs_le.mp ((sq_le_one_iff_abs_le_one _).mp h1))
    have hT : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (A.c j) (A.r j / 2) ×ˢ S) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall _ _).prod hSc
    have hTne : (Metric.closedBall (A.c j) (A.r j / 2) ×ˢ S).Nonempty := by
      refine ⟨(A.c j, fun a => if a = 0 then 1 else 0),
        Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by linarith [A.r_pos j]), ?_⟩
      rw [hS]
      show ∑ a : Fin 3, (if a = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ^ 2 = 1
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    have hKs' : Set.MapsTo Prod.fst (Metric.closedBall (A.c j) (A.r j / 2) ×ˢ S)
        (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j)) := fun p hp => hKs j hp.1
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ, ∀ p, F p =
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) p.1).det *
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (A.κ j) p.1)⁻¹ a b * p.2 a * p.2 b :=
      ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
    have hFc : ContinuousOn F (Metric.closedBall (A.c j) (A.r j / 2) ×ˢ S) := by
      have e : F = fun p : E3 × (Fin 3 → ℝ) => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) p.1).det *
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (A.κ j) p.1)⁻¹ a b * p.2 a * p.2 b := funext hF
      rw [e]
      refine ContinuousOn.mul ((hdetc j).comp continuousOn_fst hKs') ?_
      refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun b _ => ?_
      refine (((hinvc j a b).comp continuousOn_fst hKs').mul ?_).mul ?_
      · exact ((continuous_apply a).comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
      · exact ((continuous_apply b).comp continuous_snd).continuousOn
    have hFpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (A.c j) (A.r j / 2), ∀ ζ : Fin 3 → ℝ, ζ ≠ 0 →
        0 < Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det *
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (A.κ j) x)⁻¹ a b * ζ a * ζ b := by
      intro x hx ζ hζ
      have hxs : x ∈ (A.κ j).source := by rw [hball j]; exact hKs j hx
      refine mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (coeff_posDef g (A.κ j) x hxs).det_pos) ?_
      have h := ((flat_coeff_regular g (A.κ j)).2.2.1 x hxs).dotProduct_mulVec_pos hζ
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum] at h
      have e : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (A.κ j) x)⁻¹ a b * ζ a * ζ b) =
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ζ a * ((g.coeff (A.κ j) x)⁻¹ a b * ζ b) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => by ring
      rw [e]
      exact h
    obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀, hmin⟩ := hT.exists_isMinOn hTne hFc
    have hp₀S : ∑ a : Fin 3, p₀.2 a ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have := hp₀.2
      rw [hS] at this
      exact this
    have hp₀ne : p₀.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0] at hp₀S
      simp at hp₀S
    refine ⟨F p₀, by rw [hF]; exact hFpos p₀.1 hp₀.1 p₀.2 hp₀ne, ?_⟩
    intro x hx ξ
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = ∑ a : Fin 3, ξ a ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by rw [hs]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => sq_nonneg _
    rw [← hs]
    rcases hs0.lt_or_eq with hspos | hszero
    · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = Real.sqrt s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have htpos : 0 < t := by rw [ht]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hspos
      have ht2 : t ^ 2 = s := by rw [ht]; exact Real.sq_sqrt hs0
      have htne : t ≠ 0 := htpos.ne'
      have hζS : (fun a => ξ a / t) ∈ S := by
        rw [hS]
        show ∑ a : Fin 3, (ξ a / t) ^ 2 = 1
        simp only [div_pow]
        rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← hs, ← ht2]
        exact div_self (pow_ne_zero 2 htne)
      have hm : F p₀ ≤ F (x, fun a => ξ a / t) := isMinOn_iff.mp hmin _ ⟨hx, hζS⟩
      rw [hF (x, fun a => ξ a / t)] at hm
      have hQ : (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (A.κ j) x)⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b) =
          (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (A.κ j) x)⁻¹ a b * (ξ a / t) * (ξ b / t)) * s := by
        rw [← ht2, Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
        field_simp
      rw [hQ]
      calc F p₀ * s ≤ (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det *
            ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (A.κ j) x)⁻¹ a b * (ξ a / t) * (ξ b / t)) * s :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm hs0
        _ = _ := by ring
    · have hξ : ξ = 0 := by
        funext a
        have h0 : ∑ a : Fin 3, ξ a ^ 2 = 0 := by rw [← hs]; exact hszero.symm
        have := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (ξ i))).1 h0 a
          (Finset.mem_univ a)
        exact pow_eq_zero_iff (by norm_num) |>.mp this
      rw [← hszero, hξ]
      simp
  choose lam hlam0 hlam using hell
  have hbd : ∀ j, ∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (A.c j) (A.r j / 2),
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det ≤ Λ := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (A.c j) (A.r j / 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((hdetc j).mono (hKs j))
    refine ⟨C, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have h := hC x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans h
  choose Λ hΛ using hbd
  obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁⟩ : ∃ K₁ : ℝ, K₁ = ∑ j, (lam j)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨K₂, hK₂⟩ : ∃ K₂ : ℝ, K₂ = ∑ j, max (Λ j) 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK₁0 : 0 ≤ K₁ := by
    rw [hK₁]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => (inv_pos.mpr (hlam0 j)).le
  have hK₂0 : 0 ≤ K₂ := by
    rw [hK₂]; exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => le_max_right _ _
  have hlamK : ∀ j, (lam j)⁻¹ ≤ K₁ := by
    intro j
    rw [hK₁]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l => (lam l)⁻¹) (fun l _ => (inv_pos.mpr (hlam0 l)).le)
      (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hΛK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall (A.c j) (A.r j / 2),
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det ≤ K₂ := by
    intro j x hx
    refine (hΛ j x hx).trans ((le_max_left (Λ j) 0).trans ?_)
    rw [hK₂]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l => max (Λ l) 0) (fun l _ => le_max_right _ _)
      (Finset.mem_univ j)
  refine ⟨K₁ + K₂, add_nonneg hK₁0 hK₂0, fun u hu => ?_⟩
  have hcc : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (A.κ j x)) (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j)) ∧
      (∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv a (fun x => u (A.κ j x)))
        (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j))) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u u (A.κ j x)) (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j)) := by
    intro j
    have h := nds_chart_cont g (A.κ j) u u hu hu
    rw [hball j] at h
    exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1⟩
  have hB : 0 ≤ ndsInt g A (fun q => g.gradInner u u q) :=
    (nds_int_algebra g A _ _ (fun j => (hcc j).2.2) (fun j => (hcc j).2.2)).2.1
      (fun q _ => (gradInner_symm_nonneg g u u q).1)
  refine ⟨fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hpt : ∀ x ∈ ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j),
        lam j * ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => u (A.κ j z)) x) ^ 2 ≤
          g.gradInner u u (A.κ j x) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det := by
      intro x hx
      have hxs : x ∈ (A.κ j).source := by rw [hball j]; exact (hHb j).2.1 hx
      have h := hlam j x (hHK j hx) (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun z => u (A.κ j z)) x)
      rw [gradInner_pdiffeo_formula g (A.κ j) u u hu hu x hxs]
      rw [mul_comm _ (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det)]
      exact h
    have hint1 : IntegrableOn
        (fun x => lam j * ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => u (A.κ j z)) x) ^ 2)
        (ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j)) :=
      ((hHb j).2.2 _ (continuousOn_const.mul
        (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => ((hcc j).2.1 a).pow 2))).2
    have hint2 : IntegrableOn
        (fun x => g.gradInner u u (A.κ j x) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det)
        (ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j)) :=
      ((hHb j).2.2 _ ((hcc j).2.2.mul (hdetc j))).2
    have hmono := setIntegral_mono_on hint1 hint2 (hHb j).1 hpt
    rw [integral_const_mul] at hmono
    have hloc := (nds_int_localize g A (fun q => g.gradInner u u q) (fun k => (hcc k).2.2) j).1
      (fun q _ => (gradInner_symm_nonneg g u u q).1)
    have hE := hmono.trans hloc
    have hE' : (∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j),
          ∑ a : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun z => u (A.κ j z)) x) ^ 2) ≤
        (lam j)⁻¹ * ndsInt g A (fun q => g.gradInner u u q) := by
      rw [← div_eq_inv_mul, le_div_iff₀ (hlam0 j)]
      linarith
    calc _ ≤ (lam j)⁻¹ * ndsInt g A (fun q => g.gradInner u u q) := hE'
      _ ≤ (K₁ + K₂) * ndsInt g A (fun q => g.gradInner u u q) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hlamK j]) hB
  · have hI : 0 ≤ ∑ j, ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j), (u (A.κ j x)) ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
    calc ndsInt g A (fun q => u q ^ 2)
        ≤ ∑ j, K₂ * ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j), (u (A.κ j x)) ^ 2 := by
          unfold ndsInt
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
          rw [← integral_const_mul]
          have hψc : ContinuousOn (fun x => A.ψ j (A.κ j x)) (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j)) := by
            have := (A.ψ_smooth j).continuous.comp_continuousOn
              (A.κ j).contMDiffOn.continuousOn
            rw [hball j] at this
            exact this
          refine setIntegral_mono_on ?_ ?_ (hHb j).1 ?_
          · exact ((hHb j).2.2 _ ((hψc.mul ((hcc j).1.continuousOn.pow 2)).mul (hdetc j))).2
          · exact ((hHb j).2.2 _ (continuousOn_const.mul ((hcc j).1.continuousOn.pow 2))).2
          · intro x hx
            have hxb := (hHb j).2.1 hx
            have hΩ : A.κ j x ∈ Ω₀ := (A.dom j x hxb).2 (le_of_lt hx.2)
            have hψ1 : A.ψ j (A.κ j x) ≤ 1 := by
              rw [← A.ψ_sum _ hΩ]
              exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l => A.ψ l (A.κ j x))
                (fun l _ => A.ψ_nonneg l _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
            have hd0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det
            have hdK := hΛK j x (hHK j hx)
            have hw := sq_nonneg (u (A.κ j x))
            show A.ψ j (A.κ j x) * u (A.κ j x) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det ≤
              K₂ * u (A.κ j x) ^ 2
            calc A.ψ j (A.κ j x) * u (A.κ j x) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det
                ≤ 1 * u (A.κ j x) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hψ1 hw) hd0
              _ = u (A.κ j x) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ j) x).det := by ring
              _ ≤ u (A.κ j x) ^ 2 * K₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdK hw
              _ = K₂ * u (A.κ j x) ^ 2 := mul_comm _ _
      _ = K₂ * ∑ j, ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j), (u (A.κ j x)) ^ 2 :=
          (Finset.mul_sum _ _ _).symm
      _ ≤ (K₁ + K₂) * ∑ j, ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c j) (A.r j), (u (A.κ j x)) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hI

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_symm_nonneg
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u w : M → ℝ) (p : M) :
    0 ≤ g.gradInner u u p ∧ g.gradInner u w p = g.gradInner w u p

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_chart_cont
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv a (fun x => u (κ x))) κ.source) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u w (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.coeff κ x).det) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ a b) κ.source)

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_half_basic
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    MeasurableSet (ndsHalf c r) ∧ ndsHalf c r ⊆ Metric.ball c r ∧
    ∀ F : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn F (Metric.ball c r) →
      MemLp F 2 (volume.restrict (ndsHalf c r)) ∧ IntegrableOn F (ndsHalf c r)

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_int_algebra
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    {β : M → ℝ} {Ω₀ S₀ : Set M} (A : NdsAtlas M β Ω₀ S₀) (F H : M → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => F (A.κ j x)) (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j)))
    (hH : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => H (A.κ j x)) (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j))) :
    (∀ a b : ℝ, ndsInt g A (fun q => a * F q + b * H q) = a * ndsInt g A F + b * ndsInt g A H) ∧
    ((∀ q ∈ Ω₀, 0 ≤ F q) → 0 ≤ ndsInt g A F) ∧
    (ndsInt g A (fun q => F q * H q)) ^ 2 ≤
      ndsInt g A (fun q => F q ^ 2) * ndsInt g A (fun q => H q ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ φ.source) :
    (g.coeff φ y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: flat_coeff_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) :
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j) Ψ.source) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Ψ.source, ∀ i j : Fin 3, (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j = (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ j i) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Ψ.source, ((g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹).PosDef) ∧
    (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel (g.coeff Ψ) k i j) Ψ.source)

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_pdiffeo_formula
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ κ.source) :
    g.gradInner u w (κ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => u (κ z)) x *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => w (κ z)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_int_localize
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    {β : M → ℝ} {Ω₀ S₀ : Set M} (A : NdsAtlas M β Ω₀ S₀) (F : M → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => F (A.κ j x)) (Metric.ball (A.c j) (A.r j))) (k : Fin A.n) :
    ((∀ q ∈ Ω₀, 0 ≤ F q) →
      ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c k) (A.r k), F (A.κ k x) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ k) x).det
        ≤ ndsInt g A F) ∧
    ((∀ q ∈ Ω₀, q ∉ A.κ k '' Metric.ball (A.c k) (A.r k / 2) → F q = 0) →
      ∫ x in ndsHalf (A.c k) (A.r k), F (A.κ k x) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (A.κ k) x).det
        = ndsInt g A F)

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
    (hD : fcrSob c ρ k w D) (b : ContDiffBump (0 : E3)) :
    (∀ L : List (Fin 3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (L.foldr partialDeriv (fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator w)))) ∧
    ∀ L : List (Fin 3), L.length ≤ k → ∀ x : E3, -b.rOut < x 0 →
      x ∈ Metric.ball c (ρ - 3 * b.rOut) →
      L.foldr partialDeriv (fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator w)) x =
        fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator (D L)) x

signature.name: fcr_moll_deriv
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
    (hD : fcrSob c ρ k w D) (b : ContDiffBump (0 : E3)) :
    (∀ L : List (Fin 3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (L.foldr partialDeriv (fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator w)))) ∧
    ∀ L : List (Fin 3), L.length ≤ k → ∀ x : E3, -b.rOut < x 0 →
      x ∈ Metric.ball c (ρ - 3 * b.rOut) →
      L.foldr partialDeriv (fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator w)) x =
        fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator (D L)) x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hφs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (b.normed volume) := b.contDiff_normed (n := ⊤)
  have hφd : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt (b.normed volume) (fderiv ℝ (b.normed volume) y) y :=
    fun y => ((hφs.differentiable (by simp)) y).hasFDerivAt
  have hφdc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (b.normed volume)) := hφs.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ : ∃ C, ∀ y, ‖fderiv ℝ (b.normed volume) y‖ ≤ C :=
    ((b.hasCompactSupport_normed (μ := volume)).fderiv ℝ).exists_bound_of_continuous hφdc
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ : ∃ C, ∀ y, ‖b.normed volume y‖ ≤ C :=
    (b.hasCompactSupport_normed (μ := volume)).exists_bound_of_continuous b.continuous_normed
  
  have hmollC : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, Integrable f → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fcrMoll b f) := by
    intro f hf
    have heq : fcrMoll b f = (fun y => convolution (b.normed volume) f
        (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume y) ∘ (fun x => x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0) := by
      funext x
      show fcrMoll b f x = convolution (b.normed volume) f (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume
        (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0)
      rw [convolution_mul_swap]
      rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact ((b.hasCompactSupport_normed (μ := volume)).contDiff_convolution_left
      (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) (b.contDiff_normed (n := ⊤)) hf.locallyIntegrable).comp
      (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
  
  have hpdC : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (G : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ G → ContDiff ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a G) := by
    intro a G hG
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ G y (e a))
    exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hG).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
  
  have hpd : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, Integrable f → ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x : E3),
      partialDeriv a (fcrMoll b f) x =
        ∫ t, partialDeriv a (b.normed volume) (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t) * f t := by
    intro f hf a x
    have hF'meas : ∀ y : E3, AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun t => f t • fderiv ℝ (b.normed volume) (y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)) volume := by
      intro y
      exact hf.aestronglyMeasurable.smul
        (hφdc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hFmeas : ∀ y : E3, AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun t => b.normed volume (y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t) * f t) volume := by
      intro y
      exact (b.continuous_normed.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable.mul
        hf.aestronglyMeasurable
    have hFint : Integrable (fun t => b.normed volume (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t) * f t) volume :=
      hf.bdd_mul (b.continuous_normed.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => hC₀ _)
    have hbound : ∀ y t, ‖f t • fderiv ℝ (b.normed volume) (y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)‖
        ≤ C₁ * ‖f t‖ := by
      intro y t
      rw [norm_smul, mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC₁ _) (norm_nonneg _)
    have hderiv : ∀ t y, HasFDerivAt (fun y => b.normed volume (y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t) * f t)
        (f t • fderiv ℝ (b.normed volume) (y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)) y := by
      intro t y
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)
          (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3) y :=
        ((hasFDerivAt_id y).add_const _).sub_const _
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt ((b.normed volume) ∘ (fun y : E3 => y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t))
          ((fderiv ℝ (b.normed volume) (y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)) y :=
        HasFDerivAt.comp y (hφd (y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)) h1
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id] at h2
      exact h2.mul_const (f t)
    have hmain := hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le (μ := volume) (s := Set.univ)
      (x₀ := x)
      (F := fun y t => b.normed volume (y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t) * f t)
      (F' := fun y t => f t • fderiv ℝ (b.normed volume) (y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t))
      (bound := fun t => C₁ * ‖f t‖)
      Filter.univ_mem (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hFmeas) hFint (hF'meas x)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t y _ => hbound y t) (hf.norm.const_mul C₁)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t y _ => hderiv t y)
    have hF'int : Integrable
        (fun t => f t • fderiv ℝ (b.normed volume) (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)) volume :=
      (hf.norm.const_mul C₁).mono' (hF'meas x) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => hbound x t)
    have hfe : fcrMoll b f = fun y => ∫ t, b.normed volume (y + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t) * f t := rfl
    show fderiv ℝ (fcrMoll b f) x (e a) = _
    rw [hfe, hmain.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.integral_apply hF'int]
    congr 1
    funext t
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    unfold partialDeriv
    ring
  
  have hker : ∀ p : E3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t => b.normed volume (p - t)) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (fun t => b.normed volume (p - t)) ∧
      tsupport (fun t => b.normed volume (p - t)) ⊆ Metric.closedBall p b.rOut ∧
      ∀ (a : Fin 3) (t : E3), partialDeriv a (fun t => b.normed volume (p - t)) t =
        -partialDeriv a (b.normed volume) (p - t) := by
    intro p
    have hsupp : Function.support (fun t => b.normed volume (p - t)) ⊆ Metric.ball p b.rOut := by
      intro t ht
      have h : p - t ∈ Function.support (b.normed volume) := ht
      rw [b.support_normed_eq] at h
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev]
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, sub_zero] at h
    have hts : tsupport (fun t => b.normed volume (p - t)) ⊆ Metric.closedBall p b.rOut :=
      closure_minimal (hsupp.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall) Metric.isClosed_closedBall
    refine ⟨hφs.comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_id), ?_, hts, ?_⟩
    · exact (isCompact_closedBall p b.rOut).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) hts
    · intro a t
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun t : E3 => p - t) (-ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3) t :=
        (hasFDerivAt_id t).const_sub p
      have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun t => b.normed volume (p - t))
          ((fderiv ℝ (b.normed volume) (p - t)).comp (-ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)) t :=
        (hφd (p - t)).comp t h1
      show fderiv ℝ (fun t => b.normed volume (p - t)) t (e a) =
        -fderiv ℝ (b.normed volume) (p - t) (e a)
      rw [h3.fderiv]
      simp
  
  have hgeo : ∀ x : E3, -b.rOut < x 0 → x ∈ Metric.ball c (ρ - 3 * b.rOut) →
      Metric.closedBall (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0) b.rOut ⊆ fcrHalf c ρ := by
    intro x hx0 hxc t ht
    have hr := b.rOut_pos
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at ht
    have hcoord : |t 0 - x 0 - 2 * b.rOut| ≤ b.rOut := by
      have h := PiLp.norm_apply_le (t - (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0)) 0
      rw [← dist_eq_norm] at h
      have h' : (t - (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0)).ofLp 0 = t 0 - x 0 - 2 * b.rOut := by
        simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, sub_sub]
      rw [h', Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
      linarith
    have hpx : dist (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0) x = 2 * b.rOut := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one,
        mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    have hxc' := Metric.mem_ball.mp hxc
    show t ∈ Metric.ball c ρ ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      have h1 := dist_triangle t (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0) c
      have h2 := dist_triangle (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0) x c
      linarith
    · show 0 < t 0
      linarith [(abs_le.mp hcoord).1]
  
  have hHo : IsOpen (fcrHalf c ρ) := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  have hHm : MeasurableSet (fcrHalf c ρ) := hHo.measurableSet
  have hHsub : fcrHalf c ρ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ := fun x hx => hx.1
  have hHfin : volume (fcrHalf c ρ) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ((measure_mono hHsub).trans_lt measure_ball_lt_top).ne
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c ρ)) := isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hHfin
  have hint : ∀ L : List (Fin 3), L.length ≤ k → Integrable ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator (D L)) := by
    intro L hL
    exact (integrable_indicator_iff hHm).mpr ((hD.2.1 L hL).integrable (by norm_num))
  have hw : Integrable ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator w) := by
    have h := hint [] (by simp)
    rwa [hD.1] at h
  
  have hstep : ∀ (L : List (Fin 3)) (a : Fin 3), L.length < k → ∀ x : E3, -b.rOut < x 0 →
      x ∈ Metric.ball c (ρ - 3 * b.rOut) →
      partialDeriv a (fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator (D L))) x =
        fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator (D (a :: L))) x := by
    intro L a hL x hx0 hxc
    obtain ⟨hζs, hζc, hζt, hζd⟩ := hker (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0)
    have hζH := hζt.trans (hgeo x hx0 hxc)
    have hvan : ∀ t, t ∉ fcrHalf c ρ → b.normed volume (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t) = 0 ∧
        partialDeriv a (fun t => b.normed volume (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)) t = 0 := by
      intro t ht
      have ht' : t ∉ tsupport (fun t => b.normed volume (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)) :=
        fun h => ht (hζH h)
      refine ⟨image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (f := fun t =>
        b.normed volume (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)) ht', ?_⟩
      have h2 : t ∉ tsupport (fderiv ℝ (fun t => b.normed volume (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t))) :=
        fun h => ht' (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ h)
      show fderiv ℝ (fun t => b.normed volume (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)) t (e a) = 0
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport h2, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    have hweak := hD.2.2 L a hL _ hζs hζc hζH
    rw [hpd _ (hint L hL.le) a x]
    calc ∫ t, partialDeriv a (b.normed volume) (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t) *
          (fcrHalf c ρ).indicator (D L) t
        = ∫ t, -(D L t * partialDeriv a
            (fun t => b.normed volume (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)) t) := by
          congr 1
          funext t
          by_cases ht : t ∈ fcrHalf c ρ
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht, hζd]
            ring
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht, (hvan t ht).2]
            ring
      _ = -∫ t, D L t * partialDeriv a
            (fun t => b.normed volume (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t)) t := integral_neg _
      _ = ∫ t, D (a :: L) t * b.normed volume (x + (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 - t) := by
          rw [hweak, neg_neg]
      _ = fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator (D (a :: L))) x := by
          unfold fcrMoll
          congr 1
          funext t
          by_cases ht : t ∈ fcrHalf c ρ
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht]
            ring
          · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht, (hvan t ht).1]
            ring
  
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro L
    induction L with
    | nil => exact hmollC _ hw
    | cons a L ih => exact hpdC a _ ih
  · have hU : IsOpen ({x : E3 | -b.rOut < x 0} ∩ Metric.ball c (ρ - 3 * b.rOut)) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous).inter Metric.isOpen_ball
    intro L
    induction L with
    | nil =>
      intro _ x _ _
      simp only [List.foldr_nil]
      rw [hD.1]
    | cons a L ih =>
      intro hL x hx0 hxc
      have hL' : L.length < k := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hL
        omega
      have hev : L.foldr partialDeriv (fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator w)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator (D L)) := by
        filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds ⟨hx0, hxc⟩] with y hy
        exact ih hL'.le y hy.1 hy.2
      rw [List.foldr_cons]
      show fderiv ℝ (L.foldr partialDeriv (fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator w))) x (e a) = _
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      exact hstep L a hL' x hx0 hxc

(b : ContDiffBump (0 : E3)) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 volume) (S : Set E3) :

signature.name: fcr_moll_L2
signature.statement:
(b : ContDiffBump (0 : E3)) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 volume) (S : Set E3) :
    ∫ x in S, (fcrMoll b f x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x, (f x) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  set φ : E3 → ℝ := b.normed volume with hφdef
  set a : E3 := (2 * b.rOut) • e 0 with hadef
  have hφ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y := fun y => b.nonneg_normed y
  have hφint : Integrable φ volume := b.integrable_normed
  have hφ1 : ∫ y, φ y = 1 := b.integral_normed
  have hφc : Continuous φ := b.continuous_normed
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := b.hasCompactSupport_normed.exists_bound_of_continuous hφc
  have hf2 : Integrable (fun t => f t ^ 2) volume := hf.integrable_sq
  
  have hpt : ∀ x, (fcrMoll b f x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    have hk : Integrable (fun t => φ (x + a - t)) volume := hφint.comp_sub_left (x + a)
    have hk1 : ∫ t, φ (x + a - t) = 1 := by
      rw [integral_sub_left_eq_self φ volume (x + a)]
      exact hφ1
    have hkm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => φ (x + a - t)) volume :=
      (hφc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hkf2 : Integrable (fun t => φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2) volume :=
      hf2.bdd_mul hkm (ae_of_all _ (fun t => hC _))
    have hkf : Integrable (fun t => φ (x + a - t) * f t) volume := by
      refine (hk.add hkf2).mono' (hkm.mul hf.aestronglyMeasurable) (ae_of_all _ (fun t => ?_))
      show ‖φ (x + a - t) * f t‖ ≤ φ (x + a - t) + φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2
      have h0 := hφ0 (x + a - t)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h0]
      have h1 : |f t| ≤ 1 + f t ^ 2 := by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (f t), sq_abs (f t)]
      calc φ (x + a - t) * |f t| ≤ φ (x + a - t) * (1 + f t ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h0
        _ = φ (x + a - t) + φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2 := by ring
    have hmdef : fcrMoll b f x = ∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * f t := rfl
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * (f t - fcrMoll b f x) ^ 2 :=
      integral_nonneg (fun t => mul_nonneg (hφ0 _) (sq_nonneg _))
    have hexp : ∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * (f t - fcrMoll b f x) ^ 2 =
        (∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2) - 2 * fcrMoll b f x * (∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * f t)
          + fcrMoll b f x ^ 2 * ∫ t, φ (x + a - t) := by
      have e : (fun t => φ (x + a - t) * (f t - fcrMoll b f x) ^ 2) = fun t =>
          (φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2 - (2 * fcrMoll b f x) * (φ (x + a - t) * f t))
            + fcrMoll b f x ^ 2 * φ (x + a - t) := by
        funext t; ring
      have i1 : Integrable (fun t => φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2
          - (2 * fcrMoll b f x) * (φ (x + a - t) * f t)) volume := hkf2.sub (hkf.const_mul _)
      have i2 : Integrable (fun t => fcrMoll b f x ^ 2 * φ (x + a - t)) volume := hk.const_mul _
      have i3 : Integrable (fun t => (2 * fcrMoll b f x) * (φ (x + a - t) * f t)) volume :=
        hkf.const_mul _
      rw [e, integral_add i1 i2, integral_sub hkf2 i3, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    rw [hexp, hk1, ← hmdef] at hnn
    nlinarith
  
  have hconv : ∀ y, convolution (fun t => f t ^ 2) φ (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume y =
      ∫ t, φ (y - t) * f t ^ 2 := by
    intro y
    rw [convolution_def]
    congr 1
    funext t
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply']
    ring
  have hKint : Integrable
      (convolution (fun t => f t ^ 2) φ (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume) volume :=
    hf2.integrable_convolution _ hφint
  have hN : Integrable (fun x => ∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2) volume := by
    refine (hKint.comp_add_right a).congr (ae_of_all _ (fun x => ?_))
    exact hconv (x + a)
  have hNval : ∫ x, (∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2) = ∫ x, f x ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : (fun x => ∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2) = fun x =>
        convolution (fun t => f t ^ 2) φ (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume (x + a) :=
      funext fun x => (hconv (x + a)).symm
    rw [h1, integral_add_right_eq_self
      (fun y => convolution (fun t => f t ^ 2) φ (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ) volume y) a,
      integral_convolution _ hf2 hφint, hφ1, ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply', mul_one]
  
  have hNnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2 :=
    fun x => integral_nonneg (fun t => mul_nonneg (hφ0 _) (sq_nonneg _))
  calc ∫ x in S, (fcrMoll b f x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in S, (∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2) :=
        integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ (fun x => sq_nonneg _)) hN.restrict (ae_of_all _ hpt)
    _ ≤ ∫ x, (∫ t, φ (x + a - t) * f t ^ 2) := setIntegral_le_integral hN (ae_of_all _ hNnn)
    _ = ∫ x, (f x) ^ 2 := hNval

    (hb : Tendsto (fun j => (b j).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0)) :

signature.name: fcr_moll_weak_limit
signature.statement:
(g : E3 → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g) (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ)
    (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ) (b : ℕ → ContDiffBump (0 : E3))
    (hb : Tendsto (fun j => (b j).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, fcrMoll (b j) g x * ψ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, g x * ψ x))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  have hadj : ∀ (bb : ContDiffBump (0 : E3)) (k : E3 → ℝ), Continuous k → HasCompactSupport k →
      ∫ x, MeasureTheory.convolution (bb.normed MeasureTheory.volume) g
          (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume x * k x =
        ∫ y, g y * MeasureTheory.convolution (bb.normed MeasureTheory.volume) k
          (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume y := by
    intro bb k hk hkc
    have hφi : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (bb.normed (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3)) :=
      bb.integrable_normed
    have hconv : ∀ (u : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3),
        MeasureTheory.convolution (bb.normed (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3)) u
            (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume x =
          ∫ t, bb.normed (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3) (x - t) * u t := by
      intro u x
      rw [MeasureTheory.convolution_lsmul_swap]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hk.bounded_above_of_compact_support hkc
    have hint0 : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun p : E3 × E3 =>
          g p.2 * bb.normed (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3) (p.1 - p.2))
        ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3).prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
      have := hg.convolution_integrand (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) hφi
        (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (ν := MeasureTheory.volume)
      simpa using this
    have hint : MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (Function.uncurry fun x t =>
          g t * bb.normed (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3) (x - t) * k x)
        ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3).prod MeasureTheory.volume) := by
      have := hint0.mul_bdd (c := C) (hk.comp continuous_fst).aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => hC p.1)
      exact this
    calc ∫ x, MeasureTheory.convolution (bb.normed MeasureTheory.volume) g
          (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume x * k x
        = ∫ x, ∫ t, g t * bb.normed (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3) (x - t)
            * k x := by
          congr 1; funext x; rw [hconv, ← MeasureTheory.integral_mul_const]; congr 1; funext t
          ring
      _ = ∫ t, ∫ x, g t * bb.normed (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3) (x - t)
            * k x :=
          MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap hint
      _ = ∫ t, g t * MeasureTheory.convolution (bb.normed MeasureTheory.volume) k
          (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume t := by
          congr 1; funext t; rw [hconv, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]; congr 1; funext x
          rw [show bb.normed (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3) (t - x) =
              bb.normed (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3) (x - t) by
            rw [← neg_sub, bb.normed_neg]]
          ring
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hψc.exists_bound_of_continuous hψ
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℕ → E3 → ℝ, ∀ j z, K j z = ψ (z - (2 * (b j).rOut) • e 0) :=
    ⟨fun j z => ψ (z - (2 * (b j).rOut) • e 0), fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hKfun : ∀ j, K j = fun z => ψ (z - (2 * (b j).rOut) • e 0) := fun j => funext (hK j)
  have hKc : ∀ j, Continuous (K j) := by
    intro j
    rw [hKfun j]
    exact hψ.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  have hKcs : ∀ j, HasCompactSupport (K j) := by
    intro j
    have h := hψc.comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.subRight ((2 * (b j).rOut) • e 0))
    have hfun : K j = ψ ∘ ⇑(Homeomorph.subRight ((2 * (b j).rOut) • e 0)) := by
      funext z
      rw [hK j z]
      simp [Homeomorph.subRight_apply]
    rw [hfun]
    exact h
  have hKb : ∀ j z, |K j z| ≤ C := by
    intro j z
    rw [hK j z]
    have h := hC (z - (2 * (b j).rOut) • e 0)
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : ℕ → E3 → ℝ, ∀ j, Ψ j = MeasureTheory.convolution
      ((b j).normed MeasureTheory.volume) (K j) (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ)
      MeasureTheory.volume :=
    ⟨fun j => MeasureTheory.convolution ((b j).normed MeasureTheory.volume) (K j)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume, fun _ => rfl⟩
  
  have hrep : ∀ j, ∫ x, fcrMoll (b j) g x * ψ x = ∫ y, g y * Ψ j y := by
    intro j
    have h1 : ∀ x, fcrMoll (b j) g x * ψ x =
        MeasureTheory.convolution ((b j).normed MeasureTheory.volume) g
          (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume (x + (2 * (b j).rOut) • e 0) *
          K j (x + (2 * (b j).rOut) • e 0) := by
      intro x
      rw [hK j, add_sub_cancel_right, MeasureTheory.convolution_lsmul_swap]
      rfl
    have h2 := MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)
      (fun y => MeasureTheory.convolution ((b j).normed MeasureTheory.volume) g
          (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) MeasureTheory.volume y * K j y)
      ((2 * (b j).rOut) • e 0)
    simp only at h2
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h1), h2, hΨ j]
    exact hadj (b j) (K j) (hKc j) (hKcs j)
  
  have hbound : ∀ j y, |Ψ j y| ≤ 3 * C := by
    intro j y
    have hd : dist (Ψ j y) (K j y) ≤ 2 * C := by
      rw [hΨ j]
      apply ContDiffBump.dist_normed_convolution_le (hKc j).aestronglyMeasurable
      intro x _
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hKb j x)
      obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hKb j y)
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hd
    obtain ⟨a1, a2⟩ := abs_le.mp hd
    obtain ⟨b1, b2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hKb j y)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hlim : ∀ y, Tendsto (fun j => Ψ j y) atTop (𝓝 (ψ y)) := by
    intro y
    have hv : Tendsto (fun j => (2 * (b j).rOut) • e 0) atTop (𝓝 (0 : E3)) := by
      have h := (hb.const_mul 2).smul_const (e 0)
      simpa using h
    have hjoint : Tendsto (Function.uncurry K) (atTop ×ˢ 𝓝 y) (𝓝 (ψ y)) := by
      have h1 : Tendsto (fun p : ℕ × E3 => p.2 - (2 * (b p.1).rOut) • e 0)
          (atTop ×ˢ 𝓝 y) (𝓝 (y - 0)) :=
        tendsto_snd.sub (hv.comp tendsto_fst)
      rw [sub_zero] at h1
      have h2 := (hψ.tendsto y).comp h1
      refine h2.congr (fun p => ?_)
      show ψ (p.2 - (2 * (b p.1).rOut) • e 0) = K p.1 p.2
      rw [hK]
    have h := ContDiffBump.convolution_tendsto_right (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (φ := b)
      (g := K) (k := fun _ => y) hb
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun j => (hKc j).aestronglyMeasurable) hjoint
      tendsto_const_nhds
    refine h.congr (fun j => ?_)
    rw [hΨ j]
  
  have hΨc : ∀ j, Continuous (Ψ j) := by
    intro j
    rw [hΨ j]
    exact (b j).hasCompactSupport_normed.continuous_convolution_left
      (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) (b j).continuous_normed (hKc j).locallyIntegrable
  have hdct : Tendsto (fun j => ∫ y, g y * Ψ j y) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y, g y * ψ y)) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun y => ‖g y‖ * (3 * C)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro j
      exact hg.aestronglyMeasurable.mul (hΨc j).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact hg.norm.mul_const _
    · intro j
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_)
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (Ψ j y)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound j y) (norm_nonneg _)
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => (hlim y).const_mul (g y))
  
  exact hdct.congr (fun j => (hrep j).symm)

informal_problem.statement:
(τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : E3) (g : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ ∞ g →
      {z : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, y i ≤ z i ∧ z i ≤ y i + τ} ⊆ U →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y‖ ≤ ∑ L : Fin m → Fin 3, Real.sqrt (K *
        (([[], [0], [1], [1, 0], [2], [2, 0], [2, 1], [2, 1, 0]] : List (List (Fin 3))).map
          (fun S => ∫ z in {z : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, y i < z i ∧ z i < y i + τ},
            ((S ++ List.ofFn L).foldr partialDeriv g z) ^ 2)).sum)

signature.name: fcr_box_jet_bound
signature.statement:
(τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : E3) (g : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ ∞ g →
      {z : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, y i ≤ z i ∧ z i ≤ y i + τ} ⊆ U →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y‖ ≤ ∑ L : Fin m → Fin 3, Real.sqrt (K *
        (([[], [0], [1], [1, 0], [2], [2, 0], [2, 1], [2, 1, 0]] : List (List (Fin 3))).map
          (fun S => ∫ z in {z : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, y i < z i ∧ z i < y i + τ},
            ((S ++ List.ofFn L).foldr partialDeriv g z) ^ 2)).sum)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨K, hK0, hK⟩ := box_sobolev_sup τ hτ
  refine ⟨K, hK0, ?_⟩
  intro m y g U hU hg hbox
  have hyU : y ∈ U := hbox (fun i => ⟨le_rfl, by linarith⟩)
  have hsm : ∀ L' : List (Fin 3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (L'.foldr partialDeriv g) := by
    intro L'
    induction L' with
    | nil => simpa using hg
    | cons a L'' ih =>
      rw [List.foldr_cons]
      have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (L''.foldr partialDeriv g)) :=
        (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp ih).2
      have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ (L''.foldr partialDeriv g) x (e a)) :=
        h1.clm_apply contDiff_const
      exact h2
  refine (iteratedFDeriv_norm_le_partials U hU g hg.contDiffOn m y hyU).trans ?_
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun L _ => ?_)
  apply Real.abs_le_sqrt
  have h := hK y ((List.ofFn L).foldr partialDeriv g) U hU (hsm _).contDiffOn hbox
  simpa only [List.foldr_append] using h

subgoal_signatures.name: box_sobolev_sup
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (z : E3) (g : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U →
      {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, z i ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ z i + τ} ⊆ U →
      g z ^ 2 ≤ K * (([[], [0], [1], [1, 0], [2], [2, 0], [2, 1], [2, 1, 0]] :
          List (List (Fin 3))).map
        (fun S => ∫ y in {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, z i < y i ∧ y i < z i + τ},
          (S.foldr partialDeriv g y) ^ 2)).sum

informal_problem.statement:
∃ A : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ (u : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → ∀ B : ℕ → ℝ,
    (∀ (m : ℕ) (y : E3), 0 ≤ y 0 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u y‖ ≤ B m) →
    ∃ U : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ U ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ) (y : E3), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m U y‖ ≤ A m * B m) ∧
