signature.name: fcr_seeley_package
signature.statement:
∃ A : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ (u : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ u → ∀ B : ℕ → ℝ,
    (∀ (m : ℕ) (y : E3), 0 ≤ y 0 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u y‖ ≤ B m) →
    ∃ U : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ U ∧ (∀ (m : ℕ) (y : E3), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m U y‖ ≤ A m * B m) ∧
      ∀ y : E3, 0 ≤ y 0 → U y = u y

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hbound, hsum⟩ := seeley_weight_bound
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hmom⟩ := seeley_weights_limit
    (fun i => Real.exp 4 * (4:ℝ) ^ i * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (i * (i + 1) / 2))
    (fun K i => if i < K then ∏ j ∈ (Finset.range K).erase i,
        ((-1 - (2:ℝ) ^ j) / ((2:ℝ) ^ i - (2:ℝ) ^ j)) else 0)
    hsum
    (by
      intro K i
      by_cases h : i < K
      · simp only [if_pos h]
        exact hbound K i h
      · simp only [if_neg h, abs_zero]
        positivity)
    (by
      intro K i h
      simp only [if_neg (not_lt.mpr h)])
    (by
      intro K p hp
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (seeley_weight_moment K p hp)
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro i hi
      simp only [if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)])
  have hid := seeley_multilinear_identity a ha hmom
  have hglue : ∀ (m : ℕ) (h : E3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => E3) ℝ)
      (Q : E3 → E3 →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => E3) ℝ),
      Continuous h → Continuous Q → (∀ y : E3, y 0 ≠ 0 → HasFDerivAt h (Q y) y) →
      ∀ y : E3, HasFDerivAt h (Q y) y :=
    fun m h Q hh hQ hoff y => halfspace_hasFDerivAt_glue h Q hh hQ hoff y
  refine ⟨fun m => 1 + ∑' k : ℕ, |a k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ m, ?_⟩
  intro u hu B hB
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hUb, hUe⟩ := seeley_halfspace_extension a ha hid hglue u hu B hB
  refine ⟨U, hU, hUb, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have h0 := congrArg (fun T => T (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → E3)) (hUe 0 y hy)
  simpa only [iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply] using h0

subgoal_signatures.name: seeley_weight_moment
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(K p : ℕ) (hp : p < K) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, (∏ j ∈ (Finset.range K).erase i,
        ((-1 - (2:ℝ) ^ j) / ((2:ℝ) ^ i - (2:ℝ) ^ j))) * (-(2:ℝ) ^ i) ^ p = 1

subgoal_signatures.name: seeley_weights_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(D : ℕ → ℝ) (W : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ p : ℕ, Summable (fun i : ℕ => D i * ((2:ℝ) ^ i) ^ p))
    (hWD : ∀ K i : ℕ, |W K i| ≤ D i) (hW0 : ∀ K i : ℕ, K ≤ i → W K i = 0)
    (hWm : ∀ K p : ℕ, p < K → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range K, W K i * (-(2:ℝ) ^ i) ^ p = 1) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ p : ℕ, Summable (fun k : ℕ => |a k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ p)) ∧
      ∀ p : ℕ, ∑' k : ℕ, a k * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ p = 1

subgoal_signatures.name: seeley_multilinear_identity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ p : ℕ, Summable (fun k : ℕ => |a k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ p))
    (hmom : ∀ p : ℕ, ∑' k : ℕ, a k * (-(2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ p = 1) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => E3) ℝ) (v : Fin m → E3),
      HasSum (fun k : ℕ => a k * T (fun i => v i - ((1 + (2:ℝ) ^ k) * v i 0) • e 0)) (T v)

subgoal_signatures.name: halfspace_hasFDerivAt_glue
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    (h : E3 → X) (Q : E3 → E3 →L[ℝ] X) (hh : Continuous h) (hQ : Continuous Q)
    (hoff : ∀ y : E3, y 0 ≠ 0 → HasFDerivAt h (Q y) y) (y : E3) :
    HasFDerivAt h (Q y) y

subgoal_signatures.name: seeley_halfspace_extension
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(a : ℕ → ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ p : ℕ, Summable (fun k : ℕ => |a k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ p))
    (hid : ∀ (m : ℕ) (T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => E3) ℝ) (v : Fin m → E3),
      HasSum (fun k : ℕ => a k * T (fun i => v i - ((1 + (2:ℝ) ^ k) * v i 0) • e 0)) (T v))
    (hglue : ∀ (m : ℕ) (h : E3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => E3) ℝ)
      (Q : E3 → E3 →L[ℝ] ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => E3) ℝ),
      Continuous h → Continuous Q → (∀ y : E3, y 0 ≠ 0 → HasFDerivAt h (Q y) y) →
      ∀ y : E3, HasFDerivAt h (Q y) y)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : E3), 0 ≤ y 0 → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w y‖ ≤ B m) :
    ∃ W : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ W ∧
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (y : E3), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m W y‖ ≤ (1 + ∑' k : ℕ, |a k| * ((2:ℝ) ^ k) ^ m) * B m) ∧
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : E3), 0 ≤ y 0 → iteratedFDeriv ℝ m W y = iteratedFDeriv ℝ m w y

informal_problem.statement:
(O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (w v' : E3 → ℝ) (hw : IntegrableOn w O)
    (hv' : Continuous v') (M : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (hM : ∀ k, Continuous (M k)) (B : ℝ)
    (hbd : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ O, |M k x| ≤ B)
    (hpt : ∀ x ∈ O, Tendsto (fun k => M k x) atTop (𝓝 (v' x)))
    (hweak : ∀ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ O →
      Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, M k x * ψ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, w x * ψ x))) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict O), w x = v' x

signature.name: fcr_ae_identify
signature.statement:
(O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (w v' : E3 → ℝ) (hw : IntegrableOn w O)
    (hv' : Continuous v') (M : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (hM : ∀ k, Continuous (M k)) (B : ℝ)
    (hbd : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ O, |M k x| ≤ B)
    (hpt : ∀ x ∈ O, Tendsto (fun k => M k x) atTop (𝓝 (v' x)))
    (hweak : ∀ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ O →
      Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, M k x * ψ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, w x * ψ x))) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict O), w x = v' x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hOm : MeasurableSet O := hO.measurableSet
  have key : ∀ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ O →
      ∫ x, ψ x • (w - v') x = 0 := by
    intro ψ hψ hψc hψs
    have hψcont : Continuous ψ := hψ.continuous
    have hoff : ∀ x, x ∉ O → ψ x = 0 := fun x hx =>
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hψs h))
    have hbint : Integrable (fun x => B * |ψ x|) :=
      ((hψcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hψc).abs).const_mul B
    have hdct : Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, M k x * ψ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, v' x * ψ x)) := by
      refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun x => B * |ψ x|)
        (fun k => ((hM k).mul hψcont).aestronglyMeasurable) hbint ?_ ?_
      · intro k
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
        by_cases hx : x ∈ O
        · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hbd k x hx) (abs_nonneg _)
        · simp [hoff x hx]
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
        by_cases hx : x ∈ O
        · exact (hpt x hx).mul_const (ψ x)
        · simp only [hoff x hx, mul_zero]
          exact tendsto_const_nhds
    have heq : ∫ x, w x * ψ x = ∫ x, v' x * ψ x :=
      tendsto_nhds_unique (hweak ψ hψ hψc hψs) hdct
    have hv'int : Integrable (fun x => v' x * ψ x) :=
      (hv'.mul hψcont).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hψc.mul_left
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hψc.exists_bound_of_continuous hψcont
    have hwind : Integrable (O.indicator w) := (integrable_indicator_iff hOm).mpr hw
    have hwint : Integrable (fun x => w x * ψ x) := by
      have h1 : Integrable (fun x => O.indicator w x * ψ x) :=
        hwind.mul_bdd hψcont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hC)
      refine h1.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
      by_cases hx : x ∈ O
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      · simp [hoff x hx]
    have hfun : (fun x => ψ x • (w - v') x) = fun x => w x * ψ x - v' x * ψ x := by
      funext x
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, Pi.sub_apply]
      ring
    rw [hfun, integral_sub hwint hv'int, heq, sub_self]
  have hloc : LocallyIntegrableOn (w - v') O volume :=
    hw.locallyIntegrableOn.sub (hv'.locallyIntegrable.locallyIntegrableOn O)
  have h := hO.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero hloc key
  rw [ae_restrict_iff' hOm]
  filter_upwards [h] with x hx hxO
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hx hxO)

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) :
    (∃ D, fcrSob c s (k + 1) φ D) ↔
      (MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧
        ∀ a : Fin 3, ∃ ψ : E3 → ℝ, fcrWD c s φ a ψ ∧ ∃ D, fcrSob c s k ψ D)

signature.name: fcr_sob_succ_iff
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) :
    (∃ D, fcrSob c s (k + 1) φ D) ↔
      (MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧
        ∀ a : Fin 3, ∃ ψ : E3 → ℝ, fcrWD c s φ a ψ ∧ ∃ D, fcrSob c s k ψ D)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨D, hD0, hD2, hD3⟩
    refine ⟨by rw [← hD0]; exact hD2 [] (Nat.zero_le _),
      fun a => ⟨D [a], ?_, fun L => D (L ++ [a]), rfl, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · intro ζ h1 h2 h3
      have := hD3 [] a (Nat.succ_pos k) ζ h1 h2 h3
      rw [hD0] at this
      exact this
    · intro L hL
      apply hD2
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
      omega
    · intro L b hL ζ h1 h2 h3
      exact hD3 (L ++ [a]) b
        (by simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]; omega) ζ h1 h2 h3
  · rintro ⟨hφ, h⟩
    choose ψ hψ D' hD' using h
    let D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ := fun L =>
      if hL : L = [] then φ else D' (L.getLast hL) L.dropLast
    have R0 : D [] = φ := by simp [D]
    have R1 : ∀ (L' : List (Fin 3)) (a : Fin 3), D (L' ++ [a]) = D' a L' := by
      intro L' a
      simp [D]
    refine ⟨D, R0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro L hL
      rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat' L with rfl | ⟨L', a, rfl⟩
      · rw [R0]; exact hφ
      · rw [R1]
        apply (hD' a).2.1
        simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hL
        omega
    · intro L b hL ζ h1 h2 h3
      rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat' L with rfl | ⟨L', a, rfl⟩
      · rw [R0, show D [b] = ψ b from (R1 [] b).trans (hD' b).1]
        exact hψ b ζ h1 h2 h3
      · rw [show D (b :: (L' ++ [a])) = D' a (b :: L') from R1 (b :: L') a, R1]
        refine (hD' a).2.2 L' b ?_ ζ h1 h2 h3
        simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hL
        omega

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (s s' : ℝ) (hss : s' ≤ s) :
    (∀ (k k' : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ), k' ≤ k →
      fcrSob c s k φ D → fcrSob c s' k' φ D) ∧
    (∀ (φ ψ : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3), fcrWD c s φ a ψ → fcrWD c s' φ a ψ) ∧
    (∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s')))

signature.name: fcr_sob_mono
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (s s' : ℝ) (hss : s' ≤ s) :
    (∀ (k k' : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ), k' ≤ k →
      fcrSob c s k φ D → fcrSob c s' k' φ D) ∧
    (∀ (φ ψ : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3), fcrWD c s φ a ψ → fcrWD c s' φ a ψ) ∧
    (∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s')))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hsub : fcrHalf c s' ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball hss hx.1, hx.2⟩
  have hμ : volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s') ≤ volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s) :=
    Measure.restrict_mono_set volume hsub
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k k' φ D hk hD
    obtain ⟨h0, hL, hI⟩ := hD
    exact ⟨h0, fun L hLk => (hL L (le_trans hLk hk)).mono_measure hμ,
      fun L a hLk ζ h1 h2 h3 => hI L a (lt_of_lt_of_le hLk hk) ζ h1 h2 (h3.trans hsub)⟩
  · intro φ ψ a h ζ h1 h2 h3
    exact h ζ h1 h2 (h3.trans hsub)
  · intro φ h
    exact h.mono_measure hμ

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ) (D₁ D₂ : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
    (h₁ : fcrSob c s k φ₁ D₁) (h₂ : fcrSob c s k φ₂ D₂) :
    fcrSob c s k (fun x => φ₁ x + φ₂ x) (fun L x => D₁ L x + D₂ L x)

signature.name: fcr_sob_add
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ) (D₁ D₂ : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
    (h₁ : fcrSob c s k φ₁ D₁) (h₂ : fcrSob c s k φ₂ D₂) :
    fcrSob c s k (fun x => φ₁ x + φ₂ x) (fun L x => D₁ L x + D₂ L x)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hint : ∀ f g : E3 → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → Continuous g →
      HasCompactSupport g → Function.support g ⊆ fcrHalf c s →
      Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) := by
    intro f g hf hgc hgcs hsupp
    have hg2 : MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure E3) := hgc.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hgcs
    have hg2' : MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := hg2.restrict _
    have hI : Integrable (f * g) (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := hf.integrable_mul hg2'
    have hs : Function.support (fun x => f x * g x) ⊆ fcrHalf c s :=
      (Function.support_mul_subset_right f g).trans hsupp
    exact (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset hs).1 hI
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show (fun x => D₁ [] x + D₂ [] x) = _
    rw [h₁.1, h₂.1]
  · intro L hL
    exact (h₁.2.1 L hL).add (h₂.2.1 L hL)
  · intro L a hL ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have hLa : (a :: L).length ≤ k := by simp; omega
    have hζsupp : Function.support ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := (subset_tsupport ζ).trans hζs
    have hdc : Continuous (partialDeriv a ζ) :=
      (hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hdcs : HasCompactSupport (partialDeriv a ζ) := hζc.fderiv_apply ℝ (e a)
    have hdsupp : Function.support (partialDeriv a ζ) ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
      intro x hx
      apply hζs
      apply support_fderiv_subset ℝ
      intro h0
      apply hx
      show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e a) = 0
      rw [h0]
      rfl
    have I₁ := hint (D₁ L) (partialDeriv a ζ) (h₁.2.1 L hL.le) hdc hdcs hdsupp
    have I₂ := hint (D₂ L) (partialDeriv a ζ) (h₂.2.1 L hL.le) hdc hdcs hdsupp
    have J₁ := hint (D₁ (a :: L)) ζ (h₁.2.1 (a :: L) hLa) hζ.continuous hζc hζsupp
    have J₂ := hint (D₂ (a :: L)) ζ (h₂.2.1 (a :: L) hLa) hζ.continuous hζc hζsupp
    show ∫ x, (D₁ L x + D₂ L x) * partialDeriv a ζ x =
      -∫ x, (D₁ (a :: L) x + D₂ (a :: L) x) * ζ x
    simp_rw [add_mul]
    rw [integral_add I₁ I₂, integral_add J₁ J₂, h₁.2.2 L a hL ζ hζ hζc hζs,
      h₂.2.2 L a hL ζ hζ hζc hζs, neg_add]

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (m : E3 → ℝ)
    (hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R)) (k : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ)
    (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (hφ : fcrSob c s k φ D) :
    ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x => m x * φ x) D'

signature.name: fcr_sob_smul
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (m : E3 → ℝ)
    (hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R)) (k : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ)
    (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (hφ : fcrSob c s k φ D) :
    ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x => m x * φ x) D'

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hc0 : Continuous (fun x : E3 => x 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
  have hHopen : IsOpen (fcrHalf c s) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc0)
  have hHsub : fcrHalf c s ⊆ Metric.ball c R :=
    fun x hx => Metric.ball_subset_ball hsR.le hx.1
  
  have hpd : ∀ (m' : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m' (Metric.ball c R) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a m') (Metric.ball c R) := by
    intro m' a hm'
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ m' y (e a)) (Metric.ball c R)
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball).1 hm').2.clm_apply
      contDiffOn_const
  
  have hpdsupp : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      Function.support (fun x => partialDeriv a f x) ⊆ tsupport f := by
    intro f a x hx
    simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hx
    apply tsupport_fderiv_subset (𝕜 := ℝ)
    apply subset_tsupport
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    intro h
    exact hx (by simp [partialDeriv, h])
  
  have htest : ∀ m' : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m' (Metric.ball c R) →
      ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => m' x * ζ x) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x => m' x * ζ x) ∧
      tsupport (fun x => m' x * ζ x) ⊆ fcrHalf c s ∧
      ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x : E3), partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x =
        partialDeriv a m' x * ζ x + m' x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
    intro m' hm' ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have hoff : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c R → ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      have h := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h => hx (hHsub (hζs h)))
      filter_upwards [h] with y hy
      simpa using hy
    have hoff2 : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c R →
        (fun y => m' y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      filter_upwards [hoff x hx] with y hy
      simp [hy]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R
      · exact (hm'.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)).mul hζ.contDiffAt
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hoff2 x hx)
    · exact hζc.mul_left
    · exact (tsupport_mul_subset_right).trans hζs
    · intro a x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R
      · have hmd : DifferentiableAt ℝ m' x :=
          (hm'.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)
        have hζd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x := hζ.differentiable (by simp) x
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [fderiv_fun_mul hmd hζd]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · have h1 : partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x = 0 := by
          unfold partialDeriv
          rw [(hoff2 x hx).fderiv_eq]
          simp
        have h2 : partialDeriv a ζ x = 0 := by
          unfold partialDeriv
          rw [(hoff x hx).fderiv_eq]
          simp
        have h3 : ζ x = 0 := (hoff x hx).eq_of_nhds
        rw [h1, h2, h3]
        ring
  
  have hint : ∀ u g : E3 → ℝ, MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → Continuous g →
      HasCompactSupport g → Function.support g ⊆ fcrHalf c s →
      Integrable (fun x => u x * g x) := by
    intro u g hu hg hgc hgs
    have hg2 : MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      (hg.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hgc).restrict _
    have h1 : Integrable (fun x => u x * g x) (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      hu.integrable_mul hg2
    refine (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset ?_).1 h1
    intro x hx
    simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hx
    apply hgs
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    intro h
    exact hx (by simp [h])
  
  have hwd : ∀ m' : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m' (Metric.ball c R) →
      ∀ (φ ψ : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      fcrWD c s φ a ψ →
      fcrWD c s (fun x => m' x * φ x) a (fun x => partialDeriv a m' x * φ x + m' x * ψ x) := by
    intro m' hm' φ ψ a hφ hψ hw ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨hη, hηc, hηs, hprod⟩ := htest m' hm' ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨hξ, hξc, -, -⟩ := htest (partialDeriv a m') (hpd m' a hm') ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have h0 : ∫ x, φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x =
        -∫ x, ψ x * (m' x * ζ x) := hw _ hη hηc hηs
    have hsuppζ : Function.support ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := (subset_tsupport ζ).trans hζs
    have i1 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x) := by
      refine hint φ _ hφ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact (hη.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
      · exact hηc.mono' (hpdsupp _ a)
      · exact (hpdsupp _ a).trans hηs
    have i2 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * (partialDeriv a m' x * ζ x)) := by
      refine hint φ _ hφ hξ.continuous hξc ?_
      intro x hx
      simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hx
      apply hsuppζ
      rw [Function.mem_support]
      intro h
      exact hx (by simp [h])
    have i3 : Integrable (fun x => ψ x * (m' x * ζ x)) :=
      hint ψ _ hψ hη.continuous hηc ((subset_tsupport _).trans hηs)
    have e1 : (fun x => m' x * φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x) =
        fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x -
          φ x * (partialDeriv a m' x * ζ x) := by
      funext x
      rw [hprod a x]
      ring
    have e2 : (fun x => (partialDeriv a m' x * φ x + m' x * ψ x) * ζ x) =
        fun x => φ x * (partialDeriv a m' x * ζ x) + ψ x * (m' x * ζ x) := by
      funext x
      ring
    show ∫ x, m' x * φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x =
      -∫ x, (partialDeriv a m' x * φ x + m' x * ψ x) * ζ x
    rw [e1, e2, integral_sub i1 i2, integral_add i2 i3, h0]
    ring
  
  have hL2 : ∀ m' : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn m' (Metric.ball c R) → ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ,
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp (fun x => m' x * φ x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro m' hm' φ hφ
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall c s).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hm'.mono (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hsR))
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable m' (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      (hm'.mono hHsub).aestronglyMeasurable hHopen.measurableSet
    refine MemLp.of_le_mul (c := C) hφ (hmeas.mul hφ.1) ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' hHopen.measurableSet).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC x (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx.1)) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hmemD : ∀ (j : ℕ) (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (Dψ : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ),
      fcrSob c s j ψ Dψ → MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro j ψ Dψ h
    have h0 := h.2.1 [] (Nat.zero_le _)
    rwa [h.1] at h0
  
  have hlow : ∀ (j : ℕ) (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (Dψ : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ),
      fcrSob c s (j + 1) ψ Dψ → fcrSob c s j ψ Dψ := by
    intro j ψ Dψ h
    exact ⟨h.1, fun L hL => h.2.1 L (by omega), fun L a hL => h.2.2 L a (by omega)⟩
  
  have hadd : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ) (D₁ D₂ : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ),
      fcrSob c s j φ₁ D₁ → fcrSob c s j φ₂ D₂ →
      fcrSob c s j (fun x => φ₁ x + φ₂ x) (fun L x => D₁ L x + D₂ L x) := by
    intro j φ₁ φ₂ D₁ D₂ h₁ h₂
    refine ⟨?_, fun L hL => (h₁.2.1 L hL).add (h₂.2.1 L hL), ?_⟩
    · show (fun x => D₁ [] x + D₂ [] x) = _
      rw [h₁.1, h₂.1]
    · intro L a hL ζ hζ hζc hζs
      have hg1 : Continuous (fun x => partialDeriv a ζ x) :=
        (hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
      have hg2 : HasCompactSupport (fun x => partialDeriv a ζ x) := hζc.mono' (hpdsupp _ a)
      have hg3 : Function.support (fun x => partialDeriv a ζ x) ⊆ fcrHalf c s :=
        (hpdsupp _ a).trans hζs
      have hz3 : Function.support ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := (subset_tsupport ζ).trans hζs
      have j1 := hint (D₁ L) _ (h₁.2.1 L hL.le) hg1 hg2 hg3
      have j2 := hint (D₂ L) _ (h₂.2.1 L hL.le) hg1 hg2 hg3
      have j3 := hint (D₁ (a :: L)) ζ (h₁.2.1 (a :: L) (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)) hζ.continuous hζc hz3
      have j4 := hint (D₂ (a :: L)) ζ (h₂.2.1 (a :: L) (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)) hζ.continuous hζc hz3
      have e1 : (fun x => (D₁ L x + D₂ L x) * partialDeriv a ζ x) =
          fun x => D₁ L x * partialDeriv a ζ x + D₂ L x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
        funext x; ring
      have e2 : (fun x => (D₁ (a :: L) x + D₂ (a :: L) x) * ζ x) =
          fun x => D₁ (a :: L) x * ζ x + D₂ (a :: L) x * ζ x := by
        funext x; ring
      show ∫ x, (D₁ L x + D₂ L x) * partialDeriv a ζ x =
        -∫ x, (D₁ (a :: L) x + D₂ (a :: L) x) * ζ x
      rw [e1, e2, integral_add j1 j2, integral_add j3 j4,
        h₁.2.2 L a hL ζ hζ hζc hζs, h₂.2.2 L a hL ζ hζ hζc hζs]
      ring
  
  have hsucc : ∀ (j : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ),
      (∃ D, fcrSob c s (j + 1) φ D) ↔
        (MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧
          ∀ a : Fin 3, ∃ ψ : E3 → ℝ, fcrWD c s φ a ψ ∧ ∃ D, fcrSob c s j ψ D) := by
    intro j φ
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨D, hD0, hD2, hD3⟩
      refine ⟨by rw [← hD0]; exact hD2 [] (Nat.zero_le _),
        fun a => ⟨D [a], ?_, fun L => D (L ++ [a]), rfl, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · intro ζ h1 h2 h3
        have := hD3 [] a (Nat.succ_pos j) ζ h1 h2 h3
        rw [hD0] at this
        exact this
      · intro L hL
        apply hD2
        simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
        omega
      · intro L b hL ζ h1 h2 h3
        exact hD3 (L ++ [a]) b
          (by simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]; omega) ζ h1 h2 h3
    · rintro ⟨hφ, h⟩
      choose ψ hψ D' hD' using h
      let D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ := fun L =>
        if hL : L = [] then φ else D' (L.getLast hL) L.dropLast
      have R0 : D [] = φ := by simp [D]
      have R1 : ∀ (L' : List (Fin 3)) (a : Fin 3), D (L' ++ [a]) = D' a L' := by
        intro L' a
        simp [D]
      refine ⟨D, R0, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro L hL
        rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat' L with rfl | ⟨L', a, rfl⟩
        · rw [R0]; exact hφ
        · rw [R1]
          apply (hD' a).2.1
          simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hL
          omega
      · intro L b hL ζ h1 h2 h3
        rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat' L with rfl | ⟨L', a, rfl⟩
        · rw [R0, show D [b] = ψ b from (R1 [] b).trans (hD' b).1]
          exact hψ b ζ h1 h2 h3
        · rw [show D (b :: (L' ++ [a])) = D' a (b :: L') from R1 (b :: L') a, R1]
          refine (hD' a).2.2 L' b ?_ ζ h1 h2 h3
          simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hL
          omega
  induction k generalizing m φ D with
  | zero =>
    exact ⟨fun _ => fun x => m x * φ x, rfl,
      fun _ _ => hL2 m hm.continuousOn φ (hmemD 0 φ D hφ),
      fun _ _ hL => absurd hL (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hφL, hder⟩ := (hsucc k φ).1 ⟨D, hφ⟩
    refine (hsucc k (fun x => m x * φ x)).2
      ⟨hL2 m hm.continuousOn φ hφL, fun a => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψw, Dψ, hψ⟩ := hder a
    refine ⟨fun x => partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x,
      hwd m hm φ ψ a hφL (hmemD k ψ Dψ hψ) hψw, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨D₁, h₁⟩ := ih (partialDeriv a m) (hpd m a hm) φ D (hlow k φ D hφ)
    obtain ⟨D₂, h₂⟩ := ih m hm ψ Dψ hψ
    exact ⟨_, hadd k (fun x => partialDeriv a m x * φ x) (fun x => m x * ψ x)
      D₁ D₂ h₁ h₂⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (m : E3 → ℝ)
    (hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R)) (k : ℕ) : ∃ D, fcrSob c s k m D

signature.name: fcr_smooth_sob
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (m : E3 → ℝ)
    (hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R)) (k : ℕ) : ∃ D, fcrSob c s k m D

proof.tactics:
by
  have hB : IsOpen (Metric.ball c R) := Metric.isOpen_ball
  
  have hiter : ∀ L : List (Fin 3),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (L.foldr (fun a f => partialDeriv a f) m) (Metric.ball c R) := by
    intro L
    induction L with
    | nil => simpa using hm
    | cons a L ih =>
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun y => fderiv ℝ (L.foldr (fun a f => partialDeriv a f) m) y (e a)) (Metric.ball c R)
      exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hB).1 ih).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hcoord : Continuous (fun x : E3 => x 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
  have hHopen : IsOpen (fcrHalf c s) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hcoord)
  have hHsub : fcrHalf c s ⊆ Metric.ball c R :=
    Set.inter_subset_left.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball hsR.le)
  have hmem : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f (Metric.ball c R) →
      MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro f hf
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
      rw [isFiniteMeasure_restrict]
      exact (lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_left) measure_ball_lt_top).ne
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall c s).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hf.mono (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hsR))
    refine MemLp.of_bound ((hf.mono hHsub).aestronglyMeasurable hHopen.measurableSet) C ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hHopen.measurableSet (fun x hx => hC x ?_)
    exact Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx.1
  
  have hibp : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Metric.ball c R) → ∀ (a : Fin 3) (ζ : E3 → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s →
      ∫ x, f x * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, partialDeriv a f x * ζ x := by
    intro f hf a ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have hKB : tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c R := hζs.trans hHsub
    have hcases : ∀ x, x ∈ Metric.ball c R ∨ x ∉ tsupport ζ := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ tsupport ζ
      · exact Or.inl (hKB hx)
      · exact Or.inr hx
    have hfx : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x :=
      fun x hx => hf.contDiffAt (hB.mem_nhds hx)
    have hzeta0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 :=
      fun x hx => notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hx
    have hloc : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → ∀ g : E3 → ℝ,
        (fun y => g y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      intro x hx g
      filter_upwards [hzeta0 x hx] with y hy
      simp [hy]
    have hdζ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → partialDeriv a ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      intro x hx
      have hopen : IsOpen (tsupport ζ)ᶜ := (isClosed_tsupport ζ).isOpen_compl
      filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
      show fderiv ℝ ζ y (e a) = 0
      rw [(hzeta0 y hy).fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => f x * ζ x) := by
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro x
      rcases hcases x with hx | hx
      · exact (hfx x hx).mul hζ.contDiffAt
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hloc x hx f)
    have hhc : HasCompactSupport (fun x => f x * ζ x) := hζc.mul_left
    have hhd : Differentiable ℝ (fun x => f x * ζ x) := hh.differentiable (by simp)
    have hint1 : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun x => f x * ζ x) x (e a)) (volume : Measure E3) :=
      ((hh.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hhc.fderiv_apply ℝ (e a))
    have hint2 : Integrable (fun x => f x * ζ x) (volume : Measure E3) :=
      hh.continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hhc
    have h0 := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := (volume : Measure E3))
      (f := fun _ : E3 => (1 : ℝ)) (g := fun x => f x * ζ x) (v := e a)
      (by simp) (by simpa using hint1) (by simpa using hint2) (differentiable_const _) hhd
    simp only [one_mul, fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, zero_mul,
      integral_zero, neg_zero] at h0
    have hprod : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ (fun x => f x * ζ x) x (e a) =
        partialDeriv a f x * ζ x + f x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
      intro x
      rcases hcases x with hx | hx
      · have hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x := (hfx x hx).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x := hζ.differentiable (by simp) x
        have e1 : fderiv ℝ (fun x => f x * ζ x) x = f x • fderiv ℝ ζ x + ζ x • fderiv ℝ f x :=
          (hd1.hasFDerivAt.mul hd2.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
        rw [e1]
        simp only [partialDeriv, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
          smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · rw [(hloc x hx f).fderiv_eq]
        have h1 : ζ x = 0 := by simpa using (hzeta0 x hx).eq_of_nhds
        have h2 : partialDeriv a ζ x = 0 := (hdζ0 x hx).eq_of_nhds
        simp [h1, h2]
    have hdζc : Continuous (partialDeriv a ζ) :=
      (hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hPc : Continuous (fun x => partialDeriv a f x * ζ x) := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      rcases hcases x with hx | hx
      · have hcf : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e a)) (Metric.ball c R) :=
          ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hB).1 hf).2.continuousOn.clm_apply
            continuousOn_const
        have : ContinuousAt (partialDeriv a f) x := hcf.continuousAt (hB.mem_nhds hx)
        exact this.mul hζ.continuous.continuousAt
      · exact continuousAt_const.congr (hloc x hx _).symm
    have hQc : Continuous (fun x => f x * partialDeriv a ζ x) := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro x
      rcases hcases x with hx | hx
      · exact (hfx x hx).continuousAt.mul hdζc.continuousAt
      · have hev : (fun y => f y * partialDeriv a ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
          filter_upwards [hdζ0 x hx] with y hy
          simp [hy]
        exact continuousAt_const.congr hev.symm
    have hPs : HasCompactSupport (fun x => partialDeriv a f x * ζ x) := hζc.mul_left
    have hQs : HasCompactSupport (fun x => f x * partialDeriv a ζ x) :=
      (hζc.fderiv_apply ℝ (e a)).mul_left
    have hPi : Integrable (fun x => partialDeriv a f x * ζ x) (volume : Measure E3) :=
      hPc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hPs
    have hQi : Integrable (fun x => f x * partialDeriv a ζ x) (volume : Measure E3) :=
      hQc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hQs
    have hfun : (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun x => f x * ζ x) x (e a)) =
        fun x => partialDeriv a f x * ζ x + f x * partialDeriv a ζ x := funext hprod
    rw [hfun, integral_add hPi hQi] at h0
    linarith
  
  refine ⟨fun L => L.foldr (fun a f => partialDeriv a f) m, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro L _
    exact hmem _ (hiter L).continuousOn
  · intro L a _ ζ hζ hζc hζs
    exact hibp _ (hiter L) a ζ hζ hζc hζs

signature.name: fcr_prob_mono
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (s s₁ : ℝ) (hs : s₁ ≤ s) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) : fcrProb c s₁ A w D G F

proof.tactics:
by
  have hball : Metric.ball c s₁ ⊆ Metric.ball c s := Metric.ball_subset_ball hs
  have hsub : fcrHalf c s₁ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := Set.inter_subset_inter_left _ hball
  have hcont : Continuous (fun x : E3 => x 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet (fcrHalf c s) :=
    measurableSet_ball.inter (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hcont.measurable)
  have hμ : volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₁) ≤ volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s) :=
    Measure.restrict_mono hsub le_rfl
  obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, hG, hF, hI⟩ := hP
  refine ⟨⟨h1, fun L hL => (h2 L hL).mono_measure hμ,
    fun L a hL ζ hζ hζc hζs => h3 L a hL ζ hζ hζc (hζs.trans hsub)⟩,
    fun a => (hG a).mono_measure hμ, hF.mono_measure hμ, ?_⟩
  intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
  have hI' := hI ζ hζ hζc (hζs.trans hball)
  rw [← setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hmeas hsub ?_]
  · exact hI'
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨hxs, hxs₁⟩ := hx
  have hx0 : 0 < x 0 := hxs.2
  have hxb : x ∉ Metric.ball c s₁ := fun hb => hxs₁ ⟨hb, hx0⟩
  have hxt : x ∉ tsupport ζ := fun ht => hxb (hζs ht)
  have hζ0 : ζ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hxt
  have hdζ : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 := fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport ℝ hxt
  have hpd : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a ζ x = 0 := by
    intro a
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hdζ]
    rfl
  simp [hζ0, hpd]

signature.statement:
(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (a b : Fin 3) (φ ψa ψb χ : E3 → ℝ)
    (ha : fcrWD c s φ a ψa) (hb : fcrWD c s φ b ψb) (hχ : fcrWD c s ψb a χ) :
    fcrWD c s ψa b χ

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
  have hf' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ ζ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hζ).2
  have htest : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i ζ) ∧
      HasCompactSupport (partialDeriv i ζ) ∧ tsupport (partialDeriv i ζ) ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
    intro i
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e i))
      exact hf'.clm_apply contDiff_const
    · show HasCompactSupport (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e i))
      exact hζc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e i)
    · refine subset_trans ?_ hζs
      refine subset_trans ?_ (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ)
      apply closure_mono
      intro x hx h
      apply hx
      show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e i) = 0
      rw [h]
      rfl
  have hschwarz : ∀ x, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b ζ) x =
      partialDeriv b (partialDeriv a ζ) x := by
    intro x
    have hdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ζ) x :=
      (hf'.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    have key : ∀ v w : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y w) x v =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ζ) x v w := by
      intro v w
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hdx (differentiableAt_const w)]
      simp
    have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ ζ x :=
      hζ.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
        rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
        first
          | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
          | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
          | decide)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e b)) x (e a) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e a)) x (e b)
    rw [key, key]
    exact hsymm.eq (e a) (e b)
  have h1 := ha (partialDeriv b ζ) (htest b).1 (htest b).2.1 (htest b).2.2
  have h2 := hb (partialDeriv a ζ) (htest a).1 (htest a).2.1 (htest a).2.2
  have h3 := hχ ζ hζ hζc hζs
  have he : (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b ζ) x) =
      (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv b (partialDeriv a ζ) x) := by
    funext x
    rw [hschwarz x]
  rw [he] at h1
  linarith

    (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (GD : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ b, ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (D [b]) D')
    (hE : ∀ a b, a ≠ 0 → ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (E a b) D')
    (hGD : ∀ a, ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (GD a) D') (hF : ∃ D', fcrSob c s k F D') :
    ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fcrNormalZ A D E GD F) D'

signature.name: fcr_normalZ_sob
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, (A x).PosDef) (k : ℕ)
    (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (GD : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ b, ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (D [b]) D')
    (hE : ∀ a b, a ≠ 0 → ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (E a b) D')
    (hGD : ∀ a, ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (GD a) D') (hF : ∃ D', fcrSob c s k F D') :
    ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fcrNormalZ A D E GD F) D'

proof.tactics:
by
  have htr : ∀ f g : E3 → ℝ, f = g → (∃ D', fcrSob c s k f D') → ∃ D', fcrSob c s k g D' := by
    rintro f g rfl h
    exact h
  have hadd : ∀ φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ, (∃ D', fcrSob c s k φ₁ D') → (∃ D', fcrSob c s k φ₂ D') →
      ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x => φ₁ x + φ₂ x) D' := by
    rintro φ₁ φ₂ ⟨D₁, h₁⟩ ⟨D₂, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨_, fcr_sob_add c s k φ₁ φ₂ D₁ D₂ h₁ h₂⟩
  have hsm : ∀ m φ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R) → (∃ D', fcrSob c s k φ D') →
      ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x => m x * φ x) D' := by
    rintro m φ hm ⟨D₁, h₁⟩
    exact fcr_sob_smul c R s hsR m hm k φ D₁ h₁
  have hsub : ∀ φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ, (∃ D', fcrSob c s k φ₁ D') → (∃ D', fcrSob c s k φ₂ D') →
      ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x => φ₁ x - φ₂ x) D' := by
    intro φ₁ φ₂ h₁ h₂
    have h := hadd _ _ h₁ (hsm (fun _ => (-1 : ℝ)) φ₂ contDiffOn_const h₂)
    refine htr _ _ ?_ h
    funext x
    ring
  have hpA : ∀ a i j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a (fun y => A y i j)) (Metric.ball c R) := by
    intro a i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => A z i j) y (e a)) (Metric.ball c R)
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball).1 (hA i j)).2.clm_apply
      contDiffOn_const
  have hinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (A x 0 0)⁻¹) (Metric.ball c R) :=
    (hA 0 0).inv (fun x hx => ne_of_gt ((hApos x hx).diag_pos))
  
  have hrow : ∀ a : Fin 3, a ≠ 0 → ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x =>
      (∑ b : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun y => A y a b) x * D [b] x + A x a b * E a b x))
        + GD a x) D' := by
    intro a ha
    have ht : ∀ b, ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x =>
        partialDeriv a (fun y => A y a b) x * D [b] x + A x a b * E a b x) D' :=
      fun b => hadd _ _ (hsm _ _ (hpA a a b) (hD b)) (hsm _ _ (hA a b) (hE a b ha))
    have h3 := hadd _ _ (hadd _ _ (hadd _ _ (ht 0) (ht 1)) (ht 2)) (hGD a)
    refine htr _ _ ?_ h3
    funext x
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hS1 : ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x =>
      ∑ a ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
        ((∑ b : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun y => A y a b) x * D [b] x + A x a b * E a b x))
          + GD a x)) D' := by
    have h := hadd _ _ (hrow 1 (by decide)) (hrow 2 (by decide))
    refine htr _ _ ?_ h
    funext x
    rw [Finset.sum_pair (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2)]
  have hS2 : ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x =>
      ∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
        (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x)) D' := by
    have hu : ∀ b : Fin 3, b ≠ 0 → ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x =>
        partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x) D' :=
      fun b hb => hadd _ _ (hsm _ _ (hpA 0 0 b) (hD b)) (hsm _ _ (hA 0 b) (hE b 0 hb))
    have h := hadd _ _ (hu 1 (by decide)) (hu 2 (by decide))
    refine htr _ _ ?_ h
    funext x
    rw [Finset.sum_pair (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2)]
  have hT4 : ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x =>
      partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 0) x * D [0] x) D' :=
    hsm _ _ (hpA 0 0 0) (hD 0)
  have hN : ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x =>
      F x
        - (∑ a ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
            ((∑ b : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun y => A y a b) x * D [b] x + A x a b * E a b x))
              + GD a x))
        - (∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
            (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x))
        - GD 0 x - partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 0) x * D [0] x) D' :=
    hsub _ _ (hsub _ _ (hsub _ _ (hsub _ _ hF hS1) hS2) (hGD 0)) hT4
  have hfin := hsm _ _ hinv hN
  refine htr _ _ ?_ hfin
  funext x
  simp only [fcrNormalZ]
  rw [div_eq_inv_mul]

signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)

    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) (E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (GD : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ a b, a ≠ 0 → fcrWD c s (D [b]) a (E a b) ∧
      MemLp (E a b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hGD : ∀ a, fcrWD c s (G a) a (GD a) ∧ MemLp (GD a) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) :

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hc0 : Continuous (fun x : E3 => x 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
  have hHopen : IsOpen (fcrHalf c s) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc0)
  have hHsub : fcrHalf c s ⊆ Metric.ball c R :=
    fun x hx => Metric.ball_subset_ball hsR.le hx.1
  have h10 : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
  have h20 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
  have h12 : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 := by decide

    have heq := heqn ζ hζ hζc hζs
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at heq
    have hz3 : Function.support ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := (subset_tsupport ζ).trans hζs
    have iV : ∀ a, Integrable (fun x => Vf a x * partialDeriv a ζ x) := by
      intro a
      obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩ := htd ζ hζ hζc hζs a
      exact hint (Vf a) _ (hVL a) g1 g2 g3
    have iF : Integrable (fun x => F x * ζ x) := hint F ζ hP.2.2.1 hζ.continuous hζc hz3
    have iW1 : Integrable (fun x => Wf 1 x * ζ x) :=
      hint (Wf 1) ζ (hTan 1 h10).1 hζ.continuous hζc hz3
    have iW2 : Integrable (fun x => Wf 2 x * ζ x) :=
      hint (Wf 2) ζ (hTan 2 h20).1 hζ.continuous hζc hz3
    have i01 : Integrable (fun x => Vf 0 x * partialDeriv 0 ζ x +
        Vf 1 x * partialDeriv 1 ζ x) := (iV 0).add (iV 1)
    have i012 : Integrable (fun x => Vf 0 x * partialDeriv 0 ζ x +
        Vf 1 x * partialDeriv 1 ζ x + Vf 2 x * partialDeriv 2 ζ x) := i01.add (iV 2)
    have iFW1 : Integrable (fun x => F x * ζ x - Wf 1 x * ζ x) := iF.sub iW1
    rw [integral_add i012 iF, integral_add i01 (iV 2), integral_add (iV 0) (iV 1)] at heq
    have k1 := (hTan 1 h10).2 ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have k2 := (hTan 2 h20).2 ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have e : (fun x => (F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x) * ζ x) =
        fun x => F x * ζ x - Wf 1 x * ζ x - Wf 2 x * ζ x := by
      funext x; ring
    show ∫ x, Vf 0 x * partialDeriv 0 ζ x = -∫ x, (F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x) * ζ x
    rw [e, integral_sub iFW1 iW2, integral_sub iF iW1]
    linarith
  
  have hTb : ∀ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
      MemLp ((fun b x => A x 0 b * D [b] x) b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧
      MemLp ((fun b x => partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x) b)
        2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧
      fcrWD c s ((fun b x => A x 0 b * D [b] x) b) 0
        ((fun b x => partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x) b) := by
    intro b hb
    have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hb
      rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;> decide
    exact hWsmul (fun y => A y 0 b) (hA 0 b) 0 (D [b]) (E b 0) (hDL b) (hE b 0 hb0).2
      (hDb0 b hb0)
  have hTL : MemLp (fun x => ∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)), A x 0 b * D [b] x) 2
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    memLp_finset_sum (f := fun b x => A x 0 b * D [b] x) _ (fun b hb => (hTb b hb).1)
  have hT'L : MemLp (fun x => ∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
      (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x)) 2
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    memLp_finset_sum
      (f := fun b x => partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x) _
      (fun b hb => (hTb b hb).2.1)
  have hTw : fcrWD c s (fun x => ∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)), A x 0 b * D [b] x) 0
      (fun x => ∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
        (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x)) :=
    hWsum 0 _ _ _ hTb
  have hYL0 : MemLp (fun x => F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    (hP.2.2.1.sub (hTan 1 h10).1).sub (hTan 2 h20).1
  
  have hU1 := hWadd 0 (Vf 0) _ _ _ (hVL 0) hTL hYL0 hT'L hNorm hTw
  have hU2 := hWadd 0 _ (G 0) _ (GD 0) ((hVL 0).sub hTL) (hP.2.1 0) (hYL0.sub hT'L)
    (hGD 0).2 hU1.2 (hGD 0).1
  have hUL : MemLp (fun x => A x 0 0 * D [0] x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    hL2 _ (hA 0 0).continuousOn _ (hDL 0)
  have hYL : MemLp (fun x => F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x - (∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
      (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x)) - GD 0 x) 2
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    (hYL0.sub hT'L).sub (hGD 0).2
  have hUY : fcrWD c s (fun x => A x 0 0 * D [0] x) 0
      (fun x => F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x - (∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
        (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x)) - GD 0 x) := by
    refine hWcongr 0 _ _ _ _ hU2.2 (fun x _ => ?_) (fun x _ => rfl)
    show Vf 0 x - (∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)), A x 0 b * D [b] x) - G 0 x =
      A x 0 0 * D [0] x
    rw [hVf]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Finset.sum_pair h12]
    ring
  
  have hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (A x 0 0)⁻¹) (Metric.ball c R) := (hA 0 0).inv hne
  have hfin := (hWsmul _ hm 0 _ _ hUL hYL hUY).2.2
  refine hWcongr 0 _ _ _ _ hfin (fun x hx => ?_) (fun x hx => ?_)
  · have hxR := hHsub hx
    show (A x 0 0)⁻¹ * (A x 0 0 * D [0] x) = D [0] x
    exact inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (hne x hxR) _
  · have hxR := hHsub hx
    have hdm : partialDeriv 0 (fun y => (A y 0 0)⁻¹) x =
        -((A x 0 0) ^ 2)⁻¹ * partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 0) x := by
      have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => A y 0 0) x :=
        ((hA 0 0).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hxR)
      have hh := (hasDerivAt_inv (hne x hxR)).comp_hasFDerivAt x hfd.hasFDerivAt
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [show (fun y => (A y 0 0)⁻¹) = (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹) ∘ (fun y => A y 0 0) from rfl,
        hh.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    show partialDeriv 0 (fun y => (A y 0 0)⁻¹) x * (A x 0 0 * D [0] x) +
        (A x 0 0)⁻¹ * (F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x - (∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
          (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x)) - GD 0 x) =
      fcrNormalZ A D E GD F x
    rw [hdm, hWf]
    unfold fcrNormalZ
    simp only [Finset.sum_pair h12]
    have h00 := hne x hxR
    field_simp
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (E : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ b, fcrWD c s (D [b]) a (E b) ∧ MemLp (E b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (GDa : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hGa : ∀ d, fcrWD c s (G d) a (GDa d) ∧ MemLp (GDa d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (FDa : E3 → ℝ)
    (hFa : fcrWD c s F a FDa ∧ MemLp FDa 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) :
    fcrProb c s A (D [a]) (fun L => match L with | [] => D [a] | b :: _ => E b)
      (fun d x => (∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x) FDa

signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (E : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ b, fcrWD c s (D [b]) a (E b) ∧ MemLp (E b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (GDa : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hGa : ∀ d, fcrWD c s (G d) a (GDa d) ∧ MemLp (GDa d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (FDa : E3 → ℝ)
    (hFa : fcrWD c s F a FDa ∧ MemLp FDa 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) :
    fcrProb c s A (D [a]) (fun L => match L with | [] => D [a] | b :: _ => E b)
      (fun d x => (∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x) FDa

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hπc : Continuous (fun x : E3 => x 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
  have hHopen : IsOpen (fcrHalf c s) := by
    show IsOpen (Metric.ball c s ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0})
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hπc)
  have hHmeas : MeasurableSet (fcrHalf c s) := hHopen.measurableSet
  have hHball : fcrHalf c s ⊆ Metric.ball c R :=
    fun x hx => Metric.ball_subset_ball hsR.le hx.1
  
  have htestd : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i ζ) ∧ HasCompactSupport (partialDeriv i ζ) ∧
        tsupport (partialDeriv i ζ) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
    intro ζ hζ hζc i
    have hf' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ ζ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hζ).2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e i))
      exact hf'.clm_apply contDiff_const
    · show HasCompactSupport (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e i))
      exact hζc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e i)
    · refine subset_trans ?_ (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ)
      apply closure_mono
      intro x hx h
      apply hx
      show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e i) = 0
      rw [h]
      rfl
  
  have hschwarz : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x : E3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ζ) x = partialDeriv j (partialDeriv i ζ) x := by
    intro ζ hζ i j x
    have hf' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ ζ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hζ).2
    have hdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ζ) x :=
      (hf'.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    have key : ∀ v w : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y w) x v =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ζ) x v w := by
      intro v w
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hdx (differentiableAt_const w)]
      simp
    have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ ζ x :=
      hζ.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
        rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
        first
          | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
          | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
          | decide)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e j)) x (e i) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e i)) x (e j)
    rw [key, key]
    exact hsymm.eq (e i) (e j)
  
  have hint : ∀ u g : E3 → ℝ, MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → Continuous g →
      HasCompactSupport g → Integrable (fun x => u x * g x) (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro u g hu hg hgc
    have hgv : MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure E3) := hg.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hgc
    exact hu.integrable_mul (hgv.restrict (fcrHalf c s))
  have hintV : ∀ u g : E3 → ℝ, MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → Continuous g →
      HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ fcrHalf c s → Integrable (fun x => u x * g x) := by
    intro u g hu hg hgc hgs
    have hsupp : Function.support (fun x => u x * g x) ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
      intro x hx
      apply hgs
      apply subset_tsupport
      intro h0
      apply hx
      simp [h0]
    exact (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset hsupp).1 (hint u g hu hg hgc)
  
  have hmemsmul : ∀ m : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn m (Metric.ball c R) → ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ,
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp (fun x => m x * φ x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro m hm φ hφ
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall c s).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hm.mono (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hsR))
    refine MemLp.of_le_mul (c := C) hφ
      (((hm.mono hHball).aestronglyMeasurable hHmeas).mul hφ.1) ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' hHmeas).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC x (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx.1)) (norm_nonneg _)
  
  have hpdm : ∀ m : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a m) (Metric.ball c R) := by
    intro m hm
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ m y (e a)) (Metric.ball c R)
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball).1 hm).2.clm_apply
      contDiffOn_const
  
  have hsmtest : ∀ m : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R) → ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c R →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => m x * ζ x) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x => m x * ζ x) ∧
        tsupport (fun x => m x * ζ x) ⊆ tsupport ζ ∧
        ∀ x, partialDeriv a (fun y => m y * ζ y) x =
          partialDeriv a m x * ζ x + m x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
    intro m hm ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have hout : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c R → ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      fun x hx => notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h => hx (hζs h))
    have hout' : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c R → (fun y => m y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      fun x hx => (hout x hx).mono fun y hy => by simp [hy]
    refine ⟨?_, hζc.mul_left, tsupport_mul_subset_right, ?_⟩
    · refine contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.2 fun x => ?_
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R
      · exact (hm.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)).mul hζ.contDiffAt
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hout' x hx)
    · intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R
      · have hmd : DifferentiableAt ℝ m x :=
          (hm.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hζd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x := hζ.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by simp)
        show fderiv ℝ (fun y => m y * ζ y) x (e a) =
          fderiv ℝ m x (e a) * ζ x + m x * fderiv ℝ ζ x (e a)
        rw [show (fun y => m y * ζ y) = m * ζ from rfl,
          (hmd.hasFDerivAt.mul hζd.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · have hz : ζ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hζs h))
        show fderiv ℝ (fun y => m y * ζ y) x (e a) =
          fderiv ℝ m x (e a) * ζ x + m x * fderiv ℝ ζ x (e a)
        rw [(hout' x hx).fderiv_eq, (hout x hx).fderiv_eq, hz]
        simp
  
  have hwdsmul : ∀ m : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R) → ∀ φ ψ : E3 → ℝ,
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      fcrWD c s φ a ψ →
      fcrWD c s (fun x => m x * φ x) a (fun x => partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x) := by
    intro m hm φ ψ hφ hψ hwd ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have hζR : tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c R := hζs.trans hHball
    obtain ⟨hη, hηc, hηs, hprod⟩ := hsmtest m hm ζ hζ hζc hζR
    obtain ⟨hξ, hξc, hξs, -⟩ := hsmtest (partialDeriv a m) (hpdm m hm) ζ hζ hζc hζR
    obtain ⟨hdη, hdηc, hdηs⟩ := htestd _ hη hηc a
    have h1 : ∫ x, φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m y * ζ y) x = -∫ x, ψ x * (m x * ζ x) :=
      hwd _ hη hηc (hηs.trans hζs)
    have I1 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m y * ζ y) x) :=
      hintV φ _ hφ hdη.continuous hdηc (hdηs.trans (hηs.trans hζs))
    have I2 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * (partialDeriv a m x * ζ x)) :=
      hintV φ _ hφ hξ.continuous hξc (hξs.trans hζs)
    have I3 : Integrable (fun x => ψ x * (m x * ζ x)) :=
      hintV ψ _ hψ hη.continuous hηc (hηs.trans hζs)
    show ∫ x, m x * φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, (partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x) * ζ x
    have e1 : (fun x => m x * φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x) = fun x =>
        φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m y * ζ y) x - φ x * (partialDeriv a m x * ζ x) := by
      funext x
      rw [hprod x]
      ring
    have e2 : (fun x => (partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x) * ζ x) = fun x =>
        φ x * (partialDeriv a m x * ζ x) + ψ x * (m x * ζ x) := by
      funext x
      ring
    rw [e1, e2, integral_sub I1 I2, integral_add I2 I3, h1]
    ring
  
  have hwdadd : ∀ {φ₁ φ₂ ψ₁ ψ₂ : E3 → ℝ}, fcrWD c s φ₁ a ψ₁ → fcrWD c s φ₂ a ψ₂ →
      MemLp φ₁ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp φ₂ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp ψ₁ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp ψ₂ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      fcrWD c s (fun x => φ₁ x + φ₂ x) a (fun x => ψ₁ x + ψ₂ x) := by
    intro φ₁ φ₂ ψ₁ ψ₂ h₁ h₂ m1 m2 m3 m4 ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨hd, hdc, hds⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc a
    have e1 := h₁ ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have e2 := h₂ ζ hζ hζc hζs
    show ∫ x, (φ₁ x + φ₂ x) * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, (ψ₁ x + ψ₂ x) * ζ x
    simp only [add_mul]
    rw [integral_add (hintV φ₁ _ m1 hd.continuous hdc (hds.trans hζs))
        (hintV φ₂ _ m2 hd.continuous hdc (hds.trans hζs)),
      integral_add (hintV ψ₁ _ m3 hζ.continuous hζc hζs) (hintV ψ₂ _ m4 hζ.continuous hζc hζs),
      e1, e2]
    ring
  have hwdsum : ∀ f g : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, (∀ b, MemLp (f b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) →
      (∀ b, MemLp (g b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) → (∀ b, fcrWD c s (f b) a (g b)) →
      fcrWD c s (fun x => ∑ b, f b x) a (fun x => ∑ b, g b x) := by
    intro f g hf hg hfg ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨hd, hdc, hds⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc a
    show ∫ x, (∑ b, f b x) * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, (∑ b, g b x) * ζ x
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => hintV (f b) _ (hf b) hd.continuous hdc (hds.trans hζs)),
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => hintV (g b) _ (hg b) hζ.continuous hζc hζs),
      ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => hfg b ζ hζ hζc hζs)
  
  obtain ⟨θ, hθdef⟩ : ∃ θ : ℕ → E3 → ℝ,
      θ = fun (n : ℕ) (x : E3) => Real.smoothTransition (((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 - 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hθs : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (θ n) := by
    intro n
    rw [hθdef]
    have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z 0) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    exact (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).comp ((contDiff_const.mul hπ).sub contDiff_const)
  have hθb : ∀ n x, 0 ≤ θ n x ∧ θ n x ≤ 1 := by
    intro n x
    rw [hθdef]
    exact ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
  have hθge : ∀ n x, θ n x ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 := by
    intro n x h
    by_contra hx
    push_neg at hx
    apply h
    rw [hθdef]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  have hS0 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : E3), 1 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 → 0 < x 0 := by
    intro n x h
    by_contra hx
    push_neg at hx
    have := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1) hx
    linarith
  have hθpos : ∀ n x, θ n x ≠ 0 → 0 < x 0 := fun n x h => hS0 n x (hθge n x h)
  have hθ1 : ∀ x : E3, 0 < x 0 → Tendsto (fun n => θ n x) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge (2 / x 0)
    apply tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const (i₀ := N)
    intro n hn
    rw [hθdef]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    have h1 : 2 / x 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := hN.trans (by exact_mod_cast hn)
    have h2 : 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * x 0 := by rwa [div_le_iff₀ hx] at h1
    have h3 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 = (n : ℝ) * x 0 + x 0 := by ring
    linarith
  have he0 : (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (e a) = 0 := by
    show (e a) 0 = 0
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Ne.symm ha]
  have hθd : ∀ n x, fderiv ℝ (θ n) x (e a) = 0 := by
    intro n x
    have hℓ : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => ((n : ℝ) + 1) * y 0 - 1)
        (((n : ℝ) + 1) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x :=
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt).const_mul
        ((n : ℝ) + 1)).sub_const 1
    have hst : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition
        (deriv Real.smoothTransition (((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 - 1)) (((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 - 1) :=
      (((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).differentiable (by simp)) _).hasDerivAt
    have hc := hst.comp_hasFDerivAt x hℓ
    have hθeq : θ n = Real.smoothTransition ∘ (fun y : E3 => ((n : ℝ) + 1) * y 0 - 1) := by
      rw [hθdef]
      rfl
    rw [hθeq, hc.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, he0]
    simp
  have hibp : ∀ φ ψ : E3 → ℝ, MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → fcrWD c s φ a ψ →
      ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c s →
        ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ψ x * ζ x := by
    intro φ ψ hφ hψ hwd ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨hd1, hd2, hd3⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc a
    have hcut : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => θ n x * ζ x) ∧
        HasCompactSupport (fun x => θ n x * ζ x) ∧
        tsupport (fun x => θ n x * ζ x) ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
      intro n
      refine ⟨(hθs n).mul hζ, hζc.mul_left, ?_⟩
      have hcl : IsClosed (tsupport ζ ∩ {x : E3 | 1 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0}) :=
        (isClosed_tsupport ζ).inter (isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_const.mul hπc))
      refine (closure_minimal ?_ hcl).trans ?_
      · intro x hx
        have hx' : θ n x * ζ x ≠ 0 := hx
        exact ⟨subset_tsupport _ (right_ne_zero_of_mul hx'), hθge n x (left_ne_zero_of_mul hx')⟩
      · intro x hx
        exact Set.mem_inter (hζs hx.1) (hS0 n x hx.2)
    have hdcut : ∀ n x, partialDeriv a (fun y => θ n y * ζ y) x = θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
      intro n x
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (θ n) x := ((hθs n).differentiable (by simp)) x
      have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x := (hζ.differentiable (by simp)) x
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => θ n y * ζ y) x (e a) = θ n x * fderiv ℝ ζ x (e a)
      rw [show (fun y => θ n y * ζ y) = θ n * ζ from rfl,
        (h1.hasFDerivAt.mul h2.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hθd n x]
      ring
    have hseq : ∀ n : ℕ, ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x) =
        -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ψ x * (θ n x * ζ x) := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := hcut n
      have h : ∫ x, φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => θ n y * ζ y) x =
          -∫ x, ψ x * (θ n x * ζ x) := hwd _ c1 c2 c3
      have e1 : (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => θ n y * ζ y) x) =
          fun x => φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x) := funext fun x => by rw [hdcut n x]
      rw [e1] at h
      have hz1 : ∀ x ∉ fcrHalf c s, φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x) = 0 := by
        intro x hx
        by_cases h0 : θ n x = 0
        · simp [h0]
        · have hxb : x ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h' => hx (Set.mem_inter (hζs h') (hθpos n x h0))
          rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h' => hxb (hd3 h'))]
          simp
      have hz2 : ∀ x ∉ fcrHalf c s, ψ x * (θ n x * ζ x) = 0 := by
        intro x hx
        by_cases h0 : θ n x = 0
        · simp [h0]
        · have hxb : x ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h' => hx (Set.mem_inter (hζs h') (hθpos n x h0))
          rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hxb]
          simp
      rw [setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hz1,
        setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hz2]
      exact h
    have hT1 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x))
        atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x)) := by
      refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun x => ‖φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x‖)
        (fun n => ?_) ?_ (fun n => ?_) ?_
      · exact (hint φ _ hφ ((hθs n).continuous.mul hd1.continuous) hd2.mul_left).aestronglyMeasurable
      · exact (hint φ _ hφ hd1.continuous hd2).norm
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_
        show ‖φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x)‖ ≤ ‖φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x‖
        have hb := hθb n x
        have hθn : ‖θ n x‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hb.1]
          exact hb.2
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
        calc ‖φ x‖ * (‖θ n x‖ * ‖partialDeriv a ζ x‖)
            ≤ ‖φ x‖ * (1 * ‖partialDeriv a ζ x‖) := by gcongr
          _ = ‖φ x‖ * ‖partialDeriv a ζ x‖ := by ring
      · refine (ae_restrict_iff' hHmeas).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
        have := ((hθ1 x hx.2).mul_const (partialDeriv a ζ x)).const_mul (φ x)
        simpa using this
    have hT2 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ψ x * (θ n x * ζ x))
        atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ψ x * ζ x)) := by
      refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun x => ‖ψ x * ζ x‖)
        (fun n => ?_) ?_ (fun n => ?_) ?_
      · exact (hint ψ _ hψ ((hθs n).continuous.mul hζ.continuous) hζc.mul_left).aestronglyMeasurable
      · exact (hint ψ _ hψ hζ.continuous hζc).norm
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_
        show ‖ψ x * (θ n x * ζ x)‖ ≤ ‖ψ x * ζ x‖
        have hb := hθb n x
        have hθn : ‖θ n x‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hb.1]
          exact hb.2
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
        calc ‖ψ x‖ * (‖θ n x‖ * ‖ζ x‖)
            ≤ ‖ψ x‖ * (1 * ‖ζ x‖) := by gcongr
          _ = ‖ψ x‖ * ‖ζ x‖ := by ring
      · refine (ae_restrict_iff' hHmeas).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
        have := ((hθ1 x hx.2).mul_const (ζ x)).const_mul (ψ x)
        simpa using this
    have hT3 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x))
        atTop (𝓝 (-∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ψ x * ζ x)) :=
      hT2.neg.congr (fun n => (hseq n).symm)
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hT1 hT3
  
  have hcrux : ∀ (V W : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F₀ FD : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ d, MemLp (V d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) →
      (∀ d, MemLp (W d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) →
      MemLp F₀ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp FD 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      (∀ d, fcrWD c s (V d) a (W d)) → fcrWD c s F₀ a FD →
      (∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c s →
        ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ((∑ d : Fin 3, V d x * partialDeriv d ζ x) + F₀ x * ζ x) = 0) →
      ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c s →
        ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ((∑ d : Fin 3, W d x * partialDeriv d ζ x) + FD x * ζ x) = 0 := by
    intro V W F₀ FD hV hW hF hFD hVW hFFD hid ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc a
    have h0 := hid (partialDeriv a ζ) ha1 ha2 (ha3.trans hζs)
    have hIV : ∀ d, Integrable (fun x => V d x * partialDeriv d (partialDeriv a ζ) x)
        (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := fun d =>
      hint (V d) _ (hV d) (htestd _ ha1 ha2 d).1.continuous (htestd _ ha1 ha2 d).2.1
    rw [integral_add (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => hIV d))
        (hint F₀ _ hF ha1.continuous ha2),
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => hIV d)] at h0
    have hkey : ∀ d, ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, V d x * partialDeriv d (partialDeriv a ζ) x =
        -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, W d x * partialDeriv d ζ x := by
      intro d
      obtain ⟨hd1, hd2, hd3⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc d
      have e : (fun x => V d x * partialDeriv d (partialDeriv a ζ) x) =
          fun x => V d x * partialDeriv a (partialDeriv d ζ) x := by
        funext x
        rw [hschwarz ζ hζ d a x]
      rw [e]
      exact hibp (V d) (W d) (hV d) (hW d) (hVW d) (partialDeriv d ζ) hd1 hd2 (hd3.trans hζs)
    have hF' := hibp F₀ FD hF hFD hFFD ζ hζ hζc hζs
    simp only [hkey, hF', Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h0
    have hIW : ∀ d, Integrable (fun x => W d x * partialDeriv d ζ x)
        (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := fun d =>
      hint (W d) _ (hW d) (htestd ζ hζ hζc d).1.continuous (htestd ζ hζ hζc d).2.1
    rw [integral_add (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => hIW d))
        (hint FD _ hFD hζ.continuous hζc),
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => hIW d)]
    linarith
  
  have hDm : ∀ b, MemLp (D [b]) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    fun b => hP.1.2.1 [b] (by simp)
  have hpd : ∀ d b : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b)) (Metric.ball c R) :=
    fun d b => hpdm _ (hA d b)
  have hfirst : ∀ i, fcrWD c s w i (D [i]) := by
    intro i ζ h1 h2 h3
    have h0 := hP.1.2.2 [] i (by simp) ζ h1 h2 h3
    rw [hP.1.1] at h0
    exact h0
  have hsob : fcrSob c s 1 (D [a]) (fun L => match L with | [] => D [a] | b :: _ => E b) := by
    refine ⟨rfl, fun L hL => ?_, fun L b hL => ?_⟩
    · cases L with
      | nil => exact hDm a
      | cons b t => exact (hE b).2
    · cases L with
      | nil =>
        intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
        obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc b
        obtain ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc a
        have h1 := hfirst a (partialDeriv b ζ) hb1 hb2 (hb3.trans hζs)
        have h2 := hfirst b (partialDeriv a ζ) ha1 ha2 (ha3.trans hζs)
        have h3 := (hE b).1 ζ hζ hζc hζs
        have he : (fun x => w x * partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b ζ) x) =
            (fun x => w x * partialDeriv b (partialDeriv a ζ) x) := by
          funext x
          rw [hschwarz ζ hζ a b x]
        rw [he] at h1
        show ∫ x, D [a] x * partialDeriv b ζ x = -∫ x, E b x * ζ x
        linarith
      | cons b' t => simp at hL
  have hVm : ∀ d, MemLp (fun x => (∑ b, A x d b * D [b] x) + G d x) 2
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := fun d =>
    (memLp_finset_sum Finset.univ
      (fun b _ => hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b))).add (hP.2.1 d)
  have hG'm : ∀ d, MemLp (fun x => (∑ b, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x)
      2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := fun d =>
    (memLp_finset_sum Finset.univ
      (fun b _ => hmemsmul _ (hpd d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b))).add (hGa d).2
  have hWm : ∀ d, MemLp (fun x => (∑ b, A x d b * E b x) +
      ((∑ b, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x)) 2
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := fun d =>
    (memLp_finset_sum Finset.univ
      (fun b _ => hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hE b).2)).add (hG'm d)
  have hVW : ∀ d, fcrWD c s (fun x => (∑ b, A x d b * D [b] x) + G d x) a
      (fun x => (∑ b, A x d b * E b x) +
        ((∑ b, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x)) := by
    intro d
    have hS := hwdsum (fun b x => A x d b * D [b] x)
      (fun b x => partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x + A x d b * E b x)
      (fun b => hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b))
      (fun b => (hmemsmul _ (hpd d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b)).add
        (hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hE b).2))
      (fun b => hwdsmul _ (hA d b) _ _ (hDm b) (hE b).2 (hE b).1)
    have hT := hwdadd hS (hGa d).1
      (memLp_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun b _ => hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b)))
      (hP.2.1 d)
      (memLp_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun b _ => (hmemsmul _ (hpd d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b)).add
        (hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hE b).2)))
      (hGa d).2
    have e : (fun x => (∑ b, (partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x + A x d b * E b x))
        + GDa d x) = (fun x => (∑ b, A x d b * E b x) +
          ((∑ b, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x)) := by
      funext x
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      ring
    rw [← e]
    exact hT
  refine ⟨hsob, hG'm, hFa.2, ?_⟩
  exact hcrux (fun d x => (∑ b, A x d b * D [b] x) + G d x)
    (fun d x => (∑ b, A x d b * E b x) +
      ((∑ b, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x))
    F FDa hVm hWm hP.2.2.1 hFa.2 hVW hFa.1 hP.2.2.2

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R s s' : ℝ) (hs' : 0 < s') (hss : s' < s) (hsR : s < R)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (hAs : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, ∀ a b : Fin 3, A x a b = A x b a)
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, (A x).PosDef)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) (hG : ∀ d, ∃ DG, fcrSob c s 1 (G d) DG)
    (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : Fin 3) :
    ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, fcrWD c s' (D [b]) a χ ∧ MemLp χ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s'))

signature.name: fcr_tangential_energy
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R s s' : ℝ) (hs' : 0 < s') (hss : s' < s) (hsR : s < R)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (hAs : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, ∀ a b : Fin 3, A x a b = A x b a)
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, (A x).PosDef)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) (hG : ∀ d, ∃ DG, fcrSob c s 1 (G d) DG)
    (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : Fin 3) :
    ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, fcrWD c s' (D [b]) a χ ∧ MemLp χ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s'))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = (s - s') / 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; linarith
  have hδs : s' + 4 * δ = s := by rw [hδ]; ring
  have hopen : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen (fcrHalf c r) := fun r =>
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  have hea : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  
  obtain ⟨η, hηin, hηout⟩ : ∃ η : ContDiffBump c, η.rIn = s' ∧ η.rOut = s' + δ :=
    ⟨⟨s', s' + δ, hs', by linarith⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hηc1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (⇑η) := η.contDiff
  have hfdc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (⇑η)) := hηc1.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := Continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hfdc
    (η.hasCompactSupport.fderiv ℝ)
  have hdη : ∀ (d : Fin 3) (x : E3), |partialDeriv d (⇑η) x| ≤ max C₀ 0 := by
    intro d x
    have hed : ‖e d‖ = 1 := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    have h1 : ‖fderiv ℝ (⇑η) x (e d)‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (⇑η) x‖ * ‖e d‖ :=
      ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
    rw [hed, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1.trans ((hC₀ x).trans (le_max_left _ _))
  have hdηc : ∀ d : Fin 3, Continuous (fun x => partialDeriv d (⇑η) x) := by
    intro d
    exact hfdc.clm_apply continuous_const
  
  obtain ⟨lam, Λ, M, hlam, hΛ, hM, hbd⟩ := fcr_dq_bounds c R s (s' + 2 * δ) (s' + 3 * δ)
    (δ / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) hsR A hA hApos w D G F hP hG
    a ha
  obtain ⟨K, hK0, hK⟩ := fcr_energy_absorb lam Λ (max C₀ 0) hlam hΛ (le_max_right _ _)
  
  have hU : ∀ h : ℝ, h ≠ 0 → |h| ≤ δ / 2 →
      ∫ x in fcrHalf c s', (fcrDQ a h (D [b]) x) ^ 2 ≤ K * M := by
    intro h hh hhh
    obtain ⟨hco, hB, hu, hUd, hR, hF, hum, hRm, hFm⟩ := hbd h hh hhh
    obtain ⟨hid, hQb, hQm⟩ := fcr_dq_identity c R s s' (s' + δ) (s' + 2 * δ) (s' + 3 * δ)
      (δ / 2) hs' (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) hsR A hA
      w D G F hP hG η hηout a ha h hh hhh
    have hBm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => A (x + h • e a) i j)
        (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c (s' + 2 * δ))) := by
      intro i j
      refine ContinuousOn.aestronglyMeasurable ?_ (hopen _).measurableSet
      have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun x : E3 => x + h • e a) (fcrHalf c (s' + 2 * δ))
          (Metric.ball c R) := by
        intro x hx

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(lam Λ Cη : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) (hC : 0 ≤ Cη) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (S : Set E3) (B : E3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (η u F Q : E3 → ℝ)
      (dη U Rr : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (a : Fin 3), MeasurableSet S → 0 ≤ M →
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        lam * ∑ i : Fin 3, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ξ i * B x i j * ξ j) →
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |B x i j| ≤ Λ) →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => B x i j) (volume.restrict S)) →
      Continuous η → (∀ x, 0 ≤ η x ∧ η x ≤ 1) →
      (∀ d, Continuous (dη d)) → (∀ d x, |dη d x| ≤ Cη) →
      MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict S) → (∀ d, MemLp (U d) 2 (volume.restrict S)) →
      (∀ d, MemLp (Rr d) 2 (volume.restrict S)) → MemLp F 2 (volume.restrict S) →
      MemLp Q 2 (volume.restrict S) →
      ∫ x in S, u x ^ 2 ≤ M → (∀ d, ∫ x in S, Rr d x ^ 2 ≤ M) → ∫ x in S, F x ^ 2 ≤ M →
      ∫ x in S, Q x ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in S, (η x ^ 2 * U a x + 2 * η x * dη a x * u x) ^ 2 →
      (∫ x in S, ∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ b : Fin 3, B x d b * U b x) + Rr d x) *
          (η x ^ 2 * U d x + 2 * η x * dη d x * u x)) = ∫ x in S, F x * Q x →
      ∫ x in S, η x ^ 2 * ∑ d : Fin 3, U d x ^ 2 ≤ K * M
