signature.name: fdr_prob_mono
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (s s₁ : ℝ) (hs : s₁ ≤ s) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fdrProb c s A w D G F) : fdrProb c s₁ A w D G F

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hSob, hZT, hG, hF, hW⟩ := hP
  have hball : Metric.ball c s₁ ⊆ Metric.ball c s := Metric.ball_subset_ball hs
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet (fcrHalf c s) := by
    have h0 : Continuous (fun x : E3 => x 0) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
    exact (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const h0)).measurableSet
  have hsub : fcrHalf c s₁ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := fun x hx => ⟨hball hx.1, hx.2⟩
  have hL2 : ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₁)) :=
    fun φ h => h.mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono hsub le_rfl)
  have hSob' : fcrSob c s₁ 1 w D :=
    ⟨hSob.1, fun L hL => hL2 _ (hSob.2.1 L hL),
      fun L a hL ζ h1 h2 h3 => hSob.2.2 L a hL ζ h1 h2 (h3.trans hsub)⟩
  have hK : ∀ (ζ : E3 → ℝ), tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c s₁ → ∀ f : E3 → ℝ,
      (∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → f x = 0) →
      ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, f x = ∫ x in fcrHalf c s₁, f x := by
    intro ζ h3 f hf
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hmeas hsub
      (fun x hx => hf x ?_)
    intro hxt
    exact hx.2 ⟨h3 hxt, hx.1.2⟩
  have hz0 : ∀ (ζ : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3), x ∉ tsupport ζ → ζ x = 0 :=
    fun ζ x hx => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
  have hd0 : ∀ (ζ : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3) (a : Fin 3), x ∉ tsupport ζ → partialDeriv a ζ x = 0 := by
    intro ζ x a hxt
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hxt (support_fderiv_subset ℝ hne)
    simp [partialDeriv, hfd]
  refine ⟨hSob', ?_, fun a => hL2 (G a) (hG a), hL2 F hF, ?_⟩
  · intro a ζ h1 h2 h3
    have h := hZT a ζ h1 h2 (h3.trans hball)
    have e1 := hK ζ h3 (fun x => w x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
      (fun x hx => by simp [hd0 ζ x a hx])
    have e2 := hK ζ h3 (fun x => D [a] x * ζ x)
      (fun x hx => by simp [hz0 ζ x hx])
    exact e1.symm.trans (h.trans (congrArg Neg.neg e2))
  · rintro ζ h1 h2 h3 ⟨O₁, hO₁, hsub₁, hz₁⟩
    have hOo : IsOpen (O₁ ∪ (tsupport ζ)ᶜ) := hO₁.union (isClosed_tsupport ζ).isOpen_compl
    have hOf : {x ∈ Metric.ball c s | x 0 = 0} ⊆ O₁ ∪ (tsupport ζ)ᶜ := by
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxt : x ∈ tsupport ζ
      · exact Or.inl (hsub₁ ⟨h3 hxt, hx.2⟩)
      · exact Or.inr hxt
    have hOz : ∀ x ∈ O₁ ∪ (tsupport ζ)ᶜ, ζ x = 0 := by
      rintro x (hx | hx)
      · exact hz₁ x hx
      · exact hz0 ζ x hx
    have h := hW ζ h1 h2 (h3.trans hball) ⟨_, hOo, hOf, hOz⟩
    have e := hK ζ h3 (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 3,
        ((∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * D [b] x) + G a x) * partialDeriv a ζ x + F x * ζ x)
      (fun x hx => by
        have hd := fun a => hd0 ζ x a hx
        simp [hz0 ζ x hx, hd])
    exact e.symm.trans h

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, (A x).PosDef)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fdrProb c s A w D G F) (E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (GD : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ a b, a ≠ 0 → fcrWD c s (D [b]) a (E a b) ∧
      MemLp (E a b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hGD : ∀ a, fcrWD c s (G a) a (GD a) ∧ MemLp (GD a) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) :
    fcrWD c s (D [0]) 0 (fcrNormalZ A D E GD F)

signature.name: fdr_normal_step
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, (A x).PosDef)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fdrProb c s A w D G F) (E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (GD : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ a b, a ≠ 0 → fcrWD c s (D [b]) a (E a b) ∧
      MemLp (E a b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hGD : ∀ a, fcrWD c s (G a) a (GD a) ∧ MemLp (GD a) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) :
    fcrWD c s (D [0]) 0 (fcrNormalZ A D E GD F)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hc0 : Continuous (fun x : E3 => x 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
  have hHopen : IsOpen (fcrHalf c s) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc0)
  have hHsub : fcrHalf c s ⊆ Metric.ball c R :=
    fun x hx => Metric.ball_subset_ball hsR.le hx.1
  have h10 : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
  have h20 : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by decide
  have h12 : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 := by decide
  
  have hpd : ∀ (m' : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m' (Metric.ball c R) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a m') (Metric.ball c R) := by
    intro m' a hm'
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ m' y (e a)) (Metric.ball c R)
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball).1 hm').2.clm_apply
      contDiffOn_const
  
  have hpdsupp : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      Function.support (fun x => partialDeriv a f x) ⊆ tsupport f := by
    intro f a x hx
    simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hx
    apply tsupport_fderiv_subset (𝕜 := ℝ)
    apply subset_tsupport
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    intro h
    exact hx (by simp [partialDeriv, h])
  
  have htd : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s →
      ∀ a : Fin 3, Continuous (fun x => partialDeriv a ζ x) ∧
        HasCompactSupport (fun x => partialDeriv a ζ x) ∧
        Function.support (fun x => partialDeriv a ζ x) ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
    intro ζ hζ hζc hζs a
    exact ⟨(hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const,
      hζc.mono' (hpdsupp _ a), (hpdsupp _ a).trans hζs⟩
  
  have htest : ∀ m' : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m' (Metric.ball c R) →
      ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => m' x * ζ x) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x => m' x * ζ x) ∧
      tsupport (fun x => m' x * ζ x) ⊆ fcrHalf c s ∧
      ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x : E3), partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x =
        partialDeriv a m' x * ζ x + m' x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
    intro m' hm' ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have hoff : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c R → ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      have h := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h => hx (hHsub (hζs h)))
      filter_upwards [h] with y hy
      simpa using hy
    have hoff2 : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c R →
        (fun y => m' y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      filter_upwards [hoff x hx] with y hy
      simp [hy]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R
      · exact (hm'.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)).mul hζ.contDiffAt
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hoff2 x hx)
    · exact hζc.mul_left
    · exact (tsupport_mul_subset_right).trans hζs
    · intro a x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R
      · have hmd : DifferentiableAt ℝ m' x :=
          (hm'.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)
        have hζd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x := hζ.differentiable (by simp) x
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [fderiv_fun_mul hmd hζd]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · have h1 : partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x = 0 := by
          unfold partialDeriv
          rw [(hoff2 x hx).fderiv_eq]
          simp
        have h2 : partialDeriv a ζ x = 0 := by
          unfold partialDeriv
          rw [(hoff x hx).fderiv_eq]
          simp
        have h3 : ζ x = 0 := (hoff x hx).eq_of_nhds
        rw [h1, h2, h3]
        ring
  
  have hint : ∀ u g : E3 → ℝ, MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → Continuous g →
      HasCompactSupport g → Function.support g ⊆ fcrHalf c s →
      Integrable (fun x => u x * g x) := by
    intro u g hu hg hgc hgs
    have hg2 : MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      (hg.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hgc).restrict _
    have h1 : Integrable (fun x => u x * g x) (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      hu.integrable_mul hg2
    refine (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset ?_).1 h1
    intro x hx
    simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hx
    apply hgs
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    intro h
    exact hx (by simp [h])
  
  have hwd : ∀ m' : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m' (Metric.ball c R) →
      ∀ (φ ψ : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      fcrWD c s φ a ψ →
      fcrWD c s (fun x => m' x * φ x) a (fun x => partialDeriv a m' x * φ x + m' x * ψ x) := by
    intro m' hm' φ ψ a hφ hψ hw ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨hη, hηc, hηs, hprod⟩ := htest m' hm' ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨hξ, hξc, -, -⟩ := htest (partialDeriv a m') (hpd m' a hm') ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have h0 : ∫ x, φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x =
        -∫ x, ψ x * (m' x * ζ x) := hw _ hη hηc hηs
    have hsuppζ : Function.support ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := (subset_tsupport ζ).trans hζs
    have i1 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x) := by
      refine hint φ _ hφ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact (hη.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
      · exact hηc.mono' (hpdsupp _ a)
      · exact (hpdsupp _ a).trans hηs
    have i2 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * (partialDeriv a m' x * ζ x)) := by
      refine hint φ _ hφ hξ.continuous hξc ?_
      intro x hx
      simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hx
      apply hsuppζ
      rw [Function.mem_support]
      intro h
      exact hx (by simp [h])
    have i3 : Integrable (fun x => ψ x * (m' x * ζ x)) :=
      hint ψ _ hψ hη.continuous hηc ((subset_tsupport _).trans hηs)
    have e1 : (fun x => m' x * φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x) =
        fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x -
          φ x * (partialDeriv a m' x * ζ x) := by
      funext x
      rw [hprod a x]
      ring
    have e2 : (fun x => (partialDeriv a m' x * φ x + m' x * ψ x) * ζ x) =
        fun x => φ x * (partialDeriv a m' x * ζ x) + ψ x * (m' x * ζ x) := by
      funext x
      ring
    show ∫ x, m' x * φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x =
      -∫ x, (partialDeriv a m' x * φ x + m' x * ψ x) * ζ x
    rw [e1, e2, integral_sub i1 i2, integral_add i2 i3, h0]
    ring
  
  have hL2 : ∀ m' : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn m' (Metric.ball c R) → ∀ φ : E3 → ℝ,
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp (fun x => m' x * φ x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro m' hm' φ hφ
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall c s).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hm'.mono (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hsR))
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable m' (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      (hm'.mono hHsub).aestronglyMeasurable hHopen.measurableSet
    refine MemLp.of_le_mul (c := C) hφ (hmeas.mul hφ.1) ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' hHopen.measurableSet).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC x (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx.1)) (norm_nonneg _)
  
  have hWadd : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (φ₁ φ₂ ψ₁ ψ₂ : E3 → ℝ),
      MemLp φ₁ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp φ₂ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp ψ₁ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp ψ₂ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      fcrWD c s φ₁ a ψ₁ → fcrWD c s φ₂ a ψ₂ →
      fcrWD c s (fun x => φ₁ x + φ₂ x) a (fun x => ψ₁ x + ψ₂ x) ∧
      fcrWD c s (fun x => φ₁ x - φ₂ x) a (fun x => ψ₁ x - ψ₂ x) := by
    intro a φ₁ φ₂ ψ₁ ψ₂ k1 k2 k3 k4 w1 w2
    constructor
    · intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
      obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩ := htd ζ hζ hζc hζs a
      have hz3 : Function.support ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := (subset_tsupport ζ).trans hζs
      have j1 := hint φ₁ _ k1 g1 g2 g3
      have j2 := hint φ₂ _ k2 g1 g2 g3
      have j3 := hint ψ₁ ζ k3 hζ.continuous hζc hz3
      have j4 := hint ψ₂ ζ k4 hζ.continuous hζc hz3
      have e1 : (fun x => (φ₁ x + φ₂ x) * partialDeriv a ζ x) =
          fun x => φ₁ x * partialDeriv a ζ x + φ₂ x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
        funext x; ring
      have e2 : (fun x => (ψ₁ x + ψ₂ x) * ζ x) = fun x => ψ₁ x * ζ x + ψ₂ x * ζ x := by
        funext x; ring
      show ∫ x, (φ₁ x + φ₂ x) * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, (ψ₁ x + ψ₂ x) * ζ x
      rw [e1, e2, integral_add j1 j2, integral_add j3 j4, w1 ζ hζ hζc hζs, w2 ζ hζ hζc hζs]
      ring
    · intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
      obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩ := htd ζ hζ hζc hζs a
      have hz3 : Function.support ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := (subset_tsupport ζ).trans hζs
      have j1 := hint φ₁ _ k1 g1 g2 g3
      have j2 := hint φ₂ _ k2 g1 g2 g3
      have j3 := hint ψ₁ ζ k3 hζ.continuous hζc hz3
      have j4 := hint ψ₂ ζ k4 hζ.continuous hζc hz3
      have e1 : (fun x => (φ₁ x - φ₂ x) * partialDeriv a ζ x) =
          fun x => φ₁ x * partialDeriv a ζ x - φ₂ x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
        funext x; ring
      have e2 : (fun x => (ψ₁ x - ψ₂ x) * ζ x) = fun x => ψ₁ x * ζ x - ψ₂ x * ζ x := by
        funext x; ring
      show ∫ x, (φ₁ x - φ₂ x) * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, (ψ₁ x - ψ₂ x) * ζ x
      rw [e1, e2, integral_sub j1 j2, integral_sub j3 j4, w1 ζ hζ hζc hζs, w2 ζ hζ hζc hζs]
      ring
  have hWsum : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (S : Finset (Fin 3)) (φ ψ : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ i ∈ S, MemLp (φ i) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧
        MemLp (ψ i) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧ fcrWD c s (φ i) a (ψ i)) →
      fcrWD c s (fun x => ∑ i ∈ S, φ i x) a (fun x => ∑ i ∈ S, ψ i x) := by
    intro a S φ ψ h ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩ := htd ζ hζ hζc hζs a
    have hz3 : Function.support ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := (subset_tsupport ζ).trans hζs
    have e1 : (fun x => (∑ i ∈ S, φ i x) * partialDeriv a ζ x) =
        fun x => ∑ i ∈ S, φ i x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
      funext x; rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    have e2 : (fun x => (∑ i ∈ S, ψ i x) * ζ x) = fun x => ∑ i ∈ S, ψ i x * ζ x := by
      funext x; rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    show ∫ x, (∑ i ∈ S, φ i x) * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, (∑ i ∈ S, ψ i x) * ζ x
    rw [e1, e2, integral_finset_sum S (f := fun i x => φ i x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
        (fun i hi => hint (φ i) _ (h i hi).1 g1 g2 g3),
      integral_finset_sum S (f := fun i x => ψ i x * ζ x)
        (fun i hi => hint (ψ i) ζ (h i hi).2.1 hζ.continuous hζc hz3),
      ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => (h i hi).2.2 ζ hζ hζc hζs)
  have hWsmul : ∀ (m : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R) → ∀ (a : Fin 3) (φ ψ : E3 → ℝ),
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      fcrWD c s φ a ψ →
      MemLp (fun x => m x * φ x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧
      MemLp (fun x => partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧
      fcrWD c s (fun x => m x * φ x) a (fun x => partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x) := by
    intro m hm a φ ψ hφ hψ hw
    exact ⟨hL2 m hm.continuousOn φ hφ,
      (hL2 _ (hpd m a hm).continuousOn φ hφ).add (hL2 m hm.continuousOn ψ hψ),
      hwd m hm φ ψ a hφ hψ hw⟩
  
  have hWcongr : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (φ φ' ψ ψ' : E3 → ℝ), fcrWD c s φ a ψ →
      (∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s, φ x = φ' x) → (∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s, ψ x = ψ' x) →
      fcrWD c s φ' a ψ' := by
    intro a φ φ' ψ ψ' h hφ hψ ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have e1 : (fun x => φ' x * partialDeriv a ζ x) = fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ fcrHalf c s
      · rw [hφ x hx]
      · have h0 : partialDeriv a ζ x = 0 := by
          by_contra hne
          exact hx (((hpdsupp ζ a).trans hζs) (Function.mem_support.2 hne))
        rw [h0, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    have e2 : (fun x => ψ' x * ζ x) = fun x => ψ x * ζ x := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ fcrHalf c s
      · rw [hψ x hx]
      · have h0 : ζ x = 0 := by
          by_contra hne
          exact hx (((subset_tsupport ζ).trans hζs) (Function.mem_support.2 hne))
        rw [h0, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    show ∫ x, φ' x * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, ψ' x * ζ x
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact h ζ hζ hζc hζs
  
  have hDL : ∀ b : Fin 3, MemLp (D [b]) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    fun b => hP.1.2.1 [b] (by simp)
  have hwD : ∀ b : Fin 3, fcrWD c s w b (D [b]) := by
    intro b ζ k1 k2 k3
    have h0 := hP.1.2.2 [] b (by simp) ζ k1 k2 k3
    rw [hP.1.1] at h0
    exact h0
  have hsymmW : ∀ (a b : Fin 3) (φ ψa ψb χ : E3 → ℝ),
      fcrWD c s φ a ψa → fcrWD c s φ b ψb → fcrWD c s ψb a χ → fcrWD c s ψa b χ := by
    intro a b φ ψa ψb χ ha hb hχ ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have hf' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ ζ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hζ).2
    have htest' : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i ζ) ∧
        HasCompactSupport (partialDeriv i ζ) ∧ tsupport (partialDeriv i ζ) ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
      intro i
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e i))
        exact hf'.clm_apply contDiff_const
      · show HasCompactSupport (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e i))
        exact hζc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e i)
      · refine subset_trans ?_ hζs
        refine subset_trans ?_ (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ)
        apply closure_mono
        intro x hx h
        apply hx
        show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e i) = 0
        rw [h]
        rfl
    have hschwarz : ∀ x, partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b ζ) x =
        partialDeriv b (partialDeriv a ζ) x := by
      intro x
      have hdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ζ) x :=
        (hf'.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
      have key : ∀ v w : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y w) x v =
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ζ) x v w := by
        intro v w
        rw [fderiv_clm_apply hdx (differentiableAt_const w)]
        simp
      have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ ζ x :=
        hζ.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
          rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
          first
            | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
            | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
            | decide)
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e b)) x (e a) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e a)) x (e b)
      rw [key, key]
      exact hsymm.eq (e a) (e b)
    have h1 := ha (partialDeriv b ζ) (htest' b).1 (htest' b).2.1 (htest' b).2.2
    have h2 := hb (partialDeriv a ζ) (htest' a).1 (htest' a).2.1 (htest' a).2.2
    have h3 := hχ ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have he : (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b ζ) x) =
        (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv b (partialDeriv a ζ) x) := by
      funext x
      rw [hschwarz x]
    rw [he] at h1
    linarith
  have hDb0 : ∀ b : Fin 3, b ≠ 0 → fcrWD c s (D [b]) 0 (E b 0) := fun b hb =>
    hsymmW b 0 w (D [b]) (D [0]) (E b 0) (hwD b) (hwD 0) (hE b 0 hb).1
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, 0 < A x 0 0 := fun x hx => (hApos x hx).diag_pos
  have hne : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, A x 0 0 ≠ 0 := fun x hx => ne_of_gt (hpos x hx)
  obtain ⟨Vf, hVf⟩ : ∃ Vf : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ,
      Vf = fun a x => (∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * D [b] x) + G a x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Wf, hWf⟩ : ∃ Wf : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, Wf = fun a x =>
      (∑ b : Fin 3, (partialDeriv a (fun y => A y a b) x * D [b] x + A x a b * E a b x))
        + GD a x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hVL : ∀ a : Fin 3, MemLp (Vf a) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro a
    rw [hVf]
    exact (memLp_finset_sum (f := fun b x => A x a b * D [b] x) Finset.univ
      (fun b _ => hL2 _ (hA a b).continuousOn (D [b]) (hDL b))).add (hP.2.2.1 a)
  
  have hTan : ∀ a : Fin 3, a ≠ 0 →
      MemLp (Wf a) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧ fcrWD c s (Vf a) a (Wf a) := by
    intro a ha
    have hb := fun b : Fin 3 => hWsmul (fun y => A y a b) (hA a b) a (D [b]) (E a b) (hDL b)
      (hE a b ha).2 (hE a b ha).1
    have hS1 : MemLp (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * D [b] x) 2
        (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      memLp_finset_sum (f := fun b x => A x a b * D [b] x) Finset.univ (fun b _ => (hb b).1)
    have hS2 : MemLp (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv a (fun y => A y a b) x * D [b] x + A x a b * E a b x)) 2
        (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      memLp_finset_sum
        (f := fun b x => partialDeriv a (fun y => A y a b) x * D [b] x + A x a b * E a b x)
        Finset.univ (fun b _ => (hb b).2.1)
    have hS3 : fcrWD c s (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * D [b] x) a (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv a (fun y => A y a b) x * D [b] x + A x a b * E a b x)) :=
      hWsum a Finset.univ (fun b x => A x a b * D [b] x)
        (fun b x => partialDeriv a (fun y => A y a b) x * D [b] x + A x a b * E a b x)
        (fun b _ => hb b)
    rw [hVf, hWf]
    exact ⟨hS2.add (hGD a).2,
      (hWadd a _ _ _ _ hS1 (hP.2.2.1 a) hS2 (hGD a).2 hS3 (hGD a).1).1⟩
  
  have heqn : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s →
      ∫ x, ((∑ a : Fin 3, Vf a x * partialDeriv a ζ x) + F x * ζ x) = 0 := by
    intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have hO : ∃ O : Set E3, IsOpen O ∧ {x ∈ Metric.ball c s | x 0 = 0} ⊆ O ∧
        ∀ x ∈ O, ζ x = 0 := by
      refine ⟨(tsupport ζ)ᶜ, (isClosed_tsupport ζ).isOpen_compl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rintro x ⟨-, hx0⟩ hxt
        have h1 : 0 < x 0 := (hζs hxt).2
        rw [hx0] at h1
        exact lt_irrefl _ h1
      · intro x hx
        exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
    have h0 : ∫ x in fcrHalf c s,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ((∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * D [b] x) + G a x) * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + F x * ζ x) = 0 :=
      hP.2.2.2.2 ζ hζ hζc (fun x hx => (hζs hx).1) hO
    rw [hVf]
    show ∫ x, ((∑ a : Fin 3, ((∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * D [b] x) + G a x) * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + F x * ζ x) = 0
    rw [← h0]
    symm
    apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    have hz : ζ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hζs h))
    have hd : ∀ a, partialDeriv a ζ x = 0 := fun a => by
      by_contra hne'
      exact hx (((hpdsupp ζ a).trans hζs) (Function.mem_support.2 hne'))
    simp [hz, hd]
  
  have hNorm : fcrWD c s (Vf 0) 0 (fun x => F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x) := by
    intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have heq := heqn ζ hζ hζc hζs
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at heq
    have hz3 : Function.support ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := (subset_tsupport ζ).trans hζs
    have iV : ∀ a, Integrable (fun x => Vf a x * partialDeriv a ζ x) := by
      intro a
      obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩ := htd ζ hζ hζc hζs a
      exact hint (Vf a) _ (hVL a) g1 g2 g3
    have iF : Integrable (fun x => F x * ζ x) := hint F ζ hP.2.2.2.1 hζ.continuous hζc hz3
    have iW1 : Integrable (fun x => Wf 1 x * ζ x) :=
      hint (Wf 1) ζ (hTan 1 h10).1 hζ.continuous hζc hz3
    have iW2 : Integrable (fun x => Wf 2 x * ζ x) :=
      hint (Wf 2) ζ (hTan 2 h20).1 hζ.continuous hζc hz3
    have i01 : Integrable (fun x => Vf 0 x * partialDeriv 0 ζ x +
        Vf 1 x * partialDeriv 1 ζ x) := (iV 0).add (iV 1)
    have i012 : Integrable (fun x => Vf 0 x * partialDeriv 0 ζ x +
        Vf 1 x * partialDeriv 1 ζ x + Vf 2 x * partialDeriv 2 ζ x) := i01.add (iV 2)
    have iFW1 : Integrable (fun x => F x * ζ x - Wf 1 x * ζ x) := iF.sub iW1
    rw [integral_add i012 iF, integral_add i01 (iV 2), integral_add (iV 0) (iV 1)] at heq
    have k1 := (hTan 1 h10).2 ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have k2 := (hTan 2 h20).2 ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have e : (fun x => (F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x) * ζ x) =
        fun x => F x * ζ x - Wf 1 x * ζ x - Wf 2 x * ζ x := by
      funext x; ring
    show ∫ x, Vf 0 x * partialDeriv 0 ζ x = -∫ x, (F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x) * ζ x
    rw [e, integral_sub iFW1 iW2, integral_sub iF iW1]
    linarith
  
  have hTb : ∀ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
      MemLp ((fun b x => A x 0 b * D [b] x) b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧
      MemLp ((fun b x => partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x) b)
        2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧
      fcrWD c s ((fun b x => A x 0 b * D [b] x) b) 0
        ((fun b x => partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x) b) := by
    intro b hb
    have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hb
      rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;> decide
    exact hWsmul (fun y => A y 0 b) (hA 0 b) 0 (D [b]) (E b 0) (hDL b) (hE b 0 hb0).2
      (hDb0 b hb0)
  have hTL : MemLp (fun x => ∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)), A x 0 b * D [b] x) 2
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    memLp_finset_sum (f := fun b x => A x 0 b * D [b] x) _ (fun b hb => (hTb b hb).1)
  have hT'L : MemLp (fun x => ∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
      (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x)) 2
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    memLp_finset_sum
      (f := fun b x => partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x) _
      (fun b hb => (hTb b hb).2.1)
  have hTw : fcrWD c s (fun x => ∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)), A x 0 b * D [b] x) 0
      (fun x => ∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
        (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x)) :=
    hWsum 0 _ _ _ hTb
  have hYL0 : MemLp (fun x => F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    (hP.2.2.2.1.sub (hTan 1 h10).1).sub (hTan 2 h20).1
  
  have hU1 := hWadd 0 (Vf 0) _ _ _ (hVL 0) hTL hYL0 hT'L hNorm hTw
  have hU2 := hWadd 0 _ (G 0) _ (GD 0) ((hVL 0).sub hTL) (hP.2.2.1 0) (hYL0.sub hT'L)
    (hGD 0).2 hU1.2 (hGD 0).1
  have hUL : MemLp (fun x => A x 0 0 * D [0] x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    hL2 _ (hA 0 0).continuousOn _ (hDL 0)
  have hYL : MemLp (fun x => F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x - (∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
      (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x)) - GD 0 x) 2
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    (hYL0.sub hT'L).sub (hGD 0).2
  have hUY : fcrWD c s (fun x => A x 0 0 * D [0] x) 0
      (fun x => F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x - (∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
        (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x)) - GD 0 x) := by
    refine hWcongr 0 _ _ _ _ hU2.2 (fun x _ => ?_) (fun x _ => rfl)
    show Vf 0 x - (∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)), A x 0 b * D [b] x) - G 0 x =
      A x 0 0 * D [0] x
    rw [hVf]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Finset.sum_pair h12]
    ring
  
  have hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (A x 0 0)⁻¹) (Metric.ball c R) := (hA 0 0).inv hne
  have hfin := (hWsmul _ hm 0 _ _ hUL hYL hUY).2.2
  refine hWcongr 0 _ _ _ _ hfin (fun x hx => ?_) (fun x hx => ?_)
  · have hxR := hHsub hx
    show (A x 0 0)⁻¹ * (A x 0 0 * D [0] x) = D [0] x
    exact inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (hne x hxR) _
  · have hxR := hHsub hx
    have hdm : partialDeriv 0 (fun y => (A y 0 0)⁻¹) x =
        -((A x 0 0) ^ 2)⁻¹ * partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 0) x := by
      have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => A y 0 0) x :=
        ((hA 0 0).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hxR)
      have hh := (hasDerivAt_inv (hne x hxR)).comp_hasFDerivAt x hfd.hasFDerivAt
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [show (fun y => (A y 0 0)⁻¹) = (fun t : ℝ => t⁻¹) ∘ (fun y => A y 0 0) from rfl,
        hh.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    show partialDeriv 0 (fun y => (A y 0 0)⁻¹) x * (A x 0 0 * D [0] x) +
        (A x 0 0)⁻¹ * (F x - Wf 1 x - Wf 2 x - (∑ b ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)),
          (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => A y 0 b) x * D [b] x + A x 0 b * E b 0 x)) - GD 0 x) =
      fcrNormalZ A D E GD F x
    rw [hdm, hWf]
    unfold fcrNormalZ
    simp only [Finset.sum_pair h12]
    have h00 := hne x hxR
    field_simp
    ring

(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ) (Dg : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)

(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ) (Dg : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hπc : Continuous (fun x : E3 => x 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
  have hHopen : IsOpen (fcrHalf c s) := by
    show IsOpen (Metric.ball c s ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0})
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hπc)
  have hHmeas : MeasurableSet (fcrHalf c s) := hHopen.measurableSet
  
  have htestd : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i ζ) ∧ HasCompactSupport (partialDeriv i ζ) ∧
        tsupport (partialDeriv i ζ) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
    intro ζ hζ hζc i
    have hf' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ ζ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hζ).2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e i))
      exact hf'.clm_apply contDiff_const
    · show HasCompactSupport (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e i))
      exact hζc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e i)
    · refine subset_trans ?_ (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ)
      apply closure_mono
      intro x hx h
      apply hx
      show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e i) = 0
      rw [h]
      rfl
  
  have hschwarz : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x : E3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ζ) x = partialDeriv j (partialDeriv i ζ) x := by
    intro ζ hζ i j x
    have hf' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ ζ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hζ).2
    have hdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ζ) x :=
      (hf'.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    have key : ∀ v w : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y w) x v =
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ζ) x v w := by
      intro v w
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hdx (differentiableAt_const w)]
      simp
    have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ ζ x :=
      hζ.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
        rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
        first
          | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
          | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top
          | decide)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e j)) x (e i) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e i)) x (e j)
    rw [key, key]
    exact hsymm.eq (e i) (e j)
  
  have hint : ∀ u g : E3 → ℝ, MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → Continuous g →
      HasCompactSupport g → Integrable (fun x => u x * g x) (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro u g hu hg hgc
    have hgv : MemLp g 2 (volume : Measure E3) := hg.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hgc
    exact hu.integrable_mul (hgv.restrict (fcrHalf c s))
  
  obtain ⟨θ, hθdef⟩ : ∃ θ : ℕ → E3 → ℝ,
      θ = fun (n : ℕ) (x : E3) => Real.smoothTransition (((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 - 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hθs : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (θ n) := by
    intro n
    rw [hθdef]
    have hπ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => z 0) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    exact (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).comp ((contDiff_const.mul hπ).sub contDiff_const)
  have hθb : ∀ n x, 0 ≤ θ n x ∧ θ n x ≤ 1 := by
    intro n x
    rw [hθdef]
    exact ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
  have hθge : ∀ n x, θ n x ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 := by
    intro n x h
    by_contra hx
    push_neg at hx
    apply h
    rw [hθdef]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  have hS0 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : E3), 1 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 → 0 < x 0 := by
    intro n x h
    by_contra hx
    push_neg at hx
    have := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 1) hx
    linarith
  have hθpos : ∀ n x, θ n x ≠ 0 → 0 < x 0 := fun n x h => hS0 n x (hθge n x h)
  have hθ1 : ∀ x : E3, 0 < x 0 → Tendsto (fun n => θ n x) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge (2 / x 0)
    apply tendsto_atTop_of_eventually_const (i₀ := N)
    intro n hn
    rw [hθdef]
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    have h1 : 2 / x 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) := hN.trans (by exact_mod_cast hn)
    have h2 : 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * x 0 := by rwa [div_le_iff₀ hx] at h1
    have h3 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 = (n : ℝ) * x 0 + x 0 := by ring
    linarith
  have he0 : (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (e a) = 0 := by
    show (e a) 0 = 0
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Ne.symm ha]
  have hθd : ∀ n x, fderiv ℝ (θ n) x (e a) = 0 := by
    intro n x
    have hℓ : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => ((n : ℝ) + 1) * y 0 - 1)
        (((n : ℝ) + 1) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) x :=
      (((EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt).const_mul
        ((n : ℝ) + 1)).sub_const 1
    have hst : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition
        (deriv Real.smoothTransition (((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 - 1)) (((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0 - 1) :=
      (((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).differentiable (by simp)) _).hasDerivAt
    have hc := hst.comp_hasFDerivAt x hℓ
    have hθeq : θ n = Real.smoothTransition ∘ (fun y : E3 => ((n : ℝ) + 1) * y 0 - 1) := by
      rw [hθdef]
      rfl
    rw [hθeq, hc.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, he0]
    simp
  
  have hibp : ∀ φ ψ : E3 → ℝ, MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → fcrWD c s φ a ψ →
      ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c s →
        ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ψ x * ζ x := by
    intro φ ψ hφ hψ hwd ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨hd1, hd2, hd3⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc a
    have hcut : ∀ n, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => θ n x * ζ x) ∧
        HasCompactSupport (fun x => θ n x * ζ x) ∧
        tsupport (fun x => θ n x * ζ x) ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
      intro n
      refine ⟨(hθs n).mul hζ, hζc.mul_left, ?_⟩
      have hcl : IsClosed (tsupport ζ ∩ {x : E3 | 1 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * x 0}) :=
        (isClosed_tsupport ζ).inter (isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_const.mul hπc))
      refine (closure_minimal ?_ hcl).trans ?_
      · intro x hx
        have hx' : θ n x * ζ x ≠ 0 := hx
        exact ⟨subset_tsupport _ (right_ne_zero_of_mul hx'), hθge n x (left_ne_zero_of_mul hx')⟩
      · intro x hx
        exact Set.mem_inter (hζs hx.1) (hS0 n x hx.2)
    have hdcut : ∀ n x, partialDeriv a (fun y => θ n y * ζ y) x = θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
      intro n x
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (θ n) x := ((hθs n).differentiable (by simp)) x
      have h2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x := (hζ.differentiable (by simp)) x
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => θ n y * ζ y) x (e a) = θ n x * fderiv ℝ ζ x (e a)
      rw [show (fun y => θ n y * ζ y) = θ n * ζ from rfl,
        (h1.hasFDerivAt.mul h2.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hθd n x]
      ring
    have hseq : ∀ n : ℕ, ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x) =
        -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ψ x * (θ n x * ζ x) := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := hcut n
      have h : ∫ x, φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => θ n y * ζ y) x =
          -∫ x, ψ x * (θ n x * ζ x) := hwd _ c1 c2 c3
      have e1 : (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => θ n y * ζ y) x) =
          fun x => φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x) := funext fun x => by rw [hdcut n x]
      rw [e1] at h
      have hz1 : ∀ x ∉ fcrHalf c s, φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x) = 0 := by
        intro x hx
        by_cases h0 : θ n x = 0
        · simp [h0]
        · have hxb : x ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h' => hx (Set.mem_inter (hζs h') (hθpos n x h0))
          rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h' => hxb (hd3 h'))]
          simp
      have hz2 : ∀ x ∉ fcrHalf c s, ψ x * (θ n x * ζ x) = 0 := by
        intro x hx
        by_cases h0 : θ n x = 0
        · simp [h0]
        · have hxb : x ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h' => hx (Set.mem_inter (hζs h') (hθpos n x h0))
          rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hxb]
          simp
      rw [setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hz1,
        setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hz2]
      exact h
    have hT1 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x))
        atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x)) := by
      refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun x => ‖φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x‖)
        (fun n => ?_) ?_ (fun n => ?_) ?_
      · exact (hint φ _ hφ ((hθs n).continuous.mul hd1.continuous) hd2.mul_left).aestronglyMeasurable
      · exact (hint φ _ hφ hd1.continuous hd2).norm
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_
        show ‖φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x)‖ ≤ ‖φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x‖
        have hb := hθb n x
        have hθn : ‖θ n x‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hb.1]
          exact hb.2
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
        calc ‖φ x‖ * (‖θ n x‖ * ‖partialDeriv a ζ x‖)
            ≤ ‖φ x‖ * (1 * ‖partialDeriv a ζ x‖) := by gcongr
          _ = ‖φ x‖ * ‖partialDeriv a ζ x‖ := by ring
      · refine (ae_restrict_iff' hHmeas).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
        have := ((hθ1 x hx.2).mul_const (partialDeriv a ζ x)).const_mul (φ x)
        simpa using this
    have hT2 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ψ x * (θ n x * ζ x))
        atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ψ x * ζ x)) := by
      refine tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (fun x => ‖ψ x * ζ x‖)
        (fun n => ?_) ?_ (fun n => ?_) ?_
      · exact (hint ψ _ hψ ((hθs n).continuous.mul hζ.continuous) hζc.mul_left).aestronglyMeasurable
      · exact (hint ψ _ hψ hζ.continuous hζc).norm
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_
        show ‖ψ x * (θ n x * ζ x)‖ ≤ ‖ψ x * ζ x‖
        have hb := hθb n x
        have hθn : ‖θ n x‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hb.1]
          exact hb.2
        rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul]
        calc ‖ψ x‖ * (‖θ n x‖ * ‖ζ x‖)
            ≤ ‖ψ x‖ * (1 * ‖ζ x‖) := by gcongr
          _ = ‖ψ x‖ * ‖ζ x‖ := by ring
      · refine (ae_restrict_iff' hHmeas).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
        have := ((hθ1 x hx.2).mul_const (ζ x)).const_mul (ψ x)
        simpa using this
    have hT3 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * (θ n x * partialDeriv a ζ x))
        atTop (𝓝 (-∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ψ x * ζ x)) :=
      hT2.neg.congr (fun n => (hseq n).symm)
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique hT1 hT3
  
  intro b ζ hζ hζc hζs
  obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc b
  obtain ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc a
  have h1 := hzt a (partialDeriv b ζ) hb1 hb2 (hb3.trans hζs)
  have h2 := hzt b (partialDeriv a ζ) ha1 ha2 (ha3.trans hζs)
  have hsw : partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b ζ) = partialDeriv b (partialDeriv a ζ) :=
    funext (hschwarz ζ hζ a b)
  rw [hsw, h2] at h1
  have h3 := hibp (Dg b) (E b) (hDg b) (hE b).2 (hE b).1 ζ hζ hζc hζs
  linarith

by

  have htestd : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∀ i : Fin 3,

    · show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y (e i))

  have hschwarz : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x : E3),
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j ζ) x = partialDeriv j (partialDeriv i ζ) x := by
    intro ζ hζ i j x
    have hf' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ ζ) := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hζ).2
    have hdx : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ζ) x :=
      (hf'.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
    have key : ∀ v w : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ ζ y w) x v =

    refine MemLp.of_le_mul (c := C) hφ
      (((hm.mono hHball).aestronglyMeasurable hHmeas).mul hφ.1) ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' hHmeas).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul]

      ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c R →

        have hζd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x := hζ.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by simp)
        show fderiv ℝ (fun y => m y * ζ y) x (e a) =
          fderiv ℝ m x (e a) * ζ x + m x * fderiv ℝ ζ x (e a)
        rw [show (fun y => m y * ζ y) = m * ζ from rfl,
          (hmd.hasFDerivAt.mul hζd.hasFDerivAt).fderiv]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · have hz : ζ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hζs h))
        show fderiv ℝ (fun y => m y * ζ y) x (e a) =
          fderiv ℝ m x (e a) * ζ x + m x * fderiv ℝ ζ x (e a)
        rw [(hout' x hx).fderiv_eq, (hout x hx).fderiv_eq, hz]
        simp
  
  have hwdsmul : ∀ m : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R) → ∀ φ ψ : E3 → ℝ,
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      fcrWD c s φ a ψ →
      fcrWD c s (fun x => m x * φ x) a (fun x => partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x) := by
    intro m hm φ ψ hφ hψ hwd ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have hζR : tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c R := hζs.trans hHball
    obtain ⟨hη, hηc, hηs, hprod⟩ := hsmtest m hm ζ hζ hζc hζR
    obtain ⟨hξ, hξc, hξs, -⟩ := hsmtest (partialDeriv a m) (hpdm m hm) ζ hζ hζc hζR
    obtain ⟨hdη, hdηc, hdηs⟩ := htestd _ hη hηc a
    have h1 : ∫ x, φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m y * ζ y) x = -∫ x, ψ x * (m x * ζ x) :=
      hwd _ hη hηc (hηs.trans hζs)
    have I1 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m y * ζ y) x) :=
      hintV φ _ hφ hdη.continuous hdηc (hdηs.trans (hηs.trans hζs))
    have I2 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * (partialDeriv a m x * ζ x)) :=
      hintV φ _ hφ hξ.continuous hξc (hξs.trans hζs)
    have I3 : Integrable (fun x => ψ x * (m x * ζ x)) :=
      hintV ψ _ hψ hη.continuous hηc (hηs.trans hζs)
    show ∫ x, m x * φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, (partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x) * ζ x
    have e1 : (fun x => m x * φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x) = fun x =>
        φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m y * ζ y) x - φ x * (partialDeriv a m x * ζ x) := by
      funext x
      rw [hprod x]
      ring
    have e2 : (fun x => (partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x) * ζ x) = fun x =>
        φ x * (partialDeriv a m x * ζ x) + ψ x * (m x * ζ x) := by
      funext x
      ring
    rw [e1, e2, integral_sub I1 I2, integral_add I2 I3, h1]
    ring
  
  have hwdadd : ∀ {φ₁ φ₂ ψ₁ ψ₂ : E3 → ℝ}, fcrWD c s φ₁ a ψ₁ → fcrWD c s φ₂ a ψ₂ →
      MemLp φ₁ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp φ₂ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp ψ₁ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp ψ₂ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      fcrWD c s (fun x => φ₁ x + φ₂ x) a (fun x => ψ₁ x + ψ₂ x) := by
    intro φ₁ φ₂ ψ₁ ψ₂ h₁ h₂ m1 m2 m3 m4 ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨hd, hdc, hds⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc a
    have e1 := h₁ ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have e2 := h₂ ζ hζ hζc hζs
    show ∫ x, (φ₁ x + φ₂ x) * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, (ψ₁ x + ψ₂ x) * ζ x
    simp only [add_mul]
    rw [integral_add (hintV φ₁ _ m1 hd.continuous hdc (hds.trans hζs))
        (hintV φ₂ _ m2 hd.continuous hdc (hds.trans hζs)),
      integral_add (hintV ψ₁ _ m3 hζ.continuous hζc hζs) (hintV ψ₂ _ m4 hζ.continuous hζc hζs),
      e1, e2]
    ring
  have hwdsum : ∀ f g : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, (∀ b, MemLp (f b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) →
      (∀ b, MemLp (g b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) → (∀ b, fcrWD c s (f b) a (g b)) →
      fcrWD c s (fun x => ∑ b, f b x) a (fun x => ∑ b, g b x) := by
    intro f g hf hg hfg ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨hd, hdc, hds⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc a
    show ∫ x, (∑ b, f b x) * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, (∑ b, g b x) * ζ x
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => hintV (f b) _ (hf b) hd.continuous hdc (hds.trans hζs)),
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun b _ => hintV (g b) _ (hg b) hζ.continuous hζc hζs),
      ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => hfg b ζ hζ hζc hζs)
  
  have hcut : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c s → ∀ O : Set E3, IsOpen O →
      {x ∈ Metric.ball c s | x 0 = 0} ⊆ O → (∀ x ∈ O, ζ x = 0) →
      ∃ ζh : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζh ∧ HasCompactSupport ζh ∧ tsupport ζh ⊆ fcrHalf c s ∧
        ∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s, ζh =ᶠ[𝓝 x] ζ := by
    intro ζ hζ hζc hζs O hO hOf hOz
    have hAg : ∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s, (fun y : E3 => if 0 < y 0 then ζ y else 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] ζ := by
      intro x hx
      filter_upwards [hPopen.mem_nhds hx.2] with y hy
      have hy' : 0 < y 0 := hy
      simp [hy']
    have hK : ∀ x, x ∉ fcrHalf c s →
        (fun y : E3 => if 0 < y 0 then ζ y else 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxb : x ∈ Metric.ball c s
      · have hx0 : ¬ 0 < x 0 := fun h => hx ⟨hxb, h⟩
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (not_lt.1 hx0) with hlt | heq
        · filter_upwards [hNopen.mem_nhds hlt] with y hy
          have hy' : ¬ 0 < y 0 := not_lt.2 (le_of_lt hy)
          simp [hy']
        · filter_upwards [hO.mem_nhds (hOf ⟨hxb, heq⟩)] with y hy
          simp [hOz y hy]
      · have h1 : ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h => hxb (hζs h))
        filter_upwards [h1] with y hy
        have hy' : ζ y = 0 := hy
        simp [hy']
    refine ⟨fun y : E3 => if 0 < y 0 then ζ y else 0, ?_, ?_, ?_, hAg⟩
    · refine contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.2 fun x => ?_
      by_cases hx : x ∈ fcrHalf c s
      · exact hζ.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hAg x hx)
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hK x hx)
    · refine hζc.mono ?_
      intro x hx
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
      intro h0
      apply hx
      simp [h0]
    · intro x hx
      by_contra hxn
      exact notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.2 (hK x hxn) hx
  
  have hagree1 : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3), f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g → ∀ i,
      partialDeriv i f x = partialDeriv i g x := by
    intro f g x h i
    show fderiv ℝ f x (e i) = fderiv ℝ g x (e i)
    rw [h.fderiv_eq]
  have hagreeH : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ), (∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s, f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g) →
      ∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      f x = g x ∧ partialDeriv i f x = partialDeriv i g x ∧
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) x = partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j g) x := by
    intro f g h x hx i j
    refine ⟨(h x hx).eq_of_nhds, hagree1 f g x (h x hx) i, ?_⟩
    apply hagree1
    filter_upwards [hHopen.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact hagree1 f g y (h y hy) j
  have hzeroO : ∀ (ζ : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3), IsOpen O → (∀ x ∈ O, ζ x = 0) →
      ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ O, partialDeriv i ζ x = 0 := by
    intro ζ O hO hz i x hx
    have h : ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hO.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
      exact hz y hy
    rw [hagree1 ζ _ x h i]
    show fderiv ℝ (fun _ : E3 => (0 : ℝ)) x (e i) = 0
    simp
  
  have hwdH : ∀ (φ ψ : E3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3), fcrWD c s φ i ψ → ∀ η : E3 → ℝ,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ η → HasCompactSupport η → tsupport η ⊆ fcrHalf c s →
      ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * partialDeriv i η x = -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ψ x * η x := by
    intro φ ψ i hwd η hη hηc hηs
    obtain ⟨-, -, hd3⟩ := htestd η hη hηc i
    have z1 : ∀ x ∉ fcrHalf c s, φ x * partialDeriv i η x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hηs (hd3 h)))]
      simp
    have z2 : ∀ x ∉ fcrHalf c s, ψ x * η x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hηs h))]
      simp
    rw [setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero z1,
      setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero z2]
    exact hwd η hη hηc hηs
  
  have hcrux : ∀ (V W : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F₀ FD : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ d, MemLp (V d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) →
      (∀ d, MemLp (W d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) →
      MemLp F₀ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → MemLp FD 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      (∀ d, fcrWD c s (V d) a (W d)) → fcrWD c s F₀ a FD →
      fdrWeakEq c s V F₀ → fdrWeakEq c s W FD := by
    intro V W F₀ FD hV hW hF hFD hVW hFFD hid ζ hζ hζc hζs hOex
    obtain ⟨O, hO, hOf, hOz⟩ := hOex
    obtain ⟨ζh, hc1, hc2, hc3, hc4⟩ := hcut ζ hζ hζc hζs O hO hOf hOz
    have hag := hagreeH ζh ζ hc4
    obtain ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc a
    have h0 := hid (partialDeriv a ζ) ha1 ha2 (ha3.trans hζs)
      ⟨O, hO, hOf, hzeroO ζ O hO hOz a⟩
    have hIV : ∀ d, Integrable (fun x => V d x * partialDeriv d (partialDeriv a ζ) x)
        (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := fun d =>
      hint (V d) _ (hV d) (htestd _ ha1 ha2 d).1.continuous (htestd _ ha1 ha2 d).2.1
    rw [integral_add (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => hIV d))
        (hint F₀ _ hF ha1.continuous ha2),
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => hIV d)] at h0
    have hkey : ∀ d, ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, V d x * partialDeriv d (partialDeriv a ζ) x =
        -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, W d x * partialDeriv d ζ x := by
      intro d
      obtain ⟨hd1, hd2, hd3⟩ := htestd ζh hc1 hc2 d
      have e1 : ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, V d x * partialDeriv d (partialDeriv a ζ) x =
          ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, V d x * partialDeriv a (partialDeriv d ζh) x := by
        refine setIntegral_congr_fun hHmeas (fun x hx => ?_)
        simp only [hschwarz ζ hζ d a x, (hag x hx a d).2.2]
      have e2 : ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, W d x * partialDeriv d ζh x =
          ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, W d x * partialDeriv d ζ x := by
        refine setIntegral_congr_fun hHmeas (fun x hx => ?_)
        simp only [(hag x hx d d).2.1]
      rw [e1, hwdH (V d) (W d) a (hVW d) _ hd1 hd2 (hd3.trans hc3), e2]
    have hF' : ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, F₀ x * partialDeriv a ζ x =
        -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, FD x * ζ x := by
      have e1 : ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, F₀ x * partialDeriv a ζ x =
          ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, F₀ x * partialDeriv a ζh x := by
        refine setIntegral_congr_fun hHmeas (fun x hx => ?_)
        simp only [(hag x hx a a).2.1]
      have e2 : ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, FD x * ζh x = ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, FD x * ζ x := by
        refine setIntegral_congr_fun hHmeas (fun x hx => ?_)
        simp only [(hag x hx a a).1]
      rw [e1, hwdH F₀ FD a hFFD ζh hc1 hc2 hc3, e2]
    simp only [hkey, hF', Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h0
    have hIW : ∀ d, Integrable (fun x => W d x * partialDeriv d ζ x)
        (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := fun d =>
      hint (W d) _ (hW d) (htestd ζ hζ hζc d).1.continuous (htestd ζ hζ hζc d).2.1
    rw [integral_add (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => hIW d))
        (hint FD _ hFD hζ.continuous hζc),
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => hIW d)]
    linarith
  
  have hDm : ∀ b, MemLp (D [b]) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    fun b => hP.1.2.1 [b] (by simp)
  have hpd : ∀ d b : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b)) (Metric.ball c R) :=
    fun d b => hpdm _ (hA d b)
  have hfirst : ∀ i, fcrWD c s w i (D [i]) := by
    intro i ζ h1 h2 h3
    have h0 := hP.1.2.2 [] i (by simp) ζ h1 h2 h3
    rw [hP.1.1] at h0
    exact h0
  have hsob : fcrSob c s 1 (D [a]) (fun L => match L with | [] => D [a] | b :: _ => E b) := by
    refine ⟨rfl, fun L hL => ?_, fun L b hL => ?_⟩
    · cases L with
      | nil => exact hDm a
      | cons b t => exact (hE b).2
    · cases L with
      | nil =>
        intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
        obtain ⟨hb1, hb2, hb3⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc b
        obtain ⟨ha1, ha2, ha3⟩ := htestd ζ hζ hζc a
        have h1 := hfirst a (partialDeriv b ζ) hb1 hb2 (hb3.trans hζs)
        have h2 := hfirst b (partialDeriv a ζ) ha1 ha2 (ha3.trans hζs)
        have h3 := (hE b).1 ζ hζ hζc hζs
        have he : (fun x => w x * partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b ζ) x) =
            (fun x => w x * partialDeriv b (partialDeriv a ζ) x) := by
          funext x
          rw [hschwarz ζ hζ a b x]
        rw [he] at h1
        show ∫ x, D [a] x * partialDeriv b ζ x = -∫ x, E b x * ζ x
        linarith
      | cons b' t => simp at hL
  have hVm : ∀ d, MemLp (fun x => (∑ b, A x d b * D [b] x) + G d x) 2
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := fun d =>
    (memLp_finset_sum Finset.univ
      (fun b _ => hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b))).add (hP.2.2.1 d)
  have hG'm : ∀ d, MemLp (fun x => (∑ b, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x)
      2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := fun d =>
    (memLp_finset_sum Finset.univ
      (fun b _ => hmemsmul _ (hpd d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b))).add (hGa d).2
  have hWm : ∀ d, MemLp (fun x => (∑ b, A x d b * E b x) +
      ((∑ b, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x)) 2
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := fun d =>
    (memLp_finset_sum Finset.univ
      (fun b _ => hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hE b).2)).add (hG'm d)
  have hVW : ∀ d, fcrWD c s (fun x => (∑ b, A x d b * D [b] x) + G d x) a
      (fun x => (∑ b, A x d b * E b x) +
        ((∑ b, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x)) := by
    intro d
    have hS := hwdsum (fun b x => A x d b * D [b] x)
      (fun b x => partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x + A x d b * E b x)
      (fun b => hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b))
      (fun b => (hmemsmul _ (hpd d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b)).add
        (hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hE b).2))
      (fun b => hwdsmul _ (hA d b) _ _ (hDm b) (hE b).2 (hE b).1)
    have hT := hwdadd hS (hGa d).1
      (memLp_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun b _ => hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b)))
      (hP.2.2.1 d)
      (memLp_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun b _ => (hmemsmul _ (hpd d b).continuousOn _ (hDm b)).add
        (hmemsmul _ (hA d b).continuousOn _ (hE b).2)))
      (hGa d).2
    have e : (fun x => (∑ b, (partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x + A x d b * E b x))
        + GDa d x) = (fun x => (∑ b, A x d b * E b x) +
          ((∑ b, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x)) := by
      funext x
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      ring
    rw [← e]
    exact hT
  refine ⟨hsob, hzta, hG'm, hFa.2, ?_⟩
  exact hcrux (fun d x => (∑ b, A x d b * D [b] x) + G d x)
    (fun d x => (∑ b, A x d b * E b x) +
      ((∑ b, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x))
    F FDa hVm hWm hP.2.2.2.1 hFa.2 hVW hFa.1 hP.2.2.2.2

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R s s' : ℝ) (hs' : 0 < s') (hss : s' < s) (hsR : s < R)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (hAs : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, ∀ a b : Fin 3, A x a b = A x b a)
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, (A x).PosDef)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fdrProb c s A w D G F) (hG : ∀ d, ∃ DG, fcrSob c s 1 (G d) DG)
    (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : Fin 3) :
    ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, fcrWD c s' (D [b]) a χ ∧ MemLp χ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s'))

signature.name: fdr_tangential_energy
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R s s' : ℝ) (hs' : 0 < s') (hss : s' < s) (hsR : s < R)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (hAs : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, ∀ a b : Fin 3, A x a b = A x b a)
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, (A x).PosDef)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fdrProb c s A w D G F) (hG : ∀ d, ∃ DG, fcrSob c s 1 (G d) DG)
    (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : Fin 3) :
    ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, fcrWD c s' (D [b]) a χ ∧ MemLp χ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s'))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = (s - s') / 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; linarith
  have hδs : s' + 4 * δ = s := by rw [hδ]; ring
  have hopen : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen (fcrHalf c r) := fun r =>
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  have hea : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  
  obtain ⟨η, hηin, hηout⟩ : ∃ η : ContDiffBump c, η.rIn = s' ∧ η.rOut = s' + δ :=
    ⟨⟨s', s' + δ, hs', by linarith⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hηc1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 (⇑η) := η.contDiff
  have hfdc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ (⇑η)) := hηc1.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := Continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hfdc
    (η.hasCompactSupport.fderiv ℝ)
  have hdη : ∀ (d : Fin 3) (x : E3), |partialDeriv d (⇑η) x| ≤ max C₀ 0 := by

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(lam Λ Cη : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) (hC : 0 ≤ Cη) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (S : Set E3) (B : E3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (η u F Q : E3 → ℝ)
      (dη U Rr : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (a : Fin 3), MeasurableSet S → 0 ≤ M →
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        lam * ∑ i : Fin 3, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ξ i * B x i j * ξ j) →
      (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |B x i j| ≤ Λ) →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => B x i j) (volume.restrict S)) →
      Continuous η → (∀ x, 0 ≤ η x ∧ η x ≤ 1) →
      (∀ d, Continuous (dη d)) → (∀ d x, |dη d x| ≤ Cη) →
      MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict S) → (∀ d, MemLp (U d) 2 (volume.restrict S)) →
      (∀ d, MemLp (Rr d) 2 (volume.restrict S)) → MemLp F 2 (volume.restrict S) →
      MemLp Q 2 (volume.restrict S) →
      ∫ x in S, u x ^ 2 ≤ M → (∀ d, ∫ x in S, Rr d x ^ 2 ≤ M) → ∫ x in S, F x ^ 2 ≤ M →
      ∫ x in S, Q x ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in S, (η x ^ 2 * U a x + 2 * η x * dη a x * u x) ^ 2 →
      (∫ x in S, ∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ b : Fin 3, B x d b * U b x) + Rr d x) *
          (η x ^ 2 * U d x + 2 * η x * dη d x * u x)) = ∫ x in S, F x * Q x →
      ∫ x in S, η x ^ 2 * ∑ d : Fin 3, U d x ^ 2 ≤ K * M

    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fdrProb c s A w D G F)
    (η : ContDiffBump c) (hηr : η.rOut = s₁) (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : ℝ) (hh : h ≠ 0) (hhh : |h| ≤ h₀) :
    ((∫ x in fcrHalf c s₂, ∑ d : Fin 3,
       ((∑ b : Fin 3, A (x + h • e a) d b * fcrDQ a h (D [b]) x) +
         ((∑ b : Fin 3, fcrDQ a h (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + fcrDQ a h (G d) x)) *

      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂))

        have hKeq : {y : E3 | 2 ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ b} = Metric.closedBall 0 b ∩ {y | 2 ≤ ‖y‖} := by
          ext y
          simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
          tauto
        rw [hKeq]
        exact (isCompact_closedBall 0 b).inter_right (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm)
      refine hK.image_of_continuousOn ((hAF.ends j).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono ?_)
      intro y hy
      show y ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source
      rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq]
      show 1 < ‖y‖
      linarith [hy.1]
    refine (hAF.isCompact_core.union (isCompact_iUnion hA)).of_isClosed_subset hclosed ?_
    intro x hx
    by_cases hc : x ∈ (⋃ k, (hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ
    · exact Or.inl hc
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_image,
        Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hc
      obtain ⟨j, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hc
      refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, y, ⟨le_of_lt hy, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      by_contra hyb
      exact hx (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, y, not_le.1 hyb, rfl⟩)
  
  choose ρ₀ hρ₀2 hρ₀cl using fun j => endChart_far_isClosed g hAF j
  obtain ⟨ρA, hρA⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = 2 + ∑ j, ρ₀ j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, ρ₀ j := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => by linarith [hρ₀2 j]
  have hρle : ∀ j, ρ₀ j ≤ ρA := fun j => by
    have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := ρ₀) (fun i _ => by linarith [hρ₀2 i]) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    linarith
  have hρA2 : 2 ≤ ρA := by linarith
  
  have hθex : ∀ j, ∃ θ : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ θ ∧ (∀ p, 0 ≤ θ p) ∧
      tsupport θ ⊆ (hAF.ends j).Φ.target ∧ (∀ p, p ∉ (hAF.ends j).Φ.target → θ p = 0) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → ‖y‖ ≤ ρA + 1 / 4 → θ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 0) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, ρA + 1 / 2 ≤ ‖y‖ → θ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 1) := fun j =>
    hbump (hAF.ends j) (ρA + 1 / 4) (ρA + 1 / 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)
      (hρ₀cl j _ (by linarith [hρle j]))
  choose θ θsm θnn θts θoff θ0 θ1 using hθex
  
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : Set M, T = (⋃ j, (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρA + 1 / 2 < ‖y‖})ᶜ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : Set M, W = (⋃ j, (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρA + 1 ≤ ‖y‖})ᶜ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hTcpt : IsCompact T := by rw [hT]; exact hTc _ (by linarith)
  have hWo : IsOpen W := by
    rw [hW]
    exact (isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun j => hρ₀cl j _ (by linarith [hρle j])).isOpen_compl
  have hTW : T ⊆ W := by
    rw [hT, hW]
    intro x hx hxW
    obtain ⟨j, y, hy, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxW
    have hy' : ρA + 1 ≤ ‖y‖ := hy
    exact hx (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, y, (show ρA + 1 / 2 < ‖y‖ by linarith), rfl⟩)
  
  have hbx : ∀ x ∈ T, ∃ f : SmoothBumpFunction 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x, tsupport f ⊆ W := fun x hx =>
    ((SmoothBumpFunction.nhds_basis_tsupport x).mem_iff.1 (hWo.mem_nhds (hTW hx))).imp
      fun f hf => hf.2
  have hcb : ∃ (m : ℕ) (p : Fin m → M) (w : Fin m → M → ℝ),
      (∀ l, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (w l)) ∧ (∀ l x, 0 ≤ w l x) ∧
      (∀ l, IsCompact (tsupport (w l))) ∧ (∀ l, tsupport (w l) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (p l)).source) ∧
      (∀ l, tsupport (w l) ⊆ W) ∧ (∀ x ∈ T, ∃ l, 0 < w l x) := by
    choose f hf using hbx
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hcov⟩ := hTcpt.elim_nhds_subcover
      (fun x => if hx : x ∈ T then Function.support (f x hx) else Set.univ) (by
        intro x hx
        simp only [dif_pos hx]
        exact (f x hx).isOpen_support.mem_nhds
          (Function.mem_support.2 (by rw [(f x hx).eq_one]; exact one_ne_zero)))
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : {x // x ∈ t} → M → ℝ,
        F = fun s : {x // x ∈ t} => ⇑(f s.1 (ht s.1 s.2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨t.card, fun l => (t.equivFin.symm l).1, fun l => F (t.equivFin.symm l),
      ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro l; rw [hF]; exact (f _ _).contMDiff
    · intro l x; rw [hF]; exact (f _ _).nonneg
    · intro l; rw [hF]; exact (f _ _).hasCompactSupport
    · intro l; rw [hF]; exact (f _ _).tsupport_subset_chartAt_source
    · intro l; rw [hF]; exact hf _ _
    · intro x hx
      have hx' := hcov hx
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx'
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hx'
      rw [dif_pos (ht y hy)] at hxy
      refine ⟨t.equivFin ⟨y, hy⟩, ?_⟩
      simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      rw [hF]
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (f _ _).nonneg (Ne.symm hxy)
  obtain ⟨m, p, w, wsm, wnn, wcpt, wch, wW, wcov⟩ := hcb
  
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : M → ℝ, S = fun x => ∑ l, w l x + ∑ j, θ j x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hSx : ∀ x, S x = ∑ l, w l x + ∑ j, θ j x := fun x => by rw [hS]
  have Ssm : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ S := by
    rw [hS]
    exact (contMDiff_finset_sum fun l _ => wsm l).add (contMDiff_finset_sum fun j _ => θsm j)
  have Spos : ∀ x, 0 < S x := by
    intro x
    rw [hSx]
    have h1 : 0 ≤ ∑ l, w l x := Finset.sum_nonneg fun l _ => wnn l x
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ∑ j, θ j x := Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => θnn j x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ T
    · obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := wcov x hx
      have h3 : w l x ≤ ∑ l, w l x :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun l => w l x) (fun l _ => wnn l x) (Finset.mem_univ l)
      linarith
    · rw [hT] at hx
      simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, not_not, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_image,
        Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hx
      obtain ⟨j, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
      have h3 := θ1 j y hy.le
      have h4 : θ j ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) ≤ ∑ k, θ k ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k => θ k ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) (fun k _ => θnn k _)
          (Finset.mem_univ j)
      linarith
  have htsdiv : ∀ F : M → ℝ, tsupport (fun x => F x / S x) ⊆ tsupport F := by
    intro F
    apply closure_mono
    intro x hx
    rw [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
    intro h0
    apply hx
    simp [h0]
  
  let Φc : M → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ := fun q =>
    { toPartialEquiv := (chartAt E3 q).symm.toPartialEquiv
      open_source := (chartAt E3 q).open_target
      open_target := (chartAt E3 q).open_source
      contMDiffOn_toFun := contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      contMDiffOn_invFun := contMDiffOn_chart }
  have hΦct : ∀ q, (Φc q).target = (chartAt E3 q).source := fun q => rfl
  
  refine ⟨ρA, m + hAF.numEnds, Fin.append (fun l => Φc (p l)) (fun j => (hAF.ends j).Φ),
    Fin.append (fun l x => w l x / S x) (fun j x => θ j x / S x), ?_⟩
  unfold IsCLSAtlas
  refine ⟨hρA2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    induction i using Fin.addCases with
    | left l =>
      simp only [Fin.append_left]
      exact (wsm l).div₀ Ssm (fun x => (Spos x).ne')
    | right j =>
      simp only [Fin.append_right]
      exact (θsm j).div₀ Ssm (fun x => (Spos x).ne')
  · intro i x
    induction i using Fin.addCases with
    | left l =>
      simp only [Fin.append_left]
      exact div_nonneg (wnn l x) (Spos x).le
    | right j =>
      simp only [Fin.append_right]
      exact div_nonneg (θnn j x) (Spos x).le
  · intro x
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
    simp only [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_div, ← add_div, ← hSx x, div_self (Spos x).ne']
  · intro i
    induction i using Fin.addCases with
    | left l =>
      simp only [Fin.append_left]
      rw [hΦct]
      exact (htsdiv (w l)).trans (wch l)
    | right j =>
      simp only [Fin.append_right]
      exact (htsdiv (θ j)).trans (θts j)
  · intro i
    induction i using Fin.addCases with
    | left l =>
      left
      simp only [Fin.append_left]
      exact (wcpt l).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) (htsdiv (w l))
    | right j =>
      right
      refine ⟨j, by simp only [Fin.append_right], ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro y hy
        simp only [Fin.append_right]
        have hxW : (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∉ W := by
          rw [hW]
          intro h
          exact h (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨j, y, hy, rfl⟩)
        have hw0 : ∀ l, w l ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 0 := fun l =>
          image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hxW (wW l h))
        have hs : y ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
          rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq]
          show 1 < ‖y‖
          linarith
        have hxt : (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.target :=
          (hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hs
        have hθk : ∀ k, k ≠ j → θ k ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 0 := fun k hkj =>
          θoff k _ (Set.disjoint_left.1 (hAF.disjoint (Ne.symm hkj)) hxt)
        have hθj : θ j ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 1 := θ1 j y (by linarith)
        have hSj : S ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 1 := by
          rw [hSx, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun l _ => hw0 l),
            Finset.sum_eq_single j (fun k _ hkj => hθk k hkj)
              (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) h), hθj, zero_add]
        rw [hSj, hθj, div_one]
      · intro y hy1 hy2
        simp only [Fin.append_right]
        rw [θ0 j y hy1 (by linarith), zero_div]

subgoal_signatures.name: endChart_far_isClosed
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ ρ₀ ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, ρ₀ ≤ ρ → IsClosed ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖x‖})

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (ρA : ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (T : Set M) (hT : IsCompact T) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → HasCompactSupport u →
      atlasInt g κ χ (T.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2)) ≤ C * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u)

signature.name: cls_poincare_compact
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (ρA : ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (T : Set M) (hT : IsCompact T) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → HasCompactSupport u →
      atlasInt g κ χ (T.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2)) ≤ C * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hcont : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun y : E3 => y i) := fun i => by fun_prop
  let Qc : E3 → ℝ → Set E3 := fun c s => {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, c i - s ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ c i + s}
  let Qo : E3 → ℝ → Set E3 := fun c s => {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, c i - s < y i ∧ y i < c i + s}
  have hF1 : ∀ (c : E3) (s : ℝ), 0 ≤ s → Qc c s ⊆ Metric.closedBall c (2 * s) := by
    intro c s hs y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, EuclideanSpace.dist_eq]
    have h : ∀ i, dist (y i) (c i) ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      intro i
      have h1 := hy i
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have h2 : |y i - c i| ≤ s := abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [h1.1], by linarith [h1.2]⟩
      have h3 : |y i - c i| ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h2 2
      exact h3
    have h4 : ∑ i : Fin 3, dist (y i) (c i) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * s) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      nlinarith [h 0, h 1, h 2, sq_nonneg s]
    calc Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, dist (y i) (c i) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((2 * s) ^ 2) :=
          Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h4
      _ = 2 * s := Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)
  have hQo_open : ∀ (c : E3) (s : ℝ), IsOpen (Qo c s) := by
    intro c s
    have : Qo c s = ⋂ i : Fin 3, {y : E3 | c i - s < y i ∧ y i < c i + s} := by
      ext y; simp [Qo]
    rw [this]
    exact isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i =>
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (hcont i)).inter (isOpen_lt (hcont i) continuous_const)
  have hQc_closed : ∀ (c : E3) (s : ℝ), IsClosed (Qc c s) := by
    intro c s
    have : Qc c s = ⋂ i : Fin 3, {y : E3 | c i - s ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ c i + s} := by
      ext y; simp [Qc]
    rw [this]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun i =>
      (isClosed_le continuous_const (hcont i)).inter (isClosed_le (hcont i) continuous_const)
  have hQc_cpt : ∀ (c : E3) (s : ℝ), 0 ≤ s → IsCompact (Qc c s) := fun c s hs =>
    (isCompact_closedBall c (2 * s)).of_isClosed_subset (hQc_closed c s) (hF1 c s hs)
  have hQoQc : ∀ (c : E3) (s : ℝ), Qo c s ⊆ Qc c s :=
    fun c s y hy i => ⟨(hy i).1.le, (hy i).2.le⟩
  have hcen : ∀ (c : E3) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → c ∈ Qo c s :=
    fun c s hs i => ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hQcsrc : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (c : E3) (s : ℝ), 0 < s →
      Metric.closedBall c (2 * s) ⊆ ψ.source → Qc c s ⊆ ψ.source :=
    fun ψ c s hs hB => (hF1 c s hs.le).trans hB
  
  have hdetc : ∀ ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source := by
    intro ψ
    have hGc : ContinuousOn (g.coeff ψ) ψ.source :=
      continuousOn_pi.2 fun a => continuousOn_pi.2 fun c =>
        (coeff_contDiffOn_source g ψ a c).continuousOn
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn ((continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hGc)
  
  let ι : Type _ := {b : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ × E3 × ℝ //
      0 < b.2.2 ∧ Metric.closedBall b.2.1 (2 * b.2.2) ⊆ b.1.source}
  let Gs : ι → Set M := fun b => b.1.1 '' Qo b.1.2.1 b.1.2.2
  have hGo : ∀ b, IsOpen (Gs b) := fun b =>
    b.1.1.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hQo_open _ _)
      ((hQoQc _ _).trans (hQcsrc b.1.1 _ _ b.2.1 b.2.2))
  have hGne : ∀ b, (Set.univ ∩ Gs b).Nonempty := fun b =>
    ⟨b.1.1 b.1.2.1, Set.mem_univ _, b.1.2.1, hcen _ _ b.2.1, rfl⟩
  have hGcov : (Set.univ : Set M) ⊆ ⋃ b, Gs b := by
    intro p _
    let κp : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞ :=
      PartialDiffeomorph.mk (chartAt E3 p).symm.toPartialEquiv (chartAt E3 p).open_target
        (chartAt E3 p).open_source contMDiffOn_chart_symm contMDiffOn_chart
    have hsrc : κp.source = (chartAt E3 p).target := rfl
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (chartAt E3 p).open_target (chartAt E3 p p)
      (mem_chart_target E3 p)
    have hB : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) (2 * (ε / 4)) ⊆ κp.source := by
      rw [hsrc]
      exact (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨(κp, chartAt E3 p p, ε / 4), by positivity, hB⟩, chartAt E3 p p,
      hcen _ _ (by positivity), ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p
    exact (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
  
  obtain ⟨c0, s0, hs0, hB0, hgood0⟩ := cps_anchor g hAF ρA κ χ hA k
  have hgood : ∀ b : ι, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      HasCompactSupport u → ∫ y in Qc b.1.2.1 b.1.2.2, (u (b.1.1 y)) ^ 2 ≤
        C * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) := by
    intro b
    have hr := pcr_poinc_reach (Set.univ : Set M) isPreconnected_univ Gs hGo hGcov hGne
      (⟨((hAF.ends k).Φ, c0, s0), hs0, hB0⟩ : ι) b
    induction hr with
    | refl => exact hgood0
    | @tail a c _ hac ih =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2⟩ := hac
      exact cps_good_propagate g hAF ρA κ χ hA a.1.1 c.1.1 a.1.2.1 c.1.2.1 a.1.2.2 c.1.2.2
        a.2.1 c.2.1 a.2.2 c.2.2 ⟨p, hp1.2, hp2⟩ ih
  choose Cg hCg0 hCg using hgood
  
  have hMb : ∀ b : ι, ∃ Mb : ℝ, 0 ≤ Mb ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Qc b.1.2.1 b.1.2.2, Real.sqrt (g.coeff b.1.1 y).det ≤ Mb := by
    intro b
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (hQc_cpt _ _ b.2.1.le).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((hdetc b.1.1).mono (hQcsrc b.1.1 _ _ b.2.1 b.2.2))
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hC y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h1.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  choose Mb hMb0 hMb using hMb
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hT.elim_finite_subcover Gs hGo (fun p _ => hGcov (Set.mem_univ p))
  refine ⟨∑ b ∈ t, Mb b * Cg b, Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ => mul_nonneg (hMb0 b) (hCg0 b), ?_⟩
  intro u hu hus
  
  have hGc : ∀ ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => (fun p => u p ^ 2) (ψ y)) ψ.source :=
    fun ψ => (hu.continuous.pow 2).comp_continuousOn ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
  have hG0 : ∀ p, 0 ≤ (fun p => u p ^ 2) p := fun p => sq_nonneg _
  have hGK : ∀ p, p ∉ tsupport u → (fun p => u p ^ 2) p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hp]
  let Tb : ι → Set M := fun b => T ∩ b.1.1 '' Qc b.1.2.1 b.1.2.2
  have hTb_closed : ∀ b, IsClosed (Tb b) := fun b =>
    hT.isClosed.inter ((hQc_cpt _ _ b.2.1.le).image_of_continuousOn

    obtain ⟨b, hb, y, hy, hyp⟩ := h1

  have h2 : ∀ b ∈ t, atlasInt g κ χ ((Tb b).indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2)) ≤
      Mb b * Cg b * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) := by
    intro b _

    have hcpt := hQc_cpt b.1.2.1 b.1.2.2 b.2.1.le

    calc atlasInt g κ χ ((Tb b).indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2))
        ≤ ∫ y in Qc b.1.2.1 b.1.2.2, u (b.1.1 y) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (g.coeff b.1.1 y).det := h3
      _ ≤ Mb b * ∫ y in Qc b.1.2.1 b.1.2.2, u (b.1.1 y) ^ 2 := h4

    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _))
    · refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hmeas' ?_
      intro y hy
      have : 3 * ρ' / 2 < ‖y‖ := hy
      exact hpt u hu y (by linarith)
  have hstep2 : ∫ y in {y : E3 | 3 * ρ' / 2 < ‖y‖}, 4 * (g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det) =
      4 * ∫ y in {y : E3 | 3 * ρ' / 2 < ‖y‖}, g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det :=
    integral_const_mul 4 _
  have hstep3 : ∫ y in {y : E3 | 3 * ρ' / 2 < ‖y‖}, g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det ≤
      ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρA + 1 < ‖y‖}, g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det := by
    refine setIntegral_mono_set hP2 ?_ hS'S₁.eventuallyLE
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hmeas₁ ?_
    intro y hy
    have : ρA + 1 < ‖y‖ := hy
    exact mul_nonneg (hP1 y (by linarith)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hchain : ∫ y in {y : E3 | 3 * ρ' / 2 < ‖y‖},
        ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k (fun z => u ((hAF.ends j).Φ z)) y) ^ 2 ≤
      4 * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) :=
    hstep1.trans (hstep2.le.trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hstep3.trans hP3) (by norm_num)))

      ≤ 4 * ∫ y in {y : E3 | 3 * ρ' / 2 < ‖y‖},

    _ ≤ 4 * (4 * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hchain (by norm_num)

    (hLa : ∀ u v, P u → P v → L (u + v) = L u + L v)

    (hβ₀ : ∀ w, P w → |L w| ≤ β₀ * Real.sqrt (D w)) :

by
  classical
  
  have quad : ∀ a b : X, P a → P b → ∀ s t : ℝ,
      Q (s • a + t • b) (s • a + t • b) = s ^ 2 * Q a a + 2 * s * t * Q a b + t ^ 2 * Q b b ∧
      L (s • a + t • b) = s * L a + t * L b := by
    intro a b ha hb s t
    have hA : P (s • a) := hPs s a ha
    have hB : P (t • b) := hPs t b hb
    have hC : P (s • a + t • b) := hPa _ _ hA hB
    have e1 := hQa (s • a) (t • b) (s • a + t • b) hA hB hC
    have e2 := hQh s a (s • a + t • b) ha hC
    have f2 := hQh t b (s • a + t • b) hb hC
    have e3 := hQs a (s • a + t • b) ha hC
    have f3 := hQs b (s • a + t • b) hb hC
    have e4 := hQa (s • a) (t • b) a hA hB ha
    have f4 := hQa (s • a) (t • b) b hA hB hb
    have e5 := hQh s a a ha ha
    have e6 := hQh t b a hb ha
    have f5 := hQh s a b ha hb
    have f6 := hQh t b b hb hb
    have e7 := hQs b a hb ha
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [e1, e2, f2, e3, f3, e4, f4, e5, e6, f5, f6, e7]; ring
    · rw [hLa _ _ hA hB, hLh s a ha, hLh t b hb]
  have hQ00 : Q 0 0 = 0 := by
    have h := hQh 0 0 0 hP0 hP0
    rw [zero_smul] at h
    rw [h]; ring
  have hL0 : L 0 = 0 := by
    have h := hLh 0 0 hP0
    rw [zero_smul] at h
    rw [h]; ring
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : X → ℝ, J = fun w => Q w w / 2 - L w := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hJw : ∀ w, J w = Q w w / 2 - L w := by intro w; rw [hJ]
  have hJ0 : J 0 = 0 := by rw [hJw, hQ00, hL0]; ring

    rw [hJw]
    have h1 := hβ₀ w hw
    have h2 := hcoer w hw
    have h3 := hD w hw
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt h3
    have hl := le_abs_self (L w)
    have hsq : 0 ≤ (c * Real.sqrt (D w) - β₀) ^ 2 / (2 * c) := by positivity
    have hexp : (c * Real.sqrt (D w) - β₀) ^ 2 / (2 * c)
        = c * Real.sqrt (D w) ^ 2 / 2 - β₀ * Real.sqrt (D w) + β₀ ^ 2 / (2 * c) := by
      field_simp; ring
    rw [hs] at hexp
    linarith
  
  have hne : (J '' {w | P w}).Nonempty := ⟨J 0, 0, hP0, rfl⟩
  have hbdd : BddBelow (J '' {w | P w}) := by
    refine ⟨-(β₀ ^ 2 / (2 * c)), ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact hlow w hw
  obtain ⟨μ, hμdef⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ, μ = sInf (J '' {w | P w}) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hμ : ∀ w, P w → μ ≤ J w := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hμdef]

    intro n
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    have hlt : sInf (J '' {w | P w}) < μ + 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
      rw [← hμdef]; linarith
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, h⟩ := exists_lt_of_csInf_lt hne hlt

    refine ⟨fun n => if J (a n) ≤ 0 then a n else 0, fun n => ?_, fun n => ?_, fun n => ?_⟩

    have h6 : (c * Real.sqrt (D (u n))) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * β ^ 2 := by

    obtain ⟨q2, l2⟩ := quad (u n) (u m) (hPu n) (hPu m) (1 / 2) (1 / 2)

    rw [hJw, q2, l2] at hm1
    have hn1 := hJlt n
    have hm2 := hJlt m
    rw [hJw] at hn1 hm2
    rw [hdiff, q1]
    have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
    have hNn : (N : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hNm : (N : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
    have hn' : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le hNpos (by linarith)
    have hm' : 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le hNpos (by linarith)
    have h8 : 8 * (1 / ((N : ℝ) + 1)) < ε := by
      rw [mul_one_div, div_lt_iff₀ hNpos]
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hε] at hN
      nlinarith
    nlinarith

      obtain ⟨s, hsdef⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = Q φ φ + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hs : 0 < s := by rw [hsdef]; linarith
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, t = -g / s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hP' : P ((1 : ℝ) • u n + t • φ) := hPa _ _ (hPs _ _ (hPu n)) (hPs _ _ hφ)
      obtain ⟨q1, l1⟩ := quad (u n) φ (hPu n) hφ 1 t
      have h1 := hμ _ hP'
      rw [hJw, q1, l1] at h1
      have hJn := hJw (u n)
      have key : 0 ≤ (J (u n) - μ) + t * g + t ^ 2 / 2 * Q φ φ := by
        rw [hg, hJn]; nlinarith
      have hgt : g = -(t * s) := by
        rw [ht]; field_simp
      rw [hgt] at key
      have h2 : t ^ 2 * Q φ φ ≤ t ^ 2 * s :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by rw [hsdef]; linarith) (sq_nonneg t)
      have h3 : t ^ 2 * s ≤ 2 * (J (u n) - μ) := by nlinarith
      have h4 : s * (t ^ 2 * s) ≤ s * (2 * (J (u n) - μ)) :=

    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (2 * (Q φ φ + 1) / ε ^ 2)
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero]
