      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v ∧ HasCompactSupport v) →
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧ HasCompactSupport w) →
      clsQ h κ χ V (u + v) w = clsQ h κ χ V u w + clsQ h κ χ V v w) ∧
    (∀ (t : ℝ) (u w : M → ℝ), (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧ HasCompactSupport w) →
      clsQ h κ χ V (t • u) w = t * clsQ h κ χ V u w) ∧
    (∀ u v : M → ℝ, (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v ∧ HasCompactSupport v) →
      clsL h κ χ f (u + v) = clsL h κ χ f u + clsL h κ χ f v) ∧
    (∀ (t : ℝ) (u : M → ℝ), (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      clsL h κ χ f (t • u) = t * clsL h κ χ f u) ∧
    (∀ u : M → ℝ, (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      0 ≤ atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u))

signature.name: cls_form_algebra
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (V f : M → ℝ)
    (hV : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ V) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) :
    (∀ u w : M → ℝ, (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧ HasCompactSupport w) →
      clsQ h κ χ V u w = clsQ h κ χ V w u) ∧
    (∀ u v w : M → ℝ, (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v ∧ HasCompactSupport v) →
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧ HasCompactSupport w) →
      clsQ h κ χ V (u + v) w = clsQ h κ χ V u w + clsQ h κ χ V v w) ∧
    (∀ (t : ℝ) (u w : M → ℝ), (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w ∧ HasCompactSupport w) →
      clsQ h κ χ V (t • u) w = t * clsQ h κ χ V u w) ∧
    (∀ u v : M → ℝ, (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v ∧ HasCompactSupport v) →
      clsL h κ χ f (u + v) = clsL h κ χ f u + clsL h κ χ f v) ∧
    (∀ (t : ℝ) (u : M → ℝ), (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      clsL h κ χ f (t • u) = t * clsL h κ χ f u) ∧
    (∀ u : M → ℝ, (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      0 ≤ atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨h2ρ, hχs, hχ0, hsum1, hsupp, hcase⟩ := hA
  
  
  
  have hAsymm : ∀ (p : M) (i j : Fin 3),
      (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ i j =
        (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ j i := by
    intro p i j
    have hT : (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)).transpose =
        h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      ext a b
      rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
      exact h.symm _ _ _
    rw [← Matrix.transpose_apply (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ j i,
      Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hT]
  have hsym : ∀ (u w : M → ℝ) (p : M), h.gradInner u w p = h.gradInner w u p := by
    intro u w p
    unfold RiemannianMetric3.gradInner
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [hAsymm p i j]
    ring
  have hnonneg : ∀ (u : M → ℝ) (p : M), 0 ≤ h.gradInner u u p := by
    intro u p
    have hPSD : (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)).PosSemidef := by
      apply Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
      · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
        intro i j
        simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
        exact h.symm _ _ _
      · intro x
        have key : star x ⬝ᵥ (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)).mulVec x =
            h.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)
                (∑ i, x i • e i : E3))
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)
                (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
          simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
            ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
            RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
          ring
        rw [key]
        by_cases hD : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)
            (∑ i, x i • e i : E3) = 0
        · rw [hD]; simp
        · exact (h.posDef _ _ hD).le
    have h2 := hPSD.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
      (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p))
    unfold RiemannianMetric3.gradInner
    convert h2 using 1
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  
  
  have hdiff : ∀ (u : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ p : M,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    intro u hu p
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      hu.comp_contMDiffOn (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := p))
    have h2 := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    exact (h2.contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds
      (mem_chart_target E3 p))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hadd : ∀ (u v w : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v →
      ∀ p, h.gradInner (u + v) w p = h.gradInner u w p + h.gradInner v w p := by
    intro u v w hu hv p
    have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun y => (u + v) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) =
          partialDeriv i (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) +
          partialDeriv i (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) + v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 p p) (e i) = _
      rw [fderiv_fun_add (hdiff u hu p) (hdiff v hv p), ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
    unfold RiemannianMetric3.gradInner
    simp only [hpd]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring
  have hsmul : ∀ (t : ℝ) (u w : M → ℝ) (p : M),
      h.gradInner (t • u) w p = t * h.gradInner u w p := by
    intro t u w p
    have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun y => (t • u) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) =
          t * partialDeriv i (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv
      have : (fun y => (t • u) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =
          t • (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := rfl
      rw [this, fderiv_const_smul_of_field, Pi.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
    unfold RiemannianMetric3.gradInner
    simp only [hpd, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring
  have hloc : ∀ (u w : M → ℝ) (p : M), p ∉ tsupport u → h.gradInner u w p = 0 := by
    intro u w p hp
    have hev : u =ᶠ[𝓝 p] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hp
    have hcont : ContinuousAt (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 p)
    have htend : Tendsto (chartAt E3 p).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)) (𝓝 p) := by
      have := hcont.tendsto
      rwa [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)] at this
    have hev2 : (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := htend.eventually hev
    have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) = 0 := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev2.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    unfold RiemannianMetric3.gradInner
    simp [hpd]
  
  
  
  have Ihom : ∀ (t : ℝ) (F : M → ℝ),
      atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => t * F p) = t * atlasInt h κ χ F := by
    intro t F
    unfold atlasInt
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext y
    try beta_reduce
    ring
  have Ipos : ∀ F : M → ℝ, (∀ p, 0 ≤ F p) → 0 ≤ atlasInt h κ χ F := by
    intro F hF
    unfold atlasInt
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => ?_
    refine integral_nonneg fun y => ?_
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hχ0 i _) (hF _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have Iadd : ∀ F₁ F₂ : M → ℝ,
      (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * F₁ (κ i y) *
        Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source) →
      (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * F₂ (κ i y) *
        Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source) →
      atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => F₁ p + F₂ p) = atlasInt h κ χ F₁ + atlasInt h κ χ F₂ := by
    intro F₁ F₂ h1 h2
    unfold atlasInt
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [← integral_add (h1 i) (h2 i)]
    congr 1
    funext y
    try beta_reduce
    ring
  
  
  
  have hcc : ∀ φ : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ → ∀ i,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => φ (κ i y)) (κ i).source :=
    fun φ hφ i => hφ.continuous.comp_continuousOn (κ i).contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
  have Iint : ∀ (F : M → ℝ) (T : Set M), IsCompact T → (∀ p, p ∉ T → F p = 0) →
      (∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun y => F (κ i y)) (κ i).source) → ∀ i,
      IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * F (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det)
        (κ i).source := by
    intro F T hT hFT hFc i
    have hSo : IsOpen (κ i).source := (κ i).open_source
    have hcont : ContinuousOn
        (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * F (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source :=
      ((hcc (χ i) (hχs i) i).mul (hFc i)).mul
        (nds_chart_cont h (κ i) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
          contMDiff_const contMDiff_const).2.2.2.1
    suffices hZ : ∃ Z : Set E3, IsCompact Z ∧ Z ⊆ (κ i).source ∧
        ∀ y ∈ (κ i).source \ Z,
          χ i (κ i y) * F (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det = 0 by
      obtain ⟨Z, hZc, hZs, hZ0⟩ := hZ
      exact ((hcont.mono hZs).integrableOn_compact hZc).of_forall_diff_eq_zero
        hSo.measurableSet hZ0
    rcases hcase i with hc | ⟨j, hκj, -, hχin⟩
    · refine ⟨(κ i).invFun '' tsupport (χ i),
        hc.image_of_continuousOn ((κ i).contMDiffOn_invFun.continuousOn.mono (hsupp i)), ?_, ?_⟩
      · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        exact (κ i).map_target' (hsupp i hx)
      · rintro y ⟨hy, hyZ⟩
        have h0 : χ i (κ i y) = 0 := by
          by_contra hne
          apply hyZ
          exact ⟨κ i y, subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hne), (κ i).left_inv' hy⟩
        rw [h0]; ring
    · have hsrc : (κ i).source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := by
        rw [hκj]; exact (hAF.ends j).source_eq
      have hesc := end_chart_escape g hAF j
      choose ρ N hN hρ using hesc
      obtain ⟨t, -, hcover⟩ := hT.elim_nhds_subcover N (fun p _ => hN p)
      have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ p ∈ t, |ρ p| := Finset.sum_nonneg fun p _ => abs_nonneg _
      refine ⟨Metric.closedBall 0 (ρA + ∑ p ∈ t, |ρ p|) ∩ {y : E3 | ρA ≤ ‖y‖},
        (isCompact_closedBall 0 _).inter_right (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm),
        ?_, ?_⟩
      · rintro y ⟨-, hy⟩
        rw [hsrc]
        show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
        have hy' : ρA ≤ ‖y‖ := hy
        linarith
      · rintro y ⟨hyS, hyZ⟩
        have hy1 : 1 < ‖y‖ := by
          rw [hsrc] at hyS; exact hyS
        by_cases hyρ : ‖y‖ ≤ ρA
        · have h0 : χ i (κ i y) = 0 := by
            rw [hκj]; exact hχin y hy1 hyρ
          rw [h0]; ring
        · have hRy : ρA + ∑ p ∈ t, |ρ p| < ‖y‖ := by
            by_contra hle
            push_neg at hle
            apply hyZ
            refine Set.mem_inter ?_ ?_
            · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]; exact hle
            · show ρA ≤ ‖y‖
              exact le_of_lt (not_le.1 hyρ)
          have hFz : F (κ i y) = 0 := by
            apply hFT
            intro hyT
            obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcover hyT)
            have h1 : ρ q ≤ ∑ p ∈ t, |ρ p| :=
              (le_abs_self _).trans
                (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun p => |ρ p|) (fun p _ => abs_nonneg _) hq)
            rw [hκj] at hxq
            exact hρ q y (by linarith) hxq
          rw [hFz]; ring
  
  
  
  have IG : ∀ u w : M → ℝ, (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w → ∀ i,
      IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * h.gradInner u w (κ i y) *
        Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source :=
    fun u w hu hw => Iint (h.gradInner u w) (tsupport u) hu.2.isCompact
      (fun p hp => hloc u w p hp) (fun i => (nds_chart_cont h (κ i) u w hu.1 hw).2.2.1)
  have IV : ∀ u w : M → ℝ, (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) →
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w → ∀ i,
      IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * (fun p => V p * u p * w p) (κ i y) *
        Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source :=
    fun u w hu hw => Iint (fun p => V p * u p * w p) (tsupport u) hu.2.isCompact
      (fun p hp => by simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hp])
      (fun i => ((hcc V hV i).mul (hcc u hu.1 i)).mul (hcc w hw i))
  have IF : ∀ u : M → ℝ, (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u ∧ HasCompactSupport u) → ∀ i,
      IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * (fun p => f p * u p) (κ i y) *
        Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source :=
    fun u hu => Iint (fun p => f p * u p) (tsupport u) hu.2.isCompact
      (fun p hp => by simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hp])
      (fun i => (hcc f hf i).mul (hcc u hu.1 i))
  
  
  
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u w _ _
    unfold clsQ
    have e1 : h.gradInner u w = h.gradInner w u := funext (hsym u w)
    have e2 : (fun p => V p * u p * w p) = (fun p => V p * w p * u p) := by
      funext p; ring
    rw [e1, e2]
  · intro u v w hu hv hw
    unfold clsQ
    have e1 : h.gradInner (u + v) w = fun p => h.gradInner u w p + h.gradInner v w p :=
      funext (hadd u v w hu.1 hv.1)
    have e2 : (fun p => V p * (u + v) p * w p) =
        fun p => V p * u p * w p + V p * v p * w p := by
      funext p; simp only [Pi.add_apply]; ring
    have a1 := Iadd (h.gradInner u w) (h.gradInner v w) (IG u w hu hw.1) (IG v w hv hw.1)
    have a2 := Iadd (fun p => V p * u p * w p) (fun p => V p * v p * w p)
      (IV u w hu hw.1) (IV v w hv hw.1)
    rw [e1, e2]
    linarith [a1, a2]
  · intro t u w _ _
    unfold clsQ
    have e1 : h.gradInner (t • u) w = fun p => t * h.gradInner u w p := funext (hsmul t u w)
    have e2 : (fun p => V p * (t • u) p * w p) = fun p => t * (V p * u p * w p) := by
      funext p; simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [e1, e2, Ihom, Ihom]
    ring
  · intro u v hu hv
    unfold clsL
    have e : (fun p => f p * (u + v) p) = fun p => f p * u p + f p * v p := by
      funext p; simp only [Pi.add_apply]; ring
    have a := Iadd (fun p => f p * u p) (fun p => f p * v p) (IF u hu) (IF v hv)
    rw [e]
    linarith [a]
  · intro t u _
    unfold clsL
    have e : (fun p => f p * (t • u) p) = fun p => t * (f p * u p) := by
      funext p; simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [e, Ihom]
  · intro u _
    exact Ipos _ (hnonneg u)

subgoal_signatures.name: end_chart_escape
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∀ p : M, ∃ ρ : ℝ, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∉ N

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_chart_cont
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv a (fun x => u (κ x))) κ.source) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u w (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.coeff κ x).det) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ a b) κ.source)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (S : Set M) (hS : IsCompact S) (CS : ℝ) (hCS : 0 ≤ CS)
    (hP : ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → HasCompactSupport u →
      atlasInt g κ χ (S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2)) ≤ CS * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u)) :
    ∃ ε₀ cS : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 ≤ cS ∧ ∀ h : RiemannianMetric3 M,
      (∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ h.g p ξ ξ ∧ h.g p ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ) →
      ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → HasCompactSupport u →
        (∀ V : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ V → (∀ p, p ∉ S → V p = 0) →
          (∀ p, |V p| ≤ ε₀) →
          |atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => V p * u p * u p)| ≤
            (1 / 2) * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) ∧
        (∀ (F : M → ℝ) (B : ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ F → (∀ p, p ∉ S → F p = 0) →
          (∀ p, |F p| ≤ B) →
          |atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => F p * u p)| ≤
            cS * B * Real.sqrt (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u))) ∧
        atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)

signature.name: cls_coercive
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (S : Set M) (hS : IsCompact S) (CS : ℝ) (hCS : 0 ≤ CS)
    (hP : ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → HasCompactSupport u →
      atlasInt g κ χ (S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2)) ≤ CS * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u)) :
    ∃ ε₀ cS : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 ≤ cS ∧ ∀ h : RiemannianMetric3 M,
      (∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ h.g p ξ ξ ∧ h.g p ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ) →
      ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → HasCompactSupport u →
        (∀ V : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ V → (∀ p, p ∉ S → V p = 0) →
          (∀ p, |V p| ≤ ε₀) →
          |atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => V p * u p * u p)| ≤
            (1 / 2) * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) ∧
        (∀ (F : M → ℝ) (B : ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ F → (∀ p, p ∉ S → F p = 0) →
          (∀ p, |F p| ≤ B) →
          |atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => F p * u p)| ≤
            cS * B * Real.sqrt (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u))) ∧
        atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt 2 * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, hχs, hχ0, _, hχt, _⟩ := hA
  
  
  
  have hcomp : ∀ (h₁ h₂ : RiemannianMetric3 M) (c : ℝ) (F G : M → ℝ),
      (∀ i, ∀ y ∈ (κ i).source,
        Real.sqrt (h₁.coeff (κ i) y).det ≤ c * Real.sqrt (h₂.coeff (κ i) y).det) →
      (∀ p, |F p| ≤ G p) →
      (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h₂.coeff (κ i) y).det)
        (κ i).source) →
      |atlasInt h₁ κ χ F| ≤ c * atlasInt h₂ κ χ G := by
    intro h₁ h₂ c F G hdet hFG hint
    simp only [atlasInt]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_)
    refine (abs_integral_le_integral_abs).trans ?_
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    refine integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => abs_nonneg _)
      (Integrable.const_mul (hint i) c) ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' (κ i).open_source.measurableSet).2
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y hy => ?_)
    have h1 := hdet i y hy
    have hG : 0 ≤ G (κ i y) := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hFG _)
    have hχ := hχ0 i (κ i y)
    have hd1 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (h₁.coeff (κ i) y).det := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    dsimp only
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hχ, abs_of_nonneg hd1]
    calc χ i (κ i y) * |F (κ i y)| * Real.sqrt (h₁.coeff (κ i) y).det
        ≤ χ i (κ i y) * G (κ i y) * (c * Real.sqrt (h₂.coeff (κ i) y).det) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hFG _) hχ) h1 hd1 (mul_nonneg hχ hG)
      _ = c * (χ i (κ i y) * G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h₂.coeff (κ i) y).det) := by ring
  have hlinEq : ∀ (h₁ : RiemannianMetric3 M) (a b : ℝ) (G₁ G₂ : M → ℝ),
      (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * G₁ (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h₁.coeff (κ i) y).det)
        (κ i).source) →
      (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * G₂ (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h₁.coeff (κ i) y).det)
        (κ i).source) →
      (∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * (a * G₁ (κ i y) + b * G₂ (κ i y)) *
        Real.sqrt (h₁.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source) ∧
      atlasInt h₁ κ χ (fun p => a * G₁ p + b * G₂ p) =
        a * atlasInt h₁ κ χ G₁ + b * atlasInt h₁ κ χ G₂ := by
    intro h₁ a b G₁ G₂ h1 h2
    have heq : ∀ i, (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * (a * G₁ (κ i y) + b * G₂ (κ i y)) *
        Real.sqrt (h₁.coeff (κ i) y).det) = fun y =>
        a * (χ i (κ i y) * G₁ (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h₁.coeff (κ i) y).det) +
        b * (χ i (κ i y) * G₂ (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h₁.coeff (κ i) y).det) := by
      intro i; funext y; ring
    refine ⟨fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [heq i]
      exact (Integrable.const_mul (h1 i) a).add (Integrable.const_mul (h2 i) b)
    · simp only [atlasInt]
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_const_mul,
        ← integral_add (Integrable.const_mul (h1 i) a) (Integrable.const_mul (h2 i) b)]
      congr 1
      funext y
      ring
  have hscal : ∀ (h₁ : RiemannianMetric3 M) (c : ℝ) (G : M → ℝ),
      atlasInt h₁ κ χ (fun p => c * G p) = c * atlasInt h₁ κ χ G := by
    intro h₁ c G
    simp only [atlasInt]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext y
    ring
  have hnn : ∀ (h₁ : RiemannianMetric3 M) (G : M → ℝ), (∀ p, 0 ≤ G p) →
      0 ≤ atlasInt h₁ κ χ G := by
    intro h₁ G hG
    simp only [atlasInt]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
      setIntegral_nonneg (κ i).open_source.measurableSet fun y _ => ?_
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hχ0 _ _) (hG _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hempty : IsEmpty M → ∀ (h₁ : RiemannianMetric3 M) (G : M → ℝ),
      atlasInt h₁ κ χ G = 0 := by
    intro hM h₁ G
    simp only [atlasInt]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
    have hsrc : (κ i).source = ∅ :=
      Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2 fun y _ => hM.elim (κ i y)
    rw [hsrc, Measure.restrict_empty, integral_zero_measure]
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = atlasInt g κ χ (S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by
    rw [ha_def]
    exact hnn g _ (Set.indicator_nonneg fun _ _ => zero_le_one)
  have hCS1 : 0 < CS + 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀def⟩ : ∃ ε₀ : ℝ, ε₀ = 1 / (32 * (CS + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hε₀ : 0 < ε₀ := by rw [hε₀def]; exact div_pos one_pos (by linarith)
  have hK1 : 16 * ε₀ * CS ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    have hx : ε₀ * (32 * (CS + 1)) = 1 := by
      rw [hε₀def]; exact one_div_mul_cancel (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hs2 : Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2 = 2 := Real.mul_self_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have h22 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 2 := by positivity
  refine ⟨ε₀, Real.sqrt 2 * a + 8 * CS, hε₀,
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ha) (by linarith), ?_⟩
  
  
  
  intro h hgh u hu hus
  obtain ⟨Pdet, Pgrad⟩ := cls_metric_pointwise g h hgh
  have hgf := cceb_gradInner_self_facts g u hu
  have hhf := cceb_gradInner_self_facts h u hu
  have hSc : IsClosed S := hS.isClosed
  
  have hI1 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * (2 * h.gradInner u u (κ i y)) *
      Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source := by
    intro i
    have := cls_chart_integrable h (κ i) (χ i) (hχs i) (hχt i) Set.univ isClosed_univ
      (fun p => 2 * h.gradInner u u p)
      (continuousOn_const.mul (nds_chart_cont h (κ i) u u hu hu).2.2.1)
      (tsupport u) hus.isCompact (fun p hp => by
        rw [Set.indicator_univ]
        show 2 * h.gradInner u u p = 0
        rw [hhf.2 p hp, mul_zero])
    rw [Set.indicator_univ] at this
    exact this
  have hI2 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2) (κ i y) *
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source := fun i =>
    cls_chart_integrable g (κ i) (χ i) (hχs i) (hχt i) S hSc (fun p => u p ^ 2)
      ((hu.continuous.comp_continuousOn (κ i).contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn).pow 2) S hS
      (fun p hp => Set.indicator_of_notMem hp _)
  have hI3 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (κ i y) *
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source := fun i =>
    cls_chart_integrable g (κ i) (χ i) (hχs i) (hχt i) S hSc (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
      continuousOn_const S hS (fun p hp => Set.indicator_of_notMem hp _)
  have hDh : 0 ≤ atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u) := hnn h _ hhf.1
  
  
  
  have hiii : atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) ≤
      4 * Real.sqrt 2 * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u) := by
    have h1 := hcomp g h (2 * Real.sqrt 2) (g.gradInner u u) (fun p => 2 * h.gradInner u u p)
      (fun i y hy => (Pdet (κ i) y hy).2)
      (fun p => by rw [abs_of_nonneg (hgf.1 p)]; exact Pgrad u p) hI1
    rw [hscal h 2 (h.gradInner u u)] at h1
    have h2 := le_abs_self (atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u))
    linarith
  have h4 : atlasInt g κ χ (S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2)) ≤
      CS * (4 * Real.sqrt 2 * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) :=
    (hP u hu hus).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hiii hCS)
  refine ⟨fun V _ hVS hVb => ?_, fun F B _ hFS hFB => ?_, hiii⟩
  
  
  
  · have hpt : ∀ p, |V p * u p * u p| ≤ ε₀ * S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2) p := by
      intro p
      by_cases hp : p ∈ S
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hp]
        rw [show V p * u p * u p = V p * u p ^ 2 by ring, abs_mul,
          abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (u p))]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hVb p) (sq_nonneg _)
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hp, hVS p hp, zero_mul, abs_zero, mul_zero, le_refl]
    have hI4 : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) *
        (ε₀ * S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2) (κ i y)) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det)
        (κ i).source := by
      intro i
      have e : (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * (ε₀ * S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2) (κ i y)) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det) = fun y => ε₀ * (χ i (κ i y) *
          S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2) (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det) := by
        funext y; ring
      rw [e]
      exact Integrable.const_mul (hI2 i) ε₀
    have h1 := hcomp h g (2 * Real.sqrt 2) (fun p => V p * u p * u p)
      (fun p => ε₀ * S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2) p)
      (fun i y hy => (Pdet (κ i) y hy).1) hpt hI4
    rw [hscal g ε₀ (S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2))] at h1
    calc |atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => V p * u p * u p)|
        ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * (ε₀ * atlasInt g κ χ (S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2))) := h1
      _ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * (ε₀ * (CS * (4 * Real.sqrt 2 * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hε₀.le) h22
      _ = 16 * ε₀ * CS * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u) := by
          linear_combination (8 * ε₀ * CS * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) * hs2
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK1 hDh
  
  
  
  · by_cases hM : IsEmpty M
    · rw [hempty hM h (fun p => F p * u p), hempty hM h (h.gradInner u u)]
      simp
    rw [not_isEmpty_iff] at hM
    obtain ⟨p₀⟩ := hM
    have hB : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hFB p₀)
    have hstar : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → |atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => F p * u p)| ≤
        Real.sqrt 2 * a * B * t + 8 * B * CS * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u) / t := by
      intro t ht
      have h2t : 0 < 2 * t := by linarith
      have hpt : ∀ p, |F p * u p| ≤ B * t / 2 * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) p +
          B / (2 * t) * S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2) p := by
        intro p
        by_cases hp : p ∈ S
        · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hp, mul_one]
          rw [abs_mul]
          have hu2 : |u p| ≤ t / 2 + u p ^ 2 / (2 * t) := by
            have e : t / 2 + u p ^ 2 / (2 * t) = (t ^ 2 + u p ^ 2) / (2 * t) := by
              first
              | (field_simp; ring)
              | field_simp
            rw [e, le_div_iff₀ h2t]
            nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|u p| - t), sq_abs (u p)]
          calc |F p| * |u p| ≤ B * |u p| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hFB p) (abs_nonneg _)
            _ ≤ B * (t / 2 + u p ^ 2 / (2 * t)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu2 hB
            _ = B * t / 2 + B / (2 * t) * u p ^ 2 := by ring
        · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hp, hFS p hp, zero_mul, abs_zero, mul_zero,
            add_zero, le_refl]
      have hL := hlinEq g (B * t / 2) (B / (2 * t)) (S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)))
        (S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2)) hI3 hI2
      have h1 := hcomp h g (2 * Real.sqrt 2) (fun p => F p * u p)
        (fun p => B * t / 2 * S.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) p +
          B / (2 * t) * S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2) p)
        (fun i y hy => (Pdet (κ i) y hy).1) hpt hL.1
      rw [hL.2, ← ha_def] at h1
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ B / (2 * t) := div_nonneg hB h2t.le
      calc |atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => F p * u p)|
          ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * (B * t / 2 * a +
              B / (2 * t) * atlasInt g κ χ (S.indicator (fun p => u p ^ 2))) := h1
        _ ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * (B * t / 2 * a +
              B / (2 * t) * (CS * (4 * Real.sqrt 2 * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hb0)) h22
        _ = Real.sqrt 2 * a * B * t + 8 * B * CS * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u) / t := by
            linear_combination (4 * B * CS * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u) / t) * hs2
    by_cases hY : 0 < atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)
    · have hYs : 0 < Real.sqrt (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hY
      have hsq : Real.sqrt (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) *
          Real.sqrt (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) = atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u) :=
        Real.mul_self_sqrt hDh
      have h1 := hstar _ hYs
      have e : 8 * B * CS * atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u) /
          Real.sqrt (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) =
          8 * B * CS * Real.sqrt (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) := by
        rw [div_eq_iff hYs.ne']
        linear_combination (-(8 * B * CS)) * hsq
      rw [e] at h1
      calc |atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => F p * u p)|
          ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * a * B * Real.sqrt (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) +
            8 * B * CS * Real.sqrt (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) := h1
        _ = (Real.sqrt 2 * a + 8 * CS) * B * Real.sqrt (atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u)) := by
            ring
    · have hD0 : atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner u u) = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.1 hY) hDh
      rw [hD0, Real.sqrt_zero, mul_zero]
      by_contra hX
      push_neg at hX
      have hk : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * a * B := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ha) hB
      have hne : 2 * (Real.sqrt 2 * a * B + 1) ≠ 0 := by linarith
      have htpos : 0 < |atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => F p * u p)| / (2 * (Real.sqrt 2 * a * B + 1)) :=
        div_pos hX (by linarith)
      have h1 := hstar _ htpos
      rw [hD0, mul_zero, zero_div, add_zero] at h1
      have ht2 := div_mul_cancel₀ (|atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => F p * u p)|) hne
      have hkt := mul_nonneg hk htpos.le
      nlinarith

subgoal_signatures.name: cceb_gradInner_self_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (w : M → ℝ) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    (∀ p : M, 0 ≤ g.gradInner w w p) ∧
      (∀ p : M, p ∉ tsupport w → g.gradInner w w p = 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_chart_cont
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv a (fun x => u (κ x))) κ.source) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u w (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.coeff κ x).det) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ a b) κ.source)

subgoal_signatures.name: cls_metric_pointwise
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g h : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hgh : ∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), (1 / 2 : ℝ) * g.g p ξ ξ ≤ h.g p ξ ξ ∧ h.g p ξ ξ ≤ 2 * g.g p ξ ξ) :
    (∀ (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3), y ∈ φ.source →
      Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det ∧
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt (h.coeff φ y).det) ∧

    (hV : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ V) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (ζ : E3 → ℝ)
    (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ) (hζs : tsupport ζ ⊆ ψ.source) :
    ∃ φM : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φM ∧ HasCompactSupport φM ∧
      ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → HasCompactSupport u →
        clsQ h κ χ V u φM - clsL h κ χ f φM =
          ∫ y, (8 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b *
                partialDeriv b (fun z => u (ψ z)) y * partialDeriv a ζ y
              + (V (ψ y) * u (ψ y) - f (ψ y)) * ζ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hKc : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc
  have hψc : ContinuousOn ψ ψ.source := ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
  have hK'cpt : IsCompact (ψ '' tsupport ζ) := hKc.image_of_continuousOn (hψc.mono hζs)
  have hK'cl : IsClosed (ψ '' tsupport ζ) := hK'cpt.isClosed
  have hK'tgt : ψ '' tsupport ζ ⊆ ψ.target := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ψ.toPartialEquiv.map_source (hζs hy)
  
  obtain ⟨φM, hφMdef⟩ : ∃ φM : M → ℝ,
      φM = ψ.target.indicator (fun p => ζ (ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm p)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hφ0 : ∀ p, p ∉ ψ '' tsupport ζ → φM p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    by_cases hpt : p ∈ ψ.target
    · rw [hφMdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hpt]
      apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      intro hs
      exact hp ⟨_, hs, ψ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hpt⟩
    · rw [hφMdef, Set.indicator_of_notMem hpt]
  have hφψ : ∀ y ∈ ψ.source, φM (ψ y) = ζ y := by
    intro y hy
    have hmem : ψ y ∈ ψ.target := ψ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hy
    rw [hφMdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
    exact congrArg ζ (ψ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hy)
  have hφsm : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φM := by
    intro p
    by_cases hpt : p ∈ ψ.target
    · have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun q => ζ (ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm q))
          ψ.target :=
        hζ.contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn ψ.contMDiffOn_invFun
      have h2 := h1.contMDiffAt (ψ.open_target.mem_nhds hpt)
      refine h2.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [ψ.open_target.mem_nhds hpt] with q hq
      rw [hφMdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hq]
    · have hpK : p ∉ ψ '' tsupport ζ := fun h' => hpt (hK'tgt h')
      refine (contMDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hK'cl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hpK] with q hq
      exact hφ0 q hq
  
  have hgv : ∀ (w u : M → ℝ), (∀ p, p ∉ ψ '' tsupport ζ → w p = 0) →
      ∀ p, p ∉ ψ '' tsupport ζ → h.gradInner u w p = 0 := by
    intro w u hw p hp
    have hc : ContinuousAt (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 p)
    have hsymm : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p :=
      (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
    have hnhds : (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (ψ '' tsupport ζ)ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      apply hc.preimage_mem_nhds
      rw [hsymm]
      exact hK'cl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hp
    have hev : (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hnhds] with y hy
      exact hw _ hy
    have hpd : ∀ j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv j (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) = 0 := by
      intro j
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    simp [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, hpd]
  
  have hsymInv : ∀ (P : E3 → M) (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3),
      (h.coeff P y)⁻¹ a b = (h.coeff P y)⁻¹ b a := by
    intro P y a b
    have hGT : Matrix.transpose (h.coeff P y) = h.coeff P y := by
      ext i j; rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]; exact h.symm _ _ _
    have hinvT : Matrix.transpose ((h.coeff P y)⁻¹) = (h.coeff P y)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hGT]
    rw [← Matrix.transpose_apply ((h.coeff P y)⁻¹) a b, hinvT]
  
  have hgt : ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ y ∈ ψ.source,
      h.gradInner u φM (ψ y) = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b *
        partialDeriv b (fun z => u (ψ z)) y * partialDeriv a ζ y := by
    intro u hu y hy
    rw [gradInner_pdiffeo_formula h ψ u φM hu hφsm y hy]
    have hev : (fun z => φM (ψ z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] ζ := by
      filter_upwards [ψ.open_source.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact hφψ z hz
    have hpd : ∀ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv j (fun z => φM (ψ z)) y = partialDeriv j ζ y := by
      intro j
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp only [hpd]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    rw [hsymInv ψ y b a]
  
  have htransfer : ∀ (κ0 : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (G : M → ℝ),
      (∀ p, p ∉ κ0.target ∩ ψ.target → G p = 0) →
      ∫ z in κ0.source, G (κ0 z) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 z).det =
        ∫ y in ψ.source, G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
    intro κ0 G hG
    obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set E3, Ω = ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' κ0.target := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hmΩ : ∀ y, y ∈ Ω ↔ y ∈ ψ.source ∧ ψ y ∈ κ0.target := by
      intro y; rw [hΩ]; rfl
    have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by
      rw [hΩ]; exact hψc.isOpen_inter_preimage ψ.open_source κ0.open_target
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ : ∃ τ : E3 → E3, τ = fun y => κ0.toPartialEquiv.symm (ψ y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hτa : ∀ y, τ y = κ0.toPartialEquiv.symm (ψ y) := by intro y; rw [hτ]
    have hτinv : ∀ y ∈ Ω, κ0 (τ y) = ψ y := by
      intro y hy; rw [hτa]; exact κ0.toPartialEquiv.right_inv ((hmΩ y).1 hy).2
    have hτsrc : ∀ y ∈ Ω, τ y ∈ κ0.source := by
      intro y hy; rw [hτa]; exact κ0.toPartialEquiv.map_target ((hmΩ y).1 hy).2
    have hτsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ Ω := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun y => κ0.toPartialEquiv.symm (ψ y)) Ω :=
        κ0.contMDiffOn_invFun.comp (ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.mono (fun y hy => ((hmΩ y).1 hy).1))
          (fun y hy => ((hmΩ y).1 hy).2)
      rw [hτ]; exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    have hτd : ∀ y ∈ Ω, DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y := fun y hy =>
      ((hτsm.differentiableOn (by simp)) y hy).differentiableAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hy)
    have hτinj : Set.InjOn τ Ω := by
      intro y₁ h₁ y₂ h₂ heq
      have h3 : κ0 (τ y₁) = κ0 (τ y₂) := by rw [heq]
      rw [hτinv y₁ h₁, hτinv y₂ h₂] at h3
      exact ψ.toPartialEquiv.injOn ((hmΩ y₁).1 h₁).1 ((hmΩ y₂).1 h₂).1 h3
    
    have hcov := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hΩo.measurableSet
      (fun y hy => (hτd y hy).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hτinj
      (fun z => G (κ0 z) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 z).det)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hcov
    
    have himg : τ '' Ω ⊆ κ0.source := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact hτsrc y hy
    have hcc : ∫ z in κ0.source, G (κ0 z) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 z).det =
        ∫ z in τ '' Ω, G (κ0 z) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 z).det := by
      refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero κ0.open_source.measurableSet
        himg ?_
      intro z hz
      have hG0 : G (κ0 z) = 0 := by
        apply hG
        rintro ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
        apply hz.2
        have hr : ψ (ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm (κ0 z)) = κ0 z := ψ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hz2
        refine ⟨ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm (κ0 z),
          (hmΩ _).2 ⟨ψ.toPartialEquiv.map_target hz2, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · rw [hr]; exact hz1
        · rw [hτa, hr]; exact κ0.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hz.1
      rw [hG0, zero_mul]
    
    have hdd : ∫ y in ψ.source, G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det =
        ∫ y in Ω, G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
      refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero ψ.open_source.measurableSet
        (fun y hy => ((hmΩ y).1 hy).1) ?_
      intro y hy
      have hG0 : G (ψ y) = 0 := by
        apply hG
        rintro ⟨h1, -⟩
        exact hy.2 ((hmΩ y).2 ⟨hy.1, h1⟩)
      rw [hG0, zero_mul]
    
    have hvol : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det =
        |(fderiv ℝ τ y).det| * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 (τ y)).det := by
      intro y hy
      have hev : (⇑κ0 ∘ τ) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] ⇑ψ := by
        filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        exact hτinv z hz
      have hcoeq : h.coeff ψ y = h.coeff (⇑κ0 ∘ τ) y := by
        have hmf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (⇑κ0 ∘ τ) y = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y :=
          hev.mfderiv_eq
        have hpt : (⇑κ0 ∘ τ) y = ψ y := hτinv y hy
        ext i j
        simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        rw [hmf, hpt]
      have hκmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ0 (τ y) :=
        ((κ0.contMDiffOn_toFun (τ y) (hτsrc y hy)).contMDiffAt
          (κ0.open_source.mem_nhds (hτsrc y hy))).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
      obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
          J = Matrix.of fun a i => fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hmat : h.coeff ψ y = J.transpose * h.coeff κ0 (τ y) * J := by
        rw [hcoeq]
        ext i j
        rw [coeff_comp_apply h κ0 τ y (hτd y hy) hκmd i j, hJ]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      have hdetJ : (fderiv ℝ τ y).det = J.det := by
        rw [hJ]
        show LinearMap.det ((fderiv ℝ τ y : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) = _
        rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis]
        congr 1
      have hdet : (h.coeff ψ y).det = J.det ^ 2 * (h.coeff κ0 (τ y)).det := by
        rw [hmat, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]; ring
      rw [hdet, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, hdetJ]
    
    have hff : ∫ y in Ω, |(fderiv ℝ τ y).det| *
          (G (κ0 (τ y)) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 (τ y)).det) =
        ∫ y in Ω, G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hΩo.measurableSet fun y hy => ?_
      simp only
      rw [hτinv y hy, hvol y hy]; ring
    
    rw [hcc, hcov, hff, hdd]
  
  have hsq : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source :=
    (nds_chart_cont h ψ 0 0 contMDiff_const contMDiff_const).2.2.2.1
  have hvanish_src : ∀ (F : M → ℝ), (∀ p, p ∉ ψ '' tsupport ζ → F p = 0) →
      ∀ y ∈ ψ.source, y ∉ tsupport ζ → F (ψ y) = 0 := by
    intro F hF y hy hyK
    apply hF
    rintro ⟨y', hy', hyy⟩
    have h1 := ψ.toPartialEquiv.injOn (hζs hy') hy hyy
    exact hyK (h1 ▸ hy')
  have hint : ∀ (c F : M → ℝ), Continuous c → (∀ p, p ∉ ψ '' tsupport ζ → F p = 0) →
      ContinuousOn (fun y => F (ψ y)) ψ.source →
      IntegrableOn (fun y => c (ψ y) * F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source := by
    intro c F hc hF hFc
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => c (ψ y) * F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det)
        ψ.source :=
      ((hc.comp_continuousOn hψc).mul hFc).mul hsq
    refine ((h1.mono hζs).integrableOn_compact hKc).of_forall_diff_eq_zero
      ψ.open_source.measurableSet ?_
    intro y hy
    rw [hvanish_src F hF y hy.1 hy.2]; ring
  have hloc : ∀ F : M → ℝ, (∀ p, p ∉ ψ '' tsupport ζ → F p = 0) →
      ContinuousOn (fun y => F (ψ y)) ψ.source →
      atlasInt h κ χ F = ∫ y in ψ.source, F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
    intro F hF hFc
    unfold atlasInt
    have hi : ∀ i, ∫ y in (κ i).source, χ i (κ i y) * F (κ i y) *
          Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det =
        ∫ y in ψ.source, χ i (ψ y) * F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
      intro i
      have := htransfer (κ i) (fun p => χ i p * F p) (by
        intro p hp
        by_cases h1 : p ∈ (κ i).target
        · have h2 : p ∉ ψ.target := fun h2 => hp ⟨h1, h2⟩
          have h3 : p ∉ ψ '' tsupport ζ := fun h3 => h2 (hK'tgt h3)
          simp only [hF p h3, mul_zero]
        · have h2 : p ∉ tsupport (χ i) := fun h2 => h1 (hA.2.2.2.2.1 i h2)
          simp only [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport h2, zero_mul])
      exact this
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hi i)]
    rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hint (χ i) F (hA.2.1 i).continuous hF hFc)]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun ψ.open_source.measurableSet fun y hy => ?_
    show ∑ i, χ i (ψ y) * F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det =
      F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, hA.2.2.2.1 (ψ y), one_mul]
  
  refine ⟨φM, hφsm, HasCompactSupport.intro hK'cpt hφ0, ?_⟩
  intro u hu _huc
  have hψcU : ContinuousOn (fun y => u (ψ y)) ψ.source := hu.continuous.comp_continuousOn hψc
  have hψcV : ContinuousOn (fun y => V (ψ y)) ψ.source := hV.continuous.comp_continuousOn hψc
  have hψcf : ContinuousOn (fun y => f (ψ y)) ψ.source := hf.continuous.comp_continuousOn hψc
  have hψcφ : ContinuousOn (fun y => φM (ψ y)) ψ.source :=
    hφsm.continuous.comp_continuousOn hψc
  have hA0 : ∀ p, p ∉ ψ '' tsupport ζ → h.gradInner u φM p = 0 := hgv φM u hφ0
  have hAc : ContinuousOn (fun y => h.gradInner u φM (ψ y)) ψ.source :=
    (nds_chart_cont h ψ u φM hu hφsm).2.2.1
  have hB0 : ∀ p, p ∉ ψ '' tsupport ζ → V p * u p * φM p = 0 := by
    intro p hp; rw [hφ0 p hp, mul_zero]
  have hBc : ContinuousOn (fun y => V (ψ y) * u (ψ y) * φM (ψ y)) ψ.source :=
    (hψcV.mul hψcU).mul hψcφ
  have hC0 : ∀ p, p ∉ ψ '' tsupport ζ → f p * φM p = 0 := by
    intro p hp; rw [hφ0 p hp, mul_zero]
  have hCc : ContinuousOn (fun y => f (ψ y) * φM (ψ y)) ψ.source := hψcf.mul hψcφ
  have hIA : IntegrableOn
      (fun y => h.gradInner u φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source := by
    have := hint (fun _ => 1) (h.gradInner u φM) continuous_const hA0 hAc
    simpa only [one_mul] using this
  have hIB : IntegrableOn
      (fun y => V (ψ y) * u (ψ y) * φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source := by
    have := hint (fun _ => 1) (fun p => V p * u p * φM p) continuous_const hB0 hBc
    simpa only [one_mul] using this
  have hIC : IntegrableOn
      (fun y => f (ψ y) * φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source := by
    have := hint (fun _ => 1) (fun p => f p * φM p) continuous_const hC0 hCc
    simpa only [one_mul] using this
  have eA := hloc (h.gradInner u φM) hA0 hAc
  have eB := hloc (fun p => V p * u p * φM p) hB0 hBc
  have eC := hloc (fun p => f p * φM p) hC0 hCc
  unfold clsQ clsL
  rw [eA, eB, eC]
  have hcomb :
      8 * (∫ y in ψ.source, h.gradInner u φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) +
        (∫ y in ψ.source, V (ψ y) * u (ψ y) * φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) -
        (∫ y in ψ.source, f (ψ y) * φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) =
      ∫ y in ψ.source, (8 * (h.gradInner u φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) +
        V (ψ y) * u (ψ y) * φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det -
        f (ψ y) * φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) := by
    have h8 : Integrable
        (fun y => 8 * (h.gradInner u φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det))
        (volume.restrict ψ.source) := Integrable.const_mul hIA 8
    have h8B : Integrable
        (fun y => 8 * (h.gradInner u φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) +
          V (ψ y) * u (ψ y) * φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det)
        (volume.restrict ψ.source) := by
      exact Integrable.add h8 hIB
    rw [integral_sub h8B hIC, integral_add h8 hIB, integral_const_mul]
  rw [hcomb]
  rw [← setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (μ := volume) (s := ψ.source)]
  · refine setIntegral_congr_fun ψ.open_source.measurableSet fun y hy => ?_
    show 8 * (h.gradInner u φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) +
        V (ψ y) * u (ψ y) * φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det -
        f (ψ y) * φM (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det =
      (8 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b *
            partialDeriv b (fun z => u (ψ z)) y * partialDeriv a ζ y
          + (V (ψ y) * u (ψ y) - f (ψ y)) * ζ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det
    rw [hgt u hu y hy, hφψ y hy]
    ring
  · intro y hy
    have hyK : y ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h' => hy (hζs h')
    have hz : ζ y = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hyK
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ ζ y = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hyK (support_fderiv_subset ℝ (f := ζ) hne)
    have hpd : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a ζ y = 0 := by
      intro a
      simp [partialDeriv, hfd]
    simp [hz, hpd]

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_comp_apply
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : E3 → M)
    (τ : E3 → E3) (y : E3) (hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y)
    (hΦ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ (τ y)) (i j : Fin 3) :
    g.coeff (Φ ∘ τ) y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a * g.coeff Φ (τ y) a b * fderiv ℝ τ y (e j) b

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_pdiffeo_formula
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ κ.source) :
    g.gradInner u w (κ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => u (κ z)) x *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => w (κ z)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_chart_cont
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv a (fun x => u (κ x))) κ.source) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u w (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.coeff κ x).det) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ a b) κ.source)

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (s r : ℝ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (Dφ : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
    (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : ℝ) (hrs : r + |h| < s) (hφ : fcrSob c s 1 φ Dφ) :
    ∫ x in fcrHalf c r, (fcrDQ a h φ x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (Dφ [a] x) ^ 2

signature.name: fcr_dq_sob_L2_bound
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (s r : ℝ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (Dφ : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
    (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : ℝ) (hrs : r + |h| < s) (hφ : fcrSob c s 1 φ Dφ) :
    ∫ x in fcrHalf c r, (fcrDQ a h φ x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (Dφ [a] x) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  by_cases hh : h = 0
  · subst hh
    have h0 : ∫ x in fcrHalf c r, (fcrDQ a 0 φ x) ^ 2 = 0 := by simp [fcrDQ]
    rw [h0]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  
  have T_avg_int : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ), StronglyMeasurable g → Integrable g → ∀ (v : E3),
      Integrable (fun p : E3 × ℝ => g (p.1 + p.2 • v))
        ((volume : Measure E3).prod (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1))) := by
    intro g hm hg v
    have hmeas : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : E3 × ℝ => g (p.1 + p.2 • v)) :=
      hm.comp_measurable (measurable_fst.add (measurable_snd.smul_const v))
    refine (integrable_prod_iff' hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable).2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => hg.comp_add_right (t • v))
    · refine (integrable_const (∫ x, ‖g x‖)).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => ?_))
      exact (integral_add_right_eq_self (fun x => ‖g x‖) (t • v)).symm
  
  have T_avg_sq : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ), StronglyMeasurable g → MemLp g 2 volume → ∀ (v : E3)
      (S : Set E3), ∫ x in S, (∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • v)) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x, g x ^ 2 := by
    intro g hm hg v S
    have hν1 : (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)).real Set.univ = 1 := by
      simp [Measure.real, Real.volume_Ioc]
    have hg2 : Integrable (fun x => g x ^ 2) := hg.integrable_sq
    have hm2 : StronglyMeasurable (fun x => g x ^ 2) := hm.pow 2
    have hQ : Integrable (fun p : E3 × ℝ => g (p.1 + p.2 • v) ^ 2)
        ((volume : Measure E3).prod (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1))) :=
      T_avg_int (fun x => g x ^ 2) hm2 hg2 v
    have hW : Integrable (fun x => ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • v) ^ 2) volume :=
      hQ.integral_prod_left
    have hW0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • v) ^ 2 :=
      fun x => integral_nonneg (fun t => sq_nonneg _)
    have hFm : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : E3 × ℝ => g (p.1 + p.2 • v)) :=
      hm.comp_measurable (measurable_fst.add (measurable_snd.smul_const v))
    have hVm : StronglyMeasurable (fun x => ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • v)) :=
      hFm.integral_prod_right'
    have hJ : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E3), (∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • v)) ^ 2 ≤
        ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • v) ^ 2 := by
      filter_upwards [hQ.prod_right_ae] with x hx
      have hux : StronglyMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => g (x + t • v)) :=
        hm.comp_measurable (measurable_const.add (measurable_id.smul_const v))
      have hL2 : MemLp (fun t : ℝ => g (x + t • v)) 2 (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)) :=
        (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hux.aestronglyMeasurable).2 hx
      have hL1 : Integrable (fun t : ℝ => g (x + t • v)) (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)) :=
        hL2.integrable one_le_two
      obtain ⟨m, hmdef⟩ : ∃ m, m = ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • v) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hmdef]
      have hpt : ∀ t : ℝ, 2 * m * g (x + t • v) - m ^ 2 ≤ g (x + t • v) ^ 2 := fun t => by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (g (x + t • v) - m)]
      have hint : Integrable (fun t : ℝ => 2 * m * g (x + t • v) - m ^ 2)
          (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)) :=
        (hL1.const_mul (2 * m)).sub (integrable_const _)
      have h1 := integral_mono hint hx hpt
      rw [integral_sub (hL1.const_mul (2 * m)) (integrable_const _), integral_const_mul,
        integral_const, hν1, one_smul, ← hmdef] at h1
      nlinarith [h1]
    have hV2 : Integrable (fun x => (∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • v)) ^ 2) volume := by
      refine hW.mono' (hVm.aestronglyMeasurable.pow 2) ?_
      filter_upwards [hJ] with x hx
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact hx
    calc ∫ x in S, (∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • v)) ^ 2
        ≤ ∫ x in S, ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • v) ^ 2 :=
          integral_mono_ae hV2.restrict hW.restrict (ae_restrict_of_ae hJ)
      _ ≤ ∫ x, ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • v) ^ 2 :=
          setIntegral_le_integral hW (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hW0)
      _ = ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∫ x, g (x + t • v) ^ 2 :=
          integral_integral_swap (f := fun x t => g (x + t • v) ^ 2) hQ
      _ = ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, (∫ x, g x ^ 2) := by
          congr 1; funext t; exact integral_add_right_eq_self (fun x => g x ^ 2) (t • v)
      _ = ∫ x, g x ^ 2 := by rw [integral_const, hν1, one_smul]
  
  have T_ae_eq : ∀ (U : Set E3), IsOpen U → ∀ (u w : E3 → ℝ), IntegrableOn u U →
      IntegrableOn w U →
      (∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U →
        ∫ x, ζ x * u x = ∫ x, ζ x * w x) →
      ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict U), u x = w x := by
    intro U hU u w hu hw hpair
    have hint : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), IntegrableOn f U → ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, Continuous ζ →
        HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → Integrable (fun x => ζ x * f x) := by
      intro f hf ζ hζ hζc hζs
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hζ.bounded_above_of_compact_support hζc
      have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun x => ζ x * f x) U :=
        Integrable.bdd_mul hf hζ.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hC)
      have h2 : (fun x => ζ x * f x) = U.indicator (fun x => ζ x * f x) := by
        funext x
        by_cases hx : x ∈ U
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx,
            image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hζs h)), zero_mul]
      rw [h2]
      exact (integrable_indicator_iff hU.measurableSet).2 h1
    have key := hU.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero (μ := volume)
      (f := fun x => u x - w x) (IntegrableOn.locallyIntegrableOn (Integrable.sub hu hw)) (by
        intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
        have hzu := hint u hu ζ hζ.continuous hζc hζs
        have hzw := hint w hw ζ hζ.continuous hζc hζs
        simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_sub]
        rw [integral_sub hzu hzw, hpair ζ hζ hζc hζs, sub_self])
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' hU.measurableSet]
    filter_upwards [key] with x hx hxU
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (hx hxU)
  
  have T_pair : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ), StronglyMeasurable g →
      (fcrHalf c s).indicator (Dφ [a]) =ᵐ[volume] g →
      Integrable ((fcrHalf c s).indicator φ) → Integrable g →
      ∀ (ζ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c r →
      ∫ x, ζ x * fcrDQ a h φ x = ∫ x, ζ x * ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • (h • e a)) := by
    intro g hgm hg hfb hg1 ζ hζ hζc hζs
    
    have hG : ∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c r, ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| ≤ |h| → x + τ • e a ∈ fcrHalf c s := by
      intro x hx τ hτ
      have hx' : x ∈ Metric.ball c r ∧ 0 < x 0 := hx
      have hea : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
      have hn : ‖τ • e a‖ = |τ| := by rw [norm_smul, hea, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have htri : dist (x + τ • e a) c ≤ dist x c + ‖τ • e a‖ := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_right_comm]; exact norm_add_le _ _
      have h0 : (x + τ • e a) 0 = x 0 := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Ne.symm ha]
      have hxb : dist x c < r := hx'.1
      refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.2 (by linarith), ?_⟩
      show 0 < (x + τ • e a) 0
      rw [h0]; exact hx'.2
    
    have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ ζ := hζ.differentiable (by simp)
    have hfdc : Continuous (fderiv ℝ ζ) := hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hζ.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hζc
    obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hfdc.bounded_above_of_compact_support (hζc.fderiv ℝ)
    have hea : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    have hdζ : ∀ z, ‖partialDeriv a ζ z‖ ≤ C₁ := by
      intro z
      have h1 : ‖fderiv ℝ ζ z (e a)‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ ζ z‖ * ‖e a‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      rw [hea, mul_one] at h1
      exact h1.trans (hC₁ z)
    set fb := (fcrHalf c s).indicator φ with hfb_def
    set gb := (fcrHalf c s).indicator (Dφ [a]) with hgb_def
    
    have hP1pt : ∀ x, ζ x * fcrDQ a h φ x = (ζ x * fb (x + h • e a) - ζ x * fb x) / h := by
      intro x
      by_cases hz : ζ x = 0
      · simp [hz]
      · have hxt : x ∈ tsupport ζ := subset_tsupport _ hz
        have hxr : x ∈ fcrHalf c r := hζs hxt
        have h1 : x + h • e a ∈ fcrHalf c s := hG x hxr h le_rfl
        have h2 : x ∈ fcrHalf c s := by
          have := hG x hxr 0 (by simp)
          simpa using this
        rw [hfb_def, Set.indicator_of_mem h1, Set.indicator_of_mem h2]
        unfold fcrDQ
        ring
    have hi1 : Integrable (fun x => ζ x * fb (x + h • e a)) :=
      Integrable.bdd_mul (hfb.comp_add_right (h • e a)) hζ.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hC₀)
    have hi2 : Integrable (fun x => ζ x * fb x) :=
      Integrable.bdd_mul hfb hζ.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hC₀)
    have hi3 : Integrable (fun y => ζ (y - h • e a) * fb y) :=
      Integrable.bdd_mul hfb
        (hζ.continuous.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => hC₀ _))
    have hshift : ∫ x, ζ x * fb (x + h • e a) = ∫ y, ζ (y - h • e a) * fb y := by
      have := integral_add_right_eq_self (μ := (volume : Measure E3))
        (fun y => ζ (y - h • e a) * fb y) (h • e a)
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using this
    have hstep1 : ∫ x, ζ x * fcrDQ a h φ x = ∫ y, fb y * ((ζ (y - h • e a) - ζ y) / h) := by
      rw [integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hP1pt), integral_div,
        integral_sub hi1 hi2, hshift]
      have : (fun y => fb y * ((ζ (y - h • e a) - ζ y) / h)) =
          fun y => (ζ (y - h • e a) * fb y - ζ y * fb y) / h := by
        funext y; ring
      rw [this, integral_div, integral_sub hi3 hi2]
    
    have hftc : ∀ y, (ζ (y - h • e a) - ζ y) / h =
        -∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, partialDeriv a ζ (y - t • (h • e a)) := by
      intro y
      have hd : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ζ (y - t • (h • e a)))
          (-(h * partialDeriv a ζ (y - t • (h • e a)))) t := by
        intro t
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => y - t • (h • e a)) (-(h • e a)) t := by
          simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const (h • e a)).const_sub y
        have h2 := (hdiff (y - t • (h • e a))).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h1
        convert h2 using 1
        rw [map_neg, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
        rfl
      have hcont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => -(h * partialDeriv a ζ (y - t • (h • e a)))) := by
        unfold partialDeriv
        have hc0 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => fderiv ℝ ζ (y - t • (h • e a)) (e a)) :=
          (hfdc.comp (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.smul continuous_const))).clm_apply
            continuous_const
        exact (continuous_const.mul hc0).neg
      have hI := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (a := 0) (b := 1)
        (fun t _ => hd t) (hcont.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one] at hI
      simp only [one_smul, zero_smul, sub_zero] at hI
      rw [integral_neg, integral_const_mul] at hI
      rw [← hI, neg_div, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hh]
    
    have hcontP : Continuous (fun p : E3 × ℝ => partialDeriv a ζ (p.1 - p.2 • (h • e a))) := by
      unfold partialDeriv
      exact (hfdc.comp (continuous_fst.sub (continuous_snd.smul continuous_const))).clm_apply
        continuous_const
    have hint3 : Integrable (fun p : E3 × ℝ => fb p.1 * partialDeriv a ζ (p.1 - p.2 • (h • e a)))
        ((volume : Measure E3).prod (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1))) := by
      have hfp : Integrable (fun p : E3 × ℝ => fb p.1 * 1)
          ((volume : Measure E3).prod (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1))) :=
        hfb.mul_prod (integrable_const (1:ℝ))
      simp only [mul_one] at hfp
      exact Integrable.mul_bdd hfp hcontP.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => hdζ _))
    have hstep2 : ∫ y, fb y * ((ζ (y - h • e a) - ζ y) / h) =
        -∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∫ y, fb y * partialDeriv a ζ (y - t • (h • e a)) := by
      simp_rw [hftc, mul_neg, integral_neg]
      congr 1
      simp_rw [← integral_const_mul]
      exact integral_integral_swap (f := fun y t => fb y * partialDeriv a ζ (y - t • (h • e a)))
        hint3
    
    have hP4 : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 →
        ∫ y, fb y * partialDeriv a ζ (y - t • (h • e a)) =
          -∫ x, ζ x * g (x + t • (h • e a)) := by
      intro t ht0 ht1
      set w : E3 := t • (h • e a) with hw
      have hw' : w = (t * h) • e a := by rw [hw, smul_smul]
      have hτ : |t * h| ≤ |h| := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ht0]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg h) ht1
      have hout : ∀ y, y ∉ fcrHalf c s → y - w ∉ tsupport ζ := by
        intro y hy hyt
        apply hy
        have := hG (y - w) (hζs hyt) (t * h) hτ
        rwa [← hw', sub_add_cancel] at this
      have hζt : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ζ (y - w)) := hζ.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
      have hζtc : HasCompactSupport (fun y => ζ (y - w)) :=
        hζc.comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.subRight w)
      have hζts : tsupport (fun y => ζ (y - w)) ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
        have heq : tsupport (fun y => ζ (y - w)) = (Homeomorph.subRight w) ⁻¹' tsupport ζ :=
          tsupport_comp_eq_preimage ζ (Homeomorph.subRight w)
        rw [heq]
        intro y hy
        by_contra hys
        exact hout y hys hy
      have hpd : ∀ y, partialDeriv a (fun y => ζ (y - w)) y = partialDeriv a ζ (y - w) := by
        intro y
        unfold partialDeriv
        have : (fun y => ζ (y - w)) = fun y => ζ (y + -w) := by
          funext y; rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
        rw [this, fderiv_comp_add_right, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
      have hweak := hφ.2.2 [] a (by simp) (fun y => ζ (y - w)) hζt hζtc hζts
      rw [hφ.1] at hweak
      simp only [hpd] at hweak
      have hl : ∫ y, fb y * partialDeriv a ζ (y - w) = ∫ y, φ y * partialDeriv a ζ (y - w) := by
        congr 1; funext y
        by_cases hy : y ∈ fcrHalf c s
        · rw [hfb_def, Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
        · have h1 : partialDeriv a ζ (y - w) = 0 := by
            unfold partialDeriv
            have : fderiv ℝ ζ (y - w) = 0 := by
              by_contra hne
              exact hout y hy (support_fderiv_subset ℝ hne)
            rw [this]; rfl
          rw [h1, mul_zero, mul_zero]
      have hr : ∫ y, Dφ [a] y * ζ (y - w) = ∫ y, g y * ζ (y - w) := by
        have h1 : ∫ y, Dφ [a] y * ζ (y - w) = ∫ y, gb y * ζ (y - w) := by
          congr 1; funext y
          by_cases hy : y ∈ fcrHalf c s
          · rw [hgb_def, Set.indicator_of_mem hy]
          · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (hout y hy), mul_zero, mul_zero]
        rw [h1]
        refine integral_congr_ae ?_
        filter_upwards [hg] with y hy
        rw [hy]
      have htr : ∫ y, g y * ζ (y - w) = ∫ x, ζ x * g (x + w) := by
        have := integral_add_right_eq_self (μ := (volume : Measure E3))
          (fun y => g y * ζ (y - w)) w
        simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at this
        rw [← this]
        congr 1; funext x; ring
      rw [hl, hweak, hr, htr]
    
    have hint5 : Integrable (fun p : E3 × ℝ => ζ p.1 * g (p.1 + p.2 • (h • e a)))
        ((volume : Measure E3).prod (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1))) :=
      Integrable.bdd_mul (T_avg_int g hgm hg1 (h • e a))
        (hζ.continuous.comp continuous_fst).aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun p => hC₀ _))
    have hstep3 : ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∫ y, fb y * partialDeriv a ζ (y - t • (h • e a)) =
        -∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∫ x, ζ x * g (x + t • (h • e a)) := by
      rw [← integral_neg]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc (fun t ht => ?_)
      exact hP4 t ht.1.le ht.2
    have hstep4 : ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, ∫ x, ζ x * g (x + t • (h • e a)) =
        ∫ x, ζ x * ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • (h • e a)) := by
      simp_rw [← integral_const_mul]
      exact (integral_integral_swap (f := fun x t => ζ x * g (x + t • (h • e a))) hint5).symm
    rw [hstep1, hstep2, hstep3, neg_neg, hstep4]
  
  have hopen : ∀ ρ : ℝ, IsOpen (fcrHalf c ρ) := fun ρ =>
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  have hfin : ∀ ρ : ℝ, IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c ρ)) := fun ρ =>
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 (ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_left)
      measure_ball_lt_top))
  have hφL : MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    have h0 := hφ.2.1 [] (by simp)
    rwa [hφ.1] at h0
  have hDL : MemLp (Dφ [a]) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := hφ.2.1 [a] (by simp)
  have hgb2 : MemLp ((fcrHalf c s).indicator (Dφ [a])) 2 volume :=
    (memLp_indicator_iff_restrict (hopen s).measurableSet).2 hDL
  haveI := hfin s
  have hgb1 : Integrable ((fcrHalf c s).indicator (Dφ [a])) :=
    (integrable_indicator_iff (hopen s).measurableSet).2 (hDL.integrable one_le_two)
  have hfb1 : Integrable ((fcrHalf c s).indicator φ) :=
    (integrable_indicator_iff (hopen s).measurableSet).2 (hφL.integrable one_le_two)
  obtain ⟨g, hgm, hg⟩ : ∃ g : E3 → ℝ, StronglyMeasurable g ∧
      (fcrHalf c s).indicator (Dφ [a]) =ᵐ[volume] g :=
    ⟨_, hgb2.aestronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurable_mk, hgb2.aestronglyMeasurable.ae_eq_mk⟩
  have hg2 : MemLp g 2 volume := hgb2.ae_eq hg
  have hg1 : Integrable g := hgb1.congr hg
  haveI := hfin r
  have hDQL : MemLp (fcrDQ a h φ) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c r)) := by
    have hind : MemLp ((fcrHalf c s).indicator φ) 2 volume :=
      (memLp_indicator_iff_restrict (hopen s).measurableSet).2 hφL
    have htr : MemLp (((fcrHalf c s).indicator φ) ∘ (fun x => x + h • e a)) 2 volume :=
      hind.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_add_right volume (h • e a))
    have hsh : ∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c r, x + h • e a ∈ fcrHalf c s := by
      intro x hx
      have hx' : x ∈ Metric.ball c r ∧ 0 < x 0 := hx
      have hea : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
      have hn : ‖h • e a‖ = |h| := by rw [norm_smul, hea, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have htri : dist (x + h • e a) c ≤ dist x c + ‖h • e a‖ := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_right_comm]; exact norm_add_le _ _
      have h0 : (x + h • e a) 0 = x 0 := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Ne.symm ha]
      have hxb : dist x c < r := hx'.1
      refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.2 (by linarith), ?_⟩
      show 0 < (x + h • e a) 0
      rw [h0]; exact hx'.2
    have htr' : MemLp (fun x => φ (x + h • e a)) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c r)) := by
      refine (htr.restrict (fcrHalf c r)).ae_eq ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (hopen r).measurableSet (fun x hx => ?_)
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      exact Set.indicator_of_mem (hsh x hx) φ
    have hsub : fcrHalf c r ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
      intro x hx
      have hx' : x ∈ Metric.ball c r ∧ 0 < x 0 := hx
      exact ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith [abs_nonneg h]) hx'.1, hx'.2⟩
    have hφ2 : MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c r)) :=
      hφL.mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono hsub le_rfl)
    have hm := (htr'.sub hφ2).mul_const h⁻¹
    refine hm.ae_eq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
    simp only [fcrDQ, div_eq_mul_inv, Pi.sub_apply]
  have hDQ : IntegrableOn (fcrDQ a h φ) (fcrHalf c r) :=
    hDQL.integrable one_le_two
  have hV : IntegrableOn (fun x => ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • (h • e a)))
      (fcrHalf c r) :=
    (T_avg_int g hgm hg1 (h • e a)).integral_prod_left.integrableOn
  have hae := T_ae_eq (fcrHalf c r) (hopen r) (fcrDQ a h φ)
    (fun x => ∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • (h • e a))) hDQ hV
    (fun ζ h1 h2 h3 => T_pair g hgm hg hfb1 hg1 ζ h1 h2 h3)
  calc ∫ x in fcrHalf c r, (fcrDQ a h φ x) ^ 2
      = ∫ x in fcrHalf c r, (∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1, g (x + t • (h • e a))) ^ 2 := by
        refine integral_congr_ae ?_
        filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
        rw [hx]
    _ ≤ ∫ x, g x ^ 2 := T_avg_sq g hgm hg2 (h • e a) (fcrHalf c r)
    _ = ∫ x, ((fcrHalf c s).indicator (Dφ [a]) x) ^ 2 := by
        refine integral_congr_ae ?_
        filter_upwards [hg] with x hx
        rw [hx]
    _ = ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (Dφ [a] x) ^ 2 := by
        rw [← integral_indicator (hopen s).measurableSet]
        congr 1; funext x
        by_cases hx : x ∈ fcrHalf c s
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]; ring

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R s s₂ s₃ h₀ : ℝ) (hs₂ : 0 < s₂) (hh₀ : 0 < h₀)
    (h23 : s₂ + h₀ < s₃) (h3s : s₃ + 2 * h₀ ≤ s) (hsR : s < R)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, (A x).PosDef)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hw : fcrSob c s 1 w D) (hF : MemLp F 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hG : ∀ d, ∃ DG, fcrSob c s 1 (G d) DG)
    (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ lam Λ M : ℝ, 0 < lam ∧ 0 ≤ Λ ∧ 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ h : ℝ, h ≠ 0 → |h| ≤ h₀ →
      (∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s₂, ∀ ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        lam * ∑ i : Fin 3, ξ i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ξ i * A (x + h • e a) i j * ξ j) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s₂, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |A (x + h • e a) i j| ≤ Λ) ∧
      MemLp (fcrDQ a h w) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂)) ∧
      (∀ d, MemLp (fcrDQ a h (D [d])) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂))) ∧
      (∀ d, MemLp (fun x => (∑ b : Fin 3, fcrDQ a h (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) +
        fcrDQ a h (G d) x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂))) ∧
      MemLp F 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂)) ∧
      ∫ x in fcrHalf c s₂, (fcrDQ a h w x) ^ 2 ≤ M ∧
      (∀ d, ∫ x in fcrHalf c s₂, ((∑ b : Fin 3, fcrDQ a h (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) +
        fcrDQ a h (G d) x) ^ 2 ≤ M) ∧
      ∫ x in fcrHalf c s₂, (F x) ^ 2 ≤ M
