proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hs3R : s₃ < R := by linarith
  have hs2s : s₂ + h₀ < s := by linarith
  have hea : ‖e a‖ = 1 := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  have hopen : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen (fcrHalf c r) := fun r =>
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  have hmeas : ∀ r : ℝ, MeasurableSet (fcrHalf c r) := fun r => (hopen r).measurableSet
  have hsub : fcrHalf c s₂ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ Metric.ball c s₂ ∧ 0 < x 0 := hx
    exact ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith) hx'.1, hx'.2⟩
  have hμ : volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂) ≤ volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s) :=
    Measure.restrict_mono hsub le_rfl
  have hKsub : Metric.closedBall c s₃ ⊆ Metric.ball c R := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hs3R
  have hshift : ∀ h : ℝ, |h| ≤ h₀ → ∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s₂,
      x + h • e a ∈ Metric.closedBall c s₃ ∧ x + h • e a ∈ fcrHalf c s ∧
        x ∈ Metric.closedBall c s₃ := by
    intro h hh x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ Metric.ball c s₂ ∧ 0 < x 0 := hx
    have hxb : dist x c < s₂ := hx'.1
    have hx0 : 0 < x 0 := hx'.2
    have hn : ‖h • e a‖ = |h| := by rw [norm_smul, hea, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have htri : dist (x + h • e a) c ≤ dist x c + ‖h • e a‖ := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_right_comm]
      exact norm_add_le _ _
    have hlt : dist (x + h • e a) c < s₃ := by linarith
    have h0 : (x + h • e a) 0 = x 0 := by
      simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Ne.symm ha]
    refine ⟨Metric.mem_closedBall.2 hlt.le, ⟨Metric.mem_ball.2 (by linarith), ?_⟩,
      Metric.mem_closedBall.2 (by linarith)⟩
    show 0 < (x + h • e a) 0
    rw [h0]
    exact hx0
  
  obtain ⟨lam, Mx, Γ, hlam, -, -, hcb⟩ := coeff_compact_bounds A (Metric.ball c R) c s₃
    Metric.isOpen_ball hKsub hA hApos
  
  have hCb : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c s₃, ‖A y i j‖ ≤ C := fun i j =>
    (isCompact_closedBall c s₃).exists_bound_of_continuousOn ((hA i j).continuousOn.mono hKsub)
  choose C hC using hCb
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛdef⟩ : ∃ Λ : ℝ, Λ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |C i j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΛ0 : 0 ≤ Λ := by
    rw [hΛdef]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _))
  have hCΛ : ∀ i j, |C i j| ≤ Λ := by
    intro i j
    rw [hΛdef]
    calc |C i j| ≤ ∑ j' : Fin 3, |C i j'| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j' => |C i j'|) (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)
            (Finset.mem_univ j)
      _ ≤ ∑ i' : Fin 3, ∑ j' : Fin 3, |C i' j'| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i' => ∑ j' : Fin 3, |C i' j'|)
            (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  
  have hLip : ∀ d b : Fin 3, ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall c s₃,
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c s₃, |A y d b - A x d b| ≤ L * ‖y - x‖ := by
    intro d b
    have hfc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fun z => A z d b)) (Metric.ball c R) :=
      (hA d b).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball (by simp)
    obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall c s₃).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hfc.mono hKsub)
    refine ⟨max C' 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x hx y hy => ?_⟩
    have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall c s₃, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => A z d b) z :=
      fun z hz => ((hA d b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hKsub hz))
    have hmvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (C := max C' 0) hdiff
      (fun z hz => (hC' z hz).trans (le_max_left C' 0)) (convex_closedBall c s₃) hx hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt
    exact hmvt
  choose Lc hLc0 hLc using hLip
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = ∑ d : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Lc d b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := by
    rw [hLdef]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => hLc0 d b))
  have hLcL : ∀ d b, Lc d b ≤ L := by
    intro d b
    rw [hLdef]
    calc Lc d b ≤ ∑ b' : Fin 3, Lc d b' :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun b' => Lc d b') (fun _ _ => hLc0 _ _) (Finset.mem_univ b)
      _ ≤ ∑ d' : Fin 3, ∑ b' : Fin 3, Lc d' b' :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun d' => ∑ b' : Fin 3, Lc d' b')
            (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => hLc0 _ _)) (Finset.mem_univ d)
  
  choose DG hDG using hG
  have hwL : MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    have h0 := hw.2.1 [] (by simp)
    rwa [hw.1] at h0
  have hDL : ∀ b, MemLp (D [b]) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    fun b => hw.2.1 [b] (by simp)
  have hGL : ∀ d, MemLp (G d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro d
    have h0 := (hDG d).2.1 [] (by simp)
    rwa [(hDG d).1] at h0
  have hFL : MemLp F 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := hF
  
  obtain ⟨SI, hSI⟩ : ∃ SI : ℝ, SI = ∑ b : Fin 3, ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (D [b] x) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨SJ, hSJ⟩ : ∃ SJ : ℝ, SJ = ∑ d : Fin 3, ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (DG d [a] x) ^ 2 :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hSI0 : 0 ≤ SI := by
    rw [hSI]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun b _ => integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg (D [b] x)))
  have hJle : ∀ d, ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (DG d [a] x) ^ 2 ≤ SJ := by
    intro d
    rw [hSJ]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun d => ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (DG d [a] x) ^ 2)
      (fun d _ => integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg (DG d [a] x))) (Finset.mem_univ d)
  have hSJ0 : 0 ≤ SJ := le_trans (integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg (DG 0 [a] x))) (hJle 0)
  have hIa0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (D [a] x) ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hΦ0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (F x) ^ 2 := integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = (∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (D [a] x) ^ 2) +
      (∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (F x) ^ 2) + 4 * (L ^ 2 * SI) + 4 * SJ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hL2 : 0 ≤ L ^ 2 := sq_nonneg L
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by
    rw [hMdef]
    have := mul_nonneg hL2 hSI0
    linarith
  
  have hdq : ∀ (φ : E3 → ℝ) (h : ℝ), |h| ≤ h₀ → MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp (fcrDQ a h φ) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂)) := by
    intro φ h hh hφ
    have hind : MemLp ((fcrHalf c s).indicator φ) 2 volume :=
      (memLp_indicator_iff_restrict (hmeas s)).2 hφ
    have htr : MemLp (((fcrHalf c s).indicator φ) ∘ (fun x => x + h • e a)) 2 volume :=
      hind.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_add_right volume (h • e a))
    have htr' : MemLp (fun x => φ (x + h • e a)) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂)) := by
      refine (htr.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂)).ae_eq ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (hmeas s₂) (fun x hx => ?_)
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      exact Set.indicator_of_mem (hshift h hh x hx).2.1 φ
    have hφ2 : MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂)) := hφ.mono_measure hμ
    have hm := (htr'.sub hφ2).mul_const h⁻¹
    refine hm.ae_eq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
    simp only [fcrDQ, div_eq_mul_inv, Pi.sub_apply]
  
  have hAdq : ∀ (h : ℝ), h ≠ 0 → |h| ≤ h₀ → ∀ d b : Fin 3,
      ContinuousOn (fcrDQ a h (fun y => A y d b)) (fcrHalf c s₂) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s₂, |fcrDQ a h (fun y => A y d b) x| ≤ L := by
    intro h hh0 hh d b
    constructor
    · have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun x : E3 => x + h • e a) (fcrHalf c s₂) (Metric.ball c R) :=
        fun x hx => hKsub (hshift h hh x hx).1
      have hmaps2 : fcrHalf c s₂ ⊆ Metric.ball c R := fun x hx => hKsub (hshift h hh x hx).2.2
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => A (x + h • e a) d b) (fcrHalf c s₂) :=
        (hA d b).continuousOn.comp (continuous_add_right (h • e a)).continuousOn hmaps
      have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun x => A x d b) (fcrHalf c s₂) := (hA d b).continuousOn.mono hmaps2
      exact (h1.sub h2).div_const h
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨hy, -, hxK⟩ := hshift h hh x hx
      have hl := hLc d b x hxK _ hy
      have hn : ‖x + h • e a - x‖ = |h| := by
        rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hea, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      rw [hn] at hl
      have hpos : 0 < |h| := abs_pos.2 hh0
      unfold fcrDQ
      rw [abs_div, div_le_iff₀ hpos]
      calc |A (x + h • e a) d b - A x d b| ≤ Lc d b * |h| := hl
        _ ≤ L * |h| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hLcL d b) hpos.le
  refine ⟨lam, Λ, M, hlam, hΛ0, hM0, fun h hh0 hh => ?_⟩
  have hs2h : s₂ + |h| < s := by linarith
  have hDb2 : ∀ b, MemLp (D [b]) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂)) :=
    fun b => (hDL b).mono_measure hμ
  have hpmem : ∀ d b, MemLp (fun x => fcrDQ a h (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) 2
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂)) := by
    intro d b
    obtain ⟨hc, hbd⟩ := hAdq h hh0 hh d b
    refine MemLp.of_le_mul (c := L) (hDb2 b)
      ((hc.aestronglyMeasurable (hmeas s₂)).mul (hDb2 b).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (hmeas s₂) (fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hbd x hx) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hRmem : ∀ d, MemLp (fun x => (∑ b : Fin 3, fcrDQ a h (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) +
      fcrDQ a h (G d) x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂)) := by
    intro d
    exact (memLp_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun b _ => hpmem d b)).add (hdq _ h hh (hGL d))
  refine ⟨fun x hx ξ => (hcb _ (hshift h hh x hx).1).1 ξ, fun x hx i j => ?_,
    hdq w h hh hwL, fun d => hdq _ h hh (hDL d), hRmem, hFL.mono_measure hμ, ?_, fun d => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := hC i j _ (hshift h hh x hx).1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans (hCΛ i j))
  · have h1 := fcr_dq_sob_L2_bound c s s₂ w D a ha h hs2h hw
    rw [hMdef]
    have := mul_nonneg hL2 hSI0
    linarith
  · have hq := fcr_dq_sob_L2_bound c s s₂ (G d) (DG d) a ha h hs2h (hDG d)
    have hqm : MemLp (fcrDQ a h (G d)) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₂)) := hdq _ h hh (hGL d)

    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h2
    exact hy h2
  
  have hζm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ζ (y - v)) := hζ.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hζm_eq : (fun y => ζ (y - v)) = ζ ∘ (Homeomorph.subRight v) := by
    funext y
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Homeomorph.subRight_apply]
  have hcsm : HasCompactSupport (fun y => ζ (y - v)) := by
    rw [hζm_eq]; exact hcs.comp_homeomorph _
  have htsm : tsupport (fun y => ζ (y - v)) ⊆ fcrHalf c s := by
    rw [hζm_eq, tsupport_comp_eq_preimage]
    intro y hy
    have h1 : y - v ∈ tsupport ζ := by
      have h3 : (Homeomorph.subRight v) y ∈ tsupport ζ := hy
      rwa [Homeomorph.subRight_apply] at h3
    have h2 := hshift _ (hts h1)
    rwa [sub_add_cancel] at h2
  have hdm : ∀ y, partialDeriv d (fun y => ζ (y - v)) y = partialDeriv d ζ (y - v) := by
    intro y
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [fderiv_comp_sub]
  have hwm := hwd (fun y => ζ (y - v)) hζm hcsm htsm
  simp only [hdm] at hwm
  have hS2 := hwd ζ hζ hcs hts'
  
  have cv1 : ∫ x, φ (x + v) * partialDeriv d ζ x = ∫ y, φ y * partialDeriv d ζ (y - v) := by
    have h1 := integral_add_right_eq_self (μ := volume)
      (fun y => φ y * partialDeriv d ζ (y - v)) v
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at h1
    exact h1
  have cv2 : ∫ x, ψ (x + v) * ζ x = ∫ y, ψ y * ζ (y - v) := by
    have h1 := integral_add_right_eq_self (μ := volume) (fun y => ψ y * ζ (y - v)) v
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have I2 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv d ζ x) :=
    L1 φ _ hφ hdc hdcs (fun x hx => hd0 x (fun ht => hx (hts' ht)))
  have I4 : Integrable (fun x => ψ x * ζ x) :=
    L1 ψ ζ hψ hζ.continuous hcs (fun x hx => hz0 x (fun ht => hx (hts' ht)))
  have hdm_eq : (fun y => partialDeriv d ζ (y - v)) =
      partialDeriv d ζ ∘ (Homeomorph.subRight v) := by
    funext y
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Homeomorph.subRight_apply]
  have hdcsm : HasCompactSupport (fun y => partialDeriv d ζ (y - v)) := by
    rw [hdm_eq]; exact hdcs.comp_homeomorph _
  have I1' : Integrable (fun y => φ y * partialDeriv d ζ (y - v)) :=
    L1 φ (fun y => partialDeriv d ζ (y - v)) hφ (hdc.comp (continuous_sub_right v)) hdcsm
      (fun y hy => hd0 _ (hoff y hy))
  have I3' : Integrable (fun y => ψ y * ζ (y - v)) :=
    L1 ψ (fun y => ζ (y - v)) hψ (hζ.continuous.comp (continuous_sub_right v)) hcsm
      (fun y hy => hz0 _ (hoff y hy))
  have I1 : Integrable (fun x => φ (x + v) * partialDeriv d ζ x) := by
    have h1 := I1'.comp_add_right v
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at h1
    exact h1
  have I3 : Integrable (fun x => ψ (x + v) * ζ x) := by
    have h1 := I3'.comp_add_right v
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have e1 : (fun x => fcrDQ a h φ x * partialDeriv d ζ x) =
      fun x => h⁻¹ * (φ (x + v) * partialDeriv d ζ x - φ x * partialDeriv d ζ x) := by
    funext x; rw [hDQ]; ring
  have e2 : (fun x => fcrDQ a h ψ x * ζ x) =
      fun x => h⁻¹ * (ψ (x + v) * ζ x - ψ x * ζ x) := by
    funext x; rw [hDQ]; ring
  show ∫ x, fcrDQ a h φ x * partialDeriv d ζ x = -∫ x, fcrDQ a h ψ x * ζ x
  rw [e1, e2, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_sub I1 I2, integral_sub I3 I4,
    cv1, cv2, hwm, hS2]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s ≤ R) (m : E3 → ℝ)
    (hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R)) (φ ψ : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3)
    (hφ : MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hψ : MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) (hwd : fcrWD c s φ a ψ) :
    fcrWD c s (fun x => m x * φ x) a (fun x => partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x)

signature.name: fcr_wd_smul
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s ≤ R) (m : E3 → ℝ)
    (hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R)) (φ ψ : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3)
    (hφ : MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hψ : MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) (hwd : fcrWD c s φ a ψ) :
    fcrWD c s (fun x => m x * φ x) a (fun x => partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hHsub : fcrHalf c s ⊆ Metric.ball c R :=
    fun x hx => Metric.ball_subset_ball hsR hx.1
  have hpd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a m) (Metric.ball c R) := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ m y (e a)) (Metric.ball c R)
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball).1 hm).2.clm_apply
      contDiffOn_const
  have hpdsupp : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      Function.support (fun x => partialDeriv a f x) ⊆ tsupport f := by
    intro f a x hx
    simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hx
    apply tsupport_fderiv_subset (𝕜 := ℝ)
    apply subset_tsupport
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    intro h
    exact hx (by simp [partialDeriv, h])
  have htest : ∀ m' : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m' (Metric.ball c R) →
      ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => m' x * ζ x) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun x => m' x * ζ x) ∧
      tsupport (fun x => m' x * ζ x) ⊆ fcrHalf c s ∧
      ∀ (a : Fin 3) (x : E3), partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x =
        partialDeriv a m' x * ζ x + m' x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
    intro m' hm' ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have hoff : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c R → ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      have h := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 (fun h => hx (hHsub (hζs h)))
      filter_upwards [h] with y hy
      simpa using hy
    have hoff2 : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c R →
        (fun y => m' y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      intro x hx
      filter_upwards [hoff x hx] with y hy
      simp [hy]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R
      · exact (hm'.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)).mul hζ.contDiffAt
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hoff2 x hx)
    · exact hζc.mul_left
    · exact (tsupport_mul_subset_right).trans hζs
    · intro a x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball c R
      · have hmd : DifferentiableAt ℝ m' x :=
          (hm'.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)
        have hζd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x := hζ.differentiable (by simp) x
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [fderiv_fun_mul hmd hζd]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      · have h1 : partialDeriv a (fun y => m' y * ζ y) x = 0 := by
          unfold partialDeriv
          rw [(hoff2 x hx).fderiv_eq]
          simp
        have h2 : partialDeriv a ζ x = 0 := by
          unfold partialDeriv
          rw [(hoff x hx).fderiv_eq]
          simp
        have h3 : ζ x = 0 := (hoff x hx).eq_of_nhds
        rw [h1, h2, h3]
        ring
  have hint : ∀ u g : E3 → ℝ, MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → Continuous g →
      HasCompactSupport g → Function.support g ⊆ fcrHalf c s →
      Integrable (fun x => u x * g x) := by
    intro u g hu hg hgc hgs
    have hg2 : MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      (hg.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hgc).restrict _
    have h1 : Integrable (fun x => u x * g x) (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      hu.integrable_mul hg2
    refine (integrableOn_iff_integrable_of_support_subset ?_).1 h1
    intro x hx
    simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hx
    apply hgs
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    intro h
    exact hx (by simp [h])
  intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
  obtain ⟨hη, hηc, hηs, hprod⟩ := htest m hm ζ hζ hζc hζs
  obtain ⟨hξ, hξc, -, -⟩ := htest (partialDeriv a m) hpd ζ hζ hζc hζs
  have h0 : ∫ x, φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m y * ζ y) x =
      -∫ x, ψ x * (m x * ζ x) := hwd _ hη hηc hηs
  have hsuppζ : Function.support ζ ⊆ fcrHalf c s := (subset_tsupport ζ).trans hζs
  have i1 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m y * ζ y) x) := by
    refine hint φ _ hφ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact (hη.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    · exact hηc.mono' (hpdsupp _ a)
    · exact (hpdsupp _ a).trans hηs
  have i2 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * (partialDeriv a m x * ζ x)) := by
    refine hint φ _ hφ hξ.continuous hξc ?_
    intro x hx
    simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hx
    apply hsuppζ
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    intro h
    exact hx (by simp [h])
  have i3 : Integrable (fun x => ψ x * (m x * ζ x)) :=
    hint ψ _ hψ hη.continuous hηc ((subset_tsupport _).trans hηs)
  have e1 : (fun x => m x * φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x) =
      fun x => φ x * partialDeriv a (fun y => m y * ζ y) x -
        φ x * (partialDeriv a m x * ζ x) := by
    funext x
    rw [hprod a x]
    ring
  have e2 : (fun x => (partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x) * ζ x) =
      fun x => φ x * (partialDeriv a m x * ζ x) + ψ x * (m x * ζ x) := by
    funext x
    ring
  show ∫ x, m x * φ x * partialDeriv a ζ x =
    -∫ x, (partialDeriv a m x * φ x + m x * ψ x) * ζ x
  rw [e1, e2, integral_sub i1 i2, integral_add i2 i3, h0]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (s r : ℝ) (f g : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : ℝ)
    (hrs : r + |h| < s) (hf : MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hg : MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hg0 : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c r → g x = 0) :
    ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, f x * fcrDQ a (-h) g x = -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, fcrDQ a h f x * g x

signature.name: fcr_discrete_ibp
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (s r : ℝ) (f g : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : ℝ)
    (hrs : r + |h| < s) (hf : MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hg : MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hg0 : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c r → g x = 0) :
    ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, f x * fcrDQ a (-h) g x = -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, fcrDQ a h f x * g x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set H := fcrHalf c s with hHdef
  have hH : MeasurableSet H := by
    have hopen : IsOpen H := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
    exact hopen.measurableSet
  set v : E3 := h • e a with hv
  set w : E3 := (-h) • e a with hw
  have hvw : ∀ x : E3, x + w + v = x := by
    intro x
    rw [hv, hw, add_assoc, ← add_smul, neg_add_cancel, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have hwv : ∀ x : E3, x + v + w = x := by
    intro x
    rw [hv, hw, add_assoc, ← add_smul, add_neg_cancel, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have hcoord : ∀ x : E3, (x + v) 0 = x 0 := by
    intro x
    simp [hv, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Ne.symm ha]
  have hnv : ‖v‖ = |h| := by
    simp [hv, norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  
  have hshift : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c r, (x + v ∈ H ↔ x ∈ H) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : dist x c < r := hx
    have h1 : dist x c < s := by linarith [abs_nonneg h]
    have h2 : dist (x + v) c < s := by
      have hle : dist (x + v) c ≤ dist x c + ‖v‖ := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_right_comm]
        exact norm_add_le _ _
      linarith
    simp only [hHdef, fcrHalf, Set.mem_inter_iff, Metric.mem_ball, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hcoord]
    exact ⟨fun h' => ⟨h1, h'.2⟩, fun h' => ⟨h2, h'.2⟩⟩
  
  have hL : ∀ x, f x * fcrDQ a (-h) g x = (f x * g x - f x * g (x + w)) / h := by
    intro x
    simp only [fcrDQ, hw]
    rw [div_neg]
    ring
  have hR : ∀ x, fcrDQ a h f x * g x = (f (x + v) * g x - f x * g x) / h := by
    intro x
    simp only [fcrDQ, hv]
    ring
  
  have hF : MemLp (H.indicator f) 2 volume := (memLp_indicator_iff_restrict hH).mpr hf
  have hG : MemLp (H.indicator g) 2 volume := (memLp_indicator_iff_restrict hH).mpr hg
  have hGw : MemLp (fun y => H.indicator g (y + w)) 2 volume :=
    hG.comp_measurePreserving (measurePreserving_add_right volume w)
  have hQint : Integrable (fun y => H.indicator f y * H.indicator g (y + w)) volume :=
    hF.integrable_mul hGw
  have hQeq : ∀ y, H.indicator (fun y => f y * g (y + w)) y =
      H.indicator f y * H.indicator g (y + w) := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ H
    · by_cases hg' : g (y + w) = 0
      · by_cases hm : y + w ∈ H
        · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy, hm, hg']
        · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy, hm, hg']
      · have hb : y + w ∈ Metric.ball c r := by
          by_contra hb
          exact hg' (hg0 _ hb)
        have hm : y + w ∈ H := by
          have hi := hshift (y + w) hb
          rw [hvw] at hi
          exact hi.mp hy
        simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy, hm]
    · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy]
  have hQ : Integrable (H.indicator (fun y => f y * g (y + w))) volume := by
    have e0 : H.indicator (fun y => f y * g (y + w)) =
        fun y => H.indicator f y * H.indicator g (y + w) := funext hQeq
    rw [e0]
    exact hQint
  have hQ'eq : ∀ x, H.indicator (fun x => f (x + v) * g x) x =
      H.indicator (fun y => f y * g (y + w)) (x + v) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hgx : g x = 0
    · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hgx, hwv]
    · have hb : x ∈ Metric.ball c r := by
        by_contra hb
        exact hgx (hg0 _ hb)
      have hiff := hshift x hb
      by_cases hx : x ∈ H
      · have hx' : x + v ∈ H := hiff.mpr hx
        simp [Set.indicator_apply, hx, hx', hwv]
      · have hx' : x + v ∉ H := fun h' => hx (hiff.mp h')
        simp [Set.indicator_apply, hx, hx']
  have hQ' : Integrable (H.indicator (fun x => f (x + v) * g x)) volume := by
    have e0 : H.indicator (fun x => f (x + v) * g x) =
        fun x => H.indicator (fun y => f y * g (y + w)) (x + v) := funext hQ'eq
    rw [e0]
    exact hQ.comp_add_right v
  have hPon : Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) (volume.restrict H) := hf.integrable_mul hg
  have hQon : Integrable (fun y => f y * g (y + w)) (volume.restrict H) :=
    (integrable_indicator_iff hH).mp hQ
  have hQ'on : Integrable (fun x => f (x + v) * g x) (volume.restrict H) :=
    (integrable_indicator_iff hH).mp hQ'
  
  have hshiftInt : ∫ x in H, f (x + v) * g x = ∫ y in H, f y * g (y + w) := by
    rw [← integral_indicator hH, ← integral_indicator hH]
    calc ∫ x, H.indicator (fun x => f (x + v) * g x) x
        = ∫ x, H.indicator (fun y => f y * g (y + w)) (x + v) := by
          congr 1
          funext x
          exact hQ'eq x
      _ = ∫ y, H.indicator (fun y => f y * g (y + w)) y := integral_add_right_eq_self _ v
  have e1 : ∫ x in H, f x * fcrDQ a (-h) g x =
      ((∫ x in H, f x * g x) - ∫ x in H, f x * g (x + w)) / h := by
    simp_rw [hL]
    rw [integral_div, integral_sub hPon hQon]
  have e2 : ∫ x in H, fcrDQ a h f x * g x =
      ((∫ x in H, f (x + v) * g x) - ∫ x in H, f x * g x) / h := by
    simp_rw [hR]
    rw [integral_div, integral_sub hQ'on hPon]
  rw [e1, e2, hshiftInt]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R s s₂ s₃ : ℝ) (hs₂ : 0 < s₂) (h23 : s₂ < s₃) (h3s : s₃ ≤ s)
    (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (Ψ : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hψ : MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₃)))
    (hΨ : ∀ d, MemLp (Ψ d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₃)))
    (hwd : ∀ d, fcrWD c s₃ ψ d (Ψ d))
    (hψ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ → ψ x = 0)
    (hΨ0 : ∀ d x, x ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ → Ψ d x = 0) :
    ∫ x in fcrHalf c s,
      ((∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ b : Fin 3, A x d b * D [b] x) + G d x) * Ψ d x) + F x * ψ x) = 0

signature.name: fcr_h1_test
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R s s₂ s₃ : ℝ) (hs₂ : 0 < s₂) (h23 : s₂ < s₃) (h3s : s₃ ≤ s)
    (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (Ψ : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hψ : MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₃)))
    (hΨ : ∀ d, MemLp (Ψ d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₃)))
    (hwd : ∀ d, fcrWD c s₃ ψ d (Ψ d))
    (hψ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ → ψ x = 0)
    (hΨ0 : ∀ d x, x ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ → Ψ d x = 0) :
    ∫ x in fcrHalf c s,
      ((∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ b : Fin 3, A x d b * D [b] x) + G d x) * Ψ d x) + F x * ψ x) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hopen : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen (fcrHalf c r) := fun r =>
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  have hmeas : ∀ r, MeasurableSet (fcrHalf c r) := fun r => (hopen r).measurableSet
  have hfin : ∀ r, IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c r)) := fun r =>
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr
      ((measure_mono (fun x hx => hx.1 : fcrHalf c r ⊆ Metric.ball c r)).trans_lt
        measure_ball_lt_top).ne
  have hF : MemLp F 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := hP.2.2.1
  
  have hind : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₃)) →
      (∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ → f x = 0) →
      MemLp ((fcrHalf c s₃).indicator f) 2 volume ∧ Integrable ((fcrHalf c s₃).indicator f) ∧
      (∀ t, t ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ → (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator f t = 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s, (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator f x = f x) := by
    intro f hf hf0
    haveI := hfin s₃
    refine ⟨(memLp_indicator_iff_restrict (hmeas s₃)).2 hf,
      (integrable_indicator_iff (hmeas s₃)).2 (hf.integrable (by norm_num)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      exact Set.indicator_apply_eq_zero.2 (fun _ => hf0 t ht)
    · intro x hx
      by_cases hx3 : x ∈ fcrHalf c s₃
      · exact Set.indicator_of_mem hx3 f

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_moll_deriv
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
    (hD : fcrSob c ρ k w D) (b : ContDiffBump (0 : E3)) :
    (∀ L : List (Fin 3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (L.foldr partialDeriv (fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator w)))) ∧
    ∀ L : List (Fin 3), L.length ≤ k → ∀ x : E3, -b.rOut < x 0 →
      x ∈ Metric.ball c (ρ - 3 * b.rOut) →
      L.foldr partialDeriv (fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator w)) x =
        fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator (D L)) x

(b : ContDiffBump (0 : E3)) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 volume) (S : Set E3) :
    ∫ x in S, (fcrMoll b f x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x, (f x) ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_moll_weak_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(g : E3 → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g) (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ)
    (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ) (b : ℕ → ContDiffBump (0 : E3))
    (hb : Tendsto (fun j => (b j).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, fcrMoll (b j) g x * ψ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, g x * ψ x))

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (s r : ℝ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (Φ : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : ℝ) (hrs : r + |h| ≤ s) (hφ : MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hΦ : ∀ d, MemLp (Φ d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) (hzt : fdrZT c s φ Φ) :
    fdrZT c r (fcrDQ a h φ) (fun d => fcrDQ a h (Φ d))

signature.name: fdr_dq_zt
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (s r : ℝ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (Φ : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : ℝ) (hrs : r + |h| ≤ s) (hφ : MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hΦ : ∀ d, MemLp (Φ d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) (hzt : fdrZT c s φ Φ) :
    fdrZT c r (fcrDQ a h φ) (fun d => fcrDQ a h (Φ d))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hea0 : (e a) 0 = 0 := by
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Ne.symm ha]
  have hn : ‖h • e a‖ = |h| := by
    rw [norm_smul]
    simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : E3, v = h • e a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hnv : ‖v‖ = |h| := by rw [hv]; exact hn
  have hx0 : ∀ x : E3, (x + v) 0 = x 0 := by
    intro x
    simp only [hv, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hea0, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hball : ∀ x : E3, dist x c < r → dist (x + v) c < s := by
    intro x hx
    have hle : dist (x + v) c ≤ dist x c + ‖v‖ := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      calc ‖x + v - c‖ = ‖(x - c) + v‖ := by congr 1; abel
        _ ≤ _ := norm_add_le _ _
    linarith
  have hrs' : r ≤ s := by linarith [abs_nonneg h]
  have hopen : ∀ ρ : ℝ, IsOpen (fcrHalf c ρ) := fun ρ =>
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  have hmeas : ∀ ρ, MeasurableSet (fcrHalf c ρ) := fun ρ => (hopen ρ).measurableSet
  
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 (ne_top_of_le_ne_top measure_ball_lt_top.ne
      (measure_mono (show fcrHalf c s ⊆ Metric.ball c s from Set.inter_subset_left)))
  obtain ⟨φb, hφb⟩ : ∃ f : E3 → ℝ, f = (fcrHalf c s).indicator φ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Φb, hΦb⟩ : ∃ F : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, F = fun d => (fcrHalf c s).indicator (Φ d) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hφbI : Integrable φb := by
    rw [hφb]
    exact IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator (hφ.integrable (by norm_num)) (hmeas s)
  have hΦbI : ∀ d, Integrable (Φb d) := by
    intro d
    rw [hΦb]
    exact IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator ((hΦ d).integrable (by norm_num)) (hmeas s)
  
  have hsi : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ), ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, f x * g x =
      ∫ x, (fcrHalf c s).indicator f x * g x := by
    intro f g
    rw [← integral_indicator (hmeas s)]
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact Set.indicator_mul_left _ _ _
  have hglob : ∀ (d : Fin 3) (ζ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c s →
      ∫ x, φb x * partialDeriv d ζ x = -∫ x, Φb d x * ζ x := by
    intro d ζ h1 h2 h3
    have h4 : ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * partialDeriv d ζ x =
        -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, Φ d x * ζ x := hzt d ζ h1 h2 h3
    rw [hsi φ (partialDeriv d ζ), hsi (Φ d) ζ] at h4
    rw [hφb, hΦb]
    exact h4
  have hDQ : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3), fcrDQ a h f x = h⁻¹ * (f (x + v) - f x) := by
    intro f x
    rw [hv]
    simp only [fcrDQ]
    rw [div_eq_inv_mul]
  
  intro d ζ hζ hcs hts
  show ∫ x in fcrHalf c r, fcrDQ a h φ x * partialDeriv d ζ x =
    -∫ x in fcrHalf c r, fcrDQ a h (Φ d) x * ζ x
  have hts' : tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c s := hts.trans (Metric.ball_subset_ball hrs')
  have hdc : Continuous (partialDeriv d ζ) := by
    unfold partialDeriv
    exact (hζ.continuous_fderiv (by norm_num)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hdcs : HasCompactSupport (partialDeriv d ζ) := HasCompactSupport.fderiv_apply ℝ hcs (e d)
  have hd0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → partialDeriv d ζ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have h0 : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hx (support_fderiv_subset ℝ (Function.mem_support.2 hne))
    simp only [partialDeriv, h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  have hz0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → ζ x = 0 := fun x hx => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
  
  have hζm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ζ (y - v)) := hζ.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hζm_eq : (fun y => ζ (y - v)) = ζ ∘ (Homeomorph.subRight v) := by
    funext y
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Homeomorph.subRight_apply]
  have hcsm : HasCompactSupport (fun y => ζ (y - v)) := by
    rw [hζm_eq]; exact hcs.comp_homeomorph _
  have htsm : tsupport (fun y => ζ (y - v)) ⊆ Metric.ball c s := by
    rw [hζm_eq, tsupport_comp_eq_preimage]
    intro y hy
    have h1 : y - v ∈ tsupport ζ := by
      have h3 : (Homeomorph.subRight v) y ∈ tsupport ζ := hy
      rwa [Homeomorph.subRight_apply] at h3
    have h2 := hball _ (hts h1)
    rw [sub_add_cancel] at h2
    exact h2
  have hdm : ∀ y, partialDeriv d (fun y => ζ (y - v)) y = partialDeriv d ζ (y - v) := by
    intro y
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [fderiv_comp_sub]
  
  have hwm := hglob d (fun y => ζ (y - v)) hζm hcsm htsm
  simp only [hdm] at hwm
  have hS2 := hglob d ζ hζ hcs hts'
  
  have cv1 : ∫ x, φb (x + v) * partialDeriv d ζ x = ∫ y, φb y * partialDeriv d ζ (y - v) := by
    have h1 := integral_add_right_eq_self (μ := volume)
      (fun y => φb y * partialDeriv d ζ (y - v)) v
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at h1
    exact h1
  have cv2 : ∫ x, Φb d (x + v) * ζ x = ∫ y, Φb d y * ζ (y - v) := by
    have h1 := integral_add_right_eq_self (μ := volume) (fun y => Φb d y * ζ (y - v)) v
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at h1
    exact h1
  
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hdc.bounded_above_of_compact_support hdcs
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hζ.continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hcs
  have I2 : Integrable (fun x => φb x * partialDeriv d ζ x) :=
    hφbI.mul_bdd hdc.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hC₁)
  have I4 : Integrable (fun x => Φb d x * ζ x) :=
    (hΦbI d).mul_bdd hζ.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hC₀)
  have I1' : Integrable (fun y => φb y * partialDeriv d ζ (y - v)) :=
    hφbI.mul_bdd (hdc.comp (continuous_sub_right v)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => hC₁ (y - v))
  have I3' : Integrable (fun y => Φb d y * ζ (y - v)) :=
    (hΦbI d).mul_bdd (hζ.continuous.comp (continuous_sub_right v)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => hC₀ (y - v))
  have I1 : Integrable (fun x => φb (x + v) * partialDeriv d ζ x) := by
    have h1 := I1'.comp_add_right v
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at h1
    exact h1
  have I3 : Integrable (fun x => Φb d (x + v) * ζ x) := by
    have h1 := I3'.comp_add_right v
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_right] at h1
    exact h1
  
  have e1 : (fun x => fcrDQ a h φb x * partialDeriv d ζ x) =
      fun x => h⁻¹ * (φb (x + v) * partialDeriv d ζ x - φb x * partialDeriv d ζ x) := by
    funext x; rw [hDQ]; ring
  have e2 : (fun x => fcrDQ a h (Φb d) x * ζ x) =
      fun x => h⁻¹ * (Φb d (x + v) * ζ x - Φb d x * ζ x) := by
    funext x; rw [hDQ]; ring
  have hW : ∫ x, fcrDQ a h φb x * partialDeriv d ζ x = -∫ x, fcrDQ a h (Φb d) x * ζ x := by
    rw [e1, e2, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_sub I1 I2, integral_sub I3 I4,
      cv1, cv2, hwm, hS2]
    ring
  
  have P : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ), (∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → g x = 0) → ∀ x,
      (fcrHalf c r).indicator (fun y => fcrDQ a h f y * g y) x =
        fcrDQ a h ((fcrHalf c s).indicator f) x * g x := by
    intro f g hg x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ fcrHalf c r
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      show fcrDQ a h f x * g x = _
      obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := hx
      have hxs : x ∈ fcrHalf c s := ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball hrs' hx1, hx2⟩
      have hxvs : x + v ∈ fcrHalf c s := by
        refine ⟨hball x hx1, ?_⟩
        show 0 < (x + v) 0
        rw [hx0]
        exact hx2
      rw [hDQ, hDQ, Set.indicator_of_mem hxs, Set.indicator_of_mem hxvs]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
      by_cases hgx : g x = 0
      · rw [hgx, mul_zero]
      · have hxt : x ∈ tsupport ζ := by
          by_contra hc
          exact hgx (hg x hc)
        have hxb : x ∈ Metric.ball c r := hts hxt
        have hneg : ¬ (0 < x 0) := fun hpos => hx ⟨hxb, hpos⟩
        have h1 : x ∉ fcrHalf c s := fun hm => hneg hm.2
        have h2 : x + v ∉ fcrHalf c s := by
          intro hm
          have h3 : 0 < (x + v) 0 := hm.2
          rw [hx0] at h3
          exact hneg h3
        rw [hDQ, Set.indicator_of_notMem h1, Set.indicator_of_notMem h2]
        ring
  
  have eL : ∫ x in fcrHalf c r, fcrDQ a h φ x * partialDeriv d ζ x =
      ∫ x, fcrDQ a h φb x * partialDeriv d ζ x := by
    rw [← integral_indicator (hmeas r)]
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [P φ _ hd0 x, hφb]
  have eR : ∫ x in fcrHalf c r, fcrDQ a h (Φ d) x * ζ x =
      ∫ x, fcrDQ a h (Φb d) x * ζ x := by
    rw [← integral_indicator (hmeas r)]
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [P (Φ d) ζ hz0 x, hΦb]
  rw [eL, eR]
  exact hW

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (m : E3 → ℝ) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ m) (φ : E3 → ℝ)
    (Φ : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hφ : MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hΦ : ∀ d, MemLp (Φ d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) (hzt : fdrZT c s φ Φ) :
    fdrZT c s (fun x => m x * φ x) (fun d x => partialDeriv d m x * φ x + m x * Φ d x)

signature.name: fdr_zt_smul
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (m : E3 → ℝ) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ m) (φ : E3 → ℝ)
    (Φ : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hφ : MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hΦ : ∀ d, MemLp (Φ d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) (hzt : fdrZT c s φ Φ) :
    fdrZT c s (fun x => m x * φ x) (fun d x => partialDeriv d m x * φ x + m x * Φ d x)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hpdsupp : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3),
      Function.support (fun x => partialDeriv a f x) ⊆ tsupport f := by
    intro f a x hx
    simp only [Function.mem_support, ne_eq] at hx
    apply tsupport_fderiv_subset (𝕜 := ℝ)
    apply subset_tsupport
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    intro h
    exact hx (by simp [partialDeriv, h])
  have hint : ∀ u g : E3 → ℝ, MemLp u 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) → Continuous g →
      HasCompactSupport g →
      Integrable (fun x => u x * g x) (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro u g hu hg hgc
    have hg2 : MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      (hg.memLp_of_hasCompactSupport hgc).restrict _
    exact hu.integrable_mul hg2
  intro d ζ hζ hζc hζs
  have hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => m x * ζ x) := hm.mul hζ
  have hηc : HasCompactSupport (fun x => m x * ζ x) := hζc.mul_left
  have hηs : tsupport (fun x => m x * ζ x) ⊆ Metric.ball c s :=
    (tsupport_mul_subset_right).trans hζs
  have hprod : ∀ x, partialDeriv d (fun y => m y * ζ y) x =
      partialDeriv d m x * ζ x + m x * partialDeriv d ζ x := by
    intro x
    have hmd : DifferentiableAt ℝ m x := hm.differentiable (by simp) x
    have hζd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x := hζ.differentiable (by simp) x
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hmd hζd]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have h0 : ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, φ x * partialDeriv d (fun y => m y * ζ y) x =
      -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, Φ d x * (m x * ζ x) := hzt d _ hη hηc hηs
  have hξ : Continuous (fun x => partialDeriv d m x * ζ x) :=
    ((hm.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const).mul hζ.continuous
  have i1 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * partialDeriv d (fun y => m y * ζ y) x)
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    refine hint φ _ hφ ?_ ?_
    · exact (hη.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    · exact hηc.mono' (hpdsupp _ d)
  have i2 : Integrable (fun x => φ x * (partialDeriv d m x * ζ x))
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    hint φ _ hφ hξ hζc.mul_left
  have i3 : Integrable (fun x => Φ d x * (m x * ζ x)) (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    hint (Φ d) _ (hΦ d) hη.continuous hηc
  have e1 : (fun x => m x * φ x * partialDeriv d ζ x) =
      fun x => φ x * partialDeriv d (fun y => m y * ζ y) x -
        φ x * (partialDeriv d m x * ζ x) := by
    funext x
    rw [hprod x]
    ring
  have e2 : (fun x => (partialDeriv d m x * φ x + m x * Φ d x) * ζ x) =
      fun x => φ x * (partialDeriv d m x * ζ x) + Φ d x * (m x * ζ x) := by
    funext x
    ring
  show ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, m x * φ x * partialDeriv d ζ x =
    -∫ x in fcrHalf c s, (partialDeriv d m x * φ x + m x * Φ d x) * ζ x
  rw [e1, e2, integral_sub i1 i2, integral_add i2 i3, h0]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R s s₂ s₃ : ℝ) (hs₂ : 0 < s₂) (h23 : s₂ < s₃) (h3s : s₃ ≤ s)
    (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fdrProb c s A w D G F) (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (Ψ : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hψ : MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₃)))
    (hΨ : ∀ d, MemLp (Ψ d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₃)))
    (hzt : fdrZT c s₃ ψ Ψ)
    (hψ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ → ψ x = 0)
    (hΨ0 : ∀ d x, x ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ → Ψ d x = 0) :
    ∫ x in fcrHalf c s,
      ((∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ b : Fin 3, A x d b * D [b] x) + G d x) * Ψ d x) + F x * ψ x) = 0

signature.name: fdr_h1_test
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R s s₂ s₃ : ℝ) (hs₂ : 0 < s₂) (h23 : s₂ < s₃) (h3s : s₃ ≤ s)
    (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fdrProb c s A w D G F) (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (Ψ : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hψ : MemLp ψ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₃)))
    (hΨ : ∀ d, MemLp (Ψ d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₃)))
    (hzt : fdrZT c s₃ ψ Ψ)
    (hψ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ → ψ x = 0)
    (hΨ0 : ∀ d x, x ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ → Ψ d x = 0) :
    ∫ x in fcrHalf c s,
      ((∑ d : Fin 3, ((∑ b : Fin 3, A x d b * D [b] x) + G d x) * Ψ d x) + F x * ψ x) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hopen : ∀ r : ℝ, IsOpen (fcrHalf c r) := fun r =>
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  have hmeas : ∀ r, MeasurableSet (fcrHalf c r) := fun r => (hopen r).measurableSet
  have hfin : ∀ r, IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c r)) := fun r =>
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr
      ((measure_mono (fun x hx => hx.1 : fcrHalf c r ⊆ Metric.ball c r)).trans_lt
        measure_ball_lt_top).ne
  have hF : MemLp F 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := hP.2.2.2.1
  
  have hind : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₃)) →
      (∀ x, x ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ → f x = 0) →
      MemLp ((fcrHalf c s₃).indicator f) 2 volume ∧ Integrable ((fcrHalf c s₃).indicator f) ∧
      (∀ t, t ∉ fcrHalf c s₂ → (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator f t = 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s, (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator f x = f x) := by
    intro f hf hf0
    haveI := hfin s₃
    refine ⟨(memLp_indicator_iff_restrict (hmeas s₃)).2 hf,
      (integrable_indicator_iff (hmeas s₃)).2 (hf.integrable (by norm_num)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      by_cases htb : t ∈ Metric.ball c s₂
      · have ht3 : t ∉ fcrHalf c s₃ := fun h => ht ⟨htb, h.2⟩
        exact Set.indicator_of_notMem ht3 f
      · exact Set.indicator_apply_eq_zero.2 (fun _ => hf0 t htb)
    · intro x hx
      by_cases hx3 : x ∈ fcrHalf c s₃
      · exact Set.indicator_of_mem hx3 f
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx3]
        have hxb : x ∉ Metric.ball c s₂ := fun hb =>
          hx3 ⟨Metric.ball_subset_ball h23.le hb, hx.2⟩
        exact (hf0 x hxb).symm
  
  have hconv : ∀ (r : ℝ) (u v : E3 → ℝ),
      ∫ x in fcrHalf c r, u x * v x = ∫ x, (fcrHalf c r).indicator u x * v x := by
    intro r u v
    rw [← integral_indicator (hmeas r)]
    congr 1
    funext x
    exact Set.indicator_mul_left _ u v
  
  have hext : ∀ (d : Fin 3) (ζ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      ∫ x, (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ x * partialDeriv d ζ x =
        -∫ x, (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) x * ζ x := by
    intro d ζ hζ hζc
    obtain ⟨χ, hχin, hχout⟩ : ∃ χ : ContDiffBump c,
        χ.rIn = (2 * s₂ + s₃) / 3 ∧ χ.rOut = (s₂ + 2 * s₃) / 3 :=

      fdrWeakEq c s V F →
      ∫ x in fcrHalf c s, ((∑ d : Fin 3, V d x * Ψ d x) + F x * ψ x) = 0 by
    exact key (fun d x => (∑ b : Fin 3, A x d b * D [b] x) + G d x) hV hP.2.2.2.2
  intro V hVL hEq
  
  have honetest : ∀ bm : ContDiffBump (0 : E3), s₂ + 3 * bm.rOut < s →
      ∫ x in fcrHalf c s,
        ((∑ d : Fin 3, V d x *
            fcrMoll bm (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) (t - (4 * bm.rOut) • e 0)) x) +
          F x * fcrMoll bm (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ (t - (4 * bm.rOut) • e 0)) x) = 0 := by
    intro bm hr3
    have hr := bm.rOut_pos
    obtain ⟨hψb2, -, hψbv, -⟩ := hind ψ hψ hψ0
    obtain ⟨hsm, hcs, hts, -⟩ := hmollT bm _ hψb2 hψbv hr3
    have hsob : fcrSob c (s + 4 * bm.rOut) 1
        (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ (t - (4 * bm.rOut) • e 0))
        (fun L => match L with
          | [] => fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ (t - (4 * bm.rOut) • e 0)
          | d :: _ => fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) (t - (4 * bm.rOut) • e 0)) := by
      refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro L hL
        rcases L with _ | ⟨d, _ | ⟨d', t⟩⟩
        · exact (hTL ((fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ) ((4 * bm.rOut) • e 0) hψb2).restrict _
        · exact (hTL ((fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d)) ((4 * bm.rOut) • e 0)
            (hind (Ψ d) (hΨ d) (hΨ0 d)).1).restrict _
        · simp at hL
      · intro L a hL ζ h1 h2 h3
        rcases L with _ | ⟨d', t⟩
        · exact htrans ((4 * bm.rOut) • e 0) a ζ h1 h2
        · simp at hL
    have hmd := fcr_moll_deriv c (s + 4 * bm.rOut) 1 _ _ hsob bm
    have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s, ∀ a : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a
            (fcrMoll bm (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ (t - (4 * bm.rOut) • e 0))) x =
          fcrMoll bm (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ a) (t - (4 * bm.rOut) • e 0)) x := by
      intro x hx a
      have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x 0 := hx.2
      have hxd : dist x c < s := hx.1
      have h : partialDeriv a (fcrMoll bm ((fcrHalf c (s + 4 * bm.rOut)).indicator
            (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ (t - (4 * bm.rOut) • e 0)))) x =
          fcrMoll bm ((fcrHalf c (s + 4 * bm.rOut)).indicator
            (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ a) (t - (4 * bm.rOut) • e 0))) x :=
        hmd.2 [a] (by simp) x (by linarith) (by
          show dist x c < s + 4 * bm.rOut - 3 * bm.rOut
          linarith)
      rw [hsuppT bm _ hψbv, hsuppT bm _ (hind (Ψ a) (hΨ a) (hΨ0 a)).2.2.1] at h
      exact h
    have hO : IsOpen {x : E3 | x 0 < bm.rOut} :=
      isOpen_lt (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous continuous_const
    have hface : ∃ O : Set E3, IsOpen O ∧ {x ∈ Metric.ball c s | x 0 = 0} ⊆ O ∧
        ∀ x ∈ O, fcrMoll bm (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ (t - (4 * bm.rOut) • e 0)) x = 0 :=
      ⟨_, hO, fun x hx => by
        show x 0 < bm.rOut
        rw [hx.2]; exact hr,
       fun x hx => hvanT bm _ hψbv x (Or.inl hx)⟩
    have h := hEq _ hsm hcs hts hface
    refine Eq.trans (setIntegral_congr_fun (hmeas s) (fun x hx => ?_)) h
    simp only [hderiv x hx]
  
  have hδ : 0 < (s - s₂) / 4 := div_pos (by linarith) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨bm, hbm⟩ : ∃ bm : ℕ → ContDiffBump (0 : E3),
      ∀ j, (bm j).rOut = (s - s₂) / 4 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) :=
    ⟨fun j => ⟨(s - s₂) / 4 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) / 2, (s - s₂) / 4 / ((j : ℝ) + 1),
      div_pos (div_pos hδ (Nat.cast_add_one_pos j)) two_pos,
      half_lt_self (div_pos hδ (Nat.cast_add_one_pos j))⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hb3 : ∀ j, s₂ + 3 * (bm j).rOut < s := by
    intro j
    have hj : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have := Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) j
      linarith
    have hle : (bm j).rOut ≤ (s - s₂) / 4 := by
      rw [hbm j]
      exact div_le_self hδ.le hj
    linarith
  have hblim : Tendsto (fun j => (bm j).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simp only [hbm]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
      (tendsto_atTop_add_const_right _ 1 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  
  obtain ⟨hψb2, hψb1, hψbv, hψbH⟩ := hind ψ hψ hψ0
  have hΨb := fun d => hind (Ψ d) (hΨ d) (hΨ0 d)
  have hVt : ∀ d, MemLp ((fcrHalf c s).indicator (V d)) 2 volume :=
    fun d => (memLp_indicator_iff_restrict (hmeas s)).2 (hVL d)
  have hFt : MemLp ((fcrHalf c s).indicator F) 2 volume :=
    (memLp_indicator_iff_restrict (hmeas s)).2 hF
  
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ, T = fun j =>
      (∑ d : Fin 3, ∫ x, (fcrHalf c s).indicator (V d) x *
        fcrMoll (bm j) (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) (t - (4 * (bm j).rOut) • e 0)) x) +
      ∫ x, (fcrHalf c s).indicator F x *
        fcrMoll (bm j) (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ (t - (4 * (bm j).rOut) • e 0)) x :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT : ∀ j, T j = 0 := by
    intro j
    rw [hTdef]
    have hmψ := (hmollT (bm j) _ hψb2 hψbv (hb3 j)).2.2.2
    have hmΨ := fun d => (hmollT (bm j) _ (hΨb d).1 (hΨb d).2.2.1 (hb3 j)).2.2.2
    have i1 : ∀ d, Integrable (fun x => V d x *
        fcrMoll (bm j) (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) (t - (4 * (bm j).rOut) • e 0)) x)
        (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      fun d => (hVL d).integrable_mul ((hmΨ d).restrict _)
    have i2 : Integrable (fun x => F x *
        fcrMoll (bm j) (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ (t - (4 * (bm j).rOut) • e 0)) x)
        (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
      hF.integrable_mul (hmψ.restrict _)
    have h := honetest (bm j) (hb3 j)
    rw [integral_add (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => i1 d)) i2,
      integral_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => i1 d)] at h
    refine Eq.trans ?_ h
    show (∑ d : Fin 3, ∫ x, (fcrHalf c s).indicator (V d) x *
        fcrMoll (bm j) (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) (t - (4 * (bm j).rOut) • e 0)) x) +
      ∫ x, (fcrHalf c s).indicator F x *
        fcrMoll (bm j) (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ (t - (4 * (bm j).rOut) • e 0)) x = _
    congr 1
    · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => (hconv _ _ _).symm)
    · exact (hconv _ _ _).symm
  
  have hlimΨ : ∀ d, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, (fcrHalf c s).indicator (V d) x *
      fcrMoll (bm j) (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) (t - (4 * (bm j).rOut) • e 0)) x)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, (fcrHalf c s).indicator (V d) x * (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) x)) :=
    fun d => hpairOut _ _ (hVt d) (hΨb d).1 (hΨb d).2.1 bm hblim
      (fun j => (hmollT (bm j) _ (hΨb d).1 (hΨb d).2.2.1 (hb3 j)).2.2.2)
  have hlimψ : Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, (fcrHalf c s).indicator F x *
      fcrMoll (bm j) (fun t => (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ (t - (4 * (bm j).rOut) • e 0)) x)
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, (fcrHalf c s).indicator F x * (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ x)) :=
    hpairOut _ _ hFt hψb2 hψb1 bm hblim
      (fun j => (hmollT (bm j) _ hψb2 hψbv (hb3 j)).2.2.2)
  have hsum : Tendsto T atTop
      (𝓝 ((∑ d : Fin 3, ∫ x, (fcrHalf c s).indicator (V d) x * (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) x) +
        ∫ x, (fcrHalf c s).indicator F x * (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ x)) := by
    rw [hTdef]
    exact (tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun d _ => hlimΨ d)).add hlimψ
  have hzero : Tendsto T atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    rw [show T = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) from funext hT]
    exact tendsto_const_nhds
  have hL := tendsto_nhds_unique hsum hzero
  
  have hΨbH : ∀ d, ∀ x ∈ fcrHalf c s, (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) x = Ψ d x :=
    fun d => (hΨb d).2.2.2
  rw [setIntegral_congr_fun (hmeas s) (g := fun x =>
      (∑ d : Fin 3, V d x * (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) x) +
        F x * (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ x) (fun x hx => by
      have h1 := hψbH x hx
      have h2 : ∀ d, (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) x = Ψ d x := fun d => hΨbH d x hx
      simp only [h1, h2])]
  have j1 : ∀ d, Integrable (fun x => V d x * (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator (Ψ d) x)
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    fun d => (hVL d).integrable_mul ((hΨb d).1.restrict _)
  have j2 : Integrable (fun x => F x * (fcrHalf c s₃).indicator ψ x)
      (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) :=
    hF.integrable_mul (hψb2.restrict _)
  rw [integral_add (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => j1 d)) j2,
    integral_finset_sum _ (fun d _ => j1 d)]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hL
  congr 1
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d _ => hconv _ _ _)
  · exact hconv _ _ _

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_moll_deriv
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
    (hD : fcrSob c ρ k w D) (b : ContDiffBump (0 : E3)) :
    (∀ L : List (Fin 3), ContDiff ℝ ∞ (L.foldr partialDeriv (fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator w)))) ∧
    ∀ L : List (Fin 3), L.length ≤ k → ∀ x : E3, -b.rOut < x 0 →
      x ∈ Metric.ball c (ρ - 3 * b.rOut) →
      L.foldr partialDeriv (fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator w)) x =
        fcrMoll b ((fcrHalf c ρ).indicator (D L)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_moll_L2
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(b : ContDiffBump (0 : E3)) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : MemLp f 2 volume) (S : Set E3) :
    ∫ x in S, (fcrMoll b f x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x, (f x) ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_moll_weak_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(g : E3 → ℝ) (hg : Integrable g) (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ)
    (hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ) (b : ℕ → ContDiffBump (0 : E3))
    (hb : Tendsto (fun j => (b j).rOut) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, fcrMoll (b j) g x * ψ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, g x * ψ x))

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (β u : M → ℝ) (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β)
    (hβr : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0)
    (Ω : Set M) (hΩ : IsClosed Ω) (hΩβ : ∀ p ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ β p)
    (A : Set ℝ) (hA : IsCompact A)
    (hreg : ∀ p ∈ Ω, u p ∈ A → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0)
    (q : M) (φ : M → ℝ) (hφ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ)
    (hφc : IsCompact (tsupport φ)) (hφs : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ A,
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → |sclBulk g β u q φ Ω t s| ≤ C) ∧
      Tendsto (fun s => sclBulk g β u q φ Ω t s) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
        (𝓝 (sclBulkLim g u q φ Ω t))

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)

    (hφc : IsCompact (tsupport φ)) (hφs : tsupport φ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) :

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hDCT : ∀ (μ : Measure E3) (E : Set E3) (kk bb : E3 → ℝ) (Bk : ℝ), MeasurableSet E →
      μ E < ⊤ → ContinuousOn kk E → ContinuousOn bb E → (∀ y ∈ E, 0 ≤ bb y) →
      (∀ y ∈ E, |kk y| ≤ Bk) → μ (E ∩ bb ⁻¹' {0}) = 0 →
      (∀ s : ℝ, ‖∫ y in E, Real.smoothTransition (bb y / s) * kk y ∂μ‖ ≤ Bk * μ.real E) ∧
      Tendsto (fun s => ∫ y in E, Real.smoothTransition (bb y / s) * kk y ∂μ) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
        (𝓝 (∫ y in E, kk y ∂μ)) := by
    intro μ E kk bb Bk hE hμE hkk hbb hbb0 hkB hnul
    have hpt : ∀ s : ℝ, ∀ y ∈ E, ‖Real.smoothTransition (bb y / s) * kk y‖ ≤ Bk := by
      intro s y hy
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)]
      exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) (Real.smoothTransition.le_one _)).trans
        (hkB y hy)
    refine ⟨fun s => norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const hμE (hpt s), ?_⟩
    refine tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun _ => Bk) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s =>
        ((Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp_continuousOn (hbb.div_const s)).mul
          hkk).aestronglyMeasurable hE
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s =>
        (ae_restrict_iff' hE).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y hy => hpt s y hy)
    · exact integrableOn_const hμE.ne
    · have hae : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, y ∉ E ∩ bb ⁻¹' {0} := measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem.mp hnul
      refine (ae_restrict_iff' hE).mpr (hae.mono fun y hy hyE => ?_)
      have hbpos : 0 < bb y := by
        rcases (hbb0 y hyE).lt_or_eq with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact (hy ⟨hyE, h.symm⟩).elim
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hbpos] with s hs
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le ((one_le_div hs.1).mpr hs.2.le), one_mul]
  
  have hcl : ∀ t : ℝ, IsClosed (Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}) := fun t =>
    hΩ.inter (isClosed_singleton.preimage hu.continuous)
  have hKc : IsCompact (tsupport φ ∩ Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' A) :=
    (hφc.inter_right hΩ).inter_right (hA.isClosed.preimage hu.continuous)
  have hKsrc : tsupport φ ∩ Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' A ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source := fun p hp => hφs hp.1.1
  obtain ⟨Z, hZdef⟩ : ∃ Z : Set E3, Z = chartAt E3 q '' (tsupport φ ∩ Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' A) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hZc : IsCompact Z := by
    rw [hZdef]
    exact hKc.image_of_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn.mono hKsrc)
  have hZT : Z ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    rw [hZdef]
    rintro y ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hKsrc hp)
  have hZu : ∀ y ∈ Z, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hZdef]
    rintro y ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv (hKsrc hp)]
    exact hreg p hp.1.2 hp.2
  
  obtain ⟨hfs, hgrad, hcont⟩ := chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu q
  have hbs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    (chart_pullback_gradInner g β hβ q).1
  have hpos : ∀ y ∈ Z, 0 < g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hgrad y (hZT hy)]
    exact chart_Nsq_pos g u hu q y (hZT hy) (hZu y hy)
  have hind := fun y (hy : y ∈ Z) =>
    stern_bad_chart_indep g β u hβ hβr hu hneu q y (hZT hy) (hpos y hy)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k : E3 → ℝ, k = fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
      sternGaussM g u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
      sbgbAreaDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : E3 → ℝ, b = fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hkc : ContinuousOn k Z := by
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) Z :=
      hφ.continuous.comp_continuousOn ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn_symm.mono hZT)
    have h2 : ContinuousOn (fun y => sternGaussM g u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) Z :=
      (stern_gauss_chart g u hu q).mono (fun y hy => ⟨hZT hy, hZu y hy⟩)
    have hnum : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det *
        Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
          (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y)) (chartAt E3 q).target := by
      refine hcont.congr fun y hy => ?_
      show _ = Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      rw [hgrad y hy]
      rfl
    have hden : ContinuousOn (fun y => ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y‖)
        (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      continuous_norm.comp_continuousOn
        (hfs.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (chartAt E3 q).open_target (by simp))
    have h3 : ContinuousOn (fun y => sbgbAreaDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
        (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) Z := by
      refine (((continuousOn_const : ContinuousOn (fun _ : E3 => sbgbAreaConst) Z).mul
        (hnum.mono hZT)).div (hden.mono hZT)
          fun y hy => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hind y hy).1).congr fun y _ => ?_
      simp only [sbgbAreaDens, Pi.div_apply]
      ring
    rw [hk]
    exact (h1.mul h2).mul h3
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ := hZc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hkc
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = max B₀ 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by rw [hBdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hkB : ∀ y ∈ Z, |k y| ≤ B := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hBdef, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (hB₀ y hy).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have h1le : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by simp

by

    rcases not_and_or.mp hcon with h | h
    · push_neg at h

        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos h]; exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg y
      exact IsLocalMin.deriv_eq_zero (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hmin)
    · push_neg at h
      have hmax : ∀ y, Real.smoothTransition y ≤ Real.smoothTransition x := fun y => by
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le h]; exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one y
      exact IsLocalMax.deriv_eq_zero (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hmax)
  
  have hmeasP : ∀ (V : Set E3) (F : E3 → ℝ) (K : Set ℝ), IsOpen V → ContinuousOn F V →
      IsClosed K → MeasurableSet (V ∩ F ⁻¹' K) := by

      ext y

    rw [h1]

  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    (chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu q).1
  have hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    (chart_pullback_gradInner g β hβ q).1
  
  have hGram : ∀ (G : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 3, G i j = G j i) → G.det ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (a c : Fin 3 → ℝ), ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G k l *
        (![a 1 * c 2 - a 2 * c 1, a 2 * c 0 - a 0 * c 2, a 0 * c 1 - a 1 * c 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) k *
        (![a 1 * c 2 - a 2 * c 1, a 2 * c 0 - a 0 * c 2, a 0 * c 1 - a 1 * c 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) l =
      G.det * ((∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * a i * a j) *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * c i * c j) -
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * a i * c j) ^ 2) := by
    intro G hs hd a c
    have hinv : G⁻¹ = G.det⁻¹ • G.adjugate := by
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    have hS : ∀ v w : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * v i * w j =

      intro v w
      rw [hinv, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
      simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have h10 := hs 1 0
    have h20 := hs 2 0
    have h21 := hs 2 1
    have poly : G.det * (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G k l *
        (![a 1 * c 2 - a 2 * c 1, a 2 * c 0 - a 0 * c 2, a 0 * c 1 - a 1 * c 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) k *
        (![a 1 * c 2 - a 2 * c 1, a 2 * c 0 - a 0 * c 2, a 0 * c 1 - a 1 * c 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) l) =
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G.adjugate i j * a i * a j) *
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G.adjugate i j * c i * c j) -

signature.statement:

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hspec := sbgb_area_const_spec
  have hc : 0 < sbgbAreaConst := hspec.1
  
  have hlin := sbgb_linear_area hspec
  have hloc := fun x₀ hx₀ ε hε hε1 =>
    sbgb_local_compare hlin F W hW hF hdF x₀ hx₀ ε hε hε1
  have hmeas : ∀ T : Set E2, MeasurableSet T → T ⊆ W →
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (F '' T) =
        ∫⁻ x in T, ENNReal.ofReal
          (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2)) :=
    fun T hT hTW => sbgb_measure_form hc F W hW hinj hF.continuousOn hloc T hT hTW
  
  set ρ : E2 → ℝ := fun x => sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2)
    with hρdef
  have hρnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x := fun x => mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have htan : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (j : Fin 3), Measurable (fun x => gsTan F i x j) := by
    intro i j
    have h1 : Measurable (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) := measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ F _
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.measurable.comp h1
  have hρm : Measurable ρ := by
    have hsum : Measurable (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) := by
      have e1 : (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) = fun x =>
          (gsTan F 0 x 1 * gsTan F 1 x 2 - gsTan F 0 x 2 * gsTan F 1 x 1) ^ 2 +
          (gsTan F 0 x 2 * gsTan F 1 x 0 - gsTan F 0 x 0 * gsTan F 1 x 2) ^ 2 +
          (gsTan F 0 x 0 * gsTan F 1 x 1 - gsTan F 0 x 1 * gsTan F 1 x 0) ^ 2 := by
        funext x
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, gsCrossN]
      rw [e1]
      have a01 := htan 0 1; have a02 := htan 0 2; have a00 := htan 0 0
      have b01 := htan 1 1; have b02 := htan 1 2; have b00 := htan 1 0
      exact ((((a01.mul b02).sub (a02.mul b01)).pow_const 2).add
        (((a02.mul b00).sub (a00.mul b02)).pow_const 2)).add
        (((a00.mul b01).sub (a01.mul b00)).pow_const 2)
    exact measurable_const.mul hsum.sqrt
  have he : MeasurableEmbedding (W'.restrict F) :=
    ContinuousOn.measurableEmbedding hW' (hF.continuousOn.mono hW'W) (hinj.mono hW'W)
  set μ' : MeasureTheory.Measure W' := MeasureTheory.Measure.comap Subtype.val MeasureTheory.volume
    with hμ'
  set f : W' → NNReal := fun x => (ρ x).toNNReal with hfdef
  have hf : Measurable f := (hρm.comp measurable_subtype_coe).real_toNNReal
  have key : MeasureTheory.Measure.map (W'.restrict F) (μ'.withDensity (fun x => (f x : ENNReal))) =
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)).restrict (F '' W') := by
    ext B hB
    rw [he.map_apply, MeasureTheory.withDensity_apply _ (he.measurable hB),
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply hB]
    have hT : Subtype.val '' ((W'.restrict F) ⁻¹' B) = W' ∩ F ⁻¹' B := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨y.2, hy⟩
      · rintro ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
        exact ⟨⟨x, hx1⟩, hx2, rfl⟩
    have hTm : MeasurableSet (W' ∩ F ⁻¹' B) := by
      rw [← hT]
      exact (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hW').measurableSet_image' (he.measurable hB)
    have h1 : ∫⁻ x in (W'.restrict F) ⁻¹' B, (f x : ENNReal) ∂μ' =
        ∫⁻ x in (W'.restrict F) ⁻¹' B, (fun y : E2 => ENNReal.ofReal (ρ y)) (x : E2) ∂μ' := rfl
    rw [h1, hμ', MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_subtype hW' _ (fun y : E2 => ENNReal.ofReal (ρ y)), hT,
      ← hmeas (W' ∩ F ⁻¹' B) hTm (Set.inter_subset_left.trans hW'W),
      Set.image_inter_preimage, Set.inter_comm]
  calc ∫ y in F '' W', h y ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))
      = ∫ y, h y ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.map (W'.restrict F)
          (μ'.withDensity (fun x => (f x : ENNReal)))) := by rw [key]
    _ = ∫ x : W', h (W'.restrict F x) ∂(μ'.withDensity (fun x => (f x : ENNReal))) :=
        he.integral_map h
    _ = ∫ x : W', f x • h (W'.restrict F x) ∂μ' :=
        integral_withDensity_eq_integral_smul hf _
    _ = ∫ x : W', (fun y : E2 => ρ y * h (F y)) (x : E2) ∂μ' := by
        congr 1
        funext x
        simp only [hfdef, NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (hρnn x),
          Set.restrict_apply]
    _ = ∫ x in W', ρ x * h (F x) := by
        rw [hμ']
        exact MeasureTheory.integral_subtype_comap hW' (fun y : E2 => ρ y * h (F y))
    _ = sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * ∫ x in W', h (F x) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) := by
        rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
        congr 1
        funext x
        simp only [hρdef]
        ring
