  have hSf0 := chart_Nsq_pos g u hu z (F x) hy0 (hreg x hx)
  have hSb0 := chart_Nsq_pos g β hβ z (F x) hy0 (hβr _ hβx)
  set G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm with hGdef
  set f : E3 → ℝ := fun y => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) with hfdef
  set b : E3 → ℝ := fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) with hbdef
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) (chartAt E3 z).target :=
    fun i j => g.smooth z i j
  have hGsym : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i := fun y i j => g.symm _ _ _
  have hGpd : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, (G y).PosDef :=
    fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g z y hy
  have hfd : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y := fun y hy =>
    (hfs.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hbd : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, DifferentiableAt ℝ b y := fun y hy =>
    (hbs.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hSf : 0 < gradSqLoc G f (F x) := hSf0
  have hSb : 0 < gradSqLoc G b (F x) := hSb0
  
  have hneuV : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, b y = 0 → gradInnerLoc G f b y = 0 := by
    intro y hy hby
    have h1 : g.gradInner u β ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) = gradInnerLoc G f b y :=
      edge_gradInner_chart g u β z y hy (hfd y hy) (hbd y hy)
    rw [← h1]
    exact hneu _ hby
  have hαγ : gradInnerLoc G f b (F x) = 0 := hneuV (F x) hy0 hβx
  
  have hlmc : levelMeanCurvCoord G b (F x) = 0 :=
    (edge_lmc_chart g β hβ z (F x) hy0).symm.trans (hmin _ hβx)
  have hQ4 : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b' : Fin 3,
      (G (F x))⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a b (F x) * ((G (F x))⁻¹ j b' * partialDeriv b' b (F x)) *
        hessLoc G b i j (F x)) = hessGGLoc G b b (F x) := by
    simp only [hessGGLoc, gradUpLoc, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have h1 : lapLoc G b (F x) / Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G b (F x)) -
      hessGGLoc G b b (F x) / Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G b (F x)) ^ 3 = 0 := by
    rw [← hQ4]
    exact hlmc
  have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G b (F x)) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hSb
  have hr2 : Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G b (F x)) ^ 2 = gradSqLoc G b (F x) := Real.sq_sqrt hSb.le
  have hA4 : lapLoc G b (F x) = hessGGLoc G b b (F x) / gradSqLoc G b (F x) := by
    rw [sub_eq_zero, div_eq_div_iff hr.ne' (pow_ne_zero 3 hr.ne')] at h1
    rw [eq_div_iff hSb.ne']
    have h3 : (lapLoc G b (F x) * Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G b (F x)) ^ 2 - hessGGLoc G b b (F x)) *
        Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G b (F x)) = 0 := by linear_combination h1
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h3 with h | h
    · rw [hr2] at h; linarith
    · exact absurd h hr.ne'
  
  have h5 := edge_sqrt_neumann G (chartAt E3 z).target hΩo hGs hGsym hGpd f b hfs hbs hneuV (F x)
    hy0 hβx hSb hSf
  have hev : (fun y' => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y'))) =ᶠ[𝓝 (F x)]
      (fun y' => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y')) := by
    filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hy0] with y hy
    exact congrArg Real.sqrt (hfgrad y hy)
  have hW'd : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y' => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y'))) (F x) :=
    h5.1.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hs1 : g.gradInner β (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u y)) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) =
      gradInnerLoc G b (fun y' => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y'))) (F x) :=
    edge_gradInner_chart g β (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u y)) z (F x) hy0 (hbd _ hy0) hW'd
  have hgieq : gradInnerLoc G b (fun y' => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')))
      (F x) = gradInnerLoc G b (fun y' => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y')) (F x) := by
    unfold gradInnerLoc partialDeriv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hden : g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = gradSqLoc G f (F x) := hfgrad _ hy0
  have hL : g.gradInner β (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u y)) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) /
      Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) =
      -(hessGGLoc G b f (F x) / gradSqLoc G f (F x)) := by
    rw [hs1, hgieq, hden]
    exact h5.2
  
  have hT : ∀ cc : Fin 2 → ℝ, (∀ k : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 2, cc a * gsTan F a x k = 0) → cc = 0 := by
    intro cc hc
    have hv : fderiv ℝ F x (∑ a : Fin 2, cc a • e2 a) = 0 := by
      ext k
      have h1 := hc k
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, gsTan] at h1
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using h1
    have hv0 : (∑ a : Fin 2, cc a • e2 a) = 0 := hinj x hx (by rw [hv, map_zero])
    funext a
    have h2 := congrArg (fun v : E2 => v a) hv0
    fin_cases a <;> simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h2
  have hconst : (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => c) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hlev y hy)
  have h6f := edge_hess2_chain G (chartAt E3 z).target hΩo f hfs F W hW hF hFt x hx
  have hαT : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k f (F x) * gsTan F a x k = 0 := by
    intro a
    have e : pd2 a (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k f (F x) * gsTan F a x k := h6f.1 x hx a
    rw [← e]
    unfold pd2
    rw [hconst.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have hα : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k f (F x)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h' : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k f (F x) = 0 := fun k => congrFun h0 k
    have : gradSqLoc G f (F x) = 0 := by
      simp only [gradSqLoc, gradInnerLoc, h', mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    linarith
  have hsplit : ∀ p q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * p i * q j =
      ∑ a₁ : Fin 2, ∑ c₁ : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a₁ c₁ *
          (∑ k : Fin 3, p k * gsTan F a₁ x k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, q k * gsTan F c₁ x k) +
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f (F x) * p j) *
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f (F x) * q j) /
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
            (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i f (F x) * partialDeriv j f (F x)) :=
    edge_dual_split (G (F x)) (hGsym (F x)) (hGpd (F x) hy0) (fun a k => gsTan F a x k) hT
      (fun k => partialDeriv k f (F x)) hαT hα
  
  have hdet : (G (F x)).det ≠ 0 := (hGpd _ hy0).det_pos.ne'
  have hK := gge_koszul_tangent G (chartAt E3 z).target hΩo hGs hGsym hGpd F W hW hF hFt x hx
  have h6b := edge_hess2_chain G (chartAt E3 z).target hΩo b hbs F W hW hF hFt x hx
  have e1 : ∀ m : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x) * gsTan F m x k := fun m => h6b.1 x hx m
  have hD : ∀ a c' : Fin 2, gsCovD1 (pullMetric2 G F)
      (fun j y => pd2 j (fun y' => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y'))) y) a c' x =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, gsTan F a x k * gsTan F c' x l * hessLoc G b k l (F x) := by
    intro a c'
    have e2' : pd2 a (fun x' => pd2 c' (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x') x =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, gsTan F a x k * gsTan F c' x l * hessLoc G b k l (F x) +
          ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x) * gsCovHess G F a c' x k := h6b.2 a c'
    have e7 : ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x) * gsCovHess G F a c' x k =
        ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) m a c' x *
          ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x) * gsTan F m x k :=
      edge_tangential_proj G F x hdet (fun k => partialDeriv k f (F x))
        (fun k => partialDeriv k b (F x)) a c' (fun m => hK m a c') hsplit hαγ
    show pd2 a (fun x' => pd2 c' (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x') x -
      ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) m a c' x *
        pd2 m (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x = _
    rw [e2', e7]
    simp only [e1]
    ring
  
  have hreg2 := gs_regularity G (chartAt E3 z).target hΩo hGs hGsym hGpd F W hW hF hFt hinj
  have hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) W :=
    hbs.comp hF (fun y hy => hFt y hy)
  have hAinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j = (G (F x))⁻¹ j i := by
    intro i j
    have hT' : Matrix.transpose (G (F x)) = G (F x) := by
      ext i' j'
      exact hGsym _ j' i'
    rw [← Matrix.transpose_apply ((G (F x))⁻¹) i j, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hT']
  have h8 := edge_trace_linalg (G (F x)) hAinv (pullMetric2 G F x) (fun a k => gsTan F a x k)
    (fun k => partialDeriv k f (F x)) (fun k => partialDeriv k b (F x))
    (fun k l => hessLoc G b k l (F x)) hsplit hαγ
  have h8a : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c' : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a c' *
      (∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x) * gsTan F a x k) *
      (∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x) * gsTan F c' x k) = gradSqLoc G b (F x) := h8.1
  have h8b : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c' : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a c' *
        (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, gsTan F a x k * gsTan F c' x l * hessLoc G b k l (F x)) -
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c' : Fin 2,
        (∑ d : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a d *
          ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x) * gsTan F d x k) *
        (∑ d : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ c' d *
          ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x) * gsTan F d x k) *
        (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, gsTan F a x k * gsTan F c' x l * hessLoc G b k l (F x))) /
        gradSqLoc G b (F x) =
      lapLoc G b (F x) - hessGGLoc G b b (F x) / gradSqLoc G b (F x) -
        hessGGLoc G b f (F x) / gradSqLoc G f (F x) := h8.2
  have hgs2 : sgbGradSq2 (pullMetric2 G F) (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x =
      gradSqLoc G b (F x) := by
    unfold sgbGradSq2
    simp only [e1]
    exact h8a
  have hQ : 0 < sgbGradSq2 (pullMetric2 G F) (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x := by
    rw [hgs2]; exact hSb
  have h3 := edge_curv2_formula (pullMetric2 G F) W hW hreg2.1 hreg2.2.1 hreg2.2.2.1
    (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) hw x hx hQ
  have hcancel : Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G b (F x)) *
      (hessGGLoc G b f (F x) / gradSqLoc G f (F x) / Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G b (F x))) =
      hessGGLoc G b f (F x) / gradSqLoc G f (F x) := by
    rw [mul_comm]; exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hr.ne'
  rw [hL, h3, hgs2]
  simp only [hD]
  simp only [e1]
  rw [h8b, hA4, sub_self, zero_sub, neg_div, neg_neg, hcancel]

subgoal_signatures.name: edge_gradInner_chart
subgoal_signatures.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u w : M → ℝ) (z : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target) (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y) (hw : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y) : g.gradInner u w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) = gradInnerLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y

subgoal_signatures.name: edge_lmc_chart
subgoal_signatures.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (β : M → ℝ) (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β) (z : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target) : g.levelMeanCurv β ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y

subgoal_signatures.name: edge_curv2_formula
subgoal_signatures.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (O : Set E2) (hO : IsOpen O) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a b) O) (hsym : ∀ y ∈ O, ∀ a b : Fin 2, h y a b = h y b a) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ O, (h y).PosDef) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w O) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ O) (hQ : 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x) : sgbLevelCurv2 h w x = -((∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * gsCovD1 h (fun j y => pd2 j w y) a c x - (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a d * pd2 d w x) * (∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ c d * pd2 d w x) * gsCovD1 h (fun j y => pd2 j w y) a c x) / sgbGradSq2 h w x) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h w x))

subgoal_signatures.name: gs_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U) (hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).PosDef) (F : E2 → E3) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F s) (hFU : ∀ x ∈ s, F x ∈ U) (hinj : ∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pullMetric2 G F x i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, pullMetric2 G F x i j = pullMetric2 G F x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, (pullMetric2 G F x).PosDef) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSff G F i j) s) ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, gsSff G F i j x = gsSff G F j i x) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gsSffSq G F) s ∧ (∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ gsSffSq G F x)

subgoal_signatures.name: edge_sqrt_neumann
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ V, (G y).PosDef) (f b : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b V) (hneuV : ∀ z ∈ V, b z = 0 → gradInnerLoc G f b z = 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ V) (hby : b y = 0) (hdb : 0 < gradSqLoc G b y) (hdf : 0 < gradSqLoc G f y) : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f z)) y ∧ gradInnerLoc G b (fun z => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f z)) y / Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y) = -(hessGGLoc G b f y / gradSqLoc G f y)

subgoal_signatures.name: edge_hess2_chain
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) (b : E3 → ℝ) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b V) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFV : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ V) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : (∀ x' ∈ W, ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => b (F y)) x' = ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x') * gsTan F c x' k) ∧ (∀ a c : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => pd2 c (fun y => b (F y)) x') x = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, gsTan F a x k * gsTan F c x l * hessLoc G b k l (F x) + ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x) * gsCovHess G F a c x k)

subgoal_signatures.name: edge_tangential_proj
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hdet : (G (F x)).det ≠ 0) (α γ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a c : Fin 2) (hkos : ∀ m : Fin 2, ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) m a c x = ∑ a' : Fin 3, ∑ b' : Fin 3, gsTan F m x a' * G (F x) a' b' * gsCovHess G F a c x b') (hsplit : ∀ p q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * p i * q j = ∑ a₁ : Fin 2, ∑ c₁ : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a₁ c₁ * (∑ k : Fin 3, p k * gsTan F a₁ x k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, q k * gsTan F c₁ x k) + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * p j) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * q j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * α j)) (hαγ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * γ j = 0) : ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * gsCovHess G F a c x k = ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) m a c x * ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * gsTan F m x k

subgoal_signatures.name: edge_trace_linalg

def pcgbPoleRad {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (j₀ : Fin P.n) (x₀ x : E2) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, P.h j₀ x₀ a c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) c)


structure PcgbGreenData {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X}
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (b : X → ℝ) where
  p₀ : X
  j₀ : Fin P.n
  x₀ : E2
  r : ℝ
  C : ℝ
  U : Set X
  w : X → ℝ
  r_pos : 0 < r
  C_nonneg : 0 ≤ C
  U_open : IsOpen U
  R_sub : {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} ⊆ U
  param_x₀ : P.param j₀ x₀ = p₀
  ball_sub : Metric.closedBall x₀ r ⊆ P.W j₀
  ball_pos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r, 2 * r ≤ b (P.param j₀ x)
  smooth : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀}))
  harm : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ b (P.param j x) → P.param j x ≠ p₀ →
    lap2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x = 0
  dirichlet : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) = 0 →
    w (P.param j x) = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x ≠ 0
  neg : ∀ q ∈ S, 0 < b q → q ≠ p₀ → w q < 0
  pole : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, x ≠ x₀ →
    |w (P.param j₀ x) - Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ x)| ≤ C ∧
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => w (P.param j₀ y) - Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y)) x‖ ≤ C ∧
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => w (P.param j₀ y) - Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y))) x‖ ≤
      C / pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ x


def pcgbDefect {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (b w : X → ℝ) (ε s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x *
    (ε / (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x + ε)))


def pcgbCollarErr {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (b w : X → ℝ) (ε s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
    (Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x) *
        sgbLevelCurv2 (P.h j) (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x -
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x *
        pd2 c (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          Real.log (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun z => w (P.param j z)) y + ε)) x))

search_metadata.last_error: Commit gate approved. The four children close the target with the glue as written: CGB <= 2pi + D + E for s < s1, where s1 does not depend on eps; D <= theta/2 uniformly in s; E <= theta/2 once eps is fixed and s is then taken small. linarith consumes every child and Gd, so no binding is decorative. The [CRUX] (blueprint s1, Green function with log pole, Dirichlet/Hopf, w<0, pole expansion with |D^2 v| <= C/r0, which is the correct rate) sits isolated in pcgb_green_function through the PcgbGreenData structure, which is a good API boundary. The divergence from the blueprint is documented in findings: glue s7 is split along its three limits, with s3+s4 under main_inequality, s5 under defect_small and s2+s6 under collar_error_small. That arrangement avoids a flattened chain. Each child is true by my check and strictly easier: Kato gives K*eta_s <= eta_s*lap2 L^eps + Kato loss, and the pole flux gives 2pi; the defect is bounded by a(eps) and goes to 0 by DCT once the critical set is null; the collar mismatch vanishes on {b=0} by the s2 identity (both sides equal -Hess b(tau,tau)) and is O(eps) where |dw| >= c, and thin-band volume O(s) cancels s^-1. Blueprint sections 4 and 5 carry numerical checks and adversarial cases. Nothing restates a section 10 lemma or an ancestor.

def sspGood (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : EndChart M) (β u : M → ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3)
    (R₁ L t σ₀ δ₀ : ℝ) (S : Set M) (P : EigPatchedSurface M S) (ρ : Fin P.n → M → ℝ)
    (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2) (b : M → ℝ) (js : Fin P.n) : Prop :=
  (∀ i z, 0 ≤ ρ i z) ∧
  (∀ i j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ i (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
  (∀ i, IsCompact (Kc i) ∧ Kc i ⊆ P.W i) ∧
  (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ P.W i, x ∉ Kc i → ρ i (P.param i x) = 0) ∧
  (∀ i z, z ∉ P.O i → ρ i z = 0) ∧
  (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) ∧
  IsCompact {z | z ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b z} ∧
  IsConnected {z | z ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b z} ∧
  (∀ z, z ∈ S → 0 ≤ b z → ∑ i, ρ i z = 1) ∧
  (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ P.W i, b (P.param i x) = 0 →
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => b (P.param i y)) x ≠ 0) ∧
  (∃ z ∈ S, b z = 0) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ S, u z = t ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u z ≠ 0) ∧
  {z | z ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b z} = sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∧
  0 < σ₀ ∧ 0 < δ₀ ∧ R₁ ^ 2 < L ^ 2 - 2 * δ₀ ∧ σ₀ < δ₀ ∧
  (∀ j (q' : M),
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => chartAt E3 q' (P.param j x))
      (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source,
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (P.param j y)) x) ∧
      P.h j x = pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm)
        (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (P.param j y)) x) ∧
  (∀ j, Set.InjOn (P.param j) (P.W j)) ∧
  (∀ j, j ≠ js → ∃ (z : M) (F : E2 → E3), eigSurfParam S z (P.W j) F ∧
    (∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x = (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ∧
    P.h j = pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F) ∧
  (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x = sternGaussM g u (P.param j x)) ∧
  P.W js = {x : E2 | L ^ 2 - 2 * δ₀ < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ∧ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 < L ^ 2 + δ₀ / 2} ∧
  (∀ x ∈ P.W js, P.param js x = sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) ∧
    P.h js x = sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t x ∧ σ₀ ≤ β (P.param js x)) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ P.W js, L ^ 2 - δ₀ ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → b (P.param js x) = sgbSideDef L x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ P.W js, L ^ 2 - δ₀ ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 →
    ρ js (P.param js x) = 1) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ S, b z < σ₀ → β z < σ₀ ∨
    ∃ x ∈ P.W js, P.param js x = z ∧ L ^ 2 - δ₀ ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ S, β z < σ₀ → (∀ᶠ z' in 𝓝 z, b z' = β z') ∧ ρ js z = 0)

      (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) : MeasureTheory.Measure E2) S := by
    intro S
    have h := (PiLp.lipschitzWith_ofLp 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ)).hausdorffMeasure_image_le
      (d := 2) (by norm_num) S
    calc MeasureTheory.volume S
        = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) :
            MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ((WithLp.ofLp : E2 → (Fin 2 → ℝ)) '' S) :=
          (htrans S).symm
      _ ≤ ((1 : NNReal) : ENNReal) ^ (2 : ℝ) *
            (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) : MeasureTheory.Measure E2) S := h
      _ = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) : MeasureTheory.Measure E2) S := by
          simp
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : NNReal, AntilipschitzWith K (WithLp.ofLp : E2 → (Fin 2 → ℝ)) :=
    ⟨_, PiLp.antilipschitzWith_ofLp 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ)⟩
  have hup : ∀ S : Set E2,
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) : MeasureTheory.Measure E2) S ≤
        (K : ENNReal) ^ (2 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume S := by
    intro S
    have h := hK.le_hausdorffMeasure_image (d := 2) (by norm_num) S
    rw [htrans] at h
    exact h
  have hKfin : (K : ENNReal) ^ (2 : ℝ) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg (by norm_num) ENNReal.coe_ne_top
  haveI : MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) : MeasureTheory.Measure E2) :=
    ⟨fun Kc hKc => lt_of_le_of_lt (hup Kc)
      (ENNReal.mul_lt_top hKfin.lt_top hKc.measure_lt_top)⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l : NNReal,
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) : MeasureTheory.Measure E2) =
        l • MeasureTheory.volume :=
    ⟨_, MeasureTheory.Measure.isAddLeftInvariant_eq_smul _ _⟩
  have hμS : ∀ S : Set E2,
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) : MeasureTheory.Measure E2) S =
        (l : ENNReal) * MeasureTheory.volume S := by
    intro S
    rw [hl, MeasureTheory.Measure.coe_nnreal_smul_apply]
  have hB : (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E2) (Metric.ball 0 1) =
      ENNReal.ofReal Real.pi := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.volume_ball_fin_two]
    simp
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h1 := hlow (Metric.ball 0 1)
    rw [hμS, h0, hB, ENNReal.coe_zero, zero_mul] at h1
    exact absurd (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr Real.pi_pos) (not_lt.mpr h1)
  have hlpos : (0 : ℝ) < l :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne l.2 (Ne.symm (NNReal.coe_ne_zero.mpr hl0))
  have hconst : sbgbAreaConst = ((l : ℝ))⁻¹ := by
    unfold sbgbAreaConst
    rw [hμS, hB, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.coe_toReal,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal Real.pi_pos.le, div_mul_cancel_right₀ Real.pi_ne_zero]
  refine ⟨by rw [hconst]; exact inv_pos.mpr hlpos, fun S => ?_⟩
  rw [hconst, hμS, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hlpos, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal,
    ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (ENNReal.coe_ne_zero.mpr hl0) ENNReal.coe_ne_top, one_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(hspec : 0 < sbgbAreaConst ∧ ∀ S : Set E2,

    (a : Fin 3) (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : MeasurableSet S) :

signature.name: linear_graph_hausdorff
signature.statement:
(hspec : 0 < sbgbAreaConst ∧ ∀ S : Set E2,
      ENNReal.ofReal sbgbAreaConst * MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) S =

    (a : Fin 3) (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : MeasurableSet S) :

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hc, hsp⟩ := hspec
  have hQ : ∑ k : Fin 2, p k ^ 2 = p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2 := Fin.sum_univ_two _
  set s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, p k ^ 2) with hs_def
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = 1 + (p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2) := by
    rw [hs_def, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), hQ]
  have h1s : (1 + s) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨κ, hB⟩ : ∃ κ : ℝ, κ * (1 + s) = 1 := ⟨(1 + s)⁻¹, inv_mul_cancel₀ h1s⟩
  obtain ⟨μ, hA⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ, μ * (s * (1 + s)) = 1 :=
    ⟨(s * (1 + s))⁻¹, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity)⟩
  
  set ρ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin 2 → ℝ) :=
    Matrix.toLin' !![1 + κ * p 0 ^ 2, κ * p 0 * p 1; κ * p 0 * p 1, 1 + κ * p 1 ^ 2]
    with hρ_def
  have hρ : ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ρ x i = x i + κ * (p 0 * x 0 + p 1 * x 1) * p i := by
    intro x i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [hρ_def, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring
  have hdet : LinearMap.det ρ = s := by
    rw [hρ_def, LinearMap.det_toLin', Matrix.det_fin_two_of]
    linear_combination (-κ) * hs2 + (s - 1) * hB
  
  let ρ' : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → (Fin 2 → ℝ) := fun w i => w i - μ * (p 0 * w 0 + p 1 * w 1) * p i
  have hρ'ρ : ∀ x, ρ' (ρ x) = x := by
    intro x
    funext i
    simp only [ρ', hρ]
    linear_combination (p 0 * x 0 + p 1 * x 1) * p i * (-κ * hA + μ * hB + μ * κ * hs2)
  
  let Ψ : E2 → E3 := fun z =>
    smthLift a (ρ' (WithLp.ofLp z)) (∑ k : Fin 2, p k * ρ' (WithLp.ofLp z) k)
  have hfac : ∀ x, Ψ (WithLp.toLp 2 (ρ x)) = smthLift a x (∑ k : Fin 2, p k * x k) := by
    intro x
    simp only [Ψ, hρ'ρ]
  have hcoord : ∀ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
      (smthLift a y t) i = (Fin.insertNth a t y : Fin 3 → ℝ) i := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have hnorm : ∀ (y y' : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t t' : ℝ), dist (smthLift a y t) (smthLift a y' t') =
      Real.sqrt ((t - t') ^ 2 + (y 0 - y' 0) ^ 2 + (y 1 - y' 1) ^ 2) := by
    intro y y' t t'
    rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [hcoord, Fin.insertNth_apply_same, Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove, Real.dist_eq,
      sq_abs]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hΨ : Isometry Ψ := by
    refine Isometry.of_dist_eq (fun z z' => ?_)
    rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq z z']
    simp only [Ψ]
    rw [hnorm]
    congr 1
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, sq_abs, ρ']
    linear_combination (p 0 * (z 0 - z' 0) + p 1 * (z 1 - z' 1)) ^ 2 *
      (-(1 - μ * s ^ 2 + μ * s) * hA + (2 * μ - μ ^ 2 * (p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2) - μ ^ 2 * s ^ 2) * hs2)
  
  have himg : (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => smthLift a x (∑ k : Fin 2, p k * x k)) '' S =
      Ψ '' ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)) '' (ρ '' S)) := by
    rw [Set.image_image, Set.image_image]
    refine Set.image_congr (fun x _ => ?_)
    exact (hfac x).symm
  have hvolT : MeasureTheory.volume ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)) '' (ρ '' S)) =
      MeasureTheory.volume (ρ '' S) := by
    rw [MeasurableEquiv.image_eq_preimage_symm]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 2)).measure_preimage_equiv _
  have hvolρ : MeasureTheory.volume (ρ '' S) = ENNReal.ofReal s * MeasureTheory.volume S := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap, hdet, abs_of_pos hs0]
  have hne : ENNReal.ofReal sbgbAreaConst ≠ 0 := (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.2 hc).ne'
  have htop : ENNReal.ofReal sbgbAreaConst ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hμT : ∀ T : Set E2, MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) T =
      (ENNReal.ofReal sbgbAreaConst)⁻¹ * MeasureTheory.volume T := by
    intro T
    rw [← hsp T, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hne htop, one_mul]
  rw [himg, hΨ.hausdorffMeasure_image (Or.inl (by norm_num)), hμT, hvolT, hvolρ,
    ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos hc, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(hlin : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)), MeasurableSet S →
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)
          ((fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => smthLift a x (∑ k : Fin 2, p k * x k)) '' S) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, p k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst) *
          MeasureTheory.volume S)
    (a : Fin 3) (W : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 v W) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hSW : S ⊆ W)
    (gf : E3 → ℝ) (hg : Measurable gf) :
    (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn gf ((fun x => smthLift a x (v x)) '' S)
        (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) ↔
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x k ^ 2) /
        sbgbAreaConst * gf (smthLift a x (v x))) S) ∧
    ∫ z in (fun x => smthLift a x (v x)) '' S, gf z
        ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) =
      ∫ x in S, Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst *
        gf (smthLift a x (v x))

signature.statement:
(hlin : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)), MeasurableSet S →

          ((fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => smthLift a x (∑ k : Fin 2, p k * x k)) '' S) =

proof.tactics:
by
  have hc : 0 ≤ sbgbAreaConst := div_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  have hcoord : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (k : Fin 2), (smthLift a x t) (a.succAbove k) = x k := by
    intro x t k
    show Fin.insertNth (α := fun _ => ℝ) a t x (a.succAbove k) = x k
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove (α := fun _ => ℝ) a t x k
  have hcoorda : ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (t : ℝ), (smthLift a x t) a = t := by
    intro x t
    show Fin.insertNth (α := fun _ => ℝ) a t x a = t
    exact Fin.insertNth_apply_same (α := fun _ => ℝ) a t x
  have hLc : Continuous (fun p : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × ℝ => smthLift a p.1 p.2) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
      (Continuous.finInsertNth a continuous_snd continuous_fst)
  
  
  
  have hsq : ∀ (p q : Fin 2 → ℝ) (η : ℝ), 0 ≤ η → (∀ k : Fin 2, |q k - p k| ≤ η) →
      Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, q k ^ 2) ≤ (1 + 2 * η) * Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, p k ^ 2) := by
    intro p q η hη hpq
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have key : ∀ k : Fin 2, q k ^ 2 ≤ p k ^ 2 + η * (1 + p k ^ 2) + η ^ 2 := by
      intro k
      have hk := hpq k
      have a0 : (q k - p k) ^ 2 ≤ η ^ 2 := by
        rw [← sq_abs]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hk 2
      have b0 : 2 * p k * (q k - p k) ≤ 2 * |p k| * η := by
        calc 2 * p k * (q k - p k) ≤ |2 * p k * (q k - p k)| := le_abs_self _
          _ = 2 * |p k| * |q k - p k| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_two]
          _ ≤ 2 * |p k| * η := by gcongr
      have c0 : 2 * |p k| * η ≤ η * (1 + p k ^ 2) := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hη (sq_nonneg (|p k| - 1)), sq_abs (p k)]
      nlinarith
    have hsq' : 1 + (q 0 ^ 2 + q 1 ^ 2) ≤ (1 + 2 * η) ^ 2 * (1 + (p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2)) := by
      have k0 := key 0
      have k1 := key 1
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hη (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg (p 0)) (sq_nonneg (p 1))),
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hη hη) (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg (p 0)) (sq_nonneg (p 1))),
        mul_nonneg hη hη]
    calc Real.sqrt (1 + (q 0 ^ 2 + q 1 ^ 2))
        ≤ Real.sqrt ((1 + 2 * η) ^ 2 * (1 + (p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2))) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq'
      _ = (1 + 2 * η) * Real.sqrt (1 + (p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2)) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)]
  
  
  
  have hpiece : ∀ (K : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)), Convex ℝ K →
      (∀ ξ ∈ K, DifferentiableAt ℝ v ξ) → ∀ (x₀ : Fin 2 → ℝ) (η : ℝ), 0 ≤ η →
      (∀ ξ ∈ K, ‖fderiv ℝ v ξ - fderiv ℝ v x₀‖ ≤ η) → ∀ T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ), T ⊆ K →
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) ((fun x => smthLift a x (v x)) '' T) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + η) ^ 2) * MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)
            ((fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => smthLift a x (∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x₀ k * x k)) '' T) ∧
        MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)
            ((fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => smthLift a x (∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x₀ k * x k)) '' T) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + η) ^ 2) *
            MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) ((fun x => smthLift a x (v x)) '' T) := by
    intro K hK hd x₀ η hη hosc T hTK
    have hsub : ∀ (x y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (s t : ℝ),
        smthLift a x s - smthLift a y t = smthLift a (x - y) (s - t) := by
      intro x y s t
      simp only [smthLift]
      rw [Fin.insertNth_sub, map_sub]
    have hhor : ∀ (h : Fin 2 → ℝ) (s : ℝ), ‖h‖ ≤ ‖smthLift a h s‖ := by
      intro h s
      refine (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)).mpr (fun k => ?_)
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le (smthLift a h s) (a.succAbove k)
      rw [← hcoord h s k]
      exact this
    have hvert : ∀ s : ℝ, ‖smthLift a 0 s‖ = |s| := by
      intro s
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a]
      have h1 : ∀ k : Fin 2, (smthLift a 0 s) (a.succAbove k) = 0 := fun k => by
        rw [hcoord]; rfl
      simp only [h1, hcoorda, norm_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      simp [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    set φ := fderiv ℝ v x₀ with hφ
    have hphi : ∀ h : Fin 2 → ℝ, ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x₀ k * h k = φ h := by
      intro h
      conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single h]
      rw [map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
      have : (Pi.single k (h k) : Fin 2 → ℝ) = h k • (Pi.single k (1 : ℝ) : Fin 2 → ℝ) := by
        rw [← Pi.single_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [this, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
      rfl
    set Γ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → E3 := fun x => smthLift a x (v x) with hΓ
    set L : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → E3 := fun x => smthLift a x (∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x₀ k * x k) with hL
    have hLsub : ∀ x y, L x - L y = smthLift a (x - y) (φ (x - y)) := by
      intro x y
      simp only [hL, hsub, hphi, map_sub]
    have hΓsub : ∀ x y, Γ x - Γ y = smthLift a (x - y) (v x - v y) := fun x y => hsub _ _ _ _
    have hdiff : ∀ x y, (Γ x - Γ y) - (L x - L y) = smthLift a 0 (v x - v y - φ (x - y)) := by
      intro x y
      rw [hΓsub, hLsub, hsub, sub_self]
    have hmvt : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, |v x - v y - φ (x - y)| ≤ η * ‖x - y‖ := by
      intro x hx y hy
      have := hK.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le' (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := v) (φ := φ) hd hosc hy hx
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have hb1 : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖Γ x - Γ y‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖L x - L y‖ := by
      intro x hx y hy
      have h1 := norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub' (Γ x - Γ y) (L x - L y)
      rw [hdiff, hvert] at h1
      have h2 := hmvt x hx y hy
      have h3 : ‖x - y‖ ≤ ‖L x - L y‖ := by rw [hLsub]; exact hhor _ _
      nlinarith
    have hb2 : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖L x - L y‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖Γ x - Γ y‖ := by
      intro x hx y hy
      have h1 := norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub' (L x - L y) (Γ x - Γ y)
      rw [norm_sub_rev (L x - L y), hdiff, hvert] at h1
      have h2 := hmvt x hx y hy
      have h3 : ‖x - y‖ ≤ ‖Γ x - Γ y‖ := by rw [hΓsub]; exact hhor _ _
      nlinarith
    have transfer : ∀ (P Q : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → E3),
        (∀ x, (fun k => (Q x) (a.succAbove k)) = x) →
        (∀ x ∈ T, ∀ y ∈ T, ‖P x - P y‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖Q x - Q y‖) →
        MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (P '' T) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + η) ^ 2) * MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Q '' T) := by
      intro P Q hQ hPQ
      let F : E3 → E3 := fun z => P (fun k => z (a.succAbove k))
      have hFQ : ∀ x, F (Q x) = P x := fun x => by simp only [F, hQ x]
      have hlip : LipschitzOnWith (1 + η).toNNReal F (Q '' T) := by
        apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul
        rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        rw [hFQ, hFQ, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by linarith)]
        exact hPQ x hx y hy
      have himg : F '' (Q '' T) = P '' T := by
        rw [Set.image_image]
        exact Set.image_congr (fun x _ => hFQ x)
      have := hlip.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (d := 2) (by norm_num)
      rw [himg] at this
      refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      congr 1
      rw [show (((1 + η).toNNReal : NNReal) : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 + η) from rfl,
        ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (by linarith) (by norm_num), Real.rpow_two]
    have hQΓ : ∀ x, (fun k => (Γ x) (a.succAbove k)) = x := fun x => funext (fun k => hcoord _ _ k)
    have hQL : ∀ x, (fun k => (L x) (a.succAbove k)) = x := fun x => funext (fun k => hcoord _ _ k)
    exact ⟨transfer Γ L hQL (fun x hx y hy => hb1 x (hTK hx) y (hTK hy)),
      transfer L Γ hQΓ (fun x hx y hy => hb2 x (hTK hx) y (hTK hy))⟩
  
  
  
  have hcover : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ (B : ℕ → Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (x : ℕ → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ n, IsOpen (B n) ∧ Convex ℝ (B n) ∧ B n ⊆ W ∧
        ∀ ξ ∈ B n, ‖fderiv ℝ v ξ - fderiv ℝ v (x n)‖ ≤ η) ∧ W ⊆ ⋃ n, B n := by
    intro η hη
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ v) W := hv.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW le_rfl
    have hloc : ∀ y ∈ W, ∃ r > 0, Metric.ball y r ⊆ W ∧
        ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball y r, ‖fderiv ℝ v ξ - fderiv ℝ v y‖ ≤ η := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδ'⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (hcont.continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)) η hη
      obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε'⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW y hy
      refine ⟨min δ ε, lt_min hδ hε, (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hε',
        fun ξ hξ => ?_⟩
      have := hδ' (lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hξ) (min_le_left _ _))
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at this
      exact this.le
    choose! r hr hrW hrosc using hloc
    obtain ⟨I, hIc, hIU⟩ := TopologicalSpace.isOpen_iUnion_countable
      (fun y : W => Metric.ball (y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r y)) (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
    have hmem : ∀ y ∈ W, y ∈ ⋃ i ∈ I, Metric.ball ((i : W) : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r i) := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hIU]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr y hy)⟩
    rcases I.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hI | hI
    · refine ⟨fun _ => ∅, fun _ => 0, fun n => ⟨isOpen_empty, convex_empty, Set.empty_subset _,
        fun ξ h => absurd h (Set.notMem_empty ξ)⟩, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      have := hmem y hy
      rw [hI] at this
      simp at this
    · obtain ⟨g, hg'⟩ := hIc.exists_eq_range hI
      refine ⟨fun n => Metric.ball ((g n : W) : Fin 2 → ℝ) (r (g n)), fun n => g n,
        fun n => ⟨Metric.isOpen_ball, convex_ball _ _, hrW _ (g n).2, hrosc _ (g n).2⟩, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hyi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hmem y hy)
      rw [hg'] at hi
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hi
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, hyi⟩
  
  
  
  have hmeas : ∀ T : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ), MeasurableSet T → T ⊆ W →
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) ((fun x => smthLift a x (v x)) '' T) =
        ∫⁻ x in T, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst) := by
    intro T hT hTW
    set Γ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → E3 := fun x => smthLift a x (v x) with hΓdef
    set f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ENNReal :=
      fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst)
      with hfdef
    have hinj : Function.Injective Γ := by
      intro x y hxy
      funext k
      rw [← hcoord x (v x) k, ← hcoord y (v y) k]
      exact congrArg (fun z : E3 => z (a.succAbove k)) hxy
    have hΓc : ContinuousOn Γ W :=
      hLc.comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_id.prodMk hv.continuousOn)
    have hdW : ∀ ξ ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ v ξ := fun ξ hξ =>
      (hv.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hξ)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have hslope : ∀ (ξ y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (η : ℝ), ‖fderiv ℝ v ξ - fderiv ℝ v y‖ ≤ η →
        ∀ k, |smthGrad v ξ k - smthGrad v y k| ≤ η := by
      intro ξ y η h k
      have e1 : smthGrad v ξ k - smthGrad v y k =
          (fderiv ℝ v ξ - fderiv ℝ v y) (Pi.single k 1) := by
        simp only [smthGrad, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
      rw [e1, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      refine (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans ?_
      rw [Pi.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one]
      exact h
    have main : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
        MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Γ '' T) ≤
            (ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + η) ^ 2) * ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 * η)) * ∫⁻ x in T, f x ∧
          ∫⁻ x in T, f x ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + η) ^ 2) * ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 * η)) *
            MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Γ '' T) := by
      intro η hη
      obtain ⟨B, x, hB, hcov⟩ := hcover η hη
      set Tn : ℕ → Set (Fin 2 → ℝ) := fun n => T ∩ disjointed B n with hTndef
      have hTnm : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (Tn n) := fun n =>
        hT.inter (MeasurableSet.disjointed (fun m => (hB m).1.measurableSet) n)
      have hTnd : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint Tn) := fun i j hij =>
        (disjoint_disjointed B hij).mono Set.inter_subset_right Set.inter_subset_right
      have hTnB : ∀ n, Tn n ⊆ B n := fun n => Set.inter_subset_right.trans (disjointed_subset B n)
      have hTU : ⋃ n, Tn n = T := by
        simp only [hTndef]
        rw [← Set.inter_iUnion, iUnion_disjointed]
        exact Set.inter_eq_left.mpr (hTW.trans hcov)
      have hΓU : Γ '' T = ⋃ n, Γ '' Tn n := by rw [← hTU, Set.image_iUnion]
      have hΓd : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint (fun n => Γ '' Tn n)) := fun i j hij =>
        (Set.disjoint_image_iff hinj).mpr (hTnd hij)
      have hΓm : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (Γ '' Tn n) := fun n =>
        (hTnm n).image_of_continuousOn_injOn (hΓc.mono ((hTnB n).trans (hB n).2.2.1)) hinj.injOn
      have hμ : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Γ '' T) =
          ∑' n, MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Γ '' Tn n) := by
        rw [hΓU]; exact measure_iUnion hΓd hΓm
      have hI : ∫⁻ x in T, f x = ∑' n, ∫⁻ x in Tn n, f x := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← hTU]
        exact lintegral_iUnion hTnm hTnd f
      have h12 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + 2 * η := by linarith
      set lam := ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + η) ^ 2) * ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 * η) with hlam
      have hpc := fun n => hpiece (B n) (hB n).2.1 (fun ξ hξ => hdW ξ ((hB n).2.2.1 hξ)) (x n) η
        hη.le (hB n).2.2.2 (Tn n) (hTnB n)
      have hln := fun n => hlin a (smthGrad v (x n)) (Tn n) (hTnm n)
      have hpt1 : ∀ n, ∀ ξ ∈ Tn n,
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v (x n) k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst) ≤
            ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 * η) * f ξ := by
        intro n ξ hξ
        have hs := hslope ξ (x n) η ((hB n).2.2.2 ξ (hTnB n hξ))
        have h := hsq (smthGrad v ξ) (smthGrad v (x n)) η hη.le (fun k => by
          rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact hs k)
        rw [hfdef, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul h12, ← mul_div_assoc]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h hc)
      have hpt2 : ∀ n, ∀ ξ ∈ Tn n, f ξ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 * η) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v (x n) k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst) := by
        intro n ξ hξ
        have hs := hslope ξ (x n) η ((hB n).2.2.2 ξ (hTnB n hξ))
        have h := hsq (smthGrad v (x n)) (smthGrad v ξ) η hη.le hs
        rw [hfdef, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul h12, ← mul_div_assoc]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h hc)
      have hup : ∀ n, MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Γ '' Tn n) ≤
          lam * ∫⁻ x in Tn n, f x := by
        intro n
        calc MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Γ '' Tn n)
            ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + η) ^ 2) *
                (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v (x n) k ^ 2) /
                  sbgbAreaConst) * volume (Tn n)) := by
              rw [← hln n]; exact (hpc n).1
          _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + η) ^ 2) * ∫⁻ ξ in Tn n,
                ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v (x n) k ^ 2) /
                  sbgbAreaConst) := by
              rw [setLIntegral_const]
          _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + η) ^ 2) * ∫⁻ ξ in Tn n, ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 * η) * f ξ :=
              mul_le_mul_left' (setLIntegral_mono' (hTnm n) (hpt1 n)) _
          _ = lam * ∫⁻ x in Tn n, f x := by
              rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, hlam, mul_assoc]
      have hlow : ∀ n, ∫⁻ x in Tn n, f x ≤
          lam * MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Γ '' Tn n) := by
        intro n
        calc ∫⁻ x in Tn n, f x
            ≤ ∫⁻ ξ in Tn n, ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 * η) *
                ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v (x n) k ^ 2) /
                  sbgbAreaConst) :=
              setLIntegral_mono' (hTnm n) (hpt2 n)
          _ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 * η) *
                (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v (x n) k ^ 2) /
                  sbgbAreaConst) * volume (Tn n)) := by
              rw [setLIntegral_const, mul_assoc]
          _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 * η) * (ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + η) ^ 2) *
                MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Γ '' Tn n)) := by
              rw [← hln n]
              exact mul_le_mul_left' (hpc n).2 _
          _ = lam * MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Γ '' Tn n) := by
              rw [hlam, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 * η))]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hμ, hI, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
        exact ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hup
      · rw [hμ, hI, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]
        exact ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum hlow
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun η : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + η) ^ 2) * ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 * η))
        (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) := by
      have h1 : Tendsto (fun η : ℝ => (1 + η) ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * η)) (𝓝 0)
          (𝓝 ((1 + 0) ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * 0))) := by
        apply Continuous.tendsto; fun_prop
      have h2 := (ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal h1).mono_left (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Set.Ioi 0))
      norm_num at h2
      refine h2.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with η hη
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
    apply le_antisymm
    · have ht := ENNReal.Tendsto.mul_const hlim (b := ∫⁻ x in T, f x) (Or.inl one_ne_zero)
      rw [one_mul] at ht
      refine ge_of_tendsto ht ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with η hη
      exact (main η hη).1
    · have ht := ENNReal.Tendsto.mul_const hlim
        (b := MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Γ '' T)) (Or.inl one_ne_zero)
      rw [one_mul] at ht
      refine ge_of_tendsto ht ?_
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with η hη
      exact (main η hη).2
  
  
  
  classical
  have hJnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst :=
    fun x => div_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hc
  have hJm : Measurable
      (fun x => Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst) := by
    apply Measurable.div_const
    apply Measurable.sqrt
    apply Measurable.const_add
    apply Finset.measurable_sum
    intro k _
    exact (measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ v (Pi.single k 1)).pow_const 2
  let ρ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → NNReal := fun x =>
    (Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst).toNNReal
  have hρm : Measurable ρ := hJm.real_toNNReal
  have hρc : ∀ x, ((ρ x : NNReal) : ℝ) =
      Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst :=
    fun x => Real.coe_toNNReal _ (hJnn x)
  let vt : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ := W.piecewise v 0
  have hvt : Measurable vt := hv.continuousOn.measurable_piecewise continuousOn_const hW.measurableSet
  let Γ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → E3 := fun x => smthLift a x (v x)
  let Γt : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → E3 := fun x => smthLift a x (vt x)
  have hΓt : Measurable Γt := hLc.measurable.comp (measurable_id.prodMk hvt)
  have hΓeq : ∀ x ∈ W, Γt x = Γ x := fun x hx => by
    simp only [Γt, Γ, vt, Set.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hx]
  let ν := (volume.restrict S).withDensity (fun x => (ρ x : ENNReal))
  have hmeq : (Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)).restrict (Γ '' S) = Measure.map Γt ν := by
    ext B hB
    rw [Measure.map_apply hΓt hB, withDensity_apply _ (hΓt hB),
      Measure.restrict_restrict (hΓt hB), Measure.restrict_apply hB]
    have hset : Γ '' (Γt ⁻¹' B ∩ S) = B ∩ Γ '' S := by
      ext z; constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hxB, hxS⟩, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨?_, x, hxS, rfl⟩
        have : Γt x ∈ B := hxB
        rwa [hΓeq x (hSW hxS)] at this
      · rintro ⟨hzB, x, hxS, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨x, ⟨?_, hxS⟩, rfl⟩
        show Γt x ∈ B
        rw [hΓeq x (hSW hxS)]; exact hzB
    rw [← hset, hmeas _ ((hΓt hB).inter hS) (Set.inter_subset_right.trans hSW)]
    rfl
  have hpt : ∀ x ∈ S, (ρ x • gf (Γt x)) =
      Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst *
        gf (smthLift a x (v x)) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, hρc, hΓeq x (hSW hx)]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · show Integrable gf ((Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)).restrict (Γ '' S)) ↔
      Integrable _ (volume.restrict S)
    rw [hmeq, integrable_map_measure hg.aestronglyMeasurable hΓt.aemeasurable]
    rw [show (gf ∘ Γt) = fun x => gf (Γt x) from rfl,
      integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul hρm]
    exact integrable_congr (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hS hpt)
  · show ∫ z, gf z ∂((Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)).restrict (Γ '' S)) = _
    rw [hmeq, integral_map hΓt.aemeasurable hg.aestronglyMeasurable,
      integral_withDensity_eq_integral_smul hρm]
    exact setIntegral_congr_fun hS hpt

informal_problem.statement:
(hc : 0 < sbgbAreaConst)
    (hgraph : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (W : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)), IsOpen W → ∀ (v : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 v W → ∀ (S : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)), MeasurableSet S → S ⊆ W →
      ∀ (gf : E3 → ℝ), Measurable gf →
      (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn gf ((fun x => smthLift a x (v x)) '' S)
          (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) ↔
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x k ^ 2) /
          sbgbAreaConst * gf (smthLift a x (v x))) S) ∧
      ∫ z in (fun x => smthLift a x (v x)) '' S, gf z
          ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) =
        ∫ x in S, Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad v x k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst *
          gf (smthLift a x (v x)))
    (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ U)
    (hd : fderiv ℝ f y₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ V : Set E3, IsOpen V ∧ y₀ ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧
      ∀ (E : Set E3) (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (B : ℝ), MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ V → Measurable ψ →
        (∀ y ∈ E, |ψ y| ≤ B) →
        (∀ t : ℝ, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => ψ y * (sbgbAreaConst / ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖))
          (E ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))) ∧
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t : ℝ => ∫ y in E ∩ f ⁻¹' {t},
          ψ y * (sbgbAreaConst / ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖) ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))) ∧
        ∫ y in E, ψ y = ∫ t : ℝ, ∫ y in E ∩ f ⁻¹' {t},
          ψ y * (sbgbAreaConst / ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖) ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hslot : ∃ a : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f y₀ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    apply hd
    have h0 : ‖fderiv ℝ f y₀‖ = 0 := by
      rw [e3_dual_norm_eq]
      simp [hcon]
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp h0
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hslot
  
  obtain ⟨r, m, Ξ, hr, hm, hcb, hmcb, hWo, hWb, hΞ, hΞs⟩ :=
    straighten_local_inverse straighten_clm_det U hU f hf y₀ hy₀ a ha
  have hVU : Metric.ball y₀ r ⊆ U := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcb
  refine ⟨Metric.ball y₀ r, Metric.isOpen_ball, Metric.mem_ball_self hr, hVU, ?_⟩
  intro E ψ B hE hEV hψ hB
  have hmV : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, m ≤ |fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| :=
    fun y hy => hmcb y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy)
  have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y := fun y hy =>
    (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hVU hy))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hnormpos : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, m ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm (fderiv ℝ f y) (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact (hmV y hy).trans h1
  have hgfm : Measurable (fun y : E3 => ψ y * (sbgbAreaConst / ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖)) :=
    hψ.mul (measurable_const.div (measurable_fderiv ℝ f).norm)
  
  obtain ⟨hTE, hGint, hCV⟩ := straighten_change_of_variables straighten_clm_det a U hU f hf
    (Metric.ball y₀ r) hVU Metric.isBounded_ball m hm hmV Ξ hΞ E ψ B hE hEV hψ hB
  obtain ⟨hFint, hFeq⟩ := slice_fubini_E3 a _ hTE _ hGint
  
  have hslice : ∀ t : ℝ,
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => ψ y * (sbgbAreaConst / ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖))
        (E ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) ∧
      ∫ y in E ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, ψ y * (sbgbAreaConst / ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖)
          ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) =
        ∫ x in {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈
          (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) '' E},
          ψ (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x))) /
            |fderiv ℝ f (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)))
              (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| := by
    intro t
    obtain ⟨hP1, hP23⟩ := straighten_slice_structure a f (Metric.ball y₀ r) Ξ hΞ t
    obtain ⟨hEt, himg⟩ := hP23 E hEV hTE
    obtain ⟨hWto, hWtb, hWtc, hH⟩ :=
      straighten_slice_regular a f (Metric.ball y₀ r) Ξ hWo hWb hΞs t
    have hEW : {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈
          (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) '' E} ⊆
        {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈
          (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) ''
            Metric.ball y₀ r} :=
      fun x hx => Set.image_mono hEV hx
    obtain ⟨H, hHeq⟩ : ∃ H : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → ℝ, H = fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ =>
        (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x))) a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hHdef : ∀ x, H x = (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x))) a :=
      fun x => by rw [hHeq]
    have hH' : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 H {x : Fin 2 → ℝ |
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈
          (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) ''
            Metric.ball y₀ r} := by
      rw [hHeq]; exact hH
    have hyform : ∀ x ∈ {x : Fin 2 → ℝ |
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈
          (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) ''
            Metric.ball y₀ r},
        Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)) = smthLift a x (H x) ∧
        Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)) ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r ∧
        f (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x))) = t := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨g1, g2, g3⟩ := hP1 x hx

    have hlev : ∀ x' ∈ {x : Fin 2 → ℝ |
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈
          (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) ''
            Metric.ball y₀ r},
        f ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a (H x') x')) = t := by
      intro x' hx'
      obtain ⟨g1, -, g3⟩ := hyform x' hx'
      show f (smthLift a x' (H x')) = t
      rw [← g1]
      exact g3
    
    have hpt : ∀ x ∈ {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈
          (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) '' E},
        Real.sqrt (1 + ∑ k : Fin 2, smthGrad H x k ^ 2) / sbgbAreaConst *
            (ψ (smthLift a x (H x)) * (sbgbAreaConst / ‖fderiv ℝ f (smthLift a x (H x))‖)) =
          ψ (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x))) /
            |fderiv ℝ f (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)))
              (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| := by
      intro x hx
      have hxW := hEW hx
      obtain ⟨hy, hyV, -⟩ := hyform x hxW
      have hy2 : Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)) =
          (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a (H x) x) := hy
      have hHd : DifferentiableAt ℝ H x :=
        (hH'.contDiffAt (hWto.mem_nhds hxW)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
      have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f

        rw [← hy2]; exact hdiff _ hyV

      have ha' : fderiv ℝ f ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a (H x) x))

      rw [← hy2] at hs5

          ‖fderiv ℝ f (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)))‖ /
            |fderiv ℝ f (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)))
              (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| := hs5
      rw [← hy, hJ]
      have hn0 : ‖fderiv ℝ f (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)))‖ ≠ 0 :=
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hm (hnormpos _ hyV)).ne'
      have hd0 : |fderiv ℝ f (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)))
          (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.mpr hax
      have hc0 : sbgbAreaConst ≠ 0 := hc.ne'
      field_simp
    
    have hb : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => ψ (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x))) /
          |fderiv ℝ f (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)))
            (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))|)
        {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈
          (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) '' E} := by
      have hfin : (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict {x : Fin 2 → ℝ |
          (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈
            (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) '' E})

        rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
        exact ((hWtb.subset hEW).measure_lt_top).ne
      have hc1 : AEMeasurable (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ =>
          Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)))
          (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict {x : Fin 2 → ℝ |
            (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈
              (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) ''
                Metric.ball y₀ r}) :=
        hWtc.aemeasurable hWto.measurableSet
      have hc2 := hc1.mono_measure (MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_mono hEW le_rfl)
      have hm3 : Measurable (fun z : E3 => ψ z / |fderiv ℝ f z (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))|) :=
        hψ.div (continuous_abs.measurable.comp (measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ f _))
      have hmeas := (hm3.comp_aemeasurable hc2).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict {x : Fin 2 → ℝ |
          (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈
            (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) '' E}).restrict
              Set.univ),
          ‖((fun z : E3 => ψ z / |fderiv ℝ f z (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))|) ∘
            (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)))) x‖
            ≤ B / m := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_univ]
        refine MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hEt (fun x hx => ?_)
        obtain ⟨y, hyE, hyx⟩ := hx
        have hyV := hEV hyE
        have hXi : Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)) = y := by
          rw [← hyx]; exact hΞ y hyV
        show ‖ψ (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x))) /
            |fderiv ℝ f (Ξ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)))
              (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))|‖ ≤ B / m
        rw [hXi, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_abs]
        have hmy := hmV y hyV
        have hBy := hB y hyE
        have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans hBy
        calc |ψ y| / |fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))|
            ≤ B / |fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| :=
              div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hBy (abs_nonneg _)
          _ ≤ B / m := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hB0 hm hmy
      have := MeasureTheory.Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded hfin hmeas hbound
      rw [MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn, MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_univ] at this
      exact this
    
    have hg := hgraph a _ hWto H hH' _ hEt hEW (fun y => ψ y * (sbgbAreaConst / ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖)) hgfm
    have himgH : (fun x => smthLift a x (H x)) ''
        {x : Fin 2 → ℝ | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈

      hb.congr_fun (fun x hx => (hpt x hx).symm) hEt
    have hC1 := hg.1.mpr hint
    rw [himgH] at hC1
    have hC2 := hg.2
    rw [himgH] at hC2
    refine ⟨hC1, ?_⟩
    rw [hC2]
    exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hEt (fun x hx => hpt x hx)

    exact (chartAt E3 q).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 q).open_target hRo
  have hUmem : ∀ y ∈ U, y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hUdef] at hy
    exact ⟨hy.1, hy.2⟩
  have hwU : ContinuousOn (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) U :=
    hw.mono (fun y hy => hUmem y hy)
  obtain ⟨hfT, hgradT, hdetT⟩ := chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu q
  have hfU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) U :=
    hfT.mono (fun y hy => (hUmem y hy).1)
  
  obtain ⟨Kc, hKcdef⟩ : ∃ Kc : Set E3, Kc = chartAt E3 q '' (Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' A ∩ tsupport φ) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKcmem : ∀ y ∈ Kc, ∃ p, p ∈ Ω ∧ u p ∈ A ∧ p ∈ tsupport φ ∧ p ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source ∧
      chartAt E3 q p = y ∧ (chartAt E3 q).symm y = p ∧ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hKcdef] at hy
    obtain ⟨p, ⟨⟨hpΩ, hpA⟩, hpt⟩, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hps := hφs.2 hpt
    exact ⟨p, hpΩ, hpA, hpt, hps, rfl, (chartAt E3 q).left_inv hps, (chartAt E3 q).map_source hps⟩
  have hKcmem' : ∀ p, p ∈ Ω → u p ∈ A → p ∈ tsupport φ → chartAt E3 q p ∈ Kc := by
    intro p h1 h2 h3
    rw [hKcdef]
    exact ⟨p, ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, rfl⟩
  have hKc : IsCompact Kc := by
    rw [hKcdef]
    exact ((hΩ.inter_right (hAc.preimage huc)).inter_right (isClosed_tsupport φ)).image_of_continuousOn
      ((chartAt E3 q).continuousOn.mono (fun p hp => hφs.2 hp.2))
  have hKcU : Kc ⊆ U := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨p, hpΩ, hpA, -, -, -, hsy, hyT⟩ := hKcmem y hy
    rw [hUdef]
    refine ⟨hyT, ?_⟩
    show mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) ≠ 0
    rw [hsy]
    exact hreg p hpΩ hpA
  
  have hdK : ∀ y ∈ Kc, fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy h0
    obtain ⟨hyT, hyR⟩ := hUmem y (hKcU hy)
    have hpos := chart_Nsq_pos g u hu q y hyT hyR
    have hpd : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y = 0 := by
      intro a
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    simp [hpd] at hpos
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψdef⟩ : ∃ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ψ = fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
      w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψ : ∀ y, ψ y = φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
      (Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) := by
    intro y
    rw [hψdef]
  have hstar : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target,
      φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
        sbgbAreaDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
      ψ y * (sbgbAreaConst / ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y‖) := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : gradSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y =
        g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) := (hgradT y hy).symm
    rw [hψ, sbgbAreaDens, h1]
    ring
  
  have hψc : ContinuousOn ψ Kc := by
    have hφT : ContinuousOn (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      hφ.continuous.comp_continuousOn (chartAt E3 q).continuousOn_symm
    have hprod := ((hφT.mono (fun y hy => (hUmem y hy).1)).mul hwU).mul
      (hdetT.mono (fun y hy => (hUmem y hy).1))
    rw [hψdef]
    exact hprod.mono hKcU
  
  obtain ⟨-, hTint, hTeq⟩ :=
    hcomp U hUo (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) hfU Kc hKc hKcU hdK ψ hψc
  
  have hIT : ∀ (S : Set M) (y : E3), y ∈ chartAt E3 q '' (S ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source) →
      y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := by
    rintro S y ⟨p, ⟨-, hps⟩, rfl⟩
    exact (chartAt E3 q).map_source hps
  have hslice : ∀ t ∈ A,
      ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source),
        φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
          sbgbAreaDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y
        ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) =
      ∫ y in Kc ∩ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ⁻¹' {t},
        ψ y * (sbgbAreaConst / ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y‖)
        ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (hZm t) (fun y hy => hstar y (hIT _ y hy))]
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (hZm t) ?_ ?_
    · intro y hy
      obtain ⟨p, hpΩ, -, -, hps, hpy, hsy, -⟩ := hKcmem y hy.1
      have h2 : u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = t := hy.2
      rw [hsy] at h2
      exact ⟨p, ⟨⟨hpΩ, h2⟩, hps⟩, hpy⟩
    · rintro y ⟨hyZ, hyn⟩
      obtain ⟨p, ⟨hpΩ, hpt⟩, -, hpy, hsy, -⟩ := hImem _ y hyZ
      have hut : u p = t := hpt
      have hnot : p ∉ tsupport φ := by
        intro hpts
        apply hyn
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← hpy]
          exact hKcmem' p hpΩ (by rw [hut]; exact ht) hpts
        · show u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = t
          rw [hsy]
          exact hut
      rw [hψ, hsy, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hnot]
      ring
  have hoff : ∀ t ∉ A, (∫ y in Kc ∩ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ⁻¹' {t},
        ψ y * (sbgbAreaConst / ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y‖)
        ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))) = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have hempty : Kc ∩ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) ⁻¹' {t} = ∅ := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      rintro ⟨hyK, hyt⟩
      obtain ⟨p, -, hpA, -, -, -, hsy, -⟩ := hKcmem y hyK
      have h2 : u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = t := hyt
      rw [hsy] at h2
      rw [h2] at hpA
      exact ht hpA
    rw [hempty, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_empty]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  
  · refine (hTint.integrableOn (s := A)).congr_fun ?_ hAm
    intro t ht
    exact (hslice t ht).symm
  
  · have hD : ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' A ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source),
          φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * h ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
            Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det =
        ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' A ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), ψ y := by
      refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hDm ?_
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨p, ⟨hpΩ, hpA⟩, -, -, hsy, -⟩ := hImem _ y hy
      show φ ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * h ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) *
          Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det = ψ y
      rw [hψ, hsy, hh p hpΩ hpA]
      ring
    have hDK : ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (Ω ∩ u ⁻¹' A ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), ψ y =
        ∫ y in Kc, ψ y := by
      refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hDm ?_ ?_
      · intro y hy
        obtain ⟨p, hpΩ, hpA, -, hps, hpy, -, -⟩ := hKcmem y hy
        exact ⟨p, ⟨⟨hpΩ, hpA⟩, hps⟩, hpy⟩
      · rintro y ⟨hyD, hyn⟩
        obtain ⟨p, ⟨hpΩ, hpA⟩, -, hpy, hsy, -⟩ := hImem _ y hyD
        have hnot : p ∉ tsupport φ := by
          intro hpts
          apply hyn
          rw [← hpy]
          exact hKcmem' p hpΩ hpA hpts
        rw [hψ, hsy, image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hnot]
        ring
    rw [hD, hDK, hTeq, ← MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero hoff]
    exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hAm (fun t ht => (hslice t ht).symm)

subgoal_signatures.name: chart_Nsq_pos
subgoal_signatures.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (p : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) (hd : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) ≠ 0) : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y * partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y

subgoal_signatures.name: chart_pullback_gradInner
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (p : M) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
      (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) (chartAt E3 p).target

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_phi_chart_reps
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (q : M) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (sternPhiM g u ε) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun y => g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
    IsOpen {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0} ∧
    ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x))
      {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0}

informal_problem.statement:
(f : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O) (Kc : Set E3) (hKc : IsCompact Kc) (hKO : Kc ⊆ O)
    (hdf : ∀ y ∈ Kc, fderiv ℝ f y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Kc ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C

signature.name: level_set_chart_area_bound
signature.statement:
(f : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O) (Kc : Set E3) (hKc : IsCompact Kc) (hKO : Kc ⊆ O)
    (hdf : ∀ y ∈ Kc, fderiv ℝ f y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Kc ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hexpv : ∀ Δ : E3, Δ = ∑ b : Fin 3, Δ b • EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro Δ
    have h := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr Δ
    simp only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hnormle : ∀ Δ : E3, ‖Δ‖ ≤ ∑ b : Fin 3, |Δ b| := by
    intro Δ
    calc ‖Δ‖ = ‖∑ b : Fin 3, Δ b • EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)‖ := by rw [← hexpv Δ]
      _ ≤ ∑ b : Fin 3, ‖Δ b • EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ = ∑ b : Fin 3, |Δ b| := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  
  have hloc : ∀ y₀ ∈ Kc, ∃ (a : Fin 3) (r : ℝ), 0 < r ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r,
      ∀ z' ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, f z = f z' →
      ‖z' - z‖ ≤ 6 * ‖(fun k : Fin 2 => z' (a.succAbove k)) - (fun k : Fin 2 => z (a.succAbove k))‖ := by
    intro y₀ hy₀
    set L := fderiv ℝ f y₀ with hLdef
    obtain ⟨a, -, ha⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ
      (fun b => |L (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))|) Finset.univ_nonempty
    set m := |L (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))| with hm
    have hexp : ∀ Δ : E3, L Δ = ∑ b : Fin 3, Δ b * L (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)) := by
      intro Δ
      conv_lhs => rw [hexpv Δ]
      rw [map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hm0 : 0 < m := by
      rcases (abs_nonneg (L (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ)))).lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        apply hdf y₀ hy₀
        rw [← hLdef]
        ext Δ
        rw [hexp Δ]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
        refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => ?_
        have hb := ha b (Finset.mem_univ b)
        have : |L (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))| = 0 :=
          le_antisymm (hb.trans (le_of_eq h.symm)) (abs_nonneg _)
        rw [abs_eq_zero.mp this, mul_zero]
    have hcont : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ f) y₀ :=
      (hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl).continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds (hKO hy₀))
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδL⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont (m / 4) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hO y₀ (hKO hy₀)
    refine ⟨a, min δ ε₀, lt_min hδ hε₀, ?_⟩
    intro z hz z' hz' hzz
    have hBO : ball y₀ (min δ ε₀) ⊆ O := (ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hball
    have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ (min δ ε₀), DifferentiableAt ℝ (f - ⇑L) y := by
      intro y hy
      exact ((hf.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds (hBO hy))).sub
        L.differentiableAt
    have hbd : ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ (min δ ε₀), ‖fderiv ℝ (f - ⇑L) y‖ ≤ m / 4 := by
      intro y hy
      have hfd := (hf.differentiableOn one_ne_zero).differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds (hBO hy))
      rw [fderiv_sub hfd L.differentiableAt, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
      have := hδL (lt_of_lt_of_le (mem_ball.mp hy) (min_le_left _ _))
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at this
      exact this.le
    have hmv := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff hbd (convex_ball _ _) hz hz'
    have hLΔ : |L (z' - z)| ≤ m / 4 * ‖z' - z‖ := by
      have heq : (f - ⇑L) z' - (f - ⇑L) z = -L (z' - z) := by
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply, map_sub, hzz]
        ring
      rw [heq, norm_neg, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmv
      exact hmv
    set H := ‖(fun k : Fin 2 => z' (a.succAbove k)) - (fun k : Fin 2 => z (a.succAbove k))‖ with hH
    have hH0 : 0 ≤ H := norm_nonneg _
    have hcoord : ∀ k : Fin 2, |(z' - z) (a.succAbove k)| ≤ H := by
      intro k
      have := norm_le_pi_norm
        ((fun k : Fin 2 => z' (a.succAbove k)) - (fun k : Fin 2 => z (a.succAbove k))) k
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
    set Δ := z' - z with hΔ
    have hsplitL : L Δ = Δ a * L (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ)) +
        (Δ (a.succAbove 0) * L (EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove 0) (1 : ℝ)) +
          Δ (a.succAbove 1) * L (EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove 1) (1 : ℝ))) := by
      rw [hexp Δ, Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hsplitN : ‖Δ‖ ≤ |Δ a| + (|Δ (a.succAbove 0)| + |Δ (a.succAbove 1)|) := by
      have := hnormle Δ
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a, Fin.sum_univ_two] at this
      exact this
    have h0 := hcoord 0
    have h1 := hcoord 1
    have hl0 : |L (EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove 0) (1 : ℝ))| ≤ m := ha _ (Finset.mem_univ _)
    have hl1 : |L (EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove 1) (1 : ℝ))| ≤ m := ha _ (Finset.mem_univ _)
    have p0 : |Δ (a.succAbove 0) * L (EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove 0) (1 : ℝ))| ≤ H * m := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul h0 hl0 (abs_nonneg _) hH0
    have p1 : |Δ (a.succAbove 1) * L (EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove 1) (1 : ℝ))| ≤ H * m := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul h1 hl1 (abs_nonneg _) hH0
    have pa : |Δ a * L (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))| = |Δ a| * m := by rw [abs_mul]
    have tri : |Δ a * L (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))| ≤ |L Δ| + H * m + H * m := by
      have e1 := le_abs_self (L Δ)
      have e2 := neg_abs_le (L Δ)
      have q0 := abs_le.mp p0
      have q1 := abs_le.mp p1
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hN : m / 4 * ‖Δ‖ ≤ m / 4 * (|Δ a| + 2 * H) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
    have key : m * (3 / 4 * |Δ a|) ≤ m * (5 / 2 * H) := by nlinarith
    have hΔa : 3 / 4 * |Δ a| ≤ 5 / 2 * H := le_of_mul_le_mul_left key hm0
    linarith
  
  have hmeas : ∀ (a : Fin 3) (y₀ : E3) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ P : Set E3, P ⊆ ball y₀ r →
      (∀ z ∈ P, ∀ z' ∈ P, ‖z' - z‖ ≤
        6 * ‖(fun k : Fin 2 => z' (a.succAbove k)) - (fun k : Fin 2 => z (a.succAbove k))‖) →
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) P ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (36 * (2 * r) ^ 2) := by
    intro a y₀ r hr P hP hlip
    set π : E3 → (Fin 2 → ℝ) := fun z k => z (a.succAbove k) with hπ
    set S := π '' P with hS
    set g := Function.invFunOn π P with hg
    have hgS : ∀ x ∈ S, g x ∈ P ∧ π (g x) = x :=
      fun x hx => ⟨Function.invFunOn_mem hx, Function.invFunOn_eq hx⟩
    have hLip : LipschitzOnWith 6 g S := by
      refine LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le_mul fun x hx w hw => ?_
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hgS x hx
      obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hgS w hw
      have := hlip _ h3 _ h1
      have h2' : (fun k : Fin 2 => g x (a.succAbove k)) = x := h2
      have h4' : (fun k : Fin 2 => g w (a.succAbove k)) = w := h4
      rw [h2', h4'] at this
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      simpa using this
    have hPsub : P ⊆ g '' S := by
      intro z hz
      have hx : π z ∈ S := ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hgS _ hx
      have := hlip _ hz _ h1
      have h2' : (fun k : Fin 2 => g (π z) (a.succAbove k)) = π z := h2
      rw [h2'] at this
      have h0 : (π z) - (fun k : Fin 2 => z (a.succAbove k)) = 0 := sub_self _
      rw [h0, norm_zero, mul_zero] at this
      exact ⟨π z, hx, sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_le_zero_iff.mp this)⟩
    have hSsub : S ⊆ ball (π y₀) r := by
      rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      rw [mem_ball, dist_pi_lt_iff hr]
      intro k
      have h1 := hP hz
      rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at h1
      have h2 := PiLp.norm_apply_le (z - y₀) (a.succAbove k)
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      calc |z (a.succAbove k) - y₀ (a.succAbove k)| = ‖(z - y₀).ofLp (a.succAbove k)‖ := by
            simp [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ ‖z - y₀‖ := h2
        _ < r := h1
    have h := hLip.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (d := 2) (by norm_num)
    have h6 : (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) :
        MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)) = MeasureTheory.volume := by
      simpa using (MeasureTheory.hausdorffMeasure_pi_real (ι := Fin 2))
    rw [h6] at h
    calc MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) P
        ≤ MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (g '' S) := measure_mono hPsub
      _ ≤ ((6 : NNReal) : ENNReal) ^ (2 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume S := h
      _ ≤ ((6 : NNReal) : ENNReal) ^ (2 : ℝ) * MeasureTheory.volume (ball (π y₀) r) := by
          gcongr
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (36 * (2 * r) ^ 2) := by
          rw [Real.volume_pi_ball _ hr, Fintype.card_fin, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
          congr 1
          rw [ENNReal.rpow_two]
          norm_num
  
  choose! a r hr hL using hloc
  obtain ⟨I, hIK, hcov⟩ := hKc.elim_nhds_subcover (fun y => ball y (r y))
    (fun y hy => ball_mem_nhds y (hr y hy))
  refine ⟨∑ i ∈ I, 36 * (2 * r i) ^ 2, Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity), fun t => ?_⟩
  calc MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Kc ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})
      ≤ MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (⋃ i ∈ I, ball i (r i) ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) := by
        apply measure_mono
        rintro z ⟨hzK, hzt⟩
        obtain ⟨i, hi, hzi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcov hzK)
        exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨i, hi, hzi, hzt⟩
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (ball i (r i) ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) :=
        measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, ENNReal.ofReal (36 * (2 * r i) ^ 2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        apply hmeas (a i) i (r i) (hr i (hIK i hi)) _ Set.inter_subset_left
        intro z hz z' hz'
        exact hL i (hIK i hi) z hz.1 z' hz'.1
          ((show f z = t from hz.2).trans (show f z' = t from hz'.2).symm)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i ∈ I, 36 * (2 * r i) ^ 2) :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)).symm
