signature.name: level_edge_null
signature.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O)
    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 b O) (Kc : Set E3) (hKO : Kc ⊆ O)
    (hind : ∀ y ∈ Kc, b y = 0 → ∀ a c : ℝ,
      a • fderiv ℝ b y + c • fderiv ℝ f y = 0 → a = 0 ∧ c = 0) :
    ∀ t : ℝ,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (Kc ∩ f ⁻¹' {t} ∩ b ⁻¹' {0}) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∀ h : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h O → ∀ y₀ ∈ O, ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c →
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, ∀ y' ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r,
        |h y' - h y - fderiv ℝ h y₀ (y' - y)| ≤ c * ‖y' - y‖ := by
    intro h hh y₀ hy₀ c hc
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ h) O := hh.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO le_rfl
    have hca : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ h) y₀ := hcont.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds hy₀)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδc⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hca c hc
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρO⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hO y₀ hy₀
    refine ⟨min δ ρ, lt_min hδ hρ, fun y hy y' hy' => ?_⟩
    have hsub : Metric.ball y₀ (min δ ρ) ⊆ O :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hρO
    have hdiff : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (min δ ρ), DifferentiableAt ℝ h ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      exact (hh.differentiableOn one_ne_zero ξ (hsub hξ)).differentiableAt
        (hO.mem_nhds (hsub hξ))
    have hbound : ∀ ξ ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (min δ ρ), ‖fderiv ℝ h ξ - fderiv ℝ h y₀‖ ≤ c := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have h1 : dist ξ y₀ < δ := lt_of_lt_of_le hξ (min_le_left _ _)
      have h2 := hδc h1
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at h2
      exact h2.le
    have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le' hdiff hbound (convex_ball y₀ _) hy hy'
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact this
  intro t
  apply measure_null_of_locally_null
  rintro y₀ ⟨⟨hy₀K, hy₀f⟩, hy₀b⟩
  have hy₀O : y₀ ∈ O := hKO hy₀K
  have hy₀b' : b y₀ = 0 := hy₀b
  have hAB := hind y₀ hy₀K hy₀b'
  set A := fderiv ℝ f y₀ with hA
  set B := fderiv ℝ b y₀ with hB
  set L : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ := ((B.prod A : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ × ℝ) with hLdef
  
  have hrange : LinearMap.range L = ⊤ := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ0, hφ⟩ := Submodule.exists_le_ker_of_lt_top _ (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hne)
    have hzero : (φ ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) • B + (φ ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) • A = 0 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
      have hv : φ (L v) = 0 := hφ (LinearMap.mem_range_self L v)
      have hLv : L v = (B v) • ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) + (A v) • ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
        simp [hLdef]
      rw [hLv, map_add, map_smul, map_smul] at hv
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hv
      linarith
    obtain ⟨ha, hc⟩ := hAB _ _ hzero
    apply hφ0
    refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
    have hx : x = x.1 • ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) + x.2 • ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
      ext <;> simp
    rw [hx, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, ha, hc]
    simp
  have hN : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker L) ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker L
    have h3 : Module.finrank ℝ E3 = 3 := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
    rw [hrange, finrank_top, Module.finrank_prod, Module.finrank_self, h3] at h1
    omega
  
  set N := LinearMap.ker L with hNdef
  set P : E3 →L[ℝ] N := N.orthogonalProjection with hPdef
  set T : E3 →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) × N := (B.prod A).prod P with hTdef
  have hTinj : Function.Injective (T : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ) × N) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro v hv
    have h1 : (B.prod A) v = 0 := by
      have := congrArg Prod.fst hv
      simpa [hTdef] using this
    have h2 : P v = 0 := by
      have := congrArg Prod.snd hv
      simpa [hTdef] using this
    have hvN : v ∈ N := by
      rw [hNdef, LinearMap.mem_ker]
      exact h1
    have h3 : P v = ⟨v, hvN⟩ := Submodule.orthogonalProjection_mem_subspace_eq_self ⟨v, hvN⟩
    rw [h2] at h3
    have h4 := congrArg Subtype.val h3
    simpa using h4.symm
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hanti⟩ := (LinearMap.injective_iff_antilipschitz _).mp hTinj
  have hK' : (0 : ℝ) < K := hK
  have hTv : ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ≤ K * ‖T v‖ := by
    intro v
    have := hanti.le_mul_dist v 0
    simpa [dist_eq_norm] using this
  set c : ℝ := 1 / (2 * (K : ℝ)) with hcdef
  have hc : 0 < c := by positivity
  have hKc : (K : ℝ) * c = 1 / 2 := by
    rw [hcdef]
    field_simp
  have kstar : ∀ v : E3, |A v| ≤ c * ‖v‖ → |B v| ≤ c * ‖v‖ → ‖v‖ ≤ K * ‖P v‖ := by
    intro v hAv hBv
    have h1 : ‖T v‖ ≤ max (c * ‖v‖) ‖P v‖ := by
      refine norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨norm_prod_le_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · show ‖B v‖ ≤ _
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hBv.trans (le_max_left _ _)
      · show ‖A v‖ ≤ _
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact hAv.trans (le_max_left _ _)
      · show ‖P v‖ ≤ _
        exact le_max_right _ _
    have h2 : ‖v‖ ≤ K * max (c * ‖v‖) ‖P v‖ :=
      (hTv v).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hK'.le)
    rcases le_total (c * ‖v‖) ‖P v‖ with h | h
    · rw [max_eq_right h] at h2
      exact h2
    · rw [max_eq_left h] at h2
      have h3 : (K : ℝ) * (c * ‖v‖) = ‖v‖ / 2 := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, hKc]
        ring
      have h4 : ‖v‖ ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have h5 : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) * ‖P v‖ := mul_nonneg hK'.le (norm_nonneg _)
      linarith
  
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hf1⟩ := s1 f hf y₀ hy₀O c hc
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hb1⟩ := s1 b hb y₀ hy₀O c hc
  refine ⟨Kc ∩ f ⁻¹' {t} ∩ b ⁻¹' {0} ∩ Metric.ball y₀ (min r₁ r₂),
    inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ (Metric.ball_mem_nhds y₀ (lt_min hr₁ hr₂)), ?_⟩
  set U := Kc ∩ f ⁻¹' {t} ∩ b ⁻¹' {0} ∩ Metric.ball y₀ (min r₁ r₂) with hUdef
  have hinc : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ y' ∈ U, ‖y' - y‖ ≤ K * ‖P (y' - y)‖ := by
    rintro y ⟨⟨⟨_, hyf⟩, hyb⟩, hyr⟩ y' ⟨⟨⟨_, hyf'⟩, hyb'⟩, hyr'⟩
    have hyf2 : f y = t := hyf
    have hyb2 : b y = 0 := hyb
    have hyf2' : f y' = t := hyf'
    have hyb2' : b y' = 0 := hyb'
    have hy1 : y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hyr
    have hy2 : y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hyr
    have hy1' : y' ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hyr'
    have hy2' : y' ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r₂ := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) hyr'
    have eA := hf1 y hy1 y' hy1'
    have eB := hb1 y hy2 y' hy2'
    rw [hyf2, hyf2', sub_self, zero_sub, abs_neg] at eA
    rw [hyb2, hyb2', sub_self, zero_sub, abs_neg] at eB
    exact kstar _ eA eB
  let p : U → N := fun y => P (y : E3)
  have hp : AntilipschitzWith K p := by
    refine AntilipschitzWith.of_le_mul_dist fun y y' => ?_
    rw [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    have h1 := hinc y'.1 y'.2 y.1 y.2
    have h2 : p y - p y' = P (y.1 - y'.1) := by
      simp only [p, map_sub]
    rw [h2]
    exact h1
  have hdim : dimH U ≤ 1 := by
    calc dimH U = dimH ((Subtype.val : U → E3) '' Set.univ) := by rw [Subtype.coe_image_univ]
      _ = dimH (Set.univ : Set U) := isometry_subtype_coe.dimH_image _
      _ ≤ dimH (p '' Set.univ) := hp.le_dimH_image _
      _ ≤ dimH (Set.univ : Set N) := dimH_mono (Set.subset_univ _)
      _ = Module.finrank ℝ N := Real.dimH_univ_eq_finrank N
      _ ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hlt : dimH U < ((2 : NNReal) : ENNReal) := lt_of_le_of_lt hdim (by norm_num)
  have h := hausdorffMeasure_of_dimH_lt hlt
  rwa [NNReal.coe_ofNat] at h

informal_problem.statement:
(hspec : 0 < sbgbAreaConst ∧ ∀ S : Set E2,
      ENNReal.ofReal sbgbAreaConst * MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) S =
        MeasureTheory.volume S)
    (A : E2 →L[ℝ] E3) (hA : Function.Injective A) (S : Set E2) :
    MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (A '' S) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN (⇑A) 0 k ^ 2)) *
        MeasureTheory.volume S

signature.name: sbgb_linear_area
signature.statement:
(hspec : 0 < sbgbAreaConst ∧ ∀ S : Set E2,
      ENNReal.ofReal sbgbAreaConst * MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) S =
        MeasureTheory.volume S)
    (A : E2 →L[ℝ] E3) (hA : Function.Injective A) (S : Set E2) :
    MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (A '' S) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN (⇑A) 0 k ^ 2)) *
        MeasureTheory.volume S

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hc, hsp⟩ := hspec
  
  have hAy : ∀ (y : E2) (i : Fin 3), A y i = y 0 * A (e2 0) i + y 1 * A (e2 1) i := by
    intro y i
    have hdecomp : y = y 0 • e2 0 + y 1 • e2 1 := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hdecomp]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hnormE3 : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hnormE2 : ∀ x : E2, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hext : ∀ x y : E2, x 0 = y 0 → x 1 = y 1 → x = y := by
    intro x y h0 h1
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
  have hlin : ∀ (N : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (z : E2) (i : Fin 2),
      Matrix.toLin (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis
        (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis N z i = N i 0 * z 0 + N i 1 * z 1 := by
    intro N z i
    rw [Matrix.toLin_apply]
    fin_cases i <;> simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  
  obtain ⟨u0, hu0⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, A (e2 0) 0 = r := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u1, hu1⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, A (e2 0) 1 = r := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u2, hu2⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, A (e2 0) 2 = r := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v0, hv0⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, A (e2 1) 0 = r := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v1, hv1⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, A (e2 1) 1 = r := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v2, hv2⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, A (e2 1) 2 = r := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : ∀ y : E2, A y 0 = y 0 * u0 + y 1 * v0 := fun y => by rw [hAy, hu0, hv0]
  have hA1 : ∀ y : E2, A y 1 = y 0 * u1 + y 1 * v1 := fun y => by rw [hAy, hu1, hv1]
  have hA2 : ∀ y : E2, A y 2 = y 0 * u2 + y 1 * v2 := fun y => by rw [hAy, hu2, hv2]
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = u0 ^ 2 + u1 ^ 2 + u2 ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = v0 ^ 2 + v1 ^ 2 + v2 ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = u0 * v0 + u1 * v1 + u2 * v2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hgram : ∀ a γ : ℝ, (a * u0 + γ * v0) ^ 2 + (a * u1 + γ * v1) ^ 2 + (a * u2 + γ * v2) ^ 2 =
      a ^ 2 * P + 2 * a * γ * B + γ ^ 2 * Q := by
    intro a γ
    rw [hP, hQ, hB]
    ring
  have hcross : ∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN (⇑A) 0 k ^ 2 =
      (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) ^ 2 + (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) ^ 2 + (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [gsCrossN, gsTan, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv, Fin.sum_univ_three,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.tail_cons]
    rw [hu0, hu1, hu2, hv0, hv1, hv2]
  have hD : ∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN (⇑A) 0 k ^ 2 = P * Q - B ^ 2 := by
    rw [hcross, hP, hQ, hB]
    ring
  
  have he0 : (e2 0 : E2) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h' := congrArg (fun x : E2 => x 0) h
    simp at h'
  have hPpos : 0 < P := by
    have hune : A (e2 0) ≠ 0 := fun h => he0 (hA (by rw [h, map_zero]))
    have h1 : 0 < ‖A (e2 0)‖ ^ 2 := pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.2 hune) 2
    rw [hnormE3, hu0, hu1, hu2] at h1
    rw [hP]
    exact h1
  have hDpos : 0 < P * Q - B ^ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : E2, w = (-B) • e2 0 + P • e2 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hw0 : w 0 = -B := by simp [hw]
    have hw1 : w 1 = P := by simp [hw]
    have hwne : w ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at hw1
      simp at hw1
      linarith
    have hAw : A w ≠ 0 := fun h => hwne (hA (by rw [h, map_zero]))
    have h1 : 0 < ‖A w‖ ^ 2 := pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.2 hAw) 2
    rw [hnormE3, hA0, hA1, hA2, hw0, hw1, hgram] at h1
    have h2 : (-B) ^ 2 * P + 2 * (-B) * P * B + P ^ 2 * Q = P * (P * Q - B ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [h2] at h1
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    have := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hPpos.le hcon
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = Real.sqrt P := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by rw [hs]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 hPpos
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = P := by rw [hs]; exact Real.sq_sqrt hPpos.le
  have ht0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN (⇑A) 0 k ^ 2) := by
    rw [hD]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 hDpos
  have ht2 : Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN (⇑A) 0 k ^ 2) ^ 2 = P * Q - B ^ 2 := by
    rw [hD]; exact Real.sq_sqrt hDpos.le
  generalize htdef : Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN (⇑A) 0 k ^ 2) = t at ht0 ht2 ⊢
  obtain ⟨si, hsi⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, s * r = 1 := ⟨s⁻¹, mul_inv_cancel₀ hs0.ne'⟩
  obtain ⟨ti, hti⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, t * r = 1 := ⟨t⁻¹, mul_inv_cancel₀ ht0.ne'⟩
  
  obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E2, R = Matrix.toLin (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis !![s, B * si; 0, t * si] := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Ri, hRidef⟩ : ∃ R : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E2, R = Matrix.toLin (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis !![si, -(B * si * ti); 0, s * ti] := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hR0 : ∀ z : E2, R z 0 = s * z 0 + B * si * z 1 := fun z => by rw [hRdef, hlin]; simp
  have hR1 : ∀ z : E2, R z 1 = t * si * z 1 := fun z => by rw [hRdef, hlin]; simp
  have hRi0 : ∀ z : E2, Ri z 0 = si * z 0 + -(B * si * ti) * z 1 := fun z => by
    rw [hRidef, hlin]; simp
  have hRi1 : ∀ z : E2, Ri z 1 = s * ti * z 1 := fun z => by rw [hRidef, hlin]; simp
  have hdet : LinearMap.det R = t := by
    rw [hRdef, LinearMap.det_toLin, Matrix.det_fin_two_of]
    linear_combination t * hsi
  have hRiR : ∀ z : E2, Ri (R z) = z := by
    intro z
    apply hext
    · rw [hRi0, hR0, hR1]
      linear_combination z 0 * hsi - B * si ^ 2 * z 1 * hti
    · rw [hRi1, hR1]
      linear_combination z 1 * t * ti * hsi + z 1 * hti
  
  set Ψ : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E3 := (A : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) ∘ₗ Ri with hΨdef
  have hΨapp : ∀ w : E2, Ψ w = A (Ri w) := fun w => rfl
  have hΨR : ∀ z : E2, Ψ (R z) = A z := fun z => by rw [hΨapp, hRiR]
  have hΨiso : Isometry Ψ := by
    refine AddMonoidHomClass.isometry_of_norm Ψ (fun w => ?_)
    have hsq : ‖Ψ w‖ ^ 2 = ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [hΨapp, hnormE3, hA0, hA1, hA2, hgram, hnormE2, hRi0, hRi1]
      linear_combination ((s * si + 1) * (w 0 - B * ti * w 1) ^ 2 +
          2 * (w 0 - B * ti * w 1) * ti * w 1 * B) * hsi + (t * ti + 1) * w 1 ^ 2 * hti +
        (ti ^ 2 * w 1 ^ 2 * Q - si ^ 2 * (w 0 - B * ti * w 1) ^ 2) * hs2 - ti ^ 2 * w 1 ^ 2 * ht2
    exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).1 hsq
  
  have himg : ⇑A '' S = ⇑Ψ '' (⇑R '' S) := by
    rw [Set.image_image]
    exact Set.image_congr (fun z _ => (hΨR z).symm)
  have hne : ENNReal.ofReal sbgbAreaConst ≠ 0 := (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.2 hc).ne'
  have htop : ENNReal.ofReal sbgbAreaConst ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hμT : ∀ T : Set E2, MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) T =
      (ENNReal.ofReal sbgbAreaConst)⁻¹ * MeasureTheory.volume T := by
    intro T
    rw [← hsp T, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hne htop, one_mul]
  rw [himg, hΨiso.hausdorffMeasure_image (Or.inl (by norm_num)), hμT,
    MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar_image_linearMap, hdet, abs_of_pos ht0,
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul (inv_nonneg.2 hc.le), ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos hc]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(hlin : ∀ (A : E2 →L[ℝ] E3), Function.Injective A → ∀ S : Set E2,

proof.tactics:
by
  set A : E2 →L[ℝ] E3 := fderiv ℝ F x₀ with hAdef
  have hA : Function.Injective A := hdF x₀ hx₀
  
  have hcross : gsCrossN (⇑A) 0 = gsCrossN F x₀ := by
    have h1 : ∀ i, gsTan (⇑A) i 0 = gsTan F i x₀ := by
      intro i
      show (fderiv ℝ (⇑A) 0) (e2 i) = A (e2 i)
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp only [gsCrossN, h1]
  
  have hexp : ∀ x, ∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2 =
      (gsTan F 0 x 1 * gsTan F 1 x 2 - gsTan F 0 x 2 * gsTan F 1 x 1) ^ 2 +
      (gsTan F 0 x 2 * gsTan F 1 x 0 - gsTan F 0 x 0 * gsTan F 1 x 2) ^ 2 +
      (gsTan F 0 x 0 * gsTan F 1 x 1 - gsTan F 0 x 1 * gsTan F 1 x 0) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, gsCrossN]
  
  have hsumpos : 0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2 := by
    rw [hexp x₀]
    have hu : gsTan F 0 x₀ = A (e2 0) := rfl
    have hv : gsTan F 1 x₀ = A (e2 1) := rfl
    rw [hu, hv]
    set u := A (e2 0) with hudef
    set v := A (e2 1) with hvdef
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    have q0 := sq_nonneg (u 1 * v 2 - u 2 * v 1)
    have q1 := sq_nonneg (u 2 * v 0 - u 0 * v 2)
    have q2 := sq_nonneg (u 0 * v 1 - u 1 * v 0)
    have c0 : u 1 * v 2 - u 2 * v 1 = 0 :=
      pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (le_antisymm (by linarith) q0)
    have c1 : u 2 * v 0 - u 0 * v 2 = 0 :=
      pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (le_antisymm (by linarith) q1)
    have c2 : u 0 * v 1 - u 1 * v 0 = 0 :=
      pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (le_antisymm (by linarith) q2)
    set a : ℝ := u 0 ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2 + u 2 ^ 2 with hadef
    set b : ℝ := u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1 + u 2 * v 2 with hbdef
    have hz : A (a • e2 1 - b • e2 0) = A 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, map_zero, ← hudef, ← hvdef]
      ext j
      fin_cases j
      · simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, PiLp.zero_apply]
        simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue]
        linear_combination (-(u 1)) * c2 + u 2 * c1
      · simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, PiLp.zero_apply]
        simp only [Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue]
        linear_combination u 0 * c2 - u 2 * c0
      · simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, PiLp.zero_apply]
        simp only [Fin.reduceFinMk, Fin.isValue]
        linear_combination (-(u 0)) * c1 + u 1 * c0
    have hz' := congrArg (fun w : E2 => w 1) (hA hz)
    simp at hz'
    have ha0 : a = 0 := by simpa using hz'
    rw [hadef] at ha0
    have s0 := sq_nonneg (u 0)
    have s1 := sq_nonneg (u 1)
    have s2 := sq_nonneg (u 2)
    have hu0 : u 0 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (le_antisymm (by linarith) s0)
    have hu1 : u 1 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (le_antisymm (by linarith) s1)
    have hu2 : u 2 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (le_antisymm (by linarith) s2)
    have huz : A (e2 0) = A 0 := by
      rw [map_zero, ← hudef]
      ext j
      fin_cases j
      · simpa using hu0
      · simpa using hu1
      · simpa using hu2
    have he := congrArg (fun w : E2 => w 0) (hA huz)
    simp at he
  have hJ0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hsumpos
  
  have hFd : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ F) x₀ :=
    (hF.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hx₀)
  have ht : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (j : Fin 3), ContinuousAt (fun x => gsTan F i x j) x₀ := by
    intro i j
    have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) x₀ := hFd.clm_apply continuousAt_const
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.continuousAt.comp h1
  have hJc : ContinuousAt (fun x => Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2)) x₀ := by
    have e1 : (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) = fun x =>
        (gsTan F 0 x 1 * gsTan F 1 x 2 - gsTan F 0 x 2 * gsTan F 1 x 1) ^ 2 +
        (gsTan F 0 x 2 * gsTan F 1 x 0 - gsTan F 0 x 0 * gsTan F 1 x 2) ^ 2 +
        (gsTan F 0 x 0 * gsTan F 1 x 1 - gsTan F 0 x 1 * gsTan F 1 x 0) ^ 2 := by
      funext x
      exact hexp x
    have h2 : ContinuousAt (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) x₀ := by
      rw [e1]
      exact (((((ht 0 1).mul (ht 1 2)).sub ((ht 0 2).mul (ht 1 1))).pow 2).add
        ((((ht 0 2).mul (ht 1 0)).sub ((ht 0 0).mul (ht 1 2))).pow 2)).add
        ((((ht 0 0).mul (ht 1 1)).sub ((ht 0 1).mul (ht 1 0))).pow 2)
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.comp h2
  
  obtain ⟨K, hKpos, hK⟩ :=
    LinearMap.exists_antilipschitzWith (A : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hA)
  have hKr : (0 : ℝ) < K := hKpos
  have hcoer : ∀ h : E2, ‖h‖ ≤ K * ‖A h‖ := by
    intro h
    have := hK.le_mul_dist h 0
    simpa [dist_zero_right] using this
  
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hr₁W⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW x₀ hx₀
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hr₂d⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hFd (ε / K) (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨r₃, hr₃, hr₃J⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hJc
    (ε * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2)) (by positivity)
  set r := min r₁ (min r₂ r₃) with hrdef
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hr₁ (lt_min hr₂ hr₃)
  have hrr₁ : r ≤ r₁ := min_le_left _ _
  have hrr₂ : r ≤ r₂ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hrr₃ : r ≤ r₃ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  have hballW : Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ W :=
    (Metric.ball_subset_ball hrr₁).trans hr₁W
  
  have hE : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r,
      (1 - ε) * ‖A (x - y)‖ ≤ ‖F x - F y‖ ∧ ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖A (x - y)‖ := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => F w - A w) z := by
      intro z hz
      have hFz : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z :=
        (hF.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds (hballW hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
      exact hFz.sub A.differentiableAt
    have hbound : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => F w - A w) z‖ ≤ ε / K := by
      intro z hz
      have hFz : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z :=
        (hF.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds (hballW hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun w => F w - A w) (fderiv ℝ F z - A) z :=
        hFz.hasFDerivAt.sub A.hasFDerivAt
      rw [hd.fderiv]
      have hzd : dist z x₀ < r₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hz) hrr₂
      have := hr₂d hzd
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at this
      exact this.le
    have hmvt := (convex_ball x₀ r).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff hbound hy hx
    have hrw : (F x - A x) - (F y - A y) = (F x - F y) - A (x - y) := by
      rw [map_sub]; abel
    rw [hrw] at hmvt
    have hc := hcoer (x - y)
    have hD : ‖(F x - F y) - A (x - y)‖ ≤ ε * ‖A (x - y)‖ := by
      calc ‖(F x - F y) - A (x - y)‖ ≤ ε / K * ‖x - y‖ := hmvt
        _ ≤ ε / K * (K * ‖A (x - y)‖) := by gcongr
        _ = ε * ‖A (x - y)‖ := by field_simp
    have t1 : ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ ‖A (x - y)‖ + ‖(F x - F y) - A (x - y)‖ := by
      have := norm_add_le (A (x - y)) ((F x - F y) - A (x - y))
      simpa using this
    have t2 : ‖A (x - y)‖ ≤ ‖F x - F y‖ + ‖(F x - F y) - A (x - y)‖ := by
      have := norm_sub_le (F x - F y) ((F x - F y) - A (x - y))
      simpa using this
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  have hcoef : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      ((Real.toNNReal t : NNReal) : ENNReal) ^ (2 : ℝ) = ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ 2) := by
    intro t ht
    show ENNReal.ofReal t ^ (2 : ℝ) = ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ 2)
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg ht (by norm_num), Real.rpow_two]
  refine ⟨r, hr, hballW, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have hxd : dist x x₀ < r₃ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hx) hrr₃
    have h := hr₃J hxd
    rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_lt_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  · intro S hS
    have hES : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
        (1 - ε) * ‖A (x - y)‖ ≤ ‖F x - F y‖ ∧ ‖F x - F y‖ ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖A (x - y)‖ :=
      fun x hx y hy => hE x (hS hx) y (hS hy)
    have hL := hlin A hA S
    rw [hcross] at hL
    have h1e : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - ε := by linarith
    
    have hup : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (F '' S) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) ^ 2) * MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (A '' S) := by
      have hGlip : LipschitzOnWith (Real.toNNReal (1 + ε)) (F ∘ Function.invFun A) (A '' S) := by
        apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le'
        rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        simp only [Function.comp, Function.leftInverse_invFun hA x,
          Function.leftInverse_invFun hA y, dist_eq_norm]
        rw [← map_sub]
        exact (hES x hx y hy).2
      have himg : (F ∘ Function.invFun A) '' (A '' S) = F '' S := by
        rw [Set.image_image]
        apply Set.image_congr
        intro x _
        simp only [Function.comp, Function.leftInverse_invFun hA x]
      have := hGlip.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
      rw [himg, hcoef _ (by linarith)] at this
      exact this
    
    have hinj : Set.InjOn F S := by
      intro x hx y hy hxy
      have h := (hES x hx y hy).1
      rw [hxy, sub_self, norm_zero] at h
      have hn : ‖A (x - y)‖ = 0 := by
        have := norm_nonneg (A (x - y))
        nlinarith
      have h0 : A (x - y) = A 0 := by rw [map_zero]; exact norm_eq_zero.mp hn
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hA h0)
    have hlow : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (A '' S) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε)⁻¹ ^ 2) * MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (F '' S) := by
      have hli := hinj.leftInvOn_invFunOn
      have hHlip : LipschitzOnWith (Real.toNNReal (1 - ε)⁻¹) (⇑A ∘ Function.invFunOn F S)
          (F '' S) := by
        apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le'
        rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        simp only [Function.comp, hli hx, hli hy, dist_eq_norm]
        rw [← map_sub, le_inv_mul_iff₀ h1e]
        exact (hES x hx y hy).1
      have himg : (⇑A ∘ Function.invFunOn F S) '' (F '' S) = A '' S := by
        rw [Set.image_image]
        apply Set.image_congr
        intro x hx
        simp only [Function.comp, hli hx]
      have := hHlip.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
      rw [himg, hcoef _ (by positivity)] at this
      exact this
    rw [← hL]
    exact ⟨hup, hlow⟩

                (ENNReal.ofReal (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2)) *

            ENNReal.ofReal (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2)) *

  have hy₀S : y₀ ∈ Φ.source ∩ O := ⟨hy₀Φ, hy₀O⟩

  have hc : 0 < |fderiv ℝ f y₀ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| := abs_pos.mpr ha
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hcl⟩ :=
    Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (hcont.continuousAt (hU.mem_nhds hy₀)) _ (half_pos hc)
  have hδ : 0 < min δ₁ δ₂ := lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂
  obtain ⟨r, hrdef⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = min δ₁ δ₂ / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hr : 0 < r := by rw [hrdef]; exact half_pos hδ
  have hrlt : r < min δ₁ δ₂ := by rw [hrdef]; exact half_lt_self hδ
  have hcb : Metric.closedBall y₀ r ⊆ Metric.ball y₀ (min δ₁ δ₂) :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hrlt
  have hcbS : Metric.closedBall y₀ r ⊆ Φ.source ∩ O := fun y hy =>
    hball (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _) (hcb hy))
  have hbS : Metric.ball y₀ r ⊆ Φ.source ∩ O := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hcbS
  have hcbU : Metric.closedBall y₀ r ⊆ U := fun y hy => hOU (hcbS hy).2
  have hG2 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall y₀ r, |fderiv ℝ f y₀ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| / 2 ≤
      |fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : dist y y₀ < δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp (hcb hy)) (min_le_left _ _)
    have h2 : |fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) -
        fderiv ℝ f y₀ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| <
        |fderiv ℝ f y₀ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| / 2 := by
      have := hcl h1
      rwa [Real.dist_eq] at this
    have h3 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (fderiv ℝ f y₀ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)))
      (fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)))
    have h4 := abs_sub_comm (fderiv ℝ f y₀ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)))
      (fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)))
    linarith
  have hG3 : IsOpen (Θ '' Metric.ball y₀ r) := by
    rw [← hΦ]
    exact Φ.isOpen_image_of_subset_source Metric.isOpen_ball (fun y hy => (hbS hy).1)
  have hG4 : Bornology.IsBounded (Θ '' Metric.ball y₀ r) :=
    ((isCompact_closedBall y₀ r).image_of_continuousOn
      (hΘs.continuousOn.mono hcbU)).isBounded.subset
      (Set.image_mono Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
  have hG5 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ r, Φ.symm (Θ y) = y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [← hΦ]
    exact Φ.left_inv (hbS hy).1
  have hG6 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ.symm (Θ '' Metric.ball y₀ r) := by
    rintro z ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hyS := hbS hy
    have hz : Θ y ∈ Φ.target := by
      rw [← hΦ]; exact Φ.map_source hyS.1
    have hsy : Φ.symm (Θ y) = y := hG5 y hy
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
        ((A y).toContinuousLinearEquivOfDetNeZero (hdetO y hyS.2) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (Φ.symm (Θ y)) := by
      rw [hsy, hΦ]; exact hT y hyS.2
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
        (Φ.symm (Θ y)) := by
      rw [hsy, hΦ]; exact hC1 y (hOU hyS.2)
    exact (Φ.contDiffAt_symm hz h1 h2).contDiffWithinAt
  subst hΘ
  exact ⟨r, |fderiv ℝ f y₀ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| / 2, Φ.symm, hr, half_pos hc, hcbU,
    hG2, hG3, hG4, hG5, hG6⟩

proof.tactics:
by
  intro a S hS G hG
  let e : (ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ≃ᵐ EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) :=
    (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) a).symm.trans
      (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 3 → ℝ))
  have he : ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ),
      e (t, x) = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) := fun t x => rfl
  have hmp : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving (⇑e) MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume :=
    (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 3)).comp
      ((MeasureTheory.volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) a).symm)
  have hF : MeasureTheory.Integrable (S.indicator G) := hG.integrable_indicator hS
  have hFe : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun p : ℝ × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => S.indicator G (e p))
      ((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ).prod
        (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ))) :=
    hmp.integrable_comp_of_integrable hF
  have hslice : ∀ t : ℝ, ∫ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, S.indicator G (e (t, x)) = ∫ x in {x : Fin 2 → ℝ |
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈ S},
        G ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)) := by
    intro t
    have hm : Measurable (fun x : Fin 2 → ℝ => e (t, x)) :=
      e.measurable.comp measurable_prodMk_left
    have hSt : MeasurableSet {x : Fin 2 → ℝ |
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x) ∈ S} := hS.preimage hm
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hSt]
    congr 1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · refine hFe.integral_prod_left.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t => ?_)
    exact hslice t
  · calc ∫ z in S, G z = ∫ z, S.indicator G z := (MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hS).symm
      _ = ∫ p, S.indicator G (e p) ∂((MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ).prod
            (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ))) :=
          (hmp.integral_comp' (S.indicator G)).symm
      _ = ∫ t : ℝ, ∫ x : Fin 2 → ℝ, S.indicator G (e (t, x)) :=
          MeasureTheory.integral_prod _ hFe
      _ = _ := MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hslice)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro hnorm a f H W hW x hx hH hfd t hlev ha
  set ℓ := fderiv ℝ f ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a (H x) x)) with hℓ
  set φ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) :=
    fun x' => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a (H x') x') with hφ
  have hdec : φ = fun x' => H x' • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ) +
      (x' 0 • EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove 0) (1:ℝ) +
        x' 1 • EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove 1) (1:ℝ)) := by
    funext x'
    ext i
    rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove a i with rfl | ⟨m, rfl⟩
    · simp [φ, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    · fin_cases m <;>
        simp [φ, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_right_injective.eq_iff]
  set Λ : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) :=
    (fderiv ℝ H x).smulRight (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) +
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj 0 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
        (EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove 0) (1:ℝ)) +
       (ContinuousLinearMap.proj 1 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
        (EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove 1) (1:ℝ))) with hΛ
  have hφd : HasFDerivAt φ Λ x := by
    rw [hdec]
    refine (hH.hasFDerivAt.smul_const _).add ?_
    exact (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj 0 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt).smul_const _).add
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj 1 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt).smul_const _)
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (f ∘ φ) (ℓ.comp Λ) x := hfd.hasFDerivAt.comp x hφd
  have hconst : HasFDerivAt (f ∘ φ) (0 : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
    have hev : Filter.EventuallyEq (nhds x) (f ∘ φ) (fun _ => t) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun x' hx' => hlev x' hx')
    exact (hasFDerivAt_const t x).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hzero : ℓ.comp Λ = 0 := hcomp.unique hconst
  have hΛk : ∀ k : Fin 2, Λ (Pi.single k 1) = fderiv ℝ H x (Pi.single k 1) •
      EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ) + EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove k) (1:ℝ) := by
    intro k
    fin_cases k <;> simp [Λ]
  have hkey : ∀ k : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ H x (Pi.single k 1) * ℓ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) +
      ℓ (EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove k) (1:ℝ)) = 0 := by
    intro k
    have h := congrArg (fun L => L (Pi.single k (1:ℝ))) hzero
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, hΛk, map_add,
      map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h
    exact h
  have hA : ∀ k : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ H x (Pi.single k 1) =
      -(ℓ (EuclideanSpace.single (a.succAbove k) (1:ℝ))) / ℓ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) := by
    intro k
    rw [eq_div_iff ha]
    linarith [hkey k]
  refine ⟨hA, ?_⟩
  simp only [hA]
  rw [hnorm ℓ, Fin.sum_univ_succAbove _ a]
  have hpos : 0 < ℓ (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) ^ 2 := by positivity
  rw [← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, ← Real.sqrt_div' _ hpos.le]
  congr 1
  rw [add_div, div_self hpos.ne', Finset.sum_div]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
  rw [div_pow, neg_sq]

      (∀ j : Fin 2, u (a.succAbove j) = v (a.succAbove j)) → u = v := by
    intro u v h1 h2

      (y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) a = f y := by
    intro y; simp

      (y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) (a.succAbove j) = y (a.succAbove j) := by
    intro y j
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne]
  have hPa : ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a s x) a = s := by
    intro s x; simp

      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a s x) (a.succAbove j) = x j := by
    intro s x j; simp
  have hinv : ∀ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) (x : Fin 2 → ℝ),

  have hmem : ∀ (F : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))), F ⊆ V → ∀ x : Fin 2 → ℝ,

        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm (Fin.insertNth a t x)) :=

by
  intro hdet a U hU f hf V hVU hVb m hm hmV Ξ hΞ E ψ B hE hEV hψ hB
  set T : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) :=
    fun y => y + (f y - y a) • EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ) with hTdef
  set T' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) :=
    fun y => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) +
      (fderiv ℝ f y - (EuclideanSpace.proj a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) →L[ℝ] ℝ)).smulRight
        (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) with hT'def
  have s1 : ∀ y ∈ E, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y := fun y hy =>
    (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hVU (hEV hy)))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have s2 : ∀ y ∈ E, HasFDerivWithinAt T (T' y) E y := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun x => f x - (EuclideanSpace.proj a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) →L[ℝ] ℝ) x)
        (fderiv ℝ f y - (EuclideanSpace.proj a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) y :=
      (s1 y hy).hasFDerivAt.sub (EuclideanSpace.proj a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have h2 := h1.smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))
    have h3 := (hasFDerivAt_id y).add h2
    have h4 : HasFDerivAt T (T' y) y := by
      convert h3 using 1
    exact h4.hasFDerivWithinAt
  have s3 : Set.InjOn T E := by
    intro y₁ h₁ y₂ h₂ heq
    rw [← hΞ y₁ (hEV h₁), ← hΞ y₂ (hEV h₂)]
    exact congrArg Ξ heq
  have s4 : MeasurableSet (T '' E) :=
    MeasureTheory.measurable_image_of_fderivWithin hE s2 s3
  have s6 : ∀ y ∈ E, |(T' y).det| • (fun z => ψ (Ξ z) /
      |fderiv ℝ f (Ξ z) (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))|) (T y) = ψ y := by
    intro y hy
    have hdy : (T' y).det = fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ)) := hdet a (fderiv ℝ f y)
    have hX : Ξ (T y) = y := hΞ y (hEV hy)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hdy, hX]
    have hc : |fderiv ℝ f y (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))| ≠ 0 :=
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hm (hmV y (hEV hy))).ne'
    exact mul_div_cancel₀ (ψ y) hc
  have s7 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn ψ E := by
    have hfin : MeasureTheory.volume E < ⊤ := (hVb.subset hEV).measure_lt_top
    have hbound : ∀ᵐ y ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict E), ‖ψ y‖ ≤ B :=
      MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hE (fun y hy => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hB y hy)
    exact MeasureTheory.Measure.integrableOn_of_bounded hfin.ne hψ.aestronglyMeasurable hbound
  have s8 := MeasureTheory.integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_det_fderiv_smul
    (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hE s2 s3
    (fun z => ψ (Ξ z) / |fderiv ℝ f (Ξ z) (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))|)
  have s9 := MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul
    (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hE s2 s3
    (fun z => ψ (Ξ z) / |fderiv ℝ f (Ξ z) (EuclideanSpace.single a (1:ℝ))|)
  refine ⟨s4, s8.mpr (s7.congr_fun (fun y hy => (s6 y hy).symm) hE), ?_⟩
  rw [s9]
  exact (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hE (fun y hy => s6 y hy)).symm

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hρA, hχs, hχ0, -, hχt, hcase⟩ := hA
  
  have hfar : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∉ K := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀, hcl⟩ := endChart_far_isClosed g hAF j
    let O : ℕ → Set M := fun m => ((hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖})ᶜ
    have hOo : ∀ m, IsOpen (O m) := fun m =>
      (hcl _ (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_nonneg m))).isOpen_compl
    have hOmono : Monotone O := by
      intro m m' hmm' p hp
      simp only [O, Set.mem_compl_iff] at hp ⊢
      intro hp'
      apply hp
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzp⟩ := hp'
      refine ⟨z, ?_, hzp⟩
      have h1 : (m : ℝ) ≤ m' := Nat.cast_le.2 hmm'
      have h2 : ρ₀ + (m' : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ := hz
      show ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖
      linarith
    have hcovK : K ⊆ ⋃ m, O m := by
      intro p _
      by_contra hne
      have hmem : ∀ m : ℕ, p ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖} := fun m =>
        Classical.byContradiction fun h => hne (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨m, h⟩)
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hpz₀⟩ := hmem 0
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_gt (‖z₀‖ - ρ₀)
      obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁, hpz₁⟩ := hmem m
      have h0 : ρ₀ + ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ‖z₀‖ := hz₀
      have h1 : ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖z₁‖ := hz₁
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] at h0
      have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg m
      have hz₀s : z₀ ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
        rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖z₀‖; linarith
      have hz₁s : z₁ ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
        rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖z₁‖; linarith
      have heq : z₀ = z₁ :=
        (hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.injOn hz₀s hz₁s (hpz₀.trans hpz₁.symm)
      rw [← heq] at h1
      linarith
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hK.elim_directed_cover O hOo hcovK hOmono.directed_le
    refine ⟨ρ₀ + N, fun y hy hyK => hN hyK ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩⟩
    show ρ₀ + (N : ℝ) ≤ ‖y‖
    linarith
  
  have hD : ∀ ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source := by
    intro ψ
    have hGc : ContinuousOn (g.coeff ψ) ψ.source :=
      continuousOn_pi.2 fun a => continuousOn_pi.2 fun c =>
        (coeff_contDiffOn_source g ψ a c).continuousOn
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn ((continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hGc)
  have hH : ∀ i, ContinuousOn
      (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source := by
    intro i
    exact (((hχs i).continuous.comp_continuousOn
      (κ i).contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn).mul (hG (κ i))).mul (hD (κ i))
  
  have hZ : ∀ i, ∃ Z : Set E3, IsCompact Z ∧ Z ⊆ (κ i).source ∧
      ∀ y ∈ (κ i).source, y ∉ Z →
        χ i (κ i y) * G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det = 0 := by
    intro i
    rcases hcase i with hc | ⟨j, hκ, -, h0⟩
    · refine ⟨(κ i).toPartialEquiv.symm '' tsupport (χ i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact hc.image_of_continuousOn
          ((κ i).toOpenPartialHomeomorph.continuousOn_symm.mono (hχt i))
      · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.map_target (hχt i hx)
      · intro y hy hyZ
        have hns : κ i y ∉ tsupport (χ i) := by
          intro hmem
          exact hyZ ⟨κ i y, hmem, (κ i).toPartialEquiv.left_inv hy⟩
        rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hns, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    · obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hfar j
      refine ⟨{y : E3 | ρA ≤ ‖y‖} ∩ {y : E3 | ‖y‖ ≤ max R ρA}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) (max R ρA)).of_isClosed_subset
          ((isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
            (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)) ?_
        intro y hy
        rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
        exact hy.2
      · intro y hy
        have h1 : ρA ≤ ‖y‖ := hy.1
        rw [hκ, (hAF.ends j).source_eq]
        show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
        linarith
      · intro y hy hyZ
        rw [hκ] at hy ⊢
        have hy1 : (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := by
          have h2 := hy
          rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq] at h2
          exact h2
        by_cases hle : ‖y‖ ≤ ρA
        · rw [h0 y hy1 hle, zero_mul, zero_mul]
        · have hgt : max R ρA < ‖y‖ := by
            by_contra hc'
            exact hyZ ⟨le_of_lt (not_le.1 hle), not_lt.1 hc'⟩
          rw [hGK _ (hR y (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hgt)), mul_zero, zero_mul]
  
  have hInt : ∀ C : Set M, IsClosed C → ∀ i, IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * C.indicator G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det)
      (κ i).source := by
    intro C hC i
    obtain ⟨Z, hZc, hZS, hZ0⟩ := hZ i
    have h1 : IntegrableOn
        (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source :=
      (((hH i).mono hZS).integrableOn_compact hZc).of_forall_diff_eq_zero
        (κ i).open_source.measurableSet (fun y hy => hZ0 y hy.1 hy.2)
    have hmeas : MeasurableSet ((κ i).source ∩ κ i ⁻¹' C) := by
      have hopen : IsOpen ((κ i).source ∩ κ i ⁻¹' Cᶜ) :=
        (κ i).contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (κ i).open_source
          hC.isOpen_compl
      have heq : (κ i).source ∩ κ i ⁻¹' C = (κ i).source \ ((κ i).source ∩ κ i ⁻¹' Cᶜ) := by
        ext y
        simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff]
        tauto
      rw [heq]
      exact (κ i).open_source.measurableSet.diff hopen.measurableSet
    refine (h1.indicator hmeas).congr_fun ?_ (κ i).open_source.measurableSet
    intro y hy
    by_cases hc : κ i y ∈ C
    · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy, hc]
    · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy, hc]
  
  have hpt : ∀ p, T.indicator G p ≤ ∑ r ∈ t, (Tr r).indicator G p := by
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p ∈ T
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcov hp)
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hp]
      calc G p = (Tr r).indicator G p := (Set.indicator_of_mem hpr G).symm
        _ ≤ ∑ r ∈ t, (Tr r).indicator G p :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun r => (Tr r).indicator G p)
            (fun r _ => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun q _ => hG0 q) p) hr
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hp]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun r _ => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun q _ => hG0 q) p
  
  unfold atlasInt
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
  have hmono : ∫ y in (κ i).source,
        χ i (κ i y) * T.indicator G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det ≤
      ∫ y in (κ i).source, ∑ r ∈ t,
        χ i (κ i y) * (Tr r).indicator G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det := by
    refine setIntegral_mono_on (hInt T hT i)
      (integrable_finset_sum t fun r _ => hInt (Tr r) (hTr r) i)
      (κ i).open_source.measurableSet ?_
    intro y _
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpt _) (hχ0 i _))
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  exact hmono.trans_eq (integral_finset_sum t fun r _ => hInt (Tr r) (hTr r) i)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ)
    (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (L : Set E3) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hLψ : L ⊆ ψ.source) (G : M → ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ ψ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => G (ψ' y)) ψ'.source)
    (hG0 : ∀ p, 0 ≤ G p) (C : Set M) (hC : IsClosed C) (hCL : C ⊆ ψ '' L) :
    atlasInt g κ χ (C.indicator G) ≤ ∫ y in L, G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)

    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ)
    (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (L : Set E3) (hL : IsCompact L)
    (hLψ : L ⊆ ψ.source) (G : M → ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ ψ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => G (ψ' y)) ψ'.source)
    (hG0 : ∀ p, 0 ≤ G p) (C : Set M) (hC : IsClosed C) (hCL : C ⊆ ψ '' L) :
    atlasInt g κ χ (C.indicator G) ≤ ∫ y in L, G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, hχs, hχ0, hχ1, _, _⟩ := hA
  have h1 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast le_top
  
  have hexp : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
    intro v
    have := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr v
    simpa using this.symm
  have hexpB : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (w1 w2 : E3),
      B (D w1) (D w2) = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
    intro B D w1 w2
    calc B (D w1) (D w2)
        = B (D (∑ a : Fin 3, w1 a • e a)) (D (∑ b : Fin 3, w2 b • e b)) := by
          rw [← hexp w1, ← hexp w2]
      _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
          simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          ring
  
  have hcsm : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff ψ x i j) ψ.source := by
    intro i j
    have hΦ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ ψ ψ.source := ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro x0 hx0
    have hu : IsOpen (ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).source) :=
      hΦ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage ψ.open_source (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).open_source
    have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y))
        (ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).source) := by
      have h1 := (contMDiffOn_iff_target.mp hΦ).2 (ψ x0)
      rw [extChartAt_source] at h1
      have h2 := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
      simpa [extChartAt_coe, Function.comp_def] using h2
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y))
        (ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).source) (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).target :=
      fun y hy => (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).map_source hy.2
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y)))
        (ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).source) :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hu).mp hF).2
    have hcoord : ∀ k a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun x => (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y)) x (e k)) a)
        (ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).source) := by
      intro k a
      have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y)) x (e k))
          (ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).source) := hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
    have hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun x => g.coeff (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x)) a b)
        (ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).source) :=
      fun a b => (g.smooth (ψ x0) a b).comp hF hmaps
    have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y)) x (e i)) a *
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y)) x (e j)) b *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x)) a b)
        (ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).source) := by
      apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro a _
      apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro b _
      exact ((hcoord i a).mul (hcoord j b)).mul (hGs a b)
    have keyc : ∀ x ∈ ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).source,
        g.coeff ψ x i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y)) x (e i)) a *
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y)) x (e j)) b *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x)) a b := by
      intro x hx
      have hcont : ContinuousAt ψ x :=
        hΦ.continuousOn.continuousAt (ψ.open_source.mem_nhds hx.1)
      have hFdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y)) x :=
        (hF.contDiffAt (hu.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hFx : chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x) ∈ (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).target := hmaps hx
      have hev : (ψ : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          ((chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm ∘ fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y)) := by
        have hmem : (ψ : E3 → M) ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).source ∈ 𝓝 x :=
          hcont.preimage_mem_nhds ((chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).open_source.mem_nhds hx.2)
        filter_upwards [hmem] with y hy
        simp only [Function.comp_apply]
        exact ((chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).left_inv hy).symm
      have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm
          (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x)) :=
        ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (n := ∞)).contMDiffAt
          ((chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).open_target.mem_nhds hFx)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
      have hfac : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ x v =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x))
            (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ y)) x v) := by
        intro v
        rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp x hg hFdiff.mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
        rfl
      have hpt : (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x)) = ψ x :=
        (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).left_inv hx.2
      have h1 : g.coeff ψ x i j = g.g (ψ x) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ x (e i))
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ x (e j)) := rfl
      have h2 : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x)) a b =
          g.g (ψ x)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x)) (e a))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x))
              (e b)) := by
        intro a b
        show g.g ((chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x))) _ _ = _
        rw [show g.g ((chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x))) = g.g (ψ x) from
          congrArg g.g hpt]
      rw [h1, hfac, hfac]
      simp only [h2]
      exact hexpB (g.g (ψ x))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (ψ x0) (ψ x)))
        _ _
    refine ⟨ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (ψ x0)).source, hu,
      ⟨hx0, mem_chart_source E3 (ψ x0)⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.inter_eq_right.mpr Set.inter_subset_left]
    exact hR.congr keyc
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source := by
    have hGc : ContinuousOn (g.coeff ψ) ψ.source :=
      continuousOn_pi.2 fun a => continuousOn_pi.2 fun c => (hcsm a c).continuousOn
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn ((continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hGc)
  have hgL : ∀ i, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (ψ y) * G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) L :=
    fun i => (((((hχs i).continuous.comp_continuousOn ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn).mul
      (hG ψ)).mul hdetc).mono hLψ).integrableOn_compact hL
  
  have key : ∀ i, ∫ z in (κ i).source,
      χ i (κ i z) * C.indicator G (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det ≤
      ∫ y in L, χ i (ψ y) * G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set E3, Ω = ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (κ i).target := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΩmem : ∀ y, y ∈ Ω ↔ y ∈ ψ.source ∧ ψ y ∈ (κ i).target := by
      intro y; rw [hΩ]; rfl
    have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by
      rw [hΩ]
      exact ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage ψ.open_source
        (κ i).open_target
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ : ∃ τ : E3 → E3, τ = fun y => (κ i).toPartialEquiv.symm (ψ y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hτsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ Ω := by
      rw [hτ, hΩ]
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (ContMDiffOn.comp (κ i).contMDiffOn_invFun
        (ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hy.2))
    have hτd : ∀ y ∈ Ω, DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y := fun y hy =>
      (hτsm.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hy)
    have hκτ : ∀ y ∈ Ω, κ i (τ y) = ψ y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hτ]
      exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.right_inv ((hΩmem y).1 hy).2
    have hτmem : ∀ y ∈ Ω, τ y ∈ (κ i).source := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hτ]
      exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.map_target ((hΩmem y).1 hy).2
    
    have hjac : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det =
        |(fderiv ℝ τ y).det| * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) (τ y)).det := by
      intro y hy
      have hmdκ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) :=
        ((κ i).contMDiffOn_toFun.contMDiffAt
          ((κ i).open_source.mem_nhds (hτmem y hy))).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
      have hmdτ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) τ y := (hτd y hy).mdifferentiableAt
      have heq : (ψ : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (κ i) ∘ τ := by
        filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        exact (hκτ z hz).symm
      have hmf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ y) := by
        rw [heq.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp y hmdκ hmdτ, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
          J = Matrix.of fun a b => fderiv ℝ τ y (e b) a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hcoeff : g.coeff ψ y = J.transpose * g.coeff (κ i) (τ y) * J := by
        ext a b
        have hl : g.coeff ψ y a b = g.g (ψ y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) (fderiv ℝ τ y (e a)))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) (fderiv ℝ τ y (e b))) := by
          show g.g (ψ y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y (e a))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y (e b)) = _
          rw [hmf]
          rfl
        have hr : ∀ a' b' : Fin 3, g.coeff (κ i) (τ y) a' b' =
            (g.g (ψ y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)
              ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (e a'))
              ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (e b')) := by
          intro a' b'
          show g.g (κ i (τ y)) _ _ = _
          rw [hκτ y hy]
          try rfl
        have hl2 : g.coeff ψ y a b = ∑ a' : Fin 3, ∑ b' : Fin 3,
            fderiv ℝ τ y (e a) a' * fderiv ℝ τ y (e b) b' * g.coeff (κ i) (τ y) a' b' := by
          rw [hl]
          refine (hexpB (g.g (ψ y)) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y)) _ _).trans ?_
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b' _ => ?_
          exact congrArg _ (hr a' b').symm
        rw [hl2]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply,
          Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      have hdetJ : J.det = (fderiv ℝ τ y).det := by
        show J.det = LinearMap.det ((fderiv ℝ τ y : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)
        rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis]
        congr 1
        try (ext a b; rw [hJ, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]; simp)
      rw [hcoeff, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, hdetJ]
      rw [show (fderiv ℝ τ y).det * (g.coeff (κ i) (τ y)).det * (fderiv ℝ τ y).det =
          (fderiv ℝ τ y).det ^ 2 * (g.coeff (κ i) (τ y)).det by ring]
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    
    have hEm : MeasurableSet (L ∩ Ω) := hL.isClosed.measurableSet.inter hΩo.measurableSet
    have hEΩ : L ∩ Ω ⊆ Ω := Set.inter_subset_right
    have hτinj : Set.InjOn τ (L ∩ Ω) := by
      intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ h
      have h' : ψ y₁ = ψ y₂ := by
        rw [← hκτ y₁ (hEΩ hy₁), ← hκτ y₂ (hEΩ hy₂), h]
      exact ψ.toPartialEquiv.injOn ((hΩmem y₁).1 (hEΩ hy₁)).1 ((hΩmem y₂).1 (hEΩ hy₂)).1 h'
    
    have hs3 : ∫ z in (κ i).source,
        χ i (κ i z) * C.indicator G (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det =
        ∫ z in τ '' (L ∩ Ω),
        χ i (κ i z) * C.indicator G (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det := by
      refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (κ i).open_source.measurableSet
        ?_ ?_
      · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact hτmem y (hEΩ hy)
      · rintro z ⟨hzS, hzn⟩
        by_cases hzC : κ i z ∈ C
        · exfalso
          obtain ⟨y, hyL, hyz⟩ := hCL hzC
          have hyt : ψ y ∈ (κ i).target := by
            rw [hyz]; exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.map_source hzS
          have hyΩ : y ∈ Ω := (hΩmem y).2 ⟨hLψ hyL, hyt⟩
          apply hzn
          refine ⟨y, ⟨hyL, hyΩ⟩, ?_⟩
          rw [hτ]
          show (κ i).toPartialEquiv.symm (ψ y) = z
          rw [hyz]
          exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.left_inv hzS
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hzC]
          ring
    
    have hs4 : ∫ z in τ '' (L ∩ Ω),
        χ i (κ i z) * C.indicator G (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det =
        ∫ y in L ∩ Ω, χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
      rw [integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hEm
        (fun y hy => (hτd y (hEΩ hy)).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hτinj]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hEm (fun y hy => ?_)
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hκτ y (hEΩ hy), hjac y (hEΩ hy)]
      ring
    
    have hpt : ∀ y, 0 ≤ χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det ∧
        χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det ≤
          χ i (ψ y) * G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det ∧
        0 ≤ χ i (ψ y) * G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
      intro y
      refine ⟨mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hχ0 i _) (Set.indicator_nonneg (fun q _ => hG0 q) _))
          (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), ?_,
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hχ0 i _) (hG0 _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)⟩
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Set.indicator_le_self' (fun q _ => hG0 q) _) (hχ0 i _))
        (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have h5a : ∫ y in L ∩ Ω, χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det ≤
        ∫ y in L ∩ Ω, χ i (ψ y) * G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det :=
      integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => (hpt y).1)
        ((hgL i).mono_set Set.inter_subset_left)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => (hpt y).2.1)
    have h5b : ∫ y in L ∩ Ω, χ i (ψ y) * G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det ≤
        ∫ y in L, χ i (ψ y) * G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det :=
      setIntegral_mono_set (hgL i) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => (hpt y).2.2)
        (Set.inter_subset_left : L ∩ Ω ⊆ L).eventuallyLE
    rw [hs3, hs4]
    exact h5a.trans h5b
  
  unfold atlasInt
  calc ∑ i, ∫ z in (κ i).source,
        χ i (κ i z) * C.indicator G (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det
      ≤ ∑ i, ∫ y in L, χ i (ψ y) * G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => key i
    _ = ∫ y in L, ∑ i, χ i (ψ y) * G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det :=
        (integral_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hgL i).symm
    _ = ∫ y in L, G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
        congr 1
        funext y
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, hχ1, one_mul]

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hcont : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun y : E3 => y i) := fun i => by fun_prop
  let Qc : E3 → ℝ → Set E3 := fun c s => {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, c i - s ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ c i + s}
  let Qo : E3 → ℝ → Set E3 := fun c s => {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, c i - s < y i ∧ y i < c i + s}
  have hF1 : ∀ (c : E3) (s : ℝ), 0 ≤ s → Qc c s ⊆ Metric.closedBall c (2 * s) := by
    intro c s hs y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, EuclideanSpace.dist_eq]
    have h : ∀ i, dist (y i) (c i) ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      intro i
      have h1 := hy i
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have h2 : |y i - c i| ≤ s := abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [h1.1], by linarith [h1.2]⟩
      have h3 : |y i - c i| ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h2 2
      exact h3
    have h4 : ∑ i : Fin 3, dist (y i) (c i) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * s) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      nlinarith [h 0, h 1, h 2, sq_nonneg s]
    calc Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, dist (y i) (c i) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((2 * s) ^ 2) :=
          Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h4
      _ = 2 * s := Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)
  have hQo_open : ∀ (c : E3) (s : ℝ), IsOpen (Qo c s) := by
    intro c s
    have : Qo c s = ⋂ i : Fin 3, {y : E3 | c i - s < y i ∧ y i < c i + s} := by
      ext y; simp [Qo]
    rw [this]
    exact isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i =>
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (hcont i)).inter (isOpen_lt (hcont i) continuous_const)
  have hQc_closed : ∀ (c : E3) (s : ℝ), IsClosed (Qc c s) := by
    intro c s
    have : Qc c s = ⋂ i : Fin 3, {y : E3 | c i - s ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ c i + s} := by
      ext y; simp [Qc]
    rw [this]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun i =>
      (isClosed_le continuous_const (hcont i)).inter (isClosed_le (hcont i) continuous_const)
  have hQc_cpt : ∀ (c : E3) (s : ℝ), 0 ≤ s → IsCompact (Qc c s) := fun c s hs =>
    (isCompact_closedBall c (2 * s)).of_isClosed_subset (hQc_closed c s) (hF1 c s hs)
  have hQoQc : ∀ (c : E3) (s : ℝ), Qo c s ⊆ Qc c s :=
    fun c s y hy i => ⟨(hy i).1.le, (hy i).2.le⟩
  have hQaSrc : Qc ca sa ⊆ ψa.source := (hF1 ca sa hsa.le).trans hBa
  have hQbSrc : Qc cb sb ⊆ ψb.source := (hF1 cb sb hsb.le).trans hBb
  
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨za, hza, hpa⟩, ⟨y', hy', hpb⟩⟩ := hov
  have hGa : IsOpen (ψa '' Qo ca sa) :=
    ψa.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source (hQo_open _ _)
      ((hQoQc _ _).trans hQaSrc)
  have hWb : IsOpen (Qo cb sb ∩ (ψb.source ∩ ψb ⁻¹' (ψa '' Qo ca sa))) :=
    (hQo_open _ _).inter
      (ψb.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage ψb.open_source hGa)
  have hy'W : y' ∈ Qo cb sb ∩ (ψb.source ∩ ψb ⁻¹' (ψa '' Qo ca sa)) :=
    ⟨hy', hQbSrc (hQoQc _ _ hy'), ⟨za, hza, hpa.trans hpb.symm⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hWb y' hy'W
  have ht : 0 < ε / 4 := by positivity
  have hE'W : Qc y' (ε / 4) ⊆ Qo cb sb ∩ (ψb.source ∩ ψb ⁻¹' (ψa '' Qo ca sa)) :=
    (hF1 y' (ε / 4) ht.le).trans ((Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball)
  have hE'Qb : Qc y' (ε / 4) ⊆ Qc cb sb := fun y hy => hQoQc _ _ (hE'W hy).1
  have hE'cpt : IsCompact (Qc y' (ε / 4)) := hQc_cpt _ _ ht.le
  have hE's : Qc y' (ε / 4) ⊆ ψb.source := fun y hy => (hE'W hy).2.1
  have hδ : ∀ y ∈ Qc y' (ε / 4), ψb y ∈ ψa.target ∧ ψa.symm (ψb y) ∈ Qc ca sa := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hE'W hy).2.2
    have hzs : z ∈ ψa.source := hQaSrc (hQoQc _ _ hz)
    have h1 : ψa.symm (ψa z) = z := ψa.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hzs
    have h2 : ψa z ∈ ψa.target := ψa.toPartialEquiv.map_source hzs
    rw [← hzy]
    exact ⟨h2, by rw [h1]; exact hQoQc _ _ hz⟩
  
  obtain ⟨CE, hCE, hCEb⟩ := cps_cube_energy g hAF ρA κ χ hA ψb cb sb hsb hBb
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hKb⟩ := cps_cross_chart_l2 g ψa ψb (Qc y' (ε / 4)) (Qc ca sa) hE'cpt hE's
    (fun y hy => (hδ y hy).1) (hQc_cpt _ _ hsa.le) hQaSrc (fun y hy => (hδ y hy).2)
  obtain ⟨Ca, hCa, hCab⟩ := hgood
  have hAbox : 0 ≤ (2 * sb / (ε / 4)) ^ 3 +
      8 * sb ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * sb / (ε / 4) + (2 * sb / (ε / 4)) ^ 2) := by positivity
  refine ⟨((2 * sb / (ε / 4)) ^ 3 +
      8 * sb ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * sb / (ε / 4) + (2 * sb / (ε / 4)) ^ 2)) * (K * Ca + CE),
    mul_nonneg hAbox (add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK hCa) hCE), ?_⟩
  
  intro u hu hus
  have hU : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z => u (ψb z)) ψb.source :=
    (contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hu.comp_contMDiffOn ψb.contMDiffOn_toFun)).of_le
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
  have h1 := cps_box_propagation (fun z => u (ψb z)) cb y' sb (ε / 4) hsb ht ψb.source
    ψb.open_source hU hQbSrc hE'Qb
  have h2 := hKb u hu
  have h3 := hCab u hu hus
  have h4 := hCEb u hu hus
  have h5 : (∫ y in Qc y' (ε / 4), (u (ψb y)) ^ 2) +
      ∫ y in Qc cb sb, ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u (ψb z)) y) ^ 2 ≤
        (K * Ca + CE) * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) := by
    calc (∫ y in Qc y' (ε / 4), (u (ψb y)) ^ 2) +
          ∫ y in Qc cb sb, ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u (ψb z)) y) ^ 2
        ≤ K * (Ca * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u)) +
            CE * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) :=
          add_le_add (h2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hK)) h4
      _ = (K * Ca + CE) * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) := by ring
  calc ∫ y in Qc cb sb, (u (ψb y)) ^ 2
      ≤ ((2 * sb / (ε / 4)) ^ 3 +
          8 * sb ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * sb / (ε / 4) + (2 * sb / (ε / 4)) ^ 2)) *
        ((∫ y in Qc y' (ε / 4), (u (ψb y)) ^ 2) +
          ∫ y in Qc cb sb, ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u (ψb z)) y) ^ 2) := h1
    _ ≤ ((2 * sb / (ε / 4)) ^ 3 +
          8 * sb ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * sb / (ε / 4) + (2 * sb / (ε / 4)) ^ 2)) *
        ((K * Ca + CE) * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h5 hAbox
    _ = ((2 * sb / (ε / 4)) ^ 3 +
          8 * sb ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * sb / (ε / 4) + (2 * sb / (ε / 4)) ^ 2)) * (K * Ca + CE) *
        atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) := by ring

            - fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 0) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 2)) = 0 := by
          linear_combination -(fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 2)) * h1 + fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 2) * h2
            - (fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 2) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 1)
              - fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 2) * fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 1)) * h3
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hd
      have hv2 : v 2 = 0 := by
        have : v 2 * (fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 2) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 0)
            - fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 0) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 2)) = 0 := by
          linear_combination fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 0) * h1 - fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 0) * h2
            - (fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 0) * fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 1)
              - fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 0) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 1)) * h3
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hd
      rw [hdec v, h3, hv0, hv2]
      simp
    · have hd : fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 0) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 1)
          - fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 1) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 0) ≠ 0 := by
        simpa [cross_apply] using hk
      have hv0 : v 0 = 0 := by
        have : v 0 * (fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 0) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 1)
            - fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 1) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 0)) = 0 := by
          linear_combination fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 1) * h1 - fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 1) * h2
            - (fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 1) * fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 2)
              - fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 1) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 2)) * h3
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hd
      have hv1 : v 1 = 0 := by
        have : v 1 * (fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 0) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 1)
            - fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 1) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 0)) = 0 := by
          linear_combination -(fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 0)) * h1 + fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 0) * h2
            - (fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 0) * fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 2)
              - fderiv ℝ b y₀ (e 0) * fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e 2)) * h3
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hd
      rw [hdec v, h3, hv0, hv1]
      simp
  
  set Θ : E3 → E3 := fun y => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k] with hΘdef
  have hΘc : ∀ y, Θ y 0 = f y ∧ Θ y 1 = b y ∧ Θ y 2 = y k := by
    intro y
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rfl
  have hΘs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Θ O := by
    refine (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn ?_
    refine contDiffOn_pi.mpr fun i => ?_
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using hf
    · simpa using hb
    · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : E3 => x k) O
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffOn
  have hΘat : ∀ y ∈ O, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Θ y := fun y hy => hΘs.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hy)
  have hΘd : ∀ y ∈ O, DifferentiableAt ℝ Θ y :=
    fun y hy => (hΘat y hy).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hD0 : HasFDerivAt Θ (fderiv ℝ Θ y₀) y₀ := (hΘd y₀ hy₀).hasFDerivAt
  have hproj : ∀ i : Fin 3, HasFDerivAt (fun y => Θ y i)
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ Θ y₀)) y₀ :=
    fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp y₀ hD0
  have hf0 : (fun y => Θ y 0) = f := funext fun y => (hΘc y).1
  have hb1 : (fun y => Θ y 1) = b := funext fun y => (hΘc y).2.1
  have hk2 : (fun y => Θ y 2) = fun y : E3 => y k := funext fun y => (hΘc y).2.2
  have hinj : ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ Θ y₀ v = 0 → v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have e0 := hproj 0
    rw [hf0] at e0
    have e1 := hproj 1
    rw [hb1] at e1
    have e2 := hproj 2
    rw [hk2] at e2
    have e2' : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => y k) (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y₀ :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt
    have hu := e2.unique e2'
    apply hker v
    · rw [e0.fderiv]
      simp [hv]
    · rw [e1.fderiv]
      simp [hv]
    · have := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L v) hu
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hv, map_zero] at this
      exact this.symm
  have hinj' : Function.Injective ((fderiv ℝ Θ y₀ : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) :=
    (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr (fun v hv => hinj v hv)
  let L₀ : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3 := (LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo _ hinj').toContinuousLinearEquiv
  have hL₀ : (L₀ : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) = fderiv ℝ Θ y₀ := by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    rfl
  
  have hD : HasFDerivAt Θ (L₀ : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) y₀ := by
    rw [hL₀]
    exact hD0
  let hom := ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph Θ (hΘat y₀ hy₀) hD (by simp)
  have hcoe : (hom : E3 → E3) = Θ := ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe _ _ _
  have hy₀s : y₀ ∈ hom.source := ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source _ _ _
  have hO'o : IsOpen (O ∩ (fderiv ℝ Θ) ⁻¹' Set.range
      (ContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap : (E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) → (E3 →L[ℝ] E3))) :=
    (hΘs.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)).isOpen_inter_preimage hO
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.isOpen
  set O' := O ∩ (fderiv ℝ Θ) ⁻¹' Set.range
      (ContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap : (E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3) → (E3 →L[ℝ] E3)) with hO'def
  have hy₀O' : y₀ ∈ O' := ⟨hy₀, L₀, hL₀⟩
  have hVo : IsOpen (hom.source ∩ O') := hom.open_source.inter hO'o
  have hTo : IsOpen (hom.target ∩ hom.symm ⁻¹' O') :=
    hom.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage hom.open_target hO'o
  have hVO : hom.source ∩ O' ⊆ O := fun y hy => hy.2.1
  have hPT : ∀ w ∈ hom.target ∩ hom.symm ⁻¹' O',
      hom.symm w ∈ hom.source ∩ O' ∧ Θ (hom.symm w) = w := by
    intro w hw
    refine ⟨⟨hom.map_target hw.1, hw.2⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← hcoe]
    exact hom.right_inv hw.1
  have hVT : ∀ y ∈ hom.source ∩ O',
      Θ y ∈ hom.target ∩ hom.symm ⁻¹' O' ∧ hom.symm (Θ y) = y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [← hcoe]
    refine ⟨⟨hom.map_source hy.1, ?_⟩, hom.left_inv hy.1⟩
    show hom.symm (hom y) ∈ O'
    rw [hom.left_inv hy.1]
    exact hy.2
  have hPs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ hom.symm (hom.target ∩ hom.symm ⁻¹' O') := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨haT, haO, L, hL⟩ := ha
    refine (hom.contDiffAt_symm (f₀' := L) haT ?_ ?_).contDiffWithinAt
    · rw [hcoe, hL]
      exact (hΘd _ haO).hasFDerivAt
    · rw [hcoe]
      exact hΘat _ haO
  
  have hcT : Θ y₀ ∈ hom.target ∩ hom.symm ⁻¹' O' := (hVT y₀ ⟨hy₀s, hy₀O'⟩).1
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hTo (Θ y₀) hcT
  obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2⟩ := hΘc y₀
  have hBK : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - f y₀| < ε / 4 ∧ |w 1 - b y₀| < ε / 4 ∧ |w 2 - y₀ k| < ε / 4 →
      w ∈ Metric.closedBall (Θ y₀) (ε / 2) := by
    rintro w ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three, Real.dist_eq,
      Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, sq_abs, sq_abs, sq_abs, c0, c1, c2]
    have q0 : (w 0 - f y₀) ^ 2 ≤ (ε / 4) ^ 2 :=
      sq_le_sq' (by linarith [(abs_lt.mp h0).1]) (abs_lt.mp h0).2.le
    have q1 : (w 1 - b y₀) ^ 2 ≤ (ε / 4) ^ 2 :=
      sq_le_sq' (by linarith [(abs_lt.mp h1).1]) (abs_lt.mp h1).2.le
    have q2 : (w 2 - y₀ k) ^ 2 ≤ (ε / 4) ^ 2 :=
      sq_le_sq' (by linarith [(abs_lt.mp h2).1]) (abs_lt.mp h2).2.le
    rw [show ε / 2 = Real.sqrt ((ε / 2) ^ 2) from (Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)).symm]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    have h4 : (ε / 2) ^ 2 = 4 * (ε / 4) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h5 := sq_nonneg (ε / 4)
    linarith
  have hKT : Metric.closedBall (Θ y₀) (ε / 2) ⊆ hom.target ∩ hom.symm ⁻¹' O' :=
    fun w hw => hball (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hw)
  obtain ⟨Lp, hLp⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (Θ y₀) (ε / 2)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    ((hPs.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hTo (by simp)).mono hKT)
  have hBo : IsOpen {w : E3 | |w 0 - f y₀| < ε / 4 ∧ |w 1 - b y₀| < ε / 4 ∧
      |w 2 - y₀ k| < ε / 4} := by
    have hc : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (r : ℝ), Continuous fun w : E3 => |w i - r| := fun i r =>
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.sub continuous_const).abs
    exact (isOpen_lt (hc 0 _) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt (hc 1 _) continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt (hc 2 _) continuous_const))
  refine ⟨k, ε / 4, Lp, (hom.source ∩ O') ∩ Θ ⁻¹' {w : E3 | |w 0 - f y₀| < ε / 4 ∧
      |w 1 - b y₀| < ε / 4 ∧ |w 2 - y₀ k| < ε / 4}, hom.symm, by positivity,
    (hΘs.continuousOn.mono hVO).isOpen_inter_preimage hVo hBo, ⟨⟨hy₀s, hy₀O'⟩, ?_⟩,
    fun y hy => hVO hy.1, hPs.mono (fun w hw => hKT (hBK w hw)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · show |Θ y₀ 0 - f y₀| < ε / 4 ∧ |Θ y₀ 1 - b y₀| < ε / 4 ∧ |Θ y₀ 2 - y₀ k| < ε / 4
    rw [c0, c1, c2]
    simp only [sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact ⟨by positivity, by positivity, by positivity⟩
  · intro w hw
    obtain ⟨hPV, hPw⟩ := hPT w (hKT (hBK w hw))
    refine ⟨hLp w (hBK w hw), ⟨hPV, ?_⟩, hPw⟩
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, hPw]
    exact hw
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hyV, hyB⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨_, hPΘ⟩ := hVT y hyV
    obtain ⟨d0, d1, d2⟩ := hΘc y
    have hyB' : |Θ y 0 - f y₀| < ε / 4 ∧ |Θ y 1 - b y₀| < ε / 4 ∧ |Θ y 2 - y₀ k| < ε / 4 := hyB
    rw [d0, d1, d2] at hyB'
    exact ⟨hyB', hPΘ⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O)
    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b O) (k : Fin 3) (τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hUO : U ⊆ O) (P : E3 → E3)
    (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ})
    (hPV : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f (P w), b (P w), (P w) k] = w)
    (hPU : ∀ y ∈ U, (|f y - τ₀| < δ ∧ |b y - β₀| < δ ∧ |y k - σ₀| < δ) ∧
      P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k]) = y)
    (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψU : tsupport ψ ⊆ U) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ,
      (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun y => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b y / s) * ψ y)
          {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) ∧
        |∫ y in {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y},
          s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b y / s) * ψ y
          ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))| ≤ C) ∧
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun y => ψ y * (‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2)))
        {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ b y = 0} (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun s => sbgbAreaConst *
          ∫ y in {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y},
            s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b y / s) * ψ y
            ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
        (𝓝 (∫ y in {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ b y = 0},
          ψ y * (‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2))
          ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ))))

signature.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O)

      P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k]) = y)
    (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψU : tsupport ψ ⊆ U) :

        |∫ y in {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y},

      Tendsto (fun s => sbgbAreaConst *

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨hc0, -⟩ := sbgb_area_const_spec
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : E3 → ℝ, ∀ w : E3, J w = Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3,
      (crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j) (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i) ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ → E2 → ℝ, ∀ (t : ℝ) (z : E2),
      g t z = if |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ then
        ψ (P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1])) *
          J ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1]) else 0 :=
    ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := box_profile_props f b O hO hf hb k τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp hδ U hU hUO P hP hPV hPU
    ψ hψ hψc hψU J hJ g hg
  have harea := box_area_side f b O hO hf hb k τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp hδ U hU hUO P hP hPV hPU
    ψ hψ hψc hψU J hJ g hg
  have hedge := box_edge_side f b O hO hf hb k τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp hδ U hU hUO P hP hPV hPU
    ψ hψ hψc hψU J hJ g hg
  have hcint := box_collar_integrable f b O hO hf hb k τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp hδ U hU hUO P hP hPV hPU
    ψ hψ hψc hψU
  have heint := box_edge_integrable f b O hO hf hb k τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp hδ U hU hUO P hP hPV hPU
    ψ hψ hψc hψU
  refine ⟨2 * δ * M / sbgbAreaConst, fun t => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hgc, hgs, hgM, hgv⟩ := hM t
  obtain ⟨hbd, hlim⟩ := half_plane_kernel_limit (g t) hgc hgs σ₀ δ M hδ.le hgM hgv
  refine ⟨fun s hs => ⟨hcint t s hs, ?_⟩, heint t, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := harea t s hs
    have h2 := hbd s hs
    rw [← h1, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc0] at h2
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hc0]
    linarith
  · rw [hedge t]
    refine hlim.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs
    exact (harea t s hs).symm

subgoal_signatures.statement:
0 < sbgbAreaConst ∧ ∀ S : Set E2,
    ENNReal.ofReal sbgbAreaConst * MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) S =
      MeasureTheory.volume S

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(g : E2 → ℝ) (hg : Continuous g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (σ R M : ℝ) (hR0 : 0 ≤ R) (hM : ∀ z, |g z| ≤ M) (hR : ∀ z : E2, R < |z 1 - σ| → g z = 0) :
    (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      |∫ z in {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0}, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (z 0 / s) * g z| ≤ 2 * R * M) ∧
    Tendsto (fun s => ∫ z in {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0}, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (z 0 / s) * g z)
      (𝓝[>] (0:ℝ)) (𝓝 (∫ x : ℝ, g ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![0, x])))

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O)
    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b O) (k : Fin 3) (τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hUO : U ⊆ O) (P : E3 → E3)
    (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ})
    (hPV : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f (P w), b (P w), (P w) k] = w)
    (hPU : ∀ y ∈ U, (|f y - τ₀| < δ ∧ |b y - β₀| < δ ∧ |y k - σ₀| < δ) ∧
      P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k]) = y)
    (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψU : tsupport ψ ⊆ U)
    (J : E3 → ℝ)
    (hJ : ∀ w : E3, J w = Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j)

    have h2 : ψa.symm (ψb x) ∈ ψa.source := ψa.toPartialEquiv.map_target hx.2
    have h3 : ψb x ∈ ψb.target := ψb.toPartialEquiv.map_source hx.1

  have hn0 : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp

      rw [heq.fderiv_eq]; exact fderiv_id
