    have key : (a ^ 3 + b * (1 + a + a ^ 2)) * (P3 + (D0 + D1 + D2)) -
        (a ^ 3 * P3 + a ^ 2 * b * D2 + a * b * D1 + b * D0) =
        a ^ 3 * (D0 + D1 + D2) + b * (1 + a + a ^ 2) * P3 + b * (a + a ^ 2) * D0 +
          b * (1 + a ^ 2) * D1 + b * (1 + a) * D2 := by ring
    have t1 : 0 ≤ a ^ 3 * (D0 + D1 + D2) := by positivity
    have t2 : 0 ≤ b * (1 + a + a ^ 2) * P3 := by positivity
    have t3 : 0 ≤ b * (a + a ^ 2) * D0 := by positivity
    have t4 : 0 ≤ b * (1 + a ^ 2) * D1 := by positivity
    have t5 : 0 ≤ b * (1 + a) * D2 := by positivity
    nlinarith
  exact alg (2 * s / t) (8 * s ^ 2) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity)
    (setIntegral_nonneg hEm (fun y _ => sq_nonneg _))
    (setIntegral_nonneg hQm (fun y _ => sq_nonneg _))
    (setIntegral_nonneg hQm (fun y _ => sq_nonneg _))
    (setIntegral_nonneg hQm (fun y _ => sq_nonneg _)) h0 h1 h2

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (c : E3) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hB : Metric.closedBall c (2 * s) ⊆ ψ.source) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → HasCompactSupport u →
      ∫ y in {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, c i - s ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ c i + s},
        ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u (ψ z)) y) ^ 2 ≤
          C * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u)

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (c : E3) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hB : Metric.closedBall c (2 * s) ⊆ ψ.source) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → HasCompactSupport u →
      ∫ y in {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, c i - s ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ c i + s},
        ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u (ψ z)) y) ^ 2 ≤
          C * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨_, hχs, hχ0, hχ1, hχt, hcase⟩ := hA
  
  have hcont : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun y : E3 => y i) := fun i => by fun_prop
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : Set E3, Q = {y : E3 | ∀ i : Fin 3, c i - s ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ c i + s} :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hQ]
  have hF1 : Q ⊆ Metric.closedBall c (2 * s) := by
    rw [hQ]
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, EuclideanSpace.dist_eq]
    have h : ∀ i, dist (y i) (c i) ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      intro i
      have h1 := hy i
      rw [Real.dist_eq]
      have h2 : |y i - c i| ≤ s := abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith [h1.1], by linarith [h1.2]⟩
      have h3 : |y i - c i| ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h2 2
      exact h3
    have h4 : ∑ i : Fin 3, dist (y i) (c i) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * s) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
      nlinarith [h 0, h 1, h 2, sq_nonneg s]
    calc Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, dist (y i) (c i) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((2 * s) ^ 2) :=
          Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h4
      _ = 2 * s := Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)
  have hQclosed : IsClosed Q := by
    have : Q = ⋂ i : Fin 3, {y : E3 | c i - s ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ c i + s} := by
      rw [hQ]; ext y; simp
    rw [this]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun i =>
      (isClosed_le continuous_const (hcont i)).inter (isClosed_le (hcont i) continuous_const)
  have hQc : IsCompact Q := (isCompact_closedBall c (2 * s)).of_isClosed_subset hQclosed hF1
  have hQψ : Q ⊆ ψ.source := hF1.trans hB
  have hQm : MeasurableSet Q := hQclosed.measurableSet
  
  have hell : ∀ (ψ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (z : E3) (R : ℝ),
      Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ ψ'.source → ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall z R,
        ∀ u : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u →
          m * ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun w => u (ψ' w)) y) ^ 2 ≤
            g.gradInner u u (ψ' y) := by
    intro ψ' z R hzR
    obtain ⟨m, Mx, Γ, hm, -, -, hb⟩ := coeff_compact_bounds (fun y => (g.coeff ψ' y)⁻¹)
      ψ'.source z R ψ'.open_source hzR (flat_coeff_regular g ψ').1
      (flat_coeff_regular g ψ').2.2.1
    refine ⟨m, hm, fun y hy u hu => ?_⟩
    have h1 : m * ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun w => u (ψ' w)) y) ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun w => u (ψ' w)) y *
          (g.coeff ψ' y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv j (fun w => u (ψ' w)) y :=
      ((hb y hy).1 (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun w => u (ψ' w)) y))
    rw [gradInner_pdiffeo_formula g ψ' u u hu hu y (hzR hy)]
    refine h1.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring
  
  have hnn : ∀ (ψ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u : M → ℝ),
      ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u → ∀ z ∈ ψ'.source, 0 ≤ g.gradInner u u (ψ' z) := by
    intro ψ' u hu z hz
    have hzB : Metric.closedBall z 0 ⊆ ψ'.source := by
      rw [Metric.closedBall_zero]; exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hz
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hb⟩ := hell ψ' z 0 hzB
    have h1 := hb z (Metric.mem_closedBall_self le_rfl) u hu
    have h2 : 0 ≤ m * ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun w => u (ψ' w)) z) ^ 2 :=
      mul_nonneg hm.le (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
    linarith
  
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source :=
    (nds_chart_cont g ψ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) contMDiff_const
      contMDiff_const).2.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hmin⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall c (2 * s)).exists_isMinOn
    ⟨c, Metric.mem_closedBall_self (by linarith)⟩ (hdetc.mono hB)
  have hm₀ : 0 < Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y₀).det :=
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (coeff_posDef g ψ y₀ (hB hy₀)).det_pos
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hbd⟩ := hell ψ c (2 * s) hB
  have hCpos : 0 < m * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y₀).det := mul_pos hm hm₀
  refine ⟨(m * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y₀).det)⁻¹, (inv_pos.2 hCpos).le, ?_⟩
  intro u hu hus
  
  have hpt : ∀ y ∈ Q, ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u (ψ z)) y) ^ 2 ≤
      (m * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y₀).det)⁻¹ *
        (g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) := by
    intro y hy
    have hyB := hF1 hy
    have h1 := hbd y hyB u hu
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y₀).det ≤ Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det :=
      isMinOn_iff.1 hmin y hyB
    have h3 := hnn ψ u hu y (hB hyB)
    rw [inv_mul_eq_div, le_div_iff₀ hCpos]
    have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 h3
    have h5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hm₀.le
    nlinarith [h4, h5]
  
  have hGc : ∀ ψ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => g.gradInner u u (ψ' y)) ψ'.source :=
    fun ψ' => (nds_chart_cont g ψ' u u hu hu).2.2.1
  have hDc : ∀ ψ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ' y).det) ψ'.source :=
    fun ψ' => (nds_chart_cont g ψ' u u hu hu).2.2.2.1
  
  have hGK : ∀ p, p ∉ tsupport u → g.gradInner u u p = 0 := by
    intro p hp
    have h1 := ((lapM_gradInner_linear_local g u (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) u p).2 (tsupport u)ᶜ
      (isClosed_tsupport u).isOpen_compl hp
      (fun q hq => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hq)).2
    rw [h1]
    simp [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, partialDeriv]
  have hK : IsCompact (tsupport u) := hus
  
  have hfar : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ →
      (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∉ tsupport u := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀, hcl⟩ := endChart_far_isClosed g hAF j
    let O : ℕ → Set M := fun m => ((hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖})ᶜ
    have hOo : ∀ m, IsOpen (O m) := fun m =>
      (hcl _ (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_nonneg m))).isOpen_compl
    have hOmono : Monotone O := by
      intro m m' hmm' p hp
      simp only [O, Set.mem_compl_iff] at hp ⊢
      intro hp'
      apply hp
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzp⟩ := hp'
      refine ⟨z, ?_, hzp⟩
      have h1 : (m : ℝ) ≤ m' := Nat.cast_le.2 hmm'
      have h2 : ρ₀ + (m' : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ := hz
      show ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖
      linarith
    have hcovK : tsupport u ⊆ ⋃ m, O m := by
      intro p _
      by_contra hne
      have hmem : ∀ m : ℕ, p ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖} := fun m =>
        Classical.byContradiction fun h => hne (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨m, h⟩)
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hpz₀⟩ := hmem 0
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_gt (‖z₀‖ - ρ₀)
      obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁, hpz₁⟩ := hmem m
      have h0 : ρ₀ + ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ‖z₀‖ := hz₀
      have h1 : ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖z₁‖ := hz₁
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] at h0
      have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg m
      have hz₀s : z₀ ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
        rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖z₀‖; linarith
      have hz₁s : z₁ ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
        rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖z₁‖; linarith
      have heq : z₀ = z₁ :=
        (hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.injOn hz₀s hz₁s (hpz₀.trans hpz₁.symm)
      rw [← heq] at h1
      linarith
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hK.elim_directed_cover O hOo hcovK hOmono.directed_le
    refine ⟨ρ₀ + N, fun y hy hyK => hN hyK ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩⟩
    show ρ₀ + (N : ℝ) ≤ ‖y‖
    linarith
  
  have hH : ∀ i, ContinuousOn
      (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * g.gradInner u u (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det)
      (κ i).source := fun i =>
    (((hχs i).continuous.comp_continuousOn
      (κ i).contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn).mul (hGc (κ i))).mul (hDc (κ i))
  have hZ : ∀ i, ∃ Z : Set E3, IsCompact Z ∧ Z ⊆ (κ i).source ∧
      ∀ y ∈ (κ i).source, y ∉ Z →
        χ i (κ i y) * g.gradInner u u (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det = 0 := by
    intro i
    rcases hcase i with hc | ⟨j, hκ, -, h0⟩
    · refine ⟨(κ i).toPartialEquiv.symm '' tsupport (χ i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact hc.image_of_continuousOn
          ((κ i).toOpenPartialHomeomorph.continuousOn_symm.mono (hχt i))
      · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.map_target (hχt i hx)
      · intro y hy hyZ
        have hns : κ i y ∉ tsupport (χ i) := by
          intro hmem
          exact hyZ ⟨κ i y, hmem, (κ i).toPartialEquiv.left_inv hy⟩
        rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hns, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    · obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hfar j
      refine ⟨{y : E3 | ρA ≤ ‖y‖} ∩ {y : E3 | ‖y‖ ≤ max R ρA}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) (max R ρA)).of_isClosed_subset
          ((isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
            (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)) ?_
        intro y hy
        rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
        exact hy.2
      · intro y hy
        have h1 : ρA ≤ ‖y‖ := hy.1
        rw [hκ, (hAF.ends j).source_eq]
        show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
        linarith
      · intro y hy hyZ
        rw [hκ] at hy ⊢
        have hy1 : (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := by
          have h2 := hy
          rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq] at h2
          exact h2
        by_cases hle : ‖y‖ ≤ ρA
        · rw [h0 y hy1 hle, zero_mul, zero_mul]
        · have hgt : max R ρA < ‖y‖ := by
            by_contra hc'
            exact hyZ ⟨le_of_lt (not_le.1 hle), not_lt.1 hc'⟩
          rw [hGK _ (hR y (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hgt)), mul_zero, zero_mul]
  have hHint : ∀ i, IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * g.gradInner u u (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det)
      (κ i).source := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨Z, hZc, hZS, hZ0⟩ := hZ i
    exact (((hH i).mono hZS).integrableOn_compact hZc).of_forall_diff_eq_zero
      (κ i).open_source.measurableSet (fun y hy => hZ0 y hy.1 hy.2)
  
  have hexp : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
    intro v
    have := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr v
    simpa using this.symm
  have hexpB : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (w1 w2 : E3),
      B (D w1) (D w2) = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
    intro B D w1 w2
    calc B (D w1) (D w2)
        = B (D (∑ a : Fin 3, w1 a • e a)) (D (∑ b : Fin 3, w2 b • e b)) := by
          rw [← hexp w1, ← hexp w2]
      _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
          simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          ring
  have hgL : ∀ i, IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ i (ψ y) * g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) Q :=
    fun i => (((((hχs i).continuous.comp_continuousOn ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn).mul
      (hGc ψ)).mul (hDc ψ)).mono hQψ).integrableOn_compact hQc
  
  have key : ∀ i, ∫ y in Q, χ i (ψ y) * g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det ≤
      ∫ z in (κ i).source,
        χ i (κ i z) * g.gradInner u u (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set E3, Ω = ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (κ i).target := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΩmem : ∀ y, y ∈ Ω ↔ y ∈ ψ.source ∧ ψ y ∈ (κ i).target := by
      intro y; rw [hΩ]; rfl
    have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by
      rw [hΩ]
      exact ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage ψ.open_source
        (κ i).open_target
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ : ∃ τ : E3 → E3, τ = fun y => (κ i).toPartialEquiv.symm (ψ y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hτsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ Ω := by
      rw [hτ, hΩ]
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (ContMDiffOn.comp (κ i).contMDiffOn_invFun
        (ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hy.2))
    have hτd : ∀ y ∈ Ω, DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y := fun y hy =>
      (hτsm.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hy)
    have hκτ : ∀ y ∈ Ω, κ i (τ y) = ψ y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hτ]
      exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.right_inv ((hΩmem y).1 hy).2
    have hτmem : ∀ y ∈ Ω, τ y ∈ (κ i).source := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hτ]
      exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.map_target ((hΩmem y).1 hy).2
    
    have hjac : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det =
        |(fderiv ℝ τ y).det| * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) (τ y)).det := by
      intro y hy
      have hmdκ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) :=
        ((κ i).contMDiffOn_toFun.contMDiffAt
          ((κ i).open_source.mem_nhds (hτmem y hy))).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
      have hmdτ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) τ y := (hτd y hy).mdifferentiableAt
      have heq : (ψ : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (κ i) ∘ τ := by
        filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        exact (hκτ z hz).symm
      have hmf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ y) := by
        rw [heq.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp y hmdκ hmdτ, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
          J = Matrix.of fun a b => fderiv ℝ τ y (e b) a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hcoeff : g.coeff ψ y = J.transpose * g.coeff (κ i) (τ y) * J := by
        ext a b
        have hl : g.coeff ψ y a b = g.g (ψ y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) (fderiv ℝ τ y (e a)))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) (fderiv ℝ τ y (e b))) := by
          show g.g (ψ y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y (e a))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y (e b)) = _
          rw [hmf]
          rfl
        have hr : ∀ a' b' : Fin 3, g.coeff (κ i) (τ y) a' b' =
            (g.g (ψ y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)
              ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (e a'))
              ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (e b')) := by
          intro a' b'
          show g.g (κ i (τ y)) _ _ = _
          rw [hκτ y hy]
          try rfl
        have hl2 : g.coeff ψ y a b = ∑ a' : Fin 3, ∑ b' : Fin 3,
            fderiv ℝ τ y (e a) a' * fderiv ℝ τ y (e b) b' * g.coeff (κ i) (τ y) a' b' := by
          rw [hl]
          refine (hexpB (g.g (ψ y)) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y)) _ _).trans ?_
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b' _ => ?_
          exact congrArg _ (hr a' b').symm
        rw [hl2]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply,
          Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      have hdetJ : J.det = (fderiv ℝ τ y).det := by
        show J.det = LinearMap.det ((fderiv ℝ τ y : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)
        rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis]
        congr 1
        try (ext a b; rw [hJ, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]; simp)
      rw [hcoeff, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, hdetJ]
      rw [show (fderiv ℝ τ y).det * (g.coeff (κ i) (τ y)).det * (fderiv ℝ τ y).det =
          (fderiv ℝ τ y).det ^ 2 * (g.coeff (κ i) (τ y)).det by ring]
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    
    have hEm : MeasurableSet (Q ∩ Ω) := hQm.inter hΩo.measurableSet
    have hEΩ : Q ∩ Ω ⊆ Ω := Set.inter_subset_right
    have hτinj : Set.InjOn τ (Q ∩ Ω) := by
      intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ h
      have h' : ψ y₁ = ψ y₂ := by
        rw [← hκτ y₁ (hEΩ hy₁), ← hκτ y₂ (hEΩ hy₂), h]
      exact ψ.toPartialEquiv.injOn ((hΩmem y₁).1 (hEΩ hy₁)).1 ((hΩmem y₂).1 (hEΩ hy₂)).1 h'
    
    have hs3 : ∫ y in Q, χ i (ψ y) * g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det =
        ∫ y in Q ∩ Ω, χ i (ψ y) * g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
      refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hQm Set.inter_subset_left ?_
      rintro y ⟨hyQ, hyn⟩
      have hyt : ψ y ∉ (κ i).target := by
        intro ht
        exact hyn ⟨hyQ, (hΩmem y).2 ⟨hQψ hyQ, ht⟩⟩
      have hns : ψ y ∉ tsupport (χ i) := fun h => hyt (hχt i h)
      rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hns, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    
    have hs4 : ∫ z in τ '' (Q ∩ Ω),
        χ i (κ i z) * g.gradInner u u (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det =
        ∫ y in Q ∩ Ω, χ i (ψ y) * g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
      rw [integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hEm
        (fun y hy => (hτd y (hEΩ hy)).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hτinj]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hEm (fun y hy => ?_)
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hκτ y (hEΩ hy), hjac y (hEΩ hy)]
      ring
    
    have h5 : ∫ z in τ '' (Q ∩ Ω),
        χ i (κ i z) * g.gradInner u u (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det ≤
        ∫ z in (κ i).source,
          χ i (κ i z) * g.gradInner u u (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det := by
      refine setIntegral_mono_set (hHint i)
        (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (κ i).open_source.measurableSet fun z hz =>
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hχ0 i _) (hnn (κ i) u hu z hz)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) ?_
      refine HasSubset.Subset.eventuallyLE ?_
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact hτmem y (hEΩ hy)
    rw [hs3, ← hs4]
    exact h5
  
  have hloc : ∫ y in Q, g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det ≤
      atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) := by
    unfold atlasInt
    calc ∫ y in Q, g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det
        = ∫ y in Q, ∑ i, χ i (ψ y) * g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
          congr 1
          funext y
          rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, hχ1, one_mul]
      _ = ∑ i, ∫ y in Q, χ i (ψ y) * g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det :=
          integral_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hgL i
      _ ≤ ∑ i, ∫ z in (κ i).source,
            χ i (κ i z) * g.gradInner u u (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => key i
  
  have hI1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u (ψ z)) y) ^ 2) Q :=
    ((continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ =>
      ((nds_chart_cont g ψ u u hu hu).2.1 i).pow 2).mono hQψ).integrableOn_compact hQc
  have hI2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => (m * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y₀).det)⁻¹ *
      (g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det)) Q :=
    ((continuousOn_const.mul ((hGc ψ).mul (hDc ψ))).mono hQψ).integrableOn_compact hQc
  calc ∫ y in Q, ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => u (ψ z)) y) ^ 2
      ≤ ∫ y in Q, (m * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y₀).det)⁻¹ *
          (g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) :=
        setIntegral_mono_on hI1 hI2 hQm hpt
    _ = (m * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y₀).det)⁻¹ *
          ∫ y in Q, g.gradInner u u (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det :=
        integral_const_mul _ _
    _ ≤ (m * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y₀).det)⁻¹ * atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hloc (inv_pos.2 hCpos).le

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_chart_cont
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv a (fun x => u (κ x))) κ.source) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u w (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.coeff κ x).det) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ a b) κ.source)

subgoal_signatures.name: flat_coeff_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) :
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j) Ψ.source) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Ψ.source, ∀ i j : Fin 3, (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j = (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ j i) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Ψ.source, ((g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹).PosDef) ∧
    (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel (g.coeff Ψ) k i j) Ψ.source)

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_compact_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Ω : Set E3) (c : E3)
    (R0 : ℝ) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hball : Metric.closedBall c R0 ⊆ Ω)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) Ω)
    (hpos : ∀ y ∈ Ω, (G y).PosDef) :
    ∃ m Mx Γ : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ 0 ≤ Mx ∧ 0 ≤ Γ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c R0,
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, m * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G y i j * v j) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G y i j * v j ≤ Mx * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * (G y)⁻¹ i j * v j ≤ m⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j y| ≤ Γ)

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ φ.source) :
    (g.coeff φ y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_pdiffeo_formula
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ κ.source) :
    g.gradInner u w (κ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => u (κ z)) x *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => w (κ z)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: lapM_gradInner_linear_local
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u v w : M → ℝ) (p : M) :
    ((ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) → (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v) → ∀ a b : ℝ,
      g.lapM (fun q => a * u q + b * v q) p = a * g.lapM u p + b * g.lapM v p ∧
      g.gradInner (fun q => a * u q + b * v q) w p = a * g.gradInner u w p + b * g.gradInner v w p) ∧
    (∀ U : Set M, IsOpen U → p ∈ U → (∀ q ∈ U, u q = v q) →
      g.lapM u p = g.lapM v p ∧ g.gradInner u w p = g.gradInner v w p)

subgoal_signatures.name: endChart_far_isClosed
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ ρ₀ ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, ρ₀ ≤ ρ → IsClosed ((hAF.ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖x‖})

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hus : HasCompactSupport u) :
    (∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → 0 ≤ g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) ∧
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y : E3 => g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det) {y : E3 | ρA + 1 < ‖y‖} ∧
    ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρA + 1 < ‖y‖}, g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det ≤ atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u)

signature.name: ceh_end_atlas_lower
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hus : HasCompactSupport u) :
    (∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → 0 ≤ g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y)) ∧
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y : E3 => g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det) {y : E3 | ρA + 1 < ‖y‖} ∧
    ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρA + 1 < ‖y‖}, g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det ≤ atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hρA, hsm, hnn, hsum, hsupp, hcase⟩ := hA
  
  have hsign : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3), y ∈ ψ.source →
      0 ≤ g.gradInner u u (ψ y) := by
    intro ψ y hy
    rw [gradInner_pdiffeo_formula g ψ u u hu hu y hy]
    have hPD := (flat_coeff_regular g ψ).2.2.1 y hy
    have h0 := hPD.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
      (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun z => u (ψ z)) y)
    simp only [Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    nlinarith [h0]
  
  have hfar : ∀ T : Set M, IsCompact T → ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ →
      (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∉ T := by
    intro T hT
    choose ρf N hN hNy using end_chart_escape g hAF j
    obtain ⟨t, -, hcov⟩ := hT.elim_nhds_subcover N (fun x _ => hN x)
    refine ⟨∑ x ∈ t, |ρf x|, fun y hy hyT => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hxt, hxN⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcov hyT)
    have hle : ρf x ≤ ∑ x ∈ t, |ρf x| :=
      (le_abs_self _).trans (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun x => |ρf x|)
        (fun x _ => abs_nonneg (ρf x)) hxt)
    exact hNy x y (lt_of_le_of_lt hle hy) hxN
  have hsrcEq := (hAF.ends j).source_eq
  
  obtain ⟨i₀, hκ, hone, hzero⟩ : ∃ i₀ : Fin n, κ i₀ = (hAF.ends j).Φ ∧
      (∀ y : E3, ρA + 1 ≤ ‖y‖ → χ i₀ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 1) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ → ‖y‖ ≤ ρA → χ i₀ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 0) := by
    by_contra hno
    have hTc : IsCompact (⋃ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => IsCompact (tsupport (χ i))),
        tsupport (χ i)) :=
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => IsCompact (tsupport (χ i)))).isCompact_biUnion
        (fun i hi => (Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2)
    obtain ⟨Rc, hRc⟩ := hfar _ hTc
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = max Rc 1 + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hrpos : 0 < r := by have := le_max_right Rc 1; linarith
    have hnorm : ‖(EuclideanSpace.single 0 r : E3)‖ = r := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_single, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hrpos]
    have hRcy : Rc < ‖(EuclideanSpace.single 0 r : E3)‖ := by
      rw [hnorm]; have := le_max_left Rc 1; linarith
    have h1y : 1 < ‖(EuclideanSpace.single 0 r : E3)‖ := by
      rw [hnorm]; have := le_max_right Rc 1; linarith
    have hpT := hRc _ hRcy
    have hsrc : (EuclideanSpace.single 0 r : E3) ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
      rw [hsrcEq]; exact h1y
    have hptgt : (hAF.ends j).Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 r : E3) ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.target :=
      (hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hsrc
    have hall : ∀ i, χ i ((hAF.ends j).Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 r : E3)) = 0 := by
      intro i
      rcases hcase i with hc | ⟨j', hκj', hA1, hA0⟩
      · apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
        intro hmem
        exact hpT (Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hc⟩, hmem⟩)
      · by_cases hjj : j' = j
        · subst hjj
          exact absurd ⟨i, hκj', hA1, hA0⟩ hno
        · by_contra hne
          have h1 := hsupp i (subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hne))
          rw [hκj'] at h1
          exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hAF.disjoint hjj) h1 hptgt
    have hs1 := hsum ((hAF.ends j).Φ (EuclideanSpace.single 0 r : E3))
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => hall i)] at hs1
    exact zero_ne_one hs1
  
  obtain ⟨Ru, hRu⟩ := hfar (tsupport u) hus
  have hsrcOpen : IsOpen (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := (hAF.ends j).Φ.open_source
  have hcont := nds_chart_cont g (hAF.ends j).Φ u u hu hu
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : E3 → ℝ, H = fun y => χ i₀ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
      g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hHc : ContinuousOn H (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
    rw [hH]
    exact (((hsm i₀).continuous.comp_continuousOn
      (hAF.ends j).Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn).mul hcont.2.2.1).mul hcont.2.2.2.1
  have hFzero : ∀ y : E3, max Ru ρA < ‖y‖ → g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hy1 : y ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
      rw [hsrcEq]; show 1 < ‖y‖; linarith [le_max_right Ru ρA]
    have hyRu : Ru < ‖y‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hy
    have hev : (fun z => u ((hAF.ends j).Φ z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hyRu] with z hz
      exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (hRu z hz)
    have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((hAF.ends j).Φ z)) y = 0 := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    rw [gradInner_pdiffeo_formula g (hAF.ends j).Φ u u hu hu y hy1]
    simp [hpd]
  have hint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn H (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
    have hZc : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (max Ru ρA) ∩ {y : E3 | ρA ≤ ‖y‖}) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall 0 _).inter_right (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm)
    have hZs : Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (max Ru ρA) ∩ {y : E3 | ρA ≤ ‖y‖} ⊆
        (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hsrcEq]
      show 1 < ‖y‖
      have : ρA ≤ ‖y‖ := hy.2
      linarith
    refine MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.of_forall_diff_eq_zero
      ((hHc.mono hZs).integrableOn_compact hZc) hsrcOpen.measurableSet ?_
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hys, hyZ⟩ := hy
    have hy1 : 1 < ‖y‖ := by rw [hsrcEq] at hys; exact hys
    rw [hH]
    by_cases hle : ‖y‖ ≤ ρA
    · simp only [hzero y hy1 hle, zero_mul]
    · have hgt : max Ru ρA < ‖y‖ := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon hle
        exact hyZ ⟨mem_closedBall_zero_iff.2 hcon, hle.le⟩
      simp only [hFzero y hgt, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  
  have hS₁m : MeasurableSet {y : E3 | ρA + 1 < ‖y‖} :=
    measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm
  have hS₁ : {y : E3 | ρA + 1 < ‖y‖} ⊆ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hsrcEq]
    show 1 < ‖y‖
    have : ρA + 1 < ‖y‖ := hy
    linarith
  have hEq : Set.EqOn H (fun y : E3 => g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det) {y : E3 | ρA + 1 < ‖y‖} := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : ρA + 1 < ‖y‖ := hy
    rw [hH]
    simp only [hone y h1.le, one_mul]
  have hH0 : ∀ y ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source, 0 ≤ H y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hH]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hnn i₀ _) (hsign _ y hy)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨fun y hy => hsign (hAF.ends j).Φ y (by rw [hsrcEq]; exact hy),
    (hint.mono_set hS₁).congr_fun hEq hS₁m, ?_⟩
  
  have h6 : ∫ y in (κ i₀).source, χ i₀ (κ i₀ y) * g.gradInner u u (κ i₀ y) *
      Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i₀) y).det ≤ atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) := by
    unfold atlasInt
    refine Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => ∫ y in (κ i).source,
      χ i (κ i y) * g.gradInner u u (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det)
      (fun i _ => ?_) (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
    exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_nonneg (κ i).open_source.measurableSet
      (fun y hy => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hnn i _) (hsign (κ i) y hy)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  rw [hκ] at h6
  calc ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρA + 1 < ‖y‖}, g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det
      = ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρA + 1 < ‖y‖}, H y :=
        (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hS₁m hEq).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ y in (hAF.ends j).Φ.source, H y :=
        MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set hint
          (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hsrcOpen.measurableSet hH0)
          hS₁.eventuallyLE
    _ = ∫ y in (hAF.ends j).Φ.source, χ i₀ ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) *
          g.gradInner u u ((hAF.ends j).Φ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ y).det := by
        rw [hH]
    _ ≤ atlasInt g κ χ (g.gradInner u u) := h6

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_pdiffeo_formula
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ κ.source) :
    g.gradInner u w (κ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => u (κ z)) x *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => w (κ z)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: flat_coeff_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) :
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j) Ψ.source) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Ψ.source, ∀ i j : Fin 3, (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j = (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ j i) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Ψ.source, ((g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹).PosDef) ∧
    (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel (g.coeff Ψ) k i j) Ψ.source)

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_chart_cont
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv a (fun x => u (κ x))) κ.source) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u w (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.coeff κ x).det) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ a b) κ.source)

subgoal_signatures.name: end_chart_escape
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) :
    ∀ p : M, ∃ ρ : ℝ, ∃ N ∈ 𝓝 p, ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends k).Φ y ∉ N

informal_problem.statement:
(ρ R : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (U : E3 → ℝ)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 U {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) (hUR : ∀ y : E3, R ≤ ‖y‖ → U y = 0) (R₀ : ℝ) :
    ∫ y in {y : E3 | 2 * ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R₀}, U y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤
      4 * ∫ y in {y : E3 | 3 * ρ / 2 < ‖y‖}, ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2

signature.name: ceh_euclid_hardy
signature.statement:
(ρ R : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (U : E3 → ℝ)
    (hU : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 U {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖}) (hUR : ∀ y : E3, R ≤ ‖y‖ → U y = 0) (R₀ : ℝ) :
    ∫ y in {y : E3 | 2 * ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R₀}, U y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤
      4 * ∫ y in {y : E3 | 3 * ρ / 2 < ‖y‖}, ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have ha0 : 0 < 3 * ρ / 2 := by linarith
  have hρa : ρ < 3 * ρ / 2 := by linarith
  have hab : 3 * ρ / 2 < 2 * ρ := by linarith
  
  have hsum_coord : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (y : E3), L y = ∑ k : Fin 3, L (e k) * y k := by
    intro L y
    have hy : y = ∑ k : Fin 3, y k • e k := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hy]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => mul_comm _ _)
  have hnorm_sq : ∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ ^ 2 = y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro y
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  
  obtain ⟨η, hηC, hη01, hη0, hη1, hηrad⟩ : ∃ η : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 η ∧
      (∀ y : E3, 0 ≤ η y ∧ η y ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ ≤ 3 * ρ / 2 → η y = 0) ∧ (∀ y : E3, 2 * ρ ≤ ‖y‖ → η y = 1) ∧
      (∀ y : E3, 0 ≤ fderiv ℝ η y y) := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc_def⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = (2 * ρ) ^ 2 - (3 * ρ / 2) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hc : 0 < c := by rw [hc_def]; nlinarith
    have hsC : ContDiff ℝ 1 Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
    have hgC : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun y : E3 => (‖y‖ ^ 2 - (3 * ρ / 2) ^ 2) * c⁻¹) :=
      ((contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).sub contDiff_const).mul contDiff_const
    refine ⟨fun y => Real.smoothTransition ((‖y‖ ^ 2 - (3 * ρ / 2) ^ 2) * c⁻¹), hsC.comp hgC,
      fun y => ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y hy
      apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
      have h1 : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (3 * ρ / 2) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg y) hy 2
      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (inv_nonneg.2 hc.le)
    · intro y hy
      apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
      have h1 : (2 * ρ) ^ 2 ≤ ‖y‖ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hy 2
      rw [← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ hc]
      linarith
    · intro y
      have hN : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ y) y :=
        (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq y).hasFDerivAt
      have hg : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => (‖z‖ ^ 2 - (3 * ρ / 2) ^ 2) * c⁻¹)
          (c⁻¹ • (2 • innerSL ℝ y)) y := (hN.sub_const ((3 * ρ / 2) ^ 2)).mul_const c⁻¹
      have hs : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition
          (deriv Real.smoothTransition ((‖y‖ ^ 2 - (3 * ρ / 2) ^ 2) * c⁻¹))
          ((‖y‖ ^ 2 - (3 * ρ / 2) ^ 2) * c⁻¹) :=
        ((hsC.differentiable one_ne_zero) _).hasDerivAt
      have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun y => Real.smoothTransition ((‖y‖ ^ 2 - (3 * ρ / 2) ^ 2) * c⁻¹))
          (deriv Real.smoothTransition ((‖y‖ ^ 2 - (3 * ρ / 2) ^ 2) * c⁻¹) •
            (c⁻¹ • (2 • innerSL ℝ y))) y := by
        have h := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (h₂ := Real.smoothTransition) y hs hg
        exact h
      rw [hcomp.fderiv]
      have hd : 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition ((‖y‖ ^ 2 - (3 * ρ / 2) ^ 2) * c⁻¹) :=
        Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, innerSL_apply_apply,
        real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      have hc' : 0 ≤ c⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.2 hc.le
      positivity
  
  have hΩo : IsOpen {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hBo : IsOpen {y : E3 | ‖y‖ < 3 * ρ / 2} := isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const
  have hglueC : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} →
      (∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ < 3 * ρ / 2 → f y = 0) → ContDiff ℝ 1 f := by
    intro f hf h0
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hy : ρ < ‖y‖
    · exact hf.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hy)
    · have hy' : ‖y‖ < 3 * ρ / 2 := by push_neg at hy; linarith
      refine (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hBo.mem_nhds hy'] with z hz
      exact h0 z hz
  have hglue0 : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} →
      (∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ < 3 * ρ / 2 → f y = 0) → Continuous f := by
    intro f hf h0
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hy : ρ < ‖y‖
    · exact hf.continuousAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hy)
    · have hy' : ‖y‖ < 3 * ρ / 2 := by push_neg at hy; linarith
      refine (continuousAt_const (y := (0 : ℝ))).congr ?_
      filter_upwards [hBo.mem_nhds hy'] with z hz
      exact (h0 z hz).symm
  have hcs : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, (∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ → f y = 0) → HasCompactSupport f := by
    intro f hf
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) R) ?_
    intro x hx
    apply hf
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] at hx
    exact hx
  
  have hUd : ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → HasFDerivAt U (fderiv ℝ U y) y := fun y hy =>
    (((hU.differentiableOn one_ne_zero) y hy).differentiableAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hy)).hasFDerivAt
  have hUfar : ∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ → fderiv ℝ U y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have h : U =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact hUR z (le_of_lt (show R < ‖z‖ from hz))
    rw [h.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have hpdU : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => partialDeriv k U y) {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} :=
    fun k => (hU.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hΩo le_rfl).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hcoordC : ∀ k : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z : E3 => z k) := by
    intro k
    fun_prop
  
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ,
      F = fun k z => η z * U z ^ 2 * (z k / ‖z‖ ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hFC : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (F k) := by
    intro k
    rw [hF]
    apply hglueC
    · exact (hηC.contDiffOn.mul (hU.pow 2)).mul ((hcoordC k).contDiffOn.div
        (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).contDiffOn
        (fun z hz => pow_ne_zero 2 (lt_trans hρ (show ρ < ‖z‖ from hz)).ne'))
    · intro y hy
      simp [hη0 y hy.le]
  have hFcs : ∀ k, HasCompactSupport (F k) := by
    intro k
    apply hcs
    intro y hy
    rw [hF]
    simp [hUR y hy.le]
  have hDint : ∀ k, Integrable (fun y => partialDeriv k (F k) y) := fun k =>
    (((hFC k).continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      ((hFcs k).fderiv_apply ℝ (e k))
  have hD0 : ∀ k, ∫ y, partialDeriv k (F k) y = 0 := by
    intro k
    have h := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := (volume : Measure E3))
      (f := fun _ : E3 => (1 : ℝ)) (g := F k) (v := e k) (by simp)
      (by simpa [partialDeriv] using hDint k)
      (by simpa using (hFC k).continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hFcs k))
      (differentiable_const _) ((hFC k).differentiable one_ne_zero)
    simpa [partialDeriv] using h
  have hDI : Integrable (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (F k) y) :=
    integrable_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => hDint k)
  have hDZ : ∫ y, ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (F k) y = 0 := by
    rw [integral_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => hDint k)]
    simp [hD0]
  
  have hpk : ∀ y : E3, 3 * ρ / 2 ≤ ‖y‖ → ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (F k) y =
      η y * U y ^ 2 * ((‖y‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ - 2 * y k ^ 2 * ((‖y‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) +
        y k * (‖y‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (2 * η y * U y * partialDeriv k U y + U y ^ 2 * partialDeriv k η y) := by
    intro y hy k
    have hyρ : ρ < ‖y‖ := lt_of_lt_of_le hρa hy
    have hn0 : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (lt_trans hρ hyρ).ne'
    have hη' : HasFDerivAt η (fderiv ℝ η y) y := ((hηC.differentiable one_ne_zero) y).hasFDerivAt
    have hU' := hUd y hyρ
    have hN : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ y) y :=
      (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq y).hasFDerivAt
    have hinv : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => (‖z‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)
        ((-((‖y‖ ^ 2) ^ 2)⁻¹) • (2 • innerSL ℝ y)) y := (hasDerivAt_inv hn0).comp_hasFDerivAt y hN
    have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => z k) (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) k) y :=
      PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) 2 y k
    have hall := (hη'.mul (hU'.pow 2)).mul (hc.mul hinv)
    have hall' : HasFDerivAt (fun z => η z * U z ^ 2 * (z k * (‖z‖ ^ 2)⁻¹)) _ y := hall
    have hFk : F k = fun z => η z * U z ^ 2 * (z k * (‖z‖ ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      rw [hF]
      funext z
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    rw [hFk, hall'.fderiv]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
    simp only [one_mul, conj_trivial]
    ring
  have hpt : ∀ y : E3, η y * U y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 / 2 -
      2 * (η y * ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2) ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (F k) y := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : 3 * ρ / 2 ≤ ‖y‖
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three, hpk y hy 0, hpk y hy 1, hpk y hy 2,
        div_eq_mul_inv (η y * U y ^ 2) (‖y‖ ^ 2)]
      have hn : ‖y‖ ^ 2 = y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 := hnorm_sq y
      have hnpos : 0 < ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
        have : 0 < ‖y‖ := by linarith
        positivity
      have hdη : 0 ≤ partialDeriv 0 η y * y 0 + partialDeriv 1 η y * y 1 +
          partialDeriv 2 η y * y 2 := by
        have h := hηrad y
        rw [hsum_coord (fderiv ℝ η y) y, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h
        exact h
      have hnt : (y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2) * (‖y‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := by
        rw [← hn]; exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hnpos.ne'
      have ht0 : 0 ≤ (‖y‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.2 hnpos.le
      have hw := (hη01 y).1
      generalize (‖y‖ ^ 2)⁻¹ = t at hnt ht0 ⊢
      generalize partialDeriv 0 η y = q0 at hdη ⊢
      generalize partialDeriv 1 η y = q1 at hdη ⊢
      generalize partialDeriv 2 η y = q2 at hdη ⊢
      generalize partialDeriv 0 U y = p0
      generalize partialDeriv 1 U y = p1
      generalize partialDeriv 2 U y = p2
      generalize η y = w at hw ⊢
      generalize U y = u
      generalize y 0 = y0 at hnt hdη ⊢
      generalize y 1 = y1 at hnt hdη ⊢
      generalize y 2 = y2 at hnt hdη ⊢
      have key : (w * u ^ 2 * (t - 2 * y0 ^ 2 * t ^ 2) + y0 * t * (2 * w * u * p0 + u ^ 2 * q0) +
          (w * u ^ 2 * (t - 2 * y1 ^ 2 * t ^ 2) + y1 * t * (2 * w * u * p1 + u ^ 2 * q1)) +
          (w * u ^ 2 * (t - 2 * y2 ^ 2 * t ^ 2) + y2 * t * (2 * w * u * p2 + u ^ 2 * q2))) -
          (w * u ^ 2 * t / 2 - 2 * (w * (p0 ^ 2 + p1 ^ 2 + p2 ^ 2))) =
          u ^ 2 * t * (q0 * y0 + q1 * y1 + q2 * y2) +
            w / 2 * ((2 * p0 + u * y0 * t) ^ 2 + (2 * p1 + u * y1 * t) ^ 2 +
              (2 * p2 + u * y2 * t) ^ 2) := by
        linear_combination (-(5 / 2) * w * u ^ 2 * t) * hnt
      have h1 : 0 ≤ u ^ 2 * t * (q0 * y0 + q1 * y1 + q2 * y2) :=
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg u) ht0) hdη
      have h2 : 0 ≤ w / 2 * ((2 * p0 + u * y0 * t) ^ 2 + (2 * p1 + u * y1 * t) ^ 2 +
              (2 * p2 + u * y2 * t) ^ 2) := by positivity
      linarith
    · push_neg at hy
      have hF0 : ∀ k, partialDeriv k (F k) y = 0 := by
        intro k
        have h : F k =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [hBo.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
          rw [hF]
          simp [hη0 z (show ‖z‖ < 3 * ρ / 2 from hz).le]
        rw [partialDeriv, h.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      simp [hF0, hη0 y hy.le]
  
  have hAc : Continuous (fun y : E3 => η y * U y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
    apply hglue0
    · exact (hηC.continuous.continuousOn.mul (hU.continuousOn.pow 2)).div
        (continuous_norm.pow 2).continuousOn
        (fun z hz => pow_ne_zero 2 (lt_trans hρ (show ρ < ‖z‖ from hz)).ne')
    · intro y hy
      simp [hη0 y hy.le]
  have hAI : Integrable (fun y : E3 => η y * U y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) :=
    hAc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hcs _ (fun y hy => by simp [hUR y hy.le]))
  have hPc : ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2) {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} :=
    continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => (hpdU k).pow 2)
  have hP0 : ∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ → ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    simp [partialDeriv, hUfar y hy]
  have hQc : Continuous (fun y => η y * ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2) :=
    hglue0 _ (hηC.continuous.continuousOn.mul hPc) (fun y hy => by rw [hη0 y hy.le, zero_mul])
  have hQI : Integrable (fun y => η y * ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2) :=
    hQc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hcs _ (fun y hy => by rw [hP0 y hy, mul_zero]))
  have hPI : IntegrableOn (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2)
      {y : E3 | 3 * ρ / 2 < ‖y‖} := by
    have hK : IsCompact ({y : E3 | 3 * ρ / 2 ≤ ‖y‖} ∩ closedBall 0 (max R (3 * ρ / 2))) :=
      (isCompact_closedBall _ _).inter_left (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm)
    have hKs : {y : E3 | 3 * ρ / 2 ≤ ‖y‖} ∩ closedBall 0 (max R (3 * ρ / 2)) ⊆
        {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖} := fun z hz => lt_of_lt_of_le hρa hz.1
    refine ((hPc.mono hKs).integrableOn_compact hK).of_forall_diff_eq_zero
      (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm) ?_
    intro x hx
    apply hP0
    have h1 : x ∉ closedBall (0 : E3) (max R (3 * ρ / 2)) := fun h =>
      hx.2 ⟨le_of_lt (show 3 * ρ / 2 < ‖x‖ from hx.1), h⟩
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff, not_le] at h1
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) h1
  
  have hS₁ : MeasurableSet {y : E3 | 2 * ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R₀} :=
    (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm).inter
      (measurableSet_lt measurable_norm measurable_const)
  have hstep1 : ∫ y in {y : E3 | 2 * ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R₀}, U y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ y in {y : E3 | 2 * ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R₀}, η y * U y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun hS₁ (fun y hy => ?_)
    simp only [hη1 y hy.1.le, one_mul]
  have hstep2 : ∫ y in {y : E3 | 2 * ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R₀}, η y * U y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∫ y, η y * U y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 :=
    setIntegral_le_integral hAI (Eventually.of_forall (fun y =>
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hη01 y).1 (sq_nonneg _)) (sq_nonneg _)))
  have hIntL : Integrable (fun y => η y * U y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 / 2 -
      2 * (η y * ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2)) :=
    (hAI.div_const 2).sub (hQI.const_mul 2)
  have hmono : ∫ y, (η y * U y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 / 2 -
      2 * (η y * ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2)) ≤
      ∫ y, ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (F k) y := integral_mono hIntL hDI (fun y => hpt y)
  rw [hDZ, integral_sub (hAI.div_const 2) (hQI.const_mul 2), integral_div,
    integral_const_mul] at hmono
  have hstep4 : ∫ y, η y * ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2 =
      ∫ y in {y : E3 | 3 * ρ / 2 < ‖y‖}, η y * ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2 := by
    refine (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (fun y hy => ?_)).symm
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_lt] at hy
    rw [hη0 y hy, zero_mul]
  have hstep5 : ∫ y in {y : E3 | 3 * ρ / 2 < ‖y‖}, η y * ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2 ≤
      ∫ y in {y : E3 | 3 * ρ / 2 < ‖y‖}, ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k U y) ^ 2 :=
    setIntegral_mono_on hQI.integrableOn hPI (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm)
      (fun y _ => mul_le_of_le_one_left (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)) (hη01 y).2)
  rw [hstep1]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (R t : ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖})
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G y a b = G y b a)
    (hpd : ∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ → (G y).PosDef) :
    IsOpen {y : E2 | R < ‖cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)‖} ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => sgbSideMetric G t y a b)
      {y : E2 | R < ‖cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)‖}) ∧
    (∀ (y : E2) (a b : Fin 2), sgbSideMetric G t y a b = sgbSideMetric G t y b a) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ {y : E2 | R < ‖cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)‖}, (sgbSideMetric G t y).PosDef) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ {y : E2 | R < ‖cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)‖}, ∀ c a b : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (fun z => sgbSideMetric G t z a b) y =
        partialDeriv c.succ (fun z => G z a.succ b.succ) (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)))

signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (R t : ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y a b) {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖})
    (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (a b : Fin 3), G y a b = G y b a)
    (hpd : ∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ → (G y).PosDef) :
    IsOpen {y : E2 | R < ‖cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)‖} ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => sgbSideMetric G t y a b)
      {y : E2 | R < ‖cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)‖}) ∧
    (∀ (y : E2) (a b : Fin 2), sgbSideMetric G t y a b = sgbSideMetric G t y b a) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ {y : E2 | R < ‖cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)‖}, (sgbSideMetric G t y).PosDef) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ {y : E2 | R < ‖cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)‖}, ∀ c a b : Fin 2,
