proof.tactics:
by
  have hV : IsOpen {y : E3 | R < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  let Λ : E2 →L[ℝ] E3 := (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 1) +
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 2)
  have hΛ : ∀ v : E2, Λ v = v 0 • e 1 + v 1 • e 2 := fun v => rfl
  have hιeq : (fun y : E2 => cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)) = fun y => t • e 0 + Λ y := by
    funext y
    rw [hΛ, cylPt, add_assoc]
  have hιd : ∀ y : E2, HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)) Λ y := by
    intro y
    rw [hιeq]
    exact Λ.hasFDerivAt.const_add _
  have hιs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)) := by
    rw [hιeq]
    exact contDiff_const.add Λ.contDiff
  have hΛe : ∀ c : Fin 2, Λ (e2 c) = e c.succ := by
    intro c
    rw [hΛ]
    fin_cases c <;> ext k <;> fin_cases k <;> simp [e, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  refine ⟨hV.preimage hιs.continuous, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b
    have h := (hG a.succ b.succ).comp hιs.contDiffOn (fun y hy => hy)
    exact h
  · intro y a b
    exact hsymm _ _ _
  · intro y hy
    have hP := hpd _ hy
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [star_trivial]
      exact hsymm _ _ _
    · intro w hw0
      set v : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![0, w 0, w 1] with hvdef
      have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hw0
        have h1 := congrFun h0 1
        have h2 := congrFun h0 2
        simp [v] at h1 h2
        funext k
        fin_cases k
        · simpa using h1
        · simpa using h2
      have hpos := hP.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0
      have key : star w ⬝ᵥ (sgbSideMetric G t y).mulVec w =
          star v ⬝ᵥ (G (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1))).mulVec v := by
        simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.star_apply,
          star_trivial, hvdef, sgbSideMetric, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_one_eq_two,
          Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons,
          Matrix.tail_cons]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  · intro y hy c a b
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : E3 => G z a.succ b.succ) (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)) :=
      ((hG a.succ b.succ).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hcomp := hfd.hasFDerivAt.comp y (hιd y)
    have hfun : (fun z => sgbSideMetric G t z a b) =
        (fun z : E3 => G z a.succ b.succ) ∘ (fun y : E2 => cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)) := rfl
    unfold pd2 partialDeriv
    rw [hfun, hcomp.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hΛe]

informal_problem.statement:
(h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (O : Set E2) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a b) O)
    (hsym : ∀ (y : E2) (a b : Fin 2), h y a b = h y b a)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ O, (h y).PosDef) (L : ℝ) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ O) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h (sgbSideDef L) x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h (sgbSideDef L) x *
        Real.sqrt (h x).det =
      sgbSideF (h x) (fun c a b => pd2 c (fun y => h y a b) x) (x 0) (x 1)

signature.name: side_density_formula
signature.statement:
(h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (O : Set E2) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a b) O)
    (hsym : ∀ (y : E2) (a b : Fin 2), h y a b = h y b a)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ O, (h y).PosDef) (L : ℝ) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ O) (hx0 : x ≠ 0) :
    Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h (sgbSideDef L) x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h (sgbSideDef L) x *
        Real.sqrt (h x).det =
      sgbSideF (h x) (fun c a b => pd2 c (fun y => h y a b) x) (x 0) (x 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (k : Fin 2) (z : E2),
      HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => y k) (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) z :=
    fun k z => PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) 2 z k
  
  have hb : ∀ (z : E2) (a : Fin 2), pd2 a (sgbSideDef L) z = -2 * z a := by
    intro z a
    have h0 := (hcoord 0 z).pow 2
    have h1 := (hcoord 1 z).pow 2
    have hd := (h0.const_sub (L ^ 2)).fun_sub h1
    have hd' : HasFDerivAt (sgbSideDef L) _ z := hd
    unfold pd2
    rw [hd'.fderiv]
    fin_cases a <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> ring
  
  obtain ⟨A0, hA0⟩ : ∃ A0 : E2 → ℝ, A0 = fun y => h y 1 1 * y 0 - h y 0 1 * y 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A1, hA1⟩ : ∃ A1 : E2 → ℝ, A1 = fun y => h y 0 0 * y 1 - h y 0 1 * y 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : E2 → ℝ, Q = fun y =>
      h y 1 1 * y 0 ^ 2 - 2 * h y 0 1 * y 0 * y 1 + h y 0 0 * y 1 ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have halg : ∀ y ∈ O, y ≠ 0 →
      0 < (h y).det ∧ 0 < Q y ∧ sgbGradSq2 h (sgbSideDef L) y = 4 * Q y / (h y).det ∧
      Real.sqrt (h y).det * (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ 0 a * pd2 a (sgbSideDef L) y) /
          Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h (sgbSideDef L) y) = -(A0 y / Real.sqrt (Q y)) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h y).det * (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ 1 a * pd2 a (sgbSideDef L) y) /
          Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h (sgbSideDef L) y) = -(A1 y / Real.sqrt (Q y)) := by
    intro y hyO hy0
    have hP := hpd y hyO
    have hD : 0 < (h y).det := hP.det_pos
    have hDne : (h y).det ≠ 0 := hD.ne'
    have h10 : h y 1 0 = h y 0 1 := hsym y 1 0
    have hyne : (![-(y 1), y 0] : Fin 2 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc
      apply hy0
      have e0 : y 1 = 0 := by have := congrFun hc 0; simpa using this
      have e1 : y 0 = 0 := by have := congrFun hc 1; simpa using this
      ext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [e0, e1]
    have hq := hP.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hyne
    have hqe : star (![-(y 1), y 0] : Fin 2 → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (h y).mulVec ![-(y 1), y 0] =
        h y 1 1 * y 0 ^ 2 - 2 * h y 0 1 * y 0 * y 1 + h y 0 0 * y 1 ^ 2 := by
      simp [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, h10] <;> ring
    have hQy : 0 < Q y := by
      rw [hQ]
      rw [hqe] at hq
      exact hq
    have hinv : (h y)⁻¹ = (h y).det⁻¹ • !![h y 1 1, -h y 0 1; -h y 1 0, h y 0 0] := by
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    have i00 : (h y)⁻¹ 0 0 = h y 1 1 / (h y).det := by
      rw [hinv]; simp [div_eq_inv_mul]
    have i01 : (h y)⁻¹ 0 1 = -h y 0 1 / (h y).det := by
      rw [hinv]; simp [div_eq_inv_mul]
    have i10 : (h y)⁻¹ 1 0 = -h y 0 1 / (h y).det := by
      rw [hinv]; simp [div_eq_inv_mul, h10]
    have i11 : (h y)⁻¹ 1 1 = h y 0 0 / (h y).det := by
      rw [hinv]; simp [div_eq_inv_mul]
    have hS0 : ∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ 0 a * pd2 a (sgbSideDef L) y = -2 * A0 y / (h y).det := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, i00, i01, hb, hA0]
      field_simp <;> ring
    have hS1 : ∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ 1 a * pd2 a (sgbSideDef L) y = -2 * A1 y / (h y).det := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, i10, i11, hb, hA1]
      field_simp <;> ring
    have hG : sgbGradSq2 h (sgbSideDef L) y = 4 * Q y / (h y).det := by
      unfold sgbGradSq2
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, i00, i01, i10, i11, hb, hQ]
      field_simp <;> ring
    obtain ⟨s, hs0, hsD⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ (h y).det = s ^ 2 :=
      ⟨Real.sqrt (h y).det, Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hD, (Real.sq_sqrt hD.le).symm⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht0, htQ⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ Q y = t ^ 2 :=
      ⟨Real.sqrt (Q y), Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQy, (Real.sq_sqrt hQy.le).symm⟩
    have hsq : Real.sqrt (4 * Q y / (h y).det) = 2 * t / s := by
      rw [htQ, hsD, show 4 * t ^ 2 / s ^ 2 = (2 * t / s) ^ 2 by ring]
      exact Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)
    refine ⟨hD, hQy, hG, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hS0, hG, hsq, htQ, Real.sqrt_sq ht0.le, hsD, Real.sqrt_sq hs0.le]
      field_simp <;> ring
    · rw [hS1, hG, hsq, htQ, Real.sqrt_sq ht0.le, hsD, Real.sqrt_sq hs0.le]
      field_simp <;> ring
  
  have hdivsqrt : ∀ (A P : E2 → ℝ) (A' P' : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E2),
      HasFDerivAt A A' z → HasFDerivAt P P' z → 0 < P z → ∀ (i : Fin 2) (a q : ℝ),
      A' (e2 i) = a → P' (e2 i) = q →
      pd2 i (fun y => -(A y / Real.sqrt (P y))) z =
        -(a / Real.sqrt (P z) - A z * q / (2 * P z * Real.sqrt (P z))) := by
    intro A P A' P' z hA hP hpos i a q ha hq
    have hs0 : Real.sqrt (P z) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos).ne'
    have hPne : P z ≠ 0 := hpos.ne'
    have hS := hP.sqrt hPne
    have hI := (hasDerivAt_inv hs0).comp_hasFDerivAt z hS
    have hM := (hA.fun_mul hI).neg
    have hN : HasFDerivAt (fun y => -(A y / Real.sqrt (P y))) _ z :=
      hM.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by
        simp [div_eq_mul_inv])
    unfold pd2
    rw [hN.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_apply, ha, hq,
      Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le]
    field_simp <;> ring
  
  have hd : ∀ a b : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun y => h y a b) (fderiv ℝ (fun y => h y a b) x) x :=
    fun a b => (((hh a b).contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  
  have hA0d := HasFDerivAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    (((hd 1 1).fun_mul (hcoord 0 x)).fun_sub ((hd 0 1).fun_mul (hcoord 1 x)))
    (show A0 =ᶠ[𝓝 x] _ from Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => congrFun hA0 y)
  have hA1d := HasFDerivAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    (((hd 0 0).fun_mul (hcoord 1 x)).fun_sub ((hd 0 1).fun_mul (hcoord 0 x)))
    (show A1 =ᶠ[𝓝 x] _ from Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => congrFun hA1 y)
  have hQd := HasFDerivAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    ((((hd 1 1).fun_mul ((hcoord 0 x).pow 2)).fun_sub
      ((((hd 0 1).const_mul 2).fun_mul (hcoord 0 x)).fun_mul (hcoord 1 x))).fun_add
      ((hd 0 0).fun_mul ((hcoord 1 x).pow 2)))
    (show Q =ᶠ[𝓝 x] _ from Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => congrFun hQ y)
  
  obtain ⟨hDx, hQx, hGx, -, -⟩ := halg x hx hx0
  have hxU : x ∈ O ∩ {z : E2 | z ≠ 0} := ⟨hx, hx0⟩
  have hUo : IsOpen (O ∩ {z : E2 | z ≠ 0}) := hO.inter isOpen_ne
  have hev0 : (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det *
      (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ 0 a * pd2 a (sgbSideDef L) y) /
        Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h (sgbSideDef L) y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun y => -(A0 y / Real.sqrt (Q y))) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hxU) (fun y hy => (halg y hy.1 hy.2).2.2.2.1)
  have hev1 : (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det *
      (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ 1 a * pd2 a (sgbSideDef L) y) /
        Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h (sgbSideDef L) y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun y => -(A1 y / Real.sqrt (Q y))) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hxU) (fun y hy => (halg y hy.1 hy.2).2.2.2.2)
  have hpd_congr : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (f g : E2 → ℝ), f =ᶠ[𝓝 x] g → pd2 i f x = pd2 i g x := by
    intro i f g hfg
    unfold pd2
    rw [hfg.fderiv_eq]
  have hT0 := hdivsqrt A0 Q _ _ x hA0d hQd hQx 0
    (pd2 0 (fun y => h y 1 1) x * x 0 + h x 1 1 - pd2 0 (fun y => h y 0 1) x * x 1)
    ((pd2 0 (fun y => h y 1 1) x * x 0 ^ 2 - 2 * pd2 0 (fun y => h y 0 1) x * x 0 * x 1 +
      pd2 0 (fun y => h y 0 0) x * x 1 ^ 2) + 2 * (h x 1 1 * x 0 - h x 0 1 * x 1))
    (by simp [pd2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> ring)
    (by simp [pd2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> ring)
  have hT1 := hdivsqrt A1 Q _ _ x hA1d hQd hQx 1
    (pd2 1 (fun y => h y 0 0) x * x 1 + h x 0 0 - pd2 1 (fun y => h y 0 1) x * x 0)
    ((pd2 1 (fun y => h y 1 1) x * x 0 ^ 2 - 2 * pd2 1 (fun y => h y 0 1) x * x 0 * x 1 +
      pd2 1 (fun y => h y 0 0) x * x 1 ^ 2) + 2 * (h x 0 0 * x 1 - h x 0 1 * x 0))
    (by simp [pd2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> ring)
    (by simp [pd2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> ring)
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hss, hsD⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ Real.sqrt (h x).det = s ∧ (h x).det = s ^ 2 :=
    ⟨_, Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hDx, rfl, (Real.sq_sqrt hDx.le).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht0, hts, htQ⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ Real.sqrt (Q x) = t ∧ Q x = t ^ 2 :=
    ⟨_, Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQx, rfl, (Real.sq_sqrt hQx.le).symm⟩
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (4 * Q x / (h x).det) = 2 * t / s := by
    rw [htQ, hsD, show 4 * t ^ 2 / s ^ 2 = (2 * t / s) ^ 2 by ring]
    exact Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)
  have hpoly : h x 1 1 * x 0 ^ 2 - 2 * h x 0 1 * x 0 * x 1 + h x 0 0 * x 1 ^ 2 = t ^ 2 := by
    rw [← htQ, hQ]
  
  unfold sgbLevelCurv2
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hpd_congr 0 _ _ hev0, hpd_congr 1 _ _ hev1, hT0, hT1, hGx, hsq,
    hts, htQ, hss]
  simp only [sgbSideF, hA0, hA1]
  rw [hpoly, hss]
  have hsne : s ≠ 0 := hs0.ne'
  have htne : t ≠ 0 := ht0.ne'
  field_simp
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hg : g.PosDef)
    (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hd : ∀ c a b, d c a b = d c b a) (L φ : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * sgbSideF g d (L * Real.cos φ) (L * Real.sin φ) = curvKappa g g⁻¹ d L φ

signature.name: side_circle_identity
signature.statement:
(g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hg : g.PosDef)
    (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hd : ∀ c a b, d c a b = d c b a) (L φ : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * sgbSideF g d (L * Real.cos φ) (L * Real.sin φ) = curvKappa g g⁻¹ d L φ

proof.tactics:
by
  have hsym : g 1 0 = g 0 1 := by
    have h := hg.isHermitian.apply 0 1
    simpa using h
  have hdet : g.det = g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 ^ 2 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsym]; ring
  have hD : 0 < g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 ^ 2 := by
    have := hg.det_pos
    rwa [hdet] at this
  have ha : 0 < g 0 0 := hg.diag_pos
  have he : 0 < g 1 1 := hg.diag_pos
  have hcs : Real.cos φ ^ 2 + Real.sin φ ^ 2 = 1 := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ
  have hinv : g⁻¹ = (g.det)⁻¹ • !![g 1 1, -g 0 1; -g 1 0, g 0 0] := by
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hi00 : g⁻¹ 0 0 = (g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * g 1 1 := by
    rw [hinv, hdet]; simp
  have hi01 : g⁻¹ 0 1 = (g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-g 0 1) := by
    rw [hinv, hdet]; simp
  have hi10 : g⁻¹ 1 0 = (g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-g 0 1) := by
    rw [hinv, hdet]; simp [hsym]
  have hi11 : g⁻¹ 1 1 = (g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * g 0 0 := by
    rw [hinv, hdet]; simp
  have hqn : 0 < g 1 1 * Real.cos φ ^ 2 - 2 * g 0 1 * Real.cos φ * Real.sin φ +
      g 0 0 * Real.sin φ ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : (g 0 0 + g 1 1) * (g 1 1 * Real.cos φ ^ 2 - 2 * g 0 1 * Real.cos φ * Real.sin φ +
        g 0 0 * Real.sin φ ^ 2) = (g 1 1 * Real.cos φ - g 0 1 * Real.sin φ) ^ 2 +
        (g 0 0 * Real.sin φ - g 0 1 * Real.cos φ) ^ 2 + (g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 ^ 2) := by
      linear_combination (g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 ^ 2) * hcs
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (g 1 1 * Real.cos φ - g 0 1 * Real.sin φ),
      sq_nonneg (g 0 0 * Real.sin φ - g 0 1 * Real.cos φ)]
  have key : ∀ (S T q N Q1 Q2 Nd D qn : ℝ), 0 < D → 0 < qn →
      q = L ^ 2 * qn → T = 2 * q * S - 2 * L * (L * D - Nd) →
      Q1 = D⁻¹ * qn → Q2 = L ^ 2 * qn → N = D⁻¹ * Nd →
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((2 * S - T / q) / Real.sqrt D) =
        (L - N) / (Real.sqrt Q1 * Real.sqrt Q2) := by
    intro S T q N Q1 Q2 Nd D qn hD hqn hq hT hQ1 hQ2 hN
    subst hq hT hQ1 hQ2 hN
    obtain ⟨r, hr0, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ D = r ^ 2 :=
      ⟨Real.sqrt D, Real.sqrt_pos.2 hD, (Real.sq_sqrt hD.le).symm⟩
    have hL' := hL.ne'
    have hq' := hqn.ne'
    have hr' := hr0.ne'
    have hden : Real.sqrt ((r ^ 2)⁻¹ * qn) * Real.sqrt (L ^ 2 * qn) = L * qn / r := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 (sq_nonneg r)) hqn.le) (L ^ 2 * qn)]
      rw [show (r ^ 2)⁻¹ * qn * (L ^ 2 * qn) = (L * qn / r) ^ 2 by field_simp]
      exact Real.sqrt_sq (div_pos (mul_pos hL hqn) hr0).le
    rw [hden, Real.sqrt_sq hr0.le]
    field_simp
    ring
  simp only [sgbSideF, curvKappa]
  rw [hdet]
  refine key _ _ _ _ _ _
    ((g 1 1 * Real.cos φ - g 0 1 * Real.sin φ) *
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * d 0 0 0 * (L * Real.sin φ) ^ 2 - d 1 0 0 * (L * Real.sin φ) * (L * Real.cos φ) +
          (d 1 0 1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * d 0 1 1) * (L * Real.cos φ) ^ 2) +
      (g 0 0 * Real.sin φ - g 0 1 * Real.cos φ) *
        ((d 0 0 1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * d 1 0 0) * (L * Real.sin φ) ^ 2 -
          d 0 1 1 * (L * Real.sin φ) * (L * Real.cos φ) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * d 1 1 1 * (L * Real.cos φ) ^ 2))
    (g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 ^ 2)
    (g 1 1 * Real.cos φ ^ 2 - 2 * g 0 1 * Real.cos φ * Real.sin φ + g 0 0 * Real.sin φ ^ 2)
    hD hqn ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · ring
  · linear_combination (-2 * L ^ 2 * (g 0 0 * g 1 1 - g 0 1 ^ 2)) * hcs
  · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      hi00, hi01, hi10, hi11]
    ring
  · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      hsym]
    ring
  · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons,
      hi00, hi01, hi10, hi11, hd 0 1 0, hd 1 1 0]
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
(F : E2 → ℝ) (L ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρL : ρ < L)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F {x : E2 | ρ ^ 2 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2}) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ∫ x : E2, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) * F x)
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
      (𝓝 ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ θ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
        F ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![L * Real.cos θ, L * Real.sin θ])))

signature.name: annulus_collar_limit
signature.statement:
(F : E2 → ℝ) (L ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρL : ρ < L)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F {x : E2 | ρ ^ 2 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2}) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ∫ x : E2, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) * F x)
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
      (𝓝 ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∫ θ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
        F ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![L * Real.cos θ, L * Real.sin θ])))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hC : ContDiff ℝ 1 Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
  have hcont : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) := hC.continuous_deriv le_rfl
  have hnn : ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition σ :=
    fun σ => Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
  have h0 : ∀ σ : ℝ, σ ≤ 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition σ = 0 := by
    intro σ hσ
    apply IsLocalMin.deriv_eq_zero
    apply IsMinOn.isLocalMin _ Filter.univ_mem
    rw [isMinOn_univ_iff]
    intro x
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos hσ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg x
  have h1 : ∀ σ : ℝ, 1 ≤ σ → deriv Real.smoothTransition σ = 0 := by
    intro σ hσ
    apply IsLocalMax.deriv_eq_zero
    apply IsMaxOn.isLocalMax _ Filter.univ_mem
    rw [isMaxOn_univ_iff]
    intro x
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le hσ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one x
  have hder : ∀ σ : ℝ, HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition σ) σ :=
    fun σ => ((hC.differentiable one_ne_zero) σ).hasDerivAt
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = (ρ + L) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρa : ρ < a := by rw [ha]; linarith
  have haL : a < L := by rw [ha]; linarith
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by linarith
  have hgap : 0 < L ^ 2 - a ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hpi : -Real.pi ≤ Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ,
      w = fun s r => r * s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((L ^ 2 - r ^ 2) / s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hwc : ∀ s : ℝ, Continuous (w s) := by
    intro s
    rw [hw]
    exact (continuous_id.mul continuous_const).mul
      (hcont.comp ((continuous_const.sub (continuous_pow 2)).div_const s))
  
  have hmass : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < L ^ 2 - a ^ 2 → ∫ r in a..L, w s r = 1 / 2 := by
    intro s hs hsa
    have hderiv : ∀ r ∈ Set.uIcc a L,
        HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.smoothTransition ((L ^ 2 - r ^ 2) / s))
          (r * s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((L ^ 2 - r ^ 2) / s)) r := by
      intro r _
      have hu : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => (L ^ 2 - r ^ 2) / s) (-(2 * r) / s) r := by
        have := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 r).const_sub (L ^ 2)).div_const s
        convert this using 1
        norm_num
      have := ((hder ((L ^ 2 - r ^ 2) / s)).comp r hu).const_mul (-(1 / 2 : ℝ))
      convert this using 1
      ring
    simp only [hw]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv
      ((by simpa [hw] using hwc s : Continuous fun r : ℝ =>
        r * s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((L ^ 2 - r ^ 2) / s)).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    have e1 : (L ^ 2 - L ^ 2) / s = 0 := by simp
    have e2 : 1 ≤ (L ^ 2 - a ^ 2) / s := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith
    simp only [e1, Real.smoothTransition.zero, Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le e2]
    norm_num
  
  have hside : ∀ r θ : ℝ, sgbSideDef L
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![r * Real.cos θ, r * Real.sin θ]) = L ^ 2 - r ^ 2 := by
    intro r θ
    show L ^ 2 - (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 - (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = L ^ 2 - r ^ 2
    linear_combination (-r ^ 2) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
  have hann : ∀ r θ : ℝ, a ≤ r →
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![r * Real.cos θ, r * Real.sin θ] : E2) ∈
        {x : E2 | ρ ^ 2 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2} := by
    intro r θ hr
    show ρ ^ 2 < (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2
    have hcs : (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
      linear_combination r ^ 2 * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    rw [hcs]
    nlinarith [mul_self_lt_mul_self hρ.le (lt_of_lt_of_le hρa hr)]
  have hvec : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (![p.1 * Real.cos p.2, p.1 * Real.sin p.2] : Fin 2 → ℝ)) := by
    refine continuous_pi (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · show Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * Real.cos p.2
      fun_prop
    · show Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 * Real.sin p.2
      fun_prop
  have hQc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![p.1 * Real.cos p.2, p.1 * Real.sin p.2] : E2)) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp hvec
  
  have hpolar : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < L ^ 2 - a ^ 2 →
      ∫ x : E2, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) * F x =
      ∫ r in a..L, w s r * ∫ θ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
        F ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![r * Real.cos θ, r * Real.sin θ]) := by
    intro s hs hsa
    obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ : ∃ H : E2 → ℝ,
        H = fun x => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) * F x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hf, hhf⟩ : ∃ hf : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, hf = fun p => p.1 *
        (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((L ^ 2 - p.1 ^ 2) / s)) *
        F ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![p.1 * Real.cos p.2, p.1 * Real.sin p.2]) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : E2 ≃ᵐ ℝ × ℝ,
        e = (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hmp : MeasurePreserving e volume volume := by
      rw [he]
      exact (volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ).comp
        (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 2))
    have hes : ∀ u v : ℝ, e.symm (u, v) = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![u, v] := by
      intro u v
      rw [he]
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    have hgoal : (∫ x : E2, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) * F x) =
        ∫ x, H x := by rw [hH]
    have step1 : ∫ x, H x = ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, H (e.symm p) := by
      have := hmp.integral_comp' (fun p => H (e.symm p))
      simp only [MeasurableEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
      exact this
    have step2 : ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, H (e.symm p) =
        ∫ p in polarCoord.target, p.1 • H (e.symm (polarCoord.symm p)) :=
      (integral_comp_polarCoord_symm (fun p => H (e.symm p))).symm
    have step3 : ∫ p in polarCoord.target, p.1 • H (e.symm (polarCoord.symm p)) =
        ∫ p in polarCoord.target, hf p := by
      congr 1
      funext p
      rw [polarCoord_symm_apply, hes, smul_eq_mul, hH, hhf]
      simp only [hside]
      ring
    have htm : MeasurableSet polarCoord.target := by
      rw [polarCoord_target]; exact measurableSet_Ioi.prod measurableSet_Ioo
    have hS : Set.Icc a L ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi ⊆ polarCoord.target := by
      rw [polarCoord_target]
      exact Set.prod_mono (fun r hr => lt_of_lt_of_le ha0 hr.1) subset_rfl
    have step4 : ∫ p in polarCoord.target, hf p =
        ∫ p in Set.Icc a L ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi, hf p := by
      apply setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero htm hS
      rintro p ⟨hpt, hpS⟩
      rw [polarCoord_target] at hpt
      obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hpt
      have hp1' : 0 < p.1 := hp1
      have hr : p.1 < a ∨ L < p.1 := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        exact hpS ⟨⟨hcon.1, hcon.2⟩, hp2⟩
      have hz : deriv Real.smoothTransition ((L ^ 2 - p.1 ^ 2) / s) = 0 := by
        rcases hr with hr | hr
        · apply h1
          rw [le_div_iff₀ hs]
          have : p.1 ^ 2 < a ^ 2 := by nlinarith
          linarith
        · apply h0
          apply div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg _ hs.le
          nlinarith
      rw [hhf]
      simp [hz]
    have hK : IsCompact (Set.Icc a L ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) :=
      isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hFQ : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        F ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![p.1 * Real.cos p.2, p.1 * Real.sin p.2]))
        (Set.Icc a L ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) :=
      hF.comp hQc.continuousOn (fun p hp => hann p.1 p.2 hp.1.1)
    have hhK : ContinuousOn hf (Set.Icc a L ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) := by
      rw [hhf]
      exact ((continuous_fst.mul (continuous_const.mul (hcont.comp
        ((continuous_const.sub (continuous_fst.pow 2)).div_const s)))).continuousOn).mul hFQ
    have hint : IntegrableOn hf (Set.Icc a L ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi) volume :=
      (hhK.integrableOn_compact hK).mono_set (Set.prod_mono subset_rfl Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self)
    have step5 : ∫ p in Set.Icc a L ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi, hf p =
        ∫ r in Set.Icc a L, ∫ θ in Set.Ioo (-Real.pi) Real.pi, hf (r, θ) := by
      rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod] at hint ⊢
      exact setIntegral_prod hf hint
    rw [hgoal, step1, step2, step3, step4, step5, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le haL.le,
      ← integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc]
    congr 1
    funext r
    rw [hhf, hw]
    dsimp only
    rw [integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hpi, integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦc, hΦeq⟩ : ∃ Φ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous Φ ∧ ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc a L,
      Φ r = ∫ θ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
        F ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![r * Real.cos θ, r * Real.sin θ]) := by
    have hκ : Continuous (fun r : ℝ => (Set.projIcc a L haL.le r : ℝ)) :=
      continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_projIcc
    have hQ' : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm
          ![(Set.projIcc a L haL.le p.1 : ℝ) * Real.cos p.2,
            (Set.projIcc a L haL.le p.1 : ℝ) * Real.sin p.2] : E2)) :=
      hQc.comp ((hκ.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd)
    have hcu : Continuous (Function.uncurry fun (r θ : ℝ) =>
        F ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm
          ![(Set.projIcc a L haL.le r : ℝ) * Real.cos θ,
            (Set.projIcc a L haL.le r : ℝ) * Real.sin θ])) :=
      hF.comp_continuous hQ' (fun p => hann _ p.2 (Set.projIcc a L haL.le p.1).2.1)
    refine ⟨fun r => ∫ θ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi,
        F ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm
          ![(Set.projIcc a L haL.le r : ℝ) * Real.cos θ,
            (Set.projIcc a L haL.le r : ℝ) * Real.sin θ]), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous
        (a₀ := -Real.pi) hcu continuous_const
    · intro r hr
      simp only [Set.projIcc_of_mem haL.le hr]
  
  have hlimJ : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => ∫ r in a..L, w s r * Φ r) (𝓝[>] 0)
      (𝓝 ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Φ L)) := by
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδΦ⟩ := Metric.continuous_iff.mp hΦc L ε hε
    refine ⟨min (L ^ 2 - a ^ 2) (L * δ), lt_min hgap (mul_pos hL0 hδ), ?_⟩
    intro s hs hsd
    have hs0 : 0 < s := hs
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hs0] at hsd
    have hsa : s < L ^ 2 - a ^ 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hsd (min_le_left _ _)
    have hsδ : s < L * δ := lt_of_lt_of_le hsd (min_le_right _ _)
    have hint1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => w s r * Φ r) volume a L :=
      ((hwc s).mul hΦc).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hint2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => w s r * Φ L) volume a L :=
      ((hwc s).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hdiff : (∫ r in a..L, w s r * Φ r) - 1 / 2 * Φ L =
        ∫ r in a..L, w s r * (Φ r - Φ L) := by
      have hc : ∫ r in a..L, w s r * Φ L = 1 / 2 * Φ L := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, hmass s hs0 hsa]
      rw [← hc, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub hint1 hint2]
      congr 1
      funext r
      ring
    have hbound : ‖∫ r in a..L, w s r * (Φ r - Φ L)‖ ≤ ∫ r in a..L, w s r * ε := by
      apply intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le haL.le
      · refine ae_of_all _ (fun r hr => ?_)
        have hr0 : 0 < r := lt_trans ha0 hr.1
        have hw0 : 0 ≤ w s r := by
          rw [hw]
          exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr0.le (inv_nonneg.mpr hs0.le)) (hnn _)
        by_cases hd : (L ^ 2 - r ^ 2) / s < 1
        · have hlt : L ^ 2 - r ^ 2 < s := by rwa [div_lt_one hs0] at hd
          have hLr : L * (L - r) < L * δ := by
            nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr0.le (sub_nonneg.mpr hr.2)]
          have hLr' : L - r < δ := lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left hLr hL0.le
          have hdist : dist r L < δ := by
            rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_lt_iff]
            constructor <;> linarith [hr.2]
          have hΦ : |Φ r - Φ L| < ε := by
            have := hδΦ r hdist
            rwa [Real.dist_eq] at this
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hw0]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΦ.le hw0
        · push_neg at hd
          have hw00 : w s r = 0 := by
            rw [hw]
            simp only [h1 _ hd, mul_zero]
          rw [hw00]
          simp
      · exact ((hwc s).mul continuous_const).intervalIntegrable _ _
    have hval : ∫ r in a..L, w s r * ε = 1 / 2 * ε := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const, hmass s hs0 hsa]
    rw [Real.dist_eq, hdiff]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hbound
    linarith
  
  have hlim2 : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
      ∫ x : E2, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) * F x)
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Φ L)) := by
    refine Tendsto.congr' ?_ hlimJ
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hgap] with s hs
    show (∫ r in a..L, w s r * Φ r) =
      ∫ x : E2, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) * F x
    rw [hpolar s hs.1 hs.2]
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro r hr
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le haL.le] at hr
    simp only [hΦeq r hr]
  rw [hΦeq L ⟨haL.le, le_rfl⟩] at hlim2
  exact hlim2

informal_problem.statement:
(h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (O : Set E2) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a b) O)
    (hsym : ∀ (y : E2) (a b : Fin 2), h y a b = h y b a)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ O, (h y).PosDef) :
    ContinuousOn
      (fun x : E2 => sgbSideF (h x) (fun c a b => pd2 c (fun y => h y a b) x) (x 0) (x 1))
      {x : E2 | x ∈ O ∧ x ≠ 0}

signature.name: side_density_continuous
signature.statement:
(h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (O : Set E2) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a b) O)
    (hsym : ∀ (y : E2) (a b : Fin 2), h y a b = h y b a)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ O, (h y).PosDef) :
    ContinuousOn
      (fun x : E2 => sgbSideF (h x) (fun c a b => pd2 c (fun y => h y a b) x) (x 0) (x 1))
      {x : E2 | x ∈ O ∧ x ≠ 0}

proof.tactics:
by
  have hSO : {x : E2 | x ∈ O ∧ x ≠ 0} ⊆ O := fun x hx => hx.1
  have hg : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => h x a b) {x : E2 | x ∈ O ∧ x ≠ 0} :=
    fun a b => ((hh a b).continuousOn).mono hSO
  have hd : ∀ c a b : Fin 2,
      ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 c (fun y => h y a b) x) {x : E2 | x ∈ O ∧ x ≠ 0} := by
    intro c a b
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fun y => h y a b)) O :=
      (hh a b).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)
    exact (h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const).mono hSO
  have hx0 : ContinuousOn (fun x : E2 => x 0) {x : E2 | x ∈ O ∧ x ≠ 0} :=
    (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ 0).continuousOn
  have hx1 : ContinuousOn (fun x : E2 => x 1) {x : E2 | x ∈ O ∧ x ≠ 0} :=
    (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ 1).continuousOn
  have hdet : ∀ x ∈ {x : E2 | x ∈ O ∧ x ≠ 0}, Real.sqrt (h x).det ≠ 0 := fun x hx =>
    (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hpd x hx.1).det_pos).ne'
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) {x : E2 | x ∈ O ∧ x ≠ 0} := by
    have e : (fun x => (h x).det) = fun x => h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 := by
      funext x; exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
    have : ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x).det) {x : E2 | x ∈ O ∧ x ≠ 0} := by
      rw [e]
      exact ((hg 0 0).mul (hg 1 1)).sub ((hg 0 1).mul (hg 1 0))
    exact this.sqrt
  have hq : ∀ x ∈ {x : E2 | x ∈ O ∧ x ≠ 0},
      h x 1 1 * x 0 ^ 2 - 2 * h x 0 1 * x 0 * x 1 + h x 0 0 * x 1 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hv : (![-(x 1), x 0] : Fin 2 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hv0
      apply hx.2
      have e0 : x 1 = 0 := by
        have := congrFun hv0 0
        simpa using this
      have e1 : x 0 = 0 := by
        have := congrFun hv0 1
        simpa using this
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · simpa using e1
      · simpa using e0
    have hpos := (hpd x hx.1).dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
      Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons] at hpos
    rw [hsym x 1 0] at hpos
    have : 0 < h x 1 1 * x 0 ^ 2 - 2 * h x 0 1 * x 0 * x 1 + h x 0 0 * x 1 ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    exact this.ne'
  simp only [sgbSideF]
  refine ContinuousOn.div ?_ hdetc hdet
  refine ContinuousOn.sub ?_ (ContinuousOn.div ?_ ?_ hq)
  · apply_rules (config := { maxDepth := 500 }) [ContinuousOn.add, ContinuousOn.sub,
      ContinuousOn.mul, ContinuousOn.pow, ContinuousOn.neg, continuousOn_const, hg, hd, hx0, hx1]
  · apply_rules (config := { maxDepth := 500 }) [ContinuousOn.add, ContinuousOn.sub,
      ContinuousOn.mul, ContinuousOn.pow, ContinuousOn.neg, continuousOn_const, hg, hd, hx0, hx1]
  · apply_rules (config := { maxDepth := 500 }) [ContinuousOn.add, ContinuousOn.sub,
      ContinuousOn.mul, ContinuousOn.pow, ContinuousOn.neg, continuousOn_const, hg, hd, hx0, hx1]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (q C ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : 2 ≤ ρ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})
    (hgram : ∀ z : E3, 2 < ‖z‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e i)) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e j)) = G z i j)
    (hnear : ∀ z : E3, ρ < ‖z‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |G z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6)
    (hdG : ∀ z : E3, ρ < ‖z‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) z‖ ≤ C * ‖z‖ ^ (-q - 1)) :
    ∀ z : E3, ρ < ‖z‖ → ∀ i k : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z (e k)‖ ≤ 27 / 2 * C * ‖z‖ ^ (-q - 1)

signature.name: eii_koszul_column_bound
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (q C ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : 2 ≤ ρ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})
    (hgram : ∀ z : E3, 2 < ‖z‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e i)) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e j)) = G z i j)
    (hnear : ∀ z : E3, ρ < ‖z‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      |G z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6)
    (hdG : ∀ z : E3, ρ < ‖z‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) z‖ ≤ C * ‖z‖ ^ (-q - 1)) :
    ∀ z : E3, ρ < ‖z‖ → ∀ i k : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z (e k)‖ ≤ 27 / 2 * C * ‖z‖ ^ (-q - 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hGIB : ∀ (p : Fin 3 → E3),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |@inner ℝ E3 _ (p i) (p j) - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6) →
      ∀ v : E3, ‖v‖ ≤ 3 * ∑ l : Fin 3, |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)| := by
    intro p hp v
    have hq : ∀ c : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, c i ^ 2 ≤ ‖∑ i : Fin 3, c i • p i‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro c
      have key : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
          c i * c j * (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) - (c i ^ 2 + c j ^ 2) / 12
            ≤ c i * (c j * @inner ℝ E3 _ (p i) (p j)) := by
        intro i j
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hp i j)
        have e1 : 0 ≤ (1 / 6 + (@inner ℝ E3 _ (p i) (p j) - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)))
            * (c i + c j) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
        have e2 : 0 ≤ (1 / 6 - (@inner ℝ E3 _ (p i) (p j) - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)))
            * (c i - c j) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (by linarith) (sq_nonneg _)
        nlinarith
      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left,
        real_inner_smul_right]
      have k00 := key 0 0
      have k01 := key 0 1
      have k02 := key 0 2
      have k10 := key 1 0
      have k11 := key 1 1
      have k12 := key 1 2
      have k20 := key 2 0
      have k21 := key 2 1
      have k22 := key 2 2
      simp only [Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceEq, ↓reduceIte, mul_one, mul_zero] at k00 k01 k02 k10 k11 k12 k20 k21 k22
      linarith
    have hli : LinearIndependent ℝ p := by
      rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
      intro g hg i
      have h := hq g
      rw [hg, norm_zero] at h
      have hi : g i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, g j ^ 2 :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => g j ^ 2) (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (g j))
          (Finset.mem_univ i)
      have hz : g i ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm (by nlinarith) (sq_nonneg _)
      exact (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).mp hz
    have hspan : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range p) = ⊤ :=
      hli.span_eq_top_of_card_eq_finrank' (by rw [Fintype.card_fin, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin])
    have hvmem : v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range p) := by
      rw [hspan]; exact Submodule.mem_top
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hvmem
    have hinner : @inner ℝ E3 _ v (∑ i : Fin 3, c i • p i)
        = ∑ l : Fin 3, c l * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l) := by
      rw [inner_sum]
      simp only [real_inner_smul_right]
    rw [hc] at hinner
    have hN : ‖v‖ ^ 2 = ∑ l : Fin 3, c l * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l) := by
      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hinner]
    have hqc := hq c
    rw [hc] at hqc
    have hn0 : 0 ≤ ‖v‖ := norm_nonneg v
    have hcl : ∀ l : Fin 3, |c l| ≤ 3 * ‖v‖ := by
      intro l
      have hl : c l ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, c j ^ 2 :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => c j ^ 2) (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (c j))
          (Finset.mem_univ l)
      have hsq : c l ^ 2 ≤ (3 * ‖v‖) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have := sq_le_sq.mp hsq
      rwa [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * ‖v‖)] at this
    have hterm : ∀ l : Fin 3, c l * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)
        ≤ 3 * ‖v‖ * |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)| := by
      intro l
      calc c l * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l) ≤ |c l * @inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |c l| * |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ 3 * ‖v‖ * |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcl l) (abs_nonneg _)
    have hsum : ‖v‖ * ‖v‖ ≤ ‖v‖ * (3 * ∑ l : Fin 3, |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)|) := by
      have h1 : ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ l : Fin 3, 3 * ‖v‖ * |@inner ℝ E3 _ v (p l)| := by
        rw [hN]; exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun l _ => hterm l)
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at h1
      nlinarith
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hn0 with h0 | hpos
    · rw [← h0]; positivity
    · exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hsum hpos
  
  intro z hz
  have hz2 : 2 < ‖z‖ := lt_of_le_of_lt hρ hz
  have hΩ : IsOpen {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ψ z := hψ.contDiffAt (hΩ.mem_nhds hz2)
  have hd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ ψ) z := hc.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_cast)
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z := hd1.differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hFd : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z :=
    fun i => hd.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e i))
  have hcol : ∀ i k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z (e k) =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) z (e k) (e i) := by
    intro i k
    have h := fderiv_clm_apply (c := fderiv ℝ ψ) (u := fun _ : E3 => e i) hd
      (differentiableAt_const _)
    rw [h]
    simp
  have hsym : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ ψ z :=
    hc.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp only [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; norm_cast)
  have Dsym : ∀ i k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z (e k) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e k)) z (e i) := by
    intro i k
    rw [hcol, hcol]
    exact hsym (e k) (e i)
  
  have hgd : ∀ a b m : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y a b) z (e m) =
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e a)) (fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e b)) z (e m)) +
      @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e a)) z (e m)) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e b)) := by
    intro a b m
    have heq : (fun y => G y a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (fun y => @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ y (e a)) (fderiv ℝ ψ y (e b))) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hΩ.mem_nhds hz2) (fun y hy => (hgram y hy a b).symm)
    rw [heq.fderiv_eq]
    exact fderiv_inner_apply ℝ (hFd a) (hFd b) (e m)
  
  have hpb : ∀ a b m : Fin 3, |fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y a b) z (e m)| ≤ C * ‖z‖ ^ (-q - 1) := by
    intro a b m
    have h := (fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y a b) z).le_opNorm (e m)
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact h.trans (hdG z hz a b)
  intro i k
  refine ⟨hFd i, ?_⟩
  
  have hcoef : ∀ l : Fin 3,
      |@inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z (e k)) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l))|
        ≤ 3 / 2 * (C * ‖z‖ ^ (-q - 1)) := by
    intro l
    have h1 := hgd i l k
    have h2 := hgd k l i
    have h3 := hgd k i l
    have s1 : @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e i)) (fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e l)) z (e k))
        = @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e k)) z (e l)) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e i)) := by
      rw [Dsym l k, real_inner_comm]
    have s2 : @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e k)) (fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e l)) z (e i))
        = @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e k)) (fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z (e l)) := by
      rw [Dsym l i]
    have s3 : fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e k)) z (e i) =
        fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z (e k) := Dsym k i
    rw [s3] at h2
    have hkey : 2 * @inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z (e k))
        (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) = fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i l) z (e k)
          + fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y k l) z (e i) - fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y k i) z (e l) := by
      linarith
    obtain ⟨a1, b1⟩ := abs_le.mp (hpb i l k)
    obtain ⟨a2, b2⟩ := abs_le.mp (hpb k l i)
    obtain ⟨a3, b3⟩ := abs_le.mp (hpb k i l)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  have hp : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      |@inner ℝ E3 _ ((fun l => fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) a) ((fun l => fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) b)
        - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6 := by
    intro a b
    show |@inner ℝ E3 _ (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e a)) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e b))
        - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ 1 / 6
    rw [hgram z hz2 a b]
    exact hnear z hz a b
  have hmain := hGIB (fun l => fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) hp
    (fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ ψ w (e i)) z (e k))
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hmain
  have c0 := hcoef 0
  have c1 := hcoef 1
  have c2 := hcoef 2
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(F : E3 → E3) (q K r : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hdiff : ∀ w : E3, r < ‖w‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ F w)
    (hbd : ∀ w : E3, r < ‖w‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ F w‖ ≤ K * ‖w‖ ^ (-q - 1)) :
    ∀ x x' : E3, 2 * r < ‖x‖ → ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x'‖ →
      ‖F x - F x'‖ ≤ K * (1 / q + 2 ^ (q + 3)) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)

signature.name: eii_column_oscillation
signature.statement:
(F : E3 → E3) (q K r : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hdiff : ∀ w : E3, r < ‖w‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ F w)
    (hbd : ∀ w : E3, r < ‖w‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ F w‖ ≤ K * ‖w‖ ^ (-q - 1)) :
    ∀ x x' : E3, 2 * r < ‖x‖ → ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x'‖ →
      ‖F x - F x'‖ ≤ K * (1 / q + 2 ^ (q + 3)) * ‖x‖ ^ (-q)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have horth : ∀ (x y : E3) (ρ : ℝ), 0 ≤ ρ → ∃ z : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ x z = 0 ∧
      @inner ℝ E3 _ y z = 0 ∧ ‖z‖ = ρ := by
    intro x y ρ hρ
    obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : Submodule ℝ E3,
        W = Submodule.span ℝ ((({x, y} : Finset E3)) : Set E3) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have h1 : Module.finrank ℝ W ≤ 2 := by
      rw [hWdef]
      exact (finrank_span_finset_le_card _).trans Finset.card_le_two
    have h2 : Module.finrank ℝ W + Module.finrank ℝ Wᗮ = 3 := by
      rw [Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    have h3 : Wᗮ ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro h
      rw [h, finrank_bot] at h2
      omega
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hv0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 h3
    have hxW : x ∈ W := by rw [hWdef]; exact Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
    have hyW : y ∈ W := by rw [hWdef]; exact Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
    have hxv : @inner ℝ E3 _ x v = 0 := (Submodule.mem_orthogonal W v).1 hv x hxW
    have hyv : @inner ℝ E3 _ y v = 0 := (Submodule.mem_orthogonal W v).1 hv y hyW
    have hvn : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hv0
    refine ⟨(ρ / ‖v‖) • v, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [real_inner_smul_right, hxv, mul_zero]
    · rw [real_inner_smul_right, hyv, mul_zero]
    · rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hρ hvn.le),
        div_mul_cancel₀ _ hvn.ne']
  
  have hchord : ∀ (x z : E3) (ρ : ℝ), 2 * r < ρ → ‖x‖ = ρ → ‖z‖ = ρ →
      @inner ℝ E3 _ x z = 0 → ‖F x - F z‖ ≤ K * 2 ^ (q + 2) * ρ ^ (-q) := by
    intro x z ρ hρ hx hz hxz
    have hρpos : 0 < ρ := by linarith
    have hfloor : ∀ w ∈ segment ℝ x z, ρ / 2 ≤ ‖w‖ := by
      intro w hw
      rw [segment_eq_image] at hw
      obtain ⟨θ, hθ, rfl⟩ := hw
      show ρ / 2 ≤ ‖(1 - θ) • x + θ • z‖
      have hsq : ‖(1 - θ) • x + θ • z‖ ^ 2 = ((1 - θ) ^ 2 + θ ^ 2) * ρ ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_add_sq_real, norm_smul, norm_smul, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
          hxz, hx, hz, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs, sq_abs]
        ring
      have h2 : (ρ / 2) ^ 2 ≤ ‖(1 - θ) • x + θ • z‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hsq]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg (2 * θ - 1)) (sq_nonneg ρ), sq_nonneg ρ]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg ((1 - θ) • x + θ • z)]
    have hD : ∀ w ∈ segment ℝ x z, DifferentiableAt ℝ F w :=
      fun w hw => hdiff w (by linarith [hfloor w hw])
    have hB : ∀ w ∈ segment ℝ x z, ‖fderiv ℝ F w‖ ≤ K * (ρ / 2) ^ (-q - 1) := by
      intro w hw
      have hw' := hfloor w hw
      refine (hbd w (by linarith)).trans ?_
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by linarith) hw' (by linarith)) hK
    have hmvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hD hB (convex_segment x z)
      (right_mem_segment ℝ x z) (left_mem_segment ℝ x z)
    have hxz2 : ‖x - z‖ ≤ 2 * ρ := by
      have := norm_sub_le x z
      linarith
    have hC0 : 0 ≤ K * (ρ / 2) ^ (-q - 1) := mul_nonneg hK (Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _)
    have h2pos : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ (-q - 1) := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by norm_num) _
    have e1 : ρ ^ (-q - 1) * ρ = ρ ^ (-q) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add_one hρpos.ne']
      congr 1
      ring
    have e2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 2) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-q - 1) = 2 := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
      rw [show q + 2 + (-q - 1) = 1 by ring, Real.rpow_one]
    have halg : (ρ / 2) ^ (-q - 1) * (2 * ρ) = 2 ^ (q + 2) * ρ ^ (-q) := by
      rw [Real.div_rpow hρpos.le (by norm_num), div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_iff h2pos.ne']
      calc ρ ^ (-q - 1) * (2 * ρ) = 2 * (ρ ^ (-q - 1) * ρ) := by ring
        _ = 2 * ρ ^ (-q) := by rw [e1]
        _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 2) * (2 : ℝ) ^ (-q - 1)) * ρ ^ (-q) := by rw [e2]
        _ = 2 ^ (q + 2) * ρ ^ (-q) * 2 ^ (-q - 1) := by ring
    calc ‖F x - F z‖ ≤ K * (ρ / 2) ^ (-q - 1) * ‖x - z‖ := hmvt
      _ ≤ K * (ρ / 2) ^ (-q - 1) * (2 * ρ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxz2 hC0
      _ = K * ((ρ / 2) ^ (-q - 1) * (2 * ρ)) := by ring
      _ = K * 2 ^ (q + 2) * ρ ^ (-q) := by rw [halg]; ring
  
  have hradial : ∀ u : E3, ‖u‖ = 1 → ∀ a b : ℝ, r < a → a ≤ b →
      ‖F (b • u) - F (a • u)‖ ≤ K / q * a ^ (-q) := by
    intro u hu a b ha hab
    have hapos : 0 < a := by linarith
    have hnorm : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ‖t • u‖ = t := by
      intro t ht
      rw [norm_smul, hu, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht]
    have hderF : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (s • u) - F (a • u))
        (fderiv ℝ F (t • u) u) t := by
      intro t ht
      have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith [ht.1]
      have hF : HasFDerivAt F (fderiv ℝ F (t • u)) (t • u) :=
        (hdiff _ (by rw [hnorm t htpos]; linarith [ht.1])).hasFDerivAt
      have hl : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => s • u) u t := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).smul_const u
      exact (hF.comp_hasDerivAt t hl).sub_const _
    have hderB : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => K / q * (a ^ (-q) - s ^ (-q)))
        (K * t ^ (-q - 1)) t := by
      intro t ht
      have h1 := ((Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (p := -q) (Or.inl ht.ne')).const_sub
        (a ^ (-q))).const_mul (K / q)
      convert h1 using 1
      have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := hq.ne'
      field_simp
    have key := image_norm_le_of_norm_deriv_right_le_deriv_boundary'
      (a := a) (b := b) (f := fun s : ℝ => F (s • u) - F (a • u)) (f' := fun t => fderiv ℝ F (t • u) u)
      (B := fun s : ℝ => K / q * (a ^ (-q) - s ^ (-q))) (B' := fun t => K * t ^ (-q - 1))
      (fun t ht => (hderF t ht).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t ht => (hderF t (Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self ht)).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (by simp)
      (fun t ht => (hderB t (by linarith [ht.1])).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
      (fun t ht => (hderB t (by linarith [ht.1])).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (by
        intro t ht
        have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith [ht.1]
        have h1 := (fderiv ℝ F (t • u)).le_opNorm u
        have h2 := hbd (t • u) (by rw [hnorm t htpos]; linarith [ht.1])
        rw [hu, mul_one] at h1
        rw [hnorm t htpos] at h2
        exact h1.trans h2)
      (show b ∈ Set.Icc a b from ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩)
    have hbq : 0 ≤ b ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_nonneg (by linarith) _
    have hKq : 0 ≤ K / q := div_nonneg hK hq.le
    calc ‖F (b • u) - F (a • u)‖ ≤ K / q * (a ^ (-q) - b ^ (-q)) := key
      _ ≤ K / q * a ^ (-q) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) hKq
  
  intro x x' hx hxx'
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρdef⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = ‖x‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hρdef] at hx hxx' ⊢
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := by linarith
  have hρ'pos : 0 < ‖x'‖ := by linarith
  obtain ⟨u, hudef⟩ : ∃ u : E3, u = ‖x'‖⁻¹ • x' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
    rw [hudef, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hρ'pos.ne']
  have hx'u : ‖x'‖ • u = x' := by
    rw [hudef, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hρ'pos.ne', one_smul]
  have hy : ‖ρ • u‖ = ρ := by
    rw [norm_smul, hu, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hρpos]
  obtain ⟨z, hxz, hyz, hz⟩ := horth x (ρ • u) ρ hρpos.le
  have c1 := hchord x z ρ hx hρdef.symm hz hxz
  have c2 := hchord (ρ • u) z ρ hx hy hz hyz
  have c3 := hradial u hu ρ ‖x'‖ (by linarith) hxx'
  rw [hx'u] at c3
  have hsplit : F x - F x' = (F x - F z) - (F (ρ • u) - F z) - (F x' - F (ρ • u)) := by abel
  have h2pow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (q + 3) = 2 * 2 ^ (q + 2) := by
    rw [show q + 3 = (q + 2) + 1 by ring, Real.rpow_add_one (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)]
    ring
  have hrhs : K * (1 / q + 2 ^ (q + 3)) * ρ ^ (-q) =
      K * 2 ^ (q + 2) * ρ ^ (-q) + K * 2 ^ (q + 2) * ρ ^ (-q) + K / q * ρ ^ (-q) := by
    rw [h2pow]
    ring
  have t1 := norm_sub_le ((F x - F z) - (F (ρ • u) - F z)) (F x' - F (ρ • u))
  have t2 := norm_sub_le (F x - F z) (F (ρ • u) - F z)
  rw [hsplit, hrhs]
  linarith

signature.statement:
(η : E3 → E3) (M ρ : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hdiff : ∀ w : E3, ρ < ‖w‖ → DifferentiableAt ℝ η w)
    (hbd : ∀ w : E3, ρ < ‖w‖ → ‖fderiv ℝ η w‖ ≤ M) :
    ∀ x y : E3, 2 * ρ < ‖x‖ → 2 * ρ < ‖y‖ → ‖η x - η y‖ ≤ 11 * M * ‖x - y‖

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hmvt : ∀ a b : E3, (∀ p ∈ segment ℝ a b, ρ < ‖p‖) → ‖η a - η b‖ ≤ M * ‖a - b‖ := by
    intro a b h
    exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
      (fun p hp => hdiff p (h p hp)) (fun p hp => hbd p (h p hp))
      (convex_segment a b) (right_mem_segment ℝ a b) (left_mem_segment ℝ a b)
  
  have horth : ∀ x y : E3, ∃ u : E3, ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ @inner ℝ E3 _ x u = 0 ∧
      @inner ℝ E3 _ y u = 0 := by
    intro x y
    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : Submodule ℝ E3, S = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![x, y]) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have h1 : Module.finrank ℝ S ≤ 2 := by
      have := finrank_range_le_card (R := ℝ) (b := ![x, y])
      rw [hS]
      exact this.trans (by simp)
    have h2 := Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal S
    have h3 : Module.finrank ℝ E3 = 3 := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
    rw [h3] at h2
    have hne : Sᗮ ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro hbot
      rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at h2
      omega
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hw0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hne
    have hwn : ‖w‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.2 hw0
    have hxS : x ∈ S := by rw [hS]; exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, rfl⟩
    have hyS : y ∈ S := by rw [hS]; exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨‖w‖⁻¹ • w, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hwn]
    · rw [real_inner_smul_right, Submodule.inner_right_of_mem_orthogonal hxS hw, mul_zero]
    · rw [real_inner_smul_right, Submodule.inner_right_of_mem_orthogonal hyS hw, mul_zero]
  
  have hchord : ∀ a u : E3, ‖u‖ = 1 → @inner ℝ E3 _ a u = 0 →
      ∀ p ∈ segment ℝ a (‖a‖ • u), ‖a‖ / 2 ≤ ‖p‖ := by
    intro a u hu hau p hp
    obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hab, rfl⟩ := hp
    have hua : @inner ℝ E3 _ u a = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hau
    have hsq : ‖α • a + β • (‖a‖ • u)‖ ^ 2 = (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2) * ‖a‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      simp only [inner_add_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
        real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu, hau, hua, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_norm]
      simp only [mul_pow, sq_abs, mul_one]
      ring
    have hn := norm_nonneg (α • a + β • (‖a‖ • u))
    have ha := norm_nonneg a
    have h14 : (1 : ℝ) / 4 ≤ α ^ 2 + β ^ 2 := by
      have hb' : β = 1 - α := by linarith
      rw [hb']
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (α - 1 / 2)]
    have hq : (‖a‖ / 2) ^ 2 ≤ ‖α • a + β • (‖a‖ • u)‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [hsq]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h14 (sq_nonneg ‖a‖)
      nlinarith
    nlinarith
  
  have hstar : ∀ x y : E3, 2 * ρ < ‖x‖ → 2 * ρ < ‖y‖ → ‖x‖ ≤ ‖y‖ →
      ‖η x - η y‖ ≤ 11 * M * ‖x - y‖ := by
    intro x y hx hy hxy
    have hd0 := norm_nonneg (x - y)
    have hty : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖x - y‖ := by
      have := norm_sub_norm_le y x
      rw [norm_sub_rev y x] at this
      linarith
    by_cases hcase : ‖x - y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ / 2
    · 
      have h := hmvt x y (by
        intro p hp
        rw [segment_eq_image'] at hp
        obtain ⟨θ, ⟨hθ0, hθ1⟩, rfl⟩ := hp
        show ρ < ‖x + θ • (y - x)‖
        have h1 : ‖θ • (y - x)‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hθ0, norm_sub_rev]
          exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hθ1
        have h2 := norm_sub_norm_le x (-(θ • (y - x)))
        rw [sub_neg_eq_add, norm_neg] at h2
        linarith)
      have h3 : M * ‖x - y‖ ≤ 11 * M * ‖x - y‖ := by nlinarith
      linarith
    · 
      push_neg at hcase
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hxu, hyu⟩ := horth x y
      have hs0 : 0 ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
      have hnP : ‖‖x‖ • u‖ = ‖x‖ := by rw [norm_smul, norm_norm, hu, mul_one]
      have hnQ : ‖‖y‖ • u‖ = ‖y‖ := by rw [norm_smul, norm_norm, hu, mul_one]
      have hL1 := hmvt x (‖x‖ • u) (fun p hp => by
        have := hchord x u hu hxu p hp
        linarith)
      have hL3 := hmvt y (‖y‖ • u) (fun p hp => by
        have := hchord y u hu hyu p hp
        linarith)
      have hL2 := hmvt (‖x‖ • u) (‖y‖ • u) (by
        intro p hp
        obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, hab, rfl⟩ := hp
        have he : α • (‖x‖ • u) + β • (‖y‖ • u) = (α * ‖x‖ + β * ‖y‖) • u := by
          rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, add_smul]
        have hα' : α = 1 - β := by linarith
        have hc : ‖x‖ ≤ α * ‖x‖ + β * ‖y‖ := by
          rw [hα']
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg hβ (sub_nonneg.2 hxy)]
        rw [he, norm_smul, hu, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
        linarith)
      have hl1 : ‖x - ‖x‖ • u‖ ≤ 2 * ‖x‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_le x (‖x‖ • u)
        rw [hnP] at this
        linarith
      have hl3 : ‖y - ‖y‖ • u‖ ≤ 2 * ‖y‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_le y (‖y‖ • u)
        rw [hnQ] at this
        linarith
      have hl2 : ‖‖x‖ • u - ‖y‖ • u‖ = ‖y‖ - ‖x‖ := by
        rw [← sub_smul, norm_smul, hu, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
        ring
      have htri : ‖η x - η y‖ ≤ ‖η x - η (‖x‖ • u)‖ + ‖η (‖x‖ • u) - η (‖y‖ • u)‖ +
          ‖η y - η (‖y‖ • u)‖ := by
        have e : η x - η y = ((η x - η (‖x‖ • u)) + (η (‖x‖ • u) - η (‖y‖ • u))) -
            (η y - η (‖y‖ • u)) := by abel
        rw [e]
        have h1 := norm_sub_le ((η x - η (‖x‖ • u)) + (η (‖x‖ • u) - η (‖y‖ • u)))
          (η y - η (‖y‖ • u))
        have h2 := norm_add_le (η x - η (‖x‖ • u)) (η (‖x‖ • u) - η (‖y‖ • u))
        linarith
      have m1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl1 hM
      have m3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl3 hM
      rw [hl2] at hL2
      have hfin : ‖x‖ + 3 * ‖y‖ ≤ 11 * ‖x - y‖ := by linarith
      have m4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfin hM
      nlinarith
  
  intro x y hx hy
  rcases le_total ‖x‖ ‖y‖ with h | h
  · exact hstar x y hx hy h
  · have := hstar y x hy hx h
    rw [norm_sub_rev (η y), norm_sub_rev y] at this
    exact this

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (γ : ℝ → M) (hγ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 γ) (x₀ : M) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : γ t ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).source) :
    g.g (γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        deriv (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) t a *
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ (γ t)) a b *
            deriv (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) t b

signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (γ : ℝ → M) (hγ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 γ) (x₀ : M) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : γ t ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).source) :

proof.tactics:
by
  have hexp : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
    intro v
    ext k
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  have hφt : chartAt E3 x₀ (γ t) ∈ (chartAt E3 x₀).target := (chartAt E3 x₀).map_source ht
  have hsymm : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ (γ t)) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) hφt
  have hc : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀) (γ t) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 x₀) ht
  have hγd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) γ t := hγ.mdifferentiableAt one_ne_zero
  have hφd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) t :=
    hc.comp t hγd
  have hloc : γ =ᶠ[𝓝 t] (chartAt E3 x₀).symm ∘ (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) := by
    have h1 := hγ.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.eventually
      ((chartAt E3 x₀).eventually_left_inverse ht)
    exact h1.mono fun s hs => hs.symm
  set D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ (γ t))
    with hDdef
  set B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := g.g (γ t) with hBdef
  have hvel : RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t = D (deriv (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) t) := by
    unfold RiemannianMetric3.velocity
    have h2 := mfderiv_comp_apply t hsymm hφd (1 : ℝ)
    rw [hloc.mfderiv_eq]
    refine h2.trans ?_
    show D (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) t (1 : ℝ)) = _
    rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
    rfl
  have hD : ∀ v : E3, D v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • D (e a) := by
    intro v
    conv_lhs => rw [hexp v]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul]
  have hcoef : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ (γ t)) a b = B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
    intro a b
    show g.g ((chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ (γ t))) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) = _
    rw [(chartAt E3 x₀).left_inv ht]
  rw [hvel, hD (deriv (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) t)]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, hcoef]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_))
  rw [show B (D (e b)) (D (e a)) = B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) from g.symm _ _ _]
  ring

proof.tactics:
by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro t₀
  set x₀ := γ t₀ with hx₀
  have hγc : Continuous γ := hγ.continuous
  have hU : IsOpen (γ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x₀).source) := (chartAt E3 x₀).open_source.preimage hγc
  have ht₀ : t₀ ∈ γ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x₀).source := mem_chart_source E3 x₀
  have hUn := hU.mem_nhds ht₀
  have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) (γ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x₀).source) := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 ((chartAt E3 x₀) ∘ γ)
        (γ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x₀).source) :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart (n := 1)).comp hγ.contMDiffOn (fun s hs => hs)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
  have hdφ : ContinuousAt (deriv (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s))) t₀ :=
    (hφ.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl).continuousAt hUn
  have hφc : ContinuousAt (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) t₀ :=
    hφ.continuousOn.continuousAt hUn
  have hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousAt
      (fun t => g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ (γ t)) a b) t₀ := by
    intro a b
    have h := ((g.smooth x₀ a b).continuousOn.continuousAt
      ((chartAt E3 x₀).open_target.mem_nhds (mem_chart_target E3 x₀)))
    exact ContinuousAt.comp_of_eq (g := fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y a b) h hφc rfl
  have hcoord : ∀ a : Fin 3,
      ContinuousAt (fun t => deriv (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) t a) t₀ := by
    intro a
    exact (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 (fun _ => ℝ) a).continuousAt.comp hdφ
  have hR : ContinuousAt (fun t => Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      deriv (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) t a *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 x₀).symm (chartAt E3 x₀ (γ t)) a b *
          deriv (fun s => chartAt E3 x₀ (γ s)) t b)) t₀ := by
    apply ContinuousAt.sqrt
    apply tendsto_finset_sum
    intro a _
    apply tendsto_finset_sum
    intro b _
    exact ((hcoord a).mul (hG a b)).mul (hcoord b)
  refine hR.congr ?_
  filter_upwards [hUn] with t ht
  rw [hformula x₀ t ht]

signature.statement:
[ConnectedSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (x y : M) :
    ∃ γ : ℝ → M, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 γ ∧ γ 0 = x ∧ γ 1 = y

proof.tactics:
by
  let SP : M → M → Prop := fun a b => ∃ γ : ℝ → M, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 γ ∧
      γ 0 = a ∧ γ 1 = b ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → γ t = a) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → γ t = b)
  
  have hloc : ∀ a : M, ∀ᶠ b in 𝓝 a, SP a b := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (chartAt E3 a).open_target (chartAt E3 a a) (mem_chart_target E3 a)
    have hV : (chartAt E3 a).source ∩ (chartAt E3 a) ⁻¹' ball (chartAt E3 a a) ε ∈ 𝓝 a :=
      ((chartAt E3 a).isOpen_inter_preimage isOpen_ball).mem_nhds
        ⟨mem_chart_source E3 a, mem_ball_self hε⟩
    filter_upwards [hV] with b hb
    let σ : ℝ → E3 := fun t =>
      chartAt E3 a a + Real.smoothTransition t • (chartAt E3 a b - chartAt E3 a a)
    have hσmem : ∀ t, σ t ∈ (chartAt E3 a).target := by
      intro t
      apply hball
      exact (convex_ball (chartAt E3 a a) ε).add_smul_sub_mem (mem_ball_self hε) hb.2
        ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg t, Real.smoothTransition.le_one t⟩
    have hσs : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 σ := by
      apply ContDiff.contMDiff
      have hst : ContDiff ℝ 1 Real.smoothTransition := by
        exact_mod_cast (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1))
      exact contDiff_const.add (hst.smul contDiff_const)
    have hsy : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 (chartAt E3 a).symm (chartAt E3 a).target :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (n := ∞) (x := a)).of_le (by simp)
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 a).symm ∘ σ, hsy.comp_contMDiff hσs hσmem, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show (chartAt E3 a).symm (chartAt E3 a a +
        Real.smoothTransition 0 • (chartAt E3 a b - chartAt E3 a a)) = a
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos le_rfl, zero_smul, add_zero]
      exact (chartAt E3 a).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 a)
    · show (chartAt E3 a).symm (chartAt E3 a a +
        Real.smoothTransition 1 • (chartAt E3 a b - chartAt E3 a a)) = b
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le le_rfl, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
      exact (chartAt E3 a).left_inv hb.1
    · intro t ht
      show (chartAt E3 a).symm (chartAt E3 a a +
        Real.smoothTransition t • (chartAt E3 a b - chartAt E3 a a)) = a
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos ht, zero_smul, add_zero]
      exact (chartAt E3 a).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 a)
    · intro t ht
      show (chartAt E3 a).symm (chartAt E3 a a +
        Real.smoothTransition t • (chartAt E3 a b - chartAt E3 a a)) = b
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le ht, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
      exact (chartAt E3 a).left_inv hb.1
  
  have hsymm : ∀ a b : M, SP a b → SP b a := by
    rintro a b ⟨γ, hγ, h0, h1, hl, hr⟩
    refine ⟨fun t => γ (1 - t),
      hγ.comp (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => 1 - t)).contMDiff, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show γ (1 - 0) = b
      rw [sub_zero, h1]
    · show γ (1 - 1) = a
      rw [sub_self, h0]
    · intro t ht
      exact hr _ (by linarith)
    · intro t ht
      exact hl _ (by linarith)
  
  have htrans : ∀ a b d : M, SP a b → SP b d → SP a d := by
    rintro a b d ⟨γ₁, h₁, h₁0, h₁1, h₁l, h₁r⟩ ⟨γ₂, h₂, h₂0, h₂1, h₂l, h₂r⟩
    have hA : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 (fun t : ℝ => γ₁ (3 * t)) :=
      h₁.comp (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => 3 * t)).contMDiff
    have hB : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 (fun t : ℝ => γ₂ (3 * t - 2)) :=
      h₂.comp (by fun_prop : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t : ℝ => 3 * t - 2)).contMDiff
    refine ⟨fun t => if t ≤ 1 / 2 then γ₁ (3 * t) else γ₂ (3 * t - 2), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t
      by_cases ht : t < 2 / 3
      · apply hA.contMDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds ht] with u hu
        have hu' : u < 2 / 3 := hu
        show (if u ≤ 1 / 2 then γ₁ (3 * u) else γ₂ (3 * u - 2)) = γ₁ (3 * u)
        split_ifs with h
        · rfl
        · rw [h₂l _ (by linarith), h₁r _ (by linarith)]
      · have ht' : (1 : ℝ) / 3 < t := by push_neg at ht; linarith
        apply hB.contMDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ht'] with u hu
        have hu' : 1 / 3 < u := hu
        show (if u ≤ 1 / 2 then γ₁ (3 * u) else γ₂ (3 * u - 2)) = γ₂ (3 * u - 2)
        split_ifs with h
        · rw [h₁r _ (by linarith), h₂l _ (by linarith)]
        · rfl
    · show (if (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 then γ₁ (3 * 0) else γ₂ (3 * 0 - 2)) = a
      rw [if_pos (by norm_num), mul_zero, h₁0]
    · show (if (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 then γ₁ (3 * 1) else γ₂ (3 * 1 - 2)) = d
      rw [if_neg (by norm_num), show (3 : ℝ) * 1 - 2 = 1 by norm_num, h₂1]
    · intro t ht
      show (if t ≤ 1 / 2 then γ₁ (3 * t) else γ₂ (3 * t - 2)) = a
      rw [if_pos (by linarith)]
      exact h₁l _ (by linarith)
    · intro t ht
      show (if t ≤ 1 / 2 then γ₁ (3 * t) else γ₂ (3 * t - 2)) = d
      rw [if_neg (by linarith)]
      exact h₂r _ (by linarith)
  have hall : ∀ a b : M, SP a b :=
    PreconnectedSpace.induction₂ SP hloc
      (by intro a b d h1 h2; exact htrans a b d h1 h2)
      (by intro a b h; exact hsymm a b h)
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, h0, h1, -, -⟩ := hall x y
  exact ⟨γ, hγ, h0, h1⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (p : M) (s m : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) s ⊆ (chartAt E3 p).target)
    (hlow : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (chartAt E3 p p) s, ∀ v : E3,
      m * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, v k * g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y k l * v l)
    (γ : ℝ → M) (hγ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 γ) (hγ1 : γ 1 = p)
    (hcont : Continuous (fun t => Real.sqrt
      (g.g (γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t))))
    (hformula : ∀ t : ℝ, γ t ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source →
      g.g (γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          deriv (fun s => chartAt E3 p (γ s)) t a *
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p (γ t)) a b *
              deriv (fun s => chartAt E3 p (γ s)) t b)
    (hx : γ 0 ∉ (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ chartAt E3 p ⁻¹' Metric.ball (chartAt E3 p p) s) :
    Real.sqrt m * s ≤ g.curveLength γ

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (p : M) (s m : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hm : 0 < m)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set c := chartAt E3 p with hc_def
  set F : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.sqrt
    (g.g (γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t)) with hF_def
  have hγc : Continuous γ := hγ.continuous
  have hO : IsOpen (c.source ∩ c ⁻¹' Metric.ball (c p) s) :=
    c.isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hKc : IsCompact (c.symm '' Metric.closedBall (c p) s) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (c p) s).image_of_continuousOn (c.continuousOn_symm.mono hball)
  have hKcl : IsClosed (c.symm '' Metric.closedBall (c p) s) := hKc.isClosed
  have hKmem : ∀ z ∈ c.symm '' Metric.closedBall (c p) s,
      z ∈ c.source ∧ c z ∈ Metric.closedBall (c p) s := by
    rintro z ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c.map_target (hball hw), by rw [c.right_inv (hball hw)]; exact hw⟩
  have hOK : c.source ∩ c ⁻¹' Metric.ball (c p) s ⊆ c.symm '' Metric.closedBall (c p) s := by
    rintro y ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
    exact ⟨c y, Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy2, c.left_inv hy1⟩
  have hpO : p ∈ c.source ∩ c ⁻¹' Metric.ball (c p) s :=
    ⟨mem_chart_source E3 p, Metric.mem_ball_self hs⟩
  have hTc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ∩ γ ⁻¹' (c.source ∩ c ⁻¹' Metric.ball (c p) s)ᶜ) :=
    isCompact_Icc.inter_right (hO.isClosed_compl.preimage hγc)
  have h0T : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ∩ γ ⁻¹' (c.source ∩ c ⁻¹' Metric.ball (c p) s)ᶜ :=
    ⟨⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨τ, hτT, hτmax⟩ : ∃ τ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ∩ γ ⁻¹' (c.source ∩ c ⁻¹' Metric.ball (c p) s)ᶜ,
      ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ∩ γ ⁻¹' (c.source ∩ c ⁻¹' Metric.ball (c p) s)ᶜ, t ≤ τ :=
    ⟨_, hTc.sSup_mem ⟨0, h0T⟩, fun t ht => le_csSup hTc.bddAbove ht⟩
  have hτ0 : 0 ≤ τ := hτT.1.1
  have hτ1 : τ ≤ 1 := hτT.1.2
  have hτnot : γ τ ∉ c.source ∩ c ⁻¹' Metric.ball (c p) s := hτT.2
  have hτne : τ ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, hγ1] at hτnot
    exact hτnot hpO
  have hIoc : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioc τ 1, γ t ∈ c.symm '' Metric.closedBall (c p) s := by
    intro t ht
    by_contra hcon
    have htT : t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ∩ γ ⁻¹' (c.source ∩ c ⁻¹' Metric.ball (c p) s)ᶜ :=
      ⟨⟨by linarith [ht.1], ht.2⟩, fun h => hcon (hOK h)⟩
    have := hτmax t htT
    linarith [ht.1]
  have hτK : γ τ ∈ c.symm '' Metric.closedBall (c p) s := by
    have hcl : τ ∈ closure (Set.Ioc τ 1) := by
      rw [closure_Ioc hτne]; exact ⟨le_rfl, hτ1⟩
    have := map_mem_closure hγc hcl (fun t ht => hIoc t ht)
    rwa [hKcl.closure_eq] at this
  have hin : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc τ 1, γ t ∈ c.source ∧ c (γ t) ∈ Metric.closedBall (c p) s := by
    intro t ht
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht.1 with h | h
    · rw [← h]; exact hKmem _ hτK
    · exact hKmem _ (hIoc t ⟨h, ht.2⟩)
  have hdist : s ≤ ‖c (γ 1) - c (γ τ)‖ := by
    have h1 : c (γ τ) ∉ Metric.ball (c p) s := fun h => hτnot ⟨(hin τ ⟨le_rfl, hτ1⟩).1, h⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, not_lt, dist_eq_norm] at h1
    rw [hγ1, norm_sub_rev]
    exact h1
  
  have hUo : IsOpen (γ ⁻¹' c.source) := c.open_source.preimage hγc
  have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun t => c (γ t)) (γ ⁻¹' c.source) := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 c c.source :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart (n := ∞) (x := p)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have h2 := h1.comp hγ.contMDiffOn (fun t ht => ht)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.1 h2
  
  have hbound : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc τ 1,
      Real.sqrt m * ‖deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t‖ ≤ F t := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨hsrc, hcb⟩ := hin t ht
    have hl := hlow _ hcb (deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t)
    show Real.sqrt m * ‖deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t‖ ≤ Real.sqrt
      (g.g (γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t))
    rw [hformula t hsrc]
    calc Real.sqrt m * ‖deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t‖
        = Real.sqrt (m * ‖deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t‖ ^ 2) := by
          rw [Real.sqrt_mul hm.le, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
      _ ≤ _ := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hl
  
  have huIcc : Set.uIcc τ 1 = Set.Icc τ 1 := Set.uIcc_of_le hτ1
  have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Set.uIcc τ 1,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => c (γ s)) (deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t) t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [huIcc] at ht
    have htU : t ∈ γ ⁻¹' c.source := (hin t ht).1
    exact ((hφ.differentiableOn one_ne_zero t htU).differentiableAt
      (hUo.mem_nhds htU)).hasDerivAt
  have hdc : ContinuousOn (deriv (fun s => c (γ s))) (Set.Icc τ 1) :=
    (hφ.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen hUo le_rfl).mono (fun t ht => (hin t ht).1)
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable (deriv (fun s => c (γ s))) volume τ 1 :=
    ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (by rw [huIcc]; exact hdc)
  have hftc : ∫ t in τ..1, deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t = c (γ 1) - c (γ τ) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv hint
  have hnorm : ‖c (γ 1) - c (γ τ)‖ ≤ ∫ t in τ..1, ‖deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t‖ := by
    rw [← hftc]; exact intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm hτ1
  have hint2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => Real.sqrt m * ‖deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t‖)
      volume τ 1 :=
    ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable (by rw [huIcc]; exact continuousOn_const.mul hdc.norm)
  have hintF : ∀ a b : ℝ, IntervalIntegrable F volume a b :=
    fun a b => hcont.intervalIntegrable a b
  have hmono : ∫ t in τ..1, Real.sqrt m * ‖deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t‖ ≤ ∫ t in τ..1, F t :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hτ1 hint2 (hintF τ 1) hbound
  have hcm : ∫ t in τ..1, Real.sqrt m * ‖deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t‖ =
      Real.sqrt m * ∫ t in τ..1, ‖deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t‖ :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul _ _
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..τ, F t :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hτ0 (fun u _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hsplit : (∫ t in (0:ℝ)..τ, F t) + (∫ t in τ..1, F t) = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, F t :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (hintF 0 τ) (hintF τ 1)
  have hL : g.curveLength γ = ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..1, F t := rfl
  have hsm := Real.sqrt_nonneg m
  have h1 : Real.sqrt m * s ≤ Real.sqrt m * ‖c (γ 1) - c (γ τ)‖ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist hsm
  have h2 : Real.sqrt m * ‖c (γ 1) - c (γ τ)‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt m * ∫ t in τ..1, ‖deriv (fun s => c (γ s)) t‖ :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm hsm
  rw [hL]
  linarith
