signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hComplete : g.IsCompleteRiemannian)
    (hdist : ∀ (u : ℕ → M) (p : M),
      Tendsto (fun n => g.riemannianDist (u n) p) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 p))
    (y₀ : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (F : E3 → M)
    (hF : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ F (ball y₀ r))
    (hFg : ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r, g.coeff F y = 1) (v : E3) (hv : dist v y₀ = r) :
    ∃ q : M, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => F (y₀ + (1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) • (v - y₀))) atTop (𝓝 q)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hiso : ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r, ∀ d : E3,
      g.g (F y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F y d) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F y d) =
        ‖d‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro y hy d
    have hc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, g.g (F y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F y (e i))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F y (e j)) = if i = j then 1 else 0 := by
      intro i j
      have := congrFun (congrFun (hFg y hy) i) j
      rw [Matrix.one_apply] at this
      exact this
    have hd : d = d 0 • e 0 + d 1 • e 1 + d 2 • e 2 := by
      ext k
      fin_cases k <;> simp [e]
    have hn : ‖d‖ ^ 2 = d 0 ^ 2 + d 1 ^ 2 + d 2 ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hn]
    conv_lhs => rw [hd]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, hc]
    simp <;> ring
  
  have hdl : ∀ a ∈ ball y₀ r, ∀ b ∈ ball y₀ r, g.riemannianDist (F a) (F b) ≤ dist a b := by
    intro a ha b hb
    let c : ℝ → E3 := fun s => a + Real.smoothTransition s • (b - a)
    have hcball : ∀ s, c s ∈ ball y₀ r := by
      intro s
      have hseg : c s ∈ segment ℝ a b := by
        rw [segment_eq_image']
        exact ⟨Real.smoothTransition s,
          ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg s, Real.smoothTransition.le_one s⟩, rfl⟩
      exact (convex_ball y₀ r).segment_subset ha hb hseg
    have hcd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c :=
      contDiff_const.add (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.smul contDiff_const)
    have hcder : ∀ t, HasDerivAt c (deriv Real.smoothTransition t • (b - a)) t := by
      intro t
      have h1 : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition t) t :=
        ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      exact (h1.smul_const (b - a)).const_add a
    let γ : ℝ → M := fun s => F (c s)
    have hFat : ∀ s, MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F (c s) := fun s =>
      (hF.contMDiffAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hcball s))).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    have hγ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 γ := by
      have hinf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ γ := hF.comp_contMDiff hcd.contMDiff hcball
      exact hinf.of_le (by simp)
    have hvel : ∀ t, RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F (c t) (deriv Real.smoothTransition t • (b - a)) := by
      intro t
      unfold RiemannianMetric3.velocity
      have hcm : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) c t :=
        (hcder t).differentiableAt.mdifferentiableAt
      have hfd : fderiv ℝ c t 1 = deriv Real.smoothTransition t • (b - a) := by
        rw [(hcder t).hasFDerivAt.fderiv]
        simp
      rw [show γ = F ∘ c from rfl, mfderiv_comp_apply t (hFat t) hcm, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      erw [hfd]
    have hspeed : ∀ t, Real.sqrt (g.g (γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t)
        (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t)) = deriv Real.smoothTransition t * ‖b - a‖ := by
      intro t
      rw [hvel t]
      have hlin : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F (c t) (deriv Real.smoothTransition t • (b - a)) =
          deriv Real.smoothTransition t • mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F (c t) (b - a) :=
        map_smul _ _ _
      rw [hlin]
      simp only [map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have hi := hiso (c t) (hcball t) (b - a)
      have hγt : γ t = F (c t) := rfl
      rw [hγt, hi]
      have hnn : 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition t := Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
      rw [show deriv Real.smoothTransition t * (deriv Real.smoothTransition t * ‖b - a‖ ^ 2) =
        (deriv Real.smoothTransition t * ‖b - a‖) ^ 2 by ring]
      exact Real.sqrt_sq (mul_nonneg hnn (norm_nonneg _))
    have hlen : g.curveLength γ = ‖b - a‖ := by
      unfold RiemannianMetric3.curveLength
      simp_rw [hspeed]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
      have hcont : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) :=
        (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).continuous_deriv le_rfl
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub (fun x _ =>
          ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt)
        (hcont.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le le_rfl, Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos le_rfl]
      ring
    have hbdd : BddBelow (Set.range fun γ' : {γ : ℝ → M // ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 γ ∧
        γ 0 = F a ∧ γ 1 = F b} => g.curveLength γ'.1) := by
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨γ', rfl⟩
      exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun t _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hγ0 : γ 0 = F a := by
      simp [γ, c, Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos le_rfl]
    have hγ1 : γ 1 = F b := by
      simp [γ, c, Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le le_rfl]
    have hle : g.riemannianDist (F a) (F b) ≤ g.curveLength γ := by
      unfold RiemannianMetric3.riemannianDist
      exact ciInf_le hbdd ⟨γ, hγ, hγ0, hγ1⟩
    rw [hlen, ← dist_eq_norm'] at hle
    exact hle
  
  set x : ℕ → E3 := fun n => y₀ + (1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) • (v - y₀) with hx
  have hvnorm : ‖v - y₀‖ = r := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hv
  have hxball : ∀ n, x n ∈ ball y₀ r := by
    intro n
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hx]
    simp only [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hvnorm]
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
    have h3 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) ≤ 1 / 2 :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) (by linarith [n.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ)])
    have h4 : 0 < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by positivity
    rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
    nlinarith
  
  have hxdist : ∀ N m n : ℕ, N ≤ m → N ≤ n → dist (x m) (x n) ≤ r / ((N : ℝ) + 2) := by
    intro N m n hm hn
    rw [dist_eq_norm, hx]
    simp only
    rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← sub_smul,
      show (1 - 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 2)) - (1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) =
        1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) - 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 2) by ring,
      norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hvnorm]
    have hmN : (N : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
    have hnN : (N : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hN : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
    have a1 : 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 2) ≤ 1 / ((N : ℝ) + 2) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hN (by linarith)
    have a2 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) ≤ 1 / ((N : ℝ) + 2) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hN (by linarith)
    have a3 : 0 ≤ 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 2) := by positivity
    have a4 : 0 ≤ 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by positivity
    have hab : |1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) - 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 2)| ≤ 1 / ((N : ℝ) + 2) :=
      abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    calc |1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) - 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 2)| * r ≤ 1 / ((N : ℝ) + 2) * r :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab hr.le
      _ = r / ((N : ℝ) + 2) := by ring
  
  have hcauchy : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N,
      g.riemannianDist (F (x m)) (F (x n)) < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt (r / ε)
    refine ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hdl (x m) (hxball m) (x n) (hxball n)
    have h2 := hxdist N m n hm hn
    have h3 : r / ((N : ℝ) + 2) < ε := by
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hε] at hN
      nlinarith
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hComplete (fun n => F (x n)) hcauchy
  exact ⟨q, hdist _ q hq⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hchart : ∀ p : M, ∃ j : E3 → M, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ j 0 = p ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ j (ball 0 ε) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ ball (0 : E3) ε, g.coeff j y = 1) ∧
      ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ ε → j '' ball 0 ρ ∈ 𝓝 p)
    (y₀ : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (F : E3 → M)
    (hF : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ F (ball y₀ r))
    (hFg : ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r, g.coeff F y = 1) (v : E3) (hv : dist v y₀ = r) (q : M)
    (hq : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => F (y₀ + (1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) • (v - y₀))) atTop (𝓝 q)) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ G : E3 → M, ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ G (ball v ρ) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ ball v ρ, g.coeff G y = 1) ∧ Set.EqOn G F (ball v ρ ∩ ball y₀ r)

signature.name: local_isometry_boundary_patch
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hchart : ∀ p : M, ∃ j : E3 → M, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ j 0 = p ∧
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ j (ball 0 ε) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ ball (0 : E3) ε, g.coeff j y = 1) ∧
      ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ ε → j '' ball 0 ρ ∈ 𝓝 p)
    (y₀ : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (F : E3 → M)
    (hF : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ F (ball y₀ r))
    (hFg : ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r, g.coeff F y = 1) (v : E3) (hv : dist v y₀ = r) (q : M)
    (hq : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => F (y₀ + (1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) • (v - y₀))) atTop (𝓝 q)) :
    ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ G : E3 → M, ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ G (ball v ρ) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ ball v ρ, g.coeff G y = 1) ∧ Set.EqOn G F (ball v ρ ∩ ball y₀ r)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨j, ε, hε, -, hjs, hjg, hjn⟩ := hchart q
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρdef⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = ε / 3 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := by rw [hρdef]; positivity
  have hN : j '' ball 0 ρ ∈ 𝓝 q := hjn ρ hρ (by rw [hρdef]; linarith)
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (hq.eventually_mem hN)
  obtain ⟨n, hn1, hn2⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, N₁ ≤ n ∧ ⌈r / ρ⌉₊ ≤ n :=
    ⟨max N₁ ⌈r / ρ⌉₊, le_max_left _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hxdef⟩ : ∃ x : E3, x = y₀ + (1 - 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) • (v - y₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hFx : F x ∈ j '' ball 0 ρ := by rw [hxdef]; exact hN₁ n hn1
  obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀, hjw⟩ := hFx
  
  have hnorm : ‖v - y₀‖ = r := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hv
  have hn2pos : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 2 := by positivity
  have hinv_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by positivity
  have hinv_le : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) ≤ 1 / 2 :=
    one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) (by linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0:ℝ) ≤ n)])
  have hx : x ∈ ball y₀ r := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, hxdef, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (by linarith), hnorm]
    nlinarith
  have hxv : dist x v < ρ := by
    have hxv' : x - v = (-(1 / ((n : ℝ) + 2))) • (v - y₀) := by rw [hxdef]; module
    rw [dist_eq_norm, hxv', norm_smul, norm_neg, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hinv_pos, hnorm]
    have hc : r / ρ ≤ (n : ℝ) := le_trans (Nat.le_ceil _) (by exact_mod_cast hn2)
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hρ] at hc
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_lt_iff₀ hn2pos]
    nlinarith
  have hw₀V : w₀ ∈ ball (0 : E3) ε := ball_subset_ball (by rw [hρdef]; linarith) hw₀
  
  have hdecomp : ∀ u : E3, u = u 0 • e 0 + u 1 • e 1 + u 2 • e 2 := by
    intro u; ext k; fin_cases k <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have orth : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3),
      (∀ i k : Fin 3, B (L (e i)) (L (e k)) = if i = k then 1 else 0) →
      ∀ u w : E3, B (L u) (L w) = @inner ℝ E3 _ u w := by
    intro B L hB u w
    have hL : B (L u) (L w) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, u i * w k * B (L (e i)) (L (e k)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hdecomp u, hdecomp w]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [hL]
    simp [hB, Fin.sum_univ_three, PiLp.inner_apply]
    ring
  set P : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) j w₀ with hPdef
  set Q : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F x with hQdef
  have hPcoef : ∀ i k : Fin 3, g.g (F x) (P (e i)) (P (e k)) = if i = k then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i k
    rw [← hjw]
    have h := congrFun (congrFun (hjg w₀ hw₀V) i) k
    rw [Matrix.one_apply] at h
    exact h
  have hQcoef : ∀ i k : Fin 3, g.g (F x) (Q (e i)) (Q (e k)) = if i = k then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i k
    have h := congrFun (congrFun (hFg x hx) i) k
    rw [Matrix.one_apply] at h
    exact h
  have hPF := orth (g.g (F x)) P hPcoef
  have hQF := orth (g.g (F x)) Q hQcoef
  have hPinj : Function.Injective P := by
    intro a b hab
    have h0 : P (a - b) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, hab, sub_self]
    have h1 := hPF (a - b) (a - b)
    simp only [h0, map_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h1
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (inner_self_eq_zero.mp h1.symm)
  have hPsurj : Function.Surjective P :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective (f := (P : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3))).mp hPinj
  let Pe : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3 :=
    (LinearEquiv.ofBijective (P : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) ⟨hPinj, hPsurj⟩).toContinuousLinearEquiv
  let A : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := (Pe.symm : E3 →L[ℝ] E3).comp Q
  have hPA : ∀ u, P (A u) = Q u := by
    intro u
    have := Pe.apply_symm_apply (Q u)
    exact this
  have hAinner : ∀ u w : E3, @inner ℝ E3 _ (A u) (A w) = @inner ℝ E3 _ u w := by
    intro u w
    rw [← hPF, hPA, hPA, hQF]
  have hAnorm : ∀ u : E3, ‖A u‖ = ‖u‖ := by
    intro u
    have h := hAinner u u
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at h
    exact (pow_left_inj₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _) two_ne_zero).mp h
  have hAe : ∀ i k : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, A (e i) a * A (e k) a = if i = k then 1 else 0 := by
    intro i k
    have h := hAinner (e i) (e k)
    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, e] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => mul_comm _ _)
  
  let σ : E3 → E3 := fun y => A y + (w₀ - A x)
  have hσx : σ x = w₀ := by simp [σ]
  have hσD : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt σ A y := fun y => A.hasFDerivAt.add_const _
  have hσsm : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ σ := (A.contDiff.add contDiff_const).contMDiff
  have hball : ∀ y ∈ ball x (2 * ρ), σ y ∈ ball (0 : E3) ε := by
    intro y hy
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy
    have hw : ‖w₀‖ < ρ := by rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hw₀; exact hw₀
    have hσy : σ y = A (y - x) + w₀ := by simp only [σ, map_sub]; abel
    rw [hσy]
    calc ‖A (y - x) + w₀‖ ≤ ‖A (y - x)‖ + ‖w₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖y - x‖ + ‖w₀‖ := by rw [hAnorm]
      _ < ε := by rw [hρdef] at hy hw; linarith
  have hjσs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (j ∘ σ) (ball x (2 * ρ)) :=
    hjs.comp hσsm.contMDiffOn (fun y hy => hball y hy)
  have hjσg : ∀ y ∈ ball x (2 * ρ), g.coeff (j ∘ σ) y = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    ext i k
    have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ σ y := (hσD y).differentiableAt
    have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) j (σ y) :=
      (hjs.contMDiffAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hball y hy))).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
    rw [coeff_comp_apply g j σ y hdiff hmd i k, (hσD y).fderiv, hjg (σ y) (hball y hy)]
    simp [Matrix.one_apply]
    exact hAe i k
  have hmdw : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) j (σ x) := by
    rw [hσx]; exact (hjs.contMDiffAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hw₀V)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  have hder : ∀ u : E3, (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (j ∘ σ) x u : E3) =
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F x u := by
    intro u
    rw [mfderiv_comp_apply x hmdw (hσsm.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)), mfderiv_eq_fderiv,
      (hσD x).fderiv]
    rw [hσx]
    exact hPA u
  
  have hO : IsOpen (ball y₀ r ∩ ball x (2 * ρ)) := isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_ball
  have hOc : IsPreconnected (ball y₀ r ∩ ball x (2 * ρ)) :=
    ((convex_ball _ _).inter (convex_ball _ _)).isPreconnected
  have hxO : x ∈ ball y₀ r ∩ ball x (2 * ρ) := ⟨hx, mem_ball_self (by linarith)⟩
  have hval : (j ∘ σ) x = F x := by
    show j (σ x) = F x
    rw [hσx, hjw]
  have hEq := local_isometry_rigidity g _ hO hOc (j ∘ σ) F (hjσs.mono Set.inter_subset_right)
    (hF.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hjσg y hy.2) (fun y hy => hFg y hy.1) x hxO
    hval hder
  have hsub : ball v ρ ⊆ ball x (2 * ρ) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [mem_ball] at hy ⊢
    have h3 := dist_triangle y v x
    rw [dist_comm v x] at h3
    linarith
  exact ⟨ρ, hρ, j ∘ σ, hjσs.mono hsub, fun y hy => hjσg y (hsub hy),
    fun y hy => hEq ⟨hy.2, hsub hy.1⟩⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_comp_apply
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : E3 → M)
    (τ : E3 → E3) (y : E3) (hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y)
    (hΦ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ (τ y)) (i j : Fin 3) :
    g.coeff (Φ ∘ τ) y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a * g.coeff Φ (τ y) a b * fderiv ℝ τ y (e j) b

subgoal_signatures.name: local_isometry_rigidity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hUc : IsPreconnected U) (f₁ f₂ : E3 → M)
    (hf₁ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ f₁ U) (hf₂ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ f₂ U)
    (hg₁ : ∀ y ∈ U, g.coeff f₁ y = 1) (hg₂ : ∀ y ∈ U, g.coeff f₂ y = 1)
    (z : E3) (hz : z ∈ U) (hval : f₁ z = f₂ z)

      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) f₂ z v) :

signature.name: boundary_patches_extend
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (y₀ : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (F : E3 → M)
    (hF : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ F (ball y₀ r))
    (hFg : ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r, g.coeff F y = 1)
    (hpatch : ∀ v : E3, dist v y₀ = r → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ G : E3 → M,
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ G (ball v ρ) ∧ (∀ y ∈ ball v ρ, g.coeff G y = 1) ∧
      Set.EqOn G F (ball v ρ ∩ ball y₀ r)) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ F' : E3 → M,
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ F' (ball y₀ (r + δ)) ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hcoeff : ∀ (F₁ F₂ : E3 → M) (y : E3), F₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] F₂ → g.coeff F₁ y = g.coeff F₂ y := by
    intro F₁ F₂ y h
    have hv : F₁ y = F₂ y := h.eq_of_nhds
    have hm : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F₁ y = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F₂ y := h.mfderiv_eq
    ext i j
    have key : ∀ (p q : M) (L₁ L₂ : E3 →L[ℝ] E3), p = q → L₁ = L₂ →
        g.g p (L₁ (e i)) (L₁ (e j)) = g.g q (L₂ (e i)) (L₂ (e j)) := by
      rintro p q L₁ L₂ rfl rfl
      rfl
    exact key _ _ _ _ hv hm
  
  have hpair : ∀ (v₁ v₂ : E3), dist v₁ y₀ = r → dist v₂ y₀ = r → ∀ (ρ₁ ρ₂ : ℝ), 0 < ρ₁ →
      0 < ρ₂ → ∀ (G₁ G₂ : E3 → M), ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ G₁ (ball v₁ ρ₁) →
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ G₂ (ball v₂ ρ₂) →
      (∀ y ∈ ball v₁ ρ₁, g.coeff G₁ y = 1) → (∀ y ∈ ball v₂ ρ₂, g.coeff G₂ y = 1) →
      Set.EqOn G₁ F (ball v₁ ρ₁ ∩ ball y₀ r) → Set.EqOn G₂ F (ball v₂ ρ₂ ∩ ball y₀ r) →
      Set.EqOn G₁ G₂ (ball v₁ ρ₁ ∩ ball v₂ ρ₂) := by
    intro v₁ v₂ hv₁ hv₂ ρ₁ ρ₂ hρ₁ hρ₂ G₁ G₂ hG₁ hG₂ hG₁g hG₂g hG₁F hG₂F y hy
    have hBo : IsOpen (ball v₁ ρ₁ ∩ ball v₂ ρ₂) := isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_ball
    have hBc : IsPreconnected (ball v₁ ρ₁ ∩ ball v₂ ρ₂) :=
      ((convex_ball v₁ ρ₁).inter (convex_ball v₂ ρ₂)).isPreconnected
    have hd : dist v₁ v₂ < ρ₁ + ρ₂ := by
      have h1 : dist y v₁ < ρ₁ := hy.1
      have h2 : dist y v₂ < ρ₂ := hy.2
      calc dist v₁ v₂ ≤ dist v₁ y + dist y v₂ := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ = dist y v₁ + dist y v₂ := by rw [dist_comm v₁ y]
        _ < ρ₁ + ρ₂ := by linarith
    have hspos : 0 < ρ₁ + ρ₂ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = ρ₂ / (ρ₁ + ρ₂) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb_def⟩ : ∃ b : ℝ, b = ρ₁ / (ρ₁ + ρ₂) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have ha : 0 ≤ a := by rw [ha_def]; exact div_nonneg hρ₂.le hspos.le
    have hb : 0 ≤ b := by rw [hb_def]; exact div_nonneg hρ₁.le hspos.le
    have hab : a + b = 1 := by
      rw [ha_def, hb_def, div_add_div_same, add_comm ρ₂ ρ₁, div_self hspos.ne']
    have hbd : b * dist v₁ v₂ < ρ₁ := by
      rw [hb_def, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hspos]
      nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hd hρ₁]
    have had : a * dist v₁ v₂ < ρ₂ := by
      rw [ha_def, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hspos]
      nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hd hρ₂]
    obtain ⟨w, hw_def⟩ : ∃ w : E3, w = a • v₁ + b • v₂ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hw0 : dist w y₀ ≤ r := by
      have h1 : v₁ ∈ closedBall y₀ r := mem_closedBall.2 hv₁.le
      have h2 : v₂ ∈ closedBall y₀ r := mem_closedBall.2 hv₂.le
      have h3 := (convex_closedBall y₀ r) h1 h2 ha hb hab
      rw [← hw_def] at h3
      exact mem_closedBall.1 h3
    have hw1 : dist w v₁ < ρ₁ := by
      have haeq : a = 1 - b := by linarith
      have hsub : w - v₁ = b • (v₂ - v₁) := by
        rw [hw_def, haeq, sub_smul, one_smul, smul_sub]
        abel
      rw [dist_eq_norm, hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hb, ← dist_eq_norm, dist_comm]
      exact hbd
    have hw2 : dist w v₂ < ρ₂ := by
      have hbeq : b = 1 - a := by linarith
      have hsub : w - v₂ = a • (v₁ - v₂) := by
        rw [hw_def, hbeq, sub_smul, one_smul, smul_sub]
        abel
      rw [dist_eq_norm, hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ha, ← dist_eq_norm]
      exact had
    have hwB : w ∈ ball v₁ ρ₁ ∩ ball v₂ ρ₂ := ⟨mem_ball.2 hw1, mem_ball.2 hw2⟩
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεB⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hBo w hwB
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ_def⟩ : ∃ τ : ℝ, τ = min (1 / 2 : ℝ) (ε / (2 * r)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hτ0 : 0 < τ := by
      rw [hτ_def]; exact lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hε (by linarith))
    have hτ1 : τ ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [hτ_def]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hτr : τ * r ≤ ε / 2 := by
      have h : τ ≤ ε / (2 * r) := by rw [hτ_def]; exact min_le_right _ _
      calc τ * r ≤ ε / (2 * r) * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hr.le
        _ = ε / 2 := by field_simp
    obtain ⟨z, hz_def⟩ : ∃ z : E3, z = w + τ • (y₀ - w) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hzw : dist z w < ε := by
      have hsub : z - w = τ • (y₀ - w) := by rw [hz_def]; abel
      rw [dist_eq_norm, hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hτ0.le, ← dist_eq_norm, dist_comm]
      calc τ * dist w y₀ ≤ τ * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw0 hτ0.le
        _ ≤ ε / 2 := hτr
        _ < ε := by linarith
    have hzB : z ∈ ball v₁ ρ₁ ∩ ball v₂ ρ₂ := hεB (mem_ball.2 hzw)
    have hz0 : dist z y₀ < r := by
      have hsub : z - y₀ = (1 - τ) • (w - y₀) := by
        rw [hz_def, sub_smul, one_smul, smul_sub, smul_sub]
        abel
      rw [dist_eq_norm, hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by linarith), ← dist_eq_norm]
      calc (1 - τ) * dist w y₀ ≤ (1 - τ) * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw0 (by linarith)
        _ < r := by nlinarith
    have hev : G₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] G₂ := by
      filter_upwards [(hBo.inter isOpen_ball).mem_nhds ⟨hzB, mem_ball.2 hz0⟩] with u hu
      rw [hG₁F ⟨hu.1.1, hu.2⟩, hG₂F ⟨hu.1.2, hu.2⟩]
    exact local_isometry_rigidity g (ball v₁ ρ₁ ∩ ball v₂ ρ₂) hBo hBc G₁ G₂
      (hG₁.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (hG₂.mono Set.inter_subset_right)
      (fun u hu => hG₁g u hu.1) (fun u hu => hG₂g u hu.2) z hzB hev.eq_of_nhds
      (fun v => by rw [hev.mfderiv_eq] <;> rfl) hy
  
  have hpatch' : ∀ v : E3, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ G : E3 → M, dist v y₀ = r →
      (ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ G (ball v ρ) ∧ (∀ y ∈ ball v ρ, g.coeff G y = 1) ∧
      Set.EqOn G F (ball v ρ ∩ ball y₀ r)) := by
    intro v
    by_cases hv : dist v y₀ = r
    · obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, G, h⟩ := hpatch v hv
      exact ⟨ρ, hρ, G, fun _ => h⟩
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, F, fun h => absurd h hv⟩
  choose ρ hρ G hG using hpatch'
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hcov⟩ := (isCompact_sphere y₀ r).elim_nhds_subcover (fun v => ball v (ρ v))
    (fun v _ => ball_mem_nhds v (hρ v))
  
  obtain ⟨F', hF'def⟩ : ∃ F' : E3 → M, F' = fun y => if y ∈ ball y₀ r then F y else
      if h : ∃ v ∈ t, y ∈ ball v (ρ v) then G (Classical.choose h) y else F y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hEF : Set.EqOn F' F (ball y₀ r) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hF'def]
    dsimp only
    rw [if_pos hy]
  have hEG : ∀ v ∈ t, Set.EqOn F' (G v) (ball v (ρ v)) := by
    intro v hv y hy
    have hvs : dist v y₀ = r := mem_sphere.1 (ht v hv)
    rw [hF'def]
    dsimp only
    by_cases hy0 : y ∈ ball y₀ r
    · rw [if_pos hy0]
      exact ((hG v hvs).2.2 ⟨hy, hy0⟩).symm
    · rw [if_neg hy0]
      have hex : ∃ v ∈ t, y ∈ ball v (ρ v) := ⟨v, hv, hy⟩
      rw [dif_pos hex]
      obtain ⟨hv't, hyv'⟩ := Classical.choose_spec hex
      have hv's : dist (Classical.choose hex) y₀ = r := mem_sphere.1 (ht _ hv't)
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hG _ hv's
      obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3⟩ := hG v hvs
      exact hpair _ v hv's hvs _ _ (hρ _) (hρ v) _ _ h1 k1 h2 k2 h3 k3 ⟨hyv', hy⟩
  
  have hlocal : ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r ∪ ⋃ v ∈ t, ball v (ρ v),
      ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ F' y ∧ g.coeff F' y = 1 := by
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with hy | hy
    · have hev : F' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] F := by
        filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy] with u hu
        exact hEF hu
      exact ⟨(hF.contMDiffAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev,
        (hcoeff _ _ _ hev).trans (hFg y hy)⟩
    · obtain ⟨v, hv, hyv⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 hy
      have hvs : dist v y₀ = r := mem_sphere.1 (ht v hv)
      have hev : F' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] G v := by
        filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hyv] with u hu
        exact hEG v hv hu
      exact ⟨((hG v hvs).1.contMDiffAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hyv)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev,
        (hcoeff _ _ _ hev).trans ((hG v hvs).2.1 y hyv)⟩
  
  have hOopen : IsOpen (ball y₀ r ∪ ⋃ v ∈ t, ball v (ρ v)) :=
    isOpen_ball.union (isOpen_biUnion fun v _ => isOpen_ball)
  have hsub : closedBall y₀ r ⊆ ball y₀ r ∪ ⋃ v ∈ t, ball v (ρ v) := by
    intro y hy
    rcases (mem_closedBall.1 hy).lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (mem_ball.2 h)
    · exact Or.inr (hcov (mem_sphere.2 h))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδsub⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall y₀ r).exists_thickening_subset_open hOopen hsub
  have hball : ball y₀ (r + δ) ⊆ ball y₀ r ∪ ⋃ v ∈ t, ball v (ρ v) := by
    rw [add_comm, ← thickening_closedBall hδ hr.le y₀]
    exact hδsub
  
  exact ⟨δ, hδ, F', fun y hy => (hlocal y (hball hy)).1.contMDiffWithinAt,
    fun y hy => (hlocal y (hball hy)).2, hEF⟩

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (J : E3 → M) (y₀ : E3) (S : Set ℝ) (hSne : S.Nonempty)
    (hS : ∀ r ∈ S, 0 < r ∧ ∃ F : E3 → M, ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ F (ball y₀ r) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r, g.coeff F y = 1) ∧ F y₀ = J y₀ ∧
      ∀ v : E3, (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F y₀ v : E3) = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) J y₀ v) :

      ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r, g.coeff F y = 1) ∧ F y₀ = J y₀ ∧
      ∀ v : E3, (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F y₀ v : E3) = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) J y₀ v

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  choose hpos Fr hFr using hS
  
  have hcoeff : ∀ (F₁ F₂ : E3 → M) (y : E3), F₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] F₂ → g.coeff F₁ y = g.coeff F₂ y := by
    intro F₁ F₂ y h
    have hv : F₁ y = F₂ y := h.eq_of_nhds
    have hm := h.mfderiv_eq (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, E3))
    ext i j
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
    rw [hm, hv]
  
  have hcompat : ∀ r (hr : r ∈ S) r' (hr' : r' ∈ S),
      Set.EqOn (Fr r hr) (Fr r' hr') (ball y₀ (min r r')) := by
    intro r hr r' hr'
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hFr r hr
    obtain ⟨h1', h2', h3', h4'⟩ := hFr r' hr'
    have hsub : ball y₀ (min r r') ⊆ ball y₀ r := ball_subset_ball (min_le_left r r')
    have hsub' : ball y₀ (min r r') ⊆ ball y₀ r' := ball_subset_ball (min_le_right r r')
    exact local_isometry_rigidity g (ball y₀ (min r r')) isOpen_ball
      (convex_ball y₀ _).isPreconnected
      (Fr r hr) (Fr r' hr') (h1.mono hsub) (h1'.mono hsub') (fun y hy => h2 y (hsub hy))
      (fun y hy => h2' y (hsub' hy)) y₀ (mem_ball_self (lt_min (hpos r hr) (hpos r' hr')))
      (h3.trans h3'.symm) (fun v => (h4 v).trans (h4' v).symm)
  
  let F : E3 → M := fun y =>
    if h : ∃ r, r ∈ S ∧ dist y y₀ < r then Fr h.choose h.choose_spec.1 y else J y₀
  have hloc : ∀ r (hr : r ∈ S), ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r, F y = Fr r hr y := by
    intro r hr y hy
    have hex : ∃ r, r ∈ S ∧ dist y y₀ < r := ⟨r, hr, mem_ball.mp hy⟩
    have hF : F y = Fr hex.choose hex.choose_spec.1 y := dif_pos hex
    rw [hF]
    exact hcompat _ _ r hr (mem_ball.mpr (lt_min hex.choose_spec.2 (mem_ball.mp hy)))
  have hev : ∀ r (hr : r ∈ S), ∀ y ∈ ball y₀ r, F =ᶠ[𝓝 y] Fr r hr := fun r hr y hy =>
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hloc r hr z hz)
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀⟩ := hSne
  have hy₀ : y₀ ∈ ball y₀ r₀ := mem_ball_self (hpos r₀ hr₀)
  refine ⟨F, fun r hr => ⟨(hFr r hr).1.congr (fun y hy => hloc r hr y hy), fun y hy => ?_⟩,
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcoeff F (Fr r hr) y (hev r hr y hy)]
    exact (hFr r hr).2.1 y hy
  · rw [(hev r₀ hr₀ y₀ hy₀).eq_of_nhds]
    exact (hFr r₀ hr₀).2.2.1
  · intro v
    rw [(hev r₀ hr₀ y₀ hy₀).mfderiv_eq]
    exact (hFr r₀ hr₀).2.2.2 v

(g : E2 → ℝ) (hg : Continuous g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (σ R M : ℝ) (hR0 : 0 ≤ R) (hM : ∀ z, |g z| ≤ M) (hR : ∀ z : E2, R < |z 1 - σ| → g z = 0) :
    (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      |∫ z in {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0}, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (z 0 / s) * g z| ≤ 2 * R * M) ∧
    Tendsto (fun s => ∫ z in {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0}, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (z 0 / s) * g z)
      (𝓝[>] (0:ℝ)) (𝓝 (∫ x : ℝ, g ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![0, x])))

signature.name: half_plane_kernel_limit
signature.statement:
(g : E2 → ℝ) (hg : Continuous g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g)
    (σ R M : ℝ) (hR0 : 0 ≤ R) (hM : ∀ z, |g z| ≤ M) (hR : ∀ z : E2, R < |z 1 - σ| → g z = 0) :
    (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      |∫ z in {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0}, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (z 0 / s) * g z| ≤ 2 * R * M) ∧
    Tendsto (fun s => ∫ z in {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0}, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (z 0 / s) * g z)
      (𝓝[>] (0:ℝ)) (𝓝 (∫ x : ℝ, g ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![0, x])))

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hη1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)
  have hk : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) := hη1.continuous_deriv le_rfl
  have hk0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ deriv Real.smoothTransition x :=
    fun x => Real.smoothTransition.monotone.deriv_nonneg
  have hkn : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hmin : IsMinOn Real.smoothTransition Set.univ x := by
      rw [isMinOn_univ_iff]
      intro y
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos hx]
      exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg y
    exact (hmin.isLocalMin Filter.univ_mem).deriv_eq_zero
  have hk1 : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → deriv Real.smoothTransition x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hmax : IsMaxOn Real.smoothTransition Set.univ x := by
      rw [isMaxOn_univ_iff]
      intro y
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le hx]
      exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one y
    exact (hmax.isLocalMax Filter.univ_mem).deriv_eq_zero
  have hint01 : ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, deriv Real.smoothTransition x = 1 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_deriv_eq_sub (fun x _ => (hη1.differentiable one_ne_zero) x)
      (hk.intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le le_rfl, Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos le_rfl]
    norm_num
  have hkI : ∫ x, deriv Real.smoothTransition x = 1 := by
    have hz : ∀ x, x ∉ Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1 → deriv Real.smoothTransition x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_Ioc, not_and_or, not_lt, not_le] at hx
      rcases hx with h | h
      · exact hkn x h
      · exact hk1 x h.le
    have h := setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (μ := volume) hz
    rw [← h, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one, hint01]
  set k : ℝ → ℝ := deriv Real.smoothTransition with hkdef
  
  have hks0 : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ s⁻¹ * k (u / s) :=
    fun s hs u => mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hs.le) (hk0 _)
  have hksz : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ u : ℝ, (u < 0 ∨ s < u) → s⁻¹ * k (u / s) = 0 := by
    intro s hs u hu
    rcases hu with h | h
    · rw [hkn _ (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg h.le hs.le), mul_zero]
    · rw [hk1 _ ((one_le_div hs).mpr h.le), mul_zero]
  have hksI : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) = 1 := by
    intro s hs
    rw [integral_const_mul, Measure.integral_comp_div k s, hkI, abs_of_pos hs, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one, inv_mul_cancel₀ hs.ne']
  have hksint : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous φ →
      Integrable (fun u => s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * φ u) := by
    intro s hs φ hφ
    apply Continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    · exact (continuous_const.mul (hk.comp (continuous_id.div_const s))).mul hφ
    · apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_Icc (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := s))
      intro u hu
      simp only [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le] at hu
      rw [hksz s hs u hu, zero_mul]
  have hkerA : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ h : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous h → ∀ B : ℝ,
      (∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → u ≤ s → |h u| ≤ B) → |∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * h u| ≤ B := by
    intro s hs h hh B hB
    have hpt : ∀ u, ‖s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * h u‖ ≤ s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * B := by
      intro u
      by_cases hu : 0 ≤ u ∧ u ≤ s
      · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hks0 s hs u)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hB u hu.1 hu.2) (hks0 s hs u)
      · have hu' : u < 0 ∨ s < u := by
          rcases not_and_or.mp hu with h1 | h1
          · exact Or.inl (not_le.mp h1)
          · exact Or.inr (not_le.mp h1)
        rw [hksz s hs u hu']
        simp
    have hI := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
      (hksint s hs (fun _ => B) continuous_const : Integrable (fun u => s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * B))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
    rw [integral_mul_const, hksI s hs, one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hI
    exact hI
  have hkerB : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ h : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous h → ∀ B : ℝ,
      (∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → u ≤ s → |h u - h 0| ≤ B) →
      |(∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * h u) - h 0| ≤ B := by
    intro s hs h hh B hB
    have hi1 : Integrable (fun u => s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * h u) := hksint s hs h hh
    have hi2 : Integrable (fun u => s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * h 0) :=
      hksint s hs (fun _ => h 0) continuous_const
    have h3 : ∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * (h u - h 0) =
        (∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * h u) - ∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * h 0 := by
      rw [← integral_sub hi1 hi2]
      congr 1
      funext u
      ring
    have heq : (∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * h u) - h 0 = ∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * (h u - h 0) := by
      rw [h3, integral_mul_const, hksI s hs, one_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact hkerA s hs (fun u => h u - h 0) (hh.sub continuous_const) B hB
  
  obtain ⟨ι, hι⟩ : ∃ ι : ℝ → ℝ → E2,
      ∀ u x, ι u x = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![u, x] := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hι0 : ∀ u x, ι u x 0 = u := fun u x => by rw [hι]; rfl
  have hι1 : ∀ u x, ι u x 1 = x := fun u x => by rw [hι]; rfl
  have hιu : ∀ x, Continuous (fun u => ι u x) := by
    intro x
    simp only [hι]
    first
      | exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
          (continuous_id.matrixVecCons continuous_const)
      | fun_prop
  have hιx : ∀ u, Continuous (fun x => ι u x) := by
    intro u
    simp only [hι]
    first
      | exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
          (continuous_const.matrixVecCons (continuous_id.matrixVecCons continuous_const))
      | fun_prop
  have hιu' : ∀ x, Continuous (fun u => g (ι u x)) := fun x => hg.comp (hιu x)
  have hιx' : ∀ u, Continuous (fun x => g (ι u x)) := fun u => hg.comp (hιx u)
  have hdist : ∀ u x, dist (ι u x) (ι 0 x) = |u| := by
    intro u x
    rw [hι, hι, EuclideanSpace.dist_eq]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  
  let eM : ℝ × ℝ ≃ᵐ E2 :=
    MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow.symm.trans (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ))
  have heM : ∀ u x, eM (u, x) = ι u x := fun u x => by rw [hι]; rfl
  have hmp : MeasurePreserving (⇑eM) volume volume :=
    (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 2)).comp (volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ).symm
  have hfub : ∀ F : E2 → ℝ, Integrable F →
      Integrable (fun x => ∫ u, F (ι u x)) ∧ ∫ z, F z = ∫ x, ∫ u, F (ι u x) := by
    intro F hF
    have hFe : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F (eM p))
        ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) :=
      hmp.integrable_comp_of_integrable hF
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 := hFe.integral_prod_right
      simp only [heM] at h1
      exact h1
    · calc ∫ z, F z = ∫ p, F (eM p) ∂((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) :=
            (hmp.integral_comp' F).symm
        _ = ∫ x, ∫ u, F (eM (u, x)) := integral_prod_symm _ hFe
        _ = ∫ x, ∫ u, F (ι u x) := by simp only [heM]
  
  have hrep : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      Integrable (fun x => ∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * g (ι u x)) ∧
      ∫ z in {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0}, s⁻¹ * k (z 0 / s) * g z =
        ∫ x, ∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * g (ι u x) := by
    intro s hs
    have hc0 : Continuous (fun z : E2 => z 0) := by
      first
        | exact PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ 0
        | exact (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2)).continuous
        | fun_prop
    have hKc : Continuous (fun z : E2 => s⁻¹ * k (z 0 / s) * g z) :=
      (continuous_const.mul (hk.comp (hc0.div_const s))).mul hg
    have hKs : HasCompactSupport (fun z : E2 => s⁻¹ * k (z 0 / s) * g z) := hc.mul_left
    have hKi : Integrable (fun z : E2 => s⁻¹ * k (z 0 / s) * g z) :=
      hKc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hKs
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hfub _ hKi
    simp only [hι0] at h1 h2
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    rw [setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero, h2]
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_le] at hz
    rw [hkn _ (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hz.le hs.le), mul_zero, zero_mul]
  
  have hV : ∀ x, x ∉ Set.Icc (σ - R) (σ + R) → ∀ u, g (ι u x) = 0 := by
    intro x hx u
    apply hR
    rw [hι1]
    simp only [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le] at hx
    rw [lt_abs]
    rcases hx with h | h
    · right; linarith
    · left; linarith
  have hJvol : volume.real (Set.Icc (σ - R) (σ + R)) = 2 * R := by
    rw [Real.volume_real_Icc_of_le (by linarith)]
    ring
  have hJint : ∀ c : ℝ, Integrable ((Set.Icc (σ - R) (σ + R)).indicator (fun _ => c)) :=
    fun c => (continuous_const.integrableOn_Icc).integrable_indicator measurableSet_Icc
  refine ⟨fun s hs => ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨hAi, hIeq⟩ := hrep s hs
    rw [hIeq]
    have hpt : ∀ x, ‖∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * g (ι u x)‖ ≤
        (Set.Icc (σ - R) (σ + R)).indicator (fun _ => M) x := by
      intro x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (σ - R) (σ + R)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
        exact hkerA s hs _ (hιu' x) M (fun u _ _ => hM _)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
        exact hkerA s hs _ (hιu' x) 0 (fun u _ _ => by rw [hV x hx u, abs_zero])
    have hI := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hJint M) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
    rw [integral_indicator_const M measurableSet_Icc, hJvol, smul_eq_mul,
      Real.norm_eq_abs] at hI
    exact hI
  · 
    rw [Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    have h2R : 0 < 2 * R + 1 := by linarith
    have hε'0 : 0 < ε / (2 * R + 1) := div_pos hε h2R
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδg⟩ :=
      Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.mp (hc.uniformContinuous_of_continuous hg) _ hε'0
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    intro s hs hsd
    have hs0 : 0 < s := hs
    have hsδ : s < δ := by
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hs0] at hsd
      exact hsd
    obtain ⟨hAi, hIeq⟩ := hrep s hs0
    have hG0i : Integrable (fun x => g (ι 0 x)) := by
      apply (hιx' 0).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      apply HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_Icc (a := σ - R) (b := σ + R))
      intro x hx
      exact hV x hx 0
    have hpt : ∀ x, ‖(∫ u, s⁻¹ * k (u / s) * g (ι u x)) - g (ι 0 x)‖ ≤
        (Set.Icc (σ - R) (σ + R)).indicator (fun _ => ε / (2 * R + 1)) x := by
      intro x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (σ - R) (σ + R)
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
        refine hkerB s hs0 _ (hιu' x) _ (fun u hu0 hus => ?_)
        have hd : dist (ι u x) (ι 0 x) < δ := by
          rw [hdist, abs_of_nonneg hu0]
          linarith
        have h4 := hδg hd
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at h4
        exact h4.le
      · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
        refine hkerB s hs0 _ (hιu' x) 0 (fun u _ _ => ?_)
        rw [hV x hx u, hV x hx 0, sub_zero, abs_zero]
    have hint := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hJint _) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt)
    rw [integral_sub hAi hG0i, integral_indicator_const _ measurableSet_Icc, hJvol, smul_eq_mul,
      Real.norm_eq_abs] at hint
    have hL : ∫ x : ℝ, g ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![0, x]) =
        ∫ x : ℝ, g (ι 0 x) := by
      simp only [hι]
    try dsimp only
    rw [Real.dist_eq, hIeq, hL]
    have hfin : 2 * R * (ε / (2 * R + 1)) < ε := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc', div_lt_iff₀ h2R]
      nlinarith
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O)
    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b O) (k : Fin 3) (τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hUO : U ⊆ O) (P : E3 → E3)
    (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ})
    (hPV : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f (P w), b (P w), (P w) k] = w)
    (hPU : ∀ y ∈ U, (|f y - τ₀| < δ ∧ |b y - β₀| < δ ∧ |y k - σ₀| < δ) ∧
      P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k]) = y)
    (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψU : tsupport ψ ⊆ U)
    (J : E3 → ℝ)
    (hJ : ∀ w : E3, J w = Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j)
        (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i) ^ 2))
    (g : ℝ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ (t : ℝ) (z : E2), g t z = if |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ then
        ψ (P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1])) *
          J ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1]) else 0) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, Continuous (g t) ∧ HasCompactSupport (g t) ∧ (∀ z : E2, |g t z| ≤ M) ∧
      (∀ z : E2, δ < |z 1 - σ₀| → g t z = 0)

signature.name: box_profile_props
signature.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O)
    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b O) (k : Fin 3) (τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hUO : U ⊆ O) (P : E3 → E3)
    (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ})
    (hPV : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f (P w), b (P w), (P w) k] = w)
    (hPU : ∀ y ∈ U, (|f y - τ₀| < δ ∧ |b y - β₀| < δ ∧ |y k - σ₀| < δ) ∧
      P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k]) = y)
    (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψU : tsupport ψ ⊆ U)
    (J : E3 → ℝ)
    (hJ : ∀ w : E3, J w = Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j)
        (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i) ^ 2))
    (g : ℝ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ (t : ℝ) (z : E2), g t z = if |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ then
        ψ (P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1])) *
          J ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1]) else 0) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ, Continuous (g t) ∧ HasCompactSupport (g t) ∧ (∀ z : E2, |g t z| ≤ M) ∧
      (∀ z : E2, δ < |z 1 - σ₀| → g t z = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ → E2 → E3, ∀ (t : ℝ) (z : E2),
      L t z = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1] := ⟨_, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘ⟩ : ∃ Θ : E3 → E3, ∀ y : E3,
      Θ y = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k] := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : Set E3,
      V = {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hVdef] at hP
  have hmemV : ∀ w : E3, w ∈ V ↔ (|w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ) := by
    intro w; rw [hVdef]; rfl
  have hLc : ∀ (t : ℝ) (z : E2), L t z 0 = t ∧ L t z 1 = z 0 ∧ L t z 2 = z 1 := by
    intro t z; rw [hL]; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hΘc : ∀ y : E3, Θ y 0 = f y ∧ Θ y 1 = b y ∧ Θ y 2 = y k := by
    intro y; rw [hΘ]; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hcoord : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous fun w : E3 => w i := fun i => PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ i
  
  have hV : IsOpen V := by
    rw [hVdef]
    exact (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((hcoord 0).sub continuous_const)) continuous_const).and
      ((isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((hcoord 1).sub continuous_const)) continuous_const).and
        (isOpen_lt (continuous_abs.comp ((hcoord 2).sub continuous_const)) continuous_const))
  
  have hLiso : ∀ t : ℝ, Isometry (L t) := by
    intro t
    refine Isometry.of_dist_eq (fun z z' => ?_)
    rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2⟩ := hLc t z
    obtain ⟨b0, b1, b2⟩ := hLc t z'
    rw [a0, a1, a2, b0, b1, b2, dist_self]
    congr 1
    ring
  
  have hΘO : ContinuousOn Θ O := by
    have hΘeq : Θ = fun y => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k] := funext hΘ
    rw [hΘeq]
    refine (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp_continuousOn ?_
    refine continuousOn_pi.mpr (fun i => ?_)
    fin_cases i
    · exact hf.continuousOn
    · exact hb.continuousOn
    · exact (hcoord k).continuousOn
  
  have hcond : ∀ (t : ℝ) (z : E2), (|t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ) ↔
      L t z ∈ V := by
    intro t z
    rw [hmemV]
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := hLc t z
    rw [h0, h1, h2]
  have hg' : ∀ (t : ℝ) (z : E2), g t z = if |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ then
      ψ (P (L t z)) * J (L t z) else 0 := by
    intro t z
    rw [hg t z, ← hL t z]
  have hgW : ∀ (t : ℝ) (z : E2), L t z ∈ V → g t z = ψ (P (L t z)) * J (L t z) := by
    intro t z h
    rw [hg' t z, if_pos ((hcond t z).2 h)]
  have hg0 : ∀ (t : ℝ) (z : E2), L t z ∉ V → g t z = 0 := by
    intro t z h
    rw [hg' t z, if_neg (fun h' => h ((hcond t z).1 h'))]
  have hPV' : ∀ w ∈ V, ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧ Θ (P w) = w := by
    intro w hw
    rw [hΘ]
    exact hPV w ((hmemV w).1 hw)
  have hΘV : ∀ y ∈ U, Θ y ∈ V := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hmemV]
    obtain ⟨a0, a1, a2⟩ := hΘc y
    rw [a0, a1, a2]
    exact (hPU y hy).1
  
  have hLag : ∀ u v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct u v i) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i : Fin 3, u i ^ 2) * (∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) := by
    intro u v
    have key : ∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct u v i) ^ 2 =
        (∑ i : Fin 3, u i ^ 2) * (∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) -
          (u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1 + u 2 * v 2) ^ 2 := by
      simp [cross_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    rw [key]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 0 * v 0 + u 1 * v 1 + u 2 * v 2)]
  have hJle : ∀ w ∈ V, 0 ≤ J w ∧ J w ≤ Lp ^ 2 := by
    intro w hwV
    have hw := (hPV' w hwV).1
    rw [hJ w]
    refine ⟨Real.sqrt_nonneg _, ?_⟩
    have hq : ∀ j : Fin 3, ∑ i : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ P w (e j) i) ^ 2 ≤ Lp ^ 2 := by
      intro j
      have h1 : ‖fderiv ℝ P w (e j)‖ ≤ Lp := by
        calc ‖fderiv ℝ P w (e j)‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ * ‖e j‖ := (fderiv ℝ P w).le_opNorm _
          _ = ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
          _ ≤ Lp := hw
      have h2 : ‖fderiv ℝ P w (e j)‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ P w (e j) i) ^ 2 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
        simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      rw [← h2]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1 2
    have h3 := hLag (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j) (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j)
    have h4 : (∑ i : Fin 3, (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j) i ^ 2) *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i ^ 2) ≤ Lp ^ 2 * Lp ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul (hq 1) (hq 2) (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)) (sq_nonneg _)
    calc Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j)
          (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i) ^ 2) ≤ Real.sqrt ((Lp ^ 2) ^ 2) :=
          Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by nlinarith)
      _ = Lp ^ 2 := Real.sqrt_sq (sq_nonneg _)
  
  have hJc : ContinuousOn J V := by
    have hD : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ P) V := hP.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by simp)
    have hcomp : ∀ j i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun w => fderiv ℝ P w (e j) i) V := by
      intro j i
      exact (hcoord i).comp_continuousOn (hD.clm_apply continuousOn_const)
    have a0 := hcomp 1 0
    have a1 := hcomp 1 1
    have a2 := hcomp 1 2
    have b0 := hcomp 2 0
    have b1 := hcomp 2 1
    have b2 := hcomp 2 2
    have hcr : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun w => crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j)
        (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i) V := by
      intro i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [cross_apply] <;> fun_prop
    have heq : J = fun w => Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j)
        (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i) ^ 2) := funext hJ
    rw [heq]
    exact (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => (hcr i).pow 2)).sqrt
  
  obtain ⟨Cψ, hCψ⟩ := hψ.bounded_above_of_compact_support hψc
  have hCψ0 : 0 ≤ Cψ := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hCψ 0)
  have hKimg : IsCompact (Θ '' tsupport ψ) :=
    hψc.image_of_continuousOn (hΘO.mono (hψU.trans hUO))
  refine ⟨Cψ * Lp ^ 2, fun t => ?_⟩
  have hKt : IsCompact (L t ⁻¹' (Θ '' tsupport ψ)) :=
    (hLiso t).isClosedEmbedding.isCompact_preimage hKimg
  have hS : ∀ z : E2, g t z ≠ 0 → z ∈ L t ⁻¹' (Θ '' tsupport ψ) := by
    intro z hz
    by_cases h : L t z ∈ V
    · rw [hgW t z h] at hz
      have hψne : ψ (P (L t z)) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hz
      obtain ⟨-, -, hΘP⟩ := hPV' _ h
      exact ⟨P (L t z), subset_tsupport _ hψne, hΘP⟩
    · exact absurd (hg0 t z h) hz
  have hKW : L t ⁻¹' (Θ '' tsupport ψ) ⊆ L t ⁻¹' V := by
    rintro z ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩
    show L t z ∈ V
    rw [← hyz]
    exact hΘV y (hψU hy)
  have htsupp : tsupport (g t) ⊆ L t ⁻¹' (Θ '' tsupport ψ) :=
    closure_minimal (fun z hz => hS z hz) hKt.isClosed
  have hgcont : ContinuousOn (g t) (L t ⁻¹' V) := by
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun z => ψ (P (L t z)) * J (L t z)) (L t ⁻¹' V) := by
      refine ContinuousOn.mul ?_ ?_
      · exact hψ.comp_continuousOn
          (hP.continuousOn.comp (hLiso t).continuous.continuousOn (fun z hz => hz))
      · exact hJc.comp (hLiso t).continuous.continuousOn (fun z hz => hz)
    exact h1.congr (fun z hz => hgW t z hz)
  refine ⟨hgcont.continuous_of_tsupport_subset (hV.preimage (hLiso t).continuous)
    (htsupp.trans hKW), HasCompactSupport.intro hKt (fun z hz => by_contra fun h => hz (hS z h)),
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z
    by_cases h : L t z ∈ V
    · rw [hgW t z h, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hJle _ h).1]
      have hψb : |ψ (P (L t z))| ≤ Cψ := by
        have := hCψ (P (L t z))
        rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      exact mul_le_mul hψb (hJle _ h).2 (hJle _ h).1 hCψ0
    · rw [hg0 t z h, abs_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hCψ0 (sq_nonneg _)
  · intro z hz
    apply hg0
    intro h
    have h3 := ((hmemV _).1 h).2.2
    rw [(hLc t z).2.2] at h3
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O)
    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b O) (k : Fin 3) (τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hUO : U ⊆ O) (P : E3 → E3)
    (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ})
    (hPV : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f (P w), b (P w), (P w) k] = w)
    (hPU : ∀ y ∈ U, (|f y - τ₀| < δ ∧ |b y - β₀| < δ ∧ |y k - σ₀| < δ) ∧
      P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k]) = y)
    (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψU : tsupport ψ ⊆ U)
    (J : E3 → ℝ)
    (hJ : ∀ w : E3, J w = Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j)
        (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i) ^ 2))
    (g : ℝ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ (t : ℝ) (z : E2), g t z = if |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ then
        ψ (P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1])) *
          J ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1]) else 0) :
    ∀ t s : ℝ, 0 < s → sbgbAreaConst *
      ∫ y in {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y},
        s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b y / s) * ψ y
        ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) =
      ∫ z in {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0}, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (z 0 / s) * g t z

proof.tactics:
by
  intro t s hs
  obtain ⟨hc0, -⟩ := sbgb_area_const_spec
  
  have hco : ∀ a a' a'' : ℝ, ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![a, a', a'']) 0 = a ∧
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![a, a', a'']) 1 = a' ∧
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![a, a', a'']) 2 = a'' := fun a a' a'' => by simp
  have hco2 : ∀ a a' : ℝ, ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![a, a']) 0 = a ∧
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![a, a']) 1 = a' := fun a a' => by simp
  have hcoord : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      f (P w) = w 0 ∧ b (P w) = w 1 ∧ (P w) k = w 2 := by
    intro w hw
    have h := (hPV w hw).2.2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h' := congrArg (fun x : E3 => x 0) h
      simpa using h'
    · have h' := congrArg (fun x : E3 => x 1) h
      simpa using h'
    · have h' := congrArg (fun x : E3 => x 2) h
      simpa using h'
  have hVopen : IsOpen {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := by
    simp only [Set.setOf_and]
    exact (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const))
  
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ : ∃ Λ : E2 →L[ℝ] E3, ∀ v : E2,
      Λ v = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![0, v 0, v 1] :=
    ⟨(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi ![0, EuclideanSpace.proj 0, EuclideanSpace.proj 1]),
      fun v => by ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp⟩
  have hΛe : Λ (e2 0) = e 1 ∧ Λ (e2 1) = e 2 := by
    constructor
    · ext j; fin_cases j <;> simp [hΛ, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    · ext j; fin_cases j <;> simp [hΛ, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  obtain ⟨ι, hιdef⟩ : ∃ ι : E2 → E3,
      ι = fun z => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, 0] + Λ z := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hιeq : ∀ z : E2, ι z = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1] := by
    intro z
    simp only [hιdef]
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hΛ]
  have hιcd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ι := by
    rw [hιdef]; exact contDiff_const.add Λ.contDiff
  have hιd : ∀ z : E2, HasFDerivAt ι Λ z := by
    intro z; rw [hιdef]; exact Λ.hasFDerivAt.const_add _
  have hιc : ∀ z : E2, ι z 0 = t ∧ ι z 1 = z 0 ∧ ι z 2 = z 1 := by
    intro z; rw [hιeq z]; exact hco t (z 0) (z 1)
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : E2 → E3, F = P ∘ ι := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hFι : ∀ z, F z = P (ι z) := by intro z; rw [hFdef]; rfl
  have hFeq : ∀ z : E2, F z = P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1]) := by
    intro z; rw [hFι, hιeq]
  
  obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ : ∃ W : Set E2,
      W = {z : E2 | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemW : ∀ z, z ∈ W ↔ (|t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ) := by
    intro z; simp only [hW, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ : ∃ S : Set E2,
      S = {z : E2 | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ ∧ 0 ≤ z 0} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemS : ∀ z, z ∈ S ↔ (|t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ ∧ 0 ≤ z 0) := by
    intro z; simp only [hS, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  have hWopen : IsOpen W := by
    rw [hW]
    simp only [Set.setOf_and]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const))
  have hSmeas : MeasurableSet S := by
    rw [hS]
    simp only [Set.setOf_and]
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_const).measurableSet.inter
      ((isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const).measurableSet.inter
        ((isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const).measurableSet.inter
          (isClosed_le continuous_const (by fun_prop)).measurableSet))
  have hSW : S ⊆ W := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3, -⟩ := (hmemS z).1 hz
    exact (hmemW z).2 ⟨a1, a2, a3⟩
  have hmaps : ∀ z ∈ W, ι z ∈ {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3⟩ := hιc z
    obtain ⟨b1, b2, b3⟩ := (hmemW z).1 hz
    show |ι z 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |ι z 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |ι z 2 - σ₀| < δ
    rw [a1, a2, a3]
    exact ⟨b1, b2, b3⟩
  have hcoord' : ∀ z ∈ W, f (F z) = t ∧ b (F z) = z 0 ∧ (F z) k = z 1 := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨a1, a2, a3⟩ := hcoord (ι z) (hmaps z hz)
    obtain ⟨c1, c2, c3⟩ := hιc z
    rw [hFι z]
    exact ⟨a1.trans c1, a2.trans c2, a3.trans c3⟩
  have hFU : ∀ z ∈ W, F z ∈ U := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hFι z]
    exact (hPV _ (hmaps z hz)).2.1
  
  have hFcd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W := by
    rw [hFdef]
    exact hP.comp hιcd.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hmaps z hz)
  have hFinj : Set.InjOn F W := by
    intro z hz z' hz' hzz
    have a := hcoord' z hz
    have a' := hcoord' z' hz'
    have e0 : z 0 = z' 0 := by rw [← a.2.1, ← a'.2.1, hzz]
    have e1 : z 1 = z' 1 := by rw [← a.2.2, ← a'.2.2, hzz]
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [e0, e1]
  have hdF : ∀ z ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F z) := by
    intro z hz
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F z :=
      (hFcd.contDiffAt (hWopen.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hbd : DifferentiableAt ℝ b (F z) :=
      (hb.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds (hUO (hFU z hz)))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hev0 : (b ∘ F) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hWopen.mem_nhds hz] with z' hz'
      rw [Function.comp_apply, (hcoord' z' hz').2.1]
      simp
    have hev1 : ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ F) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hWopen.mem_nhds hz] with z' hz'
      rw [Function.comp_apply]
      simp [(hcoord' z' hz').2.2]
    have hd0 : (fderiv ℝ b (F z)).comp (fderiv ℝ F z) =
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
      rw [← fderiv_comp z hbd hFd, hev0.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ), ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    have hd1 : (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ F z) =
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
      have h := fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt hFd
      rw [hev1.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)] at h
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv] at h
      exact h.symm
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro v hv
    have e0 : v 0 = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L v) hd0
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hv, map_zero] at h
      simpa using h.symm
    have e1 : v 1 = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L v) hd1
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hv, map_zero] at h
      simpa using h.symm
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [e0, e1]
  
  have hcross : ∀ z ∈ W, Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F z k ^ 2) =
      J ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1]) := by
    intro z hz
    have hPd : DifferentiableAt ℝ P (ι z) :=
      (hP.contDiffAt (hVopen.mem_nhds (hmaps z hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hFd : fderiv ℝ F z = (fderiv ℝ P (ι z)).comp Λ := by
      rw [hFdef]; exact (hPd.hasFDerivAt.comp z (hιd z)).fderiv
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ F z (e2 0) = fderiv ℝ P (ι z) (e 1) := by
      rw [hFd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hΛe.1]
    have h2 : fderiv ℝ F z (e2 1) = fderiv ℝ P (ι z) (e 2) := by
      rw [hFd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hΛe.2]
    rw [hJ, ← hιeq z]
    simp only [gsCrossN, gsTan, h1, h2, cross_apply]
  
  have hslice : {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} ∩ U = F '' S := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hyO, hft, hb0⟩, hyU⟩
      obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, hPy⟩ := hPU y hyU
      obtain ⟨hz0, hz1⟩ := hco2 (b y) (y k)
      refine ⟨(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![b y, y k], ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine (hmemS _).2 ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← hft]; exact h1
        · rw [hz0]; exact h2
        · rw [hz1]; exact h3
        · rw [hz0]; exact hb0
      · rw [hFeq, hz0, hz1, ← hft]
        exact hPy
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
      have hz' := (hmemS z).1 hz
      have hzW : z ∈ W := hSW hz
      have hc := hcoord' z hzW
      refine ⟨⟨hUO (hFU z hzW), hc.1, ?_⟩, hFU z hzW⟩
      rw [hc.2.1]; exact hz'.2.2.2
  
  have hDmeas : MeasurableSet {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} := by
    have h1 : IsOpen (O ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}ᶜ) :=
      hf.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_compl_singleton
    have h2 : IsOpen (O ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Iio 0) :=
      hb.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_Iio
    have heq : {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} =
        O \ ((O ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}ᶜ) ∪ (O ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Iio 0)) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff,
        Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_Iio]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hyO, hft, hb0⟩
        refine ⟨hyO, ?_⟩
        rintro (⟨_, h⟩ | ⟨_, h⟩)
        · exact h hft
        · exact absurd h (not_lt.mpr hb0)
      · rintro ⟨hyO, hn⟩
        refine ⟨hyO, ?_, ?_⟩
        · by_contra h; exact hn (Or.inl ⟨hyO, h⟩)
        · by_contra h; exact hn (Or.inr ⟨hyO, lt_of_not_ge h⟩)
    rw [heq]
    exact hO.measurableSet.diff (h1.union h2).measurableSet
  
  have hzero1 : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} \
      ({y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} ∩ U),
      s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b y / s) * ψ y = 0 := by
    rintro y ⟨hyD, hyn⟩
    have hyU : y ∉ U := fun h => hyn ⟨hyD, h⟩
    have hψ0 : ψ y = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hyU (hψU h))
    rw [hψ0, mul_zero]
  
  have hB := sbgb_hausdorff_area_formula F W hWopen hFcd hFinj hdF S hSmeas hSW
    (fun y => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b y / s) * ψ y)
  
  have hC : ∫ x in S, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (F x) / s) * ψ (F x) *
        Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) =
      ∫ z in S, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (z 0 / s) * g t z := by
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun hSmeas (fun z hz => ?_)
    have hz' := (hmemS z).1 hz
    have hzW : z ∈ W := hSW hz
    have hgz : g t z = ψ (P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1])) *
        J ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1]) := by
      rw [hg, if_pos ⟨hz'.1, hz'.2.1, hz'.2.2.1⟩]
    dsimp only
    rw [(hcoord' z hzW).2.1, hcross z hzW, hgz, hFeq z]
    ring
  
  have hHmeas : MeasurableSet {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0} :=
    (isClosed_le (f := fun _ : E2 => (0 : ℝ)) (g := fun z : E2 => z 0) continuous_const
      (by fun_prop)).measurableSet
  have hSH : S ⊆ {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0} := fun z hz => ((hmemS z).1 hz).2.2.2
  have hzero2 : ∀ z ∈ {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0} \ S,
      s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (z 0 / s) * g t z = 0 := by
    rintro z ⟨hzH, hzS⟩
    have hgz : g t z = 0 := by
      rw [hg, if_neg]
      rintro ⟨a1, a2, a3⟩
      exact hzS ((hmemS z).2 ⟨a1, a2, a3, hzH⟩)
    rw [hgz, mul_zero]
  have hD : ∫ z in {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0}, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (z 0 / s) * g t z =
      ∫ z in S, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (z 0 / s) * g t z :=
    setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hHmeas hSH hzero2
  rw [setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hDmeas Set.inter_subset_left hzero1, hslice,
    hB, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hc0.ne', hD]
  exact hC

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hinj : Set.InjOn F W)
    (hdF : ∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x))
    (W' : Set E2) (hW' : MeasurableSet W') (hW'W : W' ⊆ W) (h : E3 → ℝ) :
    ∫ y in F '' W', h y ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) =
      sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * ∫ x in W', h (F x) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro t s _hs
  
  have hc0 : ∀ a b' c' : ℝ, ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![a, b', c']) 0 = a :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have hc1 : ∀ a b' c' : ℝ, ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![a, b', c']) 1 = b' :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have hc2 : ∀ a b' c' : ℝ, ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![a, b', c']) 2 = c' :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : E2 → E3, ∀ z : E2,
      L z = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1] := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  
  have hVo : IsOpen {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := by
    have h0 : IsOpen {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    have h1 : IsOpen {w : E3 | |w 1 - β₀| < δ} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    have h2 : IsOpen {w : E3 | |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const
    exact h0.inter (h1.inter h2)
  
  have hcoord : ∀ (x y : E3) (a b' : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b' → a + b' = 1 → ∀ (i : Fin 3) (c' : ℝ),
      |x i - c'| < δ → |y i - c'| < δ → |(a • x + b' • y) i - c'| < δ := by
    intro x y a b' ha hb hab i c' h1 h2
    have e : (a • x + b' • y) i - c' = a * (x i - c') + b' * (y i - c') := by
      simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      linear_combination c' * hab
    rw [e]
    calc |a * (x i - c') + b' * (y i - c')|
        ≤ |a * (x i - c')| + |b' * (y i - c')| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = a * |x i - c'| + b' * |y i - c'| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      _ ≤ a * max |x i - c'| |y i - c'| + b' * max |x i - c'| |y i - c'| :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left _ _) ha)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right _ _) hb)
      _ = max |x i - c'| |y i - c'| := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      _ < δ := max_lt h1 h2
  have hVc : Convex ℝ {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := by
    intro x hx y hy a b' ha hb hab
    obtain ⟨hx0, hx1, hx2⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨hy0, hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨hcoord x y a b' ha hb hab 0 τ₀ hx0 hy0, hcoord x y a b' ha hb hab 1 β₀ hx1 hy1,
      hcoord x y a b' ha hb hab 2 σ₀ hx2 hy2⟩
  
  have hPlip : LipschitzOnWith (Real.toNNReal Lp) P
      {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := by
    refine Convex.lipschitzOnWith_of_nnnorm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (fun w hw => ?_)
      (fun w hw => ?_) hVc
    · exact (hP.contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds hw)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    · rw [← norm_toNNReal]
      exact Real.toNNReal_le_toNNReal (hPV w hw).1
  
  have hLiso : Isometry L := by
    refine Isometry.of_dist_eq (fun z z' => ?_)
    rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [hL, hc0, hc1, hc2, dist_self]
    norm_num
  
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo L {z : E2 | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ}
      {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hz
    show |L z 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |L z 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |L z 2 - σ₀| < δ
    rw [hL, hc0, hc1, hc2]
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  
  have hFlip : LipschitzOnWith (Real.toNNReal Lp * 1) (P ∘ L)
      {z : E2 | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ} :=
    hPlip.comp hLiso.lipschitz.lipschitzOnWith hmaps
  
  have hWb : Bornology.IsBounded {z : E2 | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ} := by
    rw [isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le]
    refine ⟨|β₀| + |σ₀| + 2 * δ, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨_, h1, h2⟩ := hz
    have e1 : |z 0| ≤ |β₀| + δ := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (z 0) β₀
      linarith
    have e2 : |z 1| ≤ |σ₀| + δ := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (z 1) σ₀
      linarith
    have hn : ‖z‖ ≤ |z 0| + |z 1| := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      have hsq : (z 0) ^ 2 + (z 1) ^ 2 ≤ (|z 0| + |z 1|) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (z 0), abs_nonneg (z 1), sq_abs (z 0), sq_abs (z 1)]
      have h3 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at h3
      exact h3
    linarith
  
  have hfinE2 : ∀ S : Set E2, Bornology.IsBounded S →
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) S < ⊤ := by
    intro S hS
    have hS' : Bornology.IsBounded ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ) '' S) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).toContinuousLinearMap.lipschitz.isBounded_image hS
    have hvol : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)
        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ) '' S) < ⊤ := by
      have h := MeasureTheory.hausdorffMeasure_pi_real (ι := Fin 2)
      simp only [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
      rw [h]
      exact hS'.measure_lt_top
    have heq : S = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ''
        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ) '' S) := by
      rw [Set.image_image]; simp
    rw [heq]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt
      (((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.lipschitz.lipschitzOnWith
        (s := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ) '' S)).hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num))
      (ENNReal.mul_lt_top (ENNReal.rpow_lt_top_of_nonneg (by norm_num) ENNReal.coe_ne_top) hvol)
  have hWfin : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)
      {z : E2 | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ} < ⊤ := hfinE2 _ hWb
  have himg : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)
      ((P ∘ L) '' {z : E2 | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ}) < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (hFlip.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num))
      (ENNReal.mul_lt_top (ENNReal.rpow_lt_top_of_nonneg (by norm_num) ENNReal.coe_ne_top) hWfin)
  
  have hsub : {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} ∩ U ⊆
      (P ∘ L) '' {z : E2 | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ} := by
    rintro y ⟨⟨_, hft, _⟩, hyU⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, hPy⟩ := hPU y hyU
    refine ⟨(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![b y, y k], ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hft]; exact h1
    · exact h2
    · exact h3
    · show P (L _) = y
      rw [hL, ← hft]
      exact hPy
  
  have hDm : MeasurableSet {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} := by
    have h1 : IsOpen (O ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}ᶜ) :=
      hf.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_compl_singleton
    have h2 : IsOpen (O ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Iio 0) :=
      hb.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_Iio
    have heq : {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} =
        O \ ((O ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}ᶜ) ∪ (O ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Iio 0)) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff,
        Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_Iio, not_or,
        not_and, not_not, not_lt]
      tauto
    rw [heq]
    exact hO.measurableSet.diff (h1.union h2).measurableSet
  
  have hη : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) :=
    ContDiff.continuous_deriv (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)) le_rfl
  have hφc : ContinuousOn (fun y => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b y / s) * ψ y) O :=
    (continuousOn_const.mul (hη.comp_continuousOn (hb.continuousOn.div_const s))).mul
      hψ.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hψc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hφc.mono (hψU.trans hUO))
  have hbound : ∀ y, ‖s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b y / s) * ψ y‖ ≤ max B 0 := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ tsupport ψ
    · exact (hB y hy).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy, mul_zero, norm_zero]
      exact le_max_right _ _
  have hDU : MeasurableSet ({y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} ∩ U) :=
    hDm.inter hU.measurableSet
  have hμ : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)
      ({y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} ∩ U) < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hsub) himg
  have hint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun y => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b y / s) * ψ y)
      ({y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} ∩ U)
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) :=
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.of_bound hμ
      ((hφc.mono (fun y hy => hy.1.1)).aestronglyMeasurable hDU) (max B 0)
      (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ hbound)
  refine hint.of_forall_diff_eq_zero hDm (fun y hy => ?_)
  have hyU : y ∉ U := fun h => hy.2 ⟨hy.1, h⟩
  have hyψ : y ∉ tsupport ψ := fun h => hyU (hψU h)
  simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hyψ]

informal_problem.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O)
    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b O) (k : Fin 3) (τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hUO : U ⊆ O) (P : E3 → E3)
    (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ})
    (hPV : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f (P w), b (P w), (P w) k] = w)
    (hPU : ∀ y ∈ U, (|f y - τ₀| < δ ∧ |b y - β₀| < δ ∧ |y k - σ₀| < δ) ∧
      P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k]) = y)
    (ψ : E3 → ℝ) (hψ : Continuous ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψU : tsupport ψ ⊆ U)
    (J : E3 → ℝ)
    (hJ : ∀ w : E3, J w = Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j)
        (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i) ^ 2))
    (g : ℝ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ (t : ℝ) (z : E2), g t z = if |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ then
        ψ (P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1])) *
          J ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1]) else 0) :
