    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hx
    show |ℓ x 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |ℓ x 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |ℓ x 2 - σ₀| < δ
    rw [hℓ, hc0, hc1, hc2]
    exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
  have hFlip : LipschitzOnWith (Real.toNNReal Lp * 1) (P ∘ ℓ)
      {x : ℝ | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |(0 : ℝ) - β₀| < δ ∧ |x - σ₀| < δ} :=
    hPlip.comp hℓiso.lipschitz.lipschitzOnWith hmaps
  
  have hIfin : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ)
      {x : ℝ | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |(0 : ℝ) - β₀| < δ ∧ |x - σ₀| < δ} < ⊤ := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.hausdorffMeasure_real]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (MeasureTheory.measure_mono ?_)
      (measure_Ioo_lt_top (a := σ₀ - δ) (b := σ₀ + δ))
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨_, _, h3⟩ := hx
    rw [abs_lt] at h3
    rw [Set.mem_Ioo]
    constructor <;> linarith [h3.1, h3.2]
  have himg : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ)
      ((P ∘ ℓ) '' {x : ℝ | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |(0 : ℝ) - β₀| < δ ∧ |x - σ₀| < δ}) < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (hFlip.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num))
      (ENNReal.mul_lt_top (ENNReal.rpow_lt_top_of_nonneg (by norm_num) ENNReal.coe_ne_top) hIfin)
  
  have hsub : {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ b y = 0} ∩ U ⊆
      (P ∘ ℓ) '' {x : ℝ | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |(0 : ℝ) - β₀| < δ ∧ |x - σ₀| < δ} := by
    rintro y ⟨⟨_, hft, hb0⟩, hyU⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, hPy⟩ := hPU y hyU
    refine ⟨y k, ⟨?_, ?_, h3⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hft]; exact h1
    · rw [← hb0]; exact h2
    · show P (ℓ (y k)) = y
      rw [hℓ, ← hft, ← hb0]
      exact hPy
  
  have hΓm : MeasurableSet {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ b y = 0} := by
    have h1 : IsOpen (O ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}ᶜ) :=
      hf.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_compl_singleton
    have h2 : IsOpen (O ∩ b ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) :=
      hb.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hO isOpen_compl_singleton
    have heq : {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ b y = 0} =
        O \ ((O ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}ᶜ) ∪ (O ∩ b ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ)) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff,
        Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto
    rw [heq]
    exact hO.measurableSet.diff (h1.union h2).measurableSet
  
  have hCS : ∀ X0 X1 X2 Y0 Y1 Y2 : ℝ,
      (X0 * Y0 + X1 * Y1 + X2 * Y2) ^ 2 ≤ (X0 ^ 2 + X1 ^ 2 + X2 ^ 2) * (Y0 ^ 2 + Y1 ^ 2 + Y2 ^ 2) := by
    intro X0 X1 X2 Y0 Y1 Y2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X0 * Y1 - X1 * Y0), sq_nonneg (X0 * Y2 - X2 * Y0),
      sq_nonneg (X1 * Y2 - X2 * Y1)]
  have halg : ∀ a0 a1 a2 c0 c1 c2 u0 u1 u2 v0 v1 v2 L : ℝ,
      a0 * u0 + a1 * u1 + a2 * u2 = 1 → a0 * v0 + a1 * v1 + a2 * v2 = 0 →
      c0 * u0 + c1 * u1 + c2 * u2 = 0 → c0 * v0 + c1 * v1 + c2 * v2 = 1 →
      u0 ^ 2 + u1 ^ 2 + u2 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 → v0 ^ 2 + v1 ^ 2 + v2 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 →
      1 ≤ ((a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) ^ 2 + (a2 * c0 - a0 * c2) ^ 2 + (a0 * c1 - a1 * c0) ^ 2) * L ^ 4 := by
    intro a0 a1 a2 c0 c1 c2 u0 u1 u2 v0 v1 v2 L hau hav hcu hcv hu hv
    have hXY : (a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) * (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) + (a2 * c0 - a0 * c2) * (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2)
        + (a0 * c1 - a1 * c0) * (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) = 1 := by
      have h : (a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) * (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) + (a2 * c0 - a0 * c2) * (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2)
          + (a0 * c1 - a1 * c0) * (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) =
          (a0 * u0 + a1 * u1 + a2 * u2) * (c0 * v0 + c1 * v1 + c2 * v2)
            - (a0 * v0 + a1 * v1 + a2 * v2) * (c0 * u0 + c1 * u1 + c2 * u2) := by ring
      rw [h, hau, hav, hcu, hcv]; ring
    have hY : (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) ^ 2 + (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) ^ 2 + (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0) ^ 2 ≤
        (u0 ^ 2 + u1 ^ 2 + u2 ^ 2) * (v0 ^ 2 + v1 ^ 2 + v2 ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u0 * v0 + u1 * v1 + u2 * v2)]
    have hUV : (u0 ^ 2 + u1 ^ 2 + u2 ^ 2) * (v0 ^ 2 + v1 ^ 2 + v2 ^ 2) ≤ L ^ 2 * L ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul hu hv (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have h1 := hCS (a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) (a2 * c0 - a0 * c2) (a0 * c1 - a1 * c0)
      (u1 * v2 - u2 * v1) (u2 * v0 - u0 * v2) (u0 * v1 - u1 * v0)
    rw [hXY, one_pow] at h1
    have hXn : 0 ≤ (a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) ^ 2 + (a2 * c0 - a0 * c2) ^ 2 + (a0 * c1 - a1 * c0) ^ 2 := by
      positivity
    calc (1 : ℝ) ≤ _ := h1
      _ ≤ ((a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) ^ 2 + (a2 * c0 - a0 * c2) ^ 2 + (a0 * c1 - a1 * c0) ^ 2) *
          (L ^ 2 * L ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hY.trans hUV) hXn
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have hexp : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E3),
      L z = L (e 0) * z 0 + L (e 1) * z 1 + L (e 2) * z 2 := by
    intro L z
    have hz : z = z 0 • e 0 + z 1 • e 1 + z 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hz]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hnsq : ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 + z 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  
  have hkey : ∀ y ∈ U, 1 ≤ (∑ i : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y i ^ 2) * Lp ^ 4 := by
    intro y hyU
    obtain ⟨hwV, hPy⟩ := hPU y hyU
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : E3, w = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k] :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hwV' : w ∈ {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := by
      show |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ
      rw [hw, hc0, hc1, hc2]
      exact hwV
    rw [← hw] at hPy
    have hnorm : ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp := (hPV w hwV').1
    have hPd : HasFDerivAt P (fderiv ℝ P w) w :=
      ((hP.contDiffAt (hVo.mem_nhds hwV')).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hfd : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f y) (P w) := by
      rw [hPy]
      exact ((hf.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds (hUO hyU))).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hbd : HasFDerivAt b (fderiv ℝ b y) (P w) := by
      rw [hPy]
      exact ((hb.contDiffAt (hO.mem_nhds (hUO hyU))).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hpr0 : HasFDerivAt (⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ))
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) w := ContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt _
    have hpr1 : HasFDerivAt (⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ))
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) w := ContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt _
    have hfP : HasFDerivAt (f ∘ P) (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) w := by
      refine hpr0.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hVo.mem_nhds hwV') (fun w' hw' => ?_))
      have h3 := congrArg (fun z : E3 => z 0) (hPV w' hw').2.2
      exact h3
    have hbP : HasFDerivAt (b ∘ P) (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) w := by
      refine hpr1.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (Filter.eventually_of_mem (hVo.mem_nhds hwV') (fun w' hw' => ?_))
      have h3 := congrArg (fun z : E3 => z 1) (hPV w' hw').2.2
      exact h3
    have hEf := (hfd.comp w hPd).unique hfP
    have hEb := (hbd.comp w hPd).unique hbP
    have hfu : fderiv ℝ f y (fderiv ℝ P w (e 0)) = 1 := by
      have := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e 0)) hEf
      simpa [e] using this
    have hfv : fderiv ℝ f y (fderiv ℝ P w (e 1)) = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e 1)) hEf
      simpa [e] using this
    have hbu : fderiv ℝ b y (fderiv ℝ P w (e 0)) = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e 0)) hEb
      simpa [e] using this
    have hbv : fderiv ℝ b y (fderiv ℝ P w (e 1)) = 1 := by
      have := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e 1)) hEb
      simpa [e] using this
    have hle : ∀ i : Fin 3, ‖fderiv ℝ P w (e i)‖ ^ 2 ≤ Lp ^ 2 := by
      intro i
      have h1 : ‖fderiv ℝ P w (e i)‖ ≤ Lp :=
        calc ‖fderiv ℝ P w (e i)‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ * ‖e i‖ := (fderiv ℝ P w).le_opNorm _
          _ = ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
          _ ≤ Lp := hnorm
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1 2
    have hu2 := hle 0
    have hv2 := hle 1
    rw [hnsq] at hu2 hv2
    have hS : ∑ i : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y i ^ 2 =
        (partialDeriv 1 f y * partialDeriv 2 b y - partialDeriv 2 f y * partialDeriv 1 b y) ^ 2 +
        (partialDeriv 2 f y * partialDeriv 0 b y - partialDeriv 0 f y * partialDeriv 2 b y) ^ 2 +
        (partialDeriv 0 f y * partialDeriv 1 b y - partialDeriv 1 f y * partialDeriv 0 b y) ^ 2 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]; rfl
    rw [hS]
    exact halg (partialDeriv 0 f y) (partialDeriv 1 f y) (partialDeriv 2 f y)
      (partialDeriv 0 b y) (partialDeriv 1 b y) (partialDeriv 2 b y)
      (fderiv ℝ P w (e 0) 0) (fderiv ℝ P w (e 0) 1) (fderiv ℝ P w (e 0) 2)
      (fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) 0) (fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) 1) (fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) 2) Lp
      ((hexp _ _).symm.trans hfu) ((hexp _ _).symm.trans hfv)
      ((hexp _ _).symm.trans hbu) ((hexp _ _).symm.trans hbv) hu2 hv2
  
  have hfc : ContinuousOn (fun y => ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖) (tsupport ψ) :=
    ((hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by simp)).norm).mono (hψU.trans hUO)
  obtain ⟨Mψ, hMψ⟩ := hψc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hψ.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨Mf, hMf⟩ := hψc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hfc
  have hbound : ∀ y ∈ U,
      ‖ψ y * (‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2))‖ ≤
        max Mψ 0 * (max Mf 0 * Lp ^ 2) := by
    intro y hyU
    by_cases hyK : y ∈ tsupport ψ
    · have h1 := hkey y hyU
      have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
      have hSpos : 0 < ∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2 := by
        rcases hS0.lt_or_eq with h | h
        · exact h
        · rw [← h] at h1; norm_num at h1
      have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hSpos
      have hrsq : Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2) ^ 2 =
          ∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hS0
      have hLr : 1 ≤ Lp ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2) := by
        have h2 : 1 ≤ (Lp ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
          calc (1 : ℝ) ≤ (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2) * Lp ^ 4 := h1
            _ = (Lp ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
              rw [mul_pow, hrsq]; ring
        have h3 : 0 ≤ Lp ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2) := by positivity
        nlinarith
      have hN0 : 0 ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hNr : ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2) ≤
          ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ * Lp ^ 2 := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hr]
        calc ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ = ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
          _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ * (Lp ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLr hN0
          _ = ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ * Lp ^ 2 * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2) := by ring
      have hNr0 : 0 ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2) :=
        div_nonneg hN0 hr.le
      have hψb : |ψ y| ≤ max Mψ 0 := by
        have := hMψ y hyK
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
        exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
      have hNb : ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ max Mf 0 := by
        have := hMf y hyK
        simp only [norm_norm] at this
        exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hNr0]
      exact mul_le_mul hψb (hNr.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hNb (sq_nonneg _))) hNr0
        (le_max_right _ _)
    · rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hyK, zero_mul, norm_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) (mul_nonneg (le_max_right _ _) (sq_nonneg _))
  
  have hpd : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3), Measurable (fun y => partialDeriv i g y) :=
    fun g i => measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ g (e i)
  have hcross : ∀ i : Fin 3, Measurable (fun y => sbgbCross f b y i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact ((hpd f 1).mul (hpd b 2)).sub ((hpd f 2).mul (hpd b 1))
    · exact ((hpd f 2).mul (hpd b 0)).sub ((hpd f 0).mul (hpd b 2))
    · exact ((hpd f 0).mul (hpd b 1)).sub ((hpd f 1).mul (hpd b 0))
  have hmeas : Measurable
      (fun y => ψ y * (‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2))) := by
    refine hψ.measurable.mul ((measurable_fderiv ℝ f).norm.div ?_)
    exact (Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => (hcross i).pow_const 2)).sqrt
  
  have hΓU : MeasurableSet ({y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ b y = 0} ∩ U) :=
    hΓm.inter hU.measurableSet
  have hμ : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ)
      ({y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ b y = 0} ∩ U) < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hsub) himg
  have hint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun y => ψ y * (‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ / Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b y k ^ 2)))
      ({y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ b y = 0} ∩ U)
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ)) :=
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn.of_bound hμ hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
      (max Mψ 0 * (max Mf 0 * Lp ^ 2))
      (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hΓU (fun y hy => hbound y hy.2))
  refine hint.of_forall_diff_eq_zero hΓm (fun y hy => ?_)
  have hyU : y ∉ U := fun h => hy.2 ⟨hy.1, h⟩
  have hyψ : y ∉ tsupport ψ := fun h => hyU (hψU h)
  simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hyψ]

informal_problem.statement:
(G : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hG : G.PosDef) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |G i j|) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * v i * v j

signature.name: cceb_inv_quad_lower
signature.statement:
(G : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hG : G.PosDef) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |G i j|) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * v i * v j

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdet : IsUnit G.det := hG.det_pos.ne'.isUnit
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : Fin 3 → ℝ, w = G⁻¹.mulVec v := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hGw : G.mulVec w = v := by
    rw [hw, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv G hdet, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hv : ∀ i, v i = ∑ j : Fin 3, G i j * w j := fun i => (congrFun hGw i).symm
  have hwi : ∀ i, w i = ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * v j := fun i => by rw [hw]; rfl
  have hQ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * v i * v j =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G k l * w k * w l := by
    have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * v i * v j = ∑ i : Fin 3, v i * w i := by
      simp only [hwi, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    rw [e1]
    simp only [hv, Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  rw [hQ]
  have hsym : ∀ k l : Fin 3, G l k = G k l := fun k l => by
    simpa using hG.isHermitian.apply k l
  have s10 : G 1 0 = G 0 1 := hsym 0 1
  have s20 : G 2 0 = G 0 2 := hsym 0 2
  have s21 : G 2 1 = G 1 2 := hsym 1 2
  have hpsd : ∀ x y z : ℝ, 0 ≤ G 0 0 * x * x + G 0 1 * x * y + G 0 2 * x * z
      + G 0 1 * y * x + G 1 1 * y * y + G 1 2 * y * z
      + G 0 2 * z * x + G 1 2 * z * y + G 2 2 * z * z := by
    intro x y z
    have h := hG.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg ![x, y, z]
    refine h.trans_eq ?_
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three, s10, s20, s21,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons,
      Matrix.tail_cons]
    ring
  have hv0 : v 0 = G 0 0 * w 0 + G 0 1 * w 1 + G 0 2 * w 2 := by
    rw [hv 0]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have hv1 : v 1 = G 0 1 * w 0 + G 1 1 * w 1 + G 1 2 * w 2 := by
    rw [hv 1]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, s10]
  have hv2 : v 2 = G 0 2 * w 0 + G 1 2 * w 1 + G 2 2 * w 2 := by
    rw [hv 2]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, s20, s21]
  obtain ⟨Q, hQdef⟩ : ∃ Q : ℝ, Q = G 0 0 * w 0 * w 0 + G 0 1 * w 0 * w 1 + G 0 2 * w 0 * w 2
      + G 0 1 * w 1 * w 0 + G 1 1 * w 1 * w 1 + G 1 2 * w 1 * w 2
      + G 0 2 * w 2 * w 0 + G 1 2 * w 2 * w 1 + G 2 2 * w 2 * w 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQe : ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, G k l * w k * w l = Q := by
    rw [hQdef]; simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, s10, s20, s21]; ring
  rw [hQe]
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := by rw [hQdef]; exact hpsd (w 0) (w 1) (w 2)
  have ha0 : 0 < G 0 0 := hG.diag_pos
  have ha1 : 0 < G 1 1 := hG.diag_pos
  have ha2 : 0 < G 2 2 := hG.diag_pos
  have k0 : 0 ≤ G 0 0 * (G 0 0 * Q - v 0 ^ 2) := by
    have h0 := hpsd (G 0 0 * w 0 - v 0) (G 0 0 * w 1) (G 0 0 * w 2)
    rw [hv0] at h0 ⊢
    rw [hQdef]
    exact h0.trans_eq (by ring)
  have k1 : 0 ≤ G 1 1 * (G 1 1 * Q - v 1 ^ 2) := by
    have h1 := hpsd (G 1 1 * w 0) (G 1 1 * w 1 - v 1) (G 1 1 * w 2)
    rw [hv1] at h1 ⊢
    rw [hQdef]
    exact h1.trans_eq (by ring)
  have k2 : 0 ≤ G 2 2 * (G 2 2 * Q - v 2 ^ 2) := by
    have h2 := hpsd (G 2 2 * w 0) (G 2 2 * w 1) (G 2 2 * w 2 - v 2)
    rw [hv2] at h2 ⊢
    rw [hQdef]
    exact h2.trans_eq (by ring)
  have r0 : v 0 ^ 2 ≤ G 0 0 * Q := by
    have := (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left ha0).1 k0
    linarith
  have r1 : v 1 ^ 2 ≤ G 1 1 * Q := by
    have := (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left ha1).1 k1
    linarith
  have r2 : v 2 ^ 2 ≤ G 2 2 * Q := by
    have := (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left ha2).1 k2
    linarith
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : ℝ, S = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |G i j| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hSdef]
  have htr : G 0 0 + G 1 1 + G 2 2 ≤ S := by
    rw [hSdef]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    linarith [le_abs_self (G 0 0), le_abs_self (G 1 1), le_abs_self (G 2 2),
      abs_nonneg (G 0 1), abs_nonneg (G 0 2), abs_nonneg (G 1 0), abs_nonneg (G 1 2),
      abs_nonneg (G 2 0), abs_nonneg (G 2 1)]
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htr hQ0
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  nlinarith [hm, r0, r1, r2]

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (L : Set E3) (hL : IsCompact L) (hLψ : L ⊆ ψ.source) (G : M → ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ ψ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => G (ψ' y)) ψ'.source)
    (hG0 : ∀ p, 0 ≤ G p) (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hGK : ∀ p, p ∉ K → G p = 0)
    (C : Set M) (hC : IsClosed C) :
    ∫ y in L, C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det ≤
      atlasInt g κ χ (C.indicator G)

signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞)
    (L : Set E3) (hL : IsCompact L) (hLψ : L ⊆ ψ.source) (G : M → ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ ψ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => G (ψ' y)) ψ'.source)
    (hG0 : ∀ p, 0 ≤ G p) (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hGK : ∀ p, p ∉ K → G p = 0)
    (C : Set M) (hC : IsClosed C) :
    ∫ y in L, C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det ≤
      atlasInt g κ χ (C.indicator G)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hρA, hχs, hχ0, hχ1, hχt, hcase⟩ := hA
  
  have hexp : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
    intro v
    have := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr v
    simpa using this.symm
  have hexpB : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (w1 w2 : E3),
      B (D w1) (D w2) = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
    intro B D w1 w2
    calc B (D w1) (D w2)
        = B (D (∑ a : Fin 3, w1 a • e a)) (D (∑ b : Fin 3, w2 b • e b)) := by
          rw [← hexp w1, ← hexp w2]
      _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
          simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          ring
  
  have hD : ∀ φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff φ y).det) φ.source := by
    intro φ
    have hGc : ContinuousOn (g.coeff φ) φ.source :=
      continuousOn_pi.2 fun a => continuousOn_pi.2 fun c =>
        (coeff_contDiffOn_source g φ a c).continuousOn
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn ((continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hGc)
  
  have hfar : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∉ K := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ₀, hcl⟩ := endChart_far_isClosed g hAF j
    let O : ℕ → Set M := fun m => ((hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖})ᶜ
    have hOo : ∀ m, IsOpen (O m) := fun m =>
      (hcl _ (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_nonneg m))).isOpen_compl
    have hOmono : Monotone O := by
      intro m m' hmm' p hp
      simp only [O, Set.mem_compl_iff] at hp ⊢
      intro hp'
      apply hp
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzp⟩ := hp'
      refine ⟨z, ?_, hzp⟩
      have h1 : (m : ℝ) ≤ m' := Nat.cast_le.2 hmm'
      have h2 : ρ₀ + (m' : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖ := hz
      show ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖z‖
      linarith
    have hcovK : K ⊆ ⋃ m, O m := by
      intro p _
      by_contra hne
      have hmem : ∀ m : ℕ, p ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖} := fun m =>
        Classical.byContradiction fun h => hne (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨m, h⟩)
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, hpz₀⟩ := hmem 0
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_gt (‖z₀‖ - ρ₀)
      obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁, hpz₁⟩ := hmem m
      have h0 : ρ₀ + ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ‖z₀‖ := hz₀
      have h1 : ρ₀ + (m : ℝ) ≤ ‖z₁‖ := hz₁
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] at h0
      have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := Nat.cast_nonneg m
      have hz₀s : z₀ ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
        rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖z₀‖; linarith
      have hz₁s : z₁ ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
        rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖z₁‖; linarith
      have heq : z₀ = z₁ :=
        (hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.injOn hz₀s hz₁s (hpz₀.trans hpz₁.symm)
      rw [← heq] at h1
      linarith
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hK.elim_directed_cover O hOo hcovK hOmono.directed_le
    refine ⟨ρ₀ + N, fun y hy hyK => hN hyK ⟨y, ?_, rfl⟩⟩
    show ρ₀ + (N : ℝ) ≤ ‖y‖
    linarith
  have hH : ∀ i, ContinuousOn
      (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source := by
    intro i
    exact (((hχs i).continuous.comp_continuousOn
      (κ i).contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn).mul (hG (κ i))).mul (hD (κ i))
  
  have hZ : ∀ i, ∃ Z : Set E3, IsCompact Z ∧ Z ⊆ (κ i).source ∧
      ∀ y ∈ (κ i).source, y ∉ Z →
        χ i (κ i y) * G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det = 0 := by
    intro i
    rcases hcase i with hc | ⟨j, hκ, -, h0⟩
    · refine ⟨(κ i).toPartialEquiv.symm '' tsupport (χ i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact hc.image_of_continuousOn
          ((κ i).toOpenPartialHomeomorph.continuousOn_symm.mono (hχt i))
      · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.map_target (hχt i hx)
      · intro y hy hyZ
        have hns : κ i y ∉ tsupport (χ i) := by
          intro hmem
          exact hyZ ⟨κ i y, hmem, (κ i).toPartialEquiv.left_inv hy⟩
        rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hns, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    · obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hfar j
      refine ⟨{y : E3 | ρA ≤ ‖y‖} ∩ {y : E3 | ‖y‖ ≤ max R ρA}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) (max R ρA)).of_isClosed_subset
          ((isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
            (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)) ?_
        intro y hy
        rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
        exact hy.2
      · intro y hy
        have h1 : ρA ≤ ‖y‖ := hy.1
        rw [hκ, (hAF.ends j).source_eq]
        show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
        linarith
      · intro y hy hyZ
        rw [hκ] at hy ⊢
        have hy1 : (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := by
          have h2 := hy
          rw [(hAF.ends j).source_eq] at h2
          exact h2
        by_cases hle : ‖y‖ ≤ ρA
        · rw [h0 y hy1 hle, zero_mul, zero_mul]
        · have hgt : max R ρA < ‖y‖ := by
            by_contra hc'
            exact hyZ ⟨le_of_lt (not_le.1 hle), not_lt.1 hc'⟩
          rw [hGK _ (hR y (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hgt)), mul_zero, zero_mul]
  
  have hInt : ∀ i, IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * C.indicator G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det)
      (κ i).source := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨Z, hZc, hZS, hZ0⟩ := hZ i
    have h1 : IntegrableOn
        (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source :=
      (((hH i).mono hZS).integrableOn_compact hZc).of_forall_diff_eq_zero
        (κ i).open_source.measurableSet (fun y hy => hZ0 y hy.1 hy.2)
    have hmeas : MeasurableSet ((κ i).source ∩ κ i ⁻¹' C) := by
      have hopen : IsOpen ((κ i).source ∩ κ i ⁻¹' Cᶜ) :=
        (κ i).contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (κ i).open_source
          hC.isOpen_compl
      have heq : (κ i).source ∩ κ i ⁻¹' C = (κ i).source \ ((κ i).source ∩ κ i ⁻¹' Cᶜ) := by
        ext y
        simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff]
        tauto
      rw [heq]
      exact (κ i).open_source.measurableSet.diff hopen.measurableSet
    refine (h1.indicator hmeas).congr_fun ?_ (κ i).open_source.measurableSet
    intro y hy
    by_cases hc : κ i y ∈ C
    · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy, hc]
    · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hy, hc]
  
  have hψc : ContinuousOn ψ ψ.source := ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
  have hL'c : IsClosed (L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) :=
    (hψc.mono hLψ).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hL.isClosed hC
  have hL'k : IsCompact (L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) := hL.of_isClosed_subset hL'c Set.inter_subset_left
  have hL'm : MeasurableSet (L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) := hL'c.measurableSet
  have hL'ψ : L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C ⊆ ψ.source := fun y hy => hLψ hy.1
  have hs1 : ∫ y in L, C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det =
      ∫ y in L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C, C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
    refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hL.isClosed.measurableSet
      Set.inter_subset_left ?_
    rintro y ⟨hyL, hyn⟩
    have hyC : ψ y ∉ C := fun h => hyn ⟨hyL, h⟩
    simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hyC, zero_mul]
  
  have hfi : ∀ i, IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det)
      (L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) := by
    intro i
    have h : IntegrableOn
        (fun y => χ i (ψ y) * G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) (L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) :=
      (((((hχs i).continuous.comp_continuousOn hψc).mul (hG ψ)).mul (hD ψ)).mono
        hL'ψ).integrableOn_compact hL'k
    refine h.congr_fun (fun y hy => ?_) hL'm
    simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem (show ψ y ∈ C from hy.2)]
  
  have key : ∀ i, ∫ y in L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C,
      χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det ≤
      ∫ z in (κ i).source,
        χ i (κ i z) * C.indicator G (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set E3, Ω = ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' (κ i).target := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΩmem : ∀ y, y ∈ Ω ↔ y ∈ ψ.source ∧ ψ y ∈ (κ i).target := by
      intro y; rw [hΩ]; rfl
    have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by
      rw [hΩ]
      exact ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage ψ.open_source
        (κ i).open_target
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ : ∃ τ : E3 → E3, τ = fun y => (κ i).toPartialEquiv.symm (ψ y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hτsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ Ω := by
      rw [hτ, hΩ]
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (ContMDiffOn.comp (κ i).contMDiffOn_invFun
        (ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hy.2))
    have hτd : ∀ y ∈ Ω, DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y := fun y hy =>
      (hτsm.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hy)
    have hκτ : ∀ y ∈ Ω, κ i (τ y) = ψ y := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hτ]
      exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.right_inv ((hΩmem y).1 hy).2
    have hτmem : ∀ y ∈ Ω, τ y ∈ (κ i).source := by
      intro y hy
      rw [hτ]
      exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.map_target ((hΩmem y).1 hy).2
    
    have hjac : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det =
        |(fderiv ℝ τ y).det| * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) (τ y)).det := by
      intro y hy
      have hmdκ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) :=
        ((κ i).contMDiffOn_toFun.contMDiffAt
          ((κ i).open_source.mem_nhds (hτmem y hy))).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
      have hmdτ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) τ y := (hτd y hy).mdifferentiableAt
      have heq : (ψ : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (κ i) ∘ τ := by
        filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        exact (hκτ z hz).symm
      have hmf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ y) := by
        rw [heq.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp y hmdκ hmdτ, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
          J = Matrix.of fun a b => fderiv ℝ τ y (e b) a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hcoeff : g.coeff ψ y = J.transpose * g.coeff (κ i) (τ y) * J := by
        ext a b
        have hl : g.coeff ψ y a b = g.g (ψ y)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) (fderiv ℝ τ y (e a)))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) (fderiv ℝ τ y (e b))) := by
          show g.g (ψ y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y (e a))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y (e b)) = _
          rw [hmf]
          rfl
        have hr : ∀ a' b' : Fin 3, g.coeff (κ i) (τ y) a' b' =
            (g.g (ψ y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)
              ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (e a'))
              ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (e b')) := by
          intro a' b'
          show g.g (κ i (τ y)) _ _ = _
          rw [hκτ y hy]
          try rfl
        have hl2 : g.coeff ψ y a b = ∑ a' : Fin 3, ∑ b' : Fin 3,
            fderiv ℝ τ y (e a) a' * fderiv ℝ τ y (e b) b' * g.coeff (κ i) (τ y) a' b' := by
          rw [hl]
          refine (hexpB (g.g (ψ y)) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (κ i) (τ y)) _ _).trans ?_
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b' _ => ?_
          exact congrArg _ (hr a' b').symm
        rw [hl2]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply,
          Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      have hdetJ : J.det = (fderiv ℝ τ y).det := by
        show J.det = LinearMap.det ((fderiv ℝ τ y : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)
        rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis]
        congr 1
        try (ext a b; rw [hJ, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]; simp)
      rw [hcoeff, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, hdetJ]
      rw [show (fderiv ℝ τ y).det * (g.coeff (κ i) (τ y)).det * (fderiv ℝ τ y).det =
          (fderiv ℝ τ y).det ^ 2 * (g.coeff (κ i) (τ y)).det by ring]
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    
    have hEm : MeasurableSet ((L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) ∩ Ω) := hL'm.inter hΩo.measurableSet
    have hEΩ : (L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) ∩ Ω ⊆ Ω := Set.inter_subset_right
    have hτinj : Set.InjOn τ ((L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) ∩ Ω) := by
      intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ h
      have h' : ψ y₁ = ψ y₂ := by
        rw [← hκτ y₁ (hEΩ hy₁), ← hκτ y₂ (hEΩ hy₂), h]
      exact ψ.toPartialEquiv.injOn ((hΩmem y₁).1 (hEΩ hy₁)).1 ((hΩmem y₂).1 (hEΩ hy₂)).1 h'
    
    have hr1 : ∫ y in L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C,
        χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det =
        ∫ y in (L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) ∩ Ω,
        χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
      refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hL'm Set.inter_subset_left ?_
      rintro y ⟨hyL', hyE⟩
      have hyΩ : y ∉ Ω := fun h => hyE ⟨hyL', h⟩
      have hns : ψ y ∉ tsupport (χ i) := fun h => hyΩ ((hΩmem y).2 ⟨hL'ψ hyL', hχt i h⟩)
      simp only [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hns, zero_mul]
    
    have hs4 : ∫ z in τ '' ((L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) ∩ Ω),
        χ i (κ i z) * C.indicator G (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det =
        ∫ y in (L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) ∩ Ω,
        χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
      rw [integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hEm
        (fun y hy => (hτd y (hEΩ hy)).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hτinj]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hEm (fun y hy => ?_)
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hκτ y (hEΩ hy), hjac y (hEΩ hy)]
      ring
    
    have hsub : τ '' ((L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) ∩ Ω) ⊆ (κ i).source := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact hτmem y (hEΩ hy)
    have hmono : ∫ z in τ '' ((L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C) ∩ Ω),
        χ i (κ i z) * C.indicator G (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det ≤
        ∫ z in (κ i).source,
        χ i (κ i z) * C.indicator G (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det :=
      setIntegral_mono_set (hInt i)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hχ0 i _)
          (Set.indicator_nonneg (fun q _ => hG0 q) _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
        hsub.eventuallyLE
    rw [hr1, ← hs4]
    exact hmono
  
  have hpt : ∀ y, ∑ i, χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det =
      C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
    intro y
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, hχ1, one_mul]
  unfold atlasInt
  rw [hs1]
  calc ∫ y in L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C, C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det
      = ∫ y in L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C, ∑ i,
          χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det :=
        setIntegral_congr_fun hL'm (fun y _ => (hpt y).symm)
    _ = ∑ i, ∫ y in L ∩ ψ ⁻¹' C,
          χ i (ψ y) * C.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det :=
        integral_finset_sum Finset.univ fun i _ => hfi i
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ∫ z in (κ i).source,
          χ i (κ i z) * C.indicator G (κ i z) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (κ i) z).det :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => key i

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun p => ?_, fun p hp => ?_⟩
  · have hGpsd : (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)).PosSemidef := by
      refine Matrix.PosSemidef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg ?_ ?_
      · refine Matrix.IsHermitian.ext fun i j => ?_
        simp only [star_trivial, RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        exact g.symm _ _ _
      · intro x
        have hv : 0 ≤ g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))
            (∑ i, x i • mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) (e i))
            (∑ i, x i • mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) (e i)) := by
          by_cases h : (∑ i, x i • mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm
              (chartAt E3 p p) (e i) : E3) = 0
          · rw [h]; simp
          · exact (g.posDef _ _ h).le
        refine le_of_le_of_eq hv ?_
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
    have h := hGpsd.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg
      (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p))
    refine le_of_le_of_eq h ?_
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, star_trivial,
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  · have hw0 : w =ᶠ[𝓝 p] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp hp
    have hT : Tendsto (chartAt E3 p).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)) (𝓝 p) := by
      have h1 := (chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 p)
      rw [ContinuousAt, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)] at h1
      exact h1
    have hcomp : (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      hw0.comp_tendsto hT
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) = 0 := by
      rw [hcomp.fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_const_apply _
    have hpd : ∀ i, partialDeriv i (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) = 0 := by
      intro i
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hfd]
      rfl
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, hpd, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

informal_problem.statement:
(G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hGc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => G y i j) K)
    (hHc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => H y i j) K)
    (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ K, 0 < (G y).det) :
    ∃ t₁ C : ℝ, 0 < t₁ ∧ t₁ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₁ →
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y + t • H y).det) K ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y + t • H y)⁻¹ i j) K) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ K, 0 < (G y + t • H y).det ∧ Real.sqrt (G y + t • H y).det ≤ C ∧
        |Real.sqrt (G y + t • H y).det - Real.sqrt (G y).det| ≤ C * |t| ∧
        ∀ i j : Fin 3, |(G y + t • H y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (G y + t • H y).det -
            (G y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (G y).det| ≤ C * |t|

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have trip : ∀ x1 x2 x3 y1 y2 y3 L δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ L → |x1| ≤ L → |x2| ≤ L → |x3| ≤ L →
      |y1| ≤ L → |y2| ≤ L → |y3| ≤ L → |x1 - y1| ≤ δ → |x2 - y2| ≤ δ → |x3 - y3| ≤ δ →
      |x1 * x2 * x3 - y1 * y2 * y3| ≤ 3 * L ^ 2 * δ ∧ |x1 * x2 * x3| ≤ L ^ 3 := by
    intro x1 x2 x3 y1 y2 y3 L δ hL hx1 hx2 hx3 hy1 hy2 hy3 h1 h2 h3
    have hδ : 0 ≤ δ := (abs_nonneg _).trans h1
    have e : x1 * x2 * x3 - y1 * y2 * y3 =
        (x1 - y1) * x2 * x3 + y1 * (x2 - y2) * x3 + y1 * y2 * (x3 - y3) := by ring
    constructor
    · rw [e]
      refine (abs_add_three _ _ _).trans ?_
      simp only [abs_mul]
      have a1 : |x1 - y1| * |x2| * |x3| ≤ δ * L * L :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul h1 hx2 (abs_nonneg _) hδ) hx3 (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hδ hL)
      have a2 : |y1| * |x2 - y2| * |x3| ≤ L * δ * L :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hy1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hL) hx3 (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hL hδ)
      have a3 : |y1| * |y2| * |x3 - y3| ≤ L * L * δ :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hy1 hy2 (abs_nonneg _) hL) h3 (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hL hL)
      nlinarith
    · simp only [abs_mul]
      calc |x1| * |x2| * |x3| ≤ L * L * L :=
            mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hx1 hx2 (abs_nonneg _) hL) hx3 (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hL hL)
        _ = L ^ 3 := by ring
  
  have det3 : ∀ (X Y : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (L δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ L → (∀ i j, |X i j| ≤ L) →
      (∀ i j, |Y i j| ≤ L) → (∀ i j, |X i j - Y i j| ≤ δ) →
      |X.det - Y.det| ≤ 18 * L ^ 2 * δ ∧ |X.det| ≤ 6 * L ^ 3 := by
    intro X Y L δ hL hX hY hXY
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_three, Matrix.det_fin_three]
    obtain ⟨a1, b1⟩ := trip (X 0 0) (X 1 1) (X 2 2) (Y 0 0) (Y 1 1) (Y 2 2) L δ hL (hX _ _)
      (hX _ _) (hX _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _)
    obtain ⟨a2, b2⟩ := trip (X 0 0) (X 1 2) (X 2 1) (Y 0 0) (Y 1 2) (Y 2 1) L δ hL (hX _ _)
      (hX _ _) (hX _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _)
    obtain ⟨a3, b3⟩ := trip (X 0 1) (X 1 0) (X 2 2) (Y 0 1) (Y 1 0) (Y 2 2) L δ hL (hX _ _)
      (hX _ _) (hX _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _)
    obtain ⟨a4, b4⟩ := trip (X 0 1) (X 1 2) (X 2 0) (Y 0 1) (Y 1 2) (Y 2 0) L δ hL (hX _ _)
      (hX _ _) (hX _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _)
    obtain ⟨a5, b5⟩ := trip (X 0 2) (X 1 0) (X 2 1) (Y 0 2) (Y 1 0) (Y 2 1) L δ hL (hX _ _)
      (hX _ _) (hX _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _)
    obtain ⟨a6, b6⟩ := trip (X 0 2) (X 1 1) (X 2 0) (Y 0 2) (Y 1 1) (Y 2 0) L δ hL (hX _ _)
      (hX _ _) (hX _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _) (hXY _ _)
    rw [abs_le] at a1 a2 a3 a4 a5 a6 b1 b2 b3 b4 b5 b6
    constructor
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
    · rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
  
  have adj3 : ∀ (X Y : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (L δ : ℝ), 1 ≤ L → 0 ≤ δ →
      (∀ i j, |X i j| ≤ L) → (∀ i j, |Y i j| ≤ L) → (∀ i j, |X i j - Y i j| ≤ δ) →
      ∀ i j, |X.adjugate i j - Y.adjugate i j| ≤ 18 * L ^ 2 * δ ∧
        |X.adjugate i j| ≤ 6 * L ^ 3 := by
    intro X Y L δ hL hδ hX hY hXY i j
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply]
    have hs : ∀ k : Fin 3, |(Pi.single i (1 : ℝ) : Fin 3 → ℝ) k| ≤ L := by
      intro k
      by_cases hk : k = i
      · subst hk; rw [Pi.single_eq_same, abs_one]; exact hL
      · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hk, abs_zero]; linarith
    apply det3 _ _ L δ (by linarith)
    · intro a b; rw [Matrix.updateRow_apply]; split_ifs
      · exact hs b
      · exact hX a b
    · intro a b; rw [Matrix.updateRow_apply]; split_ifs
      · exact hs b
      · exact hY a b
    · intro a b; rw [Matrix.updateRow_apply, Matrix.updateRow_apply]; split_ifs
      · rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; exact hδ
      · exact hXY a b
  
  have sq1 : ∀ a b s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ^ 2 ≤ a → s ^ 2 ≤ b →
      |Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b| ≤ |a - b| / s := by
    intro a b s hs ha hb
    have hsa : s ≤ Real.sqrt a := by
      have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ha; rwa [Real.sqrt_sq hs.le] at this
    have hsb : s ≤ Real.sqrt b := by
      have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hb; rwa [Real.sqrt_sq hs.le] at this
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := le_trans (sq_nonneg s) ha
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ b := le_trans (sq_nonneg s) hb
    have h1 := Real.mul_self_sqrt ha0
    have h2 := Real.mul_self_sqrt hb0
    have e : a - b = (Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b) * (Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b) := by
      linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) * h1 + h2
    have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b := by linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg b]
    have hge : s ≤ Real.sqrt a + Real.sqrt b := by linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg b]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hs, e, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hpos]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hge (abs_nonneg _)
  have sq2 : ∀ a b s P Q : ℝ, 0 < s → s ^ 2 ≤ a → s ^ 2 ≤ b →
      |P / Real.sqrt a - Q / Real.sqrt b| ≤ |P - Q| / s + |Q| * |a - b| / s ^ 3 := by
    intro a b s P Q hs ha hb
    have hsa : s ≤ Real.sqrt a := by
      have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt ha; rwa [Real.sqrt_sq hs.le] at this
    have hsb : s ≤ Real.sqrt b := by
      have := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hb; rwa [Real.sqrt_sq hs.le] at this
    have hra : 0 < Real.sqrt a := lt_of_lt_of_le hs hsa
    have hrb : 0 < Real.sqrt b := lt_of_lt_of_le hs hsb
    have hra' := hra.ne'
    have hrb' := hrb.ne'
    have e : P / Real.sqrt a - Q / Real.sqrt b = (P - Q) / Real.sqrt a +
        Q * (Real.sqrt b - Real.sqrt a) / (Real.sqrt a * Real.sqrt b) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [e]
    refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ ?_)
    · rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hra]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _) hs hsa
    · rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (mul_pos hra hrb), abs_sub_comm]
      have h1 := sq1 a b s hs ha hb
      have h2 : s ^ 2 ≤ Real.sqrt a * Real.sqrt b := by
        rw [sq]; exact mul_le_mul hsa hsb hs.le hra.le
      calc |Q| * |Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b| / (Real.sqrt a * Real.sqrt b)
          ≤ |Q| * |Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b| / s ^ 2 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (by positivity) h2
        _ ≤ |Q| * (|a - b| / s) / s ^ 2 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
        _ = |Q| * |a - b| / s ^ 3 := by
            rw [mul_div_assoc', div_div]; ring
  
  have invq : ∀ X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, 0 < X.det → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      X⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt X.det = X.adjugate i j / Real.sqrt X.det := by
    intro X hX i j
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt X.det := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hX
    have hrr : Real.sqrt X.det * Real.sqrt X.det = X.det := Real.mul_self_sqrt hX.le
    obtain ⟨r, hrdef⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = Real.sqrt X.det := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hrdef] at hr hrr ⊢
    rw [← hrr]
    calc (r * r)⁻¹ * X.adjugate i j * r = X.adjugate i j * (r * r⁻¹) * r⁻¹ := by ring
      _ = X.adjugate i j / r := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', mul_one, div_eq_mul_inv]
  
  choose BG hBG using fun i j => hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hGc i j)
  choose BH hBH using fun i j => hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hHc i j)
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (|BG i j| + |BH i j|) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hMij : ∀ i j : Fin 3, |BG i j| + |BH i j| ≤ M := by
    intro i j
    have h1 : |BG i j| + |BH i j| ≤ ∑ j' : Fin 3, (|BG i j'| + |BH i j'|) :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j' => |BG i j'| + |BH i j'|)
        (fun _ _ => add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have h2 : ∑ j' : Fin 3, (|BG i j'| + |BH i j'|) ≤ M := by
      rw [hMdef]
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i' => ∑ j' : Fin 3, (|BG i' j'| + |BH i' j'|))
        (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))
        (Finset.mem_univ i)
    linarith
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (add_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) (hMij 0 0)
  have hGb : ∀ y ∈ K, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |G y i j| ≤ M := by
    intro y hy i j
    have h := hBG i j y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    linarith [le_abs_self (BG i j), hMij i j, abs_nonneg (BH i j)]
  have hHb : ∀ y ∈ K, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |H y i j| ≤ M := by
    intro y hy i j
    have h := hBH i j y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    linarith [le_abs_self (BH i j), hMij i j, abs_nonneg (BG i j)]
  have hGcK : ContinuousOn G K := continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j => hGc i j
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y).det) K :=
    (continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hGcK
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmK⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ y ∈ K, m ≤ (G y).det := by
    rcases K.eq_empty_or_nonempty with he | hne
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun y hy => by simp [he] at hy⟩
    · obtain ⟨y0, hy0, hmin⟩ := hK.exists_isMinOn hne hdetc
      exact ⟨(G y0).det, hGpos y0 hy0, fun y hy => (isMinOn_iff.1 hmin) y hy⟩
  
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = 2 * M + 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ L := by rw [hLdef]; linarith
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := by linarith
  obtain ⟨D, hDdef⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = 18 * L ^ 2 * M := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := by rw [hDdef]; positivity
  obtain ⟨s, hsdef⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = Real.sqrt (m / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hs : 0 < s := by rw [hsdef]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (half_pos hm)
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = m / 2 := by rw [hsdef]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (half_pos hm).le
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = 1 + 6 * L ^ 3 + 2 * (D / s) + 6 * L ^ 3 * (D / s ^ 3) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hDs : 0 ≤ D / s := div_nonneg hD hs.le
  have hDs3 : 0 ≤ 6 * L ^ 3 * (D / s ^ 3) := by positivity
  have hL3 : 0 ≤ 6 * L ^ 3 := by positivity
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by rw [hCdef]; linarith
  have hD2 : 0 < 2 * (D + 1) := by linarith
  refine ⟨min 1 (m / (2 * (D + 1))), C, lt_min one_pos (div_pos hm hD2), min_le_left _ _, hC, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have ht1 : |t| ≤ 1 := ht.trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have ht2 : |t| ≤ m / (2 * (D + 1)) := ht.trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have htD : D * |t| ≤ m / 2 := by
    have h := (le_div_iff₀ hD2).1 ht2
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg t]
  have hat : 0 ≤ |t| := abs_nonneg t
  have hδ : 0 ≤ M * |t| := mul_nonneg hM hat
  have hAe : ∀ y i j, (G y + t • H y) i j = G y i j + t * H y i j := by
    intro y i j; simp [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply]
  have key : ∀ y ∈ K, 0 < (G y + t • H y).det ∧ Real.sqrt (G y + t • H y).det ≤ C ∧
      |Real.sqrt (G y + t • H y).det - Real.sqrt (G y).det| ≤ C * |t| ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin 3, |(G y + t • H y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (G y + t • H y).det -
          (G y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (G y).det| ≤ C * |t| := by
    intro y hy
    have hGL : ∀ i j, |G y i j| ≤ L := fun i j => by linarith [hGb y hy i j]
    have hAL : ∀ i j, |(G y + t • H y) i j| ≤ L := by
      intro i j
      rw [hAe]
      have h1 : |t * H y i j| ≤ 1 * M := by
        rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul ht1 (hHb y hy i j) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      have h2 := abs_add_le (G y i j) (t * H y i j)
      linarith [hGb y hy i j]
    have hAd : ∀ i j, |(G y + t • H y) i j - G y i j| ≤ M * |t| := by
      intro i j
      rw [hAe, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_mul, mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hHb y hy i j) hat
    obtain ⟨hdd, hdA⟩ := det3 _ _ L (M * |t|) hL0 hAL hGL hAd
    have hdd' : |(G y + t • H y).det - (G y).det| ≤ D * |t| := by
      rw [hDdef]; linarith
    have hb : m ≤ (G y).det := hmK y hy
    have hpos : m / 2 ≤ (G y + t • H y).det := by
      have := (abs_le.1 hdd').1
      linarith
    have hApos : 0 < (G y + t • H y).det := by linarith
    have hsa : s ^ 2 ≤ (G y + t • H y).det := by rw [hs2]; exact hpos
    have hsb : s ^ 2 ≤ (G y).det := by rw [hs2]; linarith
    refine ⟨hApos, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : (G y + t • H y).det ≤ (1 + 6 * L ^ 3) ^ 2 := by
        have := le_abs_self (G y + t • H y).det
        nlinarith
      have h2 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by linarith)] at h2
      rw [hCdef]; linarith
    · have h1 := sq1 _ _ s hs hsa hsb
      have h2 : |(G y + t • H y).det - (G y).det| / s ≤ D * |t| / s :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hdd' hs.le
      have h3 : D * |t| / s = (D / s) * |t| := by ring
      have h4 : D / s ≤ C := by rw [hCdef]; linarith
      have h5 : (D / s) * |t| ≤ C * |t| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4 hat
      linarith
    · intro i j
      rw [invq _ hApos i j, invq _ (hGpos y hy) i j]
      have h1 := sq2 _ _ s ((G y + t • H y).adjugate i j) ((G y).adjugate i j) hs hsa hsb
      obtain ⟨hPQ, -⟩ := adj3 _ _ L (M * |t|) hL1 hδ hAL hGL hAd i j
      obtain ⟨-, hQ⟩ := adj3 (G y) (G y) L 0 hL1 le_rfl hGL hGL
        (fun a b => by rw [sub_self, abs_zero]) i j
      have hPQ' : |(G y + t • H y).adjugate i j - (G y).adjugate i j| ≤ D * |t| := by
        rw [hDdef]; linarith
      have h2 : |(G y + t • H y).adjugate i j - (G y).adjugate i j| / s ≤ D * |t| / s :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hPQ' hs.le
      have h3 : |(G y).adjugate i j| * |(G y + t • H y).det - (G y).det| / s ^ 3 ≤
          6 * L ^ 3 * (D * |t|) / s ^ 3 :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul hQ hdd' (abs_nonneg _) hL3) (by positivity)
      have h4 : D * |t| / s + 6 * L ^ 3 * (D * |t|) / s ^ 3 =
          (D / s + 6 * L ^ 3 * (D / s ^ 3)) * |t| := by ring
      have h5 : D / s + 6 * L ^ 3 * (D / s ^ 3) ≤ C := by rw [hCdef]; linarith
      have h6 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h5 hat
      linarith
  
  have hAc : ∀ i j, ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y + t • H y) i j) K := by
    intro i j
    have : ContinuousOn (fun y => G y i j + t * H y i j) K :=
      (hGc i j).add (continuousOn_const.mul (hHc i j))
    exact this.congr (fun y _ => hAe y i j)
  have hAcK : ContinuousOn (fun y => G y + t • H y) K :=
    continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j => hAc i j
  have hdetAc : ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y + t • H y).det) K :=
    (continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hAcK
  have hadjc : ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y + t • H y).adjugate) K :=
    (continuous_id.matrix_adjugate).comp_continuousOn hAcK
  refine ⟨hdetAc.sqrt, ?_, key⟩
  intro i j
  have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => (G y + t • H y).adjugate i j) K :=
    continuousOn_pi.1 (continuousOn_pi.1 hadjc i) j
  have h2 := hdetAc.inv₀ (fun y hy => (key y hy).1.ne')
  exact (h2.mul h1).congr (fun y _ => by
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv'])

informal_problem.statement:
(Φ : ℝ × E3 → ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × E3)) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Φ W) (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKW : ∀ y ∈ K, ((0 : ℝ), y) ∈ W) :
    ∃ t₁ C : ℝ, 0 < t₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun y => deriv (fun s => Φ (s, y)) 0) K ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₁ → ∀ y ∈ K, (t, y) ∈ W ∧
        |Φ (t, y) - Φ (0, y) - t * deriv (fun s => Φ (s, y)) 0| ≤ C * t ^ 2

signature.name: param_taylor_compact
signature.statement:
(Φ : ℝ × E3 → ℝ) (W : Set (ℝ × E3)) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 Φ W) (K : Set E3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKW : ∀ y ∈ K, ((0 : ℝ), y) ∈ W) :
    ∃ t₁ C : ℝ, 0 < t₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun y => deriv (fun s => Φ (s, y)) 0) K ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ t₁ → ∀ y ∈ K, (t, y) ∈ W ∧
        |Φ (t, y) - Φ (0, y) - t * deriv (fun s => Φ (s, y)) 0| ≤ C * t ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have taylor2 : ∀ (f D D2 : ℝ → ℝ) (r M : ℝ),
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r, HasDerivAt f (D s) s) →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r, HasDerivAt D (D2 s) s) →
      (∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r, |D2 s| ≤ M) →
      ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ r → |f t - f 0 - t * D 0| ≤ M * t ^ 2 := by
    intro f D D2 r M hf hD hD2 t ht
    have hr : 0 ≤ r := (abs_nonneg t).trans ht
    have h0I : (0:ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r := ⟨by linarith, hr⟩
    have htI : t ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r := abs_le.1 ht
    have hM : 0 ≤ M := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hD2 0 h0I)
    have h1 : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (-r) r, |D s - D 0| ≤ M * |s| := by
      intro s hs
      have := (convex_Icc (-r) r).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
        (f := D) (f' := D2) (C := M) (fun x hx => (hD x hx).hasDerivWithinAt)
        (fun x hx => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hD2 x hx) h0I hs
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero] at this
      exact this
    have hJ : Set.uIcc 0 t ⊆ Set.Icc (-r) r := Set.uIcc_subset_Icc h0I htI
    have hg : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => f s - f 0 - s * D 0)
        (D s - D 0) (Set.uIcc 0 t) s := by
      intro s hs
      have h2 := ((hf s (hJ hs)).sub (hasDerivAt_const s (f 0))).sub
        ((hasDerivAt_id' s).mul_const (D 0))
      have h3 := h2.hasDerivWithinAt (s := Set.uIcc 0 t)
      convert h3 using 1
      ring
    have hgb : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, ‖D s - D 0‖ ≤ M * |t| := by
      intro s hs
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h2 : |s| ≤ |t| := by
        have h3 := Set.abs_sub_left_of_mem_uIcc hs
        rw [sub_zero, sub_zero] at h3
        exact h3
      exact (h1 s (hJ hs)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hM)
    have hfin := (convex_uIcc (0:ℝ) t).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le hg hgb
      Set.left_mem_uIcc Set.right_mem_uIcc
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_self, zero_mul, sub_zero] at hfin
    calc |f t - f 0 - t * D 0| ≤ M * |t| * |t| := hfin
      _ = M * t ^ 2 := by rw [mul_assoc, ← sq, sq_abs]
  
  have slice : ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (Ψ : ℝ × E3 → F)
      (s : ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ (s, y) →
      HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => Ψ (r, y)) (fderiv ℝ Ψ (s, y) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3))) s := by
    intro F _ _ Ψ s y h
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ((r, y) : ℝ × E3)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) s :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' s).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const s y)
    exact h.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt s hγ
  
  obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, h0u, hKv, huvW⟩ :=
    generalized_tube_lemma (isCompact_singleton (x := (0:ℝ))) hK hW (by
      rintro ⟨a, y⟩ ⟨ha, hy⟩
      obtain rfl : a = 0 := ha
      exact hKW y hy)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hu 0 (h0u (Set.mem_singleton 0))
  have hslab : ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ δ / 2 → ∀ y ∈ K, (t, y) ∈ W := by
    intro t ht y hy
    apply huvW
    refine ⟨hball ?_, hKv hy⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero]
    linarith
  
  have hΦ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun p => fderiv ℝ Φ p) W := hΦ.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by norm_num)
  have hΦ2c : ContinuousOn (fun p => fderiv ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ Φ q) p) W :=
    hΦ1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW le_rfl
  have hΦ1c : ContinuousOn (fun p => fderiv ℝ Φ p) W :=
    hΦ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by norm_num)
  have hΦd : ∀ p ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ p := fun p hp =>
    (hΦ.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp)
  have hΦ1d : ∀ p ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ Φ q) p := fun p hp =>
    (hΦ1.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp)
  
  have ht₁ : 0 < δ / 2 := half_pos hδ
  have hLW : Set.Icc (-(δ / 2)) (δ / 2) ×ˢ K ⊆ W := by
    rintro ⟨t, y⟩ ⟨ht, hy⟩
    exact hslab t (abs_le.2 ht) y hy
  have hc2 := (hΦ1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW le_rfl).mono hLW
  obtain ⟨M, hM'⟩ := isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.1
    ((isCompact_Icc.prod hK).image_of_continuousOn hc2).isBounded
  have hM : ∀ p ∈ Set.Icc (-(δ / 2)) (δ / 2) ×ˢ K,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ Φ q) p‖ ≤ M := fun p hp => hM' _ ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  have he₁n : ‖((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3))‖ = 1 := by simp [Prod.norm_def]
  
  have hderiv0 : ∀ y ∈ K,
      deriv (fun s => Φ (s, y)) 0 = fderiv ℝ Φ (0, y) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) :=
    fun y hy => (slice Φ 0 y (hΦd _ (hKW y hy))).deriv
  refine ⟨δ / 2, max M 0, ht₁, le_max_right _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hc : ContinuousOn (fun y : E3 => fderiv ℝ Φ ((0:ℝ), y)) K :=
      hΦ1c.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousOn (fun y hy => hKW y hy)
    exact (hc.clm_apply continuousOn_const).congr hderiv0
  
  · intro t ht y hy
    refine ⟨hslab t ht y hy, ?_⟩
    rw [hderiv0 y hy]
    refine taylor2 (fun s => Φ (s, y)) (fun s => fderiv ℝ Φ (s, y) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)))
      (fun s => fderiv ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ Φ q) (s, y) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)))
      (δ / 2) (max M 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ t ht
    · intro s hs
      exact slice Φ s y (hΦd _ (hLW ⟨hs, hy⟩))
    · intro s hs
      have h1 := slice (fun q => fderiv ℝ Φ q) s y (hΦ1d _ (hLW ⟨hs, hy⟩))
      have h2 := h1.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const s ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)))
      convert h2 using 1
      rw [map_zero, add_zero]
    · intro s hs
      have h1 := hM (s, y) ⟨hs, hy⟩
      calc |fderiv ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ Φ q) (s, y) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3))|
          = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ Φ q) (s, y) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3))
              ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3))‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ Φ q) (s, y)‖ * ‖((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3))‖ *
              ‖((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3))‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm₂ _ _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (fun q => fderiv ℝ Φ q) (s, y)‖ := by rw [he₁n]; ring
        _ ≤ M := h1
        _ ≤ max M 0 := le_max_left _ _

informal_problem.statement:
(G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j)) :
    IsOpen {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0} ∧
    (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E3 => christoffel (fun z => G z + p.1 • H z) k i j p.2)
      {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0}) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => G z + p.1 • H z) p.2)
      {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0}

signature.name: perturbed_curvature_contDiffOn
signature.statement:
(G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j)) :
    IsOpen {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0} ∧
    (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E3 => christoffel (fun z => G z + p.1 • H z) k i j p.2)
      {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0}) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => G z + p.1 • H z) p.2)
      {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0}

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hdetgen : ∀ (S : Set (ℝ × E3)) (F : ℝ × E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F z i j) S) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (F z).det) S := by
    intro S F hF
    simp only [Matrix.det_apply]
    refine ContDiffOn.sum (fun σ _ => ?_)
    simp only [Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
    refine contDiffOn_const.mul ?_
    have hp := contDiffOn_prod' (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)))
      (f := fun i z => F z (σ i) i) (s := S) (n := ∞) (fun i _ => hF _ _)
    refine hp.congr (fun z _ => ?_)
    simp [Finset.prod_apply]
  
  have hinvgen : ∀ (S : Set (ℝ × E3)) (F : ℝ × E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F z i j) S) →
      (∀ z ∈ S, (F z).det ≠ 0) →
      ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (F z)⁻¹ i j) S := by
    intro S F hF hdet i j
    have hadj : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (F z).adjugate i j) S := by
      simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
      refine hdetgen S (fun z => (F z).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1)) ?_
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = j
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hF a b
    have heq : (fun z => (F z)⁻¹ i j) =
        fun z => ((F z).det)⁻¹ * (F z).adjugate i j := by
      funext z
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact ((hdetgen S F hF).inv hdet).mul hadj
  
  have hD : ∀ (O : Set (ℝ × E3)), IsOpen O → ∀ F : ℝ × E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F O →
      ∀ v : ℝ × E3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => fderiv ℝ F p v) O := by
    intro O hO F hF v
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).mp hF).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdiff : ∀ (O : Set (ℝ × E3)), IsOpen O → ∀ F : ℝ × E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F O →
      ∀ p ∈ O, DifferentiableAt ℝ F p := by
    intro O hO F hF p hp
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).mp hF).1.differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
  
  have hslice : ∀ (F : ℝ × E3 → ℝ) (p : ℝ × E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ F p → ∀ c : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv c (fun z => F (p.1, z)) p.2 = fderiv ℝ F p ((0 : ℝ), e c) := by
    intro F p hF c
    obtain ⟨s, y⟩ := p
    have hι := hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right (𝕜 := ℝ) s y
    have hF' : HasFDerivAt F (fderiv ℝ F (s, y)) (s, y) := hF.hasFDerivAt
    have hcomp := hF'.comp y hι
    unfold partialDeriv
    have hfun : (fun z => F ((s, y).1, z)) = F ∘ (fun z => (s, z)) := rfl
    rw [hfun, hcomp.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply]
  
  have hVo : IsOpen {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} := hU.preimage continuous_snd
  have hM : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2) a b)
      {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} := by
    intro a b
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => G p.2 a b) {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} :=
      (hG a b).comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => p.1 * H p.2 a b) {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} :=
      (contDiff_fst.mul ((hH a b).comp contDiff_snd)).contDiffOn
    refine (h1.add h2).congr (fun p _ => ?_)
    simp [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hdetV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det)
      {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} :=
    hdetgen _ (fun p => G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2) hM
  have hWo : IsOpen {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0} := by
    have h := hdetV.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hVo (isOpen_compl_singleton (x := (0 : ℝ)))
    exact h
  set W := {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0} with hWdef
  have hWmem : ∀ p ∈ W, p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hWdef] at hp
    exact hp
  have hWV : ∀ p ∈ W, p ∈ {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} := fun p hp => (hWmem p hp).1
  have hinvW : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2)⁻¹ a b) W :=
    hinvgen W (fun p => G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2) (fun a b => (hM a b).mono hWV)
      (fun p hp => (hWmem p hp).2)
  have hparM : ∀ a b c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E3 => partialDeriv c (fun z => (G z + p.1 • H z) a b) p.2) W := by
    intro a b c
    refine ((hD _ hVo _ (hM a b) ((0 : ℝ), e c)).mono hWV).congr (fun p hp => ?_)
    exact hslice (fun q : ℝ × E3 => (G q.2 + q.1 • H q.2) a b) p
      (hdiff _ hVo _ (hM a b) p (hWV p hp)) c
  
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E3 => christoffel (fun z => G z + p.1 • H z) k i j p.2) W := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum (fun l _ =>
      (hinvW k l).mul (((hparM j l i).add (hparM i l j)).sub (hparM i j l))))
  have hparΓ : ∀ d a b c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E3 => partialDeriv d (christoffel (fun z => G z + p.1 • H z) a b c) p.2) W := by
    intro d a b c
    refine (hD _ hWo _ (hΓ a b c) ((0 : ℝ), e d)).congr (fun p hp => ?_)
    exact hslice (fun q : ℝ × E3 => christoffel (fun z => G z + q.1 • H z) a b c q.2) p
      (hdiff _ hWo _ (hΓ a b c) p hp) d
  
  have hRic : ∀ j k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E3 => ricci (fun z => G z + p.1 • H z) j k p.2) W := by
    intro j k
    unfold ricci
    refine (ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ?_)).add
      (ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun q _ =>
        ((hΓ i i q).mul (hΓ q j k)).sub ((hΓ i j q).mul (hΓ q i k)))))
    exact (hparΓ i i j k).sub (hparΓ j i i k)
  
  have hScal : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E3 => scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => G z + p.1 • H z) p.2) W := by
    unfold scalarCurvatureLocal
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hinvW j k).mul (hRic j k)))
  exact ⟨hWo, hΓ, hScal⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hGs : ∀ y i j, G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j)) (hHs : ∀ y i j, H y i j = H y j i) :
    ∀ y ∈ U, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => G z + s • H z) y)
      (fvScalarVar G H y) 0
