signature.statement:
(G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hGs : ∀ y i j, G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j)) (hHs : ∀ y i j, H y i j = H y j i) :
    ∀ y ∈ U, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => scalarCurvatureLocal (fun z => G z + s • H z) y)
      (fvScalarVar G H y) 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro y hy
  
  
  
  have L1 : ∀ (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), A.det ≠ 0 → ∀ k l : Fin 3,
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (A + s • B)⁻¹ k l)
        (-(∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k a * B a b * A⁻¹ b l)) 0 := by
    intro A B hA
    have hdetd : Differentiable ℝ (fun s : ℝ => (A + s • B).det) := by
      simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      fun_prop
    have hadjd : ∀ k l : Fin 3, Differentiable ℝ (fun s : ℝ => (A + s • B).adjugate k l) := by
      intro k l s
      fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l <;>
        simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three, Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;>
        fun_prop
    have hA0 : (A + (0 : ℝ) • B).det ≠ 0 := by simpa using hA
    have hQd : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s : ℝ => (A + s • B)⁻¹ k l) 0 := by
      intro k l
      have heq : (fun s : ℝ => (A + s • B)⁻¹ k l) =
          fun s => ((A + s • B).det)⁻¹ * (A + s • B).adjugate k l := by
        funext s
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [heq]
      exact ((hdetd 0).inv hA0).mul (hadjd k l 0)
    obtain ⟨D, hQ⟩ : ∃ D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∀ m l, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (A + s • B)⁻¹ m l) (D m l) 0 :=
      ⟨fun m l => deriv (fun s : ℝ => (A + s • B)⁻¹ m l) 0, fun m l => (hQd m l).hasDerivAt⟩
    have hev : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), (A + s • B).det ≠ 0 :=
      (hdetd 0).continuousAt.eventually_ne hA0
    have hkey : ∀ k l : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, (B k m * A⁻¹ m l + A k m * D m l) = 0 := by
      intro k l
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∑ m : Fin 3, (A k m + s * B k m) * (A + s • B)⁻¹ m l)
          (∑ m : Fin 3, (B k m * (A + (0 : ℝ) • B)⁻¹ m l + (A k m + 0 * B k m) * D m l)) 0 := by
        apply HasDerivAt.fun_sum
        intro m _
        exact ((hasDerivAt_mul_const (B k m)).const_add (A k m)).fun_mul (hQ m l)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∑ m : Fin 3, (A k m + s * B k m) * (A + s • B)⁻¹ m l)
          0 0 := by
        apply (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) ((1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) k l)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        filter_upwards [hev] with s hs
        have h4 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (A + s • B) hs.isUnit
        have h3 := congrFun (congrFun h4 k) l
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply] at h3
        simpa [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using h3
      have h5 := h1.unique h2
      simpa using h5
    have hmat : B * A⁻¹ + A * Matrix.of D = 0 := by
      ext k l
      simpa [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib] using hkey k l
    have hDm : Matrix.of D = -(A⁻¹ * B * A⁻¹) := by
      have h1 : A * Matrix.of D = -(B * A⁻¹) := by
        rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm]; exact hmat
      calc Matrix.of D = A⁻¹ * (A * Matrix.of D) :=
            (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul_cancel_left A (Matrix.of D) hA.isUnit).symm
        _ = -(A⁻¹ * B * A⁻¹) := by rw [h1, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    intro k l
    refine (hQ k l).congr_deriv ?_
    have h2 := congrFun (congrFun hDm k) l
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply] at h2
    rw [h2]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  
  
  have L2 : ∀ y' : E3, (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y') →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => H z a b) y') → (G y').det ≠ 0 →
      ∀ k i j : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => christoffel (fun z => G z + s • H z) k i j y')
        (fvChristoffelVar G H k i j y') 0 := by
    intro y' hGd hHd hdet k i j
    have hpd : ∀ (s : ℝ) (c a b : Fin 3), partialDeriv c (fun z => (G z + s • H z) a b) y' =
        partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y' + s * partialDeriv c (fun z => H z a b) y' := by
      intro s c a b
      have hf : (fun z => (G z + s • H z) a b) = fun z => G z a b + s * H z a b := by
        funext z; simp [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      unfold partialDeriv
      have hsum : HasFDerivAt (fun z => G z a b + s * H z a b)
          (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y' + s • fderiv ℝ (fun z => H z a b) y') y' :=
        (hGd a b).hasFDerivAt.add ((hHd a b).hasFDerivAt.const_mul s)
      rw [hf, hsum.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hform : (fun s : ℝ => christoffel (fun z => G z + s • H z) k i j y') =
        fun s => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y' + s • H y')⁻¹ k l *
          ((partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y' + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y'
              - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y') +
           s * (partialDeriv i (fun z => H z j l) y' + partialDeriv j (fun z => H z i l) y'
              - partialDeriv l (fun z => H z i j) y')) := by
      funext s
      unfold christoffel
      simp only [hpd]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)
      ring
    rw [hform]
    have hlin : ∀ (a b : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => a + s * b) b 0 :=
      fun a b => (hasDerivAt_mul_const b).const_add a
    refine ((HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun l _ =>
        (L1 (G y') (H y') hdet k l).fun_mul (hlin _ _))).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)).congr_deriv ?_
    simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, zero_mul]
    unfold fvChristoffelVar christoffel
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  
  
  have hdetgen : ∀ (S : Set (ℝ × E3)) (F : ℝ × E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F z i j) S) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (F z).det) S := by
    intro S F hF
    simp only [Matrix.det_apply]
    refine ContDiffOn.sum (fun σ _ => ?_)
    simp only [Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
    refine contDiffOn_const.mul ?_
    have hp := contDiffOn_prod' (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)))
      (f := fun i z => F z (σ i) i) (s := S) (n := ∞) (fun i _ => hF _ _)
    refine hp.congr (fun z _ => ?_)
    simp [Finset.prod_apply]
  have hinvgen : ∀ (S : Set (ℝ × E3)) (F : ℝ × E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F z i j) S) →
      (∀ z ∈ S, (F z).det ≠ 0) →
      ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (F z)⁻¹ i j) S := by
    intro S F hF hdet i j
    have hadj : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (F z).adjugate i j) S := by
      simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
      refine hdetgen S (fun z => (F z).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1)) ?_
      intro a b
      by_cases hab : a = j
      · subst hab
        simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
        exact contDiffOn_const
      · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
        exact hF a b
    have heq : (fun z => (F z)⁻¹ i j) =
        fun z => ((F z).det)⁻¹ * (F z).adjugate i j := by
      funext z
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact ((hdetgen S F hF).inv hdet).mul hadj
  have hDv : ∀ (O : Set (ℝ × E3)), IsOpen O → ∀ F : ℝ × E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F O →
      ∀ v : ℝ × E3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p => fderiv ℝ F p v) O := by
    intro O hO F hF v
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).mp hF).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdiff : ∀ (O : Set (ℝ × E3)), IsOpen O → ∀ F : ℝ × E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F O →
      ∀ p ∈ O, DifferentiableAt ℝ F p := by
    intro O hO F hF p hp
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hO).mp hF).1.differentiableAt (hO.mem_nhds hp)
  have hslice : ∀ (F : ℝ × E3 → ℝ) (p : ℝ × E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ F p → ∀ c : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv c (fun z => F (p.1, z)) p.2 = fderiv ℝ F p ((0 : ℝ), e c) := by
    intro F p hF c
    obtain ⟨s, y⟩ := p
    have hι := hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right (𝕜 := ℝ) s y
    have hF' : HasFDerivAt F (fderiv ℝ F (s, y)) (s, y) := hF.hasFDerivAt
    have hcomp := hF'.comp y hι
    unfold partialDeriv
    have hfun : (fun z => F ((s, y).1, z)) = F ∘ (fun z => (s, z)) := rfl
    rw [hfun, hcomp.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.inr_apply]
  have hVo : IsOpen {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} := hU.preimage continuous_snd
  have hM : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2) a b)
      {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} := by
    intro a b
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => G p.2 a b) {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} :=
      (hG a b).comp contDiff_snd.contDiffOn (fun p hp => hp)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => p.1 * H p.2 a b) {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} :=
      (contDiff_fst.mul ((hH a b).comp contDiff_snd)).contDiffOn
    refine (h1.add h2).congr (fun p _ => ?_)
    simp [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hdetV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det)
      {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} :=
    hdetgen _ (fun p => G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2) hM
  have hWo : IsOpen {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0} := by
    have h := hdetV.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hVo (isOpen_compl_singleton (x := (0 : ℝ)))
    exact h
  set W := {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0} with hWdef
  have hWmem : ∀ p ∈ W, p.2 ∈ U ∧ (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hWdef] at hp
    exact hp
  have hWV : ∀ p ∈ W, p ∈ {p : ℝ × E3 | p.2 ∈ U} := fun p hp => (hWmem p hp).1
  have hinvW : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E3 => (G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2)⁻¹ a b) W :=
    hinvgen W (fun p => G p.2 + p.1 • H p.2) (fun a b => (hM a b).mono hWV)
      (fun p hp => (hWmem p hp).2)
  have hparM : ∀ a b c : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E3 => partialDeriv c (fun z => (G z + p.1 • H z) a b) p.2) W := by
    intro a b c
    refine ((hDv _ hVo _ (hM a b) ((0 : ℝ), e c)).mono hWV).congr (fun p hp => ?_)
    exact hslice (fun q : ℝ × E3 => (G q.2 + q.1 • H q.2) a b) p
      (hdiff _ hVo _ (hM a b) p (hWV p hp)) c
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E3 => christoffel (fun z => G z + p.1 • H z) k i j p.2) W := by
    intro k i j
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum (fun l _ =>
      (hinvW k l).mul (((hparM j l i).add (hparM i l j)).sub (hparM i j l))))
  
  
  
  have hdetU : ∀ y' ∈ U, (G y').det ≠ 0 := fun y' hy' => (hGpos y' hy').ne'
  have hGdU : ∀ y' ∈ U, ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y' :=
    fun y' hy' a b => ((hG a b).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy')).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hHd : ∀ (y' : E3) (a b : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => H z a b) y' :=
    fun y' a b => ((hH a b).differentiable (by simp)) y'
  have h0W : ∀ y' ∈ U, ((0 : ℝ), y') ∈ W := by
    intro y' hy'
    rw [hWdef]
    show y' ∈ U ∧ (G y' + (0 : ℝ) • H y').det ≠ 0
    exact ⟨hy', by simpa using hdetU y' hy'⟩
  
  
  
  have L3 : ∀ m k i j : Fin 3, HasDerivAt
      (fun s : ℝ => partialDeriv m (christoffel (fun z => G z + s • H z) k i j) y)
      (partialDeriv m (fvChristoffelVar G H k i j) y) 0 := by
    intro m k i j
    set F : ℝ × E3 → ℝ := fun p => christoffel (fun z => G z + p.1 • H z) k i j p.2 with hFdef
    have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W := hΓ k i j
    have hFat : ∀ p ∈ W, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F p := fun p hp => hFs.contDiffAt (hWo.mem_nhds hp)
    have hFd : ∀ p ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ F p :=
      fun p hp => (hFat p hp).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have p0 : ((0 : ℝ), y) ∈ W := h0W y hy
    have hDF : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) ((0 : ℝ), y) :=
      (hFat _ p0).fderiv_right (m := ∞) le_rfl
    obtain ⟨D2, hD2h⟩ : ∃ D2, HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ F) D2 ((0 : ℝ), y) :=
      ⟨_, (hDF.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt⟩
    
    have hslice' : ∀ (s : ℝ) (y' : E3), (s, y') ∈ W →
        partialDeriv m (christoffel (fun z => G z + s • H z) k i j) y' =
          fderiv ℝ F (s, y') ((0 : ℝ), e m) :=
      fun s y' hp => hslice F (s, y') (hFd _ hp) m
    
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s, y)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) 0 :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' (0 : ℝ)).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) y)
    have hL1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ F (s, y)) (D2 ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3))) 0 :=
      hD2h.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hc
    have hL2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => fderiv ℝ F (s, y) ((0 : ℝ), e m))
        (D2 ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) ((0 : ℝ), e m)) 0 :=
      (hL1.clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) ((0 : ℝ), e m))).congr_deriv (by simp)
    have hopen : {s : ℝ | (s, y) ∈ W} ∈ 𝓝 (0 : ℝ) := by
      have hcont : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => (s, y)) := continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const
      exact hcont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hWo.mem_nhds p0)
    have hLHS : HasDerivAt
        (fun s : ℝ => partialDeriv m (christoffel (fun z => G z + s • H z) k i j) y)
        (D2 ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) ((0 : ℝ), e m)) 0 := by
      refine hL2.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hopen] with s hs
      exact hslice' s y hs
    
    have hfvEq : ∀ y' ∈ U,
        fvChristoffelVar G H k i j y' = fderiv ℝ F ((0 : ℝ), y') ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) := by
      intro y' hy'
      have hcy : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s, y')) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) 0 :=
        (hasDerivAt_id' (0 : ℝ)).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) y')
      have hFh : HasFDerivAt F (fderiv ℝ F ((0 : ℝ), y')) ((0 : ℝ), y') :=
        (hFd _ (h0W y' hy')).hasFDerivAt
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (s, y'))
          (fderiv ℝ F ((0 : ℝ), y') ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3))) 0 :=
        HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt (l := F) (f := fun s : ℝ => (s, y')) (0 : ℝ) hFh hcy
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => F (s, y')) (fvChristoffelVar G H k i j y') 0 :=
        L2 y' (hGdU y' hy') (hHd y') (hdetU y' hy') k i j
      exact h2.unique h1
    have hRHS : partialDeriv m (fvChristoffelVar G H k i j) y =
        D2 ((0 : ℝ), e m) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) := by
      have hc1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y' : E3 => fderiv ℝ F ((0 : ℝ), y'))
          (D2.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E3)) y :=
        hD2h.comp y (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right (0 : ℝ) y)
      have hc2 := hc1.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) y)
      have hev : fvChristoffelVar G H k i j =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          (fun y' => fderiv ℝ F ((0 : ℝ), y') ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3))) := by
        filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hy] with y' hy'
        exact hfvEq y' hy'
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hc2.fderiv]
      simp
    
    have hsymm : IsSymmSndFDerivAt ℝ F ((0 : ℝ), y) :=
      (hFat _ p0).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
        rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
    have hsw : D2 ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) ((0 : ℝ), e m) = D2 ((0 : ℝ), e m) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : E3)) := by
      rw [← hD2h.fderiv]
      exact hsymm _ _
    rw [hRHS, ← hsw]
    exact hLHS
  
  
  
  have hdet : (G y).det ≠ 0 := hdetU y hy
  have L2y := L2 y (hGdU y hy) (hHd y) hdet
  have h0 : (fun z => G z + (0 : ℝ) • H z) = G := by funext z; simp
  have L5 : ∀ j k : Fin 3, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ricci (fun z => G z + s • H z) j k y)
      (fvRicciVar G H j k y) 0 := by
    intro j k
    unfold ricci
    have hd := (HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
        (fun i _ => (L3 i i j k).sub (L3 j i i k))).add
      (HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
        (fun p _ => ((L2y i i p).fun_mul (L2y p j k)).sub ((L2y i j p).fun_mul (L2y p i k)))))
    refine hd.congr_deriv ?_
    rw [h0]
    unfold fvRicciVar
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  unfold scalarCurvatureLocal
  have hd := HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => HasDerivAt.fun_sum
    (u := Finset.univ) (fun k _ => (L1 (G y) (H y) hdet j k).fun_mul (L5 j k)))
  refine hd.congr_deriv ?_
  rw [h0]
  simp only [zero_smul, add_zero]
  unfold fvScalarVar
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ)
    (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hGs : ∀ y i j, G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j)) (hHs : ∀ y i j, H y i j = H y j i)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) :
    ∀ y ∈ U, f y * fvScalarVar G H y * Real.sqrt (G y).det =
      -((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
          (G y)⁻¹ a c * (G y)⁻¹ b d * H y a b * staticLoc G f c d y) * Real.sqrt (G y).det)
      + ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fvField G H f i) y

signature.name: first_variation_divergence_pointwise
signature.statement:
(G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ)
    (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hGs : ∀ y i j, G y i j = G y j i) (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j)) (hHs : ∀ y i j, H y i j = H y j i)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) :
    ∀ y ∈ U, f y * fvScalarVar G H y * Real.sqrt (G y).det =
      -((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
          (G y)⁻¹ a c * (G y)⁻¹ b d * H y a b * staticLoc G f c d y) * Real.sqrt (G y).det)
      + ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fvField G H f i) y

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y hy
  have hyU : U ∈ 𝓝 y := hU.mem_nhds hy
  have hdet : 0 < (G y).det := hGpos y hy
  have hdet0 : (G y).det ≠ 0 := hdet.ne'
  have hGd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y :=
    fun a b => ((hG a b).contDiffAt hyU).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hdetD : ∀ K : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => K z a b) y) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (K z).det) y := by
    intro K hK
    have hfun : (fun z => (K z).det) = fun z =>
        K z 0 0 * K z 1 1 * K z 2 2 - K z 0 0 * K z 1 2 * K z 2 1
        - K z 0 1 * K z 1 0 * K z 2 2 + K z 0 1 * K z 1 2 * K z 2 0
        + K z 0 2 * K z 1 0 * K z 2 1 - K z 0 2 * K z 1 1 * K z 2 0 := by
      funext z; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (K z)
    rw [hfun]
    have h00 := hK 0 0
    have h01 := hK 0 1
    have h02 := hK 0 2
    have h10 := hK 1 0
    have h11 := hK 1 1
    have h12 := hK 1 2
    have h20 := hK 2 0
    have h21 := hK 2 1
    have h22 := hK 2 2
    fun_prop
  have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z).det) y := hdetD G hGd
  have hPd : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y := by
    intro k l
    have hfun : (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) =
        fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹ * ((G z).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det := by
      funext z
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
        smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hfun]
    refine (hD.inv hdet0).mul (hdetD _ ?_)
    intro a b
    by_cases hal : a = l
    · subst hal
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
      exact differentiableAt_const _
    · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hal]
      exact hGd a b
  
  have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, (G z).det ≠ 0 := hD.continuousAt.eventually_ne hdet0
  have hinv : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) y =
      -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y * (G y)⁻¹ b l := by
    intro m
    have hE : ∀ a l : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ b l) y
        + ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y * (G y)⁻¹ b l = 0 := by
      intro a l
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * (G z)⁻¹ b l)
          (∑ b : Fin 3, (G y a b • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ b l) y
            + (G y)⁻¹ b l • fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b) y)) y := by
        have hs := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
          (A := fun b z => G z a b * (G z)⁻¹ b l)
          (fun b _ => (hGd a b).hasFDerivAt.mul (hPd b l).hasFDerivAt)
        convert hs using 1
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∑ b : Fin 3, G z a b * (G z)⁻¹ b l)
          (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y := by
        apply (hasFDerivAt_const (if a = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) y).congr_of_eventuallyEq
        filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
        have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G z) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hz)) a) l
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
        exact this
      have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e m)) (h1.unique h2)
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h3
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [← h3, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      ring
    intro k l
    let X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun b l => partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ b l) y
    let DM : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
      Matrix.of fun a b => partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y
    have hM : G y * X = -(DM * (G y)⁻¹) := by
      ext a l'
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
      simp only [X, DM, Matrix.of_apply]
      exact hE a l'
    have hX : X = -((G y)⁻¹ * (DM * (G y)⁻¹)) := by
      calc X = ((G y)⁻¹ * G y) * X := by
            rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet0), Matrix.one_mul]
        _ = (G y)⁻¹ * (G y * X) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [hM, Matrix.mul_neg]
    have hkl := congrFun (congrFun hX k) l
    simp only [X, DM, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply] at hkl
    rw [hkl]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro b _
    ring
  
  have hsd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y := hD.sqrt hdet0
  have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f y := (hf.contDiffAt hyU).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hdfd : ∀ j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv j f) y := by
    intro j
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) U := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e j)) U := h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h2.contDiffAt hyU).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hDGd : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b)) y := by
    intro m a b
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b)) U :=
      (hG a b).fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z a b) z (e m)) U :=
      h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h2.contDiffAt hyU).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hHd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => H z a b) y :=
    fun a b => (hH a b).differentiable (by simp) y
  have hdHd : ∀ m a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv m (fun z => H z a b)) y := by
    intro m a b
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun z => H z a b)) := (hH a b).fderiv_right (by simp)
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ (fun z => H z a b) z (e m)) :=
      h1.clm_apply contDiff_const
    exact h2.differentiable (by simp) y
  have hΓd : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (christoffel G k i j) y := by
    intro k i j
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k l *
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) z + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) z
        - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) z)) y
    exact (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun l _ => (hPd k l).fun_mul
      (((hDGd i j l).fun_add (hDGd j i l)).fun_sub (hDGd l i j))).const_mul _
  have hAd : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fvChristoffelVar G H k i j) y := by
    intro k i j
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k l *
      (partialDeriv i (fun z => H z j l) z + partialDeriv j (fun z => H z i l) z
        - partialDeriv l (fun z => H z i j) z)
      - ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ k a * H z a b * christoffel G b i j z) y
    exact ((DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun l _ => (hPd k l).fun_mul
      (((hdHd i j l).fun_add (hdHd j i l)).fun_sub (hdHd l i j))).const_mul _).fun_sub
      (DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun a _ => DifferentiableAt.fun_sum fun b _ =>
        ((hPd k a).fun_mul (hHd a b)).fun_mul (hΓd b i j))
  
  have hGT : (G y).transpose = G y := by
    ext a b
    exact hGs y b a
  have hPs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b = (G y)⁻¹ b a := by
    intro a b
    have h := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv (G y)) b) a
    rw [hGT, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h
    exact h
  have hDs : ∀ m a b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y = partialDeriv m (fun z => G z b a) y := by
    intro m a b
    rw [show (fun z => G z a b) = (fun z => G z b a) from funext fun z => hGs z a b]
  have hdHs : ∀ m a b : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv m (fun z => H z a b) y = partialDeriv m (fun z => H z b a) y := by
    intro m a b
    rw [show (fun z => H z a b) = (fun z => H z b a) from funext fun z => hHs z a b]
  have hΓs : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, christoffel G k i j y = christoffel G k j i y := by
    intro k i j
    have hij : (fun z => G z j i) = fun z => G z i j := funext fun z => hGs z j i
    rw [christoffel, christoffel, hij]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    ring
  have hGP : ∀ b c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ b d * G y d c = if b = c then 1 else 0 := by
    intro b c
    have h := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (G y) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet0)) b) c
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h
    exact h
  have hPadj : ∀ a b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b = ((G y).det)⁻¹ * (G y).adjugate a b := by
    intro a b
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have calg : ∀ (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, P a b = P b a) → (∀ m a b : Fin 3, D m a b = D m b a) →
      (∀ m : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, P a l * (D a m l + D m a l - D l a m) =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P b a * D m a b) ∧
      ∀ m k l : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P k a * D m a b * P b l =
        ∑ b : Fin 3, (((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ q : Fin 3, P k q * (D b m q + D m b q - D q b m)) * P b l +
          P k b * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ q : Fin 3, P l q * (D b m q + D m b q - D q b m))) := by
    intro P D hP hD
    obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ : ∃ Q : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, P = fun a b => Q a b + Q b a :=
      ⟨fun a b => P a b / 2, by funext a b; show P a b = P a b / 2 + P b a / 2; rw [hP a b]; ring⟩
    obtain ⟨E, rfl⟩ : ∃ E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, D = fun m a b => E m a b + E m b a :=
      ⟨fun m a b => D m a b / 2, by
        funext m a b; show D m a b = D m a b / 2 + D m b a / 2; rw [hD m a b]; ring⟩
    refine ⟨fun m => ?_, fun m k l => ?_⟩ <;> simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring
  
  have hdP : ∀ m j k : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ j k) y =
      -∑ b : Fin 3, (christoffel G j b m y * (G y)⁻¹ b k + (G y)⁻¹ j b * christoffel G k b m y) := by
    intro m j k
    have h2 : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ j a * partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y * (G y)⁻¹ b k =
        ∑ b : Fin 3, (christoffel G j b m y * (G y)⁻¹ b k + (G y)⁻¹ j b * christoffel G k b m y) :=
      (calg (fun a b => (G y)⁻¹ a b) (fun m a b => partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y) hPs hDs).2 m j k
    rw [hinv m j k, h2]
  
  have hJac : ∀ m : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y =
      Real.sqrt (G y).det * ∑ a : Fin 3, christoffel G a a m y := by
    intro m
    have h00 := (hGd 0 0).hasFDerivAt
    have h01 := (hGd 0 1).hasFDerivAt
    have h02 := (hGd 0 2).hasFDerivAt
    have h10 := (hGd 1 0).hasFDerivAt
    have h11 := (hGd 1 1).hasFDerivAt
    have h12 := (hGd 1 2).hasFDerivAt
    have h20 := (hGd 2 0).hasFDerivAt
    have h21 := (hGd 2 1).hasFDerivAt
    have h22 := (hGd 2 2).hasFDerivAt
    have hpoly := ((((((h00.fun_mul h11).fun_mul h22).fun_sub ((h00.fun_mul h12).fun_mul h21)).fun_sub
      ((h01.fun_mul h10).fun_mul h22)).fun_add ((h01.fun_mul h12).fun_mul h20)).fun_add
      ((h02.fun_mul h10).fun_mul h21)).fun_sub ((h02.fun_mul h11).fun_mul h20)
    have hdetF := hpoly.congr_of_eventuallyEq (f₁ := fun z => (G z).det)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => Matrix.det_fin_three (G z))
    have hsq := hdetF.sqrt hdet0
    have hc : ∑ a : Fin 3, christoffel G a a m y =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ b a * partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y :=
      (calg (fun a b => (G y)⁻¹ a b) (fun m a b => partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) y) hPs hDs).1 m
    rw [hc]
    simp only [hPadj]
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hsq.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hs0 : Real.sqrt (G y).det ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hdet).ne'
    have hsq2 : Real.sqrt (G y).det ^ 2 = (G y).det := Real.sq_sqrt hdet.le
    generalize Real.sqrt (G y).det = s at hs0 hsq2 ⊢
    rw [← hsq2]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.adjugate_fin_three, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val',
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.empty_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Matrix.vecHead,
      Matrix.vecTail, Function.comp_apply, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_one_eq_two,
      Matrix.cons_val_succ]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have leib : ∀ (s F : E3 → ℝ) (P Hf : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
      (A : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (dF : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ s y → DifferentiableAt ℝ F y → (∀ a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (P a b) y) →
      (∀ a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (Hf a b) y) → (∀ k a b, DifferentiableAt ℝ (A k a b) y) →
      (∀ j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (dF j) y) →
      partialDeriv i (fun z => s z *
          (F z * (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k z * A i j k z
                - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P i j z * A k k j z)
            - ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P i a z * Hf a b z * P b j z
                - P i j z * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b z * Hf a b z) * dF j z)) y =
        partialDeriv i s y *
            (F y * (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k y * A i j k y
                    - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P i j y * A k k j y)
              - ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P i a y * Hf a b y * P b j y
                    - P i j y * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b y * Hf a b y) * dF j y)
          + s y *
            (partialDeriv i F y * (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k y * A i j k y
                    - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P i j y * A k k j y)
              + F y * (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (P j k) y * A i j k y
                        + P j k y * partialDeriv i (A i j k) y)
                    - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (P i j) y * A k k j y
                        + P i j y * partialDeriv i (A k k j) y))
              - ∑ j : Fin 3,
                  ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
                      (partialDeriv i (P i a) y * Hf a b y * P b j y
                        + P i a y * partialDeriv i (Hf a b) y * P b j y
                        + P i a y * Hf a b y * partialDeriv i (P b j) y)
                    - (partialDeriv i (P i j) y * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b y * Hf a b y
                        + P i j y * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
                          (partialDeriv i (P a b) y * Hf a b y
                            + P a b y * partialDeriv i (Hf a b) y)))
                    * dF j y
                  + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P i a y * Hf a b y * P b j y
                      - P i j y * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b y * Hf a b y)
                    * partialDeriv i (dF j) y)) := by
    intro s F P Hf A dF i hs hF hP hHf hA hdF
    have h := hs.hasFDerivAt.fun_mul
      ((hF.hasFDerivAt.fun_mul
        ((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun (j : Fin 3) _ =>
            HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun (k : Fin 3) _ =>
              (hP j k).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul (hA i j k).hasFDerivAt).fun_sub
          (HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun (j : Fin 3) _ =>
            HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun (k : Fin 3) _ =>
              (hP i j).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul (hA k k j).hasFDerivAt))).fun_sub
        (HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun (j : Fin 3) _ =>
          ((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun (a : Fin 3) _ =>
              HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun (b : Fin 3) _ =>
                ((hP i a).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul (hHf a b).hasFDerivAt).fun_mul
                  (hP b j).hasFDerivAt).fun_sub
            ((hP i j).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul
              (HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun (a : Fin 3) _ =>
                HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun (b : Fin 3) _ =>
                  (hP a b).hasFDerivAt.fun_mul (hHf a b).hasFDerivAt))).fun_mul
            (hdF j).hasFDerivAt))
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [h.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  have master : ∀ (P Hm Gm Ric hess ddf : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (Γ A dP dH : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (dA : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (sg f0 lap : ℝ) (dsg df L : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, P a b = P b a) → (∀ a b : Fin 3, Hm a b = Hm b a) →
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, Γ k i j = Γ k j i) → (∀ m a b : Fin 3, dH m a b = dH m b a) →
      (∀ m : Fin 3, dsg m = sg * ∑ a : Fin 3, Γ a a m) →
      (∀ m j k : Fin 3, dP m j k = -∑ b : Fin 3, (Γ j b m * P b k + P j b * Γ k b m)) →
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, A k i j = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, P k l * (dH i j l + dH j i l - dH l i j)
        - ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P k a * Hm a b * Γ b i j) →
      (∀ a b : Fin 3, Gm a b = Gm b a) →
      (∀ b c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, P b d * Gm d c = if b = c then 1 else 0) →
      (∀ c d : Fin 3, hess c d = ddf c d - ∑ k : Fin 3, Γ k c d * df k) →
      (lap = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, P i j * hess i j) →
      (∀ i : Fin 3, L i =
        dsg i *
            (f0 * (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k * A i j k
                    - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P i j * A k k j)
              - ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P i a * Hm a b * P b j
                    - P i j * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b * Hm a b) * df j)
          + sg *
            (df i * (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k * A i j k
                    - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P i j * A k k j)
              + f0 * (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (dP i j k * A i j k + P j k * dA i i j k)
                    - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (dP i i j * A k k j + P i j * dA i k k j))
              - ∑ j : Fin 3,
                  ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
                      (dP i i a * Hm a b * P b j + P i a * dH i a b * P b j
                        + P i a * Hm a b * dP i b j)
                    - (dP i i j * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b * Hm a b
                        + P i j * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (dP i a b * Hm a b + P a b * dH i a b)))
                    * df j
                  + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P i a * Hm a b * P b j
                      - P i j * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b * Hm a b) * ddf i j))) →
      f0 * (- ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3,
              (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P j a * Hm a b * P b k) * Ric j k
            + ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k *
              (∑ i : Fin 3, (dA i i j k - dA j i i k)
                + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3,
                    (A i i p * Γ p j k + Γ i i p * A p j k - A i j p * Γ p i k - Γ i j p * A p i k)))
          * sg =
        -((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
            P a c * P b d * Hm a b * (f0 * Ric c d - hess c d + lap * Gm c d)) * sg)
        + ∑ i : Fin 3, L i := by
    intro P Hm Gm Ric hess ddf Γ A dP dH dA sg f0 lap dsg df L hP hH hΓ hdH hsg hdP' hA hGm hGP'
      hhess hlap hL
    have p10 := hP 1 0
    have p20 := hP 2 0
    have p21 := hP 2 1
    have h10 := hH 1 0
    have h20 := hH 2 0
    have h21 := hH 2 1
    have g10 : ∀ k, Γ k 1 0 = Γ k 0 1 := fun k => hΓ k 1 0
    have g20 : ∀ k, Γ k 2 0 = Γ k 0 2 := fun k => hΓ k 2 0
    have g21 : ∀ k, Γ k 2 1 = Γ k 1 2 := fun k => hΓ k 2 1
    have e10 : ∀ k, dH k 1 0 = dH k 0 1 := fun k => hdH k 1 0
    have e20 : ∀ k, dH k 2 0 = dH k 0 2 := fun k => hdH k 2 0
    have e21 : ∀ k, dH k 2 1 = dH k 1 2 := fun k => hdH k 2 1
    
    have hPal : sg * ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k *
          (∑ i : Fin 3, (dA i i j k - dA j i i k) +
            ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3, (A i i p * Γ p j k + Γ i i p * A p j k
              - A i j p * Γ p i k - Γ i j p * A p i k)) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, (dsg i * (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k * A i j k
              - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P i j * A k k j)
          + sg * ((∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (dP i j k * A i j k + P j k * dA i i j k))
              - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (dP i i j * A k k j + P i j * dA i k k j))) := by
      simp only [hsg, hdP']
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, g10, g20, g21]
      ring
    
    have hHess : ∑ i : Fin 3, (-(dsg i * ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
              P i a * Hm a b * P b j
            - P i j * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b * Hm a b) * df j)
        + sg * (df i * (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P j k * A i j k
              - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, P i j * A k k j)
          - ∑ j : Fin 3, ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (dP i i a * Hm a b * P b j
                  + P i a * dH i a b * P b j + P i a * Hm a b * dP i b j)
                - (dP i i j * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b * Hm a b
                  + P i j * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (dP i a b * Hm a b + P a b * dH i a b)))
                * df j
              + (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P i a * Hm a b * P b j
                  - P i j * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b * Hm a b) * ddf i j))) =
        -(sg * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
              P a c * P b d * Hm a b * hess c d
            - lap * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b * Hm a b)) := by
      simp only [hlap, hhess]
      simp only [hsg, hdP', hA]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, p10, p20, p21, h10, h20, h21, g10, g20, g21, e10, e20, e21]
      ring
    
    have hXT : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
          P a c * P b d * Hm a b * Ric c d =
        ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P j a * Hm a b * P b k) * Ric j k := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, p10, p20, p21]
      ring
    
    have hTG : ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3,
          P a c * P b d * Hm a b * Gm c d =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, P a b * Hm a b := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      have h1 : ∑ c : Fin 3, ∑ d : Fin 3, P a c * P b d * Hm a b * Gm c d =
          ∑ c : Fin 3, P a c * Hm a b * ∑ d : Fin 3, P b d * Gm d c := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
        rw [hGm c d]
        ring
      rw [h1]
      simp only [hGP', mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    simp only [hL]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hPal hHess hXT hTG ⊢
    linear_combination f0 * hPal + f0 * sg * hXT + sg * lap * hTG - hHess
  exact master (fun a b => (G y)⁻¹ a b) (fun a b => H y a b) (fun a b => G y a b) (fun j k => ricci G j k y) (fun c d => hessLoc G f c d y)
    (fun i j => partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j f) y) (fun k i j => christoffel G k i j y)
    (fun k i j => fvChristoffelVar G H k i j y)
    (fun m a b => partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) y)
    (fun m a b => partialDeriv m (fun z => H z a b) y)
    (fun m k i j => partialDeriv m (fvChristoffelVar G H k i j) y)
    (Real.sqrt (G y).det) (f y) (lapLoc G f y)
    (fun m => partialDeriv m (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) y) (fun k => partialDeriv k f y)
    (fun i => partialDeriv i (fvField G H f i) y)
    hPs (hHs y) hΓs hdHs hJac hdP (fun k i j => rfl) (hGs y) hGP (fun c d => rfl) rfl
    (fun i => leib (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) f (fun a b z => (G z)⁻¹ a b)
      (fun a b z => H z a b) (fvChristoffelVar G H) (fun j => partialDeriv j f) i
      hsd hfd hPd hHd hAd hdfd)

informal_problem.statement:
(U K : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKU : K ⊆ U) (Y : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hY : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Y i) U)
    (hY0 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ y ∈ U, y ∉ K → Y i y = 0) :
    ∫ y in K, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (Y i) y = 0

signature.name: divergence_setIntegral_eq_zero
signature.statement:
(U K : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKU : K ⊆ U) (Y : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hY : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Y i) U)
    (hY0 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ y ∈ U, y ∉ K → Y i y = 0) :
    ∫ y in K, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (Y i) y = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set Z : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ := fun i y => if y ∈ K then Y i y else 0 with hZdef
  have hKc : IsOpen Kᶜ := hK.isClosed.isOpen_compl
  have s1a : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ U, Z i y = Y i y := by
    intro i y hy
    by_cases hyK : y ∈ K
    · simp [hZdef, hyK]
    · simp [hZdef, hyK, hY0 i y hy hyK]
  have s1b : ∀ i, ∀ y, y ∉ K → Z i y = 0 := by
    intro i y hy
    simp [hZdef, hy]
  have s2a : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ U, Z i =ᶠ[nhds y] Y i := fun i y hy =>
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => s1a i z hz)
  have s2b : ∀ i, ∀ y, y ∉ K → Z i =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := fun i y hy =>
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hKc.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => s1b i z hz)
  have s3 : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Z i) := by
    intro i
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ U
    · exact ((hY i).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (s2a i y hy)
    · have hyK : y ∉ K := fun h => hy (hKU h)
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (s2b i y hyK)
  have s4a : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ K, partialDeriv i (Y i) y = partialDeriv i (Z i) y := by
    intro i y hy
    show fderiv ℝ (Y i) y (e i) = fderiv ℝ (Z i) y (e i)
    rw [(s2a i y (hKU hy)).symm.fderiv_eq]
  have s4b : ∀ i, ∀ y, y ∉ K → partialDeriv i (Z i) y = 0 := by
    intro i y hy
    show fderiv ℝ (Z i) y (e i) = 0
    rw [(s2b i y hy).fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.measurableSet
  have s5 : ∫ y in K, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (Y i) y =
      ∫ y in K, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (Z i) y := by
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hKm fun y hy => ?_
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => s4a i y hy
  have s6 : ∫ y in K, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (Z i) y =
      ∫ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (Z i) y := by
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero fun y hy => ?_
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => s4b i y hy
  have hZc : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (Z i) := fun i => HasCompactSupport.intro hK (s1b i)
  have hdZcont : ∀ i, Continuous (fun y => fderiv ℝ (Z i) y (e i)) := fun i =>
    ((s3 i).continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hdZint : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => fderiv ℝ (Z i) y (e i)) := fun i =>
    (hdZcont i).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport ((hZc i).fderiv_apply ℝ (e i))
  have hZint : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.Integrable (Z i) := fun i =>
    (s3 i).continuous.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hZc i)
  have s8 : ∫ y, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (Z i) y =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∫ y, partialDeriv i (Z i) y :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ fun i _ => hdZint i
  have s9 : ∀ i, ∫ y, partialDeriv i (Z i) y = 0 := by
    intro i
    have h := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (f := fun _ : E3 => (1 : ℝ)) (g := Z i) (v := e i)
      (by simp) (by simpa using hdZint i) (by simpa using hZint i)
      (differentiable_const _) ((s3 i).differentiable one_ne_zero)
    simp only [one_mul, fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, zero_mul,
      MeasureTheory.integral_zero, neg_zero] at h
    exact h
  rw [s5, s6, s8]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => s9 i

informal_problem.statement:
(G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ)
    (U K : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hKc : IsClosed K)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j)) (hHK : ∀ y, y ∉ K → H y = 0)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fvField G H f i) U) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ y ∈ U, y ∉ K → fvField G H f i y = 0) ∧
    (∀ c d : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (staticLoc G f c d) U) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) U

signature.name: first_variation_regularity
signature.statement:
(G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ)
    (U K : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hKc : IsClosed K)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) U)
    (hGpos : ∀ y ∈ U, 0 < (G y).det)
    (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y i j)) (hHK : ∀ y, y ∉ K → H y = 0)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fvField G H f i) U) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ y ∈ U, y ∉ K → fvField G H f i y = 0) ∧
    (∀ c d : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (staticLoc G f c d) U) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) U) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) U

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hdet : ∀ y ∈ U, (G y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hGpos y hy).ne'
  have hpd : ∀ h : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U → ∀ c : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv c h) U := by
    intro h hh c
    have hD := ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hU).mp hh).2
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ h y (e c)) U
    exact hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdetgen : ∀ F : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => F z i j) U) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (F z).det) U := by
    intro F hF
    simp only [Matrix.det_apply]
    refine ContDiffOn.sum (fun σ _ => ?_)
    simp only [Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
    refine contDiffOn_const.mul ?_
    have hp := contDiffOn_prod' (t := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)))
      (f := fun i z => F z (σ i) i) (s := U) (n := ∞) (fun i _ => hF _ _)
    refine hp.congr (fun z _ => ?_)
    simp [Finset.prod_apply]
  have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).adjugate i j) U := by
    intro i j
    simp only [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
    refine hdetgen (fun z => (G z).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1)) ?_
    intro a b
    by_cases hab : a = j
    · subst hab
      simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
      exact contDiffOn_const
    · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hab]
      exact hG a b
  have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) U := by
    intro i j
    have heq : (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) =
        fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹ * (G z).adjugate i j := by
      funext z
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact ((hdetgen _ hG).inv hdet).mul (hadj i j)
  have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (G y).det) U :=
    (hdetgen _ hG).sqrt hdet
  have hpar : ∀ a b c : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => G z a b) y) U :=
    fun a b c => hpd _ (hG a b) c
  have hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel G k i j) U := by
    intro k i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => christoffel G k i j y) U
    unfold christoffel
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum (fun l _ =>
      (hinv k l).mul (((hpar j l i).add (hpar i l j)).sub (hpar i j l))))
  have hRic : ∀ j k : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (ricci G j k) U := by
    intro j k
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ricci G j k y) U
    unfold ricci
    refine (ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ?_)).add
      (ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun p _ =>
        ((hΓ i i p).mul (hΓ p j k)).sub ((hΓ i j p).mul (hΓ p i k)))))
    exact (hpd _ (hΓ i j k) i).sub (hpd _ (hΓ i i k) j)
  have hHU : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => H y a b) U :=
    fun a b => (hH a b).contDiffOn
  have hdH : ∀ a b c : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => partialDeriv c (fun z => H z a b) y) U :=
    fun a b c => hpd _ (hHU a b) c
  have hdf : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv j f) U := fun j => hpd f hf j
  have hΓ' : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fvChristoffelVar G H k i j) U := by
    intro k i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fvChristoffelVar G H k i j y) U
    unfold fvChristoffelVar
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ =>
        (hinv k l).mul (((hdH j l i).add (hdH i l j)).sub (hdH i j l)))).sub
      (ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ =>
        ((hinv k a).mul (hHU a b)).mul (hΓ b i j))
  have hFsm : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fvField G H f i) U := by
    intro i
    have hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y =>
        ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j k * fvChristoffelVar G H i j k y
          - ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * fvChristoffelVar G H k k j y) U :=
      (ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hinv j k).mul (hΓ' i j k)).sub
        (ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hinv i j).mul (hΓ' k k j))
    have hN : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y =>
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i a * H y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b j
          - (G y)⁻¹ i j * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b * H y a b)
          * partialDeriv j f y) U := by
      intro j
      exact ((ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ =>
          ((hinv i a).mul (hHU a b)).mul (hinv b j)).sub
        ((hinv i j).mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ =>
          (hinv a b).mul (hHU a b)))).mul (hdf j)
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fvField G H f i y) U
    unfold fvField
    exact hsq.mul ((hf.mul hV).sub (ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => hN j))
  have hHess : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (hessLoc G f i j) U := by
    intro i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => hessLoc G f i j y) U
    unfold hessLoc
    exact (hpd _ (hdf j) i).sub (ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => (hΓ k i j).mul (hdf k)))
  have hLap : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lapLoc G f) U := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => lapLoc G f y) U
    unfold lapLoc
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => (hinv i j).mul (hHess i j)))
  have hSt : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (staticLoc G f i j) U := by
    intro i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => staticLoc G f i j y) U
    unfold staticLoc
    exact ((hf.mul (hRic i j)).sub (hHess i j)).add (hLap.mul (hG i j))
  have hF0 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ y ∈ U, y ∉ K → fvField G H f i y = 0 := by
    intro i y _ hyK
    have hnhds : Kᶜ ∈ 𝓝 y := hKc.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hyK
    have hb2 : ∀ a b : Fin 3, H y a b = 0 := by
      intro a b; rw [hHK y hyK]; rfl
    have hb3 : ∀ a b c : Fin 3, partialDeriv c (fun z => H z a b) y = 0 := by
      intro a b c
      have hev : (fun z => H z a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
        filter_upwards [hnhds] with z hz
        rw [hHK z hz]; rfl
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => H z a b) y (e c) = 0
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_apply]
      rfl
    have hb4 : ∀ k i' j : Fin 3, fvChristoffelVar G H k i' j y = 0 := by
      intro k i' j
      unfold fvChristoffelVar
      simp [hb2, hb3]
    unfold fvField
    simp [hb2, hb4]
  exact ⟨hFsm, hF0, fun c d => (hSt c d).continuousOn, hinv, hsq⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(U K : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKU : K ⊆ U)
    (φ ρ δ σ σ₀ u : E3 → ℝ) (M : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (t P Q C₂ C₃ D B₀ : ℝ)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hP : 0 ≤ P) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q) (hC₂ : 0 ≤ C₂) (hC₃ : 0 ≤ C₃) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hB₀ : 0 ≤ B₀)
    (hφc : ContinuousOn φ K) (hdφc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv i φ) K)
    (hρc : ContinuousOn ρ K) (hδc : ContinuousOn δ K) (hσc : ContinuousOn σ K)
    (hσ₀c : ContinuousOn σ₀ K) (hMc : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (M i j) K)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u U)
    (hφb : ∀ y ∈ K, |φ y| ≤ P ∧ ∀ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i φ y| ≤ P)
    (hσb : ∀ y ∈ K, |σ y| ≤ Q)
    (hρb : ∀ y ∈ K, |ρ y - t * δ y| ≤ C₂ * t ^ 2 ∧ |ρ y| ≤ C₃ * t ∧ |δ y| ≤ D)
    (hσσ : ∀ y ∈ K, |σ y - σ₀ y| ≤ C₂ * t)
    (hMb : ∀ y ∈ K, ∀ i j : Fin 3, |M i j y| ≤ C₂ * t)
    (hint : ∫ y in K, (|u y| + ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖) ≤ B₀ * t) :
    |(∫ y in K, (φ y * (ρ y * (1 + u y) / 8) * σ y +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j y * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j u y))
      - t / 8 * ∫ y in K, φ y * δ y * σ₀ y|
      ≤ (MeasureTheory.volume.real K * P * C₂ * (Q + D) / 8 + P * C₃ * Q * B₀ / 8
          + 9 * C₂ * P * B₀) * t ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hKm : MeasurableSet K := hK.measurableSet
  have huc : ContinuousOn u K := hu.continuousOn.mono hKU
  have hdu : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y) K :=
    (hu.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl).mono hKU
  have hduj : ∀ j : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv j u) K := by
    intro j
    show ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ u y (e j)) K
    exact hdu.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hwc : ContinuousOn (fun y => |u y| + ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖) K := huc.abs.add hdu.norm
  have hFc : ContinuousOn (fun y => φ y * (ρ y * (1 + u y) / 8) * σ y +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j y * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j u y) K := by
    refine ContinuousOn.add ?_ ?_
    · exact (hφc.mul ((hρc.mul (continuousOn_const.add huc)).div_const 8)).mul hσc
    · exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
        ((hMc i j).mul (hdφc i)).mul (hduj j)
  have hGc : ContinuousOn (fun y => φ y * δ y * σ₀ y) K := (hφc.mul hδc).mul hσ₀c
  have hpd : ∀ (y : E3) (j : Fin 3), |partialDeriv j u y| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖ := by
    intro y j
    have h1 := (fderiv ℝ u y).le_opNorm (e j)
    have h2 : ‖(e j : E3)‖ = 1 := by simp [e, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    rw [h2, mul_one] at h1
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact h1
  have hC₂t : 0 ≤ C₂ * t := mul_nonneg hC₂ ht.le
  have hb0 : 0 ≤ (P * C₃ * Q / 8 + 9 * C₂ * P) * t := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ P * C₃ * Q / 8 := by
      have := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hP hC₃) hQ
      linarith
    have h2 : 0 ≤ 9 * C₂ * P := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC₂) hP
    exact mul_nonneg (add_nonneg h1 h2) ht.le
  
  have hpt : ∀ y ∈ K, ‖(φ y * (ρ y * (1 + u y) / 8) * σ y +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j y * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j u y)
        - t / 8 * (φ y * δ y * σ₀ y)‖ ≤ P * C₂ * (Q + D) / 8 * t ^ 2 +
          (P * C₃ * Q / 8 + 9 * C₂ * P) * t * (|u y| + ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    obtain ⟨hφ, hdφ⟩ := hφb y hy
    have hσ := hσb y hy
    obtain ⟨hρδ, hρ, hδ⟩ := hρb y hy
    have hss := hσσ y hy
    have hN0 : 0 ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hu0 : 0 ≤ |u y| := abs_nonneg _
    set S := ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j y * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j u y with hS
    have hid : (φ y * (ρ y * (1 + u y) / 8) * σ y + S) - t / 8 * (φ y * δ y * σ₀ y) =
        φ y * (ρ y - t * δ y) * σ y / 8 + φ y * t * δ y * (σ y - σ₀ y) / 8 +
          φ y * ρ y * u y * σ y / 8 + S := by ring
    have h8 : |(8 : ℝ)| = 8 := abs_of_pos (by norm_num)
    have e1 : |φ y * (ρ y - t * δ y) * σ y / 8| ≤ P * (C₂ * t ^ 2) * Q / 8 := by
      have hp : |φ y| * |ρ y - t * δ y| * |σ y| ≤ P * (C₂ * t ^ 2) * Q :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hφ hρδ (abs_nonneg _) hP) hσ (abs_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg hP (mul_nonneg hC₂ (sq_nonneg t)))
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, h8]
      linarith
    have e2 : |φ y * t * δ y * (σ y - σ₀ y) / 8| ≤ P * t * D * (C₂ * t) / 8 := by
      have hp : |φ y| * t * |δ y| * |σ y - σ₀ y| ≤ P * t * D * (C₂ * t) :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hφ le_rfl ht.le hP) hδ (abs_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg hP ht.le)) hss (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hP ht.le) hD)
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos ht, h8]
      linarith
    have e3 : |φ y * ρ y * u y * σ y / 8| ≤ P * (C₃ * t) * |u y| * Q / 8 := by
      have hp : |φ y| * |ρ y| * |u y| * |σ y| ≤ P * (C₃ * t) * |u y| * Q :=
        mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hφ hρ (abs_nonneg _) hP) le_rfl hu0
          (mul_nonneg hP (mul_nonneg hC₃ ht.le))) hσ (abs_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hP (mul_nonneg hC₃ ht.le)) hu0)
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul, h8]
      linarith
    have eS : |S| ≤ 9 * (C₂ * t * P * ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖) := by
      have hterm : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
          |M i j y * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j u y| ≤ C₂ * t * P * ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖ := by
        intro i j
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (hMb y hy i j) (hdφ i) (abs_nonneg _) hC₂t) (hpd y j)
          (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hC₂t hP)
      rw [hS]
      calc |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j y * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j u y|
          ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |∑ j : Fin 3, M i j y * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j u y| :=
            Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |M i j y * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j u y| :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C₂ * t * P * ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖ :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hterm i j
        _ = 9 * (C₂ * t * P * ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖) := by
            simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
    have tri : |φ y * (ρ y - t * δ y) * σ y / 8 + φ y * t * δ y * (σ y - σ₀ y) / 8 +
          φ y * ρ y * u y * σ y / 8 + S| ≤
        |φ y * (ρ y - t * δ y) * σ y / 8| + |φ y * t * δ y * (σ y - σ₀ y) / 8| +
          |φ y * ρ y * u y * σ y / 8| + |S| := by
      have a1 := abs_add_le (φ y * (ρ y - t * δ y) * σ y / 8 + φ y * t * δ y * (σ y - σ₀ y) / 8 +
          φ y * ρ y * u y * σ y / 8) S
      have a2 := abs_add_le (φ y * (ρ y - t * δ y) * σ y / 8 + φ y * t * δ y * (σ y - σ₀ y) / 8)
          (φ y * ρ y * u y * σ y / 8)
      have a3 := abs_add_le (φ y * (ρ y - t * δ y) * σ y / 8) (φ y * t * δ y * (σ y - σ₀ y) / 8)
      linarith
    have n1 : 0 ≤ P * C₃ * Q * t * ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖ :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hP hC₃) hQ) ht.le) hN0
    have n2 : 0 ≤ C₂ * P * t * |u y| :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC₂ hP) ht.le) hu0
    rw [hid]
    linarith [tri, e1, e2, e3, eS, n1, n2]
  
  have hFi : IntegrableOn (fun y => φ y * (ρ y * (1 + u y) / 8) * σ y +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j y * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j u y) K :=
    hFc.integrableOn_compact hK
  have hGi : IntegrableOn (fun y => φ y * δ y * σ₀ y) K := hGc.integrableOn_compact hK
  have hwi : IntegrableOn (fun y => |u y| + ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖) K := hwc.integrableOn_compact hK
  have hci : IntegrableOn (fun _ : E3 => P * C₂ * (Q + D) / 8 * t ^ 2) K :=
    continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact hK
  have hlin : (∫ y in K, (φ y * (ρ y * (1 + u y) / 8) * σ y +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j y * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j u y))
      - t / 8 * ∫ y in K, φ y * δ y * σ₀ y =
      ∫ y in K, ((φ y * (ρ y * (1 + u y) / 8) * σ y +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j y * partialDeriv i φ y * partialDeriv j u y)
        - t / 8 * (φ y * δ y * σ₀ y)) := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    exact (integral_sub hFi (hGi.const_mul (t / 8))).symm
  have hgi : Integrable (fun y => P * C₂ * (Q + D) / 8 * t ^ 2 +
      (P * C₃ * Q / 8 + 9 * C₂ * P) * t * (|u y| + ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖)) (volume.restrict K) :=
    hci.add (hwi.const_mul _)
  have hnorm := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hgi (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hKm hpt)
  have hgeq : ∫ y in K, (P * C₂ * (Q + D) / 8 * t ^ 2 +
      (P * C₃ * Q / 8 + 9 * C₂ * P) * t * (|u y| + ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖)) =
      MeasureTheory.volume.real K * (P * C₂ * (Q + D) / 8 * t ^ 2) +
        (P * C₃ * Q / 8 + 9 * C₂ * P) * t * ∫ y in K, (|u y| + ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖) := by
    rw [integral_add hci (hwi.const_mul _), setIntegral_const, integral_const_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hgeq, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hnorm
  have hfin : (P * C₃ * Q / 8 + 9 * C₂ * P) * t * ∫ y in K, (|u y| + ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖) ≤
      (P * C₃ * Q / 8 + 9 * C₂ * P) * t * (B₀ * t) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hint hb0
  rw [hlin]
  calc _ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real K * (P * C₂ * (Q + D) / 8 * t ^ 2) +
        (P * C₃ * Q / 8 + 9 * C₂ * P) * t * ∫ y in K, (|u y| + ‖fderiv ℝ u y‖) := hnorm
    _ ≤ MeasureTheory.volume.real K * (P * C₂ * (Q + D) / 8 * t ^ 2) +
        (P * C₃ * Q / 8 + 9 * C₂ * P) * t * (B₀ * t) := by linarith
    _ = (MeasureTheory.volume.real K * P * C₂ * (Q + D) / 8 + P * C₃ * Q * B₀ / 8
          + 9 * C₂ * P * B₀) * t ^ 2 := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
(ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 1 < ρ) (I : ℝ) (U : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ)
    (D : ℕ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hU : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (U n) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})
    (hw : ContinuousOn w {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})
    (hD : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (D n) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖}) (hD0 : ∀ n y, 0 ≤ D n y)
    (hH : ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ), ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R}, (U n y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ I)
    (hconv : ∀ L : Set E3, IsCompact L → L ⊆ {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y in L, ((U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    0 ≤ I ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R}, (w y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * I

signature.name: cld_hardy_transfer
signature.statement:
(ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 1 < ρ) (I : ℝ) (U : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ)
    (D : ℕ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hU : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (U n) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})
    (hw : ContinuousOn w {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖})
    (hD : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (D n) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖}) (hD0 : ∀ n y, 0 ≤ D n y)
    (hH : ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ), ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R}, (U n y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ I)
    (hconv : ∀ L : Set E3, IsCompact L → L ⊆ {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y in L, ((U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    0 ≤ I ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, ∫ y in {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R}, (w y) ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * I

proof.tactics:
by
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by linarith
  have alg : ∀ u v r d : ℝ, ρ < r → 0 ≤ d →
      v ^ 2 / r ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (u ^ 2 / r ^ 2) + 2 / ρ ^ 2 * ((u - v) ^ 2 + d) := by
    intro u v r d hr hd
    have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
    have hr2 : 0 < r ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hρ2 : 0 < ρ ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hρr : ρ ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have key : v ^ 2 ≤ 2 * u ^ 2 + 2 * (u - v) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * u - v)]
    have h1 : v ^ 2 / r ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (u ^ 2 / r ^ 2) + 2 * ((u - v) ^ 2 / r ^ 2) := by
      calc v ^ 2 / r ^ 2 ≤ (2 * u ^ 2 + 2 * (u - v) ^ 2) / r ^ 2 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right key hr2.le
        _ = 2 * (u ^ 2 / r ^ 2) + 2 * ((u - v) ^ 2 / r ^ 2) := by ring
    have h2 : (u - v) ^ 2 / r ^ 2 ≤ ((u - v) ^ 2 + d) / ρ ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) hρ2 hρr
    have h3 : 2 / ρ ^ 2 * ((u - v) ^ 2 + d) = 2 * (((u - v) ^ 2 + d) / ρ ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [h3]; linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := hH 0 ρ
    have hemp : {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < ρ} = ∅ := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and, not_lt]
      intro h1; exact h1.le
    rw [hemp, setIntegral_empty] at h
    exact h
  · intro R
    set A : Set E3 := {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < R} with hAdef
    set L : Set E3 := {y : E3 | ρ ≤ ‖y‖} ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R with hLdef
    have hLc : IsCompact L :=
      (isCompact_closedBall 0 R).inter_left (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm)
    have hLΩ : L ⊆ {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := fun y hy => lt_of_lt_of_le hρ hy.1
    have hAL : A ⊆ L := fun y hy => ⟨hy.1.le, mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr hy.2.le⟩
    have hAm : MeasurableSet A :=
      (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm).inter
        (measurableSet_lt measurable_norm measurable_const)
    have hne : ∀ y ∈ L, ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 : ρ ≤ ‖y‖ := hy.1
      have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < ‖y‖ := by linarith
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 h2.ne'
    have hwc : ContinuousOn (fun y => w y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) L :=
      ((hw.mono hLΩ).pow 2).div (continuous_norm.pow 2).continuousOn hne
    have hUc : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (fun y => U n y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) L := fun n =>
      (((hU n).mono hLΩ).pow 2).div (continuous_norm.pow 2).continuousOn hne
    have hgc : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (fun y => (U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y) L := fun n =>
      ((((hU n).sub hw).pow 2).add (hD n)).mono hLΩ
    have hwi : IntegrableOn (fun y => w y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) A :=
      (hwc.integrableOn_compact hLc).mono_set hAL
    have hUi : ∀ n, IntegrableOn (fun y => U n y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) A := fun n =>
      ((hUc n).integrableOn_compact hLc).mono_set hAL
    have hgiL : ∀ n, IntegrableOn (fun y => (U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y) L := fun n =>
      (hgc n).integrableOn_compact hLc
    have hgi : ∀ n, IntegrableOn (fun y => (U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y) A := fun n =>
      (hgiL n).mono_set hAL
    have hbound : ∀ n : ℕ, ∫ y in A, w y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤
        2 * I + 2 / ρ ^ 2 * ∫ y in L, ((U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y) := by
      intro n
      have hpt : ∀ y ∈ A, w y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤
          2 * (U n y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) + 2 / ρ ^ 2 * ((U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y) :=
        fun y hy => alg (U n y) (w y) ‖y‖ (D n y) hy.1 (hD0 n y)
      have hi1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => 2 * (U n y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2)) A :=
        Integrable.const_mul (hUi n) 2
      have hi2 : IntegrableOn (fun y => 2 / ρ ^ 2 * ((U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y)) A :=
        Integrable.const_mul (hgi n) (2 / ρ ^ 2)
      have hRi : IntegrableOn (fun y => 2 * (U n y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2) +
          2 / ρ ^ 2 * ((U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y)) A := Integrable.add hi1 hi2
      have hm1 := setIntegral_mono_on hwi hRi hAm hpt
      rw [integral_add hi1 hi2, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul] at hm1
      have hH' : ∫ y in A, U n y ^ 2 / ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ I := hH n R
      have hmono : ∫ y in A, ((U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y) ≤
          ∫ y in L, ((U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y) :=
        setIntegral_mono_set (hgiL n)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (hD0 n y))
          hAL.eventuallyLE
      have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 / ρ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmono hc
      linarith
    have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * I + 2 / ρ ^ 2 * ∫ y in L, ((U n y - w y) ^ 2 + D n y))
        atTop (𝓝 (2 * I)) := by
      have h := ((hconv L hLc hLΩ).const_mul (2 / ρ ^ 2)).const_add (2 * I)
      rw [mul_zero, add_zero] at h
      exact h
    exact ge_of_tendsto' ht hbound

informal_problem.statement:
∃ ε₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 < ε₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₂ ∧
    ∀ (W : E3 → ℝ) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ W (Metric.ball 0 2) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ z' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
        (∀ i j : Fin 3, |a z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε₁ ∧
           |a z i j - a z' i j| ≤ ε₁ * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
        (∀ k : Fin 3, |b z k| ≤ ε₁ ∧ |b z k - b z' k| ≤ ε₁ * ‖z - z'‖)) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a z i j * partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j W y) z
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, b z k * partialDeriv k W z = 0) →
      ∀ (x : E3) (d K : ℝ), 0 < d → ‖x‖ + d ≤ 1 → (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x d, |W y| ≤ K) →
        ∀ i : Fin 3, d * |partialDeriv i W x| ≤ C₂ * K

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨C_G, hCG, hG⟩ := holder_schauder_global
  obtain ⟨ε₀, C₀, hε₀, hC₀, hPB⟩ := perturbed_ball_estimate C_G hCG hG
  refine ⟨ε₀, C₀, hε₀, hC₀, ?_⟩
  intro W a b hW hcoef heq x d K hd hxd hK i
  have hd1 : d ≤ 1 := by linarith [norm_nonneg x]
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ K := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hK x (Metric.mem_ball_self hd))
  have hTn : ∀ z : E3, ‖x + d • z‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + d * ‖z‖ := by
    intro z
    calc ‖x + d • z‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖d • z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖x‖ + d * ‖z‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hd.le]
  have hT2 : ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ < 2 → x + d • z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 2 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    have h1 := hTn z
    have h2 : d * ‖z‖ < d * 2 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz hd
    linarith
  have hT1 : ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ < 1 → x + d • z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    have h1 := hTn z
    have h2 : d * ‖z‖ < d * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz hd
    linarith
  have hTx : ∀ z : E3, ‖z‖ < 1 → x + d • z ∈ Metric.ball x d := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hd.le]
    have h2 : d * ‖z‖ < d * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz hd
    linarith
  have hdiff : ∀ z z' : E3, ‖(x + d • z) - (x + d • z')‖ = d * ‖z - z'‖ := by
    intro z z'
    rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hd.le]
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun z : E3 => x + d • z) (Metric.ball 0 2) (Metric.ball 0 2) := by
    intro z hz
    exact hT2 z (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz)
  have hWt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => W (x + d • z)) (Metric.ball 0 2) :=
    hW.comp (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.const_smul d)).contDiffOn hmaps
  have hsup : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, |W (x + d • z)| ≤ K := by
    intro z hz
    exact hK _ (hTx z (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz))
  have hcoef' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ z' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, |a (x + d • z) i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε₀ ∧
         |a (x + d • z) i j - a (x + d • z') i j| ≤ ε₀ * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin 3, |d * b (x + d • z) k| ≤ ε₀ ∧
         |d * b (x + d • z) k - d * b (x + d • z') k| ≤ ε₀ * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
      |(0 : ℝ)| ≤ K ∧ |(0 : ℝ) - 0| ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ := by
    intro z hz z' hz'
    have hp := hT1 z (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz)
    have hp' := hT1 z' (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz')
    obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := hcoef _ hp _ hp'
    have hn := hdiff z z'
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖z - z'‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hstep : ε₀ * (d * ‖z - z'‖) ≤ ε₀ * ‖z - z'‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_of_le_one_left hnn hd1) hε₀.le
    refine ⟨fun i j => ⟨(ha i j).1, ?_⟩, fun k => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 := (ha i j).2
      rw [hn] at h1
      exact h1.trans hstep
    · rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hd]
      exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hd1).trans (hb k).1
    · rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hd]
      have h1 := (hb k).2
      rw [hn] at h1
      exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hd1).trans (h1.trans hstep)
    · rw [abs_zero]; exact hK0
    · rw [sub_self, abs_zero]; exact mul_nonneg hK0 hnn
  have heq' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a (x + d • z) i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun y' => W (x + d • y')) y) z
        - ∑ k : Fin 3, d * b (x + d • z) k * partialDeriv k (fun y => W (x + d • y)) z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    have hz1 : ‖z‖ < 1 := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz
    have hp1 := hT1 z hz1
    have hp2 : x + d • z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 2 := hT2 z (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := rescale_partialDeriv W _ Metric.isOpen_ball hW x d z hp2
    have he := heq _ hp1
    simp only [h1, h2]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at he ⊢
    linear_combination d ^ 2 * he
  have hfin := (hPB (fun z => W (x + d • z)) (fun z => a (x + d • z))
    (fun z k => d * b (x + d • z) k) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) ε₀ K hε₀.le le_rfl hK0 hWt hsup
    hcoef' heq').1 i
  have h0 := (rescale_partialDeriv W _ Metric.isOpen_ball hW x d 0 (hT2 0 (by simp))).1 i
  rw [smul_zero, add_zero] at h0
  rw [h0, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hd] at hfin
  exact hfin

subgoal_signatures.name: holder_schauder_global
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ C_G : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_G ∧
    ∀ (ψ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ K : ℝ,
      (∀ x y : E3, |∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) x
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) y| ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) →
      ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x y : E3), |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) x
          - partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) y| ≤ C_G * K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)

subgoal_signatures.name: perturbed_ball_estimate
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(C_G : ℝ) (hCG : 0 ≤ C_G)
    (hG : ∀ (ψ : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ K : ℝ,
      (∀ x y : E3, |∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) x
          - ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => partialDeriv k ψ z) y| ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) →
      ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (x y : E3), |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) x
          - partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j ψ z) y| ≤ C_G * K * ‖x - y‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    ∃ ε₀ C₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C₀ ∧
      ∀ (w : E3 → ℝ) (a : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (b : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ) (ε M : ℝ),
        0 ≤ ε → ε ≤ ε₀ → 0 ≤ M →
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w (Metric.ball 0 2) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, |w z| ≤ M) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ z' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
          (∀ i j : Fin 3, |a z i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε ∧
             |a z i j - a z' i j| ≤ ε * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
          (∀ k : Fin 3, |b z k| ≤ ε ∧ |b z k - b z' k| ≤ ε * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
          |F z| ≤ M ∧ |F z - F z'| ≤ M * ‖z - z'‖) →
        (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, a z i j * partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j w y) z
            - ∑ k : Fin 3, b z k * partialDeriv k w z = F z) →
        (∀ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i w 0| ≤ C₀ * M) ∧
        (∀ i j : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j w y) 0| ≤ C₀ * M)

subgoal_signatures.name: rescale_partialDeriv
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(v : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v U)
    (x : E3) (t : ℝ) (z : E3) (hz : x + t • z ∈ U) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => v (x + t • y)) z = t * partialDeriv i v (x + t • z)) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun y' => v (x + t • y')) y) z
        = t ^ 2 * partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j v y) (x + t • z))

        ∀ i : Fin 3, d * |partialDeriv i W x| ≤ C₂ * K) →
      W 0 ^ 2 ≤ C₃ * ∫ y in Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, W y ^ 2
