proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set vB : ℝ := (volume : Measure E3).real (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1) with hvBdef
  have hvBpos : 0 < vB := by
    rw [hvBdef, measureReal_def]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_pos (Metric.measure_ball_pos volume 0 one_pos).ne'
      measure_ball_lt_top.ne
  have hvol : ∀ (x : E3) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      (volume : Measure E3).real (Metric.ball x r) = r ^ 3 * vB := by
    intro x r hr
    rw [hvBdef, measureReal_def, measureReal_def, Measure.addHaar_ball_of_pos volume x hr,
      finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (pow_nonneg hr.le 3)]
  set c : ℝ := 72 * C₂ + 4 with hcdef
  have hc4 : 4 ≤ c := by linarith
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by linarith
  have hc3 : 0 < c ^ 3 := pow_pos hcpos 3
  have hC3 : 0 ≤ 4 * c ^ 3 / vB := div_nonneg (by linarith) hvBpos.le
  refine ⟨4 * c ^ 3 / vB, hC3, ?_⟩
  intro W hW hgrad
  set E := ∫ y in Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, W y ^ 2 with hEdef
  have hcl : ContinuousOn W (Metric.closedBall 0 1) :=
    hW.continuousOn.mono (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by norm_num))
  have hint1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => W y ^ 2) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1) :=
    ((hcl.pow 2).integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall 0 1)).mono_set
      Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have hE : 0 ≤ E := setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_ball (fun y _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ W y := fun y hy =>
    (hW.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy)
  
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hmax⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) 1).exists_isMaxOn
    (Metric.nonempty_closedBall.mpr zero_le_one)
    (f := fun x => (1 - ‖x‖) ^ 3 * W x ^ 2)
    (((continuous_const.sub continuous_norm).continuousOn.pow 3).mul (hcl.pow 2))
  have hm : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) 1,
      (1 - ‖y‖) ^ 3 * W y ^ 2 ≤ (1 - ‖x₀‖) ^ 3 * W x₀ ^ 2 :=
    isMaxOn_iff.mp hmax
  have hx₀n : ‖x₀‖ ≤ 1 := mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mp hx₀
  set d := 1 - ‖x₀‖ with hddef
  set a := |W x₀| with hadef
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ d := by linarith
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := abs_nonneg _
  have hWa : W x₀ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 := by rw [hadef, sq_abs]
  have h0 : W 0 ^ 2 ≤ d ^ 3 * a ^ 2 := by
    have := hm 0 (Metric.mem_closedBall_self zero_le_one)
    rw [← hWa]
    simpa using this
  refine h0.trans ?_
  have hEC : 0 ≤ 4 * c ^ 3 / vB * E := mul_nonneg hC3 hE
  rcases hd0.eq_or_lt with hd | hd
  · rw [← hd, zero_pow (by norm_num), zero_mul]; exact hEC
  rcases ha0.eq_or_lt with ha | ha
  · rw [← ha, zero_pow (by norm_num), mul_zero]; exact hEC
  have hd3 : 0 < d ^ 3 := pow_pos hd 3
  
  have hbd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (d / 2), |W y| ≤ 3 * a := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy
    have h1 := norm_sub_norm_le y x₀
    have hyc : y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) 1 := mem_closedBall_zero_iff.mpr (by linarith)
    have h2 := hm y hyc
    have hdy : d / 2 ≤ 1 - ‖y‖ := by linarith
    have h3 : (d / 2) ^ 3 * W y ^ 2 ≤ d ^ 3 * a ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hWa]
      exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hdy 3) (sq_nonneg _)) h2
    have h5 : d ^ 3 * W y ^ 2 ≤ d ^ 3 * (8 * a ^ 2) := by
      have : (d / 2) ^ 3 = d ^ 3 / 8 := by ring
      rw [this] at h3
      linarith
    have h6 : W y ^ 2 ≤ 8 * a ^ 2 := le_of_mul_le_mul_left h5 hd3
    have h4 : W y ^ 2 ≤ (3 * a) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have := sq_le_sq.mp h4
    rwa [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * a)] at this
  
  have hpd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (d / 4), ∀ k : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv k W z| ≤ 12 * C₂ * a / d := by
    intro z hz k
    have hz' : dist z x₀ < d / 4 := hz
    have h1 := norm_sub_norm_le z x₀
    have hz'' : ‖z - x₀‖ < d / 4 := by rwa [dist_eq_norm] at hz'
    have hsub : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z (d / 4), |W y| ≤ 3 * a := by
      intro y hy
      apply hbd
      have hy' : dist y z < d / 4 := hy
      have := dist_triangle y z x₀
      show dist y x₀ < d / 2
      linarith
    have h2 := hgrad z (d / 4) (3 * a) (by positivity) (by linarith) hsub k
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hd]
    linarith
  
  set r := d / c with hrdef
  have hr : 0 < r := div_pos hd hcpos
  have hr4 : r ≤ d / 4 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hd.le (by norm_num) hc4
  have hL : 0 ≤ 12 * C₂ * a / d :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC₂) ha.le) hd.le
  have hnorm : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, ‖fderiv ℝ W z‖ ≤ 3 * (12 * C₂ * a / d) := by
    intro z hz
    have hz4 : z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (d / 4) := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr4 hz
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by linarith) ?_
    intro v
    have hv : v = v 0 • e 0 + v 1 • e 1 + v 2 • e 2 := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hD : fderiv ℝ W z v = v 0 * partialDeriv 0 W z + v 1 * partialDeriv 1 W z
        + v 2 * partialDeriv 2 W z := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      rfl
    have h0 : |v 0| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le v 0
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have h1 : |v 1| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le v 1
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have h2 : |v 2| ≤ ‖v‖ := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le v 2
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    have b0 := hpd z hz4 0
    have b1 := hpd z hz4 1
    have b2 := hpd z hz4 2
    have m0 : |v 0 * partialDeriv 0 W z| ≤ ‖v‖ * (12 * C₂ * a / d) := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul h0 b0 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    have m1 : |v 1 * partialDeriv 1 W z| ≤ ‖v‖ * (12 * C₂ * a / d) := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul h1 b1 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    have m2 : |v 2 * partialDeriv 2 W z| ≤ ‖v‖ * (12 * C₂ * a / d) := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul h2 b2 (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hD]
    calc |v 0 * partialDeriv 0 W z + v 1 * partialDeriv 1 W z + v 2 * partialDeriv 2 W z|
        ≤ |v 0 * partialDeriv 0 W z + v 1 * partialDeriv 1 W z| + |v 2 * partialDeriv 2 W z| :=
          abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ |v 0 * partialDeriv 0 W z| + |v 1 * partialDeriv 1 W z| + |v 2 * partialDeriv 2 W z| := by
          linarith [abs_add_le (v 0 * partialDeriv 0 W z) (v 1 * partialDeriv 1 W z)]
      _ ≤ 3 * (12 * C₂ * a / d) * ‖v‖ := by linarith
  have hSd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, DifferentiableAt ℝ W z := by
    intro z hz
    apply hdiff
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    have := norm_sub_norm_le z x₀
    linarith
  have hkey : 3 * (12 * C₂ * a / d) * r ≤ a / 2 := by
    have hdne := hd.ne'
    have hcne := hcpos.ne'
    have : 3 * (12 * C₂ * a / d) * r = 36 * C₂ * a / c := by
      rw [hrdef]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [this, div_le_iff₀ hcpos, hcdef]
    nlinarith
  have hlow : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, a / 2 ≤ |W y| := by
    intro y hy
    have hlip := (convex_ball x₀ r).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hSd hnorm hy
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hlip
    have hxy : ‖x₀ - y‖ < r := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy
      rwa [norm_sub_rev]
    have hb : 3 * (12 * C₂ * a / d) * ‖x₀ - y‖ ≤ 3 * (12 * C₂ * a / d) * r :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxy.le (by linarith)
    have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (W x₀) (W y)
    rw [← hadef] at this
    linarith
  
  have hsubB : Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
    have := norm_sub_norm_le y x₀
    linarith
  have hlowint : (a / 2) ^ 2 * (volume : Measure E3).real (Metric.ball x₀ r) ≤
      ∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, W y ^ 2 := by
    have hconst : ∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, (a / 2) ^ 2 =
        (volume : Measure E3).real (Metric.ball x₀ r) • (a / 2) ^ 2 := setIntegral_const _
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] at hconst
    rw [← hconst]
    refine setIntegral_mono_on ?_ (hint1.mono_set hsubB) measurableSet_ball ?_
    · exact (continuousOn_const.integrableOn_compact (isCompact_closedBall x₀ r)).mono_set
        Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    · intro y hy
      have := hlow y hy
      have h0 : 0 ≤ a / 2 := by linarith
      calc (a / 2) ^ 2 ≤ |W y| ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 this 2
        _ = W y ^ 2 := sq_abs _
  have hmono : ∫ y in Metric.ball x₀ r, W y ^ 2 ≤ E :=
    setIntegral_mono_set hint1 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => sq_nonneg _)
      hsubB.eventuallyLE
  rw [hvol x₀ r hr] at hlowint
  have hfin : (a / 2) ^ 2 * (r ^ 3 * vB) ≤ E := hlowint.trans hmono
  have hr3 : r ^ 3 * c ^ 3 = d ^ 3 := by
    rw [hrdef, div_pow, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero 3 hcpos.ne')]
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hvBpos]
  calc d ^ 3 * a ^ 2 * vB = 4 * c ^ 3 * ((a / 2) ^ 2 * (r ^ 3 * vB)) := by rw [← hr3]; ring
    _ ≤ 4 * c ^ 3 * E := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfin (by linarith)

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ R₂ : ℝ, 1 ≤ R₂ ∧ ∀ x : E3, R₂ < ‖x‖ →
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ z' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
        (∀ i j : Fin 3,
          |(G (x + (‖x‖ / 4) • z))⁻¹ i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ ε ∧
          |(G (x + (‖x‖ / 4) • z))⁻¹ i j - (G (x + (‖x‖ / 4) • z'))⁻¹ i j| ≤ ε * ‖z - z'‖) ∧
        (∀ k : Fin 3,
          |(‖x‖ / 4) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
              (G (x + (‖x‖ / 4) • z))⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j (x + (‖x‖ / 4) • z)| ≤ ε ∧
          |(‖x‖ / 4) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
              (G (x + (‖x‖ / 4) • z))⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j (x + (‖x‖ / 4) • z)
            - (‖x‖ / 4) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
              (G (x + (‖x‖ / 4) • z'))⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j (x + (‖x‖ / 4) • z')|
            ≤ ε * ‖z - z'‖)

signature.name: cld_rescaled_coeffs
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨R, C, hR, hC, hb⟩ := metric_coeff_bounds G q hq hsmooth hdecay
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hL⟩ := lapLoc_coeff_bounds G q hq hsmooth R C hR hC hb
  
  have hev : ∃ T₀ : ℝ, 0 < T₀ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, T₀ ≤ t → K * t ^ (-q) ≤ ε := by
    have hδ : 0 < ε / (K + 1) := div_pos hε (by linarith)
    have h1 := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hq).eventually_lt_const hδ
    obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 h1
    refine ⟨max T₁ 1, lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_right _ _), fun t ht => ?_⟩
    have ht1 : T₁ ≤ t := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) ht
    have ht0 : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) ht)
    have hA : 0 ≤ t ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_nonneg ht0.le _
    have h2 := hT₁ t ht1
    have h3 : (K + 1) * t ^ (-q) ≤ (K + 1) * (ε / (K + 1)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2.le (by linarith)
    rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (by linarith : (K + 1) ≠ 0)] at h3
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀, hT⟩ := hev
  
  have hscale : ∀ s P : ℝ, 0 < s → 3 * s < P →
      K * P ^ (-q) ≤ K * (3 * s) ^ (-q) ∧
      s * (K * P ^ (-q - 1)) ≤ K * (3 * s) ^ (-q) ∧
      s * (s * (K * P ^ (-q - 2))) ≤ K * (3 * s) ^ (-q) := by
    intro s P hs hP
    have hP0 : 0 < P := by linarith
    have hA : 0 ≤ P ^ (-q) := Real.rpow_nonneg hP0.le _
    have hAB : P ^ (-q) ≤ (3 * s) ^ (-q) :=
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) hP.le (by linarith)
    have hKAB : K * P ^ (-q) ≤ K * (3 * s) ^ (-q) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hAB hK
    have hKA : 0 ≤ K * P ^ (-q) := mul_nonneg hK hA
    have h1 : P ^ (-q - 1) = P ^ (-q) / P := Real.rpow_sub_one hP0.ne' (-q)
    have h2 : P ^ (-q - 2) = P ^ (-q) / P / P := by
      rw [show -q - 2 = (-q - 1) - 1 by ring, Real.rpow_sub_one hP0.ne', h1]
    have hu0 : 0 ≤ s / P := div_nonneg hs.le hP0.le
    have hu1 : s / P ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hP0).2 (by linarith)
    have e1 : s * (K * P ^ (-q - 1)) = K * P ^ (-q) * (s / P) := by
      rw [h1]; field_simp
    have e2 : s * (s * (K * P ^ (-q - 2))) = K * P ^ (-q) * (s / P) * (s / P) := by
      rw [h2]; field_simp
    have i1 : K * P ^ (-q) * (s / P) ≤ K * P ^ (-q) := mul_le_of_le_one_right hKA hu1
    have i2 : K * P ^ (-q) * (s / P) * (s / P) ≤ K * P ^ (-q) * (s / P) :=
      mul_le_of_le_one_right (mul_nonneg hKA hu0) hu1
    refine ⟨hKAB, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [e1]; linarith
    · rw [e2]; linarith
  
  have hlip : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (x : E3) (s m c : ℝ), 0 ≤ s → 0 ≤ m →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, DifferentiableAt ℝ f (x + s • z)) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, m * (s * ‖fderiv ℝ f (x + s • z)‖) ≤ c) →
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, ∀ z' ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
        |m * f (x + s • z) - m * f (x + s • z')| ≤ c * ‖z - z'‖ := by
    intro f x s m c hs hm hd hbd z hz z' hz'
    have hA : ∀ w : E3, HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => x + s • y)
        (s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3) w :=
      fun w => ((hasFDerivAt_id w).const_smul s).const_add x
    have hψ : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, HasFDerivAt (fun y : E3 => m * f (x + s • y))
        (m • (fderiv ℝ f (x + s • w)).comp (s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)) w := by
      intro w hw
      exact ((hd w hw).hasFDerivAt.comp w (hA w)).const_mul m
    have hdiff : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : E3 => m * f (x + s • y)) w :=
      fun w hw => (hψ w hw).differentiableAt
    have hbd' : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1,
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y : E3 => m * f (x + s • y)) w‖ ≤ c := by
      intro w hw
      rw [(hψ w hw).fderiv]
      have hid : ‖s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3‖ ≤ ‖s‖ * 1 :=
        (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le s _).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id_le (norm_nonneg _))
      calc ‖m • (fderiv ℝ f (x + s • w)).comp (s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)‖
          ≤ ‖m‖ * ‖(fderiv ℝ f (x + s • w)).comp (s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖m‖ * (‖fderiv ℝ f (x + s • w)‖ * ‖s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ ‖m‖ * (‖fderiv ℝ f (x + s • w)‖ * (‖s‖ * 1)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hid (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = m * (s * ‖fderiv ℝ f (x + s • w)‖) := by
            rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hm, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs]; ring
        _ ≤ c := hbd w hw
    have h := (convex_ball (0 : E3) 1).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff hbd' hz' hz
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact h
  
  refine ⟨max (max 1 (4 * R / 3)) (4 * T₀ / 3),
    le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  simp only [max_lt_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨⟨hx1, hxR⟩, hxT⟩ := hx
  set s : ℝ := ‖x‖ / 4 with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by rw [hs]; linarith
  have hsmall : K * (3 * s) ^ (-q) ≤ ε := hT _ (by rw [hs]; linarith)
  have key : ∀ w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1, R < ‖x + s • w‖ ∧
      K * ‖x + s • w‖ ^ (-q) ≤ ε ∧ s * (K * ‖x + s • w‖ ^ (-q - 1)) ≤ ε ∧
      s * (s * (K * ‖x + s • w‖ ^ (-q - 2))) ≤ ε := by
    intro w hw
    have hw1 : ‖w‖ < 1 := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hw
    have h1 := norm_sub_norm_le x (-(s • w))
    rw [norm_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hs0.le] at h1
    have h2 : s * ‖w‖ < s * 1 := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hw1 hs0
    have h3 : 3 * s < ‖x + s • w‖ := by linarith
    obtain ⟨r0, r1, r2⟩ := hscale s _ hs0 h3
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  intro z hz z' hz'
  refine ⟨fun i j => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun k => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨hRp, r0, -, -⟩ := key z hz
    exact le_trans ((hL _ hRp).1 i j).1 r0
  · have h := hlip (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ i j) x s 1 ε hs0.le zero_le_one
      (fun w hw => ((hL _ (key w hw).1).1 i j).2.1)
      (fun w hw => by
        rw [one_mul]
        exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hL _ (key w hw).1).1 i j).2.2 hs0.le)
          (key w hw).2.2.1)
      z hz z' hz'
    simpa only [one_mul] using h
  · obtain ⟨hRp, -, r1, -⟩ := key z hz
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs0]
    exact le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hL _ hRp).2 k).1 hs0.le) r1
  · exact hlip (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j y)
      x s s ε hs0.le hs0.le
      (fun w hw => ((hL _ (key w hw).1).2 k).2.1)
      (fun w hw => le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hL _ (key w hw).1).2 k).2.2 hs0.le) hs0.le)
        (key w hw).2.2.2)
      z hz z' hz'

subgoal_signatures.name: metric_coeff_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
          (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))) :
    ∃ R C : ℝ, 1 ≤ R ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
        |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: lapLoc_coeff_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (R C : ℝ) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (G x).det ∧ ∀ i j k : Fin 3,
      |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y i j) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z i j) y) x‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 2)) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ y : E3, R < ‖y‖ →
      (∀ i j : Fin 3,
        |(G y)⁻¹ i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ K * ‖y‖ ^ (-q) ∧
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y‖ ≤ K * ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 1)) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin 3,
        |∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j y| ≤ K * ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 1) ∧
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z) y ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j z) y‖
          ≤ K * ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 2))

informal_problem.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U) (x : E3) (s : ℝ) (z : E3) (hz : x + s • z ∈ U) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (x + s • z))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun y' => w (x + s • y')) y) z
      - ∑ k : Fin 3, (s * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (G (x + s • z))⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j (x + s • z)) *
          partialDeriv k (fun y => w (x + s • y)) z
    = s ^ 2 * lapLoc G w (x + s • z)

signature.name: cld_rescaled_equation
signature.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (w : E3 → ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U) (x : E3) (s : ℝ) (z : E3) (hz : x + s • z ∈ U) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (x + s • z))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun y' => w (x + s • y')) y) z
      - ∑ k : Fin 3, (s * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (G (x + s • z))⁻¹ i j * christoffel G k i j (x + s • z)) *
          partialDeriv k (fun y => w (x + s • y)) z

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have key : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ f (x + s • y) → ∀ k : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv k (fun y' => f (x + s • y')) y = s * partialDeriv k f (x + s • y) := by
    intro f y hf k
    have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun y' : E3 => x + s • y') (s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3) y :=
      ((hasFDerivAt_id y).const_smul s).const_add x
    have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun y' => f (x + s • y'))
        ((fderiv ℝ f (x + s • y)).comp (s • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3)) y :=
      hf.hasFDerivAt.comp y hA
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y' => f (x + s • y')) y (e k) = s * fderiv ℝ f (x + s • y) (e k)
    rw [hc.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hAc : Continuous (fun y : E3 => x + s • y) :=
    continuous_const.add (continuous_const.smul continuous_id)
  have hwd : ∀ y : E3, x + s • y ∈ U → DifferentiableAt ℝ w (x + s • y) := fun y hy =>
    (hw.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have h1 : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun y => w (x + s • y)) z
      = s * partialDeriv k w (x + s • z) := key w z (hwd z hz)
  have h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun y' => w (x + s • y')) y) z
        = s ^ 2 * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) (x + s • z) := by
    intro i j
    have hV : IsOpen {y : E3 | x + s • y ∈ U} := hU.preimage hAc
    have heq : (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun y' => w (x + s • y')) y)
        =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (fun y => s * partialDeriv j w (x + s • y)) := by
      filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds hz] with y hy
      exact key w y (hwd y hy) j
    have hwc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ w (x + s • z) := hw.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hz)
    have hdj : DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv j w) (x + s • z) := by
      have h3 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ w) (x + s • z) :=
        hwc.fderiv_right (m := 1) (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
      exact (h3.differentiableAt (by simp)).clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e j))
    have hdj' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q => s * partialDeriv j w q) (x + s • z) :=
      hdj.const_mul s
    have h4 := key (fun q => s * partialDeriv j w q) z hdj' i
    have h5 : partialDeriv i (fun q => s * partialDeriv j w q) (x + s • z)
        = s * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) (x + s • z) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (fun q => s * partialDeriv j w q) (x + s • z) (e i)
        = s * fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j w) (x + s • z) (e i)
      rw [fderiv_const_mul hdj]
      rfl
    have h6 : partialDeriv i (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun y' => w (x + s • y')) y) z
        = partialDeriv i (fun y => s * partialDeriv j w (x + s • y)) z := by
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun y' => w (x + s • y')) y) z (e i)
        = fderiv ℝ (fun y => s * partialDeriv j w (x + s • y)) z (e i)
      rw [heq.fderiv_eq]
    rw [h6, h4, h5]
    ring
  simp only [h1, h2]
  unfold lapLoc hessLoc
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

proof.tactics:
by
  have h1 := MeasureTheory.Measure.setIntegral_comp_smul_of_pos
    (μ := (MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E3))
    (fun w : E3 => f (x + w)) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) 1) hs

informal_problem.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (k : Fin 3) (τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp : ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hUO : U ⊆ O) (P : E3 → E3)
    (hPV : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f (P w), b (P w), (P w) k] = w)
    (hPU : ∀ y ∈ U, (|f y - τ₀| < δ ∧ |b y - β₀| < δ ∧ |y k - σ₀| < δ) ∧
      P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k]) = y) :
    (∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      f (P w) = w 0 ∧ b (P w) = w 1 ∧ (P w) k = w 2) ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} ∩ U =
        (fun z : E2 => P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1])) ''
          {z : E2 | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ ∧ 0 ≤ z 0} ∧
      {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ b y = 0} ∩ U =
        (fun x : ℝ => P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x])) ''
          {x : ℝ | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |x - σ₀| < δ}

signature.name: box_slice_geometry
signature.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (k : Fin 3) (τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp : ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (hUO : U ⊆ O) (P : E3 → E3)
    (hPV : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f (P w), b (P w), (P w) k] = w)
    (hPU : ∀ y ∈ U, (|f y - τ₀| < δ ∧ |b y - β₀| < δ ∧ |y k - σ₀| < δ) ∧
      P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k]) = y) :
    (∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      f (P w) = w 0 ∧ b (P w) = w 1 ∧ (P w) k = w 2) ∧
    ∀ t : ℝ, {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ 0 ≤ b y} ∩ U =
        (fun z : E2 => P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1])) ''
          {z : E2 | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |z 0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |z 1 - σ₀| < δ ∧ 0 ≤ z 0} ∧
      {y : E3 | y ∈ O ∧ f y = t ∧ b y = 0} ∩ U =
        (fun x : ℝ => P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x])) ''
          {x : ℝ | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |x - σ₀| < δ}

proof.tactics:
by
  have hA : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      f (P w) = w 0 ∧ b (P w) = w 1 ∧ (P w) k = w 2 := by
    intro w hw
    have H := (hPV w hw).2.2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v 0) H
      exact this
    · have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v 1) H
      exact this
    · have := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v 2) H
      exact this
  refine ⟨hA, fun t => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨_, hft, hb⟩, hyU⟩
      obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, hP⟩ := hPU y hyU
      refine ⟨(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm ![b y, y k], ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hft]; exact h1
      · exact h2
      · exact h3
      · exact hb
      · show P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, b y, y k]) = y
        rw [← hft]; exact hP
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨ht, hz0, hz1, hnn⟩, rfl⟩
      have hw : |(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1] 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧
          |(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1] 1 - β₀| < δ ∧
          |(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, z 0, z 1] 2 - σ₀| < δ := ⟨ht, hz0, hz1⟩
      obtain ⟨-, hU, -⟩ := hPV _ hw
      obtain ⟨e1, e2, -⟩ := hA _ hw
      exact ⟨⟨hUO hU, e1, hnn.trans_eq e2.symm⟩, hU⟩
  · ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨_, hft, hb0⟩, hyU⟩
      obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, hP⟩ := hPU y hyU
      refine ⟨y k, ⟨?_, ?_, h3⟩, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hft]; exact h1
      · rw [hb0] at h2; exact h2
      · have e : (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, y k] =
            (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f y, b y, y k] := by rw [hft, hb0]
        show P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, y k]) = y
        rw [e]; exact hP
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨ht, h0, hx⟩, rfl⟩
      have hw : |(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x] 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧
          |(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x] 1 - β₀| < δ ∧
          |(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x] 2 - σ₀| < δ := ⟨ht, h0, hx⟩
      obtain ⟨-, hU, -⟩ := hPV _ hw
      obtain ⟨e1, e2, -⟩ := hA _ hw
      exact ⟨⟨hUO hU, e1, e2⟩, hU⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O)
    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b O) (k : Fin 3) (τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp : ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hUO : U ⊆ O)
    (P : E3 → E3)
    (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ})
    (hPV : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f (P w), b (P w), (P w) k] = w) :
    ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ P w) ∧
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b (P w) i ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ f (P w)‖ / Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b (P w) i ^ 2) *
          ‖fderiv ℝ P w (e 2)‖ =
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j)
          (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i) ^ 2)

signature.name: box_chart_calculus
signature.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O)
    (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b O) (k : Fin 3) (τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp : ℝ) (U : Set E3) (hUO : U ⊆ O)
    (P : E3 → E3)
    (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ})
    (hPV : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f (P w), b (P w), (P w) k] = w) :
    ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ P w) ∧
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b (P w) i ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ f (P w)‖ / Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b (P w) i ^ 2) *
          ‖fderiv ℝ P w (e 2)‖ =
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j)
          (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i) ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro w hw
  
  have hnorm : ∀ ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ‖ℓ‖ = Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 3, ℓ (e i) ^ 2) := by
    intro ℓ
    set v := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E3).symm ℓ with hvdef
    have hv : ‖ℓ‖ = ‖v‖ := by simp [v]
    have hvi : ∀ i, v i = ℓ (e i) := by
      intro i
      have h1 : inner ℝ v (e i) = ℓ (e i) := InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
      rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right] at h1
      simpa using h1
    rw [hv, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    simp [hvi, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hexp : ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : E3), ℓ x = ∑ i : Fin 3, ℓ (e i) * x i := by
    intro ℓ x
    have hx : x = x 0 • e 0 + x 1 • e 1 + x 2 • e 2 := by
      ext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [e]
    conv_lhs => rw [hx]
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add, map_smul, mul_comm]
  
  have alg : ∀ a0 a1 a2 c0 c1 c2 r0 r1 r2 x00 x01 x02 x10 x11 x12 x20 x21 x22 : ℝ,
      a0 * x00 + a1 * x01 + a2 * x02 = 1 → a0 * x10 + a1 * x11 + a2 * x12 = 0 →
      a0 * x20 + a1 * x21 + a2 * x22 = 0 →
      c0 * x00 + c1 * x01 + c2 * x02 = 0 → c0 * x10 + c1 * x11 + c2 * x12 = 1 →
      c0 * x20 + c1 * x21 + c2 * x22 = 0 →
      r0 * x00 + r1 * x01 + r2 * x02 = 0 → r0 * x10 + r1 * x11 + r2 * x12 = 0 →
      r0 * x20 + r1 * x21 + r2 * x22 = 1 →
      0 < (a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) ^ 2 + (a2 * c0 - a0 * c2) ^ 2 + (a0 * c1 - a1 * c0) ^ 2 ∧
      Real.sqrt (a0 ^ 2 + a1 ^ 2 + a2 ^ 2) /
          Real.sqrt ((a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) ^ 2 + (a2 * c0 - a0 * c2) ^ 2 + (a0 * c1 - a1 * c0) ^ 2) *
          Real.sqrt (x20 ^ 2 + x21 ^ 2 + x22 ^ 2) =
        Real.sqrt ((x11 * x22 - x12 * x21) ^ 2 + (x12 * x20 - x10 * x22) ^ 2 +
          (x10 * x21 - x11 * x20) ^ 2) := by
    intro a0 a1 a2 c0 c1 c2 r0 r1 r2 x00 x01 x02 x10 x11 x12 x20 x21 x22
      h00 h01 h02 h10 h11 h12 h20 h21 h22
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : ℝ, D = x00 * (x11 * x22 - x12 * x21) + x01 * (x12 * x20 - x10 * x22) +
        x02 * (x10 * x21 - x11 * x20) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = a0 * (c1 * r2 - c2 * r1) + a1 * (c2 * r0 - c0 * r2) +
        a2 * (c0 * r1 - c1 * r0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    
    have hy0 : x11 * x22 - x12 * x21 = D * a0 := by
      linear_combination (-a0) * hD + (-(x11 * x22 - x12 * x21)) * h00 +
        (-(x21 * x02 - x22 * x01)) * h01 + (-(x01 * x12 - x02 * x11)) * h02
    have hy1 : x12 * x20 - x10 * x22 = D * a1 := by
      linear_combination (-a1) * hD + (-(x12 * x20 - x10 * x22)) * h00 +
        (-(x22 * x00 - x20 * x02)) * h01 + (-(x02 * x10 - x00 * x12)) * h02
    have hy2 : x10 * x21 - x11 * x20 = D * a2 := by
      linear_combination (-a2) * hD + (-(x10 * x21 - x11 * x20)) * h00 +
        (-(x20 * x01 - x21 * x00)) * h01 + (-(x00 * x11 - x01 * x10)) * h02
    
    have hc0 : a1 * c2 - a2 * c1 = E * x20 := by
      linear_combination (-x20) * hE + (-(a1 * c2 - a2 * c1)) * h22 +
        (-(c1 * r2 - c2 * r1)) * h02 + (-(r1 * a2 - r2 * a1)) * h12
    have hc1 : a2 * c0 - a0 * c2 = E * x21 := by
      linear_combination (-x21) * hE + (-(a2 * c0 - a0 * c2)) * h22 +
        (-(c2 * r0 - c0 * r2)) * h02 + (-(r2 * a0 - r0 * a2)) * h12
    have hc2 : a0 * c1 - a1 * c0 = E * x22 := by
      linear_combination (-x22) * hE + (-(a0 * c1 - a1 * c0)) * h22 +
        (-(c0 * r1 - c1 * r0)) * h02 + (-(r0 * a1 - r1 * a0)) * h12
    
    have hED : E * D = 1 := by
      linear_combination D * hE +
        (a0 * (c1 * r2 - c2 * r1) + a1 * (c2 * r0 - c0 * r2) + a2 * (c0 * r1 - c1 * r0)) * hD +
        ((c0 * x10 + c1 * x11 + c2 * x12) * (r0 * x20 + r1 * x21 + r2 * x22) -
          (c0 * x20 + c1 * x21 + c2 * x22) * (r0 * x10 + r1 * x11 + r2 * x12)) * h00 +
        (r0 * x20 + r1 * x21 + r2 * x22) * h11 + h22 -
        (r0 * x10 + r1 * x11 + r2 * x12) * h12 -
        ((c0 * x00 + c1 * x01 + c2 * x02) * (r0 * x20 + r1 * x21 + r2 * x22) -
          (c0 * x20 + c1 * x21 + c2 * x22) * (r0 * x00 + r1 * x01 + r2 * x02)) * h01 +
        ((c0 * x00 + c1 * x01 + c2 * x02) * (r0 * x10 + r1 * x11 + r2 * x12) -
          (c0 * x10 + c1 * x11 + c2 * x12) * (r0 * x00 + r1 * x01 + r2 * x02)) * h02
    have hE0 : E ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hED
    have hN : 0 < x20 ^ 2 + x21 ^ 2 + x22 ^ 2 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have e0 : x20 ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith [sq_nonneg x20, sq_nonneg x21, sq_nonneg x22]
      have e1 : x21 ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith [sq_nonneg x20, sq_nonneg x21, sq_nonneg x22]
      have e2 : x22 ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith [sq_nonneg x20, sq_nonneg x21, sq_nonneg x22]
      have f0 : x20 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp e0
      have f1 : x21 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp e1
      have f2 : x22 = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp e2
      rw [f0, f1, f2] at h22
      norm_num at h22
    have hQ : (a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) ^ 2 + (a2 * c0 - a0 * c2) ^ 2 + (a0 * c1 - a1 * c0) ^ 2 =
        E ^ 2 * (x20 ^ 2 + x21 ^ 2 + x22 ^ 2) := by
      rw [hc0, hc1, hc2]; ring
    have hT : (x11 * x22 - x12 * x21) ^ 2 + (x12 * x20 - x10 * x22) ^ 2 +
        (x10 * x21 - x11 * x20) ^ 2 = D ^ 2 * (a0 ^ 2 + a1 ^ 2 + a2 ^ 2) := by
      rw [hy0, hy1, hy2]; ring
    have hE2 : 0 < E ^ 2 := by positivity
    refine ⟨by rw [hQ]; exact mul_pos hE2 hN, ?_⟩
    rw [hQ, hT, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg E), Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg D), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs,
      Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    have hsN : 0 < Real.sqrt (x20 ^ 2 + x21 ^ 2 + x22 ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hN
    have hEa : 0 < |E| := abs_pos.mpr hE0
    have hEDabs : |E| * |D| = 1 := by rw [← abs_mul, hED, abs_one]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt (mul_pos hEa hsN))]
    linear_combination (-(Real.sqrt (a0 ^ 2 + a1 ^ 2 + a2 ^ 2) *
      Real.sqrt (x20 ^ 2 + x21 ^ 2 + x22 ^ 2))) * hEDabs
  
  have hVo : IsOpen {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := by
    have c0 : Continuous (fun w : E3 => |w 0 - τ₀|) := by fun_prop
    have c1 : Continuous (fun w : E3 => |w 1 - β₀|) := by fun_prop
    have c2 : Continuous (fun w : E3 => |w 2 - σ₀|) := by fun_prop
    exact (isOpen_lt c0 continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt c1 continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt c2 continuous_const))
  have hVn : {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} ∈ 𝓝 w :=
    hVo.mem_nhds hw
  have hPwU : P w ∈ U := (hPV w hw).2.1
  have hOn : O ∈ 𝓝 (P w) := hO.mem_nhds (hUO hPwU)
  have hfd : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f (P w)) (P w) :=
    ((hf.contDiffAt hOn).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have hbd : HasFDerivAt b (fderiv ℝ b (P w)) (P w) :=
    ((hb.contDiffAt hOn).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have hPd : HasFDerivAt P (fderiv ℝ P w) w :=
    ((hP.contDiffAt hVn).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have hcoord : ∀ w' : E3, |w' 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w' 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w' 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      f (P w') = w' 0 ∧ b (P w') = w' 1 ∧ (P w') k = w' 2 := by
    intro w' hw'
    have h := (hPV w' hw').2.2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact congrArg (fun v : E3 => v 0) h
    · exact congrArg (fun v : E3 => v 1) h
    · exact congrArg (fun v : E3 => v 2) h
  have hL0 : (fderiv ℝ f (P w)).comp (fderiv ℝ P w) =
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
    have h1 := hfd.comp w hPd
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (f ∘ P) (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) w := by
      apply (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
      filter_upwards [hVn] with w' hw'
      exact (hcoord w' hw').1
    exact h1.unique h2
  have hL1 : (fderiv ℝ b (P w)).comp (fderiv ℝ P w) =
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
    have h1 := hbd.comp w hPd
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (b ∘ P) (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) w := by
      apply (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
      filter_upwards [hVn] with w' hw'
      exact (hcoord w' hw').2.1
    exact h1.unique h2
  have hL2 : (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ P w) =
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
    have h1 := (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp w hPd
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ P)
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) w := by
      apply (EuclideanSpace.proj (2 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
      filter_upwards [hVn] with w' hw'
      exact (hcoord w' hw').2.2
    exact h1.unique h2
  have r0 : ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ f (P w) (fderiv ℝ P w v) = v 0 := fun v =>
    congrArg (fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T v) hL0
  have r1 : ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ b (P w) (fderiv ℝ P w v) = v 1 := fun v =>
    congrArg (fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T v) hL1
  have r2 : ∀ v : E3, (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (fderiv ℝ P w v) = v 2 := fun v =>
    congrArg (fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T v) hL2
  
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ P w) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro v hv
    have a0 : v 0 = 0 := by rw [← r0 v, hv, map_zero]
    have a1 : v 1 = 0 := by rw [← r1 v, hv, map_zero]
    have a2 : v 2 = 0 := by rw [← r2 v, hv, map_zero]
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [a0, a1, a2]
  
  have rel : ∀ (ℓ : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (j : Fin 3), ℓ (fderiv ℝ P w (e j)) =
      ℓ (e 0) * fderiv ℝ P w (e j) 0 + ℓ (e 1) * fderiv ℝ P w (e j) 1 +
        ℓ (e 2) * fderiv ℝ P w (e j) 2 := by
    intro ℓ j
    rw [hexp ℓ (fderiv ℝ P w (e j)), Fin.sum_univ_three]
  have h00 := (rel (fderiv ℝ f (P w)) 0).symm.trans (r0 (e 0))
  have h01 := (rel (fderiv ℝ f (P w)) 1).symm.trans (r0 (e 1))
  have h02 := (rel (fderiv ℝ f (P w)) 2).symm.trans (r0 (e 2))
  have h10 := (rel (fderiv ℝ b (P w)) 0).symm.trans (r1 (e 0))
  have h11 := (rel (fderiv ℝ b (P w)) 1).symm.trans (r1 (e 1))
  have h12 := (rel (fderiv ℝ b (P w)) 2).symm.trans (r1 (e 2))
  have h20 := (rel (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) 0).symm.trans (r2 (e 0))
  have h21 := (rel (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) 1).symm.trans (r2 (e 1))
  have h22 := (rel (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) 2).symm.trans (r2 (e 2))
  have v00 : (e 0 : E3) 0 = 1 := by simp [e]
  have v10 : (e 1 : E3) 0 = 0 := by simp [e]
  have v20 : (e 2 : E3) 0 = 0 := by simp [e]
  have v01 : (e 0 : E3) 1 = 0 := by simp [e]
  have v11 : (e 1 : E3) 1 = 1 := by simp [e]
  have v21 : (e 2 : E3) 1 = 0 := by simp [e]
  have v02 : (e 0 : E3) 2 = 0 := by simp [e]
  have v12 : (e 1 : E3) 2 = 0 := by simp [e]
  have v22 : (e 2 : E3) 2 = 1 := by simp [e]
  rw [v00] at h00
  rw [v10] at h01
  rw [v20] at h02
  rw [v01] at h10
  rw [v11] at h11
  rw [v21] at h12
  rw [v02] at h20
  rw [v12] at h21
  rw [v22] at h22
  obtain ⟨hQpos, hid⟩ := alg _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    h00 h01 h02 h10 h11 h12 h20 h21 h22
  
  have hQeq : ∑ i : Fin 3, sbgbCross f b (P w) i ^ 2 =
      (fderiv ℝ f (P w) (e 1) * fderiv ℝ b (P w) (e 2) -
          fderiv ℝ f (P w) (e 2) * fderiv ℝ b (P w) (e 1)) ^ 2 +
        (fderiv ℝ f (P w) (e 2) * fderiv ℝ b (P w) (e 0) -
          fderiv ℝ f (P w) (e 0) * fderiv ℝ b (P w) (e 2)) ^ 2 +
        (fderiv ℝ f (P w) (e 0) * fderiv ℝ b (P w) (e 1) -
          fderiv ℝ f (P w) (e 1) * fderiv ℝ b (P w) (e 0)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rfl
  have hTeq : ∑ i : Fin 3, (crossProduct (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) j)
      (fun j => fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) j) i) ^ 2 =
      (fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) 1 * fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) 2 -
          fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) 2 * fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) 1) ^ 2 +
        (fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) 2 * fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) 0 -
          fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) 0 * fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) 2) ^ 2 +
        (fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) 0 * fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) 1 -
          fderiv ℝ P w (e 1) 1 * fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) 0) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, cross_apply]
    rfl
  have hNeq : ‖fderiv ℝ P w (e 2)‖ = Real.sqrt (fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) 0 ^ 2 +
      fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) 1 ^ 2 + fderiv ℝ P w (e 2) 2 ^ 2) := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hFeq : ‖fderiv ℝ f (P w)‖ = Real.sqrt (fderiv ℝ f (P w) (e 0) ^ 2 +
      fderiv ℝ f (P w) (e 1) ^ 2 + fderiv ℝ f (P w) (e 2) ^ 2) := by
    rw [hnorm, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  refine ⟨hinj, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hQeq]; exact hQpos
  · rw [hFeq, hQeq, hNeq, hTeq]; exact hid

informal_problem.statement:
(f b : E3 → ℝ) (k : Fin 3) (τ₀ β₀ σ₀ δ Lp : ℝ) (U : Set E3)
    (P : E3 → E3)
    (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ})
    (hPV : ∀ w : E3, |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ P w‖ ≤ Lp ∧ P w ∈ U ∧
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![f (P w), b (P w), (P w) k] = w)
    (t : ℝ) :
    IsOpen {x : ℝ | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |x - σ₀| < δ} ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x]))
      {x : ℝ | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |x - σ₀| < δ} ∧
    Set.InjOn (fun x : ℝ => P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x]))
      {x : ℝ | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |x - σ₀| < δ} ∧
    ∀ x ∈ {x : ℝ | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |x - σ₀| < δ},
      deriv (fun x : ℝ => P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x])) x =
        fderiv ℝ P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x]) (e 2)

signature.statement:

proof.tactics:
by
  have hAff : (fun x : ℝ => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x]) =
      fun x : ℝ => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, 0] + x • e 2 := by
    funext x
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hAd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x])
      (e 2) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hAff]
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id x).smul_const (e 2)).const_add
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, 0])
    simpa using h
  have hAs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : ℝ => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x]) := by
    rw [hAff]
    exact contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.smul contDiff_const)
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun w : E3 => w i) := fun i => PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ i
  have hVopen : IsOpen {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := by
    refine IsOpen.and ?_ (IsOpen.and ?_ ?_)
    · exact isOpen_lt (((hc 0).sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (((hc 1).sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt (((hc 2).sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun x : ℝ => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x])
      {x : ℝ | |t - τ₀| < δ ∧ |0 - β₀| < δ ∧ |x - σ₀| < δ}
      {w : E3 | |w 0 - τ₀| < δ ∧ |w 1 - β₀| < δ ∧ |w 2 - σ₀| < δ} := fun x hx => hx
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine IsOpen.and ?_ (IsOpen.and ?_ ?_)
    · exact isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_const
    · exact isOpen_lt ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).abs) continuous_const
  · exact hP.comp hAs.contDiffOn hmaps
  · intro x hx x' hx' hxx
    have hxx' : P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x]) =
        P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x']) := hxx
    have h1 := (hPV _ (hmaps hx)).2.2
    have h2 := (hPV _ (hmaps hx')).2.2
    rw [hxx'] at h1
    have h3 := congrArg (fun v : E3 => v 2) (h1.symm.trans h2)
    exact h3
  · intro x hx
    have hPd : HasFDerivAt P (fderiv ℝ P ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x]))
        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 3) ℝ).symm ![t, 0, x]) :=
      ((hP.contDiffAt (hVopen.mem_nhds (hmaps hx))).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    exact (hPd.comp_hasDerivAt x (hAd x)).deriv

informal_problem.statement:
(γ : ℝ → E3) (W : Set ℝ) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ γ W) (hinj : Set.InjOn γ W) (hdγ : ∀ x ∈ W, deriv γ x ≠ 0)
    (W' : Set ℝ) (hW' : MeasurableSet W') (hW'W : W' ⊆ W) (h : E3 → ℝ) :
    ∫ y in γ '' W', h y ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ)) =
      ∫ x in W', h (γ x) * ‖deriv γ x‖

signature.name: sbgb_curve_length_formula
signature.statement:
(γ : ℝ → E3) (W : Set ℝ) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hγ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ γ W) (hinj : Set.InjOn γ W) (hdγ : ∀ x ∈ W, deriv γ x ≠ 0)
    (W' : Set ℝ) (hW' : MeasurableSet W') (hW'W : W' ⊆ W) (h : E3 → ℝ) :
    ∫ y in γ '' W', h y ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ)) =
      ∫ x in W', h (γ x) * ‖deriv γ x‖

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  
  
  have hloc : ∀ x₀ ∈ W, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 →
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ W ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r,
          (1 - ε) * ‖deriv γ x₀‖ ≤ ‖deriv γ x‖ ∧ ‖deriv γ x‖ ≤ (1 + ε) * ‖deriv γ x₀‖) ∧
        ∀ S : Set ℝ, S ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r →
          MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' S) ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal (1 + ε) * (ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x₀‖ * MeasureTheory.volume S) ∧
            ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x₀‖ * MeasureTheory.volume S ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε)⁻¹) *
                MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' S) := by
    intro x₀ hx₀ ε hε hε1
    have hm0 : 0 < ‖deriv γ x₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hdγ x₀ hx₀)
    have hdc : ContinuousAt (deriv γ) x₀ :=
      (hγ.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hx₀)
    obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hr₁W⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hr₂d⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hdc (ε * ‖deriv γ x₀‖) (by positivity)
    have hr : 0 < min r₁ r₂ := lt_min hr₁ hr₂
    have hballW : Metric.ball x₀ (min r₁ r₂) ⊆ W :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _)).trans hr₁W
    have hdv : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (min r₁ r₂), ‖deriv γ x - deriv γ x₀‖ < ε * ‖deriv γ x₀‖ := by
      intro x hx
      have hxd : dist x x₀ < r₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Metric.mem_ball.mp hx) (min_le_right _ _)
      have := hr₂d hxd
      rwa [dist_eq_norm] at this
    have hE : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (min r₁ r₂), ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (min r₁ r₂),
        (1 - ε) * (‖deriv γ x₀‖ * |x - y|) ≤ ‖γ x - γ y‖ ∧
          ‖γ x - γ y‖ ≤ (1 + ε) * (‖deriv γ x₀‖ * |x - y|) := by
      intro x hx y hy
      have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (min r₁ r₂),
          DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => γ w - w • deriv γ x₀) z := by
        intro z hz
        have hγz : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ z :=
          (hγ.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds (hballW hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
        exact hγz.sub (differentiableAt_id.smul_const (deriv γ x₀))
      have hbound : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x₀ (min r₁ r₂),
          ‖deriv (fun w => γ w - w • deriv γ x₀) z‖ ≤ ε * ‖deriv γ x₀‖ := by
        intro z hz
        have hγz : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ z :=
          (hγ.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds (hballW hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hd : HasDerivAt (fun w => γ w - w • deriv γ x₀)
            (deriv γ z - (1 : ℝ) • deriv γ x₀) z :=
          hγz.hasDerivAt.sub ((hasDerivAt_id z).smul_const (deriv γ x₀))
        rw [hd.deriv, one_smul]
        exact (hdv z hz).le
      have hmvt := (convex_ball x₀ (min r₁ r₂)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le hdiff hbound hy hx
      have hrw : (γ x - x • deriv γ x₀) - (γ y - y • deriv γ x₀) =
          (γ x - γ y) - (x - y) • deriv γ x₀ := by
        rw [sub_smul]; abel
      rw [hrw, Real.norm_eq_abs (x - y)] at hmvt
      have hn : ‖(x - y) • deriv γ x₀‖ = ‖deriv γ x₀‖ * |x - y| := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm]
      have t1 : ‖γ x - γ y‖ ≤ ‖(x - y) • deriv γ x₀‖ +
          ‖(γ x - γ y) - (x - y) • deriv γ x₀‖ := by
        have := norm_add_le ((x - y) • deriv γ x₀) ((γ x - γ y) - (x - y) • deriv γ x₀)
        simpa using this
      have t2 : ‖(x - y) • deriv γ x₀‖ ≤ ‖γ x - γ y‖ +
          ‖(γ x - γ y) - (x - y) • deriv γ x₀‖ := by
        have := norm_sub_le (γ x - γ y) ((γ x - γ y) - (x - y) • deriv γ x₀)
        simpa using this
      rw [hn] at t1 t2
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    refine ⟨min r₁ r₂, hr, hballW, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      have h1 := hdv x hx
      have h2 := abs_norm_sub_norm_le (deriv γ x) (deriv γ x₀)
      rw [abs_le] at h2
      obtain ⟨h2a, h2b⟩ := h2
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    · intro S hS
      have hES : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S,
          (1 - ε) * (‖deriv γ x₀‖ * |x - y|) ≤ ‖γ x - γ y‖ ∧
            ‖γ x - γ y‖ ≤ (1 + ε) * (‖deriv γ x₀‖ * |x - y|) :=
        fun x hx y hy => hE x (hS hx) y (hS hy)
      have h1e : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - ε := by linarith
      have hp : 0 < (1 - ε) * ‖deriv γ x₀‖ := mul_pos h1e hm0
      
      have hup : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' S) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) * ‖deriv γ x₀‖) * MeasureTheory.volume S := by
        have hlip : LipschitzOnWith (Real.toNNReal ((1 + ε) * ‖deriv γ x₀‖)) γ S := by
          apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le'
          intro x hx y hy
          rw [dist_eq_norm, Real.dist_eq]
          have := (hES x hx y hy).2
          linarith
        have := hlip.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
        rw [ENNReal.rpow_one, MeasureTheory.hausdorffMeasure_real] at this
        exact this
      
      have hinjS : Set.InjOn γ S := by
        intro x hx y hy hxy
        have h := (hES x hx y hy).1
        rw [hxy, sub_self, norm_zero] at h
        have h0 : |x - y| = 0 := by
          have := abs_nonneg (x - y)
          nlinarith
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp h0)
      have hlow : MeasureTheory.volume S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (((1 - ε) * ‖deriv γ x₀‖)⁻¹) *
          MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' S) := by
        have hli := hinjS.leftInvOn_invFunOn
        have hHlip : LipschitzOnWith (Real.toNNReal ((1 - ε) * ‖deriv γ x₀‖)⁻¹)
            (Function.invFunOn γ S) (γ '' S) := by
          apply LipschitzOnWith.of_dist_le'
          rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          rw [hli hx, hli hy, Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, le_inv_mul_iff₀ hp]
          have := (hES x hx y hy).1
          linarith
        have himg : Function.invFunOn γ S '' (γ '' S) = S := by
          ext z
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
            rw [hli hx]
            exact hx
          · intro hz
            exact ⟨γ z, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, hli hz⟩
        have := hHlip.hausdorffMeasure_image_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
        rw [himg, ENNReal.rpow_one, MeasureTheory.hausdorffMeasure_real] at this
        exact this
      constructor
      · rw [← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by linarith)]
        exact hup
      · have hcoef : ‖deriv γ x₀‖ * ((1 - ε) * ‖deriv γ x₀‖)⁻¹ = (1 - ε)⁻¹ := by
          rw [mul_inv, mul_left_comm, mul_inv_cancel₀ hm0.ne', mul_one]
        calc ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x₀‖ * MeasureTheory.volume S
            ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x₀‖ * (ENNReal.ofReal (((1 - ε) * ‖deriv γ x₀‖)⁻¹) *
                MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' S)) := by gcongr
          _ = ENNReal.ofReal (‖deriv γ x₀‖ * ((1 - ε) * ‖deriv γ x₀‖)⁻¹) *
                MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' S) := by
              rw [← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hm0.le]
          _ = _ := by rw [hcoef]
  
  
  
  have hγc : ContinuousOn γ W := hγ.continuousOn
  have hmeas : ∀ T : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet T → T ⊆ W →
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' T) =
        ∫⁻ x in T, ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖ := by
    intro T hT hTW
    rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty W with hWe | hWne
    · have hTe : T = ∅ := Set.subset_empty_iff.mp (hWe ▸ hTW)
      subst hTe
      simp
    
    have squeeze : ∀ a b : ENNReal, (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 →
        a ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) * (1 - ε)⁻¹) * b ∧
        b ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) * (1 - ε)⁻¹) * a) → a = b := by
      intro a b h
      have key : ∀ (k : ℝ → ℝ) (x y : ENNReal), ContinuousAt k 0 → k 0 = 1 →
          (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 → x ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (k ε) * y) → x ≤ y := by
        intro k x y hk hk0 hxy
        have h1 : Filter.Tendsto k (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 1) := by
          have := hk.tendsto
          rw [hk0] at this
          exact this.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
        have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun ε => ENNReal.ofReal (k ε)) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0))
            (nhds 1) := by
          have := ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal h1
          rwa [ENNReal.ofReal_one] at this
        have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun ε => ENNReal.ofReal (k ε) * y) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0))
            (nhds (1 * y)) :=
          ENNReal.Tendsto.mul_const h2 (Or.inl one_ne_zero)
        rw [one_mul] at h3
        have hev : ∀ᶠ ε in nhdsWithin (0 : ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0), x ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (k ε) * y := by
          filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (zero_lt_one' ℝ)] with ε hε
          exact hxy ε hε.1 hε.2
        exact ge_of_tendsto h3 hev
      have hk : ContinuousAt (fun ε : ℝ => (1 + ε) * (1 - ε)⁻¹) 0 :=
        (continuous_const.add continuous_id).continuousAt.mul
          ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousAt.inv₀ (by norm_num))
      refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
      · exact key _ a b hk (by norm_num) (fun ε h0 h1 => (h ε h0 h1).1)
      · exact key _ b a hk (by norm_num) (fun ε h0 h1 => (h ε h0 h1).2)
    
    have piece : ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ε < 1 → ∀ (J0 : ℝ) (S : Set ℝ), MeasurableSet S →
        (∀ x ∈ S, (1 - ε) * J0 ≤ ‖deriv γ x‖ ∧ ‖deriv γ x‖ ≤ (1 + ε) * J0) →
        ∀ m : ENNReal,
        m ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + ε) * (ENNReal.ofReal J0 * MeasureTheory.volume S) →
        ENNReal.ofReal J0 * MeasureTheory.volume S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε)⁻¹) * m →
        m ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) * (1 - ε)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ x in S, ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖ ∧
          ∫⁻ x in S, ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) * (1 - ε)⁻¹) * m := by
      intro ε hε hε1 J0 S hS hJ m hup hlo
      have h1e : 0 ≤ 1 + ε := by linarith
      have h1me : 0 < 1 - ε := by linarith
      have hne : 1 - ε ≠ 0 := h1me.ne'
      have hinv : 0 ≤ (1 - ε)⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr h1me.le
      have hpu : ∀ x ∈ S, ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖ ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (1 + ε) * ENNReal.ofReal J0 := by
        intro x hx
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul h1e]
        exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hJ x hx).2
      have hpl : ∀ x ∈ S, ENNReal.ofReal J0 ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε)⁻¹) * ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖ := by
        intro x hx
        rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hinv]
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hJ x hx).1 hinv
        refine le_of_eq_of_le ?_ h2
        rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_mul]
      have hI_le : ∫⁻ x in S, ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖ ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (1 + ε) * ENNReal.ofReal J0 * MeasureTheory.volume S := by
        calc _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in S, ENNReal.ofReal (1 + ε) * ENNReal.ofReal J0 :=
              MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_mono' hS hpu
          _ = _ := MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_const _ _
      have hV_le : ENNReal.ofReal J0 * MeasureTheory.volume S ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ x in S, ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖ := by
        calc _ = ∫⁻ x in S, ENNReal.ofReal J0 := (MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_const _ _).symm
          _ ≤ ∫⁻ x in S, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε)⁻¹) * ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖ :=
              MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_mono' hS hpl
          _ = _ := MeasureTheory.lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
      constructor
      · calc m ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + ε) * (ENNReal.ofReal J0 * MeasureTheory.volume S) := hup
          _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + ε) * (ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε)⁻¹) *
              ∫⁻ x in S, ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖) := by gcongr
          _ = _ := by rw [← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul h1e]
      · calc _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + ε) * (ENNReal.ofReal J0 * MeasureTheory.volume S) := by
              rw [← mul_assoc]; exact hI_le
          _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + ε) * (ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε)⁻¹) * m) := by gcongr
          _ = _ := by rw [← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul h1e]
    
    apply squeeze
    intro ε hε hε1
    choose! r hr0 hrW hrJ hrS using fun x hx => hloc x hx ε hε hε1
    obtain ⟨Tc, hTcW, hTcc, hTcU⟩ := TopologicalSpace.isOpen_biUnion_countable W
      (fun x => Metric.ball x (r x)) (fun x _ => Metric.isOpen_ball)
    have hWsub : W ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ W, Metric.ball x (r x) := fun x hx =>
      Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨x, hx, Metric.mem_ball_self (hr0 x hx)⟩
    have hTcne : Tc.Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hWne
      have hw' := hWsub hw
      rw [← hTcU] at hw'
      obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hw'
      exact ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hTcc.exists_eq_range hTcne
    have hcW : ∀ n, c n ∈ W := fun n => hTcW ⟨n, rfl⟩
    set B : ℕ → Set ℝ := fun n => Metric.ball (c n) (r (c n)) with hB
    set P := disjointed B with hP
    have hPm : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (P n) :=
      MeasurableSet.disjointed (fun n => measurableSet_ball)
    have hPd : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint P) := disjoint_disjointed B
    have hPB : ∀ n, P n ⊆ B n := disjointed_subset B
    have hcov : W ⊆ ⋃ n, P n := by
      rw [hP, iUnion_disjointed]
      intro x hx
      have hx' := hWsub hx
      rw [← hTcU, Set.biUnion_range] at hx'
      exact hx'
    set Tn : ℕ → Set ℝ := fun n => T ∩ P n with hTn
    have hTnm : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (Tn n) := fun n => hT.inter (hPm n)
    have hTnd : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint Tn) := fun i j hij =>
      (hPd hij).mono Set.inter_subset_right Set.inter_subset_right
    have hTnW : ∀ n, Tn n ⊆ W := fun n => Set.inter_subset_left.trans hTW
    have hTnB : ∀ n, Tn n ⊆ Metric.ball (c n) (r (c n)) := fun n =>
      Set.inter_subset_right.trans (hPB n)
    have hTU : T = ⋃ n, Tn n := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hcov (hTW hx))
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, hx, hn⟩
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
        exact hn.1
    have hA : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' T) =
        ∑' n, MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' Tn n) := by
      have hA' : MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' ⋃ n, Tn n) =
          ∑' n, MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' Tn n) := by
        rw [Set.image_iUnion]
        refine MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion ?_ ?_
        · intro i j hij
          rw [Function.onFun, Set.disjoint_left]
          rintro y ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩
          have hqp := hinj (hTnW j hq) (hTnW i hp) hpq
          subst hqp
          exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hTnd hij) hp hq
        · intro n
          exact (hTnm n).image_of_continuousOn_injOn (hγc.mono (hTnW n)) (hinj.mono (hTnW n))
      rw [← hTU] at hA'
      exact hA'
    have hB2 : ∫⁻ x in T, ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖ =
        ∑' n, ∫⁻ x in Tn n, ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖ := by
      have h := MeasureTheory.lintegral_iUnion (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hTnm hTnd
        (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ x‖)
      rw [← hTU] at h
      exact h
    have hpc := fun n => piece ε hε hε1 ‖deriv γ (c n)‖ (Tn n)
      (hTnm n) (fun x hx => hrJ (c n) (hcW n) x (hTnB n hx))
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ) (γ '' Tn n))
      (hrS (c n) (hcW n) (Tn n) (hTnB n)).1 (hrS (c n) (hcW n) (Tn n) (hTnB n)).2
    rw [hA, hB2]
    constructor
    · exact (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun n => (hpc n).1).trans (le_of_eq ENNReal.tsum_mul_left)
    · exact (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun n => (hpc n).2).trans (le_of_eq ENNReal.tsum_mul_left)
  
  
  
  have hρm : Measurable (fun x => ‖deriv γ x‖) := (measurable_deriv γ).norm
  have he : MeasurableEmbedding (W'.restrict γ) :=
    ContinuousOn.measurableEmbedding hW' (hγc.mono hW'W) (hinj.mono hW'W)
  set μ' : MeasureTheory.Measure W' := MeasureTheory.Measure.comap Subtype.val MeasureTheory.volume
    with hμ'
  set f : W' → NNReal := fun x => (‖deriv γ x‖).toNNReal with hfdef
  have hf : Measurable f := (hρm.comp measurable_subtype_coe).real_toNNReal
  have key : MeasureTheory.Measure.map (W'.restrict γ) (μ'.withDensity (fun x => (f x : ENNReal))) =
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ)).restrict (γ '' W') := by
    ext B hB
    rw [he.map_apply, MeasureTheory.withDensity_apply _ (he.measurable hB),
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply hB]
    have hT : Subtype.val '' ((W'.restrict γ) ⁻¹' B) = W' ∩ γ ⁻¹' B := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨y.2, hy⟩
      · rintro ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
        exact ⟨⟨x, hx1⟩, hx2, rfl⟩
    have hTm : MeasurableSet (W' ∩ γ ⁻¹' B) := by
      rw [← hT]
      exact (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hW').measurableSet_image' (he.measurable hB)
    have h1 : ∫⁻ x in (W'.restrict γ) ⁻¹' B, (f x : ENNReal) ∂μ' =
        ∫⁻ x in (W'.restrict γ) ⁻¹' B, (fun y : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ y‖) (x : ℝ) ∂μ' := rfl
    rw [h1, hμ', MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_subtype hW' _
        (fun y : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ‖deriv γ y‖), hT,
      ← hmeas (W' ∩ γ ⁻¹' B) hTm (Set.inter_subset_left.trans hW'W),
      Set.image_inter_preimage, Set.inter_comm]
  calc ∫ y in γ '' W', h y ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (1 : ℝ))
      = ∫ y, h y ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.map (W'.restrict γ)
          (μ'.withDensity (fun x => (f x : ENNReal)))) := by rw [key]
    _ = ∫ x : W', h (W'.restrict γ x) ∂(μ'.withDensity (fun x => (f x : ENNReal))) :=
        he.integral_map h
    _ = ∫ x : W', f x • h (W'.restrict γ x) ∂μ' :=
        integral_withDensity_eq_integral_smul hf _
    _ = ∫ x : W', (fun y : ℝ => ‖deriv γ y‖ * h (γ y)) (x : ℝ) ∂μ' := by
        congr 1
        funext x
        simp only [hfdef, NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (norm_nonneg _),
          Set.restrict_apply]
    _ = ∫ x in W', ‖deriv γ x‖ * h (γ x) := by
        rw [hμ']
        exact MeasureTheory.integral_subtype_comap hW' (fun y : ℝ => ‖deriv γ y‖ * h (γ y))
    _ = ∫ x in W', h (γ x) * ‖deriv γ x‖ := by
        congr 1
        funext x
        exact mul_comm _ _

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds)
    (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) (hβ : IsExteriorDomain (hAF.ends k) β Re)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0)
    (X Y : E3 → E3) (R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) (hXY : CoordChange X Y (min hAF.q (3 / 4)) R₀ R₁ C)
    (hRe : Re ≤ R₀)
    (hX : ∀ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ → X y = cylPt (u ((hAF.ends k).Φ y)) (y 1) (y 2))
    (hdom : (∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
        u (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y x) = x 0 ∧ 0 < β (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y x)) ∧
      ∀ L : ℝ, R₁ < L → IsCompact (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L) ∧
        IsOpen (sternOuter (hAF.ends k) Y L) ∧ IsClosed (sternOuterClosed (hAF.ends k) Y L) ∧
        ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < L → IsCompact (sternSide (hAF.ends k) Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}))
    (hconn : ∀ L : ℝ, R₁ < L → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < L →
      (∀ p ∈ sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t},
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0) →
      IsConnected (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}))
    (hchart : ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ →
      g.coeff (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y) x = pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y x ∧
      g.gradInner u u (sternPsi (hAF.ends k) Y x) =
        (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y x)⁻¹ 0 0 ∧
      lapLoc (pullbackMetric (g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ) Y) (fun z : E3 => z 0) x = 0) :
    ∀ L : ℝ, R₁ + 1 ≤ L → ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < L →
      (∀ p ∈ sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0) →
      ∃ (σ₀ δ₀ : ℝ) (S : Set M) (P : EigPatchedSurface M S) (ρ : Fin P.n → M → ℝ)
        (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2) (b : M → ℝ) (js : Fin P.n),
        sspGood g (hAF.ends k) β u Y R₁ L t σ₀ δ₀ S P ρ Kc b js

by
  intro L hL t ht hreg
  have hR₁L : R₁ < L := by linarith
  obtain ⟨σ₀, b, ψs, Z, V, Os, prs, Kcs, hside⟩ :=
    ssp_side_data g (hAF.ends k) β u hβ.1 hu X Y _ R₀ R₁ C hXY hdom.1
      (fun x hx => (hchart x hx).1) L t hL ht
  have hside' := hside
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, ⟨hZc, hVo⟩, -, hnotV, -⟩ := hside'
  obtain ⟨hcptΩ, -, hOC, -⟩ := hdom.2 L hR₁L
  have hcpt : IsCompact (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}) :=
    hcptΩ.inter_right (isClosed_singleton.preimage hu.continuous)
  have hcon := hconn L hR₁L t ht hreg
  set U : Set M := Zᶜ ∩ (sternOuterClosed (hAF.ends k) Y L)ᶜ with hUdef
  have hUo : IsOpen U := hZc.isOpen_compl.inter hOC.isOpen_compl
  have hK : IsCompact (sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∩ Vᶜ) :=
    hcpt.inter_right hVo.isClosed_compl
  have hKU : sternDomain (hAF.ends k) β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∩ Vᶜ ⊆ U := by
    intro p hp
    exact hnotV p hp.1 hp.2

def sspSideData (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : EndChart M) (β u : M → ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3)
    (R₁ L t σ₀ : ℝ) (b ψs : M → ℝ) (Z V Os : Set M) (prs : M → E2) (Kcs : Set E2) : Prop :=
  let Ws : Set E2 := {x : E2 | L ^ 2 - 2 < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ∧ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 < L ^ 2 + 1 / 2}
  let ps : E2 → M := fun x => sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))
  let hs : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t
  let Sg : Set M := sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}
  (0 < σ₀ ∧ σ₀ < 1 ∧ R₁ ^ 2 < L ^ 2 - 2) ∧
  (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ b ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψs ∧ ∀ z, 0 ≤ ψs z) ∧
  (IsCompact (tsupport ψs) ∧ tsupport ψs ⊆ Os) ∧
  (IsOpen Os ∧ ContinuousOn ps Ws ∧ ContinuousOn prs Os ∧ ps '' Ws = Os ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∧
    (∀ x ∈ Ws, prs (ps x) = x) ∧ Set.InjOn ps Ws) ∧
  (∀ q' : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => prs ((chartAt E3 q').symm y))
    ((chartAt E3 q').target ∩ (chartAt E3 q').symm ⁻¹' Os)) ∧
  (∀ q' : M,
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => chartAt E3 q' (ps x)) (Ws ∩ ps ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) ∧
    ∀ x ∈ Ws ∩ ps ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source,
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (ps y)) x) ∧
      hs x = pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm) (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (ps y)) x) ∧
  ((∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => hs x a c) Ws) ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ws, (hs x).PosDef) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ Ws, u (ps x) = t ∧ mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u (ps x) ≠ 0 ∧ σ₀ ≤ β (ps x) ∧
    gaussCurv2 hs x = sternGaussM g u (ps x)) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ Ws, L ^ 2 - 1 ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → b (ps x) = sgbSideDef L x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ Ws, b (ps x) = 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y => b (ps y)) x ≠ 0) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ Ws, L ^ 2 - 5 / 4 ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → ps x ∈ Z) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ Ws, L ^ 2 - 1 ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 → x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 → ψs (ps x) = 1) ∧
  (IsClosed Z ∧ IsOpen V) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ Sg, z ∈ V → z ∈ ps '' Ws ∧ ψs z = 1) ∧
  (∀ z ∈ Sg, z ∉ V → z ∉ Z ∧ z ∉ sternOuterClosed Φ Y L) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ Ws, (0 ≤ b (ps x) ↔ ps x ∈ Sg)) ∧
  (∀ z : M, u z = t → z ∉ Z → (0 ≤ b z ↔ 0 ≤ β z)) ∧
  (∀ z : M, u z = t → z ∉ Z → b z < σ₀ → β z < σ₀) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ Ws, b (ps x) < σ₀ → L ^ 2 - 1 ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) ∧
  (∀ z : M, β z < σ₀ → (∀ᶠ z' in 𝓝 z, b z' = β z') ∧ ψs z = 0) ∧
  (IsCompact Kcs ∧ Kcs ⊆ Ws ∧ ∀ x ∈ Ws, x ∉ Kcs → ψs (ps x) = 0)

def sspChartData [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (β u : M → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (U K : Set M) (m : ℕ) (W : Fin m → Set E2) (pm : Fin m → E2 → M) (pr : Fin m → M → E2)
    (O : Fin m → Set M) (z : Fin m → M) (F : Fin m → E2 → E3) (ψ : Fin m → M → ℝ)
    (Kc : Fin m → Set E2) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : Fin m,
    (IsOpen (W i) ∧ IsOpen (O i) ∧ O i ⊆ U ∧ ContinuousOn (pm i) (W i) ∧
      ContinuousOn (pr i) (O i) ∧ pm i '' W i = O i ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} ∧
      (∀ x ∈ W i, pr i (pm i x) = x) ∧ Set.InjOn (pm i) (W i)) ∧
    (∀ q' : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => pr i ((chartAt E3 q').symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 q').target ∩ (chartAt E3 q').symm ⁻¹' O i)) ∧
    (∀ q' : M,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => chartAt E3 q' (pm i x)) (W i ∩ pm i ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ W i ∩ pm i ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source,
        Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (pm i y)) x) ∧
        pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z i)).symm) (F i) x =
          pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm) (fun y => chartAt E3 q' (pm i y)) x) ∧
    ((∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun x => pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z i)).symm) (F i) x a c) (W i)) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ W i, (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z i)).symm) (F i) x).PosDef) ∧
    (ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (F i) (W i) ∧ ∀ x ∈ W i, F i x ∈ (chartAt E3 (z i)).target ∧
      Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (F i) x) ∧ pm i x = (chartAt E3 (z i)).symm (F i x)) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ W i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u (pm i x) ≠ 0 ∧
      gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (z i)).symm) (F i)) x =
        sternGaussM g u (pm i x)) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ W i, β (pm i x) = 0 → fderiv ℝ (fun y => β (pm i y)) x ≠ 0) ∧
    (ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ i) ∧ (∀ p, 0 ≤ ψ i p) ∧ IsCompact (tsupport (ψ i)) ∧
      tsupport (ψ i) ⊆ O i) ∧
    (IsCompact (Kc i) ∧ Kc i ⊆ W i ∧ ∀ x ∈ W i, x ∉ Kc i → ψ i (pm i x) = 0)) ∧
  ∀ p ∈ K, 1 ≤ ∑ i, ψ i p
