  have collar : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < σ₀ → ∀ z ∈ S, 0 ≤ b z → b z < s → σ₀ ≤ β z →
      ∃ x' ∈ P.W js, P.param js x' = z ∧ L ^ 2 - s < x' 0 ^ 2 + x' 1 ^ 2 ∧
        x' 0 ^ 2 + x' 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 ∧ ρ js z = 1 := by
    intro s hs hsσ z hz hb hbs hβz
    rcases h26 z hz (by linarith) with hlt | ⟨x', hx', hpx, hq⟩
    · exact absurd hlt (not_lt.mpr hβz)
    · have hbz := h24 x' hx' hq
      rw [hpx] at hbz
      unfold sgbSideDef at hbz
      have hq2 : x' 0 ^ 2 + x' 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 := by linarith
      refine ⟨x', hx', hpx, by linarith, hq2, ?_⟩
      have hρ1 := h25 x' hx' hq hq2
      rwa [hpx] at hρ1
  
  have pa : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < σ₀ → ∀ j : Fin P.n, j ≠ js → ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      ρ j (P.param j x) * (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
          (fun p => Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) * sternGaussM g u p) (P.param j x) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det =
        ρ j (P.param j x) * (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
    intro s hs hsσ j hj x hx
    rw [h21 j x hx]
    rcases dich s hs hsσ (P.param j x) (hS j x hx) with hI | ⟨hb, hbs, hβz, -⟩
    · rw [hI]
    · obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hρ⟩ := collar s hs hsσ (P.param j x) (hS j x hx) hb hbs hβz
      have hsum := h9 (P.param j x) (hS j x hx) hb
      have hle := Finset.add_le_sum (f := fun i => ρ i (P.param j x)) (s := Finset.univ)
        (fun i _ => h1 i (P.param j x)) (Finset.mem_univ j) (Finset.mem_univ js) hj
      have hρj : ρ j (P.param j x) = 0 := by
        have := h1 j (P.param j x)
        try simp only at hle
        linarith
      rw [hρj]
      ring
  
  have pb : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < σ₀ → ∀ x ∈ P.W js,
      ρ js (P.param js x) * (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
          (fun p => Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) * sternGaussM g u p) (P.param js x) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det =
        ρ js (P.param js x) *
            (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param js x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h js) x) *
            Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det +
          {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2}.indicator
            (fun y => ρ js (P.param js y) * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L y / s)) *
              gaussCurv2 (P.h js) y * Real.sqrt (P.h js y).det) x := by
    intro s hs hsσ x hx
    by_cases hA : x ∈ {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2}
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hA, h21 js x hx]
      obtain ⟨hA1, hA2⟩ := hA
      have hq : L ^ 2 - δ₀ ≤ x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by linarith
      have hbz := h24 x hx hq
      have hb0 : 0 ≤ b (P.param js x) := by
        rw [hbz]
        unfold sgbSideDef
        linarith
      have hm := (hSig _ (hS js x hx)).2 hb0
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hm]
      have e1 : Real.smoothTransition (β (P.param js x) / s) = 1 :=
        Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le ((one_le_div hs).mpr (by linarith [(h23 x hx).2.2]))
      try dsimp only
      rw [e1, hbz]
      ring
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hA, add_zero, h21 js x hx]
      rcases dich s hs hsσ (P.param js x) (hS js x hx) with hI | ⟨hb, hbs, hβz, -⟩
      · rw [hI]
      · exfalso
        obtain ⟨x', hx', hpx, hq1, hq2, -⟩ :=
          collar s hs hsσ (P.param js x) (hS js x hx) hb hbs hβz
        have hxx : x' = x := h19 js hx' hx hpx
        rw [hxx] at hq1 hq2
        exact hA ⟨hq1, hq2⟩
  
  have hgc : ∀ (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2), IsOpen s →
      (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) → (∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) →
      ContinuousOn (gaussCurv2 h) s := by
    intro h s hs hh hpos
    have hinf : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f s → ∀ c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 c f) s := by
      intro f hf c
      have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) s :=
        ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 hf).2
      exact hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hdet : ∀ y ∈ s, (h y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hpos y hy).det_pos.ne'
    have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).det) s := by
      have heq : (fun y => (h y).det) = fun y => h y 0 0 * h y 1 1 - h y 0 1 * h y 1 0 := by
        funext y
        exact Matrix.det_fin_two (h y)
      rw [heq]
      exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
    have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).adjugate i j) s := by
      intro i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] <;>
        first | exact hh _ _ | exact (hh _ _).neg
    have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s := by
      intro i j
      have heq : (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) = fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹ * (h y).adjugate i j := by
        funext y
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [heq]
      exact (hdetS.inv hdet).mul (hadj i j)
    have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s := by
      intro k i j
      show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
        (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x)) s
      exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hinv k l).mul
        (((hinf _ (hh j l) i).add (hinf _ (hh i l) j)).sub (hinf _ (hh i j) l)))
    have hchrC : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (christoffel2 h k i j) s :=
      fun k i j => (hchr k i j).continuousOn
    have hdchr : ∀ c k i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (pd2 c (christoffel2 h k i j)) s :=
      fun c k i j => (hinf _ (hchr k i j) c).continuousOn
    have hric : ∀ j k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (ricci2 h j k) s := by
      intro j k
      show ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2,
          (pd2 i (christoffel2 h i j k) x - pd2 j (christoffel2 h i i k) x)
        + ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2,
            (christoffel2 h i i p x * christoffel2 h p j k x
              - christoffel2 h i j p x * christoffel2 h p i k x)) s
      exact (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => (hdchr i i j k).sub (hdchr j i i k)).add
        (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun p _ =>
          ((hchrC i i p).mul (hchrC p j k)).sub ((hchrC i j p).mul (hchrC p i k)))
    show ContinuousOn
      (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ j : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ j k * ricci2 h j k x) s
    exact continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun j _ =>
      continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun k _ => (hinv j k).continuousOn.mul (hric j k))
  have hk : ContinuousOn (gaussCurv2 (P.h js)) (P.W js) :=
    hgc (P.h js) (P.W js) (P.W_open js) (P.h_smooth js) (P.h_posDef js)
  have hr : ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ js (P.param js x)) (P.W js) := (h2 js js).continuousOn
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (P.h js x).det) (P.W js) := by
    have heq : (fun x => (P.h js x).det) =
        fun x => P.h js x 0 0 * P.h js x 1 1 - P.h js x 0 1 * P.h js x 1 0 := by
      funext x
      exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
    rw [heq]
    exact ((P.h_smooth js 0 0).continuousOn.mul (P.h_smooth js 1 1).continuousOn).sub
      ((P.h_smooth js 0 1).continuousOn.mul (P.h_smooth js 1 0).continuousOn)
  have hd : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det) (P.W js) := hdetc.sqrt
  have hqc : Continuous (fun y : E2 => y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) := by fun_prop
  have hζc : Continuous (fun y : E2 => sgbSideDef L y) := by
    unfold sgbSideDef
    fun_prop
  have hnsq : ∀ y : E2, ‖y‖ ^ 2 = y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro y
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  
  have hKbB : {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - σ₀ ≤ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2} ⊆
      Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) |L| := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    have h1' : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ |L| ^ 2 := by
      rw [hnsq, sq_abs]
      exact hy.2
    exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)).1 h1'
  have hKsub : {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - σ₀ ≤ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2} ⊆
      P.W js := by
    intro y hy
    rw [h22]
    exact ⟨by linarith [hy.1], by linarith [hy.2]⟩
  have hKc : IsCompact {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - σ₀ ≤ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2} := by
    apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
    · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const hqc).inter (isClosed_le hqc continuous_const)
    · exact Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset hKbB
  have hfc : ContinuousOn (fun y => ρ js (P.param js y) * gaussCurv2 (P.h js) y *
      Real.sqrt (P.h js y).det) (P.W js) := (hr.mul hk).mul hd
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hfc.mono hKsub)
  have hball : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r →
      volume.real (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) r) = Real.pi * r ^ 2 := by
    intro r hr0
    rw [measureReal_def, EuclideanSpace.volume_closedBall_fin_two, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
      ENNReal.toReal_pow, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hr0, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal Real.pi_pos.le]
    ring
  
  have key : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < σ₀ →
      |eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
          (fun p => Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) * sternGaussM g u p) (P.param i x)) -
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x)|
        ≤ max C₀ 0 * (Real.pi * s) := by
    intro s hs hsσ
    have hAK : {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2} ⊆
        {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - σ₀ ≤ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2} := by
      intro y hy
      exact ⟨by linarith [hy.1], hy.2⟩
    have hAm : MeasurableSet
        {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2} :=
      (measurableSet_lt measurable_const hqc.measurable).inter
        (measurableSet_le hqc.measurable measurable_const)
    have hgs : ContinuousOn (fun y => ρ js (P.param js y) *
        (1 - Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L y / s)) *
        gaussCurv2 (P.h js) y * Real.sqrt (P.h js y).det) (P.W js) :=
      ((hr.mul (continuous_const.sub
        (Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp (hζc.div_const s))).continuousOn).mul hk).mul hd
    have hEint : IntegrableOn
        ({y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2}.indicator
          (fun y => ρ js (P.param js y) * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L y / s)) *
            gaussCurv2 (P.h js) y * Real.sqrt (P.h js y).det)) (P.W js) := by
      have h1' : IntegrableOn (fun y => ρ js (P.param js y) *
          (1 - Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L y / s)) *
          gaussCurv2 (P.h js) y * Real.sqrt (P.h js y).det)
          {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2} :=
        ((hgs.mono hKsub).integrableOn_compact hKc).mono_set hAK
      exact (h1'.integrable_indicator hAm).integrableOn
    have hBc : ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ js (P.param js x) *
        (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param js x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h js) x) *
        Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det) (P.W js) :=
      (hr.mul ((Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp_continuousOn
        ((h6 js).continuousOn.div_const s)).mul hk)).mul hd
    have hBint : IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ js (P.param js x) *
        (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param js x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h js) x) *
        Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det) (P.W js) := by
      refine ((hBc.mono (h3 js).2).integrableOn_compact (h3 js).1).of_forall_diff_eq_zero
        (P.W_open js).measurableSet ?_
      intro x hx
      show ρ js (P.param js x) * _ * _ = 0
      rw [h4 js x hx.1 hx.2]
      ring
    have hjs : (∫ x in P.W js, ρ js (P.param js x) *
          (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
            (fun p => Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) * sternGaussM g u p) (P.param js x) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det) -
        (∫ x in P.W js, ρ js (P.param js x) *
          (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param js x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h js) x) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det) =
        ∫ x in P.W js,
          {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2}.indicator
            (fun y => ρ js (P.param js y) * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L y / s)) *
              gaussCurv2 (P.h js) y * Real.sqrt (P.h js y).det) x := by
      have e1 : (∫ x in P.W js, ρ js (P.param js x) *
            (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
              (fun p => Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) * sternGaussM g u p) (P.param js x) *
            Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det) =
          ∫ x in P.W js, (ρ js (P.param js x) *
            (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param js x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h js) x) *
            Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det +
            {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2}.indicator
              (fun y => ρ js (P.param js y) * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L y / s)) *
                gaussCurv2 (P.h js) y * Real.sqrt (P.h js y).det) x) :=
        setIntegral_congr_fun (P.W_open js).measurableSet (fun x hx => pb s hs hsσ x hx)
      rw [e1, integral_add hBint hEint]
      ring
    have hsum : eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
          (fun p => Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) * sternGaussM g u p) (P.param i x)) -
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x) =
        ∫ x in P.W js,
          {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2}.indicator
            (fun y => ρ js (P.param js y) * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L y / s)) *
              gaussCurv2 (P.h js) y * Real.sqrt (P.h js y).det) x := by
      unfold eigWInt
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_eq_single js]
      · exact hjs
      · intro j _ hj
        refine sub_eq_zero.mpr ?_
        exact setIntegral_congr_fun (P.W_open j).measurableSet (fun x hx => pa s hs hsσ j hj x hx)
      · intro h
        exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ js) h
    rw [hsum, setIntegral_indicator hAm, Set.inter_eq_right.mpr (hAK.trans hKsub)]
    have hfin : volume
        {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2} < ⊤ :=
      (measure_mono (hAK.trans hKbB)).trans_lt measure_closedBall_lt_top
    have hbd : ∀ x ∈ {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2},
        ‖ρ js (P.param js x) * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s)) *
          gaussCurv2 (P.h js) x * Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det‖ ≤ max C₀ 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have hb' : |ρ js (P.param js x) * gaussCurv2 (P.h js) x * Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det| ≤ C₀ := by
        have := hC₀ x (hAK hx)
        rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      have e0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (sgbSideDef L x / s)
      have e1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (sgbSideDef L x / s)
      have heq : ρ js (P.param js x) * (1 - Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s)) *
          gaussCurv2 (P.h js) x * Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det =
          (1 - Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s)) *
            (ρ js (P.param js x) * gaussCurv2 (P.h js) x * Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det) := by ring
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, heq, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 e1)]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg e0 (abs_nonneg
        (ρ js (P.param js x) * gaussCurv2 (P.h js) x * Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det)),
        le_max_left C₀ 0]
    have h1' := norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const hfin hbd
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1'
    have hLs : 0 ≤ L ^ 2 - s := by linarith
    have hAeq : {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2} =
        Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) |L| \ Metric.closedBall 0 (Real.sqrt (L ^ 2 - s)) := by
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_diff, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      rw [← sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg y) (abs_nonneg L),
        ← sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg y) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), hnsq, sq_abs, Real.sq_sqrt hLs]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1'', h2''⟩
        exact ⟨h2'', not_le.mpr h1''⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1'', h2''⟩
        exact ⟨not_le.mp h2'', h1''⟩
    have hrL : Real.sqrt (L ^ 2 - s) ≤ |L| := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith)
    have hvol : volume.real
        {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - s < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ∧ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2} = Real.pi * s := by
      rw [hAeq, measureReal_diff (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hrL) measurableSet_closedBall
        measure_closedBall_lt_top.ne, hball _ (abs_nonneg L), hball _ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),
        sq_abs, Real.sq_sqrt hLs]
      ring
    rw [hvol] at h1'
    exact h1'
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => max C₀ 0 * (Real.pi * s)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hc : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => max C₀ 0 * (Real.pi * s)) := by fun_prop
    exact (hc.tendsto' 0 0 (by simp)).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ hlim
  filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT h14] with s hs
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  exact key s hs.1 hs.2

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : EndChart M) (β u : M → ℝ)
    (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hEdge : ∀ (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target) →
      (∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) →
      ∀ (c : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ W, u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = c) →
      (∀ x ∈ W, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ≠ 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ W, β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = 0 →
      g.gradInner β (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u y)) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) /
          Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) =
        -(Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
              (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x) *
          sgbLevelCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
              (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x))
    (Y : E3 → E3) (R₁ L t σ₀ δ₀ : ℝ) (S : Set M) (P : EigPatchedSurface M S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → M → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2) (b : M → ℝ) (js : Fin P.n)
    (hgood : sspGood g Φ β u Y R₁ L t σ₀ δ₀ S P ρ Kc b js) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
      eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
          (fun p => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) *
            g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) p /
              Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p)) (P.param i x)) +
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
          Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x) *
          sgbLevelCurv2 (P.h j) (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x) -
        ∫ x : E2, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) *
          Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t)
            (sgbSideDef L) x) *
          sgbLevelCurv2 (sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t) (sgbSideDef L) x *
          Real.sqrt (sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t x).det)
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0)

signature.name: patched_collar_compare
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : EndChart M) (β u : M → ℝ)
    (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hEdge : ∀ (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target) →
      (∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) →
      ∀ (c : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ W, u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = c) →
      (∀ x ∈ W, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ≠ 0) →
      ∀ x ∈ W, β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = 0 →
      g.gradInner β (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u y)) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) /
          Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) =
        -(Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
              (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x) *
          sgbLevelCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F)
              (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x))
    (Y : E3 → E3) (R₁ L t σ₀ δ₀ : ℝ) (S : Set M) (P : EigPatchedSurface M S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → M → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2) (b : M → ℝ) (js : Fin P.n)
    (hgood : sspGood g Φ β u Y R₁ L t σ₀ δ₀ S P ρ Kc b js) :
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
      eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
          (fun p => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) *
            g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) p /
              Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p)) (P.param i x)) +
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
          Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x) *
          sgbLevelCurv2 (P.h j) (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x) -
        ∫ x : E2, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) *
          Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t)
            (sgbSideDef L) x) *
          sgbLevelCurv2 (sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t) (sgbSideDef L) x *
          Real.sqrt (sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t x).det)
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11, h12, h13, h14, h15, h16, h17, h18, h19,
    h20, h21, h22, h23, h24, h25, h26, h27⟩ := hgood
  
  have hη0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rcases hy.lt_or_eq with hy | hy
    · have h : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0:ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos hz.le
      rw [h.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    · rw [hy]
      apply IsLocalMin.deriv_eq_zero
      filter_upwards with z
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos le_rfl]
      exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg z
  have hη1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → deriv Real.smoothTransition y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rcases hy.lt_or_eq with hy | hy
    · have h : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (1:ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le hz.le
      rw [h.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    · rw [← hy]
      apply IsLocalMax.deriv_eq_zero
      filter_upwards with z
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le le_rfl]
      exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one z
  have hηpos : ∀ v s : ℝ, 0 < s → deriv Real.smoothTransition (v / s) ≠ 0 → 0 < v ∧ v < s := by
    intro v s hs hne
    constructor
    · by_contra hv
      push_neg at hv
      exact hne (hη0 _ (by rw [div_le_iff₀ hs]; linarith))
    · by_contra hv
      push_neg at hv
      exact hne (hη1 _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith))
  
  have hgerm : ∀ (h₁ h₂ : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w₁ w₂ : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2),
      h₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] h₂ → w₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] w₂ →
      sgbGradSq2 h₁ w₁ x = sgbGradSq2 h₂ w₂ x ∧
        sgbLevelCurv2 h₁ w₁ x = sgbLevelCurv2 h₂ w₂ x := by
    intro h₁ h₂ w₁ w₂ x hh hw
    have hpd : ∀ a : Fin 2, (pd2 a w₁) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (pd2 a w₂) := by
      intro a
      filter_upwards [hw.eventuallyEq_nhds] with y hy
      simp only [pd2, hy.fderiv_eq]
    have hG : (sgbGradSq2 h₁ w₁) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (sgbGradSq2 h₂ w₂) := by
      filter_upwards [hh, hpd 0, hpd 1] with y hy1 hy2 hy3
      simp only [sgbGradSq2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hy1, hy2, hy3]
    refine ⟨hG.eq_of_nhds, ?_⟩
    have hV : ∀ i : Fin 2, (fun y => Real.sqrt (h₁ y).det *
        (∑ a : Fin 2, (h₁ y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a w₁ y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h₁ w₁ y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => Real.sqrt (h₂ y).det *
        (∑ a : Fin 2, (h₂ y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a w₂ y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h₂ w₂ y)) := by
      intro i
      filter_upwards [hh, hpd 0, hpd 1, hG] with y hy1 hy2 hy3 hy4
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hy1, hy2, hy3, hy4]
    have hpdV : ∀ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y => Real.sqrt (h₁ y).det *
        (∑ a : Fin 2, (h₁ y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a w₁ y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h₁ w₁ y)) x =
        pd2 i (fun y => Real.sqrt (h₂ y).det *
        (∑ a : Fin 2, (h₂ y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a w₂ y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h₂ w₂ y)) x := by
      intro i
      exact congrArg (fun T : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T (e2 i)) (hV i).fderiv_eq
    unfold sgbLevelCurv2
    rw [hh.eq_of_nhds, Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hpdV i)]
  
  have hmemS : ∀ j : Fin P.n, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ S := fun j x hx =>
    (((P.image_eq j).subset) (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx)).2
  have hdetc : ∀ i : Fin P.n, ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det) (P.W i) := by
    intro i
    have hfun : (fun x => (P.h i x).det) =
        fun x => P.h i x 0 0 * P.h i x 1 1 - P.h i x 0 1 * P.h i x 1 0 := by
      funext x
      exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
    apply ContinuousOn.sqrt
    rw [hfun]
    exact ((P.h_smooth i 0 0).continuousOn.mul (P.h_smooth i 1 1).continuousOn).sub
      ((P.h_smooth i 0 1).continuousOn.mul (P.h_smooth i 1 0).continuousOn)
  
  have hind : ∀ z ∈ S, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < σ₀ →
      (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
        (fun p => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) *
          g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) p /
            Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p)) z =
      s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β z / s) *
        (g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) z /
          Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u z)) := by
    intro z hz s hs hsσ
    by_cases hzS : z ∈ sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hzS]
      ring
    · rw [Set.indicator_apply, if_neg hzS]
      have hb : b z < 0 := by
        by_contra hb
        push_neg at hb
        apply hzS
        rw [← h13]
        exact ⟨hz, hb⟩
      have hd : deriv Real.smoothTransition (β z / s) = 0 := by
        by_cases hβ' : β z < σ₀
        · have hbe := (h27 z hz hβ').1.self_of_nhds
          exact hη0 _ (by rw [div_le_iff₀ hs]; linarith)
        · push_neg at hβ'
          exact hη1 _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith)
      rw [hd]
      ring
  
  have hloc : ∀ j : Fin P.n, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, β (P.param j x) < σ₀ →
      (fun y => b (P.param j y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => β (P.param j y)) := by
    intro j x hx hβx
    have hc : ContinuousAt (P.param j) x :=
      (P.param_cont j).continuousAt ((P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx)
    exact Filter.Tendsto.eventually hc (h27 _ (hmemS j x hx) hβx).1
  
  have hside : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < σ₀ →
      (∫ x in P.W js, ρ js (P.param js x) * (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
          (fun p => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) *
            g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) p /
              Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p)) (P.param js x) * Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det) = 0 ∧
      (∫ x in P.W js, ρ js (P.param js x) *
          (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param js x) / s) *
            Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (P.h js) (fun y => b (P.param js y)) x) *
            sgbLevelCurv2 (P.h js) (fun y => b (P.param js y)) x) * Real.sqrt (P.h js x).det) =
        ∫ x : E2, s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) *
          Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t)
            (sgbSideDef L) x) *
          sgbLevelCurv2 (sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t) (sgbSideDef L) x *
          Real.sqrt (sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t x).det := by
    intro s hs hsσ
    refine ⟨setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun x hx => ?_), ?_⟩
    · rw [hind _ (hmemS js x hx) s hs hsσ,
        hη1 (β (P.param js x) / s) (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith [(h23 x hx).2.2])]
      ring
    refine Eq.trans (setIntegral_congr_fun (P.W_open js).measurableSet ?_)
      (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero ?_)
    · intro x hx
      beta_reduce
      have hζdef : sgbSideDef L x = L ^ 2 - x 0 ^ 2 - x 1 ^ 2 := rfl
      by_cases hr : L ^ 2 - δ₀ < x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2
      · have hO' : IsOpen (P.W js ∩ {y : E2 | L ^ 2 - δ₀ < y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2}) :=
          (P.W_open js).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const (by fun_prop))
        have hevb : (fun y => b (P.param js y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] sgbSideDef L :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem (hO'.mem_nhds ⟨hx, hr⟩)
            (fun y hy => h24 y hy.1 (le_of_lt hy.2))
        have hevh : P.h js =ᶠ[𝓝 x] sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem ((P.W_open js).mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => (h23 y hy).2.1)
        obtain ⟨hG, hLc⟩ := hgerm _ _ _ _ x hevh hevb
        have hbx : b (P.param js x) = sgbSideDef L x := h24 x hx hr.le
        have hhx : P.h js x = sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t x := (h23 x hx).2.1
        by_cases hd : deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) = 0
        · rw [hbx, hd]
          ring
        · obtain ⟨hζ0, -⟩ := hηpos _ _ hs hd
          have hρ1 : ρ js (P.param js x) = 1 := h25 x hx hr.le (by linarith)
          rw [hbx, hρ1, hG, hLc, hhx]
          ring
      · push_neg at hr
        have hζ : δ₀ ≤ sgbSideDef L x := by linarith
        have hd2 : deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) = 0 :=
          hη1 _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith)
        have hbz : s ≤ b (P.param js x) := by
          by_contra hlt
          push_neg at hlt
          rcases h26 _ (hmemS js x hx) (by linarith) with hβ' | ⟨x', hx', hpx, hr'⟩
          · linarith [(h23 x hx).2.2]
          · rw [h19 js hx' hx hpx] at hr'
            have hbe := h24 x hx hr'
            linarith
        have hd1 : deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param js x) / s) = 0 :=
          hη1 _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith)
        rw [hd1, hd2]
        ring
    · intro x hx
      rw [h22] at hx
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_and_or, not_lt] at hx
      have hζdef : sgbSideDef L x = L ^ 2 - x 0 ^ 2 - x 1 ^ 2 := rfl
      have hd : deriv Real.smoothTransition (sgbSideDef L x / s) = 0 := by
        rcases hx with hx | hx
        · exact hη1 _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith)
        · exact hη0 _ (by rw [div_le_iff₀ hs]; linarith)
      rw [hd]
      ring
  
  have hpatch : ∀ j : Fin P.n, j ≠ js → Tendsto (fun s : ℝ =>
      (∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
          (fun p => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) *
            g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) p /
              Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p)) (P.param j x) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) +
      ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) *
          (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
            Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x) *
            sgbLevelCurv2 (P.h j) (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨z₀, F, hpar, hπ, hh⟩ := h20 j hj
    obtain ⟨hWo, hFs, hFx⟩ := hpar
    have hKW : Kc j ⊆ P.W j := (h3 j).2
    obtain ⟨w, hw_def⟩ : ∃ f : E2 → ℝ, f = fun x => β (P.param j x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha_def⟩ : ∃ f : E2 → ℝ,
        f = fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨e₁, he₁_def⟩ : ∃ f : E2 → ℝ, f = fun x =>
        g.gradInner β (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u y)) (P.param j x) /
          Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (P.param j x)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨e₂, he₂_def⟩ : ∃ f : E2 → ℝ, f = fun x =>
        Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) w x) * sgbLevelCurv2 (P.h j) w x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    
    have hβc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z₀).symm y)) (chartAt E3 z₀).target := by
      have hm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (β ∘ (chartAt E3 z₀).symm)
          (chartAt E3 z₀).target := hβ.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hm
    have hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w (P.W j) := by
      rw [hw_def]
      exact (hβc.comp hFs (fun x hx => (hFx x hx).1)).congr (fun x hx => by
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, hπ x hx])
    have ha : ContinuousOn a (P.W j) := by
      rw [ha_def]
      exact (h2 j j).continuousOn.mul (hdetc j)
    have ha0 : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → a x = 0 := by
      intro x hx hxK
      rw [ha_def]
      simp only [h4 j x hx hxK, zero_mul]
    have he₁ : ContinuousOn e₁ (P.W j) := by
      rw [he₁_def]
      exact (edge_quot_continuousOn g β u hβ hu).comp (P.param_cont j)
        (fun x hx => (h12 _ (hmemS j x hx)).2)
    obtain ⟨hUo, he₂c, hpos⟩ := sgb_curv_density_regular (P.h j) (P.W j) (P.W_open j)
      (P.h_smooth j) (P.h_posDef j) w hw
    have he₂ : ContinuousOn e₂ {x : E2 | x ∈ P.W j ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) w x} := by
      rw [he₂_def]
      exact he₂c
    have hwreg : ∀ x ∈ Kc j, w x = 0 → fderiv ℝ w x ≠ 0 := by
      intro x hxK hw0
      have hxW := hKW hxK
      simp only [hw_def] at hw0
      have hev := hloc j x hxW (by linarith)
      have hb0 : b (P.param j x) = 0 := by
        have hbe := hev.eq_of_nhds
        simp only at hbe
        rw [hbe]
        exact hw0
      have hne := h10 j x hxW hb0
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, ← hw_def] at hne
      exact hne
    have hZU : ∀ x ∈ Kc j, w x = 0 →
        x ∈ {x : E2 | x ∈ P.W j ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) w x} :=
      fun x hxK hw0 => ⟨hKW hxK, hpos x (hKW hxK) (hwreg x hxK hw0)⟩
    have hedge : ∀ x ∈ Kc j, w x = 0 → e₁ x + e₂ x = 0 := by
      intro x hxK hw0
      have hxW := hKW hxK
      simp only [hw_def] at hw0
      have hE := hEdge z₀ (P.W j) F hWo hFs (fun x hx => (hFx x hx).1)
        (fun x hx => (hFx x hx).2.2) t
        (fun x hx => by rw [← hπ x hx]; exact (h12 _ (hmemS j x hx)).1)
        (fun x hx => by rw [← hπ x hx]; exact (h12 _ (hmemS j x hx)).2) x hxW
        (by rw [← hπ x hxW]; exact hw0)
      rw [← hh, ← hπ x hxW] at hE
      have hev : (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z₀).symm (F y))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] w := by
        rw [hw_def]
        exact Filter.eventually_of_mem ((P.W_open j).mem_nhds hxW)
          (fun y hy => by simp only [hπ y hy])
      obtain ⟨hG, hLc⟩ := hgerm (P.h j) (P.h j) _ w x Filter.EventuallyEq.rfl hev
      rw [hG, hLc] at hE
      rw [he₁_def, he₂_def]
      simp only
      rw [hE]
      ring
    
    have hPA : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < σ₀ → ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
        ρ j (P.param j x) * (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator
          (fun p => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (β p / s) *
            g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) p /
              Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u p)) (P.param j x) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det =
        a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * e₁ x := by
      intro s hs hsσ x hx
      rw [hind _ (hmemS j x hx) s hs hsσ]
      simp only [ha_def, hw_def, he₁_def]
      ring
    have hPB : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < σ₀ → ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
        ρ j (P.param j x) * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
          Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x) *

by
  classical
  
  have bridge : ∀ (Mx : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Mx i j * x i * x j = x ⬝ᵥ (Mx.mulVec x) := by
    intro Mx x
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have symmA : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), A.PosDef → A.transpose = A := by
    intro A hA
    have h1 := hA.isHermitian
    unfold Matrix.IsHermitian at h1
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at h1
    exact h1
  have dot_symm : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), A.transpose = A →
      ∀ u w : Fin 3 → ℝ, u ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec w) = w ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec u) := by
    intro A hA u w
    rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, dotProduct_comm (Matrix.vecMul u A) w,
      ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hA]
  have psd : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), A.PosDef →
      ∀ w : Fin 3 → ℝ, 0 ≤ w ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec w) := by
    intro A hA w
    have h1 := hA.posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg w
    simpa [Pi.star_def] using h1
  
  have inv_le : ∀ (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), A.PosDef → B.PosDef → ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c →
      (∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, x ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec x) ≤ c * (x ⬝ᵥ (B.mulVec x))) →
      ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, x ⬝ᵥ (B⁻¹.mulVec x) ≤ c * (x ⬝ᵥ (A⁻¹.mulVec x)) := by
    intro A B hA hB c hc hAB x
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA.isUnit
    have hBu : IsUnit B.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det B).mp hB.isUnit
    have hAT := symmA A hA
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, z = B⁻¹.mulVec x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, v = A⁻¹.mulVec x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hz, ← hv]
    have hBz : B.mulVec z = x := by
      rw [hz, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hBu, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have hAv : A.mulVec v = x := by
      rw [hv, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hAu, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    have e1 : x ⬝ᵥ z = z ⬝ᵥ (B.mulVec z) := by rw [hBz, dotProduct_comm z x]
    have e2 : x ⬝ᵥ v = v ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec v) := by rw [hAv, dotProduct_comm v x]
    have e3 : z ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec v) = x ⬝ᵥ z := by rw [hAv, dotProduct_comm z x]
    have e4 : v ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec z) = z ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec v) := dot_symm A hAT v z
    have hpos := psd A hA (z - c • v)
    have hexp : (z - c • v) ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec (z - c • v)) =
        z ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec z) - c * (z ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec v)) - c * (v ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec z)) +
          c ^ 2 * (v ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec v)) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec_sub, Matrix.mulVec_smul, sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_sub,
        smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [hexp, e4, e3, ← e2] at hpos
    have hz' := hAB z
    rw [← e1] at hz'
    nlinarith
  
  have det_le : ∀ (A B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), A.PosDef → B.PosDef → ∀ c : ℝ,
      (∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, x ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec x) ≤ c * (x ⬝ᵥ (B.mulVec x))) →
      A.det ≤ c ^ 3 * B.det := by
    intro A B hA hB c hAB
    obtain ⟨R, hRu, hBR⟩ := Matrix.posDef_iff_eq_conjTranspose_mul_self.mp hB
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at hBR
    have hRd : IsUnit R.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det R).mp hRu
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, P = R⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hRP : R * P = 1 := by rw [hP]; exact Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv R hRd
    have hAT := symmA A hA
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ : ∃ C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, C = P.transpose * A * P := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hCT : C.transpose = C := by
      rw [hC, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose, hAT,
        Matrix.mul_assoc]
    have hCH : C.IsHermitian := by
      unfold Matrix.IsHermitian
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial]
      exact hCT
    have hform : ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        x ⬝ᵥ (C.mulVec x) = (P.mulVec x) ⬝ᵥ (A.mulVec (P.mulVec x)) := by
      intro x
      rw [hC, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
        Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec x P.transpose, Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
    have hformB : ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, (P.mulVec x) ⬝ᵥ (B.mulVec (P.mulVec x)) = x ⬝ᵥ x := by
      intro x
      rw [hBR, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec (P.mulVec x) R.transpose,
        Matrix.vecMul_transpose, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hRP, Matrix.one_mulVec]

      intro k
      have hww : (hCH.eigenvectorBasis k).ofLp ⬝ᵥ (hCH.eigenvectorBasis k).ofLp = 1 := by
        have h1 := EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct (hCH.eigenvectorBasis k)
          (hCH.eigenvectorBasis k)
        rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hCH.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 k] at h1
        simpa [Pi.star_def] using h1.symm
      have hq : (hCH.eigenvectorBasis k).ofLp ⬝ᵥ (C.mulVec (hCH.eigenvectorBasis k).ofLp) =
          hCH.eigenvalues k := by
        rw [hCH.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis k, dotProduct_smul, hww]
        simp [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id]
      have h0 := psd A hA (P.mulVec (hCH.eigenvectorBasis k).ofLp)
      have h1 := hAB (P.mulVec (hCH.eigenvectorBasis k).ofLp)

      rw [← hform, hq] at h0

    have hdetC : C.det ≤ c ^ 3 := by

        rw [hCH.det_eq_prod_eigenvalues]
        simp [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id]
      rw [hprod]
      calc ∏ k, hCH.eigenvalues k ≤ ∏ _k : Fin 3, c :=

    have hdC : C.det = P.det * A.det * P.det := by

  have qform : ∀ (k : RiemannianMetric3 M) (φ : E3 → M) (y : E3) (x : Fin 3 → ℝ),

          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by
    intro k φ y x
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
      ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec,
      RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
    ring
  
  have coeffPD : ∀ (k : RiemannianMetric3 M)
      (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3), y ∈ φ.source →

      intro w hw
      have hL : ∀ u : E3, (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv hn) u =

        intro u
        rw [← hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv_coe hn]
        rfl
      apply (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv hn).injective
      rw [hL, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]

            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y (∑ i, x i • e i : E3)) := by

    have hGH : ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, x ⬝ᵥ ((g.coeff φ y).mulVec x) ≤

      (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p))

    (hχ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ χ) (hχt : tsupport χ ⊆ κ.target) (C : Set M)
    (hC : IsClosed C) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn (fun y => f (κ y)) κ.source) (T : Set M)
    (hT : IsCompact T) (hCT : ∀ p, p ∉ T → C.indicator f p = 0) :
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ (κ y) * C.indicator f (κ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ y).det) κ.source

signature.name: cls_chart_integrable
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (h : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : M → ℝ)
    (hχ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ χ) (hχt : tsupport χ ⊆ κ.target) (C : Set M)
    (hC : IsClosed C) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn (fun y => f (κ y)) κ.source) (T : Set M)
    (hT : IsCompact T) (hCT : ∀ p, p ∉ T → C.indicator f p = 0) :
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ (κ y) * C.indicator f (κ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ y).det) κ.source

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set A : Set M := T ∩ (C ∩ tsupport χ) with hAdef
  have hA : IsCompact A := hT.inter_right (hC.inter (isClosed_tsupport χ))
  have hAt : A ⊆ κ.target := fun p hp => hχt hp.2.2
  set L : Set E3 := κ.toPartialEquiv.symm '' A with hLdef
  have hL : IsCompact L :=
    hA.image_of_continuousOn (κ.contMDiffOn_invFun.continuousOn.mono hAt)
  have hLs : L ⊆ κ.source := by
    rintro y ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact κ.toPartialEquiv.map_target (hAt hp)
  have hLm : MeasurableSet L := hL.isClosed.measurableSet
  have hLC : ∀ y ∈ L, κ y ∈ C := by
    rintro y ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    have : κ (κ.toPartialEquiv.symm p) = p := κ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv (hAt hp)
    rw [this]; exact hp.2.1
  have hχc : ContinuousOn (fun y => χ (κ y)) κ.source :=
    hχ.continuous.comp_continuousOn κ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
  have hdc : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ y).det) κ.source :=
    (nds_chart_cont h κ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) contMDiff_const
      contMDiff_const).2.2.2.1
  have hGc : ContinuousOn (fun y => χ (κ y) * f (κ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ y).det)
      κ.source := (hχc.mul hf).mul hdc
  have hGL : IntegrableOn (fun y => χ (κ y) * f (κ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ y).det) L :=
    (hGc.mono hLs).integrableOn_compact hL
  have hFL : IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ (κ y) * C.indicator f (κ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ y).det) L := by
    refine hGL.congr_fun (fun y hy => ?_) hLm
    simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem (hLC y hy)]
  refine hFL.of_forall_diff_eq_zero κ.open_source.measurableSet ?_
  rintro y ⟨hyU, hyL⟩
  by_cases hpT : κ y ∈ T
  · by_cases hpC : κ y ∈ C
    · by_cases hpχ : κ y ∈ tsupport χ
      · exfalso
        apply hyL
        refine ⟨κ y, ⟨hpT, hpC, hpχ⟩, ?_⟩
        exact κ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hyU
      · simp only [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hpχ, zero_mul]
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hpC, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  · simp only [hCT _ hpT, mul_zero, zero_mul]

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_chart_cont
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv a (fun x => u (κ x))) κ.source) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u w (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.coeff κ x).det) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ a b) κ.source)

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hRc : IsCompact {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hRconn : IsConnected {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (hreg : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) = 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x ≠ 0)
    (hbd : ∃ q ∈ S, b q = 0) :
    Nonempty (PcgbGreenData P b)

signature.name: pcgb_green_function
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hRc : IsCompact {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hRconn : IsConnected {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (hreg : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) = 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x ≠ 0)
    (hbd : ∃ q ∈ S, b q = 0) :
    Nonempty (PcgbGreenData P b)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hadd : ∀ (hm : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (f g : E2 → ℝ) (V : Set E2), IsOpen V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 g V → ∀ x ∈ V,
      lap2 hm (fun y => f y + g y) x = lap2 hm f x + lap2 hm g x := by
    intro hm f g V hV hf hg x hx
    have hdf : ∀ y ∈ V, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y := fun y hy =>
      (hf.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt two_ne_zero
    have hdg : ∀ y ∈ V, DifferentiableAt ℝ g y := fun y hy =>
      (hg.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt two_ne_zero
    have hf1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) V := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by norm_num)
    have hg1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ g) V := hg.fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by norm_num)
    have hdf' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x :=
      (hf1.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have hdg' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) x :=
      (hg1.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have hp1 : ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => f y + g y) y = pd2 k f y + pd2 k g y := by
      intro y hy k
      unfold pd2
      rw [fderiv_fun_add (hdf y hy) (hdg y hy)]
      rfl
    have hp2 : ∀ i k : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 k (fun y => f y + g y)) x =
        pd2 i (pd2 k f) x + pd2 i (pd2 k g) x := by
      intro i k
      have hev : pd2 k (fun y => f y + g y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => pd2 k f y + pd2 k g y :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hp1 y hy k)
      have hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 k f) x := hdf'.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)
      have hB : DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 k g) x := hdg'.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 k (fun y => f y + g y)) x (e2 i) =
        fderiv ℝ (pd2 k f) x (e2 i) + fderiv ℝ (pd2 k g) x (e2 i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_add hA hB]
      rfl
    unfold lap2
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hp2, hp1 x hx]
    ring
  
  have hparamOS : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ P.O j ∩ S := by
    intro j x hx
    rw [← P.image_eq]
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hchart : ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ j, ∃ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x = q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (P.cover hq)
    have hq' : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq]; exact ⟨hj, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxq⟩ := hq'
    exact ⟨j, x, hx, hxq⟩
  
  obtain ⟨j₀, x₀, r₁, hr₁, hball₁, hpos₁⟩ := pcgb_interior_ball S P b hb hreg hbd
  have hx₀W : x₀ ∈ P.W j₀ := hball₁ (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr₁.le)
  have hp₀S : P.param j₀ x₀ ∈ S := (hparamOS j₀ x₀ hx₀W).2
  have hbp₀ : 2 * r₁ ≤ b (P.param j₀ x₀) := hpos₁ x₀ (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr₁.le)
  have hbp₀' : 0 < b (P.param j₀ x₀) := by linarith
  
  obtain ⟨Λ, F, ρ₂, C₂, K, hρ₂, hρ₂r, hC₂, hK0, hΛs, hFs, hzero, hlapΛ, hhold, hP6, hpole⟩ :=
    pcgb_chart_parametrix (P.W j₀) (P.W_open j₀) (P.h j₀) (P.h_smooth j₀) (P.h_posDef j₀) x₀ r₁
      hr₁ hball₁
  have hball₂ : Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ₂ ⊆ P.W j₀ :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ₂r).trans hball₁
  
  obtain ⟨TΛ0, TΛ1, -, TΛ3, TΛ4⟩ := pcgb_chart_transport S P j₀ x₀ ρ₂ hρ₂ hball₂ Λ
    (fun x hx => (hzero x hx).1) hΛs
  obtain ⟨-, TF1, TF2, -, TF4⟩ := pcgb_chart_transport S P j₀ x₀ ρ₂ hρ₂ hball₂ F
    (fun x hx => (hzero x hx).2) hFs
  have hout : ∀ q, b q < 2 * r₁ → q ∉ P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ₂ := by
    rintro q hq ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have := hpos₁ y (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ₂r hy)
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨v, U, hUo, hRU, hv1, hv2, hv3, hv4⟩ :=
    pcgb_dirichlet_solve S P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hK hρK hρO b hb hRc hRconn hρ1 hreg hbd
      (P.param j₀ x₀) (pcgbTransport P j₀ F) TF1 (TF2 K hhold)
      ⟨2 * r₁, by linarith, fun q _ hq => TF4 q (hout q hq)⟩
  
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : X → ℝ, w = fun q => pcgbTransport P j₀ Λ q + v q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hwq : ∀ q, w q = pcgbTransport P j₀ Λ q + v q := fun q => by rw [hw]
  have hwj : ∀ j, (fun y => w (P.param j y)) =
      fun y => pcgbTransport P j₀ Λ (P.param j y) + v (P.param j y) := by
    intro j; funext y; exact hwq _
  have hVo : ∀ j, IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {P.param j₀ x₀})) := fun j =>
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (hUo.sdiff isClosed_singleton)
  have hΛinf : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pcgbTransport P j₀ Λ (P.param j x))
      (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {P.param j₀ x₀})) := fun j =>
    (TΛ1 j).mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.2⟩)
  have hΛ2 : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => pcgbTransport P j₀ Λ (P.param j x))
      (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {P.param j₀ x₀})) := fun j =>
    (hΛinf j).of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
  have hv2' : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => v (P.param j x))
      (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {P.param j₀ x₀})) := fun j =>
    (hv2 j).mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.1⟩)
  have hsmoothW : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w (P.param j x))
      (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {P.param j₀ x₀})) := by
    intro j
    rw [hwj j]
    exact (hΛinf j).add (hv1 j)
  
  have harm : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ b (P.param j x) → P.param j x ≠ P.param j₀ x₀ →
      lap2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x = 0 := by
    intro j x hx hb0 hne
    have hxV : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {P.param j₀ x₀}) :=
      ⟨hx, hRU ⟨(hparamOS j x hx).2, hb0⟩, hne⟩
    have key := hadd (P.h j) (fun y => pcgbTransport P j₀ Λ (P.param j y))
      (fun y => v (P.param j y)) _ (hVo j) (hΛ2 j) (hv2' j) x hxV
    beta_reduce at key
    rw [hwj j, key, TΛ3 j x hx hne, hv3 j x hx hb0]
    unfold pcgbTransport
    by_cases hq : P.param j x ∈ P.O j₀ ∩ S
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hq]
      have hq' : P.param j x ∈ P.param j₀ '' P.W j₀ := by rw [P.image_eq]; exact hq
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyq⟩ := hq'
      rw [← hyq, P.proj_param j₀ y hy]
      have hyx : y ≠ x₀ := by
        rintro rfl
        exact hne hyq.symm
      rw [hlapΛ y hy hyx]
      ring
    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hq]
      ring
  
  have hval : ∀ q ∈ S, b q = 0 → w q = 0 := by
    intro q hq hbq
    obtain ⟨j, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hchart q hq
    rw [hwq, TΛ4 _ (hout _ (by linarith)), hv4 j x hx hbq, add_zero]
  
  have hcoord : ∀ a : Fin 2, Continuous fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) a := fun a =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  have hr0c : Continuous (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀) := by
    show Continuous fun y : E2 =>
      Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, P.h j₀ x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)
    exact (continuous_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuous_finset_sum _ fun c _ =>
      (continuous_const.mul (hcoord a)).mul (hcoord c)).sqrt
  have hr0x₀ : pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ x₀ = 0 := by
    unfold pcgbPoleRad
    simp
  have hr0pos : ∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ → 0 < pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y := by
    intro y hy
    unfold pcgbPoleRad
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
    have hv0 : (fun a => (y - x₀) a : Fin 2 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hy
      rw [← sub_eq_zero]
      ext a
      simpa using congrFun h0 a
    have hpd := (P.h_posDef j₀ x₀ hx₀W).dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0
    have hform : star (fun a => (y - x₀) a : Fin 2 → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ
        (P.h j₀ x₀).mulVec (fun a => (y - x₀) a) =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, P.h j₀ x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, star_trivial, Pi.star_apply]
      ring
    rw [← hform]
    exact hpd
  
  have hVpo : IsOpen (P.W j₀ ∩ P.param j₀ ⁻¹' U) :=
    (P.param_cont j₀).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j₀) hUo
  have hcb : Metric.closedBall x₀ r₁ ⊆ P.W j₀ ∩ P.param j₀ ⁻¹' U := fun y hy =>
    ⟨hball₁ hy, hRU ⟨(hparamOS j₀ y (hball₁ hy)).2, by have := hpos₁ y hy; linarith⟩⟩
  have hv2b := hv2 j₀
  have hv1d : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ (fun x => v (P.param j₀ x)))
      (P.W j₀ ∩ P.param j₀ ⁻¹' U) := hv2b.fderiv_of_isOpen hVpo (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x₀ r₁).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (hv2b.continuousOn.mono hcb)
  obtain ⟨B₁, hB₁⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x₀ r₁).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    ((hv2b.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hVpo (by norm_num)).mono hcb)
  obtain ⟨B₂, hB₂⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x₀ r₁).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    ((hv1d.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hVpo le_rfl).mono hcb)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x₀ r₁).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hr0c.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = C₂ + |B₀| + |B₁| + |B₂| * |m| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCnn : 0 ≤ C := by rw [hCdef]; positivity
  have hvd : ∀ y ∈ P.W j₀ ∩ P.param j₀ ⁻¹' U, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => v (P.param j₀ x)) y :=
    fun y hy => (hv2b.contDiffAt (hVpo.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt two_ne_zero
  
  set D : E2 → ℝ := fun y => Λ y - Real.log (Real.sqrt
    (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, P.h j₀ x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)) with hDdef
  have hΩo : IsOpen (Metric.ball x₀ ρ₂ \ {x₀}) := Metric.isOpen_ball.sdiff isClosed_singleton
  have hD6 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ D (Metric.ball x₀ ρ₂ \ {x₀}) := hP6
  have hD2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 D (Metric.ball x₀ ρ₂ \ {x₀}) := hD6.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
  have hD1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ D) (Metric.ball x₀ ρ₂ \ {x₀}) :=
    hD2.fderiv_of_isOpen hΩo (by norm_num)
  have hΩV : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ₂ \ {x₀}, y ∈ P.W j₀ ∩ P.param j₀ ⁻¹' U := fun y hy =>
    hcb (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ₂r (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy.1))
  have hDd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ₂ \ {x₀}, DifferentiableAt ℝ D y := fun y hy =>
    (hD2.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt two_ne_zero
  have hEq : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ₂,
      w (P.param j₀ y) - Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y) = D y + v (P.param j₀ y) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hwq, TΛ0 y (hball₂ (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy))]
    simp only [hDdef, pcgbPoleRad]
    ring
  have hF1 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ₂ \ {x₀},
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => w (P.param j₀ y) - Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y)) y =
        fderiv ℝ D y + fderiv ℝ (fun y => v (P.param j₀ y)) y := by
    intro y hy
    have hev : (fun y => w (P.param j₀ y) - Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        fun y => D y + v (P.param j₀ y) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy.1) hEq
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact fderiv_fun_add (hDd y hy) (hvd y (hΩV y hy))
  have hpoleW : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ₂, x ≠ x₀ →
      |w (P.param j₀ x) - Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ x)| ≤ C ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => w (P.param j₀ y) - Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y)) x‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => w (P.param j₀ y) - Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y))) x‖ ≤
        C / pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ x := by
    intro x hx hxne
    have hxcb : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r₁ :=
      Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hρ₂r (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx)
    have hxΩ : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ₂ \ {x₀} := ⟨hx, hxne⟩

      have := hB₀ x hxcb
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this

    have hdvx : ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => v (P.param j₀ y)) x‖ ≤ |B₁| := (hB₁ x hxcb).trans (le_abs_self _)
    have hd2vx : ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => v (P.param j₀ y))) x‖ ≤ |B₂| :=
      (hB₂ x hxcb).trans (le_abs_self _)

      (hD1.contDiffAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hxΩ)).differentiableAt one_ne_zero

        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ D) x + fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => v (P.param j₀ y))) x := by
      have hev : fderiv ℝ (fun y => w (P.param j₀ y) - Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]

    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hEq x hx]
      calc |D x + v (P.param j₀ x)| ≤ |D x| + |v (P.param j₀ x)| := abs_add_le _ _

          rw [hCdef]
          have := abs_nonneg B₁
          have := mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg B₂) (abs_nonneg m)

    · rw [hF1 x hxΩ]

        rw [div_add' _ _ _ hr.ne']

        have : |B₂| * pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ x ≤ |B₂| * |m| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrm (abs_nonneg _)
        rw [hCdef]
        have := abs_nonneg B₀
        have := abs_nonneg B₁
        linarith
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ D) x + fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => v (P.param j₀ y))) x‖

            norm_add_le (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ D) x)
              (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => v (P.param j₀ y))) x)
        _ ≤ C₂ / pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ x + |B₂| := add_le_add e2' hd2vx
        _ ≤ C / pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ x := hkey

        rw [Metric.mem_ball, hy1d]
        linarith

        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hy1d]

        linarith

      refine ⟨P.param j₀ (x₀ + (min δ ρ₂ / 2) • e2 0),
        ⟨hmemN _ hy1W hy1b, (hparamOS j₀ _ hy1W).2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩

      (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {P.param j₀ x₀}ᶜ)) ∧

        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x δ, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x δ,
          |pcgbTransport P j₀ G (P.param j y) - pcgbTransport P j₀ G (P.param j z)| ≤
            K' * dist y z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∧

      have hη1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (b (P.param j x) / s)
      have heq : ρ j (P.param j x) * (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
          gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x * (ε / (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => Gd.w (P.param j y)) x + ε))) *

        rw [heq, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hη0, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hq]

      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm x i j) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    fun i j => h.smooth p i j
  have hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm x i j = h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm x j i :=
    fun x i j => h.symm _ _ _
  have hdet : ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm x).det ≠ 0 :=
    fun x hx => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef h p x hx).det_pos.ne'
  have hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hv.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => 1 + v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    contDiffOn_const.add hw
  have hupos : ∀ x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, 0 < 1 + v ((chartAt E3 p).symm x) :=
    fun x _ => hvpos _
  have hy : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := mem_chart_target E3 p
  have key := conformal_scalarCurvatureLocal (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
    (fun y => 1 + v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) _ hU hG hsymm hdet hu hupos _ hy
  have hcoeff : g'.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm =
      fun x => ((1 + v ((chartAt E3 p).symm x)) ^ 4) • h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm x := by
    funext y
    ext i j
    show g'.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ _ =
      (1 + v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) ^ 4 * h.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) _ _
    rw [hg' ((chartAt E3 p).symm y), ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hpd : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun y => 1 + v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =
      partialDeriv k (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := by
    intro k
    funext z
    simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_const_add]
  have hlap : lapLocal (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => 1 + v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 p p) = h.lapM v p := by
    simp only [lapLocal, RiemannianMetric3.lapM, lapLoc, hessLoc, hpd]
  have hleft : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p :=
    (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
  show scalarCurvatureLocal (g'.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p p) = 0
  refine (congrArg (fun G => scalarCurvatureLocal G (chartAt E3 p p)) hcoeff).trans ?_
  refine key.trans ?_
  show ((1 + v ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))) ^ 5)⁻¹ *
      (-8 * lapLocal (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun y => 1 + v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
          (chartAt E3 p p) +
        h.scalarCurvature p * (1 + v ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)))) = 0
  rw [hlap, hleft, hveq p, mul_zero]

subgoal_signatures.name: conformal_scalarCurvatureLocal
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ)
    (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i)
    (hdet : ∀ x ∈ U, (G x).det ≠ 0) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (hupos : ∀ x ∈ U, 0 < u x)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) :
    scalarCurvatureLocal (fun x => (u x ^ 4) • G x) y =
      (u y ^ 5)⁻¹ * (-8 * lapLocal G u y + scalarCurvatureLocal G y * u y)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M)
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) :
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).PosDef

    (hhi : ∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), g'.g p ξ ξ ≤ c₂ * g.g p ξ ξ) (hC : g.IsCompleteRiemannian) :

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hexp : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (w : E3),
      B (L w) (L w) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, w i * w j * B (L (e i)) (L (e j)) := by
    intro B L w
    have hw : w = w 0 • e 0 + w 1 • e 1 + w 2 • e 2 := by
      ext k
      fin_cases k <;> simp [e]
    conv_lhs => rw [hw]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_smul',
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hsum3 : ∀ (t₀ : ℝ) (f : Fin 3 → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ i, ContinuousAt (f i) t₀) →
      ContinuousAt (fun s => ∑ i : Fin 3, f i s) t₀ := by
    intro t₀ f hf
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    exact ((hf 0).add (hf 1)).add (hf 2)
  
  have hspeed : ∀ (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (γ : ℝ → M), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 γ →
      Continuous (fun t => h.g (γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t)
        (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t)) := by
    intro h γ hγ
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro t₀
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c, c = chartAt E3 (γ t₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hcatlas : c ∈ atlas E3 M := by rw [hc]; exact chart_mem_atlas E3 (γ t₀)
    obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ : ∃ U : Set ℝ, U = γ ⁻¹' c.source := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hUo : IsOpen U := by rw [hU]; exact c.open_source.preimage hγ.continuous
    have ht₀ : t₀ ∈ U := by rw [hU, hc]; exact mem_chart_source E3 (γ t₀)
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : ∃ ψ : ℝ → E3, ψ = fun s => c (γ s) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hψm : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 ψ U := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 c c.source := by
        rw [hc]; exact contMDiffOn_chart
      rw [hψ]
      exact h1.comp hγ.contMDiffOn (fun s hs => by rw [hU] at hs; exact hs)
    have hψd : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ U := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hψm
    have hdc : ContinuousOn (deriv ψ) U := hψd.continuousOn_deriv_of_isOpen hUo le_rfl
    have hvel : ∀ s ∈ U, RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ s =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) c.symm (ψ s) (deriv ψ s) := by
      intro s hs
      have hUs : U ∈ 𝓝 s := hUo.mem_nhds hs
      have hs' : γ s ∈ c.source := by rw [hU] at hs; exact hs
      have heq : γ =ᶠ[𝓝 s] (c.symm ∘ ψ) := by
        filter_upwards [hUs] with s' hs''
        rw [hU] at hs''
        simp only [Function.comp, hψ]
        exact (c.left_inv hs'').symm
      have h1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) c.symm (ψ s) := by
        have : ψ s = c (γ s) := by rw [hψ]
        rw [this]
        exact mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm hcatlas (c.map_source hs')
      have h2 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ s :=
        (hψm.contMDiffAt hUs).mdifferentiableAt one_ne_zero
      unfold RiemannianMetric3.velocity
      have hB : (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ s) (1 : ℝ) = deriv ψ s := by
        rw [mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
        rfl
      rw [heq.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp s h1 h2]
      exact congrArg (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) c.symm (ψ s)) hB
    obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → ℝ, F = fun s => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        deriv ψ s i * deriv ψ s j * coeffMatrix h.g c.symm (ψ s) i j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hFeq : F =ᶠ[𝓝 t₀] (fun t => h.g (γ t) (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t)
        (RiemannianMetric3.velocity γ t)) := by
      filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds ht₀] with s hs
      have hs' : γ s ∈ c.source := by rw [hU] at hs; exact hs
      have hγs : γ s = c.symm (ψ s) := by rw [hψ]; exact (c.left_inv hs').symm
      rw [hvel s hs, hF]
      simp only [coeffMatrix]
      rw [hγs]
      exact (hexp _ _ _).symm
    have hFc : ContinuousAt F t₀ := by
      rw [hF]
      have hψc : ContinuousAt ψ t₀ := hψd.continuousOn.continuousAt (hUo.mem_nhds ht₀)
      have hdct : ContinuousAt (deriv ψ) t₀ := hdc.continuousAt (hUo.mem_nhds ht₀)
      have hwi : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (fun s => deriv ψ s i) t₀ := fun i =>
        (PiLp.continuous_apply 2 _ i).continuousAt.comp hdct
      have hψt : ψ t₀ ∈ c.target := by
        have : ψ t₀ = c (γ t₀) := by rw [hψ]
        rw [this]
        have hs' : γ t₀ ∈ c.source := by rw [hU] at ht₀; exact ht₀
        exact c.map_source hs'
      have hcoef : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContinuousAt (fun s => coeffMatrix h.g c.symm (ψ s) i j) t₀ := by
        intro i j
        have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun y => coeffMatrix h.g c.symm y i j) (ψ t₀) := by
          have := h.smooth (γ t₀) i j
          rw [← hc] at this
          exact this.continuousOn.continuousAt (c.open_target.mem_nhds hψt)
        exact h1.comp hψc
      exact hsum3 t₀ _ (fun i => hsum3 t₀ _ (fun j => ((hwi i).mul (hwi j)).mul (hcoef i j)))
    exact hFc.congr hFeq
  
  have hnn : ∀ (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p q : M), 0 ≤ h.riemannianDist p q := by
    intro h p q
    unfold RiemannianMetric3.riemannianDist RiemannianMetric3.curveLength
    exact Real.iInf_nonneg (fun i =>
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun t _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
  have hcmp : ∀ (h₁ h₂ : RiemannianMetric3 M) (a : ℝ), 0 ≤ a →
      (∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), a * h₁.g p ξ ξ ≤ h₂.g p ξ ξ) →
      ∀ p q : M, Real.sqrt a * h₁.riemannianDist p q ≤ h₂.riemannianDist p q := by
    intro h₁ h₂ a ha hle p q
    have hL : ∀ γ : ℝ → M, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 γ →
        0 ≤ h₁.curveLength γ ∧ Real.sqrt a * h₁.curveLength γ ≤ h₂.curveLength γ := by
      intro γ hγ
      have c1 := (hspeed h₁ γ hγ).sqrt
      have c2 := (hspeed h₂ γ hγ).sqrt
      unfold RiemannianMetric3.curveLength
      refine ⟨intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg zero_le_one (fun t _ => Real.sqrt_nonneg _), ?_⟩
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on zero_le_one
        ((c1.intervalIntegrable 0 1).const_mul _) (c2.intervalIntegrable 0 1) (fun t _ => ?_)
      rw [← Real.sqrt_mul ha]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (hle _ _)
    unfold RiemannianMetric3.riemannianDist
    rw [Real.mul_iInf_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg a)]
    exact ciInf_mono ⟨0, by
        rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hL i.1 i.2.1).1⟩
      (fun i => (hL i.1 i.2.1).2)
  
  have hgnn : ∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), 0 ≤ g.g p ξ ξ := by
    intro p ξ
    by_cases hξ : ξ = 0
    · subst hξ; simp
    · exact (g.posDef p ξ hξ).le
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = max c₂ 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hCpos : 0 < C := by rw [hCdef]; exact lt_max_of_lt_right one_pos
  have hle2 : ∀ (p : M) (ξ : E3), (1 / C) * g'.g p ξ ξ ≤ g.g p ξ ξ := by
    intro p ξ
    have h1 : g'.g p ξ ξ ≤ C * g.g p ξ ξ := (hhi p ξ).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by rw [hCdef]; exact le_max_left _ _) (hgnn p ξ))
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_le_iff₀ hCpos]
    linarith
  have hd1 := hcmp g g' c₁ hc₁.le hlo
  have hd2 := hcmp g' g (1 / C) (by positivity) hle2
  have hk : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 / C) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  intro u hu
  have hu' : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, g.riemannianDist (u m) (u n) < ε := by
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hu (Real.sqrt c₁ * ε) (mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hc₁) hε)
    refine ⟨N, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
    have h3 : Real.sqrt c₁ * g.riemannianDist (u m) (u n) < Real.sqrt c₁ * ε :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (hd1 _ _) (hN m hm n hn)
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h3 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hC u hu'
  refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
  have ht : Tendsto (fun n => (Real.sqrt (1 / C))⁻¹ * g.riemannianDist (u n) p) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using hp.const_mul (Real.sqrt (1 / C))⁻¹
  refine squeeze_zero (fun n => hnn g' (u n) p) (fun n => ?_) ht
  rw [le_inv_mul_iff₀ hk]
  exact hd2 (u n) p

informal_problem.statement:
(G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ)
    (q q' R : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hq' : 0 < q') (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ)))
    (hudec : ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 → (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l u x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - (l : ℝ)))
    (hG' : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → G' x = ((1 + u x) ^ 4) • G x) :
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G' y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-(min q q') - (l : ℝ))

signature.name: conformal_factor_decay
signature.statement:
(G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ)
    (q q' R : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hq' : 0 < q') (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ)))
    (hudec : ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 → (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l u x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - (l : ℝ)))
    (hG' : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → G' x = ((1 + u x) ^ 4) • G x) :
    ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G' y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-(min q q') - (l : ℝ))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro i j l hl
  have hev : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3, 1 < ‖x‖ :=
    tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop 1
  have hopen : IsOpen {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have t_mono : ∀ (s s' : ℝ), s ≤ s' →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ s) =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ s' := by
    intro s s' hss
    refine Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1 ?_
    filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _),
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _), one_mul]
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx.le hss
  
  have t_lincomb : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (m₁ m₂ m α β : ℝ), m₁ ≤ m → m₂ ≤ m →
      cdecaySym f m₁ → cdecaySym g m₂ → cdecaySym (fun y => α * f y + β * g y) m := by
    intro f g m₁ m₂ m α β h₁ h₂ hf hg
    refine ⟨(contDiffOn_const.mul hf.1).add (contDiffOn_const.mul hg.1), fun l hl => ?_⟩
    have key : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3,
        ‖‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => α * f y + β * g y) x‖‖ ≤
          1 * ‖|α| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l f x‖ + |β| * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l g x‖‖ := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
      have hfx : ContDiffAt ℝ l f x :=
        (hf.1.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hgx : ContDiffAt ℝ l g x :=
        (hg.1.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds hx)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have e : (fun y => α * f y + β * g y) = α • f + β • g := by
        funext y; simp [smul_eq_mul]
      have hfs : ContDiffAt ℝ l (α • f) x := hfx.const_smul α
      have hgs : ContDiffAt ℝ l (β • g) x := hgx.const_smul β
      rw [e, iteratedFDeriv_add_apply hfs hgs,
        iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hfx, iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply hgx, norm_norm,
        one_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      calc _ ≤ ‖α • iteratedFDeriv ℝ l f x‖ + ‖β • iteratedFDeriv ℝ l g x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = _ := by rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have b1 := ((hf.2 l hl).const_mul_left |α|).trans (t_mono (m₁ - l) (m - l) (by linarith))
    have b2 := ((hg.2 l hl).const_mul_left |β|).trans (t_mono (m₂ - l) (m - l) (by linarith))
    exact (Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1 key).trans (b1.add b2)
  
  have t_mul : ∀ (f g : E3 → ℝ) (m₁ m₂ : ℝ),
      cdecaySym f m₁ → cdecaySym g m₂ → cdecaySym (fun y => f y * g y) (m₁ + m₂) := by
    intro f g m₁ m₂ hf hg
    refine ⟨hf.1.mul hg.1, fun l hl => ?_⟩
    have key : ∀ᶠ x in Bornology.cobounded E3,
        ‖‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => f y * g y) x‖‖ ≤
          1 * ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), (l.choose k : ℝ) * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x‖ *
            ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (l - k) g x‖‖ := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
      have h := norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_mul_le hf.1 hg.1 hopen.uniqueDiffOn hx (n := l)
        (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hw : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : E3 → ℝ),
          iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n u {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} x = iteratedFDeriv ℝ n u x :=
        fun n u => iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen n hopen hx
      simp only [hw] at h
      rw [norm_norm, one_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => by positivity))]
      exact h
    have hsum : (fun x => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (l + 1), (l.choose k : ℝ) *
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x‖ * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (l - k) g x‖) =O[Bornology.cobounded E3]
        (fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (m₁ + m₂ - (l : ℝ))) := by
      apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.sum
      intro k hk
      have hkl : k ≤ l := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      have h1 :=
        ((hf.2 k (by omega)).const_mul_left (l.choose k : ℝ)).mul (hg.2 (l - k) (by omega))
      refine h1.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun x => rfl) ?_
      filter_upwards [hev] with x hx
      rw [← Real.rpow_add (by linarith)]
      congr 1
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hkl]
      ring
    exact (Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound 1 key).trans hsum
  
  have hus : cdecaySym u (-q') := ⟨hu, hudec⟩
  
  have hu2 := t_mul _ _ _ _ hus hus
  have hu3 := t_mul _ _ _ _ hu2 hus
  have hu4 := t_mul _ _ _ _ hu3 hus
  have hA := t_lincomb _ _ _ _ (-q') 4 6 le_rfl (by linarith) hus hu2
  have hB := t_lincomb _ _ _ _ (-q') 4 1 (by linarith) (by linarith) hu3 hu4
  have hV' := t_lincomb _ _ _ _ (-q') 1 1 le_rfl le_rfl hA hB
  obtain ⟨V, hVdef⟩ : ∃ V : E3 → ℝ, V = fun y => (1 + u y) ^ 4 - 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hV : cdecaySym V (-q') := by
    have e : V = fun y => 1 * (4 * u y + 6 * (u y * u y)) +
        1 * (4 * (u y * u y * u y) + 1 * (u y * u y * u y * u y)) := by
      rw [hVdef]; funext y; ring
    rw [e]; exact hV'
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hhdef⟩ : ∃ h : E3 → ℝ, h = fun y => G y i j - c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hh : cdecaySym h (-q) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hhdef]; exact (hsmooth i j).sub contDiffOn_const
    · intro l hl
      rw [hhdef, hc]
      exact hdecay i j l hl
  have hVh := t_mul _ _ _ _ hV hh
  have hmin1 := min_le_left q q'
  have hmin2 := min_le_right q q'
  have hT := t_lincomb _ _ (-q) (-q' + -q) (-(min q q')) 1 1 (by linarith) (by linarith) hh hVh
  have hH := t_lincomb _ _ (-(min q q')) (-q') (-(min q q')) 1 c le_rfl (by linarith) hT hV
  have hfarnhds : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ →
      (fun y => G' y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => 1 * (1 * h y + 1 * (V y * h y)) + c * V y) := by
    intro x hx
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm).mem_nhds hx) ?_
    intro y hy
    have hy' : R < ‖y‖ := hy
    have hGy : G' y i j = (1 + u y) ^ 4 * G y i j := by
      rw [hG' y hy', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    simp only
    rw [hGy, ← hc, hhdef, hVdef]
    ring
  refine (hH.2 l hl).congr' ?_ (EventuallyEq.rfl)
  filter_upwards [tendsto_norm_cobounded_atTop.eventually_gt_atTop R] with x hx
  rw [((hfarnhds x hx).iteratedFDeriv ℝ l).eq_of_nhds]

informal_problem.statement:
(G G' : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ)
    (q q' R : ℝ) (hq : 1 / 2 < q) (hq' : 1 / 2 < q') (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖})
    (hdecay : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
      (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l (fun y => G y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ)))
    (hudec : ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 → (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l u x‖)
        =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q' - (l : ℝ)))
    (hG' : ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → G' x = ((1 + u x) ^ 4) • G x) :
    Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => fluxLocal G' r - fluxLocal G r -
      4 * fluxLocal (fun x => (1 + u x) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) r) atTop (𝓝 0)
