  have hball1 : Metric.closedBall y₁ R ⊆ ψ.source :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)).trans hball2
  have hΩK : Metric.ball y₁ R ⊆ Metric.closedBall y₁ R := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have hΩs : Metric.ball y₁ R ⊆ ψ.source := hΩK.trans hball1
  
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => w (ψ z)) ψ.source :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hw.comp_contMDiffOn ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun)
  let ζ : ContDiffBump y₁ := ⟨R, 2 * R, hR, by linarith⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : E3 → ℝ, W = fun y => ζ y * w (ψ y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hWy : ∀ y, W y = ζ y * w (ψ y) := fun y => by rw [hWdef]
  have hζ1 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall y₁ R, ζ y = 1 := fun y hy => ζ.one_of_mem_closedBall hy
  have hWc : ContDiff ℝ 2 W := by
    have hinf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W := by
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro y
      by_cases hy : y ∈ ψ.source
      · rw [hWdef]
        exact (ζ.contDiff.contDiffOn.mul hf).contDiffAt (ψ.open_source.mem_nhds hy)
      · have hyt : y ∉ tsupport (ζ : E3 → ℝ) := by
          rw [ζ.tsupport_eq]
          exact fun hc => hy (hball2 hc)
        have hev := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.1 hyt
        have hev' : W =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [hev] with z hz
          have hz' : ζ z = 0 := hz
          rw [hWy z, hz', zero_mul]
        exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev'
    exact hinf.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
  have hW0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ W y := fun y => by rw [hWy y]; exact mul_nonneg ζ.nonneg (hnn _)
  have hWv : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ R, W y = w (ψ y) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hWy y, hζ1 y (hΩK hy), one_mul]
  have hWev : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ R, W =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => w (ψ z)) := by
    intro y hy
    filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
    exact hWv z hz
  have hW1 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ R, ∀ k : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv k W y = partialDeriv k (fun z => w (ψ z)) y := by
    intro y hy k
    exact congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e k)) (hWev y hy).fderiv_eq
  have hW2 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ R, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j W) y =
        partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => w (ψ z))) y := by
    intro y hy i j
    have hev : partialDeriv j W =ᶠ[𝓝 y] partialDeriv j (fun z => w (ψ z)) := by
      filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact hW1 z hz j
    exact congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e i)) hev.fderiv_eq
  
  have hGsm : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h.coeff ψ y a b) ψ.source :=
    fun a b => coeff_contDiffOn_source h ψ a b
  have hpos : ∀ y ∈ ψ.source, (h.coeff ψ y).PosDef := fun y hy => coeff_posDef h ψ y hy
  obtain ⟨m, Mx, Gam, hm, hMx, hGam, hCB⟩ :=
    coeff_compact_bounds (h.coeff ψ) ψ.source y₁ R ψ.open_source hball1 hGsm hpos
  have hscont : ContinuousOn (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, |h.coeff ψ y a b|) ψ.source :=
    continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
      (hGsm a b).continuousOn.abs
  have hinvc := (nds_chart_cont h ψ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
    contMDiff_const contMDiff_const).2.2.2.2
  have hicont : ContinuousOn
      (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, |(h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b|) ψ.source :=
    continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun b _ => (hinvc a b).abs
  have hVc : ContinuousOn (fun y => V (ψ y)) ψ.source :=
    hV.continuous.comp_continuousOn ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall y₁ R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hscont.mono hball1)
  obtain ⟨C₂, hC₂⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall y₁ R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hicont.mono hball1)
  obtain ⟨C₃, hC₃⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall y₁ R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hVc.mono hball1)
  have hB : 0 < max C₁ 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos (le_max_right _ _)
  have hell : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall y₁ R, ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      (1 / max C₁ 1) * ∑ i, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j := by
    intro y hy v
    have hq := cceb_inv_quad_lower (h.coeff ψ y) (hpos y (hball1 hy)) v
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |h.coeff ψ y i j| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => abs_nonneg _
    have hsB : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |h.coeff ψ y i j| ≤ max C₁ 1 := by
      have h1 : ‖∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |h.coeff ψ y i j|‖ ≤ C₁ := hC₁ y hy
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs0] at h1
      exact h1.trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have hv0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _
    have hQ : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j := by
      by_contra hneg
      push_neg at hneg
      have h1 : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |h.coeff ψ y i j|) *
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j) ≤ 0 :=
        mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hs0 hneg.le
      have h2 : ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm (hq.trans h1) hv0
      have hv : ∀ i, v i = 0 := by
        intro i
        have h3 := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (v i))).1 h2 i
          (Finset.mem_univ _)
        exact (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).1 h3
      have h4 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j = 0 := by
        simp [hv]
      linarith
    calc (1 / max C₁ 1) * ∑ i, v i ^ 2
        ≤ (1 / max C₁ 1) * (max C₁ 1 * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hq.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsB hQ))
            (one_div_pos.2 hB).le
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j * v i * v j := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, one_div_mul_cancel hB.ne', one_mul]
  obtain ⟨Lam, hLamdef⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = max C₂ 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hLam0 : 0 ≤ Lam := by rw [hLamdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hLamB : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall y₁ R, ∀ a b : Fin 3, |(h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b| ≤ Lam := by
    intro y hy a b
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |(h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => abs_nonneg _
    have h1 : ‖∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |(h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j|‖ ≤ C₂ := hC₂ y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs0] at h1
    rw [hLamdef]
    calc |(h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b| ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, |(h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |(h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a j|)
            (fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ b)
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |(h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j| :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => ∑ j : Fin 3, |(h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j|)
            (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => abs_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ a)
      _ ≤ C₂ := h1
      _ ≤ max C₂ 0 := le_max_left _ _
  obtain ⟨BV, hBVdef⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = max C₃ 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hBV0 : 0 ≤ BV := by rw [hBVdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hBVB : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall y₁ R, |V (ψ y)| ≤ BV := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 : ‖V (ψ y)‖ ≤ C₃ := hC₃ y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    rw [hBVdef]
    exact h1.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have hceq : ∀ y ∈ ψ.source,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => w (ψ z))) y =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j *
          ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel (h.coeff ψ) k i j y * partialDeriv k (fun z => w (ψ z)) y
        + V (ψ y) * w (ψ y) / 8 := by
    intro y hy
    have hinv := lapLocal_chart_invariant h ψ w Set.univ isOpen_univ hw.contMDiffOn y hy
      (Set.mem_univ _)
    have e2 : lapM h w (ψ y) = h.lapM w (ψ y) := rfl
    have e3 := heq (ψ y)
    have hL : lapLocal (h.coeff ψ) (w ∘ ψ) y =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => w (ψ z))) y -
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j *
          ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel (h.coeff ψ) k i j y * partialDeriv k (fun z => w (ψ z)) y := by
      unfold lapLocal
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      exact mul_sub _ _ _
    linarith
  
  have hpb : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (d : Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (L G : ℝ), 0 ≤ L → 0 ≤ G → (∀ i j, |A i j| ≤ L) → (∀ k i j, |C k i j| ≤ G) →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ∑ k : Fin 3, C k i j * d k ≤
        9 * L * G * ∑ k : Fin 3, |d k| := by
    intro A C d L G hL hG hAb hCb
    have hterm : ∀ i j, A i j * ∑ k : Fin 3, C k i j * d k ≤ L * G * ∑ k : Fin 3, |d k| := by
      intro i j
      have h1 : |∑ k : Fin 3, C k i j * d k| ≤ G * ∑ k : Fin 3, |d k| := by
        calc |∑ k : Fin 3, C k i j * d k| ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, |C k i j * d k| :=
              Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, G * |d k| := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => by
              rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hCb k i j) (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = G * ∑ k : Fin 3, |d k| := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      calc A i j * ∑ k : Fin 3, C k i j * d k ≤ |A i j * ∑ k : Fin 3, C k i j * d k| :=
            le_abs_self _
        _ = |A i j| * |∑ k : Fin 3, C k i j * d k| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ L * (G * ∑ k : Fin 3, |d k|) := mul_le_mul (hAb i j) h1 (abs_nonneg _) hL
        _ = L * G * ∑ k : Fin 3, |d k| := by ring
    calc ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A i j * ∑ k : Fin 3, C k i j * d k
        ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, L * G * ∑ k : Fin 3, |d k| :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hterm i j
      _ = 9 * L * G * ∑ k : Fin 3, |d k| := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]; ring
  
  obtain ⟨K₀, hK₀⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = 9 * Lam * Gam + BV / 8 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hkey : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ R,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j W) y ≤
        K₀ * (W y + ∑ i : Fin 3, |partialDeriv i W y|) := by
    intro y hy
    have hyK : y ∈ Metric.closedBall y₁ R := hΩK hy
    have hys : y ∈ ψ.source := hball1 hyK
    have e1 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j W) y =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j (fun z => w (ψ z))) y :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by rw [hW2 y hy i j]
    have e2 := hceq y hys
    have hb : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j *
          ∑ k : Fin 3, christoffel (h.coeff ψ) k i j y * partialDeriv k (fun z => w (ψ z)) y ≤
        9 * Lam * Gam * ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun z => w (ψ z)) y| :=
      hpb _ (fun k i j => christoffel (h.coeff ψ) k i j y)
        (fun k => partialDeriv k (fun z => w (ψ z)) y)
        Lam Gam hLam0 hGam (hLamB y hyK) (fun k i j => (hCB y hyK).2.2.2 k i j)
    have hS : ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k W y| =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun z => w (ψ z)) y| :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by rw [hW1 y hy k]
    have hWy' : W y = w (ψ y) := hWv y hy
    have hVW : V (ψ y) * w (ψ y) ≤ BV * w (ψ y) :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self _) (hnn _)).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hBVB y hyK) (hnn _))
    have hS0 : 0 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun z => w (ψ z)) y| :=
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => abs_nonneg _
    have p1 : 0 ≤ 9 * Lam * Gam * w (ψ y) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hLam0) hGam) (hnn _)
    have p2 : 0 ≤ BV / 8 * ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun z => w (ψ z)) y| :=
      mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hBV0 (by norm_num)) hS0
    have hexp : K₀ * (W y + ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k W y|) =
        (9 * Lam * Gam * ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k W y| + BV * W y / 8) +
        (9 * Lam * Gam * W y + BV / 8 * ∑ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k W y|) := by
      rw [hK₀]; ring
    rw [e1, e2, hexp, hS, hWy']
    linarith
  have h0 : W y₁ = 0 := by rw [hWv y₁ (Metric.mem_ball_self hR), hψy₁, hp₁]
  have hWz : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ R, W y = 0 := by
    refine hopf_strong_min_principle (Metric.ball y₁ R) Metric.isOpen_ball
      (convex_ball y₁ R).isPreconnected W hWc (fun y _ => hW0 y) ?_ y₁
      (Metric.mem_ball_self hR) h0
    intro y' hy' _
    refine ⟨fun y => (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹, R - dist y' y₁, 1 / max C₁ 1, Lam, K₀, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := Metric.mem_ball.1 hy'
      linarith
    · exact one_div_pos.2 hB
    · intro y hy
      have hyΩ : y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ R := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hy ⊢
        have := dist_triangle y y' y₁
        linarith
      exact ⟨hyΩ, hell y (hΩK hyΩ), hLamB y (hΩK hyΩ), hkey y hyΩ⟩
  
  have himgo : IsOpen (ψ '' Metric.ball y₁ R) :=
    ψ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_image_of_subset_source Metric.isOpen_ball hΩs
  refine ⟨ψ '' Metric.ball y₁ R, himgo.mem_nhds ⟨y₁, Metric.mem_ball_self hR, hψy₁⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro p ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  rw [← hWv y hy]
  exact hWz y hy

subgoal_signatures.name: hopf_strong_min_principle
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(Ω : Set E3) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hΩc : IsPreconnected Ω)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiff ℝ 2 w) (hnn : ∀ y ∈ Ω, 0 ≤ w y)
    (hloc : ∀ y₁ ∈ Ω, w y₁ = 0 → ∃ (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (r lam Lam K : ℝ),
      0 < r ∧ 0 < lam ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₁ r, y ∈ Ω ∧
        (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, lam * ∑ i, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * v i * v j) ∧
        (∀ i j, |A y i j| ≤ Lam) ∧
        ∑ i, ∑ j, A y i j * partialDeriv i (partialDeriv j w) y ≤
          K * (w y + ∑ i, |partialDeriv i w y|))
    (y₀ : E3) (hy₀ : y₀ ∈ Ω) (h0 : w y₀ = 0) : ∀ y ∈ Ω, w y = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_compact_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Ω : Set E3) (c : E3)
    (R0 : ℝ) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hball : Metric.closedBall c R0 ⊆ Ω)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) Ω)
    (hpos : ∀ y ∈ Ω, (G y).PosDef) :
    ∃ m Mx Γ : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ 0 ≤ Mx ∧ 0 ≤ Γ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c R0,
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, m * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G y i j * v j) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * G y i j * v j ≤ Mx * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ,
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, v i * (G y)⁻¹ i j * v j ≤ m⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ k i j : Fin 3, |christoffel G k i j y| ≤ Γ)

subgoal_signatures.name: cceb_inv_quad_lower
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hG : G.PosDef) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, v i ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |G i j|) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G⁻¹ i j * v i * v j

subgoal_signatures.name: lapLocal_chart_invariant
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) (hxV : Φ x ∈ V) :
    lapLocal (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) x = lapM g f (Φ x)

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ φ.source) :
    (g.coeff φ y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_contDiffOn_source
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_chart_cont
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv a (fun x => u (κ x))) κ.source) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u w (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.coeff κ x).det) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ a b) κ.source)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (V f : M → ℝ)
    (hV : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ V) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (u : ℕ → M → ℝ) (hu : ∀ n, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u n))
    (hC : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (L : Set E3),
      IsCompact L → L ⊆ ψ.source → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m, N ≤ m → ∀ n, N ≤ n →
        ∫ y in L, ((u n (ψ y) - u m (ψ y)) ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) y
            - partialDeriv i (fun z => u m (ψ z)) y) ^ 2) < ε)
    (hEL : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (ζ : E3 → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ψ.source →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y, (8 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b *
            partialDeriv b (fun z => u n (ψ z)) y * partialDeriv a ζ y
          + (V (ψ y) * u n (ψ y) - f (ψ y)) * ζ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det)
        atTop (𝓝 0))
    (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hB : Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ ψ.source) :
    ∃ w : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w (Metric.ball c (r / 4)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c (r / 4),
        -8 * lapLoc (h.coeff ψ) w x + V (ψ x) * w x = f (ψ x)) ∧
      (∀ n, MemLp (fun x => u n (ψ x) - w x) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4)))) ∧
      (∀ n (i : Fin 3), MemLp (fun x => partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) x
        - partialDeriv i w x) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4)))) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 4), (u n (ψ x) - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 4),
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) x - partialDeriv i w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)

signature.name: cwl_chart_solution
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (V f : M → ℝ)
    (hV : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ V) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (u : ℕ → M → ℝ) (hu : ∀ n, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u n))
    (hC : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (L : Set E3),
      IsCompact L → L ⊆ ψ.source → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m, N ≤ m → ∀ n, N ≤ n →
        ∫ y in L, ((u n (ψ y) - u m (ψ y)) ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin 3,
          (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) y
            - partialDeriv i (fun z => u m (ψ z)) y) ^ 2) < ε)
    (hEL : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (ζ : E3 → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ψ.source →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y, (8 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b *
            partialDeriv b (fun z => u n (ψ z)) y * partialDeriv a ζ y
          + (V (ψ y) * u n (ψ y) - f (ψ y)) * ζ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det)
        atTop (𝓝 0))
    (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hB : Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ ψ.source) :
    ∃ w : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w (Metric.ball c (r / 4)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c (r / 4),
        -8 * lapLoc (h.coeff ψ) w x + V (ψ x) * w x = f (ψ x)) ∧
      (∀ n, MemLp (fun x => u n (ψ x) - w x) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4)))) ∧
      (∀ n (i : Fin 3), MemLp (fun x => partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) x
        - partialDeriv i w x) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4)))) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 4), (u n (ψ x) - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 3, Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 4),
        (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) x - partialDeriv i w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hr2 : r / 2 ≤ r := by linarith
  have hr4 : r / 4 ≤ r / 2 := by linarith
  have hK2S : Metric.closedBall c (r / 2) ⊆ ψ.source :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hr2).trans hB
  have hB2S : Metric.ball c (r / 2) ⊆ ψ.source := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hK2S
  have hBrS : Metric.ball c r ⊆ ψ.source := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hB
  have hB42 : Metric.ball c (r / 4) ⊆ Metric.ball c (r / 2) := Metric.ball_subset_ball hr4
  have hB4S : Metric.ball c (r / 4) ⊆ ψ.source := hB42.trans hB2S
  have hvn_sm : ∀ n, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => u n (ψ z)) ψ.source := fun n =>
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp ((hu n).comp_contMDiffOn ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun)
  have hvn_d : ∀ n (i : Fin 3), ContinuousOn (partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z))) ψ.source := by
    intro n i
    have h1 := (hvn_sm n).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen ψ.open_source
      (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    show ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => u n (ψ z)) y (e i)) ψ.source
    exact h1.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hFR := flat_coeff_regular h ψ
  have hsd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ z).det) ψ.source :=
    ccs_sqrtdet_smooth (h.coeff ψ) ψ.source (coeff_contDiffOn_source h ψ)
      (fun z hz => (coeff_posDef h ψ z hz).det_pos)
  have hsdpos : ∀ z ∈ ψ.source, 0 < Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ z).det := fun z hz =>
    Real.sqrt_pos.2 (coeff_posDef h ψ z hz).det_pos
  have hVψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => V (ψ z)) ψ.source :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hV.comp_contMDiffOn ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun)
  have hfψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => f (ψ z)) ψ.source :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hf.comp_contMDiffOn ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun)
  
  let A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := fun y =>
    Matrix.of (fun a b => 8 * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det * (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b)
  let P : E3 → ℝ := fun y => Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det * V (ψ y)
  let F : E3 → ℝ := fun y => -(Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det * f (ψ y))
  have hAsm : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) ψ.source := by
    intro a b
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => 8 * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ x).det * (h.coeff ψ x)⁻¹ a b) ψ.source
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul hsd).mul (hFR.1 a b)
  have hAs : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c r, ∀ a b : Fin 3, A x a b = A x b a := by
    intro x hx a b
    show 8 * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ x).det * (h.coeff ψ x)⁻¹ a b
      = 8 * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ x).det * (h.coeff ψ x)⁻¹ b a
    rw [hFR.2.1 x (hBrS hx) a b]
  have hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c r, (A x).PosDef := by
    intro x hx
    have hAx : A x = (8 * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ x).det) • (h.coeff ψ x)⁻¹ := by
      ext a b
      simp only [A, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hAx]
    exact Matrix.PosDef.smul (hFR.2.2.1 x (hBrS hx)) (mul_pos (by norm_num) (hsdpos x (hBrS hx)))
  have hPsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P ψ.source := hsd.mul hVψ
  have hFsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F ψ.source := (hsd.mul hfψ).neg
  
  obtain ⟨hvnL, hdvnL, v, Gr, hvL, hGL, hv0, hv1⟩ :=
    cwl_l2_limits c (r / 2) (fun n z => u n (ψ z))
      (fun n => (hvn_sm n).continuousOn.mono hK2S)
      (fun n i => (hvn_d n i).mono hK2S)
      (hC ψ _ (isCompact_closedBall c (r / 2)) hK2S)
  
  have hlim : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c (r / 2) →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 2),
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            A x a b * partialDeriv b (fun z => u n (ψ z)) x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * u n (ψ x) + F x) * ζ x)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have h1 := hEL ψ ζ hζ hζc (hζs.trans hB2S)
    have hpt : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : E3), (8 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b *
            partialDeriv b (fun z => u n (ψ z)) y * partialDeriv a ζ y
          + (V (ψ y) * u n (ψ y) - f (ψ y)) * ζ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det
        = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            A y a b * partialDeriv b (fun z => u n (ψ z)) y * partialDeriv a ζ y)
          + (P y * u n (ψ y) + F y) * ζ y := by
      intro n y
      simp only [A, P, F, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      ring
    have hzero : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ y ∉ Metric.ball c (r / 2),
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            A y a b * partialDeriv b (fun z => u n (ψ z)) y * partialDeriv a ζ y)
          + (P y * u n (ψ y) + F y) * ζ y = 0 := by
      intro n y hy
      have hyt : y ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h' => hy (hζs h')
      have hζ0 : ζ y = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hyt
      have hd0 : fderiv ℝ ζ y = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hyt (support_fderiv_subset ℝ hne)
      have hpd : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a ζ y = 0 := fun a => by
        simp only [partialDeriv, hd0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
      simp only [hpd, hζ0, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
    refine h1.congr fun n => ?_
    calc _ = ∫ y, ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
            A y a b * partialDeriv b (fun z => u n (ψ z)) y * partialDeriv a ζ y)
          + (P y * u n (ψ y) + F y) * ζ y) :=
          integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hpt n))
      _ = _ := (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (hzero n)).symm
  have hweak := cwl_weak_limit_identity c (r / 2) A P F
    (fun a b => (hAsm a b).continuousOn.mono hB2S) (hPsm.continuousOn.mono hB2S)
    (hFsm.continuousOn.mono hB2S) (fun n z => u n (ψ z)) v Gr hvnL hdvnL hvL hGL hv0 hv1 hlim
  
  obtain ⟨v', hv'sm, hae0, hae1, hdiv⟩ := cwl_interior_regularity c r hr A
    (fun a b => (hAsm a b).mono hBrS) hAs hApos P F (hPsm.mono hBrS) (hFsm.mono hBrS)
    v Gr (fun n z => u n (ψ z)) (fun m => (hvn_sm m).mono hBrS) hvL hGL hv0 hv1 hweak
  
  have heqn : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c (r / 4),
      -8 * lapLoc (h.coeff ψ) v' x + V (ψ x) * v' x = f (ψ x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hd := hdiv x hx
    have hfun : ∀ a : Fin 3, (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, A y a b * partialDeriv b v' y)
        = (8 : ℝ) • (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3,
            Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det * (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b v' y) := by
      intro a
      funext y
      simp only [A, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      ring
    have hpd8 : ∀ a : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, A y a b * partialDeriv b v' y) x
          = 8 * partialDeriv a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3,
            Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det * (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b v' y) x := by
      intro a
      rw [hfun a]
      simp only [partialDeriv, fderiv_const_smul_of_field, Pi.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hdf := lapLoc_div_form (Metric.ball c (r / 4)) Metric.isOpen_ball (h.coeff ψ)
      (fun i j => (coeff_contDiffOn_source h ψ i j).mono hB4S) (fun y i j => h.symm _ _ _)
      (fun y hy => coeff_posDef h ψ y (hB4S hy)) v' hv'sm x hx
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hpd8 a), ← Finset.mul_sum, hdf] at hd
    have hs := hsdpos x (hB4S hx)
    have key : Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ x).det *
        (-8 * lapLoc (h.coeff ψ) v' x + V (ψ x) * v' x - f (ψ x)) = 0 := by
      simp only [P, F] at hd
      linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) * hd
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 key with h0 | h0
    · linarith
    · linarith
  
  have hμ : volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4)) ≤ volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 2)) :=
    Measure.restrict_mono hB42 le_rfl
  have restrict_lim : ∀ (g : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (v₀ w₀ : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ n, MemLp (fun x => g n x - v₀ x) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 2)))) →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 2), (g n x - v₀ x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4))), v₀ x = w₀ x) →
      (∀ n, MemLp (fun x => g n x - w₀ x) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4)))) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 4), (g n x - w₀ x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro g v₀ w₀ hm ht hae
    have hae' : ∀ n, (fun x => g n x - v₀ x) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4))]
        (fun x => g n x - w₀ x) := fun n => hae.mono fun x hx => by simp only [hx]
    refine ⟨fun n => ((hm n).mono_measure hμ).ae_eq (hae' n), ?_⟩
    have heq : ∀ n, ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 4), (g n x - w₀ x) ^ 2
        = ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 4), (g n x - v₀ x) ^ 2 :=
      fun n => integral_congr_ae (hae.mono fun x hx => by simp only [hx])
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds ht
      (fun n => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
    · show (0 : ℝ) ≤ ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 4), (g n x - w₀ x) ^ 2
      rw [heq n]
      exact integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
    · show ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 4), (g n x - w₀ x) ^ 2
          ≤ ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 2), (g n x - v₀ x) ^ 2
      rw [heq n]
      exact setIntegral_mono_set (hm n).integrable_sq
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => sq_nonneg _)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x hx => hB42 hx)
  obtain ⟨hm0, ht0⟩ := restrict_lim (fun n x => u n (ψ x)) v v'
    (fun n => (hvnL n).sub hvL) hv0 hae0
  have hpar := fun i : Fin 3 => restrict_lim
    (fun n x => partialDeriv i (fun z => u n (ψ z)) x) (Gr i) (partialDeriv i v')
    (fun n => (hdvnL n i).sub (hGL i)) (hv1 i) (hae1 i)
  exact ⟨v', hv'sm, heqn, hm0, fun n i => (hpar i).1 n, ht0, fun i => (hpar i).2⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: cwl_interior_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c r))
    (hAs : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c r, ∀ a b : Fin 3, A x a b = A x b a)
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c r, (A x).PosDef)
    (P F : E3 → ℝ) (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P (Metric.ball c r))
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball c r))
    (v : E3 → ℝ) (Gr : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (vn : ℕ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hvn : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (vn m) (Metric.ball c r))
    (hvL : MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 2))))
    (hGL : ∀ a, MemLp (Gr a) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 2))))
    (hv0 : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 2), (vn m x - v x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hv1 : ∀ a, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 2),
      (partialDeriv a (vn m) x - Gr a x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c (r / 2) →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 2),
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * Gr b x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * v x + F x) * ζ x) = 0) :
    ∃ v' : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v' (Metric.ball c (r / 4)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4))), v x = v' x) ∧
      (∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4))),
        Gr a x = partialDeriv a v' x) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c (r / 4),
        ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, A y a b * partialDeriv b v' y) x
          = P x * v' x + F x

subgoal_signatures.name: cwl_l2_limits
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (vn : ℕ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hvc : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (vn n) (Metric.closedBall c ρ))
    (hdc : ∀ n (i : Fin 3), ContinuousOn (partialDeriv i (vn n)) (Metric.closedBall c ρ))
    (hC : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m, N ≤ m → ∀ n, N ≤ n →
      ∫ y in Metric.closedBall c ρ, ((vn n y - vn m y) ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (vn n) y - partialDeriv i (vn m) y) ^ 2) < ε) :
    (∀ n, MemLp (vn n) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ))) ∧
    (∀ n (i : Fin 3), MemLp (partialDeriv i (vn n)) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ))) ∧
    ∃ (v : E3 → ℝ) (Gr : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ),
      MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) ∧
      (∀ i, MemLp (Gr i) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ))) ∧
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (vn n x - v x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ i, Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ,
        (partialDeriv i (vn n) x - Gr i x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: cwl_weak_limit_identity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (P F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c ρ))
    (hP : ContinuousOn P (Metric.ball c ρ)) (hF : ContinuousOn F (Metric.ball c ρ))
    (vn : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (v : E3 → ℝ) (Gr : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hvnL : ∀ n, MemLp (vn n) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)))
    (hdvnL : ∀ n (a : Fin 3), MemLp (partialDeriv a (vn n)) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)))
    (hvL : MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)))
    (hGL : ∀ a, MemLp (Gr a) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)))
    (hv0 : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (vn n x - v x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hv1 : ∀ a, Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ,
      (partialDeriv a (vn n) x - Gr a x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hlim : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * partialDeriv b (vn n) x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * vn n x + F x) * ζ x)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ,

proof.tactics:
by
  intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ hψ
  
  have rinv : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (p : M),
      p ∈ ψ.target → ψ (ψ.symm p) = p := fun ψ p hp => ψ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hp
  have linv : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (x : E3),
      x ∈ ψ.source → ψ.symm (ψ x) = x := fun ψ x hx => ψ.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hx
  have msrc : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (x : E3),
      x ∈ ψ.source → ψ x ∈ ψ.target := fun ψ x hx => ψ.toPartialEquiv.map_source hx
  have mtgt : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (p : M),
      p ∈ ψ.target → ψ.symm p ∈ ψ.source := fun ψ p hp => ψ.toPartialEquiv.map_target hp
  
  have s1 : ∀ (μ : Measure E3) (f : ℕ → E3 → ℝ), (∀ n, MemLp (f n) 2 μ) →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, (f n x) ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      TendstoInMeasure μ f atTop (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
    intro μ f hf ht
    refine tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_eLpNorm (p := 2) (by norm_num)
      (fun n => (hf n).aestronglyMeasurable) aestronglyMeasurable_const ?_
    have heq : ∀ n, eLpNorm (f n - fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) 2 μ =
        ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ x, (f n x) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (2⁻¹ : ℝ)) := by
      intro n
      have h1 : (f n - fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) = f n := by funext x; simp
      rw [h1, MemLp.eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (hf n)]
      simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    simp_rw [heq]
    have h2 : Tendsto (fun n => (∫ x, (f n x) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ (2⁻¹ : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have := ((Real.continuousAt_rpow_const 0 2⁻¹ (Or.inr (by norm_num))).tendsto).comp ht
      rwa [Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num)] at this
    have := (ENNReal.continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp h2
    rwa [ENNReal.ofReal_zero] at this
  
  obtain ⟨ns, hns, hfa⟩ := (s1 _ _ hm₁ ht₁).exists_seq_tendsto_ae
  obtain ⟨ms, hms, hga⟩ := ((s1 _ _ hm₂ ht₂).comp hns.tendsto_atTop).exists_seq_tendsto_ae
  have hA₁ : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict U₁),
      Tendsto (fun k => u (ns (ms k)) (ψ₁ x) - w₁ x) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    hfa.mono fun x hx => hx.comp hms.tendsto_atTop
  have hA₂ : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict U₂),
      Tendsto (fun k => u (ns (ms k)) (ψ₂ x) - w₂ x) atTop (𝓝 0) := hga
  rw [ae_restrict_iff' hU₁.measurableSet, ae_iff] at hA₁
  rw [ae_restrict_iff' hU₂.measurableSet, ae_iff] at hA₂
  
  have s3 : ∀ E : Set E3, volume E = 0 →
      volume {x : E3 | x ∈ ψ₁.source ∧ ψ₁ x ∈ ψ₂.target ∧ ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x) ∈ E} = 0 := by
    intro E hE
    have hσ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun y => ψ₁.symm (ψ₂ y))
        (ψ₂.source ∩ ψ₂ ⁻¹' ψ₁.target) :=
      ψ₁.symm.contMDiffOn.comp (ψ₂.contMDiffOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun y hy => hy.2)
    have hσd : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun y => ψ₁.symm (ψ₂ y))
        (E ∩ (ψ₂.source ∩ ψ₂ ⁻¹' ψ₁.target)) :=
      ((contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hσ).differentiableOn (by decide)).mono
        Set.inter_subset_right
    have h0 := addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn_of_addHaar_eq_zero volume hσd
      (measure_mono_null Set.inter_subset_left hE)
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ h0
    rintro x ⟨hx1, hx2, hx3⟩
    refine ⟨ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x), ⟨hx3, mtgt ψ₂ _ hx2, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show ψ₂ (ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x)) ∈ ψ₁.target
      rw [rinv ψ₂ _ hx2]
      exact msrc ψ₁ x hx1
    · show ψ₁.symm (ψ₂ (ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x))) = x
      rw [rinv ψ₂ _ hx2]
      exact linv ψ₁ x hx1
  
  have hc₁ : ContinuousOn ψ₁ ψ₁.source := ψ₁.contMDiffOn.continuousOn
  have hc₂ : ContinuousOn ψ₂.symm ψ₂.target := ψ₂.symm.contMDiffOn.continuousOn
  have hA : IsOpen (ψ₁.source ∩ ψ₁ ⁻¹' ψ₂.target) :=
    hc₁.isOpen_inter_preimage ψ₁.open_source ψ₂.open_target
  have hτ : ContinuousOn (fun x => ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x)) (ψ₁.source ∩ ψ₁ ⁻¹' ψ₂.target) :=
    hc₂.comp (hc₁.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun x hx => hx.2)
  have hW : IsOpen ((U₁ ∩ (ψ₁.source ∩ ψ₁ ⁻¹' ψ₂.target)) ∩
      (fun x => ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x)) ⁻¹' U₂) :=
    (hτ.mono Set.inter_subset_right).isOpen_inter_preimage (hU₁.inter hA) hU₂
  have hwτ : ContinuousOn (fun x => w₂ (ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x)))
      ((U₁ ∩ (ψ₁.source ∩ ψ₁ ⁻¹' ψ₂.target)) ∩ (fun x => ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x)) ⁻¹' U₂) :=
    hw₂.comp (hτ.mono fun x hx => hx.1.2) (fun x hx => hx.2)
  have hτy₁ : ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ y₁) = y₂ := by
    rw [hψ]; exact linv ψ₂ y₂ (hU₂s hy₂)
  have hy₁W : y₁ ∈ (U₁ ∩ (ψ₁.source ∩ ψ₁ ⁻¹' ψ₂.target)) ∩
      (fun x => ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x)) ⁻¹' U₂ := by
    refine ⟨⟨hy₁, hU₁s hy₁, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show ψ₁ y₁ ∈ ψ₂.target
      rw [hψ]; exact msrc ψ₂ y₂ (hU₂s hy₂)
    · show ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ y₁) ∈ U₂
      rw [hτy₁]; exact hy₂
  
  have s5 : w₁ =ᵐ[volume.restrict ((U₁ ∩ (ψ₁.source ∩ ψ₁ ⁻¹' ψ₂.target)) ∩
      (fun x => ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x)) ⁻¹' U₂)] (fun x => w₂ (ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x))) := by
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, ae_restrict_iff' hW.measurableSet, ae_iff]
    refine measure_mono_null ?_ (measure_union_null hA₁ (s3 _ hA₂))
    intro x hx
    by_contra hcon
    apply hx
    intro hxW
    rw [Set.mem_union, not_or] at hcon
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hcon
    have T1 : Tendsto (fun k => u (ns (ms k)) (ψ₁ x) - w₁ x) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      by_contra hc
      exact h1 (fun h => hc (h hxW.1.1))
    have T2 : Tendsto (fun k => u (ns (ms k)) (ψ₂ (ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x))) - w₂ (ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x)))
        atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      by_contra hc
      exact h2 ⟨hxW.1.2.1, hxW.1.2.2, fun h => hc (h hxW.2)⟩
    rw [rinv ψ₂ _ hxW.1.2.2] at T2
    have L1 := T1.add_const (w₁ x)
    have L2 := T2.add_const (w₂ (ψ₂.symm (ψ₁ x)))
    simp only [sub_add_cancel, zero_add] at L1 L2
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique L1 L2
  
  have hfin := Measure.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq s5 hW (hw₁.mono fun x hx => hx.1.1) hwτ hy₁W
  exact hfin.trans (congrArg w₂ hτy₁)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  choose! ρ hρpos hρsub hρlim using hloc
  obtain ⟨t, htL, hcov⟩ := hL.elim_nhds_subcover (fun y => Metric.ball y (ρ y))
    (fun y hy => Metric.ball_mem_nhds y (hρpos y (hLS hy)))
  have hLmeas : MeasurableSet L := hL.measurableSet
  have hint : ∀ n, ∀ y ∈ t,
      MeasureTheory.Integrable ((Metric.ball y (ρ y)).indicator (F n)) := by
    intro n y hy
    have h1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (F n) (Metric.closedBall y (ρ y)) :=
      ((hFc n).mono (hρsub y (hLS (htL y hy)))).integrableOn_compact
        (isCompact_closedBall y (ρ y))
    exact (MeasureTheory.integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_ball).2
      (h1.mono_set Metric.ball_subset_closedBall)
  have hbound : ∀ n, ∫ x in L, F n x ≤ ∑ y ∈ t, ∫ x in Metric.ball y (ρ y), F n x := by
    intro n
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_indicator hLmeas]
    have hsum : ∑ y ∈ t, ∫ x in Metric.ball y (ρ y), F n x
        = ∫ x, ∑ y ∈ t, (Metric.ball y (ρ y)).indicator (F n) x := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum t (fun y hy => hint n y hy)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun y _ => ?_
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_indicator measurableSet_ball]
    rw [hsum]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono_of_nonneg
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun x _ => hF0 n x) x)
      (MeasureTheory.integrable_finset_sum t fun y hy => hint n y hy)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    show L.indicator (F n) x ≤ ∑ y ∈ t, (Metric.ball y (ρ y)).indicator (F n) x
    have hnn : ∀ y ∈ t, 0 ≤ (Metric.ball y (ρ y)).indicator (F n) x :=
      fun y _ => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun x _ => hF0 n x) x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ L
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcov hx)
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      calc F n x = (Metric.ball y (ρ y)).indicator (F n) x :=
            (Set.indicator_of_mem hxy _).symm
        _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ t, (Metric.ball y (ρ y)).indicator (F n) x :=
          Finset.single_le_sum hnn hy
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg hnn
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => ∑ y ∈ t, ∫ x in Metric.ball y (ρ y), F n x) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have := tendsto_finset_sum t fun y hy => hρlim y (hLS (htL y hy))
    simpa using this
  exact squeeze_zero (fun n => MeasureTheory.setIntegral_nonneg hLmeas fun x _ => hF0 n x)
    hbound hlim

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hR0 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ R₀ := hXY.1
  have hR01 : R₀ ≤ R₁ := hXY.2.1
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by linarith
  have hRL : R₁ ^ 2 < L ^ 2 - 2 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨P, hPs, hPΨ⟩ := sternPsi_partialDiffeomorph Φ X Y q R₀ R₁ C hXY
  have hnE3 : ∀ y : E3, ‖y‖ ^ 2 = y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro y
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hmemD : ∀ y : E3, L ^ 2 - 2 ≤ y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 → y ∈ P.source := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hPs]
    show R₁ < ‖y‖
    have h := hnE3 y
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    have := mul_self_le_mul_self (norm_nonneg y) hc
    nlinarith
  have hD : ∀ y ∈ P.source, R₁ < ‖y‖ := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hPs] at hy
    exact hy
  have hΨP : ∀ y ∈ P.source, P y = sternPsi Φ Y y ∧ u (P y) = y 0 ∧ 0 < β (P y) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hPΨ y hy]

      · intro _
        rw [hΨfs]
        have hZ : Pf 0 x ∈ Z := by rw [hPf0x]; exact hA11 x hx' (by linarith)
        exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => (hUZ _ (hOU i (hψsupp i h))).1 hZ)
  · 
    intro p hp hbp
    rcases hS1' p hp with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hpO, hpt⟩
    · right
      refine ⟨x, hx, rfl, ?_⟩
      have hx' := hW0 x hx
      rw [hPf0x] at hbp
      exact hA19 x hx' hbp
    · left
      exact hA18 p hpt (hUZ p (hOU i hpO)).1 hbp
  · 
    intro p hp hβp
    refine ⟨(hA20 p hβp).1, hR3 0 p ?_⟩
    rw [hΨf0]
    exact (hA20 p hβp).2

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (hharm : ∀ x ∈ W, lap2 h w x = 0) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) :
    lap2 h (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y + ε)) x =
      gaussCurv2 h x * sgbGradSq2 h w x / (sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε) +
      ε * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * (h x)⁻¹ b d *
           (pd2 a (pd2 b w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k a b x * pd2 k w x) *
           (pd2 c (pd2 d w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k c d x * pd2 k w x)) /
        (sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε) ^ 2

signature.name: pcgb_kato_identity
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (hharm : ∀ x ∈ W, lap2 h w x = 0) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) :
    lap2 h (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y + ε)) x =
      gaussCurv2 h x * sgbGradSq2 h w x / (sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε) +
      ε * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * (h x)⁻¹ b d *
           (pd2 a (pd2 b w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k a b x * pd2 k w x) *

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsymm : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h z i j = h z j i := by
    intro z hz i j
    have h1 := (hpos z hz).isHermitian.apply i j
    rw [star_trivial] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have G := gs2_metric_calculus h W hW hh hsymm hpos
  have hω : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 a w) W := by
    intro a
    have h1 := hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := ∞) (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hGs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sgbGradSq2 h w) W := by
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a w y * pd2 c w y) W
    refine ContDiffOn.sum (fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun c _ => ?_))
    exact ((G.1 a c).mul (hω a)).mul (hω c)
  have hGnn : ∀ y ∈ W, 0 ≤ sgbGradSq2 h w y := by
    intro y hy
    exact ((posDef_inv_quad_facts (h y) (hpos y hy)).1 (fun a => pd2 a w y)).1
  
  have chain : ∀ F : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W → (∀ y ∈ W, 0 < F y + ε) →
      lap2 h (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (F y + ε)) x =
        lap2 h F x / (2 * (F x + ε)) -
          (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * pd2 i F x * pd2 j F x) /
            (2 * (F x + ε) ^ 2) := by
    intro F hF hFε
    have hFd : ∀ y ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ F y := fun y hy =>
      (hF.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)
    have hstar : ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ j : Fin 2,
        pd2 j (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (F y + ε)) y =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((F y + ε)⁻¹ * pd2 j F y) := by
      intro y hy j
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => F y + ε) (fderiv ℝ F y) y :=
        (hFd y hy).hasFDerivAt.add_const ε
      have h2 := h1.log (hFε y hy).ne'
      have h3 := h2.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
      unfold pd2
      rw [h3.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hQ : F x + ε ≠ 0 := (hFε x hx).ne'
    have hDF : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 j F) x := by
      intro j
      have h1 := hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (m := ∞) (by simp)
      exact ((h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        (hW.mem_nhds hx)
    have hinv : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (F y + ε)⁻¹) ((-((F x + ε) ^ 2)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ F x) x := by
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => F y + ε) (fderiv ℝ F x) x :=
        (hFd x hx).hasFDerivAt.add_const ε
      exact (hasDerivAt_inv hQ).comp_hasFDerivAt x h1
    have hstar2 : ∀ i j : Fin 2,
        pd2 i (pd2 j (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (F y + ε))) x =
          (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((-((F x + ε) ^ 2)⁻¹) * pd2 i F x * pd2 j F x +
            (F x + ε)⁻¹ * pd2 i (pd2 j F) x) := by
      intro i j
      have hev : pd2 j (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (F y + ε)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((F y + ε)⁻¹ * pd2 j F y)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hstar y hy j)
      have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((F y + ε)⁻¹ * pd2 j F y)) _ x :=
        (hinv.mul (hDF j).hasFDerivAt).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (F y + ε))) x (e2 i) = _
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hd.fderiv]
      rw [show pd2 i (pd2 j F) x = fderiv ℝ (pd2 j F) x (e2 i) from rfl,
        show pd2 i F x = fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i) from rfl]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hstar1 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (F y + ε)) x =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((F x + ε)⁻¹ * pd2 k F x) := fun k => hstar x hx k
    unfold lap2
    simp only [hstar2, hstar1, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hlapw : ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (lap2 h w) x = 0 := by
    intro b
    have hev : lap2 h w =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hharm y hy)
    show fderiv ℝ (lap2 h w) x (e2 b) = 0
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have hA : (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 = (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 := G.2.1 x hx 1 0
  have hH : (fun i j => pd2 i (pd2 j w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k w x) 1 0 =
      (fun i j => pd2 i (pd2 j w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k w x) 0 1 := by
    show pd2 1 (pd2 0 w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k 1 0 x * pd2 k w x =
      pd2 0 (pd2 1 w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k 0 1 x * pd2 k w x
    rw [elr_cacc_pd2_comm W hW w hw x hx 1 0]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by rw [G.2.2.2.1 x hx k 1 0])
  have htr : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j *
      (fun i j => pd2 i (pd2 j w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k w x) i j = 0 :=
    hharm x hx
  
  have alg : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℝ),
      A 1 0 = A 0 1 → H 1 0 = H 0 1 → ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A i j * H i j = 0 →
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A i j * (2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a b * H i a * v b) *
          (2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A a b * H j a * v b) =
        2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, A a c * A b d * H a b * H c d) *
          (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * v a * v c) := by
    intro A H v hA' hH' htr'
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at htr' ⊢
    rw [hA', hH'] at htr' ⊢
    linear_combination
      (4 * (H 0 0 * (A 0 0 * v 0 + A 0 1 * v 1) ^ 2 +
          2 * H 0 1 * (A 0 0 * v 0 + A 0 1 * v 1) * (A 0 1 * v 0 + A 1 1 * v 1) +
          H 1 1 * (A 0 1 * v 0 + A 1 1 * v 1) ^ 2) -
        2 * (A 0 0 * H 0 0 + 2 * A 0 1 * H 0 1 + A 1 1 * H 1 1) *
          (A 0 0 * v 0 ^ 2 + 2 * A 0 1 * v 0 * v 1 + A 1 1 * v 1 ^ 2)) * htr'
  have key := alg (h x)⁻¹
    (fun i j => pd2 i (pd2 j w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k w x)
    (fun b => pd2 b w x) hA hH htr
  
  have hgrad : ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (sgbGradSq2 h w) x =
      2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b *
        (pd2 c (pd2 a w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k c a x * pd2 k w x) * pd2 b w x :=
    fun c => bl2_grad_Q W hW h hh hpos w hw x hx c
  have hgsq : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      (h x)⁻¹ i j * pd2 i (sgbGradSq2 h w) x * pd2 j (sgbGradSq2 h w) x =
      2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * (h x)⁻¹ b d *
           (pd2 a (pd2 b w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k a b x * pd2 k w x) *
           (pd2 c (pd2 d w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k c d x * pd2 k w x)) *
        sgbGradSq2 h w x := by
    simp only [hgrad]
    exact key
  
  have hB : lap2 h (sgbGradSq2 h w) x =
      2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * (h x)⁻¹ b d *
           (pd2 a (pd2 b w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k a b x * pd2 k w x) *
           (pd2 c (pd2 d w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k c d x * pd2 k w x)) +
        2 * gaussCurv2 h x * sgbGradSq2 h w x := by
    have := bochner_lap2_identity W hW h hh hpos w hw x hx
    simp only [hlapw, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero] at this
    exact this
  
  have hL := chain (sgbGradSq2 h w) hGs (fun y hy => by linarith [hGnn y hy])
  have hQ : sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε ≠ 0 := by linarith [hGnn x hx]
  rw [hL, hB, hgsq]
  have fin : ∀ HS K g : ℝ, g + ε ≠ 0 →
      (2 * HS + 2 * K * g) / (2 * (g + ε)) - 2 * HS * g / (2 * (g + ε) ^ 2) =
        K * g / (g + ε) + ε * HS / (g + ε) ^ 2 := by
    intro HS K g hg
    field_simp
    ring
  exact fin _ _ _ hQ

subgoal_signatures.name: gs2_metric_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) (hhsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j y = christoffel2 h k j i y) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j) k i j y = 0) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m))

subgoal_signatures.name: posDef_inv_quad_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b ∧
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b = 0 → ξ = 0)) ∧
    (∀ H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        A⁻¹ a c * A⁻¹ b d * H a b * H c d)

subgoal_signatures.name: bochner_lap2_identity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) :
    lap2 h (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w y * pd2 b w y) x =
      2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * (h x)⁻¹ b d *
          (pd2 a (pd2 b w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k a b x * pd2 k w x) *
          (pd2 c (pd2 d w) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k c d x * pd2 k w x)) +
        2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b (lap2 h w) x) +
        2 * gaussCurv2 h x * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w x * pd2 b w x)

subgoal_signatures.name: bl2_grad_Q
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) :
    ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ c : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w z * pd2 b w z) y =
        2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          (h y)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) c a y * pd2 b w y

subgoal_signatures.name: elr_cacc_pd2_comm
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) (i j : Fin 2) : pd2 i (pd2 j f) x = pd2 j (pd2 i f) x

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (j₀ : Fin P.n) (x₀ : E2) (p₀ : X) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hp₀ : P.param j₀ x₀ = p₀)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ r ⊆ P.W j₀)
    (hbpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r, 2 * r ≤ b (P.param j₀ x))
    (U : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hRU : {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} ⊆ U)
    (L : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hLs : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (L j) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀})))
    (hLc : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.O k ∩ (U \ {p₀})),
      L j x = L k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
    (C : ℝ) (hpole : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, x ≠ x₀ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => L j₀ y + Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y)) x‖ ≤ C ∧
      |lap2 (P.h j₀) (L j₀) x| ≤ C) :
    ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r →
      (∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
         (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x) *
         Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j)) ∧
      (∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
         (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
           ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x *
             pd2 c (L j) x) *
         Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j)) ∧
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x) +
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x *
            pd2 c (L j) x)
        = 2 * Real.pi

signature.name: pcgb_pole_divergence
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (j₀ : Fin P.n) (x₀ : E2) (p₀ : X) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hp₀ : P.param j₀ x₀ = p₀)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ r ⊆ P.W j₀)
    (hbpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r, 2 * r ≤ b (P.param j₀ x))
    (U : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hRU : {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} ⊆ U)
    (L : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hLs : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (L j) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀})))
    (hLc : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.O k ∩ (U \ {p₀})),
      L j x = L k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
    (C : ℝ) (hpole : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, x ≠ x₀ →
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => L j₀ y + Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y)) x‖ ≤ C ∧
      |lap2 (P.h j₀) (L j₀) x| ≤ C) :
    ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r →
      (∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
         (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x) *
         Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j)) ∧
      (∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
         (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
           ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x *
             pd2 c (L j) x) *
         Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j)) ∧
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x) +
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x *
            pd2 c (L j) x)
        = 2 * Real.pi

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro s hs hsr
  obtain ⟨hI1, hI2⟩ := pcgb_pd_integrable S P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hK hρK hρO b hb hρ1 j₀ x₀ p₀ r hr hp₀
    hball hbpos U hU hRU L hLs hLc C hpole
    (fun A B hA hB τ hτ hτAB h h' hh hh' hpd' hpd hcomp g hg f hf x hx =>
      lap2_chart_invariant A B hA hB τ hτ hτAB h h' hh hh' hpd' hpd hcomp g hg f hf x hx)
    s hs hsr
  refine ⟨hI1, hI2, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hcut⟩ := pcgb_pd_cutoff_identity S P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hK hρK hρO b hb hρ1 j₀ x₀
    p₀ r hr hp₀ hball hbpos U hU hRU L hLs hLc
    (fun Aset hAo hAW hρ1' Wv hWc hWz hWt =>
      pcgb_local_div_sum_zero S P ρ Kc hρs hK hρK hρO Aset hAo hAW hρ1' Wv hWc hWz hWt)
  obtain ⟨cut, hcutdef⟩ : ∃ cut : ℝ → X → ℝ, cut = fun δ q =>
      1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q' => 1 - Real.smoothTransition
        ((pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ (P.proj j₀ q') - δ) / δ)) q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨I2, hI2def⟩ : ∃ I2 : ℝ, I2 =
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x *
          pd2 c (L j) x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hcut01 : ∀ (δ : ℝ) (q : X), 0 ≤ cut δ q ∧ cut δ q ≤ 1 := by
    intro δ q
    rw [hcutdef]
    beta_reduce
    by_cases hq : q ∈ P.O j₀
    · rw [Set.indicator_apply, if_pos hq]
      beta_reduce
      have h1 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg ((pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ (P.proj j₀ q) - δ) / δ)
      have h2 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one ((pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ (P.proj j₀ q) - δ) / δ)
      constructor <;> linarith
    · rw [Set.indicator_apply, if_neg hq]
      constructor <;> norm_num
  
  have hcut1 : ∀ q ∈ S, q ≠ p₀ → ∀ᶠ δ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), cut δ q = 1 := by
    intro q hqS hq
    by_cases hqO : q ∈ P.O j₀
    · have hmem : q ∈ P.param j₀ '' P.W j₀ := by
        rw [P.image_eq j₀]
        exact ⟨hqO, hqS⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hzW, rfl⟩ := hmem
      have hzx : z ≠ x₀ := by
        intro h
        apply hq
        rw [h, hp₀]
      have hA0 : (P.h j₀ x₀).PosDef :=
        P.h_posDef j₀ x₀ (hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le))
      have hw0 : (fun a : Fin 2 => (z - x₀) a) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        apply hzx
        have h' : z - x₀ = 0 := by
          ext i
          have := congrFun h i
          simpa using this
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp h'
      have hQ : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, P.h j₀ x₀ a c * (z - x₀) a * (z - x₀) c := by
        have h1 := hA0.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hw0
        have h2 : star (fun a : Fin 2 => (z - x₀) a) ⬝ᵥ
            (P.h j₀ x₀).mulVec (fun a : Fin 2 => (z - x₀) a) =
            ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, P.h j₀ x₀ a c * (z - x₀) a * (z - x₀) c := by
          simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, star_trivial, Pi.star_apply]
          ring
        rw [← h2]
        exact h1
      have hr0 : 0 < pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ z := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (half_pos hr0)] with δ hδ
      rw [hcutdef]
      beta_reduce
      rw [Set.indicator_apply, if_pos hqO]
      beta_reduce
      rw [P.proj_param j₀ z hzW]
      have hge : 1 ≤ (pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ z - δ) / δ := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ.1]
        linarith [hδ.2]
      rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le hge]
      ring
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun δ => ?_)
      rw [hcutdef]
      beta_reduce
      rw [Set.indicator_apply, if_neg hqO]
      ring
  
  have hae : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure E2), x ∈ P.W j → P.param j x ≠ p₀ := by
    intro j
    have hZ : (volume : Measure E2) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {p₀}) = 0 := by
      apply Set.Subsingleton.measure_zero
      intro x hx y hy
      have h1 : P.param j x = p₀ := hx.2
      have h2 : P.param j y = p₀ := hy.2
      calc x = P.proj j (P.param j x) := (P.proj_param j x hx.1).symm
        _ = P.proj j (P.param j y) := by rw [h1, h2]
        _ = y := P.proj_param j y hy.1
    rw [ae_iff]
    refine measure_mono_null (fun x hx => ?_) hZ
    have hx' : ¬ (x ∈ P.W j → P.param j x ≠ p₀) := hx
    push_neg at hx'
    exact ⟨hx'.1, hx'.2⟩
  have key : ∀ a c e d : ℝ, 0 ≤ c → c ≤ 1 → |a * (c * e) * d| ≤ |a * e * d| := by
    intro a c e d hc hc1
    rw [show a * (c * e) * d = c * (a * e * d) by ring, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) hc1
  
  have hA : ∀ j, Tendsto (fun δ => ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) *
      (cut δ (P.param j x) * (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
        lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
      (𝓝 (∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) *
        (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x) *
        Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)) := by
    intro j
    refine MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
      (fun x => ‖ρ j (P.param j x) *
        (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x) *
        Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det‖) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hδ₀] with δ hδ
      have h := MeasureTheory.Integrable.aestronglyMeasurable
        ((hcut δ hδ.1 hδ.2 s hs hsr).1 j)
      rw [hcutdef]
      exact h
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun δ => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_))
      obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hcut01 δ (P.param j x)
      simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact key _ _ _ _ h0 h1
    · exact MeasureTheory.Integrable.norm (hI1 j)
    · rw [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' (P.W_open j).measurableSet]
      filter_upwards [hae j] with x hx hxW
      have hq := hx hxW
      have hqS : P.param j x ∈ S := by
        have h := Set.mem_image_of_mem (P.param j) hxW
        rw [P.image_eq j] at h
        exact h.2
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [hcut1 _ hqS hq] with δ hδ
      rw [hδ, one_mul]
  have hAsum : Tendsto (fun δ => eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => cut δ (P.param j x) *
      (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x))) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
      (𝓝 (eigWInt P ρ (fun j x =>
        Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x))) := by
    unfold eigWInt
    exact tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hA j)
  
  have hLball : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (L j₀) (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}) := by
    refine (hLs j₀).mono (fun x hx => ?_)
    have hxW : x ∈ P.W j₀ := hball (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx.1)
    have hxne : x ≠ x₀ := hx.2
    have hS : P.param j₀ x ∈ S := by
      have h := Set.mem_image_of_mem (P.param j₀) hxW
      rw [P.image_eq j₀] at h
      exact h.2
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ b (P.param j₀ x) := by
      have := hbpos x (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx.1)
      linarith
    refine ⟨hxW, hRU ⟨hS, hb0⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hpx
    have hpx' : P.param j₀ x = p₀ := hpx
    apply hxne
    calc x = P.proj j₀ (P.param j₀ x) := (P.proj_param j₀ x hxW).symm
      _ = P.proj j₀ (P.param j₀ x₀) := by rw [hpx', hp₀]
      _ = x₀ := P.proj_param j₀ x₀ (hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le))
  have hF := pcgb_pole_flux_limit (P.W j₀) (P.W_open j₀) (P.h j₀) (P.h_smooth j₀)
    (P.h_posDef j₀) x₀ r hr hball (L j₀) hLball C (fun x hx hne => (hpole x hx hne).1)
  have hlim := (hAsum.add (tendsto_const_nhds (x := I2))).add hF
  have hzero : Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) := tendsto_const_nhds
  have huniq := tendsto_nhds_unique hlim (hzero.congr' (by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hδ₀] with δ hδ
    have h := (hcut δ hδ.1 hδ.2 s hs hsr).2
    rw [hcutdef, hI2def]
    exact h.symm))
  rw [hI2def] at huniq
  linarith

(A B : Set E2) (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (τ : E2 → E2)
    (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ A) (hτAB : ∀ x ∈ A, τ x ∈ B)

    (hpd' : ∀ y ∈ B, (h' y).PosDef) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ A, (h x).PosDef)
    (hcomp : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ c d : Fin 2, h x c d = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' * h' (τ x) c' d' * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 d) d')

by
  classical
  have hUo : IsOpen (Gd.U \ {Gd.p₀}) := Gd.U_open.sdiff isClosed_singleton
  have hVo : ∀ j, IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (Gd.U \ {Gd.p₀})) := fun j =>
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) hUo
  
  have hnn : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ), A.PosDef → ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a c * ξ a * ξ c := by
    intro A hA ξ
    have hB : A⁻¹.PosDef := hA.inv
    have hsym : A⁻¹ 1 0 = A⁻¹ 0 1 := by
      have h := hB.isHermitian.apply 0 1
      simpa using h
    have hp : 0 < A⁻¹ 0 0 := hB.diag_pos
    have hdet : 0 < A⁻¹.det := hB.det_pos
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsym] at hdet
    have hδ : 0 ≤ A⁻¹ 0 0 * A⁻¹ 1 1 - A⁻¹ 0 1 ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have key1 : A⁻¹ 0 0 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a c * ξ a * ξ c) =
        (A⁻¹ 0 0 * ξ 0 + A⁻¹ 0 1 * ξ 1) ^ 2 +
          (A⁻¹ 0 0 * A⁻¹ 1 1 - A⁻¹ 0 1 ^ 2) * ξ 1 ^ 2 := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym]
      ring
    have h2 : 0 ≤ A⁻¹ 0 0 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a c * ξ a * ξ c) := by
      rw [key1]
      exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hδ (sq_nonneg _))
    exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h2 hp
  
  have hgen : ∀ (V : Set E2), IsOpen V → ∀ (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) V) → (∀ y ∈ V, (h y).PosDef) →

      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y + ε)) V := by

    have hinv : ∀ i l : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i l) V := by

          exact Matrix.det_fin_two _

      intro i l

        funext y
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [e]
      refine hdi.mul ?_

        first

        | exact (hh _ _).neg

      fun a => ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 hw).2.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => sgbGradSq2 h w y + ε) V := by
      unfold sgbGradSq2
      refine ContDiffOn.add ?_ contDiffOn_const
      exact ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun c _ =>
        ((hinv a c).mul (hDr a)).mul (hDr c)

  refine ⟨fun j => ?_, fun j k x hx => ?_⟩
  · exact hgen _ (hVo j) (P.h j) (fun a b => (P.h_smooth j a b).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
      (fun y hy => P.h_posDef j y hy.1) _ (Gd.smooth j)

      (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)

      intro x' hx''

      rw [← hyeq, P.proj_param k y' hy']
      exact ⟨hy', rfl⟩

      ((P.trans_smooth j k).contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hx')).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hyV : P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' (Gd.U \ {Gd.p₀}) := by
      refine ⟨(hP3 x hx').1, ?_⟩
      show P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) ∈ Gd.U \ {Gd.p₀}
      rw [(hP3 x hx').2]
      exact hxU
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Gd.w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) :=
      ((Gd.smooth k).contDiffAt ((hVo k).mem_nhds hyV)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have chain : ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b (fun x' => Gd.w (P.param j x')) x =
        ∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) c *
          pd2 c (fun y => Gd.w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) := by
      intro b
      have hev : (fun x' => Gd.w (P.param j x')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          ((fun y => Gd.w (P.param k y)) ∘ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x'))) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hD.mem_nhds hx')
          (fun x' hx'' => by simp only [Function.comp, (hP3 x' hx'').2])
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_comp x hfd hτd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      have hw' : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) =
          ∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) c • e2 c := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, Fin.sum_univ_two, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      conv_lhs => rw [hw']
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

      Matrix.of fun c a => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 a) c with hJ
    have hKJ : P.h j x = J.transpose * P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * J := by
      ext a b
      rw [P.h_compat j k x hx' a b]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    have hdetK : 0 < (P.h j x).det := (P.h_posDef j x hxW).det_pos
    have hJdet : IsUnit J.det := by
      rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
      intro h0
      have : (P.h j x).det = 0 := by
        rw [hKJ, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, h0]; simp
      linarith
    have hJTdet : IsUnit J.transpose.det := by rwa [Matrix.det_transpose]

      rw [hKJ, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, ← Matrix.mul_assoc J J⁻¹,
        Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv J hJdet, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul J.transpose hJTdet, Matrix.mul_one]
    have e : ∀ d c : Fin 2, (J * (P.h j x)⁻¹ * J.transpose) d c =
        (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ d c := fun d c => by rw [hinv]
    have e00 := e 0 0
    have e01 := e 0 1
    have e10 := e 1 0
    have e11 := e 1 1
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_two] at e00 e01 e10 e11
    have key : sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun z => Gd.w (P.param j z)) x =
        sgbGradSq2 (P.h k) (fun z => Gd.w (P.param k z)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) := by
      simp only [sgbGradSq2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      rw [chain 0, chain 1]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      linear_combination
        (pd2 0 (fun y => Gd.w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
          pd2 0 (fun y => Gd.w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e00 +
        (pd2 0 (fun y => Gd.w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
          pd2 1 (fun y => Gd.w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e01 +
        (pd2 1 (fun y => Gd.w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
          pd2 0 (fun y => Gd.w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e10 +
        (pd2 1 (fun y => Gd.w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
          pd2 1 (fun y => Gd.w (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e11
    rw [key]

            Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ y)) x‖ ≤ C ∧

            (sgbGradSq2 (P.h Gd.j₀) (fun z => Gd.w (P.param Gd.j₀ z)) y + ε)) x| ≤ C

    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (b : X → ℝ) (Gd : PcgbGreenData P b)
    (hkato : ∀ (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ∀ (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ),

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := P.h Gd.j₀ with hhdef
  set w : E2 → ℝ := fun z => Gd.w (P.param Gd.j₀ z) with hwdef
  have hWo : IsOpen (P.W Gd.j₀) := P.W_open Gd.j₀
  have hhs : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) (P.W Gd.j₀) := P.h_smooth Gd.j₀
  have hpd : ∀ x ∈ P.W Gd.j₀, (h x).PosDef := P.h_posDef Gd.j₀
  have hsym : ∀ x ∈ P.W Gd.j₀, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i := by
    intro x hx i j
    have h1 := (hpd x hx).isHermitian.apply i j
    rw [star_trivial] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  obtain ⟨hinv, -, hΓs, -, -, -⟩ := gs2_metric_calculus h (P.W Gd.j₀) hWo hhs hsym hpd
  have hKc : ContinuousOn (gaussCurv2 h) (P.W Gd.j₀) := gaussCurv2_continuousOn h _ hWo hhs hpd
  obtain ⟨κ, C₀M, hκ, hC₀M, hMB⟩ :=
    pcgb_pole_metric_bounds h (P.W Gd.j₀) hWo hinv hΓs hKc Gd.x₀ Gd.r Gd.ball_sub
  have hx₀W : Gd.x₀ ∈ P.W Gd.j₀ := Gd.ball_sub (Metric.mem_closedBall_self Gd.r_pos.le)
  have hC₀ : 0 ≤ max C₀M Gd.C := le_max_of_le_right Gd.C_nonneg
  obtain ⟨δ, K, hδ, hK, hAlg⟩ :=
    pcgb_pole_algebra (h Gd.x₀) (hpd Gd.x₀ hx₀W) κ (max C₀M Gd.C) hκ hC₀
  obtain ⟨hqpos, hℓs, hℓd⟩ := pcgb_log_r0_derivs (h Gd.x₀) (hpd Gd.x₀ hx₀W) Gd.x₀
  set ℓ : E2 → ℝ := fun y => Real.log (Real.sqrt
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h Gd.x₀ a c * (y - Gd.x₀) a * (y - Gd.x₀) c)) with hℓdef
  have hu_eq : ∀ y : E2, y ≠ Gd.x₀ → ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c ℓ y =
      (∑ b : Fin 2, h Gd.x₀ c b * (y - Gd.x₀) b) /
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h Gd.x₀ a c * (y - Gd.x₀) a * (y - Gd.x₀) c) :=
    fun y hy c => (hℓd y hy c c).1
  
  have hsc1 : ∀ (ε G N u : ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < G → |N + u * G| ≤ K * G → |u| ≤ K * G →
      |N / (G + ε) + u| ≤ K * (1 + ε) := by
    intro ε G N u hε hG h1 h2
    have hQ : 0 < G + ε := by linarith
    have heq : N / (G + ε) + u = (N + u * G + ε * u) / (G + ε) := by
      rw [div_add' _ _ _ hQ.ne']
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [heq, abs_div, abs_of_pos hQ, div_le_iff₀ hQ]
