      calc |N + u * G + ε * u| ≤ |N + u * G| + |ε * u| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |N + u * G| + ε * |u| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hε]
    have hKG : 0 ≤ K * G := mul_nonneg hK hG.le
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 + ε)) hε.le,
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hε.le]
  have hsc2 : ∀ (ε G Kg HS : ℝ), 0 < ε → 0 < G → |Kg| ≤ max C₀M Gd.C → |HS| ≤ K * G ^ 2 →
      |Kg * G / (G + ε) + ε * HS / (G + ε) ^ 2| ≤ max C₀M Gd.C + ε * K := by
    intro ε G Kg HS hε hG h1 h2
    have hQ : 0 < G + ε := by linarith
    have hr : G / (G + ε) ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hQ).mpr (by linarith)
    have hr0 : 0 ≤ G / (G + ε) := div_nonneg hG.le hQ.le
    have t1 : |Kg * G / (G + ε)| ≤ max C₀M Gd.C := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hr0]
      calc |Kg| * (G / (G + ε)) ≤ max C₀M Gd.C * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul h1 hr hr0 (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) h1)
        _ = max C₀M Gd.C := mul_one _
    have hQ2 : 0 < (G + ε) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have t2 : |ε * HS / (G + ε) ^ 2| ≤ ε * K := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hε, abs_of_pos hQ2, div_le_iff₀ hQ2]
      have hG2 : G ^ 2 ≤ (G + ε) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      calc ε * |HS| ≤ ε * (K * G ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hε.le
        _ = (ε * K) * G ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ (ε * K) * (G + ε) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hG2 (mul_nonneg hε.le hK)
    calc |Kg * G / (G + ε) + ε * HS / (G + ε) ^ 2|
        ≤ |Kg * G / (G + ε)| + |ε * HS / (G + ε) ^ 2| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ max C₀M Gd.C + ε * K := add_le_add t1 t2
  
  have hnorm2 : ∀ D : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ‖D‖ ≤ |D (e2 0)| + |D (e2 1)| := by
    intro D
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ (by positivity) (fun v => ?_)
    have hv : v = v 0 • e2 0 + v 1 • e2 1 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have h0 : |v 0| ≤ ‖v‖ := by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le v 0
    have h1 : |v 1| ≤ ‖v‖ := by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using PiLp.norm_apply_le v 1
    have hDv : D v = v 0 * D (e2 0) + v 1 * D (e2 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      simp [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hDv]
    calc |v 0 * D (e2 0) + v 1 * D (e2 1)| ≤ |v 0| * |D (e2 0)| + |v 1| * |D (e2 1)| := by
          rw [← abs_mul, ← abs_mul]; exact abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖v‖ * |D (e2 0)| + ‖v‖ * |D (e2 1)| := by gcongr
      _ = (|D (e2 0)| + |D (e2 1)|) * ‖v‖ := by ring
  refine ⟨min Gd.r δ, lt_min Gd.r_pos hδ, min_le_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  refine ⟨max (2 * (K * (1 + ε))) (max C₀M Gd.C + ε * K), ?_⟩
  intro x hx hxne
  
  set O : Set E2 := Metric.ball Gd.x₀ Gd.r ∩ {Gd.x₀}ᶜ with hOdef
  have hOo : IsOpen O := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hOW : O ⊆ P.W Gd.j₀ := fun y hy => Gd.ball_sub (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy.1)
  have hOgood : ∀ y ∈ O, y ∈ P.W Gd.j₀ ∩ P.param Gd.j₀ ⁻¹' (Gd.U \ {Gd.p₀}) ∧
      0 ≤ b (P.param Gd.j₀ y) ∧ P.param Gd.j₀ y ≠ Gd.p₀ := by
    intro y hy
    have hyW : y ∈ P.W Gd.j₀ := hOW hy
    have hyS : P.param Gd.j₀ y ∈ S := by
      have h1 : P.param Gd.j₀ y ∈ P.param Gd.j₀ '' P.W Gd.j₀ := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hyW
      rw [P.image_eq Gd.j₀] at h1
      exact h1.2
    have hb : 0 ≤ b (P.param Gd.j₀ y) := by
      have h1 := Gd.ball_pos y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy.1)
      have h2 := Gd.r_pos
      linarith
    have hne : P.param Gd.j₀ y ≠ Gd.p₀ := by
      intro heq
      have h1 := P.proj_param Gd.j₀ y hyW
      rw [heq, ← Gd.param_x₀, P.proj_param Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ hx₀W] at h1
      exact hy.2 (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr h1.symm)
    exact ⟨⟨hyW, Gd.R_sub ⟨hyS, hb⟩, hne⟩, hb, hne⟩
  have hws : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w O := (Gd.smooth Gd.j₀).mono (fun y hy => (hOgood y hy).1)
  have hwharm : ∀ y ∈ O, lap2 h w y = 0 :=
    fun y hy => Gd.harm Gd.j₀ y (hOW hy) (hOgood y hy).2.1 (hOgood y hy).2.2
  have hxball : x ∈ Metric.ball Gd.x₀ Gd.r := Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hx
  have hxO : x ∈ O := ⟨hxball, hxne⟩
  have hxcl : x ∈ Metric.closedBall Gd.x₀ Gd.r := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hxball
  
  have hne : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hℓO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ℓ O := hℓs.mono (fun y hy => hy.2)
  set v : E2 → ℝ := fun y => w y - ℓ y with hvdef
  have hvO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v O := hws.sub hℓO
  have hdiff : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ∀ y ∈ O, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y :=
    fun f hf y hy => (hf.contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt hne
  have hpdO : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f O → ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 a f) O :=
    fun f hf a => (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hOo le_rfl).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hsplit1 : ∀ y ∈ O, ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a w y = pd2 a ℓ y + pd2 a v y := by
    intro y hy a
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ v y = fderiv ℝ w y - fderiv ℝ ℓ y :=
      fderiv_sub (hdiff w hws y hy) (hdiff ℓ hℓO y hy)
    show fderiv ℝ w y (e2 a) = fderiv ℝ ℓ y (e2 a) + fderiv ℝ v y (e2 a)
    rw [h1, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
    ring
  have hsplit2 : ∀ a c : Fin 2, pd2 c (pd2 a w) x = pd2 c (pd2 a ℓ) x + pd2 c (pd2 a v) x := by
    intro a c
    have hev : pd2 a w =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => pd2 a ℓ y + pd2 a v y :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hOo.mem_nhds hxO) (fun y hy => hsplit1 y hy a)
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ (pd2 a w) x = fderiv ℝ (pd2 a ℓ) x + fderiv ℝ (pd2 a v) x := by
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_add (hdiff _ (hpdO ℓ hℓO a) x hxO) (hdiff _ (hpdO v hvO a) x hxO)
    show fderiv ℝ (pd2 a w) x (e2 c) = fderiv ℝ (pd2 a ℓ) x (e2 c) + fderiv ℝ (pd2 a v) x (e2 c)
    rw [h1, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
  have he2 : ∀ a : Fin 2, ‖e2 a‖ = 1 := fun a => by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  have hv1b : ∀ a : Fin 2, |pd2 a v x| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖ := by
    intro a
    have h1 := (fderiv ℝ v x).le_opNorm (e2 a)
    rw [he2, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1
  have hv2b : ∀ a c : Fin 2, |pd2 c (pd2 a v) x| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) x‖ := by
    intro a c
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) x :=
      ((hvO.fderiv_of_isOpen hOo le_rfl).contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds hxO)).differentiableAt hne
    have heq : pd2 c (pd2 a v) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) x (e2 c) (e2 a) := by
      have hF := hD.hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e2 a) x)
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 a)) x (e2 c) = _
      rw [hF.fderiv]
      simp
    rw [heq]
    have h1 := (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) x).le_opNorm₂ (e2 c) (e2 a)
    rw [he2, he2, mul_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact h1
  
  obtain ⟨-, hp1, hp2⟩ := Gd.pole x hxball hxne
  have hp1' : ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖ ≤ Gd.C := hp1
  have hp2' : ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) x‖ ≤ Gd.C / Real.sqrt
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h Gd.x₀ a c * (x - Gd.x₀) a * (x - Gd.x₀) c) := hp2
  
  have hs0 : 0 < ‖x - Gd.x₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxne)
  have hsδ : ‖x - Gd.x₀‖ ≤ δ := by
    have h1 : dist x Gd.x₀ < min Gd.r δ := hx
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at h1
    exact le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le h1 (min_le_right _ _))
  have hz : (x - Gd.x₀) 0 ^ 2 + (x - Gd.x₀) 1 ^ 2 = ‖x - Gd.x₀‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hpb : ∀ a : Fin 2, |pd2 a w x - pd2 a ℓ x| ≤ max C₀M Gd.C := by
    intro a
    rw [hsplit1 x hxO a, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact le_trans (hv1b a) (le_trans hp1' (le_max_right _ _))
  have hHb : ∀ c a : Fin 2,
      |(pd2 c (pd2 a w) x - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m c a x * pd2 m w x) +
          ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m c a x * pd2 m w x -
        (h Gd.x₀ c a / (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h Gd.x₀ i j * (x - Gd.x₀) i * (x - Gd.x₀) j) -
          2 * pd2 c ℓ x * pd2 a ℓ x)| ≤
      max C₀M Gd.C /
        Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h Gd.x₀ i j * (x - Gd.x₀) i * (x - Gd.x₀) j) := by
    intro c a
    have e1 : (pd2 c (pd2 a w) x - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m c a x * pd2 m w x) +
          ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m c a x * pd2 m w x -
        (h Gd.x₀ c a / (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, h Gd.x₀ i j * (x - Gd.x₀) i * (x - Gd.x₀) j) -
          2 * pd2 c ℓ x * pd2 a ℓ x) = pd2 c (pd2 a v) x := by
      rw [hsplit2 a c, (hℓd x hxne a c).2, hu_eq x hxne c, hu_eq x hxne a]
      ring
    rw [e1]
    refine le_trans (hv2b a c) (le_trans hp2' ?_)
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨hGpos, hNb, hHSb, hub⟩ := hAlg (fun i => (x - Gd.x₀) i) ‖x - Gd.x₀‖ hs0 hsδ hz (h x)⁻¹
    (fun c => pd2 c ℓ x) (fun a => pd2 a w x)
    (fun c a => pd2 c (pd2 a w) x - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m c a x * pd2 m w x)
    (fun m c a => christoffel2 h m c a x)
    (fun a b => (hMB x hxcl).1 a b) (fun c => hu_eq x hxne c) hpb hHb
    (fun m c a => le_trans ((hMB x hxcl).2.1 m c a) (le_max_left _ _))
  have hGpos' : 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x := hGpos
  
  have hGO : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sgbGradSq2 h w) O := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a w y * pd2 c w y) O :=
      ContDiffOn.sum (fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun c _ =>
        (((hinv a c).mono hOW).mul (hpdO w hws a)).mul (hpdO w hws c)))
    exact h1
  have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (sgbGradSq2 h w) x := hdiff _ hGO x hxO
  have hgrad : ∀ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (sgbGradSq2 h w) x (e2 c) =
      2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b *
        (pd2 c (pd2 a w) x - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m c a x * pd2 m w x) * pd2 b w x := by
    intro c
    exact bl2_grad_Q O hOo h (fun a b => (hhs a b).mono hOW) (fun y hy => hpd y (hOW hy)) w hws
      x hxO c
  have hGε : 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε := by linarith
  have hL : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y + ε))
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (sgbGradSq2 h w) x)) x :=
    ((hGd.hasFDerivAt.add_const ε).log hGε.ne').const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hℓx : HasFDerivAt ℓ (fderiv ℝ ℓ x) x := (hdiff ℓ hℓO x hxO).hasFDerivAt
  have hF : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y + ε) +
      Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ y))
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (sgbGradSq2 h w) x) +
        fderiv ℝ ℓ x) x :=
    hL.add hℓx
  have hcb : ∀ c : Fin 2, |((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε)⁻¹ •
      fderiv ℝ (sgbGradSq2 h w) x) + fderiv ℝ ℓ x) (e2 c)| ≤ K * (1 + ε) := by
    intro c
    have hcomp : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (sgbGradSq2 h w) x) +
        fderiv ℝ ℓ x) (e2 c) =
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b *
          (pd2 c (pd2 a w) x - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m c a x * pd2 m w x) * pd2 b w x) /
          (sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε) + pd2 c ℓ x := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hgrad c, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
      have h1 : pd2 c ℓ x = fderiv ℝ ℓ x (e2 c) := rfl
      rw [h1, div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring
    rw [hcomp]
    exact hsc1 ε (sgbGradSq2 h w x)
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b *
        (pd2 c (pd2 a w) x - ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 h m c a x * pd2 m w x) * pd2 b w x)
      (pd2 c ℓ x) hε hGpos' (hNb c) (hub c)
  have hfin1 : ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y + ε) +
      Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ y)) x‖ ≤
      max (2 * (K * (1 + ε))) (max C₀M Gd.C + ε * K) := by
    rw [hF.fderiv]
    refine le_trans (hnorm2 _) ?_
    refine le_trans ?_ (le_max_left _ _)
    have h0 := hcb 0
    have h1 := hcb 1
    linarith
  
  have hlap := hkato O hOo h (fun a b => (hhs a b).mono hOW) (fun y hy => hpd y (hOW hy)) w hws
    hwharm ε hε x hxO
  have hfin2 : |lap2 h (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y + ε)) x| ≤
      max (2 * (K * (1 + ε))) (max C₀M Gd.C + ε * K) := by
    rw [hlap]
    exact le_trans (hsc2 ε _ _ _ hε hGpos' (le_trans (hMB x hxcl).2.2 (le_max_left _ _)) hHSb)
      (le_max_right _ _)
  exact ⟨hfin1, hfin2⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: gs2_metric_calculus
subgoal_signatures.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2) (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s) (hhsymm : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h x i j = h x j i) (hhpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) : (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i j = (h y)⁻¹ j i) ∧ (∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j y = christoffel2 h k j i y) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, gsCovD2 h (fun i j y => h y i j) k i j y = 0) ∧ (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ k i j : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y = -∑ m : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h i k m y * (h y)⁻¹ m j + christoffel2 h j k m y * (h y)⁻¹ i m))

subgoal_signatures.name: bl2_grad_Q
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) :
    ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ c : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a w z * pd2 b w z) y =
        2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
          (h y)⁻¹ a b * gsCovD1 h (fun r => pd2 r w) c a y * pd2 b w y

subgoal_signatures.name: gaussCurv2_continuousOn
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (s : Set E2)
    (hs : IsOpen s) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) s)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ s, (h x).PosDef) :
    ContinuousOn (gaussCurv2 h) s

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_pole_algebra
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A₀ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : A₀.PosDef) (κ C₀ : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∃ δ K : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧
      ∀ (z : Fin 2 → ℝ) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s ≤ δ → z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 = s ^ 2 →
      ∀ (B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (u p : Fin 2 → ℝ) (H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (Γ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 2, |B a b - A₀⁻¹ a b| ≤ κ * s) →
      (∀ c : Fin 2, u c = (∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ c b * z b) /
        (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A₀ i j * z i * z j)) →
      (∀ a : Fin 2, |p a - u a| ≤ C₀) →
      (∀ c a : Fin 2, |H c a + ∑ m : Fin 2, Γ m c a * p m -
        (A₀ c a / (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A₀ i j * z i * z j) - 2 * u c * u a)| ≤
          C₀ / Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A₀ i j * z i * z j)) →
      (∀ m c a : Fin 2, |Γ m c a| ≤ C₀) →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j ∧
      (∀ c : Fin 2, |(∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B a b * H c a * p b) +
          u c * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j| ≤
        K * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j) ∧
      |∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, B a c * B b d * H a b * H c d| ≤
        K * (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j) ^ 2 ∧
      (∀ c : Fin 2, |u c| ≤ K * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_pole_metric_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hinv : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a b) W)
    (hΓ : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) W)
    (hK : ContinuousOn (gaussCurv2 h) W) (x₀ : E2) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hsub : Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ ⊆ W) :
    ∃ κ C₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ κ ∧ 0 ≤ C₀ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ,
      (∀ a b : Fin 2, |(h x)⁻¹ a b - (h x₀)⁻¹ a b| ≤ κ * ‖x - x₀‖) ∧
      (∀ m c a : Fin 2, |christoffel2 h m c a x| ≤ C₀) ∧ |gaussCurv2 h x| ≤ C₀

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_log_r0_derivs
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A₀ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : A₀.PosDef) (x₀ : E2) :
    (∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ → 0 < ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c) ∧
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => Real.log (Real.sqrt
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c))) {x₀}ᶜ ∧
    ∀ x : E2, x ≠ x₀ → ∀ a c : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (fun y : E2 => Real.log (Real.sqrt
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c))) x =
        (∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ c b * (x - x₀) b) /
          (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) c) ∧

        simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, hΨx]
        exact hWn
      have htend : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => Φ x + t • ((0 : ℝ), innerSL ℝ v v)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (Φ x)) := by
        have := hℓ.continuousAt.tendsto
        rw [zero_smul, add_zero] at this
        exact this
      have hfst : ∀ y, (Φ y).1 = b y := fun y => by rw [hΦdef]
      filter_upwards [hmemW, htend.eventually hright] with t htW htR
      refine ⟨htW, ?_⟩
      have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst htR
      rw [← hfst (Ψ (Φ x + t • ((0 : ℝ), innerSL ℝ v v))), h1]
      simp [hfst, hbx]
  refine ⟨-α / β, fun a => hDw (e2 a), ?_⟩
  intro τ hτ
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : E2, v = τ 0 • e2 0 + τ 1 • e2 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [hquad w (hdd w hwA) τ, hquad b (hdd b hbA) τ, ← hv]
  by_cases hv0 : v = 0
  · simp [hv0]
  have hDbv : fderiv ℝ b x v = 0 := by
    rw [hv]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    exact hτ
  obtain ⟨γ, hγc, hγ0, hγv, hγev⟩ := hcurve v hv0 hDbv
  have eb := hsecond b hb γ hγc hγ0 (hγev.mono fun t ht => ht)
  have ew := hsecond w hw γ hγc hγ0 (hγev.mono fun t ht => ⟨ht.1, hvan _ ht.1 ht.2⟩)
  rw [hγv.deriv] at eb ew
  linear_combination ew - (-α / β) * eb - hDw (deriv (deriv γ) 0)

(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W, (h y).PosDef) (b w : E2 → ℝ) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b W)
    (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) (hdb : fderiv ℝ b x ≠ 0)
    (hdw : fderiv ℝ w x ≠ 0) (lam : ℝ)
    (H1 : ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a w x = lam * pd2 a b x)
    (H2 : ∀ τ : Fin 2 → ℝ, τ 0 * pd2 0 b x + τ 1 * pd2 1 b x = 0 →
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, τ i * τ j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x =
          lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, τ i * τ j * pd2 i (pd2 j b) x)
    (H3 : lap2 h w x = 0) :
    ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a b x *
        pd2 c (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y)) x =
      Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x

signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W, (h y).PosDef) (b w : E2 → ℝ) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b W)
    (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) (hdb : fderiv ℝ b x ≠ 0)
    (hdw : fderiv ℝ w x ≠ 0) (lam : ℝ)
    (H1 : ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a w x = lam * pd2 a b x)
    (H2 : ∀ τ : Fin 2 → ℝ, τ 0 * pd2 0 b x + τ 1 * pd2 1 b x = 0 →
        ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, τ i * τ j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x =
          lam * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, τ i * τ j * pd2 i (pd2 j b) x)
    (H3 : lap2 h w x = 0) :
    ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a b x *
        pd2 c (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y)) x =
      Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hxU : W ∈ 𝓝 x := hW.mem_nhds hx
  have hsymm : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h z i j = h z j i := by
    intro z hz i j
    have := (hpd z hz).isHermitian.apply j i
    simpa using this
  have hdh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h z a c) x := fun a c =>
    ((hh a c).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hxU
  
  have pmul : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z * g z) x = pd2 k f x * g x + f x * pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have padd : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z + g z) x = pd2 k f x + pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hg]
    rfl
  have psub : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z - g z) x = pd2 k f x - pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub hf hg]
    rfl
  have pneg : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), pd2 k (fun z => -f z) x = -pd2 k f x := by
    intro f k
    unfold pd2
    rw [show (fun z => -f z) = -f from rfl, fderiv_neg]
    rfl
  have pinv : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x ≠ 0 →
      pd2 k (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) x = -pd2 k f x / (f x) ^ 2 := by
    intro f k hf hf0
    unfold pd2
    have H := (hasDerivAt_inv hf0).comp_hasFDerivAt x hf.hasFDerivAt
    rw [show (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) = (fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) ∘ f from rfl, H.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have psqrt : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x ≠ 0 →
      pd2 k (fun z => Real.sqrt (f z)) x = pd2 k f x / (2 * Real.sqrt (f x)) := by
    intro f k hf hf0
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_sqrt hf hf0]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have pdiv : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      g x ≠ 0 →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z / g z) x = pd2 k f x * (g x)⁻¹ + f x * (-pd2 k g x / (g x) ^ 2) := by
    intro f g k hf hg hg0
    have e : (fun z => f z / g z) = fun z => f z * (g z)⁻¹ := funext fun z => div_eq_mul_inv _ _
    rw [e, pmul _ _ k hf (hg.fun_inv hg0), pinv _ k hg hg0]
  have hfz : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, pd2 0 f x = 0 → pd2 1 f x = 0 → fderiv ℝ f x = 0 := by
    intro f h0 h1
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    have hv : v = v 0 • e2 0 + v 1 • e2 1 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [e2]
    rw [hv, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
    unfold pd2 at h0 h1
    rw [h0, h1]
    simp
  
  have hinvE : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (i j : Fin 2),
      A⁻¹ i j = A.det⁻¹ * A.adjugate i j := by
    intro A i j
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rfl
  have hadj00 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 0 0 = A 1 1 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj01 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 0 1 = -A 0 1 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj10 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 1 0 = -A 1 0 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj11 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 1 1 = A 0 0 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hdetE : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 1 0 :=
    fun A => Matrix.det_fin_two A
  have hDpos : 0 < (h x).det := (hpd x hx).det_pos
  have hD0 : (h x).det ≠ 0 := hDpos.ne'
  have hx10 : h x 1 0 = h x 0 1 := hsymm x hx 1 0
  have hd10 : ∀ l : Fin 2, pd2 l (fun z => h z 1 0) x = pd2 l (fun z => h z 0 1) x := by
    intro l
    have hev : (fun z => h z 1 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => h z 0 1) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hxU (fun z hz => hsymm z hz 1 0)
    unfold pd2
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev]
  have hdetfun : (fun z => (h z).det) = fun z => h z 0 0 * h z 1 1 - h z 0 1 * h z 1 0 := by
    funext z; exact hdetE (h z)
  have hdD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z).det) x := by
    rw [hdetfun]; exact ((hdh 0 0).mul (hdh 1 1)).sub ((hdh 0 1).mul (hdh 1 0))
  have hdS : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det) x := hdD.sqrt hD0
  have hdpd : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ∀ j : Fin 2,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 j f) x := by
    intro f hf j
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f W := contDiffOn_infty.mp hf 2
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) W := h2.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by norm_num)
    have h3 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (pd2 j f) W := h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h3.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt hxU
  have hdbj := hdpd b hb
  have hdI : ∀ i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) x := by
    intro i j
    have e : (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) = fun z => ((h z).det)⁻¹ * (h z).adjugate i j :=
      funext fun z => hinvE (h z) i j
    rw [e]
    refine (hdD.inv hD0).mul ?_
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, hadj00]; exact hdh 1 1
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, hadj01]; exact (hdh 0 1).neg
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, hadj10]; exact (hdh 1 0).neg
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, hadj11]; exact hdh 0 0
  
  have pD : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x =
      pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 0) x * h x 1 1 + h x 0 0 * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 1) x -
        (pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 1) x * h x 1 0 + h x 0 1 * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 0) x) := by
    intro k
    rw [hdetfun, psub _ _ k ((hdh 0 0).fun_mul (hdh 1 1)) ((hdh 0 1).fun_mul (hdh 1 0)),
      pmul _ _ k (hdh 0 0) (hdh 1 1), pmul _ _ k (hdh 0 1) (hdh 1 0)]
  have pS : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det) x =
      Real.sqrt (h x).det * pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (2 * (h x).det) := by
    intro k
    rw [psqrt _ k hdD hD0]
    have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (h x).det := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hDpos
    have hss : Real.sqrt (h x).det * Real.sqrt (h x).det = (h x).det :=
      Real.mul_self_sqrt hDpos.le
    generalize Real.sqrt (h x).det = s at hs0 hss ⊢
    rw [← hss]
    field_simp
  have pI00 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 0) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * h x 1 1 +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 1) x := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj00]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 1 1), pinv _ k hdD hD0]
  have pI01 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 1) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * (-h x 0 1) +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * (-pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 1) x) := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj01]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 0 1).fun_neg, pinv _ k hdD hD0, pneg]
  have pI10 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 0) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * (-h x 1 0) +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * (-pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 0) x) := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj10]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 1 0).fun_neg, pinv _ k hdD hD0, pneg]
  have pI11 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 1) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * h x 0 0 +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 0) x := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj11]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 0 0), pinv _ k hdD hD0]
  
  have hdiv : pd2 0 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 0 j * pd2 j b z) x +
      pd2 1 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 1 j * pd2 j b z) x =
      Real.sqrt (h x).det * lap2 h b x := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hdA : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i 0 * pd2 0 b z + (h z)⁻¹ i 1 * pd2 1 b z) x :=
      fun i => ((hdI i 0).fun_mul (hdbj 0)).fun_add ((hdI i 1).fun_mul (hdbj 1))
    rw [pmul _ _ 0 hdS (hdA 0), pmul _ _ 1 hdS (hdA 1),
      padd _ _ 0 ((hdI 0 0).fun_mul (hdbj 0)) ((hdI 0 1).fun_mul (hdbj 1)),
      padd _ _ 1 ((hdI 1 0).fun_mul (hdbj 0)) ((hdI 1 1).fun_mul (hdbj 1)),
      pmul _ _ 0 (hdI 0 0) (hdbj 0), pmul _ _ 0 (hdI 0 1) (hdbj 1),
      pmul _ _ 1 (hdI 1 0) (hdbj 0), pmul _ _ 1 (hdI 1 1) (hdbj 1),
      pS 0, pS 1, pI00 0, pI01 0, pI10 1, pI11 1, pD 0, pD 1]
    simp only [lap2, christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hinvE (h x), hadj00, hadj01, hadj10, hadj11]
    have hD1 : h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 0 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have e := hdetE (h x)
      rw [hx10] at e
      rw [← e]
      exact hD0
    generalize Real.sqrt (h x).det = s
    simp only [hx10, hd10]
    field_simp
    simp only [hdetE (h x), hx10]
    ring
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hdiv
  have hX1 := eq_sub_of_add_eq' hdiv
  
  have hA10 : (h x)⁻¹ 1 0 = (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 := by
    have := (hpd x hx).inv.isHermitian.apply 0 1
    simpa using this
  have hβ : (fun a : Fin 2 => pd2 a b x) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hdb (hfz b (congrFun h0 0) (congrFun h0 1))
  have hNpos : 0 < sgbGradSq2 h b x := by
    have hp := (hpd x hx).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hβ
    have e : sgbGradSq2 h b x = dotProduct (star (fun a : Fin 2 => pd2 a b x))
        (Matrix.mulVec (h x)⁻¹ (fun a : Fin 2 => pd2 a b x)) := by
      simp only [sgbGradSq2, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, Pi.star_apply,
        star_trivial]
      ring
    rw [e]; exact hp
  have hN0 : sgbGradSq2 h b x ≠ 0 := hNpos.ne'
  have hlam : lam ≠ 0 := by
    intro hl
    apply hdw
    refine hfz w ?_ ?_
    · rw [H1 0, hl, zero_mul]
    · rw [H1 1, hl, zero_mul]
  
  have pGf : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (sgbGradSq2 h f) x ∧ ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (sgbGradSq2 h f) x =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a d) x * pd2 a f x * pd2 d f x +
          (h x)⁻¹ a d * (pd2 k (pd2 a f) x * pd2 d f x + pd2 a f x * pd2 k (pd2 d f) x)) := by
    intro f hf
    have hf1 := hdpd f hf
    have hT : ∀ a d : Fin 2,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a d * pd2 a f y * pd2 d f y) x :=
      fun a d => ((hdI a d).fun_mul (hf1 a)).fun_mul (hf1 d)
    have pT : ∀ a d k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a d * pd2 a f y * pd2 d f y) x =
        pd2 k (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a d) x * pd2 a f x * pd2 d f x +
          (h x)⁻¹ a d * (pd2 k (pd2 a f) x * pd2 d f x + pd2 a f x * pd2 k (pd2 d f) x) := by
      intro a d k
      rw [pmul _ _ k ((hdI a d).fun_mul (hf1 a)) (hf1 d), pmul _ _ k (hdI a d) (hf1 a)]
      ring
    have e : sgbGradSq2 h f = fun y => ((h y)⁻¹ 0 0 * pd2 0 f y * pd2 0 f y +
        (h y)⁻¹ 0 1 * pd2 0 f y * pd2 1 f y) + ((h y)⁻¹ 1 0 * pd2 1 f y * pd2 0 f y +
        (h y)⁻¹ 1 1 * pd2 1 f y * pd2 1 f y) := by
      funext y; simp only [sgbGradSq2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [e]
    refine ⟨((hT 0 0).fun_add (hT 0 1)).fun_add ((hT 1 0).fun_add (hT 1 1)), fun k => ?_⟩
    rw [padd _ _ k ((hT 0 0).fun_add (hT 0 1)) ((hT 1 0).fun_add (hT 1 1)),
      padd _ _ k (hT 0 0) (hT 0 1), padd _ _ k (hT 1 0) (hT 1 1), pT, pT, pT, pT]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  obtain ⟨hGwd, hGw'⟩ := pGf w hw
  obtain ⟨hGbd, hGb'⟩ := pGf b hb
  have hGwx : sgbGradSq2 h w x = lam ^ 2 * sgbGradSq2 h b x := by
    simp only [sgbGradSq2, H1, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hGw0 : sgbGradSq2 h w x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hGwx]; exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hlam) hN0
  
  have pLog : ∀ k : Fin 2,
      pd2 k (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y)) x =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((sgbGradSq2 h w x)⁻¹ * pd2 k (sgbGradSq2 h w) x) := by
    intro k
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_const_mul (hGwd.log hGw0), fderiv.log hGwd hGw0]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hdV : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b y)) x := hGbd.sqrt hN0
  have hV0 : Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hNpos).ne'
  have hdU : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det *
      ((h y)⁻¹ i 0 * pd2 0 b y + (h y)⁻¹ i 1 * pd2 1 b y)) x :=
    fun i => hdS.fun_mul (((hdI i 0).fun_mul (hdbj 0)).fun_add ((hdI i 1).fun_mul (hdbj 1)))
  have hRHS : Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x =
      -lap2 h b x + (((h x)⁻¹ 0 0 * pd2 0 b x + (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * pd2 1 b x) *
          pd2 0 (sgbGradSq2 h b) x +
        ((h x)⁻¹ 1 0 * pd2 0 b x + (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 * pd2 1 b x) * pd2 1 (sgbGradSq2 h b) x) /
        (2 * sgbGradSq2 h b x) := by
    have hLC : sgbLevelCurv2 h b x = -((Real.sqrt (h x).det)⁻¹ *
        (pd2 0 (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * ((h y)⁻¹ 0 0 * pd2 0 b y +
            (h y)⁻¹ 0 1 * pd2 1 b y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b y)) x +
          pd2 1 (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * ((h y)⁻¹ 1 0 * pd2 0 b y +
            (h y)⁻¹ 1 1 * pd2 1 b y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b y)) x)) := by
      simp only [sgbLevelCurv2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hLC, pdiv _ _ 0 (hdU 0) hdV hV0, pdiv _ _ 1 (hdU 1) hdV hV0,
      psqrt _ 0 hGbd hN0, psqrt _ 1 hGbd hN0, hX1]
    have hrr : Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) = sgbGradSq2 h b x :=
      Real.mul_self_sqrt hNpos.le
    have hs0 : Real.sqrt (h x).det ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hDpos).ne'
    generalize Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) = r at hrr hV0 ⊢
    generalize Real.sqrt (h x).det = s at hs0 ⊢
    rw [← hrr]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have H3' := H3
  simp only [lap2, H1, Fin.sum_univ_two, hA10] at H3'
  have H2' := H2 ![-(pd2 1 b x), pd2 0 b x]
    (by simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons]; ring)
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.head_cons] at H2'
  have hNe : sgbGradSq2 h b x = (h x)⁻¹ 0 0 * pd2 0 b x * pd2 0 b x +
      (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * pd2 0 b x * pd2 1 b x + ((h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * pd2 1 b x * pd2 0 b x +
      (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 * pd2 1 b x * pd2 1 b x) := by
    simp only [sgbGradSq2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hA10]
  
  rw [hRHS]
  simp only [pLog, hGw', hGb', hGwx, H1]
  simp only [lap2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hA10]
  linear_combination (norm := skip) (1 / lam) * H3' +
    (-((h x)⁻¹ 0 0 * (h x)⁻¹ 1 1 - (h x)⁻¹ 0 1 * (h x)⁻¹ 0 1) /
      (lam * sgbGradSq2 h b x)) * H2'
  field_simp
  rw [hNe]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (Kc : Set E2) (hKc : IsCompact Kc)
    (hKW : Kc ⊆ W) (b : E2 → ℝ) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b W)
    (hreg : ∀ x ∈ W, b x = 0 → fderiv ℝ b x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ Cb s₄ : ℝ, 0 < s₄ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₄ →
      MeasureTheory.volume (Kc ∩ {x | 0 < b x ∧ b x < s}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Cb * s)

signature.name: pcgb_thin_band_volume
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (Kc : Set E2) (hKc : IsCompact Kc)
    (hKW : Kc ⊆ W) (b : E2 → ℝ) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b W)
    (hreg : ∀ x ∈ W, b x = 0 → fderiv ℝ b x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ Cb s₄ : ℝ, 0 < s₄ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₄ →
      MeasureTheory.volume (Kc ∩ {x | 0 < b x ∧ b x < s}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Cb * s)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have growth : ∀ y₀ ∈ W, fderiv ℝ b y₀ ≠ 0 →
      ∃ R cc : ℝ, ∃ v : E2, 0 < R ∧ 0 < cc ∧ ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R) ⊆ W ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ R → b y + cc * t ≤ b (y + t • v) := by
    intro y₀ hy₀ hd
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, fderiv ℝ b y₀ w ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hd (ContinuousLinearMap.ext hcon)
    have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      simp at hw
    have hwn : 0 < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hw0
    have hwi : 0 < ‖w‖⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hwn
    obtain ⟨v, hv1, hav⟩ : ∃ v : E2, ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < fderiv ℝ b y₀ v := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hw with h | h
      · refine ⟨-(‖w‖⁻¹ • w), ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hwn.ne']
        · rw [map_neg, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
          nlinarith
      · refine ⟨‖w‖⁻¹ • w, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm, inv_mul_cancel₀ hwn.ne']
        · rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
          exact mul_pos hwi h
    have hfc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ b) W :=
      hb.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
    have hfca : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ b) y₀ := hfc.continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hy₀)
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hδ₁'⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hfca (fderiv ℝ b y₀ v / 2)
      (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hδ₂'⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW y₀ hy₀
    have hδ : 0 < min δ₁ δ₂ := lt_min hδ₁ hδ₂
    have hballT : Metric.ball y₀ (min δ₁ δ₂) ⊆ W :=
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hδ₂'
    have hder : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (min δ₁ δ₂), fderiv ℝ b y₀ v / 2 < fderiv ℝ b z v := by
      intro z hz
      have hz1 : dist z y₀ < δ₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le hz (min_le_left _ _)
      have h1 := hδ₁' hz1
      rw [dist_eq_norm] at h1
      have h2 : ‖(fderiv ℝ b z - fderiv ℝ b y₀) v‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ b z - fderiv ℝ b y₀‖ * ‖v‖ :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      rw [hv1, mul_one, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h2
      have h3 := neg_abs_le (fderiv ℝ b z v - fderiv ℝ b y₀ v)
      linarith
    refine ⟨min δ₁ δ₂ / 2, fderiv ℝ b y₀ v / 2, v, by linarith, by linarith, hv1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [show 2 * (min δ₁ δ₂ / 2) = min δ₁ δ₂ by ring]
      exact hballT
    · intro y hy t ht0 htR
      have hseg : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ t → y + τ • v ∈ Metric.ball y₀ (min δ₁ δ₂) := by
        intro τ hτ0 hτt
        rw [Metric.mem_ball] at hy ⊢
        calc dist (y + τ • v) y₀ ≤ dist (y + τ • v) y + dist y y₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ = τ + dist y y₀ := by
              rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hv1, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                abs_of_nonneg hτ0]
          _ < min δ₁ δ₂ := by linarith
      have hderiv : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ τ → τ ≤ t →
          HasDerivAt (fun τ => b (y + τ • v)) (fderiv ℝ b (y + τ • v) v) τ := by
        intro τ hτ0 hτt
        have hmem := hballT (hseg τ hτ0 hτt)
        have hbd : DifferentiableAt ℝ b (y + τ • v) :=
          (hb.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hmem)).differentiableAt (by simp)
        have hp : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => y + τ • v) v τ := by
          simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id τ).smul_const v).const_add y
        exact hbd.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt τ hp
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht0 with h | h
      · subst h
        simp
      · have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun τ => b (y + τ • v)) (Set.Icc 0 t) := by
          intro τ hτ
          exact (hderiv τ hτ.1 hτ.2).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
        obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hξeq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (fun τ => b (y + τ • v))
          (fun τ => fderiv ℝ b (y + τ • v) v) h hcont
          (fun τ hτ => hderiv τ hτ.1.le hτ.2.le)
        have hgt := hder _ (hseg ξ hξ.1.le hξ.2.le)
        rw [hξeq] at hgt
        simp only [zero_smul, add_zero, sub_zero] at hgt
        rw [lt_div_iff₀ h] at hgt
        linarith
  
  have pack : ∀ (y₀ v : E2) (R cc : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < cc → ‖v‖ = 1 →
      ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball y₀ R) →
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball y₀ R, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ R → b y + cc * t ≤ b (y + t • v)) →
      ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < R * cc →
        MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R))).toReal /
            (R * cc) * s) := by
    intro y₀ v R cc hR hcc hv hbc hgrow s hs hsR
    have hUo : IsOpen (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) :=
      hbc.isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball (isOpen_Ioo (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := s))
    have hhpos : 0 < s / cc := div_pos hs hcc
    have hx1 : 1 < R * cc / s := by rw [lt_div_iff₀ hs]; linarith
    have hN1 : 0 < ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ := Nat.floor_pos.mpr hx1.le
    have hNx : (⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ R * cc / s := Nat.floor_le (by linarith)
    have hxN : R * cc / s < ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hNh : (⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) * (s / cc) ≤ R := by
      calc (⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) * (s / cc) ≤ R * cc / s * (s / cc) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hNx hhpos.le
        _ = R := by field_simp
    have hUkm : ∀ k : ℕ, MeasurableSet
        ((fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) := fun k =>
      (measurable_add_const _) hUo.measurableSet
    have hUkv : ∀ k : ℕ, MeasureTheory.volume
        ((fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) =
        MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) := fun k =>
      MeasureTheory.measure_preimage_add_right MeasureTheory.volume _ _
    have hUksub : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊,
        (fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ⊆ Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R) := by
      intro k hk z hz
      have hkN : (k : ℝ) ≤ ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ := by exact_mod_cast (Finset.mem_range.mp hk).le
      have hd : dist (z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) y₀ < R := hz.1
      have hkh : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) * (s / cc) := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k) hhpos.le
      have hkh2 : (k : ℝ) * (s / cc) ≤ ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ * (s / cc) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkN hhpos.le
      have hdz : dist z (z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) = (k : ℝ) * (s / cc) := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, sub_add_cancel_left, norm_neg, norm_smul, hv, mul_one,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hkh]
      rw [Metric.mem_ball]
      calc dist z y₀ ≤ dist z (z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) +
            dist (z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) y₀ := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < (k : ℝ) * (s / cc) + R := by rw [hdz]; linarith
        _ ≤ 2 * R := by linarith
    have key : ∀ j k : ℕ, j < k → k < ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ → Disjoint
        ((fun z => z + (-((j : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}))
        ((fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) := by
      intro j k hjk hkN
      rw [Set.disjoint_left]
      intro z hzj hzk
      have hj : z + (-((j : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v ∈
          Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s} := hzj
      have hk : z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v ∈
          Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s} := hzk
      have hjk' : (j : ℝ) + 1 ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hjk
      have hkN' : (k : ℝ) ≤ ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ := by exact_mod_cast hkN.le
      have hj0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j := Nat.cast_nonneg j
      have ht0 : s / cc ≤ ((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc) := by nlinarith
      have htR : ((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc) ≤ R := by
        have : ((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc) ≤ (⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) * (s / cc) := by nlinarith
        linarith
      have heq : z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v + (((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc)) • v =
          z + (-((j : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v := by
        rw [add_assoc, ← add_smul]
        congr 2
        ring
      have hg := hgrow _ hk.1 (((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc)) (by linarith) htR
      rw [heq] at hg
      have h1 : 0 < b (z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) := hk.2.1
      have h2 : b (z + (-((j : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) < s := hj.2.2
      have h3 : cc * (s / cc) ≤ cc * (((k : ℝ) - j) * (s / cc)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht0 hcc.le
      have hcs : cc * (s / cc) = s := by field_simp
      linarith
    have hdisj : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (↑(Finset.range ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊) : Set ℕ)
        (fun k : ℕ => (fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) := by
      intro j hj k hk hne
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h' | h'
      · exact key j k h' (Finset.mem_range.mp hk)
      · exact (key k j h' (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)).symm
    have hsum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊, MeasureTheory.volume
        ((fun z => z + (-((k : ℝ) * (s / cc))) • v) ⁻¹'
          (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) ≤
        MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R)) := by
      rw [← MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset hdisj (fun k _ => hUkm k)]
      exact MeasureTheory.measure_mono (Set.iUnion₂_subset hUksub)
    simp only [hUkv, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at hsum
    have hWt : MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R)) ≠ ⊤ := measure_ball_lt_top.ne
    have hUt : MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro htop
      rw [htop, ENNReal.mul_top (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))] at hsum
      exact hWt (top_le_iff.mp hsum)
    have hreal : (⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) *
        (MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})).toReal ≤
        (MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R))).toReal := by
      have := ENNReal.toReal_mono hWt hsum
      rwa [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_natCast] at this
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hUt]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    have hU0 : 0 ≤ (MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})).toReal :=
      ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    have hN1' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ := by exact_mod_cast hN1
    have hRc : R * cc ≤ 2 * ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ * s := by
      have h2N : R * cc / s ≤ 2 * ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ := by linarith
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hs] at h2N
      linarith
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hR hcc)]
    calc (MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})).toReal * (R * cc)
        ≤ (MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})).toReal *
            (2 * ⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ * s) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRc hU0
      _ = 2 * s * ((⌊R * cc / s⌋₊ : ℝ) *
            (MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ R ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})).toReal) := by
          ring
      _ ≤ 2 * s * (MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R))).toReal :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal (by linarith)
      _ = 2 * (MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R))).toReal * s := by ring
  
  have hloc : ∀ y₀ ∈ Kc, ∃ r C s₁ : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 < s₁ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < s₁ →
      MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ r ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (C * s) := by
    intro y₀ hy₀
    have hy₀T := hKW hy₀
    by_cases hb0 : b y₀ = 0
    · obtain ⟨R, cc, v, hR, hcc, hv, hball, hgrow⟩ := growth y₀ hy₀T (hreg y₀ hy₀T hb0)
      have hbc : ContinuousOn b (Metric.ball y₀ R) :=
        hb.continuousOn.mono ((Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)).trans hball)
      refine ⟨R, 2 * (MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y₀ (2 * R))).toReal / (R * cc), R * cc, hR,
        div_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two ENNReal.toReal_nonneg) (mul_pos hR hcc).le,
        mul_pos hR hcc, ?_⟩
      exact pack y₀ v R cc hR hcc hv hbc hgrow
    · have hm : 0 < |b y₀| := abs_pos.mpr hb0
      have hca : ContinuousAt b y₀ := hb.continuousOn.continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hy₀T)
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hca (|b y₀| / 2) (by linarith)
      refine ⟨r, 0, |b y₀| / 2, hr, le_rfl, by linarith, fun s hs hss => ?_⟩
      have hempty : Metric.ball y₀ r ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s} = ∅ := by
        rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        rintro z ⟨hz, hz1, hz2⟩
        have h1 : dist (b z) (b y₀) < |b y₀| / 2 := hr' hz
        rw [Real.dist_eq] at h1
        have h2 := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (b y₀) (b z)
        have h3 : |b y₀ - b z| = |b z - b y₀| := abs_sub_comm _ _
        rw [abs_of_pos hz1] at h2
        linarith
      rw [hempty, MeasureTheory.measure_empty]
      exact zero_le _
  
  choose! r C s₁ hr hC hs₁ hbd using hloc
  obtain ⟨t, htK, hcover⟩ := hKc.elim_nhds_subcover (fun y => Metric.ball y (r y))
    (fun y hy => Metric.ball_mem_nhds y (hr y hy))
  refine ⟨∑ y ∈ t, C y, (insert 1 (t.image s₁)).min' (Finset.insert_nonempty _ _), ?_,
    fun s hs hss => ?_⟩
  · have hm := Finset.min'_mem (insert 1 (t.image s₁)) (Finset.insert_nonempty _ _)
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image] at hm
    rcases hm with h | ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩
    · rw [h]; exact one_pos
    · rw [← hy']; exact hs₁ y (htK y hy)
  · have hle : ∀ y ∈ t, s < s₁ y := fun y hy => lt_of_lt_of_le hss
      (Finset.min'_le _ _ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hy)))
    calc MeasureTheory.volume (Kc ∩ {x | 0 < b x ∧ b x < s})
        ≤ MeasureTheory.volume (⋃ y ∈ t, (Metric.ball y (r y) ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s})) := by
          apply MeasureTheory.measure_mono
          rintro z ⟨hzK, hz⟩
          have hzc := hcover hzK
          rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hzc ⊢
          obtain ⟨y, hy, hzy⟩ := hzc
          exact ⟨y, hy, hzy, hz⟩
      _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ t, MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball y (r y) ∩ {y | 0 < b y ∧ b y < s}) :=
          MeasureTheory.measure_biUnion_finset_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ t, ENNReal.ofReal (C y * s) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun y hy => hbd y (htK y hy) s hs (hle y hy))
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ y ∈ t, C y * s) :=
          (ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (fun y hy => mul_nonneg (hC y (htK y hy)) hs.le)).symm
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((∑ y ∈ t, C y) * s) := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (Kc : Set E2) (hKc : IsCompact Kc)
    (hKW : Kc ⊆ W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a c) W) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W, (h y).PosDef)
    (b w : E2 → ℝ) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b W) (V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (hVW : V ⊆ W)
    (σ₀ : ℝ) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hbV : ∀ x ∈ W, 0 ≤ b x → b x ≤ σ₀ → x ∈ V)
    (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w V)
    (hreg : ∀ x ∈ W, b x = 0 → fderiv ℝ b x ≠ 0)
    (hdw : ∀ x ∈ W, b x = 0 → fderiv ℝ w x ≠ 0)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ W, b x = 0 → ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a b x *
        pd2 c (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y)) x =
      Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ x ∈ Kc,
      0 < b x → b x < σ →
      |Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x -
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a b x *
          pd2 c (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y + ε)) x| ≤ δ + A * ε

signature.name: pcgb_patch_collar_bound
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (Kc : Set E2) (hKc : IsCompact Kc)
    (hKW : Kc ⊆ W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a c) W) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W, (h y).PosDef)
    (b w : E2 → ℝ) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b W) (V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (hVW : V ⊆ W)
    (σ₀ : ℝ) (hσ₀ : 0 < σ₀) (hbV : ∀ x ∈ W, 0 ≤ b x → b x ≤ σ₀ → x ∈ V)
    (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w V)
    (hreg : ∀ x ∈ W, b x = 0 → fderiv ℝ b x ≠ 0)
    (hdw : ∀ x ∈ W, b x = 0 → fderiv ℝ w x ≠ 0)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ W, b x = 0 → ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a b x *
        pd2 c (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y)) x =
      Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ x ∈ Kc,
      0 < b x → b x < σ →
      |Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x -
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a b x *
          pd2 c (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y + ε)) x| ≤ δ + A * ε

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hne : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  
  have sep : ∀ (K : Set E2), IsCompact K → ∀ (bb F : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn bb K →
      ContinuousOn F K → ∀ (δ' : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ K, bb x = 0 → F x < δ') →
      ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ bb x → bb x < σ → F x < δ' := by
    intro K hK bb F hbb hF δ' hz
    have hK1 : IsClosed (K ∩ bb ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0) :=
      hbb.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hK.isClosed isClosed_Ici
    have hK2 : IsClosed ((K ∩ bb ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0) ∩ F ⁻¹' Set.Ici δ') :=
      (hF.mono Set.inter_subset_left).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hK1 isClosed_Ici
    have hK'c : IsCompact ((K ∩ bb ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0) ∩ F ⁻¹' Set.Ici δ') :=
      hK.of_isClosed_subset hK2 (fun x hx => hx.1.1)
    rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty ((K ∩ bb ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0) ∩ F ⁻¹' Set.Ici δ') with hE | hE
    · refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun x hx h0 _ => ?_⟩
      by_contra hc
      have hmem : x ∈ ((K ∩ bb ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0) ∩ F ⁻¹' Set.Ici δ') :=
        ⟨⟨hx, h0⟩, not_lt.mp hc⟩
      rw [hE] at hmem
      exact hmem
    · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hmin⟩ := hK'c.exists_isMinOn hE (hbb.mono (fun x hx => hx.1.1))
      have hx₀b : (0 : ℝ) ≤ bb x₀ := hx₀.1.2
      have hx₀F : δ' ≤ F x₀ := hx₀.2
      have hpos : 0 < bb x₀ := by
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hx₀b with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd (hz x₀ hx₀.1.1 h.symm) (not_lt.mpr hx₀F)
      refine ⟨bb x₀, hpos, fun x hx h0 hlt => ?_⟩
      by_contra hc
      have hmem : x ∈ ((K ∩ bb ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0) ∩ F ⁻¹' Set.Ici δ') :=
        ⟨⟨hx, h0⟩, not_lt.mp hc⟩
      have := isMinOn_iff.mp hmin x hmem
      linarith
  
  have gpos : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), (h x).PosDef → fderiv ℝ f x ≠ 0 →
      0 < sgbGradSq2 h f x := by
    intro f x hx hd
    have hξ : (![pd2 0 f x, pd2 1 f x] : Fin 2 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hd
      have h0' : fderiv ℝ f x (e2 0) = 0 := by simpa [pd2] using congrFun h0 0
      have h1' : fderiv ℝ f x (e2 1) = 0 := by simpa [pd2] using congrFun h0 1
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
      have hv : v = v 0 • e2 0 + v 1 • e2 1 := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      rw [hv, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, h0', h1']
      simp
    refine lt_of_lt_of_eq (hx.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ) ?_
    simp only [sgbGradSq2, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, star_trivial,
      Pi.star_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    ring
  
  have hdetW : ∀ y ∈ W, (h y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).det) W := by
    have e : (fun y => (h y).det) = fun y => h y 0 0 * h y 1 1 - h y 0 1 * h y 1 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
    rw [e]
    exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have hinvW : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a c) W := by
    have hdi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹) W := hdetS.inv hdetW
    have e : ∀ y, ∀ a c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c = ((h y).det)⁻¹ * (h y).adjugate a c := by
      intro y a c
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hadj : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).adjugate a c) W := by
      intro a c
      have e2' : (fun y => (h y).adjugate a c) = fun y =>
          (!![h y 1 1, -h y 0 1; -h y 1 0, h y 0 0] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) a c := by
        funext y
        rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
      rw [e2']
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c
      · simpa using hh 1 1
      · simpa using (hh 0 1).neg
      · simpa using (hh 1 0).neg
      · simpa using hh 0 0
    intro a c
    exact (hdi.mul (hadj a c)).congr (fun y _ => e y a c)
  
  have pdS : ∀ (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 a f) U := by
    intro U hU f hf a
    exact (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have gS : ∀ (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → U ⊆ W → ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sgbGradSq2 h f) U := by
    intro U hU hUW f hf
    have hp := pdS U hU f hf
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a f x * pd2 c f x) U
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun c _ =>
      (((hinvW a c).mono hUW).mul (hp a)).mul (hp c)))
  
  have kC : ∀ (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → U ⊆ W → ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      (∀ x ∈ U, 0 < sgbGradSq2 h f x) → ContinuousOn (sgbLevelCurv2 h f) U := by
    intro U hU hUW f hf hpos
    have hsd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det) U :=
      (hdetS.mono hUW).sqrt (fun y hy => hdetW y (hUW hy))
    have hsdne : ∀ y ∈ U, Real.sqrt (h y).det ≠ 0 :=
      fun y hy => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpd y (hUW hy)).det_pos).ne'
    have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sgbGradSq2 h f) U := gS U hU hUW f hf
    have hsG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h f y)) U :=
      hG.sqrt (fun y hy => (hpos y hy).ne')
    have hsGne : ∀ y ∈ U, Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h f y) ≠ 0 :=
      fun y hy => (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (hpos y hy)).ne'
    have hp := pdS U hU f hf
    have hY : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det *
        (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a f y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h f y)) U := by
      intro i
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det *
          (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a f y)) U :=
        hsd.mul (ContDiffOn.sum (fun a _ => ((hinvW i a).mono hUW).mul (hp a)))
      exact h1.div hsG hsGne
    have hYd : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 i (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det *
        (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a f y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h f y)) x) U := by
      intro i
      exact ((hY i).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hinvd : ContinuousOn (fun x => (Real.sqrt (h x).det)⁻¹) U :=
      hsd.continuousOn.inv₀ hsdne
    show ContinuousOn (fun x => -((Real.sqrt (h x).det)⁻¹ * ∑ i : Fin 2,
      pd2 i (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a f y) /
        Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h f y)) x)) U
    exact (hinvd.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hYd i))).neg
  
  have logd : ∀ (F : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2) (ε : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ F x → 0 < F x + ε →
      ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (F y + ε)) x =
        pd2 c F x / (2 * (F x + ε)) := by
    intro F x ε hF hpos c
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => F y + ε) (fderiv ℝ F x) x := hF.hasFDerivAt.add_const ε
    have h2 := (h1.log hpos.ne').const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    simp only [pd2]
    rw [h2.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  
  have alg : ∀ q g ε A : ℝ, 0 < g → 0 < ε → |q| / (2 * g ^ 2) ≤ A →
      |q / (2 * g) - q / (2 * (g + ε))| ≤ A * ε := by
    intro q g ε A hg hε hA
    have hgε : 0 < g + ε := by linarith
    have h2g : (2 * g) ≠ 0 := (mul_pos two_pos hg).ne'
    have h2gε : (2 * (g + ε)) ≠ 0 := (mul_pos two_pos hgε).ne'
    have hden : 0 < 2 * g * (g + ε) := mul_pos (mul_pos two_pos hg) hgε
    have hden2 : 0 < 2 * g ^ 2 := mul_pos two_pos (pow_pos hg 2)
    have e : q / (2 * g) - q / (2 * (g + ε)) = q * ε / (2 * g * (g + ε)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [e, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hε, abs_of_pos hden]
    have h1 : |q| * ε / (2 * g * (g + ε)) ≤ |q| * ε / (2 * g ^ 2) := by
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg q) hε.le) hden2
      nlinarith
    calc |q| * ε / (2 * g * (g + ε)) ≤ |q| * ε / (2 * g ^ 2) := h1
      _ = |q| / (2 * g ^ 2) * ε := by ring
      _ ≤ A * ε := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hA hε.le
  
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : E2 → ℝ, Q = fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
      (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a b x * pd2 c (sgbGradSq2 h w) x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hpdb : ∀ a, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 a b) W := pdS W hW b hb
  have hGV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sgbGradSq2 h w) V := gS V hV hVW w hw
  have hGbW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sgbGradSq2 h b) W := gS W hW Set.Subset.rfl b hb
  have hGdiff : ∀ x ∈ V, DifferentiableAt ℝ (sgbGradSq2 h w) x :=
    fun x hx => (hGV.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt hne
  have hpdG : ∀ c, ContinuousOn (pd2 c (sgbGradSq2 h w)) V :=
    fun c => (pdS V hV _ hGV c).continuousOn
  have hQc : ContinuousOn Q V := by
    rw [hQ]
    exact continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun c _ =>
      (((hinvW a c).mono hVW).continuousOn.mul ((hpdb a).continuousOn.mono hVW)).mul (hpdG c)))
  
  have hPε : ∀ x ∈ V, 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε →
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a b x *
        pd2 c (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y + ε)) x =
      Q x / (2 * (sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε)) := by
    intro x hx hG ε hε
    have hpos : 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε := by linarith
    simp only [logd _ x ε (hGdiff x hx) hpos, hQ]
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => ?_)
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_)
    ring
  have hP0 : ∀ x ∈ V, 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x →
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a b x *
        pd2 c (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (sgbGradSq2 h w y)) x =
      Q x / (2 * sgbGradSq2 h w x) := by
    intro x hx hG
    have := hPε x hx hG 0 le_rfl
    simpa only [add_zero] using this
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set E2,
      O = {x | x ∈ V ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h b x} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hOmem : ∀ x, x ∈ O ↔ (x ∈ V ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h b x) := by
    intro x
    subst hOdef
    exact Iff.rfl
  have hOV : O ⊆ V := fun x hx => ((hOmem x).1 hx).1
  have hOW : O ⊆ W := hOV.trans hVW
  have hOo : IsOpen O := by
    have h1 : IsOpen (V ∩ sgbGradSq2 h w ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) :=
      hGV.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hV isOpen_Ioi
    have h2 : IsOpen ((V ∩ sgbGradSq2 h w ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) ∩ sgbGradSq2 h b ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (hGbW.continuousOn.mono (fun x hx => hVW hx.1)).isOpen_inter_preimage h1 isOpen_Ioi
    have e : O = (V ∩ sgbGradSq2 h w ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) ∩ sgbGradSq2 h b ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0 := by
      ext x
      rw [hOmem x]
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioi, and_assoc]
    rw [e]
    exact h2
  
  have hf0c : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x -
      Q x / (2 * sgbGradSq2 h w x)) O := by
    have hk : ContinuousOn (sgbLevelCurv2 h b) O :=
      kC O hOo hOW b (hb.mono hOW) (fun x hx => ((hOmem x).1 hx).2.2)
    have hs : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x)) O :=
      (hGbW.continuousOn.mono hOW).sqrt
    have hq : ContinuousOn (fun x => Q x / (2 * sgbGradSq2 h w x)) O :=
      (hQc.mono hOV).div (continuousOn_const.mul (hGV.continuousOn.mono hOV))
        (fun x hx => (mul_pos two_pos ((hOmem x).1 hx).2.1).ne')
    exact (hs.mul hk).sub hq
  
  have hbK : ContinuousOn b Kc := hb.continuousOn.mono hKW
  have hK0c : IsCompact (Kc ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 σ₀) :=
    hKc.of_isClosed_subset (hbK.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hKc.isClosed isClosed_Icc)
      Set.inter_subset_left
  have hK0V : Kc ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 σ₀ ⊆ V := fun x hx => hbV x (hKW hx.1) hx.2.1 hx.2.2
  obtain ⟨σ', hσ', hσ'P⟩ := sep (Kc ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 σ₀) hK0c b
    (fun x => |sgbGradSq2 h w x - sgbGradSq2 h b x| - (sgbGradSq2 h w x + sgbGradSq2 h b x))
    (hbK.mono Set.inter_subset_left)
    ((((hGV.continuousOn.mono hK0V).sub
        (hGbW.continuousOn.mono (fun x hx => hKW hx.1))).abs).sub
      ((hGV.continuousOn.mono hK0V).add
        (hGbW.continuousOn.mono (fun x hx => hKW hx.1)))) 0
    (fun x hx hbx => by
      have hxW := hKW hx.1
      have h1 := gpos w x (hpd x hxW) (hdw x hxW hbx)
      have h2 := gpos b x (hpd x hxW) (hreg x hxW hbx)
      have h3 : |sgbGradSq2 h w x - sgbGradSq2 h b x| <
          sgbGradSq2 h w x + sgbGradSq2 h b x :=
        abs_sub_lt_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      show |sgbGradSq2 h w x - sgbGradSq2 h b x| -
        (sgbGradSq2 h w x + sgbGradSq2 h b x) < 0
      linarith)
  have hσ₁ : 0 < min σ₀ (σ' / 2) := lt_min hσ₀ (half_pos hσ')
  have hK1c : IsCompact (Kc ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 (min σ₀ (σ' / 2))) :=
    hKc.of_isClosed_subset (hbK.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hKc.isClosed isClosed_Icc)
      Set.inter_subset_left
  have hK1O : Kc ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 (min σ₀ (σ' / 2)) ⊆ O := by
    intro x hx
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ b x := hx.2.1
    have hb1 : b x ≤ min σ₀ (σ' / 2) := hx.2.2
    have hbσ₀ : b x ≤ σ₀ := hb1.trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have hbσ' : b x < σ' := lt_of_le_of_lt (hb1.trans (min_le_right _ _)) (half_lt_self hσ')
    have hxV := hbV x (hKW hx.1) hb0 hbσ₀
    have hneg : |sgbGradSq2 h w x - sgbGradSq2 h b x| -
        (sgbGradSq2 h w x + sgbGradSq2 h b x) < 0 :=
      hσ'P x ⟨hx.1, hb0, hbσ₀⟩ hb0 hbσ'
    have e1 := le_abs_self (sgbGradSq2 h w x - sgbGradSq2 h b x)
    have e2 := neg_abs_le (sgbGradSq2 h w x - sgbGradSq2 h b x)
    exact (hOmem x).2 ⟨hxV, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  
  have hrc : ContinuousOn (fun x => |Q x| / (2 * sgbGradSq2 h w x ^ 2)) O :=
    (hQc.mono hOV).abs.div (continuousOn_const.mul ((hGV.continuousOn.mono hOV).pow 2))
      (fun x hx => (mul_pos two_pos (pow_pos ((hOmem x).1 hx).2.1 2)).ne')
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hK1c.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hrc.mono hK1O)
  refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Kc ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 (min σ₀ (σ' / 2)), ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      |Q x / (2 * sgbGradSq2 h w x) - Q x / (2 * (sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε))| ≤ max C 0 * ε := by
    intro x hx ε hε
    have hG : 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x := ((hOmem x).1 (hK1O hx)).2.1
    have hr : |Q x| / (2 * sgbGradSq2 h w x ^ 2) ≤ max C 0 := by
      have h1 : ‖|Q x| / (2 * sgbGradSq2 h w x ^ 2)‖ ≤ C := hC x hx
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h1.trans (le_max_left _ _))
    exact alg (Q x) (sgbGradSq2 h w x) ε (max C 0) hG hε hr
  
  intro δ hδ
  obtain ⟨σ₂, hσ₂, hσ₂P⟩ := sep (Kc ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 (min σ₀ (σ' / 2))) hK1c b
    (fun x => |Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x -
      Q x / (2 * sgbGradSq2 h w x)|)
    (hbK.mono Set.inter_subset_left) ((hf0c.mono hK1O).abs) δ
    (fun x hx hbx => by
      have hxO := hK1O hx
      have hxW := hKW hx.1
      have hG := ((hOmem x).1 hxO).2.1
      have h1 := hzero x hxW hbx
      rw [hP0 x ((hOmem x).1 hxO).1 hG] at h1
      show |Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x -
        Q x / (2 * sgbGradSq2 h w x)| < δ
      rw [← h1, sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact hδ)
  refine ⟨min (min σ₀ (σ' / 2)) σ₂, lt_min hσ₁ hσ₂, fun ε hε x hx hbx hbσ => ?_⟩
  have hx1 : x ∈ Kc ∩ b ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 (min σ₀ (σ' / 2)) :=
    ⟨hx, hbx.le, hbσ.le.trans (min_le_left _ _)⟩
  have hxO := hK1O hx1
  have hG := ((hOmem x).1 hxO).2.1
  have hxV := ((hOmem x).1 hxO).1
  have h1 : |Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x -
      Q x / (2 * sgbGradSq2 h w x)| < δ :=
    hσ₂P x hx1 hbx.le (lt_of_lt_of_le hbσ (min_le_right _ _))
  have h2 := hdiff x hx1 ε hε
  rw [hPε x hxV hG ε hε.le]
  have h3 := abs_sub_le (Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h b x) * sgbLevelCurv2 h b x)
    (Q x / (2 * sgbGradSq2 h w x)) (Q x / (2 * (sgbGradSq2 h w x + ε)))
  linarith

informal_problem.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u w : M → ℝ) (z : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target) (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y) (hw : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y) : g.gradInner u w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) = gradInnerLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y

signature.name: edge_gradInner_chart
signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u w : M → ℝ) (z : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target) (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y) (hw : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y) : g.gradInner u w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) = gradInnerLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hbasis : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ d : Fin 3, v d • e d := by
    intro v
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr v]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  have hcomp_e : ∀ v : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ a : Fin 3, (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) a = v a := by
    intro v a
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  have hcompo : ∀ (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z → ∀ l d : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z = (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) d := by
    intro ψ z hψ l d
    have hfun : (fun v => ψ v d) = (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ ψ := by
      funext v; simp
    rw [partialDeriv, hfun, fderiv_comp z (EuclideanSpace.proj d).differentiableAt hψ,
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp
  have pd_comp : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ) (ψ : E3 → E3) (z : E3), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ F (ψ z) → ∀ l : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv l (fun w' => F (ψ w')) z
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv d F (ψ z) * partialDeriv l (fun v => ψ v d) z := by
    intro F ψ z hψ hF l
    have h1 : partialDeriv l (fun w' => F (ψ w')) z = fderiv ℝ F (ψ z) (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (F ∘ ψ) z (e l) = _
      rw [fderiv_comp z hF hψ]
      rfl
    rw [h1, hbasis (fderiv ℝ ψ z (e l)), map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hcompo ψ z hψ]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d _
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  
  have grad_alg : ∀ (A Gm Gt : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P Pt Q Qt : Fin 3 → ℝ), A.det ≠ 0 →
      (∀ i j, Gt i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A a i * Gm a b * A b j) →
      (∀ i, Pt i = ∑ a : Fin 3, P a * A a i) →
      (∀ i, Qt i = ∑ a : Fin 3, Q a * A a i) →
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gt⁻¹ i j * Pt i * Qt j =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Gm⁻¹ i j * P i * Q j := by
    intro A Gm Gt P Pt Q Qt hA hGt hPt hQt
    have hAu : IsUnit A.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA
    have hGt' : Gt = Matrix.transpose A * Gm * A := by
      ext i j
      rw [hGt]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
    have hGtinv : Gt⁻¹ = A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGt', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
      exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    have hM : A * Gt⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A = Gm⁻¹ := by
      rw [hGtinv]
      calc A * (A⁻¹ * Gm⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A⁻¹) * Matrix.transpose A
          = (A * A⁻¹) * Gm⁻¹ * (Matrix.transpose A⁻¹ * Matrix.transpose A) := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = Gm⁻¹ := by
            rw [hAB, ← Matrix.transpose_mul, hAB, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul,
              Matrix.mul_one]
    have hM' : ∀ a b, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A a i * Gt⁻¹ i j * A b j = Gm⁻¹ a b := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hM]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [hPt, hQt, ← hM']
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : M, (chartAt E3 z).symm y = q := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [hq]
  have hqz : q ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source := by
    rw [← hq]; exact (chartAt E3 z).map_target hy
  have hx0 : chartAt E3 q q ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target := mem_chart_target E3 q
  have hsq : (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) = q :=
    (chartAt E3 q).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 q)
  have hOo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source) :=
    (chartAt E3 q).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 q).open_target
      (chartAt E3 z).open_source
  have hx0O : chartAt E3 q q ∈
      (chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source := by
    refine ⟨hx0, ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source
    rw [hsq]; exact hqz
  have hO'o : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) :=
    (chartAt E3 z).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 z).open_target
      (chartAt E3 q).open_source
  have hyO' : y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source := by
    refine ⟨hy, ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 z).symm y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source
    rw [hq]; exact mem_chart_source E3 q
  obtain ⟨τ, hτdef⟩ : ∃ τ : E3 → E3, τ = fun y' => chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y') :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨σ, hσdef⟩ : ∃ σ : E3 → E3, σ = fun y' => chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hτx : ∀ y', τ y' = chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y') := by
    intro y'; rw [hτdef]
  have hσx : ∀ y', σ y' = chartAt E3 q ((chartAt E3 z).symm y') := by
    intro y'; rw [hσdef]
  have hτs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ
      ((chartAt E3 q).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source) := by
    have hc : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 z) (chartAt E3 z).source :=
      contMDiffOn_chart
    have hs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q).target :=
      contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    have hcomp := hc.comp (hs.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun w' hw' => hw'.2)
    rw [hτdef]
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcomp
  have hσs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ σ
      ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q).source) := by
    have hc : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 q) (chartAt E3 q).source :=
      contMDiffOn_chart
    have hs : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 z).symm (chartAt E3 z).target :=
      contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    have hcomp := hc.comp (hs.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun w' hw' => hw'.2)
    rw [hσdef]
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp hcomp
  have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ (chartAt E3 q q) :=
    (hτs.contDiffAt (hOo.mem_nhds hx0O)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hσd : DifferentiableAt ℝ σ y :=
    (hσs.contDiffAt (hO'o.mem_nhds hyO')).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hτy : τ (chartAt E3 q q) = y := by
    rw [hτx, hsq, ← hq]; exact (chartAt E3 z).right_inv hy
  have hσd' : DifferentiableAt ℝ σ (τ (chartAt E3 q q)) := by rw [hτy]; exact hσd
  have hτt : τ (chartAt E3 q q) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target := by rw [hτy]; exact hy
  have hev : ((chartAt E3 q).symm : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 q q)]
      ((chartAt E3 z).symm ∘ τ) := by
    filter_upwards [hOo.mem_nhds hx0O] with w' hw'
    show (chartAt E3 q).symm w' = (chartAt E3 z).symm (τ w')
    rw [hτx]
    exact ((chartAt E3 z).left_inv hw'.2).symm
  have hinv : (fun y' => σ (τ y')) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 q q)] (fun y' => y') := by
    filter_upwards [hOo.mem_nhds hx0O] with w' hw'
    show σ (τ w') = w'
    rw [hσx, hτx, (chartAt E3 z).left_inv hw'.2, (chartAt E3 q).right_inv hw'.1]
  
  have hid : ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ σ (τ (chartAt E3 q q)) (fderiv ℝ τ (chartAt E3 q q) v) = v := by
    intro v
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ (σ ∘ τ) (chartAt E3 q q) =
        (fderiv ℝ σ (τ (chartAt E3 q q))).comp (fderiv ℝ τ (chartAt E3 q q)) :=
      fderiv_comp (chartAt E3 q q) hσd' hτd
    have h2 : fderiv ℝ (σ ∘ τ) (chartAt E3 q q) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 := by
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y' => σ (τ y')) (chartAt E3 q q) = _
      rw [hinv.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id']
    have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => L v) (h1.symm.trans h2)
    simpa using h3
  have hM1 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) =
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (τ (chartAt E3 q q))).comp
        (fderiv ℝ τ (chartAt E3 q q)) := by
    rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp (chartAt E3 q q)
      (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 z) hτt) hτd.mdifferentiableAt,
      mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
  
  have s1 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) i j =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv i (fun w' => τ w' a) (chartAt E3 q q) *
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (τ (chartAt E3 q q)) a b *
            partialDeriv j (fun w' => τ w' b) (chartAt E3 q q) := by
    intro i j
    have hq' : (chartAt E3 z).symm (τ (chartAt E3 q q)) =
        (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) := by
      rw [hτx]; exact (chartAt E3 z).left_inv hx0O.2
    have hgq : g.g ((chartAt E3 z).symm (τ (chartAt E3 q q))) =
        g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q)) := congrArg g.g hq'
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3,
        D = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (τ (chartAt E3 q q)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hΦD : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) v =
        D (fderiv ℝ τ (chartAt E3 q q) v) := by
      intro v
      rw [hM1, hD]
      rfl
    have hcD : ∀ a b : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (τ (chartAt E3 q q)) a b
        = g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q)) (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
      intro a b
      rw [← hgq, hD]
      rfl
    have hJ : ∀ k : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ τ (chartAt E3 q q) (e k)
        = ∑ d : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun w' => τ w' d) (chartAt E3 q q) • e d := by
      intro k
      rw [hbasis (fderiv ℝ τ (chartAt E3 q q) (e k))]
      simp only [hcompo _ (chartAt E3 q q) hτd]
    simp only [hcD]
    show g.g ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q))
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) (e i))
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q) (e j)) = _
    rw [hΦD, hΦD, hJ i, hJ j]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  rw [hτy] at s1
  
  have s3 : (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 =>
      partialDeriv i (fun w' => τ w' a) (chartAt E3 q q)).det ≠ 0 := by
    intro hdet
    obtain ⟨v, hv0, hJv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr hdet
    have hw0 : fderiv ℝ τ (chartAt E3 q q) (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
      ext a
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul]
      have := congrFun hJv a
      simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.of_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
        hcompo _ (chartAt E3 q q) hτd] at this
      simp only [WithLp.ofLp_sum, WithLp.ofLp_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        WithLp.ofLp_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
      rw [← this]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      ring
    have h0 : (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i) = 0 := by
      calc (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i)
          = fderiv ℝ σ (τ (chartAt E3 q q))
              (fderiv ℝ τ (chartAt E3 q q) (∑ i : Fin 3, v i • e i)) := (hid _).symm
        _ = 0 := by rw [hw0, map_zero]
    apply hv0
    funext a
    rw [← hcomp_e v a, h0]
    rfl
  
  have chain : ∀ f : M → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y →
      ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun y' => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y')) (chartAt E3 q q) = ∑ a : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a (fun y' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y *
          (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 =>
            partialDeriv i (fun w' => τ w' a) (chartAt E3 q q)) a i := by
    intro f hf i
    have hequ : (fun y' => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y')) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 q q)]
        (fun y' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (τ y'))) := by
      filter_upwards [hev] with y' hy'
      exact congrArg f hy'
    have e1 : partialDeriv i (fun y' => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm y')) (chartAt E3 q q) =
        partialDeriv i (fun y' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm (τ y'))) (chartAt E3 q q) := by
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hequ.fderiv_eq]
    have hf' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) (τ (chartAt E3 q q)) := by
      rw [hτy]; exact hf
    rw [e1, pd_comp (fun y' => f ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) τ (chartAt E3 q q) hτd hf' i, hτy]
    rfl
  
  have hL : g.gradInner u w q = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q))⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y')) (chartAt E3 q q) *
        partialDeriv j (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y')) (chartAt E3 q q) := rfl
  have hR : gradInnerLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y'))
      (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
        partialDeriv i (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y *
        partialDeriv j (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y := rfl
  rw [hL, hR]
  exact grad_alg (Matrix.of fun a i : Fin 3 => partialDeriv i (fun w' => τ w' a) (chartAt E3 q q))
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y) (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q q))
    (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y)
    (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun y' => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y')) (chartAt E3 q q))
    (fun a => partialDeriv a (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y)
    (fun i => partialDeriv i (fun y' => w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y')) (chartAt E3 q q))
    s3 (fun i j => s1 i j) (chain u hu) (chain w hw)

informal_problem.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (β : M → ℝ) (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β) (z : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target) : g.levelMeanCurv β ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y

signature.name: edge_lmc_chart
signature.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (β : M → ℝ) (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β) (z : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target) : g.levelMeanCurv β ((chartAt E3 z).symm y) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) (fun y' => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) y

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hlmc : ∀ (G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ), G₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] G₂ →
      levelMeanCurvCoord G₁ f y = levelMeanCurvCoord G₂ f y := by
    intro G₁ G₂ f h
    have h0 : G₁ y = G₂ y := h.eq_of_nhds
    have hpd : ∀ a b c : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv c (fun w => G₁ w a b) y = partialDeriv c (fun w => G₂ w a b) y := by
      intro a b c
      have hev : (fun w => G₁ w a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun w => G₂ w a b) :=
        h.mono (fun w hw => by simp only [hw])
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 3, christoffel G₁ k i j y = christoffel G₂ k i j y := by
      intro k i j
      simp only [christoffel, h0, hpd]
    have hhess : ∀ i j : Fin 3, hessLoc G₁ f i j y = hessLoc G₂ f i j y := by
      intro i j
      simp only [hessLoc, hchr]
    have hlap : lapLoc G₁ f y = lapLoc G₂ f y := by
      simp only [lapLoc, h0, hhess]
    simp only [levelMeanCurvCoord, h0, hlap, hhess]
  
  have hΩ : IsOpen (chartAt E3 z).target := (chartAt E3 z).open_target
  obtain ⟨Φ, hsrc, hΦ⟩ := partialDiffeomorph_of_injOn z (chartAt E3 z).target hΩ id
    contDiffOn_id (Set.injOn_id _) (fun w hw => hw)
    (fun w _ => by rw [fderiv_id]; exact fun a b hab => by simpa using hab)
  have hΦ' : ∀ w ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target, Φ w = (chartAt E3 z).symm w := fun w hw => hΦ w hw
  
  have hcoeff : g.coeff Φ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm := by
    filter_upwards [hΩ.mem_nhds hy] with y' hy'
