    have hev : (⇑Φ) =ᶠ[𝓝 y'] (chartAt E3 z).symm := by
      filter_upwards [hΩ.mem_nhds hy'] with w hw
      exact hΦ' w hw
    have hmf := hev.mfderiv_eq (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, E3))
    have hval : Φ y' = (chartAt E3 z).symm y' := hΦ' y' hy'
    funext i j
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
    rw [hmf, hval]
  
  have hx : y ∈ Φ.source := hsrc ▸ hy
  have hfh : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 y, β (Φ w) = (fun y' => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) w := by
    filter_upwards [hΩ.mem_nhds hy] with w hw
    show β (Φ w) = β ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)
    rw [hΦ' w hw]
  have h2 := levelMeanCurv_eq_coord g Φ β (fun y' => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm y')) hβ y hx hfh
  rw [hΦ' y hy] at h2
  rw [h2]
  exact hlmc _ _ _ hcoeff

subgoal_signatures.name: partialDiffeomorph_of_injOn
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (z : M) (Ω : Set E3)
    (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (φ : E3 → E3) (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ Ω) (hinj : Set.InjOn φ Ω)
    (hφt : ∀ y ∈ Ω, φ y ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target)
    (hder : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ φ y)) :
    ∃ Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
      Φ.source = Ω ∧ ∀ y ∈ Ω, Φ y = (chartAt E3 z).symm (φ y)

subgoal_signatures.name: levelMeanCurv_eq_coord
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (h : E3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source)
    (hfh : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, f (Φ z) = h z) :
    g.levelMeanCurv f (Φ x) = levelMeanCurvCoord (g.coeff Φ) h x

informal_problem.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (O : Set E2) (hO : IsOpen O) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a b) O) (hsym : ∀ y ∈ O, ∀ a b : Fin 2, h y a b = h y b a) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ O, (h y).PosDef) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w O) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ O) (hQ : 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x) : sgbLevelCurv2 h w x = -((∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * gsCovD1 h (fun j y => pd2 j w y) a c x - (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a d * pd2 d w x) * (∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ c d * pd2 d w x) * gsCovD1 h (fun j y => pd2 j w y) a c x) / sgbGradSq2 h w x) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h w x))

signature.name: edge_curv2_formula
signature.statement: (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (O : Set E2) (hO : IsOpen O) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a b) O) (hsym : ∀ y ∈ O, ∀ a b : Fin 2, h y a b = h y b a) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ O, (h y).PosDef) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w O) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ O) (hQ : 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x) : sgbLevelCurv2 h w x = -((∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * gsCovD1 h (fun j y => pd2 j w y) a c x - (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a d * pd2 d w x) * (∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ c d * pd2 d w x) * gsCovD1 h (fun j y => pd2 j w y) a c x) / sgbGradSq2 h w x) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h w x))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hxU : O ∈ 𝓝 x := hO.mem_nhds hx
  have hw2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 w O := hw.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
  have hdh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h z a b) x := fun a b =>
    ((hh a b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hxU
  
  have pmul : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z * g z) x = pd2 k f x * g x + f x * pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have padd : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z + g z) x = pd2 k f x + pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hg]
    rfl
  have psub : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 k (fun z => f z - g z) x = pd2 k f x - pd2 k g x := by
    intro f g k hf hg
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub hf hg]
    rfl
  have pneg : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), pd2 k (fun z => -f z) x = -pd2 k f x := by
    intro f k
    unfold pd2
    rw [show (fun z => -f z) = -f from rfl, fderiv_neg]
    rfl
  have pinv : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x ≠ 0 →
      pd2 k (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) x = -pd2 k f x / (f x) ^ 2 := by
    intro f k hf hf0
    unfold pd2
    have H := (hasDerivAt_inv hf0).comp_hasFDerivAt x hf.hasFDerivAt
    rw [show (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) = (fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) ∘ f from rfl, H.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  have psqrt : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x ≠ 0 →
      pd2 k (fun z => Real.sqrt (f z)) x = pd2 k f x / (2 * Real.sqrt (f x)) := by
    intro f k hf hf0
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_sqrt hf hf0]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have pdivsqrt : ∀ (P R : E2 → ℝ) (i : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ P x →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ R x → 0 < R x →
      pd2 i (fun y => P y / Real.sqrt (R y)) x =
        pd2 i P x / Real.sqrt (R x) - P x * pd2 i R x / (2 * R x * Real.sqrt (R x)) := by
    intro P R i hP hR hpos
    have hR0 : R x ≠ 0 := hpos.ne'
    have hS : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => Real.sqrt (R y)) x := hR.sqrt hR0
    have hs0 : Real.sqrt (R x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos).ne'
    have hss : Real.sqrt (R x) ^ 2 = R x := Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le
    have e : (fun y => P y / Real.sqrt (R y)) = fun y => P y * (Real.sqrt (R y))⁻¹ := by
      funext y; rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [e, pmul _ _ i hP (hS.fun_inv hs0), pinv _ i hS hs0, psqrt _ i hR hR0]
    beta_reduce
    rw [hss]
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hinvE : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (i j : Fin 2),
      A⁻¹ i j = A.det⁻¹ * A.adjugate i j := by
    intro A i j
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rfl
  have hadj00 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 0 0 = A 1 1 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj01 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 0 1 = -A 0 1 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj10 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 1 0 = -A 1 0 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj11 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 1 1 = A 0 0 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hdetE : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 1 0 :=
    fun A => Matrix.det_fin_two A
  have hDpos : 0 < (h x).det := (hpd x hx).det_pos
  have hD0 : (h x).det ≠ 0 := hDpos.ne'
  have hx10 : h x 1 0 = h x 0 1 := hsym x hx 1 0
  have hd10 : ∀ l : Fin 2, pd2 l (fun z => h z 1 0) x = pd2 l (fun z => h z 0 1) x := by
    intro l
    have hev : (fun z => h z 1 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => h z 0 1) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hxU (fun z hz => hsym z hz 1 0)
    unfold pd2
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev]
  
  have hdetfun : (fun z => (h z).det) = fun z => h z 0 0 * h z 1 1 - h z 0 1 * h z 1 0 := by
    funext z; exact hdetE (h z)
  have hdD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z).det) x := by
    rw [hdetfun]; exact ((hdh 0 0).mul (hdh 1 1)).sub ((hdh 0 1).mul (hdh 1 0))
  have hdS : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det) x := hdD.sqrt hD0
  have hdw : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 j w) x := by
    intro j
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y) O := hw2.fderiv_of_isOpen hO (by norm_num)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (pd2 j w) O := h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (h2.differentiableOn (by norm_num)).differentiableAt hxU
  have hdI : ∀ i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) x := by
    intro i j
    have e : (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) = fun z => ((h z).det)⁻¹ * (h z).adjugate i j :=
      funext fun z => hinvE (h z) i j
    rw [e]
    refine (hdD.inv hD0).mul ?_
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, hadj00]; exact hdh 1 1
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, hadj01]; exact (hdh 0 1).neg
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, hadj10]; exact (hdh 1 0).neg
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, hadj11]; exact hdh 0 0
  
  have pD : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x =
      pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 0) x * h x 1 1 + h x 0 0 * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 1) x -
        (pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 1) x * h x 1 0 + h x 0 1 * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 0) x) := by
    intro k
    rw [hdetfun, psub _ _ k ((hdh 0 0).fun_mul (hdh 1 1)) ((hdh 0 1).fun_mul (hdh 1 0)),
      pmul _ _ k (hdh 0 0) (hdh 1 1), pmul _ _ k (hdh 0 1) (hdh 1 0)]
  have pS : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det) x =
      Real.sqrt (h x).det * pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (2 * (h x).det) := by
    intro k
    rw [psqrt _ k hdD hD0]
    have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (h x).det := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hDpos
    have hss : Real.sqrt (h x).det * Real.sqrt (h x).det = (h x).det :=
      Real.mul_self_sqrt hDpos.le
    generalize Real.sqrt (h x).det = s at hs0 hss ⊢
    rw [← hss]
    field_simp
  have pI00 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 0) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * h x 1 1 +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 1) x := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj00]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 1 1), pinv _ k hdD hD0]
  have pI01 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 1) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * (-h x 0 1) +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * (-pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 1) x) := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj01]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 0 1).fun_neg, pinv _ k hdD hD0, pneg]
  have pI10 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 0) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * (-h x 1 0) +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * (-pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 0) x) := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj10]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 1 0).fun_neg, pinv _ k hdD hD0, pneg]
  have pI11 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 1) x =
      -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * h x 0 0 +
        (h x).det⁻¹ * pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 0) x := by
    intro k
    simp only [hinvE, hadj11]
    rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 0 0), pinv _ k hdD hD0]
  
  have hdiv : pd2 0 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 0 j * pd2 j w z) x +
      pd2 1 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 1 j * pd2 j w z) x =
      Real.sqrt (h x).det * lap2 h w x := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hdA : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i 0 * pd2 0 w z + (h z)⁻¹ i 1 * pd2 1 w z) x :=
      fun i => ((hdI i 0).fun_mul (hdw 0)).fun_add ((hdI i 1).fun_mul (hdw 1))
    rw [pmul _ _ 0 hdS (hdA 0), pmul _ _ 1 hdS (hdA 1),
      padd _ _ 0 ((hdI 0 0).fun_mul (hdw 0)) ((hdI 0 1).fun_mul (hdw 1)),
      padd _ _ 1 ((hdI 1 0).fun_mul (hdw 0)) ((hdI 1 1).fun_mul (hdw 1)),
      pmul _ _ 0 (hdI 0 0) (hdw 0), pmul _ _ 0 (hdI 0 1) (hdw 1),
      pmul _ _ 1 (hdI 1 0) (hdw 0), pmul _ _ 1 (hdI 1 1) (hdw 1),
      pS 0, pS 1, pI00 0, pI01 0, pI10 1, pI11 1, pD 0, pD 1]
    simp only [lap2, christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hinvE (h x), hadj00, hadj01, hadj10, hadj11]
    generalize Real.sqrt (h x).det = s
    simp only [hx10, hd10]
    field_simp
    simp only [hdetE (h x), hx10]
    ring
  have hlap : lap2 h w x =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * gsCovD1 h (fun j y => pd2 j w y) a c x := by
    simp only [lap2, gsCovD1]
  
  have hQfun : sgbGradSq2 h w = fun y =>
      ((h y)⁻¹ 0 0 * pd2 0 w y * pd2 0 w y + (h y)⁻¹ 0 1 * pd2 0 w y * pd2 1 w y) +
      ((h y)⁻¹ 1 0 * pd2 1 w y * pd2 0 w y + (h y)⁻¹ 1 1 * pd2 1 w y * pd2 1 w y) := by
    funext y; simp only [sgbGradSq2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have dt : ∀ a c : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a w z * pd2 c w z) x :=
    fun a c => ((hdI a c).fun_mul (hdw a)).fun_mul (hdw c)
  have hdQ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (sgbGradSq2 h w) x := by
    rw [hQfun]
    exact ((dt 0 0).fun_add (dt 0 1)).fun_add ((dt 1 0).fun_add (dt 1 1))
  have pt : ∀ a c k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a w z * pd2 c w z) x =
      pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a c) x * pd2 a w x * pd2 c w x +
        (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 k (pd2 a w) x * pd2 c w x +
        (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a w x * pd2 k (pd2 c w) x := by
    intro a c k
    rw [pmul _ _ k ((hdI a c).fun_mul (hdw a)) (hdw c), pmul _ _ k (hdI a c) (hdw a)]
    ring
  have pQ : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (sgbGradSq2 h w) x =
      2 * ∑ m : Fin 2, (∑ d : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ m d * pd2 d w x) *
        gsCovD1 h (fun j y => pd2 j w y) k m x := by
    intro k
    rw [hQfun, padd _ _ k ((dt 0 0).fun_add (dt 0 1)) ((dt 1 0).fun_add (dt 1 1)),
      padd _ _ k (dt 0 0) (dt 0 1), padd _ _ k (dt 1 0) (dt 1 1), pt, pt, pt, pt]
    rw [pI00, pI01, pI10, pI11, pD]
    obtain rfl | rfl : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 := by fin_cases k <;> simp
    all_goals
      simp only [gsCovD1, christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hinvE (h x), hadj00, hadj01, hadj10,
        hadj11]
      simp only [hx10, hd10]
      field_simp
      simp only [hdetE (h x), hx10]
      ring
  
  have hP : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * ∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a w y) x := by
    intro i
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    exact hdS.fun_mul (((hdI i 0).fun_mul (hdw 0)).fun_add ((hdI i 1).fun_mul (hdw 1)))
  have hs0 : Real.sqrt (h x).det ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hDpos).ne'
  have hr0 : Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h w x) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ).ne'
  have hq0 : sgbGradSq2 h w x ≠ 0 := hQ.ne'
  rw [hlap] at hdiv
  unfold sgbLevelCurv2
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, pdivsqrt _ _ 0 (hP 0) hdQ hQ, pdivsqrt _ _ 1 (hP 1) hdQ hQ, pQ 0, pQ 1]
  linear_combination (norm := skip)
    (-((Real.sqrt (h x).det)⁻¹ / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h w x))) * hdiv
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  field_simp
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ V, (G y).PosDef) (f b : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b V) (hneuV : ∀ z ∈ V, b z = 0 → gradInnerLoc G f b z = 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ V) (hby : b y = 0) (hdb : 0 < gradSqLoc G b y) (hdf : 0 < gradSqLoc G f y) : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f z)) y ∧ gradInnerLoc G b (fun z => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f z)) y / Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y) = -(hessGGLoc G b f y / gradSqLoc G f y)

signature.name: edge_sqrt_neumann
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G y i j) V) (hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G y i j = G y j i) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ V, (G y).PosDef) (f b : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b V) (hneuV : ∀ z ∈ V, b z = 0 → gradInnerLoc G f b z = 0) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ V) (hby : b y = 0) (hdb : 0 < gradSqLoc G b y) (hdf : 0 < gradSqLoc G f y) : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f z)) y ∧ gradInnerLoc G b (fun z => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f z)) y / Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y) = -(hessGGLoc G b f y / gradSqLoc G f y)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hVy : V ∈ 𝓝 y := hV.mem_nhds hy
  have hinf0 : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have h1inf : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast (le_top : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
  have hGT : ∀ z, Matrix.transpose (G z) = G z := fun z => Matrix.ext fun i j => by
    rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]; exact hsymm z j i
  have hAsymG : ∀ z (i j : Fin 3), (G z)⁻¹ i j = (G z)⁻¹ j i := by
    intro z i j
    have h : Matrix.transpose ((G z)⁻¹) j i = (Matrix.transpose (G z))⁻¹ j i := by
      rw [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv]
    rw [Matrix.transpose_apply, hGT z] at h
    exact h
  have hdet : ∀ z ∈ V, (G z).det ≠ 0 := fun z hz => ((hpd z hz).det_pos).ne'
  have hinvC : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) V := by
    have h00 := hG 0 0
    have h01 := hG 0 1
    have h02 := hG 0 2
    have h10 := hG 1 0
    have h11 := hG 1 1
    have h12 := hG 1 2
    have h20 := hG 2 0
    have h21 := hG 2 1
    have h22 := hG 2 2
    have hdC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).det) V := by
      simp only [Matrix.det_fin_three]
      fun_prop
    have hdi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ((G z).det)⁻¹) V := hdC.inv hdet
    have key : ∀ z (i j : Fin 3), (G z)⁻¹ i j = ((G z).det)⁻¹ * (G z).adjugate i j := by
      intro z i j
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    intro i j
    have hadj : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (G z).adjugate i j) V := by
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three] <;> fun_prop
    exact (hdi.mul hadj).congr (fun z _ => key z i j)
  have hGd : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z i j) y := fun i j =>
    ((hG i j).contDiffAt hVy).differentiableAt hinf0
  have hAd : ∀ i j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y := fun i j =>
    ((hinvC i j).contDiffAt hVy).differentiableAt hinf0
  have hdA : ∀ k i l : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i l) y =
      -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv k (fun z => G z a c) y * (G y)⁻¹ c l := by
    intro k i l
    have hstar : ∀ j : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, (partialDeriv k (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i c) y * G y c j
        + (G y)⁻¹ i c * partialDeriv k (fun z => G z c j) y) = 0 := by
      intro j
      have hev : (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i c * G z c j) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          (fun _ => if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
        filter_upwards [hVy] with z hz
        have h1 : (G z)⁻¹ * G z = 1 :=
          Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hdet z hz))
        have h2 := congrArg (fun M => M i j) h1
        simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using h2
      have hD : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i c * G z c j)
          (∑ c : Fin 3, ((G y)⁻¹ i c • fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z c j) y
            + G y c j • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i c) y)) y := by
        apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
        intro c _
        exact (hAd i c).hasFDerivAt.mul (hGd c j).hasFDerivAt
      have hD0 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ i c * G z c j)
          (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y :=
        (hasFDerivAt_const _ y).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
      have h3 := congrArg (fun L => L (e k)) (hD.unique hD0)
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h3
      refine Eq.trans (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_)) h3
      simp only [partialDeriv]
      ring
    have hGA : ∀ c : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, G y c j * (G y)⁻¹ j l = if c = l then 1 else 0 := by
      intro c
      have h1 : G y * (G y)⁻¹ = 1 :=
        Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hdet y hy))
      have h2 := congrArg (fun M => M c l) h1
      simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using h2
    have e1 : partialDeriv k (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i l) y = ∑ c : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv k (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i c) y * ∑ j : Fin 3, G y c j * (G y)⁻¹ j l := by
      simp only [hGA, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    rw [e1]
    have e2 : ∀ j : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i c) y * G y c j =
        -∑ c : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i c * partialDeriv k (fun z => G z c j) y := by
      intro j
      have := hstar j
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at this
      linarith
    have e20 := e2 0
    have e21 := e2 1
    have e22 := e2 2
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at e20 e21 e22 ⊢
    linear_combination (G y)⁻¹ 0 l * e20 + (G y)⁻¹ 1 l * e21 + (G y)⁻¹ 2 l * e22
  have hpartC : ∀ (u : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u V → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i u) V := by
    intro u hu i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ u) V := hu.fderiv_of_isOpen hV (le_of_eq rfl)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hgiC : ∀ u w : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (gradInnerLoc G u w) V := by
    intro u w hu hw
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (G z)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i u z * partialDeriv j w z) V
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro i _
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro j _
    exact ((hinvC i j).mul (hpartC u hu i)).mul (hpartC w hw j)
  have hlag : ∀ (F : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffAt ℝ 1 b y → ContDiffAt ℝ 1 F y →
      (∀ z ∈ V, b z = b y → F z = F y) → fderiv ℝ b y ≠ 0 →
      ∀ w : E3, fderiv ℝ b y w = 0 → fderiv ℝ F y w = 0 := by
    intro F hb1 hF1 hloc hne w hw
    have hext : IsLocalExtrOn F {z | b z = b y} y := by
      refine Or.inl ?_
      show ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[{z | b z = b y}] y, F y ≤ F z
      filter_upwards [mem_nhdsWithin_of_mem_nhds hVy, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz1 hz2
      exact le_of_eq (hloc z hz1 hz2).symm
    obtain ⟨a, c, hac, hsum⟩ := hext.exists_multipliers_of_hasStrictFDerivAt_1d
      (hb1.hasStrictFDerivAt one_ne_zero) (hF1.hasStrictFDerivAt one_ne_zero)
    have h := congrArg (fun L => L w) hsum
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hw,
      mul_zero, zero_add, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with hc | hc
    · exfalso
      have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
        intro ha
        exact hac (by simp [ha, hc])
      apply hne
      have h5 : a • fderiv ℝ b y = 0 := by simpa [hc] using hsum
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp h5).resolve_left ha
    · exact hc
  have hgiP : ∀ u w : E3 → ℝ, (∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv i u) y) →
      (∀ j : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv j w) y) → ∀ k : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv k (gradInnerLoc G u w) y = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv k (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y * partialDeriv i u y * partialDeriv j w y
          + (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv k (partialDeriv i u) y * partialDeriv j w y
          + (G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i u y * partialDeriv k (partialDeriv j w) y) := by
    intro u w hu hw k
    have hD : HasFDerivAt (gradInnerLoc G u w) (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (((G y)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i u y) • fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv j w) y
          + partialDeriv j w y • ((G y)⁻¹ i j • fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv i u) y
            + partialDeriv i u y • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y))) y := by
      have hfun : gradInnerLoc G u w = fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
          (G z)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i u z * partialDeriv j w z := rfl
      rw [hfun]
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
      intro i _
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
      intro j _
      exact ((hAd i j).hasFDerivAt.mul (hu i).hasFDerivAt).mul (hw j).hasFDerivAt
    rw [show partialDeriv k (gradInnerLoc G u w) y = fderiv ℝ (gradInnerLoc G u w) y (e k)
      from rfl, hD.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    ring
  have hfy : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f y := hf.contDiffAt hVy
  have hsch : ∀ i k : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv k (partialDeriv i f) y = partialDeriv i (partialDeriv k f) y := by
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ f) y :=
      (hfy.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (le_of_eq rfl)).of_le h1inf
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y := h2.differentiableAt one_ne_zero
    have hsym := hfy.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
    have hpp : ∀ i k : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv k (partialDeriv i f) y = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) y (e k) (e i) := by
      intro i k
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e i)) y (e k) = _
      rw [fderiv_clm_apply hd (differentiableAt_const (e i))]
      simp
    intro i k
    rw [hpp, hpp]
    exact hsym _ _
  have hSd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (gradSqLoc G f) y :=
    ((hgiC f f hf hf).contDiffAt hVy).differentiableAt hinf0
  have halg : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (dA D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
      (f1 b1 : Fin 3 → ℝ) (f2 b2 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (P Q : Fin 3 → ℝ),
      (∀ i j, A i j = A j i) →
      (∀ k i j, dA k i j = -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ c : Fin 3, A i a * D k a c * A c j) →
      (∀ k i, f2 k i = f2 i k) →
      (∀ k, P k = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (dA k i j * f1 i * b1 j + A i j * f2 k i * b1 j
        + A i j * f1 i * b2 k j)) →
      (∀ k, Q k = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (dA k i j * f1 i * f1 j + A i j * f2 k i * f1 j
        + A i j * f1 i * f2 k j)) →
      ∑ k : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, A k a * f1 a) * P k =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A k l * Q k * b1 l +
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, A i a * f1 a) * (∑ a : Fin 3, A j a * f1 a) *
          (b2 i j - ∑ m : Fin 3,
            ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, A m l * (D i j l + D j i l - D l i j)) * b1 m) := by
    intro A dA D f1 b1 f2 b2 P Q hA hdA' hf2 hP hQ
    simp only [hP, hQ, hdA']
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hA 1 0, hA 2 0, hA 2 1, hf2 1 0, hf2 2 0, hf2 2 1]
    ring
  have hpfd : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv i f) y := fun i =>
    ((hpartC f hf i).contDiffAt hVy).differentiableAt hinf0
  have hpbd : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv i b) y := fun i =>
    ((hpartC b hb i).contDiffAt hVy).differentiableAt hinf0
  have hb1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 b y := (hb.contDiffAt hVy).of_le h1inf
  have hFd1 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (gradInnerLoc G f b) y :=
    ((hgiC f b hf hb).contDiffAt hVy).of_le h1inf
  have hbne : fderiv ℝ b y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h4 : gradSqLoc G b y = 0 := by
      simp only [gradSqLoc, gradInnerLoc, partialDeriv, h0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,
        mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    linarith
  have hFnz : gradInnerLoc G f b y = 0 := hneuV y hy hby
  have hlin : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ), L (∑ i : Fin 3, gradUpLoc G f y i • e i) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, gradUpLoc G f y i * L (e i) := by
    intro L
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hbw : fderiv ℝ b y (∑ i : Fin 3, gradUpLoc G f y i • e i) = 0 := by
    rw [hlin]
    have h4 : gradInnerLoc G f b y = ∑ i : Fin 3, gradUpLoc G f y i * fderiv ℝ b y (e i) := by
      simp only [gradInnerLoc, gradUpLoc, partialDeriv, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      rw [hAsymG y 1 0, hAsymG y 2 0, hAsymG y 2 1]
      ring
    rw [← h4, hFnz]
  have hFw := hlag (gradInnerLoc G f b) hb1 hFd1
    (fun z hz hbz => by rw [hneuV z hz (hbz.trans hby), hFnz]) hbne _ hbw
  rw [hlin] at hFw
  have hsum0 : ∑ k : Fin 3, gradUpLoc G f y k * partialDeriv k (gradInnerLoc G f b) y = 0 := hFw
  have hmain : ∑ k : Fin 3, gradUpLoc G f y k * partialDeriv k (gradInnerLoc G f b) y =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k (gradSqLoc G f) y * partialDeriv l b y +
      hessGGLoc G b f y :=
    halg (G y)⁻¹ (fun k i j => partialDeriv k (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ i j) y)
      (fun k a c => partialDeriv k (fun z => G z a c) y)
      (fun i => partialDeriv i f y) (fun j => partialDeriv j b y)
      (fun k i => partialDeriv k (partialDeriv i f) y)
      (fun k j => partialDeriv k (partialDeriv j b) y)
      (fun k => partialDeriv k (gradInnerLoc G f b) y)
      (fun k => partialDeriv k (gradSqLoc G f) y)
      (hAsymG y) hdA (fun k i => hsch i k)
      (hgiP f b hpfd hpbd) (hgiP f f hpfd hpfd)
  have hS : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k (gradSqLoc G f) y * partialDeriv l b y =
        -hessGGLoc G b f y := by linarith [hmain, hsum0]
  
  have hD0 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f z))
      ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y))) • fderiv ℝ (gradSqLoc G f) y) y :=
    hSd.hasFDerivAt.sqrt hdf.ne'
  refine ⟨hD0.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
  have hΦP : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f z)) y =
      partialDeriv k (gradSqLoc G f) y / (2 * Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y)) := by
    intro k
    show fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f z)) y (e k) =
      fderiv ℝ (gradSqLoc G f) y (e k) / (2 * Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y))
    rw [hD0.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hgi : gradInnerLoc G b (fun z => Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f z)) y =
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        (G y)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv k (gradSqLoc G f) y * partialDeriv l b y) /
        Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y) := by
    simp only [gradInnerLoc, hΦP, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hAsymG y 1 0, hAsymG y 2 0, hAsymG y 2 1]
    ring
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y) * Real.sqrt (gradSqLoc G f y) = gradSqLoc G f y :=
    Real.mul_self_sqrt hdf.le
  rw [hgi, hS, div_div, hsq, neg_div]

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) (b : E3 → ℝ) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b V) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFV : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ V) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : (∀ x' ∈ W, ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => b (F y)) x' = ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x') * gsTan F c x' k) ∧ (∀ a c : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => pd2 c (fun y => b (F y)) x') x = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, gsTan F a x k * gsTan F c x l * hessLoc G b k l (F x) + ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x) * gsCovHess G F a c x k)

signature.name: edge_hess2_chain
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (V : Set E3) (hV : IsOpen V) (b : E3 → ℝ) (hb : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ b V) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hFV : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ V) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W) : (∀ x' ∈ W, ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => b (F y)) x' = ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x') * gsTan F c x' k) ∧ (∀ a c : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun x' => pd2 c (fun y => b (F y)) x') x = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, gsTan F a x k * gsTan F c x l * hessLoc G b k l (F x) + ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x) * gsCovHess G F a c x k)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hbasis : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ d : Fin 3, v d • e d := by
    intro v
    conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr v]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  
  have s1 : ∀ (φ : E3 → ℝ) (x' : E2), DifferentiableAt ℝ φ (F x') → DifferentiableAt ℝ F x' →
      ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => φ (F y)) x' =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k φ (F x') * gsTan F c x' k := by
    intro φ x' hφ hFd c
    have h1 : pd2 c (fun y => φ (F y)) x' = fderiv ℝ φ (F x') (gsTan F c x') := by
      show fderiv ℝ (φ ∘ F) x' (e2 c) = _
      rw [fderiv_comp x' hφ hFd]
      rfl
    rw [h1]
    conv_lhs => rw [hbasis (gsTan F c x')]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d _
    rw [mul_comm]
    rfl
  have hFd : ∀ x' ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x' := fun x' hx' =>
    (hF.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx')).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hbd : ∀ x' ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ b (F x') := fun x' hx' =>
    (hb.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hFV x' hx'))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have C1 : ∀ x' ∈ W, ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => b (F y)) x' =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k b (F x') * gsTan F c x' k :=
    fun x' hx' c => s1 b x' (hbd x' hx') (hFd x' hx') c
  
  have hbfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ b) V :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hV).mp hb).2
  have s2 : ∀ l : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv l b) V := by
    intro l
    have h : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ b y (e l)) V := hbfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact h
  
  have hFfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) W :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW).mp hF).2
  have hTd : ∀ c : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 c)) x := fun c =>
    ((hFfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const).contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hcomp3 : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (l : Fin 3), (fun x' => gsTan F c x' l) =
      (EuclideanSpace.proj l : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) ∘ (fun y => fderiv ℝ F y (e2 c)) := by
    intro c l
    funext y
    simp [gsTan]
  have s3d : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (l : Fin 3), DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => gsTan F c x' l) x := by
    intro c l
    rw [hcomp3 c l]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj l : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt.comp x (hTd c)
  have s3e : ∀ (a c : Fin 2) (l : Fin 3),
      fderiv ℝ (fun x' => gsTan F c x' l) x (e2 a) = gsHessF F a c x l := by
    intro a c l
    rw [hcomp3 c l, fderiv_comp x (EuclideanSpace.proj l : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt (hTd c),
      ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    simp [gsHessF]
  refine ⟨C1, fun a c => ?_⟩
  have hev : (fun x' => pd2 c (fun y => b (F y)) x') =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun x' => ∑ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l b (F x') * gsTan F c x' l) :=
    Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun x' hx' => C1 x' hx' c)
  have hpbd : ∀ l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv l b) (F x) := fun l =>
    ((s2 l).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hFV x hx))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hAd : ∀ l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => partialDeriv l b (F x')) x := fun l =>
    (hpbd l).comp x (hFd x hx)
  have hAe : ∀ l : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => partialDeriv l b (F x')) x (e2 a) =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l b) (F x) * gsTan F a x k := fun l =>
    s1 (partialDeriv l b) x (hpbd l) (hFd x hx) a
  have hL : pd2 a (fun x' => pd2 c (fun y => b (F y)) x') x =
      fderiv ℝ (fun x' => ∑ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l b (F x') * gsTan F c x' l) x (e2 a) := by
    show fderiv ℝ (fun x' => pd2 c (fun y => b (F y)) x') x (e2 a) = _
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hprod : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => ∑ l : Fin 3, partialDeriv l b (F x') * gsTan F c x' l) x (e2 a)
      = ∑ l : Fin 3, (partialDeriv l b (F x) * gsHessF F a c x l +
          gsTan F c x l * ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (partialDeriv l b) (F x) * gsTan F a x k) := by
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
      (A := fun l x' => partialDeriv l b (F x') * gsTan F c x' l)
      (fun l _ => (hAd l).mul (s3d c l))]
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l _
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hAd l) (s3d c l)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [s3e a c l, hAe l]
  rw [hL, hprod]
  simp only [hessLoc, gsCovHess, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hdet : (G (F x)).det ≠ 0) (α γ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a c : Fin 2) (hkos : ∀ m : Fin 2, ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) m a c x = ∑ a' : Fin 3, ∑ b' : Fin 3, gsTan F m x a' * G (F x) a' b' * gsCovHess G F a c x b') (hsplit : ∀ p q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * p i * q j = ∑ a₁ : Fin 2, ∑ c₁ : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a₁ c₁ * (∑ k : Fin 3, p k * gsTan F a₁ x k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, q k * gsTan F c₁ x k) + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * p j) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * q j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * α j)) (hαγ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * γ j = 0) : ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * gsCovHess G F a c x k = ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) m a c x * ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * gsTan F m x k

signature.name: edge_tangential_proj
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2) (hdet : (G (F x)).det ≠ 0) (α γ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (a c : Fin 2) (hkos : ∀ m : Fin 2, ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) m a c x = ∑ a' : Fin 3, ∑ b' : Fin 3, gsTan F m x a' * G (F x) a' b' * gsCovHess G F a c x b') (hsplit : ∀ p q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * p i * q j = ∑ a₁ : Fin 2, ∑ c₁ : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ a₁ c₁ * (∑ k : Fin 3, p k * gsTan F a₁ x k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, q k * gsTan F c₁ x k) + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * p j) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * q j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * α j)) (hαγ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * α i * γ j = 0) : ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * gsCovHess G F a c x k = ∑ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) m a c x * ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * gsTan F m x k

proof.tactics:
by
  have hinv : (G (F x))⁻¹ * G (F x) = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (Ne.isUnit hdet)
  have hent : ∀ i l : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * G (F x) j l =
      if i = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
    intro i l
    have h1 := congrFun (congrFun hinv i) l
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h1
    exact h1
  have hchr : ∀ m : Fin 2, christoffel2 (pullMetric2 G F) m a c x =
      ∑ l : Fin 2, (pullMetric2 G F x)⁻¹ m l * ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) l a c x := by
    intro m
    simp only [christoffel2, ggeGam1, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by ring)
  have htan : ∀ c₁ : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 3,
      (∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) k l * gsCovHess G F a c x l) * gsTan F c₁ x k =
        ggeGam1 (pullMetric2 G F) c₁ a c x := by
    intro c₁
    rw [hkos c₁]
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by ring))
  have hlhs : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * γ i *
      (∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) j l * gsCovHess G F a c x l) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * gsCovHess G F a c x k := by
    calc _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, γ i * (∑ j : Fin 3, (G (F x))⁻¹ i j * G (F x) j l) *
          gsCovHess G F a c x l := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three]
          ring
      _ = _ := by
          simp only [hent, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
            Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have e := hsplit γ (fun j => ∑ l : Fin 3, G (F x) j l * gsCovHess G F a c x l)
  beta_reduce at e
  rw [hαγ, zero_mul, zero_div, add_zero, hlhs] at e
  simp only [htan] at e
  rw [e]
  simp only [hchr, Finset.sum_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => by ring))

informal_problem.statement: (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hAinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j = A⁻¹ j i) (hm : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (α γ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hsplit : ∀ p q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * p i * q j = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 3, p k * T a k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, q k * T c k) + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * p j) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * q j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * α j)) (hαγ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * γ j = 0) : (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T a k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T c k) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * γ i * γ j) ∧ (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, T a k * T c l * H k l) - (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (∑ d : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a d * ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T d k) * (∑ d : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ c d * ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T d k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, T a k * T c l * H k l)) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * γ i * γ j) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * H i j - (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i m * γ m) * (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ j m * γ m) * H i j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * γ i * γ j) - (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i m * α m) * (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ j m * α m) * H i j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * α j))

signature.name: edge_trace_linalg
signature.statement: (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hAinv : ∀ i j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j = A⁻¹ j i) (hm : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (α γ : Fin 3 → ℝ) (H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hsplit : ∀ p q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * p i * q j = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 3, p k * T a k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, q k * T c k) + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * p j) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * q j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * α j)) (hαγ : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * γ j = 0) : (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T a k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T c k) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * γ i * γ j) ∧ (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, T a k * T c l * H k l) - (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (∑ d : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a d * ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T d k) * (∑ d : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ c d * ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T d k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, T a k * T c l * H k l)) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * γ i * γ j) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * H i j - (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i m * γ m) * (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ j m * γ m) * H i j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * γ i * γ j) - (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i m * α m) * (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ j m * α m) * H i j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * α j))

proof.tactics:
by
  have s1 : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T a k) *
      (∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T c k) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * γ i * γ j := by
    have h := hsplit γ γ
    rw [hαγ, zero_mul, zero_div, add_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  have s2 : ∀ k : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ k m * γ m =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, (∑ d : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a d * ∑ l : Fin 3, γ l * T d l) * T a k := by
    intro k
    have h := hsplit (Pi.single k 1) γ
    rw [hαγ, mul_zero, zero_div, add_zero] at h
    simp only [Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, ite_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_mul, one_mul,
      Finset.sum_ite_irrel, Finset.sum_const_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.sum_ite_eq,
      Finset.mem_univ, if_true] at h
    rw [h]
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => ?_))
    ring
  have s3 : ∀ i j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a c * T a i * T c j +
      (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ m i * α m) * (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ m j * α m) /
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * α j) := by
    intro i j
    have h := hsplit (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)
    simp only [Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, ite_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, zero_mul, one_mul,
      Finset.sum_ite_irrel, Finset.sum_const_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.sum_ite_eq,
      Finset.mem_univ, if_true] at h
    rw [h]
  have hw : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i m * α m = ∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ m i * α m := by
    intro i
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => by rw [hAinv i m])
  have s4 : ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * H i j -
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i m * α m) * (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ j m * α m) *
        H i j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * α j) =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, T a k * T c l * H k l) := by
    simp only [hw]
    have e : ∀ i j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * H i j =
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a c * T a i * T c j) * H i j +
        (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ m i * α m) * (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ m j * α m) * H i j /
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * α j) := by
      intro i j
      rw [s3 i j]
      ring
    simp only [e]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have s5 : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (∑ d : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ a d * ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T d k) *
      (∑ d : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ c d * ∑ k : Fin 3, γ k * T d k) *
      (∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, T a k * T c l * H k l) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i m * γ m) * (∑ m : Fin 3, A⁻¹ j m * γ m) *
        H i j := by
    simp only [s2]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  refine ⟨s1, ?_⟩
  rw [s5]
  linarith [s4]

informal_problem.statement: (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hAs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, A i j = A j i) (hA : A.PosDef) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hT : ∀ c : Fin 2 → ℝ, (∀ k : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 2, c a * T a k = 0) → c = 0) (α : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hαT : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 3, α k * T a k = 0) (hα : α ≠ 0) : ∀ p q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * p i * q j = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (Matrix.of fun a' c' : Fin 2 => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, T a' k * A k l * T c' l)⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 3, p k * T a k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, q k * T c k) + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * p j) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * q j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * α j)

signature.name: edge_dual_split
signature.statement: (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hAs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, A i j = A j i) (hA : A.PosDef) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hT : ∀ c : Fin 2 → ℝ, (∀ k : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 2, c a * T a k = 0) → c = 0) (α : Fin 3 → ℝ) (hαT : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 3, α k * T a k = 0) (hα : α ≠ 0) : ∀ p q : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * p i * q j = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (Matrix.of fun a' c' : Fin 2 => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, T a' k * A k l * T c' l)⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 3, p k * T a k) * (∑ k : Fin 3, q k * T c k) + (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * p j) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * q j) / (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * α j)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  intro p q
  
  have hAu : IsUnit A.det := (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det A).mp hA.isUnit
  have hAB : A * A⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A hAu
  have hBA : A⁻¹ * A = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A hAu
  have hAT : Matrix.transpose A = A := by
    ext i j
    exact hAs j i
  have hBT : Matrix.transpose (A⁻¹) = A⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, hAT]
  have hBs : ∀ i j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j = A⁻¹ j i := fun i j => congrFun (congrFun hBT j) i
  
  have hκpos : 0 < ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * α j := by
    have h := hA.inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hα
    convert h using 1
    simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  
  generalize hH : (Matrix.of fun a' c' : Fin 2 => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, T a' k * A k l * T c' l) = H
  have hHe : ∀ a c : Fin 2, H a c = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, T a k * A k l * T c l := by
    intro a c
    rw [← hH]
    rfl
  have hHdet : H.det ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    obtain ⟨c, hc0, hc⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr h0
    have hc' : ∀ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, H a b * c b = 0 := fun a => congrFun hc a
    by_cases hv0 : (fun k : Fin 3 => ∑ a : Fin 2, c a * T a k) = 0
    · exact hc0 (hT c (fun k => congrFun hv0 k))
    · have hpos := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0
      have hlt : (0 : ℝ) < c 0 * (∑ b : Fin 2, H 0 b * c b) + c 1 * (∑ b : Fin 2, H 1 b * c b) := by
        convert hpos using 1
        simp only [hHe, star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two,
          Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      rw [hc' 0, hc' 1] at hlt
      simp at hlt
  have hHM : H * H⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv H (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hHdet)
  have hHMe : ∀ b c : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, H b a * H⁻¹ a c = (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) b c := by
    intro b c
    rw [← Matrix.mul_apply, hHM]
  
  obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ : ∃ ν : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ j, ν j = ∑ i : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i :=
    ⟨fun j => ∑ i : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i, fun j => rfl⟩
  have hνv : ν = A⁻¹.mulVec α := by
    funext j
    rw [hν j]
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [hBs 0 j, hBs 1 j, hBs 2 j]
  have hAν : ∀ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3, A k l * ν l = α k := by
    intro k
    have h1 : A.mulVec (A⁻¹.mulVec α) = α := by
      rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hAB, Matrix.one_mulVec]
    rw [hνv]
    exact congrFun h1 k
  have hAν' : ∀ l : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, A k l * ν k = α l := by
    intro l
    rw [← hAν l]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => by rw [hAs k l])
  have hxν : ∀ x : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * α i * x j = ∑ j : Fin 3, ν j * x j := by
    intro x
    simp only [hν, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hκν0 : ∑ k : Fin 3, ν k * α k ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hxν α]
    exact ne_of_gt hκpos
  
  have hind : ∀ d : Fin 3 → ℝ, (∀ a : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 3, d k * T a k = 0) →
      ∑ k : Fin 3, d k * ν k = 0 → d = 0 := by
    intro d hdT hdν
    have hN : (Matrix.of ![T 0, T 1, ν]).det ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      obtain ⟨c, hc0, hc⟩ := Matrix.exists_vecMul_eq_zero_iff.mpr h0
      have hk : ∀ k : Fin 3, c 0 * T 0 k + c 1 * T 1 k + c 2 * ν k = 0 := by
        intro k
        have := congrFun hc k
        simpa [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three] using this
      have h2 : c 2 = 0 := by
        have hαT0 := hαT 0
        have hαT1 := hαT 1
        have hk0 := hk 0
        have hk1 := hk 1
        have hk2 := hk 2
        have hκ := hκν0
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hαT0 hαT1 hκ
        have : c 2 * (ν 0 * α 0 + ν 1 * α 1 + ν 2 * α 2) = 0 := by
          linear_combination α 0 * hk0 + α 1 * hk1 + α 2 * hk2 - c 0 * hαT0 - c 1 * hαT1
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hκ
      have h01 : ![c 0, c 1] = 0 := hT _ (by
        intro k
        have := hk k
        rw [h2, zero_mul, add_zero] at this
        simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two] using this)
      apply hc0
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · simpa using congrFun h01 0
      · simpa using congrFun h01 1
      · simpa using h2
    by_contra hd
    apply hN
    apply Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mp
    refine ⟨d, hd, ?_⟩
    have h0 := hdT 0
    have h1 := hdT 1
    have h2 := hdν
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0 h1 h2
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination h0
    · simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination h1
    · simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination h2
  
  rw [hxν p, hxν q, hxν α]
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : ℝ, w = ∑ j : Fin 3, ν j * q j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨κ, hk⟩ : ∃ κ : ℝ, κ = ∑ j : Fin 3, ν j * α j := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hw, ← hk]
  have hκ0 : κ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hk]
    exact hκν0
  have hwk : w / κ * κ = w := div_mul_cancel₀ w hκ0
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : Fin 3 → ℝ, ∀ i, P i = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
      H⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 3, q k * T c k) * T a i + w / κ * ν i := ⟨_, fun i => rfl⟩
  have hP0 := hP 0
  have hP1 := hP 1
  have hP2 := hP 2
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three] at hP0 hP1 hP2 hw hk
  
  have hAP : A.mulVec P = q := by
    have hd := hind (A.mulVec P - q) ?_ ?_
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hd
    · intro b
      have h0 := hHMe b 0
      have h1 := hHMe b 1
      have hA0 := hAν 0
      have hA1 := hAν 1
      have hA2 := hAν 2
      have hαb := hαT b
      simp only [hHe, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three] at h0 h1 hA0 hA1 hA2 hαb
      have hs : (q 0 * T 0 0 + q 1 * T 0 1 + q 2 * T 0 2) * (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) b 0 +
          (q 0 * T 1 0 + q 1 * T 1 1 + q 2 * T 1 2) * (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) b 1 =
          q 0 * T b 0 + q 1 * T b 1 + q 2 * T b 2 := by
        fin_cases b <;> simp [Matrix.one_apply]
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination (T b 0 * A 0 0 + T b 1 * A 1 0 + T b 2 * A 2 0) * hP0 +
        (T b 0 * A 0 1 + T b 1 * A 1 1 + T b 2 * A 2 1) * hP1 +
        (T b 0 * A 0 2 + T b 1 * A 1 2 + T b 2 * A 2 2) * hP2 +
        (q 0 * T 0 0 + q 1 * T 0 1 + q 2 * T 0 2) * h0 +
        (q 0 * T 1 0 + q 1 * T 1 1 + q 2 * T 1 2) * h1 +
        w / κ * (T b 0 * hA0 + T b 1 * hA1 + T b 2 * hA2) + w / κ * hαb + hs
    · have hB0 := hAν' 0
      have hB1 := hAν' 1
      have hB2 := hAν' 2
      have hα0 := hαT 0
      have hα1 := hαT 1
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hB0 hB1 hB2 hα0 hα1
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
      linear_combination P 0 * hB0 + P 1 * hB1 + P 2 * hB2 + α 0 * hP0 + α 1 * hP1 + α 2 * hP2 +
        (H⁻¹ 0 0 * (q 0 * T 0 0 + q 1 * T 0 1 + q 2 * T 0 2) +
          H⁻¹ 0 1 * (q 0 * T 1 0 + q 1 * T 1 1 + q 2 * T 1 2)) * hα0 +
        (H⁻¹ 1 0 * (q 0 * T 0 0 + q 1 * T 0 1 + q 2 * T 0 2) +
          H⁻¹ 1 1 * (q 0 * T 1 0 + q 1 * T 1 1 + q 2 * T 1 2)) * hα1 -
        w / κ * hk + hwk + hw
  
  have hBq' : A⁻¹.mulVec q = P := by
    rw [← hAP, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hBA, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  have hBq : ∀ i, ∑ j : Fin 3, A⁻¹ i j * q j = P i := fun i => congrFun hBq' i
  have hq0 := hBq 0
  have hq1 := hBq 1
  have hq2 := hBq 2
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hq0 hq1 hq2
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  linear_combination p 0 * hq0 + p 1 * hq1 + p 2 * hq2 + p 0 * hP0 + p 1 * hP1 + p 2 * hP2

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (G : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), 0 < G.det →
    ∀ (a b ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ), ξ ≠ 0 → ∑ k, ξ k * a k = 0 → ∑ k, ξ k * b k = 0 →
    Real.sqrt G.det * Real.sqrt (∑ i, ∑ j, G⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) / Real.sqrt (∑ k, ξ k ^ 2) *
        Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, (![a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1, a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2,
          a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) k ^ 2) =
      Real.sqrt ((∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * a l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * b l) -
        (∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * b l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * a l))

signature.name: slice_cofactor_identity
signature.statement:
∀ (G : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), 0 < G.det →
    ∀ (a b ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ), ξ ≠ 0 → ∑ k, ξ k * a k = 0 → ∑ k, ξ k * b k = 0 →
    Real.sqrt G.det * Real.sqrt (∑ i, ∑ j, G⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) / Real.sqrt (∑ k, ξ k ^ 2) *
        Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, (![a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1, a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2,
          a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) k ^ 2) =
      Real.sqrt ((∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * a l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * b l) -
        (∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * b l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * a l))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro G hD a b ξ hξ ha hb
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three] at ha hb
  
  have hN : 0 < ∑ k, ξ k ^ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hξ
    have hm' : ξ m ≠ 0 := by simpa using hm
    exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)
      ⟨m, Finset.mem_univ _, lt_of_le_of_ne (sq_nonneg _) (Ne.symm (pow_ne_zero 2 hm'))⟩
  have hN3 : ∑ k, ξ k ^ 2 = ξ 0 ^ 2 + ξ 1 ^ 2 + ξ 2 ^ 2 := Fin.sum_univ_three _
  have hN' : 0 < ξ 0 ^ 2 + ξ 1 ^ 2 + ξ 2 ^ 2 := hN3 ▸ hN
  
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ : ∃ μ : ℝ, μ = (ξ 0 * (a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1) + ξ 1 * (a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2) +
      ξ 2 * (a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0)) / (ξ 0 ^ 2 + ξ 1 ^ 2 + ξ 2 ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hv0 : a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1 = μ * ξ 0 := by
    rw [hμ, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hN'.ne']
    linear_combination (ξ 1 * b 2 - ξ 2 * b 1) * ha - (ξ 1 * a 2 - ξ 2 * a 1) * hb
  have hv1 : a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2 = μ * ξ 1 := by
    rw [hμ, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hN'.ne']
    linear_combination (ξ 2 * b 0 - ξ 0 * b 2) * ha - (ξ 2 * a 0 - ξ 0 * a 2) * hb
  have hv2 : a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0 = μ * ξ 2 := by
    rw [hμ, div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hN'.ne']
    linear_combination (ξ 0 * b 1 - ξ 1 * b 0) * ha - (ξ 0 * a 1 - ξ 1 * a 0) * hb
  have hw : (![a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1, a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2,
      a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) = fun k => μ * ξ k := by
    ext k
    fin_cases k
    · exact hv0
    · exact hv1
    · exact hv2
  
  have hgram : (∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * a l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * b l) -
      (∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * b l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * a l) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, G.adjugate i j * (![a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1, a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2,
        a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) i * (![a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1, a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2,
        a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) j := by
    rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
    ring
  rw [hw] at hgram
  have hinv : ∀ i j, G⁻¹ i j = G.det⁻¹ * G.adjugate i j := by
    intro i j
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
  have hQ : ∑ i, ∑ j, G⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j =
      G.det⁻¹ * ∑ i, ∑ j, G.adjugate i j * ξ i * ξ j := by
    simp only [hinv, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hS : ∑ i, ∑ j, G.adjugate i j * (fun k => μ * ξ k) i * (fun k => μ * ξ k) j =
      μ ^ 2 * ∑ i, ∑ j, G.adjugate i j * ξ i * ξ j := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hDD : G.det * G.det⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hD.ne'
  have hG : (∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * a l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * b l) -
      (∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * b l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * a l) =
      G.det * (μ ^ 2 * ∑ i, ∑ j, G⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) := by
    rw [hgram, hS, hQ]
    linear_combination (-(μ ^ 2) * ∑ i, ∑ j, G.adjugate i j * ξ i * ξ j) * hDD
  have hsum : ∑ k : Fin 3, (fun k => μ * ξ k) k ^ 2 = μ ^ 2 * ∑ k, ξ k ^ 2 := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hNs : Real.sqrt (∑ k, ξ k ^ 2) ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hN).ne'
  rw [hw, hsum, hG, Real.sqrt_mul hD.le, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg μ),
    Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg μ), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  field_simp

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hcof : ∀ (G : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), 0 < G.det →
      ∀ (a b ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ), ξ ≠ 0 → ∑ k, ξ k * a k = 0 → ∑ k, ξ k * b k = 0 →
      Real.sqrt G.det * Real.sqrt (∑ i, ∑ j, G⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) / Real.sqrt (∑ k, ξ k ^ 2) *
          Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, (![a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1, a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2,
            a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) k ^ 2) =
        Real.sqrt ((∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * a l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * b l) -
          (∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * b l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * a l)))
    (p : M) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W)
    (hFt : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) (c : ℝ)
    (hlev : ∀ x ∈ W, u ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) = c) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W)
    (hdu : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) ≠ 0) :
    sbgbAreaDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x) *
        Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) =
      sbgbAreaConst * Real.sqrt (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) F x).det

signature.name: slice_area_density_identity
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hcof : ∀ (G : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ), 0 < G.det →
      ∀ (a b ξ : Fin 3 → ℝ), ξ ≠ 0 → ∑ k, ξ k * a k = 0 → ∑ k, ξ k * b k = 0 →
      Real.sqrt G.det * Real.sqrt (∑ i, ∑ j, G⁻¹ i j * ξ i * ξ j) / Real.sqrt (∑ k, ξ k ^ 2) *
          Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, (![a 1 * b 2 - a 2 * b 1, a 2 * b 0 - a 0 * b 2,
            a 0 * b 1 - a 1 * b 0] : Fin 3 → ℝ) k ^ 2) =
        Real.sqrt ((∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * a l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * b l) -
          (∑ k, ∑ l, a k * G k l * b l) * (∑ k, ∑ l, b k * G k l * a l)))
    (p : M) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W)
    (hFt : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) (c : ℝ)
    (hlev : ∀ x ∈ W, u ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) = c) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ W)
    (hdu : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) ≠ 0) :
    sbgbAreaDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x) *
        Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) =
      sbgbAreaConst * Real.sqrt (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) F x).det

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hy : F x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := hFt x hx
  have hq : (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x) ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := (chartAt E3 p).map_target hy
  have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hy
  have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 p) hq
  
  have hG : (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)).PosDef := by
    have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) (F x) =
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x))).comp
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) := mfderiv_comp (F x) hg hf
    have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 p) ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) (F x) =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id (F x) := by
      apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_right_inverse hy] with z hz
      exact hz
    rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
    have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x) w) = w := by
      intro w
      have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
      simpa using h1
    have hDinj : ∀ w : E3,
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x) w = 0 → w = 0 := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    · intro v hv0
      have hvx : (∑ i, v i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hv0
        funext j
        have h1 := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w j) h0
        fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
      have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
      have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) _ hDv
      have key : star v ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)).mulVec v =
          g.g ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x) (∑ i, v i • e i : E3))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x) (∑ i, v i • e i : E3)) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
          ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
          RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hpos
  
  have hux : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) :=
    hu.mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
  have hfc : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (u ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) (F x) :=
    MDifferentiableAt.comp (F x) hux hf
  have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.mp hfc
  have hκx : (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) = F x := (chartAt E3 p).right_inv hy
  have hfc' : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) (u ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm)
      ((chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x))) := by
    rw [hκx]; exact hfc
  have hloc : ((u ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) ∘ (chartAt E3 p)) =ᶠ[𝓝 ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x))] u := by
    filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p).eventually_left_inverse hq] with z hz
    simp [Function.comp, hz]
  have hchain0 := mfderiv_comp ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) hfc' hg
  rw [hloc.mfderiv_eq, hκx, mfderiv_eq_fderiv] at hchain0
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x :=
    (hF.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have hexp : ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x) v =
      ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x) * v k := by
    intro v
    have hv := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr v
    simp only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr] at hv
    conv_lhs => rw [← hv]
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    rfl
  
  have horth : ∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv k (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x) * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) k = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hev : ((fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) ∘ F) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => c) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun x' hx' => hlev x' hx')
    have h0 : fderiv ℝ ((fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) ∘ F) x = 0 := by
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]; exact fderiv_const_apply c
    rw [fderiv_comp x hfd hFd] at h0
    have h1 := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e2 i)) h0
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h1
    rw [← hexp]; exact h1
  
  have hnorm : ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x)‖ =
      Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x) ^ 2) := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E3).surjective
      (fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x))
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x) = v k := by
      intro k
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x) (e k) = v k
      rw [← hv, InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
      simp
    rw [← hv, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    rw [hk, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hdet : 0 < (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)).det := hG.det_pos
  have hξ : (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hz : ∀ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv k (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x) = 0 :=
      fun k => congrFun h0 k
    apply hdu
    rw [hchain0]
    have hz0 : fderiv ℝ (u ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) (F x) = 0 := by
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
      have := hexp v
      simp only [hz, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero] at this
      exact this
    rw [hz0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp]
  have H := hcof (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) hdet
    (fun k => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 0)) k) (fun k => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1)) k)
    (fun k : Fin 3 => partialDeriv k (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x)) hξ
    (horth 0) (horth 1)
  beta_reduce at H
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]
  simp only [sbgbAreaDens, gradSqLoc, gradInnerLoc, gsCrossN, gsTan, pullMetric2]
  rw [hnorm]
  linear_combination sbgbAreaConst * H

informal_problem.statement:
(F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hinj : Set.InjOn F W)
    (hdF : ∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x))
    (W' : Set E2) (hW' : MeasurableSet W') (hW'W : W' ⊆ W) (h : E3 → ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn h (F '' W') (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) ↔
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => h (F x) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2))
        W'

signature.name: sbgb_area_integrableOn_iff
signature.statement:
(F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W) (hinj : Set.InjOn F W)
    (hdF : ∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x))
    (W' : Set E2) (hW' : MeasurableSet W') (hW'W : W' ⊆ W) (h : E3 → ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn h (F '' W') (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) ↔
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => h (F x) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2))
        W'

proof.tactics:
by
  have hspec := sbgb_area_const_spec
  have hc : 0 < sbgbAreaConst := hspec.1
  have hlin := sbgb_linear_area hspec
  have hloc := fun x₀ hx₀ ε hε hε1 =>
    sbgb_local_compare hlin F W hW hF hdF x₀ hx₀ ε hε hε1
  have hmeas : ∀ T : Set E2, MeasurableSet T → T ⊆ W →
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (F '' T) =
        ∫⁻ x in T, ENNReal.ofReal
          (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2)) :=
    fun T hT hTW => sbgb_measure_form hc F W hW hinj hF.continuousOn hloc T hT hTW
  set ρ : E2 → ℝ := fun x => sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2)
    with hρdef
  have hρnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x := fun x => mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have htan : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (j : Fin 3), Measurable (fun x => gsTan F i x j) := by
    intro i j
    have h1 : Measurable (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x (e2 i)) := measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ F _
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.measurable.comp h1
  have hρm : Measurable ρ := by
    have hsum : Measurable (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) := by
      have e1 : (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) = fun x =>
          (gsTan F 0 x 1 * gsTan F 1 x 2 - gsTan F 0 x 2 * gsTan F 1 x 1) ^ 2 +
          (gsTan F 0 x 2 * gsTan F 1 x 0 - gsTan F 0 x 0 * gsTan F 1 x 2) ^ 2 +
          (gsTan F 0 x 0 * gsTan F 1 x 1 - gsTan F 0 x 1 * gsTan F 1 x 0) ^ 2 := by
        funext x
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, gsCrossN]
      rw [e1]
      have a01 := htan 0 1; have a02 := htan 0 2; have a00 := htan 0 0
      have b01 := htan 1 1; have b02 := htan 1 2; have b00 := htan 1 0
      exact ((((a01.mul b02).sub (a02.mul b01)).pow_const 2).add
        (((a02.mul b00).sub (a00.mul b02)).pow_const 2)).add
        (((a00.mul b01).sub (a01.mul b00)).pow_const 2)
    exact measurable_const.mul hsum.sqrt
  have he : MeasurableEmbedding (W'.restrict F) :=
    ContinuousOn.measurableEmbedding hW' (hF.continuousOn.mono hW'W) (hinj.mono hW'W)
  set μ' : MeasureTheory.Measure W' := MeasureTheory.Measure.comap Subtype.val MeasureTheory.volume
    with hμ'
  set f : W' → NNReal := fun x => (ρ x).toNNReal with hfdef
  have hf : Measurable f := (hρm.comp measurable_subtype_coe).real_toNNReal
  have key : MeasureTheory.Measure.map (W'.restrict F) (μ'.withDensity (fun x => (f x : ENNReal))) =
      (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)).restrict (F '' W') := by
    ext B hB
    rw [he.map_apply, MeasureTheory.withDensity_apply _ (he.measurable hB),
      MeasureTheory.Measure.restrict_apply hB]
    have hT : Subtype.val '' ((W'.restrict F) ⁻¹' B) = W' ∩ F ⁻¹' B := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨y.2, hy⟩
      · rintro ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
        exact ⟨⟨x, hx1⟩, hx2, rfl⟩
    have hTm : MeasurableSet (W' ∩ F ⁻¹' B) := by
      rw [← hT]
      exact (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe hW').measurableSet_image' (he.measurable hB)
    have h1 : ∫⁻ x in (W'.restrict F) ⁻¹' B, (f x : ENNReal) ∂μ' =
        ∫⁻ x in (W'.restrict F) ⁻¹' B, (fun y : E2 => ENNReal.ofReal (ρ y)) (x : E2) ∂μ' := rfl
    rw [h1, hμ', MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_subtype hW' _ (fun y : E2 => ENNReal.ofReal (ρ y)), hT,
      ← hmeas (W' ∩ F ⁻¹' B) hTm (Set.inter_subset_left.trans hW'W),
      Set.image_inter_preimage, Set.inter_comm]
  have hpt : (fun x : W' => f x • h (W'.restrict F x)) =
      (fun y : E2 => ρ y * h (F y)) ∘ Subtype.val := by
    funext x
    simp only [hfdef, NNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, Real.coe_toNNReal _ (hρnn x),
      Set.restrict_apply, Function.comp]
  have hfun : (fun y : E2 => ρ y * h (F y)) =
      fun y => sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * (h (F y) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F y k ^ 2)) := by
    funext y
    simp only [hρdef]
    ring
  have hunit : IsUnit (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (inv_ne_zero hc.ne')
  calc MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn h (F '' W') (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ))
      ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable h (MeasureTheory.Measure.map (W'.restrict F)
          (μ'.withDensity (fun x => (f x : ENNReal)))) := by
        rw [key]; rfl
    _ ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable (h ∘ W'.restrict F)
          (μ'.withDensity (fun x => (f x : ENNReal))) := he.integrable_map_iff
    _ ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x : W' => f x • h (W'.restrict F x)) μ' :=
        MeasureTheory.integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul hf
    _ ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable ((fun y : E2 => ρ y * h (F y)) ∘ Subtype.val) μ' := by
        rw [hpt]
    _ ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y : E2 => ρ y * h (F y)) W' :=
        (MeasureTheory.integrableOn_iff_comap_subtypeVal hW').symm
    _ ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun x => h (F x) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2)) W' := by
        rw [hfun]
        exact MeasureTheory.integrable_const_mul_iff hunit _
  exact Iff.rfl

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hspec : 0 < sbgbAreaConst ∧ ∀ S : Set E2,
      ENNReal.ofReal sbgbAreaConst * MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) S =
        MeasureTheory.volume S)
    (A : E2 →L[ℝ] E3) (hA : Function.Injective A) (S : Set E2) :
    MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (A '' S) =

subgoal_signatures.name: sbgb_local_compare
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hlin : ∀ (A : E2 →L[ℝ] E3), Function.Injective A → ∀ S : Set E2,
      MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (A '' S) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN (⇑A) 0 k ^ 2)) *
          MeasureTheory.volume S)
    (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W)
    (hdF : ∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x))
    (x₀ : E2) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ W) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ W ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r,
        (1 - ε) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2) ≤
            Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) ∧
          Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) ≤
            (1 + ε) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2)) ∧
      ∀ S : Set E2, S ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r →
        MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (F '' S) ≤
            ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) ^ 2) *
              (ENNReal.ofReal (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2)) *
                MeasureTheory.volume S) ∧
          ENNReal.ofReal (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2)) *
              MeasureTheory.volume S ≤
            ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε)⁻¹ ^ 2) *
              MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (F '' S)

subgoal_signatures.name: sbgb_measure_form
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(hc : 0 < sbgbAreaConst) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn F W) (hFc : ContinuousOn F W)
    (hloc : ∀ x₀ ∈ W, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 →
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ W ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r,
          (1 - ε) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2) ≤
              Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) ∧
            Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) ≤
              (1 + ε) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2)) ∧
        ∀ S : Set E2, S ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r →
          MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (F '' S) ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ε) ^ 2) *
                (ENNReal.ofReal (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2)) *
                  MeasureTheory.volume S) ∧
            ENNReal.ofReal (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x₀ k ^ 2)) *
                MeasureTheory.volume S ≤
              ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - ε)⁻¹ ^ 2) *
                MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (F '' S))
    (T : Set E2) (hT : MeasurableSet T) (hTW : T ⊆ W) :
    MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ) (F '' T) =
      ∫⁻ x in T, ENNReal.ofReal (sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2))

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, h12, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, h21, -⟩ := hgood
  
  have hS : ∀ x ∈ P.W i, P.param i x ∈ S := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : P.param i x ∈ P.param i '' P.W i := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx
    rw [P.image_eq i] at h1
    exact h1.2
  have hreg : ∀ x ∈ P.W i, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u (P.param i x) ≠ 0 :=
    fun x hx => (h12 _ (hS x hx)).2
  
  have hpos : ∀ p : M, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0 → 0 < g.gradInner u u p := by
    intro p hp
    have hy : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := mem_chart_target E3 p
    have hsy : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p :=
      (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
    have hd : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hsy]; exact hp
    exact chart_Nsq_pos g u hu p (chartAt E3 p p) hy hd
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt
    intro x₀ hx₀
    obtain ⟨-, -, hUo, hN⟩ := stern_phi_chart_reps g u hu 1 one_pos (P.param i x₀)
    set κ := chartAt E3 (P.param i x₀) with hκ
    set U : Set M := {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0} with hUdef
    have hVo : IsOpen (P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' κ.source) :=
      (P.param_cont i).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open i) κ.open_source
    have hx₀V : x₀ ∈ P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' κ.source := ⟨hx₀, mem_chart_source E3 _⟩
    have hψ : ContinuousOn (fun x => κ (P.param i x)) (P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' κ.source) :=
      κ.continuousOn.comp ((P.param_cont i).mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun x hx => hx.2)
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun x => κ (P.param i x)) (P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' κ.source)
        {y | y ∈ κ.target ∧ κ.symm y ∈ U} := by
      intro x hx
      refine ⟨κ.map_source hx.2, ?_⟩
      show κ.symm (κ (P.param i x)) ∈ U
      rw [κ.left_inv hx.2]
      exact hreg x hx.1
    have hnum0 := stern_gradInner_chart g β (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u y)) U hUo hβ hN
      (P.param i x₀)
    have hden0 := stern_gradInner_chart g u u U hUo hu hu.contMDiffOn (P.param i x₀)
    have hnum : ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner β (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u y))
        (P.param i x)) (P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' κ.source) := by
      refine (hnum0.comp hψ hmaps).congr ?_
      intro x hx
      simp only [Function.comp]
      rw [κ.left_inv hx.2]
    have hrad : ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u u (P.param i x))
        (P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' κ.source) := by
      refine (hden0.comp hψ hmaps).congr ?_
      intro x hx
      simp only [Function.comp]
      rw [κ.left_inv hx.2]
    have hne : ∀ x ∈ P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' κ.source,
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u (P.param i x)) ≠ 0 :=
      fun x hx => ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hpos _ (hreg x hx.1)))
    have hq := hnum.div hrad.sqrt hne
    exact hq.continuousAt (hVo.mem_nhds hx₀V)
  · have hK := gaussCurv2_continuousOn (P.h i) (P.W i) (P.W_open i) (P.h_smooth i) (P.h_posDef i)
    exact hK.congr (fun x hx => (h21 i x hx).symm)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : EndChart M) (β u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hArea : ∀ (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W → Set.InjOn F W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) →
      ∀ (W' : Set E2), MeasurableSet W' → W' ⊆ W → ∀ (h : E3 → ℝ),
      ∫ y in F '' W', h y ∂(MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) =
        sbgbAreaConst⁻¹ * ∫ x in W', h (F x) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2))
    (hIff : ∀ (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W → Set.InjOn F W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x)) →
      ∀ (W' : Set E2), MeasurableSet W' → W' ⊆ W → ∀ (h : E3 → ℝ),
      (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn h (F '' W') (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure (2 : ℝ)) ↔
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
          (fun x => h (F x) * Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2)) W'))
    (hDens : ∀ (p : M) (F : E2 → E3) (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W →
      (∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) → ∀ (c : ℝ),
      (∀ x ∈ W, u ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) = c) →
      ∀ x ∈ W, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) ≠ 0 →
      sbgbAreaDens (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (F x) *
          Real.sqrt (∑ k : Fin 3, gsCrossN F x k ^ 2) =
        sbgbAreaConst * Real.sqrt (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) F x).det)
    (Y : E3 → E3) (R₁ L t σ₀ δ₀ : ℝ) (S : Set M) (P : EigPatchedSurface M S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → M → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2) (b : M → ℝ) (js : Fin P.n)
    (hgood : sspGood g Φ β u Y R₁ L t σ₀ δ₀ S P ρ Kc b js)
    {n : ℕ} (q : Fin n → M) (φ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hadm : sternAdmissible (sternDomain Φ β Y L) q φ) (h : M → ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun x => h (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) (i : Fin P.n) (j : Fin n)
