      h (P.param i x) * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det) (P.W i) := by
    intro j
    have hφc : ContinuousOn (fun x => φ j (P.param i x)) (P.W i) :=
      (hφs j).continuous.comp_continuousOn (P.param_cont i)
    exact ((hφc.mul (h2 i i).continuousOn).mul (hh i)).mul hD
  have hkint : ∀ j : Fin n, IntegrableOn (fun x => φ j (P.param i x) * ρ i (P.param i x) *
      h (P.param i x) * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det)
      (P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t})) := by
    intro j
    have hK : IntegrableOn (fun x => φ j (P.param i x) * ρ i (P.param i x) *
        h (P.param i x) * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det) (Kc i) :=
      ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact (h3 i).1 ((hk j).mono (h3 i).2)
    refine hK.of_forall_diff_eq_zero hW'm ?_
    intro x hx
    simp only [h4 i x hx.1.1 hx.2, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  have hstep5 : ∀ j : Fin n,
      ∫ x in P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' ((chartAt E3 (q j)).source ∩
        (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t})),
        φ j (P.param i x) * ρ i (P.param i x) * h (P.param i x) * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det =
      ∫ x in P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}),
        φ j (P.param i x) * ρ i (P.param i x) * h (P.param i x) * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det := by
    intro j
    refine (setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hW'm ?_ ?_).symm
    · intro x hx
      exact ⟨hx.1, hx.2.2⟩
    · intro x hx
      have hnot : P.param i x ∉ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source := by
        intro hs
        exact hx.2 ⟨hx.1.1, hs, hx.1.2⟩
      have hz : φ j (P.param i x) = 0 :=
        image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun ht => hnot ((hφsupp j).2 ht).2)
      simp only [hz, zero_mul]
  have hR : ∫ x in P.W i, ρ i (P.param i x) *
        (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator h (P.param i x) * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det =
      ∫ x in P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}), ρ i (P.param i x) *
        (sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}).indicator h (P.param i x) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det := by
    refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hWm Set.inter_subset_left ?_
    intro x hx
    have hns : P.param i x ∉ sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} := fun hs => hx.2 ⟨hx.1, hs⟩
    simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hns, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hstep5 j),
    ← integral_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun j _ => (hkint j).integrable), hR]
  refine setIntegral_congr_fun hW'm ?_
  intro x hx
  have hO : P.param i x ∈ O := hΩO hx.2.1
  have hmem : P.param i x ∈ sternDomain Φ β Y L ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} := hx.2
  simp only [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum _ hO, one_mul, Set.indicator_of_mem hmem h]

informal_problem.statement:

    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫ x in W, a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * e₁ x) +

signature.name: collar_band_vanish
signature.statement:
∀ (W U K : Set E2), IsOpen W → IsOpen U → U ⊆ W → IsCompact K →
    K ⊆ W → ∀ (a w e₁ e₂ : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn a W → (∀ x ∈ W, x ∉ K → a x = 0) →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W → (∀ x ∈ K, w x = 0 → fderiv ℝ w x ≠ 0) → ContinuousOn e₁ W →
    ContinuousOn e₂ U → (∀ x ∈ K, w x = 0 → x ∈ U) → (∀ x ∈ K, w x = 0 → e₁ x + e₂ x = 0) →
    Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫ x in W, a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * e₁ x) +
      ∫ x in W, a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * e₂ x)
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro W U K hW hU hUW hK hKW a w e₁ e₂ ha ha0 hw hwreg he₁ he₂ hZU hedge
  
  have hη0 : ∀ y : ℝ, y ≤ 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hy with h | h
    · have hev : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds h] with z hz
        exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hz)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    · subst h
      have hmin : IsLocalMin Real.smoothTransition 0 := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_)
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos le_rfl]
        exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg z
      exact hmin.deriv_eq_zero
  have hη1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 1 ≤ y → deriv Real.smoothTransition y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hy with h | h
    · have hev : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
        filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds h] with z hz
        exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (le_of_lt hz)
      rw [hev.deriv_eq, deriv_const]
    · subst h
      have hmax : IsLocalMax Real.smoothTransition 1 := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => ?_)
        rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le le_rfl]
        exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one z
      exact hmax.deriv_eq_zero
  have hηc : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) :=
    (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).continuous_deriv le_rfl
  obtain ⟨Cη, hCη0, hCη⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, |deriv Real.smoothTransition y| ≤ C := by
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hηc.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max C₀ 0, le_max_right _ _, fun y => ?_⟩
    by_cases h0 : y ≤ 0
    · rw [hη0 y h0, abs_zero]; exact le_max_right _ _
    by_cases h1 : 1 ≤ y
    · rw [hη1 y h1, abs_zero]; exact le_max_right _ _
    push_neg at h0 h1
    have := hC₀ y ⟨h0.le, h1.le⟩
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  
  have hvan : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ x ∈ W,
      a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) ≠ 0 →
      x ∈ K ∧ 0 < w x ∧ w x < s := by
    intro s hs x hxW hne
    have ha' : a x ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hne
    have hd : deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s) ≠ 0 :=
      right_ne_zero_of_mul (right_ne_zero_of_mul hne)
    have hxK : x ∈ K := by
      by_contra hxK
      exact ha' (ha0 x hxW hxK)
    refine ⟨hxK, ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      apply hd
      apply hη0
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hs, zero_mul]
      exact h
    · by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      apply hd
      apply hη1
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hs, one_mul]
      exact h
  
  have hmargin : ∀ V : Set E2, IsOpen V → (∀ x ∈ K, w x = 0 → x ∈ V) →
      ∃ m : ℝ, 0 < m ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, |w x| < m → x ∈ V := by
    intro V hV hZ
    have hKV : IsCompact (K \ V) := hK.diff hV
    rcases (K \ V).eq_empty_or_nonempty with he | hne
    · refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun x hxK _ => ?_⟩
      by_contra hxV
      have hx : x ∈ K \ V := ⟨hxK, hxV⟩
      rw [he] at hx
      exact hx
    · have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun x => |w x|) (K \ V) :=
        ((hw.continuousOn.mono hKW).mono Set.diff_subset).abs
      obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hmin⟩ := hKV.exists_isMinOn hne hcont
      refine ⟨|w x₀|, ?_, fun x hxK hlt => ?_⟩
      · rcases (abs_nonneg (w x₀)).lt_or_eq with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          exact hx₀.2 (hZ x₀ hx₀.1 (abs_eq_zero.mp h.symm))
      · by_contra hxV
        have h2 := isMinOn_iff.mp hmin x ⟨hxK, hxV⟩
        linarith
  
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (ha.mono hKW)
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ max A₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hA : ∀ x ∈ K, |a x| ≤ max A₀ 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have := hA₀ x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  obtain ⟨m₂, hm₂, hm₂U⟩ := hmargin U hU hZU
  have hfd : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ w) W := hw.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
  obtain ⟨Cb₀, sb, hsb, hband⟩ := pcgb_thin_band_volume
    ((W ∩ w ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) ∪ (W ∩ (fderiv ℝ w) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ))
    ((hw.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hW isOpen_compl_singleton).union
      (hfd.isOpen_inter_preimage hW isOpen_compl_singleton))
    K hK
    (fun x hx => by
      by_cases h : w x = 0
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hKW hx, hwreg x hx h⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hKW hx, h⟩)
    w (hw.mono (Set.union_subset Set.inter_subset_left Set.inter_subset_left))
    (fun x hx h0 => by
      rcases hx with ⟨_, hx⟩ | ⟨_, hx⟩
      · exact absurd h0 hx
      · exact hx)
  have hCb0 : 0 ≤ max Cb₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hCb : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < sb →
      volume (K ∩ {x | 0 < w x ∧ w x < s}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (max Cb₀ 0 * s) := by
    intro s hs hss
    exact (hband s hs hss).trans
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) hs.le))
  
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds]
  intro ε' hε'
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 := mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA0 hCη0) hCb0
  have hQ1 : 0 < 2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1) := by linarith
  have hε : 0 < ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1)) := div_pos hε' hQ1
  have hεeq : ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1)) *
      (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1)) = ε' := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hQ1.ne'
  
  obtain ⟨mε, hmε, hmεV⟩ := hmargin
    (U ∩ (fun x => e₁ x + e₂ x) ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-(ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))))
      (ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))))
    (((he₁.mono hUW).add he₂).isOpen_inter_preimage hU isOpen_Ioo)
    (fun x hx h0 => by
      refine ⟨hZU x hx h0, ?_⟩
      show e₁ x + e₂ x ∈ Set.Ioo _ _
      rw [hedge x hx h0]
      exact ⟨by linarith, hε⟩)
  refine ⟨min (min m₂ mε) sb, lt_min (lt_min hm₂ hmε) hsb, fun {s} hs hds => ?_⟩
  have hs0 : 0 < s := hs
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hs0] at hds
  have hsm₂ : s < m₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hds (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hsmε : s < mε := lt_of_lt_of_le hds (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  have hssb : s < sb := lt_of_lt_of_le hds (min_le_right _ _)
  
  have hk : ContinuousOn (fun x => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) W :=
    continuousOn_const.mul (hηc.comp_continuousOn (hw.continuousOn.div_const s))
  have hI₁ : IntegrableOn
      (fun x => a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * e₁ x) W := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn
        (fun x => a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * e₁ x) W :=
      (ha.mul hk).mul he₁
    refine ((hc.mono hKW).integrableOn_compact hK).of_forall_diff_eq_zero hW.measurableSet ?_
    intro x hx
    simp only [ha0 x hx.1 hx.2, zero_mul]
  have hK₂c : IsClosed (K ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 s) :=
    (hw.continuousOn.mono hKW).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed hK.isClosed isClosed_Icc
  have hK₂ : IsCompact (K ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 s) := hK.of_isClosed_subset hK₂c Set.inter_subset_left
  have hK₂U : K ∩ w ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 s ⊆ U := by
    intro x hx
    have hx2 : w x ∈ Set.Icc 0 s := hx.2
    apply hm₂U x hx.1
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hx2.1]
    linarith [hx2.2]
  have hI₂ : IntegrableOn
      (fun x => a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * e₂ x) W := by
    have hc : ContinuousOn
        (fun x => a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * e₂ x) U :=
      ((ha.mono hUW).mul (hk.mono hUW)).mul he₂
    refine ((hc.mono hK₂U).integrableOn_compact hK₂).of_forall_diff_eq_zero hW.measurableSet ?_
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    have hv := hvan s hs0 x hx.1 (left_ne_zero_of_mul h)
    exact hx.2 ⟨hv.1, show w x ∈ Set.Icc 0 s from ⟨hv.2.1.le, hv.2.2.le⟩⟩
  have hmerge : (∫ x in W, a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * e₁ x) +
      ∫ x in W, a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * e₂ x =
      ∫ x in W, a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * (e₁ x + e₂ x) := by
    rw [← integral_add hI₁ hI₂]
    congr 1
    ext x
    ring
  
  have hBW : K ∩ {x | 0 < w x ∧ w x < s} ⊆ W := fun x hx => hKW hx.1
  have hrestr : ∫ x in W, a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * (e₁ x + e₂ x) =
      ∫ x in K ∩ {x | 0 < w x ∧ w x < s},
        a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * (e₁ x + e₂ x) := by
    refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hW.measurableSet hBW ?_
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    exact hx.2 (hvan s hs0 x hx.1 (left_ne_zero_of_mul h))
  have hpt : ∀ x ∈ K ∩ {x | 0 < w x ∧ w x < s},
      ‖a x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)) * (e₁ x + e₂ x)‖ ≤
        max A₀ 0 * (s⁻¹ * Cη) * (ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxK : x ∈ K := hx.1
    have hxb : 0 < w x ∧ w x < s := hx.2
    have h1 : |a x| ≤ max A₀ 0 := hA x hxK
    have hsi : 0 < s⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hs0
    have h2 : |s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (w x / s)| ≤ s⁻¹ * Cη := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hsi]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hCη _) hsi.le
    have h3 : |e₁ x + e₂ x| ≤ ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1)) := by
      have hV := hmεV x hxK (by rw [abs_of_pos hxb.1]; linarith [hxb.2])
      have hV2 : e₁ x + e₂ x ∈ Set.Ioo (-(ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))))
          (ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))) := hV.2
      exact (abs_lt.mpr hV2).le
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hA0) h3 (abs_nonneg _)
      (mul_nonneg hA0 (mul_nonneg hsi.le hCη0))
  have hfin : volume (K ∩ {x | 0 < w x ∧ w x < s}) < ⊤ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (measure_mono Set.inter_subset_left) hK.measure_lt_top
  have hbound := norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const hfin hpt
  have hvol : volume.real (K ∩ {x | 0 < w x ∧ w x < s}) ≤ max Cb₀ 0 * s := by
    rw [measureReal_def]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (mul_nonneg hCb0 hs0.le) (hCb s hs0 hssb)
  have hss : s⁻¹ * s = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hs0.ne'
  have hcs0 : 0 ≤ max A₀ 0 * (s⁻¹ * Cη) * (ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hA0 (mul_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr hs0).le hCη0)) hε.le
  have hfinal : max A₀ 0 * (s⁻¹ * Cη) * (ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))) *
      (max Cb₀ 0 * s) =
      max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 * (ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))) := by
    calc max A₀ 0 * (s⁻¹ * Cη) * (ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))) *
          (max Cb₀ 0 * s)
        = max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 * (ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))) *
            (s⁻¹ * s) := by ring
      _ = max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 * (ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))) := by
          rw [hss, mul_one]
  have hle := hbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvol hcs0)
  rw [hfinal] at hle
  have hQε : max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 * (ε' / (2 * (max A₀ 0 * Cη * max Cb₀ 0 + 1))) < ε' := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hQ0 hε.le, hεeq, hε]
  rw [dist_zero_right, hmerge, hrestr]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle hQε

signature.name: sgb_curv_density_regular
signature.statement:
∀ (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (W : Set E2), IsOpen W →
    (∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a b) W) → (∀ y ∈ W, (h y).PosDef) →
    ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W →

proof.tactics:
by
  intro h W hW hh hpd w hw
  have hUW : {x : E2 | x ∈ W ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x} ⊆ W := fun x hx => hx.1
  
  have hdet_eq : (fun y => (h y).det) = fun y => h y 0 0 * h y 1 1 - h y 0 1 * h y 1 0 := by
    funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
  have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).det) W := by
    rw [hdet_eq]; exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have hdetpos : ∀ y ∈ W, 0 < (h y).det := fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos
  have hsqdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det) W :=
    hdetS.sqrt (fun y hy => (hdetpos y hy).ne')
  
  have hadj : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).adjugate a c) W := by
    intro a c
    have e : (fun y => (h y).adjugate a c) =
        fun y => !![h y 1 1, -h y 0 1; -h y 1 0, h y 0 0] a c := by
      funext y; rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
    rw [e]
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c
    · simpa using hh 1 1
    · simpa using (hh 0 1).neg
    · simpa using (hh 1 0).neg
    · simpa using hh 0 0
  have hinvS : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a c) W := by
    intro a c
    have e : (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a c) = fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹ * (h y).adjugate a c := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    rw [e]
    exact (hdetS.inv (fun y hy => (hdetpos y hy).ne')).mul (hadj a c)
  
  have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ w) W := hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
  have hpd2 : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 a w) W := by
    intro a
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ w x (e2 a)) W
    exact hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sgbGradSq2 h w) W := by
    have e : sgbGradSq2 h w =
        fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a w x * pd2 c w x := by
      funext x; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum
      (fun c _ => ((hinvS a c).mul (hpd2 a)).mul (hpd2 c)))
  
  have hUopen : IsOpen {x : E2 | x ∈ W ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x} :=
    hG.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hW isOpen_Ioi
  
  have hGU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h w y))
      {x : E2 | x ∈ W ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x} :=
    (hG.mono hUW).sqrt (fun y hy => hy.2.ne')
  have hV : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det *
      (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a w y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h w y))
      {x : E2 | x ∈ W ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x} := by
    intro i
    have hnum : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det * (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a w y)) W :=
      hsqdet.mul (ContDiffOn.sum (fun a _ => (hinvS i a).mul (hpd2 a)))
    exact (hnum.mono hUW).div hGU (fun y hy => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hy.2).ne')
  have hdV : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 i (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det *
      (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a w y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h w y)) x)
      {x : E2 | x ∈ W ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x} := by
    intro i
    exact ((hV i).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hUopen (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hκ : ContinuousOn (fun x => sgbLevelCurv2 h w x)
      {x : E2 | x ∈ W ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x} := by
    have hsd : ContinuousOn (fun x => (Real.sqrt (h x).det)⁻¹)
        {x : E2 | x ∈ W ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x} :=
      (hsqdet.continuousOn.mono hUW).inv₀
        (fun x hx => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hdetpos x (hUW hx))).ne')
    have hs : ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det *
        (∑ a : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ i a * pd2 a w y) / Real.sqrt (sgbGradSq2 h w y)) x)
        {x : E2 | x ∈ W ∧ 0 < sgbGradSq2 h w x} :=
      continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hdV i)
    unfold sgbLevelCurv2
    exact (hsd.mul hs).neg
  refine ⟨hUopen, (hG.continuousOn.mono hUW).sqrt.mul hκ, ?_⟩
  
  intro x hx hne
  have hA := (hpd x hx).inv
  have hv : (fun a : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ w x (e2 a)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hv0
    apply hne
    have h0 : fderiv ℝ w x (e2 0) = 0 := congrFun hv0 0
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ w x (e2 1) = 0 := congrFun hv0 1
    ext y
    have hy : y = y 0 • e2 0 + y 1 • e2 1 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hy]
    simp [h0, h1]
  have hpos := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv
  calc (0 : ℝ) < _ := hpos
    _ = sgbGradSq2 h w x := by
      simp only [sgbGradSq2, pd2, star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring

proof.tactics:
by
  apply continuousOn_of_forall_continuousAt
  intro p₀ hp₀
  obtain ⟨-, -, hUo, hN⟩ := stern_phi_chart_reps g u hu 1 one_pos p₀
  have hNum : ContinuousOn
      (fun y => g.gradInner β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x)) ((chartAt E3 p₀).symm y))
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₀).target ∧
        (chartAt E3 p₀).symm y ∈ {p : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0}} :=
    stern_gradInner_chart g β (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x))
      {p : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0} hUo hβ hN p₀
  have hB : ContinuousOn (fun y => g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p₀).symm y))
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₀).target ∧ (chartAt E3 p₀).symm y ∈ (Set.univ : Set M)} :=
    stern_gradInner_chart g u u Set.univ isOpen_univ hu hu.contMDiffOn p₀
  have hB' : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p₀).symm y)))
      {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₀).target ∧
        (chartAt E3 p₀).symm y ∈ {p : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0}} :=
    (hB.mono (fun y hy => ⟨hy.1, Set.mem_univ _⟩)).sqrt
  have hne : ∀ y ∈ {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₀).target ∧
        (chartAt E3 p₀).symm y ∈ {p : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0}},
      Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p₀).symm y)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have h1 := (chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu p₀).2.1 y hy.1
    have h2 := chart_Nsq_pos g u hu p₀ y hy.1 hy.2
    apply ne_of_gt
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
    rw [h1]
    exact h2
  have hE' := hNum.div hB' hne
  have hTo : IsOpen {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₀).target ∧
        (chartAt E3 p₀).symm y ∈ {p : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0}} :=
    (chartAt E3 p₀).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hUo
  have hsrc : p₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 p₀).source := mem_chart_source E3 p₀
  have hmem : (chartAt E3 p₀) p₀ ∈ {y | y ∈ (chartAt E3 p₀).target ∧
        (chartAt E3 p₀).symm y ∈ {p : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0}} := by
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 p₀).map_source hsrc, ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 p₀).symm ((chartAt E3 p₀) p₀) ∈ {p : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0}
    rw [(chartAt E3 p₀).left_inv hsrc]
    exact hp₀
  have hat := hE'.continuousAt (hTo.mem_nhds hmem)
  have hcomp := hat.comp ((chartAt E3 p₀).continuousAt hsrc)
  refine hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
  filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 p₀).open_source.mem_nhds hsrc] with p hp
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.div_apply, (chartAt E3 p₀).left_inv hp]

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_phi_chart_reps
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (q : M) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (sternPhiM g u ε) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun y => g.lapM (sternPhiM g u ε) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      (chartAt E3 q).target ∧
    IsOpen {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0} ∧
    ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u x))
      {x : M | mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u x ≠ 0}

    (U : Set M) (hU : IsOpen U) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f)
    (hw : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w U) (q : M) :
    ContinuousOn (fun y => g.gradInner f w ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))

subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (p : M) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
      (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) (chartAt E3 p).target

informal_problem.statement:
(δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => δ * smax1 (-t / δ - 1)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → δ * smax1 (-t / δ - 1) = 0) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ * smax1 (-t / δ - 1)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, -t - δ ≤ δ * smax1 (-t / δ - 1)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, δ * smax1 (-t / δ - 1) ≤ max (-t) 0 + δ) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, deriv (fun s : ℝ => δ * smax1 (-s / δ - 1)) t =
      -Real.smoothTransition (-t / (2 * δ))) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, -1 ≤ deriv (fun s : ℝ => δ * smax1 (-s / δ - 1)) t ∧
      deriv (fun s : ℝ => δ * smax1 (-s / δ - 1)) t ≤ 0)

signature.name: clsp_profile
signature.statement:
(δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun t : ℝ => δ * smax1 (-t / δ - 1)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → δ * smax1 (-t / δ - 1) = 0) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ * smax1 (-t / δ - 1)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, -t - δ ≤ δ * smax1 (-t / δ - 1)) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, δ * smax1 (-t / δ - 1) ≤ max (-t) 0 + δ) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, deriv (fun s : ℝ => δ * smax1 (-s / δ - 1)) t =
      -Real.smoothTransition (-t / (2 * δ))) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, -1 ≤ deriv (fun s : ℝ => δ * smax1 (-s / δ - 1)) t ∧
      deriv (fun s : ℝ => δ * smax1 (-s / δ - 1)) t ≤ 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ → ℝ, σ = fun t => Real.smoothTransition ((t + 1) / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ σ := by
    rw [hσ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (by fun_prop)
  have hσc : Continuous σ := hσd.continuous
  have hσ01 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ σ u ∧ σ u ≤ 1 := by
    intro u; rw [hσ]
    exact ⟨Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _, Real.smoothTransition.le_one _⟩
  have hσ0 : ∀ t, t ≤ -1 → σ t = 0 := by
    intro t ht; rw [hσ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith)
  have hσ1 : ∀ t, 1 ≤ t → σ t = 1 := by
    intro t ht; rw [hσ]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
  have hS : ∀ x : ℝ, Real.smoothTransition x + Real.smoothTransition (1 - x) = 1 := by
    intro x
    have h1 := Real.smoothTransition.pos_denom x
    unfold Real.smoothTransition
    rw [sub_sub_cancel, add_comm (expNegInvGlue (1 - x)) (expNegInvGlue x), div_add_div_same,
      div_self h1.ne']
  have hσs : ∀ t, σ t + σ (-t) = 1 := by
    intro t
    have h := hS ((t + 1) / 2)
    have e : 1 - (t + 1) / 2 = (-t + 1) / 2 := by ring
    rw [e] at h
    rw [hσ]
    exact h
  have e1 : smax1 = fun u => ∫ t in (-1 : ℝ)..u, σ t := by
    funext v; rw [hσ]; rfl
  have hD : ∀ u, HasDerivAt smax1 (σ u) u := by
    intro u
    rw [e1]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hσc.intervalIntegrable (-1) u)
      (hσc.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) hσc.continuousAt
  have hderiv : deriv smax1 = σ := funext fun u => (hD u).deriv
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ smax1 := fun u => (hD u).differentiableAt
  have P1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ smax1 := contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mpr ⟨hdiff, hderiv ▸ hσd⟩
  have P4 : ∀ u, u ≤ -1 → smax1 u = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    rw [e1]
    show ∫ t in (-1 : ℝ)..u, σ t = 0
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) ?_]
    · exact intervalIntegral.integral_zero
    · intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_ge hu] at ht
      exact hσ0 t ht.2
  have hI : ∫ t in (-1 : ℝ)..1, σ t = 1 := by
    have h1 : ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, σ (-x) = ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, σ x := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg]
      norm_num
    have h2 : ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (σ x + σ (-x)) =
        (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, σ x) + ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, σ (-x) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_add (hσc.intervalIntegrable _ _)
        ((hσc.comp continuous_neg : Continuous fun x => σ (-x)).intervalIntegrable _ _)
    have h3 : ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, (σ x + σ (-x)) = 2 := by
      simp only [hσs]
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
      norm_num
    linarith
  have P5 : ∀ u, 1 ≤ u → smax1 u = u := by
    intro u hu
    rw [e1]
    show ∫ t in (-1 : ℝ)..u, σ t = u
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (b := 1)
      (hσc.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hσc.intervalIntegrable _ _), hI]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ?_]
    · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    · intro t ht
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hu] at ht
      exact hσ1 t ht.1
  have hmono : Monotone smax1 :=
    monotone_of_deriv_nonneg hdiff (fun u => by rw [hderiv]; exact (hσ01 u).1)
  have hDh : ∀ u, HasDerivAt (fun v => smax1 v - v) (σ u - 1) u :=
    fun u => (hD u).sub (hasDerivAt_id' u)
  have hanti : Antitone (fun v => smax1 v - v) :=
    antitone_of_deriv_nonpos (fun u => (hDh u).differentiableAt)
      (fun u => by rw [(hDh u).deriv]; linarith [(hσ01 u).2])
  have P6 : ∀ u, max u 0 ≤ smax1 u := by
    intro u
    apply max_le
    · have h := hanti (le_max_left u 1)
      simp only at h
      rw [P5 _ (le_max_right u 1)] at h
      linarith
    · have h := hmono (min_le_left u (-1))
      rw [P4 _ (min_le_right u (-1))] at h
      exact h
  have P7 : ∀ u, smax1 u ≤ max u 0 + 1 := by
    intro u
    have h := hmono (le_max_left u 1)
    rw [P5 _ (le_max_right u 1)] at h
    have h0 := le_max_left u 0
    have h1 := le_max_right u 0
    have h2 : max u 1 ≤ max u 0 + 1 := max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)
    linarith
  
  have hδne : δ ≠ 0 := hδ.ne'
  have I1 : ∀ t : ℝ, δ * (-t / δ - 1) = -t - δ := by
    intro t; field_simp
  have hderivm : ∀ t : ℝ, deriv (fun s : ℝ => δ * smax1 (-s / δ - 1)) t =
      -Real.smoothTransition (-t / (2 * δ)) := by
    intro t
    have hin : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => -s / δ - 1) (-1 / δ) t := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_id t).neg.div_const δ).sub_const 1
      simpa using this
    have hc := ((hD (-t / δ - 1)).comp t hin).const_mul δ
    have hc' : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => δ * smax1 (-s / δ - 1))
        (δ * (σ (-t / δ - 1) * (-1 / δ))) t := hc
    rw [hc'.deriv, hσ]
    have e2 : (-t / δ - 1 + 1) / 2 = -t / (2 * δ) := by field_simp; ring
    simp only
    rw [e2]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hderivm, ?_⟩
  · exact contDiff_const.mul (P1.comp (by fun_prop))
  · intro t ht
    have : -t / δ - 1 ≤ -1 := by
      have : 0 ≤ t / δ := div_nonneg ht hδ.le
      rw [neg_div]; linarith
    rw [P4 _ this, mul_zero]
  · intro t
    exact mul_nonneg hδ.le ((le_max_right _ _).trans (P6 _))
  · intro t
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((le_max_left _ _).trans (P6 (-t / δ - 1))) hδ.le
    rw [I1] at h
    exact h
  · intro t
    have h7 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (P7 (-t / δ - 1)) hδ.le
    have hm1 := le_max_left (-t) 0
    have hm2 := le_max_right (-t) 0
    rcases le_or_gt (-t / δ - 1) 0 with hx | hx
    · rw [max_eq_right hx] at h7
      linarith
    · rw [max_eq_left hx.le, mul_add, I1] at h7
      linarith
  · intro t
    rw [hderivm]
    exact ⟨by linarith [Real.smoothTransition.le_one (-t / (2 * δ))],
      by linarith [Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (-t / (2 * δ))]⟩

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) (G : ℝ → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ∀ p : M, h.gradInner (fun q => G (w q)) w p = deriv G (w p) * h.gradInner w w p ∧
      h.gradInner (fun q => G (w q)) (fun q => G (w q)) p =
        deriv G (w p) ^ 2 * h.gradInner w w p

signature.name: clsp_gradInner_comp
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (w : M → ℝ)
    (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) (G : ℝ → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ∀ p : M, h.gradInner (fun q => G (w q)) w p = deriv G (w p) * h.gradInner w w p ∧
      h.gradInner (fun q => G (w q)) (fun q => G (w q)) p =
        deriv G (w p) ^ 2 * h.gradInner w w p

proof.tactics:
by
  intro p
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hw.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) :=
    (hf.contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds (mem_chart_target E3 p))).differentiableAt
      (by simp)
  have hGd : HasDerivAt G (deriv G (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))))
      (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))) :=
    ((hG.differentiable (by simp)) _).hasDerivAt
  have hbase : w ((chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p)) = w p := by
    rw [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)]
  have hcomp := hGd.comp_hasFDerivAt (chartAt E3 p p) hfd.hasFDerivAt
  have hpd : ∀ i : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv i (fun y => G (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) (chartAt E3 p p) =
        deriv G (w p) * partialDeriv i (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
    intro i
    unfold partialDeriv
    have e : (fun y => G (w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) =
        G ∘ (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) := rfl
    rw [e, hcomp.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hbase]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, hpd]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring
  · simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, hpd]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F G : M → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun y => F (κ i y)) (κ i).source)
    (hG : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun y => G (κ i y)) (κ i).source)
    (KF KG : Set M) (hKF : IsCompact KF) (hKG : IsCompact KG)
    (hFK : ∀ p, p ∉ KF → F p = 0) (hGK : ∀ p, p ∉ KG → G p = 0) :
    atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => F p + G p) = atlasInt h κ χ F + atlasInt h κ χ G ∧
    (∀ c : ℝ, atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => c * F p) = c * atlasInt h κ χ F) ∧
    ((∀ p, F p ≤ G p) → atlasInt h κ χ F ≤ atlasInt h κ χ G) ∧
    ((∀ p, 0 ≤ F p) → 0 ≤ atlasInt h κ χ F)

signature.name: clsp_atlasInt_algebra
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (F G : M → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun y => F (κ i y)) (κ i).source)
    (hG : ∀ i, ContinuousOn (fun y => G (κ i y)) (κ i).source)
    (KF KG : Set M) (hKF : IsCompact KF) (hKG : IsCompact KG)
    (hFK : ∀ p, p ∉ KF → F p = 0) (hGK : ∀ p, p ∉ KG → G p = 0) :
    atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => F p + G p) = atlasInt h κ χ F + atlasInt h κ χ G ∧
    (∀ c : ℝ, atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => c * F p) = c * atlasInt h κ χ F) ∧
    ((∀ p, F p ≤ G p) → atlasInt h κ χ F ≤ atlasInt h κ χ G) ∧
    ((∀ p, 0 ≤ F p) → 0 ≤ atlasInt h κ χ F)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨-, hχs, hχ0, -, hχt, -⟩ := hA
  have hint : ∀ (i : Fin n) (f : M → ℝ), ContinuousOn (fun y => f (κ i y)) (κ i).source →
      ∀ T : Set M, IsCompact T → (∀ p, p ∉ T → f p = 0) →
      IntegrableOn (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * f (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det)
        (κ i).source := by
    intro i f hf T hT hfT
    have := cls_chart_integrable h (κ i) (χ i) (hχs i) (hχt i) Set.univ isClosed_univ f hf
      T hT (fun p hp => by rw [Set.indicator_univ]; exact hfT p hp)
    simpa only [Set.indicator_univ] using this
  have hIF : ∀ i, IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * F (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source :=
    fun i => hint i F (hF i) KF hKF hFK
  have hIG : ∀ i, IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ i (κ i y) * G (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det) (κ i).source :=
    fun i => hint i G (hG i) KG hKG hGK
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold atlasInt
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [← integral_add (hIF i) (hIG i)]
    congr 1
    funext y
    ring
  · intro c
    unfold atlasInt
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    funext y
    ring
  · intro hle
    unfold atlasInt
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    refine setIntegral_mono (hIF i) (hIG i) ?_
    intro y
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hle _) (hχ0 i _))
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  · intro h0
    unfold atlasInt
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    apply integral_nonneg
    intro y
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hχ0 i _) (h0 _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

subgoal_signatures.name: cls_chart_integrable
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (h : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : M → ℝ)
    (hχ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ χ) (hχt : tsupport χ ⊆ κ.target) (C : Set M)
    (hC : IsClosed C) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn (fun y => f (κ y)) κ.source) (T : Set M)
    (hT : IsCompact T) (hCT : ∀ p, p ∉ T → C.indicator f p = 0) :
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ (κ y) * C.indicator f (κ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ y).det) κ.source

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (φ w : M → ℝ)
    (hφ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner φ w) = -atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => φ p * h.lapM w p)

signature.name: clsp_green_atlas
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (h : RiemannianMetric3 M) (φ w : M → ℝ)
    (hφ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ φ) (hφc : HasCompactSupport φ)
    (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner φ w) = -atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => φ p * h.lapM w p)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  obtain ⟨-, hχs, -, hχ1, hχt, -⟩ := hA
  
  obtain ⟨u, hudef⟩ : ∃ u : Fin n → M → ℝ, u = fun i p => χ i p * φ p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hup : ∀ i p, u i p = χ i p * φ p := by intro i p; rw [hudef]
  have hu : ∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u i) := by
    intro i; rw [hudef]; exact (hχs i).mul hφ
  have hφsum : ∀ q, φ q = ∑ i, u i q := by
    intro q; simp only [hup]; rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hχ1 q, one_mul]
  obtain ⟨K, hKdef⟩ : ∃ K : Fin n → Set M, K = fun i => tsupport (χ i) ∩ tsupport φ :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hKa : ∀ i, K i = tsupport (χ i) ∩ tsupport φ := by intro i; rw [hKdef]
  have hKc : ∀ i, IsCompact (K i) := by
    intro i; rw [hKa]; exact hφc.isCompact.inter_left (isClosed_tsupport _)
  have hKt : ∀ i, K i ⊆ (κ i).target := by
    intro i p hp; rw [hKa] at hp; exact hχt i hp.1
  have htsK : ∀ i, tsupport (u i) ⊆ K i := by
    intro i
    rw [hKa]
    apply closure_minimal _ ((isClosed_tsupport _).inter (isClosed_tsupport _))
    intro p hp
    rw [Function.mem_support, hup] at hp
    exact ⟨subset_tsupport _ (left_ne_zero_of_mul hp), subset_tsupport _ (right_ne_zero_of_mul hp)⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : Fin n → Set E3, L = fun i => (κ i).toPartialEquiv.symm '' K i :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hLa : ∀ i, L i = (κ i).toPartialEquiv.symm '' K i := by intro i; rw [hLdef]
  have hLs : ∀ i, L i ⊆ (κ i).source := by
    intro i; rw [hLa]; rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact (κ i).toPartialEquiv.map_target (hKt i hx)
  have hLc : ∀ i, IsCompact (L i) := by
    intro i; rw [hLa]
    exact (hKc i).image_of_continuousOn ((κ i).contMDiffOn_invFun.continuousOn.mono (hKt i))
  have hKL : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ (κ i).source, y ∉ L i → κ i y ∉ K i := by
    intro i y hy hyL hK
    rw [hLa] at hyL
    exact hyL ⟨κ i y, hK, (κ i).toPartialEquiv.left_inv hy⟩
  
  have hgv : ∀ (v : M → ℝ) (p : M), p ∉ tsupport v → h.gradInner v w p = 0 := by
    intro v p hp
    have hc : ContinuousAt (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm (mem_chart_target E3 p)
    have hsymm : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p :=
      (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
    have hnhds : (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' (tsupport v)ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      apply hc.preimage_mem_nhds
      rw [hsymm]
      exact (isClosed_tsupport v).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hp
    have hev : (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hnhds] with y hy
      exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy
    have hpd : ∀ j : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv j (fun y => v ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) = 0 := by
      intro j
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    simp [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, hpd]
  
  have hsplitG : h.gradInner φ w = fun p => ∑ i, h.gradInner (u i) w p := by
    funext p
    have hdiff : ∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u i ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      intro i
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u i ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
        contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp ((hu i).comp_contMDiffOn (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := p)))
      exact (h1.differentiableOn (by simp) _ (mem_chart_target E3 p)).differentiableAt
        ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds (mem_chart_target E3 p))
    have hfun : (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) =
        fun y => ∑ i, u i ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) := by
      funext y; exact hφsum _
    have hpd : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => φ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) =
        ∑ i, partialDeriv a (fun y => u i ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) := by
      intro a
      rw [hfun]
      simp only [partialDeriv]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => hdiff i), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.gradInner, hpd, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  
  have htransfer : ∀ (ψ κ0 : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (G : M → ℝ),
      (∀ p, p ∉ κ0.target ∩ ψ.target → G p = 0) →
      ∫ z in κ0.source, G (κ0 z) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 z).det =
        ∫ y in ψ.source, G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
    intro ψ κ0 G hG
    have hψc : ContinuousOn ψ ψ.source := ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
    obtain ⟨Ω, hΩ⟩ : ∃ Ω : Set E3, Ω = ψ.source ∩ ψ ⁻¹' κ0.target := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hmΩ : ∀ y, y ∈ Ω ↔ y ∈ ψ.source ∧ ψ y ∈ κ0.target := by
      intro y; rw [hΩ]; rfl
    have hΩo : IsOpen Ω := by
      rw [hΩ]; exact hψc.isOpen_inter_preimage ψ.open_source κ0.open_target
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ : ∃ τ : E3 → E3, τ = fun y => κ0.toPartialEquiv.symm (ψ y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hτa : ∀ y, τ y = κ0.toPartialEquiv.symm (ψ y) := by intro y; rw [hτ]
    have hτinv : ∀ y ∈ Ω, κ0 (τ y) = ψ y := by
      intro y hy; rw [hτa]; exact κ0.toPartialEquiv.right_inv ((hmΩ y).1 hy).2
    have hτsrc : ∀ y ∈ Ω, τ y ∈ κ0.source := by
      intro y hy; rw [hτa]; exact κ0.toPartialEquiv.map_target ((hmΩ y).1 hy).2
    have hτsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ Ω := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun y => κ0.toPartialEquiv.symm (ψ y)) Ω :=
        κ0.contMDiffOn_invFun.comp (ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.mono (fun y hy => ((hmΩ y).1 hy).1))
          (fun y hy => ((hmΩ y).1 hy).2)
      rw [hτ]; exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    have hτd : ∀ y ∈ Ω, DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y := fun y hy =>
      ((hτsm.differentiableOn (by simp)) y hy).differentiableAt (hΩo.mem_nhds hy)
    have hτinj : Set.InjOn τ Ω := by
      intro y₁ h₁ y₂ h₂ heq
      have h3 : κ0 (τ y₁) = κ0 (τ y₂) := by rw [heq]
      rw [hτinv y₁ h₁, hτinv y₂ h₂] at h3
      exact ψ.toPartialEquiv.injOn ((hmΩ y₁).1 h₁).1 ((hmΩ y₂).1 h₂).1 h3
    have hcov := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hΩo.measurableSet
      (fun y hy => (hτd y hy).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hτinj
      (fun z => G (κ0 z) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 z).det)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at hcov
    have himg : τ '' Ω ⊆ κ0.source := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩; exact hτsrc y hy
    have hcc : ∫ z in κ0.source, G (κ0 z) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 z).det =
        ∫ z in τ '' Ω, G (κ0 z) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 z).det := by
      refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero κ0.open_source.measurableSet
        himg ?_
      intro z hz
      have hG0 : G (κ0 z) = 0 := by
        apply hG
        rintro ⟨hz1, hz2⟩
        apply hz.2
        have hr : ψ (ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm (κ0 z)) = κ0 z := ψ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hz2
        refine ⟨ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm (κ0 z),
          (hmΩ _).2 ⟨ψ.toPartialEquiv.map_target hz2, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · rw [hr]; exact hz1
        · rw [hτa, hr]; exact κ0.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hz.1
      rw [hG0, zero_mul]
    have hdd : ∫ y in ψ.source, G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det =
        ∫ y in Ω, G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
      refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero ψ.open_source.measurableSet
        (fun y hy => ((hmΩ y).1 hy).1) ?_
      intro y hy
      have hG0 : G (ψ y) = 0 := by
        apply hG
        rintro ⟨h1, -⟩
        exact hy.2 ((hmΩ y).2 ⟨hy.1, h1⟩)
      rw [hG0, zero_mul]
    have hvol : ∀ y ∈ Ω, Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det =
        |(fderiv ℝ τ y).det| * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 (τ y)).det := by
      intro y hy
      have hev : (⇑κ0 ∘ τ) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] ⇑ψ := by
        filter_upwards [hΩo.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
        exact hτinv z hz
      have hcoeq : h.coeff ψ y = h.coeff (⇑κ0 ∘ τ) y := by
        have hmf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (⇑κ0 ∘ τ) y = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ψ y :=
          hev.mfderiv_eq
        have hpt : (⇑κ0 ∘ τ) y = ψ y := hτinv y hy
        ext i j
        simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
        rw [hmf, hpt]
      have hκmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) κ0 (τ y) :=
        ((κ0.contMDiffOn_toFun (τ y) (hτsrc y hy)).contMDiffAt
          (κ0.open_source.mem_nhds (hτsrc y hy))).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
      obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
          J = Matrix.of fun a i => fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hmat : h.coeff ψ y = J.transpose * h.coeff κ0 (τ y) * J := by
        rw [hcoeq]
        ext i j
        rw [coeff_comp_apply h κ0 τ y (hτd y hy) hκmd i j, hJ]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three]
        ring
      have hdetJ : (fderiv ℝ τ y).det = J.det := by
        rw [hJ]
        show LinearMap.det ((fderiv ℝ τ y : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) = _
        rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis]
        congr 1
      have hdet : (h.coeff ψ y).det = J.det ^ 2 * (h.coeff κ0 (τ y)).det := by
        rw [hmat, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]; ring
      rw [hdet, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, hdetJ]
    have hff : ∫ y in Ω, |(fderiv ℝ τ y).det| *
          (G (κ0 (τ y)) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ0 (τ y)).det) =
        ∫ y in Ω, G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hΩo.measurableSet fun y hy => ?_
      simp only
      rw [hτinv y hy, hvol y hy]; ring
    rw [hcc, hcov, hff, hdd]
  
  have hloc : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (K0 : Set M) (L0 : Set E3),
      IsCompact L0 → L0 ⊆ ψ.source → K0 ⊆ ψ.target →
      (∀ y ∈ ψ.source, y ∉ L0 → ψ y ∉ K0) → ∀ F : M → ℝ, (∀ p, p ∉ K0 → F p = 0) →
      ContinuousOn (fun y => F (ψ y)) ψ.source →
      atlasInt h κ χ F = ∫ y in ψ.source, F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
    intro ψ K0 L0 hL0 hL0s hK0t hK0L F hF hFc
    have hψc : ContinuousOn ψ ψ.source := ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
    have hsq : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source :=
      (nds_chart_cont h ψ 0 0 contMDiff_const contMDiff_const).2.2.2.1
    have hint : ∀ c : M → ℝ, Continuous c →
        IntegrableOn (fun y => c (ψ y) * F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source := by
      intro c hc
      have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => c (ψ y) * F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det)
          ψ.source := ((hc.comp_continuousOn hψc).mul hFc).mul hsq
      refine ((h1.mono hL0s).integrableOn_compact hL0).of_forall_diff_eq_zero
        ψ.open_source.measurableSet ?_
      intro y hy
      rw [hF _ (hK0L y hy.1 hy.2)]; ring
    unfold atlasInt
    have hi : ∀ i, ∫ y in (κ i).source, χ i (κ i y) * F (κ i y) *
          Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det =
        ∫ y in ψ.source, χ i (ψ y) * F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
      intro i
      exact htransfer ψ (κ i) (fun p => χ i p * F p) (by
        intro p hp
        by_cases h1 : p ∈ (κ i).target
        · have h2 : p ∉ ψ.target := fun h2 => hp ⟨h1, h2⟩
          have h3 : p ∉ K0 := fun h3 => h2 (hK0t h3)
          simp only [hF p h3, mul_zero]
        · have h2 : p ∉ tsupport (χ i) := fun h2 => h1 (hχt i h2)
          simp only [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport h2, zero_mul])
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hi i)]
    rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hint (χ i) (hχs i).continuous)]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun ψ.open_source.measurableSet fun y hy => ?_
    show ∑ i, χ i (ψ y) * F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det =
      F (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, hχ1 (ψ y), one_mul]
  
  have hgreen : ∀ (ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (L0 : Set E3),
      IsCompact L0 → L0 ⊆ ψ.source → ∀ v : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v →
      (∀ y ∈ ψ.source, y ∉ L0 → ψ y ∉ tsupport v) →
      ∫ y in ψ.source, h.gradInner v w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det =
        -∫ y in ψ.source, v (ψ y) * h.lapM w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
    intro ψ L0 hL0 hL0s v hv hvK
    have hψc : ContinuousOn ψ ψ.source := ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
    have hG := coeff_contDiffOn_source h ψ
    have hGinv := (flat_coeff_regular h ψ).1
    have hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), h.coeff ψ x i j = h.coeff ψ x j i :=
      fun x i j => h.symm _ _ _
    have hpos := coeff_posDef h ψ
    have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source :=
      ccs_sqrtdet_smooth _ _ hG (fun y hy => (hpos y hy).det_pos)
    have hζ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => v (ψ y)) ψ.source := (nds_chart_cont h ψ v w hv hw).1
    have hV : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => w (ψ y)) ψ.source := (nds_chart_cont h ψ w w hw hw).1
    have hpd : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f ψ.source → ∀ b : Fin 3,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv b f) ψ.source := by
      intro f hf b
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) ψ.source :=
        hf.fderiv_of_isOpen ψ.open_source (by simp)
      exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    have hdA : ∀ f : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f ψ.source → ∀ y ∈ ψ.source,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ f y := fun f hf y hy =>
      ((hf.differentiableOn (by simp)) y hy).differentiableAt (ψ.open_source.mem_nhds hy)
    have hv0 : ∀ y ∈ ψ.source, y ∉ L0 → v (ψ y) = 0 := fun y hy hyL =>
      image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (hvK y hy hyL)
    obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, W = fun a y => ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det * (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b *
          partialDeriv b (fun z => w (ψ z)) y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hWa : ∀ a, W a = fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det * (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ a b *
          partialDeriv b (fun z => w (ψ z)) y := by intro a; rw [hWdef]
    have hW : ∀ a, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (W a) ψ.source := by
      intro a; rw [hWa]
      exact ContDiffOn.sum fun b _ => (hsq.mul (hGinv a b)).mul (hpd _ hV b)
    obtain ⟨Y, hYdef⟩ : ∃ Y : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ, Y = fun a y => v (ψ y) * W a y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hYa : ∀ a, Y a = fun y => v (ψ y) * W a y := by intro a; rw [hYdef]
    have hY : ∀ a, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Y a) ψ.source := by
      intro a; rw [hYa]
      exact (hζ.mul (hW a)).of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hY0 : ∀ a, ∀ y ∈ ψ.source, y ∉ L0 → Y a y = 0 := by
      intro a y hy hyL
      rw [hYa]
      show v (ψ y) * W a y = 0
      rw [hv0 y hy hyL, zero_mul]
    have hdivL := divergence_setIntegral_eq_zero ψ.source L0 ψ.open_source hL0 hL0s Y hY hY0
    have hpt : ∀ y ∈ ψ.source, ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (Y a) y =
        h.gradInner v w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det +
          v (ψ y) * h.lapM w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
      intro y hy
      have hprod : ∀ a, partialDeriv a (Y a) y =
          partialDeriv a (fun z => v (ψ z)) y * W a y +
            v (ψ y) * partialDeriv a (W a) y := by
        intro a
        rw [hYa a]
        simp only [partialDeriv]
        rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hdA _ hζ y hy) (hdA _ (hW a) y hy)]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      have hdiv : ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (W a) y =
          Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det * lapLoc (h.coeff ψ) (fun z => w (ψ z)) y := by
        rw [hWdef]
        exact lapLoc_div_form ψ.source ψ.open_source (h.coeff ψ) hG hsymm hpos _ hV y hy
      have hlap : h.lapM w (ψ y) = lapLoc (h.coeff ψ) (fun z => w (ψ z)) y := by
        rw [show h.lapM w (ψ y) = lapM h w (ψ y) from rfl,
          ← lapLocal_chart_invariant h ψ w Set.univ isOpen_univ hw.contMDiffOn y hy
            (Set.mem_univ _)]
        rfl
      have e1 : ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => v (ψ z)) y * W a y =
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (h.coeff ψ y)⁻¹ i j *
            partialDeriv i (fun z => v (ψ z)) y * partialDeriv j (fun z => w (ψ z)) y) *
            Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
        rw [hWdef]
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
        ring
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => hprod a, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
        hdiv, e1, gradInner_pdiffeo_formula h ψ v w hv hw y hy, hlap]
      ring
    have hsqc := (nds_chart_cont h ψ v w hv hw).2.2.2.1
    have hc1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => h.gradInner v w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det)
        ψ.source := (nds_chart_cont h ψ v w hv hw).2.2.1.mul hsqc
    have hc2 : ContinuousOn
        (fun y => v (ψ y) * h.lapM w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source :=
      ((hv.continuous.comp_continuousOn hψc).mul
        ((lapM_contMDiff h w hw).continuous.comp_continuousOn hψc)).mul hsqc
    have hi1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => h.gradInner v w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) L0 :=
      (hc1.mono hL0s).integrableOn_compact hL0
    have hi2 : IntegrableOn
        (fun y => v (ψ y) * h.lapM w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) L0 :=
      (hc2.mono hL0s).integrableOn_compact hL0
    have hsumL : ∫ y in L0, (h.gradInner v w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det +
          v (ψ y) * h.lapM w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det) = 0 :=
      (setIntegral_congr_fun hL0.isClosed.measurableSet
        fun y hy => (hpt y (hL0s hy)).symm).trans hdivL
    have hadd := integral_add hi1 hi2
    have e1 : ∫ y in ψ.source, h.gradInner v w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det =
        ∫ y in L0, h.gradInner v w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
      refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero ψ.open_source.measurableSet hL0s ?_
      intro y hy
      rw [hgv v (ψ y) (hvK y hy.1 hy.2), zero_mul]
    have e2 : ∫ y in ψ.source, v (ψ y) * h.lapM w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det =
        ∫ y in L0, v (ψ y) * h.lapM w (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff ψ y).det := by
      refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero ψ.open_source.measurableSet hL0s ?_
      intro y hy
      rw [hv0 y hy.1 hy.2, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    rw [e1, e2]
    linarith
  
  have hintg : ∀ i j, IntegrableOn (fun y => χ j (κ j y) * h.gradInner (u i) w (κ j y) *
      Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ j) y).det) (κ j).source := by
    intro i j
    have := cls_chart_integrable h (κ j) (χ j) (hχs j) (hχt j) Set.univ isClosed_univ
      (h.gradInner (u i) w) (nds_chart_cont h (κ j) (u i) w (hu i) hw).2.2.1 (K i) (hKc i)
      (fun p hp => by rw [Set.indicator_univ]; exact hgv _ p (fun h' => hp (htsK i h')))
    simpa only [Set.indicator_univ] using this
  have hsum : atlasInt h κ χ (fun p => ∑ i, h.gradInner (u i) w p) =
      ∑ i, ∫ y in (κ i).source, h.gradInner (u i) w (κ i y) *
        Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det := by
    have hlocI : ∀ i, atlasInt h κ χ (h.gradInner (u i) w) =
        ∫ y in (κ i).source, h.gradInner (u i) w (κ i y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det :=
      fun i => hloc (κ i) (K i) (L i) (hLc i) (hLs i) (hKt i) (hKL i) _
        (fun p hp => hgv _ p (fun h' => hp (htsK i h')))
        (nds_chart_cont h (κ i) (u i) w (hu i) hw).2.2.1
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => (hlocI i).symm]
    simp only [atlasInt]
    conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hintg i j)]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun (κ j).open_source.measurableSet fun y _ => ?_
    simp only
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hstep : ∀ i, ∫ y in (κ i).source, h.gradInner (u i) w (κ i y) *
        Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det =
      -∫ y in (κ i).source, χ i (κ i y) * (φ (κ i y) * h.lapM w (κ i y)) *
        Real.sqrt (h.coeff (κ i) y).det := by
    intro i
    rw [hgreen (κ i) (L i) (hLc i) (hLs i) (u i) (hu i)
      (fun y hy hyL h' => hKL i y hy hyL (htsK i h'))]
    congr 1
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun (κ i).open_source.measurableSet fun y _ => ?_
    simp only
    rw [hup]
    ring
  rw [hsplitG, hsum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hstep i, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  rfl

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_comp_apply
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : E3 → M)
    (τ : E3 → E3) (y : E3) (hτ : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y)
    (hΦ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ (τ y)) (i j : Fin 3) :
    g.coeff (Φ ∘ τ) y i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ τ y (e i) a * g.coeff Φ (τ y) a b * fderiv ℝ τ y (e j) b

subgoal_signatures.name: gradInner_pdiffeo_formula
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w)
    (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ κ.source) :
    g.gradInner u w (κ x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ i j * partialDeriv i (fun z => u (κ z)) x *
        partialDeriv j (fun z => w (κ z)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: nds_chart_cont
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (u w : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (hw : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (partialDeriv a (fun x => u (κ x))) κ.source) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => g.gradInner u w (κ x)) κ.source ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (g.coeff κ x).det) κ.source ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => (g.coeff κ x)⁻¹ a b) κ.source)

subgoal_signatures.name: divergence_setIntegral_eq_zero
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(U K : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKU : K ⊆ U) (Y : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (hY : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Y i) U)
    (hY0 : ∀ i : Fin 3, ∀ y ∈ U, y ∉ K → Y i y = 0) :
    ∫ y in K, ∑ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (Y i) y = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: lapLoc_div_form
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) U)
    (hsymm : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ U, (G x).PosDef) (v : E3 → ℝ) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v U) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Real.sqrt (G y).det * (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b v y) x =
      Real.sqrt (G x).det * lapLoc G v x

subgoal_signatures.name: lapLocal_chart_invariant
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : M → ℝ) (V : Set M) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f V) (x : E3) (hx : x ∈ Φ.source) (hxV : Φ x ∈ V) :
    lapLocal (g.coeff Φ) (f ∘ Φ) x = lapM g f (Φ x)

subgoal_signatures.name: lapM_contMDiff
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (fun p => g.lapM u p)

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_contDiffOn_source
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source

subgoal_signatures.name: coeff_posDef
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ φ.source) :
    (g.coeff φ y).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: flat_coeff_regular
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) :
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j) Ψ.source) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Ψ.source, ∀ i j : Fin 3, (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ i j = (g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹ j i) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ Ψ.source, ((g.coeff Ψ z)⁻¹).PosDef) ∧
    (∀ k i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel (g.coeff Ψ) k i j) Ψ.source)

subgoal_signatures.name: ccs_sqrtdet_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (T : Set E3) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => G z i j) T) (hdet : ∀ z ∈ T, 0 < (G z).det) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) T

subgoal_signatures.name: cls_chart_integrable
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (h : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (κ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : M → ℝ)
    (hχ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ χ) (hχt : tsupport χ ⊆ κ.target) (C : Set M)
    (hC : IsClosed C) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : ContinuousOn (fun y => f (κ y)) κ.source) (T : Set M)
    (hT : IsCompact T) (hCT : ∀ p, p ∉ T → C.indicator f p = 0) :
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun y => χ (κ y) * C.indicator f (κ y) * Real.sqrt (h.coeff κ y).det) κ.source

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (p₀ : M) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : f p₀ < a) :
    ∃ (T : Set M) (c : ℝ), IsCompact T ∧ 0 < c ∧ (∀ p ∈ T, f p ≤ a) ∧
      ∀ (G : M → ℝ) (b : ℝ),
        (∀ ψ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
          ContinuousOn (fun y => G (ψ' y)) ψ'.source) →
        (∀ p, 0 ≤ G p) → (∃ K : Set M, IsCompact K ∧ ∀ p, p ∉ K → G p = 0) →
        (∀ p ∈ T, b ≤ G p) → c * b ≤ atlasInt g κ χ (T.indicator G)

signature.name: clsp_local_lower
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (ρA : ℝ)
    {n : ℕ} (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)
    (hA : IsCLSAtlas g hAF ρA κ χ) (f : M → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) (p₀ : M) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : f p₀ < a) :
    ∃ (T : Set M) (c : ℝ), IsCompact T ∧ 0 < c ∧ (∀ p ∈ T, f p ≤ a) ∧
      ∀ (G : M → ℝ) (b : ℝ),
        (∀ ψ' : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
          ContinuousOn (fun y => G (ψ' y)) ψ'.source) →
        (∀ p, 0 ≤ G p) → (∃ K : Set M, IsCompact K ∧ ∀ p, p ∉ K → G p = 0) →
        (∀ p ∈ T, b ≤ G p) → c * b ≤ atlasInt g κ χ (T.indicator G)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hsum : ∑ i, χ i p₀ ≠ 0 := by rw [hA.2.2.2.1 p₀]; exact one_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hsum
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : ∃ ψ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞, ψ = κ i := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hp₀t : p₀ ∈ ψ.target := by
    rw [hψ]; exact hA.2.2.2.2.1 i (subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.2 hi))
  have hy₀ : ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm p₀ ∈ ψ.source := ψ.toPartialEquiv.map_target hp₀t
  have hψy₀ : ψ (ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm p₀) = p₀ := ψ.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hp₀t
  have hψc : ContinuousOn ψ ψ.source := ψ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn
  have hfψ : ContinuousOn (fun y => f (ψ y)) ψ.source := hf.comp_continuousOn hψc
  
  obtain ⟨O, hOdef⟩ : ∃ O : Set E3, O = ψ.source ∩ (fun y => f (ψ y)) ⁻¹' Set.Iio a :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hO : IsOpen O := by
    rw [hOdef]; exact hfψ.isOpen_inter_preimage ψ.open_source isOpen_Iio
  have hy₀O : ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm p₀ ∈ O := by
    rw [hOdef]
    refine ⟨hy₀, ?_⟩
    show f (ψ (ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm p₀)) < a
    rw [hψy₀]; exact ha
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hO _ hy₀O
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : Set E3,
      L = Metric.closedBall (ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm p₀) (r₁ / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hLO : L ⊆ O := by
    rw [hLdef]; exact (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (half_lt_self hr₁)).trans hball
  have hLψ : L ⊆ ψ.source := fun y hy => by
    have h1 := hLO hy; rw [hOdef] at h1; exact h1.1
  have hLf : ∀ y ∈ L, f (ψ y) < a := fun y hy => by
    have h1 := hLO hy; rw [hOdef] at h1; exact h1.2
  have hLc : IsCompact L := by rw [hLdef]; exact isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have hLm : MeasurableSet L := by rw [hLdef]; exact measurableSet_closedBall
  have hLn : L ∈ 𝓝 (ψ.toPartialEquiv.symm p₀) := by
    rw [hLdef]; exact Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds _ (half_pos hr₁)
  
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Set M, T = ψ '' L := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT : IsCompact T := by rw [hTdef]; exact hLc.image_of_continuousOn (hψc.mono hLψ)
  have hTcl : IsClosed T := hT.isClosed
  have hψT : ∀ y ∈ L, ψ y ∈ T := fun y hy => by rw [hTdef]; exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hy
  have hTf : ∀ p ∈ T, f p ≤ a := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hTdef] at hp
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hp
    exact (hLf y hy).le
  
  have hsd : ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) ψ.source :=
    (nds_chart_cont g ψ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) contMDiff_const
      contMDiff_const).2.2.2.1
  have hsdL := hsd.mono hLψ
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = ∫ y in L, Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    rw [hcdef, setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (hsdL.integrableOn_compact hLc)]
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (Measure.measure_pos_of_mem_nhds _ hLn) (measure_mono ?_)
    intro y hy
    exact ⟨(Real.sqrt_pos.2 (coeff_posDef g ψ y (hLψ hy)).det_pos).ne', hy⟩
  refine ⟨T, c, hT, hc, hTf, ?_⟩
  rintro G b hG hG0 ⟨K, hK, hGK⟩ hb
  have I₁ : IntegrableOn (fun y => b * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) L :=
    (continuousOn_const.mul hsdL).integrableOn_compact hLc
  have I₂ : IntegrableOn (fun y => T.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det) L := by
    refine ((((hG ψ).mono hLψ).mul hsdL).integrableOn_compact hLc).congr_fun ?_ hLm
    intro y hy
    simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem (hψT y hy)]
  have hmono : ∫ y in L, b * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det ≤
      ∫ y in L, T.indicator G (ψ y) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
    refine setIntegral_mono_on I₁ I₂ hLm fun y hy => ?_
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem (hψT y hy)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hb _ (hψT y hy)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hloc := cceb_localize_lower_ind g hAF ρA κ χ hA ψ L hLc hLψ G hG hG0 K hK hGK T hTcl
  calc c * b = ∫ y in L, b * Real.sqrt (g.coeff ψ y).det := by
        rw [integral_const_mul, hcdef, mul_comm]
    _ ≤ _ := hmono
    _ ≤ _ := hloc

    (κ : Fin n → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (χ : Fin n → M → ℝ)

      ContinuousOn (fun y => G (ψ' y)) ψ'.source)
    (hG0 : ∀ p, 0 ≤ G p) (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K) (hGK : ∀ p, p ∉ K → G p = 0)
    (C : Set M) (hC : IsClosed C) :

      atlasInt g κ χ (C.indicator G)

(c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c r))
    (hAs : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c r, ∀ a b : Fin 3, A x a b = A x b a)
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c r, (A x).PosDef)
    (P F : E3 → ℝ) (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P (Metric.ball c r))
    (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball c r))
    (v : E3 → ℝ) (Gr : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (vn : ℕ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hvn : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (vn m) (Metric.ball c r))
    (hvL : MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 2))))
    (hGL : ∀ a, MemLp (Gr a) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 2))))
    (hv0 : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 2), (vn m x - v x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hv1 : ∀ a, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 2),
      (partialDeriv a (vn m) x - Gr a x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c (r / 2) →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 2),
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * Gr b x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * v x + F x) * ζ x) = 0) :
    ∃ v' : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v' (Metric.ball c (r / 4)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4))), v x = v' x) ∧
      (∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4))),
        Gr a x = partialDeriv a v' x) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c (r / 4),
        ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, A y a b * partialDeriv b v' y) x
          = P x * v' x + F x

    (v : E3 → ℝ) (Gr : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (vn : ℕ → E3 → ℝ)

    (hv0 : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 2), (vn m x - v x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hv1 : ∀ a, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in Metric.ball c (r / 2),

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6⟩ := cir_translate_basic
  obtain ⟨M1, M2, M3⟩ := cir_translate_meas
  
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : E3, u = (c 0 - r) • e 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc' : (c - u) 0 = r := by rw [hu]; exact B6 c r
  have hH : ∀ ρ : ℝ, ρ ≤ r → fcrHalf (c - u) ρ = Metric.ball (c - u) ρ := fun ρ hρ =>
    B5 (c - u) r ρ hc'.ge hρ
  have hN : ndsHalf (c - u) r = Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 2) :=
    B5 (c - u) r (r / 2) hc'.ge (by linarith)
  have hcc : c - u - -u = c := by rw [sub_neg_eq_add, sub_add_cancel]
  
  have hAt : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A (x + u) a b) (Metric.ball (c - u) r) :=
    fun a b => B2 c u r (fun y => A y a b) (hA a b)
  have hAts : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (c - u) r, ∀ a b : Fin 3, A (x + u) a b = A (x + u) b a :=
    fun x hx a b => hAs (x + u) ((B1 c u x r).1 hx) a b
  have hAtpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (c - u) r, (A (x + u)).PosDef :=
    fun x hx => hApos (x + u) ((B1 c u x r).1 hx)
  have hPt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => P (x + u)) (Metric.ball (c - u) r) := B2 c u r P hP
  have hFt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => F (x + u)) (Metric.ball (c - u) r) := B2 c u r F hF
  have hvnt : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => vn m (x + u)) (Metric.ball (c - u) r) :=
    fun m => B2 c u r (vn m) (hvn m)
  have hvLt : MemLp (fun x => v (x + u)) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 2))) :=
    M1 c u (r / 2) v hvL
  have hGLt : ∀ a, MemLp (fun x => Gr a (x + u)) 2
      (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 2))) :=
    fun a => M1 c u (r / 2) (Gr a) (hGL a)
  have hv0t : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 2),
      (vn m (x + u) - v (x + u)) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    refine hv0.congr fun m => ?_
    exact (M2 c u (r / 2) (fun y => (vn m y - v y) ^ 2)).symm
  have hv1t : ∀ a, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 2),
      (partialDeriv a (fun y => vn m (y + u)) x - Gr a (x + u)) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro a
    refine (hv1 a).congr fun m => ?_
    refine Eq.trans (M2 c u (r / 2) (fun y => (partialDeriv a (vn m) y - Gr a y) ^ 2)).symm ?_
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_ball fun x _ => ?_
    simp only [B3 u x a (vn m)]
  have hwt : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 2) →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 2),
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A (x + u) a b * Gr b (x + u) * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P (x + u) * v (x + u) + F (x + u)) * ζ x) = 0 := by
    intro ζ h1 h2 h3
    obtain ⟨k1, k2, k3⟩ := B4 (c - u) (-u) (r / 2) ζ h1 h2 h3
    rw [hcc] at k3
    have h0 := hweak (fun y => ζ (y + -u)) k1 k2 k3
    refine Eq.trans ?_ ((M2 c u (r / 2) _).trans h0)
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_ball fun x _ => ?_
    have hz' : ζ (x + u + -u) = ζ x := by rw [add_neg_cancel_right]
    have hpd' : ∀ a : Fin 3,
        partialDeriv a (fun y => ζ (y + -u)) (x + u) = partialDeriv a ζ x := by
      intro a
      rw [← B3 u x a (fun y => ζ (y + -u))]
      simp only [add_neg_cancel_right]
    simp only [hz', hpd']
  
  have hw1 := fcr_weak_grad (c - u) r hr (fun x => v (x + u)) (fun a x => Gr a (x + u))
    (fun m x => vn m (x + u)) hvnt (by rw [hN]; exact hvLt) (by rw [hN]; exact hGLt)
    (by rw [hN]; exact hv0t) (by rw [hN]; exact hv1t)
  
  have hQ := fcr_prob_regularity (c - u) r (fun x => A (x + u)) hAt hAts hAtpos
  have hk := cir_sobolev_bootstrap (c - u) r (r / 2) (7 * r / 16) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (by linarith) (fun x => A (x + u)) (fun x => P (x + u)) (fun x => F (x + u)) hPt hFt hQ
    (fun x => v (x + u)) _ hw1
    (fun ζ h1 h2 h3 => by rw [hH (r / 2) (by linarith)]; exact hwt ζ h1 h2 h3)
  
  obtain ⟨v'', hv''sm, hae''⟩ := fcr_smooth_representative (c - u) (7 * r / 16) (3 * r / 8)
    (by linarith) (by linarith) (fun x => v (x + u)) hk
  rw [hH (3 * r / 8) (by linarith)] at hae''
  have hae3 : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball (c - u) (3 * r / 8))), v (x + u) = v'' x :=
    hae''
  have hae₄ : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 4))), v (x + u) = v'' x :=
    ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)) hae3
  
  have hw3 := cir_weak_shrink (c - u) (r / 2) (3 * r / 8) (by linarith) (fun x => A (x + u))
    (fun x => P (x + u)) (fun x => F (x + u)) (fun x => v (x + u)) v''
    (fun a x => Gr a (x + u)) hae3 hwt
  
  have hsub : Metric.ball (c - u) (3 * r / 8) ⊆ Metric.ball (c - u) r :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hs2 : Metric.ball (c - u) (3 * r / 8) ⊆ Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 2) :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hF' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => P (x + u) * v'' x + F (x + u))
      (Metric.ball (c - u) (3 * r / 8)) :=
    ((hPt.mono hsub).mul hv''sm.contDiffOn).add (hFt.mono hsub)
  obtain ⟨hstr, -⟩ := fcr_weak_to_strong (c - u) (3 * r / 8) (r / 4) (by linarith) (by linarith)
    (fun x => A (x + u)) (fun a b => (hAt a b).mono hsub) (fun x => P (x + u) * v'' x + F (x + u))
    hF' (fun x => v (x + u)) (fun a x => Gr a (x + u))
    (fun a => by
      rw [hH (3 * r / 8) (by linarith)]
      exact (hGLt a).mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono hs2 le_rfl))
    (fun a ζ h1 h2 h3 => hw1.2.2 [] a (by simp) ζ h1 h2 (h3.trans (by
      rw [hH (3 * r / 8) (by linarith), hH (r / 2) (by linarith)]; exact hs2)))
    (fun ζ h1 h2 h3 => by rw [hH (3 * r / 8) (by linarith)]; exact hw3 ζ h1 h2 h3)
    v'' hv''sm (by rw [hH (r / 4) (by linarith)]; exact hae₄)
  
  have hgr : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 4))),
      Gr a (x + u) = partialDeriv a v'' x := by
    intro a
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 2))) :=
      isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 measure_ball_lt_top.ne
    have hgI : IntegrableOn (fun x => Gr a (x + u)) (Metric.ball (c - u) (3 * r / 8)) :=
      IntegrableOn.mono_set ((hGLt a).integrable one_le_two) hs2
    have h := cir_grad_identify (Metric.ball (c - u) (3 * r / 8)) Metric.isOpen_ball
      (fun x => v (x + u)) v'' (fun x => Gr a (x + u)) a hv''sm hgI hae3
      (fun ζ h1 h2 h3 => hw1.2.2 [] a (by simp) ζ h1 h2 (h3.trans (by
        rw [hH (r / 2) (by linarith)]; exact hs2)))
    exact ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset (Metric.ball_subset_ball (by linarith)) h
  
  refine ⟨fun y => v'' (y + -u), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := B2 (c - u) (-u) (r / 4) v'' hv''sm.contDiffOn
    rwa [hcc] at h
  · have h := M3 (c - u) (-u) (r / 4) _ hae₄
    rw [hcc] at h
    refine h.mono fun y hy => ?_
    simpa only [neg_add_cancel_right] using hy
  · intro a
    have h := M3 (c - u) (-u) (r / 4) _ (hgr a)
    rw [hcc] at h
    refine h.mono fun y hy => ?_
    rw [B3 (-u) y a v'']
    simpa only [neg_add_cancel_right] using hy
  · intro y hy
    have hx : y + -u ∈ Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 4) :=
      (B1 c u (y + -u) (r / 4)).2 (by rw [neg_add_cancel_right]; exact hy)
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ (y + -u) 0 := by
      have hm : y + -u ∈ Metric.ball (c - u) (r / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} := by
        rw [B5 (c - u) r (r / 4) hc'.ge (by linarith)]; exact hx
      exact le_of_lt hm.2
    have h : ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a

      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_

      intro a
      rw [hfun a]
      exact B3 (-u) y a (fun w => ∑ b : Fin 3, A (w + u) a b * partialDeriv b v'' w)
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => hpa a, h, neg_add_cancel_right]

      rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hc (ε ^ 2) (pow_pos hε 2)

    have hGeq : MemLp.toLp (G : E3 → ℝ) (Lp.memLp G) = G := Lp.toLp_coeFn G (Lp.memLp G)
