signature.statement:
(c : E3) (ρ : ℝ) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (P F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c ρ))
    (hP : ContinuousOn P (Metric.ball c ρ)) (hF : ContinuousOn F (Metric.ball c ρ))
    (vn : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (v : E3 → ℝ) (Gr : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hvnL : ∀ n, MemLp (vn n) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)))
    (hdvnL : ∀ n (a : Fin 3), MemLp (partialDeriv a (vn n)) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)))
    (hvL : MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)))
    (hGL : ∀ a, MemLp (Gr a) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)))
    (hv0 : Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (vn n x - v x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hv1 : ∀ a, Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ,
      (partialDeriv a (vn n) x - Gr a x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hlim : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * partialDeriv b (vn n) x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * vn n x + F x) * ζ x)) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * Gr b x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * v x + F x) * ζ x) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
  have hBm : MeasurableSet (Metric.ball c ρ) := measurableSet_ball
  have hBf : volume (Metric.ball c ρ) < ⊤ := measure_ball_lt_top
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 hBf.ne
  
  have key : ∀ (g : E3 → ℝ) (M : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable g (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) →
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)), ‖g x‖ ≤ M) →
      ∀ (fn : ℕ → E3 → ℝ) (f : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ n, MemLp (fn n) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ))) →
      MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (fn n x - f x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) →
      Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, g x * fn n x) atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, g x * f x)) := by
    intro g M hg hgae0 fn f hfn hf ht
    obtain ⟨M', hM'⟩ : ∃ M', M' = max M 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hM'0 : 0 ≤ M' := by rw [hM']; exact le_max_right _ _
    have hgae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)), ‖g x‖ ≤ M' :=
      hgae0.mono fun x hx => hx.trans (by rw [hM']; exact le_max_left _ _)
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ : ∃ V : ℝ, V = ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (1 : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hV0 : 0 ≤ V := by rw [hV]; exact integral_nonneg fun _ => zero_le_one
    have hden : 0 < M' * V + 1 := by positivity
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = ε / (M' * V + 1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hδ0 : 0 < δ := by rw [hδ]; exact div_pos hε hden
    have hδeq : δ * (M' * V + 1) = ε := by rw [hδ]; exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden.ne'
    have hη : 0 < ε * δ / (M' + 1) := by positivity
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.1 ht) _ hη
    refine ⟨N, fun n hn => ?_⟩
    have han := hN n hn
    have ha0 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (fn n x - f x) ^ 2 :=
      integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg ha0] at han
    have hdL : MemLp (fun x => fn n x - f x) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) :=
      (hfn n).sub hf
    have hd2 : Integrable (fun x => (fn n x - f x) ^ 2) (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) :=
      hdL.integrable_sq
    have hi1 : Integrable (fun x => g x * fn n x) (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) :=
      ((hfn n).integrable one_le_two).bdd_mul hg hgae
    have hi2 : Integrable (fun x => g x * f x) (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) :=
      (hf.integrable one_le_two).bdd_mul hg hgae
    have hdiff : (∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, g x * fn n x) - ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, g x * f x
        = ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, g x * (fn n x - f x) := by
      rw [← integral_sub hi1 hi2]
      congr 1
      funext x
      ring
    have hone : Integrable (fun _ : E3 => (1 : ℝ)) (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) :=
      integrable_const _
    have hbnd_int : Integrable (fun x => M' * (fn n x - f x) ^ 2 + M' * δ ^ 2 * 1)
        (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) :=
      (hd2.const_mul M').add (hone.const_mul _)
    have hbnd_eq : ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (M' * (fn n x - f x) ^ 2 + M' * δ ^ 2 * 1)
        = M' * (∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (fn n x - f x) ^ 2) + M' * δ ^ 2 * V := by
      rw [integral_add (hd2.const_mul M') (hone.const_mul _), integral_const_mul,
        integral_const_mul, hV]
    have hpt : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)),
        ‖(2 * δ) * (g x * (fn n x - f x))‖ ≤ M' * (fn n x - f x) ^ 2 + M' * δ ^ 2 * 1 := by
      filter_upwards [hgae] with x hx
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hx ⊢
      have h2δ : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * δ := by positivity
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos h2δ, abs_mul]
      have h1 : |g x| * |fn n x - f x| ≤ M' * |fn n x - f x| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hx (abs_nonneg _)
      have h2 : 2 * δ * |fn n x - f x| ≤ (fn n x - f x) ^ 2 + δ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|fn n x - f x| - δ), sq_abs (fn n x - f x)]
      have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hM'0
      have h4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 h2δ.le
      nlinarith
    have hI := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le hbnd_int hpt
    have h2δ : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * δ := by positivity
    rw [integral_const_mul, hbnd_eq, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos h2δ] at hI
    rw [Real.dist_eq, hdiff]
    have h4 : (M' + 1) * (∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (fn n x - f x) ^ 2) < ε * δ := by
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)] at han
      linarith
    have h3 : M' * (∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (fn n x - f x) ^ 2)
        ≤ (M' + 1) * (∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (fn n x - f x) ^ 2) := by nlinarith
    have h6 : δ * (M' * V) < ε := by
      have : δ * (M' * V) = ε - δ := by rw [← hδeq]; ring
      linarith
    have h7 : M' * δ ^ 2 * V < δ * ε := by
      have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h6 hδ0
      nlinarith
    have h8 : 2 * δ * |∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, g x * (fn n x - f x)| < 2 * δ * ε := by
      linarith
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h8 h2δ.le
  
  have hKc : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc
  have hζcont : Continuous ζ := hζ.continuous
  have hdζ : ∀ a : Fin 3, Continuous (partialDeriv a ζ) := fun a =>
    (hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hdζ0 : ∀ a : Fin 3, ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → partialDeriv a ζ x = 0 := by
    intro a x hx
    have hd0 : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hx (support_fderiv_subset ℝ hne)
    simp only [partialDeriv, hd0, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  have hζ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → ζ x = 0 := fun x hx => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
  
  have wbound : ∀ w : E3 → ℝ, ContinuousOn w (Metric.ball c ρ) →
      (∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → w x = 0) →
      ∃ M : ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable w (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) ∧
        ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)), ‖w x‖ ≤ M := by
    intro w hw hw0
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hw.mono hζs)
    refine ⟨max C 0, hw.aestronglyMeasurable hBm, ?_⟩
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_
    by_cases hxK : x ∈ tsupport ζ
    · exact (hC x hxK).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · rw [hw0 x hxK, norm_zero]; exact le_max_right _ _
  have hwab : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ∃ M : ℝ,
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => A x a b * partialDeriv a ζ x)
        (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) ∧
      ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)), ‖A x a b * partialDeriv a ζ x‖ ≤ M :=
    fun a b => wbound _ ((hA a b).mul (hdζ a).continuousOn)
      (fun x hx => by simp only [hdζ0 a x hx, mul_zero])
  choose Mab hMab using hwab
  obtain ⟨MP, hPm, hPb⟩ := wbound (fun x => P x * ζ x) (hP.mul hζcont.continuousOn)
    (fun x hx => by simp only [hζ0 x hx, mul_zero])
  obtain ⟨MF, hFm, hFb⟩ := wbound (fun x => F x * ζ x) (hF.mul hζcont.continuousOn)
    (fun x hx => by simp only [hζ0 x hx, mul_zero])
  have hFi : Integrable (fun x => F x * ζ x) (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) :=
    Integrable.of_bound hFm MF hFb
  
  have split : ∀ (D : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (u : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ b, Integrable (D b) (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ))) →
      Integrable u (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * D b x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * u x + F x) * ζ x)
      = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ,
            (A x a b * partialDeriv a ζ x) * D b x)
        + (∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (P x * ζ x) * u x)
        + ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, F x * ζ x := by
    intro D u hD hu
    have hiab : ∀ a b : Fin 3, Integrable (fun x => (A x a b * partialDeriv a ζ x) * D b x)
        (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) :=
      fun a b => (hD b).bdd_mul (hMab a b).1 (hMab a b).2
    have hiP : Integrable (fun x => (P x * ζ x) * u x) (volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ)) :=
      hu.bdd_mul hPm hPb
    have hpt : (fun x => ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * D b x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * u x + F x) * ζ x))
        = fun x => (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (A x a b * partialDeriv a ζ x) * D b x)
          + (P x * ζ x) * u x + F x * ζ x := by
      funext x
      have : ∀ a b : Fin 3, A x a b * D b x * partialDeriv a ζ x
          = (A x a b * partialDeriv a ζ x) * D b x := fun a b => by ring
      simp only [this]
      ring
    rw [hpt, integral_add _ hFi, integral_add _ hiP, integral_finset_sum]
    · congr 2
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      exact integral_finset_sum _ fun b _ => hiab a b
    · exact fun a _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun b _ => hiab a b
    · exact integrable_finset_sum _ fun a _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun b _ => hiab a b
    · exact (integrable_finset_sum _ fun a _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun b _ => hiab a b).add
        hiP
  have hIn : ∀ n, ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * partialDeriv b (vn n) x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * vn n x + F x) * ζ x)
      = (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ,
            (A x a b * partialDeriv a ζ x) * partialDeriv b (vn n) x)
        + (∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, (P x * ζ x) * vn n x)
        + ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, F x * ζ x := fun n =>
    split (fun b => partialDeriv b (vn n)) (vn n)
      (fun b => (hdvnL n b).integrable one_le_two) ((hvnL n).integrable one_le_two)
  have hJ := split Gr v (fun b => (hGL b).integrable one_le_two) (hvL.integrable one_le_two)
  have hT := ((tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ fun a _ => tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ
      fun b _ => key _ (Mab a b) (hMab a b).1 (hMab a b).2 (fun n => partialDeriv b (vn n))
        (Gr b) (fun n => hdvnL n b) (hGL b) (hv1 b)).add
    (key _ MP hPm hPb vn v hvnL hvL hv0)).add
    (tendsto_const_nhds (x := ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ, F x * ζ x))
  rw [← hJ] at hT
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique (hT.congr fun n => (hIn n).symm) (hlim ζ hζ hζc hζs)

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (s : ℝ) (j : Fin P.n) :
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
        (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x) *
        Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j)

signature.name: pcgb_bulk_curv_integrable
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (s : ℝ) (j : Fin P.n) :
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
        (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x) *
        Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hs : IsOpen (P.W j) := P.W_open j
  have hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => P.h j x a c) (P.W j) := P.h_smooth j
  have hinf : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (P.W j) → ∀ c : Fin 2,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 c f) (P.W j) := by
    intro f hf c
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) (P.W j) :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hs).1 hf).2
    exact hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdet : ∀ y ∈ P.W j, (P.h j y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (P.h_posDef j y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (P.h j y).det) (P.W j) := by
    have heq : (fun y => (P.h j y).det) =
        fun y => P.h j y 0 0 * P.h j y 1 1 - P.h j y 0 1 * P.h j y 1 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_two (P.h j y)
    rw [heq]
    exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have hadj : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (P.h j y).adjugate a c) (P.W j) := by
    intro a c
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] <;>
      first | exact hh _ _ | exact (hh _ _).neg
  have hinv : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (P.h j y)⁻¹ a c) (P.W j) := by
    intro a c
    have heq : (fun y => (P.h j y)⁻¹ a c) =
        fun y => ((P.h j y).det)⁻¹ * (P.h j y).adjugate a c := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact (hdetS.inv hdet).mul (hadj a c)
  have hchr : ∀ k a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 (P.h j) k a c) (P.W j) := by
    intro k a c
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ k l *
      (pd2 a (fun z => P.h j z c l) x + pd2 c (fun z => P.h j z a l) x
        - pd2 l (fun z => P.h j z a c) x)) (P.W j)
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hinv k l).mul
      (((hinf _ (hh c l) a).add (hinf _ (hh a l) c)).sub (hinf _ (hh a c) l)))
  have hchrC : ∀ k a c : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (christoffel2 (P.h j) k a c) (P.W j) :=
    fun k a c => (hchr k a c).continuousOn
  have hdchr : ∀ d k a c : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (pd2 d (christoffel2 (P.h j) k a c)) (P.W j) :=
    fun d k a c => (hinf _ (hchr k a c) d).continuousOn
  have hric : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (ricci2 (P.h j) a c) (P.W j) := by
    intro a c
    show ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2,
        (pd2 i (christoffel2 (P.h j) i a c) x - pd2 a (christoffel2 (P.h j) i i c) x)
      + ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ p : Fin 2,
          (christoffel2 (P.h j) i i p x * christoffel2 (P.h j) p a c x
            - christoffel2 (P.h j) i a p x * christoffel2 (P.h j) p i c x)) (P.W j)
    exact (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => (hdchr i i a c).sub (hdchr a i i c)).add
      (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun i _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun p _ =>
        ((hchrC i i p).mul (hchrC p a c)).sub ((hchrC i a p).mul (hchrC p i c)))
  have hKc : ContinuousOn (gaussCurv2 (P.h j)) (P.W j) := by
    show ContinuousOn
      (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * ricci2 (P.h j) a c x)
      (P.W j)
    exact continuousOn_const.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ =>
      continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun c _ => (hinv a c).continuousOn.mul (hric a c))
  have hρc : ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x)) (P.W j) := (hρs j j).continuousOn
  have hηc : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s)) (P.W j) :=
    Real.smoothTransition.continuous.comp_continuousOn ((hb j).continuousOn.div_const s)
  have hdA : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j) :=
    hdetS.continuousOn.sqrt
  have hA : ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
      (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x) *
      Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j) :=
    (hρc.mul (hηc.mul hKc)).mul hdA
  have hAK : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
      (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x) *
      Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (Kc j) :=
    (hA.mono (hK j).2).integrableOn_compact (hK j).1
  refine hAK.of_forall_diff_eq_zero hs.measurableSet ?_
  intro x hx
  rw [hρK j x hx.1 hx.2]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (b w : X → ℝ)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (s : ℝ) (j : Fin P.n)
    (hA : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
        (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x) *
        Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j)) :
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
        (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * gaussCurv2 (P.h j) x *
          (ε / (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x + ε))) *
        Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j)

signature.name: pcgb_bulk_defect_integrable
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (b w : X → ℝ)
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (s : ℝ) (j : Fin P.n)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hWm : MeasurableSet (P.W j) := (P.W_open j).measurableSet
  have hent : ∀ u v : Fin 2, AEMeasurable (fun x => P.h j x u v)
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (P.W j)) :=
    fun u v => ((P.h_smooth j u v).continuousOn.aestronglyMeasurable hWm).aemeasurable
  have hinv_eq : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (a c : Fin 2),
      A⁻¹ a c = (A.det)⁻¹ * A.adjugate a c := by
    intro A a c
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hdet : AEMeasurable (fun x => ((P.h j x).det)⁻¹)
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (P.W j)) := by
    have hd : (fun x => (P.h j x).det) =
        fun x => P.h j x 0 0 * P.h j x 1 1 - P.h j x 0 1 * P.h j x 1 0 := by
      funext x; exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
    have h1 : AEMeasurable (fun x => (P.h j x).det) (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (P.W j)) := by
      rw [hd]
      exact ((hent 0 0).mul (hent 1 1)).sub ((hent 0 1).mul (hent 1 0))
    exact h1.inv
  have hadj : ∀ a c : Fin 2, AEMeasurable (fun x => (P.h j x).adjugate a c)
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (P.W j)) := by
    intro a c
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] <;>
      first
        | exact hent _ _
        | exact (hent _ _).neg
  have hinvE : ∀ a c : Fin 2, AEMeasurable (fun x => (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c)
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (P.W j)) := by
    intro a c
    simp_rw [hinv_eq]
    exact hdet.mul (hadj a c)
  have hp : ∀ a : Fin 2, Measurable (fun x => pd2 a (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x) :=
    fun a => measurable_fderiv_apply_const ℝ _ _
  have hG : AEMeasurable (fun x => sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x)
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (P.W j)) := by
    simp only [sgbGradSq2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    exact ((((hinvE 0 0).mul (hp 0).aemeasurable).mul (hp 0).aemeasurable).add
      (((hinvE 0 1).mul (hp 0).aemeasurable).mul (hp 1).aemeasurable)).add
      ((((hinvE 1 0).mul (hp 1).aemeasurable).mul (hp 0).aemeasurable).add
      (((hinvE 1 1).mul (hp 1).aemeasurable).mul (hp 1).aemeasurable))
  have hf : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun x => ε / (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x + ε))
      (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (P.W j)) :=
    ((hG.add_const ε).const_div ε).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂(MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (P.W j)),
      ‖ε / (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x + ε)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    refine MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hWm (fun x hx => ?_)
    have hG0 : 0 ≤ sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x := by
      have hpsd := (P.h_posDef j x hx).inv.posSemidef
      have hq := hpsd.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg (fun a => pd2 a (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x)
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, star_trivial] at hq
      simp only [sgbGradSq2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring_nf at hq ⊢
      linarith
    have hpos : 0 < sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x + ε := by linarith
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ε / (sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x + ε) :=
      div_nonneg hε.le hpos.le
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hnn]
    exact (div_le_one hpos).mpr (by linarith)
  have key := MeasureTheory.Integrable.bdd_mul (c := 1) hA hf hbound
  refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.congr key (MeasureTheory.ae_of_all _ (fun x => ?_))
  simp only
  ring

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have quad : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.PosDef →
      (∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b) ∧
      (∀ H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ, 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
          A⁻¹ a c * A⁻¹ b d * H a b * H c d) := by
    intro A hA
    have hB : A⁻¹.PosDef := hA.inv
    have hsym : A⁻¹ 1 0 = A⁻¹ 0 1 := by
      have h := hB.isHermitian.apply 0 1
      simpa using h
    have hp : 0 < A⁻¹ 0 0 := hB.diag_pos
    have hdet : 0 < A⁻¹.det := hB.det_pos
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsym] at hdet
    have hδ : 0 < A⁻¹ 0 0 * A⁻¹ 1 1 - A⁻¹ 0 1 ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have key1 : ∀ ξ : Fin 2 → ℝ,
        A⁻¹ 0 0 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b) =
          (A⁻¹ 0 0 * ξ 0 + A⁻¹ 0 1 * ξ 1) ^ 2 +
            (A⁻¹ 0 0 * A⁻¹ 1 1 - A⁻¹ 0 1 ^ 2) * ξ 1 ^ 2 := by
      intro ξ
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym]
      ring
    have key2 : ∀ H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ,
        A⁻¹ 0 0 ^ 2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
          A⁻¹ a c * A⁻¹ b d * H a b * H c d) =
          (A⁻¹ 0 0 ^ 2 * H 0 0 + A⁻¹ 0 0 * A⁻¹ 0 1 * H 0 1 + A⁻¹ 0 0 * A⁻¹ 0 1 * H 1 0
              + A⁻¹ 0 1 ^ 2 * H 1 1) ^ 2
            + (A⁻¹ 0 0 * A⁻¹ 1 1 - A⁻¹ 0 1 ^ 2) * (A⁻¹ 0 0 * H 0 1 + A⁻¹ 0 1 * H 1 1) ^ 2
            + (A⁻¹ 0 0 * A⁻¹ 1 1 - A⁻¹ 0 1 ^ 2) * (A⁻¹ 0 0 * H 1 0 + A⁻¹ 0 1 * H 1 1) ^ 2
            + (A⁻¹ 0 0 * A⁻¹ 1 1 - A⁻¹ 0 1 ^ 2) ^ 2 * H 1 1 ^ 2 := by
      intro H
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym]
      ring
    refine ⟨fun ξ => ?_, fun H => ?_⟩
    · have h1 := key1 ξ
      have h2 : 0 ≤ A⁻¹ 0 0 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a b * ξ a * ξ b) := by
        rw [h1]
        exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hδ.le (sq_nonneg _))
      exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h2 hp
    · have h1 := key2 H
      have h2 : 0 ≤ A⁻¹ 0 0 ^ 2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
          A⁻¹ a c * A⁻¹ b d * H a b * H c d) := by
        rw [h1]
        exact add_nonneg (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
          (mul_nonneg hδ.le (sq_nonneg _))) (mul_nonneg hδ.le (sq_nonneg _)))
          (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
      exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h2 (pow_pos hp 2)
  
  have alg : ∀ (r η dA K G HS : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → 0 ≤ η → 0 ≤ dA → 0 ≤ G → 0 ≤ HS →
      r * (η * K) * dA ≤ r * (η * K * (ε / (G + ε))) * dA +
        r * (η * (K * G / (G + ε) + ε * HS / (G + ε) ^ 2)) * dA := by
    intro r η dA K G HS hr hη hdA hG hHS
    have hQ : 0 < G + ε := by linarith
    have e1 : K * (ε / (G + ε)) + K * G / (G + ε) = K := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have e2 : 0 ≤ ε * HS / (G + ε) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hc : 0 ≤ r * η * dA := by positivity
    have hdiff : r * (η * K * (ε / (G + ε))) * dA +
        r * (η * (K * G / (G + ε) + ε * HS / (G + ε) ^ 2)) * dA - r * (η * K) * dA =
        r * η * dA * (K * (ε / (G + ε)) + K * G / (G + ε) - K) +
          r * η * dA * (ε * HS / (G + ε) ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [e1, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_add] at hdiff
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hc e2]
  rcases le_or_gt (b (P.param j x)) 0 with hβ | hβ
  · have h0 : Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) = 0 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hβ hs.le)
    rw [h0]
    simp
  · have hO1 : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) :=
      (hb j).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) isOpen_Ioi
    have hOo : IsOpen ((P.W j ∩ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) ∩
        P.param j ⁻¹' {Gd.p₀}ᶜ) :=
      ((P.param_cont j).mono Set.inter_subset_left).isOpen_inter_preimage hO1
        isOpen_compl_singleton
    have hxO : x ∈ (P.W j ∩ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) ∩
        P.param j ⁻¹' {Gd.p₀}ᶜ := ⟨⟨hx, hβ⟩, hxp⟩
    have hOW : (P.W j ∩ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) ∩
        P.param j ⁻¹' {Gd.p₀}ᶜ ⊆ P.W j := fun y hy => hy.1.1
    have hOd : (P.W j ∩ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi 0) ∩
        P.param j ⁻¹' {Gd.p₀}ᶜ ⊆ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (Gd.U \ {Gd.p₀}) := by
      intro y hy
      have hyb : 0 < b (P.param j y) := hy.1.2
      have hyp : P.param j y ≠ Gd.p₀ := hy.2
      refine ⟨hy.1.1, ?_, hyp⟩
      have hS : P.param j y ∈ S := by
        have hmem : P.param j y ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨y, hy.1.1, rfl⟩
        rw [P.image_eq j] at hmem
        exact hmem.2
      exact Gd.R_sub ⟨hS, le_of_lt hyb⟩
    have hK := hkato _ hOo (P.h j) (fun a b' => (P.h_smooth j a b').mono hOW)
      (fun y hy => P.h_posDef j y (hOW hy)) (fun z => Gd.w (P.param j z))
      ((Gd.smooth j).mono hOd)
      (fun y hy => Gd.harm j y (hOW hy) (le_of_lt (show 0 < b (P.param j y) from hy.1.2))
        (show P.param j y ≠ Gd.p₀ from hy.2)) ε hε x hxO
    rw [hK]
    obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := quad (P.h j x) (P.h_posDef j x hx)
    have hG : 0 ≤ sgbGradSq2 (P.h j) (fun z => Gd.w (P.param j z)) x := by
      unfold sgbGradSq2
      exact hq1 (fun a => pd2 a (fun z => Gd.w (P.param j z)) x)
    exact alg _ _ _ _ _ _ (hρnn j _) (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hG
      (hq2 (fun a b' => pd2 a (pd2 b' (fun z => Gd.w (P.param j z))) x -
        ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 (P.h j) k a b' x * pd2 k (fun z => Gd.w (P.param j z)) x))

    (hreg : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) = 0 →

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq0⟩ := hbd
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (P.cover hq)
  have hq' : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq]; exact ⟨hj, hq⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxq⟩ := hq'
  set f : E2 → ℝ := fun y => b (P.param j y) with hfdef
  have hfx : f x = 0 := by simp only [hfdef, hxq, hq0]
  have hnmax : ¬ IsLocalMax f x := fun hmax =>
    hreg j x hx (by simpa [hfdef] using hfx) hmax.fderiv_eq_zero
  have hfreq : ∃ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ¬ (f y ≤ f x) := Filter.not_eventually.mp hnmax
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁f, hx₁W⟩ :=
    (hfreq.and_eventually ((P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx)).exists
  have hβ : 0 < f x₁ := by rw [hfx] at hx₁f; exact not_le.mp hx₁f
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (P.W_open j) x₁ hx₁W
  have hcont : ContinuousAt f x₁ :=
    (hb j).continuousOn.continuousAt ((P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx₁W)
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hδ₂f⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont (f x₁ / 2) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨j, x₁, min (min (δ₁ / 2) (δ₂ / 2)) (f x₁ / 4), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact lt_min (lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)) (by linarith)
  · intro y hy
    apply hball
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hy
    rw [Metric.mem_ball]
    have h1 := min_le_left (min (δ₁ / 2) (δ₂ / 2)) (f x₁ / 4)
    have h2 := min_le_left (δ₁ / 2) (δ₂ / 2)
    linarith
  · intro y hy
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hy
    have h1 := min_le_left (min (δ₁ / 2) (δ₂ / 2)) (f x₁ / 4)
    have h2 := min_le_right (δ₁ / 2) (δ₂ / 2)
    have h3 := min_le_right (min (δ₁ / 2) (δ₂ / 2)) (f x₁ / 4)
    have hd : dist y x₁ < δ₂ := by linarith
    have h4 := hδ₂f hd
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at h4
    have h5 := (abs_lt.mp h4).1
    show 2 * min (min (δ₁ / 2) (δ₂ / 2)) (f x₁ / 4) ≤ f y
    linarith

    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)

      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ (W \ {x₀}) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (W \ {x₀}) ∧
      (∀ x : E2, ρ ≤ dist x x₀ → Λ x = 0 ∧ F x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ W, x ≠ x₀ → lap2 h Λ x = -F x) ∧
      (∀ x y : E2, |F x - F y| ≤ K * dist x y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∧

        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)))
        (Metric.ball x₀ ρ \ {x₀}) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, x ≠ x₀ →
        |Λ x - Real.log (Real.sqrt
          (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) c))| ≤ C ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => Λ y - Real.log (Real.sqrt
          (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c))) x‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Λ y - Real.log (Real.sqrt
          (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)))) x‖ ≤
          C / Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) c)

signature.name: pcgb_chart_parametrix
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (x₀ : E2) (R₀ : ℝ) (hR₀ : 0 < R₀)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ R₀ ⊆ W) :
    ∃ (Λ F : E2 → ℝ) (ρ C K : ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ ρ ≤ R₀ ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ (W \ {x₀}) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (W \ {x₀}) ∧
      (∀ x : E2, ρ ≤ dist x x₀ → Λ x = 0 ∧ F x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ W, x ≠ x₀ → lap2 h Λ x = -F x) ∧
      (∀ x y : E2, |F x - F y| ≤ K * dist x y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Λ y - Real.log (Real.sqrt
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)))
        (Metric.ball x₀ ρ \ {x₀}) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ ρ, x ≠ x₀ →
        |Λ x - Real.log (Real.sqrt
          (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) c))| ≤ C ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => Λ y - Real.log (Real.sqrt
          (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c))) x‖ ≤ C ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Λ y - Real.log (Real.sqrt
          (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)))) x‖ ≤
          C / Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) c)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hx₀W : x₀ ∈ W := hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR₀.le)
  have hH : (h x₀).PosDef := hpd x₀ hx₀W
  obtain ⟨D, M, σ, c₀, K₁, hσ, hσR, hσ1, hc₀, hK₁, hMs, hDs, hjet⟩ :=
    pcgb_parametrix_jet W hW h hh hpd x₀ R₀ hR₀ hball
  obtain ⟨hψs, Kψ, hKψ, hψ⟩ := pcgb_log_quad_correction (h x₀) M hH hMs x₀
  have hballσ : Metric.closedBall x₀ σ ⊆ W :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hσR).trans hball
  have hΩo : IsOpen (Metric.ball x₀ σ \ {x₀}) := Metric.isOpen_ball.sdiff isClosed_singleton
  have hΩmem : ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < σ → x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ σ \ {x₀} := by
    intro x h1 h2
    refine ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr h2, ?_⟩
    intro he
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at he
    rw [he, dist_self] at h1
    exact lt_irrefl _ h1
  have hDpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ σ \ {x₀}, 0 < D x := by
    intro x hx
    have h2 : dist x x₀ < σ := Metric.mem_ball.mp hx.1
    have hne : x ≠ x₀ := hx.2
    have h1 : 0 < dist x x₀ := dist_pos.mpr hne
    have h3 := (hjet x h1 h2).1
    have h4 : 0 < c₀ * dist x x₀ ^ 2 := by positivity
    linarith
  have hD2 : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 D (Metric.ball x₀ σ \ {x₀}) :=
    hDs.contDiffOn.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
  have hid : ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < σ →
      lap2 h (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y)) x =
        lap2 h D x / (2 * D x) -
          (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a D x * pd2 c D x) / (2 * D x ^ 2) :=
    fun x h1 h2 => pcgb_lap2_half_log _ hΩo h D hD2 hDpos x (hΩmem x h1 h2)
  have hlap : ∀ (u : E2 → ℝ) (V : Set E2), IsOpen V → V ⊆ W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lap2 h u) V :=
    fun u V hV hVW hu => pcgb_lap2_contDiffOn V hV h (fun a c => (hh a c).mono hVW)
      (fun x hx => hpd x (hVW hx)) u hu
  obtain ⟨Λ₀, hΛ₀⟩ : ∃ f : E2 → ℝ,
      f = fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y) - pcgbPxPsi (h x₀) M x₀ y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨cst, K', hK', hcore⟩ := pcgb_parametrix_estimate_core W hW h hh hpd x₀ σ hσ hσ1
    hballσ D M hMs c₀ K₁ Kψ hc₀ hK₁ hKψ hlap hDs hψs hjet hψ hid Λ₀ (fun y => by rw [hΛ₀])
  have hΛ₀s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ₀ (Metric.ball x₀ σ \ {x₀}) := by
    rw [hΛ₀]
    exact (contDiffOn_const.mul (hDs.contDiffOn.log (fun x hx => (hDpos x hx).ne'))).sub
      (hψs.mono (fun x hx => hx.2))
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρdef⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = min R₀ σ / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmin0 : 0 < min R₀ σ := lt_min hR₀ hσ
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by rw [hρdef]; exact half_pos hmin0
  have hρR : ρ ≤ R₀ := by have := min_le_left R₀ σ; rw [hρdef]; linarith
  have hρσ : ρ < σ := by have := min_le_right R₀ σ; rw [hρdef]; linarith
  have hdc : Continuous fun y : E2 => dist y x₀ := continuous_id.dist continuous_const
  obtain ⟨χ, hχdef⟩ : ∃ χ : E2 → ℝ, χ = fun x =>
      Real.smoothTransition ((9 * ρ ^ 2 - 16 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ 2) / (5 * ρ ^ 2)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hχs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ := by
    rw [hχdef]
    exact (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).comp
      ((contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul
        ((contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)))).div_const _)
  have hχ0 : ∀ x : E2, 3 * ρ / 4 ≤ dist x x₀ → χ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hχdef]
    show Real.smoothTransition ((9 * ρ ^ 2 - 16 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ 2) / (5 * ρ ^ 2)) = 0
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    refine div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg ?_ (by positivity)
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    have h4 : 3 * ρ ≤ 4 * dist x x₀ := by linarith
    nlinarith [mul_self_le_mul_self (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 3 * ρ) h4]
  have hχ1 : ∀ x : E2, dist x x₀ ≤ ρ / 2 → χ x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hχdef]
    show Real.smoothTransition ((9 * ρ ^ 2 - 16 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ 2) / (5 * ρ ^ 2)) = 1
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity), ← dist_eq_norm]
    have h0 : 0 ≤ dist x x₀ := dist_nonneg
    nlinarith [mul_self_le_mul_self h0 hx]
  
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛdef⟩ : ∃ Λ : E2 → ℝ, Λ = fun x => χ x * Λ₀ x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΛ0 : ∀ x : E2, 3 * ρ / 4 ≤ dist x x₀ → Λ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hΛdef]
    simp only [hχ0 x hx, zero_mul]
  have hfar_open : IsOpen {y : E2 | 3 * ρ / 4 < dist y x₀} := isOpen_lt continuous_const hdc
  have hΛs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Λ {x₀}ᶜ := by
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro x hx
    rcases lt_or_ge (dist x x₀) σ with hxs | hxs
    · refine ⟨Metric.ball x₀ σ \ {x₀}, hΩo, ⟨Metric.mem_ball.mpr hxs, hx⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hΛdef]
      exact ((hχs.contDiffOn).mul hΛ₀s).mono Set.inter_subset_right
    · refine ⟨{y : E2 | 3 * ρ / 4 < dist y x₀}, hfar_open, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show 3 * ρ / 4 < dist x x₀
        linarith
      · refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℝ))).congr ?_
        intro y hy
        exact hΛ0 y hy.2.le
  
  have hgerm : ∀ (u v : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), u =ᶠ[𝓝 x] v → lap2 h u x = lap2 h v x := by
    intro u v x huv
    have h1 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k u x = pd2 k v x := by
      intro k
      show fderiv ℝ u x (e2 k) = fderiv ℝ v x (e2 k)
      rw [huv.fderiv_eq]
    have h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j u) x = pd2 i (pd2 j v) x := by
      intro i j
      have hev : pd2 j u =ᶠ[𝓝 x] pd2 j v := by
        filter_upwards [huv.eventuallyEq_nhds] with y hy
        show fderiv ℝ u y (e2 j) = fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)
        rw [hy.fderiv_eq]
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j u) x (e2 i) = fderiv ℝ (pd2 j v) x (e2 i)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    unfold lap2
    simp only [h1, h2]
  have hz : ∀ j : Fin 2, pd2 j (fun _ : E2 => (0:ℝ)) = fun _ => 0 := by
    intro j
    funext y
    simp [pd2]
  have hlap0 : ∀ x : E2, lap2 h (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) x = 0 := fun x => by
    simp only [lap2, hz]
    simp [pd2]
  have hlapfar : ∀ x : E2, 3 * ρ / 4 < dist x x₀ → lap2 h Λ x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hgerm Λ (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) x ?_, hlap0]
    filter_upwards [hfar_open.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact hΛ0 y (le_of_lt hy)
  have hWo : IsOpen (W \ {x₀}) := hW.sdiff isClosed_singleton
  have hLs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lap2 h Λ) {x₀}ᶜ := by
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxW : x ∈ W
    · refine ⟨W \ {x₀}, hWo, ⟨hxW, hx⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (hlap Λ (W \ {x₀}) hWo Set.diff_subset
        (hΛs.mono (fun y hy => hy.2))).mono Set.inter_subset_right
    · have hxR : R₀ < dist x x₀ := by
        by_contra hc
        push_neg at hc
        exact hxW (hball (Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr hc))
      refine ⟨{y : E2 | 3 * ρ / 4 < dist y x₀}, hfar_open, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show 3 * ρ / 4 < dist x x₀
        linarith
      · exact (contDiffOn_const (c := (0:ℝ))).congr (fun y hy => hlapfar y hy.2)
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : E2 → ℝ, F = fun x => if x = x₀ then -cst else -lap2 h Λ x :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hFx : ∀ x : E2, x ≠ x₀ → F x = -lap2 h Λ x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hFdef]
    simp only [if_neg hx]
  have hFx₀ : F x₀ = -cst := by
    rw [hFdef]
    simp
  have hFeqO : ∀ x : E2, x ≠ x₀ → F =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => -lap2 h Λ y := by
    intro x hx
    filter_upwards [isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact hFx y hy
  have hFs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F {x₀}ᶜ := hLs.neg.congr (fun y hy => hFx y hy)
  have hnear : ∀ x : E2, dist x x₀ < ρ / 2 → Λ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] Λ₀ := by
    intro x hx
    filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hx)] with y hy
    rw [hΛdef]
    simp only [hχ1 y (Metric.mem_ball.mp hy).le, one_mul]
  have hnearL : ∀ x : E2, dist x x₀ < ρ / 2 → lap2 h Λ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] lap2 h Λ₀ := by
    intro x hx
    filter_upwards [Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hx)] with y hy
    exact hgerm Λ Λ₀ y (hnear y (Metric.mem_ball.mp hy))
  
  have hA : IsCompact {y : E2 | ρ / 2 ≤ dist y x₀ ∧ dist y x₀ ≤ ρ} := by
    refine (isCompact_closedBall x₀ ρ).of_isClosed_subset ?_ ?_
    · exact (isClosed_le continuous_const hdc).inter (isClosed_le hdc continuous_const)
    · intro y hy
      exact Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr hy.2
  have hAO : {y : E2 | ρ / 2 ≤ dist y x₀ ∧ dist y x₀ ≤ ρ} ⊆ {x₀}ᶜ := by
    intro y hy he
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at he
    have h1 := hy.1
    rw [he, dist_self] at h1
    linarith
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ := hA.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hFs.continuousOn.mono hAO)
  obtain ⟨B₁, hB₁⟩ := hA.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    ((hFs.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen isOpen_compl_singleton (by simp)).mono hAO)
  obtain ⟨KF, hKFdef⟩ : ∃ KF : ℝ,
      KF = K' + |B₁| * Real.sqrt ρ + (|B₀| + |cst|) / Real.sqrt (ρ / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hsρ2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (ρ / 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have hT1 : 0 ≤ |B₁| * Real.sqrt ρ := by positivity
  have hT2 : 0 ≤ (|B₀| + |cst|) / Real.sqrt (ρ / 2) := by positivity
  have hKF0 : 0 ≤ KF := by rw [hKFdef]; linarith
  have hK'KF : K' ≤ KF := by rw [hKFdef]; linarith
  have hB₁KF : |B₁| * Real.sqrt ρ ≤ KF := by rw [hKFdef]; linarith
  have hB₀KF : (|B₀| + |cst|) / Real.sqrt (ρ / 2) ≤ KF := by rw [hKFdef]; linarith
  
  have hgrad : ∀ x : E2, x ≠ x₀ → ‖fderiv ℝ F x‖ ≤ KF / Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) := by
    intro x hne
    have hd0 : 0 < dist x x₀ := dist_pos.mpr hne
    have hsd : 0 < Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hd0
    rcases lt_or_ge (dist x x₀) (ρ / 2) with hd | hd
    · have e1 : fderiv ℝ F x = -fderiv ℝ (lap2 h Λ₀) x := by
        rw [(hFeqO x hne).fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_neg, (hnearL x hd).fderiv_eq]
      rw [e1, norm_neg]
      have hdσ : dist x x₀ < σ := by linarith
      exact ((hcore x hd0 hdσ).2.1).trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hK'KF hsd.le)
    · rcases le_or_gt (dist x x₀) ρ with hd' | hd'
      · have hb := hB₁ x ⟨hd, hd'⟩
        rw [le_div_iff₀ hsd]
        calc ‖fderiv ℝ F x‖ * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) ≤ |B₁| * Real.sqrt ρ :=
              mul_le_mul (hb.trans (le_abs_self _)) (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hd') hsd.le
                (abs_nonneg _)
          _ ≤ KF := hB₁KF
      · have hev : F =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          filter_upwards [hfar_open.mem_nhds (show 3 * ρ / 4 < dist x x₀ by linarith)]
            with y hy
          have hy' : 3 * ρ / 4 < dist y x₀ := hy
          have hyne : y ≠ x₀ := by
            intro he
            rw [he, dist_self] at hy'
            linarith
          rw [hFx y hyne, hlapfar y hy', neg_zero]
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_apply, norm_zero]
        exact div_nonneg hKF0 hsd.le
  
  have hval : ∀ x : E2, |F x - F x₀| ≤ KF * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hne : x = x₀
    · rw [hne, sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact mul_nonneg hKF0 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hd0 : 0 < dist x x₀ := dist_pos.mpr hne
    rw [hFx₀]
    rcases lt_or_ge (dist x x₀) (ρ / 2) with hd | hd
    · have hdσ : dist x x₀ < σ := by linarith
      rw [hFx x hne, (hnearL x hd).eq_of_nhds]
      have hc := (hcore x hd0 hdσ).1
      calc |-lap2 h Λ₀ x - -cst| = |lap2 h Λ₀ x - cst| := by
            rw [show -lap2 h Λ₀ x - -cst = -(lap2 h Λ₀ x - cst) by ring, abs_neg]
        _ ≤ K' * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) := hc
        _ ≤ KF * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK'KF (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    · have hFb : |F x| ≤ |B₀| := by
        rcases le_or_gt (dist x x₀) ρ with hd' | hd'
        · have hb := hB₀ x ⟨hd, hd'⟩
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hb
          exact hb.trans (le_abs_self _)
        · rw [hFx x hne, hlapfar x (by linarith), neg_zero, abs_zero]
          exact abs_nonneg _
      have hs2 : Real.sqrt (ρ / 2) ≤ Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hd
      calc |F x - -cst| ≤ |F x| + |cst| := by
            rw [sub_neg_eq_add]
            exact abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ |B₀| + |cst| := by linarith
        _ = (|B₀| + |cst|) / Real.sqrt (ρ / 2) * Real.sqrt (ρ / 2) := by
            rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hsρ2.ne']
        _ ≤ (|B₀| + |cst|) / Real.sqrt (ρ / 2) * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs2 hT2
        _ ≤ KF * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB₀KF (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hhold := pcgb_holder_half_of_grad F x₀ KF hKF0
    (fun x hx => (hFs.contDiffAt (isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt
      (by simp))
    hgrad hval
  
  have hcoord : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) a) := fun a =>
    (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hQs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀) := by
    show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)
    exact ContDiff.sum fun a _ => ContDiff.sum fun c _ =>
      (contDiff_const.mul (hcoord a)).mul (hcoord c)
  have hQpos : ∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ → 0 < pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ y := by
    intro y hy
    show 0 < ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c
    have hv0 : (fun a => (y - x₀) a : Fin 2 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hy
      rw [← sub_eq_zero]
      ext a
      simpa using congrFun h0 a
    have hpd' := hH.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv0
    have hform : star (fun a => (y - x₀) a : Fin 2 → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ
        (h x₀).mulVec (fun a => (y - x₀) a) =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, star_trivial, Pi.star_apply]
      ring
    rw [← hform]
    exact hpd'
  have hlogs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.log (Real.sqrt (pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ y)))
      {x₀}ᶜ :=
    (hQs.contDiffOn.sqrt (fun y hy => (hQpos y hy).ne')).log
      (fun y hy => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hQpos y hy)).ne')
  have hΦs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun y => Λ y - Real.log (Real.sqrt (pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ y))) {x₀}ᶜ :=
    hΛs.sub hlogs
  have hΦ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Λ y - Real.log (Real.sqrt (pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ y)))) {x₀}ᶜ :=
    hΦs.fderiv_of_isOpen isOpen_compl_singleton le_rfl
  obtain ⟨B₂, hB₂⟩ := hA.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hΦs.continuousOn.mono hAO)
  obtain ⟨B₃, hB₃⟩ := hA.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hΦ1.continuousOn.mono hAO)
  obtain ⟨B₄, hB₄⟩ := hA.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    ((hΦ1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen isOpen_compl_singleton (by simp)).mono hAO)
  obtain ⟨mQ, hmQ⟩ := hA.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hQs.continuous.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨C, hCdef⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, C = K' + |B₂| + |B₃| + |B₄| * Real.sqrt |mQ| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT3 : 0 ≤ |B₄| * Real.sqrt |mQ| := by positivity

def pcgbPxQuad (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ x : E2) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, H a c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) c

def pcgbPxMu (H M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, H⁻¹ i j * M j i

def pcgbPxPsi (H M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ x : E2) : ℝ :=
  (pcgbPxQuad M x₀ x - pcgbPxMu H M * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x) * Real.log (pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x) / 16

def pcgbPxEik (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (D : E2 → ℝ) (y : E2) : ℝ :=
  ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a D y * pd2 c D y - 4 * D y

def pcgbPxJet (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (D : E2 → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (x₀ : E2) (c₀ K : ℝ) (x : E2) : Prop :=
  c₀ * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ≤ D x ∧
  |D x - pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 3 ∧
  ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ y) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ∧
  ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ y)) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ∧
  |pcgbPxEik h D x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 5 ∧
  ‖fderiv ℝ (pcgbPxEik h D) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 4 ∧
  |lap2 h D x - 4 - pcgbPxQuad M x₀ x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 3 ∧
  ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => lap2 h D y - 4 - pcgbPxQuad M x₀ y) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 2

def pcgbPxPsiEst (H M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (K : ℝ) (x : E2) : Prop :=
  ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, H⁻¹ i j * pd2 i (pd2 j (pcgbPxPsi H M x₀)) x =
    (pcgbPxQuad M x₀ x - pcgbPxMu H M * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x) / (2 * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x) ∧
  |pcgbPxPsi H M x₀ x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 2 * (1 + |Real.log (dist x x₀)|) ∧
  ‖fderiv ℝ (pcgbPxPsi H M x₀) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ * (1 + |Real.log (dist x x₀)|) ∧
  ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (pcgbPxPsi H M x₀)) x‖ ≤ K * (1 + |Real.log (dist x x₀)|) ∧
  ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 (pcgbPxPsi H M x₀) x‖ ≤ K / dist x x₀

  have alg2 : ∀ (D : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (hm hm' : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)

          ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ k a b * ∑ p : Fin 2, g p * D k p) =
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, hm'⁻¹ i j * (H' i j - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ' k i j * g k) := by

      ext a b
      rw [hcomp a b]
      simp only [hDm, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring

      rw [hm_eq, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]

      intro h0; apply hdet; rw [hdet', h0]; ring

    have hDtu : IsUnit Dm.transpose.det := by rw [Matrix.det_transpose]; exact hDu

      rw [hm_eq, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
      calc Dm.transpose * (Dm.transpose⁻¹ * (hm'⁻¹ * Dm⁻¹)) * Dm
          = (Dm.transpose * Dm.transpose⁻¹) * hm'⁻¹ * (Dm⁻¹ * Dm) := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

          rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hDtu, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hDu, Matrix.one_mul,

      intro q r
      rw [← hK]
      simp only [hDm, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring

        (∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, H' p q * D a p * D b q + ∑ m : Fin 2, g m * S' m a b) -
          ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ k a b * ∑ p : Fin 2, g p * D k p =
        ∑ q : Fin 2, ∑ r : Fin 2, (H' q r - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ' k q r * g k) * D a q * D b r := by
      intro a b
      have e0 := hchr 0 a b
      have e1 := hchr 1 a b

    have k11 := hKe 1 1

    obtain ⟨c1, c2⟩ := chain A B hA hB τ hτ hτAB F hF x hx
    have key := alg2 (fun a p => fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 a) p) (h x) (h' (τ x))
      (fun p q => pd2 p (pd2 q F) (τ x)) (fun k a b => christoffel2 h k a b x)
      (fun k i j => christoffel2 h' k i j (τ x))
      (fun m b c => fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c)) x (e2 b) m)
      (fun p => pd2 p F (τ x)) (hpd x hx).det_pos.ne' (hcomp x hx)
      (fun m b c => chr A B hA hB τ hτ hτAB h h' hh' hpd' hpd hcomp x hx m b c)
    unfold lap2
    simp only [c1, c2]
    exact key
  
  
  
  have hBc : IsCompact (P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall x₀ ρ).image_of_continuousOn ((P.param_cont j₀).mono hball)
  have hBcl : IsClosed (P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ) := hBc.isClosed
  have hBO : P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ ⊆ P.O j₀ := by
    rintro q ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have hm : P.param j₀ y ∈ P.param j₀ '' P.W j₀ := ⟨y, hball hy, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j₀] at hm
    exact hm.1
  have hinS : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ P.W j, P.param j y ∈ S := by
    intro j y hy
    have hm : P.param j y ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at hm
    exact hm.2
  have hGt : ∀ (F : E2 → ℝ) (q : X), q ∈ P.O j₀ ∩ S →
      pcgbTransport P j₀ F q = F (P.proj j₀ q) := fun F q hq => Set.indicator_of_mem hq _
  have hGt0 : ∀ (F : E2 → ℝ) (q : X), q ∉ P.O j₀ ∩ S →
      pcgbTransport P j₀ F q = 0 := fun F q hq => Set.indicator_of_notMem hq _
  have hN : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ P.W j, P.param j y ∈ P.O j₀ →
      P.proj j₀ (P.param j y) ∈ P.W j₀ ∧
        P.param j₀ (P.proj j₀ (P.param j y)) = P.param j y := by
    intro j y hy hyO
    have hm : P.param j y ∈ P.param j₀ '' P.W j₀ := by
      rw [P.image_eq j₀]; exact ⟨hyO, hinS j y hy⟩
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hyy⟩ := hm
    rw [← hyy, P.proj_param j₀ y' hy']
    exact ⟨hy', rfl⟩
  have hNne : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ P.W j, P.param j y ∈ P.O j₀ → P.param j y ≠ P.param j₀ x₀ →
      P.proj j₀ (P.param j y) ≠ x₀ := by
    intro j y hy hyO hne heq
    apply hne
    rw [← (hN j y hy hyO).2, heq]
  have hNopen : ∀ j, IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) := fun j =>
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open j₀)
  have hMopen : ∀ j,
      IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ)ᶜ) := fun j =>
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) hBcl.isOpen_compl
  
  
  
  have T4 : ∀ q, q ∉ P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ → pcgbTransport P j₀ G q = 0 := by
    intro q hq
    by_cases hqO : q ∈ P.O j₀ ∩ S
    · rw [hGt G q hqO]
      have hm : q ∈ P.param j₀ '' P.W j₀ := by rw [P.image_eq j₀]; exact hqO
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hm
      rw [P.proj_param j₀ y hy]
      apply hG0
      by_contra hlt
      push_neg at hlt
      exact hq ⟨y, Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr hlt.le, rfl⟩
    · exact hGt0 G q hqO
  have T0 : ∀ x ∈ P.W j₀, pcgbTransport P j₀ G (P.param j₀ x) = G x := by
    intro x hx
    have hm : P.param j₀ x ∈ P.O j₀ ∩ S := by
      rw [← P.image_eq j₀]; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [hGt G _ hm, P.proj_param j₀ x hx]
  
  
  
  have T1 : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pcgbTransport P j₀ G (P.param j x))
      (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {P.param j₀ x₀}ᶜ) := by
    intro j
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxO : P.param j x ∈ P.O j₀
    · refine ⟨P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀, hNopen j, ⟨hx.1, hxO⟩, ?_⟩
      have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => G (P.proj j₀ (P.param j y)))
          ((P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {P.param j₀ x₀}ᶜ) ∩ (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀)) := by
        refine hGs.comp ((P.trans_smooth j j₀).mono Set.inter_subset_right) ?_
        intro y hy
        exact ⟨(hN j y hy.2.1 hy.2.2).1, hNne j y hy.2.1 hy.2.2 hy.1.2⟩
      refine hsm.congr ?_
      intro y hy
      exact hGt G _ ⟨hy.2.2, hinS j y hy.2.1⟩
    · refine ⟨P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ)ᶜ, hMopen j,
        ⟨hx.1, fun hB => hxO (hBO hB)⟩, ?_⟩
      refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr ?_
      intro y hy
      exact T4 _ hy.2.2
  
  
  
  have T2 : ∀ K : ℝ, (∀ x y : E2, |G x - G y| ≤ K * dist x y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) → ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      ∃ δ K' : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ Metric.ball x δ ⊆ P.W j ∧
        ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x δ, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x δ,
          |pcgbTransport P j₀ G (P.param j y) - pcgbTransport P j₀ G (P.param j z)| ≤
            K' * dist y z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    intro K hK j x hx
    by_cases hxO : P.param j x ∈ P.O j₀
    · have hxN : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀ := ⟨hx, hxO⟩
      have hτx : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun y => P.proj j₀ (P.param j y)) x :=
        ((P.trans_smooth j j₀).contDiffAt ((hNopen j).mem_nhds hxN)).of_le (by simp)
      obtain ⟨L, t, ht, hL⟩ := hτx.exists_lipschitzOnWith
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδsub⟩ :=
        Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (Filter.inter_mem ht ((hNopen j).mem_nhds hxN))
      refine ⟨δ, |K| * (L : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ), hδ, fun y hy => (hδsub hy).2.1, ?_⟩
      intro y hy z hz
      have hyN := (hδsub hy).2
      have hzN := (hδsub hz).2
      rw [hGt G _ ⟨hyN.2, hinS j y hyN.1⟩, hGt G _ ⟨hzN.2, hinS j z hzN.1⟩]
      have hd : dist (P.proj j₀ (P.param j y)) (P.proj j₀ (P.param j z)) ≤ L * dist y z :=
        hL.dist_le_mul y (hδsub hy).1 z (hδsub hz).1
      have h1 := hK (P.proj j₀ (P.param j y)) (P.proj j₀ (P.param j z))
      have h2 : K * dist (P.proj j₀ (P.param j y)) (P.proj j₀ (P.param j z)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
          |K| * dist (P.proj j₀ (P.param j y)) (P.proj j₀ (P.param j z)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_abs_self K) (Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg _)
      have h3 : dist (P.proj j₀ (P.param j y)) (P.proj j₀ (P.param j z)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤
          ((L : ℝ) * dist y z) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow dist_nonneg hd (by norm_num)
      have h4 : ((L : ℝ) * dist y z) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) =
          (L : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dist y z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
        Real.mul_rpow L.coe_nonneg dist_nonneg
      calc _ ≤ _ := h1
        _ ≤ _ := h2
        _ ≤ |K| * (((L : ℝ) * dist y z) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (abs_nonneg K)
        _ = |K| * (L : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dist y z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by rw [h4]; ring
    · have hxM : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ)ᶜ :=
        ⟨hx, fun hB => hxO (hBO hB)⟩
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hMopen j) x hxM
      refine ⟨δ, 0, hδ, fun y hy => (hδsub hy).1, ?_⟩
      intro y hy z hz
      rw [T4 _ (hδsub hy).2, T4 _ (hδsub hz).2]
      simp
  
  
  
  have T3 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ≠ P.param j₀ x₀ →
      lap2 (P.h j) (fun y => pcgbTransport P j₀ G (P.param j y)) x =
        pcgbTransport P j₀ (lap2 (P.h j₀) G) (P.param j x) := by
    intro j x hx hne
    by_cases hxO : P.param j x ∈ P.O j₀
    · have hxN : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀ := ⟨hx, hxO⟩
      have hB'o : IsOpen (P.W j₀ \ {x₀}) := (P.W_open j₀).sdiff isClosed_singleton
      have hAo : IsOpen ((P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) ∩
          (fun y => P.proj j₀ (P.param j y)) ⁻¹' (P.W j₀ \ {x₀})) :=
        (P.trans_smooth j j₀).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (hNopen j) hB'o
      have hxA : x ∈ (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) ∩
          (fun y => P.proj j₀ (P.param j y)) ⁻¹' (P.W j₀ \ {x₀}) :=
        ⟨hxN, (hN j x hx hxO).1, hNne j x hx hxO hne⟩
      have hinv := lapInv _ _ hAo hB'o (fun y => P.proj j₀ (P.param j y))
        ((P.trans_smooth j j₀).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        (fun y hy => hy.2) (P.h j) (P.h j₀)
        (fun c d => (P.h_smooth j₀ c d).mono Set.diff_subset)
        (fun y hy => P.h_posDef j₀ y hy.1) (fun y hy => P.h_posDef j y hy.1.1)
        (fun y hy c d => P.h_compat j j₀ y hy.1 c d) G hGs x hxA
      have hev : (fun y => pcgbTransport P j₀ G (P.param j y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          (fun y => G (P.proj j₀ (P.param j y))) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hNopen j).mem_nhds hxN)
          (fun y hy => hGt G _ ⟨hy.2, hinS j y hy.1⟩)
      rw [lapcongr _ _ _ x hev, hGt _ _ ⟨hxO, hinS j x hx⟩]
      exact hinv
    · have hxM : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ)ᶜ :=
        ⟨hx, fun hB => hxO (hBO hB)⟩
      have hev : (fun y => pcgbTransport P j₀ G (P.param j y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hMopen j).mem_nhds hxM) (fun y hy => T4 _ hy.2)
      rw [lapcongr _ _ _ x hev, lapzero, hGt0 _ _ (fun hm => hxO hm.1)]
  exact ⟨T0, T1, T2, T3, T4⟩

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hRc : IsCompact {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hRconn : IsConnected {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (hreg : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) = 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x ≠ 0)
    (hbd : ∃ q ∈ S, b q = 0)
    (p₀ : X) (f : X → ℝ)
    (hf1 : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => f (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ))
    (hf2 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∃ δ K : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ Metric.ball x δ ⊆ P.W j ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x δ, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x δ,
        |f (P.param j y) - f (P.param j z)| ≤ K * dist y z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (hf3 : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → f q = 0) :
    ∃ (v : X → ℝ) (U : Set X), IsOpen U ∧ {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} ⊆ U ∧
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀}))) ∧
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' U)) ∧
      (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ b (P.param j x) →
        lap2 (P.h j) (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x = f (P.param j x)) ∧
      (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) = 0 → v (P.param j x) = 0)

signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hRc : IsCompact {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hRconn : IsConnected {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (hreg : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) = 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x ≠ 0)
    (hbd : ∃ q ∈ S, b q = 0)
    (p₀ : X) (f : X → ℝ)
    (hf1 : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => f (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ))
    (hf2 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∃ δ K : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ Metric.ball x δ ⊆ P.W j ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x δ, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball x δ,
        |f (P.param j y) - f (P.param j z)| ≤ K * dist y z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (hf3 : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → f q = 0) :
    ∃ (v : X → ℝ) (U : Set X), IsOpen U ∧ {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} ⊆ U ∧
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀}))) ∧
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' U)) ∧
      (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ b (P.param j x) →
        lap2 (P.h j) (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x = f (P.param j x)) ∧
      (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) = 0 → v (P.param j x) = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀, hf3'⟩ := hf3
  have hparamS : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ S := by
    intro j x hx
    have h := Set.mem_image_of_mem (P.param j) hx
    rw [P.image_eq j] at h
    exact h.2
  have hpoinc := pcgb_ds_dirichlet_poincare S P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hK hρK hρO b hb hRc hRconn hρ1
    hreg hbd
  have hfc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => f (P.param j x)) (P.W j) := by
    intro j x hx
    obtain ⟨δ, K, hδ, -, hH⟩ := hf2 j x hx
    apply ContinuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hcont : Continuous fun y : E2 => max K 0 * dist y x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
      continuous_const.mul ((continuous_id.dist continuous_const).rpow_const
        (fun _ => Or.inr (by norm_num)))
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun y : E2 => max K 0 * dist y x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (𝓝 x) (𝓝 0) := by
      have := hcont.tendsto x
      simpa [Real.zero_rpow (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0)] using this
    rw [ContinuousAt, tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    refine squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun y => norm_nonneg _) ?_ hlim
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x hδ] with y hy
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc |f (P.param j y) - f (P.param j x)| ≤ K * dist y x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
          hH y hy x (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
      _ ≤ max K 0 * dist y x ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (Real.rpow_nonneg dist_nonneg _)
  obtain ⟨u, w, G, hua, hub, huc, hud, hue, hug⟩ :=
    pcgb_ds_weak_solution S P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hK hρK hρO b hb hRc hRconn hρ1 hreg hbd f hfc hpoinc
  have hloc : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ b (P.param j x) →
      ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x r ⊆ P.W j ∧ ∃ V : E2 → ℝ,
        ContDiffOn ℝ 2 V (Metric.ball x r) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V (Metric.ball x r ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ) ∧
        (∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r ∩ {y | 0 < b (P.param j y)})), w j y = V y) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, 0 ≤ b (P.param j y) → lap2 (P.h j) V y = f (P.param j y)) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, b (P.param j y) = 0 → V y = 0) := by
    intro j x hx hbx
    rcases hbx.lt_or_eq with hpos | hzero
    · 
      have hΩo : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ {y | 0 < b (P.param j y)}) :=
        (hb j).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) isOpen_Ioi
      have hΩW : P.W j ∩ {y | 0 < b (P.param j y)} ⊆ P.W j := Set.inter_subset_left
      have hxΩ : x ∈ P.W j ∩ {y | 0 < b (P.param j y)} := ⟨hx, hpos⟩
      have hWso : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ) :=
        (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) isOpen_compl_singleton
      have hF : ∀ y ∈ P.W j ∩ {y | 0 < b (P.param j y)}, ∃ δ K : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
          Metric.ball y δ ⊆ P.W j ∩ {y | 0 < b (P.param j y)} ∧
          ∀ y' ∈ Metric.ball y δ, ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball y δ,
            |(fun y => f (P.param j y)) y' - (fun y => f (P.param j y)) z| ≤
              K * dist y' z ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        intro y hy
        obtain ⟨δ, K, hδ, -, hH⟩ := hf2 j y (hΩW hy)
        obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩo y hy
        refine ⟨min δ δ₂, K, lt_min hδ hδ₂,
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_right _ _)).trans hball, ?_⟩
        intro y' hy' z hz
        exact hH y' (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hy') z
          (Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left _ _) hz)
      obtain ⟨w', hw'2, hw'S, hw'ae, hw'lap⟩ := pcgb_ds_interior_regularity
        (P.W j ∩ {y | 0 < b (P.param j y)}) hΩo (P.h j)
        (fun a c => (P.h_smooth j a c).mono hΩW) (fun y hy => P.h_posDef j y (hΩW hy))
        (fun y => f (P.param j y)) hF (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ) hWso
        ((hf1 j).mono fun y hy => hy.2) (w j) (G j)
        (fun L hL hLΩ => ⟨(huc j L hL (hLΩ.trans hΩW)).1, (huc j L hL (hLΩ.trans hΩW)).2.1⟩)

    exact H a haA (hq₁ ⟨haN1, haA⟩) (hq₂ ⟨haN2, haA⟩)
  
  have transfer : ∀ (j : Fin P.n) (x : E2) (V : Set E2), IsOpen V → V ⊆ P.W j → x ∈ V →
      IsPreconnected {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ P.param j y ≠ p₀} →
      x ∈ closure {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ P.param j y ≠ p₀} →
      P.param j x ∈ closure ({q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 < b q} \ {p₀}) ∧
        ∃ N : Set X, IsOpen N ∧ P.param j x ∈ N ∧
          IsPreconnected (N ∩ ({q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 < b q} \ {p₀})) := by
    intro j x V hV hVW hxV hD hcl
    have hOS : ∀ y ∈ P.W j, P.param j y ∈ P.O j ∩ S := fun y hy => by
      rw [← P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    have himg : P.param j '' {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ P.param j y ≠ p₀} ⊆
        {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 < b q} \ {p₀} := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, ⟨hyV, hyb, hyp⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨(hOS y (hVW hyV)).2, hyb⟩, hyp⟩
    have hcont : ContinuousOn (P.param j)
        {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ P.param j y ≠ p₀} :=
      (P.param_cont j).mono (fun y hy => hVW hy.1)
    refine ⟨?_, P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹' V,
      (P.proj_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open j) hV,
      ⟨(hOS x (hVW hxV)).1, show P.proj j (P.param j x) ∈ V by
        rw [P.proj_param j x (hVW hxV)]; exact hxV⟩, ?_⟩
    · have hca : ContinuousWithinAt (P.param j)
          {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ P.param j y ≠ p₀} x :=
        ((P.param_cont j).continuousAt ((P.W_open j).mem_nhds (hVW hxV))).continuousWithinAt
      exact closure_mono himg (hca.mem_closure_image hcl)
    · have heq : P.O j ∩ P.proj j ⁻¹' V ∩ ({q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 < b q} \ {p₀}) =
          P.param j '' {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ P.param j y ≠ p₀} := by
        ext q
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨hqO, hqV⟩, ⟨hqS, hqb⟩, hqp⟩
          have hq' : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hqO, hqS⟩
          obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hq'
          have hyV : y ∈ V := by
            have h' : P.proj j (P.param j y) ∈ V := hqV
            rwa [P.proj_param j y hy] at h'
          exact ⟨y, ⟨hyV, hqb, hqp⟩, rfl⟩
        · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hyV, hyb, hyp⟩, rfl⟩
          refine ⟨⟨(hOS y (hVW hyV)).1, ?_⟩, ⟨(hOS y (hVW hyV)).2, hyb⟩, hyp⟩
          show P.proj j (P.param j y) ∈ V
          rw [P.proj_param j y (hVW hyV)]; exact hyV
      rw [heq]
      exact hD.image _ hcont
  
  have hrank : 1 < Module.rank ℝ E2 := by
    rw [← Module.finrank_eq_rank, finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin]; norm_num
  have punct : ∀ (x : E2) (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ →
      IsPreconnected (ball x δ \ {x}) ∧ x ∈ closure (ball x δ \ {x}) := by
    intro x δ hδ
    have hsph := isConnected_sphere hrank (0 : E2) zero_le_one
    have himg : (fun p : E2 × ℝ => x + p.2 • p.1) '' (sphere (0 : E2) 1 ×ˢ Set.Ioo 0 δ) =
        ball x δ \ {x} := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨v, r⟩, ⟨hv, hr⟩, rfl⟩
        have hv' : ‖v‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hv
        have hr0 : 0 < r := hr.1
        have hrδ : r < δ := hr.2
        show x + r • v ∈ ball x δ \ {x}
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hv', mul_one,
            Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr0]
          exact hrδ
        · intro h
          have h2 : x + r • v = x := h
          have h3 : r • v = 0 := by
            have h4 := congrArg (fun z => z - x) h2
            simpa using h4
          rcases smul_eq_zero.mp h3 with h4 | h4
          · exact absurd h4 hr0.ne'
          · rw [h4, norm_zero] at hv'; exact zero_ne_one hv'
      · rintro ⟨hy, hyx⟩
        have hne : y - x ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hyx
        have hpos : 0 < ‖y - x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
        refine ⟨(‖y - x‖⁻¹ • (y - x), ‖y - x‖), ⟨?_, hpos, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm]; exact norm_smul_inv_norm hne
        · rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hy
        · show x + ‖y - x‖ • (‖y - x‖⁻¹ • (y - x)) = y
          rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hpos.ne', one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← himg]
      exact (hsph.isPreconnected.prod isPreconnected_Ioo).image _
        (by fun_prop : Continuous fun p : E2 × ℝ => x + p.2 • p.1).continuousOn
    · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hsph.nonempty
      have hv' : ‖v‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp hv
      rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
      intro ε hε
      have hm : 0 < min ε δ / 2 := half_pos (lt_min hε hδ)
      refine ⟨x + (min ε δ / 2) • v, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← himg]
        exact ⟨(v, min ε δ / 2), ⟨hv, hm, by linarith [min_le_right ε δ]⟩, rfl⟩
      · rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hv', mul_one,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hm]
        linarith [min_le_left ε δ]
  
  have halfball : ∀ (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W →
      ∀ x ∈ W, f x = 0 → fderiv ℝ f x ≠ 0 →
      ∃ V : Set E2, IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ W ∧ IsPreconnected {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < f y} ∧
        x ∈ closure {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < f y} := by
    intro W hW f hf x hx hfx hdf
    have hfd : DifferentiableOn ℝ f W := hf.differentiableOn (by simp)
    have hfc : ContinuousOn f W := hfd.continuousOn
    have hdc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) W := hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w : E2, 0 < fderiv ℝ f x w := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      apply hdf
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun v => ?_)
      have h1 := hcon v
      have h2 := hcon (-v)
      rw [map_neg] at h2
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
      linarith
    have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hw
    have hu1 : ‖‖w‖⁻¹ • w‖ = 1 := norm_smul_inv_norm hw0
    have hu : 0 < fderiv ℝ f x (‖w‖⁻¹ • w) := by
      rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hw0)) hw
    generalize ‖w‖⁻¹ • w = u at hu1 hu
    have hcu : ContinuousOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y u) W :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ ℝ u).continuous.comp_continuousOn hdc
    obtain ⟨δ0, hδ0, hball0⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hcu.isOpen_inter_preimage hW isOpen_Ioi) x ⟨hx, hu⟩
    obtain ⟨η, hηdef⟩ : ∃ η : ℝ, η = δ0 / 4 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hη : 0 < η := by rw [hηdef]; positivity
    have hstep : ∀ z : E2, dist z x < δ0 / 2 → ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| < η →
        z + τ • u ∈ W ∧ 0 < fderiv ℝ f (z + τ • u) u := by
      intro z hz τ hτ
      have hmem : z + τ • u ∈ ball x δ0 := by
        rw [mem_ball]
        calc dist (z + τ • u) x ≤ dist (z + τ • u) z + dist z x := dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ = |τ| + dist z x := by
            rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hu1, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
          _ < δ0 := by linarith
      exact hball0 hmem
    have hmono : ∀ z : E2, dist z x < δ0 / 2 →
        StrictMonoOn (fun τ : ℝ => f (z + τ • u)) (Set.Ioo (-η) η) := by
      intro z hz
      have hder : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η,
          HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => f (z + τ • u)) (fderiv ℝ f (z + τ • u) u) τ := by
        intro τ hτ
        have hτ' : |τ| < η := abs_lt.mpr ⟨hτ.1, hτ.2⟩
        obtain ⟨hW', _⟩ := hstep z hz τ hτ'
        have hcurve : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => z + τ • u) u τ := by
          simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id' τ).smul_const u).const_add z
        exact ((hfd.differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hW')).hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt τ hcurve
      refine strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Ioo _ _)
        (fun τ hτ => (hder τ hτ).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt) ?_
      intro τ hτ
      rw [interior_Ioo] at hτ
      rw [(hder τ hτ).deriv]
      exact (hstep z hz τ (abs_lt.mpr ⟨hτ.1, hτ.2⟩)).2
    have hxx : dist x x < δ0 / 2 := by rw [dist_self]; exact half_pos hδ0
    have h0I : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η := ⟨by linarith, hη⟩
    have hη2 : η / 2 ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have hfm : 0 < f (x + (η / 2) • u) := by
      have h := hmono x hxx h0I hη2 (by linarith)
      change f (x + (0 : ℝ) • u) < f (x + (η / 2) • u) at h
      rw [zero_smul, add_zero, hfx] at h
      exact h
    have hmW : x + (η / 2) • u ∈ W :=
      (hstep x hxx (η / 2) (by rw [abs_of_pos (half_pos hη)]; linarith)).1
    obtain ⟨a1, ha1, hball1⟩ :=
      Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (hfc.isOpen_inter_preimage hW isOpen_Ioi) _ ⟨hmW, hfm⟩
    obtain ⟨a, hadef⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = min a1 (δ0 / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have ha : 0 < a := by rw [hadef]; exact lt_min ha1 (half_pos hδ0)
    have ha1' : a ≤ a1 := by rw [hadef]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have ha2 : a ≤ δ0 / 2 := by rw [hadef]; exact min_le_right _ _
    have hmemV : ∀ (y : E2) (s : ℝ), s ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η → dist y (x + s • u) < a →
        y ∈ ⋃ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η, ball (x + s • u) a :=
      fun y s hs hy => Set.mem_biUnion hs hy
    have hz_of : ∀ (y : E2) (s : ℝ), dist (y - s • u) x = dist y (x + s • u) := by
      intro y s
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, sub_sub, add_comm (s • u) x]
    have hVW : (⋃ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η, ball (x + s • u) a) ⊆ W := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hys⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hy
      have hz : dist (y - s • u) x < δ0 / 2 := by
        rw [hz_of]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le (mem_ball.mp hys) ha2
      have h' := (hstep (y - s • u) hz s (abs_lt.mpr ⟨hs.1, hs.2⟩)).1
      rwa [sub_add_cancel] at h'
    refine ⟨⋃ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η, ball (x + s • u) a, isOpen_biUnion (fun _ _ => isOpen_ball),
      hmemV x 0 h0I (by simp [ha]), hVW, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine isPreconnected_of_forall (x + (η / 2) • u) ?_
      rintro y ⟨hyV, hy⟩
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hys⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hyV
      have hzx : dist (y - s • u) x < a := by rw [hz_of]; exact mem_ball.mp hys
      have hzx2 : dist (y - s • u) x < δ0 / 2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hzx ha2
      have hyz : y - s • u + s • u = y := sub_add_cancel y (s • u)
      have hs' : s ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η := hs
      have hball_sub : ball (x + (η / 2) • u) a ⊆
          {y | y ∈ ⋃ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η, ball (x + s • u) a ∧ 0 < f y} := by
        intro p hp
        refine ⟨hmemV p (η / 2) hη2 hp, ?_⟩
        exact (hball1 (ball_subset_ball ha1' hp)).2
      have hzm : y - s • u + (η / 2) • u ∈ ball (x + (η / 2) • u) a := by
        rw [mem_ball, dist_add_right]; exact hzx
      have hzmpos : 0 < f (y - s • u + (η / 2) • u) := (hball_sub hzm).2
      refine ⟨(fun τ : ℝ => y - s • u + τ • u) '' Set.uIcc s (η / 2) ∪
          ball (x + (η / 2) • u) a, ?_, Set.mem_union_right _ (mem_ball_self ha),
          Set.mem_union_left _ ⟨s, Set.left_mem_uIcc, hyz⟩, ?_⟩
      · rintro p (⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩ | hp)
        · show y - s • u + τ • u ∈
            {y | y ∈ ⋃ s ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η, ball (x + s • u) a ∧ 0 < f y}
          have hτI : τ ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η := by
            have h1 := Set.mem_uIcc.mp hτ
            constructor <;> rcases h1 with h | h <;> linarith [hs'.1, hs'.2]
          refine ⟨hmemV _ τ hτI (by rw [dist_add_right]; exact hzx), ?_⟩
          rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hτ with h | h
          · rcases h.1.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
            · have h2 := hmono (y - s • u) hzx2 hs' hτI hlt
              change f (y - s • u + s • u) < f (y - s • u + τ • u) at h2
              rw [hyz] at h2
              linarith
            · rw [← heq, hyz]; exact hy
          · rcases h.1.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
            · have h2 := hmono (y - s • u) hzx2 hη2 hτI hlt
              change f (y - s • u + (η / 2) • u) < f (y - s • u + τ • u) at h2
              linarith
            · rw [← heq]; exact hzmpos
        · exact hball_sub hp
      · exact (isPreconnected_uIcc.image _
          (by fun_prop : Continuous fun τ : ℝ => y - s • u + τ • u).continuousOn).union
          (y - s • u + (η / 2) • u) ⟨η / 2, Set.right_mem_uIcc, rfl⟩ hzm
          (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
    · rw [Metric.mem_closure_iff]
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨σ, hσdef⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ, σ = min (η / 2) (ε / 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hσ : 0 < σ := by rw [hσdef]; exact lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
      have hσ1 : σ ≤ η / 2 := by rw [hσdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
      have hσ2 : σ ≤ ε / 2 := by rw [hσdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
      have hσI : σ ∈ Set.Ioo (-η) η := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
      refine ⟨x + σ • u, ⟨hmemV _ σ hσI (by simp [ha]), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · have h := hmono x hxx h0I hσI hσ
        change f (x + (0 : ℝ) • u) < f (x + σ • u) at h
        rw [zero_smul, add_zero, hfx] at h
        exact h
      · rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, hu1, mul_one,
          Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hσ]
        linarith
  
  have key : ∀ q ∈ {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q}, q ∈ closure ({q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 < b q} \ {p₀}) ∧
      ∃ N : Set X, IsOpen N ∧ q ∈ N ∧ IsPreconnected (N ∩ ({q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 < b q} \ {p₀})) := by
    rintro q ⟨hqS, hqb⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (P.cover hqS)
    have hq' : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hj, hqS⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hq'
    have hfc : ContinuousOn (fun y => b (P.param j y)) (P.W j) := (hb j).continuousOn
    have hinj : ∀ y ∈ P.W j, P.param j y = P.param j x → y = x := by
      intro y hy h
      rw [← P.proj_param j y hy, ← P.proj_param j x hx, h]
    have hWo : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ) :=
      (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) isOpen_compl_singleton
    rcases hqb.lt_or_eq with hpos | hzero
    · by_cases hp : P.param j x = p₀
      · obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδb⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp
          (hfc.isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) isOpen_Ioi) x ⟨hx, hpos⟩
        have hDeq : {y | y ∈ ball x δ ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ P.param j y ≠ p₀} =
            ball x δ \ {x} := by
          ext y
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hy, -, hyp⟩
            refine ⟨hy, fun h => hyp ?_⟩
            rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp h, hp]
          · rintro ⟨hy, hyx⟩
            refine ⟨hy, (hδb hy).2, fun h => hyx ?_⟩
            exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr (hinj y (hδb hy).1 (h.trans hp.symm))
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := punct x δ hδ
        exact transfer j x (ball x δ) isOpen_ball (fun y hy => (hδb hy).1) (mem_ball_self hδ)
          (by rw [hDeq]; exact h1) (by rw [hDeq]; exact h2)
      · obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδb⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp
          ((hfc.mono Set.inter_subset_left).isOpen_inter_preimage hWo isOpen_Ioi) x
          ⟨⟨hx, hp⟩, hpos⟩
        have hDeq : {y | y ∈ ball x δ ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ P.param j y ≠ p₀} =
            ball x δ := by
          ext y
          exact ⟨fun h => h.1, fun hy => ⟨hy, (hδb hy).2, (hδb hy).1.2⟩⟩
        exact transfer j x (ball x δ) isOpen_ball (fun y hy => (hδb hy).1.1) (mem_ball_self hδ)
          (by rw [hDeq]; exact (convex_ball x δ).isPreconnected)
          (by rw [hDeq]; exact subset_closure (mem_ball_self hδ))
    · have hb0 : b (P.param j x) = 0 := hzero.symm
      have hp : P.param j x ≠ p₀ := by
        intro h; rw [h] at hb0; linarith
      obtain ⟨V, hVo, hxV, hVW, hD, hcl⟩ := halfball _ hWo _ ((hb j).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
        x ⟨hx, hp⟩ hb0 (hreg j x hx hb0)
      have hDeq : {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ P.param j y ≠ p₀} =
          {y | y ∈ V ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y)} := by
        ext y
        exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2, (hVW h.1).2⟩⟩
      exact transfer j x V hVo (fun y hy => (hVW hy).1) hxV (by rw [hDeq]; exact hD)
        (by rw [hDeq]; exact hcl)
  refine glue {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} _ ?_ hRconn.isPreconnected
    (fun q hq => (key q hq).1) (fun q hq => (key q hq).2)
  rintro q ⟨⟨hqS, hqb⟩, -⟩
  exact ⟨hqS, hqb.le⟩

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (b : X → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hRc : IsCompact {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (p₀ : X) (U : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hRU : {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} ⊆ U) (w : X → ℝ)
    (hw1 : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀})))
    (hw2 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < b (P.param j x) → P.param j x ≠ p₀ →
      lap2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x = 0)
    (hw3 : ∀ q ∈ S, b q = 0 → w q = 0)
    (hw4 : ∃ N : Set X, IsOpen N ∧ p₀ ∈ N ∧ (∀ q ∈ N ∩ S, q ≠ p₀ → w q < -1) ∧
      ∃ q ∈ N ∩ S, 0 < b q ∧ q ≠ p₀)
    (hw5 : IsPreconnected ({q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 < b q} \ {p₀})) :
    ∀ q ∈ S, 0 < b q → q ≠ p₀ → w q < 0

{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (b : X → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hRc : IsCompact {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (p₀ : X) (U : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hRU : {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} ⊆ U) (w : X → ℝ)
    (hw1 : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => w (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀})))
    (hw2 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < b (P.param j x) → P.param j x ≠ p₀ →
      lap2 (P.h j) (fun y => w (P.param j y)) x = 0)
    (hw3 : ∀ q ∈ S, b q = 0 → w q = 0)
    (hw4 : ∃ N : Set X, IsOpen N ∧ p₀ ∈ N ∧ (∀ q ∈ N ∩ S, q ≠ p₀ → w q < -1) ∧

    (hw5 : IsPreconnected ({q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 < b q} \ {p₀})) :
    ∀ q ∈ S, 0 < b q → q ≠ p₀ → w q < 0

      intro q hq

    have hMpos : 0 < w qs := lt_of_lt_of_le hq₁pos (hmax' q₁ hq₁K)

      refine ⟨⟨hqsK.1.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩

    have hleM : ∀ q ∈ ({q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 < b q} \ {p₀}), w q ≤ w qs := by
      intro q hq

      · have := hNneg q ⟨hqN, hq.1.1⟩ hq.2
