      · exact hmax' q ⟨⟨hq.1.1, hq.1.2.le⟩, hqN⟩
    have := hprop (w qs) hleM qs hqsA rfl qN hqNA
    linarith
  
  intro q hqS hbq hqp
  have hqA : q ∈ ({q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 < b q} \ {p₀}) := ⟨⟨hqS, hbq⟩, hqp⟩
  rcases (hle0 q hqA).lt_or_eq with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso
    have := hprop 0 hle0 q hqA h qN hqNA
    linarith

subgoal_signatures.name: esm_lap2_coeff_form
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsm : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) : ∃ (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) ∧ (∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) ∧ ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), lap2 h w x = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k w x

subgoal_signatures.name: esm_hopf_touching
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w c : E2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) (hB : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) (hAs : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W) (hc : ContinuousOn c W) (hnn : ∀ x ∈ W, 0 ≤ w x) (heq : ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k w x + c x * w x = 0) (z x₁ : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z R, 0 < w x) (hx₁ : dist x₁ z = R) (hw₁ : w x₁ = 0) : False

by
  
  obtain ⟨z, R, hR, hball, hx₁z, hbpos⟩ : ∃ (z : E2) (R : ℝ), 0 < R ∧
      Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W ∧ dist x₁ z = R ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball z R, 0 < b y := by
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεW⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hW x₁ hx₁
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ρ = ε / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := by rw [hρ]; positivity
    have hcbW : Metric.closedBall x₁ ρ ⊆ W := fun y hy =>
      hεW (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by rw [hρ]; linarith) hy)
    have hdb1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ b) W := hb.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
    have hdb2 := hdb1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
    obtain ⟨M', hM'⟩ :=
      (isCompact_closedBall x₁ ρ).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hdb2.mono hcbW)
    obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : ℝ, M = max M' 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := by rw [hMdef]; exact le_max_right _ _
    have hMb : ∀ p ∈ Metric.closedBall x₁ ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ b) p‖ ≤ M := fun p hp =>
      (hM' p hp).trans (by rw [hMdef]; exact le_max_left _ _)
    have hbd : ∀ p ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ b p := fun p hp =>
      (hb.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp)
    have hdbd : ∀ p ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ b) p := fun p hp =>
      (hdb1.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hp)
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ, D = fderiv ℝ b x₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    
    have htay : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₁ ρ, D (y - x₁) - M * ‖y - x₁‖ ^ 2 ≤ b y := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : ℝ, r = ‖y - x₁‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hrρ : r ≤ ρ := by rw [hr, ← dist_eq_norm]; exact hy
      have hsub : Metric.closedBall x₁ r ⊆ Metric.closedBall x₁ ρ :=
        Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hrρ
      have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := by rw [hr]; exact norm_nonneg _
      have hx₁s : x₁ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₁ r := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr0
      have hys : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₁ r := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, hr]
      have h1 : ∀ p ∈ Metric.closedBall x₁ r, ‖fderiv ℝ b p - D‖ ≤ M * r := by
        intro p hp
        have h0 := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (f := fderiv ℝ b) (C := M)
          (s := Metric.closedBall x₁ r) (fun q hq => hdbd q (hcbW (hsub hq)))
          (fun q hq => hMb q (hsub hq)) (convex_closedBall x₁ r) hx₁s hp
        rw [← hD] at h0
        calc ‖fderiv ℝ b p - D‖ ≤ M * ‖p - x₁‖ := h0
          _ ≤ M * r := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact hp) hM0
      have hφd : ∀ p ∈ W, HasFDerivAt (fun q => b q - D (q - x₁)) (fderiv ℝ b p - D) p := by
        intro p hp
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q => D (q - x₁)) D p := by
          have hD' : HasFDerivAt (⇑D) D p := D.hasFDerivAt
          refine (hD'.sub_const (D x₁)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q => ?_)
          show D (q - x₁) = D q - D x₁
          exact map_sub D q x₁
        exact (hbd p hp).hasFDerivAt.sub h2
      have h3 := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
        (f := fun q => b q - D (q - x₁)) (C := M * r) (s := Metric.closedBall x₁ r)
        (fun q hq => (hφd q (hcbW (hsub hq))).differentiableAt)
        (fun q hq => by rw [(hφd q (hcbW (hsub hq))).fderiv]; exact h1 q hq)
        (convex_closedBall x₁ r) hx₁s hys
      simp only [sub_self, map_zero, hb0, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h3
      rw [← hr] at h3
      have h4 := neg_abs_le (b y - D (y - x₁))
      rw [← hr]
      have h5 : M * r * r = M * r ^ 2 := by ring
      linarith
    
    obtain ⟨ν, hν⟩ : ∃ ν : E2, ν = (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E2).symm D := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hνD : ∀ p : E2, inner ℝ ν p = D p := by
      intro p
      rw [hν]
      exact InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : ℝ, g = ‖ν‖ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hg0 : 0 < g := by
      rw [hg, norm_pos_iff]
      intro h0
      apply hdb
      rw [← hD]
      ext p
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, ← hνD p, h0, inner_zero_left]
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : E2, n = g⁻¹ • ν := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hn1 : ‖n‖ = 1 := by
      rw [hn, norm_smul, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hg0, ← hg,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hg0.ne']
    have hDn : ∀ p : E2, D p = g * inner ℝ n p := by
      intro p
      rw [hn, real_inner_smul_left, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hg0.ne', one_mul, hνD p]
    have hnn : inner ℝ n n = (1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hn1]; norm_num
    obtain ⟨R, hRdef⟩ : ∃ R : ℝ, R = min (ρ / 2) (g / (4 * M + 1)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hR0 : 0 < R := by
      rw [hRdef]
      exact lt_min (by positivity) (div_pos hg0 (by linarith))
    have hRρ : R ≤ ρ / 2 := by rw [hRdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
    have hRg : R * (4 * M + 1) ≤ g := by
      have : R ≤ g / (4 * M + 1) := by rw [hRdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
      exact (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)).mp this
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z : E2, z = x₁ + R • n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hRn : ‖R • n‖ = R := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hR0, hn1, mul_one]
    refine ⟨z, R, hR0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y hy
      apply hcbW
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hy ⊢
      have hzx : dist z x₁ = R := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, hz, add_sub_cancel_left, hRn]
      have := dist_triangle y z x₁
      linarith
    · rw [dist_eq_norm, hz, sub_add_cancel_left, norm_neg, hRn]
    · intro y hy
      have hu : ‖y - z‖ < R := by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact Metric.mem_ball.mp hy
      have hd : y - x₁ = R • n + (y - z) := by rw [hz]; abel
      obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ : ∃ s₀ : ℝ, s₀ = R + inner ℝ n (y - z) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hip : |inner ℝ n (y - z)| ≤ ‖y - z‖ := by
        have := abs_real_inner_le_norm n (y - z)
        rw [hn1, one_mul] at this
        exact this
      have hs0 : 0 < s₀ := by
        rw [hs₀]
        have := neg_abs_le (inner ℝ n (y - z))
        linarith
      have hDd : D (y - x₁) = g * s₀ := by
        rw [hDn, hd, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, hnn, hs₀, mul_one]
      have hdsq : ‖y - x₁‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * R * s₀ := by
        rw [hd, norm_add_sq_real, hRn, real_inner_smul_left, hs₀]
        have hu0 := norm_nonneg (y - z)
        nlinarith
      have hdρ : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₁ ρ := by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, hd]
        have := norm_add_le (R • n) (y - z)
        rw [hRn] at this
        linarith
      have ht := htay y hdρ
      rw [hDd] at ht
      have e1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hRg hs0.le
      have e2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdsq hM0
      have e3 := mul_pos (mul_pos hR0 (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * M + 1)) hs0
      nlinarith
  have hbW : Metric.ball z R ⊆ W := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall.trans hball
  have hx₁W : x₁ ∈ W := hx₁
  
  obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hAs, hApos, hL⟩ := esm_lap2_coeff_form W hW h hh hpd
  have hH0 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z R, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x
      + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k w x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← hL w x]
    exact hharm x (hbW hx) (hbpos x hx)
  
  obtain ⟨m₀, Λ, β, Γ, m, hm₀, hΛ, hβ, hΓ, hm, hK, hSin⟩ :=
    esm_hopf_constants W A B (fun x => -w x) (fun _ => 0) hA hB hApos hw.continuousOn.neg
      continuousOn_const z R hR hball (fun x hx => by
        show 0 < -w x
        linarith [hneg x (hbW hx) (hbpos x hx)])
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ : ∃ α : ℝ, α = 1 + (4 * Λ + 4 * β * R) / (4 * m₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hα1 : 1 ≤ α := by
    have : 0 ≤ (4 * Λ + 4 * β * R) / (4 * m₀) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hα0 : 0 < α := by linarith
  
  have hbar : ∀ (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (bb : Fin 2 → ℝ) (y : E2),
      m₀ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, y i * a i j * y j → (∀ i : Fin 2, |a i i| ≤ Λ) →
      (∀ k : Fin 2, |bb k| ≤ β) → ‖y‖ ≤ R →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a i j * ((4 * α ^ 2 * y i * y j
          - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, bb k * (-2 * α * y k * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2)) := by
    intro a bb y hq ha hbb hy
    have hE := Real.exp_pos (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2)
    have hy0 : |y 0| ≤ R := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le y 0
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      linarith
    have hy1 : |y 1| ≤ R := by
      have := PiLp.norm_apply_le y 1
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      linarith
    have htr : a 0 0 + a 1 1 ≤ 2 * Λ := by
      have h0 := le_abs_self (a 0 0)
      have h1 := le_abs_self (a 1 1)
      linarith [ha 0, ha 1]
    have hbb0 : bb 0 * y 0 ≤ β * R := by
      calc bb 0 * y 0 ≤ |bb 0 * y 0| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |bb 0| * |y 0| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ β * R := mul_le_mul (hbb 0) hy0 (abs_nonneg _) hβ
    have hbb1 : bb 1 * y 1 ≤ β * R := by
      calc bb 1 * y 1 ≤ |bb 1 * y 1| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |bb 1| * |y 1| := abs_mul _ _
        _ ≤ β * R := mul_le_mul (hbb 1) hy1 (abs_nonneg _) hβ
    have h4 : 4 * α * m₀ = 4 * m₀ + 4 * Λ + 4 * β * R := by
      rw [hα]
      field_simp
      ring
    set q := ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, y i * a i j * y j with hqdef
    have hP : 0 < 4 * α ^ 2 * q - 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1) - 2 * α * (bb 0 * y 0 + bb 1 * y 1) := by
      have e1 : 4 * α ^ 2 * m₀ ≤ 4 * α ^ 2 * q := by
        have : 0 ≤ 4 * α ^ 2 := by positivity
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq this
      have e2 : 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1) ≤ 2 * α * (2 * Λ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htr (by positivity)
      have e3 : 2 * α * (bb 0 * y 0 + bb 1 * y 1) ≤ 2 * α * (2 * β * R) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have e4 : 4 * α ^ 2 * m₀ - 4 * α * Λ - 4 * α * β * R = 4 * α * m₀ := by
        linear_combination α * h4
      have e5 : 0 < 4 * α * m₀ := by positivity
      nlinarith
    have hkey : ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, a i j * ((4 * α ^ 2 * y i * y j
          - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, bb k * (-2 * α * y k * Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2))
        = Real.exp (-α * ‖y‖ ^ 2) * (4 * α ^ 2 * q - 2 * α * (a 0 0 + a 1 1)
          - 2 * α * (bb 0 * y 0 + bb 1 * y 1)) := by
      rw [hqdef]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, if_pos (rfl : (0 : Fin 2) = 0), if_pos (rfl : (1 : Fin 2) = 1),
        if_neg (show ¬((0 : Fin 2) = 1) by decide), if_neg (show ¬((1 : Fin 2) = 0) by decide),
        if_true]
      ring
    rw [hkey]
    exact mul_pos hE hP
  
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : E2 → ℝ, ∀ x, v x = Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2) :=
    ⟨_, fun x => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨hvs, hvD, hv1, hv2⟩ := esm_barrier_derivs z α R v hv
  have hV1 : ∀ x, dist x z = R → v x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hv, ← dist_eq_norm, hx, sub_self]
  have hV2 : ∀ x, v x ≤ 1 := by
    intro x
    have h1 : Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
      have := sq_nonneg ‖x - z‖
      nlinarith
    have h2 := Real.exp_pos (-α * R ^ 2)
    rw [hv]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ : ∃ y₀ : E2, y₀ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (z - x₁) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hV3 : 0 < fderiv ℝ v x₁ y₀ := by
    rw [hvD x₁ y₀]
    have hs : ∑ k : Fin 2, (x₁ - z) k * y₀ k = -(1 / 2) * ‖x₁ - z‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      simp [hy₀, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      ring
    rw [hs, ← dist_eq_norm, hx₁z]
    rw [show -2 * α * (-(1 / 2) * R ^ 2) = α * R ^ 2 by ring]
    positivity
  
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => -w x - m * v x) W :=
    hw.neg.sub (contDiffOn_const.mul hvs.contDiffOn)
  
  have hlin : ∀ x ∈ W, fderiv ℝ (fun y => -w y - m * v y) x = -fderiv ℝ w x - m • fderiv ℝ v x ∧
      (∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => -w y - m * v y) x = -pd2 k w x - m * pd2 k v x) ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (fun y => -w y - m * v y)) x
        = -pd2 i (pd2 j w) x - m * pd2 i (pd2 j v) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hdf : ∀ y ∈ W, DifferentiableAt ℝ w y := fun y hy =>
      (hw.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)
    have hdg : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ v y := fun y => hvs.differentiable (by simp) y
    have h1 : ∀ y ∈ W, fderiv ℝ (fun y => -w y - m * v y) y = -fderiv ℝ w y - m • fderiv ℝ v y := by
      intro y hy
      exact ((hdf y hy).hasFDerivAt.neg.sub ((hdg y).hasFDerivAt.const_mul m)).fderiv
    have h2 : ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ k : Fin 2,
        pd2 k (fun y => -w y - m * v y) y = -pd2 k w y - m * pd2 k v y := by
      intro y hy k
      show fderiv ℝ (fun y => -w y - m * v y) y (e2 k)
        = -fderiv ℝ w y (e2 k) - m * fderiv ℝ v y (e2 k)
      rw [h1 y hy]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hdpf : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) x := by
      intro j
      have hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) W :=
        (hw.fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      exact (hc.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
    have hdpg : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) x := by
      intro j
      have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) :=
        (hvs.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const
      exact hc.differentiable (by simp) x
    refine ⟨h1 x hx, h2 x hx, fun i j => ?_⟩
    have hev : pd2 j (fun y => -w y - m * v y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        fun y => -fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j) - m * fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => h2 y hy j)
    show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (fun y => -w y - m * v y)) x (e2 i)
      = -fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) x (e2 i)
        - m * fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) x (e2 i)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hD : HasFDerivAt (fun y => -fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j) - m * fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j))
        (-(fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ w y (e2 j)) x)
          - m • fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ v y (e2 j)) x) x :=
      (hdpf j).hasFDerivAt.neg.sub ((hdpg j).hasFDerivAt.const_mul m)
    rw [hD.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hstrict : ∀ x : E2, R / 2 < dist x z → dist x z < R →
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j (fun x => -w x - m * v x)) x
        + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k (fun x => -w x - m * v x) x
        - (0 : ℝ) * (fun x => -w x - m * v x) x < 0 := by
    intro x h1 h2
    have hxb : x ∈ Metric.ball z R := Metric.mem_ball.mpr h2
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hbW hxb
    obtain ⟨-, hp1, hp2⟩ := hlin x hxW
    obtain ⟨hq, ha, hbx, -⟩ := hK x h1.le h2.le
    have hineq := hbar (A x) (B x) (x - z) hq ha hbx
      (by rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact h2.le)
    have he := hH0 x hxb
    have hTv := mul_pos hm hineq
    simp only [hp1, hp2, hv1, hv2, zero_mul] at hTv ⊢
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hTv he ⊢
    linarith
  have hout : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R → 0 ≤ (fun x => -w x - m * v x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hball (by rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hx])
    have hxcl : x ∈ closure (Metric.ball z R) := by
      rw [closure_ball z hR.ne']
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, hx]
    have hwc : ContinuousWithinAt w (Metric.ball z R) x :=
      (hw.continuousOn.continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hxW)).continuousWithinAt
    have hwx : w x ≤ (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x :=
      ContinuousWithinAt.closure_le hxcl hwc continuousWithinAt_const
        (fun y hy => (hneg y (hbW hy) (hbpos y hy)).le)
    show 0 ≤ -w x - m * v x
    rw [hV1 x hx, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    simp only at hwx
    linarith
  have hin : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → 0 ≤ (fun x => -w x - m * v x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 : m ≤ -w x := hSin x hx
    have h2 := hV2 x
    show 0 ≤ -w x - m * v x
    nlinarith
  have hApsd : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j := by
    intro x hx ξ
    by_cases hξ : ξ = 0
    · subst hξ
      simp
    · exact (hApos x hx ξ hξ).le
  have hmp := esm_annulus_min_principle W hW A B (fun x => -w x - m * v x) 0 z R hR hball hu hAs
    hApsd le_rfl hstrict hin hout
  
  have hu1 : -w x₁ - m * v x₁ = 0 := by
    rw [hw0, hV1 x₁ hx₁z]
    ring
  have hseg : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 →
      (fun x => -w x - m * v x) x₁ ≤ (fun x => -w x - m * v x) (x₁ + t • y₀) := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    have hd : dist (x₁ + t • y₀) z = (1 - t / 2) * R := by
      have e1 : x₁ + t • y₀ - z = (1 - t / 2) • (x₁ - z) := by
        rw [hy₀]
        module
      rw [dist_eq_norm, e1, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith),
        ← dist_eq_norm, hx₁z]
    show -w x₁ - m * v x₁ ≤ -w (x₁ + t • y₀) - m * v (x₁ + t • y₀)
    rw [hu1]
    exact hmp _ (by rw [hd]; nlinarith) (by rw [hd]; nlinarith)
  have hdu : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => -w x - m * v x) x₁ :=
    (hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx₁W)
  have h11 : 0 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fun x => -w x - m * v x) x₁ y₀ := by
    have hminOn : IsLocalMinOn (fun x => -w x - m * v x) (segment ℝ x₁ (x₁ + y₀)) x₁ := by
      apply Filter.eventually_of_mem self_mem_nhdsWithin
      intro p hp
      rw [segment_eq_image'] at hp
      obtain ⟨θ, ⟨h0, h1⟩, rfl⟩ := hp
      have := hseg θ h0 h1
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left] using this
    exact hminOn.hasFDerivWithinAt_nonneg hdu.hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
      (mem_posTangentConeAt_of_segment_subset subset_rfl)
  
  intro hdw0
  obtain ⟨hf1, -, -⟩ := hlin x₁ hx₁W
  rw [hf1, hdw0] at h11
  simp only [neg_zero, zero_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, smul_eq_mul] at h11
  nlinarith [mul_pos hm hV3]

subgoal_signatures.name: esm_lap2_coeff_form
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsm : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) : ∃ (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ), (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) ∧ (∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) ∧ ∀ (w : E2 → ℝ) (x : E2), lap2 h w x = ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j w) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k w x

subgoal_signatures.name: esm_hopf_constants
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (w c : E2 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => A x i j) W) (hB : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => B x k) W) (hApos : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, ξ ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) (hwc : ContinuousOn w W) (hc : ContinuousOn c W) (z : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball z R, 0 < w x) : ∃ m₀ Λ β Γ m : ℝ, 0 < m₀ ∧ 0 ≤ Λ ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ 0 ≤ Γ ∧ 0 < m ∧ (∀ x : E2, R / 2 ≤ dist x z → dist x z ≤ R → m₀ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (x - z) i * A x i j * (x - z) j ∧ (∀ i : Fin 2, |A x i i| ≤ Λ) ∧ (∀ k : Fin 2, |B x k| ≤ β) ∧ |c x| ≤ Γ) ∧ ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → m ≤ w x

subgoal_signatures.name: esm_barrier_derivs
subgoal_signatures.statement: (z : E2) (α R : ℝ) (v : E2 → ℝ) (hv : ∀ x, v x = Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2) - Real.exp (-α * R ^ 2)) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v ∧ (∀ x d : E2, fderiv ℝ v x d = -2 * α * (∑ k : Fin 2, (x - z) k * d k) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)) ∧ (∀ (x : E2) (j : Fin 2), pd2 j v x = -2 * α * (x - z) j * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)) ∧ ∀ (x : E2) (i j : Fin 2), pd2 i (pd2 j v) x = (4 * α ^ 2 * (x - z) i * (x - z) j - 2 * α * (if i = j then 1 else 0)) * Real.exp (-α * ‖x - z‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: esm_annulus_min_principle
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (B : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ) (Γ : ℝ) (z : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hball : Metric.closedBall z R ⊆ W) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W) (hAs : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, A x i j = A x j i) (hApsd : ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ ξ : E2, 0 ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ξ i * A x i j * ξ j) (hΓ : 0 ≤ Γ) (hstrict : ∀ x : E2, R / 2 < dist x z → dist x z < R → ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A x i j * pd2 i (pd2 j u) x + ∑ k : Fin 2, B x k * pd2 k u x - Γ * u x < 0) (hin : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R / 2 → 0 ≤ u x) (hout : ∀ x : E2, dist x z = R → 0 ≤ u x) : ∀ x : E2, R / 2 ≤ dist x z → dist x z ≤ R → 0 ≤ u x

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (t : ℝ) (p : M) (hp : u p = t)
    (hdp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0) (U : Set M) (hU : IsOpen U) (hpU : p ∈ U) :
    ∃ (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3) (O : Set M) (π : E3 →L[ℝ] E2),
      IsOpen W ∧ IsOpen O ∧ p ∈ O ∧ O ⊆ U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W ∧
      Set.InjOn F W ∧
      (∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x) ∧ π (F x) = x) ∧
      (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) '' W = O ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}

signature.name: chart_level_patch
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (t : ℝ) (p : M) (hp : u p = t)
    (hdp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p ≠ 0) (U : Set M) (hU : IsOpen U) (hpU : p ∈ U) :
    ∃ (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3) (O : Set M) (π : E3 →L[ℝ] E2),
      IsOpen W ∧ IsOpen O ∧ p ∈ O ∧ O ⊆ U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W ∧
      Set.InjOn F W ∧
      (∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target ∧ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x) ∧ π (F x) = x) ∧
      (fun x => (chartAt E3 p).symm (F x)) '' W = O ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hn : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hn1 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by simp
  obtain ⟨f, hfdef⟩ : ∃ f : E3 → ℝ, f = fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfapp : ∀ y, f y = u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) := fun y => by rw [hfdef]
  set y₀ : E3 := chartAt E3 p p with hy₀
  have hpsrc : p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).source := mem_chart_source E3 p
  have hy₀t : y₀ ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := mem_chart_target E3 p
  have hleft : (chartAt E3 p).symm y₀ = p := (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hpsrc
  
  have hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (chartAt E3 p).target := by
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (u ∘ (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      hu.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm
    have h2 := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    rw [hfdef]
    exact h2
  set A : Set E3 := (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' U with hAdef
  have hAo : IsOpen A :=
    (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 p).open_target hU
  have hy₀A : y₀ ∈ A := ⟨hy₀t, by show (chartAt E3 p).symm y₀ ∈ U; rw [hleft]; exact hpU⟩
  have hfA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f A := hf.mono Set.inter_subset_left
  have hfat : ∀ z ∈ A, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f z := fun z hz => hfA.contDiffAt (hAo.mem_nhds hz)
  
  have hmd : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p := by
    by_contra h
    exact hdp (mfderiv_zero_of_not_mdifferentiableAt h)
  have hmf : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p =
      fderiv ℝ (u ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) p).symm) (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) p p) := by
    rw [hmd.mfderiv, ModelWithCorners.range_eq_univ, fderivWithin_univ]
    congr 1
  have hL : fderiv ℝ f y₀ ≠ 0 := by
    have e1 : (u ∘ (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) p).symm) = f := by
      funext y
      rw [hfapp]
      first
        | rfl
        | simp [extChartAt_coe_symm]
    have e2 : extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) p p = y₀ := by
      first
        | rfl
        | simp [hy₀, extChartAt_coe]
    rw [← e1, ← e2, ← hmf]
    exact hdp
  
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f y₀ (e b) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    apply hL
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
    have hv : v = ∑ a : Fin 3, v a • e a := by
      ext k
      simp [e, Pi.single_apply, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [hv, map_sum]
    simp [hcon]
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : E3 →L[ℝ] E3, ∀ v, P v = v - v b • e b :=
    ⟨ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 - (EuclideanSpace.proj b).smulRight (e b), fun v => by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : E2 →L[ℝ] E3, ∀ x, J x = ∑ k : Fin 2, x k • e (b.succAbove k) :=
    ⟨∑ k : Fin 2, (EuclideanSpace.proj k).smulRight (e (b.succAbove k)), fun x => by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ : ∃ π : E3 →L[ℝ] E2, ∀ z, π z = ∑ k : Fin 2, z (b.succAbove k) • e2 k :=
    ⟨∑ k : Fin 2, (EuclideanSpace.proj (b.succAbove k)).smulRight (e2 k), fun z => by simp⟩
  have heb : (e b) b = 1 := by simp
  have hPb : ∀ v : E3, (P v) b = 0 := by intro v; rw [hP]; simp
  have hPc : ∀ (v : E3) (j : Fin 2), (P v) (b.succAbove j) = v (b.succAbove j) := by
    intro v j; rw [hP]; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne]
  have hJb : ∀ x : E2, (J x) b = 0 := by
    intro x; rw [hJ]; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.ne_succAbove]
  have hJc : ∀ (x : E2) (j : Fin 2), (J x) (b.succAbove j) = x j := by
    intro x j; rw [hJ]; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_right_inj]
    fin_cases j <;> simp
  have hπc : ∀ (z : E3) (j : Fin 2), (π z) j = z (b.succAbove j) := by
    intro z j; rw [hπ]; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    fin_cases j <;> simp
  have hπe : π (e b) = 0 := by
    ext j; rw [hπc]; simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.succAbove_ne]
  have hπP : ∀ v : E3, π (P v) = π v := by
    intro v; rw [hP, map_sub, map_smul, hπe, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  have hπJ : ∀ x : E2, π (J x) = x := by
    intro x; ext j; rw [hπc, hJc]
  have hJπ : ∀ w : E3, J (π w) = P w := by
    intro w
    ext i
    rcases eq_or_ne i b with rfl | hi
    · rw [hJb, hPb]
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_succAbove_eq hi
      rw [hJc, hπc, hPc]
  
  set B : Set E3 := A ∩ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e b)) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ with hBdef
  have hfderc : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (e b)) A :=
    (hfA.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hAo hn1).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hBo : IsOpen B := hfderc.isOpen_inter_preimage hAo isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hy₀B : y₀ ∈ B := ⟨hy₀A, hb⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : E3 → E3, Ψ = fun z => P z + (f z - t) • e b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hΨapp : ∀ z, Ψ z = P z + (f z - t) • e b := fun z => by rw [hΨ]
  have hΨcd : ∀ z ∈ A, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Ψ z := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hΨ]
    exact P.contDiff.contDiffAt.add (((hfat z hz).sub contDiffAt_const).smul contDiffAt_const)
  have hderiv : ∀ z ∈ A, HasFDerivAt Ψ (P + (fderiv ℝ f z).smulRight (e b)) z := by
    intro z hz
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z := (hfat z hz).differentiableAt hn
    rw [hΨ]
    exact P.hasFDerivAt.add ((hd.hasFDerivAt.sub_const t).smul_const (e b))
  have hequiv : ∀ z ∈ B, ∃ E : E3 ≃L[ℝ] E3,
      (E : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) = P + (fderiv ℝ f z).smulRight (e b) := by
    intro z hz
    have hκ : fderiv ℝ f z (e b) ≠ 0 := hz.2
    have hinj : Function.Injective (P + (fderiv ℝ f z).smulRight (e b)) := by
      refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 ?_
      intro v hv
      have hv' : P v + (fderiv ℝ f z v) • e b = 0 := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply] at hv
        exact hv
      have h1 : fderiv ℝ f z v = 0 := by
        simpa [hPb] using congrArg (fun w : E3 => w b) hv'
      rw [h1, zero_smul, add_zero] at hv'
      have hvd : v = (v b) • e b := by
        have h := hP v
        rw [hv'] at h
        exact (sub_eq_zero.mp h.symm)
      have h2 : fderiv ℝ f z v = v b * fderiv ℝ f z (e b) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hvd]
        rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      have hvb : v b = 0 := by
        rw [h1] at h2
        exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h2.symm).resolve_right hκ
      rw [hvd, hvb, zero_smul]
    exact ⟨(LinearEquiv.ofInjectiveEndo
      ((P + (fderiv ℝ f z).smulRight (e b) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) hinj).toContinuousLinearEquiv,
      by ext v; rfl⟩
  
  obtain ⟨E₀, hE₀⟩ := hequiv y₀ hy₀B
  have hs : HasStrictFDerivAt Ψ (E₀ : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) y₀ := by
    have hd : HasFDerivAt Ψ (E₀ : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) y₀ := by rw [hE₀]; exact hderiv y₀ hy₀A
    exact (hΨcd y₀ hy₀A).hasStrictFDerivAt' hd hn
  obtain ⟨H, hHcoe, hy₀H⟩ : ∃ H : OpenPartialHomeomorph E3 E3, ⇑H = Ψ ∧ y₀ ∈ H.source :=
    ⟨hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph Ψ, hs.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe,
      hs.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source⟩
  have hHapp : ∀ z, H z = Ψ z := fun z => by rw [hHcoe]
  have hsymm : ∀ a ∈ H.target, H.symm a ∈ B → ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H.symm a := by
    intro a ha haB
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := hequiv _ haB
    have hd : HasFDerivAt H (E : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (H.symm a) := by
      rw [hHcoe, hE]; exact hderiv _ haB.1
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H (H.symm a) := by rw [hHcoe]; exact hΨcd _ haB.1
    exact H.contDiffAt_symm ha hd hc
  set T : Set E3 := H.target ∩ H.symm ⁻¹' (H.source ∩ B) with hTdef
  have hTo : IsOpen T :=
    H.continuousOn_symm.isOpen_inter_preimage H.open_target (H.open_source.inter hBo)
  have hWo : IsOpen (J ⁻¹' T) := hTo.preimage J.continuous
  have hkey : ∀ x ∈ J ⁻¹' T, f (H.symm (J x)) = t ∧ π (H.symm (J x)) = x ∧
      H.symm (J x) ∈ H.source ∩ B := by
    intro x hx
    have hxT : J x ∈ T := hx
    have hΨF : Ψ (H.symm (J x)) = J x := by rw [← hHapp]; exact H.right_inv hxT.1
    rw [hΨapp] at hΨF
    have hft : f (H.symm (J x)) = t := by
      have hb' := congrArg (fun w : E3 => w b) hΨF
      have h' : f (H.symm (J x)) - t = 0 := by simpa [hPb, hJb] using hb'
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h'
    rw [hft, sub_self, zero_smul, add_zero] at hΨF
    refine ⟨hft, ?_, hxT.2⟩
    rw [← hπP, hΨF, hπJ]
  have hsmoothF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => H.symm (J x)) (J ⁻¹' T) := by
    intro x hx
    exact ((hsymm _ hx.1 hx.2.2).comp x J.contDiff.contDiffAt).contDiffWithinAt
  have hinjD : ∀ x ∈ J ⁻¹' T, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x => H.symm (J x)) x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hWn : J ⁻¹' T ∈ 𝓝 x := hWo.mem_nhds hx
    have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x => H.symm (J x)) x :=
      (hsmoothF.contDiffAt hWn).differentiableAt hn
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => π (H.symm (J y)))
        (π.comp (fderiv ℝ (fun x => H.symm (J x)) x)) x :=
      π.hasFDerivAt.comp x hFd.hasFDerivAt
    have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => π (H.symm (J y))) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2) x := by
      refine (hasFDerivAt_id x).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [hWn] with y hy
      exact (hkey y hy).2.1
    have h3 := h1.unique h2
    intro v w hvw
    have h4 := congrArg π hvw
    have e1 := DFunLike.congr_fun h3 v
    have e2 := DFunLike.congr_fun h3 w
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] at e1 e2
    rw [← e1, ← e2, h4]
  refine ⟨J ⁻¹' T, fun x => H.symm (J x),
    (chartAt E3 p).source ∩ (chartAt E3 p) ⁻¹' (H.source ∩ B), π, hWo, ?_, ?_, ?_, hsmoothF,
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (chartAt E3 p).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (chartAt E3 p).open_source
      (H.open_source.inter hBo)
  · exact ⟨hpsrc, hy₀H, hy₀B⟩
  · rintro w ⟨hws, hwH, hwB⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hws⟩
    have h : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p w) ∈ U := hwB.1.2
    rwa [(chartAt E3 p).left_inv hws] at h
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    have h1 := (hkey x hx).2.1
    have h2 := (hkey y hy).2.1
    have h3 : H.symm (J x) = H.symm (J y) := hxy
    rw [← h1, ← h2, h3]
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨(hkey x hx).2.2.2.1.1, hinjD x hx, (hkey x hx).2.1⟩
  · ext w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨hft, -, hHs, hB'⟩ := hkey x hx
      have hFt : H.symm (J x) ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := hB'.1.1
      refine ⟨⟨(chartAt E3 p).map_target hFt, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · show chartAt E3 p ((chartAt E3 p).symm (H.symm (J x))) ∈ H.source ∩ B
        rw [(chartAt E3 p).right_inv hFt]
        exact ⟨hHs, hB'⟩
      · show u ((chartAt E3 p).symm (H.symm (J x))) = t
        rw [← hfapp]
        exact hft
    · rintro ⟨⟨hws, hwH, hwB⟩, hwt⟩
      have hwt' : u w = t := hwt
      have hyt : f (chartAt E3 p w) = t := by
        rw [hfapp, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hws]; exact hwt'
      have hΨy : Ψ (chartAt E3 p w) = J (π (chartAt E3 p w)) := by
        rw [hΨapp, hyt, sub_self, zero_smul, add_zero, hJπ]
      have hJT : J (π (chartAt E3 p w)) ∈ T := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← hΨy, ← hHapp]; exact H.map_source hwH
        · show H.symm (J (π (chartAt E3 p w))) ∈ H.source ∩ B
          rw [← hΨy, ← hHapp, H.left_inv hwH]
          exact ⟨hwH, hwB⟩
      refine ⟨π (chartAt E3 p w), hJT, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 p).symm (H.symm (J (π (chartAt E3 p w)))) = w
      rw [← hΨy, ← hHapp, H.left_inv hwH, (chartAt E3 p).left_inv hws]

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (z : M) (W : Set E2) (F : E2 → E3) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W)
    (hFt : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hfd : ∀ (a : Fin 2) (k : Fin 3),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 a)) k) W := by
    intro a k
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) W := hF.fderiv_of_isOpen hW le_rfl
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ F x (e2 a)) W := h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
  have hGF : ∀ k l : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) k l) W :=
    fun k l => (g.smooth z k l).comp hF (fun x hx => hFt x hx)
  have hGsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (k l : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y k l = g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm y l k := by
    intro y k l
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
    exact g.symm _ _ _
  refine ⟨fun a c => ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
      (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 a)) k * g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) k l *
        (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 c)) l) W
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun k _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun l _ =>
      ((hfd a k).mul (hGF k l)).mul (hfd c l)))
  · have hGpd : (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)).PosDef := by
      classical
      have hy : F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target := hFt x hx
      have hq : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source :=
        (chartAt E3 z).map_target hy
      have hf : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 z) hy
      have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z)
          ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) :=
        mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 z) hq
      have hcomp : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 z) ∘ (chartAt E3 z).symm) (F x) =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))).comp
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) := mfderiv_comp (F x) hg hf
      have hid : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 z) ∘ (chartAt E3 z).symm) (F x) =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) id (F x) := by
        apply Filter.EventuallyEq.mfderiv_eq
        filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 z).eventually_right_inverse hy] with u hu
        exact hu
      rw [mfderiv_id] at hid
      have hinv : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z) ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) w) = w := by
        intro w
        have h1 := congrArg (fun L => L w) (hcomp.symm.trans hid)
        simpa using h1
      have hDinj : ∀ w : E3,
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) w = 0 → w = 0 := by
        intro w hw
        rw [← hinv w, hw, map_zero]
      apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
      · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
        intro i j
        simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix, star_trivial]
        exact g.symm _ _ _
      · intro y hy0
        have hvx : (∑ i, y i • e i : E3) ≠ 0 := by
          intro h0
          apply hy0
          funext j
          have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u j) h0
          fin_cases j <;> simpa [e, Fin.sum_univ_three, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] using h1
        have hDv := fun h => hvx (hDinj _ h)
        have hpos := g.posDef ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) _ hDv
        have key : star y ⬝ᵥ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)).mulVec y =
            g.g ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) (∑ i, y i • e i : E3))
              (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) (∑ i, y i • e i : E3)) := by
          simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add,
            ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
            RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
          ring
        rw [key]
        exact hpos
    apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
    · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
      intro i j
      simp only [star_trivial, pullMetric2]
      conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      rw [hGsymm (F x) l k]
      ring
    · intro w hw0
      set v : E2 := w 0 • e2 0 + w 1 • e2 1 with hvdef
      have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hw0
        have h1 := congrArg (fun u : E2 => u 0) h0
        have h2 := congrArg (fun u : E2 => u 1) h0
        simp [v, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] at h1 h2
        funext k
        fin_cases k
        · simpa using h1
        · simpa using h2
      have hξ0 : (fun k => (fderiv ℝ F x v) k) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        apply hv0
        apply hinj x hx
        rw [map_zero]
        ext k
        have := congrFun h0 k
        simpa using this
      have key : star w ⬝ᵥ (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm) F x).mulVec w =
          star (fun k => (fderiv ℝ F x v) k) ⬝ᵥ
            (g.coeff (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)).mulVec (fun k => (fderiv ℝ F x v) k) := by
        simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three,
          Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, pullMetric2, hvdef, map_add, map_smul,
          PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      rw [key]
      exact hGpd.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hξ0

proof.tactics:
by
  have hne : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  
  have htrans : ∀ a b : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => chartAt E3 b ((chartAt E3 a).symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 a).target ∩ (chartAt E3 a).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 b).source) := by
    intro a b
    have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 a).symm
        ((chartAt E3 a).target ∩ (chartAt E3 a).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 b).source) :=
      (contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := a) (n := ∞)).mono Set.inter_subset_left
    have h2 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (chartAt E3 b) (chartAt E3 b).source :=
      contMDiffOn_chart (x := b)
    have h3 := h2.comp h1 (fun y hy => hy.2)
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h3
  have hAo : ∀ a b : M,
      IsOpen ((chartAt E3 a).target ∩ (chartAt E3 a).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 b).source) :=
    fun a b => (chartAt E3 a).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 b).open_source
  have hpmc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) W :=
    (chartAt E3 z).continuousOn_symm.comp hF.continuousOn hFt
  have hSo : IsOpen (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) :=
    hpmc.isOpen_inter_preimage hW (chartAt E3 q').open_source
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo F (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source)
      ((chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) :=
    fun x hx => ⟨hFt x hx.1, hx.2⟩
  have hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)))
      (W ∩ (fun x => (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) :=
    (htrans z q').comp (hF.mono Set.inter_subset_left) hmaps
  refine ⟨hsm, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x := (hF.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx.1)).differentiableAt hne
  have hy : F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target ∩ (chartAt E3 z).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source :=
    hmaps hx
  have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F x) :=
    ((htrans z q').contDiffAt ((hAo z q').mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt hne
  have hτy : chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ∈
      (chartAt E3 q').target ∩ (chartAt E3 q').symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 z).source := by
    refine ⟨(chartAt E3 q').map_source hx.2, ?_⟩
    show (chartAt E3 q').symm (chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source
    rw [(chartAt E3 q').left_inv hx.2]
    exact (chartAt E3 z).map_target (hFt x hx.1)
  have hτ'd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q').symm y))
      (chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) :=
    ((htrans q' z).contDiffAt ((hAo q' z).mem_nhds hτy)).differentiableAt hne
  have hcomp : (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q').symm y))
      (chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)))).comp
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F x)) =
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 := by
    rw [← fderiv_comp (F x) hτ'd hτd]
    have hev : ((fun y => chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q').symm y)) ∘
        (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm y))) =ᶠ[𝓝 (F x)] id := by
      filter_upwards [(hAo z q').mem_nhds hy] with w hw
      show chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q').symm (chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm w))) = w
      rw [(chartAt E3 q').left_inv hw.2, (chartAt E3 z).right_inv hw.1]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id]
  have hτinj : Function.Injective
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F x)) := by
    intro v w hvw
    have h1 := congrArg (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q').symm y))
      (chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)))) hvw
    have h2 := congrArg (fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => T v) hcomp
    have h3 := congrArg (fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => T w) hcomp
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] at h2 h3
    exact h2.symm.trans (h1.trans h3)
  have hchainF : fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x =
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm y)) (F x)).comp (fderiv ℝ F x) :=
    fderiv_comp x hτd hFd
  have hG2d : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x :=
    hτd.comp x hFd
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hchainF, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp']
    exact hτinj.comp (hinj x hx.1)
  
  have hexp3 : ∀ v : E3, v = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k • e k := by
    intro v
    ext k
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]
  have hs1 : ∀ (φ : E3 → M) (G : E2 → E3) (y : E2) (i j : Fin 2),
      pullMetric2 (g.coeff φ) G y i j =
        g.g (φ (G y)) ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ (G y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (fderiv ℝ G y (e2 i)))
          ((mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ (G y) : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (fderiv ℝ G y (e2 j))) := by
    intro φ G y i j
    set L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 := mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ (G y) with hLdef
    set B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ := g.g (φ (G y)) with hBdef
    have hL : ∀ v : E3, L v = ∑ k : Fin 3, v k • L (e k) := by
      intro v
      conv_lhs => rw [hexp3 v]
      rw [map_sum]
      simp only [map_smul]
    have hc : ∀ k l : Fin 3, g.coeff φ (G y) k l = B (L (e k)) (L (e l)) := fun k l => rfl
    have hbil : ∀ u w : E3, B (L u) (L w) = ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
        u k * g.coeff φ (G y) k l * w l := by
      intro u w
      rw [hL u, hL w]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum, hc]
      first
        | (refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)); ring1)
        | (rw [Finset.sum_comm]
           refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ => ?_)); ring1)
    unfold pullMetric2
    exact (hbil _ _).symm
  have hp : (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) =
      (chartAt E3 q').symm (chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) :=
    ((chartAt E3 q').left_inv hx.2).symm
  have hd₁ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 z) (hFt x hx.1)
  have hd₂ : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q').symm
      (chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x))) :=
    mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q') ((chartAt E3 q').map_source hx.2)
  have hchain : ∀ v : E2,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) (fderiv ℝ F x v) =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q').symm
          (chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)))
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x v) := by
    intro v
    have hev : ((chartAt E3 z).symm ∘ F) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        ((chartAt E3 q').symm ∘ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y)))) := by
      filter_upwards [hSo.mem_nhds hx] with x' hx'
      show (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x') =
        (chartAt E3 q').symm (chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x')))
      exact ((chartAt E3 q').left_inv hx'.2).symm
    have hm := hev.mfderiv_eq (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E2)) (I' := 𝓘(ℝ, E3))
    have h1 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E2) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ((chartAt E3 z).symm ∘ F) x v =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 z).symm (F x) (fderiv ℝ F x v) := by
      rw [mfderiv_comp_apply x hd₁ hFd.mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      rfl
    have h2 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E2) 𝓘(ℝ, E3)
        ((chartAt E3 q').symm ∘ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y)))) x v =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q').symm
          (chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)))
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x v) := by
      rw [mfderiv_comp_apply x hd₂ hG2d.mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      rfl
    rw [← h1, ← h2, hm]
    rfl
  have key : ∀ (p p' : M) (u w : E3), p = p' → g.g p u w = g.g p' u w := by
    rintro p p' u w rfl
    rfl
  funext a b
  rw [hs1 _ F x a b, hs1 _ (fun y => chartAt E3 q' ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x a b,
    hchain, hchain]
  exact key _ _ _ _ hp

by
  have h1 := contDiffOn_ext_coord_change (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞) z q'
  have hsub : (chartAt E3 q').target ∩ (chartAt E3 q').symm ⁻¹' O ⊆
      ((extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) q').symm.trans (extChartAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) z)).source := by
    intro y hy
    rw [PartialEquiv.trans_source]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [PartialEquiv.symm_source, extChartAt_target]

    · rw [extChartAt_source]

  have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => chartAt E3 z ((chartAt E3 q').symm y))
      ((chartAt E3 q').target ∩ (chartAt E3 q').symm ⁻¹' O) := by
    have h3 := h1.mono hsub
    refine h3.congr ?_
    intro y _
    simp
  exact π.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2

(h₁ h₂ : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x : E2)

signature.name: gaussCurv2_congr_nhds
signature.statement:
(h₁ h₂ : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x : E2)
    (hev : h₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] h₂) : gaussCurv2 h₁ x = gaussCurv2 h₂ x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hchr : ∀ y : E2, h₁ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] h₂ → ∀ k i j : Fin 2,
      christoffel2 h₁ k i j y = christoffel2 h₂ k i j y := by
    intro y hy k i j
    have hpt : h₁ y = h₂ y := hy.eq_of_nhds
    have hpd : ∀ a b c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun z => h₁ z a b) y = pd2 c (fun z => h₂ z a b) y := by
      intro a b c
      have he : (fun z => h₁ z a b) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => h₂ z a b) :=
        hy.mono (fun z hz => by simp only [hz])
      unfold pd2
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq he]
    simp only [christoffel2, hpt, hpd]
  have hev2 : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, christoffel2 h₁ k i j =ᶠ[𝓝 x] christoffel2 h₂ k i j := by
    intro k i j
    exact hev.eventually_nhds.mono (fun y hy => hchr y hy k i j)
  have hpdc : ∀ c k i j : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (christoffel2 h₁ k i j) x = pd2 c (christoffel2 h₂ k i j) x := by
    intro c k i j
    unfold pd2
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (hev2 k i j)]
  have hric : ∀ j k : Fin 2, ricci2 h₁ j k x = ricci2 h₂ j k x := by
    intro j k
    simp only [ricci2, hpdc, hchr x hev]
  have hpt : h₁ x = h₂ x := hev.eq_of_nhds
  simp only [gaussCurv2, hpt, hric]

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (q : M) (S : Set E2) (hS : IsOpen S) (P : E2 → M)
    (hP : ∀ x ∈ S, P x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source)
    (hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => chartAt E3 q (P x)) S)
    (hinj : ∀ x ∈ S, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q (P y)) x)) (c : ℝ)
    (hlev : ∀ x ∈ S, u (P x) = c)
    (hreg : ∀ x ∈ S, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u (P x) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ S, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun y => chartAt E3 q (P y))) x =
      levelGaussLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 q (P x))

signature.name: chart_level_gauss
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u : M → ℝ)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (q : M) (S : Set E2) (hS : IsOpen S) (P : E2 → M)
    (hP : ∀ x ∈ S, P x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).source)
    (hsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => chartAt E3 q (P x)) S)
    (hinj : ∀ x ∈ S, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 q (P y)) x)) (c : ℝ)
    (hlev : ∀ x ∈ S, u (P x) = c)
    (hreg : ∀ x ∈ S, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u (P x) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ S, gaussCurv2 (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun y => chartAt E3 q (P y))) x =
      levelGaussLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
        (chartAt E3 q (P x))

proof.tactics:
by
  have hFV : ∀ x ∈ S, (fun y => chartAt E3 q (P y)) x ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target :=
    fun x hx => (chartAt E3 q).map_source (hP x hx)
  have hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j)
      (chartAt E3 q).target := fun i j => g.smooth q i j
  have hsymm : ∀ (y : E3) (i j : Fin 3),
      g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y i j = g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y j i := by
    intro y i j
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
    exact g.symm _ _ _
  have hpd : ∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).PosDef :=
    fun y hy => coeff_chart_symm_posDef g q y hy
  have hf := (chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu q).1
  have hlev' : ∀ x ∈ S, (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))
      ((fun y => chartAt E3 q (P y)) x) = c := by
    intro x hx
    show u ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q (P x))) = c
    rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv (hP x hx)]
    exact hlev x hx
  have hreg' : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < gradSqLoc (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm)
      (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) ((fun y => chartAt E3 q (P y)) x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hd : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 q).symm (chartAt E3 q (P x))) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [(chartAt E3 q).left_inv (hP x hx)]
      exact hreg x hx
    have h := chart_Nsq_pos g u hu q _ (hFV x hx) hd
    unfold gradSqLoc gradInnerLoc
    exact h
  intro x hx
  exact level_gauss_equation (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (chartAt E3 q).target
    (chartAt E3 q).open_target hG hsymm hpd (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) hf
    (fun y => chartAt E3 q (P y)) S hS hsm hFV hinj c hlev' hreg' x hx

subgoal_signatures.name: chart_pullback_gradInner
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (p : M) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p).target ∧
      (∀ y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target, g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) =
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ i j *
          partialDeriv i (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y *
          partialDeriv j (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y) ∧
      ContinuousOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det *
        Real.sqrt (g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y))) (chartAt E3 p).target

    (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V)

informal_problem.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (β u : M → ℝ) (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β)
    (hβr : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0) (t : ℝ) (z : M) (W : Set E2)
    (F : E2 → E3) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W)
    (hFt : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target)
    (hinj : ∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x))
    (hlev : ∀ x ∈ W, u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = t)
    (hreg : ∀ x ∈ W, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ≠ 0) :

      fderiv ℝ (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x ≠ 0

signature.name: level_param_edge_regular
signature.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (β u : M → ℝ) (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β)
    (hβr : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0) (t : ℝ) (z : M) (W : Set E2)
    (F : E2 → E3) (hW : IsOpen W) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F W)
    (hFt : ∀ x ∈ W, F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target)
    (hinj : ∀ x ∈ W, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x))
    (hlev : ∀ x ∈ W, u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = t)
    (hreg : ∀ x ∈ W, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ W, β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) = 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F y))) x ≠ 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx hβ0 h0
  have hy : F x ∈ (chartAt E3 z).target := hFt x hx
  have htgt : (chartAt E3 z).target ∈ 𝓝 (F x) := (chartAt E3 z).open_target.mem_nhds hy
  obtain ⟨hfs, hgrad, -⟩ := chart_pullback_gradInner g u hu z
  have hBs := (chart_pullback_gradInner g β hβ z).1
  have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x) :=
    (hfs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt htgt
  have hBd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x) :=
    (hBs.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt htgt
  have hFd : DifferentiableAt ℝ F x :=
    (hF.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)
  have hpos : 0 < g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 z).symm (F x)) := by
    rw [hgrad (F x) hy]
    exact chart_Nsq_pos g u hu z (F x) hy (hreg x hx)
  obtain ⟨hDf0, hind'⟩ := stern_bad_chart_indep g β u hβ hβr hu hneu z (F x) hy hpos
  have hind := hind' hβ0
  have hDf : (fderiv ℝ (fun w => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x)).comp (fderiv ℝ F x) = 0 := by
    have hev : ((fun w => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) ∘ F) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => t) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun x' hx' => hlev x' hx')
    rw [← fderiv_comp x hfd hFd, hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_const_apply]
  have hDB : (fderiv ℝ (fun w => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x)).comp (fderiv ℝ F x) = 0 := by
    rw [← fderiv_comp x hBd hFd]
    exact h0
  have hinjx := hinj x hx
  clear hind'
  generalize fderiv ℝ F x = DF at hDf hDB hinjx
  generalize fderiv ℝ (fun w => u ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x) = Df at hDf hDB hind hDf0
  generalize fderiv ℝ (fun w => β ((chartAt E3 z).symm w)) (F x) = DB at hDf hDB hind hDf0
  
  obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀⟩ : ∃ w₀, Df w₀ ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    exact hDf0 (ContinuousLinearMap.ext hc)
  set v : E3 := (Df w₀)⁻¹ • w₀ with hv
  have hDfv : Df v = 1 := by
    rw [hv, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hw₀]
  have hRN : LinearMap.range (DF : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E3) = LinearMap.ker (Df : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) := by
    apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le
    · rintro _ ⟨x', rfl⟩
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      have := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L x') hDf
      simpa using this
    · have h1 : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (DF : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)) = 2 := by
        rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (by exact hinjx)]
        simp
      have h2 : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (Df : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) < 3 := by
        have hlt : LinearMap.ker (Df : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) < ⊤ := by
          rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
          intro htop
          have hvm : v ∈ LinearMap.ker (Df : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) := htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top
          rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hvm
          have : Df v = 0 := hvm
          rw [hDfv] at this
          exact one_ne_zero this
        have := Submodule.finrank_lt hlt.ne
        simpa using this
      omega
  have hDBw : ∀ w : E3, DB w = Df w * DB v := by
    intro w
    have hmem : w - (Df w) • v ∈ LinearMap.ker (Df : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) := by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      show Df (w - (Df w) • v) = 0
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hDfv, mul_one, sub_self]
    rw [← hRN] at hmem
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hmem
    have h3 : DB (DF x') = 0 := by
      have := congrArg (fun L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L x') hDB
      simpa using this
    have hx'' : DF x' = w - (Df w) • v := hx'
    rw [hx'', map_sub, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h3
    linarith
  have hfin := hind 1 (-(DB v)) (by
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun w => ?_
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, one_mul]
    rw [hDBw w]
    ring)
  exact one_ne_zero hfin.1
