subgoal_signatures.name: chart_Nsq_pos
subgoal_signatures.statement: [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (ρ : M → ℝ) (hρ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ρ) (p : M) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target) (hd : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) ≠ 0) : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y * partialDeriv b (fun z => ρ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) y

subgoal_signatures.name: stern_bad_chart_indep
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (β u : M → ℝ) (hβ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β)
    (hβr : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0)
    (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u)
    (hneu : ∀ p : M, β p = 0 → g.gradInner u β p = 0) (q : M) (y : E3)
    (hy : y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target) (hpos : 0 < g.gradInner u u ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y ≠ 0 ∧
      (β ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) = 0 → ∀ a c : ℝ,
        a • fderiv ℝ (fun z => β ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y +
          c • fderiv ℝ (fun z => u ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y = 0 → a = 0 ∧ c = 0)

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (O : M → Set M) (hO : ∀ p ∈ K, IsOpen (O p) ∧ p ∈ O p) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (z : Fin m → M) (ψ : Fin m → M → ℝ), (∀ i, z i ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ i) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ i x) ∧
        IsCompact (tsupport (ψ i)) ∧ tsupport (ψ i) ⊆ O (z i)) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ K, 1 ≤ ∑ i, ψ i p

signature.name: finite_bump_cover
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (K : Set M) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (O : M → Set M) (hO : ∀ p ∈ K, IsOpen (O p) ∧ p ∈ O p) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (z : Fin m → M) (ψ : Fin m → M → ℝ), (∀ i, z i ∈ K) ∧
      (∀ i, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (ψ i) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ i x) ∧
        IsCompact (tsupport (ψ i)) ∧ tsupport (ψ i) ⊆ O (z i)) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ K, 1 ≤ ∑ i, ψ i p

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hbump : ∀ p : M, ∃ f : SmoothBumpFunction 𝓘(ℝ, E3) p, p ∈ K → tsupport ⇑f ⊆ O p := by
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p ∈ K
    · have hmem : O p ∈ 𝓝 p := (hO p hp).1.mem_nhds (hO p hp).2
      obtain ⟨f, -, hf⟩ := (SmoothBumpFunction.nhds_basis_tsupport (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) p).mem_iff.mp hmem
      exact ⟨f, fun _ => hf⟩
    · obtain ⟨f, -, -⟩ :=
        (SmoothBumpFunction.nhds_basis_tsupport (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) p).mem_iff.mp Filter.univ_mem
      exact ⟨f, fun h => absurd h hp⟩
  choose f hf using hbump
  have hplat : ∀ x ∈ K, {y : M | f x y = 1} ∈ 𝓝 x := by
    intro x _
    have h := (f x).eventuallyEq_one
    filter_upwards [h] with y hy
    simpa using hy
  obtain ⟨t, htK, hcov⟩ := hK.elim_nhds_subcover (fun x => {y : M | f x y = 1}) hplat
  let e := t.equivFin
  refine ⟨t.card, fun i => ((e.symm i : t) : M), fun i => ⇑(f ((e.symm i : t) : M)), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact htK _ (e.symm i).2
  · intro i
    refine ⟨(f _).contMDiff, fun x => (f _).nonneg, (f _).hasCompactSupport.isCompact, ?_⟩
    exact hf _ (htK _ (e.symm i).2)
  · intro p hp
    have hp' := hcov hp
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hp'
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hpx⟩ := hp'
    have hz : ((e.symm (e ⟨x, hx⟩) : t) : M) = x := by
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    have hone : (fun i => f ((e.symm i : t) : M) p) (e ⟨x, hx⟩) = 1 := by
      show f ((e.symm (e ⟨x, hx⟩) : t) : M) p = 1
      rw [hz]
      exact hpx
    calc (1 : ℝ) = (fun i => f ((e.symm i : t) : M) p) (e ⟨x, hx⟩) := hone.symm
      _ ≤ ∑ i, (fun i => f ((e.symm i : t) : M) p) i :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => f ((e.symm i : t) : M) p)
            (fun i _ => (f _).nonneg) (Finset.mem_univ _)

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (Aset : Fin P.n → Set E2) (hAo : ∀ j, IsOpen (Aset j)) (hAW : ∀ j, Aset j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρ1 : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Aset j, ∑ i, ρ i (P.param j y) = 1)
    (Wv : Fin P.n → E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hWc : ∀ j (e : Fin 2), ContinuousOn (fun x => Wv j x e) (P.W j))
    (hWz : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Aset j → ∀ e : Fin 2, Wv j x e = 0)
    (hWt : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ∑ e : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 e) i * Wv j x e =
        Wv k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) i) :
    ∑ j, ∑ e : Fin 2, ∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
      (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) = 0

signature.name: pcgb_local_div_sum_zero
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (Aset : Fin P.n → Set E2) (hAo : ∀ j, IsOpen (Aset j)) (hAW : ∀ j, Aset j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρ1 : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Aset j, ∑ i, ρ i (P.param j y) = 1)
    (Wv : Fin P.n → E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hWc : ∀ j (e : Fin 2), ContinuousOn (fun x => Wv j x e) (P.W j))
    (hWz : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Aset j → ∀ e : Fin 2, Wv j x e = 0)
    (hWt : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, ∀ i : Fin 2,
      ∑ e : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 e) i * Wv j x e =
        Wv k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) i) :
    ∑ j, ∑ e : Fin 2, ∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
      (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hmc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j) := by
    intro j
    have hc : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => P.h j x a b) (P.W j) :=
      fun a b => (P.h_smooth j a b).continuousOn
    have hdet : ContinuousOn (fun x => (P.h j x).det) (P.W j) := by
      have : (fun x => (P.h j x).det) =
          fun x => P.h j x 0 0 * P.h j x 1 1 - P.h j x 0 1 * P.h j x 1 0 := by
        funext x
        exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
      rw [this]
      exact ((hc 0 0).mul (hc 1 1)).sub ((hc 0 1).mul (hc 1 0))
    exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn hdet
  have hcov : ∀ (j k : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ),
      (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) =
        ∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det :=
    fun j k G => (eig_chart_cov S P j k G).1
  
  have memS : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ S := by
    intro j x hx
    have h : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at h
    exact h.2
  have memO : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ P.O j := by
    intro j x hx
    have h : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq j] at h
    exact h.1
  have hH3 : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) = P.param j x := by
    intro j k x hx
    have h2 : P.param j x ∈ P.param k '' P.W k := by
      rw [P.image_eq k]; exact ⟨hx.2, memS j x hx.1⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := h2
    rw [← hyx, P.proj_param k y hy]
    exact ⟨hy, rfl⟩
  have hAopen : ∀ j k, IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := fun j k =>
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)
  
  have pd_zero : ∀ (u : E2 → ℝ) (y : E2) (V : Set E2), IsOpen V → y ∈ V →
      (∀ z ∈ V, u z = 0) → ∀ i, pd2 i u y = 0 := by
    intro u y V hV hy hu i
    have hev : u =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := Filter.eventually_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hy) hu
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have pd_cont : ∀ (u : E2 → ℝ) (V : Set E2), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u V → ∀ i,
      ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 i u x) V := by
    intro u V hV hu i
    exact (hu.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  
  have hint : ∀ j (f : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn f (P.W j) →
      (∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → f x = 0) → IntegrableOn f (P.W j) := by
    intro j f hf hf0
    have h1 : IntegrableOn f (Kc j) := (hf.mono (hK j).2).integrableOn_compact (hK j).1
    exact h1.of_forall_diff_eq_zero (P.W_open j).measurableSet (fun x hx => hf0 x hx.1 hx.2)
  
  have s5 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ∀ e,
      pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x = 0 := by
    intro j x hx hxK e
    exact pd_zero _ x (P.W j ∩ (Kc j)ᶜ) ((P.W_open j).inter (hK j).1.isClosed.isOpen_compl)
      ⟨hx, hxK⟩ (fun z hz => hρK j z hz.1 hz.2) e
  
  have s2 : ∀ j k, ∀ y ∈ P.W k, P.param k y ∉ P.O j → ∀ i,
      pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y = 0 := by
    intro j k y hy hyO i
    have hCc : IsCompact (P.param j '' Kc j) :=
      (hK j).1.image_of_continuousOn ((P.param_cont j).mono (hK j).2)
    have hCO : P.param j '' Kc j ⊆ P.O j := by
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact memO j x ((hK j).2 hx)
    refine pd_zero _ y (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' (P.param j '' Kc j)ᶜ)
      ((P.param_cont k).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open k) hCc.isClosed.isOpen_compl)
      ⟨hy, fun h => hyO (hCO h)⟩ ?_ i
    intro z hz
    by_cases hzO : P.param k z ∈ P.O j
    · have h2 : P.param k z ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
        rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hzO, memS k z hz.1⟩
      obtain ⟨x', hx', hx'z⟩ := h2
      have hx'K : x' ∉ Kc j := fun h => hz.2 ⟨x', h, hx'z⟩
      show ρ j (P.param k z) = 0
      rw [← hx'z]
      exact hρK j x' hx' hx'K
    · exact hρO j _ hzO
  
  have s3 : ∀ k, ∀ y ∈ Aset k, ∀ i, ∑ j, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y = 0 := by
    intro k y hyA i
    have hy : y ∈ P.W k := hAW k hyA
    have hd : ∀ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.n)),
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y :=
      fun j _ => ((hρs j k).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        ((P.W_open k).mem_nhds hy)
    have hsum := fderiv_fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (A := fun j y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) hd
    have h0 : fderiv ℝ (fun y' => ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k y')) y = 0 := by
      have hev : (fun y' => ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k y')) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hAo k).mem_nhds hyA) (fun z hz => hρ1 k z hz)
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    have he : ∑ j, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y =
        (∑ j, fderiv ℝ (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y) (e2 i) := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
      rfl
    rw [he, ← hsum, h0]
    simp
  
  have hexp : ∀ (L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E2), L v = ∑ i : Fin 2, v i * L (e2 i) := by
    intro L v
    have hv : v = ∑ i : Fin 2, v i • e2 i := by
      ext m
      fin_cases m <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have s1 : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
      ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x * Wv j x e =
        ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) *
          Wv k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) i := by
    intro j k x hx
    obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := hH3 j k x hx
    have hev : (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) ∘ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hAopen j k).mem_nhds hx) (fun z hz => by
        show ρ j (P.param j z) = ρ j (P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j z)))
        rw [(hH3 j k z hz).2])
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) :=
      ((hρs j k).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt ((P.W_open k).mem_nhds h1)
    have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x :=
      ((P.trans_smooth j k).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        ((hAopen j k).mem_nhds hx)
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x =
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x) := by
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      exact fderiv_comp x hφd hτd
    have hpd : ∀ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x =
        ∑ i : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 e) i *
          pd2 i (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)) := by
      intro e
      show fderiv ℝ (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x (e2 e) = _
      rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
        hexp (fderiv ℝ (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y)) (P.proj k (P.param j x)))]
      rfl
    simp only [hpd, Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [← hWt j k x hx i, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => ?_)
    ring
  
  have s4 : ∀ j (g : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn g (P.W j) → (∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → g x = 0) →
      (∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Aset j → g x = 0) →
      ∫ x in P.W j, g x = ∑ k, ∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, ρ k (P.param j x) * g x := by
    intro j g hg hg0 hgA
    have hI : ∀ k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin P.n)),
        Integrable (fun x => ρ k (P.param j x) * g x) (volume.restrict (P.W j)) := by
      intro k _
      refine hint j _ ((hρs k j).continuousOn.mul hg) ?_
      intro x hx hxK
      rw [hg0 x hx hxK, mul_zero]
    calc ∫ x in P.W j, g x = ∫ x in P.W j, ∑ k, ρ k (P.param j x) * g x := by
          refine setIntegral_congr_fun (P.W_open j).measurableSet (fun x hx => ?_)
          show g x = ∑ k, ρ k (P.param j x) * g x
          by_cases hxA : x ∈ Aset j
          · rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hρ1 j x hxA, one_mul]
          · rw [hgA x hx hxA]
            simp
      _ = ∑ k, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ k (P.param j x) * g x := integral_finset_sum _ hI
      _ = _ := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
          refine setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (P.W_open j).measurableSet
            Set.inter_subset_left ?_
          intro x hx
          have hxO : P.param j x ∉ P.O k := fun h => hx.2 ⟨hx.1, h⟩
          show ρ k (P.param j x) * g x = 0
          rw [hρO k _ hxO, zero_mul]
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : Fin P.n → Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, ∀ j k y, G j k y =
      ρ k (P.param k y) * ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y * Wv k y i :=
    ⟨fun j k y => ρ k (P.param k y) * ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y *
      Wv k y i, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hstep : ∀ j, ∑ e : Fin 2, ∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
      (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) =
      ∑ k, ∫ y in P.W k, G j k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det := by
    intro j
    have hfc : ∀ e, ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
        (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e)) (P.W j) :=
      fun e => (pd_cont _ _ (P.W_open j) (hρs j j) e).mul ((hmc j).mul (hWc j e))
    have hf0 : ∀ e, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
        (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) = 0 := by
      intro e x hx hxK
      rw [s5 j x hx hxK e, zero_mul]
    have hfA : ∀ e, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Aset j → pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
        (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) = 0 := by
      intro e x hx hxA
      rw [hWz j x hx hxA e, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun e _ => hint j _ (hfc e) (hf0 e))]
    rw [s4 j _ (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun e _ => hfc e))
      (fun x hx hxK => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun e _ => hf0 e x hx hxK))
      (fun x hx hxA => Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun e _ => hfA e x hx hxA))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
    have hpt : ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
        ρ k (P.param j x) * ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
          (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) =
        G j k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
      intro x hx
      have h3 := s1 j k x hx
      have h2 := (hH3 j k x hx).2
      rw [hG, h2]
      have hsplit : ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
          (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) =
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x * Wv j x e := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => by ring)
      rw [hsplit, h3]
      ring
    rw [setIntegral_congr_fun (hAopen j k).measurableSet hpt, hcov j k (G j k)]
    refine (setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (P.W_open k).measurableSet
      Set.inter_subset_left ?_).symm
    intro y hy
    have hyO : P.param k y ∉ P.O j := fun h => hy.2 ⟨hy.1, h⟩
    show G j k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det = 0
    rw [hG, Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => by rw [s2 j k y hy.1 hyO i, zero_mul]), mul_zero,
      zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hstep j), Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun k _ => ?_)
  have hGc : ∀ j, IntegrableOn (fun y => G j k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k) := by
    intro j
    have hfun : (fun y => G j k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) = fun y =>
        ρ k (P.param k y) * (∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y * Wv k y i) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det := by
      funext y
      rw [hG]
    rw [hfun]
    refine hint k _ (((hρs k k).continuousOn.mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun i _ =>
      (pd_cont _ _ (P.W_open k) (hρs j k) i).mul (hWc k i)))).mul (hmc k)) ?_
    intro y hy hyK
    rw [hρK k y hy hyK, zero_mul, zero_mul]
  rw [← integral_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => hGc j)]
  refine setIntegral_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero (fun y hy => ?_)
  show ∑ j, G j k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det = 0
  simp only [hG]
  calc ∑ j, ρ k (P.param k y) * (∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y * Wv k y i) *
        Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det
      = ∑ i : Fin 2, (ρ k (P.param k y) * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det * Wv k y i) *
          ∑ j, pd2 i (fun y' => ρ j (P.param k y')) y := by
        simp only [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun _ _ => by ring))
    _ = 0 := by
        by_cases hyA : y ∈ Aset k
        · simp only [s3 k y hyA, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
        · simp only [hWz k y hy hyA, mul_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_chart_cov
subgoal_signatures.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (j k : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ) : (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) = (∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) ∧ (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j) MeasureTheory.volume)

informal_problem.statement:
(A B : Set E2) (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (τ : E2 → E2)
    (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ A) (hτAB : ∀ x ∈ A, τ x ∈ B)
    (h h' : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ c d : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y c d) A)
    (hh' : ∀ c d : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h' y c d) B)
    (hpd' : ∀ y ∈ B, (h' y).PosDef) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ A, (h x).PosDef)
    (hcomp : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ c d : Fin 2, h x c d = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' * h' (τ x) c' d' * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 d) d')
    (g : E2 → ℝ) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g B) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ A, f x = g (τ x))
    (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ A) :
    lap2 h f x = lap2 h' g (τ x)

signature.name: lap2_chart_invariant
signature.statement:
(A B : Set E2) (hA : IsOpen A) (hB : IsOpen B) (τ : E2 → E2)
    (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ A) (hτAB : ∀ x ∈ A, τ x ∈ B)
    (h h' : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ c d : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y c d) A)
    (hh' : ∀ c d : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h' y c d) B)
    (hpd' : ∀ y ∈ B, (h' y).PosDef) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ A, (h x).PosDef)
    (hcomp : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ c d : Fin 2, h x c d = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' * h' (τ x) c' d' * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 d) d')
    (g : E2 → ℝ) (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g B) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x ∈ A, f x = g (τ x))
    (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ A) :
    lap2 h f x = lap2 h' g (τ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  
  have ctrans : ∀ m b c : Fin 2,
      ∑ e : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 e) m * christoffel2 h e b c x =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2,
            christoffel2 h' m p q (τ x) * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) p * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) q +
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c)) x (e2 b) m := by
    intro m b c
    have alg : ∀ (J : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (g hm : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
        (D T dH : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
        (∀ p q : Fin 2, g p q = g q p) →
        (∀ m b c : Fin 2, T m b c = T m c b) →
        (∀ c d : Fin 2, hm c d = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2, J c' c * g c' d' * J d' d) →
        hm.det ≠ 0 →
        (∀ i c d : Fin 2, dH i c d = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
          (T c' i c * g c' d' * J d' d + J c' c * (∑ r : Fin 2, D r c' d' * J r i) * J d' d +
            J c' c * g c' d' * T d' i d)) →
        ∀ m b c : Fin 2,
        ∑ e : Fin 2, J m e * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ e l * (dH b c l + dH c b l - dH l b c)) =
          ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2,
              ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, g⁻¹ m l * (D p q l + D q p l - D l p q)) * J p b * J q c +
            T m b c := by
      intro J g hm D T dH hg hT hhm hdet hdH m b c
      have hA : ∀ l : Fin 2, dH b c l + dH c b l - dH l b c = ∑ q : Fin 2, J q l *
          (2 * ∑ p : Fin 2, g q p * T p b c +
            ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ r : Fin 2, (D p r q + D r p q - D q p r) * J p b * J r c) := by
        intro l
        have hT1 : ∀ x, T x c b = T x b c := fun x => hT x c b
        have hT2 : ∀ x, T x l b = T x b l := fun x => hT x l b
        have hT3 : ∀ x, T x l c = T x c l := fun x => hT x l c
        have hg10 : g 1 0 = g 0 1 := hg 1 0
        simp only [hdH, Fin.sum_univ_two, hT1, hT2, hT3, hg10]
        ring
      set Jm : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := Matrix.of J with hJm
      have hhm' : hm = Jm.transpose * g * Jm := by
        ext i j
        rw [hhm i j]
        simp only [hJm, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        ring
      have hdet' : hm.det = Jm.det * g.det * Jm.det := by
        rw [hhm', Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
      have hJdet : Jm.det ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0; apply hdet; rw [hdet', h0]; ring
      have hgdet : g.det ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0; apply hdet; rw [hdet', h0]; ring
      have hJu : IsUnit Jm.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hJdet
      have hJtu : IsUnit Jm.transpose.det := by rw [Matrix.det_transpose]; exact hJu
      have hgu : IsUnit g.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hgdet
      have hraiseM : Jm * hm⁻¹ * Jm.transpose = g⁻¹ := by
        rw [hhm', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
        calc Jm * (Jm⁻¹ * (g⁻¹ * Jm.transpose⁻¹)) * Jm.transpose
            = (Jm * Jm⁻¹) * g⁻¹ * (Jm.transpose⁻¹ * Jm.transpose) := by
              simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
          _ = g⁻¹ := by
            rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hJu, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hJtu, Matrix.one_mul,
              Matrix.mul_one]
      have hB : ∀ q : Fin 2, ∑ e : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, J m e * hm⁻¹ e l * J q l = g⁻¹ m q := by
        intro q
        have := congrFun (congrFun hraiseM m) q
        rw [← this]
        simp only [hJm, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
        ring
      have hC : ∑ p : Fin 2, (∑ q : Fin 2, g⁻¹ m q * g q p) * T p b c = T m b c := by
        have h1 : ∀ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, g⁻¹ m q * g q p =
            (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) m p := by
          intro p
          rw [← Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul g hgu, Matrix.mul_apply]
        simp only [h1, Matrix.one_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
          Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
      have key : ∀ U : Fin 2 → ℝ, (∀ l : Fin 2, dH b c l + dH c b l - dH l b c =
          ∑ q : Fin 2, J q l * U q) → ∑ e : Fin 2, J m e * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, hm⁻¹ e l *
          (dH b c l + dH c b l - dH l b c)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ q : Fin 2, g⁻¹ m q * U q := by
        intro U hU
        simp only [hU]
        have hB0 := hB 0
        have hB1 := hB 1
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hB0 hB1 ⊢
        linear_combination (1 / 2 * U 0) * hB0 + (1 / 2 * U 1) * hB1
      rw [key (fun q => 2 * ∑ p : Fin 2, g q p * T p b c +
            ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ r : Fin 2, (D p r q + D r p q - D q p r) * J p b * J r c) hA, ← hC]
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    have schwarz : ∀ m b c : Fin 2,
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c)) x (e2 b) m =
          fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 b)) x (e2 c) m := by
      intro m b c
      have hτx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ τ x := hτ.contDiffAt (hA.mem_nhds hx)
      have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) x :=
        (hτx.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hrw : ∀ u : E2, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y u) x =
          (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) x).flip u := by
        intro u
        rw [fderiv_clm_apply hD (differentiableAt_const u)]
        simp
      have hsym := hτx.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
        rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
      rw [hrw, hrw]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
      rw [hsym.eq]
    have pull : ∀ i c d : Fin 2,
        pd2 i (fun y => h y c d) x = ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c)) x (e2 i) c' * h' (τ x) c' d' *
              fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 d) d' +
            fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' *
              (∑ r : Fin 2, pd2 r (fun y => h' y c' d') (τ x) * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i) r) *
              fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 d) d' +
            fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' * h' (τ x) c' d' *
              fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 d)) x (e2 i) d') := by
      intro i c d
      have hτx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ τ x := hτ.contDiffAt (hA.mem_nhds hx)
      have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ x := hτx.differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) x :=
        (hτx.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have ha : ∀ (u : E2) (k : Fin 2), HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y u k)
          ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y u) x)) x := by
        intro u k
        have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y u) x :=
          hD.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const u)
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp x h1.hasFDerivAt
      have hb : ∀ p q : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun y => h' (τ y) p q)
          ((fderiv ℝ (fun z => h' z p q) (τ x)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ x)) x := by
        intro p q
        have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h' z p q) (τ x) :=
          ((hh' p q).contDiffAt (hB.mem_nhds (hτAB x hx))).differentiableAt (by simp)
        exact h1.hasFDerivAt.comp x hτd.hasFDerivAt
      have hΦ : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
          fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c) c' * h' (τ y) c' d' * fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 d) d')
          (∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
            ((fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' * h' (τ x) c' d') •
                (EuclideanSpace.proj d' : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
                  (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 d)) x) +
              fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 d) d' •
                (fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) c' •
                    (fderiv ℝ (fun z => h' z c' d') (τ x)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ x) +
                  h' (τ x) c' d' •
                    (EuclideanSpace.proj c' : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
                      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c)) x)))) x := by
        apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
        intro c' _
        apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
        intro d' _
        exact ((ha (e2 c) c').mul (hb c' d')).mul (ha (e2 d) d')
      have hev : (fun y => h y c d) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => ∑ c' : Fin 2, ∑ d' : Fin 2,
          fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c) c' * h' (τ y) c' d' * fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 d) d') :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hA.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hcomp y hy c d)
      have hexp : ∀ v : E2, v = v 0 • e2 0 + v 1 • e2 1 := by
        intro v
        ext k
        fin_cases k <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
      have hp : ∀ (k : Fin 2) (v : E2), (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) v = v k :=
        fun _ _ => rfl
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hΦ.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      have hv := hexp (fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i))
      have hlin : ∀ p q : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun z => h' z p q) (τ x) (fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i)) =
          ∑ r : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun z => h' z p q) (τ x) (e2 r) * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i) r := by
        intro p q
        conv_lhs => rw [hv]
        rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, Fin.sum_univ_two, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      simp only [hlin]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun d' _ => ?_))
      simp only [hp]
      ring
    have hg : ∀ p q : Fin 2, h' (τ x) p q = h' (τ x) q p := by
      intro p q
      have h1 := (hpd' (τ x) (hτAB x hx)).isHermitian.apply p q
      simp only [star_trivial] at h1
      exact h1.symm
    have key := alg (fun p b => fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) p) (h' (τ x)) (h x)
      (fun r p q => pd2 r (fun y => h' y p q) (τ x))
      (fun m b c => fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 c)) x (e2 b) m)
      (fun i c d => pd2 i (fun y => h y c d) x)
      hg schwarz (hcomp x hx) (hpd x hx).det_pos.ne' pull m b c
    unfold christoffel2
    exact key
  
  have hinv : ∀ p q : Fin 2, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
      (h x)⁻¹ i j * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i) p * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 j) q = (h' (τ x))⁻¹ p q := by
    set Jm : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := Matrix.of (fun a b => fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 b) a) with hJm
    have hhm' : h x = Jm.transpose * h' (τ x) * Jm := by
      ext i j
      rw [hcomp x hx i j]
      simp only [hJm, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    have hdet : (h x).det ≠ 0 := (hpd x hx).det_pos.ne'
    have hdet' : (h x).det = Jm.det * (h' (τ x)).det * Jm.det := by
      rw [hhm', Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
    have hJdet : Jm.det ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0; apply hdet; rw [hdet', h0]; ring
    have hJu : IsUnit Jm.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hJdet
    have hJtu : IsUnit Jm.transpose.det := by rw [Matrix.det_transpose]; exact hJu
    have hraiseM : Jm * (h x)⁻¹ * Jm.transpose = (h' (τ x))⁻¹ := by
      rw [hhm', Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev]
      calc Jm * (Jm⁻¹ * ((h' (τ x))⁻¹ * Jm.transpose⁻¹)) * Jm.transpose
          = (Jm * Jm⁻¹) * (h' (τ x))⁻¹ * (Jm.transpose⁻¹ * Jm.transpose) := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = (h' (τ x))⁻¹ := by
          rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hJu, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hJtu, Matrix.one_mul,
            Matrix.mul_one]
    intro p q
    have := congrFun (congrFun hraiseM p) q
    rw [← this]
    simp only [hJm, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have hexp : ∀ v : E2, v = v 0 • e2 0 + v 1 • e2 1 := by
    intro v
    ext k
    fin_cases k <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hlinexp : ∀ (ℓ : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E2), ℓ v = ∑ m : Fin 2, v m * ℓ (e2 m) := by
    intro ℓ v
    conv_lhs => rw [hexp v]
    rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, Fin.sum_univ_two, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hfirst : ∀ y ∈ A, ∀ k : Fin 2,
      pd2 k f y = ∑ m : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 k) m * pd2 m g (τ y) := by
    intro y hy k
    have hτy : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ y :=
      (hτ.contDiffAt (hA.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hgy : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (τ y) :=
      (hg.contDiffAt (hB.mem_nhds (hτAB y hy))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hev : f =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun z => g (τ z)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hA.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hf z hz)
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    rw [show (fun z => g (τ z)) = g ∘ τ from rfl, fderiv_comp y hgy hτy,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hlinexp]
  have hsecond : ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j f) x =
      ∑ m : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 j)) x (e2 i) m * pd2 m g (τ x) +
      ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2,
        fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i) p * fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 j) q * pd2 p (pd2 q g) (τ x) := by
    intro i j
    have hev : pd2 j f =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
        (fun y => ∑ m : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 j) m * pd2 m g (τ y)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hA.mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hfirst y hy j)
    have hτx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ τ x := hτ.contDiffAt (hA.mem_nhds hx)
    have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ τ x := hτx.differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) x :=
      (hτx.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hgx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (τ x) := hg.contDiffAt (hB.mem_nhds (hτAB x hx))
    have hDg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (τ x) :=
      (hgx.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have ha : ∀ k : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 j) k)
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 j)) x)) x := by
      intro k
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 j)) x :=
        hD.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp x h1.hasFDerivAt
    have hb : ∀ m : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun y => pd2 m g (τ y))
        ((fderiv ℝ (pd2 m g) (τ x)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ x)) x := by
      intro m
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 m g) (τ x) :=
        hDg.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e2 m))
      exact h1.hasFDerivAt.comp x hτd.hasFDerivAt
    have hΦ : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ m : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 j) m * pd2 m g (τ y))
        (∑ m : Fin 2, (fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 j) m • (fderiv ℝ (pd2 m g) (τ x)).comp (fderiv ℝ τ x) +
          pd2 m g (τ x) • (EuclideanSpace.proj m : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 j)) x))) x := by
      apply HasFDerivAt.fun_sum
      intro m _
      exact (ha m).mul (hb m)
    have hp : ∀ (k : Fin 2) (v : E2), (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) v = v k :=
      fun _ _ => rfl
    have hd2 : ∀ p q : Fin 2, pd2 p (pd2 q g) (τ x) = fderiv ℝ (pd2 q g) (τ x) (e2 p) :=
      fun _ _ => rfl
    have hlin : ∀ m : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (pd2 m g) (τ x) (fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i)) =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 i) p * fderiv ℝ (pd2 m g) (τ x) (e2 p) :=
      fun m => hlinexp _ _
    simp only [hd2]
    show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j f) x (e2 i) = _
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, hΦ.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, smul_eq_mul, hp]
    simp only [hlin]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have alg2 : ∀ (Hi Hpi J : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (Γ Γ' T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
      (d1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) (d2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ m i j : Fin 2, ∑ e : Fin 2, J m e * Γ e i j =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, Γ' m p q * J p i * J q j + T m i j) →
      (∀ p q : Fin 2, ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, Hi i j * J p i * J q j = Hpi p q) →
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, Hi i j *
          ((∑ m : Fin 2, T m i j * d1 m + ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, J p i * J q j * d2 p q) -
            ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ k i j * ∑ m : Fin 2, J m k * d1 m) =
        ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, Hpi p q * (d2 p q - ∑ k : Fin 2, Γ' k p q * d1 k) := by
    intro Hi Hpi J Γ Γ' T d1 d2 hΓ hI
    have e000 := hΓ 0 0 0
    have e001 := hΓ 0 0 1
    have e010 := hΓ 0 1 0
    have e011 := hΓ 0 1 1
    have e100 := hΓ 1 0 0
    have e101 := hΓ 1 0 1
    have e110 := hΓ 1 1 0
    have e111 := hΓ 1 1 1
    have f00 := hI 0 0
    have f01 := hI 0 1
    have f10 := hI 1 0
    have f11 := hI 1 1
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at e000 e001 e010 e011 e100 e101 e110 e111 f00 f01 f10 f11 ⊢
    linear_combination
      (-(Hi 0 0 * d1 0)) * e000 + (-(Hi 0 1 * d1 0)) * e001 +
      (-(Hi 1 0 * d1 0)) * e010 + (-(Hi 1 1 * d1 0)) * e011 +
      (-(Hi 0 0 * d1 1)) * e100 + (-(Hi 0 1 * d1 1)) * e101 +
      (-(Hi 1 0 * d1 1)) * e110 + (-(Hi 1 1 * d1 1)) * e111 +
      (d2 0 0 - Γ' 0 0 0 * d1 0 - Γ' 1 0 0 * d1 1) * f00 +
      (d2 0 1 - Γ' 0 0 1 * d1 0 - Γ' 1 0 1 * d1 1) * f01 +
      (d2 1 0 - Γ' 0 1 0 * d1 0 - Γ' 1 1 0 * d1 1) * f10 +
      (d2 1 1 - Γ' 0 1 1 * d1 0 - Γ' 1 1 1 * d1 1) * f11
  
  unfold lap2
  simp only [hfirst x hx, hsecond]
  exact alg2 (fun i j => (h x)⁻¹ i j) (fun p q => (h' (τ x))⁻¹ p q)
    (fun m c => fderiv ℝ τ x (e2 c) m) (fun k i j => christoffel2 h k i j x)
    (fun k p q => christoffel2 h' k p q (τ x))
    (fun m i j => fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ τ y (e2 j)) x (e2 i) m)
    (fun m => pd2 m g (τ x)) (fun p q => pd2 p (pd2 q g) (τ x)) ctrans hinv

signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hx₀W : x₀ ∈ W := hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le)
  have hA : (h x₀).PosDef := hpd x₀ hx₀W
  obtain ⟨hsymm, hD, ha, hT, hz⟩ := pcgb_pf_quad_facts (h x₀) hA
  obtain ⟨hηc, _hηd, hη0, hη1, M₁, hM₁0, hM₁⟩ := pcgb_pf_eta_deriv
  obtain ⟨K₁, K₂, hK₁, hK₂, hKb⟩ := pcgb_pf_metric_bounds W hW h hh hpd x₀ r hr hball
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : E2 → ℝ,
      Q = fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hQe : ∀ y, Q y = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c :=
    fun y => by rw [hQ]
  have hQc : Continuous Q := by rw [hQ]; fun_prop
  have hρc : Continuous (fun y => Real.sqrt (Q y)) := hQc.sqrt
  have hQnn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ Q y := fun y => by rw [hQe]; exact (hz (y - x₀)).1
  have hQx₀ : Q x₀ = 0 := by rw [hQe]; simp
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ κ : ℝ, κ = Real.sqrt ((h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) / (h x₀).det) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκpos : 0 < κ := by rw [hκ]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (div_pos hT hD)
  have hκsq : κ ^ 2 = (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) / (h x₀).det := by
    rw [hκ]; exact Real.sq_sqrt (div_pos hT hD).le
  have hκdet : κ ^ 2 * (h x₀).det = h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1 := by
    rw [hκsq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hD.ne']
  have h3κ : (0 : ℝ) < 3 * κ := mul_pos (by norm_num) hκpos
  have hδ₁ : 0 < r / (3 * κ) := div_pos hr h3κ
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : ℝ → Set E2,
      N = fun δ => {y | δ ≤ Real.sqrt (Q y) ∧ Real.sqrt (Q y) ≤ 2 * δ} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hNmem : ∀ δ y, y ∈ N δ ↔ δ ≤ Real.sqrt (Q y) ∧ Real.sqrt (Q y) ≤ 2 * δ := by
    intro δ y; rw [hN]; exact Iff.rfl
  have hgeo : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r / (3 * κ) → ∀ y ∈ N δ,
      0 < Q y ∧ y ≠ x₀ ∧ ‖y - x₀‖ ≤ 2 * κ * δ ∧ ‖y - x₀‖ < 3 * κ * δ ∧ 3 * κ * δ < r := by
    intro δ hδ hδ₁' y hy
    rw [hNmem] at hy
    obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
    have hρpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (Q y) := lt_of_lt_of_le hδ hy1
    have hQpos : 0 < Q y := Real.sqrt_pos.mp hρpos
    have hne : y ≠ x₀ := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [hQx₀] at hQpos
      exact lt_irrefl _ hQpos
    have hQle : Q y ≤ 4 * δ ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : Q y = Real.sqrt (Q y) ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt (hQnn y)).symm
      rw [h1]
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (Q y)]
    have hDz : (h x₀).det * ‖y - x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) * Q y := by
      rw [hQe]; exact (hz (y - x₀)).2.2.2.1
    have hnorm_sq : ‖y - x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ (2 * κ * δ) ^ 2 := by
      have e1 : (2 * κ * δ) ^ 2 * (h x₀).det = 4 * (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) * δ ^ 2 := by
        calc (2 * κ * δ) ^ 2 * (h x₀).det = 4 * δ ^ 2 * (κ ^ 2 * (h x₀).det) := by ring
          _ = 4 * (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) * δ ^ 2 := by rw [hκdet]; ring
      have e2 : ‖y - x₀‖ ^ 2 * (h x₀).det ≤ (2 * κ * δ) ^ 2 * (h x₀).det := by
        rw [e1]
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hQle hT.le
        linarith
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right e2 hD
    have hnorm : ‖y - x₀‖ ≤ 2 * κ * δ :=
      (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity) two_ne_zero).mp hnorm_sq
    have h3 : 3 * κ * δ < r := by
      have := (lt_div_iff₀ h3κ).mp hδ₁'
      linarith
    have hκδ : 0 < κ * δ := mul_pos hκpos hδ
    exact ⟨hQpos, hne, hnorm, by linarith, h3⟩
  have hsubN : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r / (3 * κ) → N δ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀} := by
    intro δ hδ hδ₁' y hy
    obtain ⟨_, hne, _, hlt, h3⟩ := hgeo δ hδ hδ₁' y hy
    refine ⟨?_, hne⟩
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    linarith
  have hηout : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ y, y ∉ N δ →
      deriv Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y) - δ) / δ) = 0 := by
    intro δ hδ y hy
    rw [hNmem] at hy
    by_cases h1 : δ ≤ Real.sqrt (Q y)
    · have h2 : 2 * δ < Real.sqrt (Q y) := by
        by_contra h3
        exact hy ⟨h1, not_lt.mp h3⟩
      apply hη1
      rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]
      linarith
    · apply hη0
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hδ]
      linarith [not_le.mp h1]
  have hs3 : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      (∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y ∧
        ∀ a : Fin 2,
          pd2 a (fun y' => Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y') - δ) / δ)) y =
            δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y) - δ) / δ) *
              (∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) c) / Real.sqrt (Q y) ∧
          pd2 a (fun y' => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y =
            (∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) c) / Q y) ∧
      ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y' => Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y') - δ) / δ)) x₀ = 0 := by
    intro δ hδ
    subst hQ
    exact pcgb_pf_cutoff_derivs (h x₀) hsymm (fun z hz0 => (hz z).2.1 hz0) x₀ δ hδ
  have hχz : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ y, y ∉ N δ → ∀ a : Fin 2,
      pd2 a (fun y' => Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y') - δ) / δ)) y = 0 := by
    intro δ hδ y hy a
    by_cases hyx : y = x₀
    · rw [hyx]; exact (hs3 δ hδ).2 a
    · rw [(((hs3 δ hδ).1 y hyx).2 a).1, hηout δ hδ y hy]
      simp
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ : ∃ F : ℝ → E2 → ℝ, F = fun δ x => (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c *
      pd2 a (fun y => Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y) - δ) / δ)) x * pd2 c L x) *
      Real.sqrt (h x).det := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ : ∃ J : ℝ → E2 → ℝ, J = fun δ y => -(Real.sqrt (h x₀).det *
      (δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y) - δ) / δ)) / Real.sqrt (Q y)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hK : 0 ≤ 4 * M₁ * Real.sqrt (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) * K₁ * max C 0 +
      8 * K₂ * κ * M₁ * (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) := by
    have h1 : 0 ≤ 4 * M₁ * Real.sqrt (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) * K₁ * max C 0 :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hM₁0)
        (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) hK₁) (le_max_right C 0)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ 8 * K₂ * κ * M₁ * (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hK₂) hκpos.le) hM₁0) hT.le
    linarith
  have hV : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 9 * κ ^ 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have hNprop : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r / (3 * κ) → IsCompact (N δ) ∧ N δ ⊆ W ∧
      MeasureTheory.volume (N δ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (9 * κ ^ 2 * Real.pi * δ ^ 2) := by
    intro δ hδ hδ₁'
    have hclosed : IsClosed (N δ) := by
      have : N δ = {y | δ ≤ Real.sqrt (Q y)} ∩ {y | Real.sqrt (Q y) ≤ 2 * δ} := by
        ext y; rw [hNmem]; exact Iff.rfl
      rw [this]
      exact (isClosed_le continuous_const hρc).inter (isClosed_le hρc continuous_const)
    refine ⟨(isCompact_closedBall x₀ r).of_isClosed_subset hclosed
        (fun y hy => Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hsubN δ hδ hδ₁' hy).1),
      fun y hy => hball (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hsubN δ hδ hδ₁' hy).1), ?_⟩
    calc MeasureTheory.volume (N δ) ≤ MeasureTheory.volume (Metric.ball x₀ (3 * κ * δ)) :=
          MeasureTheory.measure_mono (fun y hy => by
            rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]; exact (hgeo δ hδ hδ₁' y hy).2.2.2.1)
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (3 * κ * δ) ^ 2 * ENNReal.ofReal Real.pi :=
          EuclideanSpace.volume_ball_fin_two _ _
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (9 * κ ^ 2 * Real.pi * δ ^ 2) := by
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (p := 3 * κ * δ) (by positivity) 2,
            ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (p := (3 * κ * δ) ^ 2) (by positivity)]
          congr 1; ring
  have hFz : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r / (3 * κ) → ∀ y ∈ W, y ∉ N δ → F δ y = 0 := by
    intro δ hδ _ y _ hy
    subst hF
    beta_reduce
    simp only [hχz δ hδ y hy, mul_zero, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have hJz : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r / (3 * κ) → ∀ y : E2, y ∉ N δ → J δ y = 0 := by
    intro δ hδ _ y hy
    subst hJ
    beta_reduce
    rw [hηout δ hδ y hy]
    simp
  have hFc : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r / (3 * κ) → ContinuousOn (F δ) (N δ) := by
    intro δ hδ hδ₁'
    have hsub := hsubN δ hδ hδ₁'
    subst hF hQ
    exact (pcgb_pf_integrand_cont W hW h hh hpd x₀ r hr hball L hL δ hδ).mono hsub
  have hJc : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r / (3 * κ) → ContinuousOn (J δ) (N δ) := by
    intro δ hδ _
    subst hJ
    show ContinuousOn (fun y => -(Real.sqrt (h x₀).det *
      (δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y) - δ) / δ)) / Real.sqrt (Q y))) (N δ)
    refine ContinuousOn.neg (ContinuousOn.div ?_ hρc.continuousOn ?_)
    · exact (continuous_const.mul (continuous_const.mul
        (hηc.comp ((hρc.sub continuous_const).div_const δ)))).continuousOn
    · intro y hy
      exact ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le hδ ((hNmem δ y).mp hy).1)
  have hJi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r / (3 * κ) → ∫ y, J δ y = -(2 * Real.pi) := by
    intro δ hδ _
    subst hJ hQ
    exact pcgb_pf_frozen_integral (h x₀) (hsymm 0 1) ha hD x₀ δ hδ hηc hη0 hη1
  have hFJ : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < r / (3 * κ) → ∀ y ∈ N δ, |F δ y - J δ y| ≤
      (4 * M₁ * Real.sqrt (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) * K₁ * max C 0 +
        8 * K₂ * κ * M₁ * (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1)) / δ := by
    intro δ hδ hδ₁' y hy
    obtain ⟨hQpos, hne, hnorm, _, _⟩ := hgeo δ hδ hδ₁' y hy
    have hyball : y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r := (hsubN δ hδ hδ₁' hy).1
    have hyU : Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀} ∈ 𝓝 y :=
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.sdiff isClosed_singleton).mem_nhds ⟨hyball, hne⟩
    have hLd : DifferentiableAt ℝ L y := (hL.contDiffAt hyU).differentiableAt (by simp)
    obtain ⟨hlogd, hform⟩ := (hs3 δ hδ).1 y hne
    have hpφ : ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y' => L y' + Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y =
        pd2 c L y + (∑ k : Fin 2, h x₀ c k * (y - x₀) k) / Q y := by
      intro c
      have e1 : pd2 c (fun y' => L y' + Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y =
          pd2 c L y + pd2 c (fun y' => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y := by
        simp only [pd2]
        rw [fderiv_fun_add hLd hlogd, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
      rw [e1, (hform c).2]
    have hgradQ : ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y' => L y' + Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y‖ ≤ C := by
      have hg := hgrad y hyball hne
      subst hQ
      exact hg
    have hp : ∀ c : Fin 2,
        |pd2 c (fun y' => L y' + Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y| ≤ max C 0 := by
      intro c
      have h1 : |pd2 c (fun y' => L y' + Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y| ≤
          ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y' => L y' + Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y‖ := by
        simp only [pd2]
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
        calc _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y' => L y' + Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y‖ * ‖e2 c‖ :=
              ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
          _ = _ := by simp
      linarith [le_max_left C 0]
    have hℓ : ∀ c : Fin 2, pd2 c L y =
        pd2 c (fun y' => L y' + Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y -
          (∑ k : Fin 2, h x₀ c k * (y - x₀) k) / Q y := by
      intro c; rw [hpφ c]; ring
    have hv : ∑ a : Fin 2, (∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) c) ^ 2 ≤
        (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) * Q y := by
      rw [hQe]; exact (hz (y - x₀)).2.2.1
    have hinv : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x₀)⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 2, h x₀ a k * (y - x₀) k) *
        (∑ k : Fin 2, h x₀ c k * (y - x₀) k) = Q y := by
      rw [hQe]; exact (hz (y - x₀)).2.2.2.2
    have hyc : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r := Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hyball
    have hfinal := pcgb_pf_pointwise_algebra (fun a c => (h y)⁻¹ a c) (fun a c => (h x₀)⁻¹ a c)
      (fun a => pd2 a (fun y' => Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y') - δ) / δ)) y)
      (fun c => pd2 c L y)
      (fun c => pd2 c (fun y' => L y' + Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y)
      (fun a => ∑ k : Fin 2, h x₀ a k * (y - x₀) k)
      (Real.sqrt (h y).det) (Real.sqrt (h x₀).det) (Q y) (Real.sqrt (Q y)) δ
      (deriv Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y) - δ) / δ)) M₁ (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1)
      K₁ K₂ κ (max C 0)
      hδ hQpos rfl ((hNmem δ y).mp hy).1 (hM₁ _) hT.le hv hκpos.le hK₂
      (fun a => (hform a).1) hℓ hp
      (fun a c => (hKb y hyc a c).1)
      (fun a c => le_trans (hKb y hyc a c).2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm hK₂))
      hinv
    subst hF hJ
    exact hfinal
  have key := pcgb_pf_abstract_limit W hW F J N (r / (3 * κ))
    (4 * M₁ * Real.sqrt (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1) * K₁ * max C 0 +
      8 * K₂ * κ * M₁ * (h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1))
    (9 * κ ^ 2 * Real.pi) (-(2 * Real.pi)) hδ₁ hK hV hNprop hFz hJz hFc hJc hJi hFJ
  subst hF hQ
  exact key

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_pf_eta_deriv
subgoal_signatures.statement:
Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition t) t) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0) ∧
    ∃ M₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ M₁ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |deriv Real.smoothTransition t| ≤ M₁

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_pf_quad_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (∀ a c : Fin 2, A a c = A c a) ∧ 0 < A.det ∧ 0 < A 0 0 ∧ 0 < A 0 0 + A 1 1 ∧
    ∀ z : E2,
      0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c ∧
      (z ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c) ∧
      ∑ a : Fin 2, (∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z c) ^ 2 ≤
        (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c ∧
      A.det * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c ∧
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 2, A a k * z k) * (∑ k : Fin 2, A c k * z k) =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_pf_frozen_integral
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsymm : A 0 1 = A 1 0)
    (ha : 0 < A 0 0) (hD : 0 < A.det) (x₀ : E2) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hηc : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition))
    (hη0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0)
    (hη1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0) :
    ∫ y : E2, -(Real.sqrt A.det * (δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition
        ((Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c) - δ) / δ)) /
        Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)) = -(2 * Real.pi)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_pf_cutoff_derivs
subgoal_signatures.statement:

      have hq : P.param j x ∈ P.O j₀ ∩ S := ⟨hx.2, hparamS j x hx.1⟩
      rw [← P.image_eq j₀] at hq
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzq⟩ := hq
      rw [← hzq, P.proj_param j₀ z hz]
      exact ⟨hz, rfl⟩
    have hinj0 : ∀ y ∈ P.W j₀, P.param j₀ y = p₀ → y = x₀ := by
      intro y hy h
      calc y = P.proj j₀ (P.param j₀ y) := (P.proj_param j₀ y hy).symm
        _ = P.proj j₀ (P.param j₀ x₀) := by rw [h, hp₀]
        _ = x₀ := P.proj_param j₀ x₀ hx₀W
    have hp₀O : p₀ ∈ P.O j₀ := by
      have h := Set.mem_image_of_mem (P.param j₀) hx₀W
      rw [P.image_eq j₀, hp₀] at h
      exact h.1
    have hproj₀ : P.proj j₀ p₀ = x₀ := by rw [← hp₀]; exact P.proj_param j₀ x₀ hx₀W
    have hD0o : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) :=
      (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open j₀)
    have hτc : ContinuousOn (fun x' => P.proj j₀ (P.param j x')) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) :=
      (P.trans_smooth j j₀).continuousOn
    have hBo : IsOpen (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}) := Metric.isOpen_ball.sdiff isClosed_singleton
    have hVo : IsOpen ((P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) ∩
        (fun x' => P.proj j₀ (P.param j x')) ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r) :=
      hτc.isOpen_inter_preimage hD0o Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hAo : IsOpen ((P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) ∩
        (fun x' => P.proj j₀ (P.param j x')) ⁻¹' (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀})) :=
      hτc.isOpen_inter_preimage hD0o hBo
    have hBsub : Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀} ⊆ P.W j₀ := fun y hy =>
      hball (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy.1)
    have hgood0 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}, P.param j₀ y ∈ U \ {p₀} := by
      intro y hy
      have hyW := hBsub hy
      have hb2 := hbpos y (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hy.1)
      refine ⟨hRU ⟨hparamS j₀ y hyW, by linarith⟩, ?_⟩
      intro h
      exact hy.2 (hinj0 y hyW h)
    have hlapeq : ∀ x ∈ (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) ∩
        (fun x' => P.proj j₀ (P.param j x')) ⁻¹' (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}),
        lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x =
          lap2 (P.h j₀) (L j₀) ((fun x' => P.proj j₀ (P.param j x')) x) := by
      refine hlap _ _ hAo hBo (fun x' => P.proj j₀ (P.param j x'))
        ((P.trans_smooth j j₀).mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun x hx => hx.2) (P.h j) (P.h j₀)
        (fun c d => (P.h_smooth j c d).mono (fun x hx => hx.1.1))
        (fun c d => (P.h_smooth j₀ c d).mono hBsub)
        (fun y hy => P.h_posDef j₀ y (hBsub hy))
        (fun x hx => P.h_posDef j x hx.1.1)
        (fun x hx c d => P.h_compat j j₀ x hx.1 c d)
        (L j₀) ((hLs j₀).mono (fun y hy => ⟨hBsub hy, hgood0 y hy⟩))
        (L j) ?_
      intro x hx
      have hgx : P.param j x ∈ U \ {p₀} := by
        rw [← (hlift x hx.1).2]
        exact hgood0 _ hx.2
      exact hLc j j₀ x ⟨hx.1.1, hx.1.2, hgx⟩
    have hZV : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x = p₀ → x ∈ (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) ∩
        (fun x' => P.proj j₀ (P.param j x')) ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r := by
      intro x hx h
      refine ⟨⟨hx, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · show P.param j x ∈ P.O j₀
        rw [h]; exact hp₀O
      · show P.proj j₀ (P.param j x) ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r
        rw [h, hproj₀]; exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr
    have hbdV : ∀ x ∈ (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) ∩
        (fun x' => P.proj j₀ (P.param j x')) ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r,
        P.param j x ≠ p₀ → |lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x| ≤ C := by
      intro x hx hne
      have hτB : P.proj j₀ (P.param j x) ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀} := by
        refine ⟨hx.2, ?_⟩
        intro h
        have h' : P.proj j₀ (P.param j x) = x₀ := h
        apply hne
        have he := (hlift x hx.1).2
        rw [h'] at he
        rw [← he, hp₀]
      rw [hlapeq x ⟨hx.1, hτB⟩]
      exact (hpole _ hτB.1 hτB.2).2
    
    have hZsub : ({x | x ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j x = p₀} : Set E2).Subsingleton := by
      intro x hx y hy
      have h1 : P.param j x = p₀ := hx.2
      have h2 : P.param j y = p₀ := hy.2
      calc x = P.proj j (P.param j x) := (P.proj_param j x hx.1).symm
        _ = P.proj j (P.param j y) := by rw [h1, h2]
        _ = y := P.proj_param j y hy.1
    have hZ0 : (volume : Measure E2) {x | x ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j x = p₀} = 0 :=
      hZsub.measure_zero _
    have hZm : MeasurableSet ({x | x ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j x = p₀} : Set E2) :=
      hZsub.measurableSet
    
    have hKc := (hK j).1
    have hKW := (hK j).2
    obtain ⟨Mρ, hMρ⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn ((hρs j j).continuousOn.mono hKW)
    obtain ⟨MA, hMA⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (((hdetS j).continuousOn.sqrt).mono hKW)
    have hKVsub : Kc j \ ((P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) ∩
        (fun x' => P.proj j₀ (P.param j x')) ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r) ⊆
        {x | x ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j x ≠ p₀} := by
      rintro x ⟨hxK, hxV⟩
      exact ⟨hKW hxK, fun h => hxV (hZV x (hKW hxK) h)⟩
    obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁⟩ := (hKc.diff hVo).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hcont.mono hKVsub)
    have hbound : ∀ x ∈ Kc j, x ∉ {x | x ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j x = p₀} →
        ‖F x‖ ≤ max M₁ (Mρ * C * MA) := by
      intro x hxK hxZ
      by_cases hxV : x ∈ (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) ∩
          (fun x' => P.proj j₀ (P.param j x')) ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r
      · have hne : P.param j x ≠ p₀ := fun h => hxZ ⟨hKW hxK, h⟩
        have h1 : |ρ j (P.param j x)| ≤ Mρ := by
          rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hMρ x hxK
        have h2 : |Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s)| ≤ 1 := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)]
          exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
        have h3 : |lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x| ≤ C := hbdV x hxV hne
        have h4 : |Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det| ≤ MA := by
          rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hMA x hxK
        have hMρ0 : 0 ≤ Mρ := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) h1
        have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) h3
        have hab : |Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s)| * |lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x| ≤ C := by
          calc |Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s)| * |lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x|
              ≤ 1 * |lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (abs_nonneg _)
            _ ≤ C := by linarith
        have e1 : |ρ j (P.param j x)| *
            (|Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s)| * |lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x|) ≤ Mρ * C :=
          mul_le_mul h1 hab (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _)) hMρ0
        have e2 : |ρ j (P.param j x)| *
            (|Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s)| * |lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x|) *
            |Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det| ≤ Mρ * C * MA :=
          mul_le_mul e1 h4 (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hMρ0 hC0)
        have hFx : ‖F x‖ = |ρ j (P.param j x)| *
            (|Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s)| * |lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x|) *
            |Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det| := by
          rw [hF, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_mul]
        rw [hFx]
        exact le_trans e2 (le_max_right _ _)
      · exact le_trans (hM₁ x ⟨hxK, hxV⟩) (le_max_left _ _)
    
    have hKZm : MeasurableSet (Kc j \ {x | x ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j x = p₀}) :=
      hKc.measurableSet.diff hZm
    have hKZsub : Kc j \ {x | x ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j x = p₀} ⊆
        {x | x ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j x ≠ p₀} := by
      rintro x ⟨hxK, hxZ⟩
      exact ⟨hKW hxK, fun h => hxZ ⟨hKW hxK, h⟩⟩
    have haesm : AEStronglyMeasurable F
        (volume.restrict (Kc j \ {x | x ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j x = p₀})) :=
      (hcont.mono hKZsub).aestronglyMeasurable hKZm
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Kc j \ {x | x ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j x = p₀})) :=
      isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr
        (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hKc.measure_lt_top.ne (measure_mono Set.diff_subset))
    have hint : Integrable F (volume.restrict (Kc j \ {x | x ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j x = p₀})) := by
      refine Integrable.of_bound haesm (max M₁ (Mρ * C * MA)) ?_
      rw [ae_restrict_iff' hKZm]
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => hbound x hx.1 hx.2)
    have hintK : IntegrableOn F (Kc j) :=
      IntegrableOn.congr_set_ae hint (diff_null_ae_eq_self hZ0).symm
    refine hintK.of_forall_diff_eq_zero (P.W_open j).measurableSet ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [hF]
    simp only [hρK j x hx.1 hx.2, zero_mul]
  
  · have hΩW : P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀}) ⊆ P.W j := Set.inter_subset_left
    have hTc : IsCompact (Kc j ∩ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 s) := by
      refine (hK j).1.of_isClosed_subset ?_ Set.inter_subset_left
      exact ((hb j).continuousOn.mono (hK j).2).preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed
        (hK j).1.isClosed isClosed_Icc
    have hTΩ : Kc j ∩ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) ⁻¹' Set.Icc 0 s ⊆
        P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀}) := by
      rintro x ⟨hxK, hx0, hxs⟩
      have hxW := (hK j).2 hxK
      refine ⟨hxW, hRU ⟨hparamS j x hxW, hx0⟩, ?_⟩
      intro hxp
      have hxp' : P.param j x = p₀ := hxp
      have hle : b (P.param j x) ≤ r := le_trans hxs hsr
      rw [hxp'] at hle
      linarith
    have hG : ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
         (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
           ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x *
             pd2 c (L j) x) *
         Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀})) := by
      have hρc := (hρs j j).continuousOn.mono hΩW
      have hdc : ContinuousOn (fun x => deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s))
          (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀})) :=
        hdηc.comp_continuousOn (((hb j).continuousOn.div_const s).mono hΩW)
      have hbd : ∀ a, ContinuousOn (pd2 a (fun y => b (P.param j y)))
          (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀})) := fun a =>
        (hinfG _ (P.W_open j) _ (hb j) a).continuousOn.mono hΩW
      have hLd : ∀ c, ContinuousOn (pd2 c (L j)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀})) := fun c =>
        (hinfG _ (hΩo j) _ (hLs j) c).continuousOn
      have hdA : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
          (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀})) := ((hdetS j).continuousOn.sqrt).mono hΩW
      exact (hρc.mul ((continuousOn_const.mul hdc).mul (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ =>
        continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun c _ =>
          (((hinv j a c).continuousOn.mono hΩW).mul (hbd a)).mul (hLd c)))).mul hdA
    have hGT := (hG.mono hTΩ).integrableOn_compact (μ := volume) hTc
    refine hGT.of_forall_diff_eq_zero (P.W_open j).measurableSet ?_
    rintro x ⟨hxW, hxT⟩
    by_cases hxK : x ∈ Kc j
    · have hbx : ¬ (0 ≤ b (P.param j x) ∧ b (P.param j x) ≤ s) := fun h => hxT ⟨hxK, h⟩
      have hd0 : deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) = 0 := by
        apply hdη
        by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ b (P.param j x)
        · right
          have hlt : s < b (P.param j x) := by
            by_contra h
            exact hbx ⟨h0, not_lt.mp h⟩
          exact (one_lt_div hs).mpr hlt
        · left
          exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (not_le.mp h0) hs
      simp only [hd0, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    · simp only [hρK j x hxW hxK, zero_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (j₀ : Fin P.n) (x₀ : E2) (p₀ : X) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hp₀ : P.param j₀ x₀ = p₀)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ r ⊆ P.W j₀)
    (hbpos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r, 2 * r ≤ b (P.param j₀ x))
    (U : Set X) (hU : IsOpen U) (hRU : {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} ⊆ U)
    (L : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hLs : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (L j) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (U \ {p₀})))
    (hLc : ∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.O k ∩ (U \ {p₀})),
      L j x = L k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
    (hdiv : ∀ (Aset : Fin P.n → Set E2), (∀ j, IsOpen (Aset j)) → (∀ j, Aset j ⊆ P.W j) →
      (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Aset j, ∑ i, ρ i (P.param j y) = 1) →
      ∀ (Wv : Fin P.n → E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ j (e : Fin 2), ContinuousOn (fun x => Wv j x e) (P.W j)) →
      (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Aset j → ∀ e : Fin 2, Wv j x e = 0) →
      (∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, ∀ i : Fin 2,
        ∑ e : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 e) i * Wv j x e =
          Wv k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) i) →
      ∑ j, ∑ e : Fin 2, ∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
        (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) = 0) :
    ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₀ → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ r →
      (∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) *
         ((1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q => 1 - Real.smoothTransition
             ((pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ (P.proj j₀ q) - δ) / δ)) (P.param j x)) *
           (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x)) *
         Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j)) ∧
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => (1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q => 1 - Real.smoothTransition
             ((pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ (P.proj j₀ q) - δ) / δ)) (P.param j x)) *
           (Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) * lap2 (P.h j) (L j) x)) +
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (b (P.param j x) / s) *
           ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x *
             pd2 c (L j) x) +
        (∫ x in P.W j₀, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j₀ x)⁻¹ a c *
           pd2 a (fun y => Real.smoothTransition ((pcgbPoleRad P j₀ x₀ y - δ) / δ)) x *
             pd2 c (L j₀) x) *
           Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ x).det) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hsm : ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Fin m → E2),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y u) V ∧
      ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ v : E2,
        fderiv ℝ (fun y' => iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y' u) y v =
          fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) y v u := by
    intro m u
    have hat : ∀ y ∈ V, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) y := by
      intro y hy
      have hfy : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f y := hf.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hy)
      refine hfy.iteratedFDeriv_right ?_
      rw [← WithTop.coe_natCast, ← WithTop.coe_add, top_add]
    refine ⟨fun y hy => ?_, fun y hy v => ?_⟩
    · have h1 := (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => E2) ℝ u).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp
        y (hat y hy)
      exact h1.contDiffWithinAt
    · have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) y :=
        (hat y hy).differentiableAt (by simp)
      exact fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply hd u v
  
  have hbw : ∀ (m : ℕ) (L : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin m => E2) ℝ), L ≠ 0 →
      ∃ ι : Fin m → Fin 2, L (fun i => e2 (ι i)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro m L hL
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    apply hL
    apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.toMultilinearMap_injective
    rw [ContinuousMultilinearMap.toMultilinearMap_zero]
    refine Module.Basis.ext_multilinear (ιM := fun _ => Fin 2)
      (fun _ => (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis) ?_
    intro v
    simp only [OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply,
      ContinuousMultilinearMap.coe_coe, MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
    exact hcon v
  
  let φ : (Σ m : ℕ, Fin m → Fin 2) → E2 → ℝ :=
    fun p y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ p.1 f y (fun i => e2 (p.2 i))
  let N : (Σ m : ℕ, Fin m → Fin 2) → Set E2 :=
    fun p => (V ∩ (fderiv ℝ (φ p)) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) ∩ φ p ⁻¹' {0}
  have hN : ∀ p, MeasureTheory.volume (N p) = 0 := by
    intro p
    have hφ := (hsm p.1 (fun i => e2 (p.2 i))).1
    have hopen : IsOpen (V ∩ (fderiv ℝ (φ p)) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) :=
      (hφ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by simp)).isOpen_inter_preimage hV
        isOpen_compl_singleton
    exact hsub _ (φ p) hopen (hφ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun z hz => hz.2)
  have hcover : {x | x ∈ V ∧ fderiv ℝ f x = 0 ∧
      ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x ≠ 0} ⊆ ⋃ p, N p := by
    rintro x ⟨hxV, hdf, H⟩
    have hk1 := Nat.find_spec H
    set k₀ := Nat.find H with hk₀
    have hne1 : k₀ ≠ 1 := by
      intro h1
      apply hk1.2
      rw [h1]
      rw [← norm_eq_zero, norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, hdf, norm_zero]
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, k₀ = m + 1 := ⟨k₀ - 1, by omega⟩
    have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := by omega
    have hDm : iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f x = 0 := by
      have hmin := Nat.find_min H (show m < Nat.find H by omega)
      push_neg at hmin
      exact hmin hm1
    have hDm1 : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f x ≠ 0 := by rw [← hm]; exact hk1.2
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f x v ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      exact hDm1 (ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext hcon)
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left] at hv
    have hL : fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f) x (v 0) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, ContinuousMultilinearMap.zero_apply] at hv
      exact hv rfl
    obtain ⟨ι, hι⟩ := hbw m _ hL
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨m, ι⟩, ⟨hxV, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show fderiv ℝ (φ ⟨m, ι⟩) x ∉ ({0} : Set (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ))
      intro h0
      have h0' : fderiv ℝ (φ ⟨m, ι⟩) x = 0 := h0
      have hfor := (hsm m (fun i => e2 (ι i))).2 x hxV (v 0)
      apply hι
      rw [← hfor]
      show fderiv ℝ (φ ⟨m, ι⟩) x (v 0) = 0
      rw [h0']
      rfl
    · show iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f x (fun i => e2 (ι i)) = 0
      rw [hDm]
      rfl
  exact MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null hcover (MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion_null hN)

signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (b : X → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hRconn : IsConnected {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hbd : ∃ q ∈ S, b q = 0) (Gd : PcgbGreenData P b)
    (hsucp : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < b (P.param j x) → P.param j x ≠ Gd.p₀ →
      (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => Gd.w (P.param j y)) x = 0) →
      ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, Gd.w (P.param j y) = Gd.w (P.param j x)) :
    ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < b (P.param j x) → P.param j x ≠ Gd.p₀ →
      ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun y => Gd.w (P.param j y)) x ≠ 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro j x hx hbx hp
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  
  have hparamS : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ P.W i, P.param i y ∈ S ∧ P.param i y ∈ P.O i := by
    intro i y hy
    have h1 : P.param i y ∈ P.param i '' P.W i := Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hy
    rw [P.image_eq i] at h1
    exact ⟨h1.2, h1.1⟩
  have hC0 : ∀ q ∈ S, ∃ i, ∃ y ∈ P.W i, P.param i y = q := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (P.cover hq)
    have h1 : q ∈ P.param i '' P.W i := by rw [P.image_eq i]; exact ⟨hi, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyq⟩ := h1
    exact ⟨i, y, hy, hyq⟩
  have htrans : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ P.W i, ∀ p : E2 → Prop, (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, p z) →
      ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (P.param i y), q ∈ S → ∃ z ∈ P.W i, P.param i z = q ∧ p z := by
    intro i y hy p hpz
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hto, hyt⟩ := _root_.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hpz
    have hN : IsOpen (P.O i ∩ P.proj i ⁻¹' (t ∩ P.W i)) :=
      (P.proj_cont i).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open i) (hto.inter (P.W_open i))
    have hqN : P.param i y ∈ P.O i ∩ P.proj i ⁻¹' (t ∩ P.W i) := by
      refine ⟨(hparamS i y hy).2, ?_⟩
      show P.proj i (P.param i y) ∈ t ∩ P.W i
      rw [P.proj_param i y hy]
      exact ⟨hyt, hy⟩
    filter_upwards [hN.mem_nhds hqN] with q hq hqS
    have h1 : q ∈ P.param i '' P.W i := by rw [P.image_eq i]; exact ⟨hq.1, hqS⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := h1
    have h2 : P.proj i (P.param i z) ∈ t ∩ P.W i := hq.2
    rw [P.proj_param i z hz] at h2
    exact ⟨z, hz, rfl, ht z h2.1⟩
  have hback : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ P.W i, ∀ Φ : X → Prop, (∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (P.param i y), Φ q) →
      ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, z ∈ P.W i ∧ Φ (P.param i z) := by
    intro i y hy Φ hΦ
    have hc : ContinuousAt (P.param i) y :=
      (P.param_cont i).continuousAt ((P.W_open i).mem_nhds hy)
    have hW : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, z ∈ P.W i := (P.W_open i).mem_nhds hy
    exact hW.and (Filter.Tendsto.eventually hc hΦ)
  have hsmoothAt : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ P.W i, P.param i y ∈ Gd.U → P.param i y ≠ Gd.p₀ →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun z => Gd.w (P.param i z)) y := by
    intro i y hy hU hne
    have hV : IsOpen (P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' (Gd.U \ {Gd.p₀})) :=
      (P.param_cont i).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open i) (Gd.U_open.sdiff isClosed_singleton)
    exact (Gd.smooth i).contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds ⟨hy, hU, hne⟩)
  have hbp₀ : 0 < b Gd.p₀ := by
    have h1 := Gd.ball_pos Gd.x₀ (Metric.mem_closedBall_self Gd.r_pos.le)
    rw [Gd.param_x₀] at h1
    linarith [Gd.r_pos]
  
  have hgood : ∀ (c : ℝ) (i : Fin P.n), ∀ y ∈ P.W i, 0 < b (P.param i y) →
      P.param i y ≠ Gd.p₀ → (∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, Gd.w (P.param i z) = c) →
      ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (P.param i y), q ∈ S → Gd.w q = c ∧ 0 < b q ∧ q ≠ Gd.p₀ := by
    intro c i y hy hby hpy hc
    have hbc : ContinuousAt (fun z => b (P.param i z)) y :=
      (hb i).continuousOn.continuousAt ((P.W_open i).mem_nhds hy)
    have hbpos : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, 0 < b (P.param i z) :=
      Filter.Tendsto.eventually hbc (lt_mem_nhds hby)
    have hne : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 (P.param i y), q ≠ Gd.p₀ := eventually_ne_nhds hpy
    filter_upwards [htrans i y hy _ (hc.and hbpos), hne] with q hq hq0 hqS
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl, hzc, hzb⟩ := hq hqS
    exact ⟨hzc, hzb, hq0⟩
  
  have hbdry : ∀ (c : ℝ), c < 0 → ∀ q ∈ S, b q = 0 →
      ∀ᶠ q' in 𝓝 q, q' ∈ S → c < Gd.w q' := by
    intro c hc q hqS hq0
    obtain ⟨i, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hC0 q hqS
    have hw0 := (Gd.dirichlet i y hy hq0).1
    have hne : P.param i y ≠ Gd.p₀ := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at hq0
      linarith
    have hU : P.param i y ∈ Gd.U := Gd.R_sub ⟨hqS, hq0.ge⟩
    have hcont := (hsmoothAt i y hy hU hne).continuousAt
    have hnb : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (Gd.w (P.param i y)), c < t := by
      rw [hw0]
      exact lt_mem_nhds hc
    have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, c < Gd.w (P.param i z) := Filter.Tendsto.eventually hcont hnb
    filter_upwards [htrans i y hy _ hev] with q' hq' hq'S
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl, hzc⟩ := hq' hq'S
    exact hzc
  
  have hpole : ∀ c : ℝ, ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 Gd.p₀, q ∈ S → q ≠ Gd.p₀ → Gd.w q < c := by
    intro c
    have hx₀W : Gd.x₀ ∈ P.W Gd.j₀ := Gd.ball_sub (Metric.mem_closedBall_self Gd.r_pos.le)
    have hHpd : (P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀).PosDef := P.h_posDef Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ hx₀W
    obtain ⟨Mb, hMb⟩ : ∃ Mb : ℝ, Mb = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ a' : Fin 2, |P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ a a'| :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hMb0 : 0 ≤ Mb := by
      rw [hMb]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a' _ => abs_nonneg _))
    obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E : ℝ, E = Real.exp (c - Gd.C) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hE0 : 0 < E := by rw [hE]; exact Real.exp_pos _
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, δ = min Gd.r (min 1 (E ^ 2 / (Mb + 1))) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hδ0 : 0 < δ := by
      rw [hδ]
      exact lt_min Gd.r_pos (lt_min one_pos (div_pos (pow_pos hE0 2) (by linarith)))
    have key : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball Gd.x₀ δ, y ≠ Gd.x₀ → Gd.w (P.param Gd.j₀ y) < c := by
      intro y hy hyne
      have hd : dist y Gd.x₀ < δ := hy
      rw [hδ] at hd
      obtain ⟨hdr, hd'⟩ := lt_min_iff.mp hd
      obtain ⟨hd1, hdE⟩ := lt_min_iff.mp hd'
      have hd0 : 0 ≤ dist y Gd.x₀ := dist_nonneg
      have hvne : (fun a => (y - Gd.x₀) a) ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        apply hyne
        have : y - Gd.x₀ = 0 := by
          ext a
          have := congrFun h a
          simpa using this
        exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
      have hQpos : 0 < ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ a' : Fin 2,
          P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ a a' * (y - Gd.x₀) a * (y - Gd.x₀) a' := by
        have h := hHpd.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hvne
        have heq : dotProduct (star (fun a => (y - Gd.x₀) a))
            ((P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀).mulVec (fun a => (y - Gd.x₀) a)) =
            ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ a' : Fin 2,
              P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ a a' * (y - Gd.x₀) a * (y - Gd.x₀) a' := by
          simp [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two]
          ring
        linarith
      have hva : ∀ a, |(y - Gd.x₀) a| ≤ dist y Gd.x₀ := by
        intro a
        rw [dist_eq_norm]
        have := PiLp.norm_apply_le (y - Gd.x₀) a
        rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
      have hQle : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ a' : Fin 2,
          P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ a a' * (y - Gd.x₀) a * (y - Gd.x₀) a' ≤ Mb * dist y Gd.x₀ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hMb, Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro a _
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro a' _
        have h1 := hva a
        have h2 := hva a'
        calc P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ a a' * (y - Gd.x₀) a * (y - Gd.x₀) a'
            ≤ |P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ a a' * (y - Gd.x₀) a * (y - Gd.x₀) a'| := le_abs_self _
          _ = |P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ a a'| * |(y - Gd.x₀) a| * |(y - Gd.x₀) a'| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          _ ≤ |P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ a a'| * dist y Gd.x₀ * dist y Gd.x₀ := by gcongr
          _ = |P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ a a'| * dist y Gd.x₀ ^ 2 := by ring
      have hQE : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ a' : Fin 2,
          P.h Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ a a' * (y - Gd.x₀) a * (y - Gd.x₀) a' < E ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : dist y Gd.x₀ ^ 2 ≤ dist y Gd.x₀ := by nlinarith
        have h2 : dist y Gd.x₀ * (Mb + 1) < E ^ 2 := (lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith)).mp hdE
        have h3 : Mb * dist y Gd.x₀ ^ 2 ≤ Mb * dist y Gd.x₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hMb0
        nlinarith
      have hrad : pcgbPoleRad P Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ y < E := by
        unfold pcgbPoleRad
        rw [Real.sqrt_lt' hE0]
        exact hQE
      have hradpos : 0 < pcgbPoleRad P Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ y := by
        unfold pcgbPoleRad
        exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQpos
      have hlog : Real.log (pcgbPoleRad P Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ y) < c - Gd.C := by
        rw [Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp hradpos, ← hE]
        exact hrad
      have hpb := (Gd.pole y (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hdr) hyne).1
      have := (abs_le.mp hpb).2
      linarith
    have hballnhds : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 Gd.x₀, z ∈ Metric.ball Gd.x₀ δ := Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hδ0
    have htr := htrans Gd.j₀ Gd.x₀ hx₀W _ hballnhds
    rw [Gd.param_x₀] at htr
    filter_upwards [htr] with q hq hqS hqne
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl, hzb⟩ := hq hqS
    have hzne : z ≠ Gd.x₀ := by
      intro h
      apply hqne
      rw [h, Gd.param_x₀]
    exact key z hzb hzne
  
  have hinterior : ∀ (c : ℝ), ∀ q ∈ S, 0 < b q → q ≠ Gd.p₀ →
      (∃ᶠ q' in 𝓝 q, q' ∈ S ∧
        ∀ᶠ q'' in 𝓝 q', q'' ∈ S → Gd.w q'' = c ∧ 0 < b q'' ∧ q'' ≠ Gd.p₀) →
      ∀ᶠ q' in 𝓝 q, q' ∈ S → Gd.w q' = c ∧ 0 < b q' ∧ q' ≠ Gd.p₀ := by
    intro c q hqS hbq hqp hfreq
    obtain ⟨i, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hC0 q hqS
    have hU : P.param i y ∈ Gd.U := Gd.R_sub ⟨hqS, hbq.le⟩
    have hcd := hsmoothAt i y hy hU hqp
    have hacc : ∃ᶠ z in 𝓝 y, ∀ᶠ z' in 𝓝 z, Gd.w (P.param i z') = c := by
      intro hnot
      have h1 := htrans i y hy _ hnot
      obtain ⟨q', ⟨hq'S, hq'good⟩, hq'z⟩ := (hfreq.and_eventually h1).exists
      obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl, hznot⟩ := hq'z hq'S
      apply hznot
      have h2 := hback i z hz _ hq'good
      filter_upwards [h2] with z' hz'
      exact (hz'.2 (hparamS i z' hz'.1).1).1
    have hflat : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k →
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => Gd.w (P.param i z)) y = 0 := by
      intro k hk
      by_contra hne
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (fun z => Gd.w (P.param i z))) y :=
        hcd.continuousAt_iteratedFDeriv (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      have hev := hcont.eventually_ne hne
      obtain ⟨z, hzc, hzne⟩ := (hacc.and_eventually hev).exists
      apply hzne
      have heq : (fun z' => Gd.w (P.param i z')) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (fun _ => c) := hzc
      rw [(heq.iteratedFDeriv ℝ k).eq_of_nhds, iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega : k ≠ 0)]
      rfl
    have hloc := hsucp i y hy hbq hqp hflat
    have hval : Gd.w (P.param i y) = c := by
      obtain ⟨z, hzc, hzl⟩ := (hacc.and_eventually hloc).exists
      rw [← hzl]
      exact hzc.self_of_nhds
    exact hgood c i y hy hbq hqp (hloc.mono fun z hz => hz.trans hval)
  
  have hq₁S := (hparamS j x hx).1
  have hc0 : Gd.w (P.param j x) < 0 := Gd.neg _ hq₁S hbx hp
  have hloc₁ := hsucp j x hx hbx hp hcon
  obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : ℝ, c = Gd.w (P.param j x) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hcdef] at hc0 hloc₁
  have hgood₁ := hgood c j x hx hbx hp hloc₁
  let Good : X → Prop := fun q =>
    ∀ᶠ q' in 𝓝 q, q' ∈ S → Gd.w q' = c ∧ 0 < b q' ∧ q' ≠ Gd.p₀
  have hu : IsOpen {q | Good q} := isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds
  have hv : IsOpen {q | ∀ᶠ q' in 𝓝 q, q' ∈ S → ¬ Good q'} := isOpen_setOf_eventually_nhds
  have hdisj : {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} ∩
      ({q | Good q} ∩ {q | ∀ᶠ q' in 𝓝 q, q' ∈ S → ¬ Good q'}) = ∅ := by
    ext q
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hqS, _⟩, hqu, hqv⟩
      exact absurd hqu (hqv.self_of_nhds hqS)
    · intro h
      exact h.elim
  have hcover : {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} ⊆
      {q | Good q} ∪ {q | ∀ᶠ q' in 𝓝 q, q' ∈ S → ¬ Good q'} := by
    rintro q ⟨hqS, hbq⟩
    by_cases hqv : ∀ᶠ q' in 𝓝 q, q' ∈ S → ¬ Good q'
    · exact Or.inr hqv
    left
    have F : ∃ᶠ q' in 𝓝 q, q' ∈ S ∧ Good q' := by
      rw [Filter.not_eventually] at hqv
      exact hqv.mono fun q' h =>
        ⟨(_root_.not_imp.mp h).1, not_not.mp (_root_.not_imp.mp h).2⟩
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hbq with h0 | hpos
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨q', ⟨hq'S, hq'g⟩, hlt⟩ := (F.and_eventually (hbdry c hc0 q hqS h0.symm)).exists
      have h1 := (hq'g.self_of_nhds hq'S).1
      have h2 := hlt hq'S
      linarith
    · by_cases hqp : q = Gd.p₀
      · exfalso
        rw [hqp] at F
        obtain ⟨q', ⟨hq'S, hq'g⟩, hlt⟩ := (F.and_eventually (hpole c)).exists
        obtain ⟨h1, _, h3⟩ := hq'g.self_of_nhds hq'S
        have h4 := hlt hq'S h3
        linarith
      · exact hinterior c q hqS hpos hqp F
  rcases isPreconnected_iff_subset_of_disjoint.mp hRconn.isPreconnected _ _ hu hv hcover hdisj
    with hRu | hRv
  · obtain ⟨qb, hqbS, hqb0⟩ := hbd
    have hg : Good qb := hRu ⟨hqbS, hqb0.ge⟩
    have h1 := (hg.self_of_nhds hqbS).2.1
    linarith
  · have hg : ∀ᶠ q' in 𝓝 (P.param j x), q' ∈ S → ¬ Good q' := hRv ⟨hq₁S, hbx.le⟩
    exact hg.self_of_nhds hq₁S hgood₁
