signature.name: e2_submersion_zero_null
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (f : E2 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W) (hdf : ∀ z ∈ W, fderiv ℝ f z ≠ 0) :
    MeasureTheory.volume (W ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set v0 : E2 := EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ) with hv0
  set v1 : E2 := EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ) with hv1
  have h1n : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by simp
  have hfd : ∀ z ∈ W, HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f z) z := fun z hz =>
    ((hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hz)).hasFDerivAt
  have hDc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) W := hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW h1n
  
  have hZm : ∀ v : E2, MeasurableSet {z | z ∈ W ∧ f z = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ f z v ≠ 0} := by
    intro v
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z v) W := hDc.clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hA : IsOpen (W ∩ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z v) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) :=
      hc.isOpen_inter_preimage hW isOpen_compl_singleton
    have hB : IsOpen ((W ∩ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z v) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) :=
      (hf.continuousOn.mono Set.inter_subset_left).isOpen_inter_preimage hA
        isOpen_compl_singleton
    have hEq : {z | z ∈ W ∧ f z = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ f z v ≠ 0} =
        (W ∩ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z v) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) \
          ((W ∩ (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z v) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) ∩ f ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ) := by
      ext z
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage,
        Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
      tauto
    rw [hEq]
    exact hA.measurableSet.diff hB.measurableSet
  
  have hslice : ∀ v p : E2,
      volume {t : ℝ | p + t • v ∈ {z | z ∈ W ∧ f z = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ f z v ≠ 0}} = 0 := by
    intro v p
    apply measure_null_of_locally_null
    intro b hb
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hb
    obtain ⟨hbW, hb0, hbd⟩ := hb
    have hℓ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => p + t • v) v b := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id b).smul_const v).const_add p
    have hg : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (p + t • v)) (fderiv ℝ f (p + b • v) v) b :=
      (hfd _ hbW).comp_hasDerivAt b hℓ
    have hev : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[≠] b, f (p + z • v) ≠ 0 := hg.eventually_ne hbd
    rw [eventually_nhdsWithin_iff] at hev
    refine ⟨_, inter_mem_nhdsWithin _ hev, ?_⟩
    apply measure_mono_null _ (Real.volume_singleton (a := b))
    rintro t ⟨ht, htV⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at ht
    by_contra hne
    exact htV hne ht.2.1
  
  have hτ : MeasurePreserving (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • v0 + q.2 • v1) volume volume := by
    have h1 := (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin 2)).trans
      (volume_preserving_finTwoArrow ℝ)
    have h2 := MeasurePreserving.symm
      ((MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin 2 → ℝ)).symm.trans MeasurableEquiv.finTwoArrow) h1
    convert h2 using 1
    funext q
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [v0, v1] <;> rfl
  have hZ1 : volume {z | z ∈ W ∧ f z = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ f z v1 ≠ 0} = 0 := by
    rw [← hτ.measure_preimage (hZm v1).nullMeasurableSet, Measure.volume_eq_prod,
      Measure.prod_apply ((hZm v1).preimage hτ.measurable)]
    refine (lintegral_congr (fun a => ?_)).trans lintegral_zero
    exact hslice v1 (a • v0)
  have hZ0 : volume {z | z ∈ W ∧ f z = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ f z v0 ≠ 0} = 0 := by
    rw [← hτ.measure_preimage (hZm v0).nullMeasurableSet, Measure.volume_eq_prod,
      Measure.prod_apply_symm ((hZm v0).preimage hτ.measurable)]
    refine (lintegral_congr (fun b => ?_)).trans lintegral_zero
    have hs : (fun a : ℝ => (a, b)) ⁻¹'
        ((fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • v0 + q.2 • v1) ⁻¹'
          {z | z ∈ W ∧ f z = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ f z v0 ≠ 0}) =
        {t : ℝ | b • v1 + t • v0 ∈ {z | z ∈ W ∧ f z = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ f z v0 ≠ 0}} := by
      ext t
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
      rw [add_comm]
    rw [hs]
    exact hslice v0 (b • v1)
  have hcover : W ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ⊆ {z | z ∈ W ∧ f z = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ f z v0 ≠ 0} ∪
      {z | z ∈ W ∧ f z = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ f z v1 ≠ 0} := by
    rintro z ⟨hzW, hz0⟩
    have hz0' : f z = 0 := hz0
    by_cases h0 : fderiv ℝ f z v0 = 0
    · by_cases h1 : fderiv ℝ f z v1 = 0
      · exfalso
        apply hdf z hzW
        ext w
        have hw : w = w 0 • v0 + w 1 • v1 := by
          ext j
          fin_cases j <;> simp [v0, v1]
        calc fderiv ℝ f z w = fderiv ℝ f z (w 0 • v0 + w 1 • v1) := by
              conv_lhs => rw [hw]
          _ = 0 := by simp [h0, h1]
          _ = (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) w := rfl
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hzW, hz0', h1⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hzW, hz0', h0⟩
  exact measure_mono_null hcover (measure_union_null hZ0 hZ1)

proof.tactics:
by
  have s1 : ∀ (c u x : E3) (ρ : ℝ), x ∈ Metric.ball (c - u) ρ ↔ x + u ∈ Metric.ball c ρ := by
    intro c u x ρ
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Metric.mem_ball, dist_sub_eq_dist_add_right]

  · intro c u ρ f hf

    · exact hζc.comp_homeomorph (Homeomorph.addRight u)
    · intro x hx
      have hx' : x ∈ tsupport (ζ ∘ (Homeomorph.addRight u)) := hx
      rw [tsupport_comp_eq_preimage] at hx'
      exact (s1 c u x ρ).2 (hs hx')
  · intro c r ρ hr hρ
    ext x
    constructor
    · exact fun h => h.1
    · intro hx
      refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
      show 0 < x 0
      have h1 := PiLp.norm_apply_le (x - c) 0

by
  
  have hmem : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ),
      fcrSob c s k φ D → MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro s k φ D h
    have h0 := h.2.1 [] (Nat.zero_le _)
    rwa [h.1] at h0
  have hmemH : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ), (∃ D, fcrSob c s k φ D) →
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    rintro s k φ ⟨D, h⟩
    exact hmem s k φ D h
  have hfirst : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ),
      fcrSob c s (k + 1) φ D → ∀ a, fcrWD c s φ a (D [a]) ∧
        MemLp (D [a]) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro s k φ D h a
    refine ⟨fun ζ h1 h2 h3 => ?_, h.2.1 [a] (by simp)⟩
    have h0 := h.2.2 [] a (by simp) ζ h1 h2 h3
    rw [h.1] at h0
    exact h0
  have hL2 : ∀ (s : ℝ) (χ : E3 → ℝ), MemLp χ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      ∃ D, fcrSob c s 0 χ D := by
    intro s χ hχ
    exact ⟨fun _ => χ, rfl, fun _ _ => hχ, fun _ _ hL => absurd hL (Nat.not_lt_zero _)⟩
  have hHmono : ∀ (s s' : ℝ) (k k' : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ), s' ≤ s → k' ≤ k →
      (∃ D, fcrSob c s k φ D) → ∃ D, fcrSob c s' k' φ D := by
    rintro s s' k k' φ hss hk ⟨D, hD⟩
    exact ⟨D, (fcr_sob_mono c s s' hss).1 k k' φ D hk hD⟩
  have hadd : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ), (∃ D, fcrSob c s k φ₁ D) →
      (∃ D, fcrSob c s k φ₂ D) → ∃ D, fcrSob c s k (fun x => φ₁ x + φ₂ x) D := by
    rintro s k φ₁ φ₂ ⟨D₁, h₁⟩ ⟨D₂, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨_, fcr_sob_add c s k φ₁ φ₂ D₁ D₂ h₁ h₂⟩
  have hsum3 : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ), (∀ b, ∃ D, fcrSob c s k (φ b) D) →
      ∃ D, fcrSob c s k (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3, φ b x) D := by
    intro s k φ h
    have h012 := hadd s k _ _ (hadd s k _ _ (h 0) (h 1)) (h 2)
    have he : (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3, φ b x) = (fun x => (φ 0 x + φ 1 x) + φ 2 x) := by
      funext x
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    rw [he]
    exact h012
  have hpd : ∀ (m : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv a m) (Metric.ball c R) := by
    intro m a hm
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ m y (e a)) (Metric.ball c R)
    exact ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball).1 hm).2.clm_apply
      contDiffOn_const
  have hsmulH : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (m φ : E3 → ℝ), s < R → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R) →
      (∃ D, fcrSob c s k φ D) → ∃ D, fcrSob c s k (fun x => m x * φ x) D := by
    rintro s k m φ hs hm ⟨D, hD⟩
    exact fcr_sob_smul c R s hs m hm k φ D hD
  
  have hassemble : ∀ (s : ℝ) (j : ℕ) (v : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
      (E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (Z : E3 → ℝ),
      (∀ b, fcrWD c s v b (D [b])) →
      (∀ b, MemLp (D [b]) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) →
      (∀ a b, a ≠ 0 → fcrWD c s (D [b]) a (E a b) ∧ ∃ D', fcrSob c s j (E a b) D') →
      fcrWD c s (D [0]) 0 Z → (∃ D', fcrSob c s j Z D') →
      ∀ b, ∃ D', fcrSob c s (j + 1) (D [b]) D' := by
    intro s j v D E Z hv hDm hE hZ hZs b
    refine (fcr_sob_succ_iff c s j (D [b])).2 ⟨hDm b, fun a => ?_⟩
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · subst ha
      by_cases hb : b = 0
      · subst hb
        exact ⟨Z, hZ, hZs⟩
      · exact ⟨E b 0, fcr_weak_symm c s b 0 v (D [b]) (D [0]) (E b 0) (hv b) (hv 0)
          (hE b 0 hb).1, (hE b 0 hb).2⟩
    · exact ⟨E a b, (hE a b ha).1, (hE a b ha).2⟩
  
  have hQ : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ (s' s : ℝ) (v : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
      (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (Fs : E3 → ℝ), 0 < s' → s' < s → s < R →
      fcrProb c s A v D G Fs → (∀ d, ∃ DG, fcrSob c s (k + 1) (G d) DG) →
      (∃ DF, fcrSob c s k Fs DF) → ∀ b, ∃ D', fcrSob c s' (k + 1) (D [b]) D' := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro s' s v D G Fs hs' hss hsR hP hG hFs
      have hP' := fcr_prob_mono c s s' hss.le A v D G Fs hP
      have hs'R : s' < R := hss.trans hsR
      have hm := fcr_sob_mono c s s' hss.le
      have hT : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, a ≠ 0 →
          (fcrWD c s' (D [b]) a χ ∧ MemLp χ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s'))) := by
        intro a b
        by_cases ha : a = 0
        · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd ha h⟩
        · obtain ⟨χ, h1, h2⟩ := fcr_tangential_energy c R s s' hs' hss hsR A hA hAs hApos
            v D G Fs hP hG a ha b
          exact ⟨χ, fun _ => ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩
      choose E hE using hT
      choose DG hDG using hG
      have hGD : ∀ a, fcrWD c s' (G a) a (DG a [a]) ∧
          MemLp (DG a [a]) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s')) := by
        intro a
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hfirst s 0 (G a) (DG a) (hDG a) a
        exact ⟨hm.2.1 _ _ _ h1, hm.2.2 _ h2⟩
      have hZ := fcr_normal_step c R s' hs'R A hA hApos v D G Fs hP' E (fun a => DG a [a])
        hE hGD
      have hZs := fcr_normalZ_sob c R s' hs'R A hA hApos 0 D E (fun a => DG a [a]) Fs
        (fun b => hL2 s' _ (hP'.1.2.1 [b] (by simp)))
        (fun a b ha => hL2 s' _ (hE a b ha).2)
        (fun a => hL2 s' _ (hGD a).2)
        (hL2 s' _ hP'.2.2.1)
      exact hassemble s' 0 v D E _ (fun b => (hfirst s' 0 v D hP'.1 b).1)
        (fun b => (hfirst s' 0 v D hP'.1 b).2)
        (fun a b ha => ⟨(hE a b ha).1, hL2 s' _ (hE a b ha).2⟩) hZ hZs
    | succ k ih =>
      intro s' s v D G Fs hs' hss hsR hP hG hFs
      obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁⟩ : ∃ s₁ : ℝ, s₁ = (s' + s) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hs'1 : s' < s₁ := by rw [hs₁]; linarith
      have hs1s : s₁ < s := by rw [hs₁]; linarith
      have hs1R : s₁ < R := hs1s.trans hsR
      have hs'R : s' < R := hss.trans hsR
      have hs1pos : 0 < s₁ := hs'.trans hs'1
      have hP₁ := fcr_prob_mono c s s₁ hs1s.le A v D G Fs hP
      have hm1 := fcr_sob_mono c s s₁ hs1s.le
      have hm2 := fcr_sob_mono c s₁ s' hs'1.le
      have hm3 := fcr_sob_mono c s s' hss.le
      have hDb : ∀ b, ∃ D', fcrSob c s₁ (k + 1) (D [b]) D' :=
        ih s₁ s v D G Fs hs1pos hs1s hsR hP
          (fun d => hHmono s s (k + 1 + 1) (k + 1) (G d) le_rfl (by omega) (hG d))
          (hHmono s s (k + 1) k Fs le_rfl (by omega) hFs)
      choose Db hDbs using hDb
      have hE1 : ∀ a b, fcrWD c s₁ (D [b]) a (Db b [a]) ∧
          MemLp (Db b [a]) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s₁)) :=
        fun a b => hfirst s₁ k (D [b]) (Db b) (hDbs b) a
      have hGd : ∀ d a, ∃ ψ, fcrWD c s (G d) a ψ ∧ ∃ D', fcrSob c s (k + 1) ψ D' :=
        fun d => ((fcr_sob_succ_iff c s (k + 1) (G d)).1 (hG d)).2
      choose Gd hGdw hGds using hGd
      have hFd : ∀ a, ∃ ψ, fcrWD c s Fs a ψ ∧ ∃ D', fcrSob c s k ψ D' :=
        ((fcr_sob_succ_iff c s k Fs).1 hFs).2
      choose Fd hFdw hFds using hFd
      have hEH : ∀ a b, a ≠ 0 → ∃ D', fcrSob c s' (k + 1) (Db b [a]) D' := by
        intro a b ha
        have hPa := fcr_diff_problem c R s₁ hs1R A hA v D G Fs hP₁ a ha (fun b => Db b [a])
          (fun b => hE1 a b) (fun d => Gd d a)
          (fun d => ⟨hm1.2.1 _ _ _ (hGdw d a), hm1.2.2 _ (hmemH s (k + 1) _ (hGds d a))⟩)
          (Fd a) ⟨hm1.2.1 _ _ _ (hFdw a), hm1.2.2 _ (hmemH s k _ (hFds a))⟩
        have hG' : ∀ d, ∃ DG, fcrSob c s₁ (k + 1)
            (fun x => (∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + Gd d a x)
            DG := by
          intro d
          exact hadd s₁ (k + 1) _ _
            (hsum3 s₁ (k + 1) (fun b x => partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x)
              (fun b => hsmulH s₁ (k + 1) _ _ hs1R (hpd _ a (hA d b)) ⟨Db b, hDbs b⟩))
            (hHmono s s₁ (k + 1) (k + 1) _ hs1s.le le_rfl (hGds d a))
        exact ih s' s₁ (D [a]) _ _ (Fd a) hs' hs'1 hs1R hPa hG'
          (hHmono s s₁ k k _ hs1s.le le_rfl (hFds a)) b
      have hZ := fcr_normal_step c R s₁ hs1R A hA hApos v D G Fs hP₁ (fun a b => Db b [a])
        (fun a => Gd a a) (fun a b _ => hE1 a b)
        (fun a => ⟨hm1.2.1 _ _ _ (hGdw a a), hm1.2.2 _ (hmemH s (k + 1) _ (hGds a a))⟩)
      have hZs := fcr_normalZ_sob c R s' hs'R A hA hApos (k + 1) D (fun a b => Db b [a])
        (fun a => Gd a a) Fs
        (fun b => hHmono s₁ s' (k + 1) (k + 1) _ hs'1.le le_rfl ⟨Db b, hDbs b⟩)
        (fun a b ha => hEH a b ha)
        (fun a => hHmono s s' (k + 1) (k + 1) _ hss.le le_rfl (hGds a a))
        (hHmono s s' (k + 1) (k + 1) _ hss.le le_rfl hFs)
      exact hassemble s' (k + 1) v D (fun a b => Db b [a]) _
        (fun b => hm3.2.1 _ _ _ (hfirst s 0 v D hP.1 b).1)
        (fun b => hm3.2.2 _ (hfirst s 0 v D hP.1 b).2)
        (fun a b ha => ⟨hm2.2.1 _ _ _ (hE1 a b).1, hEH a b ha⟩)
        (hm2.2.1 _ _ _ hZ) hZs
  exact hQ

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_sob_succ_iff
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) :
    (∃ D, fcrSob c s (k + 1) φ D) ↔
      (MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) ∧
        ∀ a : Fin 3, ∃ ψ : E3 → ℝ, fcrWD c s φ a ψ ∧ ∃ D, fcrSob c s k ψ D)

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_sob_mono
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (s s' : ℝ) (hss : s' ≤ s) :
    (∀ (k k' : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ), k' ≤ k →
      fcrSob c s k φ D → fcrSob c s' k' φ D) ∧
    (∀ (φ ψ : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3), fcrWD c s φ a ψ → fcrWD c s' φ a ψ) ∧
    (∀ φ : E3 → ℝ, MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) →
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s')))

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_sob_add
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ₁ φ₂ : E3 → ℝ) (D₁ D₂ : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
    (h₁ : fcrSob c s k φ₁ D₁) (h₂ : fcrSob c s k φ₂ D₂) :
    fcrSob c s k (fun x => φ₁ x + φ₂ x) (fun L x => D₁ L x + D₂ L x)

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_sob_smul
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (m : E3 → ℝ)
    (hm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ m (Metric.ball c R)) (k : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ)
    (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (hφ : fcrSob c s k φ D) :
    ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fun x => m x * φ x) D'

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_prob_mono
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (s s₁ : ℝ) (hs : s₁ ≤ s) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) : fcrProb c s₁ A w D G F

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_weak_symm
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (s : ℝ) (a b : Fin 3) (φ ψa ψb χ : E3 → ℝ)
    (ha : fcrWD c s φ a ψa) (hb : fcrWD c s φ b ψb) (hχ : fcrWD c s ψb a χ) :
    fcrWD c s ψa b χ

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_normalZ_sob
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, (A x).PosDef) (k : ℕ)
    (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (GD : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ b, ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (D [b]) D')
    (hE : ∀ a b, a ≠ 0 → ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (E a b) D')
    (hGD : ∀ a, ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (GD a) D') (hF : ∃ D', fcrSob c s k F D') :
    ∃ D', fcrSob c s k (fcrNormalZ A D E GD F) D'

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_normal_step
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, (A x).PosDef)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) (E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (GD : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ a b, a ≠ 0 → fcrWD c s (D [b]) a (E a b) ∧
      MemLp (E a b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (hGD : ∀ a, fcrWD c s (G a) a (GD a) ∧ MemLp (GD a) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) :
    fcrWD c s (D [0]) 0 (fcrNormalZ A D E GD F)

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_diff_problem
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (R s : ℝ) (hsR : s < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (E : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ b, fcrWD c s (D [b]) a (E b) ∧ MemLp (E b) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (GDa : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hGa : ∀ d, fcrWD c s (G d) a (GDa d) ∧ MemLp (GDa d) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)))
    (FDa : E3 → ℝ)
    (hFa : fcrWD c s F a FDa ∧ MemLp FDa 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s))) :
    fcrProb c s A (D [a]) (fun L => match L with | [] => D [a] | b :: _ => E b)
      (fun d x => (∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => A y d b) x * D [b] x) + GDa d x) FDa

subgoal_signatures.name: fcr_tangential_energy
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (R s s' : ℝ) (hs' : 0 < s') (hss : s' < s) (hsR : s < R)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c R))
    (hAs : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, ∀ a b : Fin 3, A x a b = A x b a)
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, (A x).PosDef)
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : fcrProb c s A w D G F) (hG : ∀ d, ∃ DG, fcrSob c s 1 (G d) DG)
    (a : Fin 3) (ha : a ≠ 0) (b : Fin 3) :
    ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, fcrWD c s' (D [b]) a χ ∧ MemLp χ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s'))

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (R ρ ρ' : ℝ) (hρ' : 0 < ρ') (hρρ' : ρ' < ρ)
    (hρR : ρ < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P (Metric.ball c R)) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball c R))
    (hQ : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ (s' s : ℝ) (v : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
      (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (Fs : E3 → ℝ), 0 < s' → s' < s → s < R →
      fcrProb c s A v D G Fs → (∀ d, ∃ DG, fcrSob c s (k + 1) (G d) DG) →
      (∃ DF, fcrSob c s k Fs DF) → ∀ b, ∃ D', fcrSob c s' (k + 1) (D [b]) D')
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D1 : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (hw : fcrSob c ρ 1 w D1)
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ →
      ∫ x in fcrHalf c ρ,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * D1 [b] x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * w x + F x) * ζ x) = 0) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ, fcrSob c ρ' k w D

signature.name: cir_sobolev_bootstrap
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (R ρ ρ' : ℝ) (hρ' : 0 < ρ') (hρρ' : ρ' < ρ)
    (hρR : ρ < R) (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P F : E3 → ℝ)
    (hP : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ P (Metric.ball c R)) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball c R))
    (hQ : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ (s' s : ℝ) (v : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ)
      (G : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (Fs : E3 → ℝ), 0 < s' → s' < s → s < R →
      fcrProb c s A v D G Fs → (∀ d, ∃ DG, fcrSob c s (k + 1) (G d) DG) →
      (∃ DF, fcrSob c s k Fs DF) → ∀ b, ∃ D', fcrSob c s' (k + 1) (D [b]) D')
    (w : E3 → ℝ) (D1 : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ) (hw : fcrSob c ρ 1 w D1)
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ →
      ∫ x in fcrHalf c ρ,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * D1 [b] x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * w x + F x) * ζ x) = 0) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ, fcrSob c ρ' k w D

proof.tactics:
by
  have hmem : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (φ : E3 → ℝ) (D : List (Fin 3) → E3 → ℝ),
      fcrSob c s k φ D → MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c s)) := by
    intro s k φ D h
    have h0 := h.2.1 [] (Nat.zero_le _)
    rwa [h.1] at h0
  have hFsH : ∀ (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ), s < R → (∃ D, fcrSob c s k w D) →
      ∃ D, fcrSob c s k (fun x => P x * w x + F x) D := by
    rintro s k hs ⟨Dw, hDw⟩
    obtain ⟨D', h1⟩ := fcr_sob_smul c R s hs P hP k w Dw hDw
    obtain ⟨DF, h2⟩ := fcr_smooth_sob c R s hs F hF k
    exact ⟨_, fcr_sob_add c s k (fun x => P x * w x) F D' DF h1 h2⟩
  have hwD : ∀ a : Fin 3, fcrWD c ρ w a (D1 [a]) := by
    intro a ζ h1 h2 h3
    have h0 := hw.2.2 [] a (by simp) ζ h1 h2 h3
    rw [hw.1] at h0
    exact h0
  have hwL : MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c ρ)) := hmem ρ 1 w D1 hw
  have hFsL : MemLp (fun x => P x * w x + F x) 2 (volume.restrict (fcrHalf c ρ)) := by
    obtain ⟨DF, hDF⟩ := hFsH ρ 1 hρR ⟨D1, hw⟩
    exact hmem ρ 1 _ DF hDF
  have hP0 : fcrProb c ρ A w D1 (fun _ _ => 0) (fun x => P x * w x + F x) := by
    refine ⟨hw, fun _ => MemLp.zero', hFsL, fun ζ h1 h2 h3 => ?_⟩
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (hweak ζ h1 h2 h3)
    refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    simp only [add_zero, Finset.sum_mul]
  have hind : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ, ρ' ≤ t → t < ρ → ∃ D, fcrSob c t (k + 1) w D := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro t _ htρ
      exact ⟨D1, (fcr_sob_mono c ρ t htρ.le).1 1 1 w D1 le_rfl hw⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      intro t hρ't htρ
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = (t + ρ) / 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hts : t < s := by rw [hs]; linarith
      have hsρ : s < ρ := by rw [hs]; linarith
      have hρ's : ρ' ≤ s := by linarith
      have hsR : s < R := by linarith
      have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
      obtain ⟨Dk, hDk⟩ := ih s hρ's hsρ
      have hFk : ∃ DF, fcrSob c s k (fun x => P x * w x + F x) DF := by
        obtain ⟨DF, hDF⟩ := hFsH s (k + 1) hsR ⟨Dk, hDk⟩
        exact ⟨DF, (fcr_sob_mono c s s le_rfl).1 (k + 1) k _ DF (Nat.le_succ k) hDF⟩
      have hPs := fcr_prob_mono c ρ s hsρ.le A w D1 (fun _ _ => 0) _ hP0
      have hGs : ∀ d : Fin 3, ∃ DG, fcrSob c s (k + 1) ((fun _ _ => (0 : ℝ)) d) DG :=
        fun _ => fcr_smooth_sob c R s hsR (fun _ => 0) contDiffOn_const (k + 1)
      have hb := hQ k t s w D1 (fun _ _ => 0) _ ht0 hts hsR hPs hGs hFk
      have m := fcr_sob_mono c ρ t htρ.le
      exact (fcr_sob_succ_iff c t (k + 1) w).2
        ⟨m.2.2 w hwL, fun a => ⟨D1 [a], m.2.1 w (D1 [a]) a (hwD a), hb a⟩⟩
  intro k
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hind k ρ' le_rfl hρρ'
  exact ⟨D, (fcr_sob_mono c ρ' ρ' le_rfl).1 (k + 1) k w D (Nat.le_succ k) hD⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (w v' g : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3)
    (hv' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v') (hg : IntegrableOn g O)
    (hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict O), w x = v' x)
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ O →
      ∫ x, w x * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, g x * ζ x) :

signature.name: cir_grad_identify
signature.statement:
(O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (w v' g : E3 → ℝ) (a : Fin 3)
    (hv' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v') (hg : IntegrableOn g O)
    (hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict O), w x = v' x)
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ O →
      ∫ x, w x * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, g x * ζ x) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict O), g x = partialDeriv a v' x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcd : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → Continuous (fun x => partialDeriv a f x) := by
    intro f hf
    exact (hf.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have key : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ O →
      ∫ x, ζ x • (g - partialDeriv a v') x = 0 := by
    intro ζ hζ hζc hts
    have hpair : ∫ x, w x * partialDeriv a ζ x = ∫ x, v' x * partialDeriv a ζ x := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      have h1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ O → w x = v' x := (ae_restrict_iff' hO.measurableSet).1 hae
      filter_upwards [h1] with x hx
      by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
      · simp only [hx hxO]
      · have hnt : x ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h => hxO (hts h)
        have hfd : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 := by
          by_contra hne
          exact hnt (support_fderiv_subset ℝ (Function.mem_support.2 hne))
        simp only [partialDeriv, hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero]
    have hibp : ∫ x, v' x * partialDeriv a ζ x = -∫ x, partialDeriv a v' x * ζ x := by
      have hd1 : Continuous (fun x => partialDeriv a v' x) := hcd v' hv'
      have hd2 : Continuous (fun x => partialDeriv a ζ x) := hcd ζ hζ
      have i1 : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ v' x (e a) * ζ x) :=
        (hd1.mul hζ.continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hζc.mul_left
      have i2 : Integrable (fun x => v' x * fderiv ℝ ζ x (e a)) :=
        (hv'.continuous.mul hd2).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
          (hζc.fderiv_apply ℝ (e a)).mul_left
      have i3 : Integrable (fun x => v' x * ζ x) :=
        (hv'.continuous.mul hζ.continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hζc.mul_left
      exact integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable i1 i2 i3
        (hv'.differentiable (by simp)) (hζ.differentiable (by simp))
    have igz : Integrable (fun x => g x * ζ x) := by
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hζc.exists_bound_of_continuous hζ.continuous
      have hon : IntegrableOn (fun x => g x * ζ x) O :=
        Integrable.mul_bdd hg hζ.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hC)
      refine hon.integrable_of_forall_notMem_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_
      have : ζ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hts h))
      simp [this]
    have idz : Integrable (fun x => partialDeriv a v' x * ζ x) :=
      ((hcd v' hv').mul hζ.continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hζc.mul_left
    have hw := hweak ζ hζ hζc hts
    have hsplit : ∫ x, ζ x • (g - partialDeriv a v') x
        = (∫ x, g x * ζ x) - ∫ x, partialDeriv a v' x * ζ x := by
      rw [← integral_sub igz idz]
      congr 1
      funext x
      simp only [Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [hsplit]
    linarith
  have hloc : LocallyIntegrableOn (g - partialDeriv a v') O volume :=
    hg.locallyIntegrableOn.sub ((hcd v' hv').continuousOn.locallyIntegrableOn hO.measurableSet)
  have h0 := hO.ae_eq_zero_of_integral_contDiff_smul_eq_zero hloc key
  filter_upwards [(ae_restrict_iff' hO.measurableSet).2 h0] with x hx
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 hx

informal_problem.statement:
(c : E3) (ρ₁ ρ₂ : ℝ) (h12 : ρ₂ ≤ ρ₁)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P F v v' : E3 → ℝ) (Gr : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ₂)), v x = v' x)
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ₁ →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ₁,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * Gr b x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * v x + F x) * ζ x) = 0) :
    ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ₂ →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ₂,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * Gr b x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * v' x + F x) * ζ x) = 0

signature.name: cir_weak_shrink
signature.statement:
(c : E3) (ρ₁ ρ₂ : ℝ) (h12 : ρ₂ ≤ ρ₁)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P F v v' : E3 → ℝ) (Gr : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ)
    (hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c ρ₂)), v x = v' x)
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ₁ →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ₁,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * Gr b x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * v x + F x) * ζ x) = 0) :
    ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ₂ →
      ∫ x in Metric.ball c ρ₂,
        ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * Gr b x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
          + (P x * v' x + F x) * ζ x) = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ζ hζ hζc hζs
  have hsub : Metric.ball c ρ₂ ⊆ Metric.ball c ρ₁ := Metric.ball_subset_ball h12
  have h0 := hweak ζ hζ hζc (hζs.trans hsub)
  have hvan : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c ρ₁ \ Metric.ball c ρ₂,
      ((∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * Gr b x * partialDeriv a ζ x)
        + (P x * v x + F x) * ζ x) = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hxt : x ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h => hx.2 (hζs h)
    have hz : ζ x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hxt
    have hd : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 := fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport ℝ hxt
    have hpd : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a ζ x = 0 := by
      intro a
      show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e a) = 0
      rw [hd, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    simp only [hz, hpd, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  rw [setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero Metric.isOpen_ball.measurableSet hsub hvan]
    at h0
  rw [← h0]
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [hae] with x hx
  rw [hx]

informal_problem.statement:
(A₀ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : A₀.PosDef) (κ C₀ : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∃ δ K : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧
      ∀ (z : Fin 2 → ℝ) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s ≤ δ → z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 = s ^ 2 →
      ∀ (B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (u p : Fin 2 → ℝ) (H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (Γ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 2, |B a b - A₀⁻¹ a b| ≤ κ * s) →
      (∀ c : Fin 2, u c = (∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ c b * z b) /
        (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A₀ i j * z i * z j)) →
      (∀ a : Fin 2, |p a - u a| ≤ C₀) →
      (∀ c a : Fin 2, |H c a + ∑ m : Fin 2, Γ m c a * p m -
        (A₀ c a / (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A₀ i j * z i * z j) - 2 * u c * u a)| ≤
          C₀ / Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A₀ i j * z i * z j)) →
      (∀ m c a : Fin 2, |Γ m c a| ≤ C₀) →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j ∧
      (∀ c : Fin 2, |(∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B a b * H c a * p b) +
          u c * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j| ≤
        K * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j) ∧
      |∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, B a c * B b d * H a b * H c d| ≤
        K * (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j) ^ 2 ∧
      (∀ c : Fin 2, |u c| ≤ K * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j)

signature.name: pcgb_pole_algebra
signature.statement:
(A₀ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : A₀.PosDef) (κ C₀ : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀) :
    ∃ δ K : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧
      ∀ (z : Fin 2 → ℝ) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s ≤ δ → z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 = s ^ 2 →
      ∀ (B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (u p : Fin 2 → ℝ) (H : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (Γ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ a b : Fin 2, |B a b - A₀⁻¹ a b| ≤ κ * s) →
      (∀ c : Fin 2, u c = (∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ c b * z b) /
        (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A₀ i j * z i * z j)) →
      (∀ a : Fin 2, |p a - u a| ≤ C₀) →
      (∀ c a : Fin 2, |H c a + ∑ m : Fin 2, Γ m c a * p m -
        (A₀ c a / (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A₀ i j * z i * z j) - 2 * u c * u a)| ≤
          C₀ / Real.sqrt (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, A₀ i j * z i * z j)) →
      (∀ m c a : Fin 2, |Γ m c a| ≤ C₀) →
      0 < ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j ∧
      (∀ c : Fin 2, |(∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B a b * H c a * p b) +
          u c * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j| ≤
        K * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j) ∧
      |∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, B a c * B b d * H a b * H c d| ≤
        K * (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j) ^ 2 ∧
      (∀ c : Fin 2, |u c| ≤ K * ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, B i j * p i * p j)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have prod2 : ∀ x y X Y : ℝ, |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |x * y| ≤ X * Y := by
    intro x y X Y hx hy
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul hx hy (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hx)
  have prod3 : ∀ x y w X Y W : ℝ, |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |w| ≤ W → |x * y * w| ≤ X * Y * W :=
    fun x y w X Y W hx hy hw => prod2 _ _ _ _ (prod2 _ _ _ _ hx hy) hw
  have prod4 : ∀ x y w v X Y W V : ℝ, |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |w| ≤ W → |v| ≤ V →
      |x * y * w * v| ≤ X * Y * W * V :=
    fun x y w v X Y W V hx hy hw hv => prod2 _ _ _ _ (prod3 _ _ _ _ _ _ hx hy hw) hv
  have abs2 : ∀ x y X Y : ℝ, |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |x + y| ≤ X + Y := by
    intro x y X Y hx hy
    have h1 := abs_le.mp hx
    have h2 := abs_le.mp hy
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]
  have abs3 : ∀ x y w X Y W : ℝ, |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |w| ≤ W → |x + y + w| ≤ X + Y + W :=
    fun x y w X Y W hx hy hw => abs2 _ _ _ _ (abs2 _ _ _ _ hx hy) hw
  have sub2 : ∀ x y X Y : ℝ, |x| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |x - y| ≤ X + Y := by
    intro x y X Y hx hy
    have h1 := abs_le.mp hx
    have h2 := abs_le.mp hy
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]
  have tri : ∀ x y X Y : ℝ, |x - y| ≤ X → |y| ≤ Y → |x| ≤ X + Y := by
    intro x y X Y hx hy
    have h1 := abs_le.mp hx
    have h2 := abs_le.mp hy
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]
  have sum2 : ∀ (f : Fin 2 → ℝ) (X : ℝ), (∀ i, |f i| ≤ X) → |∑ i, f i| ≤ 2 * X := by
    intro f X hf
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have := abs2 _ _ _ _ (hf 0) (hf 1)
    linarith
  
  have hsym : A₀ 1 0 = A₀ 0 1 := by simpa using hA.1.apply 0 1
  have ha : 0 < A₀ 0 0 := hA.diag_pos
  have hc : 0 < A₀ 1 1 := hA.diag_pos
  have hD : 0 < A₀ 0 0 * A₀ 1 1 - A₀ 0 1 * A₀ 0 1 := by
    have h := hA.det_pos
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsym] at h
    exact h
  have hBA := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul A₀ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA.det_pos.ne')
  have e00 : A₀⁻¹ 0 0 * A₀ 0 0 + A₀⁻¹ 0 1 * A₀ 1 0 = 1 := by
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using congrFun (congrFun hBA 0) 0
  have e01 : A₀⁻¹ 0 0 * A₀ 0 1 + A₀⁻¹ 0 1 * A₀ 1 1 = 0 := by
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using congrFun (congrFun hBA 0) 1
  have e10 : A₀⁻¹ 1 0 * A₀ 0 0 + A₀⁻¹ 1 1 * A₀ 1 0 = 0 := by
    simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] using congrFun (congrFun hBA 1) 0
  have e11 : A₀⁻¹ 1 0 * A₀ 0 1 + A₀⁻¹ 1 1 * A₀ 1 1 = 1 := by

    have m2 : 28 * M ^ 4 * t ^ 2 ≤ 28 * M ^ 4 * (2 * M * G) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGt2 (by linarith)
    have m3 : 56 * M ^ 5 * G ≤ 1024 * M ^ 6 * G :=

    have f1 : M * t * (12 * M ^ 3 * t) = 12 * M ^ 4 * t ^ 2 := by ring
    have f2 : 28 * M ^ 4 * (2 * M * G) = 56 * M ^ 5 * G := by ring
    linarith
  · have h1 : (t ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ (2 * M * G) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ ht2p.le hGt2 2
    have h2 : 256 * M ^ 4 * (t ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 256 * M ^ 4 * (2 * M * G) ^ 2 :=

proof.tactics:
by
  have hKc : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ) := isCompact_closedBall x₀ ρ
  have hKv : Convex ℝ (Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ) := convex_closedBall x₀ ρ
  have hne : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have h1le : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by
    exact_mod_cast (le_top : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
  
  have hGc : ContinuousOn
      (fun y => fun a b : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a b) y)
      (Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ) := by
    refine continuousOn_pi.2 fun a => continuousOn_pi.2 fun b => ?_
    exact ((hinv a b).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW h1le).mono hsub
  obtain ⟨κ', hκ'⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hGc
  
  have hΓc : ContinuousOn
      (fun y => fun m c a : Fin 2 => christoffel2 h m c a y) (Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ) := by
    refine continuousOn_pi.2 fun m => continuousOn_pi.2 fun c => continuousOn_pi.2 fun a => ?_
    exact (hΓ m c a).continuousOn.mono hsub
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hΓc
  obtain ⟨MK, hMK⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hK.mono hsub)
  refine ⟨max κ' 0, max (max M MK) 0, le_max_right _ _, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨fun a b => ?_, fun m c a => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a b) y := fun y hy =>
      ((hinv a b).differentiableOn hne).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds (hsub hy))
    have hbd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ,
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a b) y‖ ≤ max κ' 0 := by
      intro y hy
      have h1 := hκ' y hy
      have h2 := norm_le_pi_norm (fun b : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a b) y) b
      have h3 := norm_le_pi_norm (fun a b : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a b) y) a
      exact le_trans h2 (le_trans h3 (le_trans h1 (le_max_left _ _)))
    have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ := le_trans dist_nonneg (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hx)
    have hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ
    have := hKv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff hbd hx₀ hx
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  · have h1 := hM x hx
    have h2 := norm_le_pi_norm (fun m c a : Fin 2 => christoffel2 h m c a x) m
    have h3 := norm_le_pi_norm (fun c a : Fin 2 => christoffel2 h m c a x) c
    have h4 := norm_le_pi_norm (fun a : Fin 2 => christoffel2 h m c a x) a
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h4
    exact le_trans h4 (le_trans h3 (le_trans h2 (le_trans h1
      (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _)))))
  · have h1 := hMK x hx
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact le_trans h1 (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_left _ _))

(A₀ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : A₀.PosDef) (x₀ : E2) :
    (∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ → 0 < ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c) ∧

      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c))) {x₀}ᶜ ∧
    ∀ x : E2, x ≠ x₀ → ∀ a c : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (fun y : E2 => Real.log (Real.sqrt
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c))) x =
        (∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ c b * (x - x₀) b) /

        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)))) x =
        A₀ c a / (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) c) -

            (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) c)) *

proof.tactics:
by
  have hsym : ∀ a c : Fin 2, A₀ a c = A₀ c a := fun a c => by
    have := hA.isHermitian.apply c a
    simpa using this
  
  have hpos : ∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ →
      0 < ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c := by
    intro y hy
    have hne : (fun i : Fin 2 => (y - x₀) i) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hy
      have h0 : y - x₀ = 0 := by
        ext i
        have := congrFun h i
        simpa using this
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0
    have h2 := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hne
    have h3 : star (fun i : Fin 2 => (y - x₀) i) ⬝ᵥ A₀.mulVec (fun i : Fin 2 => (y - x₀) i) =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial]
      ring
    linarith
  
  have hζ : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (y : E2), HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) i)
      (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) i : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y := by
    intro i y
    have h := (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 y i).sub_const (x₀ i)
    convert h using 1
  have hζc : ∀ i : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) i) := by
    intro i
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => y - x₀) := contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const
    first
      | exact (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) i : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp h1
      | exact (contDiff_piLp_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (p := 2) (i := i)).comp h1
      | fun_prop
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : E2 → ℝ,
      Q = fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ,
      N = fun a y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ a b * (y - x₀) b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hposQ : ∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ → 0 < Q y := by
    rw [hQ]; exact hpos
  have hQd : ∀ y : E2, HasFDerivAt Q
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ((A₀ a c * (y - x₀) a) •
        (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) c : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) +
        (y - x₀) c • (A₀ a c • (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) a : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)))) y := by
    intro y
    rw [hQ]
    have h := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun a _ => HasFDerivAt.sum
      (u := Finset.univ) (fun c _ => ((hζ a y).const_mul (A₀ a c)).mul (hζ c y)))
    convert h using 1
  have hNd : ∀ (a : Fin 2) (y : E2), HasFDerivAt (N a)
      (∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ a b • (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) b : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) y := by
    intro a y
    rw [hN]
    show HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => ∑ b : Fin 2, A₀ a b * (y - x₀) b) _ y
    have h := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun b _ => (hζ b y).const_mul (A₀ a b))
    convert h using 1
  have hQc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q := by
    rw [hQ]
    exact ContDiff.sum (fun a _ => ContDiff.sum (fun c _ =>
      (contDiff_const.mul (hζc a)).mul (hζc c)))
  have h10 := hsym 1 0
  have hQpd : ∀ (y : E2) (k : Fin 2), fderiv ℝ Q y (e2 k) = 2 * N k y := by
    intro y k
    rw [(hQd y).fderiv, hN]
    fin_cases k <;>
      simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
        h10] <;> ring
  have hNpd : ∀ (y : E2) (a k : Fin 2), fderiv ℝ (N a) y (e2 k) = A₀ a k := by
    intro y a k
    rw [(hNd a y).fderiv]
    fin_cases k <;>
      simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have hU : IsOpen ({x₀}ᶜ : Set E2) := isOpen_compl_singleton
  have hev : ∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ → (fun z => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q z))) =ᶠ[nhds y]
      (fun z => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (Q z)) := by
    intro y hy
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
    rw [Real.log_sqrt (hposQ z hz).le]
    ring
  have hsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y))) {x₀}ᶜ := by
    have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.log (Q y) / 2) {x₀}ᶜ :=
      (hQc.contDiffOn.log (fun y hy => (hposQ y hy).ne')).div_const 2
    refine hs.congr ?_
    intro y hy
    exact Real.log_sqrt (hposQ y hy).le
  have hd1 : ∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      pd2 k (fun y => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y))) y = N k y / Q y := by
    intro y hy k
    have hQ0 := (hposQ y hy).ne'
    have h := ((((hQd y).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt).log hQ0).const_mul
      (1 / 2 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hev y hy)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y))) y (e2 k) = _
    rw [h.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hQpd y k]
    field_simp
  have hd2 : ∀ x : E2, x ≠ x₀ → ∀ a c : Fin 2,
      pd2 c (pd2 a (fun y => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y)))) x =
        A₀ c a / Q x - 2 * (N c x / Q x) * (N a x / Q x) := by
    intro x hx a c
    have hev2 : pd2 a (fun y => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y))) =ᶠ[nhds x]
        fun y => N a y / Q y := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with z hz
      exact hd1 z hz a
    show fderiv ℝ (pd2 a (fun y => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y)))) x (e2 c) = _
    rw [hev2.fderiv_eq]
    have hQ0 := (hposQ x hx).ne'
    have hQx : HasFDerivAt Q (fderiv ℝ Q x) x := (hQd x).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
    have hNx : HasFDerivAt (N a) (fderiv ℝ (N a) x) x :=
      (hNd a x).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
    have hinv : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (Q y)⁻¹) ((-(Q x ^ 2)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ Q x) x :=
      (hasDerivAt_inv hQ0).comp_hasFDerivAt x hQx
    have hprod : HasFDerivAt (fun y => N a y / Q y)
        (N a x • ((-(Q x ^ 2)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ Q x) + (Q x)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (N a) x) x := by
      have := hNx.mul hinv
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using this
    rw [hprod.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hQpd x c, hNpd x a c, hsym a c]
    field_simp
    ring
  have key : (∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ → 0 < Q y) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y))) {x₀}ᶜ ∧
      ∀ x : E2, x ≠ x₀ → ∀ a c : Fin 2,
        pd2 c (fun y => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y))) x = N c x / Q x ∧
        pd2 c (pd2 a (fun y => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y)))) x =
          A₀ c a / Q x - 2 * (N c x / Q x) * (N a x / Q x) :=
    ⟨hposQ, hsmooth, fun x hx a c => ⟨hd1 x hx c, hd2 x hx a c⟩⟩
  subst hQ hN
  exact key

informal_problem.statement: (U : Set E3) (hU : IsOpen U) (G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hG : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) U) (hH : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => H x i j) U) (hGs : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i) (hHs : ∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), H x i j = H x j i) (hGpd : ∀ x ∈ U, (G x).PosDef) (hHpd : ∀ x ∈ U, (H x).PosDef) (f u : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u U) (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ U) : ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => Real.sqrt (H z).det * (f z * ∑ e : Fin 3, (H z)⁻¹ a e * partialDeriv e u z) - Real.sqrt (G z).det * (u z * ∑ e : Fin 3, (G z)⁻¹ a e * partialDeriv e f z)) y = f y * lapLoc H u y * Real.sqrt (H y).det - u y * lapLoc G f y * Real.sqrt (G y).det + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ((H y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (H y).det - (G y)⁻¹ i j * Real.sqrt (G y).det) * partialDeriv i f y * partialDeriv j u y
