proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have divform : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x i j) U) →
      (∀ (x : E3) (i j : Fin 3), G x i j = G x j i) →
      (∀ x ∈ U, (G x).PosDef) → ∀ (v : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v U → ∀ x ∈ U,
      (∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Real.sqrt (G y).det * (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b v y) x) ∧
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Real.sqrt (G y).det * (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b v y) x =
      Real.sqrt (G x).det * lapLoc G v x := by
    intro G hG hsymm hpos v hv x hx
    have hUx : U ∈ 𝓝 x := hU.mem_nhds hx
    have hdet : 0 < (G x).det := (hpos x hx).det_pos
    have hGd : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => G z a b) x := fun a b =>
      ((hG a b).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt hUx
    have hpd' : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (partialDeriv a v) x := by
      intro a
      have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ v x := hv.contDiffAt hUx
      have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fderiv ℝ v) x :=
        ((contDiffAt_infty.1 h1) 2).fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)
      have h3 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ v) x := h2.differentiableAt one_ne_zero
      exact h3.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (e a))
    have hsymI : ∀ a b : Fin 3, (G x)⁻¹ a b = (G x)⁻¹ b a := by
      have hS : (G x).IsSymm := Matrix.IsSymm.ext (fun i j => hsymm x j i)
      have hSi := hS.inv
      intro a b
      exact hSi.apply b a
    have inv_entry : ∀ (m : Fin 3) (k l : Fin 3),
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x ∧
          partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x =
            -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
              (G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l := by
      intro m
      have hdet0 : (G x).det ≠ 0 := hdet.ne'
      have hdetD : ∀ H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ,
          (∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => H y a b) x) →
          DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (H y).det) x := by
        intro H hH
        have hfun : (fun y => (H y).det) = fun y =>
            H y 0 0 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 2 - H y 0 0 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 1
            - H y 0 1 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 2 + H y 0 1 * H y 1 2 * H y 2 0
            + H y 0 2 * H y 1 0 * H y 2 1 - H y 0 2 * H y 1 1 * H y 2 0 := by
          funext y; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (H y)
        rw [hfun]
        have h00 := hH 0 0
        have h01 := hH 0 1
        have h02 := hH 0 2
        have h10 := hH 1 0
        have h11 := hH 1 1
        have h12 := hH 1 2
        have h20 := hH 2 0
        have h21 := hH 2 1
        have h22 := hH 2 2
        fun_prop
      have hD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y).det) x := hdetD G hGd
      have hP : ∀ k l : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) x := by
        intro k l
        have hfun : (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ k l) =
            fun y => ((G y).det)⁻¹ * ((G y).updateRow l (Pi.single k 1)).det := by
          funext y
          rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.adjugate_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv,
            smul_eq_mul]
        rw [hfun]
        refine (hD.inv hdet0).mul (hdetD _ ?_)
        intro a b
        by_cases hal : a = l
        · subst hal
          simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
          exact differentiableAt_const _
        · simp only [Matrix.updateRow_ne hal]
          exact hGd a b
      have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (G y).det ≠ 0 := hD.continuousAt.eventually_ne hdet0
      have hE : ∀ a l : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, G x a b * partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
          + ∑ b : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l = 0 := by
        intro a l
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
            (∑ b : Fin 3, (G x a b • fderiv ℝ (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
              + (G x)⁻¹ b l • fderiv ℝ (fun y => G y a b) x)) x := by
          have hs := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
            (A := fun b y => G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
            (fun b _ => (hGd a b).hasFDerivAt.mul (hP b l).hasFDerivAt)
          convert hs using 1
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, G y a b * (G y)⁻¹ b l)
            (0 : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
          apply (hasFDerivAt_const (if a = l then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq
          filter_upwards [hev] with y hy
          have := congrFun (congrFun (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (G y) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hy)) a) l
          rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
          exact this
        have h3 := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (e m)) (h1.unique h2)
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply] at h3
        unfold partialDeriv
        rw [← h3, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro b _
        ring
      intro k l
      refine ⟨hP k l, ?_⟩
      let Xm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
        Matrix.of fun b l => partialDeriv m (fun y => (G y)⁻¹ b l) x
      let Dm : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
        Matrix.of fun a b => partialDeriv m (fun y => G y a b) x
      have hM : G x * Xm = -(Dm * (G x)⁻¹) := by
        ext a l'
        rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
        simp only [Xm, Dm, Matrix.of_apply]
        exact hE a l'
      have hX : Xm = -((G x)⁻¹ * (Dm * (G x)⁻¹)) := by
        calc Xm = ((G x)⁻¹ * G x) * Xm := by
              rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet0), Matrix.one_mul]
          _ = (G x)⁻¹ * (G x * Xm) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
          _ = _ := by rw [hM, Matrix.mul_neg]
      have hkl := congrFun (congrFun hX k) l
      simp only [Xm, Dm, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.neg_apply, Matrix.mul_apply] at hkl
      rw [hkl]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro b _
      ring
    have hs1 : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) x ∧
        partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) x = Real.sqrt (G x).det / 2 *
          ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (G x)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv i (fun z => G z a b) x := by
      intro i
      have hfun : (fun z => (G z).det) = fun z =>
          G z 0 0 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 2 - G z 0 0 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 1
            - G z 0 1 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 2 + G z 0 1 * G z 1 2 * G z 2 0
            + G z 0 2 * G z 1 0 * G z 2 1 - G z 0 2 * G z 1 1 * G z 2 0 := by
        funext z; exact Matrix.det_fin_three (G z)
      have h00 := (hGd 0 0).hasFDerivAt
      have h01 := (hGd 0 1).hasFDerivAt
      have h02 := (hGd 0 2).hasFDerivAt
      have h10 := (hGd 1 0).hasFDerivAt
      have h11 := (hGd 1 1).hasFDerivAt
      have h12 := (hGd 1 2).hasFDerivAt
      have h20 := (hGd 2 0).hasFDerivAt
      have h21 := (hGd 2 1).hasFDerivAt
      have h22 := (hGd 2 2).hasFDerivAt
      have hD := (((((((h00.mul h11).mul h22).sub ((h00.mul h12).mul h21)).sub
        ((h01.mul h10).mul h22)).add ((h01.mul h12).mul h20)).add
        ((h02.mul h10).mul h21)).sub ((h02.mul h11).mul h20))
      have hD' : HasFDerivAt (fun z => (G z).det) _ x :=
        hD.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => congrFun hfun z)
      have hS := hD'.sqrt hdet.ne'
      refine ⟨hS.differentiableAt, ?_⟩
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [hS.fderiv]
      have hinv : ∀ a b, (G x)⁻¹ a b = ((G x).det)⁻¹ * (G x).adjugate a b := by
        intro a b
        rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [hinv]
      have hs2 : Real.sqrt (G x).det * Real.sqrt (G x).det = (G x).det :=
        Real.mul_self_sqrt hdet.le
      have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt (G x).det := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hdet
      have hfac : 1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (G x).det) = Real.sqrt (G x).det / 2 * ((G x).det)⁻¹ := by
        have aux : ∀ s d : ℝ, 0 < s → s * s = d → 1 / (2 * s) = s / 2 * d⁻¹ := by
          intro s d hs h
          subst h
          field_simp
        exact aux _ _ hspos hs2
      rw [hfac]
      set d := (G x).det with hd
      have f10 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 1 0) x = fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 0 1) x := by
        congr 1; funext z; exact hsymm z 1 0
      have f20 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 2 0) x = fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 0 2) x := by
        congr 1; funext z; exact hsymm z 2 0
      have f21 : fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 2 1) x = fderiv ℝ (fun z => G z 1 2) x := by
        congr 1; funext z; exact hsymm z 2 1
      have e10 := hsymm x 1 0
      have e20 := hsymm x 2 0
      have e21 := hsymm x 2 1
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three,
        Matrix.adjugate_fin_three, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.empty_val',
        Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons, Matrix.head_fin_const, f10, f20, f21, e10, e20, e21]
      ring
    have hdS : ∀ i : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) x =
        Real.sqrt (G x).det / 2 * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G x)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv i (fun z => G z a b) x := fun i => (hs1 i).2
    have hdGi : ∀ m k l : Fin 3, partialDeriv m (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ k l) x =
        -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          (G x)⁻¹ k a * partialDeriv m (fun z => G z a b) x * (G x)⁻¹ b l :=
      fun m k l => (inv_entry m k l).2
    have hs : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) x := (hs1 0).1
    have hGi : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) x :=
      fun a b => (inv_entry 0 a b).1
    have pd_mul : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (u w : E3 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ u x →
        DifferentiableAt ℝ w x →
        partialDeriv i (fun z => u z * w z) x =
          partialDeriv i u x * w x + u x * partialDeriv i w x := by
      intro i u w hu hw
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [fderiv_fun_mul hu hw]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have pd_sum : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (u : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ), (∀ k, DifferentiableAt ℝ (u k) x) →
        partialDeriv i (fun z => ∑ k : Fin 3, u k z) x = ∑ k : Fin 3, partialDeriv i (u k) x := by
      intro i u hu
      unfold partialDeriv
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun k _ => hu k)]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
    have hmg : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (G z)⁻¹ a b) x :=
      fun a b => hs.mul (hGi a b)
    have hT : ∀ a b : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b v z) x :=
      fun a b => (hmg a b).mul (hpd' b)
    have hexp : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Real.sqrt (G y).det * (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b v y) x =
        ∑ b : Fin 3, ((partialDeriv a (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det) x * (G x)⁻¹ a b +
            Real.sqrt (G x).det * partialDeriv a (fun z => (G z)⁻¹ a b) x) * partialDeriv b v x +
          Real.sqrt (G x).det * (G x)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv a (partialDeriv b v) x) := by
      intro a
      rw [pd_sum a (fun b z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b v z) (hT a)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
      rw [pd_mul a _ (partialDeriv b v) (hmg a b) (hpd' b), pd_mul a _ _ hs (hGi a b)]
    refine ⟨fun a => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hsum := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ)
        (A := fun b z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b v z)
        (fun b _ => (hT a b).hasFDerivAt)
      exact hsum.differentiableAt
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hexp a)]
    simp only [hdS, hdGi]
    unfold lapLoc hessLoc christoffel
    have e10 := hsymI 1 0
    have e20 := hsymI 2 0
    have e21 := hsymI 2 1
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, e10, e20, e21]
    ring
  
  have hy' : U ∈ 𝓝 y := hU.mem_nhds hy
  obtain ⟨dA, hdA⟩ := divform H hH hHs hHpd u hu y hy
  obtain ⟨dB, hdB⟩ := divform G hG hGs hGpd f hf y hy
  have df : DifferentiableAt ℝ f y := (hf.contDiffAt hy').differentiableAt (by simp)
  have du : DifferentiableAt ℝ u y := (hu.contDiffAt hy').differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have leib : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (p q r s : E3 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ p y →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ q y → DifferentiableAt ℝ r y → DifferentiableAt ℝ s y →
      partialDeriv i (fun z => p z * q z - r z * s z) y =
        p y * partialDeriv i q y + q y * partialDeriv i p y -
          (r y * partialDeriv i s y + s y * partialDeriv i r y) := by
    intro i p q r s hp hq hr hs
    have hpq : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => p z * q z) y := hp.mul hq
    have hrs : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => r z * s z) y := hr.mul hs
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub hpq hrs, fderiv_fun_mul hp hq, fderiv_fun_mul hr hs]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  
  have hfun : ∀ a : Fin 3, (fun z => Real.sqrt (H z).det * (f z * ∑ e : Fin 3,
      (H z)⁻¹ a e * partialDeriv e u z) - Real.sqrt (G z).det * (u z * ∑ e : Fin 3,
      (G z)⁻¹ a e * partialDeriv e f z)) = fun z => f z * (∑ b : Fin 3,
      Real.sqrt (H z).det * (H z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b u z) - u z * (∑ b : Fin 3,
      Real.sqrt (G z).det * (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b f z) := by
    intro a
    funext z
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hLHS : ∀ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => Real.sqrt (H z).det * (f z * ∑ e : Fin 3,
      (H z)⁻¹ a e * partialDeriv e u z) - Real.sqrt (G z).det * (u z * ∑ e : Fin 3,
      (G z)⁻¹ a e * partialDeriv e f z)) y =
      f y * partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Real.sqrt (H z).det * (H z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b u z) y +
      (∑ b : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (H y).det * (H y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b u y) *
        partialDeriv a f y -
      (u y * partialDeriv a (fun z => ∑ b : Fin 3,
        Real.sqrt (G z).det * (G z)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b f z) y +
      (∑ b : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (G y).det * (G y)⁻¹ a b * partialDeriv b f y) *
        partialDeriv a u y) := by
    intro a
    rw [hfun a]
    exact leib a f _ u _ df (dA a) du (dB a)
  
  have hGinv : ∀ a b : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ a b = (G y)⁻¹ b a := by
    have hS : (G y).IsSymm := Matrix.IsSymm.ext (fun i j => hGs y j i)
    intro a b
    exact hS.inv.apply b a
  
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => hLHS a), Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hdA, hdB]
  
  have g10 := hGinv 1 0
  have g20 := hGinv 2 0
  have g21 := hGinv 2 1
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, g10, g20, g21]
  ring

informal_problem.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (c : ℝ) (y : E3) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hX : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z a) y) : sepDensDiv G (fun z => (1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) • X z) y = (1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)) * sepDensDiv G X y - deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) * ∑ a : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y a * (y a / ‖y‖)

signature.name: shell_cutoff_densDiv
signature.statement: (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X : E3 → E3) (c : ℝ) (y : E3) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hX : ∀ a : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z a) y) : sepDensDiv G (fun z => (1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) • X z) y = (1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)) * sepDensDiv G X y - deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) * ∑ a : Fin 3, Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y a * (y a / ‖y‖)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hn : 0 < ‖y‖ := norm_pos_iff.2 hy
  have hsq : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ ^ 2) (2 • innerSL ℝ y) y :=
    (hasStrictFDerivAt_norm_sq y).hasFDerivAt
  have hsq' : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => Real.sqrt (‖z‖ ^ 2))
      ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (‖y‖ ^ 2))) • (2 • innerSL ℝ y)) y :=
    hsq.sqrt (by positivity)
  have hnorm : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => ‖z‖)
      ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (‖y‖ ^ 2))) • (2 • innerSL ℝ y)) y := by
    have hf : (fun z : E3 => Real.sqrt (‖z‖ ^ 2)) = fun z => ‖z‖ := by
      funext z; exact Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg z)
    rwa [hf] at hsq'
  have hT : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)) (‖y‖ - c) :=
    ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable one_ne_zero _).hasDerivAt
  have hs : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E3 => 1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c))
      (-(deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) •
        ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (‖y‖ ^ 2))) • (2 • innerSL ℝ y)))) y :=
    by
      have hc : HasFDerivAt (Real.smoothTransition ∘ fun z : E3 => ‖z‖ - c)
          (deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) •
            ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (‖y‖ ^ 2))) • (2 • innerSL ℝ y))) y :=
        hT.comp_hasFDerivAt y (hnorm.sub_const c)
      exact hc.const_sub 1
  have hsa : ∀ a : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun z : E3 => 1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) y (e a) =
      -(deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) * (y a / ‖y‖)) := by
    intro a
    rw [hs.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, innerSL_apply_apply,
      e, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg y)]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, one_mul, conj_trivial]
    field_simp
  have hfun : ∀ a : Fin 3,
      (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * ((1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) • X z) a) =
        fun z => (1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) * (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z a) := by
    intro a; funext z; simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  have hprod : ∀ a : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (fun z => (1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) *
        (Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z a)) y =
      (1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)) * partialDeriv a (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z a) y +
        Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y a *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z : E3 => 1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) y (e a) := by
    intro a
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hs.differentiableAt (hX a)]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have key : ∀ a : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * ((1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) • X z) a) y =
      (1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c)) * partialDeriv a (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z a) y -
        deriv Real.smoothTransition (‖y‖ - c) * (Real.sqrt (G y).det * X y a * (y a / ‖y‖)) := by
    intro a
    rw [hfun a, hprod a, hsa a]
    ring
  have h1 : sepDensDiv G (fun z => (1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) • X z) y =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * ((1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) • X z) a) y := rfl
  have h2 : sepDensDiv G X y =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z a) y := rfl
  rw [h1, h2]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  rw [key 0, key 1, key 2]
  ring

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [SigmaCompactSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Y : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (C : Set M) (hC : IsCompact C)
    (hYC : ∀ p : M, p ∉ C → Y p = 0)
    (P₀ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (K₀ : Set E3) (hK₀ : IsCompact K₀)
    (hK₀P : K₀ ⊆ P₀.source) (Yt₀ : E3 → E3) (hYt₀s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt₀ P₀.source)
    (hYt₀ : ∀ x ∈ P₀.source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) P₀ x (Yt₀ x) = Y (P₀ x))
    {m : ℕ} (P : Fin m → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (Kp : Fin m → Set E3)
    (hKp : ∀ k, IsCompact (Kp k)) (hKpP : ∀ k, Kp k ⊆ (P k).source)
    (hdisj₀ : ∀ k, Disjoint (P₀ '' K₀) ((P k) '' Kp k))
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun k l => Disjoint ((P k) '' Kp k) ((P l) '' Kp l))
    (Yt : Fin m → E3 → E3) (hYts : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Yt k) (P k).source)
    (hYt : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ (P k).source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (P k) x (Yt k x) = Y (P k x))
    (hdiv : ∀ p : M, p ∉ P₀ '' K₀ → (∀ k, p ∉ (P k) '' Kp k) →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 p p) = 0) :
    (∫ y in K₀, sepDensDiv (g.coeff P₀) Yt₀ y) +
      ∑ k, ∫ y in Kp k, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (P k)) (Yt k) y = 0

signature.name: manifold_div_chart_sum
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [SigmaCompactSpace M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Y : M → E3) (hY : calSmoothField Y) (C : Set M) (hC : IsCompact C)
    (hYC : ∀ p : M, p ∉ C → Y p = 0)
    (P₀ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (K₀ : Set E3) (hK₀ : IsCompact K₀)
    (hK₀P : K₀ ⊆ P₀.source) (Yt₀ : E3 → E3) (hYt₀s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt₀ P₀.source)
    (hYt₀ : ∀ x ∈ P₀.source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) P₀ x (Yt₀ x) = Y (P₀ x))
    {m : ℕ} (P : Fin m → PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (Kp : Fin m → Set E3)
    (hKp : ∀ k, IsCompact (Kp k)) (hKpP : ∀ k, Kp k ⊆ (P k).source)
    (hdisj₀ : ∀ k, Disjoint (P₀ '' K₀) ((P k) '' Kp k))
    (hdisj : Pairwise fun k l => Disjoint ((P k) '' Kp k) ((P l) '' Kp l))
    (Yt : Fin m → E3 → E3) (hYts : ∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Yt k) (P k).source)
    (hYt : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ (P k).source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (P k) x (Yt k x) = Y (P k x))
    (hdiv : ∀ p : M, p ∉ P₀ '' K₀ → (∀ k, p ∉ (P k) '' Kp k) →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
        (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 p p) = 0) :
    (∫ y in K₀, sepDensDiv (g.coeff P₀) Yt₀ y) +
      ∑ k, ∫ y in Kp k, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (P k)) (Yt k) y = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have germ : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (X X' : E3 → E3) (y : E3),
      X =ᶠ[𝓝 y] X' → sepDensDiv G X y = sepDensDiv G X' y := by
    intro G X X' y h
    unfold sepDensDiv partialDeriv
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X z i) =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * X' z i) := by
      filter_upwards [h] with z hz
      rw [hz]
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  
  have hlin : ∀ (L : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : E3), ∑ i : Fin 3, L (e i) * v i = L v := by
    intro L v
    conv_rhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr v]
    simp [e, map_sum, map_smul, mul_comm]
  
  have hRepd : ∀ (p : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target → ∀ i : Fin 3,
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det *
        (show E3 from mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) i) y := by
    intro p y hy i
    have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm z).det)
        (chartAt E3 p).target :=
      ccs_sqrtdet_smooth _ _ (g.smooth p) (fun z hz => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p z hz).det_pos)
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (show E3 from mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p)
        ((chartAt E3 p).symm z) (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm z))) i) (chartAt E3 p).target := by
      have := (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (ι := Fin 3) i).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hY p)
      exact this
    exact ((hsq.mul h2).contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt
      (by simp)
  
  have htr : ∀ q₀ x : M, x ∈ (chartAt E3 q₀).source →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm)
        (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x) ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 x x) = 0 →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q₀).symm)
        (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q₀) ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm y)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 q₀ x) = 0 := by
    intro q₀ x hx h0
    have hUo : IsOpen ((chartAt E3 q₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q₀).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x).source) :=
      (chartAt E3 q₀).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm (chartAt E3 x).open_source
    have hyU : chartAt E3 q₀ x ∈
        (chartAt E3 q₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q₀).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x).source := by
      refine ⟨(chartAt E3 q₀).map_source hx, ?_⟩
      show (chartAt E3 q₀).symm (chartAt E3 q₀ x) ∈ (chartAt E3 x).source
      rw [(chartAt E3 q₀).left_inv hx]
      exact mem_chart_source E3 x
    have hτs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z))
        ((chartAt E3 q₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q₀).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x).source) := by
      have h1 : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞
          ((chartAt E3 x : M → E3) ∘ ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm : E3 → M))
          ((chartAt E3 q₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q₀).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x).source) :=
        (contMDiffOn_chart (x := x)).comp
          ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (x := q₀)).mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun z hz => hz.2)
      exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
    have hlaw : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 q₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q₀).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x).source,
        ∀ i j : Fin 3, g.coeff (chartAt E3 q₀).symm z i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)) z (e i) a *
            g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)) a b *
            fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)) z (e j) b :=
      fun z hz => (sep_chart_transition g q₀ x z hz.1 hz.2).2.1
    have hpos : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 q₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q₀).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x).source,
        0 ≤ (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z))).det :=
      fun z hz => (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g x _ ((chartAt E3 x).map_source hz.2)).det_pos.le
    have hvec : ∀ z ∈ (chartAt E3 q₀).target ∩ (chartAt E3 q₀).symm ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 x).source,
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)) z
          ((fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q₀) ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm y)
            (Y ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm y)) : E3)) z) =
        (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x) ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)
          (Y ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)) := by
      intro z hz
      have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm w)) z =
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x) ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)).comp
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q₀).symm z) := by
        rw [← mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
        exact mfderiv_comp z (mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 x) hz.2)
          (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 q₀) hz.1)
      have hY1 : mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q₀).symm z
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q₀) ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)
            (Y ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z))) = Y ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z) := by
        have hw : (chartAt E3 q₀).symm z ∈ (chartAt E3 q₀).source :=
          (chartAt E3 q₀).map_target hz.1
        have hid := (mdifferentiable_chart (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) q₀).symm_comp_deriv hw
        rw [(chartAt E3 q₀).right_inv hz.1] at hid
        exact congrArg (fun L => L (Y ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z))) hid
      have hl : (chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)) =
          (chartAt E3 q₀).symm z := (chartAt E3 x).left_inv hz.2
      show fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)) z
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q₀) ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)
            (Y ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z))) =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x)
          ((chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)))
          (Y ((chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z))))
      rw [hfd]
      exact (congrArg (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x) ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)) hY1).trans
        (congrArg (fun p : M => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x) p (Y p) : E3)) hl.symm)
    have hτx : chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm (chartAt E3 q₀ x)) ∈ (chartAt E3 x).target :=
      (chartAt E3 x).map_source hyU.2
    have hdet : (fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z))
        (chartAt E3 q₀ x)).det ≠ 0 := by
      have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z))
          (chartAt E3 q₀ x) := (sep_chart_transition g q₀ x _ hyU.1 hyU.2).1
      have hσm : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3)
          (fun w => chartAt E3 q₀ ((chartAt E3 x).symm w))
          (chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm (chartAt E3 q₀ x))) := by
        have h1 : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q₀)
            ((chartAt E3 x).symm (chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm (chartAt E3 q₀ x)))) := by
          rw [(chartAt E3 x).left_inv hyU.2]
          exact mdifferentiableAt_atlas (chart_mem_atlas E3 q₀) ((chartAt E3 q₀).map_target hyU.1)
        exact h1.comp _ (mdifferentiableAt_atlas_symm (chart_mem_atlas E3 x) hτx)
      have hσ := mdifferentiableAt_iff_differentiableAt.mp hσm
      have hev : (fun w => chartAt E3 q₀ ((chartAt E3 x).symm w)) ∘
          (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 q₀ x)] id := by
        filter_upwards [hUo.mem_nhds hyU] with z hz
        simp only [Function.comp_apply, id, (chartAt E3 x).left_inv hz.2]
        exact (chartAt E3 q₀).right_inv hz.1
      have hcomp : (fderiv ℝ (fun w => chartAt E3 q₀ ((chartAt E3 x).symm w))
          (chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm (chartAt E3 q₀ x)))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm z)) (chartAt E3 q₀ x)) =
            ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 := by
        rw [← fderiv_comp (chartAt E3 q₀ x) hσ hτd, hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id]
      have hd := congrArg (fun L : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => LinearMap.det (L : E3 →ₗ[ℝ] E3)) hcomp
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, LinearMap.det_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id,
        LinearMap.det_id] at hd
      exact right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hd
    have key := sepDensDiv_transition_pointwise _ hUo _ hτs (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q₀).symm)
      (g.coeff (chartAt E3 x).symm)
      (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q₀) ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm y)
        (Y ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm y)) : E3))
      (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 x) ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)
        (Y ((chartAt E3 x).symm y)) : E3))
      hlaw hpos hvec (chartAt E3 q₀ x) hyU hdet (hRepd x _ hτx)
    have hτy : chartAt E3 x ((chartAt E3 q₀).symm (chartAt E3 q₀ x)) = chartAt E3 x x := by
      rw [(chartAt E3 q₀).left_inv hx]
    rw [key, hτy, h0, mul_zero]
  
  have hS₀c : IsCompact (P₀ '' K₀) :=
    hK₀.image_of_continuousOn (P₀.contMDiffOn.continuousOn.mono hK₀P)
  have hSkc : ∀ k, IsCompact ((P k) '' Kp k) := fun k =>
    (hKp k).image_of_continuousOn ((P k).contMDiffOn.continuousOn.mono (hKpP k))
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : Set M, S = P₀ '' K₀ ∪ ⋃ k, (P k) '' Kp k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS0S : P₀ '' K₀ ⊆ S := by
    intro x hx; rw [hSdef]; exact Or.inl hx
  have hSkS : ∀ k, (P k) '' Kp k ⊆ S := by
    intro k x hx; rw [hSdef]; exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨k, hx⟩)
  have hSc : IsCompact S := by rw [hSdef]; exact hS₀c.union (isCompact_iUnion hSkc)
  have hScl : IsClosed S := hSc.isClosed
  
  have hP0 : calPartition (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → M) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → M → ℝ) Set.univ := by
    unfold calPartition
    exact ⟨fun j => j.elim0, fun j => j.elim0, fun x => by simp, fun j => j.elim0⟩
  obtain ⟨n, q, φ, O, hφ, hO, hCSO, h1, -⟩ := calPartition_extend g Set.univ isOpen_univ
    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → M) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → M → ℝ) hP0 ∅ isOpen_empty
    (fun x hx => by simp at hx) (C ∪ S) (hC.union hSc) (Set.subset_univ _)
  have hCO : C ⊆ O := fun x hx => hCSO (Or.inl (Or.inl hx))
  have hSO : S ⊆ O := fun x hx => hCSO (Or.inl (Or.inr hx))
  have hφ' := hφ
  obtain ⟨hφsm, -, -, hφt⟩ := hφ'
  have hφc : ∀ j, IsCompact (tsupport (φ j)) := fun j => (hφt j).1
  have hφsrc : ∀ j, tsupport (φ j) ⊆ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source :=
    fun j x hx => ((hφt j).2 hx).2
  
  have hZfr : ∀ x ∈ frontier O, ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Y x' = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hO.frontier_eq] at hx
    have hxC : x ∉ C := fun h => hx.2 (hCO h)
    filter_upwards [hC.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxC] with x' hx'
    exact hYC x' hx'
  have hOzero : calDivSum g q φ O Y = 0 := by
    unfold calDivSum
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ =>
      (chart_flux_zero_of_vanishing g O hO Y hY hZfr (q j) (φ j) (hφsm j) (hφc j) (hφsrc j)).1
  
  have hmeasO : ∀ U : Set M, IsOpen U → sepChartMeas U := by
    intro U hU p
    have h : chartAt E3 p '' (U ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =
        (chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' U := by
      rw [Set.inter_comm]; exact (chartAt E3 p).image_source_inter_eq' U
    rw [h]
    exact ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hU).measurableSet
  have hmeasC : ∀ F : Set M, IsClosed F → sepChartMeas F := by
    intro F hF p
    have h : chartAt E3 p '' (F ∩ (chartAt E3 p).source) =
        (chartAt E3 p).target \ ((chartAt E3 p).target ∩ (chartAt E3 p).symm ⁻¹' Fᶜ) := by
      rw [Set.inter_comm, (chartAt E3 p).image_source_inter_eq']
      ext y
      simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_compl_iff]
      tauto
    rw [h]
    exact (chartAt E3 p).open_target.measurableSet.diff
      ((chartAt E3 p).isOpen_inter_preimage_symm hF.isOpen_compl).measurableSet
  
  have hadd : ∀ {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (E : ι → Set M), (∀ i, sepChartMeas (E i)) →
      Pairwise (fun i k => Disjoint (E i) (E k)) →
      calDivSum g q φ (⋃ i, E i) Y = ∑ i, calDivSum g q φ (E i) Y := by
    intro ι _ E hE hd
    unfold calDivSum
    conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [Set.iUnion_inter, Set.image_iUnion]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_iUnion_fintype (fun i => hE i (q j)) ?_
      (fun i => (calPiece_regular g (q j) (φ j) (hφsm j) (hφc j) (hφsrc j) Y hY).2.integrableOn)
    intro i k hik
    rw [Function.onFun, Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro _ ⟨a, ⟨haE, has⟩, rfl⟩ ⟨b, ⟨hbE, hbs⟩, hab⟩
    have hba : b = a := (chartAt E3 (q j)).injOn hbs has hab
    subst hba
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hd hik) haE hbE
  
  have hpt : ∀ j x, x ∉ S → x ∈ (chartAt E3 (q j)).source →
      sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm) (calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y) (chartAt E3 (q j) x) =
        Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 (q j)).symm (chartAt E3 (q j) x)).det *
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) (chartAt E3 (q j) x)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j))
              ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm (chartAt E3 (q j) x))
              (Y ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm (chartAt E3 (q j) x))) : E3) := by
    intro j x hxS hxs
    have hyt : chartAt E3 (q j) x ∈ (chartAt E3 (q j)).target := (chartAt E3 (q j)).map_source hxs
    have hloc : calPiece (q j) (φ j) Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 (q j) x)]
        fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z) •
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (q j)) ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)
            (Y ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) : E3) := by
      filter_upwards [(chartAt E3 (q j)).open_target.mem_nhds hyt] with z hz
      unfold calPiece
      rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
    have hs : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) (chartAt E3 (q j) x) := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => φ j ((chartAt E3 (q j)).symm z)) (chartAt E3 (q j)).target :=
        contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp ((hφsm j).comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
      exact (h1.contDiffAt ((chartAt E3 (q j)).open_target.mem_nhds hyt)).differentiableAt
        (by simp)
    have h0 := htr (q j) x hxs (hdiv x (fun h => hxS (hS0S h)) (fun k h => hxS (hSkS k h)))
    rw [germ _ _ _ _ hloc, sepDensDiv_smul_eq _ _ _ _ hs (hRepd (q j) _ hyt), h0, mul_zero,
      zero_add]
    congr 1
    simp only [partialDeriv]
    exact hlin _ _
  
  have hRm : sepChartMeas (O \ S) := hmeasO _ (hO.sdiff hScl)
  have hrem : calDivSum g q φ (O \ S) Y = 0 := by
    have hcanc := cal_partition_div_cancel g Set.univ q φ hφ O hO h1 Y hY (O \ S) hRm
      Set.diff_subset
    unfold calDivSum
    refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_).trans hcanc
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (hRm (q j)) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨hxR, hxs⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hpt j x hxR.2 hxs
  
  have hpiece0 : calDivSum g q φ (P₀ '' K₀) Y = ∫ y in K₀, sepDensDiv (g.coeff P₀) Yt₀ y :=
    calDivSum_chart_transfer g Set.univ q φ hφ O hO h1 Y hY (P₀ '' K₀) (hmeasC _ hS₀c.isClosed)
      P₀ K₀ hK₀ hK₀P (Set.Subset.refl _) (hS0S.trans hSO) (fun x hx hx' => absurd hx hx')
      Yt₀ hYt₀s hYt₀
  have hpiecek : ∀ k, calDivSum g q φ ((P k) '' Kp k) Y =
      ∫ y in Kp k, sepDensDiv (g.coeff (P k)) (Yt k) y := fun k =>
    calDivSum_chart_transfer g Set.univ q φ hφ O hO h1 Y hY _ (hmeasC _ (hSkc k).isClosed)
      (P k) (Kp k) (hKp k) (hKpP k) (Set.Subset.refl _) ((hSkS k).trans hSO)
      (fun x hx hx' => absurd hx hx') (Yt k) (hYts k) (hYt k)
  
  obtain ⟨Ef, hEf⟩ : ∃ Ef : Option (Option (Fin m)) → Set M, Ef = fun i =>
      Option.elim i (O \ S) (fun o => Option.elim o (P₀ '' K₀) (fun k => (P k) '' Kp k)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hE0 : Ef none = O \ S := by subst hEf; rfl
  have hE1 : Ef (some none) = P₀ '' K₀ := by subst hEf; rfl
  have hE2 : ∀ k, Ef (some (some k)) = (P k) '' Kp k := by intro k; subst hEf; rfl
  have hUnion : (⋃ i, Ef i) = O := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      rcases i with _ | _ | k
      · rw [hE0] at hi; exact hi.1
      · rw [hE1] at hi; exact hSO (hS0S hi)
      · rw [hE2] at hi; exact hSO (hSkS k hi)
    · intro hx
      by_cases hxS : x ∈ S
      · have hxS' := hxS
        rw [hSdef] at hxS'
        rcases hxS' with h | h
        · exact ⟨some none, by rw [hE1]; exact h⟩
        · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 h
          exact ⟨some (some k), by rw [hE2]; exact hk⟩
      · exact ⟨none, by rw [hE0]; exact ⟨hx, hxS⟩⟩
  have hEm : ∀ i, sepChartMeas (Ef i) := by
    intro i
    rcases i with _ | _ | k
    · rw [hE0]; exact hRm
    · rw [hE1]; exact hmeasC _ hS₀c.isClosed
    · rw [hE2]; exact hmeasC _ (hSkc k).isClosed
  have hEd : Pairwise (fun i k => Disjoint (Ef i) (Ef k)) := by
    intro i k hik
    rcases i with _ | _ | i
    · rcases k with _ | _ | k
      · exact absurd rfl hik
      · rw [hE0, hE1]; exact Set.disjoint_sdiff_left.mono_right hS0S
      · rw [hE0, hE2]; exact Set.disjoint_sdiff_left.mono_right (hSkS k)
    · rcases k with _ | _ | k
      · rw [hE0, hE1]; exact (Set.disjoint_sdiff_left.mono_right hS0S).symm
      · exact absurd rfl hik
      · rw [hE1, hE2]; exact hdisj₀ k
    · rcases k with _ | _ | k
      · rw [hE0, hE2]; exact (Set.disjoint_sdiff_left.mono_right (hSkS i)).symm
      · rw [hE1, hE2]; exact (hdisj₀ i).symm
      · rw [hE2, hE2]
        exact hdisj (fun h => hik (by rw [h]))
  have hsplit := hadd Ef hEm hEd
  rw [hUnion, hOzero, Fintype.sum_option, Fintype.sum_option, hE0, hE1, hrem, hpiece0] at hsplit
  simp only [hE2, hpiecek] at hsplit
  linarith

subgoal_signatures.statement: [T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (E : Set M) (hE : IsOpen E) (Z : M → E3) (hZ : calSmoothField Z) (hZfr : ∀ x ∈ frontier E, ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Z x' = 0) (q : M) (ψ : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hψc : IsCompact (tsupport ψ)) (hψs : tsupport ψ ⊆ (chartAt E3 q).source) : ∫ y in chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source), sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q ψ Z) y = 0 ∧ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y).det * fderiv ℝ (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)) : E3)) (chartAt E3 q '' (E ∩ (chartAt E3 q).source)) ∧ MeasureTheory.Integrable (sepDensDiv (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm) (calPiece q ψ Z))

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (s : E3 → ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3)
    (y : E3) (hs : DifferentiableAt ℝ s y)
    (hF : ∀ i : Fin 3, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (G z).det * Y z i) y) :

(O : Set E3) (hO : IsOpen O) (τ : E3 → E3)
    (hτ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ τ O) (G₁ G₂ : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (P₁ P₂ : E3 → E3)
    (hlaw : ∀ z ∈ O, ∀ i j : Fin 3, G₁ z i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      fderiv ℝ τ z (e i) a * G₂ (τ z) a b * fderiv ℝ τ z (e j) b)
    (hpos : ∀ z ∈ O, 0 ≤ (G₂ (τ z)).det)
    (hvec : ∀ z ∈ O, fderiv ℝ τ z (P₁ z) = P₂ (τ z))
    (y : E3) (hy : y ∈ O) (hdet : (fderiv ℝ τ y).det ≠ 0)

    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y ∧

      fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e i) a *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 p₂).symm (chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm y)) a b *
        fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartAt E3 p₂ ((chartAt E3 p₁).symm z)) y (e j) b) ∧

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g h : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (K : Set E3)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKφ : K ⊆ φ.source) (hh : ∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K → h.g p = g.g p)
    (ψ v : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hv : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v) :
    ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ ρ₀ ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, ρ₀ ≤ c →
      ∃ (Y : M → E3) (C : Set M) (Yt₀ : E3 → E3) (Yt : Fin hAF.numEnds → E3 → E3),
        calSmoothField Y ∧ IsCompact C ∧ (∀ p : M, p ∉ C → Y p = 0) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt₀ φ.source ∧
        (∀ x ∈ φ.source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ x (Yt₀ x) = Y (φ x)) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Yt j) (hAF.ends j).Φ.source) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∀ x ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source,
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (hAF.ends j).Φ x (Yt j x) = Y ((hAF.ends j).Φ x)) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ K, Yt₀ =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          gfiVec (g.coeff φ) (h.coeff φ) (fun z => ψ (φ z)) (fun z => v (φ z))) ∧
        (∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), c ≤ ‖y‖ → Yt j =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun z =>
          (1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) •
            gfiVec (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ)
              (fun w => ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ w)) (fun w => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ w)) z) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds,
          Disjoint (φ '' K) ((hAF.ends j).Φ '' {y : E3 | c ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ c + 1})) ∧
        (Pairwise fun j l : Fin hAF.numEnds =>
          Disjoint ((hAF.ends j).Φ '' {y : E3 | c ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ c + 1})
            ((hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | c ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ c + 1})) ∧
        (∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K →
          (∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, p ∉ (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {y : E3 | c ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ c + 1}) →
          ((fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
              (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
            gfiVec (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
              (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (fun z => v ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) ∨
          (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
              (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)] fun _ => 0))

signature.name: green_field_pieces
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g h : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (K : Set E3)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKφ : K ⊆ φ.source) (hh : ∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K → h.g p = g.g p)
    (ψ v : M → ℝ) (hψ : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ ψ) (hv : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ v) :
    ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ ρ₀ ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, ρ₀ ≤ c →
      ∃ (Y : M → E3) (C : Set M) (Yt₀ : E3 → E3) (Yt : Fin hAF.numEnds → E3 → E3),
        calSmoothField Y ∧ IsCompact C ∧ (∀ p : M, p ∉ C → Y p = 0) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Yt₀ φ.source ∧
        (∀ x ∈ φ.source, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ x (Yt₀ x) = Y (φ x)) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Yt j) (hAF.ends j).Φ.source) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∀ x ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source,
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (hAF.ends j).Φ x (Yt j x) = Y ((hAF.ends j).Φ x)) ∧
        (∀ y ∈ K, Yt₀ =ᶠ[𝓝 y]
          gfiVec (g.coeff φ) (h.coeff φ) (fun z => ψ (φ z)) (fun z => v (φ z))) ∧
        (∀ (j : Fin hAF.numEnds) (y : E3), c ≤ ‖y‖ → Yt j =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun z =>
          (1 - Real.smoothTransition (‖z‖ - c)) •
            gfiVec (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ) (g.coeff (hAF.ends j).Φ)
              (fun w => ψ ((hAF.ends j).Φ w)) (fun w => v ((hAF.ends j).Φ w)) z) ∧
        (∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds,
          Disjoint (φ '' K) ((hAF.ends j).Φ '' {y : E3 | c ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ c + 1})) ∧
        (Pairwise fun j l : Fin hAF.numEnds =>
          Disjoint ((hAF.ends j).Φ '' {y : E3 | c ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ c + 1})
            ((hAF.ends l).Φ '' {y : E3 | c ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ c + 1})) ∧
        (∀ p : M, p ∉ φ '' K →
          (∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, p ∉ (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {y : E3 | c ≤ ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ ≤ c + 1}) →
          ((fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
              (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)]
            gfiVec (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm)
              (fun z => ψ ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (fun z => v ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) ∨
          (fun y => (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 p) ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
              (Y ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) : E3)) =ᶠ[𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)] fun _ => 0))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have smP : ∀ (w : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w →
      ∀ P : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞,
        ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => w (P z)) P.source :=
    fun w hw P => contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hw.comp_contMDiffOn P.contMDiffOn_toFun)
  have smC : ∀ (w : M → ℝ), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w → ∀ p : M,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm z)) (chartAt E3 p).target :=
    fun w hw p => contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp (hw.comp_contMDiffOn contMDiffOn_chart_symm)
  have hcoeq : ∀ (Q : E3 → M) (z : E3), h.g (Q z) = g.g (Q z) → h.coeff Q z = g.coeff Q z := by
    intro Q z hz
    ext a b
    show h.g (Q z) _ _ = g.g (Q z) _ _
    rw [hz]
  have hgfi : ∀ (G H : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (f u : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) (i : Fin 3),
      gfiVec G H f u y i = Real.sqrt (H y).det / Real.sqrt (G y).det *
        (f y * ∑ e : Fin 3, (H y)⁻¹ i e * partialDeriv e u y) -
          u y * ∑ e : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ i e * partialDeriv e f y :=
    fun G H f u y i => rfl
  have hsrc : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, (hAF.ends j).Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖} :=
    fun j => (hAF.ends j).source_eq
  have hS : IsCompact (φ '' K) :=
    hK.image_of_continuousOn (φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.continuousOn.mono hKφ)
  have hSc : IsClosed (φ '' K) := hS.isClosed
  
  have hfar : ∀ j : Fin hAF.numEnds, ∃ ρ : ℝ, 2 ≤ ρ ∧
      ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∉ φ '' K := by
    intro j
    have key : ∃ ρ : ℝ, ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∉ φ '' K := by
      refine hS.induction_on
        (p := fun s => ∃ ρ : ℝ, ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (hAF.ends j).Φ y ∉ s) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact ⟨0, fun y _ hy' => by simp at hy'⟩
      · rintro s t hst ⟨ρ, hρ⟩
        exact ⟨ρ, fun y hy hs => hρ y hy (hst hs)⟩
      · rintro s t ⟨ρ₁, h₁⟩ ⟨ρ₂, h₂⟩

      apply (hAF.ends k).Φ.map_source
      rw [hsrc k]
      have hy1 : c ≤ ‖y‖ := hy.1
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y‖
      linarith
    exact (hAF.disjoint hjl).mono (hA j) (hA l)
  · 
    intro p hp0 hpk
    have hmem : chartAt E3 p p ∈ (chartAt E3 p).target := mem_chart_target E3 p
    have hlinv : (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p) = p :=
      (chartAt E3 p).left_inv (mem_chart_source E3 p)
    have hT : Tendsto (chartAt E3 p).symm (𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p)) (𝓝 p) := by
      have := ((chartAt E3 p).continuousAt_symm hmem).tendsto
      rwa [hlinv] at this
    have htg : (chartAt E3 p).target ∈ 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p) :=
      (chartAt E3 p).open_target.mem_nhds hmem
    by_cases hA : ∀ j, p ∉ (hAF.ends j).Φ '' {x : E3 | c ≤ ‖x‖}
    · left
      have h0 : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 p, q ∉ φ '' K := hSc.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hp0
      have h1 : ∀ᶠ q in 𝓝 p, χ q = 1 ∧ q ∉ φ '' K := (hχone p hA).and h0
      have h2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (chartAt E3 p p),
          χ ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) = 1 ∧ (chartAt E3 p).symm y ∉ φ '' K :=
        hT.eventually h1
      filter_upwards [h2, htg] with y hy hyt
      rw [hrepC p y hyt, hy.1, one_smul]
      have hHG : h.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y = g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y :=
        hcoeq _ y (hh _ hy.2)
      have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm y).det :=
        Real.sqrt_pos.2 (coeff_chart_symm_posDef g p y hyt).det_pos
      refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
      rw [hrvi, hgfi, hdr1 _ hy.2, hHG, div_self hpos.ne']
      ring
    · right
      push_neg at hA
      obtain ⟨j, y₀, hy₀, he⟩ := hA
      have hy₀c : c ≤ ‖y₀‖ := hy₀
      have hy₀' : c + 1 < ‖y₀‖ := by
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        exact hpk j ⟨y₀, ⟨hy₀c, hcon⟩, he⟩
      have hy₀s : y₀ ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.source := by
        rw [hsrc j]; show (1 : ℝ) < ‖y₀‖; linarith
      have hNo : IsOpen ((hAF.ends j).Φ.target ∩
          (hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ⁻¹' {z : E3 | c + 1 < ‖z‖}) :=
        (hAF.ends j).Φ.contMDiffOn_invFun.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage
          (hAF.ends j).Φ.open_target (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm)
      have hpN : p ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.target ∩
          (hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ⁻¹' {z : E3 | c + 1 < ‖z‖} := by
        rw [← he]
        refine ⟨(hAF.ends j).Φ.map_source hy₀s, ?_⟩
        show c + 1 < ‖(hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ((hAF.ends j).Φ y₀)‖
        rw [(hAF.ends j).Φ.left_inv hy₀s]
        exact hy₀'
      have hY0 : ∀ q ∈ (hAF.ends j).Φ.target ∩
          (hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm ⁻¹' {z : E3 | c + 1 < ‖z‖}, Y q = 0 := by
        rintro q ⟨hqt, hq⟩
        have hq' : c + 1 < ‖(hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm q‖ := hq
        have e1 : (hAF.ends j).Φ ((hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm q) = q :=
          (hAF.ends j).Φ.right_inv hqt
        have hχ0 : χ q = 0 := by
          rw [← e1, hχΦ j ((hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm q) (by linarith),
            Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
              (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖(hAF.ends j).Φ.toPartialEquiv.symm q‖ - c by linarith), sub_self]
        simp only [hY, hχ0, zero_smul]
      filter_upwards [hT (hNo.mem_nhds hpN)] with y hy
      rw [hY0 ((chartAt E3 p).symm y) hy, map_zero]

subgoal_signatures.name: weighted_gradient_field
subgoal_signatures.statement:
[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (a f : M → ℝ)
    (ha : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ a) (hf : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f) :
    ∃ Z : M → E3, calSmoothField Z ∧ (∀ p : M, a p = 0 → Z p = 0) ∧
      (∀ (q : M) (y : E3), y ∈ (chartAt E3 q).target → ∀ i : Fin 3,
        (show E3 from mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q) ((chartAt E3 q).symm y)
          (Z ((chartAt E3 q).symm y))) i =
          a ((chartAt E3 q).symm y) * ∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q).symm y)⁻¹ i k *
            partialDeriv k (fun z => f ((chartAt E3 q).symm z)) y) ∧
      (∀ (P : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (x : E3), x ∈ P.source →
        ∀ w : E3, (∀ i : Fin 3, w i = a (P x) * ∑ k : Fin 3, (g.coeff P x)⁻¹ i k *
          partialDeriv k (fun z => f (P z)) x) →
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) P x w = Z (P x))

informal_problem.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (P : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hfc : HasCompactSupport f) (hfs : tsupport f ⊆ P.source) :
    ∃ F : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ F ∧ (∀ y ∈ P.source, F (P y) = f y) ∧
      (∀ z, z ∉ P '' tsupport f → F z = 0) ∧ IsCompact (P '' tsupport f) ∧
      tsupport F ⊆ P '' tsupport f ∧ (∀ z, F z = 0 ∨ ∃ y ∈ P.source, F z = f y)

signature.name: pdiffeo_lift_smooth
signature.statement:
[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M]
    (P : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (f : E3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hfc : HasCompactSupport f) (hfs : tsupport f ⊆ P.source) :
    ∃ F : M → ℝ, ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ F ∧ (∀ y ∈ P.source, F (P y) = f y) ∧
      (∀ z, z ∉ P '' tsupport f → F z = 0) ∧ IsCompact (P '' tsupport f) ∧
      tsupport F ⊆ P '' tsupport f ∧ (∀ z, F z = 0 ∨ ∃ y ∈ P.source, F z = f y)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  let F : M → ℝ := P.target.indicator (fun z => f (P.toPartialEquiv.symm z))
  have hFin : ∀ z ∈ P.target, F z = f (P.toPartialEquiv.symm z) :=
    fun z hz => Set.indicator_of_mem hz _
  have hFout : ∀ z ∉ P.target, F z = 0 := fun z hz => Set.indicator_of_notMem hz _
  have hK : IsCompact (P '' tsupport f) :=
    hfc.isCompact.image_of_continuousOn (P.contMDiffOn.continuousOn.mono hfs)
  have hKc : IsClosed (P '' tsupport f) := hK.isClosed
  have hKt : P '' tsupport f ⊆ P.target := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact P.toPartialEquiv.map_source (hfs hy)
  have hC2 : ∀ y ∈ P.source, F (P y) = f y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hFin _ (P.toPartialEquiv.map_source hy)]
    exact congrArg f (P.toPartialEquiv.left_inv hy)
  have hC3 : ∀ z, z ∉ P '' tsupport f → F z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    by_cases hzt : z ∈ P.target
    · rw [hFin z hzt]
      apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      intro hy
      exact hz ⟨_, hy, P.toPartialEquiv.right_inv hzt⟩
    · exact hFout z hzt
  have hC5 : tsupport F ⊆ P '' tsupport f :=
    closure_minimal (Function.support_subset_iff'.mpr hC3) hKc
  have hC6 : ∀ z, F z = 0 ∨ ∃ y ∈ P.source, F z = f y := by
    intro z
    by_cases hzt : z ∈ P.target
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, P.toPartialEquiv.map_target hzt, hFin z hzt⟩
    · exact Or.inl (hFout z hzt)
  have hC1 : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ F := by
    apply contMDiff_of_tsupport
    intro x hx
    have hxT : x ∈ P.target := hKt (hC5 hx)
    have hT : P.target ∈ 𝓝 x := P.open_target.mem_nhds hxT
    have hG : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ (f ∘ P.invFun) P.target :=
      hf.contMDiff.comp_contMDiffOn P.contMDiffOn_invFun
    refine (hG.contMDiffAt hT).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hT] with z hz
    exact hFin z hz
  exact ⟨F, hC1, hC2, hC3, hK, hC5, hC6⟩

informal_problem.statement:
∀ L t : ℝ, ∃ ψ χ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ ∧
    HasCompactSupport ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport χ ∧
    tsupport ψ ⊆ {y : E3 | |y 0 - t| ≤ 1 ∧ L ^ 2 - 7 / 4 ≤ y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ∧
      y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + 1} ∧
    tsupport χ ⊆ {y : E3 | |y 0 - t| ≤ 1 ∧ L ^ 2 - 7 / 4 ≤ y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ∧
      y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + 3 / 8} ∧
    (∀ y, 0 ≤ ψ y ∧ ψ y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y) ∧
    (∀ a c : ℝ, L ^ 2 - 1 ≤ a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 → a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + 1 / 2 → ψ (cylPt t a c) = 1) ∧
    (∀ a c : ℝ, L ^ 2 - 3 / 2 ≤ a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 → a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + 1 / 4 →
      χ (cylPt t a c) = 1)

signature.name: slice_side_bumps
signature.statement:
∀ L t : ℝ, ∃ ψ χ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ χ ∧
    HasCompactSupport ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport χ ∧
    tsupport ψ ⊆ {y : E3 | |y 0 - t| ≤ 1 ∧ L ^ 2 - 7 / 4 ≤ y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ∧
      y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + 1} ∧
    tsupport χ ⊆ {y : E3 | |y 0 - t| ≤ 1 ∧ L ^ 2 - 7 / 4 ≤ y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ∧
      y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + 3 / 8} ∧
    (∀ y, 0 ≤ ψ y ∧ ψ y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y, 0 ≤ χ y) ∧
    (∀ a c : ℝ, L ^ 2 - 1 ≤ a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 → a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + 1 / 2 → ψ (cylPt t a c) = 1) ∧
    (∀ a c : ℝ, L ^ 2 - 3 / 2 ≤ a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 → a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + 1 / 4 →
      χ (cylPt t a c) = 1)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro L t
  have hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => y i) := fun i => contDiff_piLp_apply 2
  have hcont : ∀ i : Fin 3, Continuous (fun y : E3 => y i) := fun i => (hc i).continuous
  have hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff
  have hnsq : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hcyl : ∀ a b : ℝ, (cylPt t a b) 0 = t ∧ (cylPt t a b) 1 = a ∧ (cylPt t a b) 2 = b := by
    intro a b
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hpos : ∀ x : ℝ, Real.smoothTransition x ≠ 0 → 0 < x := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    exact hx (Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos h)
  have hclosed : ∀ c : ℝ, IsClosed {y : E3 | |y 0 - t| ≤ 1 ∧ L ^ 2 - 7 / 4 ≤ y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ∧
      y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + c} := by
    intro c
    exact (isClosed_le ((hcont 0).sub continuous_const).abs continuous_const).inter
      ((isClosed_le continuous_const (((hcont 1).pow 2).add ((hcont 2).pow 2))).inter
        (isClosed_le (((hcont 1).pow 2).add ((hcont 2).pow 2)) continuous_const))
  have hbdd : ∀ c : ℝ, c ≤ 1 → {y : E3 | |y 0 - t| ≤ 1 ∧ L ^ 2 - 7 / 4 ≤ y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ∧
      y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + c} ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E3) (|t| + |L| + 2) := by
    intro c hc1 y hy
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hy
    rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
    have h0 : |y 0| ≤ |t| + 1 := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub (y 0) t
      linarith
    have hy0 : y 0 ^ 2 ≤ (|t| + 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs (y 0)]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h0 2
    have hL : L ^ 2 = |L| ^ 2 := (sq_abs L).symm
    have hn := hnsq y
    have hB : 0 ≤ |t| + |L| + 2 := by positivity
    have ht0 := abs_nonneg t
    have hL0 := abs_nonneg L
    have hsq : ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ (|t| + |L| + 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht0 hL0]
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg y]
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2) := ((hc 1).pow 2).add ((hc 2).pow 2)
  have hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E3 => 2 - 2 * (y 0 - t) ^ 2) :=
    contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.mul (((hc 0).sub contDiff_const).pow 2))
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : ∃ ψ : E3 → ℝ, ψ = fun y =>
      Real.smoothTransition (4 / 3 * (y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 - L ^ 2 + 7 / 4)) *
      Real.smoothTransition (2 * (L ^ 2 + 1 - (y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2))) *
      Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (y 0 - t) ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ : ∃ χ : E3 → ℝ, χ = fun y =>
      Real.smoothTransition (4 * (y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 - L ^ 2 + 7 / 4)) *
      Real.smoothTransition (8 * (L ^ 2 + 3 / 8 - (y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2))) *
      Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (y 0 - t) ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hψS : tsupport ψ ⊆ {y : E3 | |y 0 - t| ≤ 1 ∧ L ^ 2 - 7 / 4 ≤ y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ∧
      y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + 1} := by
    refine closure_minimal ?_ (hclosed 1)
    intro y hy
    rw [Function.mem_support, hψ] at hy
    obtain ⟨hAB, hC⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hy
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hAB
    have pA := hpos _ hA
    have pB := hpos _ hB
    have pC := hpos _ hC
    exact ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hχS : tsupport χ ⊆ {y : E3 | |y 0 - t| ≤ 1 ∧ L ^ 2 - 7 / 4 ≤ y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ∧
      y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 2 + 3 / 8} := by
    refine closure_minimal ?_ (hclosed (3 / 8))
    intro y hy
    rw [Function.mem_support, hχ] at hy
    obtain ⟨hAB, hC⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hy
    obtain ⟨hA, hB⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hAB
    have pA := hpos _ hA
    have pB := hpos _ hB
    have pC := hpos _ hC
    exact ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  refine ⟨ψ, χ, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hψS, hχS, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hψ]
    exact ((hη.comp (contDiff_const.mul ((hr.sub contDiff_const).add contDiff_const))).mul
      (hη.comp (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.sub hr)))).mul (hη.comp hd)
  · rw [hχ]
    exact ((hη.comp (contDiff_const.mul ((hr.sub contDiff_const).add contDiff_const))).mul
      (hη.comp (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.sub hr)))).mul (hη.comp hd)
  · exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) (|t| + |L| + 2)).of_isClosed_subset
      (isClosed_tsupport ψ) (hψS.trans (hbdd 1 le_rfl))
  · exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E3) (|t| + |L| + 2)).of_isClosed_subset
      (isClosed_tsupport χ) (hχS.trans (hbdd (3 / 8) (by norm_num)))
  · intro y
    rw [hψ]
    have a1 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (4 / 3 * (y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 - L ^ 2 + 7 / 4))
    have a2 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (2 * (L ^ 2 + 1 - (y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2)))
    have a3 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (2 - 2 * (y 0 - t) ^ 2)
    have b1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (4 / 3 * (y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2 - L ^ 2 + 7 / 4))
    have b2 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (2 * (L ^ 2 + 1 - (y 1 ^ 2 + y 2 ^ 2)))
    have b3 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (2 - 2 * (y 0 - t) ^ 2)
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg a1 a2) a3, ?_⟩
    exact mul_le_one₀ (mul_le_one₀ b1 a2 b2) a3 b3
  · intro y
    rw [hχ]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)
      (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)) (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)
  · intro a c h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e0, e1, e2⟩ := hcyl a c
    have k1 : Real.smoothTransition (4 / 3 * (a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 - L ^ 2 + 7 / 4)) = 1 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
    have k2 : Real.smoothTransition (2 * (L ^ 2 + 1 - (a ^ 2 + c ^ 2))) = 1 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
    have k3 : Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (t - t) ^ 2) = 1 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by norm_num)
    rw [hψ]
    simp only [e0, e1, e2, k1, k2, k3, mul_one]
  · intro a c h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e0, e1, e2⟩ := hcyl a c
    have k1 : Real.smoothTransition (4 * (a ^ 2 + c ^ 2 - L ^ 2 + 7 / 4)) = 1 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
    have k2 : Real.smoothTransition (8 * (L ^ 2 + 3 / 8 - (a ^ 2 + c ^ 2))) = 1 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
    have k3 : Real.smoothTransition (2 - 2 * (t - t) ^ 2) = 1 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by norm_num)
    rw [hχ]
    simp only [e0, e1, e2, k1, k2, k3, mul_one]

[IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcoeffS : ∀ (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞) (i j : Fin 3),
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ x i j) Φ.source := by
    intro Φ i j
    have hw : ∀ w : E3, w = ∑ a : Fin 3, w a • e a := by
      intro w
      ext k
      simp [e, Pi.single_apply]
    have hexp : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (w1 w2 : E3),
        B (D w1) (D w2) = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
      intro B D w1 w2
      calc B (D w1) (D w2)
          = B (D (∑ a : Fin 3, w1 a • e a)) (D (∑ b : Fin 3, w2 b • e b)) := by
            rw [← hw w1, ← hw w2]
        _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
            simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
              ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
            conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
            ring
    have hΦ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ Φ.source := Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro x0 hx0
    have hu : IsOpen (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) :=
      hΦ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage Φ.open_source (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).open_source
    have hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y))
        (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) := by
      have h1 := (contMDiffOn_iff_target.mp hΦ).2 (Φ x0)
      rw [extChartAt_source] at h1
      have h2 := contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp h1
      simpa [extChartAt_coe, Function.comp_def] using h2
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y))
        (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).target :=
      fun y hy => (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).map_source hy.2
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)))
        (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hu).mp hF).2
    have hcoord : ∀ k a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun x => (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e k)) a)
        (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) := by
      intro k a
      have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e k))
          (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) := hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj a : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h2
    have hG : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun x => g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) a b)
        (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) :=
      fun a b => (g.smooth (Φ x0) a b).comp hF hmaps
    have hR : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e i)) a *
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e j)) b *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) a b)
        (Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source) := by
      apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro a _
      apply ContDiffOn.sum
      intro b _
      exact ((hcoord i a).mul (hcoord j b)).mul (hG a b)
    have key : ∀ x ∈ Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source,
        g.coeff Φ x i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e i)) a *
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x (e j)) b *
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) a b := by
      intro x hx
      have hcont : ContinuousAt Φ x :=
        hΦ.continuousOn.continuousAt (Φ.open_source.mem_nhds hx.1)
      have hFdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x :=
        (hF.contDiffAt (hu.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
      have hFx : chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x) ∈ (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).target := hmaps hx
      have hev : (Φ : E3 → M) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
          ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm ∘ fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) := by
        have hmem : (Φ : E3 → M) ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source ∈ 𝓝 x :=
          hcont.preimage_mem_nhds ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).open_source.mem_nhds hx.2)
        filter_upwards [hmem] with y hy
        simp only [Function.comp_apply]
        exact ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).left_inv hy).symm
      have hg : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm
          (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) :=
        ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (n := ∞)).contMDiffAt
          ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).open_target.mem_nhds hFx)).mdifferentiableAt (by simp)
      have hfac : ∀ v : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ x v =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x))
            (fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ y)) x v) := by
        intro v
        rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp x hg hFdiff.mdifferentiableAt, mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
        rfl
      have hpt : (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) = Φ x :=
        (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).left_inv hx.2
      have h1 : g.coeff Φ x i j = g.g (Φ x) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ x (e i))
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ x (e j)) := rfl
      have h2 : ∀ a b : Fin 3,
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) a b =
          g.g (Φ x)
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) (e a))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)) (e b)) := by
        intro a b
        show g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x))) _ _ = _
        rw [show g.g ((chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x))) = g.g (Φ x) from
          congrArg g.g hpt]
      rw [h1, hfac, hfac]
      simp only [h2]
      exact hexp (g.g (Φ x))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).symm (chartAt E3 (Φ x0) (Φ x)))
        _ _
    refine ⟨Φ.source ∩ Φ ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 (Φ x0)).source, hu,
      ⟨hx0, mem_chart_source E3 (Φ x0)⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Set.inter_eq_right.mpr Set.inter_subset_left]
    exact hR.congr key
  have hw : ∀ w : E3, w = ∑ a : Fin 3, w a • e a := by
    intro w
    ext k
    simp [e, Pi.single_apply]
  have hexp : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (w1 w2 : E3),
      B (D w1) (D w2) = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
    intro B D w1 w2
    calc B (D w1) (D w2)
        = B (D (∑ a : Fin 3, w1 a • e a)) (D (∑ b : Fin 3, w2 b • e b)) := by
          rw [← hw w1, ← hw w2]
      _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
          simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          ring
  set G := pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y with hGdef
  obtain ⟨hR0, hR01, hC, hXs, hYs, hinv, hinj, hbd⟩ := hXY
  have hU : IsOpen {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hV : IsOpen {y : E3 | R₀ < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  have hne : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hmapsW : Set.MapsTo Y {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := (hinv x hx).1
    show (1 : ℝ) < ‖Y x‖
    linarith
  have hsmooth : ∀ i j : Fin 3,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => g.coeff Φ.Φ y i j) {y : E3 | 1 < ‖y‖} := by
    intro i j
    have h := hcoeffS Φ.Φ i j
    rwa [Φ.source_eq] at h
  have hcoordF : ∀ (F : E3 → E3) (S : Set E3), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F S →
      ∀ d : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun w => F w d) S := by
    intro F S hF d
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj d : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hF
  have hfd : ∀ a i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) i)
      {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
    intro a i
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Y) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := hYs.fderiv_of_isOpen hU le_rfl
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ Y z (e a)) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} :=
      h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact hcoordF _ _ h2 i
  have hGs : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => G x a b) {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := by
    intro a b
    have hGY : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => g.coeff Φ.Φ (Y x) i j)
        {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} := fun i j => (hsmooth i j).comp hYs hmapsW
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * g.coeff Φ.Φ (Y x) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j) _
    exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ =>
      ((hfd a i).mul (hGY i j)).mul (hfd b j)))
  have hsymmG : ∀ (y : E3) (a c : Fin 3), G y a c = G y c a := by
    intro y a c
    show ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ Y y (e a)) i * g.coeff Φ.Φ (Y y) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y y (e c)) j =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (fderiv ℝ Y y (e c)) i * g.coeff Φ.Φ (Y y) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y y (e a)) j
    conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    have hs : g.coeff Φ.Φ (Y y) j i = g.coeff Φ.Φ (Y y) i j := by
      simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
      exact g.symm _ _ _
    rw [hs]
    ring
  refine ⟨hGs, hsymmG, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hYx : Y x ∈ Φ.Φ.source := by rw [Φ.source_eq]; exact hmapsW hx
  have hloc := PartialDiffeomorph.isLocalDiffeomorphAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ Φ.Φ hYx
  have hDinj : ∀ w : E3, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ.Φ (Y x) w = 0 → w = 0 := by
    intro w hw0
    have hL : ∀ u : E3, (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv hne) u =
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ.Φ (Y x) u := by
      intro u
      rw [← hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv_coe hne]
      rfl
    apply (hloc.mfderivToContinuousLinearEquiv hne).injective
    rw [hL, hw0, map_zero]
  have hYd : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y x := (hYs.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt hne
  have hXd : DifferentiableAt ℝ X (Y x) :=
    (hXs.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hinv x hx).1)).differentiableAt hne
  have hc2 : (fderiv ℝ X (Y x)).comp (fderiv ℝ Y x) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E3 := by
    rw [← fderiv_comp x hXd hYd]
    have hev : X ∘ Y =ᶠ[𝓝 x] id := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with z hz
      exact (hinv z hz).2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id]
  have hJinj : ∀ v : E3, fderiv ℝ Y x v = 0 → v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have h := congrArg (fun T : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 => T v) hc2
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, hv,
      map_zero] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hGform : ∀ a c : Fin 3, G x a c = g.g (Φ.Φ (Y x))
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ.Φ (Y x) (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)))
      (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ.Φ (Y x) (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c))) := by
    intro a c
    have hh := hexp (g.g (Φ.Φ (Y x))) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ.Φ (Y x))
      (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c))
    refine Eq.trans ?_ hh.symm
    show ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * g.coeff Φ.Φ (Y x) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e c)) j = _
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    simp only [RiemannianMetric3.coeff, coeffMatrix]
    exact mul_right_comm _ _ _
  apply Matrix.PosDef.of_dotProduct_mulVec_pos
  · apply Matrix.IsHermitian.ext
    intro i j
    simp only [star_trivial]
    exact hsymmG x j i
  · intro w hw0
    set v : E3 := w 0 • e 0 + w 1 • e 1 + w 2 • e 2 with hvdef
    have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hw0
      have h0' := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u 0) h0
      have h1' := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u 1) h0
      have h2' := congrArg (fun u : E3 => u 2) h0
      simp [v, e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] at h0' h1' h2'
      funext k
      fin_cases k
      · simpa using h0'
      · simpa using h1'
      · simpa using h2'
    have hpos := g.posDef (Φ.Φ (Y x)) _ (fun h => hv0 (hJinj _ (hDinj _ h)))
    have key : star w ⬝ᵥ (G x).mulVec w =
        g.g (Φ.Φ (Y x)) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ.Φ (Y x) (fderiv ℝ Y x v))
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) Φ.Φ (Y x) (fderiv ℝ Y x v)) := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.star_apply, star_trivial,
        hGform, hvdef, map_add, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [key]
    exact hpos

[T2Space M] [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M)
    (Φ : EndChart M) (u : M → ℝ) (hu : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ u) (X Y : E3 → E3)
    (q R₀ R₁ C t : ℝ) (hXY : CoordChange X Y q R₀ R₁ C)
    (hu1 : ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ → u (sternPsi Φ Y x) = x 0)
    (hch : ∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ → g.coeff (sternPsi Φ Y) x = pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y x)
    (hpd : ∀ x : E2, R₁ < ‖cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)‖ →
      (sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t x).PosDef) :
    ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E2) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun x : E2 => sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)))
      {x : E2 | R₁ < ‖cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)‖} ∧
    (∀ x : E2, R₁ < ‖cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)‖ →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))) ≠ 0) ∧
    ∀ q' : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))))
      ({x : E2 | R₁ < ‖cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)‖} ∩
        (fun x : E2 => sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))) ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) ∧
      ∀ x : E2, R₁ < ‖cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)‖ →
        sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) ∈ (chartAt E3 q').source →
        Function.Injective
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)))) x) ∧
        sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t x =
          pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm)
            (fun y : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)))) x
