      (sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t x).PosDef) :
    ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E2) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (fun x : E2 => sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)))
      {x : E2 | R₁ < ‖cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)‖} ∧
    (∀ x : E2, R₁ < ‖cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)‖ →
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))) ≠ 0) ∧
    ∀ q' : M, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))))
      ({x : E2 | R₁ < ‖cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)‖} ∩
        (fun x : E2 => sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))) ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) ∧
      ∀ x : E2, R₁ < ‖cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)‖ →
        sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) ∈ (chartAt E3 q').source →
        Function.Injective
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)))) x) ∧
        sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t x =
          pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm)
            (fun y : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)))) x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hne : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hD : IsOpen {y : E3 | R₁ < ‖y‖} := isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_norm
  obtain ⟨hR0, hR01, hC, hXs, hYs, hinv, hinj, hbd⟩ := hXY
  
  have hw : ∀ w : E3, w = ∑ a : Fin 3, w a • e a := by
    intro w
    ext k
    simp [e, Pi.single_apply]
  have hexp : ∀ (B : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (D : E3 →L[ℝ] E3) (w1 w2 : E3),
      B (D w1) (D w2) = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
    intro B D w1 w2
    calc B (D w1) (D w2)
        = B (D (∑ a : Fin 3, w1 a • e a)) (D (∑ b : Fin 3, w2 b • e b)) := by
          rw [← hw w1, ← hw w2]
      _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, w1 a * w2 b * B (D (e a)) (D (e b)) := by
          simp only [map_sum, map_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
            ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
          conv_lhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          ring
  
  have hs6 : ∀ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (F : E2 → E3) (x : E2),
      (pullMetric2 G F x).PosDef → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ F x) := by
    intro G F x hP
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro v hv
    by_contra hv0
    have hw0 : (fun i : Fin 2 => v i) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hv0
      ext i
      simpa using congrFun h i
    have hpos := hP.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hw0
    have hvdec : v = v 0 • e2 0 + v 1 • e2 1 := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e2]
    have hs : ∀ k : Fin 3,
        v 0 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 0)) k + v 1 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1)) k = 0 := by
      intro k
      have h1 := congrArg (fun z : E3 => z k) hv
      rw [hvdec] at h1
      simpa [map_add, map_smul] using h1
    have key : star (fun i : Fin 2 => v i) ⬝ᵥ (pullMetric2 G F x).mulVec (fun i : Fin 2 => v i) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          (v 0 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 0)) k + v 1 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1)) k) * G (F x) k l *
          (v 0 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 0)) l + v 1 * (fderiv ℝ F x (e2 1)) l) := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, pullMetric2, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three,
        Pi.star_apply, star_trivial]
      ring
    rw [key] at hpos
    simp only [hs, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero] at hpos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
  
  have hΨ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ (sternPsi Φ Y) {y : E3 | R₁ < ‖y‖} := by
    have hmaps : Set.MapsTo Y {y : E3 | R₁ < ‖y‖} Φ.Φ.source := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Φ.source_eq]
      have h1 := (hinv x hx).1
      show (1 : ℝ) < ‖Y x‖
      linarith
    exact Φ.Φ.contMDiffOn_toFun.comp hYs.contMDiffOn hmaps
  
  obtain ⟨Lι, hLι⟩ : ∃ L : E2 →L[ℝ] E3,
      L = (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 1) +
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hιfun : (fun y : E2 => cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)) = fun y => t • e 0 + Lι y := by
    funext y
    rw [hLι]
    simp only [cylPt, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply]
    rw [add_assoc]
    rfl
  have hιd : ∀ x : E2, HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)) Lι x := by
    intro x
    rw [hιfun]
    exact Lι.hasFDerivAt.const_add (t • e 0)
  have hιs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)) := by
    rw [hιfun]
    exact contDiff_const.add Lι.contDiff
  have hLe : ∀ a : Fin 2, Lι (e2 a) = e a.succ := by
    intro a
    rw [hLι]
    fin_cases a <;> simp [e2, e]
  
  have hσ : ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E2) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞
      (fun x : E2 => sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)))
      {x : E2 | R₁ < ‖cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)‖} :=
    hΨ.comp hιs.contMDiff.contMDiffOn (fun x hx => hx)
  
  have hreg : ∀ y ∈ {y : E3 | R₁ < ‖y‖},
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u (sternPsi Φ Y y) ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy h0
    have hΨy : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (sternPsi Φ Y) y :=
      (hΨ.contMDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hy)).mdifferentiableAt hne
    have huy : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u (sternPsi Φ Y y) :=
      hu.contMDiffAt.mdifferentiableAt hne
    have hcomp := mfderiv_comp y huy hΨy
    have hev : (u ∘ sternPsi Φ Y) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := by
      filter_upwards [hD.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
      exact hu1 z hz
    rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_eq_fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv, h0,
      ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp] at hcomp
    have h3 : (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (e 0) = 1 := by
      simp [e, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    rw [hcomp] at h3
    have h4 : (0 : ℝ) = 1 := h3
    exact zero_ne_one h4
  refine ⟨hσ, fun x hx => hreg _ hx, fun q' => ⟨?_, fun x hx hsrc => ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    exact contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp
      ((contMDiffOn_chart (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞) (x := q')).comp
        (hσ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun x hx => hx.2))
  · 
    have hN : IsOpen ({y : E3 | R₁ < ‖y‖} ∩ sternPsi Φ Y ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) :=
      hΨ.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hD (chartAt E3 q').open_source
    have hy₀ : cylPt t (x 0) (x 1) ∈
        {y : E3 | R₁ < ‖y‖} ∩ sternPsi Φ Y ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source := ⟨hx, hsrc⟩
    have hT : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : E3 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y z))
        ({y : E3 | R₁ < ‖y‖} ∩ sternPsi Φ Y ⁻¹' (chartAt E3 q').source) :=
      contMDiffOn_iff_contDiffOn.mp
        ((contMDiffOn_chart (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞) (x := q')).comp
          (hΨ.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun z hz => hz.2))
    have hTd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : E3 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y z))
        (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) :=
      (hT.contDiffAt (hN.mem_nhds hy₀)).differentiableAt hne
    have hFd : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1))))
        ((fderiv ℝ (fun z : E3 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y z)) (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))).comp Lι)
        x := by
      have hc := hTd.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hιd x)
      exact hc
    have hFe : ∀ a : Fin 2,
        fderiv ℝ (fun y : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)))) x (e2 a) =
          fderiv ℝ (fun z : E3 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y z)) (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))
            (e a.succ) := by
      intro a
      rw [hFd.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hLe a]
    
    have hev : sternPsi Φ Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))]
        ((chartAt E3 q').symm ∘ fun z : E3 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y z)) := by
      filter_upwards [hN.mem_nhds hy₀] with z hz
      exact ((chartAt E3 q').left_inv hz.2).symm
    have hcs : MDifferentiableAt 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q').symm
        (chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)))) :=
      ((contMDiffOn_chart_symm (I := 𝓘(ℝ, E3)) (n := ∞) (x := q')).contMDiffAt
        ((chartAt E3 q').open_target.mem_nhds
          ((chartAt E3 q').map_source hsrc))).mdifferentiableAt hne
    have hfac : ∀ v : E3,
        mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (sternPsi Φ Y) (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) v =
          mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q').symm
            (chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))))
            (fderiv ℝ (fun z : E3 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y z)) (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) v) := by
      intro v
      rw [hev.mfderiv_eq, mfderiv_comp (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) hcs hTd.mdifferentiableAt,
        mfderiv_eq_fderiv]
      rfl
    have hpt : (chartAt E3 q').symm (chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)))) =
        sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) := (chartAt E3 q').left_inv hsrc
    have h2 : ∀ k l : Fin 3,
        g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm (chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)))) k l =
          g.g (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q').symm
              (chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)))) (e k))
            (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q').symm
              (chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)))) (e l)) := by
      intro k l
      show g.g ((chartAt E3 q').symm (chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))))) _ _ = _
      rw [show g.g ((chartAt E3 q').symm (chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))))) =
        g.g (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))) from congrArg g.g hpt]
    
    have hmet : sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t x =
        pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm)
          (fun y : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)))) x := by
      funext a b
      have e1 : sgbSideMetric (pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y) t x a b =
          g.coeff (sternPsi Φ Y) (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) a.succ b.succ := by
        show pullbackMetric (g.coeff Φ.Φ) Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) a.succ b.succ = _
        rw [hch _ hx]
      rw [e1]
      show g.g (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)))
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (sternPsi Φ Y) (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) (e a.succ))
          (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (sternPsi Φ Y) (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)) (e b.succ)) =
        ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ l : Fin 3,
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)))) x (e2 a)) k *
          g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm (chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1)))) k l *
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)))) x (e2 b)) l
      rw [hfac (e a.succ), hfac (e b.succ)]
      refine (hexp (g.g (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))))
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) (chartAt E3 q').symm
          (chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (x 0) (x 1))))) _ _).trans ?_
      rw [hFe a, hFe b]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
      rw [h2 k l]
      exact mul_right_comm _ _ _
    have hP : (pullMetric2 (g.coeff (chartAt E3 q').symm)
        (fun y : E2 => chartAt E3 q' (sternPsi Φ Y (cylPt t (y 0) (y 1)))) x).PosDef := by
      rw [← hmet]
      exact hpd x hx
    exact ⟨hs6 _ _ x hP, hmet⟩

    (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0) ∧

signature.name: pcgb_pf_eta_deriv
signature.statement:
Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition t) t) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0) ∧
    (∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0) ∧
    ∃ M₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ M₁ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |deriv Real.smoothTransition t| ≤ M₁

proof.tactics:
by
  have hcd : ContDiff ℝ 1 Real.smoothTransition := Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)
  have hηc : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) := hcd.continuous_deriv le_rfl
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ Real.smoothTransition := hcd.differentiable (by norm_num)
  have h0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t ≤ 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    apply IsLocalMin.deriv_eq_zero
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos ht]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.nonneg x
  have h1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    apply IsLocalMax.deriv_eq_zero
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le ht]
    exact Real.smoothTransition.le_one x
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc (a := (0:ℝ)) (b := 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    hηc.continuousOn
  refine ⟨hηc, fun t => (hdiff t).hasDerivAt, h0, h1, max C 0, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1
  · have := hC t ht
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
    exact le_trans this (le_max_left _ _)
  · rw [Set.mem_Icc, not_and_or, not_le, not_le] at ht
    rcases ht with ht | ht
    · rw [h0 t ht.le, abs_zero]; exact le_max_right _ _
    · rw [h1 t ht.le, abs_zero]; exact le_max_right _ _

(A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (∀ a c : Fin 2, A a c = A c a) ∧ 0 < A.det ∧ 0 < A 0 0 ∧ 0 < A 0 0 + A 1 1 ∧
    ∀ z : E2,
      0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c ∧
      (z ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c) ∧
      ∑ a : Fin 2, (∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z c) ^ 2 ≤
        (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c ∧
      A.det * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c ∧
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 2, A a k * z k) * (∑ k : Fin 2, A c k * z k) =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c

signature.name: pcgb_pf_quad_facts
signature.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hA : A.PosDef) :
    (∀ a c : Fin 2, A a c = A c a) ∧ 0 < A.det ∧ 0 < A 0 0 ∧ 0 < A 0 0 + A 1 1 ∧
    ∀ z : E2,
      0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c ∧
      (z ≠ 0 → 0 < ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c) ∧
      ∑ a : Fin 2, (∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z c) ^ 2 ≤
        (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c ∧
      A.det * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤ (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c ∧
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 2, A a k * z k) * (∑ k : Fin 2, A c k * z k) =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c

proof.tactics:
by
  have hsym : ∀ a c : Fin 2, A a c = A c a := by
    intro a c
    simpa using hA.isHermitian.apply c a
  have hD : 0 < A.det := hA.det_pos
  have h00 : 0 < A 0 0 := hA.diag_pos
  have h11 : 0 < A 1 1 := hA.diag_pos
  have hdet : A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsym 1 0]
  have hD' : 0 < A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1 := hdet ▸ hD
  have hinv : A⁻¹ = A.det⁻¹ • !![A 1 1, -A 0 1; -A 1 0, A 0 0] := by
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
  have i00 : A⁻¹ 0 0 = A.det⁻¹ * A 1 1 := by rw [hinv]; simp
  have i01 : A⁻¹ 0 1 = A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) := by rw [hinv]; simp
  have i10 : A⁻¹ 1 0 = A.det⁻¹ * (-A 0 1) := by rw [hinv]; simp [hsym 1 0]
  have i11 : A⁻¹ 1 1 = A.det⁻¹ * A 0 0 := by rw [hinv]; simp
  have hDinv : (A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1)⁻¹ * (A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1) = 1 :=
    inv_mul_cancel₀ hD'.ne'
  refine ⟨hsym, hD, h00, by linarith, fun z => ?_⟩
  have hn : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hzne : z ≠ 0 → z 0 ≠ 0 ∨ z 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    apply hz
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using h.1
    · simpa using h.2
  have hQ : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c =
      A 0 0 * z 0 ^ 2 + 2 * A 0 1 * z 0 * z 1 + A 1 1 * z 1 ^ 2 := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym 1 0]
    ring
  have hv : ∑ a : Fin 2, (∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z c) ^ 2 =
      (A 0 0 * z 0 + A 0 1 * z 1) ^ 2 + (A 0 1 * z 0 + A 1 1 * z 1) ^ 2 := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym 1 0]
  have h9 : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A⁻¹ a c * (∑ k : Fin 2, A a k * z k) *
      (∑ k : Fin 2, A c k * z k) =
      (A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1)⁻¹ *
        (A 1 1 * (A 0 0 * z 0 + A 0 1 * z 1) ^ 2
          - 2 * A 0 1 * (A 0 0 * z 0 + A 0 1 * z 1) * (A 0 1 * z 0 + A 1 1 * z 1)
          + A 0 0 * (A 0 1 * z 0 + A 1 1 * z 1) ^ 2) := by
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, i00, i01, i10, i11, hsym 1 0, hdet]
    ring
  have hQa : A 0 0 * (A 0 0 * z 0 ^ 2 + 2 * A 0 1 * z 0 * z 1 + A 1 1 * z 1 ^ 2) =
      (A 0 0 * z 0 + A 0 1 * z 1) ^ 2 + (A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1) * z 1 ^ 2 := by ring
  have hCH : (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * (A 0 0 * z 0 ^ 2 + 2 * A 0 1 * z 0 * z 1 + A 1 1 * z 1 ^ 2) =
      (A 0 0 * z 0 + A 0 1 * z 1) ^ 2 + (A 0 1 * z 0 + A 1 1 * z 1) ^ 2 +
        (A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1) * (z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2) := by ring
  have hQa0 : 0 ≤ A 0 0 * (A 0 0 * z 0 ^ 2 + 2 * A 0 1 * z 0 * z 1 + A 1 1 * z 1 ^ 2) := by
    rw [hQa]
    exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hD'.le (sq_nonneg _))
  rw [hQ, hv, h9, hn, hdet]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left h00).mp hQa0
  · intro hz
    have hpos : 0 < A 0 0 * (A 0 0 * z 0 ^ 2 + 2 * A 0 1 * z 0 * z 1 + A 1 1 * z 1 ^ 2) := by
      rw [hQa]
      by_cases hy : z 1 = 0
      · have hx : z 0 ≠ 0 := by
          rcases hzne hz with h | h
          · exact h
          · exact absurd hy h
        rw [hy]
        have : 0 < (A 0 0 * z 0) ^ 2 := by
          have : A 0 0 * z 0 ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero h00.ne' hx
          positivity
        simpa using this
      · have : 0 < (A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1) * z 1 ^ 2 := by
          have : 0 < z 1 ^ 2 := by positivity
          exact mul_pos hD' this
        linarith [sq_nonneg (A 0 0 * z 0 + A 0 1 * z 1)]
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left h00).mp hpos
  · nlinarith [hCH, mul_nonneg hD'.le (add_nonneg (sq_nonneg (z 0)) (sq_nonneg (z 1)))]
  · nlinarith [hCH, sq_nonneg (A 0 0 * z 0 + A 0 1 * z 1), sq_nonneg (A 0 1 * z 0 + A 1 1 * z 1)]
  · linear_combination
      (A 0 0 * z 0 ^ 2 + 2 * A 0 1 * z 0 * z 1 + A 1 1 * z 1 ^ 2) * hDinv

informal_problem.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsymm : A 0 1 = A 1 0)

signature.name: pcgb_pf_frozen_integral
signature.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hsymm : A 0 1 = A 1 0)
    (ha : 0 < A 0 0) (hD : 0 < A.det) (x₀ : E2) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hηc : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition))

    (hη1 : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ t → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0) :

        Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)) = -(2 * Real.pi)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hpolar : ∀ F : ℝ → ℝ,
      ∫ u : E2, F ‖u‖ = 2 * Real.pi * ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), y * F y := by
    intro F
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_fun_norm_addHaar volume F]
    have hb : volume.real (Metric.ball (0 : E2) 1) = Real.pi := by
      rw [Measure.real, EuclideanSpace.volume_ball_fin_two]
      simp [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal Real.pi_pos.le]
    rw [hb, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, nsmul_eq_mul]
    norm_num
    ring
  
  have hftc : ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((y - δ) / δ) = 1 := by
    have hsub : ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((y - δ) / δ) =
        ∫ y in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (2 * δ), δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((y - δ) / δ) := by
      apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero measurableSet_Ioi
        Set.Ioc_subset_Ioi_self
      intro y hy
      have hy2 : 2 * δ < y := by
        rcases hy with ⟨hy1, hy2⟩
        simp only [Set.mem_Ioc, not_and, not_le] at hy2
        exact hy2 hy1
      rw [hη1 _ (by rw [le_div_iff₀ hδ]; linarith), mul_zero]
    rw [hsub, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith)]
    have hd : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition t) t := by
      intro t
      exact ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by simp) t).hasDerivAt
    have hF : ∀ y ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) (2 * δ), HasDerivAt
        (fun y => Real.smoothTransition ((y - δ) / δ))
        (δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((y - δ) / δ)) y := by
      intro y _
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (y - δ) / δ) (1 / δ) y :=
        ((hasDerivAt_id y).sub_const δ).div_const δ
      have h2 := (hd ((y - δ) / δ)).comp y h1
      convert h2 using 1
      field_simp
    have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun y => δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((y - δ) / δ))
        volume 0 (2 * δ) := by
      apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
      exact continuous_const.mul (hηc.comp ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).div_const δ))
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hF hint]
    have e1 : (2 * δ - δ) / δ = 1 := by field_simp; ring
    have e2 : (0 - δ) / δ = -1 := by rw [zero_sub, neg_div, div_self hδ.ne']
    simp only [e1, e2]
    rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le le_rfl,
      Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  
  have hlin : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ,
      ∫ y : E2, g (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)) =
        (Real.sqrt A.det)⁻¹ * ∫ u : E2, g ‖u‖ := by
    intro g
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ : ∃ f : E2 → ℝ, f = fun w => g (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        A a c * w a * w c)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have htr : ∫ y : E2, f (y - x₀) = ∫ w : E2, f w :=
      MeasureTheory.integral_sub_right_eq_self f x₀
    have hL : ∫ y : E2, g (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        A a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c)) = ∫ y : E2, f (y - x₀) := by rw [hf]
    rw [hL, htr]
    have hdet : A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1 := by rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsymm]
    obtain ⟨sa, hsa_def⟩ : ∃ s, s = Real.sqrt (A 0 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨sD, hsD_def⟩ : ∃ s, s = Real.sqrt A.det := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hsD_def]
    have hsa : 0 < sa := by rw [hsa_def]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ha
    have hsD : 0 < sD := by rw [hsD_def]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hD
    have hsa2 : sa ^ 2 = A 0 0 := by rw [hsa_def]; exact Real.sq_sqrt ha.le
    have hsD2 : sD ^ 2 = A.det := by rw [hsD_def]; exact Real.sq_sqrt hD.le
    set M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := !![sa⁻¹, -(A 0 1 / (sa * sD)); 0, sa / sD] with hM
    set Φ : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E2 := Matrix.toEuclideanLin M with hΦ
    have hΦ0 : ∀ u : E2, Φ u 0 = sa⁻¹ * u 0 + -(A 0 1 / (sa * sD)) * u 1 := by
      intro u
      simp [Φ, M, Matrix.toEuclideanLin_apply, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hΦ1 : ∀ u : E2, Φ u 1 = sa / sD * u 1 := by
      intro u
      simp [Φ, M, Matrix.toEuclideanLin_apply, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hdetΦ : LinearMap.det Φ = sD⁻¹ := by
      rw [hΦ, Matrix.toEuclideanLin_eq_toLin, LinearMap.det_toLin, hM, Matrix.det_fin_two_of]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hdet0 : LinearMap.det Φ ≠ 0 := by rw [hdetΦ]; positivity
    have hmap := MeasureTheory.Measure.map_linearMap_addHaar_eq_smul_addHaar
      (μ := (volume : Measure E2)) hdet0
    have hemb : MeasurableEmbedding Φ :=
      (LinearMap.equivOfDetNeZero Φ hdet0).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding
    have hkey : ∀ u : E2, f (Φ u) = g ‖u‖ := by
      intro u
      rw [hf]
      simp only
      congr 1
      have hn : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = u 0 ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2 := by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
          Fin.sum_univ_two]
        simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      have hq : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * Φ u a * Φ u c = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hn]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hΦ0, hΦ1, ← hsymm]
        have e1 : A 1 1 = (sD ^ 2 + A 0 1 ^ 2) / sa ^ 2 := by
          rw [hsD2, hsa2, hdet]; field_simp; ring
        rw [e1, ← hsa2]
        field_simp
        ring
      rw [hq, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
    have h1 : ∫ u : E2, g ‖u‖ = ∫ w, f w ∂(Measure.map Φ volume) := by
      rw [hemb.integral_map]
      simp only [hkey]
    rw [hmap, integral_smul_measure, hdetΦ, inv_inv, abs_of_pos hsD,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hsD.le, smul_eq_mul] at h1
    rw [h1]
    field_simp
  
  have hsD : 0 < Real.sqrt A.det := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hD
  refine (hlin (fun ρ => -(Real.sqrt A.det * (δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition
    ((ρ - δ) / δ)) / ρ))).trans ?_
  rw [hpolar (fun ρ => -(Real.sqrt A.det * (δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition
    ((ρ - δ) / δ)) / ρ))]
  have hI : ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), y * -(Real.sqrt A.det * (δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition
      ((y - δ) / δ)) / y) = ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (-Real.sqrt A.det) *
      (δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((y - δ) / δ)) := by
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi ?_
    intro y hy
    have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hy
    calc y * -(Real.sqrt A.det * (δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((y - δ) / δ)) / y)
        = (-Real.sqrt A.det) * (δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((y - δ) / δ)) * (y / y) := by
          ring
      _ = (-Real.sqrt A.det) * (δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((y - δ) / δ)) := by
          rw [div_self hy0, mul_one]
  rw [hI, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, hftc]
  calc (Real.sqrt A.det)⁻¹ * (2 * Real.pi * (-Real.sqrt A.det * 1))
      = -(2 * Real.pi) * ((Real.sqrt A.det)⁻¹ * Real.sqrt A.det) := by ring
    _ = -(2 * Real.pi) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hsD.ne', mul_one]

proof.tactics:
by
  have hζ : ∀ (i : Fin 2) (y : E2), HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) i)
      (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) i : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y := by
    intro i y
    have h := (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 y i).sub_const (x₀ i)
    convert h using 1
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ : ∃ Q : E2 → ℝ,
      Q = fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ,
      N = fun a y => ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * (y - x₀) c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hposQ : ∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ → 0 < Q y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hQ]
    exact hQpos (y - x₀) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hy)
  have hQd : ∀ y : E2, HasFDerivAt Q
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ((A a c * (y - x₀) a) •
        (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) c : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) +
        (y - x₀) c • (A a c • (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ℝ) a : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)))) y := by
    intro y
    rw [hQ]
    have h := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun a _ => HasFDerivAt.sum
      (u := Finset.univ) (fun c _ => ((hζ a y).const_mul (A a c)).mul (hζ c y)))
    convert h using 1
  have h10 := hsymm 1 0
  have hQpd : ∀ (y : E2) (k : Fin 2), fderiv ℝ Q y (e2 k) = 2 * N k y := by
    intro y k
    rw [(hQd y).fderiv, hN]
    fin_cases k <;>
      simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
        h10] <;> ring
  have hQc : Continuous Q := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun y => (hQd y).continuousAt
  have hQ0 : Q x₀ = 0 := by
    rw [hQ]
    simp
  have hη : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition t) t := by
    intro t
    have hd : Differentiable ℝ Real.smoothTransition :=
      (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by norm_num)
    exact (hd t).hasDerivAt
  have alg1 : ∀ s q n : ℝ, s ≠ 0 → s * s = q → s⁻¹ * (1 / (2 * s) * (2 * n)) = n / q := by
    intro s q n hs hsq
    subst hsq
    field_simp
  have alg2 : ∀ s d e n : ℝ, s ≠ 0 → d ≠ 0 →
      e * (d⁻¹ * (1 / (2 * s) * (2 * n))) = d⁻¹ * e * n / s := by
    intro s d e n hs hd
    field_simp
  have hpart1 : ∀ y : E2, y ≠ x₀ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y' : E2 => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y ∧
      ∀ a : Fin 2,
        pd2 a (fun y' : E2 => Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y') - δ) / δ)) y =
          δ⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y) - δ) / δ) * N a y /
            Real.sqrt (Q y) ∧
        pd2 a (fun y' : E2 => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y'))) y = N a y / Q y := by
    intro y hy
    have hq := hposQ y hy
    have hsq : 0 < Real.sqrt (Q y) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hq
    have hS : HasFDerivAt (fun y' => Real.sqrt (Q y'))
        ((1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q y))) • fderiv ℝ Q y) y :=
      ((hQd y).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt).sqrt hq.ne'
    have hL : HasFDerivAt (fun y' => Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y')))
        ((Real.sqrt (Q y))⁻¹ • (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q y))) • fderiv ℝ Q y) y :=
      hS.log hsq.ne'
    have hin : HasFDerivAt (fun y' => (Real.sqrt (Q y') - δ) / δ)
        (δ⁻¹ • (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q y))) • fderiv ℝ Q y) y := by
      have := (hS.sub_const δ).mul_const δ⁻¹
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using this
    have hχ : HasFDerivAt (fun y' => Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y') - δ) / δ))
        (deriv Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y) - δ) / δ) •
          δ⁻¹ • (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (Q y))) • fderiv ℝ Q y) y := by
      have h := HasDerivAt.comp_hasFDerivAt (x := y) (hη ((Real.sqrt (Q y) - δ) / δ)) hin
      exact h
    refine ⟨hL.differentiableAt, fun a => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · show fderiv ℝ _ y (e2 a) = _
      rw [hχ.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hQpd y a]
      exact alg2 _ _ _ _ hsq.ne' hδ.ne'
    · show fderiv ℝ _ y (e2 a) = _
      rw [hL.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hQpd y a]
      exact alg1 _ _ _ hsq.ne' (Real.mul_self_sqrt hq.le)
  have hpart2 : ∀ a : Fin 2,
      pd2 a (fun y' : E2 => Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y') - δ) / δ)) x₀ = 0 := by
    intro a
    have hev : (fun y' : E2 => Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt (Q y') - δ) / δ)) =ᶠ[nhds x₀]
        fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
      have hU : IsOpen {y' : E2 | Q y' < δ ^ 2} := isOpen_lt hQc continuous_const
      have hx : x₀ ∈ {y' : E2 | Q y' < δ ^ 2} := by
        show Q x₀ < δ ^ 2
        rw [hQ0]
        positivity
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with y' hy'
      apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
      have h1 : Real.sqrt (Q y') < δ := (Real.sqrt_lt' hδ).mpr hy'
      exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hδ.le
    show fderiv ℝ _ x₀ (e2 a) = 0
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have key := And.intro hpart1 hpart2
  subst hQ hN
  exact key

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)

    ∃ K₁ K₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ K₁ ∧ 0 ≤ K₂ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r, ∀ a c : Fin 2,
      |(h y)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h y).det| ≤ K₁ ∧
      |(h y)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h y).det - (h x₀)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h x₀).det| ≤ K₂ * ‖y - x₀‖

signature.name: pcgb_pf_metric_bounds
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef)
    (x₀ : E2) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ r ⊆ W) :
    ∃ K₁ K₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ K₁ ∧ 0 ≤ K₂ ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r, ∀ a c : Fin 2,
      |(h y)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h y).det| ≤ K₁ ∧
      |(h y)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h y).det - (h x₀)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h x₀).det| ≤ K₂ * ‖y - x₀‖

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).det) W := by
    have hpoly : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y 0 0 * h y 1 1 - h y 0 1 * h y 1 0) W :=
      ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
    exact hpoly.congr (fun y _ => Matrix.det_fin_two (h y))
  have hadj : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).adjugate a c) W := by
    intro a c
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases c
    · exact (hh 1 1).congr (fun y _ => by simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two])
    · exact (hh 0 1).neg.congr (fun y _ => by simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two])
    · exact (hh 1 0).neg.congr (fun y _ => by simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two])
    · exact (hh 0 0).congr (fun y _ => by simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two])
  have hdinv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹) W :=
    hdet.inv (fun y hy => (Matrix.PosDef.det_pos (hpd y hy)).ne')
  have hinv : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a c) W := by
    intro a c
    refine (hdinv.mul (hadj a c)).congr ?_
    intro y _
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.sqrt (h y).det) W :=
    hdet.sqrt (fun y hy => (Matrix.PosDef.det_pos (hpd y hy)).ne')
  have hH : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h y).det) W :=
    fun a c => (hinv a c).mul hsq
  have hKc : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall x₀ r) := isCompact_closedBall x₀ r
  have hKv : Convex ℝ (Metric.closedBall x₀ r) := convex_closedBall x₀ r
  have hne : (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have h1le : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by
    exact_mod_cast (le_top : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
  have hHc : ContinuousOn
      (fun y => fun a c : Fin 2 => (h y)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h y).det)
      (Metric.closedBall x₀ r) := by
    refine continuousOn_pi.2 fun a => continuousOn_pi.2 fun c => ?_
    exact (hH a c).continuousOn.mono hball
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hHc
  have hGc : ContinuousOn
      (fun y => fun a c : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h z).det) y)
      (Metric.closedBall x₀ r) := by
    refine continuousOn_pi.2 fun a => continuousOn_pi.2 fun c => ?_
    exact ((hH a c).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW h1le).mono hball
  obtain ⟨κ', hκ'⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hGc
  refine ⟨max M 0, max κ' 0, le_max_right _ _, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro y hy a c
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 := hM y hy
    have h2 := norm_le_pi_norm (fun a c : Fin 2 => (h y)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h y).det) a
    have h3 := norm_le_pi_norm (fun c : Fin 2 => (h y)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h y).det) c
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h3
    exact le_trans h3 (le_trans h2 (le_trans h1 (le_max_left _ _)))
  · have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r,
        DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => (h w)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h w).det) z := fun z hz =>
      ((hH a c).differentiableOn hne).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds (hball hz))
    have hbd : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r,
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => (h w)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h w).det) z‖ ≤ max κ' 0 := by
      intro z hz
      have h1 := hκ' z hz
      have h2 := norm_le_pi_norm
        (fun c : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ (fun w => (h w)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h w).det) z) c
      have h3 := norm_le_pi_norm
        (fun a c : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ (fun w => (h w)⁻¹ a c * Real.sqrt (h w).det) z) a
      exact le_trans h2 (le_trans h3 (le_trans h1 (le_max_left _ _)))
    have hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ r := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le
    have := hKv.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff hbd hx₀ hy
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this

informal_problem.statement:
(G Ainv : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (g ℓ p v : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (s sD Q ρ δ e M₁ T K₁ K₂ κ C : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hρ : ρ = Real.sqrt Q) (hρδ : δ ≤ ρ)
    (hM₁ : |e| ≤ M₁) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hv : ∑ a : Fin 2, v a ^ 2 ≤ T * Q)
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hK₂ : 0 ≤ K₂)
    (hg : ∀ a : Fin 2, g a = δ⁻¹ * e * v a / ρ)
    (hℓ : ∀ c : Fin 2, ℓ c = p c - v c / Q)
    (hp : ∀ c : Fin 2, |p c| ≤ C)
    (hH : ∀ a c : Fin 2, |G a c * s| ≤ K₁)
    (hHH : ∀ a c : Fin 2, |G a c * s - Ainv a c * sD| ≤ K₂ * (2 * κ * δ))
    (hinv : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, Ainv a c * v a * v c = Q) :
    |(∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, G a c * g a * ℓ c) * s - -(sD * (δ⁻¹ * e) / ρ)| ≤
      (4 * M₁ * Real.sqrt T * K₁ * C + 8 * K₂ * κ * M₁ * T) / δ

signature.name: pcgb_pf_pointwise_algebra
signature.statement:
(G Ainv : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (g ℓ p v : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (s sD Q ρ δ e M₁ T K₁ K₂ κ C : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hρ : ρ = Real.sqrt Q) (hρδ : δ ≤ ρ)
    (hM₁ : |e| ≤ M₁) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hv : ∑ a : Fin 2, v a ^ 2 ≤ T * Q)
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hK₂ : 0 ≤ K₂)
    (hg : ∀ a : Fin 2, g a = δ⁻¹ * e * v a / ρ)
    (hℓ : ∀ c : Fin 2, ℓ c = p c - v c / Q)
    (hp : ∀ c : Fin 2, |p c| ≤ C)
    (hH : ∀ a c : Fin 2, |G a c * s| ≤ K₁)
    (hHH : ∀ a c : Fin 2, |G a c * s - Ainv a c * sD| ≤ K₂ * (2 * κ * δ))
    (hinv : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, Ainv a c * v a * v c = Q) :
    |(∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, G a c * g a * ℓ c) * s - -(sD * (δ⁻¹ * e) / ρ)| ≤
      (4 * M₁ * Real.sqrt T * K₁ * C + 8 * K₂ * κ * M₁ * T) / δ

proof.tactics:
by
  have hρpos : 0 < ρ := by rw [hρ]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hQ
  have hρsq : ρ * ρ = Q := by rw [hρ]; exact Real.mul_self_sqrt hQ.le
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hp 0)
  have hK₁ : 0 ≤ K₁ := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hH 0 0)
  have hM : 0 ≤ M₁ := le_trans (abs_nonneg _) hM₁
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt T := Real.sqrt_nonneg T
  have hrr : Real.sqrt T * Real.sqrt T = T := Real.mul_self_sqrt hT
  have hrρ : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt T * ρ := mul_nonneg hr0 hρpos.le
  
  have hva : ∀ a : Fin 2, |v a| ≤ Real.sqrt T * ρ := by
    intro a
    have h1 : v a ^ 2 ≤ T * Q := by
      have : v a ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b : Fin 2, v b ^ 2 :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun b => v b ^ 2) (fun b _ => sq_nonneg (v b))
          (Finset.mem_univ a)
      linarith
    have h2 : |v a| ≤ Real.sqrt (T * Q) := Real.abs_le_sqrt h1
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul hT, ← hρ] at h2
    exact h2
  
  have hQQ : Q⁻¹ * Q = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hQ.ne'
  have hid : (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, G a c * g a * ℓ c) * s - -(sD * (δ⁻¹ * e) / ρ)
      = (δ⁻¹ * e / ρ) * ((∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (G a c * s) * v a * p c) -
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (G a c * s - Ainv a c * sD) * v a * v c) / Q) := by
    simp only [hg, hℓ, Fin.sum_univ_two] at hinv ⊢
    linear_combination (-(δ⁻¹ * e / ρ * Q⁻¹ * sD)) * hinv - (δ⁻¹ * e / ρ * sD) * hQQ
  
  have ht1 : |∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (G a c * s) * v a * p c| ≤
      4 * (K₁ * (Real.sqrt T * ρ) * C) := by
    have hterm : ∀ a c : Fin 2, |(G a c * s) * v a * p c| ≤ K₁ * (Real.sqrt T * ρ) * C := by
      intro a c
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (hH a c) (hva a) (abs_nonneg _) hK₁) (hp c) (abs_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg hK₁ hrρ)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have e00 := abs_le.mp (hterm 0 0)
    have e01 := abs_le.mp (hterm 0 1)
    have e10 := abs_le.mp (hterm 1 0)
    have e11 := abs_le.mp (hterm 1 1)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [e00.1, e00.2, e01.1, e01.2, e10.1, e10.2, e11.1, e11.2]
  
  have hK : 0 ≤ K₂ * (2 * κ * δ) := mul_nonneg hK₂ (by positivity)
  have ht2 : |∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (G a c * s - Ainv a c * sD) * v a * v c| ≤
      4 * (K₂ * (2 * κ * δ) * (Real.sqrt T * ρ) * (Real.sqrt T * ρ)) := by
    have hterm : ∀ a c : Fin 2, |(G a c * s - Ainv a c * sD) * v a * v c| ≤
        K₂ * (2 * κ * δ) * (Real.sqrt T * ρ) * (Real.sqrt T * ρ) := by
      intro a c
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (hHH a c) (hva a) (abs_nonneg _) hK) (hva c) (abs_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg hK hrρ)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have e00 := abs_le.mp (hterm 0 0)
    have e01 := abs_le.mp (hterm 0 1)
    have e10 := abs_le.mp (hterm 1 0)
    have e11 := abs_le.mp (hterm 1 1)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith [e00.1, e00.2, e01.1, e01.2, e10.1, e10.2, e11.1, e11.2]
  have ht2' : |(∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (G a c * s - Ainv a c * sD) * v a * v c) / Q| ≤
      8 * K₂ * κ * δ * T := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hQ, div_le_iff₀ hQ]
    have : 4 * (K₂ * (2 * κ * δ) * (Real.sqrt T * ρ) * (Real.sqrt T * ρ)) =
        8 * K₂ * κ * δ * (Real.sqrt T * Real.sqrt T) * (ρ * ρ) := by ring
    rw [hrr, hρsq] at this
    linarith
  
  rw [hid, abs_mul, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_inv, abs_of_pos hδ, abs_of_pos hρpos]
  set t₁ := ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (G a c * s) * v a * p c
  set t₂ := (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (G a c * s - Ainv a c * sD) * v a * v c) / Q
  have hY : |t₁ - t₂| ≤ 4 * (K₁ * (Real.sqrt T * ρ) * C) + 8 * K₂ * κ * δ * T :=
    le_trans (abs_sub _ _) (add_le_add ht1 ht2')
  have hY0 : 0 ≤ |t₁ - t₂| := abs_nonneg _
  have h8 : 0 ≤ 8 * K₂ * κ * M₁ * T := by positivity
  have hkey : |e| * |t₁ - t₂| ≤
      (4 * M₁ * Real.sqrt T * K₁ * C + 8 * K₂ * κ * M₁ * T) * ρ := by
    have h1 : |e| * |t₁ - t₂| ≤
        M₁ * (4 * (K₁ * (Real.sqrt T * ρ) * C) + 8 * K₂ * κ * δ * T) :=
      mul_le_mul hM₁ hY hY0 hM
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hρδ h8
    nlinarith [h1, h2]
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff₀ hρpos hδ]
  have hδδ : δ⁻¹ * |e| * |t₁ - t₂| * δ = (δ⁻¹ * δ) * (|e| * |t₁ - t₂|) := by ring
  rw [hδδ, inv_mul_cancel₀ hδ.ne', one_mul]
  exact hkey

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (F J : ℝ → E2 → ℝ) (N : ℝ → Set E2)
    (δ₁ K V lim : ℝ) (hδ₁ : 0 < δ₁) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hN : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → IsCompact (N δ) ∧ N δ ⊆ W ∧
      MeasureTheory.volume (N δ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (V * δ ^ 2))
    (hFz : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ∀ y ∈ W, y ∉ N δ → F δ y = 0)
    (hJz : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ∀ y : E2, y ∉ N δ → J δ y = 0)
    (hFc : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ContinuousOn (F δ) (N δ))
    (hJc : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ContinuousOn (J δ) (N δ))
    (hJi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ∫ y, J δ y = lim)
    (hFJ : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ∀ y ∈ N δ, |F δ y - J δ y| ≤ K / δ) :
    Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => ∫ x in W, F δ x) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 lim)

signature.name: pcgb_pf_abstract_limit
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (F J : ℝ → E2 → ℝ) (N : ℝ → Set E2)
    (δ₁ K V lim : ℝ) (hδ₁ : 0 < δ₁) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hN : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → IsCompact (N δ) ∧ N δ ⊆ W ∧
      MeasureTheory.volume (N δ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (V * δ ^ 2))
    (hFz : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ∀ y ∈ W, y ∉ N δ → F δ y = 0)
    (hJz : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ∀ y : E2, y ∉ N δ → J δ y = 0)
    (hFc : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ContinuousOn (F δ) (N δ))
    (hJc : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ContinuousOn (J δ) (N δ))
    (hJi : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ∫ y, J δ y = lim)
    (hFJ : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ∀ y ∈ N δ, |F δ y - J δ y| ≤ K / δ) :
    Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => ∫ x in W, F δ x) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 lim)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hbound : ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < δ₁ → ‖(∫ x in W, F δ x) - lim‖ ≤ K * V * δ := by
    intro δ hδ hδ'
    obtain ⟨hNc, hNW, hNv⟩ := hN δ hδ hδ'
    have h1 : ∫ x in W, F δ x = ∫ x in N δ, F δ x :=
      MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hW.measurableSet hNW
        (fun x hx => hFz δ hδ hδ' x hx.1 hx.2)
    have h2 : ∫ x in N δ, J δ x = lim := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
        (fun x hx => hJz δ hδ hδ' x hx)]
      exact hJi δ hδ hδ'
    have hFi : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (F δ) (N δ) :=
      (hFc δ hδ hδ').integrableOn_compact hNc
    have hJi' : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (J δ) (N δ) :=
      (hJc δ hδ hδ').integrableOn_compact hNc
    have h3 : (∫ x in W, F δ x) - lim = ∫ x in N δ, (F δ x - J δ x) := by
      rw [h1, ← h2, MeasureTheory.integral_sub hFi hJi']
    have h4 : ‖∫ x in N δ, (F δ x - J δ x)‖ ≤
        K / δ * (MeasureTheory.volume (N δ)).toReal :=
      MeasureTheory.norm_setIntegral_le_of_norm_le_const hNc.measure_lt_top
        (fun x hx => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hFJ δ hδ hδ' x hx)
    have h5 : (MeasureTheory.volume (N δ)).toReal ≤ V * δ ^ 2 :=
      ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by positivity) hNv
    have h6 : K / δ * (MeasureTheory.volume (N δ)).toReal ≤ K / δ * (V * δ ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h5 (div_nonneg hK hδ.le)
    have h7 : K / δ * (V * δ ^ 2) = K * V * δ := by
      field_simp
    rw [h3]
    linarith
  rw [← tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff]
  have hlin : Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => K * V * δ) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) := by
    have h : Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => K * V * δ) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (K * V * 0)) :=
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).tendsto 0
    rw [mul_zero] at h
    exact tendsto_nhdsWithin_of_tendsto_nhds h
  refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ hlin
  filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hδ₁] with δ hδ
  exact hbound δ hδ.1 hδ.2

proof.tactics:
by

  have hUW : Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀} ⊆ W := fun x hx => hball (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hx.1)
  have hUc : Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀} ⊆ ({x₀}ᶜ : Set E2) := fun x hx => hx.2
  have hx₀W : x₀ ∈ W := hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le)
  have hA : (h x₀).PosDef := hpd x₀ hx₀W
  have hc : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => h x i j) (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}) :=
    fun i j => (hh i j).continuousOn.mono hUW
  have hm : ContinuousOn h (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}) :=
    continuousOn_pi.2 fun i => continuousOn_pi.2 fun j => hc i j
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x).det) (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}) :=
    (continuous_id.matrix_det).comp_continuousOn hm
  have hdet0 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}, (h x).det ≠ 0 :=
    fun x hx => (hpd x (hUW hx)).det_pos.ne'
  have hadj : ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x).adjugate) (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}) :=
    (continuous_id.matrix_adjugate).comp_continuousOn hm
  have hinv : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a c) (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}) := by
    intro a c
    have e : (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a c) = fun x => (h x).det⁻¹ * (h x).adjugate a c := by
      funext x
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rw [e]
    exact (hdetc.inv₀ hdet0).mul
      (continuousOn_pi.1 (continuousOn_pi.1 hadj a) c)
  have h1 : (1 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := by exact_mod_cast (le_top : (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
  have hLd : ∀ c : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 c L x) (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}) := by
    intro c

    exact (contDiff_piLp_apply (p := 2) (i := a')).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have hQs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => ∑ a' : Fin 2, ∑ c' : Fin 2,
      h x₀ a' c' * (y - x₀) a' * (y - x₀) c') := by
    refine ContDiff.sum (fun a' _ => ContDiff.sum (fun c' _ => ?_))
    exact (contDiff_const.mul (hcoord a')).mul (hcoord c')
  have hQpos : ∀ y ∈ ({x₀}ᶜ : Set E2),
      (∑ a' : Fin 2, ∑ c' : Fin 2, h x₀ a' c' * (y - x₀) a' * (y - x₀) c') ≠ 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hzx : y ≠ x₀ := hy
    have hw0 : (fun a : Fin 2 => (y - x₀) a) ≠ 0 := by

      apply hzx
      have h'' : y - x₀ = 0 := by

      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h''
    have e1 := hA.dotProduct_mulVec_pos hw0
    have e2 : star (fun a : Fin 2 => (y - x₀) a) ⬝ᵥ

        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c := by
      simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, star_trivial, Pi.star_apply]
      ring
    rw [← e2]
    exact e1.ne'
  have hsq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => Real.sqrt (∑ a' : Fin 2, ∑ c' : Fin 2,
      h x₀ a' c' * (y - x₀) a' * (y - x₀) c')) ({x₀}ᶜ : Set E2) :=
    hQs.contDiffOn.sqrt hQpos
  have hχ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => Real.smoothTransition ((Real.sqrt
      (∑ a' : Fin 2, ∑ c' : Fin 2, h x₀ a' c' * (y - x₀) a' * (y - x₀) c') - δ) / δ))

    (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := ⊤)).comp_contDiffOn

  have hχd : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 a (fun y => Real.smoothTransition
      ((Real.sqrt (∑ a' : Fin 2, ∑ c' : Fin 2, h x₀ a' c' * (y - x₀) a' * (y - x₀) c') - δ)
        / δ)) x) (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}) := by
    intro a
    exact ((hχ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen isOpen_compl_singleton h1).clm_apply
      continuousOn_const).mono hUc
  have hdet : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) (Metric.ball x₀ r \ {x₀}) :=

  refine ContinuousOn.mul ?_ hdet
  refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun c _ => ?_))

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεV⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV x₀ hx₀
  have hρ0 : 0 < min (ε / 2) 1 := lt_min (half_pos hε) one_pos
  have hρ1 : min (ε / 2) 1 ≤ 1 := min_le_right _ _
  have hρε : min (ε / 2) 1 < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (half_lt_self hε)
  have hB : Metric.closedBall x₀ (min (ε / 2) 1) ⊆ V :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hρε).trans hεV
  have hCD : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (min (ε / 2) 1), ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ u y :=
    fun y hy => hu.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hB hy))
  have hDiffG : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (min (ε / 2) 1),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u) y := by
    intro m y hy
    refine (hCD y hy).differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv ?_
    exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 (ENat.coe_lt_top m)
  have hDu : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (min (ε / 2) 1), DifferentiableAt ℝ u y :=
    fun y hy => (hCD y hy).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hsub : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (min (ε / 2) 1),
      Metric.closedBall x₀ ‖x - x₀‖ ⊆ Metric.closedBall x₀ (min (ε / 2) 1) := by
    intro x hx
    apply Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hx
    exact hx
  have hxmem : ∀ x : E2, x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ‖x - x₀‖ := by
    intro x
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
  have hx0mem : ∀ x : E2, x₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ‖x - x₀‖ :=
    fun x => Metric.mem_closedBall_self (norm_nonneg _)
  have hynorm : ∀ x y : E2, y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ‖x - x₀‖ → ‖y - x₀‖ ≤ ‖x - x₀‖ := by
    intro x y hy
    rwa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hy
  refine ⟨min (ε / 2) 1, hρ0, hB, fun K => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x₀ (min (ε / 2) 1)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (fun y hy => (hDiffG (K + 1) y hy).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ max M₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hMb : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (min (ε / 2) 1),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (K + 1) u y‖ ≤ max M₀ 0 :=
    fun y hy => (hM₀ y hy).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hind : ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ K → ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (min (ε / 2) 1),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (K - j + 1) u x‖ ≤ max M₀ 0 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ j := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro _ x hx
      simpa using hMb x hx
    | succ j ih =>
      intro hj x hx
      have hm1 : 1 ≤ K - (j + 1) + 1 := Nat.le_add_left 1 _
      have hmeq : K - (j + 1) + 1 + 1 = K - j + 1 := by omega
      have hzero := hflat (K - (j + 1) + 1) hm1
      have hmvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
        (f := iteratedFDeriv ℝ (K - (j + 1) + 1) u) (C := max M₀ 0 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ j)
        (fun y hy => hDiffG _ y (hsub x hx hy))
        (fun y hy => by
          rw [norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv, hmeq]
          calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (K - j + 1) u y‖ ≤ max M₀ 0 * ‖y - x₀‖ ^ j :=
                ih (by omega) y (hsub x hx hy)
            _ ≤ max M₀ 0 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ j :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                  (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hynorm x y hy) j) hM0)
        (convex_closedBall x₀ ‖x - x₀‖) (hx0mem x) (hxmem x)
      rw [hzero, sub_zero] at hmvt
      calc ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (K - (j + 1) + 1) u x‖
          ≤ max M₀ 0 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ j * ‖x - x₀‖ := hmvt
        _ = max M₀ 0 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ (j + 1) := by ring
  have hgrad : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (min (ε / 2) 1),
      ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ max M₀ 0 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ K := by
    intro x hx
    have h1 := hind K le_rfl x hx
    rw [Nat.sub_self, zero_add, norm_iteratedFDeriv_one] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨max M₀ 0, hM0, fun x hx => ⟨?_, hgrad x hx⟩⟩
  have hmvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (f := u)
    (C := max M₀ 0 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ K)
    (fun y hy => hDu y (hsub x hx hy))
    (fun y hy => (hgrad y (hsub x hx hy)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hynorm x y hy) K) hM0))
    (convex_closedBall x₀ ‖x - x₀‖) (hx0mem x) (hxmem x)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hmvt
  have hxr : ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ min (ε / 2) 1 := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hx
    exact hx
  have hr1 : ‖x - x₀‖ ≤ 1 := hxr.trans hρ1
  calc |u x - u x₀| ≤ max M₀ 0 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ K * ‖x - x₀‖ := hmvt
    _ ≤ max M₀ 0 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ K * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr1 (mul_nonneg hM0 (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _))
    _ = max M₀ 0 * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ K := mul_one _

informal_problem.statement:
(T C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (H D X Y Q g q : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hH0 : ∀ t < T, 0 ≤ H t) (hX0 : ∀ t < T, 0 ≤ X t) (hY0 : ∀ t < T, 0 ≤ Y t)

    (hDd : ∀ t < T, HasDerivAt D (X t + Y t) t)
    (hQ : ∀ t < T, Q t = X t - Y t)
    (hQd : ∀ t < T, HasDerivAt Q (q t) t)
    (hq : ∀ t < T, |q t| ≤ C * Real.exp t * (X t + Y t))
    (hDlim : Tendsto D atBot (𝓝 0)) (hQlim : Tendsto Q atBot (𝓝 0))
    (hdecay : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ CK : ℝ, ∀ t < T, H t ≤ CK * Real.exp (K * t)) :

signature.statement:
(T C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (H D X Y Q g q : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hH0 : ∀ t < T, 0 ≤ H t) (hX0 : ∀ t < T, 0 ≤ X t) (hY0 : ∀ t < T, 0 ≤ Y t)
    (hCS : ∀ t < T, D t ^ 2 ≤ H t * X t)
    (hHd : ∀ t < T, HasDerivAt H (2 * D t + g t) t)
    (hg : ∀ t < T, |g t| ≤ C * Real.exp t * H t)
    (hDd : ∀ t < T, HasDerivAt D (X t + Y t) t)
    (hQ : ∀ t < T, Q t = X t - Y t)
    (hQd : ∀ t < T, HasDerivAt Q (q t) t)
    (hq : ∀ t < T, |q t| ≤ C * Real.exp t * (X t + Y t))
    (hDlim : Tendsto D atBot (𝓝 0)) (hQlim : Tendsto Q atBot (𝓝 0))
    (hdecay : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ CK : ℝ, ∀ t < T, H t ≤ CK * Real.exp (K * t)) :
    ∀ t < T, H t = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hD0 : ∀ t < T, 0 ≤ D t := by
    intro t ht
    have hmono : MonotoneOn D (Set.Iic t) := by
      apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (f' := fun r => X r + Y r) (convex_Iic t)
      · intro r hr
        exact (hDd r (lt_of_le_of_lt hr ht)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · intro r hr
        rw [interior_Iic] at hr
        exact (hDd r (lt_trans hr ht)).hasDerivWithinAt
      · intro r hr
        rw [interior_Iic] at hr
        have hrT := lt_trans hr ht
        beta_reduce
        linarith [hX0 r hrT, hY0 r hrT]
    have hev : ∀ᶠ s in atBot, D s ≤ D t := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_le_atBot t] with s hs
      exact hmono hs (Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl) hs
    exact le_of_tendsto hDlim hev
  
  have hrel : ∀ t < T, ∀ σ : ℝ, (σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) → σ * Q t ≤ C * Real.exp t * D t := by
    intro t ht σ hσ
    have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun r => σ * Q r - C * Real.exp t * D r) (Set.Iic t) := by
      apply antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos
        (f' := fun r => σ * q r - C * Real.exp t * (X r + Y r)) (convex_Iic t)
      · intro r hr
        have hrT := lt_of_le_of_lt hr ht
        exact (((hQd r hrT).const_mul σ).sub
          ((hDd r hrT).const_mul (C * Real.exp t))).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · intro r hr
        rw [interior_Iic] at hr
        have hrT := lt_trans hr ht
        exact (((hQd r hrT).const_mul σ).sub
          ((hDd r hrT).const_mul (C * Real.exp t))).hasDerivWithinAt
      · intro r hr
        rw [interior_Iic] at hr
        have hrT := lt_trans hr ht
        have h1 : σ * q r ≤ |q r| := by
          rcases hσ with h | h
          · rw [h, one_mul]; exact le_abs_self _
          · rw [h, neg_one_mul]; exact neg_le_abs _
        have h2 := hq r hrT
        have h3 : Real.exp r ≤ Real.exp t := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hr.le
        have h4 : 0 ≤ X r + Y r := by linarith [hX0 r hrT, hY0 r hrT]
        have h5 : C * Real.exp r * (X r + Y r) ≤ C * Real.exp t * (X r + Y r) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ h4
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hC
        beta_reduce
        linarith
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun r => σ * Q r - C * Real.exp t * D r) atBot (𝓝 0) := by
      have := (hQlim.const_mul σ).sub (hDlim.const_mul (C * Real.exp t))
      rwa [mul_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero] at this
    have hev : ∀ᶠ s in atBot, σ * Q t - C * Real.exp t * D t ≤ σ * Q s - C * Real.exp t * D s := by
      filter_upwards [eventually_le_atBot t] with s hs
      exact hanti hs (Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl) hs
    have := ge_of_tendsto hlim hev
    linarith
  have hXY : ∀ t < T, |X t - Y t| ≤ C * Real.exp t * D t := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 := hrel t ht 1 (Or.inl rfl)
    have h2 := hrel t ht (-1) (Or.inr rfl)
    rw [← hQ t ht, abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  
  intro t₀ ht₀
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (hH0 t₀ ht₀)
  by_contra hneg
  push_neg at hneg
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ : ∃ N₀, N₀ = D t₀ / H t₀ * Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp t₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L, L = 2 * N₀ + C * Real.exp t₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hN₀0 : 0 ≤ N₀ := by
    rw [hN₀]
    exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (hD0 t₀ ht₀) hneg.le) (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := by
    rw [hLdef]
    exact add_nonneg (by linarith) (mul_nonneg hC (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  
  have himp : ∀ a ≤ t₀, (∀ r ∈ Set.Icc a t₀, 0 < H r) →
      H t₀ * Real.exp (L * (a - t₀)) ≤ H a := by
    intro a hat hpos
    have hT : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc a t₀, r < T := fun r hr => lt_of_le_of_lt hr.2 ht₀
    have hNd : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc a t₀, HasDerivAt (fun s => D s / H s * Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp s))
        (((X r + Y r) * H r - D r * (2 * D r + g r)) / H r ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r)
          + D r / H r * (Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r) * (2 * C * Real.exp r))) r := by
      intro r hr
      have h1 := (hDd r (hT r hr)).div (hHd r (hT r hr)) (hpos r hr).ne'
      have h2 := ((Real.hasDerivAt_exp r).const_mul (2 * C)).exp
      exact h1.mul h2
    have hNd_nonneg : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc a t₀, 0 ≤
        ((X r + Y r) * H r - D r * (2 * D r + g r)) / H r ^ 2 * Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r)
          + D r / H r * (Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r) * (2 * C * Real.exp r)) := by
      intro r hr
      have hrT := hT r hr
      have hHr := hpos r hr
      have hHne := hHr.ne'
      have hDr := hD0 r hrT
      obtain ⟨hxy1, hxy2⟩ := abs_le.1 (hXY r hrT)
      obtain ⟨hg1, hg2⟩ := abs_le.1 (hg r hrT)
      have p1 : 0 ≤ (C * Real.exp r * D r - (X r - Y r)) * H r := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hHr.le
      have p2 : 0 ≤ D r * (C * Real.exp r * H r - g r) := mul_nonneg hDr (by linarith)
      have hCSr := hCS r hrT
      have hΦ : 0 ≤ (X r + Y r) * H r - D r * (2 * D r + g r)
          + 2 * (C * Real.exp r) * D r * H r := by nlinarith
      have heq : ((X r + Y r) * H r - D r * (2 * D r + g r)) / H r ^ 2
            * Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r)
          + D r / H r * (Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r) * (2 * C * Real.exp r))
          = Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r) * ((X r + Y r) * H r - D r * (2 * D r + g r)
            + 2 * (C * Real.exp r) * D r * H r) / H r ^ 2 := by
        field_simp
      rw [heq]
      exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le hΦ) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hNmono : MonotoneOn (fun s => D s / H s * Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp s))
        (Set.Icc a t₀) := by
      apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg
        (f' := fun r => ((X r + Y r) * H r - D r * (2 * D r + g r)) / H r ^ 2
          * Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r)
          + D r / H r * (Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r) * (2 * C * Real.exp r)))
        (convex_Icc a t₀)
      · intro r hr
        exact (hNd r hr).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · intro r hr
        rw [interior_Icc] at hr
        exact (hNd r (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hr)).hasDerivWithinAt
      · intro r hr
        rw [interior_Icc] at hr
        exact hNd_nonneg r (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hr)
    have hDle : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc a t₀, D r ≤ N₀ * H r := by
      intro r hr
      have h1 : D r / H r * Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r)
          ≤ D t₀ / H t₀ * Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp t₀) :=
        hNmono hr (Set.right_mem_Icc.2 hat) hr.2
      have hE1 : 1 ≤ Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r) :=
        Real.one_le_exp (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hC) (Real.exp_pos r).le)
      have hN0 : 0 ≤ D r / H r := div_nonneg (hD0 r (hT r hr)) (hpos r hr).le
      have h2 : D r / H r ≤ N₀ := by
        calc D r / H r = D r / H r * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
          _ ≤ D r / H r * Real.exp (2 * C * Real.exp r) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE1 hN0
          _ ≤ N₀ := h1.trans (le_of_eq hN₀.symm)
      rwa [div_le_iff₀ (hpos r hr)] at h2
    have h2Dg : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc a t₀, 2 * D r + g r ≤ L * H r := by
      intro r hr
      have h1 := hDle r hr
      have h2 := (abs_le.1 (hg r (hT r hr))).2
      have h3 : C * Real.exp r * H r ≤ C * Real.exp t₀ * H r :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.2 hr.2) hC)
          (hpos r hr).le
      rw [hLdef]
      nlinarith
    have hGd : ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc a t₀, HasDerivAt (fun s => H s * Real.exp (-L * s))
        ((2 * D r + g r) * Real.exp (-L * r) + H r * (Real.exp (-L * r) * (-L * 1))) r := by
      intro r hr
      exact (hHd r (hT r hr)).mul (((hasDerivAt_id' r).const_mul (-L)).exp)
    have hGanti : AntitoneOn (fun s => H s * Real.exp (-L * s)) (Set.Icc a t₀) := by
      apply antitoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonpos
        (f' := fun r => (2 * D r + g r) * Real.exp (-L * r) + H r * (Real.exp (-L * r) * (-L * 1)))
        (convex_Icc a t₀)
      · intro r hr
        exact (hGd r hr).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · intro r hr
        rw [interior_Icc] at hr
        exact (hGd r (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hr)).hasDerivWithinAt
      · intro r hr
        rw [interior_Icc] at hr
        have hr' := Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hr
        have hle := h2Dg r hr'
        have he := Real.exp_pos (-L * r)
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle he.le
        beta_reduce
        nlinarith
    have key : H t₀ * Real.exp (-L * t₀) ≤ H a * Real.exp (-L * a) :=
      hGanti (Set.left_mem_Icc.2 hat) (Set.right_mem_Icc.2 hat) hat
    have e1 : Real.exp (L * (a - t₀)) = Real.exp (-L * t₀) * Real.exp (L * a) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    have e2 : Real.exp (-L * a) * Real.exp (L * a) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, show -L * a + L * a = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
    calc H t₀ * Real.exp (L * (a - t₀))
        = (H t₀ * Real.exp (-L * t₀)) * Real.exp (L * a) := by rw [e1]; ring
      _ ≤ (H a * Real.exp (-L * a)) * Real.exp (L * a) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right key (Real.exp_pos _).le
      _ = H a := by rw [mul_assoc, e2, mul_one]
  
  have hposAll : ∀ a ≤ t₀, ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc a t₀, 0 < H r := by
    intro a hat
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hHr₀⟩ := hcon
    have hHc : ContinuousOn H (Set.Icc a t₀) := fun r hr =>
      (hHd r (lt_of_le_of_lt hr.2 ht₀)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hZc : IsClosed (Set.Icc a t₀ ∩ H ⁻¹' Set.Iic 0) :=
      hHc.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc isClosed_Iic
    have hZne : (Set.Icc a t₀ ∩ H ⁻¹' Set.Iic 0).Nonempty := ⟨r₀, hr₀, hHr₀⟩
    have hZbdd : BddAbove (Set.Icc a t₀ ∩ H ⁻¹' Set.Iic 0) := ⟨t₀, fun r hr => hr.1.2⟩
    have hsZ := hZc.csSup_mem hZne hZbdd
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, s = sSup (Set.Icc a t₀ ∩ H ⁻¹' Set.Iic 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hs] at hsZ
    have hs2 : s ≤ t₀ := hsZ.1.2
    have hHs : H s ≤ 0 := hsZ.2
    have hst : s < t₀ := lt_of_le_of_ne hs2 (fun h => by rw [h] at hHs; linarith)
    have hposR : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioc s t₀, 0 < H r := by
      intro r hr
      by_contra hle
      push_neg at hle
      have hmem : r ∈ Set.Icc a t₀ ∩ H ⁻¹' Set.Iic 0 :=
        ⟨⟨by linarith [hr.1, hsZ.1.1], hr.2⟩, hle⟩
      have := le_csSup hZbdd hmem
      rw [← hs] at this
      linarith [hr.1]
    have hm : 0 < H t₀ * Real.exp (L * (s - t₀)) := mul_pos hneg (Real.exp_pos _)
    have hlow : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo s t₀, H t₀ * Real.exp (L * (s - t₀)) ≤ H r := by
      intro r hr
      have h1 := himp r hr.2.le (fun x hx => hposR x ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hr.1 hx.1, hx.2⟩)
      have h2 : Real.exp (L * (s - t₀)) ≤ Real.exp (L * (r - t₀)) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith [hr.1]) hL0)
      calc H t₀ * Real.exp (L * (s - t₀)) ≤ H t₀ * Real.exp (L * (r - t₀)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hneg.le
        _ ≤ H r := h1
    have hcont : Tendsto H (𝓝[>] s) (𝓝 (H s)) :=
      (hHd s (lt_trans hst ht₀)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt.tendsto
    have hev : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] s, H t₀ * Real.exp (L * (s - t₀)) ≤ H r := by
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hst] with r hr using hlow r hr
    have := ge_of_tendsto hcont hev
    linarith
  have hlowAll : ∀ a ≤ t₀, H t₀ * Real.exp (L * (a - t₀)) ≤ H a :=
    fun a hat => himp a hat (hposAll a hat)
  
  obtain ⟨CK, hCK⟩ := hdecay (⌈L⌉₊ + 1)
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K = ((⌈L⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hK] at hCK
  have hKL : 0 < K - L := by
    have h1 := Nat.le_ceil L
    have h2 : K = (⌈L⌉₊ : ℝ) + 1 := by rw [hK]; push_cast; ring
    linarith
  have hbound : ∀ r ≤ t₀, H t₀ ≤ CK * Real.exp (L * t₀) * Real.exp ((K - L) * r) := by
    intro r hr
    have h1 := hlowAll r hr
    have h2 := hCK r (lt_of_le_of_lt hr ht₀)
    have e : Real.exp (K * r) =
        Real.exp (L * t₀) * Real.exp ((K - L) * r) * Real.exp (L * (r - t₀)) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    have hE := Real.exp_pos (L * (r - t₀))
    have h3 : H t₀ * Real.exp (L * (r - t₀)) ≤
        CK * Real.exp (L * t₀) * Real.exp ((K - L) * r) * Real.exp (L * (r - t₀)) := by
      calc H t₀ * Real.exp (L * (r - t₀)) ≤ H r := h1
        _ ≤ CK * Real.exp (K * r) := h2
        _ = _ := by rw [e]; ring
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h3 hE
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun r => CK * Real.exp (L * t₀) * Real.exp ((K - L) * r)) atBot (𝓝 0) := by
    have h1 : Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (K - L) * r) atBot atBot :=
      tendsto_id.const_mul_atBot hKL
    have h2 := (Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp h1).const_mul (CK * Real.exp (L * t₀))
    rw [mul_zero] at h2
    exact h2
  have hev : ∀ᶠ r in atBot, H t₀ ≤ CK * Real.exp (L * t₀) * Real.exp ((K - L) * r) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_le_atBot t₀] with r hr using hbound r hr
  have := ge_of_tendsto hlim hev
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V)
    (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) V)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ V, (h x).PosDef)
    (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u V) (hharm : ∀ x ∈ V, lap2 h u x = 0)
    (x₀ : E2) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ ⊆ V)
    (hdec : ∀ K : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ,
      |u x - u x₀| ≤ C * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ K ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ C * ‖x - x₀‖ ^ K) :
    ∃ (T C₁ : ℝ) (a b c w : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ fplCylData T C₁ a b c w ∧
      (∀ K : ℕ, ∃ CK : ℝ, ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 < T →
        |w p| ≤ CK * Real.exp (K * p.1) ∧ |fplDt w p| ≤ CK * Real.exp (K * p.1) ∧
        |fplDs w p| ≤ CK * Real.exp (K * p.1)) ∧
      ((∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 < T → w p = 0) → ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, u x = u x₀)

proof.tactics:
by
  have cyl_flux_algebra : ∀ (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (A00 A01 A11 g0 g1 θ E : ℝ),
      P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0 = 1 →
      cylRotA θ (cylM00 P A00 A01 A11) (cylM01 P A00 A01 A11) (cylM11 P A00 A01 A11) *
          (E * ((P 0 0 * Real.cos θ + P 0 1 * Real.sin θ) * g0 +
            (P 1 0 * Real.cos θ + P 1 1 * Real.sin θ) * g1)) +
        cylRotB θ (cylM00 P A00 A01 A11) (cylM01 P A00 A01 A11) (cylM11 P A00 A01 A11) *
          (E * ((-P 0 0 * Real.sin θ + P 0 1 * Real.cos θ) * g0 +
            (-P 1 0 * Real.sin θ + P 1 1 * Real.cos θ) * g1)) =
        E * (Real.cos θ * (P 1 1 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) - P 0 1 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1)) +
          Real.sin θ * (-P 1 0 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) + P 0 0 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1))) ∧
      cylRotB θ (cylM00 P A00 A01 A11) (cylM01 P A00 A01 A11) (cylM11 P A00 A01 A11) *
          (E * ((P 0 0 * Real.cos θ + P 0 1 * Real.sin θ) * g0 +
            (P 1 0 * Real.cos θ + P 1 1 * Real.sin θ) * g1)) +
        cylRotC θ (cylM00 P A00 A01 A11) (cylM01 P A00 A01 A11) (cylM11 P A00 A01 A11) *
          (E * ((-P 0 0 * Real.sin θ + P 0 1 * Real.cos θ) * g0 +
            (-P 1 0 * Real.sin θ + P 1 1 * Real.cos θ) * g1)) =
        E * (-Real.sin θ * (P 1 1 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) - P 0 1 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1)) +
          Real.cos θ * (-P 1 0 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) + P 0 0 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1))) ∧
      cylM00 P A00 A01 A11 * cylM11 P A00 A01 A11 - cylM01 P A00 A01 A11 ^ 2 =
        A00 * A11 - A01 ^ 2 := by
    intro P A00 A01 A11 g0 g1 θ E hd
    unfold cylRotA cylRotB cylRotC cylM00 cylM01 cylM11
    have hCS := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ
    generalize Real.cos θ = C at hCS ⊢
    generalize Real.sin θ = S at hCS ⊢
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · linear_combination (E * (C * (P 1 1 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) - P 0 1 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1)) +
          S * (-P 1 0 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) + P 0 0 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1))) *
          (P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0)) * hCS +
        (E * (C * (P 1 1 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) - P 0 1 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1)) +
          S * (-P 1 0 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) + P 0 0 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1)))) * hd
    · linear_combination (E * (-S * (P 1 1 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) - P 0 1 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1)) +
          C * (-P 1 0 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) + P 0 0 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1))) *
          (P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0)) * hCS +
        (E * (-S * (P 1 1 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) - P 0 1 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1)) +
          C * (-P 1 0 * (A00 * g0 + A01 * g1) + P 0 0 * (A01 * g0 + A11 * g1)))) * hd
    · linear_combination ((P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0 + 1) * (A00 * A11 - A01 ^ 2)) * hd
  have cyl_cholesky_normalise : ∀ (p q r : ℝ), 0 < p → p * r - q ^ 2 = 1 →
      ∃ P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0 = 1 ∧
        cylM00 P p q r = 1 ∧ cylM01 P p q r = 0 ∧ cylM11 P p q r = 1 := by
    intro p q r hp hpr
    have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt p := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hp
    have hps : p = Real.sqrt p ^ 2 := (Real.sq_sqrt hp.le).symm
    have hinv : Real.sqrt p * (Real.sqrt p)⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hs.ne'
    generalize Real.sqrt p = s at hs hps hinv
    refine ⟨!![s, 0; q * s⁻¹, s⁻¹], ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
      simp only [cylM00, cylM01, cylM11, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_zero,
        Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.empty_val', Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
    · linear_combination hinv
    · linear_combination (s⁻¹ ^ 2) * hps + (s * s⁻¹ + 1) * hinv
    · linear_combination (-q * s⁻¹ ^ 2) * hps + (-q * (s * s⁻¹)) * hinv
    · linear_combination (q ^ 2 * s⁻¹ ^ 2 - r) * hps + hpr + q ^ 2 * (s * s⁻¹ - 1) * hinv
  have cyl_lipschitz_center : ∀ (V : Set E2), IsOpen V → ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V →
      ∀ (x₀ : E2) (ρ : ℝ), Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ ⊆ V →
      ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ,
        ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ L ∧ |f x - f x₀| ≤ L * ‖x - x₀‖ := by
    intro V hV f hf x₀ ρ hball
    have hc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) V := hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by simp)
    obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x₀ ρ).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hc.mono hball)
    refine ⟨max L₀ 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x hx => ⟨(hL₀ x hx).trans (le_max_left _ _), ?_⟩⟩
    have hρ : 0 ≤ ρ := le_trans dist_nonneg (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hx)
    have hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ
    have hd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y := fun y hy =>
      (hf.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds (hball hy))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hbd : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ ρ, ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ max L₀ 0 := fun y hy =>
      (hL₀ y hy).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := f) (C := max L₀ 0) hd hbd
      (convex_closedBall x₀ ρ) hx₀ hx
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at this
  obtain ⟨hAs, hAsym, hAdet, hApos⟩ := cyl_coeff_field_facts V hV h hh hpos
  have hx₀V : x₀ ∈ V := hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ.le)
  obtain ⟨P, hPdet, hP00, hP01, hP11⟩ := cyl_cholesky_normalise (cylA h x₀ 0 0)
    (cylA h x₀ 0 1) (cylA h x₀ 1 1) (hApos x₀ hx₀V) (hAdet x₀ hx₀V)
  obtain ⟨κ0, hκ0⟩ : ∃ k : ℝ, k = |P 0 0| + |P 0 1| + |P 1 0| + |P 1 1| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκ0nn : 0 ≤ κ0 := by rw [hκ0]; positivity
  have hκpos : 0 < κ0 + 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hΦs, hΦper, hΦnorm, hΦchain⟩ := cyl_polar_grad_chain x₀ P
  simp only [← hκ0] at hΦnorm hΦchain
  have hΦd : ∀ p, DifferentiableAt ℝ (cylPhi x₀ P) p := fun p => hΦs.differentiable (by simp) p
  
  obtain ⟨m00, hm00⟩ : ∃ f : E2 → ℝ, ∀ x, f x = cylM00 P (cylA h x 0 0) (cylA h x 0 1) (cylA h x 1 1) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m01, hm01⟩ : ∃ f : E2 → ℝ, ∀ x, f x = cylM01 P (cylA h x 0 0) (cylA h x 0 1) (cylA h x 1 1) :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: lap2_divergence_form
subgoal_signatures.statement: (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ) (hh : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x i j) U) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ U, (h x).PosDef) (hw : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 w U) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ U) : pd2 0 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 0 j * pd2 j w z) x + pd2 1 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 1 j * pd2 j w z) x = Real.sqrt (h x).det * lap2 h w x

subgoal_signatures.name: cyl_coeff_field_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) V)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ V, (h x).PosDef) :
    (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => cylA h x i j) V) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ V, ∀ i j : Fin 2, cylA h x i j = cylA h x j i) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ V, cylA h x 0 0 * cylA h x 1 1 - cylA h x 0 1 ^ 2 = 1) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ V, 0 < cylA h x 0 0)

subgoal_signatures.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (F₀ F₁ : E2 → ℝ)
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) (h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P p))
    (h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P p)) :
    fplDt (fun q => Real.exp q.1 * (Real.cos q.2 * (P 1 1 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) -
        P 0 1 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)) + Real.sin q.2 * (-P 1 0 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) +
        P 0 0 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)))) p +
      fplDs (fun q => Real.exp q.1 * (-Real.sin q.2 * (P 1 1 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) -
        P 0 1 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)) + Real.cos q.2 * (-P 1 0 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) +
        P 0 0 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)))) p =
    Real.exp (2 * p.1) * (P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0) *
      (pd2 0 F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P p) + pd2 1 F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P p))

    (∀ t < T, fplH a w t = 0 → ∀ θ : ℝ, w (t, θ) = 0)
