proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc, hw, hper, hpt⟩ := hcyl
  set U : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 < T} with hUdef
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const
  have hpi : -Real.pi ≤ Real.pi := by linarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have hD : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fplDt F) U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fplDs F) U := by
    intro F hF
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F) U := hF.fderiv_of_isOpen (m := ∞) hU le_rfl
    exact ⟨h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const, h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const⟩
  have hdiff : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ p ∈ U, DifferentiableAt ℝ F p :=
    fun F hF p hp => (hF.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hcont : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContinuousOn F U → ∀ t : ℝ, t < T →
      Continuous (fun θ : ℝ => F (t, θ)) :=
    fun F hF t ht => hF.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) (fun _ => ht)
  have hlt : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (t θ : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ F (t, θ) →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => F (s, θ)) (fplDt F (t, θ)) t := by
    intro F t θ hF
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s, θ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) t :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t θ)
    exact hF.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t h2
  have hls : ∀ (F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (t θ : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ F (t, θ) →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => F (t, s)) (fplDs F (t, θ)) θ := by
    intro F t θ hF
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (t, s)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) θ :=
      (hasDerivAt_const θ t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' θ)
    exact hF.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt θ h2
  have hmix : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U → ∀ p ∈ U,
      fplDs (fplDt F) p = fplDt (fplDs F) p := by
    intro F hF p hp
    have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) p :=
      ((hF.fderiv_of_isOpen (m := ∞) hU le_rfl).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)).differentiableAt
        (by simp)
    have hsym := (hF.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hp)).isSymmSndFDerivAt
      (by rw [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]; exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.2 le_top)
    have h1 := fderiv_clm_apply (c := fderiv ℝ F) (u := fun _ => ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))) hfd
      (differentiableAt_const _)
    have h2 := fderiv_clm_apply (c := fderiv ℝ F) (u := fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) hfd
      (differentiableAt_const _)
    unfold fplDs fplDt
    rw [h1, h2]
    simp
    exact hsym _ _
  have hperD : ∀ F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, (∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 < T → F (p.1, p.2 + 2 * Real.pi) = F p) →
      ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 < T → fderiv ℝ F (p.1, p.2 + 2 * Real.pi) = fderiv ℝ F p := by
    intro F hF p hp
    have hv : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, q + ((0 : ℝ), 2 * Real.pi) = (q.1, q.2 + 2 * Real.pi) :=
      fun q => Prod.ext (add_zero q.1) rfl
    have hev : (fun q => F (q + ((0 : ℝ), 2 * Real.pi))) =ᶠ[𝓝 p] F := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds (show p ∈ U from hp)] with q hq
      rw [hv]; exact hF q hq
    have h2 := hev.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
    rw [fderiv_comp_add_right] at h2
    rw [← hv]; exact h2
  have hend : ∀ t : ℝ, t < T → a (t, Real.pi) = a (t, -Real.pi) ∧ b (t, Real.pi) = b (t, -Real.pi) ∧
      c (t, Real.pi) = c (t, -Real.pi) ∧ w (t, Real.pi) = w (t, -Real.pi) ∧
      fplDt w (t, Real.pi) = fplDt w (t, -Real.pi) ∧
      fplDs w (t, Real.pi) = fplDs w (t, -Real.pi) := by
    intro t ht
    have e : (((t, -Real.pi) : ℝ × ℝ).1, ((t, -Real.pi) : ℝ × ℝ).2 + 2 * Real.pi) =
        ((t, Real.pi) : ℝ × ℝ) :=
      Prod.ext rfl (show -Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi = Real.pi by ring)
    have h := hper (t, -Real.pi) ht
    have hd := hperD w (fun p hp => (hper p hp).2.2.2) (t, -Real.pi) ht
    rw [e] at h hd
    refine ⟨h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold fplDt; rw [hd]
    · unfold fplDs; rw [hd]
  have hderI : ∀ G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G U → ∀ t : ℝ, t < T →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ θ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, G (s, θ))
        (∫ θ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, fplDt G (t, θ)) t := by
    intro G hG t ht
    have hKc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (t - (T - t) / 2) (t + (T - t) / 2) ×ˢ
        Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi) := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
    have hKU : Set.Icc (t - (T - t) / 2) (t + (T - t) / 2) ×ˢ Set.Icc (-Real.pi) Real.pi ⊆ U := by
      intro q hq
      show q.1 < T
      have := hq.1.2
      linarith
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hKc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn ((hD G hG).1.continuousOn.mono hKU)
    refine (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (μ := volume)
      (F := fun x θ => G (x, θ)) (F' := fun x θ => fplDt G (x, θ)) (bound := fun _ => M)
      (s := Set.Ioo (t - (T - t) / 2) (t + (T - t) / 2))
      (Ioo_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ intervalIntegrable_const ?_).2
    · filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds ht] with x hx
      exact (hcont G hG.continuousOn x hx).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact (hcont G hG.continuousOn t ht).intervalIntegrable _ _
    · exact (hcont _ (hD G hG).1.continuousOn t ht).aestronglyMeasurable
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ hθ x hx => hM (x, θ) ⟨⟨hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩, ?_⟩)
      rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hpi] at hθ
      exact ⟨hθ.1.le, hθ.2⟩
    · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun θ _ x hx => hlt G x θ (hdiff G hG _ ?_))
      show x < T
      linarith [hx.2]
  have hDs0 : ∀ R : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ R U → ∀ t : ℝ, t < T →
      R (t, Real.pi) = R (t, -Real.pi) → ∫ θ in (-Real.pi)..Real.pi, fplDs R (t, θ) = 0 := by
    intro R hR t ht h
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (f := fun θ => R (t, θ))
      (fun θ _ => hls R t θ (hdiff R hR _ ht))
      ((hcont _ (hD R hR).2.continuousOn t ht).intervalIntegrable _ _)]
    show R (t, Real.pi) - R (t, -Real.pi) = 0
    rw [h, sub_self]
  have ha0U : ∀ q ∈ U, a q ≠ 0 := fun q hq => by
    have := (hpt q hq).2.1; intro h; rw [h] at this; norm_num at this
  have ha20U : ∀ q ∈ U, a q ^ 2 ≠ 0 := fun q hq => pow_ne_zero 2 (ha0U q hq)
  have hwt := (hD w hw).1
  have hws := (hD w hw).2
  have hat := (hD a ha).1
  have hbs := (hD b hb).2
  have hV0 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fplV0 a b w) U := (ha.mul hwt).add (hb.mul hws)
  have hV1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fplV1 b c w) U := (hb.mul hwt).add (hc.mul hws)
  have hG1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => a q * w q ^ 2) U := ha.mul (hw.pow 2)
  have hR1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => b q * w q ^ 2) U := hb.mul (hw.pow 2)
  have hG2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => w q * fplV0 a b w q) U := hw.mul hV0
  have hR2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => w q * fplV1 b c w q) U := hw.mul hV1
  have hG3 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => fplV0 a b w q ^ 2 / a q) U := (hV0.pow 2).div ha ha0U
  have hG4 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => fplDs w q ^ 2 / a q) U := (hws.pow 2).div ha ha0U
  have hZ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => -(b q / a q ^ 2) * fplV0 a b w q ^ 2 -
      2 / a q ^ 2 * (fplV0 a b w q * fplDs w q) + b q / a q ^ 2 * fplDs w q ^ 2) U :=
    ((((hb.div (ha.pow 2) ha20U).neg).mul (hV0.pow 2)).sub
      ((contDiffOn_const.div (ha.pow 2) ha20U).mul (hV0.mul hws))).add
      ((hb.div (ha.pow 2) ha20U).mul (hws.pow 2))
  have hgC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => (fplDt a q + fplDs b q) * w q ^ 2) U :=
    (hat.add hbs).mul (hw.pow 2)
  have hqC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun q => (fplDt a q + fplDs b q) *
      (fplDs w q ^ 2 - fplV0 a b w q ^ 2) / a q ^ 2) U :=
    ((hat.add hbs).mul ((hws.pow 2).sub (hV0.pow 2))).div (ha.pow 2) ha20U
  have hP1 : ∀ t θ : ℝ, t < T → fplDt (fun q => a q * w q ^ 2) (t, θ) =
      2 * (w (t, θ) * fplV0 a b w (t, θ)) + (fplDt a (t, θ) + fplDs b (t, θ)) * w (t, θ) ^ 2 -
        fplDs (fun q => b q * w q ^ 2) (t, θ) := by
    intro t θ ht
    have hp : (t, θ) ∈ U := ht
    have e1 := (hlt (fun q => a q * w q ^ 2) t θ (hdiff _ hG1 _ hp)).unique
      ((hlt a t θ (hdiff a ha _ hp)).mul ((hlt w t θ (hdiff w hw _ hp)).pow 2))
    have e2 := (hls (fun q => b q * w q ^ 2) t θ (hdiff _ hR1 _ hp)).unique
      ((hls b t θ (hdiff b hb _ hp)).mul ((hls w t θ (hdiff w hw _ hp)).pow 2))
    rw [e1, e2]
    simp only [fplV0]
    norm_num
    ring
  have hP2 : ∀ t θ : ℝ, t < T → fplDt (fun q => w q * fplV0 a b w q) (t, θ) =
      fplV0 a b w (t, θ) ^ 2 / a (t, θ) + fplDs w (t, θ) ^ 2 / a (t, θ) -
        fplDs (fun q => w q * fplV1 b c w q) (t, θ) := by
    intro t θ ht
    have hp : (t, θ) ∈ U := ht
    have ha0 := ha0U _ hp
    have e1 := (hlt (fun q => w q * fplV0 a b w q) t θ (hdiff _ hG2 _ hp)).unique
      ((hlt w t θ (hdiff w hw _ hp)).mul (hlt _ t θ (hdiff _ hV0 _ hp)))
    have e2 := (hls (fun q => w q * fplV1 b c w q) t θ (hdiff _ hR2 _ hp)).unique
      ((hls w t θ (hdiff w hw _ hp)).mul (hls _ t θ (hdiff _ hV1 _ hp)))
    have E1 := (hpt _ hp).2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
    have E2 := (hpt _ hp).1
    rw [e1, e2]
    have hV0t : fplDt (fplV0 a b w) (t, θ) = -fplDs (fplV1 b c w) (t, θ) := by linarith
    have hc' : c (t, θ) = (1 + b (t, θ) ^ 2) / a (t, θ) := by
      field_simp; linarith
    rw [hV0t]
    simp only [fplV0, fplV1]
    rw [hc']
    field_simp
    ring
  have hP3 : ∀ t θ : ℝ, t < T →
      fplDt (fun q => fplV0 a b w q ^ 2 / a q) (t, θ) -
        fplDt (fun q => fplDs w q ^ 2 / a q) (t, θ) =
      fplDs (fun q => -(b q / a q ^ 2) * fplV0 a b w q ^ 2 -
        2 / a q ^ 2 * (fplV0 a b w q * fplDs w q) + b q / a q ^ 2 * fplDs w q ^ 2) (t, θ) +
      (fplDt a (t, θ) + fplDs b (t, θ)) * (fplDs w (t, θ) ^ 2 - fplV0 a b w (t, θ) ^ 2) /
        a (t, θ) ^ 2 := by
    intro t θ ht
    have hp : (t, θ) ∈ U := ht
    have ha0 := ha0U _ hp
    have ha20 := ha20U _ hp
    have dA := hdiff a ha _ hp
    have dB := hdiff b hb _ hp
    have dC := hdiff c hc _ hp
    have dWt := hdiff _ hwt _ hp
    have dWs := hdiff _ hws _ hp
    have dV0 := hdiff _ hV0 _ hp
    have dV1 := hdiff _ hV1 _ hp
    have E4 := hmix w hw _ hp
    have e1 := (hlt (fun q => fplV0 a b w q ^ 2 / a q) t θ (hdiff _ hG3 _ hp)).unique
      (((hlt _ t θ dV0).pow 2).div (hlt _ t θ dA) ha0)
    have e2 := (hlt (fun q => fplDs w q ^ 2 / a q) t θ (hdiff _ hG4 _ hp)).unique
      (((hlt _ t θ dWs).pow 2).div (hlt _ t θ dA) ha0)

          have heq : 4 * C₁ * Real.exp t * (fplV0 a b w (t, θ) ^ 2 / a (t, θ) +
              fplDs w (t, θ) ^ 2 / a (t, θ)) * a (t, θ) ^ 2 =
              4 * C₁ * Real.exp t * (fplDs w (t, θ) ^ 2 + fplV0 a b w (t, θ) ^ 2) * a (t, θ) := by
            field_simp; ring
          rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < a (t, θ) ^ 2),
            div_le_iff₀ (by positivity), heq]
          nlinarith
      _ = 4 * C₁ * Real.exp t * (fplX a b w t + fplY a w t) := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_add iX iY]
          rfl
  exact ⟨hH0, hX0, hY0, hCS, hHd, hgb, hDd, hQd, hqb⟩

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hRc : IsCompact {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hRconn : IsConnected {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (hreg : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) = 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x ≠ 0)
    (hbd : ∃ q ∈ S, b q = 0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => u (P.param j x) ^ 2) ≤ C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u)

signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hRc : IsCompact {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hRconn : IsConnected {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q})
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (hreg : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) = 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) x ≠ 0)
    (hbd : ∃ q ∈ S, b q = 0) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => u (P.param j x) ^ 2) ≤ C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hρc' : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x)) (P.W j) :=
    fun j => (hρs j j).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hnn, ⟨A, hA0, hAb⟩, -⟩ := eig_wint_facts S P ρ Kc hρnn hρc' hK hρK
  have hQ : ∀ j, ∀ q ∈ S, q ∈ P.O j → P.proj j q ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j (P.proj j q) = q := by
    intro j q hqS hqO
    have hq : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hqO, hqS⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hq
    rw [P.proj_param j x hx]
    exact ⟨hx, rfl⟩
  have hparS : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ P.O j ∩ S := by
    intro j x hx
    rw [← P.image_eq j]
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hsome : ∀ q ∈ S, 0 ≤ b q → ∃ j, ρ j q ≠ 0 := by
    intro q hq hbq
    have h1 : ∑ j, ρ j q ≠ 0 := by rw [hρ1 q hq hbq]; exact one_ne_zero
    obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero h1
    exact ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hinO : ∀ j q, ρ j q ≠ 0 → q ∈ P.O j := by
    intro j q h
    by_contra hc
    exact h (hρO j q hc)
  
  have hV : ∀ (u : X → ℝ) (c : ℝ), (∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
      ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ P.W k, b (P.param k x) < c →
        u (P.param k x) = 0 ∧ eigGam P u u k x = 0 := by
    intro u c hcu k x hx hbx
    have hVo : IsOpen (P.W k ∩ (fun y => b (P.param k y)) ⁻¹' Set.Iio c) :=
      (hb k).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open k) isOpen_Iio
    have hzero : ∀ y ∈ P.W k ∩ (fun y => b (P.param k y)) ⁻¹' Set.Iio c, u (P.param k y) = 0 :=
      fun y hy => hcu _ (hparS k y hy.1).2 hy.2
    have hev : (fun y => u (P.param k y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hVo.mem_nhds ⟨hx, hbx⟩) hzero
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => u (P.param k y)) x = 0 := by
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
      simp
    refine ⟨hzero x ⟨hx, hbx⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [eigGam, pd2, hfd]
  
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ : ∃ R : Set X, R = {q | q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemR : ∀ q, q ∈ R ↔ q ∈ S ∧ 0 ≤ b q := fun q => by rw [hR]; exact Iff.rfl
  have hRpc : IsPreconnected R := by rw [hR]; exact hRconn.isPreconnected
  
  obtain ⟨m, jr, a, b', s, hs, hsub, hcovK⟩ := pcr_poinc_square_cover P.n P.W P.W_open Kc hK
  have hc0 : Continuous (fun x : E2 => x 0) := by fun_prop
  have hc1 : Continuous (fun x : E2 => x 1) := by fun_prop
  have hQoOpen : ∀ r, IsOpen {x : E2 | a r < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a r + s r ∧ b' r < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b' r + s r} := by
    intro r
    exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc0).inter ((isOpen_lt hc0 continuous_const).inter
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const hc1).inter (isOpen_lt hc1 continuous_const)))
  obtain ⟨Gs, hGs⟩ : ∃ Gs : Fin m → Set X, Gs = fun r => P.O (jr r) ∩ P.proj (jr r) ⁻¹'
      {x : E2 | a r < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a r + s r ∧ b' r < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b' r + s r} := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hmemG : ∀ r q, q ∈ Gs r ↔ q ∈ P.O (jr r) ∧
      P.proj (jr r) q ∈ {x : E2 | a r < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a r + s r ∧ b' r < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b' r + s r} := by
    intro r q
    rw [hGs]
    exact Iff.rfl
  have hGopen : ∀ r, IsOpen (Gs r) := by
    intro r
    rw [hGs]
    exact (P.proj_cont (jr r)).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open _) (hQoOpen r)
  
  have hM : ∀ r, ∀ x ∈ P.W (jr r), 0 ≤ b (P.param (jr r) x) →
      x ∈ {y : E2 | a r < y 0 ∧ y 0 < a r + s r ∧ b' r < y 1 ∧ y 1 < b' r + s r} →
      P.param (jr r) x ∈ R ∩ Gs r := by
    intro r x hx hbx hxQ
    obtain ⟨hO, hS⟩ := hparS (jr r) x hx
    refine ⟨(hmemR _).2 ⟨hS, hbx⟩, (hmemG r _).2 ⟨hO, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [P.proj_param _ x hx]
    exact hxQ
  
  have hRpt : ∀ q ∈ S, 0 ≤ b q → ∃ r, P.proj (jr r) q ∈ P.W (jr r) ∧
      P.param (jr r) (P.proj (jr r) q) = q ∧
      P.proj (jr r) q ∈ {y : E2 | a r < y 0 ∧ y 0 < a r + s r ∧ b' r < y 1 ∧ y 1 < b' r + s r} ∧
      q ∈ R ∩ Gs r := by
    intro q hq hbq
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hsome q hq hbq
    have hqO := hinO j q hj
    obtain ⟨hxW, hpx⟩ := hQ j q hq hqO
    have hxK : P.proj j q ∈ Kc j := by
      by_contra hc
      have h0 := hρK j _ hxW hc
      rw [hpx] at h0
      exact hj h0
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hxr⟩ := hcovK j _ hxK
    subst hr
    refine ⟨r, hxW, hpx, hxr, ?_⟩
    have := hM r _ hxW (by rw [hpx]; exact hbq) hxr
    rwa [hpx] at this
  have hcovι : R ⊆ ⋃ i : {r : Fin m // (R ∩ Gs r).Nonempty}, Gs i.1 := by
    intro q hqR
    obtain ⟨hq, hbq⟩ := (hmemR q).1 hqR
    obtain ⟨r, -, -, -, hqRG⟩ := hRpt q hq hbq
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨r, ⟨q, hqRG⟩⟩, hqRG.2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨mean, hmean⟩ : ∃ mean : Fin m → (X → ℝ) → ℝ, mean = fun r u =>
      (∫ x in {x : E2 | a r ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a r + s r ∧ b' r ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b' r + s r},
        u (P.param (jr r) x)) / s r ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨osc, hosc⟩ : ∃ osc : Fin m → (X → ℝ) → ℝ, osc = fun r u =>
      ∫ x in {x : E2 | a r ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a r + s r ∧ b' r ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b' r + s r},
        (u (P.param (jr r) x) - (∫ y in {y : E2 | a r ≤ y 0 ∧ y 0 < a r + s r ∧ b' r ≤ y 1 ∧
          y 1 < b' r + s r}, u (P.param (jr r) y)) / s r ^ 2) ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hC : ∀ r, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : X → ℝ,
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
      osc r u ≤ C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u) := by
    intro r
    obtain ⟨hQc, C, hC0, hCv⟩ := pcgb_dp_square_chart (P.W (jr r)) (P.W_open _) (P.h (jr r))
      (fun i k => P.h_smooth (jr r) i k) (P.h_posDef (jr r)) (a r) (b' r) (s r) (hs r) (hsub r)
    refine ⟨C, hC0, fun u hu hadm => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcu⟩ := hadm
    have h1 := hCv (fun x => u (P.param (jr r) x)) (hu (jr r))
    have h2 := pcgb_dp_localize S P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hK hρK hρO b hρ1 (eigGam P u u)
      (fun j => (eig_gam_facts S P u u hu hu j).1) (fun j => (eig_gam_facts S P u u hu hu j).2.1)
      (fun j i x hx => eig_grad_pair_compat S P u u hu hu j i x hx) (jr r)
      (fun x hx hbx => (hV u c hcu (jr r) x hx (by linarith)).2)
      _ hQc (hsub r)
    simp only [hosc]
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hC0)
  choose C hC0 hCb using hC
  
  obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀S, hbq₀⟩ := hbd
  obtain ⟨r₀, hx₀W, hpx₀, hx₀Q, hq₀RG⟩ := hRpt q₀ hq₀S (le_of_eq hbq₀.symm)
  have hb0 : b (P.param (jr r₀) (P.proj (jr r₀) q₀)) = 0 := by rw [hpx₀]; exact hbq₀
  obtain ⟨y, ⟨hyQ, hyW⟩, hby⟩ := pcgb_dp_negative_point (P.W (jr r₀)) (P.W_open _)
    (fun x => b (P.param (jr r₀) x)) (hb _) _ hx₀W hb0 (hreg _ _ hx₀W hb0) _ (hQoOpen r₀) hx₀Q
  obtain ⟨U₀, hU₀⟩ : ∃ U₀ : Set E2, U₀ =
      {x : E2 | a r₀ < x 0 ∧ x 0 < a r₀ + s r₀ ∧ b' r₀ < x 1 ∧ x 1 < b' r₀ + s r₀} ∩
        (P.W (jr r₀) ∩ (fun x => b (P.param (jr r₀) x)) ⁻¹' Set.Iio 0) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hU₀o : IsOpen U₀ := by
    rw [hU₀]
    exact (hQoOpen r₀).inter
      ((hb _).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open _) isOpen_Iio)
  have hU₀ne : U₀.Nonempty := ⟨y, by rw [hU₀]; exact ⟨hyQ, hyW, hby⟩⟩
  have hU₀Q : U₀ ⊆ {x : E2 | a r₀ ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a r₀ + s r₀ ∧ b' r₀ ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b' r₀ + s r₀} := by
    rw [hU₀]
    rintro x ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩, -⟩
    exact ⟨h1.le, h2, h3.le, h4⟩
  obtain ⟨hμ, hanc⟩ := pcgb_dp_anchor_mean (a r₀) (b' r₀) (s r₀) (hs r₀) U₀ hU₀o hU₀ne hU₀Q
  have hD₀ : ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧ ∀ u : X → ℝ,
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
      (mean r₀ u) ^ 2 ≤ D * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u) := by
    refine ⟨C r₀ / (MeasureTheory.volume U₀).toReal, div_nonneg (hC0 r₀) hμ.le,
      fun u hu hadm => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcu⟩ := hadm
    have hvan : ∀ x ∈ U₀, u (P.param (jr r₀) x) = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      rw [hU₀] at hx
      have hbx : b (P.param (jr r₀) x) < 0 := hx.2.2
      exact (hV u c hcu _ x hx.2.1 (by linarith)).1
    have h1 := hanc (fun x => u (P.param (jr r₀) x)) ((hu (jr r₀)).continuousOn.mono (hsub r₀))
      hvan
    have h2 := hCb r₀ u hu ⟨c, hc, hcu⟩
    simp only [hosc] at h2
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀ hμ]
    simp only [hmean]
    linarith [h1, h2]
  
  have hedge : ∀ r r', (R ∩ Gs r ∩ Gs r').Nonempty → ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧ ∀ u : X → ℝ,
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
      (mean r u - mean r' u) ^ 2 ≤ D * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u) := by
    rintro r r' ⟨q, ⟨hqR, hq1⟩, hq2⟩
    rw [hmemG] at hq1 hq2
    have hqS := ((hmemR q).1 hqR).1
    obtain ⟨D, hD0, hD⟩ := pcr_poinc_overlap_means S P (jr r) (jr r') (a r) (b' r) (s r)
      (a r') (b' r') (s r') (hs r) (hs r') (hsub r) (hsub r') q hqS hq1.1 hq2.1 hq1.2 hq2.2
    refine ⟨D * (C r + C r'), mul_nonneg hD0 (add_nonneg (hC0 r) (hC0 r')),
      fun u hu hadm => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hD u (fun i => (hu i).continuousOn)
    have h2 := hCb r u hu hadm
    have h3 := hCb r' u hu hadm
    simp only [hosc] at h2 h3
    simp only [hmean]
    calc _ ≤ _ := h1
      _ ≤ D * (C r * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u) + C r' * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add h2 h3) hD0
      _ = _ := by ring
  
  have hchain : ∀ r, ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧ ∀ u : X → ℝ,
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
      (R ∩ Gs r).Nonempty → (mean r u) ^ 2 ≤ D * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u) := by
    intro r
    by_cases hr : (R ∩ Gs r).Nonempty
    · have hreach := pcr_poinc_reach R hRpc
        (fun i : {r : Fin m // (R ∩ Gs r).Nonempty} => Gs i.1) (fun i => hGopen i.1) hcovι
        (fun i => i.2) ⟨r₀, ⟨q₀, hq₀RG⟩⟩ ⟨r, hr⟩
      suffices H : ∀ i : {r : Fin m // (R ∩ Gs r).Nonempty},
          Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => (R ∩ Gs a.1 ∩ Gs b.1).Nonempty)
            ⟨r₀, ⟨q₀, hq₀RG⟩⟩ i →
          ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧ ∀ u : X → ℝ,
            (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
            (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
            (mean i.1 u) ^ 2 ≤ D * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u) by
        obtain ⟨D, hD0, hD⟩ := H _ hreach
        exact ⟨D, hD0, fun u hu hadm _ => hD u hu hadm⟩
      intro i hi
      induction hi with
      | refl => exact hD₀
      | @tail i₁ i₂ _ hbc ih =>
        obtain ⟨D₁, hD₁, h₁⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨D₂, hD₂, h₂⟩ := hedge i₁.1 i₂.1 hbc
        refine ⟨2 * D₂ + 2 * D₁, by positivity, fun u hu hadm => ?_⟩
        have e1 := h₁ u hu hadm
        have e2 := h₂ u hu hadm
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * mean i₁.1 u - mean i₂.1 u)]
    · exact ⟨0, le_rfl, fun u _ _ h => absurd h hr⟩
  choose Dm hDm0 hDmb using hchain
  
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ T : ℝ, T = ∑ j, ∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.filter
      (fun r => jr r = j ∧ (R ∩ Gs r).Nonempty), (2 * C r + 2 * s r ^ 2 * Dm r) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT0 : 0 ≤ T := by
    rw [hT]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun r _ => ?_))
    have h1 := hC0 r
    have h2 := hDm0 r
    positivity
  refine ⟨A * T, mul_nonneg hA0.le hT0, fun u hu hadm => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcu⟩ := hadm
  have hcont : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j) :=
    fun j => (hu j).continuousOn
  have hN := hAb (fun j x => u (P.param j x) ^ 2) (fun j => (hcont j).pow 2)
    (fun j x _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have hKj : ∀ j, ∫ x in Kc j, u (P.param j x) ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun r => jr r = j ∧ (R ∩ Gs r).Nonempty),
        (2 * C r + 2 * s r ^ 2 * Dm r)) * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u) := by
    intro j
    have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Kc j \ (Kc j ∩ {x | 0 ≤ b (P.param j x)}), u (P.param j x) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rintro x ⟨hxK, hxL⟩
      have hbx : b (P.param j x) < 0 := by
        by_contra hcon
        exact hxL ⟨hxK, not_lt.mp hcon⟩
      rw [(hV u c hcu j x ((hK j).2 hxK) (by linarith)).1]
      ring
    have hL : ∫ x in Kc j, u (P.param j x) ^ 2 =
        ∫ x in Kc j ∩ {x | 0 ≤ b (P.param j x)}, (u (P.param j x) - 0) ^ 2 := by
      rw [setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero (hK j).1.isClosed.measurableSet
        Set.inter_subset_left hdiff]
      simp only [sub_zero]
    have hcs := pcr_poinc_cover_sum (Finset.univ.filter (fun r => jr r = j ∧ (R ∩ Gs r).Nonempty))
      (P.W j) (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (hcont j) a b' s (fun r _ => hs r)

    fun v j hv x hx => (hv.contDiffAt ((P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hpdcG : ∀ (v : X → ℝ) j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j) →
      ∀ k : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 k (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x) (P.W j) := by
    intro v j hv k
    exact (hv.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (P.W_open j) (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
  have hEc : ∀ (v : X → ℝ) j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j) →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => v (P.param j x) ^ 2 +
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x) ^ 2) (P.W j) := by
    intro v j hv
    exact (hv.continuousOn.pow 2).add
      (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun k _ => (hpdcG v j hv k).pow 2)
  have hsub_adm : ∀ m l,
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (u m - u l) (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) ∧
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → (u m - u l) q = 0) := by
    intro m l
    refine ⟨fun i => (hua m i).sub (hua l i), ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, h₁⟩ := hub m
    obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, h₂⟩ := hub l
    refine ⟨min c₁ c₂, lt_min hc₁ hc₂, fun q hq hbq => ?_⟩
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, h₁ q hq (lt_of_lt_of_le hbq (min_le_left _ _)),
      h₂ q hq (lt_of_lt_of_le hbq (min_le_right _ _)), sub_zero]
  have hpdsub : ∀ m l j (k : Fin 2), ∀ x ∈ P.W j,
      pd2 k (fun y => (u m - u l) (P.param j y)) x =
        pd2 k (fun y => u m (P.param j y)) x - pd2 k (fun y => u l (P.param j y)) x := by
    intro m l j k x hx
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => u m (P.param j y) - u l (P.param j y)) x (e2 k) = _
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hdiff (u m) j (hua m j) x hx) (hdiff (u l) j (hua l j) x hx),
      ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
    rfl
  
  have hcauchyV : ∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ,
      ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l →
        ∫ x in L, ((u m - u l) (P.param j x) ^ 2 +
          ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun y => (u m - u l) (P.param j y)) x) ^ 2) < ε := by
    intro j L hL hLW ε hε
    obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ :=
      pcgb_ws_local_control S P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hK hρK hρO b hb hρ1 hpoinc j L hL hLW
    have hC1 : (0 : ℝ) < C + 1 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hcau (ε / (C + 1)) (div_pos hε hC1)
    refine ⟨N, fun m l hm hl => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hC (u m - u l) (hsub_adm m l).1 (hsub_adm m l).2
    have h2 := hN m l hm hl
    have h3 : C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (u m - u l) (u m - u l)) ≤ C * (ε / (C + 1)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2.le hC0
    have h4 : C * (ε / (C + 1)) < ε := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc', div_lt_iff₀ hC1]
      nlinarith
    linarith
  have hvalC : ∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ,
      ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l →
        ∫ x in L, ((fun m x => u m (P.param j x)) m x - (fun m x => u m (P.param j x)) l x) ^ 2
          < ε := by
    intro j L hL hLW ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hcauchyV j L hL hLW ε hε
    refine ⟨N, fun m l hm hl => lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (hN m l hm hl)⟩
    apply setIntegral_mono_on
    · exact ((((hua m j).continuousOn.sub (hua l j).continuousOn).pow 2).mono hLW).integrableOn_compact hL
    · exact ((hEc (u m - u l) j ((hsub_adm m l).1 j)).mono hLW).integrableOn_compact hL
    · exact hL.measurableSet
    · intro x _
      have e : (u m - u l) (P.param j x) = u m (P.param j x) - u l (P.param j x) := rfl
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun y => (u m - u l) (P.param j y)) x) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)
      rw [e]
      show (u m (P.param j x) - u l (P.param j x)) ^ 2 ≤ _
      linarith
  have hderC : ∀ j (k : Fin 2) (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l →
        ∫ x in L, ((fun m x => pd2 k (fun y => u m (P.param j y)) x) m x -
          (fun m x => pd2 k (fun y => u m (P.param j y)) x) l x) ^ 2 < ε := by
    intro j k L hL hLW ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hcauchyV j L hL hLW ε hε
    refine ⟨N, fun m l hm hl => lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (hN m l hm hl)⟩
    apply setIntegral_mono_on
    · exact ((((hpdcG (u m) j (hua m j) k).sub (hpdcG (u l) j (hua l j) k)).pow 2).mono
        hLW).integrableOn_compact hL
    · exact ((hEc (u m - u l) j ((hsub_adm m l).1 j)).mono hLW).integrableOn_compact hL
    · exact hL.measurableSet
    · intro x hx
      show (pd2 k (fun y => u m (P.param j y)) x - pd2 k (fun y => u l (P.param j y)) x) ^ 2 ≤ _
      rw [← hpdsub m l j k x (hLW hx)]
      have h0 : 0 ≤ (u m - u l) (P.param j x) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have h1 : (pd2 k (fun y => (u m - u l) (P.param j y)) x) ^ 2 ≤
          ∑ k' : Fin 2, (pd2 k' (fun y => (u m - u l) (P.param j y)) x) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun k' => (pd2 k' (fun y => (u m - u l) (P.param j y)) x) ^ 2)
          (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ k)
      linarith
  
  have hW : ∀ j, ∃ wj : E2 → ℝ,
      (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j → MemLp wj 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j →
        Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (u m (P.param j x) - wj x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    fun j => pcgb_ws_l2loc_limit (P.W j) (P.W_open j) (fun m x => u m (P.param j x))
      (fun m => (hua m j).continuousOn) (hvalC j)
  have hG : ∀ j (k : Fin 2), ∃ Gjk : E2 → ℝ,
      (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j → MemLp Gjk 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j →
        Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (pd2 k (fun y => u m (P.param j y)) x - Gjk x) ^ 2)
          atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    fun j k => pcgb_ws_l2loc_limit (P.W j) (P.W_open j)
      (fun m x => pd2 k (fun y => u m (P.param j y)) x)
      (fun m => hpdcG (u m) j (hua m j) k) (hderC j k)
  choose w hwL2 hwconv using hW
  choose G hGL2 hGconv using hG
  have hc : ∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j →
      MemLp (w j) 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ k, MemLp (G j k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (u m (P.param j x) - w j x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ k, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L,
        (pd2 k (fun y => u m (P.param j y)) x - G j k x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    fun j L hL hLW => ⟨hwL2 j L hL hLW, fun k => hGL2 j k L hL hLW, hwconv j L hL hLW,
      fun k => hGconv j k L hL hLW⟩
  
  have hd : ∀ j (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W j →
      ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x, w j x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, G j k x * ζ x) :=
    fun j => pcgb_ws_weak_deriv (P.W j) (P.W_open j) (fun m y => u m (P.param j y))
      (fun m => hua m j) (w j) (G j) (hc j)
  
  have he : ∀ j (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W j ∩ {x | 0 < b (P.param j x)} →
      ∫ x, ((∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * G j c x * pd2 a ζ x) +
        Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x) = 0 := by
    intro j ζ hζ hζc hζs
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ1, hZ2, hφ, hint, hB, hΛ⟩ :=
      pcgb_ws_test_pairing S P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hK hρK hρO b hb hρ1 f hfc j ζ hζ hζc hζs
    have hT : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc.isCompact
    have hTW : tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W j := fun x hx => (hζs hx).1
    have hP := l2_compact_pairing (tsupport ζ) hT
    have hrw : ∀ n, eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (u n) Z) +
        eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => f (P.param i x) * Z (P.param i x)) =
        (∑ c : Fin 2, ∫ x, pd2 c (fun y => u n (P.param j y)) x *
          (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x)) +
        ∫ x, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x := by
      intro n
      rw [hB (u n) (hua n), hΛ]
    have hlim2 := (tendsto_congr hrw).mp (hEL Z hZ1 hZ2)
    have hpair : ∀ c : Fin 2, Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, pd2 c (fun y => u n (P.param j y)) x *
        (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x)) atTop
        (𝓝 (∫ x, G j c x *
          (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x))) := by
      intro c
      exact hP.2.2 (fun n x => pd2 c (fun y => u n (P.param j y)) x) (G j c) _
        (fun n => hP.1 _ ((hpdcG (u n) j (hua n j) c).mono hTW)) (hGL2 j c _ hT hTW)
        (hφ c).1 (hφ c).2 (hGconv j c _ hT hTW)
    have hsum := (tendsto_finset_sum (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))
      (fun c _ => hpair c)).add_const (∫ x, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x)
    have heq := tendsto_nhds_unique hsum hlim2
    have hpt : ∀ x, ((∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * G j c x * pd2 a ζ x) +
        Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x) =
        (∑ c : Fin 2, G j c x *
          (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x)) +
        Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x := by
      intro x
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    have hintc : ∀ c : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => G j c x *
        (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x)) :=
      fun c => hP.2.1 (G j c) _ (hGL2 j c _ hT hTW) (hφ c).1 (hφ c).2
    rw [integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt),
      integral_add (integrable_finset_sum _ fun c _ => hintc c) hint,
      integral_finset_sum _ fun c _ => hintc c]
    exact heq
  
  have hg := pcr_dw_limit_compat S P u (fun m j => (hua m j).continuousOn) w hwL2 hwconv
  exact ⟨u, w, G, hua, hub, hc, hd, he, hg⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: l2_compact_pairing
subgoal_signatures.statement: (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) : (∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f L → MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ f φ : E2 → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L → Integrable (fun x => f x * φ x)) ∧ ∀ (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (w φ : E2 → ℝ), (∀ m, MemLp (v m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) → MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, v m x * φ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, w x * φ x))

subgoal_signatures.name: pcr_dw_limit_compat
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (v : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ m j, ContinuousOn (fun x => v m (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (w : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j → MemLp (w j) 2 (volume.restrict L))
    (hconv : ∀ j (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ P.W j →
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m (P.param j x) - w j x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ j k, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k)),
      w j x = w k (P.proj k (P.param j x))

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_ws_var_seq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (f : X → ℝ) (hfc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => f (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hpoinc : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : X → ℝ,
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => u (P.param j x) ^ 2) ≤ C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u)) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → X → ℝ,
      (∀ m j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u m (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
      (∀ m, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u m q = 0) ∧
      (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m n, N ≤ m → N ≤ n →
        eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (u m - u n) (u m - u n)) < ε) ∧
      (∀ φ : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => φ (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) →
        (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → φ q = 0) →
        Tendsto (fun n => eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (u n) φ) +
          eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) * φ (P.param j x))) atTop (𝓝 0))

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_ws_local_control
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (hpoinc : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : X → ℝ,
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => u (P.param j x) ^ 2) ≤ C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u))
    (j : Fin P.n) (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) (hLW : L ⊆ P.W j) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ v : X → ℝ,
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → v q = 0) →
      ∫ x in L, ((v (P.param j x)) ^ 2 +
          ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x) ^ 2) ≤
        C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P v v)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_ws_l2loc_limit
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ m, ContinuousOn (v m) W)
    (hcauchy : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ,
      ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l → ∫ x in L, (v m x - v l x) ^ 2 < ε) :
    ∃ w : E2 → ℝ, (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W →
        Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_ws_weak_deriv
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (v m) W) (w : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W →
      MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ k, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (pd2 k (v m) x - G k x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W →
      ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, G k x * ζ x)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_ws_test_pairing
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (f : X → ℝ) (hfc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => f (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (j : Fin P.n) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ)
    (hζs : tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W j ∩ {x | 0 < b (P.param j x)}) :
    ∃ Z : X → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Z (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) ∧
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → Z q = 0) ∧
      (∀ c : Fin 2,
        Continuous (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) ∧
        tsupport (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) ⊆
          tsupport ζ) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x) ∧
      (∀ v : X → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
        eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P v Z) = ∑ c : Fin 2, ∫ x, pd2 c (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x *
          (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x)) ∧
      eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => f (P.param i x) * Z (P.param i x)) =
        ∫ x, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (β : E2 → ℝ) (hβ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ β W)
    (x₀ : E2) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ W) (hβ0 : β x₀ = 0) (hdβ : fderiv ℝ β x₀ ≠ 0)
    (u : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hu : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u m) W)
    (huz : ∀ m, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, β x < c → u m x = 0)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W →
      MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (u m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ k, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (pd2 k (u m) x - G k x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ W ∩ {x | 0 < β x} →
      ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a c * G c x * pd2 a ζ x = 0) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ W ∧ ∃ V : E2 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V (Metric.ball x₀ r) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x₀ r ∩ {x | 0 < β x})), w x = V x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, 0 ≤ β x → lap2 h V x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, β x = 0 → V x = 0)

signature.name: pcgb_ds_boundary_regularity
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (β : E2 → ℝ) (hβ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ β W)
    (x₀ : E2) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ W) (hβ0 : β x₀ = 0) (hdβ : fderiv ℝ β x₀ ≠ 0)
    (u : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hu : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u m) W)
    (huz : ∀ m, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, β x < c → u m x = 0)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W →
      MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (u m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ k, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (pd2 k (u m) x - G k x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ W ∩ {x | 0 < β x} →
      ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a c * G c x * pd2 a ζ x = 0) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ W ∧ ∃ V : E2 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V (Metric.ball x₀ r) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x₀ r ∩ {x | 0 < β x})), w x = V x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, 0 ≤ β x → lap2 h V x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r, β x = 0 → V x = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨ρ, N, Φ, Ψ, hρ, hNo, hx₀N, hNW, hΦ0, hΦs, hΨs, hΦN, hΨB, hβΨ, hdet⟩ :=
    pcgb_bdr_flat_chart W hW β hβ x₀ hx₀ hβ0 hdβ
  have hBo : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hinj : Set.InjOn Ψ (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rw [← (hΨB a ha).2, ← (hΨB b hb).2, hab]
  have hΨW : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, Ψ z ∈ W := fun z hz => hNW (hΨB z hz).1
  obtain ⟨hts, htpd, hid⟩ := pcgb_bdr_pull_metric (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) N hBo hNo Ψ hΨs
    (fun z hz => (hΨB z hz).1) hdet h (fun a c => (hh a c).mono hNW)
    (fun x hx => hpd x (hNW hx))
  obtain ⟨hsqpos, hsqs, hinvs, hApd⟩ :=
    elr_coeff_smooth (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) hBo (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ) hts htpd
  obtain ⟨At, hAt⟩ : ∃ At : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, ∀ z a c,
      At z a c = Real.sqrt (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z).det * (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z)⁻¹ a c :=
    ⟨fun z => Real.sqrt (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z).det • (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z)⁻¹, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  have hAteq : ∀ z, At z = Real.sqrt (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z).det • (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z)⁻¹ := by
    intro z
    ext a c
    rw [hAt, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hApd' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (At z).PosDef := fun z hz => by
    rw [hAteq]
    exact hApd z hz
  have hAs : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ a b : Fin 2, At z a b = At z b a :=
    fun z hz a b => ((hApd' z hz).isHermitian.apply a b).symm.trans (star_trivial _)
  have hAsm : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => At z a b) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) :=
    fun a b => (hsqs.mul (hinvs a b)).congr (fun z _ => hAt z a b)
  have hu' : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => u m (Ψ y)) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) :=
    fun m => (hu m).comp hΨs (fun z hz => hΨW z hz)
  have huz' : ∀ m, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, z 0 < c → u m (Ψ z) = 0 := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcz⟩ := huz m
    refine ⟨c, hc, fun z hz hz0 => hcz _ (hΨW z hz) ?_⟩
    rw [hβΨ z hz]
    exact hz0
  have hL2' := pcgb_bdr_l2_transport W (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) hW hBo Ψ hΨs hΨW hinj hdet
    u hu w G hL2
  have hid' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ q : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, At z a c * pcgbBdrVec G Ψ c z *
          (∑ a' : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 a) a' * q a') =
        |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
          (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det • (h x)⁻¹) (Ψ z) a c * G c (Ψ z) * q a := by
    intro z hz q
    have := hid z hz (fun c' => G c' (Ψ z)) q
    simp only [hAt, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    exact this
  have hweak' := pcgb_bdr_weak_transport W N (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) hNo hBo hNW Φ Ψ hΦs hΨs
    hΦN hΨB β hβΨ (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det • (h x)⁻¹) At G (pcgbBdrVec G Ψ) hid' hweak
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsρ, Vt, hVs, hVae, hVeq, hVd⟩ :=
    pcgb_bdr_flat2_regularity ρ hρ At hAsm hAs hApd' (fun m y => u m (Ψ y)) hu' huz'
      (fun z => w (Ψ z)) (pcgbBdrVec G Ψ) hL2' hweak'
  have hsB : Metric.ball (0 : E2) s ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := Metric.ball_subset_ball hsρ
  have hN'o : IsOpen (N ∩ Φ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : E2) s) :=
    hΦs.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage hNo Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hx₀N' : x₀ ∈ N ∩ Φ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : E2) s := by
    refine ⟨hx₀N, ?_⟩
    show Φ x₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) s
    rw [hΦ0]
    exact Metric.mem_ball_self hs
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hN'o x₀ hx₀N'
  have hballW : Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ W := fun x hx => hNW (hrsub hx).1
  have hVsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Vt (Φ x)) (Metric.ball x₀ r) :=
    hVs.comp (hΦs.mono (fun x hx => (hrsub hx).1)) (fun x hx => (hrsub hx).2)
  refine ⟨r, hr, hballW, fun x => Vt (Φ x), hVsm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hΩo : IsOpen (Metric.ball x₀ r ∩ {x | 0 < β x}) :=
      (hβ.continuousOn.mono hballW).isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball isOpen_Ioi
    have hΩ'o : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) s ∩ {z : E2 | 0 < z 0}) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' hΩo.measurableSet]
    rw [ae_restrict_iff' hΩ'o.measurableSet] at hVae
    rw [ae_iff] at hVae ⊢
    have hsub : {x : E2 | ¬(x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r ∩ {x | 0 < β x} → w x = Vt (Φ x))} ⊆
        Ψ '' {z : E2 | ¬(z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) s ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} → w (Ψ z) = Vt z)} := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, _root_.not_imp] at hx
      obtain ⟨⟨hxb, hxβ⟩, hne⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨hxN, hΦxs⟩ := hrsub hxb
      have hΨΦ := (hΦN x hxN).2
      have h1 := hβΨ (Φ x) (hsB hΦxs)
      rw [hΨΦ] at h1
      refine ⟨Φ x, ?_, hΨΦ⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, _root_.not_imp]
      refine ⟨⟨hΦxs, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · show 0 < Φ x 0
        rw [← h1]
        exact hxβ
      · rw [hΨΦ]
        exact hne
    refine measure_mono_null hsub ?_
    refine addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn_of_addHaar_eq_zero volume ?_ hVae
    refine (hΨs.differentiableOn (by simp)).mono ?_
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, _root_.not_imp] at hz
    exact hsB hz.1.1
  · intro x hx hβx
    obtain ⟨hxN, hΦxs⟩ := hrsub hx
    have hΨΦ := (hΦN x hxN).2
    have h1 := hβΨ (Φ x) (hsB hΦxs)
    rw [hΨΦ] at h1
    have hA'B : Metric.ball (0 : E2) s ∩ Ψ ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ :=
      fun z hz => hsB hz.1
    have hA'o : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) s ∩ Ψ ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r) :=
      (hΨs.continuousOn.mono hsB).isOpen_inter_preimage Metric.isOpen_ball Metric.isOpen_ball
    have hzA : Φ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) s ∩ Ψ ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r := by
      refine ⟨hΦxs, ?_⟩
      show Ψ (Φ x) ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r
      rw [hΨΦ]
      exact hx
    have hchart := lap2_chart_invariant (Metric.ball (0 : E2) s ∩ Ψ ⁻¹' Metric.ball x₀ r)
      (Metric.ball x₀ r) hA'o Metric.isOpen_ball Ψ (hΨs.mono hA'B) (fun z hz => hz.2)
      (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ) h (fun c d => (hts c d).mono hA'B) (fun c d => (hh c d).mono hballW)
      (fun y hy => hpd y (hballW hy)) (fun z hz => htpd z (hA'B hz))
      (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) (fun x => Vt (Φ x)) hVsm Vt
      (fun z hz => by
        show Vt z = Vt (Φ (Ψ z))
        rw [(hΨB z (hA'B hz)).2]) (Φ x) hzA
    rw [hΨΦ] at hchart
    have hdiv := lap2_divergence_form (Metric.ball (0 : E2) s) Metric.isOpen_ball
      (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ) Vt (fun i j => (hts i j).mono hsB) (fun y hy => htpd y (hsB hy))
      (hVs.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)) (Φ x) hΦxs
    have hE := hVeq (Φ x) hΦxs (by rw [← h1]; exact hβx)
    have hfun : ∀ a : Fin 2, (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, At y a b * pd2 b Vt y) =
        (fun y => Real.sqrt (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ y).det *
          ∑ j : Fin 2, (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ y)⁻¹ a j * pd2 j Vt y) := by
      intro a
      funext y
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _ => ?_)
      rw [hAt]
      ring
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hfun 0, hfun 1, hdiv] at hE
    have hpos := hsqpos (Φ x) (hsB hΦxs)
    have hlap : lap2 (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ) Vt (Φ x) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hE with h0 | h0
      · exact absurd h0 hpos.ne'
      · exact h0
    rw [hchart] at hlap
    exact hlap
  · intro x hx hβx
    obtain ⟨hxN, hΦxs⟩ := hrsub hx
    have h1 := hβΨ (Φ x) (hsB hΦxs)
    rw [(hΦN x hxN).2] at h1
    exact hVd (Φ x) hΦxs (h1.symm.trans hβx)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_bdr_flat_chart
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (β : E2 → ℝ) (hβ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ β W)
    (x₀ : E2) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ W) (hβ0 : β x₀ = 0) (hdβ : fderiv ℝ β x₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (N : Set E2) (Φ Ψ : E2 → E2), 0 < ρ ∧ IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ W ∧ Φ x₀ = 0 ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ N ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ N, Φ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∧ Ψ (Φ x) = x) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, Ψ z ∈ N ∧ Φ (Ψ z) = z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, β (Ψ z) = z 0) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det ≠ 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_bdr_pull_metric
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(B N : Set E2) (hB : IsOpen B) (hN : IsOpen N) (Ψ : E2 → E2)
    (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ B) (hΨBN : ∀ z ∈ B, Ψ z ∈ N)
    (hdet : ∀ z ∈ B, (fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det ≠ 0) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) N) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ N, (h x).PosDef) :
    (∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z a c) B) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ B, (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z).PosDef) ∧
    ∀ z ∈ B, ∀ g q : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z).det * (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z)⁻¹ a c *
          (∑ c' : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 c) c' * g c') *
          (∑ a' : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 a) a' * q a') =
        |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h (Ψ z)).det * (h (Ψ z))⁻¹ a c * g c * q a

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_bdr_l2_transport
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W B : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (hB : IsOpen B) (Ψ : E2 → E2)
    (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ B) (hΨBW : ∀ z ∈ B, Ψ z ∈ W) (hinj : Set.InjOn Ψ B)
    (hdet : ∀ z ∈ B, (fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det ≠ 0) (u : ℕ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u m) W) (w : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W →
      MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (u m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ k, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (pd2 k (u m) x - G k x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ B →
      MemLp (fun z => w (Ψ z)) 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧
      (∀ k, MemLp (pcgbBdrVec G Ψ k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ z in L, (u m (Ψ z) - w (Ψ z)) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ k, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ z in L,
        (pd2 k (fun y => u m (Ψ y)) z - pcgbBdrVec G Ψ k z) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_bdr_weak_transport
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W N B : Set E2) (hN : IsOpen N) (hB : IsOpen B) (hNW : N ⊆ W)
    (Φ Ψ : E2 → E2) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ N) (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ B)
    (hΦN : ∀ x ∈ N, Φ x ∈ B ∧ Ψ (Φ x) = x) (hΨB : ∀ z ∈ B, Ψ z ∈ N ∧ Φ (Ψ z) = z)
    (β : E2 → ℝ) (hβΨ : ∀ z ∈ B, β (Ψ z) = z 0)
    (A At : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (G Gt : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hid : ∀ z ∈ B, ∀ q : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, At z a c * Gt c z * (∑ a' : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 a) a' * q a') =
        |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A (Ψ z) a c * G c (Ψ z) * q a)
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ W ∩ {x | 0 < β x} →
      ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A x a c * G c x * pd2 a ζ x = 0) :
    ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ B ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} →
      ∫ z, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, At z a c * Gt c z * pd2 a ζ z = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_bdr_flat2_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => A z a b) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ))
    (hAs : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ a b : Fin 2, A z a b = A z b a)
    (hApos : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (A z).PosDef)
    (u : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hu : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u m) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ))
    (huz : ∀ m, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, z 0 < c → u m z = 0)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ →
      MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ z in L, (u m z - w z) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ k, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ z in L, (pd2 k (u m) z - G k z) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} →
      ∫ z, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A z a b * G b z * pd2 a ζ z = 0) :
    ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ ρ ∧ ∃ V : E2 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V (Metric.ball (0 : E2) s) ∧

  have h00 : 0 < A 0 0 := hA.diag_pos
  have h11 : 0 < A 1 1 := hA.diag_pos

  have hdetf : A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsym 1 0]
  have hq : ∀ z : E2, A.det * ‖z‖ ^ 2 ≤

    intro z
    have hn : ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have hQ : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * z a * z c =

      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym 1 0]
      ring
    have hCH : (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * (A 0 0 * z 0 ^ 2 + 2 * A 0 1 * z 0 * z 1 + A 1 1 * z 1 ^ 2) =

          (A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 0 1) * (z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [hQ, hn, hdetf, hCH]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (A 0 0 * z 0 + A 0 1 * z 1), sq_nonneg (A 0 1 * z 0 + A 1 1 * z 1)]

  refine ⟨r * Real.sqrt (A.det / (A 0 0 + A 1 1)) / 16, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ hδ₀
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : E2 → ℝ, ∀ y : E2,

  simp only [← hFdef]

    have hcoord : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) a) := by
      intro a
      have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) a (y - x₀)) :=

      exact h1
    rw [hFe]
    refine ContDiff.sum (fun a _ => ContDiff.sum (fun c _ => ?_))
    exact ((contDiff_const.mul (hcoord a)).mul (hcoord c))

    exact Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hy)

  · rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y₁
    by_cases h0 : F y₁ = 0
    · exact (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hvan y₁ h0)
    · have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => (Real.sqrt (F y) - δ) / δ) y₁ :=
        ((hFc.contDiffAt.sqrt h0).sub contDiffAt_const).div_const δ

    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le

    have hQ1 : A.det / (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * ‖y - x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ F y := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ htr]
      linarith
    have hQ : A.det / (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * (r / 8) ^ 2 ≤ F y := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn hμpos.le
      linarith
    have hsq : (2 * (r * Real.sqrt (A.det / (A 0 0 + A 1 1)) / 16)) ^ 2 =
        A.det / (A 0 0 + A 1 1) * (r / 8) ^ 2 := by
      rw [show 2 * (r * Real.sqrt (A.det / (A 0 0 + A 1 1)) / 16) =

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (j k : Fin P.n) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) (u v u' v' : E2 → ℝ)
    (hu : u =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => u' (P.proj k (P.param j y)))
    (hv : v =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => v' (P.proj k (P.param j y)))
    (hu' : DifferentiableAt ℝ u' (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
    (hv' : DifferentiableAt ℝ v' (P.proj k (P.param j x))) :
    (∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ e : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 e) i *
        ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c v x =
      ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ i c * pd2 c v' (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ∧
    (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a u x * pd2 c v x =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ a c *
        pd2 a u' (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 c v' (P.proj k (P.param j x)))

signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (j k : Fin P.n) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) (u v u' v' : E2 → ℝ)
    (hu : u =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => u' (P.proj k (P.param j y)))
    (hv : v =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => v' (P.proj k (P.param j y)))
    (hu' : DifferentiableAt ℝ u' (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
    (hv' : DifferentiableAt ℝ v' (P.proj k (P.param j x))) :
    (∀ i : Fin 2, ∑ e : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 e) i *
        ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c v x =
      ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ i c * pd2 c v' (P.proj k (P.param j x))) ∧
    (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a u x * pd2 c v x =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ a c *
        pd2 a u' (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 c v' (P.proj k (P.param j x)))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hD : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
    (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)
  have hτd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x :=
    ((P.trans_smooth j k).contDiffAt (hD.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have chain : ∀ (w w' : E2 → ℝ), (w =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun y => w' (P.proj k (P.param j y))) →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ w' (P.proj k (P.param j x)) →
      ∀ b : Fin 2, pd2 b w x =
        ∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) c *
          pd2 c w' (P.proj k (P.param j x)) := by
    intro w w' hw hfd b
    unfold pd2
    rw [hw.fderiv_eq, show (fun y => w' (P.proj k (P.param j y))) =
      w' ∘ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) from rfl,
      fderiv_comp x hfd hτd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    have hw' : fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) =
        ∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 b) c • e2 c := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, Fin.sum_univ_two, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hw']
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  set J : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
    Matrix.of fun c a => fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 a) c with hJ
  have hKJ : P.h j x = J.transpose * P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * J := by
    ext a b
    rw [P.h_compat j k x hx a b]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hdetK : 0 < (P.h j x).det := (P.h_posDef j x hx.1).det_pos
  have hJdet : IsUnit J.det := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    intro h0
    have : (P.h j x).det = 0 := by
      rw [hKJ, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, h0]; simp
    linarith
  have hJTdet : IsUnit J.transpose.det := by rwa [Matrix.det_transpose]
  have hinv : J * (P.h j x)⁻¹ * J.transpose = (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ := by
    rw [hKJ, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, ← Matrix.mul_assoc J J⁻¹,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv J hJdet, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul J.transpose hJTdet, Matrix.mul_one]
  have e : ∀ m n : Fin 2,
      fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 0) m *
          ((P.h j x)⁻¹ 0 0 * fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 0) n +
            (P.h j x)⁻¹ 0 1 * fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 1) n) +
        fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 1) m *
          ((P.h j x)⁻¹ 1 0 * fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 0) n +
            (P.h j x)⁻¹ 1 1 * fderiv ℝ (fun x' => P.proj k (P.param j x')) x (e2 1) n) =
      (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ m n := by
    intro m n
    have h1 : (J * (P.h j x)⁻¹ * J.transpose) m n =
        (P.h k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))⁻¹ m n := by rw [hinv]
    rw [← h1]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, hJ, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have cu := chain u u' hu hu'
  have cv := chain v v' hv hv'
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [cv 0, cv 1]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    linear_combination
      pd2 0 v' (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * e i 0 + pd2 1 v' (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * e i 1
  · simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [cu 0, cu 1, cv 0, cv 1]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    linear_combination
      (pd2 0 u' (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 0 v' (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e 0 0 +
      (pd2 0 u' (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 1 v' (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e 0 1 +
      (pd2 1 u' (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 0 v' (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e 1 0 +
      (pd2 1 u' (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * pd2 1 v' (P.proj k (P.param j x))) * e 1 1

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (j₀ : Fin P.n) (x₀ : E2) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ r ⊆ P.W j₀)
    (ψ : E2 → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (hψ1 : ∀ y : E2, r / 8 ≤ ‖y - x₀‖ → ψ y = 1)
    (hψ0 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x₀, ψ y = 0) :
    (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun x => 1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q => 1 - ψ (P.proj j₀ q)) (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
    (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, (∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8), P.param j₀ y ≠ P.param j x) →
       ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, 1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q => 1 - ψ (P.proj j₀ q)) (P.param j x') = 1) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ P.W j₀, 1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q => 1 - ψ (P.proj j₀ q)) (P.param j₀ y) = ψ y) ∧
    (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x = P.param j₀ x₀ →
       ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, 1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q => 1 - ψ (P.proj j₀ q)) (P.param j x') = 0) ∧
    (∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
       P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) = P.param j x)

signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (j₀ : Fin P.n) (x₀ : E2) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ r ⊆ P.W j₀)
    (ψ : E2 → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ) (hψ1 : ∀ y : E2, r / 8 ≤ ‖y - x₀‖ → ψ y = 1)
    (hψ0 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x₀, ψ y = 0) :
    (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun x => 1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q => 1 - ψ (P.proj j₀ q)) (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
    (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, (∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8), P.param j₀ y ≠ P.param j x) →
       ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, 1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q => 1 - ψ (P.proj j₀ q)) (P.param j x') = 1) ∧
    (∀ y ∈ P.W j₀, 1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q => 1 - ψ (P.proj j₀ q)) (P.param j₀ y) = ψ y) ∧
    (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x = P.param j₀ x₀ →
       ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, 1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q => 1 - ψ (P.proj j₀ q)) (P.param j x') = 0) ∧
    (∀ j k, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
       P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) = P.param j x)

proof.tactics:
by
  set cut : X → ℝ := fun q => 1 - (P.O j₀).indicator (fun q => 1 - ψ (P.proj j₀ q)) q
    with hcut
  have f0 : ∀ q ∈ P.O j₀, cut q = ψ (P.proj j₀ q) := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [hcut, Set.indicator_of_mem hq]
    ring
  have f0' : ∀ q, q ∉ P.O j₀ → cut q = 1 := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [hcut, Set.indicator_of_notMem hq, sub_zero]
  have f1 : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∈ P.O j ∩ S := by
    intro j x hx
    rw [← P.image_eq j]
    exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx
  have f2 : ∀ k, ∀ q ∈ P.O k ∩ S, ∃ y ∈ P.W k, P.param k y = q ∧ P.proj k q = y := by
    intro k q hq
    rw [← P.image_eq k] at hq
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hq
    exact ⟨y, hy, rfl, P.proj_param k y hy⟩
  have hball8 : Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8) ⊆ P.W j₀ :=
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (by linarith)).trans hball
  have hKc : IsCompact (P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8)) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall x₀ (r / 8)).image_of_continuousOn ((P.param_cont j₀).mono hball8)
  have hKcl : IsClosed (P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8)) := hKc.isClosed
  have hKO : P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8) ⊆ P.O j₀ := by
    rintro q ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (f1 j₀ y (hball8 hy)).1
  have c1 : ∀ q ∈ S, q ∉ P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8) → cut q = 1 := by
    intro q hqS hqK
    by_cases hqO : q ∈ P.O j₀
    · obtain ⟨y, hyW, hyq, hpy⟩ := f2 j₀ q ⟨hqO, hqS⟩
      have hyB : y ∉ Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8) := by
        intro hyB
        apply hqK
        rw [← hyq]
        exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hyB
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, not_le] at hyB
      rw [f0 q hqO, hpy]
      exact hψ1 y hyB.le
    · exact f0' q hqO
  have hV1 : ∀ j, IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8))ᶜ) :=
    fun j => (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) hKcl.isOpen_compl
  have hone : ∀ j, ∀ x' ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8))ᶜ,
      cut (P.param j x') = 1 := fun j x' hx' => c1 _ (f1 j x' hx'.1).2 hx'.2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxK : P.param j x ∈ P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8)
    · refine ⟨P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀,
        (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open j₀), ⟨hx, hKO hxK⟩, ?_⟩
      have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x' => ψ (P.proj j₀ (P.param j x')))
          (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) :=
        hψ.comp_contDiffOn (P.trans_smooth j j₀)
      refine (hs.mono (fun z hz => hz.2)).congr ?_
      intro z hz
      exact f0 _ hz.2.2
    · refine ⟨P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8))ᶜ, hV1 j,
        ⟨hx, hxK⟩, ?_⟩
      refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (1 : ℝ))).congr ?_
      intro z hz
      exact hone j z hz.2
  · intro j x hx hne
    have hxK : P.param j x ∉ P.param j₀ '' Metric.closedBall x₀ (r / 8) := by
      rintro ⟨y, hyB, hyeq⟩
      exact hne y hyB hyeq
    exact Filter.eventually_of_mem ((hV1 j).mem_nhds ⟨hx, hxK⟩) (hone j)
  · intro y hy
    exact (f0 _ (f1 j₀ y hy).1).trans (by rw [P.proj_param j₀ y hy])
  · intro j x hx hx0
    obtain ⟨Z, hZψ, hZo, hx₀Z⟩ := _root_.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hψ0
    have hx₀W : x₀ ∈ P.W j₀ := hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr.le)
    have hN : IsOpen (P.O j₀ ∩ P.proj j₀ ⁻¹' Z) :=
      (P.proj_cont j₀).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.O_open j₀) hZo
    have hp₀N : P.param j₀ x₀ ∈ P.O j₀ ∩ P.proj j₀ ⁻¹' Z := by
      refine ⟨(f1 j₀ x₀ hx₀W).1, ?_⟩
      show P.proj j₀ (P.param j₀ x₀) ∈ Z
      rw [P.proj_param j₀ x₀ hx₀W]
      exact hx₀Z
    have hV : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.O j₀ ∩ P.proj j₀ ⁻¹' Z)) :=
      (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) hN
    have hxV : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' (P.O j₀ ∩ P.proj j₀ ⁻¹' Z) := by
      refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
      show P.param j x ∈ P.O j₀ ∩ P.proj j₀ ⁻¹' Z
      rw [hx0]
      exact hp₀N
    refine Filter.eventually_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hxV) ?_
    intro z hz
    exact (f0 _ hz.2.1).trans (hZψ _ hz.2.2)
  · intro j k x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hyW, hyq, hpy⟩ := f2 k (P.param j x) ⟨hx.2, (f1 j x hx.1).2⟩
    rw [hpy]
    exact ⟨hyW, hyq⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a c) W) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W, (h y).PosDef)
    (Ω : Set E2) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hΩW : Ω ⊆ W) (bt χ L : E2 → ℝ) (hbt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ bt W)
    (hχ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ χ W) (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L Ω) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (htri : ∀ x ∈ W, x ∈ Ω ∨ (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, bt y < 0) ∨ (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, χ y = 0)) :
    (∀ e : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => χ z * (Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s) *
        ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z)) W) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ W, ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * (χ z *
        (Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s) * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z))) x =
      Real.sqrt (h x).det * (χ x * (Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) * lap2 h L x) +
        χ x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a bt x * pd2 c L x) +
        Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a χ x * pd2 c L x)) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => χ x * (Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) * lap2 h L x)) W ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => χ x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) *
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a bt x * pd2 c L x)) W ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) *
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a χ x * pd2 c L x) W

signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y a c) W) (hpd : ∀ y ∈ W, (h y).PosDef)
    (Ω : Set E2) (hΩ : IsOpen Ω) (hΩW : Ω ⊆ W) (bt χ L : E2 → ℝ) (hbt : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ bt W)
    (hχ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ χ W) (hL : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ L Ω) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s)
    (htri : ∀ x ∈ W, x ∈ Ω ∨ (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, bt y < 0) ∨ (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, χ y = 0)) :
    (∀ e : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => χ z * (Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s) *
        ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z)) W) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ W, ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * (χ z *
        (Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s) * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z))) x =
      Real.sqrt (h x).det * (χ x * (Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) * lap2 h L x) +
        χ x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a bt x * pd2 c L x) +
        Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a χ x * pd2 c L x)) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => χ x * (Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) * lap2 h L x)) W ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun x => χ x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) *
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a bt x * pd2 c L x)) W ∧
