        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a χ x * pd2 c L x) W

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsymm : ∀ z ∈ W, ∀ i j : Fin 2, h z i j = h z j i := by
    intro z hz i j
    have := (hpd z hz).isHermitian.apply j i
    simpa using this
  have hinvE : ∀ (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (i j : Fin 2),
      A⁻¹ i j = A.det⁻¹ * A.adjugate i j := by
    intro A i j
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv']
    rfl
  have hadj00 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 0 0 = A 1 1 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj01 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 0 1 = -A 0 1 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj10 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 1 0 = -A 1 0 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hadj11 : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.adjugate 1 1 = A 0 0 := by
    intro A; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
  have hdetE : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ, A.det = A 0 0 * A 1 1 - A 0 1 * A 1 0 :=
    fun A => Matrix.det_fin_two A
  have hdetfun : (fun z => (h z).det) = fun z => h z 0 0 * h z 1 1 - h z 0 1 * h z 1 0 := by
    funext z; exact hdetE (h z)
  have hDc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (h z).det) W := by
    rw [hdetfun]; exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have hDne : ∀ z ∈ W, (h z).det ≠ 0 := fun z hz => ((hpd z hz).det_pos).ne'
  have hSc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det) W := hDc.sqrt hDne
  have hIc : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) W := by
    intro i j
    have e : (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) = fun z => ((h z).det)⁻¹ * (h z).adjugate i j :=
      funext fun z => hinvE (h z) i j
    rw [e]
    refine (hDc.inv hDne).mul ?_
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, hadj00]; exact hh 1 1
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, hadj01]; exact (hh 0 1).neg
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, hadj10]; exact (hh 1 0).neg
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, hadj11]; exact hh 0 0
  have hpdc : ∀ (U : Set E2), IsOpen U → ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 a f) U := by
    intro U hU f hf a
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) U := hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) W := by
    intro k i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
      (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x)) W
    apply ContDiffOn.mul contDiffOn_const
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro l _
    exact (hIc k l).mul (((hpdc W hW _ (hh j l) i).add (hpdc W hW _ (hh i l) j)).sub
      (hpdc W hW _ (hh i j) l))
  
  have hβc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s)) W :=
    Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn (hbt.div_const s)
  have hηc : Continuous (deriv Real.smoothTransition) :=
    (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).continuous_deriv (by simp)
  have hηd : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition t) t :=
    fun t => ((Real.smoothTransition.contDiff (n := 1)).differentiable (by simp) t).hasDerivAt
  have hη0 : ∀ t : ℝ, t < 0 → deriv Real.smoothTransition t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    have hev : Real.smoothTransition =ᶠ[𝓝 t] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (Iio_mem_nhds ht)
        (fun y hy => Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hy))
    rw [hev.deriv_eq]
    simp
  have hdβc : ContinuousOn (fun z => deriv Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s)) W :=
    hηc.comp_continuousOn (hbt.div_const s).continuousOn
  
  have hYc : ∀ e : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z) Ω := fun e =>
    (hSc.mono hΩW).mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun c _ => ((hIc e c).mono hΩW).mul (hpdc Ω hΩ L hL c))
  have hFΩ : ∀ e : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => χ z * (Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s) *
      ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z)) Ω := fun e =>
    (hχ.mono hΩW).mul ((hβc.mono hΩW).mul
      (ContDiffOn.sum fun c _ => ((hIc e c).mono hΩW).mul (hpdc Ω hΩ L hL c)))
  have hlapc : ContinuousOn (lap2 h L) Ω := by
    have H : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j *
        (pd2 i (pd2 j L) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k L x)) Ω := by
      apply ContDiffOn.sum; intro i _
      apply ContDiffOn.sum; intro j _
      refine ((hIc i j).mono hΩW).mul ((hpdc Ω hΩ _ (hpdc Ω hΩ L hL j) i).sub ?_)
      apply ContDiffOn.sum; intro k _
      exact ((hchr k i j).mono hΩW).mul (hpdc Ω hΩ L hL k)
    exact H.continuousOn
  have hT1Ω : ContinuousOn (fun x => χ x * (Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) * lap2 h L x)) Ω :=
    (hχ.mono hΩW).continuousOn.mul ((hβc.mono hΩW).continuousOn.mul hlapc)
  have hT2Ω : ContinuousOn (fun x => χ x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) *
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a bt x * pd2 c L x)) Ω :=
    (hχ.mono hΩW).continuousOn.mul ((continuousOn_const.mul (hdβc.mono hΩW)).mul
      (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun c _ =>
        (((hIc a c).mono hΩW).continuousOn.mul ((hpdc W hW bt hbt a).mono hΩW).continuousOn).mul
          (hpdc Ω hΩ L hL c).continuousOn))
  have hT3Ω : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) *
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a χ x * pd2 c L x) Ω :=
    (hβc.mono hΩW).continuousOn.mul
      (continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun a _ => continuousOn_finset_sum _ fun c _ =>
        (((hIc a c).mono hΩW).continuousOn.mul ((hpdc W hW χ hχ a).mono hΩW).continuousOn).mul
          (hpdc Ω hΩ L hL c).continuousOn)
  
  have hvanish : ∀ x : E2, ((∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, bt y < 0) ∨ (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, χ y = 0)) →
      ∃ t : Set E2, IsOpen t ∧ x ∈ t ∧ ∀ y ∈ t,
        (∀ e : Fin 2, χ y * (Real.smoothTransition (bt y / s) *
          ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L y) = 0) ∧
        χ y * (Real.smoothTransition (bt y / s) * lap2 h L y) = 0 ∧
        χ y * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (bt y / s) *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a bt y * pd2 c L y) = 0 ∧
        Real.smoothTransition (bt y / s) *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a χ y * pd2 c L y = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hA | hB
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, hto, hxt⟩ := _root_.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hA
      refine ⟨t, hto, hxt, fun y hy => ?_⟩
      have hneg : bt y / s < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (ht y hy) hs
      have h1 : Real.smoothTransition (bt y / s) = 0 :=
        Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos hneg.le
      have h2 : deriv Real.smoothTransition (bt y / s) = 0 := hη0 _ hneg
      simp [h1, h2]
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, hto, hxt⟩ := _root_.eventually_nhds_iff.mp hB
      refine ⟨t, hto, hxt, fun y hy => ?_⟩
      have h1 : χ y = 0 := ht y hy
      have h2 : ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a χ y = 0 := by
        intro a
        have hev : χ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem (hto.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => ht z hz)
        unfold pd2
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      simp [h1, h2]
  
  have hdivform : ∀ x ∈ Ω,
      pd2 0 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 0 j * pd2 j L z) x +
        pd2 1 (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ j : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ 1 j * pd2 j L z) x =
      Real.sqrt (h x).det * lap2 h L x := by
    intro x hx
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hΩW hx
    have hxU : Ω ∈ 𝓝 x := hΩ.mem_nhds hx
    have hxWn : W ∈ 𝓝 x := hW.mem_nhds hxW
    have hdh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => h z a b) x := fun a b =>
      ((hh a b).contDiffAt hxWn).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have pmul : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
        pd2 k (fun z => f z * g z) x = pd2 k f x * g x + f x * pd2 k g x := by
      intro f g k hf hg
      unfold pd2
      rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have padd : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
        pd2 k (fun z => f z + g z) x = pd2 k f x + pd2 k g x := by
      intro f g k hf hg
      unfold pd2
      rw [fderiv_fun_add hf hg]
      rfl
    have psub : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
        pd2 k (fun z => f z - g z) x = pd2 k f x - pd2 k g x := by
      intro f g k hf hg
      unfold pd2
      rw [fderiv_fun_sub hf hg]
      rfl
    have pneg : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), pd2 k (fun z => -f z) x = -pd2 k f x := by
      intro f k
      unfold pd2
      rw [show (fun z => -f z) = -f from rfl, fderiv_neg]
      rfl
    have pinv : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x ≠ 0 →
        pd2 k (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) x = -pd2 k f x / (f x) ^ 2 := by
      intro f k hf hf0
      unfold pd2
      have H := (hasDerivAt_inv hf0).comp_hasFDerivAt x hf.hasFDerivAt
      rw [show (fun z => (f z)⁻¹) = (fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) ∘ f from rfl, H.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    have psqrt : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x ≠ 0 →
        pd2 k (fun z => Real.sqrt (f z)) x = pd2 k f x / (2 * Real.sqrt (f x)) := by
      intro f k hf hf0
      unfold pd2
      rw [fderiv_sqrt hf hf0]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hDpos : 0 < (h x).det := (hpd x hxW).det_pos
    have hD0 : (h x).det ≠ 0 := hDpos.ne'
    have hx10 : h x 1 0 = h x 0 1 := hsymm x hxW 1 0
    have hd10 : ∀ l : Fin 2, pd2 l (fun z => h z 1 0) x = pd2 l (fun z => h z 0 1) x := by
      intro l
      have hev : (fun z => h z 1 0) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun z => h z 0 1) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem hxWn (fun z hz => hsymm z hz 1 0)
      unfold pd2
      rw [Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev]
    have hdD : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z).det) x := by
      rw [hdetfun]; exact ((hdh 0 0).mul (hdh 1 1)).sub ((hdh 0 1).mul (hdh 1 0))
    have hdS : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det) x := hdD.sqrt hD0
    have hdw : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 j L) x := fun j =>
      ((hpdc Ω hΩ L hL j).contDiffAt hxU).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hdI : ∀ i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) x := fun i j =>
      ((hIc i j).contDiffAt hxWn).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have pD : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x =
        pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 0) x * h x 1 1 + h x 0 0 * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 1) x -
          (pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 1) x * h x 1 0 + h x 0 1 * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 0) x) := by
      intro k
      rw [hdetfun, psub _ _ k ((hdh 0 0).fun_mul (hdh 1 1)) ((hdh 0 1).fun_mul (hdh 1 0)),
        pmul _ _ k (hdh 0 0) (hdh 1 1), pmul _ _ k (hdh 0 1) (hdh 1 0)]
    have pS : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det) x =
        Real.sqrt (h x).det * pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (2 * (h x).det) := by
      intro k
      rw [psqrt _ k hdD hD0]
      have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt (h x).det := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hDpos
      have hss : Real.sqrt (h x).det * Real.sqrt (h x).det = (h x).det :=
        Real.mul_self_sqrt hDpos.le
      generalize Real.sqrt (h x).det = sq at hs0 hss ⊢
      rw [← hss]
      field_simp
    have pI00 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 0) x =
        -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * h x 1 1 +
          (h x).det⁻¹ * pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 1) x := by
      intro k
      simp only [hinvE, hadj00]
      rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 1 1), pinv _ k hdD hD0]
    have pI01 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 0 1) x =
        -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * (-h x 0 1) +
          (h x).det⁻¹ * (-pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 1) x) := by
      intro k
      simp only [hinvE, hadj01]
      rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 0 1).fun_neg, pinv _ k hdD hD0, pneg]
    have pI10 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 0) x =
        -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * (-h x 1 0) +
          (h x).det⁻¹ * (-pd2 k (fun z => h z 1 0) x) := by
      intro k
      simp only [hinvE, hadj10]
      rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 1 0).fun_neg, pinv _ k hdD hD0, pneg]
    have pI11 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ 1 1) x =
        -pd2 k (fun z => (h z).det) x / (h x).det ^ 2 * h x 0 0 +
          (h x).det⁻¹ * pd2 k (fun z => h z 0 0) x := by
      intro k
      simp only [hinvE, hadj11]
      rw [pmul _ _ k (hdD.fun_inv hD0) (hdh 0 0), pinv _ k hdD hD0]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hdA : ∀ i : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i 0 * pd2 0 L z + (h z)⁻¹ i 1 * pd2 1 L z) x :=
      fun i => ((hdI i 0).fun_mul (hdw 0)).fun_add ((hdI i 1).fun_mul (hdw 1))
    rw [pmul _ _ 0 hdS (hdA 0), pmul _ _ 1 hdS (hdA 1),
      padd _ _ 0 ((hdI 0 0).fun_mul (hdw 0)) ((hdI 0 1).fun_mul (hdw 1)),
      padd _ _ 1 ((hdI 1 0).fun_mul (hdw 0)) ((hdI 1 1).fun_mul (hdw 1)),
      pmul _ _ 0 (hdI 0 0) (hdw 0), pmul _ _ 0 (hdI 0 1) (hdw 1),
      pmul _ _ 1 (hdI 1 0) (hdw 0), pmul _ _ 1 (hdI 1 1) (hdw 1),
      pS 0, pS 1, pI00 0, pI01 0, pI10 1, pI11 1, pD 0, pD 1]
    simp only [lap2, christoffel2, Fin.sum_univ_two, hinvE (h x), hadj00, hadj01, hadj10, hadj11]
    have hD1 : h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 0 1 ≠ 0 := by
      have e := hdetE (h x)
      rw [hx10] at e
      rw [← e]
      exact hD0
    generalize Real.sqrt (h x).det = sD
    simp only [hx10, hd10]
    field_simp
    simp only [hdetE (h x), hx10]
    ring
  
  have hidΩ : ∀ x ∈ Ω, ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * (χ z *
        (Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s) * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z))) x =
      Real.sqrt (h x).det * (χ x * (Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) * lap2 h L x) +
        χ x * (s⁻¹ * deriv Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a bt x * pd2 c L x) +
        Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) *
          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a χ x * pd2 c L x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hΩW hx
    have hnW : W ∈ 𝓝 x := hW.mem_nhds hxW
    have hnΩ : Ω ∈ 𝓝 x := hΩ.mem_nhds hx
    have pmul : ∀ (f g : E2 → ℝ) (k : Fin 2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
        pd2 k (fun z => f z * g z) x = pd2 k f x * g x + f x * pd2 k g x := by
      intro f g k hf hg
      unfold pd2
      rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hdχ : DifferentiableAt ℝ χ x := (hχ.contDiffAt hnW).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hdbt : DifferentiableAt ℝ bt x := (hbt.contDiffAt hnW).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hdβ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s)) x :=
      (hβc.contDiffAt hnW).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hdY : ∀ e : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z) x := fun e =>
      ((hYc e).contDiffAt hnΩ).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hCR : ∀ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s)) x =
        deriv Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) * (s⁻¹ * pd2 e bt x) := by
      intro e
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => bt z * s⁻¹) (s⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ bt x) x :=
        hdbt.hasFDerivAt.mul_const s⁻¹
      have h2 : HasDerivAt Real.smoothTransition (deriv Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s))
          (bt x * s⁻¹) := by
        rw [← div_eq_mul_inv]; exact hηd (bt x / s)
      have h3 := h2.comp_hasFDerivAt x h1
      have e1 : (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s)) =
          Real.smoothTransition ∘ (fun z => bt z * s⁻¹) := by
        funext z; simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
      unfold pd2
      rw [e1, h3.fderiv]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hre : ∀ e : Fin 2, (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * (χ z *
        (Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s) * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z))) =
        fun z => (χ z * Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s)) *
          (Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z) := by
      intro e; funext z; ring
    have hPR : ∀ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * (χ z *
        (Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s) * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z))) x =
        (pd2 e χ x * Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s) +
            χ x * pd2 e (fun z => Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s)) x) *
          (Real.sqrt (h x).det * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L x) +
        (χ x * Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s)) *
          pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z) x := by
      intro e
      rw [hre e, pmul _ _ e (hdχ.fun_mul hdβ) (hdY e), pmul _ _ e hdχ hdβ]
    have hdiv := hdivform x hx
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hPR 0, hPR 1, hCR 0, hCR 1]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hdiv ⊢
    linear_combination (χ x * Real.smoothTransition (bt x / s)) * hdiv
  
  refine ⟨fun e => ?_, fun x hx => ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn (fun x hx => ?_)
    rcases htri x hx with hxΩ | hv
    · exact ⟨Ω, hΩ, hxΩ, (hFΩ e).mono Set.inter_subset_right⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, hto, hxt, hvan⟩ := hvanish x hv
      exact ⟨t, hto, hxt, (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr (fun y hy => (hvan y hy.2).1 e)⟩
  · rcases htri x hx with hxΩ | hv
    · exact hidΩ x hxΩ
    · obtain ⟨t, hto, hxt, hvan⟩ := hvanish x hv
      have hz : ∀ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * (χ z *
          (Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s) * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z))) x = 0 := by
        intro e
        have hev : (fun z => Real.sqrt (h z).det * (χ z *
            (Real.smoothTransition (bt z / s) * ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ e c * pd2 c L z))) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
            fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
          Filter.eventually_of_mem (hto.mem_nhds hxt)
            (fun z hz => by simp only [(hvan z hz).1 e, mul_zero])
        show fderiv ℝ _ x (e2 e) = 0
        rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
        simp
      obtain ⟨_, hT1, hT2, hT3⟩ := hvan x hxt
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun e _ => hz e), hT1, hT2, hT3]
      ring
  · refine continuousOn_of_locally_continuousOn (fun x hx => ?_)
    rcases htri x hx with hxΩ | hv
    · exact ⟨Ω, hΩ, hxΩ, hT1Ω.mono Set.inter_subset_right⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, hto, hxt, hvan⟩ := hvanish x hv
      exact ⟨t, hto, hxt,
        (continuousOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr (fun y hy => (hvan y hy.2).2.1)⟩
  · refine continuousOn_of_locally_continuousOn (fun x hx => ?_)
    rcases htri x hx with hxΩ | hv
    · exact ⟨Ω, hΩ, hxΩ, hT2Ω.mono Set.inter_subset_right⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, hto, hxt, hvan⟩ := hvanish x hv
      exact ⟨t, hto, hxt,
        (continuousOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr (fun y hy => (hvan y hy.2).2.2.1)⟩
  · refine continuousOn_of_locally_continuousOn (fun x hx => ?_)
    rcases htri x hx with hxΩ | hv
    · exact ⟨Ω, hΩ, hxΩ, hT3Ω.mono Set.inter_subset_right⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, hto, hxt, hvan⟩ := hvanish x hv
      exact ⟨t, hto, hxt,
        (continuousOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr (fun y hy => (hvan y hy.2).2.2.2)⟩

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0) (j₀ : Fin P.n)
    (F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hFt : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀, F j x = F j₀ (P.proj j₀ (P.param j x)))
    (hFo : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∉ P.O j₀ → F j x = 0)
    (hF1 : ∀ y ∈ P.W j₀, F j₀ y ≠ 0 → ∑ i, ρ i (P.param j₀ y) = 1)
    (hFi : ∀ i : Fin P.n, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun y => ρ i (P.param j₀ y) * F j₀ y * Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ y).det) (P.W j₀)
        MeasureTheory.volume) :
    ∑ j, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det =
      ∫ y in P.W j₀, F j₀ y * Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ y).det

signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0) (j₀ : Fin P.n)
    (F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hFt : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀, F j x = F j₀ (P.proj j₀ (P.param j x)))
    (hFo : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∉ P.O j₀ → F j x = 0)
    (hF1 : ∀ y ∈ P.W j₀, F j₀ y ≠ 0 → ∑ i, ρ i (P.param j₀ y) = 1)
    (hFi : ∀ i : Fin P.n, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun y => ρ i (P.param j₀ y) * F j₀ y * Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ y).det) (P.W j₀)
        MeasureTheory.volume) :
    ∑ j, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det =
      ∫ y in P.W j₀, F j₀ y * Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ y).det

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have cov : ∀ (j k : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ),
      (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) =
        ∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det := by
    intro j k G
    have hF : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ P.W i, P.param i x ∈ P.O i ∩ S := fun i x hx => by
      rw [← P.image_eq i]; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    have hG : ∀ i, ∀ q ∈ P.O i ∩ S, P.proj i q ∈ P.W i ∧ P.param i (P.proj i q) = q := by
      intro i q hq
      rw [← P.image_eq i] at hq
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hq
      rw [P.proj_param i y hy]
      exact ⟨hy, rfl⟩
    have hAo : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
      (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open k)
    have hAm : MeasurableSet (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := hAo.measurableSet
    have hK : ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, P.proj k (P.param j x) ∈ P.W k ∧
        P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) = P.param j x :=
      fun x hx => hG k _ ⟨hx.2, (hF j x hx.1).2⟩
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := by
      intro x hx x' hx' hxx
      have hxx' : P.proj k (P.param j x) = P.proj k (P.param j x') := hxx
      have h1 : P.param j x = P.param j x' := by
        rw [← (hK x hx).2, ← (hK x' hx').2, hxx']
      rw [← P.proj_param j x hx.1, ← P.proj_param j x' hx'.1, h1]
    have himg : (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) '' (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) =
        P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j := by
      ext y
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨(hK x hx).1, ?_⟩
        show P.param k (P.proj k (P.param j x)) ∈ P.O j
        rw [(hK x hx).2]
        exact (hF j x hx.1).1
      · rintro ⟨hy, hyO⟩
        obtain ⟨hxW, hxq⟩ := hG j (P.param k y) ⟨hyO, (hF k y hy).2⟩
        refine ⟨P.proj j (P.param k y), ⟨hxW, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · show P.param j (P.proj j (P.param k y)) ∈ P.O k
          rw [hxq]
          exact (hF k y hy).1
        · show P.proj k (P.param j (P.proj j (P.param k y))) = y
          rw [hxq, P.proj_param k y hy]
    have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
        HasFDerivWithinAt (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x))
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) x) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) x := by
      intro x hx
      have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x))
          (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) :=
        (P.trans_smooth j k).differentiableOn (by simp)
      exact ((hd x hx).differentiableAt (hAo.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
    have hjac : ∀ (f : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) (H H' : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ),
        (∀ a b : Fin 2, H' a b = ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, f (e2 a) c * H c d * f (e2 b) d) →
        Real.sqrt H'.det = |f.det| * Real.sqrt H.det := by
      intro f H H' hc
      have hdet : f.det = f (e2 0) 0 * f (e2 1) 1 - f (e2 1) 0 * f (e2 0) 1 := by
        change LinearMap.det (f : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E2) = _
        rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis,
          Matrix.det_fin_two]
        simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, e2]
      have hH' : H'.det = f.det ^ 2 * H.det := by
        rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, Matrix.det_fin_two, hc 0 0, hc 0 1, hc 1 0, hc 1 1, hdet]
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
        ring
      rw [hH', Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    have hpt : Set.EqOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
        (fun x => |(fderiv ℝ (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) x).det| •
          (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
        (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      rw [hjac _ _ _ (P.h_compat j k x hx)]
      ring
    have h1 := MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hAm hdiff hinj
      (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det)
    rw [himg] at h1
    exact (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hAm hpt).trans h1.symm
  have key : ∀ j, (∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) =
      ∫ y in P.W j₀, ρ j (P.param j₀ y) * F j₀ y * Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ y).det := by
    intro j
    have hWm : MeasurableSet (P.W j) := (P.W_open j).measurableSet
    have hNo : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀) :=
      (P.param_cont j).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) (P.O_open j₀)
    have h1 : (∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) =
        ∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀,
          ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
      refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero hWm
        Set.inter_subset_left ?_
      intro x hx
      have hxO : P.param j x ∉ P.O j₀ := fun h => hx.2 ⟨hx.1, h⟩
      rw [hFo j x hx.1 hxO]
      ring
    have h2 : (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀,
          ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) =
        ∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O j₀,
          (fun y => ρ j (P.param j₀ y) * F j₀ y) (P.proj j₀ (P.param j x)) *
            Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
      refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hNo.measurableSet ?_
      intro x hx
      have hS : P.param j x ∈ P.O j₀ ∩ S := by
        refine ⟨hx.2, ?_⟩
        have hmem : P.param j x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := ⟨x, hx.1, rfl⟩
        rw [P.image_eq j] at hmem
        exact hmem.2
      rw [← P.image_eq j₀] at hS
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hS
      have hpar : P.param j₀ (P.proj j₀ (P.param j x)) = P.param j x := by
        rw [← hyx, P.proj_param j₀ y hy]
      show ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det =
        ρ j (P.param j₀ (P.proj j₀ (P.param j x))) * F j₀ (P.proj j₀ (P.param j x)) *
          Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det
      rw [hFt j x hx, hpar]
    have h3 := cov j j₀ (fun y => ρ j (P.param j₀ y) * F j₀ y)
    have h4 : (∫ y in P.W j₀ ∩ P.param j₀ ⁻¹' P.O j,
          (fun y => ρ j (P.param j₀ y) * F j₀ y) y * Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ y).det) =
        ∫ y in P.W j₀, ρ j (P.param j₀ y) * F j₀ y * Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ y).det := by
      refine (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero
        (P.W_open j₀).measurableSet Set.inter_subset_left ?_).symm
      intro y hy
      have hyO : P.param j₀ y ∉ P.O j := fun h => hy.2 ⟨hy.1, h⟩
      show ρ j (P.param j₀ y) * F j₀ y * Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ y).det = 0
      rw [hρO j _ hyO]
      ring
    exact h1.trans (h2.trans (h3.trans h4))
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => key j)]
  rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hFi i)]
  refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (P.W_open j₀).measurableSet ?_
  intro y hy
  show ∑ j, ρ j (P.param j₀ y) * F j₀ y * Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ y).det =
    F j₀ y * Real.sqrt (P.h j₀ y).det
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  by_cases h : F j₀ y = 0
  · rw [h]
    ring
  · rw [hF1 y hy h, one_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (Wv : Fin P.n → E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hWs : ∀ j (e : Fin 2), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Wv j x e) (P.W j))
    (hsum : ∑ j, ∑ e : Fin 2, ∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
       (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) = 0) :
    ∑ j, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) *
      ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det * Wv j z e) x = 0

signature.name: pcgb_patched_ibp_sum
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (Wv : Fin P.n → E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hWs : ∀ j (e : Fin 2), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Wv j x e) (P.W j))
    (hsum : ∑ j, ∑ e : Fin 2, ∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
       (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) = 0) :
    ∑ j, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) *
      ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det * Wv j z e) x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have ibp : ∀ (W : Set E2), IsOpen W → ∀ (u : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W →
      ∀ (ζ : E2 → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      ∫ x, u x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, pd2 k u x * ζ x) := by
    intro W hW u hu ζ hζ hζc hζW k
    have hvan : ∀ x, x ∉ W → (ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0) := by
      intro x hx
      exact notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (fun h => hx (hζW h))
    have hζ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ W → ζ x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport (fun h => hx (hζW h))
    have hdζ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ W → pd2 k ζ x = 0 := by
      intro x hx
      have h1 : fderiv ℝ ζ x = fderiv ℝ (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) x :=
        Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (hvan x hx)
      simp only [pd2, h1, fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
    have hFder : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x) x ∧
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k) = pd2 k u x * ζ x + u x * pd2 k ζ x := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ W
      · have hu' : HasFDerivAt u (fderiv ℝ u x) x :=
          ((hu.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).hasFDerivAt
        have hζ' : HasFDerivAt ζ (fderiv ℝ ζ x) x :=
          (hζ.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
        have hm : HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y) (u x • fderiv ℝ ζ x + ζ x • fderiv ℝ u x) x :=
          hu'.mul hζ'
        refine ⟨hm.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt, ?_⟩
        rw [hm.fderiv]
        simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, pd2]
        ring
      · have hF0 : (fun y => u y * ζ y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := by
          filter_upwards [hvan x hx] with y hy
          simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hy
          simp [hy]
        have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y * ζ y) (0 : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x :=
          (hasFDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) x).congr_of_eventuallyEq hF0
        refine ⟨hd.differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt, ?_⟩
        rw [hd.fderiv, hζ0 x hx, hdζ0 x hx]
        simp
    have hFd : Differentiable ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) :=
      fun x => (hFder x).1.differentiableAt
    have hprod : (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k)) =
        fun x => pd2 k u x * ζ x + u x * pd2 k ζ x := funext fun x => (hFder x).2
    have helper : ∀ (a φ : E2 → ℝ), ContinuousOn a W → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ W →
        HasCompactSupport φ → Integrable (fun x => a x * φ x) := by
      intro a φ ha hφ hφW hφc
      have hcont : Continuous (fun x => a x * φ x) := by
        refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x => ?_
        by_cases hx : x ∈ W
        · exact (ha.continuousAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).mul hφ.continuousAt
        · have h0 : φ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0 := notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mp (fun h => hx (hφW h))
          have h1 : (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => a y * φ y) := by
            filter_upwards [h0] with y hy
            simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hy
            simp [hy]
          exact continuousAt_const.congr h1
      exact hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hφc.mul_left)
    have hdu : ContinuousOn (pd2 k u) W :=
      (hu.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hdζc : Continuous (pd2 k ζ) :=
      (hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
    have hdζs : tsupport (pd2 k ζ) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
      refine closure_minimal (fun x hx => ?_) (isClosed_tsupport ζ)
      refine support_fderiv_subset ℝ ?_
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
      intro h0
      apply hx
      simp [pd2, h0]
    have hg₁ : Integrable (fun x => pd2 k u x * ζ x) :=
      helper _ _ hdu hζ.continuous hζW hζc
    have hg₂ : Integrable (fun x => u x * pd2 k ζ x) :=
      helper _ _ hu.continuousOn hdζc (hdζs.trans hζW) (hζc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (e2 k))
    have hF : Integrable (fun x => u x * ζ x) :=
      helper _ _ hu.continuousOn hζ.continuous hζW hζc
    have hF' : Integrable (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k)) := by
      rw [hprod]; exact hg₁.add hg₂
    have h := integral_mul_fderiv_eq_neg_fderiv_mul_of_integrable (μ := volume)
      (f := fun y => u y * ζ y) (g := fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (v := e2 k)
      (by simpa using hF') (by simp) (by simpa using hF) hFd (differentiable_const 1)
    have hzero : ∫ x, fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * ζ y) x (e2 k) = 0 := by
      simp only [fderiv_const_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, mul_zero, integral_zero,
        mul_one] at h
      linarith
    rw [hprod, integral_add hg₁ hg₂] at hzero
    linarith
  
  have chart : ∀ j (e : Fin 2),
      (∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det * Wv j z e) x) =
        -(∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
          (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e)) ∧
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) * pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det * Wv j z e) x)
        (P.W j) := by
    intro j e
    have hW : IsOpen (P.W j) := P.W_open j
    have hmeas : MeasurableSet (P.W j) := hW.measurableSet
    have hρ' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x)) (P.W j) := hρs j j
    have hdet : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => (P.h j z).det) (P.W j) := by
      have hfun : (fun z => (P.h j z).det) =
          fun z => P.h j z 0 0 * P.h j z 1 1 - P.h j z 0 1 * P.h j z 1 0 := by
        funext z; exact Matrix.det_fin_two _
      rw [hfun]
      exact ((P.h_smooth j 0 0).mul (P.h_smooth j 1 1)).sub
        ((P.h_smooth j 0 1).mul (P.h_smooth j 1 0))
    have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det) (P.W j) :=
      hdet.sqrt (fun x hx => (Matrix.PosDef.det_pos (P.h_posDef j x hx)).ne')
    have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det * Wv j z e) (P.W j) :=
      hD.mul (hWs j e)
    obtain ⟨hKc, hKW⟩ := hK j
    have hKcl : IsClosed (Kc j) := hKc.isClosed
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζdef⟩ : ∃ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ζ = (P.W j).indicator (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x)) :=
      ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hz0 : ∀ y, y ∉ Kc j → ζ y = 0 := by
      intro y hy
      by_cases hyW : y ∈ P.W j
      · rw [hζdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hyW]; exact hρK j y hyW hy
      · rw [hζdef, Set.indicator_of_notMem hyW]
    have hzev : ∀ y, y ∉ Kc j → ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0:ℝ) :=
      fun y hy => Filter.eventually_of_mem (hKcl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hy) (fun z hz => hz0 z hz)
    have hζW : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ζ x = ρ j (P.param j x) := fun x hx => by
      rw [hζdef, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
    have hζnW : ∀ x, x ∉ P.W j → ζ x = 0 := fun x hx => by
      rw [hζdef, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
    have hWev : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x)) :=
      fun x hx => Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx) (fun z hz => hζW z hz)
    have hζs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ := by
      rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ P.W j
      · exact (hρ'.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx)).congr_of_eventuallyEq (hWev x hx)
      · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hzev x (fun h => hx (hKW h)))
    have hsupp : Function.support ζ ⊆ Kc j := fun y hy => by
      by_contra h; exact hy (hz0 y h)
    have hts : tsupport ζ ⊆ Kc j := closure_minimal hsupp hKcl
    have hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ := HasCompactSupport.intro hKc hz0
    have hI := ibp (P.W j) hW _ hu ζ hζs hζc (hts.trans hKW) e
    have hpdW : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, pd2 e ζ x = pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x := fun x hx => by
      unfold pd2; rw [(hWev x hx).fderiv_eq]
    have hpd0 : ∀ x, x ∉ P.W j → pd2 e ζ x = 0 := fun x hx => by
      unfold pd2; rw [(hzev x (fun h => hx (hKW h))).fderiv_eq]; simp
    have h2 : (∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) *
          pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det * Wv j z e) x) =
        ∫ x, pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det * Wv j z e) x * ζ x := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hmeas
        (g := fun x => pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det * Wv j z e) x * ζ x)
        (fun x hx => by simp only [hζW x hx]; ring)]
      exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (fun x hx => by
        simp [hζnW x hx])
    have h3 : (∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
          (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e)) =
        ∫ x, (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) * pd2 e ζ x := by
      rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hmeas
        (g := fun x => (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) * pd2 e ζ x)
        (fun x hx => by simp only [hpdW x hx]; ring)]
      exact MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (fun x hx => by
        simp [hpd0 x hx])
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h2, h3]
      have hI' : (∫ x, (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e) * pd2 e ζ x) =
          -(∫ x, pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det * Wv j z e) x * ζ x) := hI
      rw [hI', neg_neg]
    · have hcont : ContinuousOn
          (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) * pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det * Wv j z e) x)
          (P.W j) :=
        hρ'.continuousOn.mul
          ((hu.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const)
      exact ((hcont.mono hKW).integrableOn_compact hKc).of_forall_diff_eq_zero hmeas
        (fun x hx => by simp only [hρK j x hx.1 hx.2, zero_mul])
  
  have hj : ∀ j, (∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) *
      ∑ e : Fin 2, pd2 e (fun z => Real.sqrt (P.h j z).det * Wv j z e) x) =
      -(∑ e : Fin 2, ∫ x in P.W j, pd2 e (fun x' => ρ j (P.param j x')) x *
        (Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * Wv j x e)) := by
    intro j
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ (fun e _ => (chart j e).2)]
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun e _ => (chart j e).1)
  
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hj j), Finset.sum_neg_distrib, hsum, neg_zero]

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (x₀ : E2) (R₀ : ℝ) (hR₀ : 0 < R₀)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ R₀ ⊆ W) :
    ∃ (D : E2 → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (σ c₀ K : ℝ),
      0 < σ ∧ σ ≤ R₀ ∧ σ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < c₀ ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧ (∀ a c : Fin 2, M a c = M c a) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ D ∧
      ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < σ → pcgbPxJet h D M x₀ c₀ K x

signature.name: pcgb_parametrix_jet
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (x₀ : E2) (R₀ : ℝ) (hR₀ : 0 < R₀)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ R₀ ⊆ W) :
    ∃ (D : E2 → ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (σ c₀ K : ℝ),
      0 < σ ∧ σ ≤ R₀ ∧ σ ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < c₀ ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧ (∀ a c : Fin 2, M a c = M c a) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ D ∧
      ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < σ → pcgbPxJet h D M x₀ c₀ K x

proof.tactics:
by
  have hx₀W : x₀ ∈ W := hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR₀.le)
  have hH : (h x₀).PosDef := hpd x₀ hx₀W
  have hsym : h x₀ 1 0 = h x₀ 0 1 := by
    have := hH.isHermitian.apply 0 1
    simpa using this
  have h00 : 0 < h x₀ 0 0 := hH.diag_pos
  have h11 : 0 < h x₀ 1 1 := hH.diag_pos
  have hdet : 0 < (h x₀).det := hH.det_pos
  have hdet2 : (h x₀).det = h x₀ 0 0 * h x₀ 1 1 - h x₀ 0 1 * h x₀ 1 0 := Matrix.det_fin_two _
  obtain ⟨tr, htrdef⟩ : ∃ tr : ℝ, tr = h x₀ 0 0 + h x₀ 1 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have htr : 0 < tr := by rw [htrdef]; linarith
  obtain ⟨lam, hlamdef⟩ : ∃ lam : ℝ, lam = (h x₀).det / tr := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hlam : 0 < lam := by rw [hlamdef]; exact div_pos hdet htr
  have hs2 : ∀ x : E2, dist x x₀ ^ 2 = (x - x₀) 0 ^ 2 + (x - x₀) 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.dist_eq, sq_abs]
  
  have hQlow : ∀ x : E2, lam * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ≤ pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ x := by
    intro x
    have hQ : pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ x =
        h x₀ 0 0 * (x - x₀) 0 * (x - x₀) 0 + h x₀ 0 1 * (x - x₀) 0 * (x - x₀) 1 +
          (h x₀ 1 0 * (x - x₀) 1 * (x - x₀) 0 + h x₀ 1 1 * (x - x₀) 1 * (x - x₀) 1) := by
      simp only [pcgbPxQuad, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have key : tr * pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ x - (h x₀).det * dist x x₀ ^ 2 =
        (h x₀ 0 0 * (x - x₀) 0 + h x₀ 0 1 * (x - x₀) 1) ^ 2 +
          (h x₀ 1 0 * (x - x₀) 0 + h x₀ 1 1 * (x - x₀) 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [hQ, hs2, hdet2, htrdef, hsym]; ring
    rw [hlamdef, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ htr]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (h x₀ 0 0 * (x - x₀) 0 + h x₀ 0 1 * (x - x₀) 1),
      sq_nonneg (h x₀ 1 0 * (x - x₀) 0 + h x₀ 1 1 * (x - x₀) 1)]
  
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ, T = pcgbJT (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨U, hUdef⟩ : ∃ U : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ,
      U = pcgbJU (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) (pcgbJg2 h x₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hDdef : pcgbJetD h x₀ = fun y => pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ y +
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, T a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) +
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        U a b c d * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d) := by
    rw [hTdef, hUdef]; rfl
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hQs, hTs, hUs⟩ := pcgb_form_pd2 x₀ x₀ 0 (fun _ => 0) (h x₀) T U
  have hDs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcgbJetD h x₀) := by
    rw [hDdef]; exact (hQs.add hTs).add hUs
  
  obtain ⟨φ, hφdef⟩ : ∃ φ : E2 → ℝ, φ = fun y => pcgbJetD h x₀ y - pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ y :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hφeq : φ = fun y =>
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, T a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) +
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        U a b c d * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d) := by
    rw [hφdef, hDdef]; funext y; ring
  have hφs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ := by rw [hφeq]; exact hTs.add hUs
  have hpdφ : ∀ l : Fin 2, pd2 l φ = fun y =>
      (∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, pcgbJW T l b c * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) +
      (∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        pcgbJV U l b c d * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d) := by
    intro l

def pcgbJg1 (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (k : Fin 2) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
  fun p q => pd2 k (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q) x₀

def pcgbJg2 (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (k l : Fin 2) :
    Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
  fun p q => pd2 k (pd2 l (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q)) x₀

def pcgbJT (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (g1 : Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (a b c : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, H p a * g1 c p q * H q b

def pcgbJW (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (p a b : Fin 2) : ℝ := T p a b + T a p b + T a b p

def pcgbJU (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (g1 : Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (g2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (a b c d : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  -(1 / 12 : ℝ) * ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2,
    (H⁻¹ p q * pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) p a b * pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) q c d
      + 2 * H p a * g1 b p q * pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) q c d
      + 2 * pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) p c d * g1 b p q * H q a
      + 2 * H p a * g2 c d p q * H q b)

def pcgbJV (U : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (p b c d : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
  U p b c d + U b p c d + U b c p d + U b c d p

def pcgbJD (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (g1 : Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (g2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ x : E2) : ℝ :=
  pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x
  + ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
      pcgbJT H g1 a b c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c
  + ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
      pcgbJU H g1 g2 a b c d * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c * (x - x₀) d

def pcgbJetD (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ : E2) : E2 → ℝ :=
  pcgbJD (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) (pcgbJg2 h x₀) x₀

def pcgbTay2 (φ : E2 → ℝ) (x₀ y : E2) : ℝ :=
  φ y - φ x₀ - ∑ k : Fin 2, pd2 k φ x₀ * (y - x₀) k
    - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, pd2 k (pd2 l φ) x₀ * (y - x₀) k * (y - x₀) l

def pcgbOrd (x₀ : E2) (σ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (u : E2 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ x : E2, dist x x₀ < σ →
    DifferentiableAt ℝ u x ∧ |u x| ≤ c * dist x x₀ ^ n ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ c * dist x x₀ ^ (n - 1)

      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (pcgbPxPsi H M x₀) x := by
    intro k
    rw [hφdef, iteratedFDeriv_comp_add_left, hxz]
  obtain ⟨b0, b1, b2, b3⟩ := hBb (x - x₀) hz
  rw [hnz] at b0 b1 b2 b3
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hpd : ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (pcgbPxPsi H M x₀)) x = pcgbPsiG2 H M x₀ i j x := by
      intro i j
      rw [← t_second x hne i j]
      apply hpdcongr
      filter_upwards [isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hne] with y hy
      exact t_first y hy j
    rw [← t_trace x hne]
    simp only [hpd]
  · have e : φ (x - x₀) = pcgbPxPsi H M x₀ x := by rw [hφdef]; simp only [hxz]
    rw [e, Real.norm_eq_abs] at b0
    exact b0
  · rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, hiter 1, norm_iteratedFDeriv_one] at b1
    exact b1
  · rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
    rw [hiter 2] at b2
    exact b2
  · rw [hiter 3] at b3
    exact b3

pcgb_log_quad_correction.definitions:
def pcgbPsiG1 (H M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (j : Fin 2) (y : E2) : ℝ :=
  (∑ c : Fin 2, (M j c - pcgbPxMu H M * H j c) * (y - x₀) c) * Real.log (pcgbPxQuad H x₀ y) / 8 +
  (pcgbPxQuad M x₀ y - pcgbPxMu H M * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ y) * (∑ c : Fin 2, H j c * (y - x₀) c) /
    (8 * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ y)

def pcgbPsiG2 (H M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (i j : Fin 2) (x : E2) : ℝ :=
  (M j i - pcgbPxMu H M * H j i) * Real.log (pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x) / 8 +
  (∑ c : Fin 2, (M j c - pcgbPxMu H M * H j c) * (x - x₀) c) * (∑ c : Fin 2, H i c * (x - x₀) c) /
    (4 * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x) +
  (∑ c : Fin 2, (M i c - pcgbPxMu H M * H i c) * (x - x₀) c) * (∑ c : Fin 2, H j c * (x - x₀) c) /
    (4 * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x) +
  (pcgbPxQuad M x₀ x - pcgbPxMu H M * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x) * H j i / (8 * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x) -
  (pcgbPxQuad M x₀ x - pcgbPxMu H M * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x) * (∑ c : Fin 2, H i c * (x - x₀) c) *
    (∑ c : Fin 2, H j c * (x - x₀) c) / (4 * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x ^ 2)

informal_problem.statement:
(V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (D : E2 → ℝ) (hD : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 D V) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ V, 0 < D x) :
    ∀ x ∈ V, lap2 h (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y)) x =
      lap2 h D x / (2 * D x) -
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a D x * pd2 c D x) / (2 * D x ^ 2)

signature.name: pcgb_lap2_half_log
signature.statement:
(V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (D : E2 → ℝ) (hD : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 D V) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ V, 0 < D x) :
    ∀ x ∈ V, lap2 h (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y)) x =
      lap2 h D x / (2 * D x) -
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a D x * pd2 c D x) / (2 * D x ^ 2)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x hx
  have hVx : V ∈ 𝓝 x := hV.mem_nhds hx
  have hdiff : ∀ y ∈ V, DifferentiableAt ℝ D y := fun y hy =>
    (hD.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  
  have hfirst : ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ j : Fin 2,
      pd2 j (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y)) y = pd2 j D y * (2 * D y)⁻¹ := by
    intro y hy j
    have hDy : D y ≠ 0 := (hpos y hy).ne'
    have h1 := ((hdiff y hy).hasFDerivAt.log hDy).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y)) y (e2 j) = fderiv ℝ D y (e2 j) * _
    rw [h1.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [mul_inv]
    ring
  have hev : ∀ j : Fin 2, pd2 j (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun y => pd2 j D y * (2 * D y)⁻¹) :=
    fun j => Filter.eventually_of_mem hVx (fun y hy => hfirst y hy j)
  
  have hC2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 D x := hD.contDiffAt hVx
  have hfd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ D) x :=
    (hC2.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt (by norm_num)
  have hpdj : ∀ j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (pd2 j D) x := fun j => by
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ D y (e2 j)) x
    exact hfd.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const _)
  have hDx : D x ≠ 0 := (hpos x hx).ne'
  have hq0 : (2 * D x) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hDx
  have hq : HasFDerivAt (fun y => 2 * D y) ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x) x :=
    (hdiff x hx).hasFDerivAt.const_mul 2
  have hr : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (2 * D y)⁻¹)
      ((-((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x)) x :=
    (hasDerivAt_inv hq0).comp_hasFDerivAt x hq
  
  have hsecond : ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y))) x =
      pd2 i (pd2 j D) x * (2 * D x)⁻¹ - pd2 j D x * pd2 i D x * (2 * D x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro i j
    have hprod : HasFDerivAt (fun y => pd2 j D y * (2 * D y)⁻¹)
        (pd2 j D x • ((-((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x)) +
          (2 * D x)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (pd2 j D) x) x :=
      (hpdj j).hasFDerivAt.mul hr
    have e1 : pd2 i (pd2 j (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y))) x =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => pd2 j D y * (2 * D y)⁻¹) x (e2 i) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y))) x (e2 i) = _
      rw [(hev j).fderiv_eq]
    rw [e1, hprod.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [show fderiv ℝ D x (e2 i) = pd2 i D x from rfl,
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j D) x (e2 i) = pd2 i (pd2 j D) x from rfl]
    field_simp
    ring
  unfold lap2
  simp only [hsecond]
  simp only [hfirst x hx]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  field_simp
  ring

signature.name: pcgb_lap2_contDiffOn
signature.statement:
(V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) V) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ V, (h x).PosDef)
    (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u V) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lap2 h u) V

proof.tactics:
by
  have hinf : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f V → ∀ c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 c f) V := by
    intro f hf c
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) V :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hV).1 hf).2
    exact hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdet : ∀ y ∈ V, (h y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).det) V := by
    have heq : (fun y => (h y).det) = fun y => h y 0 0 * h y 1 1 - h y 0 1 * h y 1 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_two (h y)
    rw [heq]
    exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).adjugate i j) V := by
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] <;>
      first | exact hh _ _ | exact (hh _ _).neg
  have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) V := by
    intro i j
    have heq : (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) = fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹ * (h y).adjugate i j := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact (hdetS.inv hdet).mul (hadj i j)
  have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) V := by
    intro k i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
      (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x)) V
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hinv k l).mul
      (((hinf _ (hh j l) i).add (hinf _ (hh i l) j)).sub (hinf _ (hh i j) l)))
  have hpu : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 k u) V := fun k => hinf u hu k
  have hppu : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 i (pd2 j u)) V :=
    fun i j => hinf _ (hpu j) i
  show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j *
    (pd2 i (pd2 j u) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k u x)) V
  exact ContDiffOn.sum fun i _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => (hinv i j).mul ((hppu i j).sub
    (ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hchr k i j).mul (hpu k)))

informal_problem.statement:
(F : E2 → ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hd : ∀ x : E2, x ≠ x₀ → DifferentiableAt ℝ F x)
    (hg : ∀ x : E2, x ≠ x₀ → ‖fderiv ℝ F x‖ ≤ K / Real.sqrt (dist x x₀))
    (hv : ∀ x : E2, |F x - F x₀| ≤ K * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀)) :
    ∀ x y : E2, |F x - F y| ≤ 3 * K * dist x y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)

signature.name: pcgb_holder_half_of_grad
signature.statement:
(F : E2 → ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hd : ∀ x : E2, x ≠ x₀ → DifferentiableAt ℝ F x)
    (hg : ∀ x : E2, x ≠ x₀ → ‖fderiv ℝ F x‖ ≤ K / Real.sqrt (dist x x₀))
    (hv : ∀ x : E2, |F x - F x₀| ≤ K * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀)) :
    ∀ x y : E2, |F x - F y| ≤ 3 * K * dist x y ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x y
  wlog hxy : dist y x₀ ≤ dist x x₀ generalizing x y
  · have h := this y x (le_of_lt (not_le.mp hxy))
    rw [abs_sub_comm, dist_comm]
    exact h
  rw [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ dist x x₀ := dist_nonneg
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ dist x y := dist_nonneg
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ dist y x₀ := dist_nonneg
  have ha0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (dist x x₀)
  have hb0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (dist x y)
  have ha := Real.sq_sqrt hr0
  have hb := Real.sq_sqrt hd0
  rcases le_or_gt (4 * dist x x₀) (9 * dist x y) with hA | hB
  · 
    have h1 : |F x - F y| ≤ |F x - F x₀| + |F y - F x₀| := by
      have := abs_sub_le (F x) (F x₀) (F y)
      rwa [abs_sub_comm (F x₀) (F y)] at this
    have h2 := hv x
    have h3 := hv y
    have h4 : Real.sqrt (dist y x₀) ≤ Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hxy
    have h5 : 2 * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) ≤ 3 * Real.sqrt (dist x y) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) - 3 * Real.sqrt (dist x y)),
        mul_nonneg ha0 hb0]
    have h6 : K * (2 * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀)) ≤ K * (3 * Real.sqrt (dist x y)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h5 hK
    have h7 : K * Real.sqrt (dist y x₀) ≤ K * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 hK
    nlinarith
  · 
    have hrpos : 0 < dist x x₀ := by linarith
    have hball : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x (dist x y),
        z ≠ x₀ ∧ dist x x₀ ≤ 4 * dist z x₀ := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hz
      have ht := dist_triangle x z x₀
      rw [dist_comm x z] at ht
      have h4 : dist x x₀ ≤ 4 * dist z x₀ := by linarith
      refine ⟨?_, h4⟩
      intro hzx
      rw [hzx, dist_self] at h4
      linarith
    have hsr : 0 < Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hrpos
    have hder : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x (dist x y), DifferentiableAt ℝ F z :=
      fun z hz => hd z (hball z hz).1
    have hbound : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x (dist x y),
        ‖fderiv ℝ F z‖ ≤ 2 * K / Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) := by
      intro z hz
      obtain ⟨hz0, hz4⟩ := hball z hz
      have ht : 0 < dist z x₀ := dist_pos.mpr hz0
      have hst : 0 < Real.sqrt (dist z x₀) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht
      have hc := Real.sq_sqrt ht.le
      have h1 : Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (dist z x₀) := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) - 2 * Real.sqrt (dist z x₀)),
          mul_nonneg ha0 hst.le]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ F z‖ ≤ K / Real.sqrt (dist z x₀) := hg z hz0
        _ ≤ 2 * K / Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) := by
          rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hst hsr]
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 hK
          linarith
    have hyB : y ∈ Metric.closedBall x (dist x y) := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_comm]
    have hmvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hder hbound
      (convex_closedBall x (dist x y)) (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hd0) hyB
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, ← dist_eq_norm, dist_comm y x] at hmvt
    have hdr : dist x y ≤ dist x x₀ := by linarith
    have hsq : dist x y ≤ Real.sqrt (dist x y) * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) := by
      have e1 := Real.mul_self_sqrt hd0
      have e2 := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hdr
      nlinarith
    have hfin : 2 * K / Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) * dist x y ≤ 2 * K * Real.sqrt (dist x y) := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_iff₀ hsr]
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * K)
      linarith
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
    have hKb : 0 ≤ K * Real.sqrt (dist x y) := mul_nonneg hK hb0
    linarith

(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W)
    (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)

    (hM : ∀ a c : Fin 2, M a c = M c a) (c₀ K Kψ : ℝ) (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hKψ : 0 ≤ Kψ)
    (hlap : ∀ (u : E2 → ℝ) (V : Set E2), IsOpen V → V ⊆ W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u V →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lap2 h u) V)
    (hD : ContDiff ℝ ∞ D)
    (hψs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pcgbPxPsi (h x₀) M x₀) {x | x ≠ x₀})
    (hjet : ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < σ → pcgbPxJet h D M x₀ c₀ K x)
    (hψ : ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < 1 → pcgbPxPsiEst (h x₀) M x₀ Kψ x)
    (hid : ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < σ →
      lap2 h (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y)) x =
        lap2 h D x / (2 * D x) -
          (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a D x * pd2 c D x) / (2 * D x ^ 2))
    (Λ₀ : E2 → ℝ)
    (hΛ₀ : ∀ y : E2, Λ₀ y = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y) - pcgbPxPsi (h x₀) M x₀ y) :
    ∃ c K' : ℝ, 0 ≤ K' ∧ ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < σ →
      |lap2 h Λ₀ x - c| ≤ K' * Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (lap2 h Λ₀) x‖ ≤ K' / Real.sqrt (dist x x₀) ∧
      |Λ₀ x - Real.log (Real.sqrt (pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ x))| ≤ K' ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => Λ₀ y - Real.log (Real.sqrt (pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ y))) x‖ ≤ K' ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Λ₀ y - Real.log (Real.sqrt (pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ y)))) x‖ ≤
        K' / Real.sqrt (pcgbPxQuad (h x₀) x₀ x)

    intro y hyL
    have hy : y ∈ P.W k := hLW hyL
    by_cases hF0 : F k y = 0
    · simp [hF0]
    · have hb : 0 ≤ b (P.param k y) := by
        by_contra hlt
        exact hF0 (hFb y hy (lt_of_not_ge hlt))
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul, hρ1 _ (hP1 k y hy).2 hb, one_mul]
  have hfnn : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det :=
    fun j x hx => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hρnn _ _) (hFnn j x hx)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hgnn : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ P.W k, 0 ≤ ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det :=
    fun j y hy => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hρnn _ _) (hFnn k y hy)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hfi : ∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j)
      MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro j
    exact s1 (P.W j) (Kc j) (P.W_open j) (hK j).1 (hK j).2 (P.h j) (P.h_smooth j)
      (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x)) (F j) (hρc j j) (hF j)
      (fun x hx hxK => by
        show ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x = 0
        rw [hρK j x hx hxK, zero_mul])
  have hgi : ∀ j, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun y => ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k)
      MeasureTheory.volume := fun j => (s2 j).2 ((hfi j).mono_set Set.inter_subset_left)
  have hle : ∀ j,
      (∫ y in L, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) ≤
        ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
    intro j
    calc (∫ y in L, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det)
        ≤ ∫ y in P.W k, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det :=
          MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set (hgi j)
            (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (P.W_open k).measurableSet (hgnn j))
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x (hx : x ∈ L) => hLW hx))
      _ = ∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k,
            ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := (s2 j).1.symm
      _ ≤ ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det :=
          MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set (hfi j)
            (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (P.W_open j).measurableSet (hfnn j))
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall
              (fun x (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) => hx.1))
  have hswap := MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict L)
    Finset.univ (fun j _ => (hgi j).mono_set hLW)
  calc (∫ x in L, F k x * Real.sqrt (P.h k x).det)
      = ∫ y in L, ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det :=
        MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hL.measurableSet
          (fun y hy => (hP7L y hy).symm)
    _ = ∑ j, ∫ y in L, ρ j (P.param k y) * F k y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det := hswap
    _ ≤ ∑ j, ∫ x in P.W j, ρ j (P.param j x) * F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hle j)
    _ = eigWInt P ρ F := rfl

subgoal_signatures.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (j k : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ) : (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) = (∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) ∧ (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j) MeasureTheory.volume)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hc0 : Continuous (fun x : E2 => x 0) := by fun_prop
  have hc1 : Continuous (fun x : E2 => x 1) := by fun_prop
  have hQcClosed : IsClosed {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} :=
    (isClosed_le continuous_const hc0).inter ((isClosed_le hc0 continuous_const).inter
      ((isClosed_le continuous_const hc1).inter (isClosed_le hc1 continuous_const)))
  have hQcBdd : Bornology.IsBounded {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} := by
    refine (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := (0 : E2)) (r := |a| + |b| + 2 * s)).subset ?_
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hx
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    have hn : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 := by
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        sq_abs, sq_abs]
    have e0 : x 0 ^ 2 ≤ (|a| + s) ^ 2 :=
      sq_le_sq' (by linarith [neg_abs_le a]) (by linarith [le_abs_self a])
    have e1 : x 1 ^ 2 ≤ (|b| + s) ^ 2 :=
      sq_le_sq' (by linarith [neg_abs_le b]) (by linarith [le_abs_self b])
    have ha := abs_nonneg a
    have hb := abs_nonneg b
    have hR : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (|a| + |b| + 2 * s) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
  have hQc : IsCompact {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} :=
    Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hQcClosed hQcBdd
  have hQQc : {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} ⊆
      {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} :=
    fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.1.le, hx.2.2.1, hx.2.2.2.le⟩
  
  obtain ⟨CL, hCL0, hCL⟩ := (chart_dirichlet_form_facts W hW h hh hpd).2.2.2 _ hQc hsub
  refine ⟨hQc, s ^ 2 * CL, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg s) hCL0, fun v hv => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℝ, m = (∫ y in {y : E2 | a ≤ y 0 ∧ y 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ y 1 ∧ y 1 < b + s},
      v y) / s ^ 2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hm]
  
  have hvQc : ContinuousOn v
      {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} := hv.continuousOn.mono hsub
  obtain ⟨hIv, -, -⟩ := square_iterated_integral v a b s hs hvQc
  obtain ⟨hIm, hm2, -⟩ := square_iterated_integral (fun _ => m) a b s hs continuousOn_const
  simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul] at hm2
  have hmean : ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s},
      (v x - m) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_sub hIv hIm, hm2, hm]
    have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := hs.ne'
    field_simp
    ring
  
  have hw : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v x - m) W := hv.sub contDiffOn_const
  have hP := poincare_halfopen_square W hW (fun x => v x - m) hw a b s hs hsub
  beta_reduce at hP
  have hgrad : ∀ x, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun x => v x - m) x) ^ 2 =
      ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k v x) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    simp only [pd2, fderiv_sub_const]
  simp only [hgrad, hmean] at hP
  have hstep1 : ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s},
      (v x - m) ^ 2 ≤ s ^ 2 * ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s},
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k v x) ^ 2 := by
    have hz : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 / s ^ 2 = 0 := by simp
    linarith [hP]
  
  have hGc : ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k v x) ^ 2) W := by
    have hfd := hv.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)
    refine continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => ?_)
    exact (hfd.clm_apply continuousOn_const).pow 2
  have hstep2 : ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s},
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k v x) ^ 2 ≤
      ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s},
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k v x) ^ 2 :=
    setIntegral_mono_set (ContinuousOn.integrableOn_compact hQc (hGc.mono hsub))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => sq_nonneg _)))
      hQQc.eventuallyLE
  
  have hstep3 := hCL _ hv
  have hint_eq : (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s},
      (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i k * pd2 i v x * pd2 k v x) * Real.sqrt (h x).det) =
      ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s},
        (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i k * pd2 k v x * pd2 i v x) *
          Real.sqrt (h x).det := by
    congr 1
    funext x
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i' _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k' _ => ?_))
    ring
  rw [hint_eq] at hstep3
  
  have hs2 : 0 ≤ s ^ 2 := sq_nonneg s
  calc _ ≤ _ := hstep1
    _ ≤ s ^ 2 * ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s},
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k v x) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep2 hs2
    _ ≤ s ^ 2 * (CL * ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s},
        (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i k * pd2 k v x * pd2 i v x) *
          Real.sqrt (h x).det) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hstep3 hs2
    _ = s ^ 2 * CL * ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s},
        (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ k : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i k * pd2 k v x * pd2 i v x) *
          Real.sqrt (h x).det := by ring

subgoal_signatures.name: poincare_halfopen_square
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : E2 → ℝ) (hv : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v W) (a b s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hsub : {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} ⊆ W) : ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, v x ^ 2 ≤ (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, v x) ^ 2 / s ^ 2 + s ^ 2 * ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k v x) ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: square_iterated_integral
subgoal_signatures.statement: (G : E2 → ℝ) (a b s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hG : ContinuousOn G {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s}) : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn G {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} MeasureTheory.volume ∧ (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, G x) = (∫ y in b..b + s, ∫ x in a..a + s, G !₂[x, y]) ∧ (∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, G x) = (∫ x in a..a + s, ∫ y in b..b + s, G !₂[x, y])

subgoal_signatures.name: chart_dirichlet_form_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) :
    (∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W →
      ContinuousOn (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b g x) W) ∧
    (∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ∀ x ∈ W, 0 ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x) ∧
    (∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W → ∀ x ∈ W, ∀ t : ℝ,
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a (fun y => f y - t * g y) x *
          pd2 b (fun y => f y - t * g y) x =
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x
        - 2 * t * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a g x * pd2 b f x
        + t ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a g x * pd2 b g x) ∧
    ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W →
      ∫ x in L, ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k f x) ^ 2 ≤
        C * ∫ x in L, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a f x * pd2 b f x) *
          Real.sqrt (h x).det

signature.statement:
(a b s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (U : Set E2) (hU : IsOpen U) (hUne : U.Nonempty)
