proof.tactics:
by
  have hK : IsCompact {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} := by
    have heq : {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} =
        (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ) ⁻¹' Set.Icc ![a, b] ![a + s, b + s] := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Icc, Pi.le_def, Fin.forall_fin_two]
      simp [EuclideanSpace.equiv]
      tauto
    rw [heq]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).toHomeomorph.isCompact_preimage.mpr isCompact_Icc
  have hsq : ∀ G : E2 → ℝ,
      ContinuousOn G {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn G {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}
        MeasureTheory.volume := by
    intro G hG
    refine (hG.integrableOn_compact hK).mono_set ?_
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨hx.1, hx.2.1.le, hx.2.2.1, hx.2.2.2.le⟩
  have hQint1 : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun _ : E2 => (1 : ℝ))
      {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} MeasureTheory.volume :=
    hsq (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) continuousOn_const
  have hQfin : MeasureTheory.volume {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s} < ⊤ := by
    rcases (MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const_iff).mp hQint1 with h | h
    · simp at h
    · exact h
  have hUfin : MeasureTheory.volume U ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top hQfin.ne (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hUQ)
  have hUpos : MeasureTheory.volume U ≠ 0 := (hU.measure_pos MeasureTheory.volume hUne).ne'
  refine ⟨ENNReal.toReal_pos hUpos hUfin, fun v hv hv0 => ?_⟩
  set m := (∫ y in {y : E2 | a ≤ y 0 ∧ y 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ y 1 ∧ y 1 < b + s}, v y) / s ^ 2 with hm
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun x => (v x - m) ^ 2)
      {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 ≤ a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 ≤ b + s} :=
    (hv.sub continuousOn_const).pow 2
  have hint := hsq (fun x => (v x - m) ^ 2) hcont
  have hU_eq : ∫ x in U, (v x - m) ^ 2 = (MeasureTheory.volume U).toReal * m ^ 2 := by
    have h1 : ∫ x in U, (v x - m) ^ 2 = ∫ x in U, m ^ 2 := by
      refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun hU.measurableSet ?_
      intro x hx
      simp only
      rw [hv0 x hx]
      ring
    rw [h1, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, MeasureTheory.measureReal_def]
  have hmono : ∫ x in U, (v x - m) ^ 2 ≤
      ∫ x in {x : E2 | a ≤ x 0 ∧ x 0 < a + s ∧ b ≤ x 1 ∧ x 1 < b + s}, (v x - m) ^ 2 :=
    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set hint
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => sq_nonneg _)) hUQ.eventuallyLE
  rw [← hU_eq]
  exact hmono

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (β : E2 → ℝ) (hβ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ β W)
    (x₀ : E2) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ W) (hβ0 : β x₀ = 0) (hdβ : fderiv ℝ β x₀ ≠ 0)
    (N : Set E2) (hN : IsOpen N) (hxN : x₀ ∈ N) :
    ∃ y ∈ N ∩ W, β y < 0

signature.name: pcgb_dp_negative_point
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (β : E2 → ℝ) (hβ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ β W)
    (x₀ : E2) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ W) (hβ0 : β x₀ = 0) (hdβ : fderiv ℝ β x₀ ≠ 0)
    (N : Set E2) (hN : IsOpen N) (hxN : x₀ ∈ N) :
    ∃ y ∈ N ∩ W, β y < 0

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := ContinuousLinearMap.exists_ne_zero hdβ
  set L := fderiv ℝ β x₀ with hL
  set w : E2 := (-(L v)) • v with hw
  have hLw : L w < 0 := by
    have h1 : L w = -(L v * L v) := by
      rw [hw, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, neg_mul]
    rw [h1]
    have h2 := mul_self_pos.mpr hv
    linarith
  have hdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ β x₀ :=
    (hβ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds hx₀)
  have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => x₀ + t • w) w 0 := by
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const w).const_add x₀
    simpa using h
  have hx0' : x₀ + (0:ℝ) • w = x₀ := by rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
  have hφ : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => β (x₀ + t • w)) (L w) 0 := by
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt β L (x₀ + (0:ℝ) • w) := by
      rw [hx0']
      exact hdiff.hasFDerivAt
    exact h1.comp_hasDerivAt (0:ℝ) hγ
  have hslope := hφ.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  have E1 := hslope.eventually_lt_const hLw
  have hmem : x₀ + (0:ℝ) • w ∈ N ∩ W := by
    rw [hx0']
    exact ⟨hxN, hx₀⟩
  have E2 : ∀ᶠ t in nhdsWithin (0:ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0), x₀ + t • w ∈ N ∩ W :=
    nhdsWithin_le_nhds (hγ.continuousAt.tendsto.eventually_mem ((hN.inter hW).mem_nhds hmem))
  have E3 : ∀ᶠ t in nhdsWithin (0:ℝ) (Set.Ioi 0), t ∈ Set.Ioi (0:ℝ) := self_mem_nhdsWithin
  obtain ⟨t, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (E1.and (E2.and E3)).exists
  have ht : (0:ℝ) < t := h3
  simp only [zero_add, hx0', hβ0, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul] at h1
  refine ⟨x₀ + t • w, h2, ?_⟩
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  have := mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr ht.le) hc
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (K : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKW : K ⊆ W) (β : E2 → ℝ) (hβ : ContinuousOn β W) (Ws : Set E2) (w : E2 → ℝ)
    (hloc : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ β x → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x r ⊆ W ∧ ∃ V : E2 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 V (Metric.ball x r) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V (Metric.ball x r ∩ Ws) ∧
      (∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r ∩ {y | 0 < β y})), w y = V y) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, β y = 0 → V y = 0)) :
    ∃ vt : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 vt ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ vt Ws ∧ (∀ y ∈ K, β y = 0 → vt y = 0) ∧
      volume {y | y ∈ K ∧ 0 < β y ∧ vt y ≠ w y} = 0

signature.name: pcgb_patch_chart_glue
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (K : Set E2) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hKW : K ⊆ W) (β : E2 → ℝ) (hβ : ContinuousOn β W) (Ws : Set E2) (w : E2 → ℝ)
    (hloc : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 ≤ β x → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball x r ⊆ W ∧ ∃ V : E2 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 V (Metric.ball x r) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V (Metric.ball x r ∩ Ws) ∧
      (∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r ∩ {y | 0 < β y})), w y = V y) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, β y = 0 → V y = 0)) :
    ∃ vt : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 vt ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ vt Ws ∧ (∀ y ∈ K, β y = 0 → vt y = 0) ∧
      volume {y | y ∈ K ∧ 0 < β y ∧ vt y ≠ w y} = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hK'closed : IsClosed (K ∩ β ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0) :=
    ContinuousOn.preimage_isClosed_of_isClosed (hβ.mono hKW) hK.isClosed isClosed_Ici
  have hK'compact : IsCompact (K ∩ β ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0) :=
    hK.of_isClosed_subset hK'closed Set.inter_subset_left
  have hloc' : ∀ x ∈ K ∩ β ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∃ V : E2 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 V (Metric.ball x r) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V (Metric.ball x r ∩ Ws) ∧
      (∀ᵐ y ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball x r ∩ {y | 0 < β y})), w y = V y) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ Metric.ball x r, β y = 0 → V y = 0) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨r, hr, -, V, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hloc x hx.1 hx.2
    exact ⟨r, hr, V, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
  choose! r hr V hV2 hVs hVae hV0 using hloc'
  obtain ⟨t, htK, hcovt⟩ := hK'compact.elim_nhds_subcover (fun x => Metric.ball x (r x))
    (fun x hx => Metric.ball_mem_nhds x (hr x hx))
  have hcov : K ∩ β ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0 ⊆ ⋃ i : ↥t, Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2)) := by
    intro y hy
    have h := hcovt hy
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at h
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := h
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hyx⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := SmoothPartitionOfUnity.exists_isSubordinate 𝓘(ℝ, E2) hK'closed
    (fun i : ↥t => Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2))) (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) hcov
  obtain ⟨χ, hP1, hP2, hP3⟩ : ∃ χ : ↥t → E2 → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ i)) ∧
      (∀ i, tsupport (χ i) ⊆ Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2))) ∧
      (∀ y ∈ K ∩ β ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0, ∑ i, χ i y = 1) := by
    refine ⟨fun i => ⇑(f i), fun i => contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp (f i).contMDiff,
      fun i => hf i, ?_⟩
    intro y hy
    have h := f.sum_eq_one hy
    rwa [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype] at h
  have hP2' : ∀ i y, χ i y ≠ 0 → y ∈ Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2)) :=
    fun i y h => hP2 i (subset_tsupport _ (Function.mem_support.mpr h))
  have hmul : ∀ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (i : ↥t) (s : Set E2),
      ContDiffOn ℝ n (V (i : E2)) (Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2)) ∩ s) →
      ContDiff ℝ n (χ i) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun y => χ i y * V (i : E2) y) s := by
    intro n i s hV hχ
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro y _
    by_cases hyB : y ∈ Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2))
    · refine ⟨Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2)), Metric.isOpen_ball, hyB, ?_⟩
      exact hχ.contDiffOn.mul (hV.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.2, hz.1⟩))
    · refine ⟨(tsupport (χ i))ᶜ, (isClosed_tsupport _).isOpen_compl,
        fun h => hyB (hP2 i h), ?_⟩
      refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr ?_
      intro z hz
      simp [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hz.2]
  refine ⟨fun y => ∑ i : ↥t, χ i y * V (i : E2) y, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply ContDiff.sum
    intro i _
    have h := hmul 2 i Set.univ ((hV2 (i : E2) (htK (i : E2) i.2)).mono Set.inter_subset_left)
      ((hP1 i).of_le (by first
        | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
        | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
        | simp))
    exact contDiffOn_univ.mp h
  · apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro i _
    exact hmul ∞ i Ws (hVs (i : E2) (htK (i : E2) i.2)) (hP1 i)
  · intro y _ hβy
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    by_cases h : χ i y = 0
    · rw [h, zero_mul]
    · rw [hV0 (i : E2) (htK (i : E2) i.2) y (hP2' i y h) hβy, mul_zero]
  · have hN : ∀ i : ↥t, volume {y | y ∈ Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2)) ∩ {y | 0 < β y} ∧
        w y ≠ V (i : E2) y} = 0 := by
      intro i
      have h := hVae (i : E2) (htK (i : E2) i.2)
      have h1 : (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2)) ∩ {y | 0 < β y}))
          {y | ¬ (w y = V (i : E2) y)} = 0 := MeasureTheory.ae_iff.mp h
      have h2 : volume ({y | ¬ (w y = V (i : E2) y)} ∩
          (Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2)) ∩ {y | 0 < β y})) ≤
          (volume.restrict (Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2)) ∩ {y | 0 < β y}))
            {y | ¬ (w y = V (i : E2) y)} :=
        MeasureTheory.Measure.le_restrict_apply _ _
      rw [h1] at h2
      have hsub : {y | y ∈ Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2)) ∩ {y | 0 < β y} ∧
          w y ≠ V (i : E2) y} ⊆ {y | ¬ (w y = V (i : E2) y)} ∩
          (Metric.ball (i : E2) (r (i : E2)) ∩ {y | 0 < β y}) :=
        fun y hy => ⟨hy.2, hy.1⟩
      exact MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null hsub (le_antisymm h2 (zero_le _))
    refine MeasureTheory.measure_mono_null ?_ (MeasureTheory.measure_iUnion_null hN)
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hyK, hβy, hne⟩ := hy
    by_contra hnot
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at hnot
    push_neg at hnot
    apply hne
    have hyK' : y ∈ K ∩ β ⁻¹' Set.Ici 0 := ⟨hyK, le_of_lt hβy⟩
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset ↥t),
        χ i y * V (i : E2) y = χ i y * w y := by
      intro i _
      by_cases h : χ i y = 0
      · rw [h, zero_mul, zero_mul]
      · have hyB := hP2' i y h
        have hni := hnot i
        have heq : w y = V (i : E2) y := by
          by_contra hc
          exact hni ⟨⟨hyB, hβy⟩, hc⟩
        rw [heq]
    show ∑ i : ↥t, χ i y * V (i : E2) y = w y
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, ← Finset.sum_mul, hP3 y hyK', one_mul]

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0) (p₀ : X) (vt : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hvt2 : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (vt j))
    (hvtS : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (vt j) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ)) :
    (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k x) * vt j (P.proj j (P.param k x)))
      (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ)) ∧
    (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k x) * vt j (P.proj j (P.param k x)))
      (P.W k))

signature.name: pcgb_patch_regularity
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X)
    (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0) (p₀ : X) (vt : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hvt2 : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (vt j))
    (hvtS : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (vt j) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ)) :
    (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k x) * vt j (P.proj j (P.param k x)))
      (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ)) ∧
    (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k x) * vt j (P.proj j (P.param k x)))
      (P.W k))

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hparamS : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ P.W i, P.param i x ∈ P.O i ∩ S := by
    intro i x hx
    have h := Set.mem_image_of_mem (P.param i) hx
    rw [P.image_eq i] at h
    exact h
  have htr : ∀ k j, ∀ x ∈ P.W k, P.param k x ∈ P.O j →
      P.proj j (P.param k x) ∈ P.W j ∧ P.param j (P.proj j (P.param k x)) = P.param k x := by
    intro k j x hx hO
    have hmem : P.param k x ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
      rw [P.image_eq j]
      exact ⟨hO, (hparamS k x hx).2⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := hmem
    rw [← hzx, P.proj_param j z hz]
    exact ⟨hz, rfl⟩
  have hCc : ∀ j, IsClosed (P.param j '' Kc j) := fun j =>
    ((hK j).1.image_of_continuousOn ((P.param_cont j).mono (hK j).2)).isClosed
  have hCO : ∀ j, P.param j '' Kc j ⊆ P.O j := by
    rintro j _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact (hparamS j z ((hK j).2 hz)).1
  have hρ0 : ∀ j q, q ∈ S → q ∉ P.param j '' Kc j → ρ j q = 0 := by
    intro j q hqS hqC
    by_contra hne
    have hO : q ∈ P.O j := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hne (hρO j q hn)
    have hmem : q ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
      rw [P.image_eq j]
      exact ⟨hO, hqS⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hmem
    by_cases hzK : z ∈ Kc j
    · exact hqC ⟨z, hzK, rfl⟩
    · exact hne (hρK j z hz hzK)
  have key : ∀ (n : WithTop ℕ∞) (k j : Fin P.n) (s : Set E2), n ≤ ∞ → s ⊆ P.W k →
      ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun x => vt j (P.proj j (P.param k x)))
        (s ∩ (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j)) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x) * vt j (P.proj j (P.param k x))) s := by
    intro n k j s hn hs hv
    apply contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxO : P.param k x ∈ P.O j
    · refine ⟨P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j,
        (P.param_cont k).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open k) (P.O_open j), ⟨hs hx, hxO⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (((hρs j k).of_le hn).mono (fun y hy => hs hy.1)).mul hv
    · refine ⟨P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' (P.param j '' Kc j)ᶜ,
        (P.param_cont k).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open k) (hCc j).isOpen_compl,
        ⟨hs hx, fun h => hxO (hCO j h)⟩, ?_⟩
      refine (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr ?_
      intro y hy
      rw [hρ0 j _ (hparamS k y hy.2.1).2 hy.2.2, zero_mul]
  have h2inf : (2 : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ ∞ := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
  refine ⟨fun k => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro j _
    refine key ∞ k j _ le_rfl (fun y hy => hy.1) ?_
    have hm : Set.MapsTo (fun x => P.proj j (P.param k x))
        ((P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ) ∩ (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j))
        (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' {p₀}ᶜ) := by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := htr k j y hy.2.1 hy.2.2
      refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
      show P.param j (P.proj j (P.param k y)) ∈ ({p₀}ᶜ : Set X)
      rw [h2]
      exact hy.1.2
    exact (hvtS j).comp ((P.trans_smooth k j).mono Set.inter_subset_right) hm
  · apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro j _
    refine key 2 k j _ h2inf subset_rfl ?_
    exact (hvt2 j).comp_contDiffOn
      (((P.trans_smooth k j).of_le h2inf).mono Set.inter_subset_right)

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0) (b : X → ℝ)
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1) (w : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hwc : ∀ j k, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k)),
      w j x = w k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
    (vt : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hnull : ∀ j, volume {y | y ∈ Kc j ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ vt j y ≠ w j y} = 0) :
    ∀ k, volume {y | y ∈ P.W k ∧ 0 < b (P.param k y) ∧
      ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k y) * vt j (P.proj j (P.param k y)) ≠ w k y} = 0

signature.name: pcgb_patch_ae_eq
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0) (b : X → ℝ)
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1) (w : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hwc : ∀ j k, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k)),
      w j x = w k (P.proj k (P.param j x)))
    (vt : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ)
    (hnull : ∀ j, volume {y | y ∈ Kc j ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ vt j y ≠ w j y} = 0) :
    ∀ k, volume {y | y ∈ P.W k ∧ 0 < b (P.param k y) ∧
      ∑ j, ρ j (P.param k y) * vt j (P.proj j (P.param k y)) ≠ w k y} = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro k
  classical
  set A : Fin P.n → Set E2 := fun j =>
    {y | ¬(y ∈ P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j → w k y = w j (P.proj j (P.param k y)))} with hAdef
  have hA : ∀ j, volume (A j) = 0 := by
    intro j
    have hopen : IsOpen (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j) :=
      (P.param_cont k).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open k) (P.O_open j)
    have h1 := (ae_restrict_iff' hopen.measurableSet).mp (hwc k j)
    exact ae_iff.mp h1
  set B : Fin P.n → Set E2 := fun j =>
    (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x)) ''
      ({y | y ∈ Kc j ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ vt j y ≠ w j y} ∩
        (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k)) with hBdef
  have hB : ∀ j, volume (B j) = 0 := by
    intro j
    have hd : DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun x => P.proj k (P.param j x))
        ({y | y ∈ Kc j ∧ 0 < b (P.param j y) ∧ vt j y ≠ w j y} ∩
          (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k)) :=
      ((P.trans_smooth j k).differentiableOn (by simp)).mono Set.inter_subset_right
    exact MeasureTheory.addHaar_image_eq_zero_of_differentiableOn_of_addHaar_eq_zero volume hd
      (measure_mono_null Set.inter_subset_left (hnull j))
  have hU : volume (⋃ j, (A j ∪ B j)) = 0 :=
    measure_iUnion_null (fun j => measure_union_null (hA j) (hB j))
  refine measure_mono_null ?_ hU
  rintro y ⟨hyW, hby, hne⟩
  by_contra hn
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists, Set.mem_union, not_or] at hn
  have hqS : P.param k y ∈ P.O k ∩ S := by
    have h := Set.mem_image_of_mem (P.param k) hyW
    rw [P.image_eq k] at h
    exact h
  apply hne
  have hterm : ∀ j, ρ j (P.param k y) * vt j (P.proj j (P.param k y)) =
      ρ j (P.param k y) * w k y := by
    intro j
    by_cases hρ0 : ρ j (P.param k y) = 0
    · rw [hρ0, zero_mul, zero_mul]
    · have hO : P.param k y ∈ P.O j := by
        by_contra hc
        exact hρ0 (hρO j _ hc)
      have hmem : P.param k y ∈ P.param j '' P.W j := by
        rw [P.image_eq j]; exact ⟨hO, hqS.2⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzq⟩ := hmem
      have hτ : P.proj j (P.param k y) = z := by rw [← hzq, P.proj_param j z hz]
      have hzK : z ∈ Kc j := by
        by_contra hc
        apply hρ0
        rw [← hzq]
        exact hρK j z hz hc
      have hbz : 0 < b (P.param j z) := by rw [hzq]; exact hby
      have hzD : z ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k := by
        refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩
        show P.param j z ∈ P.O k
        rw [hzq]; exact hqS.1
      have hback : P.proj k (P.param j z) = y := by rw [hzq, P.proj_param k y hyW]
      have hvt : vt j z = w j z := by
        by_contra hc
        exact (hn j).2 ⟨z, ⟨⟨hzK, hbz, hc⟩, hzD⟩, hback⟩
      have hwk : w k y = w j (P.proj j (P.param k y)) := by
        have h : ¬¬(y ∈ P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j →
            w k y = w j (P.proj j (P.param k y))) := (hn j).1
        exact not_not.mp h ⟨hyW, hO⟩
      rw [hτ] at hwk ⊢
      rw [hvt, hwk]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => hterm j), ← Finset.sum_mul, hρ1 _ hqS.2 hby.le, one_mul]

informal_problem.statement:

signature.statement:
(V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hdpos : ∀ x ∈ V, 0 < (h x).det := fun x hx => (hpos x hx).det_pos
  have hdetC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x).det) V := by
    have : (fun x => (h x).det) = fun x => h x 0 0 * h x 1 1 - h x 0 1 * h x 1 0 :=
      funext fun x => Matrix.det_fin_two _
    rw [this]
    exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have hsC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) V :=
    hdetC.sqrt (fun x hx => (hdpos x hx).ne')
  have hdinvC : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹) V :=
    hdetC.inv (fun x hx => (hdpos x hx).ne')
  have hadjC : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x).adjugate a b) V := by
    intro a b
    have : (fun x => (h x).adjugate a b) =
        fun x => !![h x 1 1, -h x 0 1; -h x 1 0, h x 0 0] a b :=
      funext fun x => by rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two]
    rw [this]
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp <;> first | exact hh _ _ | exact (hh _ _).neg
  have hinvC : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) V := by
    intro a b
    have : (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) = fun x => ((h x).det)⁻¹ * (h x).adjugate a b :=
      funext fun x => by rw [Matrix.inv_def, Matrix.smul_apply, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [this]
    exact hdinvC.mul (hadjC a b)
  have hsym : ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ i j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j = (h x)⁻¹ j i := by
    intro x hx i j
    have hH : ((h x)⁻¹).IsHermitian := (hpos x hx).isHermitian.inv
    have := hH.apply i j
    simpa using this.symm
  have hsymA : ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ i j : Fin 2, cylA h x i j = cylA h x j i := by
    intro x hx i j
    simp only [cylA, hsym x hx i j]
  refine ⟨?_, hsymA, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    exact hsC.mul (hinvC i j)
  · intro x hx
    have hd : 0 < (h x).det := hdpos x hx
    have hdet1 : (Real.sqrt (h x).det • (h x)⁻¹).det = 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_smul, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, Fintype.card_fin,
        Real.sq_sqrt hd.le]
      exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hd.ne'
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two] at hdet1
    simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hdet1
    have h10 := hsymA x hx 1 0
    simp only [cylA] at h10 ⊢
    rw [h10] at hdet1
    rw [sq]
    exact hdet1
  · intro x hx
    exact mul_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hdpos x hx)) (hpos x hx).inv.diag_pos

informal_problem.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (F₀ F₁ : E2 → ℝ)
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) (h0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P p))
    (h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P p)) :
    fplDt (fun q => Real.exp q.1 * (Real.cos q.2 * (P 1 1 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) -
        P 0 1 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)) + Real.sin q.2 * (-P 1 0 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) +
        P 0 0 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)))) p +
      fplDs (fun q => Real.exp q.1 * (-Real.sin q.2 * (P 1 1 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) -
        P 0 1 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)) + Real.cos q.2 * (-P 1 0 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) +
        P 0 0 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)))) p =
    Real.exp (2 * p.1) * (P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0) *
      (pd2 0 F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P p) + pd2 1 F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P p))

signature.name: cyl_polar_div_pullback
signature.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ : E2) (F₀ F₁ : E2 → ℝ)

    (h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P p)) :
    fplDt (fun q => Real.exp q.1 * (Real.cos q.2 * (P 1 1 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) -
        P 0 1 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)) + Real.sin q.2 * (-P 1 0 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) +

      fplDs (fun q => Real.exp q.1 * (-Real.sin q.2 * (P 1 1 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) -
        P 0 1 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)) + Real.cos q.2 * (-P 1 0 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) +

    Real.exp (2 * p.1) * (P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0) *

proof.tactics:
by
  have hexp : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.exp q.1)
      (Real.exp p.1 • ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ) p :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_exp p.1).comp_hasFDerivAt p hasFDerivAt_fst
  have hcos : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.cos q.2)
      ((-Real.sin p.2) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) p :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_cos p.2).comp_hasFDerivAt p hasFDerivAt_snd
  have hsin : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sin q.2)
      (Real.cos p.2 • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) p :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_sin p.2).comp_hasFDerivAt p hasFDerivAt_snd
  have hΦeq : cylPhi x₀ P = fun q => x₀ +
      ((Real.exp q.1 * (P 0 0 * Real.cos q.2 + P 0 1 * Real.sin q.2)) • e2 0 +
        (Real.exp q.1 * (P 1 0 * Real.cos q.2 + P 1 1 * Real.sin q.2)) • e2 1) := by
    funext q
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [cylPhi, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  obtain ⟨Φ', hΦ, hΦt, hΦs⟩ : ∃ Φ' : ℝ × ℝ →L[ℝ] E2, HasFDerivAt (cylPhi x₀ P) Φ' p ∧
      Φ' (1, 0) = (Real.exp p.1 * (P 0 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P 0 1 * Real.sin p.2)) • e2 0 +
        (Real.exp p.1 * (P 1 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P 1 1 * Real.sin p.2)) • e2 1 ∧
      Φ' (0, 1) = (Real.exp p.1 * (-P 0 0 * Real.sin p.2 + P 0 1 * Real.cos p.2)) • e2 0 +
        (Real.exp p.1 * (-P 1 0 * Real.sin p.2 + P 1 1 * Real.cos p.2)) • e2 1 := by
    have hc0 := hexp.fun_mul ((hcos.const_mul (P 0 0)).fun_add (hsin.const_mul (P 0 1)))
    have hc1 := hexp.fun_mul ((hcos.const_mul (P 1 0)).fun_add (hsin.const_mul (P 1 1)))
    have hsum := ((hc0.smul_const (e2 0)).add (hc1.smul_const (e2 1))).const_add x₀
    rw [hΦeq]
    refine ⟨_, hsum, ?_, ?_⟩
    · ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> ring
    · ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply] <;> ring
  have hf0 := h0.hasFDerivAt.comp p hΦ
  have hf1 := h1.hasFDerivAt.comp p hΦ
  have hG0 := (hf0.const_mul (P 1 1)).fun_sub (hf1.const_mul (P 0 1))
  have hG1 := (hf0.const_mul (-P 1 0)).fun_add (hf1.const_mul (P 0 0))
  have hW0 : HasFDerivAt (fun q => Real.exp q.1 * (Real.cos q.2 * (P 1 1 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) -
        P 0 1 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)) + Real.sin q.2 * (-P 1 0 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) +
        P 0 0 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)))) _ p :=
    hexp.fun_mul ((hcos.fun_mul hG0).fun_add (hsin.fun_mul hG1))
  have hW1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q => Real.exp q.1 * (-Real.sin q.2 * (P 1 1 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) -
        P 0 1 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)) + Real.cos q.2 * (-P 1 0 * F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P q) +
        P 0 0 * F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P q)))) _ p :=
    hexp.fun_mul ((hsin.neg.fun_mul hG0).fun_add (hcos.fun_mul hG1))
  have hX : Real.exp (2 * p.1) = Real.exp p.1 * Real.exp p.1 := by
    rw [two_mul, Real.exp_add]
  have hCS := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq p.2
  unfold fplDt fplDs
  rw [hW0.fderiv, hW1.fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp', Function.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_fst',
    ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul, hΦt, hΦs, map_add, map_smul, pd2, Pi.neg_apply]
  linear_combination (Real.exp p.1 ^ 2 * (P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0) *
      (fderiv ℝ F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P p) (e2 0) + fderiv ℝ F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P p) (e2 1))) * hCS -
    ((P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0) *
      (fderiv ℝ F₀ (cylPhi x₀ P p) (e2 0) + fderiv ℝ F₁ (cylPhi x₀ P p) (e2 1))) * hX

informal_problem.statement:
(x₀ : E2) (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cylPhi x₀ P) ∧
    (∀ t θ : ℝ, cylPhi x₀ P (t, θ + 2 * Real.pi) = cylPhi x₀ P (t, θ)) ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ‖cylPhi x₀ P p - x₀‖ ≤
      (|P 0 0| + |P 0 1| + |P 1 0| + |P 1 1|) * Real.exp p.1) ∧
    ∀ (v : E2 → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ v (cylPhi x₀ P p) →
      fplDt (fun q => v (cylPhi x₀ P q)) p = Real.exp p.1 *
        ((P 0 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P 0 1 * Real.sin p.2) * pd2 0 v (cylPhi x₀ P p) +
          (P 1 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P 1 1 * Real.sin p.2) * pd2 1 v (cylPhi x₀ P p)) ∧
      fplDs (fun q => v (cylPhi x₀ P q)) p = Real.exp p.1 *
        ((-P 0 0 * Real.sin p.2 + P 0 1 * Real.cos p.2) * pd2 0 v (cylPhi x₀ P p) +
          (-P 1 0 * Real.sin p.2 + P 1 1 * Real.cos p.2) * pd2 1 v (cylPhi x₀ P p)) ∧
      |fplDt (fun q => v (cylPhi x₀ P q)) p| ≤
        (|P 0 0| + |P 0 1| + |P 1 0| + |P 1 1|) * Real.exp p.1 * ‖fderiv ℝ v (cylPhi x₀ P p)‖ ∧
      |fplDs (fun q => v (cylPhi x₀ P q)) p| ≤
        (|P 0 0| + |P 0 1| + |P 1 0| + |P 1 1|) * Real.exp p.1 * ‖fderiv ℝ v (cylPhi x₀ P p)‖

(x₀ : E2) (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) :

    (∀ t θ : ℝ, cylPhi x₀ P (t, θ + 2 * Real.pi) = cylPhi x₀ P (t, θ)) ∧
    (∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ‖cylPhi x₀ P p - x₀‖ ≤

      |fplDs (fun q => v (cylPhi x₀ P q)) p| ≤

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cylPhi x₀ P) := by
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
        (fun i : Fin 2 => P i 0 * Real.cos q.2 + P i 1 * Real.sin q.2)) := by
      refine contDiff_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
      exact (contDiff_const.mul (Real.contDiff_cos.comp contDiff_snd)).add
        (contDiff_const.mul (Real.contDiff_sin.comp contDiff_snd))
    unfold cylPhi
    exact contDiff_const.add ((Real.contDiff_exp.comp contDiff_fst).smul
      ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp h1))
  have hdiff : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (cylPhi x₀ P) p :=
    fun p => hsmooth.differentiable (by simp) p
  
  have hbasis : ∀ w : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm w = w 0 • e2 0 + w 1 • e2 1 := by
    intro w
    refine PiLp.ext (fun i => ?_)
    rw [show ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm w).ofLp i = w i from rfl]
    fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hlin : ∀ (D : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : Fin 2 → ℝ),
      D ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm w) = w 0 * D (e2 0) + w 1 * D (e2 1) := by
    intro D w
    rw [hbasis w, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  have hnormL : ∀ w : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm w‖ ≤ |w 0| + |w 1| := by
    intro w
    rw [hbasis w]
    calc ‖w 0 • e2 0 + w 1 • e2 1‖ ≤ ‖w 0 • e2 0‖ + ‖w 1 • e2 1‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = |w 0| + |w 1| := by simp [norm_smul, e2, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  have hcoord : ∀ (D : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (i : Fin 2), |D (e2 i)| ≤ ‖D‖ := by
    intro D i
    have h := D.le_opNorm (e2 i)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    have he : ‖e2 i‖ = 1 := by simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
    rw [he, mul_one] at h
    exact h
  have htrig : ∀ a b c s : ℝ, |c| ≤ 1 → |s| ≤ 1 → |a * c + b * s| ≤ |a| + |b| := by
    intro a b c s hc hs
    calc |a * c + b * s| ≤ |a * c| + |b * s| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |a| * |c| + |b| * |s| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      _ ≤ |a| * 1 + |b| * 1 := by gcongr
      _ = |a| + |b| := by ring
  have hbnd : ∀ E A B kA kB g0 g1 N : ℝ, 0 ≤ E → |A| ≤ kA → |B| ≤ kB → |g0| ≤ N → |g1| ≤ N →
      |E * (A * g0 + B * g1)| ≤ (kA + kB) * E * N := by
    intro E A B kA kB g0 g1 N hE hA hB hg0 hg1
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hE]
    have h : |A * g0 + B * g1| ≤ kA * N + kB * N :=
      calc |A * g0 + B * g1| ≤ |A * g0| + |B * g1| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |A| * |g0| + |B| * |g1| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        _ ≤ kA * N + kB * N := add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul hA hg0 (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans hA))
            (mul_le_mul hB hg1 (abs_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans hB))
    calc E * |A * g0 + B * g1| ≤ E * (kA * N + kB * N) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hE
      _ = (kA + kB) * E * N := by ring
  
  have hdirT : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, fderiv ℝ (cylPhi x₀ P) p (1, 0) = Real.exp p.1 •
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm (fun i => P i 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P i 1 * Real.sin p.2) := by
    rintro ⟨t, θ⟩
    have hΦ : HasFDerivAt (cylPhi x₀ P) (fderiv ℝ (cylPhi x₀ P) (t, θ)) (t, θ) :=
      (hdiff _).hasFDerivAt
    have hℓ : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (τ, θ)) ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) t :=
      (hasDerivAt_id' t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t θ)
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (cylPhi x₀ P ∘ fun τ : ℝ => (τ, θ))
        (fderiv ℝ (cylPhi x₀ P) (t, θ) (1, 0)) t := hΦ.comp_hasDerivAt t hℓ
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => x₀ + Real.exp τ • (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm
        (fun i => P i 0 * Real.cos θ + P i 1 * Real.sin θ))
        (Real.exp t • (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm
          (fun i => P i 0 * Real.cos θ + P i 1 * Real.sin θ)) t :=
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_exp t).smul_const _).const_add x₀
    exact h1.unique h2
  have hdirS : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, fderiv ℝ (cylPhi x₀ P) p (0, 1) = Real.exp p.1 •
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm (fun i => -P i 0 * Real.sin p.2 + P i 1 * Real.cos p.2) := by
    rintro ⟨t, θ⟩
    have hΦ : HasFDerivAt (cylPhi x₀ P) (fderiv ℝ (cylPhi x₀ P) (t, θ)) (t, θ) :=
      (hdiff _).hasFDerivAt
    have hℓ : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (t, τ)) ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) θ :=
      (hasDerivAt_const θ t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_id' θ)
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (cylPhi x₀ P ∘ fun τ : ℝ => (t, τ))
        (fderiv ℝ (cylPhi x₀ P) (t, θ) (0, 1)) θ := hΦ.comp_hasDerivAt θ hℓ
    have hg : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => (fun i : Fin 2 => P i 0 * Real.cos τ + P i 1 * Real.sin τ))
        (fun i : Fin 2 => -P i 0 * Real.sin θ + P i 1 * Real.cos θ) θ := by
      refine hasDerivAt_pi.2 (fun i => ?_)
      have := ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos θ).const_mul (P i 0)).add
        ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin θ).const_mul (P i 1))
      convert this using 1
      ring
    have hLg := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt θ hg
    have h2 := (hLg.const_smul (Real.exp t)).const_add x₀
    rw [h1.unique h2, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  
  have hchain : ∀ (v : E2 → ℝ) (p d : ℝ × ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ v (cylPhi x₀ P p) →
      fderiv ℝ (fun q => v (cylPhi x₀ P q)) p d =
        fderiv ℝ v (cylPhi x₀ P p) (fderiv ℝ (cylPhi x₀ P) p d) := by
    intro v p d hv
    rw [fderiv_comp' p hv (hdiff p)]
    rfl
  refine ⟨hsmooth, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t θ
    simp only [cylPhi, Real.cos_add_two_pi, Real.sin_add_two_pi]
  · intro p
    have hsub : cylPhi x₀ P p - x₀ = Real.exp p.1 • (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm
        (fun i => P i 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P i 1 * Real.sin p.2) := by
      simp only [cylPhi, add_sub_cancel_left]
    rw [hsub, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    have hL := hnormL (fun i => P i 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P i 1 * Real.sin p.2)
    have h0 := htrig (P 0 0) (P 0 1) _ _ (Real.abs_cos_le_one p.2) (Real.abs_sin_le_one p.2)
    have h1 := htrig (P 1 0) (P 1 1) _ _ (Real.abs_cos_le_one p.2) (Real.abs_sin_le_one p.2)
    have hE := Real.exp_pos p.1
    have hk : ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm
        (fun i => P i 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P i 1 * Real.sin p.2)‖ ≤
        |P 0 0| + |P 0 1| + |P 1 0| + |P 1 1| := by
      refine hL.trans ?_
      show |P 0 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P 0 1 * Real.sin p.2| +
        |P 1 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P 1 1 * Real.sin p.2| ≤ _
      linarith
    calc Real.exp p.1 * ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm
          (fun i => P i 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P i 1 * Real.sin p.2)‖
        ≤ Real.exp p.1 * (|P 0 0| + |P 0 1| + |P 1 0| + |P 1 1|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk hE.le
      _ = (|P 0 0| + |P 0 1| + |P 1 0| + |P 1 1|) * Real.exp p.1 := by ring
  · intro v p hv
    have hT : fplDt (fun q => v (cylPhi x₀ P q)) p = Real.exp p.1 *
        ((P 0 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P 0 1 * Real.sin p.2) * pd2 0 v (cylPhi x₀ P p) +
          (P 1 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P 1 1 * Real.sin p.2) * pd2 1 v (cylPhi x₀ P p)) := by
      unfold fplDt
      rw [hchain v p _ hv, hdirT p, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hlin]
      rfl
    have hS : fplDs (fun q => v (cylPhi x₀ P q)) p = Real.exp p.1 *
        ((-P 0 0 * Real.sin p.2 + P 0 1 * Real.cos p.2) * pd2 0 v (cylPhi x₀ P p) +
          (-P 1 0 * Real.sin p.2 + P 1 1 * Real.cos p.2) * pd2 1 v (cylPhi x₀ P p)) := by
      unfold fplDs
      rw [hchain v p _ hv, hdirS p, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hlin]
      rfl
    have hE := (Real.exp_pos p.1).le
    have hg0 : |pd2 0 v (cylPhi x₀ P p)| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ v (cylPhi x₀ P p)‖ := hcoord _ 0
    have hg1 : |pd2 1 v (cylPhi x₀ P p)| ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ v (cylPhi x₀ P p)‖ := hcoord _ 1
    have hc := Real.abs_cos_le_one p.2
    have hs := Real.abs_sin_le_one p.2
    refine ⟨hT, hS, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hT]
      refine (hbnd _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hE (htrig (P 0 0) (P 0 1) _ _ hc hs)
        (htrig (P 1 0) (P 1 1) _ _ hc hs) hg0 hg1).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      ring
    · rw [hS]
      have hA := htrig (-P 0 0) (P 0 1) _ _ hs hc
      have hB := htrig (-P 1 0) (P 1 1) _ _ hs hc
      rw [abs_neg] at hA hB
      refine (hbnd _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hE hA hB hg0 hg1).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      ring

informal_problem.statement:
(M00 M01 M11 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hd0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ M00 p) (hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ M01 p)
    (hd2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ M11 p)
    (hb0 : |M00 p - 1| ≤ η) (hb1 : |M01 p| ≤ η) (hb2 : |M11 p - 1| ≤ η)
    (ht0 : |fplDt M00 p| ≤ η) (ht1 : |fplDt M01 p| ≤ η) (ht2 : |fplDt M11 p| ≤ η)
    (hs0 : |fplDs M00 p| ≤ η) (hs1 : |fplDs M01 p| ≤ η) (hs2 : |fplDs M11 p| ≤ η) :
    |cylRotA p.2 (M00 p) (M01 p) (M11 p) - 1| ≤ 2 * η ∧
    |cylRotB p.2 (M00 p) (M01 p) (M11 p)| ≤ 2 * η ∧
    |fplDt (fun q => cylRotA q.2 (M00 q) (M01 q) (M11 q)) p| ≤ 2 * η ∧
    |fplDt (fun q => cylRotB q.2 (M00 q) (M01 q) (M11 q)) p| ≤ 2 * η ∧
    |fplDs (fun q => cylRotA q.2 (M00 q) (M01 q) (M11 q)) p| ≤ 6 * η ∧
    |fplDs (fun q => cylRotB q.2 (M00 q) (M01 q) (M11 q)) p| ≤ 6 * η ∧
    cylRotA p.2 (M00 p) (M01 p) (M11 p) * cylRotC p.2 (M00 p) (M01 p) (M11 p) -
      cylRotB p.2 (M00 p) (M01 p) (M11 p) ^ 2 = M00 p * M11 p - M01 p ^ 2

signature.statement:
(M00 M01 M11 : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hd0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ M00 p) (hd1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ M01 p)

    (hb0 : |M00 p - 1| ≤ η) (hb1 : |M01 p| ≤ η) (hb2 : |M11 p - 1| ≤ η)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hCS : Real.cos p.2 ^ 2 + Real.sin p.2 ^ 2 = 1 := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq p.2
  
  have key : ∀ C S : ℝ, C ^ 2 + S ^ 2 = 1 → ∀ d0 d1 d2 : ℝ, |d0| ≤ η → |d1| ≤ η → |d2| ≤ η →
      |C ^ 2 * d0 + 2 * C * S * d1 + S ^ 2 * d2| ≤ 2 * η ∧
      |-(C * S * d0) + (C ^ 2 - S ^ 2) * d1 + C * S * d2| ≤ 2 * η ∧
      |-(2 * C * S * d0) + 2 * (C ^ 2 - S ^ 2) * d1 + 2 * C * S * d2| ≤ 4 * η ∧
      |-((C ^ 2 - S ^ 2) * d0) - 4 * C * S * d1 + (C ^ 2 - S ^ 2) * d2| ≤ 4 * η := by
    intro C S hCS d0 d1 d2 h0 h1 h2
    have term : ∀ u d : ℝ, |d| ≤ η → -(|u| * η) ≤ u * d ∧ u * d ≤ |u| * η := fun u d hd =>
      abs_le.mp (by rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (abs_nonneg u))
    have hT1 : 2 * |C * S| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      have a := sq_abs C
      have b := sq_abs S
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|C| - |S|)]
    have hT2 : |C ^ 2 - S ^ 2| ≤ 1 :=
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith [sq_nonneg C, sq_nonneg S], by nlinarith [sq_nonneg C, sq_nonneg S]⟩
    have hT1' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT1 hη
    have hT2' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hT2 hη
    have hsum : C ^ 2 * η + S ^ 2 * η = η := by rw [← add_mul, hCS, one_mul]
    have hC2 : |C ^ 2| = C ^ 2 := abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg C)
    have hS2 : |S ^ 2| = S ^ 2 := abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg S)
    obtain ⟨a0, a0'⟩ := term (C ^ 2) d0 h0
    obtain ⟨a2, a2'⟩ := term (S ^ 2) d2 h2
    rw [hC2] at a0 a0'
    rw [hS2] at a2 a2'
    obtain ⟨b0, b0'⟩ := term (C * S) d0 h0
    obtain ⟨b1, b1'⟩ := term (C * S) d1 h1
    obtain ⟨b2, b2'⟩ := term (C * S) d2 h2
    obtain ⟨c0, c0'⟩ := term (C ^ 2 - S ^ 2) d0 h0
    obtain ⟨c1, c1'⟩ := term (C ^ 2 - S ^ 2) d1 h1
    obtain ⟨c2, c2'⟩ := term (C ^ 2 - S ^ 2) d2 h2
    refine ⟨abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩,
      abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
  
  have hM0 := hd0.hasFDerivAt
  have hM1 := hd1.hasFDerivAt
  have hM2 := hd2.hasFDerivAt
  have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.cos q.2)
      ((-Real.sin p.2) • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) p :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_cos p.2).comp_hasFDerivAt p hasFDerivAt_snd
  have hs : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => Real.sin q.2)
      (Real.cos p.2 • ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) p :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_sin p.2).comp_hasFDerivAt p hasFDerivAt_snd
  have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => cylRotA q.2 (M00 q) (M01 q) (M11 q)) _ p :=
    (((hc.pow 2).mul hM0).add (((hc.const_mul 2).mul hs).mul hM1)).add ((hs.pow 2).mul hM2)
  have hB : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => cylRotB q.2 (M00 q) (M01 q) (M11 q)) _ p :=
    ((((hc.mul hs).mul hM0).neg).add (((hc.pow 2).sub (hs.pow 2)).mul hM1)).add
      ((hc.mul hs).mul hM2)
  have dtA : fplDt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => cylRotA q.2 (M00 q) (M01 q) (M11 q)) p =
      cylRotA p.2 (fplDt M00 p) (fplDt M01 p) (fplDt M11 p) := by
    unfold fplDt; rw [hA.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul, cylRotA]
    norm_num
    try ring
  have dtB : fplDt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => cylRotB q.2 (M00 q) (M01 q) (M11 q)) p =
      cylRotB p.2 (fplDt M00 p) (fplDt M01 p) (fplDt M11 p) := by
    unfold fplDt; rw [hB.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul, cylRotB]
    norm_num
    try ring
  have dsA : fplDs (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => cylRotA q.2 (M00 q) (M01 q) (M11 q)) p =
      cylRotA p.2 (fplDs M00 p) (fplDs M01 p) (fplDs M11 p) +
        (-(2 * Real.cos p.2 * Real.sin p.2 * (M00 p - 1)) +
          2 * (Real.cos p.2 ^ 2 - Real.sin p.2 ^ 2) * M01 p +
          2 * Real.cos p.2 * Real.sin p.2 * (M11 p - 1)) := by
    unfold fplDs; rw [hA.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul, cylRotA]
    norm_num
    ring
  have dsB : fplDs (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => cylRotB q.2 (M00 q) (M01 q) (M11 q)) p =
      cylRotB p.2 (fplDs M00 p) (fplDs M01 p) (fplDs M11 p) +
        (-((Real.cos p.2 ^ 2 - Real.sin p.2 ^ 2) * (M00 p - 1)) -
          4 * Real.cos p.2 * Real.sin p.2 * M01 p +
          (Real.cos p.2 ^ 2 - Real.sin p.2 ^ 2) * (M11 p - 1)) := by
    unfold fplDs; rw [hB.fderiv]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd', smul_eq_mul, cylRotB]
    norm_num
    ring
  have kb := key _ _ hCS _ _ _ hb0 hb1 hb2
  have kt := key _ _ hCS _ _ _ ht0 ht1 ht2
  have ks := key _ _ hCS _ _ _ hs0 hs1 hs2
  have e1 : cylRotA p.2 (M00 p) (M01 p) (M11 p) - 1 =
      Real.cos p.2 ^ 2 * (M00 p - 1) + 2 * Real.cos p.2 * Real.sin p.2 * M01 p +
        Real.sin p.2 ^ 2 * (M11 p - 1) := by
    unfold cylRotA; linear_combination hCS
  have e2 : cylRotB p.2 (M00 p) (M01 p) (M11 p) =
      -(Real.cos p.2 * Real.sin p.2 * (M00 p - 1)) +
        (Real.cos p.2 ^ 2 - Real.sin p.2 ^ 2) * M01 p +
        Real.cos p.2 * Real.sin p.2 * (M11 p - 1) := by
    unfold cylRotB; ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [e1]; exact kb.1
  · rw [e2]; exact kb.2.1
  · rw [dtA]; exact kt.1
  · rw [dtB]; exact kt.2.1
  · rw [dsA]
    calc _ ≤ |cylRotA p.2 (fplDs M00 p) (fplDs M01 p) (fplDs M11 p)| +
          |-(2 * Real.cos p.2 * Real.sin p.2 * (M00 p - 1)) +
            2 * (Real.cos p.2 ^ 2 - Real.sin p.2 ^ 2) * M01 p +
            2 * Real.cos p.2 * Real.sin p.2 * (M11 p - 1)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * η + 4 * η := add_le_add ks.1 kb.2.2.1
      _ = 6 * η := by ring
  · rw [dsB]
    calc _ ≤ |cylRotB p.2 (fplDs M00 p) (fplDs M01 p) (fplDs M11 p)| +
          |-((Real.cos p.2 ^ 2 - Real.sin p.2 ^ 2) * (M00 p - 1)) -
            4 * Real.cos p.2 * Real.sin p.2 * M01 p +
            (Real.cos p.2 ^ 2 - Real.sin p.2 ^ 2) * (M11 p - 1)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ 2 * η + 4 * η := add_le_add ks.2.1 kb.2.2.2
      _ = 6 * η := by ring
  · unfold cylRotA cylRotB cylRotC
    linear_combination ((Real.cos p.2 ^ 2 + Real.sin p.2 ^ 2) + 1) *
      (M00 p * M11 p - M01 p ^ 2) * hCS

(P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hP : P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0 = 1)
    (x₀ : E2) (T : ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf0 : f x₀ = 0)

signature.name: cyl_polar_cover
signature.statement:
(P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hP : P 0 0 * P 1 1 - P 0 1 * P 1 0 = 1)
    (x₀ : E2) (T : ℝ) (f : E2 → ℝ) (hf0 : f x₀ = 0)
    (hf : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 < T → f (cylPhi x₀ P p) = 0) :
    ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 x₀, f x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ : ∃ k : ℝ, k = |P 0 0| + |P 0 1| + |P 1 0| + |P 1 1| := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ := by rw [hκ]; positivity
  have hκ1 : 0 < κ + 1 := by linarith
  have hδ : 0 < Real.exp T / (κ + 1) := div_pos (Real.exp_pos T) hκ1
  have hcoord : ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (i : Fin 2), cylPhi x₀ P p i =
      x₀ i + Real.exp p.1 * (P i 0 * Real.cos p.2 + P i 1 * Real.sin p.2) := by
    intro p i
    simp [cylPhi]
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x₀ hδ] with x hx
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, lt_div_iff₀ hκ1] at hx
  have hy : ∀ i : Fin 2, |x i - x₀ i| ≤ ‖x - x₀‖ := by
    intro i
    have := PiLp.norm_apply_le (x - x₀) i
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using this
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = x 0 - x₀ 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = x 1 - x₀ 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hy0b : |y₀| ≤ ‖x - x₀‖ := by rw [hy₀]; exact hy 0
  have hy1b : |y₁| ≤ ‖x - x₀‖ := by rw [hy₁]; exact hy 1
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = P 1 1 * y₀ - P 0 1 * y₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z₁, hz₁⟩ : ∃ a : ℝ, a = -P 1 0 * y₀ + P 0 0 * y₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hI0 : P 0 0 * z₀ + P 0 1 * z₁ = y₀ := by
    rw [hz₀, hz₁]; linear_combination y₀ * hP
  have hI1 : P 1 0 * z₀ + P 1 1 * z₁ = y₁ := by
    rw [hz₀, hz₁]; linear_combination y₁ * hP
  by_cases hz : z₀ = 0 ∧ z₁ = 0
  · obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hz
    have e0 : x 0 = x₀ 0 := by
      have : y₀ = 0 := by rw [← hI0, h0, h1]; ring
      linarith
    have e1 : x 1 = x₀ 1 := by
      have : y₁ = 0 := by rw [← hI1, h0, h1]; ring
      linarith
    have hxx : x = x₀ := by
      refine PiLp.ext ?_
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact e0
      · exact e1
    rw [hxx]; exact hf0
  · let ζ : ℂ := ⟨z₀, z₁⟩
    have hζ0 : ζ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hz
      exact ⟨congrArg Complex.re h, congrArg Complex.im h⟩
    have hr : 0 < ‖ζ‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hζ0
    have hcos : ‖ζ‖ * Real.cos ζ.arg = z₀ := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg ζ
    have hsin : ‖ζ‖ * Real.sin ζ.arg = z₁ := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg ζ
    have hrle : ‖ζ‖ ≤ |z₀| + |z₁| := Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im ζ
    have hp1 : |P 1 1 * y₀| ≤ |P 1 1| * ‖x - x₀‖ := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy0b (abs_nonneg _)
    have hp2 : |P 0 1 * y₁| ≤ |P 0 1| * ‖x - x₀‖ := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy1b (abs_nonneg _)
    have hp3 : |P 1 0 * y₀| ≤ |P 1 0| * ‖x - x₀‖ := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy0b (abs_nonneg _)
    have hp4 : |P 0 0 * y₁| ≤ |P 0 0| * ‖x - x₀‖ := by
      rw [abs_mul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy1b (abs_nonneg _)
    have hz0b : |z₀| ≤ |P 1 1| * ‖x - x₀‖ + |P 0 1| * ‖x - x₀‖ := by
      rw [hz₀]
      have a1 := abs_le.mp hp1
      have a2 := abs_le.mp hp2
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [a1.1, a2.2], by linarith [a1.2, a2.1]⟩
    have hz1b : |z₁| ≤ |P 1 0| * ‖x - x₀‖ + |P 0 0| * ‖x - x₀‖ := by
      rw [hz₁]
      have a1 := abs_le.mp hp3
      have a2 := abs_le.mp hp4
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [a1.2, a2.1], by linarith [a1.1, a2.2]⟩
    have hnn := norm_nonneg (x - x₀)
    have hlt : ‖ζ‖ < Real.exp T := by
      have : ‖ζ‖ ≤ ‖x - x₀‖ * κ := by rw [hκ]; linarith
      nlinarith
    have ht : Real.log ‖ζ‖ < T := (Real.log_lt_iff_lt_exp hr).2 hlt
    have hexp : Real.exp (Real.log ‖ζ‖) = ‖ζ‖ := Real.exp_log hr
    have c0 : cylPhi x₀ P (Real.log ‖ζ‖, ζ.arg) 0 = x 0 := by
      rw [hcoord]
      simp only
      rw [hexp]
      linear_combination P 0 0 * hcos + P 0 1 * hsin + hI0 + hy₀
    have c1 : cylPhi x₀ P (Real.log ‖ζ‖, ζ.arg) 1 = x 1 := by
      rw [hcoord]
      simp only
      rw [hexp]
      linear_combination P 1 0 * hcos + P 1 1 * hsin + hI1 + hy₁
    have hΦ : cylPhi x₀ P (Real.log ‖ζ‖, ζ.arg) = x := by
      refine PiLp.ext ?_
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact c0
      · exact c1
    rw [← hΦ]
    exact hf _ ht

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hpoinc
  have hρc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x)) (P.W j) :=
    fun j => (hρs j j).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨W1, -, W3, -, W5, -, -⟩ := eig_wint_facts S P ρ Kc hρnn hρc hK hρK
  have hdiff : ∀ (v : X → ℝ) j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j) →
      ∀ x ∈ P.W j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x :=
    fun v j hv x hx => (hv.contDiffAt ((P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hsymmH : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ a c : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ c a = (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c := by
    intro j x hx a c
    have hH : ((P.h j x)⁻¹).IsHermitian := (P.h_posDef j x hx).isHermitian.inv
    have h1 := hH.apply a c
    rwa [star_trivial] at h1
  have hgsymm : ∀ (u w : X → ℝ) j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, eigGam P u w j x = eigGam P w u j x := by
    intro u w j x hx
    simp only [eigGam, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hsymmH j x hx 1 0]
    ring
  have hglin : ∀ (u v w : X → ℝ) j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j) →
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j) → ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ s t : ℝ,
      eigGam P (s • u + t • v) w j x = s * eigGam P u w j x + t * eigGam P v w j x := by
    intro u v w j hu hv x hx s t
    have hd : ∀ i : Fin 2, pd2 i (fun x' => (s • u + t • v) (P.param j x')) x =
        s * pd2 i (fun x' => u (P.param j x')) x + t * pd2 i (fun x' => v (P.param j x')) x := by
      intro i
      show fderiv ℝ (fun x' => s * u (P.param j x') + t * v (P.param j x')) x (e2 i) =
        s * fderiv ℝ (fun x' => u (P.param j x')) x (e2 i) +
          t * fderiv ℝ (fun x' => v (P.param j x')) x (e2 i)
      rw [fderiv_fun_add ((hdiff u j hu x hx).const_mul s) ((hdiff v j hv x hx).const_mul t),
        fderiv_const_mul (hdiff u j hu x hx), fderiv_const_mul (hdiff v j hv x hx)]
      rfl
    simp only [eigGam, hd, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hmem : ∀ u : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b),
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → (u : X → ℝ) q = 0 := fun u => u.2
  have hmk : ∀ φ : X → ℝ, ((∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => φ (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → φ q = 0) → φ ∈ pcgbWsAdm P b := fun φ h => h
  have hBsymm : ∀ u w : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b),
      eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)) =
        eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (w : X → ℝ) (u : X → ℝ)) :=
    fun u w => W3 _ _ (fun j x hx => hgsymm _ _ j x hx)
  have hBlin : ∀ (a c : ℝ) (u v w : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b)),
      eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P ((a • u + c • v : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b)) : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)) =
        a * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)) +
          c * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (v : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)) := by
    intro a c u v w
    have hcu : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ) j) (P.W j) :=
      fun j => (eig_gam_facts S P _ _ (hmem u).1 (hmem w).1 j).1
    have hcv : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (eigGam P (v : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ) j) (P.W j) :=
      fun j => (eig_gam_facts S P _ _ (hmem v).1 (hmem w).1 j).1
    have e1 : eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P ((a • u + c • v : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b)) : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)) =
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => a * eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ) j x +
          c * eigGam P (v : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ) j x +
          0 * eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ) j x) :=
      W3 _ _ (fun j x hx => by
        have h := hglin (u : X → ℝ) (v : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ) j ((hmem u).1 j) ((hmem v).1 j)
          x hx a c
        rw [zero_mul, add_zero]
        exact h)
    have e2 : eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => a * eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ) j x +
          c * eigGam P (v : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ) j x +
          0 * eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ) j x) =
        a * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)) +
          c * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (v : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)) +
          0 * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)) :=
      W1 _ _ _ hcu hcv hcu a c 0
    rw [e1, e2, zero_mul, add_zero]
  have hBnn : ∀ u : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b), 0 ≤ eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (u : X → ℝ)) :=
    fun u => W5 _ (fun j x hx =>
      (eig_gam_facts S P _ _ (hmem u).1 (hmem u).1 j).2.1 x ((hK j).2 hx))
  have hLlin : ∀ (a c : ℝ) (u v : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b)),
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) *
          ((a • u + c • v : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b)) : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) =
        a * eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) * (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) +
          c * eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) * (v : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) := by
    intro a c u v
    have hcu : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => f (P.param j x) * (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) (P.W j) :=
      fun j => (hfc j).mul ((hmem u).1 j).continuousOn
    have hcv : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => f (P.param j x) * (v : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) (P.W j) :=
      fun j => (hfc j).mul ((hmem v).1 j).continuousOn
    have e1 : eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) *
          ((a • u + c • v : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b)) : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) =
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => a * (f (P.param j x) * (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) +
          c * (f (P.param j x) * (v : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) +
          0 * (f (P.param j x) * (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x))) :=
      W3 _ _ (fun j x _ => by
        show f (P.param j x) * (a * (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x) + c * (v : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) = _
        ring)
    have e2 : eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => a * (f (P.param j x) * (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) +
          c * (f (P.param j x) * (v : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) +
          0 * (f (P.param j x) * (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x))) =
        a * eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) * (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) +
          c * eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) * (v : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) +
          0 * eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) * (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) :=
      W1 _ _ _ hcu hcv hcu a c 0
    rw [e1, e2, zero_mul, add_zero]
  have hQ : ∀ u : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b),
      0 ≤ eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x) ^ 2) ∧
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x) ^ 2) ≤
          C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (u : X → ℝ)) :=
    fun u => ⟨W5 _ (fun j x _ => sq_nonneg _), hC (u : X → ℝ) (hmem u).1 (hmem u).2⟩
  have hCS : ∀ (F G : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ), (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) →
      (∀ j, ContinuousOn (G j) (P.W j)) →
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => F j x * G j x) ^ 2 ≤
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => F j x ^ 2) * eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => G j x ^ 2) := by
    intro F G hF hG
    have hFF : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => F j x ^ 2) (P.W j) := fun j => (hF j).pow 2
    have hFG : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => F j x * G j x) (P.W j) := fun j => (hF j).mul (hG j)
    have hGG : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => G j x ^ 2) (P.W j) := fun j => (hG j).pow 2
    have hquad : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => G j x ^ 2) * (t * t) +
        (2 * eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => F j x * G j x)) * t +
          eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => F j x ^ 2) := by
      intro t
      have h0 : 0 ≤ eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => (F j x + t * G j x) ^ 2) :=
        W5 _ (fun j x _ => sq_nonneg _)
      have h1 : eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => (F j x + t * G j x) ^ 2) =
          eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => 1 * (F j x ^ 2) + (2 * t) * (F j x * G j x) +
            t ^ 2 * (G j x ^ 2)) :=
        W3 _ _ (fun j x _ => by ring)
      have h2 : eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => 1 * (F j x ^ 2) + (2 * t) * (F j x * G j x) +
            t ^ 2 * (G j x ^ 2)) =
          1 * eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => F j x ^ 2) +
            (2 * t) * eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => F j x * G j x) +
            t ^ 2 * eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => G j x ^ 2) :=
        W1 _ _ _ hFF hFG hGG 1 (2 * t) (t ^ 2)
      rw [h1, h2] at h0
      nlinarith [h0]
    have hd := discrim_le_zero hquad
    unfold discrim at hd
    nlinarith [hd]
  have hL : ∀ u : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b),
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) * (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) ^ 2 ≤
        eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) ^ 2) *
          eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x) ^ 2) :=
    fun u => hCS (fun j x => f (P.param j x)) (fun j x => (u : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) hfc
      (fun j => ((hmem u).1 j).continuousOn)
  obtain ⟨u', hcau, hEL⟩ := nds_direct_method (V := ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b))
    (fun u w => eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P (u : X → ℝ) (w : X → ℝ)))
    (fun w => eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) * (w : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)))
    (fun w => eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => (w : X → ℝ) (P.param j x) ^ 2)) C
    (eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => f (P.param j x) ^ 2)) hBsymm hBlin hBnn hLlin hQ hL
  refine ⟨fun m => ((u' m : ↥(pcgbWsAdm P b)) : X → ℝ), fun m => (hmem (u' m)).1,
    fun m => (hmem (u' m)).2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hcau ε hε
    exact ⟨N, fun m n hm hn => hN m n hm hn⟩
  · intro φ hφ1 hφ2
    exact hEL ⟨φ, hmk φ ⟨hφ1, hφ2⟩⟩

def pcgbWsAdm {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {S : Set X} (P : EigPatchedSurface X S)
    (b : X → ℝ) : Submodule ℝ (X → ℝ) where
  carrier := {u | (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0}
  add_mem' := by
    rintro u w ⟨hu, c₁, hc₁, hu0⟩ ⟨hw, c₂, hc₂, hw0⟩
    show (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (u + w) (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → (u + w) q = 0
    refine ⟨fun j => ?_, min c₁ c₂, lt_min hc₁ hc₂, fun q hq hbq => ?_⟩
    · exact (hu j).add (hw j)
    · show u q + w q = 0
      rw [hu0 q hq (lt_of_lt_of_le hbq (min_le_left _ _)),
        hw0 q hq (lt_of_lt_of_le hbq (min_le_right _ _)), add_zero]
  zero_mem' := by
    show (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (0 : X → ℝ) (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → (0 : X → ℝ) q = 0
    exact ⟨fun j => contDiffOn_const, 1, one_pos, fun q _ _ => rfl⟩
  smul_mem' := by
    rintro r u ⟨hu, c, hc, hu0⟩
    show (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (r • u) (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧
      ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → (r • u) q = 0
    refine ⟨fun j => ?_, c, hc, fun q hq hbq => ?_⟩
    · exact contDiffOn_const.mul (hu j)
    · show r * u q = 0
      rw [hu0 q hq hbq, mul_zero]
