subgoal_signatures.statement:
{V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]
    (B : V → V → ℝ) (L Q : V → ℝ) (CP K : ℝ)
    (hBsymm : ∀ u w, B u w = B w u)
    (hBlin : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (u v w : V), B (a • u + b • v) w = a * B u w + b * B v w)
    (hBnn : ∀ u, 0 ≤ B u u)
    (hLlin : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (u v : V), L (a • u + b • v) = a * L u + b * L v)
    (hQ : ∀ u, 0 ≤ Q u ∧ Q u ≤ CP * B u u)
    (hL : ∀ u, L u ^ 2 ≤ K * Q u) :
    ∃ u : ℕ → V,
      (∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m n, N ≤ m → N ≤ n → B (u m - u n) (u m - u n) < ε) ∧
      (∀ φ : V, Tendsto (fun n => B (u n) φ + L φ) atTop (𝓝 0))

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_wint_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (K : Fin P.n → Set E2) (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q) (hρc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => ρ j (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (K j) ∧ K j ⊆ P.W j) (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ K j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0) : (∀ (F G H : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ), (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ContinuousOn (G j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ContinuousOn (H j) (P.W j)) → ∀ a b c : ℝ, eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => a * F j x + b * G j x + c * H j x) = a * eigWInt P ρ F + b * eigWInt P ρ G + c * eigWInt P ρ H) ∧ (∀ (F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ) (a : ℝ), eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => a * F j x) = a * eigWInt P ρ F) ∧ (∀ F G : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, F j x = G j x) → eigWInt P ρ F = eigWInt P ρ G) ∧ (∀ F G : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ContinuousOn (G j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K j, F j x ≤ G j x) → eigWInt P ρ F ≤ eigWInt P ρ G) ∧ (∀ F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K j, 0 ≤ F j x) → 0 ≤ eigWInt P ρ F) ∧ (∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K j, 0 ≤ F j x) → eigWInt P ρ F ≤ A * ∑ j, ∫ x in K j, F j x) ∧ (∀ F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j)) → (∃ j, ∃ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < ρ j (P.param j x)) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 < F j x) → 0 < eigWInt P ρ F)

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_gam_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (u v : X → ℝ) (hu : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hv : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (j : Fin P.n) : ContinuousOn (eigGam P u v j) (P.W j) ∧ (∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ eigGam P u u j x) ∧ ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ t : ℝ, eigGam P (u + t • v) (u + t • v) j x = eigGam P u u j x + 2 * t * eigGam P u v j x + t ^ 2 * eigGam P v v j x

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (hpoinc : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : X → ℝ,
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => u (P.param j x) ^ 2) ≤ C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u))
    (j : Fin P.n) (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) (hLW : L ⊆ P.W j) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ v : X → ℝ,
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → v q = 0) →
      ∫ x in L, ((v (P.param j x)) ^ 2 +
          ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x) ^ 2) ≤
        C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P v v)

signature.name: pcgb_ws_local_control
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (hpoinc : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ u : X → ℝ,
      (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → u q = 0) →
      eigWInt P ρ (fun j x => u (P.param j x) ^ 2) ≤ C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P u u))
    (j : Fin P.n) (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) (hLW : L ⊆ P.W j) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ v : X → ℝ,
      (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → v q = 0) →
      ∫ x in L, ((v (P.param j x)) ^ 2 +
          ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x) ^ 2) ≤
        C * eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P v v)

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨CP, hCP, hP⟩ := hpoinc
  obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁, hE⟩ := eig_local_energy (P.W j) (P.W_open j) (P.h j) (P.h_smooth j)
    (P.h_posDef j) L hL hLW
  refine ⟨C₁ * (CP + 1), mul_nonneg hC₁ (by linarith), ?_⟩
  intro v hv hadm
  obtain ⟨c, hc0, hcz⟩ := hadm
  have hparamS : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ P.W i, P.param i x ∈ S := by
    intro i x hx
    have h := Set.mem_image_of_mem (P.param i) hx
    rw [P.image_eq i] at h
    exact h.2
  have hT : ∀ i' i, ∀ x ∈ P.W i' ∩ P.param i' ⁻¹' P.O i,
      P.param i (P.proj i (P.param i' x)) = P.param i' x := by
    intro i' i x hx
    have hmem : P.param i' x ∈ P.param i '' P.W i := by
      rw [P.image_eq i]
      exact ⟨hx.2, hparamS i' x hx.1⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hmem
    rw [← hyx, P.proj_param i y hy]
  
  have hV1 : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) < 0 → v (P.param j x) = 0 := by
    intro x hx hbx
    exact hcz _ (hparamS j x hx) (by linarith)
  have hV2 : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) < 0 →
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x = 0 := by
    intro x hx hbx
    have hUo : IsOpen (P.W j ∩ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) ⁻¹' Set.Iio c) :=
      (hb j).continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open j) isOpen_Iio
    have hxU : x ∈ P.W j ∩ (fun y => b (P.param j y)) ⁻¹' Set.Iio c :=
      ⟨hx, show b (P.param j x) < c by linarith⟩
    have hev : (fun y => v (P.param j y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hUo.mem_nhds hxU) (fun y hy => hcz _ (hparamS j y hy.1) hy.2)
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact fderiv_const_apply 0
  have hV3 : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, b (P.param j x) < 0 → eigGam P v v j x = 0 := by
    intro x hx hbx
    have h0 := hV2 x hx hbx
    simp [eigGam, pd2, h0]
  
  have h1 := hE (fun y => v (P.param j y)) (hv j)
  
  have hA : ∫ x in L, v (P.param j x) * v (P.param j x) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det ≤
      eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => v (P.param i x) * v (P.param i x)) :=
    pcgb_dp_localize S P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hK hρK hρO b hρ1
      (fun i x => v (P.param i x) * v (P.param i x))
      (fun i => (hv i).continuousOn.mul (hv i).continuousOn)
      (fun i x _ => mul_self_nonneg _)
      (fun i' i x hx => by simp only [hT i' i x hx])
      j (fun x hx hbx => by simp only [hV1 x hx hbx, mul_zero]) L hL hLW
  have hAeq : eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => v (P.param i x) * v (P.param i x)) =
      eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => v (P.param i x) ^ 2) := by
    congr 1
    funext i x
    ring
  have hPv := hP v hv ⟨c, hc0, hcz⟩
  
  have hB : ∫ x in L, eigGam P v v j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det ≤
      eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P v v) :=
    pcgb_dp_localize S P ρ Kc hρnn hρs hK hρK hρO b hρ1 (eigGam P v v)
      (fun i => (eig_gam_facts S P v v hv hv i).1)
      (fun i => (eig_gam_facts S P v v hv hv i).2.1)
      (fun i' i x hx => eig_grad_pair_compat S P v v hv hv i' i x hx)
      j hV3 L hL hLW
  have hBeq : (∫ x in L, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (P.h j x)⁻¹ a b *
        pd2 b (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x * pd2 a (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x) *
        Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) =
      ∫ x in L, eigGam P v v j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := rfl
  rw [hBeq] at h1
  set E := eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P v v) with hEdef
  have hsum : (∫ x in L, v (P.param j x) * v (P.param j x) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) +
      (∫ x in L, eigGam P v v j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) ≤ (CP + 1) * E := by
    rw [hAeq] at hA
    nlinarith
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hC₁
  calc _ ≤ _ := h1
    _ ≤ C₁ * ((CP + 1) * E) := h2
    _ = C₁ * (CP + 1) * E := by ring

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_local_energy
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) (hLW : L ⊆ W) : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ w : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w W → ∫ x in L, (w x ^ 2 + ∑ k : Fin 2, (pd2 k w x) ^ 2) ≤ C * ((∫ x in L, w x * w x * Real.sqrt (h x).det) + ∫ x in L, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 b w x * pd2 a w x) * Real.sqrt (h x).det)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_dp_localize
subgoal_signatures.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ) (hF : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (F j) (P.W j))
    (hFnn : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ F j x)
    (hcompat : ∀ j i, ∀ x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O i, F j x = F i (P.proj i (P.param j x)))
    (k : Fin P.n) (hFb : ∀ x ∈ P.W k, b (P.param k x) < 0 → F k x = 0)
    (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) (hLW : L ⊆ P.W k) :
    ∫ x in L, F k x * Real.sqrt (P.h k x).det ≤ eigWInt P ρ F

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_gam_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (u v : X → ℝ) (hu : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hv : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (j : Fin P.n) : ContinuousOn (eigGam P u v j) (P.W j) ∧ (∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ eigGam P u u j x) ∧ ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ t : ℝ, eigGam P (u + t • v) (u + t • v) j x = eigGam P u u j x + 2 * t * eigGam P u v j x + t ^ 2 * eigGam P v v j x

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_grad_pair_compat
subgoal_signatures.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (u v : X → ℝ) (hu : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hv : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (j k : Fin P.n) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) : eigGam P u v j x = eigGam P u v k (P.proj k (P.param j x))

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ m, ContinuousOn (v m) W)
    (hcauchy : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ,
      ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l → ∫ x in L, (v m x - v l x) ^ 2 < ε) :
    ∃ w : E2 → ℝ, (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W →
        Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)

signature.name: pcgb_ws_l2loc_limit
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ m, ContinuousOn (v m) W)
    (hcauchy : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ,
      ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l → ∫ x in L, (v m x - v l x) ^ 2 < ε) :
    ∃ w : E2 → ℝ, (∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W →
        Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s1 : ∃ K : ℕ → Set E2, (∀ j, IsCompact (K j)) ∧ (∀ j, K j ⊆ W) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≤ j → K i ⊆ K j) ∧ ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ∃ j, L ⊆ K j := by
    refine ⟨fun j => Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) j ∩
      {x | ∀ y, y ∉ W → 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ dist x y}, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j
      apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
      · apply Metric.isClosed_closedBall.inter
        have : {x : E2 | ∀ y, y ∉ W → 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ dist x y} =
            ⋂ y ∈ Wᶜ, {x | 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ dist x y} := by
          ext x; simp
        rw [this]
        exact isClosed_biInter fun y _ =>
          isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)
      · exact Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset Set.inter_subset_left
    · intro j x hx
      by_contra h
      have h1 := hx.2 x h
      rw [dist_self] at h1
      have : (0:ℝ) < 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
      linarith
    · intro i j hij x hx
      have hij' : (i : ℝ) ≤ j := by exact_mod_cast hij
      refine ⟨Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hij' hx.1, fun y hy => ?_⟩
      have h1 : 1 / ((j:ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 / ((i:ℝ) + 1) :=
        one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)
      exact h1.trans (hx.2 y hy)
    · intro L hL hLW
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδW⟩ := hL.exists_thickening_subset_open hW hLW
      obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall (0:E2)).1 hL.isBounded
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max R (1/δ))
      refine ⟨j, fun x hx => ⟨Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall
        (le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hj)) (hR hx), fun y hy => ?_⟩⟩
      have h1 : 1/δ < (j:ℝ) + 1 := by linarith [le_max_right R (1/δ)]
      have h2 : 1 / ((j:ℝ)+1) < δ := by
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        rw [div_lt_iff₀ hδ] at h1
        linarith
      have h3 : δ ≤ dist x y := by
        by_contra h
        push_neg at h
        apply hy
        apply hδW
        rw [Metric.mem_thickening_iff]
        exact ⟨x, hx, by rw [dist_comm]; exact h⟩
      linarith
  
  have s2 : ∀ (μ : Measure E2) (f : E2 → ℝ), MemLp f 2 μ →
      (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ < ε ^ 2 → eLpNorm f 2 μ < ENNReal.ofReal ε) ∧
      (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 ≤ ε → eLpNorm f 2 μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε → ∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ ε ^ 2) := by
    intro μ f hf
    have h := hf.eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm two_ne_zero ENNReal.ofNat_ne_top
    have hI : 0 ≤ ∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ := integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
    have e1 : (fun a => ‖f a‖ ^ (2:ENNReal).toReal) = fun a => f a ^ 2 := by
      funext a
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
    have hid : ∫ x, f x ^ 2 ∂μ = ((eLpNorm f 2 μ).toReal) ^ 2 := by
      rw [h, e1, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Real.rpow_nonneg hI _), ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, ← one_div,
        ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sq_sqrt hI]
    have ha : 0 ≤ (eLpNorm f 2 μ).toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    have he : eLpNorm f 2 μ = ENNReal.ofReal (eLpNorm f 2 μ).toReal :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hf.eLpNorm_lt_top.ne).symm
    refine ⟨fun ε hε hlt => ?_, fun ε hε hle => ?_⟩
    · rw [hid] at hlt
      have : (eLpNorm f 2 μ).toReal < ε := by nlinarith
      rw [he]
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hε).2 this
    · have h2 : (eLpNorm f 2 μ).toReal ≤ ε := ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal hε hle
      rw [hid]
      nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨K, hKc, hKW, hKmono, hKabs⟩ := s1
  have hmem : ∀ (φ : E2 → ℝ) (L : Set E2), IsCompact L → L ⊆ W → ContinuousOn φ W →
      MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict L) := by
    intro φ L hL hLW hφ
    exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq ((hφ.mono hLW).aestronglyMeasurable hL.measurableSet)).2
      (((hφ.mono hLW).pow 2).integrableOn_compact hL)
  have hvK : ∀ m i, MemLp (v m) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) :=
    fun m i => hmem _ _ (hKc i) (hKW i) (hv m)
  have hcauK : ∀ i (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m l, N ≤ m → N ≤ l →
      eLpNorm (v m - v l) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) < ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    intro i ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hcauchy (K i) (hKc i) (hKW i) (ε ^ 2) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨N, fun m l hm hl => ?_⟩
    exact (s2 _ _ ((hvK m i).sub (hvK l i))).1 ε hε (hN m l hm hl)
  
  choose N hN using fun j => hcauK j ((1/2:ℝ) ^ j) (by positivity)
  set n : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => j + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (j+1), N k with hn_def
  have hn_ge : ∀ j, j ≤ n j := fun j => Nat.le_add_right _ _
  have hNn : ∀ j, N j ≤ n j := fun j =>
    le_add_left (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.self_mem_range_succ j))
  have hn_mono : Monotone n := by
    intro a b hab
    exact Nat.add_le_add hab (Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.range_mono (by omega)))
  set w : E2 → ℝ := fun x => limUnder atTop (fun t => v (n t) x) with hw_def
  have hae : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (K i)),
      Tendsto (fun t => v (n t) x) atTop (𝓝 (w x)) := by
    intro i
    have hclaim : ∀ T a b : ℕ, T ≤ a → T ≤ b →
        eLpNorm (v (n (a + i)) - v (n (b + i))) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) <
          ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2:ℝ) ^ T) := by
      intro T a b ha hb
      have hM1 : N (T + i) ≤ n (a + i) := (hNn _).trans (hn_mono (by omega))
      have hM2 : N (T + i) ≤ n (b + i) := (hNn _).trans (hn_mono (by omega))
      calc eLpNorm (v (n (a + i)) - v (n (b + i))) 2 (volume.restrict (K i))
          ≤ eLpNorm (v (n (a + i)) - v (n (b + i))) 2 (volume.restrict (K (T + i))) :=
            eLpNorm_mono_measure _ (Measure.restrict_mono (hKmono i (T+i) (by omega)) le_rfl)
        _ < ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2:ℝ) ^ (T + i)) := hN (T + i) _ _ hM1 hM2
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2:ℝ) ^ T) :=
            ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by omega))
    have hBsum : ∑' T : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal ((1/2:ℝ) ^ T) ≠ ⊤ := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun _ => by positivity) summable_geometric_two]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    have hc := MeasureTheory.Lp.ae_tendsto_of_cauchy_eLpNorm (f := fun t => v (n (t + i)))
      (fun t => (hvK (n (t + i)) i).aestronglyMeasurable) (by norm_num : (1:ENNReal) ≤ 2)
      hBsum hclaim
    filter_upwards [hc] with x hx
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hx
    have hl' : Tendsto (fun t => v (n t) x) atTop (𝓝 l) :=
      (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat (f := fun t => v (n t) x) i).1 hl
    exact tendsto_nhds_limUnder ⟨l, hl'⟩
  
  have hlim : ∀ i, MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N' : ℕ, ∀ m, N' ≤ m →
      eLpNorm (v m - w) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
    intro i
    have hw : AEStronglyMeasurable w (volume.restrict (K i)) :=
      aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae atTop (fun t => (hvK (n t) i).aestronglyMeasurable) (hae i)
    have hbound : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N' : ℕ, ∀ m, N' ≤ m →
        eLpNorm (v m - w) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ := hcauK i ε hε
      refine ⟨N', fun m hm => ?_⟩
      have hF := MeasureTheory.Lp.eLpNorm_lim_le_liminf_eLpNorm (p := 2)
        (fun t => (hvK m i).aestronglyMeasurable.sub (hvK (n t) i).aestronglyMeasurable) (v m - w) (by
          filter_upwards [hae i] with x hx
          simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
          exact tendsto_const_nhds.sub hx)
      refine hF.trans ?_
      refine Filter.liminf_le_of_frequently_le' ?_
      refine Filter.Eventually.frequently ?_
      filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop N'] with t ht
      exact (hN' m (n t) hm (ht.trans (hn_ge t))).le
    refine ⟨?_, hbound⟩
    obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁⟩ := hbound 1 one_pos
    have h1 : MemLp (v N₁ - w) 2 (volume.restrict (K i)) :=
      ⟨(hvK N₁ i).aestronglyMeasurable.sub hw,
        lt_of_le_of_lt (hN₁ N₁ le_rfl) ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top⟩
    have : w = v N₁ - (v N₁ - w) := by funext x; simp
    rw [this]
    exact (hvK N₁ i).sub h1
  
  refine ⟨w, fun L hL hLW => ?_, fun L hL hLW => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨j, hLj⟩ := hKabs L hL hLW
    exact (hlim j).1.mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono hLj le_rfl)
  · obtain ⟨j, hLj⟩ := hKabs L hL hLW
    rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
    intro ε hε
    have hη : 0 < Real.sqrt (ε / 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ := (hlim j).2 _ hη
    refine ⟨N', fun m hm => ?_⟩
    have hD : MemLp (v m - w) 2 (volume.restrict (K j)) := (hvK m j).sub (hlim j).1
    have h1 : ∫ x in K j, (v m x - w x) ^ 2 ≤ Real.sqrt (ε / 2) ^ 2 :=
      (s2 _ _ hD).2 _ hη.le (hN' m hm)
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)] at h1
    have h2 : ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ x in K j, (v m x - w x) ^ 2 :=
      setIntegral_mono_set hD.integrable_sq (Eventually.of_forall fun x => sq_nonneg _)
        hLj.eventuallyLE
    have h3 : 0 ≤ ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2 :=
      setIntegral_nonneg hL.measurableSet (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _)
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg h3]
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (v m) W) (w : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W →
      MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ k, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (pd2 k (v m) x - G k x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W →
      ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, G k x * ζ x)

signature.name: pcgb_ws_weak_deriv
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (v m) W) (w : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ W →
      MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ k, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (pd2 k (v m) x - G k x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W →
      ∀ k : Fin 2, ∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, G k x * ζ x)

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ζ hζ hζc hζW k
  have hL : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc.isCompact
  obtain ⟨hwL, hGL, hvconv, hdconv⟩ := hL2 (tsupport ζ) hL hζW
  have hP := l2_compact_pairing (tsupport ζ) hL
  have hibp : ∀ m, ∫ x, v m x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, pd2 k (v m) x * ζ x) :=
    fun m => ibp_open_test W hW (v m) (hv m) ζ hζ hζc hζW k
  
  have hφc : Continuous (pd2 k ζ) := by
    have h1 : Continuous (fderiv ℝ ζ) := hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
    exact h1.clm_apply continuous_const
  have hφs : tsupport (pd2 k ζ) ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
    refine subset_trans ?_ (tsupport_fderiv_subset ℝ (f := ζ))
    apply closure_mono
    intro x hx
    simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
    intro h0
    apply hx
    show fderiv ℝ ζ x (e2 k) = 0
    rw [h0]
    rfl
  have hvm : ∀ m, MemLp (v m) 2 (volume.restrict (tsupport ζ)) :=
    fun m => hP.1 (v m) ((hv m).continuousOn.mono hζW)
  have hdm : ∀ m, MemLp (pd2 k (v m)) 2 (volume.restrict (tsupport ζ)) := by
    intro m
    refine hP.1 _ ?_
    have h1 : ContinuousOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ (v m) x (e2 k)) W :=
      ((hv m).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    exact h1.mono hζW
  have hA : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, v m x * pd2 k ζ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x)) :=
    hP.2.2 v w (pd2 k ζ) hvm hwL hφc hφs hvconv
  have hB : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, pd2 k (v m) x * ζ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, G k x * ζ x)) :=
    hP.2.2 (fun m => pd2 k (v m)) (G k) ζ hdm (hGL k) hζ.continuous subset_rfl (hdconv k)
  have hA' : Tendsto (fun m => -(∫ x, pd2 k (v m) x * ζ x)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x, w x * pd2 k ζ x)) := by
    have hfun : (fun m => ∫ x, v m x * pd2 k ζ x) = (fun m => -(∫ x, pd2 k (v m) x * ζ x)) :=
      funext hibp
    rw [← hfun]
    exact hA
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hA' hB.neg

subgoal_signatures.name: l2_compact_pairing
subgoal_signatures.statement: (L : Set E2) (hL : IsCompact L) : (∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f L → MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧ (∀ f φ : E2 → ℝ, MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L → Integrable (fun x => f x * φ x)) ∧ ∀ (v : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (w φ : E2 → ℝ), (∀ m, MemLp (v m) 2 (volume.restrict L)) → MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) → Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ L → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in L, (v m x - w x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x, v m x * φ x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, w x * φ x))

subgoal_signatures.name: ibp_open_test
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ) (hζW : tsupport ζ ⊆ W) (k : Fin 2) : ∫ x, u x * pd2 k ζ x = -(∫ x, pd2 k u x * ζ x)

informal_problem.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (f : X → ℝ) (hfc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => f (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (j : Fin P.n) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ)
    (hζs : tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W j ∩ {x | 0 < b (P.param j x)}) :
    ∃ Z : X → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Z (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) ∧
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → Z q = 0) ∧
      (∀ c : Fin 2,
        Continuous (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) ∧
        tsupport (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) ⊆
          tsupport ζ) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x) ∧
      (∀ v : X → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
        eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P v Z) = ∑ c : Fin 2, ∫ x, pd2 c (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x *
          (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x)) ∧
      eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => f (P.param i x) * Z (P.param i x)) =
        ∫ x, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x

signature.name: pcgb_ws_test_pairing
signature.statement:
{X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X]
    (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (ρ : Fin P.n → X → ℝ) (Kc : Fin P.n → Set E2)
    (hρnn : ∀ j q, 0 ≤ ρ j q)
    (hρs : ∀ j k, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => ρ j (P.param k x)) (P.W k))
    (hK : ∀ j, IsCompact (Kc j) ∧ Kc j ⊆ P.W j)
    (hρK : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, x ∉ Kc j → ρ j (P.param j x) = 0)
    (hρO : ∀ j q, q ∉ P.O j → ρ j q = 0)
    (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => b (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (hρ1 : ∀ q, q ∈ S → 0 ≤ b q → ∑ j, ρ j q = 1)
    (f : X → ℝ) (hfc : ∀ j, ContinuousOn (fun x => f (P.param j x)) (P.W j))
    (j : Fin P.n) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ)
    (hζs : tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W j ∩ {x | 0 < b (P.param j x)}) :
    ∃ Z : X → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Z (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) ∧
      (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → Z q = 0) ∧
      (∀ c : Fin 2,
        Continuous (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) ∧
        tsupport (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) ⊆
          tsupport ζ) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x) ∧
      (∀ v : X → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
        eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P v Z) = ∑ c : Fin 2, ∫ x, pd2 c (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x *
          (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x)) ∧
      eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => f (P.param i x) * Z (P.param i x)) =
        ∫ x, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hT : IsCompact (tsupport ζ) := hζc.isCompact
  have hTW : tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W j := fun x hx => (hζs hx).1
  have hTb : ∀ x ∈ tsupport ζ, 0 < b (P.param j x) := fun x hx => (hζs hx).2
  have hζ0 : ∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → ζ x = 0 := fun x hx => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
  have hP1 : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ P.W i, P.param i x ∈ P.O i ∧ P.param i x ∈ S := by
    intro i x hx
    have hmem : P.param i x ∈ P.param i '' P.W i := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [P.image_eq i] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hP3 : ∀ i k, ∀ x ∈ P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' P.O k,
      P.proj k (P.param i x) ∈ P.W k ∧ P.param k (P.proj k (P.param i x)) = P.param i x := by
    intro i k x hx
    have hq : P.param i x ∈ P.O k ∩ S := ⟨hx.2, (hP1 i x hx.1).2⟩
    rw [← P.image_eq k] at hq
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hq
    rw [← hyx, P.proj_param k y hy]
    exact ⟨hy, rfl⟩
  have hd : ContinuousOn (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j) :=
    (elr_coeff_smooth (P.W j) (P.W_open j) (P.h j) (P.h_smooth j) (P.h_posDef j)).2.1.continuousOn
  
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ1, hZ2, hZ3, hZ4⟩ := eig_lift_smooth S P j ζ hζ hζc hTW
  have hZj : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, Z (P.param j x) = ζ x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hZ3 _ (hP1 j x hx).1, P.proj_param j x hx]
  have hZjd : ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => Z (P.param j y)) x = pd2 a ζ x := by
    intro x hx a
    have hev : (fun y => Z (P.param j y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] ζ :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((P.W_open j).mem_nhds hx) (fun y hy => hZj y hy)
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  have hZoff : ∀ i, ∀ x ∈ P.W i, P.param i x ∉ P.param j '' tsupport ζ →
      Z (P.param i x) = 0 ∧ ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => Z (P.param i y)) x = 0 := by
    intro i x hx hnot
    have hev : (fun y => Z (P.param i y)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := hZ4 i x hx hnot
    refine ⟨hev.self_of_nhds, fun a => ?_⟩
    unfold pd2
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  
  have hadm : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → Z q = 0 := by
    have key : ∀ c : ℝ, (∀ y ∈ tsupport ζ, c ≤ b (P.param j y)) →
        ∀ q ∈ S, b q < c → Z q = 0 := by
      intro c hc q hqS hbq
      by_cases hqO : q ∈ P.O j
      · have hq : q ∈ P.O j ∩ S := ⟨hqO, hqS⟩
        rw [← P.image_eq j] at hq
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hyq⟩ := hq
        rw [← hyq, hZj y hy]
        apply hζ0
        intro hyT
        have h1 := hc y hyT
        rw [hyq] at h1
        linarith
      · exact hZ2 q hqO
    rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (tsupport ζ) with hE | hne
    · refine ⟨1, one_pos, key 1 ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      simp [hE] at hy
    · obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hmin⟩ := hT.exists_isMinOn hne ((hb j).continuousOn.mono hTW)
      refine ⟨b (P.param j x₁), hTb x₁ hx₁, key _ ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      exact isMinOn_iff.mp hmin y hy
  
  have hPL : ∀ y ∈ P.W j, y ∉ tsupport ζ → P.param j y ∉ P.param j '' tsupport ζ := by
    rintro y hy hyL ⟨y', hy', heq⟩
    apply hyL
    have e := congrArg (P.proj j) heq
    rw [P.proj_param j y' (hTW hy'), P.proj_param j y hy] at e
    rw [← e]
    exact hy'
  have hAo : ∀ i, IsOpen (P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' P.O j) := fun i =>
    (P.param_cont i).isOpen_inter_preimage (P.W_open i) (P.O_open j)
  have hloc : ∀ F : Fin P.n → E2 → ℝ, (∀ i, ContinuousOn (F i) (P.W i)) →
      (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' P.O j, F i x = F j (P.proj j (P.param i x))) →
      (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ P.W i, P.param i x ∉ P.param j '' tsupport ζ → F i x = 0) →
      eigWInt P ρ F = ∫ x in P.W j, F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det := by
    intro F hF hcompat hL0
    have s2 : ∀ i,
        (∫ x in P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' P.O j,
            ρ i (P.param i x) * F i x * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det) =
          (∫ y in P.W j, ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det) := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨hc1, -⟩ := eig_chart_cov S P i j (fun y => ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y)
      have hEq : Set.EqOn (fun x => ρ i (P.param i x) * F i x * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det)
          (fun x => ρ i (P.param j (P.proj j (P.param i x))) * F j (P.proj j (P.param i x)) *
            Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det)
          (P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' P.O j) := by
        intro x hx
        show ρ i (P.param i x) * F i x * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det =
          ρ i (P.param j (P.proj j (P.param i x))) * F j (P.proj j (P.param i x)) *
            Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det
        rw [(hP3 i j x hx).2, hcompat i x hx]
      have hzero : ∀ y ∈ P.W j \ (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O i),
          ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det = 0 := by
        intro y hy
        have hy' : P.param j y ∉ P.O i := fun h => hy.2 ⟨hy.1, h⟩
        rw [hρO i _ hy', zero_mul, zero_mul]
      calc (∫ x in P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' P.O j,
            ρ i (P.param i x) * F i x * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det)
          = ∫ x in P.W i ∩ P.param i ⁻¹' P.O j,
              ρ i (P.param j (P.proj j (P.param i x))) * F j (P.proj j (P.param i x)) *
                Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det :=
            MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (hAo i).measurableSet hEq
        _ = ∫ y in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O i,
              ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det := hc1
        _ = ∫ y in P.W j, ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det :=
            (MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero
              (P.W_open j).measurableSet Set.inter_subset_left hzero).symm
    have hgi : ∀ i, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
        (fun y => ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det) (P.W j)
        MeasureTheory.volume := by
      intro i
      have hc : ContinuousOn
          (fun y => ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det) (P.W j) :=
        (((hρs i j).continuousOn).mul (hF j)).mul hd
      have hiL := (hc.mono hTW).integrableOn_compact (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hT
      refine hiL.of_forall_diff_eq_zero (P.W_open j).measurableSet ?_
      intro y hy
      show ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det = 0
      rw [hL0 j y hy.1 (hPL y hy.1 hy.2), mul_zero, zero_mul]
    have hWj : ∀ i, (∫ x in P.W i, ρ i (P.param i x) * F i x * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det) =
        ∫ y in P.W j, ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det := by
      intro i
      rw [← s2 i]
      apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_diff_eq_zero
        (P.W_open i).measurableSet Set.inter_subset_left
      intro x hx
      have hxO : P.param i x ∉ P.O j := fun h => hx.2 ⟨hx.1, h⟩
      have hxL : P.param i x ∉ P.param j '' tsupport ζ := by
        rintro ⟨y', hy', heq⟩
        apply hxO
        rw [← heq]
        exact (hP1 j y' (hTW hy')).1
      rw [hL0 i x hx.1 hxL, mul_zero, zero_mul]
    have hP7 : ∀ y ∈ P.W j,
        (∑ i, ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det) =
          F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det := by
      intro y hy
      by_cases hyL : y ∈ tsupport ζ
      · rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul,
          hρ1 _ (hP1 j y hy).2 (hTb y hyL).le, one_mul]
      · rw [hL0 j y hy (hPL y hy hyL)]
        simp
    have hswap := MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum
      (μ := MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (P.W j)) Finset.univ (fun i _ => hgi i)
    calc eigWInt P ρ F
        = ∑ i, ∫ x in P.W i, ρ i (P.param i x) * F i x * Real.sqrt (P.h i x).det := rfl
      _ = ∑ i, ∫ y in P.W j, ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hWj i)
      _ = ∫ y in P.W j, ∑ i, ρ i (P.param j y) * F j y * Real.sqrt (P.h j y).det :=
          hswap.symm
      _ = ∫ x in P.W j, F j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det :=
          MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (P.W_open j).measurableSet hP7
  
  have hcpt : ∀ g : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn g (P.W j) → (∀ x, x ∉ tsupport ζ → g x = 0) →
      Continuous g ∧ Integrable g := by
    intro g hg h0
    have hsupp : Function.support g ⊆ tsupport ζ := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxT
      exact hx (h0 x hxT)
    have hts : tsupport g ⊆ tsupport ζ := closure_minimal hsupp (isClosed_tsupport ζ)
    have hcont : Continuous g := hg.continuous_of_tsupport_subset (P.W_open j) (hts.trans hTW)
    have hcs : HasCompactSupport g := hT.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport g) hts
    exact ⟨hcont, hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcs⟩
  
  have hel := (el_coeff_continuous (P.W j) (P.W_open j) (P.h j) (P.h_smooth j) (P.h_posDef j)
    (fun _ => 0) contDiffOn_const ζ hζ hζc hTW).1
  have hφ : ∀ c : Fin 2,
      Continuous (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) ∧
      tsupport (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) ⊆
        tsupport ζ := by
    intro c
    refine ⟨continuous_finset_sum _ (fun a _ => (hel a c).1), ?_⟩
    apply closure_minimal _ (isClosed_tsupport ζ)
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxT
    apply hx
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro a _
    exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      (f := fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x)
      (fun h => hxT ((hel a c).2 h))
  have hφz : ∀ (c : Fin 2) (x : E2), x ∉ tsupport ζ →
      (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) = 0 := by
    intro c x hx
    exact image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      (f := fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x)
      (fun h => hx ((hφ c).2 h))
  
  have hint : Integrable (fun x => Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x) :=
    (hcpt _ ((hd.mul (hfc j)).mul hζ.continuous.continuousOn)
      (fun x hx => by simp [hζ0 x hx])).2
  
  have hB : ∀ v : X → ℝ, (∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param i x)) (P.W i)) →
      eigWInt P ρ (eigGam P v Z) = ∑ c : Fin 2, ∫ x, pd2 c (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x *
        (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) := by
    intro v hv
    have h1 := hloc (eigGam P v Z) (fun i => (eig_gam_facts S P v Z hv hZ1 i).1)
      (fun i x hx => eig_grad_pair_compat S P v Z hv hZ1 i j x hx)
      (fun i x hx hnot => by
        unfold eigGam
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro a _
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro b _
        rw [(hZoff i x hx hnot).2 a, mul_zero])
    rw [h1]
    have hgc : ∀ c : Fin 2,
        ContinuousOn (fun x => pd2 c (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x) (P.W j) := fun c =>
      ((hv j).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (P.W_open j) (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hgi : ∀ c : Fin 2, Integrable (fun x => pd2 c (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x *
        (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x)) :=
      fun c => (hcpt _ ((hgc c).mul (hφ c).1.continuousOn)
        (fun x hx => by simp only [hφz c x hx, mul_zero])).2
    calc (∫ x in P.W j, eigGam P v Z j x * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
        = ∫ x in P.W j, ∑ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x *
            (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) := by
          apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (P.W_open j).measurableSet
          intro x hx
          simp only [eigGam, hZjd x hx, Fin.sum_univ_two]
          ring
      _ = ∫ x, ∑ c : Fin 2, pd2 c (fun y => v (P.param j y)) x *
            (∑ a : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * (P.h j x)⁻¹ a c * pd2 a ζ x) := by
          apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
          intro x hx
          have hxT : x ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h => hx (hTW h)
          simp only [hφz _ x hxT, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
      _ = _ := MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ (fun c _ => hgi c)
  
  have hΛ : eigWInt P ρ (fun i x => f (P.param i x) * Z (P.param i x)) =
      ∫ x, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x := by
    rw [hloc (fun i x => f (P.param i x) * Z (P.param i x))
      (fun i => (hfc i).mul (hZ1 i).continuousOn)
      (fun i x hx => by
        show f (P.param i x) * Z (P.param i x) =
          f (P.param j (P.proj j (P.param i x))) * Z (P.param j (P.proj j (P.param i x)))
        rw [(hP3 i j x hx).2])
      (fun i x hx hnot => by
        show f (P.param i x) * Z (P.param i x) = 0
        rw [(hZoff i x hx hnot).1, mul_zero])]
    calc (∫ x in P.W j, f (P.param j x) * Z (P.param j x) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det)
        = ∫ x in P.W j, Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det * f (P.param j x) * ζ x := by
          apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun (P.W_open j).measurableSet
          intro x hx
          simp only [hZj x hx]
          ring
      _ = _ := by
          apply MeasureTheory.setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
          intro x hx
          simp [hζ0 x (fun h => hx (hTW h))]
  exact ⟨Z, hZ1, hadm, hφ, hint, hB, hΛ⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_lift_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (k : Fin P.n) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hc : HasCompactSupport ζ) (hs : tsupport ζ ⊆ P.W k) : ∃ Z : X → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Z (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) ∧ (∀ q, q ∉ P.O k → Z q = 0) ∧ (∀ q ∈ P.O k, Z q = ζ (P.proj k q)) ∧ ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ P.W j, P.param j x ∉ P.param k '' tsupport ζ → ∀ᶠ x' in 𝓝 x, Z (P.param j x') = 0

subgoal_signatures.name: elr_coeff_smooth
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) : (∀ x ∈ W, 0 < Real.sqrt (h x).det) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det) W ∧ (∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ a b) W) ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, (Real.sqrt (h x).det • (h x)⁻¹).PosDef

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_chart_cov
subgoal_signatures.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (j k : Fin P.n) (G : E2 → ℝ) : (∫ x in P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k, G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) = (∫ y in P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j, G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) ∧ (MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun x => G (P.proj k (P.param j x)) * Real.sqrt (P.h j x).det) (P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => G y * Real.sqrt (P.h k y).det) (P.W k ∩ P.param k ⁻¹' P.O j) MeasureTheory.volume)

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_gam_facts
subgoal_signatures.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (u v : X → ℝ) (hu : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hv : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (j : Fin P.n) : ContinuousOn (eigGam P u v j) (P.W j) ∧ (∀ x ∈ P.W j, 0 ≤ eigGam P u u j x) ∧ ∀ x ∈ P.W j, ∀ t : ℝ, eigGam P (u + t • v) (u + t • v) j x = eigGam P u u j x + 2 * t * eigGam P u v j x + t ^ 2 * eigGam P v v j x

subgoal_signatures.name: eig_grad_pair_compat
subgoal_signatures.statement: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (S : Set X) (P : EigPatchedSurface X S) (u v : X → ℝ) (hu : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (hv : ∀ j, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => v (P.param j x)) (P.W j)) (j k : Fin P.n) (x : E2) (hx : x ∈ P.W j ∩ P.param j ⁻¹' P.O k) : eigGam P u v j x = eigGam P u v k (P.proj k (P.param j x))

subgoal_signatures.name: el_coeff_continuous
subgoal_signatures.statement: (W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (hh : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a b) W) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (c : E2 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ c W) (ζ : E2 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ) (hζW : tsupport ζ ⊆ W) : (∀ a b : Fin 2, Continuous (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a ζ x) ∧ tsupport (fun x => Real.sqrt (h x).det * (h x)⁻¹ a b * pd2 a ζ x) ⊆ tsupport ζ) ∧ Continuous (fun x => c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * ζ x) ∧ tsupport (fun x => c x * Real.sqrt (h x).det * ζ x) ⊆ tsupport ζ

informal_problem.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ : E2) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcgbPxQuad A x₀) ∧ ∀ y : E2,
      |pcgbPxQuad A x₀ y| ≤ (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, |A a c|) * dist y x₀ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (pcgbPxQuad A x₀) y‖ ≤ 2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, |A a c|) * dist y x₀ ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (pcgbPxQuad A x₀)) y‖ ≤ 2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, |A a c|)

signature.name: pcgb_px_quad_bounds
signature.statement:
(A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ : E2) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcgbPxQuad A x₀) ∧ ∀ y : E2,
      |pcgbPxQuad A x₀ y| ≤ (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, |A a c|) * dist y x₀ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (pcgbPxQuad A x₀) y‖ ≤ 2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, |A a c|) * dist y x₀ ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (pcgbPxQuad A x₀)) y‖ ≤ 2 * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, |A a c|)

proof.tactics:
by
  set ℓ : Fin 2 → (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := fun a => EuclideanSpace.proj a with hℓdef
  have hℓv : ∀ (a : Fin 2) (v : E2), ℓ a v = v a := fun a v => rfl
  have hℓn : ∀ a, ‖ℓ a‖ ≤ 1 := fun a =>
    ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun v => by
      rw [hℓv, one_mul]; exact PiLp.norm_apply_le v a)
  have hz : ∀ (a : Fin 2) (y : E2), |(y - x₀) a| ≤ dist y x₀ := fun a y => by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact PiLp.norm_apply_le _ _
  have hzd : ∀ (a : Fin 2) (y : E2), HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) a) (ℓ a) y := by
    intro a y
    have e : (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) a) = fun y => ℓ a y - ℓ a x₀ := by
      funext w; exact (ℓ a).map_sub w x₀
    rw [e]; exact ((ℓ a).hasFDerivAt).sub_const _
  have hzc : ∀ a : Fin 2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) a) := fun a =>
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj a : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff).comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  have eQ : pcgbPxQuad A x₀ =
      fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c * ((y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) c) := by
    funext w; simp only [pcgbPxQuad, mul_assoc]
  have hQd : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt (pcgbPxQuad A x₀)
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c • ((y - x₀) a • ℓ c + (y - x₀) c • ℓ a)) y := by
    intro y
    rw [eQ]
    refine HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (fun a _ => HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (fun c _ => ?_))
    exact ((hzd a y).fun_mul (hzd c y)).const_mul (A a c)
  set H : E2 →L[ℝ] (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) := ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
    A a c • ((ℓ a).smulRight (ℓ c) + (ℓ c).smulRight (ℓ a)) with hHdef
  have hfQ : fderiv ℝ (pcgbPxQuad A x₀) =
      fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c • ((y - x₀) a • ℓ c + (y - x₀) c • ℓ a) :=
    funext fun y => (hQd y).fderiv
  have hPd : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt
      (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c • ((y - x₀) a • ℓ c + (y - x₀) c • ℓ a)) H y := by
    intro y
    refine HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (fun a _ => HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (fun c _ => ?_))
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) a • ℓ c + (y - x₀) c • ℓ a)
        ((ℓ a).smulRight (ℓ c) + (ℓ c).smulRight (ℓ a)) y :=
      ((hzd a y).smul_const (ℓ c)).add ((hzd c y).smul_const (ℓ a))
    exact h1.const_smul (A a c)
  refine ⟨?_, fun y => ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [eQ]
    exact ContDiff.sum (fun a _ => ContDiff.sum (fun c _ =>
      contDiff_const.mul ((hzc a).mul (hzc c))))
  · have key : |pcgbPxQuad A x₀ y| ≤ ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, |A a c| * dist y x₀ ^ 2 := by
      rw [eQ]
      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ =>
        (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => ?_))
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      have h1 := hz a y
      have h2 := hz c y
      have h3 := mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) dist_nonneg
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by nlinarith) (abs_nonneg _)
    refine key.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  · rw [hfQ]
    have key : ‖∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A a c • ((y - x₀) a • ℓ c + (y - x₀) c • ℓ a)‖ ≤
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, |A a c| * (2 * dist y x₀) := by
      refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ =>
        (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => ?_))
      have t : ‖(y - x₀) a • ℓ c + (y - x₀) c • ℓ a‖ ≤ 2 * dist y x₀ := by
        refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans ?_
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have k1 := mul_le_mul (hz a y) (hℓn c) (norm_nonneg _) dist_nonneg
        have k2 := mul_le_mul (hz c y) (hℓn a) (norm_nonneg _) dist_nonneg
        linarith
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left t (abs_nonneg _)
    refine key.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  · rw [hfQ, (hPd y).fderiv, hHdef]
    have key : ‖∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        A a c • ((ℓ a).smulRight (ℓ c) + (ℓ c).smulRight (ℓ a))‖ ≤
        ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, |A a c| * 2 := by
      have hs1 := norm_sum_le (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))
        (fun a : Fin 2 => (∑ c : Fin 2,
          A a c • ((ℓ a).smulRight (ℓ c) + (ℓ c).smulRight (ℓ a)) : E2 →L[ℝ] (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)))
      refine le_trans hs1 ?_
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => ?_
      have hs2 := norm_sum_le (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))
        (fun c : Fin 2 =>
          (A a c • ((ℓ a).smulRight (ℓ c) + (ℓ c).smulRight (ℓ a)) : E2 →L[ℝ] (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)))
      refine le_trans hs2 ?_
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun c _ => ?_
      have t : ‖(ℓ a).smulRight (ℓ c) + (ℓ c).smulRight (ℓ a)‖ ≤ 2 := by
        have hadd := norm_add_le ((ℓ a).smulRight (ℓ c)) ((ℓ c).smulRight (ℓ a))
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply,
          ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply] at hadd
        have k1 := mul_le_one₀ (hℓn a) (norm_nonneg _) (hℓn c)
        have k2 := mul_le_one₀ (hℓn c) (norm_nonneg _) (hℓn a)
        linarith
      have hsm := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le (A a c)
        ((ℓ a).smulRight (ℓ c) + (ℓ c).smulRight (ℓ a))
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hsm
      exact hsm.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left t (abs_nonneg _))
    refine key.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring

informal_problem.statement:
(x₀ : E2) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hσ1 : σ ≤ 1) (D Q : E2 → ℝ)
    (hD : ContDiff ℝ ∞ D) (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (c₀ l Λ K : ℝ) (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hl : 0 < l)
    (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hyp : ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < σ →
      c₀ * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ≤ D x ∧ l * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ≤ Q x ∧ Q x ≤ Λ * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ Q x‖ ≤ Λ * dist x x₀ ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Q) x‖ ≤ Λ ∧
      |D x - Q x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 3 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - Q y) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - Q y)) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < σ →
      |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D x) - Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q x))| ≤ C ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y) - Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y))) x‖ ≤ C ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y) - Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y)))) x‖ ≤
        C / dist x x₀

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hDd : Differentiable ℝ D := hD.differentiable (by simp)
  have hQd : Differentiable ℝ Q := hQ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hE : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => D y - Q y) := hD.sub hQ
  have hP1 : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ Q) :=
    (hQ.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiable (by simp)
  have hR1 : Differentiable ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - Q y)) :=
    (hE.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiable (by simp)
  have hDD : ∀ y, fderiv ℝ D y = fderiv ℝ Q y + fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) y := by
    intro y
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hDd y) (hQd y)]
    abel
  
  have hgrad : ∀ y, 0 < D y → 0 < Q y →
      HasFDerivAt (fun z => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D z) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (Q z))
        (((2 * D y)⁻¹ - (2 * Q y)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ Q y +
          (2 * D y)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) y) y := by
    intro y hDy hQy
    have h1 := ((hDd y).hasFDerivAt.log hDy.ne').const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    have h2 := ((hQd y).hasFDerivAt.log hQy.ne').const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun z => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D z) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (Q z))
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((D y)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ D y) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • ((Q y)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ Q y)) y :=
      h1.sub h2
    refine h3.congr_fderiv ?_
    rw [hDD y]
    module
  have hVo : IsOpen ({y : E2 | 0 < D y} ∩ {y : E2 | 0 < Q y}) :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const hD.continuous).inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const hQ.continuous)
  have hFgrad : ∀ y ∈ ({y : E2 | 0 < D y} ∩ {y : E2 | 0 < Q y}),
      HasFDerivAt (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y) - Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y)))
        (((2 * D y)⁻¹ - (2 * Q y)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ Q y +
          (2 * D y)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) y) y := by
    intro y hy
    refine (hgrad y hy.1 hy.2).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    filter_upwards [hVo.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
    have hz2 : 0 < Q z := hz.2
    show (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D z) - Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q z)) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D z) - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (Q z)
    rw [Real.log_sqrt hz2.le]
    ring
  
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ : ∃ A : ℝ, A = K / (2 * c₀ * l) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ : ∃ B : ℝ, B = 1 / (2 * c₀) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ : ∃ G : ℝ, G = K * (2 * Λ + K) / (2 * c₀ ^ 2 * l ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Bt, hBt⟩ : ∃ Bt : ℝ, Bt = 1 / (2 * c₀ ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by rw [hA]; positivity
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by rw [hB]; positivity
  have hG0 : 0 ≤ G := by rw [hG]; positivity
  have hBt0 : 0 ≤ Bt := by rw [hBt]; positivity
  
  have key : ∀ s d q : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ 1 → c₀ * s ^ 2 ≤ d → l * s ^ 2 ≤ q → q ≤ Λ * s ^ 2 →
      |d - q| ≤ K * s ^ 3 →
      |(1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log d - Real.log (Real.sqrt q)| ≤ (K / l + Λ / c₀) / 2 ∧
      s * |(2 * d)⁻¹ - (2 * q)⁻¹| ≤ A ∧ s ^ 2 * (2 * d)⁻¹ ≤ B ∧
      s ^ 3 * |2 * ((2 * q) ^ 2)⁻¹ - 2 * ((2 * d) ^ 2)⁻¹| ≤ G ∧
      s ^ 4 * (2 * ((2 * d) ^ 2)⁻¹) ≤ Bt := by
    intro s d q hs hs1 hd hq1 hq2 hdq
    have hs2 : 0 < s ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hd0 : 0 < d := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hd
    have hq0 : 0 < q := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hq1
    have hd0' : d ≠ 0 := hd0.ne'
    have hq0' : q ≠ 0 := hq0.ne'
    have hs32 : s ^ 3 ≤ s ^ 2 := by
      calc s ^ 3 = s ^ 2 * s := by ring
        _ ≤ s ^ 2 := mul_le_of_le_one_right hs2.le hs1
    have hdq' : d - q ≤ K * s ^ 3 := le_trans (le_abs_self _) hdq
    have hqd : |q - d| ≤ K * s ^ 3 := by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact hdq
    have hdqprod : c₀ * s ^ 2 * (l * s ^ 2) ≤ d * q := mul_le_mul hd hq1 (by positivity) hd0.le
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Real.log_sqrt hq0.le]
      have hup : Real.log d - Real.log q ≤ K / l := by
        rw [← Real.log_div hd0' hq0']
        refine le_trans (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hd0 hq0)) ?_
        rw [div_sub_one hq0', div_le_div_iff₀ hq0 hl]
        have e1 : (d - q) * l ≤ K * s ^ 3 * l := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdq' hl.le
        have e2 : K * l * s ^ 3 ≤ K * l * s ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs32 (by positivity)
        have e3 : K * (l * s ^ 2) ≤ K * q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq1 hK
        linarith
      have hlo : Real.log q - Real.log d ≤ Λ / c₀ := by
        rw [← Real.log_div hq0' hd0']
        refine le_trans (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hq0 hd0)) ?_
        have : q / d ≤ Λ / c₀ := by
          rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hd0 hc₀]
          have e1 : q * c₀ ≤ Λ * s ^ 2 * c₀ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq2 hc₀.le
          have e2 : Λ * (c₀ * s ^ 2) ≤ Λ * d := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hΛ
          linarith
        linarith
      have hKl : 0 ≤ K / l := by positivity
      have hΛc : 0 ≤ Λ / c₀ := by positivity
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith
    · rw [show (2 * d)⁻¹ - (2 * q)⁻¹ = (q - d) / (2 * d * q) by field_simp, abs_div,
        abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 * d * q), hA, ← mul_div_assoc,
        div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      have e1 : s * |q - d| ≤ s * (K * s ^ 3) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqd hs.le
      have e2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right e1 (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * c₀ * l)
      have e3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdqprod (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * K)
      linarith
    · rw [hB, show s ^ 2 * (2 * d)⁻¹ = s ^ 2 / (2 * d) by ring,
        div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      linarith
    · have e0 : K * s ^ 3 ≤ K * s ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs32 hK
      have hsum : d + q ≤ (2 * Λ + K) * s ^ 2 := by linarith
      have hsum0 : 0 < d + q := by positivity
      rw [show 2 * ((2 * q) ^ 2)⁻¹ - 2 * ((2 * d) ^ 2)⁻¹ = (d - q) * (d + q) / (2 * d ^ 2 * q ^ 2) by
          field_simp; ring,
        abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hsum0, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 * d ^ 2 * q ^ 2),
        hG, ← mul_div_assoc, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      have e1 : s ^ 3 * |d - q| ≤ s ^ 3 * (K * s ^ 3) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdq (by positivity)
      have e2 : s ^ 3 * |d - q| * (d + q) ≤ s ^ 3 * (K * s ^ 3) * ((2 * Λ + K) * s ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul e1 hsum hsum0.le (by positivity)
      have e3 : (c₀ * s ^ 2 * (l * s ^ 2)) ^ 2 ≤ (d * q) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hdqprod 2
      have e4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e3 (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * K * (2 * Λ + K))
      have e5 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right e2 (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * c₀ ^ 2 * l ^ 2)
      linarith
    · rw [hBt, show s ^ 4 * (2 * ((2 * d) ^ 2)⁻¹) = s ^ 4 / (2 * d ^ 2) by ring,
        div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      have e := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hd 2
      linarith
  
  have hfin : ∀ s ua b ual β nQ nE mQ mE nA nB N : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ 1 →
      s * ua ≤ A → s ^ 2 * b ≤ B → s ^ 3 * ual ≤ G → s ^ 4 * β ≤ Bt →
      0 ≤ ua → 0 ≤ b → 0 ≤ ual → 0 ≤ β →
      0 ≤ nQ → nQ ≤ Λ * s → 0 ≤ nE → nE ≤ K * s ^ 2 → 0 ≤ mQ → mQ ≤ Λ → 0 ≤ mE → mE ≤ K * s →
      0 ≤ nA → nA ≤ ual * nQ + β * nE → 0 ≤ nB → nB ≤ β * (nQ + nE) →
      N ≤ ua * mQ + nA * nQ + (b * mE + nB * nE) →
      N * s ≤ A * Λ + G * Λ ^ 2 + 2 * Bt * K * Λ + B * K + Bt * K ^ 2 := by
    intro s ua b ual β nQ nE mQ mE nA nB N hs hs1 hua hb hual hβ hua0 hb0 hual0 hβ0
      hnQ0 hnQ hnE0 hnE hmQ0 hmQ hmE0 hmE hnA0 hnA hnB0 hnB hN
    have q0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN hs.le
    have q1 : ua * mQ * s ≤ ua * Λ * s :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmQ hua0) hs.le
    have q1' : s * ua * Λ ≤ A * Λ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hua hΛ
    have q2 : nA * (nQ * s) ≤ (ual * nQ + β * nE) * (nQ * s) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnA (by positivity)
    have q3 : nQ * nQ ≤ (Λ * s) * (Λ * s) := mul_self_le_mul_self hnQ0 hnQ
    have q3' : ual * s * (nQ * nQ) ≤ ual * s * ((Λ * s) * (Λ * s)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left q3 (by positivity)
    have q3'' : s ^ 3 * ual * Λ ^ 2 ≤ G * Λ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hual (sq_nonneg _)
    have q4 : nE * nQ ≤ (K * s ^ 2) * (Λ * s) := mul_le_mul hnE hnQ hnQ0 (by positivity)
    have q4' : β * s * (nE * nQ) ≤ β * s * ((K * s ^ 2) * (Λ * s)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left q4 (by positivity)
    have q4'' : s ^ 4 * β * (K * Λ) ≤ Bt * (K * Λ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hβ (by positivity)
    have q5 : b * s * mE ≤ b * s * (K * s) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmE (by positivity)
    have q5' : s ^ 2 * b * K ≤ B * K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb hK
    have q6 : nB * (nE * s) ≤ β * (nQ + nE) * (nE * s) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnB (by positivity)
    have q7 : (nQ + nE) * nE ≤ (Λ * s + K * s ^ 2) * (K * s ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul (add_le_add hnQ hnE) hnE hnE0 (by positivity)
    have q7' : β * s * ((nQ + nE) * nE) ≤ β * s * ((Λ * s + K * s ^ 2) * (K * s ^ 2)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left q7 (by positivity)
    have q9 : s ^ 4 * β * K ^ 2 * s ≤ s ^ 4 * β * K ^ 2 * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs1 (by positivity)
    have q9' : s ^ 4 * β * K ^ 2 ≤ Bt * K ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hβ (sq_nonneg _)
    linarith
  
  have hnorm : ∀ (ax bx : ℝ) (a' b' P R : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (P' R' : E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ),
      ‖ax • P' + a'.smulRight P + (bx • R' + b'.smulRight R)‖ ≤
        |ax| * ‖P'‖ + ‖a'‖ * ‖P‖ + (|bx| * ‖R'‖ + ‖b'‖ * ‖R‖) := by
    intro ax bx a' b' P R P' R'
    calc ‖ax • P' + a'.smulRight P + (bx • R' + b'.smulRight R)‖
        ≤ ‖ax • P' + a'.smulRight P‖ + ‖bx • R' + b'.smulRight R‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (‖ax • P'‖ + ‖a'.smulRight P‖) + (‖bx • R'‖ + ‖b'.smulRight R‖) :=
          add_le_add (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_add_le _ _)
            (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_add_le _ _)
      _ ≤ |ax| * ‖P'‖ + ‖a'‖ * ‖P‖ + (|bx| * ‖R'‖ + ‖b'‖ * ‖R‖) := by
          have k1 := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le ax P'
          have k2 := ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le bx R'
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at k1 k2
          rw [ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply]
          linarith
  have hCv : 0 ≤ (K / l + Λ / c₀) / 2 := by positivity
  have hC1 : 0 ≤ A * Λ + B * K := by positivity
  have hC2 : 0 ≤ A * Λ + G * Λ ^ 2 + 2 * Bt * K * Λ + B * K + Bt * K ^ 2 := by positivity
  refine ⟨(K / l + Λ / c₀) / 2 + (A * Λ + B * K) +
      (A * Λ + G * Λ ^ 2 + 2 * Bt * K * Λ + B * K + Bt * K ^ 2), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro x h1 h2
  obtain ⟨hdx, hqx1, hqx2, hnQ, hmQ, hdq, hnE, hmE⟩ := hyp x h1 h2
  have hs1 : dist x x₀ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨kv, ka, kb, kα, kβ⟩ := key (dist x x₀) (D x) (Q x) h1 hs1 hdx hqx1 hqx2 hdq
  have hDx : 0 < D x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hdx
  have hQx : 0 < Q x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hqx1
  have hxV : x ∈ ({y : E2 | 0 < D y} ∩ {y : E2 | 0 < Q y}) := ⟨hDx, hQx⟩
  have hFx := hFgrad x hxV
  have hbx : 0 < (2 * D x)⁻¹ := by positivity
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · rw [hFx.fderiv]
    have hN : ‖((2 * D x)⁻¹ - (2 * Q x)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ Q x +
        (2 * D x)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) x‖ ≤
        |(2 * D x)⁻¹ - (2 * Q x)⁻¹| * ‖fderiv ℝ Q x‖ +
          (2 * D x)⁻¹ * ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) x‖ := by
      refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hbx]
    have e1 : |(2 * D x)⁻¹ - (2 * Q x)⁻¹| * ‖fderiv ℝ Q x‖ ≤
        |(2 * D x)⁻¹ - (2 * Q x)⁻¹| * (Λ * dist x x₀) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnQ (abs_nonneg _)
    have e2 : dist x x₀ * |(2 * D x)⁻¹ - (2 * Q x)⁻¹| * Λ ≤ A * Λ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ka hΛ
    have e3 : (2 * D x)⁻¹ * ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) x‖ ≤
        (2 * D x)⁻¹ * (K * dist x x₀ ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnE hbx.le
    have e4 : dist x x₀ ^ 2 * (2 * D x)⁻¹ * K ≤ B * K := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right kb hK
    linarith
  · have hev : fderiv ℝ (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.log (D y) - Real.log (Real.sqrt (Q y)))
        =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => ((2 * D y)⁻¹ - (2 * Q y)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ Q y +
          (2 * D y)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) y) := by
      filter_upwards [hVo.mem_nhds hxV] with y hy
      exact (hFgrad y hy).fderiv
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hb : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (2 * D y)⁻¹)
        ((-((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x)) x :=
      (hasDerivAt_inv (by positivity : 2 * D x ≠ 0)).comp_hasFDerivAt x
        ((hDd x).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (2 : ℝ))
    have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (2 * Q y)⁻¹)
        ((-((2 * Q x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ Q x)) x :=
      (hasDerivAt_inv (by positivity : 2 * Q x ≠ 0)).comp_hasFDerivAt x
        ((hQd x).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (2 : ℝ))
    have ha := hb.sub hc
    have hT1 := ha.smul (hP1 x).hasFDerivAt
    have hT2 := hb.smul (hR1 x).hasFDerivAt
    have hΓ : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ((2 * D y)⁻¹ - (2 * Q y)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ Q y +
          (2 * D y)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) y)
        (((2 * D x)⁻¹ - (2 * Q x)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Q) x +
          ((-((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x) -
            (-((2 * Q x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ Q x)).smulRight (fderiv ℝ Q x) +
          ((2 * D x)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z)) x +
            ((-((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x)).smulRight
              (fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) x))) x :=
      hT1.add hT2
    rw [hΓ.fderiv, le_div_iff₀ h1]
    have hβ0 : 0 < 2 * ((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
    have ha'eq : (-((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x) -
        (-((2 * Q x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ Q x) =
        (2 * ((2 * Q x) ^ 2)⁻¹ - 2 * ((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ Q x -
          (2 * ((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) x := by
      rw [hDD x]; module
    have hb'eq : (-((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x) =
        -((2 * ((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • (fderiv ℝ Q x + fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) x)) := by
      rw [hDD x]; module
    have hA' : ‖(-((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x) -
        (-((2 * Q x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ Q x)‖ ≤
        |2 * ((2 * Q x) ^ 2)⁻¹ - 2 * ((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹| * ‖fderiv ℝ Q x‖ +
          (2 * ((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) * ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) x‖ := by
      rw [ha'eq]
      refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hβ0]
    have hB' : ‖(-((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x)‖ ≤
        (2 * ((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) * (‖fderiv ℝ Q x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) x‖) := by
      rw [hb'eq, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hβ0]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_add_le _ _) hβ0.le
    have hN := hnorm ((2 * D x)⁻¹ - (2 * Q x)⁻¹) (2 * D x)⁻¹
      ((-((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x) -
        (-((2 * Q x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ Q x))
      ((-((2 * D x) ^ 2)⁻¹) • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x))
      (fderiv ℝ Q x) (fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z) x)
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Q) x) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z)) x)
    rw [abs_of_pos hbx] at hN
    have hfin' := hfin (dist x x₀) _ _ _ _ _ _ ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Q) x‖
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun z => D z - Q z)) x‖ _ _ _ h1 hs1 ka kb kα kβ (abs_nonneg _) hbx.le
      (abs_nonneg _) hβ0.le (norm_nonneg _) hnQ (norm_nonneg _) hnE
      (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg _) hmQ
      (ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_nonneg _) hmE (norm_nonneg _) hA' (norm_nonneg _) hB' hN
    linarith

(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hinf : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ∀ c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 c f) W := by
    intro f hf c
    have hfd : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y) W :=
      ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hW).1 hf).2
    exact hfd.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have hdet : ∀ y ∈ W, (h y).det ≠ 0 := fun y hy => (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne'
  have hdetS : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).det) W := by
    have heq : (fun y => (h y).det) = fun y => h y 0 0 * h y 1 1 - h y 0 1 * h y 1 0 := by
      funext y
      exact Matrix.det_fin_two (h y)
    rw [heq]
    exact ((hh 0 0).mul (hh 1 1)).sub ((hh 0 1).mul (hh 1 0))
  have hadj : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y).adjugate i j) W := by
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two] <;>
      first | exact hh _ _ | exact (hh _ _).neg
  have hinv : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) W := by
    intro i j
    have heq : (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) = fun y => ((h y).det)⁻¹ * (h y).adjugate i j := by
      funext y
      rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [heq]
    exact (hdetS.inv hdet).mul (hadj i j)
  have hchr : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) W := by
    intro k i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
      (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x)) W
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hinv k l).mul
      (((hinf _ (hh j l) i).add (hinf _ (hh i l) j)).sub (hinf _ (hh i j) l)))
  have hgam : ∀ k : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c y) W :=
    fun k => ContDiffOn.sum fun a _ => ContDiffOn.sum fun c _ => (hinv a c).mul (hchr k a c)
  
  have hC1 : ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f W → ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ σ,
        |f y - f x₀| ≤ B * dist y x₀ ∧ |f y| ≤ B ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ B := by
    intro f hf
    have hK := isCompact_closedBall x₀ σ
    have hfc : ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall x₀ σ) := hf.continuousOn.mono hball
    have hdc : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ f) (Metric.closedBall x₀ σ) :=
      (hf.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).mono hball
    obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hfc
    obtain ⟨C₁, hC₁⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hdc
    have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ σ, DifferentiableAt ℝ f z := fun z hz =>
      (hf.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds (hball hz))).differentiableAt (by simp)
    refine ⟨|C₀| + |C₁|, by positivity, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    have hx₀ : x₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ σ :=
      Metric.mem_closedBall_self (dist_nonneg.trans (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hy))
    have hd' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ σ, ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ ≤ |C₀| + |C₁| := fun z hz =>
      (hC₁ z hz).trans ((le_abs_self C₁).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _)))
    have hmv := (convex_closedBall x₀ σ).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff hd' hx₀ hy
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hd' y hy⟩
    · rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, dist_eq_norm]
      exact hmv
    · rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact (hC₀ y hy).trans ((le_abs_self C₀).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg _)))
  refine ⟨hinv, hgam, ?_⟩
  choose BG hBG0 hBG using fun i j => hC1 _ (hinv i j)
  choose Bγ hBγ0 hBγ using fun k => hC1 _ (hgam k)
  have h00 := hBG0 0 0
  have h01 := hBG0 0 1
  have h10 := hBG0 1 0
  have h11 := hBG0 1 1
  have hg0 := hBγ0 0
  have hg1 := hBγ0 1
  have hBGle : ∀ i j : Fin 2, BG i j ≤ BG 0 0 + BG 0 1 + BG 1 0 + BG 1 1 + Bγ 0 + Bγ 1 := by
    simp only [Fin.forall_fin_two]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
  have hγle : ∀ k : Fin 2, Bγ k ≤ BG 0 0 + BG 0 1 + BG 1 0 + BG 1 1 + Bγ 0 + Bγ 1 := by
    simp only [Fin.forall_fin_two]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
  refine ⟨BG 0 0 + BG 0 1 + BG 1 0 + BG 1 1 + Bγ 0 + Bγ 1, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro y hy i j k
  obtain ⟨g1, -, g3⟩ := hBG i j y hy
  obtain ⟨-, c2, c3⟩ := hBγ k y hy
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact g1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hBGle i j) dist_nonneg)
  · exact g3.trans (hBGle i j)
  · exact c2.trans (hγle k)
  · exact c3.trans (hγle k)

informal_problem.statement:
(h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ x : E2) (V : Set E2)
    (hV : IsOpen V) (hxV : x ∈ V) (ψ : E2 → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ψ V) (B a₁ a₂ a₃ : ℝ)
    (hGd : ∀ i j : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) x)
    (hγd : ∀ k : Fin 2, DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c z) x)
    (hB : ∀ i j k : Fin 2,
      |(h x)⁻¹ i j - (h x₀)⁻¹ i j| ≤ B * dist x x₀ ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) x‖ ≤ B ∧
      |∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c x| ≤ B ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c z) x‖ ≤ B)
    (h1 : ‖fderiv ℝ ψ x‖ ≤ a₁) (h2 : ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x‖ ≤ a₂)
    (h3 : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 ψ x‖ ≤ a₃) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => lap2 h ψ y -
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x₀)⁻¹ i j * pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) y) x ∧
    |lap2 h ψ x - ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x₀)⁻¹ i j * pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) x| ≤
      4 * B * dist x x₀ * a₂ + 2 * B * a₁ ∧
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => lap2 h ψ y -
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x₀)⁻¹ i j * pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) y) x‖ ≤
      4 * B * (a₂ + dist x x₀ * a₃) + 2 * B * (a₁ + a₂)

(h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (x₀ x : E2) (V : Set E2)
