proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hid : (fun y => lap2 h ψ y -
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x₀)⁻¹ i j * pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) y) =
      fun y => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ((h y)⁻¹ i j - (h x₀)⁻¹ i j) * pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) y -
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c y) *
          pd2 k ψ y := by
    funext y
    simp only [lap2, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  have hidx : lap2 h ψ x - ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x₀)⁻¹ i j * pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) x =
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, ((h x)⁻¹ i j - (h x₀)⁻¹ i j) * pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) x -
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c x) *
          pd2 k ψ x := congrFun hid x
  
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hB 0 0 0).2.1
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ dist x x₀ := dist_nonneg
  have he : ∀ k : Fin 2, ‖e2 k‖ = 1 := fun k => by simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
  
  have hψ1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ ψ) V := hψ.fderiv_of_isOpen hV le_rfl
  have d1 : ∀ y ∈ V, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) y := fun y hy =>
    (hψ1.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have d2 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ψ) x :=
    (hψ.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hxV)).differentiableAt_iteratedFDeriv
      (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (ENat.coe_lt_top 2))
  have hQf : ∀ k : Fin 2, ∀ y ∈ V,
      HasFDerivAt (pd2 k ψ) ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) y).flip (e2 k)) y := by
    intro k y hy
    have h0 := (d1 y hy).hasFDerivAt.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const (e2 k) y)
    convert h0 using 1
    ext v
    simp
  have hp_eq : ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ψ y ![e2 i, e2 j] := by
    intro i j
    filter_upwards [hV.mem_nhds hxV] with y hy
    show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j ψ) y (e2 i) = _
    rw [(hQf j y hy).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
    simp
  have hPf : ∀ i j : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (pd2 i (pd2 j ψ))
      (fderiv ℝ (fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ψ y ![e2 i, e2 j]) x) x :=
    fun i j => ((d2.continuousMultilinear_apply_const ![e2 i, e2 j]).hasFDerivAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq
      (hp_eq i j)
  have h3' : ‖fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ψ) x‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 3 ψ x‖ :=
    norm_fderiv_iteratedFDeriv
  have hPn : ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ψ y ![e2 i, e2 j]) x‖ ≤ a₃ := by
    intro i j
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ ((norm_nonneg _).trans h3) (fun v => ?_)
    rw [fderiv_continuousMultilinear_apply_const_apply d2]
    calc ‖fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ψ) x v ![e2 i, e2 j]‖
        ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ψ) x v‖ * ∏ k : Fin 2, ‖(![e2 i, e2 j] : Fin 2 → E2) k‖ :=
          ContinuousMultilinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ψ) x v‖ := by
          simp [Fin.prod_univ_two, he]
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ψ) x‖ * ‖v‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ ≤ a₃ * ‖v‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h3'.le.trans h3) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hPv : ∀ i j : Fin 2, |pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) x| ≤ a₂ := by
    intro i j
    have hx : pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) x = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (e2 i) (e2 j) := by
      show fderiv ℝ (pd2 j ψ) x (e2 i) = _
      rw [(hQf j x hxV).fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
    rw [hx]
    calc |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (e2 i) (e2 j)|
        = ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (e2 i) (e2 j)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x‖ * ‖e2 i‖ * ‖e2 j‖ :=
          ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm₂ _ _ _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x‖ := by rw [he, he, mul_one, mul_one]
      _ ≤ a₂ := h2
  have hQv : ∀ k : Fin 2, |pd2 k ψ x| ≤ a₁ := by
    intro k
    calc |pd2 k ψ x| = ‖fderiv ℝ ψ x (e2 k)‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ ψ x‖ * ‖e2 k‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
      _ = ‖fderiv ℝ ψ x‖ := by rw [he, mul_one]
      _ ≤ a₁ := h1
  have hQn : ∀ k : Fin 2, ‖(fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x).flip (e2 k)‖ ≤ a₂ := by
    intro k
    have e1 := (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x).flip.le_opNorm (e2 k)
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_flip, he, mul_one] at e1
    linarith
  
  have hGf : ∀ i j : Fin 2, HasFDerivAt (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j - (h x₀)⁻¹ i j)
      (fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) x) x :=
    fun i j => (hGd i j).hasFDerivAt.sub_const _
  have hT : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
        ((h y)⁻¹ i j - (h x₀)⁻¹ i j) * pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) y -
        ∑ k : Fin 2, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c y) *
          pd2 k ψ y)
      (∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
        (((h x)⁻¹ i j - (h x₀)⁻¹ i j) •
            (fderiv ℝ (fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ψ y ![e2 i, e2 j]) x) +
          pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) x • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) x) -
        ∑ k : Fin 2, ((∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c x) •
            (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x).flip (e2 k) +
          pd2 k ψ x • fderiv ℝ
            (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c z) x)) x := by
    have hsum : ∀ (F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ) (F' : Fin 2 → E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ),
        (∀ k, HasFDerivAt (F k) (F' k) x) →
        HasFDerivAt (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 2, F k y) (∑ k : Fin 2, F' k) x := by
      intro F F' hF
      have h0 := HasFDerivAt.sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun k _ => hF k)
      convert h0 using 1
    apply HasFDerivAt.sub
    · refine hsum _ _ (fun i => ?_)
      refine hsum _ _ (fun j => ?_)
      exact (hGf i j).mul (hPf i j)
    · refine hsum _ _ (fun k => ?_)
      exact (hγd k).hasFDerivAt.mul (hQf k x hxV)
  
  have key : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (u w : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (A1 A2 A3 A4 : ℝ), |a| ≤ A1 → ‖u‖ ≤ A2 →
      |b| ≤ A3 → ‖w‖ ≤ A4 → ‖a • u + b • w‖ ≤ A1 * A2 + A3 * A4 := by
    intro a b u w A1 A2 A3 A4 ha hu hb hw
    calc ‖a • u + b • w‖ ≤ ‖a • u‖ + ‖b • w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = |a| * ‖u‖ + |b| * ‖w‖ := by rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ A1 * A2 + A3 * A4 :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul ha hu (norm_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans ha))
            (mul_le_mul hb hw (norm_nonneg _) ((abs_nonneg _).trans hb))
  have sum4 : ∀ (F : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ i j, |F i j| ≤ C) →
      |∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, F i j| ≤ 4 * C := by
    intro F C hF
    calc |∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, F i j| ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, |∑ j : Fin 2, F i j| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, C := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
          (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hF i j)
      _ = 4 * C := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
  have sum2 : ∀ (F : Fin 2 → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ k, |F k| ≤ C) →
      |∑ k : Fin 2, F k| ≤ 2 * C := by
    intro F C hF
    calc |∑ k : Fin 2, F k| ≤ ∑ k : Fin 2, |F k| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin 2, C := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hF k
      _ = 2 * C := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
  have nsum4 : ∀ (F : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (C : ℝ), (∀ i j, ‖F i j‖ ≤ C) →
      ‖∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, F i j‖ ≤ 4 * C := by
    intro F C hF
    calc ‖∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, F i j‖ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ‖∑ j : Fin 2, F i j‖ :=
          norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, C := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ =>
          (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hF i j)
      _ = 4 * C := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
  have nsum2 : ∀ (F : Fin 2 → (E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (C : ℝ), (∀ k, ‖F k‖ ≤ C) →
      ‖∑ k : Fin 2, F k‖ ≤ 2 * C := by
    intro F C hF
    calc ‖∑ k : Fin 2, F k‖ ≤ ∑ k : Fin 2, ‖F k‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ k : Fin 2, C := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hF k
      _ = 2 * C := by simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
  
  have hgp : ∀ i j : Fin 2, |((h x)⁻¹ i j - (h x₀)⁻¹ i j) * pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) x| ≤
      B * dist x x₀ * a₂ := by
    intro i j
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hB i j 0).1 (hPv i j) (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hB0 hs0)
  have hcq : ∀ k : Fin 2,
      |(∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c x) * pd2 k ψ x| ≤
        B * a₁ := by
    intro k
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hB 0 0 k).2.2.1 (hQv k) (abs_nonneg _) hB0
  have hX : ∀ i j : Fin 2,
      ‖((h x)⁻¹ i j - (h x₀)⁻¹ i j) •
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ψ y ![e2 i, e2 j]) x) +
        pd2 i (pd2 j ψ) x • fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) x‖ ≤
      B * dist x x₀ * a₃ + a₂ * B :=
    fun i j => key _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (hB i j 0).1 (hPn i j) (hPv i j) (hB i j 0).2.1
  have hY : ∀ k : Fin 2,
      ‖(∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c x) •
            (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x).flip (e2 k) +
          pd2 k ψ x • fderiv ℝ
            (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c z) x‖ ≤
      B * a₂ + a₁ * B :=
    fun k => key _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (hB 0 0 k).2.2.1 (hQn k) (hQv k) (hB 0 0 k).2.2.2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hid]
    exact hT.differentiableAt
  · rw [hidx]
    refine (abs_sub _ _).trans ?_
    have t1 := sum4 _ _ hgp
    have t2 := sum2 _ _ hcq
    linarith
  · rw [hid, hT.fderiv]
    refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
    have t1 := nsum4 _ _ hX
    have t2 := nsum2 _ _ hY
    linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(x₀ : E2) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hσ1 : σ ≤ 1)
    (D Q m f ε : E2 → ℝ) (c₀ l Λ K : ℝ) (hc₀ : 0 < c₀) (hl : 0 < l) (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) (hK : 0 ≤ K)
    (hyp : ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < σ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ D x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ Q x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ m x ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f x ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ ε x ∧
      c₀ * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ≤ D x ∧ l * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ≤ Q x ∧ Q x ≤ Λ * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ Q x‖ ≤ Λ * dist x x₀ ∧ |m x| ≤ Λ * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ m x‖ ≤ Λ * dist x x₀ ∧
      |D x - Q x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 3 ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - Q y) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ∧
      |ε x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 5 ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ ε x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 4 ∧
      |f x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 3 ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 2) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x : E2, 0 < dist x x₀ → dist x x₀ < σ →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => f y / (2 * D y) - m y * (D y - Q y) / (2 * D y * Q y) -
        ε y / (2 * D y ^ 2)) x ∧
      |f x / (2 * D x) - m x * (D x - Q x) / (2 * D x * Q x) - ε x / (2 * D x ^ 2)| ≤
        C * dist x x₀ ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => f y / (2 * D y) - m y * (D y - Q y) / (2 * D y * Q y) -
        ε y / (2 * D y ^ 2)) x‖ ≤ C

proof.tactics:
by
  have hquot : ∀ (u v : E2 → ℝ) (u' v' : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : E2) (s t a b c : ℝ),
      0 < s → 0 < t → 0 < b → HasFDerivAt u u' x → HasFDerivAt v v' x →
      |u x| ≤ a * s * t → ‖u'‖ ≤ a * t → b * t ≤ |v x| → s * ‖v'‖ ≤ c * t →
      ∃ w : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ, HasFDerivAt (fun y => u y / v y) w x ∧
        |u x / v x| ≤ a / b * s ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ a / b + a * c / b ^ 2 := by
    intro u v u' v' x s t a b c hs ht hb hu hv hu0 hu1 hv0 hv1
    have ha : 0 ≤ a := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h ht
      linarith [norm_nonneg u']
    have hc : 0 ≤ c := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      have := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h ht
      have := mul_nonneg hs.le (norm_nonneg v')
      linarith
    have hbt : 0 < b * t := mul_pos hb ht
    have hvpos : 0 < |v x| := lt_of_lt_of_le hbt hv0
    have hvx : v x ≠ 0 := abs_pos.mp hvpos
    have hinv : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (v y)⁻¹) (-(v x ^ 2)⁻¹ • v') x :=
      (hasDerivAt_inv hvx).comp_hasFDerivAt x hv
    have hmul := hu.mul hinv
    refine ⟨u x • (-(v x ^ 2)⁻¹ • v') + (v x)⁻¹ • u', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e : (fun y => u y / v y) = fun y => u y * (v y)⁻¹ := by
        funext y; rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      rw [e]; exact hmul
    · rw [abs_div, div_le_iff₀ hvpos]
      have e : a / b * s * (b * t) = a * s * t := by field_simp
      calc |u x| ≤ a * s * t := hu0
        _ = a / b * s * (b * t) := e.symm
        _ ≤ a / b * s * |v x| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv0 (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg ha hb.le) hs.le)
    · have e1 : ‖u x • (-(v x ^ 2)⁻¹ • v')‖ = |u x| * ‖v'‖ / |v x| ^ 2 := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, norm_neg, norm_inv, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          Real.norm_eq_abs]
        ring
      have e2 : ‖(v x)⁻¹ • u'‖ = ‖u'‖ / |v x| := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        ring
      have b1 : |u x| * ‖v'‖ / |v x| ^ 2 ≤ a * c / b ^ 2 := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos hvpos 2)]
        have hsq : (b * t) ^ 2 ≤ |v x| ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hbt.le hv0 2
        have eq : a * t * (c * t) = a * c / b ^ 2 * (b * t) ^ 2 := by field_simp
        calc |u x| * ‖v'‖ ≤ a * s * t * ‖v'‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hu0 (norm_nonneg _)
          _ = a * t * (s * ‖v'‖) := by ring
          _ ≤ a * t * (c * t) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv1 (mul_nonneg ha ht.le)
          _ = a * c / b ^ 2 * (b * t) ^ 2 := eq
          _ ≤ a * c / b ^ 2 * |v x| ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hc) (sq_nonneg b))
      have b2 : ‖u'‖ / |v x| ≤ a / b := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hvpos]
        have eq : a * t = a / b * (b * t) := by field_simp
        calc ‖u'‖ ≤ a * t := hu1
          _ = a / b * (b * t) := eq
          _ ≤ a / b * |v x| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv0 (div_nonneg ha hb.le)
      calc ‖u x • (-(v x ^ 2)⁻¹ • v') + (v x)⁻¹ • u'‖
          ≤ ‖u x • (-(v x ^ 2)⁻¹ • v')‖ + ‖(v x)⁻¹ • u'‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ a * c / b ^ 2 + a / b := by rw [e1, e2]; exact add_le_add b1 b2
        _ = a / b + a * c / b ^ 2 := by ring
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ Λ + K := add_nonneg hΛ hK
  have hn2 : ∀ w : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ, ‖(2 : ℝ) • w‖ = 2 * ‖w‖ := by
    intro w; rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_two]
  refine ⟨(K / (2 * c₀) + K * (2 * (Λ + K)) / (2 * c₀) ^ 2) +
      (2 * Λ * K / (2 * c₀ * l) + 2 * Λ * K * (4 * Λ * (Λ + K)) / (2 * c₀ * l) ^ 2) +
      (K / (2 * c₀ ^ 2) + K * (4 * (Λ + K) ^ 2) / (2 * c₀ ^ 2) ^ 2), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hc1 : 0 < 2 * c₀ := by positivity
    have hc2 : 0 < 2 * c₀ * l := by positivity
    have hc3 : 0 < 2 * c₀ ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hΛK : 0 ≤ 2 * Λ * K := by positivity
    refine add_nonneg (add_nonneg (add_nonneg ?_ ?_) (add_nonneg ?_ ?_)) (add_nonneg ?_ ?_)
    · exact div_nonneg hK hc1.le
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK (by positivity)) (sq_nonneg _)
    · exact div_nonneg hΛK hc2.le
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hΛK (by positivity)) (sq_nonneg _)
    · exact div_nonneg hK hc3.le
    · exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK (by positivity)) (sq_nonneg _)
  intro x hx0 hxσ
  obtain ⟨hD, hQ, hm, hf, hε, hDlo, hQlo, hQhi, hDQ, hmv, hDm, hE, hDE, hεv, hDε, hfv, hDf⟩ :=
    hyp x hx0 hxσ
  set s := dist x x₀ with hs
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by linarith
  have hs2 : 0 < s ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hDpos : 0 < D x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hDlo
  have hQpos : 0 < Q x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hQlo
  have hss2 : s ^ 2 ≤ s := by nlinarith
  have hss3 : s ^ 3 ≤ s ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hDhi : D x ≤ (Λ + K) * s ^ 2 := by
    have := (abs_le.mp hE).2
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hss3 hK]
  have hdsub : fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - Q y) x = fderiv ℝ D x - fderiv ℝ Q x :=
    fderiv_fun_sub hD hQ
  have hDD : ‖fderiv ℝ D x‖ ≤ (Λ + K) * s := by
    have e : fderiv ℝ D x = fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - Q y) x + fderiv ℝ Q x := by
      rw [hdsub]; abel
    rw [e]
    calc _ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - Q y) x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ Q x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ K * s ^ 2 + Λ * s := add_le_add hDE hDQ
      _ ≤ (Λ + K) * s := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hss2 hK]
  have hDDn : 0 ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ D x‖ := norm_nonneg _
  
  have hv1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => 2 * D y) ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x) x :=
    hD.hasFDerivAt.const_mul 2
  obtain ⟨w1, h1, hT1v, hT1n⟩ := hquot f (fun y => 2 * D y) (fderiv ℝ f x)
    ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x) x s (s ^ 2) K (2 * c₀) (2 * (Λ + K)) hx0 hs2 (by positivity)
    hf.hasFDerivAt hv1
    (by rw [show K * s * s ^ 2 = K * s ^ 3 by ring]; exact hfv) hDf
    (by
      show 2 * c₀ * s ^ 2 ≤ |2 * D x|
      rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]; linarith)
    (by rw [hn2]; nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDD hx0.le])
  
  have hEd : HasFDerivAt (fun y => D y - Q y) (fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - Q y) x) x :=
    (hD.sub hQ).hasFDerivAt
  have hu2 := hm.hasFDerivAt.mul hEd
  have hv2 := hv1.mul hQ.hasFDerivAt
  have hmv0 : 0 ≤ Λ * s ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hΛ hs2.le
  have hEv0 : 0 ≤ K * s ^ 3 := mul_nonneg hK (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨w2, h2, hT2v, hT2n⟩ := hquot (fun y => m y * (D y - Q y)) (fun y => 2 * D y * Q y)
    (m x • fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - Q y) x + (D x - Q x) • fderiv ℝ m x)
    ((2 * D x) • fderiv ℝ Q x + Q x • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x)) x s (s ^ 4)
    (2 * Λ * K) (2 * c₀ * l) (4 * Λ * (Λ + K)) hx0 (by positivity) (by positivity) hu2 hv2
    (by
      show |m x * (D x - Q x)| ≤ 2 * Λ * K * s * s ^ 4
      rw [abs_mul]
      have := mul_le_mul hmv hE (abs_nonneg _) hmv0
      have h5 : 0 ≤ Λ * K * s ^ 5 := by positivity
      nlinarith)
    (by
      calc _ ≤ ‖m x • fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - Q y) x‖ + ‖(D x - Q x) • fderiv ℝ m x‖ :=
            norm_add_le _ _
        _ = |m x| * ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => D y - Q y) x‖ + |D x - Q x| * ‖fderiv ℝ m x‖ := by
            rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ Λ * s ^ 2 * (K * s ^ 2) + K * s ^ 3 * (Λ * s) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul hmv hDE (norm_nonneg _) hmv0)
              (mul_le_mul hE hDm (norm_nonneg _) hEv0)
        _ = 2 * Λ * K * s ^ 4 := by ring)
    (by
      show 2 * c₀ * l * s ^ 4 ≤ |2 * D x * Q x|
      rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      have := mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDlo (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)) hQlo
        (by positivity) (by positivity)
      nlinarith)
    (by
      have hb : ‖(2 * D x) • fderiv ℝ Q x + Q x • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x)‖ ≤
          2 * D x * ‖fderiv ℝ Q x‖ + Q x * (2 * ‖fderiv ℝ D x‖) := by
        calc _ ≤ ‖(2 * D x) • fderiv ℝ Q x‖ + ‖Q x • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x)‖ :=
              norm_add_le _ _
          _ = 2 * D x * ‖fderiv ℝ Q x‖ + Q x * (2 * ‖fderiv ℝ D x‖) := by
              rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, hn2, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
                abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * D x), abs_of_pos hQpos]
      have k1 : 2 * D x * ‖fderiv ℝ Q x‖ ≤ 2 * ((Λ + K) * s ^ 2) * (Λ * s) :=
        mul_le_mul (by linarith) hDQ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      have k2 : Q x * (2 * ‖fderiv ℝ D x‖) ≤ Λ * s ^ 2 * (2 * ((Λ + K) * s)) :=
        mul_le_mul hQhi (by linarith) (by positivity) hmv0
      have e : s * (2 * ((Λ + K) * s ^ 2) * (Λ * s) + Λ * s ^ 2 * (2 * ((Λ + K) * s))) =
          4 * Λ * (Λ + K) * s ^ 4 := by ring
      calc s * ‖(2 * D x) • fderiv ℝ Q x + Q x • ((2 : ℝ) • fderiv ℝ D x)‖
          ≤ s * (2 * ((Λ + K) * s ^ 2) * (Λ * s) + Λ * s ^ 2 * (2 * ((Λ + K) * s))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb.trans (add_le_add k1 k2)) hx0.le
        _ = 4 * Λ * (Λ + K) * s ^ 4 := e)
  
  have hv3 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => 2 * D y ^ 2)
      ((2 : ℝ) • (D x • fderiv ℝ D x + D x • fderiv ℝ D x)) x := by
    have h := (hD.hasFDerivAt.mul hD.hasFDerivAt).const_mul (2 : ℝ)
    have e : (fun y => 2 * D y ^ 2) = fun y => 2 * (D y * D y) := by funext y; ring
    rw [e]; exact h
  obtain ⟨w3, h3, hT3v, hT3n⟩ := hquot ε (fun y => 2 * D y ^ 2) (fderiv ℝ ε x)
    ((2 : ℝ) • (D x • fderiv ℝ D x + D x • fderiv ℝ D x)) x s (s ^ 4) K (2 * c₀ ^ 2)
    (4 * (Λ + K) ^ 2) hx0 (by positivity) (by positivity) hε.hasFDerivAt hv3
    (by rw [show K * s * s ^ 4 = K * s ^ 5 by ring]; exact hεv) hDε
    (by
      show 2 * c₀ ^ 2 * s ^ 4 ≤ |2 * D x ^ 2|
      rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
      have := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hDlo 2
      nlinarith)
    (by
      have hb : ‖(2 : ℝ) • (D x • fderiv ℝ D x + D x • fderiv ℝ D x)‖ =
          4 * (D x * ‖fderiv ℝ D x‖) := by
        rw [hn2, ← two_smul ℝ (D x • fderiv ℝ D x), hn2, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
          abs_of_pos hDpos]
        ring
      rw [hb]
      have k : D x * ‖fderiv ℝ D x‖ ≤ (Λ + K) * s ^ 2 * ((Λ + K) * s) :=
        mul_le_mul hDhi hDD hDDn (by positivity)
      have e : s * (4 * ((Λ + K) * s ^ 2 * ((Λ + K) * s))) = 4 * (Λ + K) ^ 2 * s ^ 4 := by
        ring
      calc s * (4 * (D x * ‖fderiv ℝ D x‖))
          ≤ s * (4 * ((Λ + K) * s ^ 2 * ((Λ + K) * s))) := by gcongr
        _ = _ := e)
  
  have h1' : HasFDerivAt (fun y => f y / (2 * D y)) w1 x := h1
  have h2' : HasFDerivAt (fun y => m y * (D y - Q y) / (2 * D y * Q y)) w2 x := h2
  have h3' : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ε y / (2 * D y ^ 2)) w3 x := h3
  have hR : HasFDerivAt (fun y => f y / (2 * D y) - m y * (D y - Q y) / (2 * D y * Q y) -
      ε y / (2 * D y ^ 2)) (w1 - w2 - w3) x := (h1'.sub h2').sub h3'
  have hT1v' : |f x / (2 * D x)| ≤ K / (2 * c₀) * s := hT1v
  have hT2v' : |m x * (D x - Q x) / (2 * D x * Q x)| ≤ 2 * Λ * K / (2 * c₀ * l) * s := hT2v
  have hT3v' : |ε x / (2 * D x ^ 2)| ≤ K / (2 * c₀ ^ 2) * s := hT3v
  have hc1 : 0 < 2 * c₀ := by positivity
  have hc2 : 0 < 2 * c₀ * l := by positivity
  have hc3 : 0 < 2 * c₀ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hΛK : 0 ≤ 2 * Λ * K := by positivity
  have x1 : 0 ≤ K * (2 * (Λ + K)) / (2 * c₀) ^ 2 :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK (by positivity)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have x2 : 0 ≤ 2 * Λ * K * (4 * Λ * (Λ + K)) / (2 * c₀ * l) ^ 2 :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hΛK (by positivity)) (sq_nonneg _)
  have x3 : 0 ≤ K * (4 * (Λ + K) ^ 2) / (2 * c₀ ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK (by positivity)) (sq_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨hR.differentiableAt, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have habs1 := abs_sub (f x / (2 * D x) - m x * (D x - Q x) / (2 * D x * Q x))
        (ε x / (2 * D x ^ 2))
    have habs2 := abs_sub (f x / (2 * D x)) (m x * (D x - Q x) / (2 * D x * Q x))
    have hextra : 0 ≤ (K * (2 * (Λ + K)) / (2 * c₀) ^ 2 +
        2 * Λ * K * (4 * Λ * (Λ + K)) / (2 * c₀ * l) ^ 2 +
        K * (4 * (Λ + K) ^ 2) / (2 * c₀ ^ 2) ^ 2) * s :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) hx0.le
    nlinarith
  · rw [hR.fderiv]
    calc ‖w1 - w2 - w3‖ ≤ ‖w1 - w2‖ + ‖w3‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖w1‖ + ‖w2‖ + ‖w3‖ := by linarith [norm_sub_le w1 w2]
      _ ≤ _ := by linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (β : E2 → ℝ) (hβ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ β W)
    (x₀ : E2) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ W) (hβ0 : β x₀ = 0) (hdβ : fderiv ℝ β x₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (N : Set E2) (Φ Ψ : E2 → E2), 0 < ρ ∧ IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ W ∧ Φ x₀ = 0 ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ N ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ N, Φ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∧ Ψ (Φ x) = x) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, Ψ z ∈ N ∧ Φ (Ψ z) = z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, β (Ψ z) = z 0) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det ≠ 0)

signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (β : E2 → ℝ) (hβ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ β W)

    ∃ (ρ : ℝ) (N : Set E2) (Φ Ψ : E2 → E2), 0 < ρ ∧ IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ W ∧ Φ x₀ = 0 ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ N ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ N, Φ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∧ Ψ (Φ x) = x) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, Ψ z ∈ N ∧ Φ (Ψ z) = z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, β (Ψ z) = z 0) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det ≠ 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦs, hΦx₀, hΦc, hdet0⟩ : ∃ Φ : E2 → E2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ W ∧ Φ x₀ = 0 ∧
      (∀ x, Φ x 0 = β x) ∧ (fderiv ℝ Φ x₀).det ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ : ∃ D, fderiv ℝ β x₀ = D := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [hD] at hdβ
    have hβd : HasFDerivAt β D x₀ := by
      rw [← hD]
      exact ((hβ.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx₀)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    obtain ⟨d0, hd0⟩ : ∃ d0, D (e2 0) = d0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨d1, hd1⟩ : ∃ d1, D (e2 1) = d1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hdec : ∀ y : E2, y = y 0 • e2 0 + y 1 • e2 1 := by
      intro y
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp
    have hDy : ∀ y : E2, D y = y 0 * d0 + y 1 * d1 := by
      intro y
      calc D y = D (y 0 • e2 0 + y 1 • e2 1) := by rw [← hdec y]
        _ = y 0 * d0 + y 1 * d1 := by
          rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, hd0, hd1, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    have hcoord : ∀ c d : ℝ, (c • e2 0 + d • e2 1 : E2) 0 = c ∧
        (c • e2 0 + d • e2 1 : E2) 1 = d := by
      intro c d
      constructor <;> simp
    let ℓ : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
      (-d1) • EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) + d0 • EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2)
    have hℓ : ∀ y : E2, ℓ y = -d1 * y 0 + d0 * y 1 := fun y => by simp [ℓ]
    let A : E2 →L[ℝ] E2 := D.smulRight (e2 0) + ℓ.smulRight (e2 1)
    have hAy : ∀ y, A y = D y • e2 0 + ℓ y • e2 1 := fun y => rfl
    have hA : HasFDerivAt (fun x => β x • e2 0 + (ℓ x - ℓ x₀) • e2 1) A x₀ :=
      (hβd.smul_const (e2 0)).add ((ℓ.hasFDerivAt.sub_const (ℓ x₀)).smul_const (e2 1))
    have hsq : d0 ^ 2 + d1 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have h0' : d0 ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg d0, sq_nonneg d1]
      have h1' : d1 ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg d0, sq_nonneg d1]
      have h0 : d0 = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).mp h0'
      have h1 : d1 = 0 := (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero).mp h1'
      apply hdβ
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun y => ?_
      rw [hDy y, h0, h1]
      simp
    have hAinj : Function.Injective A := by
      rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
      intro y hy
      rw [hAy] at hy
      have e1 : D y = 0 := by
        have := (hcoord (D y) (ℓ y)).1
        rw [hy] at this
        simpa using this.symm
      have e2' : ℓ y = 0 := by
        have := (hcoord (D y) (ℓ y)).2
        rw [hy] at this
        simpa using this.symm
      rw [hDy] at e1
      rw [hℓ] at e2'
      have hy0 : (d0 ^ 2 + d1 ^ 2) * y 0 = 0 := by linear_combination d0 * e1 - d1 * e2'
      have hy1 : (d0 ^ 2 + d1 ^ 2) * y 1 = 0 := by linear_combination d1 * e1 + d0 * e2'
      rw [hdec y, (mul_eq_zero.mp hy0).resolve_left hsq, (mul_eq_zero.mp hy1).resolve_left hsq]
      simp
    have hdetA : A.det ≠ 0 := by
      have hu : IsUnit (A : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E2) := by
        rw [LinearMap.isUnit_iff_ker_eq_bot]
        exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hAinj
      exact ((LinearMap.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu).ne_zero
    refine ⟨fun x => β x • e2 0 + (ℓ x - ℓ x₀) • e2 1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (hβ.smul contDiffOn_const).add
        (((ℓ.contDiff.sub contDiff_const).smul contDiff_const).contDiffOn)
    · simp [hβ0]
    · intro x
      exact (hcoord _ _).1
    · rw [hA.fderiv]
      exact hdetA
  
  have hΦd : ∀ y ∈ W, HasFDerivAt Φ (fderiv ℝ Φ y) y := fun y hy =>
    ((hΦs.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have hequiv : ∀ y, (fderiv ℝ Φ y).det ≠ 0 →
      ∃ f' : E2 ≃L[ℝ] E2, (f' : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) = fderiv ℝ Φ y :=
    fun y h => ⟨(LinearMap.equivOfDetNeZero (fderiv ℝ Φ y : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E2) h).toContinuousLinearEquiv,
      ContinuousLinearMap.ext (fun _ => rfl)⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hSo, hSW, hx₀S, hSdet⟩ : ∃ S : Set E2, IsOpen S ∧ S ⊆ W ∧ x₀ ∈ S ∧
      ∀ y ∈ S, (fderiv ℝ Φ y).det ≠ 0 := by
    refine ⟨W ∩ ((fun f : E2 →L[ℝ] E2 => f.det) ∘ fderiv ℝ Φ) ⁻¹' {0}ᶜ, ?_,
      Set.inter_subset_left, ⟨hx₀, hdet0⟩, fun y hy => hy.2⟩
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.continuous_det.comp_continuousOn
      (hΦs.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp))).isOpen_inter_preimage hW
      isOpen_compl_singleton
  
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀⟩ := hequiv x₀ hdet0
  have hcd0 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Φ x₀ := hΦs.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx₀)
  have hfd0 : HasFDerivAt Φ (f₀ : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) x₀ := by
    rw [hf₀]
    exact hΦd x₀ hx₀
  obtain ⟨eΦ, hecoe, hx₀e⟩ : ∃ eΦ : OpenPartialHomeomorph E2 E2, ⇑eΦ = Φ ∧ x₀ ∈ eΦ.source :=
    ⟨_, ContDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe hcd0 hfd0 (by simp),
      ContDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hcd0 hfd0 (by simp)⟩
  have hT₀ : IsOpen (eΦ '' (eΦ.source ∩ S)) := eΦ.isOpen_image_source_inter hSo
  have h0T : (0 : E2) ∈ eΦ '' (eΦ.source ∩ S) := ⟨x₀, ⟨hx₀e, hx₀S⟩, by rw [hecoe]; exact hΦx₀⟩
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hT₀ 0 h0T
  have hB : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ,
      z ∈ eΦ.target ∧ eΦ.symm z ∈ eΦ.source ∩ S ∧ Φ (eΦ.symm z) = z := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ := hball hz
    have hΨz : eΦ.symm z = y := by
      rw [← hyz]
      exact eΦ.left_inv hy.1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hyz]
      exact eΦ.map_source hy.1
    · rw [hΨz]
      exact hy
    · rw [hΨz, ← hyz, hecoe]
  have hΨs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (⇑eΦ.symm) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hzt, ⟨_, hyS⟩, _⟩ := hB z hz
    obtain ⟨f', hf'⟩ := hequiv (eΦ.symm z) (hSdet _ hyS)
    have h1 : HasFDerivAt (⇑eΦ) (f' : E2 →L[ℝ] E2) (eΦ.symm z) := by
      rw [hf', hecoe]
      exact hΦd _ (hSW hyS)
    have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (⇑eΦ) (eΦ.symm z) := by
      rw [hecoe]
      exact hΦs.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds (hSW hyS))
    exact (eΦ.contDiffAt_symm hzt h1 h2).contDiffWithinAt
  refine ⟨ρ, (eΦ.source ∩ S) ∩ Φ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, Φ, ⇑eΦ.symm, hρ, ?_, ?_, ?_, hΦx₀,
    ?_, hΨs, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (hΦs.continuousOn.mono (fun x hx => hSW hx.2)).isOpen_inter_preimage
      (eΦ.open_source.inter hSo) Metric.isOpen_ball
  · refine ⟨⟨hx₀e, hx₀S⟩, ?_⟩
    show Φ x₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ
    rw [hΦx₀]
    exact Metric.mem_ball_self hρ
  · exact fun x hx => hSW hx.1.2
  · exact hΦs.mono (fun x hx => hSW hx.1.2)
  · intro x hx
    refine ⟨hx.2, ?_⟩
    rw [← hecoe]
    exact eΦ.left_inv hx.1.1
  · intro z hz
    refine ⟨⟨(hB z hz).2.1, ?_⟩, (hB z hz).2.2⟩
    show Φ (eΦ.symm z) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ
    rw [(hB z hz).2.2]
    exact hz
  · intro z hz
    have := hΦc (eΦ.symm z)
    rw [(hB z hz).2.2] at this
    exact this.symm
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨_, hyS⟩, _⟩ := hB z hz
    have hdΦ : DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (eΦ.symm z) := (hΦd _ (hSW hyS)).differentiableAt
    have hdΨ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (⇑eΦ.symm) z :=
      (hΨs.contDiffAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have hev : (Φ ∘ ⇑eΦ.symm) =ᶠ[𝓝 z] id :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz) (fun w hw => (hB w hw).2.2)
    have hcomp := fderiv_comp z hdΦ hdΨ
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_id] at hcomp
    intro h0
    have h1 : (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2).det =
        ((fderiv ℝ Φ (eΦ.symm z)).comp (fderiv ℝ (⇑eΦ.symm) z)).det := congrArg _ hcomp
    have h2 : ((fderiv ℝ Φ (eΦ.symm z)).comp (fderiv ℝ (⇑eΦ.symm) z)).det =
        (fderiv ℝ Φ (eΦ.symm z)).det * (fderiv ℝ (⇑eΦ.symm) z).det := LinearMap.det_comp _ _
    have h3 : (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2).det = 1 := LinearMap.det_id
    rw [h2, h3, h0, mul_zero] at h1
    exact one_ne_zero h1

          ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, Real.sqrt (h (Ψ z)).det * (h (Ψ z))⁻¹ a c * g c * q a

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hD : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) B :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty_iff_fderiv_of_isOpen hB).mp hΨ).2
  have hJs : ∀ c c' : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 c) c') B := by
    intro c c'
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 c)) B :=
      hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj c' : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn h1
  have hHs : ∀ c' d' : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => h (Ψ z) c' d') B :=
    fun c' d' => (hh c' d').comp hΨ (fun z hz => hΨBN z hz)
  have hS : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z a c) B := by
    intro a c
    simp only [pcgbBdrPull, Matrix.of_apply]
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro c' _
    apply ContDiffOn.sum
    intro d' _
    exact ((hJs a c').mul (hHs c' d')).mul (hJs c d')
  
  have hjac : ∀ f : E2 →L[ℝ] E2, (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 2 => f (e2 j) i).det = f.det := by
    intro f
    let b := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis
    have hm : LinearMap.toMatrix b b (f : E2 →ₗ[ℝ] E2) =
        Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 2 => f (e2 j) i := by
      ext i j
      rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
      simp [b, e2, OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis_repr_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr]
    rw [← hm, LinearMap.det_toMatrix]
  
  have hPeq : ∀ z, pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z =
      (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 j) i).transpose * h (Ψ z) *
        (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 j) i) := by
    intro z
    ext c d
    simp only [pcgbBdrPull, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    ring
  
  have hid : ∀ (J H P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ), J.det ≠ 0 → 0 < H.det →
      P = J.transpose * H * J → ∀ g q : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, Real.sqrt P.det * P⁻¹ a c *
          (∑ c' : Fin 2, J c' c * g c') * (∑ a' : Fin 2, J a' a * q a') =
        |J.det| * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, Real.sqrt H.det * H⁻¹ a c * g c * q a := by
    intro J H P hJ hH hP g q
    have hdetP : P.det = J.det ^ 2 * H.det := by
      rw [hP, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
      ring
    have hsqrt : Real.sqrt P.det = |J.det| * Real.sqrt H.det := by
      rw [hdetP, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    have eL : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, Real.sqrt P.det * P⁻¹ a c *
          (∑ c' : Fin 2, J c' c * g c') * (∑ a' : Fin 2, J a' a * q a') =
        Real.sqrt P.det * (P.det)⁻¹ * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, P.adjugate a c *
          (∑ c' : Fin 2, J c' c * g c') * (∑ a' : Fin 2, J a' a * q a') := by
      rw [Matrix.inv_def]
      simp only [Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    have eR : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, Real.sqrt H.det * H⁻¹ a c * g c * q a =
        Real.sqrt H.det * (H.det)⁻¹ * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, H.adjugate a c * g c * q a := by
      rw [Matrix.inv_def]
      simp only [Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    have hpoly : ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, P.adjugate a c *
          (∑ c' : Fin 2, J c' c * g c') * (∑ a' : Fin 2, J a' a * q a') =
        J.det ^ 2 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, H.adjugate a c * g c * q a := by
      rw [hP, Matrix.det_fin_two J]
      simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.mul_apply]
      ring
    rw [eL, eR, hpoly, hsqrt, hdetP]
    have hJ2 : J.det ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hJ
    have hH0 : H.det ≠ 0 := hH.ne'
    field_simp
  refine ⟨hS, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    have hJdet : (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 j) i).det ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hjac]; exact hdet z hz
    have hHpd : (h (Ψ z)).PosDef := hpd (Ψ z) (hΨBN z hz)
    have hJu : IsUnit (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 j) i) :=
      (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hJdet)
    have key := Matrix.PosDef.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hHpd
      (Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr hJu)
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_eq_transpose_of_trivial] at key
    rw [hPeq z]
    exact key
  · intro z hz g q
    have hJdet : (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 2 => fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 j) i).det ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hjac]; exact hdet z hz
    have hHpd : (h (Ψ z)).PosDef := hpd (Ψ z) (hΨBN z hz)
    have key := hid _ (h (Ψ z)) (pcgbBdrPull h Ψ z) hJdet hHpd.det_pos (hPeq z) g q
    rw [hjac] at key
    simpa only [Matrix.of_apply] using key

proof.tactics:
by
  intro L hL hLB
  have hLm : MeasurableSet L := hL.isClosed.measurableSet
  have hΨc : ContinuousOn Ψ L := hΨ.continuousOn.mono hLB
  have hL'c : IsCompact (Ψ '' L) := hL.image_of_continuousOn hΨc
  have hL'W : Ψ '' L ⊆ W := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact hΨBW z (hLB hz)
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Ψ '' L)) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hL'c.measure_lt_top.ne
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict L) :=
    isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hL.measure_lt_top.ne
  obtain ⟨hw, hG, hval, hgrad⟩ := hL2 (Ψ '' L) hL'c hL'W
  
  have hcontL2 : ∀ S : Set E2, IsCompact S → ∀ f : E2 → ℝ, ContinuousOn f S →
      MemLp f 2 (volume.restrict S) := by
    intro S hS f hf
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict S) :=
      isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hS.measure_lt_top.ne
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hS.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf
    exact MemLp.of_bound (hf.aestronglyMeasurable hS.isClosed.measurableSet) M
      (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hS.isClosed.measurableSet hM)
  
  have hDΨ : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ Ψ) B := hΨ.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hB (by simp)
  have hdiffΨ : ∀ z ∈ L, DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ z := fun z hz =>
    (hΨ.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hB.mem_nhds (hLB hz))
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ L, HasFDerivWithinAt Ψ (fderiv ℝ Ψ x) L x := fun x hx =>
    (hdiffΨ x hx).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt
  have hinjL : Set.InjOn Ψ L := hinj.mono hLB
  have hdetc : ContinuousOn (fun z => (fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det) B :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.continuous_det.comp_continuousOn hDΨ
  have hδc : ContinuousOn (fun z => |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det|) L := (hdetc.mono hLB).abs
  have hδne : ∀ z ∈ L, |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| ≠ 0 := fun z hz =>
    abs_ne_zero.mpr (hdet z (hLB hz))
  have hqc : ContinuousOn (fun z => |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det|⁻¹) L := hδc.inv₀ hδne
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hL.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hqc
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hqC⟩ : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ z ∈ L, |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det|⁻¹ ≤ C := by
    refine ⟨max K 0, le_max_right _ _, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    have h := hK z hz
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans (h.trans (le_max_left _ _))
  
  have hcov : ∀ φ : E2 → ℝ, MemLp φ 2 (volume.restrict (Ψ '' L)) →
      MemLp (fun z => φ (Ψ z)) 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧
      ∫ z in L, φ (Ψ z) ^ 2 ≤ C * ∫ x in Ψ '' L, φ x ^ 2 := by
    intro φ hφ
    have hφi : IntegrableOn φ (Ψ '' L) := hφ.integrable (by norm_num)
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun z => |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| • φ (Ψ z)) L :=
      (integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hLm hderiv hinjL φ).mp hφi
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => φ (Ψ z)) (volume.restrict L) := by
      have h2 : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det|⁻¹ *
          (|(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| • φ (Ψ z))) (volume.restrict L) :=
        (hqc.aestronglyMeasurable hLm).mul h1.aestronglyMeasurable
      refine h2.congr ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hLm (fun z hz => ?_)
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      exact inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (hδne z hz) _
    have hφ2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => φ x ^ 2) (Ψ '' L) := hφ.integrable_sq
    have h3 : IntegrableOn (fun z => |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| • φ (Ψ z) ^ 2) L :=
      (integrableOn_image_iff_integrableOn_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hLm hderiv hinjL
        (fun x => φ x ^ 2)).mp hφ2
    have heq : ∫ x in Ψ '' L, φ x ^ 2 = ∫ z in L, |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| • φ (Ψ z) ^ 2 :=
      integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hLm hderiv hinjL (fun x => φ x ^ 2)
    have hpt : ∀ z ∈ L, φ (Ψ z) ^ 2 ≤ C * (|(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| • φ (Ψ z) ^ 2) := by
      intro z hz
      rw [smul_eq_mul]
      calc φ (Ψ z) ^ 2 = |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det|⁻¹ * (|(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| * φ (Ψ z) ^ 2) :=
            (inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (hδne z hz) _).symm
        _ ≤ C * (|(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| * φ (Ψ z) ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hqC z hz) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))
    have h4 : IntegrableOn (fun z => C * (|(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| • φ (Ψ z) ^ 2)) L :=
      h3.const_mul C
    have hint : Integrable (fun z => φ (Ψ z) ^ 2) (volume.restrict L) := by
      refine h4.mono' (hmeas.pow 2) ?_
      refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hLm (fun z hz => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact hpt z hz
    refine ⟨(memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hmeas).mpr hint, ?_⟩
    calc ∫ z in L, φ (Ψ z) ^ 2 ≤ ∫ z in L, C * (|(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| • φ (Ψ z) ^ 2) :=
          setIntegral_mono_on hint h4 hLm hpt
      _ = C * ∫ x in Ψ '' L, φ x ^ 2 := by rw [integral_const_mul, heq]
  
  have ha : ∀ k c : Fin 2, ContinuousOn (fun z => fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) c) L := fun k c =>
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj c : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp_continuousOn
      (hDΨ.clm_apply continuousOn_const)).mono hLB
  
  have hws : ∀ k : Fin 2, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ φ : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ,
      (∀ c, MemLp (φ c) 2 (volume.restrict L)) →
      MemLp (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) c * φ c z) 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧
      ∫ z in L, (∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) c * φ c z) ^ 2 ≤
        M * ∑ c : Fin 2, ∫ z in L, φ c z ^ 2 := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨A0, hA0⟩ := hL.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (ha k 0)
    obtain ⟨A1, hA1⟩ := hL.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (ha k 1)
    refine ⟨2 * (|A0| + |A1|) ^ 2, by positivity, fun φ hφ => ?_⟩
    have hb : ∀ c : Fin 2, ∀ z ∈ L, |fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) c| ≤ |A0| + |A1| := by
      refine Fin.forall_fin_two.mpr ⟨fun z hz => ?_, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      · have h := hA0 z hz
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
        exact h.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (abs_nonneg _)))
      · have h := hA1 z hz
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
        exact h.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left (abs_nonneg _)))
    have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => ∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) c * φ c z)
        (volume.restrict L) := by
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      exact (((ha k 0).aestronglyMeasurable hLm).mul (hφ 0).aestronglyMeasurable).add
        (((ha k 1).aestronglyMeasurable hLm).mul (hφ 1).aestronglyMeasurable)
    have hdom : Integrable (fun z => 2 * (|A0| + |A1|) ^ 2 * (φ 0 z ^ 2 + φ 1 z ^ 2))
        (volume.restrict L) :=
      ((hφ 0).integrable_sq.add (hφ 1).integrable_sq).const_mul (2 * (|A0| + |A1|) ^ 2)
    have hpt : ∀ z ∈ L, (∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) c * φ c z) ^ 2 ≤
        2 * (|A0| + |A1|) ^ 2 * (φ 0 z ^ 2 + φ 1 z ^ 2) := by
      intro z hz
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have h0 := hb 0 z hz
      have h1 := hb 1 z hz
      have s0 : (fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) 0) ^ 2 ≤ (|A0| + |A1|) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq' (abs_le.mp h0).1 (abs_le.mp h0).2
      have s1 : (fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) 1) ^ 2 ≤ (|A0| + |A1|) ^ 2 :=
        sq_le_sq' (abs_le.mp h1).1 (abs_le.mp h1).2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) 0 * φ 0 z - fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) 1 * φ 1 z),
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right s0 (sq_nonneg (φ 0 z)),
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right s1 (sq_nonneg (φ 1 z))]
    have hint : Integrable (fun z => (∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) c * φ c z) ^ 2)
        (volume.restrict L) := by
      refine hdom.mono' (hmeas.pow 2) (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hLm fun z hz => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact hpt z hz
    refine ⟨(memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hmeas).mpr hint, ?_⟩
    calc ∫ z in L, (∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) c * φ c z) ^ 2
        ≤ ∫ z in L, 2 * (|A0| + |A1|) ^ 2 * (φ 0 z ^ 2 + φ 1 z ^ 2) :=
          setIntegral_mono_on hint hdom hLm hpt
      _ = 2 * (|A0| + |A1|) ^ 2 * ∑ c : Fin 2, ∫ z in L, φ c z ^ 2 := by
        rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add (hφ 0).integrable_sq (hφ 1).integrable_sq,
          Fin.sum_univ_two]
  
  have hchain : ∀ (f : E2 → ℝ) (z : E2), DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ z →
      DifferentiableAt ℝ f (Ψ z) → ∀ k : Fin 2,
      pd2 k (fun y => f (Ψ y)) z = ∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) c * pd2 c f (Ψ z) := by
    intro f z hΨz hfz k
    have hcomp : fderiv ℝ (fun y => f (Ψ y)) z = (fderiv ℝ f (Ψ z)).comp (fderiv ℝ Ψ z) :=
      fderiv_comp z hfz hΨz
    unfold pd2
    rw [hcomp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
    set v := fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) with hvdef
    have hv : v = v 0 • e2 0 + v 1 • e2 1 := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    conv_lhs => rw [hv]
    rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul, Fin.sum_univ_two, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  refine ⟨(hcov w hw).1, fun k => ?_, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨M, -, hM⟩ := hws k
    exact (hM (fun c z => G c (Ψ z)) (fun c => (hcov (G c) (hG c)).1)).1
  · have hum : ∀ m, MemLp (fun x => u m x - w x) 2 (volume.restrict (Ψ '' L)) := fun m =>
      (hcontL2 _ hL'c (u m) ((hu m).continuousOn.mono hL'W)).sub hw
    refine squeeze_zero (fun m => integral_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _))
      (fun m => (hcov _ (hum m)).2) ?_
    have h := hval.const_mul C
    simp only [mul_zero] at h
    exact h
  · obtain ⟨M, hM0, hM⟩ := hws k
    have hpdc : ∀ m (c : Fin 2), ContinuousOn (pd2 c (u m)) W := fun m c =>
      ((hu m).continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hW (by simp)).clm_apply continuousOn_const
    have hψ : ∀ m (c : Fin 2), MemLp (fun x => pd2 c (u m) x - G c x) 2
        (volume.restrict (Ψ '' L)) :=
      fun m c => (hcontL2 _ hL'c _ ((hpdc m c).mono hL'W)).sub (hG c)
    have hbound : ∀ m, ∫ z in L, (pd2 k (fun y => u m (Ψ y)) z - pcgbBdrVec G Ψ k z) ^ 2 ≤
        M * ((C * ∫ x in Ψ '' L, (pd2 0 (u m) x - G 0 x) ^ 2) +
          C * ∫ x in Ψ '' L, (pd2 1 (u m) x - G 1 x) ^ 2) := by
      intro m
      have hφ : ∀ c, MemLp (fun z => pd2 c (u m) (Ψ z) - G c (Ψ z)) 2 (volume.restrict L) :=
        fun c => (hcov _ (hψ m c)).1
      have hEq : ∫ z in L, (pd2 k (fun y => u m (Ψ y)) z - pcgbBdrVec G Ψ k z) ^ 2 =
          ∫ z in L, (∑ c : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 k) c *
            (pd2 c (u m) (Ψ z) - G c (Ψ z))) ^ 2 := by
        refine setIntegral_congr_fun hLm (fun z hz => ?_)
        have huz : DifferentiableAt ℝ (u m) (Ψ z) :=
          ((hu m).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (hW.mem_nhds (hΨBW z (hLB hz)))
        beta_reduce
        rw [hchain (u m) z (hdiffΨ z hz) huz k]
        unfold pcgbBdrVec
        simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two]
        ring
      rw [hEq]
      refine (hM (fun c z => pd2 c (u m) (Ψ z) - G c (Ψ z)) hφ).2.trans ?_
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add (hcov _ (hψ m 0)).2 (hcov _ (hψ m 1)).2) hM0
    refine squeeze_zero (fun m => integral_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)) hbound ?_
    have h := (((hgrad 0).const_mul C).add ((hgrad 1).const_mul C)).const_mul M
    simp only [mul_zero, add_zero] at h
    exact h

(W N B : Set E2) (hN : IsOpen N) (hB : IsOpen B) (hNW : N ⊆ W)
    (Φ Ψ : E2 → E2) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ N) (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ B)
    (hΦN : ∀ x ∈ N, Φ x ∈ B ∧ Ψ (Φ x) = x) (hΨB : ∀ z ∈ B, Ψ z ∈ N ∧ Φ (Ψ z) = z)

signature.name: pcgb_bdr_weak_transport
signature.statement:
(W N B : Set E2) (hN : IsOpen N) (hB : IsOpen B) (hNW : N ⊆ W)
    (Φ Ψ : E2 → E2) (hΦ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Φ N) (hΨ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Ψ B)
    (hΦN : ∀ x ∈ N, Φ x ∈ B ∧ Ψ (Φ x) = x) (hΨB : ∀ z ∈ B, Ψ z ∈ N ∧ Φ (Ψ z) = z)
    (β : E2 → ℝ) (hβΨ : ∀ z ∈ B, β (Ψ z) = z 0)
    (A At : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (G Gt : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hid : ∀ z ∈ B, ∀ q : Fin 2 → ℝ,
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, At z a c * Gt c z * (∑ a' : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 a) a' * q a') =
        |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A (Ψ z) a c * G c (Ψ z) * q a)
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ W ∩ {x | 0 < β x} →
      ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A x a c * G c x * pd2 a ζ x = 0) :
    ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ B ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} →
      ∫ z, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, At z a c * Gt c z * pd2 a ζ z = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  intro ξ hξ hξc hξs
  classical
  have hKc : IsCompact (tsupport ξ) := hξc.isCompact
  have hKB : tsupport ξ ⊆ B := hξs.trans Set.inter_subset_left
  have hΨc : ContinuousOn Ψ B := hΨ.continuousOn
  have hK'c : IsCompact (Ψ '' tsupport ξ) := hKc.image_of_continuousOn (hΨc.mono hKB)
  have hK'cl : IsClosed (Ψ '' tsupport ξ) := hK'c.isClosed
  have hK'N : Ψ '' tsupport ξ ⊆ N := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact (hΨB z (hKB hz)).1
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζdef⟩ : ∃ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ζ = N.indicator (fun x => ξ (Φ x)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hζN : ∀ x ∈ N, ζ x = ξ (Φ x) := fun x hx => by
    rw [hζdef]; exact Set.indicator_of_mem hx _
  have hζoff : ∀ y, y ∉ Ψ '' tsupport ξ → ζ y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    by_cases hyN : y ∈ N
    · rw [hζN y hyN]
      apply image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      intro hΦK
      apply hy
      exact ⟨Φ y, hΦK, (hΦN y hyN).2⟩
    · rw [hζdef]; exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hyN _
  have hζs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro y
    by_cases hyN : y ∈ N
    · have hev : ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (ξ ∘ Φ) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hN.mem_nhds hyN) (fun x hx => hζN x hx)
      exact (ContDiffAt.comp y hξ.contDiffAt
        (hΦ.contDiffAt (hN.mem_nhds hyN))).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
    · have hyK : y ∉ Ψ '' tsupport ξ := fun h => hyN (hK'N h)
      have hev : ζ =ᶠ[𝓝 y] (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hK'cl.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hyK) (fun x hx => hζoff x hx)
      exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ := HasCompactSupport.intro hK'c hζoff
  have hζt : tsupport ζ ⊆ Ψ '' tsupport ξ := by
    apply closure_minimal _ hK'cl
    intro y hy
    by_contra h
    exact hy (hζoff y h)
  have hζΨ : ∀ z ∈ B, ζ (Ψ z) = ξ z := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hζN _ (hΨB z hz).1, (hΨB z hz).2]
  have hζW : tsupport ζ ⊆ W ∩ {x | 0 < β x} := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hζt hx
    have hzB := hKB hz
    refine ⟨hNW (hΨB z hzB).1, ?_⟩
    show 0 < β (Ψ z)
    rw [hβΨ z hzB]
    exact (hξs hz).2
  have h0 := hweak ζ hζs hζc hζW
  have hloc : ∫ x in Ψ '' B, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A x a c * G c x * pd2 a ζ x) =
      ∫ x, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A x a c * G c x * pd2 a ζ x := by
    apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    have hxt : x ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h => hx (Set.image_mono hKB (hζt h))
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ ζ x = 0 := fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport ℝ hxt
    simp [pd2, hfd]
  have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ Ψ z := fun z hz =>
    (hΨ.contDiffAt (hB.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn Ψ B := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rw [← (hΨB a ha).2, ← (hΨB b hb).2, hab]
  have hcov := integral_image_eq_integral_abs_det_fderiv_smul volume hB.measurableSet
    (fun z hz => (hdiff z hz).hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt) hinj
    (fun x => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A x a c * G c x * pd2 a ζ x)
  have hpt : ∀ z ∈ B, |(fderiv ℝ Ψ z).det| •
      (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, A (Ψ z) a c * G c (Ψ z) * pd2 a ζ (Ψ z)) =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, At z a c * Gt c z * pd2 a ξ z := by
    intro z hz
    have hchain : ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 a ξ z =
        ∑ a' : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 a) a' * pd2 a' ζ (Ψ z) := by
      intro a
      have hev : ξ =ᶠ[𝓝 z] (ζ ∘ Ψ) :=
        Filter.eventually_of_mem (hB.mem_nhds hz) (fun y hy => (hζΨ y hy).symm)
      have hζd : DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ (Ψ z) := hζs.differentiable (by simp) _
      unfold pd2
      rw [hev.fderiv_eq, fderiv_comp z hζd (hdiff z hz), ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      have hv : fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 a) =
          ∑ a' : Fin 2, fderiv ℝ Ψ z (e2 a) a' • e2 a' := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      conv_lhs => rw [hv]
      rw [map_sum]
      simp [map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    simp only [hchain]
    rw [hid z hz (fun a' => pd2 a' ζ (Ψ z)), smul_eq_mul]
  have hzloc : ∫ z in B, (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, At z a c * Gt c z * pd2 a ξ z) =
      ∫ z, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, At z a c * Gt c z * pd2 a ξ z := by
    apply setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero
    intro z hz
    have hzt : z ∉ tsupport ξ := fun h => hz (hKB h)
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ ξ z = 0 := fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport ℝ hzt
    simp [pd2, hfd]
  rw [← hzloc, ← setIntegral_congr_fun hB.measurableSet (fun z hz => hpt z hz), ← hcov, hloc, h0]

informal_problem.statement:
(ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => A z a b) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ))
    (hAs : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, ∀ a b : Fin 2, A z a b = A z b a)
    (hApos : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, (A z).PosDef)
    (u : ℕ → E2 → ℝ) (hu : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (u m) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ))
    (huz : ∀ m, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ, z 0 < c → u m z = 0)
    (w : E2 → ℝ) (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ →
      MemLp w 2 (volume.restrict L) ∧ (∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict L)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ z in L, (u m z - w z) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      ∀ k, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ z in L, (pd2 k (u m) z - G k z) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} →
      ∫ z, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A z a b * G b z * pd2 a ζ z = 0) :
    ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ ρ ∧ ∃ V : E2 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ V (Metric.ball (0 : E2) s) ∧
      (∀ᵐ z ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E2) s ∩ {z | 0 < z 0})), w z = V z) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) s, 0 ≤ z 0 →
        ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b * pd2 b V y) z = 0) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) s, z 0 = 0 → V z = 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hP0 : ∀ x : E3, pcgbF2P x 0 = x 0 := by
    intro x
    simp [pcgbF2P, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hP1 : ∀ x : E3, pcgbF2P x 1 = x 1 := by
    intro x
    simp [pcgbF2P, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hnsq3 : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hnsq2 : ∀ z : E2, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hcyl : ∀ t a b : ℝ, (cylPt t a b) 0 = t ∧ (cylPt t a b) 1 = a ∧ (cylPt t a b) 2 = b := by
    intro t a b
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPn : ∀ x : E3, ‖pcgbF2P x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    intro x
    have h1 := hnsq2 (pcgbF2P x)
    have h2 := hnsq3 x
    rw [hP0, hP1] at h1
    have h3 := norm_nonneg (pcgbF2P x)
    have h4 := norm_nonneg x
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 2)]
  have hPball : ∀ R : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R, pcgbF2P x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) R := by
    intro R x hx
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hx ⊢
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hPn x) hx
  have hE0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E2 => cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0) := by
    have h0 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E2 => z 0) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : E2 => z 1) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff
    unfold cylPt
    exact ((h0.smul contDiff_const).add (h1.smul contDiff_const)).add contDiff_const
  have hE0ball : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8),
      cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hz ⊢
    have h1 := hnsq3 (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0)
    obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2⟩ := hcyl (z 0) (z 1) 0
    rw [c0, c1, c2] at h1
    have h2 := hnsq2 z
    have h3 := norm_nonneg (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0)
    have h4 := norm_nonneg z
    nlinarith
  
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTx⟩ := pcgb_flat2_split
  
  obtain ⟨hA3, hAs3, hApos3⟩ := pcgb_flat2_coeff_lift ρ hρ A hA hAs hApos
  
  have hvn : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => u m (pcgbF2P x)) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) ρ) :=
    fun m => (hu m).comp pcgbF2P.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun x hx => hPball ρ x hx)
  have hvz : ∀ m, ∃ O : Set E3, IsOpen O ∧ {x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) ρ | x 0 = 0} ⊆ O ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, (fun m x => u m (pcgbF2P x)) m x = 0 := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcz⟩ := huz m
    refine ⟨Metric.ball (0 : E3) ρ ∩ {x : E3 | x 0 < c},
      Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous continuous_const), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      refine ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
      show x 0 < c
      rw [hx.2]
      exact hc
    · intro x hx
      show u m (pcgbF2P x) = 0
      refine hcz _ (hPball ρ x hx.1) ?_
      rw [hP0]
      exact hx.2
  
  have hcore := fun φ hφ => pcgb_flat2_lift_sq ρ hρ T hT hTx φ hφ
  obtain ⟨hvL, hGL, hv0, hv1⟩ := pcgb_flat2_l2_data ρ hρ u hu w G hL2 hcore
  
  have hKsub : Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hG : ∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2))) :=
    (hL2 _ (isCompact_closedBall _ _) hKsub).2.1
  have hweak3 : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 2) →
      (∃ O : Set E3, IsOpen O ∧ {x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) ρ | x 0 = 0} ⊆ O ∧
        ∀ x ∈ O, ζ x = 0) →
      ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ,
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A x a b * pcgbF2G G b x * partialDeriv a ζ x +
          (fun _ : E3 => (0 : ℝ)) x * ζ x) = 0 := by
    intro ζ hζ hζc hζs hO
    have hslice := fun t => pcgb_flat2_slice_weak ρ hρ A G hweak ζ hζ hζc hζs hO t
    have hfl := pcgb_flat2_fubini_lift ρ hρ T hT hTx A hA G hG ζ hζ hζc hζs hslice
    simp only [zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact hfl
  
  obtain ⟨v', hv's, hae, heq3, hface⟩ := flat_dirichlet_regularity (0 : E3) ρ hρ (by simp)
    (pcgbF2A A) hA3 hAs3 hApos3 (fun _ => 0) contDiffOn_const (fun x => w (pcgbF2P x))
    (pcgbF2G G) (fun m x => u m (pcgbF2P x)) hvn hvz hvL hGL hv0 hv1 hweak3
  
  have hinv := pcgb_flat2_x2_invariant (ρ / 4) v' w hv's.continuousOn hae
  
  have heq2 := pcgb_flat2_eq_slice ρ hρ A hA v' hv's hinv heq3
  
  have hae2 := pcgb_flat2_ae_slice ρ hρ T hT hTx v' w hinv hae
  
  refine ⟨ρ / 8, by positivity, by linarith, fun z => v' (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0), ?_, hae2,
    heq2, ?_⟩
  · exact hv's.comp hE0.contDiffOn (fun z hz => hE0ball z hz)
  · intro z hz hz0
    refine hface _ (hE0ball z hz) ?_
    rw [(hcyl (z 0) (z 1) 0).1]
    exact hz0

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_flat2_lift_sq

    (hT : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving T MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hTx : ∀ x : E3, T x = (pcgbF2P x, x 2)) (φ : E2 → ℝ)

subgoal_signatures.statement:

    (hL2 : ∀ L : Set E2, IsCompact L → L ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ →

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_flat2_slice_weak

subgoal_signatures.name: flat_dirichlet_regularity
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(c : E3) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hc : c 0 = 0)
    (A : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A x a b) (Metric.ball c r))
    (hAs : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c r, ∀ a b : Fin 3, A x a b = A x b a)
    (hApos : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c r, (A x).PosDef)
    (F : E3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F (Metric.ball c r))
    (v : E3 → ℝ) (Gr : Fin 3 → E3 → ℝ) (vn : ℕ → E3 → ℝ)
    (hvn : ∀ m, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (vn m) (Metric.ball c r))
    (hvz : ∀ m, ∃ O : Set E3, IsOpen O ∧ {x ∈ Metric.ball c r | x 0 = 0} ⊆ O ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, vn m x = 0)
    (hvL : MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict (ndsHalf c r)))
    (hGL : ∀ a, MemLp (Gr a) 2 (volume.restrict (ndsHalf c r)))
    (hv0 : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in ndsHalf c r, (vn m x - v x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hv1 : ∀ a, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in ndsHalf c r,
      (partialDeriv a (vn m) x - Gr a x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball c (r / 2) →
      (∃ O : Set E3, IsOpen O ∧ {x ∈ Metric.ball c r | x 0 = 0} ⊆ O ∧ ∀ x ∈ O, ζ x = 0) →
      ∫ x in ndsHalf c r,
        (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, A x a b * Gr b x * partialDeriv a ζ x + F x * ζ x) = 0) :
    ∃ v' : E3 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v' (Metric.ball c (r / 4)) ∧
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball c (r / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0})), v x = v' x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c (r / 4), 0 ≤ x 0 →
        ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, A y a b * partialDeriv b v' y) x = F x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c (r / 4), x 0 = 0 → v' x = 0)

informal_problem.statement:
(V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (φ : E2 → ℝ)
    (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ V) (x₀ : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ R ⊆ V) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R,
      |pcgbTay2 φ x₀ x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 3 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (pcgbTay2 φ x₀) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (pcgbTay2 φ x₀)) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀

signature.statement:
(V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (φ : E2 → ℝ)

    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ R ⊆ V) :

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hx₀V : x₀ ∈ V := hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR.le)
  have hφa : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ φ x₀ := hφ.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hx₀V)
  have hφ' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ φ) V := hφ.fderiv_of_isOpen hV le_rfl
  have hdφ' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x₀ :=
    (hφ'.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hx₀V)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  obtain ⟨L, hLdef⟩ : ∃ L : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ, L = fderiv ℝ φ x₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B : E2 →L[ℝ] E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ, B = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hsymm : ∀ v w : E2, B v w = B w v := by
    intro v w
    rw [hBdef]
    exact hφa.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
      simp [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
      first
        | exact_mod_cast (le_top : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤)
        | exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top
        | decide) v w
  
  have hX : ∀ k l : Fin 2, pd2 k (pd2 l φ) x₀ = B (e2 k) (e2 l) := by
    intro k l
    have h := fderiv_clm_apply hdφ' (differentiableAt_const (e2 l))
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ φ y (e2 l)) x₀ (e2 k) = _
    rw [h]
    simp [hBdef]
  
  have hrep : ∀ y, pcgbTay2 φ x₀ y =
      φ y - (φ x₀ + L (y - x₀) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * B (y - x₀) (y - x₀)) := by
    intro y
    have hu : y - x₀ = (y - x₀) 0 • e2 0 + (y - x₀) 1 • e2 1 := by
      ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
    have hLu : L (y - x₀) = (y - x₀) 0 * L (e2 0) + (y - x₀) 1 * L (e2 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hu]
      simp
    have hBu : B (y - x₀) (y - x₀) =
        (y - x₀) 0 * (y - x₀) 0 * B (e2 0) (e2 0) + (y - x₀) 0 * (y - x₀) 1 * B (e2 0) (e2 1) +
        (y - x₀) 1 * (y - x₀) 0 * B (e2 1) (e2 0) + (y - x₀) 1 * (y - x₀) 1 * B (e2 1) (e2 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hu]
      simp
      ring
    unfold pcgbTay2
    simp only [hX, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    rw [hLu, hBu]
    simp only [pd2, ← hLdef]
    ring
  set τ := pcgbTay2 φ x₀ with hτdef
  have hτfun : τ = fun y => φ y - (φ x₀ + L (y - x₀) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * B (y - x₀) (y - x₀)) :=
    funext hrep
  have hlin : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => y - x₀) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E2) y :=
    fun y => (hasFDerivAt_id y).sub_const x₀
  have hBlin : ∀ y, HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => B (y - x₀)) B y := fun y =>
    (B.hasFDerivAt.comp y (hlin y)).congr_fderiv (by simp)
  have hτd : ∀ y ∈ V, HasFDerivAt τ (fderiv ℝ φ y - L - B (y - x₀)) y := by
    intro y hy
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ y :=
      (hφ.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hy)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    have h1 := hφd.hasFDerivAt
    have h2 := L.hasFDerivAt.comp y (hlin y)
    have h3 := (hBlin y).clm_apply (hlin y)
    have h4 := h1.sub (((hasFDerivAt_const (φ x₀) y).add h2).add (h3.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)))
    rw [hτfun]
    refine h4.congr_fderiv ?_
    ext v
    have hs := hsymm v (y - x₀)
    simp at hs ⊢
    linarith
  have hfτ : ∀ z ∈ V, fderiv ℝ τ z = fderiv ℝ φ z - L - B (z - x₀) :=
    fun z hz => (hτd z hz).fderiv
  have hD1s : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => fderiv ℝ φ z - L - B (z - x₀)) V :=
    (hφ'.sub contDiffOn_const).sub
      ((B.contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)).contDiffOn)
  have hτ' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ τ) V := hD1s.congr hfτ
  have hτ'' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ)) V := hτ'.fderiv_of_isOpen hV le_rfl
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ))) V :=
    hτ''.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by simp)
  have hd0 : ∀ z ∈ V, DifferentiableAt ℝ τ z := fun z hz => (hτd z hz).differentiableAt
  have hd1 : ∀ z ∈ V, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) z := fun z hz =>
    (hτ'.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hd2 : ∀ z ∈ V, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ)) z := fun z hz =>
    (hτ''.contDiffAt (hV.mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  
  have h0 : τ x₀ = 0 := by rw [hrep]; simp
  have h1 : fderiv ℝ τ x₀ = 0 := by rw [hfτ x₀ hx₀V, hLdef]; simp
  have h2 : fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) x₀ = 0 := by
    have hev : fderiv ℝ τ =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀] (fun z => fderiv ℝ φ z - L - B (z - x₀)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hV.mem_nhds hx₀V) hfτ
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    have hD : HasFDerivAt (fun z => fderiv ℝ φ z - L - B (z - x₀))
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x₀ - 0 - B) x₀ :=
      (hdφ'.hasFDerivAt.sub (hasFDerivAt_const L x₀)).sub (hBlin x₀)
    rw [hD.fderiv, hBdef]
    simp
  
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x₀ R).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    ((hτ''.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen hV (by simp)).mono hball)
  refine ⟨max B₀ 0, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ max B₀ 0 := le_max_right _ _
  have hL2 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) y‖ ≤ max B₀ 0 * dist y x₀ := by
    intro y hy
    have := (convex_closedBall x₀ R).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
      (fun z hz => hd2 z (hball hz)) (fun z hz => (hB₀ z hz).trans (le_max_left B₀ 0))
      (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR.le) hy
    rwa [h2, sub_zero, ← dist_eq_norm] at this
  intro x hx
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ dist x x₀ := dist_nonneg
  have hsR : dist x x₀ ≤ R := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hx
  have hSB : Metric.closedBall x₀ (dist x x₀) ⊆ Metric.closedBall x₀ R :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hsR
  have hxS : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (dist x x₀) := Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr le_rfl
  have hx₀S : x₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (dist x x₀) := Metric.mem_closedBall_self hs0
  have hL1 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (dist x x₀),
      ‖fderiv ℝ τ y‖ ≤ max B₀ 0 * dist x x₀ * dist x x₀ := by
    intro y hy
    have hb : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ (dist x x₀),
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ τ) z‖ ≤ max B₀ 0 * dist x x₀ := fun z hz =>
      (hL2 z (hSB hz)).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hz) hK0)
    have := (convex_closedBall x₀ (dist x x₀)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
      (fun z hz => hd1 z (hball (hSB hz))) hb hx₀S hy
    rw [h1, sub_zero, ← dist_eq_norm] at this
    exact this.trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hy) (mul_nonneg hK0 hs0))
  have h0b := (convex_closedBall x₀ (dist x x₀)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
    (fun z hz => hd0 z (hball (hSB hz))) hL1 hx₀S hxS
  rw [h0, sub_zero, ← dist_eq_norm, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h0b
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hL2 x hx⟩
  · calc |τ x| ≤ max B₀ 0 * dist x x₀ * dist x x₀ * dist x x₀ := h0b
      _ = max B₀ 0 * dist x x₀ ^ 3 := by ring
  · calc ‖fderiv ℝ τ x‖ ≤ max B₀ 0 * dist x x₀ * dist x x₀ := hL1 x hxS
      _ = max B₀ 0 * dist x x₀ ^ 2 := by ring

informal_problem.statement:
(x₀ x : E2) (p : Fin 2) (L : Fin 2 → ℝ) (B : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (U : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, L a * (y - x₀) a) x = L p ∧
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B a b * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b) x =
      ∑ b : Fin 2, (B p b + B b p) * (x - x₀) b ∧
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        T a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) x =
      ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (T p b c + T b p c + T b c p) * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c ∧
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        U a b c d * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d) x =
      ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        (U p b c d + U b p c d + U b c p d + U b c d p) * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c * (x - x₀) d ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, L a * (y - x₀) a) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B a b * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        T a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        U a b c d * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d)

    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B a b * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        T a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        U a b c d * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hz : ∀ a : Fin 2, pd2 p (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) a) x = if a = p then 1 else 0 := by
    intro a
    have h := (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) 2 (x - x₀) a).comp x
      ((hasFDerivAt_id x).sub_const x₀)
    unfold pd2
    rw [show (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) a) = ((fun f : E2 => f.ofLp a) ∘ fun y : E2 => id y - x₀)
      from rfl, h.fderiv]
    simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hK : ∀ c : ℝ, pd2 p (fun _ : E2 => c) x = 0 := by
    intro c; unfold pd2; simp
  have hP : ∀ f g : E2 → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → DifferentiableAt ℝ g x →
      pd2 p (fun y => f y * g y) x = f x * pd2 p g x + g x * pd2 p f x := by
    intro f g hf hg; unfold pd2; rw [fderiv_fun_mul hf hg]; simp
  have hS : ∀ F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ, (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F i) x) →
      pd2 p (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 2, F i y) x = ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 p (F i) x := by
    intro F hF; unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => hF i)]
    simp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, by fun_prop, by fun_prop, by fun_prop, by fun_prop⟩
  · simp (disch := fun_prop) only [hS, hP, hK, hz]
    fin_cases p <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  · simp (disch := fun_prop) only [hS, hP, hK, hz]
    fin_cases p <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring
  · simp (disch := fun_prop) only [hS, hP, hK, hz]
    fin_cases p <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring
  · simp (disch := fun_prop) only [hS, hP, hK, hz]
    fin_cases p <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (x₀ : E2) (R₀ : ℝ) (hR₀ : 0 < R₀)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ R₀ ⊆ W) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ x : E2, dist x x₀ < min R₀ 1 →
      |pcgbPxEik h (pcgbJetD h x₀) x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 5 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (pcgbPxEik h (pcgbJetD h x₀)) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 4
