signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (x₀ : E2) (R₀ : ℝ) (hR₀ : 0 < R₀)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ R₀ ⊆ W) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ x : E2, dist x x₀ < min R₀ 1 →
      |pcgbPxEik h (pcgbJetD h x₀) x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 5 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (pcgbPxEik h (pcgbJetD h x₀)) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 4

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  have hx₀W : x₀ ∈ W := hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR₀.le)
  have hH : (h x₀).PosDef := hpd x₀ hx₀W
  have hHs : ∀ a c : Fin 2, h x₀ a c = h x₀ c a := by
    intro a c
    have := hH.isHermitian.apply a c
    rw [star_trivial] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hdet : (h x₀).det ≠ 0 := hH.det_pos.ne'
  obtain ⟨σ, hσdef⟩ : ∃ σ : ℝ, σ = min R₀ 1 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσR : σ ≤ R₀ := by rw [hσdef]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hσ1 : σ ≤ 1 := by rw [hσdef]; exact min_le_right _ _
  
  have ord_congr : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u v : E2 → ℝ), (∀ y, u y = v y) → pcgbOrd x₀ σ n v →
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ n u := by
    intro n u v huv hv
    rw [show u = v from funext huv]
    exact hv
  have ord_coord : ∀ k : Fin 2, pcgbOrd x₀ σ 1 (fun y => (y - x₀) k) := by
    intro k
    have hfun : (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) k) = fun y =>
        (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) y - (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x₀ := by
      funext y; simp
    have hD : ∀ x : E2, HasFDerivAt (fun y : E2 => (y - x₀) k)
        (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
      intro x
      rw [hfun]
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj k : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.sub_const _
    refine ⟨1, zero_le_one, fun x _ => ⟨(hD x).differentiableAt, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · show |(x - x₀) k| ≤ 1 * dist x x₀ ^ 1
      rw [pow_one, one_mul, dist_eq_norm]
      calc |(x - x₀) k| = ‖(x - x₀) k‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖x - x₀‖ := PiLp.norm_apply_le _ k
    · rw [(hD x).fderiv]
      simp only [Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul]
      refine ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one (fun v => ?_)
      rw [one_mul]
      exact PiLp.norm_apply_le v k
  have ord_add : ∀ (n : ℕ) (u v : E2 → ℝ), pcgbOrd x₀ σ n u → pcgbOrd x₀ σ n v →
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ n (fun y => u y + v y) := by
    rintro n u v ⟨c1, hc1, h1⟩ ⟨c2, hc2, h2⟩
    refine ⟨c1 + c2, add_nonneg hc1 hc2, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨d1, a1, b1⟩ := h1 x hx
    obtain ⟨d2, a2, b2⟩ := h2 x hx
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u y + v y) x ∧ |u x + v x| ≤ (c1 + c2) * dist x x₀ ^ n ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y + v y) x‖ ≤ (c1 + c2) * dist x x₀ ^ (n - 1)
    refine ⟨d1.add d2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc |u x + v x| ≤ |u x| + |v x| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ c1 * dist x x₀ ^ n + c2 * dist x x₀ ^ n := add_le_add a1 a2
        _ = (c1 + c2) * dist x x₀ ^ n := by ring
    · rw [fderiv_fun_add d1 d2]
      calc ‖fderiv ℝ u x + fderiv ℝ v x‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ c1 * dist x x₀ ^ (n - 1) + c2 * dist x x₀ ^ (n - 1) := add_le_add b1 b2
        _ = (c1 + c2) * dist x x₀ ^ (n - 1) := by ring
  have ord_smul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (u : E2 → ℝ), pcgbOrd x₀ σ n u →
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ n (fun y => a * u y) := by
    rintro n a u ⟨c, hc, hu⟩
    refine ⟨|a| * c, mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg a) hc, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨d, h1, h2⟩ := hu x hx
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => a * u y) x ∧ |a * u x| ≤ |a| * c * dist x x₀ ^ n ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => a * u y) x‖ ≤ |a| * c * dist x x₀ ^ (n - 1)
    refine ⟨d.const_mul a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [abs_mul, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (abs_nonneg a)
    · rw [fderiv_const_mul d a, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (abs_nonneg a)
  have ord_sum : ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ), (∀ i, pcgbOrd x₀ σ n (w i)) →
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ n (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 2, w i y) := by
    intro n w hw
    have hfun : (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 2, w i y) = fun y => w 0 y + w 1 y := by
      funext y; exact Fin.sum_univ_two _
    rw [hfun]
    exact ord_add n _ _ (hw 0) (hw 1)
  have ord_mul : ∀ (m n k : ℕ) (u v : E2 → ℝ), m + n = k → pcgbOrd x₀ σ m u →
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ n v → pcgbOrd x₀ σ k (fun y => u y * v y) := by
    rintro m n k u v rfl ⟨c1, hc1, h1⟩ ⟨c2, hc2, h2⟩
    refine ⟨2 * c1 * c2, mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hc1) hc2, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨d1, a1, b1⟩ := h1 x hx
    obtain ⟨d2, a2, b2⟩ := h2 x hx
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ dist x x₀ := dist_nonneg
    have hs1 : dist x x₀ ≤ 1 := (hx.trans_le hσ1).le
    have hc12 : 0 ≤ c1 * c2 := mul_nonneg hc1 hc2
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => u y * v y) x ∧
      |u x * v x| ≤ 2 * c1 * c2 * dist x x₀ ^ (m + n) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => u y * v y) x‖ ≤ 2 * c1 * c2 * dist x x₀ ^ (m + n - 1)
    refine ⟨d1.mul d2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [abs_mul]
      have hp : 0 ≤ dist x x₀ ^ (m + n) := pow_nonneg hs0 _
      calc |u x| * |v x| ≤ (c1 * dist x x₀ ^ m) * (c2 * dist x x₀ ^ n) :=
            mul_le_mul a1 a2 (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hc1 (pow_nonneg hs0 _))
        _ = c1 * c2 * dist x x₀ ^ (m + n) := by rw [pow_add]; ring
        _ ≤ 2 * c1 * c2 * dist x x₀ ^ (m + n) := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hc12 hp]
    · rw [fderiv_fun_mul d1 d2]
      have e1 : dist x x₀ ^ m * dist x x₀ ^ (n - 1) ≤ dist x x₀ ^ (m + n - 1) := by
        rw [← pow_add]; exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one hs0 hs1 (by omega)
      have e2 : dist x x₀ ^ n * dist x x₀ ^ (m - 1) ≤ dist x x₀ ^ (m + n - 1) := by
        rw [← pow_add]; exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one hs0 hs1 (by omega)
      have t1 : ‖u x • fderiv ℝ v x‖ ≤ (c1 * dist x x₀ ^ m) * (c2 * dist x x₀ ^ (n - 1)) := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact mul_le_mul a1 b2 (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hc1 (pow_nonneg hs0 _))
      have t2 : ‖v x • fderiv ℝ u x‖ ≤ (c2 * dist x x₀ ^ n) * (c1 * dist x x₀ ^ (m - 1)) := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact mul_le_mul a2 b1 (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hc2 (pow_nonneg hs0 _))
      calc ‖u x • fderiv ℝ v x + v x • fderiv ℝ u x‖
          ≤ ‖u x • fderiv ℝ v x‖ + ‖v x • fderiv ℝ u x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ (c1 * dist x x₀ ^ m) * (c2 * dist x x₀ ^ (n - 1)) +
              (c2 * dist x x₀ ^ n) * (c1 * dist x x₀ ^ (m - 1)) := add_le_add t1 t2
        _ = c1 * c2 * (dist x x₀ ^ m * dist x x₀ ^ (n - 1)) +
              c1 * c2 * (dist x x₀ ^ n * dist x x₀ ^ (m - 1)) := by ring
        _ ≤ c1 * c2 * dist x x₀ ^ (m + n - 1) + c1 * c2 * dist x x₀ ^ (m + n - 1) :=
            add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e1 hc12) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e2 hc12)
        _ = 2 * c1 * c2 * dist x x₀ ^ (m + n - 1) := by ring
  have ord_mono : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (u : E2 → ℝ), m ≤ n → pcgbOrd x₀ σ n u → pcgbOrd x₀ σ m u := by
    rintro m n u hmn ⟨c, hc, hu⟩
    refine ⟨c, hc, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨d, h1, h2⟩ := hu x hx
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ dist x x₀ := dist_nonneg
    have hs1 : dist x x₀ ≤ 1 := (hx.trans_le hσ1).le
    exact ⟨d, h1.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_of_le_one hs0 hs1 hmn) hc),
      h2.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_of_le_one hs0 hs1 (by omega)) hc)⟩
  have ord_mm : ∀ (m n k : ℕ) (u v : E2 → ℝ), k ≤ m + n → pcgbOrd x₀ σ m u →
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ n v → pcgbOrd x₀ σ k (fun y => u y * v y) := fun m n k u v hk hu hv =>
    ord_mono k (m + n) _ hk (ord_mul m n (m + n) u v rfl hu hv)
  
  have hv1 : ∀ (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (p : Fin 2),
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ 1 (fun y => pcgbJv1 H x₀ y p) := by
    intro H p
    show pcgbOrd x₀ σ 1 (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, (H p b + H b p) * (y - x₀) b)
    exact ord_sum 1 _ (fun b => ord_smul 1 _ _ (ord_coord b))
  have hv2 : ∀ (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (p : Fin 2),
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ 2 (fun y => pcgbJv2 T x₀ y p) := by
    intro T p
    show pcgbOrd x₀ σ 2 (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
      (T p b c + T b p c + T b c p) * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c)
    exact ord_sum 2 _ (fun b => ord_sum 2 _ (fun c =>
      ord_mm 1 1 2 _ _ (by norm_num) (ord_smul 1 _ _ (ord_coord b)) (ord_coord c)))
  have hv3 : ∀ (U : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (p : Fin 2),
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ 3 (fun y => pcgbJv3 U x₀ y p) := by
    intro U p
    show pcgbOrd x₀ σ 3 (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
      (U p b c d + U b p c d + U b c p d + U b c d p) * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d)
    exact ord_sum 3 _ (fun b => ord_sum 3 _ (fun c => ord_sum 3 _ (fun d =>
      ord_mm 2 1 3 _ _ (by norm_num)
        (ord_mm 1 1 2 _ _ (by norm_num) (ord_smul 1 _ _ (ord_coord b)) (ord_coord c))
        (ord_coord d))))
  have hA1 : ∀ (g1 : Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (p q : Fin 2),
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ 1 (fun y => pcgbJA1 g1 x₀ y p q) := by
    intro g1 p q
    show pcgbOrd x₀ σ 1 (fun y => ∑ k : Fin 2, g1 k p q * (y - x₀) k)
    exact ord_sum 1 _ (fun k => ord_smul 1 _ _ (ord_coord k))
  have hA2 : ∀ (g2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (p q : Fin 2),
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ 2 (fun y => pcgbJA2 g2 x₀ y p q) := by
    intro g2 p q
    show pcgbOrd x₀ σ 2 (fun y => (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2, g2 k l p q * (y - x₀) k * (y - x₀) l)
    exact ord_smul 2 _ _ (ord_sum 2 _ (fun k => ord_sum 2 _ (fun l =>
      ord_mm 1 1 2 _ _ (by norm_num) (ord_smul 1 _ _ (ord_coord k)) (ord_coord l))))
  have hw : ∀ (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
      (U : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (p : Fin 2),
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ 1 (fun y => pcgbJv1 H x₀ y p + pcgbJv2 T x₀ y p + pcgbJv3 U x₀ y p) :=
    fun H T U p => ord_add 1 _ _ (ord_add 1 _ _ (hv1 H p) (ord_mono 1 2 _ (by norm_num) (hv2 T p)))
      (ord_mono 1 3 _ (by norm_num) (hv3 U p))
  have hE5gen : ∀ (Hi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (A1 A2 : E2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
      (v1 v2 v3 : E2 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ p q, pcgbOrd x₀ σ 1 (fun y => A1 y p q)) → (∀ p q, pcgbOrd x₀ σ 2 (fun y => A2 y p q)) →
      (∀ p, pcgbOrd x₀ σ 1 (fun y => v1 y p)) → (∀ p, pcgbOrd x₀ σ 2 (fun y => v2 y p)) →
      (∀ p, pcgbOrd x₀ σ 3 (fun y => v3 y p)) →
      pcgbOrd x₀ σ 5 (fun y => pcgbJE5 Hi (A1 y) (A2 y) (v1 y) (v2 y) (v3 y)) := by
    intro Hi A1 A2 v1 v2 v3 hB1 hB2 h1 h2 h3
    show pcgbOrd x₀ σ 5 (fun y => ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2,
      (Hi p q * (v2 y p * v3 y q + v3 y p * v2 y q + v3 y p * v3 y q)
        + A1 y p q * (v1 y p * v3 y q + v3 y p * v1 y q + v2 y p * v2 y q + v2 y p * v3 y q
            + v3 y p * v2 y q + v3 y p * v3 y q)
        + A2 y p q * (v1 y p * v2 y q + v2 y p * v1 y q + v1 y p * v3 y q + v3 y p * v1 y q
            + v2 y p * v2 y q + v2 y p * v3 y q + v3 y p * v2 y q + v3 y p * v3 y q)))
    refine ord_sum 5 _ (fun p => ord_sum 5 _ (fun q => ?_))
    refine ord_add 5 _ _ (ord_add 5 _ _ ?_ ?_) ?_
    · exact ord_smul 5 (Hi p q) _ (ord_add 5 _ _ (ord_add 5 _ _
        (ord_mm 2 3 5 _ _ (by norm_num) (h2 p) (h3 q))
        (ord_mm 3 2 5 _ _ (by norm_num) (h3 p) (h2 q)))
        (ord_mm 3 3 5 _ _ (by norm_num) (h3 p) (h3 q)))
    · exact ord_mm 1 4 5 _ _ (by norm_num) (hB1 p q)
        (ord_add 4 _ _ (ord_add 4 _ _ (ord_add 4 _ _ (ord_add 4 _ _ (ord_add 4 _ _
          (ord_mm 1 3 4 _ _ (by norm_num) (h1 p) (h3 q))
          (ord_mm 3 1 4 _ _ (by norm_num) (h3 p) (h1 q)))
          (ord_mm 2 2 4 _ _ (by norm_num) (h2 p) (h2 q)))
          (ord_mm 2 3 4 _ _ (by norm_num) (h2 p) (h3 q)))
          (ord_mm 3 2 4 _ _ (by norm_num) (h3 p) (h2 q)))
          (ord_mm 3 3 4 _ _ (by norm_num) (h3 p) (h3 q)))
    · exact ord_mm 2 3 5 _ _ (by norm_num) (hB2 p q)
        (ord_add 3 _ _ (ord_add 3 _ _ (ord_add 3 _ _ (ord_add 3 _ _ (ord_add 3 _ _
          (ord_add 3 _ _ (ord_add 3 _ _
          (ord_mm 1 2 3 _ _ (by norm_num) (h1 p) (h2 q))
          (ord_mm 2 1 3 _ _ (by norm_num) (h2 p) (h1 q)))
          (ord_mm 1 3 3 _ _ (by norm_num) (h1 p) (h3 q)))
          (ord_mm 3 1 3 _ _ (by norm_num) (h3 p) (h1 q)))
          (ord_mm 2 2 3 _ _ (by norm_num) (h2 p) (h2 q)))
          (ord_mm 2 3 3 _ _ (by norm_num) (h2 p) (h3 q)))
          (ord_mm 3 2 3 _ _ (by norm_num) (h3 p) (h2 q)))
          (ord_mm 3 3 3 _ _ (by norm_num) (h3 p) (h3 q)))
  
  obtain ⟨hinvS, -, -⟩ := pcgb_px_coeff_bounds W hW h hh hpd x₀ R₀ hR₀ hball
  have hτ : ∀ p q : Fin 2, pcgbOrd x₀ σ 3 (pcgbTay2 (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q) x₀) := by
    intro p q
    obtain ⟨K, hK, hb⟩ := pcgb_taylor2_remainder W hW _ (hinvS p q) x₀ R₀ hR₀ hball
    refine ⟨K, hK, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hxR : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R₀ :=
      Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr ((hx.trans_le hσR).le)
    have hxW : x ∈ W := hball hxR
    obtain ⟨e0, e1, -⟩ := hb x hxR
    refine ⟨?_, e0, e1⟩
    have hφd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q) x :=
      ((hinvS p q).contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hxW)).differentiableAt (by simp)
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hLs, hBs, -, -⟩ := pcgb_form_pd2 x₀ x p
      (fun k => pd2 k (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q) x₀)
      (fun k l => pd2 k (pd2 l (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q)) x₀)
      (fun _ _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ _ _ => 0)
    have hd1 := (hLs.differentiable (by simp)) x
    have hd2 := (hBs.differentiable (by simp)) x
    show DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q - (h x₀)⁻¹ p q
      - ∑ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q) x₀ * (y - x₀) k
      - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ k : Fin 2, ∑ l : Fin 2,
          pd2 k (pd2 l (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q)) x₀ * (y - x₀) k * (y - x₀) l) x
    exact ((hφd.sub_const _).sub hd1).sub (hd2.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ))
  
  have hgrad : ∀ (a : Fin 2) (y : E2), pd2 a (pcgbJetD h x₀) y =
      pcgbJv1 (h x₀) x₀ y a + pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀)) x₀ y a +
        pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) (pcgbJg2 h x₀)) x₀ y a := by
    intro a y
    obtain ⟨-, h2, h3, h4, -, hQs, hTs, hUs⟩ := pcgb_form_pd2 x₀ y a (fun _ => 0) (h x₀)
      (pcgbJT (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀)) (pcgbJU (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) (pcgbJg2 h x₀))
    have hd1 := (hQs.differentiable (by simp)) y
    have hd2 := (hTs.differentiable (by simp)) y
    have hd3 := (hUs.differentiable (by simp)) y
    have hDdef : pcgbJetD h x₀ = fun y =>
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, h x₀ a b * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b) +
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
          pcgbJT (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) +
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
          pcgbJU (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) (pcgbJg2 h x₀) a b c d *
            (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d) := rfl
    rw [hDdef]
    unfold pd2 at h2 h3 h4 ⊢
    have hd12 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y =>
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, h x₀ a b * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b) +
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
          pcgbJT (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c)) y :=
      hd1.add hd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_add hd12 hd3, fderiv_fun_add hd1 hd2, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, h2, h3, h4]
    rfl
  have hsplit : ∀ (y : E2) (p q : Fin 2), (h y)⁻¹ p q = (h x₀)⁻¹ p q +
      pcgbJA1 (pcgbJg1 h x₀) x₀ y p q + pcgbJA2 (pcgbJg2 h x₀) x₀ y p q +
        pcgbTay2 (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q) x₀ y := by
    intro y p q
    simp only [pcgbTay2, pcgbJA1, pcgbJA2, pcgbJg1, pcgbJg2]
    ring
  
  have halg : ∀ (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ), (∀ a c : Fin 2, H a c = H c a) → H.det ≠ 0 →
      ∀ (g1 : Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (g2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
        (x : E2),
      ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2,
          (H⁻¹ p q + pcgbJA1 g1 x₀ x p q + pcgbJA2 g2 x₀ x p q) *
          (pcgbJv1 H x₀ x p + pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x p + pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU H g1 g2) x₀ x p) *
          (pcgbJv1 H x₀ x q + pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x q + pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU H g1 g2) x₀ x q)
        - 4 * pcgbJD H g1 g2 x₀ x =
      pcgbJE5 H⁻¹ (pcgbJA1 g1 x₀ x) (pcgbJA2 g2 x₀ x) (pcgbJv1 H x₀ x)
        (pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x) (pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU H g1 g2) x₀ x) := by
    intro H hHs' hdet' g1 g2 x
    have hsym : H 1 0 = H 0 1 := hHs' 1 0
    have hu : IsUnit H.det := Ne.isUnit hdet'
    have hR1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv H hu
    have hR2 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul H hu
    have n01 : (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) 0 1 = 0 :=
      Matrix.one_apply_ne (show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 by decide)
    have n10 : (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) 1 0 = 0 :=
      Matrix.one_apply_ne (show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide)
    have r00 : H 0 0 * H⁻¹ 0 0 + H 0 1 * H⁻¹ 1 0 = 1 := by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hR1 0) 0
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at this; exact this
    have r01 : H 0 0 * H⁻¹ 0 1 + H 0 1 * H⁻¹ 1 1 = 0 := by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hR1 0) 1
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, n01] at this; exact this
    have r10 : H 0 1 * H⁻¹ 0 0 + H 1 1 * H⁻¹ 1 0 = 0 := by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hR1 1) 0
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, n10, hsym] at this
      exact this
    have r11 : H 0 1 * H⁻¹ 0 1 + H 1 1 * H⁻¹ 1 1 = 1 := by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hR1 1) 1
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.one_apply_eq, hsym] at this; exact this
    have s00 : H⁻¹ 0 0 * H 0 0 + H⁻¹ 0 1 * H 0 1 = 1 := by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hR2 0) 0
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.one_apply_eq, hsym] at this; exact this
    have s01 : H⁻¹ 0 0 * H 0 1 + H⁻¹ 0 1 * H 1 1 = 0 := by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hR2 0) 1
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, n01] at this; exact this
    have s10 : H⁻¹ 1 0 * H 0 0 + H⁻¹ 1 1 * H 0 1 = 0 := by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hR2 1) 0
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, n10, hsym] at this
      exact this
    have s11 : H⁻¹ 1 0 * H 0 1 + H⁻¹ 1 1 * H 1 1 = 1 := by
      have := congrFun (congrFun hR2 1) 1
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at this; exact this
    have F1L0 : pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 0 * H⁻¹ 0 0 + pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 1 * H⁻¹ 1 0 = 2 * (x - x₀) 0 := by
      simp only [pcgbJv1, Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym]
      linear_combination (2 * (x - x₀) 0) * r00 + (2 * (x - x₀) 1) * r10
    have F1L1 : pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 0 * H⁻¹ 0 1 + pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 1 * H⁻¹ 1 1 = 2 * (x - x₀) 1 := by
      simp only [pcgbJv1, Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym]
      linear_combination (2 * (x - x₀) 0) * r01 + (2 * (x - x₀) 1) * r11
    have F1R0 : H⁻¹ 0 0 * pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 0 + H⁻¹ 0 1 * pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 1 = 2 * (x - x₀) 0 := by
      simp only [pcgbJv1, Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym]
      linear_combination (2 * (x - x₀) 0) * s00 + (2 * (x - x₀) 1) * s01
    have F1R1 : H⁻¹ 1 0 * pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 0 + H⁻¹ 1 1 * pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 1 = 2 * (x - x₀) 1 := by
      simp only [pcgbJv1, Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym]
      linear_combination (2 * (x - x₀) 0) * s10 + (2 * (x - x₀) 1) * s11
    have Eu1 : (x - x₀) 0 * pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 0 + (x - x₀) 1 * pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 1 =
        2 * pcgbPxQuad H x₀ x := by
      simp only [pcgbJv1, pcgbPxQuad, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    have Eu2 : (x - x₀) 0 * pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x 0 +
        (x - x₀) 1 * pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x 1 =
        3 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
          pcgbJT H g1 a b c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c := by
      simp only [pcgbJv2, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    have Eu3 : (x - x₀) 0 * pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU H g1 g2) x₀ x 0 +
        (x - x₀) 1 * pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU H g1 g2) x₀ x 1 =
        4 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
          pcgbJU H g1 g2 a b c d * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c * (x - x₀) d := by
      simp only [pcgbJv3, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring
    have F3 : ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2,
        pcgbJA1 g1 x₀ x p q * pcgbJv1 H x₀ x p * pcgbJv1 H x₀ x q =
        -8 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
          pcgbJT H g1 a b c * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c := by
      simp only [pcgbJA1, pcgbJv1, pcgbJT, Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym]; ring
    have hv2W : ∀ p : Fin 2, pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x p =
        ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) p b c * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c :=
      fun p => rfl
    have F4 : ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2,
        (H⁻¹ p q * pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x p * pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x q
          + pcgbJA1 g1 x₀ x p q * (pcgbJv1 H x₀ x p * pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x q
              + pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x p * pcgbJv1 H x₀ x q)
          + pcgbJA2 g2 x₀ x p q * pcgbJv1 H x₀ x p * pcgbJv1 H x₀ x q) =
        -12 * ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
          pcgbJU H g1 g2 a b c d * (x - x₀) a * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c * (x - x₀) d := by
      simp only [hv2W]
      simp only [pcgbJA1, pcgbJA2, pcgbJv1, pcgbJU, Fin.sum_univ_two, hsym]
      ring
    simp only [pcgbJE5, pcgbJD]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at F3 F4 Eu2 Eu3 ⊢
    linear_combination
      (pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 0 + pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x 0 + pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU H g1 g2) x₀ x 0) * F1L0 +
      (pcgbJv1 H x₀ x 1 + pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x 1 + pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU H g1 g2) x₀ x 1) * F1L1 +
      (pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x 0 + pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU H g1 g2) x₀ x 0) * F1R0 +
      (pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT H g1) x₀ x 1 + pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU H g1 g2) x₀ x 1) * F1R1 +
      2 * Eu1 + 4 * Eu2 + 4 * Eu3 + F3 + F4
  
  have hid : ∀ y : E2, pcgbPxEik h (pcgbJetD h x₀) y =
      pcgbJE5 (h x₀)⁻¹ (pcgbJA1 (pcgbJg1 h x₀) x₀ y) (pcgbJA2 (pcgbJg2 h x₀) x₀ y)
        (pcgbJv1 (h x₀) x₀ y) (pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀)) x₀ y)
        (pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) (pcgbJg2 h x₀)) x₀ y) +
      ∑ p : Fin 2, ∑ q : Fin 2, pcgbTay2 (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q) x₀ y *
        (pcgbJv1 (h x₀) x₀ y p + pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀)) x₀ y p +
          pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) (pcgbJg2 h x₀)) x₀ y p) *
        (pcgbJv1 (h x₀) x₀ y q + pcgbJv2 (pcgbJT (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀)) x₀ y q +
          pcgbJv3 (pcgbJU (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) (pcgbJg2 h x₀)) x₀ y q) := by
    intro y
    have hal := halg (h x₀) hHs hdet (pcgbJg1 h x₀) (pcgbJg2 h x₀) y
    have t00 := hsplit y 0 0
    have t01 := hsplit y 0 1
    have t10 := hsplit y 1 0
    have t11 := hsplit y 1 1
    have hDy : pcgbJetD h x₀ y = pcgbJD (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) (pcgbJg2 h x₀) x₀ y := rfl
    unfold pcgbPxEik
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hal ⊢
    rw [← hgrad 0 y, ← hgrad 1 y] at hal
    rw [← hgrad 0 y, ← hgrad 1 y, hDy]
    linear_combination hal +
      pd2 0 (pcgbJetD h x₀) y * pd2 0 (pcgbJetD h x₀) y * t00 +
      pd2 0 (pcgbJetD h x₀) y * pd2 1 (pcgbJetD h x₀) y * t01 +
      pd2 1 (pcgbJetD h x₀) y * pd2 0 (pcgbJetD h x₀) y * t10 +
      pd2 1 (pcgbJetD h x₀) y * pd2 1 (pcgbJetD h x₀) y * t11
  
  have hfinal : pcgbOrd x₀ σ 5 (pcgbPxEik h (pcgbJetD h x₀)) := by
    refine ord_congr 5 _ _ hid ?_
    exact ord_add 5 _ _ (hE5gen _ _ _ _ _ _ (hA1 _) (hA2 _) (hv1 _) (hv2 _) (hv3 _))
      (ord_sum 5 _ fun p => ord_sum 5 _ fun q =>
        ord_mm 4 1 5 _ _ (by norm_num)
          (ord_mm 3 1 4 _ _ (by norm_num) (hτ p q) (hw _ _ _ p)) (hw _ _ _ q))
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hb⟩ := hfinal
  refine ⟨c, hc, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨-, e1, e2⟩ := hb x (by rw [hσdef]; exact hx)
  exact ⟨e1, e2⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_taylor2_remainder
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (φ : E2 → ℝ)
    (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ V) (x₀ : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ R ⊆ V) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R,
      |pcgbTay2 φ x₀ x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 3 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (pcgbTay2 φ x₀) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (pcgbTay2 φ x₀)) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_form_pd2
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(x₀ x : E2) (p : Fin 2) (L : Fin 2 → ℝ) (B : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (U : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, L a * (y - x₀) a) x = L p ∧
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B a b * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b) x =
      ∑ b : Fin 2, (B p b + B b p) * (x - x₀) b ∧
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        T a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) x =
      ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (T p b c + T b p c + T b c p) * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c ∧
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        U a b c d * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d) x =
      ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        (U p b c d + U b p c d + U b c p d + U b c d p) * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c * (x - x₀) d ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, L a * (y - x₀) a) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B a b * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        T a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        U a b c d * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_px_coeff_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (x₀ : E2) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ σ ⊆ W) :
    (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) W) ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c y) W) ∧
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ σ, ∀ i j k : Fin 2,
      |(h y)⁻¹ i j - (h x₀)⁻¹ i j| ≤ B * dist y x₀ ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y‖ ≤ B ∧
      |∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c y| ≤ B ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c z) y‖ ≤ B

informal_problem.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (x₀ : E2) (R₀ : ℝ) (hR₀ : 0 < R₀)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ R₀ ⊆ W) :
    ∃ (M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (K : ℝ), (∀ a c : Fin 2, M a c = M c a) ∧ 0 ≤ K ∧
      ∀ x : E2, dist x x₀ < min R₀ 1 →
        |lap2 h (pcgbJetD h x₀) x - 4 - pcgbPxQuad M x₀ x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 3 ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => lap2 h (pcgbJetD h x₀) y - 4 - pcgbPxQuad M x₀ y) x‖ ≤
          K * dist x x₀ ^ 2

signature.name: pcgb_jet_lap_bound
signature.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)

      ∀ x : E2, dist x x₀ < min R₀ 1 →

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have s3 : ∀ (H : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (g1 : Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
      (g2 : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcgbJD H g1 g2 x₀) ∧ (∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (pcgbJD H g1 g2 x₀) x₀ = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (pcgbJD H g1 g2 x₀)) x₀ = H j i + H i j) ∧
      (∀ m i j : Fin 2, pd2 m (pd2 i (pd2 j (pcgbJD H g1 g2 x₀))) x₀ =
        pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) j i m + pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) j m i) := by
    intro H g1 g2
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hQs, hTs, hUs⟩ :=
      pcgb_form_pd2 x₀ x₀ 0 (fun _ => 0) H (pcgbJT H g1) (pcgbJU H g1 g2)
    have hDe : pcgbJD H g1 g2 x₀ = fun y =>
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, H a b * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b) +
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
          pcgbJT H g1 a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) +
        (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
          pcgbJU H g1 g2 a b c d * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d) := rfl
    have hDs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcgbJD H g1 g2 x₀) := by rw [hDe]; exact (hQs.add hTs).add hUs
    have h1 : ∀ j : Fin 2, pd2 j (pcgbJD H g1 g2 x₀) = fun y =>
        (∑ b : Fin 2, (H j b + H b j) * (y - x₀) b) +
        (∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) j b c * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) +
        (∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
          pcgbJV (pcgbJU H g1 g2) j b c d * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d) := by
      intro j
      funext y
      obtain ⟨-, e2, e3, e4, -, -, -, -⟩ :=
        pcgb_form_pd2 x₀ y j (fun _ => 0) H (pcgbJT H g1) (pcgbJU H g1 g2)
      rw [hDe]
      unfold pd2 at e2 e3 e4 ⊢
      rw [fderiv_fun_add ((hQs.add hTs).differentiable (by simp) y)
          (hUs.differentiable (by simp) y),
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        fderiv_fun_add (hQs.differentiable (by simp) y) (hTs.differentiable (by simp) y),
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, e2, e3, e4]
      simp only [pcgbJW, pcgbJV]
    have h2 : ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (pcgbJD H g1 g2 x₀)) = fun y =>
        (H j i + H i j) +
        (∑ c : Fin 2, (pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) j i c + pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) j c i) * (y - x₀) c) +
        (∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2, (pcgbJV (pcgbJU H g1 g2) j i c d +
          pcgbJV (pcgbJU H g1 g2) j c i d + pcgbJV (pcgbJU H g1 g2) j c d i) *
            (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d) := by
      intro i j
      rw [h1 j]
      funext y
      obtain ⟨e1, e2, e3, -, hLs, hBs, hTs', -⟩ :=
        pcgb_form_pd2 x₀ y i (fun b => H j b + H b j) (pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) j)
          (pcgbJV (pcgbJU H g1 g2) j) (fun _ _ _ _ => 0)
      unfold pd2 at e1 e2 e3 ⊢
      rw [fderiv_fun_add ((hLs.add hBs).differentiable (by simp) y)
          (hTs'.differentiable (by simp) y),
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        fderiv_fun_add (hLs.differentiable (by simp) y) (hBs.differentiable (by simp) y),
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, e1, e2, e3]
    have h3 : ∀ m i j : Fin 2, pd2 m (pd2 i (pd2 j (pcgbJD H g1 g2 x₀))) x₀ =
        pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) j i m + pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) j m i := by
      intro m i j
      rw [h2 i j]
      obtain ⟨e1, e2, -, -, hLs, hBs, -, -⟩ :=
        pcgb_form_pd2 x₀ x₀ m
          (fun c => pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) j i c + pcgbJW (pcgbJT H g1) j c i)
          (fun c d => pcgbJV (pcgbJU H g1 g2) j i c d + pcgbJV (pcgbJU H g1 g2) j c i d +
            pcgbJV (pcgbJU H g1 g2) j c d i) (fun _ _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ _ _ => 0)
      unfold pd2 at e1 e2 ⊢
      have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : E2 => H j i + H i j) := contDiff_const
      rw [fderiv_fun_add ((hc.add hLs).differentiable (by simp) x₀)
          (hBs.differentiable (by simp) x₀),
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
        fderiv_fun_add (differentiableAt_const _) (hLs.differentiable (by simp) x₀),
        ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, e1, e2]
      simp
    refine ⟨hDs, fun k => ?_, fun i j => ?_, h3⟩
    · rw [h1 k]; simp
    · rw [h2 i j]; simp
  
  have hx₀ : x₀ ∈ W := hball (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hR₀.le)
  have hH : (h x₀).PosDef := hpd x₀ hx₀
  have hsymy : ∀ y ∈ W, ∀ r s : Fin 2, h y r s = h y s r := by
    intro y hy r s
    have := (hpd y hy).isHermitian.apply s r
    simpa using this
  have hsym10 : h x₀ 1 0 = h x₀ 0 1 := hsymy x₀ hx₀ 1 0
  have hdet2 : (h x₀).det = h x₀ 0 0 * h x₀ 1 1 - h x₀ 0 1 * h x₀ 0 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hsym10]
  have hdetne : h x₀ 0 0 * h x₀ 1 1 - h x₀ 0 1 * h x₀ 0 1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hdet2]; exact hH.det_pos.ne'
  have hI00 : (h x₀)⁻¹ 0 0 = h x₀ 1 1 / (h x₀ 0 0 * h x₀ 1 1 - h x₀ 0 1 * h x₀ 0 1) := by
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, hdet2]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, div_eq_inv_mul, hsym10]
  have hI01 : (h x₀)⁻¹ 0 1 = -h x₀ 0 1 / (h x₀ 0 0 * h x₀ 1 1 - h x₀ 0 1 * h x₀ 0 1) := by
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, hdet2]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, div_eq_inv_mul, hsym10]
  have hI10 : (h x₀)⁻¹ 1 0 = -h x₀ 0 1 / (h x₀ 0 0 * h x₀ 1 1 - h x₀ 0 1 * h x₀ 0 1) := by
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, hdet2]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, div_eq_inv_mul, hsym10]
  have hI11 : (h x₀)⁻¹ 1 1 = h x₀ 0 0 / (h x₀ 0 0 * h x₀ 1 1 - h x₀ 0 1 * h x₀ 0 1) := by
    rw [Matrix.inv_def, hdet2]; simp [Matrix.adjugate_fin_two, Ring.inverse_eq_inv, div_eq_inv_mul, hsym10]
  generalize hΔdef : h x₀ 0 0 * h x₀ 1 1 - h x₀ 0 1 * h x₀ 0 1 = Δ at hI00 hI01 hI10 hI11 hdetne
  have hHiH : ∀ p s : Fin 2, ∑ r : Fin 2, (h x₀)⁻¹ p r * h x₀ r s = if p = s then 1 else 0 := by
    intro p s
    have hm := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (h x₀) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hH.det_pos.ne')
    have := congrFun (congrFun hm p) s
    rwa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
  
  have hGs : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) W :=
    (pcgb_px_coeff_bounds W hW h hh hpd x₀ R₀ hR₀ hball).1
  have dA : ∀ u : E2 → ℝ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W → DifferentiableAt ℝ u x₀ := fun u hu =>
    (hu.contDiffAt (hW.mem_nhds hx₀)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have pdS : ∀ (j : Fin 2) (u : E2 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u W → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (pd2 j u) W := by
    intro j u hu
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ u x (e2 j)) W
    exact (hu.fderiv_of_isOpen hW le_rfl).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  have pSub : ∀ (k : Fin 2) (u v : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ u x₀ → DifferentiableAt ℝ v x₀ →
      pd2 k (fun y => u y - v y) x₀ = pd2 k u x₀ - pd2 k v x₀ := by
    intro k u v hu hv
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sub hu hv, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
  have pMul : ∀ (k : Fin 2) (u v : E2 → ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ u x₀ → DifferentiableAt ℝ v x₀ →
      pd2 k (fun y => u y * v y) x₀ = u x₀ * pd2 k v x₀ + v x₀ * pd2 k u x₀ := by
    intro k u v hu hv
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hu hv, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
  have pSum : ∀ (k : Fin 2) (F : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ), (∀ i, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F i) x₀) →
      pd2 k (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 2, F i y) x₀ = ∑ i : Fin 2, pd2 k (F i) x₀ := by
    intro k F hF
    unfold pd2
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => hF i), ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  have hΓs : ∀ k i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (christoffel2 h k i j) W := by
    intro k i j
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ k l *
      (pd2 i (fun z => h z j l) x + pd2 j (fun z => h z i l) x - pd2 l (fun z => h z i j) x)) W
    exact contDiffOn_const.mul (ContDiffOn.sum fun l _ => (hGs k l).mul
      (((pdS i _ (hh j l)).add (pdS j _ (hh i l))).sub (pdS l _ (hh i j))))
  
  have hAsym : ∀ k r s : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => h y r s) x₀ = pd2 k (fun y => h y s r) x₀ := by
    intro k r s
    have ev : (fun y => h y r s) =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀] (fun y => h y s r) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hW.mem_nhds hx₀) (fun y hy => hsymy y hy r s)
    unfold pd2
    rw [ev.fderiv_eq]
  have hE : ∀ k r q : Fin 2, ∑ s : Fin 2, (h x₀ r s * pd2 k (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ s q) x₀ +
      (h x₀)⁻¹ s q * pd2 k (fun y => h y r s) x₀) = 0 := by
    intro k r q
    have ev : (fun y => ∑ s : Fin 2, h y r s * (h y)⁻¹ s q) =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀]
        (fun _ => if r = q then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      filter_upwards [hW.mem_nhds hx₀] with y hy
      have hm := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (h y) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hpd y hy).det_pos.ne')
      have := congrFun (congrFun hm r) q
      rwa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at this
    have h0 : pd2 k (fun y => ∑ s : Fin 2, h y r s * (h y)⁻¹ s q) x₀ = 0 := by
      unfold pd2; rw [ev.fderiv_eq]; simp
    rw [pSum k (fun s y => h y r s * (h y)⁻¹ s q)
      (fun s => dA _ ((hh r s).mul (hGs s q)))] at h0
    refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_).trans h0
    rw [pMul k (fun y => h y r s) (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ s q) (dA _ (hh r s)) (dA _ (hGs s q))]
  have hg1 : ∀ k p q : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q) x₀ =
      -∑ r : Fin 2, ∑ s : Fin 2,
        (h x₀)⁻¹ p r * pd2 k (fun y => h y r s) x₀ * (h x₀)⁻¹ s q := by
    intro k p q
    have e2 : ∑ s : Fin 2, (∑ r : Fin 2, (h x₀)⁻¹ p r * h x₀ r s) *
        pd2 k (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ s q) x₀ = pd2 k (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ p q) x₀ := by
      simp only [hHiH]; simp
    have e3 : ∑ r : Fin 2, (h x₀)⁻¹ p r * ∑ s : Fin 2, (h x₀ r s *
        pd2 k (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ s q) x₀ + (h x₀)⁻¹ s q * pd2 k (fun y => h y r s) x₀) = 0 := by
      simp only [hE, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two] at e2 e3 ⊢
    linear_combination e3 - e2
  
  have hT : ∀ a b c : Fin 2, pcgbJT (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) a b c =
      1 / 2 * pd2 c (fun y => h y a b) x₀ := by
    intro a b c
    simp only [pcgbJT, pcgbJg1, hg1, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    revert a b
    simp only [Fin.forall_fin_two]
    simp only [hI00, hI01, hI10, hI11, hsym10, hAsym c 1 0]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;> (field_simp; rw [← hΔdef]; ring)
  
  obtain ⟨hDs, hd1, hd2, hd3⟩ := s3 (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀) (pcgbJg2 h x₀)
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pcgbJetD h x₀) at hDs
  change ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (pcgbJetD h x₀) x₀ = 0 at hd1
  change ∀ i j : Fin 2, pd2 i (pd2 j (pcgbJetD h x₀)) x₀ = h x₀ j i + h x₀ i j at hd2
  change ∀ m i j : Fin 2, pd2 m (pd2 i (pd2 j (pcgbJetD h x₀))) x₀ =
    pcgbJW (pcgbJT (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀)) j i m +
      pcgbJW (pcgbJT (h x₀) (pcgbJg1 h x₀)) j m i at hd3
  generalize pcgbJetD h x₀ = D at hDs hd1 hd2 hd3 ⊢
  have hDW : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ D W := hDs.contDiffOn
  
  have hpm : ∀ m : Fin 2, pd2 m (lap2 h D) x₀ =
      ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2,
        ((h x₀)⁻¹ i j * (pd2 m (pd2 i (pd2 j D)) x₀ -
            ∑ k : Fin 2, (christoffel2 h k i j x₀ * pd2 m (pd2 k D) x₀ +
              pd2 k D x₀ * pd2 m (christoffel2 h k i j) x₀)) +
          (pd2 i (pd2 j D) x₀ - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x₀ * pd2 k D x₀) *
            pd2 m (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) x₀) := by
    intro m
    have hl : lap2 h D = fun x => ∑ i : Fin 2, ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j *
        (pd2 i (pd2 j D) x - ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k D x) := rfl
    have sK : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (fun x => ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k D x) W :=
      fun i j => ContDiffOn.sum fun k _ => (hΓs k i j).mul (pdS k _ hDW)
    have sI : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pd2 i (pd2 j D) x -
        ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k D x) W :=
      fun i j => (pdS i _ (pdS j _ hDW)).sub (sK i j)
    have sS : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => (h x)⁻¹ i j * (pd2 i (pd2 j D) x -
        ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k D x)) W :=
      fun i j => (hGs i j).mul (sI i j)
    rw [hl, pSum m (fun i x => ∑ j : Fin 2, (h x)⁻¹ i j * (pd2 i (pd2 j D) x -
        ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k D x))
      (fun i => dA _ (ContDiffOn.sum fun j _ => sS i j))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
    rw [pSum m (fun j x => (h x)⁻¹ i j * (pd2 i (pd2 j D) x -
        ∑ k : Fin 2, christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k D x)) (fun j => dA _ (sS i j))]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ?_)
    have hk : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 m (fun x => christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k D x) x₀ =
        christoffel2 h k i j x₀ * pd2 m (pd2 k D) x₀ +
          pd2 k D x₀ * pd2 m (christoffel2 h k i j) x₀ :=
      fun k => pMul m _ _ (dA _ (hΓs k i j)) (dA _ (pdS k _ hDW))
    rw [pMul m (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) _ (dA _ (hGs i j)) (dA _ (sI i j)),
      pSub m _ _ (dA _ (pdS i _ (pdS j _ hDW))) (dA _ (sK i j)),
      pSum m (fun k x => christoffel2 h k i j x * pd2 k D x)
        (fun k => dA _ ((hΓs k i j).mul (pdS k _ hDW)))]
    simp only [hk]
  
  have hpm0 : ∀ m : Fin 2, pd2 m (lap2 h D) x₀ = 0 := by
    intro m
    rw [hpm m]
    simp only [hd1, hd2, hd3, mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, sub_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    simp only [pcgbJW, hT, christoffel2, hg1, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    revert m
    simp only [Fin.forall_fin_two]
    simp only [hI00, hI01, hI10, hI11, hsym10, hAsym 0 1 0, hAsym 1 1 0]
    constructor <;> (field_simp; rw [← hΔdef]; ring)
  
  have hfs : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => lap2 h D y - 4) W :=
    (pcgb_lap2_contDiffOn W hW h hh hpd D hDW).sub contDiffOn_const
  have hf0 : lap2 h D x₀ - 4 = 0 := by
    simp only [lap2, hd1, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, sub_zero, hd2]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, hI00, hI01, hI10, hI11, hsym10]
    field_simp
    rw [← hΔdef]
    ring
  have hf1 : ∀ k : Fin 2, pd2 k (fun y => lap2 h D y - 4) x₀ = 0 := by
    intro k
    have : pd2 k (fun y => lap2 h D y - 4) x₀ = pd2 k (lap2 h D) x₀ := by
      unfold pd2; rw [fderiv_sub_const]
    rw [this, hpm0 k]
  
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hb⟩ :=
    pcgb_taylor2_remainder W hW (fun y => lap2 h D y - 4) hfs x₀ R₀ hR₀ hball
  refine ⟨Matrix.of fun a c => (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
      (pd2 a (pd2 c (fun y => lap2 h D y - 4)) x₀ + pd2 c (pd2 a (fun y => lap2 h D y - 4)) x₀),
    K, ?_, hK, ?_⟩
  · intro a c
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
    ring
  · intro x hx
    have hTay : pcgbTay2 (fun y => lap2 h D y - 4) x₀ = fun y => lap2 h D y - 4 -
        pcgbPxQuad (Matrix.of fun a c => (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
          (pd2 a (pd2 c (fun y => lap2 h D y - 4)) x₀ +
            pd2 c (pd2 a (fun y => lap2 h D y - 4)) x₀)) x₀ y := by
      funext y
      simp only [pcgbTay2, pcgbPxQuad, hf0, hf1, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero, sub_zero,
        Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
      ring
    have hxb : x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R₀ :=
      Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (le_trans hx.le (min_le_left _ _))
    obtain ⟨e0, e1, -⟩ := hb x hxb
    rw [hTay] at e0 e1
    exact ⟨e0, e1⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_form_pd2
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(x₀ x : E2) (p : Fin 2) (L : Fin 2 → ℝ) (B : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (T : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (U : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, L a * (y - x₀) a) x = L p ∧
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B a b * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b) x =
      ∑ b : Fin 2, (B p b + B b p) * (x - x₀) b ∧
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        T a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) x =
      ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (T p b c + T b p c + T b c p) * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c ∧
    pd2 p (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        U a b c d * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d) x =
      ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        (U p b c d + U b p c d + U b c p d + U b c d p) * (x - x₀) b * (x - x₀) c * (x - x₀) d ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, L a * (y - x₀) a) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, B a b * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2,
        T a b c * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c) ∧
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ d : Fin 2,
        U a b c d * (y - x₀) a * (y - x₀) b * (y - x₀) c * (y - x₀) d)

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_lap2_contDiffOn
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) V) (hpd : ∀ x ∈ V, (h x).PosDef)
    (u : E2 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ u V) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (lap2 h u) V

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_px_coeff_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(W : Set E2) (hW : IsOpen W) (h : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hh : ∀ a c : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => h x a c) W)
    (hpd : ∀ x ∈ W, (h x).PosDef) (x₀ : E2) (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ σ ⊆ W) :
    (∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => (h y)⁻¹ i j) W) ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun y => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c y) W) ∧
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ σ, ∀ i j k : Fin 2,
      |(h y)⁻¹ i j - (h x₀)⁻¹ i j| ≤ B * dist y x₀ ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => (h z)⁻¹ i j) y‖ ≤ B ∧
      |∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h y)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c y| ≤ B ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun z => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, (h z)⁻¹ a c * christoffel2 h k a c z) y‖ ≤ B

subgoal_signatures.name: pcgb_taylor2_remainder
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(V : Set E2) (hV : IsOpen V) (φ : E2 → ℝ)
    (hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ φ V) (x₀ : E2) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hball : Metric.closedBall x₀ R ⊆ V) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ R,
      |pcgbTay2 φ x₀ x| ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 3 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (pcgbTay2 φ x₀) x‖ ≤ K * dist x x₀ ^ 2 ∧

  have hP0 : ∀ x : E3, pcgbF2P x 0 = x 0 := by

  have hP1 : ∀ x : E3, pcgbF2P x 1 = x 1 := by
    intro x; simp [pcgbF2P, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hnsq3 : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hnsq2 : ∀ z : E2, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hPn : ∀ x : E3, ‖pcgbF2P x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    intro x
    have h1 := hnsq2 (pcgbF2P x)
    rw [hP0, hP1] at h1
    have h2 := hnsq3 x

  have hPball : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) ρ, pcgbF2P x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := by
    intro x hx

  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (⇑pcgbF2P) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) ρ) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ) :=

    intro x hx a b
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [pcgbF2A]
    · exact hAs (pcgbF2P x) (hPball x hx) 0 1
    · exact hAs (pcgbF2P x) (hPball x hx) 1 0

    · exact hcomp 0 1

    · exact hcomp 1 0
    · exact hcomp 1 1
    · exact contDiffOn_const
    · exact contDiffOn_const
    · exact contDiffOn_const

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  set K : Set E2 := Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2) with hKdef
  set J : Set ℝ := Set.Icc (-(ρ / 2)) (ρ / 2) with hJdef
  have hP0 : ∀ x : E3, pcgbF2P x 0 = x 0 := by
    intro x
    simp [pcgbF2P, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hP1 : ∀ x : E3, pcgbF2P x 1 = x 1 := by
    intro x
    simp [pcgbF2P, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hnsq3 : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hnsq2 : ∀ z : E2, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hPn : ∀ x : E3, ‖pcgbF2P x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    intro x
    have h1 := hnsq2 (pcgbF2P x)
    have h2 := hnsq3 x
    rw [hP0, hP1] at h1
    have h3 := norm_nonneg (pcgbF2P x)
    have h4 := norm_nonneg x
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 2)]
  
  have hHS : ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ ⊆ T ⁻¹' (K ×ˢ J) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 2) := by
      unfold ndsHalf at hx
      exact hx.1
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hx'
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, hTx, Set.mem_prod]
    have h2 := hnsq3 x
    have h4 := norm_nonneg x
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · show pcgbF2P x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2)
      rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
      exact le_trans (hPn x) hx'.le
    · show x 2 ∈ Set.Icc (-(ρ / 2)) (ρ / 2)
      rw [Set.mem_Icc]
      have h5 : x 2 ^ 2 < (ρ / 2) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1)]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
  
  have hKJ : MeasurableSet (K ×ˢ J) :=
    (Metric.isClosed_closedBall.prod isClosed_Icc).measurableSet
  have hJfin : volume J ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [hJdef, Real.volume_Icc]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hJreal : volume.real J = ρ := by
    rw [hJdef, Real.volume_real_Icc, max_eq_left (by linarith)]
    ring
  
  have hTS : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving T (volume.restrict (T ⁻¹' (K ×ˢ J)))
      (volume.restrict (K ×ˢ J)) := hT.restrict_preimage hKJ
  have hprod : (volume.restrict K).prod (volume.restrict J) =
      (volume : MeasureTheory.Measure (E2 × ℝ)).restrict (K ×ˢ J) :=
    MeasureTheory.Measure.prod_restrict K J
  
  have hφt : MemLp (fun p : E2 × ℝ => φ p.1) 2 (volume.restrict (K ×ˢ J)) := by
    rw [← hprod]
    have hae : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p : E2 × ℝ => φ p.1)

      hφ.aestronglyMeasurable.comp_fst

      MeasureTheory.integrableOn_const hJfin
    have h2 := hφ.integrable_sq.mul_prod h1
    simpa only [mul_one] using h2
  
  have hfS : MemLp (fun x => φ (pcgbF2P x)) 2 (volume.restrict (T ⁻¹' (K ×ˢ J))) := by
    have h1 := hφt.comp_measurePreserving hTS
    have heq : (fun p : E2 × ℝ => φ p.1) ∘ T = fun x => φ (pcgbF2P x) := by

      simp only [Function.comp, hTx]
    rw [heq] at h1
    exact h1

  have h8 : ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ, φ (pcgbF2P x) ^ 2 ≤

    MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_set hfS.integrable_sq

  have h9 : ∫ x in T ⁻¹' (K ×ˢ J), φ (pcgbF2P x) ^ 2 = ∫ p in K ×ˢ J, φ p.1 ^ 2 := by
    have h := hT.setIntegral_preimage_emb T.measurableEmbedding
      (fun p : E2 × ℝ => φ p.1 ^ 2) (K ×ˢ J)
    simp only [hTx] at h
    exact h
  
  have h10 : ∫ p in K ×ˢ J, φ p.1 ^ 2 = (∫ z in K, φ z ^ 2) * ρ := by
    have h := MeasureTheory.setIntegral_prod_mul (μ := (volume : MeasureTheory.Measure E2))
      (ν := (volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ)) (fun z : E2 => φ z ^ 2) (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) K J
    simp only [mul_one] at h
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, hJreal] at h
    exact h
  
  calc ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ, φ (pcgbF2P x) ^ 2
      ≤ ∫ x in T ⁻¹' (K ×ˢ J), φ (pcgbF2P x) ^ 2 := h8
    _ = ∫ p in K ×ˢ J, φ p.1 ^ 2 := h9
    _ = (∫ z in K, φ z ^ 2) * ρ := h10
    _ = ρ * ∫ z in Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2), φ z ^ 2 := mul_comm _ _

      Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ, φ m (pcgbF2P x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    intro φ hφ h
    have h' : Tendsto (fun m => ρ * ∫ z in Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2), φ m z ^ 2)
        atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using h.const_mul ρ
    exact squeeze_zero (fun m => setIntegral_nonneg hHm (fun x _ => sq_nonneg _))
      (fun m => (hcore (φ m) (hφ m)).2) h'
  
  have hPe0 : pcgbF2P (e 0) = e2 0 := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [pcgbF2P, e, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPe1 : pcgbF2P (e 1) = e2 1 := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [pcgbF2P, e, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPe2 : pcgbF2P (e 2) = 0 := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [pcgbF2P, e, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hchain : ∀ m, ∀ x ∈ ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ, ∀ a : Fin 3,
      partialDeriv a (fun y => u m (pcgbF2P y)) x =
        fderiv ℝ (u m) (pcgbF2P x) (pcgbF2P (e a)) := by
    intro m x hx a
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (u m) (pcgbF2P x) :=
      ((hu m).differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt
        (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hHB x hx))
    have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun y => u m (pcgbF2P y))
        ((fderiv ℝ (u m) (pcgbF2P x)).comp pcgbF2P) x :=
      hd.hasFDerivAt.comp x pcgbF2P.hasFDerivAt
    unfold partialDeriv
    rw [hcomp.fderiv]
    rfl
  
  have hC1 : MemLp (fun x => w (pcgbF2P x)) 2 (volume.restrict (ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ)) :=
    (hcore w hw).1
  
  have hC2 : ∀ a, MemLp (pcgbF2G G a) 2 (volume.restrict (ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ)) := by
    have h0 : MemLp (pcgbF2G G 0) 2 (volume.restrict (ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ)) :=
      (hcore (G 0) (hG 0)).1
    have h1 : MemLp (pcgbF2G G 1) 2 (volume.restrict (ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ)) :=
      (hcore (G 1) (hG 1)).1
    have h2 : MemLp (pcgbF2G G 2) 2 (volume.restrict (ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ)) := by
      have : pcgbF2G G 2 = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := rfl
      rw [this]
      exact MemLp.zero
    intro a
    fin_cases a
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
    · exact h2
  
  have hC3 : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ,
      (u m (pcgbF2P x) - w (pcgbF2P x)) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    hsq (fun m z => u m z - w z) (fun m => (hL2K _ (hcu m)).sub hw) hc0
  
  have hC4 : ∀ a, Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ,
      (partialDeriv a (fun y => u m (pcgbF2P y)) x - pcgbF2G G a x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h0 : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ,
        (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => u m (pcgbF2P y)) x - pcgbF2G G 0 x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have h := hsq (fun m z => pd2 0 (u m) z - G 0 z)
        (fun m => (hL2K _ (hcd m 0)).sub (hG 0)) (hc1 0)
      refine h.congr (fun m => ?_)
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hHm (fun x hx => ?_)
      show (pd2 0 (u m) (pcgbF2P x) - G 0 (pcgbF2P x)) ^ 2 =
        (partialDeriv 0 (fun y => u m (pcgbF2P y)) x - pcgbF2G G 0 x) ^ 2
      rw [hchain m x hx 0, hPe0]
      rfl
    have h1 : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ,
        (partialDeriv 1 (fun y => u m (pcgbF2P y)) x - pcgbF2G G 1 x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have h := hsq (fun m z => pd2 1 (u m) z - G 1 z)
        (fun m => (hL2K _ (hcd m 1)).sub (hG 1)) (hc1 1)
      refine h.congr (fun m => ?_)
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun hHm (fun x hx => ?_)
      show (pd2 1 (u m) (pcgbF2P x) - G 1 (pcgbF2P x)) ^ 2 =
        (partialDeriv 1 (fun y => u m (pcgbF2P y)) x - pcgbF2G G 1 x) ^ 2
      rw [hchain m x hx 1, hPe1]
      rfl
    have h2 : Tendsto (fun m => ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ,
        (partialDeriv 2 (fun y => u m (pcgbF2P y)) x - pcgbF2G G 2 x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have hz : ∀ m, ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ,
          (partialDeriv 2 (fun y => u m (pcgbF2P y)) x - pcgbF2G G 2 x) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        intro m
        have hfun : Set.EqOn
            (fun x => (partialDeriv 2 (fun y => u m (pcgbF2P y)) x - pcgbF2G G 2 x) ^ 2)
            (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ) := by
          intro x hx
          have hG2 : pcgbF2G G 2 x = 0 := rfl
          show (partialDeriv 2 (fun y => u m (pcgbF2P y)) x - pcgbF2G G 2 x) ^ 2 = 0
          rw [hchain m x hx 2, hPe2, map_zero, hG2]
          norm_num
        rw [setIntegral_congr_fun hHm hfun]
        simp
      exact tendsto_const_nhds.congr (fun m => (hz m).symm)
    intro a
    fin_cases a
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
    · exact h2
  exact ⟨hC1, hC2, hC3, hC4⟩

informal_problem.statement:
(ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} →
      ∫ z, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A z a b * G b z * pd2 a ζ z = 0)
    (ζ : E3 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ)
    (hζs : tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 2))
    (hζO : ∃ O : Set E3, IsOpen O ∧ {x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) ρ | x 0 = 0} ⊆ O ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, ζ x = 0)
    (t : ℝ) :
    ∫ z, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A z a b * G b z *
      (if 0 < z 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) t) else 0) = 0

signature.statement:
(ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hweak : ∀ ζ : E2 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ →
      tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} →
      ∫ z, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A z a b * G b z * pd2 a ζ z = 0)
    (ζ : E3 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ)
    (hζs : tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 2))
    (hζO : ∃ O : Set E3, IsOpen O ∧ {x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) ρ | x 0 = 0} ⊆ O ∧
      ∀ x ∈ O, ζ x = 0)
    (t : ℝ) :
    ∫ z, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A z a b * G b z *

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨O, hOo, hOface, hOzero⟩ := hζO
  obtain ⟨Et, hEt⟩ : ∃ Et : E2 → E3, ∀ y, Et y = cylPt (y 0) (y 1) t := ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  set Lm : E2 →L[ℝ] E3 := (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 0) +
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 1) with hLm
  have hEtL : Et = fun y => Lm y + t • e 2 := by
    funext y
    rw [hEt, hLm]
    simp [cylPt]
  have hEfd : ∀ z, HasFDerivAt Et Lm z := by
    intro z
    rw [hEtL]
    exact Lm.hasFDerivAt.add_const _
  have hE : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Et := by
    rw [hEtL]
    exact Lm.contDiff.add contDiff_const
  have hEc : Continuous Et := hE.continuous
  have hLe : ∀ a : Fin 2, Lm (e2 a) = e (Fin.castSucc a) := by
    intro a
    fin_cases a <;> ext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [hLm, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hE0 : ∀ z : E2, Et z 0 = z 0 := by
    intro z
    rw [hEt]
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hE1 : ∀ z : E2, Et z 1 = z 1 := by
    intro z
    rw [hEt]
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hnsq3 : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hnsq2 : ∀ z : E2, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hnorm : ∀ z : E2, ‖z‖ ≤ ‖Et z‖ := by
    intro z
    have h1 := hnsq3 (Et z)
    have h2 := hnsq2 z
    rw [hE0, hE1] at h1
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg z, norm_nonneg (Et z), sq_nonneg (Et z 2)]
  
  have hface : ∀ z : E2, z 0 = 0 → ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, ζ (Et y) = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    by_cases hx : Et z ∈ tsupport ζ
    · have hxb : Et z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) ρ := by
        have h := hζs hx
        rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at h ⊢
        linarith
      have hxO : Et z ∈ O := hOface ⟨hxb, by rw [hE0]; exact hz⟩
      exact Filter.eventually_of_mem (hEc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (hOo.mem_nhds hxO))
        (fun y hy => hOzero _ hy)
    · exact Filter.eventually_of_mem
        (hEc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds ((isClosed_tsupport ζ).isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hx))
        (fun y hy => image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hy)
  
  obtain ⟨η, hη⟩ : ∃ η : E2 → ℝ, ∀ z, η z = if 0 < z 0 then ζ (Et z) else 0 :=
    ⟨_, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hc0 : Continuous (fun y : E2 => y 0) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous
  have hpos : ∀ z : E2, 0 < z 0 → η =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun y => ζ (Et y) := by
    intro z hz
    filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt continuous_const hc0).mem_nhds hz] with y hy
    rw [hη, if_pos hy]
  have hnpos : ∀ z : E2, ¬ 0 < z 0 → η =ᶠ[𝓝 z] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro z hz
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (not_lt.mp hz) with h | h
    · filter_upwards [(isOpen_lt hc0 continuous_const).mem_nhds h] with y hy
      rw [hη, if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hy))]
    · filter_upwards [hface z h] with y hy
      rw [hη]
      split_ifs
      · exact hy
      · rfl
  have hζE : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ζ (Et y)) := hζ.comp hE
  have hηs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro z
    by_cases hz : 0 < z 0
    · exact hζE.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hpos z hz)
    · exact contDiffAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq (hnpos z hz)
  have hder : ∀ (z : E2) (a : Fin 2),
      pd2 a η z = if 0 < z 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (Et z) else 0 := by
    intro z a
    unfold pd2
    by_cases hz : 0 < z 0
    · rw [if_pos hz, (hpos z hz).fderiv_eq]
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y => ζ (Et y)) ((fderiv ℝ ζ (Et z)).comp Lm) z :=
        ((hζ.differentiable (by simp)) (Et z)).hasFDerivAt.comp z (hEfd z)
      rw [h1.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hLe]
      rfl
    · rw [if_neg hz, (hnpos z hz).fderiv_eq]
      simp
  
  have hsupp : Function.support η ⊆ {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0} ∩ Et ⁻¹' tsupport ζ := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Function.mem_support, hη] at hz
    by_cases h : 0 < z 0
    · rw [if_pos h] at hz
      exact ⟨le_of_lt h, subset_tsupport ζ hz⟩
    · rw [if_neg h] at hz
      exact absurd rfl hz
  have hC : IsClosed ({z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0} ∩ Et ⁻¹' tsupport ζ) :=
    (isClosed_le continuous_const hc0).inter ((isClosed_tsupport ζ).preimage hEc)
  have hts : tsupport η ⊆ {z : E2 | 0 ≤ z 0} ∩ Et ⁻¹' tsupport ζ := closure_minimal hsupp hC
  have hηt : tsupport η ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hts hz
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h2 := hζs h1
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at h2 ⊢
      have h3 := hnorm z
      linarith
    · show 0 < z 0
      by_contra hneg
      exact (notMem_tsupport_iff_eventuallyEq.mpr (hnpos z hneg)) hz
  have hηc : HasCompactSupport η :=
    IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E2) ρ) (isClosed_tsupport η)
      (hηt.trans (Set.inter_subset_left.trans Metric.ball_subset_closedBall))
  have hint := hweak η hηs hηc hηt
  have hfun : (fun z : E2 => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A z a b * G b z *
      (if 0 < z 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) t) else 0)) =
      fun z : E2 => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A z a b * G b z * pd2 a η z := by
    funext z
    simp only [hder, hEt]
  rw [hfun]
  exact hint

informal_problem.statement:
(ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (T : E3 ≃ᵐ (E2 × ℝ))
    (hT : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving T MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hTx : ∀ x : E3, T x = (pcgbF2P x, x 2)) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => A z a b) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ))
    (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2))))
    (ζ : E3 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ)
    (hζs : tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 2))
    (hslice : ∀ t : ℝ, ∫ z, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A z a b * G b z *
      (if 0 < z 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) t) else 0) = 0) :
    ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      pcgbF2A A x a b * pcgbF2G G b x * partialDeriv a ζ x = 0
