signature.statement:
(ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (T : E3 ≃ᵐ (E2 × ℝ))
    (hT : MeasureTheory.MeasurePreserving T MeasureTheory.volume MeasureTheory.volume)
    (hTx : ∀ x : E3, T x = (pcgbF2P x, x 2)) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => A z a b) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ))
    (G : Fin 2 → E2 → ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ k, MemLp (G k) 2 (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2))))
    (ζ : E3 → ℝ) (hζ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ζ) (hζc : HasCompactSupport ζ)
    (hζs : tsupport ζ ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 2))
    (hslice : ∀ t : ℝ, ∫ z, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A z a b * G b z *
      (if 0 < z 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) t) else 0) = 0) :
    ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      pcgbF2A A x a b * pcgbF2G G b x * partialDeriv a ζ x = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  classical
  
  have hcyl : ∀ t a b : ℝ, (cylPt t a b) 0 = t ∧ (cylPt t a b) 1 = a ∧ (cylPt t a b) 2 = b := by
    intro t a b
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hP0 : ∀ x : E3, (pcgbF2P x) 0 = x 0 := by
    intro x; simp [pcgbF2P, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hP1 : ∀ x : E3, (pcgbF2P x) 1 = x 1 := by
    intro x; simp [pcgbF2P, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hcylx : ∀ x : E3, cylPt (x 0) (x 1) (x 2) = x := by
    intro x
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact (hcyl _ _ _).1
    · exact (hcyl _ _ _).2.1
    · exact (hcyl _ _ _).2.2
  have hnsq3 : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hnsq2 : ∀ z : E2, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hpd0 : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (y : E3), y ∉ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 2) →
      partialDeriv i ζ y = 0 := by
    intro i y hy
    have hy' : y ∉ tsupport ζ := fun h => hy (hζs h)
    simp [partialDeriv, fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport ℝ hy']
  
  have hblock : ∀ x : E3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      pcgbF2A A x a b * pcgbF2G G b x * partialDeriv a ζ x
      = ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, A (pcgbF2P x) a b * G b (pcgbF2P x) *
          partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ x := by
    intro x
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [pcgbF2A, pcgbF2G, Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.castSucc_one]
  
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ : ∃ Ψ : E2 × ℝ → ℝ, Ψ = fun p => ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2,
      A p.1 a b * G b p.1 *
        (if 0 < p.1 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2) else 0) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have hpt : ∀ x : E3, Ψ (T x) = (ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ).indicator (fun x =>
      ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A x a b * pcgbF2G G b x * partialDeriv a ζ x) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hΨ, hTx]
    simp only [hP0, hP1, hcylx]
    by_cases hx0 : 0 < x 0
    · by_cases hxb : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 2)
      · have hxH : x ∈ ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ := ⟨hxb, hx0⟩
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hxH, hblock]
        simp only [if_pos hx0]
      · have hxH : x ∉ ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ := fun h => hxb h.1
        rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxH]
        have hz := fun i => hpd0 i x hxb
        simp [hz]
    · have hxH : x ∉ ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ := fun h => hx0 h.2
      rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxH]
      simp [hx0]
  have hH : MeasurableSet (ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ) := by
    unfold ndsHalf
    exact (Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)).measurableSet
  have hmain : ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      pcgbF2A A x a b * pcgbF2G G b x * partialDeriv a ζ x
      = ∫ p, Ψ p ∂((volume : Measure E2).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) := by
    calc ∫ x in ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
          pcgbF2A A x a b * pcgbF2G G b x * partialDeriv a ζ x
        = ∫ x, (ndsHalf (0 : E3) ρ).indicator (fun x =>
            ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A x a b * pcgbF2G G b x * partialDeriv a ζ x) x :=
          (integral_indicator hH).symm
      _ = ∫ x, Ψ (T x) := integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => (hpt x).symm)
      _ = ∫ p, Ψ p := hT.integral_comp' Ψ
      _ = ∫ p, Ψ p ∂((volume : Measure E2).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) := by
          first
          | rfl
          | rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod]
  
  have hsupp : ∀ (a : Fin 2) (p : E2 × ℝ),
      (if 0 < p.1 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2) else 0) ≠ 0 →
      p.1 ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2) ∧ p.2 ∈ Set.Icc (-(ρ / 2)) (ρ / 2) := by
    intro a p hne
    have hy : cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 2) := by
      by_contra hy
      apply hne
      split_ifs
      · exact hpd0 _ _ hy
      · rfl
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hy
    have h1 := hnsq3 (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2)
    obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2⟩ := hcyl (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2
    rw [c0, c1, c2] at h1
    have hn0 := norm_nonneg (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2)
    have hsq : ‖cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2‖ ^ 2 < (ρ / 2) ^ 2 :=
      pow_lt_pow_left₀ hy hn0 (by norm_num)
    have h2 := hnsq2 p.1
    have hρ2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ρ / 2 := by linarith
    constructor
    · rw [mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
      have hz : ‖p.1‖ ^ 2 < (ρ / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg p.2]
      exact le_of_lt (lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 hρ2 hz)
    · have ht : p.2 ^ 2 < (ρ / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p.1 0), sq_nonneg (p.1 1)]
      have hab := abs_lt.mp (abs_lt_of_sq_lt_sq ht hρ2)
      exact ⟨le_of_lt hab.1, le_of_lt hab.2⟩
  
  obtain ⟨Mζ, hMζ⟩ :=
    (hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).bounded_above_of_compact_support (hζc.fderiv ℝ)
  have hDb : ∀ (a : Fin 2) (p : E2 × ℝ),
      ‖(if 0 < p.1 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2) else 0)‖
        ≤ max Mζ 0 := by
    intro a p
    split_ifs
    · calc ‖partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2)‖
          ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ ζ (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2)‖ * ‖e (Fin.castSucc a)‖ :=
            ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
        _ = ‖fderiv ℝ ζ (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2)‖ := by simp [EuclideanSpace.norm_single]
        _ ≤ max Mζ 0 := (hMζ _).trans (le_max_left _ _)
    · simp
  
  have hc0 : Continuous fun p : E2 × ℝ => p.1 0 :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_fst
  have hc1 : Continuous fun p : E2 × ℝ => p.1 1 :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_fst
  have hDm : ∀ a : Fin 2, Measurable (fun p : E2 × ℝ =>
      if 0 < p.1 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2) else 0) := by
    intro a
    refine Measurable.ite ?_ ?_ measurable_const
    · exact measurableSet_lt measurable_const hc0.measurable
    · apply Continuous.measurable
      unfold partialDeriv
      refine Continuous.clm_apply ((hζ.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).comp ?_) continuous_const
      unfold cylPt
      exact ((hc0.smul continuous_const).add (hc1.smul continuous_const)).add
        (continuous_snd.smul continuous_const)
  
  have hKc : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2)) := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have hKsub : Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ :=
    Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith)
  have hGi : ∀ b, IntegrableOn (G b) (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2)) := by
    intro b
    haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2))) :=
      isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hKc.measure_lt_top.ne
    exact (hG b).integrable one_le_two
  have hKab : ∀ a b : Fin 2, Integrable ((Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2)).indicator
      (fun z => A z a b * G b z)) (volume : Measure E2) := by
    intro a b
    exact (IntegrableOn.continuousOn_mul (g := fun z => A z a b)
      ((hA a b).continuousOn.mono hKsub) (hGi b) hKc).integrable_indicator measurableSet_closedBall
  have hJ : Integrable ((Set.Icc (-(ρ / 2)) (ρ / 2)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)))
      (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    refine IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator ?_ measurableSet_Icc
    exact integrableOn_const (by rw [Real.volume_Icc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
  have hΨi : Integrable Ψ ((volume : Measure E2).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) := by
    have hterm : ∀ a b : Fin 2, Integrable (fun p : E2 × ℝ => A p.1 a b * G b p.1 *
        (if 0 < p.1 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2) else 0))
        ((volume : Measure E2).prod (volume : Measure ℝ)) := by
      intro a b
      have h1 := ((hKab a b).mul_prod hJ).bdd_mul (hDm a).aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hDb a))
      refine h1.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => ?_)
      show (if 0 < p.1 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2) else 0) *
          ((Metric.closedBall (0 : E2) (ρ / 2)).indicator (fun z => A z a b * G b z) p.1 *
            (Set.Icc (-(ρ / 2)) (ρ / 2)).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) p.2)
        = A p.1 a b * G b p.1 *
          (if 0 < p.1 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2) else 0)
      by_cases hD : (if 0 < p.1 0 then partialDeriv (Fin.castSucc a) ζ
          (cylPt (p.1 0) (p.1 1) p.2) else 0) = 0
      · rw [hD]; ring
      · obtain ⟨hK, hJ'⟩ := hsupp a p hD
        rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hK, Set.indicator_of_mem hJ']
        ring
    rw [hΨ]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ fun a _ => integrable_finset_sum _ fun b _ => hterm a b
  
  rw [hmain, integral_prod_symm Ψ hΨi]
  have hsl : ∀ t : ℝ, ∫ z, Ψ (z, t) = 0 := by
    intro t
    rw [hΨ]
    exact hslice t
  simp only [hsl, integral_zero]

informal_problem.statement:
(R : ℝ) (v' : E3 → ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ)
    (hv' : ContinuousOn v' (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R))
    (hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0})),
      w (pcgbF2P x) = v' x) :
    ∀ (x : E3) (τ : ℝ), x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} →
      x + τ • e 2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} → v' (x + τ • e 2) = v' x

signature.name: pcgb_flat2_x2_invariant
signature.statement:
(R : ℝ) (v' : E3 → ℝ) (w : E2 → ℝ)
    (hv' : ContinuousOn v' (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R))
    (hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0})),
      w (pcgbF2P x) = v' x) :
    ∀ (x : E3) (τ : ℝ), x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} →
      x + τ • e 2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} → v' (x + τ • e 2) = v' x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro x τ hx hxτ
  have hΩo : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}) := Metric.isOpen_ball.inter
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  have hs : Continuous (fun y : E3 => y + τ • e 2) := continuous_id.add continuous_const
  have hUo : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} ∩
      (fun y : E3 => y + τ • e 2) ⁻¹' (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0})) :=
    hΩo.inter (hΩo.preimage hs)
  have hxU : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} ∩
      (fun y : E3 => y + τ • e 2) ⁻¹' (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}) :=
    ⟨hx, hxτ⟩
  have h0 : pcgbF2P (e 2) = 0 := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [pcgbF2P, e, e2, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hPe : ∀ y : E3, pcgbF2P (y + τ • e 2) = pcgbF2P y := by
    intro y
    rw [map_add, map_smul, h0, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have h1 : ∀ᵐ y ∂volume, y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} →
      w (pcgbF2P y) = v' y :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' hΩo.measurableSet).mp hae
  have h2 : ∀ᵐ y ∂volume, (y + τ • e 2) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} →
      w (pcgbF2P (y + τ • e 2)) = v' (y + τ • e 2) :=
    (measurePreserving_add_right volume (τ • e 2)).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae
      (p := fun y => y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} → w (pcgbF2P y) = v' y) h1
  have h3 : (fun y => v' (y + τ • e 2)) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩
      {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} ∩
      (fun y : E3 => y + τ • e 2) ⁻¹' (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}))] v' := by
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, ae_restrict_iff' hUo.measurableSet]
    filter_upwards [h1, h2] with y hy1 hy2 hyU
    rw [← hy2 hyU.2, hPe, hy1 hyU.1]
  have hΩball : Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : E3) R :=
    Set.inter_subset_left
  have hc1 : ContinuousOn (fun y => v' (y + τ • e 2)) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩
      {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} ∩
      (fun y : E3 => y + τ • e 2) ⁻¹' (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0})) :=
    hv'.comp hs.continuousOn (fun y hy => hΩball hy.2)
  have hc2 : ContinuousOn v' (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} ∩
      (fun y : E3 => y + τ • e 2) ⁻¹' (Metric.ball (0 : E3) R ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0})) :=
    hv'.mono (fun y hy => hΩball hy.1)
  exact Measure.eqOn_open_of_ae_eq h3 hUo hc1 hc2 hxU

informal_problem.statement:
(ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => A z a b) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ))
    (v' : E3 → ℝ) (hv' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v' (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4)))
    (hinv : ∀ (x : E3) (τ : ℝ), x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} →
      x + τ • e 2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} → v' (x + τ • e 2) = v' x)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4), 0 ≤ x 0 →
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A y a b * partialDeriv b v' y) x
        = 0) :
    ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8), 0 ≤ z 0 →
      ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b *
        pd2 b (fun z' => v' (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) y) z = 0

signature.name: pcgb_flat2_eq_slice
signature.statement:
(ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (A : E2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ a b : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z => A z a b) (Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ))
    (v' : E3 → ℝ) (hv' : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v' (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4)))
    (hinv : ∀ (x : E3) (τ : ℝ), x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} →
      x + τ • e 2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} → v' (x + τ • e 2) = v' x)
    (heq : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4), 0 ≤ x 0 →
      ∑ a : Fin 3, partialDeriv a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A y a b * partialDeriv b v' y) x
        = 0) :
    ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8), 0 ≤ z 0 →
      ∑ a : Fin 2, pd2 a (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y a b *
        pd2 b (fun z' => v' (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) y) z = 0

proof.tactics:
by
  
  have hcyl : ∀ t a b : ℝ, (cylPt t a b) 0 = t ∧ (cylPt t a b) 1 = a ∧ (cylPt t a b) 2 = b := by
    intro t a b
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hP0 : ∀ x : E3, pcgbF2P x 0 = x 0 := by
    intro x
    simp [pcgbF2P, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hP1 : ∀ x : E3, pcgbF2P x 1 = x 1 := by
    intro x
    simp [pcgbF2P, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hnsq3 : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hnsq2 : ∀ z : E2, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hPn : ∀ x : E3, ‖pcgbF2P x‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    intro x
    have h1 := hnsq2 (pcgbF2P x)
    have h2 := hnsq3 x
    rw [hP0, hP1] at h1
    have h3 := norm_nonneg (pcgbF2P x)
    have h4 := norm_nonneg x
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 2)]
  have hE0ball : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8),
      cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hz ⊢
    have h1 := hnsq3 (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0)
    obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2⟩ := hcyl (z 0) (z 1) 0
    rw [c0, c1, c2] at h1
    have h2 := hnsq2 z
    have h3 := norm_nonneg (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0)
    have h4 := norm_nonneg z
    nlinarith
  have hPE : ∀ y : E2, pcgbF2P (cylPt (y 0) (y 1) 0) = y := by
    intro y
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · show pcgbF2P (cylPt (y 0) (y 1) 0) 0 = y 0
      rw [hP0, (hcyl _ _ _).1]
    · show pcgbF2P (cylPt (y 0) (y 1) 0) 1 = y 1
      rw [hP1, (hcyl _ _ _).2.1]
  have hF : ∀ x : E3, pcgbF2A A x 0 0 = A (pcgbF2P x) 0 0 ∧
      pcgbF2A A x 0 1 = A (pcgbF2P x) 0 1 ∧ pcgbF2A A x 0 2 = 0 ∧
      pcgbF2A A x 1 0 = A (pcgbF2P x) 1 0 ∧ pcgbF2A A x 1 1 = A (pcgbF2P x) 1 1 ∧
      pcgbF2A A x 1 2 = 0 ∧ pcgbF2A A x 2 0 = 0 ∧ pcgbF2A A x 2 1 = 0 ∧
      pcgbF2A A x 2 2 = 1 := fun x =>
    ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  
  have hΩo : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  have hdiff : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4)) →
      ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4), DifferentiableAt ℝ f x := fun f hf x hx =>
    (hf.differentiableOn (by simp)).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)
  have hpd_smooth : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ), ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4)) →
      ∀ i : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (partialDeriv i f) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4)) := by
    intro f hf i
    show ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (e i)) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4))
    exact (hf.fderiv_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball (by simp)).clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  
  have hd2 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0},
      partialDeriv 2 v' x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hΩo x hx
    have hγ : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x + s • e 2) (e 2) 0 := by
      have := ((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const (e 2)).const_add x
      simpa using this
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => v' (x + s • e 2)) (fderiv ℝ v' x (e 2)) 0 := by
      have hf : HasFDerivAt v' (fderiv ℝ v' x) (x + (0 : ℝ) • e 2) := by
        simpa using (hdiff v' hv' x hx.1).hasFDerivAt
      exact hf.comp_hasDerivAt (0 : ℝ) hγ
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => v' (x + s • e 2)) 0 0 := by
      refine (hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (v' x)).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ) hδ] with s hs
      apply hinv x s hx
      apply hball
      have hd : dist (x + s • e 2) x = |s| := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one,
          mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, hd]
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at hs
      exact hs
    exact h1.unique h2
  
  have hD : ContinuousOn (partialDeriv 2 (partialDeriv 2 v')) (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4)) :=
    (hpd_smooth _ (hpd_smooth v' hv' 2) 2).continuousOn
  have hDΩ : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0},
      partialDeriv 2 (partialDeriv 2 v') y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    have hev : partialDeriv 2 v' =ᶠ[𝓝 y] fun _ => (0 : ℝ) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem (hΩo.mem_nhds hy) (fun w hw => hd2 w hw)
    show fderiv ℝ (partialDeriv 2 v') y (e 2) = 0
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    simp
  have hd22 : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4), 0 ≤ x 0 →
      partialDeriv 2 (partialDeriv 2 v') x = 0 := by
    intro x hx hx0
    have hxn : ‖x‖ < ρ / 4 := mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hx
    have hc : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => x + ε • e 0) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 x) := by
      have hcont : Continuous (fun ε : ℝ => x + ε • e 0) := by fun_prop
      have h := hcont.tendsto 0
      simp only [zero_smul, add_zero] at h
      exact h.mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds
    have h1 : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => partialDeriv 2 (partialDeriv 2 v') (x + ε • e 0))
        (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (partialDeriv 2 (partialDeriv 2 v') x)) :=
      (hD.continuousAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx)).tendsto.comp hc
    have h2 : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => partialDeriv 2 (partialDeriv 2 v') (x + ε • e 0))
        (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
      refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (show (0 : ℝ) < ρ / 4 - ‖x‖ by linarith)] with ε hε
      symm
      apply hDΩ
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
        calc ‖x + ε • e 0‖ ≤ ‖x‖ + ‖ε • e 0‖ := norm_add_le _ _
          _ = ‖x‖ + ε := by
            rw [norm_smul, EuclideanSpace.norm_single, norm_one, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
              abs_of_pos hε.1]
          _ < ρ / 4 := by linarith [hε.2]
      · have hcoord : (x + ε • e 0) 0 = x 0 + ε := by
          simp [EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
        show 0 < (x + ε • e 0) 0
        rw [hcoord]
        linarith [hε.1]
    exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2
  
  obtain ⟨L, hLz⟩ : ∃ L : E2 →L[ℝ] E3, ∀ z : E2, L z = cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0 :=
    ⟨(EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 0) +
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (e 1), fun z => by simp [cylPt]⟩
  have hLe0 : L (e2 0) = e 0 := by
    rw [hLz]
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hLe1 : L (e2 1) = e 1 := by
    rw [hLz]
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hslice : ∀ (f : E3 → ℝ) (z : E2), DifferentiableAt ℝ f (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0) →
      pd2 0 (fun z' => f (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) z = partialDeriv 0 f (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0) ∧
      pd2 1 (fun z' => f (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) z = partialDeriv 1 f (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0) := by
    intro f z hf
    have hf' : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (L z) := by rw [hLz]; exact hf
    have hfun : (fun z' => f (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) = f ∘ L := by
      funext z'
      simp only [Function.comp, hLz]
    have hcomp : fderiv ℝ (fun z' => f (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) z = (fderiv ℝ f (L z)).comp L := by
      rw [hfun, fderiv_comp z hf' L.differentiableAt, ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv]
    unfold pd2 partialDeriv
    rw [hcomp, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hLe0, hLe1, hLz]
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  
  have hPmaps : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4), pcgbF2P x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) ρ := by
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_ball_zero_iff] at hx ⊢
    linarith [hPn x]
  have hAP : ∀ i j : Fin 2, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => A (pcgbF2P x) i j)
      (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4)) := fun i j =>
    (hA i j).comp pcgbF2P.contDiff.contDiffOn (fun x hx => hPmaps x hx)
  have hA3 : ∀ a b : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun x => pcgbF2A A x a b)
      (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4)) := by
    intro a b
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
      first
        | exact (hAP 0 0).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
        | exact (hAP 0 1).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
        | exact (hAP 1 0).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
        | exact (hAP 1 1).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
        | exact (contDiffOn_const (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
        | exact (contDiffOn_const (c := (1 : ℝ))).congr (fun x _ => rfl)
  have hH : ∀ a : Fin 3, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A y a b * partialDeriv b v' y)
      (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4)) := fun a =>
    ContDiffOn.sum (fun b _ => (hA3 a b).mul (hpd_smooth v' hv' b))
  
  have hrow0 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8),
      (∑ b : Fin 2, A y 0 b * pd2 b (fun z' => v' (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) y) =
        (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A x 0 b * partialDeriv b v' x) (cylPt (y 0) (y 1) 0) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hs0, hs1⟩ := hslice v' y (hdiff v' hv' _ (hE0ball y hy))
    obtain ⟨f00, f01, f02, -, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hF (cylPt (y 0) (y 1) 0)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three, hs0, hs1, f00, f01, f02, hPE y]
    ring
  have hrow1 : ∀ y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8),
      (∑ b : Fin 2, A y 1 b * pd2 b (fun z' => v' (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) y) =
        (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A x 1 b * partialDeriv b v' x) (cylPt (y 0) (y 1) 0) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hs0, hs1⟩ := hslice v' y (hdiff v' hv' _ (hE0ball y hy))
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, f10, f11, f12, -, -, -⟩ := hF (cylPt (y 0) (y 1) 0)
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three, hs0, hs1, f10, f11, f12, hPE y]
    ring
  
  have hrow2 : (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A y 2 b * partialDeriv b v' y) =
      partialDeriv 2 v' := by
    funext y
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, -, f20, f21, f22⟩ := hF y
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, f20, f21, f22]
    ring
  
  intro z hz hz0
  have hx : cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) := hE0ball z hz
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0) 0 := by rw [(hcyl _ _ _).1]; exact hz0
  have hzn : Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8) ∈ 𝓝 z := Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz
  have hT0 : pd2 0 (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y 0 b *
        pd2 b (fun z' => v' (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) y) z =
      partialDeriv 0 (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A x 0 b * partialDeriv b v' x)
        (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0) := by
    have hev : (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y 0 b *
          pd2 b (fun z' => v' (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) y) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (fun y => (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A x 0 b * partialDeriv b v' x)
          (cylPt (y 0) (y 1) 0)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hzn hrow0
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y 0 b *
        pd2 b (fun z' => v' (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) y) z (e2 0) = _
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact (hslice _ z (hdiff _ (hH 0) _ hx)).1
  have hT1 : pd2 1 (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y 1 b *
        pd2 b (fun z' => v' (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) y) z =
      partialDeriv 1 (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A x 1 b * partialDeriv b v' x)
        (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0) := by
    have hev : (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y 1 b *
          pd2 b (fun z' => v' (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) y) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (fun y => (fun x => ∑ b : Fin 3, pcgbF2A A x 1 b * partialDeriv b v' x)
          (cylPt (y 0) (y 1) 0)) :=
      Filter.eventually_of_mem hzn hrow1
    show fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ b : Fin 2, A y 1 b *
        pd2 b (fun z' => v' (cylPt (z' 0) (z' 1) 0)) y) z (e2 1) = _
    rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
    exact (hslice _ z (hdiff _ (hH 1) _ hx)).2
  have h3 := heq _ hx hx0
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, hrow2, hd22 _ hx hx0] at h3
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two, hT0, hT1]
  linarith

by
  have hP0 : ∀ x : E3, pcgbF2P x 0 = x 0 := by
    intro x
    simp [pcgbF2P, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hP1 : ∀ x : E3, pcgbF2P x 1 = x 1 := by
    intro x
    simp [pcgbF2P, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hnsq3 : ∀ x : E3, ‖x‖ ^ 2 = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hnsq2 : ∀ z : E2, ‖z‖ ^ 2 = z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => by positivity)),
      Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hcyl : ∀ t a b : ℝ, (cylPt t a b) 0 = t ∧ (cylPt t a b) 1 = a ∧ (cylPt t a b) 2 = b := by
    intro t a b
    simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hR : ∀ x : E3, cylPt (x 0) (x 1) 0 + x 2 • e 2 = x := by
    intro x
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [cylPt, EuclideanSpace.single_apply]
  have hD : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8) ∩ {z : E2 | 0 < z 0}) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) : E2 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  have hΩ : IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0}) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.inter (isOpen_lt continuous_const
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous)
  rw [ae_restrict_iff' hD.measurableSet, ae_iff]
  rw [ae_restrict_iff' hΩ.measurableSet, ae_iff] at hae
  have hsub : T ⁻¹' ({z : E2 | ¬(z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8) ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} →
        w z = v' (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0))} ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(ρ / 8)) (ρ / 8)) ⊆
      {x : E3 | ¬(x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} →
        w (pcgbF2P x) = v' x)} := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, hTx, Set.mem_prod] at hx
    obtain ⟨hxB, hxI⟩ := hx
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, _root_.not_imp, Set.mem_inter_iff, mem_ball_zero_iff] at hxB
    obtain ⟨⟨hpn, hp0⟩, hne⟩ := hxB
    rw [hP0, hP1] at hne
    rw [hP0] at hp0
    have h2 := hnsq2 (pcgbF2P x)
    rw [hP0, hP1] at h2
    have h3 := hnsq3 x
    obtain ⟨hI1, hI2⟩ := hxI
    have hpnn := norm_nonneg (pcgbF2P x)
    have hpsq : ‖pcgbF2P x‖ ^ 2 < (ρ / 8) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hx2sq : x 2 ^ 2 < (ρ / 8) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hxΩ : x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} := by
      refine ⟨?_, hp0⟩
      rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
      have hxsq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 < (ρ / 4) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hxn := norm_nonneg x
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      nlinarith
    have hyΩ : cylPt (x 0) (x 1) 0 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E3) (ρ / 4) ∩ {x : E3 | 0 < x 0} := by
      obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2⟩ := hcyl (x 0) (x 1) 0
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [mem_ball_zero_iff]
        have h4 := hnsq3 (cylPt (x 0) (x 1) 0)
        rw [c0, c1, c2] at h4
        have hysq : ‖cylPt (x 0) (x 1) 0‖ ^ 2 < (ρ / 4) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        have hyn := norm_nonneg (cylPt (x 0) (x 1) 0)
        by_contra hcon
        push_neg at hcon
        nlinarith
      · show 0 < (cylPt (x 0) (x 1) 0) 0
        rw [c0]
        exact hp0
    have hv := hinv _ (x 2) hyΩ (by rw [hR]; exact hxΩ)
    rw [hR] at hv
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, _root_.not_imp]
    refine ⟨hxΩ, ?_⟩
    rw [hv]
    exact hne
  have hprod : volume {z : E2 | ¬(z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8) ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} →
        w z = v' (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0))} * volume (Set.Ioo (-(ρ / 8)) (ρ / 8)) = 0 := by
    have h1 : volume (T ⁻¹' ({z : E2 | ¬(z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8) ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} →
          w z = v' (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0))} ×ˢ Set.Ioo (-(ρ / 8)) (ρ / 8))) =
        volume {z : E2 | ¬(z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E2) (ρ / 8) ∩ {z | 0 < z 0} →
          w z = v' (cylPt (z 0) (z 1) 0))} * volume (Set.Ioo (-(ρ / 8)) (ρ / 8)) := by
      rw [hT.measure_preimage_equiv]
      exact Measure.prod_prod _ _
    rw [← h1]
    exact measure_mono_null hsub hae
  have hI : volume (Set.Ioo (-(ρ / 8)) (ρ / 8)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo, Ne, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le]
    linarith
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact absurd h hI

environment.shared_definitions:
import Mathlib
set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000

/-!
# The Riemannian positive mass theorem in dimension three

This file contains **only the statement** of Theorem 1.1 of

> H. L. Bray, D. P. Kazaras, M. A. Khuri, D. L. Stern,
> *Harmonic functions and the mass of 3-dimensional asymptotically flat Riemannian manifolds*,
> J. Geom. Anal. (2022), arXiv:1911.06754,

(originally due to Schoen–Yau, 1979), with the proof left as `sorry`.

## Informal statement (BKKS, §1)

> Let `(M, g)` be a smooth connected 3-dimensional Riemannian manifold. It is *asymptotically
> flat* if there is a compact set `K ⊂ M` such that `M \ K = ⋃ₖ M_endᵏ`, where the ends
> `M_endᵏ` are finitely many, pairwise disjoint and diffeomorphic to the complement of a ball in
> `ℝ³`, and in each end there is a coordinate system with
> `|∂ˡ (g_ij - δ_ij)(x)| = O(|x|^(-q-l))`, `l = 0, 1, 2`, for some `q > 1/2`.
> The scalar curvature is assumed integrable, `R_g ∈ L¹(M)`, so that the ADM mass of each end
> `m = lim_{r→∞} (1/16π) ∫_{S_r} ∑_{i,j} (g_ij,i - g_ii,j) υ^j dA`
> is well defined (`υ` the unit outer normal of the coordinate sphere `S_r`, `dA` its area
> element).
>
> **Theorem 1.1.** If `(M, g)` is complete and asymptotically flat with nonnegative scalar
> curvature then `m ≥ 0`, and `m = 0` if and only if `(M, g) ≅ (ℝ³, δ)`.

## Why the ingredients have to be built here

Mathlib (as of the pinned version) has smooth manifolds, `mfderiv`, partial diffeomorphisms,
diffeomorphisms and the surface measure `Measure.toSphere` on the unit sphere, but it has **no**
Levi-Civita connection, curvature tensors, scalar curvature, asymptotically flat manifolds or ADM
mass. We therefore define the needed notions below, directly and transparently, in local
coordinates — exactly as in any textbook treatment.

## Conventions

* `E3 = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)` is the model space `ℝ³`; `M` is a smooth (`C^∞`) manifold
  modelled on `E3` (`IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M`), Hausdorff and connected.
* Following Mathlib, the tangent space at `x : M` is `TangentSpace 𝓘(ℝ, E3) x`, which is by
  definition `E3`, identified with the tangent space via the preferred chart `chartAt E3 x`.
  A Riemannian metric is therefore a family `g x : E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ` of symmetric positive
  definite bilinear forms (in the coordinates of `chartAt E3 x`). Its coefficient matrix in any
  local parametrisation `φ : E3 → M` is
  `g_ij(y) = g (φ y) (dφ_y eᵢ) (dφ_y eⱼ)`, where `dφ_y = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ,E3) 𝓘(ℝ,E3) φ y`
  (see `coeffMatrix`). Smoothness of `g` means smoothness of all these coefficients in all charts.
* The scalar curvature is computed from the coefficient matrix by the classical formulas
  `Γᵏᵢⱼ = ½ gᵏˡ (∂ᵢ gⱼₗ + ∂ⱼ gᵢₗ - ∂ₗ gᵢⱼ)`,
  `Rⱼₖ = ∂ᵢ Γⁱⱼₖ - ∂ⱼ Γⁱᵢₖ + Γⁱᵢₚ Γᵖⱼₖ - Γⁱⱼₚ Γᵖᵢₖ`,
  `R = gʲᵏ Rⱼₖ` (summation convention), in the preferred chart `chartAt E3 p` at `p`.
  (This is chart-independent; with this sign convention the round sphere has `R > 0`.)
* **Ends.** An end chart is a partial diffeomorphism `Φ : E3 → M` with source `{x : 1 < ‖x‖}`
  (the asymptotic coordinate system). Asymptotic flatness asks for finitely many end charts with
  pairwise disjoint images such that `M \ ⋃ₖ Φₖ({‖x‖ > 2})` is compact; this is the compact set
  `K` of the paper, and each `Φₖ({‖x‖ > 2})` is an end diffeomorphic to `ℝ³ \ B̄₂`.
  (Requiring the coordinates to extend a bit inside, to `{‖x‖ > 1}`, encodes that the paper's ends
  are diffeomorphic to the complement of an *open* ball, i.e. they include their boundary sphere;
  this rules out e.g. an extra cylindrical end hidden near the inner boundary of a chart.)
* **Decay.** `|∂ˡ (g_ij - δ_ij)(x)| = O(|x|^(-q-l))` as `|x| → ∞` for `l = 0, 1, 2`, expressed
  with `iteratedFDeriv` and `Asymptotics.IsBigO` along `Bornology.cobounded E3`.
* **Integrability of `R_g`.** Since `M \ ⋃ₖ Φₖ({‖x‖ > 2})` is compact and `R_g` is continuous,
  `R_g ∈ L¹(M, dV_g)` is equivalent to integrability of `R_g ∘ Φₖ · √(det g_ij)` over
  `{‖x‖ > 2}` (Lebesgue measure) for each end; this is how it is stated.
* **ADM mass.** With `∂ᵢ` the coordinate partial derivatives in the end, `υ = x/|x|` and
  `dA` the Euclidean area element of the coordinate sphere `S_r = {|x| = r}` (as in (1.2) of the
  paper), the flux is
  `(1/16π) ∫_{S_r} ∑_{i,j} (∂ᵢ g_ij - ∂ⱼ g_ii) υ^j dA
     = (1/16π) r² ∫_{S²} ∑_{i,j} (∂ᵢ g_ij - ∂ⱼ g_ii)(r ω) ω^j dσ(ω)`,
  where `σ = volume.toSphere` is the standard surface measure on the unit sphere `S² ⊂ ℝ³`
  (total mass `3 · vol(B₁) = 4π`). The mass is the limit as `r → ∞`. The theorem asserts in
  particular that this limit exists (Bartnik's well-definedness theorem).
  Sanity check: for `g = (1 + m/2r)⁴ δ` the flux tends to `m`.
* **Completeness** of `(M, g)` is a hypothesis of Theorem 1.1 and is stated explicitly. To this
  end the Riemannian distance is defined:
  - the speed of a `C¹` curve `γ : ℝ → M` at `t` is `|γ'(t)|_g = √(g_{γ t}(γ'(t), γ'(t)))`, where
    `γ'(t) = mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ,ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ,E3) γ t 1` (in the coordinates of `chartAt E3 (γ t)`, matching
    the convention for `g`);
  - the length of `γ` on `[0, 1]` is `L_g(γ) = ∫₀¹ |γ'(t)|_g dt` (see `curveLength`);
  - `d_g(p, q) = inf { L_g(γ) | γ : ℝ → M is C¹, γ 0 = p, γ 1 = q }` (see `riemannianDist`).
    Taking `C¹` curves rather than piecewise `C¹` ones gives the same infimum: a piecewise `C¹`
    path can be reparametrised, without changing its length, so that its velocity vanishes at
    the corners and at the endpoints, and then extended by constants outside `[0, 1]`.
  `(M, g)` is complete if `(M, d_g)` is a complete metric space, i.e. every `d_g`-Cauchy sequence
  `d_g`-converges (see `IsCompleteRiemannian`). By Hopf–Rinow this is the same as geodesic
  completeness. (With the definition of asymptotic flatness used here, completeness would actually
  follow from the other hypotheses; it is nevertheless stated, as in the paper.)
* **`(M, g) ≅ (ℝ³, δ)`** means there is a smooth diffeomorphism `F : M → ℝ³` with
  `g_p(v, w) = ⟪dF_p v, dF_p w⟫` for all `p, v, w`.
* The rigidity statement is per end: for every end `k` with mass `mₖ`, `mₖ = 0` iff
  `(M, g) ≅ (ℝ³, δ)`.
-/

noncomputable section

open Manifold Filter Topology MeasureTheory Metric
open scoped ContDiff

namespace PositiveMass

/-- The model space `ℝ³`. -/
abbrev E3 : Type := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)

/-- The `i`-th standard basis vector of `ℝ³`. -/
abbrev e (i : Fin 3) : E3 := EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)

/-- The coordinate partial derivative `∂ᵢ f (y)` of a function `f : ℝ³ → ℝ`. -/
def partialDeriv (i : Fin 3) (f : E3 → ℝ) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ f y (e i)

/-! ### Curvature of a metric given by its coefficient matrix in local coordinates -/

section LocalCoordinates

/-- Christoffel symbols `Γᵏᵢⱼ = ½ ∑ₗ gᵏˡ (∂ᵢ gⱼₗ + ∂ⱼ gᵢₗ - ∂ₗ gᵢⱼ)` of a metric whose coefficient
matrix in local coordinates is `G : ℝ³ → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ`. -/
def christoffel (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (k i j : Fin 3) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ l : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ k l *
    (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z j l) y + partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i l) y
      - partialDeriv l (fun z => G z i j) y)

/-- Ricci tensor `Rⱼₖ = ∂ᵢ Γⁱⱼₖ - ∂ⱼ Γⁱᵢₖ + Γⁱᵢₚ Γᵖⱼₖ - Γⁱⱼₚ Γᵖᵢₖ` in local coordinates. -/
def ricci (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (j k : Fin 3) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (christoffel G i j k) y - partialDeriv j (christoffel G i i k) y)
    + ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ p : Fin 3,
        (christoffel G i i p y * christoffel G p j k y
          - christoffel G i j p y * christoffel G p i k y)

/-- Scalar curvature `R = ∑ⱼₖ gʲᵏ Rⱼₖ` in local coordinates. -/
def scalarCurvatureLocal (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ k : Fin 3, (G y)⁻¹ j k * ricci G j k y

end LocalCoordinates

/-! ### Riemannian metrics on a 3-manifold -/

variable {M : Type*} [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace E3 M]

/-- The coefficient matrix `g_ij(y) = g (φ y) (dφ_y eᵢ) (dφ_y eⱼ)` of a field of bilinear forms
`g` (in Mathlib's tangent-space convention) with respect to a local parametrisation `φ : ℝ³ → M`. -/
def coeffMatrix (g : M → E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (φ : E3 → M) (y : E3) :
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  fun i j => g (φ y) (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y (e i))
    (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) φ y (e j))

/-- A smooth Riemannian metric on the 3-manifold `M`. At each point `x`, `g x` is a bilinear form on
`T_x M = E3` (expressed in the coordinates of `chartAt E3 x`, as in Mathlib's convention for tangent
spaces). -/
structure RiemannianMetric3 (M : Type*) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace E3 M] where
  /-- The metric tensor. -/
  g : M → E3 →L[ℝ] E3 →L[ℝ] ℝ
  /-- Symmetry. -/
  symm : ∀ x v w, g x v w = g x w v
  /-- Positive definiteness. -/
  posDef : ∀ x v, v ≠ 0 → 0 < g x v v
  /-- Smoothness: the coefficients in every chart are `C^∞` on the chart's target. -/
  smooth : ∀ x₀ : M, ∀ i j : Fin 3,
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun y => coeffMatrix g (chartAt E3 x₀).symm y i j) (chartAt E3 x₀).target

namespace RiemannianMetric3

/-- The coefficient matrix of the metric in a local parametrisation `φ : ℝ³ → M`. -/
def coeff (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (φ : E3 → M) : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  coeffMatrix g.g φ

/-- The scalar curvature `R_g(p)`, computed in the preferred chart at `p`. -/
def scalarCurvature (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p : M) : ℝ :=
  scalarCurvatureLocal (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm) (chartAt E3 p p)

end RiemannianMetric3

/-! ### The Riemannian distance and completeness -/

namespace RiemannianMetric3

/-- The velocity `γ'(t) ∈ T_{γ t} M` of a curve `γ : ℝ → M`, i.e. `dγ_t (1)`. -/
def velocity (γ : ℝ → M) (t : ℝ) : E3 :=
  mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) γ t (1 : ℝ)

/-- The `g`-length `L_g(γ) = ∫₀¹ √(g_{γ t}(γ'(t), γ'(t))) dt` of a curve `γ` on `[0, 1]`. -/
def curveLength (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (γ : ℝ → M) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, Real.sqrt (g.g (γ t) (velocity γ t) (velocity γ t))

/-- The Riemannian distance `d_g(p, q)`: the infimum of the `g`-lengths of the `C¹` curves
`γ : ℝ → M` with `γ 0 = p` and `γ 1 = q`. -/
def riemannianDist (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (p q : M) : ℝ :=
  ⨅ (γ : {γ : ℝ → M // ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 1 γ ∧ γ 0 = p ∧ γ 1 = q}),
    g.curveLength γ.1

/-- `(M, g)` is complete: `(M, d_g)` is a complete metric space, i.e. every `d_g`-Cauchy sequence
converges with respect to `d_g`. -/
def IsCompleteRiemannian (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) : Prop :=
  ∀ u : ℕ → M,
    (∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, g.riemannianDist (u m) (u n) < ε) →
      ∃ p : M, Tendsto (fun n => g.riemannianDist (u n) p) atTop (𝓝 0)

end RiemannianMetric3

/-! ### Asymptotically flat ends and the ADM mass -/

/-- An end chart: an asymptotic coordinate system `Φ : {x ∈ ℝ³ : ‖x‖ > 1} → M`, i.e. a smooth
partial diffeomorphism with source `{x | 1 < ‖x‖}`. -/
structure EndChart (M : Type*) [TopologicalSpace M] [ChartedSpace E3 M] where
  /-- The coordinate parametrisation of the end. -/
  Φ : PartialDiffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) E3 M ∞
  /-- It is defined exactly on the complement of the closed unit ball. -/
  source_eq : Φ.source = {x : E3 | 1 < ‖x‖}

/-- The ADM flux through the coordinate sphere of radius `r` in an end:
`(1/16π) ∫_{S_r} ∑_{i,j} (∂ᵢ g_ij - ∂ⱼ g_ii) υ^j dA`, written as
`(1/16π) r² ∫_{S²} ∑_{i,j} (∂ᵢ g_ij - ∂ⱼ g_ii)(r θ) θ^j dσ(θ)`. -/
def admFlux (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (Φ : EndChart M) (r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / (16 * Real.pi) * r ^ 2 *
    ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (fun x => g.coeff Φ.Φ x i j) (r • (θ : E3))
          - partialDeriv j (fun x => g.coeff Φ.Φ x i i) (r • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j
      ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere

/-- `(M, g)` is asymptotically flat (BKKS (1.1)), with integrable scalar curvature. -/
structure AsymptoticallyFlat (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) where
  /-- The number of ends. -/
  numEnds : ℕ
  /-- The asymptotic coordinate systems of the ends. -/
  ends : Fin numEnds → EndChart M
  /-- The decay rate. -/
  q : ℝ
  q_gt : 1 / 2 < q
  /-- The ends are pairwise disjoint. -/
  disjoint : Pairwise fun k l => Disjoint (ends k).Φ.target (ends l).Φ.target
  /-- Outside the ends `{‖x‖ > 2}`, the manifold is compact: this is the compact set `K`. -/
  isCompact_core : IsCompact (⋃ k, (ends k).Φ '' {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖})ᶜ
  /-- `|∂ˡ (g_ij - δ_ij)(x)| = O(|x|^(-q-l))` as `|x| → ∞`, for `l = 0, 1, 2`. -/
  decay : ∀ k, ∀ i j : Fin 3, ∀ l : ℕ, l ≤ 2 →
    (fun x : E3 => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ l
        (fun y => g.coeff (ends k).Φ y i j - if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) x‖)
      =O[Bornology.cobounded E3] fun x : E3 => ‖x‖ ^ (-q - (l : ℝ))
  /-- The scalar curvature is integrable, `R_g ∈ L¹(M, dV_g)` (stated end by end; on the compact
  core integrability is automatic). -/
  integrable_scalarCurvature : ∀ k,
    IntegrableOn
      (fun x : E3 => g.scalarCurvature ((ends k).Φ x) * Real.sqrt (g.coeff (ends k).Φ x).det)
      {x : E3 | 2 < ‖x‖}

/-- `(M, g)` is isometric to Euclidean space `(ℝ³, δ)`. -/
def IsometricToEuclidean [IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ M] (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) : Prop :=
  ∃ F : Diffeomorph 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) M E3 ∞,
    ∀ (p : M) (v w : E3),
      g.g p v w = @inner ℝ E3 _ (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F p v)
        (mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, E3) F p w)

/-- **Positive mass theorem** (BKKS, Theorem 1.1; Schoen–Yau). Let `(M, g)` be a smooth connected
complete asymptotically flat Riemannian 3-manifold with nonnegative scalar curvature. Then for every
end the ADM mass `m` exists and satisfies `m ≥ 0`, and `m = 0` if and only if `(M, g)` is isometric
to `(ℝ³, δ)`. -/

dynamic_headers.content:
def fluxLocal (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / (16 * Real.pi) * r ^ 2 *
    ∫ (θ : sphere (0 : E3) 1),
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (partialDeriv i (fun x => G x i j) (r • (θ : E3))
          - partialDeriv j (fun x => G x i i) (r • (θ : E3))) * (θ : E3) j
      ∂(volume : Measure E3).toSphere


def fluxDivLocal (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    (partialDeriv j (fun y => partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) y) x
      - partialDeriv j (fun y => partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) y) x)

def cylPt (t a b : ℝ) : E3 := t • e 0 + a • e 1 + b • e 2


def pullbackMetric (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (Y : E3 → E3) (x : E3) :
    Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  fun a b => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    (fderiv ℝ Y x (e a)) i * G (Y x) i j * (fderiv ℝ Y x (e b)) j


def admVec (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  fun j => ∑ i : Fin 3, (partialDeriv i (fun z => G z i j) x - partialDeriv j (fun z => G z i i) x)


def gradVec (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : E3) : Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  fun k => Real.sqrt (G x).det *
    ∑ l : Fin 3, (G x)⁻¹ k l * partialDeriv l (fun z => Real.sqrt ((G z)⁻¹ 0 0)) x


def capFlux (V : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ ρ in (0 : ℝ)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
    (V (cylPt L (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0
      - V (cylPt (-L) (ρ * Real.cos s) (ρ * Real.sin s)) 0) * ρ


def sideFlux (V : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
    (V (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) 1 * Real.cos s
      + V (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) 2 * Real.sin s) * L


def cylFlux (V : E3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  capFlux V L + sideFlux V L


def curvIntegrand (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t L s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let P : E3 := cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)
  let γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := fun a b => G P a.succ b.succ
  let γi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ := γ⁻¹
  let Γ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun a b c => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ d : Fin 2, γi a d *
    (partialDeriv b.succ (fun z => G z c.succ d.succ) P
      + partialDeriv c.succ (fun z => G z b.succ d.succ) P
      - partialDeriv d.succ (fun z => G z b.succ c.succ) P)
  let n : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![Real.cos s, Real.sin s]
  let v : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![-(L * Real.sin s), L * Real.cos s]
  (L - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, n a * Γ a b c * v b * v c) /
    (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, γi a b * n a * n b) *
      Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, γ a b * v a * v b))


def curvTerm (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi), curvIntegrand G t L s


def sternBoundary (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  4 * Real.pi * L - curvTerm G L + cylFlux (gradVec G) L


def P1 (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * capFlux (admVec G) L + (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
    ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      (Real.cos s * (partialDeriv 0 (fun z => G z 1 0) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
          - partialDeriv 1 (fun z => G z 0 0) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)))
        + Real.sin s * (partialDeriv 0 (fun z => G z 2 0) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
          - partialDeriv 2 (fun z => G z 0 0) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)))) * L


def P2 (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (L : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  4 * Real.pi * L + (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
    ∫ t in (-L)..L, ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(2 * Real.pi),
      (Real.cos s * (partialDeriv 1 (fun z => G z 2 2) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
          - partialDeriv 2 (fun z => G z 1 2) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)))
        + Real.sin s * (partialDeriv 2 (fun z => G z 1 1) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
          - partialDeriv 1 (fun z => G z 2 1) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)))) * L


def Dec1 (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (q R C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : E3, R < ‖x‖ → ∀ i j : Fin 3,
    |G x i j - (if i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q) ∧
    ∀ k : Fin 3, |partialDeriv k (fun y => G y i j) x| ≤ C * ‖x‖ ^ (-q - 1)


def CoordChange (X Y : E3 → E3) (q R₀ R₁ C : ℝ) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ R₀ ∧ R₀ ≤ R₁ ∧ 0 < C ∧
  ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ X {y : E3 | R₀ < ‖y‖} ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Y {x : E3 | R₁ < ‖x‖} ∧
  (∀ x : E3, R₁ < ‖x‖ → R₀ < ‖Y x‖ ∧ X (Y x) = x) ∧
  Set.InjOn X {y : E3 | R₀ < ‖y‖} ∧
  (∀ y : E3, R₀ < ‖y‖ →
    ‖X y - y‖ ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (1 - q) ∧
    (∀ i a : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv i (fun z => X z a) y - (if i = a then (1 : ℝ) else 0)| ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (-q)) ∧
    (∀ i j a : Fin 3,
      |partialDeriv i (fun z => partialDeriv j (fun w => X w a) z) y| ≤ C * ‖y‖ ^ (-q - 1)))

def riemannLocal (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (l i j k : Fin 3) (y : E3) : ℝ :=
  partialDeriv i (christoffel G l j k) y - partialDeriv j (christoffel G l i k) y
    + ∑ p : Fin 3, (christoffel G l i p y * christoffel G p j k y
        - christoffel G l j p y * christoffel G p i k y)

def RiemannianMetric3.gradInner (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (u w : M → ℝ) (p : M) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    (g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm (chartAt E3 p p))⁻¹ i j *
      partialDeriv i (fun y => u ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p) *
      partialDeriv j (fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)) (chartAt E3 p p)


def RiemannianMetric3.levelMeanCurv (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (w : M → ℝ) (p : M) : ℝ :=
  let G := g.coeff (chartAt E3 p).symm
  let f : E3 → ℝ := fun y => w ((chartAt E3 p).symm y)
  let y := chartAt E3 p p
  let N := Real.sqrt (g.gradInner w w p)
  lapLoc G f y / N -
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      (G y)⁻¹ i a * partialDeriv a f y * ((G y)⁻¹ j b * partialDeriv b f y) * hessLoc G f i j y)
      / N ^ 3


def IsExteriorDomain (Φ : EndChart M) (β : M → ℝ) (Re : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ β ∧
  (∀ p : M, β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ≠ 0) ∧
  2 ≤ Re ∧
  (∀ y : E3, Re < ‖y‖ → 0 < β (Φ.Φ y)) ∧
  IsCompact ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} \ Φ.Φ '' {y : E3 | Re < ‖y‖})


def SeparatesLevelComponents (β : M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : M → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (p₀ : M), ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ w →
    p₀ ∈ {p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t} →
    IsCompact (connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀) →
    (∀ p ∈ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀, ∃ ξ : E3,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) w p ξ ≠ 0 ∧
        (β p = 0 → mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) β p ξ = 0)) →
    ∃ K : Set M, IsCompact K ∧
      connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀ ⊆ K ∧
      K ⊆ {p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∧
      frontier K ⊆ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀ ∪ {p : M | β p = 0} ∧
      IsConnected (K \ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ w ⁻¹' {t}) p₀) ∧
      K ⊆ closure (interior K)


def NoCompactRegularLevel (β u : M → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (t : ℝ) (p₀ : M), p₀ ∈ {p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ u ⁻¹' {t} →
    IsCompact (connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}) p₀) →
    ∃ p ∈ connectedComponentIn ({p : M | 0 ≤ β p} ∩ u ⁻¹' {t}) p₀,
      mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) u p = 0

def cylGam (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t L s : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
  fun a b => G (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)) a.succ b.succ


def cylDG (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t L s : ℝ) : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ :=
  fun c a b => partialDeriv c.succ (fun z => G z a.succ b.succ)
    (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))


def curvKappa (γ γi : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (L s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let Γ : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun a b c => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ f : Fin 2, γi a f *
    (d b c f + d c b f - d f b c)
  let n : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![Real.cos s, Real.sin s]
  let v : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![-(L * Real.sin s), L * Real.cos s]
  (L - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, ∑ c : Fin 2, n a * Γ a b c * v b * v c) /
    (Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, γi a b * n a * n b) *
      Real.sqrt (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, γ a b * v a * v b))


def curvLinAlg (γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (L s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let k : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun a b => γ a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
  let n : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![Real.cos s, Real.sin s]
  let τ : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![-Real.sin s, Real.cos s]
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, k a b * n a * n b
      - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, k a b * τ a * τ b)
    - L * ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, τ c * τ a * n b * d c a b
    + L / 2 * ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, n c * τ a * τ b * d c a b


def curvWAlg (γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (d : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ) (L s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let k : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ := fun a b => γ a b - (if a = b then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
  let n : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![Real.cos s, Real.sin s]
  let τ : Fin 2 → ℝ := ![-Real.sin s, Real.cos s]
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, k a b * n a * n b
      - ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, k a b * τ a * τ b)
    - L / 2 * ∑ c : Fin 2, ∑ a : Fin 2, ∑ b : Fin 2, τ c * τ a * n b * d c a b


def cylQ (G : E3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (t L s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.cos s * (partialDeriv 1 (fun z => G z 2 2) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
      - partialDeriv 2 (fun z => G z 1 2) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)))
    + Real.sin s * (partialDeriv 2 (fun z => G z 1 1) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s))
      - partialDeriv 1 (fun z => G z 2 1) (cylPt t (L * Real.cos s) (L * Real.sin s)))

structure ExteriorCover.{uX} {N : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 N) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) where
  carrier : Type uX
  [instTop : TopologicalSpace carrier]
  [instChart : ChartedSpace E3 carrier]
  [instT2 : T2Space carrier]
  [instMfd : IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ carrier]
  metric : RiemannianMetric3 carrier
  af : AsymptoticallyFlat metric
  endIdx : Fin af.numEnds
  q_eq : af.q = hAF.q
  coeff_eq : ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ →
    metric.coeff (af.ends endIdx).Φ y = g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y
  scal_nonneg : ∀ p : carrier, 0 ≤ metric.scalarCurvature p
  β : carrier → ℝ
  Re : ℝ
  exterior : IsExteriorDomain (af.ends endIdx) β Re
  minimal : ∀ p : carrier, β p = 0 → metric.levelMeanCurv β p = 0
  separates : SeparatesLevelComponents β

instance ExteriorCover.instTopCarrier {N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    {g : RiemannianMetric3 N} {hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g} {k : Fin hAF.numEnds}
    (D : ExteriorCover g hAF k) : TopologicalSpace D.carrier := D.instTop

def IsMinimalFrontierChart (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ) (p : M) : Prop :=
  IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧ ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧
  (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
  V ∩ frontier U = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧
  (∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv f x = 0) ∧
  IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∧ IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | f x < 0}) ∧
  (V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | 0 < f x} ∨ V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0})


def HasMinimalFrontier (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 p, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), V ⊆ O ∧ IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p


def HasOneSidedMinimalFrontier (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (U : Set M) : Prop :=
  ∀ p ∈ frontier U, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ),
    IsMinimalFrontierChart g U V f p ∧ V ∩ U = V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}


def CircleLiftable (U : Set M) : Prop :=
  ∀ θ : C(U, Circle), ∃ φ : C(U, ℝ), ∀ x : U, θ x = Circle.exp (φ x)


structure RegionCover.{uX} {N : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 N) (hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g) (k : Fin hAF.numEnds) (U : Set N) where
  carrier : Type uX
  [instTop : TopologicalSpace carrier]
  [instChart : ChartedSpace E3 carrier]
  [instT2 : T2Space carrier]
  [instMfd : IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ carrier]
  metric : RiemannianMetric3 carrier
  af : AsymptoticallyFlat metric
  endIdx : Fin af.numEnds
  q_eq : af.q = hAF.q
  coeff_eq : ∀ y : E3, 1 < ‖y‖ →
    metric.coeff (af.ends endIdx).Φ y = g.coeff (hAF.ends k).Φ y
  scal_nonneg : ∀ p : carrier, 0 ≤ metric.scalarCurvature p
  W : Set carrier
  ρ : ℝ
  W_open : IsOpen W
  W_conn : IsConnected W
  ρ_ge : 2 ≤ ρ
  far_sub : ∀ y : E3, ρ < ‖y‖ → (af.ends endIdx).Φ y ∈ W
  compact : IsCompact (closure W \ (af.ends endIdx).Φ '' {y : E3 | ρ < ‖y‖})
  frontier_min : HasOneSidedMinimalFrontier metric W
  homeo : Nonempty (W ≃ₜ U)

instance RegionCover.instTopCarrier {N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    {g : RiemannianMetric3 N} {hAF : AsymptoticallyFlat g} {k : Fin hAF.numEnds} {U : Set N}

def IsMinimalSurfaceSet (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) (S : Set M) : Prop :=
  IsClosed S ∧ ∀ p ∈ S, ∀ O ∈ 𝓝 p, ∃ (V : Set M) (f : M → ℝ), V ⊆ O ∧ IsOpen V ∧ p ∈ V ∧
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) ∞ f ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, mfderiv 𝓘(ℝ, E3) 𝓘(ℝ, ℝ) f x ≠ 0) ∧
    V ∩ S = V ∩ f ⁻¹' {0} ∧ (∀ x ∈ V, f x = 0 → g.levelMeanCurv f x = 0) ∧
    IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | 0 < f x}) ∧ IsPreconnected (V ∩ {x | f x < 0})


def trappedSet (g : RiemannianMetric3 M) : Set M :=
  closure (⋃₀ {S : Set M | IsCompact S ∧ IsMinimalSurfaceSet g S})

structure FlipCoverTop.{uX} {N : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 N) (U : Set N) where
  carrier : Type uX
  [instTop : TopologicalSpace carrier]
  [instT2 : T2Space carrier]
  proj : carrier → N
  label : carrier → Bool
  bij : Function.Bijective (fun z : carrier => (proj z, label z))
  covering : IsCoveringMap proj
  label_locConst : ∀ z : carrier, proj z ∈ U → ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, label w = label z
  label_flip : ∀ (V' : Set carrier) (f : N → ℝ) (p : N) (a b : carrier),
    IsOpen V' → Set.InjOn proj V' → p ∈ frontier U →
    IsMinimalFrontierChart g U (proj '' V') f p →
    (proj '' V') ∩ U = (proj '' V') ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0} →
    a ∈ V' → b ∈ V' → 0 < f (proj a) → f (proj b) < 0 → label a ≠ label b

instance FlipCoverTop.instTopCarrier {N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    {g : RiemannianMetric3 N} {U : Set N} (T : FlipCoverTop g U) :
    TopologicalSpace T.carrier := T.instTop

instance FlipCoverTop.instT2Carrier {N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    {g : RiemannianMetric3 N} {U : Set N} (T : FlipCoverTop g U) :

structure FlipCover.{uX} {N : Type uX} [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E3 N]
    (g : RiemannianMetric3 N) (U : Set N) where
  carrier : Type uX
  [instTop : TopologicalSpace carrier]
  [instT2 : T2Space carrier]
  [instChart : ChartedSpace E3 carrier]
  [instMfd : IsManifold 𝓘(ℝ, E3) ∞ carrier]
  proj : carrier → N
  label : carrier → Bool
  bij : Function.Bijective (fun z : carrier => (proj z, label z))
  covering : IsCoveringMap proj
  label_locConst : ∀ z : carrier, proj z ∈ U → ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, label w = label z
  label_flip : ∀ (V' : Set carrier) (f : N → ℝ) (p : N) (a b : carrier),
    IsOpen V' → Set.InjOn proj V' → p ∈ frontier U →
    IsMinimalFrontierChart g U (proj '' V') f p →
    (proj '' V') ∩ U = (proj '' V') ∩ {x | f x ≠ 0} →
    a ∈ V' → b ∈ V' → 0 < f (proj a) → f (proj b) < 0 → label a ≠ label b
  chart_source : ∀ z w : carrier, w ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source →
    proj w ∈ (chartAt E3 (proj z)).source
  chart_eq : ∀ z w : carrier, w ∈ (chartAt E3 z).source →
    chartAt E3 z w = chartAt E3 (proj z) (proj w)

    {g : RiemannianMetric3 N} {U : Set N} (F : FlipCover g U) :
    TopologicalSpace F.carrier := F.instTop
